ext.ext_cn: 不容置疑的货币主义
ext.ext_en: ...the sacred cow of monetarism.

defs.def_en: If you describe a belief, custom, or institution as a sacred cow, you disapprove of people treating it with too much respect and being afraid to criticize or question it.

defs.def_cn: 欢乐时光（指酒吧的优惠时段）
defs.def_en: In a pub, happy hour is a period when drinks are sold more cheaply than usual to encourage people to come to the pub.
A sander is a machine for making wood or metal surfaces smoother.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坚韧不拔的;坚毅的;坚持不懈的

ext.ext_cn: 她是个锲而不舍的人，为了达到目标愿意长期苦干。
ext.ext_en: She is very tenacious and will work hard and long to achieve objectives...

ext.ext_cn: 在英国广播公司，他被看成一个不屈不挠、坚定执著的采访者。
ext.ext_en: He is regarded at the BBC as a tenacious and persistent interviewer.

defs.def_en: If you are tenacious, you are very determined and do not give up easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (观点、信念)根深蒂固的，深入人心的

ext.ext_cn: 会左右未来军事战略理论的一个特别根深蒂固的信念
ext.ext_en: ...a remarkably tenacious belief that was to dominate future theories of military strategy.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as an idea or belief as tenacious, you mean that it has a strong influence on people and is difficult to change or remove.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 施虐受虐式的性关系
ext.ext_en: ...a sado-masochistic relationship.

defs.def_en: Something that is sado-masochistic is connected with the practice of sado-masochism.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 程式化的;俗套的;非独创的

ext.ext_cn: 他的绘画作品做作而又俗套。
ext.ext_en: His paintings are contrived and formulaic.

defs.def_en: If you describe a way of saying or doing something as formulaic, you are criticizing it because it is not original and has been used many times before in similar situations.

ext.ext_cn: 这位营养学家就如何改善饮食给我提出了些建议，对我很有帮助。
ext.ext_en: The dietitian was helpful, making suggestions as to how I could improve my diet...

ext.ext_cn: 也许他已经听从了她的建议去河边散步了。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps he'd followed her suggestion of a stroll to the river...

defs.def_en: If you make a suggestion, you put forward an idea or plan for someone to think about.

ext.ext_cn: 对于任何暗示该法律需要修改的观点我们都拒绝接受。
ext.ext_en: We reject any suggestion that the law needs amending...

ext.ext_cn: 有人认为他可能会受到社会党的支持。
ext.ext_en: There are suggestions that he might be supported by the Socialists.

defs.def_en: A suggestion is something that a person says which implies that something is the case.

ext.ext_cn: 没有任何迹象表明双方将会达成一致。
ext.ext_en: There is no suggestion whatsoever that the two sides are any closer to agreeing...

ext.ext_cn: 没有任何依据表明有任何主要政党参与其中。
ext.ext_en: There is absolutely no suggestion of any mainstream political party involvement.

defs.def_en: If there is no suggestion that something is the case, there is no reason to think that it is the case.

ext.ext_cn: 略带一点流行的古铜色
ext.ext_en: ...that fashionably faint suggestion of a tan.

ext.ext_cn: 结实、没有一点凹陷的高弹力床垫
ext.ext_en: ...a firm, well-sprung mattress with not one suggestion of a sag.

defs.def_en: If there is a suggestion of something, there is a slight amount or sign of it.

ext.ext_cn: 暗示的力量是无比强大的。
ext.ext_en: The power of suggestion is very strong.

defs.def_en: Suggestion means giving people a particular idea by associating it with other ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 布伦基特先生提出的观点我们一个都不同意。
ext.ext_en: We disagree with every point Mr Blunkett makes...

ext.ext_cn: 戴夫·希尔的文章对《泰勒报告》的看法是正确的。
ext.ext_en: Dave Hill's article makes the right point about the Taylor Report...

defs.def_en: You use point to refer to something that someone has said or written.

ext.ext_cn: “如果他杀过一次人，那他一定已经杀了萨拉吧？”她说得有道理。
ext.ext_en: 'If he'd already killed once, surely he'd have killed Sarah?' She had a point there...

ext.ext_cn: 噢，约翰，关于那一点，我觉得你说得对。
ext.ext_en: Oh I take your point, John, about that.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a point, or if you take their point, you mean that you accept that what they have said is important and should be considered.

ext.ext_cn: “我请你跟我谈了吗？”——“问题不在这儿。”
ext.ext_en: 'Did I ask you to talk to me?' — 'That's not the point.'...

ext.ext_cn: 美国国会和媒体大都没搞清这一切的核心问题。
ext.ext_en: The American Congress and media mostly missed the point about all this.

defs.def_en: The point of what you are saying or discussing is the most important part that provides a reason or explanation for the rest.

ext.ext_cn: 想他有什么用呢？
ext.ext_en: What was the point of thinking about him?...

ext.ext_cn: 再留下来就没有意义了。
ext.ext_en: There was no point in staying any longer.

defs.def_en: If you ask what the point of something is, or say that there is no point in it, you are indicating that a particular action has no purpose or would not be useful.

ext.ext_cn: 报告中的很多细节是正确的。
ext.ext_en: Many of the points in the report are correct...

ext.ext_cn: 这个村庄最有意思的地方就是它的宗教。
ext.ext_en: The most interesting point about the village was its religion...

defs.def_en: A point is a detail, aspect, or quality of something or someone.

defs.def_cn: 地点；地方；（表示位置的）点，处

ext.ext_cn: 出于尊重，皇帝在离首都还有几个星期路程的地方迎接了他。
ext.ext_en: As a mark of respect the emperor met him at a point several weeks' march from the capital...

ext.ext_cn: 疼痛是从他右大腿的某处开始的。
ext.ext_en: The pain originated from a point in his right thigh.

defs.def_en: A point is a particular place or position where something happens.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都将在某个时间死去。
ext.ext_en: We're all going to die at some point...

ext.ext_cn: 一度曾有约7万名成员没有支付费用。
ext.ext_en: At one point, around 70,000 members had failed to pay...

defs.def_en: You use point to refer to a particular time, or to a particular stage in the development of something.
The point of something such as a pin, needle, or knife is the thin, sharp end of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这里是调频立体声103.7。
ext.ext_en: This is FM stereo one oh three point seven...

ext.ext_cn: 9.4%的通货膨胀率是8年来最糟的。
ext.ext_en: Inflation at nine point four percent is the worst for eight years.

defs.def_en: In spoken English, you use point to refer to the dot or mark in a decimal number that separates the whole numbers from the fractions.

defs.def_cn: （用作某些体育运动等计分单位的）点，分

ext.ext_cn: 他们在1977年的世界杯决赛中仅以一分之差输给了澳大利亚队。
ext.ext_en: They lost the 1977 World Cup final to Australia by a single point...

ext.ext_cn: 张伯伦在赛季中有4次得分不低于50。
ext.ext_en: Chamberlain scored 50 or more points four times in the season.

defs.def_en: In some sports, competitions, and games, a point is one of the single marks that are added together to give the total score.

ext.ext_cn: 观光者来自四面八方。
ext.ext_en: Sightseers arrived from all points of the compass.

defs.def_en: The points of the compass are directions such as North, South, East, and West.

ext.ext_cn: 驶过道岔的车轮发出的哐啷哐啷声
ext.ext_en: ...the rattle of the wheels across the points.

defs.def_en: On a railway track, the points are the levers and rails at a place where two tracks join or separate. The points enable a train to move from one track to another.

ext.ext_cn: 离最近的电掣位也太远
ext.ext_en: ...too far away from the nearest electrical point.

defs.def_en: A point is an electric socket.

ext.ext_cn: 我指了指坐得离我最近的男孩。
ext.ext_en: I pointed at the boy sitting nearest me...

ext.ext_cn: 他用烟斗柄指着我。
ext.ext_en: He pointed at me with the stem of his pipe...

defs.def_en: If you point at a person or thing, you hold out your finger towards them in order to make someone notice them.

ext.ext_cn: 戴维·卡恩用手指指着玛丽。
ext.ext_en: David Khan pointed his finger at Mary...

ext.ext_cn: 一名男子用手枪指着他们，扣动了扳机。
ext.ext_en: A man pointed a gun at them and pulled the trigger.

defs.def_en: If you point something at someone, you aim the tip or end of it towards them.

ext.ext_cn: 箭头指向卫生间。
ext.ext_en: An arrow pointed to the toilets...

ext.ext_cn: 无论走到哪里，罗盘仍然指向北或南。
ext.ext_en: You can go anywhere and still the compass points north or south...

defs.def_en: If something points to a place or points in a particular direction, it shows where that place is or it faces in that direction.

ext.ext_cn: 早些时候的报告显示学生学习更为刻苦、持久，并且怀有学习热情。
ext.ext_en: Earlier reports pointed to pupils working harder, more continuously, and with enthusiasm...

ext.ext_cn: 私人民意调查和使馆报告表明投票结果将会是否决。
ext.ext_en: Private polls and embassy reports pointed to a no vote.

defs.def_en: If something points to a particular situation, it suggests that the situation exists or is likely to occur.

defs.def_cn: 着重指出；强调；以…为证明

ext.ext_cn: 乔治·福多尔以运动开展过程中的其他不足为证。
ext.ext_en: George Fodor points to other weaknesses in the way the campaign has progressed...

ext.ext_cn: 古奇昨晚指出，他们的投球是在世界杯上取得成功的关键。
ext.ext_en: Gooch last night pointed to their bowling as the key to World Cup success.

defs.def_en: If you point to something that has happened or that is happening, you are using it as proof that a particular situation exists.

defs.def_cn: （用水泥等）勾嵌（砖或石墙的砌缝）
defs.def_en: When builders point a wall, they put a substance such as cement into the gaps between the bricks or stones in order to make the wall stronger and seal it.

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩不喜欢它，但那并不重要。
ext.ext_en: Brian didn't like it, but that was beside the point.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is beside the point, you mean that it is not relevant to the subject that you are discussing.

defs.def_cn: 谈到正题；讲到关键问题

ext.ext_cn: 他立刻切入正题道：“这件案子你处理得很棒。”
ext.ext_en: He came to the point at once. 'You did a splendid job on this case.'...

ext.ext_cn: 她到底还会不会讲到重点？
ext.ext_en: Was she ever going to get to the point?

defs.def_en: When someone comes to the point or gets to the point, they start talking about the thing that is most important to them.

ext.ext_cn: 亲爱的，我想你已证明你的观点了。
ext.ext_en: I think you've made your point, dear...

ext.ext_cn: 为证明这一点，波士顿大学的戴维·麦克莱兰博士对100名年龄在18至60岁之间的人进行了研究。
ext.ext_en: Dr David McCleland, of Boston University, studied one-hundred people, aged eighteen to sixty, to prove the point...

defs.def_en: If you make your point or prove your point, you prove that something is true, either by arguing about it or by your actions or behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 她特意尽可能地不呆在奥斯本庄园。
ext.ext_en: She made a point of spending as much time as possible away from Osborne House.

defs.def_en: If you make a point of doing something, you do it in a very deliberate or obvious way.

ext.ext_cn: 他正要说话时电话铃响了。
ext.ext_en: He was on the point of saying something when the phone rang...

ext.ext_cn: 她看起来就要哭了。
ext.ext_en: She looked on the point of tears.

defs.def_en: If you are on the point of doing something, you are about to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 贝克先生微笑着，说得很中肯。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Baker was smiling and to the point...

ext.ext_cn: 给他的描述言简意赅。
ext.ext_en: The description which he had been given was brief and to the point.

defs.def_en: Something that is to the point is relevant to the subject that you are discussing, or expressed neatly without wasting words or time.

ext.ext_cn: “她行不行？”——“嗯，某种程度上来说还可以。”
ext.ext_en: 'Was she good?' — 'Mmm. Up to a point.'

ext.ext_cn: 它起了一定作用。
ext.ext_en: It worked up to a point.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is true up to a point, you mean that it is partly but not completely true.

ext.ext_cn: 在流浪途中，他学会了西班牙语、意大利语、法语和一丁点儿俄语。
ext.ext_en: On his wanderings he's picked up Spanish, Italian, French and a smattering of Russian.

defs.def_en: Someone's wanderings are journeys that they make from place to place without staying in one place for a long time.

defs.def_cn: 不可能错的;不会犯错误的;永无过失的

ext.ext_cn: 尽管他经验丰富,却并非不会出错。
ext.ext_en: Although he was experienced, he was not infallible...

ext.ext_cn: 在时尚方面她的眼光错不了。
ext.ext_en: She had an infallible eye for style.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is infallible, they are never wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 圣殿山，圣殿真正坐落的地方
ext.ext_en: ...Temple Mount, the place where the Temple actually stood.

ext.ext_cn: 博物馆和名胜目录
ext.ext_en: ...a list of museums and places of interest...

defs.def_en: A place is any point, building, area, town, or country.

ext.ext_cn: 除了厨房特别干净外，这地方一片狼藉。
ext.ext_en: Except for the remarkably tidy kitchen, the place was a mess...

ext.ext_cn: 就一所破败的房子而言，它的状况还算不错，就好像仍在使用中一样。
ext.ext_en: For a ruin it was in good condition, as though the place was still being used.

defs.def_en: You can use the place to refer to the point, building, area, town, or country that you have already mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 他找到了一家提供住宿与早餐的旅馆。
ext.ext_en: He found a bed-and-breakfast place...

ext.ext_cn: 我和妻子发现了一些就餐的极好去处。
ext.ext_en: My wife and I discovered some superb places to eat...

defs.def_en: You can refer to somewhere that provides a service, such as a hotel, restaurant, or institution, as a particular kind of place.

defs.def_cn: （尤指在控制或组织下）发生，进行，举行

ext.ext_cn: 商讨是在湖边一座著名的别墅内进行的。
ext.ext_en: The discussion took place in a famous villa on the lake's shore...

ext.ext_cn: 她希望休快点举行婚礼。
ext.ext_en: She wanted Hugh's wedding to take place quickly...

defs.def_en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

defs.def_cn: （用于 any，no，some 或 every 之后）…地方

ext.ext_cn: 这个可怜的家伙显然复活节无处可去。
ext.ext_en: The poor guy obviously didn't have any place to go for Easter...

ext.ext_cn: 为什么不出去看看是否有我们可以跳舞的地方？
ext.ext_en: Why not go out and see if there's some place we can dance?

defs.def_en: Place can be used after 'any', 'no', 'some', or 'every' to mean 'anywhere', 'nowhere', 'somewhere', or 'everywhere'.

ext.ext_cn: 我没有钱到处旅行。
ext.ext_en: I don't have money to go places...

ext.ext_cn: 人们和他交谈、听他讲话、带他游览。
ext.ext_en: People were talking to him, listening to him, taking him places.

defs.def_en: If you go places, you visit pleasant or interesting places.

defs.def_cn: 所属的位置；应在的位置；适当的位置

ext.ext_cn: 他把相册放回架子上原来的地方。
ext.ext_en: He returned the album to its place on the shelf...

ext.ext_cn: 他坐回到沙发上自己的位子。
ext.ext_en: He returned to his place on the sofa.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the position where something belongs, or where it is supposed to be, as its place .

ext.ext_cn: 他走回到桌旁，在两个空位子中挑了一个就近的坐下。
ext.ext_en: He walked back to the table and sat at the nearest of two empty places...

ext.ext_cn: 我在一辆旅行车旁边找到了一个车位。
ext.ext_en: I found a place to park beside a station wagon.

defs.def_en: A place is a seat or position that is available for someone to occupy.

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望看到更多的女性在管理或职业的阶梯上占据高位。
ext.ext_en: They want to see more women take their place higher up the corporate or professional ladder.

ext.ext_cn: 基督教在我们国家文化中的重要地位
ext.ext_en: ...the important place of Christianity in our national culture.

defs.def_en: Someone's or something's place in a society, system, or situation is their position in relation to other people or things.

ext.ext_cn: 简的进球帮助英国队在巴塞罗那奥运会上获得了第三名。
ext.ext_en: Jane's goals helped Britain win third place in the Barcelona games...

ext.ext_cn: 他在民意测验中已升至第二位。
ext.ext_en: He has risen to second place in the opinion polls.

defs.def_en: Your place in a race or competition is your position in relation to the other competitors. If you are in first place, you are ahead of all the other competitors.

ext.ext_cn: 他已在一队里获得了一席之地。
ext.ext_en: He has found a place in the first team...

ext.ext_cn: 所有候选人都在管理委员会赢得了席位。
ext.ext_en: All the candidates won places on the  ruling council...

defs.def_en: If you get a place in a team, on a committee, or on a course of study, for example, you are accepted as a member of the team or committee or as a student on the  course.

ext.ext_cn: 不知怎的，似乎是到了该结束的合适时机了。
ext.ext_en: It seemed an appropriate place to end somehow...

ext.ext_cn: 这会儿不是讨论个没完的时候。
ext.ext_en: This is not the place for a lengthy discussion.

defs.def_en: A good place to do something in a situation or activity is a good time or stage at which to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都回我那里吧！
ext.ext_en: Let's all go back to my place!...

ext.ext_cn: 他不断鼓励罗茜为自己找个住处。
ext.ext_en: He kept encouraging Rosie to find a place of her own.

defs.def_en: Your place is the house or flat where you live.

defs.def_cn: （书等中）正读到的部分；（演说等中）正讲到的地方

ext.ext_cn: 她用手指着她读到的地方
ext.ext_en: ...her finger marking her place in the book...

ext.ext_cn: 他忘了稿子讲到哪里了。
ext.ext_en: He lost his place in his notes.

defs.def_en: Your place in a book or speech is the point you have reached in reading the book or making the speech.

ext.ext_cn: 袖珍计算器只能计算到小数点后8位数。
ext.ext_en: A pocket calculator only works to eight decimal places.

defs.def_en: If you say how many decimal places there are in a number, you are saying how many numbers there are to the right of the decimal point.

defs.def_cn: （尤指小心、稳当或特意地）放置

ext.ext_cn: 布兰德用手绢把它包好，放到自己夹克的内兜里。
ext.ext_en: Brand folded it in his handkerchief and placed it in the inside pocket of his jacket...

ext.ext_cn: 椅子匆忙摆成了几排，等着家长们到来。
ext.ext_en: Chairs were hastily placed in rows for the parents.

defs.def_en: If you place something somewhere, you put it in a particular position, especially in a careful, firm, or deliberate way.

ext.ext_cn: 铺天盖地的抗议让总统倍感压力。
ext.ext_en: Widespread protests have placed the President under serious pressure...

ext.ext_cn: 这场危机可能会使这一关系有破裂的危险。
ext.ext_en: The crisis could well place the relationship at risk...

defs.def_en: To place a person or thing in a particular state means to cause them to be in it.

defs.def_cn: 把（重点等）放（在）；将（责任等）归（于）

ext.ext_cn: 我们应该通过让年轻人承担责任、令他们进行真正的尝试来教育他们。
ext.ext_en: We should teach the young by placing responsibility on them and by trusting them in real endeavors...

ext.ext_cn: 他非常重视家庭生活和家人之间的关系。
ext.ext_en: He placed great emphasis on the importance of family life and ties...

defs.def_en: You can use place instead of 'put' or 'lay' in certain expressions where the meaning is carried by the following noun. For example, if you place emphasis on something, you emphasize it, and if you place the blame on someone, you blame them.

defs.def_cn: 评定，划分（为某一等级或类别）

ext.ext_cn: 当局把这种毒品列为A类，与海洛因和可卡因一样。
ext.ext_en: The authorities have placed the drug in Class A, the same category as heroin and cocaine...

ext.ext_cn: 鲍里斯·西季斯医生是一位出生于俄国、素负盛名的精神病学家，有些人认为他堪与皮埃尔·雅内和莫顿·普林斯比肩。
ext.ext_en: Dr. Boris Sidis was a Russian-born psychiatrist who enjoyed considerable prestige; some placed him on a par with Pierre Janet and Morton Prince.

defs.def_en: If you place someone or something in a particular class or group, you label or judge them in that way.

defs.def_cn: （在比赛或竞赛中）使获得第…名，使名列；（美国英语中常指）使获得亚军，使名列第二

ext.ext_cn: 我好几次名列第二、第三，但从未得过冠军。
ext.ext_en: I had been placed 2nd and 3rd a few times but had never won...

ext.ext_cn: 排名第二的欧塞尔队出人意料地在主场以0比2败给了南特队。
ext.ext_en: Second-placed Auxerre suffered a surprising 2-0 home defeat to Nantes.

defs.def_en: If a competitor is placed first, second, or last, for example, that is their position at the end of a race or competition. In American English, be placed often means 'finish in second position'.

ext.ext_cn: 早早就提前下单是个好主意。
ext.ext_en: It is a good idea to place your order well in advance...

ext.ext_cn: 点菜前先仔细看一下菜单。
ext.ext_en: Before placing your order for a meal, study the menu.

defs.def_en: If you place an order for a product or for a meal, you ask for it to be sent or brought to you.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在当地报纸上登了一则招聘秘书的广告。
ext.ext_en: They placed an advertisement in the local paper for a secretary.

defs.def_en: If you place an advertisement in a newspaper, you arrange for the advertisement to appear in the newspaper.

defs.def_cn: （请接线员帮助接通时）说出，给出（联系人的电话号码）

ext.ext_cn: 我想打一个国际长途。
ext.ext_en: I'd like to place an overseas call.

defs.def_en: If you place a telephone call to a particular place, you give the telephone operator the number of the person you want to speak to and ask them to connect you.

ext.ext_cn: 但这场比赛他已经在其中一匹马身上下了赌注。
ext.ext_en: For this race, though, he had already placed a bet on one of the horses.

defs.def_en: If you place a bet, you bet money on something.

defs.def_cn: 为…找到职位；安插；为…找到住处；安置

ext.ext_cn: 他们在1861年设法把14名女性安排到殖民地有报酬的职位上。
ext.ext_en: In 1861, they managed to place fourteen women in paid positions in the colonies...

ext.ext_cn: 遇到难以安置的孩子，收容中心会提供长期的照顾。
ext.ext_en: In cases where it proves difficult to place a child, the reception centre provides long-term care.

defs.def_en: If an agency or organization places someone, it finds them a job or somewhere to live.

ext.ext_cn: 这个男子让人感到有些熟悉，但是希尔斯滕一时认不出他是谁。
ext.ext_en: Something about the man was familiar, although Hillsden could not immediately place him...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管声音听上去耳熟，但他不能马上想起是谁。
ext.ext_en: It was a voice he recognized, though he could not immediately place it.

defs.def_en: If you say that you cannot place someone, you mean that you recognize them but cannot remember exactly who they are or where you have met them before.

ext.ext_cn: 各处都有企业商家倒闭。
ext.ext_en: Businesses are closing down all over the place...

ext.ext_cn: 到处都有罢工纠察线。
ext.ext_en: There are picket lines all over the place.

defs.def_en: If something is happening all over the place, it is happening in many different places.

defs.def_cn: （通常指乱七八糟地）随处遍布

ext.ext_cn: 我们的指纹可能到处都是。
ext.ext_en: Our fingerprints are probably all over the place...

ext.ext_cn: 军火堆了遍地。
ext.ext_en: There was ammunition lying all over the place.

defs.def_en: If things are all over the place, they are spread over a very large area, usually in a disorganized way.

ext.ext_cn: 他细心且勤奋，我则稀里糊涂。
ext.ext_en: He was careful and diligent. I was all over the place.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is all over the place, you mean that they are confused or disorganized, and unable to think clearly or act properly.

ext.ext_cn: 等他试过识别所有的物品后，你们可以互换角色，让他来测试你。
ext.ext_en: When he has tried to identify all the items, you can change places, and he can test you...

ext.ext_cn: 手里拿着房门钥匙，知道米莉和孩子们在等他，这一刻千金不换。
ext.ext_en: With his door key in his hand, knowing Millie and the kids awaited him, he wouldn't change places with anyone.

defs.def_en: If you change places with another person, you start being in their situation or role, and they start being in yours.

ext.ext_cn: 当然，在这一决定背后的原因得到解释之后，一切就变得豁然开朗了。
ext.ext_en: When the reasons behind the decision were explained, of course, it all fell into place...

ext.ext_cn: 但是直到我看见报纸上的照片后才明白了一切。
ext.ext_en: But it wasn't until I saw the photograph in the paper that everything clicked into place.

defs.def_en: If you have been trying to understand something puzzling and then everything falls into place or clicks into place, you suddenly understand how different pieces of information are connected and everything becomes clearer.

defs.def_cn: （事件等）自然而然地按所希望的方式发生

ext.ext_cn: 一旦作出决定，事情就立刻顺理成章地发展下去了。
ext.ext_en: Once the decision was made, things fell into place rapidly...

ext.ext_cn: 给自己留出选择的余地，一切将会水到渠成。
ext.ext_en: Keep your options open and everything will fall into place.

defs.def_en: If things fall into place, events happen naturally to produce a situation you want.

ext.ext_cn: 不用说，芭芭拉定会大有作为，因为她与众不同。
ext.ext_en: You always knew Barbara was going places, she was different.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is going places, you mean that they are showing a lot of talent or ability and are likely to become very successful.

defs.def_cn: （在政府、社会或组织中）身居高位

ext.ext_cn: 他有身居要职的朋友。
ext.ext_en: He had friends in high places...

ext.ext_cn: 关于身居高位者腐败行为的指控更激起了人们的不满。
ext.ext_en: The discontent has been fuelled by allegations of corruption in high places.

defs.def_en: People in high places are people who have powerful and influential positions in a government, society, or organization.

defs.def_cn: 在/不在正确的位置；在/不在通常的位置

ext.ext_cn: 杰夫匆忙把抽屉推回去。
ext.ext_en: Geoff hastily pushed the drawer back into place...

ext.ext_cn: 她的金发纹丝不乱。
ext.ext_en: Not a strand of her golden hair was out of place.

defs.def_en: If something is in place, it is in its correct or usual position. If it is out of place, it is not in its correct or usual position.

defs.def_cn: （法律、政策、行政体系等）正在运作，就位

ext.ext_cn: 类似的法规在威尔士已经就位。
ext.ext_en: Similar legislation is already in place in Wales...

ext.ext_cn: 他们被警方部署的繁复安全措施惹怒了。
ext.ext_en: They're offended by the elaborate security measures the police have put in place.

defs.def_en: If something such as a law, a policy, or an administrative structure is in place, it is working or able to be used.

ext.ext_cn: 煮熟的红芸豆可以代替四季豆。
ext.ext_en: Cooked kidney beans can be used in place of French beans...

ext.ext_cn: 劳伦斯·沃特斯代替不幸生病的约翰·特雷休伊来拜访我们。
ext.ext_en: Laurence Waters visited us in place of John Trethewy who was unfortunately ill...

defs.def_en: If one thing or person is used or does something in place of another, they replace the other thing or person.

ext.ext_cn: 路边某些地方的积雪有六英尺深。
ext.ext_en: The snow along the roadside was six feet deep in places...

ext.ext_cn: 他脸上有疤痕，还有几处奇怪的肿包。
ext.ext_en: His face was scarred and oddly puffy in places.

defs.def_en: If something has particular characteristics or features in places, it has them at several points within an area.

defs.def_cn: 身在…的处境；处于…的位置

ext.ext_cn: 如果我是她就可能抗拒不了。
ext.ext_en: In her place I wouldn't have been able to resist it...

ext.ext_cn: 亲爱的，你如果处在我的位置会怎么做？
ext.ext_en: What would you have done in my place, my dear?

defs.def_en: If you say what you would have done in someone else's place, you say what you would have done if you had been in their situation and had been experiencing what they were experiencing.

ext.ext_cn: 最初是什么让你来到华盛顿的？
ext.ext_en: What brought you to Washington in the first place?...

ext.ext_cn: 重点正从简单地对症下药转移到先期预防的方法上来。
ext.ext_en: The emphasis is swinging away from simply finding cures for illness to ways of preventing illness in the first place...

defs.def_en: You say in the first place when you are talking about the beginning of a situation or about the situation as it was before a series of events.

defs.def_cn: （用于列举事项）第一/第二，首先/其次；（用于强调）首要的是

ext.ext_cn: 首先你不老，其次你是个富有魅力的男人。
ext.ext_en: In the first place you are not old and in the second place you are a very attractive man...

ext.ext_cn: 她不可能口服这么大的剂量，因为她根本没有足够的药丸了。
ext.ext_en: She could not have taken these massive doses orally. In the first place, she did not have enough pills.

defs.def_en: You say in the first place and in the second place to introduce the first and second in a series of points or reasons. In the first place can also be used to emphasize a very important point or reason.

defs.def_cn: （做…）不正确，不妥当，不在职责范围内

ext.ext_cn: 他说他不适宜就政府进一步投入资金的承诺发表评论。
ext.ext_en: He says that it is not his place to comment on government commitment to further funds...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的工作不该由我来做。
ext.ext_en: It's not my place to do their job.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is not your place to do something, you mean that it is not right or appropriate for you to do it, or that it is not your responsibility to do it.

defs.def_cn: 格格不入；不相称；不适当；不适时

ext.ext_cn: 我穿着西服、打着领带感觉十分别扭。
ext.ext_en: I felt out of place in my suit and tie...

ext.ext_cn: 她用憎恨一词听起来怪怪的，不合时宜。
ext.ext_en: Her use of the word hate sounded strange and out of place.

defs.def_en: If someone or something seems out of place in a particular situation, they do not seem to belong there or to be suitable for that situation.

defs.def_cn: 有利的境遇；一帆风顺的位置
defs.def_en: If you say that someone has found their place in the sun, you mean that they are in a job or a situation where they will be happy and have everything that they want.

ext.ext_cn: 很多省级政府已利用了这一点，把地方利益置于中央政府利益之上。
ext.ext_en: Many provincial governments have taken advantage of this to place local interests above those of the central government...

ext.ext_cn: 他继续把安保问题置于所有目标之上。
ext.ext_en: He continued to place security above all other objectives.

defs.def_en: If you place one thing above ,before, or over another, you think that the first thing is more important than the second and you show this in your behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 她简单几句话就杀了他的威风。
ext.ext_en: In a few words she had put him in his place.

defs.def_en: If you put someone in their place, you show them that they are less important or clever than they think they are.

defs.def_cn: （常为幽默用法）使有自知之明，使识相

ext.ext_cn: 需要让他知道自己几斤几两的傲慢的酒馆老板
ext.ext_en: ...an uppity publican who needs to be shown his place.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在使女兵安分守己的歧视
ext.ext_en: ...discrimination intended to keep women soldiers in their place.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone should be shown their place or be kept in their place, you are saying, often in a humorous way, that they should be made aware of their low status.

ext.ext_cn: 我的私人生活不得不让位于事业。
ext.ext_en: My personal life has had to take second place to my career.

defs.def_en: If one thing takes second place to another, it is considered to be less important and is given less attention than the other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 乐观情绪逐渐取代了悲观主义。
ext.ext_en: Optimism was gradually taking the place of pessimism...

ext.ext_cn: 他最终在一个很受欢迎的拉丁乐队中取代了查利的位置。
ext.ext_en: He eventually took Charlie's place in a popular Latin band.

defs.def_en: If one thing or person takes the place of another or takes another's place, they replace the other thing or person.
A space shuttle or a shuttle is a spacecraft that is designed to travel into space and back to earth several times.
If someone who lives in the countryside refers to someone from a town or city as a townie, they disapprove of that person because they think they have no knowledge of the countryside or country life.

ext.ext_cn: 她会努力忘记对克里斯托弗的迷恋。
ext.ext_en: She would try to forget her obsession with Christopher...

ext.ext_cn: 95％的病人都知道他们的痴迷是不理智的。
ext.ext_en: 95% of patients know their obsessions are irrational.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has an obsession with a person or thing, you think they are spending too much time thinking about them.
Angels are spiritual beings that some people believe are God's servants in heaven.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于得到友好对待或帮助时）大好人，大善人

ext.ext_cn: 万分感谢，你真是个大好人。
ext.ext_en: Thank you a thousand times, you're an angel.

defs.def_en: You can call someone you like very much an angel in order to show affection, especially when they have been kind to you or done you a favour.

ext.ext_cn: 爸爸视她为小天使。
ext.ext_en: Poppa thought her an angel...

ext.ext_cn: 他这都能忍，真是个大好人。
ext.ext_en: He was such an angel to put up with it.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as an angel, you mean that they seem to be very kind and good.

ext.ext_cn: 说起种族间的包容，比利可真是宅心仁厚。
ext.ext_en: Billy is on the side of the angels when it comes to racial tolerance.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is on the side of the angels, you believe very strongly that what they are doing is right.

defs.def_cn: 愚蠢地冒险;鲁莽行事;暴虎冯河

ext.ext_cn: 马丁总是喜欢贸然行事。
ext.ext_en: Martin is inclined to rush in where angels fear to tread.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone rushes in where angels fear to tread, you are criticizing them gently because they get themselves into dangerous or difficult situations without thinking carefully enough about what they are doing.

ext.ext_cn: 他在讲演中提到了前不久的加拿大之行。
ext.ext_en: In his speech, he referred to a recent trip to Canada.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

ext.ext_cn: 马西娅把他称作好朋友。
ext.ext_en: Marcia had referred to him as a dear friend...

ext.ext_cn: 他就叫他龙尼。
ext.ext_en: He simply referred to him as Ronnie...

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone or something as a particular thing, you use a particular word, expression, or name to mention or describe them.

ext.ext_cn: 电子学这个术语涉及电感作用。
ext.ext_en: The term electronics refers to electrically-induced action.

defs.def_en: If a word refers to a particular thing, situation, or idea, it describes it in some way.

defs.def_cn: 将…转到（医院就医）；将…转给（专科医生）

ext.ext_cn: 病人大多数是在他们的全科医生建议下转往医院就医。
ext.ext_en: Patients are mostly referred to hospital by their general practitioners...

ext.ext_cn: 病人必须马上转去医院做化验。
ext.ext_en: The patient should be referred for tests immediately.

defs.def_en: If a person who is ill is referred to a hospital or a specialist, they are sent there by a doctor in order to be treated.

ext.ext_cn: 他可以将此事交由高等法院裁决。
ext.ext_en: He could refer the matter to the high court.

defs.def_en: If you refer a task or a problem to a person or an organization, you formally tell them about it, so that they can deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 我不时地介绍客户给他。
ext.ext_en: Now and then I referred a client to him.

defs.def_en: If you refer someone to a person or organization, you send them there for the help they need.

ext.ext_cn: 他简单地看了看自己的笔记。
ext.ext_en: He referred briefly to his notebook.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a book or other source of information, you look at it in order to find something out.

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩先生还建议我去查阅美国记者安东尼·斯卡杜托的一本书。
ext.ext_en: Mr Bryan also referred me to a book by the American journalist Anthony Scaduto.

defs.def_en: If you refer someone to a source of information, you tell them the place where they will find the information which they need or which you think will interest them.

ext.ext_cn: 法官将听证会延至下周二。
ext.ext_en: The judge adjourned the hearing until next Tuesday...

ext.ext_cn: 法官席曼先生判处他终身监禁。
ext.ext_en: Judge Mr Justice Schiemann jailed him for life.

defs.def_en: A judge is the person in a court of law who decides how the law should be applied, for example how criminals should be punished.

ext.ext_cn: 评判小组现在正选拔参加决赛的选手。
ext.ext_en: A panel of judges is now selecting the finalists.

defs.def_en: A judge is a person who decides who will be the winner of a competition.

defs.def_cn: 为（竞赛等）担任裁判；评定

ext.ext_cn: 科林·米切尔负责每周对参赛作品进行评判。
ext.ext_en: Colin Mitchell will judge the entries each week...

ext.ext_cn: 参赛者将分成两个年龄段接受评判：5 至10岁和11至14岁。
ext.ext_en: Entrants will be judged in two age categories: 5-10 years and 11-14 years...

defs.def_en: If you judge something such as a competition, you decide who or what is the winner.

ext.ext_cn: 要再花上几年的时间才能判断出这些想法的影响。
ext.ext_en: It will take a few more years to judge the impact of these ideas...

ext.ext_cn: 我愿意根据每本图书各自的优点来作出评价。
ext.ext_en: I am ready to judge any book on its merits...

defs.def_en: If you judge something or someone, you form an opinion about them after you have examined the evidence or thought carefully about them.

defs.def_cn: 估计，猜测（数量、大小、价值等）

ext.ext_cn: 正确估计待洗衣物的重量很重要。
ext.ext_en: It is important to judge the weight of your washing load correctly...

ext.ext_cn: 我估计他40岁上下。
ext.ext_en: I judged him to be about forty...

defs.def_en: If you judge something, you guess its amount, size, or value or you guess what it is.

ext.ext_cn: 我很善于判断人的性格。
ext.ext_en: I'm a pretty good judge of character...

ext.ext_cn: 看来我妹妹全然不懂得欣赏男性的魅力。
ext.ext_en: It would appear that my sister is a poor judge of masculine charm.

defs.def_en: If someone is a good judge of something, they understand it and can make sensible decisions about it. If someone is a bad judge of something, they cannot do this.

ext.ext_cn: 从民意测验来看，他似乎胜券在握。
ext.ext_en: Judging by the opinion polls, he seems to be succeeding...

ext.ext_cn: 从他讲这件事时笑的样子来看，那应该是很幽默的了。
ext.ext_en: Judging from the way he laughed as he told it, it was meant to be humorous...

defs.def_en: You use judging by ,judging from, or to judge from to introduce the reasons why you believe or think something.

ext.ext_cn: 据我判断，这些是他过去几年下注打赌的书面记录。
ext.ext_en: They were typed records of his bets, going back a couple of years as far as I could judge...

ext.ext_cn: 就我看来，这本书内容相当准确。
ext.ext_en: The book, so far as I can judge, is remarkably accurate.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is true as far as you can judge or so far as you can judge, you are assuming that it is true, although you do not know all the facts about it.

defs.def_cn: 申请人（尤指提交正式书面申请的求职或求学的人）
defs.def_en: An applicant for something such as a job or a place at a college is someone who makes a formal written request to be given it.

ext.ext_cn: 她的家被盗贼光顾过。
ext.ext_en: Her home was burglarized.

defs.def_en: If a building is burglarized, a thief enters it by force and steals things.

ext.ext_cn: 他进入奥特哥大学学习艺术和神学。
ext.ext_en: He entered Otago University to study arts and divinity.

defs.def_en: Divinity is the study of religion.

ext.ext_cn: 对基督话语的神圣性的持久信仰
ext.ext_en: ...a lasting faith in the divinity of Christ's word.

defs.def_en: Divinity is the quality of being divine.

ext.ext_cn: 上面的3尊雕像可能是罗马诸神。
ext.ext_en: The three statues above are probably Roman divinities.

defs.def_en: A divinity is a god or goddess.

defs.def_cn: 多米诺（骨牌）效应;连锁反应

ext.ext_cn: 如果一班火车被取消，其连锁反应将是巨大的。
ext.ext_en: The domino effect if one train is cancelled is enormous.

defs.def_en: If one event causes another similar event, which in turn causes another event, and so on, you can refer to this as a domino effect .

defs.def_cn: （人、生活或工作）刻板乏味，一成不变，老一套

ext.ext_cn: 我不喜欢一成不变的生活——我喜欢不断进取。
ext.ext_en: I don't like being in a rut — I like to keep moving on...

ext.ext_cn: 很多超过30岁的人都觉得自己的经济状况很难有所改变。
ext.ext_en: Many over 30s feel stuck in a financial rut.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in a rut, you disapprove of the fact that they have become fixed in their way of thinking and doing things, and find it difficult to change. You can also say that someone's life or career is in a rut.

ext.ext_cn: 当驶近路上的车辙时，我们的司机放慢了速度。
ext.ext_en: Our driver slowed up as we approached the ruts in the road.

ext.ext_cn: 卡车沉重的轮子留下的很深的车辙
ext.ext_en: ...the deep ruts left by the trucks' heavy wheels.

defs.def_en: A rut is a deep, narrow mark made in the ground by the wheels of a vehicle.

ext.ext_cn: 两头麋鹿在秋季的发情期互相打斗
ext.ext_en: ...two elks sparring during the autumn rut.

ext.ext_cn: 发情期的牡鹿
ext.ext_en: ...a stag in rut.

defs.def_en: The rut is the period of the year when some animals such as deer are sexually active, and the males fight each other to mate with the females.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的身体能出汗，由此可以蒸发散热。
ext.ext_en: Our bodies can sweat, thereby losing heat by evaporation...

ext.ext_cn: 公司有时会通过亏本出售来将对手挤垮，从而提高其市场地位。
ext.ext_en: A firm might sometimes sell at a loss to drive a competitor out of business, and thereby increase its market power.

defs.def_en: You use thereby to introduce an important result or consequence of the event or action you have just mentioned.
A pawn shop is a pawnbroker's shop.
A time zone is one of the areas into which the world is divided where the time is calculated as being a particular number of hours behind or ahead of GMT.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 拥有广袤土地的南非白人农场主
ext.ext_en: ...Afrikaner farmers who own vast stretches of land...

ext.ext_cn: 绝大部分鸡蛋都会被打碎。
ext.ext_en: The vast majority of the eggs would be cracked.

defs.def_en: Something that is vast is extremely large.

defs.def_cn: 和平地；平静地；非暴力地

ext.ext_cn: 反对派游击组织同意停战，以和平的方式解决争端。
ext.ext_en: The rival guerrilla groups had agreed to stop fighting and settle their differences peaceably...

ext.ext_cn: “好吧，你说什么都行，”他和气地同意了。
ext.ext_en: 'OK, whatever you say,' he had agreed peaceably.

defs.def_en: If you do something peaceably, you do it quietly or peacefully, without violence or anger.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (眼神、表情或话语)会意的，心照不宣的

ext.ext_cn: 他心照不宣地咧嘴一笑。
ext.ext_en: His lips were spread in a sly smile...

ext.ext_cn: 他心照不宣地看了我一眼，意味深长。
ext.ext_en: He gave me a sly, meaningful look.

defs.def_en: A sly look, expression, or remark shows that you know something that other people do not know or that was meant to be a secret.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她阴险狡诈，会玩人。
ext.ext_en: She is devious and sly and manipulative...

ext.ext_cn: 他确确实实是个老奸巨猾的家伙。
ext.ext_en: He's a sly old beggar if ever there was one.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as sly, you disapprove of them because they keep their feelings or intentions hidden and are clever at deceiving people.

ext.ext_cn: 她是不是偷偷地在见什么人？
ext.ext_en: Was she meeting some guy on the sly?

defs.def_en: To do something on the sly means to do it secretly, often because it is wrong or bad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 糟透的;极其恶劣的;非常讨厌的

ext.ext_cn: 那是个十分低级的错误，一个小学生才会犯的错误。
ext.ext_en: It was a diabolical error, a schoolboy error...

ext.ext_cn: 疼痛异常剧烈。
ext.ext_en: The pain was diabolical.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as diabolical, you are emphasizing that it is very bad, extreme, or unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 为了罪恶的享乐而犯下的罪孽
ext.ext_en: ...sins committed in a spirit of diabolical enjoyment...

ext.ext_cn: 今天一名发言人称该计划阴险恶毒。
ext.ext_en: One speaker today called the plan diabolical and sinister.

defs.def_en: Diabolical is used to emphasize how evil something is.

ext.ext_cn: 还没有向我道歉。
ext.ext_en: I didn't get an apology...

ext.ext_cn: 我们收到了一封致歉信。
ext.ext_en: We received a letter of apology...

defs.def_en: An apology is something that you say or write in order to tell someone that you are sorry that you have hurt them or caused trouble for them.

ext.ext_cn: 他的母亲向琼斯一家赔了不是。
ext.ext_en: His mother offered her apologies to the Jones family...

ext.ext_cn: 最终露面时，玛丽向马德里加尔夫人表示了歉意。
ext.ext_en: When Mary finally appeared, she made her apologies to Mrs Madrigal.

defs.def_en: If you offer or make your apologies, you apologize.

ext.ext_cn: 工会干部们对于迫在眉睫的混乱局面不予道歉。
ext.ext_en: Union officials made no apologies for the threatened chaos.

defs.def_en: If you say that you make no apologies for what you have done, you are emphasizing that you feel that you have done nothing wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 他和妻子、家人正面临着被驱逐。
ext.ext_en: He was facing eviction, along with his wife and family...

ext.ext_cn: 他也批评这些驱逐暴力无情。
ext.ext_en: He also criticised the evictions for being violent and ruthless.

defs.def_en: Eviction is the act or process of officially forcing someone to leave a house or piece of land.

ext.ext_cn: 25岁的白人男子
ext.ext_en: ...a 25-year-old Caucasian male.

ext.ext_cn: 安·汉密尔顿是来自新英格兰的白人。
ext.ext_en: Ann Hamilton was a Caucasian from New England.

defs.def_en: A Caucasian person is a white person.

defs.def_cn: 高加索人的，白种人的(人类学上指属于欧洲、北非及西亚的人种)

ext.ext_cn: 蓝眼睛和白种人的面庞
ext.ext_en: ...blue eyes and Caucasian features.

defs.def_en: Anthropologists use Caucasian to refer to someone from a racial grouping coming from Europe, North Africa, and western Asia.

ext.ext_cn: 噪音吵得他一直没有睡着。
ext.ext_en: The noise kept him awake...

ext.ext_cn: 雷吉一直在柜台后忙活。
ext.ext_en: Reggie was being kept busy behind the bar...

defs.def_en: If someone keeps or is kept in a particular state, they remain in it.

ext.ext_cn: 列车运行过程中要远离车门。
ext.ext_en: Keep away from the doors while the train is moving...

ext.ext_cn: 他低头掩面。
ext.ext_en: He kept his head down, hiding his features...

defs.def_en: If you keep or you are kept in a particular position or place, you remain in it.

ext.ext_cn: 我努力做到了只吃规定饮食，不沾甜食。
ext.ext_en: I managed to stick to the diet and keep off sweet foods...

ext.ext_cn: 如果能不近酒色，他将成为一名出色的运动员。
ext.ext_en: He's going to be a fantastic player if he keeps away from booze and women...

defs.def_en: If you keep off something or keep away from it, you avoid it. If you keep out of something, you avoid getting involved in it. You can also say that you keep someone off ,away from or out of something.

ext.ext_cn: 我总是害怕受窘，什么事都不敢去做。
ext.ext_en: Embarrassment has kept me from doing all sorts of things...

ext.ext_cn: 他不让她感到孤独。
ext.ext_en: He kept her from being lonely...

defs.def_en: If someone or something keeps you from a particular action, they prevent you from doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 她咬住嘴唇不哭。
ext.ext_en: She bit her lip to keep from crying...

ext.ext_cn: 他不得不靠在丹身上以免摔倒。
ext.ext_en: He had to lean on Dan to keep from falling.

defs.def_en: If you try to keep from doing something, you try to stop yourself from doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 她知道加布里埃尔有事瞒着她。
ext.ext_en: She knew that Gabriel was keeping something from her.

defs.def_en: If you keep something from someone, you do not tell them about it.

ext.ext_cn: 我总是忘了现在是12月了。
ext.ext_en: I keep forgetting it's December...

ext.ext_cn: 我过了一会就往回走了，但他还接着走。
ext.ext_en: I turned back after a while, but he kept walking...

defs.def_en: If you keep doing something, you do it repeatedly or continue to do it.

defs.def_cn: （与某些名词连用，表示持续一段时间或继续做某事）持续，继续（持有或控制）

ext.ext_cn: 直到去年，那个国家还处于该政权的严密控制之下。
ext.ext_en: Until last year, the regime kept a tight grip on the country...

ext.ext_cn: 他们中会有一人看着后面的路，提醒我们注意过来的车辆。
ext.ext_en: One of them would keep a look-out on the road behind to warn us of approaching vehicles...

defs.def_en: Keep is used with some nouns to indicate that someone does something for a period of time or continues to do it. For example, if you keep a grip on something, you continue to hold or control it.

ext.ext_cn: “我喜欢这件连衣裙，”她说。“留下吧。给你了，”达夫妮说道。
ext.ext_en: 'I like this dress,' she said. 'Keep it. You can have it,' said Daphne...

ext.ext_cn: 莱森不得不在娶她和保住工作之间作出选择。
ext.ext_en: Lathan had to choose between marrying her and keeping his job.

defs.def_en: If you keep something, you continue to have it in your possession and do not throw it away, give it away, or sell it.

ext.ext_cn: 她把钱放在床垫下。
ext.ext_en: She kept her money under the mattress...

ext.ext_cn: 她记得放枪的地方。
ext.ext_en: She remembered where she kept the gun...

defs.def_en: If you keep something in a particular place, you always have it or store it in that place so that you can use it whenever you need it.

ext.ext_cn: 我希望你遵守诺言来这儿多呆几天。
ext.ext_en: I'm hoping you'll keep your promise to come for a long visit...

ext.ext_cn: 他又食言了。
ext.ext_en: He had again failed to keep his word.

defs.def_en: When you keep something such as a promise or an appointment, you do what you said you would do.

ext.ext_cn: 埃莉诺开始记日记了。
ext.ext_en: Eleanor began to keep a diary...

ext.ext_cn: 志愿者记录下他们一周所吃的所有食物。
ext.ext_en: The volunteers kept a record of everything they ate for a week.

defs.def_en: If you keep a record of a series of events, you write down details of it so that they can be referred to later.

ext.ext_cn: 她勉勉强强能养得起自己的5个孩子。
ext.ext_en: She could just about afford to keep her five kids...

ext.ext_cn: 我难以维持生计。
ext.ext_en: I just cannot afford to keep myself...

defs.def_en: If you keep yourself or keep someone else, you support yourself or the other person by earning enough money to provide food, clothing, money, and other necessary things.

ext.ext_cn: 雷求学期间会在当地的农场干活赚取生活费。
ext.ext_en: Ray will earn his keep on local farms while studying...

ext.ext_cn: 我需要付给父母我的生活费。
ext.ext_en: I need to give my parents money for my keep.

defs.def_en: Someone's keep is the cost of food and other things that they need in their daily life.

ext.ext_cn: 我给你带了些鸡蛋。我们养鸡。
ext.ext_en: I've brought you some eggs. We keep chickens...

ext.ext_cn: 这个疯狂的作家把龙虾当宠物养。
ext.ext_en: This mad writer kept a lobster as a pet.

defs.def_en: If you keep animals, you own them and take care of them.

ext.ext_cn: 他父亲经营一家乡村商店。
ext.ext_en: His father kept a village shop.

defs.def_en: If you keep a business such as a small shop or hotel, you own it and manage it.

ext.ext_cn: 很抱歉让你久等了，杰克。
ext.ext_en: Sorry to keep you, Jack...

ext.ext_cn: “你为什么晚了？”——“我走错了方向。”
ext.ext_en: 'What kept you?' — 'I went in the wrong direction.'

defs.def_en: If someone or something keeps you, they delay you and make you late.

ext.ext_cn: 剩下的东西都可以放进冰箱，可以保持两到三个星期不坏。
ext.ext_en: Whatever is left over may be put into the refrigerator, where it will keep for 2-3 weeks.

defs.def_en: If food keeps for a certain length of time, it stays fresh and suitable to eat for that time.

defs.def_cn: （用于询问健康状况）保持健康

ext.ext_cn: 她最近身体不太好。
ext.ext_en: She hasn't been keeping too well lately...

ext.ext_cn: 你这些天身体怎么样？
ext.ext_en: How are you keeping these days?

defs.def_en: You can say or ask how someone is keeping as a way of saying or asking whether they are well.
A keep is the main tower of a medieval castle, in which people lived.

ext.ext_cn: 可能要试几次，但还是值得坚持的。
ext.ext_en: It may take a number of attempts, but it is worth keeping at it...

ext.ext_cn: “坚持下去！”萨德鼓励我道。
ext.ext_en: 'Keep at it!' Thade encouraged me.

defs.def_en: If you keep at it, you continue doing something that you have started, even if you are tired and would prefer to stop.

ext.ext_cn: 确保你现在所获得的一切永远不会失去。
ext.ext_en: Ensure that whatever you gain now will be for keeps...

ext.ext_cn: 他建议他们离开镇子，永远别再回来。
ext.ext_en: He advised them to leave town for keeps.

defs.def_en: Something that is for keeps is permanent and will not change.

ext.ext_cn: 她强迫自己继续下去。
ext.ext_en: She forced herself to keep going...

ext.ext_cn: 我喊着：“坚持，坚持！”
ext.ext_en: I was shouting: 'Keep going, keep going!'

defs.def_en: If you keep going, you continue moving along or doing something that you have started, even if you are tired and would prefer to stop.

defs.def_cn: 协调/不协调;一致/不一致

ext.ext_cn: 他的办公室与其身份和阅历相称。
ext.ext_en: His office was in keeping with his station and experience...

ext.ext_cn: 按照传统，皇帝和皇后未参加该仪式。
ext.ext_en: In keeping with tradition, the Emperor and Empress did not attend the ceremony...

defs.def_en: If one thing is in keeping with another, it is suitable in relation to that thing. If one thing is out of keeping with another, it is not suitable in relation to that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 有人担心他到了要求极其严格的第3年时会坚持不下去。
ext.ext_en: There are fears that he will not be able to keep it up when he gets to the particularly demanding third year...

ext.ext_cn: 你们干得非常棒！继续好好干吧！
ext.ext_en: You're doing a great job! Keep it up!

defs.def_en: If you keep it up, you continue working or trying as hard as you have been in the past.

defs.def_cn: 把…秘而不宣；不将…说出去

ext.ext_cn: 我得找人说说。我心里憋不住。
ext.ext_en: I have to tell someone. I can't keep it to myself...

ext.ext_cn: 有件事你能帮我做。但你要保密。
ext.ext_en: There's one thing you can do for me. But keep it to yourself.

defs.def_en: If you keep something to yourself, you do not tell anyone else about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个喜欢安静、不爱与人来往的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a quiet man who kept himself to himself...

ext.ext_cn: 因为不怎么懂意大利语，她很少和人交往。
ext.ext_en: Since she knows little Italian, she keeps to herself.

defs.def_en: If you keep yourself to yourself or keep to yourself, you stay on your own most of the time and do not mix socially with other people.

ext.ext_cn: “大概吧，”我边说边把衬衫掖了进去。
ext.ext_en: 'Probably,' I said, tucking in my shirt...

ext.ext_cn: 掖紧被子。
ext.ext_en: Tuck the sheets in firmly.

defs.def_en: If you tuck in a piece of material, you keep it in position by placing one edge or end of it behind or under something else. For example, if you tuck in your shirt, you place the bottom part of it inside your trousers or skirt.

defs.def_cn: 给（孩子）掖好被子；给…盖好被子

ext.ext_cn: 我为莉莉读了个故事，然后给她盖好被子。
ext.ext_en: I read Lili a story and tucked her in her own bed...

ext.ext_cn: 母亲会给我掖好被子，关上灯，然后蹑手蹑脚走出去。
ext.ext_en: My mother would tuck me in, turn out the lights and tiptoe out.

defs.def_en: If you tuck a child in bed or tuck them in, you make them comfortable by straightening the sheets and blankets and pushing the loose ends under the mattress.

defs.def_cn: （旅途中在公路旁的）休息，歇脚
defs.def_en: On a long journey by road, a rest stop is a short period when you stop and leave your vehicle, for example to eat or go to the toilet.

defs.def_cn: （高速公路旁的）停车区，休息站
defs.def_en: A rest stop is a place beside a motorway or freeway where you can buy petrol and other things, or have a meal.

ext.ext_cn: 成都市位于东南方大约 700 英里处。
ext.ext_en: The city of Chengdu lies some seven hundred miles to the South-East.

defs.def_en: The south-east is the direction which is halfway between south and east.

ext.ext_cn: 为英格兰东南部服务的区域电力公司
ext.ext_en: ...the regional electricity company serving the South-east of England...

ext.ext_cn: 今天最大的降雪预计将出现在东南部地区。
ext.ext_en: The heaviest snowfalls today are expected in the south east.

defs.def_en: The south-east of a place, country, or region is the part which is in the south-east.

ext.ext_cn: 我们转向东南方向，朝费拉约港前进。
ext.ext_en: We turned south-east, making for Portoferraio.

defs.def_en: If you go south-east, you travel towards the south-east.

defs.def_cn: 位于…的东南方;在…的东南

ext.ext_cn: 位于伊斯坦布尔东南大约120公里处的伊兹尼克出产的陶器
ext.ext_en: ...the potteries of Iznik, some 120km south-east of Istanbul.

defs.def_en: Something that is south-east of a place is positioned to the south-east of it.

ext.ext_cn: 东南亚
ext.ext_en: ...South-East Asia.

ext.ext_cn: 林肯郡的东南区
ext.ext_en: ...the south-east quarter of Lincolnshire.

defs.def_en: The south-east part of a place, country, or region is the part which is towards the south-east.
A south-east wind is a wind that blows from the south-east.

defs.def_cn: (通常指男性)不要脸的家伙，混账东西
defs.def_en: If someone calls a person, usually a man, a motherfucker, they are insulting him in a very unpleasant way.

defs.def_cn: 酒椰叶纤维（用来制作草垫、篮子等）

ext.ext_cn: 一些人给桌布绣花或编酒椰叶纤维席子。
ext.ext_en: Some embroidered tablecloths or made raffia mats.

defs.def_en: Raffia is a fibre made from palm leaves. It is used to make mats and baskets.

ext.ext_cn: 这艘船配有不少于5个液压泵。
ext.ext_en: The boat has no fewer than five hydraulic pumps.

defs.def_en: Hydraulic equipment or machinery involves or is operated by a fluid that is under pressure, such as water or oil.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 盈利的；有利润的；赚钱的

ext.ext_cn: 制药业是美国利润最丰厚的业务。
ext.ext_en: Drug manufacturing is the most profitable business in America...

ext.ext_cn: 生产大量的食物能让他们获利。
ext.ext_en: It was profitable for them to produce large amounts of food.

defs.def_en: A profitable organization or practice makes a profit.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有利可图的；有益的；有用的

ext.ext_cn: 有利于人员和观念交流的合作
ext.ext_en: ...collaboration which leads to a profitable exchange of personnel and ideas.

defs.def_en: Something that is profitable results in some benefit for you.

defs.def_cn: 成为…的典范;作为…的缩影

ext.ext_cn: 被称作bouchon的里昂小餐馆是里昂饮食的缩影。
ext.ext_en: Lyonnais cooking is epitomized by the so-called 'bouchons'.

ext.ext_cn: 作为酒店浮华装潢之缩影的豪华电梯
ext.ext_en: ...the sleek lift that epitomized the hotel's glossy decor.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone epitomizes a particular thing, you mean that they are a perfect example of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们最终能捞回全部或大部分的债务。
ext.ext_en: They will eventually be able to claw back all or most of the debt...

ext.ext_cn: 与此同时，他的将军们还想东山再起。
ext.ext_en: In the meantime his generals will want to claw back some of their old influence.

defs.def_en: If someone claws back some of the money or power they had lost, they get some of it back again.

defs.def_cn: (政府)收回(已支付给民众的款项)

ext.ext_cn: 财政大臣在明年的预算中将争取收回35亿英镑。
ext.ext_en: The Chancellor will try to claw back £3.5 billion in next year's Budget.

defs.def_en: If a government claws back money, it finds a way of taking money back from people that it gave money to in another way.

defs.def_cn: (尤指选票或比分的)差额，差数

ext.ext_cn: 他们最终可能会以50分的优势获胜。
ext.ext_en: They could end up with a 50-point winning margin...

ext.ext_cn: 《星期日泰晤士报》仍以巨大的优势稳居报业龙头的地位。
ext.ext_en: The Sunday Times remains the brand leader by a huge margin...

defs.def_en: A margin is the difference between two amounts, especially the difference in the number of votes or points between the winner and the loser in an election or other contest.

ext.ext_cn: 她在页边的空白处写下了评语。
ext.ext_en: She added her comments in the margin.

defs.def_en: The margin of a written or printed page is the empty space at the side of the page.

ext.ext_cn: 钱是直接筹集上来的，不太容易出错。
ext.ext_en: The money is collected in a straightforward way with little margin for error...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管量刑幅度很大，但是这些指控仍面临长达5年的刑期。
ext.ext_en: These charges can carry prison terms of up to five years, though there's a wide margin of discretion...

defs.def_en: If there is a margin for something in a situation, there is some freedom to choose what to do or decide how to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 沿着西部边缘的地势低平的沿海平原
ext.ext_en: ...the low coastal plain along the western margin...

ext.ext_cn: 这些岛屿位于人类聚居地的边缘。
ext.ext_en: These islands are on the margins of human habitation.

defs.def_en: The margin of a place or area is the extreme edge of it.

defs.def_cn: （社会、群体或活动中的）边缘地位，非主体地位

ext.ext_cn: 学生过去曾经发挥了重要的作用，不过现在他们变得无足轻重了。
ext.ext_en: Students have played an important role in the past, but for the moment, they're on the margins.

ext.ext_cn: 该党在政治上迅速失势的种种迹象
ext.ext_en: ...signs of the party's rapid retreat to the political margins.

defs.def_en: To be on the margins of a society, group, or activity means to be among the least typical or least important parts of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 由不卫生的环境引起的疾病
ext.ext_en: ...diseases caused by unsanitary conditions...

ext.ext_cn: 把未经处理的污水排放到海里既不卫生也不安全。
ext.ext_en: Discharge of raw sewage into the sea is unsanitary and unsafe.

defs.def_en: Something that is unsanitary is dirty and unhealthy, so that you may catch a disease from it.

defs.def_cn: 恶作剧;淘气;使坏的念头

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我满足于从山脚下观赏山景。
ext.ext_en: I am content to admire the mountains from below...

ext.ext_cn: 我对竞选活动的进展十分满意。
ext.ext_en: I'm perfectly content with the way the campaign has gone...

defs.def_en: If you are content with something, you are willing to accept it, rather than wanting something more or something better.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他说他女儿非常满意。
ext.ext_en: He says his daughter is quite content.

defs.def_en: If you are content, you are fairly happy or satisfied.

ext.ext_cn: 他非常明智，拥有家庭和对自然的热爱便知足了。
ext.ext_en: He wisely contented himself with his family and his love of nature...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数制造商都满足于对现有款型进行更新。
ext.ext_en: Most manufacturers content themselves with updating existing models.

defs.def_en: If you content yourself with something, you accept it and do not try to do or have other things.

defs.def_cn: 鼓吹沙文主义的；大国主义的

ext.ext_cn: 报刊继续大力鼓吹沙文主义。
ext.ext_en: The press continued its jingoistic display.

defs.def_en: Jingoistic behaviour shows a strong and unreasonable belief in the superiority of your own country.

defs.def_cn: (尤指出乎意料的)令人失望的事，无趣的事

ext.ext_cn: 遗憾的是，整个晚上都没什么特别有趣的事。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately, the entire evening was a total non-event.

defs.def_en: If you say that something was a non-event, you mean that it was disappointing or dull, especially when this was not what you had expected.

ext.ext_cn: 只用玻璃隔板隔开的新办公室
ext.ext_en: ...new offices divided only by glass partitions...

ext.ext_cn: 她的出租车里乘客座位和驾驶员之间装着厚厚的有机玻璃隔板。
ext.ext_en: Her taxicab has a thick perspex partition between the passengers' seats and the driver.

defs.def_en: A partition is a wall or screen that separates one part of a room or vehicle from another.

ext.ext_cn: 通过将一间大屋用隔断断开的方法再隔出了几间卧室。
ext.ext_en: Bedrooms have again been created by partitioning a single larger room...

ext.ext_cn: 他坐在用隔板隔开的办公室里的双人沙发上。
ext.ext_en: He sat on the two-seater sofa in the partitioned office.

defs.def_en: If you partition a room, you separate one part of it from another by means of a partition.

ext.ext_cn: 自爱尔兰被分裂后第一次
ext.ext_en: ...for the first time since Ireland was partitioned...

ext.ext_cn: 英国被指“出于历史仇恨”企图分裂该国。
ext.ext_en: Britain was accused of trying to partition the country 'because of historic enmity'...

defs.def_en: If a country is partitioned, it is divided into two or more independent countries.
Hairspray is a sticky substance that you spray out of a can onto your hair in order to hold it in place.
Usury is the practice of lending money at a high rate of interest.
A sedan is a car with seats for four or more people, a fixed roof, and a boot that is separate from the part of the car that you sit in.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （想法、计划等）考虑不周的，愚蠢的，不切实际的

ext.ext_cn: 这又是一个不靠谱的计划，是不会成功的。
ext.ext_en: This is another half-baked scheme that isn't going to work...

ext.ext_cn: 我可不想一拍脑门想出些馊主意而把事情搞得更糟。
ext.ext_en: I didn't want to make things worse by coming up with half-baked notions.

defs.def_en: If you describe an idea or plan as half-baked, you mean that it has not been properly thought out, and so is stupid or impractical.

ext.ext_cn: 她精力充沛，热情洋溢。
ext.ext_en: She was brimful of energy and enthusiasm...

ext.ext_cn: 美国有很多薪酬很高的医生。
ext.ext_en: The United States is brimful with highly paid doctors.

defs.def_en: Someone who is brimful of an emotion or quality feels or seems full of it. An object or place that is brimful of something is full of it.

defs.def_cn: 不动感情的人;不易受伤害的人；硬汉

ext.ext_cn: 她真正是个铁娘子。
ext.ext_en: She really is a tough cookie.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a tough cookie, you mean that they are unemotional and are not easily hurt by what people say or do.

ext.ext_cn: 壁炉台上是一对明代的青铜花瓶。
ext.ext_en: On the mantelpiece are a pair of bronze Ming vases.

defs.def_en: A mantelpiece is a wood or stone shelf which is the top part of a border round a fireplace.

defs.def_cn: (外裹砂糖或巧克力粉的)土耳其软糖
defs.def_en: Turkish delight is a jelly-like sweet that is covered with powdered sugar or chocolate.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 占有欲强的；有控制欲的

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼很爱吃醋，对我的占有欲很强。
ext.ext_en: Danny could be very jealous and possessive about me...

ext.ext_cn: 他母亲控制欲很强，过去他常常一天给她打好几次电话。
ext.ext_en: He used to ring his possessive mother several times a day.

defs.def_en: Someone who is possessive about another person wants all that person's love and attention.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不愿与人分享的；自私的

ext.ext_cn: 人们很想独占礼券。
ext.ext_en: People were very possessive about their coupons.

defs.def_en: Someone who is possessive about things that they own does not like other people to use them.

In grammar, a possessive determiner or possessive adjective is a word such as 'my' or 'his' which shows who or what something belongs to or is connected with. The possessive form of a name or noun has 's added to it, as in 'Jenny's' or 'cat's'.
A possessive is a possessive determiner or the possessive form of a name or noun.

ext.ext_cn: 她伸手拿纸巾擤鼻涕。
ext.ext_en: She reached for a Kleenex and blew her nose.

ext.ext_cn: 一盒纸巾
ext.ext_en: ...a box of Kleenex.

defs.def_en: A Kleenex is a piece of soft tissue paper that is used as a handkerchief.

defs.def_cn: 石油商；石油大王；石油工人

ext.ext_cn: 北海的一处石油钻塔昨天发生了瓦斯爆炸，5名石油工人受伤。
ext.ext_en: Five oilmen were injured when a gas explosion shook a North Sea oil rig yesterday.

defs.def_en: An oilman is a man who owns an oil company or who works in the oil business.

ext.ext_cn: 长满松树的高山
ext.ext_en: ...high mountains covered in pine trees.

ext.ext_cn: 一张大松木桌子
ext.ext_en: ...a big pine table.

defs.def_en: A pine tree or a pine is a tall tree which has very thin, sharp leaves and a fresh smell. Pine trees have leaves all year round.

defs.def_cn: （因死亡或离别而）怀念，苦苦思念，为…难过

ext.ext_cn: 她会坐在家里，思念死去的丈夫。
ext.ext_en: She'd be sitting at home pining for her lost husband...

ext.ext_cn: 要确保不在家时宠物不会想你。
ext.ext_en: Make sure your pet won't pine while you're away.

defs.def_en: If you pine for someone who has died or gone away, you want them to be with you very much and feel sad because they are not there.

defs.def_cn: 渴望，苦苦盼望（尤指不大可能拥有的东西）

ext.ext_cn: 我渴望乡间的生活。
ext.ext_en: I pine for the countryside.

ext.ext_cn: 从1939年以来他们就一直盼望着的民主
ext.ext_en: ...the democracy they have pined for since 1939.

defs.def_en: If you pine for something, you want it very much, especially when it is unlikely that you will be able to have it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们也许可以用桨把自己推过去。
ext.ext_en: We might be able to push ourselves across with the paddle.

ext.ext_cn: 他用作桨使的一块浮木
ext.ext_en: ...a piece of driftwood which he used as a paddle.

defs.def_en: A paddle is a short pole with a wide flat part at one end or at both ends. You hold it in your hands and use it as an oar to move a small boat through water.

ext.ext_cn: 划独木舟要用到的技术
ext.ext_en: ...the skills you will use to paddle the canoe.

ext.ext_cn: 划着皮划子在南太平洋游弋
ext.ext_en: ...paddling around the South Pacific in a kayak.

defs.def_en: If you paddle a boat, you move it through water using a paddle.

ext.ext_cn: 玩水的时候穿上凉鞋。
ext.ext_en: Wear sandals when you paddle.

ext.ext_cn: 能够在其中戏水的美丽的小溪
ext.ext_en: ...a lovely little stream that you can paddle in.

defs.def_en: If you paddle, you walk or stand in shallow water, for example at the edge of the sea, for pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 她接受了呼气测醉检查，结果超过了限定值。
ext.ext_en: She was breathalysed and found to be over the limit.

defs.def_en: If the driver of a car is breathalyzed by the police, they ask him or her to breathe into a special bag or device in order to test whether he or she has drunk too much alcohol.

defs.def_cn: 积习不改的;上瘾的;根深蒂固的

ext.ext_cn: 嗜赌成性的赌徒
ext.ext_en: ...an inveterate gambler.

ext.ext_cn: 这些男孩子懒惰成性
ext.ext_en: ...the inveterate laziness of these boys.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as, for example, an inveterate liar or smoker, you mean that they have lied or smoked for a long time and are not likely to stop doing it.

defs.def_cn: 莎笼，围裙(尤指马来西亚人围在腰间或裹在身上的一块长布)
defs.def_en: A sarong is a piece of clothing that is worn especially by Malaysian men and women. It consists of a long piece of cloth wrapped round the waist or body.

ext.ext_cn: 尼尔给他发了一封唁函。
ext.ext_en: Neil sent him a letter of condolence.

defs.def_en: A message of condolence is a message in which you express your sympathy for someone because one of their friends or relatives has died recently.

ext.ext_cn: 他向这次事件中的死者家属表示了慰唁。
ext.ext_en: He expressed his condolences to the families of the people who died in the incident.

defs.def_en: When you offer or express your condolences to someone, you express your sympathy for them because one of their friends or relatives has died recently.

defs.def_cn: 钟面;表盘;（仪表等的）刻度盘，标度盘

ext.ext_cn: 夜光钟面显示时间为 6点 55 分。
ext.ext_en: The luminous dial on the clock showed five minutes to seven...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数气压计的盘面都刻有天气术语。
ext.ext_en: The dials of most barometers are inscribed with weather terms.

defs.def_en: A dial is the part of a machine or instrument such as a clock or watch which shows you the time or a measurement that has been recorded.

defs.def_cn: （装置或设备的）调节器，控制器

ext.ext_cn: 他转动收音机的电台旋钮。
ext.ext_en: He turned the dial on the radio...

ext.ext_cn: 温度调节器设定在 150 度。
ext.ext_en: The heat dial was set at 150 degrees.

defs.def_en: A dial is a control on a device or piece of equipment which you can move in order to adjust the setting, for example to select or change the frequency on a radio or the temperature of a heater.

ext.ext_cn: 打转盘拨号电话
ext.ext_en: ...turning the dial on the phone.

defs.def_en: On some telephones, especially older ones, the dial is the disc on the front that you turn with your finger to choose the number that you want to call. The disc has holes in it, and numbers or letters behind the holes.

ext.ext_cn: 他拿起电话，拨打了她的号码。
ext.ext_en: He lifted the phone and dialled her number...

ext.ext_cn: 他拨通了电话，跟值班员简短地说了几句。
ext.ext_en: He dialled, and spoke briefly to the duty officer.

defs.def_en: If you dial or if you dial a number, you turn the dial or press the buttons on a telephone in order to phone someone.

defs.def_cn: 虚拟足球赛(人们选择现实中的足球运动员组成一支虚拟的球队，以球员的实际表现计分)
defs.def_en: Fantasy football is a game in which people choose real footballers to form an imaginary team, and win points based on the actual performances of the players.

ext.ext_cn: 她祖母含混不清地说着梦话。
ext.ext_en: Her grandmother mumbled in her  sleep...

ext.ext_cn: 他小声咕哝了一句。
ext.ext_en: He mumbled a few words...

defs.def_en: If you mumble, you speak very quietly and not at all clearly with the result that the words are difficult to understand.

ext.ext_cn: 他是由海军上将精心挑选出来担任这项工作的。
ext.ext_en: He was hand-picked for this job by the Admiral...

ext.ext_cn: 创价学会可以仔细挑选其继任人。
ext.ext_en: Sokagakkai was able to hand-pick his successor.

defs.def_en: If someone is hand-picked, they are very carefully chosen by someone in authority for a particular purpose or a particular job.

defs.def_cn: 斯芬克斯，狮身人面像(古埃及人建造于金字塔旁的巨大雕像，神话中传说它会出谜语来为难人);神秘的人;令人困惑不解的人

ext.ext_cn: 让他演神秘莫测的人很合适。
ext.ext_en: It suited him to play the sphinx.

defs.def_en: The Sphinx is a large ancient statue of a creature with a human head and a lion's body that stands near the pyramids in Egypt. In mythology, sphinxes gave people puzzles to solve, and so a person who is mysterious or puzzling is sometimes referred to as a sphinx .

ext.ext_cn: 他无疑是听到了小道消息。
ext.ext_en: He'd doubtless heard rumours on the grapevine...

ext.ext_cn: 我听到有传言说他对我们在做的工作非常不满。
ext.ext_en: I had heard through the grapevine that he was quite critical of what we were doing.

defs.def_en: If you hear or learn something on the grapevine, you hear it or learn it in casual conversation with other people.
A grapevine is a climbing plant on which grapes grow.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数人猜测买方出价可能为每股380便士。
ext.ext_en: Speculation centred on a likely bid price of 380p a share.

defs.def_en: The bid price of a particular stock or share is the price that investors are willing to pay for it.
A jugular or jugular vein is one of the three important veins in your neck that carry blood from your head back to your heart.

defs.def_cn: 抨击致命的弱点；直击软肋

ext.ext_cn: 布莱克先生直攻要害，问起了性方面的隐私问题。
ext.ext_en: Mr Black went for the jugular, asking intimate sexual questions.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone went for the jugular, you mean that they strongly attacked another person's weakest points in order to harm them.

ext.ext_cn: 一名15岁的女孩在地铁里遭持刀袭击。
ext.ext_en: A 15-year-old girl was attacked at knifepoint in a subway...

ext.ext_cn: 他用刀将她挟持并威胁说要杀了她。
ext.ext_en: He held her at knifepoint and threatened to kill her.

defs.def_en: If you are attacked or robbed at knifepoint, someone threatens you with a knife while they attack or steal from you.

ext.ext_cn: 英印混血作家阿米塔夫·高希
ext.ext_en: ...Anglo-Indian writer Amitav Ghosh.

defs.def_en: An Anglo-Indian person is someone whose family is partly British and partly Indian.
An Anglo-Indian is someone who is Anglo-Indian.

ext.ext_cn: 我已经不是他记忆中那个似乎永远快乐无忧的人了。
ext.ext_en: I'm no longer the apparently eternally cheerful chappy he remembers...

ext.ext_cn: 他那直立的头发和咧着嘴的笑容使他更像个厚脸皮的家伙。
ext.ext_en: His cheeky chappy image is reinforced by the spiky hair and the wide grin.

defs.def_en: A chappy is the same as a chap .

defs.def_cn: (基于思想或情感的)态度，情绪

ext.ext_cn: 公众情绪迅速转变，开始反对美国。
ext.ext_en: Public sentiment rapidly turned anti-American...

ext.ext_cn: 他发现支持采取军事行动的情绪日益高涨。
ext.ext_en: He's found growing sentiment for military action.

defs.def_en: A sentiment that people have is an attitude which is based on their thoughts and feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 我不得不对约翰·普雷斯科特的见解表示赞同。
ext.ext_en: I must agree with the sentiments expressed by John Prescott...

ext.ext_cn: 外交大臣附和了这一看法。
ext.ext_en: The Foreign Secretary echoed this sentiment.

defs.def_en: A sentiment is an idea or feeling that someone expresses in words.

defs.def_cn: (尤指对过去的事过度而无谓的)感伤，眷恋

ext.ext_cn: 劳拉因无法释怀而一直保留着那封信。
ext.ext_en: Laura kept that letter out of sentiment...

ext.ext_cn: 加冕典礼是极尽奢华和怀旧的仪式。
ext.ext_en: The coronation was an occasion for extravagant myth and sentiment.

defs.def_en: Sentiment is feelings such as pity or love, especially for things in the past, and may be considered exaggerated and foolish.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她办事很有效率，也很可靠。
ext.ext_en: She was efficient and reliable...

ext.ext_cn: 日本产的汽车质量非常可靠。
ext.ext_en: Japanese cars are so reliable.

defs.def_en: People or things that are reliable can be trusted to work well or to behave in the way that you want them to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 关于平民的伤亡还没有确凿的信息。
ext.ext_en: There is no reliable information about civilian casualties...

ext.ext_cn: 要给出可靠的估计非常困难。
ext.ext_en: It's very difficult to give a reliable estimate...

defs.def_en: Information that is reliable or that is from a reliable source is very likely to be correct.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 马修不由得苦笑了一下。
ext.ext_en: Matthew allowed himself a wry smile...

ext.ext_cn: 她朝奶奶无可奈何地瞟了一眼。
ext.ext_en: She cast a wry glance in her grandmother's direction.

defs.def_en: If someone has a wry expression, it shows that they find a bad situation or a change in a situation slightly amusing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （话语或文章）挖苦的，讽刺的，揶揄的

ext.ext_cn: 该剧凄然而讽刺地描述了我们大家是如何被岁月所摧残的。
ext.ext_en: The play is a rueful, wry observation about the way we are all subject to the ravages of time...

ext.ext_cn: 他的作品带有一种讽刺意味的幽默。
ext.ext_en: There is a wry sense of humour in his work.

defs.def_en: A wry remark or piece of writing refers to a bad situation or a change in a situation in an amusing way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 想不到的；未预料到的；意外的

ext.ext_cn: 他的死亡完全出乎意料。
ext.ext_en: His death was totally unexpected...

ext.ext_cn: 他出乎意料地在办公室露了一下脸。
ext.ext_en: He made a brief, unexpected appearance at the office...

defs.def_en: If an event or someone's behaviour is unexpected, it surprises you because you did not think that it was likely to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 在原子核里，中子和质子是结合在一起的。
ext.ext_en: Neutrons and protons are bound together in the nucleus of an atom.

defs.def_en: The nucleus of an atom or cell is the central part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 公民运动的成员可能会成为未来中间派政党的核心。
ext.ext_en: The Civic Movement could be the nucleus of a centrist party of the future.

defs.def_en: The nucleus of a group of people or things is the small number of members which form the most important part of the group.

ext.ext_cn: 法官认为他已经被那些年长的孩子们带坏了。
ext.ext_en: The judge thought he'd been led astray by older children.

defs.def_en: If you are led astray by someone or something, you behave badly or foolishly because of them.

ext.ext_cn: 证言会激怒陪审员，使他们背离案件事实。
ext.ext_en: The testimony would inflame the jurors, and lead them astray from the facts of the case...

ext.ext_cn: 我们驱车向东去罗斯托克，但地图却给我指错了方向。
ext.ext_en: We drove east to Rostock, where my map led me astray.

defs.def_en: If someone or something leads you astray, they make you believe something which is not true, causing you to make a wrong decision.

ext.ext_cn: 许多寄给她的邮件都不知所终。
ext.ext_en: Many items of mail being sent to her have gone astray.

defs.def_en: If something goes astray, it gets lost while it is being taken or sent somewhere.

defs.def_cn: 动物赛跑比赛;(尤指)赛马;赛车

ext.ext_cn: 本田先生自己年轻时就是位热衷赛车的车手。
ext.ext_en: Mr Honda was himself a keen racing driver in his younger days...

ext.ext_cn: 赛马
ext.ext_en: ...horse racing...

defs.def_en: Racing refers to races between animals, especially horses, or between vehicles.

ext.ext_cn: 在这种宜人的天气里，他们健康活泼地茁壮成长。
ext.ext_en: They are bouncing with health in the good weather...

ext.ext_cn: 德里克现在是一位自豪的父亲，他有一个健康的小女儿。
ext.ext_en: Derek is now the proud father of a bouncing baby girl.

defs.def_en: See also:bounce;If you say that someone is bouncing with health, you mean that they are very healthy. You can also refer to a bouncing baby.
The common cold is a mild illness. If you have it, your nose is blocked or runny and you have a sore throat or a cough.
A conch is a shellfish with a large shell rather like a snail's. A conch or a conch shell is the shell of this creature.
Genera is the plural of genus.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 讨厌的;烦人的;令人厌倦的

ext.ext_cn: 隔壁讨人嫌的老太太
ext.ext_en: ...the tiresome old lady next door...

ext.ext_cn: 排队等候太烦人。

ext.ext_en: We suspected the telephone line was tapped.

defs.def_cn: (饮料)散装的，可随时(打开旋塞)取饮的

ext.ext_en: Filtered water is always on tap, making it very convenient to use.

defs.def_cn: 可轻松获取;可随时使用

ext.ext_en: The advantage of group holidays is company on tap but time alone if you want it.

defs.def_en: If something is on tap, you can have as much of it as you want whenever you want.

ext.ext_en: He is most insistent on this point...

defs.def_en: Someone who is insistent keeps insisting that a particular thing should be done or is the case.

ext.ext_en: ...the insistent rhythms of the Caribbean and Latin America.

defs.def_en: An insistent noise or rhythm keeps going on for a long time and holds your attention.

ext.ext_en: ...the lace trimming on her satin nightgown.

defs.def_en: The trimming on something such as a piece of clothing is the decoration, for example along its edges, that is in a different colour or material.

defs.def_cn: (切取所需部分以后的)下脚料，剩余物

ext.ext_en: Use any pastry trimmings to decorate the apples.

defs.def_cn: 种种额外的东西;外加的种种配搭

ext.ext_en: They were married with all the trimmings, soon after graduation.

ext.ext_cn: 有火鸡及各色配菜的感恩节大餐
ext.ext_en: …a Thanksgiving dinner of turkey and all the trimmings.

defs.def_en: If you say that something comes with all the trimmings, you mean that it has many extra things added to it to make it more special.

ext.ext_en: Most software programs allow you to compose emails offline.

defs.def_en: If a computer is offline, it is not connected to the Internet.  →see: line;

ext.ext_en: ...as the Chancellor arrived.

The Chancellor of a British university is the official head of the university. The Chancellor does not take part in running the university.
The head of some American universities is called the Chancellor .

defs.def_cn: (博物馆、足球场等入口处的)旋转栅门，十字转门

ext.ext_cn: 一串彩珠项链
ext.ext_en: ...a multicoloured bead necklace.

defs.def_en: Beads are small pieces of coloured glass, wood, or plastic with a hole through the middle. Beads are often put together on a piece of string or wire to make jewellery.

ext.ext_cn: 血滴
ext.ext_en: ...beads of blood...

ext.ext_en: He wiped away the beads of sweat on his forehead.

defs.def_en: A bead of liquid or moisture is a small drop of it.

ext.ext_en: She reworked a lot of her compositions to make them more danceable...

ext.ext_en: See if you can rework your schedule and come up with practical ways to reduce the number of hours you're on call.

defs.def_en: If you rework something such as an idea or a piece of writing, you reorganize it and make changes to it in order to improve it or bring it up to date.

ext.ext_en: It is always prudent to start any exercise programme gradually at first...

defs.def_en: Someone who is prudent is sensible and careful.

defs.def_en: A cockatoo is a kind of parrot from Australia or New Guinea which has a bunch of feathers called a crest on its head.

ext.ext_en: ...the possibility of professionalising local government by offering salaries to senior councillors.

defs.def_en: To professionalize an organization, an institution, or an activity means to make it more professional, for example by paying the people who are involved in it.

ext.ext_en: ...empty bottles of booze.

defs.def_en: If people booze, they drink alcohol.

ext.ext_en: ...a botched job.

ext.ext_en: I rather made a botch of that whole thing.

defs.def_en: If you make a botch of something that you are doing, you botch it.

ext.ext_en: ...two years of travel throughout the 48 contiguous states.

defs.def_en: Things that are contiguous are next to each other or touch each other.

ext.ext_en: Don't arch your back, keep your spine straight.

defs.def_en: If you arch a part of your body such as your back or if it arches, you bend it so that it forms a curve.

ext.ext_cn: “哦，真的吗？”他扬起一边的眉毛说。
ext.ext_en: 'Oh really?' he said, arching an eyebrow.

defs.def_en: If you arch your eyebrows or if they arch, you move them upwards as a way of showing surprise or disapproval.

defs.def_cn: 拱起；成弓形；呈弧形运动

ext.ext_en: I gazed up at the domed ceiling arching overhead.

defs.def_en: If something arches in a particular direction, it makes a curved line or movement.

ext.ext_en: Both of them looked at him with that curious, slightly amused and even arch expression.

defs.def_en: An arch look is mysterious and mischievous.

ext.ext_en: Their attempts to be casual have so far just looked arch or patronising.

defs.def_en: If there is a knock-on effect, one action or event causes several other events to happen one after the other.

ext.ext_en: Ben continued to stare out the window...

defs.def_en: If you stare at someone or something, you look at them for a long time.
