defs.def_en: To enrich a nuclear fuel such as uranium means to increase the number of atoms of a particular kind in it, so that it can be used to produce more energy or a greater explosion.

ext.ext_cn: 罗莎娜和福布斯默不作声地走了一会儿。
ext.ext_en: Rosanna and Forbes walked in silence for some while...

ext.ext_cn: 我们走进门厅。
ext.ext_en: We walked into the foyer...

defs.def_en: When you walk, you move forward by putting one foot in front of the other in a regular way.

ext.ext_cn: 我去散步了。
ext.ext_en: I went for a walk...

ext.ext_cn: 他经常在山中久久漫步。
ext.ext_en: He often took long walks in the hills.

defs.def_en: A walk is a journey that you make by walking, usually for pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 从那里到喀布尔只需走上3英里。
ext.ext_en: It was only a three-mile walk to Kabul from there...

ext.ext_cn: 教堂离但丁广场只有几步之遥。
ext.ext_en: The church is a short walk from Piazza Dante.

defs.def_en: A walk of a particular distance is the distance which a person has to walk to get somewhere.

defs.def_cn: 步行小径;(适宜散步的)小径，道路

ext.ext_cn: 从克拉斯特到牛顿有一条两英里的海滨小径。
ext.ext_en: There is a 2 mile coastal walk from Craster to Newton.

defs.def_en: A walk is a route suitable for walking along for pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 她放慢脚步，徐徐而行。
ext.ext_en: She slowed to a steady walk.

defs.def_en: A walk is the action of walking rather than running.

ext.ext_cn: 乔治尽管长得过高，走路姿势难看，但却热衷于跳舞。
ext.ext_en: George, despite his great height and gangling walk, was a keen dancer.

defs.def_en: Someone's walk is the way that they walk.

ext.ext_cn: 她陪我走到我的车旁。
ext.ext_en: She walked me to my car...

ext.ext_cn: “您能送希拉里走回家，真是一位绅士，”她的母亲说道。
ext.ext_en: 'What a nice gentleman you are, to walk Hilary home,' her mother said.

defs.def_en: If you walk someone somewhere, you walk there with them in order to show politeness or to make sure that they get there safely.

ext.ext_cn: 我每晚在家附近的街道上遛狗。
ext.ext_en: I walk my dog each evening around my local streets.

defs.def_en: If you walk your dog, you take it for a walk in order to keep it healthy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在拉丁美洲广泛游历
ext.ext_en: ...an extensive tour of Latin America...

ext.ext_cn: 建成时，宫殿及其庭园比城市本身面积还要大。
ext.ext_en: When built, the palace and its grounds were more extensive than the city itself.

defs.def_en: Something that is extensive covers or includes a large physical area.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 广泛的;全面的;包罗万象的

ext.ext_cn: 《星期日电讯报》全面报道了南非的发展。
ext.ext_en: Developments in South Africa receive extensive coverage in The Sunday Telegraph...

ext.ext_cn: 针对公众科学观的广泛调查
ext.ext_en: ...the extensive research into public attitudes to science...

defs.def_en: Something that is extensive covers a wide range of details, ideas, or items.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 爆炸造成了巨大的破坏，震碎了一楼的窗户。
ext.ext_en: The blast caused extensive damage, shattering the ground-floor windows...

ext.ext_cn: 安全部队拥有搜查和逮捕的至高权力。
ext.ext_en: The security forces have extensive powers of search and arrest...

defs.def_en: If something is extensive, it is very great.

ext.ext_cn: 她开始解衬衣扣子。
ext.ext_en: She had begun to unbutton her blouse.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有扣上纽扣的蓝色外套
ext.ext_en: ...his unbuttoned blue coat.

defs.def_en: If you unbutton an item of clothing, you undo the buttons fastening it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在最近的一次袭击中，一名男子遇袭身亡，另外两人受伤。
ext.ext_en: In the most recent attack one man was shot dead and two others were wounded...

ext.ext_cn: 近几年来销售额下降了75%以上。
ext.ext_en: Sales have fallen by more than 75 percent in recent years.

defs.def_en: A recent event or period of time happened only a short while ago.
A  crocodile is a large reptile with a long body and strong jaws. Crocodiles live in rivers and eat meat.

defs.def_cn: (尤指小学生排成的)长队;（行进车辆排成的）长蛇阵

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们排队从校舍去餐厅吃午饭。
ext.ext_en: The children walk in crocodiles from the schoolhouse to the dining-room for lunch.

ext.ext_cn: 排成一长串的长途客车
ext.ext_en: ...a long crocodile of coaches.

defs.def_en: A crocodile of people, especially school children, or vehicles is a long line of them, moving together.

defs.def_cn: （西服）有细条纹的，有细线条的
defs.def_en: A pinstriped suit is made of cloth that has very narrow vertical stripes.

ext.ext_cn: 我会送你一只阿尔萨斯小狗作为圣诞节礼物。
ext.ext_en: I'll get you an Alsatian pup for Christmas.

defs.def_en: A pup is a young dog.

ext.ext_cn: 那里每年秋天有2,000头灰色小海豹出生。
ext.ext_en: Two thousand grey seal pups are born there every autumn.

defs.def_en: The young of some other animals, for example seals, are called pups.

ext.ext_cn: 带铜纽扣的外套
ext.ext_en: ...a coat with brass buttons.

defs.def_en: Buttons are small hard objects sewn on to shirts, coats, or other pieces of clothing. You fasten the clothing by pushing the buttons through holes called buttonholes.

ext.ext_cn: 弗格森站起身来，扣上了外套。
ext.ext_en: Ferguson stood up and buttoned his coat.

ext.ext_cn: 我扣上了外套的扣子；天气很冷。
ext.ext_en: I buttoned up my coat; it was chilly...

defs.def_en: If you button a shirt, coat, or other piece of clothing, you fasten it by pushing its buttons through the buttonholes.

ext.ext_cn: 他伸手拿过遥控器，按下“播放”键。
ext.ext_en: He reached for the remote control and pressed the 'play' button.

defs.def_en: A button is a small object on a machine or electrical device that you press in order to operate it.
A button is a small piece of metal or plastic which you wear in order to show that you support a particular movement, organization, or person. You fasten a button to your clothes with a pin.

ext.ext_cn: 布坎南通过激发马厄的忠心和负罪感得到了他想要的东西。
ext.ext_en: Buchanan pushed all the right buttons, appealing to Maher's loyalty and to his guilt.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone presses the right button or pushes the right button, you mean that they get what they want from a particular situation or person by behaving in a clever way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （情感、记忆、兴趣等）持久的，长久的

ext.ext_cn: 他对这门手艺有着真挚持久的热爱。
ext.ext_en: He has a genuine and abiding love of the craft...

ext.ext_cn: 我对他难以忘怀的一幕是他在一次小型私人派对上献歌的情景。
ext.ext_en: One of my abiding memories of him is of his singing to a small private party...

defs.def_en: An abiding feeling, memory, or interest is one that you have for a very long time.
A text message is a written message that you send using a mobile phone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有些人非常虚伪,你根本说不准他们是否在讲实话。
ext.ext_en: Some people are so terribly insincere you can never tell if they are telling the truth...

ext.ext_cn: 约翰发现自己为虚情假意的奉承阿谀所包围。
ext.ext_en: John found himself surrounded by insincere flattery.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is insincere, you are being critical of them because they say things they do not really mean, usually pleasant, admiring, or encouraging things.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车大奖赛将由英国广播公司进行电视转播。
ext.ext_en: The Grand Prix will be televised by the BBC.

defs.def_en: If an event or programme is televised, it is broadcast so that it can be seen on television.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不顾及他人的;欠考虑的

ext.ext_cn: 一小群只顾自己、不顾别人的人
ext.ext_en: ...a small minority of thoughtless and inconsiderate people...

ext.ext_cn: 她提起这事有些欠考虑。
ext.ext_en: It was thoughtless of her to mention it...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as thoughtless, you are critical of them because they forget or ignore other people's wants, needs, or feelings.

defs.def_cn: (旧时受雇在市镇街头宣读公告的)公告传报员
defs.def_en: In former times, a town crier was a man whose job was to walk through the streets of a town shouting out news and official announcements.

ext.ext_cn: 英国业余体操协会
ext.ext_en: ...the British Amateur Gymnastics Association.

defs.def_en: Gymnastics consists of physical exercises that develop your strength, co-ordination, and ease of movement.

ext.ext_cn: 体操训练
ext.ext_en: ...gymnastic exercises.

defs.def_en: Gymnastic is used to describe things relating to gymnastics.

ext.ext_cn: 她的嗓音擅长演绎有难度的歌曲。
ext.ext_en: Hers is the kind of voice that excels at vocal gymnastics...

ext.ext_cn: 他们是仅有的那些头脑足够灵活来应对这些需要动脑筋的事的人。
ext.ext_en: They are the only ones whose brains are supple enough for the mental gymnastics required.

defs.def_en: You can use gymnastics to refer to activities which require skills such as speed and adaptability.

ext.ext_cn: 伊斯兰先知的圣名
ext.ext_en: ...the sacred name of the Holy Prophet of Islam.

defs.def_en: A prophet is a person who is believed to be chosen by God to say the things that God wants to tell people.

ext.ext_cn: 我发誓要打破所有的死亡预言，力争恢复健康。
ext.ext_en: I promised myself I'd defy all the prophets of doom and battle back to fitness.

defs.def_en: A prophet is someone who predicts that something will happen in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 这种人令我们这一行业蒙羞。
ext.ext_en: Such people bring our profession into disrepute.

defs.def_en: If something is brought into disrepute or falls into disrepute, it loses its good reputation, because it is connected with activities that people do not approve of.

ext.ext_cn: 对我们很多人来说，圣诞期间可能是一年中压力最大的时候。
ext.ext_en: For many of us, the festive season can be one of the most stressful times of the year.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to the Christmas period as the festive season .

ext.ext_cn: 火箭发射了两颗通信卫星。
ext.ext_en: The rocket launched two communications satellites...

ext.ext_cn: 信号通过人造卫星链路发出。
ext.ext_en: The signals are sent by satellite link...

defs.def_en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

defs.def_cn: (电视)使用卫星技术的;卫视的

ext.ext_cn: 他们有 4 个卫星频道。
ext.ext_en: They have four satellite channels.

defs.def_en: Satellite television is broadcast using a satellite.

ext.ext_cn: 木星的卫星
ext.ext_en: ...the satellites of Jupiter.

defs.def_en: A satellite is a natural object in space that moves round a planet or star.

defs.def_cn: 卫星国;附属国;卫星区;卫星组织

ext.ext_cn: 意大利在 20 世纪 30 年代末成了德国的附庸。
ext.ext_en: Italy became a satellite state of Germany by the end of the 1930s.

ext.ext_cn: 俄国及其曾经的卫星国
ext.ext_en: ...Russia and its former satellites.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a country, area, or organization as a satellite when it is controlled by or depends on a larger and more powerful one.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极不理智的;愚蠢透顶的

ext.ext_cn: 如果他能够向委员会证明他没有丧失理智
ext.ext_en: ...if he can convince the committee that he is not certifiable.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as certifiable, you think that their behaviour is extremely unreasonable or foolish.

ext.ext_cn: 节目的最后我们要举行一次智力竞赛。
ext.ext_en: We'll have a quiz at the end of the show.

defs.def_en: A quiz is a game or competition in which someone tests your knowledge by asking you questions.

ext.ext_cn: 他被问及收入、债务以及是否有资格享受政府发放的救济金等问题。
ext.ext_en: He was quizzed about his income, debts and eligibility for state benefits...

ext.ext_cn: 西比尔询问了她当女工的生活。
ext.ext_en: Sybil quizzed her about life as a working girl.

defs.def_en: If you are quizzed by someone about something, they ask you questions about it.

ext.ext_cn: 警方已经告诫该市居民不要在这条被污染的河里游泳。
ext.ext_en: The police have warned the city's inhabitants not to bathe in the polluted river.

ext.ext_cn: 可供禽鸟嬉戏的小池塘
ext.ext_en: ...small ponds for the birds to bathe in.

defs.def_en: If you bathe in a sea, river, or lake, you swim, play, or wash yourself in it. Birds and animals can also bathe.

ext.ext_cn: 现在我们当中至少60%的人每天淋浴或洗澡一次。
ext.ext_en: At least 60% of us now bathe or shower once a day.

defs.def_en: When  you bathe, you have a bath.

ext.ext_cn: 回到家里，雪莉逗宝宝玩耍，喂他吃饭，给他洗澡。
ext.ext_en: Back home, Shirley plays with, feeds and bathes the baby.

defs.def_en: If you bathe someone, especially a child, you wash them in a bath.

defs.def_cn: （用液体）轻轻地清洗（某身体部位或伤口）；将（某身体部位或伤口）浸泡（在液体中）

ext.ext_cn: 用盐水清洗感染的部位。
ext.ext_en: Bathe the infected area in a salt solution...

ext.ext_cn: 她把双脚长时间泡在水中，以充分浸泡长满水泡的脚。
ext.ext_en: She paused long enough to bathe her blistered feet.

defs.def_en: If you bathe a part of your body or a wound, you wash it gently or soak it in a liquid.

defs.def_cn: （光线）洒满，覆盖；使沐浴在（光线中）

ext.ext_cn: 竞技场沐浴在温暖的阳光中。
ext.ext_en: The arena was bathed in warm sunshine...

ext.ext_cn: 我被带到了一间笼罩在柔和红光中的小屋里。
ext.ext_en: I was led to a small room bathed in soft red light...

defs.def_en: If a place is bathed in light, it is covered with light, especially a gentle, pleasant light.

ext.ext_cn: 我服用了抗生素来治疗鼻窦炎，但似乎未能根治。
ext.ext_en: I have had antibiotics for my sinusitis but it doesn't seem to be clearing up.

defs.def_en: If you have sinusitis, the layer of flesh inside your sinuses is swollen and painful, which can cause headaches and a blocked nose.

ext.ext_cn: 我们会尽全力维持和平。
ext.ext_en: We will do everything to preserve peace.

ext.ext_cn: 在保持原有教学水平的同时招收更多学生的努力
ext.ext_en: ...an effort to fit in more students while preserving standards.

defs.def_en: If you preserve a situation or condition, you make sure that it remains as it is, and does not change or end.

ext.ext_cn: 我们需要保护森林。
ext.ext_en: We need to preserve the forest...

ext.ext_cn: 资源保护是目前备受关注的问题——不管它指的是对古建筑的保护，还是对环境的保护。
ext.ext_en: Conservation is an issue which gets a lot of attention these days — whether it means preserving old buildings, or protecting the environment.

defs.def_en: If you preserve something, you take action to save it or protect it from damage or decay.

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢做果泥，只需要用一点糖把李子腌一下。
ext.ext_en: I like to make puree, using only enough sugar to preserve the plums.

ext.ext_cn: 用糖浆腌制的姜
ext.ext_en: ...preserved ginger in syrup.

defs.def_en: If you preserve food, you treat it in order to prevent it from decaying so that you can store it for a long time.
Preserves are foods such as jam that are made by cooking fruit with a large amount of sugar so that they can be stored for a long time.

defs.def_cn: 专属工作；独占的活动领域

ext.ext_cn: 外交政策事宜主要由总统专门负责。
ext.ext_en: The conduct of foreign policy is largely the preserve of the president...

ext.ext_cn: 由于男人们都去了战场，女人们第一次在男性专属的职业和运动中一展身手。
ext.ext_en: With the menfolk away at war, women got their first crack at the male preserves of employment and sport.

defs.def_en: If you say that a job or activity is the preserve of a particular person or group of people, you mean that they are the only ones who take part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 潘塔纳尔，世界上最大的野生动物保护区之一
ext.ext_en: ...Pantanal, one of the world's great wildlife preserves.

defs.def_en: A nature preserve is an area of land or water where animals are protected from hunters.
Stock control is the activity of making sure that a company always has exactly the right amount of goods available to sell.
If you have a crick in your neck or in your back, you have a pain there caused by muscles becoming stiff.

ext.ext_cn: 2 月或 3 月里把种子播种在温暖的地方。
ext.ext_en: Sow the seed in a warm place in February/March...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天对面的田里播种了玉米。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday the field opposite was sown with maize.

defs.def_en: If you sow seeds or sow an area of land with seeds, you plant the seeds in the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 他巧妙地令对手心生疑窦。
ext.ext_en: He cleverly sowed doubts into the minds of his rivals...

ext.ext_cn: 相反，这次会议却引发了混乱。
ext.ext_en: Instead, the session has sowed confusion.

defs.def_en: If someone sows an undesirable feeling or situation, they cause it to begin and develop.

defs.def_cn: 播下了…的种子;开始了(某一进程)

ext.ext_cn: 富庶的工业国家播下了全球变暖的种子。
ext.ext_en: Rich industrialised countries have sown the seeds of global warming.

defs.def_en: If one thing sows the seeds of another, it starts the process which leads eventually to the other thing.
A sow is an adult female pig.

defs.def_cn: (尤指色彩或感情)弥漫于，布满，充满

ext.ext_cn: 塞尔比的脸庞泛起了淡淡的红晕。
ext.ext_en: A dull red flush suffused Selby's face.

defs.def_en: If something, especially a colour or feeling, suffuses a person or thing, it gradually spreads over or through them.

defs.def_cn: 使充满，使洋溢着(某种品质)

ext.ext_cn: 这本书充满了萧伯纳独特的爱尔兰式幽默与嘲讽。
ext.ext_en: This book is suffused with Shaw's characteristic wry Irish humour...

ext.ext_cn: 金登身为作家和学者的丰富阅历在这部重要的著作中体现得淋漓尽致。
ext.ext_en: Kingdon's broad experience, as writer and scholar, suffuses this important book.

defs.def_en: If something such as a book, film, or piece of music is suffused with a quality, it is full of that quality.
Whilst means the same as the conjunction while .

ext.ext_cn: 氟利昂有液态和气态两种形态。
ext.ext_en: Freon exists both in liquid and gaseous states.

defs.def_en: You use gaseous to describe something which is in the form of a gas, rather than a solid or liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 银制托盘上放着几杯斟在长笛杯里的香槟酒
ext.ext_en: ...silver salvers laden with flutes of champagne.

defs.def_en: A salver is a flat object, usually made of silver, on which things are carried.

ext.ext_cn: 墙壁漆成了亮黄色。
ext.ext_en: The walls have been painted bright yellow...

ext.ext_cn: 金为主卧室挑选了偏冷色调的蓝色和黄色。
ext.ext_en: Kim opted for cooler blues and yellows in the master bedroom.

defs.def_en: Something that is yellow is the colour of lemons, butter, or the middle part of an egg.

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎有些面色发黄。
ext.ext_en: The flesh of his cheeks seemed to have yellowed...

ext.ext_cn: 她坐着浏览发黄的书页。
ext.ext_en: She sat scanning the yellowing pages.

defs.def_en: If something yellows, it becomes yellow in colour, often because it is old.
An aspen is a tall tree with leaves that move a lot in the wind.

defs.def_cn: （形成反差的物体、形象或想法的）并置，并列

ext.ext_cn: 这种残忍的现实和浪漫美好事物的并存始终贯穿于帕克的短篇小说中。
ext.ext_en: This juxtaposition of brutal reality and lyrical beauty runs through Park's stories.

defs.def_en: The juxtaposition of two contrasting objects, images, or ideas is the fact that they are placed together or described together, so that the differences between them are emphasized.

ext.ext_cn: 在百慕大，萨姆的父亲带他到附近的珊瑚礁去游玩。
ext.ext_en: In Bermuda, Sam's father took him on an excursion to a coral barrier.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a short journey as an excursion, especially if it is made for pleasure or enjoyment.  →see usage note at:journey

defs.def_cn: （尤指旅行社组织的）短途旅游

ext.ext_cn: 我们还推荐去杜罗河上游的短途自选一日游。
ext.ext_en: We also recommend a full day optional excursion to the Upper Douro...

ext.ext_cn: 另一个非常不错的短途旅游是去18英里以外的马拉加。
ext.ext_en: Another pleasant excursion is Malaga, 18 miles away.

defs.def_en: An excursion is a trip or visit to an interesting place, especially one that is arranged or recommended by a holiday company or tourist organization.

ext.ext_cn: 第三广播台最近开始涉及有关少数民族音乐、舞蹈和文学的节目
ext.ext_en: ...Radio 3's latest excursion into ethnic music, dance and literature...

ext.ext_cn: 几次体裁上的尝试都不算很成功。
ext.ext_en: The few excursions into stylistic experiment do not entirely come off.

defs.def_en: If you describe an activity as an excursion into something, you mean that it is an attempt to develop or understand something new that you have not experienced before.

ext.ext_cn: 因为感情方面的原因，我想把离开的日期延迟至6月。
ext.ext_en: For sentimental reasons I wanted to delay my departure until June...

ext.ext_cn: 为了那个通常的原因——创立自己的事业，他们推迟了要孩子。
ext.ext_en: They had delayed having children, for the usual reason, to establish their careers...

defs.def_en: If you delay doing something, you do not do it immediately or at the planned or expected time, but you leave it until later.  →see usage note at:cancel

ext.ext_cn: 你能想办法拖住他一会儿吗？
ext.ext_en: Can you delay him in some way?...

ext.ext_cn: 各种各样的挫折和问题耽搁了生产进度。
ext.ext_en: Various setbacks and problems delayed production...

defs.def_en: To delay someone or something means to make them late or to slow them down.

ext.ext_cn: 如果他再拖延，太阳就要出来了。
ext.ext_en: If he delayed any longer, the sun would be up.

defs.def_en: If you delay, you deliberately take longer than necessary to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 他们声称这样的延期对谁都不会造成损害。
ext.ext_en: They claimed that such a delay wouldn't hurt anyone...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然检测造成了一定的延迟，不过今天早上航班就应该能恢复正常了。
ext.ext_en: Although the tests have caused some delay, flights should be back to normal this morning.

defs.def_en: If there is a delay, something does not happen until later than planned or expected.

ext.ext_cn: 已经没有时间再耽误了。
ext.ext_en: There is no time left for delay...

ext.ext_cn: 我们会立刻送一份报价给你。
ext.ext_en: We'll send you a quote without delay.

defs.def_en: Delay is a failure to do something immediately or in the required or usual time.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为 7 岁大的学生的测试分数和班级的规模有关系。
ext.ext_en: He suggested a link between class size and test results of seven-year-olds...

ext.ext_cn: 我建议你问他一些有关他的过去的具体问题。
ext.ext_en: I suggest you ask him some specific questions about his past...

defs.def_en: If you suggest something, you put forward a plan or idea for someone to think about.

ext.ext_cn: 这该怎么办？你能不能推荐一个人帮我出个主意？
ext.ext_en: Could you suggest someone to advise me how to do this?...

ext.ext_cn: 他们可以推荐去哪里购买。
ext.ext_en: They can suggest where to buy one.

defs.def_en: If you suggest the name of a person or place, you recommend them to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 我没有说那就是事实。
ext.ext_en: I'm not suggesting that is what is happening...

ext.ext_cn: 如果认为有更容易的选择，那就错了。
ext.ext_en: It is wrong to suggest that there are easy alternatives...

defs.def_en: If you suggest that something is the case, you say something which you believe is the case.

ext.ext_cn: 早先的报道暗示周日可能会召开会议。
ext.ext_en: Earlier reports suggested that a meeting would take place on Sunday...

ext.ext_cn: 它毛茸茸的身体表明它是哺乳动物。
ext.ext_en: Its hairy body suggests a mammal.

defs.def_en: If one thing suggests another, it implies it or makes you think that it might be the case.

ext.ext_cn: 这个拟声词让我想起捕鼠夹子突然合上时的声音。
ext.ext_en: This onomatopoeic word suggests to me the sound a mousetrap makes when it snaps shut.

defs.def_en: If one thing suggests another, it brings it to your mind through an association of ideas.

defs.def_cn: （用于名词后构成形容词）表示“由…携带的”，“通过…传播的”

ext.ext_cn: 通过水传播的疾病
ext.ext_en: ...water-borne diseases.

ext.ext_cn: 一种由蚊子携带的传染病
ext.ext_en: ...a mosquito-borne infection.

defs.def_en: -borne combines with nouns to form adjectives that describe the method or means by which something is carried or moved.
A cooktop is a surface on top of a cooker or set into a work surface, which can be heated in order to cook things on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （对新思想或建议）乐于接受的，能接纳的，善于听取的

ext.ext_cn: 选民看上去很愿意接受他的想法。
ext.ext_en: The voters had seemed receptive to his ideas...

ext.ext_cn: 你觉得有人愿意接受他的言论吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you think that there is any receptive audience for his remarks.

defs.def_en: Someone who is receptive to new ideas or suggestions is prepared to consider them or accept them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （对治疗）反应良好的，能接纳的

ext.ext_cn: 治疗未见效果的那些病人
ext.ext_en: ...those patients who are not receptive to treatment.

defs.def_en: If someone who is ill is receptive to treatment, they start to get better when they are given treatment.

defs.def_cn: 使合法化；使得到法律认可

ext.ext_cn: 离婚合法化是在1981年。
ext.ext_en: Divorce was legalized in 1981.

ext.ext_cn: 格鲁吉亚政府让多党选举合法化的决定
ext.ext_en: ...the decision of the Georgian government to legalise multi-party elections.

defs.def_en: If something is legalized, a law is passed that makes it legal.

ext.ext_cn: 指挥官说军队会遵守停火协议。
ext.ext_en: The commander said that the army would comply with the ceasefire...

ext.ext_cn: 有些海滩未能遵守欧洲有关浴场的指令。
ext.ext_en: Some beaches had failed to comply with European directives on bathing water...

defs.def_en: If someone or something complies with an order or set of rules, they are in accordance with what is required or expected.

ext.ext_cn: 巴格达的哈里发
ext.ext_en: ...the caliph of Baghdad.

defs.def_en: A Caliph was a Muslim ruler.

ext.ext_cn: 他安慰地捏了捏她的胳膊。
ext.ext_en: He squeezed her arm reassuringly...

ext.ext_cn: 将面包在水里快速蘸一下，然后将它挤干。
ext.ext_en: Dip the bread briefly in water, then squeeze it dry.

defs.def_en: If you squeeze something, you press it firmly, usually with your hands.

defs.def_cn: 压榨，挤出(液体或软的东西)

ext.ext_cn: 乔用塞子塞住水槽，往盘子上挤了点洗涤剂。
ext.ext_en: Joe put the plug in the sink and squeezed some detergent over the dishes.

ext.ext_cn: 新榨的柠檬汁
ext.ext_en: ...freshly squeezed lemon juice.

defs.def_en: If you squeeze a liquid or a soft substance out of an object, you get the liquid or substance out by pressing the object.

defs.def_cn: (常因害怕或保护眼睛而)紧闭(双眼)

ext.ext_cn: 南希紧闭双眼祈祷着。
ext.ext_en: Nancy squeezed her eyes shut and prayed...

ext.ext_cn: 如果一直紧闭双眼，你就要错过精彩的表演了。
ext.ext_en: If you keep your eyes squeezed shut, you'll miss the show...

defs.def_en: If you squeeze your eyes shut or if your eyes squeeze shut, you close them tightly, usually because you are frightened or to protect your eyes from something such as strong sunlight.

ext.ext_cn: 他们将他慢慢向下放入驾驶舱，设法将他塞进了狭小的空间，并给他系好安全带。
ext.ext_en: They lowered him gradually into the cockpit. Somehow they squeezed him in the tight space, and strapped him in...

ext.ext_cn: 很多入室盗窃案都是年轻人干的，他们可以从狭小的窗口钻进去。
ext.ext_en: Many break-ins are carried out by youngsters who can squeeze through tiny windows.

defs.def_en: If you squeeze a person or thing somewhere or if they squeeze there, they manage to get through or into a small space.

ext.ext_cn: 车里坐了他们 5 个人，很拥挤。
ext.ext_en: It was a squeeze in the car with five of them...

ext.ext_cn: 电梯里挤一挤能容纳 6 个人。
ext.ext_en: The lift holds six people at a squeeze.

defs.def_en: If you say that getting a number of people into a small space is a squeeze, you mean that it is only just possible for them all to get into it.

ext.ext_cn: 调查人员抱怨说很难从居民身上获取信息。
ext.ext_en: The investigators complained about the difficulties of squeezing information out of residents...

ext.ext_cn: 公司试图从供货商那里再省下一笔费用。
ext.ext_en: The company intends to squeeze further savings from its suppliers.

defs.def_en: If you squeeze something out of someone, you persuade them to give it to you, although they may be unwilling to do this.

ext.ext_cn: 政府将紧缩经济，使之出现严重衰退，以此迫使通货膨胀率下降。
ext.ext_en: The government will squeeze the economy into a severe recession to force inflation down...

ext.ext_cn: 国防专家说合作项目正迫于预算压力越来越受到压缩。
ext.ext_en: Defense experts say joint projects are increasingly squeezed by budget pressures.

defs.def_en: If a government squeezes the economy, they put strict controls on people's ability to borrow money or on their own departments' freedom to spend money, in order to control the country's rate of inflation.

ext.ext_cn: 周末杰克炫耀了一番自己新交的女朋友。
ext.ext_en: Jack showed off his latest squeeze at the weekend.

defs.def_en: Someone's squeeze is their boyfriend or girlfriend.

ext.ext_cn: 腹部肿胀和疼痛
ext.ext_en: ...abdominal bloating and pain.

defs.def_en: Bloating is the swelling of a body or part of a body, usually because it has a lot of gas or liquid in it.

defs.def_cn: （柑橘类水果皮和瓤之间的）衬皮
defs.def_en: The pith of an orange, lemon, or similar fruit is the white substance between the skin and the inside of the fruit.

ext.ext_cn: 7月酷热的一天
ext.ext_en: ...a baking July day...

ext.ext_cn: 棺材放在炽热的太阳下，周围是哀悼的人们。
ext.ext_en: The coffins stood in the baking heat surrounded by mourners.

defs.def_en: See also:bake;You can use baking to describe weather or a place that is very hot indeed.

defs.def_cn: （与形容词连用）表示“长着…眼睛的”，“有…眼神的”

ext.ext_cn: 金发碧眼的小女孩
ext.ext_en: ...a blonde-haired, blue-eyed little girl...

ext.ext_cn: 飞机起飞时，她瞪大眼睛看着。
ext.ext_en: She watched open-eyed as the plane took off.

defs.def_en: -eyed combines with adjectives to form adjectives which indicate the colour, shape, or size of a person's eyes, or indicate the kind of expression that they have.
Eyeglasses are two lenses in a frame that some people wear in front of their eyes in order to help them see better.

ext.ext_cn: 他正在考虑抵押他的手表。
ext.ext_en: He is contemplating pawning his watch.

defs.def_en: If you pawn something that you own, you leave it with a pawnbroker, who gives you money for it and who can sell it if you do not pay back the money before a certain time.
In chess, a pawn is the smallest and least valuable playing piece. Each player has eight pawns at the start of the game.

ext.ext_cn: 看起来他似乎被总统当作了政治卒子。
ext.ext_en: It looks as though he is being used as a political pawn by the President...

ext.ext_cn: 他们是那些看不见的俘获者手中的权力斗争工具。
ext.ext_en: They are the pawns in the power game played by their unseen captors.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is using you as a pawn, you mean that they are using you for their own advantage.

ext.ext_cn: 他打算重走哥伦布到达西印度群岛的航行路线。
ext.ext_en: He aims to follow Columbus's voyage to the West Indies.

ext.ext_cn: 首次完全以天文研究为目的的航天飞行
ext.ext_en: ...the first space shuttle voyage to be devoted entirely to astronomy.

defs.def_en: A voyage is a long journey on a ship or in a spacecraft.  →see usage note at:journey

ext.ext_cn: 绿色和平组织的旗舰正在穿越巴伦支海的北极寒冷地带。
ext.ext_en: The Greenpeace flagship is voyaging through the Arctic cold of the Barents Sea.

defs.def_en: To voyage to a place means to travel there, especially by sea.

ext.ext_cn: 和伦敦城及伦敦地铁网连接的高速交通网
ext.ext_en: ...a rapid transit link with the City and London's underground system...

ext.ext_cn: 今晨早些时候，两辆高速火车在波士顿相撞。
ext.ext_en: Two rapid transit trains collided early this morning in Boston.

defs.def_en: A rapid transit system is a transport system in a city which allows people to travel quickly, using trains that run underground or above the streets.
A credit slip is the same as a credit note .
See also:water polo;Polo is a game played between two teams of players. The players ride horses and use wooden hammers with long handles to hit a ball.
A giraffe is a large African animal with a very long neck, long legs, and dark patches on its body.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 舞跳得太棒了。
ext.ext_en: The dancing is fab.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is fab, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good.
Interior decoration is the decoration of the inside of a house.
Chinatown is the name given to the area in a city where there are many Chinese shops and restaurants, and which is a social centre for the Chinese community in the city.

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚他们呆在了家里看电视。
ext.ext_en: Last night they stayed at home and watched TV...

ext.ext_cn: 他位于汉普斯特德的住所
ext.ext_en: ...his home in Hampstead.

defs.def_en: Someone's home is the house or flat where they live.

ext.ext_cn: 她经常在国内外演出自己的作品。
ext.ext_en: She gives frequent performances of her work, both at home and abroad...

ext.ext_cn: 父亲在吉姆5岁前的大部分时间里都在外地工作。
ext.ext_en: His father worked away from home for much of Jim's first five years...

defs.def_en: You can use home to refer in a general way to the house, town, or country where someone lives now or where they were born, often to emphasize that they feel they belong in that place.

ext.ext_cn: 他的妻子感到有些不舒服，想要回家。
ext.ext_en: His wife wasn't feeling too well and she wanted to go home...

ext.ext_cn: 我一到家就给你打电话。
ext.ext_en: I'll telephone you as soon as I get home...

defs.def_en: Home means to or at the place where you live.

ext.ext_cn: 便宜而健康的家常菜
ext.ext_en: ...cheap but healthy home cooking...

ext.ext_cn: 你要做的就是拍一段家庭录像片。
ext.ext_en: All you have to do is make a home video.

defs.def_en: Home means made or done in the place where you live.

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲软件公司的国内市场仍在增长中。
ext.ext_en: Europe's software companies still have a growing home market.

ext.ext_cn: 《卫报》的国内新闻版
ext.ext_en: ...the Guardian's home news pages.

defs.def_en: Home means relating to your own country as opposed to foreign countries.

ext.ext_cn: 这将是一家残疾儿童福利院。
ext.ext_en: It's going to be a home for handicapped children.

ext.ext_cn: 养老院
ext.ext_en: ...an old people's home.

defs.def_en: A home is a large house or institution where a number of people live and are looked after, instead of living in their own houses or flats. They usually live there because they are too old or ill to look after themselves or for their families to care for them.

ext.ext_cn: 她至少为哈丽雅特提供了一个安宁关爱的家。
ext.ext_en: She had, at any rate, provided a peaceful and loving home for Harriet...

ext.ext_cn: 单亲家庭很普遍。
ext.ext_en: Single-parent homes are commonplace.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a family unit as a home .

defs.def_cn: 发源地;发祥地;产地;生息地

ext.ext_cn: 法国西南部的这个地区是干红葡萄酒的产地。
ext.ext_en: This south-west region of France is the home of claret.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the home of something, you mean the place where it began or where it is most typically found.

ext.ext_cn: 该设备本身正变得越来越小，越来越轻巧，也越来越便于存放。
ext.ext_en: The equipment itself is getting smaller, neater and easier to find a home for.

defs.def_en: If you find a home for something, you find a place where it can be kept.

defs.def_cn: 击中要害地;彻底地;深切地;切实地

ext.ext_cn: 现在要靠我们大家对此问题进行辩论，并尽可能将论点阐述清楚。
ext.ext_en: It is now up to all of us to debate this issue and press home the argument.

defs.def_en: If you press, drive, or hammer something home, you explain it to people as forcefully as possible.

ext.ext_cn: 我在两场对阵巴塞罗那队的比赛中都进了球;我们在主场战平，在客场赢了他们。
ext.ext_en: I scored in both games against Barcelona; we drew at home and beat them away.

ext.ext_cn: 3个人都是切尔西队的球迷，一起观看了所有的主场比赛。
ext.ext_en: All three are Chelsea fans, and attend all home games together.

defs.def_en: When a sports team plays at home, they play a game on their own ground, rather than on the opposing team's ground.

defs.def_cn: 像在家一样舒适自在;无拘束

ext.ext_cn: 他英语说得非常好，见到我们显得很高兴，我们很快就不拘束了。
ext.ext_en: He spoke very good English and appeared pleased to see us, and we soon felt quite at home...

ext.ext_cn: 我在任何一个新教教会都不是特别自在。
ext.ext_en: I am not completely at home in any Protestant Church.

defs.def_en: If you feel at home, you feel comfortable in the place or situation that you are in.

defs.def_cn: 使清楚地领会;使深切地感到

ext.ext_cn: 他们发人深省的对话使在座的每个人都清楚地认识到红十字会所从事的严肃而有价值的工作。
ext.ext_en: Their sobering conversation brought home to everyone present the serious and worthwhile work the Red Cross does.

defs.def_en: To bring something home to someone means to make them understand how important or serious it is.

ext.ext_cn: 首相和温和派还未大功告成。
ext.ext_en: The prime minister and the moderates are not yet home and dry.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is, in British English home and dry, or in American English home free, you mean that they have been successful or that they are certain to be successful.

defs.def_cn: 切中要害;使人接受（或认清）事实

ext.ext_cn: 人们终于认清战争的现实了吗？
ext.ext_en: Did the reality of war finally hit home?...

ext.ext_cn: 以色列官员说这一信息切中了要害。
ext.ext_en: Israeli officials say that message struck home.

defs.def_en: If a situation or what someone says hits home or strikes home, people accept that it is real or true, even though it may be painful for them to realize.

defs.def_cn: 像家里一样舒适的地方

ext.ext_cn: 很多度假屋都像自家一样，里面有微波炉、洗碗机、电视机和录像机。
ext.ext_en: Many cottages are a home from home, offering microwaves, dishwashers, tvs and videos.

defs.def_en: You can say a home from home in British English or a home away from home in American English to refer to a place in which you are as comfortable as in your own home.
If you say to a guest 'Make yourself at home', you are making them feel welcome and inviting them to behave in an informal, relaxed way.

defs.def_cn: 平平常常;没有什么特别有趣的地方

ext.ext_cn: 这么说，在沃尔瑟姆斯托度过的一个沉闷的周一下午没什么值得大书特书的，是吗？
ext.ext_en: So a dreary Monday afternoon in Walthamstow is nothing to write home about, right?

defs.def_en: If you say that something is nothing to write home about, you mean that it is not very interesting or exciting.

ext.ext_cn: 只有两枚鱼雷击中了目标。
ext.ext_en: Only two torpedoes struck home.

defs.def_en: If something that is thrown or fired strikes home, it reaches its target.

ext.ext_cn: 大卫·麦克尼尔正和白宫记者团一同前行。
ext.ext_en: David McNeil is travelling with the White House press corps.

defs.def_en: The press corps is a group of journalists who are all working in a particular place, for different newspapers.

ext.ext_cn: 他首次代表球队登场亮相时苦乐参半的记忆
ext.ext_en: ...bittersweet memories of his first appearance for the team.

defs.def_en: If you describe an experience as bittersweet, you mean that it has some happy aspects and some sad ones.

ext.ext_cn: 苦中带甜的酒
ext.ext_en: ...a wine with a bitter-sweet flavour.

defs.def_en: A bittersweet taste seems bitter and sweet at the same time.

defs.def_cn: （用于级别或头衔前）表示“副的”，“次的”

ext.ext_cn: 美国副总统
ext.ext_en: ...America's vice-president...

ext.ext_cn: 蒂姆·芒顿成为新的副队长。
ext.ext_en: Tim Munton becomes the new vice-captain.

defs.def_en: Vice- is used before a rank or title to indicate that someone is next in importance to the person who holds the rank or title mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 陶罐
ext.ext_en: ...an earthen jar.

defs.def_en: Earthen containers and objects are made of clay that is baked so that it becomes hard.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管外面泥泞，屋内的泥土地面还是很干净。
ext.ext_en: Despite the mud outside, the earthen floor was clean.

defs.def_en: An earthen floor, bank, or mound is made of hard earth.

defs.def_cn: （红毛）猩猩（产于婆罗洲和苏门答腊）
defs.def_en: An orang-utan is an ape with long reddish hair that comes from Borneo and Sumatra.
Processed cheese is cheese that has been specially made so that it can be sold and stored in large quantities. It is sometimes sold in the form of single wrapped slices.
The alimentary canal in a person or animal is the passage in their body through which food passes from their mouth to their anus.

defs.def_cn: (尤用于园艺和农事的)麻线，合股线
defs.def_en: Twine is strong string used especially in gardening and farming.

ext.ext_cn: 他胖乎乎的双臂搂住文森特的脖子。
ext.ext_en: He had twined his chubby arms around Vincent's neck...

ext.ext_cn: 他和她十指相扣。
ext.ext_en: He twined his fingers into hers…

defs.def_en: If you twine one thing around another, or if one thing twines around another, the first thing is twisted or wound around the second.

defs.def_en: Binding is a strip of material that you put round the edge of a piece of cloth or other object in order to protect or decorate it.

An alternating current is an electric current that continually changes direction as it flows. The abbreviation AC is also used.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: You can describe a picture, model, or statue of a person or thing as a representation of them.

defs.def_en: Ultrasound is sound waves which travel at such a high frequency that they cannot be heard by humans. Ultrasound is used in medicine to get pictures of the inside of people's bodies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Many months of back-breaking work still face them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The legal aid system should be accessible to more people...

ext.ext_en: This device helps make virtual reality a more usable and accessible technology.

defs.def_en: If something is accessible to people, they can easily use it or obtain it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...literary books that are accessible to a general audience.

defs.def_en: If you describe a book, painting, or other work of art as accessible, you think it is good because it is simple enough for people to understand and appreciate easily.

defs.def_en: If something is symmetrical, it has two halves which are exactly the same, except that one half is the mirror image of the other.

defs.def_cn: （与形容词连用构成形容词）表示“有…肢的”

ext.ext_cn: 他四肢修长，眼睛浅黑。
ext.ext_en: He was long-limbed and dark-eyed.

defs.def_en: -limbed combines with adjectives to form other adjectives which indicate that a person or animal has limbs of a particular type or appearance.
Apoplexy is a stroke.

ext.ext_cn: 他关于阶级和战争的书已经激起了极大的愤怒。
ext.ext_en: He has already caused apoplexy with his books on class and on war.

defs.def_en: Apoplexy is extreme anger.
A boxing ring is a raised square platform with ropes around it in which boxers fight.
In some university colleges in Britain, the provost is the head.

defs.def_cn: （美国某些大专院校的）教务长
defs.def_en: In some colleges and universities in the  United States, a provost is an official who deals with matters such as the teaching staff and the courses of study.
A provost is the chief magistrate of a Scottish administrative area.

defs.def_cn: （天主教或圣公会中的）主教座堂（或大圣堂）教士长
defs.def_en: In the Roman Catholic and Anglican Churches, a provost is the person who is in charge of the administration of a cathedral.
To go down on someone means to have oral sex with them.
A caretaker is a person whose job it is to look after a large building such as a school or a block of flats or apartments, and deal with small repairs to it.
A caretaker is a person whose job it is to take care of a house or property when the owner is not there.

ext.ext_cn: 军方打算将政权移交给临时政府,并在6个月内举行选举。
ext.ext_en: The military intends to hand over power to a caretaker government and hold elections within six months.

defs.def_en: A caretaker government or leader is in charge temporarily until a new government or leader is appointed.
A caretaker is someone who is responsible for looking after another person, for example, a person who is disabled, ill, or very young.

ext.ext_cn: 她并没有说起她母亲不在场的事。
ext.ext_en: She did not mention her mother's absence...

ext.ext_cn: 我可能没跟她提过这件事。
ext.ext_en: I may not have mentioned it to her...

defs.def_en: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

ext.ext_cn: 声明里没有提及政府方面的伤亡情况。
ext.ext_en: The statement made no mention of government casualties...

ext.ext_cn: 在社区中心一提到资金问题，大家就会愁眉不展。
ext.ext_en: At the community centre, mention of funds produces pained looks.

defs.def_en: A mention is a reference to something or someone.

defs.def_cn: （在文章中）提到，谈及(某人的名字)

ext.ext_cn: 我大为恼火，我的名字居然出现在这种文章里面。
ext.ext_en: I was absolutely outraged that I could be even mentioned in an article of this kind...

ext.ext_cn: 至于你父亲，我的遗嘱里不会提到他的名字。
ext.ext_en: As for your father, he won't be mentioned in my will.

defs.def_en: If someone is mentioned in writing, a reference is made to them by name, often to criticize or praise something that they have done.

ext.ext_cn: 他的任命完全出人意料——他从来都不是呼声最高的候选人。
ext.ext_en: His appointment is a complete surprise — he has never been mentioned as a front runner...

ext.ext_cn: 提到她的名字时，说她是领导职位的热门候选人。
ext.ext_en: Her name has been mentioned as a favoured leadership candidate.

defs.def_en: If someone is mentioned as a candidate for something such as a job, it is suggested that they might  become a candidate.

ext.ext_cn: 帮助我完成本书的人数太多，难以从中选出几位特别致谢。
ext.ext_en: So many people have helped me with this book that it is hard to pick out the few for special mention.

defs.def_en: A special or honourable mention is formal praise that is given for an achievement that is very good, although not usually the best of its kind.

ext.ext_cn: “非常感谢！”——“别客气。”
ext.ext_en: 'Thank you very much.' — 'Don't mention it.'

defs.def_en: People sometimes say 'don't mention it' as a polite reply to someone who has just thanked them for doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 观众们并没有觉得好笑，更不用说那些一头雾水的演员了。
ext.ext_en: The audience, not to mention the bewildered cast, were not amused...

ext.ext_cn: 这件事是处心积虑、早有预谋的，更不用说其手段的高明。
ext.ext_en: It was both deliberate and malicious, not to mention clever.

defs.def_en: You use not to mention when you want to add extra information which emphasizes the point that you are making.

ext.ext_cn: 1987年他在本国逃脱警察追捕后，就申请了政治庇护。
ext.ext_en: He applied for asylum in 1987 after fleeing the police back home.

defs.def_en: If a government gives a person from another country asylum, they allow them to stay, usually because they are unable to return home safely for political reasons.
An asylum is a psychiatric hospital.
A caribou is a large north American deer.
Episcopalian means belonging to the Episcopal Church.
An Episcopalian is a member of the Episcopal Church.

ext.ext_cn: 她作为巴赫研究专家的资历
ext.ext_en: ...her credentials as a Bach specialist...

ext.ext_cn: 我可以证明委托人的资质。
ext.ext_en: I can testify to the credentials of the clientele.

defs.def_en: Someone's credentials are their previous achievements, training, and general background, which indicate that they are qualified to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 英国驻黎巴嫩的新任大使已将国书递交给总统。
ext.ext_en: Britain's new ambassador to Lebanon has presented his credentials to the President.

defs.def_en: Someone's credentials are a letter or certificate that proves their identity or qualifications.

defs.def_cn: （had 有时代替 if 用于从句句首，表示某种情况可能发生但并未发生）

ext.ext_cn: 要是他当时成功了，他就会取得垄断地位。
ext.ext_en: Had he succeeded, he would have acquired a monopoly...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我当时知道问题出在哪里，我们就可以设法解决了。
ext.ext_en: Had I known what the problem was, we could have addressed it.

defs.def_en: Had is sometimes used instead of 'if' to begin a clause which refers to a situation that might have happened but did not. For example, the clause 'had he been elected' means the same as 'if he had been elected'.

ext.ext_cn: 要是顾客感觉自己当了冤大头，你就得设法让他消气。
ext.ext_en: If your customer thinks he's been had, you have to make him happy.

defs.def_en: If you have been had, someone has tricked you, for example by selling you something at too high a price.

ext.ext_cn: 除非她减点儿肥，否则她就没戏了。
ext.ext_en: Unless she loses some weight, she's had it...

ext.ext_cn: 他要的是会说威尔士语的演员。明摆着，我是没指望了。
ext.ext_en: He wants actors who can speak Welsh. Obviously I've had it.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has had it, you mean they are in very serious trouble or have no hope of succeeding.

ext.ext_cn: 我受不了了。今天就到这儿吧。
ext.ext_en: I've had it. Let's call it a day...

ext.ext_cn: 我再也忍受不了那样对待美国人了。
ext.ext_en: I've had it with that kind of treatment of Americans.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have had it, you mean that you are very tired of something or very annoyed about it, and do not want to continue doing it or it to continue happening.

ext.ext_cn: 敞篷马车
ext.ext_en: ...a horse-drawn open-topped carriage.

defs.def_en: A horse-drawn carriage, cart, or other vehicle is one that is pulled by one or more horses.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一定要拍张照片！
ext.ext_en: We must take a photo!...

ext.ext_cn: 我在墙上挂了一张他的照片。
ext.ext_en: I've got a photo of him on the wall.

defs.def_en: A photo is the same as a photograph .

ext.ext_cn: 简决心要守住自己的财产。
ext.ext_en: Jane is determined to hold on to her fortune...

ext.ext_cn: 各公司现在都急切地想要留住招聘来的员工。
ext.ext_en: Firms are now keen to hold on to the people they recruit.

defs.def_en: If you hold on to something that gives you an advantage, you succeed in keeping it for yourself, and prevent it from being taken away or given to someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 你能把那篇报道多留一两天再登吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you think you could hold on to that report for the next day or two?...

ext.ext_cn: 人们会将信件保存很多很多年。
ext.ext_en: People hold onto letters for years and years.

defs.def_en: If you hold on to something, you keep it for a longer time than would normally be expected.

ext.ext_cn: 他在监狱里被关了19年，但依然对人民充满信心。
ext.ext_en: He was imprisoned for 19 years yet held on to his belief in his people.

defs.def_en: If you hold on to your beliefs, ideas, or principles, you continue to believe in them and do not change or abandon them if others try to influence you or if circumstances cause you to doubt them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的父母手头很拮据。
ext.ext_en: Her parents were very hard up.

defs.def_en: If you are hard up, you have very little money.
If you suffer from eye strain, you feel pain around your eyes or at the back of your eyes, because you are very tired or should be wearing glasses.

defs.def_cn: (为迅速解决某问题采取的)应急行动，极端政策

ext.ext_cn: 布拉格的应急经济政策
ext.ext_en: ...Prague's policy of economic shock therapy.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the use of extreme policies or actions to solve a particular problem quickly as shock therapy .

defs.def_cn: (通过电击来治疗精神病患者的)休克疗法，电击治疗

ext.ext_cn: 用于休克疗法的电极
ext.ext_en: ...the electrodes used for shock therapy.

defs.def_en: Shock therapy is a way of treating mentally ill patients by passing an electric current through their brain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (婉指女性或男性性别特征明显)天赋异禀的，硕大的

ext.ext_cn: 我在观众席上看到一个穿着紧身白色T恤的巨乳女孩。
ext.ext_en: I spotted a well-endowed girl in the audience wearing a tight white T-shirt.

ext.ext_cn: 用白垩画成的一个生殖器硕大的勇士形象
ext.ext_en: ...the chalk figure of a well-endowed warrior.

defs.def_en: If someone says that a woman is well-endowed, they mean that she has large breasts. If someone says that a man is well-endowed, they mean that he has a large penis. People often use this expression if they are trying to be polite.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在一所规模庞大且资金充足的学校，可能会有更多机会参与实验室的研究工作。
ext.ext_en: In a large, well-endowed school, the opportunities for laboratory work are likely to be greater.

defs.def_en: A well-endowed organization has a lot of money or resources.
A furrier is a person who makes or sells clothes made from fur.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （记忆、描述等）生动的,逼真的,清晰的

ext.ext_cn: 我们这一代经历过二战的人都真切地记得当时的迷惘和无助。
ext.ext_en: People of my generation who lived through World War II have vivid memories of confusion and incompetence...

ext.ext_cn: 周三晚上，我做了个十分逼真的梦，让我很不安。
ext.ext_en: On Wednesday night  I had a very vivid dream which really upset me.

defs.def_en: If you describe memories and descriptions as vivid, you mean that they are very clear and detailed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 蔚蓝的天空
ext.ext_en: ...a vivid blue sky.

defs.def_en: Something that is vivid is very bright in colour.
An MP3 player is a machine on which you can play music downloaded from the Internet.

ext.ext_cn: 他打开了写字台的一个抽屉。
ext.ext_en: He opened a drawer in his writing-table.

defs.def_en: A drawer is part of a desk, chest, or other piece of furniture that is shaped like a box and is designed for putting things in. You pull it towards you to open it.
Drawers are underpants, especially ones worn by women.

ext.ext_cn: 对不公正的纠正
ext.ext_en: ...the rectification of an injustice.

defs.def_en: The rectification of something that is wrong is the act of changing it to make it correct or satisfactory.

ext.ext_cn: 到市中心最直接的路线
ext.ext_en: ...the most direct route to the town centre...

ext.ext_cn: 所有逃跑的路都被武警封锁了。
ext.ext_en: All escape routes were blocked by armed police...

defs.def_en: A route is a way from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 去往日本的主要航运线路
ext.ext_en: ...the main shipping routes to Japan.

defs.def_en: A bus, air, or shipping route is the way between two places along which buses, planes, or ships travel regularly.

ext.ext_cn: 580号公路的百老汇－韦伯斯特出口
ext.ext_en: ...the Broadway-Webster exit on Route 580.

defs.def_en: In the United States, Route is used in front of a number in the names of main roads between major cities.

ext.ext_cn: 他打开装黄油饼干的蓝色大罐子，开始沿路给狗喂食。
ext.ext_en: He began cracking open big blue tins of butter cookies and feeding the dogs on his route...

ext.ext_cn: 他们会到他那里走访一下，看看他的情况。
ext.ext_en: They would go out on his route and check him.

defs.def_en: Your route is the series of visits you make to different people or places, as part of your job.

ext.ext_cn: 研究人员正试图通过间接的途径获得相同的信息。
ext.ext_en: Researchers are trying to get at the same information through an indirect route...

ext.ext_cn: 和其他领域一样，投资领域获得成功的途径也是买进最佳商品。
ext.ext_en: Buying the best is as sure a route to success in investment as in any other field.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a way of achieving something as a route .

defs.def_cn: 按特定路线发送(车辆、货物或乘客)

ext.ext_cn: 以往由卡车运送的很多货物现在都改用双层列车运送了。
ext.ext_en: Double-stack trains are taking a lot of freight that used to be routed via trucks...

ext.ext_cn: 驶来的车辆会分流到两条车道。
ext.ext_en: Approaching cars will be routed into two lanes.

defs.def_en: If vehicles, goods, or passengers are routed in a particular direction, they are made to travel in that direction.

defs.def_cn: 以…线路发送(电话或其他电子信号)

ext.ext_cn: 只通过3次电话转接来传送英国境内所有紧急呼叫的计划
ext.ext_en: ...plans to route every emergency call in Britain through just three telephone exchanges.

defs.def_en: If telephone calls or other electronic signals are routed in a particular way, the signals are sent through a particular series of connections.

defs.def_cn: 在途中，沿途(在不规范英语中有时拼作on route)

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经到达伦敦，正在前往美国的途中。
ext.ext_en: They have arrived in London en route to the United States...

ext.ext_cn: 其中一个包在途中丢失了。
ext.ext_en: One of the bags was lost en route.

defs.def_en: En route to a place means on the way to that place. En route is sometimes spelled on toute in non-standard English.

defs.def_cn: （新闻用语）作为（较长进程）的一部分，在…之前

ext.ext_cn: 那个德国人在获得高尔夫球赛最高奖金的同时刷新了3项锦标赛纪录，平了其他两项纪录。
ext.ext_en: The German set three tournament records and equalled two others en route to grabbing golf's richest prize.

defs.def_en: Journalists sometimes use en route when they are mentioning an event that happened as part of a longer process or before another event.

defs.def_cn: 把事情进行到底;贯彻始终

ext.ext_cn: 在很多情况下，他们从头到尾都只做大的东西——大碗，大雕像，大面具，所有东西都是大的。
ext.ext_en: They have gone the route, in many cases, of just big — big bowls, big statues, big masks, big everything.

defs.def_en: If you go the route, you do something fully or continue with a task until you have completely finished.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 夸张的；过分的；夸大其词的

ext.ext_cn: 灾害预警有被夸大的可能。
ext.ext_en: Warnings of disaster may be overblown...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管这篇关于人质的报道有些夸大其词，但还算公正。
ext.ext_en: The reporting of the hostage story was fair, if sometimes overblown.

defs.def_en: Something that is overblown makes something seem larger, more important, or more significant than it really is.

ext.ext_cn: 柴可夫斯基的《胡桃夹子》选段
ext.ext_en: ...an excerpt from Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker.

defs.def_en: An excerpt is a short piece of writing or music which is taken from a larger piece.

ext.ext_cn: 你之前听到的朗读片段节选自一部新的珍珠港口述史。
ext.ext_en: The readings you heard earlier were excerpted from a new oral history of Pearl Harbor.

defs.def_en: If a long piece of writing or music is excerpted, short pieces from it are printed or played on their own.

defs.def_cn: (尤指羊毛或丝线的)一束，一绞

ext.ext_cn: 一束羊毛
ext.ext_en: ...a skein of wool.

defs.def_en: A skein is a length of thread, especially wool or silk, wound loosely round on itself.

defs.def_cn: （尤指吸引人或令人兴奋的）混合物,大杂烩

ext.ext_cn: 从灵乐、节奏布鲁斯到说唱等各种音乐风格的成功组合
ext.ext_en: ...a successful melange of music styles, from soul and rhythm and blues to rap.

ext.ext_cn: 不同风味的奇妙组合
ext.ext_en: ...a wonderful melange of flavours.

defs.def_en: A melange of things is a mixture of them, especially when this is attractive or exciting.
Dentistry is the work done by a dentist.
A polo neck or a polo neck sweater is a sweater with a high neck which folds over.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们祝愿比尔快快康复。
ext.ext_en: We wish Bill a speedy recovery...

ext.ext_cn: 这将是一次十分迅速的审讯。
ext.ext_en: This would be a very speedy trial...

defs.def_en: A speedy process, event, or action happens or is done very quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 国际调停努力的失败
ext.ext_en: ...the failure of international peacemaking efforts...

ext.ext_cn: 希腊是该地区调解冲突、稳定局势的一支力量。
ext.ext_en: Greece is a peacemaking, stabilizing force in the area.

defs.def_en: Peacemaking efforts are attempts to persuade countries or groups to stop fighting with each other.

defs.def_cn: 重组；重新整合；重新装配

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在会尽量把残骸重新组合起来。
ext.ext_en: We will now try to reassemble pieces of the wreckage...

ext.ext_cn: 桌子得被拆开，通过窗户吊进来，然后再重新组装。
ext.ext_en: The table had to be taken apart and hoisted through the window before it was reassembled.

defs.def_en: If you reassemble something, you put it back together after it has been taken apart.

ext.ext_cn: 我们30分钟后在停车场再碰面。
ext.ext_en: We shall reassemble in the car park in thirty minutes...

ext.ext_cn: 卢卡斯先生在9月重新召集了他的队伍。
ext.ext_en: Mr Lucas reassembled his team in September.

defs.def_en: If a group of people reassembles or if you reassemble them, they gather together again in a group.

ext.ext_cn: 在小公寓中摆放过多室内植物会让人觉得很压抑。
ext.ext_en: An excess of house plants in a small flat can be oppressive...

ext.ext_cn: 多不饱和油对健康很重要。但是，食用过量就会有害。
ext.ext_en: Polyunsaturated oils are essential for health. Excess is harmful, however.

defs.def_en: An excess of something is a larger amount than is needed, allowed, or usual.

ext.ext_cn: 烹完鱼后，倒掉多余的油。
ext.ext_en: After cooking the fish, pour off any excess fat...

ext.ext_cn: 体重超标的主要原因是饮食过量。
ext.ext_en: The major reason for excess weight is excess eating.

defs.def_en: Excess is used to describe amounts that are greater than what is needed, allowed, or usual.

ext.ext_cn: 她说她厌倦了自己无节制的生活。
ext.ext_en: She said she was sick of her life of excess.

ext.ext_cn: 青春期的放肆
ext.ext_en: ...adolescent excess.

defs.def_en: Excess is behaviour that is unacceptable because it is considered too extreme or immoral.

ext.ext_cn: 要求额外付20英镑邮资的信
ext.ext_en: ...a letter demanding an excess fare of £20...

ext.ext_cn: 需要到更远的地方出差的职员可以领取额外差旅费。
ext.ext_en: Staff who have to travel farther can claim excess travel expenses.

defs.def_en: Excess is used to refer to additional amounts of money that need to be paid for services and activities that were not originally planned or taken into account.

defs.def_cn: （保险中的）免赔额，承保人本人需承担的款额

ext.ext_cn: 那家公司想要办理单价1,800英镑的保单，并且要求21岁以下人员承担价值500英镑的免赔额。
ext.ext_en: The company wanted £1,800 for a policy with a £500 excess for under-21s.

defs.def_en: The excess on an insurance policy is a sum of money which the insured person has to pay towards the cost of a claim. The insurance company pays the rest.

ext.ext_cn: 单一账户存款勿超过两万英镑。
ext.ext_en: Avoid deposits in excess of £20,000 in any one account...

ext.ext_cn: 干果的能量值大大超过新鲜水果。
ext.ext_en: The energy value of dried fruits is considerably in excess of that of fresh items.

defs.def_en: In excess of means more than a particular amount.

ext.ext_cn: 我相当健康，经常打网球，不怎么吸烟，也不酗酒。
ext.ext_en: I was reasonably fit, played a lot of tennis, and didn't smoke or drink to excess...

ext.ext_cn: 过量食用的红肉中脂肪和卡路里含量很高。
ext.ext_en: Red meat, eaten to excess, is very high in fat and calories.

defs.def_en: If you do something to excess, you do it too much.
A cooper is a person who makes barrels.

defs.def_cn: 《圣经》中的;源自《圣经》的;根据《圣经》的

ext.ext_cn: 《圣经》中关于灵魂得救的过程的记载
ext.ext_en: ...scriptural accounts of the process of salvation.

defs.def_en: Scriptural is used to describe things that are written in or based on the Christian Bible.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Latest reports say another five people have been killed...

ext.ext_en: Crooks are using the latest laser photocopiers to produce millions of fake banknotes...

ext.ext_cn: 我开上了最新款的车。
ext.ext_en: I got to drive the latest model...

defs.def_en: You can use latest to describe something that is very new and modern and is better than older things of a similar kind.

ext.ext_en: She should be back by ten o'clock at the latest.

defs.def_en: You use at the latest in order to indicate that something must happen at or before a particular time and not after that time.

defs.def_cn: 诱饵;诱惑物;用作诱饵的人

ext.ext_en: Nick acted as a decoy after the dog attacked a group of children swimming in the river.

ext.ext_en: He was booked on a flight leaving that day, but that was just a decoy.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something or someone as a decoy, you mean that they are intended to attract people's  attention and deceive them, for example by leading them into a trap or away from a particular place.
A decoy is a model of a bird that is used to attract wild birds towards it so that people can study them or shoot them.

ext.ext_cn: 他这把左轮手枪只有7梭子子弹。
ext.ext_en: He had only seven rounds of ammunition for the revolver.

defs.def_en: Ammunition is bullets and rockets that are made to be fired from guns.

ext.ext_en: The improved trade figures have given the government fresh ammunition.

defs.def_en: You can describe information that you can use against someone in an argument or discussion as ammunition.
A pug is a small, fat, short-haired dog with a flat face.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: My horse is small but wiry and sure-footed.

defs.def_en: A person or animal that is sure-footed can move easily over steep or uneven ground without falling.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If someone is sure-footed, they are confident in what they are doing.
An earwig is a small, thin, brown insect that has a pair of claws at the back end of its body.
A sprog is a baby or child.

defs.def_cn: (骑摩托车者戴的)防护头盔，安全帽

A blast furnace is a large structure in which iron ore is heated under pressure so that it melts and the pure iron metal separates out and can be collected.

defs.def_en: A spook is a spy.

ext.ext_en: Investors were spooked by slowing economies.

defs.def_en: If people are spooked, something has scared them or made them nervous.

Cunt is an offensive word that some people use to refer to a woman's vagina.

ext.ext_cn: 伤心欲绝的母亲
ext.ext_en: ...an anguished mother.

defs.def_en: A clarion call is a strong and emotional appeal to people to do something.

ext.ext_en: ...a tea strainer.

defs.def_en: A strainer is an object with holes which you pour a liquid through in order to separate the liquid from the solids in it.

defs.def_en: American football is a game similar to rugby that is played by two teams of eleven players using an oval-shaped ball. Players try to score points by carrying the ball to their opponents' end of the field, or by kicking it over a bar fixed between two posts.

defs.def_cn: 毛料的；羊毛制的;像羊毛的

ext.ext_cn: 她戴着这顶有小绒球的毛绒帽子。
ext.ext_en: She wore this woolly hat with pompoms.

defs.def_en: Something that is woolly is made of wool or looks like wool.

defs.def_en: A woolly is a woollen piece of clothing, especially a sweater.

defs.def_en: You can refer to underwear as woollies, especially when it is knitted from wool, and has long legs or long sleeves.

ext.ext_en: ...a weak and woolly Government...

ext.ext_en: It is no good setting vague and woolly goals — you will not know whether or not you have really achieved them.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their ideas as woolly, you are criticizing them for being confused or vague.

ext.ext_cn: 半音阶音符
ext.ext_en: ...the notes of the chromatic scale.

defs.def_en: In music, chromatic means related to the scale that consists only of semitones.

ext.ext_en: That lovely, rich fragrant smell of the forest enveloped us...

ext.ext_cn: 萦绕的幸福感
ext.ext_en: ...an enveloping sense of well-being.

defs.def_en: If one thing envelops another, it covers or surrounds it completely.

ext.ext_en: ...the end of the cold war and the decline in armaments spending.

ext.ext_cn: 冷战后第一次重大的危机
ext.ext_en: ...the first major crisis of the post-Cold War era.

defs.def_en: The Cold War was the period of hostility and tension between the Soviet bloc and the Western powers that followed the Second World War.

ext.ext_en: The soundtrack of 'Highlander II' will be released on compact disc at Easter.

defs.def_en: Compact discs are small shiny discs that contain music or computer information. The abbreviation CD is also used.

ext.ext_en: In Rugby League, Australia trounced France by sixty points to four.

ext.ext_en: Stephen is going to be pretty upset when he finds out how you tricked him...

ext.ext_en: His family tricked him into going to Pakistan, and once he was there, they took away his passport...

defs.def_en: If someone tricks you, they deceive you, often in order to make you do something.

ext.ext_en: He shows me card tricks.

defs.def_en: A trick is a clever or skilful action that someone does in order to entertain people.

ext.ext_en: Tiffany revamped her sitting room with simple decorative tricks.

ext.ext_en: It is not just a little trick you can pick up in half an hour.

defs.def_en: A trick is a clever way of doing something.

ext.ext_en: Sometimes a few choice words will do the trick.

ext.ext_en: Companies are using every trick in the book to stay one step in front of their competitors.
