ext.ext_en: 'He wants a police escort.' — 'Well, he can whistle for that.'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone can whistle for a particular thing, you mean that you are not willing or able to give it to them.
If you describe something as clean as a whistle, you mean that it is completely clean.

ext.ext_cn: “他的私生活没有任何污点，”麦克史密斯说。
ext.ext_en: 'His private life is as clean as a whistle,' says McSmith.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as clean as a whistle, you mean that they are not guilty of having done anything wrong.

defs.def_cn: 借吹口哨壮胆;故作镇定

ext.ext_cn: 之后我开始等待，并竭力保持镇定，可是恐惧和焦虑却丝毫没有消减。
ext.ext_en: Then I waited, trying not to feel as if I were whistling in the dark, but I experienced no easing of my fear and anxiety.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is whistling in the dark, you mean that they are trying to remain brave and convince themselves that the situation is not as bad as it seems.
To wet your whistle means to have a drink.

ext.ext_cn: 自由民主党领导人指责首相鼓舞保守党士气之举根本就是徒劳。
ext.ext_en: The leader of the Liberal Democrats accused the Prime Minister of whistling in the wind to raise Conservative party morale.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as whistling in the wind, you mean that they are trying unsuccessfully to change something which cannot be changed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他突然看起来很阴郁，一副忧虑的样子。
ext.ext_en: He looked suddenly sombre, pensive.

defs.def_en: If you are pensive, you are thinking deeply about something, especially something that worries you slightly.
A needle is a small, very thin piece of polished metal which is used for sewing. It has a sharp point at one end and a hole in the other for a thread to go through.
Knitting needles are thin sticks that are used for knitting. They are usually made of plastic or metal and have a point at one end.
A needle is a thin hollow metal rod with a sharp point, which is part of a medical instrument called a syringe. It is used to put a drug into someone's body, or to take blood out.
A needle is a thin metal rod with a point which is put into a patient's  body during acupuncture.

ext.ext_cn: 她把唱针从唱片上移开，把灯也关了。
ext.ext_en: She took the needle off the record and turned the lights out.

defs.def_en: On a record player, the needle is the small pointed device that touches the record and picks up the sound signals.

ext.ext_cn: 她一直看着锅炉上的刻度盘，指针已指向了250度。
ext.ext_en: She kept looking at the dial on the boiler. The needle had reached 250 degrees.

defs.def_en: On an instrument which measures something such as speed or weight, the needle is the long strip of metal or plastic on the dial that moves backwards and forwards, showing the measurement.

ext.ext_cn: 脚下厚厚的松针踩上去软绵绵的。
ext.ext_en: The carpet of pine needles was soft underfoot.

defs.def_en: The needles of a fir or pine tree are its thin, hard, pointed leaves.

defs.def_cn: 刺激;惹…发火;(尤指)不断数落

ext.ext_cn: 布莱克看得出他已经惹怒了杰罗尔德，这也许并不是什么明智之举。
ext.ext_en: Blake could see he had needled Jerrold, which might be unwise.

defs.def_en: If someone needles you, they annoy you continually, especially by criticizing you.

ext.ext_cn: 第七装甲旅的士兵们
ext.ext_en: ...the men of the Seventh Armoured Brigade.

defs.def_en: See also:fire brigade;A brigade is one of the groups which an army is divided into.

defs.def_cn: （信奉某事或具有共同特点的）一帮人，族

ext.ext_cn: 健康饮食族
ext.ext_en: ...the healthy eating brigade.

ext.ext_cn: 黑T恤一族
ext.ext_en: ...the black T-shirt brigade.

defs.def_en: You can use brigade to refer to a group of people who believe strongly in a particular thing or who share a particular characteristic.

defs.def_cn: 举止粗野的男子（或男孩）

ext.ext_cn: 粗鲁的醉汉
ext.ext_en: ...a drunken lout.

defs.def_en: If you describe a man or boy as a lout, you are critical of them because they behave in an impolite or aggressive way.
If you describe someone or something as top-notch, you mean that they are of a very high standard or quality.

defs.def_cn: 国内的;内政的;(组织)内部的

ext.ext_cn: 该国加强了国内安保。
ext.ext_en: The country stepped up internal security...

ext.ext_cn: 我们如今拥有一个内部没有边界的欧洲。
ext.ext_en: We now have a Europe without internal borders...

defs.def_en: Internal is used to describe things that exist or happen inside a country or organization.

defs.def_cn: 体内的;(物体或场所)内部的

ext.ext_cn: 体内大出血
ext.ext_en: ...massive internal bleeding...

ext.ext_cn: 我家房子的一些内墙是石膏板做的。
ext.ext_en: Some of the internal walls of my house are made of plasterboard.

defs.def_en: Internal is used to describe things that exist or happen inside a particular person, object, or place.

defs.def_cn: （尤指商业上用来栽培植物等用的）玻璃暖房，温室
defs.def_en: A glasshouse is a greenhouse, especially a large one which is used for the commercial production of fruit, flowers, or vegetables.
A jailbreak is an escape from jail.

defs.def_cn: （用不同方法或从不同出处）反复核对,交叉检查

ext.ext_cn: 你必须仔细检查并多方核对你所听到的每一件事。
ext.ext_en: You have to scrupulously check and cross-check everything you hear...

ext.ext_cn: 之后会对他的说法与校方的说法进行多方核对。
ext.ext_en: His version will later be cross-checked against that of the university...

defs.def_en: If you cross-check information, you check that it is correct using a different method or source from the one originally used to obtain it.

ext.ext_cn: 答应我，你会特别小心照顾好自己。
ext.ext_en: Promise me you'll take very special care of yourself...

ext.ext_cn: 我想，你在这儿能找到你所需要的一切东西。
ext.ext_en: I think you'll find everything you need here.

defs.def_en: You'll is the usual spoken form of 'you will'.

ext.ext_cn: 当信息大潮滚滚而来的时候究竟发生了些什么呢？
ext.ext_en: So what is really happening as the information bandwagon starts to roll?

ext.ext_cn: 环保热潮
ext.ext_en: ...the environmental bandwagon.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an activity or movement that has suddenly become fashionable or popular as a bandwagon .

ext.ext_cn: 最近几个月，很多保守政客都搭上了“反移民”这班车。
ext.ext_en: In recent months many conservative politicians have jumped on the anti-immigrant bandwagon...

ext.ext_cn: 很多农场正赶潮流宣传有机食品。
ext.ext_en: Many farms are jumping on the bandwagon and advertising organically grown food...

defs.def_en: If someone, especially a politician, jumps or climbs on the bandwagon, they become involved in an activity or movement because it is fashionable or likely to succeed and not because they are really interested in it.

defs.def_cn: 一方的；单边的；单方面的

ext.ext_cn: 单方面核裁军
ext.ext_en: ...unilateral nuclear disarmament.

defs.def_en: A unilateral decision or action is taken by only one of the groups, organizations, or countries that are involved in a particular situation, without the agreement of the others.
A selling point is a desirable quality or feature that something has which makes it likely that people will want to buy it.

defs.def_cn: 社会主义式的;具有社会主义某些特征的;有社会主义色彩的

ext.ext_cn: 使我们的经济走上社会主义道路的计划
ext.ext_en: ...a design to move our economy in a socialistic direction.

ext.ext_cn: 这些具有社会主义色彩的具体政策大部分都被废止了。
ext.ext_en: Most of these specific Socialistic policies have been abandoned.

defs.def_en: If you describe a policy or organization as socialistic, you mean that it has some of the features of socialism.

defs.def_cn: 热的;由热引起的;温度变化引起的

ext.ext_cn: 热电厂
ext.ext_en: ...thermal power stations.

ext.ext_cn: 政府拨款供修缮、隔热和房屋改造之用的经济援助
ext.ext_en: ...financial assistance with repair, thermal insulation and improvements to homes through Government grants.

defs.def_en: Thermal means relating to or caused by heat or by changes in temperature.

ext.ext_cn: 火山活动产生了温泉和沸腾的泥浆池。
ext.ext_en: Volcanic activity has created thermal springs and boiling mud pools.

defs.def_en: Thermal streams or baths contain water which is naturally hot or warm.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然穿了保暖袜子，我的双脚还是像冰块一样。
ext.ext_en: My feet were like blocks of ice despite the thermal socks...

ext.ext_cn: 我穿上保暖紧身裤、长袜和其他衣服。
ext.ext_en: I put on my thermal leggings, long socks and the rest of my clothes.

defs.def_en: Thermal clothes are specially designed to keep you warm in cold weather.

ext.ext_cn: 鸟类利用上升热气流升入空中。
ext.ext_en: Birds use thermals to lift them through the air.

defs.def_en: A thermal is a movement of rising warm air.
A wisecrack is a clever remark that is intended to be amusing, but is often rather unkind.

ext.ext_cn: 我每次打开电视都是足球节目，真是受不了。
ext.ext_en: Every time I switch on the TV, there's football. It's overkill...

ext.ext_cn: 这样的安保措施很可能过头了。
ext.ext_en: Such security measures may well be overkill.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is overkill when you think that there is more of it than is necessary or appropriate.

ext.ext_cn: 树叶在风中沙沙作响。
ext.ext_en: The leaves rustled in the wind...

ext.ext_cn: 她不耐烦地把文件翻得沙沙作响。
ext.ext_en: She rustled her papers impatiently...

defs.def_en: When something thin and dry rustles or when you rustle it, it makes soft sounds as it moves.
A sketchbook is a book of plain paper for drawing on.

defs.def_cn: 强烈地，激烈地，极为（愤恨、憎恶等）

ext.ext_cn: 发生的事情让我们极为心烦。
ext.ext_en: We are bitterly upset at what has happened.

ext.ext_cn: 露西·甘农令人捧腹又倍感心酸的优秀剧本
ext.ext_en: ...Lucy Gannon's  fine, bitterly funny play.

defs.def_en: You use bitterly when you are describing an attitude which involves strong, unpleasant emotions such as anger or dislike.

defs.def_cn: 时尚派对女郎;社交名媛

ext.ext_cn: 交际花塔玛拉·贝克威思因为在聚会上受到冷落而恼怒。
ext.ext_en: It-girl Tamara Beckwith was livid at being turned away from the party.

defs.def_en: Journalists sometimes use It-girl to describe a young woman who is well-known because she goes to the most fashionable places and events and knows famous people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 倒霉的；走霉运的；不祥的；带来厄运的
defs.def_en: If something is jinxed, it is considered to be unlucky or to bring bad luck.

ext.ext_cn: 把手头的所有食物都送给别人，或者把食物藏好锁起，然后将钥匙交给邻居。
ext.ext_en: Give away any food you have on hand, or lock it up and give the key to the neighbours...

ext.ext_cn: 把炸弹锁起妥藏可实现对物资的控制。
ext.ext_en: Control of materials could be maintained by locking up bombs.

defs.def_en: If you lock something up in a place or container, you put or hide it there and fasten the lock.

defs.def_cn: 把…关入监狱（或精神病院）

ext.ext_cn: 米尔纳先生说服联邦检察官不把他的当事人关起来。
ext.ext_en: Mr Milner persuaded the federal prosecutors not to lock up his client...

ext.ext_cn: 你疯了，伊莎贝尔。应该把你关起来才是。
ext.ext_en: You are mad, Isabel. You should be locked up.

defs.def_en: To lock someone up means to put them in prison or a secure psychiatric hospital.

defs.def_cn: 锁好（建筑物或汽车的）门窗

ext.ext_cn: 别忘了锁好门窗。
ext.ext_en: Don't forget to lock up...

ext.ext_cn: 把车停在这里锁好。
ext.ext_en: Leave your car here and lock it up.

defs.def_en: When you lock up a building or car or lock up, you make sure that all the doors and windows are locked so that nobody can get in.
Bean sprouts are small, long, thin shoots grown from beans. They are frequently used in Chinese cookery.

defs.pos_cn: 可数名词；头衔名词；称呼名词

ext.ext_cn: 将军造访萨拉热窝是在为增加兵力部署做准备。
ext.ext_en: The General's visit to Sarajevo is part of preparations for the deployment of extra troops.

defs.def_en: A general is a high-ranking officer in the armed forces, usually in the army.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些数字显示就业人数总体在下降。
ext.ext_en: The figures represent a general decline in employment.

ext.ext_cn: 英国社会的普遍堕落
ext.ext_en: ...the general deterioration of English society.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the general situation somewhere or talk about something in general terms, you are describing the situation as a whole rather than considering its details or exceptions.

ext.ext_cn: 用于软件方面的2,500英镑很快就被一般性费用耗光了。
ext.ext_en: £2,500 for software is soon swallowed up in general costs...

ext.ext_cn: 他的公司去年3月接管了公园的绿化和日常维护工作。
ext.ext_en: His firm took over the planting and general maintenance of the park last March.

defs.def_en: You use general to describe several items or activities when there are too many of them or when they are not important enough to mention separately.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个项目将会提高民众对恃强凌弱行径的认识。
ext.ext_en: The project should raise general awareness about bullying.

defs.def_en: You use general to describe something that involves or affects most people, or most people in a particular group.

ext.ext_cn: 从后颈部扩散到全身的疼痛
ext.ext_en: ...a general ache radiating from the back of the neck.

ext.ext_cn: 总体上的幸福感
ext.ext_en: ...a general sense of well-being.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as general, you mean that it is not restricted to any one thing or area.

ext.ext_cn: 他们经营着杂货店和农场的乳品店。
ext.ext_en: They ran the general store and the farm dairy.

defs.def_en: A general business offers a variety of services or goods rather than just one particular kind.

defs.def_cn: （常用于头衔中）首席的，总管的，级别最高的

ext.ext_cn: 他加入了桑德斯·罗公司，后来一路晋升至总经理。
ext.ext_en: He joined Sanders Roe, moving on later to become General Manager.

defs.def_en: General is used to describe a person's  job, usually as part of their title, to indicate that they have complete responsibility for the administration of an organization or business.

defs.def_cn: （员工）普通的，非专业的，一般的

ext.ext_cn: 农场雇用了一名拖拉机手和两名杂工。
ext.ext_en: The farm employed a tractor driver and two general labourers.

defs.def_en: General workers do a variety of jobs which require no special skill or training.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （对某方面的知识或兴趣）一般的，泛泛的

ext.ext_cn: 这本书面向一般读者而非学生。
ext.ext_en: This book is intended for the general reader rather than the student.

defs.def_en: General is used to describe a person who has an average amount of knowledge or interest in a particular subject.

defs.def_cn: 总的来说；总体上来看；大体上

ext.ext_cn: 我认为有必要从整体上改进我们的教育体系。
ext.ext_en: I think we need to improve our educational system in general...

ext.ext_cn: 总的来说，她对生活非常困惑。
ext.ext_en: She had a confused idea of life in general.

defs.def_en: You use in general to indicate that you are talking about something as a whole, rather than about part of it.

defs.def_cn: （指某一群体的大多数）总的来说，总体上

ext.ext_cn: 总体而言，人们会支持我们的。
ext.ext_en: People in general will support us...

ext.ext_cn: 总的说来，她在执法界和老百姓当中口碑甚佳。
ext.ext_en: She enjoys a sterling reputation in law enforcement circles and among the community in general.

defs.def_en: You say in general to indicate that you are referring to most people or things in a particular group.

ext.ext_cn: 通常是那些受教育程度较高的人在全民公决中投赞成票。
ext.ext_en: In general, it was the better-educated voters who voted Yes in the referendum.

defs.def_en: You say in general to indicate that a statement is true in most cases.
A tamarind is a fruit which grows on a tropical evergreen tree which has pleasant-smelling flowers. You can also refer to the tree on which this fruit grows as a tamarind .

defs.def_cn: 容貌酷似的人;长得一模一样的人
defs.def_en: If you say that one person is a ringer or a dead ringer for another, you mean that they look exactly like each other.
A bell ringer is someone who rings church bells or hand bells as a hobby.

ext.ext_cn: 展览恰好在他逝世50周年之际举行。
ext.ext_en: The exhibition coincides with the 50th anniversary of his death...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然他的精神病刚好在他参战期间发作，但并不是由此引起的。
ext.ext_en: Although his mental illness had coincided with his war service it had not been caused by it...

defs.def_en: If one event coincides with another, they happen at the same time.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们的人生观并不总是一致，但他们敢于表达自己的观点。
ext.ext_en: The kids' views on life don't always coincide, but they're not afraid of voicing their opinions...

ext.ext_cn: 一个公众利益和私人利益一致的例子
ext.ext_en: ...a case in which public and private interests coincide...

defs.def_en: If the ideas or interests of two or more people coincide, they are the same.

ext.ext_cn: 在货币市场上，美元不如欧洲货币坚挺。
ext.ext_en: On the money markets the dollar was weaker against European currencies.

defs.def_en: A country's money market consists of all the banks and other organizations that deal with short-term loans, capital, and foreign exchange.

defs.def_cn: 胆大;无所顾忌;敢作敢为

ext.ext_cn: 爱因斯坦敢于抛弃常识和长期公认的理论。
ext.ext_en: Einstein had the chutzpah to discard common sense and long-established theory.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has chutzpah, you mean that you admire the fact that they are not afraid or embarrassed to do or say things that shock, surprise, or annoy other people.

ext.ext_cn: 未遭破坏的珊瑚礁环绕着海湾。
ext.ext_en: An unspoilt coral reef encloses the bay.

defs.def_en: A coral reef is a long narrow mass of coral and other substances, the top of which is usually just above or just below the surface of the sea.
Buckskin is soft, strong leather made from the skin of a deer or a goat.
A compass point is one of the 32 marks on the dial of a compass that show direction, for example north, south, east, and west.

ext.ext_cn: 我们认为他会成为一流的选手。
ext.ext_en: We think he'll turn into a top-class player.

ext.ext_cn: 顶级宾馆
ext.ext_en: …a top-class hotel.

defs.def_en: Top-class means among the finest of its kind.

defs.def_cn: （通常指工会成员）在…设置罢工纠察队，在…外抗议

ext.ext_cn: 矿工开始罢工，并在发电站周围设置了纠察队。
ext.ext_en: The miners went on strike and picketed the power stations...

ext.ext_cn: 100名工会成员和支持者在外头抗议。
ext.ext_en: 100 union members and supporters picketed outside.

defs.def_en: When a group of people, usually trade union members, picket a place of work, they stand outside it in order to protest about something, to prevent people from going in, or to persuade the workers to join a strike.

defs.def_cn: 罢工纠察队员；示威者；抗议者

ext.ext_cn: 在宾馆员工周末举行的罢工中，有10家宾馆遭到纠察队员的破坏。
ext.ext_en: Ten hotels were damaged by pickets in the weekend strike of hotel workers...

ext.ext_cn: 罢工者同意撤回纠察队员，并和政府进行对话。
ext.ext_en: The strikers agreed to remove their pickets and hold talks with the government.

defs.def_en: Pickets are people who are picketing a place of work.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 一味攫取的；贪婪的；吝啬的

ext.ext_cn: 贪婪且嗜财如命的瘾君子
ext.ext_en: ...a greedy grasping drug-ridden individual...

ext.ext_cn: 他们贪得无厌而且喜欢摆布人。
ext.ext_en: They were grasping and manipulative.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as grasping, you are criticizing them for wanting to get and keep as much money as possible, and for being unwilling to spend it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤用于生气时加强语气）该死的，讨厌的
defs.def_en: Bloody is used by some people to emphasize what they are saying, especially when they are angry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 43名示威者在流血冲突中丧生。
ext.ext_en: Forty-three demonstrators were killed in bloody clashes...

ext.ext_cn: 在一场腥风血雨的内战之后，他们于1975年上台执政。
ext.ext_en: They came to power in 1975 after a bloody civil war.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation or event as bloody, you mean that it is very violent and a lot of people are killed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 去年10月他被捕时，身上还带着一把血迹斑斑的刀。
ext.ext_en: He was arrested last October still carrying a bloody knife...

ext.ext_cn: 尤尔卡的手指折断了，鲜血直流。
ext.ext_en: Yulka's  fingers were bloody and cracked.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone or something as bloody if they are covered in a lot of blood.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的一个孩子跌倒了，膝盖磕破了。
ext.ext_en: One of our children fell and bloodied his knee...

ext.ext_cn: 她盯着自己流血的双手，呆呆地愣住了。

The future perfect tense of a verb is used to talk about things that will have happened at some time in the future.

defs.def_en: You use in future when saying what will happen from now on, which will be different from what has previously happened. The form in the future is sometimes used instead, especially in American English.

defs.def_cn: 未来将发生…;将来会发生…

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's future lies in a particular place or activity, you think they will be most successful or happy in that place or doing that activity.

ext.ext_cn: 100名工会成员和支持者在外头抗议。
ext.ext_en: 100 union members and supporters picketed outside.

defs.def_en: When a group of people, usually trade union members, picket a place of work, they stand outside it in order to protest about something, to prevent people from going in, or to persuade the workers to join a strike.

defs.def_cn: 罢工纠察队员；示威者；抗议者

ext.ext_cn: 在宾馆员工周末举行的罢工中，有10家宾馆遭到纠察队员的破坏。
ext.ext_en: Ten hotels were damaged by pickets in the weekend strike of hotel workers...

ext.ext_cn: 罢工者同意撤回纠察队员，并和政府进行对话。
ext.ext_en: The strikers agreed to remove their pickets and hold talks with the government.

defs.def_en: Pickets are people who are picketing a place of work.

ext.ext_cn: 奈杰尔一直在他家周围10英里的范围内找工作。
ext.ext_en: Nigel has searched for work in a ten-mile radius around his home.

defs.def_en: The radius around a particular point is the distance from it in any direction.

ext.ext_cn: 他标示出了一个半径大约为30英里的半圆形。
ext.ext_en: He indicated a semicircle with a radius of about thirty miles.

defs.def_en: The radius of a circle is the distance from its centre to its outside edge.
A pleat in a piece of clothing is a permanent fold that is made in the cloth by folding one part over the other and sewing across the top end of the fold.

ext.ext_cn: 她对权威的仇恨导致她被中学开除。
ext.ext_en: Her hatred of authority led to her expulsion from high school.

ext.ext_cn: 被开除学生人数之多
ext.ext_en: ...the high number of school expulsions...

defs.def_en: Expulsion is when someone is forced to leave a school, university, or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 对也门工人的驱逐
ext.ext_en: ...the expulsion of Yemeni workers.

ext.ext_cn: 大规模驱逐的新浪潮
ext.ext_en: ...a new wave of mass expulsions.

defs.def_en: Expulsion is when someone is forced to leave a place.

ext.ext_cn: 废弃物的排出
ext.ext_en: ...the expulsion of waste products.

ext.ext_cn: 它们被从消化道排出
ext.ext_en: ...their expulsion from the digestive tract.

defs.def_en: Expulsion is when something is forced out from your body.

defs.def_cn: 心存侥幸地；怀着渺茫希望地

ext.ext_cn: 他搭飞机去了巴黎，心想着或许能遇到弗朗西丝卡。
ext.ext_en: He had taken a flight to Paris on the off-chance that he might be able to meet Francesca.

ext.ext_cn: 为有幸一睹王妃风采而前来的美国游客
ext.ext_en: ...an American visitor who had turned up on the off-chance of catching a glimpse of the princess.

defs.def_en: If you do something on the off-chance, you do it because you hope that it will succeed, although you think that this is unlikely.
Utilitarianism is the idea that the morally correct course of action is the one that produces benefit for the greatest number of people.

defs.def_cn: （为慈善机构或其他组织筹款而举行的）义卖，义捐义卖
defs.def_en: A bring-and-buy sale is an informal sale to raise money for a charity or other organization. People who come to the sale bring things to be sold and buy things that other people have brought.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎毫无凭据，我们只能猜测发生了什么。
ext.ext_en: There's so little to go on, we can only surmise what happened...

ext.ext_cn: 他推测自己已经发现了一条非法活动猖獗的街道。
ext.ext_en: He surmised that he had discovered one of the illegal streets.

defs.def_en: If you surmise that something is true, you guess it from the available evidence, although you do not know for certain.

ext.ext_cn: 认为博斯在画这幅画时脑子里想着布兰特的诗，这仅仅是猜测而已。
ext.ext_en: It is mere surmise that Bosch had Brant's poem in mind when doing this painting...

ext.ext_cn: 他的猜测后来证明是正确的。
ext.ext_en: His surmise proved correct.

defs.def_en: If you say that a particular conclusion is surmise, you mean that it is a guess based on the available evidence and you do not know for certain that it is true.

ext.ext_cn: 他们要求坑道工兵修桥或拆雷。
ext.ext_en: They requested sappers to mend bridges or remove mines.

defs.def_en: A sapper is a soldier whose job is to do building, digging, and similar work.
Big cats are lions, tigers, and other large wild animals in the cat family.

ext.ext_cn: 他知道索利是想吓唬他，所以他挤出笑容掩饰自己的恐惧。
ext.ext_en: He knew that Soli was trying to frighten him, so he smiled to hide his fear...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数孩子见到血就害怕。
ext.ext_en: Most children are frightened by the sight of blood.

defs.def_en: If something or someone frightens you, they cause you to suddenly feel afraid, anxious, or nervous.

defs.def_cn: 使吓得魂飞魄散;使吓破了胆

ext.ext_cn: 露天游乐场的飞车就是想把人吓丢了魂儿。
ext.ext_en: Fairground rides are intended to frighten the life out of you.

defs.def_en: If something frightens the life out of you, frightens the wits out of you, or frightens you out of your wits, it causes you to feel suddenly afraid or gives you a very unpleasant shock.

ext.ext_cn: 渔民们说这家公司进行的地震勘测把鱼都吓跑了。
ext.ext_en: The fishermen said the company's seismic survey was frightening away fish...

ext.ext_cn: 他向空中开枪，希望枪声能把它们吓走。
ext.ext_en: He fired into the air, hoping that the noise would frighten them off.

defs.def_en: If you frighten away a person or animal or frighten them off, you make them afraid so that they run away or stay some distance away from you.

defs.def_cn: 使吓得不敢打交道(或参与)

ext.ext_cn: 建屋互助协会收回未偿清房贷的住房，这吓退了很多买家。
ext.ext_en: Building society repossessions have frightened buyers off...

ext.ext_cn: 政府确信炸弹袭击者的目的是想吓跑外国投资者。
ext.ext_en: The government is convinced that the bombers want to frighten away foreign investors.

defs.def_en: To frighten someone away or frighten them off means to make them nervous so that they decide not to become involved with a particular person or activity.

ext.ext_cn: 他恃强欺弱，总是想吓得人们按他的意愿做事。
ext.ext_en: He was a bully. He tried to frighten people into doing what he wanted.

defs.def_en: If you frighten someone into doing something they would not normally do, you make them do it by making them afraid not to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 可能他是想在雨里凉快一下。
ext.ext_en: Maybe he's trying to cool off out there in the rain...

ext.ext_cn: 她做了个扇风的动作，假装想让自己凉快一点。
ext.ext_en: She made a fanning motion, pretending to cool herself off...

defs.def_en: If someone or something cools off, or if you cool them off, they become cooler after having been hot.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 该报道的作者马丁·帕里宣称是世界各国的首脑采取一致行动的时候了。
ext.ext_en: Martin Parry, author of the report, says it's time for concerted action by world leaders.

defs.def_en: A concerted action  is done by several people or groups working together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他费尽心思想把我从我那稳健、温柔但却有些乏味的男朋友身边抢走。
ext.ext_en: He made a concerted effort to win me away from my steady, sweet but boring boyfriend.

defs.def_en: If you make a concerted effort to do something, you try very hard to do it.
An acrobat is an entertainer who performs difficult physical acts such as jumping and balancing, especially in a circus.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 相貌奇特的；外表怪异的;奇形怪状的

ext.ext_cn: 这对夫妇长相奇特。
ext.ext_en: They were an odd-looking couple...

ext.ext_cn: 一位女招待端来一道样子相当古怪的菜。
ext.ext_en: One of the waitresses arrived with a very odd-looking dish.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as odd-looking, you think that they look strange or unusual.

ext.ext_cn: 她曾经对他的傲慢很反感。
ext.ext_en: Once, she had been put off by his hauteur.

defs.def_en: You can use hauteur to describe behaviour which you think is proud and arrogant.

In Britain, a fish and chip shop is a shop which sells hot food such as fish and chips, fried chicken, sausages, and meat pies. The food is cooked in the shop and people take it away to eat at home or in the street.
A bulldog clip is a metal clip with a spring lever that opens and closes two flat pieces of metal. It is used for holding papers together.
A ditch is a long narrow channel cut into the ground at the side of a road or field.

ext.ext_cn: 我决定把沙发床扔了。
ext.ext_en: I decided to ditch the sofa bed.

ext.ext_cn: 诸如单边裁军之类不得人心的政策已被废除了。
ext.ext_en: Unpopular policies such as unilateral disarmament were ditched.

defs.def_en: If you ditch something that you have or are responsible for, you abandon it or get rid of it, because you no longer want it.

ext.ext_cn: 我不忍心蹬掉他再觅新欢。
ext.ext_en: I can't bring myself to ditch him and start again.

defs.def_en: If someone ditches someone, they end a relationship with that person.

ext.ext_cn: 一位美国飞行员被迫将喷气式飞机紧急迫降在波斯湾上。
ext.ext_en: One American pilot was forced to ditch his jet in the Gulf...

ext.ext_cn: 在直升机紧急迫降时，一名幸存者被撞昏过去。
ext.ext_en: A survivor was knocked unconscious when the helicopter ditched.

defs.def_en: If a pilot ditches an aircraft or if it ditches, the pilot makes an emergency landing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (在组织或专业领域中)级别高的，资深的

ext.ext_cn: 以色列政府的高级官员
ext.ext_en: ...senior officials in the Israeli government.

ext.ext_cn: 公司的高级管理层
ext.ext_en: ...the company's senior management...

defs.def_en: The senior people in an organization or profession have the highest and most important jobs.

defs.def_cn: 职位高于…的;资格比…老的;更资深的

ext.ext_cn: 这个位置必须由一个职位高于黑格的官员来担任。
ext.ext_en: The position had to be filled by an officer senior to Haig...

ext.ext_cn: 威廉斯自认为比他们所有人资格都要老。
ext.ext_en: Williams felt himself to be senior to all of them.

defs.def_en: If someone is senior to you in an organization or profession, they have a higher and more important job than you or they are considered to be superior to you because they have worked there for longer and have more experience.

defs.def_cn: 较年长的人;比…大…岁的人

ext.ext_cn: 她和一个比自己大很多岁的已婚男子好上了。
ext.ext_en: She became involved with a married man many years her senior.

defs.def_en: Senior is used when indicating how much older one person is than another. For example, if someone is ten years your senior, they are ten years older than you.

defs.def_cn: (中学或大学里的)高年级学生，毕业班学生
defs.def_en: Seniors are students in a high school, university, or college who are the oldest and who have reached an advanced level in their studies.

ext.ext_cn: 这将是他第五个世界冠军，第三个成人级别赛事的冠军。
ext.ext_en: This will be his fifth international championship and his third at senior level.

defs.def_en: If you take part in a sport at senior level, you take part in competitions with adults and people who have reached a high degree of achievement in that sport.

defs.def_cn: (高尔夫、网球等体育运动中的)年长的运动员，资深运动员
defs.def_en: In sports such as golf and tennis, a senior is a professional player who is fairly old and who plays in special competitions against other older players.

defs.def_cn: (用在疑问句中，与I和we连用表示提出或征求意见)

ext.ext_cn: 我去拿钥匙好吗？
ext.ext_en: Shall I get the keys?...

ext.ext_cn: 我在面包店里买了些很好吃的葡萄干圆面包，要不要我给你拿一个，再来点儿茶？
ext.ext_en: I bought some lovely raisin buns at the bakery. Shall I bring you one with some tea?...

defs.def_en: You use shall with 'I' and 'we' in questions in order to make offers or suggestions, or to ask for advice.

defs.def_cn: (通常与 I 和 we 连用)将要，将会

ext.ext_cn: 我们将于 16 分钟后准时在巴黎降落。
ext.ext_en: We shall be landing in Paris in sixteen minutes, exactly on time...

ext.ext_cn: 我将于 22 日启航。
ext.ext_en: I shall sail out on the twenty-second...

defs.def_en: You use shall, usually with 'I' and 'we', when you are referring to something that you intend to do, or when you are referring to something that you are sure will happen to you in the future.

defs.def_cn: (与I和we连用，在演讲或文章中用于引出将要讨论或解释的内容)后面要，下文会

ext.ext_cn: 在第三章，我会介绍我收集到的一些文献记录。
ext.ext_en: In Chapter 3, I shall describe some of the documentation that I gathered...

ext.ext_cn: 这里我们将提及过去 10 年中出现的 3 个显著趋势。
ext.ext_en: We shall refer here to three significant trends that arose in the previous decade...

defs.def_en: You use shall with 'I' or 'we' during a speech or piece of writing to say what you are going to discuss or explain later.

defs.def_cn: (通常指按照规则或法律规定)必须，一定，将

ext.ext_cn: 总统将任职 5 年。
ext.ext_en: The president shall hold office for five years...

ext.ext_cn: 安理会将决定采取何种措施来恢复和平与安全。
ext.ext_en: The Security Council shall decide what measures shall be taken to restore peace and security...

defs.def_en: You use shall to indicate that something must happen, usually because of a rule or law. You use shall not to indicate that something must not happen.

defs.def_cn: (通常与 you 连用)可以，能够

ext.ext_cn: 好吧，如果你想走，就走吧。
ext.ext_en: Very well, if you want to go, go you shall...

ext.ext_cn: “把所有的八卦，所有的丑闻都告诉我吧。”——“好的，亲爱的，好的。”
ext.ext_en: 'I want to hear all the gossip, all the scandal.' — 'You shall, dearie, you shall!'

defs.def_en: You use shall, usually with 'you', when you are telling someone that they will be able to do or have something they want.

defs.def_cn: (用于 look forward to 和 hope 之类的动词前表示语气的委婉)

ext.ext_cn: 嗯，我们期待着明天与他会面。
ext.ext_en: Well, we shall look forward to seeing him tomorrow...

ext.ext_cn: 希望你能到我办公室来，小姐，我们将审查一下你的资料。
ext.ext_en: I shall hope to see you in my office, young lady, and we'll review your portfolio.

defs.def_en: You use shall with verbs such as 'look forward to' and 'hope' to say politely that you are looking forward to something or hoping to do something.

defs.def_cn: (表示可能的结果或后果)应该，就会

ext.ext_cn: 当伦敦商业区的大公司削减他们的娱乐活动开支，我们就知道世道真的变得艰难了。
ext.ext_en: When big City firms cut down on their entertainments, we shall know that times really are hard...

ext.ext_cn: 这是我们最后的机会，如果我们想要竞争并存活下来的话，就一定要抓住这次机会。
ext.ext_en: This is our last chance and we shall need to take it if we are to compete and survive.

defs.def_en: You use shall when you are referring to the likely result or consequence of a particular action or situation.

defs.def_cn: (英国国教会等的)会吏;助祭;辅祭
defs.def_en: A deacon is a member of the clergy, for example in the Church of England, who is lower in rank than a priest.

defs.def_cn: (某些基督教新教教会的)执事
defs.def_en: A deacon is a person who is not ordained but who assists the minister in some Protestant churches.

ext.ext_cn: 他只求一杯清茶、片刻小憩。
ext.ext_en: All he wanted was a cup of tea and a sit-down.

defs.def_en: If you have a sit-down, you sit down and rest for a short time.

defs.def_cn: (餐饭)由侍者送上餐桌的，坐在桌前吃的

ext.ext_cn: 晚宴之后播放了一曲迪斯科舞曲。
ext.ext_en: A sit-down dinner was followed by a disco.

defs.def_en: A sit-down meal is served to people sitting at tables.

ext.ext_cn: 老师们在校长办公室门前举行了一场静坐抗议。
ext.ext_en: Teachers staged a sit-down protest in front of the president's office.

defs.def_en: In a sit-down protest, people refuse to leave a place until they get what they want.
The secret police is a police force in some countries that works secretly and deals with political crimes committed against the government.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (信息)粗略的，大概的，不完全的，不充分的

ext.ext_cn: 对于已发生事实的详细情况知道的仍然有限。
ext.ext_en: Details of what actually happened are still sketchy...

ext.ext_cn: 人们对鱼类等自然资源的总储备量所知甚少。
ext.ext_en: Only sketchy information exists on the stock of natural resources such as fish.

defs.def_en: Sketchy information about something does not include many details and is therefore incomplete or inadequate.

defs.def_cn: 陛下(对国王或王后的尊称)

ext.ext_cn: 我十分赞成，陛下。
ext.ext_en: I quite agree, Your Majesty...

ext.ext_cn: 国王陛下要在皇宫召见你。
ext.ext_en: His Majesty requests your presence in the royal chambers...

defs.def_en: You use majesty in expressions such as Your Majesty or Her Majesty when you are addressing or referring to a King or Queen.

ext.ext_cn: 大陆山脉的壮观
ext.ext_en: ...the majesty of the mainland mountains.

defs.def_en: Majesty is the quality of being beautiful, dignified, and impressive.

defs.def_cn: (过去南非的)黑人城镇，黑人居住区

ext.ext_cn: 南非黑人城镇索韦托
ext.ext_en: ...the South African township of Soweto.

ext.ext_cn: 黑人居住区
ext.ext_en: …a black township.

defs.def_en: In South Africa, a township was a town where only black people lived.

defs.def_cn: 区，镇区(美国及加拿大县的下一级行政区)
defs.def_en: In the United States and Canada, a township is an area of land, especially a part of a county which is organized as a unit of local government.

ext.ext_cn: 库克先生说如果联合国的目标无法达成,那么将来的侵略者就可能会逃脱惩罚。
ext.ext_en: Mr Cook said future aggressors would be able to act with impunity if the objectives of the UN weren't met...

ext.ext_cn: 这些团伙明目张胆地活动,却不受任何惩罚。
ext.ext_en: These gangs operate with apparent impunity.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something with impunity, you disapprove of the fact that they are not punished for doing something bad.
The star turn of a performance or show is the main item, or the one that is considered to be the most interesting or exciting.

ext.ext_cn: 一打鸡蛋
ext.ext_en: ...a dozen eggs...

ext.ext_cn: 你可以携带120瓶免税通过海关。
ext.ext_en: You will be able to take ten dozen bottles free of duty through customs...

defs.def_en: If you have a dozen things, you have twelve of them.

ext.ext_cn: 我正坐在只有十几英尺远的地方。
ext.ext_en: I was sitting only a dozen feet away...

ext.ext_cn: 他用了六七个字就解释清楚了他们之间的关系。
ext.ext_en: In half a dozen words, he had explained the bond that linked them...

defs.def_en: You can refer to a group of approximately twelve things or people as a dozen. You can refer to a group of approximately six things or people as half a dozen .

ext.ext_cn: 摧毁了许多房屋和建筑的暴风雨
ext.ext_en: ...a storm which destroyed dozens of homes and buildings.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰逊先生的肖像画同样发人深省，而这样的画有很多。
ext.ext_en: Just as revealing are Mr Johnson's portraits, of which there are dozens.

defs.def_en: If you refer to dozens of things or people, you are emphasizing that there are very many of them.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国对那个国家实施了武器禁运。
ext.ext_en: The United Nations imposed an arms embargo against the country...

ext.ext_cn: 他呼吁政府解除对越南的贸易禁运。
ext.ext_en: He has called on the government to lift its embargo on trade with Vietnam.

defs.def_en: If one country or group of countries imposes an embargo against another, it forbids trade with that country.

ext.ext_cn: 对水果实施禁运。
ext.ext_en: The fruit was embargoed...

ext.ext_cn: 他们对美国实施石油禁运。
ext.ext_en: They embargoed oil shipments to the US.

defs.def_en: If goods of a particular kind are embargoed, people are not allowed to import them from a particular country or export them to a particular country.

ext.ext_cn: 《佩兴丝与萨拉》一书最初于1969年出版时以《属于我们的地方》为名。
ext.ext_en: 'Patience and Sarah' was first published in 1969 under the title 'A Place for Us'.

defs.def_en: The title of a book, play, film, or piece of music is its name.

ext.ext_cn: 皮兰德娄把他的戏剧命名为《六个寻找作者的剧中人》。
ext.ext_en: Pirandello titled his play 'Six Characters in Search of an Author'...

ext.ext_cn: 单曲名为《白色爱情》。
ext.ext_en: The single is titled 'White Love'...

defs.def_en: When a writer, composer, or artist titles a work, they give it a title.

ext.ext_cn: 它成为英国最大的新诗出版商，每年推出新书 50 种。
ext.ext_en: It has become the biggest publisher of new poetry in Britain, with 50 new titles a year.

defs.def_en: Publishers and booksellers often refer to books or magazines as titles .

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫也被封为“丹尼斯爵士”。
ext.ext_en: Her husband was also honoured with his title 'Sir Denis'...

ext.ext_cn: 亚历山德拉公主将会继承法夫女公爵的爵位。
ext.ext_en: Princess Alexandra was to inherit the title of Duchess of Fife…

defs.def_en: A person's title is a word such as 'Sir', 'Lord', or 'Lady' that is used in front of their name, or a phrase that is used instead of their name, and indicates that they have a high rank in society.

ext.ext_cn: 她已被授予教授职称。
ext.ext_en: She has been awarded the title Professor.

defs.def_en: Someone's title is a word such as 'Mr', 'Mrs', or 'Doctor', that is used before their own name in order to show their status or profession.

ext.ext_en: The sky began to lighten...

ext.ext_en: Leslie lightens her hair and has now had it cut into a short, feathered style.

defs.def_en: When something lightens or when you lighten it, it becomes less dark in colour.

ext.ext_en: Anthony  felt the need to lighten the atmosphere...

ext.ext_en: He managed to lighten the generally lifeless debate at times...

ext.ext_en: It is a good idea to blend it in a food processor as this lightens the mixture...

ext.ext_cn: 他用尽全力拉减轻了重量的雪橇。
ext.ext_en: He pulled the lightened sled with all his strength.

defs.def_en: If you lighten something, you make it less heavy.

ext.ext_cn: 部长已经说服银行减轻外债负担。
ext.ext_en: The minister has persuaded the banks to lighten the burden of the foreign debt...

ext.ext_cn: 和别人分享这个秘密可以减轻自己的负担。
ext.ext_en: In sharing this secret you lighten your burden...

defs.def_en: If someone or something lightens your burden or your load, they make a bad or difficult situation better for you.

A lectureship is the position of lecturer at a university or college.
A double bass is the largest instrument in the violin family.

A turd is a lump of faeces.
People sometimes insult someone they do not like by referring to them as a turd .

defs.def_cn: 杰出典范；尽善尽美的人；完人

ext.ext_en: We don't expect candidates to be paragons of virtue.

ext.ext_cn: 整洁、高效和可靠的典范
ext.ext_en: ...a paragon of neatness, efficiency and reliability...

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a paragon, you mean that they are perfect or have a lot of a good quality.

defs.def_cn: (与名词连用构成形容词)表示“有…顶端的”，“覆盖着…的”

ext.ext_en: ...poison-tipped arrows.

defs.def_cn: （尤其当 have 用作助动词时，must have 的常用口语形式）
defs.def_en: Must've is the usual spoken form of 'must have', especially when 'have' is an auxiliary verb.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有趣的;令人愉快的;惬意的

ext.ext_cn: 这比我预期的有趣得多。
ext.ext_en: It was much more enjoyable than I had expected.

ext.ext_cn: 他们做的最有趣的活动
ext.ext_en: ...the most enjoyable activity they did.

defs.def_en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 英国 60 多年以来阳光最灿烂的4月
ext.ext_en: ...the sunniest April in Britain for more than sixty years.

defs.def_en: Sixty is the number 60.

defs.def_cn: 六十几(指 60 至 69 之间的数字)

ext.ext_en: ...a lively widow in her sixties.

defs.def_en: When you talk about the sixties, you are referring to numbers between 60 and 69. For example, if you are in your sixties, you are aged between 60 and 69. If the temperature is in the sixties, it is between 60 and 69 degrees.

defs.def_cn: 二十世纪六十年代(指1960年至1969年)

ext.ext_cn: 20 世纪 60 年代，肯尼迪兄弟和马丁·路德·金先后去世。
ext.ext_en: In the sixties there were the deaths of the two Kennedy brothers and Martin Luther King.

defs.def_en: The sixties is the decade between 1960 and 1969.

defs.def_cn: 在西南方的;西南的;向西南部的

ext.ext_en: ...the most south-westerly tip of Scotland.

defs.def_en: A south-westerly point, area, or direction is to the south-west or towards the south-west.
A south-westerly wind is a wind that blows from the south-west.

ext.ext_cn: 一位过路人描述了汽车炸弹爆炸后他看到的情形。

ext.ext_en: I went and sat in a cafe and watched the passers-by.

defs.def_en: A passer-by is a person who is walking past someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 他骑车去英格伍德。

ext.ext_en: Britain could save £4.6 billion a year in road transport costs if more people cycled...

defs.def_en: If you cycle, you ride a bicycle.

ext.ext_cn: 骑自行车8英里
ext.ext_en: ...an eight-mile cycle ride.

defs.def_en: A cycle is a bicycle.
A cycle is a motorcycle.

ext.ext_cn: 植物的生命周期
ext.ext_en: ...the life cycle of the plant...

ext.ext_en: The figures marked the final low point of the present economic cycle...

defs.def_en: A cycle is a series of events or processes that is repeated again and again, always in the same order.

ext.ext_cn: 每秒10转
ext.ext_en: ...10 cycles per second.

defs.def_en: A cycle is a single complete series of movements in an electrical, electronic, or mechanical process.

ext.ext_cn: 瓦格纳的《指环》组歌
ext.ext_en: ...Wagner's Ring cycle.

defs.def_en: A cycle is a series of songs or poems that are intended to be performed or read one after the other.

ext.ext_cn: 保罗是自学的，他四年前才开始对摄影产生兴趣。
ext.ext_en: Paul is self-taught and became interested in photography just four years ago.

ext.ext_cn: 自学成才的音乐家
ext.ext_en: ...a self-taught musician.

defs.def_en: If you are self-taught, you have learned a skill by yourself rather than being taught it by someone else such as a teacher at school.
Laryngitis is an infection of the throat in which your larynx becomes swollen and painful, making it difficult to speak.

defs.def_cn: (足球比赛中场外协助主裁判和助理裁判的)第四官员

defs.def_en: People sometimes use legumes to refer to peas, beans, and other related vegetables.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 面无表情的；不动声色的

ext.ext_en: His expressions varied from poker-faced to blank...

ext.ext_cn: 那个官员面无表情地听着。
ext.ext_en: The officer listened, poker-faced.

defs.def_en: If you are poker-faced, you have a calm expression on your face which shows none of your thoughts or feelings.

ext.ext_en: We rely quite a bit on ready-made meals — they are so convenient...

ext.ext_en: You can buy it ready-made at Chinese groceries...

ext.ext_en: Those wishing to study urban development have a ready-made example on their doorstep...

ext.ext_en: It provides perfect strangers with a ready-made and infinitely adaptable topic of conversation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you describe something as anodyne, you are criticizing it because it has no strong characteristics and is not likely to excite, interest, or upset anyone.

defs.def_en: If you stare someone out, you look steadily into their eyes for such a long time that they feel that they have to turn their eyes away from you.

ext.ext_en: ...an able and fiercely contentious rhetorician.

ext.ext_en: ...Marxist ideology.

ext.ext_cn: 支撑现代艺术的一些观念
ext.ext_en: ...the beliefs underpinning contemporary art.

ext.ext_en: ...a wine taster.

ext.ext_cn: 即将推出之物的试用品
ext.ext_en: ...a taster of things to come...

ext.ext_cn: 刺耳的尖叫声
ext.ext_en: ...ear-splitting screams.

defs.def_en: An ear-splitting noise is very loud.

ext.ext_cn: 高度易燃的液体
ext.ext_en: ...a highly inflammable liquid.

defs.def_en: An inflammable material or chemical catches fire and burns easily.

ext.ext_en: ...an artist of international standing...

ext.ext_en: He has improved his country's standing abroad...

defs.def_en: Someone's standing is their reputation or status.

ext.ext_en: But, as the opinion poll shows, the party's standing with the people at large has never been so low...

ext.ext_en: Mrs Thatcher's standing was much higher in the US than at home.

defs.def_en: A party's or person's standing is their popularity.

ext.ext_cn: 以色列的常备军规模相对较小，其军事实力主要在于它的预备役部队。
ext.ext_en: Israel has a relatively small standing army and its strength is based on its reserves...

ext.ext_en: Elizabeth had a standing invitation to stay with her.

defs.def_en: You use standing to describe something which is permanently in existence.

ext.ext_cn: 英国在各队排名中位列第 11 位。
ext.ext_en: Britain is 11th in the team standings.

defs.def_en: In a contest or competition, the list of competitors which shows their places during the event is called the standings .

ext.ext_cn: 有 24 年资历的国会议员
ext.ext_en: ...a Congressman of 24 years' standing...

ext.ext_cn: 不，它不是一个梦，它是真实的。
ext.ext_en: No, it wasn't a dream. It was real...

ext.ext_en: Legends grew up around a great many figures, both real and fictitious.

defs.def_en: Something that is real actually exists and is not imagined, invented, or theoretical.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 身临其境的;亲身经历的

ext.ext_cn: 怀特蔡尔德的生活在读者面前显得越来越真实。
ext.ext_en: Whitechild's life becomes increasingly real to the reader.

defs.def_en: If something is real to someone, they experience it as though it really exists or happens, even though it does not.

defs.def_cn: 天然的；真材实料的；非仿制的；非人工合成的

ext.ext_cn: 真皮的气味
ext.ext_en: ...the smell of real leather...

ext.ext_cn: 谁能知道它们是不是真枪呢？
ext.ext_en: Who's to know if they're real guns or not?...

defs.def_en: A material or object that is real is natural or functioning, and not artificial or an imitation.

defs.def_cn: 真正的；完全的；不掺假的；货真价实的

ext.ext_cn: 他第一个真正的女友
ext.ext_en: ...his first real girlfriend...

ext.ext_cn: 他并非货真价实的酒鬼。
ext.ext_en: He's not a real alcoholic...

defs.def_en: You can use real to describe someone or something that has all the characteristics or qualities that such a person or thing typically has.

ext.ext_cn: 这才是她打电话的真正原因。
ext.ext_en: This was the real reason for her call...

ext.ext_cn: 她的真名叫米丽娅姆·平卡斯。
ext.ext_en: Her real name had been Miriam Pinckus.

defs.def_en: You can use real to describe something that is the true or original thing of its kind, in contrast to one that someone wants you to believe is true.

ext.ext_cn: 当他讲话时，他只流露少许个人的真实想法。
ext.ext_en: When he talks, he only gives glimpses of his real self...

ext.ext_cn: 这个精明的主管所有重要的工作都有信得过的人来做。
ext.ext_en: The smart executive has people he can trust doing all the real work.

defs.def_en: You can use real to describe something that is the most important or typical part of a thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 全球变暖是个严重的问题。
ext.ext_en: Global warming is a real problem...

ext.ext_cn: 发生内战的可能性是真实存在的。
ext.ext_en: The prospect of civil war is very real...

defs.def_en: You can use real when you are talking about a situation or feeling to emphasize that it exists and is important or serious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你从一个工作跳到另一个工作，从没有真正投入进去。
ext.ext_en: You've been drifting from job to job without any real commitment...

ext.ext_cn: 德国表现出正视自己反犹主义历史的诚意。
ext.ext_en: Germany has shown real determination to come to terms with the anti-Semitism of its past.

defs.def_en: You can use real to emphasize a quality that is genuine and sincere.

ext.ext_cn: “这桩买卖真让人难以置信，绝对合算。”
ext.ext_en: 'It's a fabulous deal, a real bargain.'

ext.ext_cn: “你一定觉得我简直是个白痴.”
ext.ext_en: 'You must think I'm a real idiot.'

defs.def_en: You can use real before nouns to emphasize your description of something or someone.

defs.def_cn: （成本或价值）实际的，净的，实的

ext.ext_cn: 借款的实际成本
ext.ext_en: ...the real cost of borrowing.

ext.ext_cn: 开车的实际成本比10年前降低了。
ext.ext_en: In real terms the cost of driving is cheaper than a decade ago...

defs.def_en: The real cost or value of something is its cost or value after other amounts have been added or subtracted and when factors such as the level of inflation have been considered.

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词或副词前表示强调）非常，真正

ext.ext_cn: 他发现监狱生活“确实难熬”。
ext.ext_en: He is finding prison life 'real tough'...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得你并没有真正努力尝试。
ext.ext_en: I don't think you are trying real hard.

defs.def_en: You can use real to emphasize an adjective or adverb.

defs.def_cn: 真实地;真正地;不是假装

ext.ext_cn: 床戏只是逼真的表演。我们没有来真的。
ext.ext_en: The sex scenes were just good acting. We didn't do it for real.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something for real, you mean that they actually do it and do not just pretend to do it.

defs.def_cn: 来真的，真是这样（表示令人吃惊）

ext.ext_cn: 这家伙是来真的吗？
ext.ext_en: Is this guy for real?

defs.def_en: If you think that someone or something is very surprising, you can ask if they are for real .

defs.def_cn: 真品；非仿冒品；真实事件

ext.ext_cn: 赝品比真货便宜大约20美元。
ext.ext_en: The counterfeits sell for about $20 less than the real thing...

ext.ext_cn: 另一方面，布莱尔高里高地赛确实是真正的比赛，而不单是媒体盛事。
ext.ext_en: The Blairgowrie Highland Games, on the other hand, are the real thing rather than a media event.

defs.def_en: If you say that a thing or event is the real thing, you mean that it is the thing or event itself, rather than an imitation or copy.

ext.ext_cn: 他们散布假消息，企图败坏政治家的名声。
ext.ext_en: They spread disinformation in order to discredit politicians...

ext.ext_cn: 政府已经卷入了一场造假运动，他们有意误导和扰乱民众生活。
ext.ext_en: The government has been involved in a disinformation campaign, deliberately misleading and harassing its citizens.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of spreading disinformation, you are accusing them of spreading false information in order to deceive people.

ext.ext_cn: 美国人有一种天生的公平观。
ext.ext_en: Americans have an innate sense of fairness.

ext.ext_cn: 个人可以发挥其天生才干和能力的社会
ext.ext_en: ...a society in which individuals could develop their innate abilities and capacities.

defs.def_en: An innate quality or ability is one which a person is born with.

ext.ext_cn: 互相竞争的政党吵闹着争取选民的注意
ext.ext_en: ...competing parties clamouring for the attention of the voter...

ext.ext_cn: 第二天早饭时，我那两个孙子嚷嚷着要去游泳。
ext.ext_en: At breakfast next morning my two grandsons were clamouring to go swimming.

defs.def_en: If people are clamouring for something, they are demanding it in a noisy or angry way.

ext.ext_cn: 凯瑟琳平静的声音使得嘈杂声平息了下来。
ext.ext_en: Kathryn's quiet voice stilled the clamour...

ext.ext_cn: 她能听得见外面路上的吵闹声。
ext.ext_en: She could hear a clamour in the road outside.

defs.def_en: Clamour is used to describe the loud noise of a large group of people talking or shouting together.

ext.ext_cn: 一些黑人感到种族歧视的程度在下降。
ext.ext_en: There is a feeling among some black people that the level of racism is declining.

defs.def_en: Racism is the belief that people of some races are inferior to others, and the behaviour which is the result of this belief.

ext.ext_cn: 他辞去了在雅典当办公室勤杂工的工作。
ext.ext_en: He quit his job as an office boy in Athens...

ext.ext_cn: 他估计自己会在约翰逊炒他鱿鱼之前先辞职。
ext.ext_en: He figured he would quit before Johnson fired him.

defs.def_en: If you quit your job, you choose to leave it.

ext.ext_cn: 尼古丁喷雾剂能够帮助吸烟者在不增加体重的同时戒烟。
ext.ext_en: A nicotine spray can help smokers quit the habit without putting on weight...

ext.ext_cn: 当时我正在努力戒烟。
ext.ext_en: I was trying to quit smoking at the time.

defs.def_en: If you quit an activity or quit doing something, you stop doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 人类有朝一日可能会离开地球到其他星球定居繁衍的想法
ext.ext_en: ...the idea that humans might one day quit the earth to colonise other planets...

ext.ext_cn: 他拒绝离开那座大楼，于是人们叫来了警察。
ext.ext_en: Police were called when he refused to quit the building.

defs.def_en: If you quit a place, you leave it completely and do not go back to it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们通过听众捐款的方式筹集了63万美元后宣告结束。
ext.ext_en: They raised $630,000 through listener donations, and then called it quits...

ext.ext_cn: 你可以决定是否有希望为双方共同的幸福努力，或者就此一刀两断。
ext.ext_en: You can decide whether there is hope in working for mutual happiness, or if you should call it quits.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are going to call it quits, you mean that you have decided to stop doing something or being involved in something.

defs.def_cn: (尤指经与他人讨论)最后确定，最终敲定

ext.ext_cn: 8 月里三国谈判人员最终敲定了协议。
ext.ext_en: Negotiators from the three countries finalized the agreement in August...

ext.ext_cn: 在所有细节最后确定下来之前我们无可奉告。
ext.ext_en: We are saying nothing until all the details have been finalised...

defs.def_en: If you finalize something such as a plan or an agreement, you complete the arrangements for it, especially by discussing it with other people.

ext.ext_cn: 这家托儿所能照料29个孩子。
ext.ext_en: This nursery will be able to cater for 29 children...

ext.ext_cn: 她的公司开办了内部的托儿所。
ext.ext_en: Her company ran its own workplace nursery.

defs.def_en: See also:day nursery;A nursery is a place where children who are not old enough to go to school are looked after.

ext.ext_cn: 人们能负担得起的幼儿园教育是一项基本的社会福利。
ext.ext_en: An affordable nursery education service is an essential basic amenity.

ext.ext_cn: 幼儿园老师
ext.ext_en: ...a nursery teacher.

defs.def_en: Nursery is a school for very young children.

ext.ext_cn: 他在孩子们的儿童房墙壁上画上了画。
ext.ext_en: He has painted murals in his children's nursery.

defs.def_en: A nursery is a room in a family home in which the young children of the family sleep or play.

ext.ext_cn: 这个有35年历史的花园里有一个苗圃。
ext.ext_en: The garden, developed over the past 35 years, includes a nursery.

defs.def_en: A nursery is a place where plants are grown in order to be sold.
A decoder is a device used to decode messages or signals sent in code, for example the television signals from a satellite.

defs.def_cn: (板球运动中的)三柱门守门员，捕手
defs.def_en: A wicketkeeper is the player in a cricket team who stands behind the wicket in order to stop balls that the batsman misses or to catch balls that the batsman hits.

defs.def_cn: (圆筒状的)行李袋,帆布包,旅行包
defs.def_en: A duffel bag is a bag shaped like a cylinder and made of strong fabric such as canvas. A duffel bag has a string at one end that is used to close the bag and to carry it with.
A reservoir is a lake that is used for storing water before it is supplied to people.

ext.ext_cn: 科威特沙漠下面巨大的石油储藏
ext.ext_en: ...the huge oil reservoir beneath the Kuwaiti desert.

ext.ext_cn: 身体的短期能量储备
ext.ext_en: ...the body's short-term reservoir of energy.

defs.def_en: A reservoir of something is a large quantity of it that is available for use when needed.

ext.ext_cn: 道路上车流拥挤。
ext.ext_en: There was heavy traffic on the roads...

ext.ext_cn: 对于一天中的那个时间段而言，来往车辆少得有些不寻常。
ext.ext_en: Traffic was unusually light for that time of day.

defs.def_en: See also:traffic jam;Traffic refers to all the vehicles that are moving along the roads in a particular area.

defs.def_cn: (海上、铁路或空中的)交通，通行;(客、货)运输量

ext.ext_cn: 空中交通已恢复正常。
ext.ext_en: Air traffic had returned to normal...

ext.ext_cn: 铁路将承担比例高得多的货运量。
ext.ext_en: The railways will carry a far higher proportion of freight traffic...

defs.def_en: See also:air traffic control;Traffic refers to the movement of ships, trains, or aircraft between one place and another. Traffic also refers to the people and goods that are being transported.

defs.def_cn: (毒品、赃物等的)非法买卖，非法交易

ext.ext_cn: 如今每年非法毒品的交易值约在 5,000 亿美元。
ext.ext_en: Traffic in illicit drugs was now worth some 500 thousand million dollars a year.

defs.def_en: Traffic in something such as drugs or stolen goods is an illegal trade in them.

ext.ext_cn: 总统称毒品正在危害整个世界，任何非法贩卖毒品的人都应依法受到惩处。
ext.ext_en: The president said illegal drugs are hurting the entire world and anyone who traffics in them should be brought to justice.

defs.def_en: Someone who traffics in something such as drugs or stolen goods buys and sells them even though it is illegal to do so.

ext.ext_cn: 确保懿行得到嘉奖。
ext.ext_en: Make sure that good behaviour is rewarded.

ext.ext_cn: 人类性行为
ext.ext_en: ...human sexual behaviour...

defs.def_en: People's or animals' behaviour is the way that they behave. You can refer to a typical and repeated way of behaving as a behaviour .

defs.def_cn: （科学领域中的）运动方式，活动方式，性能，特点

ext.ext_cn: 要能够相当准确地预测出飓风的特性尚需多年。
ext.ext_en: It will be many years before anyone can predict a hurricane's behavior with much accuracy.

defs.def_en: In science, the behaviour of something is the way that it behaves.

defs.def_cn: 极力表现；尽量做到举止得体
defs.def_en: If someone is on their best behaviour, they are trying very hard to behave well.

defs.def_cn: 修饰语;(某些语法中仅指置于名词前的)修饰词
defs.def_en: A modifier is a word or group of words that modifies another word or group. In some descriptions of grammar, only words that are used before a noun are called modifiers .

ext.ext_cn: 朱莉安娜心中充满了重新找回的信心。
ext.ext_en: Juliana was brimming over with new-found confidence...

ext.ext_cn: 作为电影界的一名性格演员，亨明斯最近开始走红。
ext.ext_en: Hemmings is enjoying a newfound popularity as a character actor in the movies.

defs.def_en: A new-found quality or ability is one that you have got recently.
See also:snowplough;A plough is a large farming tool with sharp blades which is pulled across the soil to turn it over, usually before seeds are planted.

ext.ext_cn: 他们犁了将近10万英亩未开垦的高沼地。
ext.ext_en: They ploughed nearly 100,000 acres of virgin moorland.

ext.ext_cn: 仔细犁过的田地
ext.ext_en: ...a carefully ploughed field.

defs.def_en: When someone ploughs an area of land, they turn over the soil using a plough.

ext.ext_cn: 没有一寸土地未被开垦成耕地。
ext.ext_en: There was not one inch of soil that was not under the plough.

ext.ext_cn: 随着我们将越来越多的荒地开垦成耕地
ext.ext_en: ...as we put more and more wilderness under the plough.

defs.def_en: If an area of land is under the plough, it is used for growing crops. If land is brought or put under the plough, it is ploughed for the first time and is then used for growing crops.

defs.def_cn: （想法、感觉、信息）蔓延，逐渐流传

ext.ext_cn: 新时尚要很长时间才能在大众中流行起来。
ext.ext_en: New fashions took a long time to percolate down.

ext.ext_cn: 所有这些想法在我脑海中扩散
ext.ext_en: ...all of these thoughts percolated through my mind.

defs.def_en: If an idea, feeling, or piece of information percolates through a group of people or a thing, it spreads slowly through the group or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 她滤煮好咖啡，然后把羊角面包放进烤箱加热。
ext.ext_en: She percolated the coffee and put croissants in the oven to warm.

defs.def_en: When you percolate coffee or when coffee percolates, you prepare it in a percolator.

ext.ext_cn: 雨水只会慢慢地渗进来。
ext.ext_en: Rain water will only percolate through slowly.

defs.def_en: To percolate somewhere means to pass slowly through something that has very small holes or gaps in it.

ext.ext_cn: 浇酸奶酪汁的烤箭鱼
ext.ext_en: ...grilled swordfish with a yogurt dressing.

ext.ext_cn: 浇酸奶酪汁的烤箭鱼
ext.ext_en: ...grilled swordfish with a yogurt dressing.

defs.def_en: A swordfish is a large sea fish with a very long upper jaw.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 主卧室非常大。
ext.ext_en: The main bedroom is enormous...

ext.ext_cn: 当然有很多可看的。
ext.ext_en: There is, of course, an enormous amount to see.

defs.def_en: Something that is enormous is extremely large in size or amount.

ext.ext_cn: 真是让人万分失望。
ext.ext_en: It was an enormous disappointment.

ext.ext_cn: 他的穷凶极恶
ext.ext_en: ...his enormous capacity for brutality.

defs.def_en: You can use enormous to emphasize the great degree or extent of something.
A shoulder-bag is a bag that has a long strap so that it can be carried on a person's shoulder.

ext.ext_cn: 与他分居的妻子已经申请到了针对他的限制令。
ext.ext_en: His estranged wife had taken out a restraining order against him.

defs.def_en: A restraining order is an order by a court of law that someone should stop doing something until a court decides whether they are legally allowed to continue doing it.

defs.def_cn: (律师就某人所提供的证据进行)盘问，反诘

ext.ext_cn: 被告律师将有机会盘问他。
ext.ext_en: The accused's lawyers will get a chance to cross-examine him...

ext.ext_cn: 你要清楚他们可能会就这起人身侵犯案毫不留情地盘问你。
ext.ext_en: You know you are liable to be cross-examined mercilessly about the assault.

defs.def_en: When a lawyer cross-examines someone during a trial or hearing, he or she questions them about the evidence that they have already given.

ext.ext_cn: 她有一头黄褐色的头发。
ext.ext_en: She had tawny hair.

ext.ext_cn: 黄褐色的大狗
ext.ext_en: ...a large, tawny dog.

defs.def_en: Tawny hair, fur, or skin is a pale brown colour.

defs.def_cn: (与名词连用构成其他名词)表示“硝基”，“硝化”

ext.ext_cn: 极具腐蚀性的物质，如硝基磷酸盐
ext.ext_en: ...highly corrosive substances such as nitro-phosphates.

defs.def_en: Nitro- combines with nouns to form other nouns referring to things which contain nitrogen and oxygen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 大惊小怪的；一本正经的；谨小慎微的

ext.ext_cn: 我变得讨厌和我有着同样出身背景的人——他们太保守、太一本正经了。
ext.ext_en: I grew to dislike the people from my background — they were rather uptight and prissy.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is prissy, you are critical of them because they are very easily shocked by anything rude or bad.

ext.ext_cn: 剃光了头的小男孩
ext.ext_en: ...a small boy with a shaven head.

defs.def_en: See also:clean-shaven;If a part of someone's body is shaven, it has been shaved.
A chamber pot is a round container shaped like a very large cup. Chamber pots used to be kept in bedrooms so that people could urinate in them instead of having to leave their room during the night.

ext.ext_cn: 有20人在这一暴力事件中丧生。
ext.ext_en: Twenty people were killed in the violence...

ext.ext_cn: 他们对其进行暴力威胁。
ext.ext_en: They threaten them with violence.

defs.def_en: Violence is behaviour which is intended to hurt, injure, or kill people.

ext.ext_cn: “没有必要，”埃米突然激愤地说。
ext.ext_en: 'There's no need,' Amy said, with sudden violence...

ext.ext_cn: 她语气之强烈令阿利斯泰尔深感震惊。
ext.ext_en: The violence in her tone gave Alistair a shock.

defs.def_en: If you do or say something with violence, you use a lot of force and energy in doing or saying it, often because you are angry.

defs.def_cn: 活过；经过（不愉快的事件或变故）之后仍旧活着

ext.ext_cn: 我们太年轻，没经历过那场战争。
ext.ext_en: We are too young to have lived through the war...

ext.ext_cn: 就像是做了一场噩梦。
ext.ext_en: It's been like living through a nightmare.

defs.def_en: If you live through an unpleasant event or change, you experience it and survive.

defs.def_cn: 内陆的；北方边远地区的

ext.ext_cn: 内地村落
ext.ext_en: ...a collection of upcountry hamlets.

ext.ext_cn: 我在北边几英里开外的地方有一个养牛场。
ext.ext_en: I run a cattle station some miles up-country...

defs.def_en: Upcountry places are towards the middle or north of a large country, usually in the countryside.

defs.def_cn: (加在形容词之后构成形容词)表示“稍带…的”，“有点儿…的”

ext.ext_cn: 她身材偏高,棕色头发,皮肤光洁。
ext.ext_en: She is tallish, brown-haired, and clear-skinned...

ext.ext_cn: 和她在一起的是一个略显年轻、身着无尾礼服的男人。
ext.ext_en: With her was a youngish man in a dinner jacket.

defs.def_en: -ish is added to adjectives to form adjectives which indicate that someone or something has a quality to a small extent. For example, something that is largish is fairly large.

defs.def_cn: (用于名词和姓名之后构成形容词)表示“像(某类人或事物)的”，“有…特征的”

ext.ext_cn: 她完全没有了少女时胖嘟嘟的感觉。
ext.ext_en: She had entirely lost her girlish chubbiness.

ext.ext_cn: 一个修道士模样的男人
ext.ext_en: ...a man of monkish appearance.

defs.def_en: -ish is added to nouns and names to form adjectives which indicate that someone or something is like a particular kind of person or thing. For example, 'childish' means like a child, or typical of a child.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示时间、日期、年龄的词之后)表示“…前后的”，“…左右的”

ext.ext_cn: 我明天给你们打电话,中午前后吧。
ext.ext_en: I'll call you guys tomorrow. Noon-ish...

ext.ext_cn: 那个护士大概50岁上下。
ext.ext_en: The nurse was fiftyish.

defs.def_en: -ish is added to words referring to times, dates, or ages to form words which indicate that the time or age mentioned is approximate.

ext.ext_cn: 天主教教堂
ext.ext_en: ...the Catholic Church.

ext.ext_cn: 天主教神父
ext.ext_en: ...Catholic priests.

defs.def_en: See also:Anglo-Catholic;The Catholic Church is the branch of the Christian Church that accepts the Pope as its leader and is based in the Vatican in Rome.

ext.ext_cn: 墨西哥人至少有9/10是受洗的天主教徒。
ext.ext_en: At least nine out of ten Mexicans are baptised Catholics.

defs.def_en: A Catholic is a member of the Catholic Church.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他这个人兴趣广泛，大歌剧、历史、美术，无所不好。
ext.ext_en: He was a man of catholic tastes, a lover of grand opera, history and the fine arts.

defs.def_en: If you describe a collection of things or people as catholic, you are emphasizing that they are very varied.
Flour is a white or brown powder that is made by grinding grain. It is used to make bread, cakes, and pastry.

defs.def_cn: 给…裹上面粉;在…上撒以面粉

ext.ext_cn: 在擀面杖上撒上薄薄的一层面粉。
ext.ext_en: Lightly flour a rolling pin...

ext.ext_cn: 把面团从碗中取出，放在撒有面粉的台面上。
ext.ext_en: Remove the dough from the bowl and put it on a floured surface.

defs.def_en: If you flour cooking equipment or food, you cover it with flour.

defs.def_cn: 无法计算的;不可估量的;数不清的

ext.ext_cn: 他警告说任何战争造成的后果都是不可估量的。
ext.ext_en: He warned that the effects of any war would be incalculable...

ext.ext_cn: 这给他的声誉造成了难以估量的损失。
ext.ext_en: This has done incalculable damage to his reputation.

defs.def_en: Something that is incalculable cannot be calculated or estimated because it is so great.
Tundra is one of the large flat areas of land in the north of Europe, Asia, and America. The ground below the top layer of soil is always frozen and no trees grow there.

ext.ext_cn: 埃及法老拉美西斯二世
ext.ext_en: ...Rameses II, Pharaoh of All Egypt.

defs.def_en: A pharaoh was a king of ancient Egypt.
A snaffle is an object consisting of two short joined bars of metal that is put in a horse's mouth and attached to the straps that the rider uses to control the horse.

ext.ext_cn: 接着，迈克尔·斯蒂克又一举拿下了两百万美元的头奖。
ext.ext_en: Michael Stich then proceeded to snaffle the $2 million first prize.

defs.def_en: If you snaffle something, you take it for yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 资本主义生产方式
ext.ext_en: ...the capitalist mode of production...

ext.ext_cn: 他自动切换到访谈模式。
ext.ext_en: He switched automatically into interview mode.

defs.def_en: A mode of life or  behaviour is a particular way of living or behaving.

ext.ext_cn: 略显典雅和正式的着装风格
ext.ext_en: ...a slightly more elegant and formal mode of dress...

ext.ext_cn: 利瓦伊最为人所知之处在于他的工作风格同这里的人迥然不同。
ext.ext_en: Levi is best known for work in a very different mode from what is to be found here.

defs.def_en: A mode is a particular style in art, literature, or dress.

defs.def_cn: (照相机、电子设备的)模式，状态

ext.ext_en: A leakage of kerosene has polluted water supplies...

ext.ext_cn: 应该可以减少管道的渗漏量。
ext.ext_en: It should be possible to reduce leakage from pipes.

defs.def_en: A leakage is an amount of liquid or gas that is escaping from a pipe or container by means of a crack, hole, or other fault.

defs.def_cn: (基督教圣餐礼上所用的)圣餐杯，圣杯
defs.def_en: A chalice is a large gold or silver cup with a stem. Chalices are used to hold wine in the Christian service of Holy Communion.

defs.def_cn: 金杯毒酒(指看似诱人、实则只会导致失败的工作或机会)

ext.ext_cn: 他并不认为自己的新工作是金杯毒酒。
ext.ext_en: He does not regard his new job as a poisoned chalice...

ext.ext_cn: 有人甚至说，他之所以任命自己的政治对手，是因为他知道所给的职位是杯诱人的毒酒，接受者肯定撑不过一年。
ext.ext_en: Some people even claimed that he appointed his political rival only in the belief that he was giving him a poisoned chalice and that he would not last more than a year.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a job or an opportunity as a poisoned chalice, you mean that it seems to be very attractive but you believe it will lead to failure.

ext.ext_cn: 搞得他们晕头转向的问题
ext.ext_en: ...problems that are befuddling them.

defs.def_en: If something befuddles you, it confuses your mind or thoughts.

ext.ext_cn: 该党需要一种不同的领导风格。
ext.ext_en: The party needs a different kind of leadership...

ext.ext_cn: 杰米遇到过什么麻烦吗？
ext.ext_en: Had Jamie ever been in any kind of trouble?...

defs.def_en: If you talk about a particular kind of thing, you are talking about one of the types or sorts of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我和你一样痛恨刘易斯之流。
ext.ext_en: I hate Lewis and his kind just as much as you do...

ext.ext_cn: 我能对付像你这样的家伙。
ext.ext_en: I can take care of your kind.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's kind, you are referring to all the other people that are like them or that belong to the same class or set.

defs.def_cn: 各种类型的；五花八门的

ext.ext_cn: 收养不成功可能有各种原因。
ext.ext_en: Adoption can fail for all kinds of reasons...

ext.ext_cn: 捐赠来自于各界人士。
ext.ext_en: Donations came from all kinds of people...

defs.def_en: You can use all kinds of to emphasize that there are a great number and variety of particular things or people.

ext.ext_cn: 有点儿让人难过，真的。
ext.ext_en: It was kind of sad, really...

ext.ext_cn: 她不漂亮。但她有几分可爱。
ext.ext_en: She wasn't beautiful. But she was kind of cute...

defs.def_en: You use kind of when you want to say that something or someone can be roughly described in a particular way.

defs.def_cn: 名不副实，徒有其名（指不如本应有的那么好）

ext.ext_cn: 对总理来说也算是有个好消息。
ext.ext_en: There is good news of a kind for the Prime Minister...

ext.ext_cn: 她从酒精中多少得到一些安慰。
ext.ext_en: She finds solace of a kind in alcohol.

defs.def_en: You can use of a kind to indicate that something is not as good as it might be expected to be, but that it seems to be the best that is possible or available.

ext.ext_cn: 她是个非常与众不同的女人，是独一无二的。
ext.ext_en: She's a very unusual woman, one of a kind.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone or something as one of a kind, you mean that there is nobody or nothing else like them.

defs.def_cn: 两个/三个/四个同一类的

ext.ext_cn: 他们俩是一类人，有相同的背景。
ext.ext_en: They were two of a kind, from the same sort of background.

defs.def_en: If you refer, for example, to two, three, or four of a kind, you mean two, three, or four similar people or things that seem to go well or belong together.

ext.ext_cn: 他们向防暴警察挑衅大骂，防暴警察同样回骂他们。
ext.ext_en: They hurled defiant taunts at the riot police, who responded in kind.

defs.def_en: If you respond in kind, you react to something that someone has done to you by doing the same thing to them.

defs.def_cn: 以实物支付；以货代款；以服务偿付

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀和纸币短缺使工厂不得不以实物抵付工人的工资。
ext.ext_en: Inflation and the shortage of banknotes has forced factories to pay their workers in kind.

ext.ext_cn: 实物形式的福利
ext.ext_en: ...benefits in kind.

defs.def_en: If you pay a debt in kind, you pay it in the form of goods or services and not money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 慈祥的；体贴的；乐于助人的

ext.ext_cn: 她对每个人每件事都很热心、宽厚。
ext.ext_en: She is warm-hearted and kind to everyone and everything...

ext.ext_cn: 我很感激你对我这么好。
ext.ext_en: I must thank you for being so kind to me...

defs.def_en: Someone who is kind behaves in a gentle, caring, and helpful way towards other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 请…，…可以吗（表示坚定且客气地请求某人做某事）

ext.ext_cn: 请务必立即执行变更！
ext.ext_en: Please be so kind as to see to it that all the alterations are made at once!...

ext.ext_cn: 请你给他打个电话好吗？
ext.ext_en: I wonder if you'd be kind enough to call him.

defs.def_en: You can use kind in expressions such as please be so kind as to and would you be kind enough to in order to ask someone to do something in a firm but polite way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 突出优点的；使胜过实物的

ext.ext_cn: 体形较丰满的人穿夏装总是不那么好看。
ext.ext_en: Summer clothes are invariably less kind to fuller figures.

defs.def_en: Something that is kind emphasizes the good qualities in something, and perhaps makes it appear better than it really is.

ext.ext_cn: 她有了一丝满足感。
ext.ext_en: She felt a small glow of satisfaction...

ext.ext_cn: 双方对目前的进展都表示满意。
ext.ext_en: Both sides expressed satisfaction with the progress so far...

defs.def_en: Satisfaction is the pleasure that you feel when you do something or get something that you wanted or needed to do or get.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你得不到任何赔偿，向园区所有者投诉。
ext.ext_en: If you can't get any satisfaction, complain to the park owner.

defs.def_en: If you get satisfaction from someone, you get money or an apology from them because you have been treated badly.

ext.ext_cn: 她似乎从没能做过一件正确或令他满意的事。
ext.ext_en: She never could seem to do anything right or to his satisfaction...

ext.ext_cn: 很难想象这个问题如何解决才能让每个人都满意。
ext.ext_en: It is hard to see how the issue can be resolved to everyone's satisfaction.

defs.def_en: If you do something to someone's satisfaction, they are happy with the way that you have done it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 羞怯的;胆怯的;缺乏自信的

ext.ext_cn: 海伦比较害羞内向。
ext.ext_en: Helen was diffident and reserved.

defs.def_en: Someone who is diffident is rather shy and does not enjoy talking about themselves or being noticed by other people.
An air base is a centre where military aircraft take off or land and are serviced, and where many of the centre's staff live.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 法国有很多相当不错的家庭旅馆。
ext.ext_en: France is abundantly supplied with excellent family-run hotels.

defs.def_en: See also:supply;If you say that a person or place is well supplied with particular things, you mean that they have a large number of them.

ext.ext_cn: 需要很多种土生昆虫给当地植物授粉。
ext.ext_en: Many of the indigenous insects are needed to pollinate the local plants.

defs.def_en: To pollinate a plant or tree means to fertilize it with pollen. This is often done by insects.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （糟糕、无聊或程度强烈到）令人头脑麻木的

ext.ext_cn: 又是一个令人麻木的单调乏味的日子。
ext.ext_en: It was another day of mind-numbing tedium.

defs.def_en: If you describe an event or experience as mind-numbing, you mean that it is so bad, boring, or great in extent that you are unable to think about it clearly.
A garter belt is a piece of underwear for women that is used for holding up stockings.

ext.ext_cn: 将伊伍德公园球场扩建成能容纳3万座席的体育场的计划
ext.ext_en: ...the plan to enlarge Ewood Park into a 30,000 all-seater stadium...

ext.ext_cn: 颈部腺体可能增大。
ext.ext_en: The glands in the neck may enlarge.

defs.def_en: When you enlarge something or when it enlarges, it becomes bigger.

ext.ext_cn: 希望把他们大喜之日的照片放大的新婚夫妻
ext.ext_en: ...newlyweds wishing to enlarge snaps of their big day.

defs.def_en: To enlarge a photograph means to develop a bigger print of it.

defs.def_cn: 进一步补充;详述;详细说明

ext.ext_cn: 他没有进一步说明过渡政府和立法机构将采取的形式。
ext.ext_en: He didn't enlarge on the form that the interim government and assembly would take...

ext.ext_cn: 我想就加里·多金的话再展开说一下。
ext.ext_en: I wish to enlarge upon a statement made by Gary Docking.

defs.def_en: If you enlarge on something that has been mentioned, you give more details about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 引起烦恼的;令人不安的;引起恐慌的

ext.ext_cn: 他身上有某种东西使她不安。
ext.ext_en: There was something about him she found disturbing...

ext.ext_cn: 对这两个中心发生的谋杀的报道令人不安。
ext.ext_en: There are disturbing reports of killings at the two centres.

defs.def_en: Something that is disturbing makes you feel worried or upset.
A drawbridge is a bridge that can be pulled up, for example to prevent people from getting into a castle or to allow ships to pass underneath it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 强健的;健壮的;坚固的;结实的

ext.ext_cn: 看医生的女性多于男性。也许男性更强壮或者顾虑要少一些？
ext.ext_en: More women than men go to the doctor. Perhaps men are more robust or worry less?...

ext.ext_cn: 我们一直专注于制造极为结实耐用而且设计简单的机器。
ext.ext_en: We've always specialised in making very robust, simply designed machinery.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is robust is very strong or healthy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (观点等)强烈的，坚定的，坚决的

ext.ext_cn: 一位英国外交大臣坚决维护这个协议。
ext.ext_en: A British Foreign Office minister has made a robust defence of the agreement...

ext.ext_cn: 他具备了所需的敏锐的洞察力和坚定的行事态度。
ext.ext_en: He has the keen eye and robust approach needed.

defs.def_en: Robust views or opinions are strongly held and forcefully expressed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...a lethal dose of sleeping pills.

ext.ext_cn: 会杀死鱼类和水生哺乳动物的致命化学品
ext.ext_en: ...chemicals lethal to fish and aquatic mammals.

defs.def_en: A substance that is lethal can kill people or animals.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 马力大的汽车到了缺乏经验的司机手中便成了毁灭性的武器。
ext.ext_en: High-powered cars are lethal weapons in the hands of inexperienced drivers...

ext.ext_cn: 霜雨天气对植物危害极大。
ext.ext_en: Frost and wet are the lethal combination for plants.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as lethal, you mean that it is capable of causing a lot of damage.

defs.def_cn: 阿拉贝斯克舞姿（芭蕾基本舞姿之一，单腿直立，另一腿往后抬起，两臂前伸）

ext.ext_cn: 这位芭蕾舞女演员一直保持着完美的阿拉贝斯克舞姿不动。
ext.ext_en: The ballerina remained suspended in a faultless arabesque.

defs.def_en: An arabesque is a position in ballet dancing. The dancer stands on one leg with their other leg lifted and stretched out backwards, and their arms stretched out in front of them.

ext.ext_cn: 绘有阿拉伯式花饰的泥制水罐
ext.ext_en: ...a clay water jug decorated with painted arabesques.

defs.def_en: In art, an arabesque is a design of flowing lines.

ext.ext_cn: 表示照片这类复杂图像的位图图形
ext.ext_en: ...bitmap graphics for representing complex images such as photographs.

ext.ext_cn: 位图贴图需要巨大的存储空间。
ext.ext_en: Bitmapped maps require huge storage space.

defs.def_en: A bitmap is a type of graphics file on a computer.

ext.ext_cn: 显然，13天拘留并没能让他悔过自新。
ext.ext_en: He has clearly not been chastened by his thirteen days in detention...

ext.ext_cn: 追悔莫及的阿加西坐飞机回家面壁思过去了。
ext.ext_en: A chastened Agassi flew home for a period of deep contemplation.

defs.def_en: If you are chastened by something, it makes you regret that you have behaved badly or stupidly.

ext.ext_cn: 实现独立
ext.ext_en: ...the attainment of independence.

defs.def_en: The attainment of an aim is the achieving of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的学业成就
ext.ext_en: ...their educational attainments.

defs.def_en: An attainment is a skill you have learned or something you have achieved.

ext.ext_cn: 丁香鸡汤
ext.ext_en: ...chicken soup with cloves.

defs.def_en: Cloves are small dried flower buds which are used as a spice.
A clove of garlic is one of the sections of a garlic bulb.

ext.ext_cn: 他从椅子上站起来，朝窗口走去。
ext.ext_en: He rose from his chair and walked to the window.

defs.def_en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on. Chairs have a back and four legs.

ext.ext_cn: 他被任命担任南安普敦大学的社会学教授一职。
ext.ext_en: He has been appointed to the chair of sociology at Southampton University...

ext.ext_cn: 他资助伦敦大学10万英镑，以设立伊斯兰艺术教授一职。
ext.ext_en: He gave London University £100,000 to establish a chair in Islamic art.

defs.def_en: At a university, a chair is the post of professor.

ext.ext_cn: 她担任军队女性权益保护顾问委员会主席。
ext.ext_en: She is the chair of the Defense Advisory Committee on Women in the Military.

defs.def_en: The person who is the chair of a committee or meeting is the person in charge of it.

defs.def_cn: 主持(会议);担任(委员会的)主席

ext.ext_cn: 他将主持在威尼斯召开的欧盟外长会议。
ext.ext_en: He was about to chair a meeting in Venice of EU foreign ministers...

ext.ext_en: The declaration was drafted by a committee chaired by Dr Robert Song.

defs.def_en: If you chair a meeting or a committee, you are the person in charge of it.
The chair is the same as the electric chair .

ext.ext_cn: 会议由莫里恩·摩根主持。
ext.ext_en: In the chair was Morien Morgan...

ext.ext_cn: 惠勒担任该小组委员会会议主席。
ext.ext_en: Wheeler took the chair of this sub-committee...

defs.def_en: If you are in the chair or take the chair at a meeting, you are the person in charge of it.

ext.ext_en: She stood watching the car's tail-lights disappear down the drive.

defs.def_en: The tail-lights on a car or other vehicle are the two red lights at the back.
