ext.ext_en: Her head spins dizzily as soon as she sits up.

ext.ext_cn: 她帮他坐起身来，好让他舒服一点。
ext.ext_en: She sat him up and made him comfortable.

defs.def_en: If you sit someone up, you move them into a sitting position when they have been leaning back or lying down.

ext.ext_en: We sat up drinking and talking...

ext.ext_en: A defeat like that makes you sit up and think.

ext.ext_cn: 威廉斯先生是个保守派，主张政府应减少对商业的控制。
ext.ext_en: Mr Williams is a conservative who advocates fewer government controls on business.

ext.ext_en: ...the tax policy advocated by the Opposition.

ext.ext_en: He was a strong advocate of free market policies and a multi-party system.

ext.ext_cn: 为无家可归的人谋利益者
ext.ext_en: ...advocates for the homeless...

ext.ext_en: Animal rights advocates argue that zoos are really animal prisons and very often cruel.

ext.ext_en: James had provided for just such an emergency.

defs.def_en: If you provide for something that might happen or that might need to be done, you make arrangements to deal with it.

defs.def_en: If someone or something chases away worries, fears, or other bad feelings, they cause those feelings to change and become happier.

defs.def_en: A loaded question or word has more meaning or purpose than it appears to have, because the person who uses it hopes it will cause people to respond in a particular way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If something is loaded with a particular characteristic, it has that characteristic to a very great degree.

defs.def_en: If you duplicate something that has already been done, you repeat or copy it.

ext.ext_en: Working to a prearranged plan, he rang the First Secretary and requested an appointment with the Ambassador.

defs.def_en: You use prearranged to indicate that something has been planned or arranged before the time when it actually happens.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is the personification of a particular thing or quality, you mean that they are a perfect example of that thing or that they have a lot of that quality.

ext.ext_en: ...personifications of the attributes of Justice, Prudence and Truth.

defs.def_en: A personification of something abstract is its representation in the form of a person.

ext.ext_en: ...grey eyes that seemed filled with pain.

defs.def_en: In informal English, if you call someone or something a pain or a pain in the neck, you mean that they are very annoying or irritating. Expressions such as a pain in the arse and a pain in the backside in British English, or a pain in the ass and a pain in the butt in American English, are also used, but most people consider them offensive.

defs.def_en: If someone is at pains to do something, they are very eager and anxious to do it, especially because they want to avoid a difficult situation.

ext.ext_en: Chantal was lucky to be able to salvage her career.

ext.ext_en: It's an open secret that the security service bugged telephones.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as an open secret, you mean that it is supposed to be a secret, but many people know about it.
A manicurist is a person whose job is mani-curing people's hands and nails.

ext.ext_cn: 南美洲壮丽的自然美景
ext.ext_en: ...the grandeur and natural beauty of South America...

ext.ext_en: Only inside do you appreciate the church's true grandeur.

defs.def_en: If something such as a building or a piece of scenery has grandeur, it is impressive because of its size, its beauty, or its power.

ext.ext_cn: 他只关心自己的显赫地位。
ext.ext_en: He is wholly concerned with his own grandeur.

defs.def_en: Someone's grandeur is the great importance and social status that they have, or think they have.

ext.ext_cn: 他们等着瞧那个可怜的富家小姐出丑。
ext.ext_en: They're waiting for the poor little rich girl to take a pratfall.

defs.def_en: If someone takes a pratfall, they make an embarrassing mistake.

defs.def_cn: （广播、电视节目）不在广播中；（发生）在播送节目之外

ext.ext_en: When I get off air around 2am my neck and shoulders are locked with tension...

ext.ext_en: The argument continued off air.

defs.def_en: In radio or television, when a programme goes off-air or when something happens off-air, it is not broadcast.
Quietude is quietness and calm.

ext.ext_cn: 他头顶上的秃斑
ext.ext_en: ...the bald patch on the top of his head...

ext.ext_cn: 灰色的云团中透出一小片蓝天。
ext.ext_en: There was a small patch of blue in the grey clouds.

defs.def_en: A patch on a surface is a part of it which is different in appearance from the area around it.

defs.def_cn: （种有某种植物或农作物的）小块土地

ext.ext_cn: 一小块林地
ext.ext_en: ...a patch of land covered in forest.

ext.ext_cn: 她家后院中的一小块菜地
ext.ext_en: ...the little vegetable patch in her backyard.

defs.def_en: A patch of land is a small area of land where a particular plant or crop grows.

ext.ext_cn: 肘部打着补丁的夹克
ext.ext_en: ...jackets with patches on the elbows.

ext.ext_cn: 想打上一块补丁修好漏气的轮胎
ext.ext_en: ...trying to fix the flat tire by putting a patch on it.

defs.def_en: A patch is a piece of material which you use to cover a hole in something.

ext.ext_cn: 她去了医院，发现他躺着，一只眼睛戴着眼罩。
ext.ext_en: She went to the hospital and found him lying down with a patch over his eye.

defs.def_en: See also:eye patch;A patch is a small piece of material which you wear to cover an injured eye.

ext.ext_en: He and Walker patched the barn roof...

ext.ext_en: One of the mechanics took off the damaged tyre, and took it back to the station to be patched.

defs.def_en: If you patch something that has a hole in it, you mend it by fastening a patch over the hole.

ext.ext_cn: 老些的机器需要下载软件补丁来修改日期。
ext.ext_en: Older machines will need a software patch to be loaded to correct the date.

defs.def_en: A patch is a piece of computer program code written as a temporary solution for dealing with a virus in computer software and distributed by the makers of the original program.

ext.ext_cn: 他的婚姻当时麻烦不断。
ext.ext_en: His marriage was going through a bad patch...

ext.ext_cn: 我所在的公司经历了一段困难时期。
ext.ext_en: The company I work for went through a rough patch.

defs.def_en: If you have or go through a bad patch or a rough patch, you have a lot of problems for a time.

ext.ext_cn: 他远比不上内阁的其他成员。
ext.ext_en: He's not a patch on the rest of the Cabinet...

ext.ext_en: Handsome, she thought, but not a patch on Alex.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is not a patch on another person or thing, you mean that they are not as good as that person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他很快就改变了对这个职业的看法。
ext.ext_en: He soon came to revise his opinion of the profession.

defs.def_en: If you revise the way you think about something, you adjust your thoughts, usually in order to make them better or more suited to how things are.

defs.def_cn: 调整，改变(价格、数目、估计等)

ext.ext_cn: 他们意识到自己有些价格高于竞争对手，就相应调整了价格。
ext.ext_en: They realised that some of their prices were higher than their competitors' and revised prices accordingly...

ext.ext_en: The United Nations has been forced to revise its estimates of population growth upwards.

defs.def_en: If you revise a price, amount, or estimate, you change it to make it more fair, realistic, or accurate.

defs.def_cn: 修改（音乐作品）；修订（法律）；审定，校订（文章、书籍）

ext.ext_cn: 3位编辑负责文章的修订出版工作。
ext.ext_en: Three editors handled the work of revising the articles for publication...

ext.ext_cn: 全体教职工应当齐心协力修订学校课程。
ext.ext_en: The staff should work together to revise the school curriculum.

defs.def_en: When you revise an article, a book, a law, or a piece of music, you change it in order to improve it, make it more modern, or make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 我得复习数学。
ext.ext_en: I have to revise for maths...

ext.ext_en: I'd better skip the party and stay at home to revise.

defs.def_en: When you revise for an examination, you read things again and make notes in order to be prepared for the examination.

defs.def_cn: 粗野女子;轻佻女子;荡妇
defs.def_en: If someone refers to a girl or woman as a hussy, they are criticizing her for behaving in a shocking or immoral way.

ext.ext_cn: 声称要讲述全部事实的一本书
ext.ext_en: ...a book that purports to tell the whole truth.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something purports to do or be a particular thing, you mean that they claim to do or be that thing, although you may not always believe that claim.

ext.ext_en: No liquids are served with meals because they interfere with digestion.

ext.ext_cn: 对脂肪的消化
ext.ext_en: ...the digestion of fats.

defs.def_en: Digestion is the process of digesting food.

ext.ext_cn: 我的消化系统这几天也不怎么对劲儿。
ext.ext_en: My digestion ain't so hot these days, either.

defs.def_en: Your digestion is the system in your body which digests your food.

defs.def_cn: 剧目轮演;轮流上演选定剧目

ext.ext_en: Her repertory was vast and to her it seemed that each song told some part of her life.

defs.def_en: A performer's repertory is all the plays or pieces of music that he or she has learned and can perform.

ext.ext_cn: 已经实践证明的电子商务解决方案
ext.ext_en: ...proven e-business solutions.

defs.def_en: E-business is the buying, selling, and ordering of goods and services using the Internet.

ext.ext_cn: 他满脸红斑，像是起了很严重的粉刺。

ext.ext_en: Keep stirring until the sauce thickens.

defs.def_en: When you thicken a liquid or when it thickens, it becomes stiffer and more solid.

ext.ext_en: As the ice sheet grows and thickens it chills the nearby air.

defs.def_en: If something thickens, it becomes more closely grouped together or more solid than it was before.

defs.def_en: People sometimes say 'the plot thickens' when a situation or series of events is getting more and more complicated and mysterious.

defs.def_en: When animals or plants ingest a substance, they take it into themselves, for example by eating or absorbing it.

ext.ext_en: Politicians normally avoid getting tangled up in anything to do with their electorate's savings.

ext.ext_en: More women than men go to the doctor. Perhaps men are more robust or worry less?...

ext.ext_en: We've always specialised in making very robust, simply designed machinery.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (观点等)强烈的，坚定的，坚决的

ext.ext_cn: 一位英国外交大臣坚决维护这个协议。
ext.ext_en: A British Foreign Office minister has made a robust defence of the agreement...

ext.ext_cn: 他具备了所需的敏锐的洞察力和坚定的行事态度。
ext.ext_en: He has the keen eye and robust approach needed.

defs.def_en: Robust views or opinions are strongly held and forcefully expressed.

ext.ext_en: ...the Wharton School, Univ. of Pennsylvania.

defs.def_en: Univ is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) University which is used especially in the names of universities.

ext.ext_en: They were very nearly forced to turn back...

ext.ext_cn: 学校食堂
ext.ext_en: ...a school canteen.

ext.ext_en: ...a full canteen of water.

defs.def_en: A canteen is a small plastic bottle for carrying water and other drinks. Canteens are used by soldiers.

ext.ext_cn: 印度第八任总理
ext.ext_en: ...the eighth prime minister of India.

defs.def_en: The eighth item in a series is the one that you count as number eight.

ext.ext_en: The Kuban produces an eighth of Russia's grain, meat and milk.

ext.ext_en: ...her belief that scientists are trying to blur the distinction between 'how' and 'why' questions...

defs.def_en: If your vision blurs, or if something blurs it, you cannot see things clearly.

ext.ext_cn: 不受限制的自由贸易

defs.def_en: You can use low-rent to describe something that is of poor quality, especially when it is compared with something else.

ext.ext_cn: 地球每天绕地轴自转
ext.ext_en: ...the daily rotation of the earth upon its axis.

defs.def_en: Rotation is circular movement. A rotation is the movement of something through one complete circle.

ext.ext_cn: 他连续5年在同一块地里种植不同的作物，研究人员称之为轮作。
ext.ext_en: He grew a different crop on the same field five years in a row, what researchers call crop rotation...

ext.ext_cn: 我们每个月聚在一起一整天，轮流担任领队。
ext.ext_en: Once a month we met for the whole day, and in rotation each one led the group.

defs.def_en: The rotation of a group of things or people is the fact of them taking turns to do a particular job or serve a particular purpose. If people do something in rotation, they take turns to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他提起箱子，向出口走去。
ext.ext_en: He picked up the case and walked towards the exit...

ext.ext_cn: 楼下女洗手间旁边有个消防出口。
ext.ext_en: There's a fire exit by the downstairs ladies room.

defs.def_en: The exit is the door through which you can leave a public building.

defs.def_cn: （高速路、公路等的）出口，换道口

ext.ext_cn: 从旧斯特拉福特的A422号出口出来。
ext.ext_en: Take the A422 exit at Old Stratford.

defs.def_en: An exit on a motorway or highway is a place where traffic can leave it.

ext.ext_cn: 我匆忙离开并设法打开了大门。
ext.ext_en: I made a hasty exit and managed to open the gate.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's exit, you are referring to the way that they left a room or building, or the fact that they left it.

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰退出欧锦赛后
ext.ext_en: ...after England's exit from the European Championship...

ext.ext_cn: 他们建议她为了政党的利益体面地下台。
ext.ext_en: They suggested that she make a dignified exit in the interest of the party.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's exit, you are referring to the way that they left a situation or activity, or the fact that they left it.

ext.ext_cn: 她走了出去，消失在热带风暴中。
ext.ext_en: She exits into the tropical storm...

ext.ext_cn: 我从最后一个展厅里出来，走进一个六角形的房间。
ext.ext_en: As I exited the final display, I entered a hexagonal room...

defs.def_en: If you exit from a room or building, you leave it.

defs.def_cn: 退出，停止运行（计算机程序、系统等）

ext.ext_cn: 我不必退出WordPerfect程序就可以打开其他应用程序。
ext.ext_en: I can open other applications without having to exit WordPerfect.

ext.ext_cn: 按“退出”返回文档。
ext.ext_en: Press Exit to return to your document.

defs.def_en: If you exit a computer program or system, you stop running it.

ext.ext_cn: 法庭上展开激辩的律师们
ext.ext_en: ...lawyers joust in the courtroom...

ext.ext_cn: 这家石油公司和埃索公司角逐英国市场销量的榜首位置。
ext.ext_en: The oil company jousts with Esso for lead position in UK sales.

defs.def_en: When two or more people or organizations joust, they compete to see who is better.

defs.def_cn: （中世纪的骑士）进行马上长矛比武，骑马比武

ext.ext_cn: 骑士们骑马比武，嬉戏作乐。
ext.ext_en: Knights joust and frolic.

defs.def_en: In medieval times, when two knights on horseback jousted, they fought against each other using long spears called lances.

ext.ext_cn: 天气很糟。
ext.ext_en: The weather was bad...

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢冷天。
ext.ext_en: I like cold weather...

defs.def_en: The weather is the condition of the atmosphere in one area at a particular time, for example if it is raining, hot, or windy.

ext.ext_cn: 没有上漆的木制家具会褪成灰色。
ext.ext_en: Unpainted wooden furniture weathers to a grey colour...

ext.ext_cn: 这块岩石经风吹日晒已被侵蚀。
ext.ext_en: This rock has been weathered and eroded.

defs.def_en: If something such as wood or rock weathers or is weathered, it changes colour or shape as a result of the wind, sun, rain, or cold.

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司从经济萧条中挺了过来。
ext.ext_en: The company has weathered the recession...

ext.ext_cn: 政府平安度过了其最严重的政治危机。
ext.ext_en: The government has weathered its worst political crisis.

defs.def_en: If you weather a difficult time or a difficult situation, you survive it and are able to continue normally after it has passed or ended.  to weather the storm→see: storm;

defs.def_cn: 警惕;密切注意；留心观察

ext.ext_cn: 街道委员会留意所辖区域内的家家户户。
ext.ext_en: Street committees keep a weather eye on the families in their district.

defs.def_en: If you keep a weather eye on someone or something, you stay alert so that you will notice if anything unpleasant happens.

defs.def_cn: 夸大…的困难；对…小题大做

ext.ext_cn: 这个环节的部分骑手夸大了这场越野比赛的困难。
ext.ext_en: Some of the riders in this section made heavy weather of the cross-country race.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is making heavy weather of a task, you are critical of them because they are doing it in an inefficient way and are making it seem more difficult than it really is.

ext.ext_cn: 我仍觉得身体有些不舒服。
ext.ext_en: I was still feeling a bit under the weather.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are under the weather, you mean that you feel slightly ill.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他能活下来真是万幸。
ext.ext_en: He was extremely fortunate to survive...

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦市中心有幸拥有许多大型公园和大片空地。
ext.ext_en: Central London is fortunate in having so many large parks and open spaces...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is fortunate, you mean that they are lucky.

ext.ext_cn: 我系着安全带，所以幸免于难。
ext.ext_en: The fact I was wearing a seat belt saved my life.

defs.def_en: A seat belt is a strap attached to a seat in a car or an aircraft. You fasten it across your body in order to prevent yourself being thrown out of the seat if there is a sudden movement.

ext.ext_cn: 她搬进来时，屋子里井井有条。
ext.ext_en: Her house was in perfect order when she moved in...

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫和一个比她年轻的女人同居了。
ext.ext_en: Her  husband had moved in with a younger woman...

defs.def_en: When you move in somewhere, you begin to live there as your home.

defs.def_cn: (警察、士兵或袭击者)逼近，进逼

ext.ext_cn: 警察开进来驱散人群。
ext.ext_en: Police moved in to disperse the crowd...

ext.ext_cn: 军队正向克宁镇进逼。
ext.ext_en: Forces were moving in on the town of Knin.

defs.def_en: If police, soldiers, or attackers move in, they go towards a place or person in order to deal with or attack them.

ext.ext_cn: 黑人模特正逐步涉足曾是白人主宰的领地：签约获利丰厚的化妆品行业。
ext.ext_en: These black models are moving in on what was previously white territory: the lucrative cosmetic contracts.

defs.def_en: If someone moves in on an area of activity which was previously only done by a particular group of people, they start becoming involved with it  for the first time.

defs.def_cn: 保全面子的;挽回面子的

ext.ext_cn: 这个决定看来是一种保全面子的妥协，让政府不至于下台。
ext.ext_en: The decision appears to be a face-saving compromise which will allow the government to remain in office.

defs.def_en: A face-saving action is one which prevents damage to your reputation or the loss of people's respect for you.

ext.ext_cn: 一顿丰盛的英式早餐总会包括香肠。
ext.ext_en: A good British breakfast always includes sausages...

ext.ext_cn: 旅程被延长，其他几项活动也被包括进来。
ext.ext_en: The trip has been extended to include a few other events...

defs.def_en: If one thing includes another thing, it has the other thing as one of its parts.

defs.def_cn: 把…列为…的一部分;把…算入

ext.ext_cn: 为参与这样的项目,我过去一直努力工作。
ext.ext_en: I had worked hard to be included in a project like this...

ext.ext_cn: 人们期望总统把这一意见列入他的教育计划当中。
ext.ext_en: The President is expected to include this idea in his education plan.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is included in a large group, system, or area, they become a part of it or are considered a part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 四五年前，在我40岁的时候，我经历了中年危机。
ext.ext_en: I went through my midlife crisis about four or five years ago, when I was forty.

defs.def_en: A midlife crisis is a period of doubt and anxiety that some people experience in middle age, when they think about whether their life is the kind of life that they want.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 异常的;离经叛道的;为社会不容的

ext.ext_cn: 伊恩的怒气越来越大，反常行为也愈发恶劣。
ext.ext_en: Ian's rages and aberrant behavior worsened.

defs.def_en: Aberrant means unusual and not socially acceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 布莱克神思恍惚地回到了自己的房间。
ext.ext_en: Like a man in a trance, Blake found his way back to his rooms...

ext.ext_cn: 他们进入出神状态与灵界交流。
ext.ext_en: They went into a trance to communicate with the spirit world.

defs.def_en: A trance is a state of mind in which someone seems to be asleep and to have no conscious control over their thoughts or actions, but in which they can see and hear things and respond to commands given by other people.

ext.ext_cn: 咖啡经冷冻干燥以保留原汁原味。
ext.ext_en: The coffee is freeze-dried to seal in all the flavour.

defs.def_en: If something seals in a smell or liquid, it prevents it from getting out of a food.
A four-wheel drive is a vehicle in which all four wheels receive power from the engine to help with steering. This makes the vehicle easier to drive on rough roads or surfaces such as sand or snow.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 巨大的；庞大的；大得惊人的

ext.ext_cn: 这种业务收益丰厚。
ext.ext_en: This business generates cash in prodigious amounts...

ext.ext_cn: 他惊人的记忆力让所有见过他的人都印象深刻。
ext.ext_en: He impressed all who met him with his prodigious memory.

defs.def_en: Something that is prodigious is very large or impressive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 达不到的;难到达的;不可(或不易)进入的

ext.ext_cn: 偏僻遥远、难以到达的安第斯雨林地区
ext.ext_en: ...the remote, inaccessible areas of the Andes rainforests.

ext.ext_cn: 这条路线带我们穿越了驾车者难以抵达的风景区。
ext.ext_en: The route took us through scenery quite inaccessible to the motorist.

defs.def_en: An inaccessible place is very difficult or impossible to reach.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 见不到的;不可使用的;买不到的

ext.ext_cn: 其中 95% 的顶级收藏品仍不会向公众开放。
ext.ext_en: Ninety-five per cent of its magnificent collection will remain inaccessible to the public...

ext.ext_cn: 我们得到了通常难以获取的大量数据。
ext.ext_en: We gained a rich supply of data which would normally be inaccessible.

defs.def_en: If something is inaccessible, you are unable to see, use, or buy it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 许多当代音乐几乎难以理解。
ext.ext_en: A lot of contemporary music is virtually inaccessible.

ext.ext_cn: 使用劳动人民无法理解的语言
ext.ext_en: ...using language that is inaccessible to working people.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is inaccessible is difficult or impossible to understand or appreciate.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 长期的；持续很久的；时间长的

ext.ext_cn: 长期的低利率
ext.ext_en: ...a prolonged period of low interest rates.

ext.ext_cn: 长期的干旱
ext.ext_en: ...a prolonged drought.

defs.def_en: A prolonged event or situation continues for a long time, or for longer than expected.

ext.ext_cn: 双方都声称决不让步。
ext.ext_en: Both sides say they will not budge...

ext.ext_cn: 美国人非常强硬，他们在这一点上是不会妥协的。
ext.ext_en: The Americans are adamant that they will not budge on this point...

defs.def_en: If someone will not budge on a matter, or if nothing budges them, they refuse to change their mind or to come to an agreement.

ext.ext_cn: 她母亲不肯离开伦敦。
ext.ext_en: Her mother refused to budge from London...

ext.ext_cn: 窗户推不开。
ext.ext_en: The window refused to budge...

defs.def_en: If someone or something will not budge, they will not move. If you cannot budge them, you cannot make them move.
An engraving is a picture or design that has been cut into a surface.

ext.ext_cn: 橙子和柠檬的彩色版画
ext.ext_en: ...a color engraving of oranges and lemons.

defs.def_en: An engraving is a picture that has been printed from a plate on which designs have been cut.

ext.ext_cn: 一片片开阔的草地
ext.ext_en: ...areas of open grassland.

defs.def_en: Grassland is land covered with wild grass.

defs.def_cn: 引言的;导论的;介绍性的

ext.ext_cn: 宗教与神学入门课程
ext.ext_en: ...an introductory course in religion and theology.

defs.def_en: An introductory remark, talk, or part of a book gives a small amount of general information about a particular subject, often before a more detailed explanation.

ext.ext_cn: 刚刚以2.99英镑的新品促销价上架
ext.ext_en: ...just out on the shelves at an introductory price of £2.99.

defs.def_en: An introductory offer or price on a new product is something such as a free gift or a low price that is meant to attract new customers.

defs.def_cn: (哲学和文学评论中)解构，拆析(观点或文本)

ext.ext_cn: 她构建了一个缜密的智识框架来解构各种类型的电影。
ext.ext_en: She sets up a rigorous intellectual framework to deconstruct various categories of film.

defs.def_en: In philosophy and literary criticism, to deconstruct an idea or text means to show the contradictions in its meaning, and to show how it does not fully explain what it claims to explain.

defs.def_cn: 抢购，赶紧买下(便宜或心仪之物)

ext.ext_cn: 每次新到一批服装时，人们都在排起长队来抢购。
ext.ext_en: Every time we get a new delivery of clothes, people are queuing to snap them up...

ext.ext_cn: 一个眼疾手快的收藏家以仅仅 6 英镑的价钱抢到了一副斯基亚帕雷利设计的耳环。
ext.ext_en: One eagle-eyed collector snapped up a pair of Schiaparelli earrings for just £6.

defs.def_en: If you snap something up, you buy it quickly because it is cheap or is just what you want.

defs.def_cn: (太阳表面大约会持续存在一周的)黑子，日斑
defs.def_en: Sunspots are dark cool patches that appear on the surface of the sun and last for about a week.

ext.ext_cn: 滚开，鲍勃。
ext.ext_en: Push off, Bob.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to push off, you are telling them rather rudely to go away.

defs.def_cn: 棘手的问题;难以处理的问题;烫手山芋
defs.def_en: If you describe a problem or issue as a hot potato, you mean that it is very difficult and nobody wants to deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 下个月，披头士乐队的专辑《红与蓝》将首次发行CD。
ext.ext_en: The Beatles' Red and Blue compilations are issued on CD for the first time next month.

defs.def_en: CDs are small plastic discs on which sound, especially music, is recorded. CDs can also be used to store information which can be read by a computer. CD is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'compact disc'.

ext.ext_cn: 该国领导将5名外国记者驱逐出境。
ext.ext_en: The country's leaders kicked five foreign journalists out of the country...

ext.ext_cn: 她的家人把她赶了出来。
ext.ext_en: Her family kicked her out.

defs.def_en: See also:kick;To kick someone out of a place means to force them to leave it.

defs.def_cn: （书、电影或戏剧的）情节主线，主要情节

ext.ext_cn: 主要情节是围绕一位名叫查斯的伦敦黑帮小混混如何走向毁灭的过程展开的。
ext.ext_en: The plotline revolved around the fall of Chas, a minor London gangster.

defs.def_en: The plotline of a book, film, or play is its plot and the way in which it develops.

defs.def_cn: （体育比赛）因雨暂停，因雨取消

ext.ext_cn: 星期六的比赛因雨取消了。
ext.ext_en: Saturday's game was rained out.

defs.def_en: If a sports game is rained out, it has to stop, or it is not able to start, because of rain.

ext.ext_cn: 皮肤的肌理和颜色，身体的轮廓
ext.ext_en: ...the texture and colour of the skin, the contours of the body...

ext.ext_cn: 我紧张地把摄影机架在大腿上，但是它冰冷的外形并没能给我任何安慰。
ext.ext_en: I cradled my video camera nervously on my lap, but its cold contours did nothing to comfort me.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the general shape or outline of an object as its contours .

ext.ext_cn: 刚好在450英尺的等高线之下有3个缓坡。
ext.ext_en: There were three moderate climbs to just below the 450 feet contour.

ext.ext_cn: 标示着两座小山和中间这座大山的等高线地图
ext.ext_en: ...a contour map showing two hills and this large mountain in the middle.

defs.def_en: A contour on a map is a line joining points of equal height and indicating hills, valleys, and the steepness of slopes.

ext.ext_cn: 我肩膀里的几块金属碎片
ext.ext_en: ...fragments of metal in my shoulder...

ext.ext_cn: 她什么都看，对新闻的每个片段都细细品味。
ext.ext_en: She read everything, digesting every fragment of news.

defs.def_en: A fragment of something is a small piece or part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 乌云散开，太阳出来了。
ext.ext_en: The clouds fragmented and out came the sun...

ext.ext_cn: 激烈的竞争已经如从前一样使得该地区四分五裂。
ext.ext_en: Fierce rivalries have traditionally fragmented the region...

defs.def_en: If something fragments or is fragmented, it breaks or separates into small pieces or parts.

ext.ext_cn: 他提着公文包。
ext.ext_en: He was carrying a briefcase...

ext.ext_cn: 他端着盘子来到餐厅。
ext.ext_en: He carried the plate through to the dining room...

defs.def_en: If you carry something, you take it with you, holding it so that it does not touch the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 你要随身带着寻呼机,以便他们随时呼你。
ext.ext_en: You have to carry a bleeper so that they can call you in at any time.

defs.def_en: If you carry something, you have it with you wherever you go.

ext.ext_cn: 花的作用在于吸引昆虫，然后昆虫再将花粉传到其他植株上。
ext.ext_en: Flowers are designed to attract insects which then carry the pollen from plant to plant...

ext.ext_cn: 代表团向穆巴拉克总统转达了谢意。
ext.ext_en: The delegation was carrying a message of thanks to President Mubarak...

defs.def_en: If something carries a person or thing somewhere, it takes them there.

ext.ext_cn: 艾滋病病毒携带者的官方数字并不高。
ext.ext_en: The official number of people carrying the AIDS virus is low...

ext.ext_cn: 青蛙吃破坏庄稼、传播疾病的害虫。
ext.ext_en: Frogs eat pests which destroy crops and carry diseases.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal is carrying a disease, they are infected with it and can pass it on to other people or animals.

ext.ext_cn: 仔细检查,确保你所服用的任何药物不会对胎儿造成危险。
ext.ext_en: Check that any medication you're taking carries no risk for your developing baby...

ext.ext_cn: 个人主义以及社会和谐的崩溃具有一定的建设意义,然而这也是有代价的。
ext.ext_en: Individualism, and the breakdown of social harmony, had a constructive purpose. But they also carried a price.

defs.def_en: If an action or situation has a particular quality or consequence, you can say that it carries it.

defs.def_cn: 使达到(目标);帮助…渡过(难关)

ext.ext_cn: 他具有进入内阁所必需的冷酷性格。
ext.ext_en: He had the ruthless streak necessary to carry him into the Cabinet...

ext.ext_cn: 他们互相关心,关系牢固,这才熬过了艰难岁月。
ext.ext_en: The warmth and strength of their relationship carried them through difficult times.

defs.def_en: If a quality or advantage carries someone into a particular position or through a difficult situation, it helps them to achieve that position or deal with that situation.

ext.ext_cn: 这虽然不是什么新想法，但是我将它发挥到了极致。
ext.ext_en: It's not such a new idea, but I carried it to extremes...

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以再进一步：取出相同的基因,并将它们植入另一植株。
ext.ext_en: We could carry that one step further by taking the same genes and putting them into another crop.

defs.def_en: If you carry an idea or a method to a particular extent, you use or develop it to that extent.

ext.ext_cn: 好几份报纸都刊登了安德森先生的照片。
ext.ext_en: Several papers carry the photograph of Mr Anderson.

defs.def_en: If a newspaper or poster carries a picture or a piece of writing, it contains it or displays it.

ext.ext_cn: 一项支持其经济政策的动议以322票对296票通过。
ext.ext_en: A motion backing its economic policy was carried by 322 votes to 296.

defs.def_en: In a debate, if a proposal or motion is carried, a majority of people vote in favour of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这是间谍罪,应判死刑。
ext.ext_en: It was a crime of espionage and carried the death penalty.

defs.def_en: If a crime carries a particular punishment, a person who is found guilty of that crime will receive that punishment.

ext.ext_cn: 就是在这样的寂静当中,利普霍恩也怀疑声音不会传很远。
ext.ext_en: Even in this stillness Leaphorn doubted if the sound would carry far.

defs.def_en: If a sound carries, it can be heard a long way away.

ext.ext_en: In the formative years their alliance carried all before it.

defs.def_en: If a person or team carries all before them, they succeed very easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you describe something as edifying, you mean that it benefits you in some way, for example by teaching you about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (通常用于否定句)令人愉快的,可以接受的

ext.ext_cn: 所有这些都让人回想起一段并不那么愉快的过去。
ext.ext_en: It all brought back memories of a not very edifying past.

defs.def_en: You say that something is not very edifying when you want to express your disapproval or dislike of it, or to suggest that there is something unpleasant or unacceptable about it.

ext.ext_en: Sarajevo took one of its worst poundings in weeks.

defs.def_en: If a person or team gets a pounding, they are severely defeated.

ext.ext_en: ...a spy movie with car chases, a murder, a shag and a happy ending.

defs.def_en: If someone shags another person, or if two people shag, they have sex together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you are unhappy, you are sad and depressed.

ext.ext_en: I suspect he isn't altogether unhappy about my absence...

ext.ext_en: The legislation represents in itself an unhappy compromise.

defs.def_en: An unhappy situation or choice is not satisfactory or desirable.

ext.ext_en: I used to stay up late with my mom and watch movies.

defs.def_en: If you stay up, you remain out of bed at a time when most people have gone to bed or at a time when you are normally in bed yourself.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不对的；不正常的；错误的

ext.ext_en: Their instincts warned them something was amiss...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的保健制度存在重大缺陷。
ext.ext_en: Something is radically amiss in our health care system.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is amiss, you mean there is something wrong.

defs.def_cn: 会起作用；会称心如意；不会出错

ext.ext_en: A bit of charm and humour would not go amiss...

ext.ext_en: The cracks are showing in the walls and a lick of paint would not come amiss.

defs.def_en: If you say that something would not go amiss or would not come amiss, you mean that it would be pleasant and useful.

ext.ext_en: Fresh fruits and vegetables are important and so is bran.

defs.def_en: Bran is the outer skin of grain that is left when the grain has been used to make flour.

ext.ext_en: ...negotiations over a 1992 treaty on global warming.

defs.def_en: A treaty is a written agreement between countries in which they agree to do a particular thing or to help each other.

ext.ext_en: ...cold water with ice cubes in it...

ext.ext_en: ...a box of sugar cubes...

defs.def_en: A cube is a solid object with six square surfaces which are all the same size.

ext.ext_en: Remove the seeds and stones and cube the flesh...

ext.ext_cn: 和小面包块一起食用。
ext.ext_en: Serve with cubed bread.

defs.def_en: When you cube food, you cut it into cube-shaped pieces.
The cube of a number is another number that is produced by multiplying the first number by itself twice. For example, the cube of 2 is 8.

ext.ext_cn: 高级经理人把工作与生活的平衡作为择业的主要标准。
ext.ext_en: Senior managers stipulated work-life balance as their main criterion when choosing jobs.

defs.def_en: Your work-life balance is how you organize your days, for example how many hours you spend at work, and how much time you spend with friends or doing things you enjoy.

defs.def_cn: 无记名投票；无记名选举；无记名表决

ext.ext_en: The result of the ballot will not be known for two weeks...

ext.ext_en: Fifty of its members will be elected by direct ballot.

defs.def_en: A ballot is a secret vote in which people select a candidate in an election, or express their opinion about something.

ext.ext_en: Election boards will count the ballots by hand...

ext.ext_cn: 他们成功地让佩罗在佛罗里达州成为了候选人之一。
ext.ext_en: They succeeded in putting Perot's name on the ballot in Florida.

defs.def_en: A ballot is a piece of paper on which you indicate your choice or opinion in a secret vote.

defs.def_cn: 在…中间进行无记名投票（或表决）

ext.ext_cn: 工会称他们将要求会员投票表决是否罢工。
ext.ext_en: The union said they will ballot members on whether to strike.

defs.def_en: If you ballot a group of people, you find out what they think about a subject by organizing a secret vote.
A grasshopper is an insect with long back legs that jumps high into the air and makes a high, vibrating sound.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: We passed one or two dwellings, but were not disposed to stop...

ext.ext_en: I might have been disposed to like him in other circumstances...

defs.def_en: If you are disposed to do something, you are willing or eager to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我看出出版商对我的书颇有好感。
ext.ext_en: I saw that the publishers were well disposed towards my book...

ext.ext_cn: 历届政府一直以来——或者说某些时候——都对新闻界冷面相待。
ext.ext_en: Every government is ill-disposed to the press, all or some of the time...

defs.def_en: You can use disposed when you are talking about someone's general attitude or opinion. For example, if you are well or favourably disposed to someone or something, you like them or approve of them.

defs.def_en: If things are disposed in a particular way, they are arranged in that way.

ext.ext_en: ...a collection of works of art of international significance.

defs.def_en: A work of art is a painting or piece of sculpture which is of high quality.

ext.ext_cn: 真实的鸟巢十分精致。
ext.ext_en: The actual nest is a work of art.

defs.def_en: A work of art is something which is very complex or which has been skilfully made or produced.

defs.def_cn: （置于形容词、副词、名词之前表示反义）

ext.ext_en: He had sensed his mother's unhappiness.

defs.def_en: Un- is added to the beginning of adjectives, adverbs, and nouns, in order to form words that have the opposite meaning.

defs.def_cn: （置于动词之前表示相反的过程）

ext.ext_en: He undressed and draped his clothes neatly over the back of the chair...

ext.ext_en: She was anxious for me to unwrap the other gifts.

defs.def_en: Un- is added to the beginning of a verb that describes a process, in order to form another verb that describes the reverse of that process.

defs.def_cn: （置于动词的过去分词之前构成形容词，表示动作尚未发生）

ext.ext_cn: 该理论尚未得到检验。
ext.ext_en: The theory remains untested...

ext.ext_en: Dealers across the country continue to complain about huge stocks of unsold cars.

defs.def_en: Un- is added to the beginning of the past participle of a verb, in order to form an adjective that means that the process described by the verb has not happened.

ext.ext_en: ...a sixteen-piece dance band with a female singer...

ext.ext_en: There was a small air vent in the ceiling.

defs.def_en: A vent is a hole in something through which air can come in and smoke, gas, or smells can go out.

ext.ext_en: She gave vent to her anger and jealousy.

ext.ext_en: The cabby gave vent to an angry shout.

defs.def_cn: （情况）惊险刺激的，令人担忧的，令人害怕的

ext.ext_cn: 他的车技让人不放心。
ext.ext_en: His driving was a bit hairy.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as hairy, you mean that it is exciting, worrying, and rather frightening.

defs.def_cn: 时间范围;时间段;时间框架

ext.ext_cn: 这一切发生的时间范围是 1985年9月到1986年3月。
ext.ext_en: The time frame within which all this occurred was from September 1985 to March 1986...

ext.ext_cn: 联合国进行的讨论可能包括采取行动的时间安排。
ext.ext_en: Discussions at the UN could include a time frame for action.

defs.def_en: The time frame of an event is the length of time during which it happens or develops.

ext.ext_cn: 园艺铲
ext.ext_en: ... a garden spade...

ext.ext_cn: 女孩子们拿着桶和铲子在沙滩上快活地玩耍。
ext.ext_en: The girls happily played in the sand with buckets and spades.

defs.def_en: A spade is a tool used for digging, with a flat metal blade and a long handle.

ext.ext_cn: 黑桃 A
ext.ext_en: ...the ace of spades.

defs.def_en: Spades is one of the four suits in a pack of playing cards. Each card in the suit is marked with one or more black symbols: .

ext.ext_cn: 我不会遮遮掩掩，我喜欢直言不讳。
ext.ext_en: I'm not at all secretive, and I'm pretty good at calling a spade a spade.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone calls a spade a spade, you mean that they speak clearly and directly about things, even embarrassing or unpleasant things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 当时媒体的报道糟透了。
ext.ext_en: The media coverage was shocking...

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚我的情况一定很糟糕。
ext.ext_en: I must have been in a shocking state last night.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is shocking if you think that it is very bad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人震惊的;令人愤慨的;不道德的

ext.ext_cn: 当时竟然什么都没说,真让人愤慨。
ext.ext_en: It is shocking that nothing was said...

ext.ext_cn: 这是对隐私的公然侵犯。
ext.ext_en: This was a shocking invasion of privacy.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is shocking if you think that it is morally wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 对暴力赤裸裸的影像描绘
ext.ext_en: ...the graphic visual depiction of violence.

ext.ext_cn: 音乐、电影、舞蹈和视觉艺术
ext.ext_en: ...music, film, dance, and the visual arts.

defs.def_en: Visual means relating to sight, or to things that you can see.

defs.def_cn: 视觉材料（指用于展示或说明的图画、表格、影片等）

ext.ext_cn: 要记住，使用视觉材料是为了使表达的意思更加清楚明白，而不能分散对所讲内容的注意力。
ext.ext_en: Remember you want your visuals to reinforce your message, not detract from what you are saying.

defs.def_en: A visual is something such as a picture, diagram, or piece of film that is used to show or explain something.

defs.def_cn: 困境；窘境;左右为难的境地

ext.ext_cn: 政府似乎陷入了左右为难的境地，不知道该拿这么多人怎么办。
ext.ext_en: The government appears to be in a quandary about what to do with so many people.

defs.def_en: If you are in a quandary, you have to make a decision but cannot decide what to do.

defs.def_cn: （为竞选拉票或个人利益进行的）政治活动

ext.ext_cn: 威斯敏斯特的政治活动异常激烈。
ext.ext_en: The politicking at Westminster is extremely intense.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's political activity as politicking, you think that they are engaged in it to gain votes or personal advantage for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 预计自己在接下来的几周里会丢掉工作的市政工人
ext.ext_en: ...a council workman who expects to lose his job in the next few weeks...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不再期待公司利润会增长。
ext.ext_en: They no longer expect corporate profits to improve...

defs.def_en: If you expect something to happen, you believe that it will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 我正在等几封重要的信件，可是一封都没到。
ext.ext_en: I am expecting several important letters but nothing has arrived...

ext.ext_cn: 我没想到会有人来访。
ext.ext_en: I wasn't expecting a visitor...

defs.def_en: If you are expecting something or someone, you believe that they will be delivered to you or come to you soon, often because this has been arranged earlier.

defs.def_cn: 要求；认为应当得到;指望

ext.ext_cn: 他没有指望我们会盛情款待。
ext.ext_en: He wasn't expecting our hospitality...

ext.ext_cn: 我确实希望晚上能有些属于自己的时间。
ext.ext_en: I do expect to have some time to myself in the evenings...

defs.def_en: If you expect something, or expect a person to do something, you believe that it is your right to have that thing, or the person's duty to do it for you.

ext.ext_cn: 别指望立即治愈。
ext.ext_en: Don't expect an instant cure...

ext.ext_cn: 不要指望你会喜欢所有和你共事的人。
ext.ext_en: You cannot expect to like all the people you will work with...

defs.def_en: If you tell someone not to expect something, you mean that the thing is unlikely to happen as they have planned or imagined, and they should not hope that it will.

ext.ext_cn: 她又怀孕了。
ext.ext_en: She was expecting another baby...

ext.ext_cn: 我听说唐又怀孕了。
ext.ext_en: I hear Dawn's expecting again.

defs.def_en: If you say that a woman is expecting a baby, or that she is expecting, you mean that she is pregnant.

ext.ext_cn: 我想你能猜出接下来发生了什么。
ext.ext_en: I expect you can guess what follows...

ext.ext_cn: 我想你累了。
ext.ext_en: I expect you're tired...

defs.def_en: You say 'I expect' to suggest that a statement is probably correct, or a natural consequence of the present situation, although you have no definite knowledge.

defs.def_cn: 你还想指望什么；那有什么大惊小怪的

ext.ext_cn: 尝起来像是假的，但是就这个价格你还想指望什么？
ext.ext_en: It tastes artificial, but at that price what can you expect?...

ext.ext_cn: 如果一个人打猎而且还有自己的枪，你还想指望什么？
ext.ext_en: If a guy hunts and owns guns, what do you expect?

defs.def_en: You can say 'What can you expect?' or 'What do you expect?' to emphasize that there is nothing surprising about a situation or a person's behaviour, especially if you find this disappointing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 内向的;羞赧的;不爱交际的

ext.ext_cn: 梅琴是个孤僻内向的孩子。
ext.ext_en: Machen was a lonely, introverted child.

defs.def_en: Introverted people are quiet and shy and find it difficult to talk to other people.

ext.ext_cn: 被工党反对派戏称为“不变首相”的男人
ext.ext_en: ...the man whom the Labour opposition dubbed as the 'no change Prime Minister'...

ext.ext_cn: 奥森·韦尔斯把处在事业巅峰的她戏称为“世上最令人兴奋的女人”。
ext.ext_en: At the height of her career, Orson Welles dubbed her 'the most exciting woman in the world'.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is dubbed a particular thing, they are given that description or name.

ext.ext_cn: 它被译制成西班牙语以方便墨西哥观众观看。
ext.ext_en: It was dubbed into Spanish for Mexican audiences.

ext.ext_cn: 配音很差劲的外国电影
ext.ext_en: ...a badly dubbed foreign film.

defs.def_en: If a film or soundtrack in a foreign language is dubbed, a new soundtrack is added with actors giving a translation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 思想贫乏的;空洞的;无知的

ext.ext_cn: 男模特儿并不总像人们说的那样愚蠢。
ext.ext_en: Male models are not always so vacuous as they are made out to be.

ext.ext_cn: 一些千人一面的评论员给出的毫无意义的寻常意见
ext.ext_en: ...the usual vacuous comments by some faceless commentator.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their comments as vacuous, you are critical of them because they lack intelligent thought or ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 他们无所畏惧的勇气
ext.ext_en: ...their dauntless courage.

defs.def_en: A dauntless person is brave and confident and not easily frightened.

ext.ext_cn: 那个小镇位于这里以南 10 英里处。
ext.ext_en: The town lies ten miles to the south of here...

ext.ext_cn: 在他的四周，从东到西，从北向南，苍穹里到处繁星闪闪。
ext.ext_en: All around him, from east to west, north to south, the stars glittered in the heavens.

defs.def_en: The south is the direction which is on your right when you are looking towards the direction where the sun rises.

ext.ext_cn: 在法国南部度过的假日
ext.ext_en: ...holidays in the south of France.

defs.def_en: The south of a place, country, or region is the part which is in the south.

ext.ext_cn: 我们飞快地来了个 180 度的转弯，然后沿着圣米歇尔大道向南疾驰而去。
ext.ext_en: We did an extremely fast U-turn and shot south up the Boulevard St. Michel...

ext.ext_cn: 他南下去爬泰山了，那是中国人心目中一座神圣的山。
ext.ext_en: He went south to climb Taishan, a mountain sacred to the Chinese.

defs.def_en: If you go south, you travel towards the south.

ext.ext_cn: 他们现在拥有并经营着一家位于罗切斯特以南 50 英里处的农场。
ext.ext_en: They now own and operate a farm 50 miles south of Rochester...

ext.ext_cn: 我就住在市场街南边的一座房子里。
ext.ext_en: I was living in a house just south of Market Street.

defs.def_en: Something that is south of a place is positioned to the south of it.

ext.ext_cn: 奥尔德尼岛的南部海岸
ext.ext_en: ...the south coast of Alderney.

defs.def_en: The south edge, corner, or part of a place or country is the part which is towards the south.

defs.def_cn: (用于国家、州或地区等的名称中)南部的

ext.ext_cn: 总统将在下周的 6 天时间内访问南美洲的 5 个国家。
ext.ext_en: Next week the President will visit five South American countries in six days.

ext.ext_cn: 密西西比州与南卡罗来纳州
ext.ext_en: ...the states of Mississippi and South Carolina.

defs.def_en: 'South' is used in the names of some countries, states, and regions in the south of a larger area.
A south wind is a wind that blows from the south.

defs.def_cn: 南方国家(指世界上较贫穷、欠发达的国家)

ext.ext_cn: 这次辩论会将形成北方工业国家与南方发展中国家针锋相对的局面。
ext.ext_en: The debate will pit the industrial North against developing countries in the South.

defs.def_en: The South is used to refer to the poorer, less developed countries of the world.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 狠毒的;恶毒的；存心不良的

ext.ext_cn: 她目光狠毒，唇紧抿。
ext.ext_en: Her stare was malevolent, her mouth a thin line.

defs.def_en: A malevolent person deliberately tries to cause harm or evil.

ext.ext_cn: 那些非常稀奇古怪的事情会唤起人们的记忆。
ext.ext_en: The oddest events will summon up memories.

defs.def_en: If something summons up a memory or thought, it causes it to come to your mind.

defs.def_cn: 工厂直销店;厂家直营店

ext.ext_cn: 欧塞奇比奇有购物中心、工厂直销店以及出售乡村手工艺品和古玩的小店。
ext.ext_en: Osage Beach has shopping centers, factory outlet stores, and small shops with country crafts and antiques.

defs.def_en: A factory outlet is a shop where a factory sells damaged or out-of-date goods directly to customers at reduced prices.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 隐喻的;比喻意义的;象征的

ext.ext_cn: 利维原来说的是一种比喻。
ext.ext_en: It turns out Levy is talking in  metaphorical terms...

ext.ext_cn: 除非可以找到买家，否则这条船也许就像朝着岩石撞过去一样下场悲惨。
ext.ext_en: The ship may be heading for the metaphorical rocks unless a buyer can be found.

defs.def_en: You use the word metaphorical to indicate that you are not using words with their ordinary meaning, but are describing something by means of an image or symbol.

ext.ext_cn: 理查兹声称在一次围攻中他是在佩吉特朝他开火后才进行自卫的。
ext.ext_en: Richards claimed he acted in self-defence after Pagett opened fire on him during a siege.

ext.ext_cn: 空手道或其他形式的防身课程
ext.ext_en: ...courses in karate or some other means of self-defence.

defs.def_en: Self-defence is the use of force to protect yourself against someone who is attacking you.

ext.ext_cn: 开玩笑可以是一种自我保护。
ext.ext_en: Jokes can be a form of self-defence.

defs.def_en: Self-defence is the action of protecting yourself against something bad.

ext.ext_cn: 水面上波光粼粼。
ext.ext_en: The lights shimmered on the water...

ext.ext_cn: 午后的热浪中,树木闪着微光。
ext.ext_en: The trees shimmered in the afternoon heat.

defs.def_en: If something shimmers, it shines with a faint, unsteady light or has an unclear, unsteady appearance.

ext.ext_cn: 他毫不掩饰失望之情。
ext.ext_en: He made no effort to hide his disappointment...

ext.ext_cn: 找到治疗的办法需要大量的时间和精力。
ext.ext_en: Finding a cure requires considerable time and effort.

defs.def_en: If you make an effort to do something, you try very hard to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 她深吸一口气，费力地慢慢坐起身来。
ext.ext_en: She took a deep breath and sat up slowly and with great effort...

ext.ext_cn: 她努力强压住了怒火。
ext.ext_en: With an effort she contained her irritation.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone did something with effort or with an effort, you mean it was difficult for them to do.

defs.def_cn: （为达到某一目的的）有组织的行动，一系列活动

ext.ext_cn: 在安哥拉进行的饥荒救济行动
ext.ext_en: ...a famine relief effort in Angola.

defs.def_en: An effort is a particular series of activities that is organized by a group of people in order to achieve something.

defs.def_cn: 费力的事;困难的事;劳神的事

ext.ext_cn: 在森林中徒步旅行时，即便带的是便携式摄像机也非常费力。
ext.ext_en: Even carrying the camcorder while hiking in the forest was an effort.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is an effort, you mean that an unusual amount of physical or mental energy is needed to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我现在不觉得孤独了，因为我尝试着与人交往。
ext.ext_en: I don't get lonely now because I make the effort to see people.

defs.def_en: If you make the effort to do something, you do it, even though you need extra energy to do it or you do not really want to.

ext.ext_cn: 他全凭超凡的决心和勇气才使自己振作起来。
ext.ext_en: It was only by a supreme effort of will and courage that he was able to pull himself together.

defs.def_en: If you do something difficult or painful by an effort of will, you manage to make yourself do it.

ext.ext_cn: 幸运的是，干清扫落叶这个活儿是值得的。
ext.ext_en: Fortunately, the chore of leaf sweeping is well worth the effort.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is worth the effort, you mean that it will justify the energy that you have spent or will spend on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他出身于一个非常正派的中产阶级家庭。
ext.ext_en: He came from a perfectly respectable middle-class family...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一家非常体面的“老式”旅馆，坐落在离皮卡迪利广场不远的地方。
ext.ext_en: It was a highly respectable and what was called an 'old-fashioned' hotel situated not far from Piccadilly.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is respectable is approved of by society and considered to be morally correct.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 好的;可观的;令人满意的

ext.ext_cn: 回报率可观的投资
ext.ext_en: ...investments that offer respectable rates of return...

ext.ext_cn: 我终于可以穿上体面的衣服了！
ext.ext_en: At last I have something respectable to wear!

defs.def_en: You can say that something is respectable when you mean that it is good enough or acceptable.
Baking soda is the same as bicarbonate of soda .

ext.ext_cn: 沿那一页的中心画一条竖线。
ext.ext_en: Draw a line down that page's  center.

ext.ext_cn: 虚线
ext.ext_en: ...a dotted line...

defs.def_en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

ext.ext_cn: 他宽大的脸盘上布满了深深的皱纹。
ext.ext_en: He has a large, generous face with deep lines.

ext.ext_cn: 细细的皱纹和褶子
ext.ext_en: ...fine lines and wrinkles.

defs.def_en: The lines on some-one's skin, especially on their face, are long thin marks that appear there as they grow older.

ext.ext_cn: 那一排稀稀落落的观众没留意到任何不寻常之处。
ext.ext_en: The sparse line of spectators noticed nothing unusual.

defs.def_en: A line of people or things is a number of them arranged one behind the other or side by side.

defs.def_cn: （人、车辆等在等候时排成的）队，队伍

ext.ext_cn: 紧紧抓着空碗的孩子们排成一队。
ext.ext_en: Children clutching empty bowls form a line...

defs.def_en: A line of people or vehicles is a number of them that are waiting one behind another, for example in order to buy something or to go in a particular direction.

ext.ext_cn: 下一行应该是：5天，23.5小时。
ext.ext_en: The next line should read: Five days, 23.5 hours...

ext.ext_cn: 蒂娜肯定读不过三行。
ext.ext_en: Tina wouldn't have read more than three lines.

defs.def_en: A line of a piece of writing is one of the rows of words, numbers, or other symbols in it.
In school, if a child is given lines, he or she is punished by being made to write out a sentence many times or to write out a passage from a book.

ext.ext_cn: 莎士比亚剧作《奥赛罗》中的一句台词：“一个在恋爱上不智而过于深情的人”
ext.ext_en: ...a line from Shakespeare's Othello: 'one that loved not wisely but too well'...

ext.ext_cn: 每次唱到那一句，我都不得不跟那该死的长号拼声音。
ext.ext_en: Every time I sing that line, I have to compete with that bloody trombone!...

defs.def_en: A line of a poem, song, or play is a group of words that are spoken or sung together. If an actor learns his or her lines for a play or film, they learn what they have to say.

ext.ext_cn: “有一天也许你会再结婚的。”“这句话真中听啊，难得你能这么说！”
ext.ext_en: 'In time perhaps you'll marry again'. 'That's a great line, coming from you!'.

ext.ext_cn: 诸如“你的眼睛很漂亮”之类的搭讪语
ext.ext_en: ...chat-up lines like 'You've got beautiful eyes'.

defs.def_en: A particular type of line in a conversation is a remark that is intended to have a particular effect.

ext.ext_cn: 她把洗好的衣物晾在绳子上。
ext.ext_en: She put her washing on the line.

ext.ext_cn: 一节钓线
ext.ext_en: ...a piece of fishing-line...

defs.def_en: You can refer to a long piece of wire, string, or cable as a line when it is used for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 电话断线了。
ext.ext_en: The telephone lines went dead...

ext.ext_cn: 电话线路不太好。苏珊，我们再打给你好吗？
ext.ext_en: It's not a very good line. Shall we call you back Susan?...

defs.def_en: A line is a connection which makes it possible for two people to speak to each other on the telephone.

ext.ext_cn: 24小时信息热线
ext.ext_en: ...the 24-hours information line.

ext.ext_cn: 女同性恋热线传来的详情
ext.ext_en: ...details from Lesbian Line.

defs.def_en: You can use line to refer to a telephone number which you can ring in order to get information or advice.

defs.def_cn: （尤指危险或秘密的）路线，线路

ext.ext_cn: 美洲大陆的地形严重限制了进攻路线。
ext.ext_en: The American continent's geography severely limited the lines of attack...

ext.ext_cn: 谈判专家说他们保持着沟通渠道的畅通。
ext.ext_en: Negotiators say they're keeping communication lines open.

defs.def_en: A line is a route, especially a dangerous or secret one, along which people move or send messages or supplies.

ext.ext_cn: 沿直线行进。
ext.ext_en: Walk in a straight line...

ext.ext_cn: 机翼与航线成直角。
ext.ext_en: The wings were at right angles to the line of flight.

defs.def_en: The line in which something or someone moves is the particular route that they take, especially when they keep moving straight ahead.

ext.ext_cn: 他们得一直坐到终点站。
ext.ext_en: They've got to ride all the way to the end of the line...

ext.ext_cn: 三个火车站发生了火灾，两条通勤线路的服务被迫中断数小时。
ext.ext_en: Fires broke out at three railway stations, halting service on two commuter lines for several hours...

defs.def_en: A line is a particular route, involving the same stations, roads, or stops along which a train or bus service regularly operates.

ext.ext_cn: 处理铁轨上的落叶对铁路公司而言是一个耗资巨大的工程。
ext.ext_en: Leaves on the line are an expensive problem for the railways.

defs.def_en: A railway line consists of the pieces of metal and wood which form the track that the trains travel along.

ext.ext_cn: 外交部愿意向海运公司支付将该船改道至百慕大的一切费用。
ext.ext_en: The Foreign Office offered to pay the shipping line all the costs of diverting the ship to Bermuda.

defs.def_en: A shipping, air, or bus line is a company which provides services for transporting people or goods by sea, air, or bus.
