ext.ext_en: After a lot of agonizing she decided to terminate the pregnancy...

ext.ext_cn: 从全世界看来，所有怀孕的人中约 10% 的妊娠被终止了。
ext.ext_en: In the world as a whole, about ten per cent of all pregnancies are terminated.

defs.def_en: To terminate a pregnancy means to end it.

ext.ext_cn: 这列火车的终点站是汤顿。
ext.ext_en: This train will terminate at Taunton.

defs.def_en: When a train or bus terminates somewhere, it ends its journey there.

defs.def_cn: (因害怕或信心不足而)回避，躲避，避免做

ext.ext_cn: 我们常常害怕作出决定。
ext.ext_en: We frequently shy away from making decisions...

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦不回避争议。
ext.ext_en: Alan doesn't shy away from controversy.

defs.def_en: If you shy away from doing something, you avoid doing it, often because you are afraid or not confident enough.

ext.ext_cn: 他会把她揽在怀中抚慰她。
ext.ext_en: He would take her in his arms and soothe her...

ext.ext_cn: 中央银行很快便消除了投资者的担忧。
ext.ext_en: It did not take long for the central bank to soothe investors' fears.

defs.def_en: If you soothe someone who is angry or upset, you make them feel calmer.

defs.def_cn: 减轻，缓和(身体的痛处或不适)

ext.ext_cn: 滋润干燥皮肤的润肤液
ext.ext_en: ...body lotion to soothe dry skin.

defs.def_en: Something that soothes a part of your body where there is pain or discomfort makes the pain or discomfort less severe.

defs.def_cn: 传奇的;充满传奇色彩的

ext.ext_cn: 普拉多美术馆充满传奇色彩的艺术藏品属于旅游时的必看之选。
ext.ext_en: You cannot go home without visiting the fabled art collections of the Prado.

ext.ext_cn: 传奇之城特洛伊
ext.ext_en: ...the fabled city of Troy.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or thing as fabled, especially someone or something remarkable, you mean that they are well known because they are often talked about or a lot of stories are told about them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他形容这是自己一生中最可怕的经历。
ext.ext_en: He described it as the most horrendous experience of his life...

ext.ext_cn: 所使用的暴力骇人听闻。
ext.ext_en: The violence used was horrendous.

defs.def_en: Something that is horrendous is very unpleasant or shocking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （数量、程度等）大得惊人的，极其过分的

ext.ext_cn: 如果和他们的固定资产值相比，他们的债务看起来也并不算惊人。
ext.ext_en: Nor do their debts looks so horrendous when related to the value of their fixed assets.

ext.ext_cn: 常常糟糕透顶的交通堵塞
ext.ext_en: ...the usually horrendous traffic jams.

defs.def_en: Some people use horrendous to describe something that is so big or great that they find it extremely unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 比特/秒（计算机数据传输速度的计量单位）

ext.ext_cn: 传输速度为 28,800 比特/秒的调制解调器很可能是你愿意忍受的最低速度的解调器。
ext.ext_en: A minimum 28,800 bps modem is probably the slowest you'll want to put up with.

defs.def_en: bps is a measurement of the speed at which computer data is transferred, for example by a modem. bps is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'bits per second'.

defs.def_cn: 农业综合经营;（尤指）大农场经营

ext.ext_cn: 许多老式的农业合作群体现在正在转型为农业综合经营公司。
ext.ext_en: Many of the old agricultural collectives are now being turned into agribusiness corporations.

defs.def_en: Agribusiness is the various businesses that produce, sell, and distribute farm products, especially on a large scale.

ext.ext_cn: 公司应该将其要求交由仲裁者审核。
ext.ext_en: The company should put its claims up for review by an arbitrator...

ext.ext_cn: 旧的花草水果市场已开始求售了。
ext.ext_en: The old flower and fruit market has been put up for sale...

defs.def_en: If you put something up for sale or auction, for example, you make it available to be sold or auctioned.

ext.ext_cn: 一个小姑娘和她的弟弟在十字路口被车撞成了重伤。
ext.ext_en: A young girl and her little brother were seriously hurt when a car ploughed into them on a crossing.

defs.def_en: If something, for example a car, ploughs into something else, it goes out of control and crashes violently into it.

ext.ext_cn: 巨额私人资本将投入东部处境困难的一些行业。
ext.ext_en: Huge sums of private capital will be ploughed into the ailing industries of the east...

ext.ext_cn: 他声称把所有的钱都投进了自己的古董生意。
ext.ext_en: He claimed he ploughed all his money into his antique business.

defs.def_en: If you say that money is ploughed into something such as a business or a service, you are emphasizing that the amount of money which is invested in it or spent on it in order to improve it is very large.

defs.def_cn: 表面上的；貌似真实的；宣称的

ext.ext_cn: 这些会议声称旨在收集有关金融策略的信息。
ext.ext_en: The ostensible purpose of these meetings was to gather information on financial strategies.

defs.def_en: Ostensible is used to describe something that seems to be true or is officially stated to be true, but about which you or other people have doubts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人惊恐的;令人害怕的;骇人的

ext.ext_cn: 那段经历太恐怖了，他们表现得非常勇敢。
ext.ext_en: It was a very frightening experience and they were very courageous...

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人犯罪的人数多得骇人。
ext.ext_en: The number of youngsters involved in crime is frightening.

defs.def_en: If something is frightening, it makes you feel afraid, anxious, or nervous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 目光短浅的;缺乏远见的

ext.ext_cn: 政府在开支问题上仍然目光短浅。
ext.ext_en: The Government still has a myopic attitude to spending.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as myopic, you are critical of them because they seem unable to realize that their actions might have negative consequences.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If someone is myopic, they are unable to see things which are far away from them.

defs.def_cn: （与名词和形容词连用构成形容词）表示“在…受教育的”，“在…读书的”

ext.ext_cn: 在牛津受过教育的利物浦商人之子
ext.ext_en: ...the Oxford-educated son of a Liverpool merchant.

ext.ext_cn: 在美国接受教育的律师
ext.ext_en: ...an American-educated lawyer.

defs.def_en: -educated combines with nouns and adjectives to form adjectives indicating where someone was educated.

defs.def_cn: （与副词连用构成形容词）表示“受过…教育的”

ext.ext_cn: 很多移民受过良好教育。
ext.ext_en: Many of the immigrants are well-educated.

ext.ext_cn: 穷困潦倒、营养不良、未受过良好教育的工人们
ext.ext_en: ...impoverished, undernourished, and ill-educated workers.

defs.def_en: -educated combines with adverbs to form adjectives indicating how much education someone has had and how good it was.

defs.def_cn: 爱开玩笑的人；逗趣的人

ext.ext_cn: 他天性是个爱开玩笑的人，说话诙谐，很有幽默感。
ext.ext_en: He is, by nature, a joker, a witty man with a sense of fun.

defs.def_en: Someone who is a joker likes making jokes or doing amusing things.
The joker in a pack of playing cards is the card which does not belong to any of the four suits.

defs.def_cn: 愚蠢的人；举止危险的人；小丑

ext.ext_cn: 留神那些活宝，你永远也不知道他们会想出什么样的主意。
ext.ext_en: Keep your eye on these jokers, you never know what they will come up with.

defs.def_en: You can call someone a joker if you think they are behaving in a stupid or dangerous way.

defs.def_cn: 与众不同的人（或事物）；难以捉摸的人（或事物）
defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as the joker in the pack, you mean that they are different from the other people or things in their group, and can be unpredictable.
Leaves is the plural form of leaf, and the third person singular form of leave.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 尼克出现头痛时脾气就变得很差，甚至还会动粗。
ext.ext_en: When his headaches developed Nick became bad-tempered and even violent...

ext.ext_cn: 他们心情很糟，一言不发地走着。
ext.ext_en: They walked in bad-tempered silence.

defs.def_en: Someone who is bad-tempered is not very cheerful and gets angry easily.  →see usage note at:angry
Your torso is the main part of your body, and does not include your head, arms, and legs.

ext.ext_cn: 我们支持要求通过《权利法案》的呼声。
ext.ext_en: We support the call for the enactment of a Bill of Rights.

defs.def_en: The enactment of a law is the process in a parliament or other law-making body by which the law is agreed upon and made official.

ext.ext_cn: 主楼还用于神秘剧的演出。
ext.ext_en: The main building was also used for the enactment of mystery plays.

defs.def_en: The enactment of a play or story is the performance of it by an actor or group of actors.
A transistor is a small electronic part in something such as a television or radio, which controls the flow of electricity.
A transistor or a transistor radio is a small portable radio.

ext.ext_cn: 所有这些破产而不得不变卖家当的农场主
ext.ext_en: ...all these farmers going out of business and having to sell up...

ext.ext_cn: 他建议埃文斯卖掉公寓搬到乡下去住。
ext.ext_en: He advised Evans to sell up his flat and move away to the country.

defs.def_en: If you sell up, you sell everything you have, such as your house or your business, because you need the money.

ext.ext_cn: 到现在，我设法戒烟已快两年了。
ext.ext_en: I've been trying to give up smoking for getting on for two years now...

ext.ext_cn: 快两点钟了。
ext.ext_en: It was getting on for two o'clock.

defs.def_en: Getting on for means the same as nearly .

ext.ext_cn: 竹丛
ext.ext_en: ...a bamboo thicket.

defs.def_en: A thicket is a small group of trees or bushes which are growing closely together.

defs.def_cn: 乱糟糟的一团(思想、事件)

ext.ext_cn: 这本小说纯粹是由一堆文学参考书胡乱拼凑而成。
ext.ext_en: The novel is a thicket of literary references...

ext.ext_cn: 要开一家外资企业就要钻条条框框，没几个出来的。
ext.ext_en: To try to open a foreign-owned business is to enter a thicket of regulations from which few emerge.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a thicket of ideas or events, you mean that there a lot of them together, and often that they are confusing or difficult to identify.

defs.def_cn: (运输大量气体或液体的)巨轮;(尤指)油轮

ext.ext_cn: 一艘希腊油轮搁浅了。
ext.ext_en: A Greek oil tanker has run aground.

defs.def_en: A tanker is a very large ship used for transporting large quantities of gas or liquid, especially oil.

defs.def_cn: 大卡车;铁路罐车;运输机

ext.ext_cn: 在南安普敦以东的 27 号高速公路上发生的一起车祸，其中有一辆油罐车
ext.ext_en: ...an accident involving a petrol tanker on the M27, east of Southampton.

defs.def_en: A tanker is a large truck, railway vehicle, or aircraft used for transporting large quantities of a substance.
On a boat or a ship, the engine room is the place where the engines are.

defs.def_cn: （组织、机构等的）最重要部分，最有影响力部分

ext.ext_cn: 这些公司被认为是英国经济至关重要的组成部分。
ext.ext_en: These firms are regarded as the engine room of the British economy.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as the engine room of an organization or institution, you mean it is the most important or influential part of that organization or institution.

defs.def_cn: 出版者；出版社；出版公司

ext.ext_cn: 出版者计划将该期刊定为周刊。
ext.ext_en: The publishers planned to produce the journal on a weekly basis.

defs.def_en: A publisher is a person or a company that publishes books, newspapers, or magazines.

ext.ext_cn: 煤油炉上的白色搪瓷炖锅
ext.ext_en: ...a white enamel saucepan on the oil stove.

ext.ext_cn: 搪瓷浴缸
ext.ext_en: ...enamel baths.

defs.def_en: Enamel is a substance like glass which can be heated and put onto metal, glass, or pottery in order to decorate or protect it.

defs.def_cn: （尤指用于金属和木材上漆的）瓷漆,瓷釉

ext.ext_cn: 聚合瓷漆
ext.ext_en: ...enamel polymer paints...

ext.ext_cn: 他利用半透明瓷漆绘制出鲜艳生动的图画。
ext.ext_en: He relied on translucent enamels to produce vivid, glowing pictures.

defs.def_en: Enamel is a hard, shiny paint that is used especially for painting metal and wood.
Enamel is the hard white substance that forms the outer part of a tooth.

ext.ext_cn: 房价相对上涨率已经在全国达到平衡。
ext.ext_en: Relative rates of house price inflation have evened out across the country...

ext.ext_cn: 底妆让你的肤色和肤质均匀。
ext.ext_en: Foundation make-up evens out your skin tone and texture.

defs.def_en: If something evens out, or if you even it out, the differences between the different parts of it are reduced.

ext.ext_cn: 在赫伯里兹，剪羊毛的时间比其他任何地方都要晚。
ext.ext_en: In the Hebrides they shear their sheep later than anywhere else.

defs.def_en: To shear a sheep means to cut its wool off.

ext.ext_cn: 用大剪刀修剪灌木丛。
ext.ext_en: Trim the shrubs with shears.

defs.def_en: A pair of shears is a garden tool like a very large pair of scissors. Shears are used especially for cutting hedges.

ext.ext_cn: 羊肠小道变成了宽阔的公路。
ext.ext_en: The trails broadened into roads...

ext.ext_cn: 笑容变得更加灿烂。
ext.ext_en: The smile broadened to a grin.

defs.def_en: When something broadens, it becomes wider.

defs.def_cn: 扩大…的范围；增长，增加（经验、受欢迎程度）

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须进行更广泛的呼吁。
ext.ext_en: We must broaden our appeal...

ext.ext_cn: 我想你是想拓宽自己的视野。
ext.ext_en: I thought you wanted to broaden your horizons...

defs.def_en: When you broaden something such as your experience or popularity or when it broadens, the number of things or people that it includes becomes greater.

ext.ext_cn: 他们说旅行能够开阔心胸。
ext.ext_en: They say that travel broadens the mind.

defs.def_en: If an experience broadens your mind, it makes you more willing to accept other people's beliefs and customs.

ext.ext_cn: 精神分析疗法
ext.ext_en: ...psychoanalytic therapy...

ext.ext_cn: 她的著作中有相当一部分内容是推测性的，建立在精神分析理论之上而缺乏来自实际经验的数据。
ext.ext_en: Much of her work is speculative, based on psychoanalytic theory rather than empirical data.

defs.def_en: Psychoanalytic means relating to psychoanalysis.

defs.def_cn: （通过在他人面前表演将问题表达出来的）心理剧疗法
defs.def_en: Psychodrama is a type of psychotherapy in which people express their problems by acting them out in front of other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 直率的；不客气的；直言不讳的

ext.ext_cn: 她对自己的私生活直言不讳。
ext.ext_en: She is blunt about her personal life...

ext.ext_cn: 她直截了当地告诉业界，这种歧视是完全无法接受的。
ext.ext_en: She told the industry in blunt terms that such discrimination is totally unacceptable.

defs.def_en: If you are blunt, you say exactly what you think without trying to be polite.

ext.ext_cn: 他们中有一个人的头部被钝器击打13次。
ext.ext_en: One of them had been struck 13 times over the head with a blunt object.

defs.def_en: A blunt object has a rounded or flat end rather than a sharp one.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: A blunt knife or blade is no longer sharp and does not cut well.

defs.def_cn: 使（情感、感觉、需求）减弱；使迟钝

ext.ext_cn: 反复出现的暴力事件使人们的反应都变得麻木了。
ext.ext_en: The constant repetition of violence has blunted the human response to it...

ext.ext_cn: 喝啤酒让我们没有了胃口。
ext.ext_en: Our appetite was blunted by the beer.

defs.def_en: If something blunts an emotion, a feeling or a need, it weakens it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (事物或人)奇特的，离奇的，古怪的

ext.ext_cn: 我们因为风格奇特又独具创意而名声在外。
ext.ext_en: We've developed a reputation for being quite quirky and original...

defs.def_en: Something or someone that is quirky is rather odd or unpredictable in their appearance, character, or behaviour.
Palmistry is the practice and art of trying to find out what people are like and what will happen in their future life by examining the lines on the palms of their hands.

defs.def_cn: 开始独立从事新的活动;自立谋生

ext.ext_cn: 她想让我自己闯一闯，买下一个公司。
ext.ext_en: She wanted me to strike out on my own, buy a business.

ext.ext_cn: 想要有所改变并朝新的方向开拓的渴望
ext.ext_en: ...a desire to make changes and to strike out in new directions.

defs.def_en: If you strike out, you begin to do something different, often because you want to become more independent.

ext.ext_cn: 不管什么原因、对任何人，他他似乎总是摆出一副凶相。
ext.ext_en: He seemed always ready to strike out at anyone and for any cause...

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰普顿乱打一通，没有打到沃丁顿却打到了一位老人。
ext.ext_en: Frampton struck out blindly, hitting not Waddington, but an elderly man.

defs.def_en: If you strike out at someone, you hit, attack, or speak angrily to them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们下了车，然后开始沿着泥泞的小路往前走。
ext.ext_en: They left the car and struck out along the muddy track...

ext.ext_cn: 他正打算甩了她，然后一个人前往纽约。
ext.ext_en: He was planning to dump her and strike out for New York alone.

defs.def_en: If you strike out in a particular direction, you start travelling in that direction.

defs.def_cn: (击球手)三击不中出局;使…三振出局

ext.ext_cn: 他使 10 名击球手三振出局，仅让对方两次跑垒得分。
ext.ext_en: He struck out ten batters, and allowed only two runs...

ext.ext_cn: 坎塞科因背部受伤而三振出局。
ext.ext_en: Canseco, nursing a back injury, struck out.

defs.def_en: In baseball, if a pitcher strikes out a batter or if a batter strikes out, the batter fails to hit three balls thrown properly by the pitcher, and is out.

ext.ext_cn: 该律师承认其为该公司的第二任律师。第一任已经干砸了。
ext.ext_en: The lawyer admitted that he was the firm's second lawyer. The first one had struck out completely.

defs.def_en: If someone strikes out, they fail.

ext.ext_cn: 发出遇险信号弹的一艘船
ext.ext_en: ...a ship which had fired a distress flare.

defs.def_en: A flare is a small device that produces a bright flame. Flares are used as signals, for example on ships.

ext.ext_cn: 营火突然熊熊燃烧起来，看上去就像黑暗中的航标灯。
ext.ext_en: Camp fires flared like beacons in the dark.

ext.ext_cn: 不要在烤肉上浇太多的油，会烧起来的。
ext.ext_en: Don't spill too much fat on the barbecue as it could flare up.

defs.def_en: If a fire flares, the flames suddenly become larger.

defs.def_cn: (麻烦、暴乱、冲突等)加剧，升级，愈演愈烈

ext.ext_cn: 尽管总统呼吁保持冷静，美国一些城市的骚乱仍有所升级。
ext.ext_en: Even as the President appealed for calm, trouble flared in several American cities.

ext.ext_cn: 争斗愈演愈烈，数十人受伤。
ext.ext_en: Dozens of people were injured as fighting flared up.

defs.def_en: If something such as trouble, violence, or conflict flares, it starts or becomes more violent.

ext.ext_cn: 怒气突然爆发，人们开始恶言相向。
ext.ext_en: Tempers flared and harsh words were exchanged.

defs.def_en: If people's tempers flare, they get angry.

defs.def_cn: (常因气愤或难过而)张大(鼻孔),(鼻孔)张开

ext.ext_cn: 我转过身厌恶地看着杰基，鼻翼呼呼地翕动着。
ext.ext_en: I turned to Jacky, my nostrils flaring in disgust...

ext.ext_cn: 他伸出舌头，鼻翼扇动着。
ext.ext_en: He stuck out his tongue and flared his nostrils.

defs.def_en: If someone's nostrils flare or if they flare them, their nostrils become wider, often because the person is angry or upset.

defs.def_cn: (连衣裙等)底部展开，呈喇叭形展开

ext.ext_cn: 一条简洁的黑裙，剪裁成从胯部向外展开的式样
ext.ext_en: ...a simple black dress, cut to flare from the hips.

defs.def_en: If something such as a dress flares, it spreads outwards at one end to form a wide shape.
See also:flared;Flares are trousers that are very wide at the bottom.

defs.def_cn: (疾病、伤势)突然复发，突然恶化

ext.ext_cn: 学生们经常发现在考前和考试期间他们的粉刺会严重起来。
ext.ext_en: Students often find that their acne flares up before and during exams.

defs.def_en: See also:flare 2;3;flare-up;If a disease or injury flares up, it suddenly returns or becomes painful again.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人惊骇的；令人震惊的

ext.ext_cn: 结果令人无比震惊。
ext.ext_en: The results are quite astounding.

defs.def_en: If something is astounding, you are shocked or amazed that it could exist or happen.

ext.ext_cn: 两个大的青椒或红椒
ext.ext_en: ...2 large green or red peppers.

ext.ext_cn: 奶酪、生菜和红甜椒丁
ext.ext_en: ...cheese, lettuce and chopped red pepper.

defs.def_en: Red peppers are peppers which are sweet-tasting and can be used in cooking or eaten raw in salads.

ext.ext_cn: 用红辣椒粉调味的油
ext.ext_en: ...oil flavored with hot red peppers.

defs.def_en: Red pepper is a hot-tasting spicy powder made from the flesh and seeds of small, dried, red peppers. It is used for flavouring food.

defs.def_cn: (通常指因生病发烧而)谵妄的，神志不清的，说胡话的

ext.ext_cn: 我神志不清，昏迷了好几次。
ext.ext_en: I was delirious and blacked out several times.

defs.def_en: Someone who is delirious is unable to think or speak in a sensible and reasonable way, usually because they are very ill and have a fever.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 欣喜若狂的;极度兴奋的

ext.ext_cn: 他减税的承诺让亢奋的人群欢呼雀跃起来。
ext.ext_en: His tax-cutting pledge brought a delirious crowd to their feet...

ext.ext_cn: 我欣喜若狂。
ext.ext_en: I was delirious with joy.

defs.def_en: Someone who is delirious is extremely excited and happy.
A cinematographer is a person who decides what filming techniques should be used during the shooting of a film.

defs.def_cn: (用于名词后构成形容词)表示“用…作燃料的”,“烧…的”

ext.ext_cn: 燃煤发电站
ext.ext_en: ...coal-fired power stations...

ext.ext_cn: 大部分食物都是在一口很大的烧柴土灶上烹煮的。
ext.ext_en: Most of the food is cooked on a large wood-fired oven.

defs.def_en: -fired combines with nouns which refer to fuels to form adjectives which describe power stations, machines, or devices that operate by means of that fuel.

defs.def_cn: (使）(死去的动植物)腐烂;（使）分解

ext.ext_cn: 在树林里发现的一具正在腐烂的尸体
ext.ext_en: ...a dead body found decomposing in a wood...

ext.ext_cn: 这些垃圾慢慢地分解成了堆肥。
ext.ext_en: The debris slowly decomposes into compost...

defs.def_en: When things such as dead plants or animals decompose, or when something decomposes them, they change chemically and begin to decay.

ext.ext_cn: 理论物理学
ext.ext_en: ...theoretical physics.

defs.def_en: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles that relate to a particular subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

ext.ext_cn: 从理论上讲，这肯定是有风险的，可是实际上很少出问题。
ext.ext_en: This is certainly a theoretical risk but in practice there is seldom a problem...

ext.ext_cn: 这些担忧纯粹是臆测出来的。
ext.ext_en: These fears are purely theoretical.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as a theoretical one, you mean that although it is supposed to be true or to exist in the way stated, it may not in fact be true or exist in that way.

defs.def_cn: (尤指政治组织或新闻机构的一名)工作人员，职员

ext.ext_cn: 空中新闻电视台主要是由原英国广播公司的新闻工作人员运作的。
ext.ext_en: The Sky News TV station is largely run by ex-BBC news staffers.

defs.def_en: A staffer is a member of staff, especially in political organizations or in journalism.

ext.ext_cn: 闭上你的嘴。
ext.ext_en: Shut your gob.

defs.def_en: A person's gob is their mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 一口唾沫
ext.ext_en: ...a gob of spit.

defs.def_en: A gob of a thick, unpleasant liquid is a small amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 在利兹举办的一场演唱会上，一些小流氓朝他们吐口水，扔啤酒罐。
ext.ext_en: At a concert in Leeds, some punks gobbed at them and threw beer cans.

defs.def_en: If someone gobs, they spit .

ext.ext_cn: 一块冰
ext.ext_en: ...a gob of ice.

defs.def_en: A gob of something is a lump of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们从多方渠道得到信息。
ext.ext_en: We're  getting input from gobs of sources.

defs.def_en: Gobs of something means a lot of it.

defs.def_cn: 不能根除的;根深蒂固的

ext.ext_cn: 童年早期的情感创伤留下了难以抚平的伤痕。
ext.ext_en: The emotional wounds of early childhood leave ineradicable scars...

ext.ext_cn: 离婚在现代生活中一直存在、无法改变。
ext.ext_en: Divorce is a permanent, ineradicable fact of modern life.

defs.def_en: You use ineradicable to emphasize that a quality, fact, or situation is permanent and cannot be changed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她种了很多我不熟悉的奇妙植物。
ext.ext_en: She grew many wonderful plants that were unfamiliar to me...

ext.ext_cn: 我在一个陌生的城市里形单影只。
ext.ext_en: I was alone in an unfamiliar city.

defs.def_en: If something is unfamiliar to you, you know nothing or very little about it, because you have not seen or experienced it before.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她不会说日语，也不了解日本文化。
ext.ext_en: She speaks no Japanese and is unfamiliar with Japanese culture.

defs.def_en: If you are unfamiliar with something, it is unfamiliar to you.

ext.ext_cn: 战事爆发之后，他回到英格兰参军了。
ext.ext_en: When hostilities broke out he returned to England and joined up.

defs.def_en: If someone joins up, they become a member of the army, the navy, or the air force.

ext.ext_cn: 霍金斯在马拉加和米克会合，然后两个人到乡间游玩去了。
ext.ext_en: Hawkins joined up with Mick in Malaga, and the two went touring around the countryside...

ext.ext_cn: 这些委员会将与欧洲的委员会结成联盟。
ext.ext_en: Councils are joining up with their European counterparts...

defs.def_en: If one person or organization joins up with another, they start doing something together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 敷衍的；潦草的；马马虎虎的

ext.ext_cn: 她马马虎虎地扫了一眼清单。
ext.ext_en: She gave the list only a perfunctory glance...

ext.ext_cn: 漫不经心的握手
ext.ext_en: ...a perfunctory handshake...

defs.def_en: A perfunctory action is done quickly and carelessly, and shows a lack of interest in what you are doing.

ext.ext_cn: 我要找妈妈。
ext.ext_en: I want my mummy...

ext.ext_cn: 妈妈，我累了。
ext.ext_en: Mummy, I'm tired!...

defs.def_en: Some people, especially young children, call their mother mummy .

ext.ext_cn: 埃及木乃伊
ext.ext_en: ...an Egyptian mummy.

defs.def_en: A mummy is a dead body which was preserved long ago by being rubbed with special oils and wrapped in cloth.

defs.def_cn: （表示强烈的反应或引出评论）哇，啊，哎呀

ext.ext_cn: 啊，他们玩个没完没了，他们很喜欢这个晚会。
ext.ext_en: Gee whiz, they carried on and on, they loved the evening.

defs.def_en: People sometimes say gee whiz in order to express a strong reaction to something or to introduce a remark or response.

defs.def_cn: 新奇的；过于复杂的；招眼的

ext.ext_cn: 现在的趋势是追求“有品位”的电子产品——人们渴望拥有那些黑色锃亮、非常炫丽的东西。
ext.ext_en: The trend now is towards 'lifestyle' electronics — black, shiny gee-whiz things that people like to own.

defs.def_en: You use gee whiz to describe something that is new, exciting, and impressive, but that is perhaps more complicated or showy than it needs to be.

ext.ext_cn: 罗杰厌恶地看着她。
ext.ext_en: Roger looked at her with distaste...

ext.ext_cn: 他声称厌恶与金钱有关的一切。
ext.ext_en: He professed a distaste for everything related to money.

defs.def_en: If you feel distaste for someone or something, you dislike them and consider them to be unpleasant, disgusting, or immoral.

defs.def_cn: （色彩）艳丽地，强烈地;（味道、香味）浓郁地

ext.ext_cn: 各种色彩艳丽的织物的华美展示
ext.ext_en: ...an opulent display of richly coloured fabrics.

ext.ext_cn: 该地区风味浓郁、品种丰盛的食物
ext.ext_en: ...the richly flavoured, hearty foods of the region.

defs.def_en: If something is richly coloured, flavoured, or perfumed, it has a pleasantly strong colour, flavour, or perfume.

ext.ext_cn: 咖啡在装饰精美的银壶中冒着热气。
ext.ext_en: Coffee steamed in the richly decorated silver pot.

ext.ext_cn: 对伊斯兰国家艺术的配有精美插图的介绍
ext.ext_en: ...a richly illustrated introduction to the art of the Islamic world.

defs.def_en: If something is richly decorated, patterned, or furnished, it has a lot of elaborate and beautiful decoration, patterns, or furniture.

ext.ext_cn: 他取得了自己完全应得的成功。
ext.ext_en: He achieved the success he so richly deserved.

ext.ext_cn: 让他理所当然地获得了奥斯卡奖的那感人至深的表演
ext.ext_en: ...a deeply affecting performance that won him a richly deserved Oscar.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone richly deserves an award, success, or victory, you approve of what they have done and feel very strongly that they deserve it.

ext.ext_cn: 一个充满勇气的男孩
ext.ext_en: ...a boy richly endowed with courage...

ext.ext_cn: 手上布满了神经末梢。
ext.ext_en: The hands are richly supplied with nerve endings.

defs.def_en: If a person or place is richly endowed or supplied with something, they have a lot of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这本书很难读懂，但是非常值得一读。
ext.ext_en: It is a difficult book to read, but it richly rewards the effort...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的谨慎得到了很好的回报。
ext.ext_en: Their caution has been richly rewarded.

defs.def_en: If you are richly rewarded for doing something, you get something very valuable or pleasant in return for doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 我面前的一个牌子上写着：扣好安全带。这是法律规定。
ext.ext_en: A sign just ahead of me said, Buckle Up. It's the Law.

defs.def_en: When you buckle up in a car or a plane, you fasten your seat belt.

ext.ext_cn: 在老情歌中June总是和moon成韵。
ext.ext_en: June always rhymes with moon in old love songs.

ext.ext_cn: 给孩子取Donnie, Ronnie, Connie之类押韵的名字的父母
ext.ext_en: ...the sort of people who give their children names that rhyme: Donnie, Ronnie, Connie.

defs.def_en: If one word rhymes with another or if two words rhyme, they have a very similar sound. Words that rhyme with each other are often used in poems.

ext.ext_cn: 为了押韵，他似乎选择了脑海里出现的第一个词。
ext.ext_en: In his efforts to make it rhyme he seems to have chosen the first word that comes into his head.

ext.ext_cn: 押韵的对句
ext.ext_en: ...rhyming couplets.

defs.def_en: If a poem or song rhymes, the lines end with words that have very similar sounds.

defs.def_cn: 押韵词;同韵词;押韵的诗行

ext.ext_cn: 和passion押韵的词是fashion。
ext.ext_en: The one rhyme for passion is fashion...

ext.ext_cn: 歌词平淡老套，押韵生硬蹩脚。
ext.ext_en: The lyrics are banal and the rhymes clumsy.

defs.def_en: A rhyme is a word which rhymes with another word, or a set of lines which rhyme.

ext.ext_cn: 他当时正教海伦一首押韵小诗。
ext.ext_en: He was teaching Helen a little rhyme.

defs.def_en: See also:nursery rhyme;A rhyme is a short poem which has rhyming words at the ends of its lines.

ext.ext_cn: 波特遵循押韵的规则。
ext.ext_en: Porter stayed within the rules of rhyme...

ext.ext_cn: 这些剧本以韵文写成。
ext.ext_en: The plays are in rhyme.

defs.def_en: Rhyme is the use of rhyming words as a technique in poetry. If something is written in rhyme, it is written as a poem in which the lines rhyme.

defs.def_cn: 莫名其妙;无缘无故;毫无道理

ext.ext_cn: 他选人时总是随心所欲，毫无根据。
ext.ext_en: He picked people on a whim, without rhyme or reason.

defs.def_en: If something happens or is done without rhyme or reason, there seems to be no logical reason for it to happen or be done.

ext.ext_cn: 一个粗率强硬的人,出了名的性子直,脾气急
ext.ext_en: ...a brash, forceful man, noted both for his candour and his quick temper.

defs.def_en: Candour is the quality of speaking honestly and openly about things.

defs.def_cn: （过去狩猎或打高尔夫球时穿的）宽大运动裤，灯笼裤
defs.def_en: Plus-fours are short wide trousers fastened below the knees which people used to wear when hunting or playing golf.

In grammar, a question tag is a very short clause at the end of a statement which changes the statement into a question. For example, in 'She said half price, didn't she?', the words 'didn't she' are a question tag.

defs.def_cn: 大乐队（尤指流行于20世纪30至50年代的大型爵士乐队或伴舞乐队）
defs.def_en: A big band is a large group of musicians who play jazz or dance music. Big bands were especially popular from the 1930s to the 1950s.
Rubbing alcohol is a liquid which is used to clean wounds or surgical instruments.

ext.ext_cn: 他清楚地表明自己坚决支持拉夫桑贾尼总统。
ext.ext_en: He clearly and decisively came down on the side of President Rafsanjani.

defs.def_en: If you come down on one side of an argument, you declare that you support that side.

ext.ext_cn: 如果道格拉斯对戴尔太过严厉，他就会反抗。
ext.ext_en: If Douglas came down hard enough on him, Dale would rebel.

defs.def_en: If you come down on someone, you criticize them severely or treat them strictly.
Webbed feet or toes have a piece of skin between the toes. Water birds such as ducks have webbed feet.
DC is used to refer to an electric current that always flows in the same direction. DC is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'direct current'.

ext.ext_cn: 我想若是我不给他打电话，你就会一直威吓我。
ext.ext_en: I suppose you'll hector me until I phone him.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is hectoring you, you do not like the way they are trying to make you do something by bothering you and talking to you aggressively.

defs.def_cn: 特定时刻；（尤指）当口，重要关头

ext.ext_cn: 在这个关键时刻，最重要的是这3个共和国的合作能力。
ext.ext_en: What's important at this juncture is the ability of the three republics to work together...

ext.ext_cn: 就他的国内计划而言，我们正处于一个紧要的关口。
ext.ext_en: We're at a critical juncture in terms of his domestic program.

defs.def_en: At a particular juncture means at a particular point in time, especially when it is a very important time in a process or series of events.

defs.def_cn: (松鸡或山鹑的)一小群，一小窝
defs.def_en: A covey of grouse or partridges is a small group of them.
Convolutions are curves on an object or design that has a lot of curves.

ext.ext_cn: 困难重重、百转千回的爱情
ext.ext_en: ...the thorny convolutions of love.

defs.def_en: You can use convolutions to refer to a situation that is very complicated.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人）公平的，明智的，理智的，有判断力的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个理智的家伙。
ext.ext_en: He's a reasonable sort of chap...

ext.ext_cn: 噢，好了，理智一点。
ext.ext_en: Oh, come on, be reasonable.

defs.def_en: If you think that someone is fair and sensible you can say that they are reasonable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 完全合理的决定
ext.ext_en: ...a perfectly reasonable decision...

ext.ext_cn: 那时他的所作所为似乎很合理。
ext.ext_en: At the time, what he'd done had seemed reasonable.

defs.def_en: If you say that a decision or action is reasonable, you mean that it is fair and sensible.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （期望或解释）合理的，有道理的

ext.ext_cn: 似乎有理由期望城市快速发展。
ext.ext_en: It seems reasonable to expect rapid urban growth.

defs.def_en: If you say that an expectation or explanation is reasonable, you mean that there are good reasons why it may be correct.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （价钱）合理的，公道的，不太贵的

ext.ext_cn: 你花不多的钱就可以吃一顿很特别的饭。
ext.ext_en: You get an interesting meal for a reasonable price...

ext.ext_cn: 他的收费还挺合理。
ext.ext_en: His fees were quite reasonable.

defs.def_en: If you say that the price of something is reasonable, you mean that it is fair and not too high.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个男孩用还算流利的法语回答他。
ext.ext_en: The boy answered him in reasonable French...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直没能靠写作过上舒适的生活。
ext.ext_en: He had never been able to make a reasonable living from his writing.

defs.def_en: You can use reasonable to describe something that is fairly good, but not very good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们将需要一个面积较大的摆放办公桌的地方和充足的照明。
ext.ext_en: They will need a reasonable amount of desk area and good light.

defs.def_en: A reasonable amount of something is a fairly large amount of it.

defs.def_cn: 摩尔人的(公元8至15世纪在北非和西班牙具有伊斯兰教文明特点的)

ext.ext_cn: 中世纪摩尔人的宫殿
ext.ext_en: ...a medieval Moorish palace.

defs.def_en: Something that is Moorish belongs to or is characteristic of the Muslim civilization in North Africa and Spain between the 8th and the 15th century A.D.

ext.ext_cn: 他听到前门门铃在响。
ext.ext_en: He heard the front doorbell chime.

ext.ext_cn: 市政厅的大钟敲响3点的时候
ext.ext_en: ...as the Guildhall clock chimed three o'clock.

defs.def_en: When a bell or a clock chimes, it makes ringing sounds.

ext.ext_cn: 就在那时，房前传来一声铃。
ext.ext_en: At that moment a chime sounded from the front of the house...

ext.ext_cn: 子夜钟声响起的时候，仪式开始了。
ext.ext_en: The ceremony started as the chimes of midnight struck.

defs.def_en: A chime is a ringing sound made by a bell, especially when it is part of a clock.

ext.ext_cn: 萦绕心头的风铃声
ext.ext_en: ...the haunting sound of the wind chimes.

defs.def_en: Chimes are a set of small objects which make a ringing sound when they are blown by the wind.

defs.def_cn: 获特许权的人;特许经营人(或公司)
defs.def_en: A franchisee is a person or group of people who buy a particular franchise.

defs.def_cn: （尤指养牛、马、羊等的）农场经营，牧场经营
defs.def_en: Ranching is the activity of running a large farm, especially one used for raising cattle, horses, or sheep.

ext.ext_cn: 联邦以 492 票对 391 票的投票结果决定维持现状。
ext.ext_en: By 492 votes to 391, the federation voted to maintain the status quo...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不想改变现状。
ext.ext_en: They have no wish for any change in the status quo...

defs.def_en: The status quo is the state of affairs that exists at a particular time, especially in contrast to a different possible state of affairs.

defs.def_cn: (用于名词之前构成度量单位)表示“毫”，“千分之一”

ext.ext_cn: 5毫安左右的弱电流
ext.ext_en: ...a small current, around 5 milliamps.

defs.def_en: Milli- is added to some nouns that refer to units of measurement in order to form other nouns referring to units a thousand times smaller.

ext.ext_cn: 亚利桑那州的医生称他们已经把一颗人造心脏移植到一名 46 岁妇女的体内。
ext.ext_en: Doctors in Arizona say they have implanted an artificial heart into a 46-year-old woman...

ext.ext_cn: 两天以后,他们把受精卵重新植入了我的体内。
ext.ext_en: Two days later, they implanted the fertilized eggs back inside me.

defs.def_en: To implant something into a person's body means to put it there, usually by means of a medical operation.

ext.ext_cn: 女人可以选择进行隆胸。
ext.ext_en: A woman can choose to have breast implants.

defs.def_en: An implant is something that is implanted into a person's body.

ext.ext_cn: 非同卵双生子是两个受精卵同时在子宫内着床的结果。
ext.ext_en: Non-identical twins are the result of two fertilised eggs implanting in the uterus at the same time.

defs.def_en: When an egg or embryo implants in the womb, it becomes established there and can then develop.

ext.ext_cn: 那场演讲给他们灌输了一种很危险的偏见。
ext.ext_en: The speech implanted a dangerous prejudice in their minds...

ext.ext_cn: 格雷戈里的父亲早就向他灌输了要接受教育的志向。
ext.ext_en: Gregory's father had implanted in him an ambition to obtain an education...

defs.def_en: If you implant an idea or attitude in people, you make it become accepted or believed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (组织或体系)庞大而僵化的，单一的

ext.ext_cn: 庞大僵化的独裁体制
ext.ext_en: ...an authoritarian and monolithic system.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an organization or system as monolithic, you are critical of it because it is very large and very slow to change, and does not seem to have different parts with different characters.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 庞大而无特点的;巨大而单调的

ext.ext_cn: 毫无特色的庞大混凝土建筑
ext.ext_en: ...a huge monolithic concrete building.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a building as monolithic, you do not like it because it is very large and plain with no character.

ext.ext_cn: 一杯啤酒表面的啤酒沫
ext.ext_en: ...the froth of bubbles on the top of a glass of beer...

ext.ext_cn: 泡沫给吹开了。
ext.ext_en: The froth is blown away.

defs.def_en: Froth is a mass of small bubbles on the surface of a liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 海水在我的脚上泛起泡沫。
ext.ext_en: The sea froths over my feet...

ext.ext_cn: 加一点温牛奶，并让它起点儿沫。
ext.ext_en: Add a little of the warmed milk and allow to froth a little.

defs.def_en: If a liquid froths, small bubbles appear on its surface.

defs.def_cn: (因非常愤怒或激动而)嘴喷唾沫，口吐白沫

ext.ext_cn: “不！不！绝不!”他气得口吐白沫。
ext.ext_en: 'No! No! Never!' he froths...

ext.ext_cn: 这篇报道包含了众多元素，任何一个新闻编辑都会激动得嘴上唾沫横飞。
ext.ext_en: This story has many ingredients which make any news editor froth at the mouth with excitement.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is frothing, or that they are frothing at the mouth, you are emphasizing that they are very angry or excited about something.

defs.def_cn: 迷人但没有实际价值的事物;虚浮的东西

ext.ext_cn: 根本没有任何实质，只是一些虚浮的东西。
ext.ext_en: No substance at all, just froth...

ext.ext_cn: 初恋完全是一场虚幻的美梦。
ext.ext_en: Falling in love the first time is all froth and fantasy.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an activity or object as froth, you disapprove of it because it appears exciting or attractive, but has very little real value or importance.

ext.ext_cn: 最近的一次盖洛普民意测验披露，2,000 万美国人声称他们有过濒死体验。
ext.ext_en: A recent Gallup poll revealed that 20 million Americans claimed to have had near-death experiences.

defs.def_en: A near-death experience is a strange experience that some people who have nearly died say they had when they were unconscious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们的通讯系统效率非常差。
ext.ext_en: Their communication systems are inefficient in the extreme.

ext.ext_cn: 设备陈旧、效率低下的工厂的关闭
ext.ext_en: ...the closure of outdated and inefficient factories.

defs.def_en: Inefficient people, organizations, systems, or machines do not use time, energy, or other resources in the best way.
A conger or a conger eel is a large fish that looks like a snake.

defs.def_cn: 部分地；不完全地；在某种程度上

ext.ext_cn: 这在一定程度上是我的错。
ext.ext_en: It's partly my fault...

ext.ext_cn: 他长叹一口气，主要是因为如释重负，也有一部分是因为伤心。
ext.ext_en: He let out a long sigh, mainly of relief, partly of sadness...

defs.def_en: You use partly to indicate that something happens or exists to some extent, but not completely.

ext.ext_cn: 她目前正专注于服装设计师的工作。
ext.ext_en: She is now concentrating on a career as a fashion designer...

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼斯最近开始从事歌剧指挥的工作,并且非常成功。
ext.ext_en: Dennis had recently begun a successful career conducting opera.

defs.def_en: A career is the job or profession that someone does for a long period of their life.

ext.ext_cn: 在他的创作生涯中,他写下了50多部剧本。
ext.ext_en: During his career, he wrote more than fifty plays...

ext.ext_cn: 她开始了自己的教师生涯。
ext.ext_en: She began her career as a teacher.

defs.def_en: Your career is the part of your life that you spend working.

ext.ext_cn: 她年轻时基本没有接受过就业指导。
ext.ext_en: She received very little careers guidance when young...

ext.ext_cn: 到就业指导处领取企业名录。
ext.ext_en: Get hold of the company list from your careers advisory service.

defs.def_en: Careers advice or guidance in British English, or career advice or guidance in American English, consists of information about different jobs and help with deciding what kind of job you want to do.

ext.ext_cn: 他的车一头冲入河里。
ext.ext_en: His car careered into a river...

ext.ext_cn: 他控制不住，冲出了赛道。
ext.ext_en: He went careering off down the track.

defs.def_en: If a person or vehicle careers somewhere, they move fast and in an uncontrolled way.

ext.ext_cn: 最终被军队严厉镇压的反政府动乱
ext.ext_en: ...anti-government unrest that ended with the violent army crackdown.

defs.def_en: A crackdown is strong official action that is taken to punish people who break laws.

ext.ext_cn: 政府严厉镇压了那些发起运动争取更广泛民主的人士。
ext.ext_en: The government has cracked down hard on those campaigning for greater democracy...

ext.ext_cn: 最近有很多人喝酒。我们现在要开始严惩。抓住一个解雇一个。
ext.ext_en: There has been a lot of drinking. We are cracking down now. Anyone who gets caught is fired.

defs.def_en: See also:crackdown;If people in authority crack down on a group of people, they become stricter in making the group obey rules or laws.
Something that is electric blue is very bright blue in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 对雇用非法移民的打击
ext.ext_en: ...a clampdown on the employment of illegal immigrants...

ext.ext_cn: 让人哭笑不得的是，最近的制裁结果只是导致新一波国际社会的批评。
ext.ext_en: Ironically, the latest clamp-down has just led to renewed international criticism.

defs.def_en: A clampdown is a sudden restriction on a particular activity by a government or other authority.

ext.ext_cn: 他梦见了克莱尔。
ext.ext_en: He had a dream about Claire...

ext.ext_cn: 我梦见我在一间古老的书房里,四周全是皮装书。
ext.ext_en: I had a dream that I was in an old study, surrounded by leather books.

defs.def_en: A dream is an imaginary series of events that you experience in your mind while you are asleep.

ext.ext_cn: 艾弗梦见他在一辆公共汽车上。
ext.ext_en: Ivor dreamed that he was on a bus...

ext.ext_cn: 她梦见了她的宝宝。
ext.ext_en: She dreamed about her baby.

defs.def_en: When you dream, you experience imaginary events in your mind while you are asleep.

ext.ext_cn: 他最终实现了成为一名飞行员的梦想。
ext.ext_en: He had finally accomplished his dream of becoming a pilot...

ext.ext_cn: 我梦想在乡间拥有一栋房子。
ext.ext_en: My dream is to have a house in the country...

defs.def_en: You can refer to a situation or event as a dream if you often think about it because you would like it to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 她上学时曾梦想成为一名女演员。
ext.ext_en: As a schoolgirl, she had dreamed of becoming an actress...

ext.ext_cn: 对我们大多数人来说,一间崭新的由著名设计师设计的厨房只能是一种梦想。
ext.ext_en: For most of us, a brand new designer kitchen is something we can only dream about...

defs.def_en: If you often think about something that you would very much like to happen or have, you can say that you dream of it.

defs.def_cn: 理想的;梦幻般的;完美的

ext.ext_cn: 他在布尔河畔建造了他的梦幻屋。
ext.ext_en: He had his dream house built on the banks of the river Bure.

ext.ext_cn: 牙买加梦幻之旅
ext.ext_en: ...a dream holiday to Jamaica.

defs.def_en: You can use dream to describe something that you think is ideal or perfect, especially if it is something that you thought you would never be able to have or experience.

defs.def_cn: 理想;夙愿;梦寐以求的事物

ext.ext_cn: 据说希腊是植物学家梦寐以求的地方。
ext.ext_en: Greece is said to be a botanist's dream...

ext.ext_cn: 他是所有姑娘的梦中情人！
ext.ext_en: He's every girl's dream!

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a particular person's dream, you think that it would be ideal for that person and that he or she would like it very much.
If you say that something is a dream, you mean that it is wonderful.

ext.ext_cn: 当有合适的女人出现时,这种胡思乱想就会停止了。
ext.ext_en: When the right woman comes along, this bad dream will be over.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a situation or event that does not seem real as a dream, especially if it is very strange or unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 我绝不会取笑你。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't dream of making fun of you...

ext.ext_cn: 我的几个儿子从不指望别人帮他们熨好衣服。
ext.ext_en: My sons would never dream of expecting their clothes to be ironed.

defs.def_en: If you say that you would not dream of doing something, you are emphasizing that you would never do it because you think it is wrong or is not possible or suitable for you.

ext.ext_cn: 我从没想到我在这儿能买得起房子。
ext.ext_en: I never dreamed that I would be able to afford a home here...

ext.ext_cn: 谁能想到会发生这样的灾难？
ext.ext_en: Who could ever dream of a disaster like this?...

defs.def_en: If you say that you never dreamed that something would happen, you are emphasizing that you did not think that it would happen because it seemed very unlikely.

ext.ext_cn: “也许有一天我可以享受一个放松身心的假期。”——“是啊,你就做梦吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'Perhaps one day I may go on a relaxing holiday.' — 'Yeah, dream on.'

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to dream on, you mean that something they are hoping for is unlikely to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 整整一天我都心不在焉。
ext.ext_en: All day long I moved in a dream.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are in a dream, you mean that you do not concentrate properly on what you are doing because you are thinking about other things.

defs.def_cn: 梦幻般地;美妙地;完美地

ext.ext_cn: 她烹饪技艺精湛。
ext.ext_en: She cooked like a dream...

ext.ext_cn: 他的船行驶十分顺畅。
ext.ext_en: His ship had sailed like a dream.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something like a dream, you think that they do it very well. If you say that something happens like a dream, you mean that it happens successfully without any problems.

ext.ext_cn: 这就是我理想中的男子。
ext.ext_en: This could be the man of my dreams.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as the person or thing of your dreams, you mean that you consider them to be ideal or perfect.

defs.def_cn: （强调极为奇怪或完全不可能）再怎么想也

ext.ext_cn: 我做梦也没想到我们会赢。
ext.ext_en: Never in my wildest dreams did I think we could win.

defs.def_en: If you say that you could not imagine a particular thing in your wildest dreams, you are emphasizing that you think it is extremely strange or unlikely.

defs.def_cn: 超出想象的;比希望中要好的

ext.ext_cn: 她已经取得超乎想象的成功。
ext.ext_en: She had already achieved success beyond her wildest dreams.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as being beyond your wildest dreams, you are emphasizing that it is better than you could have imagined or hoped for.

defs.def_cn: 印刷版面式样;排版式样；印刷格式
defs.def_en: Typography is the way in which written material is arranged and prepared for printing.

defs.def_cn: （员工每周有一天去大学学习与工作有关的科目的）脱产学习制，在职进修制
defs.def_en: Day release is a system in which workers spend one day each week at a college in order to study a subject connected with their work.

The IMF is an international agency which tries to promote trade and improve economic conditions in poorer countries, sometimes by lending them money. IMF is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'International Monetary Fund'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 夸大的;夸张的;言过其实的

ext.ext_cn: 对于那些课程能够取得何等成果的夸大宣传，他们应该持怀疑态度。
ext.ext_en: They should be sceptical of exaggerated claims for what such courses can achieve...

ext.ext_cn: 他坚持说，西方的恐惧被过分夸大了。
ext.ext_en: Western fears, he insists, are greatly exaggerated.

defs.def_en: Something that is exaggerated is or seems larger, better, worse, or more important than it actually needs to be.

ext.ext_cn: 那箱文件一直藏在家中的地窖里。
ext.ext_en: The box of papers had been stored in a cellar at the family home.

defs.def_en: A cellar is a room underneath a building, which is often used for storing things in.

ext.ext_cn: 饭店藏酒品种繁多的酒窖
ext.ext_en: ...the restaurant's extensive wine cellar.

defs.def_en: A person's or restaurant's cellar is the collection of different wines that they have.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人困惑的；令人不知所措的；让人晕头转向的

ext.ext_cn: 看一眼他的书架就知道他兴趣繁杂。
ext.ext_en: A glance along his bookshelves reveals a bewildering array of interests...

ext.ext_cn: 各种各样可供选择的远足项目让人眼花缭乱。
ext.ext_en: The choice of excursions was bewildering.

defs.def_en: A bewildering thing or situation is very confusing and difficult to understand or to make a decision about.

ext.ext_cn: 按顺时针方向转动头部，然后再逆时针旋转。
ext.ext_en: Rotate the head clockwise and counterclockwise.

ext.ext_cn: 这支舞是按逆时针方向跳的。
ext.ext_en: The dance moves in a counter-clockwise direction.

defs.def_en: If something is moving counterclockwise, it is moving in the opposite direction to the direction in which the hands of a clock move.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这条消息让整个国家陷入躁动不安的状态中。
ext.ext_en: The news plunged the nation into a febrile, agitated state.

defs.def_en: Febrile behaviour is intensely and nervously active.
Someone's stepson is a son born to their husband or wife during a previous relationship.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数哮喘或肺炎患者无需住院。
ext.ext_en: Most people do not have to be hospitalized for asthma or pneumonia.

defs.def_en: If someone is hospitalized, they are sent or admitted to hospital.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一个胖胖的中年男人
ext.ext_en: ...a portly middle-aged man.

defs.def_en: A portly person, especially a man, is rather fat.

ext.ext_cn: 事实已经很清楚，这件事不是偶发的，它并不是一起孤立的事件。
ext.ext_en: It became very clear that the incident was not just an aberration, it was not just a single incident.

defs.def_en: An aberration is an incident or way of behaving that is not typical.

defs.def_cn: 不正常的怪人；异常行为

ext.ext_cn: 独身者被当成异类，而且要付一笔额外的费用。
ext.ext_en: Single people are treated as an aberration and made to pay a supplement.

ext.ext_cn: 性变态
ext.ext_en: ...sexual aberration.

defs.def_en: If someone considers a person or their behaviour to be an aberration, they think that they are strange and not socially acceptable.

defs.def_cn: 职业选手和业余选手混合赛

ext.ext_cn: 一场职业选手和业余选手混赛的高尔夫赞助联赛
ext.ext_en: ...a sponsored pro-am golf tournament.

defs.def_en: A pro-am is a sports competition in which professional and amateur players compete together.
A punch-drunk boxer shows signs of brain damage, for example by being unsteady and unable to think clearly, after being hit too often on the head.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 精疲力竭的；头昏脑涨的

ext.ext_cn: 他疲惫不堪，头昏沉沉的，因为下雨情绪也很低落。
ext.ext_en: He was punch-drunk with fatigue and depressed by the rain.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is punch-drunk, you mean that they are very tired or confused, for example because they have been working too hard.

ext.ext_cn: 在夏季学期，我们会在村里的空地上打板球。
ext.ext_en: During the summer term we would play cricket at the village ground.

ext.ext_cn: 约克郡板球俱乐部
ext.ext_en: ...the Yorkshire County Cricket Club.

defs.def_en: Cricket is an  outdoor game played between two teams. Players try to score points, called runs, by hitting a ball with a wooden bat.

defs.def_cn: 不公正;不光明正大;不光彩

ext.ext_cn: 他们对待员工的方式绝对不公正。
ext.ext_en: Their treatment of staff is definitely not cricket.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's behaviour is not cricket, you mean that they have not behaved fairly.
A cricket is a small jumping insect that produces short, loud sounds by rubbing its wings together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个计划东拼西凑，毫无意义。
ext.ext_en: The programme was bitty and pointless.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is bitty, you mean that it seems to be formed from a lot of different parts which you think do not fit together or go together well.

ext.ext_cn: 她是一个很纤弱的小女孩。
ext.ext_en: She's just a little bitty wisp of a girl.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as a little bitty person or thing, you are emphasizing that they are very small.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (地方)景色优美的，风景秀丽的

ext.ext_cn: 这是美国风景非常秀丽的一个地区。
ext.ext_en: This is an extremely scenic part of America.

ext.ext_cn: 穿越景色优美的乡间的两个小时车程
ext.ext_en: ...a 2-hour drive through scenic country.

defs.def_en: A scenic place has attractive scenery.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 它甚至还作为观光路线标在了地图上。
ext.ext_en: It was even marked on the map as a scenic route...

ext.ext_cn: 我绕行了几英里，想要经由那条风景秀丽的公路进入梅肯。
ext.ext_en: I went some miles out of my way to take the scenic road into Macon.

defs.def_en: A scenic route goes through attractive scenery and has nice views.

ext.ext_cn: 风光无比秀丽的土地
ext.ext_en: ...a land of unparalleled scenic beauty.

defs.def_en: If a place has scenic beauty, its scenery is attractive.

defs.def_cn: 亵渎行为；不敬的行为；渎神的行为

ext.ext_cn: 圣泉俗用被认为是亵渎神灵的行为。
ext.ext_en: To desecrate a holy spring is considered profanity.

defs.def_en: Profanity is an act that shows disrespect for a religion or religious beliefs.

ext.ext_cn: 我们已经渐渐对那些无礼的诅咒和谩骂习以为常了。
ext.ext_en: We have grown accustomed to having our ears assailed by mindless cursing and profanities.

defs.def_en: Profanities are swear words.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 官僚和懦弱的政客们
ext.ext_en: ...bureaucrats and spineless politicians.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is spineless, you mean that they are afraid to take action or oppose people when they should.

ext.ext_cn: 在非洲传播关于艾滋病方面的知识耗时数年。
ext.ext_en: It took years to disseminate information about Aids in Africa...

ext.ext_cn: 他们散布反对法国的宣传资料。
ext.ext_en: They disseminated anti-French propaganda.

defs.def_en: To disseminate information or knowledge means to distribute it so that it reaches many people or organizations.
Giblets are the parts such as the heart and liver that you remove from inside a chicken or other bird before you cook and eat it. Some people cook the giblets separately to make soup or a sauce.

ext.ext_cn: 一块巧克力
ext.ext_en: ...a bar of chocolate...

ext.ext_cn: 你要巧克力吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you want some chocolate?

defs.def_en: See also:milk chocolate;plain chocolate;Chocolate is a sweet hard food made from cocoa beans. It is usually brown in colour and is eaten as a sweet.

defs.def_cn: (通常用热牛奶调制的)巧克力热饮

ext.ext_cn: 为游客提供茶、咖啡和巧克力热饮的小餐馆
ext.ext_en: ...a small cafeteria where the visitors can buy tea, coffee and chocolate...

ext.ext_cn: 我小口喝着她调制的巧克力热饮。
ext.ext_en: I sipped the hot chocolate she had made.

defs.def_en: Chocolate or hot chocolate is a drink made from a powder containing chocolate. It is usually made with hot milk.

ext.ext_cn: 一盒巧克力糖
ext.ext_en: ...a box of chocolates...

ext.ext_cn: 来，吃块巧克力糖。
ext.ext_en: Here, have a chocolate.

defs.def_en: Chocolates are small sweets or nuts covered with a layer of chocolate. They are usually sold in a box.

ext.ext_cn: 窗帘和床罩是深棕色天鹅绒的。
ext.ext_en: The curtains and the coverlet of the bed were chocolate velvet...

ext.ext_cn: 她将深棕色大衣放在手提箱旁。
ext.ext_en: She placed the chocolate-colored coat beside the case.

defs.def_en: Chocolate is used to describe things that are dark brown in colour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 房子里似乎悄然无声，安静得好像已经没人在住一样。
ext.ext_en: The house seemed muted, hushed as if it had been deserted...

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢一种寂静庄重的气氛。
ext.ext_en: He liked a hushed and dignified atmosphere.

defs.def_en: A hushed place is peaceful and much quieter and calmer than usual.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 刚开始我们低声交谈，走路也蹑手蹑脚的，以免惊动他们。
ext.ext_en: At first we spoke in hushed voices and crept about in order not to alarm them...

ext.ext_cn: 我们窃窃私语地讨论了形势。
ext.ext_en: We discussed the situation in hushed whispers.

defs.def_en: A hushed voice or hushed conversation is very quiet.
