defs.def_en: If people rush to do something, they do it as soon as they can, because they are very eager to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 男人们匆匆离开了。
ext.ext_en: The men left in a rush...

ext.ext_cn: 这太仓促了。
ext.ext_en: It was all rather a rush...

defs.def_en: A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 唱片店正期待着人们会争相抢购这张单曲唱片。
ext.ext_en: Record stores are expecting a huge rush for the single.

ext.ext_cn: 争先恐后签约
ext.ext_en: ...the rush for contracts.

defs.def_en: If there is a rush for something, many people suddenly try to get it or do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这家商店的开张正好赶上了圣诞的抢购热潮。
ext.ext_en: The shop's opening coincided with the Christmas rush...

ext.ext_cn: 赶在高峰期开始前申请。
ext.ext_en: Apply before the rush starts.

defs.def_en: The rush is a period of time when many people go somewhere or do something.

ext.ext_cn: 搜寻时不能仓促行事。
ext.ext_en: You can't rush a search...

ext.ext_cn: 充分咀嚼食物，吃饭不要太快。
ext.ext_en: Chew your food well and do not rush meals...

defs.def_en: If you rush something, you do it in a hurry, often too quickly and without much care.

ext.ext_cn: 我们叫了一辆救护车，赶紧把她送到了医院。
ext.ext_en: We got an ambulance and rushed her to hospital...

ext.ext_cn: 联邦探员赶紧把他送进了一辆车里。
ext.ext_en: Federal agents rushed him into a car...

defs.def_en: If you rush someone or something to a place, you take them there quickly.

defs.def_cn: (未经充分考虑而)匆忙做，仓促做，草率地做

ext.ext_cn: 他不会草率作出任何决定的。
ext.ext_en: He will not rush into any decisions...

ext.ext_cn: 他们还没有充分了解这项任务就仓促行动了。
ext.ext_en: They had rushed in without adequate appreciation of the task...

defs.def_en: If you rush into something or are rushed into it, you do it without thinking about it for long enough.

ext.ext_cn: 他们猛冲到入口，强行闯入。
ext.ext_en: They rushed the entrance and forced their way in...

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆从另一个方向突袭了他。
ext.ext_en: Tom came rushing at him from another direction.

defs.def_en: If you rush something or someone, you move quickly and forcefully at them, often in order to attack them.

ext.ext_cn: 水从巨大的隧道中奔涌而出。
ext.ext_en: Water rushes out of huge tunnels...

ext.ext_cn: 气流一直从我们身边呼啸而过。
ext.ext_en: The air was rushing past us all the time.

defs.def_en: If air or liquid rushes somewhere, it flows there suddenly and quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 一阵强烈而纯洁的爱意涌遍他全身。
ext.ext_en: A rush of pure affection swept over him...

ext.ext_cn: 想到这点，他突然感到一阵强烈的恐慌。
ext.ext_en: He felt a sudden rush of panic at the thought.

defs.def_en: If you experience a rush of a feeling, you suddenly experience it very strongly.
Rushes are plants with long thin stems that grow near water.
In film-making, the rushes of a film are the parts of it that have been filmed but have not yet been edited.

ext.ext_cn: 以前我们在午饭时间会忙得不可开交。
ext.ext_en: We used to be rushed off our feet at lunchtimes.

defs.def_en: If you are rushed off your feet, you are extremely busy.
Existentialism is a philosophy which stresses the importance of human experience, and says that everyone is responsible for the results of their own actions.

ext.ext_cn: 那个女人使劲把杯子朝他扔去。
ext.ext_en: The woman flung the cup at him...

ext.ext_cn: 有一次他抓过我织的东西，把它扔到了屋子的另一头。
ext.ext_en: He once seized my knitting, flinging it across the room.

defs.def_en: If you fling something somewhere, you throw it there using a lot of force.

ext.ext_cn: 他突然跳到地板上。
ext.ext_en: He flung himself to the floor.

defs.def_en: If you fling yourself somewhere, you move or jump there suddenly and with a lot of force.

defs.def_cn: 急伸，猛动(尤指头或手臂)

ext.ext_cn: 她突然张开手臂搂住我的脖子，然后吻了我一下。
ext.ext_en: She flung her arms around my neck and kissed me.

defs.def_en: If you fling a part of your body in a particular direction, especially your arms or head, you move it there suddenly.

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人抓住他的衬衫前襟，把他摔在了地上。
ext.ext_en: The youth got him by the front of his shirt and flung him to the ground.

defs.def_en: If you fling someone to the ground, you push them very roughly so that they fall over.

ext.ext_cn: 彼得把他的鞋子甩到角落里。
ext.ext_en: Peter flung his shoes into the corner...

ext.ext_cn: 他把东西摔在桌子上。
ext.ext_en: He flung it down on the desk.

defs.def_en: If you fling something into a particular place or position, you put it there in a quick or angry way.

ext.ext_cn: 她一心扑在事业上。
ext.ext_en: She flung herself into her career...

ext.ext_cn: 我全身心投入诗歌创作。
ext.ext_en: I flung myself into poetry.

defs.def_en: If you fling yourself into a particular activity, you do it with a lot of enthusiasm and energy.

ext.ext_cn: 她声称在 30 年前曾和他有过一段短暂的风流韵事。
ext.ext_en: She claims she had a brief fling with him 30 years ago.

defs.def_en: If two people have a fling, they have a brief sexual relationship.

defs.def_cn: 短暂的放纵;一时的尽情享乐

ext.ext_cn: 你最终收心并开始工作之前的最后一次放纵
ext.ext_en: ...that last fling before you finally give up and take up a job.

defs.def_en: A fling is a short period of enjoyment, especially the last one that you will get an opportunity to have.
Fling can be used instead of 'throw' in many expressions that usually contain 'throw'.

defs.def_cn: 北的;(在)北部的;来自北部的

ext.ext_cn: 他们的两个孩子是从宾夕法尼亚州移民到北爱尔兰的。
ext.ext_en: Their two children were immigrants to Northern Ireland from Pennsylvania...

ext.ext_cn: 3星级宾馆的住宿价格在几个北方城市降得最多。
ext.ext_en: Prices at three-star hotels fell furthest in several northern cities.

defs.def_en: Northern means in or from the north of a region, state, or country.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 教养差的;粗野的;无礼的

ext.ext_cn: 在她看来他们非常粗俗无礼。
ext.ext_en: They seemed to her rather vulgar and ill-bred.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is ill-bred, you mean that they have bad manners.

defs.def_cn: 大批，一连串，一阵(尤指令人不快之物)

ext.ext_cn: 最近发生的一连串袭马事件
ext.ext_en: ...the recent spate of attacks on horses.

ext.ext_cn: 目前流传的大量谣言
ext.ext_en: ...the current spate of scandals.

defs.def_en: A spate of things, especially unpleasant things, is a large number of them that happen or appear within a short period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 泰晤士河河水暴涨，成群的加拿大雁迅速游向下游。
ext.ext_en: The Thames was in spate, with flocks of Canada geese speeding downriver.

defs.def_en: When a river is in spate it contains a lot more water than usual and is flowing very fast.

ext.ext_cn: 乳腺
ext.ext_en: ...the mammary glands.

defs.def_en: Mammary means relating to the breasts.
A one-night stand is a very brief sexual relationship, usually one that is casual and perhaps only lasts one night.
Liturgical things are used in or relate to church services.

defs.def_cn: (成就)辉煌的，值得钦佩的;(品质)出色的,卓越的

ext.ext_cn: 她是我们所有人的光辉榜样。
ext.ext_en: She is a shining example to us all...

ext.ext_cn: 阿里安航天火箭项目取得了辉煌的成功。
ext.ext_en: The Ariane space-rocket project has had a shining success.

defs.def_en: See also:shine;A shining achievement or quality is a very good one which should be greatly admired.

ext.ext_cn: 他们谢幕多达23次。
ext.ext_en: They took 23 curtain calls.

defs.def_en: In a theatre, when actors or performers take a curtain call, they come forward to the front of the stage after a performance in order to receive the applause of the audience.

defs.def_cn: 重新定居;移居;重新安置

ext.ext_cn: 只有难民才符合移民国外的条件。
ext.ext_en: Only refugees are eligible for resettlement abroad.

ext.ext_cn: 强制村民从农村搬迁到城市
ext.ext_en: ...the forcible resettlement of villagers from the countryside into towns.

defs.def_en: Resettlement is the process of moving people to a different place to live, because they are no longer allowed to stay in the area where they used to live.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极痛苦的;折磨人的;剧痛的

ext.ext_cn: 我忍受着剧痛，一条腿无法动弹。
ext.ext_en: I was in excruciating pain and one leg wouldn't move...

ext.ext_cn: 她对爱情的寻觅常常给她带来极大的痛苦和孤独感。
ext.ext_en: Her search for love has often caused her excruciating misery and loneliness.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as excruciating, you are emphasizing that it is extremely painful, either physically or emotionally.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以忍受的;令人苦恼的

ext.ext_cn: 同时，又无聊得让人苦恼不已。
ext.ext_en: Meanwhile, the boredom is excruciating...

ext.ext_cn: 一时间安静得令人难以忍受。
ext.ext_en: There was a moment of excruciating silence.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as excruciating, you mean that it is very unpleasant to experience, for example because it is very boring or embarrassing.

defs.def_cn: （平分后要决出胜负的）附加赛

ext.ext_cn: 尼克·福尔多在附加赛中被彼得·贝克击败。
ext.ext_en: Nick Faldo was beaten by Peter Baker in a play-off.

ext.ext_cn: 决定谁是联赛冠军的附加赛
ext.ext_en: ...a playoff game to determine who is the league winner.

defs.def_en: A playoff is an extra game which is played to decide the winner of a sports competition when two or more people have got the same score.

ext.ext_cn: 获胜者将在本周末的季后赛中对阵奥克兰运动者队。
ext.ext_en: The winner will face the Oakland A's in the playoffs this weekend.

defs.def_en: You use playoffs to refer to a series of games between the winners of different leagues, to decide which teams will play for a championship.

defs.def_cn: 外国佬(对有色人种的蔑称)
defs.def_en: Wog is an extremely offensive word for anyone whose skin is not white.

defs.def_cn: 有刺痛感；有强烈的感触

ext.ext_cn: 他停了下来，觉得帽子下面头皮刺痒。
ext.ext_en: He paused, feeling his scalp prickling under his hat...

ext.ext_cn: 她因为忧惧而浑身发毛。
ext.ext_en: Her skin prickled with apprehension.

defs.def_en: If your skin prickles, it feels as if a lot of small sharp points are being stuck into it, either because of something touching it or because you feel a strong emotion.

ext.ext_cn: 根部有几根刺的笔直的茎
ext.ext_en: ...an erect stem covered at the base with a few prickles.

defs.def_en: Prickles are small sharp points that stick out from leaves or from the stalks of plants.

ext.ext_cn: 诸如采煤与钢铁制造之类的传统工业
ext.ext_en: ...traditional industries such as coal mining and steel making...

ext.ext_cn: 他出生在南威尔士的阿伯德尔，是一位采矿工程师的儿子。
ext.ext_en: He was born at Aberdare in South Wales, the son of a mining engineer.

defs.def_en: Mining is the industry and activities connected with getting valuable or useful minerals from the ground, for example coal, diamonds, or gold.

defs.def_cn: (湿物落在平面上发出的)啪嗒声，溅泼声

ext.ext_cn: 鸡蛋啪嚓一声打在我脸颊上。
ext.ext_en: The egg landed on my cheek with a splat.

defs.def_en: Splat is used to describe the sound of something wet hitting a surface with a lot of force.
A lemur is an animal that looks like a small monkey and has a long tail and a face similar to that of a fox.
Capillaries are tiny blood vessels in your body.

defs.def_cn: （大批地）居住于，生活于，栖居于

ext.ext_cn: 在所有这一切发生之前，这个岛上居住的是印第安阿拉瓦克人。
ext.ext_en: Before all this the island was populated by native American Arawaks.

ext.ext_cn: 生活在周围村庄的当地信德人
ext.ext_en: ...native Sindhis, who populate the surrounding villages.

defs.def_en: If an area is populated by certain people or animals, those people or animals live there, often in large numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 各继任政权吞并了该地区，并将低地的人们迁移到了这里。
ext.ext_en: Successive regimes annexed the region and populated it with lowland people.

defs.def_en: To populate an area means to cause people to live there.

ext.ext_cn: 占据法国政权上层的勤勉、审慎的技术专家型官员
ext.ext_en: ...the diligent and discreet technocrats who populate the upper reaches of French power.

ext.ext_cn: 电影里那种来自下层社会的人物
ext.ext_en: ...the sort of low-life characters who populate the film.

defs.def_en: The people or characters who populate an area of public life or a piece of entertainment are the people or characters in it.

ext.ext_cn: 一杯葡萄酒的热量确实不低。
ext.ext_en: A glass of wine does have quite a lot of calories.

ext.ext_cn: 控制热量的饮食
ext.ext_en: ...calorie controlled diets.

defs.def_en: See also:-calorie;Calories are units used to measure the energy value of food. People who are on diets try to eat food that does not contain many calories.

defs.def_cn: 四肢麻痹者;四肢瘫痪者

ext.ext_cn: 现在的他四肢麻痹，只能呆在轮椅上。
ext.ext_en: He is now quadriplegic and confined to a wheelchair.

ext.ext_cn: 现在的他四肢麻痹，只能呆在轮椅上。
ext.ext_en: He is now quadriplegic and confined to a wheelchair.

defs.def_en: A quadriplegic is a person who is permanently unable to use their arms and legs.

ext.ext_cn: 这种病如果不治疗可能会发展成慢性病。
ext.ext_en: If left untreated the condition may become chronic.

ext.ext_cn: 肺结核得不到治疗的后果
ext.ext_en: ...the consequences of untreated tuberculosis.

defs.def_en: If an injury or illness is left untreated, it is not given medical treatment.

ext.ext_cn: 倾倒核废料和未经处理的污水
ext.ext_en: ...the dumping of nuclear waste and untreated sewage.

defs.def_en: Untreated materials, water, or chemicals are harmful and have not been made safe.

defs.def_cn: （天然或原始物质）未经处理的，未加工过的

ext.ext_cn: 所有床上用品全部用未经处理的天然棉花制成。
ext.ext_en: All the bedding is made of simple, untreated cotton...

ext.ext_cn: 原始的碳纤维材料很像布料。
ext.ext_en: In its untreated state the carbon fibre material is rather like cloth.

defs.def_en: Untreated materials are in their natural or original state, often before being prepared for use in a particular process.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 容易注意到的;显著的;明显的

ext.ext_cn: 显而易见，女性不像男人们那样好勇斗狠。
ext.ext_en: It is noticeable that women do not have the rivalry that men have...

ext.ext_cn: 这些变化带来的最明显效果体现在人们现在一起工作的方式上。
ext.ext_en: The most noticeable effect of these changes is in the way people are now working together.

defs.def_en: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有艺术天赋的;有艺术鉴赏力的

ext.ext_cn: 他们鼓励培养男孩子的敏感和艺术气质。
ext.ext_en: They encourage boys to be sensitive and artistic...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽把一切弄得都很漂亮——你还记得她以前总是对色彩很有艺术品位吧。
ext.ext_en: Mary's got it all so nice — you remember how artistic she always was with colors.

defs.def_en: Someone who is artistic is good at drawing or painting, or arranging things in a beautiful way.

ext.ext_cn: 艺术自由运动
ext.ext_en: ...the campaign for artistic freedom.

ext.ext_cn: 他们1,300年的艺术传统
ext.ext_en: ...their 1,300 year old artistic traditions.

defs.def_en: Artistic means relating to art or artists.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 石子路的精美图案
ext.ext_en: ...an artistic arrangement of stone paving.

defs.def_en: An artistic design or arrangement is beautiful.

defs.def_cn: (篮球、美式橄榄球、冰球等比赛过程中的)暂停
defs.def_en: In basketball, American football, ice hockey, and some other sports, when a team calls a time out, they call a stop to the game for a few minutes in order to rest and discuss how they are going to play.

defs.def_cn: (工作或活动中的)暂停时间，休息时间

ext.ext_cn: 他从竞选活动中挤出一点时间陪母亲吃饭。
ext.ext_en: He took time out from campaigning to accompany his mother to dinner.

ext.ext_cn: 为抚养年幼子女暂停工作后又重返劳动力市场的女性
ext.ext_en: …women returning to the labour market after time out to raise young families.

defs.def_en: If you take time out from a job or activity, you have a break from it and do something different instead.

ext.ext_cn: 不管给他吃什么，他都能眨眼就下肚。
ext.ext_en: No matter what he is offered to eat he polishes it off in an instant...

ext.ext_cn: 他一仰脖喝完苏格兰威士忌，砰的一声把杯子放下。
ext.ext_en: He polished off  his scotch and slammed the glass down.

defs.def_en: If you polish off food or drink, you eat or drink all of it, or finish it.

defs.def_cn: （尤指在体育运动中）击败，战胜

ext.ext_cn: 他以21比2、21比8和21比8直落三局击败了对手。
ext.ext_en: He polished off his opponents 21-2, 21-8 and 21-8...

ext.ext_cn: 南非队今天上午以278分7人出局继续比赛，英格兰队应该很容易就能击败他们。
ext.ext_en: South Africa resume this morning on 278 for seven and England could well polish them off first thing.

defs.def_en: If you polish off an opponent, especially in sports, you beat them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 懦弱的;胆怯的;意志薄弱的

ext.ext_cn: 他需要动用所有的职权防止那些胆小的志愿兵逃跑。
ext.ext_en: He would need all his authority to keep the weak-kneed volunteers from bolting.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as weak-kneed, you mean that they are unable or unwilling to do anything because they are influenced by a strong emotion such as fear.
Kindling is small pieces of dry wood and other materials that you use to start a fire.

defs.def_cn: （因为疲惫、厌烦等）动作机械的人

ext.ext_cn: 我讨厌被看作政治机器。
ext.ext_en: I get sick of being thought of as a political automaton.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is an automaton, you are critical of them because they behave as if they are so tired or bored that they do things without thinking.
An automaton is a small, mechanical figure that can move automatically.

defs.def_cn: （用于动词和名词前构成新的动词和名词）表示“再”，“又”（如，re-read（再读一次），re-election（再次选举））
defs.def_en: Re- is added to verbs and nouns to form new verbs and nouns that refer to the repeating of an action or process. For example, to 're-read' something means to read it again, and someone's 're-election' is their being elected again.

defs.def_cn: （用于动词和名词前构成新的动词和名词，表示与前一动作或过程相反的动作或过程，如reappear（消失后再次出现），regain（失去后重新得到））
defs.def_en: Re- is added to verbs and nouns to form new verbs and nouns that refer to a process opposite to one that has already taken place. For example, to 'reappear' means to appear after disappearing, and to 'regain' something means to gain it after you have lost it.

defs.def_cn: （用于动词和名词前构成新的动词和名词，表示位置或状态的改变，如relocate（重新安置），rearrange（重新安排））
defs.def_en: Re- is added to verbs and nouns to form new verbs and nouns which describe a change in the position or state of something. For example, to 'relocate' something means to locate it in a different place and to 'rearrange' something means to arrange it in a different way.

ext.ext_cn: 空气中散发着硫黄味儿。
ext.ext_en: The air reeks of sulphur.

ext.ext_cn: 二氧化硫的减排措施
ext.ext_en: ...measures to reduce emissions of sulphur dioxide.

defs.def_en: Sulphur is a yellow chemical which has a strong smell.
In tennis, if a player serves a double fault, they make a mistake with both serves and lose the point.

defs.def_cn: 漫画;讽刺画;夸张性（或讽刺性）描述

ext.ext_cn: 海报漫画中的希特勒长着魔鬼的犄角和尾巴。
ext.ext_en: The poster showed a caricature of Hitler with a devil's horns and tail...

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙阶梯上挤满了出售荒诞漫画的人。
ext.ext_en: The Spanish Steps were crowded with the sellers of grotesque caricatures.

defs.def_en: A caricature of someone is a drawing or description of them that exaggerates their appearance or behaviour in a humorous or critical way.

defs.def_cn: 把…画成漫画;用讽刺性手法描述;夸大

ext.ext_cn: 她的政治生涯在头条新闻里遭到夸张嘲弄。
ext.ext_en: Her political career has been caricatured in headlines...

ext.ext_cn: 在漫画里他被画成了一棵大头菜。
ext.ext_en: He was caricatured as a turnip.

defs.def_en: If you caricature someone, you draw or describe them in an exaggerated way in order to be humorous or critical.

ext.ext_cn: 在霍尔看来,当代社会工作者所受的培训被大肆夸大,他感到很气愤。
ext.ext_en: Hall is angry at what he sees as a caricature of the training offered to modern-day social workers.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a caricature of an event or situation, you mean that it is a very exaggerated account of it.

defs.def_cn: 极好的;优秀的;卓越的;杰出的

ext.ext_cn: 录音质量非常好。
ext.ext_en: The recording quality is excellent...

ext.ext_cn: 幸运的是，作为弗雷德的私人助理，休办事效率很高，工作很出色。
ext.ext_en: Luckily, Sue is very efficient and does an excellent job as Fred's personal assistant.

defs.def_en: Something that is excellent is very good indeed.
Some people say 'Excellent!' to show that they approve of something.

defs.def_cn: 向后的，往后的（一些人亦使用backwards)

ext.ext_cn: 他打开2号公寓的门，回头瞥了拉里一眼，然后就进了房间。
ext.ext_en: He unlocked the door of apartment two and disappeared inside after a backward glance at Larry...

ext.ext_cn: 他做了一个后空翻。
ext.ext_en: He did a backward flip.

defs.def_en: A backward movement or look is in the direction that your back is facing. Some people use backwards for this meaning.

ext.ext_cn: 到了一定的年龄，就不可能再退回去干不需要技能的工作。
ext.ext_en: At a certain age, it's not viable for men to take a backward step into unskilled work...

ext.ext_cn: 许多牙医不再为依靠国民保健制度的病人看病，这是该国的一大倒退。
ext.ext_en: Many dentists will no longer treat National Health Service patients, which is a big backward step in this country.

defs.def_en: If someone takes a backward step, they do something that does not change or improve their situation, but causes them to go back a stage.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们应当为落后的祖国加快变革的脚步。
ext.ext_en: We need to accelerate the pace of change in our backward country.

defs.def_en: A backward country or society does not have modern industries and machines.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 关于帮助落后孩子的教学方法研究
ext.ext_en: ...research into teaching techniques to help backward children...

ext.ext_cn: 我学走路和说话都很慢，所以我父母以为我很迟钝。
ext.ext_en: I was slow to walk and talk and my parents thought I was backward.

defs.def_en: A backward child has difficulty in learning.

ext.ext_cn: 杀红了眼的暴徒们意欲占领这座城市。
ext.ext_en: The mobs became driven by a crazed blood-lust to take the city.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is driven by a blood lust, you mean that they are acting in an extremely violent way because their emotions have been aroused by the events around them.

ext.ext_cn: 那么，女性怎样做才能使自己不得心脏病呢？
ext.ext_en: So, what can women do to protect themselves from heart disease?...

ext.ext_cn: 一件薄薄的羊毛长外套和一条紫色的头巾为她挡了风。
ext.ext_en: A long thin wool coat and a purple headscarf protected her against the wind...

defs.def_en: To protect someone or something means to prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

ext.ext_cn: 许多厂家都购买了保险，以防遭到敲诈。
ext.ext_en: Many manufacturers have policies to protect themselves against blackmailers.

defs.def_en: If an insurance policy protects you against an event such as death, injury, fire, or theft, the insurance company will give you or your family money if that event happens.

ext.ext_cn: 美国大选的新鲜和热闹
ext.ext_en: ...the colour and razzmatazz of a US election.

defs.def_en: Razzmatazz is a noisy and showy display.

ext.ext_cn: 由其他证据支持的书面陈述
ext.ext_en: ...a written statement supported by other corroborative evidence.

defs.def_en: Corroborative evidence or information supports an idea, account, or argument.

ext.ext_cn: 他领导武装暴动已达15年之久。
ext.ext_en: He has led a violent armed insurgency for 15 years.

defs.def_en: An insurgency is a violent attempt to oppose a country's government carried out by citizens of that country.
A haemophiliac is a person who suffers from haemophilia.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他感到头晕目眩。
ext.ext_en: He felt giddy and light-headed.

defs.def_en: If you feel giddy, you feel unsteady and think that you are about to fall over, usually because you are not well.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （高兴或激动得）发狂的，举止反常的

ext.ext_cn: 安东尼自鸣得意，忘乎所以。
ext.ext_en: Anthony was giddy with self-satisfaction...

ext.ext_cn: 身处那个地方让我激动得难以自持。
ext.ext_en: Being there gave me a giddy pleasure.

defs.def_en: If you feel giddy with delight or excitement, you feel so happy or excited that you find it hard to think or act normally.

ext.ext_cn: 她自称痛恨自己的外号。
ext.ext_en: She professed to hate her nickname...

ext.ext_cn: 为什么机构都谎称自己对此很关心？
ext.ext_en: Why do organisations profess that they care?...

defs.def_en: If you profess to do or have something, you claim that you do it or have it, often when you do not.

defs.def_cn: 表达，表明（感情、观点、信仰等）

ext.ext_cn: 他对这个安排表示满意。
ext.ext_en: He professed to be content with the arrangement...

ext.ext_cn: 巴奇尔表示对印度之行很满意。
ext.ext_en: Bacher professed himself pleased with the Indian tour.

defs.def_en: If you profess a feeling, opinion, or belief, you express it.

ext.ext_cn: 总统将这场灾难说成是天灾。
ext.ext_en: The President described the disaster as an act of God.

defs.def_en: An act of God is an event that is beyond human control, especially one in which something is damaged or someone is hurt.

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦东部的雷纳姆泽，那儿有一条新的旁道将会分流 A13 公路的交通
ext.ext_en: ...Rainham Marshes, east London, where a new bypass will divert traffic from the A13...

ext.ext_cn: 在罢工期间，救护车将被转到私人医院去。
ext.ext_en: During the strike, ambulances will be diverted to private hospitals...

defs.def_en: To divert vehicles or travellers means to make them follow a different route or go to a different destination than they originally intended. You can also say that someone or something diverts from a particular route or to a particular place.

defs.def_cn: 改变(资金、资源)的用途;转移

ext.ext_cn: 政府正试图将更多的公共基金从西部转到东部。
ext.ext_en: The government is trying to divert more public funds from west to east.

ext.ext_cn: 负责将资源用于社区保健的政府部门
ext.ext_en: ...government departments involved in diverting resources into community care.

defs.def_en: To divert money or resources means to cause them to be used for a different purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 他让总机接线员将劳拉所有的电话都转给他。
ext.ext_en: He instructed switchboard staff to divert all Laura's calls to him.

ext.ext_cn: 只有当电话被转接到英国之外，客户才会被加收额外的电话费。
ext.ext_en: Customers will only incur additional call charges if the call is diverted outside the UK.

defs.def_en: To divert a phone call means to send it to a different number or place from the one that was dialled by the person making the call.

ext.ext_cn: 他们想要把人们的注意力从真正的问题上转移开。
ext.ext_en: They want to divert the attention of the people from the real issues.

ext.ext_cn: 总统需要将人们的视线从他以往在经济上的表现上转移开。
ext.ext_en: The President needed to divert attention away from his own economic record.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone diverts your attention from something important or serious, you disapprove of them behaving or talking in a way that stops you thinking about it.
A sleepover is an occasion when someone, especially a child, sleeps for one night in a place such as a friend's home.

ext.ext_cn: 顾客三三两两地来了。
ext.ext_en: Clients came in dribs and drabs.

defs.def_en: If people or things arrive in dribs and drabs, they arrive in small numbers over a period of time rather than arriving all together.

defs.def_cn: (药品)致幻的，使心情产生变化的
defs.def_en: A mind-altering drug is one that produces mood changes in the person who has taken it.

ext.ext_cn: 蒂姆摄影经验丰富，在过去13年里一直以拍摄野生生物为业余爱好。
ext.ext_en: An old hand at photography, Tim has been shooting wildlife as a hobby for the last 13 years.

defs.def_en: If someone is an old hand at something, they are very skilled at it because they have been doing it for a long time.

defs.def_cn: （尤指对宗教著作的）注释，诠释，解经

ext.ext_cn: 艾萨克斯擅长的那种学术诠释
ext.ext_en: ...the kind of academic exegesis at which Isaacs excels.

ext.ext_cn: 对他作品的大量注释
ext.ext_en: ...a substantial exegesis of his work.

defs.def_en: An exegesis is an explanation and interpretation of a piece of writing, especially a religious piece of writing, after very careful study.

ext.ext_cn: 胸部的脂肪和腺体组织数量
ext.ext_en: ...the amount of fat and glandular tissue in the breasts.

defs.def_en: Glandular means relating to or affecting your glands.

ext.ext_cn: 越橘已经成了主要经济作物。
ext.ext_en: Cranberries have become a major cash crop.

defs.def_en: A cash crop is a crop that is grown in order to be sold.
Some people refer to or address their grandfather as grandaddy .
A mayfly is an insect which lives near water and only lives for a very short time as an adult.

ext.ext_cn: 他从伦纳德家正下方的公寓里走了出来。
ext.ext_en: He appeared from the apartment directly below Leonard's...

ext.ext_cn: 小道位于长砖墙脚下。
ext.ext_en: The path runs below a long brick wall...

defs.def_en: If something is below something else, it is in a lower position.

ext.ext_cn: 他们设计了一套从地下70米处抽水的系统。
ext.ext_en: They have designed a system which pumps up water from 70m below ground...

ext.ext_cn: 埋在地下隧道里的线圈可能很快就会被用来储存大量的电。
ext.ext_en: Coils buried in tunnels below the ground might soon be used to store large amounts of electricity.

defs.def_en: If something is below ground or below the ground, it is in the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 请按照下面的地址给我写信。
ext.ext_en: Please write to me at the address below...

ext.ext_cn: 英国广播公司“美食秀”正在派送比赛免费券，详情见下文。
ext.ext_en: The BBC Good Food Show is giving away free tickets in a competition. For details, see below.

defs.def_en: You use below in a piece of writing to refer to something that is mentioned later.

defs.def_cn: （数量、比率或水平）低于，小于，少于

ext.ext_cn: 夜间气温会降到15摄氏度以下。
ext.ext_en: Night temperatures can drop below 15 degrees Celsius...

ext.ext_cn: 英国电信同意将整体价格增幅控制在低于通货膨胀7.5%的水平。
ext.ext_en: British Telecom agreed to keep overall price increases to 7.5 per cent below inflation...

defs.def_en: If something is below a particular amount, rate, or level, it is less than that amount, rate, or level.

ext.ext_cn: 这些人承受的压力往往小于那些职位仅次于他们的人。
ext.ext_en: Such people often experience less stress than those in the ranks immediately below them.

ext.ext_cn: 所有职位低于首席官员的白领员工的薪酬增长
ext.ext_en: ...pay rises awarded to all white-collar staff below chief officer level.

defs.def_en: If someone is below you in an organization, they are lower in rank.
A cricketer is a person who plays cricket.

ext.ext_cn: 她把那张纸在手里揉成一团。
ext.ext_en: She crumpled the paper in her hand...

ext.ext_cn: 碰撞时，汽车的前部和后部会被撞瘪。
ext.ext_en: The front and rear of the car will crumple during a collision.

defs.def_en: If you crumple something such as paper or cloth, or if it crumples, it is squashed and becomes full of untidy creases and folds.

ext.ext_cn: 他身子一软，倒在地上。
ext.ext_en: His body crumpled...

ext.ext_cn: 他一下子瘫倒在地。
ext.ext_en: He immediately crumpled to the floor...

defs.def_en: If someone crumples, they collapse, for example when they have received a shock.

defs.def_cn: (指脸突然)沮丧地皱起，哭丧着脸

ext.ext_cn: 她的声音颤抖起来，随后又露出一脸苦相。
ext.ext_en: She faltered, and then her face crumpled once more.

defs.def_en: If someone's face crumples, they suddenly look very disappointed or as if they want to cry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （信息、测量、数据或仪器等）精确的，准确的

ext.ext_cn: 警方强调这是迄今对凶手最精确的描述。
ext.ext_en: Police have stressed that this is the most accurate description of the killer to date...

ext.ext_cn: 这也许能提供一个监测空气中二氧化碳含量的既快又准的方法。
ext.ext_en: This may provide a quick and accurate way of monitoring the amount of carbon dioxide in the air...

defs.def_en: Accurate information, measurements, and statistics are correct to a very detailed level. An accurate instrument is able to give you information of this kind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我认为我们对损失作出准确的估算可能需要一段时间。
ext.ext_en: I think it may take sometime before we can have an accurate assessment of the damage...

ext.ext_cn: 他们预测得没错，他使她的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。
ext.ext_en: They were accurate in their prediction that he would change her life drastically.

defs.def_en: An accurate statement or account gives a true or fair judgment of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 因拼写及标点正确而得分。
ext.ext_en: Marks were given for accurate spelling and punctuation.

ext.ext_cn: 他对休伯特·德伯格到位的恶搞模仿
ext.ext_en: ...his maliciously accurate imitation of Hubert de Burgh.

defs.def_en: You can use accurate to describe the results of someone's actions when they do or  copy something correctly or exactly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （武器、投掷）精准的；（人）射击（或投掷）准的

ext.ext_cn: 这把步枪准头极高。
ext.ext_en: The rifle was extremely accurate...

ext.ext_cn: 然而飞行员并不像他们该达到的水平那样精准。
ext.ext_en: The pilots, however, were not as accurate as they should be.

defs.def_en: An accurate weapon or throw reaches the exact point or target that it was intended to reach. You can also describe a person as accurate if they fire a weapon or throw something in this way.
A hillock is a small hill.
In an organization that produces goods or provides services, quality control is the activity of checking that the goods or services are of an acceptable standard.

defs.def_cn: （在英国用于主要为学士学位的某些大学学位名称之后）

ext.ext_cn: 凯文·P. 卡恩斯，利物浦大学（荣誉）文学士
ext.ext_en: ...Kevin P Kearns, BA (Hons), University of Liverpool.

defs.def_en: In Britain, Hons is an abbreviation for (缩略=) Honours, used after the names of some university degrees, mainly first degrees.

defs.def_cn: 安全处所;庇护所;避难所

ext.ext_cn: 忙碌了一整天后，这真是一个安乐窝。
ext.ext_en: It's a real haven at the end of a busy working day.

ext.ext_cn: 众多鸟类的淡水天堂巴林戈湖
ext.ext_en: ...Lake Baringo, a freshwater haven for a mixed variety of birds.

defs.def_en: See also:safe haven;A haven is a place where people or animals feel safe, secure, and happy.

defs.def_cn: （旧时女子穿的长至膝部的）宽松内裤，灯笼衬裤
defs.def_en: Bloomers are an old-fashioned kind of women's underwear which consists of wide, loose trousers gathered at the knees.

ext.ext_cn: 首相的官方新闻秘书
ext.ext_en: ...the Prime Minister's official press secretary.

defs.def_en: A government's or political leader's press secretary is someone who is employed by them to give information to the press.
A dramatist is someone who writes plays.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 喜怒不形于色的;不露感情的;面无表情的

ext.ext_cn: 他盯着希尔毫无表情的面孔，寻找着表明他已明白的些许迹象。
ext.ext_en: He searched Hill's impassive face for some indication that he understood...

ext.ext_cn: 陪审团主席宣布裁决时,艾伦小姐一直面无表情。
ext.ext_en: As the foreman of the jury announced the verdict, Miss Allan remained impassive.

defs.def_en: If someone is impassive or their face is impassive, they are not showing any emotion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 悬崖峭壁上的小村庄
ext.ext_en: ...tiny villages on craggy cliffs.

defs.def_en: A craggy cliff or mountain is steep and rocky.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是个脸部轮廓分明、皱纹明显的矮个子男人。
ext.ext_en: He's a very small man with a lined, craggy face.

defs.def_en: A craggy face has large features and deep lines.

ext.ext_cn: 国家党派的倒退政策
ext.ext_en: ...the retrogressive policies of the National parties.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action or idea as retrogressive, you disapprove of it because it returns to old ideas or beliefs and does not take advantage of recent progress.

defs.def_cn: 不害羞的；不难为情的；无羞耻心的

ext.ext_cn: 我高兴地朝他笑了笑，一点也不觉得难为情。
ext.ext_en: I grinned at him in unashamed delight.

ext.ext_cn: 对自己的能力毫不避讳的人
ext.ext_en: ...a man rightly unashamed of his own talent.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour or attitude as unashamed, you mean that they are open and honest about things that other people might find embarrassing or shocking.

ext.ext_cn: 他受过更高的教育，拥有化学博士学位。
ext.ext_en: He is more highly educated, with a PhD in Chemistry.

ext.ext_cn: 未发表的博士论文
ext.ext_en: ...an unpublished PhD thesis.

defs.def_en: A PhD is a degree awarded to people who have done advanced research into a particular subject. PhD is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'Doctor of Philosophy'.

ext.ext_cn: R.D.库姆斯博士
ext.ext_en: ...R.D. Combes, PhD.

defs.def_en: PhD is written after someone's name to indicate that they have a PhD.

ext.ext_cn: 部长对他计划的不理会将使他特别尴尬。
ext.ext_en: He will be particularly discomfited by the minister's dismissal of his plan...

ext.ext_cn: 反对派领导人常搞得他在国会中下不来台。
ext.ext_en: The opposition leader has regularly discomfited him in parliament.

defs.def_en: If you are discomfited by something, it causes you to feel slightly embarrassed or confused.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他想和马丁娜发生性关系。
ext.ext_en: The object of his amorous intentions is Martina.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's feelings or actions as amorous, you mean that they involve sexual desire.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的这种旅行绝对不适合那些想要受到百般呵护的人。
ext.ext_en: Our kind of travel is definitely not suitable for people who expect to be cosseted.

defs.def_en: If someone is cosseted, everything possible is done for them and they are protected from anything unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 他们发现了一处迷宫似的地道。
ext.ext_en: They found a labyrinth of tunnels under the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 在泳池里游泳或躺在阳伞底下
ext.ext_en: ...swimming in the pool or lying under an umbrella...

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is under something, they are at a lower level than that thing, and may be covered or hidden by it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们说他被按到水里淹死了。
ext.ext_en: They said he'd been held under the water and drowned...

ext.ext_cn: 金鱼聚在一起贴着水面懒洋洋地游着。
ext.ext_en: Goldfish were swimming lazily in a group just under the surface.

defs.def_en: In a place such as a sea, river, or swimming pool, if someone or something is under the water, they are fully in the water and covered by it.

ext.ext_cn: 他穿过一个砖砌的拱门。
ext.ext_en: He went under a brick arch...

ext.ext_cn: 一条内河船从桥下经过。
ext.ext_en: A river boat passed under the bridge.

defs.def_en: If you go under something, you move from one side to the other of something that is at a higher level than you.

defs.def_cn: 在（尤指一层衣服）的里面（或底下)

ext.ext_cn: 我在绿军装里套了两件毛线衫。
ext.ext_en: I was wearing two sweaters under the green army jacket...

ext.ext_cn: 他在薄套头衫里面没有穿衬衣。
ext.ext_en: He had no shirt on under his thin jumper...

defs.def_en: Something that is under a layer of something, especially clothing, is covered by that layer.

ext.ext_cn: 生计受到威胁的渔夫
ext.ext_en: ...fishermen whose livelihoods are under threat...

ext.ext_cn: 我很少感受到压力，同事们一直对我很好。
ext.ext_en: I'm rarely under pressure and my co-workers are always nice to me...

defs.def_en: You can use under before a noun to indicate that a person or thing is being affected by something or is going through a particular process.

ext.ext_cn: 他最好的朋友在极其可疑的情况下被警察打死了。
ext.ext_en: His best friend was killed by police under extremely questionable circumstances...

ext.ext_cn: 正常情况下，仅有20%到40%的维生素E会被吸收。
ext.ext_en: Under normal conditions, only about 20 to 40 per cent of vitamin E is absorbed...

defs.def_en: If something happens under particular circumstances or conditions, it happens when those circumstances or conditions exist.

defs.def_cn: 根据，按照，依照（法律、协定、制度等）

ext.ext_cn: 根据法律规定，你的雇主有权雇用一名临时工来代替你。
ext.ext_en: Under law, your employer has the right to hire a temporary worker to replace you...

ext.ext_cn: 我们认为根据欧盟有关规定已经构成了犯罪。
ext.ext_en: We believe an offence was committed under EU regulations...

defs.def_en: If something happens under a law, agreement, or system, it happens because that law, agreement, or system says that it should happen.

defs.def_cn: 在（…领导）下；在（…当政）期间；在（…统治）之下

ext.ext_cn: 在他主政期间不会增加新税种。
ext.ext_en: There would be no new taxes under his leadership.

ext.ext_cn: 残暴的独裁统治下的生活现实
ext.ext_en: ...the realities of life under a brutal dictatorship...

defs.def_en: If something happens under a particular person or government, it happens when that person or government is in power.

defs.def_cn: 在…指导下(学习)；在…手下(工作)

ext.ext_cn: 基弗只是60年代早期师从博伊斯的艺术家之一。
ext.ext_en: Kiefer was just one of the artists who had studied under Beuys in the early Sixties...

ext.ext_cn: 刘易斯·海德将军曾是“比利”·米切尔将军的部下。
ext.ext_en: General Lewis Hyde had served under General 'Billy' Mitchell...

defs.def_en: If you study or work under a particular person, that person teaches you or tells you what to do.

defs.def_cn: 用（…之名）；以（…的名义）；假借（…之名）

ext.ext_cn: 你们所出版的书里有署名为阿曼达·费尔柴尔德的吗？
ext.ext_en: Were any of your books published under the name Amanda Fairchild?...

ext.ext_cn: 那位患者挂号时用了假名。
ext.ext_en: The patient was registered under a false name.

defs.def_en: If you do something under a particular name, you use that name instead of your real name.

ext.ext_cn: “普通眼科疾病”这一部分里对该项研究作了描述。
ext.ext_en: This study is described under 'General Diseases of the Eye'...

ext.ext_cn: 《家庭法改革法案》第4款中有关父母权利的规定
ext.ext_en: ...a parental rights order under section 4 of the Family Law Reform Act...

defs.def_en: You use under to say which section of a list, book, or system something is in.

defs.def_cn: （年龄或数量）不足，低于，在…以下

ext.ext_cn: 适合65岁以下人群从事的工作
ext.ext_en: ...jobs for those under 65...

ext.ext_cn: 孩子不满5岁的妈妈中近一半有工作。
ext.ext_en: Nearly half of mothers with children under five have a job...

defs.def_en: If something or someone is under a particular age or amount, they are less than that age or amount.  →see: canvas; under wraps→see: wrap;

ext.ext_cn: 所有的信件上都盖有阿伯丁郡的邮戳。
ext.ext_en: All the letters bore an Aberdeen postmark.

defs.def_en: A postmark is a mark which is printed on letters and packages at a post office. It shows the time and place at which something was posted.

ext.ext_cn: 彼得大帝及其随从1698年踏足英格兰时的野蛮行为震惊了伦敦。
ext.ext_en: Peter the Great shocked London by his wild behaviour and that of his entourage when he visited England in 1698...

ext.ext_cn: 他有12名警官随行。
ext.ext_en: He was accompanied by an entourage of a dozen police officers.

defs.def_en: A famous or important person's entourage is the group of assistants, servants, or other people who travel with them.

ext.ext_cn: 燕子在万里无云的蓝天飞翔。
ext.ext_en: There were swallows in the cloudless blue sky...

ext.ext_cn: 她淡蓝色的眼睛紧紧盯着她父亲的双眼。
ext.ext_en: She fixed her pale blue eyes on her father's.

defs.def_en: Something that is blue is the colour of the sky on a sunny day.

defs.def_cn: 蓝调音乐，布鲁斯音乐（源于美国南部黑人音乐家，节奏缓慢，旋律感强）

ext.ext_en: His singing really does have the depth and the emotional range of the blues.

ext.ext_cn: 芝加哥的蓝调酒吧
ext.ext_en: ...the blues bars of Chicago.

defs.def_en: The blues is a type of music which was developed by African American musicians in the southern United States. It is characterized by a slow tempo and a strong rhythm.

ext.ext_cn: 喜欢指手画脚的姻亲最让人头疼。
ext.ext_en: Interfering in-laws are the prime sources of the blues.

defs.def_en: If you have got the blues, you feel sad and depressed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我也说不出来为什么这么沮丧。
ext.ext_en: There's no earthly reason for me to feel so blue.

defs.def_en: If you are feeling blue, you are feeling sad or depressed, often when there is no particular reason.

defs.def_cn: （剑桥或牛津大学的）校队运动员，蓝色荣誉者
defs.def_en: A Cambridge blue or an Oxford blue is a man or woman who has played for Cambridge or Oxford University in a particular sport.

ext.ext_cn: 偷偷藏起来的一堆色情杂志和黄色影碟
ext.ext_en: ...a secret stash of porn mags and blue movies.

defs.def_en: Blue films, stories, or jokes are about sex.

ext.ext_en: One of them wrote to us out of the blue several years later.

defs.def_en: If something happens out of the blue, it happens unexpectedly.

defs.def_cn: 前座议员(英国议会中坐在前排座位的政府大臣和反对党要员的总称)

ext.ext_en: Some of the Government front bench still believe our relationship with the US is paramount...

ext.ext_en: Both men had argued that their trips had been undertaken in their capacity as front bench spokesmen.

defs.def_en: In Britain, the front bench or people who sit on the front bench are members of Parliament who are ministers in the Government or who hold official positions in an opposition party.

ext.ext_cn: 没有签证的西方人不能乘飞机入境。
ext.ext_en: No westerner could fly in without a visa.

defs.def_en: A westerner is a person who was born in or lives in the United States, Canada, or Western, Northern, or Southern Europe.

ext.ext_cn: 她的教练昨天说，她将是英国奥运代表队席位的有力争夺者。
ext.ext_en: Her trainer said yesterday that she would be a strong contender for a place in Britain's Olympic squad...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的“英国国内事务”记者报道了3名竞争者对辞职消息的反应。
ext.ext_en: Our British Affairs correspondent reports on how the three contenders reacted to the news of the resignation.

defs.def_en: A contender is someone who takes part in a competition.
A scallion is a small onion with long green leaves.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎所有的房子都一模一样。
ext.ext_en: Nearly all the houses were identical...

ext.ext_en: The two parties fought the last election on almost identical manifestos.

defs.def_en: Things that are identical are exactly the same.

defs.def_cn: （多指小说或电影中的）反角，坏人，恶人

ext.ext_cn: 最后，“坏人”都被抓住送进了监狱。
ext.ext_en: In the end the 'bad guys' are caught and sent to jail.

defs.def_en: A bad guy is a person in a story or film who is considered to be evil or wicked, or who is fighting on the wrong side. You can also refer to the bad guys in a situation in real life.
If you say that someone is on the road to perdition, you mean that their behaviour is likely to lead them to failure and disaster.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不幸的;灾难性的;严重的

ext.ext_cn: 国势危难
ext.ext_en: ...the calamitous state of the country.

ext.ext_cn: 一起严重的坠机事件
ext.ext_en: ...a calamitous air crash.

defs.def_en: If you describe an event or situation as calamitous, you mean it is very unfortunate or serious.

defs.def_cn: 公共服务事业;公共服务系统

ext.ext_en: Britain still boasts the cheapest postal service...

ext.ext_en: We have started a campaign for better nursery and school services...

defs.def_en: A service is something that the public needs, such as transport, communications facilities, hospitals, or energy supplies, which is provided in a planned and organized way by the government or an official body.

ext.ext_cn: 英国广播公司国际广播台
ext.ext_en: ...the BBC World Service.

ext.ext_cn: 职业咨询服务
ext.ext_en: ...Careers Advisory Services.

ext.ext_en: The kitchen maintains a twenty-four hour service and can be contacted via Reception...

ext.ext_en: The larger firm was capable of providing a better range of services.

defs.def_en: If an organization or company provides a particular service, they can do a particular job or a type of work for you.

ext.ext_en: Mining rose by 9.1%, manufacturing by 9.4% and services by 4.3%.

ext.ext_en: ...the doctrine that a highly developed service sector was the sign of a modern economy.

defs.def_en: Services are activities such as tourism, banking, and selling things which are part of a country's economy, but are not concerned with producing or manufacturing goods.

defs.def_cn: 服务内容;服务(质量);服务态度

ext.ext_cn: 员工能够为客户提供有价值、高效的服务的唯一途径就是敢于冒险。
ext.ext_en: Taking risks is the only way employees can provide effective and efficient customer service...

ext.ext_en: A bus service operates between Bolton and Salford.

defs.def_en: A bus or train service is a route or regular journey that is part of a transport system.

ext.ext_en: I have obtained the services of a top photographer to take our pictures...

ext.ext_cn: 演员们都愿意免费出演。
ext.ext_en: The performers have all offered their services free of charge.

defs.def_en: Your services are the things that you do or the skills that you use in your job, which other people find useful and are usually willing to pay you for.

defs.def_cn: (为某组织或活动所做的)工作，服务，效劳

ext.ext_en: You've given a lifetime of service to athletics...

ext.ext_en: More than half his long service in parliament has been as a cabinet minister.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's service or services to a particular organization or activity, you mean that they have done a lot of work for it or spent a lot of their time on it.

ext.ext_en: ...an aircraft carrier that saw service in World War II.

defs.def_en: Service is the work done by people or equipment in the army, navy, or air force, for example during a war.

ext.ext_en: ...clean stores with respectful service and fair prices.

defs.def_en: When you receive service in a restaurant, hotel, or shop, an employee asks you what you want or gives you what you have ordered.

ext.ext_cn: 在长达一小时的悼念仪式结束后，他的遗体被抬到了城南的一所公墓。
ext.ext_en: After the hour-long service, his body was taken to a cemetery in the south of the city.

ext.ext_cn: 总统做晨祷的教堂
ext.ext_en: ...the church in which the President was attending morning service.

defs.def_en: A service is a religious ceremony that takes place in a church.

ext.ext_cn: 一套六十件套的餐具
ext.ext_en: ...a 60-piece dinner service.

defs.def_en: A dinner service or a tea service is a complete set of plates, cups, saucers, and other pieces of china.

defs.def_cn: (高速公路边可加油、购物或用餐的)服务站

ext.ext_en: We have repeatedly told planners that services are vital on a motorway like the M40.

defs.def_en: A services is a place beside a motorway where you can buy petrol and other things, or have a meal.

defs.def_cn: (网球、羽毛球等的)发球权，开球局

ext.ext_cn: 她在第一盘自己的发球局仅失了 3 分。
ext.ext_en: She conceded just three points on her service during the first set.

defs.def_en: In tennis, badminton, and some other sports, when it is your service, it is your turn to serve.

ext.ext_en: He wheeled the trolley down the corridor and disappeared with it into the service lift.

ext.ext_en: ...the bigger tunnels, which run either side of the service tunnel.

defs.def_en: Service is used to describe the parts of a building or structure that are used by the staff who clean, repair, or look after it, and are not usually used by the public.

ext.ext_en: If a young woman did not have a dowry, she went into domestic service.

ext.ext_en: I had had my car serviced at the local garage...

ext.ext_en: Make sure that all gas fires and central heating boilers are serviced annually.

defs.def_en: If you have a vehicle or machine serviced, you arrange for someone to examine, adjust, and clean it so that it will keep working efficiently and safely.

ext.ext_cn: 该国几乎 1/4 的出口收入都用来支付 290 亿美元外债的利息了。
ext.ext_en: Almost a quarter of the country's export earnings go to service a foreign debt of $29 billion.

defs.def_en: If a country or organization services its debts, it pays the interest on them.

defs.def_cn: 为…提供服务;满足…的需求

ext.ext_cn: 现在总部有 400 名职员负责地区和海外事务。
ext.ext_en: There are now 400 staff at headquarters, servicing our regional and overseas work...

ext.ext_cn: 诸如煤、石油和天然气之类的矿物燃料会在以后很长一段时间里满足我们的需求。
ext.ext_en: Fossil fuels such as coal, oil and gas will service our needs for some considerable time to come.

defs.def_en: If someone or something services an organization, a project, or a group of people, they provide it with the things that it needs in order to function properly or effectively.

defs.def_cn: 随时可供…使用;随时为…提供帮助

ext.ext_cn: 世界文化潜在的知识和道德力量一定要为政治所用。
ext.ext_en: The intellectual and moral potential of the world's culture must be put at the service of politics.

defs.def_en: To be at the service of a person or organization means to be available to help or be used by that person or organization.

defs.def_cn: 随时为您效劳;随时听您的吩咐

ext.ext_cn: 她夸张地鞠了个躬。“阿纳斯塔西娅·克鲁布尼克，随时为您效劳，”她说。
ext.ext_en: She bowed dramatically. 'Anastasia Krupnik, at your service,' she said.

defs.def_en: You can use 'at your service' after your name as a formal way of introducing yourself to someone and saying that you are willing to help them in any way you can.

ext.ext_cn: 你帮了我一个大忙，非常感激。

ext.ext_en: 'You don't feel that you've betrayed your country?' — 'Not at all, I think I've done a service to my country.'

ext.ext_en: That is, after all, the primary reason we live — to be of service to others.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is of service to you, they help you or are useful to you.

defs.def_en: A free-standing piece of furniture or other object is not fixed to anything, or stands on its own away from other things.

ext.ext_en: They may need some additional inputs and advice on how to improve the management of their farms.

ext.ext_en: Few women can understand a grown man's love of sport...

defs.def_cn: 恐旷症的;患公共场所恐惧症的
defs.def_en: Someone who is agoraphobic suffers from agoraphobia.

defs.def_en: If someone has a gift for doing something, they have a natural ability for doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 8页打印稿
ext.ext_en: ...eight pages of hard copy.

defs.def_en: A hard copy of a document is a printed version of it, rather than a version that is stored on a computer.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可怕的;令人惊叹的;艰巨的

ext.ext_cn: 我们面临着一项艰巨的任务。
ext.ext_en: We have a formidable task ahead of us...

ext.ext_cn: 马萨利斯在爵士乐和古典音乐领域都有极高的声望。
ext.ext_en: Marsalis has a formidable reputation in both jazz and classical music...

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as formidable, you mean that you feel slightly frightened by them because they are very great or impressive.

ext.ext_cn: 男孩已脱离生命危险，但病情仍很严重。
ext.ext_en: The boy's condition has been downgraded from critical to serious...

ext.ext_cn: 在争取更多平等的运动中，女性角色完全被贬低了。
ext.ext_en: The female role has been downgraded altogether in the drive for greater equality.

defs.def_en: If something is downgraded, it is given less importance than it used to have or than you think it should have.

ext.ext_cn: 在被降职前她的工作从未受过批评。
ext.ext_en: There was no criticism of her work until after she was downgraded...

ext.ext_cn: 他的上司先将他暂时停职，随后把他降职。
ext.ext_en: His superiors suspended him, and then downgraded him.

defs.def_en: If someone is downgraded, their job or status is changed so that they become less important or receive less money.

ext.ext_cn: 外长们正在莫斯科市中心富丽堂皇的十月酒店里开会。
ext.ext_en: The foreign ministers are meeting in the splendour of Oktyabrskaya Hotel in central Moscow.

defs.def_en: The splendour of something is its beautiful and impressive appearance.

ext.ext_cn: 法国宫廷的豪华给蒙塔古留下了很深的印象。
ext.ext_en: Montagu was extremely impressed by the splendours of the French court.

defs.def_en: The splendours of a place or way of life are its beautiful and impressive features.

ext.ext_cn: 美丽的月夜
ext.ext_en: ...a beautiful moonlit night.

defs.def_en: Something that is moonlit is lit by moonlight.
An albatross is a very large white seabird.

defs.def_cn: 沉重的负担；无法摆脱的苦恼；障碍

ext.ext_cn: 私有化可能会成为该执政党一个难以摆脱的政治障碍。
ext.ext_en: Privatization could become a political albatross for the ruling party.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as an albatross around your neck, you mean that they cause you great problems from which you cannot escape, or they prevent you from doing what you want to do.

ext.ext_cn: 各地政务委员会被要求编制一份该地区成年居民的名册。
ext.ext_en: Councils were required to compile a register of all adults living in their areas...

ext.ext_cn: 编这本书花了10年时间。
ext.ext_en: The book took 10 years to compile...

defs.def_en: When you compile something such as a report, book, or programme, you produce it by collecting and putting together many pieces of information.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她突然变得激动狂躁，四处乱跳还大喊大叫。
ext.ext_en: She suddenly became very vehement and agitated, jumping around and shouting...

ext.ext_cn: 其中一位言辞激烈的评论家是迈克尔·霍华德。
ext.ext_en: One vehement critic is Michael Howard...

defs.def_en: If a person or their actions or comments are vehement, the person has very strong feelings or opinions and expresses them forcefully.

ext.ext_cn: 第一期有一张随刊附赠的 CD-ROM。
ext.ext_en: The first issue has a cover-mounted CD-ROM.

defs.def_en: Cover-mounted items such as cassettes, videos and CDs are attached to the front of a magazine as free gifts.

defs.def_cn: 吹口哨；用口哨吹出(曲调)

ext.ext_cn: 他吹口哨并唱了几段小曲。
ext.ext_en: He whistled and sang snatches of songs...

ext.ext_cn: 他轻声吹着口哨。
ext.ext_en: He was whistling softly to himself...

defs.def_en: When you whistle or when you whistle a tune, you make a series of musical notes by forcing your breath out between your lips, or your teeth.

defs.def_cn: (吃惊、唤狗、赞叹等时)发出口哨声

ext.ext_cn: 他吹了声口哨，很是惊讶但没有被吓住。
ext.ext_en: He whistled, surprised but not shocked...

ext.ext_cn: 詹金斯吹了声口哨，最终被打动了。
ext.ext_en: Jenkins whistled through his teeth, impressed at last...

defs.def_en: See also:wolf-whistle;When someone whistles, they make a sound by forcing their breath out between their lips or their teeth. People sometimes whistle when they are surprised or shocked, or to call a dog, or to show that they are impressed.

defs.def_cn: (火车)鸣汽笛；(水开时水壶)发出尖啸声

ext.ext_cn: 不知哪里的火车在鸣汽笛。
ext.ext_en: Somewhere a train whistled...

ext.ext_cn: 车载收音机的尖啸声
ext.ext_en: ...the whistling car radio.

defs.def_en: If something such as a train or a kettle whistles, it makes a loud, high sound.

ext.ext_cn: 风呼啸着穿过大楼。
ext.ext_en: The wind was whistling through the building...

ext.ext_cn: 我起身时一颗子弹嗖的一声从我背后擦过。
ext.ext_en: As I stood up a bullet whistled past my back.

defs.def_en: If something such as the wind or a bullet whistles somewhere, it moves there, making a loud, high sound.

defs.def_cn: (空气或液流通过狭窄孔洞时发出的)呼啸声;(物体在空气中快速移动时的)呼呼声

ext.ext_cn: 休听着火车呼啸而过。
ext.ext_en: Hugh listened to the whistle of a train.

ext.ext_cn: 呼啸的风声
ext.ext_en: ...the whistle of the wind.

defs.def_en: A whistle is a loud sound produced by air or steam being forced through a small opening, or by something moving quickly through the air.

ext.ext_cn: 平台上的警卫吹响了哨子。
ext.ext_en: On the platform, the guard blew his whistle...

ext.ext_cn: 裁判鸣哨判罚。
ext.ext_en: The referee blew his whistle for a penalty.

defs.def_en: A whistle is a small metal tube which you blow in order to produce a loud sound and attract someone's attention.

ext.ext_cn: 每晚你都会听见炼钢厂的下班哨声。
ext.ext_en: Every night you could hear the whistles of the steel mill.

defs.def_en: Some factories and other places where people work have a whistle which signals the beginning and the end of the working day.
See also:tin whistle;A whistle is a simple musical instrument in the shape of a metal pipe with holes.

ext.ext_cn: 公司应该保护那些检举不诚实的工友及工作行为的员工。
ext.ext_en: Companies should protect employees who blow the whistle on dishonest workmates and work practices.

defs.def_en: See also:whistle-blower;If you blow the whistle on someone, or on something secret or illegal, you tell another person, especially a person in authority, what is happening.

ext.ext_cn: “他希望有警卫护送。”——“那他是指望不上了。”
ext.ext_en: 'He wants a police escort.' — 'Well, he can whistle for that.'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone can whistle for a particular thing, you mean that you are not willing or able to give it to them.
If you describe something as clean as a whistle, you mean that it is completely clean.

ext.ext_cn: “他的私生活没有任何污点，”麦克史密斯说。
ext.ext_en: 'His private life is as clean as a whistle,' says McSmith.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as clean as a whistle, you mean that they are not guilty of having done anything wrong.

defs.def_cn: 借吹口哨壮胆;故作镇定

ext.ext_cn: 之后我开始等待，并竭力保持镇定，可是恐惧和焦虑却丝毫没有消减。
ext.ext_en: Then I waited, trying not to feel as if I were whistling in the dark, but I experienced no easing of my fear and anxiety.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is whistling in the dark, you mean that they are trying to remain brave and convince themselves that the situation is not as bad as it seems.
To wet your whistle means to have a drink.

ext.ext_cn: 自由民主党领导人指责首相鼓舞保守党士气之举根本就是徒劳。
ext.ext_en: The leader of the Liberal Democrats accused the Prime Minister of whistling in the wind to raise Conservative party morale.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as whistling in the wind, you mean that they are trying unsuccessfully to change something which cannot be changed.
A casino is a building or room where people play gambling games such as roulette.
A stillbirth is the birth of a dead baby.

ext.ext_cn: 电暖炉的火刚开始烧着他的裤腿。
ext.ext_en: The electric fire had begun to singe the bottoms of his trousers...

ext.ext_cn: 她头发烧焦了，带风帽的夹克也烧掉了。
ext.ext_en: Her hair was singed and her anorak was burnt...

defs.def_en: If you singe something or if it singes, it burns very slightly and changes colour but does not catch fire.
A periscope is a vertical tube which people inside submarines can look through to see above the surface of the water.
A tea cosy is a soft knitted or fabric cover which you put over a teapot in order to keep the tea hot.
Acetic acid is a colourless acid. It is the main substance in vinegar.

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚，他谴责了英国那位“抨击我们自己人的天才”。
ext.ext_en: He last night denounced the British 'genius for running ourselves down'.

ext.ext_cn: 抨击公立学校的那个家伙
ext.ext_en: ...that chap who was running down state schools.

defs.def_en: If you run people or things down, you criticize them strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 瑞典政府正自私自利地削减本国的福利。
ext.ext_en: The government is cynically running down Swe-den's welfare system...

ext.ext_cn: 可售出或削减房地产业务。
ext.ext_en: The property business could be sold or run down.

defs.def_en: If people run down an industry or an organization, they deliberately reduce its size or the amount of work that it does.

ext.ext_cn: 但是调查也显示，各公司正在减少库存，而没有生产新的产品。
ext.ext_en: But the survey also revealed firms were running down stocks instead of making new products...

ext.ext_cn: 其2,500万美元的储备金已被减少到了800万美元左右。
ext.ext_en: Its $25m reserve fund had been run down to around $8m.

defs.def_en: If someone runs down an amount of something, they reduce it or allow it to decrease.

ext.ext_cn: 洛扎诺声称克莱门特·劳埃德骑着摩托车想把他撞伤。
ext.ext_en: Lozano claimed that motorcycle driver Clement Lloyd was trying to run him down.

defs.def_en: If a vehicle or its driver runs someone down, the vehicle hits them and injures them.

defs.def_cn: (机器或设备等)逐渐损耗，效能降低

ext.ext_cn: 这些电池快没电了。
ext.ext_en: The batteries are running down.

defs.def_en: If a machine or device runs down, it gradually loses power or works more slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 派遣警察和军队支援
ext.ext_en: ...the despatch of police and troop reinforcements.

defs.def_en: Reinforcements are soldiers or policemen who are sent to join an army or group of police in order to make it stronger.

ext.ext_cn: 我相信这次会议将会促进世界范围内的和平与安全。
ext.ext_en: I am sure that this meeting will contribute to the reinforcement of peace and security all over the world...

ext.ext_cn: 现在老师要做的是避免这种不良行为更加严重。
ext.ext_en: What the teacher now has to do is remove the reinforcement for this bad behaviour...

defs.def_en: The reinforcement of something is the process of making it stronger.

ext.ext_cn: 他大部分零花钱都用来买PS游戏了。
ext.ext_en: He spends most of his pocket money on PlayStation games.

defs.def_en: A PlayStation is a type of games console.

ext.ext_cn: 他患了严重的流感，尚未痊愈。
ext.ext_en: He was recovering from a severe bout of flu...

ext.ext_cn: 我感到一阵紧张。
ext.ext_en: I was suffering with a bout of nerves.

defs.def_en: If you have a bout of an illness or of an unpleasant feeling, you have it for a short period.

defs.def_cn: （不愉快之事大量发生的）一阵，一小段时间

ext.ext_cn: 最近发生的一起暴力事件造成24人死亡。
ext.ext_en: The latest bout of violence has claimed twenty four lives...

ext.ext_cn: 每天散步半小时会比一周剧烈运动一次对身体更有益。
ext.ext_en: A half-hour daily walk can be more beneficial than one hard bout of exercise a week.

defs.def_en: A bout of something that is unpleasant is a short time during which it occurs a great deal.

ext.ext_cn: 这将是他19个月里的第8次卫冕赛。
ext.ext_en: This will be his eighth title bout in 19 months.

defs.def_en: A bout is a boxing or wrestling match.

defs.def_cn: （当about的第一个音节不发音时，有些作家以’bout或bout替代about）

ext.ext_cn: 来点儿咖啡吗？
ext.ext_en: How 'bout some coffee?...

ext.ext_cn: 我想我就是觉得有必要对此写点儿什么。
ext.ext_en: I just felt the need to write bout it, I guess.

defs.def_en: Some writers use  'bout or bout to represent about when the first syllable is not pronounced.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 鲜红的连衣裙
ext.ext_en: ...a bright red dress.

ext.ext_cn: 参加白金汉宫阅兵式的卫兵们色彩鲜艳的制服
ext.ext_en: ...the bright uniforms of the guards parading at Buckingham Palace.

defs.def_en: A bright colour is strong and noticeable, and not dark.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 10月的一天，天气晴朗
ext.ext_en: ...a bright October day...

ext.ext_cn: 她身体前倾，眼里闪动着兴奋的光芒。
ext.ext_en: She leaned forward, her eyes bright with excitement.

defs.def_en: A bright light, object, or place is shining strongly or is full of light.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我确信他比一般人聪明。
ext.ext_en: I was convinced that he was brighter than average.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as bright, you mean that they are quick at learning things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 许多书里都有很多绝妙的想法。
ext.ext_en: There are lots of books crammed with bright ideas...

ext.ext_cn: 福特公司想出了付给工人足够的薪水去购买汽车这一绝妙的主意。
ext.ext_en: Ford had the bright idea of paying workers enough to buy cars.

defs.def_en: A bright idea is clever and original.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个男孩活泼开朗，充满活力。
ext.ext_en: The boy was so bright and animated...

ext.ext_cn: “请问您需要什么帮助？”电话里传出一个充满活力的美国人的声音。
ext.ext_en: 'May I help you?' said a bright American voice over the telephone.

defs.def_en: If someone looks or sounds bright, they look or sound cheerful and lively.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 两个人都事业有成，前程似锦。
ext.ext_en: Both had successful careers and the future looked bright...

ext.ext_cn: 综合性的社区具有比以前更加光明的前景。
ext.ext_en: There are much brighter prospects for a comprehensive settlement than before.

defs.def_en: If the future is bright, it is likely to be pleasant or successful.

defs.def_cn: （汽车或其他车辆）打开的前灯
defs.def_en: The brights on a car or other vehicle are the headlights when they are switched on fully.

defs.def_cn: 看光明的一面；抱乐观态度
defs.def_en: If you look on the bright side, you try to be cheerful about a bad situation by thinking of some advantages that could result from it, or thinking that it is not as bad as it could have been.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 白色紧身衬衫
ext.ext_en: ...a white tailored shirt.

defs.def_en: Tailored clothes are designed to fit close to the body, rather than being loose.

ext.ext_cn: 检查手术切片，以判断是否为恶性。
ext.ext_en: Tissue that is removed during the operation is checked for signs of malignancy.

ext.ext_cn: 恶性皮肤癌
ext.ext_en: ...cancerous malignancies of the skin.

defs.def_en: A tumour or disease in a state of malignancy is out of control and is likely to cause death.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他未能制定出一条连贯的策略来实现服务的现代化。
ext.ext_en: He has failed to work out a coherent strategy for modernising the service...

ext.ext_cn: 总统的政策环环相扣，浑然一体。
ext.ext_en: The President's policy is perfectly coherent.

defs.def_en: If something is coherent, it is well planned, so that it is clear and sensible and all its parts go well with each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他在面试中回答问题时非常从容镇静。我希望自己也能那样条理清晰。
ext.ext_en: He's so calm when he answers questions in interviews. I wish I could be that coherent.

defs.def_en: If someone is coherent, they express their thoughts in a clear and calm way, so that other people can understand what they are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 我们会密切注意事情的任何进展。
ext.ext_en: We'll be watching for any developments...

ext.ext_cn: 他冲他们大喊，叫他们小心哑雷。
ext.ext_en: He called out to them to watch out for the unexploded mine.

defs.def_en: If you watch for something or watch out for it, you pay attention so that you notice it, either because you do not want to miss it or because you want to avoid it.

ext.ext_cn: 在价格低廉的城郊超市购物
ext.ext_en: ...shopping at cheaper, out-of-town supermarkets.

defs.def_en: Out-of-town shops or facilities are situated away from the centre of a town or city.

ext.ext_cn: 供外地来客下榻的豪华旅馆
ext.ext_en: ...a deluxe hotel for out-of-town visitors.

defs.def_en: Out-of-town is used to describe people who do not live in a particular town or city, but have travelled there for a particular purpose.

defs.def_cn: （动植物）自然生长的，野生的，野的

ext.ext_cn: 我们看见又有两只野猫在黑暗中悄悄向我们靠近。
ext.ext_en: We saw two more wild cats creeping towards us in the darkness...

ext.ext_cn: 小路两边都是野花。
ext.ext_en: The lane was lined with wild flowers.

defs.def_en: Wild animals or plants live or grow in natural surroundings and are not looked after by people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 埃尔姆利是东南部仅存的几块荒地之一。
ext.ext_en: Elmley is one of the few wild areas remaining in the South East.

defs.def_en: Wild land is natural and is not used by people.

ext.ext_cn: 他们到加拿大的荒野之地去划独木舟。
ext.ext_en: They went canoeing in the wilds of Canada.

defs.def_en: The wilds of a place are the natural areas that are far away from towns.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有暴风雨的;多风暴的;狂风暴雨的

ext.ext_cn: 尽管风雨交加，一些人还是会下海游泳。
ext.ext_en: The wild weather did not deter some people from swimming in the sea.

defs.def_en: Wild is used to describe the weather or the sea when it is stormy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们欣喜若狂。
ext.ext_en: The children are wild with joy...

ext.ext_cn: 乔治本人走上台时，他们都变得十分狂热。
ext.ext_en: As George himself came on stage they went wild...

defs.def_en: Wild behaviour is uncontrolled, excited, or energetic.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以约束的;不受控制的;放荡的;无节制的

ext.ext_cn: 但愤怒或激动的时候，他也会发狂、会骂人、令人生畏。
ext.ext_en: When angry or excited, however, he could be wild, profane, and terrifying...

ext.ext_cn: 她过去的生活极其放纵。
ext.ext_en: She lived a wild and incredible life...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or their behaviour as wild, you mean that they behave in a very uncontrolled way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 很长时间我都不敢告诉他我知道了，但当我告诉他时，他简直气疯了。
ext.ext_en: For a long time I daren't tell him I knew, and when I did he went wild.

defs.def_en: If someone is wild, they are very angry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (因恐惧、愤怒或精神失常而)双目圆睁的，眼睛瞪大的

ext.ext_cn: 她现在可以看见他的脸了，他的眼睛瞪得溜圆，皮肤上闪着汗水。
ext.ext_en: She could see his face now, his eyes wild and his skin glistening with perspiration...

ext.ext_cn: 我忘不了他圆睁的双眼。
ext.ext_en: I could not forget the wild look in his eyes.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has wild eyes or a wild look, you mean that their eyes are wide open and staring because they are frightened, angry, or insane.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （想法）非同寻常的，极端的;(猜测)未经思索的，胡乱的

ext.ext_cn: 我不过是个孩子，充满各种奇异的想法。
ext.ext_en: I was just a kid and full of all sorts of wild ideas...

ext.ext_cn: 勃朗宁的预测不过是妄加猜测而已。
ext.ext_en: Browning's prediction is no better than a wild guess.

defs.def_en: A wild idea is unusual or extreme. A wild guess is one that you make without much thought.

ext.ext_cn: 我为彼得疯狂，他对我也一样。

ext.ext_cn: 艾琳非常喜欢这出戏。
ext.ext_en: Irene was wild about the play.

defs.def_en: If you are wild about someone or something, you like them very much.

defs.def_cn: 在自然环境中；处于野生状态

ext.ext_en: Fewer than a thousand giant pandas still live in the wild.

defs.def_en: Animals that live in the wild live in a free and natural state and are not looked after by people.

defs.def_cn: （事物）疯狂发展；（尤指小孩）恣意妄为，失去控制

ext.ext_en: Molly has let that girl run wild.

defs.def_en: If something or someone, especially a child, runs wild, they behave in a natural, free, or uncontrolled way.
A riddle is a puzzle or joke in which you ask a question that seems to be nonsense but which has a clever or amusing answer.

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们昨天声称已经解开了宇宙形成之谜。
ext.ext_en: Scientists claimed yesterday to have solved the riddle of the birth of the Universe.

defs.def_en: You can describe something as a riddle if people have been trying to understand or explain it but have not been able to.

defs.def_cn: （用子弹）把…打得到处是洞，使满是弹孔

ext.ext_cn: 来路不明的袭击者用枪炮将两处住宅打得千疮百孔。
ext.ext_en: Unknown attackers riddled two homes with gunfire...

ext.ext_cn: 身处黑暗中让我不至于被子弹打得浑身是洞。
ext.ext_en: The darkness saved me from being riddled with bullets.

defs.def_en: If someone riddles something with bullets or bullet holes, they fire a lot of bullets into it.

defs.def_cn: 踢足球的人;(尤指)足球运动员
defs.def_en: A footballer is a person who plays football, especially as a profession.
A pick-up or a pick-up truck is a small truck with low sides that can be easily loaded and unloaded.

ext.ext_cn: 房地产市场的回暖
ext.ext_en: ...a pick-up in the housing market...

ext.ext_en: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.

defs.def_en: A pick-up in trade or in a country's economy is an improvement in it.

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司在大部分城市都有提货点。
ext.ext_en: The company had pick-up points in most cities...

ext.ext_cn: 火车从滑铁卢站出发，途中会在阿什福德站停靠上人。
ext.ext_en: Trains will operate from Waterloo with a pick-up stop at Ashford.

defs.def_en: A pick-up takes place when someone picks up a person or thing that is waiting to be collected.

defs.def_cn: （以发生性关系为目的的）搭识，搭讪

ext.ext_cn: 他们已来到了世界上最著名的调情场所。
ext.ext_en: They had come to the world's most famous pick-up joint.

defs.def_en: When a pick-up takes place, someone talks to a person in a friendly way in the hope of having a casual sexual relationship with them.

defs.def_cn: (国有企业等的)出售;(公司股票的)抛售

ext.ext_cn: 电力行业的私有化——其中最大的一笔出售
ext.ext_en: The privatisation of the electricity industry — the biggest sell-off of them all...

ext.ext_cn: 任何俄罗斯的土地或资产都不可出售。
ext.ext_en: There is no question of any 'sell-off' of Russian land or assets.

defs.def_en: The sell-off of something, for example an industry owned by the state or a company's shares, is the selling of it.
A podium is a small platform on which someone stands in order to give a lecture or conduct an orchestra.

defs.def_cn: 在（摩托车或自行车的）后座上

ext.ext_cn: 她坐在儿子摩托车的后座上。
ext.ext_en: She rode pillion on her son's motor bike.

defs.def_en: If someone rides pillion on a motorcycle or bicycle, they sit behind the person who is controlling it.

ext.ext_cn: 作为摩托车初学者，切勿后座载人。
ext.ext_en: As a learner rider you must not carry a pillion passenger.

defs.def_en: On a motorcycle, the pillion is the seat or part behind the rider.

ext.ext_cn: 评论家谴责他煽动群众。
ext.ext_en: Critics have accused him of rabble-rousing.

defs.def_en: Rabble-rousing is encouragement that a person gives to a group of people to behave violently or aggressively, often for that person's own political advantage.

defs.def_cn: （英国政府为无收入或低收入人群提供的）住房补助
defs.def_en: In Britain, housing benefit is money that the government gives to people with no income or very low incomes to pay for part or all of their rent.

defs.def_cn: 上层阶级；上等阶层；上流社会

ext.ext_cn: 专门为迎合上流社会品位而设计的商品
ext.ext_en: ...goods specifically designed to appeal to the tastes of the upper class...

ext.ext_cn: 英国的上流社会许多人已不再富得流油。
ext.ext_en: Many of the British upper classes are no longer very rich.

defs.def_en: The upper class or the upper classes are the group of people in a society who own the most property and have the highest social status, and who may not need to work for money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他已经是英国最高级俱乐部的成员了。
ext.ext_en: He is already a member of Britain's most exclusive club...

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦城被指责过于奢华和缺乏竞争力。
ext.ext_en: The City was criticised for being too exclusive and uncompetitive.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as exclusive, you mean that it is limited to people who have a lot of money or who belong to a high social class, and is therefore not available to everyone.

ext.ext_cn: 我们小组将独用一条60英尺长的船。
ext.ext_en: Our group will have exclusive use of a 60-foot boat...

ext.ext_cn: 在英国，他们生产的奶酪很多只在我们商店出售。
ext.ext_en: Many of their cheeses are exclusive to our stores in Britain.

defs.def_en: Something that is exclusive is used or owned by only one person or group, and not shared with anyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 他在接受一家杂志社的独家采访时说：“我所有的问题都是饮酒造成的。”
ext.ext_en: He told the magazine in an exclusive interview: 'All my problems stem from drink'.

ext.ext_cn: 一些报纸认为自己是独家报道。
ext.ext_en: Some papers thought they had an exclusive.

defs.def_en: If a newspaper, magazine, or broadcasting organization describes one of its reports as exclusive, they mean that it is a special report which does not appear in any other publication or on any other channel.

ext.ext_cn: 所有服务费都不包括增值税。
ext.ext_en: All charges for service are exclusive of value added tax...

ext.ext_cn: 周末滑雪价格为58英镑（不含交通和住宿费）。
ext.ext_en: Skiing weekends cost £58 (exclusive of travel and accommodation).

defs.def_en: If a company states that its prices, goods, or services are exclusive of something, that thing is not included in the stated price, although it usually still has to be paid for.

defs.def_cn: 相互排斥的;互不相容的

ext.ext_cn: 他们两个人都认识到了追求理想和做个好父亲不能两者兼顾。
ext.ext_en: They both have learnt that ambition and successful fatherhood can be mutually exclusive.

defs.def_en: If two things are mutually exclusive, they are separate and very different from each other, so that it is impossible for them to exist or happen together.
Identical twins are twins of the same sex who look exactly the same.

defs.def_cn: (枪炮、导弹的)齐射，并发;(礼炮的)齐鸣

ext.ext_cn: 奏完国歌后，他们将同时发射空弹。
ext.ext_en: They were to fire a salvo of blanks, after the national anthem.

defs.def_en: A salvo is the firing of several guns or missiles at the same time in a battle or ceremony.

defs.def_cn: (书面或口头的)一连串，一顿，一阵(生气的话)

ext.ext_cn: 然而他的证词只是新一轮唇枪舌剑中的一股火力。
ext.ext_en: His testimony, however, was only one in a salvo of new attacks.

defs.def_en: A salvo of angry words is a lot of them spoken or written at about the same time.
A calendar year is a period of twelve months from January 1 to December 31. Calendar year is often used in business to compare with the financial year .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他主持会议的时候仍旧显示出一贯的好辩作风，拒绝承认任何错误。
ext.ext_en: He conducted the meeting in his usual combative style, refusing to admit any mistakes.

defs.def_en: A person who is combative is aggressive and eager to fight or argue.

ext.ext_cn: 分数在记分牌上亮起。
ext.ext_en: The figures flash up on the scoreboard.

defs.def_en: A scoreboard is a large board, for example at a sports ground or stadium, which shows the score in a match or competition.
Bedsores are sore places on a person's skin, caused by having to lie in bed for a long time without changing position.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 宏伟的;壮丽的;令人印象深刻的

ext.ext_cn: 绿树掩映中的一幢乡间豪宅
ext.ext_en: ...a magnificent country house in wooded grounds.

ext.ext_cn: 圣费尔南多河谷的壮丽美景
ext.ext_en: ...magnificent views over the San Fernando Valley...

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is magnificent, you mean that you think they are extremely good, beautiful, or impressive.

defs.def_cn: 英国人（美国英语或旧式英国英语中的非正式说法）
defs.def_en: In American English or old-fashioned British English, British people are sometimes informally referred to as Britishers .

defs.def_cn: 公正的;无偏见的;公允的

ext.ext_cn: 她是我所认识的最公正的人之一。
ext.ext_en: She is one of the most fair-minded people I know.

defs.def_en: A fair-minded person always tries to be fair and reasonable, and always listens to other people's opinions.
Honey is a sweet, sticky, yellowish substance that is made by bees.

ext.ext_cn: 亲爱的，我不认为那是个好主意。
ext.ext_en: Honey, I don't really think that's a good idea.

defs.def_en: You call someone honey as a sign of affection.

ext.ext_cn: 机场地勤人员试图阻止这位飞行员驾机起飞。
ext.ext_en: The airport ground crew tried to dissuade the pilot from taking off.

defs.def_en: At an airport, the people who look after the planes when they are on the ground are called the ground crew.

ext.ext_cn: 陶壶
ext.ext_en: ...earthenware pots.

defs.def_en: Earthenware bowls, pots, or other objects are made of clay that is baked so that it becomes hard.

ext.ext_cn: 五颜六色的意大利陶瓷器皿
ext.ext_en: ...colourful Italian china and earthenware.

defs.def_en: Earthenware objects are referred to as earthenware .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 弥漫着硫黄味的;含有硫黄的

ext.ext_cn: 含硫黄的火山气体
ext.ext_en: ...sulphurous volcanic gases.

ext.ext_cn: 硫黄泉
ext.ext_en: ...a sulphurous spring.

defs.def_en: Sulphurous air or places contain sulphur or smell of sulphur.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不负责任的;无责任感的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为鼓吹毒品合法化是不负责任的行为。
ext.ext_en: I felt that it was irresponsible to advocate the legalisation of drugs...

ext.ext_cn: 若我不建议公司放弃这个项目，那我就是不负责任。
ext.ext_en: It would be irresponsible of me not to advise my company to abandon this project...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as irresponsible, you are criticizing them because they do things without properly considering their possible consequences.
A piranha is a small, fierce fish which is found in South America.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
