ext.ext_en: Disposable nappies are fairly straightforward to put on...

ext.ext_cn: 这个问题看起来够简单的。
ext.ext_en: The question seemed straightforward enough.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她非常直率，很坦诚，也非常诚实。
ext.ext_en: She is very blunt, very straightforward and very honest...

ext.ext_cn: 我很欣赏他的坦率和睿智。
ext.ext_en: I was impressed by his straightforward intelligent manner.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as straightforward, you approve of them because they are honest and direct, and do not try to hide their feelings.
A convector heater is a heater that heats a room by means of hot air.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 迷上戏剧表演的;一心想当演员的
defs.def_en: Someone who is stage-struck is fascinated by the theatre and wants to become an actor or actress.

ext.ext_cn: 有些裹糖的谷物食品含糖量达 50%。
ext.ext_en: Some sugar-coated cereals are 50% sugar.

ext.ext_cn: 裹糖的爆米花
ext.ext_en: ...sugar-coated popcorn.

defs.def_en: Sugar-coated food is covered with a sweet substance made of sugar.

defs.def_cn: 巧作粉饰的;经过美化的

ext.ext_cn: 对男孩首次接触性所持的冠冕堂皇的看法
ext.ext_en: ...a sugar-coated view of a boy's introduction to sex.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a story as sugar-coated, you disapprove of it because it appears to be pleasant or attractive but in fact describes something very unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: （公学毕业生的）校友裙带，校友间的互相关照

ext.ext_cn: 校友关系当然是帮了忙的。
ext.ext_en: Of course, the old school tie has been a help.

defs.def_en: When people talk about the old school tie, they are referring to the situation in which people who attended the same public school use their positions of influence to help each other.

ext.ext_cn: 二氧化碳气体通过这个切口进入，造成腹腔肿胀。
ext.ext_en: Through this incision, the abdominal cavity is distended with carbon dioxide gas...

ext.ext_cn: 结肠，或大肠，因充满气体而膨胀。
ext.ext_en: The colon, or large intestine, distends and fills with gas.

defs.def_en: If a part of your body is distended, or if it distends, it becomes swollen and unnaturally large.

ext.ext_cn: 许多乘客骨折。
ext.ext_en: Many passengers suffered broken bones...

ext.ext_cn: 斯蒂芬断了一根股骨。
ext.ext_en: Stephen fractured a thigh bone...

defs.def_en: Your bones are the hard parts inside your body which together form your skeleton.

ext.ext_cn: 剔鸡腿骨时切勿戳破外面的皮。
ext.ext_en: Make sure that you do not pierce the skin when boning the chicken thighs...

ext.ext_cn: 剔了刺的鱼很容易烹制。
ext.ext_en: The boned fish is so easy to serve.

defs.def_en: If you bone a piece of meat or fish, you remove the bones from it before cooking it.

ext.ext_cn: 昂贵的骨柄小折刀
ext.ext_en: ...a small, expensive pocketknife with a bone handle.

defs.def_en: A bone tool or ornament is made of bone.

ext.ext_cn: 这儿连个花园的影子都没有——我什么也没看到。
ext.ext_en: There are not even the bare bones of a garden here — I've got nothing.

defs.def_en: The bare bones of something are its most basic parts or details.

defs.def_cn: 太过直白；过于直率；露骨
defs.def_en: If something is too close to the bone, it makes you feel uncomfortable because it is very close to the truth or to the real nature of something.

ext.ext_cn: 直觉告诉我情况不太对头。
ext.ext_en: I've got a feeling in my bones that things are not quite right.

defs.def_en: If you say that you feel or know something in your bones, you are indicating that you are certain about it, although you cannot explain why.

ext.ext_cn: 他们中的一些人坦率地表达了自己的政治观点。
ext.ext_en: Some of them make no bones about their political views.

defs.def_en: If you make no bones about something, you talk openly about it, rather than trying to keep it a secret.

defs.def_cn: 毫不犹豫；毫不迟疑；二话不说

ext.ext_cn: 当戴德利对他表示支持时，斯塔福德-克拉克毫不迟疑地再次申请了这份工作。
ext.ext_en: Stafford-Clark made no bones about reapplying for the job when Daldry was standing for it.

defs.def_en: If you make no bones about doing something that is unpleasant or difficult or that might upset someone else, you do it without hesitating.

defs.def_cn: 瘦得皮包骨头；瘦骨嶙峋

ext.ext_cn: 他瘦得只剩皮包骨头了。
ext.ext_en: He was nothing but skin and bones.

defs.def_en: You can say someone is just skin and bone when you do not approve of the fact that they are very thin.

defs.def_cn: （削减）达到最低限度，到最小化

ext.ext_cn: 它通过最大限度地降低运营成本生存了下来。
ext.ext_en: It has survived by cutting its costs to the bone...

ext.ext_cn: 为了维持资金周转，利润率已被降为最低。
ext.ext_en: Profit margins have been slashed to the bone in an attempt to keep turnover moving.

defs.def_en: If something such as costs are cut to the bone, they are reduced to the minimum possible.

ext.ext_cn: 我看到的景象令我不寒而栗。
ext.ext_en: What I saw chilled me to the bone.

defs.def_en: You use to the bone to indicate that you are very deeply affected by something. For example, if you feel chilled to the bone, your whole body feels extremely cold, often because you have had a shock.

ext.ext_cn: 航天器和太空交通工具的设计和工程制造
ext.ext_en: ...the design and engineering of aircraft and space vehicles.

ext.ext_cn: 有工程学学位的毕业生
ext.ext_en: ...graduates with degrees in engineering.

defs.def_en: See also:chemical engineering;civil engineering;electrical engineering;genetic engineering;Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

ext.ext_cn: 他那36英尺长的游艇去年夏天突然沉没了。
ext.ext_en: His 36ft yacht sank suddenly last summer.

ext.ext_cn: 环球帆船比赛
ext.ext_en: ...a round-the-world yacht race.

defs.def_en: A yacht is a large boat with sails or a motor, used for racing or pleasure trips.

defs.def_cn: (事物成长和发展的)环境，背景

ext.ext_cn: 他们文明的摇篮
ext.ext_en: ...the matrix of their culture.

defs.def_en: A matrix is the environment or context in which something such as a society develops and grows.
In mathematics, a matrix is an arrangement of numbers, symbols, or letters in rows and columns which is used in solving mathematical problems.
An anti-depressant is a drug which is used to treat people who are suffering from depression.

defs.def_cn: 使人放松（或快乐）的事物;解忧良药

ext.ext_cn: 锻炼能够使人一扫阴霾。
ext.ext_en: Exercise is a powerful antidepressant.

defs.def_en: You can use anti-depressant to talk about something that makes people feel happier and more relaxed.

ext.ext_cn: 他极富正义感和公平意识。
ext.ext_en: He has a good overall sense of justice and fairness...

ext.ext_cn: 他只要自由、公正和平等。
ext.ext_en: He only wants freedom, justice and equality...

defs.def_en: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

defs.def_cn: （理由、要求或论点的）合理，正当，正确，公道

ext.ext_cn: 我们属于少数群体，必须赢得人们对我们的正义事业的支持。
ext.ext_en: We are a minority and must win people round to the justice of our cause.

defs.def_en: The justice of a cause, claim, or argument is its quality of being reasonable, fair, or right.

ext.ext_cn: 多伦多的黑人群体中有很多人觉得司法制度对待他们有失公正。
ext.ext_en: Many in Toronto's black community feel that the justice system does not treat them fairly...

ext.ext_cn: 律师是司法体系的一部分。
ext.ext_en: A lawyer is part of the machinery of justice.

defs.def_en: Justice is the legal system that a country uses in order to deal with people who break the law.

ext.ext_cn: 托马斯今天将宣誓就任最高法院法官。
ext.ext_en: Thomas will be sworn in today as a justice on the Supreme Court.

defs.def_en: A justice is a judge.

ext.ext_cn: 今天法官哈奇森先生本来要主持一项预审，但暂时休庭了。
ext.ext_en: A preliminary hearing was due to start today before Mr Justice Hutchison, but was adjourned.

defs.def_en: Justice is used before the names of judges.

defs.def_cn: 将…绳之以法；把…缉拿归案

ext.ext_cn: 他们要求将责任人缉拿归案。
ext.ext_en: They demanded that those responsible be brought to justice...

ext.ext_cn: 她需要有证据才能将贾森绳之以法。
ext.ext_en: She'd need proof to bring Jason to justice.

defs.def_en: If a criminal is brought to justice, he or she is punished for a crime by being arrested and tried in a court of law.

defs.def_cn: 准确地再现；逼真地重现

ext.ext_cn: 我看到的那张照片把她拍得走样了。
ext.ext_en: The photograph I had seen didn't  do her justice...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数电视机的音质不好，无法播出原来的音乐效果。
ext.ext_en: Most TV sets don't have the sound quality to do justice to the music.

defs.def_en: To do justice to a person or thing means to reproduce them accurately and show how good they are.

defs.def_cn: 妥善应付；恰当处理；尽力全面做好

ext.ext_cn: 没有哪一篇文章能把欺诈这一话题讲得恰到好处。
ext.ext_en: No one article can ever do justice to the topic of fraud...

ext.ext_cn: 在这里不可能完整地论述古罗马军团复杂的历史。
ext.ext_en: It is impossible here to do justice to the complex history of the Legion.

defs.def_en: If you do justice to someone or something, you deal with them properly and completely.

defs.def_cn: 充分发挥能力；尽最大的努力

ext.ext_cn: 我认为他为英格兰队效力时不可能充分发挥自己的水平。
ext.ext_en: I don't think he could do himself justice playing for England...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为我不会获胜，但我会尽自己最大的努力。
ext.ext_en: I don't think I can win, but I want to do myself justice.

defs.def_en: If you do yourself justice, you do something as well as you are capable of doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 电视庭审实际上会令审判不公。
ext.ext_en: Trial by television makes for very rough justice indeed.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's treatment or punishment as rough justice, you mean that it is not given according to the law.

ext.ext_cn: 要是他被剥夺了这一意义重大的第三个欧洲冠军头衔，那对他简直是太不公平了。
ext.ext_en: It would have been rough justice had he been deprived of this important third European win.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is rough justice for someone, you mean that they have not been treated fairly.

defs.def_cn: 详细的检查(或审查);仔细的观察

ext.ext_cn: 他的私生活受到媒体的密切关注。
ext.ext_en: His private life came under media scrutiny...

ext.ext_cn: 总统承诺政府将接受公众监督。
ext.ext_en: The President promised a government open to public scrutiny.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is under scrutiny, they are being studied or observed very carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 他被指控为英国间谍，入狱关押了 5 年。
ext.ext_en: He was jailed for five years as an alleged British spy...

ext.ext_cn: 该间谍团伙向敌方传送秘密情报。
ext.ext_en: The spy ring passed secrets to the enemy.

defs.def_en: A spy is a person whose job is to find out secret information about another country or organization.
A spy satellite or spy plane obtains secret information about another country by taking photographs from the sky.

defs.def_cn: 从事间谍活动;充当间谍

ext.ext_cn: 该特工人员为东德做了 20 多年的间谍。
ext.ext_en: The agent spied for East Germany for more than twenty years...

ext.ext_cn: 东西方仍在互相进行间谍活动。
ext.ext_en: East and West are still spying on one another...

defs.def_en: Someone who spies for a country or organization tries to find out secret information about another country or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 那天，他假装在修剪灌木，秘密对她进行监视。
ext.ext_en: That day he spied on her while pretending to work on the shrubs...

ext.ext_cn: 他请人秘密监视自己的妻子，为离婚案搜集证据。
ext.ext_en: He had his wife spied on for evidence in a divorce case.

defs.def_en: If you spy on someone, you watch them secretly.

ext.ext_cn: 他正沿街走着，突然看见了一位老朋友。
ext.ext_en: He was walking down the street when he spied an old friend.

defs.def_en: If you spy someone or something, you notice them.

ext.ext_cn: 他被控劫持一名出租车司机并强迫他开车把一颗炸弹送到唐宁街。
ext.ext_en: He was charged with abducting a taxi driver and forcing him to drive a bomb to Downing Street...

ext.ext_cn: 他在俄罗斯保守议会的压力下被迫辞职。
ext.ext_en: He was forced to resign by Russia's conservative parliament...

defs.def_en: If someone forces you to do something, they make you do it even though you do not want to, for example by threatening you.

ext.ext_cn: 背部受伤使她不得不退出温布尔登赛事。
ext.ext_en: A back injury forced her to withdraw from Wimbledon...

ext.ext_cn: 他右转弯，开到了一条土路上，不得不以四轮驱动行进。
ext.ext_en: He turned right, down a dirt road that forced him into four-wheel drive...

defs.def_en: If a situation or event forces you to do something, it makes it necessary for you to do something that you would not otherwise have done.

ext.ext_cn: 把这份协定强加给这个国家是错误的。
ext.ext_en: To force this agreement on the nation is wrong.

defs.def_en: If someone forces something on or upon you, they make you accept or use it when you would prefer not to.

ext.ext_cn: 他们用力把她的头按到冰冷的水中，想淹死她。
ext.ext_en: They were forcing her head under the icy waters, drowning her.

defs.def_en: If you force something into a particular position, you use a lot of strength to make it move there.

ext.ext_cn: 那一晚，警察强行打开公寓大门，逮捕了罗伯茨先生。
ext.ext_en: That evening police forced the door of the flat and arrested Mr Roberts...

ext.ext_cn: 他试图破窗而入，但是窗户卡死了。
ext.ext_en: He tried to force the window open but it was jammed shut.

defs.def_en: If someone forces a lock, a door, or a window, they break the lock or fastening in order to get into a building without using a key.

ext.ext_cn: 政府决定不使用暴力驱散示威人群。
ext.ext_en: The government decided against using force to break-up the demonstrations.

ext.ext_cn: 游击队使用武力夺取政权的努力
ext.ext_en: ...the guerrillas' efforts to seize power by force.

defs.def_en: If someone uses force to do something, or if it is done by force, strong and violent physical action is taken in order to achieve it.

ext.ext_cn: 爆炸的冲力震碎了几栋楼房的玻璃窗。
ext.ext_en: The force of the explosion shattered the windows of several buildings...

ext.ext_cn: 看上去暴风雨来势汹汹。
ext.ext_en: It looked as though the storm had an awful lot of force.

defs.def_en: Force is the power or strength which something has.

ext.ext_cn: 多年来，军队一直是这个国家最强大的政治力量。
ext.ext_en: For years the army was the most powerful political force in the country...

ext.ext_cn: 这支乐队一如他们刚刚组建时那样是英国音乐界的一支创新力量。
ext.ext_en: The band are still as innovative a force in British music as they were when they started...

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone or something as a force in a particular type of activity, you mean that they have a strong influence on it.

ext.ext_cn: 他通过自己观念的力量改变了我们的世界。
ext.ext_en: He changed our world through the force of his ideas...

ext.ext_cn: 或许是你的雄辩使情况发生了变化。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps your force of argument might have made some difference.

defs.def_en: The force of something is the powerful effect or quality that it has.

ext.ext_cn: 保护人类抵御自然力——传染病、食肉动物、洪水和飓风
ext.ext_en: ...the protection of mankind against the forces of nature: epidemics, predators, floods, hurricanes...

ext.ext_cn: 市场运作的规律被应用到该国某些最具影响力的机构。
ext.ext_en: The principle of market forces was applied to some of the country's most revered institutions...

defs.def_en: You can use forces to refer to processes and events that do not appear to be caused by human beings, and are therefore difficult to understand or control.

ext.ext_cn: 地球的重力
ext.ext_en: ...the earth's gravitational force.

ext.ext_cn: 范艾伦辐射带的磁力俘获的质子和电子
ext.ext_en: ...protons and electrons trapped by magnetic forces in the Van Allen belts.

defs.def_en: In physics, a force is the pulling or pushing effect that something has on something else.

defs.def_cn: (置于数字前表示风力的)级数

ext.ext_cn: 空运在 10 级大风中进行。
ext.ext_en: The airlift was conducted in force ten winds...

ext.ext_cn: 到中午时分北风会加强到 6 级。
ext.ext_en: Northerly winds will increase to force six by midday.

defs.def_en: Force is used before a number to indicate a wind of a particular speed or strength, especially a very strong wind.

ext.ext_cn: 乔强颜欢笑，但内心里感到有些不安。
ext.ext_en: Joe forced a smile, but underneath he was a little disturbed...

ext.ext_cn: “为什么不请我喝一杯？”他问道，勉强笑了笑。
ext.ext_en: 'Why don't you offer me a drink?' he asked, with a forced smile.

defs.def_en: If you force a smile or a laugh, you manage to smile or laugh, but with an effort because you are unhappy.

ext.ext_cn: 美国武装力量在这一地区的部署
ext.ext_en: ...the deployment of American forces in the region.

defs.def_en: Forces are groups of soldiers or military vehicles that are organized for a particular purpose.

defs.def_cn: 军队(指陆海空三军之一或三军)

ext.ext_cn: 在部队里级别越高，最后就越有可能去做文职工作。
ext.ext_en: The more senior you become in the forces, the more likely you are to end up in a desk job.

defs.def_en: The forces means the army, the navy, or the air force, or all three.

ext.ext_cn: 警官很难与警队外面的人交朋友。
ext.ext_en: It was hard for a police officer to make friends outside the force.

defs.def_en: See also:air force;armed forces;labour force;peacekeeping;task force;tour de force;workforce;The force is sometimes used to mean the police force.

ext.ext_cn: 通过辩论说服提出质疑者
ext.ext_en: ...converting the sceptics by force of argument.

ext.ext_cn: 通过武力解放科威特的承诺
ext.ext_en: ...its promise to free Kuwait by force of arms.

defs.def_en: If something happens by force of a particular quality, action, or set of circumstances, it happens because of the nature or intensity of that quality, action, or set of circumstances.

ext.ext_cn: 他出于习惯环顾四周，但是没人注意他。
ext.ext_en: He looked around from force of habit, but nobody paid any attention to him...

ext.ext_cn: 下意识地，她习惯性地把咖啡壶的插头插上了。
ext.ext_en: Unconsciously, by force of habit, she plugged the coffee pot in.

defs.def_en: If you do something from force of habit, you do it because you have always done it in the past, rather than because you have thought carefully about it.

defs.def_cn: (法律、规定或体系)在实施，生效

ext.ext_cn: 尽管新的税法已经生效，你需要等到 12 月才能提出上诉。
ext.ext_en: Although the new tax is already in force, you have until November to lodge an appeal.

defs.def_en: A law, rule, or system that is in force exists or is being used.

ext.ext_cn: 大批选民前来参加他们的第一次多党选举。
ext.ext_en: Voters turned out in force for their first taste of multi-party elections.

defs.def_en: When people do something in force, they do it in large numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 两个团体联合游说投票者赞成给予这个行业税收优惠。
ext.ext_en: Both groups joined forces to persuade voters to approve a tax break for the industry...

ext.ext_cn: 威廉和企业家尼古拉斯·考特联手推出这款新车。
ext.ext_en: William joined forces with businessman Nicholas Court to launch the new vehicle.

defs.def_en: If you join forces with someone, you work together in order to achieve a common aim or purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 矿工们手持棍棒冲过了警戒线。
ext.ext_en: The miners were armed with clubs as they forced their way through a police cordon...

ext.ext_cn: 他冲进一幢房子呼喊求救。
ext.ext_en: He forced his way into a house shouting for help.

defs.def_en: If you force your way through or into somewhere, you have to push or break things that are in your way in order to get there.

ext.ext_cn: 南希强忍泪水。她不会在那些人面前哭的。
ext.ext_en: Nancy forced back tears. She wasn't going to cry in front of all those people.

defs.def_en: If you force back an emotion or desire, you manage, with an effort, not to experience it.

ext.ext_cn: 表格 3.1 是对以上信息的总结。
ext.ext_en: Table 3.1 summarizes the information given above...

ext.ext_cn: 这篇文章基本上可以概述为 3 句话。
ext.ext_en: Basically, the article can be summarized in three sentences...

defs.def_en: If you summarize something, you give a summary of it.

ext.ext_cn: 乔治逃脱了和他表亲的包办婚姻。
ext.ext_en: George ducked out of his forced marriage to a cousin...

ext.ext_cn: 一旦承担起责任你就不能逃避。
ext.ext_en: You can't duck out once you've taken on a responsibility.

defs.def_en: If you duck out of something that you are supposed to do, you avoid doing it.

defs.def_cn: 自由思想家;独立思考者
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a free-thinker, you admire them because they work out their own ideas rather than accepting generally accepted views.

defs.def_cn: 反情报行动;反间谍活动

ext.ext_cn: 美国联邦调查局反间谍处
ext.ext_en: ...the FBI's department of counter-intelligence.

ext.ext_cn: 反情报官员
ext.ext_en: ...a counter-intelligence officer.

defs.def_en: Counter-intelligence consists of actions that a country takes in order to find out whether another country is spying on it and to prevent it from doing so.

defs.def_cn: 滩头阵地；登陆场；滩头堡
defs.def_en: A beachhead is an area of land next to the sea or a river where an attacking force has taken control and can prepare to advance further inland.

ext.ext_cn: 我们搬进一栋通了电但没有自来水的小屋。
ext.ext_en: We moved into a cabin with electricity but no running water...

ext.ext_cn: 停电了。
ext.ext_en: The electricity had been cut off.

defs.def_en: Electricity is a form of energy that can be carried by wires and is used for heating and lighting, and to provide power for machines.

defs.def_cn: 盲目约会；（由第三方安排的）男女初次约会
defs.def_en: A blind date is an arrangement made for you to spend a romantic evening with someone you have never met before.

ext.ext_cn: 他双手被汗水浸湿了。
ext.ext_en: His hands were wet with perspiration.

ext.ext_cn: 夜间盗汗和出汗过多
ext.ext_en: ...night sweats and excessive perspiration.

defs.def_en: Perspiration is the liquid which comes out on the surface of your skin when you are hot or frightened.

defs.def_cn: 角色颠倒;角色互换;角色对调

ext.ext_cn: 那些进行了最极端的角色互换、做起了家庭主夫的男人们
ext.ext_en: ...men who have undertaken the most extreme role reversal and become house-husbands.

defs.def_en: Role reversal is a situation in which two people have chosen or been forced to exchange their duties and responsibilities, so that each is now doing what the other used to do.

defs.def_cn: (热通过气体或液体的)对流，运流

ext.ext_cn: 通过对流而使温暖潮湿的空气上升到大气中的云朵
ext.ext_en: ...clouds which lift warm, moist air by convection high into the atmosphere.

ext.ext_cn: 对流气流
ext.ext_en: ...convection currents.

defs.def_en: Convection is the process by which heat travels through air, water, and other gases and liquids.

ext.ext_cn: 几年前，索尔兹伯里勋爵在伦敦拍得了这幅画。
ext.ext_en: Lord Salisbury bought the picture at auction in London some years ago...

ext.ext_cn: 英国最大的两家拍卖行，苏富比和佳士得参与了对这些作品的估价。
ext.ext_en: Britain's two main auction houses, Sotheby's and Christies, have been involved in valuing the works.

defs.def_en: An auction is a public sale where goods are sold to the person who offers the highest price.

ext.ext_cn: 下周法国画家让·科克托的8幅作品将被拍卖。
ext.ext_en: Eight drawings by French artist Jean Cocteau will be auctioned next week...

ext.ext_cn: 这家航空公司打算把他们的国际线路拍卖给以前的竞争对手。
ext.ext_en: The airline plans to auction its international routes to former competitors...

defs.def_en: If something is auctioned, it is sold in an auction.
The tentacles of an animal such as an octopus are the long thin parts that are used for feeling and holding things, for getting food, and for moving.

defs.def_cn: (政治、商业、社会等机构的)影响力，触角

ext.ext_cn: 言论自由正在一年又一年逐渐被政府不断施加的影响力所削弱。
ext.ext_en: Free speech is being gradually eroded year after year by new tentacles of government control.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the tentacles of a political, commercial, or social organization, you are referring to the power and influence that it has in the outside community.

defs.def_cn: (不同特质、思想等的)合成体，融合体

ext.ext_cn: 事实证明他先前融合了爵士乐、流行乐和非洲旋律的作品非常成功。
ext.ext_en: His previous fusions of jazz, pop and African melodies have proved highly successful.

defs.def_en: A fusion of different qualities, ideas, or things is something new that is created by joining them together.

ext.ext_cn: 他最后的一项改革是把常规军和预备役部队合为一体。
ext.ext_en: His final reform was the fusion of regular and reserve forces.

defs.def_en: The fusion of two or more things involves joining them together to form one thing.

ext.ext_cn: 核聚变研究
ext.ext_en: ...research into nuclear fusion.

defs.def_en: In physics, fusion is the process in which atomic particles combine and produce a large amount of nuclear energy.

ext.ext_cn: 空军特勤团图片史
ext.ext_en: ...a pictorial history of the Special Air Service.

ext.ext_cn: 图片形象
ext.ext_en: ...pictorial images.

defs.def_en: Pictorial means using or relating to pictures.

defs.def_cn: (作为对罪犯的惩罚、用以代替入狱服刑的)社区服务

ext.ext_cn: 他被判140小时社区服务。
ext.ext_en: He was sentenced to 140 hours community service.

defs.def_en: Community service is unpaid work that criminals sometimes do as a punishment instead of being sent to prison.

ext.ext_cn: 飞机起飞并迅速爬升至空中。
ext.ext_en: The plane lifted off and climbed steeply into the sky.

defs.def_en: When an aircraft or rocket lifts off, it leaves the ground and rises into the air.

ext.ext_cn: 片刻的走神儿
ext.ext_en: ...a momentary lapse of concentration...

ext.ext_cn: 他只迟疑了一下。
ext.ext_en: His hesitation was only momentary.

defs.def_en: Something that is momentary lasts for a very short period of time, for example for a few seconds or less.

ext.ext_cn: 这名证人作了伪证，她的证词不可信。
ext.ext_en: This witness has committed perjury and no reliance can be placed on her evidence.

ext.ext_cn: 伪证罪指控
ext.ext_en: ...charges of perjury.

defs.def_en: If someone who is giving evidence in a court of law commits perjury, they lie.

ext.ext_cn: 死难者纪念碑揭幕仪式
ext.ext_en: ...a ceremony to unveil a monument to the victims.

defs.def_en: If someone formally unveils something such as a new statue or painting, they draw back the curtain which is covering it.

ext.ext_cn: 沃纳先生本周公布了其新策略。
ext.ext_en: Mr Werner unveiled his new strategy this week...

ext.ext_cn: 全欧洲的公司都来到这里展示其最新款产品。
ext.ext_en: Companies from across Europe are here to unveil their latest models.

defs.def_en: If you unveil a plan, new product, or some other thing that has been kept secret, you introduce it to the public.

ext.ext_cn: 如果在中午12点前退房，当天不计费。
ext.ext_en: The day of departure is not chargeable if rooms are vacated by 12.00 noon.

defs.def_en: If something is chargeable, you have to pay a sum of money for it.

ext.ext_cn: 纳税人的应税收入
ext.ext_en: ...the taxpayer's chargeable gain.

defs.def_en: If something is chargeable, you have to pay tax on it.

defs.def_cn: （pics 的非正式拼法）照片，电影

ext.ext_cn: 一流摄影师迈克·戈得华特超棒的照片
ext.ext_en: ...splendid pix by ace photographer Mike Goldwater.

ext.ext_cn: 铺天盖地的黑帮片
ext.ext_en: ...a deluge of gangster pix.

defs.def_en: Pix is an informal way of spelling pics meaning 'photographs' or 'films'.

defs.def_cn: （尤指田径项目的）运动员，运动选手

ext.ext_cn: 戴利·汤普森是位著名的运动员。
ext.ext_en: Daley Thompson was a great athlete.

defs.def_en: An athlete is a person who does a sport, especially athletics, or track and field events.

defs.def_cn: 运动健儿;身强力壮的人

ext.ext_cn: 我根本不是当运动员的料。
ext.ext_en: I was no athlete.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone who is fit and athletic as an athlete .

ext.ext_cn: 我感觉他们是对的。
ext.ext_en: I suspect they were right...

ext.ext_cn: 我想，以上的抱怨只是冰山一角。
ext.ext_en: The above complaints are, I suspect, just the tip of the iceberg...

defs.def_en: You use suspect when you are stating something that you believe is probably true, in order to make it sound less strong or direct.

ext.ext_cn: 他怀疑楼上公寓里的那个女人正在吸食海洛因。
ext.ext_en: He suspected that the woman staying in the flat above was using heroin...

ext.ext_cn: 警方说他们怀疑索布拉还有一些走私毒品的同伙。
ext.ext_en: Police said they suspected that Sobhraj had accomplices who are drug smugglers...

defs.def_en: If you suspect that something dishonest or unpleasant has been done, you believe that it has probably been done. If you suspect someone of doing an action of this kind, you believe that they probably did it.

ext.ext_cn: 警察已经逮捕了一名涉嫌在该市犯下一系列杀人及强奸案的嫌疑犯。
ext.ext_en: Police have arrested a suspect in a series of killings and sexual assaults in the city.

defs.def_en: A suspect is a person who the police or authorities think may be guilty of a crime.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可靠的;不可信的;可能有假的;可疑的

ext.ext_cn: 发现可疑包裹后，代表们撤离了这座楼。
ext.ext_en: Delegates evacuated the building when a suspect package was found...

ext.ext_cn: 该公司在全国性的报纸上登出广告，催促顾客退回疑似假冒产品。
ext.ext_en: The firm has taken out adverts in national newspapers to urge customers to return suspect products...

defs.def_en: Suspect things or people are ones that you think may be dangerous or may be less good or genuine than they appear.

ext.ext_cn: 他们打算结婚。
ext.ext_en: They were planning on getting married...

ext.ext_cn: 他们计划下个月去圭亚那旅行。
ext.ext_en: They are planning on a trip to Guyana next month.

defs.def_en: If you plan on doing something, you intend to do it.
A bobsled is the same as a bobsleigh .
A lumberjack is a person whose job is to cut down trees.

ext.ext_cn: 反对独裁政府的群众暴动
ext.ext_en: ...a popular uprising against the authoritarian government...

ext.ext_cn: 该国东北部的零星袭击现在已经演变成为全面暴动。
ext.ext_en: Isolated attacks in the north-east of the country have now turned into a full-scale uprising.

defs.def_en: When there is an uprising, a group of people start fighting against the people who are in power in their country, because they want to bring about a political change.

defs.def_cn: (橄榄球或足球中的)防守后卫
defs.def_en: In rugby or football, a full-back is a defending player whose position is towards the goal which their team is defending.

defs.def_cn: （大厅或房间）（用于）举行宴会的
defs.def_en: A banqueting hall or room is a large room where banquets are held.

ext.ext_cn: 我们选择了越野赛跑。
ext.ext_en: We chose to do cross-country running.

ext.ext_cn: 跑鞋
ext.ext_en: ...running shoes.

defs.def_en: Running is the activity of moving fast on foot, especially as a sport.

ext.ext_cn: 负责党内日常事务管理的委员会
ext.ext_en: ...the committee in charge of the day-to-day running of the party.

defs.def_en: The running of something such as a business is the managing or organizing of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他也开始接二连三地和艾奇逊院长发生争执。
ext.ext_en: He also began a running feud with Dean Acheson...

ext.ext_cn: 这首歌一时成了他和媒体之间的一个笑料。
ext.ext_en: The song turned into a running joke between him and the press.

defs.def_en: You use running to describe things that continue or keep occurring over a period of time.

defs.def_cn: 不断增加的;持续增长的

ext.ext_cn: 他不断记录着又有谁给他打电话，拜访过他，或给他送花。
ext.ext_en: He kept a running tally of who had called him, who had visited, who had sent flowers...

ext.ext_cn: 到目前为止，他持续增长的转会费已高达200万英镑。
ext.ext_en: So far, his running total in transfers fees is £2 million.

defs.def_en: A running total is a total which changes because numbers keep being added to it as something progresses.

ext.ext_cn: 他说干旱已经连续两年导致农作物严重歉收。
ext.ext_en: He said drought had led to severe crop failure for the second year running...

ext.ext_cn: 她经常改变形象，一天一个样。
ext.ext_en: She changes her look so often that she never seems the same woman two days running.

defs.def_en: You can use running when indicating that something keeps happening. For example, if something has happened every day for three days, you can say that it has happened for the third day running or for three days running .

ext.ext_cn: 森林中处处都能听到流水声。
ext.ext_en: The forest was filled with the sound of running water...

ext.ext_cn: 用流动的凉水冲洗小扁豆。
ext.ext_en: Wash the lentils under cold running water.

defs.def_en: Running water is water that is flowing rather than standing still.

ext.ext_cn: 非洲一座小村庄里既没有电，也没有自来水的房子
ext.ext_en: ...a house without electricity or running water in a tiny African village.

defs.def_en: If a house has running water, water is supplied to the house through pipes and taps.

defs.def_cn: 有/没有希望获胜;有/没有机会得到

ext.ext_cn: 她在电影《不道德的审判》中的演出使她很有希望获得劳伦斯·奥利弗奖
ext.ext_en: Her role in Death and the Maiden, which put her in the running for the Laurence Olivier Award...

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎一直因为年龄问题不认为自己有获胜的可能，但情况在这周改变了。
ext.ext_en: Until this week he appeared to have ruled himself out of the running because of his age.

defs.def_en: If someone is in the running for something, they have a good chance of winning or obtaining it. If they are out of the running for something, they have no chance of winning or obtaining it.

ext.ext_cn: 现在民主党人好像成了领头羊，这让共和党人非常愤怒。
ext.ext_en: Republicans are furious that the Democrats currently seem to be making all the running.

defs.def_en: If someone is making the running in a situation, they are more active than the other people involved.

defs.def_cn: (系统或地方等)正常运转，正常运营

ext.ext_cn: 我们正努力让这些医疗机构恢复正常运营。
ext.ext_en: We're trying to get the medical facilities up and running again.

defs.def_en: If something such as a system or place is up and running, it is operating normally.
A state school is a school that is controlled and funded by the government or a local authority, and which children can attend without having to pay.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不直截了当的;拐弯抹角的

ext.ext_cn: 这影射到了他的母亲。
ext.ext_en: It was an oblique reference to his mother...

ext.ext_cn: 戈尔丁先生谈及草率行事的危险，这是他在委婉地发出警告。
ext.ext_en: Mr Golding delivered an oblique warning, talking of the danger of sudden action.

defs.def_en: If you describe a statement as oblique, you mean that is not expressed directly or openly, making it difficult to understand.

ext.ext_cn: 它位于平原与大海之间，跟海岸线形成一个斜角。
ext.ext_en: It lies between the plain and the sea at an oblique angle to the coastline.

defs.def_en: An oblique line is a straight line that is not horizontal or vertical. An oblique angle is any angle other than a right angle.
A watchtower is a high building which gives a person a good view of the area around the place that they are guarding.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 暴躁的;易怒的;好斗的;尖刻的
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is truculent, you mean that they are bad-tempered and aggressive.

ext.ext_cn: “你没事吧?”我问她。她点点头，笑了。
ext.ext_en: 'Are you okay?' I asked. She nodded and smiled...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维什么都没说，只是点点头，好像完全理解了。
ext.ext_en: David said nothing, but simply nodded, as if understanding perfectly...

defs.def_en: If you nod, you move your head downwards and upwards to show that you are answering 'yes' to a question, or to show agreement, understanding, or approval.

ext.ext_cn: “它能用吗？”他边问边朝钢琴方向扬了下头。
ext.ext_en: 'Does it work?' he asked, nodding at the piano...

ext.ext_cn: 她朝客厅方向扬了扬头说：“他在那里面。”
ext.ext_en: She nodded towards the drawing room. 'He's in there.'...

defs.def_en: If you nod in a particular direction, you bend your head once in that direction in order to indicate something or to give someone a signal.

defs.def_cn: (用于打招呼或告别)点头，点头招呼

ext.ext_cn: 所有的女孩都点头招呼道：“嗨!”
ext.ext_en: All the girls nodded and said 'Hi'...

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆点头致意，但什么都没说。
ext.ext_en: Tom nodded a greeting but didn't  say anything...

defs.def_en: If you nod, you bend your head once, as a way of saying hello or goodbye.

ext.ext_cn: 泰勒跳起来头球破门。
ext.ext_en: Taylor leapt up to nod the ball home...

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩·麦克莱尔头球攻入了自己本赛季第23粒进球。
ext.ext_en: Brian McClair nodded in his twenty-third goal of the season.

defs.def_en: In football, if a player nods the ball in a particular direction, they hit the ball there with their head.

ext.ext_cn: “没我同意，别让他进来。”
ext.ext_en: 'Keep him outside till I give you the nod.'

defs.def_en: If you give someone the nod, you give them permission to do something.

defs.def_cn: (建议)一致接受地，毫无异议地

ext.ext_cn: 他一直争辩，不能眼看着该党让此条约毫无异议地通过。
ext.ext_en: He has always argued that the party cannot be seen to let the treaty through on the nod...

ext.ext_cn: 重大议题将会一致通过。
ext.ext_en: Big issues are going through on the nod.

defs.def_en: If a proposal is accepted on the nod, it is accepted without being questioned or argued about.
A pudding basin is a deep round bowl that is used in the kitchen, especially for mixing or for cooking puddings.

defs.def_cn: (通常指出人意料的或在困难环境中)大获成功的人(或事物)

ext.ext_cn: “袜铺”是 20 世纪 80 年代商业成功的范例之一。
ext.ext_en: Sock Shop was one of the high-street success stories of the 80s.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is a success story is very successful, often unexpectedly or in spite of unfavourable conditions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （声明、评论）简短的,短促的,无礼的

ext.ext_cn: 他发表了简短声明，称他正在和同事讨论他的未来，并将于星期一宣布他的决定。
ext.ext_en: He issued a terse statement, saying he is discussing his future with colleagues before announcing his decision on Monday...

ext.ext_cn: 他提问时语气生硬。
ext.ext_en: His tone was terse as he asked the question.

defs.def_en: A terse statement or comment is brief and unfriendly.

defs.def_cn: 失去已久的；久违的；久别的

ext.ext_cn: 对我来说就像久别的姐妹重逢一样。我们聊呀聊呀，话总是说不完。
ext.ext_en: For me it was like meeting a long-lost sister. We talked, and talked, and talked...

ext.ext_cn: 发现一份失传很久的6世纪手稿
ext.ext_en: ...finding a long-lost sixth century manuscript.

defs.def_en: You use long-lost to describe someone or something that you have not seen for a long time.

defs.def_cn: （尤指属于同一社会阶层的）（男）老乡，（男）同乡
defs.def_en: A homeboy is a boy or man from the same area as you, especially one from the same social group as you.

ext.ext_cn: 人们疑心重重，惶恐不安，很难说这一切什么时候会平息下来。
ext.ext_en: There's a great deal of suspicion and fear, and it's hard to say when all of this will simmer down...

ext.ext_cn: 他对待克里斯的态度最初让金尼感到无比愤怒，后来慢慢转变成了怨恨。
ext.ext_en: Ginny's initial rage at his treatment of Chris had simmered down to resentment.

defs.def_en: If someone's feelings simmer down, they become less intense.
A beauty parlour is a place where women can go to have beauty treatments, for example to have their hair, nails or make-up done.

defs.def_cn: （古建筑、乡村地区等的）保护主义者

ext.ext_cn: 这座房子年久失修，但一群古建筑保护者已翻盖了房顶。
ext.ext_en: The house fell into disrepair but a group of preservationists have reconstructed the roofs.

defs.def_en: A preservationist is someone who takes action to preserve something such as old buildings or an area of countryside.

ext.ext_cn: 有10万户左右的家庭在地震中失去了家园，其中许多家庭还没有得到安置。
ext.ext_en: Many of the 100,000 or so families who lost their homes in the earthquake have still not been rehoused...

ext.ext_cn: 委员会同意给这个家庭重新安排住房。
ext.ext_en: The council has agreed to rehouse the family.

defs.def_en: If someone is rehoused, their council, local government, or other authority provides them with a different house to live in.

defs.def_cn: 不可饶恕的重罪(天主教会中指十分严重的罪恶，犯此罪恶者死后会受到惩罚，除非被教会宽恕)

ext.ext_cn: 通奸是不可饶恕的罪孽。
ext.ext_en: Adultery is a mortal sin.

defs.def_en: In the Roman Catholic Church, a mortal sin is an extremely serious sin and the person who has committed it will be punished after death unless they are forgiven by the Church.
A fingermark is a mark which is made when someone puts a dirty or oily finger onto a clean surface.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他扬起胳膊徒劳地想要挡住这一拳。
ext.ext_en: He brought his arm up in a futile attempt to ward off the blow...

ext.ext_cn: 如果没有任何好转的机会，继续维持他的生命也是无益的。
ext.ext_en: It would be futile to sustain his life when there is no chance of any improvement.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is futile, you mean there is no point in doing it, usually because it has no chance of succeeding.

defs.def_cn: (从现有公司中)剥离出，独立，分立

ext.ext_cn: 他挽救了该公司，随后将其纺织部门剥离出来成立了一个独立的公司。
ext.ext_en: He rescued the company and later spun off its textile division into a separate company...

ext.ext_cn: 科文计划帮大公司分立出一些小型企业。
ext.ext_en: Corven plans to help large companies spin out smaller, entrepreneurial firms.

defs.def_en: To spin off or spin off something such as a company means to create a new company that is separate from the original organization.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她缺乏母性。
ext.ext_en: She had little maternal instinct...

ext.ext_cn: 她对他的感情是近乎母亲般的。
ext.ext_en: Her feelings towards him were almost maternal.

defs.def_en: Maternal is used to describe feelings or actions which are typical of those of a kind mother towards her child.

ext.ext_cn: 母亲吸烟会对胎儿造成不良影响。
ext.ext_en: Maternal smoking can damage the unborn child.

defs.def_en: Maternal is used to describe things that relate to the mother of a baby.

ext.ext_cn: 她的外公是卡拉奇市的市长。
ext.ext_en: Her maternal grandfather was Mayor of Karachi.

defs.def_en: A maternal relative is one who is related through a person's mother rather than their father.

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名外交官的儿子，他一生有大量的时间在周游世界。
ext.ext_en: The son of a diplomat, he has spent much of his life globe-trotting.

defs.def_en: If someone spends their time globe-trotting, they spend a lot of time travelling to different parts of the world.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有启发性的;有启示作用的;有鼓舞力量的

ext.ext_cn: 甘地是富有感召力的人物。
ext.ext_en: Gandhi was an inspirational figure...

ext.ext_cn: 坎布里亚郡为华兹华斯提供了灵感。
ext.ext_en: Cumbria was inspirational for Wordsworth.

defs.def_en: Something that is inspirational provides you with inspiration.

defs.def_cn: 榴霰弹;子母弹;集束炸弹
defs.def_en: A cluster bomb is a type of bomb which is dropped from an aircraft. It contains a large number of smaller bombs that spread out before they hit the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 他可能会被一个年龄比他小的人取代。
ext.ext_en: He may be supplanted by a younger man...

ext.ext_cn: 到了 20 世纪 30 年代，手表几乎完全取代了怀表。
ext.ext_en: By the 1930s the wristwatch had almost completely supplanted the pocket watch.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is supplanted, another person or thing takes their place.

defs.def_cn: 违反，违背，触犯(法律或规则)

ext.ext_cn: 委员会决定禁播这部电影，理由是它触犯了刑事诽谤法。
ext.ext_en: The Board has banned the film on the grounds that it contravenes criminal libel laws...

ext.ext_cn: 他说这一条款并未违反行业的行为准则。
ext.ext_en: He said the article did not contravene the industry's code of conduct.

defs.def_en: To contravene a law or rule means to do something that is forbidden by the law or rule.

ext.ext_cn: 埃利奥特跨过终点线时仅比对手落后半秒钟。
ext.ext_en: Elliott crossed the finish line just half a second behind his adversary...

ext.ext_cn: 他的政敌正在给他制造一些麻烦。
ext.ext_en: His political adversaries were creating a certain amount of trouble for him.

defs.def_en: Your adversary is someone you are competing with, or arguing or fighting against.

ext.ext_cn: 国民保健服务中的插队现象
ext.ext_en: ...queue-jumping within the National Health Service.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of queue-jumping, you mean that they are trying to get to the front of a queue or waiting list unfairly.

defs.def_cn: 论说文作家;杂文作家;散文作家
defs.def_en: An essayist is a writer who writes essays for publication.

ext.ext_cn: 由于刹车太急，车子侧滑到了满是尘土的路肩上。
ext.ext_en: The car pulled up too fast and skidded on the dusty shoulder of the road...

ext.ext_cn: 飞机在暴风雪中起飞的时候滑出了跑道。
ext.ext_en: The plane skidded off the runway while taking off in a snow storm.

defs.def_en: If a vehicle skids, it slides sideways or forwards while moving, for example when you are trying to stop it suddenly on a wet road.

defs.def_cn: 无法挽救的;注定要失败的

ext.ext_cn: 他的事业每况愈下。
ext.ext_en: His career is on the skids.

ext.ext_cn: 我的婚姻注定要失败。
ext.ext_en: ...my marriage was on the skids.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is on the skids, you believe that it is out of control and certain to fail.

defs.def_cn: （在沉默了一阵之后）开始说话，开始讲话（尤指说出令人吃惊或奇怪的事情）

ext.ext_cn: “没错，先生，”另一个孩子突然说道。
ext.ext_en: 'That's right, mister,' another child piped up...

ext.ext_cn: 在此我插了一句询问这事儿是否会产生一些积极的投入。
ext.ext_en: At which point I piped up and asked whether it might be at all possible to have some positive input.

defs.def_en: If someone who has been silent for a while pipes up, they say something, especially something surprising or strange.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经在华盛顿的大陪审团前作证。
ext.ext_en: They have already given evidence before a grand jury in Washington.

defs.def_en: A grand jury is a jury, usually in the United States, which considers a criminal case in order to decide if someone should be tried in a court of law.

ext.ext_cn: 她先是指控他勒索，但他几乎不理睬她。
ext.ext_en: She started off by accusing him of blackmail but he more or less ignored her...

ext.ext_cn: 乔·洛斯先是于 20 世纪 20 年代为无声电影弹奏钢琴背景音乐。
ext.ext_en: Joe Loss started off playing piano background music for silent films in the 1920s.

defs.def_en: If you start off by doing something, you do it as the first part of an activity.

ext.ext_cn: 她母亲先是让她在儿童剧院里演出。
ext.ext_en: Her mother started her off acting in children's theatre.

defs.def_en: To start someone off means to cause them to begin doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 他越来越清楚地认识到引起紧张局势的原因。
ext.ext_en: He became more aware of the things that started that tension off...

ext.ext_cn: 要想取得最理想的结果，一开始就应该让植株在温暖的温室里生长。
ext.ext_en: Best results are obtained by starting the plants off in a warm greenhouse.

defs.def_en: To start something off means to cause it to begin.

ext.ext_cn: 细胞会立即开始吸收水分。
ext.ext_en: The cells will promptly start to soak up moisture.

defs.def_en: If a soft or dry material soaks up a liquid, the liquid goes into the substance.

ext.ext_cn: 我正趴在那里晒着太阳。
ext.ext_en: I was lying on my stomach soaking up the sun.

defs.def_en: If you soak up the sun, you sit or lie in the sun, because you enjoy it.

ext.ext_cn: 基顿每年到这里来一两次，为的是尽情感受这里的气氛。
ext.ext_en: Keaton comes here once or twice a year to soak up the atmosphere.

defs.def_en: If you soak up the atmosphere in a place that you are visiting, you observe or get involved in the way of life there, because you enjoy it or are interested in it.

defs.def_cn: 用去，耗费(大量金钱、资源等)

ext.ext_cn: 国防耗去40%的预算。
ext.ext_en: Defence soaks up forty per cent of the budget...

ext.ext_cn: 英国花费在对外广播上的财力高于其他国家。
ext.ext_en: External broadcasting soaks up more resources in Britain than elsewhere.

defs.def_en: If something soaks up something such as money or other resources, it uses a great deal of money or other resources.

ext.ext_cn: 在下拉列表项中选择“全部删除”。
ext.ext_en: Select 'Delete all' from the drop-down list.

defs.def_en: A drop-down menu, list, or box is a list of options that appears on a computer screen when you select an item with a computer mouse.
A buggy is the same as a baby buggy .
A buggy is a small lightweight carriage pulled by one horse.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她一副无事不登三宝殿的神情，很明显，这不是一次随意造访。
ext.ext_en: She had a purposeful air, and it became evident that this was not a casual visit.

defs.def_en: If someone is purposeful, they show that they have a definite aim and a strong desire to achieve it.

defs.def_cn: 追捕到，穷追直至找到（罪犯、敌人等）

ext.ext_cn: 去年12月他们追捕到其中一名匪徒并将其击毙。
ext.ext_en: Last December they hunted down and killed one of the gangsters...

ext.ext_cn: 对于那些不肯自首的罪犯应予缉拿归案。
ext.ext_en: Those who do not come forward should be hunted down...

defs.def_en: If you hunt down a criminal or an enemy, you find them after searching for them.
A friar is a member of one of several Catholic religious orders.

ext.ext_cn: 他们试着在洞穴正下方的一块地上挖掘。
ext.ext_en: They tried digging in a patch just below the cave...

ext.ext_cn: 挖一个大点儿的洞，先把木桩敲进去。
ext.ext_en: Dig a largish hole and bang the stake in first...

defs.def_en: If people or animals dig, they make a hole in the ground or in a pile of earth, stones, or rubbish.

ext.ext_cn: 他把手伸进上衣口袋里摸钥匙。
ext.ext_en: He dug into his coat pocket for his keys.

defs.def_en: If you dig into something such as a deep container, you put your hand in it to search for something.

ext.ext_cn: 她把分菜匙伸进那盘碎肉茄子蛋中。
ext.ext_en: She digs the serving spoon into the moussaka...

ext.ext_cn: 我抓住乔治的胳膊，指甲抠进了他的肉里。
ext.ext_en: I grab George's arm and dig my nails into his flesh...

defs.def_en: If you dig one thing into another or if one thing digs into another, the first thing is pushed hard into the second, or presses hard into it.

ext.ext_cn: 这一调查对其政府涉嫌的财政违规行为展开了进一步深究。
ext.ext_en: The enquiry dug deeper into the alleged financial misdeeds of his government...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直在仔细查阅当地的档案资料。
ext.ext_en: He has been digging into the local archives...

defs.def_en: If you dig into a subject or a store of information, you study it very carefully in order to discover or check facts.

defs.def_cn: (尤指从自己造成的困境或令人不快的情形中)脱（身）

ext.ext_cn: 在竞选活动的关键时刻，白宫的主人利用职权帮助自己摆脱了麻烦。
ext.ext_en: Occupants of the White House have exploited their office at key moments in an election campaign to dig themselves out of trouble...

ext.ext_cn: 他已采取了这些措施，试图让自己摆脱困境。
ext.ext_en: He's taken these measures to try and dig himself out of a hole.

defs.def_en: If you dig yourself out of a difficult or unpleasant situation, especially one which you caused yourself, you manage to get out of it.

ext.ext_cn: “他们演奏经典摇滚乐，”她的男朋友说道，“我爸爸也喜欢他们。”
ext.ext_en: 'They play classic rock'n'roll,' states her boyfriend, 'My dad digs them too.'...

ext.ext_cn: 我可以理解。我不指望一个乐队总能创新。
ext.ext_en: I can dig it. I don't expect a band always to be innovative.

defs.def_en: If you say that you dig something, you mean that you like it and understand it.

ext.ext_cn: 他是位考古学家，过去的一年都在参与克里特岛上的一项考古发掘工作。
ext.ext_en: He's an archaeologist and has been on a dig in Crete for the past year.

defs.def_en: A dig is an organized activity in which people dig into the ground in order to discover ancient historical objects.

ext.ext_cn: 美国人总是动不动就嘲讽英国人。
ext.ext_en: Americans are always quick to have a dig at the British...

ext.ext_cn: 戴夫糟糕的表演结束后，她忍不住想挖苦他一番。
ext.ext_en: She couldn't resist a dig at Dave after his unfortunate performance.

defs.def_en: If you have a dig at someone, you say something which is intended to make fun of them or upset them.

ext.ext_cn: 卡桑德拉使劲戳了一下他的后腰，让他住嘴。
ext.ext_en: Cassandra silenced him with a sharp dig in the small of the back.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a dig in a part of their body, you push them with your finger or your elbow, usually as a warning or as a joke.

ext.ext_cn: 他去了伦敦，在格洛斯特路的一所房子里租了房间住。
ext.ext_en: He went to London and lived in digs in Gloucester Road...

defs.def_en: If you live in digs, you live in a room in someone else's house and pay them rent.

ext.ext_cn: 我想让你彻底调查一下，弄清她是谁，从哪里来的。
ext.ext_en: I want you to dig deep. Find out who she is, and where she came from.

defs.def_en: If you dig deep, you do a very thorough investigation into something.

ext.ext_cn: 度假者想方设法拿出钱来预订夏末的短暂假期。
ext.ext_en: Holidaymakers are digging deep into their pockets to book late summer breaks.

defs.def_en: If someone digs into their pocket or digs into their purse, they manage after some difficulty to find the money to pay for something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 尽管工作繁忙，本尼却少有身体不好的时候。
ext.ext_en: Despite his hectic work schedule, Benny has rarely suffered poor health...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在那里度过的两天愉快但忙乱。
ext.ext_en: The two days we spent there were enjoyable but hectic.

defs.def_en: A hectic situation is one that is very busy and involves a lot of rushed activity.

defs.def_cn: （新鲜空气、香烟等）深吸的一大口

ext.ext_cn: 我浮上水面，深吸了一口气。
ext.ext_en: I bobbed to the surface and gasped a lungful of air.

defs.def_en: If someone takes a lungful of something such as fresh air or smoke, they breathe in deeply so that their lungs feel as if they are full of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我把手提箱扛到肩上，转身向入住的旅馆走去。
ext.ext_en: Hoisting my suitcase on to my shoulder, I turned and headed toward my hotel...

ext.ext_cn: 他抓住铺位的床沿，坐起身来。
ext.ext_en: Grabbing the side of the bunk, he hoisted himself to a sitting position.

defs.def_en: If you hoist something heavy somewhere, you lift it or pull it up there.

ext.ext_cn: 一个高20英尺的钢质角锥体将被吊起，安装在塔的顶部。
ext.ext_en: A twenty-foot steel pyramid is to be hoisted into position on top of the tower...

ext.ext_cn: 然后一台升降机将他送到了舞台上。
ext.ext_en: Then a crane hoisted him on to the platform.

defs.def_en: If something heavy is hoisted somewhere, it is lifted there using a machine such as a crane.
A hoist is a machine for lifting heavy things.

ext.ext_cn: 一群年轻人将他们的旗帜升到那座备受争议的纪念碑顶上。
ext.ext_en: A group of youths hoisted their flag on top of the disputed monument.

defs.def_en: If you hoist a flag or a sail, you pull it up to its correct position by using ropes.

defs.def_cn: (研究方面的)合作者，协作者;（书的）合著者

ext.ext_cn: 欧文研究小组和他们的合作伙伴正在测试激光是否会更为有效。
ext.ext_en: The Irvine group and their collaborators are testing whether lasers do the job better.

defs.def_en: A collaborator is someone that you work with to produce a piece of work, especially a book or some research.

defs.def_cn: 通敌者;(与占领军)勾结的人

ext.ext_cn: 两名涉嫌通敌者被蒙面的激进分子击毙。
ext.ext_en: Two alleged collaborators were shot dead by masked activists.

defs.def_en: A collaborator is someone who helps an enemy who is occupying their country during a war.
Taxable income is income on which you have to pay tax.
An identity card is a card with a person's name, photograph, date of birth, and other information on it. In some countries, people are required to carry identity cards in order to prove who they are.

ext.ext_cn: 身着盛装的客人们
ext.ext_en: ...the guests in all their finery.

defs.def_en: If someone is dressed in their finery, they are wearing the elegant and impressive clothes and jewellery that they wear on special occasions.

ext.ext_cn: 从权力中心收集来的趣闻轶事
ext.ext_en: ...titbits of gossip gleaned from the corridors of power...

ext.ext_cn: 是谁告诉你那条花边新闻的？
ext.ext_en: Who passed that titbit on to you?

defs.def_en: You can refer to a small piece of information about someone's private affairs as a titbit, especially when it is interesting and shocking.

ext.ext_cn: 她给了莫莉一些吃的：一根鸡腿下段和一些奶酪。
ext.ext_en: She offered Molly tidbits: a chicken drumstick, some cheese.

defs.def_en: A titbit is a small piece of food.

ext.ext_cn: 他们可以与他们选择的任何人交换或分享这份合约。
ext.ext_en: They can transfer or share the contract with whosoever they choose.

defs.def_en: Whosoever means the same as whoever .

ext.ext_cn: 一对著名的歌舞表演搭档
ext.ext_en: ...a famous dancing and singing duo.

defs.def_en: A duo is two musicians, singers, or other performers who perform together as a pair.

defs.def_cn: (尤指拥有共同特征的)一对,一双

ext.ext_cn: 英国前奥运会金牌得主二人档林福德·克里斯蒂和萨莉·冈纳尔
ext.ext_en: ...Britain's former golden Olympic duo of Linford Christie and Sally Gunnell.

defs.def_en: You can refer to two people together as a duo, especially when they have something in common.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不会根据短期预测就试图对经济进行微调。
ext.ext_en: We do not try to fine-tune the economy on the basis of short-term predictions...

ext.ext_cn: 计算机使得这些图样能够得到细调，并且可以迅速更改。
ext.ext_en: Computers allow the plans to be fine-tuned and to be altered quickly.

defs.def_en: If you fine-tune something, you make very small and precise changes to it in order to make it as successful or effective as it possibly can be.

defs.def_cn: 好友;密友;(尤指)狐朋狗友

ext.ext_cn: 中午跟那帮生意上的朋友喝完酒后，他回来了。
ext.ext_en: He returned from a lunchtime drinking session with his business cronies.

defs.def_en: You can refer to friends that someone spends a lot of time with as their cronies, especially when you disapprove of them.

ext.ext_cn: 现存于多米尼加的各种粮食作物和植物群落
ext.ext_en: ...the variety of food crops and flora which now exists in Dominica.

defs.def_en: You can refer to plants as flora, especially the plants growing in a particular area.
A nursery nurse is a person who has been trained to look after very young children.

ext.ext_cn: 他搬出了公寓，住到了他的一个叔叔那里。
ext.ext_en: He vacated the flat and went to stay with an uncle...

ext.ext_cn: 他最近辞去了国民保健署人事主管一职。
ext.ext_en: He recently vacated his post as NHS Personnel Director...

defs.def_en: If you vacate a place or a job, you leave it or give it up, making it available for other people.

ext.ext_cn: 小时候她通过描摹母亲旧童话书里的插图学会了画画。
ext.ext_en: As a child she learned to draw by tracing pictures out of her mother's old storybooks.

ext.ext_cn: 她最喜欢的两个童话人物
ext.ext_en: ...two of her favourite storybook characters.

defs.def_en: A storybook is a book of stories for children.

defs.def_cn: 童话般美好的;结局圆满的;皆大欢喜的

ext.ext_cn: 在很多方面，这都是种童话般的生活。夏天在萨尔茨堡度过。周末在康涅狄格打猎。
ext.ext_en: In many ways it was a storybook life. Summers in Salzburg. Weekends hunting in Connecticut...

ext.ext_cn: 这是发生在现实中的童话般的罗曼史。
ext.ext_en: It was a real storybook romance.

defs.def_en: A storybook relationship, situation, or life is one that is perfect and ends happily, just as many fairy stories do.

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩用水冲了把脸，然后刷牙。
ext.ext_en: Brian splashed water on his face, then brushed his teeth...

ext.ext_cn: 他的职业生涯中有很长一段时间是在好莱坞度过的。
ext.ext_en: He spent a large part of his career in Hollywood...

defs.def_en: You use his to indicate that something belongs or relates to a man, boy, or male animal.

defs.def_cn: （书面英语中泛指人）他的，她的（有些人不喜欢这种说法，更倾向于使用 his or her 或 their）

ext.ext_cn: 以往的师生关系主要是学生惧怕老师。
ext.ext_en: Formerly, the relations between a teacher and his pupils were dominated by fear on the part of the pupils...

ext.ext_cn: 每个人都应该按劳所得。
ext.ext_en: Everyone should receive a fair price for the product of his labour.

defs.def_en: In written English, his is sometimes used to refer to a person without saying whether that person is a man or a woman. Some people dislike this use and prefer to use 'his or her' or 'their'.

ext.ext_cn: 对上帝的谦卑信仰和对教会的信任
ext.ext_en: ...humble faith in God, and trust in His Church.

ext.ext_en: In what way do you feel called to serve God as a clergyman? Is it your way, or His?

defs.def_en: In some religions, His is used to refer to God.

defs.def_cn: (警方拍摄的罪犯或嫌疑犯的)面部照片，头像

ext.ext_cn: 5名恐怖分子的头像照片
ext.ext_en: ...mug-shots of the five terrorists.

defs.def_en: A mug shot is a photograph of someone, especially a photograph of a criminal which has been taken by the police.

defs.def_cn: 非欧洲血统的;非白种人的

ext.ext_cn: 一些特定的工作事实上将非白种人排斥在外。
ext.ext_en: Non-white people are effectively excluded from certain jobs...

ext.ext_cn: 60％的人口属于非欧洲血统。
ext.ext_en: 60 percent of the population is non-white.

defs.def_en: A non-white person is a member of a race of people who are not of European origin.
An air terminal is a building in which passengers wait before they get on to an aeroplane.

defs.def_cn: 墨西哥鳄梨酱；鳄梨色拉
defs.def_en: Guacamole is a cold food from Mexico made of crushed avocados and other ingredients such as tomatoes and chillis.
A man's testes are his testicles .

defs.def_cn: 审计员，审计官(主要用于官员的头衔中)

ext.ext_cn: 美国货币审计官罗伯特·克拉克
ext.ext_en: ...Robert Clarke, US Comptroller of the Currency.

defs.def_en: A comptroller is someone who is in charge of the accounts of a business or a government department; used mainly in official titles.

ext.ext_cn: 偏头痛的其他诱因还有电脑的视频显示器和灯管照明。
ext.ext_en: Other causes of migraine are VDU screens and strip-lighting.

defs.def_en: Strip lighting is a method of lighting which uses long tubes rather than light bulbs.

ext.ext_cn: 她热爱非洲大陆。
ext.ext_en: She loved the African continent...

ext.ext_cn: 恐龙进化的时候，多数大陆连为一体。
ext.ext_en: Dinosaurs evolved when most continents were joined in a single land mass.

defs.def_en: A  continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

ext.ext_cn: 其店铺跻身欧陆最时尚的店铺之列。
ext.ext_en: Its shops are among the most stylish on the Continent.

defs.def_en: People sometimes use the Continent to refer to the continent of Europe except for Britain.

defs.def_cn: 音调符号(标在法语等语言的元音上面，一般表示这个音应该延长)
defs.def_en: A circumflex or a circumflex accent is a symbol written over a vowel in French and other languages, usually to indicate that it should be pronounced longer than usual. It is used for example in the word 'rôle'.
A mercy killing is an act of killing someone who is very ill, in order to stop them suffering any more pain.
If you accuse someone in authority of cronyism, you mean that they use their power or authority to get jobs for their friends.

ext.ext_cn: 芬兰语的名词单数形式的 15 种格尾
ext.ext_en: ...the fifteen case endings of the singular form of the Finnish noun...

ext.ext_cn: 单词 you 可以是单数也可以是复数。
ext.ext_en: The word 'you' can be singular or plural.

defs.def_en: The singular form of a word is the form that is used when referring to one person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: Inuit (依努依特人)的单数形式是 Inuk。
ext.ext_en: The singular of Inuit is Inuk.

defs.def_en: The singular of a noun is the form of it that is used to refer to one person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 无比甜美的微笑
ext.ext_en: ...a smile of singular sweetness...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管胜算微乎其微，巴雷还是很快被身不由己地推到了选举的舞台上。
ext.ext_en: Barre was quickly drawn into the electoral arena, although with singular lack of success.

defs.def_en: Singular means very great and remarkable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 红衣主教梅斯基亚无疑是个怪人。
ext.ext_en: Cardinal Meschia was without doubt a singular character...

ext.ext_cn: 我真想不出来他从哪来的那种奇怪念头。
ext.ext_en: Where he got that singular notion I just can't think.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as singular, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 叛乱分子显然决心继续施压。
ext.ext_en: The rebels are obviously intent on keeping up the pressure...

ext.ext_cn: 该剧由一名志在复出的著名隐退女演员主演。
ext.ext_en: The play starred a well-known retired actress who was intent on a come-back.

defs.def_en: If you are intent on doing something, you are eager and determined to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她看着一张张专注的面孔。
ext.ext_en: She looked from one intent face to another...

ext.ext_cn: 罗德尼字字留心。
ext.ext_en: Rodney had been intent on every word.

defs.def_en: If someone does something in an intent way, they pay great attention to what they are doing.

ext.ext_cn: 决心实施军备控制的有力声明
ext.ext_en: ...a strong statement of intent on arms control...

ext.ext_cn: 两名男子今天将在伯明翰地方法庭受审,他们被控持有武器，企图危害他人生命。
ext.ext_en: Two men will appear before Birmingham magistrates' court today charged with possession of arms with intent to endanger life.

defs.def_en: A person's intent is their intention to do something.

defs.def_cn: 差不多等于;几乎在一切方面

ext.ext_cn: 他几乎可以称得上是我的父亲。
ext.ext_en: To all intents and purposes he was my father.

defs.def_en: You say to all intents and purposes to suggest that a situation is not exactly as you describe it but the effect is the same as if it were.
A snarl-up is a disorganized situation such as a traffic jam, in which things are unable to move or work normally.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有志向的；有抱负的；一心想出人头地的

ext.ext_cn: 在一心想要飞黄腾达的家庭中典型的紧张关系
ext.ext_en: ...the typical tensions of an aspirational household.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as aspirational, you mean that they have strong hopes of moving to a higher social status.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （产品）励志的，激励人心的，受到志向远大者欣赏的

ext.ext_cn: 高雅音乐，特别是歌剧，就像佳酿或出境游一样受到志存高远者的青睐。
ext.ext_en: Fine music, particularly opera, has become aspirational, like fine wine or foreign travel.

defs.def_en: If you describe a product as aspirational, you mean that it is bought or enjoyed by people who have strong hopes of moving to a higher social class.

ext.ext_cn: 首相授予他贵族爵位。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister offered him a peerage...

ext.ext_cn: 人们认为她最终可能接受贵族头衔，进入上议院。
ext.ext_en: It's thought she may eventually accept a peerage and move to the House of Lords.

defs.def_en: If someone has a peerage, they have the rank of a peer.
The peers of a particular country are referred to as the peerage.

defs.def_cn: 香迪啤酒(掺柠檬汁的啤酒)

ext.ext_cn: 半品脱香迪啤酒
ext.ext_en: ...half a pint of shandy.

defs.def_en: Shandy is a drink which is made by mixing beer and lemonade.

ext.ext_cn: 两个酿酒地区之间有着显著的差别。
ext.ext_en: There are obvious distinctions between the two wine-making areas...

ext.ext_cn: 对手工艺和美术之间的差别争议更大。
ext.ext_en: The distinction between craft and fine art is more controversial.

defs.def_en: A distinction between similar things is a difference.

ext.ext_cn: 刘易斯作为一位悟性很高的优秀作曲家崭露头角。
ext.ext_en: Lewis emerges as a composer of distinction and sensitivity.

ext.ext_cn: 一件件精美家具
ext.ext_en: ...pieces of furniture of distinction.

defs.def_en: Distinction is the quality of being very good or better than other things of the same type.

ext.ext_cn: 该勋位设立于1902年，作为一项殊荣授予杰出的男性和女性。
ext.ext_en: The order was created in 1902 as a special distinction for eminent men and women...

ext.ext_cn: 我在利物浦大学以优异成绩获得了拉丁美洲研究方向的硕士学位。
ext.ext_en: I did an M.A. at Liverpool University in Latin American Studies and got a distinction.

defs.def_en: A distinction is a special award or honour that is given to someone because of their very high level of achievement.

ext.ext_cn: 他才华横溢，被誉为联邦共和国目前尚在世的最伟大的作家。
ext.ext_en: He has the distinction of being regarded as the Federal Republic's greatest living writer.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has the distinction of being something, you are drawing attention to the fact that they have the special quality of being that thing. Distinction is normally used to refer to good qualities, but can sometimes also be used to refer to bad qualities.

ext.ext_cn: 戴维斯不会上任何人的当。
ext.ext_en: Davis was nobody's patsy...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直觉得雷是被人陷害的，他是个糊涂蛋。
ext.ext_en: He has long felt that Ray was set up, that he was a patsy.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a patsy, you mean that they are rather stupid and are easily tricked by other people, or can be made to take the blame for other people's actions.

ext.ext_cn: 他们同贵族阶层联姻，进入了国家最高行政层。
ext.ext_en: They married into the nobility and entered the highest ranks of state administration...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管没有正式的权力，贵族阶层并非没有权势。
ext.ext_en: Despite its lack of formal power the nobility was not powerless.

defs.def_en: The nobility of a society are all the people who have titles and belong to a high social class.

defs.def_cn: 高尚的品质;高贵的举止

ext.ext_cn: 他的高尚品格和对祖国的忠诚
ext.ext_en: ...his nobility of character, and his devotion to his country.

defs.def_en: A person's nobility is their noble character and behaviour.

defs.def_cn: 使无效;使无法正常工作

ext.ext_cn: 美国正试图在联合国安理会使该决议无效。
ext.ext_en: The US is trying to neutralize the resolution in the UN Security Council...

ext.ext_cn: 闯入者打碎了一扇窗户进来，然后破坏了警报系统。
ext.ext_en: The intruder smashed a window to get in and then neutralized the alarm system.
