ext.ext_en: I'm a product of the postwar baby boom.

defs.def_en: A baby boom is a period of time when a lot of babies are born in a particular place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 确定无疑的;肯定的;坚定的

ext.ext_cn: 他对性骚扰指控的断然否认
ext.ext_en: ...his categorical denial of the charges of sexual harassment...

ext.ext_cn: 他非常坚定地认为，联合国应该只援助无辜的平民。
ext.ext_en: He is quite categorical that the UN should only help the innocent civilian population.

defs.def_en: If you are categorical about something, you state your views very definitely and firmly.

ext.ext_cn: 整座城市处处洋溢着欢欣鼓舞的气氛。
ext.ext_en: The city was swept up in the mood of exaltation.

defs.def_en: See also:exalt;Exaltation is an intense feeling of great happiness.

ext.ext_cn: 餐馆正对着一条河。
ext.ext_en: The restaurant has a river frontage.

defs.def_en: A frontage of a building is a wall which faces a public place such as a street or a river.

ext.ext_cn: 他的国家的救星
ext.ext_en: ...the saviour of his country.

ext.ext_cn: 英国足球的拯救者
ext.ext_en: ...the saviour of English football...

defs.def_en: A saviour is a person who saves someone or something from danger, ruin, or defeat.

defs.def_cn: 救主，救世主(基督教中对耶稣基督的称谓)
defs.def_en: In the Christian religion, the Saviour is Jesus Christ.

defs.def_cn: 对乙酰氨基酚；扑热息痛

ext.ext_cn: 工作中头疼得厉害时，我常服用扑热息痛。
ext.ext_en: I often take paracetamol at work if I get a bad headache...

ext.ext_cn: 我吃了两片扑热息痛。
ext.ext_en: I took 2 paracetamol.

defs.def_en: Paracetamol is a mild drug which reduces pain and fever.

ext.ext_cn: 布满棕色斑点的大个儿鸡蛋
ext.ext_en: ...a large brown speckled egg...

ext.ext_cn: 天空中繁星点点。
ext.ext_en: The sky was speckled with stars.

defs.def_en: A speckled surface is covered with small marks, spots, or shapes.

defs.def_cn: 横贯大陆的;穿越大陆的;(美国英语中通常指)横穿美国的

ext.ext_cn: 19 世纪中期的美国，在横贯大陆的铁路建成之前
ext.ext_en: ...in mid-nineteenth-century America, before the transcontinental railroad was built.

defs.def_en: A transcontinental journey or route goes from one side of a continent to the other. In American English, transcontinental usually means from one side of the United States to the other.

ext.ext_cn: 如果不喜欢这个程序，把它卸载不用就行了。
ext.ext_en: If you don't like the program, just uninstall it and forget it.

defs.def_en: If you uninstall a computer program, you remove it permanently from your computer.

ext.ext_cn: 他们买了一处老校舍当住房，然后在地下室里建了一个作坊。
ext.ext_en: They bought an old schoolhouse to live in and built a workshop in the basement...

ext.ext_cn: 他们住在伦敦北部的一所地下公寓里。
ext.ext_en: They live in a basement flat in North London.

defs.def_en: The basement of a building is a floor built partly or completely below ground level.

ext.ext_cn: 有严格的着装规定：不许穿运动鞋和牛仔裤。
ext.ext_en: There is a strict dress code: no trainers or jeans.

defs.def_en: The dress code of a place is the rules about what kind of clothes people are allowed to wear there.
A pork pie is a round, tall pie with cooked pork inside, which is eaten cold.
Patio doors are glass doors that lead onto a patio.

ext.ext_cn: 国务院官员说该问题很急迫。
ext.ext_en: Officials at the State Department say the issue is urgent.

ext.ext_cn: 国务院高级官员
ext.ext_en: ...a senior State Department official.

defs.def_en: In the United States, the State Department is the government department that is concerned with foreign affairs.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 熟练的;才华高的;有造诣的

ext.ext_cn: 她是位颇有建树的画家。
ext.ext_en: She is an accomplished painter.

ext.ext_cn: 我们这个时代最杰出的作曲家之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the most accomplished composers of our time.

defs.def_en: If someone is accomplished at something, they are very good at it.

ext.ext_cn: 他母亲很少指责他或她的任何孩子。
ext.ext_en: His mother had rarely criticized him or any of her children...

ext.ext_cn: 部长批评警方没能找到任何线索。
ext.ext_en: The minister criticised the police for failing to come up with any leads...

defs.def_en: If you criticize someone or something, you express your disapproval of them by saying what you think is wrong with them.

ext.ext_cn: 部长对他计划的不理会将使他特别尴尬。
ext.ext_en: He will be particularly discomfited by the minister's dismissal of his plan...

ext.ext_cn: 反对派领导人常搞得他在国会中下不来台。
ext.ext_en: The opposition leader has regularly discomfited him in parliament.

defs.def_en: If you are discomfited by something, it causes you to feel slightly embarrassed or confused.

defs.def_cn: (因为平局或有争议而进行的)复赛，再赛，重赛

ext.ext_cn: 达夫说他将要求重赛。
ext.ext_en: Duff said he would be demanding a rematch.

defs.def_en: A rematch is a second game that is played between two people or teams, for example because their first match was a draw or because there was a dispute about some aspect of it.

defs.def_cn: (比赛或竞赛对手之间的)复赛，二次交手

ext.ext_cn: 斯坦福队将与加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校队展开第二回合较量。
ext.ext_en: Stanford will face UCLA in a rematch...

ext.ext_cn: 这个星期的辩论还是在去年的两个对手之间进行。
ext.ext_en: The debate this week was a rematch of last year's.

defs.def_en: A rematch is a second game or contest between two people or teams who have already faced each other.

ext.ext_cn: 湖光旖旎、峭壁峥嵘，游客们被深深吸引了。
ext.ext_en: The view of lake and plunging cliffs seduces visitors...

ext.ext_cn: 巧妙策划的广告会引诱更多的人吸烟。
ext.ext_en: Clever advertising would seduce more people into smoking.

defs.def_en: If something seduces you, it is so attractive that it makes you do something that you would not otherwise do.

ext.ext_cn: 她已经开始勾引斯蒂芬了。
ext.ext_en: She has set out to seduce Stephen.

defs.def_en: If someone seduces another person, they use their charm to persuade that person to have sex with them.

ext.ext_cn: 极具代表性的英国广播公司的嗓音
ext.ext_en: ...an archetypical BBC voice.

defs.def_en: Archetypical means the same as archetypal .

defs.def_cn: 在…交叉往返;纵横交错于

ext.ext_cn: 他们乘公共汽车游历这个国家。
ext.ext_en: They criss-crossed the country by bus...

ext.ext_cn: 这条街上电话线纵横交错。
ext.ext_en: Telephone wires criss-cross the street.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing criss-crosses an area, they travel from one side to the other and back again many times, following different routes. If a number of things criss-cross an area, they cross it, and cross over each other.

defs.def_cn: (两组线或事物)相互交叉，相互交错

ext.ext_cn: 电线杆顶端的电线相互交错，形成电线网。
ext.ext_en: Wires criss-cross between the tops of the poles, forming a grid...

ext.ext_cn: 这里的道路如迷宫般纵横交错，有时让人摸不着头脑。
ext.ext_en: The roads here are quite a maze, criss-crossing one another in a fashion that at times defies logic.

defs.def_en: If two sets of lines or things criss-cross, they cross over each other.

defs.def_cn: (图案或设计)纵横交错的，十字交叉的

ext.ext_cn: 把烤面包顶部用锋利的锯齿刀交错切开。
ext.ext_en: Slash the tops of the loaves with a sharp serrated knife in a criss-cross pattern.

defs.def_en: A criss-cross pattern or design consists of lines crossing each other.

ext.ext_cn: 拾级而上的时候克莱顿夫人不得不抓着莉齐的手。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Clayton had to hold Lizzie's hand as they ascended the steps...

ext.ext_cn: 然后我们在杜鹃花丛中沿着陡坡向上爬。
ext.ext_en: Then we ascend steeply through forests of rhododendron.

defs.def_en: If you ascend a hill or staircase, you go up it.

ext.ext_cn: 一段石阶从鹅卵石路上一直向上直通城墙。
ext.ext_en: A number of staircases ascend from the cobbled streets onto the ramparts.

ext.ext_cn: 螺旋上升的通向一座塔的路
ext.ext_en: ...an ascending spiral path leading to a tower.

defs.def_en: If a staircase or path ascends, it leads up to a higher position.

ext.ext_cn: 打钻和提钻时要保持钻头平稳。
ext.ext_en: Keep the drill steady while it ascends and descends...

ext.ext_cn: 诺特和迪金森乘坐热气球上升了55，900英尺，创造了一项新的高度纪录。
ext.ext_en: Nott and Dickinson set a new altitude record when they ascended 55,900 feet in their balloon.

defs.def_en: If something ascends, it moves up, usually vertically or into the air.

defs.def_cn: 升迁；升职；(君主)登基,即位

ext.ext_cn: 同年，他上台掌权。
ext.ext_en: ...the same year he ascended to power...

ext.ext_cn: 在升为法官之前，她是纽约一家大型律所的律师。
ext.ext_en: Before ascending to the bench, she was a lawyer in a large New York firm.

defs.def_en: If someone ascends to an important position, they achieve it or are appointed to it. When someone ascends a throne, they become king, queen, or pope.

ext.ext_cn: 蒙博托出身行伍，通过一级级晋升，最终成为了陆军司令。
ext.ext_en: Mobutu ascended through the ranks, eventually becoming commander of the army...

ext.ext_cn: 随着仕途晋升，他们可以在部门间随意调动。
ext.ext_en: They move freely from one department to another as they ascend the civil service ladder.

defs.def_en: If you ascend in your career or in society, you gradually achieve success or a higher status.

defs.def_cn: （在某些宗教中指灵魂）升天，进入天堂

ext.ext_cn: 虔诚和善良的灵魂会升入天堂的信仰
ext.ext_en: ...the belief that the souls of the faithful and virtuous would ascend to heaven.

defs.def_en: In some religions, when someone's soul goes to heaven, you can say that they ascend to heaven.

ext.ext_cn: 故事从一个哥特式悲剧升华为神奇的童话。
ext.ext_en: The story ascends from a gothic tragedy to a miraculous fairy-tale.

defs.def_en: If something or someone ascends to a higher level, they reach a state that is better than the one they were in before.

defs.def_cn: 没有预设目标的；无意作出结论的；无期限的

ext.ext_cn: 女孩子更擅长需要独立思考的开放式任务。
ext.ext_en: Girls do better on open-ended tasks that require them to think for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 关于乘客对航空公司有何期望的无确定答案的问题
ext.ext_en: ...open-ended questions about what passengers expect of an airline.

defs.def_en: When people begin an open-ended discussion or activity, they do not have a particular result, decision, or timespan in mind.

ext.ext_cn: 劳里·李的自传体小说三部曲
ext.ext_en: …Laurie Lee's trilogy of autobiographical novels.

defs.def_en: A trilogy is a series of three books, plays, or films that have the same subject or the same characters.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 脚步不稳的；身体摇晃的

ext.ext_cn: 男孩站立不稳，并且起身后四下走动时步子踉跄。
ext.ext_en: The boy was very unsteady and had staggered around when he got up...

ext.ext_cn: 他把咖啡倒进杯里，然后一只手颤巍巍地端了一杯给戴维。
ext.ext_en: He poured coffee into the mugs, and with an unsteady hand, held one of them out to David.

defs.def_en: If you are unsteady, you have difficulty doing something, for example walking, because you cannot completely control your legs or your body.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不稳定的；不可靠的；无法捉摸的；变幻无常的

ext.ext_cn: 他的声音发颤，而且小得只刚刚能听见。
ext.ext_en: His voice was unsteady and only just audible...

ext.ext_cn: 她有亲身体验，知道情绪变化无常的家长对一个敏感的小女孩会产生什么影响。
ext.ext_en: She knew first-hand the impact an unsteady parent could have on a sensitive young girl.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unsteady, you mean that it is not regular or stable, but unreliable or unpredictable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不牢固的；不稳固的；不结实的

ext.ext_cn: 一件稍微有些不结实的家具
ext.ext_en: ...a slightly unsteady item of furniture.

defs.def_en: Unsteady objects are not held, fixed, or balanced securely.
A philatelist is a person who collects and studies postage stamps.

ext.ext_cn: 想交其他朋友并不意味着你不爱你的伴侣。
ext.ext_en: Wanting other friends doesn't mean you don't love your partner.

ext.ext_cn: 他对婚姻伴侣的选择
ext.ext_en: ...his choice of marriage partner.

defs.def_en: Your partner is the person you are married to or are having a romantic or sexual relationship with.

ext.ext_cn: 和舞伴跳舞
ext.ext_en: ...to dance with a partner...

ext.ext_cn: 那场比赛我的搭档是那位了不起的美国选手。
ext.ext_en: My partner for the event was the marvellous American player.

defs.def_en: Your partner is the person you are doing something with, for example dancing with or playing with in a game against two other people.

ext.ext_cn: 他是芝加哥一家律师事务所的合伙人。
ext.ext_en: He's a partner in a Chicago law firm.

ext.ext_cn: 她生意上的合伙人马克斯·汉普希尔
ext.ext_en: ...her business partner Max Hampshire.

defs.def_en: The partners in a firm or business are the people who share the ownership of it.

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙一直是古巴的主要贸易伙伴之一。
ext.ext_en: Spain has been one of Cuba's major trading partners.

ext.ext_cn: 斯洛伐克联合政府中的主要盟友
ext.ext_en: ...the main coalition partner in the Slovak government.

defs.def_en: The partner of a country or organization is another country or organization with which they work or do business.

defs.def_cn: （比赛或舞蹈中）做…的伙伴（或搭档），与…配对

ext.ext_cn: 他已经和那位著名的俄罗斯芭蕾舞女演员做了搭档。
ext.ext_en: He had partnered the famous Russian ballerina...

ext.ext_cn: 他将和卫冕冠军伊恩·贝克搭档。
ext.ext_en: He will be partnered by Ian Baker, the defending champion...

defs.def_en: If you partner someone, you are their partner in a game or in a dance.

ext.ext_cn: 他们头戴用夏季鲜花编成的花环。
ext.ext_en: They wore garlands of summer flowers in their hair.

defs.def_en: A garland is a circular decoration made from flowers and leaves. People sometimes wear garlands of flowers on their heads or around their necks.

defs.def_cn: 用花环装饰；给…戴上花冠（或饰以花环）

ext.ext_cn: 运动员和官员们戴着花环。
ext.ext_en: Players and officials were garlanded with flowers...

ext.ext_cn: 马车都用鲜花装点，由佩戴花环的几匹马拉着。
ext.ext_en: The wagons were decorated with flowers and pulled by garlanded horses.

defs.def_en: If people, places, or objects are garlanded, people hang garlands or similar decorations around them.

defs.def_cn: 欧洲的;与欧洲有关的;来自欧洲的

ext.ext_cn: 在其他一些欧洲国家
ext.ext_en: ...in some other European countries.

defs.def_en: European means belonging or relating to, or coming from Europe.
A European is a person who comes from Europe.

ext.ext_cn: 史蒂芬本人偏爱猫。
ext.ext_en: Stephen himself had a weakness for cats...

ext.ext_cn: 除了对飞机情有独钟，他还嗜好冰激凌。
ext.ext_en: His one weakness, apart from aeroplanes, is ice cream.

defs.def_en: See also:weak;If you have a weakness for something, you like it very much, although this is perhaps surprising or undesirable.

defs.def_cn: 预备学校（英国为11或13岁以下的儿童开办的私立学校）
defs.def_en: In Britain, a prep school is a private school where children are educated until the age of 11 or 13.

defs.def_cn: 预备学校，预科学校（美国为准备升入大学者而设的私立学校）

ext.ext_cn: 华盛顿一所贵族预科学校
ext.ext_en: ...an exclusive prep school in Washington.

defs.def_en: In the United States, a prep school is a private school for students who intend to go to college after they leave.
A secret agent is a person who is employed by a government to find out the secrets of other governments.

defs.def_cn: 东方的，东亚的（尤指中国和日本的）

ext.ext_cn: 地上铺的是来自东方的地毯。
ext.ext_en: There were Oriental carpets on the floors.

ext.ext_cn: 东方食物
ext.ext_en: ...oriental food.

defs.def_en: Oriental means coming from or associated with eastern Asia, especially China and Japan.

defs.def_cn: 东方人（尤指中国人或日本人）（可能具冒犯意味）

ext.ext_cn: 东方人不吃黄油，他们更喜欢对健康非常有益处的花生油。
ext.ext_en: The Orientals use no butter. They prefer the very healthful peanut oil.

defs.def_en: Some people refer to people from eastern Asia, especially China or Japan as Orientals. This use could cause offence.
Pus is a thick yellowish liquid that forms in wounds when they are infected.

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚刚过10点钟麻烦就开始了。
ext.ext_en: The trouble began just after ten o'clock last night...

ext.ext_cn: 我睡着了，凌晨两点的时候醒了过来。
ext.ext_en: I went to sleep, and at two o'clock in the morning I woke up.

defs.def_en: You use o'clock after numbers from one to twelve to say what time it is. For example, if you say that it is 9 o'clock, you mean that it is nine hours after midnight or nine hours after midday.
Beetroot is a dark red root that is eaten as a vegetable. It is often preserved in vinegar.

defs.def_cn: (与形容词或名词连用构成形容词)表示“有…屋顶的”,“有…房顶的”

ext.ext_cn: 一栋用混凝土和玻璃建成的巨大的平顶大楼
ext.ext_en: ...a huge flat-roofed concrete and glass building.

ext.ext_cn: 屋顶铺瓦的农舍
ext.ext_en: ...tile-roofed farmhouses.

defs.def_en: -roofed combines with adjectives and nouns to form adjectives that describe what kind of roof a building has.
A jet engine is an engine in which hot air and gases are forced out at the back. Jet engines are used for most modern aircraft.

defs.def_cn: （以旧时生活为背景的）情色电影，艳情小说
defs.def_en: You can refer to a film or novel which is set in the past and which includes a lot of sex scenes as a bodice ripper, especially if you do not think it is very good and is just intended to entertain people.

ext.ext_cn: 肉桂是种绝佳的提味调料。
ext.ext_en: Cinnamon is an excellent flavour enhancer.

defs.def_en: An enhancer is a substance or a device which makes a particular thing look, taste, or feel better.

ext.ext_cn: 他企图跳入河中逃跑。
ext.ext_en: He tried to escape by diving into a river...

ext.ext_cn: 她站在水池旁边，正要往里跳。
ext.ext_en: She was standing by a pool, about to dive in...

defs.def_en: If you dive into some water, you jump in head-first with your arms held straight above your head.

ext.ext_cn: 贝扎尼奇正在潜水采集海洋生物。
ext.ext_en: Bezanik is diving to collect marine organisms.

ext.ext_cn: 这是我在撒丁岛附近的沉船残骸处潜水时所见的景象。
ext.ext_en: This sighting occurred during my dive to a sunken wreck off Sardinia.

defs.def_en: If you dive, you go under the surface of the sea or a lake, using special breathing equipment.

defs.def_cn: (鸟或动物)俯冲，急速下扑(或下潜)

ext.ext_cn: 刚刚潜入水中捕鱼的鹈鹕
ext.ext_en: ...a pelican which had just dived for a fish...

ext.ext_cn: 鲨鱼急速潜入水中，在船下游动。
ext.ext_en: The shark dived down and swam under the boat.

defs.def_en: When birds and animals dive, they go quickly downwards, head-first, through the air or through water.

ext.ext_cn: 他因驾驶的单翼飞机失速坠地而丧生。
ext.ext_en: He was killed when his monoplane stalled and dived into the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 目击者说飞机未能从俯冲状态下重新拉起，坠毁在了田间。
ext.ext_en: Witnesses said the plane failed to pull out of a dive and smashed down in a field.

defs.def_en: If an aeroplane dives, it flies or drops down quickly and suddenly.

ext.ext_cn: 他们迅速钻进一辆出租车。
ext.ext_en: They dived into a taxi...

ext.ext_cn: 出纳员在持枪歹徒开枪时冲向藏身处。
ext.ext_en: The cashier dived for cover when a gunman opened fire...

defs.def_en: If you dive in a particular direction or into a particular place, you jump or move there quickly.

defs.def_cn: 迅速将手伸入(包或容器中)

ext.ext_cn: 她立即将手伸入包中拿出一张折好的纸。
ext.ext_en: She dived into her bag and brought out a folded piece of paper.

defs.def_en: If you dive into a bag or container, you put your hands into it quickly in order to get something out.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们降低利率，英镑就会大幅贬值。
ext.ext_en: If we cut interest rates, the pound would dive...

ext.ext_cn: 利润从770万英镑暴跌至710万英镑。
ext.ext_en: Profits have dived from £7.7m to £7.1m...

defs.def_en: If shares, profits, or figures dive, their value falls suddenly and by a large amount.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在利物浦所有的小酒吧和低级夜总会演出过。
ext.ext_en: We've played in all the little pubs and dives around Liverpool.

defs.def_en: If you describe a bar or club as a dive, you mean it is dirty and dark, and not very respectable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这两种蘑菇看起来似乎都无害,实际上却是致命的。
ext.ext_en: Both mushrooms look innocuous but are in fact deadly...

ext.ext_cn: 甚至看似毫无恶意的言辞在某些语境下都会引起冒犯。
ext.ext_en: Even seemingly innocuous words are offensive in certain contexts.

defs.def_en: Something that is innocuous is not at all harmful or offensive.

defs.def_cn: （意外情况下）充当替代者，代替

ext.ext_cn: 宾馆客人多时，这里的职员可以互相替班。
ext.ext_en: The staff here can pinch hit for each other when the hotel is busy.

defs.def_en: If you pinch-hit for someone, you do something for them because they are unexpectedly unable to do it.

defs.def_cn: （棒球比赛中替补队员在关键时刻）替补击球

ext.ext_cn: 达瓦里洛上场替补击球。
ext.ext_en: Davalillo goes up to pinch-hit.

defs.def_en: In a game of baseball, if you pinch-hit for another player, you hit the ball instead of them.

defs.def_cn: (用于记不起或是努力想记起某个女人的名字时）叫什么名字的女人

ext.ext_cn: 这就是那个叫什么什么的女人给我的东西。
ext.ext_en: That's the thing that whatshername gave me.

defs.def_en: You say whatshername instead of a woman's name when you cannot remember it or are trying to remember it.

ext.ext_cn: “好撒马利亚人”的寓言
ext.ext_en: ...the parable of the Good Samaritan...

ext.ext_cn: 这是个令人开怀的寓言，讲的是财富过剩造成的问题。
ext.ext_en: The story is a pleasing parable of the problems created by an excess of wealth.

defs.def_en: A parable is a short story, which is told in order to make a moral or religious point, like those in the Bible.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一次不错的尝试，但效果欠佳。
ext.ext_en: It was a good try but it didn't quite come off...

ext.ext_cn: 斯洛沃说这是一次重大的活动，他希望活动能够井然有序，不出乱子。
ext.ext_en: Slovo said it was a great occasion which he hoped would come off in an orderly and peaceful way.

defs.def_en: If something comes off, it is successful or effective.

ext.ext_cn: 一些民主党人士至今仍然记得当时困难重重、在调查中惨败的痛苦经历。
ext.ext_en: Some Democrats still have bitter memories of how, against all odds, they came off worst during the inquiry...

ext.ext_cn: 在这种情况下，几个经理表现得最好。
ext.ext_en: In these circumstances, it is the managers who come off best.

defs.def_en: If someone comes off worst in a contest or conflict, they are in the worst position after it. If they come off best, they are in the best position.

ext.ext_cn: 尝试停用止痛药的人
ext.ext_en: ...people trying to come off tranquillizers.

defs.def_en: If you come off a drug or medicine, you stop taking it.
You say 'come off it' to someone to show them that you think what they are saying is untrue or wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 穆拉特毫不退缩地直视着执行枪决的行刑队员们的眼睛。
ext.ext_en: Murat had looked into the eyes of the firing squad without flinching...

ext.ext_cn: 岩石尖尖的表面剐到了她的皮肤，令她后缩了一下。
ext.ext_en: The sharp surface of the rock caught at her skin, making her flinch.

defs.def_en: If you flinch, you make a small sudden movement, especially when something surprises you or hurts you.

ext.ext_cn: 国际社会在面对这一挑战时不应该回避。
ext.ext_en: The world community should not flinch in the face of this challenge...

ext.ext_cn: 在艰难的财政决策面前他从没有退缩过。
ext.ext_en: He has never flinched from harsh financial decisions.

defs.def_en: If you flinch from something unpleasant, you are unwilling to do it or think about it, or you avoid doing it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是一桩恶性谋杀案的受害者。
ext.ext_en: He was the victim of a very brutal murder.

ext.ext_cn: 对反政府抗议的残酷镇压
ext.ext_en: ...the brutal suppression of anti-government protests...

defs.def_en: A brutal act or person is cruel and violent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 直截了当的；直言不讳的；直率的

ext.ext_cn: 他们直言不讳地谈论自己和自己的感受，让人觉得耳目一新。
ext.ext_en: It was refreshing to talk about themselves and their feelings with brutal honesty...

ext.ext_cn: 他痛苦地吸了口气，不得不坦言此事。
ext.ext_en: He took an anguished breath. He had to be brutal and say it.

defs.def_en: If someone expresses something unpleasant with brutal honesty or frankness, they express it in a clear and accurate way, without attempting to disguise its unpleasantness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 残酷无情的；难以忍受的

ext.ext_cn: 今年夏天价格的大幅下跌将会很残酷。
ext.ext_en: The dip in prices this summer will be brutal...

ext.ext_cn: 下午的太阳酷热难挡。
ext.ext_en: The afternoon sun had been brutal...

defs.def_en: Brutal is used to describe things that have an unpleasant effect on people, especially when there is no attempt by anyone to reduce their effect.

ext.ext_cn: 他们要发动一次更大的政变。
ext.ext_en: They were about to bring off an even bigger coup...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为他的书能改变社会，但是他没有完成它。
ext.ext_en: He thought his book would change society. But he didn't bring it off.

defs.def_en: If you bring off something difficult, you do it successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 她热切渴望学到更高超的烹饪技巧。
ext.ext_en: She was keen to acquire more advanced culinary skills...

ext.ext_cn: 做三道菜的一餐就能包含烹饪的所有乐趣。
ext.ext_en: A three course dinner completes the culinary delights.

defs.def_en: Culinary means concerned with cooking.
A video diary is a film that someone makes of the things that happen to them over a period of time, recorded using a video camera.
A newscaster is a person who reads the news on the radio or on television.
An ordinal number or an ordinal is a word such as 'first', 'third', and 'tenth' that tells you where a particular thing occurs in a sequence of things.

ext.ext_cn: 无用的家庭垃圾
ext.ext_en: ...unwanted household rubbish...

ext.ext_cn: 他们把大多数的垃圾堆到了黄色的废料桶里。
ext.ext_en: They had piled most of their rubbish into yellow skips.

defs.def_en: Rubbish consists of unwanted things or waste material such as used paper, empty tins and bottles, and waste food.

ext.ext_cn: 他说她的书一文不值。
ext.ext_en: He described her book as absolute rubbish.

defs.def_en: If you think that something is of very poor quality, you can say that it is rubbish .

ext.ext_cn: 他胡说八道。
ext.ext_en: He's talking rubbish...

ext.ext_cn: 这些报告废话连篇。
ext.ext_en: These reports are total and utter rubbish.

defs.def_en: If you think that an idea or a statement is foolish or wrong, you can say that it is rubbish .

defs.def_cn: 极不擅长的;非常差劲的

ext.ext_cn: 他的工作做得差劲极了。
ext.ext_en: He was rubbish at his job...

ext.ext_cn: 我试过打高尔夫球，但是我的球技太烂了。
ext.ext_en: I tried playing golf, but I was rubbish.

defs.def_en: If you think that someone is not very good at something, you can say that they are rubbish at it.

defs.def_cn: 贬低;诋毁;将…说得一文不值

ext.ext_cn: 整整5页讲稿都是对她的政敌的诋毁。
ext.ext_en: Five whole pages of script were devoted to rubbishing her political opponents...

ext.ext_cn: 官员们对所有的正面意见一律否决。
ext.ext_en: Officials have simply rubbished all positive ideas.

defs.def_en: If you rubbish a person, their ideas or their work, you say they are of little value.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 热爱和平的；不爱惹事的

ext.ext_cn: 大体上，这些人都是热爱和平、遵纪守法的公民。
ext.ext_en: By and large, these people are peace-loving, law-abiding citizens.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as peace-loving, you mean that they try to avoid quarrelling or fighting with other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一位满脸胡须的老人
ext.ext_en: ...a whiskery old man.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as whiskery, you mean that they have lots of stiff little hairs on their face.

defs.def_cn: (政府对进口商品征收的)关税

ext.ext_cn: 美国打算取消电子产品等的关税。
ext.ext_en: America wants to eliminate tariffs on items such as electronics.

defs.def_en: A tariff is a tax that a government collects on goods coming into a country.

defs.def_cn: (公共服务的)收费，费用;(旅馆的)住宿费，服务费

ext.ext_cn: 日常费用包括住宿以及游泳池和健身房的不限时使用。
ext.ext_en: The daily tariff includes accommodation and unlimited use of the pool and gymnasium.

ext.ext_cn: 电费和电话费
ext.ext_en: ...electricity tariffs and telephone charges.

defs.def_en: A tariff is the rate at which you are charged for public services such as gas and electricity, or for accommodation and services in a hotel.
Yeast is a kind of fungus which is used to make bread rise, and in making alcoholic drinks such as beer.

defs.def_cn: 不正确的;错误的;不真实的

ext.ext_cn: 他否认自己关于电话的证词是虚假的。
ext.ext_en: He denied that his evidence about the telephone call was incorrect...

ext.ext_cn: 人们对食物经常会有不正确的认识。
ext.ext_en: People often have incorrect information about food.

defs.def_en: Something that is incorrect is wrong and untrue.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 由不当姿势造成的损伤
ext.ext_en: ...injuries caused by incorrect posture.

ext.ext_cn: 不当的饮食
ext.ext_en: ...incorrect diet.

defs.def_en: Something that is incorrect is not the thing that is required or is most suitable in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 他耳朵里进了肥皂泡。
ext.ext_en: He had soap suds in his ears.

ext.ext_cn: 厨房洗碗槽里油腻的泡沫
ext.ext_en: ...the greasy suds of a kitchen washing up bowl.

defs.def_en: Suds are the bubbles that are produced when a substance such as soap is mixed with water.

defs.def_cn: （用绳索、布或其他材料打的）结

ext.ext_cn: 一条带子已经断了，打了个结。
ext.ext_en: One lace had broken and been tied in a knot.

defs.def_en: If you tie a knot in a piece of string, rope, cloth, or other material, you pass one end or part of it through a loop and pull it tight.

defs.def_cn: 把（绳索、布或其他材料）打成结

ext.ext_cn: 他把带子紧紧地系在一起。
ext.ext_en: He knotted the laces securely together...

ext.ext_cn: 他在脖子上系了一条印花大围巾。
ext.ext_en: He knotted the bandanna around his neck.

defs.def_en: If you knot a piece of string, rope, cloth, or other material, you pass one end or part of it through a loop and pull it tight.

ext.ext_cn: 一小群人站在那儿鼓掌。
ext.ext_en: A little knot of men stood clapping.

defs.def_en: A knot of people is a group of people who are standing very close together.

defs.def_cn: （通常由害怕或激动引起的胃的）痉挛，郁结

ext.ext_cn: 他紧张得心揪得紧紧的。
ext.ext_en: There was a knot of tension in his stomach.

defs.def_en: If you feel a knot in your stomach, you get an uncomfortable tight feeling in your stomach, usually because you are afraid or excited.

defs.def_cn: （因害怕或激动而）痉挛，紧缩，使痉挛

ext.ext_cn: 我很担忧，心都揪紧了。
ext.ext_en: I felt my stomach knot with apprehension...

ext.ext_cn: 从前那些可怕的经历让她的心都揪紧了。
ext.ext_en: The old dread knotted her stomach.

defs.def_en: If your stomach knots or if something knots it, it feels tight because you are afraid or excited.

defs.def_cn: （通常因担心或愤怒而肌肉等）紧张，紧绷

ext.ext_cn: 他眉头紧锁。
ext.ext_en: His forehead knotted in a frown.

ext.ext_cn: 他紧绷的肌肉
ext.ext_en: ...his knotted muscles.

defs.def_en: If part of your face or your muscles knot, they become tense, usually because you are worried or angry.
A knot in a piece of wood is a small hard area where a branch grew.

defs.def_cn: 节（船、飞行器和风的速度计量单位）

ext.ext_cn: 他们以高达30节的速度行进。
ext.ext_en: They travel at speeds of up to 30 knots.

ext.ext_cn: 13节的风
ext.ext_en: ...thirteen knot winds.

defs.def_en: A knot is a unit of speed. The speed of ships, aircraft, and winds is measured in knots.

ext.ext_cn: 那个广告宣传人员急于道歉。
ext.ext_en: The press agent tied himself in knots trying to apologise.

defs.def_en: If you tie yourself in knots, you get very confused and anxious.

ext.ext_cn: 莱恩5年前和凯特结婚了。
ext.ext_en: Len tied the knot with Kate five years ago.

defs.def_en: If you say that two people tie the knot, you mean that they get married.

ext.ext_cn: 她在床头柜上放了一杯茶。
ext.ext_en: She put a cup of tea down on the bedside table...

ext.ext_cn: 他拉了把椅子到床边坐了下来。
ext.ext_en: He drew a chair up to the bedside and sat down.

defs.def_en: Your bedside is the area beside your bed.

ext.ext_cn: 她整夜都守在病重的儿子床边。
ext.ext_en: She kept vigil at the bedside of her critically ill son...

ext.ext_cn: 她被叫到了哥哥的病榻前。
ext.ext_en: She was called to her brother's bedside.

defs.def_en: If you talk about being at someone's bedside, you are talking about being near them when they are ill in bed.

ext.ext_cn: 出生证明
ext.ext_en: ...birth certificates.

ext.ext_cn: 股权证
ext.ext_en: ...share certificates.

defs.def_en: A certificate is an official document stating that particular facts are true.

defs.def_cn: 结业证书;合格证书;文凭

ext.ext_cn: 壁炉的右边是各种镶框的证书。
ext.ext_en: To the right of the fireplace are various framed certificates.

ext.ext_cn: 教育学研究生毕业证书
ext.ext_en: ...the Post-Graduate Certificate of Education.

defs.def_en: A certificate is an official document that you receive when you have completed a course of study or training. The qualification that you receive is sometimes also called a certificate .

ext.ext_cn: 世界末日可能不远了，但我们真的在意吗？
ext.ext_en: The end of the world may be nigh, but do we really care?...

ext.ext_cn: 她想暴风雨必定仍会到来。
ext.ext_en: The storm must still be nigh, she thought.

defs.def_en: See also:well-nigh;If an event is nigh, it will happen very soon.

ext.ext_cn: 我一直是你的铁杆粉丝之一，到现在快3年了。
ext.ext_en: I've been one of your number one fans for nigh on three years now...

ext.ext_cn: 我不得不为它花了将近40英镑。
ext.ext_en: I had to pay nigh on forty pounds for it.

defs.def_en: Nigh on an amount, number, or age means almost that amount, number, or age.

defs.def_cn: 连续的刺耳声响;砰砰声

ext.ext_cn: 砰砰的敲门声
ext.ext_en: ...the rat-a-tat at the door.

ext.ext_cn: 机关枪发出的哒哒声
ext.ext_en: ...the rat-a-tat of machine guns.

defs.def_en: You use rat-a-tat to represent a series of sharp, repeated sounds, for example the sound of someone knocking at a door.

defs.def_cn: （有围墙或围栏，并且有门卫的）住宅小区，商业小区
defs.def_en: A gated community is an area of houses and sometimes shops that is surrounded by a wall or fence and has an entrance that is guarded.
Segmentation is the dividing of something into parts which are loosely connected.

ext.ext_cn: 在过去二三十年里，中高纬度地区的降雨量持续增加。
ext.ext_en: In the middle to high latitudes rainfall has risen steadily over the last 20-30 years.

ext.ext_cn: 在北纬36度以北地区，军队必须停止军事行动。
ext.ext_en: The army must cease military operations above 36 degrees latitude north.

defs.def_en: The latitude of a place is its distance from the equator.

ext.ext_cn: 他将可以不受任何限制地组建新政府。
ext.ext_en: He would be given every latitude in forming a new government...

ext.ext_cn: 他在创作室的地位让他可以在艺术上自由探索。
ext.ext_en: His status at the studio afforded him all the artistic latitude he could ask for.

defs.def_en: Latitude is freedom to choose the way in which you do something.

ext.ext_cn: 向柬埔寨运送人道援助物资的定期航班
ext.ext_en: ...regular flights carrying humanitarian aid to Cambodia...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经许诺援助几十亿美元。
ext.ext_en: They have already pledged billions of dollars in aid.

defs.def_en: Aid is money, equipment, or services that are provided for people, countries, or organizations who need them but cannot provide them for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 美国对库尔德难民的援助行动
ext.ext_en: ...US efforts to aid Kurdish refugees.

ext.ext_cn: 已投入巨资资助药物研究的一家慈善机构
ext.ext_en: ...a charitable organization that has spent millions aiding pharmaceutical research.

defs.def_en: To aid a country, organization, or person means to provide them with money, equipment, or services that they need.

ext.ext_cn: 帮助经理作出高级决策的软件系统
ext.ext_en: ...a software system to aid managers in advanced decision-making...

ext.ext_cn: 警方将在陆军和空军的帮助下，继续追踪谋杀她的凶手。
ext.ext_en: The hunt for her killer will continue, with police aided by the army and air force.

defs.def_en: To aid someone means to help or assist them.

ext.ext_cn: 借助于自己发现的一种全新的方法，他获得了成功。
ext.ext_en: He succeeded with the aid of a completely new method he discovered...

ext.ext_cn: 在不用手扶的前提下，慢慢抬起上身直到坐起。
ext.ext_en: Gently raise your upper body to a sitting position, without the aid of your hands.

defs.def_en: If you perform a task with the aid of something, you need or use that thing to perform that task.

defs.def_cn: 辅助物;辅助用具;辅助性技术

ext.ext_cn: 新法律规定当局有责任为残疾人提供帮助。
ext.ext_en: The new law gives authorities a responsibility to provide aids to the disabled...

ext.ext_cn: 这本书对于教授文学的老师来说帮助非常大。
ext.ext_en: The book is an invaluable aid to teachers of literature...

defs.def_en: An aid is an object, device, or technique that makes something easier to do.

ext.ext_cn: 出口产业将促进经济复苏。
ext.ext_en: The export sector will aid the economic recovery...

ext.ext_cn: 钙可能有助于预防结肠癌。
ext.ext_en: Calcium may aid in the prevention of colon cancer.

defs.def_en: If something aids a process, it makes it easier or more likely to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 为给大奥蒙德街儿童医院筹资而举办的慈善演出
ext.ext_en: ...a charity performance in aid of Great Ormond Street Children's Hospital.

defs.def_en: An activity or event in aid of a particular cause or charity is intended to raise money for that cause or charity.

ext.ext_cn: 我们应联合国的要求前去救援索马里的民众。
ext.ext_en: We're coming to the aid of the people of Somalia at the request of the United Nations...

ext.ext_cn: 他摔下来时，惊恐的邻居们赶忙冲过去救他。
ext.ext_en: Horrified neighbours rushed to his aid as he fell.

defs.def_en: If you come or go to someone's aid, you try to help them when they are in danger or difficulty.

ext.ext_cn: 我们所有活动都是以“优质、平等”为前提的。
ext.ext_en: All our activities are premised on the basis of 'Quality with Equality'.

defs.def_en: If a theory or attitude is premised on an idea or belief, that idea or belief has been used as the basis for it.

ext.ext_cn: 提前做计划是个好主意。
ext.ext_en: It's a good idea to plan ahead...

ext.ext_cn: 我非常赞同帮助他人的提议。
ext.ext_en: I really like the idea of helping people...

defs.def_en: An idea is a plan, suggestion, or possible course of action.

ext.ext_cn: 他关于民主的一些观点完全是他自己的创见。
ext.ext_en: Some of his ideas about democracy are entirely his own.

ext.ext_cn: 读书过多损害眼睛的看法
ext.ext_en: ...the idea that reading too many books ruins your eyes...

defs.def_en: An idea is an opinion or belief about what something is like or should be like.

ext.ext_cn: 这张表格会让你大致了解能力水平可以怎样评估。
ext.ext_en: This table will give you some idea of how levels of ability can be measured...

ext.ext_cn: 你能跟我们大致讲一下今年收到的投诉的范围吗？
ext.ext_en: Could you give us an idea of the range of complaints you've been receiving?...

defs.def_en: If someone gives you an idea of something, they give you information about it without being very exact or giving a lot of detail.

ext.ext_cn: 到这周末你便会清楚自己的饮食习惯了。
ext.ext_en: By the end of the week you will have a clear idea of what your eating habits are...

ext.ext_cn: 我们开始自责起来，怪自己不够小心。
ext.ext_en: We begin to reproach ourselves for not having been more careful.

defs.def_en: If you reproach yourself, you think with regret about something you have done wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 这些枪杀和轰炸事件是“我们所有欧洲人的丑闻和耻辱”。
ext.ext_en: The shootings and bombings were 'a scandal and reproach to all of us in Europe'.

defs.def_en: If you consider someone's actions or behaviour to be a reproach to a group of people, you consider them to be harmful or insulting to that group.

defs.def_cn: （have 的第三人称单数的过时形式）
defs.def_en: Hath is an old-fashioned third person singular form of the verb 'have'.

ext.ext_cn: 警方已经发布了那名年龄在 50 到 60 岁之间的男子的相貌特征通告。
ext.ext_en: Police have issued a description of the man who was aged between fifty and sixty...

ext.ext_cn: 有关意大利舰队的行动和作战计划的详细说明
ext.ext_en: ...a detailed description of the movements and battle plans of Italy's fleet...

defs.def_en: A description of someone or something is an account which explains what they are or what they look like.

ext.ext_cn: 英国所有天主教堂中最古老的一座
ext.ext_en: ...the oldest Catholic church of any description in England...

ext.ext_cn: 这类事件天天发生。
ext.ext_en: Events of this description occurred daily.

defs.def_en: If something is of a particular description, it belongs to the general class of items that are mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 他一脸难以形容的疲惫。
ext.ext_en: His face is weary beyond description...

ext.ext_cn: 我们陷入了难以言表的糟糕处境。
ext.ext_en: We were in a disaster situation that defies description.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is beyond description, or that it defies description, to emphasize that it is very unusual, impressive, terrible, or extreme.

defs.def_cn: 给…更换电线;给…重新布线

ext.ext_cn: 他们的第一份工作就是给整个房子重新布线，并安装中央供暖系统。
ext.ext_en: Their first job was to rewire the whole house and install central heating...

ext.ext_cn: 我只好花了一大笔钱给房子重新布线铺管。
ext.ext_en: I have had to spend a lot of money having my house replumbed and rewired.

defs.def_en: If someone rewires a building or an electrical appliance, a new system of electrical wiring is put into it.
A paintbrush is a brush which you use for painting.

ext.ext_cn: 他的绘画天赋
ext.ext_en: ...his painterly talents...

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影的影像有绘画的风格。
ext.ext_en: The film has a painterly eye.

defs.def_en: Painterly means relating to or characteristic of painting or painters.
A plenum is a meeting that is attended by all the members of a committee or conference.

defs.def_cn: 在极端情况下;在绝境中

ext.ext_cn: 然而现在他就在这里,在绝境中寻求联盟。
ext.ext_en: Yet now he was here, in extremis, to seek an alliance...

ext.ext_cn: 只有在万不得已的情况下才允许使用抗生素。
ext.ext_en: The use of antibiotics is permitted only in extremis.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is in extremis, they are in a very difficult situation and have to use extreme methods.

ext.ext_cn: 治疗处于弥留之际的病人
ext.ext_en: ...to treat patients who were in extremis.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone is in extremis when they are very ill and likely to die.

ext.ext_cn: 这个发现似乎能印证流行占星术的一些说法。
ext.ext_en: This discovery seems to validate the claims of popular astrology.

ext.ext_cn: 历史学家如何评估和确认该证据
ext.ext_en: ...how that evidence was evaluated and validated by historians.

defs.def_en: To validate something such as a claim or statement means to prove or confirm that it is true or correct.

ext.ext_cn: 她在寻求一种能够证明自己价值的形象。
ext.ext_en: She is looking for an image that validates her...

ext.ext_cn: 奥斯卡金像奖似乎是对他事业的肯定。
ext.ext_en: The Academy Awards appear to validate his career.

defs.def_en: To validate a person, state, or system means to prove or confirm that they are valuable or worthwhile.
A climbing frame is a structure that has been made for children to climb and play on. It consists of metal or wooden bars joined together.

ext.ext_cn: 他以一块奥运金牌为自己的职业生涯画上了圆满的句号。
ext.ext_en: He topped off his career with an Olympic gold medal...

ext.ext_cn: 最后博物馆特别展示了其新收藏的一件德加作品，当晚的活动就此圆满结束。
ext.ext_en: The evening was topped off by a special showing of the museum's new Degas exhibit…

defs.def_en: If you top off an event or period with a particular thing, you end it in an especially satisfactory, dramatic, or annoying way by doing that thing.

defs.def_cn: 巨人;伟人;庞然大物;极重要的事情

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个伟人，一个传奇人物。
ext.ext_en: He was a colossus, a legend.

ext.ext_cn: 萨克斯演奏大师桑尼·罗利斯
ext.ext_en: ...saxophone colossus Sonny Rollins...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as a colossus, you think that they are extremely important and great in ability or size.
A colossus is an extremely large statue.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人烦恼的;伤脑筋的;棘手的

ext.ext_cn: 部长们开始着手处理经济联盟这个棘手的问题。
ext.ext_en: Ministers have begun work on the vexed issue of economic union...

ext.ext_cn: 后来莫伊先生提出了那个让人头疼的难民问题。
ext.ext_en: Later Mr Moi raised the vexed question of refugees.

defs.def_en: See also:vex;A vexed problem or question is very difficult and causes people a lot of trouble.
A dry-stone wall is a wall that has been built by fitting stones together without using any cement.

ext.ext_cn: 女性生殖系统
ext.ext_en: ...the female reproductive system.

defs.def_en: Reproductive processes and organs are concerned with the reproduction of living things.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已理清了他去世前几天的活动情况。
ext.ext_en: They've pieced together his movements for the last few days before his death...

ext.ext_cn: 在随后的几天里，弗朗西斯得以把发生的事情拼凑出来。
ext.ext_en: In the following days, Francis was able to piece together what had happened...

defs.def_en: If you piece together the truth about something, you gradually discover it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个过程和拼图相似。
ext.ext_en: This process is akin to piecing together a jigsaw puzzle...

ext.ext_cn: 医生们精心地把碎骨拼合起来。
ext.ext_en: Doctors painstakingly pieced together the broken bones.

defs.def_en: If you piece something together, you gradually make it by joining several things or parts together.
A metronome is a device which is used to indicate how quickly a piece of music should be played. It can be adjusted to make regular sounds at different speeds.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 冗长的会议
ext.ext_en: ...a lengthy meeting.

ext.ext_cn: 填写护照申请表的漫长过程
ext.ext_en: ...the lengthy process of filling out passport application forms.

defs.def_en: You use lengthy to describe an event or process which lasts for a long time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （报告、文章等）长篇大论的，冗长的

ext.ext_cn: 部长会议发布的冗长报告
ext.ext_en: ...a lengthy report from the Council of Ministers...

ext.ext_cn: 《观察家报》上有一篇关于斯派克·米利根的长篇文章。
ext.ext_en: There is a lengthy article on Spike Milligan in the Observer newspaper.

defs.def_en: A lengthy report, article, book, or document contains a lot of speech, writing, or other material.
An adjutant is an officer in the army who deals with administrative work.

defs.def_cn: 指定（款项等）用作特定用途

ext.ext_cn: 指定用于新项目的额外资金
ext.ext_en: ...the extra money being earmarked for the new projects...

ext.ext_cn: 教育部为这所新学校划拨了600万英镑的专款。
ext.ext_en: The education department has earmarked £6m for the new school...

defs.def_en: If resources such as money are earmarked for a particular purpose, they are reserved for that purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的支持意味着他不必被迫出售去年已决定要卖掉的公司。
ext.ext_en: Their support meant that he was not forced to sell the business which was earmarked for disposal last year...

ext.ext_cn: 这是工贸大臣明确指出要关闭的31个矿井之一。
ext.ext_en: The pit was one of the 31 earmarked for closure by the Trade and Industry Secretary.

defs.def_en: If something has been earmarked for closure or disposal, for example, people have decided that it will be closed or got rid of.

ext.ext_cn: 第一批临床实验有望明年开始。
ext.ext_en: The first clinical trials were expected to begin next year.

ext.ext_cn: 临床心理学家
ext.ext_en: ...a clinical psychologist.

defs.def_en: Clinical means involving or relating to the direct medical treatment or testing of patients.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （思想、行为）非常符合逻辑的，不带感情的

ext.ext_cn: 整个询问分析性和逻辑性太强，浪漫的气息荡然无存。
ext.ext_en: All this questioning is so analytical and clinical — it kills romance.

defs.def_en: You use clinical to describe thought or behaviour which is very logical and does not involve any emotion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她有一双蓝色的眼睛，头上有一缕缕的金发。
ext.ext_en: She has streaky fair hair and blue eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 带有条纹窗户的空房子
ext.ext_en: ...the empty house with its streaky windows.

defs.def_en: Something that is streaky is marked with long stripes that are a different colour to the rest of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经在努力消灭疟疾、破伤风等疾病。
ext.ext_en: They are already battling to eradicate illnesses such as malaria and tetanus...

ext.ext_cn: 如果可以消灭那些单调乏味的工作，世界将会变得更加美好。
ext.ext_en: If tedious tasks could be eradicated, the world would be a much better place.

defs.def_en: To eradicate something means to get rid of it completely.
A right angle is an angle of ninety degrees. A square has four right angles.

ext.ext_cn: 两束成直角的激光
ext.ext_en: ...two lasers at right angles.

defs.def_en: If two things are at right angles, they are situated so that they form an angle of 90˚ where they touch each other. You can also say that one thing is at right angles to another.
Skirting board or skirting is a narrow length of wood which goes along the bottom of a wall in a room and makes a border between the walls and the floor.

ext.ext_cn: 他们不会准许你结婚。
ext.ext_en: They'll forbid you to marry...

ext.ext_cn: 她被关了起来，并且不允许看书。
ext.ext_en: She was shut away and forbidden to read...

defs.def_en: If you forbid someone to do something, or if you forbid an activity, you order that it must not be done.

ext.ext_cn: 他的自尊心不允许他开口向阿瑟求助。
ext.ext_en: His own pride forbids him to ask Arthur's help...

ext.ext_cn: 传统习惯阻碍着现代化的进程。
ext.ext_en: Custom forbids any modernisation.

defs.def_en: If something forbids a particular course of action or state of affairs, it makes it impossible for the course of action or state of affairs to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 交换战俘是联合国和平计划的一个重要部分。
ext.ext_en: The exchange of prisoners of war was one of the key elements of the UN's peace plan.

defs.def_en: The different elements of something are the different parts it contains.

ext.ext_cn: 现在健康已经成为我们生活中的一个要素。
ext.ext_en: Fitness has now become an important element in our lives.

defs.def_en: A particular element of a situation, activity, or process is an important quality or feature that it has or needs.

defs.def_cn: （社会或组织内部具有相同目标、信仰或习惯的）一群人，一组人，分子

ext.ext_cn: 安保部队中的犯罪分子
ext.ext_en: ...criminal elements within the security forces.

ext.ext_cn: 流氓团伙
ext.ext_en: ...the hooligan element.

defs.def_en: When you talk about elements within a society or organization, you are referring to groups of people who have similar aims, beliefs, or habits.

ext.ext_cn: 这些报告明显带有一些宣传的意味。
ext.ext_en: These reports clearly contain elements of propaganda.

defs.def_en: If something has an element of a particular quality or emotion, it has a certain amount of this quality or emotion.
An element is a substance such as gold, oxygen, or carbon that consists of only one type of atom.

defs.def_cn: （电炉、热水器等的）电热元件，电热丝

ext.ext_cn: 其独特的电热元件使它能够煮出非常美味的咖啡。
ext.ext_en: With its unique heating element it makes perfect coffee.

defs.def_en: The element in an electric fire or water heater is the metal part which changes the electric current into heat.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数难民等待救济的地方都不能挡风遮雨。
ext.ext_en: The area where most refugees are waiting is exposed to the elements.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the weather, especially wind and rain, as the elements .

defs.def_cn: 自在;适得其所;如鱼得水

ext.ext_cn: 我的继母得心应手地料理着一切。
ext.ext_en: My stepmother was in her element, organizing everything...

ext.ext_cn: 可能是因为他们感到非常不自在，所以觉得有必要说说话。
ext.ext_en: Maybe it's because they're so out of their element that they feel the need to talk.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in their element, you mean that they are in a situation they enjoy.

ext.ext_cn: 他得到一年的工资作为失业补偿金。
ext.ext_en: He received one year's salary as compensation for loss of office...

ext.ext_cn: 应该给受到需求锐减影响的英国农民提供补偿金。
ext.ext_en: There should be compensation for British farmers hit by the slump in demand...

defs.def_en: Compensation is money that someone who has experienced loss or suffering claims from the person or organization responsible, or from the state.

ext.ext_cn: 海伦在公开组决赛中取胜，这对她早先的失败算是一种补偿。
ext.ext_en: Helen gained some compensation for her earlier defeat by winning the final open class...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管钱会挣得少一点，搬到生活质量高的东北部去还是有很多好处的。
ext.ext_en: Despite a reduction in earnings there are compensations in moving to the north-east where the quality of life is excellent...

defs.def_en: If something is some compensation for something bad that has happened, it makes you feel better.

defs.def_cn: （艺术家、运动员等）被埋没的，怀才未遇的

ext.ext_cn: 他们邀请有才气却尚未幸遇伯乐的电影制作人提交作品样本。
ext.ext_en: They are inviting talented, but unheralded film-makers to submit examples of their work.

ext.ext_cn: 怀才未遇的德国22岁入围者马克·格尔纳
ext.ext_en: ...the unheralded 22-year-old German qualifier Marc Gollner.

defs.def_en: If you describe an artist or sports player as unheralded, you mean that people have not recognized their talent or ability.

defs.def_cn: 出乎意料的；毫无先兆的

ext.ext_cn: 桑迪出乎意料地出现在她门前
ext.ext_en: ...Sandi's unheralded arrival on her doorstep...

ext.ext_cn: 事先没有听到一点儿风声要彻底推翻这项政策。
ext.ext_en: The complete reversal of this policy was unheralded.

defs.def_en: If you describe something that happens as unheralded, you mean that you did not expect it, because nobody mentioned it beforehand.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 空气稀薄清新，其间日光蒙眬，寒气逼人。
ext.ext_en: The air was thin and crisp, filled with hazy sunshine and frost...

ext.ext_cn: 泛光灯在斜斜的雨丝中显得很蒙眬。
ext.ext_en: The floodlights were hazy behind the slanting rain.

defs.def_en: Hazy weather conditions are those in which things are difficult to see, because of light mist, hot air, or dust.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （对想法或细节）不太了解的;不确定的;不清楚的

ext.ext_cn: 那件事我不太清楚。
ext.ext_en: I'm a bit hazy about that...

ext.ext_cn: 我只依稀记得他的实际长相。
ext.ext_en: I have only a hazy memory of what he was really like...

defs.def_en: If you are hazy about ideas or details, or if they are hazy, you are uncertain or confused about them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她小口地抿着酒。现在一切都变得模糊起来，除了尼克的脸。
ext.ext_en: She sipped the wine. Everything was hazy now, except for Nick's face...

ext.ext_cn: 我的视力已经变得非常模糊。
ext.ext_en: My vision has grown so hazy...

defs.def_en: If things seem hazy, you cannot see things clearly, for example because you are feeling ill.
Refiners are people or organizations that refine substances such as oil or sugar in order to sell them.

defs.def_cn: 技术支持(指计算机公司等提供的维修和咨询服务)
defs.def_en: Technical support is a repair and advice service that some companies such as computer companies provide for their customers, usually by telephone, fax, or e-mail.

ext.ext_cn: 你老母亲来的一封家信
ext.ext_en: ...the customary missive from your dear mother.

defs.def_en: A missive is a letter or other message that someone sends.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 德拉尔图是位优秀的运动员，赢得比赛也是理所当然。
ext.ext_en: Derartu is an outstanding athlete and deserved to win.

ext.ext_cn: 自然景色美不胜收的地方
ext.ext_en: ...an area of outstanding natural beauty...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

ext.ext_cn: 未偿债务总额达700亿美元。
ext.ext_en: The total debt outstanding is $70 billion...

ext.ext_cn: 在参加该项目之前必须结清余账。
ext.ext_en: You have to pay your outstanding bill before joining the scheme.

defs.def_en: Money that is outstanding has not yet been paid and is still owed to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 我们签协议之前还有一些未尽事宜待解决。
ext.ext_en: We still have some outstanding issues to resolve before we'll have a treaty that is ready to sign.

defs.def_en: Outstanding issues or problems have not yet been resolved.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司是小企业成长为大企业的突出例子。
ext.ext_en: The company is an outstanding example of a small business that grew into a big one...

ext.ext_cn: 对他的成长影响深远的母亲出身于一个地位显赫的美国家庭。
ext.ext_en: His mother, whose influence on his development was outstanding, came of a distinguished American family.

defs.def_en: Outstanding means very important or obvious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 焦躁不安的;不耐烦的;不满的

ext.ext_cn: 到了1982年，她感到厌倦了，需要新的动力来激发她的才能。
ext.ext_en: By 1982, she was restless and needed a new impetus for her talent.

ext.ext_cn: 安抚国家不安分的知识分子的重大新举措
ext.ext_en: ...a major new initiative to placate the country's restless intellectuals.

defs.def_en: If you are restless, you are bored, impatient, or dissatisfied, and you want to do something else.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲看起来坐立不安，激动不已。
ext.ext_en: My father seemed very restless and excited.

defs.def_en: If someone is restless, they keep moving around because they find it difficult to keep still.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以入睡的;辗转反侧的

ext.ext_cn: 这篇长达700页的报告中披露的惊人信息使他几夜未眠。
ext.ext_en: The shocking revelations of the 700-page report had caused him several restless nights...

ext.ext_cn: 赫特在从巴黎起飞的飞机上辗转反侧了几个小时。
ext.ext_en: Hurt had spent a restless few hours on the plane from Paris.

defs.def_en: If you have a restless night, you do not sleep properly and when you wake up you feel tired and uncomfortable.

ext.ext_cn: 协会的所有成员都遵守一套严格的行为规范。
ext.ext_en: All members of the association adhere to a strict code of practice...

ext.ext_cn: 她恪守伊斯兰教严格的着装规定。
ext.ext_en: She adhered to the strict Islamic dress code.

defs.def_en: If you adhere to a rule or agreement, you act in the way that it says you should.

defs.def_cn: 支持，拥护，持有（观点或信仰）

ext.ext_cn: 他鼓励他们坚守伊斯兰教维护人类尊严的价值观。
ext.ext_en: He urged them to adhere to the values of Islam which defend the dignity of man.

defs.def_en: If you adhere to an opinion or belief, you support or hold it.

ext.ext_cn: 小颗粒牢牢附着在种子上。
ext.ext_en: Small particles adhere to the seed...

ext.ext_cn: 这种黏性的化合物能牢牢地粘在这个表面上。
ext.ext_en: This sticky compound adheres well on this surface.

defs.def_en: If something adheres to something else, it sticks firmly to it.

ext.ext_cn: 他对政府的勇敢挑战
ext.ext_en: ...his courageous defiance of the government.

defs.def_en: Defiance is behaviour or an attitude which shows that you are not willing to obey someone.

defs.def_cn: 违抗（某人）；无视，不顾(规定、法律等)

ext.ext_cn: 成千上万的人不顾宵禁涌上街头。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of people have taken to the streets in defiance of the curfew.

defs.def_en: If you do something in defiance of a person, rule, or law, you do it even though you know that you are not allowed to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我曾经和威尔玛有过短短的一面之缘。
ext.ext_en: I met Wilma once, briefly...

ext.ext_cn: 从那天晚上之后，我没有睡过一次安稳觉。
ext.ext_en: Since that evening I haven't once slept through the night...

defs.def_en: If something happens once, it happens one time only.

defs.def_cn: （与后接day, week, month等的a连用）（每…）一次，（每…）一回

ext.ext_cn: 肺细胞约每周新老更替一次。
ext.ext_en: Lung cells die and are replaced about once a week...

ext.ext_cn: 我们每年举办一次专门的社交活动，邀请重要客户出席。
ext.ext_en: We arranged a special social event once a year to which we invited our major customers.

defs.def_en: You use once with 'a' and words like 'day', 'week', and 'month' to indicate that something happens regularly, one time in each day, week, or month.

defs.def_cn: （与后接day, week, year等的every连用）（每隔…）一次，（每隔…）一回

ext.ext_cn: 这位病人每三个月接受一次随访就诊。
ext.ext_en: The patient was seen for follow-up visits once every three months...

ext.ext_cn: 我女儿每两周来看我一次。
ext.ext_en: My daughter comes to visit me once every fortnight.

defs.def_en: You use once with 'every' and words like 'day', 'week', and 'year' to indicate that something happens a specified number of times and on a regular basis.

ext.ext_cn: 这位文化部长曾经经营过一家剧院。
ext.ext_en: The culture minister once ran a theatre...

ext.ext_cn: 我结婚前曾独自在那儿住过。
ext.ext_en: I lived there once myself, before I got married...

defs.def_en: If something was once true, it was true at some time in the past, but is no longer true.

ext.ext_cn: 我曾和一位朋友在达令湖畔露营。
ext.ext_en: I once went camping at Lake Darling with a friend...

ext.ext_cn: 我们曾在凌晨两点步行穿过伦敦。
ext.ext_en: We once walked across London at two in the morning...

defs.def_en: If someone once did something, they did it at some time in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 在他看过一份市场调研报告后大概10秒钟就作出了决定。
ext.ext_en: The decision had taken about 10 seconds once he'd read a market research study...

ext.ext_cn: 顾客一旦依赖上这些系统，几乎就不会光顾其他商家。
ext.ext_en: Once customers come to rely on these systems they almost never take their business elsewhere...

defs.def_en: If something happens once another thing has happened, it happens immediately afterwards.

ext.ext_cn: 我突然觉得特别困。
ext.ext_en: I feel terribly sleepy all at once...

ext.ext_cn: 忽然有人敲门。
ext.ext_en: All at once there was someone knocking on the door.

defs.def_en: If something happens all at once, it happens suddenly, often when you are not expecting it to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 我得走了，我真的必须马上就走。
ext.ext_en: I have to go, I really must, at once...

ext.ext_cn: 端离炉子，加上欧芹，颠起翻面后就立刻上桌。
ext.ext_en: Remove from the heat, add the parsley, toss and serve at once...

defs.def_en: If you do something at once, you do it immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 不能一心二用。
ext.ext_en: You can't be doing two things at once...

ext.ext_cn: 如果所有的储户同时要求提取存款，没有哪家银行能办得到。
ext.ext_en: No bank could ever pay off its creditors if they all demanded their money at once...

defs.def_en: If a number of different things happen at once or all at once, they all happen at the same time.

ext.ext_cn: 爸爸这次破天荒地没有抱怨。
ext.ext_en: For once, dad is not complaining...

ext.ext_cn: 只有这一次，他真诚地笑了。
ext.ext_en: His smile, for once, was genuine.

defs.def_en: For once is used to emphasize that something happens on this particular occasion, especially if it has never happened before, and may never happen again.

ext.ext_cn: 埃米拿起发梳，再次将头发梳理整齐。
ext.ext_en: Amy picked up the hairbrush and smoothed her hair once more...

ext.ext_cn: 官方调查又一次提到了管理不力与工人缺乏训练的问题。
ext.ext_en: Once again an official inquiry has spoken of weak management and ill-trained workers.

defs.def_en: If something happens once again or once more, it happens again.

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须彻底解决这一问题。
ext.ext_en: We have to resolve this matter once and for all...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们迅速采取行动，就可以一劳永逸地使英国的野生动物免受残忍的虐待。
ext.ext_en: If we act fast, we can once and for all prevent wild animals in Britain from suffering terrible cruelty.

defs.def_en: If something happens once and for all, it happens completely or finally.

ext.ext_cn: 耳环要偶尔取出来清洗一下。
ext.ext_en: Earrings need to be taken out and cleaned once in a while.

ext.ext_cn: 她间或会给他打个电话。
ext.ext_en: Once in a while she phoned him.

defs.def_en: If something happens once in a while, it happens sometimes, but not very often.

ext.ext_cn: 我有几次头撞到了门上。
ext.ext_en: I popped my head round the door once or twice...

ext.ext_cn: 有那么一两次，她发现威廉的眼睛里流露出一丝感兴趣的神色。
ext.ext_en: Once or twice she had caught a flash of interest in William's eyes...

defs.def_en: If you have done something once or twice, you have done it a few times, but not very often.

defs.def_cn: （常用于儿童故事的开头）从前，很久以前

ext.ext_cn: “很久很久以前，”他开始说道，“有这么一个人，他应有尽有。”
ext.ext_en: 'Once upon a time,' he began, 'there was a man who had everything.'...

ext.ext_cn: 从前，问一位女性是否有工作是个相当简单直接的问题。
ext.ext_en: Once upon a time, asking a woman if she has a job was quite a straightforward question.

defs.def_en: Once upon a time is used to indicate that something happened or existed a long time ago or in an imaginary world. It is often used at the beginning of children's stories.

ext.ext_cn: 主人担心客人们会相处得不愉快。
ext.ext_en: The host fears the guests won't get on...

ext.ext_cn: 你的邻居怎么样？跟他们相处得好吗？
ext.ext_en: What are your neighbours like? Do you get on with them?

defs.def_en: If you get on with someone, you like them and have a friendly relationship with them.

ext.ext_cn: 简继续干她的工作。
ext.ext_en: Jane got on with her work...

ext.ext_cn: 我们开始干吧。
ext.ext_en: Let's get on.

defs.def_en: If you get on with something, you continue doing it or start doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 莉薇的俄语很有起色，她学得非常快。
ext.ext_en: Livy's getting on very well in Russian. She learns very quickly...

ext.ext_cn: 他回来看我的时候，我问他进展如何。
ext.ext_en: When he came back to see me I asked how he had got on.

defs.def_en: If you say how someone is getting on, you are saying how much success they are having with what they are trying to do.

defs.def_cn: 发迹；取得成功；出人头地

ext.ext_cn: 政治被视为男人的领域，女人很难出头。
ext.ext_en: Politics is seen as a man's world. It is very difficult for women to get on.

defs.def_en: If you try to get on, you try to be successful in your career.

ext.ext_cn: 我快31了，作为足球运动员也算是高龄了。
ext.ext_en: I'm nearly 31 and that's getting on a bit for a footballer.

defs.def_en: If someone is getting on, they are getting old.

ext.ext_cn: 黑色平绒大衣
ext.ext_en: ...a black velveteen coat.

ext.ext_cn: 颜色鲜艳的平绒宽松上衣
ext.ext_en: ...loose blouses of bright-coloured velveteen.

defs.def_en: Velveteen is a soft fabric which looks and feels like velvet and is sometimes used as a cheaper alternative to velvet.

ext.ext_cn: 他们总是以非常便宜的价格把类似那样的东西处理掉。
ext.ext_en: They're always selling off stuff like that dirt cheap...

ext.ext_cn: 他给我买了一把低音提琴，非常便宜。
ext.ext_en: He got me a bass dirt cheap.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is dirt-cheap, you are emphasizing that it is very cheap indeed.
Termini is a plural of terminus.
The afterlife is a life that some people believe begins when you die, for example a life in heaven or as another person or animal.

ext.ext_cn: 从遗产中心向四周延伸出的许许多多步行道
ext.ext_en: ...the various walks which radiate from the Heritage Centre...

ext.ext_cn: 被污染的空气从这里扩散到开阔的乡村地区。
ext.ext_en: From here, contaminated air radiates out to the open countryside.

defs.def_en: If things radiate out from a place, they form a pattern that is like lines drawn from the centre of a circle to various points on its edge.

ext.ext_cn: 她看起来幸福而健康。
ext.ext_en: She radiates happiness and health...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管她声音没变，但我还是感受到了她所流露出的怒气。
ext.ext_en: Her voice hadn't changed but I felt the anger that radiated from her.

defs.def_en: If you radiate an emotion or quality or if it radiates from you, people can see it very clearly in your face and in your behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 炉子就是要发热的。
ext.ext_en: Stoves are meant to radiate heat.

defs.def_en: If something radiates heat or light, heat or light comes from it.
A burrow is a tunnel or hole in the ground that is dug by an animal such as a rabbit.

ext.ext_cn: 幼虫钻进了地板的缝隙里。
ext.ext_en: The larvae burrow into cracks in the floor.

defs.def_en: If an animal burrows into the ground or into a surface, it moves through it by making a tunnel or hole.

ext.ext_cn: 他非常紧张地在一堆图表中翻找。
ext.ext_en: He burrowed into the pile of charts feverishly.

ext.ext_cn: 他为了弄清事实真相而翻查老档案的热情
ext.ext_en: ...the enthusiasm with which he burrowed through old records in search of facts.

defs.def_en: If you burrow in a container or pile of things, you search there for something using your hands.

ext.ext_cn: 她侧过脸背向他，钻进她那堆被子里。
ext.ext_en: She turned her face away from him, burrowing into her heap of covers.

defs.def_en: If you burrow into something, you move underneath it or press against it, usually in order to feel warmer or safer.
Floodlights are very powerful lamps that are used outside to light public buildings, sports grounds, and other places at night.

ext.ext_cn: 晚上，建筑正面被泛光灯照亮。
ext.ext_en: In the evening the facade is floodlit...

ext.ext_cn: 警方的直升机在上空盘旋，照亮了整片地区。
ext.ext_en: A police helicopter hovered above, floodlighting the area.

defs.def_en: If a building or place is floodlit, it is lit by floodlights.

defs.def_cn: 连续发生地;不中断地;无休止地

ext.ext_cn: 我想一直睡下去。
ext.ext_en: I feel like sleeping 24-7.

ext.ext_cn: 24 小时广播电台
ext.ext_en: ...a 24-7 radio station.

defs.def_en: If something happens 24-7, it happens all the time without ever stopping. 24-7 means twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week.

defs.def_cn: (聋哑人或使用不同语言的人交流时使用的)手语，手势语

ext.ext_cn: 她儿子用手语告诉她发生了什么事。
ext.ext_en: Her son used sign language to tell her what happened.

defs.def_en: Sign language is movements of your hands and arms used to communicate. There are several official systems of sign language, used for example by deaf people. Movements are also sometimes invented by people when they want to communicate with someone who does not speak the same language.

ext.ext_cn: 她追了窃贼100码远。
ext.ext_en: She chased the thief for 100 yards...

ext.ext_cn: 他对等候的记者什么也没说就走了，那些记者跟在他后面追。
ext.ext_en: He said nothing to waiting journalists, who chased after him as he left.

defs.def_en: If  you chase someone, or chase after them, you run after them or follow them quickly in order to catch or reach them.

defs.def_cn: 争取，追逐，追求(工作或金钱等)

ext.ext_cn: 在威尔士，每份工作都有14个人在竞争。
ext.ext_en: In Wales, 14 people are chasing every job...

ext.ext_cn: 太多的学校在争夺太少的生源。
ext.ext_en: There are too many schools chasing too few pupils.

defs.def_en: If you are chasing something you want, such as work or money, you are trying hard to get it.

ext.ext_cn: 我不太会和女人调情，也不擅长追求女性。
ext.ext_en: I'm not very good at flirting or chasing women...

ext.ext_cn: “我以前老是追错人，”她说。
ext.ext_en: 'I was always chasing after unsuitable men,' she says.

defs.def_en: If someone chases someone that they are attracted to, or chases after them, they try hard to persuade them to have a sexual relationship with them.

ext.ext_cn: 许多农民然后就会凶巴巴地把你从他们的土地上撵走。
ext.ext_en: Many farmers will then chase you off their land quite aggressively...

ext.ext_cn: 愤怒的示威者把他赶跑了。
ext.ext_en: Angry demonstrators chased him away.

defs.def_en: If someone chases you from a place, they force you to leave by using threats or violence.

ext.ext_cn: 嗨，各位，大伙儿都知道今天我们为什么在这里，那就直入正题吧。
ext.ext_en: Hi everyone, we all know why we are here today, so let's cut to the chase.

defs.def_en: If someone cuts to the chase, they start talking about or dealing with what is important, instead of less important things.

ext.ext_cn: 他对欧洲统一的执著追求在一定程度上促成了撒切尔夫人的下台。
ext.ext_en: His single-minded pursuit of European union helped chase Mrs Thatcher from power.

defs.def_en: To chase someone from a job or a position or from power means to force them to leave it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们冲下楼梯，来到狭窄、肮脏的街上。
ext.ext_en: They chased down the stairs into the narrow, dirty street.

ext.ext_cn: 深更半夜东奔西跑寻找生活必需品
ext.ext_en: ...chasing about late at night in search of life's necessities.

defs.def_en: If you chase somewhere, you run or rush there.

ext.ext_cn: 熊皮袍子、美洲狮的皮，以及这次狩猎的其他战利品
ext.ext_en: ...bear robes, mountain lion hides, and other trophies of the chase.

defs.def_en: The chase is the activity of hunting animals.

ext.ext_cn: 猎人王越野赛马
ext.ext_en: ...the Champion Hunter Chase.

defs.def_en: Chase is often used in the name of horse races in which the horses have to jump over obstacles such as fences or bushes.

ext.ext_cn: 其他警官追了上去，可是杀手还是逃了。
ext.ext_en: Other officers gave chase but the killers escaped.

defs.def_en: If you give chase, you run after someone or follow them quickly in order to catch them.

ext.ext_cn: 享受追求过程中的刺激的人们清楚，奖赏和钻石一样，是值得为之一搏的。
ext.ext_en: People who adore the thrill of the chase know that prizes, like diamonds, are worth striving for.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the thrill of the chase, you are referring to the excitement that people feel when they are trying hard to get something.

ext.ext_cn: 尚蒂伊的田园景致
ext.ext_en: ...the bucolic surroundings of Chantilly.

defs.def_en: Bucolic means relating to the countryside.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对人命的漠视
ext.ext_en: ...his callous disregard for human life.

defs.def_en: A callous person or action is very cruel and shows no concern for other people or their feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 她鲜红色的唇彩
ext.ext_en: ...her vermilion lip gloss...

ext.ext_cn: 上面的家具色彩鲜红，富有光泽。
ext.ext_en: The furniture on it is glossy vermilion.

defs.def_en: Vermilion is used to describe things that are bright red in colour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有益健康的;环境宜人的

ext.ext_cn: 你入住的那家舒适宜人的湖边旅馆
ext.ext_en: ...your salubrious lochside hotel.

defs.def_en: A place that is salubrious is pleasant and healthy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦贫穷落后的区域
ext.ext_en: ...London's less salubrious quarters.

defs.def_en: Something that is described as salubrious is respectable or socially desirable.

ext.ext_cn: 投资者可以获得与房产购买价格相等的借款额。
ext.ext_en: Investors can borrow an amount equal to the property's purchase price.

ext.ext_cn: 在男女人数相等的人口中
ext.ext_en: ...in a population having equal numbers of men and women...

defs.def_en: If two things are equal or if one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们将要求享有工作中应得的平等权利。
ext.ext_en: We will be justly demanding equal rights at work.

ext.ext_cn: 对机会均等的承诺
ext.ext_en: ...the commitment to equal opportunities.

defs.def_en: If different groups of people have equal rights or are given equal treatment, they have the same rights or are treated the same as each other, however different they are.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （指人的权利和机会）平等的，均等的

ext.ext_cn: 我们在各个方面都是平等的。
ext.ext_en: We are equal in every way...

ext.ext_cn: 在任何赌博游戏中，每个人都机会均等。
ext.ext_en: At any gambling game, everyone is equal.

defs.def_en: If you say that people are equal, you mean that they have or should have the same rights and opportunities as each other.

defs.def_cn: （能力、地位或权利等）同样的人，相当的人

ext.ext_cn: 她也是男孩子们中的一员，和他们不相上下。
ext.ext_en: She was one of the boys, their equal...

ext.ext_cn: 你本应该和一个更门当户对的人结婚。
ext.ext_en: You should have married somebody more your equal.

defs.def_en: Someone who is your equal has the same ability, status, or rights as you have.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她下定决心要成功应对公司对他们的任何考验。
ext.ext_en: She was determined that she would be equal to any test the corporation put to them...

ext.ext_cn: 那些卫兵能够应对任何事情。
ext.ext_en: The guards were equal to anything.

defs.def_en: If someone is equal to a particular job or situation, they have the necessary ability, strength, or courage to deal successfully with it.

ext.ext_cn: 9%的利息减去7%的通货膨胀率等于2%。
ext.ext_en: 9 percent interest less 7 percent inflation equals 2 percent...

ext.ext_cn: 薪水的平均增长幅度是通货膨胀率的1.41倍。
ext.ext_en: The average pay rise equalled 1.41 times inflation.

defs.def_en: If something equals a particular number or amount, it is the same as that amount or the equivalent of that amount.

ext.ext_cn: 那次胜利堪比索森德历史上最漂亮的获胜。
ext.ext_en: The victory equalled Southend's best in history...

ext.ext_cn: 再多的金钱也比不上那样的记忆。
ext.ext_en: No amount of money can equal memories like that.

defs.def_en: To equal something or someone means to be as good or as great as them.

ext.ext_cn: 作为牧师，他可以说是出类拔萃。
ext.ext_en: As a pastor, it can be argued he has no equal...

ext.ext_cn: 那部电影众人瞩目，在电影史上无与伦比。
ext.ext_en: The film demands attention, and has no equal in cinema history.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has no equal, you think that there is nothing that is as good as them or that reaches the same standard.

defs.def_cn: 如果其他条件不变;如无意外情况发生

ext.ext_cn: 如果其他条件不变，大多数房客都愿意住单人间而不会选择与他人同住。
ext.ext_en: Other things being equal, most tenants would prefer single to shared rooms...

ext.ext_cn: 如果一切不变，谁赚的钱最多有什么关系吗？
ext.ext_en: All things being equal, should it matter who earns most money?

defs.def_en: If you say 'other things being equal' or 'all things being equal' when talking about a possible situation, you mean if nothing unexpected happens or if there are no other factors which affect the situation.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在战争中)征服，制服，使屈服

ext.ext_cn: 他们大动干戈想要控制阿富汗地区，但只持续了10年就无果而终了。
ext.ext_en: Their costly and futile attempt to subjugate the Afghans lasted just 10 years.

defs.def_en: If someone subjugates a group of people, they take complete control of them, especially by defeating them in a war.

defs.def_cn: 使(愿望、渴望)退居其次;使让位于

ext.ext_cn: 你那被雄心壮志压制已久的母性本能终于开始展现出来。
ext.ext_en: After having been subjugated to ambition, your maternal instincts are at last starting to assert themselves.

defs.def_en: If your wishes or desires are subjugated to something, they are treated as less important than that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 在美国生活了15年之后，他终于决定申请美国国籍。
ext.ext_en: After 15 years in the USA, he has finally decided to apply for American citizenship...

ext.ext_cn: 只有其在科威特的家族史可以追溯到1920年以前的人才能获国籍。
ext.ext_en: Only people who can trace their family history in Kuwait back before 1920 are entitled to citizenship.

defs.def_en: If you have citizenship of a country, you are legally accepted as belonging to it.

defs.def_cn: 公民归属；公民义务;公民责任感

ext.ext_cn: 和他们同龄的德国人有着更强烈的公民归属感。
ext.ext_en: Their German peers had a more developed sense of citizenship.

defs.def_en: Citizenship is the fact of belonging to a community because you live in it, and the duties and responsibilities that this brings.

defs.def_cn: (通常为蓝色、用来做牛仔裤等的)粗斜纹棉布，劳动布，牛仔布

ext.ext_cn: 浅蓝色的牛仔布夹克Dennis was dressed in denim jeans. 丹尼斯穿了一条劳动布牛仔裤。
ext.ext_en: ...a light blue denim jacket...

defs.def_en: Denim is a thick cotton cloth, usually blue, which is used to make clothes. Jeans are made from denim.

ext.ext_en: Bullying can indeed be distressing and frightening for those at the receiving end.

ext.ext_en: Fugazi are America's biggest unsigned alternative band.

defs.def_en: An unsigned band has not signed a contract with a company to produce CDs.

defs.def_cn: 私人疗养院;(尤指)私立养老院

ext.ext_cn: 他在一家养老院去世，享年87岁。
ext.ext_en: He died in a nursing home at the age of 87.

defs.def_en: A nursing home is a private hospital, especially one for old people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as mercurial, you mean that they frequently change their mind or mood without warning.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is servile, you disapprove of them because they are too eager to obey someone or do things for them.

defs.def_cn: 文字处理程序;文字处理机
defs.def_en: A word processor is a computer program or a computer which is used to produce printed documents.
CS gas is a gas which causes you to cry and makes breathing painful. It is sometimes used by the police to control a crowd which is rioting.
A drum kit is a set of drums and cymbals.

ext.ext_cn: 房子的高度不得超过两层。

ext.ext_en: She can hear the old woman muttering about consideration...

defs.def_en: If you mutter, you speak very quietly so that you cannot easily be heard, often because you are complaining about something.

ext.ext_en: ...this terrible story of famine and a woman who's forced to prostitute herself in order to get food.

defs.def_en: If someone prostitutes a woman or if a woman prostitutes herself, she has sex or is made to have sex with men for money.

ext.ext_en: Higher education is being forced to prostitute itself to market forces.

defs.def_en: When people or things regress, they return to an earlier and less advanced stage of development.

ext.ext_en: The yuan recovered a little; it now hovers around 8.2 to the dollar.

defs.def_en: The yuan is the unit of money used in the People's Republic of China.

ext.ext_en: ...the assertion of a perverted patriotism.

ext.ext_en: She is very caring and very genuine.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as genuine, you approve of them because they are honest, truthful, and sincere in the way they live and in their relationships with other people.

ext.ext_en: Two of the lorries, carrying industrial resin and paint thinner, burst into flames.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The avenues lined with jacaranda trees burst into a carnival of purple.

ext.ext_en: ...atomic energy.

ext.ext_cn: 核武器
ext.ext_en: ...atomic weapons.

ext.ext_cn: 他们郑重其事地剪彩，宣布展览开幕。

ext.ext_en: He thanked her ceremoniously.

defs.def_en: If someone does something ceremoniously, they do it in an extremely formal way.

ext.ext_en: He spent hours throwing a tennis ball against a wall...

ext.ext_en: On one occasion, his father threw a radio at his mother...
