ext.ext_en: ...a course designed to provide vocational training in engineering...

ext.ext_cn: 职业技术类课程通常能够获得比艺术或哲学类课程更多的重视和资助。
ext.ext_en: Vocational courses are often given more respect and funding than arts or philosophy.

defs.def_en: Vocational training and skills are the training and skills needed for a particular job or profession.

ext.ext_cn: 他从裂缝处摔了下来。
ext.ext_en: He fell down a crevasse.

defs.def_en: A crevasse is a large, deep crack in thick ice or rock.

ext.ext_cn: 研究者好不容易完成了对1.6万首不同的古典、摇滚和爵士乐曲的研究。
ext.ext_en: Researchers have ploughed through 16,000 different pieces of classical, rock and jazz music...

ext.ext_en: He used to watch body building videos and plough through a daily diet of a dozen eggs and four pints of milk.

defs.def_en: If you plough through something such as a large meal or a long piece of work, you finally finish it although it takes a lot of effort.

ext.ext_en: Mr. Dambar watched her plough through the grass...

ext.ext_cn: 那艘船破浪前进。
ext.ext_en: The ship ploughed through the waves.

defs.def_en: If someone ploughs through a place or if a ship ploughs through water, they move through it, especially with great effort.

ext.ext_en: The car ploughed through three gardens and flattened a tree.

defs.def_en: If a vehicle or a missile ploughs through something, it goes violently or carelessly through it as though it is out of control.

ext.ext_en: All of us, myself included, had been totally committed to the Party...

ext.ext_cn: 没有一个城市,包括特拉维夫与耶路撒冷在内,像纽约市一样拥有如此之多的犹太居民。
ext.ext_en: No city, Tel Aviv or Jerusalem included, is home to more Jews than New York...

defs.def_en: You use included to emphasize that a person or thing is part of the group of people or things that you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 一团黑烟吹过城市的上空。
ext.ext_en: A cloud of black smoke blew over the city...

ext.ext_cn: 空气里充斥着浓浓的烟味。
ext.ext_en: The air was thick with cigarette smoke.

defs.def_en: Smoke consists of gas and small bits of solid material that are sent into the air when something burns.

ext.ext_cn: 烟囱里浓烟滚滚。
ext.ext_en: The chimney was smoking fiercely.

ext.ext_cn: 一堆冒着烟的瓦砾
ext.ext_en: ...a pile of smoking rubble.

defs.def_en: If something is smoking, smoke is coming from it.

ext.ext_cn: 他独自坐在那儿，抽着一只大雪茄。
ext.ext_en: He was sitting alone, smoking a big cigar...

ext.ext_cn: 戒烟并非易事。
ext.ext_en: It's not easy to quit smoking cigarettes...

defs.def_en: When someone smokes a cigarette, cigar, or pipe, they suck the smoke from it into their mouth and blow it out again. If you smoke, you regularly smoke cigarettes, cigars, or a pipe.

ext.ext_en: ...the grid where the fish were being smoked.

ext.ext_cn: 熏咸肉
ext.ext_en: ...smoked bacon.

defs.def_en: If fish or meat is smoked, it is hung over burning wood so that the smoke preserves it and gives it a special flavour.
If someone says there's no smoke without fire or where there's smoke there's fire, they mean that there are rumours or signs that something is true so it must be at least partly true.

defs.def_cn: 被焚毁;被烧掉;被付之一炬

ext.ext_en: More than 900 years of British history went up in smoke in the Great Fire of Windsor.

defs.def_en: If something goes up in smoke, it is destroyed by fire.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的旅行社倒闭之后，他们的梦想也随之破灭了。
ext.ext_en: Their dreams went up in smoke after the collapse of their travel agency.

defs.def_en: If something that is very important to you goes up in smoke, it fails or ends without anything being achieved.

ext.ext_cn: 埃尔维斯·普雷斯利是现代青年文化的真正奠基人。
ext.ext_en: Elvis Presley was the true begetter of modern youth culture.

defs.def_en: The begetter of something has caused this thing to come into existence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人扼腕的；令人嘘唏的；使人惋惜的

ext.ext_cn: 这一令人遗憾的事态一直持续至1947年。
ext.ext_en: This lamentable state of affairs lasted until 1947...

ext.ext_cn: 他的英语水平糟得很。
ext.ext_en: His command of English was lamentable.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as lamentable, you mean that it is very unfortunate or disappointing.

ext.ext_cn: 对洪水的预测并不是一门精确科学。
ext.ext_en: Forecasting floods is not an exact science.

defs.def_en: If you say that a particular activity is not an exact science, you mean that there are no set rules to follow or it does not produce very accurate results.

defs.def_cn: 本地的；本地的；地方性的

ext.ext_en: We'd better check on the match in the local paper...

ext.ext_en: Some local residents joined the students' protest...

defs.def_en: Local means existing in or belonging to the area where you live, or to the area that you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 教育占地方市政会全部开支的三分之二。
ext.ext_en: Education comprises two-thirds of all local council spending.

ext.ext_cn: 被称为“人头税”的备受争议的地方税制
ext.ext_en: ...the controversial system of local taxation known as the poll tax.

defs.def_en: Local government is elected by people in one area of a country and controls aspects such as education, housing, and transport within that area.

defs.def_cn: (常去的)邻近小酒馆，本地酒吧

ext.ext_en: The Black Horse is my local.

defs.def_en: Your local is a pub which is near where you live and where you often go for a drink.

ext.ext_cn: 通常先打局麻，以使该部位失去知觉。
ext.ext_en: An injection of local anaesthetic is usually given first to numb the area.

defs.def_en: A local anaesthetic or condition affects only a small area of your body.

ext.ext_cn: 他踉跄地走到冰箱前，拿出一瓶啤酒，一屁股坐在桌边。
ext.ext_en: He tottered to the fridge, got a beer and slumped at the table...

ext.ext_en: The baby began to crawl, then managed her first tottering steps.

defs.def_en: If someone totters somewhere, they walk there in an unsteady way, for example because they are ill or drunk.

ext.ext_cn: 房地产市场摇摇欲坠。
ext.ext_en: The property market is tottering.

ext.ext_cn: 对濒临瓦解的政府的进一步批评
ext.ext_en: ...further criticism of the tottering government.

defs.def_en: If something such as a market or government is tottering, it is weak and likely to collapse or fail completely.

ext.ext_en: ...the question of whether prostitution should be decriminalized.

ext.ext_cn: 珍珠项链
ext.ext_en: ...a pearl choker.

defs.def_en: A choker is a necklace or band of material that fits very closely round a woman's neck.
Tungsten is a greyish-white metal.

ext.ext_en: Mr Fullemann was a passenger in the car when it crashed.

ext.ext_cn: 搭载着四十多名乘客的米兰来的航班
ext.ext_en: ...a flight from Milan with more than forty passengers on board.

defs.def_en: A passenger in a vehicle such as a bus, boat, or plane is a person who is travelling in it, but who is not driving it or working on it.  →see usage note at:client

ext.ext_cn: 我坐在乘客座位上。
ext.ext_en: I sat in the passenger seat.

ext.ext_cn: 客运列车
ext.ext_en: ...a passenger train.

defs.def_en: Passenger is used to describe something that is designed for passengers, rather than for drivers or goods.

ext.ext_cn: 不管从哪方面说，战争都将是场灾难。
ext.ext_en: From all points of view, war would be a catastrophe...

ext.ext_cn: 世界若要想避免环境灾难，经济发达的国家必须进行深刻变革。
ext.ext_en: If the world is to avoid environmental catastrophe, advanced economies must undergo a profound transition.

defs.def_en: A catastrophe is an unexpected event that causes great suffering or damage.

ext.ext_cn: 硫也可用来给器材消毒。
ext.ext_en: Sulphur is also used to sterilize equipment...

ext.ext_cn: 牛奶经过灭菌处理后被封装在瓶子里。
ext.ext_en: The milk was sterilized and sealed in bottles.

defs.def_en: If you sterilize a thing or a place, you make it completely clean and free from germs.

defs.def_en: If a person or an animal is sterilized, they have a medical operation that makes it impossible for them to have or produce babies.

ext.ext_en: He sat there while I made the case for his dismissal...

ext.ext_en: The concert was booked out, and in any case, most of the people gathered in the square could not afford the price of a ticket.

defs.def_en: You say in any case when you are adding something which is more important than what you have just said, but which supports or corrects it.

ext.ext_en: Either he escaped, or he came to grief. In any case, he was never seen again.

defs.def_en: You say in any case after talking about things that you are not sure about, to emphasize that your next statement is the most important thing or the thing that you are sure about.

ext.ext_en: Extra boiling water should be kept at hand just in case it is needed.

defs.def_en: If you do something in case or just in case a particular thing happens, you do it because that thing might happen.

ext.ext_en: Many shops along the route have been boarded up in case of trouble.

defs.def_en: If you do something or have something in case of a particular thing, you do it or have it because that thing might happen or be true.

defs.def_cn: (表示不耐烦地陈述显而易见或与听话人无关的事情)竟然，难道，假使

ext.ext_en: She's nervous about something, in case you didn't notice...

ext.ext_en: 'I'm waiting for Mary Ann,' she said, 'in case you're wondering.'

defs.def_en: You use in case in expressions like 'in case you didn't know' or 'in case you've forgotten' when you are telling someone in a rather irritated way something that you think is either obvious or none of their business.

defs.def_cn: 那样的话;在那种情况下

ext.ext_en: Members are concerned that a merger might mean higher costs, in which case they would oppose it.

defs.def_en: You say in that case or in which case to indicate that what you are going to say is true if the possible situation that has just been mentioned actually exists.

ext.ext_en: I guess we've already talked about this but I'll ask you again just in case.

defs.def_en: You can say that you are doing something just in case to refer vaguely to the possibility that a thing might happen or be true, without saying exactly what it is.

defs.def_cn: 无论情况如何；无论怎样

ext.ext_en: They know how everything works — or doesn't work, as the case may be.

defs.def_en: You say as the case may be or whatever the case may be to indicate that the statement you are making applies equally to the two or more alternatives that you have mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 应该是先放松，然后再玩。
ext.ext_en: It's a case of relaxing, then playing...

ext.ext_cn: 这不是会不会有人注意到的问题。
ext.ext_en: It's not a case of whether anyone would notice or not.

defs.def_en: If you say that a task or situation is a case of a particular thing, you mean that it consists of that thing or can be described as that thing.

defs.def_cn: 典型的例子;恰当的例证

ext.ext_en: In many cases religious persecution is the cause of people fleeing their country. A case in point is colonial India.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a case in point, you mean that it is a good example of something you have just mentioned.

ext.ext_en: Consumers had hoped the higher prices would mean more goods in stores. But that was not the case.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is the case, you mean that it is true or correct.

defs.def_en: You say 'Sorry' or 'I'm sorry' as a way of apologizing to someone for something that you have done which has upset them or caused them difficulties, or when you bump into them accidentally.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 遗憾的;难过的;抱歉的;失望的

ext.ext_en: She was very sorry about all the trouble she'd caused...

ext.ext_cn: 我为所发生的事情感到遗憾。
ext.ext_en: I'm  sorry about what's happened...

defs.def_en: If you are sorry about a situation, you feel regret, sadness, or disappointment about it.

ext.ext_en: No, I'm sorry, I can't agree with you...

ext.ext_en: 'I'm sorry,' he told the real estate agent, 'but we really must go now.'...

defs.def_en: You use I'm sorry or sorry as an introduction when you are telling a person something that you do not think they will want to hear, for example when you are disagreeing with them or giving them bad news.

defs.def_cn: (表示威胁或警告)你会后悔的

ext.ext_cn: 我会告诉爸爸，到时候有你好受的，因为爸爸会再揍你一顿。
ext.ext_en: I'll tell Daddy, and then you'll be sorry because he'll give you another black eye...

ext.ext_cn: 滚回那边去，否则你会后悔的。
ext.ext_en: Get back in there, or you'll be sorry.

defs.def_en: If someone says 'You'll be sorry', they are threatening you or warning you and suggesting that something unpleasant will happen to you because of your actions.

defs.def_cn: 很遗憾，很抱歉(包含失望或不赞成)

ext.ext_cn: 很遗憾，我只完成了一半。
ext.ext_en: I've only done half of it, I'm sorry to say...

ext.ext_cn: 我很遗憾，这几乎完全是一厢情愿的想法。
ext.ext_en: This, I am sorry to say, is almost entirely wishful thinking.

defs.def_en: You use the expression I'm sorry to say to express regret together with disappointment or disapproval.

defs.def_cn: (用于听到伤心或不愉快的消息时)我深感遗憾，我很难过

ext.ext_cn: 我已经听说了莫莉的事情——我很难过。
ext.ext_en: I've heard about Mollie — I'm so sorry...

ext.ext_cn: “恐怕他生病了。”——“真是遗憾。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'm afraid he's ill.' — 'I'm sorry to hear that.'

defs.def_en: You say 'I'm sorry' to express your regret and sadness when you hear sad or unpleasant news.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (为别人的不幸或不快)感到难过的，表示同情的

ext.ext_cn: 我为他和他的同事们感到难过——这件事一定让他们感到非常沮丧。
ext.ext_en: I felt sorry for him and his colleagues — it must have been so frustrating for them...

ext.ext_cn: 我十分同情这家人。
ext.ext_en: I am very sorry for the family.

defs.def_en: If you feel sorry for someone who is unhappy or in an unpleasant situation, you feel sympathy and sadness for them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (为自己的遭遇等)感到闷闷不乐，垂头丧气

ext.ext_cn: 他万万不可宅在家里自艾自怜。
ext.ext_en: What he must not do is to sit around at home feeling sorry for himself.

defs.def_en: You say that someone is feeling sorry for themselves when you disapprove of the fact that they keep thinking unhappily about their problems, rather than trying to be cheerful and positive.

defs.def_cn: (用于请对方重复所说的话)没听清，请再说一遍
defs.def_en: You say 'Sorry?' when you have not heard something that someone has said and you want them to repeat it.

defs.def_cn: (用于纠正自己刚才说错的话)不对，抱歉

ext.ext_cn: 巴塞罗那将有望首次把奖杯捧回西班牙——抱歉，是捧回加泰罗尼亚。
ext.ext_en: Barcelona will be hoping to bring the trophy back to Spain — sorry, Catalonia — for the first time.

ext.ext_cn: 拒绝回到越南的难民(抱歉，应该说是经济移民)
ext.ext_en: ...refugees (sorry, economic migrants) who refuse to return to Vietnam.

defs.def_en: You use sorry when you correct yourself and use different words to say what you have just said, especially when what you say the second time does not use the words you would normally choose to use.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这场大火使科威特的石油产业陷入悲惨的境地。
ext.ext_en: The fire left Kuwait's oil industry in a sorry state...

ext.ext_cn: 她的样子看上去糟透了。
ext.ext_en: She is a sorry sight...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is in a sorry state, they are in a bad state, mentally or physically.

ext.ext_cn: 达特河是一条令人心旷神怡的河，岸边到处开着野花。
ext.ext_en: The Dart is a delightful river with a profusion of wild flowers along its banks...

ext.ext_cn: 橄榄、葡萄和柑橘类水果产量丰富。
ext.ext_en: Olive groves, grapes, and citrus fruits grow in profusion.

defs.def_en: If there is a profusion of something or if it occurs in profusion, there is a very large quantity or variety of it.

ext.ext_cn: 国会计划重新起草私有化法律。
ext.ext_en: Parliament plans to redraft the law on privatisation...

ext.ext_cn: 演讲稿已经改写过22遍了。
ext.ext_en: The speech had already been redrafted 22 times.

defs.def_en: If you redraft something you have written, you write it again in order to improve it or change it.

ext.ext_cn: 一对后减震器
ext.ext_en: ...a pair of rear shock absorbers.

defs.def_en: A shock absorber is a device fitted near the wheels of a car or other vehicle to reduce the effects of travelling over uneven ground.

defs.def_cn: 马克杯(用来喝热饮的有柄大杯子）

ext.ext_cn: 他用勺子把速溶咖啡舀入两个杯子中。
ext.ext_en: He spooned instant coffee into two of the mugs.

ext.ext_cn: 为让自己保持清醒，他一杯接一杯地喝咖啡。
ext.ext_en: He had been drinking mugs of coffee to keep himself awake.

defs.def_en: A mug is a large deep cup with straight sides and a handle, used for hot drinks.

ext.ext_cn: 我正出门朝我的车走去，就在这时这家伙企图对我进行抢劫。
ext.ext_en: I was walking out to my car when this guy tried to mug me...

ext.ext_cn: 他已是不止一次被抢劫了。
ext.ext_en: He has been mugged more than once.

defs.def_en: If someone mugs you, they attack you in order to steal your money.

ext.ext_cn: 在女性眼里，他是个傻瓜。
ext.ext_en: He's a mug as far as women are concerned...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得签这个协议真傻。
ext.ext_en: I feel such a mug for signing the agreement.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a mug, you mean that they are stupid and easily deceived by other people.

defs.def_cn: (不值得一做的)傻瓜的游戏，傻事

ext.ext_cn: 我曾经是个赌棍，但现在再也不赌了，那是傻瓜的游戏。
ext.ext_en: I used to be a very heavy gambler, but not any more. It's a mug's game...

ext.ext_cn: 傻瓜才节食。
ext.ext_en: Dieting is a mug's game.

defs.def_en: If you say that an activity is a mug's game, you mean that it is not worth doing because it does not give the person who is doing it any benefit or satisfaction.

ext.ext_cn: 他设法让自己那张丑陋的脸上了电视。
ext.ext_en: He managed to get his ugly mug on the telly.

defs.def_en: Some-one's mug is their face.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的头还痛，并且觉得有些晕头转向。
ext.ext_en: Her head still hurt, and she felt slightly dizzy and disoriented...

ext.ext_cn: 他开始一阵阵地头晕。
ext.ext_en: He began to get dizzy spells.

defs.def_en: If you feel dizzy, you feel that you are losing your balance and are about to fall.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (指女子)粗心的，没记性的，大大咧咧的

ext.ext_cn: 她以扮演金发傻妞而闻名。
ext.ext_en: She is famed for playing dizzy blondes.

ext.ext_cn: 一位迷人的大大咧咧的曾祖母
ext.ext_en: ...a charmingly dizzy great-grandmother.

defs.def_en: You can use dizzy to describe a woman who is careless and forgets things, but is easy to like.

defs.def_cn: 使眩晕;使困惑;使晕头转向

ext.ext_cn: 突然上升的高度让她晕头转向，她抓得紧紧的。
ext.ext_en: The sudden height dizzied her and she clung tightly.

defs.def_en: If something dizzies you, it causes you to feel unsteady or confused.

defs.def_cn: 重要的职位;显赫的地位

ext.ext_cn: 我升到了总经理秘书这一显赫高位。
ext.ext_en: I escalated to the dizzy heights of director's secretary.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has reached the dizzy heights of something, you are emphasizing that they have reached a very high level by achieving it.

ext.ext_cn: 步兵部队正在向前挺进攻打山脊。
ext.ext_en: The infantry were advancing to attack the ridge...

ext.ext_cn: 敌军步兵正在隐蔽。
ext.ext_en: The enemy infantry was hiding.

defs.def_en: Infantry are soldiers who fight on foot rather than in tanks or on horses.

ext.ext_cn: 这3名男子似乎已把东西往卡车上装载完毕。
ext.ext_en: The three men seemed to have finished loading the truck...

ext.ext_cn: 丹巴尔先生盛了一大盘千层面。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Dambar had loaded his plate with lasagne...

defs.def_en: If you load a vehicle or a container, you put a large quantity of things into it.

ext.ext_cn: 他载着一大车干草驶过。
ext.ext_en: He drove by with a big load of hay...

ext.ext_cn: 他身上背着沉甸甸的东西。
ext.ext_en: He was carrying a very heavy load.

defs.def_en: A load is something, usually a large quantity or heavy object, which is being carried.

ext.ext_cn: 我把另一堆衣服放进洗衣机。
ext.ext_en: I put another load in the washing machine.

defs.def_en: A load is a quantity of clothes or sheets which need washing and which are washed together in a washing machine.

ext.ext_cn: 我有大把的钱。
ext.ext_en: I've got loads of money...

ext.ext_cn: 他的部下亮出一大堆令人尴尬的资料来。
ext.ext_en: His people came up with a load of embarrassing information...

defs.def_en: If you refer to a load of people or things or loads of them, you are emphasizing that there are a lot of them.

ext.ext_cn: 我知道怎么上子弹，也知道枪怎么用。
ext.ext_en: I knew how to load and handle a gun...

ext.ext_cn: 他带了一把子弹上膛的枪。
ext.ext_en: He carried a loaded gun...

defs.def_en: When someone loads a weapon such as a gun, they put a bullet or missile in it so that it is ready to use.

defs.def_cn: 把（胶卷、磁带等）装入；将（数据）载入

ext.ext_cn: 那家报纸的一名摄影师正往相机里装胶卷。
ext.ext_en: A photographer from the newspaper was loading his camera with film...

ext.ext_cn: 一名技师把一盒录影带装进其中一台机器。
ext.ext_en: A technician loads a video tape into one of the machines...

defs.def_en: To load a camera or other piece of equipment means to put film, tape, or data into it so that it is ready to use.

ext.ext_cn: 她在给秘书们减轻一些工作量。
ext.ext_en: She's taking some of the load off the secretaries.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the amount of work you have to do as a load .

ext.ext_cn: 一个节能灯泡也许就能减轻发电站的负荷。
ext.ext_en: An efficient bulb may lighten the load of power stations...

ext.ext_cn: 几个处理器可共同分担处理一个程序数据的负荷。
ext.ext_en: Several processors can share the load of handling data in a single program.

defs.def_en: The load of a system or piece of equipment, especially a system supplying electricity or a computer, is the extent to which it is being used at a particular time.

ext.ext_cn: 这些椅子中有的是平脚的，这样可分散地面所受的压力。
ext.ext_en: Some of these chairs have flattened feet which spread the load on the ground...

ext.ext_cn: 高血压会给心脏增加额外的负担。
ext.ext_en: High blood pressure imposes an extra load on the heart.

defs.def_en: The load on something is the amount of weight that is pressing down on it or the amount of strain that it is under.
Soya beans are beans that can be eaten or used to make flour, oil, or soy sauce.

ext.ext_cn: 靠了5个强壮的男子才将雕像拉上坡道，再下放到合适的位置。
ext.ext_en: It took five strong men to heave the statue up a ramp and lower it into place...

ext.ext_cn: 他拉巴尼站了起来。
ext.ext_en: He heaved Barney to his feet...

defs.def_en: If you heave something heavy or difficult to move somewhere, you push, pull, or lift it using a lot of effort.

ext.ext_cn: 他的胸脯上下起伏，然后他深深地吸了口气。
ext.ext_en: His chest heaved, and he took a deep breath.

ext.ext_cn: 波涛起伏的灰色海面
ext.ext_en: ...the grey, heaving seas.

defs.def_en: If something heaves, it moves up and down with large regular movements.

ext.ext_cn: 他又开始又喘又吐起来。
ext.ext_en: He gasped and heaved and vomited again...

ext.ext_cn: 我的胃翻腾起来，直想呕吐。
ext.ext_en: My stomach heaved and I felt sick.

defs.def_en: If you heave, or if your stomach heaves, you vomit or feel sick.

ext.ext_cn: 科利尔先生深叹一口气，站了起来。
ext.ext_en: Mr Collier heaved a sigh and got to his feet.

defs.def_en: If you heave a sigh, you give a big sigh.

ext.ext_cn: “快乐兔”俱乐部里人头攒动。
ext.ext_en: The Happy Bunny club was heaving...

ext.ext_cn: 父亲奥伯龙的“学院俱乐部”里真的是有为青年济济一堂。
ext.ext_en: Father Auberon's Academy Club positively heaved with dashing young men.

defs.def_en: If a place is heaving or if it is heaving with people, it is full of people.

ext.ext_cn: 现在进入视野的火车显然是一种古老得多的车型。
ext.ext_en: The train that now hove into view was clearly of a much older vintage.

defs.def_en: When something heaves into view or heaves into sight, it appears.
A thunderbolt is a flash of lightning, accompanied by thunder, which strikes something such as a building or a tree.

ext.ext_cn: 人们将享受到无污染汽车的诸多好处。
ext.ext_en: People would benefit greatly from a pollution-free vehicle...

ext.ext_cn: 谢赫·哈西娜专程前来看望我们，对此我们深感荣幸。
ext.ext_en: We were greatly honoured that Sheik Hasina took the trouble to visit us.

defs.def_en: You use greatly to emphasize the degree or extent of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他总是愁眉苦脸的，常因小事发怒。
ext.ext_en: He was miserable all the time and rows would start over petty things.

ext.ext_cn: 没完没了的规则和繁复琐碎的规定
ext.ext_en: ...endless rules and petty regulations...

defs.def_en: You can use petty to describe things such as problems, rules, or arguments which you think are unimportant or relate to unimportant things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 小题大做的；过于关注琐事的

ext.ext_cn: 他小肚鸡肠，满脑子都是鸡毛蒜皮的事儿。
ext.ext_en: He was petty-minded and obsessed with detail...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得那种态度有点小题大做。
ext.ext_en: I think that attitude is a bit petty.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as petty, you mean that they care too much about small, unimportant things and perhaps that they are unnecessarily unkind.

defs.def_cn: 下级的；次要的；小规模的

ext.ext_cn: 威尔逊不是个与小官小吏打交道的人。
ext.ext_en: Wilson was not a man who dealt with petty officials.

ext.ext_cn: 抢手提包和入室盗窃等轻罪
ext.ext_en: ...petty crime, such as handbag-snatching and minor break-ins.

defs.def_en: Petty is used of people or actions that are less important, serious, or great than others.
Sunblock is a cream which you put on your skin to protect it completely from the sun.
Self-raising flour is flour that makes cakes rise when they are cooked because it has chemicals added to it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不利的经济形势阻碍着美国保险市场的复苏。
ext.ext_en: Unfavourable economic conditions were blocking a recovery of the American insurance market...

ext.ext_cn: 眼下汇率对我们不利。
ext.ext_en: We've got a fairly unfavourable exchange rate at the moment...

defs.def_en: Unfavourable conditions or circumstances cause problems for you and reduce your chances of success.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 首相今天的回应更是表示反对。
ext.ext_en: A more unfavourable response was given today by the Prime Minister...

ext.ext_cn: 穆巴拉克总统尤其不赞同这一想法。
ext.ext_en: President Mubarak was particularly unfavourable to the idea...

defs.def_en: If you have an unfavourable reaction to something, you do not like it.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为与法国菜相比，英国菜相形见绌。
ext.ext_en: He makes unfavourable comparisons between British and French cooking...

ext.ext_cn: 与一味地比较进步情况相比，年纪小一些的孩子会从姐姐的帮助中获益更多。
ext.ext_en: A younger child will benefit more from an older sister's help than from an unfavourable comparison between their progress.

defs.def_en: If you make an unfavourable comparison between two things, you say that one thing seems worse than the other.

ext.ext_cn: 为了减轻妻子的悲痛，他带她去了欧洲旅游。
ext.ext_en: To assuage his wife's grief, he took her on a tour of Europe...

ext.ext_cn: 她装出一副慈母的样子只是想要减轻自己的罪恶感。
ext.ext_en: She was just trying to assuage her guilt by playing the devoted mother.

defs.def_en: If you assuage an unpleasant feeling that someone has, you make them feel it less strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 他们把搞到手的肉拿来充饥。
ext.ext_en: The meat they'd managed to procure assuaged their hunger.

defs.def_en: If you assuage a need or desire for something, you satisfy it.

ext.ext_cn: 在城市广场上，霓虹灯依次闪烁。
ext.ext_en: In the city squares the neon lights flashed in turn.

ext.ext_cn: 夜晚照亮整个城市的霓虹灯广告
ext.ext_en: ...neon slogans which light up the city by night.

defs.def_en: Neon lights or signs are made from glass tubes filled with neon gas which produce a bright electric light.

ext.ext_cn: 像氖和氩这样的惰性气体
ext.ext_en: ...inert gases like neon and argon.

defs.def_en: Neon is a gas which occurs in very small amounts in the atmosphere.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 大部分医生希望病人能听从医嘱。
ext.ext_en: Most doctors want their patients to be submissive.

defs.def_en: If you are submissive, you obey someone without arguing.

ext.ext_cn: 日本最大的两家汽车制造商
ext.ext_en: ...Japan's two largest car makers.

ext.ext_cn: 巧克力、糖果和饼干生产商
ext.ext_en: ...the makers of chocolates, sweets and biscuits.

defs.def_en: The maker of a product is the firm that manufactures it.

ext.ext_cn: 新闻和时事节目制作人
ext.ext_en: ...the makers of news and current affairs programmes.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the person who makes something as its maker .
An encyclical is an official letter written by the Pope and sent to all Roman Catholic bishops, usually in order to make a statement about the official teachings of the Church.

ext.ext_cn: 外国食品进口商
ext.ext_en: ...an importer of exotic food.

defs.def_en: An importer is a country, firm, or person that buys goods from another country for use in their own country.

ext.ext_cn: 众多的好莱坞名流都去光顾珍妮特·沃恩的美甲店。
ext.ext_en: The glitterati of Hollywood are flocking to Janet Vaughan's nail salon.

defs.def_en: The glitterati are rich and famous people such as actors and rock stars.

defs.def_cn: （称号或说话方式）表示尊敬的

ext.ext_cn: 他被授予国家主席的尊称。
ext.ext_en: He was given the honorific title of national chairman...

ext.ext_cn: 所有雇员相互称呼时都须在名字后添加敬语san（日语表示“先生”，“女士”）。
ext.ext_en: All employees will refer to each other by the honorific suffix 'san'.

defs.def_en: An honorific title or way of talking is used to show respect or honour to someone.
The Ice Age was a period of time lasting many thousands of years, during which a lot of the earth's surface was covered with ice.

ext.ext_cn: 一个小男孩跑上来，非常激动地拽着他的袖子。
ext.ext_en: A little boy came running up and tugged at his sleeve excitedly...

ext.ext_cn: 她一边踢他，一边扯着他那浓密的头发。
ext.ext_en: She kicked him, tugging his thick hair.

defs.def_en: If you tug something or tug at it, you give it a quick and usually strong pull.
A tug or a tug boat is a small powerful boat which pulls large ships, usually when they come into a port.

ext.ext_cn: 异常紧张的工作安排使他开始吸毒。
ext.ext_en: His punishing work schedule had made him resort to drugs...

ext.ext_cn: 有些学校不得不开始从海外招收老师。
ext.ext_en: Some schools have resorted to recruiting teachers from overseas.

defs.def_en: If you resort to a course of action that you do not really approve of, you adopt it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 国会有责任确保只有在所有和平手段都不奏效的情况下才会诉诸战争。
ext.ext_en: Congress has a responsibility to ensure that all peaceful options are exhausted before resort to war.

defs.def_en: If you achieve something without resort to a particular course of action, you succeed without carrying out that action. To have resort to a particular course of action means to have to do that action in order to achieve something.

ext.ext_cn: 滑雪胜地
ext.ext_en: ...the ski resorts.

defs.def_en: A resort is a place where a lot of people spend their holidays.

ext.ext_cn: 不到万不得已时不能选择使用核武器。
ext.ext_en: Nuclear weapons should be used only as a last resort...

ext.ext_cn: 最终，你可能不得不接受他们的观点。

defs.def_en: If you communicate with someone, you share or exchange information with them, for example by speaking, writing, or using equipment. You can also say that two people communicate .

ext.ext_cn: 他们成功地把知识传授给他人。
ext.ext_en: They successfully communicate their knowledge to others...

ext.ext_cn: 结果会通知父母。
ext.ext_en: The results will be communicated to parents...

defs.def_en: If you communicate information, a feeling, or an idea to someone, you let them know about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他不善于和队员们进行沟通。
ext.ext_en: He was never good at communicating with the players...

ext.ext_cn: 家庭疗法指导我们彼此之间的沟通交流。
ext.ext_en: Family therapy showed us how to communicate with each other.

defs.def_en: If one person communicates with another, they successfully make each other aware of their feelings and ideas. You can also say that two people communicate .

ext.ext_cn: 在 1918 年 10 月间，奥匈帝国开始瓦解。
ext.ext_en: During October 1918 the Austro-Hungarian Empire began to disintegrate.

defs.def_en: If something disintegrates, it becomes seriously weakened, and is divided or destroyed.

ext.ext_cn: 挡风玻璃在时速420英里时破碎。
ext.ext_en: At 420mph the windscreen disintegrated.

defs.def_en: If an object or substance disintegrates, it breaks into many small pieces or parts and is destroyed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 葱郁的；葱茏的；草木茂盛的

ext.ext_cn: 河畔郁郁葱葱的青草地
ext.ext_en: ...the lush green meadows bordering the river...

ext.ext_cn: 一个个花园打扮得煞是好看，到处是绿茵茵的植被。
ext.ext_en: The beautifully landscaped gardens sprawl with lush vegetation.

defs.def_en: Lush fields or gardens have a lot of very healthy grass or plants.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 铺粉色瓷砖和豪华地毯、装有镜子的卫生间
ext.ext_en: ...a mirrored bathroom done in soft pink tiles with a lush, plush carpet...

ext.ext_cn: 布料奢华。
ext.ext_en: The fabrics were lush.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place or thing as lush, you mean that it is very luxurious.
If you describe someone as a lush, you mean that they drink too much alcohol.

defs.def_cn: （表示参与某事的人的数量，people 无此用法）

ext.ext_cn: 两口之家
ext.ext_en: ...two-person households.

ext.ext_cn: 温泉疗养院的32名员工
ext.ext_en: ...the spa's 32-person staff.

defs.def_en: -person is added to numbers to form adjectives which indicate how many people are involved in something or can use something. People is not used in this way.

defs.def_cn: （表示从事某工作的人，可避免指明性别，people也有此用法）

ext.ext_cn: 萨哈娜·普拉丹夫人，联合左翼阵线主席
ext.ext_en: ...Mrs. Sahana Pradhan, chairperson of the United Leftist Front...

ext.ext_cn: 杰西·马歇尔，当代手工艺人
ext.ext_en: ...Jessie Marshall, a contemporary craftsperson...

defs.def_en: -person is added to nouns to form nouns which refer to someone who does a particular job or is in a particular group. -person is used by people who do not want to use a term which indicates whether someone is a man or a woman. -people can also be used in this way.

ext.ext_cn: 她独自一个人要供两个孩子吃穿。
ext.ext_en: She was on her own with two kids to feed and clothe.

defs.def_en: See also:clothed;clothes;clothing;To clothe someone means to provide them with clothes to wear.
Shoestrings are long, narrow pieces of material like pieces of string that you use to fasten your shoes.

ext.ext_cn: 这部英国出品的电影是小成本制作。
ext.ext_en: The British-produced film was made on a shoestring budget.

defs.def_en: A shoestring budget is one where you have very little money to spend.

ext.ext_cn: 戏院将小本经营。
ext.ext_en: The theatre will be run on a shoestring.

defs.def_en: If you do something or make something on a shoestring, you do it using very little money.
A poison-pen letter is an unpleasant unsigned letter which is sent in order to upset someone or to cause trouble.
An equerry is an officer of a royal household or court who acts as a personal assistant to a member of the royal family.

ext.ext_cn: 福特从未停止过劝说他返回美国。
ext.ext_en: Ford never desisted from trying to persuade him to return to America...

ext.ext_cn: 杂志接到投诉之后将杜绝使用此类语言。
ext.ext_en: The magazine will desist from such language after receiving complaints...

defs.def_en: If you desist from doing something, you stop doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 西北地区成为该国的大粮仓。
ext.ext_en: The north-west became the country's bread-basket.

defs.def_en: If an area or region is described as the bread basket of a country, it provides a lot of the food for that country because crops grow very easily there. It therefore produces wealth for the country.

ext.ext_cn: 这也是她唱片生涯的开始。
ext.ext_en: This was also the beginning of her recording career...

ext.ext_cn: 把这当作一个新起点。
ext.ext_en: Think of this as a new beginning.

defs.def_en: The beginning of an event or process is the first part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我有了头痛的先兆。
ext.ext_en: I had the beginnings of a headache...

ext.ext_cn: 讨论拉开了同莫斯科对话的序幕。
ext.ext_en: The discussions were the beginnings of a dialogue with Moscow.

defs.def_en: The beginnings of something are the signs or events which form the first part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 婚礼定于三月初举行。
ext.ext_en: The wedding will be at the beginning of March.

defs.def_en: The beginning of a period of time is the time at which it starts.

ext.ext_cn: 在本章开头所提出的问题
ext.ext_en: ...the question which was raised at the beginning of this chapter.

defs.def_en: The beginning of a piece of written material is the first words or sentences of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的观点源于他卑微的出身。
ext.ext_en: His views come from his own humble beginnings.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the beginnings of a person, company, or group, you are referring to their backgrounds or origins.

ext.ext_cn: 她带的这班学生都是初学者。
ext.ext_en: The people that she had in her classroom were beginning learners.

defs.def_en: You use beginning to describe someone who is in the early stages of learning to do something.

defs.def_cn: 衣衫褴褛的人（尤指儿童）

ext.ext_cn: 他们看上去像小叫花子。
ext.ext_en: They looked like little ragamuffins.

defs.def_en: A ragamuffin is someone, especially a child, who is dirty and has torn clothes.
In computer systems, hardware refers to the machines themselves as opposed to the programs which tell the machines what to do.
Military hardware is the machinery and equipment that is used by the armed forces, such as tanks, aircraft, and missiles.

defs.def_cn: （家庭和园艺用的）五金制品，金属器具
defs.def_en: Hardware refers to tools and equipment that are used in the home and garden, for example saucepans, screwdrivers, and lawnmowers.

ext.ext_cn: 能够输出数字的小型机械装置
ext.ext_en: ...a small mechanical device that taps out the numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 世界上最古老的还在走动的机械钟
ext.ext_en: ...the oldest working mechanical clock in the world...

defs.def_en: A mechanical device has parts that move when it is working, often using power from an engine or from electricity.

defs.def_cn: 机械方面的;机械原理的

ext.ext_cn: 机械工程学
ext.ext_en: ...mechanical engineering...

ext.ext_cn: 该公司承接各类汽车的修理工作。
ext.ext_en: The company undertakes mechanical work on all types of cars...

defs.def_en: Mechanical means relating to machines and engines and the way they work.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人）精通机械的;擅长于机械原理的

ext.ext_cn: 他精通机械，了解许多有关声音的知识。
ext.ext_en: He was a very mechanical person, who knew a lot about sound...

ext.ext_cn: 我没有爸爸那么精通机械，所以得按说明书上说的去做。
ext.ext_en: I'm not mechanical like my father; I have to follow the instructions.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as mechanical, you mean they are naturally good at understanding how machines work.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行为）机械的，呆板的，不动脑筋的

ext.ext_cn: 这是真正的祈祷，不是机械的重复。
ext.ext_en: It is real prayer, and not mechanical repetition...

ext.ext_cn: 许多女孩在性方面会有些率性而为。
ext.ext_en: Many girls have a kind of mechanical attitude towards sex...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's action as mechanical, you mean that they do it automatically, without thinking about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 大规模的促销活动
ext.ext_en: ...a marketing event of gargantuan proportions.

ext.ext_cn: 骇人听闻的腐败丑闻
ext.ext_en: ...a gargantuan corruption scandal.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is gargantuan, you are emphasizing that it is very large.

ext.ext_cn: 弗格森先生说犯人捏造了这件事儿以求轻判。
ext.ext_en: Mr Ferguson said the prisoner concocted the story to get a lighter sentence.

defs.def_en: If you concoct an excuse or  explanation, you invent one that is not true.

defs.def_cn: 调制，调配(尤指不寻常之物)

ext.ext_cn: 尤金当时正在用香槟和覆盆子酱调配罗西尼鸡尾酒。
ext.ext_en: Eugene was concocting Rossini Cocktails from champagne and pureed raspberries.

ext.ext_cn: 特制按摩精油
ext.ext_en: ...a specially concocted massage oil.

defs.def_en: If you concoct something, especially something unusual, you make it by mixing several things together.

ext.ext_cn: 伯恩斯坦输掉了官司，但从未因此而怨恨格伦迪。
ext.ext_en: Bernstein lost the case, but never held it against Grundy.

defs.def_en: If you hold something against someone, you let their actions in the past influence your present attitude towards them and cause you to deal severely or unfairly with them.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得他们之间的仇恨由来已久。
ext.ext_en: I think there is an historic enmity between them...

ext.ext_cn: 密特朗总统昨天到达河内，以期结束长久以来殖民战争和冷战造成的敌意。
ext.ext_en: President Mitterrand arrived in Hanoi yesterday to bury old colonial and cold war enmities.

defs.def_en: Enmity is a feeling of hatred towards someone that lasts for a long time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 恶毒的;狠毒的;充满敌意的

ext.ext_cn: 现在他面临着意大利媒体的恶毒攻击。
ext.ext_en: Now he faces virulent attacks from the Italian media...

ext.ext_cn: 朋友们说针对他正在发起“一场恶毒的个人攻击”。
ext.ext_en: Friends spoke of 'a virulent personal campaign' being waged against him.

defs.def_en: Virulent feelings or actions are extremely bitter and hostile.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 比利时出现了这种疾病的一种极其危险的变体。
ext.ext_en: A very virulent form of the disease appeared in Belgium.

ext.ext_cn: 这种病毒中毒性尤为强烈的一种
ext.ext_en: ...a particularly virulent strain of the virus.

defs.def_en: A virulent disease or poison is extremely powerful and dangerous.

ext.ext_cn: 她卧室的窗帘拉上了。
ext.ext_en: Her bedroom curtains were drawn.

defs.def_en: Curtains are large pieces of material which you hang from the top of a window.
Curtains are pieces of very thin material which you hang in front of windows in order to prevent people from seeing in.

ext.ext_cn: 序曲将近结束时帷幕升起来了。
ext.ext_en: The curtain rises toward the end of the Prelude.

defs.def_en: In a theatre, the curtain is the large piece of material that hangs in front of the stage until a performance begins.

ext.ext_cn: 烟幕
ext.ext_en: ...a curtain of cigarette smoke...

ext.ext_cn: 他看到一个黑漆漆的东西从浓密的树叶后消失了。
ext.ext_en: He saw something dark disappear behind the curtain of leaves.

defs.def_en: See also:Iron Curtain;You can refer to something as a curtain when it is thick and difficult to see through or get past.

ext.ext_cn: 正在进行的管理层变更将最终为福特勋爵辉煌的职业生涯画上句号。
ext.ext_en: Management changes are under way that will finally bring down the curtain on Lord Forte's extraordinary working life.

defs.def_en: If something brings down the curtain on an event or situation, it causes or marks the end of it.
A rudder is a device for steering a boat. It consists of a vertical piece of wood or metal at the back of the boat.
An aeroplane's rudder is a vertical piece of metal at the back which is used to make the plane turn to the right or to the left.

ext.ext_cn: 金钱是造成很多婚姻不和的一个主要原因。
ext.ext_en: Money is a major cause of strife in many marriages...

ext.ext_cn: 公司董事会的明争暗斗还远没有结束。
ext.ext_en: The boardroom strife at the company is far from over...

defs.def_en: Strife is strong disagreement or fighting.
At an opera or play that is being performed in a foreign language, surtitles are a translation or summary of the words, which appear on a screen above the stage.

defs.def_cn: 妻子有外遇的人;戴绿帽子的人

ext.ext_cn: 亚瑟王本人被描绘成一个被人戴绿帽子的软弱之人。
ext.ext_en: Arthur himself has been portrayed as a weak cuckold.

defs.def_en: A cuckold is a man whose wife is having an affair with another man.

ext.ext_cn: 妻子给他戴绿帽子了。
ext.ext_en: His wife had cuckolded him.

defs.def_en: If a married woman is having an affair, she and her lover are cuckolding her husband.

ext.ext_cn: 污染可能会造成河边大量繁殖的翠鸟大批死亡。
ext.ext_en: The pollution could decimate the river's  thriving population of kingfishers...

ext.ext_cn: 加勒比海地区的英国部队有大批的人病死。
ext.ext_en: British forces in the Caribbean were being decimated by disease.

defs.def_en: To decimate something such as a group of people or animals means to destroy a very large number of them.

defs.def_cn: 严重削弱，大幅缩减(系统或机构)

ext.ext_cn: 使该国制造业元气大伤的经济衰退
ext.ext_en: ...a recession which decimated the nation's manufacturing industry.

defs.def_en: To decimate a system or organization means to reduce its size and effectiveness greatly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 故意的;蓄意的;早有计划的

ext.ext_cn: 它在政策上有意识地将世界艺术介绍给英国。
ext.ext_en: It has a deliberate policy to introduce world art to Britain...

ext.ext_cn: 目击者说枪击是蓄意而且持续的。
ext.ext_en: Witnesses say the firing was deliberate and sustained.

defs.def_en: If you do something that is deliberate, you planned or decided to do it beforehand, and so it happens on purpose rather than by chance.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 从容的;不慌不忙的;审慎的;小心翼翼的

ext.ext_cn: 他举止文雅而从容。
ext.ext_en: His movements were gentle and deliberate.

ext.ext_cn: 小心翼翼地沿着陡峭的小路慢慢往上走
ext.ext_en: ...stepping with deliberate slowness up the steep paths.

defs.def_en: If a movement or action is deliberate, it is done slowly and carefully.

defs.def_cn: （尤指作出重大决定前）慎重考虑，仔细思考

ext.ext_cn: 她慎重考虑了好久才下定决心作出这一决定。
ext.ext_en: She deliberated over the decision for a long time before she made up her mind...

ext.ext_cn: 6人陪审团认真商议了约两个小时后作出了裁定。
ext.ext_en: The six-person jury deliberated about two hours before returning with the verdict...

defs.def_en: If you deliberate, you think about something carefully, especially before making a very important decision.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 断断续续地有汽车驶过。
ext.ext_en: Cars passed at irregular intervals...

ext.ext_cn: 她因心律不齐被送往医院。
ext.ext_en: She was taken to hospital suffering from an irregular heartbeat...

defs.def_en: If events or actions occur at irregular intervals, the periods of time between them are of different lengths.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不规则的;不平整的;不直的

ext.ext_cn: 油漆一片片地慢慢变干了。
ext.ext_en: The paint was drying in irregular patches...

ext.ext_cn: 他牙齿长得不好，参差不齐而且有些发黄。
ext.ext_en: He had bad teeth, irregular and discolored.

defs.def_en: Something that is irregular is not smooth or straight, or does not form a regular pattern.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为)欺骗性的，不正当的,不合常规的

ext.ext_cn: 被控有违规商业行为的部长
ext.ext_en: ...the minister accused of irregular business practices...

ext.ext_cn: “利奥,你能为我做这件事吗？这是唯一的办法了。”——“拉尔夫,这么做是很不正当的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Will you do this for me, Leo? It's the only way.' — 'It's highly irregular, Ralph.'

defs.def_en: Irregular behaviour is dishonest or not in accordance with the normal rules.

defs.def_cn: (动词、名词或形容词)不规则的
defs.def_en: An irregular verb, noun, or adjective has different forms from most other verbs, nouns, or adjectives in the language. For example, 'break' is an irregular verb because its past form is 'broke', not 'breaked'.

ext.ext_cn: 至少有 17 个非正规军部队参战。
ext.ext_en: At least 17 different irregular units are engaged in the war.

defs.def_en: Irregular troops do not belong to an official national army.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一个善良的爱尔兰人
ext.ext_en: ...a big-hearted Irishman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as big-hearted, you think they are kind and generous to other people, and always willing to help them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的盘子是木制的。
ext.ext_en: Their dishes were made of wood...

ext.ext_cn: 有潮湿的木料和机油的气味。
ext.ext_en: There was a smell of damp wood and machine oil.

defs.def_en: Wood is the material which forms the trunks and branches of trees.

defs.def_cn: 树林，林子（美国英语通常用woods）

ext.ext_cn: 晚餐后艾利斯溜出去跟阿蒂到林子里散步。
ext.ext_en: After dinner Alice slipped away for a walk in the woods with Artie...

ext.ext_cn: 他在镇子以西约一英里处偶遇一大片林地。
ext.ext_en: About a mile to the west of town he came upon a large wood.

defs.def_en: A wood is a fairly large area of trees growing near each other. You can refer to one or several of these areas as woods, and this is the usual form in American English.

ext.ext_cn: 该国经济尚未摆脱困境。
ext.ext_en: The nation's economy is not out of the woods yet.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is not out of the woods yet, they are still having difficulties or problems.

defs.def_cn: 上天保佑(表示希望继续走好运)

ext.ext_cn: 她从未看过病，希望她一直好运。
ext.ext_en: She's never even been to the doctor's, touch wood...

ext.ext_cn: 老天保佑，我一直很幸运，别的重伤都躲过了。
ext.ext_en: Touch wood, I've been lucky enough to avoid any other serious injuries.

defs.def_en: You can say 'touch wood' in British English, or 'knock on wood' in American English, to indicate that you hope to have good luck in something you are doing, usually after saying that you have been lucky with it so far.

ext.ext_cn: 圣乔治屠龙的那座山
ext.ext_en: ...the hill where St George slew the dragon.

defs.def_en: If someone slays an animal, they kill it in a violent way.

ext.ext_cn: 两名澳大利亚游客被杀。
ext.ext_en: Two Australian tourists were slain.

defs.def_en: If someone has been slain, they have been murdered.

ext.ext_cn: 由此你可以算出银河系的总质量。
ext.ext_en: From this you can calculate the total mass in the Galaxy...

ext.ext_cn: 我们计算出兰开斯特郡的农场面积平均为65英亩。
ext.ext_en: We calculate that the average size farm in Lancaster County is 65 acres...

defs.def_en: If you calculate a number or amount, you discover it from information that you already have, by using arithmetic, mathematics, or a special machine.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得我能准确预料此事的政治后果。
ext.ext_en: I believe I am capable of calculating the political consequences accurately...

ext.ext_cn: 总统预计这可以从某一方面缓解自己所承受的国际社会压力。
ext.ext_en: The President is calculating that this will somehow relieve the international pressure on him.

defs.def_en: If you calculate the effects of something, especially a possible course of action, you think about them in order to form an opinion or decide what to do.

defs.def_cn: (尤当have为助动词时，they have的常用口语形式)

ext.ext_cn: 最糟糕的事情是，你给朋友打电话，而他们却出去了。
ext.ext_en: The worst thing is when you call friends and they've gone out.

defs.def_en: They've is the usual spoken form of 'they have', especially when 'have' is an auxiliary verb.

ext.ext_cn: 超过90岁的所有女性中至少有1/3已经出现髋骨骨折。
ext.ext_en: At least one-third of all women over ninety have sustained a hip fracture.

defs.def_en: A fracture is a slight crack or break in something, especially a bone.

ext.ext_cn: 你的一根肋骨断了，可能不止一根。
