defs.def_en: If something holds a particular amount of something, it can contain that amount.

ext.ext_cn: 但你得能喝酒才行。
ext.ext_en: ...but you had to be able to hold your liquor.

defs.def_en: If you can hold your drink, you are able to drink large quantities of alcohol without becoming ill or getting drunk.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为这辆车抓地性能真的非常好。
ext.ext_en: I thought the car held the road really well.

defs.def_en: If a vehicle holds the road well, it remains in close contact with the road and can be controlled safely and easily.

ext.ext_cn: 他对自己的观点坚定不移，而这些观点通常和我的相左。
ext.ext_en: He held firm opinions which usually conflicted with my own...

ext.ext_cn: 他对教师的角色抱有某些期待。
ext.ext_en: He holds certain expectations about the teacher's role...

defs.def_en: Hold is used with words and expressions indicating an opinion or belief, to show that someone has a particular opinion or believes that something is true.

defs.def_cn: 带给人，使人感到（害怕、神秘等）

ext.ext_cn: 死亡对我来说并不可怕。
ext.ext_en: Death doesn't hold any fear for me...

ext.ext_cn: 它甚至比最黑暗的丛林还更令人感到神秘。
ext.ext_en: It held more mystery than even the darkest jungle...

defs.def_en: Hold is used with words such as 'fear' or 'mystery' to indicate someone's feelings towards something, as if those feelings were a characteristic of the thing itself.

defs.def_cn: 担任（职务）;掌握（权力）;负有（责任）

ext.ext_cn: 她从未担任过部长级职务。
ext.ext_en: She has never held ministerial office...

ext.ext_cn: 我以前曾在掌握大权的人身上看到过这种情况。
ext.ext_en: I'd seen it before in people who held immense power.

defs.def_en: Hold is used with nouns such as 'office', 'power', and 'responsibility' to indicate that someone has a particular position of power or authority.

defs.def_cn: 持有（许可、票证等）;拥有（学位等）

ext.ext_cn: 申请人通常应该拥有优秀荣誉学位。
ext.ext_en: Applicants should normally hold a good Honours degree...

ext.ext_cn: 他没有持枪许可。
ext.ext_en: He did not hold a firearm certificate...

defs.def_en: Hold is used with nouns such as 'permit', 'degree', or 'ticket' to indicate that someone has a particular document that allows them to do something.

defs.def_cn: 举行（聚会、会议、会谈、选举、审判等）

ext.ext_cn: 该国将在一年之内举行民主选举。
ext.ext_en: The country will hold democratic elections within a year...

ext.ext_cn: 德国体育联合会称它将进行调查。
ext.ext_en: The German sports federation said it would hold an investigation.

defs.def_en: Hold is used with nouns such as 'party', 'meeting', 'talks', 'election', and 'trial' to indicate that people are organizing a particular activity.

ext.ext_cn: 首相正在和同僚进行磋商，以敲定该协议。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister, is holding consultations with his colleagues to finalise the deal...

ext.ext_cn: 工程师和他的儿子经常就技术问题互相征求意见。
ext.ext_en: The engineer and his son held frequent consultations concerning technical problems...

defs.def_en: Hold is used with nouns such as 'conversation', 'interview', and 'talks' to indicate that two or more people meet and discuss something.

ext.ext_cn: 该集团称其继续持有1,774,687股冯氏公司的股份。
ext.ext_en: The group said it continues to hold 1,774,687 Vons shares...

ext.ext_cn: 费希尔家族持有40%的股份。
ext.ext_en: The Fisher family holds 40% of the stock.

defs.def_en: See also:holding;Hold is used with nouns such as 'shares' and 'stock' to indicate that someone owns a particular proportion of a business.

ext.ext_cn: 他继续在安哥拉总统大选中占据领先地位。
ext.ext_en: He continued to hold a lead in Angola's presidential race...

ext.ext_cn: 梅斯特尔占有微弱优势。
ext.ext_en: Mestel holds a slight advantage.

defs.def_en: Hold is used with words such as 'lead' or 'advantage' to indicate that someone is winning or doing well in a contest.

defs.def_cn: 吸引住（注意力）;保持（兴趣）

ext.ext_cn: 如果想吸引住某人的注意力，就要直视他们的眼睛，但别死盯着。
ext.ext_en: If you want to hold someone's attention, look them directly in the eye but don't stare...

ext.ext_cn: 我难道就不能让菲利普一直感兴趣吗？
ext.ext_en: Couldn't I hold Philippe's interest?

defs.def_en: Hold is used with nouns such as 'attention' or 'interest' to indicate that what you do or say keeps someone interested or listening to you.

ext.ext_cn: 不可能归咎于任何个人。
ext.ext_en: It's impossible to hold any individual responsible.

ext.ext_cn: 想让公司董事为自己的行为负更大责任的股东们
ext.ext_en: ...shareholders who want to hold corporate directors more accountable for their actions.

defs.def_en: If you hold someone responsible, liable, or accountable for something, you will blame them if anything goes wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 小货车内是关押被绑架人的好地方。
ext.ext_en: The inside of a van was as good a place as any to hold a kidnap victim...

ext.ext_cn: 有人挟持了你妻子作为人质。
ext.ext_en: Somebody is holding your wife hostage...

defs.def_en: If someone holds you in a place, they keep you there as a prisoner and do not allow you to leave.

ext.ext_cn: 示威者从周日起就占领了广场。
ext.ext_en: Demonstrators have been holding the square since Sunday.

defs.def_en: If people such as an army or a violent crowd hold a place, they control it by using force.

defs.def_cn: （因握有某人把柄或掌握权力而形成的）控制力，支配力

ext.ext_cn: 能支配像卡尔·梅这样的人总是很有用的。
ext.ext_en: It's always useful to have a hold over a fellow like Carl May...

ext.ext_cn: 他已经命令军官要倍加严格地管住自己的手下。
ext.ext_en: He had ordered his officers to keep an exceptionally firm hold over their men...

defs.def_en: If you have a hold over someone, you have power or control over them, for example because you know something about them you can use to threaten them or because you are in a position of authority.

defs.def_cn: （接电话时让对方）稍等，不要挂断

ext.ext_cn: 能否请您稍等一会儿，我拿支笔？
ext.ext_en: Could you hold the line and I'll just get my pen...

ext.ext_cn: 电话接线员让他不要挂断。
ext.ext_en: A telephone operator asked him to hold.

defs.def_en: If you ask someone to hold, or to hold the line, when you are answering a telephone call, you are asking them to wait for a short time, for example so that you can find the person they want to speak to.

defs.def_cn: 代接（电话）并向受话人转告通话内容

ext.ext_cn: 他让秘书代接电话。
ext.ext_en: He tells his secretary to hold his calls.

defs.def_en: If you hold telephone calls for someone, you do not allow people who phone to speak to that person, but take messages instead.

ext.ext_cn: 石油输出国组织的石油产量保持在每天约2,150万桶。
ext.ext_en: OPEC production is holding at around 21.5 million barrels a day...

ext.ext_cn: 他们预计失业率会保持稳定。
ext.ext_en: They were expecting the jobless rate to hold steady...

defs.def_en: If something holds at a particular value or level, or is held there, it is kept at that value or level.

ext.ext_cn: 非常自如清晰地唱出并拉长每个音符的歌喉
ext.ext_en: ...a voice which hit and held every note with perfect ease and clarity.

defs.def_en: If you hold a sound or musical note, you continue making it.

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦地铁公司的发言人为推迟发车直到警方赶来的决定作了辩解。
ext.ext_en: A London Underground spokesman defended the decision to hold the train until police arrived.

defs.def_en: If you hold something such as a train, a lift, or an elevator, you delay it.

ext.ext_cn: 你的提议仍然有效吗？
ext.ext_en: Does your offer still hold?

defs.def_en: If an offer or invitation still holds, it is still available for you to accept.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不会永远走运。
ext.ext_en: Our luck couldn't hold for ever...

ext.ext_cn: 天气会保持晴好吗？
ext.ext_en: Would the weather hold?...

defs.def_en: If a good situation holds, it continues and does not get worse or fail.

ext.ext_cn: 今天，大多数人认为那个论点已经站不住脚了。
ext.ext_en: Today, most people think that argument no longer holds...

ext.ext_cn: 该理论有可能仍然成立。
ext.ext_en: The theory could still hold.

defs.def_en: If an argument or theory holds, it is true or valid, even after close examination.

ext.ext_cn: 房顶能支撑多久？
ext.ext_en: How long would the roof hold?

defs.def_en: If part of a structure holds, it does not fall or break although there is a lot of force or pressure on it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些法律也适用于各大学。
ext.ext_en: These laws also hold for universities.

defs.def_en: If laws or rules hold, they exist and remain in force.

ext.ext_cn: 我坚信应该允许人们拥有自己的私生活。
ext.ext_en: I hold to my belief that people should be allowed to have private lives...

ext.ext_cn: 你仍会坚持那个看法吗？
ext.ext_en: Would you still hold to that view?

defs.def_en: If you say that you hold to a particular opinion or belief, you are stating firmly that you continue to have that opinion or belief.

defs.def_cn: 遵守，恪守（承诺或高尚的行为准则）

ext.ext_cn: 总统能恪守此承诺吗？
ext.ext_en: Will the President be able to hold to this commit-ment?...

ext.ext_cn: 不是所有的人都像萨姆那样品德如此高尚，抑或恪守同样的道德准则。
ext.ext_en: Not all men are as honorable or hold to the same standards as Sam.

defs.def_en: If you hold to a promise or to high standards of behaviour, you keep that promise or continue to behave according to those standards.

defs.def_cn: 使遵守，使恪守（承诺或高尚的行为准则）

ext.ext_cn: 我认为已经差不多是时候让他兑现那个承诺了。
ext.ext_en: I would say it's almost time to hold him to that promise...

ext.ext_cn: 我不能百分百保证。
ext.ext_en: Don't hold me to that...

defs.def_en: If someone or something holds you to a promise or to high standards of behaviour, they make you keep that promise or those standards.

ext.ext_cn: 巴里正在滔滔不绝地谈论政治。
ext.ext_en: Barry was holding forth on politics.

defs.def_en: If you hold forth on a subject, you speak confidently and for a long time about it, especially to a group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 在这个国家里要搞到枪支是很困难的。
ext.ext_en: It is hard to get hold of guns in this country.

defs.def_en: If you get hold of an object or information, you obtain it, usually after some difficulty.

ext.ext_cn: 他首先得弄清一些基本事实。
ext.ext_en: He first had to get hold of some basic facts.

defs.def_en: If you get hold of a fact or a subject, you learn about it and understand it well.

ext.ext_cn: 我们唯一能够联络到的电工离这里有好几英里远。
ext.ext_en: The only electrician we could get hold of was miles away.

defs.def_en: If you get hold of someone, you manage to contact them.

ext.ext_cn: 停下！别动！
ext.ext_en: Hold it! Don't move!

defs.def_en: If you say 'Hold it', you are telling someone to stop what they are doing and to wait.

ext.ext_cn: 他推迟了退休，直到他找到了解决办法。
ext.ext_en: He put his retirement on hold until he had found a solution...

ext.ext_cn: 他将他们的外交政策称为缓兵之计。
ext.ext_en: He described their foreign policy as on hold.

defs.def_en: If you put something on hold, you decide not to do it, deal with it, or change it now, but to leave it until later.

defs.def_cn: （面对攻击、反对等）顶住，坚持住

ext.ext_cn: 这名法国人顶住了挑战者的进攻。
ext.ext_en: The Frenchman held his own against the challenger.

defs.def_en: If you hold your own, you are able to resist someone who is attacking or opposing you.

ext.ext_cn: 她几乎能和任何一名选手一较高下。
ext.ext_en: She can hold her own against almost any player.

defs.def_en: If you can do something well enough to hold your own, you do not appear foolish when you are compared with someone who is generally thought to be very good at it.

ext.ext_cn: 你一秒钟不动都做不到吗？
ext.ext_en: Can't you hold still for a second?

defs.def_en: If you hold still, you do not move.

ext.ext_cn: 她浑身感到一股莫名的兴奋。
ext.ext_en: She felt a strange excitement taking hold of her...

ext.ext_cn: 她决心不让疾病再次击垮自己。
ext.ext_en: She was determined not to let the illness take hold again.

defs.def_en: If something takes hold, it gains complete control or influence over a person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他牢牢抓住绳子。
ext.ext_en: He held tight to the rope...

ext.ext_cn: 爬到我背上抓紧了。
ext.ext_en: Climb on to my back and hold tight.

defs.def_en: If you hold tight, you put your hand round or against something in order to prevent yourself from falling over. A bus driver might say 'Hold tight!' to you if you are standing on a bus when it is about to move.

ext.ext_cn: 各工会已经在其分支机构中作了宣传工作，敦促会员等到达成全国性协议后再行动。
ext.ext_en: The unions have circulated their branches, urging members to hold tight until a national deal is struck.

defs.def_en: If you hold tight, you do not immediately start a course of action that you have been planning or thinking about.

defs.def_cn: (与副词或形容词连用构成形容词)表示“以…方式说话的”

ext.ext_cn: 那名女子穿着讲究，谈吐得体。
ext.ext_en: The woman was smartly dressed and well-spoken.

ext.ext_cn: 30 岁出头、声音柔和的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a soft-spoken man in his early thirties.

defs.def_en: -spoken combines with adverbs and adjectives to form adjectives which indicate how someone speaks.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 勃起阴茎状的；象征男性生殖能力的

ext.ext_cn: 象征男性生殖能力的标志
ext.ext_en: ...a phallic symbol.

defs.def_en: Something that is phallic is shaped like an erect penis. It can also relate to male sexual powers.
A rangefinder is an instrument, usually part of a camera or a piece of military equipment, that measures the distance between things that are far away from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 他目前流亡埃及。
ext.ext_en: He is now living in exile in Egypt...

ext.ext_cn: 今年早些时候他流亡归来。
ext.ext_en: He returned from exile earlier this year.

defs.def_en: If someone is living in exile, they are living in a foreign country because they cannot live in their own country, usually for political reasons.

ext.ext_cn: 他的第二任妻子希拉丽已经成了寡妇，后来又被驱逐出南非。
ext.ext_en: His second wife, Hilary, had been widowed, then exiled from South Africa...

ext.ext_cn: 他们威胁要将她流放到西班牙南部。
ext.ext_en: They threatened to exile her in southern Spain.

defs.def_en: If someone is exiled, they are living in a foreign country because they cannot live in their own country, usually for political reasons.
An exile is someone who has been exiled.

ext.ext_cn: 他被开除出甲级球队，被迫参加丙级球队的比赛。
ext.ext_en: He has been exiled from the first team and forced to play in third team matches...

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔被赶到厨房吃晚饭。
ext.ext_en: Michael was exiled to the kitchen for supper.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has been exiled from a particular place or situation, you mean that they have been sent away from it or removed from it against their will.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 年轻的;显得年轻的;富有青春活力的;朝气蓬勃的

ext.ext_cn: 我50岁了，但仍富有青春活力。
ext.ext_en: I'm a very youthful 50.

ext.ext_cn: 青春的热情和高昂的情绪
ext.ext_en: ...youthful enthusiasm and high spirits...

defs.def_en: Someone who is youthful behaves as if they are young or younger than they really are.

ext.ext_cn: 先发制人打击可能拥有生物武器的国家的计划
ext.ext_en: ...plans for a pre-emptive strike against countries that may have biological weapons...

ext.ext_cn: 内政部抢先行动，逮捕了许多持不同政见的嫌疑人。
ext.ext_en: In a pre-emptive move the Interior Ministry arrested a number of suspected dissidents.

defs.def_en: A pre-emptive attack or strike is intended to weaken or damage an enemy or opponent, for example by destroying their weapons before they can do any harm.

ext.ext_cn: 麦克米伦回信说他肯定能帮忙。
ext.ext_en: Macmillan wrote back saying that he could certainly help...

ext.ext_cn: 我马上给缪顿回信安排会面。
ext.ext_en: I wrote back to Meudon at once to fix up a meeting.

defs.def_en: If you write back to someone who has sent you a letter, you write them a letter in reply.

ext.ext_cn: 有传闻称将通过提高录取条件来限制在校学生的数目。
ext.ext_en: There is talk of raising the admission requirements to restrict the number of students on campus...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为，法国将把从日本的最高进口量限制在其市场总量的3％。
ext.ext_en: The French, I believe, restrict Japanese imports to a maximum of 3 per cent of their market.

defs.def_en: If you restrict something, you put a limit on it in order to reduce it or prevent it becoming too great.

ext.ext_cn: 村民们说架篱笆能限制公众进山。
ext.ext_en: Villagers say the fence would restrict public access to the hills...

ext.ext_cn: 政府囚禁了持不同政见者，禁止出游，并且限制了新闻自由。
ext.ext_en: The government imprisoned dissidents, forbade travel, and restricted the press...

defs.def_en: To restrict the movement or actions of someone or something means to prevent them from moving or acting freely.

ext.ext_cn: 然而，只要他专心学习，他就可以继续留在寺庙里。
ext.ext_en: He was, however, allowed to stay on at the temple as long as he restricted himself to his studies...

ext.ext_cn: 并没有限制这位病人少吃东西。
ext.ext_en: The patient isn't restricted to a meagre diet...

defs.def_en: If you restrict someone or their activities to one thing, they can only do, have, or deal with that thing. If you restrict them to one place, they cannot go anywhere else.

defs.def_cn: 将…限制在（某地）；将…限定为（某群体）

ext.ext_cn: 这家医院可能会限定只有当地居民才能预约。
ext.ext_en: The hospital may restrict bookings to people living locally...

ext.ext_cn: 露营被限制在指定的5个野营地。
ext.ext_en: Camping is restricted to five designated campgrounds.

defs.def_en: If you restrict something to a particular group, only that group can do it or have it. If you restrict something to a particular place, it is allowed only in that place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 法律协会的重要成员
ext.ext_en: ...a prominent member of the Law Society.

ext.ext_cn: 杰出或成功人士的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...the children of very prominent or successful parents.

defs.def_en: Someone who is prominent is important.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 显著的；突出的；鲜艳的；引人注目的

ext.ext_cn: 这里窗户在设计中起着非常重要的作用。
ext.ext_en: Here the window plays a prominent part in the design.

ext.ext_cn: 罗马尼亚最著名的独立报纸
ext.ext_en: ...Romania's most prominent independent newspaper.

defs.def_en: Something that is prominent is very noticeable or is an important part of something else.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （指房屋）具有上流社会气派的，豪华老派的

ext.ext_cn: 庄重大气的庄园宅邸
ext.ext_en: ...baronial manor houses...

ext.ext_cn: 橡木制镶板和皮沙发使房间看起来既豪华气派又古色古香。
ext.ext_en: The rooms have a baronial feel, with oak paneling and leather sofas.

defs.def_en: If you describe a house or room as baronial, you mean that it is large, impressive, and old-fashioned in appearance, and looks as if it belongs to someone from the upper classes.

ext.ext_cn: 中世纪贵族领主间的世仇
ext.ext_en: ...the baronial feuding of the Middle Ages.

defs.def_en: Baronial means relating to a baron or barons.

ext.ext_cn: 商业街上的银行仍旧一派繁荣景象。
ext.ext_en: The high street banks continue to prosper...

ext.ext_cn: 他的队伍在杯赛上总是成绩不俗。
ext.ext_en: His teams have always prospered in cup competitions.

defs.def_en: If people or businesses prosper, they are successful and do well.
A scattergun is a gun that fires a lot of small metal balls at the same time.

ext.ext_cn: 他们主张采取向四处随意邮寄大量信件的方式。
ext.ext_en: They advocated a scattergun approach of posting dozens of letters.

defs.def_en: Scattergun means the same as scattershot .

ext.ext_cn: 一包卷心菜籽
ext.ext_en: ...a packet of cabbage seed...

ext.ext_cn: 我把种子种在几盆掺有堆肥的土里。
ext.ext_en: I sow the seed in pots of soil-based compost.

defs.def_en: A seed is the small, hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows.

ext.ext_cn: 人们割了大片草地的草，然后在上面播种。
ext.ext_en: Men mowed the wide lawns and seeded them...

ext.ext_cn: 报春花应该开始沿着陡峭的山坡一路撒播种子了。
ext.ext_en: The primroses should begin to seed themselves down the steep hillside.

defs.def_en: If you seed a piece of land, you plant seeds in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他提出几个问题意欲引起陪审员的疑心。
ext.ext_en: He raised questions meant to plant seeds of doubts in the minds of jurors...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为在这些事态发展中包蕴着一种新的道德秩序的萌芽。
ext.ext_en: He considered that there were, in these developments, the seeds of a new moral order.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the seeds of something when you want to talk about the beginning of a feeling or process that gradually develops and becomes stronger or more important.

defs.def_cn: (网球、羽毛球等体育项目中的)种子选手

ext.ext_cn: 皮特·桑普拉斯，温布尔登网球锦标赛的头号种子，世界排名第一
ext.ext_en: ...Pete Sampras, Wimbledon's top seed and the world No.1...

ext.ext_cn: 在决赛中，三号种子选手卡普里亚蒂击败了凯特林娜·马莉娃。
ext.ext_en: In the final Capriati, the third seed, defeated Katerina Maleeva.

defs.def_en: In sports such as tennis or badminton, a seed is a player who has been ranked according to his or her ability.

defs.def_cn: 将(选手或参赛队)排列名次

ext.ext_cn: 在欧洲联盟杯比赛中，排名前 16 位的球队已按位次进入首轮。
ext.ext_en: In the UEFA Cup the top 16 sides are seeded for the first round...

ext.ext_cn: 他被列为二号种子选手，位居布拉德·贝文之后。
ext.ext_en: He is seeded second, behind Brad Beven...

defs.def_en: When a player or a team is seeded in a sports competition, they are ranked according to their ability.

ext.ext_cn: 如果不去动的话，冬萝卜会在春天开花结籽。
ext.ext_en: If unused, winter radishes run to seed in spring.

defs.def_en: If vegetable plants go to seed or run to seed, they produce flowers and seeds as well as leaves.

defs.def_cn: 衰老;风光不再;衰退;退化

ext.ext_cn: 他说经济已经走向衰退。
ext.ext_en: He says the economy has gone to seed...

ext.ext_cn: 他 40 多岁时很魁梧，曾经肌肉发达，但如今身体逐渐衰弱了。
ext.ext_en: He was a big man in his forties; once he had a lot of muscle but now he was running to seed.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has gone to seed or has run to seed, you mean that they have become much less attractive, healthy, or efficient.

defs.def_cn: 惊讶不已;不胜惊羡;大为赞叹

ext.ext_cn: 她的同事们对她似乎无穷的精力大为惊叹。
ext.ext_en: Her fellow members marveled at her seemingly infinite energy...

ext.ext_cn: 我和萨拉读了这部小说后惊叹不已。
ext.ext_en: Sara and I read the story and marveled...

defs.def_en: If you marvel at something, you express your great surprise, wonder, or admiration.

defs.def_cn: 不可思议的事(或人);奇迹

ext.ext_cn: 鲸和海豚一样，已经成为造物杰作的象征。
ext.ext_en: The whale, like the dolphin, has become a symbol of the marvels of creation...

ext.ext_cn: 一项科技新奇迹在英国剑桥大学诞生了——这就是扫描电子显微镜。
ext.ext_en: A new technological marvel was invented at Cambridge University in England, the scanning electron microscope.

defs.def_en: You can describe something or someone as a marvel to indicate that you think that they are wonderful.

ext.ext_cn: 她已经奄奄一息，但是医院的技术却创造了伟大的奇迹。
ext.ext_en: She almost died, but the hospital's skill achieved great marvels...

ext.ext_cn: 他与全队创造了奇迹。
ext.ext_en: He's done marvels with the team...

defs.def_en: Marvels are things that people have done, or that have happened, which are very unexpected or surprising.
A dress or blouse with a plunging neckline is cut in a very low V-shape at the front.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (对热、电等)具有传导性的;导电(或热)的

ext.ext_cn: 盐水比淡水的传导性强得多。
ext.ext_en: Salt water is much more conductive than fresh water is.

defs.def_en: A conductive substance is able to conduct things such as heat and electricity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 黄绿相间的树叶
ext.ext_en: ...mottled green and yellow leaves.

defs.def_en: Something that is mottled is covered with patches of different colours which do not form a regular pattern.

ext.ext_cn: 未表态的选民支持谁将是至关重要的。
ext.ext_en: The allegiance of uncommitted voters will be crucial...

ext.ext_cn: 我们到达坎普尔时，我仍未拿定主意是否去冒险。
ext.ext_en: I was still uncommitted to the venture when we reached Kanpur.

defs.def_en: If you are uncommitted, you have not yet decided to support a particular idea, belief, group, or person, or you are unwilling to show your support.

defs.def_cn: （资源等）未指定用途的，未明确用途的

ext.ext_cn: 用途待定的汽油储备
ext.ext_en: ...uncommitted gas reserves.

ext.ext_cn: 230万英镑用途未定的贷款
ext.ext_en: ...£2.3m of uncommitted loans.

defs.def_en: If resources are uncommitted, it has not yet been decided what to use them for.

defs.def_cn: (表示汽车发动机等的容量)立方厘米

ext.ext_cn: 1,500立方厘米气缸的跑车
ext.ext_en: ...1,500 cc sports cars.

defs.def_en: You use cc when referring to the volume or capacity of something such as the size of a car engine. cc is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'cubic centimetres'.

defs.def_cn: (用于商业书信的末尾)抄送给，副本呈送

ext.ext_cn: 抄送:J.蔡特,S.库珀
ext.ext_en: ...cc J. Chater, S. Cooper.

defs.def_en: cc is used at the end of a business letter to indicate that a copy is being sent to another person.

defs.def_cn: (标志边界、崎岖路径、山顶或纪念某人的)石堆，石标
defs.def_en: A cairn is a pile of stones which marks a boundary, a route across rough ground, or the top of a mountain. A cairn is sometimes also built in memory of someone.

ext.ext_cn: 在同一个概念体系内以新法代替旧法
ext.ext_en: ...replacing old laws with new within the same conceptual framework.

defs.def_en: Conceptual means related to ideas and concepts formed in the mind.
Peas are round green seeds which grow in long thin cases and are eaten as a vegetable.
A hedge is a row of bushes or small trees, usually along the edge of a garden, field, or road.

defs.def_cn: 防备，防范（尤指金钱损失）

ext.ext_cn: 可以购买保险以防失业或患病。
ext.ext_en: You can hedge against redundancy or illness with insurance...

ext.ext_cn: 现今各种巧妙的金融手段使得各公司防范风险成为可能。
ext.ext_en: Today's clever financial instruments make it possible for firms to hedge their risks.

defs.def_en: If you hedge against something unpleasant or unwanted that might affect you, especially losing money, you do something which will protect you from it.

defs.def_cn: 防护物;防备手段;防范措施

ext.ext_cn: 购买黄金是防范通货膨胀的一种传统手段。
ext.ext_en: Gold is traditionally a hedge against inflation.

defs.def_en: Something that is a hedge against something unpleasant will protect you from its effects.

ext.ext_cn: 他们闪烁其词，不愿回答有关此次行动的各种问题。
ext.ext_en: They hedged in answering various questions about the operation...

ext.ext_cn: “我现在不能回答你，”他闪避道。
ext.ext_en: 'I can't give you an answer now,' he hedged.

defs.def_en: If you hedge, you avoid answering a question or committing yourself to a particular action or decision.

defs.def_cn: 两面下注以防损失;骑墙

ext.ext_cn: 霍克·西德利试图通过在其他领域进行多样化发展来规避风险。
ext.ext_en: Hawker Siddeley tried to hedge its bets by diversifying into other fields...

ext.ext_cn: 预测家对本周六路易斯安那州州长竞选的结果骑墙观望，多手下注。
ext.ext_en: Forecasters are hedging their bets about the outcome of this Saturday's Louisiana governor's race.

defs.def_en: If you hedge your bets, you reduce the risk of losing a lot by supporting more than one person or thing in a situation where they are opposed to each other.

defs.def_cn: （表示强调）极好的，极坏的，庞大的

ext.ext_cn: 这让我对自己了解了很多。
ext.ext_en: It taught me a helluva lot about myself...

ext.ext_cn: 这家伙把事情全都料理妥当了，真是干得不错。
ext.ext_en: The man did one helluva job getting it all together.

defs.def_en: Some people say a helluva or one helluva to emphasize that something is very good, very bad, or very big.

ext.ext_cn: 不贪财的生意人可遇不可求。
ext.ext_en: It is not every day that one meets a business-person who is not obsessed with Mammon.

defs.def_en: You can use Mammon to refer to money and business activities if you want to show your disapproval of people who think that becoming rich is the most important thing in life.

ext.ext_cn: 所需的烹饪时间取决于土豆的大小。
ext.ext_en: The cooking time needed depends on the size of the potato...

ext.ext_cn: 日后之事将有赖于他与德索利纳的谈话结果。
ext.ext_en: What happened later would depend on his talk with De Solina...

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing depends on another, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

ext.ext_cn: 他们或许讨厌他的营生，但他们要想活下来必须依靠他。
ext.ext_en: They may hate what he does but their survival depends on him...

ext.ext_cn: 他靠写作赚取收入。
ext.ext_en: He depended on his writing for his income...

defs.def_en: If you depend on someone or something, you need them in order to be able to survive physically, financially, or emotionally.

ext.ext_cn: “你可以信赖我，”克罗斯向他保证。
ext.ext_en: 'You can depend on me,' Cross assured him.

defs.def_en: If you can depend on a person, organization, or law, you know that they will support you or help you when you need them.

ext.ext_cn: “但你能在这所房子里呆多久呢？”——“我不知道，这要看情况。”
ext.ext_en: 'But how long can you stay in the house?' – 'I don't know. It depends.'...

ext.ext_cn: “这全视乎你对朋克摇滚乐的定义，不是吗？”
ext.ext_en: It all depends on your definition of punk, doesn't it?

defs.def_en: You use depend in expressions such as it depends to indicate that you cannot give a clear answer to a question because the answer will be affected or determined by other factors.

ext.ext_cn: 根据家庭的不同，我往往会给出不同的答案。
ext.ext_en: I tend to have a different answer, depending on the family...

ext.ext_cn: 该国其他地区的人们庆祝独立的时间甚至更晚，这要取决于有关国会决定的消息何时传到了他们那里。
ext.ext_en: People in the rest of the country celebrated independence even later, depending on when the news of Congress's action reached them.

defs.def_en: You use depending on when you are saying that something varies according to the circumstances mentioned.

defs.def_cn: （尤指娱乐节目）深夜的，午夜的，半夜的

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·皮尔在英国广播公司一台主持的深夜节目
ext.ext_en: ...John Peel's late-night show on BBC Radio One.

ext.ext_cn: 深夜饮酒派对
ext.ext_en: ...late-night drinking parties.

defs.def_en: Late-night is used to describe events, especially entertainments, that happen late in the evening or late at night.

ext.ext_cn: 周六晚上购物可以持续到深夜。
ext.ext_en: Saturday night was a late-night shopping night.

ext.ext_cn: 午夜列车
ext.ext_en: ...late-night trains.

defs.def_en: Late-night is used to describe services that are available late at night and do not shut when most commercial activities finish.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第13个字母
defs.def_en: M is the thirteenth letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_cn: (用于首字母为m的一些单词的书面缩写，如 minutes，married，male 和 masculine)
defs.def_en: M or m is a written abbreviation for words beginning with m, such as 'minutes', 'married', 'male', and 'masculine'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 许多山坡都是石头地，植被稀疏。
ext.ext_en: Many slopes are rock fields with sparse vegetation...

ext.ext_cn: 他50来岁，头发稀疏，身材矮胖。
ext.ext_en: He was a tubby little man in his fifties, with sparse hair...

defs.def_en: Something that is sparse is small in number or amount and spread out over an area.
A tablecloth is a cloth used to cover a table.

ext.ext_cn: 美国尚未解决的贫困和种族问题
ext.ext_en: ...America's unsolved problems of poverty and racism...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维被杀的案子仍未侦破。
ext.ext_en: David's murder remains unsolved.

defs.def_en: An unsolved mystery or problem has never been solved.
A dugout is a small boat that is made by removing the inside of a log.

defs.def_cn: 地下掩体;避弹壕;防空洞
defs.def_en: A dugout is a shelter made by digging a hole in the ground and then covering it or tunnelling so that the shelter has a roof over it.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有提到什么协议。
ext.ext_en: He made no reference to any agreement...

ext.ext_cn: 人群高呼“不要人头税”，指的是政府新确立的地方税收制度。
ext.ext_en: The crowd chanted 'No Poll Tax', a reference to the government's new local taxation system...

defs.def_en: Reference to someone or something is the act of talking about them or mentioning them. A reference is a particular example of this.

ext.ext_cn: 这件事情也许可以绕过国会直接进行。
ext.ext_en: This might be done without reference to Parliament...

ext.ext_cn: 请把这张纸放在稳妥之处以备查阅。
ext.ext_en: Please keep this sheet in a safe place for reference.

defs.def_en: Reference is the act of consulting someone or something in order to get information or advice.

ext.ext_cn: 有几本参考书专门帮你作出选择。
ext.ext_en: There are several reference books which have been compiled to help you make your choice.

ext.ext_cn: 有用的教师参考书
ext.ext_en: ...a useful reference work for teachers.

defs.def_en: Reference books are ones that you look at when you need specific information or facts about a subject.

ext.ext_cn: 引自《古兰经》的引文
ext.ext_en: ...a reference from the Quran.

ext.ext_cn: 历史引证
ext.ext_en: ...historical references.

defs.def_en: A reference is a word, phrase, or idea which comes from something such as a book, poem, or play and which you use when making a point about something.

ext.ext_cn: 地图索引
ext.ext_en: ...a map reference...

ext.ext_cn: 把表格上的编码记下来。
ext.ext_en: Make a note of the reference number shown on the form.

defs.def_en: A reference is something such as a number or a name that tells you where you can obtain the information you want.

ext.ext_cn: 公司主动给她开具介绍信。
ext.ext_en: The firm offered to give her a reference.

defs.def_en: A reference is a letter that is written by someone who knows you and which describes your character and abilities. When you apply for a job, an employer might ask for references .

defs.def_cn: （求职等时的）推荐人，介绍人，证明人
defs.def_en: A reference is a person who gives you a reference, for example when you are applying for a job.

defs.def_cn: 引用，参照（某书或某作者）

ext.ext_cn: 在这一问题上它特别参照了赫尔曼·诺丁1928年的经典之作。
ext.ext_en: It specifically referenced Hermann Noordung's classic 1928 book on this subject.

defs.def_en: If you reference a particular book or writer, you make a precise reference to them in what you are saying or writing.

ext.ext_cn: 仔细阅读这些注释并将其保留下来以备将来之用。
ext.ext_en: Read these notes carefully and keep them for future reference.

defs.def_en: If you keep information for future reference, you keep it because it might be useful in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 我写此信是为了回应你那篇探讨科学家薪水的文章。
ext.ext_en: I am writing with reference to your article on salaries for scientists...

ext.ext_cn: 我打电话是要谈谈你写的有关“偏见”的系列文章。
ext.ext_en: I'm calling in reference to your series on prejudice.

defs.def_en: You use with reference to or in reference to in order to indicate what something relates to.

ext.ext_cn: 那是一个比赛用的机器，完全是为提高速度设计的。
ext.ext_en: It is a racing machine, designed purely for speed...

ext.ext_cn: 政府说这些举措纯粹是出于防御目的。
ext.ext_en: The government said the moves were purely defensive.

defs.def_en: You use purely to emphasize that the thing you are mentioning is the most important feature or that it is the only thing which should be considered.

ext.ext_cn: 如果阿瑟是被这种疗法的前景吸引到此，那么约翰则纯粹是为了赚钱而来。
ext.ext_en: If Arthur was attracted here by the prospects of therapy, John came down purely and simply to make money...

ext.ext_cn: 该协会说此举是旨在降低成本的“不折不扣的商业决定”。
ext.ext_en: The society said the move was 'purely and simply a business decision' aimed at reducing costs.

defs.def_en: You use purely and simply to emphasize that the thing you are mentioning is the only thing involved.

ext.ext_cn: 办这个案子的过程中，我们遇到了很多阻力。
ext.ext_en: We came up against a great deal of resistance in dealing with the case.

defs.def_en: If you come up against a problem or difficulty, you are faced with it and have to deal with it.
The undercarriage of an aeroplane is the part, including the wheels, which supports the aeroplane when it is on the ground and when it is landing or taking off.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那个蠢笨粗野的家伙
ext.ext_en: ...that oafish, uncouth person.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as uncouth, you mean that their behaviour is rude, noisy, and unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 目标是对 98%的生活垃圾进行回收利用。
ext.ext_en: The objective would be to recycle 98 per cent of domestic waste...

ext.ext_cn: 所有不能再次装用的玻璃瓶子都可以被回收利用。
ext.ext_en: All glass bottles which can't be refilled can be recycled...

defs.def_en: If you recycle things that have already been used, such as bottles or sheets of paper, you process them so that they can be used again.

ext.ext_cn: 它看起来像是一个有利于我的孩子们成长的理想居住区。
ext.ext_en: It seemed like a good neighbourhood to raise my children.

defs.def_en: A neighbourhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

ext.ext_cn: 他出生在布鲁克林的弗拉特布什一带，并在那儿长大成人。
ext.ext_en: He was born and grew up in the Flatbush neighbourhood of Brooklyn...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得自己是周围社区中的一分子。
ext.ext_en: I feel a part of my immediate neighbourhood.

defs.def_en: The neighbourhood of a place or person is the area or the people around them.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经赢了约400万美元。
ext.ext_en: He's won in the neighbourhood of four million dollars...

ext.ext_cn: 它的时速大约达到了380英里，或者更快。
ext.ext_en: Its speed is probably in the neighbourhood of 380mph or even more.

defs.def_en: In the neighbourhood of a number means approximately that number.

ext.ext_cn: 大城镇附近林地的丧失
ext.ext_en: ...the loss of woodlands in the neighbourhood of large towns.

defs.def_en: A place in the neighbourhood of another place is near it.

defs.def_cn: 使(某一地区)非军事化;撤出(某一地区)的全部军事力量

ext.ext_cn: 他说联合国在促使该地区非军事化的进程中已经取得了显著进展。
ext.ext_en: He said the UN had made remarkable progress in demilitarizing the region...

ext.ext_cn: 该地区可能会成为非军事区。
ext.ext_en: The area could be turned into a demilitarized zone.

defs.def_en: To demilitarize an area means to ensure that all military forces are removed from it.

ext.ext_cn: 心智与身体绝不是分离的,它们形成了一个不可分割的整体。
ext.ext_en: Far from being separate, the mind and body form an indivisible whole.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is indivisible, you mean that it cannot be divided into different parts.

defs.def_cn: （在程度、速度、强度等上）缓和，减轻，减弱

ext.ext_cn: 雨小了。
ext.ext_en: The rain had eased up...

ext.ext_cn: 新的数据显示经济衰退可能有所缓和。
ext.ext_en: New figures indicate the recession may be easing up.

defs.def_en: If something eases up, it is reduced in degree, speed, or intensity.

ext.ext_cn: 他告诉支持者们即使眼下他在总统选举中领先也不要松懈。
ext.ext_en: He told supporters not to ease up even though he's leading in the presidential race...

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯蒂在最后10英里慢了下来，最终获得了第3名。
ext.ext_en: Christie was easing up over the last 10m to finish third.

defs.def_en: If you ease up, you start to make less effort.

ext.ext_cn: 主教练并不打算在一段时间内放松对队员的要求。
ext.ext_en: The manager does not intend to ease up on his players for some time...

ext.ext_cn: 官员们已经放松了对新闻界的限制。
ext.ext_en: Officials have eased up on the press restrictions.

defs.def_en: If you ease up on someone or something, your behaviour or attitude towards them becomes less severe or strict.

defs.def_cn: 以环作装饰的;带横纹的;带有环的

ext.ext_cn: 铁杆搭建的环形凉亭
ext.ext_en: ...a hooped arbour of iron rods.

ext.ext_cn: 红色横纹的袖子
ext.ext_en: ...red hooped sleeves.

defs.def_en: If something is hooped, it is decorated with hoops or horizontal stripes, or it contains hoops as part of its structure.

ext.ext_cn: 艾莉森已经聪明地推断出那封信就是我写的。
ext.ext_en: Alison had cleverly deduced that I was the author of the letter.

ext.ext_cn: 这份文件的日期可以从其中多次提到内战之处进行推断。
ext.ext_en: The date of the document can be deduced from references to the Civil War...

defs.def_en: If you deduce something or deduce that something is true, you reach that conclusion because of other things that you know to be true.

ext.ext_cn: 北约计划缩减派往该地区的士兵数量。
ext.ext_en: NATO plans to curtail the number of troops being sent to the region...

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉路易，一上年纪她的活动量就会减少。
ext.ext_en: I told Louie that old age would curtail her activities in time...

defs.def_en: If you curtail something, you reduce or limit it.

ext.ext_cn: 反种族主义示威

ext.ext_en: ...a old fashioned love story.

defs.def_en: Love is a very strong feeling of affection towards someone who you are romantically or sexually attracted to.

ext.ext_cn: 你决不会像疼爱自己的宝宝一样疼爱别人。
ext.ext_en: You'll never love anyone the way you love your baby.

defs.def_en: You  say that you love someone when their happiness is very important to you, so that you behave in a kind and caring way towards them.

ext.ext_cn: 我对自己所有孩子的爱都是无条件的。
ext.ext_en: My love for all my children is unconditional...

ext.ext_cn: 她很懂得如何去爱。
ext.ext_en: She's  got a great capacity for love.

defs.def_en: Love is the feeling that a person's happiness is very important to you, and the way you show this feeling in your behaviour towards them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们很喜欢这些食物，尤其是鱼。
ext.ext_en: We loved the food so much, especially the fish dishes...

ext.ext_cn: 我很爱读书。
ext.ext_en: I loved reading.

defs.def_en: If you love something, you like it very much.

ext.ext_cn: 我热爱我的祖国，就像你热爱你的祖国一样。
ext.ext_en: I love my country as you love yours.

defs.def_en: You can say that you love something when you consider that it is important and want to protect or support it.

ext.ext_cn: 靠这种办法想激起对文学的热爱是行不通的。
ext.ext_en: This is no way to encourage a love of literature...

ext.ext_cn: 法国人热爱自己的语言是出了名的。
ext.ext_en: The French are known for their love of their language.

defs.def_en: Love is a strong liking for something, or a belief that it is important.

ext.ext_cn: “她是我一生所爱，”他说道。
ext.ext_en: 'She is the love of my life,' he said...

ext.ext_cn: 音乐是我的至爱之一。
ext.ext_en: Music's one of my great loves.

defs.def_en: Your love is someone or something that you love.

ext.ext_cn: 我很乐意再次为英格兰队效力。
ext.ext_en: I would love to play for England again...

ext.ext_cn: 要是能洗个热水澡、换身干净的衣服就太好了。
ext.ext_en: I would love a hot bath and clean clothes...

defs.def_en: If you would love to have or do something, you very much want to have it or do it.

ext.ext_cn: 唔，那我就信你吧，亲爱的。
ext.ext_en: Well, I'll take your word for it then, love...

ext.ext_cn: 别哭，亲爱的。
ext.ext_en: Don't  cry, my love.

defs.def_en: Some people use love as an affectionate way of addressing someone.

ext.ext_cn: 他3比0直取奥地利的托马斯·蒙斯特。
ext.ext_en: He beat Thomas Muster of Austria three sets to love.

defs.def_en: In tennis, love is a score of zero.

defs.def_cn: （给朋友或亲人写信时结尾具名前的非正式用语）爱你（们）的

ext.ext_cn: 爱你的爷爷、奶奶
ext.ext_en: ...with love from Grandma and Grandpa.

defs.def_en: You can use expressions such as 'love', 'love from', and 'all my love', followed by your name, as an informal way of ending a letter to a friend or relation.

ext.ext_cn: 请代我问候她。
ext.ext_en: Please give her my love.

defs.def_en: If you send someone your love, you ask another person, who will soon be speaking or writing to them, to tell them that you are thinking about them with affection.

ext.ext_cn: 我爱上他，是因为他秉性善良。
ext.ext_en: I fell in love with him because of his kind nature...

ext.ext_cn: 我们疯狂地相爱了。
ext.ext_en: We fell madly in love.

defs.def_en: If you fall in love with someone, you start to be in love with them.

ext.ext_cn: 与福特的密切合作开始令我爱上了电影。
ext.ext_en: Working with Ford closely, I fell in love with the cinema.

defs.def_en: If you fall in love with something, you start to like it very much.

ext.ext_cn: 劳拉之前从来没有恋爱过。
ext.ext_en: Laura had never before been in love...

ext.ext_cn: 我从来没有真正爱上过谁。
ext.ext_en: I've  never really been in love with anyone...

defs.def_en: If you are in love with someone, you feel romantically or sexually attracted to them, and they are very important to you.

ext.ext_cn: 他一向热爱西部的迷人风光。
ext.ext_en: He had always been in love with the enchanted landscape of the West.

defs.def_en: If you are in love with something, you like it very much.

ext.ext_cn: 在一场日益严峻的危机面前，本应和睦共处、通力合作的这两个男人却势同水火。
ext.ext_en: There was no love lost between the two men who were supposed to be working in harmony on a mounting crisis.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is no love lost between two people or groups or there is little love lost between them, you mean that they do not like each other at all.

ext.ext_cn: 你和女孩有过云雨之欢吗？
ext.ext_en: Have you ever made love to a girl before?...

ext.ext_cn: 一天晚上，做了18个月的朋友之后，他们第一次也是最后一次上了床。
ext.ext_en: One night, after 18 months of friendship, they made love for the first and last time.

defs.def_en: When two people make love, they have sex.

ext.ext_cn: 替换零件怎么都找不到。
ext.ext_en: Replacement parts couldn't be found for love or money...

ext.ext_cn: 我不打算再回这里了，绝对不回了。
ext.ext_en: I'm not coming back up here. Never, for love nor money.

defs.def_en: If you cannot or will not do something for love or money, you are completely unable to do it or you do not intend to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一见钟情，他6周后就向我求婚了。
ext.ext_en: It was love at first sight, and he proposed to me six weeks later.

defs.def_en: Love at first sight is the experience of starting to be in love with someone as soon as you see them for the first time.

defs.def_cn: 微弱稳定的光；暗淡的光

ext.ext_cn: 香烟发出的红光
ext.ext_en: ...the cigarette's red glow...

ext.ext_cn: 冉冉升起的太阳在田野中洒下金色的阳光。
ext.ext_en: The rising sun casts a golden glow over the fields.

defs.def_en: A glow is a dull, steady light, for example the light produced by a fire when there are no flames.

ext.ext_cn: 涂了润肤霜，我的脸一整天都红润亮泽。
ext.ext_en: The moisturiser gave my face a healthy glow that lasted all day.

defs.def_en: A glow is a pink colour on a person's face, usually because they are healthy or have been exercising.

ext.ext_cn: 运动将让你体会到一种有所成就的无比喜悦感。
ext.ext_en: Exercise will give you a glow of satisfaction at having achieved something...

ext.ext_cn: 他为她取得的成绩深感自豪。
ext.ext_en: He felt a glow  of pride in what she had accomplished.

defs.def_en: If you feel a glow of satisfaction or achievement, you have a strong feeling of pleasure because of something that you have done or that has happened.

defs.def_cn: 发微弱而稳定的光；发暗淡的光

ext.ext_cn: 晚上点亮的灯笼在黑暗中发出柔和的光。
ext.ext_en: The night lantern glowed softly in the darkness...

ext.ext_cn: 甚至炉火上方的壁炉台都泛着白光。
ext.ext_en: Even the mantel above the fire glowed white.

defs.def_en: If something glows, it produces a dull, steady light.

defs.def_cn: 色彩鲜艳；绚丽夺目；洋溢着（某种特征）

ext.ext_cn: 这些颜色搭配使用会使你屋子里暖意融融，充满生机。
ext.ext_en: Used together these colours will make your interiors glow with warmth and vitality.

ext.ext_cn: 色彩绚丽、镶满金叶的木雕
ext.ext_en: ...carved wood bathed in glowing colors and gold leaf.

defs.def_en: If a place glows with a colour or a quality, it is bright, attractive, and colourful.

ext.ext_cn: 明亮的橙色灯光下，这些乐器闪闪发光。
ext.ext_en: The instruments glowed in the bright orange light...

ext.ext_cn: 树叶在秋日的晨曦中泛出红黄色的光。
ext.ext_en: The fall foliage glowed red and yellow in the morning sunlight.

defs.def_en: If something glows, it looks bright because it is reflecting light.

defs.def_cn: （皮肤由于健康、激动或运动）发红，泛红晕，容光焕发

ext.ext_cn: 她长有雀斑的皮肤又泛出了健康的红光。
ext.ext_en: Her freckled skin glowed with health again.

ext.ext_cn: 红润的面色
ext.ext_en: ...a glowing complexion.

defs.def_en: If someone's skin glows, it looks pink because they are healthy or excited, or have been doing physical exercise.

defs.def_cn: 洋溢着，散发出（某种情感）

ext.ext_cn: 埃米遇见的准妈妈们个个洋溢着自豪和喜悦。
ext.ext_en: The expectant mothers that Amy had encountered positively glowed with pride.

defs.def_en: If someone glows with an emotion such as pride or pleasure, the expression on their face shows how they feel.

ext.ext_cn: 失明
ext.ext_en: ...loss of sight...

ext.ext_cn: 政府收入每月大概减少2.5亿美元。
ext.ext_en: The loss of income for the government is about $250 million a month.

defs.def_en: Loss is the fact of no longer having something or having less of it than before.

ext.ext_cn: 伤亡惨重
ext.ext_en: ...a terrible loss of human life...

ext.ext_cn: 盟军伤亡人数不到20，而敌军则据说人员损失惨重。
ext.ext_en: The allies suffered less than 20 casualties while enemy losses were said to be high.

defs.def_en: Loss of life occurs when people die.

defs.def_cn: （亲人或朋友的）丧故，亡故，逝世

ext.ext_cn: 他们慢慢谈到了托马斯的死和悲痛给他们带来的影响。
ext.ext_en: They took the time to talk about the loss of Thomas and how their grief was affecting them.

ext.ext_cn: 他母亲的亡故
ext.ext_en: ...the loss of his mother.

defs.def_en: The loss of a relative or friend is their death.

ext.ext_cn: 1986年，路虎亏损9亿英镑。
ext.ext_en: In 1986 Rover made a loss of nine hundred million pounds...

ext.ext_cn: 由于持续亏损，该公司说它将在1990年停止生产化肥。
ext.ext_en: The company said it will stop producing fertilizer in 1990 because of continued losses.

defs.def_en: If a business makes a loss, it earns less than it spends.

ext.ext_cn: 把自己的失落和悲伤向他人倾诉。
ext.ext_en: Talk to others about your feelings of loss and grief...

ext.ext_cn: 他醒来时总是满怀哀愁，抑郁惆怅。
ext.ext_en: He always woke with a sense of deep sorrow and depressing loss.

defs.def_en: Loss is the feeling of sadness you experience when someone or something you like is taken away from you.

ext.ext_cn: 她说他的死对自己来说是巨大的损失。
ext.ext_en: She said his death was a great loss to herself.

defs.def_en: A loss is the disadvantage you suffer when a valuable and useful person or thing leaves or is taken away.

defs.def_cn: （热量、血液、液体等的）流失，散失，减少

ext.ext_cn: 失血
ext.ext_en: ...blood loss.

ext.ext_cn: 瘦身
ext.ext_en: ...weight loss.

defs.def_en: The loss of something such as heat, blood, or fluid is the gradual reduction of it or of its level in a system or in someone's body.

ext.ext_cn: 新款时装遇上销路不畅就要蚀本卖出。
ext.ext_en: New fashion designs have to be sold off at a loss if sales are poor.

defs.def_en: If a business produces something at a loss, they sell it at a price which is less than it cost them to produce it or buy it.

defs.def_cn: 茫然不知所措；不知如何是好

ext.ext_cn: 下一步该怎么做，我完全没谱。
ext.ext_en: I was at a loss for what to do next...

ext.ext_cn: 对于如何应对暴力问题，政府现在一筹莫展。
ext.ext_en: The government is at a loss to know how to tackle the violence.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are at a loss, you mean that you do not know what to do in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 董事们当断则断，承认自己选错了人，并且作了人员变更，这样做是正确的。
ext.ext_en: Directors are right to cut their losses, admit they chose the wrong man and make a change.

defs.def_en: If you cut your losses, you stop doing what you were doing in order to prevent the bad situation that you are in becoming worse.

ext.ext_cn: 筹办那类活动我毫无经验。我看我基本是个废物。
ext.ext_en: I'd had no experience of organizing anything of that sort. I think I was largely a dead loss.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is a dead loss, you have a low opinion of them because you think they are completely useless or unsuccessful.

defs.def_cn: 玷污，败坏，损害(名誉或形象)

ext.ext_cn: 这一事件可能有损首相的名誉。
ext.ext_en: The affair could tarnish the reputation of the prime minister...

ext.ext_cn: 他的形象因为那桩储蓄信贷丑闻而受损。
ext.ext_en: His image was tarnished by the savings and loan scandal.

defs.def_en: If you say that something tarnishes someone's reputation or image, you mean that it causes people to have a worse opinion of them than they would otherwise have had.

defs.def_cn: (使)有污迹;(使)失去光泽;(使)变暗淡

ext.ext_cn: 它从不生锈，也不会失去光泽。
ext.ext_en: It never rusts or tarnishes...

ext.ext_cn: 清洁银器时要戴上棉手套，因为你皮肤里的酸性物质会使它失去光泽。
ext.ext_en: Wear cotton gloves when cleaning silver, because the acid in your skin can tarnish the metal.

defs.def_en: If a metal tarnishes or if something tarnishes it, it becomes stained and loses its brightness.

ext.ext_cn: 戒指内侧有一层厚厚的锈斑。
ext.ext_en: The tarnish lay thick on the inside of the ring.

defs.def_en: Tarnish is a substance which forms of the surface of some metals and which stains them or causes them to lose their brightness.

defs.def_cn: (房屋的)居住权;(土地的)使用权，使用期

ext.ext_cn: 居住权得不到保证是许多家庭居无定所的一个原因。
ext.ext_en: Lack of security of tenure was a reason for many families becoming homeless.

defs.def_en: Tenure is the legal right to live in a particular building or to use a particular piece of land during a fixed period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 布什总统的三年任期
ext.ext_en: ...the three-year tenure of President Bush...

ext.ext_cn: 当时，他在牛津担任诗歌教授的聘期刚到一半，声誉正隆。
ext.ext_en: He was in the middle of his tenure as Oxford Professor of Poetry and at the height of his fame.

defs.def_en: Tenure is the period of time during which someone holds an important job.

ext.ext_cn: 初级职员得到终身职位的机会十分渺茫。
ext.ext_en: Junior staff have only a slim chance of getting tenure.

defs.def_en: If you have tenure in your job, you have the right to keep it until you retire.
A hostelry is a pub or a hotel.

ext.ext_cn: 在一篇有关版权的文章中，有一个短语引起了我的注意。
ext.ext_en: A phrase jumped out at me in a piece about copyright.

defs.def_en: If you say that something jumps out at you, you mean that it is easy to notice it because it is different from other things of its type.

defs.def_cn: 治理，管理（国家等）；施行，实施（法律、考核等）

ext.ext_cn: 该方案呼吁联合国来管理该国，直到能进行选举为止。
ext.ext_en: The plan calls for the UN to administer the country until elections can be held...

ext.ext_cn: 我们希望他们能主持正义，不偏不倚。
ext.ext_en: We hope that they're going to administer justice impartially...

defs.def_en: If someone administers something such as a country, the law, or a test, they take responsibility for organizing and supervising it.

ext.ext_cn: 护理人员们接受了配发某些药物的培训。
ext.ext_en: Paramedics are trained to administer certain drugs.

defs.def_en: If a doctor or a nurse administers a drug, they give it to a patient.

ext.ext_cn: 录像显示在斗殴中他打得最凶。
ext.ext_en: He is shown in the tape of the beating as administering most of the blows.

defs.def_en: If someone administers a punch or a kick, they punch or kick someone.
Wickerwork is the same as wicker .

defs.def_cn: (用作动词或介词宾语，与句子主语指代同一个人)我自己

ext.ext_cn: 我问自己在这种情况下我会怎么做。
ext.ext_en: I asked myself what I would have done in such a situation...

ext.ext_cn: 我看着镜子里的自己。
ext.ext_en: I looked at myself in the mirror...

defs.def_en: A speaker or writer uses myself to refer to himself or herself. Myself is used as the object of a verb or preposition when the subject refers to the same person.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调第一人称单数主语)我本人，我自己

ext.ext_cn: 我本人喜欢电影、诗歌、外出吃饭和远途散步。
ext.ext_en: I myself enjoy cinema, poetry, eating out and long walks...

ext.ext_cn: 我本人很喜欢蛋糕。
ext.ext_en: I'm fond of cake myself...

defs.def_en: You use myself to emphasize a first person singular subject. In more formal English, myself is sometimes used instead of 'me' as the object of a verb or preposition, for emphasis.

ext.ext_cn: “你从哪儿弄到那件刺绣品的？”——“我自己绣的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Where did you get that embroidery?' — 'I made it myself.'

defs.def_en: If you say something such as 'I did it myself', you are emphasizing that you did it, rather than anyone else.
A regatta is a sports event consisting of races between yachts or rowing boats.

ext.ext_cn: 供伤残人士使用的设施仍然匮乏。
ext.ext_en: Facilities for people with disabilities are still insufficient.

ext.ext_cn: 克服身体残疾从而攀上职业巅峰的运动员们
ext.ext_en: ...athletes who have overcome a physical disability to reach the top of their sport.

defs.def_en: A disability is a permanent injury, illness, or physical or mental condition that tends to restrict the way that someone can live their life.

ext.ext_cn: 残障人士会需要更多的财政资源。
ext.ext_en: Disability can make extra demands on financial resources.

defs.def_en: Disability is the state of being disabled.

defs.def_cn: 天秤宫，天秤座（黄道十二宫之一。出生于9月23日至10月22日之间的人属此星座）
defs.def_en: Libra is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac. Its symbol is a pair of scales. People who are born approximately between the 23rd of September and the 22nd of October come under this sign.

defs.def_cn: 出生于天秤宫时段的人
defs.def_en: A Libra is a person whose sign of the zodiac is Libra.
The value system of a group of people is the set of beliefs and attitudes that they all share.
Checkers is a game for two people, played with 24 round pieces on a board.

ext.ext_cn: 现代文字处理器通常带有拼写检查功能，有的还有语法检查功能。
ext.ext_en: Modern word processors usually have spelling checkers and even grammar checkers.

defs.def_en: A checker is a person or machine that has the job of checking something.

defs.def_cn: （帮助改善生活的）生命教练，人生导师
defs.def_en: A life coach is someone whose job involves helping people to improve their lives by doing challenging or worthwhile things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 男性的;有男子气概的;阳刚的

ext.ext_cn: 他希望他的儿子们能长得像他一样强壮、阳刚而又健美。
ext.ext_en: He wanted his sons to become strong, virile, and athletic like himself.

ext.ext_cn: 身材高大、体魄健壮、相貌粗犷英俊的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a tall, virile man with rugged good looks.

defs.def_en: If you describe a man as virile, you mean that he has the qualities that a man is traditionally expected to have, such as strength and sexual power.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 普罗科菲耶夫的最强劲有力的音乐
ext.ext_en: ...Prokofiev's  most virile, aggressive music.

ext.ext_cn: 克服困难的有力手段
ext.ext_en: ...a virile approach to difficulties.

defs.def_en: Something that is described as virile is considered to be very strong and forceful.

ext.ext_cn: 布莱克先生是位绅士，举止得体。
ext.ext_en: Mr Blake was a gent. He knew how to behave.

defs.def_en: Gent is an informal and old-fashioned word for gentleman .
People sometimes refer to a public toilet for men as the gents .

defs.def_cn: 先生们（非正式的诙谐用法，尤用于ladies and gents)

ext.ext_cn: 别只顾站着，女士们先生们，便宜货就要从你们的眼皮底下溜走喽。
ext.ext_en: Don't be left standing, ladies and gents, while a bargain slips past your eyes.

defs.def_en: Gents is used when addressing men in an informal, humorous way, especially in the expression 'ladies and gents'.

ext.ext_cn: 非常感谢您的来电。
ext.ext_en: Thank you very much for your call...

ext.ext_cn: 谢谢提供这个信息。
ext.ext_en: Thanks for the information...

defs.def_en: You use thank you or, in more informal English, thanks to express your gratitude when someone does something for you or gives you what you want.

defs.def_cn: 谢谢你，多谢(用于有礼貌地接受或拒绝)

ext.ext_cn: “塞科姆先生，你也想来一杯吧？”——“谢谢，简，我确实想来一杯。”
ext.ext_en: 'You'd like a cup as well, would you, Mr Secombe?' — 'Thank you, Jane, I'd love one.'...

ext.ext_cn: “要来支烟吗？”——“不了，谢谢。”
ext.ext_en: 'Would you like a cigarette?' — 'No thank you.'...

defs.def_en: You use thank you or, in more informal English, thanks to politely accept or refuse something that has just been offered to you.

defs.def_cn: 谢谢你，多谢(尤用于礼貌地感谢对方的回答或所说的令人开心的话)

ext.ext_cn: 警察冲她笑了笑，“这狗真漂亮。”——“哦，谢谢。”
ext.ext_en: The policeman smiled at her. 'Pretty dog.' — 'Oh well, thank you.'...

ext.ext_cn: “他的眼神呆滞？”——“还双眼圆睁，泪汪汪的。”——“谢谢！”
ext.ext_en: 'His eyes were glassy?' — 'And dilated. They were watery.' — 'Thank you.'...

defs.def_en: You use thank you or, in more informal English, thanks to politely acknowledge what someone has said to you, especially when they have answered your question or said something nice to you.

defs.def_cn: 谢谢，非常感谢(用于坚决回绝别人的帮助或表示不喜欢别人的举动)

ext.ext_cn: 我的茶我自己会搅，谢谢。
ext.ext_en: I can stir my own tea, thank you...

ext.ext_cn: 我们知道在哪儿能买到，谢谢。
ext.ext_en: We know where we can get it, thank you very much.

defs.def_en: You use thank you or thank you very much in order to say firmly that you do not want someone's help or to tell them that you do not like the way that they are behaving towards you.

ext.ext_cn: 我感谢他们长期以来忠诚的效力。
ext.ext_en: I thanked them for their long and loyal service...

ext.ext_cn: 判决书宣读完，加德纳夫人向法官们表示感谢。
ext.ext_en: When the decision was read out Mrs Gardner thanked the judges.

defs.def_en: When you thank someone for something, you express your gratitude to them for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们一边道谢，一边接过证书。
ext.ext_en: They accepted their certificates with words of thanks.

defs.def_en: When you express your thanks to someone, you express your gratitude to them for something.

ext.ext_cn: 感谢上帝赐给我们食物。
ext.ext_en: We give thanks for this food.

defs.def_en: When people give thanks, they thank God for something good that has happened.

ext.ext_cn: 原来我错了，感谢上帝。
ext.ext_en: I was wrong, thank God...

ext.ext_cn: 谢天谢地，我们可等到你了。
ext.ext_en: Thank heavens we have you here.

defs.def_en: You say 'Thank God', 'Thank Goodness', or 'Thank heavens' when you are very relieved about something.

ext.ext_cn: 我这条命多亏了她。
ext.ext_en: I have her to thank for my life...

ext.ext_cn: 这一切我都得感谢你才是。
ext.ext_en: For all this I have only you to thank.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have someone to thank for something, you mean that you are grateful to them because they caused it to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 又有许多赞助商找上门来，这要归功于这个委员会。
ext.ext_en: It is thanks to this committee that many new sponsors have come forward...

ext.ext_cn: 多亏近来的研究才有了有效的疗法。
ext.ext_en: Thanks to recent research, effective treatments are available.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens thanks to a particular person or thing, you mean that they are responsible for it happening or caused it to happen.

defs.def_cn: 并非由于…才(发生);并不归功于

ext.ext_cn: 净资产的确增长了，但这与政府无关。
ext.ext_en: It is no thanks to the Government that net assets did rise.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens no thanks to a particular person or thing, you mean that they did not help it to happen, or that it happened in spite of them.

ext.ext_cn: 一本薄薄的诗集
ext.ext_en: ...a slim volume of verse...

ext.ext_cn: 我因感动而写下了几句诗。
ext.ext_en: I have been moved to write a few lines of verse.

defs.def_en: See also:blank verse;Verse is writing arranged in lines which have rhythm and which often rhyme at the end.

defs.def_cn: 诗节;诗行；（歌曲的）段落;（《圣经》、《古兰经》等中的）节

ext.ext_cn: 这节诗描绘了春天来临的三个征兆。
ext.ext_en: This verse describes three signs of spring...

ext.ext_cn: 合唱团只唱了最后一首赞美诗的两个段落。
ext.ext_en: The choir has sung only two verses of the last hymn.

defs.def_en: A verse is one of the parts into which a poem, a song, or a chapter of the Bible or the Koran is divided.

defs.def_cn: 没有污渍的；没有污点的；没有疤痕的；没有斑点的

ext.ext_cn: 她的鞋仍然很白，没有任何污渍。
ext.ext_en: Her shoes are still white and unmarked.

defs.def_en: Something that is unmarked has no marks on it.

defs.def_cn: 没有标记的；没有标志的

ext.ext_cn: 他看见他们走出来，上了一辆没有标志的警车。
ext.ext_en: He had seen them come out and get into the unmarked police car...

ext.ext_cn: 他长眠在爱尔莫顿一处无名冢下。
ext.ext_en: He lies in an unmarked grave at Elmton.

defs.def_en: Something that is unmarked has no marking on it which identifies what it is or whose it is.

defs.def_cn: （球类比赛中）无人防守的，没被注意到的

ext.ext_cn: 9分钟后，谢林汉姆在无人防守的情况下接安德顿开出的任意球头球破门得分。
ext.ext_en: Sheringham was unmarked as he met Anderton's free kick and headed in after nine minutes.

defs.def_en: In a sport such as football, hockey, or basketball, if a player is unmarked, there are no players from the opposing team who are watching them in order to challenge them when they have control of the ball.

ext.ext_cn: 香肠土豆泥
ext.ext_en: ... bangers and mash.

defs.def_en: Bangers are sausages.

ext.ext_cn: 这辆破旧不堪的老爷车
ext.ext_en: ...this clapped-out old banger.

defs.def_en: You can describe a car as a banger if it is old and in very bad condition.
Bangers are fireworks that make a lot of noise.
Something or someone that is a turn-on is sexually exciting.

ext.ext_cn: 关于这两块大陆相似的假设是一种误解。
ext.ext_en: It is a misconception to assume that the two continents are similar...

ext.ext_cn: 如果包装精美，我们就会认为里面装的也是好东西。
ext.ext_en: If the package is wrapped well, we assume the contents are also wonderful...

defs.def_en: If you assume that something is true, you imagine that it is true, sometimes wrongly.

defs.def_cn: 掌管，夺取，取得（权力）；承担（责任）

ext.ext_cn: 克劳斯先生将出任首席执行官，手下有4位经理。
ext.ext_en: Mr Cross will assume the role of Chief Executive with a team of four directors...

ext.ext_cn: 如果没有主席，权力就会落入最极端的过激分子手中。
ext.ext_en: If there is no president, power will be assumed by the most extremist forces.

defs.def_en: If someone assumes power or responsibility, they take power or responsibility.

defs.def_cn: 呈现，具有，显露（某种特质）

ext.ext_cn: 在他的梦中，山有着至关重要的作用。
ext.ext_en: In his dreams, the mountains assumed enormous importance.

defs.def_en: If something assumes a particular quality, it begins to have that quality.

defs.def_cn: 表现出（某种表情）；装出，做出（某种样子）

ext.ext_cn: 他表现出一副高高在上的样子以获得自我满足。
ext.ext_en: He contented himself by assuming an air of superiority...

ext.ext_cn: 普吕以一种安慰人的语气说话。
ext.ext_en: Prue assumed a placatory tone of voice.

defs.def_en: If you assume a particular expression or way of behaving, you start to look or behave in this way.

ext.ext_cn: 倘若那些俱乐部真的赚了，那么球员就会获得一大笔奖金。
ext.ext_en: Let us assume those clubs actually win something. Then players will receive large bonuses...

ext.ext_cn: 暂且假设我是你的诉讼当事人。
ext.ext_en: Let's assume for a moment that I am a litigant in your court.

defs.def_en: See also:assuming;You can use let us assume or let's assume when you are considering a possible situation or event, so that you can think about the consequences.
A thunderstorm is a storm in which there is thunder and lightning and a lot of heavy rain.

ext.ext_cn: 合成材料制成的靴子通常可以机洗。
ext.ext_en: Boots made from synthetic materials can usually be washed in a machine.

ext.ext_cn: 合成橡胶
ext.ext_en: ...synthetic rubber.

defs.def_en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

defs.def_cn: 做手势；用手势表达；用动作示意

ext.ext_cn: 一个戴纸帽的男子在拼命地打手势。
ext.ext_en: A man with a paper hat upon his head was gesticulating wildly...

ext.ext_cn: 那位建筑师在指着地上的一个洞打手势。
ext.ext_en: The architect was gesticulating at a hole in the ground.

defs.def_en: If you gesticulate, you make movements with your arms or hands, often while you are describing something that is difficult to express in words.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (商品或服务)价廉质次的，下品的，低档的

ext.ext_cn: 低俗的电视剧
ext.ext_en: ...downmarket television drama...

ext.ext_cn: 这家饭馆档次很低，大约有60个座位。
ext.ext_en: It is a downmarket eating house, seating about 60.

defs.def_en: If you describe a product or service as downmarket, you think that they are cheap and are not very good in quality.
Amir means the same as emir .

ext.ext_cn: 我说过我那天下午要去购物。
ext.ext_en: I remarked that I would go shopping that afternoon...

ext.ext_cn: “某些人钱多但无头脑，”温斯顿曾经评论道。
ext.ext_en: 'Some people have more money than sense,' Winston had remarked...

defs.def_en: If you remark that something is the case, you say that it is the case.

ext.ext_cn: 她对英国关于大麻的立法进行了大胆评论。
ext.ext_en: She has made outspoken remarks about the legalisation of cannabis in Britain...

ext.ext_cn: 杰夫·库克近来关于没有什么人是不可缺少的那番话当然也包括他。
ext.ext_en: Geoff Cooke's recent remark that no one is indispensable will certainly not have escaped him.

defs.def_en: If you make a remark about something, you say something about it.

defs.def_cn: 麻木迟钝的人;毫无生气的人;无精打采的人

ext.ext_cn: 我什么也不想做，就是呆坐在家里，过着百无聊赖的生活。我完全变成了行尸走肉。
ext.ext_en: I didn't want to do anything, I just sat at home and vegetated. I became a total zombie...

ext.ext_cn: 不睡觉的话，工作起来会变得反应迟钝。
ext.ext_en: Without sleep you will become a zombie at work.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone as a zombie if their face or behaviour shows no feeling, understanding, or interest in what is going on around them.

defs.def_cn: （恐怖故事或某些宗教中的）僵尸，还魂尸
defs.def_en: In horror stories and some religions, a zombie is a dead person who has been brought back to life.

defs.def_cn: 浪费，挥霍(金钱、资源、机遇等)

ext.ext_cn: 胡克没有将自己的钱浪费在豪华轿车或其他恶习上。
ext.ext_en: Hooker didn't squander his money on flashy cars or other vices...

ext.ext_cn: 他白白浪费了获胜的机会。
ext.ext_en: He had squandered his chances to win.

defs.def_en: If you squander money, resources, or opportunities, you waste them.

ext.ext_cn: 十多年的内战结束之后的过渡时期
ext.ext_en: ...a transitional period following more than a decade of civil war...

ext.ext_cn: 我们仍然处于新旧方法的过渡阶段。
ext.ext_en: We are still in the transitional stage between the old and new methods.

defs.def_en: A transitional period is one in which things are changing from one state to another.

ext.ext_cn: 主要叛乱集团已同意参加会议讨论建立一个过渡政府。
ext.ext_en: The main rebel groups have agreed to join in a meeting to set up a transitional government.

defs.def_en: Transitional is used to describe something that happens or exists during a transitional period.

defs.def_cn: (匆忙或不尽如人意地)增添，附加

ext.ext_cn: 儿童保育款项将被追加到参议院正在审议的预算方案中。
ext.ext_en: The childcare bill is to be tacked on to the budget plan now being worked out in the Senate.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is tacked on to something else, you think that it is added in a hurry and in an unsatisfactory way.

defs.def_cn: 预示;是…的征兆;表示;是…的标志

ext.ext_cn: 眼睛充血表明压力过大、身心疲惫。
ext.ext_en: Red eyes denote strain and fatigue...

ext.ext_cn: 有了一条留言，这表示有人已先于她到了这儿。
ext.ext_en: There was a message waiting, denoting that someone had been here ahead of her.

defs.def_en: If one thing denotes another, it is a sign or indication of it.

ext.ext_cn: 在图 24 中，D 代表需求量而 S 代表供应量。
ext.ext_en: In figure 24 'D' denotes quantity demanded and 'S' denotes quantity supplied.

defs.def_en: What a symbol denotes is what it represents.

ext.ext_cn: 中世纪时，drab（“本色布”）一词指的是一种农民用来制衣的非常普通的羊毛织物。
ext.ext_en: In the Middle Ages the term 'drab' denoted a very simple type of woollen cloth which was used by peasants to make their clothes.

defs.def_en: What a word or name denotes is what it means or refers to.

ext.ext_cn: 他掏出枪来，走进房子。
ext.ext_en: He produced a gun and he came into the house...

ext.ext_cn: 市中心的贫民区充斥着滥用枪支、犯罪、吸毒和贫困问题。
ext.ext_en: The inner-city has guns and crime and drugs and deprivation.

defs.def_en: A gun is a weapon from which bullets or other things are fired.

ext.ext_cn: 发令枪响了，他们冲了出去。
ext.ext_en: The starting gun blasted and they were off.

defs.def_en: A gun or a starting gun is an object like a gun that is used to make a noise to signal the start of a race.

defs.def_cn: 把…发动起来；给…加大油门；使加速

ext.ext_cn: 他发动引擎，驱车而去。
ext.ext_en: He gunned his engine and drove off.

defs.def_en: To gun an engine or a vehicle means to make it start or go faster by pressing on the accelerator pedal.

ext.ext_cn: 公司鼓足了劲要大干一番。
ext.ext_en: The company came out with guns blazing.

defs.def_en: If you come out with guns blazing or with all guns blazing, you put all your effort and energy into trying to achieve something.

ext.ext_cn: 这本书定于9月10号发行，但是一些书商已抢先一步，决定提前销售。
ext.ext_en: It wasn't due to be released until September 10, but some booksellers have jumped the gun and decided to sell it early.

defs.def_en: If you jump the gun, you do something before everyone else or before the proper or right time.

defs.def_cn: 坚持自己的立场；固执己见；一意孤行

ext.ext_cn: 他本应坚持己见，拒绝与她会面。
ext.ext_en: He should have stuck to his guns and refused to meet her.

defs.def_en: If you stick to your guns, you continue to have your own opinion about something even though other people are trying to tell you that you are wrong.

defs.def_cn: 使用不当;误用;滥用；盗用

ext.ext_cn: 盗用权力和特权
ext.ext_en: ...the misuse of power and privilege...

ext.ext_cn: 滥用公共基金
ext.ext_en: ...a misuse of public funds...

defs.def_en: The misuse of something is incorrect, careless, or dishonest use of it.

defs.def_cn: 对…使用不当;误用;滥用;盗用

ext.ext_cn: 如果小偷盗用你的信用卡，你的卡会立即受到保护。
ext.ext_en: You are protected instantly if a thief misuses your credit card...

ext.ext_cn: 她滥用职权，任命了26,000名党羽在政府部门工作。
ext.ext_en: She misused her position in the appointment of 26,000 party supporters to government jobs.

defs.def_en: If someone misuses something, they use it incorrectly, carelessly, or dishonestly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他脸上极其痛苦的表情
ext.ext_en: ...the agonised look on his face.

defs.def_en: Agonized describes something that you say or do when you are in great physical or mental pain.

ext.ext_cn: 简短的葬礼悼词
ext.ext_en: ...a brief funeral oration.

defs.def_en: An oration is a formal speech made in public.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (裙子或裤子)喇叭形的，阔腿的

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪70年代的时候他们人人都有喇叭裤。
ext.ext_en: In the 1970s they all had flared trousers.

defs.def_en: Flared skirts or trousers are wider at the bottom or at the end of the legs than at the top.
A Doctor of Philosophy is someone who has a PhD .

ext.ext_cn: 来自销售税的收入下降了。
ext.ext_en: Income from sales tax went down...

ext.ext_cn: 犯罪率下降了70%。
ext.ext_en: Crime has gone down 70 percent...

defs.def_en: If a price, level, or amount goes down, it becomes lower or less than it was.

ext.ext_cn: 我跪了下来，祈求得到指引。
ext.ext_en: I went down on my knees and prayed for guidance.

defs.def_en: If you go down on your knees or on all fours, you lower your body until it is supported by your knees, or by your hands and knees.

ext.ext_cn: 他们以1比2输给了澳大利亚队。
ext.ext_en: They went down 2-1 to Australia.

defs.def_en: In sport, if a person or team goes down, they are defeated in a match or contest.

ext.ext_cn: 本赛季末只有两支队伍降级。
ext.ext_en: Only two go down at the end of this season.

defs.def_en: In sport, if a team goes down, they move to a lower division in a league.

ext.ext_cn: 律师告诫当事人穿戴整洁会赢得地方法官的好感。
ext.ext_en: Solicitors advised their clients that a tidy look went down well with the magistrates.

defs.def_en: If you say that a remark, idea, or type of behaviour goes down in a particular way, you mean that it gets a particular kind of reaction from a person or group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 天空中落日的余晖
ext.ext_en: ...the glow left in the sky after the sun has gone down.

defs.def_en: When the sun goes down, it goes below the horizon.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的飞机在一次训练中坠毁。
ext.ext_en: Their aircraft went down during a training exercise.

defs.def_en: If a ship goes down, it sinks. If a plane goes down, it crashes out of the sky.

ext.ext_cn: 这几台主要的电脑有30分钟没能正常运行。
ext.ext_en: The main computers went down for 30 minutes.

defs.def_en: If a computer goes down, it stops functioning temporarily.

ext.ext_cn: “发生什么事了？你知道吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'What's going down? Any ideas?'

defs.def_en: To go down means to happen.
If you can passivize a verb or clause, or if it can passivize, you can put the verb in the passive voice.

defs.def_cn: (表示愤怒或不耐烦)该死，可恶，他妈的

ext.ext_cn: 别不当回事，该死！这可不是闹着玩儿的事。
ext.ext_en: Don't be flippant, damn it! This is serious.

defs.def_en: Damn ,damn it, and dammit are used by some people to express anger or impatience.

defs.def_cn: (用于加强语气)该死的，可恶的，十足的，完全的

ext.ext_cn: 现在你对此做什么都完全无济于事。
ext.ext_en: There's not a damn thing you can do about it now.

ext.ext_cn: 结果证明我百分百正确。
ext.ext_en: As it turned out, I was damn right...

defs.def_en: Damn is used by some people to emphasize what they are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 她在其中大力鞭挞该极右党派的耸人听闻的书
ext.ext_en: ...a sensational book in which she damns the ultra-right party.

ext.ext_cn: 谴责巧克力广告企划人员在宣传中以女性为目标人群的一份报告
ext.ext_en: ...a report damning the chocolate advertising people for targeting women in their campaigns.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or a news report damns something such as a policy or action, you mean that they are very critical of it.
If you say that someone does not give a damn about something, you are emphasizing that they do not care about it at all.

ext.ext_cn: 我当时都快要疯了。
ext.ext_en: I damn near went crazy...

ext.ext_cn: 那几乎是每个有过生活经历的女人都必须要自己回答的问题。
ext.ext_en: That's a question damn near every woman who ever lived has had to answer for herself.

defs.def_en: People use damn near to emphasize that what they are saying is not actually true, but is very close to being true.

ext.ext_cn: 这几乎没什么分别。
ext.ext_en: It's as near as damn it the same thing...

ext.ext_cn: 体育场里将几乎空无一人。
ext.ext_en: The stadium will be as near as dammit empty.

defs.def_en: Some people say as near as damn it or as near as dammit to emphasize that what they have said is almost completely accurate, but not quite.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一些南非国家的脆弱经济可能会被彻底破坏，无法挽回。
ext.ext_en: The fragile economies of several southern African nations could be irreparably damaged...

ext.ext_cn: 首相领导的脆弱的政府处在瓦解边缘。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister's fragile government was on the brink of collapse...

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as fragile, you mean that it is weak or uncertain, and unlikely to be able to resist strong pressure or attack.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他仰靠在那把摇摇晃晃的椅子上。
ext.ext_en: He leaned back in his fragile chair.

defs.def_en: Something that is fragile is easily broken or damaged.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 发型突出了她的精致之美。
ext.ext_en: The haircut emphasised her fragile beauty.

defs.def_en: Something that is fragile is very delicate or fine in appearance.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他感到恼火和莫名其妙的虚弱，仿佛经历了一场重感冒，正在康复。
ext.ext_en: He felt irritated and strangely fragile, as if he were recovering from a severe bout of flu.

defs.def_en: If someone feels fragile, they feel weak, for example because they are ill or have drunk too much alcohol.

defs.def_cn: 焦耳（物理学中能量或功的单位）
defs.def_en: In physics, a joule is a unit of energy or work.

ext.ext_cn: 他是剧院的常客。
