ext.ext_cn: 爆炸是由甲烷气囊被引燃造成的。
ext.ext_en: The blasts were caused by pockets of methane gas that ignited.

defs.def_en: When you ignite something or when it ignites, it starts burning or explodes.

ext.ext_cn: 曾经有一位老师真正激起了我对文字的兴趣。
ext.ext_en: There was one teacher who really ignited my interest in words...

ext.ext_cn: 最近该地区的战斗可能激发边境以外整个地区的激动情绪。
ext.ext_en: The recent fighting in the area could ignite regional passions far beyond the borders.

defs.def_en: If something or someone ignites your feelings, they cause you to have very strong feelings about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 凉的;凉爽的;温度不高的

ext.ext_cn: 我感觉到一阵凉风。
ext.ext_en: I felt a current of cool air...

ext.ext_cn: 这水比小孩的洗澡水稍微凉一些。
ext.ext_en: The water was slightly cooler than a child's bath...

defs.def_en: Something that is cool has a temperature which is low but not very low.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 谢天谢地，这里面挺凉快。
ext.ext_en: Thank goodness it's cool in here...

ext.ext_cn: 将粮食和谷物储存在阴凉干燥的地方。
ext.ext_en: Store grains and cereals in a cool, dry place.

defs.def_en: If it is cool, or if a place is cool, the temperature of the air is low but not very low.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在热天里，应该穿凉快舒适的衣服。
ext.ext_en: In warm weather, you should wear clothing that is cool and comfortable.

defs.def_en: Clothing that is cool is made of thin material so that you do not become too hot in hot weather.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 选择冷色系，比如乳白色。
ext.ext_en: Choose a cool colour such as cream...

ext.ext_cn: 客厅是冷色调的银绿色。
ext.ext_en: The drawing-room was a cool silver green.

defs.def_en: Cool colours are light colours which give an impression of coolness.

ext.ext_cn: 把肉沥干水，让它冷却。
ext.ext_en: Drain the meat and allow it to cool...

ext.ext_cn: 必须用巨大的风扇来冷却混凝土地面，将其温度控制在150度以下。
ext.ext_en: Huge fans will have to cool the concrete floor to keep it below 150 degrees.

defs.def_en: When something cools or when you cool it, it becomes lower in temperature.

ext.ext_cn: 几分钟之内，火气就变小了。
ext.ext_en: Within a few minutes tempers had cooled...

ext.ext_cn: 他奇怪的举动使得她的激情冷却。
ext.ext_en: His weird behaviour had cooled her passion.

defs.def_en: When a feeling or emotion cools, or when you cool it, it becomes less powerful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人、行为等)冷静的，沉着的，泰然自若的

ext.ext_cn: 他又变得出奇地冷静，微笑着，好像什么也没有发生过。
ext.ext_en: He was marvelously cool again, smiling as if nothing had happened...

ext.ext_cn: 听了那句话，雷诺失去了冷静。
ext.ext_en: At that, Reno lost her cool composure.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or their behaviour is cool, you mean that they are calm and unemotional, especially in a difficult situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人、行为等)冷漠的，冷淡的，不友善的

ext.ext_cn: 我一点也不喜欢他，觉得他冷漠、孤僻而且傲慢。
ext.ext_en: I didn't like him at all. I thought he was cool, aloof, and arrogant...

ext.ext_cn: 人们对这个想法反应冷淡。
ext.ext_en: The idea met with a cool response...

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or their behaviour is cool, you mean that they are unfriendly or not enthusiastic.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人、行为等)酷的，时尚的，吸引人的

ext.ext_cn: 他竭力想扮酷，赶时髦。
ext.ext_en: He was trying to be really cool and trendy.

ext.ext_cn: 认为吸食海洛因很酷的一个15岁的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...some 15-year-old kid who thinks it's cool to do heroin.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or their behaviour is cool, you mean that they are fashionable and attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坦然接受的;心平气和的

ext.ext_cn: 贝芙对这一切都表现得相当平静。
ext.ext_en: Bev was really cool about it all.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is cool about something, you mean that they accept it and are not angry or upset about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 非常好的;特别棒的;绝妙的

ext.ext_cn: 凯瑟琳给了我一件非常漂亮的衣服。
ext.ext_en: Kathleen gave me a really cool dress.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is cool, you think it is very good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指轻易得到的数额)巨大的，整整

ext.ext_cn: 哥伦比亚唱片公司最近以3,000万美元的高价再次签下这个乐队。
ext.ext_en: Columbia recently resigned the band for a cool $30 million.

defs.def_en: You can use cool to emphasize that an amount or figure is very large, especially when it has been obtained easily.

ext.ext_cn: 你们能不能冷静一下？
ext.ext_en: Can't you guys just cool it?

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to cool it, you want them to stop being angry and aggressive and to behave more calmly.

ext.ext_cn: 她保持着冷静与克制，努力使自己走出了这次痛苦的经历。
ext.ext_en: She kept her cool and managed to get herself out of the ordeal...

ext.ext_cn: 那个高大的爱尔兰人快要失去冷静了。
ext.ext_en: The big Irishman was on the verge of losing his cool.

defs.def_en: If you keep your cool in a difficult situation, you manage to remain calm. If you lose your cool, you get angry or upset.

ext.ext_cn: 如果让你生气的人也在生你的气，而你还要假装冷静，那就太可笑了。
ext.ext_en: It's ridiculous to play it cool if someone you're mad about is mad about you too.

defs.def_en: If you play it cool, you deliberately behave in a calm, unemotional way because you do not want people to know you are enthusiastic or angry about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （动作）文雅的;（人）娇小的，秀丽的;（物）小巧的，精致的

ext.ext_cn: 这些女孩子娇美温柔。
ext.ext_en: The girls were dainty and feminine.

ext.ext_cn: 娇艳的粉色花朵
ext.ext_en: ...dainty pink flowers.

defs.def_en: If you describe a movement, person, or object as dainty, you mean that they are small, delicate, and pretty.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 表示谴责的;责怪的;责备的

ext.ext_cn: “马屁精，”她饱含嘲弄和责备地看了他一眼，说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Flatterer,' she said giving him a mock reproving look.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a reproving look or speak in a reproving voice, you show or say that you think they have behaved in a wrong or foolish way.
In former times, the squire of an English village was the man who owned most of the land in it.

defs.def_cn: 先生(有些男性对不相识的同性友好的尊称)

ext.ext_cn: 运气真差，先生。
ext.ext_en: Hard luck, squire.

defs.def_en: Some men use squire to address a man they do not know in a friendly but respectful way.
Diphtheria is a dangerous infectious disease which causes fever and difficulty in breathing and swallowing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (问题、情况、任务)艰难的，难处理的;棘手的

ext.ext_cn: 因此，汽车制造商面临着怎样向新顾客树立产品形象的大难题。
ext.ext_en: So car makers are faced with the ticklish problem of how to project products at new buyers.

defs.def_en: A ticklish problem, situation, or task is difficult and needs to be dealt with carefully.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这种按摩法不推荐给怕痒的人使用。
ext.ext_en: This massage method is not recommended for anyone who is very ticklish.

defs.def_en: Someone who is ticklish is sensitive to being tickled, and laughs as soon as you tickle them.

defs.def_cn: (表示某事物的特点)能够，可以

ext.ext_cn: 在肉类中,猪肉的做法也是最多的,可以整块烤来吃,也可以切片烤来吃。
ext.ext_en: Pork is also the most versatile of meats. It can be roasted whole or in pieces...

ext.ext_cn: 所幸的是,铁可以再加工,次品、废品不必被扔掉。
ext.ext_en: Luckily, iron can be reworked and mistakes don't have to be thrown away...

defs.def_en: You use can when you are mentioning a quality or fact about something which people may make use of if they want to.

defs.def_cn: (表示有能力或机会)能，会，可以

ext.ext_cn: 你别担心我,我能照顾好自己。
ext.ext_en: Don't worry yourself about me, I can take care of myself...

ext.ext_cn: 我没办法给你提供细节,因为我并不了解任何细节。
ext.ext_en: I can't give you details because I don't actually have any details...

defs.def_en: You use can to indicate that someone has the ability or opportunity to do something.

defs.def_cn: (用于否定句，表示情况不允许)不能，无法

ext.ext_cn: 看不起电影或听不起音乐会的人可以去观看足球赛。
ext.ext_en: People who can't afford to go to the theatre or concerts can afford to go to football matches...

ext.ext_cn: 一个星期才20美元,不够我们吃穿、付房租及水电等费用的。
ext.ext_en: We cannot buy food, clothes and pay for rent and utilities on $20 a week...

defs.def_en: You use cannot to indicate that someone is not able to do something because circumstances make it impossible for them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 有可能持续5年乃至更长时间的长期治疗。
ext.ext_en: ...long-term therapy that can last five years or more...

ext.ext_cn: 对于业余博物学者来说,在一片空地上或被炸后的废墟里可能发现种类繁多的植物群和动物群。
ext.ext_en: A vacant lot or a bombsite can, to the amateur naturalist, produce an extraordinary variety of flora and fauna...

defs.def_en: You use can to indicate that something is true sometimes or is true in some circumstances.

defs.def_cn: (用于否定句，表示确信某事不真实或不会发生)不可能，不会

ext.ext_cn: 根据她对道格拉斯习性的了解,她敢断定他不可能是那个袭击者。
ext.ext_en: From her knowledge of Douglas's habits, she feels sure that the attacker can't have been Douglas...

ext.ext_cn: 情况不会糟到那个地步。
ext.ext_en: Things can't be that bad...

defs.def_en: You use cannot and can't to state that you are certain that something is not the case or will not happen.

ext.ext_cn: 你必须先购买信用人寿保险,方可购买伤残保险。
ext.ext_en: You must buy the credit life insurance before you can buy the disability insurance...

ext.ext_cn: 任何人若想成立废品处理公司,必须证明其拥有足够资金和受训员工以保证工作可以顺利开展。
ext.ext_en: No-one can set up a waste disposal company unless they can show that they've got enough money and trained staff to do the job properly...

defs.def_en: You use can to indicate that someone is allowed to do something. You use cannot or can't to indicate that someone is not allowed to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 这种情况忍无可忍,不能再任其继续下去了。
ext.ext_en: It is an intolerable situation and it can't be allowed to go on...

ext.ext_cn: 委员会对瑞典的要求不能比对自己的会员国要求都多。
ext.ext_en: The Commission can't demand from Sweden more than it demands from its own members.

defs.def_en: You use cannot or can't when you think it is very important that something should not happen or that someone should not do something.

defs.def_cn: (通常用于疑问句，表示建议或提议帮忙)能

ext.ext_cn: 我在这儿能做点儿什么?
ext.ext_en: What can I do around here?...

ext.ext_cn: 我看见这位老太太正颤巍巍地下火车,就问:“嗯,我来帮您一把吗?”
ext.ext_en: This old lady was struggling out of the train and I said, 'Oh, can I help you?'...

defs.def_en: You use can, usually in questions, in order to make suggestions or to offer to do something.

defs.def_cn: (用于疑问句时,can 表示礼貌的请求，而 can't 表示强烈请求）

ext.ext_cn: 我能不能看一眼那个?
ext.ext_en: Can I have a look at that?...

ext.ext_cn: 请你帮个忙好吗?
ext.ext_en: Can you please help?...

defs.def_en: You use can in questions in order to make polite requests. You use can't in questions in order to request strongly that someone does something.

defs.def_cn: (用于有礼貌地打断,或引导要说的话)能,可以

ext.ext_cn: 我能不能打断你们一下?
ext.ext_en: Can I interrupt you just for a minute?...

ext.ext_cn: 对不起,乔,我插一句,可我认为在座的没有谁在埋怨你。
ext.ext_en: But if I can interrupt, Joe, I don't think anybody here is personally blaming you...

defs.def_en: You use can as a polite way of interrupting someone or of introducing what you are going to say next.

defs.def_cn: (与 imagine, think, believe 等动词连用,用来加强语气)能

ext.ext_cn: 你能想象得出来,他当时心里乱得要命。
ext.ext_en: You can imagine he was terribly upset...

ext.ext_cn: 你都想象不到,我看到他们全都走了,心里是多么高兴。
ext.ext_en: You can't think how glad I was to see them all go...

defs.def_en: You use can with verbs such as 'imagine', 'think', and 'believe' in order to emphasize how you feel about a particular situation.

defs.def_cn: (与 how 一起用于疑问句,表示感受强烈)能,能够

ext.ext_cn: 你怎么能抱怨税费的提高呢?
ext.ext_en: How can you complain about higher taxes?...

ext.ext_cn: 几百万美元怎么可能不翼而飞呢?
ext.ext_en: How can millions of dollars go astray?...

defs.def_en: You use can in questions with 'how' to indicate that you feel strongly about something.

defs.def_cn: (盛放食品、饮料或油漆的)罐子，金属罐，听

ext.ext_cn: 几个青年人踢着一个锡罐在路中间走着。
ext.ext_en: Several young men were kicking a tin can along the middle of the road.

ext.ext_cn: 空啤酒罐
ext.ext_en: ...empty beer cans.

defs.def_en: A can is a metal container in which something such as food, drink, or paint is put. The container is usually sealed to keep the contents fresh.

ext.ext_cn: 将要装罐、去皮、切块或用其他方法加工的水果和蔬菜
ext.ext_en: ...fruits and vegetables that will be canned, skinned, diced or otherwise processed...

ext.ext_cn: 星期天午餐总是吃烤羔羊肉和豌豆罐头。
ext.ext_en: It was always roast lamb and canned peas for Sunday lunch.

defs.def_en: When food or drink is canned, it is put into a metal container and sealed so that it will remain fresh.
The can is the toilet.

ext.ext_cn: 极端主义分子猖獗,致使安全部长被解职。
ext.ext_en: The extremists prevailed, and the security minister was canned...

ext.ext_cn: 我被开除后,就拿了这些钥匙作为纪念。
ext.ext_en: When I got canned, I took these keys as souvenirs.

defs.def_en: If you are canned, you are dismissed from your job.

defs.def_cn: 承担所有指责;代人受过

ext.ext_cn: 我们这是豪华饭店;如果客人用餐不愉快,背黑锅的就是我们。
ext.ext_en: We are a luxury restaurant and if people have a bad experience, we have to carry the can.

defs.def_en: If you have to carry the can, you have to take all the blame for something.

ext.ext_cn: 又干完了一天的活,菲利普满心愉悦地离开了广袤的乡村,前往自己位于伦敦的公寓。
ext.ext_en: With another day's work in the can, Philip is happy to leave the open countryside and head for his London flat.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a job that you are doing is in the can, you mean that it is completely finished.
Pips are the small hard seeds in a fruit such as an apple, orange, or pear.

ext.ext_cn: 失利者仍有可能在争夺半决赛权时被西德队击败。
ext.ext_en: It's still possible for the losers to be pipped by West Germany for a semi-final place...

ext.ext_cn: 她击败女演员梅丽尔·斯特里普，拿到了这个角色。
ext.ext_en: She pipped actress Meryl Streep to the part.

defs.def_en: If someone is pipped to something such as a prize or an award, they are defeated by only a small amount.
In Britain, the pips on the radio are a series of short, high-pitched sounds that are used as a time signal.

defs.def_cn: （英国公用电话提示需要投入硬币时的）嘟嘟声
defs.def_en: In Britain, when you make a telephone call from a public telephone, the pips are a signal that you need to put in more money.

defs.def_cn: （在竞赛等中）于最后一刻击败，险胜

ext.ext_cn: 我不希望我们在最后一刻落败。
ext.ext_en: I didn't want us to be pipped to the post.

defs.def_en: If someone is pipped at the post or pipped to the post they are just beaten in a competition or in a race to achieve something.

ext.ext_cn: 他完全被电视上的帕瓦罗蒂迷住了。
ext.ext_en: He was absolutely mesmerised by Pavarotti on television...

ext.ext_cn: 珀尔身上有什么东西吸引住了她。
ext.ext_en: There was something about Pearl that mesmerised her.

defs.def_en: If you are mesmerized by something, you are so interested in it or so attracted to it that you cannot think about anything else.

defs.def_cn: (两层楼之间的)夹层楼面,夹楼

ext.ext_cn: 位于夹层的餐厅
ext.ext_en: ...the dining room on the mezzanine.

ext.ext_cn: 夹楼层
ext.ext_en: ...the mezzanine floor.

defs.def_en: A mezzanine is a small floor which is built between two main floors of a building.

defs.def_cn: (剧院的)最底层楼厅;最底层楼厅的前座
defs.def_en: The mezzanine is the lowest balcony in a theatre, or the front rows in the lowest balcony.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 作者是一位经验丰富的学者。
ext.ext_en: The author is a seasoned academic...

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名久经历练的表演者，他满怀自信地开始演出。
ext.ext_en: He began acting with the confidence of a seasoned performer.

defs.def_en: You can use seasoned to describe a person who has a lot of experience of something. For example, a seasoned traveller is a person who has travelled a lot.

ext.ext_cn: 事实证明，向多党民主制的转型非常艰难。
ext.ext_en: The transition to a multi-party democracy is proving to be difficult.

ext.ext_cn: 过渡时期
ext.ext_en: ...a period of transition.

defs.def_en: Transition is the process in which something changes from one state to another.

defs.def_cn: (从某一状态或活动)转变，过渡(到另一状态或活动)

ext.ext_cn: 随着我们由安全议题转向具有挑战性的经济议题，讨论最多的就是目前需要做些什么。
ext.ext_en: Most of the discussion was on what needed to be done now as we transitioned from the security issues to the challenging economic issues...

ext.ext_cn: 随着公司向知识产权公司转型，其业务规模显著下降。
ext.ext_en: There was a significant decline in the size of the business as the company transitioned to an intellectual property company.

defs.def_en: If someone transitions from one state or activity to another, they move gradually from one to the other.

ext.ext_cn: 算命是一种非常低级的把戏，充满了迷信色彩。
ext.ext_en: Fortune-telling is a very much debased art surrounded by superstition...

ext.ext_cn: 旋转木马的幽灵只不过是当地的迷信说法。
ext.ext_en: The phantom of the merry-go-round is just a local superstition.

defs.def_en: Superstition is belief in things that are not real or possible, for example magic.

ext.ext_cn: 它错误太多,所以毫无用处。
ext.ext_en: It contained so many errors as to render it worthless.

ext.ext_cn: 不锈钢葡萄酒桶的出现使木制酒桶制造者没了生意
ext.ext_en: ...barrel-makers whose trade was rendered obsolete by the introduction of stainless steel wine vats.

defs.def_en: You can use render with an adjective that describes a particular state to say that someone or something is changed into that state. For example, if someone or something makes a thing harmless, you can say that they render it harmless.

ext.ext_cn: 他有了一个为国服务的机会。
ext.ext_en: He had a chance to render some service to his country...

ext.ext_cn: 无论给予他何种帮助，他都会非常感激。
ext.ext_en: Any assistance you can render him will be appreciated...

defs.def_en: If you render someone help or service, you help them.

defs.def_cn: 宣布，作出(判决、决定或回应)

ext.ext_cn: 董事会迟迟未能作出决定。
ext.ext_en: The Board had been slow to render its verdict.

defs.def_en: When a jury or authority renders a verdict, decision, or response, they announce it.

ext.ext_en: Rabbits still manage to find a way in. I am sure that some have even taken to gnawing through the metal.

defs.def_en: To cut through something means to cut it in two pieces or to make a hole in it.

defs.def_cn: 穿过，通过(城市、地区、国家);遍及

ext.ext_cn: 北行至拉姆斯盖特，然后横跨法国，穿过安多拉，进入西班牙。
ext.ext_en: Go up to Ramsgate, cross into France, go through Andorra and into Spain.

ext.ext_cn: 在人迹罕至的树林中穿行
ext.ext_en: ...travelling through pathless woods...

defs.def_en: To go through a town, area, or country means to travel across it or in it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们挤过人群，来到河边。
ext.ext_en: We made our way through the crowd to the river...

ext.ext_cn: 西比尔的手指在水中划来划去。
ext.ext_en: Sybil's fingers ran through the water...

defs.def_en: If you move through a group of things or a mass of something, it is on either side of you or all around you.

ext.ext_cn: 留出 25 分钟过护照检查处和海关。
ext.ext_en: Allow twenty-five minutes to get through Passport Control and Customs...

ext.ext_cn: 他是那群人里最后一批跨越障碍的。
ext.ext_en: He was one of the last of the crowd to pass through the barrier...

defs.def_en: To get through a barrier or obstacle means to get from one side of it to the other.

ext.ext_cn: 他在交叉路口被一辆闯红灯的小货车撞死了。
ext.ext_en: He was killed at a road junction by a van driver who went through a red light...

ext.ext_cn: 我们鸣着喇叭，闯过红灯。
ext.ext_en: We drove through red traffic lights, the horn blaring.

defs.def_en: If a driver goes through a red light, they keep driving even though they should stop.

ext.ext_cn: 网的两端各穿过一根木棒。
ext.ext_en: The ends of the net pass through a wooden bar at each end...

ext.ext_cn: 齐塔自己就不守传统，在一只耳垂上穿了一根别针。
ext.ext_en: Zita was herself unconventional, keeping a safety-pin stuck through her ear lobe.

defs.def_en: If something goes into an object and comes out of the other side, you can say that it passes through the object.

ext.ext_cn: 通过铜导线的电流
ext.ext_en: ...electric currents travelling through copper wires...

ext.ext_cn: 你们收到了多少寄来的贺卡啊！
ext.ext_en: What a lot of cards you've got through the post!

defs.def_en: To go through a system means to move around it or to pass from one end of it to the other.

ext.ext_cn: 艾丽斯透过湿漉漉的玻璃神情忧郁地凝视着窗外。
ext.ext_en: Alice gazed pensively through the wet glass...

ext.ext_cn: 透过墙壁，他们能听到有节奏的音乐声。
ext.ext_en: They could hear music pulsing through the walls of the house...

defs.def_en: If you see, hear, or feel something through a particular thing, that thing is between you and the thing you can see, hear, or feel.

defs.def_cn: (感觉、态度、品质)遍布，遍及，贯穿

ext.ext_cn: 期待的心情在人群中弥漫开来。
ext.ext_en: An atmosphere of anticipation vibrated through the crowd...

ext.ext_cn: 回荡在他脑海里的旋律都走调了。
ext.ext_en: The melody that ran through his brain was composed of bad notes...

defs.def_en: If something such as a feeling, attitude, or quality, happens through an area, organization, or a person's body, it happens everywhere in it or affects all of it.

ext.ext_cn: 整个 11 月，我们都在新西兰、澳大利亚和日本巡回演出。
ext.ext_en: We're playing in New Zealand, Australia and Japan through November...

ext.ext_cn: “传奇”旅行社为老年人提供全年的国内外旅游服务。
ext.ext_en: Saga features trips for older people at home and abroad all through the year...

defs.def_en: If something happens or exists through a period of time, it happens or exists from the beginning until the end.

ext.ext_cn: 开放时间：周一到周日，每天早晨 7: 00 到晚上 10: 00
ext.ext_en: ...open Monday through Sunday from 7:00 am to 10:00 pm...

ext.ext_cn: 她忙的时候(从 3 月一直到 6 月)，常常一个星期完成多达 50 幅画作。
ext.ext_en: During her busy season (March through June), she often completes as many as fifty paintings a week.

defs.def_en: If something happens from a particular period of time through another, it starts at the first period and continues until the end of the second period.

ext.ext_cn: 男人和女人一样，也要在情绪上经历更年期。
ext.ext_en: Men go through a change of life emotionally just like women.

ext.ext_cn: 在巴黎经历过两次世界大战的幽默女人
ext.ext_en: ...a humorous woman who had lived through two world wars in Paris...

defs.def_en: If you go through a particular experience or event, you experience it, and if you behave in a particular way through it, you behave in that way while it is happening.

defs.def_cn: 完成的;结束的;(与…)关系了结的

ext.ext_cn: 我不想再解释了。
ext.ext_en: I'm through with the explaining...

ext.ext_cn: 她接受的婚姻指导师培训能保证她学业一结束就找到工作。
ext.ext_en: Training as a marriage counsellor would guarantee her some employment once her schooling was through...

defs.def_en: If you are through with something or if it is through, you have finished doing it and will never do it again. If you are through with someone, you do not want to have anything to do with them again.

ext.ext_cn: 一名 39 岁的马拉松参赛者跑到一半时瘫倒在地，没过多久就死了。
ext.ext_en: A thirty-nine-year-old competitor collapsed half-way through the marathon and died shortly afterwards.

ext.ext_cn: 不停搅动猪肉，直到它全部变白为止。
ext.ext_en: Stir the pork about until it turns white all the way through.

defs.def_en: You use through in expressions such as half-way through and all the way through to indicate to what extent an action or task is completed.

ext.ext_cn: 据知他们是因年龄或健康问题而退休。
ext.ext_en: They are understood to have retired through age or ill health...

ext.ext_cn: 想到有人因为我犯的错误而吃苦头，我就不寒而栗。
ext.ext_en: The thought of someone suffering through a mistake of mine makes me shiver.

defs.def_en: If something happens because of something else, you can say that it happens through it.

ext.ext_cn: 企图通过暴力夺权的人理应受到惩罚。
ext.ext_en: Those who seek to grab power through violence deserve punishment...

ext.ext_cn: 通过官方渠道是压根儿搞不到票的。
ext.ext_en: You simply can't get a ticket through official channels.

defs.def_en: You use through when stating the means by which a particular thing is achieved.

ext.ext_cn: 我必须经过我的医生呢，还是可以直接预约？
ext.ext_en: Do I need to go through my doctor or can I make an appointment direct?...

ext.ext_cn: 他通过译员发出呼吁，希望西方能采取一些新的思维。
ext.ext_en: Speaking through an interpreter, he called for some new thinking from the West.

defs.def_en: If you do something through someone else, they take the necessary action for you.

defs.def_cn: (提议、观点)获得通过，得到批准

ext.ext_cn: 如果提案获得通过，现任总督可能被任命为临时总统。
ext.ext_en: It is possible that the present Governor General will be made interim President, if the proposals go through...

ext.ext_cn: 尼克松-福特过渡时期的国务卿不希望推动那些提案得到通过。
ext.ext_en: The secretary of state during the Nixon-Ford transition did not wish to push the proposals through.

defs.def_en: If something such as a proposal or idea goes through, it is accepted by people in authority and is made legal or official.

defs.def_cn: 通过(考试);(在比赛中)胜出

ext.ext_cn: 她头脑聪明，学语言学得快，各门考试都顺利地通过。
ext.ext_en: She was bright, learned languages quickly, and sailed through her exams...

ext.ext_cn: 所有种子选手都闯过了第一轮比赛。
ext.ext_en: All the seeded players got through the first round.

defs.def_en: If someone gets through an examination or a round of a competition, they succeed or win.

ext.ext_cn: 他可能会发现电话线被切断了，所以打不通。
ext.ext_en: He may find the line cut on the telephone so that he can't get through...

ext.ext_cn: 第二天早上，史密斯试图打电话给在沃姆斯普林斯的弗兰克。
ext.ext_en: Smith tried to get through to Frank at Warm Springs the next morning.

defs.def_en: When you get through while making a telephone call, the call is connected and you can speak to the person you are phoning.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一起把这些数目过一遍，看能不能找出个可行方案。
ext.ext_en: Let's go through the numbers together and see if a workable deal is possible...

ext.ext_cn: 等你列出个人喜好的单子后，从头到尾再看一遍。
ext.ext_en: When you have finished your list of personal preferences, go through it again...

defs.def_en: If you look or go through a lot of things, you look at them or deal with them one after the other.

ext.ext_cn: 她一页一页地翻看我带给她的乐谱。
ext.ext_en: She read through pages and pages of the music I had brought her...

ext.ext_cn: 我在乘飞机来这儿之前，只来得及把稿子浏览了一遍。
ext.ext_en: I only had time to skim through the script before I flew over here.

defs.def_en: If you read through something, you read it from beginning to end.

ext.ext_cn: 英国行程最远的直达列车路线——685 英里
ext.ext_en: ...Britain's longest through train journey, 685 miles.

defs.def_en: A through train goes directly to a particular place, so that the people who want to go there do not have to change trains.

ext.ext_cn: 我回到小旅馆时身上被毛毛雨淋透了，感觉又冷又湿。
ext.ext_en: I returned to the inn cold and wet, soaked through by the drizzling rain...

ext.ext_cn: 她还是哭，哭呀哭，一直哭到枕头都湿透了。
ext.ext_en: She went on crying, and cried and cried until the pillow was wet through.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is wet through, you are emphasizing how wet they are.

ext.ext_cn: 我双脚湿透，感觉都冻到骨头里了。
ext.ext_en: I've gotten my feet thoroughly soaked and feel frozen through and through...

ext.ext_cn: 人们一见到我，就自以为对我了如指掌了。
ext.ext_en: People assume they know me through and through the moment we meet.

defs.def_en: Through and through means completely and to the greatest extent possible.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然旅途漫长孤独，图马罗还是继续前行。
ext.ext_en: Although the journey was a long and lonely one, Tumalo pushed on.

defs.def_en: When you push on, you continue with a journey or task.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 粗俗的;庸俗的;俗气的;不雅的

ext.ext_en: I think it's a very vulgar house...

ext.ext_en: The film is tasteless, vulgar and even badly shot.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as vulgar, you think it is in bad taste or of poor artistic quality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （图画、姿势或言论）下流的，猥亵的

ext.ext_en: The women laughed coarsely at some vulgar jokes...

ext.ext_en: The lyrics were vulgar.

defs.def_en: If you describe pictures, gestures, or remarks as vulgar, you dislike them because they refer to sex or parts of the body in a rude way that you find unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 粗俗的;无礼的;粗鄙的;粗鲁的

ext.ext_en: He was a vulgar old man, but he never swore in front of a woman...

ext.ext_cn: “不要无礼，”她斥责道。
ext.ext_en: 'Don't be vulgar,' she reprimanded.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as vulgar, you mean that they lack taste or behave rudely.

ext.ext_cn: 具备传授知识并赢得尊敬的能力是对教师的基本要求。
ext.ext_en: The ability to impart knowledge and command respect is the essential qualification for teachers...

ext.ext_en: I am about to impart knowledge to you that you will never forget.

defs.def_en: If you impart information to people, you tell it to them.

ext.ext_cn: 她使自己朴素的衣着看起来也十分优雅。
ext.ext_en: She managed to impart great elegance to the unpretentious dress she was wearing...

ext.ext_cn: 他所执导的哈罗德·品特的剧作没能表现出紧张、危险感。
ext.ext_en: His production of Harold Pinter's play fails to impart a sense of excitement or danger.

defs.def_en: To impart a particular quality to something means to give it that quality.
A gendarme is a member of the French police force.

ext.ext_cn: 一些老套警匪烂片
ext.ext_en: ...some old rubbishy cop movie.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as rubbishy, you think it is of very poor quality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 瞬间的犹豫
ext.ext_en: ...a fractional hesitation.

defs.def_en: If something is fractional, it is very small in size or degree.

defs.def_cn: (英国的)警司;(美国的)警察局局长

ext.ext_cn: 他在机场被一名助理警长扣留了。
ext.ext_en: He was stopped at the airport by an assistant superintendent of police.

ext.ext_cn: 侦查警司柯比
ext.ext_en: ...Detective Superintendent Kirby.

defs.def_en: In Britain, a superintendent is a senior police officer of the rank above an inspector. In the United States, a superintendent is the head of a police department.

ext.ext_en: He became superintendent of the bank's East African branches...

ext.ext_cn: 公共建设部部长下令检查所有河道。
ext.ext_en: The Superintendent of Public Works gives orders for all watercourses to be inspected.

defs.def_en: A superintendent is a person who is responsible for a particular thing or the work done in a particular department.
A superintendent is a person whose job is to look after a large building such as a school or a block of flats and deal with small repairs to it.

defs.def_cn: (气温)零度以下的，华氏零度以下的

ext.ext_cn: 滞留在零度以下气温中的乘客们
ext.ext_en: ...passengers stranded in sub-zero temperatures.

defs.def_en: Sub-zero temperatures are below 0º centigrade or, in the United States, below 0º Fahrenheit.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 灰白的天空中满是迁徙的飞鸟。
ext.ext_en: Migrating birds filled the pale sky...

ext.ext_cn: 随着年龄的增长，我们的皮肤愈见苍白。
ext.ext_en: As we age, our skin becomes paler.

defs.def_en: If something is pale, it is very light in colour or almost white.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她看起来脸色苍白憔悴。
ext.ext_en: She looked pale and tired...

ext.ext_cn: 他面如死灰。
ext.ext_en: He went deathly pale.

defs.def_en: If someone looks pale, their face looks a lighter colour than usual, usually because they are ill, frightened, or shocked.

ext.ext_cn: 你爱的人得了致命疾病时，其他一切事情都显得不那么重要了。
ext.ext_en: When someone you love has a life-threatening illness, everything else pales in comparison.

ext.ext_cn: 让其他同类剧相形见绌的肥皂剧
ext.ext_en: ...a soap opera against which other soaps pale into insignificance.

defs.def_en: If one thing pales in comparison with another, it is made to seem much less important, serious, or good by it.

ext.ext_cn: 这种事情真是不可接受。
ext.ext_en: This sort of thing really is quite beyond the pale.

ext.ext_cn: 超出可接受的人类行为的范围
ext.ext_en: ...beyond the pale of acceptable human behaviour.

defs.def_en: If you think that someone's actions or behaviour are not acceptable, you can say that they are beyond the pale.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这地方很快变得凌乱不堪。
ext.ext_en: The place quickly became untidy.

ext.ext_cn: 头发凌乱的瘦男子
ext.ext_en: ...a thin man with untidy hair...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as untidy, you mean that it is not neat or well arranged.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我在很多方面都没有条理。
ext.ext_en: I'm untidy in most ways.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as untidy, you mean that they do not care about whether things are neat and well arranged, for example in their house.

ext.ext_cn: 美国的例子证明了这一点。
ext.ext_en: The example of the United States illustrates this point...

ext.ext_cn: 这种变化鲜明地体现在阿拉伯联盟所发生的事件上。
ext.ext_en: This change is neatly illustrated by what has happened to the Arab League...

defs.def_en: If you say that something illustrates a situation that you are drawing attention to, you mean that it shows that the situation exists.

defs.def_cn: (用例子、故事或图表)说明,阐明

ext.ext_cn: 我再举个例子来说明这个难点。
ext.ext_en: Let me give another example to illustrate this difficult point...

ext.ext_cn: 自始至终,她摘引讨论内容来阐明她的分析。
ext.ext_en: Throughout, she illustrates her analysis with excerpts from discussions.

defs.def_en: If you use an example, story, or diagram to illustrate a point, you use it show that what you are saying is true or to make your meaning clearer.

ext.ext_cn: 她后来读了艺术学校,现在正在为一本书画插图。
ext.ext_en: She went on to art school and is now illustrating a book...

ext.ext_cn: 他为那本书配了一些黑白照片插图。
ext.ext_en: He has illustrated the book with black-and-white photographs.

defs.def_en: If you illustrate a book, you put pictures, photographs or diagrams into it.

A transsexual is a person who has decided that they want to live as a person of the opposite sex, and so has changed their name and appearance in order to do this. Transsexuals sometimes have an operation to change their sex.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (歌曲、电影或书籍)过分感伤的，煽情的
defs.def_en: If you describe songs, films, or books as schmaltzy, you do not like them because they are too sentimental.

ext.ext_cn: 他正在对前同事的指责进行逐条反驳。
ext.ext_en: He is conducting a point-by-point rebuttal of charges from former colleagues...

ext.ext_cn: 巴基斯坦仍然没有对最近印度发表的声明进行官方驳斥。
ext.ext_en: Pakistan has still not issued an official rebuttal to the latest Indian statements.

defs.def_en: If you make a rebuttal of a charge or accusation that has been made against you, you make a statement which gives reasons why the accusation is untrue.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 叛逆少年
ext.ext_en: ...a rebellious teenager...

ext.ext_cn: 他长大了，也越发叛逆了。
ext.ext_en: He grew older and more rebellious.

defs.def_en: If you think someone behaves in an unacceptable way and does not do what they are told, you can say they are rebellious .

defs.def_cn: （反对现行政府体制的群体）反叛的，叛乱的

ext.ext_cn: 叛乱的军官控制了电台，广播宣布推翻君主制的消息。
ext.ext_en: The rebellious officers, having seized the radio station, broadcast the news of the overthrow of the monarchy.

defs.def_en: A rebellious group of people is a group involved in taking violent action against the rulers of their own country, usually in order to change the system of government there.

defs.def_cn: 发现者;寻得者;找到…的人

ext.ext_cn: 将钱包据为己有的人可能会被控盗窃。
ext.ext_en: The finder of a wallet who takes it home may be guilty of theft...

ext.ext_cn: 发现走失的狗后都应将它带到警察局。
ext.ext_en: Every stray dog has to be taken by its finder to the police.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone who finds something as the finder of that thing.

defs.def_cn: 持续而低沉的声音;隆隆声;辘辘声;咕噜声

ext.ext_cn: 空空如也的肚子发出的咕噜声
ext.ext_en: ...the rumbling of an empty stomach...

ext.ext_en: Our peace was soon shattered by loud rumblings and explosions like cannon fire.

defs.def_en: A rumbling is a low continuous noise.

ext.ext_cn: 士兵怨声载道。
ext.ext_en: There were rumblings of discontent within the ranks.

defs.def_en: Rumblings are signs that a bad situation is developing or that people are becoming annoyed or unhappy.

defs.def_cn: （通常指无正当理由、经常性的）旷工，旷课

ext.ext_cn: 高旷课率
ext.ext_en: ...the high rate of absenteeism.

defs.def_en: Absenteeism is the fact or habit of frequently being away from work or school, usually without a good reason.

defs.def_cn: （艺人等的）试镜，试演，试唱，试奏
defs.def_en: An audition is a short performance given by an actor, dancer, or musician so that a director or conductor can decide if they are good enough to be in a play, film, or orchestra.

defs.def_cn: 试镜;让…试演（或试唱、试音）

ext.ext_cn: 我试演一个喜欢吃醋的女友角色。
ext.ext_en: I was auditioning for the part of a jealous girlfriend...

ext.ext_en: They're auditioning for new members of the cast for 'Miss Saigon' today...

A  coniferous forest or wood is made up of conifers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 欢欣的;欢喜的;洋洋得意的

ext.ext_en: An exultant party leader said: 'He will be an excellent MP.'

defs.def_en: If you are exultant, you feel very happy and proud about something you have done.

ext.ext_cn: 我心里舒了一口气。
ext.ext_en: I sighed with inward relief.

ext.ext_cn: 内心强烈的满足感
ext.ext_en: ...a glow of inward satisfaction.

defs.def_en: Your inward thoughts or feelings are the ones that you do not express or show to other people.

ext.ext_en: ...a sharp, inward breath like a gasp...

ext.ext_cn: 这名运动员向内转体一周单腿起跳。
ext.ext_en: The athlete takes off from one leg from an inward twist.

defs.def_en: An inward movement is one towards the inside or centre of something.
Some-one's bottom can be referred to as their posterior .

ext.ext_cn: 腿部后侧的肌肉
ext.ext_en: ...the posterior leg muscles.

defs.def_en: Posterior describes something that is situated at the back of something else.

defs.def_en: Dishonesty is dishonest behaviour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 感人的;令人感伤（或同情）的

ext.ext_cn: 看到陌生人之间这般彼此关照，实在令人感动。
ext.ext_en: It is very moving to see how much strangers can care for each other...

ext.ext_cn: 对玛丽安娜来说，那是动人的一刻。
ext.ext_en: It was a moving moment for Marianne.

defs.def_en: If something is moving, it makes you feel strongly an emotion such as sadness, pity, or sympathy.

defs.def_cn: (模型或机器部件)活动的，可移动的
defs.def_en: A moving model or part of a machine moves or is able to move.

defs.def_cn: 推动力；起激励作用的人(或事)

ext.ext_en: She alone must have been the moving spirit behind the lawsuit that lost me my position...

ext.ext_en: Professor Krauss has been a moving force in the world of academic art criticism.

defs.def_en: The moving spirit or moving force behind something is the person or thing that caused it to start and to keep going, or that influenced people to take part in it.
On a computer or network of computers, a router is a piece of equipment which allows access to other computers or networks, for example the Internet.
A war widow is a woman whose husband was killed while he was in the armed forces during a war.

ext.ext_en: Highest temperatures 11º Celsius, that's 52º Fahrenheit.

ext.ext_en: The thermometer shows the temperature in Celsius and Fahrenheit.

defs.def_en: Celsius is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees. It is represented by the symbol  →see usage note at:temperature
A honeymoon is a holiday taken by a man and a woman who have just got married.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在威尼斯度了蜜月。
ext.ext_en: They honeymooned in Venice.

ext.ext_cn: 正在度蜜月的日本游客
ext.ext_en: ...honeymooning Japanese tourists.

defs.def_en: When a recently-married couple honeymoon somewhere, they go there on their honeymoon.

defs.def_cn: （新工作开始或新政府成立后的）和谐时期，蜜月期

ext.ext_en: Austrians voted for EU membership by a two-to-one majority in a June 1994 referendum, but the honeymoon is definitely over...

ext.ext_en: Brett is enjoying a honeymoon period with both press and public.

defs.def_en: You can use honeymoon to refer to a period of time after the start of a new job or new government when everyone is pleased with the person or people concerned and is nice to them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 小心谨慎的;一丝不苟的;注意细节的

ext.ext_cn: 他对所有事情都一丝不苟。
ext.ext_en: He was so meticulous about everything...

ext.ext_cn: 画这幅画的时候，画家非常注意细节。
ext.ext_en: The painting had been executed with meticulous attention to detail.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as meticulous, you mean that they do things very carefully and with great attention to detail.

defs.def_cn: (用于名词和形容词前)表示“一个”，“单一”

ext.ext_cn: 单不饱和脂肪含量高
ext.ext_en: ...high in mono-unsaturated fats.

ext.ext_cn: 双语父母和单语教师之间的交流
ext.ext_en: ...interaction between bilingual parents and monolingual teachers.

defs.def_en: Mono- is used at the beginning of nouns and adjectives that have 'one' or 'single' as part of their meanings.

ext.ext_cn: 能连接因特网的DVD和CD播放机
ext.ext_en: ...a DVD video and CD player with Internet connectivity.

defs.def_en: Connectivity is the ability of a computing device to connect to other computers or to the Internet.

ext.ext_cn: 警察使用手写笔输入设备在触控式屏幕上写报告。
ext.ext_en: The officers use stylus pen-based input devices to write their reports onto touch-sensitive screens.

defs.def_en: An input device is a piece of computer equipment such as a keyboard which enables you to put information into a computer.

ext.ext_cn: 相对来讲，这个国家几乎没有几家电影院。
ext.ext_en: The country has relatively few cinemas.

defs.def_en: A cinema is  a place where people go to watch films for entertainment.

ext.ext_cn: 我记不得上次我们去看电影是什么时候了。
ext.ext_en: I can't remember the last time we went to the cinema...

ext.ext_cn: 他们决定晚上去看电影。
ext.ext_en: They decided to spend an evening at the cinema.

defs.def_en: You can talk about the cinema when you are talking about seeing a film in a cinema.

ext.ext_cn: 当代非洲电影在活力和新颖性上颇足称道。
ext.ext_en: Contemporary African cinema has much to offer in its vitality and freshness.

ext.ext_cn: 电影业的早期
ext.ext_en: ...in the early days of cinema.

defs.def_en: Cinema is the business and art of making films.

ext.ext_cn: 涉嫌颠覆国家的阴谋
ext.ext_en: ...an alleged plot to subvert the state.

ext.ext_cn: 试图从内部瓦解文化的最后一击
ext.ext_en: ...a last attempt to subvert culture from within.

defs.def_en: To subvert something means to destroy its power and influence.

ext.ext_cn: 有越来越多的威尔士人要求得到认可，即威尔士不只是英格兰的附属
ext.ext_en: ...the growing demand in Wales for recognition that it was not just an appendage to England...

ext.ext_cn: 麦克米伦肯定极不喜欢只被当成国内政治的附属品。
ext.ext_en: Macmillan must have loathed being judged as a mere appendage to domestic politics.

defs.def_en: An appendage is something that is joined to or connected with something larger or more important.

ext.ext_cn: 一个无论从字面还是比喻意义上来说都将改变你的路线的事件
ext.ext_en: ...an event that will change your route — in both the literal and figurative sense.

defs.def_en: If you use a word or expression in a figurative sense, you use it with a more abstract or imaginative meaning than its ordinary literal one.

ext.ext_cn: 他的职业生涯延续了大约50年，作品既有抽象画也有写实画。
ext.ext_en: His career spanned some 50 years and encompassed both abstract and figurative painting.

defs.def_en: Figurative art is a style of art in which people and things are shown in a realistic way.
A ditty is a short or light-hearted song or poem.

ext.ext_cn: 我记得小时候觉得祖父的相貌很迷人。
ext.ext_en: As a child I remember being riveted by my grandfather's appearance...

ext.ext_cn: 他对约翰·韦恩的电影很痴迷。
ext.ext_en: He was riveted to the John Wayne movie...

defs.def_en: If you are riveted by something, it fascinates you and holds your interest completely.
A rivet is a short metal pin with a flat head which is used to fasten flat pieces of metal together.
An electronic book is the same as an e-book .

ext.ext_cn: 窗帘在微风中鼓了起来。
ext.ext_en: The curtains billowed in the breeze...

ext.ext_cn: 她粉红色的连衣裙鼓了起来。
ext.ext_en: Her pink dress billowed out around her.

defs.def_en: When something made of cloth billows, it swells out and moves slowly in the wind.

ext.ext_en: ...thick plumes of smoke billowing from factory chimneys...

ext.ext_cn: 引擎盖下喷出滚滚的蒸汽。
ext.ext_en: Steam billowed out from under the bonnet.

defs.def_en: When smoke or cloud billows, it moves slowly upwards or across the sky.

ext.ext_cn: 喷出滚滚黑烟的烟囱
ext.ext_en: ...smoke stacks belching billows of almost solid black smoke.

defs.def_en: A billow of smoke or dust is a large mass of it rising slowly into the air.
A clock tower is a tall, narrow building with a clock at the top.

defs.def_cn: (电影、流行歌曲或书籍的)低俗品，庸俗品

ext.ext_cn: 善于发现上座率高的低俗作品的演出经理人
ext.ext_en: ...a showman with a good eye for marketable schlock.

defs.def_en: If you refer to films, pop songs, or books as schlock, you mean that they have no artistic or social value.

ext.ext_cn: 食腐肉的蛆虫
ext.ext_en: ...maggots which eat away dead flesh.

ext.ext_cn: 淡粉色的鳟鱼和鲑鱼肉
ext.ext_en: ...the pale pink flesh of trout and salmon.

defs.def_en: Flesh is the soft part of a person's or animal's body between the bones and the skin.

ext.ext_cn: 她肌肤的温暖
ext.ext_en: ...the warmth of her flesh.

ext.ext_cn: 肉欲之罪
ext.ext_en: ...the sins of the flesh.

defs.def_en: You can use flesh to refer to human skin and the human body, especially when you are considering it in a sexual way.

ext.ext_en: Cut the flesh from the olives and discard the stones.

defs.def_en: The flesh of a fruit or vegetable is the soft inside part of it.

ext.ext_en: I'm only flesh and blood, like anyone else.

ext.ext_en: ...skills of a precision unmatched by any flesh and blood worker.

defs.def_en: You use flesh and blood to emphasize that someone has human feelings or weaknesses, often when contrasting them with machines.

ext.ext_en: The kid, after all, was his own flesh and blood. He deserved a second chance.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is your own flesh and blood, you are emphasizing that they are a member of your family.

defs.def_cn: 使人反感;使毛骨悚然;使心惊肉跳

ext.ext_en: It makes my flesh creep to think of it...

ext.ext_en: I was heading on a secret mission that made my flesh crawl.

defs.def_en: If something makes your flesh creep or makes your flesh crawl, it makes you feel disgusted, shocked or frightened.

ext.ext_en: Charles' appeal is best observed in the flesh...

ext.ext_en: The first thing viewers usually say when they see me in the flesh is 'You're smaller than you look on TV.'

defs.def_en: If you meet or see someone in the flesh, you actually meet or see them, rather than, for example, seeing them in a film or on television.

defs.def_en: If you put flesh on something, you add details and more information to it.

ext.ext_en: He talked with him for an hour and a half, fleshing out the details of his original five-minute account...

ext.ext_cn: 他从此使自己的故事更加丰满。
ext.ext_en: He has since fleshed out his story.

defs.def_en: If you flesh out something such as a story or plan, you add details and more information to it.

ext.ext_en: We have made a conscious effort to devolve responsibility...

ext.ext_en: Her Royal Highness the Duchess of Kent opened an art exhibition recently.

defs.def_en: Expressions such as 'Your Highness' or 'His Highness' are used to address or refer to a member of the royal family other than a king or queen.

defs.def_en: If someone has neatly coiffed hair, their hair is very carefully arranged.

ext.ext_en: Soon they were only dots above the hard line of the horizon.

defs.def_en: You can refer to something that you can see in the distance and that looks like a small round mark as a dot .

ext.ext_en: Small coastal towns dot the landscape.

defs.def_en: When things dot a place or an area, they are scattered or spread all over it.

ext.ext_en: They appeared on the dot of 9.50 pm as always...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在 9 点钟准时吃早饭。
ext.ext_en: At nine o' clock on the dot, they have breakfast.

defs.def_en: If you arrive somewhere or do something on the dot, you arrive there or do it at exactly the time that you were supposed to.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone dots the i's and crosses the t's, you mean that they pay great attention to every small detail in a task; often used to express your annoyance because such detailed work seems unnecessary and takes a very long time.

ext.ext_en: You've wanted to be a barrister since the year dot.

defs.def_en: The year dot is used to mean a very long time ago.

defs.def_cn: (尤指用机器进行的)批量生产，大量生产

ext.ext_cn: 能够批量生产婴儿食品的设备
ext.ext_en: ...equipment that would allow the mass production of baby food.

defs.def_en: Mass production is the production of something in large quantities, especially by machine.

ext.ext_cn: 他想通过计算机实现流程的自动化。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to use computers to automate the process.

defs.def_en: To automate a factory, office, or industrial process means to put in machines which can do the work instead of people.

ext.ext_cn: 未经医嘱不得中断治疗。
ext.ext_en: Do not discontinue the treatment without consulting your doctor.

defs.def_en: If you discontinue something that you have been doing regularly, you stop doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 徕卡 M2 型相机于 1967 年停产。
ext.ext_en: The Leica M2 was discontinued in 1967...

ext.ext_en: They have a huge selection of discontinued cookers.

ext.ext_en: ...a selfish, gluttonous and lazy person.

defs.def_en: If you think that someone eats too much and is greedy, you can say they are gluttonous .

ext.ext_en: Gabrielle entered this year's charts faster than any first-timer before her.

defs.def_en: A first-timer is someone who does something for the first time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you have a pained expression or look, you look upset, worried, or slightly annoyed.

ext.ext_cn: 海平面下降使白令海底部的浅层大陆架暴露出来。
ext.ext_en: Lowered sea levels exposed the shallow continental shelf beneath the Bering Sea...

ext.ext_en: For an instant his whole back was exposed.

defs.def_en: To expose something that is usually hidden means to uncover it so that it can be seen.

ext.ext_cn: 预算案无疑揭穿了部长们一年前所说的谎话。
ext.ext_en: The Budget does expose the lies ministers were telling a year ago...

ext.ext_cn: 丑闻曝光后，贝利博士自杀了。
ext.ext_en: After the scandal was exposed, Dr Bailey committed suicide...

defs.def_en: To expose a person or situation means to reveal that they are bad or immoral in some way.

ext.ext_en: They had not been exposed to most diseases common to urban populations...

ext.ext_cn: 明智的母亲决不会让她的孩子置身于一丁点儿危险之中。
ext.ext_en: A wise mother never exposes her children to the slightest possibility of danger.

defs.def_en: If someone is exposed to something dangerous or unpleasant, they are put in a situation in which it might affect them.

defs.def_cn: 使受…的影响(或熏陶);使接触

ext.ext_cn: 过去丝毫未曾见识过西方生活的当地人
ext.ext_en: ...local people who've not been exposed to glimpses of Western life before...

ext.ext_cn: 这些单元让孩子们接触到有关某一特定问题的多种观点。
ext.ext_en: These units exposed children to many viewpoints of a given issue.

defs.def_en: If someone is exposed to an idea or feeling, usually a new one, they are given experience of it, or introduced to it.

defs.def_cn: （常因精神或感情失控）暴露性器官，当众露阴

defs.def_en: A man who exposes himself shows people his genitals in a public place, usually because he is mentally or emotionally disturbed.

defs.def_cn: （木头、金属、玻璃）有斜边的，有斜面的

ext.ext_en: ...a huge mirror with deep bevelled edges.

defs.def_en: If a piece of wood, metal, or glass has bevelled edges, its edges are cut sloping.

ext.ext_en: ...the written and oral traditions of ancient cultures.

ext.ext_en: ...an oral agreement.

defs.def_en: Oral communication is spoken rather than written.

ext.ext_en: I spoke privately to the candidate after the oral.

defs.def_en: An oral is an examination, especially in a foreign language, that is spoken rather than written.

ext.ext_cn: 良好的口腔卫生
ext.ext_en: ...good oral hygiene.

defs.def_en: You use oral to indicate that something is done with a person's mouth or relates to a person's mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 口服避孕药
ext.ext_en: ...oral contraceptives.

defs.def_en: Oral medicines are taken by mouth.

defs.def_cn: (用于掩盖真实目的或意图的)特洛伊木马，幌子

ext.ext_cn: 科隆博是教皇保罗的特使吗？是他在委员会内部设下的卧底吗？
ext.ext_en: Was Colombo the emissary of Pope Paul, his Trojan horse within the Commission?...

ext.ext_cn: 两派都相互指责对方利用该组织作幌子以发展各自的事业。
ext.ext_en: Both factions accused each other of using the organization as a Trojan horse to advance their causes.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or thing as a Trojan horse, you mean that they are being used to hide someone's true purpose or intentions.
