ext.ext_en: Operating systems can be brought to a halt by a Trojan Horse.

defs.def_en: A Trojan horse is a computer virus which is inserted into a program or system and is designed to take effect after a particular period of time or a certain number of operations.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 葱郁的；葱茏的；草木茂盛的

ext.ext_cn: 河畔郁郁葱葱的青草地
ext.ext_en: ...the lush green meadows bordering the river...

ext.ext_cn: 一个个花园打扮得煞是好看，到处是绿茵茵的植被。
ext.ext_en: The beautifully landscaped gardens sprawl with lush vegetation.

defs.def_en: Lush fields or gardens have a lot of very healthy grass or plants.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 铺粉色瓷砖和豪华地毯、装有镜子的卫生间
ext.ext_en: ...a mirrored bathroom done in soft pink tiles with a lush, plush carpet...

ext.ext_cn: 布料奢华。
ext.ext_en: The fabrics were lush.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place or thing as lush, you mean that it is very luxurious.
If you describe someone as a lush, you mean that they drink too much alcohol.

defs.def_cn: 优质时间，宝贵时光(指放松自我、享受乐趣的时间)
defs.def_en: If people spend quality time together, they spend a period of time relaxing or doing things that they both enjoy, and not worrying about work or other responsibilities.
A splashdown is the landing of a spacecraft in the sea after a flight.

ext.ext_cn: 各级司法机构普遍存在对女性的偏见。
ext.ext_en: Bias against women permeates every level of the judicial system...

ext.ext_cn: 英国广播公司因被指具有政治偏见而遭到猛烈抨击。
ext.ext_en: There were fierce attacks on the BBC for alleged political bias.

defs.def_en: Bias is a tendency to prefer one person or thing to another, and to favour that person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 这个系特别偏重神经科学。
ext.ext_en: The Department has a strong bias towards neuroscience.

defs.def_en: Bias is a concern with or interest in one thing more than others.

ext.ext_cn: 我们决不允许它影响我们的教学。
ext.ext_en: We mustn't allow it to bias our teaching.

defs.def_en: To bias someone means to influence them in favour of a particular choice.

ext.ext_cn: 这块斜裁料如蛛网一般轻盈地从一女子身上垂下来。
ext.ext_en: The fabric, cut on the bias, hangs as light as a cobweb off a woman's body.

ext.ext_cn: 斜裁裙装
ext.ext_en: ...a bias-cut dress.

defs.def_en: A dress or skirt that is cut on the bias or that is bias-cut has been cut diagonally across the material so that it hangs down in a particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 他决心成为世界级选手。
ext.ext_en: He was determined to become a world-class player.

ext.ext_cn: 英国少有的世界级公司中的几个
ext.ext_en: ...some of Britain's few world-class companies.

defs.def_en: A world-class sports player, performer, or organization is one of the best in the world.

ext.ext_cn: 他父亲 40 年前租下了这个农场。
ext.ext_en: His father took over the tenancy of the farm 40 years ago...

ext.ext_cn: 租户应该认真核对租赁合同。
ext.ext_en: Tenants should check their tenancy agreements closely.

defs.def_en: Tenancy is the use that you have of land or property belonging to someone else, for which you pay rent.

ext.ext_cn: 一条长长的茎秆的每个节上都会长出一朵浅蓝色的花。
ext.ext_en: A single pale blue flower grows up from each joint on a long stalk.

ext.ext_cn: 玉米秆
ext.ext_en: ...corn stalks.

defs.def_en: The stalk of a flower, leaf, or fruit is the thin part that joins it to the plant or tree.

ext.ext_cn: 他像猎手跟踪鹿一样悄悄跟踪受害人。
ext.ext_en: He stalks his victims like a hunter after a deer.

defs.def_en: If you stalk a person or a wild animal, you follow them quietly in order to kill them, catch them, or observe them carefully.

defs.def_cn: 跟踪骚扰，不断纠缠(名人、分手恋人等)

ext.ext_cn: 即使在离婚后他仍继续纠缠和威胁她。
ext.ext_en: Even after their divorce he continued to stalk and threaten her.

defs.def_en: If someone stalks someone else, especially a famous person or a person they used to have a relationship with, they keep following them or contacting them in an annoying and frightening way.

defs.def_cn: 高视阔步;怒气冲冲地走

ext.ext_cn: 大家都知道如果他在会议上失去耐心，便会愤怒离席。
ext.ext_en: If his patience is tried at meetings he has been known to stalk out.

defs.def_en: If you stalk somewhere, you walk there in a stiff, proud, or angry way.

defs.def_cn: (死亡、恐惧、罪恶等)笼罩，蔓延，肆虐

ext.ext_cn: 用他的话来说，新法西斯主义的幽灵正在索非亚和其他大城市中游荡。
ext.ext_en: The spectre of neo-fascism, as he put it, was stalking the streets of Sofia and other big cities.

defs.def_en: If you say that something bad such as death, fear, or evil stalks a place, you mean it is there.

defs.def_cn: （国家或地区）难治理的，难控制的

ext.ext_cn: 该省因受种族冲突困扰而失控。
ext.ext_en: Beset by ethnic strife, the province remains ungovernable...

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家已经基本上失控了。
ext.ext_en: The country has become virtually ungovernable.

defs.def_en: If you describe a country or region as ungovernable, you mean that it seems impossible to control or govern it effectively, for example because of violence or conflict among the population.

ext.ext_cn: 他怒不可遏。
ext.ext_en: He was filled with an ungovernable rage.

ext.ext_cn: 无法控制的激情
ext.ext_en: ...ungovernable passions.

defs.def_en: If you describe feelings as ungovernable, you mean that they are so strong that they cannot be controlled.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他为人随和温厚。
ext.ext_en: He was easy-going and good-natured...

ext.ext_cn: 雅典人对待生活非常怡然自得。
ext.ext_en: Athenians have a very easy-going attitude to life.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as easy-going, you mean that they are not easily annoyed, worried, or upset, and you think this is a good quality.

defs.def_cn: （森林里林木下的）下层灌丛，灌木丛

ext.ext_cn: 雨林里使人感到凉爽的下层灌丛
ext.ext_en: ...the cool underbrush of the rain forest...

ext.ext_cn: 那条小路非常陡峭，而且长满了灌木丛。
ext.ext_en: The trail was steep and thick with underbrush.

defs.def_en: Underbrush consists of bushes and plants growing close together under trees in a forest.
A groundcloth is a piece of waterproof material which you put on the ground to sleep on when you are camping.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的剧作家生涯有了一个好的开头。
ext.ext_en: His career as a playwright had an auspicious start.

defs.def_en: Something that is auspicious indicates that success is likely.

ext.ext_cn: 他被教皇约翰·保罗二世任命为明斯克区的宗座署理。
ext.ext_en: He was appointed Apostolic Administrator of Minsk by Pope John Paul II.

defs.def_en: Apostolic means belonging or relating to a Christian religious leader, especially the Pope.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为从事祷告和门徒的工作是他的使命。
ext.ext_en: He saw his vocation as one of prayer and apostolic work.

defs.def_en: Apostolic means belonging or relating to the early followers of Christ and to their teaching.

defs.def_cn: (用于名词后构成形容词)表示“与…相关联的”，“与…有关系的”

ext.ext_cn: 与毒品有关的罪行
ext.ext_en: ...drug-related offences...

ext.ext_cn: 每小时有12人死于与吸烟有关的疾病。
ext.ext_en: Twelve people die every hour from smoking-related diseases.

defs.def_en: -related combines with nouns to form adjectives with the meaning 'connected with the thing referred to by the noun'.

ext.ext_cn: 他不久就会成为英格兰队的支柱。
ext.ext_en: He will shortly become the fulcrum of the England team...

ext.ext_cn: 这一决定是预算案的战略支点。
ext.ext_en: The decision is the strategic fulcrum of the Budget.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is the fulcrum of an activity or situation, you mean that they have a very important effect on what happens.

defs.def_cn: （英国女王授予封号或给予奖励的）受勋者名册

ext.ext_cn: 他被列入新年受勋者名册，获授英帝国勋章。
ext.ext_en: He has been made an MBE in the New Year Honours list.

defs.def_en: In Britain, the honours list is the list of people who have been selected to receive titles or awards from the Queen because of their achievements.

defs.def_cn: 地下蓄水层;砂石含水层
defs.def_en: In geology, an aquifer is an area of rock underneath the surface of the earth which absorbs and holds water.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 抗水的；不易被水损坏的

ext.ext_cn: 微纤维织物既防水又防风。
ext.ext_en: Microfibre fabrics are both water resistant and windproof...

ext.ext_cn: 这款随身听的外壳是防水的。
ext.ext_en: The personal stereo has a water-resistant outer case.

defs.def_en: Something that is water-resistant does not allow water to pass through it easily, or is not easily damaged by water.

ext.ext_cn: 香水贸易
ext.ext_en: ...the perfumery trade...

ext.ext_cn: 普罗旺斯是香水业的发源地。
ext.ext_en: Provence is the home of perfumery.

defs.def_en: Perfumery is the activity or business of producing perfume.

ext.ext_cn: 邦德大街巴利香水店
ext.ext_en: ...a perfumery called Bayley's of Bond Street.

ext.ext_cn: 香水专柜
ext.ext_en: ...the perfumery department.

defs.def_en: A perfumery is a shop or a department in a store where perfume is the main product that is sold.

defs.def_cn: 安置于…的;建于…的;…布置的

ext.ext_cn: 房子本身有三层高，绕着一个庭院而建。
ext.ext_en: The house itself is three stories high and arranged around a courtyard...

ext.ext_cn: 他们住在布置整洁的小房子里。
ext.ext_en: They lived in neatly-arranged little houses.

defs.def_en: If you say how things are arranged, you are talking about their position in relation to each other or to something else.

ext.ext_cn: 他在哈斯灵登文法学校读书。
ext.ext_en: He was educated at Haslingden Grammar School.

defs.def_en: When someone, especially a child, is educated, he or she is taught at a school or college.

ext.ext_cn: 设置“理智饮酒日”的主要目的是让人们了解酗酒的恶果。
ext.ext_en: Drinkwise Day is mainly designed to educate people about the destructive effects of alcohol abuse.

defs.def_en: To educate people means to teach them better ways of doing something or a better way of living.

ext.ext_cn: 当地人要求地方法官逮捕那些歹徒。
ext.ext_en: Local people demanded that the District Magistrate apprehend the miscreants.

defs.def_en: A miscreant is someone who has done something illegal or behaved badly.

ext.ext_cn: 不断有报道称村民被强制从农村迁入城镇定居。
ext.ext_en: Reports are coming in of the forcible resettlement of villagers from the countryside into towns.

defs.def_en: Forcible action involves physical force or violence.

ext.ext_cn: 他们欣赏着耶稣降生的场景造型。
ext.ext_en: They admired the tableau of the Nativity.

ext.ext_cn: 耶稣诞辰的故事
ext.ext_en: ...the Nativity story.

defs.def_en: The Nativity is the birth of Jesus, which is celebrated by Christians at Christmas.

defs.def_cn: 自己动手做的;家里做的

ext.ext_cn: 面包、油酥点心和蛋黄酱都是家里做的。
ext.ext_en: The bread, pastry and mayonnaise are home-made...

ext.ext_cn: 一枚自制炸弹在骚乱中爆炸了。
ext.ext_en: A home-made bomb exploded during the disturbances.

defs.def_en: Something that is home-made has been made in someone's home, rather than in a shop or factory.

ext.ext_cn: 那里发生的野蛮内战可能预示这一地区其他地方将会发生什么。
ext.ext_en: The savage civil war there could be a portent of what's to come in the rest of the region...

ext.ext_cn: 我希望这对今年余下的时间是个兆头。
ext.ext_en: I hope this is a portent for the rest of the year...

defs.def_en: A portent is something that indicates what is likely to happen in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 他在 20 世纪 70 年代作为一名社会讽刺作家声名鹊起。
ext.ext_en: He built a reputation in the 1970s as a social satirist.

defs.def_en: A satirist is someone who writes or uses satire.

ext.ext_cn: 暮色渐浓，变成了漆黑一片。
ext.ext_en: The twilight had turned to a deep blackness.

defs.def_en: Blackness is the state of being very dark.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 沃思先生机敏地把脚一伸，把其中一个袭击者给绊倒了。
ext.ext_en: With a deft flick of his foot, Mr Worth tripped one of the raiders up.

defs.def_en: A deft action is skilful and often quick.
If someone is your enemy, they hate you or want to harm you.

ext.ext_cn: 政府的政敌迅速借这一系列灾难向政府发难。
ext.ext_en: The Government's political enemies were quick to pick up on this series of disasters.

defs.def_en: If someone is your enemy, they are opposed to you and to what you think or do.

ext.ext_cn: 敌军被追击了两英里。
ext.ext_en: The enemy were pursued for two miles...

ext.ext_cn: 他在空中搜寻敌军轰炸机。
ext.ext_en: He searched the skies for enemy bombers.

defs.def_en: The enemy is an army or other force that is opposed to you in a war, or a country with which your country is at war.

ext.ext_cn: 正如我们所知，改革是革命的大敌。
ext.ext_en: Reform, as we know, is the enemy of revolution.

defs.def_en: If one thing is the enemy of another thing, the second thing cannot happen or succeed because of the first thing.

ext.ext_cn: 没有正规的厕所，只有一个位于室外的茅坑。
ext.ext_en: There were no proper toilets, but only an outdoor latrine...

ext.ext_cn: 他们逼我打扫茅厕。
ext.ext_en: They made me clean out the latrines.

defs.def_en: A latrine is a structure, usually consisting of a hole in the ground, that is used as a toilet, for example in a military camp.
Your little finger is the smallest finger on your hand.

ext.ext_cn: 油封鸭
ext.ext_en: ...confit of duck.

defs.def_en: Confit is meat such as goose or duck which has been cooked and preserved in its own fat.

ext.ext_cn: 他限制的是建筑物的种类和高度以及它们的用途。
ext.ext_en: The restrictions he imposed pertained to the type and height of buildings and the activities for which they could be used...

ext.ext_cn: 我宁愿你问楚克尔曼夫人的是与她本人相关的问题。
ext.ext_en: I would much rather that you asked Mrs Zuckerman any questions pertaining to herself.

defs.def_en: If one thing pertains to another, it relates, belongs, or applies to it.

ext.ext_cn: 她 17 岁生日刚过便生下了安娜贝尔。
ext.ext_en: She gave birth to Annabel just after her seventeenth birthday.

defs.def_en: The seventeenth item in a series is the one that you count as number seventeen.
A seventeenth is one of seventeen equal parts of something.

ext.ext_cn: 汽油价格猛涨
ext.ext_en: ...a sharp increase in the price of petrol...

ext.ext_cn: 他们盼望着房价上升。
ext.ext_en: They expected house prices to rise...

defs.def_en: The price of something is the amount of money that you have to pay in order to buy it.

ext.ext_cn: 斯洛文尼亚将为独立付出巨大的代价。
ext.ext_en: Slovenia will have to pay a high price for independence...

ext.ext_cn: 这样没命地工作可能要付出代价，也许是健康受损，甚至是离婚。
ext.ext_en: There may be a price to pay for such relentless activity, perhaps ill health or even divorce...

defs.def_en: The price that you pay for something that you want is an unpleasant thing that you have to do or suffer in order to get it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些股票的价格可能会定在330便士左右。
ext.ext_en: The shares are expected to be priced at about 330p...

ext.ext_cn: Digital公司新产品的定价比同类主机的一半还要低。
ext.ext_en: Digital priced the new line at less than half the cost of comparable mainframes...

defs.def_en: If something is priced at a particular amount, the price is set at that amount.

defs.def_cn: 不惜任何代价；不计后果

ext.ext_cn: 如果他们无论如何都想达成交易，他们就得承担其后果。
ext.ext_en: If they wanted a deal at any price, they would have to face the consequences...

ext.ext_cn: 我们显然也希望看到人质回家，但并不是不惜任何代价。
ext.ext_en: We obviously want to see the hostages home, but not at any price.

defs.def_en: If you want something at any price, you are determined to get it, even if unpleasant things happen as a result.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数商品都有售，但是价格极高。
ext.ext_en: Most goods are available, but at a price.

defs.def_en: If you can buy something that you want at a price, it is for sale, but it is extremely expensive.

ext.ext_cn: 出名是有代价的。
ext.ext_en: Fame comes at a price...

ext.ext_cn: 不过，泰斯曼付出了代价才得到这些宝贵的信息。
ext.ext_en: Theismann's precious information came at a price, however.

defs.def_en: If you get something that you want at a price, you get it but something unpleasant happens as a result.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管当局悬赏重金缉拿他，他仍旧逍遥法外。
ext.ext_en: He remains at large despite the high price put on his head by the authorities.

defs.def_en: If there is a price on someone's head, an amount of money has been offered for the capture or killing of that person.

ext.ext_cn: 友谊无价。
ext.ext_en: You can't put a price on friendship...

ext.ext_cn: 不能用金钱来衡量护士的工作。
ext.ext_en: You can't put a price on the value of the work done by our nurses.

defs.def_en: If you say that you cannot put a price on something, you mean that it is very valuable.

ext.ext_cn: 还有可能再次上演上周的辉煌胜利吗？
ext.ext_en: What price a glorious repeat of last week's triumph?

defs.def_en: You use what price in front of a word or expression that refers to something happening when you want to ask how likely it is to happen. You usually do this to emphasize either that it is very likely or very unlikely.

ext.ext_cn: 是的，他们离开了他，但是对他们自己、他们的家人以及那些留下来的人又有什么用呢？
ext.ext_en: Yes, they are free of him, but at what price to themselves, their families, those left behind?...

ext.ext_cn: 成功了又如何？
ext.ext_en: What price success!

defs.def_en: You use 'at what price ?' to comment on the fact that the consequences of doing something are unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 刚长羽毛的小鸟;刚学飞的幼鸟
defs.def_en: A fledgling is a young bird that has its feathers and is learning to fly.

defs.def_cn: 新手的;(组织或系统)新建的，没有经验的

ext.ext_cn: 他给初出茅庐的作家提出的可靠实用的建议
ext.ext_en: ...the sound practical advice he gave to fledgling writers.

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯新兴的民主
ext.ext_en: ...Russia's fledgling democracy.

defs.def_en: You use fledgling to describe a person, organization, or system that is new or without experience.

ext.ext_cn: 流放到“魔鬼岛”
ext.ext_en: ...banishment to 'Devil's Island'.

ext.ext_cn: 受逐退出政界和产业界
ext.ext_en: ...banishment from political and industrial life.

defs.def_en: Banishment is the act of banishing someone or the state of being banished.

ext.ext_cn: 父母担心音乐对青春期孩子的行为所产生的影响。
ext.ext_en: Parents worry about the effect of music on their adolescent's behavior...

ext.ext_cn: 财政紧缩政策不会对普通的摩洛哥人产生直接的负面影响。
ext.ext_en: The austerity measures will have little immediate adverse effect on the average Moroccan...

defs.def_en: The effect of one thing on another is the change that the first thing causes in the second thing.

ext.ext_cn: 整体效果很酷，轻松而随意。
ext.ext_en: The whole effect is cool, light and airy.

defs.def_en: An effect is an impression that someone creates deliberately, for example in a place or in a piece of writing.

ext.ext_cn: 他的女儿们当时正在整理他的遗物。
ext.ext_en: His daughters were collecting his effects.

defs.def_en: A person's effects are the things that they have with them at a particular time, for example when they are arrested or admitted to hospital, or the things that they owned when they died.
The effects in a film are the specially created sounds and scenery.

ext.ext_cn: 实现真正政治变革的机会似乎变得更加渺茫了。
ext.ext_en: Prospects for effecting real political change seemed to have taken a major step backwards.

defs.def_en: If you effect something that you are trying to achieve, you succeed in causing it to happen.

defs.def_cn: 为了给人印象;为了吸引注意力

ext.ext_cn: 乔克为了制造效果停下来又喝了口酒，他的眼睛在酒杯上方光芒闪烁。
ext.ext_en: Jock paused for effect, his eyes glinting over his glass as he took another drink...

ext.ext_cn: 这伦敦腔是为了给人以深刻印象而故意装出来的。
ext.ext_en: The Cockney accent was put on for effect.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is doing something for effect, you mean that they are doing it in order to impress people and to draw attention to themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 事实上，这一协议将促成世界最大航空公司的成立。
ext.ext_en: That deal would create, in effect, the world's biggest airline.

defs.def_en: You add in effect to a statement or opinion that is not precisely accurate, but which you feel is a reasonable description or summary of a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 这些以及其他类似的措施在1985年就应该开始实施了。
ext.ext_en: These and other such measures ought to have been put into effect in 1985.

ext.ext_cn: 上个月正式通过的实施政治改革的法令
ext.ext_en: ...a decree bringing into effect the political reforms adopted last month.

defs.def_en: If you put ,bring, or carry a plan or idea into effect, you cause it to happen in practice.

ext.ext_cn: 将于7月生效的禁止颁发新伐木许可证的禁令
ext.ext_en: ...the ban on new logging permits which will take effect from July...

ext.ext_cn: 该决定于昨天作出，在政府未有进一步指示前将一直有效。
ext.ext_en: The decision was taken yesterday and will remain in effect until further government instructions.

defs.def_en: If a law or policy takes effect or comes into effect at a particular time, it officially begins to apply or be valid from that time. If it remains in effect, it still applies or is still valid.

ext.ext_cn: 只有第一剂药见效后才可进行第二次注射。
ext.ext_en: The second injection should only have been given once the first drug had taken effect...

ext.ext_cn: 国际制裁开始起作用了。
ext.ext_en: International sanctions were beginning to take effect.

defs.def_en: You can say that something takes effect when it starts to produce the results that are intended.

defs.def_cn: 产生良好效果/毫无成效

ext.ext_cn: 莫里斯先生认为博物馆作的广告卓有成效。
ext.ext_en: Mr Morris feels the museum is using advertising to good effect...

ext.ext_cn: 查尔斯先生投诉无果。
ext.ext_en: Mr Charles complained, to no effect.

defs.def_en: You use effect in expressions such as to good effect and to no effect in order to indicate how successful or impressive an action is.

ext.ext_cn: 接下来的几周内将发布一份大意如此的通告。
ext.ext_en: A circular to this effect will be issued in the next few weeks...

ext.ext_cn: 那类立法在议会内外都引起了激烈的争论。
ext.ext_en: Legislation to that effect created fierce controversy both in Parliament and outside...

defs.def_en: You use to this effect ,to that effect, or to the effect that to indicate that you have given or are giving a summary of something that was said or written, and not the actual words used.

ext.ext_cn: 我们即刻起与叙利亚恢复关系。
ext.ext_en: We are now resuming relations with Syria with immediate effect...

ext.ext_cn: 自11月3日起，周六版价格将上调。
ext.ext_en: The price of the Saturday edition is going up with effect from 3 November.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen with immediate effect or with effect from a particular time, you mean that it will begin to apply or be valid immediately or from the stated time.
Washing-up liquid is a thick soapy liquid which you add to hot water to clean dirty dishes.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司现在报价 3,900 英镑安装双层玻璃窗。
ext.ext_en: The company is now offering to double-glaze the windows for £3,900...

ext.ext_cn: 最近我们给房子装了双层玻璃窗。
ext.ext_en: We recently had our house double-glazed.

defs.def_en: If someone double-glazes a house or its windows, they fit windows that have two layers of glass which keeps the inside of the house warmer and quieter.

ext.ext_cn: 大联盟运河
ext.ext_en: ...the Grand Union Canal.

ext.ext_cn: 威尼斯水道和桥梁
ext.ext_en: ...Venetian canals and bridges.

defs.def_en: A canal is a long, narrow stretch of water that has been made for boats to travel along or to bring water to a particular area.

defs.def_cn: (人体内输送食物、空气等的)管,道

ext.ext_cn: 延缓食物通过消化道
ext.ext_en: ...delaying the food's progress through the alimentary canal.

defs.def_en: A canal is a narrow tube inside your body for carrying food, air, or other substances.

ext.ext_cn: 福特公司和IBM公司等跨国公司
ext.ext_en: ...multinationals such as Ford and IBM.

ext.ext_cn: 福特公司和IBM公司等跨国公司
ext.ext_en: ...multinationals such as Ford and IBM.

defs.def_en: A multinational company has branches or owns companies in many different countries.

defs.def_cn: (军队、组织或团体)人员来自不同国家的，国际的

ext.ext_cn: 美军将是多国部队的一个组成部分。
ext.ext_en: The US troops would be part of a multinational force.

defs.def_en: Multinational armies, organizations, or other groups involve people from several different countries.
Multinational countries or regions have a population that is made up of people of several different nationalities.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他没有亲眼目睹她被处决，但他和其他人对她的死都难脱干系。
ext.ext_en: He did not witness her execution, yet he and the others are complicit in her death...

ext.ext_cn: 据说一位没有举报这起虐待事件的母亲与此有牵连。
ext.ext_en: A mother who does not report the abuse is said to be complicit.

defs.def_en: If someone is complicit in a crime or unfair activity, they are involved in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他太粗心大意,竟然没锁车库的门。
ext.ext_en: He carelessly left the garage door unlocked...

ext.ext_cn: “噢,”他漫不经心地说道,“我不急着回去。”
ext.ext_en: 'Oh,' he said carelessly. 'I'm in no hurry to get back.'

defs.def_en: See also:careless;If someone does something carelessly, they do it without much thought or effort.

ext.ext_cn: 暴力和违法事件时有发生、被本市很多市民视为危险区域的地铁系统
ext.ext_en: ...a subway system whose reputation for violence and lawlessness makes it a no-go area for many natives of the city.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a place as a no-go area, you mean that it has a reputation for violence and crime which makes people frightened to go there.

defs.def_cn: (以武力控制的)禁止入内地区，禁区

ext.ext_cn: 总统官邸区域在下午6点钟后禁止进入。
ext.ext_en: The area of the President's residence is a no-go area after six p.m...

ext.ext_cn: 安全部队进入了爱尔兰共和军的禁区。
ext.ext_en: The security forces entered the IRA's  no-go areas.

defs.def_en: A no-go area is a place which is controlled by a group of people who use force to prevent other people from entering it.

defs.def_cn: 保全面子的行为(或借口)
defs.def_en: A face-saver is an action or excuse which prevents damage to your reputation or the loss of people's respect for you.

defs.def_cn: 迫使…接受;把…强加于;强人所难

ext.ext_cn: 我们为什么要遭这份罪？
ext.ext_en: Why has such sadness been thrust upon us?...

ext.ext_cn: 她本来不想当女王的，但还是被迫接受了这一身份。
ext.ext_en: She had not wanted to be Queen, but the role was thrust upon her...

defs.def_en: If something is thrust upon you, you are forced to have it, deal with it, or experience it.

ext.ext_cn: 后女权主义时代
ext.ext_en: ...the post-feminist age.

defs.def_en: Post-feminist people and attitudes accept some of the ideas of feminism, but reject others.

ext.ext_cn: 舞蹈演员们觉得自己的作品赋予人力量，后女权主义者则认为那完全是荒诞不经。
ext.ext_en: The dancers say they find their work empowering, and post-feminists think that's just fantastic.

defs.def_en: A post-feminist is someone who accepts some of the ideas of feminism, but rejects others.

defs.def_cn: (费力或不方便地)携带,搬运，拖曳

ext.ext_cn: 你不只是背着吉他艰难地从一家乡村俱乐部转到另一家。
ext.ext_en: You didn't just schlep your guitar around from folk club to folk club.

defs.def_en: If you schlep something somewhere, you take it there although this is difficult or inconvenient.

ext.ext_cn: 天太冷，不适合到处去看房子。
ext.ext_en: It's too cold to schlepp around looking at property.

defs.def_en: If you schlep somewhere, you go there.

defs.def_cn: 蠢货;笨蛋;笨手笨脚的人
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a schlep, you mean that they are stupid or clumsy.

ext.ext_cn: 她走过地板躺在了床上。
ext.ext_en: She walked across the floor and lay down on the bed...

ext.ext_cn: 他看着卡尔向街对面的汤米跑去。
ext.ext_en: He watched Karl run across the street to Tommy.

defs.def_en: If someone or something goes across a place or a boundary, they go from one side of it to the other.

ext.ext_cn: 横跨在西雅图华盛顿湖上的浮桥
ext.ext_en: ...the floating bridge across Lake Washington in Seattle...

ext.ext_cn: 他在账单上草草地签了名。
ext.ext_en: He scrawled his name across the bill...

defs.def_en: If something is situated or stretched across something else, it is situated or stretched from one side of it to the other.

ext.ext_cn: 她发现自己的衣服堆放在椅子上。
ext.ext_en: She found her clothes lying across the chair...

ext.ext_cn: 他的发丝随风拂面。
ext.ext_en: The wind pushed his hair across his face.

defs.def_en: If something is lying across an object or place, it is resting on it and partly covering it.

ext.ext_cn: 马路对面房子里的任何一个人都能看见他。
ext.ext_en: Anyone from the houses across the road could see him...

ext.ext_cn: 我在房间那头看见你时就知道我曾见过你。
ext.ext_en: When I saw you across the room I knew I'd met you before.

defs.def_en: Something that is across something such as a street, river, or area is on the other side of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他朝熟睡的妻子看了一眼。
ext.ext_en: He glanced across at his sleeping wife...

ext.ext_cn: 她从椅子上站起身，远远地看着他。
ext.ext_en: She rose from the chair and gazed across at him.

defs.def_en: If you look across at a place, person, or thing, you look towards them.

ext.ext_cn: 他咧着大嘴笑了。
ext.ext_en: An enormous grin spread across his face...

ext.ext_cn: 一瞬间罗伊脸上似乎闪过一丝忧伤。
ext.ext_en: For a moment a shadow seemed to pass across Roy's face.

defs.def_en: You use across to say that a particular expression is shown on someone's face.

ext.ext_cn: 格雷厄姆用枪击打他的脸部。
ext.ext_en: Graham hit him across the face with the gun.

defs.def_en: If someone hits you across the face or head, they hit you on that part.

ext.ext_cn: 电影《铁钩船长》12月11日在美国全线上映。
ext.ext_en: The film 'Hook' opens across America on December 11...

ext.ext_cn: 来自欧洲各地的数千农民在布鲁塞尔市中心举行了大规模的示威游行。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of farmers from across Europe have held a huge demonstration in the centre of Brussels...

defs.def_en: When something happens across a place or organization, it happens equally everywhere within it.

defs.def_cn: 超越，跨越（政治、宗教、社会隔阂等）

ext.ext_cn: 政治纷争中的各党派
ext.ext_en: ...parties competing across the political spectrum...

ext.ext_cn: 我们想推销各种肤色的人都喜欢的化妆品。
ext.ext_en: We want to promote cosmetics that appeal across the colour barrier.

defs.def_en: When something happens across a political, religious, or social barrier, it involves people in different groups.  across the board→see: board;

ext.ext_cn: 这个手绘盘子直径为30厘米。
ext.ext_en: This hand-decorated plate measures 30cm across...

ext.ext_cn: 这些蜗牛体宽不超过1厘米。
ext.ext_en: The snails are no larger than one centimetre across.

defs.def_en: Across is used in measurements to show the width of something.

ext.ext_cn: 她穿了一条蓝色的牛仔裤。
ext.ext_en: She was dressed in blue denims.

defs.def_en: Denims are casual trousers made of denim.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 鬃毛长而柔韧的毛笔
ext.ext_en: ...brushes with long, flexible bristles.

defs.def_en: A flexible object or material can be bent easily without breaking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 易变通的;适应性强的;灵活的

ext.ext_cn: 寻找功能多、适用性强的软件。
ext.ext_en: Look for software that's flexible enough for a range of abilities.

ext.ext_cn: 灵活的工作时间
ext.ext_en: ...flexible working hours.

defs.def_en: Something or someone that is flexible is able to change easily and adapt to different conditions and circumstances as they occur.
Magnesium is a light silvery-white metal which burns with a bright white flame.

defs.def_cn: 点缀着…的;夹杂着…的;散布着…的

ext.ext_cn: 炮声阵阵,夹杂着零星的枪响
ext.ext_en: ...bursts of gunfire, interspersed with single shots.

ext.ext_cn: 有竹林点缀其间的一片混交林风景区
ext.ext_en: ...a landscape of mixed forest interspersed with bamboo groves.

defs.def_en: If one group of things are interspersed with another or interspersed among another, the second things occur between or among the first things.

defs.def_cn: （花期前移入花坛、花期后移走的）花坛植物
defs.def_en: A bedding plant is a plant which lasts for one year. It is put in a flower bed before it flowers, and is then removed when it has finished flowering.

defs.def_cn: 弗拉明科舞(西班牙舞蹈，以一种特殊的吉他乐伴奏)
defs.def_en: Flamenco is a Spanish dance that is danced to a special type of guitar music.

defs.def_cn: (通常指针对老人、学生和失业人员的)优惠的，减价的

ext.ext_cn: 学生享有优惠价。
ext.ext_en: There are concessionary rates for students.

defs.def_en: A concessionary price is a special price which is lower than the normal one and which is often given to old people, students, and the unemployed.
Selves is the plural of self .

ext.ext_cn: 旅客通过入境检查后领取了自己的行李。
ext.ext_en: The passengers went through  immigration control and collected their baggage.

ext.ext_cn: 超重行李
ext.ext_en: ...excess baggage.

defs.def_en: Your baggage consists of the bags that you take with you when you travel.

ext.ext_cn: 他背负着多重的感情包袱开始这段恋情？
ext.ext_en: How much emotional baggage is he bringing with him into the relationship?

ext.ext_cn: 法西斯主义在意识形态方面的偏执
ext.ext_en: ...the ideological baggage of Fascism.

defs.def_en: You can use baggage to refer to someone's emotional problems, fixed ideas, or prejudices.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定句）一点，丝毫，若干，任何

ext.ext_cn: 我从未作过任何重大决定。
ext.ext_en: I never make any big decisions...

ext.ext_cn: 我不会作任何保证。
ext.ext_en: I'm not making any promises...

defs.def_en: You use any in statements with negative meaning to indicate that no thing or person of a particular type exists, is present, or is involved in a situation.

defs.def_cn: （用于疑问句或条件从句）若干，一点，什么，任何一个（或一些）

ext.ext_cn: 你会说外语吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you speak any foreign languages?...

ext.ext_cn: 观众当中有女士吗？
ext.ext_en: Are there any ladies in the audience?...

defs.def_en: You use any in questions and conditional clauses to ask whether there is some of a particular thing or some of a particular group of people, or to suggest that there might be.

ext.ext_cn: 每一个演员都会告诉你演戏比做自己容易。
ext.ext_en: Any actor will tell you that it is easier to perform than to be themselves...

ext.ext_cn: 我愿意接受任何忠告。
ext.ext_en: I'm prepared to take any advice...

defs.def_en: You use any in positive statements when you are referring to someone or something of a particular kind that might exist, occur, or be involved in a situation, when their exact identity or nature is not important.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定句中强调形容词或副词的比较级）任何，丝毫，略微，多少

ext.ext_cn: 我没看出毕业生的境遇有丝毫好转。
ext.ext_en: I can't see things getting any easier for graduates...

ext.ext_cn: 安妮一点没有变年轻。
ext.ext_en: Anne's not getting any younger.

defs.def_en: You can also use any to emphasize a comparative adjective or adverb in a negative statement.

ext.ext_cn: 芬泽不是个普通的东海岸生意人。
ext.ext_en: Finzer is not just any East Coast businessman...

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人穿旅游鞋很时尚，但不是说所有的旅游鞋都如此。
ext.ext_en: It's fashionable for young people to wear trainers, but not just any trainers.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is not just any person or thing, you mean that they are special in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 我不想再见到她。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to see her any more...

ext.ext_cn: 我们觉得我们没有了家，也没有了家人，一无所有。
ext.ext_en: We felt we had no home any more, no family, nothing...

defs.def_en: If something does not happen or is not true any more or any longer, it has stopped happening or is no longer true.

ext.ext_cn: 市长概述了他整顿市容的计划。
ext.ext_en: The mayor outlined his plan to clean up the town's image...

ext.ext_cn: 本书概括的一些方法仅供参考。
ext.ext_en: The methods outlined in this book are only suggestions.

defs.def_en: If you outline an idea or a plan, you explain it in a general way.

ext.ext_cn: 以下是调查结果概要。
ext.ext_en: Following is an outline of the survey findings...

ext.ext_cn: 国务卿对提议进行了简要的概述。
ext.ext_en: The proposals were given in outline by the Secretary of State.

defs.def_en: An outline is a general explanation or description of something.

defs.def_cn: （因背后的光线）显示…的轮廓（或外形）

ext.ext_cn: 高悬的灯光映照出里兹饭店的轮廓。
ext.ext_en: The Ritz was outlined against the lights up there...

ext.ext_cn: 星空之上映衬出美景。
ext.ext_en: It was a beautiful sight outlined above the starry sky.

defs.def_en: You say that an object is outlined when you can see its general shape because there is light behind it.

ext.ext_cn: 他只能看见球门柱模糊的轮廓。
ext.ext_en: He could see only the hazy outline of the goalposts.

defs.def_en: The outline of something is its general shape, especially when it cannot be clearly seen.
A canoe is a small, narrow boat that you move through the water using a stick with a wide end called a paddle.

ext.ext_cn: 我当然不会嫉妒他得了诺贝尔奖。
ext.ext_en: I certainly don't begrudge him the Nobel Prize.

defs.def_en: If you do not begrudge someone something, you do not feel angry, upset, or jealous that they have got it.

ext.ext_cn: 我不在乎自己丢的钱。
ext.ext_en: I do not begrudge the money I have lost.

defs.def_en: If you do not begrudge something such as time or money, you do not mind giving it up.

ext.ext_cn: 很多伤者面容严重受损。
ext.ext_en: Many of the wounded had been badly disfigured.

defs.def_en: If someone is disfigured, their appearance is spoiled.

defs.def_cn: 破坏…的外形;毁损…的外观

ext.ext_cn: 风力涡轮机个头大、噪音响，还会破坏周边风景。
ext.ext_en: Wind turbines are large and noisy and they disfigure the landscape.

defs.def_en: To disfigure an object or a place means to spoil its appearance.

ext.ext_cn: 很多人正处于经济困难之中。
ext.ext_en: Many people are suffering economic hardship...

ext.ext_cn: 最大的痛苦之一是几乎没有时间和家人在一起。
ext.ext_en: One of the worst hardships is having so little time to spend with one's family.

defs.def_en: Hardship is a situation in which your life is difficult or unpleasant, often because you do not have enough money.

defs.def_cn: 自理膳食的;自供伙食的

ext.ext_cn: 膳食自理的马略卡岛一周游的费用为 239 英镑
ext.ext_en: ...a week's self-catering in Majorca for £239...

ext.ext_cn: 可以自己做饭的公寓一般留给研究生住。
ext.ext_en: The self-catering flats are usually reserved for postgraduate students.

defs.def_en: If you go on a self-catering holiday or you stay in self-catering accommodation, you stay in a place where you have to make your own meals.

defs.pos_cn: 表示说话时的语气或感情
defs.def_cn: （got you的非规范发音的书写形式）

ext.ext_cn: “他答对了，海伦。该表扬这个男孩。”
ext.ext_en: 'He gotcha, Helen. Give the boy credit.'...

ext.ext_cn: “我可逮着你了，是不是？”
ext.ext_en: 'Gotcha, didn't I?'

defs.def_en: Gotcha is used in written English to represent the words 'got you' when they are pronounced informally.

ext.ext_cn: 巴德死后6个月，这座房子被烧毁。
ext.ext_en: Six months after Bud died, the house burned down...

ext.ext_cn: 无政府主义者把一家饭店烧成平地。
ext.ext_en: Anarchists burnt down a restaurant.

defs.def_en: If a building burns down or if someone burns it down, it is completely destroyed by fire.

ext.ext_cn: 赫伯特提议喝点儿威士忌来“驱寒”。
ext.ext_en: Herbert offered whisky 'to drive out the chill'...

ext.ext_cn: 他降低价格以便挤走竞争对手。
ext.ext_en: He cut his rates to drive out rivals.

defs.def_en: To drive out something means to make it disappear or stop operating.

defs.def_cn: (尤指员工参与决策的)全面质量管理

ext.ext_cn: 全面质量管理的主题之一是员工参与。
ext.ext_en: One of the main themes of TQM is employee involvement...

ext.ext_cn: 在全面质量管理原则下，对质量的追求是持续不断的。
ext.ext_en: Under TQM principles the search for quality is continuous.

defs.def_en: TQM is a set of management principles aimed at improving performance throughout a company, especially by involving employees in decision-making. TQM is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'total quality management'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有报酬的;有酬劳的;有偿的

ext.ext_cn: 一个医生建议她去找有酬劳的工作。
ext.ext_en: A doctor advised her to seek remunerative employment.

defs.def_en: Remunerative work is work that you are paid for.
If you have a perm, your hair is curled and treated with chemicals so that it stays curly for several months.

ext.ext_cn: 她表兄是美发师，正在免费给她烫发。
ext.ext_en: Her cousin, a hairdresser, was perming her hair as a special treat...

ext.ext_cn: 她烫了发。
ext.ext_en: She had her hair permed.

defs.def_en: When a hair stylist perms someone's hair, they curl it and treat it with chemicals so that it stays curly for several months.

defs.def_cn: 从他人经验中获得的;间接感受到的

ext.ext_cn: 她幻想过着各种奇妙的生活，从想入非非中获得乐趣。
ext.ext_en: She invents fantasy lives for her own vicarious pleasure...

ext.ext_cn: 许多人从电视中间接感受社会生活。
ext.ext_en: Lots of people use television as their vicarious form of social life.

defs.def_en: A vicarious pleasure or feeling is experienced by watching, listening to, or reading about other people doing something, rather than by doing it yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 她与同居伴侣共住这一间公寓。
ext.ext_en: She shared the apartment with her live-in partner.

defs.def_en: A live-in partner is someone who lives in the same house as the person they are having a sexual relationship with, but is not married to them.

defs.def_cn: （佣人等在雇主家）寄居的，寄住的

ext.ext_cn: 我为小女儿请了个住家保姆。
ext.ext_en: I have a live-in nanny for my youngest daughter.

defs.def_en: A live-in servant or other domestic worker sleeps and eats in the house where they work.

defs.def_cn: （雇主）封厂，闭厂（以逼迫工人接受新的薪资或工作条件）
defs.def_en: A lock-out is a situation in which employers close a place of work and prevent workers from entering it until the workers accept the employer's new proposals on pay or conditions of work.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沉迷的；痴迷的；神魂颠倒的

ext.ext_cn: 他被她迷得神魂颠倒，连孩子都抛到了九霄云外。
ext.ext_en: He became so besotted with her that even his children were forgotten.

defs.def_en: If you are besotted with someone or something, you like them so much that you seem foolish or silly.

ext.ext_cn: 在世界杯比赛开始时我们有两三场比赛失利，但后来我们又恢复了状态。
ext.ext_en: We lost two or three early games in the World Cup, but we bounced back...

ext.ext_cn: 他还年轻，会很快从失望沮丧中恢复过来的。
ext.ext_en: He is young enough to bounce back from this disappointment.

defs.def_en: If you bounce back after a bad experience, you return very quickly to your previous level of success, enthusiasm, or activity.
Plastic wrap is a thin, clear, stretchy plastic which you use to cover food to keep it fresh.

defs.def_cn: 二分时刻，昼夜平分日（指春分或秋分）

ext.ext_cn: 在中国历法中，春分总是出现在2月。
ext.ext_en: In the Chinese calendar, the Spring Equinox always occurs in the second month.

defs.def_en: An equinox is one of the two days in the year when day and night are of equal length.
A gearbox is the system of gears in an engine or vehicle.
A horse show is a sporting event in which people riding horses compete in order to demonstrate their skill and control.

ext.ext_cn: 国会投票否决了改变工会结构的动议。
ext.ext_en: The Congress voted down a motion to change the union's structure...

ext.ext_cn: 如果他要求太多，工会就会投票撤换他。
ext.ext_en: If he demands too much, the unions will vote him down.

defs.def_en: If people vote down a person or their proposal, they reject that person or proposal, usually as a result of a formal vote.

defs.def_cn: 用于支付…的部分款项；作为对…的部分付款

ext.ext_cn: 公共事业总支出的1%最终应当花在艺术事业上。
ext.ext_en: One per cent of total public spending should eventually go towards the arts...

ext.ext_cn: 根据新方案，将投入更多的资金提高训练水平。
ext.ext_en: Under the new approach more money will go towards improving the standard of training.

defs.def_en: If an amount of money goes towards something, it is used to pay part of the cost of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他说话明显结巴。
ext.ext_en: He spoke with a pronounced stutter.

defs.def_en: If someone has a stutter, they find it difficult to say the first sound of a word, and so they often hesitate or repeat it two or three times.

ext.ext_cn: 我抖得厉害，感觉说话舌头会打结。
ext.ext_en: I was trembling so hard, I thought I would stutter when I spoke.

defs.def_en: If someone stutters, they have difficulty speaking because they find it hard to say the first sound of a word.

defs.def_cn: 缓慢地颠簸前进;曲折缓慢地进行

ext.ext_cn: 这辆旧卡车在蜿蜒的公路上缓慢地颠簸前行。
ext.ext_en: The old truck stuttered along the winding road...

ext.ext_cn: 政治辩论一波三折地艰难进行着。
ext.ext_en: The political debate stutters on.

defs.def_en: If something stutters along, it progresses slowly and unevenly.

ext.ext_cn: 知道所有员工的名字是有良好教养的一种体现。
ext.ext_en: It's a sign of good breeding to know the names of all your staff.

ext.ext_cn: 出身低微、缺乏教养的男人们
ext.ext_en: ...men of low birth and no breeding.

defs.def_en: See also:breed;If someone says that a person has breeding, they mean that they think the person is from a good social background and has good manners.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人愉快的；使人高兴的

ext.ext_cn: 这个晚上最让人高兴的就是精彩的焰火表演。
ext.ext_en: The most pleasurable experience of the evening was the wonderful fireworks display...

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得驾驶帆船比滑雪更好玩。
ext.ext_en: He found sailing more pleasurable than skiing.

defs.def_en: Pleasurable experiences or sensations are pleasant and enjoyable.
A vest is a piece of underwear which you can wear on the top half of your body in order to keep warm.
A vest is a sleeveless piece of clothing with buttons which people usually wear over a shirt.

defs.def_cn: 授予，赋予，给予（权利或责任）

ext.ext_cn: 女性被赋予了所有权力，履行所有公共职责。
ext.ext_en: All authority was vested in the woman, who discharged every kind of public duty...

ext.ext_cn: 在现代发达社会中，作为社会和政治媒介，大众传媒被赋予了很大的权力。
ext.ext_en: The mass media have been vested with significant power as social and political agents in modern developed societies...

defs.def_en: If something is vested in you, or if you are vested with it, it is given to you as a right or responsibility.

defs.def_cn: 不再有用的人(或事物);累赘;冗余

ext.ext_cn: 认为历史语言学完全冗赘无用的观点
ext.ext_en: ...the idea that historical linguistics is so much dead wood.

defs.def_en: People or things that have been used for a very long time and that are no longer considered to be useful can be referred to as dead wood .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 荒凉的;荒芜的;荒废的;无人烟的

ext.ext_cn: 平坦绿野被沼泽割裂开的荒凉景色
ext.ext_en: ...a desolate landscape of flat green fields broken by marsh...

ext.ext_cn: 这里大半遭毁，几乎没有一栋建筑完好无损，变成了一块荒废之地。
ext.ext_en: Half-ruined, hardly a building untouched, it's a desolate place.

defs.def_en: A desolate place is empty of people and lacking in comfort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 凄凉的;孤寂的;孤独忧伤的

ext.ext_cn: 没有她，他感到孤独而凄凉。
ext.ext_en: He was desolate without her.

defs.def_en: If someone is desolate, they feel very sad, alone, and without hope.

ext.ext_cn: 他们总是等待并要求得到更多资财的倾向让林肯总统甚感不快。
ext.ext_en: Their inclination to wait and demand more resources desolated President Lincoln.

defs.def_en: If something desolates you, it upsets you and makes you very unhappy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （书籍、讨论）高深难懂的，高雅的，学术性的

ext.ext_cn: 高雅的古典音乐
ext.ext_en: ...highbrow classical music...

ext.ext_cn: 他介绍了自己那个专业性很强的文学项目的情况。
ext.ext_en: He presents his own highbrow literary programme.

defs.def_en: If you say that a book or discussion is highbrow, you mean that it is intellectual, academic, and is often difficult to understand.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人）对高深学问感兴趣的，修养（或品味）高雅的

ext.ext_cn: 品位高雅的批评家们轻蔑地表示，该节目“太深奥”，对多数观众没有吸引力。
ext.ext_en: Highbrow critics sniff that the programme was 'too sophisticated' to appeal to most viewers.

ext.ext_cn: 品味高雅者的窃笑
ext.ext_en: ...the sniggers of the highbrows.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as highbrow, you mean that they are interested in serious subjects of a very intellectual nature, especially when these are difficult to understand.

defs.def_cn: （橡胶或塑料制的）水管，水龙带

ext.ext_cn: 你忘了关花园里的水管了。
ext.ext_en: You've left the garden hose on...

ext.ext_cn: 消防员展开水龙带，开始冲着烧焦的谷仓喷水。
ext.ext_en: The firemen unwrapped their hoses and began dousing the scorched grain silos.

defs.def_en: A hose is a long, flexible pipe made of rubber or plastic. Water is directed through a hose in order to do things such as put out fires, clean cars, or water gardens.

defs.def_cn: （引导液体或气体的）橡胶（或塑料）软管，导管

ext.ext_cn: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管抽走。
ext.ext_en: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.

defs.def_en: A hose is a pipe made of rubber or plastic, along which a liquid or gas flows, for example from one part of an engine to another.

ext.ext_cn: 我们洗车和浇灌花园时根本就没有想过用了多少水。
ext.ext_en: We wash our cars and hose our gardens without even thinking of the water that uses.

defs.def_en: If you hose something, you wash or water it using a hose.

defs.def_cn: 袜类（包括连裤袜、长筒袜、短袜）

ext.ext_cn: 如果患了静脉曲张，可以考虑穿弹力护腿袜。
ext.ext_en: If you have varicose veins, consider wearing elastic support hose.

defs.def_en: See also:panty hose;Hose is used to refer to tights, socks, and stockings.
Hose is an old-fashioned men's garment that looks like a pair of very tight trousers.

ext.ext_cn: 在先前和政府的工资纠纷中他们赢了。
ext.ext_en: They have won previous pay disputes with the government...

ext.ext_cn: 谈判者未能消弭欧共体和美国之间在削减农民补贴一事上的争端。
ext.ext_en: Negotiators failed to resolve the bitter dispute between the European Community and the United States over cutting subsides to farmers.

defs.def_en: A dispute is an argument or disagreement between people or groups.

defs.def_cn: 质疑(事实、声明或理论)；对…表示异议

ext.ext_cn: 他对指控表示怀疑。
ext.ext_en: He disputed the allegations...

ext.ext_cn: 没有人怀疑戴维是聪明的。
ext.ext_en: Nobody disputed that Davey was clever...

defs.def_en: If you dispute a fact, statement, or theory, you say that it is incorrect or untrue.

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯和乌克兰一直在争夺舰队的所有权。
ext.ext_en: Russia and Ukraine have been disputing the ownership of the fleet...

ext.ext_cn: 布里斯托尔的渔民与丹麦人争夺捕鱼权。
ext.ext_en: Fishermen from Bristol disputed fishing rights with the Danes.

defs.def_en: When people dispute something, they fight for control or ownership of it. You can also say that one group of people dispute something with another group.

ext.ext_cn: 两国在近海水域分界线上尚存分歧。
ext.ext_en: The two countries are in dispute over the boundaries of their coastal waters...

ext.ext_cn: 目前在定价上和政府还有争议。
ext.ext_en: It is currently in dispute with the government over price fixing.

defs.def_en: If two or more people or groups are in dispute, they are arguing or disagreeing about something.

ext.ext_cn: 所有这些事项都尚无定论，也不是我可以决定的。
ext.ext_en: All those matters are in dispute and it is not for me to decide them.

defs.def_en: If something is in dispute, people are questioning it or arguing about it.
A guava is a round yellow tropical fruit with pink or white flesh and hard seeds.

ext.ext_cn: 对于这种事，发火不见得是最有用或最能被接受的反应。
ext.ext_en: Anger is not necessarily the most useful or acceptable reaction to such events...

ext.ext_cn: 速度和安全未必不相容。
ext.ext_en: Speed and safety are not necessarily incompatible...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not necessarily the case, you mean that it may not be the case or is not always the case.

ext.ext_cn: 最值得拥有的财产必然要价不菲。
ext.ext_en: The most desirable properties necessarily command astonishingly high prices...

ext.ext_cn: 旅游业是与政府有着必然的密切联系的产业。
ext.ext_en: Tourism is an industry that has a necessarily close connection with governments.

defs.def_en: If you say that something necessarily happens or is the case, you mean that it has to happen or be the case and cannot be any different.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 迷上戏剧表演的;一心想当演员的
defs.def_en: Someone who is stage-struck is fascinated by the theatre and wants to become an actor or actress.
See also:snowplough;A plough is a large farming tool with sharp blades which is pulled across the soil to turn it over, usually before seeds are planted.

ext.ext_cn: 他们犁了将近10万英亩未开垦的高沼地。
ext.ext_en: They ploughed nearly 100,000 acres of virgin moorland.

ext.ext_cn: 仔细犁过的田地
ext.ext_en: ...a carefully ploughed field.

defs.def_en: When someone ploughs an area of land, they turn over the soil using a plough.

ext.ext_cn: 没有一寸土地未被开垦成耕地。
ext.ext_en: There was not one inch of soil that was not under the plough.

ext.ext_cn: 随着我们将越来越多的荒地开垦成耕地
ext.ext_en: ...as we put more and more wilderness under the plough.

defs.def_en: If an area of land is under the plough, it is used for growing crops. If land is brought or put under the plough, it is ploughed for the first time and is then used for growing crops.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (与人说话时)爱碰别人的，有肢体接触的

ext.ext_cn: 小孩子说话时喜欢用上热烈、表达喜爱的肢体触碰。
ext.ext_en: The children are very tactile with warm, loving natures.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as tactile, you mean that they tend to touch other people a lot when talking to them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 粗花呢从不过时，手感很好，结实耐磨。
ext.ext_en: Tweed is timeless, tactile and tough.

defs.def_en: Something such as fabric which is tactile is pleasant or interesting to touch.

defs.def_cn: (经验、感觉)触觉的，通过触觉获得的

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿和父母睡在一块儿比单独睡在婴儿床中能得到更多的触觉刺激。
ext.ext_en: Babies who sleep with their parents receive much more tactile stimulation than babies who sleep in a cot...

ext.ext_cn: 热、冷、触觉和其他感觉构成了食物风味的一部分。
ext.ext_en: Heat, cold, tactile and other sensations contribute to flavour.

defs.def_en: Tactile experiences or sensations are received or felt by touch.

defs.def_cn: (宾馆、饭店或俱乐部供应酒类饮料的)休息室，酒吧间

ext.ext_cn: 我们在希尔顿酒店的酒吧间碰头吧。
ext.ext_en: Let's meet in the cocktail lounge at the Hilton.

defs.def_en: A cocktail lounge is a room in a hotel, restaurant, or club where you can buy alcoholic drinks.

ext.ext_cn: 他准备在 60 岁生日那天退休。
ext.ext_en: He is to retire on his sixtieth birthday.

defs.def_en: The sixtieth item in a series is the one that you count as number sixty.
A sixtieth is one of sixty equal parts of something.

ext.ext_cn: 大约900兆赫的超高频率
ext.ext_en: ...UHF frequencies of around 900 megahertz.

defs.def_en: A megahertz is a unit of frequency, used especially for radio frequencies. One megahertz equals one million cycles per second.

defs.def_cn: 纵火的;放火的;能引起燃烧的

ext.ext_cn: 在她家里发现了5个纵火装置。
ext.ext_en: Five incendiary devices were found in her house.

ext.ext_cn: 对商店纵火袭击
ext.ext_en: ...incendiary attacks on shops.

defs.def_en: Incendiary weapons or attacks are ones that cause large fires.

ext.ext_cn: 燃烧弹密集落下，击中了歌剧院。
ext.ext_en: A shower of incendiaries struck the Opera House.

defs.def_en: An incendiary is an incendiary bomb.
A site map is a plan of a website showing what is on it and providing links to the different sections.

ext.ext_cn: 该阵线采用激进的宣传手段对付它的对手。
ext.ext_en: The Front adopted an aggressive propaganda campaign against its rivals.

ext.ext_cn: 反欧洲的宣传影片
ext.ext_en: ...anti-European propaganda movies.

defs.def_en: Propaganda is information, often inaccurate information, which a political organization publishes or broadcasts in order to influence people.

defs.def_cn: 圣痕，圣伤(人体出现的与耶稣被钉在十字架时相同部位的伤痕)
defs.def_en: Stigmata are marks that appear on a person's body in the same places where Christ was wounded when he was nailed to the cross. Some Christians believe that these marks are a sign of holiness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 现代武器残忍的毁灭性
ext.ext_en: ...the devilish destructiveness of modern weapons.

defs.def_en: A devilish idea or action is cruel or unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极大的;极度的;极其困难的

ext.ext_cn: 极大的谜
ext.ext_en: ...a devilish puzzle.

ext.ext_cn: 我真是太幸运了。
ext.ext_en: I'd been devilish lucky.

defs.def_en: You can use devilish to emphasize how extreme or difficult something is.

ext.ext_cn: 边沿上的针脚已经开始磨损了。
ext.ext_en: The stitching had begun to fray at the edges...

ext.ext_cn: 用红线缝上了一枚星章。
ext.ext_en: A star was done in red stitching.

defs.def_en: Stitching is a row of stitches that have been sewn in a piece of cloth.

ext.ext_cn: 我们刚进屋，大雨便倾盆而下。
ext.ext_en: As soon as we were inside, the rain began to bucket down...

ext.ext_cn: 如果不是大雨和狂风，我本可以欣赏到极其美丽的风景。
ext.ext_en: If it hadn't been bucketing down with rain and blowing a gale, I would have had a glorious view.

defs.def_en: If the rain buckets down, or if it buckets down with rain, it rains very heavily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 头脑简单的;天真的;愚蠢的

ext.ext_cn: 西尔维是个天真的爱幻想的人。
ext.ext_en: Sylvie was a simple-minded romantic...

ext.ext_cn: 他的政治观点也很愚蠢。
ext.ext_en: His politics were also simple-minded.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as simple-minded, you believe that they interpret things in a way that is too simple and do not understand how complicated things are.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎十分独立，你不在的时候也并不想念你。
ext.ext_en: He seems completely self-contained and he doesn't miss you when you're not there...

ext.ext_cn: 独立自足的经济集团
ext.ext_en: ...self-contained economic blocs.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone or something as self-contained when they are complete and separate and do not need help or resources from outside.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (住宿场所)设施齐全的，独门独户的
defs.def_en: Self-contained accommodation such as a flat has all its own facilities, so that a person living there does not have to share rooms such as a kitchen or bathroom with other people.

ext.ext_cn: 他们坐在一棵高大的山毛榉树下的草坪上。
ext.ext_en: They were sitting on the lawn under a large beech tree.

defs.def_en: A lawn is an area of grass that is kept cut short and is usually part of someone's garden or backyard, or part of a park.

defs.def_cn: 女经理，女管理人（有些女性更愿意被称为manager）

ext.ext_cn: 彩票经营点的女经理
ext.ext_en: ...the manageress of a betting shop.

ext.ext_cn: 守寡的饭店女经理
ext.ext_en: ...a widowed restaurant manageress.

defs.def_en: The manageress of a shop, restaurant, or other small business is the woman who is responsible for running it. Some women object to this word and prefer to be called a 'manager'.

defs.def_cn: 冈斯特说唱乐（歌词常涉及犯罪和暴力）
defs.def_en: or gangsta rap. Gangsta or gangsta rap is a form of rap music in which the words often refer to crime and violence.

defs.def_cn: 不可抗拒的；不可阻挡的

ext.ext_cn: 科学的前进步伐不可阻挡。
ext.ext_en: The progress of science is unstoppable.

ext.ext_cn: 该国看起来不可阻遏的经济发展势头
ext.ext_en: ...the country's seemingly unstoppable economy.

defs.def_en: Something that is unstoppable cannot be prevented from continuing or developing.

ext.ext_cn: “我已经有了一份工作。”我马上说道，并从房间里退了出来。
ext.ext_en: 'I've already got a job,' I said quickly, and retreated from the room...

ext.ext_cn: 看着护士长离去的身影，这个年轻的护士做了个鬼脸。
ext.ext_en: The young nurse pulled a face at the Matron's retreating figure.

defs.def_en: If you retreat, you move away from something or someone.

ext.ext_cn: 人数突然处于劣势的法军被迫撤退。
ext.ext_en: The French, suddenly outnumbered, were forced to retreat...
