ext.ext_en: ...effortless and elegant Italian cooking.

defs.def_en: Something that is effortless is done easily and well.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她最喜欢他身上那种与生俱来的魅力。
ext.ext_en: She liked him above all for his effortless charm.

defs.def_en: You use effortless to describe a quality that someone has naturally and does not have to learn.

defs.def_cn: 对…轻描淡写;使轻视;贬低

ext.ext_cn: 政府试图对暴力行为低调处理。
ext.ext_en: The government is trying to downplay the violence.

ext.ext_cn: 对核事故的危险轻描淡写
ext.ext_en: ...to downplay the dangers of nuclear accidents.

defs.def_en: If you downplay a fact or feature, you try to make people think that it is less important or serious than it really is.
Panties are short, close-fitting underpants worn by women or girls.

defs.def_cn: （印度烹饪中以牛奶或水牛奶制成的）酥油，奶油
defs.def_en: Ghee is a hard fat that is obtained by heating butter made from the milk of a cow or a buffalo. Ghee is used in Indian cooking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 聪颖的;有才智的;有灵性的

ext.ext_cn: 苏珊是个非常聪明、有主见的女子。
ext.ext_en: Susan's a very bright and intelligent woman who knows her own mind.

ext.ext_cn: 生动有趣、聪明睿智的谈话
ext.ext_en: ...lively and intelligent conversation...

defs.def_en: A person or animal that is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

ext.ext_cn: 智能计算机将成为医生不可或缺的诊断工具。
ext.ext_en: An intelligent computer will be an indispensable diagnostic tool for doctors.

ext.ext_cn: 有史以来规模最大的寻找外星智能生命的行动
ext.ext_en: ...the biggest-ever search for intelligent life elsewhere in the universe.

defs.def_en: Something that is intelligent has the ability to think and understand instead of doing things automatically or by instinct.
An emcee is the same as a master of ceremonies .

ext.ext_cn: 我将担任一场扮装比赛的司仪。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to be emceeing a costume contest...

ext.ext_cn: 第一次担任主持的那个晚上，我吓得完全乱了阵脚。
ext.ext_en: That first night I emceed I was absolutely terrified.

defs.def_en: To emcee an event or performance of something means to act as master of ceremonies for it.

ext.ext_cn: 我在走廊里意外碰见了默文·约翰斯。
ext.ext_en: I happened to bump into Mervyn Johns in the hallway.

defs.def_en: If you bump into someone you know, you meet them unexpectedly.

ext.ext_cn: 居高不下的生活开支势必会把老百姓逼入走投无路的境地。
ext.ext_en: Monstrously inflated costs are designed to keep the hoi polloi at bay.

defs.def_en: If someone refers to the hoi polloi, they are referring in a humorous or rather rude way to ordinary people, in contrast to rich, well-educated, or upper-class people.

defs.def_cn: 生活福利设施；便利设施

ext.ext_cn: 饭店的便利设施包括健身俱乐部、会议设施和宴会厅。
ext.ext_en: The hotel amenities include health clubs, conference facilities, and banqueting rooms.

defs.def_en: Amenities are things such as shopping centres or sports facilities that are provided for people's convenience, enjoyment, or comfort.

ext.ext_cn: 他从不喝自来水。
ext.ext_en: He never drinks tap water.

defs.def_en: Tap water is the water that comes out of a tap in a building such as a house or a hotel.
Disobedience is deliberately not doing what someone tells you to do, or what a rule or law says that you should do.

defs.def_cn: 使（政府或大型机构）权力分散;下放…的权力

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经分解了该公司的权力，以抑制其官僚作风。
ext.ext_en: They have decentralised the company and made it less bureaucratic.

ext.ext_cn: 将权力下放并移交给地方政府的需要
ext.ext_en: ...the need to decentralize and devolve power to regional governments...

defs.def_en: To decentralize government or a large organization means to move some departments away from the main administrative area, or to give more power to local departments.

ext.ext_cn: 寻求避难者中有不到7%的人被视作政治难民。
ext.ext_en: Fewer than 7% of asylum seekers are accepted as political refugees.

defs.def_en: An asylum seeker is a person who is trying to get asylum in a foreign country.
The pendulum of a clock is a rod with a weight at the end which swings from side to side in order to make the clock work.

defs.def_cn: （局势意见等的）摇摆不定，变化不定

ext.ext_cn: 三十年河东，三十年河西，美国汽车公司在安全方面已经取得了巨大进步。
ext.ext_en: The pendulum has swung back and the American car companies have made dramatic advances in safety...

ext.ext_cn: 政治形势转而对自由主义者有利。
ext.ext_en: The political pendulum has swung in favour of the liberals.

defs.def_en: You can use the idea of a pendulum and the way it swings regularly as a way of talking about regular changes in a situation or in people's opinions.

ext.ext_cn: 摩加迪沙2/3的居民已弃城而去，据说已成了一座名副其实的废都。
ext.ext_en: Mogadishu is said to be a virtual ghost town, deserted by two-thirds of its residents.

defs.def_en: A ghost town is a town which used to be busy and wealthy but is now poor and deserted.
A bread bin is a wooden, metal, or plastic container for storing bread.

defs.def_cn: 欺压;专横(或暴虐)地对待

ext.ext_cn: 专横对待家人的父亲
ext.ext_en: ...fathers who tyrannize their families...

ext.ext_cn: 武装组织用武力欺压平民。
ext.ext_en: Armed groups use their power to tyrannise over civilians.

defs.def_en: If you say that one person tyrannizes another, you mean that the first person uses their power over the second person in order to treat them very cruelly and unfairly.

ext.ext_cn: above, surround, arrive 等单词的非重读音节
ext.ext_en: ...the unstressed syllable of words like 'above', 'surround' or 'arrive'.

defs.def_en: If a word or syllable is unstressed, it is pronounced without emphasis.

ext.ext_cn: 政府将优先投资服务行业，而非工业和生产行业。
ext.ext_en: The government is prioritising the service sector, rather than investing in industry and production.

defs.def_en: If you prioritize something, you treat it as more important than other things.

defs.def_cn: 以优先顺序排列；决定…的优先顺序

ext.ext_cn: 将要做的事情列出来，然后决定其优先顺序。
ext.ext_en: Make lists of what to do and prioritize your tasks.

defs.def_en: If you prioritize the tasks that you have to do, you decide which are the most important and do them first.

defs.def_cn: 有前置代码的；有前置符号的

ext.ext_cn: 含硫化合物的名称前通常有前缀 thio。
ext.ext_en: Sulphur-containing compounds are often prefixed by the term 'thio'...

ext.ext_cn: 现在往都柏林打电话前面要加拨010 3531。
ext.ext_en: Calls to Dublin should now be prefixed with 010 3531.

defs.def_en: A word or code number that is prefixed by one or more letters or numbers has them as its prefix.
In the Christian religion, if you are the godparent of a younger person, you promise to help bring them up in the Christian faith.
An electron is a tiny particle of matter that is smaller than an atom and has a negative electrical charge.

ext.ext_cn: 人群里发出一片嘘声。
ext.ext_en: The crowd responded with boos and catcalls.

defs.def_en: Catcalls are loud noises that people make to show that they disapprove of something they are watching or listening to.

defs.def_cn: 下层;底层;深层特征;隐性特质

ext.ext_cn: 深厚的白垩地层
ext.ext_en: ...its deep substratum of chalk...

ext.ext_cn: 他对该城历史的再现是可信的，虚构的小说情节隐念着一些事实作为支撑。
ext.ext_en: His recreation of the city is credible, with a substratum of fact to bolster the fiction.

defs.def_en: A substratum of something is a layer that lies under the surface of another layer, or a feature that is less obvious than other features.

defs.def_cn: 同时发生(或存在)的;同时期的

ext.ext_cn: 一个独立而鲜明的苏格兰艺术流派的同时发展
ext.ext_en: ...the contemporaneous development of a separate and quite recognisable Scottish school of art.

defs.def_en: If two events or situations are contemporaneous, they happen or exist during the same period of time.

ext.ext_cn: “这是在一个笔记本里找到的，”法官道，“上面还有文字。”
ext.ext_en: 'It's from a notebook,' the sheriff said, 'And there's writing on it.'...

ext.ext_cn: 如果您对您的假日有什么意见，请书面告知我们。
ext.ext_en: If you have a complaint about your holiday, please inform us in writing.

defs.def_en: Writing is something that has been written or printed.

defs.def_cn: (尤指评论语言风格时的)文字作品，文章

ext.ext_cn: 该作品带有残酷的强悍和野性的幽默感。
ext.ext_en: The writing is brutally tough and savagely humorous...

ext.ext_cn: 这真是一篇才华横溢的文章。
ext.ext_en: It was such a brilliant piece of writing.

defs.def_en: You can refer to any piece of written work as writing, especially when you are considering the style of language used in it.

defs.def_cn: (尤指为赚取稿费而进行的)写作

ext.ext_cn: 她开始对写小说有些厌倦了。
ext.ext_en: She had begun to be a little bored with novel writing.

ext.ext_cn: 帮助孩子准备写作的活动
ext.ext_en: ...activities to help prepare children for writing.

defs.def_en: Writing is the activity of writing, especially of writing books for money.

ext.ext_cn: 你写的字有点不好认。
ext.ext_en: It was a little difficult to read your writing...

ext.ext_cn: 我想他的书写这么糟糕是因为他是左撇子。
ext.ext_en: I think it's due to being left handed that he's got terrible writing.

defs.def_en: Your writing is the way that you write with a pen or pencil, which can usually be recognized as belonging to you.

defs.def_cn: (尤指某一作者有关某一专题的全部)著作，作品

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔都塞的著作主要是论述法国的。
ext.ext_en: Althusser's writings are focused mainly on France...

ext.ext_cn: 他目前阅读的作品改编自迈克尔·弗雷恩的著作。
ext.ext_en: The pieces he is reading are adapted from the writings of Michael Frayn.

defs.def_en: An author's writings are all the things that he or she has written, especially on a particular subject.

defs.def_cn: 凶兆毕现；有大难临头的预兆

ext.ext_cn: 凶兆显而易见。如果我们对此毫无行动，就只能怨自己了。
ext.ext_en: The writing is clearly on the wall. If we do nothing about it, we shall only have ourselves to blame.

defs.def_en: If you say that the writing is on the wall, you mean that there are clear signs that a situation is going to become very difficult or unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 一名前主管挪用了3,400万美元的公司资金。
ext.ext_en: One former director embezzled $34 million in company funds.

defs.def_en: If someone embezzles money that their organization or company has placed in their care, they take it and use it illegally for their own purposes.

defs.def_cn: (杂志或报纸的)订阅人，订购者，订户

ext.ext_cn: 我订阅《铁路杂志》已有很多年了。
ext.ext_en: I have been a subscriber to Railway Magazine for many years.

defs.def_en: A magazine's or a newspaper's subscribers are the people who pay to receive copies of it regularly.

ext.ext_cn: 中国有将近 1,500 万卫星电视和有线电视用户。
ext.ext_en: China has almost 15 million subscribers to satellite and cable television.

defs.def_en: Subscribers to a service are the people who pay to receive the service.

defs.def_cn: (慈善机构、活动的)定期捐款者，定期捐助者;(组织的)定期缴费者，会员
defs.def_en: The subscribers to a charity, campaign, or organization are the people who support it by sending money regularly to it.

ext.ext_cn: 藤本月季的芳香飘进了窗户。
ext.ext_en: The scent of climbing roses wafts through the window...

ext.ext_cn: 晚会的音乐飘到了外面的露台上。
ext.ext_en: The music from the party wafts out to the terrace...

defs.def_en: If sounds or smells waft through the air, or if something such as a light wind wafts them, they move gently through the air.

defs.def_cn: 食物碎屑;面包屑;糕饼屑

ext.ext_cn: 我站起来，掸掉裤子上的碎屑。
ext.ext_en: I stood up, brushing crumbs from my  trousers.

defs.def_en: Crumbs are tiny pieces that fall from bread, biscuits, or cake when you cut it or eat it.

ext.ext_cn: 最后，安德鲁向他们透露了一点信息。
ext.ext_en: At last Andrew gave them a crumb of information...

ext.ext_cn: 政府能够从现在的失业人数中得到些许安慰。
ext.ext_en: The government were able to draw a few crumbs of comfort from today's unemployment figures.

defs.def_en: A crumb of something, for example information, is a very small amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 匈牙利和波兰因其在欧洲地图上的极为不利的地缘政治位置而备受磨难。
ext.ext_en: Hungary and Poland have suffered before because of their unfortunate geopolitical position on the European map.

defs.def_en: Geopolitical means relating to or concerned with geopolitics.

ext.ext_cn: 很明显，她想谈些私事。
ext.ext_en: It was clear that she wanted to discuss some private matter...

ext.ext_cn: 除非这个问题得以解决，否则这些运动员没有资格参加比赛。
ext.ext_en: Until the matter is resolved the athletes will be ineligible to compete...

defs.def_en: A matter is a task, situation, or event which you have to deal with or think about, especially one that involves problems.

ext.ext_cn: 如果正常生活都一团糟了，那么再讲究小情调根本无济于事。
ext.ext_en: If your ordinary life is out of control, then retreating into a cosy ritual will not improve matters...

ext.ext_cn: 如果对事态发展有利，我很乐意来纽约。
ext.ext_en: If it would facilitate matters, I would be happy to come to New York...

defs.def_en: You use matters to refer to the situation you are talking about, especially when something is affecting the  situation in some way.

defs.def_cn: (是…的)问题;取决于…的问题;关乎…的问题

ext.ext_cn: 历史总是一种阐释角度的问题。
ext.ext_en: History is always a matter of interpretation...

ext.ext_cn: 守法是我们的一个原则问题。
ext.ext_en: Observance of the law is a matter of principle for us...

defs.def_en: If you say that a situation is a matter of a particular thing, you mean that that is the most important thing to be done or considered when you are involved in the situation or explaining it.

ext.ext_cn: 政府对印刷品征收增值税的计划
ext.ext_en: ...the Government's plans to levy VAT on printed matter.

ext.ext_cn: 种类繁多的阅读材料
ext.ext_en: ...a rich variety of reading matter.

defs.def_en: Printed matter consists of books, newspapers, and other texts that are printed. Reading matter consists of things that are suitable for reading, such as books and newspapers.

ext.ext_cn: 质子是物质的基本粒子。
ext.ext_en: A proton is an elementary particle of matter.

ext.ext_cn: 他从事研究物质在有序与无序的细微临界处的行为变化。
ext.ext_en: He has spent his career studying how matter behaves at the fine edge between order and disorder.

defs.def_en: Matter is the physical part of the universe consisting of solids, liquids, and gases.

ext.ext_cn: 它们大多以腐烂的蔬菜为食。
ext.ext_en: They feed mostly on decaying vegetable matter.

ext.ext_cn: 工业废料
ext.ext_en: ...waste matter from industries.

defs.def_en: You use matter to refer to a particular type of substance.

ext.ext_cn: 卡萝尔，出什么事了？你好像不开心。
ext.ext_en: Carole, what's the matter? You don't seem happy...

ext.ext_cn: 你们部门出什么事了吗？
ext.ext_en: What's the matter with your office?...

defs.def_en: You use matter in expressions such as 'What's the matter?' or 'Is anything the matter?' when you think that someone has a problem and you want to know what it is.

ext.ext_cn: 仅仅几天后，她又回去上班了。
ext.ext_en: Within a matter of days she was back at work...

ext.ext_cn: 他希望几个小时内可以到达东格林斯特德站。
ext.ext_en: He expected to be at East Grinstead station in a matter of hours...

defs.def_en: You use matter in expressions such as 'a matter of weeks' when you are emphasizing how small an amount is or how short a period of time is.

ext.ext_cn: 许多食品掉在地板上，不过也没什么关系。
ext.ext_en: A lot of the food goes on the floor but that doesn't matter...

ext.ext_cn: 至于我和劳拉，肤色根本不是问题。
ext.ext_en: As for Laura and me, the colour of our skin has never mattered...

defs.def_en: If you say that something does not matter, you mean that it is not important to you because it does not have an effect on you or on a particular situation.

defs.def_cn: 另一码事；另一回事;不同情形

ext.ext_cn: 对自己的健康负责是一回事，对他人的健康负责就完全是另一回事了。
ext.ext_en: Being responsible for one's own health is one thing, but being responsible for another person's health is quite a different matter...

ext.ext_cn: 你们不该自己去这些地方。不过如果是父母带你们去的，那就另当别论了。
ext.ext_en: You have no business going into such places all by yourselves. If your parents take you, of course, that's another matter.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is another matter or a different matter, you mean that it is very different from the situation that you  have just discussed.

defs.def_cn: 出于（时间）的考虑;作为（紧急）事件（处理）

ext.ext_cn: 你的医生和家访护士会帮很大的忙。你应该和他们谈一谈，这是当务之急。
ext.ext_en: Your doctor and health visitor can help a great deal and you need to talk about it with them as a matter of urgency.

defs.def_en: If you are going to do something as a matter of urgency or priority, you are going to do it as soon as possible, because it is important.

ext.ext_cn: 选择客厅墙壁的颜色绝非易事。
ext.ext_en: Choosing the colour for the drawing-room walls was no easy matter.

defs.def_en: If something is no easy matter, it is  difficult to do it.

defs.def_cn: 此事已定;(事情)到此为止，到此结束

ext.ext_cn: “他就要搬来住了，”玛丽亚说，“那么就这么定了。”
ext.ext_en: 'He's moving in here,' Maria said. 'So that's the end of the matter.'

defs.def_en: If someone says that's the end of the matter or that's an end to the matter, they mean that a decision that has been taken must not be changed or discussed any more.

defs.def_cn: 事实真相是;真实情况是

ext.ext_cn: 真实的情况是，大多数人摄入的蛋白质比他们实际所需的多出许多。
ext.ext_en: The fact of the matter is that most people consume far more protein than they actually need...

ext.ext_cn: 实际情况是，他认识卡丽娜时正在迷失自我。
ext.ext_en: The truth of the matter is that he was having an identity crisis when he met Carina.

defs.def_en: You use the fact of the matter is or the truth of the matter is to introduce a fact which supports what you are saying or which is not widely known, for example because it is a secret.

ext.ext_cn: 具有讽刺意味的是，肖恩并没有见过她，别人也同样如此。
ext.ext_en: The irony was that Shawn had not seen her. Nor for that matter had anyone else...

ext.ext_cn: 大量艰苦的工作已经完成，同样，大量艰苦的工作也仍在继续。
ext.ext_en: A great deal of hard work was done and, for that matter, is continuing.

defs.def_en: You can use for that matter to emphasize that the remark you are making is true in the same way as your previous, similar remark.

ext.ext_cn: “我把你吵醒了？”——“是的，不过没关系。”
ext.ext_en: 'Did I wake you?' — 'Yes, but it doesn't matter.'

defs.def_en: You say 'it doesn't matter' to tell someone who is apologizing to you that you are not angry or upset, and that they should not worry.

ext.ext_cn: “史蒂夫，你要喝点什么？”——“可口可乐，百事，随便啦。”
ext.ext_en: 'Steve, what do you want?' — 'Coke, Pepsi, it doesn't matter.'

defs.def_en: You say 'it doesn't matter' when someone offers you a choice between two or more things and you do not mind which is chosen.

ext.ext_cn: 他们这么做是犯罪，这可不是开玩笑的。
ext.ext_en: Their behaviour is an offence. It's no laughing matter.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is no laughing matter, you mean that it is very serious and not something that you should laugh or joke about.

ext.ext_cn: 不要想不开，这样只能使情况变得更糟。
ext.ext_en: Don't let yourself despair; this will only make matters worse...

ext.ext_cn: 更糟的是，又开始下雨了。
ext.ext_en: To make matters worse, it started to rain again.

defs.def_en: If you say that something makes matters worse, you mean that it makes a difficult situation even more difficult.

ext.ext_cn: “你从没看过这本书？”基廷摇了摇头。“嗯，没关系。”
ext.ext_en: 'Didn't you ever read the book?' Keating shook his head. 'Well, no matter.'...

ext.ext_cn: “现如今的做工实在是差劲，”他说，“无所谓了，好歹还撑得住我的体重。”
ext.ext_en: 'Shoddy workmanship these days,' he remarked. 'No matter, it will still bear my weight.'

defs.def_en: You say 'no matter' after you have just asked a question or mentioned an idea or doubt and you have decided that it is not really important, interesting, or worth discussing.

ext.ext_cn: 不论年龄多大，都可以按这套方案来减肥。
ext.ext_en: No matter what your age, you can lose weight by following this program...

ext.ext_cn: 就算别人说破了嘴皮，他们就是不加入。
ext.ext_en: No matter how often they were urged, they could not bring themselves to join in...

defs.def_en: You use no matter in expressions such as 'no matter how' and 'no matter what' to say that something is true or happens in all circumstances.

ext.ext_cn: 他决定无论如何都要出版那部手稿。
ext.ext_en: He had decided to publish the manuscript no matter what...

ext.ext_cn: 于是我发誓，无论如何，我和他们那种人都不会成为一丘之貉。
ext.ext_en: I vowed then, no matter what, I would never be like those people.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are going to do something no matter what, you are emphasizing that you are definitely going to do it, even if there are obstacles or difficulties.

defs.def_cn: 看法问题;看法因人而异的事情

ext.ext_cn: “我们没那么造作，也没那么夸张。”——“见仁见智喽。”
ext.ext_en: 'We're not that contrived. We're not that theatrical.' — 'That's a matter of opinion.'

defs.def_en: If you say that a statement is a matter of opinion, you mean that it is not a fact, and that other people, including yourself, do not agree  with it.

defs.def_cn: (只是)时间的问题（用于说明某事必定发生）

ext.ext_cn: 他完成这件事只是时间问题。
ext.ext_en: It would be only a matter of time before he went through with it.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is just a matter of time, you mean that it is certain to happen at some time in the future.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 精明务实的;不感情用事的;坚韧的

ext.ext_cn: 别的不说，道格起码是个精明务实的商人。
ext.ext_en: If nothing else, Doug is a hard-nosed businessman.

defs.def_en: You use hard-nosed to describe someone who is tough and realistic, and who takes decisions on practical grounds rather than emotional ones.

ext.ext_cn: 可以采取疫苗接种和其他预防措施。
ext.ext_en: Vaccination and other prophylactic measures can be carried out.

defs.def_en: Prophylactic means concerned with preventing disease.

ext.ext_cn: 该地区开始成功地用奎宁作为预防剂。
ext.ext_en: The region began to use quinine successfully as a prophylactic.

defs.def_en: A prophylactic is a substance or device used for preventing disease.

ext.ext_cn: 想到老师将分发避孕套给学生使一些家长愤慨不已。
ext.ext_en: The prospect of teachers passing out prophylactics to their pupils has infuriated some parents.

defs.def_en: A prophylactic is a condom.

defs.def_cn: 堂兄弟(或姐妹);表兄弟(或姐妹)
defs.def_en: Someone's first cousin is the same as their cousin .

ext.ext_cn: 它是用铸铁制成，最后在外面搪了一层石墨。
ext.ext_en: Made from cast iron, it is finished in graphite enamel.

ext.ext_cn: 生铁椅子腿
ext.ext_en: ...the cast-iron chair legs.

defs.def_en: Cast iron is iron which contains a small amount of carbon. It is hard and cannot be bent so it has to be made into objects by casting.

defs.def_cn: (保证或借口)可靠的，可信的，无懈可击的

ext.ext_cn: 他们需提供绝对可靠的担保，才能投资长期项目。
ext.ext_en: They would have to offer cast-iron guarantees to invest in long-term projects.

defs.def_en: A cast-iron guarantee or alibi is one that is absolutely certain to be effective and will not fail you.

ext.ext_cn: 她比他高，而且略微有些驼背。
ext.ext_en: She was taller than he was and stooped slightly.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个瘦高个儿，有点驼背。
ext.ext_en: He was a tall, thin fellow with a slight stoop.

defs.def_en: If you stoop, you stand or walk with your shoulders bent forwards.

ext.ext_cn: 他俯下身去提装着食品杂货的购物袋。
ext.ext_en: He stooped to pick up the carrier bag of groceries...

ext.ext_cn: 两名穿衬衣的男子趴在那辆汽车上。
ext.ext_en: Two men in shirt sleeves stooped over the car...

defs.def_en: If you stoop, you bend your body forwards and downwards.

ext.ext_cn: 他以前从未像最近这样卑鄙到进行人身攻击。
ext.ext_en: He had not, until recently, stooped to personal abuse...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经无耻到把能用的武器都用上了。
ext.ext_en: They've stooped to using any and every weapon at their disposal...

defs.def_en: If you say that a person stoops to doing something, you are criticizing them because they do something wrong or immoral that they would not normally do.

ext.ext_cn: 他们一起站在门廊上按响了门铃。
ext.ext_en: They stood together on the stoop and rang the bell.

defs.def_en: A stoop is a small platform at the door of a building, with steps leading up to it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 最终，我回绝了拉乌尔提出的去棕榈海滩旅行的诱人邀请。
ext.ext_en: In the end, I turned down Raoul's tempting offer of the Palm Beach trip...

ext.ext_cn: 你要是在减肥的话，能否抗拒诱人的美食就成为衡量你作为一个女人是否“成功”的标准。
ext.ext_en: If you're slimming, resisting tempting goodies becomes a measure of your 'success' as a woman...

defs.def_en: If something is tempting, it makes you want to do it or have it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们看见一道强光和一个巨大的火球冲向数百英尺的高空。
ext.ext_en: They saw a big flash and a huge ball of fire reaching hundreds of feet into the sky...

ext.ext_cn: 许多学生被浓烟和大火困在了较高的一层上。
ext.ext_en: Many students were trapped by smoke and fire on an upper floor.

defs.def_en: Fire is the hot, bright flames produced by things that are burning.

ext.ext_cn: 87 人在乐土社交俱乐部的火灾中丧生。
ext.ext_en: 87 people died in a fire at the Happy Land Social Club...

ext.ext_cn: 今晚一场森林大火正席卷缅因州北部的部分地区。
ext.ext_en: A forest fire is sweeping across portions of north Maine this evening...

defs.def_en: Fire or a fire is an occurrence of uncontrolled burning which destroys buildings, forests, or other things.

ext.ext_cn: 壁炉内燃着火。
ext.ext_en: There was a fire in the grate...

ext.ext_cn: 杀人后，他镇定地点起火销毁罪证。
ext.ext_en: After the killing, he calmly lit a fire to destroy evidence.

defs.def_en: A fire is a burning pile of wood, coal, or other fuel that you make, for example to use for heat, light, or cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 燃气取暖器还在烧着。
ext.ext_en: The gas fire was still alight...

ext.ext_cn: 她打开了一片电暖器。
ext.ext_en: She switched on one bar of the electric fire.

defs.def_en: A fire is a device that uses electricity or gas to give out heat and warm a room.

ext.ext_cn: 陶罐在这一混合料中浸过之后就拿去烧制。
ext.ext_en: After the pot is dipped in this mixture, it is fired...

ext.ext_cn: 我见过制陶工人捏塑、烧制碗碟花瓶，并在上面涂绘各种宗教图案。
ext.ext_en: I have watched the potters mold, fire and paint their bowls, plates and vases with sacred designs.

defs.def_en: When a pot or clay object is fired, it is heated at a high temperature in a special oven, as part of the process of making it.

ext.ext_cn: 点着引擎后我们就开走了。
ext.ext_en: The engine fired and we moved off.

defs.def_en: When the engine of a motor vehicle fires, an electrical spark is produced which causes the fuel to burn and the engine to work.

ext.ext_cn: 这些发动机烧煤，并且需要加水以不断产生蒸汽。
ext.ext_en: The engines were fired with coal and needed water to keep the steam up.

defs.def_en: If a machine is fired with a particular fuel, it operates by means of that fuel.

defs.def_cn: 激起;唤起;使充满激情;激发(想象力)

ext.ext_cn: 能够激发整整一代人想象力的潜能
ext.ext_en: ...the potential to fire the imagination of an entire generation...

ext.ext_cn: 是艾伦为这场较量注入了激情。
ext.ext_en: It was Allen who fired this rivalry with real passion...

defs.def_en: If you fire someone with enthusiasm, you make them feel very enthusiastic. If you fire someone's imagination, you make them feel interested and excited.

ext.ext_cn: 我去听了他的讲话，结果留下了非常深刻的印象。他看上去充满了激情。
ext.ext_en: I went to hear him speak and was very impressed. He seemed so full of fire...

ext.ext_cn: 繁忙的日程似乎有时让他精力不济。
ext.ext_en: His punishing schedule seemed to dim his fire at times.

defs.def_en: You can use fire to refer in an approving way to someone's energy and enthusiasm.

ext.ext_cn: 我家失了火，所有的东西都烧毁了。
ext.ext_en: My home catches fire and everything is destroyed...

ext.ext_cn: 飞机起飞后不久就着火了。
ext.ext_en: The aircraft caught fire soon after take-off.

defs.def_en: If an object or substance catches fire, it starts burning.

ext.ext_cn: 这部剧直到阿申巴赫堕入情网后才真正开始精彩起来。
ext.ext_en: The play only really catches fire once Aschenbach falls in love.

defs.def_en: If a situation or event catches fire, it begins to be exciting and successful.

defs.def_cn: 以火攻火;以毒攻毒;以其人之道还治其人之身

ext.ext_cn: 他们打击犯罪的唯一方法就是以牙还牙。
ext.ext_en: The only way they can deal with crime is to fight fire with fire.

defs.def_en: If you fight fire with fire, you deal with people attacking or threatening you by using similar methods to the ones that they are using.

ext.ext_cn: 罗科不像他父亲那样充满激情。
ext.ext_en: Rocco does not have the same fire in his belly as his father.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has fire in their belly, you are expressing approval of them because they are energetic, enthusiastic, and have very strong feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 船长发无线电说船着火了。
ext.ext_en: The captain radioed that the ship was on fire.

defs.def_en: If something is on fire, it is burning and being damaged or destroyed by an uncontrolled fire.

defs.def_cn: 热情似火;激动万分;激情澎湃

ext.ext_cn: 看到这一令人叹为观止的景象，他激动万分。
ext.ext_en: He was on fire with this marvelous sight.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is on fire, you mean they are very enthusiastic, excited, or passionate about something.

ext.ext_cn: 舒尔特警告政府和业界领袖说，哪怕只是动动大规模裁员念头的人都是在玩火。
ext.ext_en: Schulte warned government and industrial leaders that those who even venture to think about mass layoffs are playing with fire.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is playing with fire, you mean that they are doing something dangerous that may result in great harm for them and cause many problems.

ext.ext_cn: 他们纵火焚烧了停在那幢大楼外的车辆。
ext.ext_en: They set fire to vehicles outside that building...

ext.ext_cn: 闪电燃着了几栋大楼。
ext.ext_en: Lightning set several buildings on fire.

defs.def_en: If you set fire to something or if you set it on fire, you start it burning in order to damage or destroy it.

ext.ext_cn: 戴上头盔，发动引擎，开上乡村干道。
ext.ext_en: Put on a helmet, fire up your engine and head out on the open road.

defs.def_en: If you fire up a machine, you switch it on.

ext.ext_cn: 总统知道自己的任务就是唤起代表的热情。
ext.ext_en: The president knows his task is to fire up the delegates.

defs.def_en: If you fire someone up, you make them feel very enthusiastic or motivated.

ext.ext_cn: 士兵发射橡皮子弹驱散人群时有7个人受了伤。
ext.ext_en: Seven people were wounded when soldiers fired rubber bullets to disperse crowds...

ext.ext_cn: 发射高爆弹的新型大炮在战场上得到了使用。
ext.ext_en: New guns firing high explosive shells were incorporated into the battlefield...

defs.def_en: If someone fires a gun or a bullet, or if they fire, a bullet is sent from a gun that they are using.

ext.ext_cn: 他的车遭到自动武器火力的扫射。
ext.ext_en: His car was raked with fire from automatic weapons...

ext.ext_cn: 据报道，这两人在警方突击搜查时发生的交火中被打死。
ext.ext_en: The two were reportedly killed in an exchange of fire during a police raid.

defs.def_en: You can use fire to refer to the shots fired from a gun or guns.

ext.ext_cn: 他将箭射向林中的一片空地。
ext.ext_en: He fired an arrow into a clearing in the forest.

defs.def_en: If you fire an arrow, you send it from a bow.

ext.ext_cn: 100多名代表针对污染问题向他们发起连珠炮似的提问。
ext.ext_en: They were bombarded by more than 100 representatives firing questions on pollution.

defs.def_en: If you fire questions at someone, you ask them a lot of questions very quickly, one after another.

defs.def_cn: 猛烈的批评(或抨击、指责)

ext.ext_cn: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。
ext.ext_en: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.

defs.def_en: You can use fire to refer to someone's strong criticisms of something.

ext.ext_cn: 其他地方的人群吸引了军队的火力。
ext.ext_en: Crowds elsewhere drew fire from troops.

defs.def_en: If you draw fire from someone, you cause them to shoot at you, for example because they think that you are threatening them.

ext.ext_cn: 委员会最近因为介入该起争端而遭到批评。
ext.ext_en: The council recently drew fire for its intervention in the dispute...

ext.ext_cn: 该活动正受到禁烟倡导者的攻击。
ext.ext_en: The campaign is drawing fire from anti-smoking advocates.

defs.def_en: If you draw fire for something that you have done, you cause people to criticize you or attack you because of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我的建议就是，先缓一缓，等上一两分钟再试一次。
ext.ext_en: All I can suggest is that you just hang fire and wait a minute or two and try again...

ext.ext_cn: 上周，银行和建屋互助会推迟了就利率问题作出决定。
ext.ext_en: Last week, banks and building societies were hanging fire on interest rates.

defs.def_en: If you hang fire, you delay making a decision about something.

defs.def_cn: 停止射击;等待射击开始

ext.ext_cn: 德弗罗命令士兵等船靠近了再开火。
ext.ext_en: Devereux ordered his men to hold their fire until the ships got closer.

defs.def_en: If someone holds their fire or holds fire, they stop shooting or they wait before they start shooting.

ext.ext_cn: 观察家认为英格兰银行会推迟到更加接近预算案出台时再采取措施。
ext.ext_en: Observers reckon the Bank of England will hold fire until nearer the Budget.

defs.def_en: If you hold fire in a situation, you delay before taking action.

ext.ext_cn: 他兴高采烈地将蠢到撞上他枪口的坏家伙全都干掉。
ext.ext_en: He cheerfully blows away any bad guy stupid enough to get in his line of fire...

ext.ext_cn: 父子俩被那些掳走他们的人推到了枪口前。
ext.ext_en: The man and his son had been pushed into the line of fire by their captors.

defs.def_en: If you are in the line of fire, you are in a position where someone is aiming their gun at you. If you move into their line of fire, you move into a position between them and the thing they were aiming at.

ext.ext_cn: 接着军队未作警示便向人群开了火。
ext.ext_en: Then without warning, the troops opened fire on the crowd.

defs.def_en: If you open fire on someone, you start shooting at them.

ext.ext_cn: 士兵们在遇袭后予以还击。
ext.ext_en: The soldiers returned fire after being attacked.

defs.def_en: If you return fire or you return someone's fire, you shoot back at someone who has shot at you.

defs.def_cn: 遭到射击;受到火力攻击

ext.ext_cn: 步兵团受到火力攻击时比利时人向后撤退。
ext.ext_en: The Belgians fell back as the infantry came under fire.

ext.ext_cn: 向那些现已连续数周遭受炮火袭击的城市提供援助
ext.ext_en: ...sending aid to cities which have been under fire for weeks now.

defs.def_en: If you come under fire or are under fire, someone starts shooting at you.

defs.def_cn: 遭到猛烈批评;受到强烈抨击

ext.ext_cn: 总统的计划先是遭到批评者的猛烈抨击，他们称开支削减力度不够。
ext.ext_en: The president's plan first came under fire from critics who said he hadn't included enough spending cuts.

defs.def_en: If you come under fire from someone or are under fire, they criticize you strongly.

ext.ext_cn: “我可以问你一个问题吗？”——“当然可以。尽管问吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'May I ask you something?' — 'Sure. Fire away.'

defs.def_en: If someone wants to say or ask something, you can say 'fire away' as a way of showing that you are ready for them to speak.

ext.ext_cn: 持枪歹徒朝天扫射了一排子弹。
ext.ext_en: A gunman fired off a volley of shots into the air...

ext.ext_cn: 塞西尔此时开始慌张起来,连忙发射了两枚遇险信号火箭。
ext.ext_en: Cecil now began to panic and fired off two distress rockets.

defs.def_en: If you fire off a shot, you send a bullet or other missile from a gun.

defs.def_cn: (常指作为一系列之一地迅速)发出(信件)，提出(问题),讲出(话语)

ext.ext_cn: 他立即给部里的同事发了一封怒气冲冲的信。
ext.ext_en: He immediately fired off an angry letter to his ministry colleagues...

ext.ext_cn: 普通警员愤怒地向政府提出了一连串增加工资、提高地位和改善条件的要求。
ext.ext_en: Ordinary officers fired off a string of angry demands to the government, to improve their pay, status, and conditions.

defs.def_en: If you fire off a letter, question, or remark, you send or say it very quickly, often as part of a series.

ext.ext_cn: 如果不是因为他在工作的其他方面做得如此之好，我可能就把他开除了。
ext.ext_en: If he hadn't been so good at the rest of his job, I probably would have fired him...

ext.ext_cn: 她收到一盒巧克力和一封信，信上说她被解雇了。
ext.ext_en: She was sent a box of chocolates along with a letter saying she was fired.

defs.def_en: If an employer fires you, they dismiss you from your job.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示颜色的名词后）表示“带…条纹的”，“镶…边的”

ext.ext_cn: 桌上摆放着白色瓷器和镶着金边的银制餐具。
ext.ext_en: Tables are set with white china and gold-banded silver cutlery.

defs.def_en: -banded combines with colours to indicate that something has bands of a particular colour.

defs.def_cn: （尤指喜欢吃稀奇食物的）美食家
defs.def_en: An epicure is someone who enjoys eating food that is of very good quality, especially unusual or rare food.

ext.ext_cn: 他决定把探险推迟到第二天。
ext.ext_en: He decided to postpone the expedition until the following day...

ext.ext_cn: 参观现在已经被无限期推迟了。
ext.ext_en: The visit has now been postponed indefinitely.

defs.def_en: If you postpone an event, you delay it or arrange for it to take place at a later time than was originally planned.  →see usage note at:cancel

defs.def_cn: 智能卡(形如信用卡，可以储存和处理计算机数据)
defs.def_en: A smart card is a plastic card which looks like a credit card and can store and process computer data.

ext.ext_cn: 他们花了很长时间修缮屋顶。
ext.ext_en: They took a long time to mend the roof...

ext.ext_cn: 别人借给我一个打气筒，又帮我补好了轮胎。
ext.ext_en: Somebody else lent me a pump and helped me mend the puncture...

defs.def_en: If you mend something that is broken or not working, you repair it, so that it works properly or can be used.

ext.ext_cn: 你会康复的。X光照片显示你的胳膊能够较好地复原。
ext.ext_en: You'll mend. The X-rays show that your arm will heal all right...

ext.ext_cn: 我感觉好多了。伤口很疼，但是正在愈合。
ext.ext_en: I'm feeling a good bit better. The cut aches, but it's mending...

defs.def_en: If a person or a part of their body mends or is mended, they get better after they have been  ill or have had an injury.

ext.ext_cn: 他派埃文斯以私人特使的身份前往商讨修复两国关系的途径。
ext.ext_en: He sent Evans as his  personal envoy to discuss ways to mend relations between the two countries...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得那样做也许可以让他们冰释前嫌。
ext.ext_en: I felt that might well mend the rift between them.

defs.def_en: If you try to mend divisions between people, you try to end the disagreements or quarrels between them.

defs.def_cn: (关系)正在改善;(形势)正在好转

ext.ext_cn: 需要更多证据来证明经济正在好转。
ext.ext_en: More evidence that the economy was on the mend was needed.

defs.def_en: If a relationship or situation is on the mend after a difficult or unsuccessful period, it is improving.

defs.def_cn: (病人)正在恢复之中，正在逐渐好起来

ext.ext_cn: 宝宝生病了，但似乎正在好起来。
ext.ext_en: The baby had been poorly but seemed on the mend.

defs.def_en: If you are on the mend after an illness or injury, you are recovering from it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果他们不改邪归正的话，他保证一定严惩不贷。
ext.ext_en: He has promised drastic disciplinary action if they do not mend their ways.

defs.def_en: If someone who has been behaving badly mends their ways, they begin to behave well.

defs.def_cn: 使有性别;使有性征;使发生性关系

ext.ext_cn: 将孩子们的朋友称为女朋友或男朋友就把他们的性别差异凸显出来了。
ext.ext_en: Referring to children's friends as girlfriends and boyfriends sexualizes them...

ext.ext_cn: 强奸是性暴力行为。
ext.ext_en: Rape is sexualised violence.

defs.def_en: To sexualize something or someone means to make them sexual or consider them in a sexual way.
A pollinator is something which pollinates plants, especially a type of insect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 刺耳的尖叫声划破长空。
ext.ext_en: A piercing scream split the air.

ext.ext_cn: 尖厉的哨音
ext.ext_en: ...a piercing whistle.

defs.def_en: A piercing sound or voice is high-pitched and very sharp and clear in an unpleasant way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的金棕色头发和目光敏锐的蓝眼睛
ext.ext_en: ...his sandy blond hair and piercing blue eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 他用锐利的目光盯住你。
ext.ext_en: He fixes you with a piercing stare.

defs.def_en: If someone has piercing eyes or a piercing stare, they seem to look at you very intensely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她感到一种深彻入骨的悔恨。
ext.ext_en: She was aware of a sharp piercing regret.

defs.def_en: If you describe a quality or feeling as piercing, you mean that it makes you experience a feeling, especially sadness, very strongly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: A piercing wind makes you feel very cold.
The stairwell is the part of a building that contains the staircase.

ext.ext_cn: 没有多少产品能拥有像“李维斯”那么深入人心的品牌形象。
ext.ext_en: Few products have brand images anywhere near as strong as Levi's.

defs.def_en: The brand image of a particular brand of product is the image or impression that people have of it, usually created by advertising.
A ferryboat is a boat used as a ferry.

ext.ext_cn: 她服用了一剂蓖麻油，已经上床睡了。
ext.ext_en: She has gone to bed and had a dose of castor oil.

defs.def_en: Castor oil is a thick yellow oil that is obtained from the seeds of the castor oil plant. It has a very unpleasant taste and in former times was used as a medicine.

defs.def_cn: 在…的上方；在…的上面；在…的上空

ext.ext_cn: 他对着桌子上方的镜子照了照。
ext.ext_en: He looked at himself in the mirror over the table.

ext.ext_cn: 多瑙河上的一座桥
ext.ext_en: ...a bridge over the river Danube.

defs.def_en: If one thing is over another thing or is moving over it, the first thing is directly above the second, either resting on it, or with a space between them.

ext.ext_cn: 她胳膊上搭着一件灰色雨衣。
ext.ext_en: A grey mackintosh was folded over her arm...

ext.ext_cn: 乔的衣服扔在椅背上。
ext.ext_en: Joe's clothing was flung over the back of a chair.

defs.def_en: If one thing is over another thing, it is supported by it and its ends are hanging down on each side of it.

defs.def_cn: （部分或完全地）覆盖在…的上面

ext.ext_cn: 他的头发没有整齐地往后梳，而是搭在前额。
ext.ext_en: His hair fell over his brow instead of being brushed straight back...

ext.ext_cn: 将配料搅拌均匀浇在蘑菇上。
ext.ext_en: Mix the ingredients and pour over the mushrooms...

defs.def_en: If one thing is over another thing, it covers part or all of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们停下来，身子探过一扇栅栏门。
ext.ext_en: They stopped to lean over a gate...

ext.ext_cn: 房间里的每一个人都弯腰围在她的办公室桌前。
ext.ext_en: Everyone in the room was bent over her desk.

defs.def_en: If you lean over an object, you bend your body so that the top part of it is above the object.

defs.def_cn: 从…上面（看过去）；隔着…（交谈）

ext.ext_cn: 我走过去站在他身边，从他的肩头望过去。
ext.ext_en: I went and stood beside him, looking over his shoulder.

ext.ext_cn: 与你的朋友隔着围栏交谈
ext.ext_en: ...conversing over the fence with your friend...

defs.def_en: If you look over or talk over an object, you look or talk across the top of it.

ext.ext_cn: 可将阿姆斯特尔河美景尽收眼底的明亮通风的酒吧
ext.ext_en: ...a light and airy bar with a wonderful view over the River Amstel...

ext.ext_cn: 从他的房间可以看见学院后面一条狭窄的小巷。
ext.ext_en: His rooms looked out over a narrow lane behind the college.

defs.def_en: If a window has a view over an area of land or water, you can see the land or water through the window.

ext.ext_cn: 警察在追捕中跳过西班牙大使馆的围墙。
ext.ext_en: Policemen jumped over the wall of the Spanish Embassy in pursuit...

ext.ext_cn: 我跨过一块破木头。
ext.ext_en: I stepped over a broken piece of wood...

defs.def_en: If someone or something goes over a barrier, obstacle, or boundary, they get to the other side of it by going across it, or across the top of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她一溜烟穿过草地跑到了大门口。
ext.ext_en: She ran swiftly over the lawn to the gate...

ext.ext_cn: 乔用手摸了一把脸，看上去疑惑不解。
ext.ext_en: Joe passed his hand over his face and looked puzzled.

defs.def_en: If someone or something moves over an area or surface, they move across it, from one side to the other.

ext.ext_cn: 住在马路对面那所房子里的理查德·加里克
ext.ext_en: ...Richard Garrick, who lived in the house over the road.

ext.ext_cn: 与曼哈顿隔河相望的时尚街区
ext.ext_en: ...a fashionable neighbourhood, just over the river from Manhattan.

defs.def_en: If something is on the opposite side of a road or river, you can say that it is over the road or river.

ext.ext_cn: 我把车开出来，驶向德韦格。
ext.ext_en: I got out the car and drove over to Dervaig...

ext.ext_cn: 我以为你可能已经邀请她过来了。
ext.ext_en: I thought you might have invited her over.

defs.def_en: If you go over to a place, you go to that place.

ext.ext_cn: 他注意到罗尔夫一声不吭地站在窗户旁边。
ext.ext_en: He noticed Rolfe standing silently over by the window...

ext.ext_cn: 约翰伸手握住乔安娜的手。
ext.ext_en: John reached over and took Joanna's hand...

defs.def_en: You can use over to indicate a particular position or place a short distance away from someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 他喝酒超过两杯就会醉倒在地。
ext.ext_en: If he drinks more than two glasses of wine he falls over...

ext.ext_cn: 他被一辆公共汽车撞倒，一条腿折了。
ext.ext_en: He was knocked over by a bus and broke his leg...

defs.def_en: You use over to say that someone or something falls towards or onto the ground, often suddenly or violently.

ext.ext_cn: 一只轮胎被扎破后，他的车翻了个底朝天。
ext.ext_en: His car rolled over after a tyre was punctured...

ext.ext_cn: 闹钟确实响了，但我只是打了个哈欠，翻个身又接着睡着了。
ext.ext_en: The alarm did go off but all I did was yawn, turn over and go back to sleep.

defs.def_en: If something rolls over or is turned over, its position changes so that the part that was facing upwards is now facing downwards.  →see usage note at:see Usage Note at above

ext.ext_cn: 在全国各地工作的医生
ext.ext_en: ...doctors who work all over the country.

ext.ext_cn: 她收到的来自世界各地的信件
ext.ext_en: ...the letters she received from people all over the world.

defs.def_en: All over a place means in every part of it.

defs.def_cn: 在这边；到这边；在身处国

ext.ext_cn: 你明天晚上过来吧。
ext.ext_en: Why don't you come over here tomorrow evening...

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲在这里的美国陆军服役。
ext.ext_en: My father was in the U.S. army over here.

defs.def_en: Over here means near you, or in the country you are in.

defs.def_cn: 在那边；到那边；在另一国

ext.ext_cn: 咖啡馆就在那边马路对面。
ext.ext_en: The cafe is just across the road over there...

ext.ext_cn: 她嫁给了一位美国人，并在那边定居了。
ext.ext_en: She'd married some American and settled down over there.

defs.def_en: Over there means in a place a short distance away from you, or in another country.

ext.ext_cn: 每年香烟夺去10万多英国人的生命。
ext.ext_en: Cigarettes kill over a hundred thousand Britons every year...

ext.ext_cn: 我认识乔治已经是一年多前的事了。
ext.ext_en: I met George well over a year ago.

defs.def_en: If something is over a particular amount, measurement, or age, it is more than that amount, measurement, or age.

defs.def_cn: 多于（正常数量）；除了…之外（还）

ext.ext_cn: 扣除通货膨胀因素，教育支出实际增长了7.8%。
ext.ext_en: Expenditure on education has gone up by seven point eight per cent over and above inflation...

ext.ext_cn: 除了这种健康饮食之外，还应考虑各种补养品。
ext.ext_en: Consider supplements over and above this healthy diet.

defs.def_en: Over and above an amount, especially a normal amount, means more than that amount or in addition to it.

ext.ext_cn: 拉森公司给我的薪水算是不错，但是两个人靠这份工资生活便没有多少闲钱买奢侈品了。
ext.ext_en: Larsons pay me well enough, but there's not much over for luxuries when there's two of you to live on it...

ext.ext_cn: 我们中午野餐剩下的一个苹果给了普丽姆罗丝。
ext.ext_en: Primrose was given an apple, left over from our picnic lunch.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have some food or money over, you mean that it remains after you have used all that you need.

ext.ext_cn: 她说如果有机会从头来过，她会雇一位新闻秘书。
ext.ext_en: She said if she had the chance to do it over, she would have hired a press secretary...

ext.ext_cn: 演奏钢琴的戴夫将这支曲子反复弹了两三遍。
ext.ext_en: Dave, the pianist, played it over a couple of times.

defs.def_en: If you do something over, you do it again or start doing it again from the beginning.

defs.def_cn: （强调发生不止一次）两次/三次

ext.ext_cn: 他不得不把所有事项都对他详细说明了两次。
ext.ext_en: He had to have everything spelled out twice over for him.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happened twice over ,three times over and so on, you are stating the number of times that it happened and emphasizing that it happened more than once.

ext.ext_cn: 当你意识到他们开始从头演唱同样的歌曲时，新鲜感也就没有了。
ext.ext_en: When you realise they are singing the same songs over again, the novelty wears off...

ext.ext_cn: 如果生命可以重来，我再也不会参加这么多委员会会议了。
ext.ext_en: If I was living my life over again I wouldn't have attended so many committee meetings.

defs.def_en: If you do something over again, you do it again or start doing it again from the beginning.

defs.def_cn: （指令人疲倦、厌烦、不快地）再一次，又一次，重新

ext.ext_cn: 他不想再惹这种麻烦了。
ext.ext_en: He doesn't want the hassle all over again...

ext.ext_cn: 整个程序又再次开始了。
ext.ext_en: The whole process started all over again...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is happening all over again, you are emphasizing that it is happening again, and you are suggesting that it is tiring, boring, or unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 他一遍又一遍地放着同样的歌曲。
ext.ext_en: He plays the same songs over and over...

ext.ext_cn: “我不明白，”他反复不停地说。
ext.ext_en: 'I don't understand it,' he said, over and over again.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happened over and over or over and over again, you are emphasizing that it happened many times.

ext.ext_cn: 降落在那里的战斗机将一直扣留到战争结束。
ext.ext_en: Warplanes that have landed there will be kept until the war is over...

ext.ext_cn: 倒霉的日子过去了。
ext.ext_en: The bad times were over...

defs.def_en: If an activity is over or all over, it is completely finished.

defs.def_cn: 从（某一疾病或经历）中恢复过来

ext.ext_cn: 你的流感好了，我真高兴。
ext.ext_en: I'm glad that you're over the flu...

ext.ext_cn: 她被告知了这件事，直到现在还惊魂未定。
ext.ext_en: She was still getting over the shock of what she had been told.

defs.def_en: If you are over an illness or an experience, it has finished and you have recovered from its effects.

ext.ext_cn: 他从未对她有过任何影响力。
ext.ext_en: He's never had any influence over her...

ext.ext_cn: 她20年来一直力图完全主宰自己的电影事业。
ext.ext_en: For two decades she has sought complete control over her film career...

defs.def_en: If you have control or influence over someone or something, you are able to control them or influence them.

ext.ext_cn: 这些女人是在无谓地小题大做。
ext.ext_en: The women were making a fuss over nothing.

ext.ext_cn: 对缅甸近期所发生事件的关注
ext.ext_en: ...concern over recent events in Burma...

defs.def_en: You use over to indicate what a disagreement or feeling relates to or is caused by.

ext.ext_cn: 上一周对首都的袭击次数已经减少了。
ext.ext_en: The number of attacks on the capital had gone down over the past week...

ext.ext_cn: 过去几年中有多次罢工都未获成功。
ext.ext_en: Many strikes over the last few years have not ended successfully...

defs.def_en: If something happens over a particular period of time or over something such as a meal, it happens during that time or during the meal.

ext.ext_cn: 我不想在电话里讨论这件事。
ext.ext_en: I'm not prepared to discuss this over the telephone...

ext.ext_cn: 这位国家元首通过广播向全国发表了讲话。
ext.ext_en: The head of state addressed the nation over the radio...

defs.def_en: You use over to indicate that you give or receive information using a telephone, radio, or other piece of electrical equipment.

defs.def_cn: （广播或电视节目中的主持人用语）下面交给…

ext.ext_cn: 下面由科林·梅特兰接着为大家播报其他体育新闻。
ext.ext_en: With the rest of the sports news, over to Colin Maitland.

defs.def_en: The presenter of a radio or television programme says 'over to someone' to indicate the person who will speak next.

defs.def_cn: （无线电通讯用语）完毕，请回答
defs.def_en: When people such as the police or the army are using a radio to communicate, they say 'Over' to indicate that they have finished speaking and are waiting for a reply.

defs.def_cn: （板球运动中）一轮6个（未让对方得分的）有效投球

ext.ext_cn: 在最后一轮由克里斯·刘易斯连续投出6个有效球之前，威尔士郡队本来胜券在握。
ext.ext_en: At the start of the last over, bowled by Chris Lewis, the Welsh county were favourites.

defs.def_en: In cricket, an over consists of six correctly bowled balls.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自相矛盾的；似矛盾而（可能） 正确的

ext.ext_cn: 一些镇静剂适得其反，加重了患者的焦虑。
ext.ext_en: Some sedatives produce the paradoxical effect of making the person more anxious...

ext.ext_cn: 我们是一个保持了个体的团队——尽管这听起来自相矛盾。
ext.ext_en: We were a team of individuals —  as paradoxical as that sounds.

defs.def_en: If something is paradoxical, it involves two facts or qualities which seem to contradict each other.

ext.ext_cn: 哈维的脸部特写
ext.ext_en: ...a close-up of Harvey's face.

ext.ext_cn: 休斯抬起头来凝视他的特写照片。
ext.ext_en: Hughes stared up at him in close-up from the photograph.

defs.def_en: A close-up is a photograph or a picture in a film that shows a lot of detail because it is taken very near to the subject.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人或人脸)清瘦的,憔悴的,愁眉苦脸的

ext.ext_cn: 她转向我时看上去憔悴又疲惫。
ext.ext_en: She looked drawn and tired when she turned towards me.

defs.def_en: If someone or their face looks drawn, their face is thin and they look very tired, ill, worried, or unhappy.

ext.ext_cn: 工艺人员服务公司也售卖纱线和绣花丝线。
ext.ext_en: Craft Resources also sells yarn and embroidery floss.

defs.def_en: See also:candyfloss;dental floss;You can use floss to refer to fine soft threads of some kind.

ext.ext_cn: 餐后要刷牙，而且每天要使用牙线清洁牙缝。
ext.ext_en: Brush your teeth after each meal and floss daily...

ext.ext_cn: 当时她正在用牙线剔牙。
ext.ext_en: She was flossing her teeth at the time.

defs.def_en: When you floss, you use a special kind of strong string to clean between your teeth and gums.

ext.ext_cn: 与肯尼迪先生争夺领导权的对手
ext.ext_en: ...Mr Kennedy's opponent in the leadership contest...

ext.ext_cn: 他称未经审判就将政敌关押起来是懦夫之举。
ext.ext_en: He described the detention without trial of political opponents as a cowardly act.

defs.def_en: A politician's opponents are other politicians who belong to a different party or who have different aims or policies.

ext.ext_cn: 诺里斯在前几个回合中两次击倒对手。
ext.ext_en: Norris twice knocked down his opponent in the early rounds of the fight...

ext.ext_cn: 他是我本赛季遇到的最出色的对手，一位了不起的运动员。
ext.ext_en: He's the best opponent I've come across this season, a great player.

defs.def_en: In a sporting contest, your opponent is the person who is playing against you.

ext.ext_cn: 反对核武器扩散的人士
ext.ext_en: ...opponents of the spread of nuclear weapons...

ext.ext_cn: 他成为旧的苏联体制直言不讳的抨击者。
ext.ext_en: He became an outspoken opponent of the old Soviet system.

defs.def_en: The opponents of an idea or policy do not agree with it and do not want it to be carried out.

ext.ext_cn: 他不想身边有那么多老古董。
ext.ext_en: He didn't want all those old fuddy-duddies around.

ext.ext_cn: 可能在后来的几年里我们真的让人感到有些古板。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps we did acquire a somewhat fuddy-duddy image in the later years.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a fuddy-duddy, you are criticizing or making fun of them because they are old-fashioned in their appearance or attitudes.

ext.ext_cn: 这些指控含有政治方面的因素。
ext.ext_en: There is a political dimension to the accusations...

ext.ext_cn: 这给我们的工作增添了新的内容。
ext.ext_en: This adds a new dimension to our work.

defs.def_en: A particular dimension of something is a particular aspect of it.

defs.def_cn: (情况或问题的)范围，规模，程度

ext.ext_cn: 他考虑了问题的严重程度。
ext.ext_en: He considers the dimensions of the problem...

ext.ext_cn: 股市崩盘的严重程度的确是没有预料到的。
ext.ext_en: The dimensions of the market collapse were certainly not anticipated.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the dimensions of a situation or problem, you are talking about its extent and size.

defs.def_cn: （长、宽、高等的）量度;尺寸;大小;面积

ext.ext_cn: 该处的钻探工作将继续下去，以便估测新油田的面积。
ext.ext_en: Drilling will continue on the site to assess the dimensions of the new oilfield...

ext.ext_cn: 我不认为它会破坏房间的大小。
ext.ext_en: I don't think it would spoil the dimensions of the room.

defs.def_en: A dimension is a measurement such as length, width, or height. If you talk about the dimensions of an object or place, you are referring to its size and proportions.
In mathematics and science, dimension is used in describing spatial concepts such as points, lines, and solids.

ext.ext_cn: 除非把事情记下来，否则我常常会忘事。
ext.ext_en: I tend to forget things unless I mark them down...

ext.ext_cn: 他一边抄价钱，一边不时停下来往一个大袋子里装东西。
ext.ext_en: As he marks down the prices, he stops now and then to pack things into a large bag.

defs.def_en: If you mark something down, you write it down.

ext.ext_cn: 要是当时他拿了那5英镑，我就会认定他是个贪心的蠢货。
ext.ext_en: If he'd taken that five pounds, I would have marked him down as a greedy fool...

ext.ext_cn: 那个时候，不管你对什么事情问“为什么”，都会被人视作激进分子。
ext.ext_en: In those days if you asked 'why?' about anything you were marked down as a militant.

defs.def_en: If you mark someone down as a particular type of person, especially a type that you do not like, you consider that they have the qualities which make them that type of person.

ext.ext_cn: 一家玩具店降低了电脑游戏《刺猬索尼克》的售价。
ext.ext_en: A toy store has marked down the Sonic Hedgehog computer game...

ext.ext_cn: 零售商将不得不为了提高销量而大幅降价。
ext.ext_en: Retailers will have to mark down prices sharply to bring in sales...

defs.def_en: To mark an item down or mark its price down means to reduce its price.

defs.def_cn: 给(学生的作业)扣分;降低…的分数

ext.ext_cn: 如果大家互相批改作业，别人便不会给你扣分，因为你随后也能给他们扣分。
ext.ext_en: If you mark each other's work, they don't mark you down because then you can mark them down.

defs.def_en: If a teacher marks a student down, the teacher puts a lower grade on the student's work because of a mistake that has been made.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (因害怕或担心)发狂的，狂躁的

ext.ext_cn: 一只鸟被关进了笼子，到现在它都十分狂躁。
ext.ext_en: A bird had been locked in and was by now quite frantic.

defs.def_en: If you are frantic, you are behaving in a wild and uncontrolled way because you are frightened or worried.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 匆忙混乱的;紧张忙乱的

ext.ext_cn: 餐馆晚上生意好,厨房里可能会忙成一片。
ext.ext_en: A busy night in the restaurant can be frantic in the kitchen.

defs.def_en: If an activity is frantic, things are done quickly and in an energetic but disorganized way, because there is very little time.

defs.def_cn: （武器、设备等）自动寻向的，自导引的

ext.ext_cn: 红外线自动寻的导弹
ext.ext_en: ...infra-red homing missiles...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的皇家轿车都装有电子自导引装置。
ext.ext_en: All the royal cars are fitted with electronic homing devices.

defs.def_en: A weapon or piece of equipment that has a homing system is able to guide itself to a target or to give out a signal that guides people to it.

ext.ext_cn: 然后鸽子飞进了浓雾中，其闻名的归巢本能丧失了。
ext.ext_en: Then the pigeons flew into thick fog, and the famous homing instinct failed.

defs.def_en: An animal that has a homing instinct has the ability to remember and return to a place where it has been in the past.
Your Achilles tendon or your Achilles is the tendon inside the back of your leg just above your heel.

defs.def_cn: （信末署名后的）附笔，附言，又及

ext.ext_cn: 在他的签名下，有一句简短的手写附言。
ext.ext_en: A brief, handwritten postscript lay beneath his signature.

defs.def_en: A postscript is something written at the end of a letter after you have signed your name. You usually write 'PS' in front of it.

defs.def_cn: （加在故事、记述、声明末尾的）附言，补充说明；补编；跋

ext.ext_cn: 正如编辑在附言中提醒读者的那样，她在本书出版前还要再经历两次精神疾病发作的折磨。
ext.ext_en: As the editor's postscript reminds the reader, she was to endure two more spells of mental illness before the book was published...

ext.ext_cn: 我想在你为约翰·凯奇写的讣告后补充一点内容。
ext.ext_en: I should like to add a postscript to your obituary for John Cage.

defs.def_en: A postscript is an addition to a finished story, account, or statement, which gives further information.

defs.def_cn: 凶杀悬疑小说（或电影、戏剧）
defs.def_en: A whodunnit is a novel, film, or play which is about a murder and which does not tell you who the murderer is until the end.

ext.ext_cn: 人们普遍认为我们是受公共基金的资助，然而我们大部分资金是通过签订竞争性合同得来的。
ext.ext_en: There's a popular supposition that we're publicly funded but the bulk of our money comes from competitive contracts...

ext.ext_cn: 博物学中虽然有许多类似的假设，却从没人对此考证过。
ext.ext_en: But as with many such suppositions in natural history, no one had ever tested it.

defs.def_en: A supposition is an idea or statement which someone believes or assumes to be true, although they may have no evidence for it.

defs.def_cn: 毫无根据的想法;无稽之谈

ext.ext_cn: 当局驳回了该报告，称其许多内容有的纯属臆测，有的存在偏差错误。
ext.ext_en: The report has been rejected by the authorities, who said much of it was based on supposition or inaccuracy.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone's ideas or statements as supposition if you disapprove of the fact that they have no evidence to support them.

ext.ext_cn: 他说一口流利的希伯来语。
ext.ext_en: He is a fluent speaker of Hebrew.

defs.def_en: Hebrew is a language that was spoken by Jews in former times. A modern form of Hebrew is spoken now in Israel.

defs.def_cn: 希伯来人（旧时指犹太人）

ext.ext_cn: 希伯来人出埃及之事
ext.ext_en: ...the exodus of the Hebrews from Egypt.

defs.def_en: In former times, a Hebrew was a Jewish person.

defs.def_cn: 希伯来语的;希伯来人的

ext.ext_cn: 受到尊崇的希伯来语报纸《国土报》
ext.ext_en: ...the respected Hebrew newspaper Haaretz...

ext.ext_cn: 他坐在那里对着古老的希伯来文本大伤脑筋。
ext.ext_en: He sits puzzling over ancient Hebrew texts.

defs.def_en: Hebrew means belonging to or relating to the Hebrew language or people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 肮脏的;邋遢的;恶心人的

ext.ext_cn: 纽约一个毒品泛滥的肮脏地区
ext.ext_en: ...a scuzzy drug district in New York.

defs.def_en: Something that is scuzzy is dirty or disgusting.

ext.ext_cn: 他突然转身走了。
ext.ext_en: He turned abruptly and walked away...

ext.ext_cn: 他转向他的宣传员开玩笑地问道：“下一个是什么？”
ext.ext_en: He turned to his publicist and jokingly asked, 'What's next?'…

defs.def_en: When you turn or when you turn part of your body, you move your body or part of your body so that it is facing in a different or opposite direction.

defs.def_cn: 转动;使转向;使改变方向

ext.ext_cn: 他们把望远镜转向附近其他星系。
ext.ext_en: They turned their telescopes towards other nearby galaxies...

ext.ext_cn: 把蛋糕翻到合适的方向对准金属丝架上。
ext.ext_en: Turn the cake the right way up on to a wire rack…

defs.def_en: When you turn something, you move it so that it is facing in a different or opposite direction, or is in a very different position.

ext.ext_cn: 轮子一边转动，制陶工人一边拉坯。
ext.ext_en: As the wheel turned, the potter shaped the clay...

ext.ext_cn: 发动机使螺旋桨旋转起来。
ext.ext_en: The engine turned a propeller.

defs.def_en: When something such as a wheel turns, or when you turn it, it continually moves around in a particular direction.

defs.def_cn: 转动，旋动(钥匙、把手、开关等)

ext.ext_cn: 转动一把特制的钥匙，踩下刹车踏板，这样你的汽车刹车就锁住了。
ext.ext_en: Turn a special key, press the brake pedal, and your car's brakes lock...

ext.ext_cn: 把温度调到很低，煮 20 分钟。
ext.ext_en: Turn the heat to very low and cook for 20 minutes...

defs.def_en: When you turn something such as a key, knob, or switch, or when it turns, you hold it and twist your hand, in order to open something or make it start working.

ext.ext_cn: 他转向自己居住的那条夹在排房间的狭窄街道。
ext.ext_en: He turned into the narrow terraced street where he lived…

ext.ext_cn: 现在向右拐沿西渡路往前走。
ext.ext_en: Now turn right to follow West Ferry Road...

defs.def_en: When you turn in a particular direction or turn a corner, you change the direction in which you are moving or travelling.

ext.ext_cn: 滕特菲尔德路拐向主道的岔路口
ext.ext_en: ...the corner where Tenterfield Road turned into the main road.

ext.ext_cn: 路上的急转弯
ext.ext_en: ...a sharp turn in the road.

defs.def_en: The point where a road, path, or river turns, is the point where it has a bend or curve in it.

ext.ext_cn: 不久就要涨潮了。
ext.ext_en: There was not much time before the tide turned.

defs.def_en: When the tide turns, it starts coming in or going out.

ext.ext_cn: 他们还在院子里一通杂耍，翻着跟头，玩着侧手翻。
ext.ext_en: They were still doing wild acrobatics in the yard, turning somersaults and cartwheels.

defs.def_en: When someone turns a cartwheel or a somersault, they do a cartwheel or somersault.

ext.ext_cn: 他翻阅面前的文件。
ext.ext_en: He turned the pages of a file in front of him.

defs.def_en: When you turn a page of a book or magazine, you move it so that is flat against the previous page, and you can read the next page.

ext.ext_cn: 他企图把枪对准我。
ext.ext_en: He tried to turn the gun on me...

ext.ext_cn: 然后人群把怒火都撒向詹姆斯·米切尔总理。
ext.ext_en: The crowd then turned their anger on Prime Minister James Mitchell.

defs.def_en: If you turn a weapon or an aggressive feeling on someone, you point it at them or direct it at them.

ext.ext_cn: 如需订购，参见 236 页。
ext.ext_en: To order, turn to page 236.

defs.def_en: If you turn to a particular page in a book or magazine, you open it at that page.

defs.def_cn: 开始思考;开始讨论;把(注意力等)转向

ext.ext_cn: 我们开始考虑有关成立公司的具体事宜。
ext.ext_en: We turned our attention to the practical matters relating to forming a company...

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在来关注英国新闻。
ext.ext_en: We turn now to the British news.

defs.def_en: If you turn your attention or thoughts to a particular subject or if you turn to it, you start thinking about it or discussing it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们求助于该市最具创新风格的一家博物馆。
ext.ext_en: For assistance, they turned to one of the city's most innovative museums...

ext.ext_cn: 没人可以求助，没人可以诉说。
ext.ext_en: There was no one to turn to, no one to tell.

defs.def_en: If you turn to someone, you ask for their help or advice.

ext.ext_cn: 这些团体现在正转而致力于大规模的回收利用工作。
ext.ext_en: These communities are now turning to recycling in large numbers...

ext.ext_cn: 超级大国开始着手削减核武器库这项更为艰难的工作。
ext.ext_en: The Superpowers turned to the harder task of cutting their nuclear arsenals…

defs.def_en: If you turn to a particular activity, job, or way of doing something, you start doing or using it.

ext.ext_cn: 在这个卡通童话里王子变成了一只青蛙。
ext.ext_en: A prince turns into a frog in this cartoon fairytale...

ext.ext_cn: 当送葬队走到墓地时，他们更加悲恸欲绝。
ext.ext_en: Their grief turned to hysteria when the funeral procession arrived at the cemetery…

defs.def_en: To turn or be turned into something means to become that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 如果法警认为事情变得不可收拾，他就会寻求警方的帮助。
ext.ext_en: If the bailiff thinks that things could turn nasty he will enlist the help of the police...

ext.ext_cn: 她宣布自己即将成为职业选手。
ext.ext_en: She announced that she was going to turn professional.

defs.def_en: You can use turn before an adjective to indicate that something or someone changes by acquiring the quality described by the adjective.

ext.ext_cn: 大海会变成浅粉色，天空则变成血红色。
ext.ext_en: The sea would turn pale pink and the sky blood red...

ext.ext_cn: 隐形眼镜把她的眼睛变成了绿色。
ext.ext_en: Her contact lenses turned her eyes green.

defs.def_en: If something turns a particular colour or if something turns it a particular colour, it becomes that colour.

ext.ext_cn: 如果天气变冷，就把植物盖起来。
ext.ext_en: If it turns cold, cover plants...

ext.ext_cn: 天气一夜之间就转暖，而且雷声阵阵。
ext.ext_en: The weather had turned warm and thundery overnight.

defs.def_en: You can use turn to indicate that there is a change to a particular kind of weather. For example, if it turns cold, the weather starts being cold.

defs.def_cn: (时局或趋势的)逆转，转变，变化

ext.ext_cn: 周末时丑闻有了新的发展。
ext.ext_en: The scandal took a new turn over the weekend.

ext.ext_cn: 战斗的最新进展
ext.ext_en: …the latest turn in the fighting…

defs.def_en: If a situation or trend takes a particular kind of turn, it changes so that it starts developing in a different or opposite way.

ext.ext_cn: 比赛在第 56 分钟时发生了扭转。
ext.ext_en: The game turned in the 56th minute.

ext.ext_cn: 加雷思·爱德华兹于 1971 年法国队与威尔士队在巴黎的比赛中贡献的一记扭转赛事的触地得分
ext.ext_en: …the Gareth Edwards try which turned the game between France and Wales in Paris in 1971.

defs.def_en: In sports, if a game turns, or is turned, something significant happens which changes the way the game is developing.

ext.ext_cn: 那家公司将有能力支付债务，而且还会赚得一笔可观的利润。
ext.ext_en: The firm will be able to service debt and still turn a modest profit...

ext.ext_cn: 他说票价太低，根本无利可图。
ext.ext_en: He says the fares are just too low to turn profits.

defs.def_en: If a business turns a profit, it earns more money than it spends.

ext.ext_cn: 他立志要在而立之年以前攒够 100 万美元。
ext.ext_en: It was his ambition to accumulate a million dollars before he turned thirty...

ext.ext_cn: 刚过 12 点。
ext.ext_en: It had just turned twelve o'clock.

defs.def_en: When someone turns a particular age, they pass that age. When it turns a particular time, it passes that time.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在世纪之交逃到了南美洲。
ext.ext_en: They fled to South America around the turn of the century.

defs.def_en: Turn is used in expressions such as the turn of the century and the turn of the year to refer to a period of time when one century or year is ending and the next one is beginning.

ext.ext_cn: 靠车削木材谋生的乐趣
ext.ext_en: ...the joys of making a living from turning wood.

ext.ext_cn: 精心车削的金属
ext.ext_en: …finely-turned metal.

defs.def_en: When someone turns a wooden or metal object that they are making, they shape it using a special tool.

defs.def_cn: (依次轮流时的)轮班，次序，轮番

ext.ext_cn: 今晚该我做饭了。
ext.ext_en: Tonight it's my turn to cook...

ext.ext_cn: 让每个孩子轮流钓鱼。
ext.ext_en: Let each child have a turn at fishing...

defs.def_en: If it is your turn to do something, you now have the duty, chance, or right to do it, when other people have done it before you or will do it after you.

ext.ext_cn: 他又犯病了。
ext.ext_en: He is having one of his turns…

ext.ext_cn: 他总是感觉不舒服。也是，他都这个岁数了。
ext.ext_en: He gets funny turns, you know. It's his age.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is having a turn, you mean they feel suddenly very unwell for a short period of time.

defs.def_cn: （表示两种感情或品质的交替）时而，间或

ext.ext_cn: 他的语气时而透着愤怒，时而流露出哀怨。
ext.ext_en: His tone was by turns angry and aggrieved.

defs.def_en: You can use by turns to indicate that someone has two particular emotions or qualities, one after the other.

ext.ext_cn: 这种出乎意料的形势变化让他们无比震惊。
ext.ext_en: They were horrified at this unexpected turn of events.

defs.def_en: If there is a particular turn of events, a particular series of things happen.

ext.ext_cn: 因为缺乏训练有素的员工，其生产经营总是遇到各种障碍。
ext.ext_en: Its operations were hampered at every turn by inadequate numbers of trained staff...

ext.ext_cn: 到处是烟雾和火焰，根本无法进入住处。
ext.ext_en: At every turn smoke and flame stopped efforts to get into the living quarters.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens at every turn, you are emphasizing that it happens frequently or all the time, usually so that it prevents you from achieving what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 他辞职对你有利。
ext.ext_en: He did you a good turn by resigning...

ext.ext_cn: 善有善报。
ext.ext_en: One good turn deserves another.

defs.def_en: If you do someone a good turn, you do something that helps or benefits them.

defs.def_cn: 彻底搜查;把…翻个底朝天

ext.ext_cn: 他们虽然把他的公寓翻了个底朝天，却没有找到一丝证据。
ext.ext_en: They hadn't found a scrap of evidence though they had turned his flat inside out.

defs.def_en: If someone turns a place inside out or upside down, they search it very thoroughly and usually make it very untidy.

defs.def_cn: 彻底改变，完全搅乱（体制或生活方式）

ext.ext_cn: 他惊呆了。他的世界已经完全被打乱了。
ext.ext_en: He felt too shocked to move. His world had been turned upside down.

defs.def_en: If something such as a system or way of life is turned inside out or upside down, it is changed completely, making people confused or upset.

ext.ext_cn: 手术小组的一名成员把这个消息泄露给了在一起工作的一个内科医生，后者又透露给了一位记者。
ext.ext_en: One of the members of the surgical team leaked the story to a fellow physician who, in turn, confided in a reporter.

defs.def_en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, for example because one causes the other.

ext.ext_cn: 当这些女人们逐一发言时，她们每个人都赢得了喝彩声。
ext.ext_en: There were cheers for each of the women as they spoke in turn.

defs.def_en: If each person in a group does something in turn, they do it one after the other in a fixed or agreed order.

ext.ext_cn: 她是个理性的人。
ext.ext_en: She was of a rational turn of mind.

defs.def_en: If someone is of a particular turn of mind, they have that kind of mind or character.

ext.ext_cn: 希望我没有多嘴。
ext.ext_en: I hope I haven't spoken out of turn.

defs.def_en: If you speak out of turn or talk out of turn, you say something that you do not have the right or authority to say.
If a person, animal, or vehicle has a good turn of speed, they have the ability to move fast.

ext.ext_cn: 我们轮流开车。
ext.ext_en: We took turns to drive the car...

ext.ext_cn: 我和特德轮流去医院陪护埃玛。
ext.ext_en: Ted and I took it in turns to go into hospital and sit with Emma.

defs.def_en: If two or more people take turns to do something, or in British English take it in turns to do something, they do it one after the other several times, rather than doing it together.

ext.ext_cn: 她的病情突然急剧恶化。
ext.ext_en: Her condition took a sharp turn for the worse.

defs.def_en: If a situation takes a turn for the worse, it suddenly becomes worse. If a situation takes a turn for the better, it suddenly becomes better.

ext.ext_cn: 一大群人聚集在克里姆林宫墙外的广场上。
ext.ext_en: A huge crowd gathered in a square outside the Kremlin walls...

ext.ext_cn: 大概花了两个小时才把人群全部疏散开。
ext.ext_en: It took some two hours before the crowd was fully dispersed...

defs.def_en: A crowd is a large group of people who have gathered together, for example to watch or listen to something interesting, or to protest about something.

defs.def_cn: (志趣相投或工作相同的)一伙人，一帮人

ext.ext_cn: 那些老伙计们都来参加这一庆典。
ext.ext_en: All the old crowd have come out for this occasion.

defs.def_en: A particular crowd is a group of friends, or a set of people who share the same interests or job.

ext.ext_cn: 饥饿的难民聚集到拖拉机周围。
ext.ext_en: The hungry refugees crowded around the tractors...

ext.ext_cn: 当酒店工作人员和旅客们都聚拢过来时，警察封锁了那条路。
ext.ext_en: Police blocked off the road as hotel staff and guests crowded around.

defs.def_en: When people crowd around someone or something, they gather closely together around them.

ext.ext_cn: 几十万人涌入立陶宛首都维尔纽斯的市中心。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of thousands of people have crowded into the center of the Lithuanian capital, Vilnius...

ext.ext_cn: 一群记者挤进一辆小型公共汽车。
ext.ext_en: One group of journalists were crowded into a minibus...

defs.def_en: If people crowd into a place or are crowded into a place, large numbers of them enter it so that it becomes very full.

ext.ext_cn: 数千名高喊着口号的示威者把街道挤得水泄不通。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of demonstrators crowded the streets shouting slogans.

defs.def_en: If a group of people crowd a place, there are so many of them there that it is full.

ext.ext_cn: 这是紧张、忙碌的一天，每时每刻都有人围在她身旁。
ext.ext_en: It had been a tense, restless day with people crowding her all the time.

defs.def_en: If people crowd you, they stand very closely around you trying to see or speak to you, so that you feel uncomfortable.
A toupee is a piece of artificial hair worn by a man to cover a patch on his head where he has lost his hair.

defs.def_cn: 前轮大后轮小的旧式自行车
defs.def_en: A penny-farthing is an old-fashioned bicycle that had a very large front wheel and a small back wheel.

ext.ext_cn: 他们出入办公室要刷卡。
ext.ext_en: They use a swipe card to go in and out of their offices.

defs.def_en: A swipe card is a plastic card with a magnetic strip on it which contains information that can be read or transferred by passing the card through a special machine.

ext.ext_cn: 20 世纪 80 年代，一些出版巨头开始吞并一些较小的公司。
ext.ext_en: During the 1980s monster publishing houses started to swallow up smaller companies.

defs.def_en: If one thing is swallowed up by another, it becomes part of the first thing and no longer has a separate identity of its own.

ext.ext_cn: 7 天的电视广告宣传可能会耗费约 5 万英镑。
ext.ext_en: A seven-day TV ad campaign could swallow up the best part of £50,000...

ext.ext_cn: 农场主会发现由于利率的上涨，收入减少了1/4。
ext.ext_en: Farmers could see a quarter of their income swallowed up by the interest rate rise.

defs.def_en: If something swallows up money or resources, it uses them entirely while giving very little in return.

ext.ext_cn: 他转身朝跳蚤市场走去，很快淹没在人群中。
ext.ext_en: He headed back towards the flea market and was quickly swallowed up in the crowd...

ext.ext_cn: 花园里杂草丛生。
ext.ext_en: Weeds had swallowed up the garden.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is swallowed up by something, they disappear into it so that you cannot see them any more.

ext.ext_cn: 我们很多人都寄望于替代疗法，个中原因从女性看医生所遇到的困难可知一二。
ext.ext_en: The difficulties women encounter with their doctors partly explain why so many of us are looking to alternative therapies.

defs.def_en: If you look to someone or something for a particular thing that you want, you expect or hope that they will provide it.

defs.def_cn: 展望，思考（将来发生的事）

ext.ext_cn: 不过，展望未来，我们问到他研制出防止感染的疫苗究竟有多大的可能性。
ext.ext_en: Looking to the future, though, we asked him what the prospects are for a vaccine to prevent infection in the first place.

defs.def_en: If you look to something that will happen in the future, you think about it.
A woman's vagina is the passage connecting her outer sex organs to her womb.

ext.ext_cn: 韦兰假装在便笺薄上做笔记。
ext.ext_en: Welland made a pretence of writing a note in his pad...

ext.ext_cn: 我们只得一直假装情形在好转。
ext.ext_en: We have to go along with the pretence that things are getting better...

defs.def_en: A pretence is an action or way of behaving that is intended to make people believe something that is not true.

defs.def_cn: 以虚假的借口；以欺骗的手段

ext.ext_cn: 我再也不能和一个靠谎言骗我结婚的男人继续生活下去了。
ext.ext_en: I could not go on living with a man who had married me under false pretences...

ext.ext_cn: 康拉德因为诈骗钱财已经坐了一年的牢。
ext.ext_en: Conrad had been imprisoned for a year for gaining money by false pretences.

defs.def_en: If you do something under false pretences, you do it when people do not know the truth about you and your intentions.

ext.ext_cn: 他这次探险的最大收获就是重新发现了自己对动手制作物品与生俱来的热忱。
ext.ext_en: The best part of his expedition had been the rediscovery of his natural passion for making things.

defs.def_en: The rediscovery of something good that you had forgotten or lost is the fact or process of becoming aware of it again or finding it again.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 贝茜身穿华丽的深蓝色天鹅绒衣服，在桌旁徘徊。
ext.ext_en: Bessie, resplendent in royal blue velvet, was hovering beside the table.

ext.ext_cn: 富丽堂皇的宾馆宴会厅
ext.ext_en: ...the resplendent hotel banqueting-room.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as resplendent, you mean that their appearance is very impressive and expensive-looking.

defs.def_en: If you forget something or forget how to do something, you cannot think of it or think how to do it, although you knew it or knew how to do it in the past.

ext.ext_en: She forgot to lock her door one day and two men got in...

defs.def_en: If you forget something or forget to do it, you fail to think about it or fail to remember to do it, for example because you are thinking about other things.

ext.ext_en: Once when we were going to Paris, I forgot my passport.

defs.def_en: If you forget something that you had intended to bring with you, you do not bring it because you did not think about it at the right time.

defs.def_en: You say 'Forget it' in reply to someone as a way of telling them not to worry or bother about something, or as an emphatic way of saying no to a suggestion.
