ext.ext_en: ...a London netherworld of criminals...

ext.ext_cn: 韦茨歌唱美国都市纵酒豪饮的下层世界。
ext.ext_en: Waits sang about the boozy netherworld of urban America.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a place as a netherworld, you mean that it is dangerous and full of poor people and criminals.

defs.def_cn: 使残缺不全;使受到严重损伤

ext.ext_cn: 在过去9个月里，超过30匹马受了重伤。
ext.ext_en: More than 30 horses have been mutilated in the last nine months...

ext.ext_cn: 他严刑拷问了6名年轻男子。
ext.ext_en: He tortured and mutilated six young men...

defs.def_en: If a person or animal is mutilated, their body is severely damaged, usually by someone who physically attacks them.

ext.ext_cn: 布雷赫特的结论是他的电影剧本已被窜改。
ext.ext_en: Brecht's verdict was that his screenplay had been mutilated...

ext.ext_cn: 我发现一盘被弄坏的盒式磁带丢在废纸篓里。
ext.ext_en: I discovered a mutilated cassette stuffed in a wastebasket.

defs.def_en: If something is mutilated, it is deliberately damaged or spoiled.

defs.def_cn: (团体、政党的)正式成员的;持有正式成员证的

ext.ext_cn: 我是个已有5年党龄的工党正式党员。
ext.ext_en: I've been a card-carrying member of the Labour party for five years.

defs.def_en: A card-carrying member of a particular group or political party is an official member of that group or party, rather than someone who supports it.

defs.def_cn: 身体力行的;彻头彻尾的

ext.ext_cn: 坚定虔诚的基督教徒
ext.ext_en: ...a card-carrying Christian.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as, for example, a card-carrying feminist, you are emphasizing the fact that they believe strongly in and try to carry out the ideas of feminism.

defs.def_cn: (运动员、乐手、歌手等)半职业性的

ext.ext_cn: 半职业的乡村乐手
ext.ext_en: ...a semi-professional country musician...

ext.ext_cn: 我作为半职业球员为沃尔索尔队踢过球。
ext.ext_en: I played semi-professional soccer for Walsall.

defs.def_en: Semi-professional sports players, musicians, and singers receive some money for playing their sport or for performing but they also have an ordinary job as well.

ext.ext_cn: 我的母亲会帮我做功课。
ext.ext_en: My mother would help me with my schoolwork.

defs.def_en: Schoolwork is the work that a child does at school or is given at school to do at home.

defs.def_cn: 大地，陆地（相对于空中或海中而言让人感到安全）

ext.ext_cn: 他发现自己又回到了陆地的如释重负感
ext.ext_en: ...his relief on finding himself once more on terra firma.

defs.def_en: If you describe the ground as terra firma, you mean that it feels safe in contrast to being in the air or at sea.

ext.ext_cn: 到了傍晚我们累趴下了，于是回家。
ext.ext_en: By dusk we were dog-tired and heading for home.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are dog-tired, you are emphasizing that you are extremely tired.

defs.def_cn: 排练，演练，预演(戏剧、舞蹈或音乐作品)

ext.ext_cn: 一群演员正在排演一出关于圣女贞德的戏。
ext.ext_en: A group of actors are rehearsing a play about Joan of Arc...

ext.ext_cn: 数万人一直在工人体育馆为开幕式进行排练。
ext.ext_en: Tens of thousands of people have been rehearsing for the opening ceremony in the workers' stadium...

defs.def_en: When people rehearse a play, dance, or piece of music, they practise it in order to prepare for a performance.

ext.ext_cn: 预先考虑可能遇到的各种棘手问题，并且自己练习回答。
ext.ext_en: Anticipate any tough questions and rehearse your answers...

ext.ext_cn: 我们鼓励他们默述一下他们要说的内容。
ext.ext_en: We encouraged them to rehearse what they were going to say.

defs.def_en: If you rehearse something that you are going to say or do, you silently practise it by imagining that you are saying or doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天在苏格兰党人会议上的演讲中又一次重复了这些观点。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday's speech to the Scottish party conference rehearsed the arguments again.

defs.def_en: If you rehearse something, you repeat it in detail.
In printing, a font is a set of characters of the same style and size.

defs.def_cn: 洗礼盆，圣水盂(教堂中洗礼用)
defs.def_en: In a church, a font is a bowl which holds the water used for baptisms.
A coot is a water bird with black feathers and a white patch on its forehead.

ext.ext_cn: 弗洛伊德的病人的典型家庭结构是父母二人和两个孩子。
ext.ext_en: The typical family structure of Freud's patients involved two parents and two children...

ext.ext_cn: 这个特殊分子的化学结构很不寻常。
ext.ext_en: The chemical structure of this particular molecule is very unusual.

defs.def_en: The structure of something is the way in which it is made, built, or organized.

ext.ext_cn: 脚的结构非常特殊，由 26 块细小的骨头组成。
ext.ext_en: The feet are highly specialised structures made up of 26 small delicate bones.

defs.def_en: A structure is something that consists of parts connected together in an ordered way.

ext.ext_cn: 那些基金中大约有一半已被用来维修公路、公共建筑物和桥梁。
ext.ext_en: About half of those funds has gone to repair public roads, structures and bridges...

ext.ext_cn: 这所房子是一幢造型美观的四层砖砌建筑物。
ext.ext_en: The house was a handsome four-story brick structure.

defs.def_en: A structure is something that has been built.

defs.def_cn: 系统安排;精心组织;使形成体系

ext.ext_cn: 这样制定发展规划后，我们不得不生产各公司认为有价值的东西。
ext.ext_en: By structuring the course this way, we're forced to produce something the companies think is valuable.

defs.def_en: If you structure something, you arrange it in a careful, organized pattern or system.
Soda is the same as soda water .

ext.ext_cn: 一杯健怡汽水
ext.ext_en: ...a glass of diet soda.

ext.ext_cn: 他们为大人准备了酒，为小孩准备了汽水。
ext.ext_en: They had liquor for the adults and sodas for the children.

defs.def_en: Soda is a sweet fizzy drink.

ext.ext_cn: 自助冷饮和小包薯片
ext.ext_en: ...self-service fountain sodas and small bags of potato chips.

defs.def_en: A soda is an ice-cream soda .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 店里的一些地方十分肮脏不洁，简直就是滋生细菌的理想温床。
ext.ext_en: Parts of the shop were very dirty, unhygienic, and an ideal breeding ground for bacteria.

ext.ext_cn: 不卫生的条件
ext.ext_en: ...unhygienic conditions.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unhygienic, you mean that it is dirty and likely to cause infection or disease.

defs.def_cn: (人或物的)行踪，下落，所在之处

ext.ext_cn: 警方急盼任何可能知道这批武器下落的人提供线索。
ext.ext_en: The police are anxious to hear from anyone who may know the whereabouts of the firearms...

ext.ext_cn: 一旦他知道了父亲的名字，查找他父亲的下落就变得出奇地容易。
ext.ext_en: Once he knew his father's name, finding his whereabouts proved surprisingly easy.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the whereabouts of a particular person or thing, you mean the place where that person or thing may be found.

ext.ext_cn: 你从利物浦什么地方来的？
ext.ext_en: Whereabouts in Liverpool are you from?...

ext.ext_cn: 你的详细住址是哪里？
ext.ext_en: Whereabouts are you living?...

defs.def_en: You use whereabouts in questions when you are asking precisely where something is.

defs.def_cn: (尤用于某些动词和形容词后，引导表示具体处所的从句)具体在哪里

ext.ext_cn: 我住在杰曼·格里尔家附近的村子里，知道她具体住在哪儿。
ext.ext_en: I live in a village near to Germaine Greer and know whereabouts she lives.

defs.def_en: You use whereabouts after certain words, especially verbs and adjectives, to introduce a clause in which you mention precisely where something is situated or happens.

defs.def_cn: (已故公爵、君主等的)孀居贵妇

ext.ext_cn: 斯潘塞伯爵遗孀
ext.ext_en: ...the Dowager Countess Spencer...

ext.ext_cn: 在皇帝遗孀面前任何人不得进餐。
ext.ext_en: Nobody was allowed to eat in the Empress Dowager's presence.

defs.def_en: You use dowager to refer to the wife of a dead duke, emperor, or other man of high rank.

defs.def_cn: 气度不凡的老妇;老年贵妇

ext.ext_cn: 像游轮上气宇不凡的老年贵妇
ext.ext_en: ...like stately dowagers on a cruise.

defs.def_en: If you describe a woman as a dowager, you mean that she is old and rich or looks important.

defs.def_cn: (将饼干、面包等)浸一浸,泡一泡

ext.ext_cn: 很多人在咖啡、茶或牛奶里蘸东西吃。
ext.ext_en: Many people dunk their foods in coffee, tea or milk.

defs.def_en: If you dunk something such as a biscuit or a piece of bread in a drink or in soup, you dip it into the drink or soup before eating it.

ext.ext_cn: 栽种新植物之前将它们在水桶中浸泡一小时左右。
ext.ext_en: Dunk new plants in a bucket of water for an hour or so before planting.

defs.def_en: If you dunk something in a liquid, you put it in the liquid, especially for a particular purpose and for a short time.

ext.ext_cn: 在越南对美亚混血儿的歧视现象
ext.ext_en: ...discrimination against Amerasians in Vietnam.

ext.ext_cn: 美亚混血男孩
ext.ext_en: ...an Amerasian boy.

defs.def_en: People who have one American parent and one Asian parent are sometimes referred to as Amerasians .

ext.ext_cn: 那时我们不可能预料到我们这项运动的结果。
ext.ext_en: At the time we couldn't have anticipated the result of our campaigning...

ext.ext_cn: 预计将失去相当于192份全职工作的岗位。
ext.ext_en: It is anticipated that the equivalent of 192 full-time jobs will be lost...

defs.def_en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

defs.def_cn: 未待提出就回答（问题）；预先考虑并满足（请求、需要等）

ext.ext_cn: 杰夫预先回答了我的下一个问题。
ext.ext_en: What Jeff did was to anticipate my next question...

ext.ext_cn: 你是否期望你的伴侣不等你提出就主动满足你的需要？
ext.ext_en: Do you expect your partner to anticipate your needs?

defs.def_en: If you anticipate a question, request, or need, you do what is necessary or required before the question, request, or need occurs.

defs.def_cn: 早于…做（或想、说）；先于…行动

ext.ext_cn: 上世纪50年代时，劳申伯格就早早地预见到了80年代的概念艺术运动。
ext.ext_en: In the 50s, Rauschenberg anticipated the conceptual art movement of the 80s.

defs.def_en: If you anticipate something, you do it, think it, or say it before someone else does.

defs.def_cn: 流浪者;露宿街头者;住廉价旅馆者
defs.def_en: A dosser is a city person who does not have a permanent home and sleeps in the streets or in very cheap hotels.

ext.ext_cn: 膝部软骨组织严重受伤
ext.ext_en: ...a serious knee cartilage injury.

defs.def_en: Cartilage is a strong, flexible substance in your body, especially around your joints and in your nose.

defs.def_cn: （尤指体育比赛中的）连中三元，帽子戏法

ext.ext_cn: 我在和阿森纳队的比赛中上演了帽子戏法。
ext.ext_en: I scored a hat-trick against Arsenal.

defs.def_en: A hat-trick is a series of three achievements, especially in a sports event, for example three goals scored by the same person in a football game.

ext.ext_cn: 设计轮盘时在小球的行进路线上设置了障碍，以使其运动随机化。
ext.ext_en: The wheel is designed with obstacles in the ball's path to randomise its movement...

ext.ext_cn: 真正的随机研究现在才接近完成。
ext.ext_en: Properly randomized studies are only now being completed.

defs.def_en: If you randomize the events or people in scientific experiments or academic research, you use a method that gives them all an equal chance of happening or being chosen.

defs.def_cn: (国家或组织的)军阀式领袖，暴君

ext.ext_cn: 他既独裁又好战，压迫侮辱南方人。
ext.ext_en: He had been a dictator and a warlord who had oppressed and degraded the people of the South.

ext.ext_cn: 毒枭
ext.ext_en: ...a drug warlord.

defs.def_en: If you describe a leader of a country or organization as a warlord, you are critical of them because they have achieved power by behaving in an aggressive and violent way.
Dance halls were large rooms or buildings where people used to pay to go and dance, usually in the evening.
The CID is the branch of the police force in Britain concerned with finding out who has committed crimes. CID is an abbreviation for (缩略 =) 'Criminal Investigation Department'.
A drawing board is a large flat board, often fixed to a metal frame so that it looks like a desk, on which you place your paper when you are drawing or designing something.
If you say that you will have to go back to the drawing board, you mean that something which you have done has not been successful and that you will have to start again or try another idea.

defs.def_cn: 十足的；完全的；彻头彻尾的

ext.ext_cn: 结果证明奥运会主题歌《永远的朋友》极为成功。
ext.ext_en: The Olympic theme tune 'Amigos para Siempre' (Friends for Life) proved an out-and-out success...

ext.ext_cn: 关于我们的报道大都是彻头彻尾的胡编乱造。
ext.ext_en: Much of what has been written about us is out-and-out lies.

defs.def_en: You use out-and-out to emphasize that someone or something has all the characteristics of a particular type of person or thing.

defs.def_cn: 使十分恼火;使大怒;激怒

ext.ext_cn: 吉米的到场激怒了休。
ext.ext_en: Jimmy's presence had infuriated Hugh...

ext.ext_cn: 冠军获得者对这一决定十分恼火。
ext.ext_en: The champion was infuriated by the decision...

defs.def_en: If something or someone infuriates you, they make you extremely angry.

ext.ext_cn: 许多应征入伍者对被迫服兵役愤愤不平。
ext.ext_en: Many conscripts resent having to do their military service.

defs.def_en: Military service is a period of service in the armed forces that every man in certain countries has to do.

defs.def_cn: 十几岁，青少年时期(指从 13 岁到 19 岁)

ext.ext_cn: 多数烟民从十几岁时就开始抽烟了。
ext.ext_en: Most people who smoke began smoking in their teens...

ext.ext_cn: 我二十岁前后那几年过得真苦啊。
ext.ext_en: My late teens and early twenties were really rough years...

defs.def_en: If you are in your teens, you are between thirteen and nineteen years old.

defs.def_cn: 面向青少年的;由青少年完成的

ext.ext_cn: 乔治·卡林主演的青春片
ext.ext_en: ...a teen movie starring George Carlin...

ext.ext_cn: 不能激起广大青少年热情的流行音乐就不能称其为流行音乐。
ext.ext_en: Pop isn't pop without huge teen sensations.

defs.def_en: Teen is used to describe things such as films, magazines, bands, or activities that are aimed at or are done by people who are in their teens.

defs.def_cn: 青少年,十几岁的孩子(指从 13 岁到 19 岁)

ext.ext_cn: 从前，十几岁的孩子到了暑假都能找着活干。
ext.ext_en: It used to be that any teen who wanted a summer job could get one.

defs.def_en: A teen is someone aged between thirteen and nineteen years old.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 折磨人的;极端痛苦的;引起痛苦的

ext.ext_cn: 他的呼吸充满痛苦。
ext.ext_en: His breathing was torturous…

ext.ext_cn: 这是一种让人受尽折磨、痛苦难忍的杀人方法。
ext.ext_en: This is a torturous, agonizing way to kill someone.

defs.def_en: Something that is torturous is extremely painful and causes great suffering.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可思议的；难以置信的；极好的；非常棒的

ext.ext_cn: 他的吉他独奏棒极了。
ext.ext_en: His guitar solos are just unbelievable...

ext.ext_cn: 他们给我们施加的压力之大超乎想象。
ext.ext_en: The pressure they put us under was unbelievable...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is unbelievable, you are emphasizing that it is very good, impressive, intense, or extreme.

defs.def_cn: 极其糟糕的；令人震惊的；令人无法相信的

ext.ext_cn: 人们竟能接受这样的行为，我震惊不已。
ext.ext_en: I find it unbelievable that people can accept this sort of behaviour...

ext.ext_cn: 是的，音乐图书馆被烧了，三四把低音提琴烧毁了。真是太不幸了。
ext.ext_en: Yes, the music library burned, three or four double basses burned. It's just unbelievable.

defs.def_en: You can use unbelievable to emphasize that you think something is very bad or shocking.

ext.ext_cn: 我仍觉得这个故事既有趣又不太可信。
ext.ext_en: I still find this story both fascinating and unbelievable...

ext.ext_cn: 我知道听上去难以置信，但我从不想撒谎。
ext.ext_en: I know it sounds unbelievable but I never wanted to cheat.

defs.def_en: If an idea or statement is unbelievable, it seems so unlikely to be true that you cannot believe it.

defs.def_cn: 先见之明;预见力;千里眼
defs.def_en: If you say that someone has second sight, you mean that they seem to have the ability to know or see things that are going to happen in the future, or are happening in a different place.

ext.ext_cn: 一种鼓励冒险和创新精神的更加浓厚的创业氛围
ext.ext_en: ...a more entrepreneurial climate, with positive encouragement of risk-taking and innovation.

defs.def_en: Risk-taking means taking actions which might have unpleasant or undesirable results.

ext.ext_cn: 他被派遣到香港任C中队的副队长。
ext.ext_en: He was posted to Hong Kong as second-in-command of C Squadron...

ext.ext_cn: 总统一职由其副手接替。
ext.ext_en: The President was replaced by his second-in-command.

defs.def_en: A second-in-command is someone who is next in rank to the leader of a group, and who has authority to give orders when the leader is not there.

ext.ext_cn: 他们最终决定通过住房合作社来重建奥米斯顿月牙街。
ext.ext_en: They decided a housing co-operative was the way to regenerate Ormiston Crescent...

ext.ext_cn: 这家饭店是合作经营的。
ext.ext_en: The restaurant is run as a co-operative.

defs.def_en: A co-operative is a business or organization run by the people who work for it, or owned by the people who use it. These people share its benefits and profits.

defs.def_cn: 齐心协力的;合作进行的

ext.ext_cn: 在埃及当局和美国当局的共同努力下他被顺利移交美国联邦调查局进行羁押。
ext.ext_en: He was transferred to FBI custody in a smooth co-operative effort between Egyptian and US authorities...

ext.ext_cn: 总统说这次访问将会促进两国之间的友好合作关系。
ext.ext_en: The President said the visit would develop friendly and co-operative relations between the two countries.

defs.def_en: A co-operative activity is done by people working together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 合作的;有协作精神的;愿意配合的

ext.ext_cn: 我尽了最大努力配合。
ext.ext_en: I made every effort to be co-operative.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is co-operative, you mean that they do what you ask them to without complaining or arguing.

ext.ext_cn: 他在工厂和建筑工地干过苦工。
ext.ext_en: He has worked as a labourer in factories and on building sites...

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫以前是个农场雇工。
ext.ext_en: Her husband had been a farm labourer.

defs.def_en: A labourer is a person who does a job which involves a lot of hard physical work.

ext.ext_cn: 大量消耗臭氧层的物质
ext.ext_en: ...substances that deplete the ozone layer...

ext.ext_cn: 他们长时间开火，耗尽了弹药。
ext.ext_en: They fired in long bursts, which depleted their ammunition...

defs.def_en: To deplete a stock or amount of something means to reduce it.
Your pay packet is the envelope containing your wages, which your employer gives you at the end of every week.
You can refer to someone's wages or salary as their pay packet .
Kerb-crawling is the activity of driving slowly along the side of a road in order to find and hire a prostitute.
Congestion charges refer to money motorists must pay in order to drive in some city centres. Congestion charges are intended to reduce traffic within those areas.

defs.def_cn: 喜爱的话题;热衷谈论的观点

ext.ext_cn: 诚信是库罗最喜欢谈论的一个话题。
ext.ext_en: Honesty is a favourite hobby-horse for Courau.

defs.def_en: You describe a subject or idea as your hobby-horse if you have strong feelings on it and like talking about it whenever you have the opportunity.

defs.def_cn: （指与周围岛屿相对的）大陆，本土

ext.ext_cn: 她准备去纳奈莫乘渡船回大陆。
ext.ext_en: She was going to Nanaimo to catch the ferry to the mainland.

ext.ext_cn: 远离英国本土的岛屿
ext.ext_en: ...the islands that lie off the coast of mainland Britain.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the largest part of a country or continent as the mainland when contrasting it with the islands around it.

defs.def_cn: （学生就某门课程所写的）论说文，短文

ext.ext_cn: 我们让贾森写一篇有关他的家乡和他自己的家的短文。
ext.ext_en: We asked Jason to write an essay about his hometown and about his place in it.

defs.def_en: An essay is a short piece of writing on one particular subject written by a student.

defs.def_cn: （关于某一方面的）论文，杂文，散文

ext.ext_cn: 托马斯·马尔萨斯有关人口的论文
ext.ext_en: ...Thomas Malthus's essay on population.

defs.def_en: An essay is a short piece of writing on one particular subject that is written by a writer for publication.

ext.ext_cn: 辛克莱想试着微笑一下，但根本没有笑出来。
ext.ext_en: Sinclair essayed a smile but it could hardly have been rated as a success.

ext.ext_cn: 众所周知，他第一次尝试经营公司时十分艰难。
ext.ext_en: His first essay in running a company was a notoriously tough undertaking.

defs.def_en: If you essay something, you try to do it.

defs.def_cn: （尤指历史上早期的）平民，庶民

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆·潘恩在18世纪90年代教育平民激进分子时论述到，如果不是为了实现王公、外交官和士兵借发起战争而使自己富有的潜在利益，人类本会生活在和谐之中。
ext.ext_en: In the 1790s Tom Paine taught plebeian radicals that mankind would live in harmony were it not for the vested interest which princes, diplomats and soldiers had in promoting wars to enrich themselves.

defs.def_en: A person, especially one from an earlier period of history, who is plebeian, comes from a low social class.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一口伦敦土腔、举止粗俗不堪的哲学教授
ext.ext_en: ...a philosophy professor with a cockney accent and an alarmingly plebeian manner...

ext.ext_cn: 他一整天都在海滩玩壁球，再没有比这更不入流的运动了。
ext.ext_en: He spent all day playing rackets on the beach, a plebeian sport if there ever was one.

defs.def_en: If someone describes something as plebeian, they think that it is unsophisticated and connected with or typical of people from a low social class.

defs.def_cn: （尤指吵闹或无秩序的）一群人

ext.ext_cn: 一群乱哄哄的记者坐在酒店大堂里焦急地等待着。
ext.ext_en: A gaggle of journalists sit in a hotel foyer waiting impatiently.

defs.def_en: You can use gaggle to refer to a group of people, especially if they are noisy or disorganized.

defs.def_cn: （汽油、油漆等）无铅的，不含铅的
defs.def_en: Something such as petrol or paint which is lead-free, is made without lead, or has no lead added to it.

defs.def_cn: （艺术家、音乐家等作品中包含的）活力，热情，激情

ext.ext_cn: 再没有哪个吉他演奏者能比他的演奏更加激情洋溢。
ext.ext_en: There's not another guitarist to rival the sheer physicality of his work.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the physicality of something such as an artist's or a musician's work, you mean that their energy and enthusiasm is obvious in the work they produce.

defs.def_cn: 降低…的重要性；贬低；淡化

ext.ext_cn: 西方外交官刻意贬低这些报告的重要性。
ext.ext_en: Western diplomats have played down the significance of the reports...

ext.ext_cn: 他对那些说他想要成为工党下院议员的传言轻描淡写。
ext.ext_en: He plays down rumours that he aims to become a Labour MP...

defs.def_en: If you play down something, you try to make people believe that it is not particularly important.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不敏感的;感觉迟钝的;麻木不仁的

ext.ext_cn: 我感觉丈夫对我的问题麻木不仁。
ext.ext_en: I feel my husband is very insensitive about my problem.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as insensitive, you are criticizing them for being unaware of or unsympathetic to other people's feelings.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 漠视的;不在乎的;毫不在意的

ext.ext_cn: 指责他漠视人权的女性组织与拉美裔组织
ext.ext_en: Women's and Latino organizations that say he is insensitive to civil rights.

defs.def_en: Someone who is insensitive to a situation or to a need does not think or care about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他对寒冷已经没有感觉了。
ext.ext_en: He had become insensitive to cold.

defs.def_en: Someone who is insensitive to a physical sensation is unable to feel it.

ext.ext_cn: 很多情况下，示威者都要具保不闹事。
ext.ext_en: On many occasions demonstrators were bound over to keep the peace...

ext.ext_cn: 他们把我们关进监狱，第二天一个糊涂法官令我们具结保证。
ext.ext_en: They put us in a cell, and the next day some bumbling judge bound us over...

defs.def_en: If someone is bound over by a court or a judge, they are given an order and must do as the order says for a particular period of time.

defs.def_cn: (罐子或盒子)用于募集捐款的
defs.def_en: A collecting tin or box is one that is used to collect money for charity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 老道的；经验丰富的；内行的；熟练的

ext.ext_cn: 一旦你熟悉了这种放松方式，在放松之后就会感到神清气爽。
ext.ext_en: Once you are practised at this sort of relaxation you will feel quite refreshed afterwards.

ext.ext_cn: 熟练而有经验的外科医生
ext.ext_en: ...a practised and experienced surgeon.

defs.def_en: Someone who is practised at doing something is good at it because they have had experience and have developed their skill at it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极度焦虑不安的;心力交瘁的
defs.def_en: If someone is stressed out, they are very tense and anxious because of difficulties in their lives.

ext.ext_cn: 对涉嫌虐童案的调查
ext.ext_en: ...investigation of alleged child abuse.

ext.ext_cn: 遭受性虐待及肉体摧残的受害者
ext.ext_en: ...victims of sexual and physical abuse.

defs.def_en: Abuse of someone is cruel and violent treatment of them.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车飞驰而去，留下我在那里大声咒骂。
ext.ext_en: I was left shouting abuse as the car sped off...

ext.ext_cn: 拉夫特不断地破口大骂和他联合主演的演员。
ext.ext_en: Raft repeatedly hurled verbal abuse at his co-star.

defs.def_en: Abuse is extremely rude and insulting things that people say when they are angry.

ext.ext_cn: 这里所发生的事是一种滥用职权的行为。
ext.ext_en: What went on here was an abuse of power.

ext.ext_cn: 嗜毒和酗酒
ext.ext_en: ...drug and alcohol abuse.

defs.def_en: Abuse of something is the use of it in a wrong way or for a bad purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮特从11岁起就遭受父亲虐待。
ext.ext_en: Janet had been abused by her father since she was eleven.

ext.ext_cn: 认为自己应付不来或可能会虐待孩子的父母
ext.ext_en: ...parents who feel they cannot cope or might abuse their children.

defs.def_en: If someone is abused, they are treated cruelly and violently.

ext.ext_cn: 他宣称自己遭到其他士兵的辱骂。
ext.ext_en: He alleged that he was verbally abused by other soldiers.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone is abused if extremely rude and insulting things are said to them.

ext.ext_cn: 他让我们看到有钱有势的人是如何滥用其地位的。
ext.ext_en: He showed how the rich and powerful can abuse their position.

defs.def_en: If you abuse something, you use it in a wrong way or for a bad purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 他再一次举起双筒望远镜，瞄准了11层的一个房间。
ext.ext_en: He raised the binoculars again and zeroed in on an eleventh-floor room.

defs.def_en: To zero in on a target means to aim at it or move towards it.

defs.def_cn: 全神贯注于（问题或主题）

ext.ext_cn: 其他许多重要日报并未将注意力集中在这个问题上。
ext.ext_en: Many of the other major daily newspapers have not really zeroed in on the problem...

ext.ext_cn: 批评者将矛头对准他打算将汽油税每加仑提高10美分的计划上。
ext.ext_en: Critics have zeroed in on his plan to raise gasoline taxes 10 cents a gallon.

defs.def_en: If you zero in on a problem or subject, you give it your full attention.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不优美的；难看的；不吸引人的

ext.ext_cn: 这是一间非常难看的大房子。
ext.ext_en: It was a massive, graceless house.

defs.def_en: Something that is graceless is unattractive and not at all interesting or charming.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 笨拙的单脚尖旋转
ext.ext_en: ...a graceless pirouette.

defs.def_en: A graceless movement is clumsy and uncontrolled.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不懂礼貌的；粗鲁无礼的

ext.ext_cn: 她无法忍受他的唐突和粗鲁。
ext.ext_en: She couldn't stand his blunt, graceless manner.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as graceless, you mean that their behaviour is impolite.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不得不依靠指南针和不错的运气找到这儿来。
ext.ext_en: We had to rely on a compass and a lot of luck to get here.

defs.def_en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.
Compasses are a hinged V-shaped instrument that you use for drawing circles.

ext.ext_cn: 在通常一本书的篇幅中要作如此全面的调查不太实际。
ext.ext_en: Within the compass of a normal sized book such a comprehensive survey was not practicable.

defs.def_en: If something is within the compass of something or someone, it is within their limits or abilities.

defs.def_cn: （尤指足够的或超出需要的）丰富，充足，大量

ext.ext_cn: 还有充裕的时间带吉尔出去吃比萨饼。
ext.ext_en: There was still plenty of time to take Jill out for pizza...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数企业面临着巨大的竞争压力。
ext.ext_en: Most businesses face plenty of competition...

defs.def_en: If there is plenty of something, there is a large amount of it. If there are plenty of things, there are many of them. Plenty is used especially to indicate that there is enough of something, or more than you need.

ext.ext_cn: 你们都很幸运，成长在和平富足的时代。
ext.ext_en: You are all fortunate to be growing up in a time of peace and plenty.

ext.ext_cn: 在富庶的美国已成为绝望象征的一个地区
ext.ext_en: ...an area that has become a symbol of despair in the midst of America's plenty.

defs.def_en: Plenty is a situation in which people have a lot to eat or a lot of money to live on.

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词或副词前）非常，十分，很

ext.ext_cn: 这水看起来很深。
ext.ext_en: The water looked plenty deep...

ext.ext_cn: 这个隔间足够大了。
ext.ext_en: The compartment is plenty big enough...

defs.def_en: You use plenty in front of adjectives or adverbs to emphasize the degree of the quality they are describing.

ext.ext_cn: 周六的塔拉萨充满着紧张兴奋的气氛，德国队在此赢得了金牌。
ext.ext_en: There were thrills in plenty on Saturday at Terrassa, where Germany won the gold medal...

ext.ext_cn: 督学定期进行检查，发现所有方面都令人满意，教材充足，还有5台计算机终端设备。
ext.ext_en: School inspectors visit regularly, finding everything satisfactory, books in plenty and five computer terminals.

defs.def_en: If there are things in plenty, those things exist or happen in large amounts or numbers.
An airplane is a vehicle with wings and one or more engines that enable it to fly through the air.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 困惑的;担忧的;神经质的

ext.ext_cn: 他深受情感问题的困扰。
ext.ext_en: He was really screwed up with his emotional problems...

ext.ext_cn: 有多少人年幼时父母因为自己没有离异，长大后神经变得敏感脆弱？
ext.ext_en: How many screwed-up adults are there now whose parents stayed together for the children's sake?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is screwed up, you mean that they are very confused or worried, or that they have psychological problems.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司外包了大部分零部件的生产。
ext.ext_en: The company is subcontracting production of most of the parts...

ext.ext_cn: 他们通过将任务转包给当地其他公司来减少成本。
ext.ext_en: They are cutting costs by subcontracting work out to other local firms.

defs.def_en: If one firm subcontracts part of its work to another firm, it pays the other firm to do part of the work that it has been employed to do.
A subcontract is a contract between a firm which is being employed to do a job and another firm which agrees to do part of that job.

ext.ext_cn: 我的手腕患有轻微关节炎。
ext.ext_en: I have a touch of arthritis in the wrist.

defs.def_en: See also:rheumatoid arthritis;Arthritis is a medical condition in which the joints in someone's body are swollen and painful.

ext.ext_cn: 西方模式的社会民主主义
ext.ext_en: ...western-style social democracy.

defs.def_en: Social democracy is a political system according to which social justice and equality can be achieved within the framework of a market economy.
A social democracy is a country where there is social democracy.

ext.ext_cn: 我睡在三楼。
ext.ext_en: I sleep on the third floor...

ext.ext_cn: 这是他的车第三次起火。
ext.ext_en: It was the third time one of his cars had gone up in flames...

defs.def_en: The third item in a series is the one that you count as number three.

ext.ext_cn: 有三分之一的支出投入了技术和服务。
ext.ext_en: A third of the cost went into technology and services...

ext.ext_cn: 只有三分之一的人得到父亲的经济援助。
ext.ext_en: Only one third get financial help from their fathers...

defs.def_en: A third is one of three equal parts of something.

ext.ext_cn: 首先，利率的下降可能没有希望的那样快;第二，实际贷款额可能会减少;第三，坏账很可能抵消大部分增长。
ext.ext_en: First, interest rates may take longer to fall than is hoped. Second, in real terms, lending may fall. Third, bad loans could wipe out much of any improvement.

defs.def_en: You say third when you want to make a third point or give a third reason for something.

defs.def_cn: 三等学位(英国大学颁发的最低级荣誉学位)
defs.def_en: A third is the lowest honours degree that can be obtained from a British university.

ext.ext_cn: 红艳欲滴的樱桃
ext.ext_en: ...blood-red cherries.

defs.def_en: Something that is blood-red is bright red in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 男装行业
ext.ext_en: ...the menswear industry.

defs.def_en: Menswear is clothing for men.

ext.ext_cn: 淫念
ext.ext_en: ...lustful thoughts.

defs.def_en: Lustful means feeling or expressing strong sexual desire.

ext.ext_cn: 有人看到他和新女友在一起亲热。
ext.ext_en: He was seen canoodling with his new girlfriend.

defs.def_en: If two people are canoodling, they are kissing and holding each other a lot.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 崎岖不平的;高低起伏的;多岩石的

ext.ext_cn: 崎岖不平的山地
ext.ext_en: ...rugged mountainous terrain.

defs.def_en: A rugged area of land is uneven and covered with rocks, with few trees or plants.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 尚克利粗犷的脸上掠过一丝完全不信任的表情。
ext.ext_en: A look of pure disbelief crossed Shankly's rugged face.

defs.def_en: If you describe a man as rugged, you mean that he has strong, masculine features.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坚强的;坚毅的;吃苦耐劳的

ext.ext_cn: 坚定的个人主义造就了美国的边疆社会。
ext.ext_en: Rugged individualism forged America's frontier society.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's character as rugged, you mean that they are strong and determined, and have the ability to cope with difficult situations.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这款相机既坚固耐用，又有超凡的光学性能和快门速度。
ext.ext_en: The camera combines rugged reliability with unequalled optical performance and speed.

defs.def_en: A rugged piece of equipment is strong and is designed to last a long time, even if it is treated roughly.
A voiced speech sound is one that is produced with vibration of the vocal cords.
A tumour is a mass of diseased or abnormal cells that has grown in a person's or animal's body.

ext.ext_cn: 长方形的桌子
ext.ext_en: ...an oblong table.

defs.def_en: An oblong is a shape which has two long sides and two short sides and in which all the angles are right angles.

defs.def_cn: 强调地;加强语气地;断然地

ext.ext_cn: “不能吃快餐，”她坚决地说。
ext.ext_en: 'No fast food', she said emphatically...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维斯先生断然否认了那些控诉。
ext.ext_en: Mr Davies has emphatically denied the charges.

defs.def_en: If you say something emphatically, you say it in a forceful way which shows that you feel very strongly about what you are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 让人出丑显然不是我的策略。
ext.ext_en: Making people feel foolish is emphatically not my strategy...

ext.ext_cn: 政治问题显然重新提上了日程。
ext.ext_en: Politics is most emphatically back on the agenda.

defs.def_en: You use emphatically to emphasize the statement you are making.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 圣诞节的;圣诞气氛浓的

ext.ext_cn: 挑选圣诞气氛浓的色彩，比如红的啦，绿的啦。
ext.ext_en: Choose Christmassy colours such as red and green.

defs.def_en: Something that is Christmassy is typical of or suitable for Christmas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我好几个晚上都睡不着，一直担心她。
ext.ext_en: I have sleepless nights worrying about her.

defs.def_en: A sleepless night is one during which you do not sleep.

ext.ext_cn: 宝宝睡不着觉似乎没有任何好处。
ext.ext_en: A sleepless baby can seem to bring little reward.

defs.def_en: Someone who is sleepless is unable to sleep.

defs.def_cn: 玻璃天花板，隐形顶障（指社会上限制女性升迁的态度和传统）

ext.ext_cn: 她冲破了职场上那道无形的障碍升至现在的职位，成为公司里第一个升至高级管理层的女性。
ext.ext_en: In her current role she broke through the glass ceiling as the first woman to reach senior management level in the company...

ext.ext_cn: 他们现在目睹自己的女儿们遭遇升迁的障碍，其结果令他们大为震惊。
ext.ext_en: They're now seeing their daughters hitting the glass ceiling and they are horrified at the effects.

defs.def_en: When people refer to a glass ceiling, they are talking about the attitudes and traditions in a society that prevent women from rising to the top jobs.

ext.ext_cn: 我上了一个15周的打字速成班。
ext.ext_en: I did a 15-week crash course in typing.

defs.def_en: A crash course in a particular subject is a short course in which you are taught basic facts or skills, for example before you start a new job.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 稀里糊涂的;迷迷糊糊的;昏醉的

ext.ext_cn: 白兰地让她脑子昏昏沉沉的，记不清楚晚上发生的事了。
ext.ext_en: Fuddled by brandy, her brain fumbled over the events of the night.

defs.def_en: Someone who is fuddled cannot think clearly, for example because they are very tired or slightly drunk.

defs.def_cn: (通常由四个乐章组成的)交响乐，交响曲
defs.def_en: A symphony is a piece of music written to be played by an orchestra. Symphonies are usually made up of four separate sections called movements.

ext.ext_cn: 农民正在掘除自古以来就一直种植的各种作物。
ext.ext_en: Farmers are grubbing up ancient varieties of crops...

ext.ext_cn: 果园被一个接一个地铲掉了。
ext.ext_en: One by one, orchards were grubbed up.

defs.def_en: If you grub up trees or plants, or grub them out, you dig them out of the ground, usually because they are no longer wanted.

ext.ext_cn: 他一定心存希望，但是考虑到6月份的情形，他可能期望得过多过快了。
ext.ext_en: He must be hoping, but considering the situation in June he may hoping for too much too soon...

ext.ext_cn: 想想人质曾遭受的折磨，获救后其身体状况已经是出奇地好了。
ext.ext_en: The former hostage is in remarkably good shape considering his ordeal.

defs.def_en: You use considering to indicate that you are thinking about a particular fact when making a judgment or giving an opinion.

ext.ext_cn: 考虑到你已经与这个男人划清了界限，你的反应有一点儿过头。
ext.ext_en: Considering that you are no longer involved with this man, your response is a little extreme.

defs.def_en: You use considering that to indicate that you are thinking about a particular fact when making a judgment or giving an opinion.

defs.def_cn: 通盘考虑;从各方面考虑

ext.ext_cn: 总的说来，我认为你的处境很安全。
ext.ext_en: I think you're pretty safe, considering.

defs.def_en: When you are giving an opinion or making a judgment, you can use considering to suggest that you have thought about all the circumstances, and often that something has succeeded in spite of these circumstances.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你这人反复无常,真叫人难以捉摸。
ext.ext_en: You are inconsistent and unpredictable.

ext.ext_cn: 领导犹豫不定、出尔反尔的行为
ext.ext_en: ...the leadership's hesitant and inconsistent behaviour.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as inconsistent, you are criticizing them for not behaving in the same way every time a similar situation occurs.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不能始终如一的;时好时坏的

ext.ext_cn: 赛季之初我们有非常好的开局,但最近却时好时坏。

defs.def_en: A perpetual feeling, state, or quality is one that never ends or changes.

defs.def_cn: 连续不断的；无尽无休的；没完没了的

ext.ext_cn: 我想我再也受不了她无休无止的抱怨了。 per|pet|ual|ly
ext.ext_en: I thought her perpetual complaints were going to prove too much for me.

ext.ext_cn: 不断再现的奇迹
ext.ext_en: ...a perpetually renewed miracle...

defs.def_en: A perpetual act, situation, or state is one that happens again and again and so seems never to end.

defs.def_cn: （对某人）应负责的，有责任的，须作交代的

ext.ext_cn: 市政会成员应对推选他们的人负责。
ext.ext_en: Councils should be answerable to the people who elect them...

ext.ext_cn: 所有大臣，包括首相都将直接对他负责。
ext.ext_en: All ministers, including the prime minister, will be answerable directly to him.

defs.def_en: If you are answerable to someone, you have to report to them and explain your actions.

defs.def_cn: 为（某事）负责任的；承担（某种行为的）后果的

ext.ext_cn: 他必须对这些可恶的罪行负责。
ext.ext_en: He must be made answerable for these terrible crimes.

defs.def_en: If you are answerable for your actions or for someone else's actions, you are considered to be responsible for them and if necessary must accept punishment for them.

ext.ext_cn: 他用拇指和食指捏着笔。
ext.ext_en: He took the pen between his thumb and forefinger.

defs.def_en: Your forefinger is the finger that is next to your thumb.

ext.ext_cn: 男性领导人担心自己的妻子放弃传统的女性角色
ext.ext_en: ...male leaders worrying about their women abandoning traditional feminine roles.

ext.ext_cn: 虚构的女性美典范
ext.ext_en: ...a manufactured ideal of feminine beauty.

defs.def_en: Feminine qualities and things relate to or are considered typical of women, in contrast to men.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 女子气的;女人味的;(尤指)柔美的

ext.ext_cn: 我总是被十分娇柔纤弱的女子吸引。
ext.ext_en: I've always been attracted to very feminine, delicate women...

ext.ext_cn: 卧室布置得很雅致，充满女人味。
ext.ext_en: The bedroom has a light, feminine look.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is feminine has qualities that are considered typical of women, especially being pretty or gentle.
In some languages, a feminine noun, pronoun, or adjective has a different form from a masculine or neuter one, or behaves in a different way.

defs.def_cn: 私人助理；私人秘书（缩略形式为PA）
defs.def_en: A personal assistant is a person who does office work and administrative work for someone. The abbreviation PA is also used.

ext.ext_cn: 巴里于1973年12月辞去了他的董事之职。
ext.ext_en: Barry resigned his directorship in December 1973.

defs.def_en: A directorship is the job or position of a company director.

ext.ext_cn: 我从树上采了一个柠檬。
ext.ext_en: I plucked a lemon from the tree...

ext.ext_cn: 他摘掉了干茴香的梗。
ext.ext_en: He plucked a stalk of dried fennel.

defs.def_en: If you pluck a fruit, flower, or leaf, you take it between your fingers and pull it in order to remove it from its stalk where it is growing.

ext.ext_cn: 他从嘴里抽出香烟，把它扔到街上。
ext.ext_en: He plucked the cigarette from his mouth and tossed it out into the street...

ext.ext_cn: 他从我怀里夺过宝宝。
ext.ext_en: He plucked the baby out of my arms...

defs.def_en: If you pluck something from somewhere, you take it between your fingers and pull it sharply from where it is.

ext.ext_cn: 内尔在弹奏竖琴。
ext.ext_en: Nell was plucking a harp.

defs.def_en: If you pluck a guitar or other musical instrument, you pull the strings with your fingers and let them go, so that they make a sound.

defs.def_cn: 拔除（鸡或其他死禽）的毛

ext.ext_cn: 她拔鸡毛时看上去很轻松。
ext.ext_en: She looked relaxed as she plucked a chicken.

defs.def_en: If you pluck a chicken or other dead bird, you pull its feathers out to prepare it for cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 你终于修了眉毛！
ext.ext_en: You've plucked your eyebrows at last!

defs.def_en: If a woman plucks her eyebrows, she pulls out some of the hairs using tweezers.

ext.ext_cn: 她从芭蕾舞团的伴舞队中被挖掘出来，担任朱丽叶这一角色。
ext.ext_en: She was plucked from the corps de ballet to take on Juliet...

ext.ext_cn: 这个经纪公司挖掘了默默无闻的娜奥米，并把她打造成了世界顶尖模特。
ext.ext_en: The agency plucked Naomi from obscurity and turned her into one of the world's top models.

defs.def_en: If someone unknown is given an important job or role and quickly becomes famous because of it, you can say that they have been plucked from obscurity or plucked from an unimportant position.

ext.ext_cn: 一名工人被警用直升机从着火电站的屋顶上救了出来。
ext.ext_en: A workman was plucked from the roof of a burning power station by a police helicopter...

ext.ext_cn: 10名渔夫从救生筏上被救到了安全处。
ext.ext_en: Ten fishermen were plucked to safety from life-rafts.

defs.def_en: If someone is rescued from a dangerous situation, you can say that they are plucked from it or are plucked to safety.

ext.ext_cn: 小公司的勇气和坚毅是出了名的，即使面对经济衰退也是如此。
ext.ext_en: Little companies are known for their pluck and perseverance, even in the face of a recession.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has pluck, you mean that they show courage and determination when they are in a difficult or frightening situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我用了大约2个小时才鼓起勇气打电话。
ext.ext_en: It took me about two hours to pluck up courage to call.

defs.def_en: If you pluck up the courage to do something that you feel nervous about, you make an effort to be brave enough to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这是否仅仅是她随口说出的数字？
ext.ext_en: Is this just a figure she plucked out of the air?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone plucks a figure, name, or date out of the air, you mean that they say it without thinking much about it before they speak.
Feet is the plural of foot .

defs.def_cn: 难解之谜;费解的事;费解的人

ext.ext_cn: 对于外界而言，伊朗仍是个谜。
ext.ext_en: Iran remains an enigma for the outside world.

ext.ext_cn: 解开现代灵性之谜的故事
ext.ext_en: ...a story which makes clear the modern enigma of spirituality.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as an enigma, you mean they are mysterious or difficult to understand.

ext.ext_cn: 营养不良的人更有可能被传染。
ext.ext_en: Infections are more likely in those suffering from malnutrition.

defs.def_en: If someone is suffering from malnutrition, they are physically weak and extremely thin because they have not eaten enough food.

ext.ext_cn: 她准备好踏上返家之程了。
ext.ext_en: She is ready for her homeward journey.

defs.def_en: If you are on a homeward journey, you are on a journey towards your home.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰驱车穿过小巷向家驶去。
ext.ext_en: John drove homeward through the lanes...

ext.ext_cn: 他们高高兴兴地往家赶。
ext.ext_en: They travelled happily homewards.

defs.def_en: If you are travelling homeward or homewards, you are travelling towards your home.

defs.def_cn: （某个事件或已提及的时间）之后

ext.ext_cn: 之后不久，警方逮捕了4名嫌犯。
ext.ext_en: Shortly afterwards, police arrested four suspects...

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯被送往医院，但随后不久就死了。
ext.ext_en: James was taken to hospital but died soon afterwards...

defs.def_en: If you do something or if something happens afterwards, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned.  →see usage note at:after

ext.ext_cn: 倡导经济开放政策的改革者
ext.ext_en: ...reformers who have advocated an open door economic policy.

ext.ext_cn: 吸引更多外资的开放政策
ext.ext_en: ...an open door to further foreign investment.

defs.def_en: If a country or organization has an open-door policy towards people or goods, it allows them to come there freely, without any restrictions.

ext.ext_cn: 这个8,500万英镑的项目将包括全面重塑该航空公司的形象。
ext.ext_en: The £85m programme will involve an extensive rebranding of the airline.

defs.def_en: Rebranding is the process of giving a product or an organization a new image, in order to make it more attractive or successful.

ext.ext_cn: 该地区那座主要的热电厂已被损毁。
ext.ext_en: The main thermo power station in the area has been damaged.

ext.ext_cn: 热核战争的危险
ext.ext_en: ...the dangers of thermo-nuclear war.

defs.def_en: Thermo means using or relating to heat.

defs.def_cn: 闯入者;干涉他人事务者

ext.ext_cn: 她不愿与任何外人分享父亲的爱,并把我们视为闯入者。
ext.ext_en: She had no wish to share her father with any outsider and regarded us as interlopers.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as an interloper, you mean that they have come into a situation or a place where they are not wanted or do not belong.
Bases is the plural of base.
Bases is the plural of basis.

ext.ext_cn: 今天下午我会去买东西。
ext.ext_en: I'll do the shopping this afternoon.

defs.def_en: See also:window shopping;When you do the shopping, you go to shops and buy things.

defs.def_cn: 从商店购买来的东西(尤指食品)

ext.ext_cn: 我们把买回来的东西放好。
ext.ext_en: We put the shopping away.

defs.def_en: Your shopping is the things that you have bought from shops, especially food.

ext.ext_cn: 窗帘挂得严严实实的窗户
ext.ext_en: ...heavily curtained windows.

defs.def_en: A curtained window, door, or other opening has a curtain hanging across it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他手下有管理人员，但重要的决策仍由他自己来做。
ext.ext_en: He had administrators under him but took the crucial decisions himself...

ext.ext_cn: 几年来最重要的竞选活动
ext.ext_en: ...the most crucial election campaign for years...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

ext.ext_cn: 他穿着漆皮鞋。
ext.ext_en: He wore patent leather shoes.

defs.def_en: Patent leather is leather which has a shiny surface. It is used to make shoes, bags, and belts.

ext.ext_cn: 有一个房间里陈列着很多纪念棒球史上伟大时刻的画作。
ext.ext_en: One room contained a gallery of paintings commemorating great moments in baseball history...

ext.ext_cn: 世界各地将举办以莫扎特的作品为主题的音乐会，以纪念他逝世200周年。
ext.ext_en: The 200th anniversary of Mozart's death is being commemorated around the world with concerts featuring his work.

defs.def_en: To commemorate an important event or person means to remember them by means of a special action, ceremony, or specially created object.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我之所以得到提拔是由于立下了所谓的英勇卓越的功勋。
ext.ext_en: I had been promoted for what was called gallant and meritorious service.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as meritorious, you approve of it for its good or worthwhile qualities.

defs.def_cn: (尤指固定地毯的)大头钉，平头钉
defs.def_en: See also:thumbtack;A tack is a short nail with a broad, flat head, especially one that is used for fastening carpets to the floor.  to get down to brass tacks→see: brass;

ext.ext_cn: 他用图钉将这张便条钉在她的门上。
ext.ext_en: He had tacked this note to her door...

ext.ext_cn: 她最近从剧院拿回一幅油画，用图钉把它钉在了墙上。
ext.ext_en: She had recently taken a canvas from the theater and tacked it up on the wall.

defs.def_en: If you tack something to a surface, you pin it there with tacks or drawing pins.

ext.ext_cn: 我走投无路，于是改变了策略。
ext.ext_en: In desperation I changed tack...

ext.ext_cn: 这份报告和此前的 20 份报告采取的思路不同。
ext.ext_en: This report takes a different tack from the 20 that have come before.

defs.def_en: If you change tack or try a different tack, you try a different method for dealing with a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我们沿着近海岸曲折航行。
ext.ext_en: We were tacking fairly close inshore...

ext.ext_cn: 我们上次旅行时曾经沿着海岸，逆着风浪向东曲折航行。
ext.ext_en: Our last trip involved a coastal passage, tacking east against wind and current...

defs.def_en: If a sailing boat is tacking or if the people in it tack it, it is sailing towards a particular point in a series of sideways movements rather than in a straight line.

ext.ext_cn: 用 1.5 厘米的针脚将它们暂时缝上。
ext.ext_en: Tack them together with a 1.5 cm seam...

ext.ext_cn: 用粗线沿着垫子边绷一圈。
ext.ext_en: Tack the cord around the cushion.

defs.def_en: If you tack pieces of material together, you sew them together with big, loose stitches in order to hold them firmly or check that they fit, before sewing them properly.

ext.ext_cn: 他有一个污点。
ext.ext_en: There was one black mark against him.

defs.def_en: A black mark against someone is something bad that they have done or a bad quality that they have which affects the way people think about them.

ext.ext_cn: 托比的脸皱了起来。
ext.ext_en: Toby's face puckered...

ext.ext_cn: 她双唇努起犹如一朵玫瑰花蕾，在他的鼻子上吻了一下。
ext.ext_en: She puckered her lips into a rosebud and kissed him on the nose.

defs.def_en: When a part of your face puckers or when you pucker it, it becomes tight or stretched, often because you are trying not to cry or are going to kiss someone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可以战胜的；能被打败的

ext.ext_cn: 没有哪个队是不可战胜的，但要打败他们会非常非常困难。
ext.ext_en: All teams are beatable, but it's going to be very, very difficult.

defs.def_en: Someone who is beatable can be beaten.

defs.def_cn: 未来的女电影明星;女影坛新秀
defs.def_en: A starlet is a young actress who is expected to become a film star in the future.

defs.def_cn: （表示在与已提及或已知的人或事物同一类中）别的，其他的，另外的，额外的

ext.ext_cn: 他们同别的年轻夫妇没什么两样。
ext.ext_en: They were just like any other young couple...

ext.ext_cn: 这份公报并未透露其他细节。
ext.ext_en: The communique gave no other details.

defs.def_en: You use other to refer to an additional thing or person of the same type as one that has been mentioned or is known about.

defs.def_cn: （表示与已提及的人或事物不同）别的，其他的

ext.ext_cn: 当局坚持此次讨论不得涉及其他任何问题。
ext.ext_en: The authorities insist that the discussions must not be linked to any other issue...

ext.ext_cn: 话费在优惠时段为每分钟36便士，其他时段一律为每分钟48便士。
ext.ext_en: Calls cost 36p per minute cheap rate and 48p per minute at all other times...

defs.def_en: You use other to indicate that a thing or person is not the one already mentioned, but a different one.

ext.ext_cn: 船长在房间的另一头。
ext.ext_en: The Captain was at the other end of the room...

ext.ext_cn: 你故意朝另一个方向走。
ext.ext_en: You deliberately went in the other direction...

defs.def_en: You use the other to refer to the second of two things or people when the identity of the first is already known or understood, or has already been mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 女王道码头将会融商店、餐馆以及其他生活便利设施为一体。
ext.ext_en: Queensway Quay will incorporate shops, restaurants and other amenities...

ext.ext_cn: 将它们装入果酱罐、瓷碗或其他类似容器中。
ext.ext_en: Place them in a jam jar, porcelain bowl, or other similar container.

defs.def_en: You use other at the end of a list or a group of examples, to refer generally to people or things like the ones just mentioned.

defs.def_cn: （一组人或事物中）其余的，剩下的

ext.ext_cn: 当其余学生被带去参观展览时，他被留了下来。
ext.ext_en: When the other pupils were taken to an exhibition, he was left behind.

ext.ext_cn: 奥布里和其他人正在来这里的路上。
ext.ext_en: Aubrey's on his way here, with the others.

defs.def_en: You use the other to refer to the rest of the people or things in a group, when you are talking about one particular person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 人们的苦难让我无比震惊。
ext.ext_en: The suffering of other people appals me...

ext.ext_cn: 她喜欢与人交往。
ext.ext_en: She likes to be with other people.

defs.def_en: Other people are people in general, as opposed to yourself or a person you have already mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 我前几天给她打电话，她说想过来玩。
ext.ext_en: I rang her the other day and she said she'd like to come round...

ext.ext_cn: 前不久的某个晚上我们搞了一次聚会。
ext.ext_en: The other evening we had a party.

defs.def_en: You use other in informal expressions of time such as the other day ,the other evening, or the other week to refer to a day, evening, or week in the recent past.

defs.def_cn: 除了别的以外；其中；包括

ext.ext_cn: 他1980年移居英格兰，期间从事过包括记者在内的很多工作。
ext.ext_en: He moved to England in 1980 where, among other things, he worked as a journalist...

ext.ext_cn: 他游历过很多地方，其中包括都柏林。
ext.ext_en: His travels took him to Dublin, among other places...

defs.def_en: You use expressions like among other things or among others to indicate that there are several more facts, things, or people like the one or ones mentioned, but that you do not intend to mention them all.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的伙食足够丰富了，有蔬菜、水果，而且至少每隔一天吃一次肉。
ext.ext_en: Their food is adequate. It includes meat at least every other day, vegetables and fruit...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的孩子都长大了，她便每隔一周就到伦敦帕迪那里。
ext.ext_en: Now that their children have grown up she joins Paddy in London every other week.

defs.def_en: If something happens, for example, every other day or every other month, there is a day or month when it does not happen between each day or month when it happens.

defs.def_cn: （用于强调，表示一组人或事物中）其余的，剩下的

ext.ext_cn: 这也适用于其他任何国家。
ext.ext_en: The same will apply in every other country.

defs.def_en: You use every other to emphasize that you are referring to all the rest of the people or things in a group.

ext.ext_cn: 他把所有的员工召集到一起，宣布经理不是别人，正是他的儿子。
ext.ext_en: He called together all his employees and announced that the manager was none other than his son.

defs.def_en: You use none other than and no other than to emphasize the name of a person or thing when something about that person or thing is surprising in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 只有判决即时监禁才算合理。
ext.ext_en: Nothing other than an immediate custodial sentence could be justified...

ext.ext_cn: 叛乱分子只有彻底推翻了现政权才肯罢休。
ext.ext_en: The rebels would not be happy with anything other than the complete removal of the current regime...

defs.def_en: You use nothing other than and no other than when you are going to mention a course of action, decision, or description and emphasize that it is the only one possible in the situation.

defs.def_cn: （表示无法或不想确切说明）某一，某些

ext.ext_cn: 我准备找个什么借口把他从屋里支出去。
ext.ext_en: I was going to have him called away from the house on some pretext or other...

ext.ext_cn: 基金会正举办某个纪念宴会。
ext.ext_en: The Foundation is holding a dinner in honour of something or other...

defs.def_en: You use or other in expressions like somehow or other and someone or other to indicate that you cannot or do not want to be more precise about the information that you are giving.

ext.ext_cn: 除了自己的之外，她没有提及其他女权主义著作。
ext.ext_en: She makes no reference to any feminist work other than her own...

ext.ext_cn: 除了经验非常丰富的自行车手外，建议其他人不要走去伍尔弗汉普顿的那条路。
ext.ext_en: The journey by road to Wolverhampton is not recommended to anyone other than the most experienced cyclist.

defs.def_en: You use other than after a negative statement to say that the person, item, or thing that follows is the only exception to the statement.

ext.ext_cn: 他感兴趣的是我们对死亡的看法如何影响我们的生活。
ext.ext_en: He is interested in how our perceptions of death affect the way we live.

ext.ext_cn: 他们对外国人的印象
ext.ext_en: ...their perception of foreigners.

defs.def_en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

ext.ext_cn: 并不需要多少洞察力也能意识到面试已经结束了。
ext.ext_en: It did not require a great deal of perception to realise the interview was over.

defs.def_en: Someone who has perception realizes or notices things that are not obvious.
Perception is the recognition of things using your senses, especially the sense of sight.
A tour rep is the same as a holiday rep .

ext.ext_cn: 他们安静地等着，嘴里咂着糖果。
ext.ext_en: They waited in silence and sucked their sweets...

ext.ext_cn: 他抽了一口烟。
ext.ext_en: He sucked on his cigarette...

defs.def_en: If you suck something, you hold it in your mouth and pull at it with the muscles in your cheeks and tongue, for example in order to get liquid out of it.

defs.def_cn: 抽吸，抽取，抽，吸(空气、液体等)

ext.ext_cn: 污染控制小组就在现场，现在随时准备开始吸油。
ext.ext_en: The pollution-control team is at the scene and is due to start sucking up oil any time now...

ext.ext_cn: 由强力风机把空气吸出去。
ext.ext_en: The air is sucked out by a high-powered fan...

defs.def_en: If something sucks a liquid, gas, or object in a particular direction, it draws it there with a powerful force.

ext.ext_cn: 他警告说，如果总统想要实施强权统治的话，那么这个国家将陷入权力真空状态。
ext.ext_en: He warned that if the President tried to enforce control, the country would be sucked into a power vacuum.

ext.ext_cn: 他们卷入暴力恶性循环的程度
ext.ext_en: ...the extent to which they have been sucked into the cycle of violence.

defs.def_en: If you are sucked into a bad situation, you are unable to prevent yourself from becoming involved in it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个系统太差劲了。

ext.ext_en: It seems such a pity that a distinguished and honored name should be commercialized in such a manner...

ext.ext_en: The area is needed for a land reclamation project.

ext.ext_en: The report is expected by the end of the year...

defs.def_en: The end of something such as a period of time, an event, a book, or a film is the last part of it or the final point in it.

ext.ext_en: The meeting quickly ended and Steve and I left the room...

ext.ext_en: Talks have resumed to try to end the fighting...

defs.def_en: When a situation, process, or activity ends, or when something or someone ends it, it reaches its final point and stops.

ext.ext_cn: 今天法国政府呼吁结束暴力行为。
ext.ext_en: The French government today called for an end to the violence...

ext.ext_cn: 我担心她会离场或者终止采访。
ext.ext_en: I was worried she would walk out or bring the interview to an end...

defs.def_en: An end to something or the end of it is the act or result of stopping it so that it does not continue any longer.

ext.ext_en: The markets ended the week on a quiet note...

ext.ext_en: British Gas shares ended the day 1p up at 287p...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something ends a period of time in a particular way, you are indicating what the final situation was like. You can also say that a period of time ends in a particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 程式交易月度报告通常在每月结束3周后出来。
ext.ext_en: Its monthly reports on program trading usually come out about three weeks after each month ends...

defs.def_en: If a period of time ends, it reaches its final point.

defs.def_en: If something such as a book, speech, or performance ends with a particular thing or the writer or performer ends it with that thing, its final part consists of the thing mentioned.

defs.def_en: If a situation or event ends in a particular way, it has that particular result.

defs.def_en: The two ends of something long and narrow are the two points or parts of it that are furthest away from each other.

ext.ext_en: He tapped the ends of his fingers together...

defs.def_en: The end of a long, narrow object such as a finger or a pencil is the tip or smallest edge of it, usually the part that is furthest away from you.

defs.def_en: If an object ends with or in a particular thing, it has that thing on its tip or point, or as its last part.

ext.ext_en: Now the government is trying another policy designed to achieve the same end.

defs.def_en: If someone ends it all, they kill themselves.

ext.ext_en: ...the sale to end all sales at Harrods.

ext.ext_en: Benny thought the president was sincere and sensitive, but, in the end, that's not what counts.

defs.def_en: You say in the end when you are saying what is the final result of a series of events, or what is your final conclusion after considering all the relevant facts.

ext.ext_en: While he had originally traveled in order to study, traveling had become an end in itself.

ext.ext_en: He had trouble keeping up his end of a technical discussion.

defs.def_en: If you have to keep your end up, or to keep up your end of something, you have to do something as well as other people, or as well as you are expected to do it.

ext.ext_en: With Betty's salary they barely made ends meet.

ext.ext_en: I spend days on end in this studio.

defs.def_en: When something happens for hours, days, weeks, or years on end, it happens continuously and without stopping for the amount of time that is mentioned.
Something that is on end is upright, instead of in its normal or natural position, for example lying down, flat, or on its longest side.

ext.ext_cn: 只有政治解决方案才能终结暴力。
ext.ext_en: Only a political solution could put an end to the violence.

defs.def_en: To put an end to something means to cause it to stop.

defs.def_en: If a process or person has reached the end of the road, they are unable to progress any further.

ext.ext_en: We can assume that the moon will continue to go around the earth until the end of time...

ext.ext_en: I'll love her till the end of time.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen or be true until the end of time or to the end of time, you are emphasizing that it will always happen or always be true.

ext.ext_en: Obviously I'd be disappointed if we don't make it, but it wouldn't be the end of the world.

defs.def_en: If you say that something bad is not the end of the world, you are trying to stop yourself or someone else being so upset by it, by suggesting that it is not the worst thing that could happen.

defs.def_cn: 极好的;非常棒的;了不起的

defs.def_en: Terrific means very great in amount, degree, or intensity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪60年代的“姑息纵容”
ext.ext_en: ...the permissive tolerance of the 1960s...

ext.ext_cn: 单亲家庭的父母更容易放任自己的孩子。
ext.ext_en: Single parents are more likely to be permissive.

defs.def_en: A permissive person, society, or way of behaving allows or tolerates things which other people disapprove of.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 合格的；过得去的；尚可的

ext.ext_cn: 斯坦鼓起瘦瘦的脸颊，像模像样地模仿着他的爸爸。
ext.ext_en: Stan puffed out his thin cheeks in a passable imitation of his dad...

ext.ext_cn: 坎贝尔女士法语说得还算可以。
ext.ext_en: Ms Campbell speaks passable French.

defs.def_en: If something is a passable effort or of passable quality, it is satisfactory or quite good.

ext.ext_cn: 机场公路今天一周来第一次可以通行。
ext.ext_en: The airport road is passable today for the first time in a week.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎无法通行的泥泞山路
ext.ext_en: ...muddy mountain roads that are barely passable.

defs.def_en: If a road is passable, it is not completely blocked, and people can still use it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不够标准的;不合格的;差劲的;劣质的

ext.ext_cn: 居民们普遍都很贫穷，受教育程度低，居住条件较差。
ext.ext_en: Residents in general are poor and undereducated, and live in sub-standard housing.

defs.def_en: A sub-standard service or product is unacceptable because it is below a required standard.

defs.def_cn: （帮助改善生活的）生命教练，人生导师
defs.def_en: A life coach is someone whose job involves helping people to improve their lives by doing challenging or worthwhile things.
A kiddie is a very young child.

defs.def_cn: （艺术作品的）陈列室，展览馆；画廊

ext.ext_cn: 美术馆
ext.ext_en: ...an art gallery.

ext.ext_cn: 国家美术馆
ext.ext_en: ...the National Gallery.

defs.def_en: A gallery is a place that has permanent exhibitions of works of art in it.

defs.def_cn: 私人画店；私人画廊（或画室）

ext.ext_cn: 那幅画在楼上的画廊里。
ext.ext_en: The painting is in the gallery upstairs.

defs.def_en: A gallery is a privately owned building or room where people can look at and buy works of art.

defs.def_cn: （大厅的）楼座，边座，楼上旁听席

ext.ext_cn: 楼座已经挤满了人。
ext.ext_en: A crowd already filled the gallery.

defs.def_en: A gallery is an area high above the ground at the back or at the sides of a large room or hall.

defs.def_cn: （剧场或音乐厅中通常票价最低的）顶层楼座

ext.ext_cn: 他们不得已买了顶层楼座的廉价票。
ext.ext_en: They had been forced to find cheap tickets in the gallery.

ext.ext_cn: 但是，我必须告诉你们，在我看来你们俩都是在哗众取宠。
ext.ext_en: ...but I must tell you that in my opinion you're both now playing to the gallery.

defs.def_en: The gallery in a theatre or concert hall is an area high above the ground that usually contains the cheapest seats.

ext.ext_cn: 他在他的酒店举行了一场历时3个钟头的家庭卡拉OK演唱会，其间高歌了辛纳屈和甲壳虫乐队的一些热门歌曲。
ext.ext_en: He held a three-hour family Karaoke session in his hotel, belting out Sinatra and Beatles hits.

defs.def_en: If you belt out a song, you sing or play it very loudly.

ext.ext_cn: 上周席卷全国的劳工暴动已经平息了。
ext.ext_en: The labour unrest which swept the country last week has quietened down...

ext.ext_cn: 我设法让她平静了下来。
ext.ext_en: Somehow I managed to quieten her down...

defs.def_en: If someone or something quietens down or if you quieten them down, they become less noisy or less active.

defs.def_cn: (治疗师或其他专家提供的)咨询，建议

ext.ext_cn: 她需要借助医学治疗和心理咨询来克服惨剧带来的影响。
ext.ext_en: She will need medical help and counselling to overcome the tragedy...

ext.ext_cn: 她带丈夫来进行婚姻咨询。
ext.ext_en: She brought her husband in for marriage counseling.

defs.def_en: Counselling is advice which a therapist or other expert gives to someone about a particular problem.

defs.def_cn: (写在信封上的地址之前)由…转交

ext.ext_cn: 布里斯托尔8区伯顿路62号，舍曼有限公司转交 A. D. 布赖特先生收
ext.ext_en: ...Mr A D Bright, c/o Sherman Ltd, 62 Burton Road, Bristol 8.

defs.def_en: You write c/o before an address on an envelope when you are sending it to someone who is staying or working at that address, often for only a short time. c/o is an abbreviation for (缩略 =) 'care of'.

defs.def_cn: 用计算机控制(系统、进程或作业);使计算机化

ext.ext_cn: 我正试着编一个电子制表软件，以把目前所有靠人力完成的工作交由计算机完成。
ext.ext_en: I'm trying to make a spreadsheet up to computerize everything that's done by hand at the moment...

ext.ext_cn: 很多医院说他们根本没资金实现计算机化。
ext.ext_en: Many hospitals say they simply can't afford to computerize.

defs.def_en: To computerize a system, process, or type of work means to arrange for a lot of the work to be done by computer.

defs.def_cn: （用来装饰衣服、窗帘等的）布带，穗带

ext.ext_cn: 饰有很多金色穗带的暗紫色制服
ext.ext_en: ...a plum-coloured uniform with lots of gold braid.

defs.def_en: Braid is a narrow piece of decorated cloth or twisted threads, which is used to decorate clothes or curtains.

defs.def_cn: 把（头发）编成辫子；把（丝线）编成辫状

ext.ext_cn: 她马上就要为路易莎编好辫子了。
ext.ext_en: She had almost finished braiding Louisa's hair...

ext.ext_cn: 他想象她梳着又黑又长的辫子。
ext.ext_en: He pictured her with long black braided hair.

defs.def_en: If you braid hair or a group of threads, you twist three or more lengths of the hair or threads over and under each other to make one thick length.
A braid is a length of hair which has been divided into three or more lengths and then braided.

ext.ext_cn: 他气得踢了那台坏机器一脚。
ext.ext_en: He kicked the broken machine in vexation.

defs.def_en: Vexation is a feeling of being annoyed, puzzled, and frustrated.

ext.ext_cn: 他们毫无必要地拔掉了病人的牙。
ext.ext_en: They have pulled out patients' teeth unnecessarily...

ext.ext_cn: 他套上一件运动衫。
ext.ext_en: He pulled on a jersey...

defs.def_en: When you pull something, you hold it firmly and use force in order to move it towards you  or away from its previous position.

ext.ext_cn: 杰克从衬衫口袋里抽出这张纸条。
ext.ext_en: Jack pulled the slip of paper from his shirt pocket...

ext.ext_cn: 韦德快步走到冰箱边又拿出一罐啤酒。
ext.ext_en: Wade walked quickly to the refrigerator and pulled out another beer.

defs.def_en: When you pull an object from a bag, pocket, or cupboard, you put your hand in and bring the object out.

ext.ext_cn: 这是20世纪早期的萨塞克斯乡村，那时还是用马拉犁。
ext.ext_en: This is early-20th-century rural Sussex, when horses still pulled the plough...

ext.ext_cn: 他拉黄包车，这可能是人类最古老的载客服务形式了。
ext.ext_en: He pulls a rickshaw, probably the oldest form of human taxi service.

defs.def_en: When a vehicle, animal, or person pulls a cart or piece of machinery, they are attached to it or hold it, so that it moves along behind them when they move forward.

ext.ext_cn: 休斯慢慢站了起来。
ext.ext_en: Hughes pulled himself slowly to his feet...

ext.ext_cn: 他把胳膊从袖子里抽出来。
ext.ext_en: He pulled his arms out of the sleeves...

defs.def_en: If you pull yourself or pull a part of your body in a particular direction, you move your body or a part of your body with effort or force.

ext.ext_cn: 他在一辆皮卡货车后面停了下来。
ext.ext_en: He pulled to a stop behind a pickup truck...

ext.ext_cn: 火车在站台边停下。
ext.ext_en: The train pulled to a halt at the platform.

defs.def_en: When a driver or vehicle pulls to a stop or a halt, the vehicle stops.

ext.ext_cn: 他把领先优势逐渐扩大到了15秒。
ext.ext_en: He pulled away, extending his lead to 15 seconds...

ext.ext_cn: 1988年他获胜的6个州也是他目前有待领先于对手的几个州。
ext.ext_en: The six states he won in 1988 are the same states in which he has yet to pull ahead of his opponent.

defs.def_en: In a race or contest, if you pull ahead of or pull away from an opponent, you gradually increase the amount by which you are ahead of them.

ext.ext_cn: 如果想好好地改进这辆车，我将不得不把它拆开重装。
ext.ext_en: If I wanted to improve the car significantly I would have to pull it apart and start again.

defs.def_en: If you pull something apart, you break or divide it into small pieces, often in order to put them back together again in a different way.

ext.ext_cn: 他们打了起来。其中一人拔出枪指着另一个人。
ext.ext_en: They had a fight. One of them pulled a gun on the other...

ext.ext_cn: 我拔出刀威胁她。
ext.ext_en: I pulled a knife and threatened her.

defs.def_en: If someone pulls a gun or a knife on someone else, they take out a gun or knife and threaten the other person with it.

defs.def_cn: 吸引，拉拢（人群、观众或选民）

ext.ext_cn: 组织者不得不雇些演员来聚拢人气。
ext.ext_en: The organisers have to employ performers to pull a crowd.

ext.ext_cn: 他们提供的新闻播报要好得多，因此吸引了更多的观众。
ext.ext_en: They provided a far better news service and pulled in many more viewers...

defs.def_en: To pull crowds, viewers, or voters means to attract them.

ext.ext_cn: 乔感到帮不上贝蒂什么忙，他的心思在别的地方。
ext.ext_en: Joe felt there was little he could do to help Betty, and his heart was pulling him elsewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 不管对过去有多么留恋，你也要下定决心往前看。
ext.ext_en: No matter how much you feel the pull of the past, make a determined effort to look to the future.

defs.def_en: If something pulls you or pulls your thoughts or feelings in a particular direction, it strongly attracts you or influences you in a particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 重力的牵引
ext.ext_en: ...the pull of gravity.

defs.def_en: A pull is a strong physical force which causes things to move in a particular direction.

ext.ext_cn: 因为我们非常想赢回奖杯，所以一直在互相打气。
ext.ext_en: We're all pulling for each other because we're desperate to win the Cup back...

ext.ext_cn: 你知道我一直在为你加油。
ext.ext_en: You know I've been pulling for you.

defs.def_en: If you are pulling for someone, you support and encourage them, especially in a competition.

ext.ext_cn: 戴夫背部拉伤，几乎没法踢球。
ext.ext_en: Dave pulled a back muscle and could barely kick the ball...

ext.ext_cn: 他小腿肚肌肉拉伤。
ext.ext_en: He suffered a pulled calf muscle.

defs.def_en: If you pull a muscle, you injure it by straining it.

ext.ext_cn: 杰夫往后一靠，深深地吸了一口烟。
ext.ext_en: Jeff leaned back and pulled on his cigarette.

ext.ext_cn: 他深吸了一口烟，然后轻轻吐了出来。
ext.ext_en: He took a deep pull of his cigarette and exhaled the smoke.

defs.def_en: If someone pulls on a cigarette, they take a deep breath with the cigarette in their mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 大家都看见了你对我耍的花招。
ext.ext_en: Everyone saw the stunt you pulled on me.

defs.def_en: To pull a stunt or a trick on someone means to do something dramatic or silly in order to get their attention or trick them.
If someone pulls someone else, they succeed in attracting them sexually and in spending the rest of the evening or night with them.

ext.ext_cn: 什么！你这么一个大块头居然被他的妻子打了！别逗了。
ext.ext_en: What! A big bloke like you, beaten by his wife! Pull the other one; it's got bells on.

defs.def_en: You can say to someone 'Pull the other one' or 'Pull the other one, it's got bells on' to tell them that you do not believe what they have told you and you think they must be joking.

ext.ext_cn: 他气得满脸通红。
ext.ext_en: He was red-cheeked with rage...

ext.ext_cn: 我勃然大怒。
ext.ext_en: I flew into a rage...

defs.def_en: Rage is strong anger that is difficult to control.

ext.ext_cn: 火灾肆虐超过4个小时，期间列车停止了运行。
ext.ext_en: Train services were halted as the fire raged for more than four hours...

ext.ext_cn: 关于圣城未来的激烈争论
ext.ext_en: ...the fierce arguments raging over the future of the Holy City...

defs.def_en: You say that something powerful or unpleasant rages when it continues with great force or violence.

ext.ext_cn: 门罗正在打电话，怒不可遏地说着她被这几个兄弟虐待的事。
ext.ext_en: Monroe was on the phone, raging about her mistreatment by the brothers...

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰妮正在屋里大发脾气。
ext.ext_en: Inside, Frannie was raging...

defs.def_en: If you rage about something, you speak or think very angrily about it.

defs.def_cn: （尤指引发暴力或攻击行为的）暴怒,盛怒

ext.ext_cn: 乘务人员一周内报告的飞机上闹事行为多达9起。
ext.ext_en: Cabin crews are reporting up to nine cases of air rage a week.

defs.def_en: See also:road rage;You can refer to the strong anger that someone feels in a particular situation as a particular rage, especially when this results in violent or aggressive behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 目前，20世纪50年代的装扮正流行。
ext.ext_en: The 1950s look is all the rage at the moment.

defs.def_en: When something is popular and fashionable, you can say that it is the rage or all the rage .

ext.ext_cn: 那些宇航员正在进行一系列实验，以更多地了解身体如何适应失重状态。
ext.ext_en: The astronauts are conducting a series of experiments to learn more about how the body adapts to weightlessness...

ext.ext_cn: 有关动物实验的最新法规提案
ext.ext_en: ...a proposed new law on animal experiments...

defs.def_en: An experiment is a scientific test which is done in order to discover what happens to something in particular conditions.

ext.ext_cn: 1857年，孟德尔开始在修道院的菜园里用豌豆做实验。
ext.ext_en: In 1857 Mendel started experimenting with peas in his monastery garden...

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们已经在老鼠细小的颈动脉上做了实验。
ext.ext_en: The scientists have experimented on the tiny neck arteries of rats...

defs.def_en: If you experiment with something or experiment on it, you do a scientific test on it in order to discover what happens to it in particular conditions.

ext.ext_cn: 我们试着给特德买了一块手表。
ext.ext_en: As an experiment, we bought Ted a watch.

ext.ext_cn: 该国5年来对民主的尝试
ext.ext_en: ...the country's five year experiment in democracy...

defs.def_en: An experiment is the trying out of a new idea or method in order to see what it is like and what effects it has.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你喜欢烹饪而且有时间尝试的话
ext.ext_en: ...if you like cooking and have the time to experiment...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为应该鼓励学生们将大胆的观念付诸试验。
ext.ext_en: He believes that students should be encouraged to experiment with bold ideas.

defs.def_en: To experiment means to try out a new idea or method to see what it is like and what effects it has.

defs.def_cn: 阿喀琉斯的脚踵；致命弱点

ext.ext_cn: 霍顿的软肋在于他不懂得放权。
ext.ext_en: Horton's Achilles heel was that he could not delegate.

defs.def_en: Someone's Achilles heel is the weakest point in their character or nature, where it is easiest for other people to attack or criticize them.
A practical joke is a trick that is intended to embarrass someone or make them look ridiculous.

defs.def_cn: 至高无上;最大权力;霸权

ext.ext_cn: 守旧的保守派已经重新掌控了政治大权。
ext.ext_en: The conservative old guard had re-established its political supremacy...

ext.ext_cn: 总统行使了高于总理的最高决策权。
ext.ext_en: The president has been able to assert his ultimate supremacy over the prime minister.

defs.def_en: If one group of people has supremacy over another group, they have more political or military power than the other group.

ext.ext_cn: 在美国网球公开赛决赛中，格拉芙始终保持优势。
ext.ext_en: In the United States Open final, Graf retained overall supremacy.

defs.def_en: If someone or something has supremacy over another person or thing, they are better.

defs.def_cn: (表演者或运动员的）首次登台，初次露面；（歌手的）首次录音

ext.ext_cn: 邓迪联队的戴夫·鲍曼首次亮相国际比赛。
ext.ext_en: Dundee United's Dave Bowman makes his international debut.

ext.ext_cn: 她的首张专辑《甜蜜时光》
ext.ext_en: ...her debut album 'Sugar Time'.

defs.def_en: The debut of a performer or sports player is their first public performance, appearance, or recording.

ext.ext_cn: 在该国不同的地区发生了群体暴力事件。
ext.ext_en: Communal violence broke out in different parts of the country.

ext.ext_cn: 不同群体之间的关系
ext.ext_en: ...inter-communal relations.

defs.def_en: Communal means relating to particular groups in a country or society.

ext.ext_cn: 囚犯们在公共餐厅吃饭。
ext.ext_en: The inmates ate in a communal dining room.

ext.ext_cn: 公共所有
ext.ext_en: ...communal ownership.

defs.def_en: You use communal to describe something that is shared by a group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 比彻姆两眼瞪着她，凶光毕露。
ext.ext_en: Beauchamp glared at her murderously.

defs.def_en: You use murderously to indicate that something is extremely unpleasant or threatening.

ext.ext_cn: 被魔鬼附身的女子
ext.ext_en: ...a woman possessed by demons.

defs.def_en: A demon is an evil spirit.

ext.ext_cn: 他个人的心魔让他多年以来酗酒度日。
ext.ext_en: His private demons drove him to drink excessively for many years.

ext.ext_cn: 仇恨、暴力和种族狂热主义等诸恶
ext.ext_en: ...the demons of hatred, violence and ethnic fanaticism.

defs.def_en: Sources of worry or conflict which trouble a person or group of people are sometimes referred to as demons .

defs.def_cn: 技艺出众的人;精力过人的人;高手;能手

ext.ext_cn: 他球艺惊人。
ext.ext_en: He played like a demon...

ext.ext_cn: 他组织能力极强。
ext.ext_en: He is a demon organizer.

defs.def_en: If you approve of someone because they are very skilled at what they do or because they do it energetically, you can say that they do it like a demon .

ext.ext_cn: 她是一个独裁者，一个女魔头。
ext.ext_en: She was a dictator and a demon...

ext.ext_cn: 他被看成一个执意要将国家交给反动分子的恶魔。
ext.ext_en: He was seen as a demon, determined to hand the country over to the reactionaries.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a powerful person such as a politician as a demon, you mean that you believe they are bad and might be dangerous.

defs.def_cn: 感到兴奋；感到激动；（尤指）性兴奋

ext.ext_cn: 我这人爱出风头，能让大家高兴我就觉得很来劲儿。
ext.ext_en: I'm an exhibitionist, and I get off on the entertainment we give people.

defs.def_en: If you get off on something, you are very excited by it, especially sexually excited.

defs.def_cn: 节省;精打细算;省吃俭用

ext.ext_cn: 在安全措施上抠手抠脚可能会打错算盘。
ext.ext_en: Scrimping on safety measures can be a false economy...

ext.ext_cn: 找工作期间，他只好放弃奢侈的生活，精打细算、省吃俭用。
ext.ext_en: He has had to give up luxuries as he scrimps and saves while looking for a job.

defs.def_en: If you scrimp on things, you live cheaply and spend as little money as possible.

defs.def_cn: 穿上，身穿，给…穿上（某种服装）

ext.ext_cn: 我穿上厚厚的牛仔裤，系上重重的皮带。
ext.ext_en: I rigged myself out in thick jeans and heavy belt...

ext.ext_cn: 我穿着平时那套绿色套装。
ext.ext_en: I was rigged out in my usual green suit.

defs.def_en: If you rig yourself out or are rigged out in a particular way, you are wearing a particular kind of clothes.
A shooting star is a piece of rock or metal that burns very brightly when it enters the earth's atmosphere from space, and is seen from earth as a bright star travelling very fast across the sky.

defs.def_cn: 无可怀疑的；完全可靠的

ext.ext_cn: 他说这五个都是品格完美无缺的人。
ext.ext_en: He said all five were men of unimpeachable character.

ext.ext_cn: 可靠的来源
ext.ext_en: ...an unimpeachable source.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as unimpeachable, you mean that they are completely honest and reliable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 两周前一份周日报纸刊登了一篇对他进行尖酸恶毒攻击的文章。
ext.ext_en: There was a vicious and vitriolic attack on him in one of the Sunday newspapers two weeks ago.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's  language or behaviour as vitriolic, you disapprove of it because it is full of bitterness and hate, and so causes a lot of distress and pain.

ext.ext_cn: 一个有魔力的小男孩辛辛的故事
ext.ext_en: ...the story of Sin-Sin, a little boy who has magical powers.

defs.def_en: Something that is magical seems to use magic or to be able to produce magic.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 美丽的塞浦路斯岛是缔结良缘的美妙之地。
ext.ext_en: The beautiful island of Cyprus is a magical place to get married.
