defs.def_en: A standby is something or someone that is always ready to be used if they are needed.

ext.ext_cn: 5 辆救护车在港口待命。
ext.ext_en: Five ambulances are on standby at the port...

ext.ext_cn: 安全部队已处于待命状态，以防出现暴力事件。
ext.ext_en: Security forces have been put on standby in case of violence.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is on standby, they are ready to be used if they are needed.

defs.def_cn: (戏票或机票)最后时刻廉价出售的，剩余的

ext.ext_cn: 全球通达公司可以预订从纽约到欧洲的剩余机票。
ext.ext_en: Access International books standby flights from New York to Europe.

ext.ext_cn: 马格达将购买起飞前的廉价剩余机票旅行。
ext.ext_en: Magda was going to fly standby.

defs.def_en: A standby ticket for something such as the theatre or a plane journey is a cheap ticket that you buy just before the performance starts or the plane takes off, if there are still some seats left.

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦有两个孩子，分别为11岁和9岁。
ext.ext_en: Alan has two children, aged eleven and nine.

defs.def_en: You use aged followed by a number to say how old someone is.

ext.ext_cn: 她有一个年迈的父亲，可能会很不好相处。
ext.ext_en: She has an aged parent who's capable of being very difficult.

defs.def_en: Aged means very old.

ext.ext_cn: 为老年人服务的人们
ext.ext_en: ...people who work with the aged.

defs.def_en: You can refer to all people who are very old as the aged .

defs.def_cn: （通常佐以酱汁食用的）肉馅玉米卷饼
defs.def_en: An enchilada consists of a flat piece of bread called a tortilla wrapped round a filling of meat or vegetables and served hot, usually with a sauce.

ext.ext_cn: 负责开药的是医生，而不是药剂师。
ext.ext_en: Doctors, not pharmacists, are responsible for dishing out drugs...

ext.ext_cn: 理事会想把钱分配到具体的工程。
ext.ext_en: The council wants to dish the money out to specific projects.

defs.def_en: If you dish out something, you distribute it among a number of people.

ext.ext_cn: 林齐完全有资格给出意见。
ext.ext_en: Linzi is well qualified to dish out advice.

defs.def_en: If someone dishes out criticism or punishment, they give it to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个大人物，迫不得已的话，他也会站出来谴责一番的。
ext.ext_en: He's a big man and he's prepared to dish it out if he has to.

defs.def_en: If someone dishes it out to you, they strongly criticize or punish you.

defs.def_cn: 布(菜);把(食物)装盘子上菜;从大盘中分（菜）

ext.ext_cn: 在餐厅这儿厨师们把皇家奶油鸡装盘。
ext.ext_en: Here in the dining hall the cooks dish out chicken à la king.

defs.def_en: If you dish out food, you serve it to people at the beginning of each course of a meal.

defs.def_cn: 尖端领域；高新领域；最前沿

ext.ext_cn: 我认为以色列在技术发展领域往往处于最前沿。
ext.ext_en: I think Israel tends to be at the leading edge of technological development.

defs.def_en: The leading edge of a particular area of research or development is the area of it that seems most advanced or sophisticated.

defs.def_cn: 分散的;七零八落的;疏疏落落的

ext.ext_cn: 他收拾好扔得到处都是的玩具。
ext.ext_en: He picked up the scattered toys...

ext.ext_cn: 明天局部地区将会有阵雨。
ext.ext_en: Tomorrow there will be a few scattered showers...

defs.def_en: Scattered things are spread over an area in an untidy or irregular way.

ext.ext_cn: 每面都贴满了照片。
ext.ext_en: Every surface is scattered with photographs.

defs.def_en: If something is scattered with a lot of small things, they are spread all over it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有分寸的;考虑周全的;圆通的

ext.ext_cn: 他在处理这个财务问题时很有分寸。
ext.ext_en: He had been extremely tactful in dealing with the financial question...

ext.ext_cn: 我想了想，觉得再要啤酒就有点过分了。
ext.ext_en: I decided it wouldn't be tactful to order another beer.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or what they say as tactful you approve of them because they are careful not to offend or upset another person.
A Jew is a person who believes in and practises the religion of Judaism.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 疲惫的;疲劳的;精疲力竭的

ext.ext_cn: 冬季会让人感觉疲乏无力。
ext.ext_en: Winter weather can leave you feeling fatigued and tired.

defs.def_en: If you are feeling fatigued, you are suffering from extreme physical or mental tiredness.

ext.ext_cn: 达到“芬司匹利”药品相对安全标准的那些药
ext.ext_en: ...those who manage to reach the comparative safety of Fendel...

ext.ext_cn: 相对而言，任务完成得比较轻松。
ext.ext_en: The task was accomplished with comparative ease.

defs.def_en: You use comparative to show that you are judging something against a previous or different situation. For example, comparative calm is a situation which is calmer than before or calmer than the situation in other places.

ext.ext_cn: 对印度各地区的人饮食习惯的比较研究
ext.ext_en: ...a comparative study of the dietary practices of people from various regions of India.

ext.ext_cn: 研究英语和比较文学的教授
ext.ext_en: ...a professor of English and comparative  literature.

defs.def_en: A comparative study is a study that involves the comparison of two or more things of the same kind.

ext.ext_cn: pretty的比较级形式是prettier。
ext.ext_en: The comparative of 'pretty' is 'prettier'.

ext.ext_cn: pretty的比较级形式是prettier。
ext.ext_en: The comparative of 'pretty' is 'prettier'.

defs.def_en: In grammar, the comparative form of an adjective or adverb shows that something has more of a quality than something else has. For example, 'bigger' is the comparative form of 'big', and 'more quickly' is the comparative form of 'quickly'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 冥顽不化的;执迷不悟的
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as wrong-headed, you mean that although they act in a determined way, their actions and ideas are based on wrong judgments.

ext.ext_cn: 她看上去不像50岁。
ext.ext_en: Her looks belie her 50 years.

defs.def_en: If one thing belies another, it hides the true situation and so creates a false idea or image of someone or something.

defs.def_cn: 证明…是虚假的；显示…不真实

ext.ext_cn: 实际情况证明他作了伪证。
ext.ext_en: The facts of the situation belie his testimony.

defs.def_en: If one thing belies another, it proves that the other thing is not true or genuine.

ext.ext_cn: 唾液顺着他的下巴流下来。
ext.ext_en: Spittle oozed down his jaw.

defs.def_en: Spittle is the watery liquid which is produced in your mouth.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在战争中)征服，制服，使屈服

ext.ext_cn: 他们大动干戈想要控制阿富汗地区，但只持续了10年就无果而终了。
ext.ext_en: Their costly and futile attempt to subjugate the Afghans lasted just 10 years.

defs.def_en: If someone subjugates a group of people, they take complete control of them, especially by defeating them in a war.

defs.def_cn: 使(愿望、渴望)退居其次;使让位于

ext.ext_cn: 你那被雄心壮志压制已久的母性本能终于开始展现出来。
ext.ext_en: After having been subjugated to ambition, your maternal instincts are at last starting to assert themselves.

defs.def_en: If your wishes or desires are subjugated to something, they are treated as less important than that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 阿玛尼的精致工艺很容易博得人们的赞誉。
ext.ext_en: It is easy to appreciate the craftsmanship of Armani.

defs.def_en: Craftsmanship is the skill that someone uses when they make beautiful things with their hands.

ext.ext_cn: 他的独木舟以其风格独特、注重细节和做工精细著称。
ext.ext_en: His canoes are known for their style, fine detail and craftsmanship.

defs.def_en: Craftsmanship is the quality that something has when it is beautiful and has been very carefully made.
Casuistry is the use of clever arguments to persuade or trick people.

ext.ext_cn: 总统通过这次会议基本上达到了他的目的。
ext.ext_en: The President broadly got what he wanted out of his meeting...

ext.ext_cn: 认为软件能够处理任何任务的观念从理论上说基本是正确的。
ext.ext_en: The idea that software is capable of any task is broadly true in theory.

defs.def_en: See also:broad;You can use broadly to indicate that something is generally true.

defs.def_cn: （系在腰带或肩带上的）手枪皮套
defs.def_en: A holster is a holder for a small gun, which is worn on a belt around someone's waist or on a strap around their shoulder.
A corpus is a large collection of written or spoken texts that is used for language research.

ext.ext_cn: 非常有趣的笑话
ext.ext_en: ...a screamingly funny joke.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is, for example, screamingly funny or screamingly boring, you mean that it is extremely funny or extremely boring.

ext.ext_cn: 蜂蜜、酸奶、燕麦和苹果调制的混合物
ext.ext_en: ...a concoction of honey, yogurt, oats, and apples.

defs.def_en: A concoction is something that has been made out of several things mixed together.

ext.ext_cn: 有语言天赋的朋友
ext.ext_en: ...a friend who has a flair for languages.

defs.def_en: If you have a flair for a particular thing, you have a natural ability to do it well.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的作品一如既往地引人入胜、气韵潇洒、新颖别致，不会让你失望。
ext.ext_en: Their work has all the usual punch, panache and flair you'd expect.

defs.def_en: If you have flair, you do things in an original, interesting, and stylish way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 外交官可能会提供一些靠不住的误导性信息，这是众所周知的。
ext.ext_en: Diplomats can be a notoriously unreliable and misleading source of information...

ext.ext_cn: 他的判断不可靠。
ext.ext_en: His judgement was unreliable...

defs.def_en: If you describe a person, machine, or method as unreliable, you mean that you cannot trust them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们没有理由在共和党的挑战中败北。
ext.ext_en: There is no reason why they cannot see off the Republican challenge.

defs.def_en: If you see off an opponent, you defeat them.

ext.ext_cn: 本已经计划好把杰姬送上飞机后自己吃一顿牛排大餐。
ext.ext_en: Ben had planned a steak dinner for himself after seeing Jackie off on her plane.

defs.def_en: When you see someone off, you go with them to the station, airport, or port that they are leaving from, and say goodbye to them there.

ext.ext_cn: 居然有那么多人还没有真正确定自己的想法就开始大发议论——这真是令人吃惊。
ext.ext_en: It is surprising how many people start sounding off about something without really deciding what they think about it.

defs.def_en: If someone sounds off, they express their opinions strongly and rather rudely without being asked.

ext.ext_cn: 他死于乱枪之下——匪徒典型的最终下场。
ext.ext_en: He died as any self-respecting gangster should — in a hail of bullets...

ext.ext_cn: 任何地道的美食家游览法国时都会带着一本红皮的《米其林指南》。
ext.ext_en: No self-respecting gourmet would travel in France without the Michelin red guide.

defs.def_en: You can use self-respecting with a noun describing a particular type of person to indicate that something is typical of, or necessary for, that type of person.

defs.def_cn: 达到目的;成功做成;办到

ext.ext_cn: 我们已经成功地与国防部敲定了基本原则。
ext.ext_en: We have already succeeded in working out ground rules with the Department of Defense...

ext.ext_cn: 一些人经过努力可以成功戒烟。
ext.ext_en: Some people will succeed in their efforts to stop smoking...

defs.def_en: If you succeed in doing something, you manage to do it.

defs.def_cn: 取得预期效果;表现良好

ext.ext_cn: 在 20 世纪 90 年代人们要想婚姻美满，那就不得不认识到它所面临的新压力。
ext.ext_en: If marriage is to succeed in the 1990's, then people have to recognise the new pressures it is facing.

ext.ext_cn: 可能使今后的所有对话都更加难以取得什么成果的举动
ext.ext_en: ...a move which would make any future talks even more unlikely to succeed.

defs.def_en: If something succeeds, it works in a satisfactory way or has the result that is intended.

ext.ext_cn: 经营好中小企业所需的技能和素质
ext.ext_en: ...the skills and qualities needed to succeed in small and medium-sized businesses.

defs.def_en: Someone who succeeds gains a high position in what they do, for example in business or politics.

ext.ext_cn: 戴维·罗兰将在 1 月 1 日接替他任主席几乎已成定局。
ext.ext_en: David Rowland is almost certain to succeed him as chairman on January 1...

ext.ext_cn: 现任元首，兰尼埃三世亲王于 1949 年 5 月 9 日继位。
ext.ext_en: The present ruler, Prince Rainier III, succeeded to the throne on 9 May 1949.

defs.def_en: If you succeed another person, you are the next person to have their job or position.

ext.ext_cn: 闪电式离婚后可能紧接着就是一段在家庭命运上互相纠结的更加漫长、更加痛苦的时期。
ext.ext_en: A quick divorce can be succeeded by a much longer — and more agonising — period of haggling over the fate of the family.

defs.def_en: If one thing is succeeded by another thing, the other thing happens or comes after it.

defs.def_cn: 鞠躬，欠身（打招呼或表示恭敬）

ext.ext_cn: 他们向路易斯深深鞠躬，并忙不迭地给他让道。
ext.ext_en: They bowed low to Louis and hastened out of his way...

ext.ext_cn: 他微微欠身，然后接过了她的包。
ext.ext_en: He bowed slightly before taking her bag.

defs.def_en: When you bow to someone, you briefly bend your body towards them as a formal way of greeting them or showing respect.

ext.ext_cn: 这位上校低头轻声做感恩祈祷。
ext.ext_en: The Colonel bowed his head and whispered a prayer of thanksgiving...

ext.ext_cn: 她一动不动地站着，低着头，双手紧扣在胸前。
ext.ext_en: She stood still, head bowed, hands clasped in front of her.

defs.def_en: If you bow your head, you bend it downwards so that you are looking towards the ground, for example because you want to show respect or because you are thinking deeply about something.

defs.def_cn: 向（压力或他人的意愿）让步；屈从于；屈服于

ext.ext_cn: 一些商店迫于顾客的压力，开始供应有机蔬菜。
ext.ext_en: Some shops are bowing to consumer pressure and stocking organically grown vegetables...

ext.ext_cn: 议会在人们的要求下已同意在明年举行全民公投。
ext.ext_en: Parliament has bowed to the demand for a referendum next year.

defs.def_en: If you bow to pressure or to someone's wishes, you agree to do what they want you to do.

ext.ext_cn: 他们绝不在联合攻击面前丧失斗志的坚定决心
ext.ext_en: ...their determination not to be bowed in the face of the allied attacks.

ext.ext_cn: 我为自己的罪孽感到不安。
ext.ext_en: I am bowed down by my sins.

defs.def_en: If you are bowed by something, you are made unhappy and anxious by it, and lose hope.

ext.ext_cn: 迫于形势他只好宣称愿意恢复外交关系。
ext.ext_en: He bowed to the inevitable and announced that he was willing to resume diplomatic relations.

defs.def_en: If someone bows to the inevitable and does something that they do not want to do, they do it, because circumstances force them to do it.

defs.def_cn: （演员或表演者向观众）鞠躬致意

ext.ext_cn: 他们跑到帐篷中央鞠躬致意。
ext.ext_en: They ran to the center of the tent to take their bows.

defs.def_en: If an actor or entertainer takes a bow, he or she shows appreciation of an audience's applause by bowing to them.

ext.ext_cn: 那时浪高大约有5英尺，船头在上下颠簸。
ext.ext_en: The waves were about five feet now, and the bow of the boat was leaping up and down.

ext.ext_cn: 那艘豪华轮船从头到尾全被照亮的景象
ext.ext_en: ...the sight of that magnificent ship lit up from bow to stern.

defs.def_en: The front part of a ship is called the bow or the bows. The plural bows can be used to refer either to one or to more than one of these parts.

ext.ext_cn: 再用一段丝带，系个蝴蝶结。
ext.ext_en: Add a length of ribbon tied in a bow.

defs.def_en: A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends that is used in tying shoelaces and ribbons.

ext.ext_cn: 其中一些袭击者身背弓箭。
ext.ext_en: Some of the raiders were armed with bows and arrows.

defs.def_en: A bow is a weapon for shooting arrows which consists of a long piece of curved wood with a string attached to both its ends.
The bow of a violin or other stringed instrument is a long thin piece of wood with fibres stretched along it, which you move across the strings of the instrument in order to play it.

ext.ext_cn: 大量的钱
ext.ext_en: ...a great deal of money...

ext.ext_cn: 我能够为你节省许多时间。
ext.ext_en: I am in a position to save you a good deal of time.

defs.def_en: If you say that you need or have a great deal of or a good deal of a particular thing, you are emphasizing that you need or have a lot of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他有许多工作要做。
ext.ext_en: He had a deal of work to do.

defs.def_en: A deal of something is a lot of it.

ext.ext_cn: 日本将不得不与美国就大米的进口达成一笔交易。
ext.ext_en: Japan will have to do a deal with America on rice imports...

ext.ext_cn: 双方都努力了，但还是没能达成协议。
ext.ext_en: The two sides tried and failed to come to a deal...

defs.def_en: If you make a deal ,do a deal, or cut a deal, you complete an agreement or an arrangement with someone, especially in business.

ext.ext_cn: 他们做古董买卖。
ext.ext_en: They deal in antiques...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的公民持有和买卖外汇的权利
ext.ext_en: ...the rights of our citizens to hold and to deal in foreign currency.

defs.def_en: If a person, company, or shop deals in a particular type of goods, their business involves buying or selling those goods.

ext.ext_cn: 我当然不贩毒。
ext.ext_en: I certainly don't deal drugs.

defs.def_en: If someone deals illegal drugs, they sell them.

ext.ext_cn: 利物浦人多年来一直没有得到公正的待遇。
ext.ext_en: The people of Liverpool have had a bad deal for many, many years.

defs.def_en: If someone has had a bad deal, they have been unfortunate or have been treated unfairly.

ext.ext_cn: 赌台管理员给每位玩家正面朝下发了一张牌。
ext.ext_en: The croupier dealt each player a card, face down...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾经在一个非法赌博点负责发牌。
ext.ext_en: He once dealt cards in an illegal gambling joint.

defs.def_en: If you deal playing cards, you give them out to the players in a game of cards.

defs.def_cn: 沉重打击;对…造成伤害（或损失）

ext.ext_cn: 夏季的干旱已经对政府的经济业绩造成了沉重打击。
ext.ext_en: The summer drought has dealt a heavy blow to the government's economic record...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天塞尔日·维亚尔退出该队令法国人又遭遇了一记重击。
ext.ext_en: The French were dealt another blow yesterday when Serge Viars withdrew from the squad.

defs.def_en: If an event deals a blow to something or someone, it causes them great difficulties or makes failure more likely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 割草机之类的庞大物件
ext.ext_en: ...bulky items like lawn mowers.

ext.ext_cn: 一个秃顶的大块头男人
ext.ext_en: ...a bulky man with balding hair.

defs.def_en: Something that is bulky is large and heavy. Bulky things are often difficult to move or deal with.

defs.def_cn: 不可逆转的;不可挽回的;不可撤销的

ext.ext_cn: 如果她在 7 天之内没有得到治疗,她的大脑有可能遭受不可逆转的损伤。
ext.ext_en: She could suffer irreversible brain damage if she is not treated within seven days...

ext.ext_cn: 改革没有回头路。
ext.ext_en: The reforms are irreversible.

defs.def_en: If a change is irreversible, things cannot be changed back to the way they were before.

ext.ext_cn: 蚊帐纱
ext.ext_en: ...mosquito netting.

ext.ext_cn: 铁丝网
ext.ext_en: ...wire netting.

defs.def_en: Netting is a kind of material made of pieces of thread or metal wires. These are woven together so that there are equal spaces between them.

ext.ext_cn: 沃利抓住我的手臂，一是想制止我，二是想稳住我。
ext.ext_en: Wally gripped my arm, partly to restrain me and partly to reassure me...

ext.ext_cn: 一个旁观者遭到了警察的制止。
ext.ext_en: One onlooker had to be restrained by police.

defs.def_en: If you restrain someone, you stop them from doing what they intended or wanted to do, usually by using your physical strength.

ext.ext_cn: 她无法控制自己极度的愤怒。
ext.ext_en: She was unable to restrain her desperate anger...

ext.ext_cn: 她没能克制住自己，起身走向电话。
ext.ext_en: Unable to restrain herself, she rose and went to the phone...

defs.def_en: If you restrain an emotion or you restrain yourself from doing something, you prevent yourself from showing that emotion or doing what you wanted or intended to do.

ext.ext_cn: 这个为期500天的激进计划明确阐明将如何控制通货膨胀。
ext.ext_en: The radical 500-day plan was very clear on how it intended to try to restrain inflation...

ext.ext_cn: 在20世纪70年代，政府曾经试图打击腐败。
ext.ext_en: In the 1970s, the government tried to restrain corruption.

defs.def_en: To restrain something that is growing or increasing means to prevent it from getting too large.

defs.def_cn: 很小的;极小的;一丁点儿的

ext.ext_cn: 我在公寓里养了一只小猫。
ext.ext_en: I've got a wee kitten in the flat...

ext.ext_cn: 他只是需要稍微冷静一下。
ext.ext_en: He just needs to calm down a wee bit.

defs.def_en: Wee means small in size or extent.

ext.ext_cn: 他说他要撒尿。
ext.ext_en: He said he wanted to wee.

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿往便壶里撒了尿。
ext.ext_en: The baby has done a wee in his potty...

defs.def_en: To wee means to urinate. Wee is an informal word used especially by children.

ext.ext_cn: 不过是对残杀动物的行为进行美化的狡猾之举
ext.ext_en: ...just a  clever effort to prettify animal slaughter...

ext.ext_cn: 它对农村进行了过度的美化。
ext.ext_en: It presented an intolerably prettified view of the countryside.

defs.def_en: To prettify something, especially something that is not beautiful, means to make it appear pretty.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一位杰出而又品行端正、作风正派的爱尔兰公民
ext.ext_en: ...a fine, upstanding and decent Irish citizen...

ext.ext_cn: 你看起来像是一个正直的好青年。
ext.ext_en: You look like a nice upstanding young man.

defs.def_en: Upstanding people behave in a morally acceptable way.

ext.ext_cn: 意大利时装品牌安普里奥·阿玛尼谨慎进入家居用品市场。
ext.ext_en: Emporio Armani, the Italian fashion house, has made a discreet foray into furnishings.

ext.ext_cn: 她首次涉足政界
ext.ext_en: ...her first forays into politics.

defs.def_en: If you make a foray into a new or unfamiliar type of activity, you start to become involved in it.

ext.ext_cn: 多数客人至少去过一次城里。
ext.ext_en: Most guests make at least one foray into the town...

ext.ext_cn: 去一趟超市就可以将一次完美野餐所需的现成食物置办妥当。
ext.ext_en: A foray to your supermarket will supply all the ready-made foods for an excellent picnic.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a short journey that you make as a foray if it seems to involve excitement or risk, for example because it is to an unfamiliar place or because you are looking for a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 这些基地训练营被库尔德工人党游击队用于对土耳其实施突袭行动。
ext.ext_en: These base camps were used by the PKK guerrillas to make forays into Turkey.

defs.def_en: If a group of soldiers make a foray into enemy territory, they make a quick attack there, and then return to their own territory.

ext.ext_cn: 整体医学执业医师
ext.ext_en: ...practitioners of holistic medicine.

defs.def_en: Holistic means based on the principles of holism.
A creamery is a place where milk and cream are made into butter and cheese.

ext.ext_cn: 一个著名的、令人尊敬的名字被人用得如此商业化，似乎太让人遗憾了。
ext.ext_en: It seems such a pity that a distinguished and honored name should be commercialized in such a manner...

ext.ext_cn: 各个联邦机构应该把研究商业化。
ext.ext_en: Federal agencies should commercialize research.

defs.def_en: If something is commercialized, it is used or changed in such a way that it makes money or profits, often in a way that people disapprove of.
A conditioner is a substance which you can put on your hair after you have washed it to make it softer.

ext.ext_cn: 使用织物柔顺剂会使衣服打理、熨烫起来更为容易。
ext.ext_en: Using a fabric conditioner will make clothes easier to handle and iron.

defs.def_en: A conditioner is a thick liquid which you can use when you wash clothes in order to make them feel softer.

ext.ext_cn: 这套设备已经挽救了许多新生儿的生命。
ext.ext_en: This equipment has saved the lives of a number of new born children.

ext.ext_cn: 刚出生的羔羊
ext.ext_en: ...new born lambs.

defs.def_en: A newborn baby or animal is one that has just been born.

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿血液取样的仪器
ext.ext_en: ...an instrument for taking a sample of blood from a newborn.

defs.def_en: A newborn is a baby that has just been born.

defs.def_cn: 新生的，新出现的(文学用语)

ext.ext_cn: 轻风把他们的名字吹向刚刚长出的小草。
ext.ext_en: The soft wind breathed their names to the newborn grass...

ext.ext_cn: 微生物学是新生科学。
ext.ext_en: Microbiology was a newborn science.

defs.def_en: Writers sometimes use newborn to describe things that have just come into existence.

ext.ext_cn: 有着红色石板房顶的小石屋
ext.ext_en: ...a small stone cottage with a red slate roof...

ext.ext_cn: 房间的一角放着一个提桶，以接住从屋顶漏下来的水滴。
ext.ext_en: A pail stood in one corner of the room to catch the drips where the roof leaked.

defs.def_en: The roof of a building is the covering on top of it that protects the people and things inside from the weather.

ext.ext_cn: 车翻了，把他困在了里面。
ext.ext_en: The car rolled onto its roof, trapping him.

defs.def_en: The roof of a car or other vehicle is the top part of it, which protects passengers or goods from the weather.

ext.ext_cn: 她用舌头顶着上腭发出啧啧声。
ext.ext_en: She clicked her tongue against the roof of her mouth.

defs.def_en: The roof of your mouth is the highest part of the inside of your mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 洞顶坍塌了。
ext.ext_en: The cave roof collapsed.

defs.def_en: The roof of an underground space such as a cave or mine is the highest part of it.

defs.def_cn: （价格、通货膨胀率等）猛增，飞涨

ext.ext_cn: 韩国艺术品的价格飞涨。
ext.ext_en: Prices for Korean art have gone through the roof.

defs.def_en: If the level of something such as the price of a product or the rate of inflation goes through the roof, it suddenly increases very rapidly indeed.

defs.def_cn: 怒气冲天;大发雷霆;暴跳如雷

ext.ext_cn: 如果我告诉朗中士你已经走了，他会大发雷霆的。
ext.ext_en: Sergeant Long will hit the roof when I tell him you've gone off.

defs.def_en: If you hit the roof or go through the roof, you become very angry indeed, and usually show your anger by shouting at someone.

ext.ext_cn: 我们有地方住我就很感激了。
ext.ext_en: I am just thankful that we have a roof over our heads.

defs.def_en: If you have a roof over your head, you have somewhere to live.

ext.ext_cn: 他演唱自己改编的社会主义赞歌《红旗颂》时，声音穿透了会场的屋顶。
ext.ext_en: He raised the roof at the conference when he sang his own version of the socialist anthem, The Red Flag.

defs.def_en: If a group of people inside a building raise the roof, they make a very loud noise, for example by singing or shouting.

defs.def_cn: 同在一个屋檐下;在同一栋大楼里

ext.ext_cn: 这些公司想一起开在同一栋大楼里，或者彼此紧挨着开在大型购物中心里。
ext.ext_en: The firms intend to open either together under one roof or alongside each other in shopping malls...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然他和母亲的关系还算不错，但和她住在一起就完全是另外一回事了。
ext.ext_en: While his relations with his mother were reasonably satisfactory, having her living under the same roof was a totally different matter!

defs.def_en: If a number of things or people are under one roof or under the same roof, they are in the same building.

ext.ext_cn: 莱昂内尔已经禁止她在他家里再提到这个名字。
ext.ext_en: Lionel has forbidden her ever to mention that name again under his roof.

defs.def_en: If something happens under your roof, it happens in your home.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 双方充满火药味的声明引发了人们对战争的担心
ext.ext_en: ...the belligerent statements from both sides which have led to fears of war...

ext.ext_cn: 他故态复萌，几乎又像一年前那样咄咄逼人了。
ext.ext_en: He was almost back to his belligerent mood of twelve months ago.

defs.def_en: A belligerent person is hostile and aggressive.

ext.ext_cn: 预计交战双方要再一次试图解决彼此的分歧了。
ext.ext_en: The belligerents were due, once again, to try to settle their differences.

defs.def_en: The belligerents in a war are the countries or groups that are fighting each other.
Your retina is the area at the back of your eye. It receives the image that you see and then sends the image to your brain.

defs.def_cn: （与数字连用构成形容词）表示“…向的”，“…方的”

ext.ext_cn: 双向无线电通讯
ext.ext_en: ...a two-way radio.

ext.ext_cn: 三方交流系统
ext.ext_en: ...a system of three-way communication.

defs.def_en: See also:one-way;two-way;-way combines with numbers to form adjectives that describe a means of communication that functions or takes place between the stated number of people.
A cutting board is a wooden or plastic board that you chop meat and vegetables on.

ext.ext_cn: 集邮爱好者
ext.ext_en: ...a stamp-collector.

ext.ext_cn: 受人尊敬的印第安艺术品收藏家
ext.ext_en: ...a respected collector of Indian art...

defs.def_en: A collector is a person who collects things of a particular type as a hobby.

defs.def_cn: (…的)收取人;讨债人;收税员;收票员;收垃圾者

ext.ext_cn: 他以收税为业。
ext.ext_en: He earned his living as a tax collector.

ext.ext_cn: 垃圾清运工
ext.ext_en: ...a garbage collector.

defs.def_en: You can use collector to refer to someone whose job is to take something such as money, tickets, or rubbish from people. For example, a rent collector collects rent from people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 倔强的;固执的;顽固的;执拗的

ext.ext_cn: 他性格固执，惯于一意孤行。
ext.ext_en: He is a stubborn character used to getting his own way...

ext.ext_cn: 他脸上流露出固执坚定的表情。
ext.ext_en: His face was set in an expression of stubborn determination.

defs.def_en: Someone who is stubborn or who behaves in a stubborn way is determined to do what they want and is very unwilling to change their mind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (污渍)顽固的，难以去除的;(问题)棘手的，难以解决的

ext.ext_cn: 这个方法能清除大多数顽固污渍。
ext.ext_en: This treatment removes the most stubborn stains...

ext.ext_cn: 最首要也是最棘手的问题是飞机数量的减少。
ext.ext_en: The first and most stubborn problem was that of reductions in the number of aircraft.

defs.def_en: A stubborn stain or problem is difficult to remove or to deal with.

defs.def_cn: (电影、电视演员)在私人生活中，在银幕（或荧屏）外

ext.ext_cn: 银幕内外的他都令女性倾倒。
ext.ext_en: He was immensely attractive to women, onscreen and offscreen...

ext.ext_cn: 生活中的凯茜受到父亲特里的严格看管。
ext.ext_en: Off-screen, Kathy is under the watchful eye of her father Terry.

defs.def_en: You use off-screen to refer to the real lives of film or television actors, in contrast with the lives of the characters they play.

ext.ext_cn: 班热博士饲养家禽、猪和羊。
ext.ext_en: Dr Binger keeps poultry, pigs and goats...

ext.ext_cn: 多数饲养家禽的农场主不得不依赖商业化生产的饲料。
ext.ext_en: Most poultry farmers have to rely on commercially manufactured feeds.

defs.def_en: You can refer to chickens, ducks, and other birds that are kept for their eggs and meat as poultry .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 回避的;避而不谈的；含糊其词的

ext.ext_cn: 他避而不谈他和斯坦利·迪安第一次会面的情况。
ext.ext_en: He was evasive about the circumstances of his first meeting with Stanley Dean...

ext.ext_cn: 直接的提问得到的几乎肯定会是含糊其词的回答。
ext.ext_en: Direct questions would almost certainly result in evasive answers.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as evasive, you mean that they deliberately avoid giving clear direct answers to questions.

ext.ext_cn: 至少有4架高空飞行战斗机不得不采取避让行动。
ext.ext_en: At least four high-flying warplanes had to take evasive action.

defs.def_en: If you take evasive action, you deliberately move away from someone or something in order to avoid meeting them or being hit by them.

ext.ext_cn: 我想和他保持联系，但当我打电话给他时，他却不理睬我。
ext.ext_en: I wanted to keep in touch, but when I called him he gave me the brush-off.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you the brush-off when you speak to them, they refuse to talk to you or be nice to you.

defs.def_cn: (在谈话中)硬扯进(不相干的或别人不想谈论的话题)

ext.ext_cn: 他们不赞成我把他的财富扯进话题。
ext.ext_en: They disapproved of my dragging in his wealth...

ext.ext_cn: 没有了附带扯进去的牢骚话，我们就能够紧扣主题。
ext.ext_en: We were able to stick to the main issue without incidental grievances being dragged in.

defs.def_en: When you are talking, if you drag in a subject, you mention something that is not relevant and that other people do not want to discuss.
A jockstrap is a piece of underwear worn by sportsmen to support their genitals.

defs.def_cn: 不分男女的；男女通用的

ext.ext_cn: 男女皆可光顾的传统理发店
ext.ext_en: ...the classic unisex hair salon...

ext.ext_cn: 很多更长一些的外套是男女都可以穿的。
ext.ext_en: A lot of the longer jackets are unisex.

defs.def_en: Unisex is used to describe things, usually clothes or places, which are designed for use by both men and women rather than by only one sex.

ext.ext_cn: 我想参加有氧运动训练班来增强体质。
ext.ext_en: I'd like to join an aerobics class to improve my fitness.

defs.def_en: Aerobics is a form of exercise which increases the amount of oxygen in your blood, and strengthens your heart and lungs. The verb that follows aerobics may be either singular or plural.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 巧妙的;制作精巧的;新颖独特的

ext.ext_cn: 真正有创意的发明
ext.ext_en: ...a truly ingenious invention...

ext.ext_cn: 戈蒂埃破解这道难题的方法很巧妙。
ext.ext_en: Gautier's solution to the puzzle is ingenious.

defs.def_en: Something that is ingenious is very clever and involves new ideas, methods, or equipment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个咖啡馆很温馨，但又有一种时尚的氛围。
ext.ext_en: The cafe has an intimate but buzzy atmosphere.

defs.def_en: If a place, event, or atmosphere is buzzy, it is lively, interesting, and modern.
A timepiece is a clock, watch, or other device that measures and shows time.
A toggle is a small piece of wood or plastic which is sewn to something such as a coat or bag, and which is pushed through a loop or hole to fasten it.
A sect is a group of people that has separated from a larger group and has a particular set of religious or political beliefs.

ext.ext_cn: 架在石桩上的桥梁
ext.ext_en: ...bridges set on stone pilings.

defs.def_en: Pilings are wooden, concrete, or metal posts which are pushed into the ground and on which buildings or bridges are built. Pilings are often used in very wet areas so that the buildings do not flood.

ext.ext_cn: 两只小鸟一出壳就离开了巢穴。
ext.ext_en: As soon as the two chicks hatch, they leave the nest burrow...

ext.ext_cn: 雏鸟出壳后不久就不见了。
ext.ext_en: The young disappeared soon after they were hatched.

defs.def_en: When a baby bird, insect, or other animal hatches, or when it is hatched, it comes out of its egg by breaking the shell.

ext.ext_cn: 蛋在1周或10天后孵化。
ext.ext_en: The eggs hatch after a week or ten days...

ext.ext_cn: 这些时期，鸟儿会趴在笼底，好像在下蛋或孵蛋。
ext.ext_en: During these periods the birds will lie on the cage floor as if trying to lay or hatch eggs.

defs.def_en: When an egg hatches or when a bird, insect, or other animal hatches an egg, the egg breaks open and a baby comes out.

ext.ext_cn: 他指控反对党密谋暗杀教皇。
ext.ext_en: He has accused opposition parties of hatching a plot to assassinate the Pope.

defs.def_en: If you hatch a plot or a scheme, you think of it and work it out.

ext.ext_cn: 他从舱口探出头来。
ext.ext_en: He stuck his head up through the hatch...

ext.ext_cn: 甲板上所有的装置、窗户、舱口盖和门都已经关牢了。
ext.ext_en: All deck fittings, windows, hatches and doors had been fastened.

defs.def_en: A hatch is an opening in the deck of a ship, through which people or cargo can go. You can also refer to the door of this opening as a hatch.

defs.def_cn: （墙上或屋顶的）小窗口;（尤指厨房和餐厅间传递菜肴等的）小窗口，传菜口
defs.def_en: A hatch is an opening in a ceiling or a wall, especially between a kitchen and a dining room, which you can pass something such as food through.

defs.def_cn: 做好准备（迎接挑战）；未雨绸缪

ext.ext_cn: 很多公司正在加紧准备，希望能挺过这场暴风雨。
ext.ext_en: Many firms are battening down the hatches and preparing to ride out the storm.

defs.def_en: If someone battens down the hatches, they prepare themselves so that they will be able to survive a coming difficulty or crisis.

ext.ext_cn: 接下来是对此流程的一个简短概括。
ext.ext_en: What follows is a brief summary of the process...

ext.ext_cn: 下面是今日新闻简报。
ext.ext_en: Here's a summary of the day's news...

defs.def_en: A summary of something is a short account of it, which gives the main points but not the details.

ext.ext_cn: 那上面称酷刑和草草处决很常见。
ext.ext_en: It says torture and summary execution are common...

ext.ext_cn: 毫无疑问，有人认为拷打比草菅人命好不到哪去。
ext.ext_en: There is no doubt that some considered that a beating was no more than summary justice...

defs.def_en: Summary actions are done without delay, often when something else should have been done first or done instead.

ext.ext_cn: 这些计划已经遭到该国多方面人士的严厉批评。
ext.ext_en: The plans have already come in for fierce criticism in many quarters of the country.

defs.def_en: If someone or something comes in for criticism or blame, they receive it.

ext.ext_cn: 洛杉矶的暴乱反映出这个城市的黑人社区和韩裔社区之间的仇恨。
ext.ext_en: The Los Angeles riots reflected the bitterness between the black and Korean communities in the city...

ext.ext_cn: 政府的预算反映了对经济运行状况的关注。
ext.ext_en: Concern at the economic situation was reflected in the government's budget.

defs.def_en: If something reflects an attitude or situation, it shows that the attitude or situation exists or it shows what it is like.

ext.ext_cn: 冰雪覆盖的山峰反射着阳光。
ext.ext_en: The sun reflected off the snow-covered mountains...

ext.ext_cn: 玻璃似乎可以自然反射光线。
ext.ext_en: The glass appears to reflect light naturally.

defs.def_en: When light, heat, or other rays reflect off a surface or when a surface reflects them, they are sent back from the surface and do not pass through it.

ext.ext_cn: 那面镜子里好像映现出很多个他的影像。
ext.ext_en: His image seemed to be reflected many times in the mirror.

defs.def_en: When something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都应该给自己时间好好想想。
ext.ext_en: We should all give ourselves time to reflect...

ext.ext_cn: 我认真考虑了孩子的将来。
ext.ext_en: I reflected on the child's future.

defs.def_en: When you reflect on something, you think deeply about it.

ext.ext_cn: 情况与战前大不同了，他想。
ext.ext_en: Things were very much changed since before the war, he reflected.

defs.def_en: You can use reflect to indicate that a particular thought occurs to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 这个事件很难让人们对英国人有好印象。
ext.ext_en: The affair hardly reflected well on the British...

ext.ext_cn: 作为教师，你在课堂以外的个人行为会影响人们对学校的印象。
ext.ext_en: Your own personal behavior as a teacher, outside of school hours, reflects on the school itself.

defs.def_en: If an action or situation reflects in a particular way on someone or something, it gives people a good or bad impression of them.
A sequencer is an electronic instrument that can be used for recording and storing sounds so that they can be replayed as part of a new piece of music.
A housing estate is a large number of houses or flats built close together at the same time.
A puffball is a round fungus which bursts when it is ripe and sends a cloud of seeds into the air.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些鱼既不卫生又不新鲜。
ext.ext_en: The fish were unwholesome and old.

defs.def_en: Unwholesome food or drink is not healthy or good for you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我对财富的渴望疯狂、病态，犹如心头的一块重石。
ext.ext_en: My desire to be rich was an insane, unwholesome, oppressive desire.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's feelings or behaviour as unwholesome, you are critical of them because they are unpleasant or unnatural.
Whitewash is a mixture of lime or chalk and water that is used for painting walls white.

ext.ext_cn: 墙已经用石灰水刷过了。
ext.ext_en: The walls had been whitewashed.

ext.ext_cn: 一座座小屋粉刷得洁白而漂亮的城镇
ext.ext_en: ...a town of picturesque whitewashed cottages.

defs.def_en: If a wall or building has been whitewashed, it has been painted white with whitewash.

ext.ext_cn: 政府在粉饰该政权的行为。
ext.ext_en: The administration is whitewashing the regime's actions...

ext.ext_cn: “整个事件都已经被粉饰过了，”他昨日声称。
ext.ext_en: 'The whole incident was whitewashed,' he claimed yesterday.

defs.def_en: If you say that people whitewash something, you are accusing them of hiding the unpleasant facts or truth about it in order to make it acceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 他保证将不会有任何掩饰，并且警方将进行全面调查。
ext.ext_en: He pledged that there would be no whitewash and that the police would carry out a full investigation...

ext.ext_cn: 这份报告最后的结论被谴责为彻头彻尾的粉饰。
ext.ext_en: The report's findings were condemned as total whitewash.

defs.def_en: Whitewash is an attempt to hide the unpleasant facts or truth about someone or something.

defs.def_cn: 轻易战胜；使（对手）得零分

ext.ext_cn: 自1988年以来她还从未在开场赛中让对手吃过鸭蛋。
ext.ext_en: Not since 1988 had she whitewashed an opponent in her opening match...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的主力阵容以0比4惨败。
ext.ext_en: Their leading players were being whitewashed 4-0.

defs.def_en: In sports, if a player or team whitewashes an opponent, they win very easily, and their opponent does not get any points at all.
A winch is a machine which is used to lift heavy objects or people who need to be rescued. It consists of a drum around which a rope or chain is wound.

ext.ext_cn: 他会把钢丝绳拴在汽车底盘上，用卷扬机把汽车吊到运河岸上。
ext.ext_en: He would attach a cable around the chassis of the car and winch it up on to the canal bank...

ext.ext_cn: 船员们被直升机吊到安全的地方。
ext.ext_en: The crew members were winched to safety by helicopters.

defs.def_en: If you winch an object or person somewhere, you lift or lower them using a winch.
A mausoleum is a building which contains the grave of a famous person or the graves of a rich family.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （艺术家）波希米亚风格的，不拘于传统的，放荡不羁的

ext.ext_cn: 放荡不羁的作家
ext.ext_en: ...a bohemian writer.

ext.ext_cn: 追求新潮的咖啡馆社交圈
ext.ext_en: ...bohemian café society.

defs.def_en: You can use bohemian to describe artistic people who live in an unconventional way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 给人印象不深的；平常的；不起眼的

ext.ext_cn: 尽管曼彻斯特联队在近几周表现平平
ext.ext_en: ...even though Manchester United have looked unimpressive over recent weeks...

ext.ext_cn: 雷尼是个平庸而且相当乏味的老师。
ext.ext_en: Rainey was an unimpressive, rather dull lecturer.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as unimpressive, you mean they appear very ordinary, without any special or exciting qualities.

defs.def_cn: 白兰地（一种烈性酒，常在饭后饮用）
defs.def_en: Brandy is a strong alcoholic drink. It is often drunk after a meal.

ext.ext_cn: 喝了两杯白兰地后，迈克尔开始向我讲述他的生平。
ext.ext_en: After a couple of brandies Michael started telling me his life story.

defs.def_en: A brandy is a glass of brandy.
If you call someone a cretin, you think they are very stupid.

ext.ext_cn: 他们宣布启动一项农村发展计划。
ext.ext_en: They announced the initiation of a rural development programme...

ext.ext_cn: 从开始到完成经过了一年的时间。
ext.ext_en: There was a year between initiation and completion.

defs.def_en: The initiation of something is the starting of it.

defs.def_cn: (常包含特殊仪式的)入会，加入

ext.ext_cn: 入会仪式后,这些小伙子与老成员开始互动。
ext.ext_en: After initiation, the youths started to interact with the older members...

ext.ext_cn: 这是我初次参加和平运动。
ext.ext_en: This was my initiation into the peace movement.

defs.def_en: Someone's initiation into a particular group is the act or process by which they officially become a member, often involving special ceremonies.

defs.def_cn: 未经加工的;天然状态的

ext.ext_cn: 我们进口原材料和能源，主要出口工业产品。
ext.ext_en: We import raw materials and energy and export mainly industrial products.

ext.ext_cn: 两艘来自古巴装有粗糖的船
ext.ext_en: ...two ships carrying raw sugar from Cuba.

defs.def_en: Raw materials or substances are in their natural state before being processed or used in manufacturing.

ext.ext_cn: 受欢迎的生鱼菜肴
ext.ext_en: ...a popular dish made of raw fish...

ext.ext_cn: 这种蔬菜有多种吃法，既可生吃也可烹调后食用。
ext.ext_en: This versatile vegetable can be eaten raw or cooked...

defs.def_en: Raw food is food that is eaten uncooked, that has not yet been cooked, or that has not been cooked enough.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 绳子摩擦着我蹭破了皮的肩头
ext.ext_en: ...the drag of the rope against the raw flesh of my shoulders...

ext.ext_cn: 这种活儿她根本做不习惯，双脚疼痛，双手也蹭破了皮。
ext.ext_en: Her feet hurt and her hands were rubbed raw from unaccustomed work.

defs.def_en: If a part of your body is raw, it is red and painful, perhaps because the skin has come off or has been burnt.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （情感）不加掩饰的，原始的，朴实的

ext.ext_cn: 朴实的民族主义热情
ext.ext_en: ...the raw passions of nationalism...

ext.ext_cn: 她仍然沉浸在悲伤中，他不知道如何帮她才好。
ext.ext_en: Her grief was still raw and he did not know how to help her.

defs.def_en: Raw emotions are strong basic feelings or responses which are not weakened by other influences.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 本能的强大力量
ext.ext_en: ...the raw power of instinct.

ext.ext_cn: 他早期绘画的强大生命力
ext.ext_en: ...the raw vitality of his earlier painting.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as raw, you mean that it is simple, powerful, and real.

ext.ext_cn: 对原始数据进行了分析。
ext.ext_en: Analyses were conducted on the raw data.

ext.ext_cn: 全面调整这项普查的原始数据的统计模型
ext.ext_en: ...a statistical model that fully adjusts the census's raw figures.

defs.def_en: Raw data is facts or information that has not yet been sorted, analysed, or prepared for use.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 用新手替代有经验的人
ext.ext_en: ...replacing experienced men with raw recruits...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维斯还是新人，但已经显示出了他的潜力。
ext.ext_en: Davies is still raw but his potential shows.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone in a new job as raw, or as a raw recruit, you mean that they lack experience in that job.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们清扫完屋顶后，寒风刺骨。
ext.ext_en: Once they cleared the housetops, the wind was raw and biting.

ext.ext_cn: 12月一个阴冷的早上
ext.ext_en: ...a raw December morning.

defs.def_en: Raw weather feels unpleasantly cold.

ext.ext_cn: 洗澡用水被未经处理的污水污染
ext.ext_en: ...contamination of bathing water by raw sewage.

defs.def_en: Raw sewage is sewage that has not been treated to make it cleaner.

ext.ext_cn: 他们觉得魁北克省受到了不公平的待遇。
ext.ext_en: They feel that Quebec is getting a raw deal...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为妇女受到了不公正的待遇。
ext.ext_en: I think women have a raw deal.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are getting a raw deal, you mean that you are being treated unfairly.

defs.def_cn: 未开化的；原生态的；处于蒙昧状态的；原原本本的

ext.ext_cn: 这是自然的原生态。
ext.ext_en: This is nature in the raw...

ext.ext_cn: 他也想看看原生态的孟加拉国是什么样子。
ext.ext_en: He also wanted to see Bangladesh in the raw...

defs.def_en: You use in the raw to describe something that is in its true state, and has not been made civilized or respectable.

defs.def_cn: (以某种方式)发生;最后是;结果是

ext.ext_cn: 如果我早知道自己的人生结局会是如此，我当时宁愿让他们杀了我。
ext.ext_en: If I had known my life was going to turn out like this, I would have let them kill me...

ext.ext_cn: 有时事情并不像我们认为的那样发展。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes things don't turn out the way we think they're going to...

defs.def_en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated.

ext.ext_cn: 天气又突然转好了。
ext.ext_en: It's turned out nice again.

defs.def_en: When you are commenting on pleasant weather, you can say that it has turned out nice or fine, especially if this is unexpected.

ext.ext_cn: 科斯格雷夫的预测最后证明是大错特错。
ext.ext_en: Cosgrave's forecast turned out to be quite wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 结果发现我认识那个中枪的人。
ext.ext_en: It turned out that I knew the person who got shot.

defs.def_en: If something turns out to be a particular thing, it is discovered to be that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我会一直玩到门房过来熄灯。
ext.ext_en: I'll just play until the janitor comes round to turn the lights out.

defs.def_en: When you turn out something such as a light or gas, you move the switch or knob that controls it so that it stops giving out light or heat.

ext.ext_cn: 他们生产优质刀片已经有 400 年历史了。
ext.ext_en: They have been turning out great blades for 400 years.

defs.def_en: If a business or other organization turns out something, it produces it.

defs.def_cn: (尤指把某人从其长期居住处)撵走，赶出,逐出

ext.ext_cn: 当然不会有人建议把他从房子里赶出去。
ext.ext_en: Surely nobody would suggest turning him out of the house...

ext.ext_cn: 他们被赶出了旅馆。
ext.ext_en: They were turned out of the hotel…

defs.def_en: If you turn someone out of a place, especially the place where they have been living, you force them to leave that place.

ext.ext_cn: 把生面团倒在撒了面粉的案板上。
ext.ext_en: Turn out the dough on to a floured surface...

ext.ext_cn: 把植物从花盆里倒出来。
ext.ext_en: Turn the plants out of their pots.

defs.def_en: If you turn out the contents of a container, you empty it by removing them or letting them fall out.

ext.ext_cn: 数千人参加了葬礼。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of people turned out for the funeral...

ext.ext_cn: 怪不得球迷们蜂拥而至来观看比赛。这些比赛共产生了 259 粒进球。
ext.ext_en: It was no wonder the fans turned out. The matches yielded 259 goals.

defs.def_en: If people turn out for a particular event or activity, they go and take part in it or watch it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他坚决支持控制政府开支。
ext.ext_en: He's a staunch supporter of controls on government spending.

defs.def_en: A staunch supporter or believer is very loyal to a person, organization, or set of beliefs, and supports them strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 政府称这是阻止每年数十万难民涌入德国的唯一办法。
ext.ext_en: The government claims this is the only way to staunch the annual flow to Germany of hundreds of thousands of refugees...

ext.ext_cn: 为阻止苏格兰北部沿海一艘油轮的原油泄漏所进行的堵漏工作因风暴天气而告中断。
ext.ext_en: Efforts to staunch the spill of crude oil from a tanker off the north coast of Scotland are being held up by gale force winds.

defs.def_en: To staunch the flow of something means to stop it.

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆试图用手帕来止血。
ext.ext_en: Tom tried to staunch the blood with his handkerchief.

defs.def_en: To staunch a wound, or to staunch the blood from a wound, means to stop the wound from bleeding.

ext.ext_cn: 河流对于一个农业国家来说是一种恩赐。
ext.ext_en: Rivers are a blessing for an agricultural country.

ext.ext_cn: 繁荣昌盛的福祉
ext.ext_en: ...the blessings of prosperity.

defs.def_en: A blessing is something good that you are grateful for.

ext.ext_cn: 在白宫的支持下，一群民主党国会议员将开会寻求进一步缩减预算。
ext.ext_en: With the blessing of the White House, a group of Democrats in Congress is meeting to find additional budget cuts...

ext.ext_cn: 4月份，泰国和印度尼西亚的领导人正式批准了这个计划。
ext.ext_en: In April Thai and Indonesian leaders gave their formal blessing to the idea.

defs.def_en: If something is done with someone's blessing, it is done with their approval and support.
A blessing is a prayer asking God to look kindly upon the people who are present or the event that is taking place.

defs.def_cn: 不要身在福中不知福；想想自己有多幸运

ext.ext_cn: 有些人可能会说这事实上算不上什么负担，她应该想想自己有多幸运。
ext.ext_en: Some would argue this was no burden in fact, and that she should count her blessings.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to count their blessings, you are saying that they should think about how lucky they are instead of complaining.

defs.def_cn: 因祸得福；坏事变好事；祸中有福

ext.ext_cn: 去年12月份贸易谈判中止可能因祸得福。
ext.ext_en: The failure to conclude the trade talks last December could prove a blessing in disguise.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a blessing in disguise, you mean that it causes problems and difficulties at first but later you realize that it was the best thing that could have happened.

ext.ext_cn: 对普通的意大利人民来说，星期天的新闻可以说是悲喜交加。
ext.ext_en: For ordinary Italians, Sunday's  news probably amounts to a mixed blessing.

defs.def_en: If you say that a situation is a mixed blessing, you mean that it has disadvantages as well as advantages.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有严格道德标准的；道学先生的

ext.ext_cn: 古板严厉的父亲
ext.ext_en: ...puritanical fathers...

ext.ext_cn: 他在性问题上主张克制，反对纵欲。
ext.ext_en: He has a puritanical attitude towards sex.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as puritanical, you mean that they have very strict moral principles, and often try to make other people behave in a more moral way.

defs.def_cn: 变卖(旧物)换进同类中更贵的东西

ext.ext_cn: 迷你车车主们正变卖旧车换进“真正的”汽车。
ext.ext_en: Mini-car owners are trading up to 'real' cars...

ext.ext_cn: 私房主会感到更安心，可能愿意变卖旧房购买更贵的房子。
ext.ext_en: Homeowners will feel more comfortable and they may feel ready to trade up.

defs.def_en: If someone trades up, they sell something such as their car or their house and buy a more expensive one.

defs.def_cn: (尤指无礼地或傻乎乎地)观望，盯着看

ext.ext_cn: 事故是由为了看热闹而减速的人引起的。
ext.ext_en: The accident was caused by people slowing down to rubber-neck.

defs.def_en: If someone is rubbernecking, they are staring at someone or something, especially in a rude or silly way.

ext.ext_cn: 这些思维习惯忽略了普通和正常之间的区别。
ext.ext_en: These habits of thinking elide the difference between what is common and what is normal.

defs.def_en: If you elide something, especially a distinction, you leave it out or ignore it.

ext.ext_cn: 他抱怨说英国广播公司播音员省略了他们的话。
ext.ext_en: He complained about BBC announcers eliding their words.

defs.def_en: In linguistics, if you elide a word, you do not pronounce or write it fully.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 变幻莫测的;动荡的;骚乱的;混乱的

ext.ext_cn: 他们在一起生活了五六年，一直吵吵闹闹，分分合合，没有片刻安宁。
ext.ext_en: They had been together for five or six turbulent years of rows and reconciliations...

ext.ext_cn: 中东动荡不安的政治局势让人难以预测。
ext.ext_en: The turbulent world of Middle Eastern politics defies prediction.

defs.def_en: A turbulent time, place, or relationship is one in which there is a lot of change, confusion, and disorder.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我必须有一艘能经得起狂风骇浪的船。
ext.ext_en: I had to have a boat that could handle turbulent seas.

defs.def_en: Turbulent water or air contains strong currents which change direction suddenly.

ext.ext_cn: 我打算未雨绸缪，作好应对准备。
ext.ext_en: I'm trying to look ahead at what might happen and be ready to handle it.

defs.def_en: If you look ahead, you think about what is going to happen in the future and perhaps make plans for the future.

defs.def_cn: 切断，剪切;(使金属等)断裂

ext.ext_cn: 还不清楚船舵是如何断裂的。
ext.ext_en: It was not yet clear how the rudder had sheared off...

ext.ext_cn: 机翼在坠机时断裂了。
ext.ext_en: The aircraft's wings were sheared off in the crash.

defs.def_en: If something such as a piece of metal shears off, or if it is sheared off, it breaks.

ext.ext_cn: 这个炸弹由遥控装置引爆。
ext.ext_en: The bomb was detonated by remote control.

defs.def_en: Remote control is a system of controlling a machine or a vehicle from a distance by using radio or electronic signals.
The remote control for a television or video recorder is the device that you use to control the machine from a distance, by pressing the buttons on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的头还痛，并且觉得有些晕头转向。
ext.ext_en: Her head still hurt, and she felt slightly dizzy and disoriented...

ext.ext_cn: 他开始一阵阵地头晕。
ext.ext_en: He began to get dizzy spells.

defs.def_en: If you feel dizzy, you feel that you are losing your balance and are about to fall.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (指女子)粗心的，没记性的，大大咧咧的

ext.ext_cn: 她以扮演金发傻妞而闻名。
ext.ext_en: She is famed for playing dizzy blondes.

ext.ext_cn: 一位迷人的大大咧咧的曾祖母
ext.ext_en: ...a charmingly dizzy great-grandmother.

defs.def_en: You can use dizzy to describe a woman who is careless and forgets things, but is easy to like.

defs.def_cn: 使眩晕;使困惑;使晕头转向

ext.ext_cn: 突然上升的高度让她晕头转向，她抓得紧紧的。
ext.ext_en: The sudden height dizzied her and she clung tightly.

defs.def_en: If something dizzies you, it causes you to feel unsteady or confused.

defs.def_cn: 重要的职位;显赫的地位

ext.ext_cn: 我升到了总经理秘书这一显赫高位。
ext.ext_en: I escalated to the dizzy heights of director's secretary.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has reached the dizzy heights of something, you are emphasizing that they have reached a very high level by achieving it.

ext.ext_cn: 这已经在这么多方面给我们造成了延误,我都无法确定我们要花多长时间才能赶上。
ext.ext_en: It has set us back in so many respects that I'm not sure how long it will take for us to catch up...

ext.ext_cn: 这可能会引发公众抗议，进而可能使变革推迟。
ext.ext_en: There will be a risk of public protest that could set back reforms.

defs.def_en: If something sets you back or sets back a project or scheme, it causes a delay.

ext.ext_cn: 1981 年的时候,在纽约两个人吃一顿饭要花费 5 英镑。
ext.ext_en: In 1981 dinner for two in New York would set you back £5.

defs.def_en: If something sets you back a certain amount of money, it costs you that much money.

defs.def_cn: (3岁马匹参加的一年一度的)德比马赛(在英国指于埃普瑟姆举行的马赛，在美国特指肯塔基马赛)
defs.def_en: The Derby is the name of a race for three-year-old horses that takes place each year. In Britain, it refers to a race that takes place in Epsom. In the United States, it refers particularly to the Kentucky Derby.

defs.def_cn: (同一地区或城市的两队之间的)德比大赛;同城比赛

ext.ext_cn: 阿森纳队和托特纳姆热刺队之间的北伦敦同城大战
ext.ext_en: ...a North London derby between Arsenal and Tottenham.

defs.def_en: A derby is a sporting event involving teams from the same area or city.

ext.ext_cn: 他在温尼珀索基湖举行的一年一度的钓鱼比赛中钓到了一条重 6.28 磅的鲑鱼。
ext.ext_en: He caught a 6.28-pound salmon in the annual fishing derby at Lake Winnipesaukee.

defs.def_en: A derby is a sports competition or race where there are no restrictions or limits on who can enter.
A derby is a round, hard hat with a narrow brim which is worn by men. Derbies are no longer very common.

defs.def_cn: （地球高空对天气变化有重大影响的）急流
defs.def_en: The jet stream is a very strong wind that blows high in the earth's atmosphere and has an important influence on the weather.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有偏见的；有成见的；偏袒一方的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为他好像对女性有点儿成见。
ext.ext_en: He seemed a bit biased against women in my opinion...

ext.ext_cn: 文法学校招生时偏向于录取来自好地段的中产阶级小家庭的孩子。
ext.ext_en: The selection of pupils for grammar schools was biased in favour of the middle-class child of a small family from a good area...

defs.def_en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result. You can also say that a process or system is biased .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在日本，公司偏重于发展，而不是一味追求利润。
ext.ext_en: In Japan firms are biased towards growth rather than profits...

ext.ext_cn: 大学科研经费向科学家极大地倾斜。
ext.ext_en: University funding was tremendously biased towards scientists.

defs.def_en: If something is biased towards one thing, it is more concerned with it than with other things.
A cleaner is someone who is employed to clean the rooms and furniture inside a building.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个洗窗工。
ext.ext_en: He was a window cleaner.

defs.def_en: A cleaner is someone whose job is to clean a particular type of thing.

ext.ext_cn: 烤箱清洁剂

ext.ext_en: ...an air cleaner.

ext.ext_en: He certainly was not politically inactive...

ext.ext_en: The satellite had been inactive since its launch two years ago.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is inactive is not doing anything or is not working.

ext.ext_en: I pushed on towards Flagstaff, a hundred miles to the west...

ext.ext_en: The sun crosses the sky from east to west.

defs.def_en: The west is the direction which you look towards in the evening in order to see the sun set.

ext.ext_en: ...physicists working at Bristol University in the west of England.

defs.def_en: The west of a place, country, or region is the part of it which is in the west.

ext.ext_en: We are going West to California.

defs.def_en: If you go west, you travel towards the west.

ext.ext_en: ...their home town of Paisley, several miles west of Glasgow.

defs.def_en: Something that is west of a place is positioned to the west of it.

ext.ext_cn: 韩国西海岸外的小岛
ext.ext_en: ...a small island off the west coast of South Korea.

defs.def_en: The west part of a place, country, or region is the part which is towards the west.

ext.ext_en: Mark has been working in West Africa for about six months.

ext.ext_cn: 他在伦敦西部的家
ext.ext_en: ...his West London home.

defs.def_en: West is used in the names of some countries, states, and regions in the west of a larger area.
A west wind blows from the west.

defs.def_cn: 西方国家(指美国、加拿大和西欧、北欧、南欧的国家)

ext.ext_cn: 伊朗和西方国家的关系
ext.ext_en: ...relations between Iran and the West.

defs.def_en: The West is used to refer to the United States, Canada, and the countries of Western, Northern, and Southern Europe.

ext.ext_cn: 带人情味的报道
ext.ext_en: ...a human interest story.

defs.def_en: If something such as a news story has human interest, people are likely to find it interesting because it gives interesting details about the person or people involved.

ext.ext_en: It's almost unheard of in France for a top politician not to come from the social elite.

defs.def_en: You can say that an event or situation is unheard of when it never happens.

defs.def_cn: 令人震惊的；前所未有的

ext.ext_en: Long lines of people had queued up to buy at the unheard-of rate of two bottles of rum for $3...

ext.ext_en: Mom announced that she was going to visit her family for a couple of weeks, which was absolutely unheard of.

defs.def_en: You can say that an event or situation is unheard of when it happens for the first time and is very surprising or shocking.

defs.def_cn: 工作日(指星期一至星期五的任何一天)

ext.ext_en: If you want to avoid the crowds, it's best to come on a weekday...

ext.ext_en: Visitor Centre and shop open 9 a.m.—5 p.m. weekdays; 10 a.m.—5 p.m. weekends.

defs.def_en: A weekday is any of the days of the week except Saturday and Sunday.
If you refer to someone as another person's henchman, you mean that they work for or support the other person, especially by doing unpleasant, violent, or dishonest things on their behalf.

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢北方人的豪爽和直率。
ext.ext_en: I like the openness and directness of northerners.

defs.def_en: A northerner is a person who was born in or who lives in the north of a place or country.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 胆小的;害羞的;缺乏自信的

ext.ext_en: A timid child, Isabella had learned obedience at an early age.

defs.def_en: Timid people are shy, nervous, and have no courage or confidence in themselves.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 犹豫不决的;瞻前顾后的

ext.ext_cn: 批评总统的人认为他在应对风云变幻的国际局势时过于瞻前顾后。
ext.ext_en: The President's critics say he has been too timid in responding to changing international developments...

ext.ext_en: The newspaper called the plan timid and unimaginative.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's attitudes or actions as timid, you are criticizing them for being too cautious or slow to act, because they are nervous about the possible consequences of their actions.

ext.ext_cn: 靛青天空中的星星
ext.ext_en: ...the stars in the indigo sky...

ext.ext_cn: 她的前额纹着靛青色的刺青。
ext.ext_en: Indigo tattoos adorn her forehead.

defs.def_en: Something that is indigo is dark purplish blue in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 大批新的运营商将获准进入该市场。
ext.ext_en: A plethora of new operators will be allowed to enter the market.

defs.def_en: A plethora of something is a large amount of it, especially an amount of it that is greater than you need, want, or can cope with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 振奋人心的；鼓舞人心的；令人兴奋不已的

ext.ext_cn: 引人入胜的、令人振奋的爱情故事
ext.ext_en: ...a charming and uplifting love story...

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢振奋人心的电影。
ext.ext_en: I like a film to be uplifting.

defs.def_en: You describe something as uplifting when it makes you feel very cheerful and happy.

defs.def_cn: 殖民地开拓者;早期殖民地居民

ext.ext_cn: 苹果是早期殖民地开拓者来的时候带过来的。
ext.ext_en: The apple was brought over here by the colonists when they came.

ext.ext_cn: 早期的美洲殖民地开拓者
ext.ext_en: ...the early American colonists.

defs.def_en: Colonists are the people who start a colony or the people who are among the first to live in a particular colony.
A traffic circle is a circular structure in the road at a place where several roads meet. You drive round it until you come to the road that you want.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 大为惊讶的;目瞪口呆的

ext.ext_cn: 我宣布要移民去澳大利亚时，所有人都惊呆了。
ext.ext_en: Everybody was flabbergasted when I announced I was going to emigrate to Australia.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are flabbergasted, you are emphasizing that you are extremely surprised.

defs.def_cn: 使（尤指不好的情况、制度、信仰等）继续，延长

ext.ext_cn: 我们绝对不能让过去的宗教分裂继续下去。
ext.ext_en: We must not perpetuate the religious divisions of the past...

ext.ext_cn: 这种形象是媒体宣传造成的错觉。
ext.ext_en: This image is a myth perpetuated by the media.

defs.def_en: If someone or something perpetuates a situation, system, or belief, especially a bad one, they cause it to continue.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （太甜腻或太多愁善感而）使人倒胃口的，让人腻烦的

ext.ext_en: Her cheap, cloying scent enveloped him...

ext.ext_en: Most TV kids are so cloying.

defs.def_en: You use cloying to describe something that you find unpleasant because it is much too sweet, or too sentimental.

ext.ext_cn: 有内置闪光灯的新式相机
ext.ext_en: ...modern cameras with built-in flash units...

ext.ext_en: We're going to have built-in cupboards in the bedrooms.

defs.def_en: Built-in devices or features are included in something as a part of it, rather than being separate.

ext.ext_en: We had reversed the running order.

defs.def_en: The running order of the items in a broadcast, concert, or show is the order in which the items will come.

defs.def_cn: (救济贫民、无家可归者等的)施粥所，施食处

ext.ext_en: ...a soup kitchen in Warsaw that's run by the Church.

defs.def_en: A soup kitchen is a place where homeless people or very poor people are provided with free food.

ext.ext_cn: 哀叹他爱情失意的歌曲
ext.ext_en: ...songs that bewail his dissatisfaction in love.

defs.def_en: If you bewail something, you express great sorrow about it.

ext.ext_en: ...the London terminus of the Channel Tunnel rail link.

defs.def_en: On a bus or train route, the terminus is the last stop, where the bus or train turns round or starts a journey in the opposite direction.

ext.ext_en: Don't try and double-cross me, Taylor, because I'll kill you...

ext.ext_cn: 他们害怕被骗。
ext.ext_en: They were frightened of being double-crossed.

defs.def_en: If someone you trust double-crosses you, they do something which harms you instead of doing something they had promised to do.

defs.def_cn: （尤指用特殊防水布做成的）雨衣

ext.ext_en: I never had anything new to wear as a child, only a cousin's cast-offs.

defs.def_cn: 粗暴（或苛刻）地对待;欺负

ext.ext_en: Do you think you can walk over me? Well, you won't, ever!

defs.def_en: A nodule is a small round lump which is found on the roots of certain plants.

ext.ext_cn: 这些光缆可以用于新型电话通讯系统。
ext.ext_en: These optical fibres may be used for new sorts of telephony.

defs.def_en: Telephony is a system of sending voice signals using electronic equipment.

ext.ext_en: The rebels seem to be trying to capitalize on the public's discontent with the government.

ext.ext_en: Our intention is to capitalize the company by any means we can...

ext.ext_cn: 该公司将以200万英镑的价格出售。
ext.ext_en: The company will be capitalized at £2 million.

defs.def_en: In business, if you capitalize something that belongs to you, you sell it in order to make money.

ext.ext_en: I met some friends and stayed out until eleven or twelve.

defs.def_en: If you stay out at night, you remain away from home, especially when you are expected to be there.

ext.ext_en: There was some bloke on the phone waffling about an airline ticket.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone waffles, you are critical of them because they talk or write a lot without actually making any clear or important points.

ext.ext_cn: 他在堕胎和同性恋权利问题上立场模糊。
ext.ext_en: He's waffled on abortion and gay rights...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直举棋不定，找出种种理由不予成交。
ext.ext_en: He kept waffling and finding excuses not to close the deal.

defs.def_en: If someone waffles on an issue or question, they cannot decide what to do or what their opinion is about it.
A waffle is a kind of square cake made of batter with squares marked on it. Waffles are usually eaten with syrup poured over them.

ext.ext_cn: 《麦克米伦指南》已经事先告诫过我会遇到什么情况。
ext.ext_en: The Macmillan Guide had forewarned me of what to expect.

defs.def_en: If you forewarn someone about something, you warn them in advance that it is going to happen.

defs.def_cn: （事先没有警告的）闪电式罢工

ext.ext_en: Bank staff are to stage a series of lightning strikes in a dispute over staffing.

ext.ext_en: ...long-term solutions to a deep-rooted problem.

ext.ext_cn: 两个超级大国之间根深蒂固的分歧和猜忌
ext.ext_en: ...the deep-rooted divisions and suspicions between the two superpowers.

defs.def_en: Deep-rooted means the same as deep-seated .

defs.def_cn: 申请；请求；申请书；申请表

ext.ext_cn: 土耳其要求加入欧共体的申请
ext.ext_en: ...Turkey's application to join the European Community...

defs.def_en: An application for something such as a job or membership of an organization is a formal written request for it.

ext.ext_en: Students learned the practical application of the theory they had learned in the classroom...

ext.ext_en: Simon's book provides a succinct outline of artificial intelligence and its application to robotics.

defs.def_en: The application of a rule or piece of knowledge is the use of it in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 他横溢的才华、充沛的精力和不懈的努力
ext.ext_en: ...his immense talent, boundless energy and unremitting application.

defs.def_en: Application is hard work and concentration on what you are doing over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 经过反复施用除草剂，杂草得以彻底根除。
ext.ext_en: With repeated applications of weedkiller, the weeds were overcome.

defs.def_en: The application of something to a surface is the act or process of putting it on or rubbing it into the surface.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as horrible, you do not like them at all.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人震惊的;使人恐惧的;让人极度反感的

ext.ext_en: Still the horrible shrieking came out of his mouth.

defs.def_en: You can call something horrible when it causes you to feel great shock, fear, and disgust.
