ext.ext_cn: 她喜爱这个昵称——“铁娘子”。
ext.ext_en: She delighted in the nickname, the 'iron lady'.

defs.def_en: You can use iron to describe the character or behaviour of someone who is very firm in their decisions and actions, or who can control their feelings well.

ext.ext_cn: 在以铁腕统治阿尔巴尼亚 40 年后，他于1985年去世。
ext.ext_en: He died in 1985 after ruling Albania with an iron fist for 40 years.

ext.ext_cn: 永远无法摆脱贫困生活的民族
ext.ext_en: ...a people living permanently in the iron grip of poverty.

defs.def_en: Iron is used in expressions such as an iron hand and iron discipline to describe strong, harsh, or unfair methods of control which do not allow people much freedom.

defs.def_cn: 同时要做的几件事情;同时进行的多个计划

ext.ext_cn: 同时做太多事会使你精力衰竭,让你不知道该做哪件事。
ext.ext_en: Too many irons in the fire can sap your energy and prevent you from seeing which path to take.

defs.def_en: If someone has a lot of irons in the fire, they are involved in several different activities or have several different plans.
If someone pumps iron, they exercise by lifting weights using special machines.

ext.ext_cn: 休是博耐顿中学的住校生。
ext.ext_en: Sue was a boarder at Benenden.

defs.def_en: A boarder is a pupil who lives at school during the term.

ext.ext_cn: 以所有人生而平等这一准则为基础的选举程序
ext.ext_en: ...an electoral process based on the precept that all men are born equal.

ext.ext_cn: 佛教的戒律
ext.ext_en: ...the precepts of Buddhism.

defs.def_en: A precept is a general rule that helps you to decide how you should behave in particular circumstances.

defs.def_cn: (用镇静剂)使安定，使镇静，使昏睡

ext.ext_cn: 这种强效药剂被用来麻醉手术病人。
ext.ext_en: This powerful drug is used to tranquilize patients undergoing surgery.

defs.def_en: To tranquillize a person or an animal means to make them become calm, sleepy, or unconscious by means of a drug.

ext.ext_cn: 充电电池
ext.ext_en: ...a rechargeable battery.

ext.ext_cn: 充电钻孔机
ext.ext_en: ...a rechargeable drill.

defs.def_en: Rechargeable batteries can be recharged and used again. Some electrical products are described as rechargeable when they contain rechargeable batteries.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Artsy means the same as arty .

ext.ext_cn: 一块蛋糕
ext.ext_en: ...a piece of cake...

ext.ext_cn: 来点巧克力蛋糕怎么样?
ext.ext_en: Would you like some chocolate cake?

defs.def_en: A cake is a sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, eggs, sugar, and fat in an oven. Cakes may be large and cut into slices or small and intended for one person only.

ext.ext_cn: 鱼饼
ext.ext_en: ...fish cakes.

ext.ext_cn: 自家做的土豆饼
ext.ext_en: ...home-made potato cakes.

defs.def_en: Food that is formed into flat round shapes before it is cooked can be referred to as cakes .

ext.ext_cn: 一小块青柠味香皂
ext.ext_en: ...a small cake of lime-scented soap.

defs.def_en: A cake of soap is a small block of it.

ext.ext_cn: 血开始结块变黑。
ext.ext_en: The blood had begun to cake and turn brown.

defs.def_en: If something such as blood or mud cakes, it changes from a thick liquid to a dry layer or lump.

defs.def_cn: 二者兼得;鱼与熊掌兼得

ext.ext_cn: 他想要转型为市场经济,同时又不降低人们的生活水平。在许多人看来,这是想要鱼与熊掌兼得。
ext.ext_en: What he wants is a switch to a market economy in a way which does not reduce people's standard of living. To many this sounds like wanting to have his cake and eat it.

defs.def_en: If you think that someone wants the benefits of doing two things when it is only reasonable to expect the benefits of doing one, you can say that they want to have their cake and eat it .

defs.def_cn: 非常抢手;非常畅销;热销

ext.ext_cn: 有关皇室的书卖得正火。
ext.ext_en: Books on the Royal Family are selling like hot cakes.

defs.def_en: If things are selling like hot cakes, a lot of people are buying them.

defs.def_cn: 小事一桩，易如反掌，小菜一碟（常用于安慰别人）

ext.ext_cn: 摆脱掉他就是小事一桩。
ext.ext_en: Getting rid of him will be a piece of cake...

ext.ext_cn: 老伙计,只不过又是一份盯梢的活。对你这样的人来说还不是小菜一碟。
ext.ext_en: Just another surveillance job, old chap. Piece of cake to somebody like you.

defs.def_en: If you think something is very easy to do, you can say it is a piece of cake. People often say this to stop someone feeling worried about doing something they have to do.

defs.def_cn: (愚蠢、无礼、自私的行为）非常过分，极其讨厌
defs.def_en: If someone has done something very stupid, rude, or selfish, you can say that they take the cake or that what they have done takes the cake, to emphasize your surprise at their behaviour.

defs.def_cn: （英国）议会（包括上议院和下议院）；议会大厦

ext.ext_cn: 议会上提出的各类议题
ext.ext_en: ...issues aired in the Houses of Parliament...

ext.ext_cn: 他们参加集会的行进途中经过议会大厦。
ext.ext_en: They marched past the Houses of Parliament on their way to a rally.

defs.def_en: In Britain, the Houses of Parliament are the British parliament, which consists of two parts, the House of Commons and the House of Lords. The buildings where the British parliament does its work are also called the Houses of Parliament.

ext.ext_cn: 她接着躺在了一个躺椅上。
ext.ext_en: She proceeded to recline on a chaise longue...

ext.ext_cn: 靠在垫子上休息15分钟。
ext.ext_en: Move to a reclining position on the mattress and rest for 15 minutes.

defs.def_en: If you recline on something, you sit or lie on it with the upper part of your body supported at an angle.

defs.def_cn: 向后倾斜（坐椅）；(使)（坐椅）椅背后仰

ext.ext_cn: 法国航空公司头等舱的坐椅可以调低成几乎像床一样。
ext.ext_en: Air France first-class seats recline almost like beds...

ext.ext_cn: 拉梅什把椅背调低，倚在上面吸烟。
ext.ext_en: Ramesh had reclined his seat and was lying back smoking...

defs.def_en: When a seat reclines or when you recline it, you lower the back so that it is more comfortable to sit in.

ext.ext_cn: 我转了一下门把手，发现门开着。
ext.ext_en: I turned the handle and found the door was open.

defs.def_en: A handle is a small round object or a lever that is attached to a door and is used for opening and closing it.

ext.ext_cn: 一个板球拍柄从他的胳肢窝下面伸了出来。
ext.ext_en: The handle of a cricket bat protruded from under his arm.

ext.ext_cn: 扫帚柄
ext.ext_en: ...a broom handle.

defs.def_en: A handle is the part of an object such as a tool, bag, or cup that you hold in order to be able to pick up and use the object.

defs.def_cn: 有能力应付;（成功地）处理

ext.ext_cn: 说实话，我不知道自己是否能做好这份工作。
ext.ext_en: To tell the truth, I don't know if I can handle the job...

ext.ext_cn: 她承受不了压力。
ext.ext_en: She cannot handle pressure...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone can handle a problem or situation, you mean that they have the ability to deal with it successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得和西格尔先生会谈我可能会搞得一团糟。
ext.ext_en: I think I would handle a meeting with Mr. Siegel very badly...

ext.ext_cn: 她心里承认自己不知道该如何处理这个问题。
ext.ext_en: She admitted to herself she didn't know how to handle the problem.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the way that someone handles a problem or situation, you mention whether or not they are successful in achieving the result they want.

ext.ext_cn: 她负责了总统竞选活动期间新闻报道团的行程安排。
ext.ext_en: She handled travel arrangements for the press corps during the presidential campaign...

ext.ext_cn: 调查由伦敦警察厅反恐部门负责。
ext.ext_en: The investigation is being handled by Scotland Yard's anti-terrorist branch.

defs.def_en: If you handle a particular area of work, you have responsibility for it.

defs.def_cn: 使用，操纵（武器、车辆等）;训练，使唤（动物）

ext.ext_cn: 我从未用过自动手枪。
ext.ext_en: I had never handled an automatic.

defs.def_en: When you handle something such as a weapon, vehicle, or animal, you use it or control it, especially by using your hands.

ext.ext_cn: 他的船操纵起来非常灵便。
ext.ext_en: His ship had handled like a dream!

defs.def_en: If something such as a vehicle handles well, it is easy to use or control.

ext.ext_cn: 清理猫粪时要带上橡胶手套。
ext.ext_en: Wear rubber gloves when handling cat litter.

defs.def_en: When you handle something, you hold it or move it with your hands.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦了解了自己焦虑的原因，你就开始能控制它了。
ext.ext_en: When you have got a handle on your anxiety you can begin to control it.

defs.def_en: If you have a handle on a subject or problem, you have a way of approaching it that helps you to understand it or deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 他为一点小事就大发脾气。
ext.ext_en: He flew off the handle at the slightest thing.

defs.def_en: If you fly off the handle, you suddenly and completely lose your temper.

defs.def_cn: （尤指不合理但又必须服从的）勒令，强制命令，专制统治
defs.def_en: You use diktat to refer to something such as a law or government which people have to obey even if they do not agree with it, especially one which seems unfair.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 强硬的;咄咄逼人的;坚定的

ext.ext_cn: 她愈加被视为强硬的女权主义者。
ext.ext_en: She was increasingly seen as a strident feminist.

ext.ext_cn: 总统发言中不必要的强硬语气
ext.ext_en: ...the unnecessarily strident tone of the President's remarks...

defs.def_en: If you use strident to describe someone or the way they express themselves, you mean that they make their feelings or opinions known in a very strong way that perhaps makes people uncomfortable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她想笑，但声音听起来尖锐刺耳。
ext.ext_en: She tried to laugh, and the sound was harsh and strident...

ext.ext_cn: 他能听到希尔顿在同休斯敦激烈争吵时的咆哮声。
ext.ext_en: He could hear Hilton's strident voice rising in vehement argument with Houston.

defs.def_en: If a voice or sound is strident, it is loud, harsh, and unpleasant to listen to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 明智的；有见地的；审慎的

ext.ext_cn: 总统授权可以明智而审慎地动用军队保护我们的公民。
ext.ext_en: The President authorizes the judicious use of military force to protect our citizens.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action or decision as judicious, you approve of it because you think that it shows good judgment and sense.

defs.def_cn: 乏味的文件；无用的公文

ext.ext_cn: 如今我们不得不面对铺天盖地的垃圾邮件、广告传单和无用的公文。
ext.ext_en: These days, we are bombarded with endless junk mail, fliers, and general bumf.

defs.def_en: Bumf consists of documents containing information which you may not need or find interesting.

defs.def_cn: (用玉米面和鸡蛋制成的)墨西哥玉米薄饼
defs.def_en: A tortilla is a piece of thin flat bread that first came from Mexico, and is made from corn and eggs.

ext.ext_cn: 用一块纱布或过滤网将果汁过滤一下。
ext.ext_en: Strain the juice through a piece of gauze or a sieve.

defs.def_en: Gauze is a type of light, soft cloth with tiny holes in it.

ext.ext_cn: 地上满是他刻木雕时落下的碎屑。
ext.ext_en: The floor was covered with shavings from his wood carvings.

ext.ext_cn: 金属屑
ext.ext_en: ...metal shavings.

defs.def_en: See also:shave;Shavings are small very thin pieces of wood or other material which have been cut from a larger piece.

defs.def_cn: (正式场合穿的)礼服，酒会礼服

ext.ext_cn: 他的妻子奥利维娅站在他身边，一头黑发，穿着白色礼服，显得十分优雅。
ext.ext_en: At his side stood his wife Olivia, dark-haired and exquisite, in a white cocktail dress.

defs.def_en: A cocktail dress is a dress that is suitable for formal social occasions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有同情心的;表示同情的

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲是一个非常富有同情心的人。
ext.ext_en: My father was a deeply compassionate man...

ext.ext_cn: 她的脸上显露出智慧和同情。
ext.ext_en: She has a wise, compassionate face...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as compassionate, you mean that they feel or show pity, sympathy, and understanding for people who are suffering.

ext.ext_cn: 随着自动化程度和效率的不断提高，对管理人员的技能要求可能会大大降低。
ext.ext_en: Administrative staff may be deskilled through increased automation and efficiency.

defs.def_en: If workers are deskilled, they no longer need special skills to do their work, especially because of modern methods of production.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 很多家用产品散发有害气体。
ext.ext_en: Many household products give off noxious fumes.

ext.ext_cn: 一氧化碳和其他有毒气体
ext.ext_en: ...carbon monoxide and other noxious gases.

defs.def_en: A noxious gas or substance is poisonous or very harmful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 烤糊了的糖、黄油、油脂和面粉浓烈难闻的气味
ext.ext_en: ...the heavy, noxious smell of burning sugar, butter, fats, and flour...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的行为令人生厌。
ext.ext_en: Their behaviour was noxious.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone or something as noxious, you mean that they are extremely unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 这次投票将使首相能够力行强硬政策。
ext.ext_en: The vote will enable the Prime Minister to push through tough policies...

ext.ext_cn: 他力促议会通过该修正案。
ext.ext_en: He tried to push the amendment through Parliament.

defs.def_en: If someone pushes through a law, they succeed in getting it accepted although some people oppose it.

ext.ext_cn: 我不再暴食薯条和薯片了。
ext.ext_en: I stopped pigging out on chips and crisps.

defs.def_en: If you say that people are pigging out, you are criticizing them for eating a very large amount at one meal.
A yak is a type of cattle that has long hair and long horns. Yaks live mainly in the Himalayan mountains.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: An unpronounceable word or name is too difficult to say.
In some systems of grammar, the predicate of a clause is the part of it that is not the subject. For example, in 'I decided what to do', 'decided what to do' is the predicate.

ext.ext_cn: 先要有钱或者能弄到钱才能够赚钱。
ext.ext_en: Financial success is usually predicated on having money or being able to obtain it.

defs.def_en: If you say that one situation is predicated on another, you mean that the first situation can be true or real only if the second one is true or real.

ext.ext_cn: 将洋葱和姜放进烤箱烘烤30分钟。
ext.ext_en: Put the onions and ginger in the oven and let them roast for thirty minutes.

defs.def_en: An oven is a device for cooking that is like a box with a door. You heat it and cook food inside it.

ext.ext_cn: 安德鲁，很抱歉我迟到了。我忘了设闹钟，结果睡过头了。
ext.ext_en: I'm really sorry I'm late, Andrew. I forgot to set my alarm and I overslept.

defs.def_en: If you oversleep, you sleep longer than you should have done.

defs.def_cn: 大帆船（主要用于15至17世纪）
defs.def_en: A galleon is a sailing ship with three masts. Galleons were used mainly in the fifteenth to seventeenth centuries.

defs.def_cn: 限制;制约因素;管制措施

ext.ext_cn: 首相正在呼吁对工会施加新的限制措施。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister is calling for new restraints on trade unions...

ext.ext_cn: 由于边境开放和签证管理松懈，罪犯可以毫无限制地进入这个国家。
ext.ext_en: With open frontiers and lax visa controls, criminals could cross into the country without restraint.

defs.def_en: Restraints are rules or conditions that limit or restrict someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 他们表现得比我预料的更为克制。
ext.ext_en: They behaved with more restraint than I'd expected...

ext.ext_cn: 我会和员工谈一谈，要他们加强自制，理智处事。
ext.ext_en: I'll speak to the staff and ask them to exercise restraint and common sense.

defs.def_en: Restraint is calm, controlled, and unemotional behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 在一年半的时间里，自愿实行的限薪措施奏效了。
ext.ext_en: For a year and a half, wage restraint on a voluntary basis worked...

ext.ext_cn: 他控告他们实行贸易管制，并且胜诉了。
ext.ext_en: He sued them for restraint of trade and won.

defs.def_en: Restraint of something is the act of preventing it from increasing too much or from being done freely.

defs.def_cn: (委员会主席在赞成票和反对票相等时所投的)决定性票，关键票

ext.ext_cn: 双方票数相等，一位当地工会领袖投了决定性票，同意复工。
ext.ext_en: The vote was tied and a local union leader used his casting vote in favour of the return to work.

defs.def_en: When a committee has given an equal number of votes for and against a proposal, the chairperson can give a casting vote. This vote decides whether or not the proposal will be passed.

ext.ext_cn: 他打算重走哥伦布到达西印度群岛的航行路线。
ext.ext_en: He aims to follow Columbus's voyage to the West Indies.

ext.ext_cn: 首次完全以天文研究为目的的航天飞行
ext.ext_en: ...the first space shuttle voyage to be devoted entirely to astronomy.

defs.def_en: A voyage is a long journey on a ship or in a spacecraft.  →see usage note at:journey

ext.ext_cn: 绿色和平组织的旗舰正在穿越巴伦支海的北极寒冷地带。
ext.ext_en: The Greenpeace flagship is voyaging through the Arctic cold of the Barents Sea.

defs.def_en: To voyage to a place means to travel there, especially by sea.

ext.ext_cn: 她浏览了一下报纸的广告页。
ext.ext_en: She scanned the advertisement pages of the newspapers...

ext.ext_cn: 我还没有细细研读，只是粗略地翻看了一下。
ext.ext_en: I haven't read much into it as yet. I've only just scanned through it.

defs.def_en: When you scan written material, you look through it quickly in order to find important or interesting information.

ext.ext_cn: 那名警官仔细检查了房间。
ext.ext_en: The officer scanned the room...

ext.ext_cn: 她很紧张，眼睛不停地在人群中搜寻保罗。
ext.ext_en: She was nervous and kept scanning the crowd for Paul...

defs.def_en: When you scan a place or group of people, you look at it carefully, usually because you are looking for something or someone.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的方法是用炸弹探测器对每一个办理了登机手续的箱包进行扫描。
ext.ext_en: Their approach is to scan every checked-in bag with a bomb detector.

defs.def_en: If people scan something such as luggage, they examine it using a machine that can show or find things inside it that cannot be seen from the outside.

ext.ext_cn: 这个盘没有感染病毒——我已经扫描过了。
ext.ext_en: The disk has no viruses — I've scanned it already.

defs.def_en: If a computer disk is scanned, a program on the computer checks the disk to make sure that it does not contain a virus.

ext.ext_cn: 所有图书馆的全部纸质内容最终都会被扫描进电脑。
ext.ext_en: The entire paper contents of all libraries will eventually be scanned into computers...

ext.ext_cn: 设计图也可以从纸上扫描进电脑。
ext.ext_en: Designs can also be scanned in from paper.

defs.def_en: If a picture or document is scanned into a computer, a machine passes a beam of light over it to make a copy of it in the computer.

ext.ext_cn: 船上的雷达扫描了前方的海域。
ext.ext_en: The ship's radar scanned the sea ahead.

defs.def_en: If a radar or sonar machine scans an area, it examines or searches it by sending radar or sonar beams over it.

ext.ext_cn: 他被火速送往医院做脑部扫描。
ext.ext_en: He was rushed to hospital for a brain scan.

ext.ext_cn: 为诊察癌症所做的乳腺扫描检查
ext.ext_en: ...a breast scan to check for cancer.

defs.def_en: A scan is a medical test in which a machine sends a beam of X-rays over a part of your body in order to check that it is healthy.
If a pregnant woman has a scan, a machine using sound waves produces an image of her womb on a screen so that a doctor can see if her baby is developing normally.

ext.ext_cn: 他写了几首诗。锡德告诉他那几首诗都不押韵。
ext.ext_en: He had written a few poems. Sid told him they didn't scan.

defs.def_en: If a line of a poem does not scan, it is not the right length or does not have emphasis in the right places to match the rest of the poem.

defs.def_cn: 高手;能人;前途无量的人

ext.ext_cn: 一群公司精英
ext.ext_en: ...a bunch of corporate hotshots...

ext.ext_cn: 她是华尔街一名业绩斐然的经纪人。
ext.ext_en: She's a hotshot broker on Wall Street.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a hotshot, you mean they are very good at a particular job and are going to be very successful.

ext.ext_cn: 只要能离开那个小屋，去哪儿她都乐意。
ext.ext_en: She'd gladly have gone anywhere to get away from the cottage...

ext.ext_cn: 我想离婚，以求解脱。
ext.ext_en: I wanted a divorce. I wanted to get away.

defs.def_en: If you get away, you succeed in leaving a place or a person's company.

ext.ext_cn: 他忙得没有时间去度假。
ext.ext_en: He is too busy to get away.

defs.def_en: If you get away, you go away for a period of time in order to have a holiday.

ext.ext_cn: 很显然，邓恩博士在遭枪击时正企图逃跑。
ext.ext_en: Dr Dunn was apparently trying to get away when he was shot...

defs.def_en: If something or someone wins out or wins through, they are successful after a competition or struggle.

defs.def_cn: (英国的)清算银行，票据交换银行
defs.def_en: The clearing banks are the main banks in Britain. Clearing banks use the central clearing house in London to deal with other banks.
A herdsman is a man who looks after a herd of animals such as cattle or goats.

defs.def_cn: 受雇做坏事的人;听钱使唤的人
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a hireling, you disapprove of them because they do not care who they work for and they are willing to do illegal or immoral things as long as they are paid.

ext.ext_cn: 她指责同事恃强凌弱，暗箭伤人。
ext.ext_en: She accused her colleagues of bullying and back-stabbing.

defs.def_en: Back-stabbing consists of unkind and disloyal actions or remarks that are likely to harm someone such as a friend or colleague.

defs.def_cn: (用以锁住非法停靠车辆的)车轮固定夹，轮夹
defs.def_en: A wheel clamp is a large metal device which is fitted to the wheel of an illegally parked car or other vehicle in order to prevent it from being driven away. The motorist has to pay to have the clamp removed.

ext.ext_cn: 未经许可停放的车辆将会被轮夹锁住或拖走。
ext.ext_en: Unauthorized vehicles will be wheel clamped or towed away.

defs.def_en: If a car is wheel clamped, a wheel clamp is fixed to one of its wheels so that it cannot be driven away.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不吸引人的；其貌不扬的

ext.ext_cn: 我们在最不起眼的酒吧和咖啡馆找到了最可口、最具创意的肉菜饭和餐前小吃。
ext.ext_en: We found the tastiest and most imaginative paella and tapas in the most unprepossessing bars and cafés.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as unprepossessing, you mean that they look rather plain or ordinary, although they may have good or special qualities that are hidden.

ext.ext_cn: 对于这次会谈有很多前期报道。
ext.ext_en: Much advance publicity was given to the talks...

ext.ext_cn: 政府宣传活动
ext.ext_en: ...government publicity campaigns...

defs.def_en: Publicity is information or actions that are intended to attract the public's attention to someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 这个案件已经在巴西引起了极大的关注。
ext.ext_en: The case has generated enormous publicity in Brazil.

ext.ext_cn: 对凯西事件的再次关注
ext.ext_en: ...the renewed publicity over the Casey affair.

defs.def_en: When the news media and the public show a lot of interest in something, you can say that it is receiving publicity.

ext.ext_cn: 没有给他们提供助听设备，也没教过他们唇读。
ext.ext_en: They are not given hearing aids or taught to lip-read.

defs.def_en: If someone can lip-read, they are able to understand what someone else is saying by looking at the way the other person's lips move as they speak, without actually hearing any of the words.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他形容这是自己一生中最可怕的经历。
ext.ext_en: He described it as the most horrendous experience of his life...

ext.ext_cn: 所使用的暴力骇人听闻。
ext.ext_en: The violence used was horrendous.

defs.def_en: Something that is horrendous is very unpleasant or shocking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （数量、程度等）大得惊人的，极其过分的

ext.ext_cn: 如果和他们的固定资产值相比，他们的债务看起来也并不算惊人。
ext.ext_en: Nor do their debts looks so horrendous when related to the value of their fixed assets.

ext.ext_cn: 常常糟糕透顶的交通堵塞
ext.ext_en: ...the usually horrendous traffic jams.

defs.def_en: Some people use horrendous to describe something that is so big or great that they find it extremely unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 我希望在温布尔登网球公开赛上至少可以进入四分之一决赛。
ext.ext_en: The very least I'm looking for at Wimbledon is to reach the quarter-finals.

defs.def_en: A quarter-final is one of the four matches in a competition which decides which four players or teams will compete in the semi-final.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有助益的;有帮助的;起作用的

ext.ext_cn: 他任董事长的最初几年为提升公司的知名度起到了积极的推动作用。
ext.ext_en: In his first years as chairman he was instrumental in raising the company's wider profile...

ext.ext_cn: 其中一些人质得以获释多亏了杰西·杰克逊。
ext.ext_en: Jesse Jackson was instrumental in the release of some of the hostages.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is instrumental in a process or event helps to make it happen.

defs.def_cn: 用乐器演奏(而非声乐)的;为器乐谱写的

ext.ext_cn: 有声乐也有器乐的磁带录音
ext.ext_en: ...a cassette recording of vocal and instrumental music.

ext.ext_cn: CD 上的最后一支曲目是一首器乐曲。
ext.ext_en: The last track on the CD is an instrumental.

defs.def_en: Instrumental music is performed by instruments and not by voices.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (法律、制度或体系)严格的，刻板的，不可变更的

ext.ext_cn: 在我们的研究中，有几所大学制定了严格的学生行为规则。
ext.ext_en: Several colleges in our study have rigid rules about student conduct...

ext.ext_cn: 医院中护士的日常工作非常刻板。
ext.ext_en: Hospital routines for nurses are very rigid.

defs.def_en: Laws, rules, or systems that are rigid cannot be changed or varied, and are therefore considered to be rather severe.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她相当顽固，宗教观念极强。
ext.ext_en: She was a fairly rigid person who had strong religious views...

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲的思想非常顽固。
ext.ext_en: My father is very rigid in his thinking.

defs.def_en: If you disapprove of someone because you think they are not willing to change their way of thinking or behaving, you can describe them as rigid .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坚硬的;刚性的;不易弯曲的

ext.ext_cn: 坚硬的塑料容器
ext.ext_en: ...rigid plastic containers...

ext.ext_cn: 这些盘子非常坚硬。
ext.ext_en: These plates are fairly rigid.

defs.def_en: A rigid substance or object is stiff and does not bend, stretch, or twist easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (常因震惊或害怕)身体僵直的，不能动弹的，呆住的

ext.ext_cn: 我惊得僵在那里。
ext.ext_en: I went rigid with shock...

ext.ext_cn: 安德鲁过去只要看见狗，无论在哪里，无论什么狗，都会吓得一动不动。
ext.ext_en: Andrew went rigid when he saw a dog, any dog, anywhere.

defs.def_en: If someone goes rigid, their body becomes very straight and stiff, usually as a result of shock or fear.

ext.ext_cn: 通往欧洲的海底管道
ext.ext_en: ...an undersea pipeline running to Europe.

ext.ext_cn: 海底探险
ext.ext_en: ...undersea exploration.

defs.def_en: Undersea things or activities exist or happen below the surface of the sea.
A wine glass is a glass, usually with a narrow stem, which you use for drinking wine.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 糟糕透顶的;令人不快的;劣质的

ext.ext_cn: 他们告诉了我们那糟糕透顶的消息。
ext.ext_en: They told us the dreadful news...

ext.ext_cn: 我的经济状况一团糟。
ext.ext_en: My financial situation is dreadful.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is dreadful, you mean that it is very bad or unpleasant, or very poor in quality.

ext.ext_cn: 我们犯了个极大的错误。
ext.ext_en: We've made a dreadful mistake...

ext.ext_cn: 我头痛欲裂。
ext.ext_en: I had a dreadful headache.

defs.def_en: Dreadful is used to emphasize the degree or extent of something bad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (看上去或感觉到)病得不轻的,极度疲惫的,非常沮丧的

ext.ext_cn: 你还好吧？你看上去十分疲惫。
ext.ext_en: Are you all right? You look dreadful...

ext.ext_cn: 我对已发生的一切感到极其失望。
ext.ext_en: I feel absolutely dreadful about what has happened.

defs.def_en: If someone looks or feels dreadful, they look or feel very ill, tired, or upset.

ext.ext_cn: 法官裁定该证据不能被采信。
ext.ext_en: The judge ruled that the evidence was inadmissible.

defs.def_en: Inadmissible evidence cannot be used in a court of law.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 绝不可接受的;绝对不行的

ext.ext_cn: 他说使用武力是万万不可的。
ext.ext_en: He said the use of force would be inadmissible.

defs.def_en: If you say that something that someone says or does is inadmissible, you think that it is totally unacceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 他们回来参加本赛季的开幕赛。
ext.ext_en: They returned to take part in the season's opening game.

ext.ext_cn: 第5届总议会的开幕日
ext.ext_en: ...the opening day of the fifth General Synod.

defs.def_en: The opening event, item, day, or week in a series is the first one.

ext.ext_cn: 这幕戏的开场描绘了埃及法老阿肯那顿和他的家人其乐融融的情景。
ext.ext_en: The opening of the scene depicts Akhnaten and his family in a moment of intimacy.

defs.def_en: The opening of something such as a book, play, or concert is the first part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他从围栏上的狭窄缺口里挤了过去。
ext.ext_en: He squeezed through a narrow opening in the fence.

defs.def_en: An opening is a hole or empty space through which things or people can pass.

ext.ext_cn: 我们经过一块林中空地时，我往下扫了一眼海滩。
ext.ext_en: I glanced down at the beach as we passed an opening in the trees.

defs.def_en: An opening in a forest is a small area where there are no trees or bushes.

ext.ext_cn: 她一直都很有能力；她需要的只是一次展示才华的机会。
ext.ext_en: Her capabilities were always there; all she needed was an opening to show them.

defs.def_en: An opening is a good opportunity to do something, for example to show people how good you are.

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在没有职位空缺，一旦有的话我们会给你打电话。
ext.ext_en: We don't have any openings now, but we'll call you if something comes up.

defs.def_en: An opening is a job that is available.

ext.ext_cn: 他谈到了他对这件事的厌恶。
ext.ext_en: He spoke of his disgust at the incident...

ext.ext_cn: 他脸上显出厌恶的表情。
ext.ext_en: A look of disgust came over his face...

defs.def_en: Disgust is a feeling of very strong dislike or disapproval.

ext.ext_cn: 他的粗野行为让很多人都讨厌他。
ext.ext_en: He disgusted many with his boorish behaviour.

defs.def_en: To disgust someone means to make them feel a strong sense of dislike and disapproval.

defs.def_cn: (重物撞击软物时的)沉闷声，低沉声

ext.ext_cn: 她绊了一下，重重地摔倒在地。
ext.ext_en: She tripped and fell with a sickening thud...

ext.ext_cn: 他们学习和复习时大多都伴着锤子和风钻沉闷的敲击声。
ext.ext_en: Much of their study and revision was done to the thud of hammers and pneumatic drills...

defs.def_en: A thud is a dull sound, such as that which a heavy object makes when it hits something soft.

defs.def_cn: 发出沉重的声音;砰砰作响

ext.ext_cn: 她光着脚噔噔地跑上木质楼梯。
ext.ext_en: She ran up the stairs, her bare feet thudding on the wood...

ext.ext_cn: 挡风玻璃上的雨刮“啪嗒啪嗒”地来回摆动。
ext.ext_en: The windscreen wipers thudded back and forth...

defs.def_en: If something thuds somewhere, it makes a dull sound, usually when it falls onto or hits something else.

ext.ext_cn: 我的心开始咚咚跳，嘴里发干。
ext.ext_en: My heart had started to thud, and my mouth was dry...

ext.ext_cn: 杰茜卡的心在胸腔里剧烈地跳动着。
ext.ext_en: Jessica's heart was thudding against her ribcage.

defs.def_en: When your heart thuds, it beats strongly and rather quickly, for example because you are very frightened or very happy.

ext.ext_cn: 他但凡提出疑问，得到的回答全是华尔街的官样文章。
ext.ext_en: When he asked questions, the answers came back in Wall Street gobbledygook.

defs.def_en: If you describe a speech or piece of writing as gobbledygook, you are criticizing it for seeming like nonsense and being very technical or complicated.

ext.ext_cn: 抽奖活动的最高奖是大加那利岛双人度假游。
ext.ext_en: The star prize in the raffle is a holiday for two in Gran Canaria.

defs.def_en: The star prize in a competition is the most valuable prize.
If someone buggers off, they go away quickly and suddenly. People often say bugger off as a rude way of telling someone to go away.
An incomer is someone who has recently come to live in a particular place or area.

ext.ext_cn: 他对该行业中新人的低素质予以了批评。
ext.ext_en: He deprecated the low quality of entrants to the profession...

ext.ext_cn: 作为律师，我会反对在现阶段对基因疗法进行任何形式的法律管制。
ext.ext_en: As a lawyer, I would deprecate any sort of legal control on gene therapy at this stage.

defs.def_en: If you deprecate something, you criticize it.

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们已经收集到了比预期更多的数据。
ext.ext_en: Scientists have collected more data than expected.

defs.def_en: See also:social scientist;A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

ext.ext_cn: 一个反对体罚儿童的团体
ext.ext_en: ...a group which campaigns against the physical punishment of children...

ext.ext_cn: 我毫不怀疑此人是罪有应得。
ext.ext_en: I have no doubt that the man is guilty and that he deserves punishment.

defs.def_en: Punishment is the act of punishing someone or of being punished.

ext.ext_cn: 政府提议对已被定罪的贪污腐败官员实施更为严厉的惩罚。
ext.ext_en: The government is proposing tougher punishments for officials convicted of corruption...

ext.ext_cn: 通常处以罚款。
ext.ext_en: The usual punishment is a fine.

defs.def_en: A punishment is a particular way of punishing someone.

ext.ext_cn: 不要指望能穿着这类靴子去干园艺活儿，它们没那么耐穿耐磨。
ext.ext_en: Don't expect these types of boot to take the punishment that gardening will give them.

defs.def_en: You can use punishment to refer to severe physical treatment of any kind.
The payee of a cheque or similar document is the person who should receive the money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （变化或过程）逐渐发生的，零敲碎打的，零散的

ext.ext_cn: 需要的不是政府零敲碎打的措施，而是要对16至19岁年龄段的教育进行彻底变革。
ext.ext_en: Instead of the government's piecemeal approach, what is needed is a radical shake-up of 16-19 education.

ext.ext_cn: 对宪法零星的修订
ext.ext_en: ...piecemeal changes to the constitution.

defs.def_en: If you describe a change or process as piecemeal, you disapprove of it because it happens gradually, usually at irregular intervals, and is probably not satisfactory.

ext.ext_cn: 她们纺纱、织布、煮饭以及料理家务。
ext.ext_en: They would spin and weave cloth, cook and attend to the domestic side of life...

ext.ext_cn: 在一间屋子里，年轻的母亲们在织布，而她们的孩子就在她们膝上打盹。
ext.ext_en: In one room, young mothers weave while babies doze in their laps.

defs.def_en: If you weave cloth or a carpet, you make it by crossing threads over and under each other using a frame or machine called a loom.

ext.ext_cn: 编织紧密的布最适合作画。
ext.ext_en: Fabrics with a close weave are ideal for painting.

defs.def_en: A particular weave is the way in which the threads are arranged in a cloth or carpet.

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮用她自己种的柳树的枝条编篮子。
ext.ext_en: Jenny weaves baskets from willow she grows herself.

defs.def_en: If you weave something such as a basket, you make it by crossing long plant stems or fibres over and under each other.

ext.ext_cn: 这些轿车就在车流中全速穿行。
ext.ext_en: The cars then weaved in and out of traffic at top speed...

ext.ext_cn: 他绕过一张张桌子，走到她和鲍勃坐着的地方。
ext.ext_en: He weaved around the tables to where she sat with Bob...

defs.def_en: If you weave your way somewhere, you move between and around things as you go there.

ext.ext_cn: 简·罗伯茨编了一个引人入胜的故事，诱骗一位年轻女性进入了黑手党的地盘。
ext.ext_en: Jan Roberts weaves a compelling tale which traps a young woman in a world run by the Mafia.

defs.def_en: If you weave a story, you invent a complicated story.

defs.def_cn: 将(素材等)编入（故事或设计中）

ext.ext_cn: 她在诗中编织着奇思妙想。
ext.ext_en: She weaves imaginative elements into her poems...

ext.ext_cn: 布拉格把他主要人物的身世都串在一起。
ext.ext_en: Bragg weaves together the histories of his main characters.

defs.def_en: If you weave details into a story or design, you include them, so that they are closely linked together or become an important part of the story or design.

ext.ext_cn: 莫斯可夫斯基百货商场，一座靠近市中心的大型多层综合建筑
ext.ext_en: ...the Moskovski Department Store, a vast multi-story complex near the city's center.

ext.ext_cn: 多层停车场
ext.ext_en: ...a multi-storey car park.

defs.def_en: A multi-storey building has several floors at different levels above the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 蛋白一煮就会凝结，并且浮起来。
ext.ext_en: As the egg whites cook, they coagulate and rise to the surface...

ext.ext_cn: 血液凝结，使伤口不再出血。
ext.ext_en: The blood coagulates to stop wounds bleeding.

defs.def_en: When a liquid coagulates, it becomes very thick.

defs.def_cn: （置于形容词之前构成形容词，用以强调）表示“超…的”，“极其…的”

ext.ext_cn: 一大批超现代设备
ext.ext_en: ...a wide range of ultra-modern equipment.

ext.ext_cn: 雄心勃勃的主管
ext.ext_en: ...an ultra-ambitious executive.

defs.def_en: Ultra- is added to adjectives to form other adjectives that emphasize that something or someone has a quality to an extreme degree.

ext.ext_cn: 医生会监测你的血压。
ext.ext_en: Your doctor will monitor your blood pressure...

ext.ext_cn: 总理帕夫洛夫因患高血压病倒了。
ext.ext_en: Prime Minister Pavlov had been taken ill with high blood pressure.

defs.def_en: Your blood pressure is the amount of force with which your blood flows around your body.

ext.ext_cn: 他们以坚忍刚毅的精神直面困境。
ext.ext_en: They bore their plight with stoicism and fortitude.

defs.def_en: Stoicism is stoical behaviour.
Whooping cough is a serious infectious disease which causes people to cough and make a loud noise when they breathe in.

ext.ext_cn: 1,000多人被武装部队杀死。
ext.ext_en: More than 1,000 people have been killed by the armed forces...

ext.ext_cn: 他好几次试图自杀。
ext.ext_en: He had attempted to kill himself on several occasions...

defs.def_en: If a person, animal, or other living thing is killed, something or someone causes them to die.

ext.ext_cn: 捕杀过后，男人们和老年妇女们聚集到一片空地上吃了一顿鲸鱼肉。
ext.ext_en: After the kill the men and old women collect in an open space and eat a meal of whale meat.

defs.def_en: The act of killing an animal after hunting it is referred to as the kill .

ext.ext_cn: 他的目的是使空间站项目全面停止。
ext.ext_en: His objective was to kill the space station project altogether...

ext.ext_cn: 舆论可能最终会扼杀这个提议。
ext.ext_en: Public opinion may yet kill the proposal.

defs.def_en: If someone or something kills a project, activity, or idea, they completely destroy or end it.

ext.ext_cn: 他被迫服用鸦片来止痛。
ext.ext_en: He was forced to take opium to kill the pain.

defs.def_en: If something kills pain, it weakens it so that it is no longer as strong as it was.

ext.ext_cn: 我的脚疼死了。
ext.ext_en: My feet are killing me.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is killing you, you mean that it is causing you physical or emotional pain.

ext.ext_cn: 你不该总是为了做到尽善尽美而累坏自己。
ext.ext_en: You shouldn't always have to kill yourself to do well.

defs.def_en: If you say that you kill yourself to do something, you are emphasizing that you make a great effort to do it, even though it causes you a lot of trouble or suffering.

ext.ext_cn: 告诉理查德，一旦抓住他，我要杀了他。
ext.ext_en: Tell Richard I'm going to kill him when I get hold of him.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will kill someone for something they have done, you are emphasizing that you are extremely angry with them.

ext.ext_cn: 再过3周或4周不会要了我的命！
ext.ext_en: Three or four more weeks won't kill me!

defs.def_en: If you say that something will not kill you, you mean that it is not really as difficult or unpleasant as it might seem.

ext.ext_cn: 在和其他目击者交谈前我只是在打发时间。
ext.ext_en: I'm just killing time until I can talk to the other witnesses...

ext.ext_cn: 为了打发等待的那几个小时，安在菜园里干些活。
ext.ext_en: To kill the hours while she waited, Ann worked in the garden.

defs.def_en: If you are killing time, you are doing something because you have some time available, not because you really want to do it.

defs.def_cn: (表示强调)即使很难，即便很费力

defs.def_en: Something that is untouched by something else is not affected by it.

defs.def_cn: 完好无缺的；未受损害的

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔指给我看说，瓦砾中有一栋建筑完好无损。
ext.ext_en: Michael pointed out to me that amongst the rubble, there was one building that remained untouched...

ext.ext_cn: 为了找到钱，桌子被翻过了，拿走了一些钞票，但支票簿和信用卡原封未动。
ext.ext_en: The desk had been rifled for money, some banknotes taken but cheque-book and credit cards left untouched.

defs.def_en: If something is untouched, it is not damaged in any way, although it has been in a situation where it could easily have been damaged.

defs.def_cn: 世外桃源般的；不染尘嚣的；天然质朴的

ext.ext_cn: 迪西岛是当今世上仅存的几个不染尘嚣的岛屿之一，距澳大利亚近5,000公里。
ext.ext_en: Ducie is one of the world's last untouched islands, nearly 5,000km from Australia.

ext.ext_cn: 相对而言未受破坏的小屋，距伦敦仅一个小时左右的车程
ext.ext_en: ...a relatively untouched cottage within only an hour or so's drive of London.

defs.def_en: An untouched area or place is thought to be beautiful because it is still in its original state and has not been changed or damaged in any way.

defs.def_cn: 未吃过（或喝过）的；未动过的

ext.ext_cn: 咖啡没有动过，吐司已经凉了。
ext.ext_en: The coffee was untouched, the toast had cooled...

ext.ext_cn: 他咕哝了些什么，然后食物丝毫未动就进了起居室。
ext.ext_en: He murmured something, then, food left untouched, went into the sitting-room.

defs.def_en: If food or drink is untouched, none of it has been eaten or drunk.
A hypochondriac is a person who continually worries about their health, although there is really nothing wrong with them.

defs.def_cn: (锡克教男教徒及一些印度教伊斯兰教男人缠在头上的)包头巾
defs.def_en: A turban is a long piece of cloth that is wound round the head. It is worn by Sikh men and by some Hindu and Muslim men.

ext.ext_cn: 给我的教授写一封短信，告诉他我为什么没有参加今天上午的考试。
ext.ext_en: Write a note to my prof and tell him why I missed an exam this morning.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to a professor as a prof .

defs.def_cn: （报纸上租赁广告中的）职业人士

ext.ext_cn: 舒适公寓中的单间，带屋顶阳台，不抽烟的职业人士，女士优先。
ext.ext_en: Single room in lovely flat, roof terrace, non-smoking prof., woman pref.

defs.def_en: In newspaper advertisements for things such as flats or apartments that are for rent, prof. means professional.

ext.ext_cn: 悉尼对2000年奥运会的成功申办
ext.ext_en: ...Sydney's  successful bid for the 2000 Olympic Games...

ext.ext_cn: 政府已经查禁了两家报纸，试图压制批评人士的言论。
ext.ext_en: The Government  has already closed down two newspapers in a bid to silence its critics.

defs.def_en: A bid for something or a bid to do something is an attempt to obtain it or do it.

ext.ext_cn: 汉森按协商出价3.51亿英镑接管该公司。
ext.ext_en: Hanson made an agreed takeover bid of £351 million.

defs.def_en: A bid is an offer to pay a particular amount of money for something that is being sold.

ext.ext_cn: 据传，新加坡航空公司正在争取签下两家机场的经营权。
ext.ext_en: Singapore Airlines is rumoured to be bidding for a management contract to run both airports...

ext.ext_cn: 我想她不会再次竞选首相。
ext.ext_en: I don't think she is bidding to be Prime Minister again.

defs.def_en: If you bid for something or bid to do something, you try to obtain it or do it.

ext.ext_cn: 她决定参与一个乔治王朝时期风格梳妆台的竞价。
ext.ext_en: She decided to bid for a Georgian dressing table...

ext.ext_cn: 这家银行宣布了参加竞标的意向。
ext.ext_en: The bank announced its intention to  bid...

defs.def_en: If you bid for something that is being sold, you offer to pay a particular amount of money for it.

ext.ext_cn: 她和儿子道了别。
ext.ext_en: She bade farewell to her son...

ext.ext_cn: 我向她道了晚安。
ext.ext_en: I bade her goodnight.

defs.def_en: If you bid someone farewell, you say goodbye to them. If you bid them goodnight, you say goodnight to them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们都朝他微笑，请他吃饭。
ext.ext_en: They all smiled at him and bade him eat...

ext.ext_cn: 我敢说他按照要求做了。
ext.ext_en: I dare say he did as he was bidden.

defs.def_en: If you bid someone do something, you ask or invite them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我对谁都不会卑躬屈膝。
ext.ext_en: I don't grovel to anybody...

ext.ext_cn: 发言人的声音被叫嚷声盖住了，课堂一片混乱，老师们不得不好言相劝。
ext.ext_en: Speakers have been shouted down, classes disrupted, teachers made to grovel.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone grovels, you think they are behaving too respectfully towards another person, for example because they are frightened or because they want something.

ext.ext_cn: 我们趴在俱乐部的地上四处找。
ext.ext_en: We grovelled around the club on our knees.

defs.def_en: If you grovel, you crawl on the ground, for example in order to find something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须考虑自私自利的后果。
ext.ext_en: We must be mindful of the consequences of selfishness...

ext.ext_cn: 考虑到学生的需要，加的夫大学投入了巨资兴建和改善学生宿舍。
ext.ext_en: Mindful of the needs of its students, Cardiff has invested heavily in providing new and improved residences.

defs.def_en: If you are mindful of something, you think about it and consider it when taking action.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他通常很善于使自己的私生活避开媒体的关注。
ext.ext_en: He's usually very adept at keeping his private life out of the media...

ext.ext_cn: 他是个吉他高手。
ext.ext_en: He is an adept guitar player.

defs.def_en: Someone who is adept at something can do it skilfully.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 现在关押的犯人中有1/4是暴力犯罪。
ext.ext_en: A quarter of current inmates have committed violent crimes.

ext.ext_cn: 反政府的暴力示威
ext.ext_en: ...violent anti-government demonstrations...

defs.def_en: If someone is violent, or if they do something which is violent, they use physical force or weapons to hurt, injure, or kill other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一股强大的冲击波把她向前抛去。
ext.ext_en: A violent impact hurtled her forward...

ext.ext_cn: 剧烈的爆炸好像要把整个地面都掀起来。
ext.ext_en: A violent explosion seemed to jolt the whole ground.

defs.def_en: A violent event happens suddenly and with great force.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （言行或感觉）激烈的，强烈的，狂暴的

ext.ext_cn: 对该计划的强烈反对之声仍不绝于耳。
ext.ext_en: Violent opposition to the plan continues...

ext.ext_cn: 他胃疼得厉害。
ext.ext_en: He had violent stomach pains.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as violent, you mean that it is said, done, or felt very strongly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 拉里开始出现严重的头痛和剧烈的情绪波动。
ext.ext_en: Larry began suffering severe headaches and violent mood swings.

defs.def_en: Violent changes are extreme changes from one state to another.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （死亡）痛苦的，突发性的，暴力造成的

ext.ext_cn: 死于非命的无辜男子
ext.ext_en: ...an innocent man who had met a violent death.

defs.def_en: A violent death is painful and unexpected, usually because the person who dies has been murdered.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （电影或电视节目）多暴力镜头的，渲染暴力的

ext.ext_cn: 这是我看过的最暴力的一部电影。
ext.ext_en: It was the most violent film that I have ever seen.

defs.def_en: A violent film or television programme contains a lot of scenes which show violence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （色彩）强烈的，刺目的，鲜艳夺目的

ext.ext_cn: 夕阳将逝时夺目的红色
ext.ext_en: ...the violent red of dying sunset.

defs.def_en: If you describe a colour as violent, you mean that it is extremely, and often unpleasantly, bright.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一场猛烈的暴风雨席卷了该地区。
ext.ext_en: A violent storm had struck the area.

defs.def_en: Violent weather is extremely stormy and windy.

ext.ext_cn: 新兴商业阶层的出现
ext.ext_en: ...the emergence of a new mercantile class.

defs.def_en: Mercantile means relating to or involved in trade.

ext.ext_cn: 她严令我不准告诉其他任何人。
ext.ext_en: She enjoined me strictly not to tell anyone else...

ext.ext_cn: 事实上伊斯兰教告诫人要宽容，这一点毫无疑问。
ext.ext_en: It is true that Islam enjoins tolerance; there's no doubt about that...

defs.def_en: If you enjoin someone to do something, you order them to do it. If you enjoin an action or attitude, you order people to do it or have it.

ext.ext_cn: 法官禁止Varityper公司以任何方式使用这则广告。
ext.ext_en: The judge enjoined Varityper from using the ad in any way.

ext.ext_cn: 严禁那种做法的初步禁令
ext.ext_en: ...a preliminary injunction enjoining the practice.

defs.def_en: If a judge enjoins someone from doing something, they order them not to do it. If a judge enjoins an action, they order people not to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的家人和支持者为争取其获得身后赦免而开展了多年的运动。
ext.ext_en: His family and supporters have campaigned  for many years for a posthumous pardon.

ext.ext_cn: 他的第一部小说在他死后的出版
ext.ext_en: ...the posthumous publication of his first novel.

defs.def_en: Posthumous is used to describe something that happens after a person's death but relates to something they did before they died.

defs.def_cn: 有再生作用的；有再造能力的

ext.ext_cn: 大自然的再造能力
ext.ext_en: ...the regenerative power of nature.

defs.def_en: Regenerative powers or processes cause something to heal or become active again after it has been damaged or inactive.

defs.def_cn: 元(美国、加拿大、澳大利亚等国的货币单位)

ext.ext_cn: 她的报酬是每小时 7元。
ext.ext_en: She gets paid seven dollars an hour...

ext.ext_cn: 政府正把数十亿元花在新城市铁路项目上。
ext.ext_en: The government is spending billions of dollars on new urban rail projects.

defs.def_en: The dollar is the unit of money used in the USA, Canada, Australia, and some other countries. It is represented by the symbol $. A dollar is divided into one hundred smaller units called cents.

ext.ext_cn: 日本投资者曾为投资美国高档酒店一掷千金。
ext.ext_en: Japanese investors once paid top dollar for the most glamorous hotels in the United States.

defs.def_en: If you pay top dollar for something, you pay a lot of money for it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (食物)非常美味的，极其可口的

ext.ext_cn: 美味可口的苹果派
ext.ext_en: ...a scrumptious apple pie.

defs.def_en: If you describe food as scrumptious, you mean that it tastes extremely good.

ext.ext_cn: 她现在是寡妇。
ext.ext_en: She's a widow now...

ext.ext_cn: 但我们现在所处的是一个更加四分五裂的社会。
ext.ext_en: But we are now a much more fragmented society...

defs.def_en: You use now to refer to the present time, often in contrast to a time in the past or the future.

ext.ext_cn: 很抱歉我得马上走了。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry, but I must go now...

ext.ext_cn: 我担心如果我不立即开始写作的话，就永远都不会再有机会了。
ext.ext_en: I fear that if I don't write now I shall never have another opportunity to do so.

defs.def_en: If you do something now, you do it immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 既然你已经安顿下来了，为什么不开始正经地学点东西呢？
ext.ext_en: Now you're settled, why don't you take up some serious study?...

ext.ext_cn: 现在她已经退休了，和姐姐一起住。
ext.ext_en: Now that she was retired she lived with her sister.

defs.def_en: You use now or now that to indicate that an event has occurred and as a result something else may or will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 钱德拉夫人已经收到了5个孩子每人一件的毛衣，她说这下冬天就不那么难挨了。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Chandra has received one sweater for each of her five children and says that the winter will not be so hard now...

ext.ext_cn: 她曾告诉我不要再重蹈覆辙，但这下我认为已经无关紧要了。
ext.ext_en: She told me not to repeat it, but now I don't suppose it matters...

defs.def_en: You use now to indicate that a particular situation is the result of something that has recently happened.

defs.def_cn: (用于讲述故事或过去的事情)这时，这会儿

ext.ext_cn: 这时她觉得好点儿了。
ext.ext_en: She felt a little better now...

ext.ext_cn: 这会儿布莱克再锁房门已太晚了。
ext.ext_en: It was too late now for Blake to lock his room door...

defs.def_en: In stories and accounts of past events, now is used to refer to the particular time that is being written or spoken about.

ext.ext_cn: 到现在他们已经结婚30年了。
ext.ext_en: They've been married now for 30 years...

ext.ext_cn: 现在他们已失踪很长一段时间了。
ext.ext_en: They have been missing for a long time now...

defs.def_en: You use now in statements which specify the length of time up to the present that something has lasted.

defs.def_cn: (引起听者的注意或改变话题)喂，喏，好

ext.ext_cn: “好吧”，马克斯说,“回到正题上来。”
ext.ext_en: 'Now then,' Max said, 'to get back to the point.'...

ext.ext_cn: 她留在学校排戏，要到9点才回来。喂，大家要喝什么？
ext.ext_en: She stays at school for drama and doesn't get back till nine. Now, what's everyone drinking?...

defs.def_en: You say 'Now' or 'Now then' to indicate to the person or people you are with that you want their attention, or that you are about to change the subject.

defs.def_cn: (用于考虑接下来想说的内容)哦，嗯

ext.ext_cn: 哦，狗能活15年。
ext.ext_en: Now, er, dogs can live to fifteen...

ext.ext_cn: 嗯，对了，显然我们的一些听众可能会有些想法。
ext.ext_en: Now, erm, obviously some of our listeners may have some ideas.

defs.def_en: Some people say 'Now' when they are thinking of what to say next.

defs.def_cn: (用于委婉地强调请求或命令)好，行

ext.ext_cn: 好，来吧，你肯定已经饿了。
ext.ext_en: Come on now. You know you must be hungry...

ext.ext_cn: 好，来，坐在这儿。
ext.ext_en: Come and sit down here, now...

defs.def_en: You use now to give a slight emphasis to a request or command.

defs.def_cn: (引出与已讲述内容有关的信息及继续讲述之前需要了解的信息)你看，喏

ext.ext_cn: 我儿子去了西班牙南部的阿尔梅里亚，你看，他和妻子是喜欢过安静假期的那种人。
ext.ext_en: My son went to Almeria in Southern Spain. Now he and his wife are people who love a quiet holiday...

ext.ext_cn: 你看，我没有告诉他这些细节，因此他一定是自己作了一些调查。
ext.ext_en: Now, I hadn't told him these details, so he must have done some research on his own.

defs.def_en: You can say 'Now' to introduce information which is relevant to the part of a story or account that you have reached, and which needs to be known before you can continue.

ext.ext_cn: 不过，如果是我，我要做的就不仅仅是换锁了。
ext.ext_en: Now, if it was me, I'd want to do more than just change the locks...

ext.ext_cn: 然而，对民主党人来说，他们成功利用了这个问题来渲染总统的麻木不仁。
ext.ext_en: Now, as for the Democrats, they've been able to use this issue quite effectively to portray the president as insensitive.

defs.def_en: You say 'Now' to introduce something which contrasts with what you have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 我爸爸收藏了很多杂志，我有时会翻看一下。
ext.ext_en: My father has a collection of magazines to which I return every now and then...

ext.ext_cn: 我们玩电子游戏时，他偶尔会和我们一起玩。
ext.ext_en: Now and again he'd join in when we were playing video games.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens now and then or every now and again, you mean that it happens sometimes but not very often or regularly.

ext.ext_cn: 吉姆预计随时会被派到欧洲去。
ext.ext_en: Jim expects to be sent to Europe any day now...

ext.ext_cn: 寂静随时会被打破。
ext.ext_en: Any moment now the silence will be broken.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen any day now ,any moment now, or any time now, you mean that it will happen very soon.

defs.def_cn: (用于转换话题或播报新活动)下面

ext.ext_cn: 下面是完全不同的事情。
ext.ext_en: And now for something completely different...

ext.ext_cn: 下面我们快速浏览一下其他新闻报道。
ext.ext_en: Now for a quick look at some of the other stories in the news.

defs.def_en: People such as television presenters sometimes use now for when they are going to start talking about a different subject or presenting a new activity.

ext.ext_cn: 你刚才看上去挺难过的。
ext.ext_en: You looked pretty upset just now...

ext.ext_cn: 我刚才说起坠入爱河的事。
ext.ext_en: I spoke just now of being in love...

defs.def_en: Just now means a very short time ago.

ext.ext_cn: 我现在特别忙。
ext.ext_en: I'm pretty busy just now...

ext.ext_cn: 戈兹沃斯先生这会儿没时间。
ext.ext_en: Mr Goldsworth is not available just now.

defs.def_en: You use just now when you want to say that a particular situation exists at the time when you are speaking, although it may change in the future.

defs.def_cn: 机不可失;勿失良机;错过这村没这店

ext.ext_cn: 机不可失，下决心吧。
ext.ext_en: It's now or never, so make up your mind...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然我很讨厌去，但也就此一回了。
ext.ext_en: Much as I hate to go, it's now or never.

defs.def_en: If you say 'It's now or never', you mean that something must be done immediately, because if it is not done immediately there will not be another chance to do it.

defs.def_cn: (用于劝慰他人)好啦，好啦;得啦，得啦

ext.ext_cn: “我想都过去了。”——“好啦，好啦，你做得还不错。”
ext.ext_en: 'I figure it's all over.'—'Now, now. You did just fine.'

ext.ext_cn: “爸爸，我想和你一起去。”——“好吧，好吧，小宝贝。”
ext.ext_en: 'I want to go with you, Daddy.'—'Now, now, sweetheart.'

defs.def_en: You can say 'now, now' as a friendly way of trying to comfort someone who is upset or distressed.

defs.def_cn: (用于友好地告诫别人)算了，算了;好了，好了

ext.ext_cn: 好了，别争了，好吗?
ext.ext_en: Now then, no unpleasantness, please...

ext.ext_cn: 算了，罗杰，我肯定你不是那个意思，但那话太难听了。
ext.ext_en: Now, now Roger, I'm sure you didn't  mean it but that remark was in very poor taste.

defs.def_en: You can say 'Now, then' or 'Now, now' when you want to give someone you know well a friendly warning not to behave in a particular way.
A dachshund is a small dog that has very short legs, a long body, and long ears.

ext.ext_cn: 这些柱子必须用混凝土固定。
ext.ext_en: The posts have to be set in concrete...

ext.ext_cn: 他们就躺在铺在混凝土地面上的睡袋上。
ext.ext_en: They had lain on sleeping bags on the concrete floor.

defs.def_en: Concrete is a substance used for building which is made by mixing together cement, sand, small stones, and water.

ext.ext_cn: 他只是把地面清理之后浇上了混凝土。
ext.ext_en: He merely cleared and concreted the floors.

defs.def_en: When you concrete something such as a path, you cover it with concrete.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他没有确凿的证据。
ext.ext_en: He had no concrete evidence...

ext.ext_cn: 没有具体的提议可供讨论。
ext.ext_en: There were no concrete proposals on the table...

defs.def_en: You use concrete to indicate that something is definite and specific.

ext.ext_cn: 用实物来教加减法
ext.ext_en: ...using concrete objects to teach addition and subtraction.

defs.def_en: A concrete object is a real, physical object.
A concrete noun is a noun that refers to a physical object rather than to a quality or idea.

ext.ext_cn: 正如布伦基特先生所强调的，一切都还没有定下来。
ext.ext_en: As Mr Blunkett emphasised, nothing is yet set in concrete.

defs.def_en: If a plan or idea is set in concrete or embedded in concrete, it is fixed and cannot be changed.

ext.ext_cn: 邪恶的神秘学实验
ext.ext_en: ...sinister experiments with the occult.

ext.ext_cn: 有关神秘学的书籍
ext.ext_en: ...books dealing with the occult.

defs.def_en: The occult is the knowledge and study of supernatural or magical forces.

defs.def_en: If amounts add up to a particular total, they result in that total when they are put together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词前构成形容词）表示“政治和…的”

ext.ext_cn: 资本主义政治经济体系
ext.ext_en: ...the capitalist politico-economic system.

ext.ext_en: ...the old politico-military struggle for supremacy.

defs.def_en: Politico- is added to adjectives to form other adjectives that describe something as being both political and the other thing that is mentioned.

defs.def_cn: (尤指挂在墙上展示的)画框，镜框

ext.ext_cn: 埃丝特尔把母亲的一张镶银框的照片挂在厨房壁炉台上。
ext.ext_en: Estelle kept a photograph of her mother in a silver frame on the kitchen mantelpiece.

ext.ext_en: ...a pair of picture frames.

defs.def_en: The frame of a picture or mirror is the wood, metal, or plastic that is fitted around it, especially when it is displayed or hung on a wall.

ext.ext_cn: 他给房屋建筑商提供了现代的木构架。
ext.ext_en: He supplied housebuilders with modern timber frames...

ext.ext_cn: 他费了很大力气才把床垫从金属架上移开，然后在下面摸索。
ext.ext_en: With difficulty he released the mattress from the metal frame, and groped beneath it...

defs.def_en: The frame of an object such as a building, chair, or window is the arrangement of wooden, metal, or plastic bars between which other material is fitted, and which give the object its strength and shape.

ext.ext_cn: 他戴了一副新的金边眼镜。
ext.ext_en: He was wearing new spectacles with gold wire frames.

defs.def_en: The frames of a pair of glasses are all the metal or plastic parts of it, but not the lenses.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的腰带紧紧裹着瘦骨嶙峋的身体。
ext.ext_en: Their belts are pulled tight against their bony frames.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's body as their frame, especially when you are describing the general shape of their body.

ext.ext_cn: 标准的 8 毫米的胶片每秒放映16 组镜头。
ext.ext_en: Standard 8mm projects at 16 frames per second.

defs.def_en: A frame of cinema film is one of the many separate photographs that it consists of.

ext.ext_cn: 他住在康涅狄格州北部一个漆成白色的木制房子里，屋子前面竖着尖桩篱栅。
ext.ext_en: He lives in a white-painted frame house behind a picket fence up in Connecticut.

defs.def_en: A frame building is one in which pieces of wood form the most important part of the structure, rather than bricks or stone.

ext.ext_cn: 这幅画现在可以装裱加框了。
ext.ext_en: The picture is now ready to be mounted and framed...

ext.ext_cn: 墙上挂着一张大幅的镶框照片。
ext.ext_en: On the wall is a large framed photograph.

defs.def_en: When a picture or photograph is framed, it is put in a frame.

ext.ext_cn: 泳池周围都是栽种热带花卉的花园。
ext.ext_en: The swimming pool is framed by tropical gardens...

ext.ext_cn: 一张雅致的供重大活动使用的餐桌被摆放在橱窗里。
ext.ext_en: An elegant occasional table is framed in the window.

defs.def_en: If an object is framed by a particular thing, it is surrounded by that thing in a way that makes the object more striking or attractive to look at.

defs.def_cn: 创设，拟定，制定(规则、计划或体系)

ext.ext_cn: 战后，为制定宪法组织了一次会议。
ext.ext_en: After the war, a convention was set up to frame a constitution.

defs.def_en: If someone frames something such as a set of rules, a plan, or a system, they create and develop it.

ext.ext_cn: 情节的展开模式既像惊险小说，又像爱情故事。
ext.ext_en: The story is framed in a format that is part thriller, part love story...

ext.ext_cn: 为了寻求答案，他以 3 种不同方式提出了这个问题。
ext.ext_en: He framed this question three different ways in search of an answer.

defs.def_en: If someone frames something in a particular style or kind of language, they express it in that way.

ext.ext_en: I need to find out who tried to frame me...

ext.ext_cn: 他声称自己被警察设计陷害了。
ext.ext_en: He claimed that he had been framed by the police.

defs.def_en: If someone frames an innocent person, they make other people think that that person is guilty of a crime, by lying or inventing evidence.

defs.def_cn: 在…考虑范围内;有机会成为…

ext.ext_cn: 要想保住夺冠希望，我们还需要再赢一场比赛。
ext.ext_en: We need a win to keep us in the frame for the title.

defs.def_en: See also:cold frame;If someone is in the frame for something such as a job or position, they are being considered for it.

ext.ext_en: They snubbed his invitation to a meeting of foreign ministers at the UN.

defs.def_en: If you snub someone, you deliberately insult them by ignoring them or by behaving or speaking rudely towards them.

ext.ext_cn: 瑞安觉得这是一种怠慢。
ext.ext_en: Ryan took it as a snub...

ext.ext_cn: 德国方面的举动被普遍视为对库克先生的有意怠慢。
ext.ext_en: The German move was widely seen as a deliberate snub to Mr Cook.

defs.def_en: If you snub someone, your behaviour or your remarks can be referred to as a snub .
Someone who has a snub nose has a short nose which points slightly upwards.

ext.ext_cn: 作为作家，我对人物塑造感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: As a writer I am interested in characterization.

ext.ext_cn: 乔叟对克瑞西达的塑造
ext.ext_en: ...Chaucer's characterization of Criseyde.

defs.def_en: See also:characterize;Characterization is the way an author or an actor describes or shows what a character is like.
A hearse is a large car that carries the coffin at a funeral.

defs.def_cn: 绝望;孤注一掷;铤而走险;拼命

ext.ext_en: This feeling of desperation and helplessness was common to most of the refugees...

ext.ext_cn: 在绝望中我参加了一个健身班。
ext.ext_en: In desperation I joined a physical exercise class.

defs.def_en: Desperation is the feeling that you have when you are in such a bad situation that you will try anything to change it.
A shoreline is the edge of a sea, lake, or wide river.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 它只是场不幸的事故。
ext.ext_en: It was just a tragic accident...

ext.ext_cn: 这么多人的不幸丧生
ext.ext_en: …the tragic loss of so many lives…

defs.def_en: A tragic event or situation is extremely sad, usually because it involves death or suffering.

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔·亨察德，《卡斯特桥市长》的悲剧主人公
ext.ext_en: ...Michael Henchard, the tragic hero of 'The Mayor of Casterbridge'.

defs.def_en: Tragic is used to refer to tragedy as a type of literature.

ext.ext_en: It is just a public relations gimmick...

ext.ext_en: The exhibition is informative, up to date, and mercifully free of gimmicks.

defs.def_en: A gimmick is an unusual and unnecessary feature or action whose purpose is to attract attention or publicity.

ext.ext_en: Their health-care system suffers from queues, shortages and ropey equipment.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is ropey, you mean that its quality is poor or unsatisfactory.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: This is an entertaining yet thought-provoking film.

defs.def_en: If something such as a book or a film is thought-provoking, it contains interesting ideas that make people think seriously.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone talks down to you, you disapprove of the way they talk to you, treating you as if you are not very intelligent or not very important.

ext.ext_en: The book is clear, readable and adequately illustrated...

defs.def_en: Something that is clear is easy to understand, see, or hear.

ext.ext_en: It was a clear case of homicide...

defs.def_cn: 完全了解的;明白的;清楚的

ext.ext_en: It is important to be clear about what Chomsky is doing here...

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He walked up Fifth Avenue to clear his head...

ext.ext_en: Our therapists will show you how to clear your mind of worries.

ext.ext_cn: 透明的凝胶
ext.ext_en: ...a clear gel...

defs.def_en: A clear substance is one which you can see through and which has no colour, like clean water.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He has clear blue eyes and a dazzling smile.

defs.def_en: A clear colour is bright and strong.

ext.ext_en: All exits must be kept clear in case of fire or a bomb scare...

defs.def_en: If a surface, place, or view is clear, it is free of unwanted objects or obstacles.

ext.ext_en: To clear the land and harvest the bananas they decided they needed a male workforce...

ext.ext_cn: 斯图尔特在努力给担架开路。
ext.ext_en: Stewart was trying to clear a path for the stretcher...

defs.def_en: When you clear an area or place or clear something from it, you remove things from it that you do not want to be there.

ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister resigned today, clearing the way for the formation of a new government...

ext.ext_en: A court in Berlin has dropped the charges against him, clearing the way for him to leave Germany.

defs.def_en: If something or someone clears the way or the path for something to happen, they make it possible.

ext.ext_en: On a clear day you can see the French coast...

ext.ext_cn: 冬天的天空万里无云。
ext.ext_en: The winter sky was clear.

defs.def_en: If it is a clear day or if the sky is clear, there is no mist, rain, or cloud.

ext.ext_cn: 晨雾散去了。

defs.def_en: When fog or mist clears, it gradually disappears.

ext.ext_en: Her eyes were clear and steady.

defs.def_en: Clear eyes look healthy, attractive, and shining.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If your skin is clear, it is healthy and free from spots.

ext.ext_cn: 加西亚先生说他对监狱中发生的事件问心无愧。
ext.ext_en: Mr Garcia said his conscience was clear over the jail incidents...

ext.ext_cn: 我可以问心无愧地回首过去，我已经尽力了。
ext.ext_en: I can look back on things with a clear conscience. I did everything I could.

defs.def_en: If you say that your conscience is clear, you mean you do not think you have done anything wrong.

defs.def_cn: 不接触的;远离的;在安全距离以外的

ext.ext_en: As soon as he was clear of the terminal building he looked round...

ext.ext_en: She placed a towel on a cluster of rocks just clear of the tidemark...

ext.ext_en: After that they drove clear over to St Paul.

defs.def_en: If you drive clear to a place, especially a place that is far away, you go all the way there without delays.

ext.ext_cn: 古巴的世界跳高纪录保持者索托马约尔跳过了2.36米。
ext.ext_en: Sotomayor, the Cuban holder of the world high jump record, cleared 2.36 metres.

defs.def_en: If an animal or person clears an object or clears a certain height, they jump over the object, or over something that height, without touching it.

ext.ext_cn: 在波兰，银行兑现支票可能还需要两三个星期。
ext.ext_en: Polish banks can still take two or three weeks to clear a cheque...

ext.ext_en: Linda Gradstein has this report from Jerusalem, which was cleared by an Israeli censor...

defs.def_en: If a course of action is cleared, people in authority give permission for it to happen.

ext.ext_en: She was cleared of murder and jailed for just five years for manslaughter...

defs.def_cn: 没有危险的;不受责备的;不受怀疑的

defs.def_en: If someone is in the clear, they are not in danger, or are not blamed or suspected of anything.
