ext.ext_cn: 椰子汁没什么营养价值。
ext.ext_en: Coconut milk has little nutritive value.

defs.def_en: The nutritive content of food is all the substances that are in it which help you to remain healthy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 含糊不清的;不明确的;模棱两可的

ext.ext_cn: 这份协议非常含糊，可以有多种解释。
ext.ext_en: This agreement is very ambiguous and open to various interpretations...

ext.ext_cn: 外交大臣的话对本周较早时候发表的一份模棱两可的声明作出了澄清。
ext.ext_en: The Foreign Secretary's remarks clarify an ambiguous statement issued earlier this week.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ambiguous, you mean that it is unclear or confusing because it can be understood in more than one way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 暧昧不清的；不协调的；捉摸不定的

ext.ext_cn: 学生们对于自己在这个世界上的角色认识模糊不清。
ext.ext_en: Students have ambiguous feelings about their role in the world.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ambiguous, you mean that it contains several different ideas or attitudes that do not fit well together.
A linden or a linden tree is a large tree with pale green leaves which is often planted in parks in towns and cities.

ext.ext_cn: 他的笔调透出一种倦意。
ext.ext_en: The tone of his text bespeaks a certain tiredness.

defs.def_en: If someone's action or behaviour bespeaks a particular quality, feeling, or experience, it shows that quality, feeling, or experience.

defs.def_cn: 最好(或最有趣)的部分;精华

ext.ext_cn: 这个计划的亮点是选民们动议的定期举行公民投票。
ext.ext_en: The centrepiece of the plan is the idea of regular referendums, initiated by voters.

defs.def_en: The centrepiece of something is the best or most interesting part of it.
A centrepiece is an ornament which you put in the middle of something, especially a dinner table.

ext.ext_cn: 这条狗撕咬着，咆哮着，摇晃着尾巴。
ext.ext_en: The dog was biting, growling and wagging its tail.

defs.def_en: When a dog wags its tail, it repeatedly waves its tail from side to side.

defs.def_cn: (通常指由于厌恶而)左右摇晃(手指)

ext.ext_cn: 他摇晃着手指表示不同意。
ext.ext_en: He wagged a disapproving finger...

ext.ext_cn: 她当着他的面嘲弄地摇晃着手指。
ext.ext_en: She wagged a finger under his nose in a taunting gesture.

defs.def_en: If you wag your finger, you shake it repeatedly and quickly from side to side, usually because you are annoyed with someone.

ext.ext_cn: 他不高兴地摇着头。
ext.ext_en: He wags his head unhappily.

defs.def_en: If you wag your head, you move it from side to side, often because you are unhappy about a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 他爸爸这个人说话相当风趣。
ext.ext_en: He's a bit of a wag, his dad...

ext.ext_cn: 墙上挂着一个驼鹿头。某个爱搞笑的人在它的嘴里放了一支香烟。
ext.ext_en: There was a moose head on the wall. Some wag had put a cigarette in its mouth.

defs.def_en: A wag is someone who makes jokes.

ext.ext_cn: 这对伴侣年龄上的差异招来了不少闲话。
ext.ext_en: What set tongues wagging was the age difference between the two partners.

defs.def_en: If tongues are wagging, people are talking a lot about someone and their behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 计算机化的数据库正在激增。
ext.ext_en: Computerized data bases are proliferating fast...

ext.ext_cn: 近年来，欧洲和中国之间的商业、文化、旅游及其他交往发展迅猛。
ext.ext_en: In recent years commercial, cultural, travel and other contacts have proliferated between Europe and China.

defs.def_en: If things proliferate, they increase in number very quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 再见！一路顺风！
ext.ext_en: Goodbye! Bon voyage!

defs.def_en: You say 'bon voyage' to someone who is going on a journey, as a way of saying goodbye and wishing them good luck.

defs.def_cn: (为有特殊需要人群设立的)护理中心

ext.ext_cn: 敬老院
ext.ext_en: ...a residential care home for the elderly.

defs.def_en: A care home is a large house or institution where people with particular problems or special needs are looked after.

defs.def_cn: (某一国家或地区的)劳动力，劳动人口

ext.ext_cn: 有一半劳动力失业的国家
ext.ext_en: ...a country where half the workforce is unemployed.

defs.def_en: The workforce is the total number of people in a country or region who are physically able to do a job and are available for work.

defs.def_cn: (某公司的)全体员工，职工总数

ext.ext_cn: 雇用了大量员工的雇主
ext.ext_en: ...an employer of a very large workforce.

defs.def_en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company.
A trousseau is a collection of clothes and other possessions that a bride brings with her when she gets married.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 故意刁难的；蓄意阻挠的

ext.ext_cn: 史密斯先生故意刁难，就是不肯照章办事。
ext.ext_en: Mr Smith was obstructive and refused to follow correct procedure.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is being obstructive, you think that they are deliberately causing difficulties for other people.

ext.ext_cn: 他们是英国坚定的爱国者，并在公寓里挂着女王的肖像。
ext.ext_en: They were staunch British patriots and had portraits of the Queen in their flat.

defs.def_en: Someone who is a patriot loves their country and feels very loyal towards it.

ext.ext_cn: 他用右手抓住了一块凸起的岩石。
ext.ext_en: He grabbed at a protrusion of rock with his right hand.

defs.def_en: A protrusion is something that sticks out from something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在工作场所中残疾人所遇到的实际问题
ext.ext_en: ...practical problems encountered by disabled people in the workplace.

ext.ext_cn: 有残疾人士专用的卫生间设施。
ext.ext_en: There are toilet facilities for the disabled.

defs.def_en: Someone who is disabled has an illness, injury, or condition that tends to restrict the way that they can live their life, especially by making it difficult for them to move about.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们声称政府一直存心欺骗。
ext.ext_en: They claimed the government had been deceitful...

ext.ext_cn: 大使指称那份报告具有欺骗性和误导性。
ext.ext_en: The ambassador called the report deceitful and misleading.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is deceitful, you mean that they behave in a dishonest way by making other people believe something that is not true.
Streamers are long rolls of coloured paper used for decorating rooms at parties.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 亵渎神圣的;大不敬的;无礼的

ext.ext_cn: 很多教堂都被洗劫一空，而且作出了诸多渎神之举。
ext.ext_en: A number of churches were sacked and sacrilegious acts committed.

defs.def_en: If someone's behaviour or actions are sacrilegious, they show great disrespect towards something holy or towards something that people think should be respected.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你对我不诚实。
ext.ext_en: You have been dishonest with me...

ext.ext_cn: 不把数据尽可能如实公开并非诚信之举。
ext.ext_en: It would be dishonest not to present the data as fairly as possible.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or their behaviour is dishonest, you mean that they are not truthful or honest and that you cannot trust them.

ext.ext_cn: 格拉斯哥市居民
ext.ext_en: ...the inhabitants of Glasgow.

defs.def_en: The inhabitants of a place are the people who live there.

ext.ext_cn: 已经日上三竿。
ext.ext_en: The sun is already high in the sky.

ext.ext_cn: 温暖的阳光和蔚蓝的晴空
ext.ext_en: ...warm sunshine and clear blue skies...

defs.def_en: The sky is the space around the earth which you can see when you stand outside and look upwards.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (手段)非暴力的，不诉诸武力的

ext.ext_cn: 金是全世界非暴力抗议种族不平等运动的象征。
ext.ext_en: King was a worldwide symbol of non-violent protest against racial injustice...

ext.ext_cn: 我只会投身明确宣称采用非暴力手段的环境保护运动。
ext.ext_en: I would only belong to an environmental movement if it was explicitly non-violent.

defs.def_en: Non-violent methods of bringing about change do not involve hurting people or causing damage.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (犯罪等)不使用暴力的，不伤害他人的

ext.ext_cn: 非暴力犯罪的罪犯
ext.ext_en: ...non-violent offenders...

ext.ext_cn: 种种迹象表明选举将会是非暴力的、公正的。
ext.ext_en: The signs suggest that the elections will be non-violent and fair.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone or something such as a crime as non-violent when that person or thing does not hurt or injure people.

defs.def_cn: （派士兵或飞机）侦察；（用卫星）搜索，勘测

ext.ext_cn: 直升机完成侦察任务后正在返航。
ext.ext_en: The helicopter was returning from a reconnaissance mission...

ext.ext_cn: 这架飞机将用于执行侦察任务而不是战斗任务。
ext.ext_en: The aircraft will be used for reconnaissance rather than combat.

defs.def_en: Reconnaissance is the activity of obtaining military information about a place by sending soldiers or planes there, or by the use of satellites.
A flywheel is a heavy wheel that is part of some engines. It regulates the engine's rotation, making it operate at a steady speed.

defs.def_cn: (电影、戏剧或电视节目的)配乐
defs.def_en: In a film, play, or television programme, incidental music is music that is played to create a particular atmosphere.

defs.def_cn: 叫;称呼;将…命名;给…起名字

ext.ext_cn: 不知怎么的,我老想把这条狗唤作穆夫提。
ext.ext_en: I always wanted to call the dog Mufty for some reason...

ext.ext_cn: “大夫…”——“就叫我萨拉好了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Doctor...' — 'Will you please call me Sarah?'...

defs.def_en: If you call someone or something by a particular name or title, you give them that name or title.

ext.ext_cn: 演说被保守党人士打断,他们称他是叛徒。
ext.ext_en: The speech was interrupted by members of the Conservative Party, who called him a traitor...

ext.ext_cn: 我不觉得这是负担;我觉得它是一种责任。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't call it a burden; I call it a responsibility...

defs.def_en: If you call someone or something a particular thing, you suggest they are that thing or describe them as that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他听到其他人从楼下不同地方喊他的名字。
ext.ext_en: He could hear the others downstairs in different parts of the house calling his name...

ext.ext_cn: “小子们!”她又叫道。
ext.ext_en: 'Boys!' she called again.

defs.def_en: If you call something, you say it in a loud voice, because you are trying to attract someone's attention.

ext.ext_cn: 你一弄清楚了就给我打电话好吗?
ext.ext_en: Would you call me as soon as you find out?...

ext.ext_cn: 一个朋友要我打这个号码。
ext.ext_en: A friend of mine gave me this number to call...

defs.def_en: If you call someone, you telephone them.

ext.ext_cn: 他尖叫着让他老婆打电话叫救护车。
ext.ext_en: He screamed for his wife to call an ambulance...

ext.ext_cn: 一天夜里,有人打来电话,请他去给一位患肺结核的妇女看病。
ext.ext_en: One night he was called to see a woman with tuberculosis.

defs.def_en: If you call someone such as a doctor or the police, you ask them to come to you, usually by telephoning them.

ext.ext_cn: 她喊她的小儿子:“喂,斯蒂芬,过来看看这个!”
ext.ext_en: She called her young son: 'Here, Stephen, come and look at this!'...

ext.ext_cn: 他用天朗扩音器喊我。
ext.ext_en: He called me over the Tannoy.

defs.def_en: If you call someone, you ask them to come to you by shouting to them.

ext.ext_cn: 我打电话给美国的一个朋友。
ext.ext_en: I made a phone call to the United States to talk to a friend...

ext.ext_cn: 我已经接到了其他受害人打来的上百个电话。
ext.ext_en: I've had hundreds of calls from other victims...

defs.def_en: When you make a telephone call, you telephone someone.

defs.def_cn: 召集(会议、排练等);宣布举行(选举等)

ext.ext_cn: 委员会决定召开国大党会议。
ext.ext_en: The Committee decided to call a meeting of the All India Congress...

ext.ext_cn: 皇家莎士比亚剧团要召开新闻发布会,宣布剧院关闭。
ext.ext_en: The RSC was calling a press conference to announce the theatre's closure...

defs.def_en: If someone in authority calls something such as a meeting, rehearsal, or election, they arrange for it to take place at a particular time.

ext.ext_cn: 小女孩等了两个小时才被传唤进去作证。
ext.ext_en: The child waited two hours before she was called to give evidence...

ext.ext_cn: 我作为专家证人被传唤出庭。
ext.ext_en: I was called as an expert witness.

defs.def_en: If someone is called before a court or committee, they are ordered to appear there, usually to give evidence.

ext.ext_cn: 一位市场调查人员造访了他的住处。
ext.ext_en: A market researcher called at the house where he was living...

ext.ext_cn: 现在安德鲁几乎每星期都来。
ext.ext_en: Andrew now came almost weekly to call.

defs.def_en: If you call somewhere, you make a short visit there.

defs.def_cn: (火车、公共汽车、船舶)停靠,停留

ext.ext_cn: 一路上,汽船在好几个港口停靠。
ext.ext_en: The steamer calls at several ports along the way.

defs.def_en: When a train, bus, or ship calls somewhere, it stops there for a short time to allow people to get on or off.

ext.ext_cn: 系列赛第二场在十局过后,双方战成3比3平，此时由于天黑,比赛取消。
ext.ext_en: The second game of the series had ended in a 3-3 tie after ten innings when the game was called on account of darkness...

ext.ext_cn: 我们取消了下一场比赛。
ext.ext_en: We called the next game.

defs.def_en: To call a game or sporting event means to cancel it, for example because of rain or bad light.

ext.ext_cn: 不少人呼吁出台新的安全措施。
ext.ext_en: There have been calls for a new kind of security arrangement...

ext.ext_cn: 工会号召工人在罢工期间呆在家里,几乎所有工人都响应了这一号召。
ext.ext_en: Almost all workers heeded a call by the trade unions to stay at home for the duration of the strike.

defs.def_en: If there is a call for something, someone demands that it should happen.

ext.ext_cn: “你们有纯巧克力吗?”——“没有,恐怕那东西没几个人要。”
ext.ext_en: 'Have you got just plain chocolate?' — 'No, I'm afraid there's not much call for that.'

defs.def_en: If there is little or no call for something, very few people want it to be done or provided.

ext.ext_cn: 新鲜事物的魅力一定让你兴奋不已。
ext.ext_en: You must be feeling exhilarated by the call of the new.

defs.def_en: The call of something such as a place is the way it attracts or interests you strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 鲸的哀鸣
ext.ext_en: ...the plaintive call of a whale.

ext.ext_cn: 各种各样的鸟兽叫声
ext.ext_en: ...a wide range of animal noises and bird calls.

defs.def_en: The call of a particular bird or animal is the characteristic sound that it makes.

ext.ext_cn: 凭什么最好的房产尽着他们先挑?
ext.ext_en: Why should they get first call on the best property?

defs.def_en: If you have first call on something, you will be asked before anyone else whether you want to buy or use it.

ext.ext_cn: 这么多人中，他不该专挑你。
ext.ext_en: There was no call for him to single you out from all the others.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is no call for someone to behave in a particular way, you are criticizing their behaviour, usually because you think it is rude.

defs.def_cn: 随时待命的;随叫随到的

ext.ext_cn: 从理论上说,我现在昼夜待命。
ext.ext_en: In theory I'm on call day and night.

ext.ext_cn: 随叫随到的医生
ext.ext_en: ...a doctor on call.

defs.def_en: If someone is on call, they are ready to go to work at any time if they are needed, especially if there is an emergency.

ext.ext_cn: “你今天不是应该上班的吗?”“我打电话请过病假了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Shouldn't you be at work today?' — 'I called in sick.'

defs.def_en: If you call in sick, you telephone the place where you work to tell them you will not be coming to work because you are ill.

ext.ext_cn: 聪明的黑发青年
ext.ext_en: ...a smart, dark-haired, youngish man.

defs.def_en: A youngish person is fairly young

defs.def_cn: 来自同一养马场的赛马

ext.ext_cn: 马夫长负责确保密尔顿及其他来自同一养马场的赛马都安全到达。
ext.ext_en: The head groom is responsible for seeing that Milton and his stablemates have safe journeys.

defs.def_en: Stablemates are race horses that come from the same stables and often compete against each other.

defs.def_cn: 同一组织的人;同一公司生产的产品

ext.ext_cn: 明天他将迎战同是台球大师俱乐部出道的球手。
ext.ext_en: Tomorrow he will play his Cuemasters stablemate.

defs.def_en: A person's stablemate is someone who is managed by the same organization. A product's stablemate is something which is produced by the same company.

defs.def_cn: (议会中代表某一地区的)议员(常用其缩略形式 MP)
defs.def_en: A Member of Parliament is a person who has been elected by the people in a particular area to represent them in a country's parliament. The abbreviation MP is often used.  →see usage note at:government

defs.def_cn: （飞机、飞船等的）商载，有酬载荷

ext.ext_cn: 客载量这么大，有一个问题非常突出——安全。
ext.ext_en: With these very large passenger payloads one question looms above all others — safety.

defs.def_en: The payload of an aircraft or spacecraft is the amount or weight of things or people that it is carrying.

defs.def_cn: （导弹等武器的）有效载荷，炸药量

ext.ext_cn: 能够向极远射程发射具有超强爆炸力的炮弹的超高速炮
ext.ext_en: ...a hypervelocity gun capable of delivering substantial payloads to extreme ranges.

defs.def_en: The payload of a missile or similar weapon is the quantity of explosives it contains.

defs.def_cn: （认为某事道义上正确，尤用于提出或征求建议或意见）应当，应该

ext.ext_cn: 马克，你娶了个好妻子，应该好好待她。
ext.ext_en: Mark, you've got a good wife. You ought to take care of her...

ext.ext_cn: 已经有点钱财或土地的人应当对其走向有发言权。
ext.ext_en: The people who already own a bit of money or land ought to have a voice in saying where it goes...

defs.def_en: You use ought to to mean that it is morally right to do a particular thing or that it is morally right for a particular situation to exist, especially when giving or asking for advice or opinions.

defs.def_cn: （认为某事可行或重要，尤用于提出或征求建议或意见）应当，应该

ext.ext_cn: 你不必单独跟他呆在一起，而且我认为你也不该这样。
ext.ext_en: You don't have to be alone with him and I don't think you ought to be...

ext.ext_cn: 你应当征求一下律师的意见。
ext.ext_en: You ought to ask a lawyer's advice...

defs.def_en: You use ought to when saying that you think it is a good idea and important for you or someone else to do a particular thing, especially when giving or asking for advice or opinions.

defs.def_cn: （认为某事确实，或预计某事发生或已经发生）应该/应该已经

ext.ext_cn: “这应该会很有趣！”他对亚历克斯说，两眼闪闪发光。
ext.ext_en: 'This ought to be fun,' he told Alex, eyes gleaming.

defs.def_en: You use ought to to indicate that you expect something to be true or to happen. You use ought to have to indicate that you expect something to have happened already.

defs.def_cn: （表示某事本应如此，但实际情况未必）应该

ext.ext_cn: 社会民主党按理应该最有希望赢得这次选举，但一切从未如此不确定过。
ext.ext_en: By rights the Social Democrats ought to be the favourites in the election. But nothing looks less certain...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然这让他们感觉良好，但他们其实应该为此担心。
ext.ext_en: Though this gives them a nice feeling, it really ought to worry them.

defs.def_en: You use ought to to indicate that you think that something should be the case, but might not be.

defs.def_cn: （表示从已知情况推测某事已经发生，但不确定）应该

ext.ext_cn: 他应该早就到房子那儿了。
ext.ext_en: He ought to have reached the house some time ago.

defs.def_en: You use ought to to indicate that you think that something has happened because of what you know about the situation, but you are not certain.

defs.def_cn: （与过去分词连用，表示预期的事未发生或预计的情况并非如此）本该，本当

ext.ext_cn: 其实这套系统本应发挥作用的。
ext.ext_en: Basically the system ought to have worked...

ext.ext_cn: 建设电站的资金本该足够了。
ext.ext_en: The money to build the power station ought to have been sufficient.

defs.def_en: You use ought to have with a past participle to indicate that something was expected to happen or be the case, but it did not happen or was not the case.

defs.def_cn: （与过去分词连用，表示未做本应该做的事情）本该，本当

ext.ext_cn: 我意识到自己本该把这件事告诉你的。
ext.ext_en: I realize I ought to have told you about it...

ext.ext_cn: 也许我们本当对人多一些信任的。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps we ought to have trusted people more...

defs.def_en: You use ought to have with a past participle to indicate that although it was best or correct for someone to do something in the past, they did not actually do it.

defs.def_cn: （礼貌地告知某人自己必须做某事）该，得

ext.ext_cn: 现在我真得回去了。
ext.ext_en: I really ought to be getting back now...

ext.ext_cn: 我想我该走了。
ext.ext_en: I think I ought to go.

defs.def_en: You use ought to when politely telling someone that you must do something, for example that you must leave.

defs.def_cn: 老处女，老姑娘（可能具冒犯意味）

ext.ext_cn: 亚历克丝认为自己是个老姑娘的想法还太早了点。
ext.ext_en: Alex is too young to be already thinking of herself as an old maid.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to an old or middle-aged woman as an old maid when she has never married and they think that it is unlikely that she ever will marry. This use could cause offence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 失血过多会导致你疲劳并且贫血。
ext.ext_en: Losing a lot of blood makes you tired and anaemic.

defs.def_en: Someone who is anaemic suffers from anaemia.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无力的;无生气的;委顿衰弱的

ext.ext_cn: 我们将看到经济有所复苏，但这种复苏将是非常无力的。
ext.ext_en: We will see some economic recovery, but it will be very anaemic...

ext.ext_cn: 他们坚持要比淡而无味的英国货味道更好的巧克力。
ext.ext_en: They insist on tastier chocolate than the anaemic British stuff.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as anaemic, you mean that it is not as strong or effective as you think it should be.

ext.ext_cn: 他从来不擅长独立创作。
ext.ext_en: Originality was never his forte.

defs.def_en: You can say that a particular activity is your forte if you are very good at it.
A piece of music that is played forte is played loudly.

defs.def_cn: (当明确指代单数主语时，用以代替 themselves;有人认为这种用法不对)

ext.ext_cn: 没有人认为自己能做主雇用这样一个人。
ext.ext_en: No one perceived themself to be in a position to hire such a man.

ext.ext_cn: 如果那个人自己不同意我和他的医生交谈
ext.ext_en: ...if the person themself wouldn't give me the permission to talk to their GP.

defs.def_en: Themself is sometimes used instead of 'themselves' when it clearly refers to a singular subject. Some people consider this use to be incorrect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这座房子有一个宽敞的厨房和用餐区。
ext.ext_en: The house has a spacious kitchen and dining area.

defs.def_en: A spacious room or other place is large in size or area, so that you can move around freely in it.

ext.ext_cn: 随春风摇曳的新栽小树
ext.ext_en: ...newly planted saplings swaying gently in the spring breeze.

defs.def_en: A sapling is a young tree.

defs.def_cn: 富豪（或财阀）统治的国家；富豪（或财阀）统治阶级

ext.ext_cn: 在富豪当政的国家里，人们见利忘义。
ext.ext_en: Financial, not moral, considerations will prevail in a plutocracy.

defs.def_en: A plutocracy is a country which is ruled by its wealthiest people, or a class of wealthy people who rule a country.

ext.ext_cn: 让人们意识到抑郁症不仅仅是心情忧郁，这点似乎很重要。
ext.ext_en: It seems important to sensitize people to the fact that depression is more than the blues...

ext.ext_cn: 在男性占主导地位的法庭上，有多少法官对妇女问题是比较敏感的呢？
ext.ext_en: How many judges in our male-dominated courts are sensitized to women's issues?

defs.def_en: If you sensitize people to a particular problem or situation, you make them aware of it.

defs.def_cn: 使对…有反应;使敏化;使过敏

ext.ext_cn: 皮肤很容易受到刺激、发生皴裂、擦得红肿和出现过敏。
ext.ext_en: Skin is easily irritated, chapped, chafed, and sensitized.

ext.ext_cn: 变得敏感的神经末梢
ext.ext_en: ...sensitised nerve endings.

defs.def_en: If a substance is sensitized to something such as light or touch, it is made sensitive to it.
A newspaperman is a journalist, especially a man, who works for a newspaper.

ext.ext_cn: 她患有贫血症，甚至需要输血。
ext.ext_en: She suffered from anaemia and even required blood transfusions.

defs.def_en: Anaemia is a medical condition in which there are too few red cells in your blood, causing you to feel tired and look pale.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一位男子模糊不清的照片
ext.ext_en: ...a blurry picture of a man.

defs.def_en: A blurry shape is one that has an unclear outline.

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩安坐在柜台后。
ext.ext_en: Brian was ensconced behind the bar...

ext.ext_cn: 她看了看梅尔维尔小姐，她正舒适地安坐在新朋友中间。
ext.ext_en: She looked at Miss Melville, snugly ensconced among her new friends.

defs.def_en: If you are ensconced somewhere, you are settled there firmly or comfortably and have no intention of moving or leaving.
A tap dancer is a dancer who does tap dancing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人)自相矛盾的，前后不一致的，反复无常的

ext.ext_cn: 一个相当反复无常的家伙
ext.ext_en: ...a rather schizoid fellow.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as schizoid, you mean that they seem to have very different opinions and purposes at different times.

ext.ext_cn: 精神分裂型人格
ext.ext_en: ...a schizoid personality.

defs.def_en: Someone who is schizoid suffers from schizophrenia.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 颇为生气的；很不高兴的
defs.def_en: If you are feeling pigged off, you feel rather angry or unhappy.

ext.ext_cn: 我不想在这无聊的乡下干这样的工作，我不想呆在这里了。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to stay here, in this job and in this God-forsaken country.

defs.def_en: If you say that somewhere is a godforsaken place, you dislike it a lot because you find it very boring and depressing.
A wet suit is a close-fitting rubber suit which an underwater swimmer wears in order to keep their body warm.
A serum is a liquid that is injected into someone's blood to protect them against a poison or disease.
Serum is the watery, pale yellow part of blood.
A camshaft is a rod in an engine and works to change circular motion into motion up and down or from side to side.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们站立不稳，协调性较差。
ext.ext_en: They were unsteady on their feet and rather uncoordinated.

ext.ext_cn: 蹒跚学步的小孩
ext.ext_en: ...an uncoordinated toddler.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as uncoordinated you mean that their movements are not smooth or controlled.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行动、计划）组织不力的，未协调好的

ext.ext_cn: 政府行动半心半意，组织不力。
ext.ext_en: Government action has been half-hearted and uncoordinated.

ext.ext_cn: 敌方拖沓迟缓、组织乏力、全无章法的反应
ext.ext_en: ...late, uncoordinated and piecemeal enemy responses.

defs.def_en: If you describe actions or plans as uncoordinated, you mean they are not well-organized.

ext.ext_cn: 警察在大楼四周暗中巡查。
ext.ext_en: Policemen prowled around the building.

defs.def_en: If an animal or a person prowls around, they move around quietly, for example when they are hunting.

defs.def_cn: （动物）在觅食；（人）在寻找性伴侣（或生意）

ext.ext_cn: 他们的旅伴中有度蜜月的新人，有寻觅伴侣的单身女孩，也有老年夫妇。
ext.ext_en: Their fellow travellers are a mix of honeymooners, single girls on the prowl and elderly couples...

ext.ext_cn: 新政府在寻求削减开支的方法。
ext.ext_en: The new administration are on the prowl for ways to reduce spending.

defs.def_en: If an animal is on the prowl, it is hunting. If a person is on the prowl, they are hunting for something such as a sexual partner or a business deal.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 干净的;洁净的;无污迹的

ext.ext_cn: 他穿着他最干净的便裤，洁净的衬衫和藏青色上装。
ext.ext_en: He wore his cleanest slacks, a clean shirt and a navy blazer...

ext.ext_cn: 不必担心会生病，因为能喝上干净水。
ext.ext_en: Disease has not been a problem because clean water is available...

defs.def_en: Something that is clean is free from dirt or unwanted marks.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人或动物)讲卫生的，爱干净的
defs.def_en: You say that people or animals are clean when they keep themselves or their surroundings clean.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (燃料或化学作用)无害的，无污染的，清洁的

ext.ext_cn: 电动汽车迷们说，电动车清洁、无噪音而且经济。
ext.ext_en: Fans of electric cars say they are clean, quiet and economical.

defs.def_en: A clean fuel or chemical process does not create many harmful or polluting substances.

ext.ext_cn: 她父亲用纸巾把眼镜擦干净。
ext.ext_en: Her father cleaned his glasses with a paper napkin...

ext.ext_cn: 花了半个钟头才把浴缸上的柑橘粉擦洗掉。
ext.ext_en: It took half an hour to clean the orange powder off the bath...

defs.def_en: If you clean something or clean dirt off it, you make it free from dirt and unwanted marks, for example by washing or wiping it. If something cleans easily, it is easy to clean.

ext.ext_cn: 和他们同住的还有玛丽·伯琳达，她负责做饭和打扫卫生。
ext.ext_en: With them also lived Mary Burinda, who cooked and cleaned...

ext.ext_cn: 她早早就起了床，把公寓打扫干净。
ext.ext_en: She got up early and cleaned the flat.

defs.def_en: If you clean a room or house, you make the inside of it and the furniture in it free from dirt and dust.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (书籍、笑话、生活方式)文明的，不淫秽的，不下流的

ext.ext_cn: 他们尽量播放文明、健康、正派的电影。
ext.ext_en: They're trying to show clean, wholesome, decent movies...

ext.ext_cn: 打情骂俏无伤大雅，还别有一番趣味。
ext.ext_en: Flirting is good clean fun...

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a book, joke, or lifestyle as clean, you think that they are not sexually immoral or offensive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 避税的指控使他的清白形象蒙污。
ext.ext_en: Accusations of tax evasion have tarnished his clean image...

ext.ext_cn: 只要你的驾照没有违规记录，就可以从多数租车公司租到这些车。
ext.ext_en: You can hire these from most car hire firms, provided you have a clean driving licence.

defs.def_en: If someone has a clean reputation or record, they have never done anything illegal or wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (比赛或打斗)无舞弊行为的，公平的，不违规的

ext.ext_cn: 他呼吁选举中进行公平竞争，结束“负面竞选”。
ext.ext_en: He called for a clean fight in the election and an end to 'negative campaigning'...

ext.ext_cn: 比赛没有舞弊行为，裁判很公正。
ext.ext_en: It was a clean match, well refereed.

defs.def_en: A clean game or fight is carried out fairly, according to the rules.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (口味、气味或色彩)淡雅的，清新的，明快的

ext.ext_cn: 大海清新舒爽的气味
ext.ext_en: ...the fresh, clean smell of the sea...

ext.ext_cn: 蓝色和灰色的柔和色调营造出明快、亮丽的视觉感观。
ext.ext_en: Soft tones of blue and grey create a clean, bright look.

defs.def_en: If you describe a flavour, smell, or colour as clean, you like it because it is light and fresh.

ext.ext_cn: 拿张白纸，在左下方列个单子。
ext.ext_en: Take a clean sheet of paper and down the left-hand side make a list.

defs.def_en: A clean sheet of paper has no writing or drawing on it.

ext.ext_cn: 她想和父母一刀两断。
ext.ext_en: She wanted to make a clean break from her mother and father.

defs.def_en: If you make a clean break or start, you end a situation completely and start again in a different way.

ext.ext_cn: 它把我工装裤屁股那块烧透了。
ext.ext_en: It burned clean through the seat of my overalls...

ext.ext_cn: 那个贼拿着钱逃之夭夭了。
ext.ext_en: The thief got clean away with the money...

defs.def_en: Clean is used to emphasize that something was done completely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (形状)规则的，简洁的，边缘平滑的

ext.ext_cn: 他欣赏夏克家具流畅的线条。
ext.ext_en: He admires the clean lines of Shaker furniture...

ext.ext_cn: 钻头必须缓慢转动，以保证钻孔平整光滑。
ext.ext_en: The drill should be slowly rotated to ensure a clean hole.

defs.def_en: A clean shape is simple and regular, with definite, smooth edges.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (动作)干脆利落的，快速无误的

ext.ext_cn: 他们更加关心那些狗的安危，而非自己如何干净利落地脱身。
ext.ext_en: They were more concerned about the dogs' welfare than a clean getaway...

ext.ext_cn: 此前，保罗逮捕过无数个这样的家伙，他估计这次能手到擒来。
ext.ext_en: Paul had arrested countless men like this one before and was expecting a clean, quick job.

defs.def_en: You can describe an action as clean to indicate that it is carried out simply and quickly without mistakes.

ext.ext_cn: 你最好一五一十地告诉她，让她知道她正在交往的那个男人是个什么货色。
ext.ext_en: It would be better if you come clean about it and let her know what kind of man she is seeing.

defs.def_en: If you come clean about something that you have been keeping secret, you admit it or tell people about it.

ext.ext_cn: 卢克的回应就是把她的肩头抓得更紧了。
ext.ext_en: Luke answered by tightening his grip on her shoulder...

ext.ext_cn: 她充满感激，把他的脖子搂得更紧了。
ext.ext_en: Her arms tightened about his neck in gratitude...

defs.def_en: If you tighten your grip on something, or if your grip tightens, you hold the thing more firmly or securely.

ext.ext_cn: 那个压阵队员使尽了全身力气往后拽，把绳子拉得紧紧的。
ext.ext_en: The anchorman flung his whole weight back, tightening the rope...

ext.ext_cn: 缆绳绷紧了，他被慢慢地吊离了甲板。
ext.ext_en: The cables tightened and he was lifted gradually from the deck.

defs.def_en: If you tighten a rope or chain, or if it tightens, it is stretched or pulled hard until it is straight.

ext.ext_cn: 他清楚有相当多的人支持他对中央政府机构加强控制的计划。
ext.ext_en: He knows he has considerable support for his plans to tighten his grip on the machinery of central government...

ext.ext_cn: 随着后来几年那个政权加强对大陆的控制，又有数十万人逃往南方。
ext.ext_en: As the regime's grip on the mainland tightened over the next few years, hundreds of thousands more people fled south.

defs.def_en: If a government or organization tightens its grip on a group of people or an activity, or if its grip tightens, it begins to have more control over it.

defs.def_cn: 拧紧，旋紧(螺钉、螺丝帽等)

ext.ext_cn: 我用拇指指甲把台灯上的螺钉拧紧了。
ext.ext_en: I used my thumbnail to tighten the screw on my lamp...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的螺钉都拧紧了。
ext.ext_en: All the bolts were fully tightened.

defs.def_en: When you tighten a screw, nut, or other device, you turn it or move it so that it is more firmly in place or holds something more firmly.

defs.def_cn: (身体局部)变僵硬，产生憋闷感，产生阻塞感

ext.ext_cn: 索菲娅喉咙哽住了，说不出话来。
ext.ext_en: Sofia's throat had tightened and she couldn't speak...

ext.ext_cn: 她看见他的下巴绷紧，脸色煞白。
ext.ext_en: She saw his jaw tighten and his face lose its colour.

defs.def_en: If a part of your body tightens, the muscles in it become tense and stiff, for example because you are angry or afraid.

defs.def_cn: 使(规定、政策、制度)更加严格；使更加有效

ext.ext_cn: 美国计划加大现有经济制裁的力度。
ext.ext_en: The United States plans to tighten the economic sanctions currently in place...

ext.ext_cn: 他们加强了边境的安全工作。
ext.ext_en: They have tightened security along the border...

defs.def_en: If someone in authority tightens a rule, a policy, or a system, they make it stricter or more efficient.

ext.ext_cn: 埃塞克斯郡布伦特里小镇的周六之夜
ext.ext_en: ...Saturday night in the small town of Braintree, Essex...

ext.ext_cn: 在市镇中心停车可能会挺费事。
ext.ext_en: Parking can be tricky in the town centre.

defs.def_en: A town is a place with many streets and buildings, where people live and work. Towns are larger than villages and smaller than cities. Many places that are called towns in Britain would be called cities in the United States.

ext.ext_cn: 他承认自己甚至不知道弟弟什么时候来了本市。
ext.ext_en: He admits he doesn't even know when his brother is in town...

ext.ext_cn: 她离开了自己生活的城镇。
ext.ext_en: She left town.

defs.def_en: You use town in order to refer to the town where you live.

defs.def_cn: 市中心;(城镇的)商业中心；闹市区

ext.ext_cn: 我在市中心逛了逛。
ext.ext_en: I walked around town...

ext.ext_cn: 我赶上辆公交车去了市中心。
ext.ext_en: I caught a bus into town.

defs.def_en: You use town in order to refer to the central area of a town where most of the shops and offices are.

ext.ext_cn: 更多的人将会想要逃离城市到乡村去。
ext.ext_en: More people are going to want to escape from the town into the country…

ext.ext_cn: 它兼具都市与乡村的优势。
ext.ext_en: It had the advantages of town and country combined.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the town, you are referring to town and city areas in general, as opposed to country areas.

defs.def_cn: 满腔热情地干;拼命地干

ext.ext_cn: 我们下了真功夫，把它办成了一场内容丰富、为时三天的展览。
ext.ext_en: We really went to town on it, turning it into a full, three-day show...

ext.ext_cn: 报纸抓住这件事大做文章。
ext.ext_en: The papers got hold of it and went to town on it…

defs.def_en: If you say that someone goes to town on something, you mean that they deal with it with a lot of enthusiasm or intensity.

defs.def_cn: 社交忙人;花花公子/时髦女郎

ext.ext_cn: 他以高大英俊的花花公子形象为人所知。
ext.ext_en: He was known as a tall, handsome man about town…

ext.ext_cn: 他是萨拉的旧情人，是她作为单身时髦女郎时的旧爱。
ext.ext_en: He is an old flame of Sarah's, from her days as a single girl about town.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a man about town or a woman about town, you mean that they are sophisticated, like to go out and spend money, and have a busy social life.

ext.ext_cn: 我过去对奢侈的概念是夜晚在闹市通宵玩乐到清晨才回来。
ext.ext_en: My idea of luxury used to be going out on the town and coming back in the early hours of the morning...

ext.ext_cn: 上个星期六我和老友晚上去闹市玩乐了。
ext.ext_en: Last Saturday, I was out on the town with my mate…

defs.def_en: If you go out on the town or go for a night on the town, you enjoy yourself by going to a town centre in the evening and spending a long time there visiting several places of entertainment.

defs.def_cn: (对不知其姓名的男士或上级的尊称)先生，长官

ext.ext_cn: 先生，请您告诉我那是什么类型的车好吗？
ext.ext_en: Excuse me sir, but would you mind telling me what sort of car that is?...

ext.ext_cn: 下午好，先生。
ext.ext_en: Good afternoon to you, sir.

defs.def_en: People sometimes say sir as a very formal and polite way of addressing a man whose name they do not know or a man of superior rank. For example, a shop assistant might address a male customer as sir .

defs.def_cn: (用于爵士或准男爵的姓名前)爵士

ext.ext_cn: 她把我引见给了托拜厄斯爵士和克拉克夫人。
ext.ext_en: She introduced me to Sir Tobias and Lady Clarke.

defs.def_en: Sir is the title used in front of the name of a knight or baronet.

defs.def_cn: (正式信函或商务信函开头的称呼语)先生，阁下(写信给某组织时使用 Dear sirs)

ext.ext_cn: 尊敬的先生，您 10 月 9 日的来信已转交我处。
ext.ext_en: Dear Sir, Your letter of the 9th October has been referred to us.

defs.def_en: You use the expression Dear sir at the beginning of a formal letter or a business letter when you are writing to a man. You use Dear sirs when you are writing to an organization.

defs.def_cn: 人类免疫缺陷病毒;艾滋病病毒
defs.def_en: HIV is a virus which reduces people's resistance to illness and can cause AIDS. HIV is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'hu-man immunodeficiency virus'.

defs.def_cn: 艾滋病病毒检测呈阳性的/阴性的
defs.def_en: If someone is HIV positive, they are infected with the HIV virus, and may develop AIDS. If someone is HIV negative, they are not infected with the virus.
An anesthetist is a nurse or other person who gives an anaesthetic to a patient.

ext.ext_cn: 湿地失水干裂的严重后果
ext.ext_en: ...the disastrous consequences of the desiccation of the wetland.

defs.def_en: Desiccation is the process of becoming completely dried out.

ext.ext_cn: 雌性与雄性配对时，雌性不允许其他雄性与之交配。
ext.ext_en: During the time she is paired to a male, the female allows no other males to copulate with her...

ext.ext_cn: 鲸交配需要24小时。
ext.ext_en: Whales take twenty-four hours to copulate.

defs.def_en: If one animal or person copulates with another, they have sex. You can also say that two animals or people copulate.
You can refer to the owners or senior managers of industrial companies as captains of industry .

defs.def_cn: （船舶上用的）吊杆式起货设备
defs.def_en: A derrick is a machine that is used to move cargo on a ship by lifting it in the air.
A derrick is a tower built over an oil well which is used to raise and lower the drill.
A piccolo is a small musical instrument that is like a flute but produces higher notes.

ext.ext_cn: 我对所有这些药物的危险性了如指掌。
ext.ext_en: I've read up on the dangers of all these drugs.

defs.def_en: If you read up on a subject, you read a lot about it so that you become informed about it.

ext.ext_cn: 压蒜器
ext.ext_en: ...a garlic crusher.

ext.ext_cn: 40吨的碎石机
ext.ext_en: ...a 40-ton stone crusher.

defs.def_en: A crusher is a piece of equipment used for crushing things.

defs.def_cn: 不充分的;不足的;缺乏的

ext.ext_cn: 他认定证据不充分无法提起刑事诉讼。
ext.ext_en: He decided there was insufficient evidence to justify criminal proceedings...

ext.ext_cn: 这些努力不足以抑制迅速扩散的危机。
ext.ext_en: These efforts were insufficient to contain the burgeoning crisis.

defs.def_en: Something that is insufficient is not large enough in amount or degree for a particular purpose.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一定要挑选硬实但已成熟的水果。
ext.ext_en: Always choose firm, but ripe fruit.

ext.ext_cn: 成熟的麦田
ext.ext_en: ...fields of ripe wheat.

defs.def_en: Ripe fruit or grain is fully grown and ready to eat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 霍乱即将暴发。
ext.ext_en: Conditions were ripe for an outbreak of cholera...

ext.ext_cn: 发生社会变革的时机已经成熟。
ext.ext_en: This society is ripe for change.

defs.def_en: If a situation is ripe for a particular development or event, you mean that development or event is likely to happen soon.

ext.ext_cn: 他活到了95岁高龄。
ext.ext_en: He lived to the ripe old age of 95.

defs.def_en: If someone lives to a ripe old age, they live until they are very old.

defs.def_cn: 唾手可得;得到…易如反掌

ext.ext_cn: 黑格传达的意思是说胜利唾手可得。
ext.ext_en: Haig's message was that victory was ripe for picking.

defs.def_en: If something is ripe for picking or ripe for plucking, it will be very easy to obtain.

ext.ext_cn: 他告诉记者他认为是时候恢复两国间正常关系。
ext.ext_en: He told reporters that he thought the time was ripe for a normalisation of relations...

ext.ext_cn: 英国外交部作出决定现在可以向该地区派驻第一位女大使。
ext.ext_en: The British Foreign Office has decided the time is ripe to send its first female ambassador to the region.

defs.def_en: If you say the time is ripe, you mean that a suitable time has arrived for something to be done.

defs.def_cn: 使省悟;使消除（错误观点）

ext.ext_cn: 他们认为乡下人爱讨好陌生人，对此观点我并未予以纠正。
ext.ext_en: Their view of country people was that they like to please strangers. I did not disabuse them of this notion.

defs.def_en: If you disabuse someone of something, you tell them or persuade them that what they believe is in fact untrue.
The women's room is a toilet for women in a public building.

ext.ext_cn: 溃疡的嘴巴
ext.ext_en: ...ulcerated mouths...

ext.ext_cn: 他四肢全都溃烂了。
ext.ext_en: Every inch of his arms and legs was ulcerated.

defs.def_en: If a part of someone's body is ulcerated, ulcers have developed on it.

defs.def_cn: 思想体系的;意识形态的;观念形态的

ext.ext_cn: 其他人由于意识形态原因而脱党。
ext.ext_en: Others left the party for ideological reasons...

ext.ext_cn: 政党之间的意识形态界线并不总是泾渭分明的。
ext.ext_en: The ideological divisions between the parties aren't always obvious.

defs.def_en: Ideological means relating to principles or beliefs.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 即使是轻度超重也会增加患高血压的风险。
ext.ext_en: Being even moderately overweight increases your risk of developing high blood pressure.

ext.ext_cn: 过胖的中年农妇
ext.ext_en: ...a middle-aged, overweight farmer's wife.

defs.def_en: Someone who is overweight weighs more than is considered healthy or attractive.  →see usage note at:fat

defs.def_cn: 巨大的;奇大无比的;举足轻重的

ext.ext_cn: 就在她离开之前，我们大吵了一架。
ext.ext_en: We had a humongous row just before she left...

ext.ext_cn: 芭芭拉·史翠珊是个天后级巨星。
ext.ext_en: Barbra Streisand is such a humungous star.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as humongous, you are emphasizing that they are very large or important.

ext.ext_cn: 吃早饭的时候他已坐在书桌前了。
ext.ext_en: By breakfast-time he was already at his desk.

defs.def_en: Breakfast time is the period of the morning when most people have their breakfast.

ext.ext_cn: 莫斯科首要的外交政策智囊团
ext.ext_en: ...Moscow's leading foreign policy think-tank.

defs.def_en: A think-tank is a group of experts who are gathered together by an organization, especially by a government, in order to consider various problems and try and work out ways to solve them.

defs.def_cn: 马毛（指马鬃或马尾毛，过去用作床垫及扶手椅等家具的填料）
defs.def_en: Horsehair is hair from the tails or manes of horses and was used in the past to fill mattresses and furniture such as armchairs.
A window frame is a frame around the edges of a window, which glass is fixed into.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 交通事故仍然是造成美国人过早死亡的头号因素。
ext.ext_en: Accidents are still the number one cause of premature death for Americans...

ext.ext_cn: 因为膝盖接二连三地受伤，他的职业生涯提前结束了。
ext.ext_en: His career was brought to a premature end by a succession of knee injuries.

defs.def_en: Something that is premature happens earlier than usual or earlier than people expect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不成熟的；过早的；草率的

ext.ext_cn: 现在看来他们高兴得太早了。
ext.ext_en: It now seems their optimism was premature...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为餐馆提出那样的建议太草率了。
ext.ext_en: I think it's premature for restaurants to come out with that advice.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is premature when it happens too early and is therefore inappropriate.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 即使是很小的早产儿也会对母亲的出现做出反应。
ext.ext_en: Even very young premature babies respond to their mother's presence...

ext.ext_cn: 我女儿埃玛出生时提前了两个半月。
ext.ext_en: When my daughter Emma was born she was two and a half months premature.

defs.def_en: A premature baby is one that was born before the date when it was expected to be born.

ext.ext_cn: 坐在 13 路公共汽车的顶层
ext.ext_en: ...sitting on the top deck of the number 13 bus.

ext.ext_cn: 有上下5层乘客舱的豪华游轮
ext.ext_en: ...a luxury liner with five passenger decks.

defs.def_en: See also:flight deck;A deck on a vehicle such as a bus or ship is a lower or upper area of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她站在甲板上挥手告别。
ext.ext_en: She stood on the deck and waved.

defs.def_en: The deck of a ship is the top part of it that forms a floor in the open air which you can walk on.

defs.def_cn: (录音机的)走带装置，匣仓;(唱机的)转盘支托面

ext.ext_cn: 我车里的磁带仓
ext.ext_en: ...the tape deck in my car...

ext.ext_cn: 我把一盘磁带放进带仓里。
ext.ext_en: I stuck a tape in the deck.

defs.def_en: A tape deck or record deck is a piece of equipment on which you play tapes or records.

ext.ext_cn: 马特把牌拢起来洗牌。
ext.ext_en: Matt picked up the cards and shuffled the deck.

defs.def_en: A deck of cards is a complete set of playing cards.

ext.ext_cn: 有一个天然的木制平台通到房子的客厅。
ext.ext_en: A natural timber deck leads into the main room of the home.

defs.def_en: A deck is a flat wooden area next to a house, where people can sit and relax or eat.

ext.ext_cn: 村民用彩旗装饰街道。
ext.ext_en: Villagers decked the streets with bunting...

ext.ext_cn: 房子里装点着鲜花。
ext.ext_en: The house was decked with flowers.

defs.def_en: If something is decked with pretty things, it is decorated with them.

ext.ext_cn: 我听说你一拳把他打倒在地，吓得他那些狐朋狗友屁滚尿流。
ext.ext_en: I hear you decked him and scared the hell out of his buddies.

defs.def_en: If someone decks you, they hit you so that you fall over.

ext.ext_cn: 托网渔船上的船员被聚集到甲板下。
ext.ext_en: The crew of the trawler were gathered below decks.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is below decks, they are inside a ship in the part of it that is underneath the deck.

defs.def_cn: 清除障碍以准备开始新的工作（或行动）

ext.ext_cn: 人质的获释可能会为发动战争扫清障碍。
ext.ext_en: The hostage release could clear the decks for war.

ext.ext_cn: 在考虑承担更多责任之前一定要先料理完手头的事。
ext.ext_en: Clear the decks before you think of taking on any more responsibilities.

defs.def_en: If you clear the decks, you get ready to start something new by finishing any work that has to be done or getting rid of any problems that are in the way.

ext.ext_cn: 安多弗摔倒在地。
ext.ext_en: Andover's body hit the deck.

defs.def_en: If someone or something hits the deck, they fall to the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 他们想让我做什么,宣战还是投降？
ext.ext_en: Which do they want me to do? declare war or surrender?...

ext.ext_cn: 哪些是你们真正喜欢的？
ext.ext_en: Which are the ones you really like?...

defs.def_en: You use which in questions when there are two or more possible answers or alternatives.

defs.def_cn: (用于指明在两个或多个答案或选项中所作出的选择)哪个，哪些

ext.ext_cn: 我想知道你上的是哪所学校。
ext.ext_en: I wanted to know which school it was you went to...

ext.ext_cn: 我记不清哪些老师教过我。
ext.ext_en: I can't remember which teachers I had...

defs.def_en: You use which to refer to a choice between two or more possible answers or alternatives.

defs.def_cn: (用于关系从句句首，具体说明所谈论的事物或提供关于它的更多信息)

ext.ext_cn: 士兵向那辆拒绝在军事检查站停车检查的汽车开了火。
ext.ext_en: Soldiers opened fire on a car which failed to stop at an army checkpoint...

ext.ext_cn: 他驻扎在波斯尼亚北部的最大城市巴尼亚卢卡。
ext.ext_en: He's based in Banja Luka, which is the largest city in northern Bosnia...

defs.def_en: You use which at the beginning of a relative clause when specifying the thing that you are talking about or when giving more information about it.

defs.def_cn: (用来回指前面句子表达的观点或状况)这，那

ext.ext_cn: 他们把酒喝完了。但实际上这对我来说无所谓，因为我不喝酒。
ext.ext_en: They ran out of drink. Which actually didn't bother me because I wasn't drinking...

ext.ext_cn: 我们自从9月份开始以来，已经募集到5万英镑，进展相当顺利。
ext.ext_en: Since we started in September we have raised fifty thousand pounds, which is pretty good going...

defs.def_en: You use which to refer back to an idea or situation expressed in a previous sentence or sentences, especially when you want to give your opinion about it.

defs.def_cn: 哪个是哪个(用于表示无法区分)

ext.ext_cn: 对我来说他们看起来全都非常相似，我永远搞不清哪个是哪个。
ext.ext_en: They all look so alike to me that I'm never sure which is which...

ext.ext_cn: 由于治疗的方法将会全然不同，因此弄清楚哪个是哪个很重要。
ext.ext_en: It's essential to know which is which as treatments will be quite different.

defs.def_en: If you cannot tell the difference between two things, you can say that you do not know which is which .

defs.def_cn: (地方法官或神职人员)领薪金的，有生活津贴的
defs.def_en: A stipendiary magistrate or member of the clergy receives a stipend.
Glue sniffing is the practice of breathing the vapour from glue in order to become intoxicated.

ext.ext_cn: 乘客们从飞机前部4个出口处的紧急滑道滑下逃生了。
ext.ext_en: Passengers escaped from the plane's front four exits by sliding down emergency chutes.

defs.def_en: A chute is a steep, narrow slope down which people or things can slide.

ext.ext_cn: 你随便哪只手都能打开降落伞，不过用左手容易些。
ext.ext_en: You can release the chute with either hand, but it is easier to do it with the left.

defs.def_en: A chute is a parachute.

ext.ext_cn: 东京的皇宫
ext.ext_en: ...the Imperial Palace in Tokyo...

ext.ext_cn: 他们 1918 年处死了俄国沙皇皇族。
ext.ext_en: They executed Russia's imperial family in 1918.

defs.def_en: Imperial is used to refer to things or people that are or were connected with an empire.
The imperial system of measurement uses inches, feet, and yards to measure length, ounces and pounds to measure weight, and pints and gallons to measure volume.

defs.def_cn: （常用来漂浅头发或杀死细菌的）过氧化氢，双氧水
defs.def_en: Hydrogen peroxide is a chemical that is often used to make hair lighter or to kill germs.
A strip joint is the same as a strip club .

ext.ext_cn: 稀有品种的牛
ext.ext_en: ...rare breeds of cattle...

ext.ext_cn: 某些品种比其他品种更危险。
ext.ext_en: Certain breeds are more dangerous than others.

defs.def_en: A breed of a pet animal or farm animal is a particular type of it. For example, terriers are a breed of dog.

ext.ext_cn: 他独自一人生活，饲养马匹和狗。
ext.ext_en: He lived alone, breeding horses and dogs...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾经为警方培育警犬。
ext.ext_en: He used to breed dogs for the police...

defs.def_en: See also:cross-breed;If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

ext.ext_cn: 通常青蛙会在任何条件适宜的池塘中繁殖。
ext.ext_en: Frogs will usually breed in any convenient pond...

ext.ext_cn: 这一地区现在吸引了60多种鸟类到此繁育后代。
ext.ext_en: The area now attracts over 60 species of breeding birds.

defs.def_en: When animals breed, they have babies.

ext.ext_cn: 如果他们失去工作，一定会产生怨恨。
ext.ext_en: If they are unemployed it's bound to breed resentment...

ext.ext_cn: 暴力会催生更多暴力。
ext.ext_en: Violence breeds violence.

defs.def_en: If you say that something breeds bad feeling or bad behaviour, you mean that it causes bad feeling or bad behaviour to develop.

ext.ext_cn: 休是英国新一代的女子壁球运动员，她们的影响正在显现出来。
ext.ext_en: Sue is one of the new breed of British women squash players who are making a real impact...

ext.ext_cn: 这种新型的徒步旅行假日重在愉悦身心，而不是为了锻炼耐力。
ext.ext_en: The new breed of walking holidays puts the emphasis on enjoyment, not endurance...

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone or something as one of a particular breed of person or thing when you want to talk about what they are like.

ext.ext_cn: 我在高地地区出生和长大。
ext.ext_en: I was born and bred in the highlands...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管生于斯长于斯，他和妻子在战后还是移民去了洛杉矶。
ext.ext_en: Born and bred in this country, he and his wife emigrated to Los Angeles after the war...

defs.def_en: Someone who was born and bred in a place was born there and grew up there.

ext.ext_cn: 在某些方面成为现代直升机前身的机器
ext.ext_en: ...a machine which, in some respects, was the forerunner of the modern helicopter...

ext.ext_cn: 一些呼吸道症状可能是哮喘病的先兆。
ext.ext_en: Some respiratory symptoms can be the forerunners of asthma.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or thing as the forerunner of someone or something similar, you mean they existed before them and either influenced their development or were a sign of what was going to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 实情被揭穿了:政府的承诺原来是空洞的谎言。
ext.ext_en: The government's promises were exposed as a hollow sham...

ext.ext_cn: 许多国家的领导人已经指责这次大选弄虚作假。
ext.ext_en: Many of the world's leaders have already denounced this election as a sham.

defs.def_en: Something that is a sham is not real or is not really what it seems to be.
A tin whistle is a simple musical instrument in the shape of a metal pipe with holes. Tin whistles make a high sound and are often used in folk music, for example Irish music.

defs.def_cn: 大麻（一种植物，用来制绳索或大麻毒品）
defs.def_en: Hemp is a plant used for making rope or the drug marijuana.

defs.def_cn: (学校、学院或大学的)全部课程

ext.ext_cn: 学校对16岁以上的学生开设的课程，范围应该更广一些。
ext.ext_en: There should be a broader curriculum in schools for post-16-year-old pupils...

ext.ext_cn: 俄语在学校课程设置中是一门必修的外语课。
ext.ext_en: Russian is the one compulsory foreign language on the school curriculum.

defs.def_en: See also:National Curriculum;A curriculum is all the different courses of study that are taught in a school, college, or university.

ext.ext_cn: 历史课
ext.ext_en: ...the history curriculum.

defs.def_en: A particular curriculum is one particular course of study that is taught in a school, college, or university.

ext.ext_cn: 要自信点儿，把自己的感受讲清楚。
ext.ext_en: Be assertive and spell out exactly how you feel...

ext.ext_cn: 我要仔仔细细讲多少遍？
ext.ext_en: How many times do I have to spell it out?

defs.def_en: If you spell something out, you explain it in detail or in a very clear way.

ext.ext_cn: 愤怒的抗议者们紧握拳头大声抗议。
ext.ext_en: Angry protestors with clenched fists shouted their defiance...

ext.ext_cn: 加里将一枚便士攥在手中。
ext.ext_en: Gary clutched a penny in his fist.

defs.def_en: Your hand is referred to as your fist when you have bent your fingers in towards the palm in order to hit someone, to make an angry gesture, or to hold something.

defs.def_cn: (政策或方法)铁拳的，残酷无情的，强硬的

ext.ext_cn: 对原教旨主义者采取的铁拳政策不可能中止。
ext.ext_en: The iron-fist policy towards the fundamentalists is unlikely to be interrupted.

defs.def_en: An iron fist policy or approach is one which deals with people and situations in a very strict and cruel way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不负责任的;无责任感的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为鼓吹毒品合法化是不负责任的行为。
ext.ext_en: I felt that it was irresponsible to advocate the legalisation of drugs...

ext.ext_cn: 若我不建议公司放弃这个项目，那我就是不负责任。
ext.ext_en: It would be irresponsible of me not to advise my company to abandon this project...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as irresponsible, you are criticizing them because they do things without properly considering their possible consequences.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经工作了两个星期左右，却没有拿到一点儿薪水。
ext.ext_en: They've worked for about two weeks without a paycheck.

defs.def_en: Your pay cheque is a piece of paper that your employer gives you as your wages or salary, and which you can then cash at a bank. You can also use pay cheque as a way of referring to your wages or salary.

defs.def_cn: 工作(或劳动)福利制(失业者必须从事社区工作或学习新技能才能领取福利金的制度)
defs.def_en: Workfare is a government scheme in which unemployed people have to do community work or learn new skills in order to receive welfare benefits.

defs.def_cn: (用于 dark、clear 等形容词之后构成形容词)表示“有…皮肤的”

ext.ext_cn: 黑皮肤的人很少得皮肤癌。
ext.ext_en: Dark-skinned people rarely develop skin cancer...

ext.ext_cn: 她皮肤光滑，非常漂亮。
ext.ext_en: She was smooth-skinned and pretty.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 动物和人在稀薄的空气中都大口喘着气。
ext.ext_en: Both animals and people were gasping for breath in the rarefied air.

ext.ext_cn: 居住在空气稀薄的高海拔地区
ext.ext_en: ...living at very high altitudes where the atmosphere is rarefied.

defs.def_en: Rarefied air is air that does not contain much oxygen, for example in mountain areas.

defs.def_cn: (有共同目的或利益的)团体，协会，联谊会

ext.ext_cn: 国家精神分裂研究协会
ext.ext_en: ...the National Schizophrenia Fellowship...

ext.ext_cn: 在梅林的建议下，亚瑟王创建了圆桌骑士团。
ext.ext_en: At Merlin's instigation, Arthur founds the Fellowship of the Round Table.

defs.def_en: A fellowship is a group of people that join together for a common purpose or interest.

ext.ext_cn: 他在克莱尔学院得到了一个研究员职位。
ext.ext_en: He was offered a research fellowship at Clare College.

defs.def_en: A fellowship at a university is a post which involves research work.

ext.ext_cn: 休戚与共的感觉
ext.ext_en: ...a sense of community and fellowship.

defs.def_en: Fellowship is a feeling of friendship that people have when they are talking or doing something together and sharing their experiences.

ext.ext_cn: 尼古拉斯把泊船的绳缆解开。
ext.ext_en: Nicholas untied the boat from her mooring...

ext.ext_cn: 赶快把绑住我的手的绳子解开。
ext.ext_en: Just untie my hands.

defs.def_en: If you untie something that is tied to another thing or if you untie two things that are tied together, you remove the string or rope that holds them or that has been tied round them.

ext.ext_cn: 她连忙解开绑着脚踝的绳子。
ext.ext_en: She hurriedly untied the ropes binding her ankles...

ext.ext_cn: 然后她把丝巾解下来。
ext.ext_en: Then she untied her silk scarf.

defs.def_en: If you untie something such as string or rope, you undo it so that there is no knot or so that it is no longer tying something.

ext.ext_cn: 她解开了一只鞋的鞋带。
ext.ext_en: She untied the laces on one of her sneakers...

ext.ext_cn: 你靴子上的鞋带松了。
ext.ext_en: Your boot lace is untied.

defs.def_en: When you untie your shoelaces or your shoes, you loosen or undo the laces of your shoes.
Flameproof cooking dishes can withstand direct heat, so they can be used, for example, on top of a cooker or stove, or under a grill.

ext.ext_cn: 我们只把最好的服务提供给客户。
ext.ext_en: We offer only the best to our clients...

ext.ext_cn: 他会得到最好的照顾。
ext.ext_en: He'll have the best of care.

defs.def_en: The best is used to refer to things of the highest quality or standard.

defs.def_cn: 最大努力；最高成就；最好水平

ext.ext_cn: 布洛基小姐弹钢琴的时候发挥了她的最好水平。
ext.ext_en: Miss Blockey was at her best when she played the piano...

ext.ext_cn: 只有一流的司机才能让那种机器发挥出最大的功效。
ext.ext_en: One needs to be a first-class driver to get the best out of that sort of machinery.

defs.def_en: Someone's best is the greatest effort or highest achievement or standard that they are capable of.

ext.ext_cn: 看来他们顶多只能指望打个平局了。
ext.ext_en: A draw seems the best they can hope for...

ext.ext_cn: 我们能做的顶多就是设法保持冷静，蒙混过关。
ext.ext_en: The best we can do is try to stay cool and muddle through.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is the best that can be done or hoped for, you think it is the most pleasant, successful, or useful thing that can be done or hoped for.

ext.ext_cn: 这场演出中我最喜欢的是它的音乐。
ext.ext_en: The thing I liked best about the show was the music...

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼尔拿到钱的时候，母亲是最高兴的。
ext.ext_en: Mother liked it best when Daniel got money...

defs.def_en: If you like something best or like it the best, you prefer it.

defs.def_cn: （用于构成以good和well开头的复合形容词的最高级，如well-known的最高级为best-known）
defs.def_en: Best is used to form the superlative of compound adjectives beginning with 'good' and 'well'. For example, the superlative of 'well-known' is 'best-known'.

defs.def_cn: （用于道别或信件末尾）万事如意，一切顺利

ext.ext_cn: 祝他一切顺利，告诉他我们想念他。
ext.ext_en: Wish him all the best, and tell him we miss him.

defs.def_en: You can say 'All the best' when you are saying goodbye to someone, or at the end of a letter.

ext.ext_cn: 房子既舒适又便宜：最妙的是，大部分租金是由两位美国朋友支付的。
ext.ext_en: It was comfortable and cheap: best of all, most of the rent was being paid by two American friends.

defs.def_en: You use best of all to indicate that what you are about to mention is the thing that you prefer or that has most advantages out of all the things you have mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 尽全力；竭尽所能；尽最大努力

ext.ext_cn: 年纪大一点的人被留下来，奋力坚持。
ext.ext_en: The older people were left to carry on as best they could.

defs.def_en: If someone does something as best they can, they do it as well as they can, although it is very difficult.

ext.ext_cn: 有人说这项政策往好里说是混乱不堪，往坏里说就是形同虚设。
ext.ext_en: This policy, they say, is at best confused and at worst non-existent...

ext.ext_cn: 它们充其量也只能起到4个月的抗抑郁剂的效果。
ext.ext_en: At best they were effective as antidepressants for no more than four months.

defs.def_en: You use at best to indicate that even if you describe something as favourably as possible or if it performs as well as it possibly can, it is still not very good.

ext.ext_cn: 我会尽力查明真相。
ext.ext_en: I'll do my best to find out...

ext.ext_cn: 这不是她的错，她是尽力帮忙的。
ext.ext_en: It wasn't her fault, she was trying her best to help...

defs.def_en: If you do your best or try your best to do something, you try as hard as you can to do it, or do it as well as you can.

ext.ext_cn: 长远来说，这是最好的。
ext.ext_en: In the long run, it was for the best...

ext.ext_cn: 不论在什么情况下，父母都应该知道怎样做才是最好的。
ext.ext_en: Whatever the circumstances, parents are supposed to know what to do for the best.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is for the best, you mean it is the most desirable or helpful thing that could have happened or could be done, considering all the circumstances.

defs.def_cn: （尤指冰释前嫌后）最好的朋友；知己

ext.ext_cn: 玛格达现在已经和乔治·卡勒比结婚了，我们成了最好的朋友。
ext.ext_en: Magda is now married to George Callerby and we are the best of friends.

defs.def_en: If two people are the best of friends, they are close friends, especially when they have had a disagreement or fight in the past.

defs.def_cn: 最好（有些人认为此用法不规范）

ext.ext_cn: 你最好还是看一看。
ext.ext_en: You'd best take a look.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone had best do something or that they'd best do it, you mean they ought to do it. Some people consider this to be non-standard.

ext.ext_cn: 他确信医生和牙医最清楚该怎么做。
ext.ext_en: He was convinced that doctors and dentists knew best.

defs.def_en: If you say that a particular person knows best, you mean that they have a lot of experience and should therefore be trusted to make decisions for other people.

defs.def_cn: 看起来处于自己最迷人的状态

ext.ext_cn: 我把自己收拾得十分整洁，美丽动人。
ext.ext_en: I made sure I was very clean and looking my best.

defs.def_en: If you look your best, you are looking as smart and attractive as you can.

defs.def_cn: 乐观地尽可能利用（逆境）

ext.ext_cn: 她慢慢给孩子们灌输勤奋工作的品德，教导他们充分利用现有的条件。
ext.ext_en: She instilled in the children the virtues of good hard work, and making the best of what you have.

defs.def_en: If you make the best of something, you accept an unsatisfactory situation cheerfully and try to manage as well as you can. In British English, you can also say that you make the best of a bad job .

defs.def_cn: (置于形容词和名词前构成形容词，指不具有某一特质或特定方面)表示“非”，“无”

ext.ext_cn: 非核武器
ext.ext_en: ...non-nuclear weapons...

ext.ext_cn: 非言语交流
ext.ext_en: ...non-verbal communication.

defs.def_en: Non- is used in front of adjectives and nouns to form adjectives that describe something as not having a particular quality or feature.

defs.def_cn: (置于名词前构成名词，指某一特定行动尚未或不会发生)表示“不”，“未”

ext.ext_cn: 他因缺席而被该委员会免除了资格。
ext.ext_en: He was disqualified from the council for non-attendance...

ext.ext_cn: 两国一致同意正常邦交关系应建立在互不干涉内政的基础之上。
ext.ext_en: Both countries agreed that normal relations would be based on non-interference in each other's internal affairs.

defs.def_en: Non- is used in front of nouns to form nouns which refer to situations where a particular action has not or will not take place.

defs.def_cn: (置于名词前构成名词，指不属于某一特定群体或类别的人)表示“非”，“不”

ext.ext_cn: 吸烟者的子女比不吸烟者的子女更有可能会抽烟。
ext.ext_en: Children of smokers are more likely to start smoking than are children of non-smokers.

defs.def_en: Non- is used in front of nouns to form nouns which refer to people who do not belong to a particular group or category.
A broomstick is an old-fashioned broom which has a bunch of small sticks at the end.
A broomstick is the handle of a broom.

defs.def_cn: (常指两个球队之间同一天进行的)连续两场比赛
defs.def_en: A double-header is a sporting contest between two teams that involves two separate games being played, often on the same day.

ext.ext_cn: 他 1977 年因冒充警官而再次入狱。
ext.ext_en: He was returned to prison in 1977 for impersonating a police officer...

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆的模仿能力是超一流的，他能惟妙惟肖地模仿学院里的大多数老师。
ext.ext_en: Tom was a brilliant mimic who could impersonate most of the college staff.

defs.def_en: If someone impersonates a person, they pretend to be that person, either to deceive people or to make people laugh.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 检查表明她近视得很厉害。
ext.ext_en: Testing showed her to be very short-sighted.

defs.def_en: If you are short-sighted, you cannot see things properly when they are far away, because there is something wrong with your eyes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 环境保护主义者担心这并非解决全球变暖问题的长久之计。
ext.ext_en: Environmentalists fear that this is a short-sighted approach to the problem of global warming...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为我们这样做目光很短浅。
ext.ext_en: I think we're being very short-sighted.

defs.def_en: If someone is short-sighted about something, or if their ideas are short-sighted, they do not make proper or careful judgments about the future.

ext.ext_cn: 巨大的烤火腿
ext.ext_en: ...a huge baked ham.

ext.ext_cn: 火腿三明治
ext.ext_en: ...ham sandwiches.

defs.def_en: Ham is meat from the top of the back leg of a pig, specially treated so that it can be kept for a long period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 我在11岁时成了一名业余无线电操作员。
ext.ext_en: I became a ham radio operator at the age of eleven.

defs.def_en: A ham is a person whose hobby consists of using special radio equipment to talk to other people with the same hobby, often people who are in other countries.

defs.def_cn: 蹩脚演员;表演过火的演员
defs.def_en: A ham actor is someone who acts badly, exaggerating every emotion and gesture.

defs.def_cn: （常指演员故意地）表演过火，夸张做作

ext.ext_cn: 他们全力投入到这部闹剧中去，极尽搞怪之能事。
ext.ext_en: Thrusting themselves into the spirit of the farce, they ham it up like mad.

defs.def_en: If actors or actresses ham it up, they exaggerate every emotion and gesture when they are acting, often deliberately because they think that the audience will be more amused.

defs.def_cn: （作为教训或说明原则的）实例

ext.ext_cn: 这是如何利用电视进行劝服的一个实际例子。
ext.ext_en: It was an object lesson in how to use television as a means of persuasion.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action, event, or situation as an object lesson, you think that it demonstrates the correct way to do something, or that it demonstrates the truth of a particular principle.

defs.def_cn: （用在书面语中表示惊讶、生气或高兴）哈

ext.ext_cn: “哈！”雷恩说，“你以为我会相信你？”
ext.ext_en: Ha! said Wren. Think I'd trust you?...

ext.ext_cn: 哈！正和我猜的一样。
ext.ext_en: Hah! Just as I suspected.

defs.def_en: ha ha;Ha is used in writing to represent a noise that people make to show they are surprised, annoyed, or pleased about something.

ext.ext_cn: 他们有时只好砍树当柴烧。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes they have to chop down a tree for firewood.

defs.def_en: If you chop down a tree, you cut through its trunk with an axe so that it falls to the ground.

defs.def_cn: 民族国家;单一民族的独立国家

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔巴尼亚是一个大约有300万人口的单一民族独立国家。
ext.ext_en: Albania is a small nation state of around 3 million people.

defs.def_en: A nation-state is an independent state which consists of people from one particular national group.

ext.ext_cn: 他能听见她的狗在暗处吠叫、哀嚎。
ext.ext_en: He could hear her dog barking and whining in the background...

ext.ext_cn: 发动机呜呜作响。
ext.ext_en: The engines whined.

defs.def_en: If something or someone whines, they make a long, high-pitched noise, especially one which sounds sad or unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 他们到我这儿来不停地唠叨他们的烦恼。
ext.ext_en: They come to me to whine about their troubles.

ext.ext_cn: 抱怨说他们觉得很无聊的孩子们
ext.ext_en: ...children who whine that they are bored...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is whining, you mean that they are complaining in an annoying way about something unimportant.

defs.def_cn: 囊地鼠，囊鼠(见于加拿大和美国)
defs.def_en: A gopher is a small animal which looks a bit like a rat and lives in holes in the ground. Gophers are found in Canada and the USA.

defs.def_cn: Gopher 程序，地鼠程序（用于在因特网上查询资料）
defs.def_en: In computing, Gopher is a program that collects information for you from many databases across the Internet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 莽撞的；不顾后果的；没头脑的

ext.ext_cn: 他并没有像没头脑的人那样说蠢话。
ext.ext_en: He doesn't say those silly things that unthinking people say...

ext.ext_cn: 布鲁斯决非蓄意搞破坏的莽汉。
ext.ext_en: Bruce was no unthinking vandal.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is unthinking, you are critical of them because you consider that they do not think carefully about the effects of their behaviour.
A cuttlefish is a sea animal that has a soft body and a hard shell inside.

defs.def_cn: (定期在电视上宣扬基督教并筹款的)电视福音布道者
defs.def_en: A televangelist is someone who makes regular television broadcasts to promote a particular form of Christianity and raise money for particular Christian groups or projects.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 原则性强的；坚持操守的

ext.ext_cn: 她是一个坚强而有原则的女人。
ext.ext_en: She was a strong, principled woman...

ext.ext_cn: 你得讲原则。
ext.ext_en: You have to take a principled stand.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as principled, you approve of them because they have strong moral principles.

ext.ext_cn: 布尔人反抗英国统治，并于1880年12月30日宣布独立。
ext.ext_en: The Boers rebelled against British rule, proclaiming their independence on 30 December 1880...

ext.ext_cn: 英国骄傲地声称自己是一个热爱动物的国家。
ext.ext_en: Britain proudly proclaims that it is a nation of animal lovers...

defs.def_en: If people proclaim something, they formally make it known to the public.

ext.ext_cn: “我想今天我们说的大家都听见了，”他明确地说。
ext.ext_en: 'I think we have been heard today,' he proclaimed...

ext.ext_cn: 他信心百倍地声称他的产品是市场上最物有所值的。
ext.ext_en: He confidently proclaims that he is offering the best value in the market.

defs.def_en: If you proclaim something, you state it in an emphatic way.

defs.def_cn: 使(机器或设备)提高效率

ext.ext_cn: 把助听器调高一两个刻度就可以。
ext.ext_en: Just crank up your hearing aid a peg or two.

defs.def_en: If you crank up a machine or a device, you make it function harder or at a greater level.

ext.ext_cn: 5月份的温热天气使得美国人打开了空调
ext.ext_en: ...May's warm weather, which caused Americans to crank up their air conditioners.

defs.def_en: If you crank up a machine or device, you start it.

ext.ext_cn: 有人调大了公共广播系统的音量。
ext.ext_en: Someone cranked up the volume of the public address system...

ext.ext_cn: 到6点左右，他们又把音乐声音开大了。
ext.ext_en: By about six, they're cranking the music up loud again.

defs.def_en: If you crank up the volume of something, you turn it up until it is very loud.

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩·史密斯被谋杀的案子让人们更加恐惧。
ext.ext_en: The incident that cranked up the fear was the murder of Brian Smith...

ext.ext_cn: 执法部门加大了调查力度。
ext.ext_en: The legal authorities cranked up the investigation.

defs.def_en: To crank something up means to increase it or make it more intense.

ext.ext_cn: 认为不该派遣驻海外部队的极左派观点
ext.ext_en: ...the hard-left view that foreign forces should not have been sent.

defs.def_en: You use hard left to describe those members of a left wing political group or party who have the most extreme political beliefs.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 独特的;特别的;有特色的

ext.ext_cn: 氯气特有的气味
ext.ext_en: ...the distinctive odour of chlorine.

ext.ext_cn: 特殊的蓝黄旗
ext.ext_en: ...a distinctive blue and yellow flag...

defs.def_en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

ext.ext_cn: 她迅速戴上一副太阳镜。
ext.ext_en: She slipped on a pair of sunglasses.

defs.def_en: Sunglasses are glasses with dark lenses which you wear to protect your eyes from bright sunlight.

ext.ext_cn: 诺拉第一次看见他时，他正在散发自己的讲座宣传单。
ext.ext_en: He was distributing handbills announcing his lecture when Nora caught her first glimpse of him.

defs.def_en: A handbill is a small printed notice which is used to advertise a particular company, service, or event.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为我们有必要走开一下去考虑这件事。
ext.ext_en: I think we need to go away and think about this.

defs.def_en: If you go away, you leave a place or a person's company.

ext.ext_cn: 外出度假时，需要格外注意安全。
ext.ext_en: When you go away on holiday, you need to take extra security precautions...

ext.ext_cn: 不如咱俩这个周末出去度假吧？
ext.ext_en: Why don't you and I go away this weekend?

defs.def_en: If you go away, you leave a place and spend a period of time somewhere else, especially as a holiday.

defs.def_cn: 持怀疑态度的人;(尤指在宗教或政治方面)信仰不坚定的人

ext.ext_cn: 有些持怀疑态度的人担心这条新闻并非像报道那般美好。
ext.ext_en: Some doubters fear this news may not be as good as it appears.

defs.def_en: If you refer to people as doubters, you mean that they have doubts about something, especially their religious or political system.
An ISP is a company that provides Internet and e-mail services. ISP is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'Internet Service Provider'.

ext.ext_cn: 如果他想出一大笔钱买辆新车，他得花好几天才能筹到现款。
ext.ext_en: If he wanted to splash out on a new car it would take him a couple of days to get his hands on the cash...

ext.ext_cn: 你能稍微奢侈一点吗？你的预算是否有上限？
ext.ext_en: Can you afford to splash out a little? Is your budget unlimited?

defs.def_en: If you splash out on something, especially on a luxury, you buy it even though it costs a lot of money.

ext.ext_cn: 一些国家也可能会发现自己的货币正在国外市场上贬值。
ext.ext_en: Countries may also find their currency is depreciating in foreign markets.

ext.ext_cn: 对外汇的需求致使本币的实际价值下跌。
ext.ext_en: The demand for foreign currency depreciates the real value of local currencies...

defs.def_en: If something such as a currency depreciates or if something depreciates it, it loses some of its original value.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极拘谨的；一本正经的；古板的

ext.ext_cn: 我们倾向于把维多利亚时代的人想象得非常古板、中规中矩。
ext.ext_en: We tend to imagine that the Victorians were very prim and proper.

ext.ext_cn: 一位极为古板的英国老处女
ext.ext_en: ...a rather prim British spinster.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as prim, you disapprove of them because they behave too correctly and are too easily shocked by anything rude.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这顶白色的帽子戴在她金色的卷发上显得非常雅致。
ext.ext_en: On her blonde wavy hair, the white hat looked nicely prim.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as prim, you mean that it is very neat, tidy, or sensible.
A light bulb or bulb is the round glass part of an electric light or lamp which light shines from.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 兽性的；残忍的；令人厌恶的

ext.ext_en: ...the bestial conditions into which the city has sunk.

defs.def_en: If you describe behaviour or a situation as bestial, you mean that it is very unpleasant or disgusting.

defs.def_cn: 使(某人)想要却得不到(某物);逗引;挑逗;撩拨

ext.ext_en: Pushing 40, he was an ageing rock star.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is pushing a particular age, you mean that they are nearly that age.

defs.def_en: See also:accident prone;To be prone to something, usually something bad, means to have a tendency to be affected by it or to do it.

ext.ext_en: Regulations placed clear obligations on the landlord for the benefit of the tenant...

defs.def_en: See also:sitting tenant;A tenant is someone who pays rent for the place they live in, or for land or buildings that they use.

defs.def_cn: （成功带来的）欢欣鼓舞，欣喜若狂

ext.ext_en: His resignation was greeted by jubilation on the streets of Sofia.

ext.ext_cn: 欣喜若狂的欢呼
ext.ext_en: ...cheers of jubilation.

ext.ext_en: ...Jack Lang, France's minister for culture, and his deputy, Catherine Tasca.

ext.ext_en: ...the academy's deputy director, Vladimir Kudryatsev.

defs.def_en: A deputy is the second most important person in an organization such as a business or government department. Someone's deputy often acts on their behalf when they are not there.

ext.ext_en: The president appealed to deputies to approve the plan quickly.

defs.def_en: In some parliaments or law-making bodies, the elected members are called deputies .

defs.def_cn: 未开发地区的；待开发地区的

ext.ext_en: The Government has ruled out the building of a new airport on a greenfield site.

defs.def_en: Greenfield is used to refer to land that has not been built on before.
A matinee is a performance of a play or a showing of a film which takes place in the afternoon.

ext.ext_en: Ferris was crouched down on his haunches.

defs.def_en: If you get down on your haunches, you lower yourself towards the ground so that your legs are bent under you and you are balancing on your feet.

ext.ext_cn: 经济正处于萧条期。
ext.ext_en: The economy is in the doldrums.

defs.def_en: If an activity or situation is in the doldrums, it is very quiet and nothing new or exciting is happening.

defs.def_cn: （板球等运动中的）投球手，投球员

defs.def_en: The bowler in a sport such as cricket is the player who is bowling the ball.

defs.def_en: A bowler is someone who plays bowls or goes bowling.

Dal is an Indian dish made from pulses such as chick peas or lentils.

ext.ext_en: It is particularly concerning that he is working for non-British companies while advising on foreign policy.

defs.def_en: If something is concerning, it causes you to feel concerned about it.

defs.def_en: If a person or a company refinances a debt or if they refinance, they borrow money in order to pay the debt.

ext.ext_en: Kim's mother agreed to vouch for Maria and get her a job.

defs.def_en: If you say that you can vouch for something, you mean that you have evidence from your own personal experience that it is true or correct.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The voice was patronizing and affected, the accent artificial.

ext.ext_en: We couldn't get through a day without arguing.

ext.ext_en: ...the most shameful episode in US naval history.

ext.ext_en: Parts of Glasgow are on a par with the worst areas of London and Liverpool for burglaries.

defs.def_en: If you say that two people or things are on a par with each other, you mean that they are equally good or bad, or equally important.

ext.ext_en: He was five under par after the first round.

ext.ext_en: A teacher's job is relatively safe, even if they perform under par in the classroom.

ext.ext_cn: 他的表演不合格。
ext.ext_en: His performance was not up to par...

ext.ext_cn: 要让他们达标，需要不断努力。
ext.ext_en: It's a constant struggle to try to keep them up to par.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is not up to par, you are disappointed in them because they are below the standard you expected.

defs.def_en: If you feel below par or under par, you feel tired and unable to perform as well as you normally do.

defs.def_cn: （不快之事）不出所料，在意料之中

ext.ext_en: He said long hours are par for the course.

defs.def_en: If you say that something that happens is par for the course, you mean that you are not pleased with it but it is what you expected to happen.

ext.ext_en: The most conspicuous way in which the old politics is changing is in the growing use of referendums...
