defs.def_en: If you have or take a crack at something, you make an attempt to do or achieve something.

ext.ext_en: When Paul made the crack about the 'famous girl detective', I began to suspect that he had it in for you.

ext.ext_en: None of them is expecting any favours, just a fair crack of the whip.

defs.def_en: If you get a fair crack of the whip, you are allowed a reasonable opportunity to succeed at something.

defs.def_en: If you say that you got an earful, you mean that someone spoke angrily to you for quite a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 我最愁的是钱。
ext.ext_en: Money is my biggest bugbear.

defs.def_en: Something or someone that is your bugbear worries or upsets you.

defs.def_cn: (常为儿语，指让人害怕或厌恶的)爬虫，蠕虫
defs.def_en: You can refer to insects as creepy-crawlies when they give you a feeling of fear or disgust. This word is mainly used by children.

ext.ext_cn: 警察还未抓获谋杀她的凶手。
ext.ext_en: Police have not apprehended her killer.

defs.def_en: If the police apprehend someone, they catch them and arrest them.

ext.ext_cn: 直到现在我才真正了解这些队伍的力量。
ext.ext_en: Only now can I begin to apprehend the power of these forces.

defs.def_en: If you apprehend something, you understand it fully.

defs.def_cn: 轮用办公桌;无固定办公桌

ext.ext_cn: 一些部长将不得不轮用办公桌，直到能够找到更多的办公场所为止。
ext.ext_en: Some ministers will have to hot-desk until more accommodation can be found.

defs.def_en: If employees hot-desk, they are not assigned particular desks and work at any desk that is available.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在保护湿地自然环境的计划
ext.ext_en: ...a scheme that aims to protect the wilderness of the wetlands...

ext.ext_cn: 有一些湿地在古代就形成了。
ext.ext_en: There are some areas of wetland which are of ancient origin.

defs.def_en: A wetland is an area of very wet, muddy land with wild plants growing in it. You can also refer to an area like this as wetlands .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 恶劣得说不出口的；坏透了的

ext.ext_cn: 化学武器难以名状的可怖
ext.ext_en: ...the unspeakable horrors of chemical weapons...

ext.ext_cn: 疼起来厉害得无法形容。
ext.ext_en: The pain is unspeakable.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unspeakable, you are emphasizing that it is extremely unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 中等的;普通的;不好不坏的

ext.ext_cn: 直到1963年，甲壳虫乐队还只是半红不紫。
ext.ext_en: The Beatles enjoyed only middling success until 1963.

ext.ext_cn: 中等身材的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a man of middling height.

defs.def_en: If you describe a quality such as the size of something as middling, you mean that it is average.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对他的客人们非常关切。
ext.ext_en: He was so solicitous of his guests.

defs.def_en: A person who is solicitous shows anxious concern for someone or something.
A synapse is one of the points in the nervous system at which a signal passes from one nerve cell to another.

ext.ext_cn: 将面团擀成大的圆形面皮。
ext.ext_en: Roll out the dough into one large circle...

ext.ext_cn: 将面粉和酵母混在一起和成黏糊糊的面团。
ext.ext_en: Work the flour and yeast mixture together until you have a sticky dough.

defs.def_en: Dough is a fairly firm mixture of flour, water, and sometimes also fat and sugar. It can be cooked to make bread, pastry, and biscuits.

ext.ext_cn: 他努力工作挣钱。
ext.ext_en: He worked hard for his dough.

defs.def_en: You can refer to money as dough .

ext.ext_cn: 我最多会给他80%。
ext.ext_en: I'll give him eight out of 10, max...

ext.ext_cn: 他把节气门的开关拧到最大。
ext.ext_en: He twisted the throttle control to max power.

defs.def_en: Max. is an abbreviation for (缩略 =) maximum, and is often used after numbers or amounts.

defs.def_cn: 最大限度地;尽可能充分地;竭尽全力地

ext.ext_cn: 每一个参与者都在尽情享受。
ext.ext_en: Everyone involved is enjoying himself to the max.

defs.def_en: If you do something to the max, you do it to the greatest degree possible.

ext.ext_cn: 听众被邀请打进电话选择赢家。
ext.ext_en: Listeners have been invited to phone in to pick the winner.

defs.def_en: If you phone in to a radio or television show, you telephone the show in order to give your opinion on a matter that the show has raised.

ext.ext_cn: 他打来电话说他正在仔细考虑他的选择。
ext.ext_en: He has phoned in to say he is thinking over his options.

defs.def_en: If you phone in to a place, you make a telephone call to that place.

ext.ext_cn: 在出发的三天之前打电话预订即可。
ext.ext_en: Just phone in your order three or more days prior to departure.

defs.def_en: If you phone in an order for something, you place the order by telephone.

ext.ext_cn: 星期一，我还是感觉不适，便打电话到单位请了病假。
ext.ext_en: On Monday I was still upset and I phoned in sick to work.

defs.def_en: If you phone in sick, you telephone your workplace to say that you will not come to work because you are ill.

ext.ext_cn: 据未经证实的报道说，几个小村庄被泥石流吞没了。
ext.ext_en: There are unconfirmed reports of several small villages buried by mudslides.

defs.def_en: If a report or a rumour is unconfirmed, there is no definite proof as to whether it is true or not.

defs.def_cn: （陪审团）不能达成一致意见的;（英国议会或政务委员会）任何政党都不占多数席位的

ext.ext_cn: 假如出现一个没有多数党的议会，他也仍将继续为实现宣言里提出的所有目标而奋斗。
ext.ext_en: In the event of a hung Parliament he would still fight for everything in the manifesto...

ext.ext_cn: 对乔治的一审以陪审团不能取得一致意见而告终。
ext.ext_en: George's first trial ended in a hung jury.

defs.def_en: A hung jury is the situation that occurs when a jury is unable to reach a decision because there is not a clear majority of its members in favour of any one decision. In British English you can also talk about a hung parliament or a hung council.

defs.def_cn: 蛋白椰子甜饼干;蛋白杏仁甜饼干;杏元饼干
defs.def_en: Macaroons are sweet cake-like biscuits that are flavoured with coconut or almond.

ext.ext_cn: 时装设计师在过去的几年间表现得更出色了。
ext.ext_en: The fashion designers have sharpened up their act in the last few years...

ext.ext_cn: 如果他真想卖出产品，就要让市场人员变得更机敏。
ext.ext_en: If he really wants to sell his product, he'll have to get his marketing boys to sharpen up.

defs.def_en: If you sharpen something up, or if it sharpens up, it becomes smarter or better than it was.

A concertina is a musical instrument consisting of two end pieces with stiff paper or cloth that folds up between them. You play the concertina by pressing the buttons on the end pieces while moving them together and apart.
A suicide note is a note written by someone who intends to kill themselves saying that this is what they are going to do and sometimes explaining why.

defs.def_cn: 傍晚茶（在英国有时用来代替晚上的正餐）
defs.def_en: In Britain, some people have a meal called high tea in the late afternoon instead of having dinner or supper later in the evening.

ext.ext_cn: 他办公室门的上半部分是磨砂玻璃。
ext.ext_en: The top half of the door to his office was of frosted glass.

defs.def_en: Frosted glass is glass that you cannot see through clearly.

ext.ext_cn: 被霜覆盖的树木
ext.ext_en: ...the frosted trees.

defs.def_en: Frosted means covered with frost.

ext.ext_cn: 蓝色霜状眼影
ext.ext_en: ...frosted blue eye shadow.

defs.def_en: Frosted means covered with something that looks like frost.

ext.ext_cn: 一盘撒有糖霜的纸杯蛋糕
ext.ext_en: ...a plate of frosted cupcakes.

defs.def_en: Frosted means covered with icing.
A cruiserweight is another name for a light heavyweight .

ext.ext_cn: 法官驳回了宽大处理的请求，判处他6个月的监禁。
ext.ext_en: The judge rejected pleas for leniency and sentenced him to six months in prison...

ext.ext_cn: 他说自己绝不轻饶那些在穆斯林和基督徒之间挑起事端的人。
ext.ext_en: He said he would show no leniency towards those who stirred up trouble between Muslims and Christians.

defs.def_en: Leniency is a lenient attitude or lenient behaviour.
Totalitarianism is the ideas, principles, and practices of totalitarian political systems.

ext.ext_cn: 政府已经宣布法国大使为不受欢迎的人，勒令其离境。
ext.ext_en: The government has declared the French ambassador persona non grata and ordered him to leave the country.

defs.def_en: If someone becomes or is declared persona non grata, they become unwelcome or unacceptable because of something they have said or done.
If a street is a dead end, there is no way out at one end of it.

ext.ext_cn: 做女服务生是一份没有前途的工作。
ext.ext_en: Waitressing was a dead-end job.

defs.def_en: A dead end job or course of action is one that you think is bad because it does not lead to further developments or progress.
The belfry of a church is the top part of its tower, where the bells are.
Ivy is an evergreen plant that grows up walls or along the ground.

defs.def_cn: (在电视讨论或访谈节目中的）专家，权威的评论家
defs.def_en: Talking heads are people who appear in television discussion programmes and interviews to give their opinions about a topic.

ext.ext_cn: 拥有各种悠久传统和众多知名校友的伊顿公学
ext.ext_en: ...Eton College, with all its traditions and long list of famous old boys.

ext.ext_cn: 加的夫中学校友橄榄球队
ext.ext_en: ...Cardiff High School Old Boys rugby team.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a man who used to be a pupil at a particular school or university as an old boy .

defs.def_cn: 老家伙；老头儿；中年老男人

ext.ext_cn: 两个老头儿在外面街角迟迟不走，聊着牛的事情。
ext.ext_en: Outside, two old boys lingered on the street corner discussing cattle.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an old or middle-aged man as an old boy, you are referring to him in a disrespectful way.

defs.def_cn: 未公开的；未公布的；未披露的

ext.ext_cn: 那家公司已被卖掉，具体售价未公开。
ext.ext_en: The company has been sold for an undisclosed amount...

ext.ext_cn: 他们现在藏身于一个秘密的地方。
ext.ext_en: They are now in hiding at an undisclosed address.

defs.def_en: Undisclosed information is not revealed to the public.

ext.ext_cn: 他为什么没把威士忌拿来？
ext.ext_en: Why hasn't he brought the whisky?...

ext.ext_cn: 为什么他没阻止我？
ext.ext_en: Why didn't he stop me?...

defs.def_en: You use why in questions when you ask about the reasons for something.

ext.ext_cn: 对于电梯为什么会卡住他仍旧给不出更多的解释。
ext.ext_en: He still could not throw any further light on why the elevator could have become jammed...

ext.ext_cn: 专家们对为什么美国政府没在这个国家采取类似的强硬措施来对抗艾滋病而感到疑惑。
ext.ext_en: Experts wonder why the US government is not taking similarly strong actions against AIDS in this country...

defs.def_en: You use why at the beginning of a clause in which you talk about the reasons for something.

ext.ext_cn: 女人不读这种东西是有原因的，它并不好笑。
ext.ext_en: There's a reason why women don't read this stuff; it's not funny...

ext.ext_cn: 除非你病了，否则你没有理由每天连走15分钟都做不到的。
ext.ext_en: Unless you're ill, there's no reason why you can't get those 15 minutes of walking in daily.

defs.def_en: You use why to introduce a relative clause after the word 'reason'.

defs.def_cn: (问句中与 not 连用表示建议)为什么(不)

ext.ext_cn: 为什么不给克莱尔打个电话？
ext.ext_en: Why not give Claire a call?...

ext.ext_cn: 你何不先和我一起回家，等事情解决了再走？
ext.ext_en: Why don't you come home with me until you sort things out?...

defs.def_en: You use why with 'not' in questions in order to introduce a suggestion.

defs.def_cn: (问句中与 not 连用表示恼怒或气愤)为什么(不)

ext.ext_cn: 走路怎么不看着点儿道呢？
ext.ext_en: Why don't you look where you're going?...

ext.ext_cn: 他们就不能别管了吗？
ext.ext_en: Why don't they just leave it alone?

defs.def_en: You use why with 'not' in questions in order to express your annoyance or anger.

defs.def_cn: (表示同意别人的建议)为什么不呢，好，行

ext.ext_cn: “想和我共度这个下午吗？”——“好啊！”
ext.ext_en: 'Want to spend the afternoon with me?' — 'Why not?'...

ext.ext_cn: “我应该告诉他们可怜的布莱尔太太的情况吗？”——“为什么不呢？”
ext.ext_en: 'Shall I tell them about poor Mrs Blair?'—'Why not?'

defs.def_en: You say why not in order to agree with what someone has suggested.

defs.def_cn: (用于句首表示惊讶、震惊或生气)哎呀，哟，嗨

ext.ext_cn: 哎呀，你好，汤姆。
ext.ext_en: Why hello, Tom...

ext.ext_cn: 啊，这只不过是普通的蔬菜汤而已。
ext.ext_en: Why, this is nothing but common vegetable soup...

defs.def_en: People say 'Why!' at the beginning of a sentence when they are surprised, shocked, or angry.
If someone takes you on a guided tour of a place, they show you the place and tell you about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他还被控非法持有枪支。
ext.ext_en: He was also charged with illegal possession of firearms...

ext.ext_cn: 他因违犯枪支管理法而被判监禁。
ext.ext_en: He was jailed for firearms offences.

defs.def_en: Firearms are guns.
An avalanche is a large mass of snow that falls down the side of a mountain.

ext.ext_cn: 新来者受到了广泛的关注。
ext.ext_en: The newcomer was greeted with an avalanche of publicity.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a very large quantity of things that all arrive or happen at the same time as an avalanche of them.

defs.def_cn: 单调的语调；一成不变的声音

ext.ext_cn: 证据被当庭呆板地宣读了一遍。
ext.ext_en: The evidence was read out to the court in a dull monotone.

defs.def_en: If  someone speaks in a monotone, their voice does not vary at all in tone or loudness and so it is not interesting to listen to.

defs.def_cn: (声音或外表)单调的，无变化的

ext.ext_cn: 人们看到他在电视上念经似地就危机问题老调重弹。
ext.ext_en: He was seen on TV delivering platitudes about the crisis in a monotone voice.

defs.def_en: A monotone sound or surface does not have any variation in its tone or colour.
A red cabbage is a cabbage with dark red leaves.

ext.ext_cn: 我要一杯咖啡和一份奶油面包卷。
ext.ext_en: I'll have coffee and a brioche.

defs.def_en: Brioche is a kind of sweet bread.

ext.ext_cn: 第一季度的股息增长了近 4%。
ext.ext_en: The first quarter dividend has been increased by nearly 4 per cent.

defs.def_en: A dividend is the part of a company's profits which is paid to people who have shares in the company.

ext.ext_cn: 现在采取措施增强体质会使你日后受益。
ext.ext_en: Steps taken now to maximise your health will pay dividends later on.

defs.def_en: If something pays dividends, it brings advantages at a later date.
The logo of a company or organization is the special design or way of writing its name that it puts on all its products, notepaper, or advertisements.

defs.def_cn: (事故、战斗等之后迅速查看伤者以决定哪些人应优先治疗的)伤病员鉴别分类，治疗类选法

ext.ext_cn: 伤病员鉴别分类过程
ext.ext_en: ...the triage process.

defs.def_en: Triage is the process of quickly examining sick or injured people, for example after an accident or a battle, so that those who are in the most serious condition can be treated first.

defs.def_cn: (汽车或飞机)制造商，建造公司
defs.def_en: A racing car constructor or aircraft constructor is a company that builds cars or aircraft.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 感到宽慰的;感到安心的;宽心的

ext.ext_cn: 回到家里我们都感到安心了。
ext.ext_en: We are all relieved to be back home...

ext.ext_cn: 这件事结束之后我感到轻松极了。
ext.ext_en: I am very relieved that it is over...

defs.def_en: If you are relieved, you feel happy because something unpleasant has not happened or is no longer happening.

ext.ext_cn: 他对我妹妹满心牵挂。
ext.ext_en: He is full of tender solicitude towards my sister.

defs.def_en: Solicitude is anxious concern for someone.

ext.ext_cn: 新的土地业主比老业主缴纳的税款要多很多。
ext.ext_en: Newcomers had to pay far more in taxes than long-time land owners...

ext.ext_cn: 她嫁给了多年的男友。
ext.ext_en: She married her long-time boyfriend.

defs.def_en: You use long-time to describe something that has existed or been a particular thing for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 迷宫般的走廊
ext.ext_en: ...the labyrinth of corridors.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as a labyrinth, you mean that it is made up of a complicated series of paths or passages, through which it is difficult to find your way.

defs.def_cn: 错综复杂的事物；千头万绪的局面；盘根错节的情况

ext.ext_cn: 错综复杂、相互矛盾的政治学与社会学诠释
ext.ext_en: ...a labyrinth of conflicting political and sociological interpretations.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation, process, or area of knowledge as a labyrinth, you mean that it is very complicated.

defs.def_cn: （建筑等）哥特式的，哥特风格的

ext.ext_cn: 宏伟高耸的哥特式教堂
ext.ext_en: ...a vast, lofty Gothic cathedral.

ext.ext_cn: 哥特式彩色玻璃窗
ext.ext_en: ...Gothic stained glass windows...

defs.def_en: Gothic architecture and religious art was produced in the Middle Ages. Its features include tall pillars, high curved ceilings, and pointed arches.

defs.def_cn: （小说）哥特派的（描写怪诞、神秘的恐怖故事）

ext.ext_cn: 这本小说既非科幻小说亦非哥特派恐怖小说。
ext.ext_en: This novel is not science fiction, nor is it Gothic horror.

defs.def_en: In Gothic stories, strange, mysterious adventures happen in dark and lonely places such as graveyards and old castles.

defs.def_cn: （印刷或书写文字）哥特体的，花体的，德文老式字体的
defs.def_en: Gothic is used to describe a style of printing or writing in which the letters are very decorative. German books and signs were often written in Gothic script.

ext.ext_cn: 极右派政治团体的出现
ext.ext_en: ...the appearance of hard-right political groupings.

defs.def_en: You use hard right to describe those members of a right wing political group or party who have the most extreme political beliefs.

defs.def_cn: （拥有某物或做某事的）权利，资格

ext.ext_cn: 他们一开始工作就失去了获得救济金的资格。
ext.ext_en: They lose their entitlement to benefit when they start work.

defs.def_en: An entitlement to something is the right to have it or do it.
A bigamous marriage is one in which one of the partners is already legally married to someone else.

defs.def_cn: (士兵、外交官、宇航员等的）任务执行情况报告会

ext.ext_cn: 这次行动之后将会有一个任务执行情况报告会，以便确定是哪里出了问题。
ext.ext_en: A debriefing would follow this operation, to determine where it went wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 他来此是进行身体检查，并听取国务院官员的汇报。
ext.ext_en: He is here for medical check-ups and debriefing by State Department officials.

defs.def_en: A debriefing is a meeting where someone such as a soldier, diplomat, or astronaut is asked to give a report on an operation or task that they have just completed.

defs.def_cn: 孤苦的人；为社会所弃的人

ext.ext_cn: 他们两个孤苦无依的人就那么互相依偎着。
ext.ext_en: They just clung to each other like two lost souls.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a lost soul, you mean that they seem unhappy, and unable to fit in with any particular group of people in society.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 老糊涂的;老态龙钟的;年老而无力自理的
defs.def_en: If old people become senile, they become confused, can no longer remember things, and are unable to look after themselves.
A militiaman is a member of a militia.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我相信这个误会将很快得到纠正。
ext.ext_en: I am hopeful this misunderstanding will be rectified very quickly...

ext.ext_cn: 外科医生有信心保住萨拉左眼的视力。
ext.ext_en: Surgeons were hopeful of saving the sight in Sara's left eye.

defs.def_en: If you are hopeful, you are fairly confident that something that you want to happen will happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 已出炉的选举结果再次显示在中东实现和平是有希望的。
ext.ext_en: The result of the election in is yet another hopeful sign that peace could come to the Middle East.

ext.ext_cn: 认为经济会改善的鼓舞人心的预测
ext.ext_en: ...hopeful forecasts that the economy will improve.

defs.def_en: If something such as a sign or event is hopeful, it makes you feel that what you want to happen will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 我们已经包租了那架飞机，希望政府会对他们放行。
ext.ext_en: We've chartered the aircraft in the hopeful anticipation that the government will allow them to leave.

defs.def_en: A hopeful action is one that you do in the hope that you will get what you want to get.

ext.ext_cn: 他的球技在他给这些希望成为明日之星的年轻人担任教练的过程中继续发挥出很大作用。
ext.ext_en: His soccer skills continue to be put to good use in his job as football coach to young hopefuls.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a hopeful, you mean that they are hoping and trying to achieve success in a particular career, election, or competition.

ext.ext_cn: 和别的树不同，它不是越往上越细，而是上下一样粗。
ext.ext_en: Unlike other trees, it doesn't taper very much. It stays fat all the way up...

ext.ext_cn: 手指修长纤细的一双美手
ext.ext_en: ...beautiful hands with long, tapering fingers...

defs.def_en: If something tapers, or if you taper it, it becomes gradually thinner at one end.

ext.ext_cn: 种种迹象显示，通货膨胀率在逐渐下降。
ext.ext_en: There are signs that inflation is tapering...

defs.def_en: You use habitual to describe someone who usually or often does a particular thing.

ext.ext_en: Tick it off in the box.

ext.ext_en: His mum ticked him off at home...

ext.ext_en: She's still ticked off at him for brushing her off and going out with you instead.

defs.def_cn: （为争取成功或控制权的）斗争，冲突

ext.ext_en: ...a renewed political battle over Britain's  attitude to Europe.

ext.ext_en: ...the eternal battle between good and evil in the world.

defs.def_en: A battle is a conflict in which different people or groups compete in order to achieve success or control.

ext.ext_en: ...the battle against crime...

ext.ext_cn: 她一直在竭力控制体重。
ext.ext_en: She has fought a constant battle with her weight...

defs.def_en: You can use battle to refer to someone's  efforts to achieve something in spite of very difficult circumstances.

ext.ext_en: Thousands of people battled with police and several were reportedly wounded...

ext.ext_en: The sides must battle again for a quarter-final place on December 16...

ext.ext_en: Doctors battled throughout the night to save her life.

ext.ext_cn: 演出门票在 70 分钟内即告售罄。
ext.ext_en: Tickets for the show sold out in 70 minutes.

defs.def_en: When things sell out, all of them that are available are sold.

defs.def_cn: 出卖原则;向敌对势力屈服

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人更是把他看作一位坚持原则、不会为了政治上的妥协而卑躬屈膝的人。
ext.ext_en: The young in particular see him as a man who will not sell out or be debased by the compromises of politics...

ext.ext_cn: 迪伦在格林尼治村的许多朋友都认为他已经向商业主义屈服了。
ext.ext_en: Many of his Greenwich Village associates thought Dylan had sold out to commercialism.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of selling out, you disapprove of the fact that they do something which used to be against their principles, or give in to an opposing group.

ext.ext_cn: 我听说她打算变卖家当，搬到这座城市。
ext.ext_en: I hear she's going to sell out and move to the city.

defs.def_en: Sell out means the same as sell up .
A musical director is the same as a music director .
A roof rack is a metal frame that is fixed on top of a car and used for carrying large objects.

ext.ext_cn: 我惊愕地瞪眼看着她。
ext.ext_en: I stared at her in amazement.

defs.def_en: Amazement is the feeling you have when something surprises you very much.
A sitter is the same as a babysitter .

ext.ext_cn: 他分不清主意的好坏。
ext.ext_en: He is incapable of discriminating between a good idea and a terrible one...

ext.ext_cn: 这台仪器可以辨别癌细胞和正常的细胞。
ext.ext_en: The device can discriminate between the cancerous and the normal cells.

defs.def_en: If you can discriminate between two things, you can recognize that they are different.

ext.ext_cn: 他们认为该项法律歧视女性。
ext.ext_en: They believe the law discriminates against women.

ext.ext_cn: 偏袒少数种族的立法
ext.ext_en: ...legislation which would discriminate in favour of racial minorities...

defs.def_en: To discriminate against a group of people or in favour of a group of people means to unfairly treat them worse or better than other groups.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自相矛盾的；似矛盾而（可能） 正确的

ext.ext_cn: 一些镇静剂适得其反，加重了患者的焦虑。
ext.ext_en: Some sedatives produce the paradoxical effect of making the person more anxious...

ext.ext_cn: 我们是一个保持了个体的团队——尽管这听起来自相矛盾。
ext.ext_en: We were a team of individuals —  as paradoxical as that sounds.

defs.def_en: If something is paradoxical, it involves two facts or qualities which seem to contradict each other.

ext.ext_cn: 爸爸很宠我，很爱我。他总是护着我。
ext.ext_en: Dad spoils me. He loves me. He sticks up for me...

ext.ext_cn: 我能捍卫自己的权利。
ext.ext_en: I can stick up for myself...

defs.def_en: If you stick up for a person or a principle, you support or defend them forcefully.

defs.def_cn: （人或动物）被砍去头的，无头的
defs.def_en: If the body of a person or animal is headless, the head has been cut off.

ext.ext_cn: 双方可获得的法律资源不成比例
ext.ext_en: ...a disproportion in the legal resources available to the two sides.

defs.def_en: A disproportion is a state in which two things are unequal.

ext.ext_cn: 永恒不变的对错法则
ext.ext_en: ...the eternal and immutable principles of right and wrong.

defs.def_en: Something that is immutable will never change or cannot be changed.

defs.def_cn: （选举中）大获全胜，一面倒的胜利

ext.ext_cn: 他以压倒性多数赢得上月的总统选举。
ext.ext_en: He won last month's  presidential election by a landslide...

ext.ext_cn: 全国民主联盟在5个月前的选举中获得压倒性胜利。
ext.ext_en: The NLD won a landslide victory in the elections five months ago.

defs.def_en: A landslide is a victory in an election in which a person or political party gets far more votes or seats than their opponents.

ext.ext_cn: 风暴致使萨沃纳发生塌方和洪灾。
ext.ext_en: The storm caused landslides and flooding in Savona.

defs.def_en: A landslide is a large amount of earth and rocks falling down a cliff or the side of a mountain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 泰得斯小酒店舒适而又简洁。
ext.ext_en: The Tides Inn is both comfortable and unpretentious.

ext.ext_cn: 好听而又朴实无华的流行音乐
ext.ext_en: ...good, unpretentious pop music...

defs.def_en: If you describe a place, person, or thing as unpretentious, you approve of them because they are simple in appearance or character, rather than sophisticated or luxurious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 工作场地是个空荡荡的大仓库。
ext.ext_en: The work space is a bare and cavernous warehouse.

defs.def_en: A cavernous room or building is very large inside, and so it reminds you of a cave.

ext.ext_cn: 公司放弃了自己的石油股份。
ext.ext_en: The company divested itself of its oil interests.

defs.def_en: If you divest yourself of something that you own or are responsible for, you get rid of it or stop being responsible for it.

ext.ext_cn: 在20世纪60年代，性爱不再被看作是罪恶时
ext.ext_en: ...in the 1960s, when sexual love had been divested of sin...

ext.ext_cn: 他们使仪式失去了原来的意义。
ext.ext_en: They have divested rituals of their original meaning...

defs.def_en: If something or someone is divested of a particular quality, they lose that quality or it is taken away from them.

ext.ext_cn: 为她脱去外衣的礼节
ext.ext_en: ...the formalities of divesting her of her coat.

ext.ext_cn: 安装在入口处让年轻人放下身上带的枪和刀的探测器
ext.ext_en: ...detectors installed at the entrances to make youngsters divest themselves of guns and knives.

defs.def_en: If you divest someone of something that they are wearing or carrying, you take it off them or away from them.

defs.def_cn: 终有一死的;不能永生的

ext.ext_cn: 人注定终有一死：长大、衰老，然后消亡。
ext.ext_en: A man is deliberately designed to be mortal. He grows, he ages, and he dies.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the fact that people are mortal, you mean that they have to die and cannot live for ever.

ext.ext_cn: 普通人好像根本买不到票。
ext.ext_en: Tickets seem unobtainable to the ordinary mortal.

ext.ext_cn: 但凡世人皆不可能达到的要求
ext.ext_en: ...impossible needs for any mere mortal to meet.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone as a mortal when you want to say that they are an  ordinary person.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 警察在保护自己和他人免遭致命危险。
ext.ext_en: The police were defending themselves and others against mortal danger...

ext.ext_cn: 广播当时被视为是现场音乐表演的死对头。
ext.ext_en: Broadcasting was regarded at the time as the mortal enemy of live music-making.

defs.def_en: You can use mortal to show that something is very serious or may cause death.

ext.ext_cn: 自信心很强时，我们不再对妒忌感到极度惧怕。
ext.ext_en: When self-esteem is high, we lose our mortal fear of jealousy.

defs.def_en: You can use mortal to emphasize that a feeling is extremely great or severe.

ext.ext_cn: 身体与头脑相互影响。
ext.ext_en: The body and the mind interrelate...

ext.ext_cn: 这些细胞都有各自的具体分工,但它们也相互联系。
ext.ext_en: Each of these cells have their specific jobs to do, but they also interrelate with each other.

defs.def_en: If two or more things interrelate, there is a connection between them and they have an effect on each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不要吃不健康食品，如汉堡和薯条。
ext.ext_en: Avoid unhealthy foods such as hamburger and chips...

ext.ext_cn: 他在一个环境出了名恶劣的煤矿里工作。
ext.ext_en: He worked in the notoriously unhealthy environment of a coal mine.

defs.def_en: Something that is unhealthy is likely to cause illness or poor health.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我真的很不舒服。
ext.ext_en: I'm quite unhealthy really.

ext.ext_cn: 衣衫褴褛、脸色憔悴、一副病容的人
ext.ext_en: ...a poorly dressed, unhealthy looking fellow with a poor complexion.

defs.def_en: If you are unhealthy, you are not very fit or well.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （经济体或公司）状况不佳的，面临财务危机的

ext.ext_cn: 技术熟练、经验丰富的工人过剩是可怕的浪费，也是经济运行不良的明显征兆。
ext.ext_en: The redundancy of skilled and experienced workers is a terrible waste and a clear sign of an unhealthy economy.

defs.def_en: An unhealthy economy or company is financially weak and unsuccessful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行为或爱好）不正常的，病态的

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰克与这些人的关系在我看来不正常。
ext.ext_en: Frank has developed what I would term an unhealthy relationship with these people...

ext.ext_cn: 本届政府在保密方面做过了头。
ext.ext_en: This government has developed an unhealthy obsession with secrecy...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour or interests as unhealthy, you do not consider them to be normal and think they may involve mental problems.

defs.def_cn: （尤指令人觉得愚蠢的）喜出风头癖，表现癖

ext.ext_cn: 那对父母的表现也显得有些爱出风头。
ext.ext_en: There is an element of exhibitionism in the parents' performance too.

defs.def_en: Exhibitionism is behaviour that tries to get people's attention all the time, and especially behaviour that most people think is silly.

ext.ext_cn: 曾经覆盖着布列塔尼大区内陆的茂密的原始森林
ext.ext_en: ...the dense primeval forests that once covered inland Brittany.

ext.ext_cn: 辽阔的原始沼泽地
ext.ext_en: ...a vast expanse of primeval swamp.

defs.def_en: You use primeval to describe things that belong to a very early period in the history of the world.

defs.def_cn: （感觉、情感）本能的，原始的，天性的

ext.ext_cn: 一种迫切想要攻击令他痛苦的事物的本能
ext.ext_en: ...a primeval urge to hit out at that which causes him pain.

defs.def_en: You use primeval to describe feelings and emotions that are basic and not the result of thought.

ext.ext_cn: 警卫不让她进去。
ext.ext_en: The sentry would not let her enter...

ext.ext_cn: 你不是应该在站岗吗？
ext.ext_en: Aren't you supposed to be on sentry duty?

defs.def_en: A sentry is a soldier who guards a camp or a building.

defs.def_cn: 保持振作；支撑下去；不气馁

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽现在怎么样？
ext.ext_en: How's Mary bearing up?...

ext.ext_cn: 她害怕自己无法承受生孩子的痛苦。
ext.ext_en: She was frightened that she would be unable to bear up under the pain of childbirth.

defs.def_en: If you bear up when experiencing problems, you remain cheerful and show courage in spite of them.
A sound system is a set of equipment for playing recorded music, or for making a band's music able to be heard by everyone at a concert.

ext.ext_cn: 他每年的薪水加上担任许多董事职务的报酬高达一百万英镑。
ext.ext_en: He could earn up to £1m a year in salary and emoluments from many directorships.

defs.def_en: Emoluments are money or other forms of payment which a person receives for doing work.

ext.ext_cn: 他溺爱他 9 岁的儿子。
ext.ext_en: He dotes on his nine-year-old son.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone dotes on a person or a thing, you mean that they love or care about them very much and ignore any faults they may have.

defs.def_cn: (葡萄酒或雪利酒)中等甜度的，不太甜的
defs.def_en: Medium-dry wine or sherry is not very sweet.

defs.def_cn: 红树(生长于热带国家的沿海或江河之畔，其须根高于地面)

ext.ext_cn: 红树林沼泽
ext.ext_en: ...mangrove swamps.

defs.def_en: A mangrove or mangrove tree is a tree with roots which are above the ground and that grows along coasts or on the banks of large rivers in hot countries.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在房子前面漫步。
ext.ext_en: We ambled along in front of the houses...

ext.ext_cn: 他们慢慢地走回到汽车那儿。
ext.ext_en: Slowly they ambled back to the car.

defs.def_en: When you amble, you walk slowly and in a relaxed manner.

defs.def_cn: 自我管理的;自我调节的

ext.ext_cn: 一个自我管理的体制要运作起来，必须得到所有相关人员的一致认可。
ext.ext_en: For a self-regulatory system to work, the consent of all those involved is required.

defs.def_en: Self-regulatory systems, organizations, or activities are controlled by the people involved in them, rather than by outside organizations or rules.

ext.ext_cn: 肛门括约肌
ext.ext_en: ...the anal sphincter.

defs.def_en: A sphincter is a ring of muscle that surrounds an opening to the body and that can tighten to close this opening.

defs.def_cn: 调查官；巡视官；申诉专员

ext.ext_cn: 这份传单介绍了如何向银行意见调查官投诉。
ext.ext_en: The leaflet explains how to complain to the banking ombudsman.

defs.def_en: The ombudsman is an independent official who has been appointed to investigate complaints that people make against the government or public organizations.

defs.def_cn: 没完没了的；无休止的；毫无起色的

ext.ext_cn: 为了摆脱贫困的煎熬，他们的祖父离开了村子。
ext.ext_en: Their grandfather had left his village in order to escape the grinding poverty.

ext.ext_cn: 想要进入体育场困难重重
ext.ext_en: ...the grinding difficulty of getting to the stadium.

defs.def_en: If you describe a bad situation as grinding, you mean it never gets better, changes, or ends.

ext.ext_cn: 如果把水灌进油箱，汽车会猛然间停下来。
ext.ext_en: A car will come to a grinding halt if you put water in the petrol tank.

defs.def_en: If you say that something comes to a grinding halt, you are emphasizing that it stops very suddenly, especially before it was meant to.

ext.ext_cn: 她的目的是通过仔细观察他的相貌以判断他是否诚实。
ext.ext_en: Her purpose was to scrutinize his features to see if he was an honest man...

ext.ext_cn: 对劳埃德银行的业绩进行了仔细分析，以确定对其他银行的表现可以作何种期待。
ext.ext_en: Lloyds' results were carefully scrutinised as a guide to what to expect from the other banks.

defs.def_en: If you scrutinize something, you examine it very carefully, often to find out some information from it or about it.

ext.ext_cn: 相传生活在苏格兰一个漆黑深水湖中的妖怪
ext.ext_en: The monster, which is reputed to live in the deep dark water of a Scottish loch...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is reputed to be true, you mean that people say it is true, but you do not know if it is definitely true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她注意到入口处站着一个小小的身影。
ext.ext_en: She noticed a diminutive figure standing at the entrance.

defs.def_en: A diminutive person or object is very small.
A diminutive is an informal form of a name. For example, 'Jim' and 'Jimmy' are diminutives of 'James'.

defs.def_cn: 指小词缀(表示亲昵或某东西很小的后缀，如 -ie 和 -ette)
defs.def_en: A diminutive is a suffix which is added to a word to show affection or to indicate that something is small. For example, '-ie' and '-ette' are diminutives, for example in 'doggie' and 'statuette'.

ext.ext_cn: 房子已经被封了，门被闩上，防止有人入内。
ext.ext_en: The house has been barred and bolted to prevent re-entry...

ext.ext_cn: 这些军人在考虑重返政界。
ext.ext_en: The military men are contemplating a re-entry into politics.

defs.def_en: Re-entry is the act of returning to a place, organization, or area of activity that you have left.

defs.def_cn: （航天器的）重返大气层，返回地球

ext.ext_cn: 空间站在重返地球大气层时会被烧毁。
ext.ext_en: The station would burn up on re-entry into the earth's atmosphere.

defs.def_en: Re-entry is used to refer to the moment when a spacecraft comes back into the earth's atmosphere after being in space.

defs.def_cn: （17世纪和18世纪早期流行于欧洲的一种设计繁复的建筑和艺术风格）巴洛克式的，巴洛克风格的

ext.ext_cn: 圣莱昂纳多的巴洛克式教堂值得一看。
ext.ext_en: The baroque church of San Leonardo is worth a quick look.

ext.ext_cn: 从中世纪到巴洛克时期的珍宝藏品
ext.ext_en: ...a collection of treasures dating from the Middle Ages to the Baroque period.

defs.def_en: Baroque architecture and art is an elaborate style of architecture and art that was popular in Europe in the seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries.

defs.def_cn: （18世纪欧洲音乐）巴洛克式的，巴洛克风格的

ext.ext_cn: 德国巴洛克风格的作曲家格奥尔格·菲利普·泰勒曼
ext.ext_en: ...the German baroque composer Georg Philip Telemann...

ext.ext_cn: 六七十年代人们对巴洛克音乐的兴趣只得到了缓慢的发展。
ext.ext_en: A more widespread interest in baroque music developed only slowly in the Sixties and Seventies.

defs.def_en: Baroque music is a style of European music that was written in the 18th century.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 复杂精美的；精雕细琢的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个巴罗克式的人物，衣着华丽但又不失优雅。
ext.ext_en: He was a baroque figure dressed in theatrical, but elegant, clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 保罗·马尔登，现代诗人中语言最为精致华丽者之一
ext.ext_en: ...Paul Muldoon, who is among the most baroque of contemporary poets.

defs.def_en: Baroque things are complicated and elaborate.

ext.ext_cn: 协作研究项目
ext.ext_en: ...a collaborative research project...

ext.ext_cn: 《第一天》是他们的首张合作专辑。
ext.ext_en: 'The First Day' is their first collaborative album.

defs.def_en: A collaborative piece of work is done by two or more people or groups working together.

ext.ext_cn: 学工科的女孩的比例已经大大增加了。
ext.ext_en: The percentage of girls in engineering has increased substantially...

ext.ext_cn: 80 岁人的皮肤与 20 岁人的皮肤看起来有天壤之别。
ext.ext_en: The skin of an eighty-year-old looks substantially different from that of a twenty-year-old...

defs.def_en: If something changes substantially or is substantially different, it changes a lot or is very different.

defs.def_cn: 基本上;大体上;总的来说

ext.ext_cn: 他核实了一下给出的细节，发现它们基本正确。
ext.ext_en: He checked the details given and found them substantially correct...

ext.ext_cn: 而英国广播公司的电视节目在其他方面基本没有变化。
ext.ext_en: BBC Television remains otherwise substantially unchanged.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is substantially correct or unchanged, you mean that it is mostly correct or mostly unchanged.

defs.def_cn: 银莲花，风花（花色分红、紫、白等颜色的园圃植物）
defs.def_en: An anemone is a garden plant with red, purple, or white flowers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指婴儿)腹绞痛的，急性腹痛的
defs.def_en: If someone, especially a baby, is colicky, they are suffering from colic.

ext.ext_cn: 内维斯湖附近一个偏僻的小农场
ext.ext_en: ...a remote croft near Loch Nevis.

defs.def_en: In Scotland, a croft is a small piece of land which is owned and farmed by one family and which provides them with food.

ext.ext_cn: 学员在通过驾照考试前可能得参加笔试。
ext.ext_en: Learners may have to take a written exam before they pass their driving test...

ext.ext_cn: 埃米发现理论和笔头作业对她来说十分容易。
ext.ext_en: Amy discovered that the theoretical and written work came easily to her.

defs.def_en: A written test or piece of work is one which involves writing rather than doing something practical or giving spoken answers.

defs.def_cn: (协议、规定、法律等)成文的，书面的

ext.ext_cn: 这家报纸违反了不出售某些摄影作品的书面协议。
ext.ext_en: The newspaper broke a written agreement not to sell certain photographs...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在等美国人的书面确认。
ext.ext_en: We're waiting for written confirmation from the Americans.

defs.def_en: A written agreement, rule, or law has been officially written down.

defs.def_cn: 简化管理结构;压缩管理层次

ext.ext_cn: 裁员、简化管理机构以及其他削减成本的措施
ext.ext_en: ...downsizing, delayering and other cost cutting measures.

defs.def_en: Delayering is the process of simplifying the administrative structure of a large organization in order to make it more efficient.

ext.ext_cn: 她的天真烂漫很快就暴露了艺术界的矫揉造作。
ext.ext_en: Her wide-eyed innocence soon exposes the pretensions of the art world...

ext.ext_cn: 我们喜欢他的诚实、不浮夸。
ext.ext_en: We like him for his honesty, his lack of pretension.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has pretensions, you disapprove of them because they claim or pretend that they are more important than they really are.

ext.ext_cn: 这个城市不切实际地标榜自己为国际都市。
ext.ext_en: The city has unrealistic pretensions to world-class status...

ext.ext_cn: 它仍然是一个压力集团，但不再自称是一个政党。
ext.ext_en: It will remain as a pressure group, but no longer has any pretension to be a political party.

defs.def_en: If someone has pretensions to something, they claim to be or do that thing.

defs.def_cn: (通常指女子的衣服)紧贴身体的，贴身的

ext.ext_cn: 贴身的晚礼服
ext.ext_en: ...figure-hugging cocktail dresses.

defs.def_en: Figure-hugging clothes fit very close to the body of the person who is wearing them. Figure-hugging is usually used to describe clothes worn by women.

ext.ext_cn: 将会有免费停泊区。
ext.ext_en: Free moorings will be available.

ext.ext_cn: 停泊费
ext.ext_en: ...mooring fees.

defs.def_en: A mooring is a place where a boat can be tied so that it cannot move away, or the object it is tied to.

ext.ext_cn: 他关掉发动机，抓住系船的绳子。
ext.ext_en: He cut the engine and grabbed the mooring lines...

ext.ext_cn: 急救人员担心燃烧着的船只可能会脱链滑走。
ext.ext_en: Emergency workers fear that the burning ship could slip its moorings.

defs.def_en: Moorings are the ropes, chains, and other objects used to moor a boat.

ext.ext_cn: 德肋撒嬷嬷是一位毕生致力于消除贫困事业的年迈修女。
ext.ext_en: Mother Teresa is an elderly nun who has devoted her life to fighting poverty...

ext.ext_cn: 计划设立更多单位防控森林火灾。
ext.ext_en: More units to fight forest fires are planned...

defs.def_en: If you fight something unpleasant, you try in a determined way to prevent it or stop it happening.

ext.ext_cn: 我们政府应该努力废止食物补贴。
ext.ext_en: Our Government should be fighting for an end to food subsidies...

ext.ext_cn: 李不得不为在考察队中获得一席之地而苦苦争取。
ext.ext_en: Lee had to fight hard for his place on the expedition...

defs.def_en: If you fight for something, you try in a determined way to get it or achieve it.

ext.ext_cn: 这两个男人为土地和水的使用权发生了争斗。
ext.ext_en: The two men fought a battle over land and water rights...

ext.ext_cn: 在周末发生的最近一起暴力事件中，警方与向他们投掷手榴弹的一伙匪徒展开了枪战。
ext.ext_en: In the latest incident at the weekend police fought a gun battle with a gang which used hand grenades against them...

defs.def_en: If an army or group fights a battle with another army or group, they oppose each other with weapons. You can also say that two armies or groups fight a battle.

ext.ext_cn: 他参了战，后被美国人俘虏。
ext.ext_en: He fought in the war and was taken prisoner by the Americans...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我是个年轻人，我宁愿进监狱也不愿为这个国家打仗。
ext.ext_en: If I were a young man I would sooner go to prison than fight for this country...

defs.def_en: See also:dogfight;If a person or army fights in a battle or a war, they take part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 她小时候会和妹妹打架。
ext.ext_en: As a child she fought with her younger sister...

ext.ext_cn: 我确实和他打了起来，我挥拳向他猛击，但就像打在墙上一样。
ext.ext_en: I did fight him, I punched him but it was like hitting a wall...

defs.def_en: If one person fights with another, or fights them, the two people hit or kick each other because they want to hurt each other. You can also say that two people fight .

ext.ext_cn: 她总是跟他争辩吵嘴。
ext.ext_en: She was always arguing with him and fighting with him...

ext.ext_cn: 格温德琳开始同老师争执起来。
ext.ext_en: Gwendolen started fighting her teachers...

defs.def_en: If one person fights with another, or fights them, they have an angry disagreement or quarrel. You can also say that two people fight .

ext.ext_cn: 我刚挤进车厢，车门就关上了。
ext.ext_en: I fought my way into a carriage just before the doors closed...

ext.ext_cn: 彼得为了救其中一只鸡在暴风雪中艰难前行。
ext.ext_en: Peter fought his way through a blizzard to save one of the chickens.

defs.def_en: If you fight your way to a place, you move towards it with great difficulty, for example because there are a lot of people or obstacles in your way.

ext.ext_cn: 这是海尔的最后一场比赛，因为再没有人向他发起挑战。
ext.ext_en: This was Hyer's last fight, for no one else challenged him...

ext.ext_cn: 裁判叫停了比赛。
ext.ext_en: The referee stopped the fight.

defs.def_en: A fight is a boxing match.

ext.ext_cn: 几个小时后，世界最著名的拳击手之一将开始其在英国的首场比赛。
ext.ext_en: In a few hours' time one of the world's most famous boxers will be fighting in Britain for the first time...

ext.ext_cn: 我想和他对阵，因为他从没有输过，而我想成为打败他的第一人。
ext.ext_en: I'd like to fight him because he's undefeated and I want to be the first man to beat him...

defs.def_en: To fight means to take part in a boxing match.

ext.ext_cn: 该党的前任财政部长帮助筹集了近 4,000 万英镑用于竞选。
ext.ext_en: The former party treasurer helped raise almost £40 million to fight the election campaign.

defs.def_en: If you fight an election, you are a candidate in the election and try to win it.

ext.ext_cn: 两党间的权力之争
ext.ext_en: ...the fight for power between the two parties.

defs.def_en: You can use fight to refer to a contest such as an election or a sports match.

defs.def_cn: 进行(诉讼、辩护等);打(官司)

ext.ext_cn: 沃特金斯将军队诉至法院，并在各级法庭打了 10 年的官司。
ext.ext_en: Watkins sued the Army and fought his case in various courts for 10 years...

ext.ext_cn: 这家报纸正和提起损害赔偿诉讼的女演员对簿公堂。
ext.ext_en: The newspaper is fighting a damages action brought by the actress.

defs.def_en: If you fight a case or a court action, you make a legal case against someone in a very determined way, or you put forward a defence when a legal case is made against you.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得我们斗志高昂。
ext.ext_en: I thought that we had a lot of fight in us.

defs.def_en: Fight is the desire or ability to keep fighting.

defs.def_cn: 努力克制，竭力抑制(感情或欲望)

ext.ext_cn: 我拼命地想忍住笑。
ext.ext_en: I desperately fought the urge to giggle...

ext.ext_cn: 他努力克制自己的烟瘾，不去抽一支戒掉没多久的雪茄。
ext.ext_en: He fought with the urge to smoke one of the cigars he'd given up awhile ago...

defs.def_en: If you fight an emotion or desire, you try very hard not to feel it, show it, or act on it, but do not always succeed.
If you fight for breath, you try to breathe but find it very difficult.

defs.def_cn: 经过努力才能成功的机会;需要极大好运的机会

ext.ext_cn: 当他们没有立即向我开枪时，我估摸自己还有一线生机。
ext.ext_en: When they didn't shoot at me right away, I figured I had a fighting chance.

defs.def_en: If you have a fighting chance of doing or achieving something, it is possible that you will do or achieve it, but only if you make a great effort or are very lucky.

ext.ext_cn: 昨夜睡得很香，我又觉得自己精力充沛了。
ext.ext_en: After a good night's sleep I feel fighting fit again.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as fighting fit, you are emphasizing that they are very fit or healthy.

defs.def_cn: 与死神殊死搏斗;奋力求生

ext.ext_cn: 他仍在医院与死神搏斗。
ext.ext_en: He is still fighting for his life in hospital.

defs.def_en: Someone who is fighting for their life is making a great effort to stay alive, either when they are being physically attacked or when they are very ill.

ext.ext_cn: 当那两名男子还击时，袭击他们的少年逃之夭夭。
ext.ext_en: The teenage attackers fled when the two men fought back...

ext.ext_cn: 司法制度有能力惩治腐败，这应使我们感到些许欣慰。
ext.ext_en: We should take some comfort from the ability of the judicial system to fight back against corruption.

defs.def_en: If you fight back against someone or something that is attacking or harming you, you resist them actively or attack them.

defs.def_cn: 强忍住，抑制住(感情或欲望)

ext.ext_cn: 她强忍住眼泪。
ext.ext_en: She fought back the tears.

defs.def_en: If you fight back an emotion or a desire, you try very hard not to feel it, show it, or act on it.

defs.def_cn: 强忍住，抑制住(感情或欲望)

ext.ext_cn: 梅格极力忍住不跑。
ext.ext_en: Meg fought down the desire to run...

ext.ext_cn: 他看着电话，把绝望和愤怒一一压下。
ext.ext_en: He looked at the telephone, fighting down first the despair and then the anger.

defs.def_en: If you fight down an emotion or a desire, you try very hard not to feel it, show it, or act on it.

defs.def_cn: 抵抗，战胜(疾病);摆脱(不快)

ext.ext_cn: 可惜的是，这些药物毒性很大，会削弱身体对感染的抵抗力。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately these drugs are quite toxic and hinder the body's ability to fight off infection...

ext.ext_cn: 她一整天都在克制自己想给哈里打电话的冲动。
ext.ext_en: All day she had fought off the impulse to telephone Harry.

defs.def_en: If you fight off something, for example an illness or an unpleasant feeling, you succeed in getting rid of it and in not letting it overcome you.

ext.ext_cn: 这名女子打跑了袭击她的人。
ext.ext_en: The woman fought off the attacker.

defs.def_en: If you fight off someone who has attacked you, you fight with them, and succeed in making them go away or stop attacking you.

defs.def_cn: 在…上一争高下;通过比出胜负解决

ext.ext_cn: 他没有以牙还牙，而是径直走开，让队友去争出个结果。
ext.ext_en: Instead of retaliating, he walks away leaving his team-mates to fight it out...

ext.ext_cn: 马尔科姆自我放逐到了巴黎，但他继续要和朱利恩斗到底。
ext.ext_en: Malcolm continued to fight it out with Julien from his self-imposed exile in Paris.

defs.def_en: If two people or groups fight something out, they fight or argue until one of them wins.

defs.def_cn: 铁路上使用的全部车辆（包括机车和车厢）

ext.ext_cn: 许多车站需要维修或重建，而且铁路车辆也出现短缺。
ext.ext_en: Many stations needed repairs or rebuilding and there was a shortage of rolling stock.

defs.def_en: Rolling stock is all the engines and carriages that are used on a railway.
A gasket is a flat piece of soft material that you put between two joined surfaces in a pipe or engine in order to make sure that gas and oil cannot escape.
Packet-switching is a method of sending computer data on telephone lines which automatically divides the data into short pieces in order to send it and puts it together again when it is received.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 劣等的;粗制滥造的;做工粗糙的

ext.ext_cn: 对劣质服务我通常会立刻投诉。
ext.ext_en: I'm normally quick to complain about shoddy service...

ext.ext_cn: 美国的顾客不再容忍劣等货了。
ext.ext_en: American customers no longer tolerate shoddy goods.

defs.def_en: Shoddy work or a shoddy product has been done or made carelessly or badly.

ext.ext_cn: 警方已排除因抢劫而杀人的可能。
ext.ext_en: Police have ruled out robbery as a motive for the killing.

ext.ext_cn: 英国外交政策的动机和目标
ext.ext_en: ...the motives and objectives of British foreign policy...

defs.def_en: Your motive for doing something is your reason for doing it.

defs.def_cn: (从 0 到 9 的任何一个)数字

ext.ext_cn: 她的电话号码和我的只差一个数字。
ext.ext_en: Her telephone number differs from mine by one digit.

defs.def_en: A digit is a written symbol for any of the ten numbers from 0 to 9.

ext.ext_cn: 许多动物有 5 趾。
ext.ext_en: Many animals have five digits.

defs.def_en: A digit is a finger, thumb, or toe.

defs.def_cn: (可供两人以上坐的、有靠背及扶手的)长沙发，长靠椅
defs.def_en: A settee is a long comfortable seat with a back and arms, which two or more people can sit on.
In former times, serfs were a class of people who had to work on a particular person's land and could not leave without that person's permission.
A drumstick is the lower part of the leg of a bird such as a chicken which is cooked and eaten.
Drumsticks are sticks used for beating a drum.

defs.def_cn: 时间表;时间安排;日程表

ext.ext_cn: 时间表制定得过于乐观。
ext.ext_en: The timetable was hopelessly optimistic…

ext.ext_cn: 难道你没意识到我们是有一个时间表的吗？我们必须出成果。
ext.ext_en: Don't you realize we're working to a timetable? We have to have results...

defs.def_en: A timetable is a plan of the times when particular events are to take place.

ext.ext_cn: 课程选择视教师的时间与课程表的限制而定。
ext.ext_en: Options are offered subject to staff availability and the constraints of the timetable...

ext.ext_cn: 协会成员将继续教授所有课程。
ext.ext_en: Members of the union will continue to teach their full timetables.

defs.def_en: In a school or college, a timetable is a list that shows the times in the week at which particular subjects are taught. You can also refer to the range of subjects that a student learns or the classes that a teacher teaches as their timetable .

ext.ext_cn: 若要当地公共汽车时刻表，请与达费德郡政务委员会联系。
ext.ext_en: For a local bus timetable, contact Dyfed County Council.

defs.def_en: A timetable is a list of the times when trains, boats, buses, or aeroplanes are supposed to arrive at or leave from a particular place.

ext.ext_cn: 这两天都将安排发出 3 列时刻不同的火车。
ext.ext_en: On both days, three very different trains will be timetabled...

ext.ext_cn: 奥佩被安排每周工作 4 天。
ext.ext_en: Opie is timetabled to work a four-day week.

defs.def_en: If something is timetabled, it is scheduled to happen or do something at a particular time.
A cot is a bed for a baby, with bars or panels round it so that the baby cannot fall out.
A cot is a narrow bed, usually made of canvas fitted over a frame which can be folded up.

ext.ext_cn: 列车驶入了一个车站。
ext.ext_en: The train pulled into a station...

ext.ext_cn: 我们能赶上凌晨的火车。
ext.ext_en: We can catch the early morning train...

defs.def_en: A train is a number of carriages, cars, or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Trains carry people and goods from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 在过去，这往往由一队驮载行李的骆驼完成。
ext.ext_en: In the old days this used to be done with a baggage train of camels.

ext.ext_cn: 一长队油轮
ext.ext_en: ...a long train of oil tankers.

defs.def_en: A train of vehicles, people, or animals is a long line of them travelling slowly in the same direction.

defs.def_cn: (想法、事件等的)(一)连串，(一)系列

ext.ext_cn: 他一时思维短路，然后又重新想了起来。
ext.ext_en: He lost his train of thought for a moment, then recovered it...

ext.ext_cn: 贾尔斯触发了随后的一系列事件，这些事件最终将以悲剧收场。
ext.ext_en: Giles set in motion a train of events which would culminate in tragedy.

defs.def_en: A train of thought or a train of events is a connected sequence, in which each thought or event seems to occur naturally or logically as a result of the previous one.
The train of a woman's formal dress or wedding dress is the long part at the back of it which flows along the floor behind her.

ext.ext_cn: 仪式马上就要开始了。
ext.ext_en: In a moment the ceremony was in train…

ext.ext_cn: 他称赞政府启动的经济改革。
ext.ext_en: He praised the economic reforms set in train by the government.

defs.def_en: If a process or event is in train or has been set in train, it is happening or starting to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车随之带来其他一大堆问题。
ext.ext_en: The cars have brought in their train a host of other problems.

defs.def_en: If something brings problems or difficulties in its train, the problems or difficulties occur as a natural or logical result of it.

ext.ext_cn: 美国准备训练军队参加。
ext.ext_en: The US was ready to train its troops to participate...

ext.ext_cn: 斯塔夫罗斯正受训成为一名牧师。
ext.ext_en: Stavros was training to be a priest...

defs.def_en: If someone trains you to do something, they teach you the skills that you need in order to do it. If you train to do something, you learn the skills that you need in order to do it.

defs.def_cn: 锻炼，培养(某一素质或能力)

ext.ext_cn: 我把学位视为可以锻炼心智、增加就业机会的东西。
ext.ext_en: I see my degree as something which will train my mind and improve my chances of getting a job...

ext.ext_cn: 一些孩子在入学时比其他孩子受过更好的感知技能培养。
ext.ext_en: Some children come to school with more finely trained perceptual skills than others.

defs.def_en: To train a natural quality or talent that someone has, for example their voice or musical ability, means to help them to develop it.

defs.def_cn: (为体育活动)(使)进行训练(或锻炼)

ext.ext_cn: 斯特罗恩正为新的赛季进行训练。
ext.ext_en: Strachan is training for the new season...

ext.ext_cn: 他已花了一年时间为下个月的环球比赛训练队伍。
ext.ext_en: He has spent a year training crews for next month's round the world race.

defs.def_en: If you train for a physical activity such as a race or if someone trains you for it, you prepare for it by doing particular physical exercises.

ext.ext_cn: 可以训练嗅探犬追捕他们。
ext.ext_en: Sniffer dogs could be trained to track them down.

ext.ext_cn: 训练过数百只狗的人
ext.ext_en: ...a man who trained hundreds of dogs...

defs.def_en: If an animal or bird is trained to do particular things, it is taught to do them, for example in order to be able to work for someone or to be a good pet.

ext.ext_cn: 她将双筒望远镜对准地平线。
ext.ext_en: She trained her binoculars on the horizon...

ext.ext_cn: 警方摄像头已特别对准那一区域。
ext.ext_en: Police cameras had been specifically trained on that area.

defs.def_en: If you train something such as a gun, a camera, or a light on a person or thing, you aim it at them and keep it towards them.

defs.def_cn: (经整枝)使(植物)朝特定方向生长

ext.ext_cn: 不要让嫩枝爬上篱笆，要令其沿着篱笆伏地向两边长。
ext.ext_en: Instead of training the shoots up the fence, lay them flat in both directions alongside it...

ext.ext_cn: 你甚至可以在墙上搭置棚架，让植物攀缘其上。
ext.ext_en: You could even put a trellis on your walls and train plants to grow up it.

defs.def_en: If you train a tree, bush, or plant in a particular direction, you tie it and cut it so that it grows in that direction.

ext.ext_cn: 蒙面强盗闯了进来，抢走了8,000美元。
ext.ext_en: Masked robbers broke in and made off with $8,000...

ext.ext_cn: 小偷是从二楼的窗户进入屋里的。
ext.ext_en: The thief had broken in through a first-floor window.

defs.def_en: See also:break-in;If someone, usually a thief, breaks in, they get into a building by force.

ext.ext_cn: 奥利里打断了他的思路。
ext.ext_en: O'Leary broke in on his thoughts...

ext.ext_cn: 萨瑟恩夫人兴致勃勃地听着，间或插话问一些相关的问题。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Southern listened keenly, occasionally breaking in with pertinent questions...

defs.def_en: If you break in on someone's conversation or activity, you interrupt them.

defs.def_cn: 使适应（新的工作或环境）

ext.ext_cn: 乐队在帮一名新的后备主唱进行磨合和适应。
ext.ext_en: The band are breaking in a new backing vocalist.

defs.def_en: If you break someone in, you get them used to a new job or situation.

defs.def_cn: 使(新产品）经使用逐渐合用；磨合

ext.ext_cn: 当磨合发动机时，最初的1,000英里里程内尽量不要高速行驶。
ext.ext_en: When breaking in an engine, you probably should refrain from high speed for the first thousand miles...

ext.ext_cn: 内森的新跑鞋不太合脚。
ext.ext_en: Nathan's new running shoes weren't broken in correctly.

defs.def_en: If you break in something new, you gradually use or wear it for longer and longer periods until it is ready to be used or worn all the time.

ext.ext_cn: 将订单和订金一同寄往《美宅周末》，海迪·罗斯收。
ext.ext_en: Send the coupon with your deposit to House Beautiful Weekend, FAO Heidi Ross.

defs.def_en: You use FAO when addressing a letter or parcel to a particular person. FAO is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) 'for the attention of'.
Handicrafts are activities such as embroidery and pottery which involve making things with your hands in a skilful way.

ext.ext_cn: 她向游客出售手工艺品。
ext.ext_en: She sells handicrafts to the tourists.

defs.def_en: Handicrafts are the objects that are produced by people doing handicrafts.

ext.ext_cn: 一段荧光带
ext.ext_en: ...a piece of fluorescent tape.

defs.def_en: A fluorescent surface, substance, or colour has a very bright appearance when light is directed onto it, as if it is actually shining itself.

ext.ext_cn: 荧光灯管
ext.ext_en: ...fluorescent light tubes.

defs.def_en: A fluorescent light shines with a very hard, bright light and is usually in the form of a long strip.

defs.def_cn: 银婚;结婚 25 周年纪念

ext.ext_cn: 他和海伦去年庆祝了他们的银婚。
ext.ext_en: He and Helen celebrated their silver wedding last year.

defs.def_en: A married couple's silver wedding or silver wedding anniversary is the 25th anniversary of their wedding.

ext.ext_cn: 他从帕洛斯-德拉弗龙特拉向西航行。
ext.ext_en: He sailed westward from Palos de la Frontera...

ext.ext_cn: 几小时以后她便抽出身来重新开始西行的旅程。
ext.ext_en: Within hours, she was free to resume her journey westward.

defs.def_en: Westward means towards the west.

defs.def_cn: 极瘦弱的人；无家可归者;流浪儿

ext.ext_cn: 五六岁大、脸上脏兮兮的流浪儿
ext.ext_en: ...a dirty-faced waif of some five or six years...

ext.ext_cn: 导演想要一个留着乌黑的长发、面黄肌瘦的十来岁女孩扮演这个角色。
ext.ext_en: The director wants a waif-like, teenage girl with long, dark hair for the role.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a child or young woman as a waif, you mean that they are very thin and look as if they have nowhere to live.

ext.ext_en: ...episodic attacks of fever.

defs.def_en: Something that is episodic occurs at irregular and infrequent intervals.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 仅靠时间和地点把那些不相关的角色联系在一起的片段式叙述
ext.ext_en: ...an episodic narrative of unrelated characters connected only by time and place.

defs.def_en: An episodic piece of writing or film consists of a series of events, which often seem not to be connected.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 银行家们害怕会发生一场全球银行业危机。
ext.ext_en: Bankers were fearful of a world banking crisis...

ext.ext_cn: 我以前经常感到非常恐惧，非常愤怒，非常孤独。
ext.ext_en: I had often been very fearful, very angry, and very isolated.

defs.def_en: If you are fearful of something, you are afraid of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 该地区处于严重的经济衰退中。
ext.ext_en: The region is in a fearful recession.

ext.ext_cn: 单方面军事行动可能造成的可怕后果
ext.ext_en: ...the fearful consequences which might flow from unilateral military moves.

defs.def_en: You use fearful to emphasize how serious or bad a situation is.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: You gave me a fearful shock!

ext.ext_cn: “这听起来是极为令人生畏的艰苦工作。”西比尔后来说。
ext.ext_en: 'It sounds the most fearful hard work,' Sybil said later.

defs.def_en: Fearful is used to emphasize that something is very bad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He towelled his wet hair...

ext.ext_en: I lowered myself to the water's edge, getting my feet wet...

defs.def_en: If something is wet, it is covered in water, rain, sweat, tears, or another liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 捏合馅饼时，要弄湿两张饼皮粘连的地方。
ext.ext_en: When assembling the pie, wet the edges where the two crusts join...

ext.ext_en: Fielding nervously wet his lips and tried to smile.

defs.def_en: To wet something means to get water or some other liquid over it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如果碰上下雨天或是严寒天气，就选择一项室内活动。
ext.ext_en: If the weather is wet or cold choose an indoor activity...

ext.ext_en: It was a miserable wet day.

defs.def_en: If the weather is wet, it is raining.

ext.ext_cn: 我把油画平放以防止未干的颜料流动。
ext.ext_en: I lay the painting flat to stop the wet paint running...

ext.ext_cn: 她用水泥抹墙，并趁它还没干时粘上贝壳。
ext.ext_en: She rendered the walls in cement and, while it was still wet, applied the shells.

defs.def_en: If something such as paint, ink, or cement is wet, it is not yet dry or solid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 当他尿湿了的时候，给他换尿布。
ext.ext_en: Change him when he's wet...

ext.ext_cn: 除非尿布脏了或非常湿，否则别换。
ext.ext_en: Avoid changing a nappy unless it's dirty or very wet.

defs.def_en: If a child or its nappy or clothing is wet, its nappy or clothing is soaked in urine.

ext.ext_en: A quarter of 4-year-olds frequently wet the bed...

ext.ext_cn: 说白了就是，他们尿裤子了。
ext.ext_en: To put it plainly, they wet themselves.

defs.def_en: If people, especially children, wet their beds or clothes or wet themselves, they urinate in their beds or in their clothes because they cannot stop themselves.
Wet fish is fish that is sold fresh and uncooked, and not frozen or dried.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人)软弱的，窝囊的，没有信心的

ext.ext_en: Don't be so wet, Charles.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is wet, you mean that they are weak and lacking in enthusiasm, energy, or confidence.

ext.ext_cn: 左派，也就是所谓的“温和派”，认为更多的政府支出将意味着更多的就业机会。
ext.ext_en: The left, the so-called 'wets', thought more state spending would mean more jobs.

defs.def_en: A wet is a Conservative politician who supports moderate political policies and opposes extreme ones.

defs.def_cn: 年轻且无经验的；乳臭未干的
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is still wet behind the ears, you mean that they have only recently arrived in a new place or job, and are therefore still not experienced.

defs.def_cn: （因涉嫌参与违法活动而遭到的）（本宅）软禁

ext.ext_en: The main opposition leaders had been arrested or placed under house arrest...

ext.ext_cn: 他两年前被解除软禁。
ext.ext_en: He was released from house arrest two years ago.

defs.def_en: If someone is under house arrest, they are officially ordered not to leave their home, because they are suspected of being involved in an illegal activity.

ext.ext_cn: 辩论完全跑题
ext.ext_en: ...the utter irrelevance of the debate.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the irrelevance of something, you mean that it is irrelevant.

defs.def_cn: 枝节问题;无关紧要的事

ext.ext_cn: 爱国者战线在政治上一直无足轻重。
ext.ext_en: The Patriotic Front has been a political irrelevance.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as an irrelevance, you have a low opinion of it because it is not important in a situation.
An optometrist is the same as an optician .

ext.ext_cn: 我讯问了每个人,甚至连稍有关联的人都没放过。
ext.ext_en: I interrogated everyone even slightly involved.

defs.def_en: If someone, especially a police officer, interrogates someone, they question them thoroughly for a long time in order to get some information from them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个温顺随和的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a meek, mild-mannered fellow.

ext.ext_cn: 众人之中最温顺驯良的一个
ext.ext_en: ...the meekest and most docile of people.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as meek, you think that they are gentle and quiet, and likely to do what other people say.

defs.def_cn: 使丢脸;有辱…的人格;降低…的身份

ext.ext_cn: 认为色情作品有辱女性尊严的观念
ext.ext_en: ...the notion that pornography degrades women...

ext.ext_cn: 我问他是否找过妓女时，他说他不会自贬身份去干那种事情。
ext.ext_en: When I asked him if he had ever been to a prostitute he said he wouldn't degrade himself like that.

defs.def_en: Something that degrades someone causes people to have less respect for them.

ext.ext_cn: 无限制地满足人类需求而不造成环境退化的能力
ext.ext_en: ...the ability to meet human needs indefinitely without degrading the environment.

defs.def_en: To degrade something means to cause it to get worse.

ext.ext_cn: 这种物质在土壤里会迅速降解。
ext.ext_en: This substance degrades rapidly in the soil.

ext.ext_cn: 这些酶降解纤维素的能力
ext.ext_en: ...the ability of these enzymes to degrade cellulose.

defs.def_en: In science, if a substance degrades or if something degrades it, it changes chemically and decays or separates into different substances.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Someone who is knock-kneed has legs which turn inwards at the knees.

ext.ext_cn: 半圆形露天竞技场
ext.ext_en: ...a semi-circular amphitheatre.

defs.def_en: Something that is semi-circular has the shape of half a circle.

defs.def_cn: 踢开，丢弃，抛弃(不再有用的人或物)

ext.ext_en: Sweden needs to cast aside outdated policies and thinking...

ext.ext_cn: 公主由于不能诞下继承人，被无情地抛弃了。
ext.ext_en: The Princess was cruelly cast aside when she failed to produce an heir...

defs.def_en: If you cast aside someone or something, you get rid of them because they are no longer necessary or useful to you.
Sealing wax is a hard, usually red, substance that melts quickly and is used for putting seals on documents or letters.

ext.ext_cn: 电动搅拌器

A mixer is a non-alcoholic drink such as fruit juice that you mix with strong alcohol such as gin.

ext.ext_cn: 库珀擅长交际，人缘很好。
ext.ext_en: Cooper was a good mixer, he was popular.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a good mixer, you mean that they are good at talking to people and making friends.

ext.ext_cn: 有3个频道的音频混合器
ext.ext_en: ...a three channel audio mixer.

defs.def_en: A mixer is a piece of equipment that is used to make changes to recorded music or film.

defs.def_cn: 米制，公制(以米、克、升等为单位)
defs.def_en: The metric system is the system of measurement that uses metres, grams, and litres.

ext.ext_cn: 价格跌到了谷底。
ext.ext_en: Prices have hit rock bottom.

defs.def_en: If something has reached rock bottom, it is at such a low level that it cannot go any lower.

ext.ext_cn: 她整个人跌至了谷底。她漫长的爱情要告结束了，她也要崩溃了。
ext.ext_en: She was at rock bottom. Her long-term love affair was breaking up and so was she.

defs.def_en: If someone has reached rock bottom, they are in such a bad state or are so completely depressed that their situation could not get any worse.

ext.ext_cn: 他们提供的确实是物美价廉的产品。
ext.ext_en: What they do offer is a good product at a rock-bottom price.

defs.def_en: A rock-bottom price or level is a very low one, mainly in advertisements.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: Something that is hard is very firm and stiff to touch and is not easily bent, cut, or broken.

ext.ext_en: I'll work hard. I don't want to let him down...

ext.ext_en: Am I trying too hard?

defs.def_en: If you work hard doing something, you are very active or work intensely, with a lot of effort.

ext.ext_en: Coping with three babies is very hard work...

ext.ext_cn: 一天的辛苦工作

ext.ext_en: You had to listen hard to hear the old man breathe...

defs.def_en: If you look, listen, or think hard, you do it carefully and with a great deal of attention.

defs.def_en: If you strike or take hold of something hard, you strike or take hold of it with a lot of force.

ext.ext_en: I've never seen Terry laugh so hard...

ext.ext_cn: 当时雪下得很大。
ext.ext_en: It was snowing hard by then.

defs.def_en: You can use hard to indicate that something happens intensely and for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 那些岁月是非常艰难的。
ext.ext_en: Those were hard times.

defs.def_en: If you have a hard life or a hard period of time, your life or that period is difficult and unpleasant for you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我估计冬天会漫长而寒冷。
ext.ext_en: I am expecting a long, hard winter.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The sea was a hard blue.

defs.def_en: Hard colours or sounds are harsh or bright and unpleasant to see or hear.

ext.ext_en: There are probably fewer hard facts about the life of Henry Purcell than that of any other great composer since the Renaissance.

defs.def_en: Hard evidence or facts are definitely true and do not need to be questioned.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Paradise Street was a short, crowded street near the railway station and hard by the factory.

defs.def_en: If one thing is hard by another, it is very close to it.

ext.ext_cn: 酒店行李搬运工因为被迫延长当班时间而愤愤不平。
ext.ext_en: The hall porter was feeling hard done by at having to extend his shift.

defs.def_en: If you feel hard done by, you feel that you have not been treated fairly.

ext.ext_cn: 会谈从一开始就举步维艰。
ext.ext_en: The talks had been hard going at the start.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is hard going, you mean it is difficult and requires a lot of effort.

ext.ext_en: California's been particularly hard hit by the recession.

defs.def_en: To be hard hit by something means to be affected very severely by it.

defs.def_cn: 佯装不感兴趣;故意摆谱

defs.def_en: If someone plays hard to get, they pretend not to be interested in another person or in what someone is trying to persuade them to do.

defs.def_cn: 十分困难的;处于困境的

defs.def_en: If someone is hard put to do something or, in British English if they are hard pushed to do something, they have great difficulty doing it.

defs.def_en: If you take something hard, you are very upset or depressed by it.

ext.ext_en: ...a change in the political landscape.

ext.ext_cn: 愚不可及的情况
ext.ext_en: ...a landscape of unparalleled ignorance.

defs.def_en: A landscape is all the features that are important in a particular situation.

ext.ext_en: The gravel pits have been landscaped and planted to make them attractive to wildfowl...

ext.ext_en: ...socialist theoreticians.
