ext.ext_cn: 莫雷尔太太伸手去拿绕成圈的花园浇水用的软管。
ext.ext_en: Mrs. Morrell reached for a loop of garden hose.

defs.def_en: A loop is a curved or circular shape in something long, for example in a piece of string.

ext.ext_cn: 他把绳子绕到木头上。
ext.ext_en: He looped the rope over the wood...

ext.ext_cn: 他将链表绕挂在脖子上，就像戴了一枚大奖章。
ext.ext_en: He wore the watch and chain looped round his neck like a medallion.

defs.def_en: If you loop something such as a piece of rope around an object, you tie a length of it in a loop around the object, for example in order to fasten it to the object.

ext.ext_cn: 敌人正从南侧包抄过来。
ext.ext_en: The enemy was looping around the south side...

ext.ext_cn: 直升机起飞后向北飞行，接着又兜向西边，朝山那边飞去。
ext.ext_en: The helicopter took off and headed north. Then it looped west, heading for the hills.

defs.def_en: If something loops somewhere, it goes there in a circular direction that makes the shape of a loop.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为副总统是局内人。
ext.ext_en: I think that the vice president was in the loop...

ext.ext_cn: 这些活跃分子不想做局外人。
ext.ext_en: These activists don't want to feel out of the loop.

defs.def_en: If someone is in the loop, they are part of a group of people who make decisions about important things, or they know about these decisions. If they are out of the loop, they do not make or know about important decisions.

ext.ext_cn: 这些电池的寿命为 6 小时。
ext.ext_en: The batteries had a life span of six hours...

ext.ext_cn: 会议之间的间隔将逐渐延长。
ext.ext_en: Gradually the time span between sessions will increase.

defs.def_en: A span is the period of time between two dates or events during which something exists, functions, or happens.

ext.ext_cn: 他吸收信息的能力令人吃惊，但是他的注意力持续时间很短。
ext.ext_en: His ability to absorb information was astonishing, but his concentration span was short...

ext.ext_cn: 小孩子的注意力持续时间十分有限，不能长时间地专注于一个活动。
ext.ext_en: Young children have a limited attention span and can't concentrate on one activity for very long.

defs.def_en: Your concentration span or your attention span is the length of time you are able to concentrate on something or be interested in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的职业生涯持续了 16 年。
ext.ext_en: His professional career spanned 16 years...

ext.ext_cn: 这部时间跨度将近四分之一世纪的影片讲述的是亨利·希尔的故事。
ext.ext_en: The film, spanning almost a quarter-century, tells the story of Henry Hill...

defs.def_en: If something spans a long period of time, it lasts throughout that period of time or relates to that whole period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 伯恩斯坦创作的乐曲涉及了从交响乐到音乐剧等音乐的各个方面。
ext.ext_en: Bernstein's compositions spanned all aspects of music, from symphonies to musicals.

ext.ext_cn: 一个兴趣广泛、几乎涉猎了自然学科所有领域的杰出男性
ext.ext_en: ...a remarkable man whose interests spanned almost every aspect of nature.

defs.def_en: If something spans a range of things, all those things are included in it.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一只非常美丽的蝴蝶，翼展 2 英寸。
ext.ext_en: It is a very pretty butterfly, with a 2 inch wing span...

ext.ext_cn: 这也许是因为你并不晓得髋关节的位置，它不在腰部，而是位于腰部以下一手拃宽处。
ext.ext_en: It may be that you are unaware of where your hip joint is; it is not at the waist but a good hand span below it.

defs.def_en: The span of something that extends or is spread out sideways is the total width of it from one end to the other.

ext.ext_cn: 游客通过一座横跨小溪的步行桥从一边来到另一边。
ext.ext_en: Travellers get from one side to the other by walking across a footbridge that spans a little stream.

ext.ext_cn: 横越铁路的铁拱桥
ext.ext_en: ...the humped iron bridge spanning the railway...

defs.def_en: A bridge or other structure that spans something such as a river or a valley stretches right across it.

defs.def_cn: (置于名字后表示所属军队)英国皇家海军

ext.ext_cn: 朴次茅斯皇家海军博物馆
ext.ext_en: ...RN Museum, Portsmouth.

ext.ext_cn: 皇家海军中校理查德·艾拉德
ext.ext_en: ...Commander Richard Aylard RN.

defs.def_en: RN is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) Royal Navy, the navy of the United Kingdom. It is written after someone's name to show that they are an officer of the Royal Navy.
An autocrat is a person in authority who has complete power.
Plum tomatoes are long egg-shaped tomatoes.
Sociology is the study of society or of the way society is organized.
A cashier's desk is the same as a cash desk .

ext.ext_cn: 房间都进行了布置，重新营造出该城堡中世纪全盛时期的氛围。
ext.ext_en: The rooms are furnished and recreate the atmosphere of the castle's medieval heyday...

ext.ext_cn: 我正试图在远离家园的地方重建家庭生活。
ext.ext_en: I am trying to recreate family life far from home.

defs.def_en: If you recreate something, you succeed in making it exist or seem to exist in a different time or place to its original time or place.
Paprika is a red powder used for flavouring meat and other food.

defs.def_cn: (股市中的)当日买卖交易者，当天买卖投机者
defs.def_en: On the stock market, day traders are traders who buy and sell particular securities on the same day.

ext.ext_cn: 他被车撞倒后死在了医院。
ext.ext_en: He died in hospital after being knocked down by a car...

ext.ext_cn: 一个酒后驾驶的司机撞死了两个女孩儿。
ext.ext_en: A drunk driver knocked down and killed two girls...

defs.def_en: If someone is knocked down or is knocked over by a vehicle or its driver, they are hit by a car and fall to the ground, and are often injured or killed.

ext.ext_cn: 他为何不干脆把墙推倒？
ext.ext_en: Why doesn't he just knock the wall down?...

ext.ext_cn: 从那以后他们拆掉了简陋的棚屋。
ext.ext_en: They have since knocked down the shack.

defs.def_en: To knock down a building or part of a building means to demolish it.

ext.ext_cn: 市场可能会抛售该股票，从而令其股价下跌。
ext.ext_en: The market might abandon the stock, and knock down its price...

ext.ext_cn: 成功地将租金降到每平方英尺1美元。
ext.ext_en: It manages to knock rents down to $1 per square foot.

defs.def_en: To knock down a price or amount means to decrease it.

ext.ext_cn: 土壤含有的极微量的矿物质
ext.ext_en: ...mineral substances present in infinitesimal amounts in the soil...

ext.ext_cn: 其中有一个极短暂的停顿。
ext.ext_en: There was an infinitesimal pause.

defs.def_en: Something that is infinitesimal is extremely small.

ext.ext_cn: 以本币银行汇票支付车款。
ext.ext_en: You pay for the car by banker's draft in the local currency.

defs.def_en: A banker's  draft is the same as a bank draft .

defs.def_cn: 支出不足；花费少于预算；花费低于支付能力

ext.ext_cn: 一个在公共卫生方面支出不足而在统计人员方面支出过高的国家
ext.ext_en: ...a country that underspends on health and overspends on statisticians.

ext.ext_cn: 该部门的花费少于其预算。
ext.ext_en: There has been an underspend in the department's budget.

defs.def_en: If an organization or country underspends, it spends less money than it plans to or less money than it can afford.

defs.def_cn: (对人、组织或信仰的)忠诚，忠实

ext.ext_cn: 我必须承诺效忠女王。
ext.ext_en: I had to promise fidelity to the Queen.

defs.def_en: Fidelity is loyalty to a person, organization, or set of beliefs.

ext.ext_cn: 要求忠诚意味着你想发展一段严肃认真的恋爱关系。
ext.ext_en: Wanting fidelity implies you're thinking about a major relationship.

defs.def_en: Fidelity is being loyal to your husband, wife, or partner by not having a sexual relationship with anyone else.

defs.def_cn: (报告或翻译的)准确度，精确度，确切度

ext.ext_cn: 这些早期文件的准确性
ext.ext_en: ...the fidelity of these early documents.

defs.def_en: The fidelity of something such as a report or translation is the degree to which it is accurate.
A puppet is a doll that you can move, either by pulling strings which are attached to it or by putting your hand inside its body and moving your fingers.

ext.ext_cn: 外敌入侵时，他作为占领者的傀儡行使统治。
ext.ext_en: When the invasion occurred he ruled as a puppet of the occupiers...

ext.ext_cn: 他警告说如果军方再安插一个新的傀儡首相，将会引发“社会暴动”。
ext.ext_en: He warned there would be a 'social explosion' if the army installed another puppet prime minister.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a person or country as a puppet when you mean that their actions are controlled by a more powerful person or government, even though they may appear to be independent.

defs.def_cn: (挤压、压碎时)发出喀嚓声，发出嘎吱声

ext.ext_cn: 地板上的沙子在我们脚下嘎吱作响。
ext.ext_en: The sand on the floor scrunched under our feet...

ext.ext_cn: 她的脚喀嚓喀嚓地踩在沙砾上。
ext.ext_en: Her feet scrunch on the gravel.

defs.def_en: If something scrunches, it makes a loud sound as it is pressed or crushed or as it presses or crushes something else.

defs.def_cn: 挤扁;掰弯;使变形;使压碎

ext.ext_cn: 她父亲打歪了他的鼻子。
ext.ext_en: Her father scrunched his nose...

ext.ext_cn: 她母亲坐得笔直，把她的白手套揉成了球状。
ext.ext_en: Her mother was sitting bolt upright, scrunching her white cotton gloves into a ball.

defs.def_en: If you scrunch something, you squeeze it or bend it so that it is no longer in its natural shape and is often crushed.

ext.ext_cn: 西方的思想和道德规范
ext.ext_en: ...Western ideas and morals...

ext.ext_cn: 他们没有一点品行。
ext.ext_en: They have no morals.

defs.def_en: Morals are principles and beliefs concerning right and wrong behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 她讲述了拍摄这部电影过程中她在道义上所面临的两难选择。
ext.ext_en: She describes her own moral dilemma in making the film.

ext.ext_cn: 教会教义和道德教化的事情
ext.ext_en: ...matters of church doctrine and moral teaching.

defs.def_en: Moral means relating to beliefs about what is right or wrong.

defs.def_cn: （勇气或职责）道义上的;基于道德规范的

ext.ext_cn: 政府即使没有法律责任，在道义上也有责任来赔偿。
ext.ext_en: The Government had a moral, if not a legal duty to pay compensation.

ext.ext_cn: 他的道德勇气和对自己观点明智的辩护
ext.ext_en: ...his moral courage and sane defence of his philosophy.

defs.def_en: Moral courage or duty is based on what you believe is right or acceptable, rather than on what the law says should be done.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 进入委员会的人要品行端正，有文化，有能力。
ext.ext_en: The people who will be on the  committee are moral, cultured, competent people.

defs.def_en: A moral person behaves in a way that is believed by most people to be good and right.

ext.ext_cn: 西方国家应该提供道义支持和经济援助。
ext.ext_en: Moral as well as financial support was what the West should provide.

defs.def_en: If you give someone moral support, you encourage them in what they are doing by expressing approval.

defs.def_cn: (由故事、事件引出的)道德训诫，寓意

ext.ext_cn: 我想这个故事的寓意是提醒购物者当心。
ext.ext_en: I think the moral of the story is let the buyer beware...

ext.ext_cn: 由此可知，烹饪后，它们的味道和品相都别无二致。
ext.ext_en: The moral is that, once cooked, they look the same and taste every bit as good.

defs.def_en: The moral of a story or event is what you learn from it about how you should or should not behave.
A musical box is the same as a music box .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (计划、方法)设想错误的，不合适的

ext.ext_cn: 老师们说这些测试并不适合14岁的孩子。
ext.ext_en: The teachers say the tests for 14-year-olds are misconceived.

ext.ext_cn: 劳伦斯值得一提但考虑不周的想法
ext.ext_en: ...Lawrence's worthy but misconceived idea.

defs.def_en: If you describe a plan or method as misconceived, you mean it is not the right one for dealing with a particular problem or situation.

defs.def_cn: 刺柏，桧（其紫色浆果可用于烹饪和制药）
defs.def_en: A juniper is an evergreen bush with purple berries which can be used in cooking and medicine.

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个健谈的人，于是我开始和他攀谈起来。
ext.ext_en: He's a talkative guy, and I struck up a conversation with him...

ext.ext_cn: 我等着她打完电话。
ext.ext_en: I waited for her to finish a telephone conversation.

defs.def_en: If you have a conversation with someone, you talk with them, usually in an informal situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我到的时候，发现她正在和威廉斯夫人谈话。
ext.ext_en: When I arrived I found her in conversation with Mrs Williams.

defs.def_en: If you say that people are in conversation, you mean that they are talking together.

ext.ext_cn: 他一直在尽量找话说。
ext.ext_en: He had been trying to make conversation.

defs.def_en: If you make conversation, you talk to someone in order to be polite and not because you really want to.
A pocket knife is a small knife with several blades which fold into the handle so that you can carry it around with you safely.

defs.def_cn: （和现在分词连用构成动词的进行式）

ext.ext_cn: 全国各地每所学校都在发生这样的事情。
ext.ext_en: This is happening in every school throughout the country...

ext.ext_cn: 她对自己在做的事情并不总是考虑得很清楚。
ext.ext_en: She didn't  always think carefully about what she was doing...

defs.def_en: You use be with a present participle to form the continuous tenses of verbs.  be going to→see: going;

defs.def_cn: （和过去分词连用构成被动语态）

ext.ext_cn: 法医专家被请来。
ext.ext_en: Forensic experts were called in...

ext.ext_cn: 她的丈夫死于车祸。
ext.ext_en: Her husband was killed in a car crash...

defs.def_en: You use be with a past participle to form the passive voice.

defs.def_cn: （和不定式连用表示将来的安排或确定会发生的事情）

ext.ext_cn: 谈判将于明天开始。
ext.ext_en: The talks are to begin tomorrow...

ext.ext_cn: 这将是近一个月来约翰逊首次和董事会碰面。
ext.ext_en: It was to be Johnson's first meeting with the board in nearly a month...

defs.def_en: You use be with an infinitive to indicate that something is planned to happen, that it will definitely happen, or that it must happen.  be about to→see: about;

defs.def_cn: （和不定式连用表示在某种情况下会发生什么事，应该怎样做或应该由谁来做）

ext.ext_cn: 没有他，我该怎么办？
ext.ext_en: What am I to do without him?...

ext.ext_cn: 谁来决定他们之中谁的权力应该更大一些？
ext.ext_en: Who is to say which of them had more power?...

defs.def_en: You use be with an infinitive to say or ask what should happen or be done in a particular situation, how it should happen, or who should do it.

defs.def_cn: （was和were和不定式连用，表示说话时间之后发生的事）

ext.ext_cn: 然后，他接到一个将改变他一生的电话。
ext.ext_en: Then he received a phone call that was to change his life...

ext.ext_cn: 几个小时之后他将证明这一点。
ext.ext_en: A few hours later he was to prove it.

defs.def_en: You use was and were with an infinitive to talk about something that happened later than the time you are discussing, and was not planned or certain at that time.

defs.def_cn: （表示可见到、可听到、可发现等）

ext.ext_cn: 街上车辆很少。
ext.ext_en: Little traffic was to be seen on the streets...

ext.ext_cn: 它们遍布于世界各地。
ext.ext_en: They are to be found all over the world.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is to be seen, heard, or found in a particular place to mean that people can see it, hear it, or find it in that place.

defs.def_cn: （用于提供与主语相关的信息）

ext.ext_cn: 她是我母亲。
ext.ext_en: She's my mother...

ext.ext_cn: 英国广播公司的伊丽莎白·布伦特在西非为您报道。
ext.ext_en: This is Elizabeth Blunt, BBC, West Africa...

defs.def_en: You use be to introduce more information about the subject, such as its identity, nature, qualities, or position.

defs.def_cn: （以it作主语，用来进行描述或作出判断）

ext.ext_cn: 这时候游泳太冷了。
ext.ext_en: It was too chilly for swimming...

ext.ext_cn: 有时候拒绝是必要的。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes it is necessary to say no...

defs.def_en: You use be, with 'it' as the subject, in clauses where you are describing something or giving your judgment of a situation.

defs.def_cn: （与非人称代词there连用构成there is和there are表示存在或发生）

ext.ext_cn: 显然，这里出了个问题。
ext.ext_en: Clearly there is a problem here...

ext.ext_cn: 这条街道上车辆很少。
ext.ext_en: There are very few cars on this street...

defs.def_en: You use be with the impersonal pronoun 'there' in expressions like there is and there are to say that something exists or happens.

defs.def_cn: （表示主语和从句和其他从句结构之间的某种联系）

ext.ext_cn: 她不喜欢的是我，而不是我的陈述。
ext.ext_en: It was me she didn't like, not what I represented...

ext.ext_cn: 媒体不应该利用人们天生的恐惧心理。
ext.ext_en: What the media should not do is to exploit people's natural fears...

defs.def_en: You use be as a link between a subject and a clause and in certain other clause structures, as shown below.

defs.def_cn: （用在如the thing is和the point is这样的结构中，引导表示陈述或提出观点的从句）

ext.ext_cn: 事实上，选手们尽了全力。
ext.ext_en: The fact is, the players gave everything they had...

ext.ext_cn: 计划不错；问题在于不够深入。
ext.ext_en: The plan is good; the problem is it doesn't  go far enough.

defs.def_en: You use be in expressions like the thing is and the point is to introduce a clause in which you make a statement or give your opinion.

defs.def_cn: （用在如to be fair, to be honest或to be serious 这样的结构中表示尽量）

ext.ext_cn: 她总是受到关注。但是说句实在话，吉莱纳喜欢被人关注。
ext.ext_en: She's always noticed. But then, to be honest, Ghislaine likes being noticed...

ext.ext_cn: 它可以让学生们有更多的时间来学习，或者更准确一点说，有更多的时间来放松自己。
ext.ext_en: It enabled students to devote more time to their studies, or to be more accurate, more time to relaxation.

defs.def_en: You use be in expressions like to be fair ,to be honest, or to be serious to introduce an additional statement or opinion, and to indicate that you are trying to be fair, honest, or serious.

defs.def_cn: （有时用来代替现在时态中be的几个常规形式，尤用于whether后）

ext.ext_cn: 这类化学制剂，不管是芥子气还是神经瓦斯，都会被皮肤吸收。
ext.ext_en: The chemical agent, whether it be mustard gas or nerve gas, can be absorbed by the skin.

defs.def_en: The form 'be' is used occasionally instead of the normal forms of the present tense, especially after 'whether'.

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得疼痛难忍，恨不得死了算了。
ext.ext_en: It hurt so badly he wished to cease to be.

ext.ext_cn: 活着还是死去
ext.ext_en: ...to be or not to be.

defs.def_en: If something is, it exists.

defs.def_cn: 保持真我；按自己的方式行事；显常态

ext.ext_cn: 她已经学会了按自己的方式行事，坚持自己的信仰。
ext.ext_en: She'd learnt to be herself and to stand up for her convictions.

defs.def_en: To be yourself means to behave in the way that is right and natural for you and your personality.
If someone or something is, for example, as happy as can be or as quiet as could be, they are extremely happy or extremely quiet.

defs.def_cn: 如果不是…的话；如果没有…的话

ext.ext_cn: 如果不是因为我会想念自己的花园的话，我会很乐意搬回公寓住。
ext.ext_en: I could happily move back into a flat if it wasn't  for the fact that I'd miss my garden...

ext.ext_cn: 如果不是因为她，你父亲今天可能还活着。
ext.ext_en: If it hadn't been for her your father would be alive today.

defs.def_en: If you talk about what would happen if it wasn't for someone or something, you mean that they are the only thing that is preventing it from happening.

ext.ext_cn: “他还是那么胖吗？”——“我不知道，”她妈妈接着说，没有理睬这一打岔，“就算那样，他已经发财了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Is he still just as fat?' — 'I wouldn't know,' continued her mother, ignoring the interruption, 'and be that as it may, he has made a fortune.'

defs.def_en: You say 'Be that as it may' when you want to move onto another subject or go further with the discussion, without deciding whether what has just been said is right or wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 她身体不舒服，简直要崩溃了。
ext.ext_en: She is not herself. She came near to a breakdown.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are not yourself, you mean you are not feeling well.

defs.def_cn: (戏剧或音乐表演的)提示，暗示，尾白

ext.ext_cn: 还未轮到演出的演员坐在舞台旁边能看得一清二楚的地方，等待着他们的出场提示。
ext.ext_en: The actors not performing sit at the side of the stage in full view, waiting for their cues...

ext.ext_cn: 我从没见过他错过提示。
ext.ext_en: I had never known him miss a cue.

defs.def_en: In the theatre or in a musical performance, a performer's cue is something another performer says or does that is a signal for them to begin speaking, playing, or doing something.

defs.def_cn: 给(演员)暗示(或提示);为…提示

ext.ext_cn: 在西顿的提示下，他念了这一场的台词。
ext.ext_en: He read the scene, with Seaton cueing him.

defs.def_en: If one performer cues another, they say or do something which is a signal for the second performer to begin speaking, playing, or doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 那意味着几个月的激烈谈判开始了。
ext.ext_en: That was the cue for several months of intense bargaining...

ext.ext_cn: 那表示尼古拉斯还想要一块巧克力曲奇。
ext.ext_en: That was Nicholas's cue to ask for another chocolate chip cookie.

defs.def_en: If you say that something that happens is a cue for an action, you mean that people start doing that action when it happens.

ext.ext_cn: 他们最年轻的弟弟第一次玩台球时才9岁。
ext.ext_en: Their youngest brother was nine when he picked up a cue for the first time.

defs.def_en: A cue is a long, thin wooden stick that is used to hit the ball in games such as snooker, billiards, and pool.

defs.def_cn: 恰好在这时;就在这时候

ext.ext_cn: 凯文到的正是时候，可以照顾哈丽。
ext.ext_en: Kevin arrived right on cue to care for Harry...

ext.ext_cn: “快8点了。”恰好在这时小教堂晨祷的钟声敲响了。
ext.ext_en: 'It's almost eight o'clock.' As if on cue the bell in the chapel began to toll for Matins.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happened on cue or as if on cue, you mean that it happened just when it was expected to happen, or just at the right time.

ext.ext_cn: 他也学着像同伴那样，为先前发脾气道歉。
ext.ext_en: Taking his cue from his companion, he apologized for his earlier display of temper.

defs.def_en: If you take your cue from someone or something, you do something similar in a particular situation.

defs.def_cn: (美国)全州范围的，遍及全州的

ext.ext_cn: 每年他们都要参加著名的全州自行车大赛。
ext.ext_en: Each year they compete in a prominent statewide bicycle race...

ext.ext_cn: 这些选民们往往决定着全州大选的结果。
ext.ext_en: These voters often determine the outcome of statewide elections.

defs.def_en: Statewide means across or throughout the whole of one of the states of the United States.

defs.def_cn: 说得委婉一些;说得轻一些

ext.ext_cn: 但是说得委婉一些，并不是所有的钱都花得很明智。
ext.ext_en: But not all the money, to put it mildly, has been used wisely...

ext.ext_cn: 说我们对此很失望是很客气的说法。
ext.ext_en: To say we are disappointed about this is putting it mildly.

defs.def_en: You use to put it mildly to indicate that you are describing something in language that is much less strong, direct, or critical than what you really think.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （衣服）肥大的，宽松下垂的，松松垮垮的

ext.ext_cn: 宽松的套衫
ext.ext_en: ...a baggy jumper.

defs.def_en: If a piece of clothing is baggy, it hangs loosely on your body.

defs.def_cn: （尤指受到某种思想、经验影响的）思考方法，态度，观点，角度

ext.ext_cn: 他说18个月前父亲的去世让他对人生有了新的认识。
ext.ext_en: He says the death of his father 18 months ago has given him a new perspective on life...

ext.ext_cn: 对青少年成长发育特点的两种不同观点
ext.ext_en: ...two different perspectives on the nature of adolescent development...

defs.def_en: A particular perspective is a particular way of thinking about something, especially one that is influenced by your beliefs or experiences.

defs.def_cn: 正确/不正确地看待（或判断）

ext.ext_cn: 记住要客观看待事物。
ext.ext_en: Remember to keep things in perspective...

ext.ext_cn: 这有助于正确看待他们的个人问题。
ext.ext_en: It helps to put their personal problems into perspective...

defs.def_en: If you get something in perspective or into perspective, you judge its real importance by considering it in relation to everything else. If you get something out of perspective, you fail to judge its real importance in relation to everything else.
Perspective is the art of making some objects or people in a picture look further away than others.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 扣人心弦的;激动人心的;引人入胜的

ext.ext_cn: 野生动物园之旅使我们得以接触自然状态下的野生动物，让人感觉很刺激。
ext.ext_en: Our wildlife trips offer a thrilling encounter with wildlife in its natural state.

defs.def_en: Something that is thrilling is very exciting and enjoyable.
A landing stage is a platform built over water where boats stop to let people get off, or to load or unload goods.

defs.def_cn: 被困住的;被缠住的；受到约束的

ext.ext_cn: 当代女性当然想了解时事，我们不再只是受缚于家务小事。
ext.ext_en: Surely modern women want to be informed of world current affairs; we are no longer chained to the kitchen sink!...

ext.ext_cn: 上班时，他淹没在枯燥乏味的会海中。
ext.ext_en: At work, he was chained to a system of boring meetings.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is chained to a person or a situation, you are emphasizing that there are reasons why they cannot leave that person or situation, even though you think they might like to.

ext.ext_cn: 仿佛是命运的捉弄，这对选手在锦标赛第一轮比赛中就狭路相逢。
ext.ext_en: By a tantalising quirk of fate, the pair have been drawn to meet in the first round of the championship...

ext.ext_cn: 从统计数字上看，近些年来暴风雨和飓风的频发非同寻常。
ext.ext_en: The spate of storms and hurricanes in recent years could be a statistical quirk.

defs.def_en: A quirk is something unusual or interesting that happens by chance.

ext.ext_cn: 布朗对人们的种种怪癖十分着迷。
ext.ext_en: Brown was fascinated by people's quirks and foibles.

defs.def_en: A quirk is a habit or aspect of a person's character which is odd or unusual.
A synagogue is a building where Jewish people meet to worship or to study their religion.

ext.ext_cn: 难以释怀的悲痛
ext.ext_en: ...unrelieved misery...

ext.ext_cn: 太阳炙烤着水泥，热度没有因为任何微风而有所减轻。
ext.ext_en: The sun baked down on the concrete, unrelieved by any breeze.

defs.def_en: If you describe something unpleasant as unrelieved, you mean that it is very severe and is not replaced by anything better, even for a short time.

defs.def_cn: 上下文的;与上下文有关的;与语境有关的

ext.ext_cn: 作者巧妙地构筑了一幅上流社会生活的背景图画。
ext.ext_en: The writer builds up a clever contextual picture of upper class life.

defs.def_en: A contextual issue or account relates to the context of something.

ext.ext_cn: 两国的外交大臣今天签署了文件。
ext.ext_en: The foreign ministers of the two countries signed the documents today.

ext.ext_cn: 为工党大会准备的政策文件
ext.ext_en: ...a policy document for the Labour Party conference...

defs.def_en: A document is one or more official pieces of paper with writing on them.

ext.ext_cn: 完成录入后，记得将文档存盘。
ext.ext_en: When you are finished typing, remember to save your document.

defs.def_en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

ext.ext_cn: 他写书详细记录了他的狱中经历。
ext.ext_en: He wrote a book documenting his prison experiences...

ext.ext_cn: 有关吸烟的影响记录翔实。
ext.ext_en: The effects of smoking have been well documented.

defs.def_en: If you document something, you make a detailed record of it in writing or on film or tape.

ext.ext_cn: 英国人将全力以赴，一较高低。
ext.ext_en: The British will be out to see how they stack up to the competition...

ext.ext_cn: 你认为这最后一次总统竞选辩论和其他几次相比怎么样？
ext.ext_en: How does this final presidential debate stack up and compare to the others, do you think?

defs.def_en: If you ask how one person or thing stacks up against other people or things, you are asking how the one compares with the others.

ext.ext_cn: 已经提出了好几种解释，但没有一种能站得住脚。
ext.ext_en: There have been a number of explanations, but none of them stack up.

defs.def_en: If facts or figures do not stack up, they do not make sense or give the results you expect.

ext.ext_cn: 坦克炮声在巴伐利亚小镇回荡。
ext.ext_en: The sound of the tank guns reverberated through the little Bavarian town...

ext.ext_cn: 一个女人的尖笑声在院子里回荡。
ext.ext_en: A woman's shrill laughter reverberated in the courtyard.

defs.def_en: When a loud sound reverberates through a place, it echoes through it.

defs.def_cn: (事情、思想等)产生巨大反响，引起轰动，影响深远

ext.ext_cn: 昨天围绕接管展开的争论在电视业仍然有巨大的反响。
ext.ext_en: The controversy surrounding the take-over yesterday continued to reverberate around the television industry...

ext.ext_cn: 这则消息震惊了整个社区，直到现在还波澜未息。
ext.ext_en: The news sent shock waves through the community that have continued to reverberate to this day.

defs.def_en: You can say that an event or idea reverberates when it has a powerful effect which lasts a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 学生们的期望根据他们的专业各有不同。
ext.ext_en: Students' expectations were as varied as their expertise...

ext.ext_cn: 那种车是通用汽车公司有目共睹最成功的车型，销量远远超过预期。
ext.ext_en: The car has been General Motors' most visible success story, with sales far exceeding expectations...

defs.def_en: Your expectations are your strong hopes or beliefs that something will happen or that you will get something that you want.

ext.ext_cn: 斯蒂芬·蔡斯决心不辜负公司的期望。
ext.ext_en: Stephen Chase had determined to live up to the expectations of the Company.

ext.ext_cn: 希望悲痛情绪不要长久持续下去
ext.ext_en: ...the expectation that the grieving process should have a time limit on it.

defs.def_en: A person's expectations are strong beliefs which they have about the proper way someone should behave or something should happen.

defs.def_cn: 有意伤害的;肆无忌惮的；恶意的

ext.ext_cn: 对我们环境毫无必要的肆意破坏
ext.ext_en: ...this unnecessary and wanton destruction of our environment...

ext.ext_cn: 肆无忌惮的暴行在城市生活中越来越司空见惯。
ext.ext_en: Wanton violence is now becoming a regular feature of urban life.

defs.def_en: A wanton action deliberately causes harm, damage, or waste without having any reason to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 认为只有放荡女人才有性激情的观念
ext.ext_en: ...the idea that only wanton women have sexual passions.

defs.def_en: If someone describes a woman as wanton, they disapprove of her because she clearly enjoys sex or has sex with a lot of men.

ext.ext_cn: 人们会改为购买价格更低的自有品牌。
ext.ext_en: People will trade down to own labels which are cheaper.

ext.ext_cn: 自家品牌的化妆品
ext.ext_en: ...own-label cosmetics.

defs.def_en: Own label is the same as own brand .

defs.def_cn: 重新安排;重新组织；调整

ext.ext_cn: 政府正在重新制定一些税收评估办法。
ext.ext_en: The government is rejiggering some tax assessment methods.

defs.def_en: If someone rejiggers an organization or a piece of work, they arrange or organize it in a different way, in order to improve it.
A limited edition is a work of art, such as a book which is only produced in very small numbers, so that each one will be valuable in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 他们还需要2,500英镑才能完成该项目。
ext.ext_en: They need an extra two and a half thousand pounds to complete the project...

ext.ext_cn: 半数以上的家庭申报收入超过35,000英镑。
ext.ext_en: More than half of all households report incomes above £35,000...

defs.def_en: Half of an amount or object is one of two equal parts that together make up the whole number, amount, or object.

defs.def_cn: 部分地;在某种程度上;有点

ext.ext_cn: 他双眼半闭。
ext.ext_en: His eyes were half closed...

ext.ext_cn: 他的冰箱里经常半空着。
ext.ext_en: His refrigerator frequently looked half empty...

defs.def_en: You use half to say that something is only partly the case or happens to only a limited extent.

defs.def_cn: （足球、橄榄球、篮球比赛等的）半场，半时，半局

ext.ext_cn: 唯一的一粒进球是由雅各布森在下半场刚开始时打进的。
ext.ext_en: The only goal was scored by Jakobsen early in the second half.

defs.def_en: In games such as football, rugby, and basketball, matches are divided into two equal periods of time which are called halves.

ext.ext_cn: 半品脱淡啤酒和一份三明治
ext.ext_en: ...a half of lager and a sandwich.

defs.def_en: A half is half a pint of a drink such as beer or cider.

defs.def_cn: (儿童乘坐公共汽车或火车时的）半（价）票
defs.def_en: A half is a half-price bus or train ticket for a child.

ext.ext_cn: 她是半意大利半英国血统。
ext.ext_en: She was half Italian and half English.

defs.def_en: You use half to say that someone has parents of different nationalities. For example, if you are half German, one of your parents is German but the other is not.

ext.ext_cn: “你打算什么时候吃午饭？”“如果方便的话，12点半。”
ext.ext_en: 'What time were you planning lunch?'—'Half past twelve, if that's convenient.'...

ext.ext_cn: 我想我是4点钟左右到达那里，大约半个小时后离开的。
ext.ext_en: I think I got there about four and left about half past.

defs.def_en: You use half past to refer to a time that is thirty minutes after a particular hour.

ext.ext_cn: 他们应该在4点半左右到达这里。
ext.ext_en: They are supposed to be here at about half four.

defs.def_en: Half means the same as half past .

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词前，表示强调或夸张）非常，极其

ext.ext_cn: 他已经累得半死不活了。
ext.ext_en: He felt half dead with tiredness...

ext.ext_cn: 我一直非常担心你，一直在想你为什么不来信。
ext.ext_en: All this time I've been half sick about you and why you wouldn't write.

defs.def_en: You can use half before an adjective describing an extreme quality, as a way of emphasizing and exaggerating something.

defs.def_cn: （有时用在否定句中，表示非常肯定的意思）

ext.ext_cn: 你听起来非常有信心。
ext.ext_en: You don't half sound confident...

ext.ext_cn: 我遇到了大麻烦。
ext.ext_en: I didn't half get into trouble...

defs.def_en: Half is sometimes used in negative statements, with a positive meaning, to emphasize a particular fact or quality. For example, if you say 'he isn't half lucky', you mean that he is very lucky.

ext.ext_cn: 你根本不是你自己想象的那种人。
ext.ext_en: You're not half the man you think you are...

ext.ext_cn: 可怜的老亨利，以为自己多聪明。
ext.ext_en: Poor old Henry, and not half as clever as he'd thought.

defs.def_en: You use not half or not half as to show that you do not think something is as good or impressive as it is meant to be.

defs.def_cn: 非常…的;更…的;非同寻常的

ext.ext_cn: 很显然，蒙哥马利手头有一大堆事情要做。
ext.ext_en: It becomes clear that Montgomerie has a job and half on his hands.

defs.def_en: When you use an expression such as a problem and a half or a meal and a half, you are emphasizing that your reaction to it is either very favourable or very unfavourable.

ext.ext_cn: 我担心我的事业、我的孩子们和我的那口子可能会让我应付不过来。
ext.ext_en: I was worried that my career, my children and my other half might become too much to cope with.

defs.def_en: If you talk about your better half or your other half you mean your wife, your husband, or the person of the opposite sex that you live with.

ext.ext_cn: 不识字的7岁儿童的人数在过去5年里增加了一半。
ext.ext_en: The number of 7 year olds who read poorly has increased by half over the past 5 years...

ext.ext_cn: 将进食量减半对任何人来说都是件非常难的事。
ext.ext_en: Cutting food intake by half is an incredibly difficult thing for anyone to do.

defs.def_en: If you increase something by half, half of the original amount is added to it. If you decrease it by half, half of the original amount is taken away from it.

ext.ext_cn: 在意大利，人们很少马虎从事。设计师们精益求精，用最美丽的布料制造出世界上最适合穿着的衣服。
ext.ext_en: In Italy they rarely do things by halves. Designers work thoroughly, producing the world's most wearable clothes in the most beautiful fabrics.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone never does things by halves, you mean that they always do things very thoroughly.

ext.ext_cn: 他总和女友煲电话粥。令我抓狂的是电话费可是我们俩平摊的。
ext.ext_en: He's constantly on the phone to his girlfriend. We have to go halves on the phone bill which drives me mad.

defs.def_en: If two people go halves, they divide the cost of something equally between them.
A search party is an organized group of people who are searching for someone who is missing.

ext.ext_cn: 因为他仍未获准经营公司，他妻子成了名义上的老板。
ext.ext_en: As he was still not allowed to run a company, his wife became its nominal head...

ext.ext_cn: 我成长为名不副实的基督徒。
ext.ext_en: I was brought up a nominal Christian.

defs.def_en: You use nominal to indicate that someone or something is supposed to have a particular identity or status, but in reality does not have it.

defs.def_cn: (价格或款项)微不足道的，象征性的

ext.ext_cn: 我做好了以极低价格卖掉自己股份的准备。
ext.ext_en: I am prepared to sell my shares at a nominal price...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的渡船都免费或以极低的收费运载自行车。
ext.ext_en: All the ferries carry bicycles free or for a nominal charge.

defs.def_en: A nominal price or sum of money is very small in comparison with the real cost or value of the thing that is being bought or sold.

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀会更低，因此名义利率换算成实际利率会更具吸引力。
ext.ext_en: Inflation would be lower and so nominal rates would be rather more attractive in real terms...

ext.ext_cn: 1990年个人收入名义上增长了6.8％。
ext.ext_en: In 1990 personal incomes grew a nominal 6.8 per cent.

defs.def_en: In economics, the nominal value, rate, or level of something is the one expressed in terms of current prices or figures, without taking into account general changes in prices that take place over time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 人迹罕至的地方
ext.ext_en: ...an out-of-the-way spot.

ext.ext_cn: 在偏远地区旅行的困难
ext.ext_en: ...the difficulty of travelling anywhere out of the way.

defs.def_en: Out-of-the-way places are difficult to reach and are therefore not often visited.
Pastrami is strongly seasoned smoked beef.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 仁慈的上帝
ext.ext_en: ...a merciful God...

ext.ext_cn: 我们唯有寄希望于法庭的宽大处理。
ext.ext_en: We can only hope the court is merciful.

defs.def_en: If you describe God or  a person in a position of authority as merciful, you mean that they show kindness and forgiveness to people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指因结束了某人的痛苦或不适）幸运的,有福气的

ext.ext_cn: 他被送到医院时，医生告诉我们他伤势过重，死亡对他算是一种幸运的解脱。
ext.ext_en: We were told when he was taken to hospital that his injuries were so severe death would be merciful...

ext.ext_cn: 这次开庭的最终结果令人庆幸。
ext.ext_en: Eventually the session came to a merciful end.

defs.def_en: If you describe an event or situation as merciful, you mean that it is a good thing, especially because it stops someone's suffering or discomfort.

ext.ext_cn: 他减挡拐入了私家车道。
ext.ext_en: Changing down, he turned into the drive...

ext.ext_cn: 我在第二个拐弯处踩了刹车，挂上三挡。
ext.ext_en: I braked at the second corner and changed down to third.

defs.def_en: When you change down, you move the gear lever in the vehicle you are driving in order to use a lower gear.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有时你需要钱，于是不得不干一份烂工作。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes you have to take a duff job when you need the money.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as duff, you mean it is useless, broken, or of poor quality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you refer to something as a bastardized form of something else, you mean that the first thing is similar to or copied from the second thing, but is of much poorer quality.

defs.def_cn: 低潮（时间）；干潮（时间）；枯潮（期）

ext.ext_cn: 通往该岛的堤道只有在枯潮时才能通行。
ext.ext_en: The causeway to the island is only accessible at low tide.

defs.def_en: At the coast, low tide is the time when the sea is at its lowest level because the tide is out.

defs.def_cn: （靠买空卖空的差价）获利回吐，见利抛售，获利了结
defs.def_en: Profit-taking is the selling of stocks and shares at a profit after their value has risen or just before their value falls.

ext.ext_cn: 无神论价值观
ext.ext_en: ...atheistic values.

ext.ext_cn: 无神论哲学家
ext.ext_en: ...atheistic philosophers.

defs.def_en: Atheistic means connected with or holding the belief that there is no God.

defs.def_cn: 住宿加次日早餐（缩略形式为 B&B;）

ext.ext_cn: 住宿加次日早餐每人每晚30英镑起。
ext.ext_en: Bed and breakfast costs from £30 per person per night.

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦附近一家提供住宿加次日早餐的小旅馆
ext.ext_en: ...a small bed and breakfast hotel near London.

defs.def_en: Bed and breakfast is a system of accommodation in a hotel or guest house, in which you pay for a room for the night and for breakfast the following morning. The abbreviation B&B; is also used.

defs.def_cn: 提供住宿加次日早餐的家庭旅馆（缩略形式为 B&B;）

ext.ext_cn: 住宿可以安排在当地提供住宿加次日早餐的家庭旅馆。
ext.ext_en: Accommodation can be arranged at local bed and breakfasts.

defs.def_en: A bed and breakfast is a guest house that provides bed and breakfast accommodation. The abbreviation B&B; is also used.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （计划、理论）愚蠢的，不切实际的

ext.ext_cn: 这已经不是他制定的第一个愚蠢方案了。
ext.ext_en: This isn't the first hare-brained scheme he's had.

defs.def_en: You use hare-brained to describe a scheme or theory which you consider to be very foolish and which you think is unlikely to be successful or true.

ext.ext_cn: 多数难民在高山上露宿。
ext.ext_en: Most of the refugees are camped high in the mountains...

ext.ext_cn: 一觉醒来,你会发现电影摄制组进驻了你家后院。
ext.ext_en: You will wake to find film crews camped in your backyard...

defs.def_en: See also:camp;If people are camped or camped out somewhere in the open air, they are living, staying, or waiting there, often in tents.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不道德的；（尤指）放荡的，淫乱的

ext.ext_cn: 关于放荡淫乱行为的骇人听闻的故事
ext.ext_en: ...alarming stories of licentious behaviour.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as licentious, you mean that they are very immoral, especially in their sexual behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 早晨开始禁食前，记下你的体重。
ext.ext_en: On the morning before starting the fast, write down your starting weight...

ext.ext_cn: 只有把东西记下来，我才能从混乱中理出些头绪来。
ext.ext_en: Only by writing things down could I bring some sort of order to the confusion.

defs.def_en: When you write something down, you record it on a piece of paper using a pen or pencil.

defs.def_cn: (某团体或职业中的)女性老前辈，资格最老的女性成员，女性元老

ext.ext_cn: 英国时装界的女元老
ext.ext_en: ...the doyenne of British fashion.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a woman as the doyenne of a group or profession, you mean that she is the oldest and most experienced and respected woman in it.
A warder is someone who works in a prison supervising the prisoners.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不对称形状
ext.ext_en: ...asymmetrical shapes.

defs.def_en: Something that is asymmetrical has two sides or halves that are different in shape, size, or style.

defs.def_cn: 产生（问题）；造成（威胁、危险等）

ext.ext_cn: 这可能会给煤炭产业的就业造成威胁。
ext.ext_en: This could pose a threat to jobs in the coal industry...

ext.ext_cn: 他身体不好，对将来造成严重的隐患。
ext.ext_en: His ill health poses serious problems for the future.

defs.def_en: If something poses a problem or a danger, it is the cause of that problem or danger.

ext.ext_cn: 当我最后问“为什么”时，他只是耸了耸肩。
ext.ext_en: When I finally posed the question, 'Why?' he merely shrugged.

ext.ext_cn: 新技术带来的道德问题
ext.ext_en: ...the moral issues posed by new technologies.

defs.def_en: If you pose a question, you ask it. If you pose an issue that needs considering, you mention the issue.

ext.ext_cn: 该队队员装扮成毒品贩子，诱捕罪犯头目。
ext.ext_en: The team posed as drug dealers to trap the ringleaders.

defs.def_en: If you pose as someone, you pretend to be that person in order to deceive people.

defs.def_cn: 摆姿势（以供人摄影或绘画）

ext.ext_cn: 开会前，6位外交部长合影留念。
ext.ext_en: Before going into their meeting the six foreign ministers posed for photographs.

defs.def_en: If you pose for a photograph or painting, you stay in a particular position so that someone can photograph you or paint you.

ext.ext_cn: 他批评她们衣着暴露而且矫揉造作。
ext.ext_en: He criticized them for dressing outrageously and posing pretentiously.

defs.def_en: You can say that people are posing when you think that they are behaving in an insincere or exaggerated way because they want to make a particular impression on other people.

ext.ext_cn: 我们进行了几次预拍摄，摆了各种不同的造型。
ext.ext_en: We have had several preliminary sittings in various poses.

defs.def_en: A pose is a particular way that you stand, sit, or lie, for example when you are being photographed or painted.

ext.ext_cn: 很多作家都是故作谦虚，但福特却似乎表里如一。
ext.ext_en: In many writers modesty is a pose, but in Ford it seems to have been genuine.

defs.def_en: A pose is an insincere or exaggerated way of behaving that is intended to make a particular impression on other people.

defs.def_cn: (用于列举观点或给出原因)第二，其次

ext.ext_cn: 你首先需要一个强大的独立董事会，其次需要一批富有经验并且爱岗敬业的员工。
ext.ext_en: You need, firstly, a strong independent board of directors and secondly, an experienced and dedicated staff.

defs.def_en: You say secondly when you want to make a second point or give a second reason for something.

defs.def_cn: （用于某些名词词尾，指称某一科学或学科）表示“…学”
defs.def_en: -ology is used at the end of some nouns that refer to a particular science or subject, for example 'geology' or 'sociology'.

defs.def_cn: （尤指为摄影或电影业服务的）发型师

ext.ext_cn: 她的私人发型师
ext.ext_en: ...her personal hair stylist.

defs.def_en: A hairstylist is someone who cuts and arranges people's hair, especially in order to get them ready for a photograph or film.

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦地铁称由于政府削减了投资，可能将不得不削减500个信号员的岗位。
ext.ext_en: London Underground said it may have to axe 500 signalling jobs because of government cutbacks in its investment.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天宣布裁员200人
ext.ext_en: ...the 200-person staff cutback announced yesterday.

defs.def_en: A cutback is a reduction that is made in something.

defs.def_cn: (尤指对被自己击败或曾欺凌过自己的人表现出的)宽宏大量，宽厚，大度

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须表现出胜者的大度。
ext.ext_en: We will have to show magnanimity in victory...

ext.ext_cn: 一名受害者的父亲以极为宽容的口吻发了言。
ext.ext_en: The father of one victim spoke with remarkable magnanimity.

defs.def_en: Magnanimity is kindness and generosity towards someone, especially after defeating them or being treated badly by them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 最需要这种指导的社会群体是青年男性。
ext.ext_en: The section of society most needful of such guidance is the young male.

ext.ext_cn: 停下来进行必要的休息和娱乐
ext.ext_en: ...stoppages for needful rest and recreation.

defs.def_en: Needful means necessary.

ext.ext_cn: 我提了速度，挂上高速挡。
ext.ext_en: I accelerated and changed up.

defs.def_en: When you change up, you move the gear lever in the vehicle you are driving in order to use a higher gear.

ext.ext_cn: 发生在船上的恋情
ext.ext_en: ...a shipboard romance.

defs.def_en: Shipboard means taking place on a ship.

ext.ext_cn: 他憎恶自负的作派，而且不喜欢被称为天才。
ext.ext_en: He hated pomposity and disliked being called a genius.

defs.def_en: Pomposity means speaking or behaving in a very serious manner which shows that you think you are more important than you really are.
Chenille is cloth or clothing made from a type of thick furry thread.

ext.ext_cn: 由于处理不当，这个问题令他大伤脑筋。
ext.ext_en: It perplexed him because he was tackling it the wrong way.

defs.def_en: If something perplexes you, it confuses and worries you because you do not understand it or because it causes you difficulty.

defs.def_cn: 使精神抖擞;使精神振奋;使重新充满活力

ext.ext_cn: 这种润肤液凉爽清新，能够焕发肌肤的活力。
ext.ext_en: The lotion cools and refreshes the skin...

ext.ext_cn: 他们曾在一处泉边停歇休息。
ext.ext_en: They had stopped by a spring to refresh themselves.

defs.def_en: If something refreshes you when you have become hot, tired, or thirsty, it makes you feel cooler or more energetic.

ext.ext_cn: 许多人把这些会面看成是交流想法和保持友谊长青的机会。
ext.ext_en: Many view these meetings as an occasion to share ideas and refresh friendship...

ext.ext_cn: 莱蒂出现了，她重新上过妆。
ext.ext_en: Lettie appeared, her make-up refreshed.

defs.def_en: If you refresh something old or dull, you make it as good as it was when it was new.

ext.ext_cn: 让我帮你回忆吧。
ext.ext_en: Allow me to refresh your memory...

ext.ext_cn: 他走在街的对面，努力回忆这座建筑的原貌。
ext.ext_en: He walked on the opposite side of the street to refresh his memory of the building.

defs.def_en: If someone refreshes your memory, they tell you something that you had forgotten.

ext.ext_cn: 点击网页浏览器上的“刷新”按钮来刷新页面，显示最新的版本。
ext.ext_en: Press the 'reload' button on your web browser to refresh the site and get the most current version.

defs.def_en: If you refresh a web page, you click a button in order to get the most recent version of the page.

ext.ext_cn: 公制度量衡的十进制
ext.ext_en: ...the decimal system of metric weights and measures...

ext.ext_cn: 英国于 1971 年开始使用十进制的 1 便士和 2 便士硬币。
ext.ext_en: In 1971, the 1p and 2p decimal coins were introduced in Britain.

defs.def_en: A decimal system involves counting in units of ten.

ext.ext_cn: 简单的数学概念，如小数和分数
ext.ext_en: ...simple math concepts, such as decimals and fractions.

defs.def_en: A decimal is a fraction that is written in the form of a dot followed by one or more numbers which represent tenths, hundredths, and so on: for example .5, .51, .517.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (问题、局势)难对付的，考验人的，棘手的

ext.ext_cn: 最考验人的时期莫过于重新回来上班的头几个月。
ext.ext_en: The most testing time is undoubtedly in the early months of your return to work...

ext.ext_cn: 数学试卷和英语试卷很难。
ext.ext_en: The papers in maths and English are very testing.

defs.def_en: A testing problem or situation is very difficult to deal with and shows a lot about the character of the person who is dealing with it.

ext.ext_cn: 检验产品和给产品贴标签
ext.ext_en: ...product testing and labelling...

ext.ext_cn: 美国大学体育联合会在 20 世纪 80 年代中期开始实行药物检测。
ext.ext_en: The National Collegiate Athletic Association introduced drug testing in the mid-1980s.

defs.def_en: Testing is the activity of testing something or someone in order to find out information.
A beggar is someone who lives by asking people for money or food.

defs.def_cn: 使极度贫穷；使一贫如洗

ext.ext_cn: 他警告说解除版权限制会使这个行业一贫如洗。
ext.ext_en: He warned that lifting copyright restrictions could beggar the industry.

defs.def_en: If something beggars a person, country, or organization, it makes them very poor.

defs.def_cn: 无法，难以（相信、描述、形容等）

ext.ext_cn: 统计数据让人难以置信。
ext.ext_en: The statistics beggar belief...

ext.ext_cn: 他的胆量无法用语言来形容。
ext.ext_en: His courage beggars description.

defs.def_en: If something beggars belief, it is impossible to believe it. If something beggars description, it is impossible to describe it.

defs.def_cn: 研究苏维埃制度的专家;苏联政策研究专家;苏联问题专家
defs.def_en: A Sovietologist is a person who is an expert on the former Soviet Union.

defs.def_cn: 宽松的女短衫；女式衬衫
defs.def_en: A blouse is a kind of shirt worn by a girl or woman.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不起作用的;无效果的;无效率的

ext.ext_cn: 经济改革仍将举步维艰,毫无成效。
ext.ext_en: Economic reform will continue to be painful and ineffective...

ext.ext_cn: 用这种方法控制你的狗不起作用。
ext.ext_en: This is an ineffective method of controlling your dog.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is ineffective, you mean that it has no effect on a process or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 政治力量、文化力量和经济力量之间必要的一致性
ext.ext_en: ...a necessary congruence between political, cultural and economic forces.

defs.def_en: Congruence is when two things are similar or fit together well.

ext.ext_cn: 斐济总理称斐济并不急于重返共同体。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister of Fiji has said Fiji is in no hurry to rejoin the Commonwealth...

ext.ext_cn: 他在1988年重回萨德勒的威尔斯皇家芭蕾舞团，任行政助理。
ext.ext_en: He rejoined Sadler's Wells Royal Ballet as Assistant Administrator in 1988.

defs.def_en: If you rejoin a group, club, or organization, you become a member of it again after not being a member for a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 米米和她的家人前往突尼斯与父亲团聚。
ext.ext_en: Mimi and her family went off to Tunisia to rejoin her father.

defs.def_en: If you rejoin someone, you go back to them after a short time away from them.

ext.ext_cn: 在多塞特码头向左返回河道。
ext.ext_en: At Dorset Wharf go left to rejoin the river...

ext.ext_cn: 早上我重新回到了127号公路的南端。
ext.ext_en: In the morning I rejoined Highway 127 south.

defs.def_en: If you rejoin a route, you go back to it after travelling along a different route for a time.

ext.ext_cn: “我敢说他们就是那样，”他的妻子冷淡地回答，“谁又能说谁是对的呢？”
ext.ext_en: 'I dare say they do,' rejoined his wife drily. 'And who's to say who's right?'

defs.def_en: To rejoin means to answer quickly what someone has said, usually in a clever or critical manner.

defs.def_cn: （舞台等表面）倾斜的，有坡度的

ext.ext_cn: 表演是在一个坡度很大的舞台上举行的。
ext.ext_en: The action takes place on a steeply raked stage.

defs.def_en: A raked stage or other surface is sloping, for example so that all the audience can see more clearly.

ext.ext_cn: 我的记忆刻在我的脑海里,永不磨灭。
ext.ext_en: My memories are within me, imperishable.

defs.def_en: Something that is imperishable cannot disappear or be destroyed.

defs.def_cn: 徒劳的;无效的;不成功的

ext.ext_cn: 起草委员会为按计划完成草案已通宵加班，但结果仍是徒劳。
ext.ext_en: The drafting committee worked through the night in a vain attempt to finish on schedule...

ext.ext_cn: 我唱歌试图让他高兴起来，结果是白费力气。
ext.ext_en: I was singing in a vain effort to cheer him up.

defs.def_en: A vain attempt or action is one that fails to achieve what was intended.

ext.ext_cn: 他娶了第四个老婆苏珊，徒然希望她能使他健康状况好转。
ext.ext_en: He married his fourth wife, Susan, in the vain hope that she would improve his health.

defs.def_en: If you describe a hope that something will happen as a vain hope, you mean that there is no chance of it happening.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自负的;虚荣的;自命不凡的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为他浅薄虚荣，不可信任。
ext.ext_en: I think he is shallow, vain and untrustworthy.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as vain, you are critical of their extreme pride in their own beauty, intelligence, or other good qualities.

ext.ext_cn: 他在门口停住，徒然地等待她和自己打招呼。
ext.ext_en: He stopped at the door, waiting in vain for her to acknowledge his presence...

ext.ext_cn: 很明显她所有的抱怨都是白费口舌。
ext.ext_en: It became obvious that all her complaints were in vain.

defs.def_en: If you do something in vain, you do not succeed in achieving what you intend.

defs.def_cn: 无用的;无意义的;无价值的

ext.ext_cn: 他想让全世界都知道，他的儿子不是白白死去的。
ext.ext_en: He wants the world to know his son did not die in vain.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as someone's  death, suffering, or effort was in vain, you mean that it was useless because it did not achieve anything.

ext.ext_cn: 布利克森男爵夫人，亦以笔名伊萨克·迪内森闻名
ext.ext_en: ...Baroness Blixen, also known by her pen-name Isak Dinesen.

defs.def_en: A writer's pen name is the name that he or she uses on books and articles instead of his or her real name.

defs.def_cn: （革命或研究的）前沿；先锋，先驱

ext.ext_cn: 这种想法使得柯达走在了改造计算机产业运动的最前沿。
ext.ext_en: Such thinking puts Kodak in the vanguard of a movement reshaping the computer industry...

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯爵士是一位非常杰出的建筑师，处于其专业领域的前沿位置。
ext.ext_en: Sir James was an immensely distinguished architect in the vanguard of his profession.

defs.def_en: If someone is in the vanguard of something such as a revolution or an area of research, they are involved in the most advanced part of it. You can also refer to the people themselves as the vanguard.

ext.ext_cn: 能够对入侵的先头部队进行快速有效反击的机动预备部队
ext.ext_en: ...a force of mobile reserve units that could strike quickly and effectively at the vanguard of an invading army.

defs.def_en: The vanguard of an army is the part of it that goes into battle first.

ext.ext_cn: 每栋别墅都有一间独立的起居室。
ext.ext_en: Each villa has a separate sitting-room...

ext.ext_cn: 他们如今正计划组建自己的独立政党。
ext.ext_en: They are now making plans to form their own separate party...

defs.def_en: If one thing is separate from another, there is a barrier, space, or division between them, so that they are clearly two things.

ext.ext_cn: 切生肉、熟肉、蔬菜和拌色拉的青菜时要使用不同的切菜板。
ext.ext_en: Use separate chopping boards for raw meats, cooked meats, vegetables and salads...

ext.ext_cn: 男女有各自的健身房。
ext.ext_en: Men and women have separate exercise rooms...

defs.def_en: If you refer to separate things, you mean several different things, rather than just one thing.

ext.ext_cn: 警方介入进来，将两拨人分开。
ext.ext_en: Police moved in to separate the two groups...

ext.ext_cn: 双手握住淘选盘不停旋动将沙金和尘土分开。
ext.ext_en: The pans were held in both hands and swirled around to separate gold particles from the dirt...

defs.def_en: If you separate people or things that are together, or if they separate, they move apart.

ext.ext_cn: 他们想把教学和研究分开。
ext.ext_en: They want to separate teaching from research...

ext.ext_cn: 很可能我们会目睹一场分裂该国这两个地区的运动。
ext.ext_en: It's  very possible that we may see a movement to separate the two parts of the country...

defs.def_en: If you separate people or things that have been connected, or if one separates from another, the connection between them is ended.

ext.ext_cn: 她很小的时候父母就分居了。
ext.ext_en: Her parents separated when she was very young...

ext.ext_cn: 自从我和我丈夫分开后，我的生活发生了很大的变化。
ext.ext_en: Since I separated from my husband I have gone a long way.

defs.def_en: If a couple who are married or living together separate, they decide to live apart.

ext.ext_cn: 将院子和小围场隔开的白色围栏
ext.ext_en: ...the white-railed fence that separated the yard from the paddock...

ext.ext_cn: 毫无疑问，他们在这两个时期相隔的 6 年间取得了进展。
ext.ext_en: They had undoubtedly made progress in the six years that separated the two periods...

defs.def_en: An object, obstacle, distance, or period of time which separates two people, groups, or things exists between them.

ext.ext_cn: 很难将传说和事实区别开来。
ext.ext_en: It is difficult to separate legend from truth...

ext.ext_cn: 学习如何分辨真实的和想象出的疾病
ext.ext_en: ...learning how to separate real problems from imaginary illnesses...

defs.def_en: If you separate one idea or fact from another, you clearly see or show the difference between them.

defs.def_cn: 使得以区分;使获得区别

ext.ext_cn: 区分普通照片和出色照片的一个至关重要的因素就是光线。
ext.ext_en: The single most important factor that separates ordinary photographs from good photographs is the lighting...

ext.ext_cn: 恐怖主义和其他暴力行为的区别是什么？
ext.ext_en: What separates terrorism from other acts of violence?

defs.def_en: A quality or factor that separates one thing from another is the reason why the two things are different from each other.

defs.def_cn: (两个参赛队或竞争者比分)相隔，相差

ext.ext_cn: 最终两队只相差 3 分。
ext.ext_en: In the end only three points separated the two teams.

defs.def_en: If a particular number of points separate two teams or competitors, one of them is winning or has won by that number of points.

ext.ext_cn: 警察想把他们拆散成几小股。
ext.ext_en: The police wanted to separate them into smaller groups...

ext.ext_cn: 沃勒斯坦的作品可以细分成3个主要的主题。
ext.ext_en: Wallerstein's work can be separated into three main component themes...

defs.def_en: If you separate a group of people or things into smaller elements, or if a group separates, it is divided into smaller elements.
Separates are clothes such as skirts, trousers, and shirts which cover just the top half or the bottom half of your body.

defs.def_cn: 分道扬镳;分手;分路而行

ext.ext_cn: 苏和丈夫决定离婚。
ext.ext_en: Sue and her husband decided to go their separate ways.

defs.def_en: When two or more people who have been together for some time go their separate ways, they go to different places or end their relationship.
