ext.ext_cn: 多德没有对自己的死刑判决提起上诉，而且他还要求自己的律师起诉任何成功使得这一死刑暂缓执行的人。
ext.ext_en: Dodd made no appeal of his death sentence and, further, instructed his attorney to sue anyone who succeeds in delaying his execution.

defs.def_en: You use further to introduce a statement that relates to the same general topic and that gives additional information or makes an additional point.

defs.def_cn: (用于书信中)关于贵方信中所提/关于我们所谈到的

ext.ext_cn: 正如贵方信中所提到的，我也认为从政治角度来说，有一些词语表意上的问题。
ext.ext_en: Further to your letter, I agree that there are some presentational problems, politically speaking.

defs.def_en: Further to is used in letters in expressions such as 'further to your letter' or 'further to our conversation', in order to indicate what you are referring to in the letter.

defs.def_cn: 有疗效的;药用的;治病的

ext.ext_cn: 药用植物
ext.ext_en: ...medicinal plants.

defs.def_en: Medicinal substances or substances with medicinal effects can be used to treat and cure illnesses.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的血喷了我一身。我几乎昏了过去。
ext.ext_en: They spurted blood all over me. I nearly passed out...

ext.ext_cn: 他击中了她的头部，她也开始流血。
ext.ext_en: He hit her on the head, causing her too to spurt blood.

defs.def_en: When liquid or fire spurts from somewhere, or when something spurts liquid or fire, it comes out quickly in a thin, powerful stream.

ext.ext_cn: 一股柴油从一个阀门中喷射出来，另一个阀门中则没有喷出任何东西。
ext.ext_en: A spurt of diesel came from one valve and none from the other.

defs.def_en: A spurt of liquid is a stream of it which comes out of something very forcefully.

ext.ext_cn: 在青春期，肌肉会迅猛发育。
ext.ext_en: At adolescence, muscles go through a growth spurt...

ext.ext_cn: 一股怒气直冲头顶，我的脸一下子涨得通红。
ext.ext_en: I flushed bright red as a spurt of anger flashed through me...

defs.def_en: A spurt of activity, effort, or emotion is a sudden, brief period of intense activity, effort, or emotion.

ext.ext_cn: 后轮突然转动起来，货车加速冲过了最后几英尺距离。
ext.ext_en: The back wheels spun and the van spurted up the last few feet.

ext.ext_cn: 在赛跑过程中这些肌肉多数时间里都匀速地运动着，但在最后运动员冲刺时则是例外。
ext.ext_en: These muscles work in a steady state for most of the race except at the end when the athlete puts on a spurt.

defs.def_en: If someone or something spurts somewhere, they suddenly increase their speed for a short while in order to get there.

ext.ext_cn: 交易时有时无：1977 年有 3 笔，1978 年没有，1979 年又有 3 笔。
ext.ext_en: The deals came in spurts: three in 1977, none in 1978, three more in 1979.

defs.def_en: If something happens in spurts, there are periods of activity followed by periods in which it does not happen.

ext.ext_cn: 用餐愉快。
ext.ext_en: Enjoy your food.

ext.ext_cn: 食物和水的供给
ext.ext_en: ...supplies of food and water.

defs.def_en: See also:convenience food;fast food;health food;junk food;wholefood;Food is what people and animals eat.

defs.def_cn: (常指因生病)不想吃东西，厌食

ext.ext_cn: 胃口不好，这可不像你了。
ext.ext_en: It's not like you to be off your food.

defs.def_en: If you are off your food, you do not want to eat, usually because you are ill.

ext.ext_cn: 弗雷泽勋爵的讲演发人深省。
ext.ext_en: Lord Fraser's speech offers much food for thought...

ext.ext_cn: 事业上的发展可能会引发你很多的思考。
ext.ext_en: Developments in your career may give you food for thought.

defs.def_en: If you give someone food for thought, you make them think carefully about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我站在那里凝望着他，惊叹竟有这么美的人。
ext.ext_en: I stood and gazed at him, awestruck that anyone could be so beautiful.

defs.def_en: If someone is awestruck, they are very impressed and amazed by something.

ext.ext_cn: 据沙特阿拉伯通讯社报道，有29人受伤。
ext.ext_en: The Saudi Press Agency reported that 29 people were injured.

defs.def_en: A country's press agency is an organization that gathers news from that country and supplies it to journalists from all over the world.

defs.def_cn: 不合时代的事；过时现象

ext.ext_cn: 总统常常认为教会属于落伍之物。
ext.ext_en: The President tended to regard the Church as an anachronism.

defs.def_en: You say that something is an anachronism when you think that it is out of date or old-fashioned.

defs.def_cn: 时代错误，年代误植（指所叙人、事与时代不符的错误）

ext.ext_cn: 最后一段有一个时代错误。异端裁判所那时已经不存在了。
ext.ext_en: The last paragraph contains an anachronism. The Holy Office no longer existed at that time.

defs.def_en: An anachronism is something in a book, play, or film that is wrong because it did not exist at the time the book, play, or film is set.
A roll-top desk is a desk which has a wooden cover which can be pulled down over the writing surface when the desk is not being used.

ext.ext_cn: 她邀请了750人乘坐豪华游艇“萨瓦罗纳”号。
ext.ext_en: She invited 750 people aboard the luxury yacht, the Savarona...

ext.ext_cn: 当他在联合火车站登上火车之际，他们向他道别。
ext.ext_en: They said goodbye to him as he got aboard the train at Union Station.

defs.def_en: If you are aboard a ship or plane, you are on it or in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他那两层高的砖房有一个漂亮的露台，四周环拥绿叶成阴的大树。
ext.ext_en: His two-story brick home was graced with a patio and surrounded by tall, leafy trees.

defs.def_en: Leafy trees and plants have lots of leaves on them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （地方）草木葱茏的，树木繁茂的

ext.ext_cn: 位于草木葱茏的市郊住宅区、带花园的半独立房子
ext.ext_en: ...semi-detached homes with gardens in leafy suburban areas.

defs.def_en: You say that a place is leafy when there are lots of trees and plants there.

defs.def_cn: 逐渐减少;越来越不重要;逐渐消失

ext.ext_cn: 去年，经济增长率下降到 4% 以下。
ext.ext_en: Last year, economic growth tailed off to below four percent...

ext.ext_cn: 反复使用本药，药效也不会减弱。
ext.ext_en: The drug's effect does not tail off after it has been used repeatedly.

defs.def_en: See also:tail away;When something tails off, it gradually becomes less in amount or value, often before coming to an end completely.

defs.def_cn: (为息事宁人而给的)小恩小惠

ext.ext_cn: 这明显是讨好广大爱尔兰裔美国观众的一种手段。
ext.ext_en: This is an obvious sop to the large Irish-American audience...

ext.ext_cn: 执政党也许想对右翼人士施以小恩小惠。
ext.ext_en: The government parties may be tempted to throw a few sops to the right-wingers.

defs.def_en: You describe something as a sop to a person when they are offered something small or unimportant in order to prevent them from getting angry or causing trouble.

ext.ext_cn: 在动手之前把炭火烧旺很重要。
ext.ext_en: It is important to get the coals white-hot before you start.

defs.def_en: If something is white-hot, it is extremely hot.

ext.ext_cn: 随着屏幕上图片的切换，记者继续报道。
ext.ext_en: As the pictures flashed on the screen, the newsman continued talking.

defs.def_en: A newsman is a journalist for a newspaper or for a television or radio news programme.

ext.ext_cn: 一个委员会专门小组受委派调查这些说法。
ext.ext_en: A sub-committee was deputed to investigate the claims.

defs.def_en: If you are deputed to do something, someone tells or allows you to do it on their behalf.

ext.ext_cn: 有很多人相信，该国种族关系的紧张最终将导致内战。
ext.ext_en: There are many who believe that civil war will be the eventual outcome of the racial tension in the country...

ext.ext_cn: 最终目标是实现统一。
ext.ext_en: The eventual aim is reunification.

defs.def_en: You use eventual to indicate that something happens or is the case at the end of a process or period of time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 邻居们的花园整洁美观。
ext.ext_en: The neighbours' gardens were trim and neat.

ext.ext_cn: 整齐的房舍
ext.ext_en: …the trim houses.

defs.def_en: Something that is trim is neat, tidy, and attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 司机是个大约 30 岁的身材苗条的年轻女子。
ext.ext_en: The driver was a trim young woman of perhaps thirty.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's figure as trim, you mean that it is attractive because there is no extra fat on their body.

ext.ext_cn: 我朋友每 8 个星期为我修剪一次头发。
ext.ext_en: My friend trims my hair every eight weeks...

ext.ext_cn: 除草剪刀专门用于修剪缝隙角落里的青草。
ext.ext_en: Grass shears are specially made to trim grass growing in awkward places.

defs.def_en: If you trim something, for example someone's hair, you cut off small amounts of it in order to make it look neater and tidier.

ext.ext_cn: 美国公司研究了能够削减这些成本的方法。
ext.ext_en: American companies looked at ways they could trim these costs...

ext.ext_cn: 我们缩小了市场营销部的规模。
ext.ext_en: We trimmed the marketing department.

defs.def_en: If a government or other organization trims something such as a plan, policy, or amount, they reduce it slightly in extent or size.

ext.ext_cn: 另外以钩花镶边的夹克
ext.ext_en: ...jackets, which are then trimmed with crocheted flowers...

ext.ext_cn: 我穿着一件带有白色蕾丝花边的格子呢睡衣。
ext.ext_en: I am wearing a plaid nightgown trimmed with white lace.

defs.def_en: If something such as a piece of clothing is trimmed with a type of material or design, it is decorated with it, usually along its edges.

ext.ext_cn: 黑边白缎围巾
ext.ext_en: ...a white satin scarf with black trim...

ext.ext_cn: 这些车座的特点是带有在夜间可视的反光镶边。
ext.ext_en: The saddles feature a reflective trim for night time visibility.

defs.def_en: The trim on something such as a piece of clothing is a decoration, for example along its edges, that is in a different colour or material.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经在为那个重要的日子调整状态了。
ext.ext_en: He is already getting in trim for the big day...

ext.ext_cn: 那是保持我声线处于良好状态的极好办法。
ext.ext_en: It is an excellent way of keeping my voice in trim.

defs.def_en: When people are in trim or in good trim, they are in good physical condition.

defs.def_cn: (尤指女子穿低胸服时露出的)乳沟
defs.def_en: A woman's cleavage is the space between her breasts, especially the top part which you see if she is wearing a dress with a low neck.

ext.ext_cn: 那两个地区之间的经济差距
ext.ext_en: ...the economic cleavages between the two regions.

defs.def_en: A cleavage between two people or things is a division or disagreement between them.

ext.ext_cn: 世界上一些最伟大的思想家
ext.ext_en: ...some of the world's greatest thinkers.

defs.def_en: A thinker is a person who spends a lot of time thinking deeply about important things, especially someone who is famous for thinking of new or interesting ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 我们明天去野餐。
ext.ext_en: We're going on a picnic tomorrow...

ext.ext_cn: 我们要到户外用午餐。
ext.ext_en: We'll take a picnic lunch.

defs.def_en: When people have a picnic, they eat a meal out of doors, usually in a field or a forest, or at the beach.

ext.ext_cn: 之后，我们在河边野餐。
ext.ext_en: Afterwards, we picnicked on the riverbank.

ext.ext_cn: 适合野餐的好天气
ext.ext_en: ...such a perfect day for picnicking.

defs.def_en: When people picnic somewhere, they have a picnic.

defs.def_cn: 不是件轻松（或愉快）的事

ext.ext_cn: 移民不是件轻松的事。
ext.ext_en: Emigrating is no picnic.

defs.def_en: If you say that an experience, task, or activity is no picnic, you mean that it is quite difficult or unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 巨大的;庞大的;厚重的;强大的

ext.ext_cn: 有证据表明是巨额欺诈。
ext.ext_en: There was evidence of massive fraud.

ext.ext_cn: 大规模空袭
ext.ext_en: ...massive air attacks...

defs.def_en: Something that is massive is very large in size, quantity, or extent.

defs.def_cn: (疾病)非常严重的，十分危急的

ext.ext_cn: 六周后他因严重的心脏病发作去世。
ext.ext_en: He died six weeks later of a massive heart attack.

defs.def_en: If you describe a medical condition as massive, you mean that it is extremely serious.

defs.def_cn: （尤指运河上载货用的）大型平底船，驳船

ext.ext_cn: 通过铁路运货的成本比驳船运货成本高出近3倍。
ext.ext_en: Carrying goods by train costs nearly three times more than carrying them by barge.

defs.def_en: A barge is a long, narrow boat with a flat bottom. Barges are used for carrying heavy loads, especially on canals.

ext.ext_cn: 学生们试图闯进秘书处的办公大楼。
ext.ext_en: Students tried to barge into the secretariat buildings...

ext.ext_cn: 联邦调查局的探员破门而入，要求在工厂内搜寻证据。
ext.ext_en: The FBI barged through the gates, demanding to search the plant for evidence.

defs.def_en: If you barge into a place or barge through it, you rush or push into it in a rough and rude way.

ext.ext_cn: 他会向他们冲过去，踹他们的小腿肚子。
ext.ext_en: He would barge into them and kick them in the shins...

ext.ext_cn: 他从她身边冲过去扑向吉利恩时，将其撞倒在地。
ext.ext_en: He barged past her and sprang at Gillian, knocking her to the floor.

defs.def_en: If you barge into someone or barge past them, you bump against them roughly and rudely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无止境的;无边无际的;无休止的

ext.ext_cn: 他们转入一条看不到尽头的街道。
ext.ext_en: They turned into an endless street...

ext.ext_cn: 那是场无休止的战争。
ext.ext_en: The war was endless.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is endless, you mean that it is very large or lasts for a very long time, and it seems as if it will never stop.

ext.ext_cn: 遮光幕帘
ext.ext_en: ...blackout curtains.

defs.def_en: A blackout is a period of time during a war in which towns and buildings are made dark so that they cannot be seen by enemy planes.

defs.def_cn: （新闻等的）禁播，封锁，禁止出版

ext.ext_cn: 皇宫施行的新闻封锁
ext.ext_en: ...a media blackout imposed by the Imperial Palace...

ext.ext_cn: 记者们说有关这场集会的新闻实际上被封锁了。
ext.ext_en: Journalists said there was a virtual news blackout about the rally.

defs.def_en: If a blackout is imposed on a particular piece of news, journalists are prevented from broadcasting or publishing it.

ext.ext_cn: 该国北部大片地区断电。
ext.ext_en: There was an electricity black-out in a large area in the north of the country.

defs.def_en: If there is a power blackout, the electricity supply to a place is temporarily cut off.

ext.ext_cn: 我昏迷了几分钟。
ext.ext_en: I suffered a black-out which lasted for several minutes.

defs.def_en: If you have a blackout, you temporarily lose consciousness.

ext.ext_cn: 我撕开了那个包裹。
ext.ext_en: I tore open the package.

ext.ext_cn: 寄给克莱尔·蒙哥马利小姐的包裹
ext.ext_en: ...a package addressed to Miss Claire Montgomery.

defs.def_en: A package is a small parcel.

ext.ext_cn: 一包炸面圈
ext.ext_en: ...a package of doughnuts...

ext.ext_cn: 它是包装盒标明的成分之一。
ext.ext_en: It is listed among the ingredients on the package.

defs.def_en: A package is a small container in which a quantity of something is sold. Packages are either small boxes made of thin cardboard, or bags or envelopes made of paper or plastic.

ext.ext_cn: 政府已经公布了帮助英国电影产业的一揽子措施。
ext.ext_en: The government has announced a package of measures to help the British film industry...

ext.ext_cn: 他们为莫斯科准备了一整套西方经济援助计划。
ext.ext_en: They put together a Western economic aid package for Moscow.

defs.def_en: A package is a set of proposals that are made by a government or organization and which must be accepted or rejected as a group.

ext.ext_cn: 然后那些咖啡豆被磨碎，包装好作为咖啡粉出售。
ext.ext_en: The beans are then ground and packaged for sale as ground coffee...

ext.ext_cn: 包装食品必须列出食品成分。
ext.ext_en: Packaged foods have to show a list of ingredients.

defs.def_en: When a product is packaged, it is put into containers to be sold.

defs.def_cn: （为提高吸引力或趣味性而）包装

ext.ext_cn: 城市必须进行适当的包装以吸引游客。
ext.ext_en: A city has to be packaged properly to be attractive to tourists.

ext.ext_cn: 被包装成知识性节目的娱乐节目
ext.ext_en: ...entertainment packaged as information.

defs.def_en: If something is packaged in a particular way, it is presented or advertised in that way in order to make it seem attractive or interesting.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你是参加包价旅游，你的旅行社代表将代为行事。
ext.ext_en: If you are on a package holiday, your travel company's rep should act on your behalf.

defs.def_en: A package tour, or in British English a package holiday, is a holiday arranged by a travel company in which your travel and your accommodation are booked for you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （体育活动）剧烈的，强度大的，强劲的

ext.ext_cn: 运动太过剧烈会增大心脏病发作的风险。
ext.ext_en: Very vigorous exercise can increase the risk of heart attacks...

ext.ext_cn: 非洲舞蹈强劲奔放，但又处处透着细腻。
ext.ext_en: African dance is vigorous, but full of subtlety.

defs.def_en: Vigorous physical activities involve using a lot of energy, usually to do short and repeated actions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯特爵士是位坚定而又活跃的政治家。
ext.ext_en: Sir Robert was a strong and vigorous politician.

ext.ext_cn: 言辞最为激烈的政府批评家们
ext.ext_en: ...the most vigorous critics of the government...

defs.def_en: A vigorous person does things with great energy and enthusiasm. A vigorous campaign or activity is done with great energy and enthusiasm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 精力旺盛的;充满活力的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个精力充沛、年轻帅气的小伙子。
ext.ext_en: He was a vigorous, handsome young man.

defs.def_en: A vigorous person is strong and healthy and full of energy.

ext.ext_cn: 我们常常认为我们所做和所想的一切都出自自己的意愿。
ext.ext_en: We like to think that everything we do and everything we think is a product of our volition...

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉自己好像被命运掌控，毫无自主选择的余地。
ext.ext_en: He felt as though he were in the grip of Fate and had no volition of his own.

defs.def_en: Your volition  is the power you have to decide something for yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 梅金说库姆斯先生是主动去投案的。
ext.ext_en: Makin said Mr Coombes had gone to the police of his own volition.

defs.def_en: If you do something of your own volition, you do it because you have decided for yourself that you will do it and not because someone else has told you to do it.

defs.def_cn: （关节和脊柱）矫形的；矫形外科的

ext.ext_cn: 矫形外科医生
ext.ext_en: ...an orthopaedic surgeon.

ext.ext_cn: 矫形鞋
ext.ext_en: ...orthopedic shoes.

defs.def_en: Orthopaedic means relating to problems affecting people's joints and spines.

ext.ext_cn: 他系着一条带大铜扣的腰带。
ext.ext_en: He wore a belt with a large brass buckle.

defs.def_en: See also:safety belt;seat belt;A belt is a strip of leather or cloth that you fasten round your waist.

ext.ext_cn: 转盘由一根传动带与电机相连。
ext.ext_en: The turning disc is connected by a drive belt to an electric motor.

defs.def_en: See also:conveyor belt;fan belt;A belt in a machine is a circular strip of rubber that is used to drive moving parts or to move objects along.

ext.ext_cn: 赞比亚北部铜矿带的矿工已经罢工了。
ext.ext_en: Miners in Zambia's northern copper belt have gone on strike...

ext.ext_cn: 在他身后是一片树林，树林后面是小山和田地。
ext.ext_en: Behind him was a belt of trees, and behind the trees hills and fields.

defs.def_en: See also:Bible Belt;commuter belt;green belt;A belt of land or sea is a long, narrow area of it that has some special feature.

ext.ext_cn: “她真的把老乔治痛打了一顿？”她问。
ext.ext_en: 'Is it right she belted old George in the gut?'  she asked.

ext.ext_cn: 爸爸会拿硬毛刷打爆你的头。
ext.ext_en: Father would give you a belt over the head with the scrubbing brush.

defs.def_en: If someone belts you, they hit you very hard.

ext.ext_cn: 我们沿着艾维格大街一路飞奔到汽车那儿。
ext.ext_en: We belted down Iveagh Parade to where the motor was.

defs.def_en: If you belt somewhere, you move or travel there very fast.

defs.def_cn: （表示柔道或空手道级别的）段，带

ext.ext_cn: 他是空手道黑带选手。
ext.ext_en: He is a black belt in karate.

defs.def_en: See also:belted.PHRAESE;If someone is or has a belt of a particular colour in judo or karate, they have reached the standard which that colour represents.

ext.ext_cn: 你觉得他们的做法是不是有点儿不太光明正大？
ext.ext_en: Do you think it's a bit below the belt what they're  doing?

ext.ext_cn: 这种不公正的歧视
ext.ext_en: ...this kind of below-the-belt discrimination.

defs.def_en: Something that is below the belt  is cruel and unfair.

defs.def_cn: 勒紧裤腰带；紧缩开支；节衣缩食

ext.ext_cn: 明摆着，要是你入不敷出，你就得省着点了。
ext.ext_en: Clearly, if you are spending more than your income, you'll need to tighten your belt.

defs.def_en: If you have to tighten your belt, you have to spend less money and manage without things because you have less money than you used to have.

ext.ext_cn: 克莱尔现在是全职作家，著有6本书，其中有4部小说。
ext.ext_en: Clare is now a full-time author with six books, including four novels, under her belt.

defs.def_en: If you have something under your belt, you have already achieved it or done it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 吱嘎作响的;发出刺耳声音的

ext.ext_cn: 吱嘎作响的地板
ext.ext_en: ...squeaky floorboards...

ext.ext_cn: 他的声音很尖。
ext.ext_en: He had a squeaky voice.

defs.def_en: Something that is squeaky makes high-pitched sounds.
Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

ext.ext_cn: 这些疾病的机理极其复杂。
ext.ext_en: The biology of these diseases is terribly complicated.

ext.ext_cn: 人体生命机理
ext.ext_en: ...human biology.

defs.def_en: The biology of a living thing is the way in which its body or cells behave.

ext.ext_cn: 艉楼甲板
ext.ext_en: ...the poop deck.

defs.def_en: The poop of an old-fashioned sailing ship is the raised structure at the back end of it.

ext.ext_cn: 青少年俚语
ext.ext_en: ...the argot of teenagers.

ext.ext_cn: 足球行话
ext.ext_en: ...footballing argot.

defs.def_en: An argot is a special language used by a particular group of people, which other people find difficult to understand.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 波尔多位于巴黎到马德里的铁路主干线上，来往列车频繁。
ext.ext_en: Bordeaux is on the main Paris-Madrid line so there are frequent trains...

ext.ext_cn: 他是这家的常客。
ext.ext_en: He is a frequent visitor to the house.

defs.def_en: If something is frequent, it happens often.

ext.ext_cn: 我听说他经常光顾汉普斯特德的卡津餐厅。
ext.ext_en: I hear he frequents the Cajun restaurant in Hampstead.

defs.def_en: If someone frequents a particular place, they regularly go there.

defs.def_cn: （尤指食物）合礼的（合乎犹太教教规的）

ext.ext_cn: 合礼的屠户
ext.ext_en: ...a kosher butcher.

defs.def_en: Something, especially food, that is kosher is approved of or allowed by the laws of Judaism.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得有点不对劲儿。
ext.ext_en: I guessed something wasn't quite kosher...

ext.ext_cn: 演戏对一个出身上流社会的女孩儿来说不是个合适的职业。
ext.ext_en: Acting was not a kosher trade for an upper-class girl.

defs.def_en: Something that is kosher is generally approved of or considered to be correct.
A destroyer is a small, heavily armed warship.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司对热带雨林的破坏位居世界之首。
ext.ext_en: The company is the world's largest destroyer of tropical forests.

defs.def_en: Something or someone that is described as a destroyer destroys things or people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 公开的；明显的；不隐藏的

ext.ext_cn: 他最近所创作的都是些精雕细琢的作品，少有鲜明的政治内容。
ext.ext_en: His recent productions have been beautifully crafted works with little overt political content...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然黑人学生与白人学生之间没有公开的敌意，但他们也不怎么来往。
ext.ext_en: Although there is no overt hostility, black and white students do not mix much.

defs.def_en: An overt action or attitude is done or shown in an open and obvious way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 当败象已呈时，芭芭拉看上去越来越沮丧。
ext.ext_en: Barbara looked increasingly downcast as defeat loomed.

ext.ext_cn: 忧郁、沮丧的表情
ext.ext_en: ...a glum, downcast expression.

defs.def_en: If you are downcast, you are feeling sad and without hope.

defs.def_cn: (眼睛通常因难过或尴尬)向下看的，低垂的

ext.ext_cn: 她一言不发，两眼低垂。
ext.ext_en: She was silent, her eyes downcast.

defs.def_en: If your eyes are downcast, you are looking towards the ground, usually because you are feeling sad or embarrassed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我非常感激他对我的帮助。
ext.ext_en: I am deeply indebted to him for his help.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are indebted to someone for something, you mean that you are very grateful to them for something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 美国财政部长指出了负债最多的那些国家。
ext.ext_en: America's treasury secretary identified the most heavily indebted countries.

defs.def_en: Indebted countries, organizations, or people are ones that owe money to other countries, organizations, or people.
A stopcock is a tap on a pipe, which you turn in order to allow something to pass through the pipe or to stop it from passing through.

ext.ext_cn: 他们显然完全接受了西方的消费主义观念。
ext.ext_en: They have clearly embraced Western consumerism.

defs.def_en: Consumerism is the belief that it is good to buy and use a lot of goods.
Consumerism is the protection of the rights and interests of consumers.

defs.def_cn: 首次的;前所未有的;史无前例的

ext.ext_cn: 这是两国领导人的首次会晤。
ext.ext_en: It's the first-ever meeting between leaders of the two countries.

defs.def_en: Something that is the first ever one of its kind has never happened before.

ext.ext_cn: 卡洛斯·梅奈姆削减国营部门、向自由市场开放经济的政策
ext.ext_en: ...Carlos Menem's policy of reducing the  public sector and opening up the economy to free-market forces...

ext.ext_cn: 为维持经济改革的正常进展，必须裁掉6万个国有部门的工作岗位。
ext.ext_en: To keep economic reform on track, 60,000 public-sector jobs must be cut.

defs.def_en: The public sector is the part of a country's economy which is controlled or supported financially by the government.

ext.ext_cn: 慢性背痛
ext.ext_en: ...chronic back pain.

defs.def_en: A chronic illness or disability lasts for a very long time.

defs.def_cn: 难以根除的;积习难改的

ext.ext_cn: 不相信抽烟能上瘾的人肯定不是老烟民。
ext.ext_en: Anyone who does not believe that smoking is an addiction has never been a chronic smoker.

ext.ext_cn: 总是忧心忡忡的人
ext.ext_en: ...a chronic worrier.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone's bad habits or behaviour as chronic when they have behaved like that for a long time and do not seem to be able to stop themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 那位艺术家自杀的一个原因似乎是极端贫困。
ext.ext_en: One cause of the artist's suicide seems to have been chronic poverty...

ext.ext_cn: 这个治安辖区严重缺乏巡逻车辆。
ext.ext_en: There is a chronic shortage of patrol cars in this police district.

defs.def_en: A chronic situation or problem is very severe and unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: “哥伦比亚”号宇宙飞船昨天着陆。
ext.ext_en: Spacecraft Columbia touched down yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 第一批分遣大部队今天在美国着陆。
ext.ext_en: The first large contingent of troops touches down on American soil today.

defs.def_en: When an aircraft touches down, it lands.

ext.ext_cn: 最终，我们一致决定组织一场复活节音乐会。
ext.ext_en: In the end, we all decided to organize a concert for Easter.

ext.ext_cn: 由联合国组织的为期两天的会议
ext.ext_en: ...a two-day meeting organised by the United Nations...

defs.def_en: If you organize an event or activity, you make sure that the necessary arrangements are made.

defs.def_cn: 提供，准备（想要或所需之物）

ext.ext_cn: 我来安排交通。
ext.ext_en: I will organize transport...

ext.ext_cn: 他给妻子打电话，叫她准备好咖啡和三明治。
ext.ext_en: He rang his wife and asked her to organize coffee and sandwiches.

defs.def_en: If you organize something that someone wants or needs, you make sure that it is provided.

defs.def_cn: 整理；使有条理；使具结构

ext.ext_cn: 他开始整理材料。
ext.ext_en: He began to organize his materials...

ext.ext_cn: 她匆匆喝了杯咖啡，试图整理一下纷乱的思绪。
ext.ext_en: She took a hasty cup of coffee and tried to organize her scattered thoughts.

defs.def_en: If you organize a set of things, you arrange them in an ordered way or give them a structure.

ext.ext_cn: 改变自我规划的方式
ext.ext_en: ...changing the way you organize yourself...

ext.ext_cn: 只管干吧，我相信你用不着我来为你安排。
ext.ext_en: Go right ahead, I'm sure you don't need me to organize you...

defs.def_en: If you organize yourself, you plan your work and activities in an ordered, efficient way.

ext.ext_cn: 帮助组织在国外工作的妇女
ext.ext_en: ...helping to organize women working abroad...

ext.ext_cn: 这是农场主首次决定组织起来。
ext.ext_en: It's the first time farmers have decided to organize.

defs.def_en: If someone organizes workers or if workers organize, they form a group or society such as a trade union in order to have more power.

ext.ext_cn: 沿着街道往北过了一个街区，我找到了一个停车场。
ext.ext_en: A block up the street I found a parking lot.

defs.def_en: A parking lot is an area of ground where people can leave their cars.

ext.ext_cn: 他们两个都想轮岗。
ext.ext_en: They both want to job share.

ext.ext_cn: 她在一家银行干一份轮岗制工作。
ext.ext_en: She works in a bank job share.

defs.def_en: If two people job share, they share the same job by working part-time, for example one person working in the mornings and the other in the afternoons.

defs.def_cn: （锻炼）对身体冲击力小的，低强度的

ext.ext_cn: 这一低强度锻炼的内容包括在伴随音乐做完固定动作之后重复踏上踏下平台。
ext.ext_en: This low-impact exercise involves stepping on and off a platform following routines to music.

defs.def_en: Low-impact exercise  does not put a lot of stress on your body.

defs.def_cn: （项目、活动等）对环境影响小的，环保的

ext.ext_cn: 审慎、文明、环保的生态旅游
ext.ext_en: ...sensitive, enlightened, low-impact ecotourism...

ext.ext_cn: 在黄石公园里使用雪车这一想法，为人们提供了一种对环境低影响、低污染的游览方式。
ext.ext_en: The snowcoach concept in Yellowstone provides low-impact, low-pollution access.

defs.def_en: Low-impact projects, developments, and activities such as holidays are designed to cause minimum harm to the environment.

defs.def_cn: （贴在汽车后保险杠上、通常印有政治、宗教标语或幽默言语的）保险杠贴纸

ext.ext_cn: 汽车后保险杠的贴纸上写着：“当祖母，真幸福。”
ext.ext_en: ...a bumper sticker that said, 'Happiness Is Being a Grandmother'.

defs.def_en: A bumper sticker is a small piece of paper or plastic with words or pictures on it, designed for sticking onto the back of your car. It usually has a political, religious, or humorous message.

ext.ext_cn: 房间里的紧张气氛消失了。
ext.ext_en: The tension in the room had dissipated...

ext.ext_cn: 他摇下窗子来散热。
ext.ext_en: He wound down the windows to dissipate the heat.

defs.def_en: When something dissipates or when you dissipate it, it becomes less or becomes less strong until it disappears or goes away completely.

defs.def_cn: 浪费(金钱、时间或精力);挥霍

ext.ext_cn: 他在太多不同的事情上浪费时间和精力。
ext.ext_en: He is dissipating his time and energy on too many different things...

ext.ext_cn: 她父亲已经挥霍掉了她继承的遗产。
ext.ext_en: Her father had dissipated her inheritance.

defs.def_en: When someone dissipates money, time, or effort, they waste it in a foolish way.

ext.ext_cn: 每年35英镑的费用
ext.ext_en: ...a fee of £35 per annum...

ext.ext_cn: 肯尼亚人口正以每年4.1%的速度增长。
ext.ext_en: Kenya's population is growing at 4.1 per cent per annum.

defs.def_en: A particular amount per annum means that amount each year.

defs.def_cn: (电影、音乐会或演出的)幕间休息

ext.ext_cn: 在音乐剧《与情人共舞》的幕间休息期间
ext.ext_en: ...during the intermission of the musical 'Steppin' Out'.

ext.ext_cn: 弗雷泽直到中场休息之后才上场。
ext.ext_en: Fraser did not perform until after intermission.

defs.def_en: An intermission is a short break between two parts of a film, concert, or show.

ext.ext_cn: 我依然做梦梦见家。
ext.ext_en: I still dream of home...

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩的脚趾还是肿得很厉害，穿不上鞋。
ext.ext_en: Brian's toe is still badly swollen and he cannot put on his shoe...

defs.def_en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

ext.ext_cn: 如果这场危机让油价居高不下的话，仍然有可能赚大钱。
ext.ext_en: Big money could still be made if the crisis keeps oil prices high...

ext.ext_cn: 我们仍然可以赶去，只不过要到 3 点钟才能到。
ext.ext_en: We could still make it, but we won't get there till three...

defs.def_en: If something that has not yet happened could still happen, it is possible that it will happen. If something that has not yet happened is still to happen, it will happen at a later time.

ext.ext_cn: 巴尔迪只加了少许咖啡给牛奶调色，还剩下很多。
ext.ext_en: Bardi coloured the milk with the slightest touch of coffee, of which there was still plenty...

ext.ext_cn: 还有一些未解决的问题。
ext.ext_en: There are still some outstanding problems...

defs.def_en: If you say that there is still an amount of something left, you are emphasizing that there is that amount left.

defs.def_cn: 但是;尽管如此;(虽然…)还是

ext.ext_cn: 从身高来看，我算是中等身材。但我还是觉得自己胖了点。
ext.ext_en: I'm average for my height. But I still feel I'm fatter than I should be...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管法庭先前已有裁决，博勒姆还是被判有罪。
ext.ext_en: Despite the ruling, Boreham was still found guilty.

defs.def_en: You use still to emphasize that something remains the case or is true in spite of what you have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的好运已经到头了。不过，别担心。
ext.ext_en: Their luck had simply run out. Still, never fear...

ext.ext_cn: “知道这个周末谁要来吗?”——“不知道。不过，管他呢。”
ext.ext_en: 'Any idea who is going to be here this weekend?' — 'No. Still, who cares?'

defs.def_en: You use still to indicate that a problem or difficulty is not really worth worrying about.

defs.def_cn: (与 further, another, more 等连用强调数量惊人或极大)更，还

ext.ext_cn: 我们期盼着进一步加强和警方的合作，形成更加紧密的合作关系。
ext.ext_en: We look forward to strengthening still further our already close co-operation with the police service...

ext.ext_cn: 银行为什么不在贷出更多钱之前先审计自己的账目呢？
ext.ext_en: Why did the bank not conduct its own audit before lending still more?

defs.def_en: You use still in expressions such as still further ,still another, and still more to show that you find the number or quantity of things you are referring to surprising or excessive.

defs.def_cn: (与比较级连用强调某种特点)更，还要

ext.ext_cn: 据说，一级方程式赛车很危险，而“印第赛车”相比更危险。
ext.ext_en: Formula One motor car racing is supposed to be dangerous. 'Indycar' racing is supposed to be more dangerous still.

defs.def_en: You use still with comparatives to indicate that something has even more of a quality than something else.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 戴维一直像个孩子似的蹦蹦跳跳，但突然他停了下来看着布拉德。
ext.ext_en: David had been dancing about like a child, but suddenly he stood still and looked at Brad...

ext.ext_cn: 他把磁带从头到尾放了一遍，然后一动不动地静坐了几分钟。
ext.ext_en: He played the tape through once, then sat very still for several minutes...

defs.def_en: If you stay still, you stay in the same position and do not move.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 夜晚没有什么风。
ext.ext_en: The night air was very still...

ext.ext_cn: 他看着船边平静的水。
ext.ext_en: He watched the still water over the side of the boat.

defs.def_en: If air or water is still, it is not moving.

defs.def_cn: (饮料)不含碳酸气的，不冒泡的

ext.ext_cn: 一杯无汽橘子水
ext.ext_en: ...a glass of still orange.

defs.def_en: Drinks that are still do not contain any bubbles of carbon dioxide.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 房间里十分宁静。
ext.ext_en: In the room it was very still.

defs.def_en: If a place is still, it is quiet and shows no sign of activity.

ext.ext_cn: 她的哭声慢慢静了下来。
ext.ext_en: Her crying slowly stilled...

ext.ext_cn: 人群的喧哗平息下来，变成了满怀期待的低语声。
ext.ext_en: The roar of the crowd stilled to an expectant murmur...

defs.def_en: If a sound stills or is stilled, it becomes quiet.
A still is a photograph taken from a cinema film which is used for publicity purposes.
A still is a piece of equipment used to make strong alcoholic drinks by a process called distilling.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 值得帮助的;应受支持的

ext.ext_cn: 省下来的钱可以用于更有意义的事业。
ext.ext_en: The money saved could be used for more deserving causes.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person, organization, or cause as deserving, you mean that you think they should be helped.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 应该得到政府津贴的艺术家
ext.ext_en: ...artists deserving of public subsidy.

defs.def_en: If someone is deserving of something, they have qualities or achievements which make it right that they should receive it.

ext.ext_cn: 我对此不禁感到一丝不安。
ext.ext_en: I can't help feeling just a mite uneasy about it...

ext.ext_cn: 我想如果你是女人的话，也许会感到些许不同。
ext.ext_en: I think if you were a woman you might feel a mite differently.

defs.def_en: A mite means to a small extent or degree. It is sometimes used to make a statement less extreme.

defs.def_cn: (生存在植物上或动物皮毛中的)螨

ext.ext_cn: 寄生螨虫引起的皮肤瘙痒
ext.ext_en: ...an itching skin disorder caused by parasitic mites.

defs.def_en: Mites are very tiny creatures that live on plants, for example, or in animals' fur.

ext.ext_cn: 可怜的孩子病得这么重。
ext.ext_en: The poor mite was so ill.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a small child as a poor little mite, you mean that you feel sorry for them.

ext.ext_cn: 用餐时她一直坐在他身旁。
ext.ext_en: She sat next to him throughout the meal...

ext.ext_cn: 我难得跟孩子们一起吃晚饭。
ext.ext_en: It's rare that I have an evening meal with my children.

defs.def_en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down and eat, usually at a regular time.

ext.ext_cn: 侍者为他端上佐餐的红葡萄酒或者白葡萄酒。
ext.ext_en: The waiter offered him red wine or white wine with his meal...

ext.ext_cn: 新鲜的鱼做菜非常美味。
ext.ext_en: Fresh fish makes a delicious meal.

defs.def_en: A meal is the food you eat during a meal.
Meal is a rough powder made of crushed grain. It is used to make flour or animal food.

defs.def_cn: 花费过多的时间或精力做…;对…小题大做

ext.ext_cn: 律师总是死抠细节。
ext.ext_en: Lawyers always make such a meal of the simplest little thing.

defs.def_en: If you think someone is taking more time and energy to do something than is necessary, you can say that they are making a meal of it.
If you have a square meal, you have a large healthy meal.

ext.ext_cn: 农民脱下了他们的帽子。
ext.ext_en: The peasants doff their hats.

defs.def_en: If you doff your hat or coat, you take it off.

defs.def_cn: 无法控制的；控制不住的

ext.ext_cn: 那是一个几乎难以抑制亢奋的时期。
ext.ext_en: It had been a time of almost uncontrollable excitement...

ext.ext_cn: 威廉怒不可遏。
ext.ext_en: William was seized with uncontrollable rage...

defs.def_en: If you describe a feeling or physical action as uncontrollable, you mean that you cannot control it or prevent yourself from feeling or doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 马克沉默寡言，难以管束。
ext.ext_en: Mark was withdrawn and uncontrollable...

ext.ext_cn: 任性放肆的孩子会变成年轻的罪犯。
ext.ext_en: Uncontrollable children grow into young criminals.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as uncontrollable, you mean that their behaviour is bad and that nobody can make them behave more sensibly.

ext.ext_cn: 如果政治和民族问题得不到解决，局面可能会失控。
ext.ext_en: If political and ethnic problems are not resolved the situation could become uncontrollable.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation or series of events as uncontrollable, you believe that nothing can be done to control them or to prevent things from getting worse.

ext.ext_cn: 批评家声称他压榨黑人音乐家谋求私利。
ext.ext_en: Critics claim he exploited black musicians for personal gain.

ext.ext_cn: 受剥削的甘蔗工人的困境
ext.ext_en: ...the plight of the exploited sugar cane workers.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is exploiting you, you think that they are treating you unfairly by using your work or ideas and giving you very little in return.

ext.ext_cn: 政府及其反对派竞相利用这些问题为自己谋利。
ext.ext_en: The government and its opponents compete to exploit the troubles to their advantage.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is exploiting a situation, you disapprove of them because they are using it to gain an advantage for themselves, rather than trying to help other people or do what is right.

ext.ext_cn: 你需要弄个好天线来发挥广播的性能。
ext.ext_en: You'll need a good aerial to exploit the radio's performance...

ext.ext_cn: 卡里希望好好利用欧洲的新机遇。
ext.ext_en: Cary is hoping to exploit new opportunities in Europe...

defs.def_en: If you exploit something, you use it well, and achieve something or gain an advantage from it.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为不开采我们自己的煤是非常短视的做法。
ext.ext_en: I think we're being very short sighted in not exploiting our own coal.

defs.def_en: To exploit resources or raw materials means to develop them and use them for industry or commercial activities.

defs.def_cn: 英勇行为;功绩;有趣的行为

ext.ext_cn: 他在战争中的英勇行为后来被改编成一部电影。
ext.ext_en: His wartime exploits were later made into a film.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's exploits, you mean the brave, interesting, or amusing things that they have done.

ext.ext_cn: 居民以白人中产阶级为主的郊区
ext.ext_en: ...a predominately white, middle-class suburb.

defs.def_en: Predominately means the same as predominantly .

defs.def_cn: （运动员或音乐家等的）精彩的表现，出色的表演
defs.def_en: If you say that someone such as a sports player or musician has played a blinder, you are emphasizing that they have played something very well.
Blinders are the same as blinkers .

defs.def_cn: (附于摩托车旁可载人的)边车，跨斗，侧车
defs.def_en: A sidecar is a kind of box with wheels which you can attach to the side of a motorcycle so that you can carry a passenger in it.

ext.ext_cn: 问题是心理方面的而不是生理方面的。
ext.ext_en: The problem was psychological rather than physiological...

ext.ext_cn: 莎草看上去和普通的草没什么两样，但其草茎是实芯的而不是空芯的。
ext.ext_en: Sedge is similar in appearance to grass but has a solid rather than a hollow stem...

defs.def_en: You use rather than when you are contrasting two things or situations. Rather than introduces the thing or situation that is not true or that you do not want.

defs.def_cn: 而是；更确切地说；还不如说；相反

ext.ext_cn: 2,000万年前，爱达荷州并不像现在这样干旱。相反，那时的爱达荷州温暖潮湿，有大片的原始森林。
ext.ext_en: Twenty million years ago, Idaho was not the arid place it is now. Rather, it was warm and damp, populated by dense primordial forest...

ext.ext_cn: 但是这还谈不上是最后的胜利；而是长期、艰难地寻找解决方法的过程。
ext.ext_en: But there must be no talk of final victory; rather, the long, hard slog to a solution...

defs.def_en: You use rather when you are correcting something that you have just said, especially when you are describing a particular situation after saying what it is not.

ext.ext_cn: 如果对你来说没什么差别，我宁愿在家中工作。
ext.ext_en: If it's all the same to you, I'd rather work at home...

ext.ext_cn: 你更愿意在哪个节目中露面？
ext.ext_en: Which programme would you rather appear on?...

defs.def_en: If you say that you would rather do something or you'd rather do it, you mean that you would prefer to do it. If you say that you would rather not do something, you mean that you do not want to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我在非同寻常的环境下长大。
ext.ext_en: I grew up in rather unusual circumstances...

ext.ext_cn: 它犯了一些相当严重的错误，我觉得应该加以纠正。
ext.ext_en: It had made some rather bad mistakes which I thought should be corrected...

defs.def_en: You use rather to indicate that something is true to a fairly great extent, especially when you are talking about something unpleasant or undesirable.

ext.ext_cn: 我倒觉得他讲的是真话。
ext.ext_en: I rather think he was telling the truth...

ext.ext_cn: 我倒很喜欢装饰的效果。
ext.ext_en: I rather like the decorative effect.

defs.def_en: You use rather before verbs that introduce your thoughts and feelings, in order to express your opinion politely, especially when a different opinion has been expressed.

ext.ext_cn: “那么，他的确和它有些家族渊源，是不是？”——“噢，是的，的确如此。”
ext.ext_en: 'Well, he did have a sort of family connection with it, didn't he.' — 'Oh yes. Rather.'

defs.def_en: People sometimes say rather to express agreement or acceptance.
Dressage is a competition in which horse riders have to make their horse perform controlled movements.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 充满活力的；生机勃勃的；劲头十足的

ext.ext_cn: 每天结束时，随便写上一小段，记下你感到多么有活力或多么疲劳。
ext.ext_en: At the end of every day, jot down a brief note on how peppy or tired you felt.

ext.ext_cn: 劲爆的舞曲
ext.ext_en: ...peppy dance-numbers.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is peppy is lively and full of energy.

defs.def_cn: （尤指学童和运动队成员穿的）运动夹克，运动上衣
defs.def_en: A blazer is a kind of jacket which is often worn by members of a particular group, especially schoolchildren and members of a sports team.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (木材)粗砍的;(石头)粗凿的;未打磨的

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个猫头雕像的毛坯。
ext.ext_en: It is a rough-hewn carving of a cat's head.

defs.def_en: Rough-hewn wood or stone has been cut into a shape but has not yet been smoothed or finished off.

ext.ext_cn: 她的声音满是焦虑不安。
ext.ext_en: Her voice was full of anxiety...

ext.ext_cn: 许多社论对该国经济的混乱状况表示忧虑。
ext.ext_en: Many editorials express their anxieties about the economic chaos in the country.

defs.def_en: Anxiety is a feeling of nervousness or worry.

ext.ext_cn: 生产中的故障影响了该厂的产量。
ext.ext_en: Manufacturing glitches have limited the factory's output.

defs.def_en: A glitch is a problem which stops something from working properly or being successful.

ext.ext_cn: 他把脚从桌上移开。
ext.ext_en: He took his feet off the desk...

ext.ext_cn: 我从她头上方的架子上拿走了房门钥匙。
ext.ext_en: I took the key for the room off a rack above her head...

defs.def_en: If something is taken off something else or moves off it, it is no longer touching that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 火车运行时请勿上下车！
ext.ext_en: Don't try to get on or off a moving train!...

ext.ext_cn: 他一走下飞机便中枪身亡。
ext.ext_en: As he stepped off the aeroplane, he was shot dead.

defs.def_en: When you get off a bus, train, or plane, you come out of it or leave it after you have been travelling on it.

ext.ext_cn: 把这些人关起来只是做到了不让他们上街而已。
ext.ext_en: Locking up men does nothing more than keep them off the streets...

ext.ext_cn: 当地警方告诫游客不要在夜间去海滩。
ext.ext_en: The local police had warned visitors to keep off the beach at night.

defs.def_en: If you keep off a street or piece of land, you do not step on it or go there.

ext.ext_cn: 这艘船停泊在离该半岛北部海岸不远的地方。
ext.ext_en: The boat was anchored off the northern coast of the peninsula...

ext.ext_cn: 莉莉住在公园大道附近的一套顶层豪华公寓里。
ext.ext_en: Lily lives in a penthouse just off Park Avenue...

defs.def_en: If something is situated off a place such as a coast, room, or road, it is near to it or next to it, but not exactly in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他正打算驾车离开，这时秘书跑了出来。
ext.ext_en: He was just about to drive off when the secretary came running out...

ext.ext_cn: 她匆匆地挥了挥手便穿过草地离开了。
ext.ext_en: She gave a hurried wave and set off across the grass...

defs.def_en: If you go off, you leave a place.

defs.def_cn: （用于非正式及有时具冒犯性的短语动词）（走）开，（滚）开
defs.def_en: Off is used in a number of informal and sometimes offensive phrasal verbs, such as buzz off ,clear off, or in British English bugger off, which are used to tell someone angrily to go away.

ext.ext_cn: 他摘下眼镜，疯狂地擦着镜片。
ext.ext_en: He took off his spectacles and rubbed frantically at the lens...

ext.ext_cn: 他匆匆地脱下旧制服，开始穿上新的那件。
ext.ext_en: He hastily stripped off his old uniform and began pulling on the new one.

defs.def_en: When you take off clothing or jewellery that you are wearing, you remove it from your body.

defs.def_cn: （因生病、放假等等）休息，不工作

ext.ext_cn: 其他人这天没上班。
ext.ext_en: The rest of the men had the day off...

ext.ext_cn: 你甚至可以抽空休息几小时，商量一下的话没准还能偶尔不用上晚班。
ext.ext_en: You can even snatch a few hours off, and perhaps negotiate the occasional night off too...

defs.def_en: If you have time off or a particular day off, you do not go to work or school, for example because you are ill or it is a day when you do not usually work.

ext.ext_cn: 勿谈政治。
ext.ext_en: Keep off the subject of politics...

ext.ext_cn: 避谈语言学问题。
ext.ext_en: Keep the conversation off linguistic matters.

defs.def_en: If you keep off a subject, you deliberately avoid talking about it.

ext.ext_cn: 但是，在波因顿完全满意之前，这一协议不再作数。
ext.ext_en: Until Pointon is completely happy, however, the deal's off...

ext.ext_cn: 空缺的世界拳击理事会次轻量级头衔被取消了。
ext.ext_en: The vacant W.B.C. junior-lightweight title has been called off...

defs.def_en: If something such as an agreement or a sporting event is off, it is cancelled.

ext.ext_cn: 她感觉好些了，那位精神科医生让她停止了药物治疗。
ext.ext_en: She felt better and the psychiatrist took her off drug therapy...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数孕妇都在孕期戒了烟。
ext.ext_en: Most pregnant women remain off cigarettes while carrying the child.

defs.def_en: If someone is off something harmful such as a drug, they have stopped taking or using it.

ext.ext_cn: 我眼下不再嗜咖啡了。
ext.ext_en: I'm off coffee at the moment...

ext.ext_cn: 腹泻会让人感到乏力，而且没有胃口。
ext.ext_en: Diarrhoea can make you feel weak, as well as putting you off your food.

defs.def_en: If you are off something, you have stopped liking it.

defs.def_cn: （机器、电灯等）关掉，停掉，不再运转

ext.ext_cn: 当他把车开进车道时，他看到她卧室的灯已经熄了。
ext.ext_en: As he pulled into the driveway, he saw her bedroom light was off...

ext.ext_cn: 我们借助风帆的动力航行，且关掉了发动机以节省燃油。
ext.ext_en: We used sail power and turned the engine off to save our fuel...

defs.def_en: When something such as a machine or electric light is off, it is not functioning or in use. When you switch it off, you stop it functioning.

ext.ext_cn: 本周六老基督堂路37号的西蒙斯皮衣店所有夹克降价20％。
ext.ext_en: ...Simons Leatherwear, 37 Old Christchurch Road. 20 per cent off all jackets this Saturday.

ext.ext_cn: 比平时车价低几千英镑的折扣
ext.ext_en: ...discounts offering thousands of pounds off the normal price of a car.

defs.def_en: If there is money off something, its price is reduced by the amount specified.

ext.ext_cn: 佛罗里达离这儿很远。
ext.ext_en: Florida was a long way off...

ext.ext_cn: 远看像苍蝇的动物
ext.ext_en: ...animals that from a long way off look like flies...

defs.def_en: If something is a long way off, it is a long distance away from you.

ext.ext_cn: 这场危机看来远未结束。
ext.ext_en: An end to the crisis seems a long way off...

ext.ext_cn: 所需技术可能还要两年才能开发出来。
ext.ext_en: The required technology is probably still two years off.

defs.def_en: If something is a long time off, it will not happen for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 我得到的信息其实不多，即使有也是马克告诉我的。
ext.ext_en: I don't really get a lot of information, and if I do I get it off Mark...

ext.ext_cn: 我找不到那帮家伙的洗发水了，从他们那里拿来后我就忘了搁在什么地方。
ext.ext_en: I can't find the boys' shampoo. I can't think where I put it when I took it off them...

defs.def_en: If you get something off someone, you obtain it from them.

defs.def_cn: （与well,badly,worse等副词连用构成形容词）表示“处于…境况的”

ext.ext_cn: 这些人大都不算太富裕。
ext.ext_en: Most of these people aren't very well off...

ext.ext_cn: 你肯定没那么穷吧？
ext.ext_en: Surely you can't be that badly off?...

defs.def_en: Off combines with adverbs such as 'well', 'badly', and 'worse' to form adjectives that indicate how poor or rich someone is.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 别吃那个！它已经发霉变质了！
ext.ext_en: Don't eat that! It's mouldy. It's gone off!

defs.def_en: If food has gone off, it tastes and smells bad because it is no longer fresh enough to be eaten.

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫只记得过去吃烤鸡、喝威士忌的日子。
ext.ext_en: Her husband's memories are of living off roast chicken and drinking whisky...

ext.ext_cn: 安东尼一直靠卖自己的画为生。
ext.ext_en: Antony had been living off the sale of his own paintings.

defs.def_en: If you live off a particular kind of food, you eat it in order to live. If you live off a particular source of money, you use it to live.

defs.def_cn: （机器）靠（某种燃料或动力运转）

ext.ext_cn: 这种光盘自动清洗机可用电池或电源两种方式驱动。
ext.ext_en: The Auto Compact Disc Cleaner can run off batteries or mains.

defs.def_en: If a machine runs off a particular kind of fuel or power, it uses that power in order to function.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行为）过头的，不当的，无法接受的

ext.ext_cn: 衣服上到处沾着化妆品回到家——他这样有点过分了，是不是。
ext.ext_en: ...coming home with make-up all over his clothes — it's a bit off isn't it...

ext.ext_cn: 部分对话有些不太得体。
ext.ext_en: Some of the dialogue is slightly off.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's behaviour is a bit off, you mean that you find it unacceptable or wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 我为了糊口仍然间或去做服务员。
ext.ext_en: I was still working on and off as a waitress to support myself...

ext.ext_cn: 我们断断续续在一起生活了两年。
ext.ext_en: We lived together, off and on, for two years.

defs.def_en: If something happens on and off, or off and on, it happens occasionally, or only for part of a period of time, not in a regular or continuous way.
Alchemy was a form of chemistry studied in the Middle Ages, which was concerned with trying to discover ways to change ordinary metals into gold.

ext.ext_cn: 让我们想象通过某种政治魔力能使人人平等。
ext.ext_en: Let us imagine that by some political alchemy it had been possible to make all men equal.

defs.def_en: Alchemy is the power to change or create things in a way which seems mysterious and magical.

defs.def_cn: (尤指儿童房间的)夜明灯，夜灯，小夜灯
defs.def_en: A night light is a light that is not bright and is kept on during the night, especially in a child's room.

defs.def_cn: 一套架子;一组搁板;搁板料

ext.ext_cn: 长长的一面没有窗户的墙上的一组架子
ext.ext_en: ...the shelving on the long, windowless wall.

ext.ext_cn: 一套金字塔形状的架子组件
ext.ext_en: ...a pyramid-shaped shelving unit.

defs.def_en: Shelving is a set of shelves, or material which is used for making shelves.
A window shade is a piece of stiff cloth or heavy paper that you can pull down over a window as a covering.

ext.ext_cn: 最好别和检查员发生冲突，他们可爱记仇了。
ext.ext_en: Better not tangle with the censors. They're very vindictive...

ext.ext_cn: 报纸最希望拍到的就是警察和示威者扭打的场面。
ext.ext_en: All the newspapers wanted to do was to photograph the police officers tangling with the demonstrators.

defs.def_en: If you tangle with another person, you get involved in a conflict with them.

ext.ext_cn: 企图逃避政治压迫的努力
ext.ext_en: ...an attempt to escape political oppression.

ext.ext_cn: 19世纪富人对穷人的压迫
ext.ext_en: ...the oppression of the 19th-century poor by the rich.

defs.def_en: Oppression is the cruel or unfair treatment of a group of people.

defs.def_cn: 经验主义的;以经验为依据的

ext.ext_cn: 他的论文缺乏实验证据的支持。
ext.ext_en: There is no empirical evidence to support his thesis.

defs.def_en: Empirical evidence or study relies on practical experience rather than theories.

defs.def_cn: 化学的;化学反应的;用化学方法生成的

ext.ext_cn: 导致臭氧受到破坏的化学反应
ext.ext_en: ...chemical reactions that cause ozone destruction.

ext.ext_cn: 海洋的化学成分
ext.ext_en: ...the chemical composition of the ocean.

defs.def_en: Chemical means involving or resulting from a reaction between two or more substances, or relating to the substances that something consists of.

defs.def_cn: 化学品;化合物;化学制品

ext.ext_cn: 整个食物链因农业生产过程过多使用化学品而受到影响。
ext.ext_en: The whole food chain is affected by the overuse of chemicals in agriculture.

ext.ext_cn: 化工公司
ext.ext_en: ...a chemicals company.

defs.def_en: Chemicals are substances that are used in a chemical process or made by a chemical process.

defs.def_cn: (尤指不愉快的事)临近的，即将发生的，逼近的

ext.ext_cn: 眼前似乎没有危险。
ext.ext_en: There appeared no imminent danger...

ext.ext_cn: 他们警告袭击即将发生。
ext.ext_en: They warned that an attack is imminent.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is imminent, especially something unpleasant, you mean it is almost certain to happen very soon.

defs.def_cn: （熙攘、纷扰的）一大帮人，一大伙人

ext.ext_cn: 这吸引了成群结队的游客到拉斯韦加斯来。
ext.ext_en: This attracts hordes of tourists to Las Vegas.

ext.ext_cn: 一大群人在嚷着要票。
ext.ext_en: ...a horde of people was screaming for tickets.

defs.def_en: If you describe a crowd of people as a horde, you mean that the crowd is very large and excited and, often, rather frightening or unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 这个城市的五星级宾馆太多了。
ext.ext_en: The city has a superfluity of five-star hotels.

defs.def_en: If there is a superfluity of something, there is more of it than is needed.
A doorstop is a heavy object that you use to keep a door open.

ext.ext_cn: 几滴碘酊
ext.ext_en: ...a few drops of tincture of iodine.

defs.def_en: A tincture is a medicine consisting of alcohol and a small amount of a drug.

ext.ext_cn: 早期的作品大多都无法入耳。
ext.ext_en: The early stuff is mostly unlistenable.

defs.def_en: If you describe music as unlistenable, you mean that is very poor in quality.

ext.ext_cn: 一些狗粮的专利品牌
ext.ext_en: ...some proprietary brands of dog food...

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须采取措施保护专利技术。
ext.ext_en: We had to take action to protect the proprietary technology.

defs.def_en: Proprietary substances or products are sold under a trade name.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 主管们不允许对他们生产的产品以所有者自居。
ext.ext_en: Directors weren't allowed any proprietary airs about the product they made.

defs.def_en: If someone has a proprietary attitude towards something, they act as though they own it.

ext.ext_cn: 她一直不知道他姓什么。
ext.ext_en: She'd never known his surname...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数英国女性结婚后随夫姓。
ext.ext_en: The majority of British women adopt their husband's surname when they marry.

defs.def_en: Your surname is the name that you share with other members of your family. In English speaking countries and many other countries it is your last name.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （置于作者姓名后，指前文已提到的著作）见前引书，同前引

ext.ext_cn: 引自伊耶（同上），332页
ext.ext_en: ...quoted in Iyer, op. cit., p. 332.

defs.def_en: In reference books, op. cit. is used after an author's name to refer to a book of theirs which has already been mentioned.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Unemployment is quite high, especially among young people.

defs.def_en: If you want to focus on something that is happening within a particular group of people, you can say that it is happening among that group.

ext.ext_en: I am sick of all the quarrelling among politicians who should be concentrating on vital issues.

defs.def_en: You use among before a noun to mention a group when talking about a smaller group within it.

ext.ext_en: Last year 600 inmates rioted, starting fires and building barricades...

ext.ext_en: They rioted in protest against the government.

defs.def_cn: 五颜六色;丰富多彩;各种各样

ext.ext_en: All the cacti were in flower, so that the desert was a riot of colour...

ext.ext_en: With Indian cuisine, you expect a riot of tastes and spices.

defs.def_en: Organizational means relating to the structure of an organization.
