ext.ext_en: The cousins tolerated each other, but did not really get on well together.

defs.def_en: If you tolerate a situation or person, you accept them although you do not particularly like them.

ext.ext_cn: 对疼痛的忍受力因人而异。
ext.ext_en: The ability to tolerate pain varies from person to person.

defs.def_en: If you can tolerate something unpleasant or painful, you are able to bear it.

ext.ext_cn: 银行留出11亿英镑以抵消因企业倒闭而产生的坏账。
ext.ext_en: The bank set aside £1.1 billion to cover bad debts from business failures.

defs.def_en: A bad debt is a sum of money that has been lent but is not likely to be repaid.

defs.def_cn: 表示同情（或怜悯、可怜）的

ext.ext_cn: 她怜悯地看了他一眼，这类借口是她父亲会用的。
ext.ext_en: She gave him a pitying look; that was the sort of excuse her father would use.

defs.def_en: A pitying look shows that someone feels pity and perhaps slight contempt.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个性格坚定的人，非常有见解，外交手段高明。
ext.ext_en: He was a man of forceful character, with considerable insight and diplomatic skills.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as forceful, you approve of them because they express their opinions and wishes in a strong, emphatic, and confident way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有影响力的;有效的;使人感触深刻的

ext.ext_cn: 它给我留下了深刻的印象。
ext.ext_en: It made a very forceful impression on me...

ext.ext_cn: 对多数人来说，心脏病发作会强烈地提醒他们终有一天自己会死去。
ext.ext_en: For most people a heart attack is a forceful reminder that they are mortal.

defs.def_en: Something that is forceful has a very powerful effect and causes you to think or feel something very strongly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有说服力的;使人信服的
defs.def_en: A forceful point or argument in a discussion is one that is good, valid, and convincing.
A couchette is a bed on a train or a boat which is either folded against the wall or used as an ordinary seat during the day.
A lumberman is a man who sells timber.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对任何与文学界权威沾边的事都嗤之以鼻。
ext.ext_en: He is highly disdainful of anything to do with the literary establishment...

ext.ext_cn: 埃德加朝他的双胞胎兄弟投去鄙夷的目光。
ext.ext_en: Edgar cast a disdainful look at his twin.

defs.def_en: To be disdainful means to dislike something or someone because you think they are unimportant or not worth your attention.
A handrail is a long piece of metal or wood which is fixed near stairs or places where people could slip and fall, and which people can hold on to for support.

ext.ext_cn: 爬行动物主宰的史前丛林
ext.ext_en: ...a prehistoric jungle occupied by reptilian creatures.

defs.def_en: A reptilian creature is a reptile.

defs.def_cn: 像爬行动物的;有爬行动物特征的

ext.ext_cn: 这只小鸡长得很丑，看起来几乎像个爬行动物。
ext.ext_en: The chick is ugly and almost reptilian in its appearance.

defs.def_en: You can also use the word reptilian to describe something that is characteristic of a reptile or that is like a reptile.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 博学的;有学问的；（书等）知识丰富的

ext.ext_cn: 他从来就不愚笨，而是一直博学多才、见多识广。
ext.ext_en: He was never dull, always erudite and well informed.

ext.ext_cn: 有独创性且非常博学的风格
ext.ext_en: ...an original and highly erudite style.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as erudite, you mean that they have or show great academic knowledge. You can also use erudite to describe something such as a book or a style of writing.
A frisbee is a light plastic disc that one person throws to another as a game.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人的生涯、组织的历史)有好有坏的，好坏参半的

ext.ext_cn: 他的政治生涯将近40年，其间起起伏伏。
ext.ext_en: He had a chequered political career spanning nearly forty years...

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦的一生跌宕起伏，蹲过多次大牢。
ext.ext_en: Alan had led a very chequered past and had been to prison lots of times.

defs.def_en: If a person or organization has had a chequered career or history, they have had a varied past with both good and bad periods.

ext.ext_cn: 红格子台布
ext.ext_en: ...red chequered tablecloths.

defs.def_en: Something that is chequered has a pattern with squares of two or more different colours.

Conifers are a group of trees and shrubs, for example pine trees and fir trees, that grow in cooler areas of the world. They have fruit called cones, and very thin leaves called needles which they do not normally lose in winter.
Bye and bye-bye are informal ways of saying goodbye.
A launching pad is the same as a launch pad .
Flower arranging is the art or hobby of arranging cut flowers in a way which makes them look attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不知道的；未注意的;未觉察的

ext.ext_cn: 她一动不动地躺在原地，已经感觉不到疼痛。
ext.ext_en: She lay motionless where she was, oblivious to pain...

ext.ext_cn: 卢埃林看起来没有注意到他周围的情况。
ext.ext_en: Llewelyn appeared oblivious of his surroundings.

defs.def_en: If you are oblivious to something or oblivious of it, you are not aware of it.

ext.ext_cn: 英国工会运动的年会
ext.ext_en: ...the annual conference of Britain's trade union movement...

ext.ext_cn: 在其年度报告中，联合国儿童基金会称每天至少有4万名儿童死亡。
ext.ext_en: In its annual report, UNICEF says at least 40,000 children die every day.

defs.def_en: Annual events happen once every year.

ext.ext_cn: 每年的花销、学费和各项杂费6,600英镑。
ext.ext_en: Annual costs, tuition and fees, £6,600...

ext.ext_cn: 电子印刷部门每年销售额约为8,000万美元。
ext.ext_en: The electronic and printing unit has annual sales of about $80 million.

defs.def_en: Annual quantities or rates relate to a period of one year.

ext.ext_cn: 我在中学年刊中寻找怀曼的照片。
ext.ext_en: I looked for Wyman's picture in my high-school annual...

ext.ext_cn: 他试着在图书馆里找过各种历书、年鉴和报纸。
ext.ext_en: He tried the various almanacs, annuals and gazettes which were held in the library.

defs.def_en: An annual is a book or magazine that is published once a year.

ext.ext_cn: 处理这些一年生耐寒植物最简单的办法是将他们种在能开花的地方。
ext.ext_en: The simplest way to deal with these hardy annuals is to sow them where they are to flower.

defs.def_en: An annual is a plant that grows and dies within one year.

ext.ext_cn: 核时代
ext.ext_en: ...the nuclear era...

ext.ext_cn: 里根-布什时期
ext.ext_en: ...the Reagan-Bush era...

defs.def_en: You can refer to a period of history or a long period of time as an era when you want to draw attention to a particular feature or quality that it has.

ext.ext_cn: 他出生在东京以北的山形县。
ext.ext_en: He was born in Yamagata prefecture, north of Tokyo.

defs.def_en: In some countries, administrative areas are called prefectures .

defs.def_cn: 神鹰，美洲秃鹫(产于南美，以腐肉为食)
defs.def_en: A condor is a large South American bird that eats the meat of dead animals.

ext.ext_cn: 滑雪爱好者乐于利用暑期假日去滑雪。
ext.ext_en: Keen skiers are happy to forego a summer holiday to go skiing.

defs.def_en: If you forego something, you decide to do without it, although you would like it.

ext.ext_cn: 汉森的成功原则是不论收购什么样的企业都要使其增值。
ext.ext_en: Hanson's golden rule is to add value to whatever business he buys.

defs.def_en: A golden rule is a principle you should remember because it will help you to be successful.

ext.ext_cn: 它只是一种作秀而已。
ext.ext_en: It was just a piece of play-acting.

defs.def_en: Play-acting is behaviour where someone pretends to have attitudes or feelings that they do not really have.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他仰天狂笑。
ext.ext_en: He tossed back his head in a howl of berserk laughter.

defs.def_en: Berserk means crazy and out of control.

ext.ext_cn: 我一看见他就冒火。
ext.ext_en: When I saw him I went berserk.

defs.def_en: If someone or something goes berserk, they lose control of themselves and become very angry or violent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 迟来的；延误的；姗姗来迟的

ext.ext_cn: 政府一再拖延的扶贫举措
ext.ext_en: ...the government's  belated attempts to alleviate the plight of the poor.

ext.ext_cn: 迟来的生日礼物
ext.ext_en: ...a belated birthday present.

defs.def_en: A belated action happens later than it should have done.

ext.ext_cn: 蟋蟀叫得更欢了。
ext.ext_en: The crickets chirped faster and louder.

ext.ext_cn: 远处传来庭园小鸟的鸣啭。
ext.ext_en: The chirps of the small garden birds sounded distant.

defs.def_en: When a bird or an insect such as a cricket or grasshopper chirps, it makes short high-pitched sounds.

defs.def_cn: （人）欢快地高声说话，叽叽喳喳

ext.ext_cn: “希望很快能再见！”我妈开心地大声说。
ext.ext_en: 'See you soon, I hope!' chirped my mother.

defs.def_en: You say that a person chirps when they say something in a cheerful, high-pitched voice.

defs.def_cn: 巨大的残骸;大型废弃物

ext.ext_cn: 古老教堂钟楼的残垣断壁
ext.ext_en: ...the ruined hulk of the old church tower...

ext.ext_cn: 我可以辨认出油船破烂不堪的残骸。
ext.ext_en: I could make out the gutted hulk of the tanker.

defs.def_en: The hulk of something is the large, ruined remains of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我跟在他魁梧的身躯后面进了屋子。
ext.ext_en: I followed his big hulk into the house.

defs.def_en: You use hulk to describe anything which is large and seems threatening to you.

defs.def_cn: (公司利润、经济等的)下降趋势

ext.ext_cn: 增长幅度降到了 0.4%，可能意味着下降的开始。
ext.ext_en: The increase slowed to 0.4 percent, possibly indicating the start of a downtrend.

defs.def_en: A downtrend is a general downward movement in something such as a company's profits or the economy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 毫无表情的;面无表情的
defs.def_en: If you describe someone's face as expressionless, you mean that they are not showing their feelings.

defs.def_cn: 千位/秒（调制解调器速度单位）

ext.ext_cn: 传输速度为28.8千位/秒的调制解调器
ext.ext_en: ...a 28.8 Kbps modem.

defs.def_en: Kbps is a unit for measuring the speed of a modem. Kbps is a written abbreviation for（书面缩略=）'kilobits per second'.

ext.ext_cn: 结果引擎最终沉到了运河底。
ext.ext_en: The result was that the engine ended up at the bottom of the canal...

ext.ext_cn: 她带着孩子逃亡，从一个邻居家跑到另一个邻居家，最后逃到了一个朋友的地下室。
ext.ext_en: She fled with her children, moving from neighbour to neighbour and ending up in a friend's cellar.

defs.def_en: If someone or something ends up somewhere, they eventually arrive there, usually by accident.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你不知道自己想要什么，到头来你可能得非所愿。
ext.ext_en: If you don't know what you want, you might end up getting something you don't want...

ext.ext_cn: 每次他们去跳舞，都会不欢而散。
ext.ext_en: Every time they went dancing they ended up in a bad mood...

defs.def_en: If you end up doing something or end up in a particular state, you do that thing or get into that state even though you did not originally intend to.

ext.ext_cn: 马勒家族已经在他们位于明斯特的啤酒厂专门从事啤酒酿制达200年之久。
ext.ext_en: The Muller family have been making specialist beers at their brewery in Munster for 200 years.

defs.def_en: A brewery is a place where beer is made.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他死得很蹊跷。
ext.ext_en: He died in mysterious circumstances...

ext.ext_cn: 他得了一种神秘的怪病，卧床有一个多月。
ext.ext_en: A mysterious illness confined him to bed for over a month...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is mysterious is strange and is not known about or understood.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 至于他的工作，他总是显得非常神秘，从不多说。
ext.ext_en: As for his job — well, he was very mysterious about it.

defs.def_en: If someone is mysterious about something, they deliberately do not talk much about it, sometimes because they want to make people more interested in it.

defs.def_cn: （由某事引起的）喧嚷，吵闹，骚动

ext.ext_cn: 最近因国会加薪引起的风波
ext.ext_en: ...the recent brouhaha over a congressional pay raise.

defs.def_en: A brouhaha is an excited and critical fuss or reaction to something.

ext.ext_cn: 位于芝加哥市中心的办事处
ext.ext_en: ...an office in downtown Chicago.

ext.ext_cn: 白天他在市中心为美标公司工作。
ext.ext_en: By day he worked downtown for American Standard...

defs.def_en: Downtown places are in or towards the centre of a large town or city, where the shops and places of business are.

ext.ext_cn: 肯尼迪劝诫听众远离暴力。
ext.ext_en: Kennedy exhorted his listeners to turn away from violence...

ext.ext_cn: 他劝诫同伴说：“要通过勤奋努力实现自己的目标。”
ext.ext_en: He exhorted his companions, 'Try to accomplish your aim with diligence'.

defs.def_en: If you exhort someone to do something, you try hard to persuade or encourage them to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 劳拉变得有些古怪。
ext.ext_en: Laura's going a bit batty.

ext.ext_cn: 他们那个有点疯癫的叔叔
ext.ext_en: ...some batty uncle of theirs.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is batty, you mean that they are rather eccentric or slightly crazy.

defs.def_cn: 分贝（表示声音强度的单位)

ext.ext_cn: 持续暴露在强度高于80分贝的噪声中可能有害。
ext.ext_en: Continuous exposure to sound above 80 decibels could be harmful.

defs.def_en: A decibel is a unit of measurement which is used to indicate how loud a sound is.

defs.def_cn: (乘车的)季票，月票，长期票;(体育比赛、戏剧等的)长期票，套票

ext.ext_cn: 我们去换月票。
ext.ext_en: We went to renew our monthly season ticket.

defs.def_en: A season ticket is a ticket that you can use repeatedly during a certain period, without having to pay each time. You can buy season tickets for things such as buses, trains, regular sporting events, or theatre performances.

ext.ext_cn: 她打开电视，来回换台看不同的新闻节目。
ext.ext_en: She turned the television on and flicked around between news programmes.

defs.def_en: A television or television set is a piece of electrical equipment consisting of a box with a glass screen on it on which you can watch programmes with pictures and sounds.

ext.ext_cn: 玩具制造商开始在电视上推销他们的一些产品。
ext.ext_en: Toy manufacturers began promoting some of their products on television...

ext.ext_cn: 越来越多的电视节目通过卫星进行转播。
ext.ext_en: Television is increasingly being transmitted by satellites.

defs.def_en: Television is the system of sending pictures and sounds by electrical signals over a distance so that people can receive them on a television in their home.

ext.ext_cn: 我没有太多时间可泡在电视上。
ext.ext_en: I don't have much time to watch very much television.

defs.def_en: Television refers to all the programmes that you can watch.

ext.ext_cn: 英国商业电视在逐步失去其作为欧洲电视广播业最先进部分的领先地位。
ext.ext_en: British commercial television has been steadily losing its lead as the most advanced sector of the industry in Europe.

defs.def_en: Television is the business or industry concerned with making programmes and broadcasting them on television.
A vehicle's roadholding is how easy it is to control safely in difficult driving conditions or when going round bends.

defs.def_cn: (书或戏剧的)结局，收场;(一系列事件的)结果

ext.ext_cn: 该书的煽情结局纯粹是好莱坞式的。
ext.ext_en: The book's sentimental denouement is pure Hollywood.

ext.ext_cn: 出人意料的收场
ext.ext_en: ...an unexpected denouement.

defs.def_en: In a book, play, or series of events, the denouement is the sequence of events at the end, when things come to a conclusion.
If you refer to an untrue statement as a white lie, you mean that it is made to avoid hurting someone's feelings or to avoid trouble, and not for an evil purpose.
A steam iron is an electric iron that produces steam from water that you put into it. The steam makes it easier to get the creases out of your clothes.
Radiography is the process of taking X-rays.
A bikini is a two-piece swimming costume worn by women.

ext.ext_cn: 警察和我们其他人一样，都有自我保护的人类本能。
ext.ext_en: The police have the same human urge for self-preservation as the rest of us.

defs.def_en: Self-preservation is the action of keeping yourself safe or alive in a dangerous situation, often without thinking about what you are doing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以置信的;不像真实的

ext.ext_cn: 我得承认那听起来像是个难以叫人相信的借口。
ext.ext_en: I had to admit it sounded like an implausible excuse...

ext.ext_cn: 这些项目没有得到她的支持就开始进行了，这似乎不合情理。
ext.ext_en: It seems implausible that the projects would have gone ahead without her backing.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as implausible, you believe that it is unlikely to be true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是个勤劳肯干的员工。
ext.ext_en: She was an industrious and willing worker.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as industrious, you mean they work very hard.

defs.def_cn: 无可辩驳的;不容置疑的;无可否认的

ext.ext_cn: 我们有确凿无疑的证据证明到底发生了什么。
ext.ext_en: We have incontrovertible evidence of what took place.

defs.def_en: Incontrovertible evidence or facts are absolutely certain and cannot be shown to be wrong.

defs.def_cn: 文员；文书；耍笔杆子的人

ext.ext_cn: 结果是，企业人浮于事，到处都是耍笔杆子的人。
ext.ext_en: As a result, industry was overmanned and pen-pushers were everywhere.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a pen-pusher, you mean that their work consists of writing or dealing with documents, and does not seem very useful or important.

defs.def_cn: 卢布（俄罗斯以及其他一些独联体国家的货币单位）
defs.def_en: The rouble is the unit of money of Russia and some of the other republics that form the Commonwealth of Independent States.

defs.def_cn: (汽车引擎上驱动风扇降低引擎热度的)风扇皮带
defs.def_en: In a car engine, the fan belt is the belt that drives the fan which keeps the engine cool.

defs.def_cn: 甜爹(对年轻女子慷慨大方的阔佬色迷)

ext.ext_cn: 影片中约翰·古德曼饰演梅兰尼·格利菲斯的甜爹。
ext.ext_en: Actor John Goodman played Melanie Griffith's sugar daddy in the film.

defs.def_en: A woman's sugar daddy is a rich older man who gives her money and presents in return for her company, affection, and usually sexual intercourse.

defs.def_cn: （某物落入水中而未溅泼的）扑通声，啪嗒声

ext.ext_cn: 又一滴水嘀嗒一声落下。
ext.ext_en: Another drop of water fell with a soft plop.

defs.def_en: A plop is a soft, gentle sound, like the sound made by something dropping into water without disturbing the surface much.

ext.ext_cn: 冰激凌啪的一声掉地上了。
ext.ext_en: The ice cream plopped to the ground.

defs.def_en: If something plops somewhere, it drops there with a soft, gentle sound.

defs.def_cn: 轻轻地放下；轻巧地放下

ext.ext_cn: 把面条轻放在调味汁中间就行了。
ext.ext_en: Just plop the noodles over the center of the sauce...

ext.ext_cn: 她拿起咖啡壶，又轻手放下去了客厅。
ext.ext_en: She picked up the coffee pot, then plopped it down and went into the living room.

defs.def_en: If you plop something somewhere, you drop it there gently and without making a loud noise.

ext.ext_cn: 他当了17年的航空公司飞行员。
ext.ext_en: He spent seventeen years as an airline pilot.

ext.ext_cn: 英国皇家空军的战斗机飞行员
ext.ext_en: ...fighter pilots of the British Royal Air Force.

defs.def_en: A pilot is a person who is trained to fly an aircraft.
A pilot is a person who steers a ship through a difficult stretch of water, for example the entrance to a harbour.

defs.def_cn: 驾驶（飞机等）；为（船舶）引航

ext.ext_cn: 乘私人飞机去华盛顿的路上，有一段行程是他自己驾驶的。
ext.ext_en: He piloted his own plane part of the way to Washington.

defs.def_en: If someone pilots an aircraft or ship, they act as its pilot.

defs.def_cn: 试验性的方案；试点性的项目

ext.ext_cn: 在试验性方案获得成功后，这项服务正在推广中。
ext.ext_en: The service is being expanded following the success of a pilot scheme.

ext.ext_cn: 由贸易和工业部支持的为期10年的试点项目
ext.ext_en: ...a ten-year pilot project backed by the trade and industry department.

defs.def_en: A pilot scheme or a pilot project is one which is used to test an idea before deciding whether to introduce it on a larger scale.

ext.ext_cn: 该信托基金机构正在寻找50所学校，以试行一个旨在帮助青少年学生做就业准备的项目。
ext.ext_en: The trust is looking for 50 schools to pilot a programme aimed at teenage pupils preparing for work.

defs.def_en: If a government or organization pilots a programme or a scheme, they test it, before deciding whether to introduce it on a larger scale.

defs.def_cn: 使（新的法律或议案）顺利通过

ext.ext_cn: 我们正促使议会顺利通过解决青少年犯罪问题的一项新策略。
ext.ext_en: We are now piloting through Parliament a new strategy to tackle youth crime.

defs.def_en: If a government minister pilots a new law or bill through parliament, he or she makes sure that it is introduced successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 《一切皆有可能》的试播集已拍摄出来了。
ext.ext_en: A pilot episode of Nothing's Impossible has already been filmed.

defs.def_en: A pilot or a pilot episode is a single television programme that is shown in order to find out whether a particular series of programmes is likely to be popular.

defs.def_cn: （煤气灶具、锅炉等用于引火的）常燃小火
defs.def_en: A pilot is the pilot light on a gas cooker or stove, boiler, or fire.

ext.ext_cn: 一个高高的四方房间，地上铺有地毯，墙上挂着挂毯
ext.ext_en: ...a room, high and square with carpet underfoot and tapestries on the walls...

ext.ext_cn: 地上仍是湿的。
ext.ext_en: It was still wet underfoot.

defs.def_en: You describe something as being underfoot when you are standing or walking on it.

ext.ext_cn: 摩根把香烟丢到地上，用脚踩灭。
ext.ext_en: Morgan dropped his cigarette and crushed it underfoot.

ext.ext_cn: 被踩踏的半熟的苹果
ext.ext_en: ...half-ripe apples that were being trampled underfoot.

defs.def_en: If you trample or crush something underfoot, you spoil or destroy it by stepping on it.
Club soda is fizzy water used for mixing with alcoholic drinks and fruit juice.

defs.def_cn: 谷氨酸一钠，味精(缩写形式为MSG)
defs.def_en: Monosodium glutamate is a substance which is sometimes added to savoury food to make it taste better. The abbreviation MSG is also used.

ext.ext_cn: 英国有禁止虐待动物的法律，但却没有保护儿童的法律。
ext.ext_en: Britain had laws against cruelty to animals but none to protect children...

ext.ext_cn: 他没能逃脱战争的残酷。
ext.ext_en: He had been unable to escape the cruelties of war.

defs.def_en: Cruelty is behaviour that deliberately causes pain or distress to people or animals.

ext.ext_cn: 他们做爱的频率越来越低。
ext.ext_en: Their love-making became less and less frequent.

defs.def_en: Lovemaking refers to sexual activities that  take place between two people who love each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 坎帕尼亚的多山地区
ext.ext_en: ...the mountainous region of Campania.

defs.def_en: A mountainous place has a lot of mountains.

defs.def_cn: 波涛汹涌的；万丈波涛的

ext.ext_cn: 渔夫们冒着汹涌的海浪出海了。
ext.ext_en: The fishermen set off in mountainous seas.

defs.def_en: If you refer to mountainous seas, you are emphasizing that the sea is very rough.

ext.ext_cn: 一个身材高大的女人站在灯光明亮的门口。
ext.ext_en: In the lighted doorway stood the mountainous figure of a woman...

ext.ext_cn: 该计划旨在减少公司堆积如山的债务。
ext.ext_en: The plan is designed to reduce some of the company's mountainous debt.

defs.def_en: You use mountainous to emphasize that something is great in size, quantity, or degree.

defs.def_cn: 使人性化;使舒适化;使更人道

ext.ext_cn: 乔·鲁宾逊最早是为在医疗中心候诊的人们提供茶水和儿童玩具，使候诊过程变得人性化。
ext.ext_en: Jo Robinson began by humanizing the waiting time at the health centre with tea-making and toys for children.

defs.def_en: If you humanize a situation or condition, you improve it by changing it in a way which makes it more suitable and pleasant for people.

ext.ext_cn: 过去十年里，对黑人及少数族裔的种族歧视和敌对行为变得日益猖獗。
ext.ext_en: The last decade has witnessed a serious rise in the levels of racism and hostility to Black and ethnic groups...

ext.ext_cn: 克丽丝特布尔带着公然的敌意看着罗恩。
ext.ext_en: Christabel looked at Ron with open hostility.

defs.def_en: Hostility is unfriendly or aggressive behaviour towards people or ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 传统主义者反对这种讲授历史的方法。
ext.ext_en: There is hostility among traditionalists to this method of teaching history.

defs.def_en: Your hostility to something you do not approve of is your opposition to it.

ext.ext_cn: 他把妻儿打发到在威尔士的一辆旅行拖车上去住。
ext.ext_en: He packed off his wife and children to stay in a caravan in Wales...

ext.ext_cn: 最后我总算是把她打发上床睡觉了。
ext.ext_en: I finally succeeded in packing her off to bed.

defs.def_en: If you pack someone off somewhere, you send them there to stay for a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 她准备重新开始。
ext.ext_en: She's ready to start anew...

ext.ext_cn: 他重新开始工作。
ext.ext_en: He began his work anew.

defs.def_en: If you do something anew, you do it again, often in a different way from before.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有远见的;向前看的;进步的

ext.ext_cn: 政党应该放眼未来并与选民态度变化保持一致的需要
ext.ext_en: ...the need for the party to be forward-looking, to identify with changing attitudes among voters.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or organization as forward-looking, you approve of the fact that they think about the future or have modern ideas.

defs.def_cn: 布里干酪（一种松软的白色法国奶酪）
defs.def_en: Brie is a type of cheese that comes from France. It is soft and creamy with a white skin.

ext.ext_cn: 白宫可能要等到7月份才会公开这个计划。
ext.ext_en: The White House probably won't make this plan public until July...

ext.ext_cn: 凡·高可能是世界上最知名的画家。
ext.ext_en: Van Gogh is probably the best-known painter in the world.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is probably the case, you think that it is likely to be the case, although you are not sure.

defs.def_cn: （用于缓和语气）大概，或许，可能

ext.ext_cn: 他可能认为你们两个人都疯了！
ext.ext_en: He probably thinks you're both crazy!

defs.def_en: You can use probably when you want to make your opinion sound less forceful or definite, so that you do not offend people.

defs.def_cn: 利己主义者;自我主义者

ext.ext_cn: 亚当足够聪明，但是他也有点自私自利。
ext.ext_en: Adam is clever enough, but he's also something of an egomaniac.

defs.def_en: An egomaniac is someone who thinks only of themselves and does not care if they harm other people in order to get what they want.

ext.ext_cn: 把少量粉末放入容器，加水混合。
ext.ext_en: Put a small amount of the powder into a container  and mix with water...

ext.ext_cn: 木头在他指间会变成粉末。
ext.ext_en: The wood turns to powder in his fingers.

defs.def_en: Powder consists of many tiny particles of a solid substance.
Powder is the same as face powder .

ext.ext_cn: 她往脸上搽了粉，抹了口红和胭脂。
ext.ext_en: She powdered her face and applied her lipstick and rouge.

ext.ext_cn: 老妇人那张搽了粉的脸
ext.ext_en: ...the old woman's powdered face.

defs.def_en: If a woman powders her face or some other part of her body, she puts face powder or talcum powder on it.

ext.ext_cn: 空气里有股火药味儿。
ext.ext_en: The smell of powder was in the air.

defs.def_en: Powder is the same as gunpowder .

ext.ext_cn: 一天的滑雪时光
ext.ext_en: ...a day's powder skiing.

defs.def_en: Powder is very fine snow.

ext.ext_cn: 她按了一下服务台的蜂鸣器。
ext.ext_en: She rang a buzzer at the information desk.

defs.def_en: A buzzer is an electrical device that is used to make a buzzing sound for example, to attract someone's attention.

ext.ext_cn: 国会正在修订国家银行法规。
ext.ext_en: Congress is in the midst of rewriting the nation's banking laws...

ext.ext_cn: 我们正处在多年来最严重的一次经济衰退之中。
ext.ext_en: We are in the midst of one of the worst recessions for many, many years.

defs.def_en: If you are in the midst of doing something, you are doing it at the moment.

ext.ext_cn: 埃莉诺在暴风雪大作时到达。
ext.ext_en: Eleanor arrived in the midst of a blizzard.

defs.def_en: If something happens in the midst of an event, it happens during it.

ext.ext_cn: 许多人看到他像这样暴露在一大群人中间都非常吃惊。
ext.ext_en: Many were surprised to see him exposed like this in the midst of a large crowd...

ext.ext_cn: 安杰洛小心翼翼地把枪放在桌上的一堆手册和文件中间。
ext.ext_en: Angelo laid the gun carefully on the table, in the midst of brochures and other papers.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is in the midst of a group of people or things, they are among them or surrounded by them.

ext.ext_cn: 在我们中间有这样一个人是我们的幸运。
ext.ext_en: We're lucky to have such a man in our midst.

defs.def_en: You say that someone is in your midst when you are drawing attention to the fact that they are in your group.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为这是一个陷阱。
ext.ext_en: My view is that this is a stitch up.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as a stitch-up, you mean that it has been arranged in a way that makes it unfair.
A sealer is the same as a sealant .
An electrolyte is a substance, usually a liquid, which electricity can pass through.

ext.ext_cn: 斯图尔特走下马路牙子。

Birth control means planning whether to have children, and using contraception to prevent having them when they are not wanted.
Lactation is the production of milk by women and female mammals during the period after they give birth.

defs.def_cn: (通常指深蓝色、肩部带条纹的)厚夹克

ext.ext_en: Thick mist made flying impossible...

ext.ext_cn: 一层淡蓝色的薄雾弥漫在空中。
ext.ext_en: A bluish mist hung in the air...

defs.def_en: Mist consists of a large number of tiny drops of water in the air, which make it difficult to see very far.

ext.ext_en: The windows misted, blurring the stark streetlight...

ext.ext_en: The temperature in the car was misting the window.

defs.def_en: If a piece of glass mists or is misted, it becomes covered with tiny drops of moisture, so that you cannot see through it easily.

defs.def_cn: （眼睛因泪水而）变得模糊不清

ext.ext_en: Her eyes misted with tears.

ext.ext_cn: 他泪眼模糊，开始颤抖起来。
ext.ext_en: His eyes misted over and he started to shake.

defs.def_en: If someone's eyes mist, they cannot see easily because there are tears in their eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 为了帮助我，朋友们冒了极大的危险。
ext.ext_en: My friends endured tremendous danger in order to help me...

ext.ext_cn: 他的生命可能会有危险。
ext.ext_en: His life could be in danger.

defs.def_en: Danger is the possibility that someone may be harmed or killed.

defs.def_cn: 危险的事物（或人）；危害;威胁

ext.ext_cn: 吸烟的危害
ext.ext_en: ...the dangers of smoking...

ext.ext_cn: 公开冲突的危险
ext.ext_en: ...the danger of open conflict...

defs.def_en: A danger is something or someone that can hurt or harm you.

defs.def_cn: (不愉快之事发生的)可能性，风险

ext.ext_en: There is a real danger that some people will no longer be able to afford insurance...

ext.ext_cn: 不存在这些团体中的任何一个当选的风险。
ext.ext_en: There was no danger that any of these groups would be elected to power...

defs.def_en: If there is a danger that something unpleasant will happen, it is possible that it will happen.
If someone who has been seriously ill is out of danger, they are still ill, but they are not expected to die.

ext.ext_cn: 他们打开了一罐沙丁鱼。
ext.ext_en: They opened a tin of sardines.

defs.def_en: Sardines are a kind of small sea fish, often eaten as food.

ext.ext_cn: 难民们像罐头里的沙丁鱼般紧紧挤在一起。
ext.ext_en: The refugees were packed like sardines.

defs.def_en: If you say that a crowd of people are packed like sardines, you are emphasizing that they are sitting or standing so close together that they cannot move easily.

defs.def_cn: （进行教学、研究等的）方法论,方法学，一套方法

ext.ext_en: Teaching methodologies vary according to the topic...

ext.ext_en: In their own work they may have favored the use of methodology different from mine.

defs.def_en: A methodology is a system of methods and principles for doing something, for example for teaching or for carrying out research.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...lonely people who just want to talk...

ext.ext_en: I feel lonelier in the middle of London than I do on my boat in the middle of nowhere.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （指状态或时期）孤独的，寂寞的，孤零零的

ext.ext_cn: 在那一个个漫长、孤单的夜晚，我极需找点事做。
ext.ext_en: I desperately needed something to occupy me during those long, lonely nights.

ext.ext_cn: 她寂寞的童年
ext.ext_en: ...her lonely childhood.

defs.def_en: A lonely situation or period of time is one in which you feel unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone to talk to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 偏僻的；荒凉的；人迹罕至的

ext.ext_cn: 感觉这就像是天底下最荒凉的地方。
ext.ext_en: It felt like the loneliest place in the world.

ext.ext_cn: 昏暗偏僻的街道
ext.ext_en: ...dark, lonely streets.

defs.def_en: A Turkish bath is a place where you can have a Turkish bath.
The birdlife in a place is all the birds that live there.

ext.ext_cn: 八点半了，特雷弗该上床睡觉了。
ext.ext_en: It was eight-thirty, Trevor's bedtime.

ext.ext_cn: 睡前故事
ext.ext_en: ...bedtime stories.

defs.def_en: Your bedtime is the time when you usually go to bed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 喧闹的；活泼的；精力充沛的

ext.ext_cn: 一群大声喧嚷但很和善的人
ext.ext_en: ...a boisterous but good-natured crowd...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数孩子都又吵又闹。
ext.ext_en: Most of the children were noisy and boisterous.

defs.def_en: Someone who is boisterous is noisy, lively, and full of energy.

defs.def_cn: (旅馆等提供的)叫醒电话，叫醒服务
defs.def_en: A wake-up call is a telephone call that you can book through an operator or at a hotel to make sure that you wake up at a particular time.

ext.ext_cn: 大使说，他希望这一声明能给政府敲响警钟。
ext.ext_en: The Ambassador said he hoped the statement would serve as a wake-up call to the government.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a wake-up call to a person or group of people, you mean that it will make them notice something and start to take action.
A monocle is a glass lens which people wore in former times in front of one of their eyes to improve their ability to see with that eye.

ext.ext_cn: 问题是：军政府会通过武力巩固其政权吗？
ext.ext_en: The question is: will the junta consolidate its power by force?...

ext.ext_cn: 布赖登的队友马丁·威廉森在最近一轮比赛中获胜，巩固了自己在全国联赛中的领先地位。
ext.ext_en: Brydon's team-mate Martin Williamson consolidated his lead in the National League when he won the latest round.

defs.def_en: If you consolidate something that you have, for example power or success, you strengthen it so that it becomes more effective or secure.

ext.ext_cn: 查尔斯·施瓦茨法官将给路易斯安那州60天时间来解散然后合并该州的4个高等教育委员会。
ext.ext_en: Judge Charles Schwartz is giving the state 60 days to disband and consolidate Louisiana's four higher education boards...

ext.ext_en: IBM, which consolidated some operations last summer, has made clear that it needs to continue to streamline them.

defs.def_cn: （婚礼上新娘的）男伴童，小男傧相
defs.def_en: A pageboy is a small boy who accompanies the bride at a wedding.

defs.def_cn: 童花头（一种发梢内卷的齐长发型）
defs.def_en: A pageboy or a pageboy hairstyle is a hairstyle in which all the hair is smooth and the same medium length and the ends are curled under.

ext.ext_cn: 我是个有 21 年教龄的教师。
ext.ext_en: I'm a teacher with 21 years' experience.

ext.ext_cn: 她的化学老师
ext.ext_en: ...her chemistry teacher.

defs.def_en: See also:supply teacher;A teacher is a person who teaches, usually as a job at a school or similar institution.

ext.ext_cn: 他将担任武装部队的最高统帅。
ext.ext_en: He was to be the commander-in-chief of the armed forces.

defs.def_en: A commander-in-chief is an officer in charge of all the forces in a particular area.

ext.ext_cn: 肇事逃逸事件的受害者
ext.ext_en: ...the victim of a hit-and-run accident.

ext.ext_cn: 驾驶失车肇事逃逸的司机
ext.ext_en: ...a hit-and-run driver in a stolen car.

defs.def_en: A hit-and-run accident is an accident in which the driver of a vehicle hits someone and then drives away without stopping.

defs.def_cn: （军事进攻）打了就跑的，攻击后马上撤离的

ext.ext_en: The rebels appear to be making hit-and-run guerrilla style attacks on military targets.

ext.ext_cn: 足球运动员的平均薪水已达50万美金，他们为什么还要抱怨呢？
ext.ext_en: Why are football players griping when the average salary is half a million dollars?...

ext.ext_en: They were always griping about high prices.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is griping, you mean they are annoying you because they keep on complaining about something.

ext.ext_cn: 我唯一不满的就是连一道主菜和一份甜点都没有。
ext.ext_en: My only gripe is that one main course and one dessert were unavailable.

defs.def_en: A gripe is a complaint about something.

ext.ext_cn: 他把她领到了一个小船舱。
ext.ext_en: He showed her to a small cabin.

ext.ext_cn: 他一脸倦意,静静地坐在头等舱里。
ext.ext_en: He sat quietly in the First Class cabin, looking tired.

defs.def_en: A cabin is one of the areas inside a plane.

ext.ext_cn: 原木小屋
ext.ext_en: ...a log cabin.

defs.def_en: A cabin is a small wooden house, especially one in an area of forests or mountains.
Gypsum is a soft white substance which looks like chalk and which is used to make plaster of Paris.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 穿过该镇狭窄的街道
ext.ext_en: ...through the town's narrow streets...

ext.ext_cn: 她的双脚瘦长。
ext.ext_en: She had long, narrow feet.

defs.def_en: Something that is narrow measures a very small distance from one side to the other, especially compared to its length or height.

defs.def_en: If something narrows, it becomes less wide.

ext.ext_cn: 科金斯气得眯起眼睛。“你认为我会告诉你？”

defs.def_en: If something that someone says or does touches you, it affects you emotionally, often because you see that they are suffering a lot or that they are being very kind.

ext.ext_cn: 他卷曲的头发有些花白。
ext.ext_en: His crinkly hair was touched with grey...

ext.ext_cn: 那个男孩透着点天分。
ext.ext_en: The boy was touched with genius.

defs.def_en: If something is touched with a particular quality, it has a certain amount of that quality.

ext.ext_cn: 就职业素养来说，没人能比得上这些姑娘。
ext.ext_en: No one can touch these girls for professionalism.

defs.def_en: If you say about someone that nobody can touch him or her for a particular thing, you mean that he or she is much better at it than anyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 到第三圈时，金基德的车速达到了每小时 289 英里。
ext.ext_en: By the third lap Kinkead had touched 289 m.p.h.

ext.ext_cn: 风力前一天就已达到了狂风级。
ext.ext_en: The winds had touched storm-force the day before.

defs.def_en: To touch a particular level, amount, or score, especially a high one, means to reach it.

ext.ext_cn: 现在是向他借笔钱的时候了。
ext.ext_en: Now is the time to touch him for a loan.

defs.def_en: If you touch someone for money, you ask them to give it to you.

ext.ext_cn: 他们把这一活动称为“向英雄致敬”，这可是加分之举。
ext.ext_en: They called the event 'a tribute to heroes', which was a nice touch...

ext.ext_cn: 房间里放些诸如鲜花之类的小点缀可以给家里带来生气。
ext.ext_en: Small touches to a room such as flowers can be what gives a house its vitality.

defs.def_en: A touch is a detail which is added to something to improve it.

ext.ext_cn: 他做的菜全都带有其个人风格。
ext.ext_en: The dishes he produces all have a personal touch...

ext.ext_cn: 那个前锋找不到进球的感觉。
ext.ext_en: The striker was unable to find his scoring touch.

defs.def_en: If someone has a particular kind of touch, they have a particular way of doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 她认为自己仅仅有点感冒。
ext.ext_en: She thought she just had a touch of flu...

ext.ext_cn: 在大学期间他写过一点东西，小试过表演，并迷恋于校内政治活动。
ext.ext_en: At university he wrote a bit, did a touch of acting, and indulged in internal college politics.

defs.def_en: A touch of something is a very small amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我想我们都稍有点不自在。
ext.ext_en: We were all a touch uneasy, I think...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得这略有点让人反感。
ext.ext_en: I found it a touch distasteful.

defs.def_en: You can use a touch to mean slightly or to a small extent, especially in order to make something you say seem less extreme. For example, if you say that something is a touch expensive, you might really think that it is very expensive.

ext.ext_cn: 工作人员一摁按钮便可以追踪电话。
ext.ext_en: Staff will be able to trace calls at the touch of a button.

ext.ext_cn: 一按控制杆就会翻开的座位
ext.ext_en: …seats that flip out at the touch of a lever.

defs.def_en: You use at the touch of in expressions such as at the touch of a button and at the touch of a key to indicate that something is possible by simply touching a switch or one of the keys of a keyboard.

ext.ext_cn: 与很多高级法官不同，他一贯表现得平易近人。
ext.ext_en: Unlike many senior judges, he has consistently shown that he has the common touch.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has the common touch, you mean that they have the natural ability to have a good relationship with ordinary people and be popular with them.

ext.ext_cn: 我会就此事与律师联系。
ext.ext_en: I will get in touch with solicitors about this…

ext.ext_cn: 该组织明天就会和他联络。
ext.ext_en: The organisation would be in touch with him tomorrow...

defs.def_en: If you get in touch with someone, you contact them by writing to them or telephoning them. If you are, keep, or stay in touch with them, you write, phone, or visit each other regularly.

defs.def_cn: 了解最新情况(或信息)/不了解最新情况(或信息)

ext.ext_cn: 您还将随时获得乐施会在当地的最新活动信息。
ext.ext_en: You'll also be kept in touch with local Oxfam events.

ext.ext_cn: 使失业者即时了解劳动力市场的最新动态
ext.ext_en: ...keeping the unemployed in touch with the labour market...

defs.def_en: If you are in touch with a subject or situation, or if someone keeps you in touch with it, you know the latest news or information about it. If you are out of touch with it, you do not know the latest news or information about it.

ext.ext_cn: 干我这行，往往会与朋友失去联系。
ext.ext_en: In my job one tends to lose touch with friends...

ext.ext_cn: 我们自那以后就失去了联络。
ext.ext_en: We lost touch after that.

defs.def_en: If you lose touch with someone, you gradually stop writing, telephoning, or visiting them.

defs.def_cn: 不再了解最新情况(或信息)

ext.ext_cn: 他们的领导人不再了解该国正发生的一切。
ext.ext_en: Their leaders have lost touch with what is happening in the country.

defs.def_en: If you lose touch with something, you no longer have the latest news or information about it.

defs.def_cn: 不确定的事态;无法预言的事

ext.ext_cn: 我们是否会破产还很难说。
ext.ext_en: It was touch and go whether we'd go bankrupt.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is touch and go, you mean that you are uncertain whether it will happen or succeed.

defs.def_cn: 容易借钱给人的人;好说话的人

ext.ext_cn: 威尔逊先生绝不会轻易借钱给别人。
ext.ext_en: Mr Wilson is no soft touch…

ext.ext_cn: 她缺钱花的时候，帕梅拉总是有求必应。
ext.ext_en: Pamela was an easy touch when she needed some cash.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a soft touch or an easy touch, you mean that they can easily be persuaded to lend you money or to do things for you.

ext.ext_cn: 乔安妮的发际线旁有个小小的深色胎记。
ext.ext_en: Joanne had a small dark birthmark near her hairline...

ext.ext_cn: 这些年来他的前额已经有点秃了。
ext.ext_en: His hairline had receded slightly over the years.

defs.def_en: Your hairline is the edge of the area where your hair grows on your head.

defs.def_cn: （裂缝、缝隙等）极细的，极细微的

ext.ext_cn: 那只罐子的口沿有条极细的裂缝。
ext.ext_en: There's a hairline crack in the rim of that jar...

ext.ext_cn: 他右手食指骨裂。
ext.ext_en: He suffered a hairline fracture of the right index finger.

defs.def_en: A hairline crack or gap is very narrow or fine.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 武断的;任意的;任性的;主观的

ext.ext_cn: 随意逮捕和拘留屡见不鲜。
ext.ext_en: Arbitrary arrests and detention without trial were common.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action, rule, or decision as arbitrary, you think that it is not based on any principle, plan, or system. It often seems unfair because of this.

defs.def_cn: (戏剧、电影或小说的)次要情节，从属情节，小插曲

ext.ext_cn: 重头戏中精彩的小插曲
ext.ext_en: ...a fascinating sub-plot to the main drama.

defs.def_en: The sub-plot in a play, film, or novel is a story that is separate from and less important than the main story.

ext.ext_cn: 有段时间，他考虑去当军医。
ext.ext_en: For a time he contemplated a career as an army medical doctor...

ext.ext_cn: 她考虑为了孩子而离开。
ext.ext_en: She contemplates leaving for the sake of the kids.

defs.def_en: If you contemplate an action, you think about whether to do it or not.

defs.def_cn: 深思熟虑;沉思;苦思冥想

ext.ext_cn: 那天晚上，他躺在医院的病床上，想到未来，他哭了起来。
ext.ext_en: As he lay in his hospital bed that night, he cried as he contemplated his future...

ext.ext_cn: 那让人难以认真思考这个可能，即目前的政策也许并不能持续下去。
ext.ext_en: That makes it difficult to contemplate the idea that the present policy may not be sustainable.

defs.def_en: If you contemplate an idea or subject, you think about it carefully for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 他盯着自己的双手，眉头紧锁。
ext.ext_en: He contemplated his hands, still frowning.

defs.def_en: If you contemplate something or someone, you look at them for a long time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他好像连话都说不清楚。
ext.ext_en: He appeared hardly capable of conducting a coherent conversation...

ext.ext_cn: 厨房能同时容纳数百人进餐。
ext.ext_en: The kitchen is capable of catering for several hundred people...

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 熟练的;胜任的;有能力的

ext.ext_cn: 她能说会道。
ext.ext_en: She's a very capable speaker...

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫又体贴又能干。
ext.ext_en: Her husband was such a fine, capable man.

defs.def_en: Someone who is capable has the skill or qualities necessary to do a particular thing well, or is able to do most things well.
A paper knife is a tool shaped like a knife, which is used for opening envelopes.

ext.ext_cn: 许多国家以美元而不是本国货币收取机场税。
ext.ext_en: Many countries charge departure tax in US dollars rather than local currency.

defs.def_en: Departure tax is a tax that airline passengers have to pay in order to use an airport.
You use headgear to refer to hats or other things worn on the head.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 梅利莎是个丰满的高个子金发美女。
ext.ext_en: Melissa was a tall, buxom blonde.

defs.def_en: If you describe a woman as buxom, you mean that she looks healthy and attractive and has a rounded body and big breasts.

defs.def_cn: 乌合之众;流氓地痞;不三不四的人
defs.def_en: If you refer to a group of people as riff-raff, you disapprove of them because you think they are not respectable.

ext.ext_cn: 强制骑自行车者戴头盔的法律的出台
ext.ext_en: ...the introduction of legislation to compel cyclists to wear a helmet...

ext.ext_cn: 利奥妮的妈妈被迫在家替人洗衣服，以贴补家用。
ext.ext_en: Leonie's mother was compelled to take in washing to help support her family...

defs.def_en: If a situation, a rule, or a person compels you to do something, they force you to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 迪肯斯觉得必须返回舞台作最后的道别。
ext.ext_en: Dickens felt compelled to return to the stage for a final good-bye...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得从道义上我必须帮忙。
ext.ext_en: I felt morally compelled to help.

defs.def_en: If you feel compelled to do something, you feel that you must do it, because it is the right thing to do.
In former times, a yeoman was a man who was free and not a servant, and who owned and worked on his own land.

ext.ext_cn: 军队指挥者没有想到会遭到叛军的正面袭击。
ext.ext_en: Military leaders are not expecting a frontal assault by the rebels...

ext.ext_cn: 他首创了被称为额叶切断术的外科手术。
ext.ext_en: He pioneered the surgical technique called frontal lobotomy.

defs.def_en: Frontal means relating to or involving the front of something, for example the front of an army, a vehicle, or the brain.

defs.def_cn: (攻击或挑战)直接的，直截了当的

ext.ext_cn: 他对工薪阶层组织发起正面挑战。
ext.ext_en: He launches a frontal attack on working-class organizations.

defs.def_en: See also:full-frontal;A frontal attack or challenge criticizes or threatens something in a very strong, direct way.

ext.ext_cn: 我想让你有一个全新的心态。
ext.ext_en: I want you to get into a whole new state of mind...

ext.ext_cn: 他住院了，意识仍然不清。
ext.ext_en: He's in hospital, and in a confused state of mind.

defs.def_en: Your state of mind is your mood or mental state at a particular time.

defs.def_cn: 专长;特长;得心应手的工作

ext.ext_cn: 他在担任杂志的业务经理后才发现自己真正的专长。
ext.ext_en: It was as the magazine's business manager that he found his true metier.

defs.def_en: Your metier is the type of work that you have a natural talent for and do well.

ext.ext_cn: 过去，许多对发展中国家的援助计划没有得到合理实施。
ext.ext_en: Many of the aid projects in the developing world have been misdirected in the past.

defs.def_en: If resources or efforts are misdirected, they are used in the wrong way or for the wrong purposes.

defs.def_cn: 将…引错方向;给…指错方向

ext.ext_cn: 他故意给记者们指错方向。
ext.ext_en: He had deliberately misdirected the reporters.

defs.def_en: If you misdirect someone, you send them in the wrong direction.

ext.ext_cn: 在橄榄球俱乐部举行的一次狂饮聚会
ext.ext_en: ...a booze-up at the rugby club.

defs.def_en: In Britain, a booze-up is a party or other social gathering where people drink a lot of alcohol.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人羡慕的;引人妒嫉的

ext.ext_cn: 日本的预算盈余令人羡慕。
ext.ext_en: Japan is in the enviable position of having a budget surplus...

ext.ext_cn: 作为运动员，他们的声望令人羡慕。
ext.ext_en: They have enviable reputations as athletes.

defs.def_en: You describe something such as a quality as enviable when someone else has it and you wish that you had it too.
A hob is a surface on top of a cooker or set into a work surface, which can be heated in order to cook things on it.

ext.ext_cn: 他设计了一种能够避免腐蚀或氧化的金丝制作流程。
ext.ext_en: He has devised a process for making gold wires which neither corrode nor oxidise...

ext.ext_cn: 工程师们发现该建筑已经受潮腐蚀。
ext.ext_en: Engineers found the structure had been corroded by moisture...

defs.def_en: If metal or stone corrodes, or is cor-roded, it is gradually destroyed by a chemical or by rust.

ext.ext_cn: 相较于他感觉正在侵蚀他灵魂的痛苦而言，这种折磨倒更容易承受。
ext.ext_en: Suffering was easier to bear than the bitterness he felt corroding his spirit...

ext.ext_cn: 他警告说腐败正在侵蚀俄罗斯。
ext.ext_en: He warns that corruption is corroding Russia.

defs.def_en: To corrode something means to gradually make it worse or weaker.
A pushchair is a small chair on wheels, in which a baby or small child can sit and be wheeled around.

defs.def_cn: （女子头发）齐短式的，蘑菇头的
defs.def_en: If a woman's hair is bobbed, it is cut in a bob.

ext.ext_cn: 鸡在花园里咯咯叫。
ext.ext_en: Chickens clucked in the garden.

defs.def_en: When a hen clucks, it makes short, low noises.

ext.ext_cn: 不管是男孩还是女孩，我从来都对小孩没什么兴趣。
ext.ext_en: I've never been one to cluck over babies of either sex...

ext.ext_cn: 这些女裁缝围着模特儿衣架叽叽嘎嘎地讨论衣服这里或那里要做的小改动。
ext.ext_en: The seamstresses cluck around a dummy, discussing a tuck here and there.

defs.def_en: To cluck over someone or something means to behave in a fussy or protective way.

ext.ext_cn: 费尔贝恩警长还在表达对摄影师们的不满，警告说他会和他们的主编谈谈。
ext.ext_en: Superintendent Fairbairn was still clucking at the photographers, warning them he'd be speaking to their editor...

ext.ext_cn: 他不满地咂咂嘴。
ext.ext_en: He clucks in disapproval...

defs.def_en: To cluck at someone or something means to make disapproving noises or say things in a disapproving way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 放松的;松弛的;安心的;轻松的

ext.ext_cn: 我一作出最后的决定就感到轻松多了。
ext.ext_en: As soon as I had made the final decision, I felt a lot more relaxed...

ext.ext_cn: 试着换一种更加放松的方式。
ext.ext_en: Try to adopt a more relaxed manner.

defs.def_en: If you are relaxed, you are calm and not worried or tense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (地方或情形)轻松的，舒适的，使人安心的

ext.ext_cn: 午餐的气氛很轻松。
ext.ext_en: The atmosphere at lunch was relaxed.

defs.def_en: If a place or situation is relaxed, it is calm and peaceful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 旧金山建在 40 座小山丘上，其中一些非常陡峭。
ext.ext_en: San Francisco is built on 40 hills and some are very steep.

ext.ext_cn: 两旁山坡陡峭的狭窄山谷
ext.ext_en: ...a narrow, steep-sided valley.

defs.def_en: A steep slope rises at a very sharp angle and is difficult to go up.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (增加或减少)急剧的，大幅度的

ext.ext_cn: 消费者在抗议物价飞涨。
ext.ext_en: Consumers are rebelling at steep price increases.

defs.def_en: A steep increase or decrease in something is a very big increase or decrease.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 每年要交的保险费可能有点高，但如果你的狗受了伤就会很值了。
ext.ext_en: The annual premium can be a little steep, but will be well worth it if your dog is injured.

defs.def_en: If you say that the price of something is steep, you mean that it is expensive.

ext.ext_cn: 这是用菠萝皮泡在水里做的饮料。
ext.ext_en: It's a drink made by steeping pineapple rind in water.

ext.ext_cn: 在橄榄油里浸泡过的青豆
ext.ext_en: ...green beans steeped in olive oil.

defs.def_en: To steep food in a liquid means to put the food in the liquid for some time so that the food gets flavour from the liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 探长巴西特负责调查该谋杀案。
ext.ext_en: Det Supt Bassett was in charge of the murder enquiry.

defs.def_en: Supt is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) superintendent when it is part of the title of someone in the police force.

ext.ext_cn: 白宫官员命令威廉斯公开宣布放弃自己的观点。
ext.ext_en: White House officials ordered Williams to recant.

ext.ext_cn: 受严刑折磨后仍拒绝放弃其异教信仰的人
ext.ext_en: ...a man who had refused after torture to recant his heresy.

defs.def_en: If you recant, you say publicly that you no longer hold a set of beliefs that you had in the past.

defs.def_cn: （用于构成形容词和名词，描述人的特性）表示“高度”，“过于”

ext.ext_cn: 我讨厌我父亲。他吹毛求疵，刻薄无情。
ext.ext_en: I hated my father. He was hyper-critical and mean...

ext.ext_cn: 他属于那种瘦削、过于健美的人。
ext.ext_en: He is one of those lean, hyper-fit people.

defs.def_en: Hyper- is used to form adjectives and nouns that describe someone as having a lot or too much of a particular quality.

An expressway is a wide road that is specially designed so that a lot of traffic can move along it very quickly. It is usually divided, so that traffic travelling in one direction is separated from the traffic travelling in the opposite direction.

defs.def_cn: 记事手册;拍纸簿;笔记本

ext.ext_cn: 准备好铅笔和笔记本。
ext.ext_en: Have a pencil and notepad ready.

defs.def_en: A notepad is a pad of paper that you use for writing notes or letters on.
See also:common denominator;lowest common denominator;In mathematics, the denominator is the number which appears under the line in a fraction.

defs.def_cn: (第一人称单数所有格代词)我的(东西)

ext.ext_cn: 她的右手和我的手挨得很近。
ext.ext_en: Her right hand is inches from mine...

ext.ext_cn: 那不是他的错，是我的错。
ext.ext_en: That wasn't his fault, it was mine...

defs.def_en: Mine is the first person singular possessive pronoun. A speaker or writer uses mine to refer to something that belongs or relates to himself or herself.

ext.ext_cn: 煤矿
ext.ext_en: ...coal mines.

defs.def_en: A mine is a place where deep holes and tunnels are dug under the ground in order to obtain a mineral such as coal, diamonds, or gold.

ext.ext_cn: 这座煤矿即将关闭，因为从经济上考虑，矿井里已经没有足够的煤可供开采。
ext.ext_en: The pit is being shut down because it no longer has enough coal that can be mined economically.

ext.ext_cn: 从世界各地采掘来的最精美的宝石
ext.ext_en: ...the finest gems, mined from all corners of the world.

defs.def_en: When a mineral such as coal, diamonds, or gold is mined, it is obtained from the ground by digging deep holes and tunnels.
A mine is a bomb which is hidden in the ground or in water and which explodes when people or things touch it.

ext.ext_cn: 通往要塞的道路都已布满地雷。
ext.ext_en: The approaches to the garrison have been heavily mined.

defs.def_en: If an area of land or water is mined, mines are placed there which will explode when people or things touch them.
If you say that someone is a mine of information, you mean that they know a great deal about something.

ext.ext_cn: 英国社会中强劲的种族主义暗流
ext.ext_en: ...a deep undercurrent of racism in British society.

defs.def_en: If there is an undercurrent of a feeling, you are hardly aware of the feeling, but it influences the way you think or behave.

ext.ext_cn: 科林想跟在他后面游，但强大的暗流把他们分开了。
ext.ext_en: Colin tried to swim after him but the strong undercurrent swept them apart.

defs.def_en: An undercurrent is a strong current of water that is moving below the surface current and in a different direction to it.

defs.def_cn: 美国独立纪念日(7 月 4 日);美国国庆日

ext.ext_en: On the Fourth of July, my husband and our friends drove into the city to see the fireworks.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_cn: 给生活带来方便的事物

ext.ext_en: It is for this reason that television proves such a boon to so many people...

ext.ext_en: This battery booster is a boon for photographers.

ext.ext_cn: 几秒钟的时间里，她经历了从愤怒到内疚的情感变化。

ext.ext_cn: 一些癌症病人懊悔不已。

ext.ext_cn: 依照刑法规定，审判仅涉及定罪。
ext.ext_en: The trial is concerned only with the determination of guilt according to criminal law...

ext.ext_cn: 你不相信马修斯先生有罪。
ext.ext_en: You weren't convinced of Mr Matthews' guilt.

defs.def_en: Guilt is the fact that you have done something wrong or illegal.

defs.def_cn: （用于要求或命令别人安静）嘘

ext.ext_cn: 嘘，宝贝，没事了。
ext.ext_en: Hush, my love, it's all right.

defs.def_en: You say 'Hush!' to someone when you are asking or telling them to be quiet.

ext.ext_cn: 她试图让吵吵嚷嚷的父亲安静下来。
ext.ext_en: She tried to hush her noisy father...

ext.ext_cn: 我不得不打了马克斯一耳光让他闭嘴。
ext.ext_en: I had to box Max's ears to get him to hush.

defs.def_en: If you hush someone or if they hush, they stop speaking or making a noise.

defs.def_cn: 寂静;宁静;（突然出现的）安静

ext.ext_cn: 人群突然一片肃静，我知道一定发生了什么可怕的事。
ext.ext_en: A hush fell over the crowd and I knew something terrible had happened.

defs.def_en: You say there is a hush in a place when everything is quiet and peaceful, or suddenly becomes quiet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He appeared hardly capable of conducting a coherent conversation...

ext.ext_cn: 厨房能同时容纳数百人进餐。
ext.ext_en: The kitchen is capable of catering for several hundred people...

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 熟练的;胜任的;有能力的

ext.ext_cn: 她能说会道。
ext.ext_en: She's a very capable speaker...

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫又体贴又能干。
ext.ext_en: Her husband was such a fine, capable man.

defs.def_en: Someone who is capable has the skill or qualities necessary to do a particular thing well, or is able to do most things well.

defs.def_cn: 睡衣派对(指一帮年轻的朋友穿着睡衣通宵畅谈的聚会)
defs.def_en: A slumber party is an occasion when a group of young friends spend the night together at the home of one of the group.

defs.def_cn: 散布恐怖消息;制造恐慌;危言耸听

ext.ext_cn: 昨日政府指责“绿色和平”组织危言耸听。
ext.ext_en: The Government yesterday accused Greenpeace of scaremongering.

defs.def_en: If one person or group accuses another person or group of scaremongering, they accuse them of deliberately spreading worrying stories to try and frighten people.

ext.ext_cn: 自制果酱
ext.ext_en: ...home-made jam.

defs.def_en: Jam is a thick sweet food that is made by cooking fruit with a large amount of sugar, and that is usually spread on bread.

ext.ext_cn: 他从地上捡起帽子，猛地扣到头上。
ext.ext_en: He picked his cap up off the ground and jammed it on his head...

ext.ext_cn: 皮特使劲把手插进口袋里。
ext.ext_en: Pete jammed his hands into his pockets.

defs.def_en: If you jam something somewhere, you push or put it there roughly.

defs.def_cn: （机器）卡住；使卡住；（使）不能运转

ext.ext_cn: 他开第二枪时枪卡壳了。
ext.ext_en: The second time he fired his gun jammed...

ext.ext_cn: 一根绳子卡住了船的螺旋桨。
ext.ext_en: A rope jammed the boat's propeller...

defs.def_en: If something such as a part of a machine jams, or if something jams it, the part becomes fixed in position and is unable to move freely or work properly.

ext.ext_cn: 数百名打算驾车离开的司机堵住了道路。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of departing motorists jammed the roads.

defs.def_en: If vehicles jam a road, there are so many of them that they cannot move.

ext.ext_cn: 数百人挤在木板人行道上观看。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of people jammed the boardwalk to watch...

ext.ext_cn: 他们挤上红十字会派来的巴士前往安全的地方。
ext.ext_en: They jammed into buses provided by the Red Cross and headed for safety.

defs.def_en: If a lot of people jam a place, or jam into a place, they are pressed tightly together so that they can hardly move.

defs.def_cn: 干扰（无线电或电子信号）

ext.ext_cn: 他们会试图用电子信号对发射进行干扰。
ext.ext_en: They will try to jam the transmissions electronically.

defs.def_en: To jam a radio or electronic signal means to interfere with it and prevent it from being received or heard clearly.

defs.def_cn: 使（电话总机）应接不暇；使（电话线）过于繁忙

ext.ext_cn: 在一个多小时内，成百上千的来电使得英国广播公司的总机应接不暇。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of callers jammed the BBC switchboard for more than an hour...

ext.ext_cn: 很多人想买季票，电话总机一天到晚忙个不停。
ext.ext_en: The telephone exchange has been jammed all day with people wanting to buy season tickets.

defs.def_en: If callers are jamming telephone lines, there are so many callers that the people answering the telephones find it difficult to deal with them all.

ext.ext_cn: 他们确实遇上麻烦了，鲍勃闷闷不乐地想。
ext.ext_en: They were in a real jam, Bob thought glumly.

defs.def_en: If someone is in a jam, they are in a very difficult situation.

defs.def_cn: （爵士乐手或摇滚乐手）即兴演奏

ext.ext_cn: 他在即兴吹奏萨克斯管。
ext.ext_en: He was jamming with his saxophone.

defs.def_en: When jazz or rock musicians are jamming, they are informally playing music that has not been written down or planned in advance.

ext.ext_cn: 她的香水味道在房间里久久不散。
ext.ext_en: The scent of her perfume lingered on in the room...

ext.ext_cn: 一场游击战已经持续了30多年。
ext.ext_en: A guerrilla war has lingered into its fourth decade...

defs.def_en: When something such as an idea, feeling, or illness lingers, it continues to exist for a long time, often much longer than expected.

defs.def_cn: 留恋；不愿离开；继续逗留

ext.ext_cn: 客人尽可以喝着咖啡逗留到午夜左右。
ext.ext_en: Customers are welcome to linger over coffee until around midnight...

ext.ext_cn: 我在亚特兰大又逗留了几天，大部分时候都和一位搞艺术的朋友在一起。
ext.ext_en: I lingered on in Atlanta for a few days, spending much of my time with an artist friend...

defs.def_en: If you linger somewhere, you stay there for a longer time than is necessary, for example because you are enjoying yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 该市曾面临种族危机，不过已经安然渡过。
ext.ext_en: The city had faced racial crisis and come through it...

ext.ext_cn: 他年纪太大，经不起那么摔一跤。
ext.ext_en: He's too old to come through a fall like that.

defs.def_en: To come through a dangerous or difficult situation means to survive it and recover from it.

ext.ext_cn: 我希望自己表现出了对这个素材的喜爱，因为这个剧本很棒。
ext.ext_en: I hope my love for the material came through, because it is a great script...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的谈话往往很难懂，但他们的兴奋之情还是显露了出来。
ext.ext_en: Their talk is often hard to fathom but their exuberance still comes through.

defs.def_en: If a feeling or message comes through, it is clearly shown in what is said or done.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在履行完某些程序后)到来

ext.ext_cn: 孩子的父亲正等着离婚手续办完。
ext.ext_en: The father of the baby was waiting for his divorce to come through...

ext.ext_cn: 这条消息是选举当天5点钟左右播出的。
ext.ext_en: The news came through at about five o'clock on election day.

defs.def_en: If something comes through, it arrives, especially after some procedure has been  carried out.

defs.def_cn: 实现(承诺);成功地完成;成功提供

ext.ext_cn: 如果他不履行改革承诺，就会使他所领导的政府面临危险。
ext.ext_en: He puts his administration at risk if he doesn't come through on these promises for reform...

ext.ext_cn: 我们觉得自己万分无助，而这时我们的女同胞们向我们伸出了援助之手。
ext.ext_en: We found that we were totally helpless, and our women came through for us.

defs.def_en: If you come through with what is expected or needed from you, you succeed in doing or providing it.

ext.ext_cn: 与外交官结婚的女性要追求自己的爱好就变得更加困难了。
ext.ext_en: It became harder for women married to diplomats to pursue their own interests...

ext.ext_cn: 他说日本将继续贯彻伦敦峰会所制定的政策。
ext.ext_en: He said Japan would continue to pursue the policies laid down at the London summit...

defs.def_en: If you pursue an activity, interest, or plan, you carry it out or follow it.

ext.ext_cn: 言外之意似乎是经济改革和民主化进程是不可能同时进行的。
ext.ext_en: The implication seems to be that it is impossible to pursue economic reform and democracy simultaneously...

ext.ext_cn: 梅嫩德斯先生积极开拓新业务。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Menendez has aggressively pursued new business.

defs.def_en: If you pursue a particular aim or result, you make efforts to achieve it, often over a long period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你最初的请求遭到拒绝，不要害怕，要继续追问下去。
ext.ext_en: If your original request is denied, don't be afraid to pursue the matter.

defs.def_en: If you pursue a particular topic, you try to find out more about it by asking questions.

ext.ext_cn: 她追赶那个偷了一个妇女提包的男人。
ext.ext_en: She pursued the man who had stolen a woman's bag.

defs.def_en: If you pursue a person, vehicle, or animal, you follow them, usually in order to catch them.

ext.ext_cn: 新的证据表明警方在审讯时撒了谎。
ext.ext_en: New evidence showed the police lied at the trial...

ext.ext_cn: 他因被控密谋颠覆国家正等待军事法庭的审判。
ext.ext_en: He's awaiting trial in a military court on charges of plotting against the state...

defs.def_en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已在临床试验中接受过这种药物的治疗。
ext.ext_en: They have been treated with this drug in clinical trials...

ext.ext_cn: 我开车上路试驾了一下。
ext.ext_en: I took the car out for a trial on the roads…

defs.def_en: A trial is an experiment in which you test something by using it or doing it for a period of time to see how well it works. If something is on trial, it is being tested in this way.

ext.ext_cn: 他刚给了一位声称自己有从业经验的年轻女子一次试用机会。
ext.ext_en: He had just given a trial to a young woman who said she had previous experience...

ext.ext_cn: 那位 26 岁的后卫已经在该俱乐部试用 10 天了。
ext.ext_en: The 26-year old fullback has been on trial at the club for ten days.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you a trial for a job, or if you are on trial, you do the job for a short period of time to see if you are suitable for it.

ext.ext_cn: 青春期的苦恼
ext.ext_en: ...the trials of adolescence.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the trials of a situation, you mean the unpleasant things that you experience in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他参加赛马选拔赛还不到一年。
ext.ext_en: He has been riding in horse trials for less than a year.

ext.ext_cn: 达夫谷牧羊犬测试赛
ext.ext_en: ...Dovedale Sheepdog Trials.

defs.def_en: In some sports or outdoor activities, trials are a series of contests that test a competitor's skill and ability.

defs.def_cn: 通过反复试验；经过不断摸索

ext.ext_cn: 很多药物都是通过反复试验才发现的。
ext.ext_en: Many drugs were found by trial and error...

ext.ext_cn: 她感到抚养孩子就像是摸着石头过河。
ext.ext_en: She feels that raising her children has been a matter of trial and error.

defs.def_en: If you do something by trial and error, you try several different methods of doing it until you find the method that works properly.

ext.ext_cn: 他目前正因严重的毒品控罪而受审。
ext.ext_en: He is currently on trial accused of serious drugs charges...

ext.ext_cn: 他将因谋杀罪名在本月晚些时候出庭受审。
ext.ext_en: He will go on trial later this month charged with murder…

defs.def_en: If someone is on trial, they are being tried in a court of law.

defs.def_cn: 在测试中;在考察中;在考验中

ext.ext_cn: 总统将被卷入一场造成负面影响的争斗中，他的资格会因此受到考验。
ext.ext_en: The President will be drawn into a damaging battle in which his credentials will be on trial.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is on trial, you mean that they are in a situation where people are observing them to see whether they succeed or fail.

ext.ext_cn: 他被判定精神状况不宜接受审判。
ext.ext_en: He was found to be mentally unfit to stand trial…

ext.ext_cn: 将有 5 个人因涉嫌谋杀受到审判。
ext.ext_en: Five people are to stand trial for murder.

defs.def_en: If someone stands trial, they are tried in court for a crime they are accused of.
A raindrop is a single drop of rain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对时间和金钱都很吝啬。
ext.ext_en: He is miserly with both his time and his money.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as miserly, you disapprove of them because they seem to hate spending money, and to spend as little as possible.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 现今，做一名补助金少得可怜、职业前景渺茫的学生非常不容易。
ext.ext_en: Being a student today with miserly grants and limited career prospects is difficult.

defs.def_en: If you describe an amount of something as miserly, you are critical of it because it is very small.

A flyover is the same as a flypast .

ext.ext_cn: G. 沃克下士
ext.ext_en: ...Cpl. G. Walker.

defs.def_en: Cpl. is the written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) corporal when it is used as a title.

defs.def_cn: (可同时供多人使用或进行复杂计算的)大型计算机
defs.def_en: A mainframe or mainframe computer is a large powerful computer which can be used by many people at the same time and which can do very large or complicated tasks.

ext.ext_cn: 用钩针编织的黑色马甲
ext.ext_en: ...a black crochet waistcoat.

defs.def_en: Crochet is a way of making cloth out of cotton or wool by using a needle with a small hook at the end.

ext.ext_cn: 她提出要教我钩织东西。
ext.ext_en: She offered to teach me to crochet...

ext.ext_cn: 我和妈妈钩织了新床罩。
ext.ext_en: Ma and I crocheted new quilts.

defs.def_en: If you crochet, you make cloth by using a needle with a small hook at the end.

defs.def_cn: （通常指医务或军队中的）辅助人员

ext.ext_cn: 助理护士只提供基本护理，不具备护士资格。
ext.ext_en: Nursing auxiliaries provide basic care, but are not qualified nurses.

defs.def_en: An auxiliary is a person who is employed to assist other people in their work. Auxiliaries are often medical workers or members of the armed forces.

ext.ext_cn: 政府关心的首要问题是扩充军队及辅助队伍。
ext.ext_en: The government's first concern was to augment the army and auxiliary forces.

defs.def_en: Auxiliary staff and troops assist other staff and troops.

ext.ext_cn: 备用发动机
ext.ext_en: ...an auxiliary motor.

ext.ext_cn: 备用油箱
ext.ext_en: ...auxiliary fuel tanks.

defs.def_en: Auxiliary equipment is extra equipment that is available for use when necessary.

ext.ext_cn: 这家餐厅由帕洛阿尔托附院经营，收益用来资助露西尔·帕卡德儿童医院。
ext.ext_en: The restaurant is operated by the Palo Alto Auxiliary for the benefit of the Lucile Salter Packard Children's Hospital.

defs.def_en: An auxiliary is an organization that is connected with, but less important than, another organization; for example, an organization for the wives of the members of the main organization.

In grammar, an auxiliary or auxiliary verb is a verb which is used with a main verb, for example to form different tenses or to make the verb passive. In English, the basic auxiliary verbs are 'be', 'have', and 'do'. Modal verbs such as 'can' and 'will' are also sometimes called auxiliaries.

defs.def_cn: （英国的）有权占有上议院议席的贵族
defs.def_en: In Britain, a peer of the realm is a member of the nobility who has the right to sit in the House of Lords.

ext.ext_cn: 加德纳在资格赛中创下了最快圈速的纪录，赢得了今天美国大奖赛的杆位。
ext.ext_en: Gardner recorded the fastest lap in qualifying to earn pole position for today's US Grand Prix.

defs.def_en: When a racing car is in pole position, it is in front of the other cars at the start of a race.

defs.def_cn: 天桥；跨线桥；上跨式立交桥

ext.ext_cn: 造价1,600万美元的1号公路上的上跨公路桥

ext.ext_en: The food industry was given a green light to extend the use of these chemicals...

ext.ext_en: Other countries are eagerly awaiting an American green light to lift the sanctions altogether.

defs.def_en: If someone in authority gives you a green light, they give you permission to do something.

ext.ext_en: In the light of this information it is now possible to identify a number of key issues.

defs.def_en: If something is possible in the light of particular information, it is only possible because you have this information.

defs.def_cn: 很快入睡；立即失去知觉

ext.ext_cn: “为什么没有人来告诉我？”——“因为你一下就睡过去了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Why didn't  somebody come and tell me?' — 'Because you were out like a light.'

defs.def_en: If someone goes out like a light, they fall asleep or become unconscious very quickly or immediately.

ext.ext_en: Museum basements are stacked full of objects which never see the light of day.

defs.def_en: If you say that an object sees the light of day or sees the light, you mean that it is taken out of the place where it is stored.

ext.ext_cn: 这份非同寻常的文件第一次公开是在1966年。
ext.ext_en: This extraordinary document first saw the light of day in 1966.

defs.def_en: If something sees the light of day at a particular time, it comes into existence or is made known to the public at that time.

ext.ext_cn: 我终于醒悟，甩掉了他。
ext.ext_en: I saw the light and ditched him.

defs.def_en: If someone sees the light, they finally realize something or change their attitude or way of behaving to a better one.

ext.ext_cn: 他们隔着公寓门往里边倒汽油，然后点着了火。
ext.ext_en: They had poured fuel through the door of the flat and had then set light to it.

defs.def_en: If you set light to something, you make it start burning.

defs.def_cn: 使（某事）显得非常清楚；使人了解（某事）

ext.ext_cn: 新的方法提供了一个答案，并且可能让人们对一个更大的问题有进一步的了解。
ext.ext_en: A new approach offers an answer, and may shed light on an even bigger question.

defs.def_en: To shed light on ,throw light on, or cast light on something means to make it easier to understand, because more information is known about it.

defs.def_cn: 隧道尽头的曙光；黑暗尽头的希望

ext.ext_cn: 我只能告诉她要坚持，让她知道总会柳暗花明的。
ext.ext_en: All I can do is tell her to hold on, that there's light at the end of the tunnel.

defs.def_en: When you talk about the light at the end of the tunnel, you are referring to the end of the difficult or unpleasant situation that you are in at the moment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Modern tennis rackets are now apparently 20 per cent lighter.

ext.ext_cn: 轻量负重训练
ext.ext_en: ...weight training with light weights...

defs.def_en: Something that is light does not weigh very much, or weighs less than you would expect it to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 少量的；程度轻的；强度低的

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个星期天，像任何一个星期天一样，城里的车辆不多。
ext.ext_en: It's  a Sunday like any other with the usual light traffic in the city...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天拍卖之前的成交量很小。
ext.ext_en: Trading was very light ahead of yesterday's auction.

defs.def_en: Something that is light is not very great in amount, degree, or intensity.

ext.ext_cn: 轻型装甲车队
ext.ext_en: ...a convoy of light armoured vehicles...

ext.ext_cn: 他们使用了轻机枪和AK—47步枪。
ext.ext_en: They used light machine guns and AK forty-sevens.

defs.def_en: Light equipment and machines are small and easily moved, especially because they are not heavy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Less chemical gets into the subsoil which is particularly important with the light, tropical soils.

defs.def_en: Soil that is light is easy to dig, because it has a loose texture and is not sticky or solid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 墙的颜色素淡，贴了墙纸。
ext.ext_en: The walls are light in colour and covered in paper...

ext.ext_cn: 他浅色头发，灰色眼睛。
ext.ext_en: He is light haired with gray eyes.

defs.def_en: Something that is light is very pale in colour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她迷迷糊糊地进入了浅睡。
ext.ext_en: She had drifted into a light sleep...

ext.ext_cn: 她通常很容易惊醒。
ext.ext_en: She was usually a light sleeper.

defs.def_en: A light sleep is one that is easily disturbed and in which you are often aware of the things around you. If you are a light sleeper, you are easily woken when you are asleep.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那嗓音甜美轻柔。
ext.ext_en: The voice was sweet and light.

defs.def_en: A light sound, for example someone's voice, is pleasantly quiet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 量少而健康的午餐
ext.ext_en: ...a light, healthy lunch.

ext.ext_cn: 酒和奶酪或其他小食品
ext.ext_en: ...wine and cheese or other light refreshment.

defs.def_en: A light meal consists of a small amount of food, or of food that is easy to digest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 伯蒂做的西红柿清汤清淡可口。
ext.ext_en: Berti's  clear tomato soup is deliciously light...

ext.ext_cn: 用箔纸包烤或用清汤蒸煮三文鱼8至10分钟。
ext.ext_en: Bake salmon in foil or poach in a light stock for 8-10 minutes.

defs.def_en: Food that is light has a delicate flavour and is easy to digest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 昨天他在训练场进行了一些强度较小的训练。
ext.ext_en: He was on the training field for some light work yesterday.

defs.def_en: Light work does not involve much physical effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行为后果、处罚等）轻微的，不严重的

ext.ext_cn: 父亲来探监时，她承认对自己受到的从轻判决感到诧异。
ext.ext_en: She confessed her astonishment at her light sentence when her father visited her at the jail.

defs.def_en: If you describe the result of an action or a punishment as light, you mean that it is less serious or severe than you expected.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻捷的；轻盈的；用力小的

ext.ext_cn: 涂抹乳霜或化妆品时动作要轻。
ext.ext_en: Use a light touch when applying cream or make-up...

ext.ext_cn: 有人在轻轻地敲门。
ext.ext_en: There was a light knock at the door.

defs.def_en: Movements and actions that are light are graceful or gentle and are done with very little force or effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （书、音乐、电影等）消遣性的，娱乐性的，轻松的

ext.ext_cn: 他不喜欢我看些消遣小说。
ext.ext_en: He doesn't like me reading light novels.

ext.ext_cn: 轻古典音乐
ext.ext_en: ...light classical music.

defs.def_en: If you describe things such as books, music, and films as light, you mean that they entertain you without making you think very deeply.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 用友好随意的方式跟他谈谈这一关系吧。
ext.ext_en: Talk to him in a friendly, light way about the relationship...

ext.ext_cn: 最后，我们谈一个比较轻松的话题吧。
ext.ext_en: Let's finish on a lighter note.

defs.def_en: If you say something in a light way, you sound as if you think that something is not important or serious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （通常用于否定句）轻微的，不重要的

ext.ext_cn: 竟然有那么多的年轻囚犯试图自杀或自残，内政部决不可等闲视之。
ext.ext_en: It can be no light matter for the Home Office that so many young prisoners should have wanted to kill or injure themselves.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not a light matter, you mean that it should be treated or considered as being important and serious.

defs.def_cn: 轻视；对…不在乎；视…为微不足道

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯茨试图轻描淡写自己的不适。
ext.ext_en: Roberts attempted to make light of his discomfort.

defs.def_en: If you make light of something, you treat it as though it is not serious or important, when in fact it is.

ext.ext_en: Convictions for criminal offences might lead to the persons concerned being debarred from entering the teaching profession.

defs.def_en: If you are debarred from doing something, you are prevented from doing it by a law or regulation.

defs.def_cn: （通常由专职司机驾驶的）大型高级轿车，豪华轿车

defs.def_cn: 令人沉迷的;极其强烈的;令人忘乎一切的

ext.ext_en: He has developed a consuming passion for chess.

defs.def_en: See also:consume;time-consuming;A consuming passion or interest is more important to you than anything else.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the torrid heat of a Spanish summer.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 火热的床戏

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Seles, the victim of a death threat earlier this week, has had a torrid time during the Championships...

ext.ext_en: The minister suffered yet another torrid day of criticism.

ext.ext_cn: 对消耗品的需求

ext.ext_en: Suppliers add computer consumables, office equipment and furniture to their product range.

ext.ext_en: He recalls his native Bombay with cinematic exactness.

defs.def_en: Exactness is the quality of being very accurate and precise.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: Someone who is pertinacious continues trying to do something difficult rather than giving up quickly.

defs.def_cn: （场合）喧闹的，欢乐的;(书、电影等)有趣的，轻松的，娱乐的

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
