defs.def_en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

defs.def_cn: (议会或其他机构就某问题在投票前进行的)辩论

ext.ext_cn: 预计接下来的几天里议会将会进行一些激烈的辩论。
ext.ext_en: There are expected to be some heated debates in parliament over the next few days.

defs.def_en: A debate is a formal discussion, for example in a parliament or institution, in which people express different opinions about a particular subject and then vote on it.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国安理会今天将就这个问题展开讨论。
ext.ext_en: The United Nations Security Council will debate the issue today...

ext.ext_cn: 关于厌食的起因存在颇多争论。
ext.ext_en: The causes of anorexia are much debated...

defs.def_en: If people debate a topic, they discuss it fairly formally, putting forward different views. You can also say that one person debates a topic with another person.

ext.ext_cn: 塔格特思忖着是否再要一杯双份伏特加。
ext.ext_en: Taggart debated whether to have yet another double vodka...

ext.ext_cn: 我们眼下正盘算着为房子购置什么样的家具。
ext.ext_en: At the moment we are debating what furniture to buy for the house...

defs.def_en: If you debate whether to do something or what to do, you think or talk about possible courses of action before deciding exactly what you are going to do.

defs.def_cn: 存在争论的;有待讨论的;未确定的

ext.ext_cn: 他们之中谁更有音乐天赋还未有定论。
ext.ext_en: Which of them has more musical talent is open to debate.

defs.def_en: If you say that a matter is open to debate, you mean that people have different opinions about it, or it has not yet been firmly decided.

defs.def_cn: （文件、论点等中对重要问题的）缺漏，脱漏，遗缺

ext.ext_cn: 手边的材料依然存在严重缺漏。
ext.ext_en: There are still major lacunae in the material available.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is a lacuna in something such as a document or a person's argument, you mean that it does not deal with an important issue and is therefore not effective or convincing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不受抑制的；无拘无束的

ext.ext_cn: 气场强大、狂放不羁的艺人
ext.ext_en: ...a commanding and uninhibited entertainer...

ext.ext_cn: 舞跳得非常奔放，就像在做有氧健身操一样疯狂。
ext.ext_en: The dancing is uninhibited and as frenzied as an aerobics class...

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as uninhibited, you mean that they express their opinions and feelings openly, and behave as they want to, without worrying what other people think.

ext.ext_cn: 减税问题已经在政府官员中引起了争议。
ext.ext_en: The tax cut issue has caused dissension among administration officials.

defs.def_en: Dissension is disagreement and argument.

ext.ext_cn: 这些电视节目的观众各自都在每周1,900万左右。
ext.ext_en: These programmes are each watched by around 19 million viewers every week.

defs.def_en: Viewers are people who watch television, or who are watching a particular programme on television.

ext.ext_cn: 艺术品与其观赏者之间的关系
ext.ext_en: ... the relationship between the art object and the viewer.

defs.def_en: A viewer is someone who is looking carefully at a picture or other interesting object.

ext.ext_cn: 这个特别的观片器操作简单，配有70张全彩幻灯片。
ext.ext_en: This special viewer is simple to use and comes with 70 full-colour slides.

defs.def_en: A viewer is a device shaped like a box with a lens in one side. It is used for looking at transparent colour photographs.

ext.ext_cn: 他们千方百计雇用那些性格上天生适合服务顾客的人。
ext.ext_en: They take pains to hire people whose personalities predispose them to serve customers well...

ext.ext_cn: 有证据表明，特定的因素会使某些人产生犯罪倾向。
ext.ext_en: There is evidence to suggest that certain factors predispose some individuals to criminal behaviour.

defs.def_en: If something predisposes you to think or behave in a particular way, it makes it likely that you will think or behave in that way.

defs.def_cn: 使易感染，使易患（某种疾病）

ext.ext_cn: 使人容易嗜酒的基因
ext.ext_en: ...a gene that predisposes people to alcoholism.

defs.def_en: If something predisposes you to a disease or illness, it makes it likely that you will suffer from that disease or illness.

defs.def_cn: （粗鲁地）打断（某人说话），打扰（某人做事）

ext.ext_cn: 很抱歉这样打扰您，但是我有个问题希望您能解决。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry to barge in like this, but I have a problem I hope you can solve.

defs.def_en: If you barge in or barge in on someone, you rudely interrupt what they are doing or saying.

defs.def_cn: 无缝的;无停顿的;衔接完美的

ext.ext_cn: 这是一曲优美流畅的电子乐曲。
ext.ext_en: It was a seamless procession of wonderful electronic music.

ext.ext_cn: 一望无际的蓝天
ext.ext_en: ...the seamless blue sky.

defs.def_en: You use seamless to describe something that has no breaks or gaps in it or which continues without stopping.

defs.def_cn: 驶离，离开（…路);转弯;拐入旁路

ext.ext_cn: 卡车驶离大路，沿着通向农场的碎石小道行进。
ext.ext_en: The truck turned off the main road along the gravelly track which led to the farm...

ext.ext_cn: 他转入岔路，却发现自己困在了一个难觅出口的市镇广场。
ext.ext_en: He turned off only to find he was trapped in a town square with no easy exit.

defs.def_en: If you turn off the road or path you are going along, you start going along a different road or path which leads away from it.

defs.def_cn: 关上;关掉；截断，切断（…的供应）

ext.ext_cn: 灯光有点太刺眼了。你可以把灯关掉。
ext.ext_en: The light's a bit too harsh. You can turn it off...

ext.ext_cn: 我必须起床关上收音机。
ext.ext_en: I have to get up and turn off the radio...

defs.def_en: When you turn off a piece of equipment or a supply of something, you stop heat, sound, or water being produced by adjusting the controls.

ext.ext_cn: 是什么使青少年对科学技术丧失了兴趣？
ext.ext_en: What turns teenagers off science and technology?...

ext.ext_cn: 照本宣科枯燥乏味，无疑会使人们丧失学习兴趣。
ext.ext_en: Teaching off a blackboard is boring, and undoubtedly turns people off.

defs.def_en: See also:turn-off;If something turns you off a particular subject or activity, it makes you have no interest in it.

defs.def_cn: 使没有性欲；使失去性欲

ext.ext_cn: 咄咄逼人的男人让我完全没有欲望。
ext.ext_en: Aggressive men turn me off completely.

defs.def_en: See also:turn-off;If something or someone turns you off, you do not find them sexually attractive or they stop you feeling sexually excited.

defs.def_cn: （尤指为避免人们发现真相的）故弄玄虚，蒙昧主义，蒙骗政策

ext.ext_cn: 条文主义的故弄玄虚
ext.ext_en: ...legalistic obscurantism.

defs.def_en: Obscurantism is the practice or policy of deliberately making something vague and difficult to understand, especially in order to prevent people from finding out the truth.
A reformer is someone who tries to change and improve something such as a law or a social system.

defs.def_cn: 未经思考作出的；依靠本能作出的

ext.ext_cn: 对此类状况的第一反应会是要求所有医院都采取适当的安全措施。
ext.ext_en: The knee-jerk reaction to this is to call for proper security in all hospitals.

defs.def_en: If you call someone's response to a question or situation a knee-jerk reaction, you mean that they react in a very predictable way, without thinking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 显然，对警察可能会上门来访，他并没有表现得很不安。
ext.ext_en: He apparently was not perturbed by the prospect of a policeman coming to call...

ext.ext_cn: 她对前景十分担心。
ext.ext_en: She was really quite perturbed at the prospect.

defs.def_en: If someone is perturbed by something, they are worried by it.

ext.ext_cn: 他直言批评政府的不公正做法，招致当局震怒。
ext.ext_en: He incurred the wrath of the authorities in speaking out against government injustices.

defs.def_en: Wrath means the same as anger .
A breadbox is the same as a bread bin .
Day-Glo colours are shades of orange, pink, green, and yellow which are so bright that they seem to glow.

ext.ext_cn: 布伦达握紧椅子扶手时指关节都变白了。
ext.ext_en: Brenda's knuckles were white as she gripped the arms of the chair.

defs.def_en: Your knuckles are the rounded pieces of bone that form lumps on your hands where your fingers join your hands, and where your fingers bend.  a rap on the knuckles→see: rap;

defs.def_cn: (讲话)照稿子念的，照本宣科的

ext.ext_cn: 他已事先写好了答案。
ext.ext_en: He had prepared scripted answers.

defs.def_en: A scripted speech has been written in advance, although the speaker may pretend that it is spoken without preparation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He gave a great performance, but he was very humble...

ext.ext_cn: 安迪是个谦逊而且彬彬有礼的绅士。
ext.ext_en: Andy was a humble, courteous and gentle man.

defs.def_en: A humble person is not proud and does not believe that they are better than other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 斯皮罗斯·拉齐斯的第一份职业是爱琴海上一名地位卑贱的渔夫。
ext.ext_en: Spyros Latsis started his career as a humble fisherman in the Aegean...

ext.ext_cn: 他出生在一个地位相当低下的贫穷家庭。
ext.ext_en: He came from a fairly humble, poor background.

defs.def_en: People with low social status are sometimes described as humble.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 粗陋的;简陋的;不起眼的

ext.ext_cn: 专门做这些菜的餐馆既有毫不起眼的也有价格昂贵的。
ext.ext_en: There are restaurants, both humble and expensive, that specialize in them...

ext.ext_cn: 瓦恩德尔用一狭条普通的厨房用箔纸自制了反光板来拍摄这些照片。
ext.ext_en: Varndell made his own reflector for these shots from a strip of humble kitchen foil.

defs.def_en: A humble place or thing is ordinary and not special in any way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 依拙见，这可能是英国最好的牛排馆。
ext.ext_en: It is, in my humble opinion, perhaps the best steak restaurant in Great Britain.

defs.def_en: People use humble in a phrase such as in my humble opinion as a polite way of emphasizing what they think, even though they do not feel humble about it.

ext.ext_cn: 安森被迫认错并公开向她道歉。
ext.ext_en: Anson was forced to eat humble pie and publicly apologise to her.

defs.def_en: If you eat humble pie, you speak or behave in a way which tells people that you admit you were wrong about something.

ext.ext_cn: 本田在20世纪80年代作为一家轻易挫败行业巨头的小汽车公司而声名鹊起。
ext.ext_en: Honda won fame in the 1980s as the little car company that humbled the industry giants...

ext.ext_cn: 排名第三的巴尼特队以0–3的比分在克鲁遭遇惨败。
ext.ext_en: Third-placed Barnet were humbled 3-0 at Crewe.

defs.def_en: If you humble someone who is more important or powerful than you, you defeat them easily.

defs.def_cn: 使谦逊;使感到卑微;羞辱

ext.ext_cn: 特德的话让我感到自惭。
ext.ext_en: Ted's words humbled me...

ext.ext_cn: 我相信数百万观众看了这个故事后都会感到自己的渺小。
ext.ext_en: I am sure millions of viewers were humbled by this story.

defs.def_en: If something or someone humbles you, they make you realize that you are not as important or good as you thought you were.

defs.def_cn: (与名词连用构成形容词)表示“为…所苦的”，“为…所累的”，“充满…的”

ext.ext_cn: 拉丁美洲负债累累的经济
ext.ext_en: ...the debt-ridden economies of Latin America...

ext.ext_cn: 很多女人都像我一样，对孩子充满了内疚。
ext.ext_en: Too many women are like me, guilt ridden about the kids.

defs.def_en: -ridden combines with nouns to form adjectives that describe something as having a lot of a particular undesirable thing or quality, or suffering very much because of it.

In Britain, the Liberal Party was a political party which believed in limited controls on industry, the providing of welfare services, and more local government and individual freedom. Liberal Party is also used to refer to similar parties in some other countries.

ext.ext_cn: 由于以农业占绝对主导地位的国家变革速度缓慢
ext.ext_en: ...owing to the slow tempo of change in an overwhelmingly rural country...

ext.ext_cn: 两支球队的水平都很高，节奏和速度都很快。
ext.ext_en: Both teams played with a lot of quality, pace and tempo.

defs.def_en: The tempo of an event is the speed at which it happens.

ext.ext_cn: 在新唱片中，波士顿爱乐乐团尝试了全新的节奏。
ext.ext_en: In a new recording, the Boston Philharmonic tried the original tempo...

ext.ext_cn: 埃尔加给自己的作品标上了精确的节奏标记。
ext.ext_en: Elgar supplied his works with precise indications of tempo.

defs.def_en: The tempo of a piece of music is the speed at which it is played.

ext.ext_cn: 有配套耳环的琥珀短项链
ext.ext_en: ...an amber choker with matching earrings.

ext.ext_cn: 维多利亚时代的琥珀和纯银制雪茄烟嘴
ext.ext_en: ...a Victorian cigar holder of amber and sterling silver.

defs.def_en: Amber is a hard yellowish-brown substance used for making jewellery.

ext.ext_cn: 破云而出的阳光透过窗户送来一束琥珀色的光线。
ext.ext_en: A burst of sunshine sent a beam of amber light through the window...

ext.ext_cn: 他用力摇晃这个琥珀色的瓶子。
ext.ext_en: He shook the amber bottle vigorously.

defs.def_en: Amber is used to describe things that are yellowish-brown in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 交通灯变成橙黄色时，汽车没有停下来。
ext.ext_en: Cars did not stop when the lights were on amber.

defs.def_en: An amber traffic light is orange.

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲对着他鼻子打了一拳。
ext.ext_en: My father biffed him one on the nose.

defs.def_en: If you biff someone, you hit them with your fist.

ext.ext_cn: 在这个问题上措词模糊。
ext.ext_en: The phrasing of the question was vague.

ext.ext_cn: 需要措词严谨的写给教皇的信
ext.ext_en: ...a letter to the Pope, which necessitates careful phrasing.

defs.def_en: The phrasing of something that is said or written is the exact words that are chosen to express the ideas in it.

defs.def_cn: （演唱、演奏、表演等的）分句处理法

ext.ext_cn: 决定表演好坏的一些特征，如节奏的把握、语调的处理，等等
ext.ext_en: ...certain features that make a performance good or bad — the timing, the phrasing, and so on.

defs.def_en: The phrasing of someone who is singing, playing a piece of music, acting, or reading something aloud is the way in which they divide up the work by pausing slightly in appropriate places.
An aircraft's airspeed is the speed at which it travels through the air.
A spray gun is a piece of equipment which you use to spray paint under pressure onto a surface.

ext.ext_cn: 雨溅落在落地窗上。
ext.ext_en: The rain splattered against the french windows...

ext.ext_en: 'Sorry Edward,' I said, splattering the cloth with jam.

defs.def_en: If a thick wet substance splatters on something or is splattered on it, it drops or is thrown over it.
Ritalin is a drug that is used especially in the treatment of attention deficit disorder and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 老，大(置于人名之后，用以与家族中较年轻的同名成员相区别)

ext.ext_cn: 老罗伯特·特伦特·琼斯
ext.ext_en: ...Robert Trent Jones, Snr.

defs.def_en: Snr is the written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) Senior. It is used after someone's name to distinguish them from a younger member of their family who has the same name.

ext.ext_cn: 独立工党1893年1月13日在布拉德福德成立。
ext.ext_en: The Independent Labour Party was founded in Bradford on January 13, 1893...

ext.ext_cn: 他在加的夫大学学院成立了新闻学研究中心。
ext.ext_en: He founded the Centre for Journalism Studies at University College Cardiff...

defs.def_en: When an institution, company, or organization is founded by someone or by a group of people, they get it started, often by providing the necessary money.

ext.ext_cn: 这个镇建于 1610 年。
ext.ext_en: The town was founded in 1610.

defs.def_en: See also:founded;founding;When a town, important building, or other place is founded by someone or by a group of people, they cause it to be built.

ext.ext_cn: 克林顿选择阿尔·戈尔作为他的竞选伙伴
ext.ext_en: ...Clinton's selection of Al Gore as his running mate.

defs.def_en: In an election campaign, a candidate's running mate is the person that they have chosen to help them in the election. If the candidate wins, the running mate will become the second most important person after the winner.

defs.def_cn: (尤指工人或学生的)管理者，监督者，指导者

ext.ext_en: ...a full-time job as a supervisor at a factory...

defs.def_en: If you say that a particular feature is the beauty of something, you mean that this feature is what makes the thing so good.

ext.ext_en: Some couples see single women as a threat to their relationships...

ext.ext_cn: 飓风中心警告人们，不要对热带风暴的危险掉以轻心。
ext.ext_en: The Hurricane Center warns people not to take the threat of tropical storms lightly...

defs.def_en: A threat to a person or thing is a danger that something unpleasant might happen to them. A threat is also the cause of this danger.

ext.ext_cn: 他也许会被迫把自己的辞职威胁付诸行动。
ext.ext_en: He may be forced to carry out his threat to resign...

ext.ext_cn: 受到被驱逐下台的独裁政府官员的威胁后，那个牧师一直藏匿不出。
ext.ext_en: The priest remains in hiding after threats by former officials of the ousted dictatorship...

defs.def_en: A threat is a statement by someone that they will do something unpleasant, especially if you do not do what they want.

ext.ext_cn: 在定于下月举行的党代表大会上，他的领导地位将受到威胁。
ext.ext_en: His position as leader will be under threat at a party congress due next month...

ext.ext_cn: 她每天都生活在暴力威胁之下。
ext.ext_en: She lives daily under threat of violence...

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is under threat, there is a danger that something unpleasant might be done to them, or that they might cease to exist.

ext.ext_cn: 一家由他独资经营的律师事务所
ext.ext_en: ...a firm of solicitors of which he was the sole proprietor.

defs.def_en: The sole proprietor of a business is the owner of the business, when it is owned by only one person.

ext.ext_cn: 问题虽然问得有点怪，但玛丽·安并不觉得惊讶。
ext.ext_en: The question came out of left field, but Mary Ann wasn't really surprised...

ext.ext_cn: 一如大多数理论家般，他想法古怪，行事出人意表，竟对实验得来的证据置之不理。
ext.ext_en: He is, like most theorists, out there in left field, ignoring the experimental evidence.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has come out of left field or is out in left field, you mean that they are untypical, unusual, or strange in some way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有点怪的；有些不同寻常的

ext.ext_cn: 怪诞的夜总会歌舞表演
ext.ext_en: ...a left-field cabaret act...

ext.ext_cn: 波莉的父母想法新奇怪异，竟希望她做歌星或是货车司机。
ext.ext_en: Her parents were creative and left-field and wanted Polly to become a singer or a truck driver.

defs.def_en: Left-field means slightly odd or unusual.

defs.def_cn: 始终如一的；恒久不变的；一贯的

ext.ext_cn: 她始终拒绝公开露面
ext.ext_en: ...her unvarying refusal to make public appearances.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unvarying, you mean that it stays the same and never changes.

ext.ext_cn: 她对小儿子过于溺爱。
ext.ext_en: She coddled her youngest son madly...

ext.ext_cn: 狱警联盟一直谴责政府姑息犯人。
ext.ext_en: The warders' union has been denouncing the government for coddling prisoners.

defs.def_en: To coddle someone means to treat them too kindly or protect them too much.

ext.ext_cn: “你是尼克的朋友吗？”——“是的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Are you a friend of Nick's?' — 'Yes.'...

ext.ext_cn: “你的确把它写下来了，对吗？”——“是的。”
ext.ext_en: 'You actually wrote it down, didn't you?' — 'Yes.'...

defs.def_en: You use yes to give a positive response to a question.

defs.def_cn: （用于接受提议或请求，或表示许可）可以，好的

ext.ext_cn: “再来点酒？”——“好的。”
ext.ext_en: 'More wine?' — 'Yes please.'...

ext.ext_cn: “你可以带我去那儿吗？”——“可以。”
ext.ext_en: 'Will you take me there?' — 'Yes, I will.'...

defs.def_en: You use yes to accept an offer or request, or to give permission.

defs.def_cn: （用于告诉对方其所说的话正确）对，是的

ext.ext_cn: “噢，我想这是按照旧制阴历来算的，是吧？”——“对，是的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Well I suppose it is based on the old lunar months isn't it.' — 'Yes that's right.'...

ext.ext_cn: “那是一种粉虱，对吗？”——“是的，是粉虱。”
ext.ext_en: 'That's a type of whitefly, is it?' — 'Yes, it is a whitefly.'

defs.def_en: You use yes to tell someone that what they have said is correct.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示准备或愿意作出应答）什么事，来啦

ext.ext_cn: 他按了内部对讲机上的一个按钮。“有什么事吗？”一个声音问道。
ext.ext_en: He pushed a button on the intercom. 'Yes?' came a voice...

ext.ext_cn: 您好，我能为您效劳吗？
ext.ext_en: Yes, can I help you?

defs.def_en: You use yes to show that you are ready or willing to speak to the person who wants to speak to you, for example when you are answering a telephone or a knock at your door.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示同意、接受或理解前一讲话者的话）是这样，确实如此

ext.ext_cn: “很多人觉得戒烟真的非常困难。”——“确实如此，我以前每天抽将近60根香烟。”
ext.ext_en: 'A lot of people find it very difficult indeed to give up smoking.' —'Oh yes. I used to smoke nearly sixty a day.'...

ext.ext_cn: “这是一次非常棒的机会。”——“是，我知道。”
ext.ext_en: 'It's a fabulous opportunity.' — 'Yeah. I know.'

defs.def_en: You use yes to indicate that you agree with, accept, or understand what the previous speaker has said.

defs.def_cn: （用于鼓励某人继续讲）往下说，接着呢

ext.ext_cn: “我记得今天有件特别有趣的事。”——“什么事？”
ext.ext_en: 'I remembered something funny today.' — 'Yeah?'

defs.def_en: You use yes to encourage someone to continue speaking.

defs.def_cn: （常接but，用于礼貌地引出与前一讲话者意见不同的话）

ext.ext_cn: “她享有的个人所得免税额是3,000英镑。”——“是的，但是她一分钱都不挣。”
ext.ext_en: 'She is entitled to her personal allowance which is three thousand pounds of income.' — 'Yes, but she doesn't earn any money.'...

ext.ext_cn: 是这样，不过别忘了他们错过了多少天伦之乐。
ext.ext_en: Ah yes, but think of all the family life they're missing.

defs.def_en: You use yes, usually followed by 'but', as a polite way of introducing what you want to say when you disagree with something the previous speaker has just said.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示前一讲话者的否定陈述或问题是错误的）不是，不对

ext.ext_cn: “那不可能，”她说。“不，有可能！”格伦太太坚持道。
ext.ext_en: 'That is not possible,' she said. 'Oh, yes, it is!' Mrs Gruen insisted...

ext.ext_cn: “我不知道你在说什么。”——“不，你知道。”
ext.ext_en: 'I don't  know what you're talking about.' — 'Yes, you do.'

defs.def_en: You use yes to say that a negative statement or question that the previous speaker has made is wrong or untrue.

defs.def_cn: （用于暗示不赞成或不同意前面讲话者的话，尤用于表示厌烦）真的吗，行啦

ext.ext_cn: “没法阻止它。”——“是吗？哼，那这还有些别的事也是你没法阻止的。”
ext.ext_en: 'There was no way to stop it.' — 'Oh yes? Well, here's something else you won't be able to stop.'

defs.def_en: You can use yes to suggest that you do not believe or agree with what the previous speaker has said, especially when you want to express your annoyance about it.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示刚刚想起忘记的事情）对了

ext.ext_cn: 我刚想说什么来着。噢，对了，我们终于有了第二台电脑。
ext.ext_en: What was I going to say. Oh yeah, we've finally got our second computer.

defs.def_en: You use yes to indicate that you had forgotten something and have just remembered it.

defs.def_cn: （用于强调并确认自己的陈述）对，一点没错

ext.ext_cn: 他领取了1万英镑的头奖。对，是1万英镑。
ext.ext_en: He collected the £10,000 first prize. Yes, £10,000.

defs.def_en: You use yes to emphasize and confirm a statement that you are making.

ext.ext_cn: “那么长时间不在，然后又回来，你会觉得陌生吗？”——“既陌生又不陌生。”
ext.ext_en: 'Was it strange for you, going back after such a long absence?' — 'Yes and no.'

defs.def_en: You say yes and no in reply to a question when you cannot give a definite answer, because in some ways the answer is yes and in other ways the answer is no.

ext.ext_cn: 反对票领先于赞成票。
ext.ext_en: The no-votes are leading the yeses...

ext.ext_cn: 反对者占50%，赞成者占35%，其余人尚未决定。
ext.ext_en: The noes have 50 percent, the yeses 35 percent and the rest are undecided.

defs.def_en: A yes is a person who has answered 'yes' to a question or who has voted in favour of something, or the answer or vote they have made.
Polling day is the day on which people vote in an election.

ext.ext_cn: 他们会深深爱上法国的乡村。
ext.ext_en: They will be in raptures over the French countryside...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维斯深深喜欢上了那幅色彩绚丽的油画作品。
ext.ext_en: Davies goes into raptures over the brilliantly coloured paintwork...

defs.def_en: If you are in raptures or go into raptures about something, you are extremely impressed by it and enthusiastic about it.
High treason is a very serious crime which involves putting your country or its head of state in danger.

ext.ext_cn: 这个血检会显示你是否对这种疾病具有免疫力。
ext.ext_en: This blood test will show whether or not you're immune to the disease...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数成人对风疹具有免疫力。
ext.ext_en: Most adults are immune to Rubella.

defs.def_en: If you are immune to a particular disease, you cannot be affected by it.

ext.ext_cn: 希望这一治疗会激发免疫反应,清除感染了艾滋病病毒的细胞，同时又不损伤未感染细胞。
ext.ext_en: It is hoped the procedure will trigger an immune response that will wipe out HIV-infected cells while leaving non-infected cells unharmed.

defs.def_en: An immune response or reaction is a reaction by the body's immune system to something harmful that is affecting it.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管马克逐渐对贫困现象无动于衷,但他对于死亡的惨象还是不免动容。
ext.ext_en: Whilst Marc did gradually harden himself to the poverty, he did not become immune to the sight of death...

ext.ext_cn: 足球不可能不受到经济衰退的影响。
ext.ext_en: Football is not immune to economic recession.

defs.def_en: If you are immune to something that happens or is done, you are not affected by it.

ext.ext_cn: 德国联邦议院的成员可免受贪腐罪的起诉。
ext.ext_en: Members of the Bundestag are immune from prosecution for corruption...

ext.ext_cn: 谁都难免会有丑闻。
ext.ext_en: No one is immune from scandal.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is immune from a particular process or situation is able to escape it.
A Siamese cat is a type of cat with short cream and brown fur, blue eyes, dark ears, and a dark tail.

defs.def_cn: 全能的；多面的；多才多艺的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个出色的全能运动员。
ext.ext_en: He is a great all-round player.

defs.def_en: An all-round person is good at a lot of different skills, academic subjects, or sports.

ext.ext_cn: 他展示了一个枢纽前卫非常全面的技术。
ext.ext_en: He demonstrated the all-round skills of a quarterback.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你想要全方位最优质的生活
ext.ext_en: ...if you want the best all-round quality of life.

defs.def_en: All-round means doing or relating to all aspects of a job or activity.

ext.ext_cn: 还不能确定反叛者是否会投降。
ext.ext_en: It is arguable whether the rebels will knuckle under...

ext.ext_cn: 他说，美国不会屈从于他人的要求。
ext.ext_en: The United States, he said, did not knuckle under to demands.

defs.def_en: If you knuckle under, you do what someone else tells you to do or what a situation forces you to do, because you realize that you have no choice.

defs.def_cn: 红脖子，乡巴佬（尤指美国社会底层的乡下人，受教育程度较低，想法固执片面）

ext.ext_cn: 一个大块头的得克萨斯州红脖子正对阿里骂着脏话。
ext.ext_en: A large Texan redneck was shouting obscenities at Ali.

defs.def_en: If someone describes a white man, especially a lower class American from the countryside, as a redneck, they disapprove of him because they think he is uneducated and has strong, unreasonable opinions.

defs.def_cn: 电车轨道;(有轨)电车线路
defs.def_en: A tramway is a set of rails laid in the surface of a road for trams to travel along.
A diamond jubilee is the sixtieth anniversary of an important event.

ext.ext_cn: 一些小东西在帐篷四周的草丛里窸窸窣窣地动着。
ext.ext_en: Small things stirred in the grass around the tent...

ext.ext_cn: 草坪上生长着各种青草。
ext.ext_en: The lawn contained a mixture of grasses.

defs.def_en: Grass is a very common plant consisting of large numbers of thin, spiky, green leaves that cover the surface of the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 过去，踩踏草坪或旷课都会被重金处罚。
ext.ext_en: In the old days, there were strict fines for walking on the grass or missing a study period...

ext.ext_cn: 我要去修剪草坪了。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to cut the grass.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the grass, you are referring to an area of ground that is covered with grass, for example in your garden.

ext.ext_cn: 我大约16岁的时候开始吸大麻。
ext.ext_en: I started smoking grass when I was about sixteen.

defs.def_en: Grass is the same as marijuana .

ext.ext_cn: 妻子要他向警方告发他所在团伙的成员。
ext.ext_en: His wife wants him to grass on the members of his own gang...

ext.ext_cn: 他屡遭指责他告密的其他囚犯的殴打。
ext.ext_en: He was repeatedly attacked by other inmates, who accused him of grassing.

defs.def_en: If you say that one person grasses on another, the first person tells the police or other authorities about something criminal or wrong which the second person has done.
A grass is someone who tells the police or other authorities about criminal activities that they know about.

defs.def_cn: 草是那边绿；这山望着那山高

ext.ext_cn: 他对我们感到十分满意，但还想看看是否有更合适的人选。
ext.ext_en: He was very happy with us but wanted to see if the grass was greener elsewhere.

defs.def_en: If you say the grass is greener somewhere else, you mean that other people's situations always seem better or more attractive than your own, but may not really be so.

ext.ext_cn: 首相拒绝被解除职务，当问到他是否会辞职时，他说，“我的回答是不。”
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister refused to be put out to grass. Asked if he would quit, he replied: 'The answer is No'.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is being put out to grass, you mean they are no longer being employed because they are considered to be too old or no longer useful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉昏昏欲睡，只好尽量克制睡意。
ext.ext_en: He felt pleasantly drowsy and had to fight off the urge to sleep.

defs.def_en: If you feel drowsy, you feel sleepy and cannot think clearly.

defs.def_cn: 做事杂乱无章;东一榔头西一棒子;瞎忙活

ext.ext_cn: 需要直言相答时，看他们东拉西扯，真让人恼火。
ext.ext_en: It was annoying to watch them faffing around when a more direct response was required.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is faffing about or faffing around, you mean that they are doing things in a disorganized way and not achieving very much.

ext.ext_cn: 那些宇航员正在进行一系列实验，以更多地了解身体如何适应失重状态。
ext.ext_en: The astronauts are conducting a series of experiments to learn more about how the body adapts to weightlessness...

ext.ext_cn: 有关动物实验的最新法规提案
ext.ext_en: ...a proposed new law on animal experiments...

defs.def_en: An experiment is a scientific test which is done in order to discover what happens to something in particular conditions.

ext.ext_cn: 1857年，孟德尔开始在修道院的菜园里用豌豆做实验。
ext.ext_en: In 1857 Mendel started experimenting with peas in his monastery garden...

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们已经在老鼠细小的颈动脉上做了实验。
ext.ext_en: The scientists have experimented on the tiny neck arteries of rats...

defs.def_en: If you experiment with something or experiment on it, you do a scientific test on it in order to discover what happens to it in particular conditions.

ext.ext_cn: 我们试着给特德买了一块手表。
ext.ext_en: As an experiment, we bought Ted a watch.

ext.ext_cn: 该国5年来对民主的尝试
ext.ext_en: ...the country's five year experiment in democracy...

defs.def_en: An experiment is the trying out of a new idea or method in order to see what it is like and what effects it has.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你喜欢烹饪而且有时间尝试的话
ext.ext_en: ...if you like cooking and have the time to experiment...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为应该鼓励学生们将大胆的观念付诸试验。
ext.ext_en: He believes that students should be encouraged to experiment with bold ideas.

defs.def_en: To experiment means to try out a new idea or method to see what it is like and what effects it has.

ext.ext_cn: M1 高速公路
ext.ext_en: ...the M1 motorway.

ext.ext_cn: 全国高速公路网
ext.ext_en: ...the national motorway network.

defs.def_en: A motorway is a major road that has been specially built for fast travel over long distances. Motorways have several lanes and special places where traffic gets on and leaves.

ext.ext_cn: 他说他想“同印度人民建立友好关系”。
ext.ext_en: He said he wanted 'to establish a rapport with the Indian people'...

ext.ext_cn: 成功取决于采访者与被采访者之间的良好沟通。
ext.ext_en: The success depends on good rapport between interviewer and interviewee...

defs.def_en: If two people or groups have a rapport, they have a good relationship in which they are able to understand each other's ideas or feelings very well.

ext.ext_cn: 所有绿色和平组织人士表现出了超乎寻常的克制和大度。
ext.ext_en: All the Greenpeace people behaved with impressive forbearance and dignity.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has shown forbearance, you admire them for behaving in a calm and sensible way about something that they have a right to be very upset or angry about.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 要是能找到足够便宜的地方，我就不在校园里住了。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to live off campus if I can find somewhere cheap enough...

ext.ext_cn: 烟雾报警器既不贵又易于安装。
ext.ext_en: Smoke detectors are cheap and easy to put up...

defs.def_en: Goods or services that are cheap cost less money than usual or than you expected.

ext.ext_cn: 别买廉价的仿冒品，攒点钱买正品吧。
ext.ext_en: Don't resort to cheap copies; save up for the real thing.

ext.ext_cn: 用廉价面料做的紧身套装
ext.ext_en: ...a tight suit made of some cheap material.

defs.def_en: If you describe goods as cheap, you mean they cost less money than similar products but their quality is poor.

ext.ext_cn: 把儿童当廉价劳动力使用的黑心雇主
ext.ext_en: ...unscrupulous employers who treat children as a cheap source of labour.

defs.def_en: If you describe the cost of someone's work as cheap, you disapprove of the way people are taking advantage of a situation to pay someone less than they should for the work that they do.

defs.def_cn: (言行)讨便宜的，刻薄的，不怀好意的

ext.ext_cn: 这些测试必然会被政客们不失时机地拿去大做政治文章。
ext.ext_en: These tests will inevitably be used by politicians to make cheap political points.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's remarks or actions as cheap, you mean that they are unkindly or insincerely using a situation to benefit themselves or to harm someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 哦，求求你，爸爸，就这一回，别抠门儿了。
ext.ext_en: Oh, please, Dad, just this once don't be cheap.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as cheap, you are criticizing them for being unwilling to spend money.

defs.def_cn: 人命不值钱;人命如草芥

ext.ext_cn: 我们最终将生活在一个视人命为儿戏的社会。
ext.ext_en: We will end up living in a society where life is cheap.

defs.def_en: You use life is cheap or life has become cheap to refer to a situation in which nobody cares that large numbers of people are dying.

ext.ext_cn: 现在的房子大多质量差劲透顶，肯定都是偷工减料盖起来的。
ext.ext_en: Most modern housing estates are terrible and inevitably done on the cheap.

defs.def_en: If someone does or buys something on the cheap, they spend less money than they should because they are more concerned with what it costs than with its quality.
Your instep is the middle part of your foot, where it arches upwards.

ext.ext_cn: 他坚持认为这些照片并非艺术，而是色情。
ext.ext_en: He insisted these photographs were not art but obscenity...

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯·乔伊斯以“淫秽”是生活的正常部分为由为自己运用“淫秽”进行辩解。
ext.ext_en: James Joyce justified his use of 'obscenity' on the grounds that it was a natural part of life.

defs.def_en: Obscenity is behaviour, art, or language that is sexual and offends or shocks people.

ext.ext_cn: 他们冲着我们大骂下流话，还把瓶子摔到地上。
ext.ext_en: They shouted obscenities at us and smashed bottles on the floor.

defs.def_en: An obscenity is a very offensive word or expression.

defs.def_cn: 令人憎恶的行为（或事件);道德败坏的行为（或事件）

ext.ext_cn: 饱经内战蹂躏的不止这一个地方。
ext.ext_en: It is not the only place experiencing the obscenities of civil war.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an action or event as an obscenity, you disapprove of it very strongly and consider it to be offensive or immoral.

ext.ext_cn: 我们有向议会报告的法定义务。
ext.ext_en: We had a statutory duty to report to Parliament.

defs.def_en: Statutory means relating to rules or laws which have been formally written down.

defs.def_cn: (非法入境人员等的)拘留营，收容所
defs.def_en: A detention centre is a sort of prison, for example a place where people who have entered a country illegally are kept while a decision is made about what to do with them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...a discerning palate.

defs.def_en: In professional sports, if a player transfers or is transferred from one club to another, they leave one club and begin playing for another.

ext.ext_cn: 我被调到图书部。
ext.ext_en: I was transferred to the book department...

ext.ext_cn: 我猜想她要被调走了。
ext.ext_en: I suspect that she is going to be transferred...

defs.def_en: If you are transferred, or if you transfer ,to a different job or place, you move to a different job or start working in a different place.

ext.ext_cn: 这种信息很容易转存到缩微胶卷上。
ext.ext_en: Such information is easily transferred onto microfilm.

ext.ext_cn: 创造胶片级电脑画质并将之转录到胶片的系统
ext.ext_en: ...systems to create film-quality computer effects and then transfer them to film.

defs.def_en: When information is transferred onto a different medium, it is copied from one medium to another.

ext.ext_cn: 他已把大部分作品的所有权转让给一家英国基金会。
ext.ext_en: He has already transferred ownership of most of the works to a British foundation...

ext.ext_cn: 死亡时某些财产会自动转让。
ext.ext_en: Certain kinds of property are transferred automatically at death.

defs.def_en: When property or land is transferred, it stops being owned by one person or institution and becomes owned by another.

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢在华兹区第 103 大街下公交车转乘地铁蓝线。
ext.ext_en: He likes to transfer from the bus to the Blue Line at 103rd Street in Watts...

ext.ext_cn: 1,654 名乘客在海上转搭了一艘挪威游轮。
ext.ext_en: 1,654 passengers were transferred at sea to a Norwegian cruise ship.

defs.def_en: If you transfer or are transferred when you are on a journey, you change from one vehicle to another.

defs.def_cn: 转印纸(纸上面印有图案，可通过加热或压力转印至其他材料上)

ext.ext_cn: 金字转印纸
ext.ext_en: ...gold letter transfers.

defs.def_en: Transfers are pieces of paper with a design on one side. The design can be transferred by heat or pressure onto material, paper, or china for decoration.
A transfer is a ticket that you get when you leave a bus or train that allows you to go on a different bus or train without paying again.

ext.ext_cn: 使燃料在发动机内循环的泵
ext.ext_en: ...pumps that circulate the fuel around in the engine...

ext.ext_cn: 楼里没有水，只是在庭院里有个水泵。
ext.ext_en: There was no water in the building, just a pump in the courtyard...

defs.def_en: A pump is a machine or device that is used to force a liquid or gas to flow in a particular direction.

ext.ext_cn: 将未经处理的污水排入海中了事是不够的。
ext.ext_en: It's not enough to get rid of raw sewage by pumping it out to sea...

ext.ext_cn: 所筹资金将用于钻孔打水以抽水到干涸的湖中。
ext.ext_en: The money raised will be used to dig bore holes to pump water into the dried-up lake.

defs.def_en: To pump a liquid or gas in a particular direction means to force it to flow in that direction using a pump.

ext.ext_cn: 加油泵边车辆已经排起了长队。
ext.ext_en: There are already long queues of vehicles at petrol pumps.

ext.ext_cn: 汽油加油泵
ext.ext_en: ...gas pumps.

defs.def_en: A petrol or gas pump is a machine with a tube attached to it that you use to fill a car with petrol.

ext.ext_cn: 洗胃之后，她昨天出了院。
ext.ext_en: She was released from hospital yesterday after having her stomach pumped.

defs.def_en: If someone has their stomach pumped, doctors remove the contents of their stomach, for example because they have swallowed poison or drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 政府需要将更多资金投入到社区护理这一块。
ext.ext_en: The Government needs to pump more money into community care.

defs.def_en: If you pump money or other resources into something such as a project or an industry, you invest a lot of money or resources in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他每隔五分钟就跑来追问我这件事。
ext.ext_en: He ran in every five minutes to pump me about the case...

ext.ext_cn: 他肯定追问过珍妮详细的情况。
ext.ext_en: He must have pumped Janey for details...

defs.def_en: If you pump someone about something, you keep asking them questions in order to get information.

ext.ext_cn: 一个持枪歹徒闯进来，朝她的脑袋连射5枪。
ext.ext_en: A gunman burst in and pumped five bullets into her head.

defs.def_en: To pump bullets into someone means to fire a lot of bullets into them very quickly.

defs.def_cn: （运动或休闲时穿的）橡胶底帆布鞋
defs.def_en: Pumps are canvas shoes with flat rubber soles which people wear for sports and leisure.
Pumps are women's shoes that do not cover the top part of the foot and are usually made of plain leather.

ext.ext_cn: 用税收收入来刺激该国经济发展
ext.ext_en: ...the use of tax money to prime the pump of the state's economy.

defs.def_en: To prime the pump means to do something to encourage the success or growth of something, especially the economy.

ext.ext_cn: 他站在那儿均匀地深呼吸。
ext.ext_en: He stood there breathing deeply and evenly...

ext.ext_cn: 要一直用鼻子呼吸。
ext.ext_en: Always breathe through your nose...

defs.def_en: When people or animals breathe, they take air into their lungs and let it out again. When they breathe smoke or a particular kind of air, they take it into their lungs and let it out again as they breathe.

ext.ext_cn: “你不明白。”他低声说道。
ext.ext_en: 'You don't  understand,' he breathed.

defs.def_en: If someone breathes something, they say it very quietly.

ext.ext_cn: 关于我们的谈话他只字未提。
ext.ext_en: He never breathed a word about our conversation.

defs.def_en: If you do not breathe a word about something, you say nothing about it, because it is a secret.

defs.def_cn: 将（生气、信心或兴奋）注入；为…带来

ext.ext_cn: 是读者通过来信给报纸带来了生气。
ext.ext_en: It is the readers who breathe life into a newspaper with their letters.

defs.def_en: If someone breathes life, confidence, or excitement into something, they improve it by adding this quality.

ext.ext_cn: 如果可能的话，在饮用红酒前应该先开瓶透透气。
ext.ext_en: Red wines should be allowed to 'breathe' if possible before drinking.

defs.def_en: If you let wine breathe, you open the bottle to allow the air to get in and improve its flavour before you drink it.
When someone breathes their last, they die.
A houseman is a doctor who has a junior post in a hospital and usually sleeps there.
A houseman is a man who is a servant in a house.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人遗憾的;可惜的;令人惋惜的

ext.ext_cn: 对军方称之为令人遗憾的事件的调查
ext.ext_en: ...an investigation into what the army described as a regrettable incident...

ext.ext_cn: 遗憾的是罢工领导人似乎决意要破坏节日的气氛。
ext.ext_en: It is regrettable that strike leaders seem intent on spoiling holidays.

defs.def_en: You describe something as regrettable when you think that it is bad and that it should not happen or have happened.
A dogfight is a fight between fighter planes, in which they fly close to one another and move very fast.

ext.ext_cn: 三名领先的竞争者陷入一场鏖战。
ext.ext_en: The three leading contenders were locked in a dogfight.

defs.def_en: If you say that organizations or people are involved in a dogfight, you mean they are struggling very hard against each other in order to succeed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 独特的;特别的;有特色的

ext.ext_cn: 氯气特有的气味
ext.ext_en: ...the distinctive odour of chlorine.

ext.ext_cn: 特殊的蓝黄旗
ext.ext_en: ...a distinctive blue and yellow flag...

defs.def_en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

ext.ext_cn: 这座建筑之前的业主将其从破败不堪的状况中挽救了出来。
ext.ext_en: The previous owners had rescued the building from dereliction.

defs.def_en: If a building or a piece of land is in a state of dereliction, it is deserted or abandoned.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无精打采的；懒洋洋的；倦怠的

ext.ext_cn: 看到一个熟悉的高大身影沿着俱乐部的台阶无精打采地走下来，他高兴极了。
ext.ext_en: To his delight a familiar, tall, languid figure lowered itself down the steps of a club.

ext.ext_cn: 来琼比湾消磨时光，动静皆宜，尽可随心所欲。
ext.ext_en: Time spent at Jumby Bay can be as energetic or as languid as you wish.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as languid, you mean that they show little energy or interest and are very slow and casual in their movements.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 安静的;庄重的;不苟言笑的;平淡无奇的

ext.ext_cn: 她带他们去拜访她那些不苟言笑的表兄表姐们。
ext.ext_en: She took them to visit her sedate, elderly cousins...

ext.ext_cn: 她在伦敦的生活平淡无奇，几乎有些枯燥。
ext.ext_en: Her London life was sedate, almost mundane...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as sedate, you mean that they are quiet and rather dignified, though perhaps a bit dull.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不慌不忙的;慢悠悠的;从容的

ext.ext_cn: 我们重新上路了，步调更加从容。
ext.ext_en: We set off again at a more sedate pace.

ext.ext_cn: 一辆性能稳定但行驶缓慢的重型汽车
ext.ext_en: ...a heavy car with solid but sedate performance.

defs.def_en: If you move along at a sedate pace, you move slowly, in a controlled way.

ext.ext_cn: 静脉注射了镇静剂后病人安然入睡。
ext.ext_en: The patient is sedated with intravenous use of sedative drugs...

ext.ext_cn: 医生们已被告知不要给儿童使用麻醉剂，因为它可能与5起死亡病例有关。
ext.ext_en: Doctors have been told not to sedate children with an anaesthetic that may be linked to five deaths.

defs.def_en: If someone is sedated, they are given a drug to calm them or to make them sleep.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 爱好和平的；以和平为目的的

ext.ext_cn: 传统上，自由党人被认为更加爱好和平。
ext.ext_en: The Liberals were traditionally seen as the more pacific party.

defs.def_en: A pacific person, country, or course of action is peaceful or has the aim of bringing about peace.
Catholics and other Christians sometimes call Mary, the mother of Jesus Christ, the Madonna .

ext.ext_cn: 天主教会已经颁布了其教义纲要。
ext.ext_en: The Roman Catholic Church has issued a compendium of its teachings.

defs.def_en: A compendium is a short but detailed collection of information, usually in a book.

ext.ext_cn: 荷兰画家凡·高逝世一百周年纪念
ext.ext_en: ...the centenary of the death of the Dutch painter, Vincent Van Gogh.

defs.def_en: The centenary of an event such as someone's birth is the 100th anniversary of that event.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是个 60 岁出头、身材矮小结实的女人。
ext.ext_en: She was a short, sturdy woman in her early sixties...

ext.ext_cn: 相机固定在一个坚固的三脚架上。
ext.ext_en: The camera was mounted on a sturdy tripod.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is sturdy looks strong and is unlikely to be easily injured or damaged.

ext.ext_cn: 博洛尼亚市
ext.ext_en: ...the city of Bologna.

ext.ext_cn: 繁忙的市中心
ext.ext_en: ...a busy city centre.

defs.def_en: A city is a large town.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 基本计算机技能
ext.ext_en: ...elementary computer skills.

defs.def_en: Something that is elementary is very simple and basic.

ext.ext_cn: 初次见面时，我就非常佩服她，时至今日我仍然认为她很出色。
ext.ext_en: I admired her when I first met her and I still think she's marvellous...

ext.ext_cn: 他欣赏她处世的方式。
ext.ext_en: He admired the way she had coped with life...

defs.def_en: If you admire someone or something, you like and respect them very much.

ext.ext_cn: 我们特意驻足欣赏风景。
ext.ext_en: We took time to stop and admire the view.

defs.def_en: If you admire someone or something, you look at them with pleasure.

defs.def_cn: （药物等的）过量；致死（或中毒）剂量

ext.ext_cn: 每年，每100名15至19岁的少女中就有1位嗑药过量。
ext.ext_en: Each year, one in 100 girls aged 15-19 takes an overdose...

ext.ext_cn: 1970年，吉他手吉米·亨德里克斯因服药过量而死亡。
ext.ext_en: In 1970, guitarist Jimi Hendrix died of a drug overdose.

defs.def_en: If someone takes an overdose of a drug, they take more of it than is safe.

defs.def_cn: 过量服用（药物）；过量吸食（毒品）

ext.ext_cn: 他曾过量吸食海洛因。
ext.ext_en: He'd overdosed on heroin...

ext.ext_cn: 医生对于服用多少药片算作过量意见不一。
ext.ext_en: Medical opinion varies on how many tablets it takes to overdose.

defs.def_en: If someone overdoses on a drug, they take more of it than is safe.

ext.ext_cn: 过量接触阳光、海水、沙粒和氯气会使浅色头发略呈绿色。
ext.ext_en: An overdose of sun, sea, sand and chlorine can give lighter hair a green tinge.

defs.def_en: You can refer to too much of something, especially something harmful, as an overdose.

ext.ext_cn: 他的结论是这座城市过分重视规划设计了。
ext.ext_en: The city, he concluded, had overdosed on design.

ext.ext_cn: 纵情享受鹅肉、鸭肉、阿马尼亚克酒等当地美食的游客
ext.ext_en: ...tourists that tend to overdose on the regional specialities of goose, duck and Armagnac.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone overdoses on something if they have or do too much of it.

defs.def_cn: 阿尔及利亚的；阿尔及利亚人的；阿尔及利亚文化的

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔及利亚沙漠
ext.ext_en: ...the Algerian desert.

ext.ext_cn: 一位年轻的阿尔及利亚演员
ext.ext_en: ...a young Algerian actor.

defs.def_en: Algerian means belonging or relating to Algeria, or its people or culture.

defs.def_cn: 阿尔及利亚人；阿尔及利亚裔人
defs.def_en: An Algerian is an Algerian citizen or a person of Algerian origin.

defs.def_cn: (医院、高校、商场等的)自助餐厅,食堂
defs.def_en: A cafeteria is a restaurant where you choose your food from a counter and take it to your table after paying for it. Cafeterias are usually found in public buildings such as hospitals, colleges, and stores.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在战争中)俘虏，擒获，占领，夺取

ext.ext_cn: 游击队击落了一架飞机,并俘获了飞行员。
ext.ext_en: The guerrillas shot down one aeroplane and captured the pilot...

ext.ext_cn: 全城居民庆祝缴获了两辆坦克。
ext.ext_en: The whole town celebrated when two tanks were captured...

defs.def_en: If you capture someone or something, you catch them, especially in a war.

defs.def_cn: 代表（特点);表现,体现(感情、气氛)

ext.ext_cn: 厨师伊德里斯·卡尔多拉开出一份富有地中海特色的菜单，让人眼前一亮。
ext.ext_en: Chef Idris Caldora offers an inspired menu that captures the spirit of the Mediterranean...

ext.ext_cn: 一个人的话道出了他们的心情，“这儿的学生既不了解也不关心校园问题。”
ext.ext_en: Their mood was captured by one who said, 'Students here don't know or care about campus issues.'

defs.def_en: If something or someone captures a particular quality, feeling, or atmosphere, they represent or express it successfully.

defs.def_cn: 吸引(注意力);激发(想象);赢得(喜爱)

ext.ext_cn: 往往会引起历史学家关注的保守党大人物
ext.ext_en: ...the great names of the Tory party who usually capture the historian's attention.

ext.ext_cn: 激发了几乎所有国人想象力的争论
ext.ext_en: ...the issue that has captured the imagination of nearly the whole nation.

defs.def_en: If something captures your attention or imagination, you begin to be interested or excited by it. If someone or something captures your heart, you begin to love them or like them very much.

ext.ext_cn: 事件被拍成了录像。
ext.ext_en: The incident was captured on videotape...

ext.ext_cn: 这些影像是电视剧组人员在外景地拍摄的。
ext.ext_en: The images were captured by TV crews filming outside the base.

defs.def_en: If an event is captured in a photograph or on film, it is photographed or filmed.

ext.ext_cn: 1987年,麦当劳占据了整个快餐业销售额的19%。
ext.ext_en: In 1987, McDonald's captured 19 percent of all fast-food sales...

ext.ext_cn: 社会党候选人在这场三人角逐的总统竞选中已经获得85%的选票。
ext.ext_en: The Socialist candidate has captured eighty-five per cent of the vote in the three-way presidential race.

defs.def_en: If you capture something that you are trying to obtain in competition with other people, you succeed in obtaining it.

defs.def_cn: （与专业头衔连用）荣誉退休的

ext.ext_cn: 荣誉退休的物理学教授
ext.ext_en: ...emeritus professor of physics...

ext.ext_cn: 他将继续担任荣誉主席。
ext.ext_en: He will continue as chairman emeritus.

defs.def_en: Emeritus is used with a professional title to indicate that the person bearing it has retired but keeps the title as an honour.
A jump jet is a jet aircraft that can take off and land vertically.

ext.ext_cn: 新的客人接踵而来。
ext.ext_en: Fresh groups of guests arrived...

ext.ext_cn: 几个通勤者等候的列车按时到达了
ext.ext_en: ...a small group of commuters waiting for their train, which arrived on time...

defs.def_en: When a person or vehicle arrives at a place, they come to it at the end of a journey.

ext.ext_cn: 在欧洲殖民者来到这个国家之前的旧日时光
ext.ext_en: ...in the old days before the European settlers arrived in the country.

ext.ext_cn: 从新西兰初次来到英格兰的年轻学生
ext.ext_en: ...a young student newly arrived in England from New Zealand.

defs.def_en: When you arrive at a place, you come to it for the first time in order to stay, live, or work there.

ext.ext_cn: 截止日期之后报名参赛的人将不予考虑。
ext.ext_en: Any entry arriving after the closing date will not be considered...

ext.ext_cn: 早餐送来的时候他还在浴室里。
ext.ext_en: Breakfast arrived while he was in the bathroom.

defs.def_en: When something such as letter or meal arrives, it is brought or delivered to you.

defs.def_cn: （新产品或发明）出现，到来，问世

ext.ext_cn: 几部让人翘首企盼的录像片终于将在这个月到货。
ext.ext_en: Several long-awaited videos will finally arrive in the shops this month...

ext.ext_cn: 他们随时准备迎接新技术的问世。
ext.ext_en: They'll be ready to embrace the new technology when it arrives.

defs.def_en: When something such as a new product or invention arrives, it becomes available.

defs.def_cn: （尤指经过等待或期盼后）来临，到来

ext.ext_cn: 我戒烟的时机已到。
ext.ext_en: The time has arrived when I need to give up smoking.

ext.ext_cn: 认为军队在冬季来临之前将会向前大举推进的看法
ext.ext_en: ...the belief that the army would be much further forward before winter arrived.

defs.def_en: When a particular moment or event arrives, it happens, especially after you have been waiting for it or expecting it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果陪审团不能作出一致判决
ext.ext_en: ...if the jury cannot arrive at a unanimous decision...

ext.ext_cn: 这些数字是根据1991至1992年间的牙医收据统计得出的。
ext.ext_en: These figures are arrived at on the basis of dentists' receipts for 1991-1992.

defs.def_en: When you arrive at something such as a decision, you decide something after thinking about it or discussing it.

ext.ext_cn: 你的孩子不大可能在你到达医院之前就出生。
ext.ext_en: It's very unlikely that your baby will arrive before you get to hospital.

defs.def_en: When a baby arrives, it is born.

ext.ext_cn: 这样的车可以显示你已功成名就，并且一路顺风顺水。
ext.ext_en: These are cars which show you've arrived and had a good time along the way.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has arrived, you mean that they have become successful or famous.
Self-determination is the right of a country to be independent, instead of being controlled by a foreign country, and to choose its own form of government.
Arteriosclerosis is a medical condition in which the walls of your arteries become hard and thick, so your blood cannot flow through them properly.
A watering can is a container with a long spout which is used to water plants.

ext.ext_cn: 银行不得不花钱买下过去200名合伙人手中的大部分股权。
ext.ext_en: The bank had to pay to buy out most of the 200 former partners...

ext.ext_cn: 他花1,700万美元买下了他哥哥的全部股份。
ext.ext_en: He bought his brother out for $17 million.

defs.def_en: See also:buyout;If you buy someone out, you buy their share of something such as a company or piece of property that you previously owned together.

defs.def_cn: 花钱使…离开（如提前退役)

ext.ext_cn: 卡林最终还是花钱提前退役了。
ext.ext_en: Carling eventually bought himself out of the army.

defs.def_en: If you buy someone out of the armed forces or another organization, you pay a sum of money so that they can leave before the end of the period they agreed to stay for.

defs.def_cn: (别人生病或不在时的)临时替代者，顶替者

ext.ext_cn: 他临时代替平常给我看病的那位医生。
ext.ext_en: He was a stand-in for my regular doctor.

defs.def_en: A stand-in is a person who takes someone else's place or does someone else's job for a while, for example because the other person is ill or away.

ext.ext_cn: 我们等爸爸妈妈回家。
ext.ext_en: We waited for Mom and Dad to get home...

ext.ext_cn: 妈妈，能告诉我怎么做吗？
