defs.def_en: When creatures such as insects or rats infest plants or a place, they are present in large numbers and cause damage.

ext.ext_cn: 市中心充斥着犯罪与毒品。
ext.ext_en: Crime and drugs are infesting the inner cities.

defs.def_en: If you say that people or things you disapprove of or regard as dangerous are infesting a place, you mean that there are large numbers of them in that place.

defs.def_cn: （人体内、尤指鼻内生长的）息肉

ext.ext_cn: 良性息肉转为恶性要经过10年或更长的时间。
ext.ext_en: It takes ten years or more for a benign polyp to turn malignant.

defs.def_en: A polyp is a small unhealthy growth on a surface inside your body, especially inside your nose.
A polyp is a small animal that lives in the sea. It has a hollow body like a tube and long parts called tentacles around its mouth.
A neutron star is a star that has collapsed under the weight of its own gravity.

ext.ext_cn: 据信华盛顿和莫斯科在克什米尔问题上的看法相似。
ext.ext_en: Washington and Moscow are believed to have similar views on Kashmir...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为应该尽快阻止她。
ext.ext_en: I take the view that she should be stopped as soon as possible...

defs.def_en: Your views on something are the beliefs or opinions that you have about it, for example whether you think it is good, bad, right, or wrong.

defs.def_cn: （对某一问题的）看法，考虑，思量

ext.ext_cn: 这部戏在对待这一主题上有些理想化，甚至是天真。
ext.ext_en: The drama takes an idealistic, even a naive view of the subject...

ext.ext_cn: 其主旨就是要抛开以基督教为中心的宗教观。
ext.ext_en: The whole point was to get away from a Christian-centred view of religion...

defs.def_en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

ext.ext_cn: 第一代美国人认为美国是一个充满了机遇的国度。
ext.ext_en: First-generation Americans view the United States as a land of golden opportunity...

ext.ext_cn: 阿比盖尔的母亲琳达带着一种又骄傲又担忧的复杂情绪看待女儿的才华。
ext.ext_en: Abigail's mother Linda views her daughter's talent with a mixture of pride and worry...

defs.def_en: If you view something in a particular way, you think of it in that way.

defs.def_cn: 景观;景色;风景;(尤指）美景

ext.ext_cn: 从我们的窗口能看见一片美丽的绿色田园风光。
ext.ext_en: The view from our window was one of beautiful green countryside...

ext.ext_cn: 每个房间都能将皮苏里湾的美景尽收眼底。
ext.ext_en: Each of the rooms has a superb view of Pissouri Bay.

defs.def_en: The view from a window or high place is everything which can be seen from that place, especially when it is considered to be beautiful.

ext.ext_cn: 为了更清楚地看到黑板上的内容，他站了起来。
ext.ext_en: He stood up to get a better view of the blackboard...

ext.ext_cn: 他站在门口，挡住了她的视线。
ext.ext_en: He stopped in the doorway, blocking her view.

defs.def_en: If you have a view of something, you can see it.

defs.def_cn: 在能看得见的地方/在（所有人）视线内

ext.ext_cn: 她躺在那里，过往的人都能看见她。
ext.ext_en: She was lying there in full view of anyone who walked by...

ext.ext_cn: 一群骑车的人出现在那条土路上。
ext.ext_en: A group of riders came into view on the dirt road...

defs.def_en: You use view in expressions to do with being able to see something. For example, if something is in view, you can see it. If something is in full view of everyone, everyone can see it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们又回来查看了一遍房子。
ext.ext_en: They came back to view the house again...

ext.ext_cn: 2.5万名送葬者前来瞻仰死者遗容。
ext.ext_en: Twenty-five thousand mourners passed to view the body.

defs.def_en: If you view something, you look at it for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 我们看过了该事件的录像。
ext.ext_en: We have viewed the video recording of the incident...

ext.ext_cn: 关于女王的电视专题片《伊丽莎白女王》创下了收视纪录。
ext.ext_en: 'Elizabeth R', a TV portrait of the Queen, had record viewing figures.

defs.def_en: If you view a television programme, video, or film, you watch it.

defs.def_cn: （文本或图表在计算机屏幕上的）显示方式

ext.ext_cn: 要完整显示当前文件，请按“全屏显示”按钮。PRHASES
ext.ext_en: To see the current document in full-page view, click the Page Zoom Full button.

defs.def_en: View refers to the way in which a piece of text or graphics is displayed on a computer screen.

defs.def_cn: 对…评价不高;对…持否定看法

ext.ext_cn: 他们对当地的工会会员们评价很低。
ext.ext_en: They took a dim view of local trade unionists...

ext.ext_cn: 法官对此并不赞成，我因此蹲了6年的监狱。
ext.ext_en: The judge took a dim view and I spent six years in prison.

defs.def_en: If you take a dim view or a poor view of someone or something, you disapprove of them or have a low opinion of them.

ext.ext_cn: 依我看，事情不会改变。
ext.ext_en: In my view things won't change...

ext.ext_cn: 在我看来，有一个简单的解释。
ext.ext_en: There is, in my view, a simple explanation...

defs.def_en: You use in my view when you want to indicate that you are stating a personal opinion, which other people might not agree with.

ext.ext_cn: 考虑到霍布森不是科班出身的经济学家，他可谓是成就非凡。
ext.ext_en: In view of the fact that Hobson was not a trained economist his achievements were remarkable...

ext.ext_cn: 考虑到这点，可能很难作出决定。
ext.ext_en: In view of this, the decision may not be easy.

defs.def_en: You use in view of when you are taking into consideration facts that have just been mentioned or are just about to be mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 他们有非常明确的职业目标。
ext.ext_en: They have very clear career aims in view...

ext.ext_cn: 阿克罗伊德制订出这一整套秘密计划就是为了达到一个目的。
ext.ext_en: Ackroyd worked out this whole plot with one objective in view.

defs.def_en: If you have something in view, you are aware of it and your actions are aimed towards it.

defs.def_cn: 从长远来看;作长远打算

ext.ext_cn: 一些投资者是从长远角度考虑的。
ext.ext_en: Some investors are taking the long view...

ext.ext_cn: 为了对这个项目作长远打算，我开始根据要求的排练计划考虑问题。
ext.ext_en: Taking a long view of the project, I began to think in terms of the rehearsal schedules required.

defs.def_en: If you take the long view, you consider what is likely to happen in the future over a long period, rather than thinking only about things that are going to happen soon.

ext.ext_cn: 一场关于当代雕塑的重要展览即将在波特兰美术馆开展。
ext.ext_en: A significant exhibition of contemporary sculpture will be on view at the Portland Gallery.

defs.def_en: If something such as a work of art is on view, it is shown in public for people to look at.

ext.ext_cn: 为了组建一个协调各方利益的全国性联合政府，他已召集所有党派参加明天的会议。
ext.ext_en: He has called a meeting of all parties tomorrow, with a view to forming a national reconciliation government.

defs.def_en: If you do something with a view to doing something else, you do it because you hope it will result in that other thing being done.

ext.ext_cn: 我在窗台上站稳。
ext.ext_en: I balanced on the ledge...

ext.ext_cn: 他将一只足球稳稳地顶在头上。
ext.ext_en: He balanced a football on his head.

defs.def_en: If you balance something somewhere, or if it balances there, it remains steady and does not fall.

ext.ext_cn: 你现在服用的药物可能会影响身体的平衡能力。
ext.ext_en: The medicines you are currently taking could be affecting your balance.

defs.def_en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up.

defs.def_cn: 使（力量、重要性等）相等；使均衡；使持平

ext.ext_cn: 做到辛辣菜和清淡菜比重相当。
ext.ext_en: Balance spicy dishes with mild ones...

ext.ext_cn: 国家必须找出平衡这两种需求的办法。
ext.ext_en: The state has got to find some way to  balance these two needs...

defs.def_en: If you balance one thing with something different, each of the things has the same strength or importance.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的婚姻在传统和现代价值观之间保持着微妙平衡。
ext.ext_en: Their marriage is a delicate balance between traditional and contemporary values...

ext.ext_cn: 没有其他方法可以确保人们饮食均衡。
ext.ext_en: There was no other way to ensure that people would get the right balance of foods.

defs.def_en: A balance is a situation in which all the different parts are equal in strength or importance.

defs.def_cn: （尤指冲突或比赛中的）局面，胜利天平

ext.ext_cn: 将使他们在战争中占据优势的威力巨大的新型火炮
ext.ext_en: ...a powerful new gun which could tip the balance of the war in their favour...

ext.ext_cn: 期末考试渐渐被连续性评估所取代。
ext.ext_en: The balance continues to swing away from final examinations to continuous assessment.

defs.def_en: If you say that the balance tips in your favour, you start winning or succeeding, especially in a conflict or contest.

ext.ext_cn: 她谨慎地试图对宗教情感和民主自由两者作出权衡。
ext.ext_en: She carefully tried to balance religious sensitivities against democratic freedom.

defs.def_en: If you balance one thing against another, you consider its importance in relation to the other one.

ext.ext_cn: 他通过严格控制公共开支保持预算平衡。
ext.ext_en: He balanced his budgets by rigid control over public expenditure.

defs.def_en: If someone balances their budget or if a government balances the economy of a country, they make sure that the amount of money that is spent is not greater than the amount that is received.

ext.ext_cn: 教他们结平账目
ext.ext_en: ...teaching them to balance the books...

ext.ext_cn: 为了使收支相等，必须减少支出，增加税收。
ext.ext_en: To make the books balance, spending must fall and taxes must rise.

defs.def_en: If you balance your books or make them balance, you prove by calculation that the amount of money you have received is equal to the amount that you have spent.

ext.ext_cn: 请查一下我的账户余额。
ext.ext_en: I'd like to check the balance in my account please.

defs.def_en: The balance in your bank account is the amount of money you have in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们应该在货到时支付余额。
ext.ext_en: They were due to pay the balance on delivery.

defs.def_en: The balance of an amount of money is what remains to be paid for something or what remains when part of the amount has been spent.

ext.ext_cn: 可能给医院的计算机使用带来革命的项目仍然前途未明。
ext.ext_en: The fate of a project which could revolutionise the use of computers in hospitals hangs in the balance.

defs.def_en: If something hangs in the balance, it is uncertain whether it will happen or continue.

ext.ext_cn: 她抓住扶手以保持平衡。
ext.ext_en: She was holding onto the rail to keep her balance...

ext.ext_cn: 他蓦地转身，差点失去平衡。
ext.ext_en: He swung around, almost losing his balance.

defs.def_en: If you keep your balance, for example when standing in a moving vehicle, you remain steady and do not fall over. If you lose your balance, you become unsteady and fall over.

ext.ext_cn: 一阵大风刮得他失去平衡，脸朝下摔在泥里。
ext.ext_en: A gust of wind knocked him off balance and he fell face down in the mud.

defs.def_en: If you are off balance, you are in an unsteady position and about to fall.

ext.ext_cn: 她尽力装作对他的造访并不吃惊。
ext.ext_en: She was trying to behave as if his visit hadn't thrown her off balance.

defs.def_en: If you are thrown off balance by something, you are surprised or confused by it.

defs.def_cn: 权衡之后；全面考虑之后；总的来说

ext.ext_cn: 总的来说，他同意克里斯蒂娜的意见。
ext.ext_en: On balance he agreed with Christine.

defs.def_en: You can say on balance to indicate that you are stating an opinion after considering all the relevant facts or arguments.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （情形）没有希望的，前景暗淡的

ext.ext_cn: 近期前景依然暗淡。
ext.ext_en: The immediate outlook remains bleak...

ext.ext_cn: 很多人都预测前景暗淡。
ext.ext_en: Many predicted a bleak future.

defs.def_en: If a situation is bleak, it is bad, and seems unlikely to improve.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这座岛屿一片荒凉。
ext.ext_en: The island's pretty bleak.

ext.ext_cn: 凄清的旧城区街道
ext.ext_en: ...bleak inner-city streets.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as bleak, you mean that it looks cold, empty, and unattractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 沿海地区的天气会非常阴冷。
ext.ext_en: The weather can be quite bleak on the coast.

defs.def_en: When the weather is bleak, it is cold, dull, and unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人）无精打采的，沮丧的，阴郁的

ext.ext_cn: 他脸色阴郁。
ext.ext_en: His face was bleak...

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔伯格沮丧地凝视着他。
ext.ext_en: Alberg gave him a bleak stare.

defs.def_en: If someone looks or sounds bleak, they look or sound depressed, as if they have no hope or energy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （感情、行为等）单纯的，质朴的，粗犷的

ext.ext_cn: 他们在这片新殖民地将要过的一种简朴生活
ext.ext_en: ...the elemental life they would be living in this new colony.

defs.def_en: Elemental feelings and types of behaviour are simple, basic, and forceful.

defs.def_cn: 污染物（尤指车辆尾气和工业有毒化学废弃物）

ext.ext_cn: 加利福尼亚川流不息的车流使空气中充斥着污染物。
ext.ext_en: A steady stream of California traffic clogs the air with pollutants.

defs.def_en: Pollutants are substances that pollute the environment, especially gases from vehicles and poisonous chemicals produced as waste by industrial processes.

ext.ext_cn: 一位留着胡子、40岁左右的社会学教授
ext.ext_en: ...a bearded 40-year-old sociology professor.

defs.def_en: A bearded man has a beard.

ext.ext_cn: 南希开始爬楼梯。
ext.ext_en: Nancy began to climb the stairs...

ext.ext_cn: 我们上了一段楼梯。
ext.ext_en: We walked up a flight of stairs...

defs.def_en: Stairs are a set of steps inside a building which go from one floor to another.

ext.ext_cn: 我跟着她下了楼梯。
ext.ext_en: I followed her down the stair.

defs.def_en: A stair is a flight of stairs.

ext.ext_cn: 特里正坐在最下面的一级楼梯上。
ext.ext_en: Terry was sitting on the bottom stair.

defs.def_en: A stair is one of the steps in a flight of stairs.

defs.def_cn: 巩固(地位);增强，加强(实力)

ext.ext_cn: 巩固了政府的地位并使其能够制衡国会和总统权力的新宪法
ext.ext_en: ...the new constitution, which strengthens the government and enables it to balance and check the powers of parliament and president...

ext.ext_cn: 为巩固其在国会中的地位，他曾与农民党的领导人进行多次会谈。
ext.ext_en: To strengthen his position in Parliament, he held talks with leaders of the Peasant Party...

defs.def_en: If something strengthens a person or group or if they strengthen their position, they become more powerful and secure, or more likely to succeed.

defs.def_cn: 支持，强化(论点或论据);使更有说服力

ext.ext_cn: 他对那些本可以为他的观点提供佐证的研究似乎并不熟悉。
ext.ext_en: He does not seem to be familiar with research which might have strengthened his own arguments.

defs.def_en: If something strengthens a case or argument, it supports it by providing more reasons or evidence for it.

defs.def_cn: (使)(经济、工业)坚挺，壮大;(使)(货币)升值

ext.ext_cn: 美元相对大多数其他货币都升值了。
ext.ext_en: The dollar strengthened against most other currencies...

ext.ext_cn: 如果政府想让英镑保值，那么首先就应该加强英国的经济。
ext.ext_en: If the Government wants to save the Pound it should start by strengthening the British economy.

defs.def_en: If a currency, economy, or industry strengthens, or if something strengthens it, it increases in value or becomes more successful.

defs.def_cn: 加强，加大(法律、措施)的力度;(使)变得更严格

ext.ext_cn: 我也在急切地关注我们该如何加强法制。
ext.ext_en: I am also looking urgently at how we can strengthen the law...

ext.ext_cn: 社区领导想要加强对小区外围的管理。
ext.ext_en: Community leaders want to strengthen controls at external frontiers...

defs.def_en: If a government strengthens laws or measures or if they strengthen, they are made more severe.

defs.def_cn: 增强(决心或毅力);使更具信心;使更加坚定

ext.ext_cn: 任何经历都能使你从中受益并让你变得坚强，而那些比较艰难的经历尤其如此。
ext.ext_en: Any experience can teach and strengthen you, but particularly the more difficult ones...

ext.ext_cn: 这只会更加坚定我们赢得联赛的决心。
ext.ext_en: This merely strengthens our resolve to win the league...

defs.def_en: If something strengthens you or strengthens your resolve or character, it makes you more confident and determined.

defs.def_cn: 增进(关系或联系);(使)变得更紧密

ext.ext_cn: 这将使你们走得更近，并将增进你们之间的关系。
ext.ext_en: It will draw you closer together, and it will strengthen the bond of your relationship...

ext.ext_cn: 他此次访问旨在增进两国间的关系。
ext.ext_en: His visit is intended to strengthen ties between the two countries...

defs.def_en: If something strengthens a relationship or link, or if a relationship or link strengthens, it makes it closer and more likely to last for a long time.

defs.def_cn: 加强，加深(印象、感情、信念);(使)变得比较深刻;(使)坚定

ext.ext_cn: 他的演讲让人更加确信他才是该组织的主心骨。
ext.ext_en: His speech strengthens the impression he is the main power in the organization...

ext.ext_cn: 每天晒太阳让人心情更加开朗。
ext.ext_en: Every day of sunshine strengthens the feelings of optimism...

defs.def_en: If something strengthens an impression, feeling, or belief, or if it strengthens, it becomes greater or affects more people.

ext.ext_cn: 骑自行车是一项不错的锻炼方式。它能使身体各部分的肌肉更强健。
ext.ext_en: Cycling is good exercise. It strengthens all the muscles of the body...

ext.ext_cn: 瑜伽能增强人体免疫系统。
ext.ext_en: Yoga can be used to strengthen the immune system.

defs.def_en: If something strengthens your body or a part of your body, it makes it healthier, often in such a way that you can move or carry heavier things.

ext.ext_cn: 施工人员将不得不另外用木料加固现有的托梁。
ext.ext_en: The builders will have to strengthen the existing joists with additional timber.

defs.def_en: If something strengthens an object or structure, it makes it able to be treated roughly or able to support heavy weights, without being damaged or destroyed.

ext.ext_cn: 风越刮越大，逐渐转为南风。
ext.ext_en: As it strengthened the wind was veering southerly...

ext.ext_cn: 一场短时强阵雨后风势渐长。
ext.ext_en: There was a short sharp shower followed by a strengthening breeze.

defs.def_en: If the wind, current, or other force strengthens, it becomes faster or more powerful.

ext.ext_cn: 工会领导人说，财政困难的政府能答应的充其量是一揽子工资方案。
ext.ext_en: Union leaders say the wage package is the best they believe the cash-strapped government will offer.

defs.def_en: If a person or organization is cash-strapped, they do not have enough money to buy or pay for the things they want or need.

ext.ext_cn: 他派了联邦探员去窃听马丁·路德·金的电话。
ext.ext_en: He assigned federal agents to listen in on Martin Luther King's phone calls.

defs.def_en: If you listen in to a private conversation, you secretly listen to it.

defs.def_cn: 不确定性;不明确;模糊不清

ext.ext_cn: 语言的不确定性
ext.ext_en: ...the indeterminacy of language.

defs.def_en: The indeterminacy of something is its quality of being uncertain or vague.

ext.ext_cn: 为了弥补自己当权时对人权的践踏，他以出家来谢罪。
ext.ext_en: He's living in a monastery in a gesture of atonement for human rights abuses committed under his leadership...

ext.ext_cn: 真正的内疚表现为愿意弥补所犯的过错。
ext.ext_en: True guilt is characterized by a readiness to make atonement for having done wrong.

defs.def_en: If you do something as an atonement for doing something wrong, you do it to show that you are sorry.

ext.ext_cn: 他很少因为约定取消或出发太晚而恼火。
ext.ext_en: Cancellations and late departures rarely rile him.

defs.def_en: If something riles you, it makes you angry.

ext.ext_cn: 有着红褐色长发的高个女子
ext.ext_en: ...a tall woman with long auburn hair.

defs.def_en: Auburn hair is reddish brown.
Holy Communion is the most important religious service in the Christian church, in which people share bread and wine as a symbol of the Last Supper and the death of Christ.

ext.ext_cn: 他声称自己的话被错误地引用，并威胁说要以诽谤罪起诉这家杂志。
ext.ext_en: He claimed that he had been misquoted and he threatened to sue the magazine for libel...

ext.ext_cn: 这起官司是由一位心理分析学家起诉的，他声称一名记者发表在杂志上面的一系列文章里错误地引用了他的话。
ext.ext_en: The case was brought by a psychoanalyst who says a journalist misquoted him in a series of magazine articles.

defs.def_en: If someone is misquoted, something that they have said or written is repeated incorrectly.

ext.ext_cn: 商业银行的主要职能是为产业融资。
ext.ext_en: The main function of the merchant banks is to raise capital for industry.

defs.def_en: The function of something or someone is the useful thing that they do or are intended to do.

ext.ext_cn: 当局称监狱现在运转正常。
ext.ext_en: The authorities say the prison is now functioning normally...

ext.ext_cn: 没有地方的支持，自然环境保护项目就无法运作。
ext.ext_en: Conservation programs cannot function without local support.

defs.def_en: If a machine or system is functioning, it is working or operating.

defs.def_cn: 发挥功能;起作用;行使职责

ext.ext_cn: 在工作日，房间的1/3用作办公区域。
ext.ext_en: On weekdays, one third of the room functions as workspace.

defs.def_en: If someone or something functions as a particular thing, they do the work or fulfil the purpose of that thing.

defs.def_cn: (计算机的)功能(指执行的一系列操作)
defs.def_en: A function is a series of operations that a computer performs, for example when a single key or a combination of keys is pressed.

defs.def_cn: 应变量;随他物变化而变化的事物

ext.ext_cn: 投资随着利率的变化而变。
ext.ext_en: Investment is a function of the interest rate.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing is a function of another, you mean that its amount or nature depends on the other thing.
A function is a large formal dinner or party.

defs.def_cn: 保妥适，肉毒杆菌毒素（可注入脸部以去除皱纹的物质）

ext.ext_cn: 肉毒素注射
ext.ext_en: ...Botox injections.

defs.def_en: Botox is a substance that is injected into the face in order to make the skin look smoother.

defs.def_cn: （面点或蔬菜）有嚼头的，软硬适中的
defs.def_en: If you cook pasta or a vegetable until it is al dente, you cook it just long enough so that it is neither hard nor soft but is firm and slightly chewy.

ext.ext_cn: 血液已经开始凝结。
ext.ext_en: The blood had started to congeal.

ext.ext_cn: 洒出来的酒混合着已变稠的汤
ext.ext_en: ...spilled wine mingled with congealed soup.

defs.def_en: When a liquid congeals, it becomes very thick and sticky and almost solid.

defs.def_cn: 麻布袋;粗布袋;厚纸袋;大口袋

ext.ext_cn: 一袋土豆
ext.ext_en: ...a sack of potatoes.

defs.def_en: A sack is a large bag made of rough woven material. Sacks are used to carry or store things such as vegetables or coal.

ext.ext_cn: 今天早些时候，首相解除了 18 名涉嫌贪污腐败的政府官员的职务。
ext.ext_en: Earlier today the Prime Minister sacked 18 government officials for corruption...

ext.ext_cn: 理科教师詹姆斯·伍德因为掌掴一名男生而被开除。
ext.ext_en: Science teacher James Wood was sacked for slapping a schoolboy.

defs.def_en: If your employers sack you, they tell you that you can no longer work for them because you have done something that they did not like or because your work was not good enough.

defs.def_cn: 抢劫，洗劫，破坏(城镇或城市)

ext.ext_cn: 1527年，帝国军队洗劫了位于罗马的法国大使官邸。
ext.ext_en: In 1527 Imperial troops sacked the French ambassador's residence in Rome.

ext.ext_cn: 《奥德赛》讲述的是在特洛伊被洗劫一空之后发生在希腊英雄们身上的故事。
ext.ext_en: The Odyssey tells what happened to the Greek heroes after the sack of Troy.

defs.def_en: When an army sacks a town or city, they destroy it, taking away all valuable things.
Some people refer to bed as the sack .

ext.ext_cn: 总统将不过是个傀儡而已。
ext.ext_en: The President will be little more than a figurehead.

defs.def_en: If someone is the figurehead of an organization or movement, they are recognized as being its leader, although they have little real power.
A figurehead is a large wooden model of a person that was put just under the pointed front of a sailing ship in former times.

ext.ext_cn: 我想让所有国家安全委员会的成员，包括总统和副总统都听到这个消息。
ext.ext_en: I want the whole National Security Council, including the President and Veep, to hear it.

defs.def_en: A veep is a vice-president, especially the vice-president of the United States.

ext.ext_cn: 她声音发颤然后便默不作声了。
ext.ext_en: Her voice quavered and she fell silent.

ext.ext_cn: 贝丽尔的声音有一丝颤抖。
ext.ext_en: There was a quaver in Beryl's voice.

defs.def_en: If someone's voice quavers, it sounds unsteady, usually because they are nervous or uncertain.
A quaver is a musical note that is half as long as a crotchet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 怀有恶意的;怀恨在心的

ext.ext_cn: 他可能怀有恶意。
ext.ext_en: He could be spiteful.

ext.ext_cn: 一连串恶意电话
ext.ext_en: ...a stream of spiteful telephone calls.

defs.def_en: Someone who is spiteful does cruel things to hurt people they dislike.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 头脑发热的;鲁莽的;性急的
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as hot-headed, you are criticizing them for acting too quickly, without thinking of the consequences.

defs.def_cn: (用在正式任命的宗教领袖的名字或身份前表示尊敬，缩略形式为Rev或Revd)大人

ext.ext_cn: 这次礼拜仪式是由吉姆·西蒙斯牧师大人主持的。
ext.ext_en: The service was led by the Reverend Jim Simons.

ext.ext_cn: 诺里奇的主教，彼得·诺特大人
ext.ext_en: ...the Bishop of Norwich, the Right Reverend Peter Knott.

defs.def_en: Reverend is a title used before the name or rank of an officially appointed religious leader. The abbreviation Rev or Revd is also used.
Air miles are points that you collect when you buy certain goods or services and which you can use to pay for air travel.

ext.ext_cn: 我们沿着一条崎岖的山间小路再度出发。
ext.ext_en: We set off once more, over a rough mountain track.

defs.def_en: A track is a narrow road or path.

ext.ext_cn: 那两个男人转身观看赛马沿赛道而行。
ext.ext_en: The two men turned to watch the horses going round the track.

ext.ext_cn: 田径跑道
ext.ext_en: ...the athletics track.

defs.def_en: A track is a piece of ground, often oval-shaped, that is used for races involving athletes, cars, bicycles, horses, or dogs called greyhounds.

ext.ext_cn: 一名女子摔倒在铁轨上。
ext.ext_en: A woman fell on to the tracks.

defs.def_en: Railway tracks are the rails that a train travels along.

defs.def_cn: (CD、唱片或磁带上的一首)歌曲，乐曲

ext.ext_cn: 格雷姆·内史密斯创作了这张专辑十首歌中的两首。
ext.ext_en: Graeme Naysmith has produced two of the ten tracks on this album.

defs.def_en: A track is one of the songs or pieces of music on a CD, record, or tape.

ext.ext_cn: 熊猫活动的唯一迹象是它们留在雪地上的足迹。
ext.ext_en: The only evidence of pandas was their tracks in the snow...

ext.ext_cn: 麦基突然注意到前方岸边的轮胎痕迹。
ext.ext_en: McKee suddenly noticed tire tracks on the bank ahead.

defs.def_en: Tracks are marks left in the ground by the feet of animals or people.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为最好跟踪这只狼，杀了它。
ext.ext_en: He thought he had better track this wolf and kill it...

ext.ext_cn: 我跟着他，在雪地里追踪他，直到他最终体力不支。
ext.ext_en: I followed him, tracking him in the snow until finally he got tired.

defs.def_en: If you track animals or people, you try to follow them by looking for the signs that they have left behind, for example the marks left by their feet.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的雷达开始追踪喷气式飞机的动向。
ext.ext_en: Our radar began tracking the jets...

ext.ext_cn: 气象预报员也在追踪飓风“约瑟芬”的动向。
ext.ext_en: Forecasters are also tracking hurricane Josephine.

defs.def_en: To track someone or something means to follow their movements by means of a special device, such as a satellite or radar.

ext.ext_cn: 如果可能，应追查谣言的源头。
ext.ext_en: If it's possible, track the rumour back to its origin...

ext.ext_cn: 该选手正为尤文图斯队所追踪关注。
ext.ext_en: The player is being tracked by Juventus.

defs.def_en: If you track someone or something, you investigate them, because you are interested in finding out more about them.

defs.def_cn: (同等年龄、能力的孩子组成的)班级，班组
defs.def_en: In a school, a track is a group of children of the same age and ability who are taught together.

defs.def_cn: 把(学生)按能力分班(或组)

ext.ext_cn: 学生已经按能力分班了。
ext.ext_en: Students are already being tracked.

defs.def_en: To track students means to divide them into groups according to their ability.

defs.def_cn: 掩盖行踪;隐匿身份(或活动)

ext.ext_cn: 他掩盖形迹，烧毁了信件与日记。
ext.ext_en: He covered his tracks, burnt letters and diaries...

ext.ext_cn: 凶手可能曾回到犯罪现场掩盖自己的罪行。
ext.ext_en: The killer may have returned to the scene of the crime to cover his tracks.

defs.def_en: If someone covers their tracks, they hide or destroy evidence of their identity or their actions, because they want to keep them secret.

defs.def_cn: 占优势;处于有利地位;了解内情

ext.ext_cn: 丹佛在 10 个被考虑的地点之中具有优势。
ext.ext_en: Denver has the inside track among 10 sites being considered...

ext.ext_cn: 作为代理人，一旦有划算的买卖你恐怕能近水楼台先得月。
ext.ext_en: As an agent, you may have an inside track when good deals become available.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has the inside track, you mean that they have an advantage, for example special knowledge about something.

defs.def_cn: 跟上…的进展;掌握…的最新消息

ext.ext_cn: 对于一支 1.1 万人的员工队伍，很难及时了解到所有有人的动态。
ext.ext_en: With eleven thousand employees, it's very difficult to keep track of them all...

ext.ext_cn: 在这里很容易忘了时间。
ext.ext_en: It's hard to keep track of time in here.

defs.def_en: If you keep track of a situation or a person, you make sure that you have the newest and most accurate information about them all the time.

defs.def_cn: 跟不上…的进展;不再掌握…的最新情况

ext.ext_cn: 你会因过于专注某项活动而失去时间概念。
ext.ext_en: You become so deeply absorbed in an activity that you lose track of time...

ext.ext_cn: 很容易就忘记谁要和谁比赛，什么时候比。
ext.ext_en: It's so easy to lose track of who's playing who and when.

defs.def_en: If you lose track of someone or something, you no longer know where they are or what is happening.

ext.ext_cn: 我们最好马上就走，不是吗？
ext.ext_en: We'd better make tracks soon, hadn't we?

defs.def_en: If you make tracks, you leave the place where you are, especially when you are in a hurry.

ext.ext_cn: 要使英国经济重新回到正轨可能需要一段时间。
ext.ext_en: It may take some time to get the British economy back on track...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维让我重新回到了正轨。
ext.ext_en: David put me back on track…

defs.def_en: If someone or something is on track, they are acting or progressing in a way that is likely to result in success.

ext.ext_cn: 他正在追踪一名逃犯。
ext.ext_en: He was on the track of an escaped criminal...

ext.ext_cn: 研究所正在探究动脉损伤的诱因。
ext.ext_en: The research institute is on the track of what causes the artery damage.

defs.def_en: If you are on the track of someone or something, you are trying to find them, or find information about them.

defs.def_cn: 循着正确/错误的路线;在正确/错误的道路上

ext.ext_cn: 回头客越来越多了——这显然表明我们的路走对了。
ext.ext_en: Guests are returning in increasing numbers — a sure sign that we are on the right track...

ext.ext_cn: 我们需要一场令人信服的大胜，以重回正轨。
ext.ext_en: We need a convincing win to put us back on the right track…

defs.def_en: If you are on the right track, you are acting or progressing in a way that is likely to result in success. If you are on the wrong track, you are acting or progressing in a way that is likely to result in failure.

ext.ext_cn: 这座宏伟的教堂一定会让你止步赞叹。
ext.ext_en: This magnificent church cannot fail to stop you in your tracks…

ext.ext_cn: 他们突然停下，惊讶地盯着他。
ext.ext_en: They stopped in their tracks and stared at him in amazement…

defs.def_en: If someone or something stops you in your tracks, or if you stop dead in your tracks, you suddenly stop moving because you are very surprised, impressed, or frightened.

ext.ext_cn: 弗朗西斯觉得他应该立即打断这一谈话。
ext.ext_en: Francis felt he would like to stop this conversation in its tracks…

ext.ext_cn: 美国制造商将会发现出口热戛然而止。
ext.ext_en: U.S. manufacturers may find the export boom stopping dead in its tracks.

defs.def_en: If someone or something stops a process or activity in its tracks, or if it stops dead in its tracks, they prevent the process or activity from continuing.

defs.def_cn: (委员会、组织机构的)主席;(公司)总裁

ext.ext_cn: 格林·福特是提交这份报告的委员会的主席。
ext.ext_en: Glyn Ford is chairman of the Committee which produced the report...

ext.ext_cn: 我和那家公司的总裁有过生意往来。
ext.ext_en: I had done business with the company's chairman.

defs.def_en: The chairman of a committee, organization, or company is the head of it.

ext.ext_cn: 大会主席宣布会议开幕。
ext.ext_en: The chairman declared the meeting open...

ext.ext_cn: 我明白，主席先生！
ext.ext_en: I hear you, Mr. Chairman.

defs.def_en: The chairman of a meeting or debate is the person in charge, who decides when each person is allowed to speak.

defs.def_cn: （能够操控形势的）影响力，手段，优势

ext.ext_cn: 他的市长身份使他有能力通过出席委员会会议来达成一些事情。
ext.ext_en: His function as a Mayor affords him the leverage to get things done through attending committee meetings.

defs.def_en: Leverage is the ability to influence situations or people so that you can control what happens.

ext.ext_cn: 锹和耙的手柄较长，可发挥较好的杠杆作用。
ext.ext_en: The spade and fork have longer shafts, providing better leverage.

defs.def_en: Leverage is the force that is applied to an object when something such as a lever is used.

ext.ext_cn: 他也许觉得，在他认为大有可为的时候让公司借贷经营是一个错误。
ext.ext_en: He might feel that leveraging the company at a time when he sees tremendous growth opportunities would be a mistake.

defs.def_en: To leverage a company or investment means to use borrowed money in order to buy it or pay for it.

defs.def_cn: 血亲；有血缘关系的亲属；骨肉
defs.def_en: A blood relation or blood relative is someone who is related to you by birth rather than by marriage.

defs.def_cn: （用于强调讨厌的性质或情形）非常，极其

ext.ext_cn: 事情进展奇慢无比。
ext.ext_en: Things are moving painfully slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 害羞过头的青年男子
ext.ext_en: ...a painfully shy young man...

defs.def_en: See also:painful;You use painfully to emphasize a quality or situation that is undesirable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 空间狭小、光线昏暗、陈设简陋的公寓
ext.ext_en: ...apartments which were poky, dimly lit and poorly furnished.

ext.ext_cn: 窄小的办公室
ext.ext_en: ...pokey little offices.

defs.def_en: A room or house that is poky is uncomfortably small.

ext.ext_cn: “动起来！”她叫道：“别这么慢吞吞的！”
ext.ext_en: 'Move!' she cried. 'Don't be so darn poky!'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is poky, you are criticizing them for moving or reacting very slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 他们把他投进监狱，服刑条件非常恶劣。
ext.ext_en: They threw him in the pokey, kept him under very harsh conditions.

defs.def_en: If someone is in the pokey, they are in prison.

ext.ext_cn: 她的父亲被企图抢劫他那间小零售店的人开枪打死了。
ext.ext_en: Her father was shot by someone trying to rob his small retail store...

ext.ext_cn: 我需要有人帮忙。
ext.ext_en: I need someone to help me...

defs.def_en: You use someone or somebody to refer to a person without saying exactly who you mean.

defs.def_cn: (某行业或某地方的)重要人物，大人物

ext.ext_cn: 他在法律部门是个人物。
ext.ext_en: He was somebody in the law division...

ext.ext_cn: “她来之前，”她说道，“我在这个镇上也算得上个人物了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Before she came around,' she says, 'I was somebody in this town'.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person is someone or somebody in a particular kind of work or in a particular place, you mean that they are considered to be important in that kind of work or in that place.

ext.ext_cn: 他开始用一种带有鼻音的、抑扬顿挫的声调说话。
ext.ext_en: He started to speak in a nasal sing-song voice.

defs.def_en: A sing-song voice repeatedly rises and falls in pitch.

defs.def_cn: (众人自娱自乐的)合唱，歌唱会
defs.def_en: A sing-song is an occasion on which a group of people sing songs together for pleasure.

defs.def_cn: （盛啤酒或其他酒精饮品的）小桶
defs.def_en: A keg is a small barrel used for storing something such as beer or other alcoholic drinks.
Keg is a kind of beer which is kept under pressure in a metal barrel.
A narrow boat is a long, low boat used on canals.

ext.ext_cn: 反战示威者们打断了辩论。
ext.ext_en: Anti-war protesters disrupted the debate.

ext.ext_cn: 旱灾已严重影响了农业生产。
ext.ext_en: The drought has severely disrupted agricultural production.

defs.def_en: If someone or something disrupts an event, system, or process, they cause difficulties that prevent it from continuing or operating in a normal way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有偏见的；狭隘的；敌视的

ext.ext_cn: 金融市场对政府的动机存有偏见。
ext.ext_en: The financial markets are taking a jaundiced view of the Government's motives...

ext.ext_cn: 这位将军以带有偏见的眼光关注事态发展。
ext.ext_en: The general watched the proceedings with a jaundiced eye.

defs.def_en: If someone has a jaundiced view of something, they can see only the bad aspects of it.

ext.ext_cn: 海军陆战队突击小组
ext.ext_en: ...a small commando of marines...

ext.ext_cn: 在突击队的突袭行动中，人质获释。
ext.ext_en: The hostages were freed in the commando raid.

defs.def_en: A commando is a group of soldiers who have been specially trained to carry out surprise attacks.

ext.ext_cn: 戴维·克莱门特上尉和150名突击队员今天早上对港口展开突袭。
ext.ext_en: Captain David Clement and 150 commandos stormed the port this morning.

defs.def_en: A commando is a soldier who is a member of a commando.

defs.def_cn: 未经培训的；未经训练的；无经验的

ext.ext_cn: 说我们派未受过培训的员工来处理紧急事故简直是胡说八道。
ext.ext_en: It is a nonsense to say we have untrained staff dealing with emergencies...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的情报部门人员缺乏训练，机构臃肿，简直毫无用处。
ext.ext_en: Our Intelligence Service was untrained, cumbersome, and almost wholly ineffectual.

defs.def_en: Someone who is untrained has not been taught the skills that they need for a particular job, activity, or situation.

defs.def_cn: (嗓子)未受专门训练的；(心智)未受正规教育的

ext.ext_cn: 人们常说，他虽未受过专门训练却极有政治头脑。
ext.ext_en: It was often said that he had the best untrained mind in politics.

defs.def_en: If you describe a voice or a mind, for example, as untrained, you mean that it has not been developed through formal education or training.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （目光）木然的，呆滞的，无神采的

ext.ext_cn: 医生们目光呆滞地坐在电视机前一支接一支地抽着烟。
ext.ext_en: Doctors with glazed eyes sat chain-smoking in front of a television set...

ext.ext_cn: 她眼神呆滞。
ext.ext_en: There was a glazed look in her eyes.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's eyes as glazed, you mean that their expression is dull or dreamy, usually because they are tired or are having difficulty concentrating on something.
Glazed pottery is covered with a thin layer of a hard shiny substance.
A glazed window or door has glass in it.
A windbreak is something such as a line of trees or a fence which gives protection against the wind.

defs.def_cn: 波罗麻，剑麻(用生长于西印度群岛、南美和非洲的一种植物的叶子制成的纤维)
defs.def_en: Sisal is the fibre from the leaves of a plant that is grown in the West Indies, South America, and Africa. Sisal is used to make rope, cord, and mats.

ext.ext_cn: 那些洞穴深约18公里。
ext.ext_en: The caves extend for some 18 kilometres...

ext.ext_cn: 如果任其自然生长，主干可以长到约12英尺。
ext.ext_en: The main stem will extend to around 12ft, if left to develop naturally...

defs.def_en: If you say that something, usually something large, extends for a particular distance or extends from one place to another, you are indicating its size or position.

ext.ext_cn: 悬崖上凸出一块空地。
ext.ext_en: A shelf of land extended from the escarpment.

defs.def_en: If an object extends from a surface or place, it sticks out from it.

ext.ext_cn: 从1894年延续至1920年的板球甲级比赛职业生涯
ext.ext_en: ...a playing career in first-class cricket that extended from 1894 to 1920...

ext.ext_cn: 这些课程每周上一节课，每节两个小时，持续25周。
ext.ext_en: The courses are based on a weekly two-hour class, extending over a period of 25 weeks.

defs.def_en: If an event or activity extends over a period of time, it continues for that time.

ext.ext_cn: 服务项目还包括包装和递送礼物。
ext.ext_en: The service also extends to wrapping and delivering gifts...

A swallow is a kind of small bird with pointed wings and a forked tail.

defs.def_cn: （给产品）重新命名，改换商标，更换标识

ext.ext_cn: 这种汽车被重新命名为沃克斯豪尔在英国出售。
ext.ext_en: The car was rebadged as a Vauxhall and sold in Britain.

defs.def_en: If a product is rebadged, it is given a new name, brand, or logo.

defs.def_cn: （尤指美国处决犯人的）电椅，电刑
defs.def_en: The electric chair is a method of killing criminals, used especially in the United States, in which a person is strapped to a special chair and killed by a powerful electric current.
Something that is brownish is slightly brown in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 她指责丈夫胆小懦弱。
ext.ext_en: She accused her husband of being a coward.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a coward, you disapprove of them because they are easily frightened and avoid dangerous or difficult situations.

ext.ext_cn: 她戴了一串珍珠项链。
ext.ext_en: She wore a string of pearls at her throat...

ext.ext_cn: 我戴上了爸爸给我买的珍珠耳环。
ext.ext_en: I put on the pearl earrings Daddy had bought me.

defs.def_en: See also:mother-of-pearl;A pearl is a hard round object which is shiny and creamy white in colour. Pearls grow inside the shell of an oyster and are used for making expensive jewellery.

ext.ext_cn: 珍珠般的小纽扣
ext.ext_en: ...tiny pearl buttons.

defs.def_en: Pearl is used to describe something which looks like a pearl.

ext.ext_cn: 你不重视应该重视的东西，我觉得我是在对牛弹琴。
ext.ext_en: You do not value what should be valued, I see I was casting pearls before swine.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is casting pearls before swine, you mean that they are wasting their time by offering something that is helpful or valuable to someone who does not appreciate or understand it.

defs.def_cn: 精辟见解，睿智言论，妙语如珠（常指开玩笑的话）

ext.ext_cn: 那番精辟见解到底是什么意思呢？
ext.ext_en: And what is that pearl of wisdom supposed to mean?...

ext.ext_cn: 她的建议中有完全正确的金玉良言，但有过于恭维之嫌。
ext.ext_en: Her advice includes perfectly true but rather fulsome pearls of wisdom.

defs.def_en: People describe what someone says as pearls of wisdom to suggest that it is wise or helpful, often when they are joking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 阿姆里塔成了一个勇敢无畏的叛逆者。
ext.ext_en: Amrita becomes a bold, daring rebel...

ext.ext_cn: 在1960年，这是一个大胆的举动。
ext.ext_en: In 1960 this was a bold move...

defs.def_en: Someone who is bold is not afraid to do things which involve risk or danger.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （在众人面前）大胆的，放肆的，莽撞的

ext.ext_cn: 我不觉得我有什么唐突，因为我素来心直口快，有什么烦心的都会说出来。
ext.ext_en: I don't feel I'm being bold, because it's always been natural for me to just speak out about whatever disturbs me.

defs.def_en: Someone who is bold is not shy or embarrassed in the company of other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 色彩鲜艳、浓淡不一的红、蓝、白色花朵
ext.ext_en: ...bold flowers in various shades of red, blue or white.

ext.ext_cn: 醒目生动的色彩
ext.ext_en: ...bold, dramatic colours.

defs.def_en: A bold colour or pattern is very bright and noticeable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 每幅图片的彩样都单独印在一页上，而在该页的背面会映出清晰的轮廓。
ext.ext_en: Each picture is shown in colour on one page and as a bold outline on the opposite page.

defs.def_en: Bold lines or designs are drawn in a clear, strong way.
Bold is print which is thicker and looks blacker than ordinary printed letters.

ext.ext_cn: 核武器实验后残留的辐射
ext.ext_en: ...residual radiation from nuclear weapons testing...

ext.ext_cn: 把烤盘关掉，让余热把混合物再煨一下。
ext.ext_en: Turn the hotplate off and allow the residual heat to keep the mixture simmering.

defs.def_en: Residual is used to describe what remains of something when most of it has gone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 会意的；心照不宣的；知情的

ext.ext_cn: 罗恩朝她会意地一笑。
ext.ext_en: Ron gave her a knowing smile...

ext.ext_cn: 丹和哈丽心照不宣地交换了一下眼神。
ext.ext_en: Dan exchanged a knowing look with Harry.

defs.def_en: A knowing gesture or remark is one that shows that you understand something, for example the way that someone is feeling or what they really mean, even though it has not been mentioned directly.

defs.def_cn: (政府)财政的;国库的;(尤指)税收的

ext.ext_cn: 在1987 年，当时政府紧缩财政政策
ext.ext_en: ...in 1987, when the government tightened fiscal policy.

defs.def_en: Fiscal is used to describe something that relates to government money or public money, especially taxes.

ext.ext_cn: 西装无可挑剔：伍德推测他可能是个相当成功的出版商或银行家。
ext.ext_en: The suit was faultless: Wood guessed that he was a very successful publisher or a banker...

ext.ext_cn: 你只能猜测他们忍受着多大的精神痛苦。
ext.ext_en: You can only guess at what mental suffering they endure...

defs.def_en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

ext.ext_cn: 你现在应该已经猜出我回到了爱尔兰了。
ext.ext_en: By now you will have guessed that I'm back in Ireland...

ext.ext_cn: 你们可能已经猜测出来了，这个问题与电有关。
ext.ext_en: As you've probably guessed, the problem was electrical...

defs.def_en: If you guess that something is the case, you correctly form the opinion that it is the case, although you do not have definite knowledge about it.

ext.ext_cn: 我猜测这些疫苗根本不可能奏效。
ext.ext_en: My guess is that the chance that these vaccines will work is zero...

ext.ext_cn: 他给她把过脉，估量了她的血压。
ext.ext_en: He'd taken her pulse and made a guess at her blood pressure...

defs.def_en: A guess is an attempt to give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

ext.ext_cn: 谁也说不准这事什么时候会发生。
ext.ext_en: Just when this will happen is anyone's guess...

ext.ext_cn: 谁也说不清发生了什么事。
ext.ext_en: It's anybody's  guess what happened.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is anyone's guess or anybody's guess, you mean that no-one can be certain about what is really true.

ext.ext_cn: 据猜测，他已死了两天。
ext.ext_en: At a guess he's been dead for two days.

defs.def_en: You say at a guess to indicate that what you are saying is only an estimate or what you believe to be true, rather than being a definite fact.

ext.ext_cn: 我想她可能认为那个很漂亮。
ext.ext_en: I guess she thought that was pretty smart...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为他是正确的。
ext.ext_en: I guess he's  right...

defs.def_en: You say I guess to show that you are slightly uncertain or reluctant about what you are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 这位作家打算把悲惨结局的悬念一直保留到最后。
ext.ext_en: The author's intention is to keep everyone guessing until the bitter end...

ext.ext_cn: 她不让任何人知道自己最近的感情生活。
ext.ext_en: She was keeping everyone guessing about the latest love in her life.

defs.def_en: If someone keeps you guessing, they do not tell you what you want to know.

ext.ext_cn: 你猜怎么着，我刚刚得到了自己的第一个电影角色。
ext.ext_en: Guess what, I just got my first part in a movie.

defs.def_en: You say guess what to draw attention to something exciting, surprising, or interesting that you are about to say.

defs.def_cn: 他们的，她们的，它们的(东西)

ext.ext_cn: 他们旁边的桌上坐了一大群人，有十几个。
ext.ext_en: There was a big group of a dozen people at the table next to theirs...

ext.ext_cn: 在他们那样的一套公寓房里安装一套新的供暖系统可能要花费 3,000 英镑左右。
ext.ext_en: It would cost about £3,000 to install a new heating system in a flat such as theirs...

defs.def_en: You use theirs to indicate that something belongs or relates to the group of people, animals, or things that you are talking about.

defs.def_cn: (用以代替his or hers，而不指明是男是女;有人认为这种用法不对)

ext.ext_cn: 他不会给那个活动房屋上锁。里面要是有什么别人想要的东西，他们可以尽管拿。
ext.ext_en: He would leave the trailer unlocked. If there was something inside someone wanted, it would be theirs for the taking...

ext.ext_cn: 在有人办理正式手续认领以前，这个孩子不属于任何人。
ext.ext_en: This child is nobody's child until someone makes her theirs officially.

defs.def_en: You use theirs instead of 'his or hers' to indicate that something belongs or relates to a person without saying whether that person is a man or a woman. Some people think this use is incorrect.
A bride-to-be is a woman who is soon going to be married.

ext.ext_cn: 最新款的运动内衣是一种可外穿的彩色上装。
ext.ext_en: The latest in sports bras are colorful tops designed as outerwear.

defs.def_en: Outerwear is clothing that is not worn underneath other clothing.

ext.ext_cn: 想到今后一直到退休为止都要缴毕业税，学生们的积极性会被彻底打消。
ext.ext_en: The prospect of having to pay a graduate tax until retirement would kill the students' enthusiasm stone dead.

defs.def_en: If you kill something such as an idea or emotion stone-dead, you completely destroy it.

ext.ext_cn: 爆炸发生的时候房子里没有人。
ext.ext_en: The house was unoccupied at the time of the explosion...

ext.ext_cn: 两间空置的棚屋里发生了火灾。
ext.ext_en: The fire broke out in two unoccupied cabins.

defs.def_en: If a building is unoccupied, there is nobody in it.

defs.def_cn: 厚颜无耻的；公然的；露骨的

ext.ext_cn: 真是厚颜无耻！
ext.ext_en: What bare-faced cheek!

ext.ext_cn: 满嘴无耻谎言的奸诈政客
ext.ext_en: ...crooked politicians who tell bare-faced lies.

defs.def_en: You use bare-faced to describe someone's behaviour when you want to emphasize that they do not care that they are behaving wrongly.

ext.ext_cn: 饥荒可能会导致该大洲人口剧减。
ext.ext_en: The famine threatened to depopulate the continent.

defs.def_en: To depopulate an area means to greatly reduce the number of people living there.

ext.ext_cn: 我从哪儿可以找到从Windows98载入DOS程序的指令呢?
ext.ext_en: Where do I find the instructions to load DOS programs from Windows 98?

defs.def_en: DOS is the part of a computer operating system that controls and manages files and programs stored on disk. DOS is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'disk operating system'.

defs.def_cn: (短信、电话)发过来的,打进来的

ext.ext_cn: 我们对来电进行录音。
ext.ext_en: We keep a tape of incoming calls.

defs.def_en: An incoming message or phone call is one that you receive.

ext.ext_cn: 机场对进港航班关闭了。
ext.ext_en: The airport was closed for incoming flights.

defs.def_en: An incoming plane or passenger is one that is arriving at a place.

defs.def_cn: (官员、政府)新当选的，新上任的，新一任的

ext.ext_cn: 新一届政府面临的问题
ext.ext_en: ...the problems confronting the incoming government.

defs.def_en: An incoming official or government is one that has just been appointed or elected.
An incoming tide or wave is coming towards the shore.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这是对10月份的一个小小改善。
ext.ext_en: This is a marginal improvement on October...

ext.ext_cn: 结果显示反对党的作用微乎其微。
ext.ext_en: The role of the opposition party proved marginal.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as marginal, you mean that it is small or not very important.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 特别法庭是为主流社会成员、而非个体设立的。
ext.ext_en: The tribunals were established for the well-integrated members of society and not for marginal individuals...

ext.ext_cn: 我不想说他是个小人物，可他也不是什么大人物。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to call him marginal, but he's not a major character.

defs.def_en: If you describe people as marginal, you mean that they are not involved in the main events or developments in society because they are poor or have no power.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (席位或选区)边缘的，以相差无几的票数获胜（或失败）的

ext.ext_cn: 选民对5个边缘席位的看法
ext.ext_en: ...the views of voters in five marginal seats.

ext.ext_cn: 边缘席位的选票才是最关键的。
ext.ext_en: The votes in the marginals are those that really count...

defs.def_en: In political elections, a marginal seat or constituency is one which is usually won or lost by only a few votes, and is therefore of great interest to politicians and journalists.

defs.def_cn: （活动、花费、税项等）边际的，边缘的

ext.ext_cn: 分析家们赞同削减边缘业务，但坚持认为公司必须作出更大牺牲。
ext.ext_en: The analysts applaud the cuts in marginal businesses, but insist the company must make deeper sacrifices...

ext.ext_cn: 对于低收入的工人来说，边际税率至少为75%。
ext.ext_en: For low-paid workers, the marginal tax rate is at least 75%.

defs.def_en: Marginal activities, costs, or taxes are not the main part of a business or an economic system, but often make the difference between its success or failure, and are therefore important to control.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 穷人们被迫在山峦更高处的更为贫瘠的土地上耕作。
ext.ext_en: The poor are forced to farm in more marginal lands higher up the mountains.

ext.ext_cn: 帮助农民们，这样他们便不必开垦贫瘠的土地了。
ext.ext_en: ...helping farmers, so they do not have to exploit marginal lands.

defs.def_en: Marginal land is not very good for growing crops or grass for animals.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （事件，时期）动乱的骚乱的，动荡的

ext.ext_cn: 动荡不安的东欧剧变
ext.ext_en: ...the tumultuous changes in Eastern Europe...

ext.ext_cn: 那是布鲁塞尔国际贸易谈判中纷乱的一天。
ext.ext_en: It's been a tumultuous day at the international trade negotiations in Brussels.

defs.def_en: A tumultuous event or period of time involves many exciting and confusing events or feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 多达 2,000 名群众热烈欢迎冠军。
ext.ext_en: A tumultuous welcome from a 2,000 strong crowd greeted the champion…

ext.ext_cn: 代表们对这个消息报以热烈的掌声。
ext.ext_en: Delegates greeted the news with tumultuous applause.

defs.def_en: A tumultuous reaction to something is very noisy, because the people involved are very happy or excited.

ext.ext_cn: 丹巴尔先生对他的回答感到满意。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Dambar was gratified by his response.

defs.def_en: If you are gratified by something, it gives you pleasure or satisfaction.

ext.ext_cn: 我们满足了朋友的好奇心。
ext.ext_en: We gratified our friend's curiosity...

ext.ext_cn: 每一个突发的念头都会得到满足。
ext.ext_en: Every whim will be gratified.

defs.def_en: If you gratify your own or another person's desire, you do what is necessary to please yourself or them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 摇摆不定的；犹豫不决的

ext.ext_cn: 她对于自己的婚事仍然拿不定主意。
ext.ext_en: She remained ambivalent about her marriage...

ext.ext_cn: 在他漫长的一生中，他对基督教信仰始终是一种摇摆不定的态度。
ext.ext_en: He maintained an ambivalent attitude to the Church throughout his long life.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is ambivalent about something, they seem to be uncertain whether they really want it, or whether they really approve of it.

defs.def_cn: (某些基督教新教教派和摩门教派的)教堂，礼拜堂

ext.ext_cn: 促使保尔克伯爵在亚特兰大建第一座教堂的远见卓识
ext.ext_en: ...the vision which led Earl Paulk to create his first tabernacle in Atlanta.

ext.ext_cn: 布鲁克林教堂唱诗班
ext.ext_en: ...the Brooklyn Tabernacle Choir.

defs.def_en: A tabernacle is a church used by certain Christian Protestant groups and by Mormons.

defs.def_cn: (存放古代犹太人圣典的)圣幕，会幕
defs.def_en: The Tabernacle was a small tent which contained the most holy writings of the ancient Jews and which they took with them when they were travelling.

defs.def_cn: (双方两场比赛中的)再次交锋，第二回合
defs.def_en: A return match is the second of two matches that are played by two sports teams or two players.

ext.ext_cn: 地板上铺着东方风情的地毯。
ext.ext_en: The floor was overlaid with rugs of oriental design.

ext.ext_cn: 缝着金银绣花的呢子
ext.ext_en: ...woollen cloth, overlaid with gold and silver embroidery.

defs.def_en: If something is overlaid with something else, it is covered by it.

ext.ext_cn: 整个表面都镀了一层银。
ext.ext_en: Silver overlay is bonded to the entire surface.

ext.ext_cn: 铁栅栏上落满的一层雪
ext.ext_en: ...an overlay of snow on the tops of the iron fences.

defs.def_en: You can use overlay to refer to a substance which covers the surface of something.

ext.ext_cn: 这个聚会一直笼罩在不安的气氛中。
ext.ext_en: The party had been overlaid with a certain nervousness.

ext.ext_cn: 此刻突然迸发出来、盖过了其他种种情绪的情感
ext.ext_en: ...a surge of feeling which at this moment overlaid all others.

defs.def_en: If something is overlaid with a feeling or quality, that feeling or quality is the most noticeable one, but there may be deeper and more important ones involved.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 教导的;教诲的;(尤指)道德说教的

ext.ext_cn: 在极权社会里，艺术只为教化的目的而存在。
ext.ext_en: In totalitarian societies, art exists for didactic purposes.

defs.def_en: Something that is didactic is intended to teach people something, especially a moral lesson.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他在教学过程中侧重于灌输。
ext.ext_en: He is more didactic in his approach to the learning process.

defs.def_en: Someone who is didactic tells people things rather than letting them find things out or discussing things.
Gerontology is the study of the process by which we get old, how our bodies change, and the problems that old people have.

ext.ext_cn: 我非常同情生活在那些地方的人们。
ext.ext_en: I clearly empathize with the people who live in those neighborhoods...

ext.ext_cn: 父母必须发挥其天性，设身处地从子女的角度感受。
ext.ext_en: Parents must make use of their natural ability to empathize.

defs.def_en: If you empathize with someone, you understand their situation, problems, and feelings, because you have been in a similar situation.
A he-man is a strong and very masculine man.

ext.ext_cn: 就要摆脱过去殖民枷锁的国家
ext.ext_en: ...a country ready to throw off the shackles of its colonial past...

ext.ext_cn: 有一天，他突然开始消沉起来，从那以后，无论他走到哪儿也摆脱不了这种情绪。
ext.ext_en: One day depression descended upon him, and wherever he went after that he could never throw it off.

defs.def_en: If you throw off something that is restricting you or making you unhappy, you get rid of it.

ext.ext_cn: 传送带会发出刺耳的噪音并释放出乌黑的橡胶颗粒。
ext.ext_en: The belt may make a squealing noise and throw off sooty black particles of rubber...

ext.ext_cn: 那颗星的亮度增加了 30%并释放出大量辐射。
ext.ext_en: The star grew 30% brighter and threw off huge amounts of radiation.

defs.def_en: If something throws off a substance, it produces it and releases it into the air.

ext.ext_cn: 据说他骑车越过威斯康星州界，摆脱了追捕他的人。
ext.ext_en: He is said to have thrown off pursuers by pedaling across the Wisconsin state line...

ext.ext_cn: 他努力让警方无法跟踪他的情人。
ext.ext_en: He tried to throw police off the track of his lover.

defs.def_en: If you throw off people who are chasing you or trying to find you, you do something unexpected that makes them unable to catch you or find you.

defs.def_cn: 捣乱的人(或事物);搞破坏的人(或事物)

ext.ext_cn: 我是个无能的捣乱分子。如果我做不好，他们有什么理由表现好呢？
ext.ext_en: I was a talentless spoiler. If I couldn't be good, why should they?...

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以施加压力来确保叙利亚不在该地区扮演破坏分子的角色。
ext.ext_en: We could use pressure to make sure that Syria doesn't play the role of spoiler in the region.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as a spoiler, you mean that they try to spoil the performance of other people or things.

defs.def_cn: (飞机的)扰流器;(汽车的)气流偏导器
defs.def_en: A spoiler is an object which forms part of an aircraft's wings or part of the body of a car. It changes the flow of air around the vehicle, allowing an aircraft to change direction or making a car's forward movement more efficient.

defs.def_cn: the printed word 同 the written word
defs.def_en: The printed word is the same as the written word .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 正直的;正义的;正派的;（有时指）假正经的，道貌岸然的

ext.ext_cn: 你不怕被人看作是一个装腔作势的改革者？

ext.ext_en: All this helps children to develop an inquiring attitude to learning.

defs.def_en: If you have an inquiring mind, you have a great interest in learning new things.

ext.ext_en: ...an enquiring glance.

defs.def_en: If someone has an inquiring expression on their face, they are showing that they want to know something.

defs.def_cn: （政府或机构制订的）一揽子协议（或提议）
defs.def_en: A package deal is a set of offers or proposals which is made by a government or an organization, and which must be accepted or rejected as a whole.

ext.ext_en: The discrepancies resulted from different methods of computation...

ext.ext_en: He took a few notes and made computations.

defs.def_en: Computation is mathematical calculation.

ext.ext_en: The ethics committee may take a decision to admonish him or to censure him...

ext.ext_cn: 我不会擅自批评奥斯本恨他妈妈这件事。
ext.ext_en: I would not presume to censure Osborne for hating his mother.

defs.def_en: If you censure someone for something that they have done, you tell them that you strongly disapprove of it.
A car bomb is a bomb which is inside a car, van, or truck.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 肥沃的土地
ext.ext_en: ...fertile soil.

ext.ext_cn: 科克郡东部起伏的乡间沃土
ext.ext_en: ...the rolling fertile countryside of East Cork.

defs.def_en: Land or soil that is fertile is able to support the growth of a large number of strong healthy plants.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...a product of Flynn's fertile imagination...

ext.ext_cn: 一个棋手必须有丰富的想象力，并善于奇思妙想。
ext.ext_en: A chess player must have a fertile imagination and rich sense of fantasy.

defs.def_en: A fertile mind or imagination is able to produce a lot of good, original ideas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (环境或条件)易于…的，有助于…的，适于…的

ext.ext_cn: 易于滋生这种极端种族主义的温床
ext.ext_en: ...a fertile breeding ground for this kind of violent racism.

defs.def_en: A situation or environment that is fertile in relation to a particular activity or feeling encourages the activity or feeling.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 手术结果不可逆转，无法让她恢复生育能力。
ext.ext_en: The operation cannot be reversed to make her fertile again.

defs.def_en: A person or animal that is fertile is able to reproduce and have babies or young.

ext.ext_cn: 许多公司都勇敢地努力尝试节约能源，减少垃圾。
ext.ext_en: Many companies have struggled valiantly to use less energy and chuck out less rubbish.

defs.def_en: If you chuck something out, you throw it away, because you do not need it or cannot use it.

ext.ext_cn: 哪个校长只要犯了这样的错误都会被开除。
ext.ext_en: Any head teacher who made errors like this would be chucked out...

ext.ext_cn: 1960年，我被从伦敦公寓里赶了出去。
ext.ext_en: I was chucked out of my London flat in 1960...

defs.def_en: If a person is chucked out of a job, a place, or their home, they are forced by other people to leave.

ext.ext_cn: 烤面包机、水壶、滴滤式咖啡壶等厨用小家电
ext.ext_en: ...kitchen gadgets including toasters, kettles and percolators.

ext.ext_cn: 面向科技发烧友的最新玩意儿：可在上面用笔书写的袖珍电脑
ext.ext_en: ...the latest gadget for the technology obsessed: pocket-sized computers that you write on with a pen.

defs.def_en: A gadget is a small machine or device which does something useful. You sometimes refer to something as a gadget when you are suggesting that it  is complicated and unnecessary.

ext.ext_cn: 他对美国的态度表示严重关切。
ext.ext_en: He expressed grave concern at American attitudes...

ext.ext_cn: 萨姆纳会冲我们皱眉，做苦脸，竭力表示他无言的反对。
ext.ext_en: Sumner would greet us with frowns and grimaces, doing his best to express wordless disapproval...

defs.def_en: When you express an idea or feeling, or express yourself, you show what you think or feel.

ext.ext_cn: 离散带来的焦虑常常体现为对走失的孩子发火。
ext.ext_en: The anxiety of the separation often expresses itself as anger towards the child for getting lost.

defs.def_en: If an idea or feeling expresses itself in some way, it can be clearly seen in someone's actions or in its effects on a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以这样表示那个等式。
ext.ext_en: We can express that equation like that...

ext.ext_cn: 它是以百分比的形式表示的。
ext.ext_en: It is expressed as a percentage.

defs.def_en: In mathematics, if you express a quantity or mathematical problem in a particular way, you write it using particular symbols, figures, or equations.

ext.ext_cn: 遵照首相的明确指令，那艘船被击沉了。
ext.ext_en: The ship was sunk on express orders from the Prime Minister.

defs.def_en: An express command or order is one that is clearly and deliberately stated.

ext.ext_cn: 我已经买了我的第一架照相机，专门用来拍摄铁路。
ext.ext_en: I had obtained my first camera for the express purpose of taking railway photographs.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an express intention or purpose, you are emphasizing that it is a deliberate and specific one that you have before you do something.

ext.ext_cn: 提供传真特快专递服务。
ext.ext_en: A special express service is available by fax...

ext.ext_cn: 那是用快递寄给我们的。
ext.ext_en: It was sent to us by express mail.

defs.def_en: Express is used to describe special services which are provided by companies or organizations such as the Post Office, in which things are sent or done faster than usual for a higher price.

ext.ext_cn: 7点45分，开往吉隆坡的特快列车准时驶离新加坡火车站。
ext.ext_en: Punctually at 7.45, the express to Kuala Lumpur left Singapore station...

ext.ext_cn: 他已经登上了前往罗马的特快列车。
ext.ext_en: He had boarded an express for Rome.

defs.def_en: An express or an express train is a fast train which stops at very few stations.

defs.def_cn: 特快公共汽车（或长途汽车）;直达公共汽车（或长途汽车）
defs.def_en: An express is a fast bus or coach which goes from one place to another directly or with very few stops.

defs.def_cn: 放射治疗的;放射医学的

ext.ext_cn: 接受全面放射学检查的病人
ext.ext_en: ...patients subjected to extensive radiological examinations.

defs.def_en: Radiological means relating to radiology.

ext.ext_cn: 国家放射性材料保护委员会关于存放核废料的原则
ext.ext_en: ...the National Radiological Protection Board's guidelines for storing nuclear waste.

defs.def_en: Radiological means relating to radioactive materials.

defs.def_cn: （可供多人共浴的）热水澡桶，热水浴池
defs.def_en: A hot tub is a very large, round bath which several people can sit in together.

defs.def_cn: （政府开办的）收容中心，收容站
defs.def_en: A reception centre is a place where people who have no homes or are being looked after by the government can live until somewhere else is found for them to live.
A DNA test is a test in which someone's DNA is analysed, for example to see if they have committed a particular crime or are the parent of a particular child.

defs.def_cn: (神话中的)次神;(尤指)半神半人
defs.def_en: In mythology, a demigod is a less important god, especially one who is half god and half human.

defs.def_cn: 被神化的人，像神一样受人崇拜的人(如政治家、作家、音乐家等)
defs.def_en: If you describe a famous or important person such as a politician, writer, or musician as a demigod, you mean that you disapprove of the way in which people admire them and treat them like a god.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一些教会领袖明确表示支持肯尼亚的政治改革。
ext.ext_en: Some church leaders have been outspoken in their support for political reform in Kenya...

ext.ext_cn: 他公开抨击种族隔离制度。
ext.ext_en: He was an outspoken critic of apartheid.

defs.def_en: Someone who is outspoken gives their opinions about things openly and honestly, even if they are likely to shock or offend people.

ext.ext_cn: 所有相关人员都表现出了极大的勇气和决心。
ext.ext_en: Everyone concerned acted with great courage and determination...

ext.ext_cn: 他重申了他们要解决通货膨胀问题的决心。
ext.ext_en: He reaffirmed their determination to tackle inflation...

defs.def_en: See also:determine;Determination is the quality that you show when you have decided to do something and you will not let anything stop you.

ext.ext_cn: 那样做肯定会破坏经济、制造混乱。
ext.ext_en: That's a sure recipe for destroying the economy and creating chaos...

ext.ext_cn: 没有人在爆炸中受伤，但大楼遭到了彻底毁坏。
ext.ext_en: No one was injured in the explosion, but the building was completely destroyed...

defs.def_en: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我再年轻一些，或是再单纯一些，那些批评可能就会把我给毁了。
ext.ext_en: If I was younger or more naive, the criticism would have destroyed me.

defs.def_en: To destroy someone means to ruin their life or to make their situation impossible to bear.

defs.def_cn: 杀死，消灭（生病或具危险性的动物）

ext.ext_cn: 林赛没有受伤，但那匹马却不得不被人道毁灭。
ext.ext_en: Lindsay was unhurt but the horse had to be destroyed.

defs.def_en: If an animal is destroyed, it is killed, either because it is ill or because it is dangerous.

defs.def_cn: （警告、危险等）未受重视的，被忽视的

ext.ext_en: The advice of experts went unheeded...

ext.ext_en: He warned of the serious threat to global ecology which is going unheeded.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a warning or danger goes unheeded, you mean that it has not been taken seriously or dealt with.

ext.ext_cn: 病变的膀胱使他小便失禁。
ext.ext_en: His diseased bladder left him incontinent.

defs.def_en: Someone who is incontinent is unable to prevent urine or faeces coming out of their body.
A bluebottle is a large fly with a shiny dark-blue body.

defs.def_en: A teddy is the same as a teddy bear. Children often call their teddies 'Teddy' when they are talking to them or about them.

defs.def_cn: 忍冬（一种开黄色、粉色或白色芬芳花朵的攀缘植物）
defs.def_en: Honeysuckle is a climbing plant with sweet-smelling yellow, pink, or white flowers.

ext.ext_en: ...soft and glutinous mud.

defs.def_en: Something that is glutinous is very sticky.
Bullion is gold or silver, usually in the form of bars.
Anexaminee is someone who is taking an exam.

ext.ext_en: The paper has earned respect for its investigative journalism.

ext.ext_cn: 爱寻根究底的记者
ext.ext_en: ...an investigative reporter.

defs.def_en: Investigative work, especially journalism, involves investigating things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人吃惊的;令人惊奇的

ext.ext_en: It is not surprising that children learn to read at different rates...

ext.ext_en: A surprising number of customers order the same sandwich every day.

defs.def_en: Something that is surprising is unexpected or unusual and makes you feel surprised.

ext.ext_en: The jet-setting couple made frequent appearances in the gossip columns.

defs.def_en: A gossip column is a part of a newspaper or magazine where the activities and private lives of famous people are discussed.

defs.def_en: Your eyelids are the two pieces of skin which cover your eyes when they are closed.  →see: bat;

ext.ext_cn: 火柴点燃后在燃烧过程中释放能量。
ext.ext_en: The energy is released by combustion on the application of a match...

ext.ext_en: The two principal combustion products are water vapor and carbon dioxide.

defs.def_en: See also:internal combustion engine;Combustion is the act of burning something or the process of burning.

ext.ext_en: The steering and braking are exactly what you want from a sporty car.

defs.def_en: You can describe a car as sporty when it performs like a racing car but can be driven on normal roads.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Someone who is sporty likes playing sports.

ext.ext_cn: 她抿了一口水，润一下发干的喉咙。
ext.ext_en: She took a sip of water to moisten her dry throat.

ext.ext_cn: 沾湿的毛巾
ext.ext_en: ...a moistened flannel.

defs.def_en: To moisten something means to make it slightly wet.

ext.ext_cn: 对阴蒂的刺激
ext.ext_en: ...clitoral stimulation.

defs.def_en: Clitoral means concerned with or relating to the clitoris.

defs.def_cn: （帮助患者或伤者培养或恢复技能的）职业疗法

ext.ext_en: She will now begin occupational therapy to regain the use of her hands.

defs.def_en: Occupational therapy is a method of helping people who have been ill or injured to develop skills or get skills back by giving them certain activities to do.
