ext.ext_en: Police withheld the dead boy's name yesterday until relatives could be told...

ext.ext_cn: 向英国提供的经济援助已经被扣。
ext.ext_en: Financial aid for Britain has been withheld...

defs.def_en: If you withhold something that someone wants, you do not let them have it.

ext.ext_cn: 这条街上没有照明的路灯。
ext.ext_en: No streetlights illuminated the street...

ext.ext_cn: 叉状的闪电照亮了黑沉沉的天空。
ext.ext_en: The black sky was illuminated by forked lightning.

defs.def_en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

ext.ext_cn: 他们用游戏和图画来阐明他们的主题。
ext.ext_en: They use games and drawings to illuminate their subject.

defs.def_en: If you illuminate something that is unclear or difficult to understand, you make it clearer by explaining it carefully or giving information about it.

ext.ext_cn: 淡褐色蕾丝袖口
ext.ext_en: ...cuffs of ecru lace.

defs.def_en: Something that is ecru is pale, creamy white in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 下午5点02分，她拿着塑料考勤卡从银行打卡下班。
ext.ext_en: She had clocked out of her bank at 5.02pm using her plastic card.

defs.def_en: Clock out means the same as clock off .

ext.ext_cn: 沃克不得不把这个坏消息告诉希尔。
ext.ext_en: Walker had the unenviable task of breaking the bad news to Hill...

ext.ext_cn: 她白天忙着处理行政工作。
ext.ext_en: She used the day to catch up with administrative tasks.

defs.def_en: A task is an activity or piece of work which you have to do, usually as part of a larger project.

ext.ext_cn: 部长被指派去督查英国的援助资金是否已用到实处。
ext.ext_en: The minister was tasked with checking that British aid money was being spent wisely.

defs.def_en: If you are tasked with doing a particular activity or piece of work, someone in authority asks you to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 该国知识分子也因未能公开反对该政权受到了指责。
ext.ext_en: The country's intellectuals are also being taken to task for their failure to speak out against the regime.

defs.def_en: If you take someone to task, you criticize them or tell them off because of something bad or wrong that they have done.

ext.ext_cn: 从肩部到裙摆都被扯得粉碎的一件连衣裙
ext.ext_en: ...a dress rent asunder from shoulder to hem...

ext.ext_cn: 这场争论令华尔街分崩离析。
ext.ext_en: The debate is tearing Wall Street asunder.

defs.def_en: If something tears or is torn asunder, it is violently separated into two or more parts or pieces.
A telephone pole is a tall wooden pole with telephone wires attached to it, connecting several different buildings to the telephone system.

defs.def_cn: （通常指非法）为他人实施人流手术的人，为人堕胎者

ext.ext_cn: 她知道向谁去打听找一个为人堕胎的。
ext.ext_en: She knew who to ask about finding an abortionist.

defs.def_en: See also:anti-abortionist;An abortionist is someone who performs abortions, usually illegally.
A slug is a small slow-moving creature with a long soft body and no legs, like a snail without a shell.

ext.ext_cn: 埃德加喝了一大口。
ext.ext_en: Edgar took a slug of his drink.

defs.def_en: If you take a slug of an alcoholic drink, you take a large mouthful of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她重重地打在她的脸上。
ext.ext_en: She slugged her right in the face...

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得自己像被一根铅管击中了。
ext.ext_en: He felt as if he had been slugged by a piece of lead pipe.

defs.def_en: If you slug someone, you hit them hard.
A slug is a bullet.

ext.ext_cn: 4名候选人将在一场肮脏的竞选中一决高下。
ext.ext_en: Four candidates are slugging it out in a dirty campaign.

defs.def_en: If two or more people slug it out, they work very hard to try to be the one who is successful or has their ideas and wishes accepted.

ext.ext_cn: 事关紧急，我们不得不重新部署兵力。
ext.ext_en: We were forced urgently to redeploy our forces...

ext.ext_cn: 美国军队正对早先控制的地点重新布防。
ext.ext_en: US troops are redeploying to positions held earlier.

defs.def_en: If forces or troops are redeployed or if they redeploy, they go to new positions so that they are ready for action.

defs.def_cn: 重新安排；调度（资源或人力）；重新配置

ext.ext_cn: 那儿的一些工人将被调配到其他地点。
ext.ext_en: Some of the workers there will be redeployed to other sites...

ext.ext_cn: 这将给我们一个重新配置资源的机会。
ext.ext_en: It would give us an opportunity to redeploy our resources.

defs.def_en: If resources or workers are redeployed, they are used for a different purpose or task.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 重新兴起的;复兴的,复苏的

ext.ext_cn: 重新兴起的民族主义运动的威胁
ext.ext_en: ...the threat from the resurgent nationalist movement.

defs.def_en: You use resurgent to say that something is becoming stronger and more popular after a period when it has been weak and unimportant.

ext.ext_cn: 我妻子决定让我自己开店。
ext.ext_en: My wife decided I should have my own shop...

ext.ext_cn: 另一组被教会自己换药的病人
ext.ext_en: ...another group of patients who were taught to change their own dressings...

defs.def_en: You use own to indicate that something belongs to a particular person or thing.

defs.def_cn: 自己所用的；具有自己特点的；特有的

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮弗坚持要有自己的房间。
ext.ext_en: Jennifer insisted on her own room...

ext.ext_cn: 我让她用自己的方式告诉我那件事。
ext.ext_en: I let her tell me about it in her own way...

defs.def_en: You use own to indicate that something is used by, or is characteristic of, only one person, thing, or group.

defs.def_cn: 自己做的；单独干的；独立完成的

ext.ext_cn: 他们喜欢自己作决定。
ext.ext_en: They enjoy making their own decisions...

ext.ext_cn: 托尼还自己设计并盖好了房子。
ext.ext_en: Tony also built his own house from his own plans...

defs.def_en: You use own to indicate that someone does something without any help from other people.

ext.ext_cn: 他父亲在当地有一家酒馆。
ext.ext_en: His father owns a local pub...

ext.ext_cn: 现在英国至少有3家高尔夫球场为日本人所有。
ext.ext_en: At least three British golf courses are now owned by the Japanese.

defs.def_en: If you own something, it is your property.

ext.ext_cn: 他们还没有自己的国家。
ext.ext_en: They don't yet have a country to call their own...

ext.ext_cn: 我想要一个自己的窝儿。
ext.ext_en: I would like a place I could call my own.

defs.def_en: If you have something you can call your own, it belongs only to you, rather than being controlled by or shared with someone else.

defs.def_cn: （因情况适宜而）开始取得成功，开始进入（良好）状态

ext.ext_cn: 守门员开始进入状态，作出了一连串精彩的扑救。
ext.ext_en: The goalkeeper came into his own with a series of brilliant saves...

ext.ext_cn: 这是天竺葵和矮牵牛盛开的时节。
ext.ext_en: This is when geraniums and petunias come into their own.

defs.def_en: If someone or something comes into their own, they become very successful or start to perform very well because the circumstances are right.

ext.ext_cn: 伦肖揭示了20种女性用来报复旧情人的离奇手段。
ext.ext_en: Renshaw reveals 20 bizarre ways in which women have got their own back on former loved ones.

defs.def_en: If you get your own back on someone, you have your revenge on them because of something bad that they have done to you.

defs.def_cn: 使只与自己相关；使为自己所有

ext.ext_cn: 下面再次为您播放这首帕瓦罗蒂的标志性歌曲。
ext.ext_en: Here again is the song that Pavarotti has made his own.

defs.def_en: If you make something your own, you become involved in it in such a way that people think of it as being related only to you or belonging only to you, rather than to anyone else.

defs.def_cn: 属于自己的；关于自己的

ext.ext_cn: 你知道，我们也有自己的问题。
ext.ext_en: You see, we have a problem of our own...

ext.ext_cn: 他开始寻求思路创办自己的公司。
ext.ext_en: He set out in search of ideas for starting a company of his own.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a particular thing of their own, you mean that that thing belongs or relates to them, rather than to other people.

ext.ext_cn: 每支乐队都有自己独特的风格。
ext.ext_en: Groups have a personality of their own...

ext.ext_cn: 海鸥的鸣叫声给这片海港带来了迷人的独特气息。
ext.ext_en: The cries of the seagulls gave this part of the harbour a fascinating character all of its own.

defs.def_en: If someone or something has a particular quality or characteristic of their own, that quality or characteristic is especially theirs, rather than being shared by other things or people of that type.

ext.ext_cn: 他独自一人生活。
ext.ext_en: He lives on his own...

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉他我有多害怕自己一个人。
ext.ext_en: I told him how scared I was of being on my own...

defs.def_en: When you are on your own, you are alone.

ext.ext_cn: 我独立工作的时候效果最好。
ext.ext_en: I work best on my own.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子能独立完成的事情
ext.ext_en: ...the jobs your child can do on her own.

defs.def_en: If you do something on your own, you do it without any help from other people.

defs.def_cn: 傲慢；目中无人；颐指气使

ext.ext_cn: 他大摇大摆地在镇上四处晃悠，好像这是他的地盘。
ext.ext_en: He struts around town like he owns the place.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something as if they own the place or like they own the place, you are critical of them because they do it in a very arrogant way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 自从离婚后她一直在洛杉矶过着独居的生活。
ext.ext_en: She had been living a reclusive life in Los Angeles since her marriage broke up.

ext.ext_cn: 她病得越来越重，越来越孤僻。
ext.ext_en: She had become increasingly ill and reclusive.

defs.def_en: A reclusive person or animal lives alone and deliberately avoids the company of others.
If someone has travel sickness, they feel sick as a result of travelling in a vehicle.

defs.def_cn: 被围困的;孤立无援的;无法脱身的

ext.ext_cn: 无法脱离日益衰败的内城区的家庭
ext.ext_en: ...families marooned in decaying inner-city areas.

ext.ext_cn: 我由于膝伤暂时无法出门
ext.ext_en: ...temporarily marooned at home by my injured knee.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are marooned, you mean that you feel alone and helpless and you cannot escape from the place or situation you are in.

ext.ext_cn: 他作为大提琴演奏家的艺术造诣
ext.ext_en: ...his artistry as a cellist.

ext.ext_cn: 具有高超技巧和艺术造诣的人像雕塑家
ext.ext_en: ...portrait sculptors of considerable skill and artistry.

defs.def_en: Artistry is the creative skill of an artist, writer, actor, or musician.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·麦肯罗将球技发挥得淋漓尽致，从而击败了吉米·康纳斯，这在比赛中前所未见。
ext.ext_en: John McEnroe beat Jimmy Connors with the most complete display of artistry the game had ever seen...

ext.ext_cn: 茶叶加工对工艺和手法都有要求。
ext.ext_en: Tea processing requires both technique and artistry.

defs.def_en: You can use artistry to refer to a high level of skill in a sport or activity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们对这位老影星的无礼回绝
ext.ext_en: ...their boorish rejection of the ageing movie star.

defs.def_en: Boorish behaviour is rough, uneducated, and rude.

ext.ext_cn: 民防演习
ext.ext_en: ...a civil defence exercise.

defs.def_en: Civil defence is the organization and training of the ordinary people in a country so that they can help the armed forces, medical services, or police force, for example if the country is attacked by an enemy.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以往杯里的葡萄酒中掺点水，当两杯来喝。
ext.ext_en: You can water down a glass of wine and make it last twice as long...

ext.ext_cn: 我买了一种水性漆，然后决定加水进一步稀释。
ext.ext_en: I bought a water-based paint, then decided to water it down even more.

defs.def_en: If you water down a substance, for example food or drink, you add water to it to make it weaker.

defs.def_cn: 使(提议、演讲、声明等)语气缓和;使打折扣;削弱

ext.ext_cn: 影响养鸟者的立法提案的措词已经缓和一些了。
ext.ext_en: Proposed legislation affecting bird-keepers has been watered down.

defs.def_en: See also:watered-down;If something such as a proposal, speech, or statement is watered down, it is made much weaker and less forceful, or less likely to make people angry.
Anyways is a non-standard form of anyway.

ext.ext_cn: 对他们的宗教表示了深深的敬意
ext.ext_en: ...showing a deep reverence for their religion.

defs.def_en: Reverence for someone or something is a feeling of great respect for them.

ext.ext_cn: 他因为在走廊里讲话受到了一位老师的斥责。
ext.ext_en: He was reprimanded by a teacher for talking in the corridor...

ext.ext_cn: 她本想斥责他，但很快就被大声喝止了。
ext.ext_en: Her attempts to reprimand him were quickly shouted down.

defs.def_en: If someone is reprimanded, they are spoken to angrily or seriously for doing something wrong, usually by a person in authority.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 妒忌的；吃醋的；小心守护的

ext.ext_cn: 她妒忌得发疯，结果是大吵一架。
ext.ext_en: She got insanely jealous and there was a terrible fight.

defs.def_en: If someone is jealous, they feel angry or bitter because they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她忌妒他的富有。
ext.ext_en: She was jealous of his wealth...

ext.ext_cn: 你之所以妒忌是因为唱片公司拒绝接受你的想法。
ext.ext_en: You're jealous because the record company rejected your idea.

defs.def_en: If you are jealous of another person's possessions or qualities, you feel angry or bitter because you do not have them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那些鹿一直没有被驯服：你一靠近，它们就跑开。
ext.ext_en: The deer never became tame; they would run away if you approached them.

defs.def_en: A tame animal or bird is one that is not afraid of humans.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如今有些政治游行显得毫无激情。
ext.ext_en: Some of today's political demonstrations look rather tame...

ext.ext_cn: 这份报告平淡无奇。
ext.ext_en: The report was pretty tame stuff.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is tame, you are criticizing them for being weak and uninteresting, rather than forceful or shocking.

defs.def_cn: 驯化，驯服(野生动物或鸟)

ext.ext_cn: 据说亚马孙人最先驯化了马。
ext.ext_en: The Amazons were believed to have been the first to tame horses.

defs.def_en: If someone tames a wild animal or bird, they train it not to be afraid of humans and to do what they say.

ext.ext_cn: 调集了两个装甲兵团去威慑、控制人群。
ext.ext_en: Two regiments of cavalry were called out to tame the crowds.

defs.def_en: If you tame someone or something that is dangerous, uncontrolled, or likely to cause trouble, you bring them under control.

ext.ext_cn: 其中7名渔夫因海盗行为遭正式起诉。
ext.ext_en: Seven of the fishermen have been formally charged with piracy.

defs.def_en: Piracy is robbery at sea carried out by pirates.

defs.def_cn: 盗版行为；侵犯版权；非法翻印

ext.ext_cn: 对书籍和电影免遭盗版的保护
ext.ext_en: ...protection against piracy of books and films.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the illegal copying of things such as video tapes and computer programs as piracy .

ext.ext_cn: 他们一直用小麦交换棉花和木材。
ext.ext_en: They have been bartering wheat for cotton and timber...

ext.ext_cn: 市场和街道上挤满了前来做物物交换的人。
ext.ext_en: The market-place and street were crowded with those who'd  come to barter...

defs.def_en: If you barter goods, you exchange them for other goods, rather than selling them for money.

ext.ext_cn: 他们靠边停车熄火。
ext.ext_en: They pulled over and shut off the engine...

ext.ext_cn: 看在上帝的份上，谁去关掉那个闹钟吧。
ext.ext_en: Will somebody for God's sake shut that alarm off.

defs.def_en: If you shut off something such as an engine or an electrical item, you turn it off to stop it working.

defs.def_cn: (通常因沮丧而)躲开他人，不见人，不与人来往

ext.ext_cn: 比利往往更多地将事情藏在心里，把自己封闭起来。
ext.ext_en: Billy tends to keep things to himself more and shut himself off...

ext.ext_cn: 她不参加任何形式的社交活动。
ext.ext_en: She shut herself off from all the social aspects of life.

defs.def_en: If you shut yourself off, you avoid seeing other people, usually because you are feeling depressed.

ext.ext_cn: 州水利工程项目已切断了对农场主的所有供水。
ext.ext_en: The State Water Project has shut off all supplies to farmers.

defs.def_en: If an official organization shuts off the supply of something, they no longer send it to the people they supplied in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 与英国海关截获的那些物品相似的部件
ext.ext_en: ...components similar to those seized by British customs.

ext.ext_cn: 海关官员
ext.ext_en: ...customs officers.

defs.def_en: Customs is the official organization responsible for collecting taxes on goods coming into a country and preventing illegal goods from being brought in.

ext.ext_cn: 他步行通过海关。
ext.ext_en: He walked through customs.

defs.def_en: Customs is the place where people arriving from a foreign country have to declare goods that they bring with them.
Customs duties are taxes that people pay for importing and exporting goods.
Push-ups are exercises to strengthen your arms and chest muscles. They are done by lying with your face towards the floor and pushing with your hands to raise your body until your arms are straight.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对被跟踪几乎到了神经过敏的程度。
ext.ext_en: He was almost neurotic about being followed...

ext.ext_cn: 也会对大脑产生不良影响，如焦虑和神经质的行为。
ext.ext_en: There are also unpleasant brain effects such as anxiety and neurotic behaviour.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is neurotic, you mean that they are always frightened or worried about things that you consider unimportant.

ext.ext_cn: 出口商品不需要交购买税。
ext.ext_en: Purchase tax was not payable on goods for export.

defs.def_en: If an amount of money is payable, it has to be paid or it can be paid.

ext.ext_cn: 写封信，附上一张支付给Cobuild有限公司的支票。
ext.ext_en: Write, enclosing a cheque made payable to Cobuild Limited.

defs.def_en: If a cheque or postal order is made payable to you, it has your name written on it to indicate that you are the person who will receive the money.

ext.ext_cn: 导演发号施令，拍摄现场的一切都必须得到他们的许可。
ext.ext_en: Directors call the shots and nothing happens on set without their say-so.

defs.def_en: If you do something on someone's say-so, they tell you to do it or they give you permission to do it.
See also:water vole;A vole is a small animal that looks like a mouse but has very small ears and a short tail. Voles usually live in fields or near rivers.

defs.def_cn: 使精简;使缩小;使小型化

ext.ext_cn: 美国制造商们一直在缩小他们工厂的规模。
ext.ext_en: American manufacturing organizations have been downsizing their factories.

ext.ext_cn: 当今规模变小的经济
ext.ext_en: ...today's downsized economy.

defs.def_en: To downsize something such as a business or industry means to make it smaller.
Anglicanism is the beliefs and practices of the Church of England, and of the churches related to it.
A sermon is a talk on a religious or moral subject that is given by a member of the clergy as part of a church service.

ext.ext_cn: 他斤斤计较，很不大度。
ext.ext_en: He was an unforgiving man who never forgot a slight...

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得人性的弱点很可爱，但不能容忍惺惺作态。
ext.ext_en: He finds human foibles endearing, but is unforgiving of pretension.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as unforgiving, you mean that they are unwilling to forgive other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （形势或活动）无情的，难以应付的，不利的

ext.ext_cn: 商场如战场，竞争激烈，不近人情。
ext.ext_en: Business is a competitive activity. It is very fierce and very unforgiving.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation or activity as unforgiving, you mean that it causes a lot of people to experience great difficulty or failure, even people who deserve to succeed.

ext.ext_cn: 他们等了约两小时。
ext.ext_en: They waited for about two hours...

ext.ext_cn: 我那天晚上只睡了大约半个小时。
ext.ext_en: I only slept about half an hour that night.

defs.def_en: An hour is a period of sixty minutes.

ext.ext_cn: 去那里要花很长时间。
ext.ext_en: Getting there would take hours.

defs.def_en: People say that something takes or lasts hours to emphasize that it takes or lasts a very long time, or what seems like a very long time.
A clock that strikes the hour strikes when it is exactly one o'clock, two o'clock, and so on.

ext.ext_cn: 处决他的时间
ext.ext_en: ...the hour of his execution...

ext.ext_cn: 即将到来的暴风雨使得天空看起来比平时这个时候更昏暗。
ext.ext_en: The gathering storm had made the day even darker than was usual at this hour.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a particular time or moment as a particular hour .

ext.ext_cn: 他回忆起她在丈夫困难之时的忠贞奉献。
ext.ext_en: He recalled her devotion to her husband during his hour of need.

ext.ext_cn: 我职业生涯中最黑暗的时期
ext.ext_en: ...the darkest hour of my professional life.

defs.def_en: If you refer, for example, to someone's hour of need or hour of happiness, you are referring to the time in their life when they are or were experiencing that condition or feeling.

defs.def_cn: （每天发生或进行某事的）特定时间，固定时间

ext.ext_cn: 夜晚
ext.ext_en: ...the hours of darkness...

ext.ext_cn: 上班时间打这个电话给我们。
ext.ext_en: Phone us on this number during office hours.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the period of time during which something happens or operates each day as the hours during which it happens or operates.

ext.ext_cn: 我的工作时间相当不固定。
ext.ext_en: I worked quite irregular hours...

ext.ext_cn: 这份工作很轻松，工作时间也很合适。
ext.ext_en: The job was easy; the hours were good.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the hours involved in a job, you are talking about how long you spend each week doing it and when you do it.

defs.def_cn: 下班后;营业（或办公、学习）时间以后

ext.ext_cn: 钢厂工人下班后去放松一下的当地餐馆
ext.ext_en: ...a local restaurant where steel workers unwind after hours...

ext.ext_cn: 戴利在学生放学后继续开放学校，把它兼作社区中心。
ext.ext_en: Daly kept this school open after hours so it doubled as a community center.

defs.def_en: See also:after-hours;If you do something after hours, you do it outside normal business hours or the time when you are usually at work.

defs.def_cn: 在（某一时段的）任何时刻

ext.ext_cn: 她不希望自己14岁的女儿凌晨才回家。
ext.ext_en: She didn't want her fourteen-year-old daughter coming home at all hours of the morning.

ext.ext_cn: 邻居的汽车警报器没日没夜响个不停。
ext.ext_en: ...a neighbour's car alarm going off at all hours of the day and night.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens at all hours of the day or night, you disapprove of it happening at the time that it does or as often as it does.

ext.ext_cn: 吉布斯于昨天凌晨被捕。
ext.ext_en: Gibbs was arrested in the early hours of yesterday morning.

defs.def_en: If something happens in the early hours or in the small hours, it happens in the early morning after midnight.

ext.ext_cn: 他和我妈妈每天晚上都吵个不停。
ext.ext_en: He and my mom were arguing every night, hour after hour.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something hour after hour, you are emphasizing that they do it continually for a long time.
If something happens on the hour, it happens every hour at, for example, nine o'clock, ten o'clock, and so on, and not at any number of minutes past an hour.

defs.def_cn: 整点差…分/ 整点过…分
defs.def_en: If you want to state the time exactly, you can give a number of minutes followed by before the hour or past the hour .

defs.def_cn: 在通常营业（或工作、学习）时间之外

ext.ext_cn: 教师拒绝课余安排体育比赛，因为他们不会获得薪酬。
ext.ext_en: Teachers refused to run out of hours sports matches because they weren't being paid.

defs.def_en: Something that happens out of hours happens at a time that is not during the usual hours of business or work.

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名外交官的儿子，他一生有大量的时间在周游世界。
ext.ext_en: The son of a diplomat, he has spent much of his life globe-trotting.

defs.def_en: If someone spends their time globe-trotting, they spend a lot of time travelling to different parts of the world.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不稳定的;难以预测的；不规则的

ext.ext_cn: 阿根廷动荡不定的通货膨胀率可能会破坏那些计划。
ext.ext_en: Argentina's erratic inflation rate threatens to upset the plans.

ext.ext_cn: 那个家庭发生的稀奇古怪的事情
ext.ext_en: ...the family's erratic affairs.

defs.def_en: Something that is erratic does not follow a regular pattern, but happens at unexpected times or moves along in an irregular way.

defs.def_cn: 墓地；坟地；（尤指）古老的墓地

ext.ext_cn: 一块古老的墓地
ext.ext_en: ...an ancient burial ground.

defs.def_en: A burial ground is a place where bodies are buried, especially an ancient place.

defs.def_cn: 亲子假（通常为无薪假期）

ext.ext_cn: 父母可以休13个星期的亲子假。
ext.ext_en: Parents are entitled to 13 weeks' parental  leave.

defs.def_en: Parental leave is time away from work, usually without pay, that parents are allowed in order to look after their children.

ext.ext_cn: 第一笔10%的法律费用将由投保人支付。
ext.ext_en: The first 10 per cent of legal fees will be paid by the policy-holder.

defs.def_en: A policyholder is a person who has an insurance policy with an insurance company.

ext.ext_cn: 警方说他们有信心抓住那个持枪歹徒。
ext.ext_en: Police say they are confident of catching the gunman...

ext.ext_cn: 这条鱼你在哪儿逮的？
ext.ext_en: Where did you catch the fish?...

defs.def_en: If you catch a person or animal, you capture them after chasing them, or by using a trap, net, or other device.

ext.ext_cn: 我跳起来接球，结果摔了个跟头。
ext.ext_en: I jumped up to catch a ball and fell over.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有接住球，比赛输了。
ext.ext_en: He missed the catch and the match was lost.

defs.def_en: If you catch an object that is moving through the air, you seize it with your hands.

ext.ext_cn: 莉兹一把抓住了他的胳膊。
ext.ext_en: Liz caught his arm...

ext.ext_cn: 他跪在她的旁边，双手握住她的一只手。
ext.ext_en: He knelt beside her and caught her hand in both of his...

defs.def_en: If you catch a part of someone's body, you take or seize it with your hand, often in order to stop them going somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 那狠狠的一巴掌差点搧在他脸上。
ext.ext_en: The stinging slap almost caught his face...

ext.ext_cn: 也许我的胳膊肘碰到了他，但那是无意的。
ext.ext_en: I may have caught him with my elbow but it was just an accident...

defs.def_en: If one thing catches another, it hits it accidentally or manages to hit it.

ext.ext_cn: 她的脚踝被树根绊了一下，差点摔倒。
ext.ext_en: Her ankle caught on a root, and she almost lost her balance...

ext.ext_cn: 有个男的一只脚绞进剪草机里了。
ext.ext_en: A man caught his foot in the lawnmower.

defs.def_en: If something catches on or in an object or if an object catches something, it accidentally becomes attached to the object or stuck in it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们时间充裕得很，足够安东尼赶上渡船。
ext.ext_en: We were in plenty of time for Anthony to catch the ferry...

ext.ext_cn: 他打了辆出租车去哈罗德百货商店。
ext.ext_en: He caught a taxi to Harrods.

defs.def_en: When you catch a bus, train, or plane, you get on it in order to travel somewhere.

defs.def_cn: 撞见，当场抓住(某人做坏事)

ext.ext_cn: 他撞见一个青年正在撬车。
ext.ext_en: He caught a youth breaking into a car...

ext.ext_cn: 我不希望看见你为了出风头而去抢镜头。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to catch you pushing yourself into the picture to get some personal publicity...

defs.def_en: If you catch someone doing something wrong, you see or find them doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 我突然发觉自己几乎同情起可怜的劳伦斯先生来了。
ext.ext_en: I caught myself feeling almost sorry for poor Mr Laurence.

defs.def_en: If you catch yourself doing something, especially something surprising, you suddenly become aware that you are doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 她转过身来，看见母亲脸上迷惑的表情。
ext.ext_en: As she turned back she caught the puzzled look on her mother's face...

ext.ext_cn: 他在商店橱窗里瞥见了一眼那个人的脸。
ext.ext_en: He caught a glimpse of the man's face in a shop window.

defs.def_en: If you catch something or catch a glimpse of it, you notice it or manage to see it briefly.

ext.ext_cn: 他听到一声微弱的叫声。
ext.ext_en: His ears caught a faint cry...

ext.ext_cn: 我没有听清你的名字。
ext.ext_en: I do not believe I caught your name...

defs.def_en: If you catch something that someone has said, you manage to hear it.

defs.def_cn: 观看，收看，收听(电视或电台节目)

ext.ext_cn: 比尔打开收音机，收听本地新闻。
ext.ext_en: Bill turns on the radio to catch the local news...

ext.ext_cn: 展览在德罗伊特威奇一直持续到5月24日。从6月5日起，还可以在莱姆斯特参观该展览。
ext.ext_en: The exhibition is on at Droitwich until May 24. You can also catch it at Leominster from June 5.

defs.def_en: If you catch a TV or radio programme or an event, you manage to see or listen to it.

ext.ext_cn: 我拨了伊丽莎白的号码，心里想或许能赶在她去上班前联系到她。
ext.ext_en: I dialled Elizabeth's number thinking I might catch her before she left for work...

ext.ext_cn: 喂，多尔夫，可见着你了。
ext.ext_en: Hello, Dolph. Glad I caught you.

defs.def_en: If you catch someone,  you manage to contact or meet them to talk to them, especially when they are just about to go somewhere else.

defs.def_cn: 使惊慌失措;使措手不及

ext.ext_cn: 看上去，她好像被摄影师搞了个猝不及防。
ext.ext_en: She looked as if the photographer had caught her by surprise...

ext.ext_cn: 对不起，我真的没什么好说的。你问得不是时候。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry but I just cannot say anything. You've caught me at a bad time...

defs.def_en: If something or someone catches you by surprise or at a bad time, you were not expecting them or do not feel able to deal with them.

ext.ext_cn: 我的鞋子引起了他的注意。
ext.ext_en: My shoes caught his attention...

ext.ext_cn: 有个人影在走道里一闪而过，引起了他的注意。
ext.ext_en: A quick movement across the aisle caught his eye.

defs.def_en: If something catches your attention or your eye, you notice it or become interested in it.

ext.ext_cn: 无疑，普金先生的讲话充分反映了大多数代表的心情。
ext.ext_en: There's no doubt Mr Putin's speech caught the mood of most deputies.

defs.def_en: If someone or something catches a mood or an atmosphere, they successfully represent it or reflect it.

ext.ext_cn: 他出岛捕鱼时，赶上一场暴风雨，差点淹死。
ext.ext_en: When he was fishing off the island he was caught in a storm and almost drowned...

ext.ext_cn: 到该地区游玩的人碰上警察和骚乱分子交战。
ext.ext_en: Visitors to the area were caught between police and the rioters.

defs.def_en: If you are caught in a storm or other unpleasant situation, it happens when you cannot avoid its effects.

defs.def_cn: (在两难中)不知如何选择，不知所措

ext.ext_cn: 争论双方使约旦领导人左右为难。
ext.ext_en: The Jordanian leader is caught between both sides in the dispute...

ext.ext_cn: 她不知是该妒忌还是该羡慕。
ext.ext_en: She was caught between envy and admiration.

defs.def_en: If you are caught between two alternatives or two people, you do not know which one to choose or follow.

ext.ext_cn: 压力越大，越有可能患感冒。
ext.ext_en: The more stress you are under, the more likely you are to catch a cold.

defs.def_en: If you catch a cold or a disease, you become ill with it.

ext.ext_cn: 鱼盛在一个大盘子里，以防汤汁洒出来。
ext.ext_en: The fish is laid out on a large serving plate to catch the juices.

ext.ext_cn: 特制的切面包板，有个能接住面包屑的槽
ext.ext_en: ...a specially designed breadboard with a tray to catch the crumbs.

defs.def_en: To catch liquids or small pieces that fall from somewhere means to collect them in a container.

ext.ext_cn: 他们看到船上的大炮在月光下熠熠生辉。
ext.ext_en: They saw the ship's guns, catching the light of the moon...

defs.def_en: If something catches the light or if the light catches it, it reflects the light and looks bright or shiny.

ext.ext_cn: 一阵风将降落伞吹远。
ext.ext_en: A gust of wind caught the parachute.

defs.def_en: If the wind or water catches something, it carries or pushes it along.

ext.ext_cn: 她摆弄着包上的搭扣。
ext.ext_en: She fiddled with the catch of her bag...

ext.ext_cn: 给窗户装上安全锁或窗栓。
ext.ext_en: Fit windows with safety locks or catches.

defs.def_en: A catch on a window, door, or container is a device that fastens it.

ext.ext_cn: 圈套在于你是在挣钱糊口，但食宿其实有可能非常简单。
ext.ext_en: The catch is that you work for your supper, and the food and accommodation can be very basic...

ext.ext_cn: “这钱归你，你该拿这个钱。”——“搞什么名堂？”
ext.ext_en: 'It's your money. You deserve it.' — 'What's the catch?'

defs.def_en: A catch is a hidden problem or difficulty in a plan or an offer that seems surprisingly good.

ext.ext_cn: 捕获的鱼里有一条重逾18磅。
ext.ext_en: The catch included one fish over 18 pounds.

defs.def_en: When people have been fishing, their catch is the total number of fish that they have caught.

ext.ext_cn: 我当时和他陷入热恋，我的朋友们都说能找到他是我的福气。
ext.ext_en: I was so in love with him and all my friends said what a good catch he was.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a good catch, you mean that they have lots of good qualities and you think their partner or employer is very lucky to have found them.
Catch is a game in which children throw a ball to each other.
Catch is a game in which one child chases other children and tries to touch or catch one of them.

ext.ext_cn: 我绝不会说他坏话的。
ext.ext_en: You won't catch me giving him a bad review!...

ext.ext_cn: 我可以告诉你，你永远别想在那里看见我。
ext.ext_en: You wouldn't catch me in there, I can tell you.

defs.def_en: You can say things such as 'You wouldn't catch me doing that' to emphasize that you would never do a particular thing.

defs.def_cn: 使猝不及防；使极其尴尬;使突陷窘境

ext.ext_cn: 顶头上司出了大洋相，当兵的最高兴了。
ext.ext_en: It makes soldiers happy to know that somebody right at the top has been caught with his trousers down...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得我们让他们下不了台了。他们有点不知所措。
ext.ext_en: I think we caught them with their pants down. They're a bit confused.

defs.def_en: If someone is caught with their pants down, something happens that they are not prepared for and that reveals something embarrassing or shocking about them. In British English, you can also say that they are caught with their trousers down .

defs.def_cn: (用于 health, fashion, politically，environmentally 等词后构成形容词)表示“注重…的”，“关注…的”

ext.ext_cn: 如今，我们都越来越注重健康。
ext.ext_en: We're all becoming increasingly health-conscious these days...

ext.ext_cn: 关注环境的德国人对汽车造成的污染十分担心。
ext.ext_en: Environmentally-conscious Germans are worried about the pollution the car produces.

defs.def_en: -conscious combines with words such as 'health', 'fashion', 'politically', and 'environmentally' to form adjectives which describe someone who believes that the aspect of life indicated is important.

defs.def_cn: 温迪屋( 供孩子玩耍的游戏室)
defs.def_en: A Wendy house is a small toy house for a child to play in.

defs.def_cn: (对机构、地方、体系等的)控制权，支配权

ext.ext_cn: 这次改组涉及龙森先生放弃对公司的控制权。
ext.ext_en: The restructuring involves Mr Ronson giving up control of the company...

ext.ext_cn: 他这届政府的首要目标是确立对共和国领土的控制权。
ext.ext_en: The first aim of his government would be to establish control over the republic's territory.

defs.def_en: Control of an organization, place, or system is the power to make all the important decisions about the way that it is run.

ext.ext_cn: 他的汽车失控了。
ext.ext_en: He lost control of his car...

ext.ext_cn: 有的老师比小学生的父母更能管得住他们。
ext.ext_en: Some teachers have more control over pupils than their parents have.

defs.def_en: If you have control of something or someone, you are able to make them do what you want them to do.

ext.ext_cn: 他的脾气很坏，有时会完全失控。
ext.ext_en: He had a terrible temper, and sometimes he would completely lose control...

ext.ext_cn: 他正努力克制自己。
ext.ext_en: He was working hard to keep control of himself.

defs.def_en: If you show control, you prevent yourself behaving in an angry or emotional way.

ext.ext_cn: 他现在掌管着加州南部最大的零售发展企业。
ext.ext_en: He now controls the largest retail development empire in southern California...

ext.ext_cn: 当时几乎所有的拉丁美洲国家都由独裁者统治。
ext.ext_en: Almost all of the countries in Latin America were controlled by dictators...

defs.def_en: The people who control an organization or place have the power to take all the important decisions about the way that it is run.

defs.def_cn: 控制，操纵(设备、过程、系统等)

ext.ext_cn: 控制大门的计算机系统
ext.ext_en: ...a computerised system to control the gates...

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们很快将能通过操控人类基因来控制衰老过程。
ext.ext_en: Scientists would soon be able to manipulate human genes to control the ageing process.

defs.def_en: To control a piece of equipment, process, or system means to make it work in the way that you want it to work.

defs.def_cn: 管制，限定，控制(价格、工资、活动等)

ext.ext_cn: 联邦政府试图控制日益高涨的医疗保健费用。
ext.ext_en: The federal government tried to control rising health-care costs.

ext.ext_cn: 控制非法采矿的措施
ext.ext_en: ...measures to control illegal mining.

defs.def_en: When a government controls prices, wages, or the activity of a particular group, it uses its power to restrict them.

ext.ext_cn: 乔得到的建议是要学会控制自己的情绪。
ext.ext_en: Jo was advised to learn to control herself...

ext.ext_cn: 我就是不能克制自己的脾气。
ext.ext_en: I just couldn't control my temper.

defs.def_en: If you control yourself, or if you control your feelings, voice, or expression, you make yourself behave calmly even though you are feeling angry, excited, or upset.

ext.ext_cn: 控制环境污染的需要
ext.ext_en: ...the need to control environmental pollution...

ext.ext_cn: 最大的任务之一就是控制疟疾的蔓延。
ext.ext_en: One of the biggest tasks will be to control the spread of malaria.

defs.def_en: To control something dangerous means to prevent it from becoming worse or from spreading.

defs.def_cn: 控制按钮;控制装置;操纵装置

ext.ext_cn: 我练习操作这些控制装置。
ext.ext_en: I practised operating the controls.

ext.ext_cn: 控制盒
ext.ext_en: ...the control box.

defs.def_en: A control is a device such as a switch or lever which you use in order to operate a machine or other piece of equipment.

ext.ext_cn: 评论家们质疑物价管制措施是否会有用。
ext.ext_en: Critics question whether price controls would do any good...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的会谈预计会集中讨论军备控制问题。
ext.ext_en: Their talks are expected to focus on arms control...

defs.def_en: Controls are the methods that a government uses to restrict increases, for example in prices, wages, or weapons.

ext.ext_cn: 他很顺利地通过了护照检查处。
ext.ext_en: He went straight through Passport Control without incident.

ext.ext_cn: 关于取消边界检查站的一项协议
ext.ext_en: ...an agreement to abolish border controls.

defs.def_en: Control is used to refer to a place where your documents or luggage are officially checked when you enter a foreign country.

ext.ext_cn: 熊熊燃烧的大火正在失去控制。
ext.ext_en: The fire is burning out of control...

ext.ext_cn: 我成天和那些负债累累、无力偿还的顾客们打交道。
ext.ext_en: I'm dealing with customers all the time who have let their debts get out of control.

defs.def_en: If something is out of control, no-one has any power over it.

ext.ext_cn: 局势已经得到控制。
ext.ext_en: The situation is under control...

ext.ext_cn: 政府必须采取行动，才能使目前的暴力行为得到控制。
ext.ext_en: If the current violence is to be brought under control, the government needs to act.

defs.def_en: If something harmful is under control, it is being dealt with successfully and is unlikely to cause any more harm.

defs.def_cn: 不考虑…的;不顾…的;不受…影响的

ext.ext_cn: 他们承诺建立一个不分种族出身、全民平等的社会
ext.ext_en: ...their commitment to a society based on equality for all citizens irrespective of ethnic origin...

ext.ext_cn: 这项服务应该面向所有人,不管他们是否负担得起。
ext.ext_en: This service should be available to everybody, irrespective of whether they can afford it.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens or should happen irrespective of a particular thing, you mean that it is not affected or should not be affected by that thing.

defs.def_cn: 强烈反应；强烈抵制；激烈反对

ext.ext_cn: 男性对女权运动的强烈抵制
ext.ext_en: ...the male backlash against feminism.

ext.ext_cn: 右翼的激烈反对
ext.ext_en: ...a right-wing backlash.

defs.def_en: A backlash against a tendency or recent development in society or politics, is a sudden, strong reaction against it.

ext.ext_cn: 他说现在还无法预料最终的结局。
ext.ext_en: He said it is still not possible to predict the ultimate outcome...

ext.ext_cn: 最终目的是为了进一步拓展该网络。
ext.ext_en: The ultimate aim is to expand the network further.

defs.def_en: You use ultimate to describe the final result or aim of a long series of events.

defs.def_cn: 最根本的；最基础的；最原始的

ext.ext_cn: 植物是所有食物的最根本来源。
ext.ext_en: Plants are the ultimate source of all foodstuffs...

ext.ext_cn: 出事的最根本原因似乎在于那场广告宣传活动。
ext.ext_en: The ultimate cause of what's happened seems to have been the advertising campaign.

defs.def_en: You use ultimate to describe the original source or cause of something.

defs.def_cn: 最重要的；最强大的；至高的

ext.ext_cn: 中央政府的至高权力
ext.ext_en: ...the ultimate power of the central government...

ext.ext_cn: 当然，拥有最高权力者依然是总统。
ext.ext_en: Of course, the ultimate authority remained the presidency...

defs.def_en: You use ultimate to describe the most important or powerful thing of a particular kind.

defs.def_cn: 极端的；极度的；令人极其不快的

ext.ext_cn: 在执行任务的过程中被免职，这对一位船长来说是莫大的耻辱。
ext.ext_en: Being removed from his post during operations is the ultimate humiliation for a ship's captain.

ext.ext_cn: 背叛是最不可饶恕的罪孽。
ext.ext_en: Treachery was the ultimate sin...

defs.def_en: You use ultimate to describe the most extreme and unpleasant example of a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他是最最典型的英国绅士。
ext.ext_en: He is the ultimate English gentleman...

ext.ext_cn: 一般认为，鱼子酱和冰镇牡蛎是顶级美味。
ext.ext_en: Caviar and oysters on ice are generally considered the ultimate luxury foods.

defs.def_en: You use ultimate to describe the best possible example of a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 芭蕾舞在人类的动作中可谓优雅至极。
ext.ext_en: Ballet is the ultimate in human movement...

ext.ext_cn: 该酒店极尽奢华。
ext.ext_en: This hotel is the ultimate in luxury...

defs.def_en: The ultimate in something is the best or most advanced example of it.

ext.ext_cn: 麦田
ext.ext_en: ...fields of corn...

ext.ext_cn: 他将谷仓装满了谷物。
ext.ext_en: He filled the barn to the roof with corn.

defs.def_en: Corn is used to refer to crops such as wheat and barley. It can also be used to refer to the seeds from these plants.

ext.ext_cn: 艾奥瓦州农田里成排的玉米
ext.ext_en: ...rows of corn in an Iowa field.

defs.def_en: Corn is the same as maize .
Corns are small, painful areas of hard skin which can form on your foot, especially near your toes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 愚蠢的；无能的；痴迷于电脑的

ext.ext_cn: 在音像店上班的电脑迷
ext.ext_en: ...that geeky guy from the video-store counter.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as geeky, you think they look or behave like a geek.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不相关的细节
ext.ext_en: ...irrelevant details...

ext.ext_cn: 政府认定他们的证词与案件不相关。
ext.ext_en: The government decided that their testimony would be irrelevant to the case.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a fact or remark as irrelevant, you mean that it is not connected with what you are discussing or dealing with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们以往辛苦学得的技能没什么大用处。
ext.ext_en: Their old hard-won skills were irrelevant...

ext.ext_cn: 题材的选择无关紧要。
ext.ext_en: The choice of subject matter is irrelevant...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is irrelevant, you mean that it is not important in a situation.
Cream cheese is a very rich, soft white cheese.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (事实、局势或经历)不悦的，沮丧的，有害的

ext.ext_cn: 来自海外的消息特别不容乐观。
ext.ext_en: The news from overseas is overwhelmingly negative...

ext.ext_cn: 这一切对刑事司法制度产生了极坏的影响。
ext.ext_en: All this had an extremely negative effect on the criminal justice system.

defs.def_en: A fact, situation, or experience that is negative is unpleasant, depressing, or harmful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 被问及你对自己目前工作的看法时，无论如何不要流露出消极情绪。
ext.ext_en: When asked for your views about your current job, on no account must you be negative about it...

ext.ext_cn: 媒体为什么对这座光彩夺目的城市持如此悲观的看法？
ext.ext_en: Why does the media present such a negative view of this splendid city?

defs.def_en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

defs.def_cn: (回答或决定)否定的，表示否认的

ext.ext_cn: 韦拉亚提医生给了一个含糊而否定的回答。
ext.ext_en: Dr Velayati gave a vague but negative response...

ext.ext_cn: 一旦得到否定裁决，申请人就失去了比利时法律的保护。
ext.ext_en: Upon a negative decision, the applicant loses the protection offered by Belgian law...

defs.def_en: A negative reply or decision indicates the answer 'no'.

defs.def_cn: 否定词;否定语;否定表示

ext.ext_cn: 说到遵循健康饮食习惯，我们过去听到的都是否定的说法。
ext.ext_en: In the past we have heard only negatives when it came to following a healthy diet.

defs.def_en: A negative is a word, expression, or gesture that means 'no' or 'not'.
In grammar, a negative clause contains a word such as 'not', 'never', or 'no-one'.

defs.def_cn: (医学检查或科学试验)呈阴性的，结果为否定的

ext.ext_cn: 到目前为止，参加测试的有57人，测试结果均呈阴性。
ext.ext_en: So far 57 have taken the test and all have been negative.

ext.ext_cn: 阴性测试结果
ext.ext_en: ...negative test results.

defs.def_en: If a medical test or scientific test is negative, it shows no evidence of the medical condition or substance that you are looking for.
In photography, a negative is an image that shows dark areas as light and light areas as dark. Negatives are made from a camera film, and are used to print photographs.

ext.ext_cn: 以微弱负电流刺激疼得最厉害的部位。
ext.ext_en: Stimulate the site of greatest pain with a small negative current.

defs.def_en: A negative charge or current has the same electrical charge as an electron.

ext.ext_cn: 最差的学生可能会以负分收场。
ext.ext_en: The weakest students can end up with a negative score.

defs.def_en: A negative number, quantity, or measurement is less than zero.

ext.ext_cn: 委员会对那些问题的答复是否定的。
ext.ext_en: The Council answered those questions in the negative...

ext.ext_cn: 79人投赞成票，没有人投反对票。
ext.ext_en: Seventy-nine voted in the affirmative, and none in the negative.

defs.def_en: If an answer is in the negative, it is 'no' or means 'no'.

ext.ext_en: ...the stickers needed to complete the collection.

defs.def_en: To complete a set or group means to provide the last item that is needed to make it a full set or group.

ext.ext_en: ...the Complete Works of William Shakespeare.

defs.def_en: If one thing comes complete with another, it has that thing as an extra or additional part.

defs.def_en: If something is complete, it has been finished.

ext.ext_en: ...the rush to get the stadiums completed on time.

defs.def_en: If you complete something, you finish doing, making, or producing it.
