defs.def_en: If you describe a middle-aged or old person as well-preserved, you mean that they look good for their age.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 保存得很好的化石
ext.ext_en: ...well-preserved fossils...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管许多石头都已经掉下来了，那个纪念碑仍保存良好。
ext.ext_en: Although many of the stones have fallen out, the monument remains very well preserved.

defs.def_en: A well-preserved object or building does not show any signs of its age.

ext.ext_cn: 他的外科手术器械是一把刀和一把钳子。
ext.ext_en: His surgical instruments were a knife and a pair of pincers.

defs.def_en: Pincers consist of two pieces of metal that are hinged in the middle. They are used as a tool for gripping things or for pulling things out.
The pincers of an animal such as a crab or a lobster are its front claws.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有些人认为我是个性情暴躁的老头。
ext.ext_en: Some folk think I'm a grumpy old man.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is grumpy, you mean that they are bad-tempered and miserable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她对地道英语的娴熟使用
ext.ext_en: ...her remarkable command of idiomatic English.

defs.def_en: Idiomatic language uses words in a way that sounds natural to native speakers of the language.

ext.ext_cn: 我们坐在莉莉的日光浴室里,我把目前形势的细节情况又补充说明了一下。
ext.ext_en: We sat in Lily's sunroom while I sketched in the situation.

defs.def_en: If you sketch in details about something, you tell them to people.

ext.ext_cn: 印花棉布帘
ext.ext_en: ...chintz curtains.

defs.def_en: Chintz is a cotton fabric decorated with flowery patterns.
Your digestive system is the set of organs in your body that digest the food you eat.

ext.ext_cn: 你不该把钱浪费在那种小奢侈品上。
ext.ext_en: You cannot chuck money away on little luxuries like that.

defs.def_en: If you chuck something away, you throw it away or waste it.

ext.ext_cn: 你必须以终端用户可以理解的方式描述产品。
ext.ext_en: You have to be able to describe things in a form that the end user can understand.

defs.def_en: The end user of a product or service is the person that it has been designed for, rather than the person who installs or maintains it.

ext.ext_cn: 从那时候起，每个人都有意回避他。
ext.ext_en: From that time forward everybody shunned him...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直有意避开媒体的关注。
ext.ext_en: He has always shunned publicity...

defs.def_en: If you shun someone or something, you deliberately avoid them or keep away from them.

ext.ext_cn: 应用物理学
ext.ext_en: ...Applied Physics.

ext.ext_cn: 将更多资金投入应用研究的计划
ext.ext_en: ...plans to put more money into applied research.

defs.def_en: An applied subject of study has a practical use, rather than being concerned only with theory.
If you give someone who has stopped breathing mouth-to-mouth resuscitation, you breathe into their mouth to make them start breathing again.

defs.def_cn: (无聊或心不在焉时)涂鸦，胡写乱画
defs.def_en: A doodle is a pattern or picture that you draw when you are bored or thinking about something else.

ext.ext_cn: 他一边朝杰克逊看过去，一边在自己的笔记本上乱涂乱画。
ext.ext_en: He looked across at Jackson, doodling on his notebook.

defs.def_en: When someone doodles, they draw doodles.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 只顾自己的;自我专注的
defs.def_en: Someone who is self-absorbed thinks so much about things concerning themselves that they do not notice other people or the things around them.
An H-bomb is a bomb in which energy is released from hydrogen atoms.

ext.ext_cn: 对女士极有风度的绅士
ext.ext_en: ...a gentleman who behaves with the utmost courtesy towards ladies...

ext.ext_cn: 他连回复我传真的这点儿礼貌都没有。
ext.ext_en: He did not even have the courtesy to reply to my fax.

defs.def_en: Courtesy is politeness, respect, and consideration for others.

ext.ext_cn: 通过礼貌性地给客户打电话，我开始和他们建立起私交。
ext.ext_en: By extending the courtesy of a phone call to my clients, I was building a personal relationship with them...

ext.ext_cn: 如果他们在争论，那至少是他们出于礼貌向你表示感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: At least if they're arguing, they're doing you the courtesy of being interested.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the courtesy of doing something, you are referring to a polite action.

ext.ext_cn: 休和约翰正说着带有相互挤兑意味的客气话。
ext.ext_en: Hugh and John were exchanging faintly barbed courtesies.

defs.def_en: Courtesies are polite, conventional things that people say in formal situations.

ext.ext_cn: 有免费班车往返于酒店和市区。
ext.ext_en: A courtesy shuttle bus operates between the hotel and the town.

ext.ext_cn: 免费电话
ext.ext_en: ...a courtesy phone.

defs.def_en: Courtesy is used to describe services that are provided free of charge by an organization to its customers, or to the general public.

ext.ext_cn: 总统对明仁天皇进行了礼节性的拜访。
ext.ext_en: The President paid a courtesy call on Emperor Akihito.

defs.def_en: A courtesy call or a courtesy visit is a formal visit that you pay someone as a way of showing them politeness or respect.

defs.def_cn: (无法律实效的或非正式的)尊称

ext.ext_cn: 两人都被尊称为“夫人”。
ext.ext_en: Both were accorded the courtesy title of Lady...

ext.ext_cn: 人们称我为，当然只是出于礼貌，尊敬的阿马利娅·洛弗尔夫人。
ext.ext_en: My title, by courtesy only, is the Honourable Amalia Lovell.

defs.def_en: A courtesy title is a title that someone is allowed to use, although it has no legal or official status.

defs.def_cn: (用来表示感谢)承蒙…的好意，蒙…提供

ext.ext_cn: 女侍者端来几杯饭店赠送的用来庆祝的香槟。
ext.ext_en: The waitress brings over some congratulatory glasses of champagne, courtesy of the restaurant...

ext.ext_cn: 图片由国家美术馆提供。
ext.ext_en: Illustrations by courtesy of the National Gallery.

defs.def_en: If something is provided courtesy of someone or by courtesy of someone, they provide it. You often use this expression in order to thank them.

ext.ext_cn: 房顶有3个洞，所以空气很清新。
ext.ext_en: The air was fresh, courtesy of three holes in the roof...

ext.ext_cn: 慢动作重放后，数百万人都可以看到裁判错判了。
ext.ext_en: As millions will have seen, by courtesy of the slow motion re-runs, the referee made a mistake.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing happens courtesy of another or by courtesy of another, you mean that the second thing causes or is responsible for the first thing.

defs.def_cn: 双鱼宫，双鱼座（黄道十二宫之一；出生于2月19日至3月20日之间的人属此星座）
defs.def_en: Pisces is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac. Its symbol is two fish. People who are born approximately between the 19th of February and the 20th of March come under this sign.

defs.def_cn: 出生于双鱼宫时段的人
defs.def_en: A Pisces is a person whose sign of the zodiac is Pisces.
A pack animal is an animal such as a horse or donkey that is used to carry things on journeys.

defs.def_cn: 印度尼西亚(人)的;印度尼西亚文化的
defs.def_en: Indonesian means belonging or relating to Indonesia, or to its people or culture.
An Indonesian is an Indonesian citizen, or a person of Indonesian origin.
Indonesian is the national language of Indonesia.
Sweatpants are the part of a sweatsuit that covers your legs.
A centilitre is a unit of volume in the metric system equal to ten millilitres or one-hundredth of a litre.

defs.pos_cn: 可数名词；头衔名词；称呼名词
defs.def_cn: 军士长(陆军或海军陆战队中的最高级军士)
defs.def_en: A sergeant major is a non-commissioned army or marine officer of the highest rank.

defs.def_cn: 强行实施，强制执行（法律、规定等）

ext.ext_cn: 到目前为止，政府仅仅对美国船只实施了禁令。
ext.ext_en: Until now, the government has only enforced the ban with regard to American ships...

ext.ext_cn: 这些措施正由内政部部队实施。
ext.ext_en: The measures are being enforced by Interior Ministry troops.

defs.def_en: If people in authority enforce a law or a rule, they make sure that it is obeyed, usually by punishing people who do not obey it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们通过实施低技术规格拼命限制成本。
ext.ext_en: They struggled to limit the cost by enforcing a low-tech specification...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维在被迫离开后，现在又回到了贝鲁特生活。
ext.ext_en: David is now living in Beirut again after an enforced absence.

defs.def_en: To enforce something means to force or cause it to be done or to happen.

defs.def_cn: 常在国外旅行的;常云游四方的
defs.def_en: A much-travelled person has travelled a lot in foreign countries.

ext.ext_cn: 加泰罗尼亚人宣布支持查理，于是一场内战在巴伦西亚和阿拉贡两地爆发。
ext.ext_en: The Catalans declared for Charles and a civil war erupted in Valencia and Aragon...

ext.ext_cn: 就在一个月前，斯滕霍尔姆先生刚刚表示过赞成减税。
ext.ext_en: Only a month earlier, Mr. Stenholm had declared for the tax cut.

defs.def_en: If you declare for something or someone, you say that you are in favour of them.
Paratroopers are soldiers who are trained to be dropped by parachute into battle or into enemy territory.

defs.def_cn: 大量地快速制造;粗制滥造

ext.ext_cn: 1993年，该电影公司粗制滥造出了55部故事片。
ext.ext_en: In 1933 the studio cranked out fifty-five feature films...

ext.ext_cn: 作者一定是在午饭时间把它赶出来的。
ext.ext_en: The writer must have cranked it out in his lunch-hour.

defs.def_en: If you say that a company or person cranks out a quantity of similar things, you mean they produce them quickly, in the same way, and are usually implying that the things are not original or are of poor quality.

ext.ext_cn: 一名牧师照着祈祷书念祷文。
ext.ext_en: A clergyman read the liturgy from the prayer-book.

ext.ext_cn: 两个教会在牧师职责、礼拜仪式和风格方面的诸多相似之处
ext.ext_en: ...the many similarities in ministry, liturgy and style between the two churches.

defs.def_en: A liturgy is a particular form of religious service, usually one that is set and approved by a branch of the Christian Church.
A footnote is a note at the bottom of a page in a book which provides more detailed information about something that is mentioned on that page.

ext.ext_cn: 我补充一句，他有时表现得过分逞强。
ext.ext_en: As a footnote, I should add that there was one point on which his bravado was more than justified.

defs.def_en: If you refer to what you are saying as a footnote, you mean that you are adding some information that is related to what has just been mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 无关紧要的事;次要事件

ext.ext_cn: 恐怕他的名字现在会成为历史的注脚。
ext.ext_en: I'm afraid that his name will now become a footnote in history.

defs.def_en: If you describe an event as a footnote, you mean that it is fairly unimportant although it will probably be remembered.

defs.def_cn: （过程、体制）自我运行的，自我维持的

ext.ext_cn: 亚洲的新兴经济体会出现自我维持的循环增长。
ext.ext_en: Asia's emerging economies will be on a self-sustaining cycle of growth...

ext.ext_cn: 生物学家称这个地区的面积可能足以让一个自我维系的种群生存下来。
ext.ext_en: Biologists say the area might be large enough to support a self-sustaining population.

defs.def_en: A self-sustaining process or system is able to continue by itself without anyone or anything else becoming involved.

defs.def_cn: 另一半(指配偶或恋人等)
defs.def_en: If you refer to your significant other, you are referring to your wife, husband, or the person you are having a relationship with.

defs.def_cn: (从国家、大集团中正式)退出，脱离，分离

ext.ext_cn: 新加坡脱离马来西亚联邦成为一个独立的主权国家。
ext.ext_en: Singapore seceded from the Federation of Malaysia and became an independent sovereign state...

ext.ext_cn: 塞内加尔于 1960年 8 月 20 日独立出去。
ext.ext_en: On 20 August 1960 Senegal seceded.

defs.def_en: If a region or group secedes from the country or larger group to which it belongs, it formally becomes a separate country or stops being a member of the larger group.

defs.def_cn: （尤指因悲伤或痛楚）嚎叫，惨叫，哀号

ext.ext_cn: 那只狗开始哀嚎。
ext.ext_en: The dog began to yowl.

ext.ext_cn: 在婴儿的号哭声中很难听清帕齐在说些什么。
ext.ext_en: Patsy could hardly be heard above the baby's yowls.

defs.def_en: If a person or an animal yowls, they make a long loud cry, especially because they are sad or in pain.

defs.def_cn: 可归因于…的，可归结于…的

ext.ext_cn: 吸烟导致每年有1万人死于慢性肺病。
ext.ext_en: 10,000 deaths a year from chronic lung disease are attributable to smoking...

ext.ext_cn: 某个腐败无能的官员是导致这一烂摊子的罪魁祸首。
ext.ext_en: The mess was directly attributable to a corrupt and incompetent official.

defs.def_en: If something is attributable to an event, situation, or person, it is likely that it was caused by that event, situation or person.
Life-sized means the same as life-size .

defs.def_cn: (表示行动、感情或变化的强烈程度，通常和 so，too，very 一起用于否定句中)很多，非常

ext.ext_cn: 她笑得太多了。
ext.ext_en: She laughs too much...

ext.ext_cn: 非常感谢。
ext.ext_en: Thank you very much...

defs.def_en: You use much to indicate the great intensity, extent, or degree of something such as an action, feeling, or change. Much is usually used with 'so', 'too', and 'very', and in negative clauses with this meaning.

ext.ext_cn: 他说他父亲从来不多谈那场战争。
ext.ext_en: He said that his father never talked much about the war...

ext.ext_cn: 格温一直不常见到她父亲，因为他大部分时间在船上工作。
ext.ext_en: Gwen had not seen her Daddy all that much, because mostly he worked on the ships...

defs.def_en: If something does not happen much, it does not happen very often.

defs.def_cn: (置于比较级或 too 前，表示强调)太，很

ext.ext_cn: 皮肤太娇嫩了。
ext.ext_en: The skin is much too delicate...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你能像我看你那样看待自己，你会快乐得多。
ext.ext_en: You'd be so much happier if you could see yourself the way I see you...

defs.def_en: You use much in front of 'too' or comparative adjectives and adverbs in order to emphasize that there is a large amount of a particular quality.

ext.ext_cn: 这一天的开始和结束几乎是一样的。
ext.ext_en: The day ended much as it began...

ext.ext_cn: 绵羊奶和山羊奶的生产过程差不多。
ext.ext_en: Sheep's milk is produced in much the same way as goat's milk.

defs.def_en: If one thing is much the same as another thing, it is very similar to it.

ext.ext_cn: 它们被种植在阳光充足、土壤水分不多的山坡上。
ext.ext_en: They are grown on the hillsides in full sun, without much water...

ext.ext_cn: 日本一直不愿意向俄罗斯提供太多的援助。
ext.ext_en: Japan has been reluctant to offer much aid to Russia...

defs.def_en: You use much to indicate that you are referring to a large amount of a substance or thing.

defs.def_cn: (用于回答关于数量的提问)不多/不太多/太多

ext.ext_cn: “你住的地方听得到吗？”他摇摇头说：“很少听到。”
ext.ext_en: 'Can you hear it where you live?' He shook his head. 'Not much.'...

ext.ext_cn: “你对别人的看法很在意吗？”——“太在意了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Do you care very much about what other people think?' — 'Too much.'

defs.def_en: You use much in expressions such as not much ,not very much, and too much when replying to questions about amounts.

ext.ext_cn: 我现在见托尼的次数不多。
ext.ext_en: I don't see much of Tony nowadays...

ext.ext_cn: 我们会有一段时间不常见面。
ext.ext_en: We won't be seeing much of each other for a while.

defs.def_en: If you do not see much of someone, you do not see them very often.

defs.def_cn: 多少(用于对数量的询问或说明)

ext.ext_cn: 我能出得起多少钱？
ext.ext_en: How much money can I afford?...

ext.ext_cn: 看看你究竟摄入了多少脂肪和胆固醇。
ext.ext_en: See just how much fat and cholesterol you're eating...

defs.def_en: You use much in the expression how much to ask questions about amounts or degrees, and also in reported clauses and statements to give information about the amount or degree of something.

ext.ext_cn: 我会尽可能耐心地试着再解释一遍。
ext.ext_en: I shall try, with as much patience as is possible, to explain yet again...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的目标是尽可能提高牛奶产量。
ext.ext_en: Their aim will be to produce as much milk as possible...

defs.def_en: You use much in the expression as much when you are comparing amounts.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然他们希望明天就回家，但还是准备耐心地继续呆到年底。
ext.ext_en: Much as they hope to go home tomorrow, they're resigned to staying on until the end of the year.

defs.def_en: You use much as to introduce a fact which makes something else you have just said or will say rather surprising.

defs.def_cn: 我想/ 我猜也是这样

ext.ext_cn: 你在等一位女士——我也这么想的。
ext.ext_en: You're waiting for a woman — I thought as much.

defs.def_en: You use as much in expressions such as 'I thought as much' and 'I guessed as much' after you have just been told something and you want to say that you already believed or expected it to be true.

ext.ext_cn: 组织者希望能募集到高达600万英镑的善款。
ext.ext_en: The organisers hope to raise as much as £6m for charity.

defs.def_en: You use as much as before an amount to suggest that it is surprisingly large.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的饮用水一直短缺，更别提洗澡水了。
ext.ext_en: They are always short of water to drink, much less to bathe in...

ext.ext_cn: 但是我们绝不应把契科夫看成是个左派人物，他更不是革命者。
ext.ext_en: But we must not think of Chekhov as a leftist, much less a revolutionary.

defs.def_en: You use much less after a statement, often a negative one, to indicate that the statement is more true of the person, thing, or situation that you are going to mention next.

ext.ext_cn: “什么被偷了？”——“噢，不是什么重要的东西。”
ext.ext_en: 'What was stolen?' — 'Oh, nothing much.'...

ext.ext_cn: 看来不会发生什么有趣的事。
ext.ext_en: Nothing much interesting seemed to be happening.

defs.def_en: You say nothing much to refer to something that is not very interesting or important.

ext.ext_cn: 这简直不像是假日。
ext.ext_en: It hasn't been much of a holiday...

ext.ext_cn: 你可能想这根本算不上是一份职业。
ext.ext_en: It's not much of a career, you may think.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as not much of a particular type of thing, you mean that it is small or of poor quality.

ext.ext_cn: 好吧，关于生产商就讲这么多，那关于消费者呢？
ext.ext_en: Well, so much for the producers. But what of the con-sumers?

defs.def_en: So much for is used to indicate that you have finished talking about a subject.

ext.ext_cn: 他已花了1,900万英镑，输掉了三场杯赛决赛，球队也降级了。钱也不是万能的。
ext.ext_en: He has spent 19 million pounds, lost three cup finals and been relegated. So much for money.

defs.def_en: If you say so much for a particular thing, you mean that it has not been successful or helpful.

ext.ext_cn: 与其说我把她当作女儿，不如说把她当作好朋友。
ext.ext_en: I don't really think of her as a daughter so much as a very good friend...

ext.ext_cn: 她告诉我，与其说是她辞了工作，不如说是工作辞了她。
ext.ext_en: She told me she was not so much leaving her job as it was leaving her.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not so much one thing as another, you mean that it is more like the second thing than the first.

ext.ext_cn: 我一整天都没见他人影。
ext.ext_en: I didn't so much as catch sight of him all day long...

ext.ext_cn: 劳拉没责备他，甚至提都没提那件事。
ext.ext_en: Laura had not reproached him, never so much as mentioned it...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone did not do so much as perform a particular action, you are emphasizing that they did not even do that, when you were expecting them to do more.

ext.ext_cn: 他非常崇尚自由，不自由，毋宁死。
ext.ext_en: He himself believed in freedom, so much so that he would rather die than live without it.

defs.def_en: You use so much so to indicate that your previous statement is true to a very great extent, and therefore it has the result mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 非…力所能及的;非…应付得了的

ext.ext_cn: 他没有哪份工作能干长，这一点最终让她难以忍受。
ext.ext_en: His inability to stay at one job for long had finally proved too much for her.

defs.def_en: If a situation or action is too much for you, it is so difficult, tiring, or upsetting that you cannot cope with it.

ext.ext_cn: 自制力很强的人
ext.ext_en: ...a man very much in charge of himself...

ext.ext_cn: 约克郡在很大程度上仍以农业为主，出产优质肉类、奶制品和蛋类。
ext.ext_en: Yorkshire is still very much a farming community with good meat, good dairy produce and eggs...

defs.def_en: You use very much to emphasize that someone or something has a lot of a particular quality, or that the description you are about to give is particularly accurate.

ext.ext_cn: 他从瞎了的眼睛里擦去了一滴泪水。
ext.ext_en: He wiped a tear from his sightless eyes.

defs.def_en: Someone who is sightless is blind.

ext.ext_cn: 过渡政府的席位的平均分配
ext.ext_en: ...the share-out of seats in the transitional government.

defs.def_en: If there is a share-out of something, several people are given equal or fair parts of it.

defs.def_cn: 怒喝，怒斥（以打断讲话或发表意见）

ext.ext_cn: 总统的讲话被数百名反对人士的怒喝声压过。
ext.ext_en: The president was howled down by hundreds of opponents.

defs.def_en: If you are howled down, people prevent you from speaking or giving your opinion, often by shouting angrily.

defs.def_cn: 无（特殊）技能的;未经专门训练的

ext.ext_cn: 他没有任何劳动技能就到巴黎找起了工作。
ext.ext_en: He went to Paris in search of work as an unskilled labourer...

ext.ext_cn: 那些离开该省出国打工的人大部分都未经专门训练。
ext.ext_en: Most of those who left the province to work abroad were unskilled.

defs.def_en: People who are unskilled do not have any special training for a job.

defs.def_cn: 无需(特殊)技能的；不需专门训练的

ext.ext_cn: 在美国，少数族裔和移民一般都会从事低薪水、无需特殊技能的工作。
ext.ext_en: In the US, minorities and immigrants have generally gone into low-paid, unskilled jobs.

defs.def_en: Unskilled work does not require any special training.

ext.ext_cn: 他要我做30个俯卧撑。
ext.ext_en: He made me do 30 press-ups.

defs.def_en: Press-ups are exercises to strengthen your arms and chest muscles. They are done by lying with your face towards the floor and pushing with your hands to raise your body until your arms are straight.

defs.def_cn: 不符合科学法则的；超自然的；超常的

ext.ext_cn: 科学也许能够解释某些超自然现象。
ext.ext_en: Science may be able to provide some explanations of paranormal phenomena.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一直在关注玄奇事物这一神秘世界。
ext.ext_en: We have been looking at the shadowy world of the paranormal.

defs.def_en: A paranormal event or power, for example the appearance of a ghost, cannot be explained by scientific laws and is thought to involve strange, unknown forces.
A gourd is a large round fruit with a hard skin. You can also use gourd to refer to the plant on which this fruit grows.

ext.ext_cn: 这家商店进口诸如彩绘葫芦容器等商品。
ext.ext_en: The shop imports goods such as painted gourd containers.

defs.def_en: A gourd is a container made from the hard dry skin of a gourd fruit. Gourds are often used to carry water or for decoration.
A mousetrap is a small device that catches or kills mice.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 瞬间的犹豫
ext.ext_en: ...a fractional hesitation.

defs.def_en: If something is fractional, it is very small in size or degree.

ext.ext_cn: 游客们在正爬上岩石寻找最佳的拍摄角度。
ext.ext_en: Tourists were scrambling over the rocks looking for the perfect camera angle...

ext.ext_cn: 他攀上了一个陡峭的河堤。
ext.ext_en: He scrambled up a steep bank.

defs.def_en: If you scramble over rocks or up a hill, you move quickly over them or up it using your hands to help you.

ext.ext_cn: 安掀开被子，急忙下了床。
ext.ext_en: Ann threw back the covers and scrambled out of bed...

ext.ext_cn: 他赶忙站起身来。
ext.ext_en: He scrambled to his feet.

defs.def_en: If you scramble to a different place or position, you move there in a hurried, awkward way.

ext.ext_cn: 预计会有超过 300 万的球迷抢购门票。
ext.ext_en: More than three million fans are expected to scramble for tickets...

ext.ext_cn: 商业繁荣，外国人争相投资。
ext.ext_en: Business is booming and foreigners are scrambling to invest.

defs.def_en: If a number of people scramble for something, they compete energetically with each other for it.

ext.ext_cn: 把面包烤一下并炒些鸡蛋。
ext.ext_en: Make the toast and scramble the eggs.

defs.def_en: If you scramble eggs, you break them, mix them together and then heat and stir the mixture in a pan.

defs.def_cn: 倒换(无线电或电话信号)的频率(使只有持特殊仪器的人才能接收)

ext.ext_cn: 最新的机器对信号作扰频处理，通话就不易被侦听了。
ext.ext_en: The latest machines scramble the messages so that the conversation cannot easily be intercepted.

defs.def_en: If a device scrambles a radio or telephone message, it interferes with the sound so that the message can only be understood by someone with special equipment.

ext.ext_cn: “莉，”他说着一把抓住我的胳膊把我拉了回来。
ext.ext_en: 'Leigh,' he said seizing my arm to hold me back.

ext.ext_cn: 捉到了一条鱼的水獭
ext.ext_en: ...an otter seizing a fish.

defs.def_en: If you seize something, you take hold of it quickly, firmly, and forcefully.

defs.def_cn: (通过暴力突然迅速地)夺取，攻占，控制

ext.ext_cn: 军队已控制了机场和火车站。
ext.ext_en: Troops have seized the airport and railroad terminals...

ext.ext_cn: 军官们昨天夺权未遂。
ext.ext_en: Army officers plotted a failed attempt yesterday to seize power.

defs.def_en: When a group of people seize a place or seize control of it, they take control of it quickly and suddenly, using force.

defs.def_cn: (通常指通过武力)起获，没收，扣押

ext.ext_cn: 据说警方已经将该报纸今天的早间版全部没收。
ext.ext_en: Police were reported to have seized all copies of this morning's edition of the newspaper...

ext.ext_cn: 查封官需要有郡法院的证明才能没收货物以抵欠租。
ext.ext_en: Bailiffs need a certificate from the county court to seize goods for rent arrears.

defs.def_en: If a government or other authority seize someone's property, they take it from them, often by force.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国官员称昨天有两名军事观察员被红色高棉逮捕。
ext.ext_en: UN officials say two military observers were seized by the Khmer Rouge yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 持冲锋枪的几名男子俘虏了 5 名士兵并开车将他们带走。
ext.ext_en: Men carrying sub-machine guns seized the five soldiers and drove them away.

defs.def_en: When someone is seized, they are arrested or captured.

ext.ext_cn: 在暴乱中成百上千的人纷纷趁机偷窃财物。
ext.ext_en: During the riots hundreds of people seized the opportunity to steal property...

ext.ext_cn: 如今政府希望抓住教育上的主动权。
ext.ext_en: The government now hopes to seize the initiative on education.

defs.def_en: When you seize an opportunity, you take advantage of it and do something that you want to do.
If a bank or building society issues a repossession order, they officially tell someone that they are going to repossess their home.

ext.ext_cn: 加上肥皂会立即起泡的那种水
ext.ext_en: ...the sort of water that easily makes a lather with soap...

ext.ext_cn: 他用毛巾抹去余下的皂沫。
ext.ext_en: He wiped off the remains of the lather with a towel.

defs.def_en: A lather is a white mass of bubbles which is produced by mixing a substance such as soap or washing powder with water.

ext.ext_cn: 这种洗发水泡沫太多，很难冲干净。
ext.ext_en: The shampoo lathers and foams so much it's very hard to rinse it all out.

defs.def_en: When a substance such as soap or washing powder lathers, it produces a white mass of bubbles because it has been mixed with water.

defs.def_cn: 在…上涂以肥皂（或洗衣粉等）（以产生泡沫并清洗）

ext.ext_cn: 像平常那样在头发上抹上洗发液。
ext.ext_en: Lather your hair as normal...

ext.ext_cn: 皮肤极柔嫩者，可在沐浴前涂上温和的护肤露。
ext.ext_en: For super-soft skin, lather on a light body lotion before you bathe.

defs.def_en: If you lather something, you rub a substance such as soap or washing powder on it until a lather is produced, in order to clean it.

ext.ext_cn: 过去半年你一直在为压根儿和你无关的事情心急上火。
ext.ext_en: You have spent the past six months working yourself up into a lather over situations which are really none of your business...

ext.ext_cn: “我不会因为这次失败而不快，”经理说道。
ext.ext_en: 'I'm not going to get into a lather over this defeat,' said the manager.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone works themselves up into a lather or gets in a lather about something, you think that they are getting upset, angry, or worried about it when there is no need to do so.

defs.def_cn: （进行教学、研究等的）方法论,方法学，一套方法

ext.ext_cn: 题目不同，教学法也不一样。
ext.ext_en: Teaching methodologies vary according to the topic...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在做自己的工作时，也许更喜欢使用和我不一样的一套方法。
ext.ext_en: In their own work they may have favored the use of methodology different from mine.

defs.def_en: A methodology is a system of methods and principles for doing something, for example for teaching or for carrying out research.

ext.ext_cn: 船正以30度角倾斜。
ext.ext_en: The boat is now leaning at a 30 degree angle.

defs.def_en: See also:right angle;An angle is the difference in direction between two lines or surfaces. Angles are measured in degrees.

defs.def_cn: （两条线或两个平面相交的）夹角，边角

ext.ext_cn: 刀口的夹角
ext.ext_en: ...the angle of the blade.

ext.ext_cn: 用于调整方向盘角度的支架
ext.ext_en: ...brackets to adjust the steering wheel's angle.

defs.def_en: An angle is the shape that is created where two lines or surfaces join together.

ext.ext_cn: 由于站的位置视角好，他刚好能看见日落。
ext.ext_en: Thanks to the angle at which he stood, he could just see the sunset...

ext.ext_cn: 通过调整照相机的角度，他的脸将被巧妙地遮住。
ext.ext_en: His face will be discreetly concealed by camera angles.

defs.def_en: An angle is the direction from which you look at something.

defs.def_cn: 角度；观点；立场；侧重点；倾向性

ext.ext_cn: 我们不得不翻来覆去地从不同的角度拍这个场面。
ext.ext_en: We had to do the scene over and over again, from different angles...

ext.ext_cn: 他正从各个角度考虑这个想法。
ext.ext_en: He was considering the idea from all angles.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a way of presenting something or thinking about it as a particular angle .

ext.ext_cn: 听起来好像他只是在博取同情。
ext.ext_en: It sounds as if he's just angling for sympathy.

defs.def_en: If someone is angling for something, they are trying to get it without asking for it directly.

ext.ext_cn: 可以调节百叶窗使光线亮一些，也可以暗一些。
ext.ext_en: You can open the slats for a bright light or angle them for more shade...

ext.ext_cn: 小路向山下伸展，然后向北延伸。
ext.ext_en: The path angled downhill and northwards...

defs.def_en: If you angle something or if it angles in a particular direction, it faces or points in that direction.

ext.ext_cn: 一根铁棍斜伸出来。
ext.ext_en: An iron bar stuck out at an angle...

ext.ext_cn: 这面墙有点歪。
ext.ext_en: The wall's at a slight angle.

defs.def_en: If something is at an angle, it is leaning in a particular direction so that it is not straight, horizontal, or vertical.

defs.def_cn: 阴郁的;乖戾的;严厉的;不友好的

ext.ext_cn: 他的举止相当乖戾阴郁，令人望而生畏。
ext.ext_en: He had a rather forbidding, saturnine manner.

defs.def_en: Someone who is saturnine is serious and unfriendly.

ext.ext_cn: 总统的辞职似乎表明他对维护国家稳定已不抱任何希望。
ext.ext_en: The President's resignation appears to be an acknowledgment that he has lost all hope of keeping the country together...

ext.ext_cn: 她承认他的成熟，他对此心怀感激。
ext.ext_en: He appreciated her acknowledgement of his maturity.

defs.def_en: An acknowledgement is a statement or action which recognizes that something exists or is true.
The acknowledgements in a book are the section in which the author thanks all the people who have helped him or her.

defs.def_cn: 打招呼的表示（如微笑等）

ext.ext_cn: 法林微笑示意，又躬身行了个礼。
ext.ext_en: Farling smiled in acknowledgement and gave a bow...

ext.ext_cn: 杯子被倒满时米芝敷衍性地点头示意。
ext.ext_en: Mitzi nodded a perfunctory acknowledgement as her glass was filled.

defs.def_en: A gesture of acknowledgement, such as a smile, shows someone that you have seen and recognized them.

ext.ext_cn: 捐赠者被印入捐赠公示榜以示感谢。
ext.ext_en: The benefit to the donor was an acknowledgment of the donation in a printed bulletin...

ext.ext_cn: 为获准重印致以深切感谢。
ext.ext_en: Grateful acknowledgment is made for permission to reprint.

defs.def_en: An acknowledgement is a published statement in which you express your gratitude for or appreciation of something.

defs.def_cn: （表示已收到信函等的）确认通知，收件复函

ext.ext_cn: 我未收到任何复函或答复。
ext.ext_en: I have received neither an acknowledgment nor a reply.

defs.def_en: An acknowledgement is a letter or message that you receive from someone, telling you that something you have sent to them has arrived.

ext.ext_cn: 肌肉组织会随着我们日趋衰老而萎缩。
ext.ext_en: As we age we lose muscle tissue...

ext.ext_cn: 运动员几乎没有什么脂肪组织。
ext.ext_en: Athletes have hardly any fatty tissue…

defs.def_en: In animals and plants, tissue consists of cells that are similar to each other in appearance and that have the same function.

defs.def_cn: (用于包装易损物品的)薄纸，绵纸
defs.def_en: Tissue or tissue paper is thin paper that is used for wrapping things that are easily damaged, such as objects made of glass or china.

ext.ext_cn: 一盒面巾纸
ext.ext_en: ...a box of tissues.

defs.def_en: A tissue is a piece of thin soft paper that you use to blow your nose.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 与上帝（或宗教）有关的;神圣的

ext.ext_cn: 对他们以及所有基督徒来说，这里是一处圣地。
ext.ext_en: To them, as to all Christians, this is a holy place.

ext.ext_cn: 赎罪日，犹太历中最神圣的日子
ext.ext_en: ...Yom Kippur, the holiest day in the Jewish calendar.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as holy, you mean that it is considered to be special because it is connected with God or a particular religion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 虔诚的;圣洁的;献身于宗教（或教会）的

ext.ext_cn: 印度人把他视为圣人，他既是医生又是僧侣。
ext.ext_en: The Indians think of him as a holy man, a combination of doctor and priest.

defs.def_en: A holy person is a religious leader or someone who leads a religious life.

defs.def_cn: （表示惊讶、恐慌等）天啊，上帝啊
defs.def_en: Holy is used in exclamations such as 'Holy cow!' and 'Holy smoke!' to express an emotion such as surprise or panic.

ext.ext_cn: 我意识到从今以后我的生活将会多么艰难。
ext.ext_en: I realised how hard life was going to be for me hereafter.

defs.def_en: Hereafter means from this time onwards.

defs.def_cn: （用于法律文书或书面英语中，引出已经提及的人或事物的缩略）在本文中其余部分，以下

ext.ext_cn: 米歇尔·福柯（1972），《知识考古学》，下文简称AK。
ext.ext_en: Michel Foucault (1972), The Archaeology of Knowledge; hereafter this text will be abbreviated as AK.

defs.def_en: In legal documents and in written English, hereafter is used to introduce information about an abbreviation that will be used in the rest of the text to refer to the person or thing just mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 相信死后灵魂的存在
ext.ext_en: ...belief in the hereafter.

ext.ext_cn: 死后灵魂的存在
ext.ext_en: ...the life hereafter...

defs.def_en: The hereafter is sometimes used to refer to the time after you have died, or to the life which some people believe you have after you have died.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 重要的;必要的;非常有价值的

ext.ext_cn: 她生命中最重要的是她的儿子们。
ext.ext_en: Her sons are the most important thing in her life...

ext.ext_cn: 这场有计划的总罢工是政府面临的一个重大经济挑战。
ext.ext_en: The planned general strike represents an important economic challenge to the government...

defs.def_en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有声望的;有影响的;显要的

ext.ext_cn: 他是岛上最有声望的人。
ext.ext_en: He was the most important person on the island.

ext.ext_cn: 传媒界很有影响力的人物
ext.ext_en: ...an important figure in the media world.

defs.def_en: Someone who is important has influence or power within a society or a particular group.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 犹豫的;迟疑不决的;有疑虑的;难为情的;不愿的

ext.ext_cn: 她不大愿意站出来讲述自己的经历。
ext.ext_en: She was hesitant about coming forward with her story...

ext.ext_cn: 他的顾问们都理所当然地有所犹豫，不愿让美国卷入冲突之中。
ext.ext_en: His advisers are rightfully hesitant to let the United States be sucked into the conflict.

defs.def_en: If you are hesitant about doing something, you do not do it quickly or immediately, usually because you are uncertain, embarrassed, or worried.

defs.def_cn: 福音传教士;巡回布道者
defs.def_en: An evangelist is a person who travels from place to place in order to try to convert people to Christianity.
Gherkins are small green cucumbers that have been preserved in vinegar.

ext.ext_cn: 她哀求他戒掉烟酒。
ext.ext_en: She beseeched him to cut his drinking and his smoking...

ext.ext_cn: “求求你留下来给我读点东西吧，妈妈，”他央求道。
ext.ext_en: 'Please stay and read to me, mummy,' he beseeched.

defs.def_en: If you beseech someone to do something, you ask them very eagerly and anxiously.

defs.def_cn: (旅馆的)客房服务，客房送餐服务

ext.ext_cn: 这家旅馆一般不提供客房送餐服务。
ext.ext_en: The hotel did not normally provide room service...

ext.ext_cn: 我们叫客房服务吧，我要一瓶红酒。
ext.ext_en: Let's call room service, I need a bottle of wine.

defs.def_en: Room service is a service in a hotel by which meals or drinks are provided for guests in their rooms.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的第一辆车于12月16日下线。
ext.ext_en: Their first car rolls off the production line on December 16.

defs.def_en: A production line is an arrangement of machines in a factory where the products pass from machine to machine until they are finished.

ext.ext_cn: 她看了看四周的文件。
ext.ext_en: She looked at the papers around her...

ext.ext_cn: 今天她的头发披在肩上。
ext.ext_en: Today she wore her hair down around her shoulders.

defs.def_en: To be positioned around a place or object means to surround it or be on all sides of it. To move around a place means to go along its edge, back to your starting point.

ext.ext_cn: 摄影师停止按动快门，匆匆绕过拐角。
ext.ext_en: The photographer stopped clicking and hurried around the corner...

ext.ext_cn: 我仔细察看了棚子周边，没有其他人。
ext.ext_en: I peered around the edge of the shed — there was no sign of anyone else.

defs.def_en: If you move around a corner or obstacle, you move to the other side of it. If you look around a corner or obstacle, you look to see what is on the other side.

defs.def_cn: 朝着相反方向；向着对立面

ext.ext_cn: 我转过身，在黑板上写下了题目。
ext.ext_en: I turned around and wrote the title on the blackboard...

ext.ext_cn: 他慢慢直起身子，坐在凳子上转过身来面对着我们。
ext.ext_en: He straightened up slowly and spun around on the stool to face us.

defs.def_en: If you turn around, you turn so that you are facing in the opposite direction.

ext.ext_cn: 我在莫斯科到处游逛，城里非常安静。
ext.ext_en: I've been walking around Moscow and the town is terribly quiet...

ext.ext_cn: 他谨慎地瞥了一眼房间里的其他人。
ext.ext_en: He glanced discreetly around the room at the other people.

defs.def_en: If you move around a place, you travel through it, going to most of its parts. If you look around a place, you look at every part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些天，我多半都是在酒会上晃悠过去的。
ext.ext_en: These days much of my time is spent weaving my way around drinks parties...

ext.ext_cn: 他们扛着摄像机在舞厅里转来转去。
ext.ext_en: They milled around the ballroom with video cameras.

defs.def_en: If someone moves around a place, they move through various parts of that place without having any particular destination.

ext.ext_cn: 她帮我打开行李，然后我们去看望其他女孩们。
ext.ext_en: She helped me unpack my things and then we went around to see the other girls.

defs.def_en: If you go around to someone's house, you visit them.

ext.ext_cn: 我只会闲呆着，什么事也不做。
ext.ext_en: I'm just going to be hanging around twiddling my thumbs...

ext.ext_cn: 第二天早饭后，他们闲坐着聊了一个小时政治话题。
ext.ext_en: After breakfast the next morning they sat around for an hour discussing political affairs.

defs.def_en: You use around in expressions such as sit around and hang around when you are saying that someone is spending time in a place and not doing anything very important.

ext.ext_cn: 教室中的桌椅如需要挪动，应事先告诉这个盲童。
ext.ext_en: Furniture in the classroom should not be changed around without warning the blind child...

ext.ext_cn: 她挪动家具使桌子靠在窗边。
ext.ext_en: She moved things around so the table was beneath the windows.

defs.def_en: If you move things around, you move them so that they are in different places.

ext.ext_cn: 船开始在水中打旋。
ext.ext_en: The boat started to spin around in the water.

defs.def_en: If a wheel or object turns around, it turns.

ext.ext_cn: 南非警方称，在全国各地零星发生的暴力事件中，有10人死亡。
ext.ext_en: Police in South Africa say ten people have died in scattered violence around the country...

ext.ext_cn: 在肯尼亚东部的塔纳河一带经常发现陷入沼泽的大象。
ext.ext_en: Elephants were often to be found in swamp in eastern Kenya around the Tana River.

defs.def_en: You use around to say that something happens in different parts of a place or area.

defs.def_cn: （人）没有希望（做好…）的，不行的，无能的

ext.ext_cn: 要是让我为别人工作，我一定做不好。
ext.ext_en: I'd be hopeless at working for somebody else...

ext.ext_cn: 我的体育不错，但学习却很差。
ext.ext_en: I was fine at sports, but pretty hopeless academically.

defs.def_en: If someone is hopeless at something, they are very bad at it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 糟糕透顶的;无可救药的;极坏的

ext.ext_cn: 我不开车，公共汽车条件又太糟糕。
ext.ext_en: I don't drive and the buses are quite hopeless...

ext.ext_cn: 阿根廷的经济政策糟得一塌糊涂。
ext.ext_en: Argentina's economic policies were a hopeless mess.

defs.def_en: You use hopeless to emphasize how bad or inadequate something or someone is.
A squirrel is a small animal with a long furry tail. Squirrels live mainly in trees.

defs.def_cn: (对可能发生之事的)兴奋，紧张，担心，挂虑

ext.ext_cn: 随着昨晚警方发现了弹痕累累的尸体，人们对剩余两名人质的担心也终告结束。
ext.ext_en: The suspense over the two remaining hostages ended last night when the police discovered the bullet ridden bodies.

ext.ext_cn: 使故事从头到尾充满悬念的女作家
ext.ext_en: ...a writer who holds the suspense throughout her tale.

defs.def_en: Suspense is a state of excitement or anxiety about something that is going to happen very soon, for example about some news that you are waiting to hear.

ext.ext_cn: 开普勒让所有的下属都焦急地等待着，直到那天上午才宣布哪两个人去。
ext.ext_en: Keppler kept all his men in suspense until that morning before announcing which two would be going...

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼斯说：“接着说，别吊我们胃口了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Go on, don't leave us in suspense,' Dennis said.

defs.def_en: If you keep or leave someone in suspense, you deliberately delay telling them something that they are very eager to know about.

defs.def_cn: （与表示身体动作的名词连用，表示该动作）

ext.ext_cn: 她伸了个懒腰，打了个大哈欠。
ext.ext_en: She stretched her arms out and gave a great yawn...

ext.ext_cn: 她叹了一口气，跪倒在我脚边。
ext.ext_en: Giving a sigh, she fell to her knees at my feet...

defs.def_en: You can use give with nouns that refer to physical actions. The whole expression refers to the performing of the action. For example, She gave a smile means almost the same as 'She smiled'.

ext.ext_cn: 我让她搭我的便车回家。
ext.ext_en: I gave her a lift back out to her house...

ext.ext_cn: 对他进行了口对口的人工呼吸。
ext.ext_en: He was given mouth-to-mouth resuscitation...

defs.def_en: You use give to say that a person does something for another person. For example, if you give someone a lift, you take them somewhere in your car.

defs.def_cn: （与表示信息、意见、问候等的名词连用）提供，给出，传递，告诉

ext.ext_cn: 他未透露细节。
ext.ext_en: He gave no details...

ext.ext_cn: 我能知道您的姓名吗？
ext.ext_en: Would you like to give me your name?...

defs.def_en: You use give with nouns that refer to information, opinions, or greetings to indicate that something is communicated. For example, if you give someone some news, you tell it to them.

ext.ext_cn: 英国广播公司的一项民意调查预计工党将领先12个百分点。
ext.ext_en: A BBC poll gave the Labour Party a 12 per cent lead...

ext.ext_cn: 特德和他的律师们预计这家公司在11个月的时间内将变卖所有东西。
ext.ext_en: Ted and his lawyers gave the company 11 months to sell off everything.

defs.def_en: You use give to say how long you think something will last or how much you think something will be.

ext.ext_cn: 他们对这个国家毫不关心。
ext.ext_en: They don't give a damn about the country.

defs.def_en: People use give in expressions such as I don't give a damn to show that they do not care about something.

defs.def_cn: 使产生（某种想法或印象）

ext.ext_cn: 他们给我的印象是，他们正在做自己人生中想做的事情。
ext.ext_en: They gave me the impression that they were doing exactly what they wanted in life...

ext.ext_cn: 这位核查员的最终报告没有准确反映事实。
ext.ext_en: The examiner's final report does not give an accurate picture.

defs.def_en: If someone or something gives you a particular idea or impression, it causes you to have that idea or impression.

defs.def_cn: 使身体感到…；使产生（某种情绪）

ext.ext_cn: 他使我大吃一惊。
ext.ext_en: He gave me a shock...

ext.ext_cn: 这将为每年成千上万来医院求诊的儿童带来很大快乐。
ext.ext_en: It will give great pleasure to the many thousands of children who visit the hospital each year.

defs.def_en: If someone or something gives you a particular physical or emotional feeling, it makes you experience it.

ext.ext_cn: 科托的表演令人惊叹。
ext.ext_en: Kotto gives a stupendous performance...

ext.ext_cn: 我相信你一定还记得巴特勒夫人，去年她给我们作了一次非常有意思的演讲。
ext.ext_en: I am sure you remember Mrs Butler who gave us such an interesting talk last year.

defs.def_en: If you give a performance or speech, you perform or speak in public.

ext.ext_cn: 这件事我已经考虑了一阵子。
ext.ext_en: I've been giving it some thought...

ext.ext_cn: 早申请者将获优先考虑。
ext.ext_en: Priority will be given to those who apply early.

defs.def_en: If you give something thought or attention, you think about it, concentrate on it, or deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 那天晚上，我设宴招待几位好朋友。
ext.ext_en: That evening, I gave a dinner party for a few close friends.

defs.def_en: If you give a party or other social event, you organize it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们为我们提供了T恤衫和贴纸。
ext.ext_en: They gave us T-shirts and stickers...

ext.ext_cn: 他向世界卫生组织提供资金以帮助消灭天花。
ext.ext_en: He gave money to the World Health Organisation to help defeat smallpox...

defs.def_en: If you give someone something that you own or have bought, you provide them with it, so that they have it or can use it.

ext.ext_cn: 把那支铅笔递给我。
ext.ext_en: Give me that pencil...

ext.ext_cn: 他从口袋里掏出手绢递给他。
ext.ext_en: He pulled a handkerchief from his pocket and gave it to him.

defs.def_en: If you give someone something that you are holding or that is near you, you pass it to them, so that they are then holding it.

ext.ext_cn: 赋予同性恋者权利的公民宪章
ext.ext_en: ...a citizen's charter giving rights to gays...

ext.ext_cn: 该草案将授权总统任命中央银行行长。
ext.ext_en: The draft would give the president the power to appoint the central bank's chairman.

defs.def_en: To give someone or something a particular power or right means to allow them to have it.

ext.ext_cn: 我两腿发软。
ext.ext_en: My knees gave under me.

defs.def_en: If something gives, it collapses or breaks under pressure.

ext.ext_cn: 我们得知他病了。
ext.ext_en: We were given to understand that he was ill...

ext.ext_cn: 他于是相信他和玛丽亚也许还有希望在一起。
ext.ext_en: He has been given to believe that there may be a future for him and Maria together.

defs.def_en: See also:given;You say that you are given to understand or believe that something is the case when you do not want to say how you found out about it, or who told you.

defs.def_cn: 毫不示弱地反击（或反驳）；回敬；以牙还牙

ext.ext_cn: 民主党人12年来首次予以反击。
ext.ext_en: For the first time in 12 years, the Democrats are giving as good as they get.

defs.def_en: If someone gives as good as they get, they fight or argue as well as the person they are fighting or arguing with.

defs.def_cn: 愿意付出一切（强调十分渴望做某事或拥有某物）

ext.ext_cn: 我真希望能像你一样。
ext.ext_en: I'd give anything to be like you.

defs.def_en: You use give in phrases such as I'd give anything ,I'd give my right arm, and what wouldn't I give to emphasize that you are very eager to do or have something.

defs.def_cn: 我宁可要；我宁可选择；我更喜欢

ext.ext_cn: 我还从未吃过烧烤，也不想吃，我宁愿哪一天美美地吃一顿烘烤大餐。
ext.ext_en: I've never had anything barbecued and I don't want it. Give me a good roast dinner any day.

defs.def_en: You use give me to say that you would rather have one thing than another, especially when you have just mentioned the thing that you do not want.

ext.ext_cn: 经常互相体谅的美满爱情
ext.ext_en: ...a happy relationship where there's  a lot of give and take.

defs.def_en: If you say that something requires give and take, you mean that people must compromise or co-operate for it to be successful.

ext.ext_cn: 它们会长到12英寸高——出入至多几英寸。
ext.ext_en: They grow to a height of 12 ins —  give or take a couple of inches.

defs.def_en: Give or take is used to indicate that  an amount is approximate. For example, if you say that something is fifty years old, give or take a few years, you mean that it is approximately fifty years old.

ext.ext_cn: 我得承认，你是个挺聪明的孩子。
ext.ext_en: You're a bright enough kid, I'll give you that.

defs.def_en: You say  I'll give you that to indicate that you admit that someone has a particular characteristic or ability.

ext.ext_cn: 女士们，先生们，请为弗雷德·德斯特来点掌声。
ext.ext_en: Ladies and Gentlemen, give it up for Fred Durst.

defs.def_en: If an audience is asked to give it up for a performer, they are being asked to applaud.
A tea caddy is a small tin in which you keep tea.

defs.def_cn: (通常指遭到轰炸之后的)风暴性大火
defs.def_en: A firestorm is a fire that is burning uncontrollably, usually in a place that has been bombed.

defs.def_cn: (抗议或批评的)热浪，热潮，风暴

ext.ext_cn: 这一讲话已引发了激烈的争议。
ext.ext_en: The speech has resulted in a firestorm of controversy.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is a firestorm of protest or criticism, you are emphasizing that there is a great deal of very fierce protest or criticism.
Yule is an old-fashioned word for Christmas .

defs.def_cn: 未婚的；没有女朋友（或男朋友）的

ext.ext_cn: 我只认识两三个未婚的男士。
ext.ext_en: I knew only two or three unattached men.

defs.def_en: Someone who is unattached is not married or does not have a girlfriend or boyfriend.
A wolf is a wild animal that looks like a large dog.

ext.ext_cn: 我回到更衣室，狼吞虎咽地喝茶、吃三明治。
ext.ext_en: I was back in the changing room wolfing tea and sandwiches.

ext.ext_cn: 他把剩下的饼干和奶酪一扫而光。
ext.ext_en: He wolfed down the rest of the biscuit and cheese...

defs.def_en: If someone wolfs their food, they eat it all very quickly and greedily.
If someone cries wolf, they say that there is a problem when there is not, with the result that people do not believe them when there really is a problem.

ext.ext_cn: 很多少年打零工帮补家里维持生计。
ext.ext_en: A lot of the lads took small jobs to help keep the wolf from the door.

defs.def_en: If you keep the wolf from the door, you succeed in providing food and other necessary things for yourself or your family.

defs.def_cn: （英国国教的）教区牧师，教区教堂主持
defs.def_en: A vicar is an Anglican priest who is in charge of a church and the area it is in, which is called a parish.

defs.def_cn: （美国新教圣公会的）教堂主持,教区牧师
defs.def_en: A vicar is a priest who is in charge of a chapel that is associated with a parish church in the Episcopal Church in the United States.

ext.ext_cn: 传统家庭价值观最热烈的捍卫者
ext.ext_en: ...the most ardent defenders of conventional family values.

ext.ext_cn: 人权或宗教自由的坚强卫士
ext.ext_en: ...a strong defender of human rights or religious freedom.

defs.def_en: If someone is a defender of a particular thing or person that has been criticized, they argue or act in support of that thing or person.

defs.def_cn: (足球、曲棍球等运动中的)防守队员，防守球员
defs.def_en: A defender in a game such as football or hockey is a player whose main task is to try and stop the other side scoring.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我注意到大家都在专注地看着我。
ext.ext_en: I noticed that everyone was watching me with rapt attention...

ext.ext_cn: 费希尔夫人发言的时候，代表们都一言不发专心致志地听着。
ext.ext_en: Delegates sat in rapt silence as Mrs Fisher spoke...

defs.def_en: If someone watches or listens with rapt attention, they are extremely interested or fascinated.

ext.ext_cn: 这种型号的迪格斯望远镜可将图像放大11倍。
ext.ext_en: This version of the Digges telescope magnifies images 11 times...

ext.ext_cn: 透镜会把图片放大，就像在看巨大的电视屏幕一样。
ext.ext_en: A lens would magnify the picture so it would be like looking at a large TV screen.

defs.def_en: To magnify an object means to make it appear larger than it really is, by means of a special lens or mirror.

ext.ext_cn: 贫困和人类的愚昧加剧了自然灾难。
ext.ext_en: Poverty and human folly magnify natural disasters...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的喧闹声在凝滞而潮湿的空气中显得更吵了。
ext.ext_en: Their noises were magnified in the still, wet air.

defs.def_en: To magnify something means to increase its effect, size, loudness, or intensity.

ext.ext_cn: 他们不去把握大局，而是在细枝末节上花费时间大做文章。
ext.ext_en: They do not grasp the broad situation and spend their time magnifying ridiculous details...

ext.ext_cn: 稍有不满便会被上纲上线。
ext.ext_en: Any signs of discontent tend to be magnified and overanalyzed.

defs.def_en: If you magnify something, you make it seem more important or serious than it really is.

ext.ext_cn: 需要大约18万公吨的食品援助。
ext.ext_en: Around 180,000 metric tons of food aid is required...

ext.ext_cn: 将公制计量单位换算为美制计量单位十分简单。
ext.ext_en: Converting metric measurements to U.S. equivalents is easy.

defs.def_en: Metric means relating to the metric system.

defs.def_cn: 玫瑰水，蔷薇水（用作香水或用于烹饪中）
defs.def_en: Rosewater is a liquid which is made from roses and which has a pleasant smell. It is used as a perfume and in cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 美国的首要任务自然是刺激经济。
ext.ext_en: America's priority is rightly to stimulate its economy...

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯的公共医疗服务已经激起了公众对家庭治疗的兴趣。
ext.ext_en: The Russian health service has stimulated public interest in home cures.

defs.def_en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

ext.ext_cn: 这个挑战让比尔热情高涨。
ext.ext_en: Bill was stimulated by the challenge...

ext.ext_cn: 我深受启发，开始审视自己内心深处的想法。
ext.ext_en: I was stimulated to examine my deepest thoughts.

defs.def_en: If you are stimulated by something, it makes you feel full of ideas and enthusiasm.

ext.ext_cn: 锻炼能促进消化和排泄系统的活动。
ext.ext_en: Exercise stimulates the digestive and excretory systems...

ext.ext_cn: 皮肤暴露在阳光下就很容易生成黑色素。
ext.ext_en: The production of melanin in the skin is stimulated by exposure to the sun...

defs.def_en: If something stimulates a part of a person's body, it causes it to move or start working.
A proton is an atomic particle that has a positive electrical charge.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻信的；易受骗的；易上当的

ext.ext_cn: 承认向轻信媒体的公众提供了不实报道有何意义呢？
ext.ext_en: What point is there in admitting that the stories fed to the gullible public were false?...

ext.ext_cn: 我很容易上当，可能会相信他的话。
ext.ext_en: I'm so gullible I would have believed him.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as gullible, you mean they are easily tricked because they are too trusting.

defs.def_cn: 乙炔，电石气（一种无色可燃气体，有高热烈焰，常用于灯具照明、切割和焊接金属等）
defs.def_en: Acetylene is a colourless gas which burns with a very hot bright flame. It is often used in lamps and for cutting and welding metal.

ext.ext_cn: 他们爱打网球和保龄球。
ext.ext_en: They go in for tennis and bowls.

defs.def_en: If you go in for a particular activity, you decide to do it as a hobby or interest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指男子)外表整洁的，衣着利落的

ext.ext_cn: 他那整洁英俊的外表
ext.ext_en: ...his clean-cut good looks.

defs.def_en: Someone, especially a boy or man, who is clean-cut has a neat, tidy appearance.

defs.def_cn: (电灯的)调光器，减光器,亮度调节开关
defs.def_en: A dimmer or a dimmer switch is a switch that allows you to gradually change the brightness of an electric light.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不均衡的；一边倒的；悬殊的

ext.ext_cn: 谈判完全呈一边倒之势。
ext.ext_en: The negotiating was completely one-sided...

ext.ext_cn: 穆斯特尔仅用72分钟便以6比2、6比3拿下了这场实力悬殊的比赛。
ext.ext_en: Muster needed just 72 minutes to win the one-sided match, 6-2, 6-3.

defs.def_en: If you say that an activity or relationship is one-sided, you think that one of the people or groups involved does much more than the other or is much stronger than the other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 片面的；偏颇的；不公正的

ext.ext_cn: 该组织仍然认为政府有失公允。
ext.ext_en: The organisation still believes the government is being one sided...

ext.ext_cn: 关于她与特德的问题，有一则非常片面的报道。
ext.ext_en: There has been a very one-sided account of her problems with Ted.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as one-sided, you are critical of what they say or do because you think it shows that they have considered only one side of an issue or event.

ext.ext_cn: 以所有司机为征收对象的高速公路年税
ext.ext_en: ...an annual motorway levy on all drivers.

defs.def_en: A levy is a sum of money that you have to pay, for example as a tax to the government.

ext.ext_cn: 他们对基督徒的商业交易征收宗教税。
ext.ext_en: They levied religious taxes on Christian commercial transactions...

ext.ext_cn: 未经议会授权不得征税。
ext.ext_en: Taxes should not be levied without the authority of Parliament.

defs.def_en: If a government or organization levies a tax or other sum of money, it demands it from people or organizations.

ext.ext_cn: 《金融时报》30股指上涨16.4点，收于1,559.6 点。
ext.ext_en: The FT 30 share index was up 16.4 points to 1,599.6.

defs.def_en: A share index is a number that indicates the state of a stock market. It is based on the combined share prices of a set of companies.

ext.ext_cn: 你或许是个怀疑论者，会把它归因于生活的不公正。
ext.ext_en: You may be a sceptic and put it down to life's inequalities.

defs.def_en: If you put something down to a particular thing, you believe that it is caused by that thing.

defs.def_cn: 删去，删除（著作中有所冒犯或令人震惊之处）

ext.ext_cn: 在第二版中，他对书中内容进行了大幅删减。
ext.ext_en: He heavily expurgated the work in its second edition.

defs.def_en: If someone expurgates a piece of writing, they remove parts of it before it is published because they think those parts will offend or shock people.

defs.def_cn: 精神变态者；变态人格者

ext.ext_cn: 她被一个危险的精神变态狂给绑架了。
ext.ext_en: She was abducted by a dangerous psychopath.

defs.def_en: A psychopath is someone who has serious mental problems and who may act in a violent way without feeling sorry for what they have done.

ext.ext_cn: “我们一定可以做点儿什么吧？”佩林突然插话道。
ext.ext_en: 'Surely there's something we can do?' interjected Palin...

ext.ext_cn: 他仔细地听着,只是偶尔插句话。
ext.ext_en: He listened thoughtfully, interjecting only the odd word.

defs.def_en: If you interject something, you say it and interrupt someone else who is speaking.

ext.ext_cn: 禁止歧视的法律
ext.ext_en: ...a prohibition on discrimination.

ext.ext_cn: 禁止在机场养鸟的法令
ext.ext_en: ...prohibitions against feeding birds at the airport.

defs.def_en: See also:prohibit;A prohibition is a law or rule forbidding something.

defs.def_cn: 内部通话系统(或设备);对讲机
defs.def_en: An intercom is a small box with a microphone which is connected to a loudspeaker in another room. You use it to talk to the people in the other room.

defs.def_cn: 离婚的人,离异者(尤指女子)
defs.def_en: A divorcee is a person, especially a woman, who is divorced.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （通常指男士）大肚子的，大腹便便的
defs.def_en: Someone, usually a man, who is pot-bellied has a pot belly.
A discotheque is the same as a disco .

defs.def_cn: （常指因激动、生气或痛苦）叫喊，大喊，吼叫

ext.ext_cn: “伊娃！”他大喊道。
ext.ext_en: 'Eva!' he yelled...

ext.ext_cn: 很抱歉昨天晚上我冲着你大吼大叫的。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry I yelled at you last night...

defs.def_en: If you yell, you shout loudly, usually because you are excited, angry, or in pain.

ext.ext_cn: 有什么东西从鲍勃的脸上扫过，他大叫了一声。
ext.ext_en: Something brushed past Bob's face and he let out a yell.

defs.def_en: A yell is a loud shout given by someone who is afraid or in pain.
School books are books giving information about a particular subject, which children use at school.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （文章或谈话）严肃呆板的，冗长乏味的，生硬的

ext.ext_cn: 他的行文晦涩而生硬。
ext.ext_en: He had a dense, ponderous style.

defs.def_en: Ponderous writing or speech is very serious, uses more words than necessary, and is rather dull.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行动或动作）缓慢的，笨拙的，费力的

ext.ext_cn: 他的步伐沉重缓慢。
ext.ext_en: His steps were heavy and ponderous.

defs.def_en: A movement or action that is ponderous is very slow or clumsy.

ext.ext_cn: 乳头发炎会抑制出奶。
ext.ext_en: Sore nipples can inhibit the milk supply.

defs.def_en: The nipples on someone's body are the two small pieces of slightly hard flesh on their chest. Babies suck milk from their mothers' breasts through their mothers' nipples.

ext.ext_cn: 有橡皮奶嘴的白色塑料奶瓶
ext.ext_en: ...a white plastic bottle with a rubber nipple.

defs.def_en: A nipple is a piece of rubber or plastic which is fitted to the top of a baby's bottle.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (政治观点或政策)温和的，不激进的

ext.ext_cn: 他的观点非常温和，容易相处。
ext.ext_en: He was an easygoing man of very moderate views...

ext.ext_cn: 两国都呼吁不要滥用武力。
ext.ext_en: Both countries have called for a moderate approach to the use of force.

defs.def_en: Moderate political opinions or policies are not extreme.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 温和的民主党人
ext.ext_en: ...a moderate Democrat.

ext.ext_cn: 军队中的稳健派
ext.ext_en: ...the moderate wing of the army.

defs.def_en: You use moderate to describe people or groups who have moderate political opinions or policies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 中等的;普通的;适度的；适量的

ext.ext_cn: 适度的压力是有好处的，但是压力太大会把人压垮。
ext.ext_en: While a moderate amount of stress can be beneficial, too much stress can exhaust you.

ext.ext_cn: 适度的锻炼
ext.ext_en: ...moderate exercise.

defs.def_en: You use moderate to describe something that is neither large nor small in amount or degree.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数药物要么不能使病情真正好转，要么最多只能带来轻微的改善。
ext.ext_en: Most drugs offer either no real improvement or, at best, only moderate improvements.

defs.def_en: A moderate change in something is a change that is not great.

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望等他一上台，可以说服他观点别那么激进。
ext.ext_en: They are hoping that once in office he can be persuaded to moderate his views...

ext.ext_cn: 救援人员的紧迫危机感已经有所减弱。
ext.ext_en: Amongst relief workers, the immediate sense of crisis has moderated somewhat...

defs.def_en: If you moderate something or if it moderates, it becomes less extreme or violent and easier to deal with or accept.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 充满气体的；充满气泡的

ext.ext_cn: 这种香槟味道很甜，但气太多了。
ext.ext_en: The champagne was sweet and too gassy.

defs.def_en: Something that is gassy contains a lot of bubbles or gas.

defs.def_cn: 进行训诫，进行说教，教化

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名剧作家，我憎恨说教。
ext.ext_en: As a dramatist I hate to moralize...

ext.ext_cn: 社会通常会对那些“浪荡女子”指指点点。
ext.ext_en: Society in general moralized about 'loose women'.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is moralizing, you are critical of them for telling people what they think is right or wrong, especially when they have not been asked their opinion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们中大多数人需要过更为平衡的生活，以保持健康和快乐。
ext.ext_en: Most of us need to lead more balanced lives to be healthy and happy...

ext.ext_cn: 她正常妊娠，生了个健康的孩子。
ext.ext_en: She had a normal pregnancy and delivered a healthy child.

defs.def_en: Someone who is healthy is well and is not suffering from any illness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 显示健康的;反映健康的

ext.ext_cn: 健康的肤色
ext.ext_en: ...the glow of healthy skin.

ext.ext_cn: 食欲旺盛的年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...young adults with healthy appetites.

defs.def_en: If a feature or quality that you have is healthy, it makes you look well or shows that you are well.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有益于健康的;促进健康的

ext.ext_cn: 对健康大有裨益的室外活动
ext.ext_en: ...a great healthy outdoor pursuit.

ext.ext_cn: 有益于健康的饮食
ext.ext_en: ...a healthy diet.

defs.def_en: Something that is healthy is good for your health.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （机构或体系）兴旺的，运作良好的

ext.ext_cn: 经济繁荣的社会主义国家
ext.ext_en: ...an economically healthy socialist state.

defs.def_en: A healthy organization or system is successful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他预计本财年能继续保持可观的利润。
ext.ext_en: He predicts a continuation of healthy profits in the current financial year.

ext.ext_cn: 巨额账户
ext.ext_en: ...a healthy bank account.

defs.def_en: A healthy amount of something is a large amount that shows success.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她对工作持一种明智态度，令人耳目一新。
ext.ext_en: She has a refreshingly healthy attitude to work...

ext.ext_cn: 不逞匹夫之勇是很明智的。
ext.ext_en: It's very healthy to be afraid when there's something to be afraid of.

defs.def_en: If you have a healthy attitude about something, you show good sense.

defs.def_cn: (尤指商业或政治方面的)谈判，协商，磋商

ext.ext_cn: 我们已进行了有益的磋商，我相信我们很快能成交。
ext.ext_en: We have had meaningful negotiations and I believe we are very close to a deal...

ext.ext_cn: 经过10年协商，参议院已经正式批准了《削减战略武器条约》。
ext.ext_en: After 10 years of negotiation, the Senate ratified the strategic arms reduction treaty.

defs.def_en: Negotiations are formal discussions between people who have different aims or intentions, especially in business or politics, during which they try to reach an agreement.

ext.ext_cn: 大部分学校都很不愿意为减少开支而裁员。
ext.ext_en: Most schools are extremely unwilling to cut down on staff in order to cut costs.

ext.ext_cn: 为了让我们其余这些人能够睡得更安稳而要他们冒生命危险
ext.ext_en: ...asking them to risk their lives in order that the rest of us can sleep better.

defs.def_en: If you do something in order to achieve a particular thing or in order that something can happen, you do it because you want to achieve that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须抛弃那种认为要想活得有价值就得始终取悦他人的想法。
ext.ext_en: We need to get rid of the idea that we must be liked all the time in order to be worthwhile...

ext.ext_cn: 他们要想同政府讨价还价就得有人质。
ext.ext_en: They need hostages in order to bargain with the government.

defs.def_en: If someone must be in a particular situation in order to achieve something they want, they cannot achieve that thing if they are not in that situation.

ext.ext_cn: 在他们的电脑上查询个人记录，需要提供被查询人的姓名和地址。
ext.ext_en: In order for their computers to trace a person's records, they need both the name and address of the individual.

defs.def_en: If something must happen in order for something else to happen, the second thing cannot happen if the first thing does not happen.

ext.ext_cn: 威廉斯命令他离开。
ext.ext_en: Williams ordered him to leave...

ext.ext_cn: 他命令这些女人下车。
ext.ext_en: He ordered the women out of the car...

defs.def_en: If a person in authority orders someone to do something, they tell them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 总统已经下令进行全面调查。
ext.ext_en: The President has ordered a full investigation...

ext.ext_cn: 据电台报道，首相已下令实行价格管制。
ext.ext_en: The radio said that the prime minister had ordered price controls to be introduced...

defs.def_en: If someone in authority orders something, they give instructions that it should be done.

ext.ext_cn: 这些激进分子因拒不服从停止前进的命令而被击毙。
ext.ext_en: The activists were shot when they refused to obey an order to halt...

ext.ext_cn: 夜幕降临，克林顿命令手下休息。
ext.ext_en: As darkness fell, Clinton gave orders for his men to rest...

defs.def_en: If someone in authority gives you an order, they tell you to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 对于法院禁止她饲养动物的指令，她决定不再上诉。
ext.ext_en: She has decided not to appeal against a court order banning her from keeping animals...

ext.ext_cn: 他被处以两年的监管。
ext.ext_en: He was placed under a two-year supervision order.

defs.def_en: A court order is a legal instruction stating that something must be done.

ext.ext_cn: 阿塔纳斯点了一份鸡尾冷虾和一份色拉。
ext.ext_en: Atanas ordered a shrimp cocktail and a salad...

ext.ext_cn: 艾丽斯最后为自己和塔妮娅点了咖啡。
ext.ext_en: Iris finally ordered coffees for herself and Tania...

defs.def_en: When you order something that you are going to pay for, you ask for it to be brought to you, sent to you, or obtained for you.

ext.ext_cn: 英国铁路公司将订购188列火车。
ext.ext_en: British Rail are going to place an order for a hundred and eighty-eight trains.

defs.def_en: An order is a request for something to be brought, made, or obtained for you in return for money.

ext.ext_cn: 侍者把他们点的餐端了过来，格雷厄姆签了单。
ext.ext_en: The waiter returned with their order and Graham signed the bill...

ext.ext_cn: 我们订的货他们无法供应。
ext.ext_en: They can't supply our order.

defs.def_en: Someone's order is what they have asked to be brought, made, or obtained for them in return for money.

ext.ext_cn: 这家航空公司尚有2,500架新飞机在订购中。
ext.ext_en: The airlines still have 2,500 new aeroplanes on order.

defs.def_en: Something that is on order at a shop or factory has been asked for but has not yet been supplied.

ext.ext_cn: 现在她为顾客定做漂亮的干花插花。
ext.ext_en: She now makes wonderful dried flower arrangements to order...

ext.ext_cn: 偷什么样的车买主说了算。
ext.ext_en: Cars are stolen to order for clients.

defs.def_en: If you do something to order, you do it whenever you are asked to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 遵照命令，我不能与任何人谈论他执行的任务和他所在的地点。
ext.ext_en: I am under orders not to discuss his mission or his location with anyone.

defs.def_en: If you are under orders to do something, you have been told to do it by someone in authority.

ext.ext_cn: （按照优先次序）写下你想具有的品质。
ext.ext_en: Write down (in order of priority) the qualities you'd like to have...

ext.ext_cn: 音像店应当按照简单的字母顺序而不是依类别来摆放唱片。
ext.ext_en: Music shops should arrange their recordings in simple alphabetical order, rather than by category...

defs.def_en: If a set of things are arranged or done in a particular order, they are arranged or done so one thing follows another, often according to a particular factor such as importance.

ext.ext_cn: 想在混乱中理出头绪是一种知性本能。
ext.ext_en: The wish to impose order upon confusion is a kind of intellectual instinct...

ext.ext_cn: 列表能使一切井然有序、便于管理。
ext.ext_en: Making lists can create order and control.

defs.def_en: Order is the situation that exists when everything is in the correct or expected place, or happens at the correct or expected time.

ext.ext_cn: 去年11月，军队被派往这些岛屿以恢复秩序。
ext.ext_en: Troops were sent to the islands to restore order last November...

ext.ext_cn: 他掌握着动用武力维持公共治安的权力。
ext.ext_en: He has the power to use force to maintain public order.

defs.def_en: Order is the situation that exists when people obey the law and do not fight or riot.

ext.ext_cn: 冷战的结束带来了建立一个以国际合作为基础的世界新秩序的希望。
ext.ext_en: The end of the Cold War has produced the prospect of a new world order based on international co-operation...

ext.ext_cn: 一些女权主义者寻求在现存的社会制度内进行改革。
ext.ext_en: Some feminists sought reforms within the existing social order.

defs.def_en: When people talk about a particular order, they mean the way society is organized at a particular time.

ext.ext_cn: 按等级划分的社会
ext.ext_en: ...a society which is ordered by hierarchy...

ext.ext_cn: 我们知道法国人安排事情的方式与众不同。
ext.ext_en: We know the French order things differently.

defs.def_en: The way that something is ordered is the way that it is organized and structured.

ext.ext_cn: 1973年的一个夜晚，又发生了一件始料未及的事情，不过这两件事完全不同。
ext.ext_en: Another unexpected event, though of quite a different order, occurred one evening in 1973...

ext.ext_cn: 我们一诺千金。
ext.ext_en: Our commitment will be of the highest order.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something of a particular order, you mean something of a particular kind.

ext.ext_cn: 本笃会
ext.ext_en: ...the Benedictine order of monks.

defs.def_en: A religious order is a group of monks or nuns who live according to a particular set of rules.

ext.ext_cn: 最高骑士勋位是嘉德勋位。
ext.ext_en: The highest Order of Knighthood is the Order of the Garter.

defs.def_en: People who belong to a particular order have been given a particular honour or rank by the head of their country as a reward for their services or achievements.
The person in charge of a meeting can say 'Order!' to tell people to stop making a noise.

ext.ext_cn: 现在他有了一个让自己的生活重新步入正轨的机会。
ext.ext_en: Now he has a chance to put his life back in order...

ext.ext_cn: 保持房间整洁是她的工作。
ext.ext_en: It was her job to keep the room in order...

defs.def_en: If you put or keep something in order, you make sure that it is tidy or properly organized.

defs.def_cn: 应当发生（或提供）的；自然的；合宜的

ext.ext_cn: 改革势在必行。
ext.ext_en: Reforms are clearly in order...

ext.ext_cn: 你回来真是太好了，就等着向你道贺呢！
ext.ext_en: It's great to have you back. Congratulations are surely in order!

defs.def_en: If you think something is in order, you think it should happen or be provided.

ext.ext_cn: 他们借了大约1,000万英镑。
ext.ext_en: They borrowed something in the order of £10 million...

ext.ext_cn: 往常的出入约为20%。
ext.ext_en: At other times the discrepancy was of the order of 20%.

defs.def_en: You use in the order of or of the order of when mentioning an approximate figure.

ext.ext_cn: 这艘船的安全设备破损失修。
ext.ext_en: The vessel's safety equipment was not in good order.

defs.def_en: If something is in good order, it is in good condition.

defs.def_cn: （机器、设备等）处于正常工作状态

ext.ext_cn: 这艘宇宙飞船的6件科学仪器中只有一半还在正常运转。
ext.ext_en: Only half of the spacecraft's six science instruments are still in working order.

defs.def_en: A machine or device that is in working order is functioning properly and is not broken.

defs.def_cn: 时下常见的；普遍的；流行的

ext.ext_cn: 我们生活在这个光怪陆离的时代，各种奇怪的生活安排如今都司空见惯。
ext.ext_en: These are strange times in which we live, and strange arrangements appear to be the order of the day.

defs.def_en: If a particular way of behaving or doing something is the order of the day, it is very common.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的电话坏了。
ext.ext_en: Their phone's out of order.

defs.def_en: A machine or device that is out of order is broken and does not work.

defs.def_cn: 令人无法接受的；不得体的；不公平的

ext.ext_cn: 你不觉得这份报纸发表这篇文章有点不妥吗？
ext.ext_en: You don't think the paper's a bit out of order in publishing it?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or their behaviour is out of order, you mean that their behaviour is unacceptable or unfair.

ext.ext_cn: 现在按照体型由小到大的顺序画出或是临摹出10只恐龙。
ext.ext_en: Now draw or trace ten dinosaurs in ascending order of size.

ext.ext_cn: 反社会行为盘旋上升的态势
ext.ext_en: ...an ascending spiral of antisocial behaviour.

defs.def_en: See also:ascend;If a group of things is arranged in ascending order, each thing is bigger, greater, or more important than the thing before it.

ext.ext_cn: 培训包括对急救过程的真实模拟。
ext.ext_en: Training includes realistic simulation of casualty procedures.

ext.ext_cn: 对温室效应的模拟
ext.ext_en: ...a simulation of the greenhouse effect.

defs.def_en: Simulation is the process of simulating something or the result of simulating it.

defs.def_cn: （房屋等）有鬼魂出没的，闹鬼的

ext.ext_cn: 特蕾西说小木屋闹鬼。
ext.ext_en: Tracy said the cabin was haunted.

ext.ext_cn: 闹鬼的房子
ext.ext_en: ...a haunted house.

defs.def_en: A haunted building or other place is one where a ghost regularly appears.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她愁容满面，我差点儿没认出她来。
ext.ext_en: She looked so haunted, I almost didn't recognize her.

defs.def_en: Someone who has a haunted expression looks very worried or troubled.

defs.def_cn: 耸人听闻的故事(或新闻);恐怖电影

ext.ext_cn: 玛莎·亨特的第二部小说《自由》是一部恐怖小说。
ext.ext_en: Marsha Hunt's second novel, 'Free', is a shocker.

defs.def_en: A shocker is something such as a story, a piece of news, or a film that shocks people or that is intended to shock them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 抹过黄油的嫩土豆
ext.ext_en: ...buttery new potatoes.

ext.ext_cn: 酥皮点心的黄油味道
ext.ext_en: ...the buttery taste of the pastry.

defs.def_en: Buttery food contains butter or is covered with butter.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他写的都是些自我陶醉、故作清高的垃圾作品。
ext.ext_en: He writes smug, sanctimonious rubbish...

ext.ext_cn: 你这个道貌岸然的伪君子！
ext.ext_en: You sanctimonious little hypocrite!

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is sanctimonious, you disapprove of them because you think that they are trying to appear morally better than other people.
Continental drift is the slow movement of the Earth's continents towards and away from each other.
In the United States, the IRS is the government authority which collects taxes. IRS is an abbreviation for (缩略＝) 'Inland Revenue Service'.

defs.def_cn: (同一间卧室里成对的)一张单人床
defs.def_en: Twin beds are two single beds in one bedroom.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 乡绅形象的;乡绅派头的

ext.ext_cn: 一位面颊绯红、一副乡下贵族打扮的老妇人出现在门口。
ext.ext_en: An older woman, pink-cheeked and tweedy, appeared in the doorway.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as tweedy, you mean that they have an upper-class but plain appearance, and look as if they live in the country, for example because they are wearing tweed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Tweedy clothes are made from tweed.

defs.def_cn: (委员会、组织机构的)主席身份，主席任期

ext.ext_cn: 政府设立一个委员会，任命罗伊·古德教授为主席。
ext.ext_en: The Government has set up a committee under the chairmanship of Professor Roy Goode.

defs.def_en: The chairmanship of a committee or organization is the fact of being its chairperson. Someone's chairmanship can also mean the period during which they are chairperson.

ext.ext_cn: 湿气被吸到织物表面从而蒸发。
ext.ext_en: Moisture is drawn to the surface of the fabric so that it evaporates...

ext.ext_cn: 水在阳光照射下蒸发了。
ext.ext_en: The water is evaporated by the sun.

defs.def_en: When a liquid evaporates, or is evaporated, it changes from a liquid state to a gas, because its temperature has increased.

defs.def_cn: （情绪）逐渐消失；（计划）逐渐落空；（活动）逐渐停止

ext.ext_cn: 我的怒气渐渐消失，想大哭一场。
ext.ext_en: My anger evaporated and I wanted to cry...

ext.ext_cn: 你的梦想似乎总是逐渐破灭，从来没有什么事情能完全符合你的预期。
ext.ext_en: Your dreams always seem to evaporate, and nothing ever quite matches expectations...

defs.def_en: If a feeling, plan, or activity evaporates, it gradually becomes weaker and eventually disappears completely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她开始被人们赞誉为有一颗金子般的心的无私女孩。
ext.ext_en: She started to get a reputation as an unselfish girl with a heart of gold...

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名选手，他毫无私念，真正把自己摆在团队中。
ext.ext_en: As a player he was unselfish, a true team man.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as unselfish, you approve of the fact that they regard other people's wishes and interests as more important than their own.

defs.def_cn: (水)剧烈翻滚的，湍急的，汹涌澎湃的

ext.ext_cn: 能够让我们不去注意脚下的峡谷和混浊湍流的任何事情
ext.ext_en: ...anything to take our minds off that gap and the brown, churning water below.

defs.def_en: Churning water is moving about violently.

defs.def_cn: 背后说别人的坏话；背后毁谤

ext.ext_cn: 在公司里，背后说人坏话并非什么新鲜事。
ext.ext_en: Corporate backbiting is nothing new.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of backbiting, you mean that they say unpleasant or unkind things about someone who is not present, especially in order to stop them doing well at work.

ext.ext_cn: 天主教会在整个波兰历史上曾发挥过举足轻重的作用。
ext.ext_en: The Catholic Church has played a prominent role throughout Polish history.

ext.ext_cn: 历史上最令人发指的屠杀狂徒
ext.ext_en: ...the most evil mass killer in history.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the events of the past as history. You can also refer to the past events which concern a particular topic or place as its history.
History is a subject studied in schools, colleges, and universities that deals with events that have happened in the past.

defs.def_cn: 过去事件的记载;发展史

ext.ext_cn: 他在加拿大辉煌的播音史
ext.ext_en: ...his magnificent history of broadcasting in Canada.

ext.ext_cn: 罗切斯特老一辈人的口述史
ext.ext_en: ...oral histories taken from elderly people in Rochester.

defs.def_en: A history is an account of events that have happened in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 他过去酗酒度日。
ext.ext_en: He had a history of drink problems...

ext.ext_cn: 男孩的母亲过去常虐待自己的孩子。
ext.ext_en: The boy's mother had a history of abusing her children.

defs.def_en: If a person or a place has a history of something, it has been very common or has happened frequently in their past.

ext.ext_cn: 由于他的病史，他无法找到新的工作。
ext.ext_en: He couldn't get a new job because of his medical history.

ext.ext_cn: 安妮·弗兰克生平资料展
ext.ext_en: ...an exhibition documenting the personal history of Anne Frank.

defs.def_en: Someone's history is the set of facts that are known about their past.

defs.def_cn: 历史的陈迹;（无关紧要的）往事

ext.ext_cn: 夏洛特敦协定已成为历史。
ext.ext_en: The Charlottetown agreement is history.

defs.def_en: If you say that an event, thing, or person is history, you mean that they are no longer important.

defs.def_cn: 接下来的事就世人皆知了

ext.ext_cn: 我们是在上大学时认识的，接下来的事大家都知道了。
ext.ext_en: We met at college, the rest is history.

defs.def_en: If you are telling someone about an event and say the rest is history, you mean that you do not need to tell them what happened next because everyone knows about it already.

defs.def_cn: 午后茶点（包括茶及三明治、蛋糕等）
defs.def_en: Afternoon tea is a small meal you can have in the afternoon. It includes a cup of tea and food such as sandwiches and cakes.

ext.ext_cn: 我把蜡烛吹灭了。
ext.ext_en: I blew out the candle.

defs.def_en: If you blow out a flame or a candle, you blow at it so that it stops burning.

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃被迫把车停在路边，然后跑去求助了。
ext.ext_en: Bob was forced to leave the car at the roadside and run for help...

ext.ext_cn: 现在路边小餐馆构成了餐饮业很大一部分。
ext.ext_en: Roadside cafes are now a big part of the catering industry.

defs.def_en: The roadside is the area at the edge of a road.

ext.ext_cn: 尼尔不停地打断我，使得我无法集中注意力。
ext.ext_en: Neal kept interrupting, breaking my concentration...

ext.ext_cn: 我们注意力不够集中，结果丢了球，输了比赛。
ext.ext_en: We lacked concentration and it cost us the goal and the game.

defs.def_en: Concentration on something involves giving all your attention to it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个地区是世界上野生动物最为密集的区域之一。
ext.ext_en: The area has one of the world's greatest concentrations of wildlife...

ext.ext_cn: 权力一直过多地集中在中央机构手中。
ext.ext_en: There's been too much concentration of power in the hands of central authorities.

defs.def_en: A concentration of something is a large amount of it or large numbers of it in a small area.

ext.ext_cn: pH值是测试溶液中自由氢原子浓度的单位。
ext.ext_en: pH is a measure of the concentration of free hydrogen atoms in a solution...

ext.ext_cn: 最新数据显示，过去10年来全球臭氧的浓度降低了几个百分点。
ext.ext_en: The latest data showed that global ozone concentrations had dropped several per cent over the last decade.

defs.def_en: The concentration of a substance is the proportion of essential ingredients or substances in it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个政府里净是爱管闲事的人。
ext.ext_en: This government is full of interfering busybodies.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a busybody, you are criticizing the way they interfere in other people's affairs.

ext.ext_cn: 我知道本回答我时在撒谎。
ext.ext_en: I knew Ben was lying when he answered me...

ext.ext_cn: 只回答问题。
ext.ext_en: Just answer the question...

defs.def_en: When you answer someone who has asked you something, you say something back to them.

ext.ext_cn: 未等答复，他就转身进了门。
ext.ext_en: Without waiting for an answer, he turned and went in through the door...

ext.ext_cn: 我不太清楚如何回答你的问题。
ext.ext_en: I don't quite know what to say in answer to your question.

defs.def_en: An answer is something that you say when you answer someone.

defs.def_cn: 接受反对意见;接受拒绝

ext.ext_cn: 她很强硬，不达目的誓不罢休。
ext.ext_en: She is tough, unwilling to take no for an answer...

ext.ext_cn: 他从来都坚持己见。
ext.ext_en: He would never take no for an answer.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone will not take no for an answer, you mean that they go on trying to make you agree to something even after you have refused.

ext.ext_cn: 他给你回信了吗？
ext.ext_en: Did he answer your letter?...

ext.ext_cn: 她看到一则招聘厨师的广告后写信应征。
ext.ext_en: She answered an advert for a job as a cook.

defs.def_en: If you answer a letter or advertisement, you write to the person who wrote it.

ext.ext_cn: 我写了信给他，但一直没收到回信。
ext.ext_en: I wrote to him but I never had an answer back...

ext.ext_cn: 她写了信给罗斯福的秘书，回复罗斯福前一天的来信。
ext.ext_en: She wrote to Roosevelt's secretary in answer to his letter of the day before.

defs.def_en: An answer is a letter that you write to someone who has written to you.

ext.ext_cn: 电话刚一响，她就接了。
