ext.ext_en: She answered her phone on the first ring...

ext.ext_cn: 一个中年妇女应声开了门。
ext.ext_en: A middle-aged woman answered the door.

defs.def_en: When you answer the telephone, you pick it up when it rings. When you answer the door, you open it when you hear a knock or the bell.

ext.ext_cn: 解决经济所面临的问题并非易事。
ext.ext_en: There are no easy answers to the problems facing the economy...

ext.ext_cn: 就大多数年轻的犯法者来说，把他们关进监狱不是解决问题的办法。
ext.ext_en: Prison is not the answer for most young offenders...

defs.def_en: An answer to a problem is a solution to it.

ext.ext_cn: 仅仅在答案上打叉号不会有助于学生做对日后的题目。
ext.ext_en: Simply marking an answer wrong will not help the pupil to get future examples correct...

ext.ext_cn: 以下所印的是1993年“脑力足球”小测验的答案。
ext.ext_en: Below are printed the answers to the Brain of Soccer 1993 quiz.

defs.def_en: Someone's answer to a question in a test or quiz is what they write or say in an attempt to give the facts that are asked for. The answer to a question is the fact that was asked for.

ext.ext_cn: 为获得学位，她回答了10页纸上的81个问题。
ext.ext_en: To obtain her degree, she answered 81 questions over 10 papers.

defs.def_en: When you answer a question in a test or quiz, you write or say something in an attempt to give the facts that are asked for.

ext.ext_cn: 为了回应她会中途退赛的猜测，她大胆地宣布她要赢得这场比赛。
ext.ext_en: In answer to speculation that she wouldn't finish the race, she boldly declared her intention of winning it.

defs.def_en: Your answer to something that someone has said or done is what you say or do in response to it or in defence of yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 他对她的微笑回以同礼。
ext.ext_en: He answered her smile with one of his own...

ext.ext_cn: 那份声明似乎是专门就联合轰炸任务的批评作出反击。
ext.ext_en: That statement seemed designed to answer criticism of allied bombing missions.

defs.def_en: If you answer something that someone has said or done, you respond to it.

defs.def_cn: （某地）与…相似的东西，相当于…的东西

ext.ext_cn: 巴西甜酒相当于是巴西的龙舌兰酒。
ext.ext_en: Cachaca is Brazil's answer to tequila.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a place's answer to a famous thing, you mean that the first thing is the equivalent of the second in that place.

defs.def_cn: 满足，适合，符合（需要、目的）

ext.ext_cn: 我们提供特别设计的购物车，以满足带幼儿的父母的需要。
ext.ext_en: We provide specially designed shopping trolleys to answer the needs of parents with young children.

defs.def_en: If something answers a need or purpose, it satisfies it, because it has the right qualities.

ext.ext_cn: 与描述的疑犯样子相符的两名男子试图进入瑞士。
ext.ext_en: Two men answering the description of the suspects tried to enter Switzerland...

ext.ext_cn: 日本人从未制造过与此描述有丝毫相近的飞机。
ext.ext_en: The Japanese never built any aircraft remotely answering to this description.

defs.def_en: If someone or something answers a particular description or answers to it, they have the characteristics described.

ext.ext_cn: 接下来的5年中，他们住在一间肮脏不堪的小破屋里。
ext.ext_en: They lived in a squalid hovel for the next five years.

defs.def_en: A hovel is a small hut, especially one which is dirty or needs a lot of repair.

ext.ext_cn: 我找了份提供住所的工作，但分给我的房间简直不是人住的地方。
ext.ext_en: I went for a living-in job, but the room I was given was a hovel.

defs.def_en: You describe a house, room, or flat as a hovel to express your disapproval or dislike of it because it is dirty, untidy, and in poor condition.

defs.def_cn: 在陆地上的；在岸上的；近岸的

ext.ext_cn: 西欧最大的陆上油田
ext.ext_en: ...Western Europe's biggest onshore oilfield.

ext.ext_cn: 他们没有赶上渡轮，还滞留在岸上。
ext.ext_en: They missed the ferry and remained onshore.

defs.def_en: Onshore means happening on or near land, rather than at sea.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 向岸海风在他身边徐徐吹过。
ext.ext_en: The onshore wind blew steadily past him.

ext.ext_cn: 有一丝向岸微风在轻轻吹拂。
ext.ext_en: There was a bit of a wind and it was blowing onshore.

defs.def_en: Onshore means happening or moving towards the land.

ext.ext_cn: 任何模型都无法完全模拟自然本身。
ext.ext_en: No model can ever be a perfect analogue of nature itself.

defs.def_en: If one thing is an analogue of another, it is similar in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 采自该录像带的模拟信号被转换成数字代码。
ext.ext_en: The analogue signals from the video tape are converted into digital code.

defs.def_en: Analogue technology involves measuring, storing, or recording an infinitely variable amount of information by using physical quantities such as voltage.
An analogue watch or clock shows what it is measuring with a pointer on a dial rather than with a number display.

ext.ext_cn: 毫无疑问，这个男人身上透着一种野性魅力。
ext.ext_en: There was no doubting the animal magnetism of the man...

ext.ext_cn: 她过后说起时会形容他的魅力难以抵挡。
ext.ext_en: Later, she would describe his magnetism as irresistible.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that has magnetism has unusual, powerful, and exciting qualities which attract people to them.
Magnetism is the natural power of some objects and substances, especially iron, to attract other objects towards them.

ext.ext_cn: 他已被老板派往罗马。
ext.ext_en: He had been sent to Rome by his employer...

ext.ext_cn: 这家电话公司是该国最大的用工单位。
ext.ext_en: The telephone company is the country's largest employer.

defs.def_en: Your employer is the person or organization that you work for.

defs.def_cn: 一条线地伸展开来的;一字排开的

ext.ext_cn: 河的北岸是一排大楼。
ext.ext_en: Buildings were strung out on the north side of the river.

defs.def_en: If things are strung out somewhere, they are spread out in a line.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 吸食海洛因令他整日神志不清。
ext.ext_en: He was permanently strung out on heroin.

defs.def_en: If someone is strung out on drugs, they are heavily affected by drugs.

defs.def_cn: 葛缕子(其籽常用作调味料)
defs.def_en: Caraway is a plant with strong-tasting seeds that are used in cooking. Caraway seeds are often used to flavour bread and cakes.

ext.ext_cn: 我们成年之后不再长个儿。
ext.ext_en: We stop growing at maturity.

defs.def_en: When people, animals, and plants grow, they increase in size and change physically over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 车站月台的两头种着玫瑰花。
ext.ext_en: The station had roses growing at each end of the platform.

defs.def_en: If a plant or tree grows in a particular place, it is alive there.

ext.ext_cn: 我总是喜欢种一些红洋葱。
ext.ext_en: I always grow a few red onions...

ext.ext_cn: 古罗马人最先种植莴苣。
ext.ext_en: Lettuce was grown by the Ancient Romans.

defs.def_en: If you grow a particular type of plant, you put seeds or young plants in the ground and look after them as they develop.

ext.ext_cn: 然后，头发又长起来了，我感觉棒极了。
ext.ext_en: Then the hair began to grow again and I felt terrific.

defs.def_en: When someone's hair grows, it gradually becomes longer. Your nails also grow.

defs.def_cn: 留长（头发或指甲）；蓄（胡须）

ext.ext_cn: 我最好开始留头发。
ext.ext_en: I'd better start growing my hair.

defs.def_en: If someone grows their hair, or grows a beard or moustache, they stop cutting their hair or shaving so that their hair becomes longer. You can also grow your nails.

ext.ext_cn: 他们开始长大成人了。
ext.ext_en: They began to grow as persons.

defs.def_en: If someone grows mentally, they change and develop in character or attitude.

ext.ext_cn: 我开始有些害怕隔壁的那个家伙。
ext.ext_en: I grew a little afraid of the guy next door...

ext.ext_cn: 他渐渐变老了。
ext.ext_en: He's growing old...

defs.def_en: You use grow to say that someone or something gradually changes until they have a new quality, feeling, or attitude.

ext.ext_cn: 上个月，波兰的失业人数增长超过了1/4。
ext.ext_en: The number of unemployed people in Poland has grown by more than a quarter in the last month...

ext.ext_cn: 反对的声音越来越高，政府只好同意进行谈判。
ext.ext_en: Opposition grew and the government agreed to negotiate.

defs.def_en: If an amount, feeling, or problem grows, it becomes greater or more intense.

ext.ext_cn: 这些男孩子长成了男子汉。
ext.ext_en: The boys grew into men...

ext.ext_cn: 这场政治争端有可能演化成一场全面爆发的危机。
ext.ext_en: This political row threatens to grow into a full blown crisis.

defs.def_en: If one thing grows into another, it develops or changes until it becomes that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 创作这本书的想法来源于跟菲莉帕·布鲁斯特的谈话。
ext.ext_en: The idea for this book grew out of conversations with Philippa Brewster.

defs.def_en: If something such as an idea or a plan grows out of something else, it develops from it.

ext.ext_cn: 经济持续发展。
ext.ext_en: The economy continues to grow.

ext.ext_cn: 迅速发展的企业
ext.ext_en: ...a fast growing business.

defs.def_en: If the economy or a business grows, it increases in wealth, size, or importance.

ext.ext_cn: 为了拓展业务，他需要提高整个团队的管理技能和创新能力。
ext.ext_en: To grow the business, he needs to develop management expertise and innovation across his team.

defs.def_en: If someone grows a business, they take actions that will cause it to increase in wealth, size, or importance.

ext.ext_cn: 岩石洞穴中形成的水晶
ext.ext_en: ...crystals that grow in cavities in the rock...

ext.ext_cn: 我们想跟孩子们一起制作硫酸铜晶体。
ext.ext_en: We tried to grow some copper sulphate crystals with our children.

defs.def_en: If a crystal grows, or if a scientist grows it, it forms from a solution.

ext.ext_cn: “它可能表现了我内心很不成熟的一面，”他承认道。
ext.ext_en: 'It probably shows up a deeply immature part of my psyche,' he confesses...

ext.ext_cn: 他对这个神话的探讨揭示了美国人的心理。
ext.ext_en: His exploration of the myth brings insight into the American psyche.

defs.def_en: In psychology, your psyche is your mind and your deepest feelings and attitudes.

defs.def_cn: 不加掩饰的；公开的；坦率的

ext.ext_cn: 不加掩饰的高兴
ext.ext_en: ...undisguised glee...

ext.ext_cn: 希恩低头看了看鲍尔，毫不掩饰自己的厌恶。
ext.ext_en: Hean looked down at Bauer in undisguised disgust...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's feelings as undisguised, you mean that they show them openly and do not make any attempt to hide them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有趣的;令人愉快的;惬意的

ext.ext_cn: 这比我预期的有趣得多。
ext.ext_en: It was much more enjoyable than I had expected.

ext.ext_cn: 他们做的最有趣的活动
ext.ext_en: ...the most enjoyable activity they did.

defs.def_en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.
Reverse video is the process of reversing the colours of normal characters and background on a computer screen, in order to highlight the display.

ext.ext_cn: 首相呼吁年轻人行使他们的投票权。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister appealed to young people to use their vote...

ext.ext_cn: 他将呼吁国家延长领取失业救济金的时限。
ext.ext_en: He will appeal to the state for an extension of unemployment benefits...

defs.def_en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them.

ext.ext_cn: 法赫德国王传话给他，据信内容是呼吁整个阿拉伯世界团结起来。
ext.ext_en: He has a message from King Fahd, believed to be an appeal for Arab unity...

ext.ext_cn: 罗马尼亚政府最后一刻恳请他取消行程。
ext.ext_en: Romania's government issued a last-minute appeal to him to call off his trip.

defs.def_en: An appeal is a serious and urgent request.

ext.ext_cn: 为挽救存有珍贵手稿的图书馆的一次募捐
ext.ext_en: ...an appeal to save a library containing priceless manuscripts...

ext.ext_cn: 这不是为赈济饥荒的又一次募捐。
ext.ext_en: This is not another appeal for famine relief.

defs.def_en: An appeal is an attempt to raise money for a charity or for a good cause.

ext.ext_cn: 他说他们将对该决议提出申诉。
ext.ext_en: He said they would appeal against the decision...

ext.ext_cn: 我们打算对裁决提出上诉。
ext.ext_en: We intend to appeal the verdict...

defs.def_en: If you appeal to someone in authority against a decision, you formally ask them to change it. In British English, you appeal against something. In American English, you appeal something.

ext.ext_cn: 希思对判决不服提出上诉，后来胜诉了。
ext.ext_en: Heath's appeal against the sentence was later successful...

ext.ext_cn: 陪审团同意她的说法，但在上诉时她败诉了。
ext.ext_en: The jury agreed with her, but she lost the case on appeal.

defs.def_en: See also:Court of Appeal;An appeal is a formal request for a decision to be changed.

ext.ext_cn: 从另一方面来说，这个想法又使他很感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: On the other hand, the idea appealed to him...

ext.ext_cn: 该系列长期受到各类人士的欢迎。
ext.ext_en: The range has long appealed to all tastes.

defs.def_en: If something appeals to you, you find it attractive or interesting.

ext.ext_cn: 新的党名意在使该党对公众具有更强的吸引力。
ext.ext_en: Its new title was meant to give the party greater public appeal...

ext.ext_cn: 约翰逊广受各界人士欢迎。
ext.ext_en: Johnson's appeal is to people in all walks of life.

defs.def_en: See also:sex appeal;The appeal of something is a quality that it has which people find attractive or interesting.

ext.ext_cn: 政府匆忙通过了针对黑手党首领的立法。
ext.ext_en: The government rushed through legislation aimed at Mafia leaders...

ext.ext_cn: 他们仓促举行了葬礼，掩盖了所有证据。
ext.ext_en: They rushed the burial through so no evidence would show up.

defs.def_en: If you rush something through, you deal with it quickly so that it is ready in a shorter time than usual.

ext.ext_cn: 他是奥彭那幅名画中位于前景的戴圆顶硬礼帽的那个人物。
ext.ext_en: He is the bowler-hatted figure in the foreground of Orpen's famous painting.

defs.def_en: The foreground of a picture or scene you are looking at is the part or area of it that appears nearest to you.

ext.ext_cn: 这是近年来开始备受关注的另一个令人忧虑的问题。
ext.ext_en: This is another worry that has come to the foreground in recent years.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is in the foreground, or comes to the foreground, they receive a lot of attention.

ext.ext_cn: 他的书重点讲了 3 个事件，以警察和媒体的关系为中心展开。
ext.ext_en: His book foregrounds three events in which police relations with the media were central.

defs.def_en: To foreground certain features of a situation means to make them the most important part of a description or account.

defs.def_cn: (中心、服务）免费提供信息和帮助的

ext.ext_cn: 年轻妈妈们的活动中心
ext.ext_en: ...a drop-in centre for young mothers.

defs.def_en: Drop-in centres or services provide information and help for people with particular problems, usually on a free and informal basis.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在有雪或冰时登山者固定在靴底的)冰爪
defs.def_en: Crampons are metal plates with spikes underneath which mountain climbers fasten to the bottom of their boots, especially when there is snow or ice, in order to make climbing easier.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他仪容整洁，穿戴漂亮，就是人长得不好看。
ext.ext_en: He was smart and well groomed but not good looking...

ext.ext_cn: 我身穿一套帅气的藏青色西服。
ext.ext_en: I was dressed in a smart navy blue suit.

defs.def_en: Smart people and things are pleasantly neat and clean in appearance.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他认为自己比萨拉聪明。
ext.ext_en: He thinks he's smarter than Sarah is...

ext.ext_cn: 购买昂贵的家具不见得就是最明智之举。
ext.ext_en: Buying expensive furniture is not necessarily the smartest move to make.

defs.def_en: See also:smartly;street smart;You can describe someone who is clever as smart .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 气派不凡的伦敦晚宴
ext.ext_en: ...smart London dinner parties.

ext.ext_cn: 豪华的住宅区
ext.ext_en: ...a smart residential district.

defs.def_en: A smart place or event is connected with wealthy and fashionable people.

defs.def_cn: (炸弹、武器等)灵巧的,精密制导的
defs.def_en: Smart bombs and weapons are guided by computers and lasers so that they hit their targets accurately.

defs.def_cn: (身体的某个部位或伤口)剧痛，刺痛

ext.ext_cn: 我的眼睛被烟薰得很疼。
ext.ext_en: My eyes smarted from the smoke.

defs.def_en: If a part of your body or a wound smarts, you feel a sharp stinging pain in it.

defs.def_cn: (因批评、失败等)感到不高兴，感到难受

ext.ext_cn: 美国人仍然对越南战争的失败耿耿于怀。
ext.ext_en: The Americans were still smarting from their defeat in the Vietnam War...

ext.ext_cn: 他还在为别人批评他尽管最终胜出但表现笨拙感到闷闷不乐。
ext.ext_en: He is still smarting over criticism of his victorious but clumsy performance.

defs.def_en: If you are smarting from something such as criticism or failure, you feel upset about it.

ext.ext_cn: 思派古——洛杉矶的时尚富人最喜欢光顾的用餐之地
ext.ext_en: ...Spago, favourite eating place of the Los Angeles smart set.

defs.def_en: The smart set is a group of fashionable and wealthy people.

defs.def_cn: (为隐瞒或逃避某事而)暂不作决定，迟迟不作答复，态度骑墙

ext.ext_cn: 政府只是在模棱两可地拖延时间，企图掩盖自己的政治窘态。
ext.ext_en: The administration is just stonewalling in an attempt to hide their political embarrassment...

ext.ext_cn: 他这周竭力避免作出明确答复，甚至连一些最温和的建议都企图阻拦。
ext.ext_en: He did his best this week to stonewall questions and to block even the most modest proposals.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone stonewalls, you disapprove of them because they delay giving a clear answer or making a clear decision, often because there is something that they want to hide or avoid doing.

defs.def_cn: （旧时的人或物的）当代翻版的，现代的，当今的

ext.ext_cn: 他深信自己是当代先知。
ext.ext_en: He holds the belief that he is a latter-day prophet.

defs.def_en: Latter-day is used to describe someone or something that is a modern equivalent of a person or thing in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 很多人正计划回到自己的祖国去。
ext.ext_en: Many are planning to return to their homeland.

defs.def_en: Your homeland is your native country.

defs.def_cn: “黑人家园”（指过去南非种族隔离制度下的黑人有一定自治权的地区）
defs.def_en: The homelands were regions within South Africa in which black South Africans had a limited form of self-government.

ext.ext_cn: 她的面孔出现在十几种杂志的封面上。
ext.ext_en: Her face is on the cover of a dozen or more magazines.

defs.def_en: A magazine is a publication with a paper cover which is issued regularly, usually every week or every month, and which contains articles, stories, photographs, and advertisements.

defs.def_cn: (广播、电视上融合多种话题的)杂志型节目，板块节目

ext.ext_cn: 直播的艺术板块节目
ext.ext_en: ...a live arts magazine.

ext.ext_cn: 《当下科学》——一个每周一期的科学新闻杂志型节目
ext.ext_en: ...'Science In Action', a weekly science magazine programme.

defs.def_en: On radio or television, a magazine or a magazine programme is a programme consisting of several items about different topics, people, and events.
In an automatic gun, the magazine is the part that contains the bullets.
A magazine is a building in which things such as guns, bullets, and explosives are kept.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们对在人身上使用酶疗法非常慎重。
ext.ext_en: The scientists are cautious about using enzyme therapy on humans...

ext.ext_cn: 他做事很谨慎。
ext.ext_en: He is a very cautious man.

defs.def_en: Someone who is cautious acts very carefully in order to avoid possible danger.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 人们一直将他视为主张更为谨慎的经济改革措施的提倡者。
ext.ext_en: He has been seen as a champion of a more cautious approach to economic reform.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's attitude or reaction as cautious, you mean that it is limited or careful.

ext.ext_cn: 多么可惜，他的事业深陷困局。
ext.ext_en: What a pity that his career was left to flounder...

ext.ext_cn: 经济深陷困境。
ext.ext_en: The economy was floundering.

defs.def_en: If something is floundering, it has many problems and may soon fail completely.

ext.ext_cn: 现在，你们的总统正踌躇不前，试图找到某种办法来推动他的竞选活动的开展。
ext.ext_en: Right now, you've got a president who's floundering, trying to find some way to get his campaign jump-started...

ext.ext_cn: 我知道你正不知所措，是在病急乱投医。
ext.ext_en: I know that you're floundering around, trying to grasp at any straw.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is floundering, you are criticizing them for not making decisions or for not knowing what to say or do.

ext.ext_cn: 有 3 个人在水中挣扎。
ext.ext_en: Three men were floundering about in the water.

defs.def_en: If you flounder in water or mud, you move in an uncontrolled way, trying not to sink.

ext.ext_cn: 但拔先生的餐盘里盛满了填馅的比目鱼。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Dambar had loaded his plate with stuffed flounder.

ext.ext_cn: 但拔先生的餐盘里盛满了填馅的比目鱼。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Dambar had loaded his plate with stuffed flounder.

defs.def_en: A flounder is a flat fish that you can eat.

ext.ext_cn: 在遭遇一次摩托车事故后，他的脑部严重受损。
ext.ext_en: He suffered severe brain damage after a motorbike accident.

defs.def_en: If someone suffers brain damage, their brain is damaged by an illness or injury so that they cannot function normally.

defs.def_cn: （建筑物、地区、家园）被炸毁；被炸得无家可归

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦已经被炸得面目全非。
ext.ext_en: London had been bombed out...

ext.ext_cn: 在10月27号他们的家园被炸毁了。
ext.ext_en: On 27 October they were bombed out.

defs.def_en: See also:bombed-out;If a building or area is bombed out, it is destroyed by bombs. If people are bombed out, their houses are destroyed by bombs.

defs.def_cn: 买卖;市场交易;商业(活动)

ext.ext_cn: 我们希望在市场中扮演越来越重要的角色，从而提供更多的就业机会。
ext.ext_en: It's our hope that we will play an increasingly greater role in the marketplace and, therefore, supply more jobs.

defs.def_en: The marketplace refers to the activity of buying and selling products.

defs.def_cn: 集市;市场;(常指)露天市场

ext.ext_cn: 集市上熙熙攘攘挤满了买卖东西的人。
ext.ext_en: The marketplace was jammed with a noisy crowd of buyers and sellers.

defs.def_en: A marketplace is a small area in a town or city where goods are bought and sold, often outdoors.

ext.ext_cn: 他们不能按时偿还抵押贷款。
ext.ext_en: They were unable to meet their mortgage repayments...

ext.ext_cn: 你可以一次付清或先付最低分期偿付款。
ext.ext_en: You can pay it off or make a minimum repayment.

defs.def_en: Repayments are amounts of money which you pay at regular intervals to a person or organization in order to repay a debt.

ext.ext_cn: 他没能在上星期五的最后期限前偿还1.14亿的贷款。
ext.ext_en: He failed to meet last Friday's deadline for repayment of a 114m loan...

ext.ext_cn: 巴西即将提出一个新的债务偿付计划。
ext.ext_en: Brazil is putting forward a new debt repayment plan.

defs.def_en: The repayment of money is the act or process of paying it back to the person you owe it to.

ext.ext_cn: 她的小手轻轻触摸我的脸庞。
ext.ext_en: Her tiny hands gently touched my face...

ext.ext_cn: 不要碰那个刻度盘。
ext.ext_en: Don't touch that dial…

defs.def_en: If you touch something, you put your hand onto it in order to feel it or to make contact with it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的膝盖挨着。
ext.ext_en: Their knees were touching ...

ext.ext_cn: 一个骑车人与另一辆自行车车轮相碰后摔倒在地。
ext.ext_en: A cyclist crashed when he touched wheels with another rider...

defs.def_en: If two things are touching, or if one thing touches another, or if you touch two things, their surfaces come into contact with each other.

ext.ext_cn: 有证据表明，我们的触觉会随着年龄的增长而减损。
ext.ext_en: The evidence suggests that our sense of touch is programmed to diminish with age.

ext.ext_cn: 想通过触觉读写的失明的男孩和女孩
ext.ext_en: …boys and girls who are blind and who want to be able to read and write by touch.

defs.def_en: Your sense of touch is your ability to tell what something is like when you feel it with your hands.

ext.ext_cn: 他第一次触球就得分了。
ext.ext_en: He scored the first time he touched the ball…

ext.ext_cn: 飞机降落沿跑道滑行的时候机翼擦到了一堆碎石。
ext.ext_en: As the aeroplane went down the runway the wing touched a pile of rubble.

defs.def_en: To touch something means to strike it, usually quite gently.

defs.def_cn: (与否定词连用)处理，照看，照管

ext.ext_cn: 约翰 20 世纪 60 年代开始整修那幢房子时，它已有 40 年都无人照管了。
ext.ext_en: When John began to restore the house in the 1960s, nothing had been touched for 40 years.

defs.def_en: If something has not been touched, nobody has dealt with it or taken care of it.

defs.def_cn: (与否定词连用，尤用于受到指责时)伤害，攻击，破坏

ext.ext_cn: 皮尔斯仍旧坚定不移地说：“我没有碰过他。”
ext.ext_en: Pearce remained adamant, saying 'I didn't touch him'...

ext.ext_cn: 我那时在花园里。我根本没动三明治。
ext.ext_en: I was in the garden. I never touched the sandwiches.

defs.def_en: If you say that you did not touch someone or something, you are emphasizing that you did not attack, harm or destroy them, especially when you have been accused of doing so.

ext.ext_cn: 他喝酒不多，也不沾毒品。
ext.ext_en: He doesn't drink much and doesn't touch drugs...

ext.ext_cn: 他吃素，已经 6 年不知肉味了。
ext.ext_en: His diet is vegetarian, and he hasn't touched meat for six years…

defs.def_en: You say that you never touch something or that you have not touched something for a long time to emphasize that you never use it, or you have not used it for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影涉及了这些问题，但却流于表面。
ext.ext_en: The film touches on these issues, but only superficially...

ext.ext_cn: 她写女人心目中理想化的男人，其中简单涉及了女人所幻想的生活的话题。
ext.ext_en: She writes about women's idealisation of men, touching briefly on the topic of women's fantasy life.

defs.def_en: If you touch on a particular subject or problem, you mention it or write briefly about it.

ext.ext_cn: 在某种意义上影响到每个人的负罪感
ext.ext_en: ...a guilt that in some sense touches everyone...

ext.ext_cn: 战争年代的救济金也没有惠及所有的人。
ext.ext_en: Nor had the benefits of the war years touched all sectors of the population.

defs.def_en: If something touches you, it affects you in some way for a short time.

ext.ext_cn: 看到这些人的生活境况，我深受触动。
ext.ext_en: It has touched me deeply to see how these people live...

ext.ext_cn: 她的热情打动了我。
ext.ext_en: Her enthusiasm touched me.

defs.def_en: If something that someone says or does touches you, it affects you emotionally, often because you see that they are suffering a lot or that they are being very kind.

ext.ext_cn: 他卷曲的头发有些花白。
ext.ext_en: His crinkly hair was touched with grey...

ext.ext_cn: 那个男孩透着点天分。
ext.ext_en: The boy was touched with genius.

defs.def_en: If something is touched with a particular quality, it has a certain amount of that quality.

ext.ext_cn: 就职业素养来说，没人能比得上这些姑娘。
ext.ext_en: No one can touch these girls for professionalism.

defs.def_en: If you say about someone that nobody can touch him or her for a particular thing, you mean that he or she is much better at it than anyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 到第三圈时，金基德的车速达到了每小时 289 英里。
ext.ext_en: By the third lap Kinkead had touched 289 m.p.h.

ext.ext_cn: 风力前一天就已达到了狂风级。
ext.ext_en: The winds had touched storm-force the day before.

defs.def_en: To touch a particular level, amount, or score, especially a high one, means to reach it.

ext.ext_cn: 现在是向他借笔钱的时候了。
ext.ext_en: Now is the time to touch him for a loan.

defs.def_en: If you touch someone for money, you ask them to give it to you.

ext.ext_cn: 他们把这一活动称为“向英雄致敬”，这可是加分之举。
ext.ext_en: They called the event 'a tribute to heroes', which was a nice touch...

ext.ext_cn: 房间里放些诸如鲜花之类的小点缀可以给家里带来生气。
ext.ext_en: Small touches to a room such as flowers can be what gives a house its vitality.

defs.def_en: A touch is a detail which is added to something to improve it.

ext.ext_cn: 他做的菜全都带有其个人风格。
ext.ext_en: The dishes he produces all have a personal touch...

ext.ext_cn: 那个前锋找不到进球的感觉。
ext.ext_en: The striker was unable to find his scoring touch.

defs.def_en: If someone has a particular kind of touch, they have a particular way of doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 她认为自己仅仅有点感冒。
ext.ext_en: She thought she just had a touch of flu...

ext.ext_cn: 在大学期间他写过一点东西，小试过表演，并迷恋于校内政治活动。
ext.ext_en: At university he wrote a bit, did a touch of acting, and indulged in internal college politics.

defs.def_en: A touch of something is a very small amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我想我们都稍有点不自在。
ext.ext_en: We were all a touch uneasy, I think...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得这略有点让人反感。
ext.ext_en: I found it a touch distasteful.

defs.def_en: You can use a touch to mean slightly or to a small extent, especially in order to make something you say seem less extreme. For example, if you say that something is a touch expensive, you might really think that it is very expensive.

ext.ext_cn: 工作人员一摁按钮便可以追踪电话。
ext.ext_en: Staff will be able to trace calls at the touch of a button.

ext.ext_cn: 一按控制杆就会翻开的座位
ext.ext_en: …seats that flip out at the touch of a lever.

defs.def_en: You use at the touch of in expressions such as at the touch of a button and at the touch of a key to indicate that something is possible by simply touching a switch or one of the keys of a keyboard.

ext.ext_cn: 与很多高级法官不同，他一贯表现得平易近人。
ext.ext_en: Unlike many senior judges, he has consistently shown that he has the common touch.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has the common touch, you mean that they have the natural ability to have a good relationship with ordinary people and be popular with them.

ext.ext_cn: 我会就此事与律师联系。
ext.ext_en: I will get in touch with solicitors about this…

ext.ext_cn: 该组织明天就会和他联络。
ext.ext_en: The organisation would be in touch with him tomorrow...

defs.def_en: If you get in touch with someone, you contact them by writing to them or telephoning them. If you are, keep, or stay in touch with them, you write, phone, or visit each other regularly.

defs.def_cn: 了解最新情况(或信息)/不了解最新情况(或信息)

ext.ext_cn: 您还将随时获得乐施会在当地的最新活动信息。
ext.ext_en: You'll also be kept in touch with local Oxfam events.

ext.ext_cn: 使失业者即时了解劳动力市场的最新动态
ext.ext_en: ...keeping the unemployed in touch with the labour market...

defs.def_en: If you are in touch with a subject or situation, or if someone keeps you in touch with it, you know the latest news or information about it. If you are out of touch with it, you do not know the latest news or information about it.

ext.ext_cn: 干我这行，往往会与朋友失去联系。
ext.ext_en: In my job one tends to lose touch with friends...

ext.ext_cn: 我们自那以后就失去了联络。
ext.ext_en: We lost touch after that.

defs.def_en: If you lose touch with someone, you gradually stop writing, telephoning, or visiting them.

defs.def_cn: 不再了解最新情况(或信息)

ext.ext_cn: 他们的领导人不再了解该国正发生的一切。
ext.ext_en: Their leaders have lost touch with what is happening in the country.

defs.def_en: If you lose touch with something, you no longer have the latest news or information about it.

defs.def_cn: 不确定的事态;无法预言的事

ext.ext_cn: 我们是否会破产还很难说。
ext.ext_en: It was touch and go whether we'd go bankrupt.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is touch and go, you mean that you are uncertain whether it will happen or succeed.

defs.def_cn: 容易借钱给人的人;好说话的人

ext.ext_cn: 威尔逊先生绝不会轻易借钱给别人。
ext.ext_en: Mr Wilson is no soft touch…

ext.ext_cn: 她缺钱花的时候，帕梅拉总是有求必应。
ext.ext_en: Pamela was an easy touch when she needed some cash.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a soft touch or an easy touch, you mean that they can easily be persuaded to lend you money or to do things for you.

defs.def_cn: (工人)不属于工会的，未加入工会的;(公司或组织)不雇用工会会员的

ext.ext_cn: 公司原打算雇用不属于工会的工人重新开工。
ext.ext_en: The company originally intended to reopen the factory with non-union workers...

ext.ext_cn: 在大约1/3不雇用工会会员的工作场所明显可见仇视管理层的现象。
ext.ext_en: Management hostility is apparent in about a third of non-union workplaces.

defs.def_en: Non-union workers do not belong to a trade union or labor union. A non-union company or organization does not employ workers who belong to a trade union or labor union.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有很多小房间、地板凹凸不平、门歪歪斜斜的小房子
ext.ext_en: ...a tiny house with lots of little rooms, wonky floors and doors...

ext.ext_cn: 轮子总是左右摇晃。
ext.ext_en: The wheels keep going wonky.

defs.def_en: If something is wonky, it is not straight or level.

ext.ext_cn: 你上的是哪类学校？
ext.ext_en: What sort of school did you go to?...

ext.ext_cn: 现在可以买到许许多多不同种类的蘑菇。
ext.ext_en: There are so many different sorts of mushrooms available these days...

defs.def_en: If you talk about a particular sort of something, you are talking about a class of things that have particular features in common and that belong to a larger group of related things.

defs.def_cn: 具有某种性格的人;某种人

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎正是干这个工作的合适人选。
ext.ext_en: He seemed to be just the right sort for the job...

ext.ext_cn: 她是那种精力非常充沛的人。
ext.ext_en: She was a very vigorous sort of person...

defs.def_en: You describe someone as a particular sort when you are describing their character.

ext.ext_cn: 他把材料分门别类放进了文件夹。
ext.ext_en: He sorted the materials into their folders...

ext.ext_cn: 学生们被按照各自的能力分成了 3 个组。
ext.ext_en: The students are sorted into three ability groups...

defs.def_en: If you sort things, you separate them into different classes, groups, or places, for example so that you can do different things with them.

ext.ext_cn: 我正努力把手稿的内容理顺。
ext.ext_en: I'm trying to get my script sorted...

ext.ext_cn: 这些问题现在已经解决了。
ext.ext_en: These problems have now been sorted.

defs.def_en: If you get a problem or the details of something sorted, you do what is necessary to solve the problem or organize the details.

defs.def_cn: 各种各样的;形形色色的

ext.ext_cn: 有各种各样的动物，包括熊、猪、袋鼠和企鹅。
ext.ext_en: There are all sorts of animals, including bears, pigs, kangaroos, and penguins...

ext.ext_cn: 各种各样的人都使用它。
ext.ext_en: It was used by all sorts of people...

defs.def_en: All sorts of things or people means a large number of different things or people.

defs.def_cn: 勉强称得上…的;低劣的;一般的;起码的

ext.ext_cn: 他靠用货车卖薄饼勉强度日。
ext.ext_en: He made a living of sorts selling pancakes from a van...

ext.ext_cn: 她甚至做了个怪笑。
ext.ext_en: She even managed a grimacing smile of sorts...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a thing of sorts or as a thing of a sort, you are suggesting that the thing is of a rather poor quality or standard.

defs.def_cn: 有几分;近似;有那么点儿

ext.ext_cn: 你甚至可以根据目录订购窗户——可以说是一种邮购彩色玻璃的业务。
ext.ext_en: You could even order windows from a catalogue — a sort of mail order stained glass service...

ext.ext_cn: 最后，她几乎是用了推的。
ext.ext_en: In the end, she sort of pushed it...

defs.def_en: You use sort of when you want to say that your description of something is not very accurate.

defs.def_cn: 身体不适;心情不佳;烦恼
defs.def_en: If you are out of sorts, you feel slightly unwell, upset, or annoyed.
A paediatrician is a doctor who specializes in treating sick children.

ext.ext_cn: 池塘表面有一层黏腻腻的污泥。
ext.ext_en: There was an unappealing film of slime on top of the pond.

defs.def_en: Slime is a thick, wet substance which covers a surface or comes from the bodies of animals such as snails.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对颓靡的西方电影在上映数量上的限制
ext.ext_en: ...restrictions on the number of decadent western films that were allowed to be shown.

ext.ext_cn: 他们颓废的摇滚生活的种种放浪及层层重压
ext.ext_en: ...the excesses and stresses of their decadent rock 'n' roll lifestyles.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or society is decadent, you think that they have low moral standards and are interested mainly in pleasure.

defs.def_cn: 自作聪明的人;自以为是的人;神气活现的家伙

ext.ext_cn: 年届不惑、自以为是的电视记者
ext.ext_en: ...a fortyish smart-alec TV reporter...

ext.ext_cn: 你最终只会变得自命不凡，而且你现在已经很有些自以为是了。
ext.ext_en: You'll end up no more than a smart alec and you're well down that road already.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a smart alec, you dislike the fact that they think they are very clever and always have an answer for everything.

ext.ext_cn: 鼓是最古老的乐器之一。
ext.ext_en: The drum is one of the oldest musical instruments.

defs.def_en: A musical instrument is an object such as a piano, guitar, or violin which you play in order to produce music.
Granite is a very hard rock used in building.

ext.ext_cn: 根本无法跟他和睦相处。
ext.ext_en: It's impossible to get along with him...

ext.ext_cn: 他们好像相处得颇为融洽。
ext.ext_en: They seemed to be getting along fine.

defs.def_en: If you get along with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them. You can also say that two people get along.

ext.ext_cn: 没有水无法活下去。
ext.ext_en: You can't get along without water...

ext.ext_cn: 许多老年人仅靠社会保障金无法生活。
ext.ext_en: Many older people cannot get along on just their Social Security checks.

defs.def_en: Get along means the same as get by .

defs.def_cn: （尤指经验老到的）演员，表演者

ext.ext_cn: 他是个老演员，出场时间把握得恰到好处。
ext.ext_en: Like the old trouper he is, he timed his entry to perfection.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an actor or other performer as a trouper, especially when you want to suggest that they have a lot of experience and can deal with difficult situations in a professional way.
A newscast is a news programme that is broadcast on the radio or on television.
Your super-ego is the part of your mind which makes you aware of what is right and wrong, and which causes you to feel guilty when you have done something wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 不管你在说什么，如果孩子们听不懂，就会很快走神。
ext.ext_en: Whatever you're talking about, children rapidly tune out if you go beyond them…

ext.ext_cn: 罗斯听到了熟悉的声音，但没注意听说的是什么。
ext.ext_en: Rose heard the familiar voice, but tuned out the words.

defs.def_en: If you tune out, you stop listening or paying attention to what is being said.

ext.ext_cn: 不，我不知道房间号。
ext.ext_en: No, I don't know the room number...

ext.ext_cn: 斯坦·劳雷尔出生在阿盖尔街3号。
ext.ext_en: Stan Laurel was born at number 3, Argyll Street...

defs.def_en: A number is a word such as 'two', 'nine', or 'twelve', or a symbol such as 1, 3, or 47. You use numbers to say how many things you are referring to or where something comes in a series.

defs.def_cn: (同 large 或 small 连用，表示约数)数量，数目

ext.ext_cn: 大量的采访在继续。
ext.ext_en: Quite a considerable number of interviews are going on...

ext.ext_cn: 我已经收到了大量单亲家长的来信。
ext.ext_en: I have had an enormous number of letters from single parents...

defs.def_en: You use number with words such as 'large' or 'small' to say approximately how many things or people there are.

ext.ext_cn: 我好像记得萨姆说过不少谎话。
ext.ext_en: I seem to remember that Sam told a number of lies...

ext.ext_cn: 一定有很多人处在我这种境况。
ext.ext_en: There must be any number of people in my position.

defs.def_en: If there are a number of things or people, there are several of them. If there are any number of things or people, there is a large quantity of them.

ext.ext_cn: 世界排名第一的泰格·伍兹
ext.ext_en: ...the world number one, Tiger Woods...

ext.ext_cn: 转眼之间这张单曲唱片已在美国单曲唱片排行榜上排名第90位了。
ext.ext_en: Before you knew it, the single was at Number 90 in the US singles charts...

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's  or something's position in a list of the most successful or most popular of a particular type of thing as, for example, number one or number two.

ext.ext_cn: 他们告诉我他们村子有100人。
ext.ext_en: They told me that their village numbered 100...

ext.ext_cn: 这次死亡人数是数以百计，而非几十人。
ext.ext_en: This time the dead were numbered in hundreds, not dozens.

defs.def_en: If a group of people or things numbers a particular total, that is how many there are.

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉坐下来拨了一个电话号码。
ext.ext_en: Sarah sat down and dialled a number.

ext.ext_cn: 姓名和电话号码表
ext.ext_en: ...a list of names and telephone numbers...

defs.def_en: A number is the series of numbers that you dial when you are making a telephone call.

defs.def_cn: 一段音乐;一首歌曲;一支舞

ext.ext_cn: 《难以忘怀》，一首1951年创作并演唱的歌曲
ext.ext_en: ...'Unforgettable', a number that was written and performed in 1951...

ext.ext_cn: 舞蹈节目分别由罗伯特·奥尔顿和年轻的乔治·巴兰钦负责。
ext.ext_en: Responsibility for the dance numbers was split between Robert Alton and the young George Balanchine.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a short piece of music, a song, or a dance as a number .

ext.ext_cn: 莱斯特—斯旺宁顿铁路被看作是英国最早的铁路之一。
ext.ext_en: The Leicester Swannington Railway is numbered among Britain's railway pioneers...

ext.ext_cn: 他把几个美国人看成朋友。
ext.ext_en: He numbered several Americans among his friends.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is numbered among a particular group, they are believed to belong in that group.

ext.ext_cn: 他把纸剪成了小方块，然后逐一编号。
ext.ext_en: He cut his paper up into tiny squares, and he numbered each one...

ext.ext_cn: 每个要素都编了号。
ext.ext_en: Each factor has been numbered.

defs.def_en: If you number something, you mark it with a number, usually starting at 1.

ext.ext_cn: 批评家猜想他走红的时间不会长了，因为观众现在厌倦了他的表演。
ext.ext_en: Critics believe his days are numbered because audiences are tired of watching him.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's or something's days are numbered, you mean that they will not survive or be successful for much longer.

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们欢迎他们中的一员接近权力中心的想法。
ext.ext_en: Scientists like the idea that one of their number is close to the seat of power...

ext.ext_cn: 我们中的一名成员设计出了非常有趣的地板图案，还获了奖。
ext.ext_en: One of our number has made a very interesting design of flooring, which has won a prize.

defs.def_en: One of your number is a member of your group.
See also:numbers game;If you refer to the numbers game ,the numbers racket, or the numbers, you are referring to an illegal lottery or illegal betting.

ext.ext_cn: 重物通过缆绳和滑轮系统运送。
ext.ext_en: The weights are moved via a cable and pulley system.

defs.def_en: A pulley is a device consisting of a wheel over which a rope or chain is pulled in order to lift heavy objects.

defs.def_cn: (同住一地的人所构成的)社区

ext.ext_cn: 社区的人都非常喜欢他。
ext.ext_en: He's well liked by people in the community...

ext.ext_cn: “社区居民开始不耐烦了，”居民协会的一位代表说。
ext.ext_en: 'The community are getting impatient,' said a representative of the Residents' Association...

defs.def_en: The community is all the people who live in a particular area or place.

ext.ext_cn: 警方并未真正特意为黑人群体做什么。
ext.ext_en: The police haven't really done anything for the black community in particular.

ext.ext_cn: 商界
ext.ext_en: ...the business community.

defs.def_en: A particular community is a group of people who are similar in some way.

defs.def_cn: (不同人士、团体之间的)友谊，伙伴关系

ext.ext_cn: 一幢扶助性住宅可供8至10位老人居住，每个人都有自己单独的房间，在这里，他们既能独处，又有社区归属感。
ext.ext_en: A supportive house for eight to ten older people, each with his or her own room, provides privacy and a sense of community...

ext.ext_cn: 我们最大的两个优势是多样性和团体精神。
ext.ext_en: Two of our greatest strengths are diversity and community.

defs.def_en: Community is friendship between different people or groups, and a sense of having something in common.
An artisan is someone whose job requires skill with their hands.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 用于使食物看起来更加可口的调味料和防腐剂
ext.ext_en: ...flavourings and preservatives, designed to make the food look more palatable.

defs.def_en: If you describe food or drink as palatable, you mean that it tastes pleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （想法、方法等）合意的，可接受的

ext.ext_cn: 可以接受的裁员方式
ext.ext_en: ...a palatable way of sacking staff...

ext.ext_cn: 那个选择不太可以接受。
ext.ext_en: That option is not very palatable.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as an idea or method as palatable, you mean that people are willing to accept it.

ext.ext_cn: 趁没人看见，她把校帽弄扁塞进了废纸篓。
ext.ext_en: While nobody was looking, she squashed her school hat and crammed it into a wastebasket...

ext.ext_cn: 我把泳衣和T恤衫塞进包里，乘卧铺前往贝济耶。
ext.ext_en: I crammed my bag full of swimsuits and T-shirts and caught the sleeper down to Beziers...

defs.def_en: If you cram things or people into a container or place, you put them into it, although there is hardly enough room for them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们挤进我的车子，然后出发了。
ext.ext_en: We crammed into my car and set off...

ext.ext_cn: 朋友和仰慕者们挤进安葬梦露的洛杉矶小公墓的教堂里。
ext.ext_en: Friends and admirers crammed the chapel at the small Los Angeles cemetery where Monroe is buried.

defs.def_en: If people cram into a place or vehicle or cram a place or vehicle, so many of them enter it at one time that it is completely full.

ext.ext_cn: 我重新戴上帽子，扶公爵起身并掸去他身上的土。
ext.ext_en: I crammed on my cap again, helped the Duke up and tried to dust him off.

defs.def_en: If you cram a hat on, you put it on, especially in a hurry.

defs.def_cn: (为应考)临时死记硬背，填鸭式学习

ext.ext_cn: 她正在为应付经济学考试临阵磨枪。
ext.ext_en: She was cramming for her Economics exam...

defs.def_en: If you are cramming for an examination, you are learning as much as possible in a short time just before you take the examination.

ext.ext_cn: 我反对宣扬婚前性行为不道德的说教。
ext.ext_en: I rejected the teaching that premarital sex was immoral.

defs.def_en: Premarital means happening at some time before someone gets married.
A guitarist is someone who plays the guitar.

ext.ext_cn: 债务款项的延期偿还
ext.ext_en: ...the deferment of debt repayments.

defs.def_en: Deferment means arranging for something to happen at a later date.
Rock climbing is the activity of climbing cliffs or large rocks, as a hobby or sport.

ext.ext_cn: 我落败的时候，他向我表示同情。
ext.ext_en: When I lost, he commiserated with me.

defs.def_en: If you commiserate with someone, you show them pity or sympathy when something unpleasant has happened to them.

ext.ext_cn: 一只大野猫在捕杀了58只羊羔后遭到猎捕。
ext.ext_en: A giant wildcat is being hunted after 58 lambs were butchered.

defs.def_en: A wildcat is a cat which is very fierce and lives especially in mountains and forests.

defs.def_cn: (罢工)未经工会同意的，自发进行的

ext.ext_cn: 挫败感、愤怒和绝望引起了一系列自发性的罢工。
ext.ext_en: Frustration, anger and desperation have led to a series of wildcat strikes.

ext.ext_cn: 公共交通部门的自发性罢工
ext.ext_en: ...wildcat stoppages on public transport.

defs.def_en: A wildcat strike happens suddenly, as a result of a decision by a group of workers, and is not officially approved by a trade union.

defs.def_cn: (计划、项目或生意等)冒险的，计划不周详的

ext.ext_cn: 这是我们的一些成员制订的一个冒险计划。
ext.ext_en: It was a wildcat plan by some of our members.

defs.def_en: A wildcat scheme, project, or business is risky and likely to fail, usually because there has not been enough planning.

ext.ext_cn: 钱也会用于越南的地方发展项目当中。
ext.ext_en: Money will also go into local development projects in Vietnam...

ext.ext_cn: 国际科学项目
ext.ext_en: ...an international science project...

defs.def_en: A project is a task that requires a lot of time and effort.

ext.ext_cn: 学生完成了做私人家教的课题，在家里按自己的步调工作。
ext.ext_en: Students complete projects for a personal tutor, working at home at their own pace.

defs.def_en: A project is a detailed study of a subject by a pupil or student.

ext.ext_cn: 预计到2025年，非洲的人口会是1993年年中人口的两倍多。
ext.ext_en: Africa's mid-1993 population is projected to more than double by 2025...

ext.ext_cn: 政府预测全年消费价格将增长5%。
ext.ext_en: The government had been projecting a 5% consumer price increase for the entire year.

defs.def_en: If something is projected, it is planned or expected.

ext.ext_cn: 布拉德利表现出一种自然的热情和真诚。
ext.ext_en: Bradley projects a natural warmth and sincerity...

ext.ext_cn: 他根本没能表现出一个强有力的领导者的样子。
ext.ext_en: He just hasn't been able to project himself as the strong leader...

defs.def_en: If you project someone or something in a particular way, you try to make people see them in that way. If you project a particular feeling or quality, you show it in your behaviour.

defs.def_cn: 把（情感、想法）投射转移（到他人身上）

ext.ext_cn: 他以为她有着和自己相同的想法和观点。
ext.ext_en: He projects his own thoughts and ideas onto her.

defs.def_en: If you project feelings or ideas on to other people, you imagine that they have the same ideas or feelings as you.

ext.ext_cn: 这个小组想用两台不同的投影仪把这些地图投射到同一个屏幕上。
ext.ext_en: The team tried projecting the maps with two different projectors onto the same screen.

defs.def_en: If you project a film or picture onto a screen or wall, you make it appear there.

ext.ext_cn: 海滨凸立着的战时防御工事的遗迹
ext.ext_en: ...the remains of a war-time defence which projected out from the shore.

ext.ext_cn: 一块凸立着的金属
ext.ext_en: ...a piece of projecting metal.

defs.def_en: If something projects, it sticks out above or beyond a surface or edge.

ext.ext_cn: 这里种植水稻的农场主仍是人工种植和收割庄稼。
ext.ext_en: Rice farmers here still plant and harvest their crops by hand...

ext.ext_cn: 主要作物是小麦，就连很陡的坡地都种上了小麦。
ext.ext_en: The main crop is wheat and this is grown even on the very steep slopes.

defs.def_en: See also:cash crop;Crops are plants such as wheat and potatoes that are grown in large quantities for food.

ext.ext_cn: 这里每年水果都大丰收。
ext.ext_en: Each year it produces a fine crop of fruit...

ext.ext_cn: 美国政府称今年的玉米产量应该会比去年提高8%左右。
ext.ext_en: The US government says that this year's corn crop should be about 8 percent more than last year...

defs.def_en: The plants or fruits that are collected at harvest time are referred to as a crop .

defs.def_cn: (在一起的)一群（人）;(同时发生的)一些（事情）

ext.ext_cn: 时下出现的这些有关玛丽莲·梦露的书和纪录片是借她逝世30周年之际推出的。
ext.ext_en: The present crop of books and documentaries about Marilyn Monroe exploit the thirtieth anniversary of her death...

ext.ext_cn: 明年选修物理的大学生仅占大学生总数的2%。
ext.ext_en: Next year's crop of undergraduates opting to take physics represents just 2 per cent of all undergraduates.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a group of people or things that have appeared together as a crop of people or things.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然这些蔬菜作物很适应我们这里温和的气候，它们的收成却很差。
ext.ext_en: Although these vegetables adapt well to our temperate climate, they tend to crop poorly.

defs.def_en: When a plant crops, it produces fruits or parts which people want.

ext.ext_cn: 我7月份开始收割豆类作物。
ext.ext_en: I started cropping my beans in July.

defs.def_en: When you crop something that you have planted, you collect the fruits or parts that you want from it.

ext.ext_cn: 我让马低下头啃吃春天的青草。
ext.ext_en: I let the horse drop his head to crop the spring grass.

defs.def_en: When an animal such as a cow or horse crops leaves or plants, it eats them.

ext.ext_cn: 她把头发剪短并染成了金黄色。
ext.ext_en: She cropped her hair and dyed it blonde.

defs.def_en: To crop someone's hair means to cut it short.

ext.ext_cn: 她把长发剪成了男孩子般的短发。
ext.ext_en: She had her long hair cut into a boyish crop.

defs.def_en: A crop is a short hairstyle.

ext.ext_cn: 我决定把这张照片水印以下的部分裁掉。
ext.ext_en: I decided to crop the picture just above the water line...

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫被从照片上剪下去了。
ext.ext_en: Her husband was cropped from the photograph.

defs.def_en: If you crop a photograph, you cut part of it off, in order to get rid of part of the picture or to be able to frame it.

ext.ext_cn: 我因为没给他打电话，被狠狠训斥了一顿。
ext.ext_en: I got a severe telling off for not phoning him.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a telling-off, you tell them that you are very angry with them about something they have done.

defs.def_cn: 红浆果;红醋栗;红浆果树

ext.ext_cn: 烤羊羔肉和红浆果果冻
ext.ext_en: ...roast lamb and redcurrant jelly.

defs.def_en: Redcurrants are very small, bright red berries that grow in bunches on a bush and can be eaten as a fruit or cooked to make a sauce for meat. The bush on which they grow can also be called a redcurrant .

ext.ext_cn: 西方的民主国家可能会发现很难自圆其说。
ext.ext_en: The democracies of the West may find it hard to shore up their defences.

defs.def_en: If you shore up something that is weak or about to fail, you do something in order to strengthen it or support it.
Starting blocks are blocks which runners put their feet against to help them move quickly forward at the start of a race.

ext.ext_cn: 她在这里住了10年了。
ext.ext_en: She has lived here for 10 years...

ext.ext_cn: 她总说我应该一个人住。
ext.ext_en: She always said I ought to live alone...

defs.def_en: If someone lives in a particular place or with a particular person, their home is in that place or with that person.

ext.ext_cn: 我们生活得非常快乐。
ext.ext_en: We lived quite grandly...

ext.ext_cn: 比起上几辈人，我们有更多机会享受生活。
ext.ext_en: Compared to people living only a few generations ago, we have greater opportunities to have a good time...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone lives in particular circumstances or that they live a particular kind of life, you mean that they are in those circumstances or that they have that kind of life.

ext.ext_cn: 他为工作而活。
ext.ext_en: He lived for his work.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone lives for a particular thing, you mean that it is the most important thing in their life.

ext.ext_cn: 他已身患重疾，时日无多。
ext.ext_en: He's got a terrible disease and will not live long...

ext.ext_cn: 多年生植物是指能存活很多年的植物。
ext.ext_en: A perennial is a plant that lives indefinitely...

defs.def_en: To live means to be alive. If someone lives to a particular age, they stay alive until they are that age.

ext.ext_cn: 最后一个狩猎为生的土著民族
ext.ext_en: ...the last indigenous people to live by hunting...

ext.ext_cn: 这些罪案大都是由以犯罪为生的职业罪犯制造的。
ext.ext_en: These crimes were committed largely by professional criminals who lived by crime.

defs.def_en: If people live by doing a particular activity, they get the money, food, or clothing they need by doing that activity.

ext.ext_cn: 他们恪守着这样的原则：我们来到世上是要为生活做贡献，而不是从中索取。
ext.ext_en: They live by the principle that we are here to add what we can to life, not to get what we want from it.

defs.def_en: If you live by a particular rule, belief, or ideal, you behave in the way in which it says you should behave.

ext.ext_cn: 那个记忆将会伴随我多年。
ext.ext_en: The memory of that will live with me for many years to come...

ext.ext_cn: 他将会作为史上最伟大的板球投手之一而留名青史。
ext.ext_en: His name will live in history as one of the greatest bowlers of all time...

defs.def_en: If a person or occasion lives in someone's mind or in history, they are remembered for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 他从7岁开始就一直热衷于马球。
ext.ext_en: He has lived and breathed polo since he was seven.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone lives and breathes a particular subject or activity, you are emphasizing that they are extremely enthusiastic about it.

ext.ext_cn: 要是从来没看过歌剧，那就枉过此生了。
ext.ext_en: If you have never been to an opera, you haven't  lived...

ext.ext_cn: 要是没用过他们新的微系统，这辈子就算白活了。
ext.ext_en: You haven't lived until you've used their new micro system.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone that they haven't lived unless they experience a particular thing, you are telling them that thing is extremely good and should be experienced.

ext.ext_cn: 十分之一的加利福尼亚人没有工作，还有数以千计的人成天提心吊胆地害怕失去工作。
ext.ext_en: One in 10 Californians is unemployed and thousands more live in fear of losing their jobs.

defs.def_en: You can use expressions such as to live in fear and to live in terror to indicate that someone is always thinking about an unpleasant or frightening event, because they think that it might happen.

defs.def_cn: 自己活也让别人活；互相宽容；互不干扰
defs.def_en: You say live and let live as a way of saying that you should let other people behave in the way that they want to and not criticize them for behaving differently from you.

ext.ext_cn: 偶尔放纵一下也无妨。
ext.ext_en: There is no reason why you couldn't live it up once in a while.

defs.def_en: If you live it up, you have a very enjoyable and exciting time, for example by going to lots of parties or going out drinking with friends.

ext.ext_cn: 反对该公司利用活体动物做试验的抗议
ext.ext_en: ...a protest against the company's tests on live animals.

ext.ext_cn: 一篮篮的活鸡
ext.ext_en: ...baskets of live chickens.

defs.def_en: Live animals or plants are alive, rather than being dead or artificial.

defs.def_cn: 现场直播的；实况转播的

ext.ext_cn: 默里在一个直播的电台节目里当嘉宾。
ext.ext_en: Murray was a guest on a live radio show.

ext.ext_cn: 我们肆意大笑，闲聊八卦，忘记了自己是在做电视直播。
ext.ext_en: ...we were laughing and gossiping, oblivious to the fact that we were on live TV...

defs.def_en: A live television or radio programme is one in which an event or performance is broadcast at exactly the same time as it happens, rather than being recorded first.

ext.ext_cn: 1981年末之后，彩虹剧院就再没主办过现场音乐会。
ext.ext_en: The Rainbow has not hosted live music since the end of 1981...

ext.ext_cn: 问题将由现场的观众提出。
ext.ext_en: A live audience will pose the questions...

defs.def_en: A live performance is given in front of an audience, rather than being recorded and then broadcast or shown in a film.

ext.ext_cn: 这是我最喜爱的现场专辑。
ext.ext_en: This is my favourite live album of all time...

ext.ext_cn: 这张大碟收录了“远大前程”全天秀的现场录音。
ext.ext_en: The LP features live recordings from the 'Great Xpectations' all-day show.

defs.def_en: A live recording is a recording of a band playing at a concert, rather than in a studio.

ext.ext_cn: 插头坏了，带电的电线露在外面。
ext.ext_en: The plug broke, exposing live wires...

ext.ext_cn: 他们爬向安全地带的过程中，他提醒其他人当心带电的电缆。
ext.ext_en: He warned others about the live electric cables as they climbed to safety.

defs.def_en: A live wire or piece of electrical equipment is directly connected to a source of electricity.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在丛林中接受真枪实弹的训练。
ext.ext_en: They trained in the jungle using live ammunition.

defs.def_en: Live bullets are made of metal, rather than rubber or plastic, and are intended to kill people rather than injure them.

ext.ext_cn: 一枚未爆炸的炸弹稍早被拆除了雷管。
ext.ext_en: A live bomb had earlier been defused.

defs.def_en: A live bomb or missile is one which has not yet exploded.

ext.ext_cn: 新系统在今年早些时候开始了运行。
ext.ext_en: The new system went live earlier this year...

ext.ext_cn: 这项服务将在今年夏天投入使用。
ext.ext_en: The service should go live this summer.

defs.def_en: If a system, campaign, or other course of action goes live, it starts to be used.

ext.ext_cn: 他从来没遇到过一位真正的海军上将。
ext.ext_en: He had never met a real live admiral...

ext.ext_cn: 她有世上最佳的宠物——一只活生生的老虎。
ext.ext_en: She has the best pet of all — a real live tiger.

defs.def_en: You use real live to say that someone or something is present or exists, when you want to indicate that you think this is exciting and unusual or unexpected.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都喜欢坐上游艺节惊险刺激的乘骑设施体验恐惧的乐趣。
ext.ext_en: We all love to frighten ourselves by going on hair-raising rides at funfairs.

defs.def_en: A funfair is an event held in a park or field at which people pay to ride on various machines for amusement or try to win prizes in games. The people who organize and operate it usually take it from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 我妹妹总让我捉摸不透，弄得我焦虑不安。
ext.ext_en: My sister puzzles me and causes me anxiety.

defs.def_en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

defs.def_cn: 对…苦苦思索；因…大伤脑筋

ext.ext_cn: 在排演莎士比亚的戏剧时，其中诗句和散文的复杂让我大伤脑筋。
ext.ext_en: In rehearsing Shakespeare, I puzzle over the complexities of his verse and prose.

defs.def_en: If you puzzle over something, you try hard to think of the answer to it or the explanation for it.

defs.def_cn: 难题；智力问题（或游戏、玩具）；谜

ext.ext_cn: 字谜
ext.ext_en: ...a word puzzle.

defs.def_en: See also:crossword;A puzzle is a question, game, or toy which you have to think about carefully in order to answer it correctly or put it together properly.

defs.def_cn: 令人费解的人；令人困惑的事物

ext.ext_cn: “旅行者二号”发回的数据给天文学家们提出了一个难题：离我们最远的那颗行星为什么会存在。
ext.ext_en: Data from Voyager II has presented astronomers with a puzzle about why our outermost planet exists...

ext.ext_cn: 她是个谜。
ext.ext_en: She was a puzzle.

defs.def_en: You can describe a person or thing that is hard to understand as a puzzle .
A gumdrop is a chewy sweet which feels like firm rubber and usually tastes of fruit.

ext.ext_cn: 破口大骂是不对的。
ext.ext_en: It's wrong to swear and shout...

ext.ext_cn: 他们骂了他们后就跑掉了。
ext.ext_en: They swore at them and ran off.

defs.def_en: If someone swears, they use language that is considered to be rude or offensive, usually because they are angry.

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦许诺要尽其所能帮助我们。
ext.ext_en: Alan swore that he would do everything in his power to help us...

ext.ext_cn: 我们发誓要见恶除恶。
ext.ext_en: We have sworn to fight cruelty wherever we find it...

defs.def_en: If you swear to do something, you promise in a serious way that you will do it.

defs.def_cn: 发誓，郑重声明，保证(所说属实)

ext.ext_cn: 我发誓我已经把我所知道的全都告诉你了。
ext.ext_en: I swear I've told you all I know...

ext.ext_cn: 我以身家性命担保，我和这件事无关。
ext.ext_en: I swear on all I hold dear that I had nothing to do with this...

defs.def_en: If you say that you swear that something is true or that you can swear to it, you are saying very firmly that it is true.

defs.def_cn: 使发誓，使承诺(保守秘密)

ext.ext_cn: 她急不可待想宣布这个消息，但却发过誓要守口如瓶。
ext.ext_en: She was bursting to announce the news but was sworn to secrecy.

defs.def_en: If someone is sworn to secrecy or is sworn to silence, they promise another person that they will not reveal a secret.

defs.def_cn: 不按逻辑规律的;非线性的

ext.ext_cn: 非线性叙事结构
ext.ext_en: ...a non-linear narrative structure.

ext.ext_cn: 有助于发现货币市场非线性变化趋势的计算机程序
ext.ext_en: ...a computer program that could help detect non-linear trends in currency markets.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as non-linear, you mean that it does not progress or develop smoothly from one stage to the next in a logical way. Instead, it makes sudden changes, or seems to develop in different directions at the same time.

defs.def_cn: (尤指头发)麦秆色的，淡黄色的
defs.def_en: If you describe something, especially hair, as straw-coloured, you mean that it is pale yellow.

defs.def_cn: 不可知论者（Compare 比较 atheist.)

ext.ext_cn: 瓦萨里惊恐地说他若非无神论者，就是不可知论者。
ext.ext_en: Vasari claimed with horror that he was, if not an atheist, then an agnostic.

defs.def_en: An agnostic believes that it is not possible to know whether God exists or not.

ext.ext_cn: 你在一个信奉不可知论的家庭里长大，一直都无法信仰上帝。
ext.ext_en: You grew up in an agnostic household and have never been able to bring yourself to believe in God.

defs.def_en: Agnostic means relating to agnostics or to their beliefs.

ext.ext_cn: 我就是在那儿第一次看到电影的。
ext.ext_en: It was there that I saw my first motion picture.

ext.ext_cn: 电影产业
ext.ext_en: ...the motion picture industry.

defs.def_en: A motion picture is a film made for cinema.

ext.ext_cn: 他不大讲究衣着。
ext.ext_en: He was not a man who thought overmuch about clothes.

defs.def_en: If something happens overmuch, it happens too much or very much.

ext.ext_cn: 西方商人在向该地区投资时表现出非同一般的深谋远虑。
ext.ext_en: Western businessmen are showing remarkable prudence in investing in the region...

ext.ext_cn: 不够谨慎可能会导致财政上出现问题。
ext.ext_en: A lack of prudence may lead to financial problems.

defs.def_en: Prudence is care and good sense that someone shows when making a decision or taking action.

ext.ext_cn: T恤的单位产品销售量增加了6%。
ext.ext_en: Unit sales of T-shirts increased 6%.

defs.def_en: Unit sales refers to the number of individual items that a company sells.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的世系可以直接追溯到18世纪。
ext.ext_en: They can trace their lineage directly back to the 18th century.

ext.ext_cn: 受人尊敬的古老世家
ext.ext_en: ...a respectable family of ancient lineage.

defs.def_en: Someone's lineage is the series of families from which they are directly descended.
Philology is the study of words, especially the history and development of the words in a particular language or group of languages.

defs.def_cn: 歼灭；消灭；毁灭；彻底击溃

ext.ext_cn: 毁灭地球有很多方法。
ext.ext_en: There are lots of ways of annihilating the planet...

ext.ext_cn: 陆军被彻底击溃了。
ext.ext_en: The Army was annihilated.

defs.def_en: To annihilate something means to destroy it completely.

defs.def_cn: （在竞赛或争论中）彻底击败，大胜

ext.ext_cn: 荷兰队以5比0完胜奥运冠军队。
ext.ext_en: The Dutch annihilated the Olympic champions 5-0.

defs.def_en: If you annihilate someone in a contest or argument, you totally defeat them.

ext.ext_cn: 早期拉比教义学者
ext.ext_en: ...early rabbinic scholars.

defs.def_en: or rabbinic /ræ'bɪnɪk/ Rabbinical or rabbinic refers to the teachings of Jewish religious teachers and leaders.

ext.ext_cn: 这是临时委员会召开的年中例会。
ext.ext_en: This is the half-yearly meeting of the interim committee.

ext.ext_cn: 中央银行关于经济状况的年中报告
ext.ext_en: ...the Central Bank's half-yearly report on the state of the economy.

defs.def_en: Half-yearly means happening in the middle of a calendar year or a financial year.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司公布其半年利润仅为200万英镑。
ext.ext_en: The company announced a half-yearly profit of just £2 million.

defs.def_en: A company's half-yearly profits are the profits that it makes in six months.

ext.ext_cn: 每半年支付的款项
ext.ext_en: ...half-yearly payments.

defs.def_en: Half-yearly means happening twice a year, with six months between each event.
A shoehorn is a piece of metal or plastic with a slight curve that you put in the back of your shoe so that your heel will go into the shoe easily.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的车硬被塞进了狭小的空间。
ext.ext_en: Their cars are shoehorned into tiny spaces...

ext.ext_cn: 我正拼命把自己塞进我的紧身晚礼服里。
ext.ext_en: I was shoehorning myself into my skin-tight ball gown.

defs.def_en: If you shoehorn something into a tight place, you manage to get it in there even though it is difficult.

ext.ext_cn: 我会毫不犹豫地选择后者。
ext.ext_en: I would unhesitatingly choose the latter option...

ext.ext_cn: 那么有什么她不愿触及的禁忌吗？她毫不犹豫地回答：“政治。”
ext.ext_en: So is there any taboo she wouldn't touch? Unhesitatingly she replies, 'Politics.'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something unhesitatingly, you mean that they do it immediately and confidently, without any doubt or anxiety.

defs.def_cn: 不幸的是；遗憾的是；令人失望的是

ext.ext_cn: 可惜的是，我的时间有限。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately, my time is limited...

ext.ext_cn: 可惜对于王子来说，封号赋予他特权的同时也给他带来了义务。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately for the Prince, his title brought obligations as well as privileges...

defs.def_en: You can use unfortunately to introduce or refer to a statement when you consider that it is sad or disappointing, or when you want to express regret.
In chess, a Grandmaster is a player who has achieved a very high standard in tournaments.

ext.ext_cn: 这个被用来掩盖他们思想的混乱和不准确。
ext.ext_en: This served to hide the confusion and imprecision in their thinking.

defs.def_en: Imprecision is the quality of being imprecise.

defs.def_cn: 缓慢地（用作音乐中的指示）
defs.def_en: Adagio written above a piece of music means that it should be played slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 塞缪尔·巴伯的《弦乐慢板》
ext.ext_en: ...Samuel Barber's Adagio For Strings.

ext.ext_cn: 他的《第六交响乐》的慢板乐章
ext.ext_en: ...the Adagio movement of his Sixth Symphony.

defs.def_en: An adagio is a piece of music that is played slowly.

defs.def_cn: 呈递，提交，邮寄(参赛作品、求职信等)

ext.ext_cn: 申请人需要提交一份简历和附函。
ext.ext_en: Applicants are asked to send in a CV and a covering letter...

ext.ext_cn: 我们希望读者能来信说说他们省钱的点子。
ext.ext_en: We're hoping that readers will send in their ideas for saving money.

defs.def_en: If you send in something such as a competition entry or a letter applying for a job, you post it to the organization concerned.

defs.def_cn: 派遣,调来(警察、军队等以应付危机或困难)

ext.ext_cn: 他已经要求政府派军队来平息这场战斗。
ext.ext_en: He has asked the government to send in troops to end the fighting.

defs.def_en: When a government sends in troops or police officers, it orders them to deal with a crisis or problem somewhere.

defs.def_cn: 习惯(新居);适应(新工作、新学校等)

ext.ext_cn: 适应了爱德华国王学校的生活后，我就深深地爱上了这里。
ext.ext_en: I enjoyed King Edward's School enormously once I'd settled in.

defs.def_en: If you settle in, you become used to living in a new place, doing a new job, or going to a new school.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对那些人很有看法，看不起他们粗俗的举止。
ext.ext_en: He was critical of the people, disparaging of their crude manners...

ext.ext_cn: 据说这位部长发表了一些贬低其他内阁成员的言论。
ext.ext_en: The Minister was alleged to have made disparaging remarks about the rest of the Cabinet.

defs.def_en: If you are disparaging about someone or something, or make disparaging comments about them, you say things which show that you do not have a good opinion of them.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经开始动手拆分这家几乎是哈默白手起家创办的公司。
ext.ext_en: He has set about carving up the company which Hammer created from almost nothing...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经开始像切馅饼一样瓜分这个国家。
ext.ext_en: They have begun carving the country up like a pie.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone carves something up, you disapprove of the way they have divided it into small parts.

ext.ext_cn: 他想上街去把别人的脸刮花。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to go into the street and carve someone's face up.

defs.def_en: To carve someone up means to hurt them badly using a knife.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以通过电子邮件和我们联系。
ext.ext_en: You can contact us by e-mail...

ext.ext_cn: 你想发电子邮件吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you want to send an E-mail?...

defs.def_en: E-mail is a system of sending written messages electronically from one computer to another. E-mail is an abbreviation of (缩略=) 'electronic mail'.

ext.ext_cn: 杰米给我发了电子邮件，说他不能来了。
ext.ext_en: Jamie e-mailed me to say he couldn't come...

ext.ext_cn: 将您的看法以电子邮件形式发送至 sport@times.co.uk。
ext.ext_en: Email your views to sport@times.co.uk

defs.def_en: If you e-mail someone, you send them an e-mail.

ext.ext_cn: 这张唱片是摇滚歌星鲍勃·格尔多夫的心血之作。
ext.ext_en: The record was the brainchild of rock star Bob Geldof.

defs.def_en: Someone's brainchild is an idea or invention that they have thought up or created.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们认为古代希腊罗马是知识的重要发源地。
ext.ext_en: They believed ancient Greece and Rome were vital sources of learning.

defs.def_en: Ancient means belonging to the distant past, especially to the period in history before the end of the Roman Empire.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 古老的犹太传统
ext.ext_en: ...ancient Jewish tradition.

ext.ext_cn: 由来已久的捕鱼权
ext.ext_en: ...ancient fishing rights.

defs.def_en: Ancient means very old, or having existed for a long time.

defs.def_cn: 古代人；（尤指）古希腊人，古罗马人

ext.ext_cn: 古代人对于上天比我们知道得多。
ext.ext_en: The ancients knew more than we do about the heavens.

defs.def_en: The ancients are the people of an old civilization, especially classical Greece or Rome.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 滑雪者在选择购买保险的问题上应该尤其慎重。
ext.ext_en: Skiers should be particularly choosy about the insurance policy they buy.

defs.def_en: Someone who is choosy is difficult to please because they will only accept something if it is exactly what they want or if it is of very high quality.

ext.ext_cn: 他用榔头和凿子铲墙。
ext.ext_en: He used a hammer and chisel to chip away at the wall.

defs.def_en: A hammer is a tool that consists of a heavy piece of metal at the end of a handle. It is used, for example, to hit nails into a piece of wood or a wall, or to break things into pieces.

ext.ext_cn: 为了不毁坏树，用锤子将一个木栓钉进洞里。
ext.ext_en: To avoid damaging the tree, hammer a wooden peg into the hole...

ext.ext_cn: 建筑工人仍在窗外敲敲打打。
ext.ext_en: Builders were still hammering outside the window.

defs.def_en: If you hammer an object such as a nail, you hit it with a hammer.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不停地拍门、叫喊，他们才开了门。
ext.ext_en: We had to hammer and shout before they would open up...

ext.ext_cn: 一群记者正在砰砰地拍打着大门。
ext.ext_en: A crowd of reporters was hammering on the door...

defs.def_en: If you hammer on a surface, you hit it several times in order to make a noise, or to emphasize something you are saying when you are angry.

ext.ext_cn: 他反复告诉我，我并没有一下子变成个差劲的守门员。
ext.ext_en: He hammered it into me that I had not suddenly become a rotten goalkeeper...

ext.ext_cn: 该行业最近的广告宣传活动一直在反复强调这些主题。
ext.ext_en: Recent advertising campaigns from the industry have hammered at these themes.

defs.def_en: If you hammer something such as an idea into people or you hammer at it, you keep repeating it forcefully so that it will have an effect on people.

defs.def_cn: 猛烈攻击;大力批评;严厉惩罚

ext.ext_cn: 该报告严词谴责了那个私家车司机。
ext.ext_en: The report hammers the private motorist...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们迟到，就会遭到大家的声讨。
ext.ext_en: If we turned up late we would be hammered by everybody.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone hammers another person, you mean that they attack, criticize, or punish the other person severely.

defs.def_cn: （因税收政策变化、经济不景气等）使（企业）受到打击

ext.ext_cn: 看看有多少小企业正在遭受无情的打击。
ext.ext_en: Look at the numbers of small businesses that are being hammered unmercifully...

ext.ext_cn: 公司因建筑和汽车行业的衰退而受到了冲击。
ext.ext_en: The company has been hammered by the downturn in the construction and motor industries.

defs.def_en: If you say that businesses are being hammered, you mean that they are being unfairly harmed, for example by a change in taxes or by bad economic conditions.

ext.ext_cn: 他直落4局轻取年轻的奥地利对手。
ext.ext_en: He hammered the young Austrian player in four straight sets.

defs.def_en: In sports, if you say that one player or team hammered another, you mean that the first player or team defeated the second completely and easily.

defs.def_cn: （通常指因恐惧而心脏）快速跳动

ext.ext_cn: 我的心怦怦直跳。脚步声已停在我的门外。
ext.ext_en: My heart was hammering. The footsteps had stopped outside my door.

defs.def_en: If someone's heart is hammering, it is beating very fast, usually because they are frightened.

defs.def_cn: （机械设备中的）锤状物;（枪上的）击铁;(钢琴的）音槌
defs.def_en: In machines and instruments, a hammer is a part that hits another part. For example, in a gun the hammer causes the explosion which makes the bullet shoot out of it, and in a piano the hammers hit the strings and cause the sounds.

ext.ext_cn: 掷链球和铁饼等在西方算不上传统的受欢迎项目。
ext.ext_en: Events like the hammer and the discus are not traditional crowd-pullers in the West.

ext.ext_cn: 掷链球和铁饼等在西方算不上传统的受欢迎项目。
ext.ext_en: Events like the hammer and the discus are not traditional crowd-pullers in the West.

defs.def_en: In athletics, a hammer is a heavy weight on a piece of wire, which the athlete throws as far as possible.

defs.def_cn: 满腔热情地;劲头十足地

ext.ext_cn: 他酷爱侍弄花草。只要下班一回到家，他就兴冲冲地忙活起来。
ext.ext_en: He loved gardening. He went at it hammer and tongs as soon as he got back from work...

ext.ext_cn: 他们又叫又喊又吵，每晚都要乐此不疲地闹腾6个小时。
ext.ext_en: They yell, shout and argue. For six hours a night they go at it, hammer and tongs.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone was going at something hammer and tongs, you mean that they were doing it with great enthusiasm or energy.

ext.ext_cn: 伊恩·弗莱明未出版的原版笔记将在伦敦的苏富比拍卖行进行拍卖。
ext.ext_en: Ian Fleming's original unpublished notes are to go under the hammer at London auctioneers Sotheby's.

defs.def_en: If you say that something goes, comes, or is under the hammer, you mean that it is going to be sold at an auction.

ext.ext_cn: 一名官员费力地挤过人群。
ext.ext_en: An official pushed through the throng.

defs.def_en: A throng is a large crowd of people.

ext.ext_cn: 人群涌进大厅。
ext.ext_en: The crowds thronged into the mall.

ext.ext_cn: 拥在教皇周围的教众甚多
ext.ext_en: ...the multitudes that throng around the Pope.

defs.def_en: When people throng somewhere, they go there in great numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 6 月底到 8 月初，他们群聚在海滩上。
ext.ext_en: They throng the beaches between late June and early August.

defs.def_en: If people throng a place, they are present there in great numbers.

defs.def_cn: 非常引人注目地;极绚丽地

ext.ext_cn: 她说坎贝尔·布莱克简直帅呆了。
ext.ext_en: She said that Campbell-Black was drop-dead gorgeous...

ext.ext_cn: 给人的印象是柔和俏丽而不是吸人眼球的性感。
ext.ext_en: The effect is soft and pretty rather than drop-dead sexy.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as, for example, drop-dead gorgeous, you mean that they are so gorgeous that people cannot fail to notice them.

defs.def_cn: （通常指一段固定时间内对房屋、土地等的）占用

ext.ext_cn: 酒店入住率最低达到40％。
ext.ext_en: Hotel occupancy has been as low as 40%...

ext.ext_cn: 旅游业经营者反映客房入住率低。
ext.ext_en: Tour operators report low occupancy rates.

defs.def_en: Occupancy is the act of using a room, building, or area of land, usually for a fixed period of time.
A video camera is a camera that you use to record something that is happening so that you can watch it later.

ext.ext_cn: 里基一直揽着她的腰。
ext.ext_en: Ricky kept his arm round her waist...

ext.ext_cn: 他上身赤裸。
ext.ext_en: He was stripped to the waist.

defs.def_en: Your waist is the middle part of your body where it narrows slightly above your hips.
The waist of a garment such as a dress, coat, or pair of trousers is the part of it which covers the middle part of your body.

ext.ext_cn: 他们本可退到山中要塞埃利里去。
ext.ext_en: They could have withdrawn into the mountain fastness of Eryri.

defs.def_en: A fastness is a place, such as a castle, which is considered safe because it is difficult to reach or easy to defend against attack.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 嫉妒是最原始的情感。
ext.ext_en: Jealousy is a primal emotion.

ext.ext_cn: 地球起源的奥秘
ext.ext_en: ...the primal mysteries of the earth.

defs.def_en: Primal is used to describe something that relates to the origins of things or that is very basic.

ext.ext_cn: 詹金森促成了老美术馆的重新整修。
ext.ext_en: Jenkinson instigated a refurbishment of the old gallery...

ext.ext_cn: 过去 48 小时的暴力事件是在前秘密警察的煽动下爆发的。
ext.ext_en: The violence over the last forty-eight hours was instigated by ex-members of the secret police.

defs.def_en: Someone who instigates an event causes it to happen.
A silicon chip is a very small piece of silicon inside a computer. It has electronic circuits on it and can hold large quantities of information or perform mathematical or logical operations.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 引人注目的;异乎寻常的;显著的

ext.ext_cn: 那些统计数据最引人注目之处是其极高的自杀率。
ext.ext_en: The most striking feature of those statistics is the high proportion of suicides...

ext.ext_cn: 他酷似列宁。
ext.ext_en: He bears a striking resemblance to Lenin.

defs.def_en: Something that is striking is very noticeable or unusual.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 妩媚动人的;标致的;俊秀的

ext.ext_cn: 她是个留着金色长发的俏女郎。
ext.ext_en: She was a striking woman with long blonde hair.

defs.def_en: Someone who is striking is very attractive, in a noticeable way.

defs.def_cn: (活动、过程或时期的)阶段，部分

ext.ext_cn: 儿童谈论或表达自己感情的方式取决于他们的年龄和所处的发育阶段。
ext.ext_en: The way children talk about or express their feelings depends on their age and stage of development...

ext.ext_cn: 库克先生在行程的最后一站来到了希腊，他此行还包括了埃及和以色列。
ext.ext_en: Mr Cook has arrived in Greece on the final stage of a tour which also included Egypt and Israel.

defs.def_en: A stage of an activity, process, or period is one part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 一场音乐会结束后，巡回乐队管理组需要用一天多时间搬走和重新搭起舞台。
ext.ext_en: The road crew needed more than 24 hours to move and rebuild the stage after a concert...

ext.ext_cn: 我上台作了表演。
ext.ext_en: I went on stage and did my show.

defs.def_en: In a theatre, the stage is an area where actors or other entertainers perform.

ext.ext_cn: 玛奇不想让自己的女儿从事戏剧表演。
ext.ext_en: Madge did not want to put her daughter on the stage...

ext.ext_cn: 他是我在舞台上看到过的第一位滑稽演员。
ext.ext_en: He was the first comedian I ever saw on the stage.

defs.def_en: You can refer to acting and the production of plays in a theatre as the stage .

ext.ext_cn: 马娅·安杰卢在 20 世纪 70 年代后期第一次将戏剧《我还会站起来》搬上了舞台。
ext.ext_en: Maya Angelou first staged the play 'And I Still Rise' in the late 1970s.

defs.def_en: If someone stages a play or other show, they organize and present a performance of it.

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯工人已经举行了数次罢工，抗议该共和国宣布独立。
ext.ext_en: Russian workers have staged a number of strikes in protest at the republic's declaration of independence...

ext.ext_cn: 今年年中，政府举行了一次盛大的阅兵活动。
ext.ext_en: At the middle of this year the government staged a huge military parade.

defs.def_en: If you stage an event or ceremony, you organize it and usually take part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他最终因身体状况恶化被迫于去年离开了政治舞台。
ext.ext_en: He was finally forced off the political stage last year by the deterioration of his physical condition...

ext.ext_cn: 欧盟认为它能够解决欧洲面临的最严重的困境，提升自己作为国际舞台上一个重要角色的声誉。
ext.ext_en: The EU thought it could resolve Europe's worst nightmare and boost its own credibility as a strong actor on the international stage.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a particular area of activity as a particular stage, especially when you are talking about politics.
Peppermint is a strong, sharp flavouring that is obtained from the peppermint plant or that is made artificially.
A peppermint is a peppermint-flavoured sweet or piece of candy.

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯和其他加盟共和国承诺销毁他们储存的大部分核武器。
ext.ext_en: Russia and the other republics are committed to destroying most of their nuclear arsenals...

ext.ext_cn: 他们持有的步枪、机枪、地雷和催泪弹数量惊人。
ext.ext_en: They possess a formidable arsenal of rifles, machine guns, landmines and teargas.

defs.def_en: An arsenal is a large collection of weapons and military equipment held by a country, group, or person.

ext.ext_cn: 1990年南非空军武器库遭到突袭，这件凶器就是当时被盗走的武器中的一件。
ext.ext_en: The murder weapon was part of a haul stolen in a raid on a South African air-force arsenal in 1990.

defs.def_en: An arsenal is a building where weapons and military equipment are stored.

defs.def_cn: （方法、资源等的）宝库；(储藏工具的)仓库

ext.ext_cn: 管理者运用各种激励措施使雇员勇于冒险。
ext.ext_en: Managers use a full arsenal of motivational techniques to get employees to take risks...

ext.ext_cn: 他比其他拳击手出拳花样多。
ext.ext_en: He has more punches in his arsenal than other boxers.

defs.def_en: You can use arsenal to refer to a large number of tools, methods, or resources that someone has available to help them achieve what they want to do.

ext.ext_cn: 那只是猜测，不是事实。
ext.ext_en: That was a conjecture, not a fact...

ext.ext_cn: 存在着几种猜测。
ext.ext_en: There are several conjectures...

defs.def_en: A conjecture is a conclusion that is based on information that is not certain or complete.

ext.ext_cn: 他猜测说有些人也许能够察觉重大灾难。
ext.ext_en: He conjectured that some individuals may be able to detect major calamities...

ext.ext_cn: 这可能属实或者部分属实，我们都是在这儿揣测。
ext.ext_en: This may be true or partly true; we are all conjecturing here.

defs.def_en: When you conjecture, you form an opinion or reach a conclusion on the basis of information that is not certain or complete.

defs.def_cn: （以各种规则或条件）束缚，限制

ext.ext_cn: 这一提议附有诸多条件。
ext.ext_en: The offer was hedged around with conditions...

ext.ext_cn: 很多优惠费率都带有限制条件。
ext.ext_en: Many reduced fares are hedged around with restrictions.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as an offer is hedged about or is hedged around with rules or conditions, you mean that there are a lot of rules or conditions.

defs.def_cn: 槌球游戏(在草地上进行，以木槌击球使之穿过金属圈)
defs.def_en: Croquet is a game played on grass in which the players use long wooden sticks called mallets to hit balls through metal arches.

ext.ext_cn: 他的任性让她无法忍受。
ext.ext_en: His petulance made her impatient.

defs.def_en: Petulance is unreasonable, childish bad temper over something unimportant.

defs.def_cn: 标语牌；告示牌；布告；海报

ext.ext_cn: 抗议者唱着歌，挥舞着标语牌。
ext.ext_en: The protesters sang songs and waved placards.

defs.def_en: A placard is a large notice that is carried in a march or displayed in a public place.

ext.ext_cn: 在这些辩论中，思想贫乏是他的一个弱点。
ext.ext_en: His vacuity was a handicap in these debates.

ext.ext_cn: 以思想空洞和人身攻击闻名的竞选活动
ext.ext_en: ...a campaign notable for its intellectual vacuity and personal nastiness.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the vacuity of something or someone, you are critical of them because they lack intelligent thought or ideas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不感兴趣的;不关心的;冷淡的
