ext.ext_cn: 人们对别人的痛苦已经变得无动于衷。
ext.ext_en: People have become indifferent to the suffering of others.

ext.ext_cn: 严厉谴责警方对杀戮无动于衷的态度
ext.ext_en: ...the row over the police's indifferent attitude to the killings.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of being indifferent to something, you mean that they have a complete lack of interest in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (水平或质量)一般的,平庸的，差的

ext.ext_cn: 她主演过几部表现非常一般的电影。
ext.ext_en: She had starred in several very indifferent movies...

ext.ext_cn: 我们吃的许多食物质量要么很差,要么很一般。
ext.ext_en: Much of the food we eat is of very poor or indifferent quality.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as indifferent, you mean that their standard or quality is not very good, and often quite bad.

defs.def_cn: 无法回答的；没有答案的

ext.ext_cn: 他们会问母亲一些无法回答的问题。
ext.ext_en: They would ask their mother unanswerable questions.

defs.def_en: If you describe a question as unanswerable, you mean that it has no possible answer or that a particular person cannot possibly answer it.

ext.ext_cn: 他实际上已经相信了护士们的情况确实如此。
ext.ext_en: He actually became convinced that the nurses had an unanswerable case...

ext.ext_cn: 录用麦格雷戈的主张毋庸置疑。
ext.ext_en: The argument for recruiting McGregor was unanswerable.

defs.def_en: If you describe a case or argument as unanswerable, you think that it is obviously true or correct and that nobody could disagree with it.

ext.ext_cn: 人数估计不一、从两千人到数千人不等的人群
ext.ext_en: ...the crowds, which were variously estimated at two to several thousand...

ext.ext_cn: 人们对这家人有各种不同的评价：愚蠢、顽固、有种族偏见和无聊透顶，不一而足。
ext.ext_en: The family has been described variously as crass, bigoted, racist and plain boring.

defs.def_en: You can use variously to introduce a number of different ways in which something can be described.

ext.ext_cn: 任何射击线上的人质就都会成为牺牲品。
ext.ext_en: Any hostages in the firing line would have been sacrificed...

ext.ext_cn: 他确信自己能够把敌人压制在两条火力线间。
ext.ext_en: He was sure he would pin down the enemy between two firing lines.

defs.def_en: If you are in the firing line in a conflict, you are in a position where someone is aiming their gun at you.

ext.ext_cn: 外国银行也在遭批之列。
ext.ext_en: Foreign banks are in the firing line too...

ext.ext_cn: 年轻球员总是发现自己备受责难。
ext.ext_en: Young players found themselves too much in the firing line.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in the firing line, you mean that they are being criticized, blamed, or attacked for something.

defs.def_cn: (尤指潜意识性情感驱使的)失言，口误
defs.def_en: If someone accidentally says something that reveals their subconscious feelings, especially their sexual feelings, this is referred to as a Freudian slip .

defs.def_cn: （某人特有的说话或动作的）习性，习气，习惯

ext.ext_cn: 他的举手投足更像是一个全神贯注的数学教授。
ext.ext_en: His mannerisms are more those of a preoccupied math professor...

ext.ext_cn: 从口音和举止来看，他像一个地道的东欧人。
ext.ext_en: In accent and mannerism he appeared to be completely Eastern European.

defs.def_en: Someone's mannerisms are the gestures or ways of speaking which are very characteristic of them, and which they often use.

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽系好扣子。
ext.ext_en: Mari did up the buttons...

ext.ext_cn: 围好围巾，扣好衣服。
ext.ext_en: Keep your scarf on, do your coat up.

defs.def_en: If you do something up, you fasten it.

ext.ext_cn: 尼古拉斯在普罗旺斯买了一座条件简陋的大房子，8月份正在装修。
ext.ext_en: Nicholas has bought a barn in Provence and is spending August doing it up.

defs.def_en: If you do up an old building, you decorate and repair it so that it is in a better condition.

defs.def_cn: （常指以可笑或夸张的方式）装饰，打扮

ext.ext_cn: 比阿特丽斯通常打扮得像圣诞树上的精灵一样。
ext.ext_en: ...Beatrice, usually done up like the fairy on the Christmas tree...

ext.ext_cn: 她把她的金发盘得和杰姬一模一样。
ext.ext_en: She's had her blond hair done up exactly like Jackie's.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or room is done up in a particular way, you mean they are dressed or decorated in that way, often a way that is rather ridiculous or extreme.

ext.ext_cn: 他的画笔锋粗犷、凌厉。
ext.ext_en: He paints with harsh, slashing brushstrokes.

defs.def_en: Brushstrokes are the marks made on a surface by a painter's brush.
A chaise lounge is the same as a chaise longue .

ext.ext_cn: 期望中的旺销并没有发生。
ext.ext_en: The expected sales bonanza hadn't materialised.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a sudden great increase in wealth, success, or luck as a bonanza .

ext.ext_cn: 大气升温引起的海平面上升和气候变化的危险
ext.ext_en: ...the threat of rising sea levels and climatic change from overheating of the atmosphere.

defs.def_en: Climatic conditions, changes, and effects relate to the general weather conditions of a place.

ext.ext_cn: 她打定主意必须像平时一样生活，遵循自己通常的作息规律，同时怀抱希望、虔诚祈祷。
ext.ext_en: She had decided she must go on as usual, follow her normal routine, and hope and pray...

ext.ext_cn: 他离开前有些犹豫，几乎像是他一直期望能够交谈点什么。
ext.ext_en: He hesitates before leaving, almost as though he had been hoping for conversation...

defs.def_en: If you hope that something is true, or if you hope for something, you want it to be true or to happen, and you usually believe that it is possible or likely.

ext.ext_cn: 事情并不理想，但你只能指望这样了。
ext.ext_en: Things aren't ideal, but that's the best you can hope for...

ext.ext_cn: 我一直都知道这是个奢望。
ext.ext_en: I always knew it was too much to hope for.

defs.def_en: If you say that you cannot hope for something, or if you talk about the only thing that you can hope to get, you mean that you are in a bad situation, and there is very little chance of improving it.

ext.ext_cn: 既然他已当上了总统，很多人又再次看到了进行真正的体制改革的希望。
ext.ext_en: Now that he has become President, many people once again have hope for genuine changes in the system...

ext.ext_cn: 但凯文仍没有放弃康复的希望。
ext.ext_en: But Kevin hasn't given up hope of being fit...

defs.def_en: Hope is a feeling of desire and expectation that things will go well in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望增进两个地区之间的贸易。
ext.ext_en: They have hopes of increasing trade between the two regions...

ext.ext_cn: 该计划的拖延使得日本在太空获得商业性成功的希望化为泡影。
ext.ext_en: The delay in the programme has dashed Japan's hopes of commercial success in space...

defs.def_en: If someone wants something to happen, and considers it likely or possible, you can refer to their hopes of that thing, or to their hope that it will happen.

defs.def_cn: 被寄予希望的人（或事物）

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队在英国乒乓球公开锦标赛中的最后希望
ext.ext_en: ...England's last hope in the English Open Table Tennis Championships...

ext.ext_cn: 罗默最有希望给路易斯安那州带来务实高效之风。
ext.ext_en: Roemer represented the best hope for a businesslike climate in Louisiana.

defs.def_en: If you think that the help or success of a particular person or thing will cause you to be successful or to get what you want, you can refer to them as your hope .

defs.def_cn: 从最好的方面想;抱乐观的希望

ext.ext_cn: 我冒了这个险，心里祈祷能够诸事顺利。
ext.ext_en: I took the risk and hoped for the best...

ext.ext_cn: 有些公司在削减成本，希望一切好转。
ext.ext_en: Some companies are cutting costs and hoping for the best.

defs.def_en: If you are in a difficult situation and do something and hope for the best, you hope that everything will happen in the way you want, although you know that it may not.

ext.ext_cn: 不必对这次行动抱太大希望。
ext.ext_en: There is no reason for people to get their hopes up over this mission...

ext.ext_cn: 我不想让你抱很大希望，但我明天会和弗雷德说一声的。
ext.ext_en: I don't want you to build your hopes up, but I'll have a word with Fred tomorrow.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone not to get their hopes up, or not to build their hopes up, you are warning them that they should not become too confident of progress or success.

defs.def_cn: 没有一线希望;毫无机会

ext.ext_cn: 众人皆知他们根本就无力组建政府。
ext.ext_en: Everybody knows they haven't got a hope in hell of forming a government anyway.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has not got a hope in hell of doing something, you are emphasizing that they will not be able to do it.

defs.def_cn: 很高期望;很大希望;厚望

ext.ext_cn: 我对德里克·兰德尔发挥重要作用寄予厚望。
ext.ext_en: I had high hopes that Derek Randall might play an important part...

ext.ext_cn: 英国队有很大希望赢得奥运会马术三日赛的金牌。
ext.ext_en: Britain's three-day event team has high hopes of winning the Olympic gold medal...

defs.def_en: If you have high hopes or great hopes that something will happen, you are confident that it will happen.

defs.def_cn: 存一线希望;抱着万分之一的希望

ext.ext_cn: 她眼睛扫过大厅，对理查德会在那里等她仍怀有一丝希望。
ext.ext_en: She glanced about the hall, hoping against hope that Richard would be waiting for her.

defs.def_en: If you hope against hope that something will happen, you hope that it will happen, although it seems impossible.

ext.ext_cn: 希望你不介意我来见你。
ext.ext_en: I hope you don't mind me coming to see you...

ext.ext_cn: 但愿我没有说过让你不高兴的话。
ext.ext_en: I hope I haven't said anything to upset you.

defs.def_en: You use 'I hope' in expressions such as 'I hope you don't mind' and 'I hope I'm not disturbing you', when you are being polite and want to make sure that you have not offended someone or disturbed them.

defs.def_cn: （表示警告他人不要做愚蠢或危险的事）我希望，但愿

ext.ext_cn: 但愿你不是想要去见他吧？
ext.ext_en: You're not trying to see him, I hope?...

ext.ext_cn: 希望你不要对那个女孩太严厉。
ext.ext_en: I hope you won't be too harsh with the girl...

defs.def_en: You say 'I hope' when you want to warn someone not to do something foolish or dangerous.

defs.def_cn: （表示更加礼貌和委婉）我希望，我想

ext.ext_cn: 希望我是那份工作的最佳人选。
ext.ext_en: I'm the best man for the job, I hope...

ext.ext_cn: 我想文德尔小姐一切都好吧？
ext.ext_en: Fraulein Wendel is well, I hope?

defs.def_en: You add 'I hope' to what you are saying to make it sound more polite and less rude or less definite.

ext.ext_cn: 他努力学习，希望能被一所工程学院录取。
ext.ext_en: He was studying in the hope of being admitted to an engineering college...

ext.ext_cn: 我们将分析她告诉我们的所有事情，希望能找出罪魁祸首。
ext.ext_en: We will be analysing all the things she has told us in the hope that we can locate the person responsible.

defs.def_en: If you do one thing in the hope of another thing happening, you do it because you think it might cause or help the other thing to happen, which is what you want.

defs.def_cn: （在不太可能的情况下）对…继续抱有希望，痴心妄想

ext.ext_cn: 我只是妄想着有一天她会和我说话。
ext.ext_en: I just live in hope that one day she'll talk to me...

ext.ext_cn: 我母亲买了很多彩票，一心希望能中大奖。
ext.ext_en: My mother bought lots of tickets and lived in hope of winning the prize.

defs.def_en: If you live in hope that something will happen, you continue to hope that it will happen, although it seems unlikely, and you realize that you are being foolish.

ext.ext_cn: 业界估计本财年订单会增加10%。这绝对不可能。
ext.ext_en: The industry reckons it will see orders swell by 10% this financial year. Some hope.

defs.def_en: If you say 'Some hope', or 'Not a hope', you think there is no possibility that something will happen, although you may want it to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他仍然每天到乳品场看看，但把生意上大部分琐碎事务交给经理和工头打理。
ext.ext_en: He still visited the dairy daily, but left most of the business details to his manager and foreman.

defs.def_en: A foreman is a person, especially a man, in charge of a group of workers.

ext.ext_cn: 陪审团团长宣布判决结果时，旁听席响起了掌声。
ext.ext_en: There was applause from the public gallery as the foreman of the jury announced the verdict.

defs.def_en: The foreman of a jury is the person who is chosen as their leader.
A skewer is a long metal pin which is used to hold pieces of food together during cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 他用扦子刺穿了受害人的脖子。
ext.ext_en: He skewered his victim through the neck.

ext.ext_cn: 串有蔬菜的烤牛肉串
ext.ext_en: ...skewered beef with vegetables.

defs.def_en: If you skewer something, you push a long, thin, pointed object through it.

ext.ext_cn: 不出两年他就开始管理这家店了。
ext.ext_en: Within two years he was managing the store...

ext.ext_cn: 这个地区的绝大多数工厂都十分陈旧，经营状况也非常糟糕。
ext.ext_en: Most factories in the area are obsolete and badly managed...

defs.def_en: If you manage an organization, business, or system, or the people who work in it, you are responsible for controlling them.

defs.def_cn: 谨慎地使用，好好地利用(时间、金钱等)

ext.ext_cn: 在忙碌的世界里，善于利用时间变得越来越重要。
ext.ext_en: In a busy world, managing your time is increasingly important...

ext.ext_cn: 乔希指望我对每笔家庭支出都精打细算。
ext.ext_en: Josh expects me to manage all the household expenses on very little.

defs.def_en: If you manage time, money, or other resources, you deal with them carefully and do not waste them.

ext.ext_cn: 不知用了什么方法，他成功说服凯给他买了一个。
ext.ext_en: Somehow, he'd managed to persuade Kay to buy one for him...

ext.ext_cn: 我终于爬上了一块潮湿倾斜的暗礁。
ext.ext_en: I managed to pull myself up onto a wet, sloping ledge...

defs.def_en: If you manage to do something, especially something difficult, you succeed in doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 3年来，她一直没有服药却挺了过来。
ext.ext_en: She had managed perfectly well without medication for three years...

ext.ext_cn: 我正在努力应付，但我不可能放弃工作。
ext.ext_en: I am managing, but I could not possibly give up work...

defs.def_en: If you manage, you succeed in coping with a difficult situation.

defs.def_cn: 抽出，腾出，安排出(时间、金钱等)

ext.ext_cn: 对于那些只能在早晚抽出几个小时的人来说，这是最理想不过的了。
ext.ext_en: This makes it ideal for those who can only manage a few hours in the morning or evening...

ext.ext_cn: 麦克明不情愿地说：“好吧，我可以出5镑。”
ext.ext_en: 'All right, I can manage a fiver,' McMinn said with reluctance.

defs.def_en: If you say that you can manage an amount of time or money for something, you mean that you can afford to spend that time or money on it.

defs.def_cn: 勉强做出（微笑、寒暄等);强作

ext.ext_cn: 跟记者谈话的时候，他只是勉强挤出一丝淡淡的微笑，显得非常恍惚。
ext.ext_en: He looked dazed as he spoke to reporters, managing only a weak smile...

ext.ext_cn: 他勉强描述了一下探监情况。
ext.ext_en: He managed a few sentences about his visit to the prison...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone managed a particular response, such as a laugh or a greeting, you mean that it was difficult for them to do it because they were feeling sad or upset.

defs.def_cn: （对他人给予帮助的婉拒）我能对付，我能行

ext.ext_cn: 我知道您是一番好意，不过我一个人能行。
ext.ext_en: I know you mean well, but I can manage by myself...

ext.ext_cn: 安格斯一跃而起道：“让我来，埃莉诺。”可是，这一次她只是摇了摇头，坚定地说：“我能应付。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'll do it, Eleanor,' Angus said, quickly jumping up. But this time she only shook her head. 'I'll manage,' she said firmly.

defs.def_en: You say 'I can manage' or 'I'll manage' as a way of refusing someone's offer of help and insisting on doing something by yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 收银员弄错了，少找了他钱。
ext.ext_en: The cashier made a mistake and short-changed him.

defs.def_en: If someone short-changes you, they do not give you enough change after you have bought something from them.

ext.ext_cn: 实际上女性在新闻界仍然没有受到公平对待。
ext.ext_en: Women are in fact still being short-changed in the press.

defs.def_en: If you are short-changed, you are treated unfairly or dishonestly, often because you are given less of something than you deserve.

ext.ext_cn: 他去男洗手间清洗衬衫上的斑斑血迹。
ext.ext_en: He went to the men's room to wash flecks of blood from his shirt...

ext.ext_cn: 他深灰色的头发夹杂着几缕姜黄色。
ext.ext_en: His hair is dark grey with flecks of ginger.

defs.def_en: Flecks are small marks on a surface, or objects that look like small marks.

defs.def_cn: 惊恐万分的;无比震惊的

ext.ext_cn: “安娜夫人怎么啦？”他惊恐万分地看着她那失神的脸小声问道。
ext.ext_en: 'What is the matter with Signora Anna?' he whispered, horror-struck at her vacant face.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as horror-struck or horror-stricken, you mean that they feel very great horror at something that has happened.

ext.ext_cn: 国民生产总值的增长率将取决于总需求的增长率。
ext.ext_en: The rate of growth of GNP will depend upon the rate of growth of aggregate demand...

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队已经连续3次打败威尔士队，总比分为83比12。
ext.ext_en: England have beaten the Welsh three times in succession with an aggregate score of 83-12.

defs.def_en: An aggregate amount or score is made up of several smaller amounts or scores added together.

ext.ext_cn: 被看成个体集合的社会
ext.ext_en: ...society viewed as an aggregate of individuals.

defs.def_en: An aggregate is a number of people or things that are being considered as a single thing.

ext.ext_cn: 不同的经济有着不同的货币，不应该视为一体以制定出统一的政策。
ext.ext_en: Different economies, with different currencies, should not be aggregated to produce uniform policies...

ext.ext_cn: 我们绝对不可将选票相加来预测另一种制度下的选举结果。
ext.ext_en: We should never aggregate votes to predict results under another system.

defs.def_en: If amounts or things are aggregated, they are added together and considered as a single amount or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 只有在消费总额超过总收入的7%时才可免税。
ext.ext_en: Expenses are deductible only to the extent that in aggregate they exceed 7 percent of gross income.

defs.def_en: If a number of different things or amounts are considered in aggregate, or in the aggregate, they are considered as a single thing or amount.

ext.ext_cn: 联队以总比分5比3胜出。
ext.ext_en: United won 5-3 on aggregate.

defs.def_en: If one team beats another on aggregate, it wins because it has a higher total score than the other team after a series of games.

ext.ext_cn: 默里并排停放了他的车。
ext.ext_en: Murray double-parked his car...

ext.ext_cn: 车在市政大厅前靠边并排停下了。
ext.ext_en: The car pulled in and double-parked in front of the town hall.

defs.def_en: If someone double-parks their car or their car double-parks, they park in a road by the side of another parked car.
A cog is a wheel with square or triangular teeth around the edge, which is used in a machine to turn another wheel or part.

defs.def_cn: (大型机构或团体中的)一小分子

ext.ext_cn: 莱克先生是共和党竞选机器中一枚重要的螺丝钉。
ext.ext_en: Mr Lake was an important cog in the Republican campaign machine.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a cog in a machine or wheel, you mean that they are a small part of a large organization or group.

ext.ext_cn: 他们认为格雷藏在法国和意大利边境附近。
ext.ext_en: Gray is thought to be in hiding near the France/Italy border...

ext.ext_cn: 据说有几百人为躲避逮捕而藏了起来。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of people are said to have gone into hiding to avoid arrest...

defs.def_en: If someone is in hiding, they have secretly gone somewhere where they cannot be seen or found.
If you give someone a hiding, you punish them by hitting them many times.

defs.def_cn: 白白浪费时间;白费工夫;毫无成功希望

ext.ext_cn: 谈到商业生存，一个年产只有5万辆的汽车制造厂家是毫无成功希望的。
ext.ext_en: As regards commercial survival, a car manufacturer capable of making only 50,000 cars a year is on a hiding to nothing.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone who is trying to achieve something is on a hiding to nothing, you are emphasizing that they have absolutely no chance of being successful.

defs.def_cn: 放出，释放（水、空气等）；呼（气）

ext.ext_cn: 它吸收阳光，但并不释放热量。
ext.ext_en: It lets sunlight in but doesn't let heat out...

ext.ext_cn: 米尔长叹了一口气。
ext.ext_en: Meer let out his breath in a long sigh.

defs.def_en: If something or someone lets water, air, or breath out, they allow it to flow out or escape.

ext.ext_cn: 她看见他时吓得大叫一声。
ext.ext_en: When she saw him, she let out a cry of horror.

defs.def_en: If you let out a particular sound, you make that sound.

defs.def_cn: 印地语（印度北部使用的语言，为印度官方语言之一）
defs.def_en: Hindi is a language that is spoken by people in northern India. It is also one of the official languages of India.

defs.def_cn: 参加四分之一决赛的选手(或队伍)
defs.def_en: A quarter-finalist is a person or team that is competing in a quarter-final.
Central heating is a heating system for buildings. Air or water is heated in one place and travels round a building through pipes and radiators.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is politically correct, you mean that they are extremely careful not to offend or upset any group of people in society who have a disadvantage, or who have been treated differently because of their sex, race, or disability.

ext.ext_cn: 这样的政策要求国家间进行空前的合作。
ext.ext_en: Such policies would require unprecedented cooperation between nations...

ext.ext_cn: 阿拉伯各国同意在巴格达会晤。
ext.ext_en: The Arab nations agreed to meet in Baghdad.

defs.def_en: A nation is an individual country considered together with its social and political structures.  →see usage note at:country

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个感动了全体国民的故事。
ext.ext_en: It was a story that touched the nation's heart.

defs.def_en: The nation is sometimes used to refer to all the people who live in a particular country.
An atheist is a person who believes that there is no God.

defs.def_cn: 开始(交谈);建立(友谊);开始(来往)

ext.ext_cn: 我跟着她进了彭尼家然后开始交谈起来。
ext.ext_en: I trailed her into Penney's and struck up a conversation...

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯和小岛上一个养了一匹小马的小男孩儿交上了朋友。
ext.ext_en: James struck up a friendship with a small boy who owned a pony on the island.

defs.def_en: When you strike up a conversation or friendship with someone, you begin one.

ext.ext_cn: 然后管弦乐队奏起了国歌。
ext.ext_en: And then the orchestra struck up the National Anthem...

ext.ext_cn: 音乐从海滨区一栋古老的大楼里响起。
ext.ext_en: Music struck up in one of the big old buildings along the seafront...

defs.def_en: When musicians strike up a piece of music, or when music strikes up, the music begins.

ext.ext_cn: 这份文件先前在纽约的联合国总部传阅过。
ext.ext_en: The document was previously circulated in New York at the United Nations...

ext.ext_cn: 公务员、教师和自由派人士正在散发请愿书，要求将他召回。
ext.ext_en: Public employees, teachers and liberals are circulating a petition for his recall...

defs.def_en: If a piece of writing circulates or is circulated, copies of it are passed round among a group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 已传出谣言说，该项目可能会被迫取消。
ext.ext_en: Rumours were already beginning to circulate that the project might have to be abandoned...

ext.ext_cn: 我特别憎恨那种在人家伤心透顶的时候还在传播的谣言。
ext.ext_en: I deeply resented those sort of rumours being circulated at a time of deeply personal grief.

defs.def_en: If something such as a rumour circulates or is circulated, the people in a place tell it to each other.

defs.def_cn: (在密闭场所或系统内)循环，流转，传播

ext.ext_cn: 通过血液循环传播、造成多种器官病变的病毒
ext.ext_en: ...a virus which circulates via the bloodstream and causes ill health in a variety of organs...

ext.ext_cn: 做饭的香味可以传到家里的各个角落。
ext.ext_en: Cooking odors can circulate throughout the entire house.

defs.def_en: When something circulates, it moves easily and freely within a closed place or system.

ext.ext_cn: 我给你找点喝的，然后我得去应酬一下。
ext.ext_en: Let me get you something to drink, then I must circulate.

defs.def_en: If you circulate at a party, you move among the guests and talk to different people.

ext.ext_cn: 百年奥运盛典将在佐治亚州亚特兰大举行。
ext.ext_en: The centennial Olympics will be in Atlanta, Georgia.

defs.def_en: A centennial is the same as a centenary .

ext.ext_cn: 她撕掉包装纸，抽出一支烟，点燃了。
ext.ext_en: She tore off the cellophane, pulled out a cigarette, and lit it.

ext.ext_cn: 透明包装纸
ext.ext_en: ...a cellophane wrapper.

defs.def_en: Cellophane is a thin, transparent material that is used to wrap things.

ext.ext_cn: 邦妮用手指旋转着她的空杯子。
ext.ext_en: Bonnie twirled her empty glass in her fingers...

ext.ext_cn: 在我周围，树叶打着转儿纷纷飘落到地上。
ext.ext_en: All around me leaves twirl to the ground.

defs.def_en: If you twirl something or if it twirls, it turns around and around with a smooth, fairly fast movement.

ext.ext_cn: 几百人在舞厅的舞池里旋转。
ext.ext_en: Several hundred people twirl around the ballroom dance floor.

defs.def_en: If you twirl, you turn around and around quickly, for example when you are dancing.

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉抬起手来开始用手指缠绕一缕头发。
ext.ext_en: Sarah lifted her hand and started twirling a strand of hair.

defs.def_en: If you twirl something such as your hair, you twist it around your finger.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对颓靡的西方电影在上映数量上的限制
ext.ext_en: ...restrictions on the number of decadent western films that were allowed to be shown.

ext.ext_cn: 他们颓废的摇滚生活的种种放浪及层层重压
ext.ext_en: ...the excesses and stresses of their decadent rock 'n' roll lifestyles.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or society is decadent, you think that they have low moral standards and are interested mainly in pleasure.
Shan't is the usual spoken form of 'shall not'.

ext.ext_cn: 有一次，他在凌晨1点钟梦游走到了家门外的马路中央。
ext.ext_en: He once sleepwalked to the middle of the road outside his home at 1 a.m.

defs.def_en: If someone is sleepwalking, they are walking around while they are asleep.

ext.ext_cn: 直到现在才确定了它的准确位置。
ext.ext_en: It has taken until now to pin down its exact location...

ext.ext_cn: 我只能确定是在1936至1942年期间。
ext.ext_en: I can only pin it down to between 1936 and 1942...

defs.def_en: If you try to pin something down, you try to discover exactly what, where, or when it is.

defs.def_cn: 迫使…作出决定（或明确表态）

ext.ext_cn: 她没有办法强迫他答应约会。
ext.ext_en: She couldn't pin him down to a date...

ext.ext_cn: 他们迫使他对一系列问题明确表态的再三努力
ext.ext_en: ...their repeated efforts to pin him down on a number of topics...

defs.def_en: If you pin someone down, you force them to make a decision or to tell you what their decision is, when they have been trying to avoid doing this.

ext.ext_cn: 一名政府官员透露他们已被列入一份秘密黑名单。
ext.ext_en: A government official disclosed that they were on a secret blacklist...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数信贷机构都有一份为期15年的黑名单，以有效阻止破产者得到贷款。
ext.ext_en: Most credit agencies run a 15-year blacklist effectively barring bankrupts from receiving credit.

defs.def_en: If someone is on a blacklist, they are seen by a government or other organization as being one of a number of people who cannot be trusted or who have done something wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 他自从1969年因持有大麻而被定罪后就被列入了黑名单。
ext.ext_en: He has been blacklisted since being convicted of possessing marijuana in 1969.

ext.ext_cn: 列入黑名单的机场的完整清单
ext.ext_en: ...the full list of blacklisted airports.

defs.def_en: If someone is blacklisted by a government or organization, they are put on a blacklist.

ext.ext_cn: 是隔壁的报警器。
ext.ext_en: That's next door's alarm.

ext.ext_cn: 邻居家的狗
ext.ext_en: ...next door's dog.

defs.def_en: You can use next door's to indicate that something belongs to the person or people who live in the house to the right or left of your own.

defs.def_cn: （有某些特色或特点的）地区，地带，区域

ext.ext_cn: 许多人留在了可能会沦为交战区的地方。
ext.ext_en: Many people have stayed behind in the potential war zone...

ext.ext_cn: 这个地区已经被宣布为灾难地带。
ext.ext_en: The area has been declared a disaster zone.

defs.def_en: A zone  is an area that has particular features or characteristics.

defs.def_cn: 将…划为特殊区域;指定…为某项用途区域

ext.ext_cn: 这块地未划作商业用地。
ext.ext_en: The land was not zoned for commercial purposes...

ext.ext_cn: 公园中的大多数私人土地并未进行任何专门规划或保护。
ext.ext_en: Most of the private land in the park wasn't zoned or protected in any way.

defs.def_en: If an area of land is zoned, it is formally set aside for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 游客们在正爬上岩石寻找最佳的拍摄角度。
ext.ext_en: Tourists were scrambling over the rocks looking for the perfect camera angle...

ext.ext_cn: 他攀上了一个陡峭的河堤。
ext.ext_en: He scrambled up a steep bank.

defs.def_en: If you scramble over rocks or up a hill, you move quickly over them or up it using your hands to help you.

ext.ext_cn: 安掀开被子，急忙下了床。
ext.ext_en: Ann threw back the covers and scrambled out of bed...

ext.ext_cn: 他赶忙站起身来。
ext.ext_en: He scrambled to his feet.

defs.def_en: If you scramble to a different place or position, you move there in a hurried, awkward way.

ext.ext_cn: 预计会有超过 300 万的球迷抢购门票。
ext.ext_en: More than three million fans are expected to scramble for tickets...

ext.ext_cn: 商业繁荣，外国人争相投资。
ext.ext_en: Business is booming and foreigners are scrambling to invest.

defs.def_en: If a number of people scramble for something, they compete energetically with each other for it.

ext.ext_cn: 把面包烤一下并炒些鸡蛋。
ext.ext_en: Make the toast and scramble the eggs.

defs.def_en: If you scramble eggs, you break them, mix them together and then heat and stir the mixture in a pan.

defs.def_cn: 倒换(无线电或电话信号)的频率(使只有持特殊仪器的人才能接收)

ext.ext_cn: 最新的机器对信号作扰频处理，通话就不易被侦听了。
ext.ext_en: The latest machines scramble the messages so that the conversation cannot easily be intercepted.

defs.def_en: If a device scrambles a radio or telephone message, it interferes with the sound so that the message can only be understood by someone with special equipment.

ext.ext_cn: 他匆匆看了一下手表。
ext.ext_en: He glanced at his watch...

ext.ext_cn: 我回头一瞥。
ext.ext_en: I glanced back.

defs.def_en: If you glance at something or someone, you look at them very quickly and then look away again immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 我拿起电话簿，匆匆扫了一遍。
ext.ext_en: I picked up the phone book and glanced through it...

ext.ext_cn: 我对日报的政治版从来连看都不看。
ext.ext_en: I never even glanced at the political page of a daily paper.

defs.def_en: If you glance through or at a newspaper, report, or book, you spend a short time looking at it without reading it very carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 特雷弗和我迅速交换了一下眼色。
ext.ext_en: Trevor and I exchanged a glance.

ext.ext_cn: 偷偷瞥一眼她的手表
ext.ext_en: ...stealing a quick glance at her watch.

defs.def_en: A glance is a quick look at someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 一眼就能看出她很有同情心。
ext.ext_en: One could tell at a glance that she was a compassionate person.

defs.def_en: If you see something at a glance, you see or recognize it immediately, and without having to think or look carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 乍一看，有机耕作对农民而言似乎花费大多了。
ext.ext_en: At first glance, organic farming looks much more expensive for the farmer.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is true or seems to be true at first glance, you mean that it seems to be true when you first see it or think about it, but that your first impression may be wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 他偷偷地看了一眼她背后的钟。
ext.ext_en: He stole a glance at the clock behind her.

defs.def_en: If you steal a glance at someone or something, you look at them quickly so that nobody sees you looking.

ext.ext_cn: 在飞行模拟装置中练习高难度着陆的飞行员
ext.ext_en: ...pilots practising a difficult landing in a flight simulator.

defs.def_en: A simulator is a device which artificially creates the effect of being in conditions of some kind. Simulators are used in training people such as pilots or astronauts.

ext.ext_cn: 电化学现象
ext.ext_en: ...electro-chemical phenomena.

ext.ext_cn: 电磁能
ext.ext_en: ...electromagnetic energy.

defs.def_en: Electro- is used to form words that refer to electricity or processes involving electricity.
A pallet is a narrow mattress filled with straw which is put on the floor for someone to sleep on.

ext.ext_cn: 只给了他一张硬板小床和一条毯子。
ext.ext_en: He was given only a wooden pallet with a blanket.

defs.def_en: A pallet is a hard, narrow bed.

defs.def_cn: （叉车搬运货物时用的）货盘，托盘

ext.ext_cn: 那间仓库将用9万多个货盘装3,000万只复活节彩蛋。
ext.ext_en: The warehouse will hold more than 90,000 pallets storing 30 million Easter eggs.

defs.def_en: A pallet is a flat wooden or metal platform on which goods are stored so that they can be lifted and moved using a forklift truck.

ext.ext_cn: 他将和他约个时间把几件事情理清楚。
ext.ext_en: He would make an appointment with him to straighten out a couple of things...

ext.ext_cn: 我姐姐凭着自己的镇定和常识帮着把这些问题都解决了。
ext.ext_en: My sister had come in with her calm common sense and straightened them out.

defs.def_en: If you straighten out a confused situation, you succeed in getting it organized and tidied up.

defs.def_cn: (摇滚音乐会上舞台前的)舞池

ext.ext_cn: 男女混合的舞池不安全，对女孩子尤其如此。
ext.ext_en: A mixed-sex moshpit is not a safe place, especially for girls.

defs.def_en: The moshpit at a rock concert is the area in front of the stage where people jump up and down.

defs.def_cn: 限制(拨款或资金)的用途;使…专门用于

ext.ext_cn: 财政部现在已经同意限制这笔钱的用途，以保证其直接用于帮助老年人。
ext.ext_en: The Treasury has now agreed to ring-fence the money to ensure that it goes directly towards helping elderly people...

ext.ext_cn: 应该有用于落实当地犯罪预防计划的专项资金。
ext.ext_en: There should be ring-fenced funding for local crime prevention initiatives.

defs.def_en: To ring-fence a grant or fund means to put restrictions on it, so that it can only be used for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙自由主义者寻求语言及行政上的统一。
ext.ext_en: Spanish liberals sought to create linguistic as well as administrative uniformity.

ext.ext_cn: 从态度和信仰上的高度一致可以看出意识形态的力量
ext.ext_en: ...the strength of the ideology is seen in the remarkable uniformity of attitudes and beliefs.

defs.def_en: See also:uniform;If there is uniformity in something such as a system, organization, or group of countries, the same rules, ideas, or methods are applied in all parts of it.

defs.def_cn: 对老年人的歧视;年龄歧视
defs.def_en: Ageism is unacceptable behaviour that occurs as a result of the belief that older people are of less value than younger people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 破旧的;年久失修的;衰老的

ext.ext_cn: 该影片是在一所破旧不堪的警察局里拍摄的。
ext.ext_en: The film had been shot in a decrepit old police station.

ext.ext_cn: 年迈体衰的老人
ext.ext_en: ..a decrepit old man.

defs.def_en: Something that is decrepit is old and in bad condition. Someone who is decrepit is old and weak.

defs.def_cn: 极简派设计师；极简派艺术家

ext.ext_cn: 他受到20世纪70年代极简派艺术家的影响。
ext.ext_en: He was influenced by the minimalists in the 1970s.

defs.def_en: A  minimalist is an artist or designer who uses minimalism.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极简派风格的;受极简主义影响的

ext.ext_cn: 两位设计师决定采用极简派风格。
ext.ext_en: The two designers settled upon a minimalist approach.

defs.def_en: Minimalist is used to describe ideas, artists, or designers that are influenced by minimalism.

defs.def_cn: 挂断（电话）/突然挂断…的电话

ext.ext_cn: 妈妈挂上了电话。
ext.ext_en: Mum hung up the phone...

ext.ext_cn: 别挂电话！
ext.ext_en: Don't hang up!...

defs.def_en: If you hang up or you hang up the phone, you end a phone call. If you hang up on someone you are speaking to on the phone, you end the phone call suddenly and unexpectedly.

defs.def_cn: 结束，终止（运动生涯或某项活动）

ext.ext_cn: 基冈宣布自己将挂靴，永远退出足坛。
ext.ext_en: Keegan announced he was hanging up his boots for good...

ext.ext_cn: 回首过去，她觉得自己真不该放下背包不再徒步旅行。
ext.ext_en: Looking back, she feels she should never have hung up her backpack.

defs.def_en: You can use hang up to indicate that someone stops doing a particular sport or activity that they have regularly done over a long period. For example, when a footballer hangs up his boots, he stops playing football.

ext.ext_cn: 一滴滴油乎乎的汤
ext.ext_en: ...oily globs of soup.

defs.def_en: A glob of something soft or liquid is a small round amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在看的是较小的系统，但是稍后我会谈到那个问题。
ext.ext_en: We're now looking at a smaller system but I'll come on to that later.

defs.def_en: When you come on to a particular topic, you start discussing it.

ext.ext_cn: 我不认为女人化妆就是想勾引男人。
ext.ext_en: I don't think that a woman, by using make-up, is trying to come on to a man.

defs.def_en: If someone comes on to you, they show that they are interested in starting a sexual relationship with you.

ext.ext_cn: 对于美国人来说，最大的挑战在于理解东欧人的思维方式。
ext.ext_en: The greatest challenge for the Americans is understanding the mindset of Eastern Europeans...

ext.ext_cn: 当今运动员的一贯想法是：“现在只管尽自己最大努力，而不去担心日后会怎么样。”
ext.ext_en: The modern athlete's mind-set is, 'I'm going to make as much as I can now and not worry about the future.'

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's mind-set, you mean their general attitudes and the way they typically think about things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （动作）文雅的;（人）娇小的，秀丽的;（物）小巧的，精致的

ext.ext_cn: 这些女孩子娇美温柔。
ext.ext_en: The girls were dainty and feminine.

ext.ext_cn: 娇艳的粉色花朵
ext.ext_en: ...dainty pink flowers.

defs.def_en: If you describe a movement, person, or object as dainty, you mean that they are small, delicate, and pretty.

defs.def_cn: (尤指结婚或买房后)定居，安顿下来

ext.ext_cn: 总有一天，我会想安定下来，成个家。
ext.ext_en: One day I'll want to settle down and have a family...

ext.ext_cn: 在定居葡萄牙之前，她在伦敦经营一家自己的古董店。
ext.ext_en: Before she settled down in Portugal, she had run her own antiques shop in London.

defs.def_en: When someone settles down, they start living a quiet life in one place, especially when they get married or buy a house.

defs.def_cn: (历经磨难或变化后)安静下来，平静下来

ext.ext_cn: 等欧洲的局势平定下来后，去法国旅行一趟应该不错。
ext.ext_en: It'd be fun, after the situation in Europe settles down, to take a trip over to France...

ext.ext_cn: 我们去看了四次治疗专家，现在孩子们已经稳定下来了。
ext.ext_en: We saw the therapist four times, and the children have now settled down.

defs.def_en: If a situation or a person that has been going through a lot of problems or changes settles down, they become calm.

defs.def_cn: 集中精力做;开始认真做

ext.ext_cn: 他喝了杯咖啡，回来后开始认真听讲。
ext.ext_en: He got his coffee, came back and settled down to listen...

ext.ext_cn: 他们着手做一些重要的工作。
ext.ext_en: They settled down to some serious work.

defs.def_en: If you settle down to do something or to something, you prepare to do it and concentrate on it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们搭好帐篷，准备过夜。
ext.ext_en: They put up their tents and settled down for the night.

defs.def_en: If you settle down for the night, you get ready to lie down and sleep.
A dessertspoon is a spoon which is midway between the size of a teaspoon and a tablespoon. You use it to eat desserts.

defs.def_cn: 一点心匙的量;一中型匙的量

ext.ext_cn: 满满一点心匙面粉
ext.ext_en: ...a rounded dessertspoon of flour.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an amount of food resting on a dessertspoon as a dessertspoon of food.

ext.ext_cn: 在任何国家的犯罪者中，十几二十几岁的青年男性都占了很高的比例。
ext.ext_en: A high proportion of crime in any country is perpetrated by young males in their teens and twenties...

ext.ext_cn: 对最贫穷和最没有特权的人们犯下了大量罪行。
ext.ext_en: Tremendous wrongs were being perpetrated on the poorest and least privileged human beings...

defs.def_en: If someone perpetrates a crime or any other immoral or harmful act, they do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们只是玩玩油彩，打发时间而已。
ext.ext_en: We were just messing around playing with paint...

ext.ext_cn: 别再磨蹭了，快去买一个。
ext.ext_en: Stop messing about and go and buy one...

defs.def_en: If you mess around or mess about, you spend time doing things without any particular purpose or without achieving anything.

ext.ext_cn: 男孩和女孩会喜欢摆弄各种机械装置。
ext.ext_en: Boys and girls will enjoy messing about with any kind of machine.

ext.ext_cn: 我想知道是谁在瞎摆弄这辆婴儿车。
ext.ext_en: I'd like to know who's been messing about with the pram.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is messing around with or messing about with something, you mean that they are interfering with it in a harmful way.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为她是在胡闹。
ext.ext_en: I thought she was messing about.

defs.def_en: If someone is messing around or messing about, they are behaving in a joking or silly way.

ext.ext_cn: 戴维森已经打消了返回原来的俱乐部的念头，因为他们“糊弄他”。
ext.ext_en: Davison had pulled out of a move to his old club because they had 'messed him about'...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为他们被耍得太过头了。
ext.ext_en: I think they've been messed around far too much.

defs.def_en: If you mess someone around or mess them about, you treat them badly, for example by not being honest with them, or by continually changing plans which affect them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 楼下有一个早餐间，宾客们可以在温馨的酒吧间休息一下。
ext.ext_en: Downstairs there's a breakfast room and guests can relax in the cosy bar.

defs.def_en: A house or room that is cosy is comfortable and warm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望确保客人们感到舒适温暖。
ext.ext_en: They like to make sure their guests are comfortable and cosy.

defs.def_en: If you are cosy, you are comfortable and warm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 朋友间亲切的闲聊
ext.ext_en: ...a cosy  chat between friends...

ext.ext_cn: 我今年想过一个温馨、愉快并且绝对健康的圣诞节。
ext.ext_en: My mood this year is for a cosy, nice and thoroughly wholesome Christmas.

defs.def_en: You use cosy to describe activities that are pleasant and friendly, and involve people who know each other well.
If you refer to someone as a ninny, you think that they are foolish or silly.

ext.ext_cn: 政府将给多达3,000人提供临时住处。
ext.ext_en: The government will provide temporary accommodation for up to three thousand people...

ext.ext_cn: 起价为单人1,095英镑，包括机票、旅店住宿和各种出游费用。
ext.ext_en: Prices start at £1,095 per person, including flights, hotel accommodation and various excursions...

defs.def_en: Accommodation is used to refer to buildings or rooms where people live or stay.

defs.def_cn: （楼房或交通工具内的）空间，座位，铺位

ext.ext_cn: 该学院分散在主校区不同地点。
ext.ext_en: The school occupies split-site accommodation on the main campus...

ext.ext_cn: 有些火车可以运载自行车，但因空间有限需要提前预订。
ext.ext_en: Some trains carry bicycles, but accommodation is restricted so a reservation is essential.

defs.def_en: Accommodation is space in buildings or vehicles that is available for certain things, people, or activities.

ext.ext_cn: 他本能的反应会是寻求与民族主义者取得新的和解。
ext.ext_en: His instinct would be to seek a new accommodation with the nationalists...

ext.ext_cn: 为了生存，宗教必须同其赖以存在的更大的政治体系相调和。
ext.ext_en: Religions, to survive, must make accommodations with the larger political structures that nurture them.

defs.def_en: An accommodation is an agreement between different people which enables them to exist together without trouble.
A Freemason is a man who is a member of a large secret society. Freemasons promise to help each other, and use a system of secret signs in order to recognize each other.

defs.def_cn: 为了…而受惩罚；为…付出代价

ext.ext_cn: 他必须为他的严重罪行付出代价。
ext.ext_en: He must be made to answer for his terrible crimes.

defs.def_en: If you have to answer for something bad or wrong you have done, you are punished for it.
If you say that someone has a lot to answer for, you are saying that their actions have led to problems which you think they are responsible for.
An exclamation mark is the sign ! which is used in writing to show that a word, phrase, or sentence is an exclamation.

defs.def_cn: 约旦的；约旦人的；约旦文化的
defs.def_en: Jordanian means belonging or relating to the country of Jordan, or to its people or culture.
A Jordanian is a Jordanian citizen, or a person of Jordanian origin.
A tome is a very large, heavy book.
A Kalashnikov is a type of rifle that is made in Russia.

ext.ext_cn: 对女人说些恭维话没有坏处。
ext.ext_en: You can do no harm by paying a woman compliments...

ext.ext_cn: “干得好，卡桑德拉。”克鲁克说。她脸一下子红了，但还是很有风度地接受了恭维。
ext.ext_en: 'Well done, Cassandra,' Crook said. She blushed, but accepted the compliment with good grace.

defs.def_en: A compliment is a polite remark that you say to someone to show that you like their appearance, appreciate their qualities, or approve of what they have done.

ext.ext_cn: 每次见到我，他们都称赞我的外貌。
ext.ext_en: They complimented me on the way I looked each time they saw me...

ext.ext_cn: 首先，让我来夸几句，你们《三角迷踪》春季号的大部分内容都非常精彩。
ext.ext_en: Firstly I compliment you on most of your excellent Spring issue of 'Triangle'.

defs.def_en: If you compliment someone, you pay them a compliment.

ext.ext_cn: 我们认为被称作“保守分子”是对我们的一种赞赏。
ext.ext_en: We consider it a compliment to be called 'conservative'...

ext.ext_cn: 显然他担心我们，我把这当做一种赞美。
ext.ext_en: It's obvious he's worried about us and I'm taking it as a compliment.

defs.def_en: If you consider something that a person says or does as a compliment, it convinces you of your own good qualities, or that the person appreciates you.

ext.ext_cn: 请向厨师代为致意！
ext.ext_en: My compliments to the chef...

ext.ext_cn: 写信回家的时候，代我问候你可爱的妻子。
ext.ext_en: Give my compliments to your lovely wife when you write home.

defs.def_en: You can refer to your compliments when you want to express thanks, good wishes, or respect to someone in  a formal way.

ext.ext_cn: 这周末演员们给我们带来了精彩的演出，我觉得我们该回请他们了。
ext.ext_en: The actors have entertained us so splendidly during this weekend, I think it's time we returned the compliment.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone returns the compliment, you mean that they do the same thing to someone else as that person has done to them.

defs.def_cn: (尤指赠送礼物或给予帮助时)…敬赠，请接受…的敬意

ext.ext_cn: 请把这个给你的老板，算是我的一点心意。
ext.ext_en: Please give this to your boss with my compliments...

ext.ext_cn: 一份让人垂涎的早餐摆在我的床头桌上，那是管理人员的一点小意思。
ext.ext_en: On my bedside table awaited, with the compliments of the management, an appetizing breakfast.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are giving someone something with your compliments, you are saying in a polite and fairly formal way that you are giving it to them, especially as a gift or a favour.

defs.def_cn: 白色婚礼（新娘穿白色礼服并在教堂举行的婚礼）
defs.def_en: A white wedding is a wedding where the bride wears white and the ceremony takes place in a church.

ext.ext_cn: 她第一次也是唯一一次宇宙飞行是在去年 9 月。
ext.ext_en: She made her first and only space flight last September...

ext.ext_cn: 载人宇宙飞行的前景看上去充满了越来越多的变数。
ext.ext_en: The future for manned space flight is looking increasingly uncertain.

defs.def_en: A space flight is a trip into space.

ext.ext_cn: 无脊椎动物
ext.ext_en: ...invertebrate creatures.

ext.ext_cn: 无脊椎动物
ext.ext_en: ...invertebrate creatures.

defs.def_en: An invertebrate is a creature that does not have a spine, for example an insect, a worm, or an octopus.

ext.ext_cn: 将糖熬成焦糖。
ext.ext_en: Cook until the sugar starts to caramelize.

defs.def_en: If sugar caramelizes, it turns to caramel as a result of being heated.

defs.def_cn: 给(水果等)炒上一层焦糖

ext.ext_cn: 先将一些洋葱外面炒上焦糖。
ext.ext_en: Start by caramelizing some onions.

ext.ext_cn: 拔丝苹果和梨
ext.ext_en: ...caramelised apples and pears.

defs.def_en: If you caramelize something such as fruit, you cook it with sugar so that it is coated with caramel.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 康诺特酒店的宁静氛围让客人完全找到了宾至如归的感觉。
ext.ext_en: The tranquil atmosphere of The Connaught allows guests to feel totally at home...

ext.ext_cn: 那个地方恬静宜人。
ext.ext_en: The place was tranquil and appealing.

defs.def_en: Something that is tranquil is calm and peaceful.

ext.ext_cn: 大屠杀有可能触发新一轮的暴行吗？
ext.ext_en: Is the massacre likely to touch off a new round of violence?

defs.def_en: If something touches off a situation or series of events, it causes it to start happening.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的教育体制真差劲。
ext.ext_en: Their education system is useless...

ext.ext_cn: 任何球类运动他都玩不好。
ext.ext_en: He was useless at any game with a ball.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is useless, you mean that they are no good at all.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她整天坐在家里，看着电视，觉得自己一无是处。
ext.ext_en: She sits at home all day, watching TV and feeling useless.

defs.def_en: If someone feels useless, they feel bad because they are unable to help someone or achieve anything.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沉默寡言的;孤僻的;内向的

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫变得沉默寡言、喜怒无常。
ext.ext_en: Her husband had become withdrawn and moody.

defs.def_en: Someone who is withdrawn is very quiet, and does not want to talk to other people.

ext.ext_cn: 城里最精致的老餐馆之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the most elegant old eateries in town.

defs.def_en: An eatery is a place where you can buy and eat food.

defs.def_cn: (会议、委员会等的)女主席，女会长

ext.ext_cn: 普里马科夫在日本会见日本社会党女主席。
ext.ext_en: Primakov was in Japan meeting with the chairwoman of the Socialist Party there.

defs.def_en: The chairwoman of a meeting, committee, or organization is the woman in charge of it.

defs.def_cn: 跳莫里斯舞的人;莫里斯舞舞者;莫里斯舞表演者
defs.def_en: A morris dancer is a person who takes part in morris dancing.

defs.def_cn: 废除(教会或宗教)的国教制

ext.ext_cn: 废除该教会的国教制是正确的。
ext.ext_en: It would be right to disestablish the church.

defs.def_en: To disestablish a church or religion means to take away its official status, so that it is no longer recognized as a national institution.

ext.ext_cn: 使这项任务实现机械化的技术只能逐步发展。
ext.ext_en: Only gradually are technologies being developed to mechanize the task...

ext.ext_cn: 也许这种治疗方法最终将实现机械化。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps, in time, this treatment will be mechanised.

defs.def_en: If someone mechanizes a process, they cause it to be done by a machine or machines, when it was previously done by people.

ext.ext_cn: 英国亚洲航空公司，英国航空公司的子公司
ext.ext_en: ...British Asia Airways, a subsidiary of British Airways.

defs.def_en: A subsidiary or a subsidiary company is a company which is part of a larger and more important company.

ext.ext_cn: 经济部已经越来越成了财政部的附属了。
ext.ext_en: The economics ministry has increasingly played a subsidiary role to the finance ministry.

defs.def_en: If something is subsidiary, it is less important than something else with which it is connected.
A troglodyte is someone who lives in a cave.

defs.def_cn: 井底之蛙;见识短浅的人

ext.ext_cn: 他认为那些鼓吹完全自由市场经济的人对经济只是一知半解，完全没有顾及到可能产生的社会后果。
ext.ext_en: He dismissed advocates of a completely free market as economic troglodytes with no concern for the social consequences.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a troglodyte, you mean that they are unsophisticated and do not know very much about anything.

ext.ext_cn: 她目光呆滞，仿佛沉浸在那天的记忆当中。
ext.ext_en: Her eyes were unfocused, as if she were staring inside at her memories of the day.

ext.ext_cn: 他茫然的凝视
ext.ext_en: ...his unfocused gaze.

defs.def_en: If someone's eyes are unfocused, they are open, but not looking at anything.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （情绪、计划等）漫无目的的，不着边际的

ext.ext_cn: 而现在，她陷入了一种无名的愤怒之中。
ext.ext_en: But for now, she is in the grip of a blind, unfocused anger...

ext.ext_cn: 政府现在优柔寡断、毫无章法，这或许并不奇怪。
ext.ext_en: It is not perhaps surprising that the administration now appears so indecisive and unfocused.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's feelings or plans as unfocused, you are criticizing them because they do not seem to be clearly formed or have any clear purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 折叠椅
ext.ext_en: ...a collapsible chair.

defs.def_en: A collapsible object is designed to be folded flat when it is not being used.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在艺术和科学方面)多才多艺者，兴趣广泛者，通才
defs.def_en: If you describe a man as a Renaissance man, you mean that he has a wide range of abilities and interests, especially in the arts and sciences.

defs.def_cn: 放弃，交出，卖掉（贵重物品或舍不得的东西）

ext.ext_cn: 买方在付现之前可能要求提供进一步的担保。
ext.ext_en: Buyers might require further assurances before parting with their cash...

ext.ext_cn: 他卖掉了大部分藏品来付园艺费。
ext.ext_en: He parted with much of his collection to pay his gardening bills.

defs.def_en: If you part with something that is valuable or that you would prefer to keep, you give it or sell it to someone else.
A changing room is a room where you can change your clothes and usually have a shower, for example at a sports centre.

ext.ext_cn: 大学教师拒绝监考。
ext.ext_en: University teachers have refused to supervise students' examinations...

ext.ext_cn: 他指导和培训了 400 多名志愿者。
ext.ext_en: He supervised and trained more than 400 volunteers.

defs.def_en: If you supervise an activity or a person, you make sure that the activity is done correctly or that the person is doing a task or behaving correctly.

ext.ext_cn: 他酿酒并管理葡萄园。
ext.ext_en: He makes the wines and supervises the vineyards...

ext.ext_cn: 他的工作之一是管理餐厅。
ext.ext_en: One of his jobs was supervising the dining room.

defs.def_en: If you supervise a place where work is done, you ensure that the work there is done properly.
A ring-pull is a metal strip that you pull off the top of a can of drink in order to open it.
Levi's are jeans.
Toilet training is the process of teaching a child to use the toilet.
A sheepdog is a breed of dog. Some sheepdogs are used for controlling sheep.

ext.ext_cn: 观看体育比赛给他以极大的愉悦。
ext.ext_en: Watching sport gave him great pleasure...

ext.ext_cn: 每个人都从吃中得到满足感。
ext.ext_en: Everybody takes pleasure in eating...

defs.def_en: If something gives you pleasure, you get a feeling of happiness, satisfaction, or enjoyment from it.

defs.def_cn: （尤指工作、职责之外的）娱乐，消遣

ext.ext_cn: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。
ext.ext_en: He mixed business and pleasure in a perfect and dynamic way...

ext.ext_cn: 我读书消遣。
ext.ext_en: I read for pleasure.

defs.def_en: Pleasure is the activity of enjoying yourself, especially rather than working or doing what you have a duty to do.

defs.def_cn: 乐趣；乐事；给人愉快的事物

ext.ext_cn: 看电视是我们唯一的乐事。
ext.ext_en: Watching TV is our only pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 看到一张微笑的面孔的愉悦
ext.ext_en: ...the pleasure of seeing a smiling face.

defs.def_en: A pleasure is an activity, experience or aspect of something that you find very enjoyable or satisfying.

defs.def_cn: 很高兴见到…/…莅临的荣幸

ext.ext_cn: 他说：“先生，很高兴见到您。”
ext.ext_en: 'A pleasure to meet you, sir,' he said...

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯·斯蒂芬斯夫妇敬请您莅临小女卡罗琳·玛丽与戴维·史密斯先生的婚礼。
ext.ext_en: Mr and Mrs James Stephens request the pleasure of your company at the marriage of their daughter Caroline Mary to Mr David Smith.

defs.def_en: If you meet someone for the first time, you can say, as a way of being polite, that it is a pleasure to meet them. You can also ask for the pleasure of someone's company as a polite and formal way of inviting them somewhere.

defs.def_cn: （受到感谢时的一种礼貌回答）别客气，不用谢，是我的荣幸

ext.ext_cn: “无论怎样，非常感谢。”——“别客气。”
ext.ext_en: 'Thanks very much anyhow.' — 'It's a pleasure.'

ext.ext_cn: “谢谢你打来电话。”——“不用谢。”
ext.ext_en: 'Thanks for your call.' — 'My pleasure.'

defs.def_en: You can say 'It's a pleasure ' or 'My pleasure ' as a polite way of replying to someone who has just thanked you for doing something.

ext.ext_cn: “你能把广告影印一下寄给我们吗？”——“当然可以，约翰。”
ext.ext_en: 'Could you photocopy the advert and put it in the post to us?' — 'With pleasure John.'

defs.def_en: You can say 'With pleasure ' as a polite way of saying that you are very willing to do something.
If you have a stomach ache, you have a pain in your stomach.

defs.def_cn: 有强烈控制欲的人;喜欢控制一切的人
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a control freak, you mean that they want to be in control of every situation they find themselves in.
A weatherwoman is a woman who presents weather forecasts at regular times on television or radio.

ext.ext_cn: 古罗马人在织物和墙壁上使用天然颜料。
ext.ext_en: The Romans used natural pigments on their fabrics and walls.

ext.ext_cn: 皮肤内的褐色素
ext.ext_en: ...the brown pigment in the skin.

defs.def_en: A pigment is a substance that gives something a particular colour.
A trombone is a large musical instrument of the brass family. It consists of two long oval tubes, one of which can be pushed backwards and forwards to play different notes.

ext.ext_cn: 我往桌上一靠，桌子就摇晃了起来。
ext.ext_en: The table wobbled when I leaned on it...

ext.ext_cn: 就在这时，巴特摇摇晃晃地滑着轮滑回来了。
ext.ext_en: Just then, Bart returned, wobbling on his skates...

defs.def_en: If something or someone wobbles, they make small movements from side to side, for example because they are unsteady.

ext.ext_cn: 当一些队员的入选招致许多不解的非议时，教练开始动摇了。
ext.ext_en: The coach began to wobble when some of his team selections provoked much baffled comment.

ext.ext_cn: 哪怕稍有波动也会殃及其银行，各银行有大约1,200亿美元未偿房贷。
ext.ext_en: Even a small wobble will hurt its banks, which have roughly $120 billion in outstanding property loans.

defs.def_en: If a person or government wobbles, they suddenly appear less secure or less sure about something.
Someone's stepbrother is the son of their stepfather or stepmother.

ext.ext_cn: 学生们欢天喜欢地迎接他。
ext.ext_en: The students gave him a rapturous welcome...

ext.ext_cn: 在访问东帝汶期间，教皇约翰·保罗受到了热烈的欢迎。
ext.ext_en: Pope John Paul received a rapturous reception when he visited East Timor...

defs.def_en: A rapturous feeling or reaction is one of extreme happiness or enthusiasm.
If you describe a person or an animal as a weakling, you mean that they are physically weak.

ext.ext_cn: 道德感不强的人
ext.ext_en: ...a moral weakling.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a weakling, you mean that they have a weak character and are not at all brave.
Underlay is a layer of thick material that you place between a carpet and the floor to protect the carpet and make it feel warmer and softer.

defs.pos_cn: 与形容词，可数名词构成的词
defs.def_cn: （用以构成形容词和名词）表示“非洲的”

ext.ext_cn: 很有名望的非裔美国人家庭
ext.ext_en: ...very well known Afro-American family.

ext.ext_cn: 以非洲为中心的时装表演
ext.ext_en: ...an Afro-centric fashion show.

defs.def_en: Afro- is used to form adjectives and nouns that describe something that is connected with Africa.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as tubby, you mean that they are rather fat.
A hummingbird is a small brightly coloured bird found in America, especially Central and South America. It has a long thin beak and powerful narrow wings that can move very fast.
A salad bowl is a large bowl from which salad is served at a meal.

defs.def_cn: (网球，壁球运动的)正手击球，正拍

ext.ext_cn: 阿加西看到了机会，再次以一个闪电式的正手击球拿到了赛点。
ext.ext_en: Agassi saw his chance and, with another lightning forehand, reached match point.

defs.def_en: A forehand is a shot in tennis or squash in which the palm of your hand faces the direction in which you are hitting the ball.

ext.ext_cn: 我妈妈试图劝我不要离婚。
ext.ext_en: My mother tried to talk me out of getting a divorce...

ext.ext_cn: 大家都劝他放弃，可他却很坚持。
ext.ext_en: People tried to talk him out of it, but he insisted.

defs.def_en: If you talk someone out of doing something they want or intend to do, you persuade them not to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我费尽口舌想避免一场打架。
ext.ext_en: I tried to talk myself out of a fight.

defs.def_en: If you talk yourself out of a particular situation or state, you get yourself out of it by talking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 声誉好的;可信赖的;有名望的

ext.ext_cn: 强烈建议您通过值得信赖的经销商购车。
ext.ext_en: You are well advised to buy your car through a reputable dealer.

defs.def_en: A reputable company or person is reliable and can be trusted.

ext.ext_cn: 总统的密友
ext.ext_en: ...a close confidant of the president.

defs.def_en: Someone's confidant is a man who they are able to discuss their private problems with.

ext.ext_cn: 她的双眸是矢车菊一般的亮蓝色。
ext.ext_en: Her eyes were a bright, cornflower blue.

defs.def_en: Cornflowers are small plants with flowers that are usually blue.

defs.def_cn: （尤指作为娱乐或锻炼的）骑马
defs.def_en: Horseback riding is the activity of riding a horse, especially for enjoyment or as a form of exercise.

ext.ext_cn: 100毫升的血液
ext.ext_en: ...100 millilitres of blood.

defs.def_en: A millilitre is a unit of volume for liquids and gases that is equal to a thousandth of a litre.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 讳莫如深的;守口如瓶的

ext.ext_cn: 他对自己在这桩买卖中所得的报酬不愿多提。
ext.ext_en: He is cagey about what he was paid for the business.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is being cagey about something, you mean that you think they are deliberately not giving you much information or expressing an opinion about it.

ext.ext_cn: 地址是安娜的笔迹。
ext.ext_en: The address was in Anna's handwriting...

ext.ext_cn: 我不得不承认自己的字写得不好看。
ext.ext_en: I have to admit that I have bad handwriting.

defs.def_en: Your handwriting is your style of writing with a pen or pencil.

defs.def_cn: 撒旦(基督教中与上帝为敌的魔王)
defs.def_en: In the Christian religion, Satan is the Devil, a powerful evil being who is the chief opponent of God.

defs.def_cn: 罢免，废黜(统治者或政治领导人)

ext.ext_cn: 本·贝拉先生在1965年的一次政变中被推翻。
ext.ext_en: Mr Ben Bella was deposed in a coup in 1965...

ext.ext_cn: 1986年，菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯被赶下台后逃往了夏威夷。
ext.ext_en: Ferdinand Marcos fled to Hawaii in 1986 after being deposed as president of the Philippines.

defs.def_en: If a ruler or political leader is deposed, they are forced to give up their position.

defs.def_cn: (时间段)介于中间的,发生于其间的

ext.ext_cn: 在那中间的几年里,布里奇特嫁给了她的丈夫罗伯特。
ext.ext_en: During those intervening years Bridget had married her husband Robert...

ext.ext_cn: 我与格蕾琴在伦敦度过了那中间的一段时间。
ext.ext_en: I had spent the intervening time in London, with Gretchen.

defs.def_en: An intervening period of time is one that separates two events or points in time.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经仔细搜遍了其间绵延数英里的高沼地。
ext.ext_en: They had scoured the intervening miles of moorland.

defs.def_en: An intervening object or area comes between two other objects or areas.

ext.ext_cn: 她的公寓里摆满了小摆设。
ext.ext_en: Her flat is spilling over with knick-knacks.

defs.def_en: Knick-knacks are small objects which people keep as ornaments or toys, rather than for a particular use.

defs.def_cn: 失踪的人;下落不明的人

ext.ext_cn: 她已经追查到了200多名失踪人口，多数是警方已经不抱希望的案子。
ext.ext_en: She's tracked down over two hundred missing persons, in many cases after the police have given up.

defs.def_en: A missing person has suddenly left their home without telling their family where they are going, and it is not known whether they are alive or dead.

defs.def_cn: 阿谀奉承的人;谄媚者;马屁精

ext.ext_cn: 被一群不敢谏言的佞臣簇拥的独裁者
ext.ext_en: ...a dictator surrounded by sycophants, frightened to tell him what he may not like.

defs.def_en: A sycophant is a person who behaves in a sycophantic way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 警方本可指控他们恐吓。
ext.ext_en: The police could have charged them with threatening behaviour...

ext.ext_cn: 她说丹尼收到一封恐吓信，并问是不是我寄的。
ext.ext_en: She said Denny had received a threatening letter and asked me if I sent it.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone's behaviour as threatening when you think that they are trying to harm you.

ext.ext_cn: 吉尼维尔是从这里透过窗户看到了站在樵夫车上的骑士。
ext.ext_en: Here, from a window, did Guinevere espy a knight standing in a woodman's cart.

defs.def_en: If you espy something, you see or notice it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自我剥夺的;自我牺牲的;克己忘我的

ext.ext_cn: 他们认为好的父母应该牺牲自我，一心为孩子着想。
ext.ext_en: They believed that good parents should be self-sacrificing and self-denying...

ext.ext_cn: 他们属于更加克己的上一代人。
ext.ext_en: They belong to an older, more self-denying generation.

defs.def_en: Someone who is self-denying refuses to do or have things that they would like, either because they cannot afford them, or because they believe it is morally good for them not to do them or have them.

defs.def_cn: 不可避免;无法规避;必然发生

ext.ext_cn: 我们早晚都会有一死。
ext.ext_en: We are all bound by the inevitability of death...

ext.ext_cn: 胜利对我们来说是必然的。
ext.ext_en: Success is an inevitability for us.

defs.def_en: The inevitability of something is the fact that it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

ext.ext_cn: 她本可以要求她来取电脑时付钱。
ext.ext_en: She could have stipulated that she would pay when she collected the computer...

ext.ext_cn: 国际规则规定了外国参赛者的人数。
ext.ext_en: International rules stipulate the number of foreign entrants.

defs.def_en: If you stipulate a condition or stipulate that something must be done, you say clearly that it must be done.

ext.ext_cn: 美国军用越野车
ext.ext_en: ...a U.S. Army Jeep.

defs.def_en: A Jeep is a type of car that can travel over rough ground.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他生硬粗暴的态度让他声名狼藉。
ext.ext_en: His abrasive manner has won him an unenviable notoriety...

ext.ext_cn: 对于自己的激烈言辞和恶语相向，帕梅拉并无悔意。
ext.ext_en: Pamela was unrepentant about her strong language and abrasive remarks.

defs.def_en: Someone who has an abrasive manner is unkind and rude.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 粗糙可用于擦洗的;有研磨作用的

ext.ext_cn: 多用途的非磨砂性新型清洁剂
ext.ext_en: ...a new all-purpose, non-abrasive cleaner.

defs.def_en: An abrasive substance is rough and can be used to clean hard surfaces.

ext.ext_cn: 避免使用磨蚀剂，以免损坏瓷砖。
ext.ext_en: Avoid abrasives, which can damage the tiles.

defs.def_en: An abrasive is a substance that is rough and can be used to clean hard surfaces.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 运用智力的;理智的;冷静的

ext.ext_cn: 我的感觉是，在华盛顿出版这样一份理性的报纸不是太靠谱。
ext.ext_en: Washington struck me as a precarious place from which to publish such a cerebral newspaper.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as cerebral, you mean that they are intellectual rather than emotional.

ext.ext_cn: 脑溢血
ext.ext_en: ...a cerebral haemorrhage.

defs.def_en: Cerebral means relating to the brain.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得我有一个天大的发现。
ext.ext_en: I felt I'd made an incredible discovery.

ext.ext_cn: 查出他妻子和儿子艾滋病病毒检测都呈阳性
ext.ext_en: ...the discovery that both his wife and son are HIV positive.

defs.def_en: If someone makes a discovery, they become aware of something that they did not know about before.

ext.ext_cn: 那一年，有两个重大发现。
ext.ext_en: In that year, two momentous discoveries were made.

ext.ext_cn: 南极上空臭氧洞的发现
ext.ext_en: ...the discovery of the ozone hole over the South Pole...

defs.def_en: If someone makes a discovery, they are the first person to find or become aware of a place, substance, or scientific fact that no one knew about before.

defs.def_cn: (对不为人知的演员、音乐人等的)发现

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you say that something is of doubtful quality or value, you mean that it is of low quality or value.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: This is a fine book.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are fine, you mean that you are in good health or reasonably happy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人满意的;可以接受的

ext.ext_en: Everything was going to be just fine...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

ext.ext_en: If competition is the best way to achieve it, then, fine...

ext.ext_en: If you don't want to give it to me, that's fine, I don't mind...

defs.def_en: Something that is fine is very delicate, narrow, or small.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: She'll wear fine jewellery wherever she goes.

defs.def_en: Fine objects or clothing are of good quality, delicate, and expensive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The market likes the broad outline but is reserving judgment on the fine detail.

defs.def_en: A fine detail or distinction is very delicate, small, or exact.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我和高尚的人们一起干着一份不错的工作。
ext.ext_en: I was with fine people doing a good job...

ext.ext_cn: 他是位杰出的记者，为人也非常正派。
ext.ext_en: He was an excellent journalist and a very fine man.

defs.def_en: A fine person is someone you consider good, moral, and worth admiring.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He might be doing a spot of gardening if the weather is fine.

defs.def_en: When the weather is fine, the sun is shining and it is not raining.

ext.ext_en: She was fined £500 and banned from driving for one month...

ext.ext_en: An east London school has set a precedent by fining pupils who break the rules.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The atmosphere was quite convivial.

defs.def_en: Convivial people or occasions are pleasant, friendly, and relaxed.

ext.ext_en: I went to the editorial board meetings when I had the time.

defs.def_en: Editorial means involved in preparing a newspaper, magazine, or book for publication.

defs.def_cn: （报纸、杂志、电视节目等）立场（或观点等）的;社论（式）的

ext.ext_en: We are not about to change our editorial policy.

defs.def_en: Editorial means involving the attitudes, opinions, and contents of something such as a newspaper, magazine, or television programme.

ext.ext_en: In an editorial, The Independent suggests the victory could turn nasty.

defs.def_en: An editorial is an article in a newspaper which gives the opinion of the editor or owner on a topic or item of news.
An editorial on television or radio is an item which gives the opinion of the network or radio station.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Similar customs were known in widely divergent cultures such as Ancient Egypt and Scandinavia.

defs.def_en: Divergent things are different from each other.

ext.ext_en: The eggs hatched and the chicks matured.

defs.def_en: When a child or young animal matures, it becomes an adult.

ext.ext_en: When the trees matured they were cut in certain areas...

ext.ext_en: Their songwriting has matured.

ext.ext_en: Hopefully after three years at university I will have matured...

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: You and I are mature, freethinking adults.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as mature, you think that they are fully developed and balanced in their personality and emotional behaviour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you describe the work of an artist, writer, or musician as mature, you mean that it is thoughtful and skilful and shows that their abilities have fully developed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: They are politically very aware.

defs.def_en: Someone who is aware notices what is happening around them or happening in the place where they live.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you describe something as characterful, you mean that it is pleasant and interesting.

ext.ext_en: ...the mindless repetitiveness of some tasks.

defs.def_en: If you describe an activity as mindless, you mean that it is so dull that people do it or take part in it without thinking.
