ext.ext_cn: 两个紧张不安的青少年抢了一家咖啡馆？
ext.ext_en: ...two nervous teenagers knocking off a cafe?

defs.def_en: To knock off a house, factory, or shop means to break into it and steal money or property.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我写完这篇报告，我就会早点下班。
ext.ext_en: If I get this report finished I'll knock off early...

ext.ext_cn: 你什么时间下班？
ext.ext_en: What time do you knock off?

defs.def_en: When you knock off, you finish work at the end of the day or before a break.

ext.ext_cn: 他有很多杀伊冯娜的动机。
ext.ext_en: He had many motives for wanting to knock off Yvonne...

ext.ext_cn: 如果不是为了冒险赚大钱，人们不会像这样彼此残杀。
ext.ext_en: People don't just knock one another off like this unless there's big money at stake.

defs.def_en: If someone knocks someone else off, they kill them.

ext.ext_cn: 这团凝固的污物堵塞了过滤器。
ext.ext_en: This congealed muck was interfering with the filter.

defs.def_en: Muck is dirt or some other unpleasant substance.

ext.ext_cn: 他能闻到粪臭和清新的干草味。
ext.ext_en: He could smell muck and clean fresh hay.

defs.def_en: Muck is animal faeces.

defs.def_cn: 无用的东西;质量低劣的东西

ext.ext_cn: 他已有好几天没吃东西了，可我只能给他这种垃圾一样的东西，你奇怪吗？
ext.ext_en: He hasn't eaten anything for days. And are you surprised, when this muck is all I have to give him?...

ext.ext_cn: 这个剧本是十足的平庸之作，难以想象有人会写出这样的垃圾。
ext.ext_en: The script is utterly banal. It is incredible that human minds can put such muck on to paper.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as muck, you are emphasizing that you think it is of very bad quality.

ext.ext_cn: 我过去常试图打我丈夫，向他扔东西。
ext.ext_en: I used to hit out at my husband and throw things at him...

ext.ext_cn: 我一生中从未打过人，但我却动手打青了他的一只眼睛。
ext.ext_en: I had never punched anybody in my life but I hit out and gave him a black eye.

defs.def_en: If you hit out at someone, you try to hit them, although you may miss them.

ext.ext_cn: 总统借机猛烈抨击了被自己视为外国干涉的行为。
ext.ext_en: The President took the opportunity to hit out at what he sees as foreign interference...

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚巴西足球队主帅卡洛斯·佩雷拉因球队被禁止在温布利球场训练而大发雷霆。
ext.ext_en: Brazilian soccer boss Carlos Parreira hit out angrily last night after his side were barred from training at Wembley.

defs.def_en: If you hit out at someone or something, you criticize them strongly because you do not agree with them.
A bucketful of something is the amount contained in a bucket.

ext.ext_cn: 这些年他们卖出了大量的唱片。
ext.ext_en: Over the years they have sold records by the bucketful.

defs.def_en: If someone produces or gets something by the bucketful, they produce or get something in large quantities.

ext.ext_cn: 当地时间约为晚上10点15分，本土时间则是早上3点15分。
ext.ext_en: It was around 10.15 pm local time, 3.15 am at home.

defs.def_en: Local time is the official time in a particular region or country.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可信赖的;值得信赖的；可靠的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个头脑冷静、值得信赖的领导。
ext.ext_en: He is a trustworthy and level-headed leader.

defs.def_en: A trustworthy person is reliable, responsible, and can be trusted completely.

defs.def_cn: 未编入册的；不公开列出的
defs.def_en: If a person or their telephone number is unlisted, the number is not listed in the telephone book, and the telephone company will refuse to give it to people who ask for it.

defs.def_cn: （公司）未上市的；（股票）场外交易的

ext.ext_cn: 那家公司的股票在场外证券市场交易。
ext.ext_en: Its shares are traded on the Unlisted Securities Market.

defs.def_en: An unlisted company or unlisted stock is not listed officially on a stock exchange.

defs.def_cn: （动词）通格的（即同一个名词既可作其宾语又可作其主语）
defs.def_en: An ergative verb is a verb that can be both transitive and intransitive, where the subject of the intransitive verb is the same as the object of the transitive verb. For example, 'open' is an ergative verb because you can say 'The door opened' or 'She opened the door'.

defs.def_cn: 宣誓书；（经陈述者宣誓在法庭上可作为证据采纳的）书面陈述
defs.def_en: An affidavit is a written statement which you swear is true and which may be used as evidence in a court of law.
An axis is an imaginary line through the middle of something.
An axis of a graph is one of the two lines on which the scales of measurement are marked.

defs.def_cn: 最神圣的地方；常人去不了的场所

ext.ext_cn: 寺院里最神圣的地方
ext.ext_en: ...the holy of holies in the Temple.

ext.ext_cn: 奥尔德堡音乐节，当代英国乐坛最神圣的聚会
ext.ext_en: ...the Aldeburgh Festival, the holy of holies in the contemporary British music scene.

defs.def_en: A holy of holies is a place that is so sacred that only particular people are allowed to enter; often used in informal English to refer humorously to a place where only a few special people can go.

defs.def_cn: 毛拉(对伊斯兰教教师或领袖的尊称)
defs.def_en: A mullah is a Muslim who is a religious teacher or leader.
Surfing is the sport of riding on the top of a wave while standing or lying on a special board.

ext.ext_cn: 事情很简单，那就是对大多数人来说，网上冲浪费用太高。
ext.ext_en: The simple fact is that, for most people, surfing is too expensive.

defs.def_en: Surfing is the activity of looking at different sites on the Internet, especially when you are not looking for anything in particular.

ext.ext_cn: 减税政策必然导致公共支出的削减。
ext.ext_en: Policies of tax reduction must lead to reduced public expenditure...

ext.ext_cn: 他们应该缩减国防开支。
ext.ext_en: They should cut their expenditure on defence...

defs.def_en: Expenditure is the spending of money on something, or the money that is spent on something.

ext.ext_cn: 经济上的回报证明付出的努力是值得的。
ext.ext_en: The financial rewards justified the expenditure of effort.

defs.def_en: Expenditure of something such as time or energy is the using of that thing for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 让国王变成纯粹发挥典礼仪式上象征作用的元首会不会更好？
ext.ext_en: Might it not be better to relegate the King to a purely ceremonial function?...

ext.ext_cn: 其他的报纸把这条消息降格报道，放到了中间版面。
ext.ext_en: Other newspapers relegated the item to the middle pages.

defs.def_en: If you relegate someone or something to a less important position, you give them this position.

ext.ext_cn: 如果利失球，他们将会降级。
ext.ext_en: If Leigh lose, they'll be relegated.

ext.ext_cn: 即将被降到乙级的球队。
ext.ext_en: ...a team about to be relegated to the second division.

defs.def_en: If a sports team that competes in a league is relegated, it has to compete in a lower division in the next competition, because it was one of the least successful teams in the higher division.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 满怀敬意的;恭敬的;虔诚的

ext.ext_cn: “那是老护林人的花园，”她用充满敬意的语气说。
ext.ext_en: 'That's the old foresters' garden,' she said in reverential tones.

defs.def_en: Something that is reverential has the qualities of respect and admiration.

ext.ext_cn: 可否私下跟您谈谈，牧师。
ext.ext_en: Could I speak to you in private a moment, padre.

defs.def_en: A padre is a Christian priest, especially one who works with the armed forces.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她很外向，喜欢交朋结友。
ext.ext_en: She is such a gregarious and outgoing person.

defs.def_en: Someone who is gregarious enjoys being with other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 雪雁是群居性鸟类。
ext.ext_en: Snow geese are very gregarious birds.

defs.def_en: Gregarious animals or birds normally live in large groups.
A husk is the outer covering of a grain or a seed.
Acetone is a type of solvent.

ext.ext_cn: 他右眼视力有损伤。
ext.ext_en: He has a visual impairment in the right eye.

defs.def_en: If someone has an impairment, they have a condition which prevents their eyes, ears, or brain from working properly.

defs.def_cn: 关于（用于商业信函、传真或其他文件中）

ext.ext_cn: 亲爱的考克斯夫人，关于房屋保险一事，我们的文件显示尚未收到您的续保通知。
ext.ext_en: Dear Mrs Cox, Re: Household Insurance. We note from our files that we have not yet received your renewal instructions.

defs.def_en: You use re in business letters, faxes, or other documents to introduce a subject or item which you are going to discuss or refer to in detail.

defs.def_cn: (动画片或电影中拥有特异功能并惩恶扬善的)超级英雄

ext.ext_cn: 像蝙蝠侠和超人那样的超级英雄
ext.ext_en: ...superheroes like Batman and Superman.

defs.def_en: A superhero is a character in a cartoon or film who has special powers and fights against evil.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Worse is the comparative of bad .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Worse is the comparative of badly .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (用于构成以 bad 和 badly 开头的复合形容词的比较级，如 badly off 的比较级是 worse off )
defs.def_en: Worse is used to form the comparative of compound adjectives beginning with 'bad' and 'badly.' For example, the comparative of 'badly off' is 'worse off'.

ext.ext_cn: 过去几年来，我的生活每况愈下。
ext.ext_en: For the past couple of years my life has gone from bad to worse.

defs.def_en: If a situation goes from bad to worse, it becomes even more unpleasant or unsatisfactory.

defs.def_cn: 不妨(做某事);(做某事)不失明智之举

ext.ext_cn: 寻求富有挑战性的事业的科学家不妨考虑一下法医学。
ext.ext_en: Scientists in search of a challenging career could do worse than consider forensic science.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone that they could do worse than do a particular thing, you are advising them that it would be quite a good thing to do.

defs.def_cn: 向着更坏(或更糟的)情况(转变)

ext.ext_cn: 爷爷奶奶叹着气说情况变得如何如何糟糕。
ext.ext_en: The grandparents sigh and say how things have changed for the worse.

defs.def_en: If a situation changes for the worse, it becomes more unpleasant or more difficult.

defs.def_cn: 受到/未受到…的伤害(或不良影响)

ext.ext_cn: 父亲从酒吧回到家里，乱撒酒疯。
ext.ext_en: Father came home from the pub very much the worse for drink...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的身体状况显然都很好，15个小时的行程没有给他们带来不适。
ext.ext_en: They are all apparently fit and well and none the worse for the fifteen hour journey.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is the worse for something, they have been harmed or badly affected by it. If they are none the worse for it, they have not been harmed or badly affected by it.

defs.def_cn: 挥金如土的人;（尤指）豪赌者
defs.def_en: High rollers are people who are very rich and who spend money in an extravagant or risky way, especially by gambling.

defs.def_cn: 衰退地区，铁锈地带（指美国等已陷入经济困境的老工业区）

ext.ext_cn: 中西部的铁锈地带
ext.ext_en: ...in the rust belt of the midwest.

defs.def_en: In the United States and some other countries, the Rust Belt is a region which used to have a lot of manufacturing industry, but whose economy is now in difficulty.

ext.ext_cn: 一时间房间里充满了窃窃私语声。
ext.ext_en: A sibilant murmuring briefly pervaded the room.

defs.def_en: Sibilant sounds are soft 's' sounds.
In ancient times, chariots were fast-moving vehicles with two wheels that were pulled by horses.

ext.ext_cn: 林肯公园的广告插图出自比尔·霍夫斯塔特之手。
ext.ext_en: The artwork for the LP was done by Bill Hofstadter.

defs.def_en: Artwork is drawings and photographs that are prepared in order to be included in something such as a book or advertisement.

ext.ext_cn: 博物馆收藏了6,000件近现代艺术作品。
ext.ext_en: The museum contains 6,000 contemporary and modern artworks.

ext.ext_cn: 令人叹为观止的价值连城的艺术收藏品
ext.ext_en: ...a magnificent collection of priceless artwork.

defs.def_en: Artworks are paintings or sculptures which are of high quality.

ext.ext_cn: 回程航班被延误了。
ext.ext_en: The return flight of the aircraft was delayed...

ext.ext_cn: 至少3架军用飞机被毁。
ext.ext_en: At least three military aircraft were destroyed.

defs.def_en: An aircraft is a vehicle which can fly, for example an aeroplane or a helicopter.

ext.ext_cn: 她颧骨高高的，非常漂亮。
ext.ext_en: She was very beautiful, with high cheekbones.

defs.def_en: Your cheekbones are the two bones in your face just below your eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 里基一直揽着她的腰。
ext.ext_en: Ricky kept his arm round her waist...

ext.ext_cn: 他上身赤裸。
ext.ext_en: He was stripped to the waist.

defs.def_en: Your waist is the middle part of your body where it narrows slightly above your hips.
The waist of a garment such as a dress, coat, or pair of trousers is the part of it which covers the middle part of your body.

ext.ext_cn: 我14岁。
ext.ext_en: I'm fourteen years old.

defs.def_en: Fourteen is the number 14.
A hot-water bottle is a rubber container that you fill with hot water and put in a bed to make it warm.

ext.ext_cn: 除非确实需要用到支票簿和信用卡，否则别带在身上。
ext.ext_en: Leave your cheque book and credit cards at home unless you know you will need them.

defs.def_en: A cheque book is a book of cheques which your bank gives you so that you can pay for things by cheque.

ext.ext_cn: 她像小鸟一样四处飞奔
ext.ext_en: ...the birdlike way she darted about.

defs.def_en: If someone has a birdlike manner, they move or look like a bird.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 活泼的;活跃的;充满活力的

ext.ext_cn: 她是个非常不错的女孩，活泼而开朗。
ext.ext_en: She's a terrific, sparky girl...

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦时装周将是一场活力四射的盛会。
ext.ext_en: London Fashion Week will be a sparky affair.

defs.def_en: Sparky people or events are lively and entertaining.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他被说成冷酷的恶棍。
ext.ext_en: He was branded an unfeeling bully...

ext.ext_cn: 谁都不能指责这个女人冷血无情。
ext.ext_en: There's no way anyone could accuse this woman of being cold and unfeeling...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as unfeeling, you are criticizing them for their lack of kindness or sympathy for other people.

ext.ext_cn: 我们需要减轻导致经济困顿的税收负荷。
ext.ext_en: We need to reduce the burden of taxes that impoverish the economy.

ext.ext_cn: 因战时通货膨胀导致贫困的社会
ext.ext_en: ...a society impoverished by wartime inflation.

defs.def_en: Something that impoverishes a person or a country makes them poor.

ext.ext_cn: 使土壤迅速贫瘠的植物
ext.ext_en: ...plants that impoverish the soil quickly.

defs.def_en: A person or thing that impoverishes something makes it worse in quality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 闷闷不乐的；忧郁的；愁闷的

ext.ext_cn: 她郁郁寡欢，显然在惦念自己的孩子们。
ext.ext_en: She was very glum and was obviously missing her children.

defs.def_en: Someone who is glum is sad and quiet because they are disappointed or unhappy about something.

ext.ext_cn: 离开马埃15分钟后，我们降落在一个临时草地机场上。
ext.ext_en: We landed on a grass airstrip, fifteen minutes after leaving Mahe.

defs.def_en: An airstrip is a stretch of land which has been cleared so that aircraft can take off and land.

ext.ext_cn: 帝国战争博物馆里的档案
ext.ext_en: ...the archives of the Imperial War Museum...

ext.ext_cn: 我决定第二天去档案馆查找对应的问题。
ext.ext_en: I decided I would go to the Archive the next day and look up the appropriate issue.

defs.def_en: The archive or archives are a collection of documents and records that contain historical information. You can also use archives to refer to the place where archives are stored.

ext.ext_cn: 档案资料
ext.ext_en: ...archive material.

ext.ext_cn: 影像资料的片段
ext.ext_en: ...pieces of archive film.

defs.def_en: Archive material is information that comes from archives.

defs.def_cn: (价格)极高的，昂贵的;(信心)高昂的，十足的

ext.ext_cn: 克丽丝蒂说：“我现在信心十足。”
ext.ext_en: Christie said: 'My confidence is sky high.'

ext.ext_cn: 房价下跌和利率暴涨产生的影响
ext.ext_en: ...the effect of falling house prices and sky-high interest rates.

defs.def_en: If you say that prices or confidence are sky-high, you are emphasizing that they are at a very high level.

defs.def_cn: （尤指德国的）裸麦粗面包，黑面包
defs.def_en: Pumpernickel is a dark brown, heavy bread, which is eaten especially in Germany.

ext.ext_cn: 她抽了抽鼻子并用手背擦了擦。
ext.ext_en: She snuffled and wiped her nose on the back of her hand.

defs.def_en: If a person or an animal snuffles, they breathe in noisily through their nose, for example because they have a cold.

ext.ext_cn: 军队发动暴乱之后国家陷入混乱中。
ext.ext_en: The nation is in disarray following rioting led by the military...

ext.ext_cn: 仅一天中就有1.2万人越过边境，这使得撤退计划全被打乱了。
ext.ext_en: 12,000 crossed the border in one day alone, throwing evacuation plans into disarray...

defs.def_en: If people or things are in disarray, they are disorganized and confused.

ext.ext_cn: 发现她时她侧躺着，且衣衫不整。
ext.ext_en: She was left lying on her side and her clothes were in disarray...

ext.ext_cn: 他发现屋里凌乱不堪，地上丢弃着食物，抽屉大开。
ext.ext_en: He found the room in disarray, with food dumped on the floor and drawers pulled open.

defs.def_en: If things or places are in disarray, they are in a very untidy state.

defs.def_cn: 肉毒杆菌中毒（一种严重的食物中毒）
defs.def_en: Botulism is a serious form of food poisoning.

ext.ext_cn: 辩护律师希望区法官不受理那个案子。
ext.ext_en: The defense wants the district Judge to throw out the case.

defs.def_en: If a judge throws out a case, he or she rejects it and the accused person does not have to stand trial.

ext.ext_cn: 他在药检呈阳性后被奥林匹克运动队除名。
ext.ext_en: He was thrown out of the Olympic team after testing positive for drugs...

ext.ext_cn: 我本想杀了他，不过我只是把他撵出了门。
ext.ext_en: I wanted to kill him, but instead I just threw him out of the house...

defs.def_en: If you throw someone out, you force them to leave a place or group.

ext.ext_cn: 消息赢得了相当普遍的欢呼。
ext.ext_en: The news was greeted with considerable popular acclamation.

defs.def_en: Acclamation is a noisy or enthusiastic expression of approval for someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 起初看起来我会以口头表决的方式获胜。
ext.ext_en: At first it looked like I was going to win by acclamation.

defs.def_en: If someone is chosen or elected by acclamation, they are elected without a written vote.

defs.def_cn: 重新占领;重新夺回;收复

ext.ext_cn: 他们说尸体是在叛军重新占领这个地区时发现的。
ext.ext_en: They said the bodies were found when rebels recaptured the area.

ext.ext_cn: 为了重新夺回该城而即将展开的进攻
ext.ext_en: ...an offensive to be launched for the recapture of the city.

defs.def_en: When soldiers recapture an area of land or a place, they gain control of it again from an opposing army who had taken it from them.

defs.def_cn: （从竞争对手手中）重新夺回，重新拿回

ext.ext_cn: 我相信在即将来临的选举中，他最有可能重新争取到中间派的选票。
ext.ext_en: I believe that he would be the best possibility to recapture the centre vote in the forthcoming election.

defs.def_en: When people recapture something that they have lost to a competitor, they get it back again.

ext.ext_cn: 警察把艾伦·洛德抓了回来，他是从博尔顿的一个警察局拘留室逃走的。
ext.ext_en: Police have recaptured Alan Lord, who escaped from a police cell in Bolton.

ext.ext_cn: 在巴拿马将变节的警察局局长重新抓获
ext.ext_en: ...the recapture of a renegade police chief in Panama.

defs.def_en: To recapture a person or animal which has escaped from somewhere means to catch them again.

ext.ext_cn: 他没能找回闯进半决赛时表现出来的状态。
ext.ext_en: He couldn't recapture the form he'd shown in getting to the semi-final...

ext.ext_cn: 这些饼干似乎重新唤回了我们记忆中童年时代的那种口感和味道。
ext.ext_en: These cookies seem to recapture all the textures and flavors we remember from childhood.

defs.def_en: When you recapture something such as an experience, emotion, or a quality that you had in the past, you experience it again. When something recaptures an experience for you, it makes you remember it.

defs.def_cn: 暂时的;临时的;过渡期间的

ext.ext_cn: 她3月份宣誓就任过渡政府首脑。
ext.ext_en: She was sworn in as head of an interim government in March.

ext.ext_cn: 临时报告
ext.ext_en: ...an interim report.

defs.def_en: Interim is used to describe something that is intended to be used until something permanent is done or established.

ext.ext_cn: 但是,在过渡期间,我们显然有责任维护治安。
ext.ext_en: But, in the interim, we obviously have a duty to maintain law and order...

ext.ext_cn: 他在此期间将会继续被关押。
ext.ext_en: He was to remain in jail in the interim.

defs.def_en: In the interim means until a particular thing happens or until a particular thing happened.

ext.ext_cn: 不管怎样他们很可能会干掉你！
ext.ext_en: They will probably bump you off anyway!

ext.ext_cn: 他雇来杀害妻子的职业杀手
ext.ext_en: ...the hit man he's hired to bump off his wife.

defs.def_en: To bump someone off means to kill them.

ext.ext_cn: 7月份的平均周薪增长了1.5%。
ext.ext_en: Average weekly earnings rose by 1.5% in July...

ext.ext_cn: 他对自己会计师的收入很满意。
ext.ext_en: He was satisfied with his earnings as an accountant.

defs.def_en: Your earnings are the sums of money that you earn by working.

ext.ext_cn: 她猛地拉开了抽屉。
ext.ext_en: She yanked open the drawer...

ext.ext_cn: 她使劲儿把那个孩子拽回了房子里。
ext.ext_en: She yanked the child back into the house...

defs.def_en: If you yank someone or something somewhere, you pull them there suddenly and with a lot of force.

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司欠下60多家银行的债。
ext.ext_en: The company owes money to more than 60 banks...

ext.ext_cn: 布莱克已经欠他将近50英镑了。
ext.ext_en: Blake already owed him nearly £50...

defs.def_en: If you owe money to someone, they have lent it to you and you have not yet paid it back. You can also say that the money is owing .

defs.def_cn: 应把…归因（于）；应把…归功（于）

ext.ext_cn: 我一直怀疑她仗着自己是罗杰的朋友才得到第一份工作。
ext.ext_en: I always suspected she owed her first job to her friendship with Roger...

ext.ext_cn: 他是因为水性好才幸免于难的。
ext.ext_en: He owed his survival to his strength as a swimmer...

defs.def_en: If someone or something owes a particular quality or their success to a person or thing, they only have it because of that person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名职业作曲家，我十分感激第三电台。
ext.ext_en: As a professional composer I owe much to Radio 3...

ext.ext_cn: 他真是个大好人，我欠他太多了。
ext.ext_en: He's been fantastic. I owe him a lot.

defs.def_en: If you say that you owe a great deal to someone or something, you mean that they have helped you or influenced you a lot, and you feel very grateful to them.

ext.ext_cn: 该岛当前的经济发展主要归功于蒸馏法酿造威士忌酒行业。
ext.ext_en: The island's present economy owes a good deal to whisky distilling...

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦太太的烹饪风格很大程度上承传于她的婆婆。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Allen's style of cooking owes much to her mother-in-law.

defs.def_en: If you say that something owes a great deal to a person or thing, you mean that it exists, is successful, or has its particular form mainly because of them.

defs.def_cn: 应该给予（某人感激、尊重、忠诚等）

ext.ext_cn: 也许我们应该给予这些人更多的尊重。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps we owe these people more respect...

ext.ext_cn: 我应该向你道歉。你一定觉得我的态度很恶劣吧。
ext.ext_en: I owe you an apology. You must have found my attitude very annoying...

defs.def_en: If you say that you owe someone gratitude, respect, or loyalty, you mean that they deserve it from you.

defs.def_cn: 应该为（某人做）；有必要为（某人做）

ext.ext_cn: 我不能走。看在他的分上我也该留下来。
ext.ext_en: I can't go. I owe it to him to stay...

ext.ext_cn: 你应该为了自己寻求专业人士的帮助。
ext.ext_en: You owe it to yourself to get some professional help...

defs.def_en: If you say that you owe it to someone to do something, you mean that you should do that thing because they deserve it.

ext.ext_cn: 他因为受伤而失业了。
ext.ext_en: He was out of work owing to a physical injury...

ext.ext_cn: 由于缺人手，这趟火车上没有餐车。
ext.ext_en: Owing to staff shortages, there was no restaurant car on the train.

defs.def_en: You use owing to when you are introducing the reason for something.

ext.ext_cn: 股票在震荡中进一步下跌，直到股价达到某个新的平衡点。
ext.ext_en: Stocks seesawed ever lower until prices found some new level of equilibrium...

ext.ext_cn: 经济要达到平衡，收支必须均衡。
ext.ext_en: For the economy to be in equilibrium, income must equal expenditure.

defs.def_en: Equilibrium is a balance between several different influences or aspects of a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我在大厅里停了一下，深吸了三口气以恢复平静。
ext.ext_en: I paused in the hall to take three deep breaths to restore my equilibrium...

ext.ext_cn: 不知怎的，他已经恢复了平静，连心情也变好了。
ext.ext_en: He had recovered his equilibrium and even his good humour, somehow.

defs.def_en: Someone's equilibrium is their normal calm state of mind.

ext.ext_cn: 他发现自己的哥哥住在一套破旧肮脏、蟑螂肆虐的公寓里。
ext.ext_en: He found his brother in a seedy, roach-infested apartment.

defs.def_en: A roach is the same as a cockroach .
A roach is a fish that lives in European rivers and lakes.

ext.ext_cn: 这个大厅一次只能容下一半的出席者。
ext.ext_en: Only one-half of the attendees could fit into the large hall at any one time.

defs.def_en: The attendees at something such as a meeting or a conference are the people who are attending it.

defs.def_cn: (突然而强烈的)激动，狂喜，恐惧

ext.ext_cn: 我还记得自己不知道圣诞节早晨会得到什么礼物时内心有多么激动。
ext.ext_en: I can remember the thrill of not knowing what I would get on Christmas morning...

ext.ext_cn: 对我这样的板球爱好者来说，能够在板球的故乡比赛是一件令人无比兴奋的事。
ext.ext_en: It's a great thrill for a cricket-lover like me to play at the home of cricket.

defs.def_en: If something gives you a thrill, it gives you a sudden feeling of great excitement, pleasure, or fear.

ext.ext_cn: 极度紧张的气氛让他既害怕又兴奋。
ext.ext_en: The electric atmosphere both terrified and thrilled him...

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们看到所有那些他们最喜爱的人物形象会兴奋不已。
ext.ext_en: The children will thrill at all their favourite characters.

defs.def_en: If something thrills you, or if you thrill at it, it gives you a feeling of great pleasure and excitement.

ext.ext_cn: 它的主要观众的年龄集中在 17 岁到 24 岁之间，而这些人喜欢极速的惊险刺激。
ext.ext_en: Its prime audience lies in the 17 to 24 age group, and they want instant thrills and spills.

defs.def_en: If you refer to thrills and spills, you are referring to an experience which is exciting and full of surprises.

defs.def_cn: (使)浸没;(使)淹没;(使)潜入水中;(使)没入水中

ext.ext_cn: 在仅剩的几个水坑里，河马根本无法没入水中。
ext.ext_en: Hippos are unable to submerge in the few remaining water holes...

ext.ext_cn: 河水决堤，淹没了整个村庄。
ext.ext_en: The river burst its banks, submerging an entire village.

defs.def_en: If something submerges or if you submerge it, it goes below the surface of some water or another liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 他沉浸在自己想象的世界中。
ext.ext_en: He submerges himself in the world of his imagination.

defs.def_en: If you submerge yourself in an activity, you give all your attention to it and do not think about anything else.

defs.def_cn: (用打字机或文字处理器)把…完全打出来

ext.ext_cn: 当两个打字员重新打出文件全文的时候，我们俩就站在旁边。
ext.ext_en: The two of us stood by while two typists typed out the whole document again...

ext.ext_cn: 我在电话里把它从头到尾地读给一个叫戴夫的人，他则把它全部打出来。
ext.ext_en: I read it down the phone to a man called Dave, who typed it out.

defs.def_en: If you type something out, you write it in full using a typewriter or word processor.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她无礼的瞪视
ext.ext_en: ...her insolent stare...

ext.ext_cn: 军官跺跺靴子：“小姐,别对我无礼。”
ext.ext_en: The officer stamped his boot. 'Don't be insolent with me, mademoiselle.'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is being insolent, you mean they are being rude to someone they ought to be respectful to.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一路南行，乡间开始变得起伏不平，绵延的山峦一直延伸到河岸。
ext.ext_en: As we travel south, the countryside begins to undulate as the rolling hills sweep down to the riverbanks...

ext.ext_cn: 他的身体随着音乐的节拍慢慢摆动。
ext.ext_en: His body slowly undulated in time to the music.

defs.def_en: Something that undulates has gentle curves or slopes, or moves gently and slowly up and down or from side to side in an attractive manner.

ext.ext_cn: 话题一离开自己就目光呆滞的电影演员
ext.ext_en: ...movie actors whose eyes glaze over as soon as the subject wavers from themselves.

defs.def_en: If your eyes glaze over, they become dull and lose all expression, usually because you are bored or are thinking about something else.

ext.ext_cn: 这门课程适合初学者和高级程度的学生。
ext.ext_en: The course is suitable for beginners and advanced students...

ext.ext_cn: 在养鸟方面，我完全是一个新手。
ext.ext_en: I am a complete beginner to bird-keeping.

defs.def_en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and cannot do it very well yet.

ext.ext_cn: 对于那些反对该方案的人，他表现得很不耐烦。
ext.ext_en: He is impatient with those who decry the scheme...

ext.ext_cn: 人们谴责这一活动是浪费金钱。
ext.ext_en: People decried the campaign as a waste of money.

defs.def_en: If someone decries an idea or action, they criticize it strongly.
The Nazis were members of the right-wing political party, led by Adolf Hitler, which held power in Germany from 1933 to 1945.

ext.ext_cn: 纳粹党的兴起
ext.ext_en: ...the rise of the Nazi Party.

ext.ext_cn: 纳粹对海峡群岛的占领
ext.ext_en: ...the Nazi occupation of the Channel Islands.

defs.def_en: You use Nazi to say that something relates to the Nazis.

ext.ext_cn: 游客晒着日光浴在海水里嬉戏。
ext.ext_en: Tourists sunbathe and frolic in the ocean.

ext.ext_cn: 在田野里嬉闹的小羊
ext.ext_en: ...lambs frolicking in the fields.

defs.def_en: When people or animals frolic, they play or move in a lively, happy way.

defs.def_cn: 生活之乐；对生活的享受

ext.ext_cn: 他尽情享受生活的乐趣。
ext.ext_en: He has plenty of joie de vivre.

defs.def_en: Joie de vivre is a feeling of happiness and enjoyment of life.

defs.def_cn: (人或事物)密排的，密集的，排紧的

ext.ext_cn: 排得密密匝匝的几排法律书籍和判例汇编
ext.ext_en: ...serried rows of law books and law reports.

ext.ext_cn: 一排排人挤人的崇拜者
ext.ext_en: ...the serried ranks of fans.

defs.def_en: Serried things or people are closely crowded together in rows.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们的日常饮食包括一块不新鲜的面包、一碗米饭和变味的水。
ext.ext_en: Their daily diet consisted of a lump of stale bread, a bowl of rice and stale water.

defs.def_en: Stale food is no longer fresh or good to eat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一层烟雾低悬在污浊的空气中。
ext.ext_en: A layer of smoke hung low in the stale air.

ext.ext_cn: 汗臭味
ext.ext_en: ...the smell of stale sweat.

defs.def_en: Stale air or a stale smells is unpleasant because it is no longer fresh.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我崇尚进取、冒险和永不倦怠。
ext.ext_en: I believe in progression, in taking risks, in never getting stale.

defs.def_en: If you feel stale, you are bored because you have no new ideas or enthusiasm for what you are doing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (地方、活动或观点)令人厌倦的，缺乏新鲜感的

ext.ext_cn: 她和马克之间已经没有新鲜感了。
ext.ext_en: Her relationship with Mark has become stale...

ext.ext_cn: 他说政府仍在抱残守缺。
ext.ext_en: The Government, he said, were sticking to stale ideas.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place, an activity, or an idea is stale, you mean that it has become boring because it is always the same.

ext.ext_cn: 该书的核心部分对毒品的使用作了历史概述。
ext.ext_en: The central section of the book is a historical overview of drug use.

defs.def_en: An overview of a situation is a general understanding or description of it as a whole.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于制作装饰品和乐器的）黄铜

ext.ext_cn: 这个仪器是用黄铜制成的，非常漂亮。
ext.ext_en: The instrument is beautifully made in brass.

defs.def_en: Brass is a yellow-coloured metal made from copper and zinc. It is used especially for making ornaments and musical instruments.

defs.def_cn: （交响乐队的）铜管乐乐器组，铜管乐器

ext.ext_cn: 他再次举起指挥棒，让铜管乐部加入进来。
ext.ext_en: He once again raised his baton and brought in the brass.

defs.def_en: The brass is the section of an orchestra which consists of brass wind instruments such as trumpets and horns.
See also:brass rubbing;Brasses are flat pieces of brass with writing or a picture cut into them, which are often found in churches.

defs.def_cn: （军队或其他机构的）高级军官，高层人物

ext.ext_cn: 高级军官不愿意与大兵们称兄道弟。
ext.ext_en: The brass are reluctant to fraternise with the enlisted men.

defs.def_en: In the army or in other organizations, the brass are the people in the highest positions.

defs.def_cn: 讨论基本事实；探讨实质问题

ext.ext_cn: 安哥拉执政党预定在今天就有关该党执政记录的问题进行实质性讨论。
ext.ext_en: Angola's ruling party was due to get down to brass tacks today with a debate on the party's record.

defs.def_en: If you get down to brass tacks, you discuss the basic, most important facts of a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 医生正在帐篷里借着火把的光做手术。
ext.ext_en: Surgeons are performing operations in tents by torchlight...

ext.ext_cn: 游行者排成了火炬长龙。
ext.ext_en: The marchers held a torchlight procession.

defs.def_en: If you do something by torchlight, you do it using the light that is produced by a torch or torches.

defs.def_cn: (困难或打击)同时发生，相继发生;祸不单行

ext.ext_cn: 对于公共部门的工作人员而言可谓祸不单行。
ext.ext_en: This is a double whammy for public sector workers...

ext.ext_cn: 我们目前正遭受到了接二连三的打击。
ext.ext_en: We're suffering a triple whammy at the moment.

defs.def_en: Whammy is used in expressions such as double whammy and triple whammy to indicate that two or three unpleasant or difficult situations occur at the same time, or occur one after the other.

defs.def_cn: 每天（发生）的;平常的;普通的

ext.ext_cn: 在我的日常生活中，我很少和青少年打交道。
ext.ext_en: In the course of my everyday life, I had very little contact with teenagers.

ext.ext_cn: 在日常生活中改善健康的机会
ext.ext_en: ...opportunities for improving fitness in your everyday routine.

defs.def_en: You use everyday to describe something which happens or is used every day, or forms a regular and basic part of your life, so it is not especially interesting or unusual.

ext.ext_cn: 到20岁时，他就会认识华盛顿所有值得认识的人。
ext.ext_en: By the time he's twenty he'll know everyone worth knowing in Washington.

defs.def_en: He'll is the usual spoken form of 'he will'.

ext.ext_cn: 越来越多的餐厅开始辟出无烟区。
ext.ext_en: More and more restaurants are providing non-smoking areas.

defs.def_en: A non-smoking area in a public place is an area in which people are not allowed to smoke.

ext.ext_cn: 吸烟女士的生育能力是不吸烟女士的一半。
ext.ext_en: The fertility of women who smoke is half that of non-smoking women.

defs.def_en: A non-smoking person is a person who does not smoke.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 缺乏自信的;对自己无把握的

ext.ext_cn: 实质上她是在惩罚父母,因为他们让她感觉受到威胁,没有安全感。
ext.ext_en: In effect she is punishing her parents for making her feel threatened and insecure...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数母亲对自己为人母的表现都不是很自信。
ext.ext_en: Most mothers are insecure about their performance as mothers.

defs.def_en: If you are insecure, you lack confidence because you think that you are not good enough or are not loved.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不安全的;无保障的;有危险的

ext.ext_cn: 报酬低、无保障的工作
ext.ext_en: ...low-paid, insecure jobs...

ext.ext_cn: 手机天生就不安全,因为任何人都可以听到并录下谈话。
ext.ext_en: Cellular phones are inherently insecure, as anyone can listen to and record conversations.

defs.def_en: Something that is insecure is not safe or protected.

ext.ext_cn: 野营地一般都位于海滨，靠近沙滩。
ext.ext_en: Camp sites are usually situated along the coast, close to beaches.

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰西海岸
ext.ext_en: ...the west coast of Scotland.

defs.def_en: The coast is an area of land that is next to the sea.

defs.def_cn: (车辆熄火后或不用动力)靠惯性滑行

ext.ext_cn: 我熄掉引擎，靠惯性转过弯去。
ext.ext_en: I switched off the engine and coasted round the corner.

ext.ext_cn: 他们加大油门，再切入空挡，随后没大响动地滑下山坡。
ext.ext_en: They picked up momentum, then slipped into neutral and coasted quietly down the slope.

defs.def_en: If a vehicle coasts somewhere, it continues to move there with the motor switched off, or without being pushed or pedalled.

defs.def_cn: 毫不费力地做;(尤指)轻松获胜

ext.ext_cn: 伊万·伦德尔以6:3，6:2和6:3的比分轻松战胜了罗杰·拉希德。
ext.ext_en: Ivan Lendl coasted to a 6-3, 6-2, 6-3 victory over Roger Rasheed...

ext.ext_cn: 公司凭借早期产品的巨大成功而在市场上遥遥领先。
ext.ext_en: The company was coasting on the enormous success of its early products.

defs.def_en: If a person or a team is coasting, they are doing something easily, especially winning a competition.

ext.ext_cn: 有一段时间查尔斯在学校不太用功，我当时应该让他加把劲的。
ext.ext_en: There was a time when Charles was coasting at school and I should have told him to buckle down.

ext.ext_cn: 马修没什么雄心大志，就凭着自己的长相混饭吃。
ext.ext_en: Matthew had no drive. He coasted along on his good looks.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is coasting, you are emphasizing that they are not putting enough effort into what they are doing.

defs.def_cn: 没有被发现(或捉住)的危险;危险已过

ext.ext_cn: “你现在可以出来了。”他喊道，“没危险了，她已经走了。”
ext.ext_en: 'You can come out now,' he called. 'The coast is clear. She's gone.'

defs.def_en: If you say that the coast is clear, you mean that there is nobody around to see you or catch you.

defs.def_cn: （尤指经历或观点相同的）一代人，同代人，同辈人

ext.ext_cn: 年轻一代的党员
ext.ext_en: ...the younger generation of Party members...

ext.ext_cn: 长期以来，戴维·马梅特一直被视为同代人中最杰出的美国剧作家。
ext.ext_en: David Mamet has long been considered the leading American playwright of his generation.

defs.def_en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

defs.def_cn: 代，一代，一辈（通常认为大约是30年）

ext.ext_cn: 就在不到一代人的时间里，坐飞机已经成了很多旅行者的出行方式。
ext.ext_en: Within a generation flight has become the method used by many travellers.

defs.def_en: A generation is the period of time, usually considered to be about thirty years, that it takes for children to grow up and become adults and have children of their own.

defs.def_cn: （机械设备的设计和制造的）代

ext.ext_cn: 新一代的IBM/苹果电脑
ext.ext_en: ...a new generation of IBM/Apple computers.

defs.def_en: You can use generation to refer to a stage of development in the design and manufacture of machines or equipment.

defs.def_cn: （表示家庭成员拥有某国国籍的时间长短情况）第…代的

ext.ext_cn: 英国的第二代亚洲移民
ext.ext_en: ...second generation Asians in Britain...

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 大片的烟云
ext.ext_en: ...an immense cloud of smoke...

ext.ext_cn: 我长长地松了一口气，停止了奔跑。
ext.ext_en: With immense relief I stopped running.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as immense, you mean that it is extremely large or great.

defs.def_cn: (通常指儿童骑的)三轮脚踏车
defs.def_en: A tricycle is a cycle with three wheels, two at the back and one at the front. Tricycles are usually ridden by children.

defs.def_cn: （表示无趣或不重要）…啊之类的；等等；诸如此类的

ext.ext_cn: 他们的职业面临的各种不同的挑战，需要求变，需要发展，等等
ext.ext_en: ...the different challenges of their career, their need to change, to evolve, blah blah blah.

defs.def_en: You use blah, blah, blah to refer to something that is said or written without giving the actual words, because you think that they are boring or unimportant.

defs.def_cn: 擅自进入，非法侵入(他人土地)

ext.ext_cn: 他们擅自闯入私人房屋。
ext.ext_en: They were trespassing on private property...

ext.ext_cn: 你这是非法侵入！
ext.ext_en: You're trespassing!

defs.def_en: If someone trespasses, they go onto someone else's land without their permission.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正采取行动以阻止国家干涉诸如性教育之类的家庭问题。
ext.ext_en: They were acting to prevent the state from trespassing on family matters such as sex education.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is trespassing on something, you mean that they are involving themselves in something that is not their concern.

defs.def_cn: 供应者；提供者；供应公司

ext.ext_cn: 美味佳肴的提供者
ext.ext_en: ...purveyors of gourmet foods.

defs.def_en: A purveyor of goods or services is a person or company that provides them.

ext.ext_cn: 他举手挥动起来。
ext.ext_en: He raised his hand to wave...

ext.ext_cn: 她走到窗前，拉起了百叶窗。
ext.ext_en: She went to the window and raised the blinds...

defs.def_en: If you raise something, you move it so that it is in a higher position.

ext.ext_cn: 他们举白旗投降了。
ext.ext_en: They had raised the white flag in surrender...

ext.ext_cn: 半夜时，德国国旗将在德国国会大厦升起。
ext.ext_en: At midnight, the German flag will be raised over the Reichstag.

defs.def_en: If you raise a flag, you display it by moving it up a pole or into a high place where it can be seen.

ext.ext_cn: 他坐了起来。
ext.ext_en: He raised himself into a sitting position...

ext.ext_cn: 她用一只胳膊肘撑起身体。
ext.ext_en: She raised herself on one elbow.

defs.def_en: If you raise yourself, you lift your body so that you are standing up straight, or so that you are no longer lying flat.

ext.ext_cn: 爱尔兰共和国预计会提高利率。
ext.ext_en: The Republic of Ireland is expected to raise interest rates...

ext.ext_cn: 最近发生的两起事件引发了更多人的关注。
ext.ext_en: Two incidents in recent days have raised the level of concern.

defs.def_en: If you raise the rate or level of something, you increase it.

ext.ext_cn: 提高英国学校文化水平的新运动
ext.ext_en: ...a new drive to raise standards of literacy in Britain's schools.

defs.def_en: To raise the standard of something means to improve it.

ext.ext_cn: 别冲我叫嚷，亨利·罗林斯！
ext.ext_en: Don't you raise your voice to me, Henry Rollins!...

ext.ext_cn: 为了让人能听得见，安妮提高了嗓门。
ext.ext_en: Anne raised her voice in order to be heard.

defs.def_en: If you raise your voice, you speak more loudly, usually because you are angry.

ext.ext_cn: 不到两个月，凯利就获得了加薪。
ext.ext_en: Within two months Kelly got a raise.

defs.def_en: A raise is an increase in your wages or salary.

defs.def_cn: （为慈善组织、机构等）募捐，筹（款）

ext.ext_cn: 为“帮助老年人”活动而发起的募捐活动
ext.ext_en: ...events held to raise money for Help the Aged...

ext.ext_cn: 所有募集到的资金都将用于“白血病患儿”组织。
ext.ext_en: All funds raised will be used by Children With Leukaemia.

defs.def_en: If you raise money for a charity or an institution, you ask people for money which you collect on its behalf.

ext.ext_cn: 他们筹钱来购买房屋及200英亩的土地。
ext.ext_en: They raised the money to buy the house and two hundred acres of grounds.

defs.def_en: If a person or company raises money that they need, they manage to get it, for example by selling their property or by borrowing.

ext.ext_cn: 那项协议使人们感到战争有望很快结束。
ext.ext_en: The agreement has raised hopes that the war may end soon...

ext.ext_cn: 这起事故再一次引发了人们对于工厂安全性的质疑。
ext.ext_en: The accident again raises questions about the safety of the plant.

defs.def_en: If an event raises a particular emotion or question, it makes people feel the emotion or consider the question.

ext.ext_cn: 会议上，阿什拉维夫人提出了巴勒斯坦人最为关注的三个问题。
ext.ext_en: In the meeting Mrs. Ashrawi raised the three main concerns that the Palestinians had...

ext.ext_cn: 事先征求了他的意见，他并没有提出异议。
ext.ext_en: He had been consulted and had raised no objections.

defs.def_en: If you raise a subject, an objection, or a question, you mention it or bring it to someone's attention.

ext.ext_cn: 我的母亲是位了不起的女性。她几乎是一个人把我们4个孩子带大的。
ext.ext_en: My mother was an amazing woman. She raised four of us kids virtually singlehandedly.

ext.ext_cn: 她在其间长大的那幢房子
ext.ext_en: ...the house where she was raised.

defs.def_en: Someone who raises a child looks after it until it is grown up.

ext.ext_cn: 他种植了2,000英亩的小麦和牧草。
ext.ext_en: He raises 2,000 acres of wheat and hay.

ext.ext_cn: 精心烹制的农场养的鸡
ext.ext_en: ...a perfectly cooked farm-raised chicken.

defs.def_en: If someone raises a particular type of animal or crop, they breed that type of animal or grow that type of crop.

ext.ext_cn: 超市的商品常常比品牌货便宜。
ext.ext_en: Supermarket lines are often cheaper than branded goods.

defs.def_en: A branded product is one which is made by a well-known manufacturer and has the manufacturer's  label on it.
French doors are the same as French windows.

ext.ext_cn: 带有大喇叭的上发条的留声机
ext.ext_en: ...a wind-up gramophone with a big horn.

ext.ext_cn: 留声机唱片
ext.ext_en: ...gramophone records.

defs.def_en: A gramophone is an old-fashioned type of record player.

ext.ext_cn: 后来,他承认确实付过款了。
ext.ext_en: Later, he admitted that the payments had indeed been made...

ext.ext_cn: 他确实把重要文件放在了他的帽子里。
ext.ext_en: He did indeed keep important documents inside his hat...

defs.def_en: You use indeed to confirm or agree with something that has just been said.

defs.def_cn: (表示语气的递进)实际上,其实,确切说来

ext.ext_cn: 我们一点都不抵触多样化;实际上,我们需要多样性更丰富一些。
ext.ext_en: We have nothing against diversity; indeed, we want more of it...

ext.ext_cn: 当我们要求进一步参观时却被拒绝了。实际上，我们是被一些带枪的人护送离开的。
ext.ext_en: When we asked to see more we were refused. Indeed we were escorted away by men with guns.

defs.def_en: You use indeed to introduce a further comment or statement which strengthens the point you have already made.

defs.def_cn: (位于句末修饰very或强调某词)确实,实在

ext.ext_cn: 发动机开始发出极大的声响。
ext.ext_en: The engine began to sound very loud indeed...

ext.ext_cn: 红酒确实非常好。
ext.ext_en: The wine was very good indeed...

defs.def_en: You use indeed at the end of a clause to give extra force to the word 'very', or to emphasize a particular word.

defs.def_cn: (重复问题以作强调,尤用于答案未知时)到底,究竟

ext.ext_cn: “那么那些真正的恶棍在哪里？”——“是啊，到底在哪里？”
ext.ext_en: 'Now where are the real villains?' — 'Where indeed?'...

ext.ext_cn: “我们在这里做什么呢?”——“是啊，到底做什么?”
ext.ext_en: 'And what do we do here?' — 'What, indeed?'

defs.def_en: You can use indeed as a way of repeating a question in order to emphasize it, especially when you do not know the answer.

ext.ext_cn: 她的雪纺裙在晚风中飘动着。
ext.ext_en: Her chiffon skirt was fluttering in the night breeze.

ext.ext_cn: 挥动着翅膀的蝴蝶
ext.ext_en: ...a butterfly fluttering its wings.

defs.def_en: If something thin or light flutters, or if you flutter it, it moves up and down or from side to side with a lot of quick, light movements.

defs.def_cn: (小鸟)振翅飞翔;(纸片)飘飞，翩翩飞舞

ext.ext_cn: 纸飘落到地板上。
ext.ext_en: The paper fluttered to the floor...

ext.ext_cn: 鸟儿们很活跃，在树林中呼呼地飞来飞去。
ext.ext_en: The birds were active, whirring and fluttering among the trees.

defs.def_en: If something light such as a small bird or a piece of paper flutters somewhere, it moves through the air with small quick movements.

ext.ext_cn: 我在5匹马身上下了小赌注。
ext.ext_en: I had a flutter on five horses.

defs.def_en: If you have a flutter, you have a small bet on something such as a horse race.

ext.ext_cn: 她一直在厨房里忙前忙后。
ext.ext_en: She'd been fluttering about in the kitchen.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone flutters somewhere, you mean that they walk there with quick, light movements, often in a silly way or in a way which suggests that they are nervous.

ext.ext_cn: 他的眼神让我心里扑通扑通直跳。
ext.ext_en: The look in his eyes made my heart flutter.

defs.def_en: If your heart or stomach flutters, you experience a strong feeling of excitement or anxiety.

ext.ext_cn: 她穿着前一天买的那套衣服。
ext.ext_en: She was wearing an outfit she'd bought the previous day...

ext.ext_cn: 我花大笔钱购置了上班时穿的漂亮新套装。
ext.ext_en: I spent lots of money on smart new outfits for work.

defs.def_en: An outfit is a set of clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 他在一家私人保安公司工作。
ext.ext_en: He works for a private security outfit...

ext.ext_cn: 我们是一家专业机构，对所提供服务确实要收取费用。
ext.ext_en: We are a professional outfit and we do require payment for our services.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an organization as an outfit .

ext.ext_cn: 他们为他安了假腿。
ext.ext_en: They outfitted him with artificial legs...

ext.ext_cn: 我把阁楼卧室改装成了工作室。
ext.ext_en: I outfitted an attic bedroom as a studio.

defs.def_en: To outfit someone or something means to provide them with equipment for a particular purpose.

defs.def_cn: 拉皮条的男子；为妓女拉客的男子
defs.def_en: A pimp is a man who gets clients for prostitutes and takes a large part of the money the prostitutes earn.

ext.ext_cn: 他通过偷窃、撒谎、欺诈和拉皮条使自己摆脱了贫困。
ext.ext_en: He stole, lied, deceived and pimped his way out of poverty.

defs.def_en: Someone who pimps gets clients for prostitutes and takes a large part of the money the prostitutes earn.
In Britain, a general election is an election where everyone votes for people to represent them in Parliament.
In the United States, a general election is a local, state, or national election where the candidates have been selected by a primary election.

ext.ext_cn: 电视上不断出现的裸体画面和脏话
ext.ext_en: ...constant nudity and bad language on TV.

defs.def_en: Nudity is the state of wearing no clothes.

defs.def_cn: 缓慢沉痛地;费力地;沉重地

ext.ext_cn: “我甚至没有想过她，”他沉重地说道。
ext.ext_en: 'I didn't even think about her,' he said heavily.

defs.def_en: See also:heavy;If someone says something heavily, they say it in a slow way which shows a feeling such as sadness, tiredness, or annoyance.

ext.ext_cn: 她真诚地希望弥补从前的过失。
ext.ext_en: She was sincere and genuine in her wish to make amends for the past...

ext.ext_cn: 她显然无意谈话。
ext.ext_en: Clearly she had no wish for conversation...

defs.def_en: See also:death wish;A wish is a desire or strong feeling that you want to have something or do something.

ext.ext_cn: 如果您想外出度周末，我们办事处将很乐意为您预订旅馆。
ext.ext_en: If you wish to go away for the weekend, our office will be delighted to make hotel reservations...

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在着装可以随心所欲。
ext.ext_en: We can dress as we wish now...

defs.def_en: If you wish to do something or to have it done for you, you want to do it or have it done.

defs.def_cn: (用于要说的话可能使人不快或担心等时)不想，无意

ext.ext_cn: 我不想让自己的话听上去麻木不仁，但我真的很庆幸我当时没在这儿。
ext.ext_en: I don't wish to sound callous, but I am glad I wasn't here...

ext.ext_cn: 我不想那么刻薄，不过她并不是非常有情趣的伴侣。
ext.ext_en: Without wishing to be unkind, she's not the most interesting company.

defs.def_en: Wish is used in expressions such as I don't wish to be rude or without wishing to be rude as a way of apologizing or warning someone when you are going to say something which might upset, annoy, or worry them.

defs.def_cn: 希望(不可能或可能性很小的事发生)

ext.ext_cn: 我希望我能做那件事。
ext.ext_en: I wish I could do that...

ext.ext_cn: 但愿这不是真的。
ext.ext_en: I wish it weren't true...

defs.def_en: If you wish something were true, you would like it to be true, even though you know that it is impossible or unlikely.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都曾祈求能找到更加体贴的男人。
ext.ext_en: We have all wished for men who are more considerate...

ext.ext_cn: 一位哲学家曾说过：“别轻易许愿——你可能会如愿以偿。”
ext.ext_en: A philosopher once said, 'Be careful what you wish for; you might get it.'

defs.def_en: If you wish for something, you express the desire for that thing silently to yourself. In fairy stories, when a person wishes for something, the thing they wish for often happens by magic.

defs.def_cn: 这是再好不过的;没有比这更好的了

ext.ext_cn: 这个老师对我来说是再好不过的了。
ext.ext_en: I really could not have wished for a better teacher...

ext.ext_cn: 谁还会企求能得到比这更好的机会呢？
ext.ext_en: Who could wish for a better opportunity?

defs.def_en: Wish is used in sentences such as I could not wish for anything better to indicate that you are very pleased with what you have and could not imagine anything better.

ext.ext_cn: 这种经历太痛苦了，我甚至都不希望它发生在死对头身上。
ext.ext_en: It's a horrid experience and I wouldn't wish it on my worst enemy.

defs.def_en: If you say that you would not wish a particular thing on someone, you mean that the thing is so unpleasant that you would not want them to be forced to experience it.

ext.ext_cn: 我祝愿你们两人旅途愉快。
ext.ext_en: I wish you both a very good journey...

ext.ext_cn: 再见，哈努，祝你顺心如意。
ext.ext_en: Goodbye, Hanu. I wish you well.

defs.def_en: If you wish someone something such as luck or happiness, you express the hope that they will be lucky or happy.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得乔治的经历很悲惨，请向他转达我最诚挚的祝福。
ext.ext_en: I found George's story very sad. Please give him my best wishes...

ext.ext_cn: 西方领导人向新任美国总统致以良好的祝愿。
ext.ext_en: Western leaders sent good wishes to the new American president.

defs.def_en: If you express your good wishes towards someone, you are politely expressing your friendly feelings towards them and your hope that they will be successful or happy.

ext.ext_cn: 他停了下来，在小溪边饮水止渴。
ext.ext_en: He stopped to quench his thirst at a stream.

defs.def_en: If someone who is thirsty quenches their thirst, they lose their thirst by having a drink.

ext.ext_cn: 持枪歹徒朝警察的巡逻车开火，两名警察被打死。
ext.ext_en: Two policemen were killed when gunmen opened fire on their patrol vehicle.

defs.def_en: A gunman is a man who uses a gun to commit a crime such as murder or robbery.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们收听收音机上的儿童节目，珍妮能跟着唱所有的曲子。
ext.ext_en: We listen to children's shows on the radio, and Janey can sing along with all the tunes...

ext.ext_cn: 你可以跟着一起唱你最喜爱的“猫王”的热门歌曲。
ext.ext_en: You can sing along to your favourite Elvis hits.

defs.def_en: singalong;If you sing along with a piece of music, you sing it while you are listening to someone else perform it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她指责他们泄露其私生活的秘密。
ext.ext_en: She accused them of leaking confidential information about her private life...

ext.ext_cn: 莱恩先生，我们会非常小心，对您告诉我们的事严格保密。
ext.ext_en: We'll take good care and keep what you've told us strictly confidential, Mr. Lane.

defs.def_en: Information that is confidential is meant to be kept secret or private.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: “听着，”他悄声说，“我想让你知道我和乔伊是警察。”
ext.ext_en: 'Look,' he said in a confidential tone, 'I want you to know that me and Joey are cops.'...

ext.ext_cn: 他脸上的神情突然严肃起来，声音也压低了。
ext.ext_en: His face suddenly turned solemn, his voice confidential.

defs.def_en: If you talk to someone in a confidential way, you talk to them quietly because what you are saying is secret or private.

defs.def_cn: 举世无双的人(或物);天下无敌的人(或物)
defs.def_en: If you describe a person or thing as a world beater, you mean that they are better than most other people or things of their kind.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的仪器检测到一个3千赫的微弱无线电波。
ext.ext_en: Their instruments detected very faint radiowaves at a frequency of 3 kilohertz.

defs.def_en: A kilohertz is a unit of measurement of radio waves. One kilohertz is a thousand hertz.

defs.def_cn: （尤指非洲的）禁猎区，野生动物保护区
defs.def_en: A game reserve is a large area of land, especially in Africa, where wild animals can live safely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她头脑聪明。
ext.ext_en: She had a brilliant mind...

ext.ext_cn: 他在《我的左脚》中的精彩表演使他一举成名。
ext.ext_en: It was his brilliant performance in 'My Left Foot' that established his reputation.

defs.def_en: A brilliant person, idea, or performance is extremely clever or skilful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 非常好的；很棒的；出色的

ext.ext_cn: 如果你有机会去看那个演出，你一定要去——棒极了！
ext.ext_en: If you get a chance to see the show, do go — it's brilliant...

ext.ext_cn: 我的姐姐给了我这本非常好看的书。
ext.ext_en: My sister's  given me this brilliant book.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is brilliant when you are very pleased about it or think that it is very good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他坐了4年牢，出狱后发现自己的辉煌事业已不复存在。
ext.ext_en: He served four years in prison, emerging to find his brilliant career in ruins...

ext.ext_cn: 这次偷袭非常成功。
ext.ext_en: The raid was a brilliant success.

defs.def_en: A brilliant career or success is very successful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个女子有双明亮的碧眼。
ext.ext_en: The woman had brilliant green eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 一件雪白的开领衬衣
ext.ext_en: ...a brilliant white open-necked shirt.

defs.def_en: A brilliant colour is extremely bright.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （光线等）明亮的，夺目的，灿烂的

ext.ext_cn: 这一活动是在阳光明媚的日子举办的。
ext.ext_en: The event was held in brilliant sunshine...

ext.ext_cn: 它比太阳亮2.5亿倍。
ext.ext_en: It was 250 million times more brilliant than the Sun.

defs.def_en: You describe light, or something that reflects light, as brilliant when it shines very brightly.

ext.ext_cn: 请登录我们的网站www.cobuild.collins.co.uk查看。
ext.ext_en: Check out our website at www.cobuild.collins.co.uk.

defs.def_en: WWW is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'World Wide Web'. It appears at the beginning of website addresses in the form www .

defs.def_cn: 非官方的；未经正式批准的；非正式的

ext.ext_cn: 职工投票决定继续进行非正式罢工，以支持上周被解雇的7名同事。
ext.ext_en: Staff voted to continue an unofficial strike in support of seven colleagues who were dismissed last week...

ext.ext_cn: 官方报道说死亡人数在100人以下，但非官方估计至少有200人死亡。
ext.ext_en: Official reports put the death toll at under one hundred, but unofficial estimates speak of at least two hundred dead.

defs.def_en: An unofficial action or statement is not organized or approved by a person or group in authority.

ext.ext_cn: 脂油布丁
ext.ext_en: ...suet pudding.

defs.def_en: Suet is hard animal fat that is used in cooking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她通常沉着而老练。
ext.ext_en: She is usually a calm and diplomatic woman...

ext.ext_cn: 镇静点,告诉我出了什么事。
ext.ext_en: Try to keep calm and just tell me what happened...

ext.ext_en: Gino clawed his way out of underworld obscurity to become a millionaire hotelier.

defs.def_en: If someone claws their way to a successful position, they achieve it with great determination in spite of many difficulties.

defs.def_cn: 影响别人的言行；（尤指）尖刻的言行，令人不愉快的言行

ext.ext_cn: 她不该再死死地缠着汤姆，应该让他继续自己的生活。
ext.ext_en: She should take her claws out of Tom and let him get on with his life.

defs.def_en: If someone gets their claws into another person, they start doing or saying things, especially unpleasant things, which affect that person.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 漫不经心的;心不在焉的;健忘的

ext.ext_cn: 他晚年变得愈加健忘了。
ext.ext_en: In his later life he became even more absent-minded.

defs.def_en: Someone who is absent-minded forgets things or does not pay attention to what they are doing, often because they are thinking about something else.

ext.ext_cn: 人生观的这种转变是否反映了日常生活中的真实遭遇？
ext.ext_en: Does such an attitudinal change reflect real experiences in daily life?

defs.def_en: Attitudinal means related to people's attitudes and the way they look at their life.

ext.ext_cn: 他19岁就加入了英国广播公司。
ext.ext_en: He joined the Beeb at 19.

defs.def_en: The BBC is sometimes called the Beeb .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一些人以低息贷款的形式得到了有力的职业援助。
ext.ext_en: Some received substantial occupational assistance in the form of low-interest loans.

defs.def_en: Occupational means relating to a person's job or profession.

defs.def_cn: 被禁锢的;被困住的;被拘禁的

ext.ext_cn: 他和其他10名犯人被囚禁在一间狭窄的牢房里。
ext.ext_en: He is cooped up in a cramped cell with 10 other inmates...

ext.ext_cn: 总是足不出户对她没有好处。
ext.ext_en: It isn't good for her to be cooped up all the time.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is cooped up, you mean that they live or are kept in a place which is too small, or which does not allow them much freedom.

defs.def_cn: （与名词连用构成形容词）表示“像…的”，“有…特征的”

ext.ext_cn: 类似矮牵牛花的美丽的紫红色花朵
ext.ext_en: ...beautiful purple-red petunia-like flowers.

ext.ext_cn: 像蠕虫一样的微小生物
ext.ext_en: ...a tiny worm-like creature.

defs.def_en: -like combines with nouns to form adjectives which describe something as being similar to the thing referred to by the noun.

defs.def_cn: 读数，数据显示（如速度、高度或分贝）

ext.ext_cn: 这个系统提供车辆速度的电子读数。
ext.ext_en: The system provides a digital readout of the vehicle's speed...

ext.ext_cn: 能见度为.019。
ext.ext_en: The visibility readout is .019.

defs.def_en: If an electronic measuring device gives you a readout, it displays information about the level of something such as a speed, height, or sound.

ext.ext_cn: 那座火山在1980年喷发，摧毁了华盛顿州大片地区。
ext.ext_en: The volcano erupted in 1980, devastating a large area of Washington state...

ext.ext_cn: 科学家说皮纳图博山近期可能会再次喷发。
ext.ext_en: Scientists say Mount Pinatubo could erupt again soon.

defs.def_en: When a volcano erupts, it throws out a lot of hot, melted rock called lava, as well as ash and steam.

defs.def_cn: （冲突、战斗等）突然发生，爆发，突然加剧

ext.ext_cn: 在停火两天后，今天那里爆发了激烈的战斗。
ext.ext_en: Heavy fighting erupted there today after a two-day ceasefire...

ext.ext_cn: 两辆警车将男孩们带走时突然发生了暴力冲突。
ext.ext_en: Violence erupted as the boys were driven away in two police vans.

defs.def_en: If violence or fighting erupts, it suddenly begins or gets worse in an unexpected, violent way.

defs.def_cn: （某地）爆发动乱;（人群）突然暴怒，发生骚乱

ext.ext_cn: 在洛杉矶，一个叫做沃茨的街区爆发了动乱。
ext.ext_en: In Los Angeles, the neighborhood known as Watts erupted into riots...

ext.ext_cn: 已经相对平静的这个地区今年春天再次爆发暴力事件。
ext.ext_en: This region which had been relatively calm erupted in violence again this spring.

defs.def_en: When people in a place suddenly become angry or violent, you can say that they erupt or that the place erupts .

defs.def_cn: （感情）迸发，突然转变;（常指）变得狂躁

ext.ext_cn: 然后在没有任何征兆的情况下，她突然大笑起来。
ext.ext_en: Then, without warning, she erupts into laughter...

ext.ext_cn: 被戴绿帽的丈夫勃然大怒，纽曼吓得光着脚逃走了。
ext.ext_en: Newman fled barefoot as the cheated husband erupted in fury.

defs.def_en: You say that someone erupts when they suddenly have a change in mood, usually becoming quite noisy.

ext.ext_cn: 第二周周末，我的皮肤上突然出现了丘疹。
ext.ext_en: At the end of the second week, my skin erupted in pimples.

defs.def_en: If your skin erupts, sores or spots suddenly appear there.

ext.ext_cn: 我把自行车锁在了吉日旅馆的前院。
ext.ext_en: I locked the bike in the forecourt of the Kirey Hotel...

ext.ext_cn: 一辆巡逻警车停在加油站的停车区。
ext.ext_en: A police patrol car was parked in the forecourt of the petrol station.

defs.def_en: The forecourt of a large building or petrol station is the open area at the front of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不名一文的;身无分文的

ext.ext_cn: 我一个子儿也没有了，借我们 10 英镑吧。
ext.ext_en: I'm skint! Lend us a tenner.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are skint, you mean that you have no money.
A picture window is a window containing one large sheet of glass, so that people have a good view of what is outside.

ext.ext_cn: “我当时正在在找萨莉”，他脱口而出，眼里噙满了泪水。
ext.ext_en: 'I was looking for Sally', he blurted, and his eyes filled with tears.

defs.def_en: If someone blurts something, they say it suddenly, after trying hard to keep quiet or to keep it secret.

ext.ext_cn: 有个地方出了点小错。
ext.ext_en: There's been a slip-up somewhere...

ext.ext_cn: 这些女孩犯下了 3 个重大的错误。
ext.ext_en: The girls had made three crucial slip-ups.

defs.def_en: A slip-up is a small or unimportant mistake.

defs.def_cn: 宝贝儿（对所爱之人的昵称）

ext.ext_cn: 对不起，宝贝儿。我不是有意的。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry, babe. I didn't  mean it.

defs.def_en: Some people use babe as an affectionate way of addressing someone they love.

defs.def_cn: 宝贝儿（对漂亮的年轻女性的称呼，可能具冒犯意味）
defs.def_en: Some men refer to an attractive young woman as a babe. This use could cause offence.

ext.ext_cn: 新生儿
ext.ext_en: ...newborn babes.

defs.def_en: A babe is the same as a baby.

defs.def_cn: 口头的;非书面的;非行动的

ext.ext_cn: 他们被推来搡去，受到大肆的谩骂攻击。
ext.ext_en: They were jostled and subjected to a torrent of verbal abuse...

ext.ext_cn: 我们和她有个口头约定。
ext.ext_en: We have a verbal agreement with her...

defs.def_en: You use verbal to indicate that something is expressed in speech rather than in writing or action.

defs.def_cn: 文字的;词语的;用文字表达的

ext.ext_cn: 测试包含对语言能力、数学能力和抽象推理能力的考查。
ext.ext_en: The test has scores for verbal skills, mathematical skills, and abstract reasoning skills...

ext.ext_cn: 韦恩的语言表达能力很强。
ext.ext_en: Wayne has great verbal dexterity.

defs.def_en: You use verbal to indicate that something is connected with words and the use of words.

ext.ext_cn: 动名词
ext.ext_en: ...a verbal noun.

defs.def_en: In grammar, verbal means relating to a verb.
A south-easterly point, area, or direction is to the south-east or towards the south-east.
A south-easterly wind is a wind that blows from the south-east.

ext.ext_cn: 会计事务所故意毁坏文件，阻挠政府调查工作。
ext.ext_en: The accounting firm deliberately destroyed documents to thwart government investigators...

ext.ext_cn: 她想成为艺术家的梦想由于视力衰减而破灭了。
ext.ext_en: Her ambition to become an artist was thwarted by failing eyesight.

defs.def_en: If you thwart someone or thwart their plans, you prevent them from doing or getting what they want.
A capon is a male chicken that has had its sex organs removed and has been specially fattened up to be eaten.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 与多人发生性关系的；淫乱的；滥交的

ext.ext_cn: 她被认为是个被人惯坏了的、既虚荣又淫乱的女人。
ext.ext_en: She is perceived as vain, spoilt and promiscuous...

ext.ext_cn: 你知道滥交的危险。
ext.ext_en: You know the risks of promiscuous sex.

defs.def_en: Someone  who is promiscuous has sex with many different people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 各种新的风格混杂在一起，令人眼花缭乱
ext.ext_en: ...the dazzling, promiscuous display of new styles.

ext.ext_cn: 50年来博览群书以图一乐
ext.ext_en: ...fifty years of promiscuous reading in pursuit of pleasure.

defs.def_en: Promiscuous means including a wide range of different things.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的一名线人用车尔尼作化名。
ext.ext_en: One of their informers was working under the code name Czerny...

ext.ext_cn: 这次行动的代号为“发电机”。
ext.ext_en: The operation was given the code name Dynamo.

defs.def_en: A code name is a name used for someone or something in order to keep their identity secret.

defs.def_cn: (军事行动或警方的行动)以…为代号

ext.ext_cn: 这次行动的代号是“月光奏鸣曲”。
ext.ext_en: The operation was code-named Moonlight Sonata.

ext.ext_cn: 代号为“雀鹰”的分遣部队
ext.ext_en: ...a military contingent, code-named Sparrowhawk.

defs.def_en: If a military or police operation is code-named something, it is given a name which only the people involved in it know.

ext.ext_cn: 我有时会头脑发热，挥霍无度。
ext.ext_en: I can have a brainstorm and be very extravagant.

defs.def_en: If you have a brainstorm, you suddenly become unable to think clearly.

defs.def_cn: 突然想到的好主意；灵感

ext.ext_cn: “对了，”她灵机一动说道，“你干吗不请他们到这儿来？”
ext.ext_en: 'Look,' she said, getting a brainstorm, 'Why don't you invite them here?'

defs.def_en: If you have a brainstorm, you suddenly have a clever idea.

ext.ext_cn: 她们每个月聚会两次，在一起出谋献策，为各自制定生意目标。
ext.ext_en: The women meet twice a month to brainstorm and set business goals for each other...

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以集体讨论，列出该公司中最有影响的人员的名单。
ext.ext_en: We can brainstorm a list of the most influential individuals in the company.

defs.def_en: If a group of people brainstorm, they have a meeting in which they all put forward as many ideas and suggestions as they can think of.

ext.ext_cn: 组织那场演出是一项浩大的工程。
ext.ext_en: Organizing the show has been a massive undertaking.

defs.def_en: An undertaking is a task or job, especially a large or difficult one.

ext.ext_cn: 国防部向萨维尔保证已向他提供了所有相关的资料。
ext.ext_en: The MOD gave an undertaking to Saville that it had provided him with all relevant material.

defs.def_en: If you give an undertaking to do something, you formally promise to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 夜间温度可能会降到零度以下。
ext.ext_en: Temperatures can drop to freezing at night...

ext.ext_cn: 一旦价格上去了就再也不会降到以前的水平了。
ext.ext_en: Once the rate rises it never drops back to its previous level...

defs.def_en: If a level or amount drops or if someone or something drops it, it quickly becomes less.

ext.ext_cn: 我不小心把眼镜掉下来摔碎了。
ext.ext_en: I dropped my glasses and broke them.

defs.def_en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉到热泪掉到他的手指上。
ext.ext_en: He felt hot tears dropping onto his fingers...

ext.ext_cn: 余火未尽的木块开始从天花板上往下掉。
ext.ext_en: Burning embers started dropping from the ceiling...

defs.def_en: If something drops onto something else, it falls onto that thing. If something drops from somewhere, it falls from that place.

ext.ext_cn: 将面条下到水里。
ext.ext_en: Drop the noodles into the water...

ext.ext_cn: 他把盘子丢到水槽里。
ext.ext_en: He dropped his plate into the sink.

defs.def_en: If you drop something somewhere or if it drops there, you deliberately let it fall there.

ext.ext_cn: 南希疲惫地瘫坐到近处的椅子上。
ext.ext_en: Nancy dropped into a nearby chair...

ext.ext_cn: 她低垂着头。
ext.ext_en: She let her head drop...

defs.def_en: If a person or a part of their body drops to a lower position, or if they drop a part of their body to a lower position, they move to that position, often in a tired and lifeless way.

ext.ext_cn: 她看上去快要累垮了。
ext.ext_en: She looked about to drop...

ext.ext_cn: 一直跑到你跑不动为止。
ext.ext_en: You have to run until you drop.

defs.def_en: To drop is used in expressions such as to be about to drop and to dance until you drop to emphasize that you are exhausted and can no longer continue doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 两名醉酒的狂欢者脱掉了他们的裤子。
ext.ext_en: A couple of boozy revellers dropped their trousers.

defs.def_en: If a man drops his trousers, he pulls them down, usually as a joke or to be rude.

ext.ext_cn: 她会把声音压低，轻蔑地低语。
ext.ext_en: Her voice will drop to a dismissive whisper...

ext.ext_cn: 他放低了声音，在门口环视了一下。
ext.ext_en: He dropped his voice and glanced round at the door.

defs.def_en: If your voice drops or if you drop your voice, you speak more quietly.

defs.def_cn: 中途放下（某人）;中途卸下（某物）

ext.ext_cn: 他把我送到了酒店。
ext.ext_en: He dropped me outside the hotel...

ext.ext_cn: 很多孩子被家长送到了体育馆。
ext.ext_en: Many children had been dropped at the stadium by their parents...

defs.def_en: If you drop someone or something somewhere, you take them somewhere and leave them there, usually in a car or other vehicle.

ext.ext_cn: 他被告知要打消那个主意。
ext.ext_en: He was told to drop the idea...

ext.ext_cn: 控方被迫撤诉。
ext.ext_en: The prosecution was forced to drop the case...

defs.def_en: If you drop an idea, course of action, or habit, you do not continue with it.

ext.ext_cn: 该国的国家队队长无缘英格兰之行。
ext.ext_en: The country's captain was dropped from the tour party to England.

defs.def_en: If someone is dropped by a sports team or organization, they are no longer included in that team or employed by that organization.

ext.ext_cn: 奥尔曼斯还一局未输。
ext.ext_en: Oremans has yet to drop a set.

defs.def_en: If you drop a game or part of a game in a sports competition, you lose it.

ext.ext_cn: 英国在联赛中的排名从第二位降到了第三位。
ext.ext_en: Britain has dropped from second to third place in the league.

defs.def_en: If you drop to a lower position in a sports competition, you move to that position.

ext.ext_cn: 一滴蓝墨水
ext.ext_en: ...a drop of blue ink...

ext.ext_cn: 每次加几滴奶油。
ext.ext_en: Add the cream a few drops at a time...

defs.def_en: A drop of a liquid is a very small amount of it shaped like a little ball. In informal English, you can also use drop when you are referring to a very small amount of something such as a drink.

ext.ext_cn: 眼药水
ext.ext_en: ...eye drops.

defs.def_en: Drops are a kind of medicine which you put drop by drop into your ears, eyes, or nose.

defs.def_cn: (水果味或巧克力味的)糖豆，糖果粒
defs.def_en: Fruit or chocolate drops are small round sweets with a fruit or chocolate flavour.

defs.def_cn: 落差;垂直距离;下降距离

ext.ext_cn: 我的窗外就是垂直深渊。
ext.ext_en: There was a sheer drop just outside my window...

ext.ext_cn: 仅有 4 英尺的落差。
ext.ext_en: It's only a four-foot drop.

defs.def_en: You use drop to talk about vertical distances. For example, a thirty-foot drop is a distance of thirty feet between the top of a cliff or wall and the bottom of it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我给点暗示，他没准会送我一段插枝。
ext.ext_en: If I drop a few hints he might give me a cutting.

defs.def_en: If you drop a hint, you give a hint or say something in a casual way.

defs.def_cn: (常指因不喜欢而让别人)终止谈论，不要谈论，谈到此为止

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽·安希望他就不要谈论它了。
ext.ext_en: Mary Ann wished he would just drop it...

ext.ext_cn: 那是不是意味着你将不再谈论那个话题了？
ext.ext_en: Does that mean you're going to drop the subject?

defs.def_en: If you want someone to drop the subject ,drop it, or let it drop, you want them to stop talking about something, often because you are annoyed that they keep talking about it.

ext.ext_cn: 花园里，七叶树已经落叶了。
ext.ext_en: In the garden, the leaves of the horse chestnut had already fallen...

ext.ext_cn: 车道对面那棵鸡爪枫刚吐新叶。
ext.ext_en: The Japanese maple that stands across the drive had just come into leaf.

defs.def_en: See also:-leaved;The leaves of a tree or plant are the parts that are flat, thin, and usually green. Many trees and plants lose their leaves in the winter and grow new leaves in the spring.

ext.ext_cn: 他把包装纸压平，夹在书里。
ext.ext_en: He flattened the wrappers and put them between the leaves of his book.

defs.def_en: A leaf is one of the pieces of paper of which a book is made.

defs.def_cn: 师法；效法；以（某人）为榜样

ext.ext_cn: 也许我们应该效法布兰森。我们都不难看出他是怎样成为亿万富翁的。
ext.ext_en: Maybe we should take a leaf out of Branson's book. It's easy to see how he became a billionaire...

defs.def_en: If you take a leaf from someone's book you behave in the same way as them because you want to be like that person or as successful as they are.

defs.def_cn: 重新开始；洗心革面；改过自新

ext.ext_cn: 他认识到自己错了，答应改过自新。
ext.ext_en: He realized he was in the wrong and promised to turn over a new leaf.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are going to turn over a new leaf, you mean that you are going to start to behave in a better or more acceptable way.

defs.def_cn: （因寒冷、恐惧等）浑身发抖，抖如落叶

ext.ext_cn: 我那时候没想到有危险，事后我吓得直发抖。
ext.ext_en: I didn't think about the danger at the time. Afterwards I was shaking like a leaf.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is shaking like a leaf, you mean that their body is shaking a lot, for instance because they are very cold or frightened.

defs.def_cn: 帮助记忆的东西；备忘录
defs.def_en: An aide-memoire is something such as a list that you use to remind you of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人或行为)冒失的，调皮的，放肆的

ext.ext_cn: 那个小男孩有点放肆，随随便便的。
ext.ext_en: The boy was cheeky and casual...

ext.ext_cn: 马丁冲着她调皮地笑了笑。
ext.ext_en: Martin gave her a cheeky grin.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as cheeky, you think that they are slightly rude or disrespectful but in a charming or amusing way.

defs.def_cn: (常因意见不合而从一团体中)分裂出来的小派别
defs.def_en: A splinter group is a group of people who break away from a larger group and form a separate organization, usually because they no longer agree with the views of the larger group.
Stage directions are the notes in the text of a play which say what the actors should do.

ext.ext_cn: 闭塞的小农场耕作社会
ext.ext_en: ...isolated crofting communities.

defs.def_en: In Scotland, crofting is the activity of farming on small pieces of land.

ext.ext_cn: 他们拥有核武器，如果逼得太紧，他们就有可能会使用。
ext.ext_en: They have nukes, and if they're sufficiently pushed, they'll use them.

defs.def_en: A nuke is a nuclear weapon.

ext.ext_cn: 他想用核弹轰掉那个地区。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to nuke the area.

defs.def_en: If one country nukes another, it attacks it using nuclear weapons.

defs.def_cn: (尤指分布在较大面积上的)少量，少许

ext.ext_cn: 薄薄的一层雪
ext.ext_en: ...a light sprinkling of snow...

ext.ext_cn: 挪威有好几位女部长。
ext.ext_en: Norway has a fair sprinkling of women ministers.

defs.def_en: A sprinkling of something is a small quantity or amount of it, especially if it is spread over a large area.

ext.ext_cn: 据说那个银行经理曾出具伪造的凭证。
ext.ext_en: The bank manager is said to have issued fake certificates.

ext.ext_cn: 这里满是艺术名品，但每一件都是赝品。
ext.ext_en: It is filled with famous works of art, and every one of them is a fake.

defs.def_en: A fake fur or a fake painting, for example, is a fur or painting that has been made to look valuable or genuine, usually in order to deceive people.

ext.ext_cn: 用化妆品打造出古铜色的皮肤比让皮肤受太阳的暴晒更为安全。
ext.ext_en: It's safer to fake a tan with make-up rather than subject your complexion to the harsh rays of the sun...

ext.ext_cn: 去年，他诈死以骗取100万美元的保险金。

ext.ext_en: The riverbed was strewn with big boulders.

defs.def_en: If a place is strewn with things, they are lying scattered there.

ext.ext_en: Employees have been idle almost a month because of shortages.

defs.def_en: If people who were working are idle, they have no jobs or work.

defs.def_en: If machines or factories are idle, they are not working or being used.

defs.def_cn: 懒散的;懒惰的;无所事事的

ext.ext_en: ...idle bureaucrats who spent the day reading newspapers...

ext.ext_en: I never met such an idle bunch of workers in all my life!

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is idle, you disapprove of them because they are not doing anything and you think they should be.

defs.def_cn: 琐碎无聊的;毫无意义的

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩又絮絮地唠叨了5分钟。
ext.ext_en: Brian kept up the idle chatter for another five minutes.

defs.def_en: Idle is used to describe something that you do for no particular reason, often because you have nothing better to do.

ext.ext_en: It would be idle to pretend the system is perfect.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is idle to do something, you mean that it is not worth doing it, because it will not achieve anything.

ext.ext_en: His statement isn't merely an idle boast.

defs.def_en: You refer to an idle threat or boast when you do not think the person making it will or can do what they say.

defs.def_en: If you idle, you spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

ext.ext_cn: 停业的装配厂
ext.ext_en: ...idled assembly plants.

defs.def_en: To idle a factory or other place of work means to close it down because there is no work to do or because the workers are on strike.

ext.ext_en: The strike has idled about 55,000 machinists.

defs.def_en: To idle workers means to stop them working.

ext.ext_cn: 在树林的那一边,一架小飞机停在那里,发动机在空转。
ext.ext_en: Beyond a stand of trees a small plane idled...

ext.ext_en: Her Daimler limo waits with its engine idling.

defs.def_en: If an engine or vehicle is idling, the engine is running slowly and quietly because it is not in gear, and the vehicle is not moving.

ext.ext_en: Harmon plays a private eye hired by Mimi Rogers to investigate her husband's disappearance.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a private detective as a private eye, especially when he or she is a character in a film or story.

defs.def_cn: 破旧的机器;(尤指)破旧不堪的汽车
defs.def_en: If you describe a machine, especially a car, as a clunker, you mean that it is very old and almost falling apart.

defs.def_en: Campy means the same as camp .

defs.def_en: See also:national anthem;An anthem is a song which is used to represent a particular nation, society, or group and which is sung on special occasions.

ext.ext_en: ...hot air electric hand dryers.

defs.def_en: See also:dry;tumble dryer;A dryer is a machine for drying things. There are different kinds of dryer, for examples ones designed for drying clothes, crops, or people's hair or hands.

ext.ext_cn: 铜、钴和钻石资源丰富的国家

defs.def_en: Cobalt is a hard silvery-white metal which is used to harden steel and for producing a blue dye.

ext.ext_en: ...a woman in a soft cobalt blue dress.

defs.def_en: Cobalt or cobalt blue is a deep blue colour.

ext.ext_en: I invited her in for a coffee...

defs.def_en: If you invite someone to something such as a party or a meal, you ask them to come to it.

ext.ext_en: At a future date, managers will be invited to apply for a management buy-out...

ext.ext_en: Their refusal to compromise will inevitably invite more criticism from the UN.

defs.def_en: If something you say or do invites trouble or criticism, it makes trouble or criticism more likely.

ext.ext_en: They haven't got an invite to the wedding.

defs.def_en: An invite is an invitation to something such as a party or a meal.

ext.ext_en: It was her unreasonable behaviour with a Texan playboy which broke up her marriage...

ext.ext_en: ...London and all the other major conurbations.

ext.ext_cn: 已到结婚年龄的女儿
ext.ext_en: ...a marriageable daughter.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as marriageable, you mean that they are suitable for marriage, especially that they are the right age to marry.

ext.ext_en: ...the Midwest states.

ext.ext_en: Like working women anywhere, Asian women are buying convenience foods.

ext.ext_en: One or two, in blue suits, might have been bank officials. Others were clearly working men.

defs.def_en: A feast is a large and special meal.
