ext.ext_cn: 他们吃玉米炖羊肉一直吃到下午。
ext.ext_en: They feasted well into the afternoon on mutton and corn stew...

ext.ext_cn: 饿狗贪婪地啃食着人的尸体。
ext.ext_en: Starving dogs feasted on the human corpses.

defs.def_en: If you feast on a particular food, you eat a large amount of it with great enjoyment.

ext.ext_cn: 仅在几英尺外，捉拿他们的人正在城堡的宴会厅里大吃大喝。
ext.ext_en: Only a few feet away, their captors feasted in the castle's banqueting hall.

defs.def_en: If you feast, you take part in a feast.

defs.def_cn: 大量(赏心悦目的事情);盛宴

ext.ext_cn: 这部新的系列剧将会是一场特效和舞美的盛宴。
ext.ext_en: This new series promises a feast of special effects and set designs...

ext.ext_cn: 《芝加哥》将给所有音乐爱好者献上一场听觉的盛宴。
ext.ext_en: Chicago provides a feast for the ears of any music lover.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a large number of good, interesting, or enjoyable things as a feast of things.

defs.def_cn: 宗教节日;宗教节庆时间

ext.ext_cn: 犹太人的宗教节日逾越节昨晚开始了。
ext.ext_en: The Jewish feast of Passover began last night...

ext.ext_cn: 圣诞节时，客人们在节日前夜开始逐家拜节。
ext.ext_en: At Christmas the visitors began their circuit of dropping in on the eve of the feast day.

defs.def_en: A feast is a day or time of the year when a special religious celebration takes place.

ext.ext_cn: 她驻足凝神欣赏这片景色。
ext.ext_en: She stood feasting her eyes on the view.

defs.def_en: If you feast your eyes on something, you look at it for a long time with great attention because you find it very attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 外国游客
ext.ext_en: ...foreign tourists...

ext.ext_cn: 布莱克浦是英国的顶级旅游胜地。
ext.ext_en: Blackpool is the top tourist attraction in England.

defs.def_en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.
In computer technology, cyberspace refers to data banks and networks, considered as a place.
The coccyx is the small triangular bone at the lower end of the spine in human beings and some apes.
Breakfast television refers to television programmes which are broadcast in the morning at the time when most people are having breakfast.

ext.ext_cn: 你今天感觉怎么样？
ext.ext_en: How are you feeling today?...

ext.ext_cn: 我想让他今天和我们一起来，但他来不了。
ext.ext_en: I wanted him to come with us today, but he couldn't.

defs.def_en: You use today to refer to the day on which you are speaking or writing.

ext.ext_cn: 当今美国正处于严重的衰退时期。
ext.ext_en: The United States is in a serious recession today…

ext.ext_cn: 他认为现今的流行音乐与以往一样令人兴奋。
ext.ext_en: He thinks pop music today is as exciting as it's ever been.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the present period of history as today .

defs.def_cn: 使丢脸;有辱…的人格;降低…的身份

ext.ext_cn: 认为色情作品有辱女性尊严的观念
ext.ext_en: ...the notion that pornography degrades women...

ext.ext_cn: 我问他是否找过妓女时，他说他不会自贬身份去干那种事情。
ext.ext_en: When I asked him if he had ever been to a prostitute he said he wouldn't degrade himself like that.

defs.def_en: Something that degrades someone causes people to have less respect for them.

ext.ext_cn: 无限制地满足人类需求而不造成环境退化的能力
ext.ext_en: ...the ability to meet human needs indefinitely without degrading the environment.

defs.def_en: To degrade something means to cause it to get worse.

ext.ext_cn: 这种物质在土壤里会迅速降解。
ext.ext_en: This substance degrades rapidly in the soil.

ext.ext_cn: 这些酶降解纤维素的能力
ext.ext_en: ...the ability of these enzymes to degrade cellulose.

defs.def_en: In science, if a substance degrades or if something degrades it, it changes chemically and decays or separates into different substances.
A grocery or a grocery store is a grocer's shop.
Groceries are foods you buy at a grocer's or at a supermarket such as flour, sugar, and tinned foods.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (联系)脆弱的;(理由)站不住脚的，牵强的;(地位)不稳固的

ext.ext_cn: 许多省份之间的文化和历史纽带被认为是很脆弱的。
ext.ext_en: The cultural and historical links between the many provinces were seen to be very tenuous...

ext.ext_cn: 这个决定使得总统的位置有些岌岌可危。
ext.ext_en: This decision puts the President in a somewhat tenuous position.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a connection, a reason, or someone's position as tenuous, you mean that it is very uncertain or weak.

defs.def_cn: (有冲突或争端时的)僵持，对峙
defs.def_en: A Mexican stand-off is a situation in which neither of the people or groups in a conflict or dispute can win and neither wants to give in first.

ext.ext_cn: 他们专门指定要一个宽敞的大门厅。
ext.ext_en: They specified a spacious entrance hall...

ext.ext_cn: 他尚未明确说明自己希望他们采取什么样的行动。
ext.ext_en: He has not specified what action he would like them to take.

defs.def_en: If you specify something, you give information about what is required or should happen in a certain situation.

ext.ext_cn: 每种菜谱都具体规定了所用鸡蛋的大小。
ext.ext_en: Each recipe specifies the size of egg to be used...

ext.ext_cn: 一条规则明确规定，见习驾驶员必须有成人的监督。
ext.ext_en: One rule specifies that learner drivers must be supervised by adults...

defs.def_en: If you specify what should happen or be done, you explain it in an exact and detailed way.

ext.ext_cn: 她对彭利先生极其信任。
ext.ext_en: She had placed a great deal of faith in Mr Penleigh...

ext.ext_cn: 人们已经对英国议会失去了信任。
ext.ext_en: People have lost faith in the British Parliament.

defs.def_en: If you have faith in someone or something, you feel confident about their ability or goodness.

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰于 16 世纪正式由天主教改信新教。
ext.ext_en: England shifted officially from a Catholic to a Protestant faith in the 16th century.

defs.def_en: A faith is a particular religion, for example Christianity, Buddhism, or Islam.

ext.ext_cn: 翁贝托·艾柯个人宗教信仰的丧失反映在了他的小说里。
ext.ext_en: Umberto Eco's loss of his own religious faith is reflected in his novels.

defs.def_en: Faith is strong religious belief in a particular God.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们不这样，就是对我们的人民背信弃义！
ext.ext_en: If we don't, we're breaking faith with our people!

defs.def_en: If you break faith with someone you made a promise to or something you believed in, you stop acting in a way that supports them.

defs.def_cn: 真诚地;真心实意地;好意地

ext.ext_cn: 我们发表这篇报道的初衷是好的，但对可能已造成的混乱深感歉意。
ext.ext_en: This report was published in good faith but we regret any confusion which may have been caused.

defs.def_en: If you do something in good faith, you seriously believe that what you are doing is right, honest, or legal, even though this may not be the case.

ext.ext_cn: 他秉承自己一贯的激进风格，制作出了本年度美国最有感染力的影片之一。
ext.ext_en: He has made one of the most powerful American films of the year by keeping faith with his radical principles.

defs.def_en: If you keep faith with someone you have made a promise to or something you believe in, you continue to support them even when it is difficult to do so.

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪80年代很多表面上的利润增长都是靠做假账做出来的。
ext.ext_en: Much of the apparent growth in profits that occurred in the 1980s was the result of creative accounting.

defs.def_en: Creative accounting is when companies present or organize their accounts in such a way that they gain money for themselves or give a false impression of their profits.

ext.ext_cn: 雇主和雇员之间出现了信任危机。
ext.ext_en: There is a credibility gap developing between employers and employees.

defs.def_en: A credibility gap is the difference between what a person says or promises and what they actually think or do.

defs.def_cn: (大城市常存在社会、经济问题的)市中心贫民区

ext.ext_cn: 帮助儿童克服住在市中心贫民区的恐惧感
ext.ext_en: ...helping kids deal with the fear of living in the inner city...

ext.ext_cn: 位于 20 个市中心贫民区的学校在去年的测试中成绩最差。
ext.ext_en: Schools in 20 inner-city areas produced the worst results in last year's tests.

defs.def_en: You use inner city to refer to the areas in or near the centre of a large city where people live and where there are often social and economic problems.

defs.def_cn: 一方得益一方受损的局面;零和博弈

ext.ext_cn: 他们明白他们正处于一场零和博弈中，双方必须针锋相对，争夺那少得可怜的资源。
ext.ext_en: They believe they're playing a zero-sum game, where both must compete for the same paltry resources.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a situation as a zero-sum game, you mean that if one person gains an advantage from it, someone else involved must suffer an equivalent disadvantage.

ext.ext_cn: 1982年那一届只有18.8% 的学生在中学毕业4年后获得了某种文凭，而1972年那一届这一比例是45％。
ext.ext_en: Only 18.8% of the class of 1982 had some kind of diploma four years after high school, versus 45% of the class of 1972.

ext.ext_cn: 牛奶喂养与母乳喂养相比
ext.ext_en: ...bottle-feeding versus breastfeeding.

defs.def_en: You use versus to indicate that two figures, ideas, or choices are opposed.

ext.ext_cn: 在意大利队对日本队的比赛中，双方竟出人意料地势均力敌。
ext.ext_en: Italy versus Japan is turning out to be a surprisingly well matched competition.

ext.ext_cn: 格雷格·诺曼和迈克尔·坎贝尔对阵雷蒂夫·戈森和戴维·弗罗斯特
ext.ext_en: ...Greg Norman and Michael Campbell versus Retief Goosen and David Frost.

defs.def_en: Versus is used to indicate that two teams or people are competing against each other in a sporting event.

ext.ext_cn: 电路图
ext.ext_en: ...a circuit diagram...

ext.ext_cn: 你可以把冗长的解释简化成一目了然的图表。
ext.ext_en: You can reduce long explanations to simple charts or diagrams.

defs.def_en: A diagram is a simple drawing which consists mainly of lines and is used, for example, to explain how a machine works.

defs.def_cn: 绘制…的示意图;用图表表示（或说明）

ext.ext_cn: 这个声音的声波如图B所示。
ext.ext_en: The sound waves of the voice could be diagramed as in B.

ext.ext_cn: 用图表表示系统各个变量的变化情况
ext.ext_en: ...diagramming the movement of a system's variables.

defs.def_en: To diagram something means to draw a diagram of it or to explain it using a diagram.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她留着微卷的褐色短发。
ext.ext_en: She had short, wavy brown hair.

defs.def_en: Wavy hair is not straight or curly, but curves slightly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些盒子上饰有波浪形的金边。
ext.ext_en: The boxes were decorated with a wavy gold line.

ext.ext_cn: 边缘呈波浪形的叶子
ext.ext_en: ...leaves with wavy edges.

defs.def_en: A wavy line has a series of regular curves along it.

ext.ext_cn: 膀胱炎发作
ext.ext_en: ...an attack of cystitis.

defs.def_en: Cystitis is a bladder infection.

ext.ext_cn: 附信不应超过一页，通常来说，一封相对非常简短的信就足够了。
ext.ext_en: A cover letter should never exceed one page; often a far shorter letter will suffice.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will suffice, you mean it will be enough to achieve a purpose or to fulfil a need.

defs.def_cn: (用于句首)无须多说，只需说…就够了

ext.ext_cn: 简单地说，此后我们再也没有见过面。
ext.ext_en: Suffice it to say that afterwards we never met again...

ext.ext_cn: 我只想说，那是几年前的事了！
ext.ext_en: Suffice to say, it was more than a couple of years ago!

defs.def_en: Suffice it to say or suffice to say is used at the beginning of a statement to indicate that what you are saying is obvious, or that you will only give a short explanation.
The sidelights on a vehicle are the small lights at the front that help other drivers to notice the vehicle and to judge its width.
The sidelights on a vehicle are lights on its sides.

defs.def_cn: (有关某情况的)侧面消息，趣闻，附带信息

ext.ext_cn: 书中有很多关于他家庭背景的趣闻。
ext.ext_en: The book is full of amusing sidelights on his family background.

defs.def_en: A sidelight on a particular situation is a piece of information about that situation which is interesting but which is not particularly important.

ext.ext_cn: 之前尝试过几次将鱼缸中的水过滤并充氧，但都没有成功。
ext.ext_en: Previous attempts at filtering and oxygenating aquarium water had failed.

ext.ext_cn: 刚充氧的血液
ext.ext_en: ...freshly oxygenated blood.

defs.def_en: To oxygenate something means to mix or dissolve oxygen into it.

defs.def_cn: 老疯子；讨厌的老家伙；（尤指）癫婆子，招嫌的老太婆
defs.def_en: If someone refers to an old person, especially an old woman, as an old bat, they think that person is silly, annoying, or unpleasant.

ext.ext_en: The number of juveniles in the general population has fallen by a fifth in the past 10 years.

defs.def_en: A juvenile is a child or young person who is not yet old enough to be regarded as an adult.

ext.ext_cn: 青少年犯罪正在以惊人的速度增长。
ext.ext_en: Juvenile crime is increasing at a terrifying rate.

ext.ext_cn: 将青少年惯犯关入监狱的计划
ext.ext_en: ...a scheme to lock up persistent juvenile offenders.

defs.def_en: Juvenile activity or behaviour involves young people who are not yet adults.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行为）幼稚的，不成熟的，孩子气的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个典型的男人，年龄越大越孩子气。
ext.ext_en: He's a typical male, as he gets older he becomes more juvenile.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as juvenile, you are critical of it because you think that it is silly or childish.
Young animals are sometimes referred to as juveniles .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 陈旧的性别歧视态度仍然常见。
ext.ext_en: Old-fashioned sexist attitudes are still common...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为整件事情非常不公平，而且恕我直言，我觉得这是非常严重的性别歧视。
ext.ext_en: I think the whole thing is very unfair and if I may say so I think it's very sexist...

defs.def_en: If you describe people or their behaviour as sexist, you mean that they are influenced by the belief that the members of one sex, usually women, are less intelligent or less capable than those of the other sex and need not be treated equally.

ext.ext_cn: 我注意到她是个左撇子。

ext.ext_en: There is a place in London that supplies practically everything for left-handed people.

defs.def_en: Someone who is left-handed uses their left hand rather than their right hand for activities such as writing and sports and for picking things up.

defs.def_cn: 附带损失，附带的破坏(指军事行动造成的平民伤亡或非军事设施的破坏)

ext.ext_cn: 为了尽量减低附带性破坏，轰炸须做到最大程度的精确。
ext.ext_en: To minimize collateral damage maximum precision in bombing was required.

defs.def_en: Collateral damage is accidental injury to non-military people or damage to non-military buildings which occurs during a military operation.
The mane on a horse or lion is the long thick hair that grows from its neck.

ext.ext_cn: 他满头浓密的白发。
ext.ext_en: He had a great mane of white hair.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a person's hair as their mane, you mean that they have a lot of hair.
The monarch of a country is the king, queen, emperor, or empress.

ext.ext_cn: 在 1,000 英尺的高度飞行时，他听到旋翼发出一种奇怪的噪音。
ext.ext_en: Flying at 1,000 ft, he heard a peculiar noise from the rotors.

ext.ext_en: ...an area of 2,750 sq ft.

defs.def_en: ft is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略

ext.ext_en: A decision was taken to discipline Marshall...

ext.ext_en: The president said he'd made no firm decision on whether he would run for a second term in office...

defs.def_en: When you make a decision, you choose what should be done or which is the best of various possible actions.

ext.ext_cn: 作出决定的时刻由不得耽搁。
ext.ext_en: The moment of decision cannot be delayed...

ext.ext_cn: 这件事需要个人自己决定。
ext.ext_en: This was a matter for decision by the individual.

defs.def_en: Decision is the act of deciding something or the need to decide something.

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个遇事非常果断、行动极为迅速的人。
ext.ext_en: He is very much a man of decision and action.

defs.def_en: Decision is the ability to decide quickly and definitely what to do.

ext.ext_cn: 他说自己在押期间并未遭受拷问和虐待。
ext.ext_en: He said that he was not tortured or maltreated during his detention...

ext.ext_cn: 只有在动物遭到严重虐待时才有必要进行调查或起诉。
ext.ext_en: Only when the animals were seriously maltreated was any inspection or prosecution called for.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal is maltreated, they are treated badly, especially by being hurt.

ext.ext_cn: 试图对劳动价值理论进行反驳
ext.ext_en: ...an attempt to develop a counter-argument to the labor theory.

defs.def_en: A counter-argument is an argument that makes an opposing point to another argument.

defs.def_cn: (尤指士兵、难民或吉普赛人的)营地

ext.ext_cn: 大军营
ext.ext_en: ...a large military encampment.

defs.def_en: An encampment is a group of tents or other shelters in a particular place, especially when they are used by soldiers, refugees, or gypsies.

ext.ext_cn: 有弹性的绳子
ext.ext_en: ...an elastic rope.

ext.ext_en: It is essentially a narrow and conservative approach to child care.

ext.ext_en: The girl was well dressed, as usual, though in a more conservative style.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: A conservative estimate or guess is one in which you are cautious and estimate or guess a low amount which is probably less that the real amount.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the secretive world of spying.

defs.def_en: If you are secretive, you like to have secrets and to keep your knowledge, feelings, or intentions hidden.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He was an upright and noble man who was always willing to help in any way he could...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a noble person, you admire and respect them because they are unselfish and morally good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (想法、目标、行动等)高尚的,崇高的

ext.ext_cn: 我们总会用听起来非常高尚的理论为我们的行动辩护。
ext.ext_en: We'll always justify our actions with noble sounding theories...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a noble idea, goal, or action, you admire it because it is based on high moral principles.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 壮观的;宏伟的;卓越的;优质的

ext.ext_cn: 树木参天的大公园
ext.ext_en: ...the great parks with their noble trees.

ext.ext_cn: 优质纯葡萄酒
ext.ext_en: ...a noble and pure wine.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as noble, you think that its appearance or quality is very impressive, making it superior to other things of its type.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Although he was of noble birth he lived as a poor man.

ext.ext_en: More and more nobles made Moscow their home during Catherine's reign.

defs.def_en: In former times, people who belonged to a high social class and had titles such as 'Baron' or 'Duke' were referred to as nobles .

defs.def_cn: (尤指用于非法政治或商业活动的)贿赂基金，行贿基金

ext.ext_en: He's accused of misusing $17.5 million from a secret government slush fund.

defs.def_en: A slush fund is a sum of money collected to pay for an illegal activity, especially in politics or business.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他可不懒，昨晚他忙了整整一夜。
ext.ext_en: He was not slothful: he had been busy all night.

defs.def_en: Someone who is slothful is lazy and unwilling to make an effort to work.

defs.def_cn: 临摹者;(过去的)誊写员，抄写员

ext.ext_cn: 像大多数临摹者一样，她也把原画家的签名临摹到画上。
ext.ext_en: She copies the true artist's signature as part of a painting, as do most copyists.

defs.def_en: A copyist copies other people's music or paintings or, in the past, made written copies of documents.
A pulpit is a small raised platform with a rail or barrier around it in a church, where a member of the clergy stands to speak.

ext.ext_cn: 沿那一页的中心画一条竖线。
ext.ext_en: Draw a line down that page's  center.

ext.ext_cn: 虚线
ext.ext_en: ...a dotted line...

defs.def_en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

ext.ext_en: He has a large, generous face with deep lines.

ext.ext_cn: 细细的皱纹和褶子
ext.ext_en: ...fine lines and wrinkles.

defs.def_en: The lines on some-one's skin, especially on their face, are long thin marks that appear there as they grow older.

ext.ext_cn: 那一排稀稀落落的观众没留意到任何不寻常之处。
ext.ext_en: The sparse line of spectators noticed nothing unusual.

defs.def_en: A line of people or things is a number of them arranged one behind the other or side by side.

defs.def_cn: （人、车辆等在等候时排成的）队，队伍

ext.ext_cn: 紧紧抓着空碗的孩子们排成一队。
ext.ext_en: Children clutching empty bowls form a line...

defs.def_en: A line of people or vehicles is a number of them that are waiting one behind another, for example in order to buy something or to go in a particular direction.

ext.ext_cn: 下一行应该是：5天，23.5小时。
ext.ext_en: The next line should read: Five days, 23.5 hours...

ext.ext_cn: 蒂娜肯定读不过三行。
ext.ext_en: Tina wouldn't have read more than three lines.

defs.def_en: A line of a piece of writing is one of the rows of words, numbers, or other symbols in it.
In school, if a child is given lines, he or she is punished by being made to write out a sentence many times or to write out a passage from a book.

ext.ext_cn: 莎士比亚剧作《奥赛罗》中的一句台词：“一个在恋爱上不智而过于深情的人”
ext.ext_en: ...a line from Shakespeare's Othello: 'one that loved not wisely but too well'...

ext.ext_en: Every time I sing that line, I have to compete with that bloody trombone!...

defs.def_en: A line of a poem, song, or play is a group of words that are spoken or sung together. If an actor learns his or her lines for a play or film, they learn what they have to say.

ext.ext_cn: “有一天也许你会再结婚的。”“这句话真中听啊，难得你能这么说！”
ext.ext_en: 'In time perhaps you'll marry again'. 'That's a great line, coming from you!'.

ext.ext_cn: 诸如“你的眼睛很漂亮”之类的搭讪语
ext.ext_en: ...chat-up lines like 'You've got beautiful eyes'.

defs.def_en: A particular type of line in a conversation is a remark that is intended to have a particular effect.

ext.ext_cn: 她把洗好的衣物晾在绳子上。
ext.ext_en: She put her washing on the line.

ext.ext_cn: 一节钓线
ext.ext_en: ...a piece of fishing-line...

defs.def_en: You can refer to a long piece of wire, string, or cable as a line when it is used for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 电话断线了。
ext.ext_en: The telephone lines went dead...

ext.ext_cn: 电话线路不太好。苏珊，我们再打给你好吗？
ext.ext_en: It's not a very good line. Shall we call you back Susan?...

defs.def_en: A line is a connection which makes it possible for two people to speak to each other on the telephone.

ext.ext_cn: 24小时信息热线
ext.ext_en: ...the 24-hours information line.

ext.ext_cn: 女同性恋热线传来的详情
ext.ext_en: ...details from Lesbian Line.

defs.def_en: You can use line to refer to a telephone number which you can ring in order to get information or advice.

defs.def_cn: （尤指危险或秘密的）路线，线路

ext.ext_cn: 美洲大陆的地形严重限制了进攻路线。
ext.ext_en: The American continent's geography severely limited the lines of attack...

ext.ext_cn: 谈判专家说他们保持着沟通渠道的畅通。
ext.ext_en: Negotiators say they're keeping communication lines open.

defs.def_en: A line is a route, especially a dangerous or secret one, along which people move or send messages or supplies.

ext.ext_cn: 沿直线行进。
ext.ext_en: Walk in a straight line...

ext.ext_cn: 机翼与航线成直角。
ext.ext_en: The wings were at right angles to the line of flight.

defs.def_en: The line in which something or someone moves is the particular route that they take, especially when they keep moving straight ahead.

ext.ext_cn: 他们得一直坐到终点站。
ext.ext_en: They've got to ride all the way to the end of the line...

ext.ext_cn: 三个火车站发生了火灾，两条通勤线路的服务被迫中断数小时。
ext.ext_en: Fires broke out at three railway stations, halting service on two commuter lines for several hours...

defs.def_en: A line is a particular route, involving the same stations, roads, or stops along which a train or bus service regularly operates.

ext.ext_cn: 处理铁轨上的落叶对铁路公司而言是一个耗资巨大的工程。
ext.ext_en: Leaves on the line are an expensive problem for the railways.

defs.def_en: A railway line consists of the pieces of metal and wood which form the track that the trains travel along.

ext.ext_cn: 外交部愿意向海运公司支付将该船改道至百慕大的一切费用。
ext.ext_en: The Foreign Office offered to pay the shipping line all the costs of diverting the ship to Bermuda.

defs.def_en: A shipping, air, or bus line is a company which provides services for transporting people or goods by sea, air, or bus.

ext.ext_cn: 花园有一种随意的风格，从而使温室的建筑轮廓显得柔和了。
ext.ext_en: The garden has an informal feel to soften the architectural lines of the conservatory.

ext.ext_cn: 贴合身体曲线的凹凸有致的晚礼服
ext.ext_en: ...a sculptured evening dress that follows the lines of the body.

defs.def_en: You can use line to refer to the edge, outline, or shape of an object or a person's body.

ext.ext_cn: 加利福尼亚州州界
ext.ext_en: ...the California state line.

defs.def_en: A state or county line is a boundary between two states or counties.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的部队在炮轰仅有7英里之遥的德军防线。
ext.ext_en: Their unit was shelling the German lines only seven miles away.

ext.ext_cn: 他们称为马其诺防线的巨大防御工事
ext.ext_en: ...the stupendous fortification they called the Maginot Line.

defs.def_en: You can use lines to refer to the set of physical defences or the soldiers that have been established along the boundary of an area occupied by an army.

ext.ext_cn: 执政的保守党有40名党员倒戈，投票反对政府的方针。
ext.ext_en: Forty members of the governing Conservative party rebelled, voting against the government line...

ext.ext_cn: 绝大多数议员在这个问题上都持强硬立场。
ext.ext_en: Most members of Parliament took a hard line on this issue.

defs.def_en: The particular line that a person has towards a problem is the attitude that they have towards it. For example, if someone takes a hard line on something, they have a firm strict policy which they refuse to change.

defs.def_cn: （思想或行动的）步骤，方式，方法

ext.ext_cn: 我们上一章的讨论延续了这一思路。
ext.ext_en: Our discussion in the previous chapter continues this line of thinking...

ext.ext_cn: 这一研究方法可能会产生哪些实际效益？
ext.ext_en: What  are some of the practical benefits likely to be of this line of research?

defs.def_en: You can use line to refer to the way in which someone's thoughts or activities develop, particularly if it is logical.

ext.ext_cn: 然后就是对咖啡的各种溢美之词，类似“嘿，这咖啡真棒！”等等。
ext.ext_en: There followed an assortment of praise for the coffee along the lines of 'Hey, this coffee is fantastic!'...

ext.ext_cn: 他已经说过类似的话了。
ext.ext_en: He'd said something along those lines already...

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens along particular lines, or on particular lines, you are giving a general summary or approximate account of what happens, which may not be correct in every detail.

ext.ext_cn: 基于民族划分的所谓自治共和国
ext.ext_en: ...so-called autonomous republics based on ethnic lines.

ext.ext_cn: 重组旧工厂使其按日本模式生产
ext.ext_en: ...reorganising old factories to work along Japanese lines.

defs.def_en: If something is organized on particular lines, or along particular lines, it is organized according to that method or principle.

ext.ext_en: So what was your father's line of business?...

ext.ext_en: In my line of work I often get home too late for dinner.

defs.def_en: Your line of business or work is the kind of work that you do.

ext.ext_en: Wild guesses aren't much in my line...

ext.ext_cn: 也许你更喜欢做志愿工作？
ext.ext_en: Perhaps doing voluntary work is more your line?

defs.def_en: If someone says that something is your line, or that it is in your line, they mean that it is the sort of thing that you often do because you enjoy doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 他最畅销的产品是最便宜的只卖1.99英镑的贮藏啤酒。
ext.ext_en: His best selling line is the cheapest lager at £1.99.

defs.def_en: A line is a particular type of product that a company makes or sells.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数孩子可以参加某项艺术活动。
ext.ext_en: Most kids can do something in the art line.

defs.def_en: You can use line to refer to something connected with a particular activity. For example, something in the sports line is connected with sports.

ext.ext_cn: 一条能生产三种不同产品的流水线
ext.ext_en: ...a production line capable of producing three different products.

defs.def_en: In a factory, a line is an arrangement of workers or machines where a product passes from one worker to another until it is finished.

ext.ext_cn: 承自亚瑟和乌瑟·彭德拉根的古老的威尔士皇族世家
ext.ext_en: ...the old Welsh royal line descended from Arthur and Uther Pendragon...

ext.ext_en: This title will only pass down through the male line.

defs.def_en: You can use line to refer to all the generations of a family, especially when you are considering the social status or the physical characteristics that the various members inherit.

ext.ext_cn: 尼古拉斯·保罗·帕特里克是王位的第七顺位继承人。
ext.ext_en: Nicholas Paul Patrick was seventh in the line of succession to the throne...

ext.ext_en: The line of command went from head office in Chicago to a regional boss and then down to a country boss and finally to a local-office managing-partner.

defs.def_en: You can use line when you are referring to a number of people who are ranked according to status.

defs.def_cn: （按时间顺序排的）一系列，一连串

ext.ext_cn: 我们同属一脉相承的艺术家。
ext.ext_en: We were part of a long line of artists...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一长串悲剧事件中最新的一件。
ext.ext_en: It's the latest in a long line of tragedies.

defs.def_en: A particular line of people or things is a series of them that has existed over a period of time, when they have all been similar in some way, or done similar things.

defs.def_cn: 沿…排列成行；遍布…的边沿

ext.ext_cn: 数以千计的当地居民站在街道两旁，为由此经过的队伍鼓掌。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of local people lined the streets and clapped as the procession went by.

ext.ext_cn: 四周遍布酒吧和俱乐部的广场
ext.ext_en: ...a square lined with pubs and clubs.

defs.def_en: If people or things line a road, room, or other place, they are present in large numbers along its edges or sides.

ext.ext_cn: 把那些丝状水藻捞出来，垫在吊篮里。
ext.ext_en: Scoop the blanket weed out and use it to line hanging baskets...

ext.ext_cn: 母熊往往会在洞穴里垫些树叶或草。
ext.ext_en: Female bears tend to line their dens with leaves or grass.

defs.def_en: If you line a wall, container, or other object, you put a layer of something such as leaves or paper on the inside surface of it in order to make it stronger, warmer, or cleaner.

defs.def_cn: 在（容器或器官）的内壁形成一层

ext.ext_cn: 肠道内壁的一层肌肉
ext.ext_en: ...the muscles that line the intestines.

defs.def_en: If something lines a container or area, especially an area inside a person, animal, or plant, it forms a layer on the inside surface.

defs.def_cn: 其间某时；在某一时刻；在某一环节

ext.ext_cn: 在此期间的某个时候他拿到了一个工程学学位。
ext.ext_en: Somewhere along the line he picked up an engineering degree...

ext.ext_cn: 这得视这一关系到底发展到了什么程度而定。
ext.ext_en: It would depend how far down the line the relationship was.

defs.def_en: If something happens somewhere along the line or down the line, it happens during the course of a situation or activity, often at a point that cannot be exactly identified.

ext.ext_cn: 全体演员的精彩表演捕捉到了那个半封建时代的声音和感觉。
ext.ext_en: Excellent acting all down the line captures the sound and feeling of that semi-feudal age...

ext.ext_cn: 民主党与共和党就何为恰当的反应处处针锋相对。
ext.ext_en: Democrats and Republicans differed right down the line on what the proper responses were.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens all down the line, or right down the line, you mean that it happens in every case.

defs.def_cn: 划定底线；不能容忍；反对

ext.ext_cn: 已经有囚犯写信来，宣称就连他们也绝对不会殴打老太太。
ext.ext_en: Letters have come from prisoners, declaring that they would draw the line at hitting an old lady.

defs.def_en: If you draw the line at a particular activity, you refuse to do it, because you disapprove of it or because it is more extreme than what you normally do.

ext.ext_cn: 不过，这两个类别无法泾渭分明地区分开来。
ext.ext_en: It is, however, not possible to draw a distinct line between the two categories.

defs.def_en: If you draw a line between two things, you make a distinction between them.

ext.ext_cn: 我的电话坏了，你写信给我吧。
ext.ext_en: My phone doesn't  work, so drop me a line.

defs.def_en: If you drop someone a line, you write to them.

defs.def_cn: 在执行公务中；在履行职责时

ext.ext_cn: 去年有3,000多名警察因公受伤。
ext.ext_en: More than 3,000 police officers were wounded in the line of duty last year.

defs.def_en: If you do something or if it happens to you in the line of duty, you do it or it happens as part of your regular work or as a result of it.

defs.def_cn: 第一项举措；最重要的方法

ext.ext_cn: 护照检查仍将是对付恐怖分子的第一道防线。
ext.ext_en: Passport checks will remain the first line of defence against terrorists...

ext.ext_cn: 首要的治疗方法就是通过定期滋润来帮助受到影响的皮肤。
ext.ext_en: The first line of treatment is to help the affected skin by moisturising it regularly.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a method as the first line of, for example, defence or treatment, you mean that it is the first or most important method to be used in dealing with a problem.

defs.def_cn: 将轮到…的；很有可能获得…的；…很有可能（发生）的

ext.ext_cn: 他肯定能在《吉尼斯世界纪录大全》中获得一席之地。
ext.ext_en: He must be in line for a place in the Guinness Book of Records...

ext.ext_cn: 公共部门的薪资也很可能受到重创。
ext.ext_en: Public sector pay is also in line to be hit hard.

defs.def_en: If you are in line for something, it is likely to happen to you or you are likely to obtain it. If something is in line to happen, it is likely to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 该装置本身就在车子正下方，几乎与变速杆处于同一直线上。
ext.ext_en: The device itself was right under the vehicle, almost in line with the gear lever...

ext.ext_cn: 金星、太阳和地球都到了一条直线上。
ext.ext_en: Venus, the Sun and Earth all moved into line.

defs.def_en: If one object is in line with others, or moves into line with others, they are arranged in a line. You can also say that a number of objects are in line or move into line.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的学校建构现在基本上与世界上主要国家的相一致了。
ext.ext_en: The structure of our schools is now broadly in line with the major countries of the world...

ext.ext_cn: 这使得该法与绝大多数医学见解保持了一致。
ext.ext_en: This brings the law into line with most medical opinion.

defs.def_en: If one thing is in line with another, or is brought into line with it, the first thing is, or becomes, similar to the second, especially in a way that has been planned or expected.

ext.ext_cn: 我已经排了3个小时的队。
ext.ext_en: I had been standing in line for three hours.

defs.def_en: When people stand in line or wait in line, they stand one behind the other in a line, waiting their turn for something.

defs.def_cn: 使（某人）就范；使（某人）听从吩咐

defs.def_cn: 在计算机上；在网上；在线

defs.def_en: If you trudge somewhere, you walk there slowly and with heavy steps, especially because you are tired or unhappy.

ext.ext_en: They have begun a hunger strike in protest at the alleged beating.

ext.ext_en: ...the British Plenipotentiary to the UN conference.

defs.def_en: An ambassador plenipotentiary or minister plenipotentiary has full power or authority to represent their country.

For example, if you do not agree with someone, you disagree with them; if one thing is not similar to something else, it is dissimilar to it.

defs.def_en: If something is hollowed, its surface is made to curve inwards or downwards.

defs.def_en: If you describe information or a situation as compromising, you mean that it reveals an embarrassing or guilty secret about someone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as brazen, you mean that they are very bold and do not care what other people think about them or their behaviour.

defs.def_en: If you weed out things or people that are useless or unwanted in a group, you find them and get rid of them.

defs.def_en: If someone has a worshipful attitude to a person or thing, they show great respect and admiration for them.

defs.def_en: If you fell someone, you knock them down, for example in a fight.

defs.def_en: If you fulfil something such as a promise, dream, or hope, you do what you said or hoped you would do.

ext.ext_en: The average man doing hard physical work has the best record, from the point of view of heart disease...

ext.ext_en: Thousands of Europe's tanks and guns are going to the scrap heap.

defs.def_en: If things such as machines or weapons are thrown on the scrapheap, they are thrown away because they are no longer needed.

defs.def_cn: （花园等处种有多年生开花草本植物的）花床，花带
defs.def_en: A herbaceous border is a flower bed containing a mixture of plants that flower every year.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她站在昏暗的光线下等待。
ext.ext_en: She stood waiting, in the dim light...

ext.ext_cn: 船舱里灯光昏暗。
ext.ext_en: Below decks, the lights were dim.

defs.def_en: Dim light is not bright.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 房间里阴暗、清冷，静悄悄的。
ext.ext_en: The room was dim and cool and quiet.

defs.def_en: A dim place is rather dark because there is not much light in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人影、物体)隐约的，蒙眬的，不分明的

ext.ext_cn: 皮特的火把映出了鲍勃和张的模糊身影。
ext.ext_en: Pete's torch picked out the dim figures of Bob and Chang.

defs.def_en: A dim figure or object is not very easy to see, either because it is in shadow or darkness, or because it is far away.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (记忆、理解)模糊的，依稀的，不清晰的

ext.ext_cn: 20 世纪 60 年代的社会激进主义似乎只是一个模糊的记忆。
ext.ext_en: It seems that the '60s era of social activism is all but a dim memory.

defs.def_en: If you have a dim memory or understanding of something, it is difficult to remember or is unclear in your mind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (前景)灰暗的，渺茫的，不光明的

ext.ext_cn: 和平解决的希望非常渺茫。
ext.ext_en: The prospects for a peaceful solution are dim.

defs.def_en: If the future of something is dim, you have no reason to feel hopeful or positive about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as dim, you think that they are stupid.

ext.ext_cn: 把灯光调暗一些——躺着时眼前灯光太强很不舒服。
ext.ext_en: Dim the lighting – it is unpleasant to lie with a bright light shining in your eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 观众席的灯暗了下来。
ext.ext_en: The houselights dimmed.

defs.def_en: If you dim a light or if it dims, it becomes less bright.

defs.def_cn: 将(汽车前灯)调为近光;使减光

ext.ext_cn: 开到那辆车后面时将前灯调为近光。
ext.ext_en: Dim your lights behind that car.

defs.def_en: If you are driving a car and dim the headlights, you operate a switch that makes them shine downwards, so that they do not shine directly into the eyes of other drivers.

defs.def_cn: (使)(前景、希望等)变渺茫;(使)（感情等）淡化

ext.ext_cn: 他们的经济前景变得很暗淡。
ext.ext_en: Their economic prospects have dimmed...

ext.ext_cn: 48 年的婚姻生活并没消磨掉比尔和海伦之间的激情。
ext.ext_en: Forty eight years of marriage have not dimmed the passion between Bill and Helen.

defs.def_en: If your future, hopes, or emotions dim or if something dims them, they become less good or less strong.

ext.ext_cn: 悲痛之下，她泪眼蒙眬。
ext.ext_en: Her eyes dimmed with sorrow...

ext.ext_cn: 他眼中闪烁的光芒被泪水模糊了。
ext.ext_en: The twinkle in his eyes was dimmed by tears.

defs.def_en: If your eyes dim or are dimmed by something, they become weaker or unable to see clearly.

defs.def_cn: (使)(记忆)变模糊;(使)变得不清晰

ext.ext_cn: 他们对所发生事情的记忆变得模糊了。
ext.ext_en: Their memory of what happened has dimmed...

ext.ext_cn: 经过了其间那么多年他的记忆已经不大清楚了。
ext.ext_en: The intervening years had dimmed his memory.

defs.def_en: If your memories dim or if something dims them, they become less clear in your mind.

ext.ext_cn: 教会与俗众越来越积极参与慈善工作。
ext.ext_en: The Church and the laity were increasingly active in charity work...

ext.ext_cn: 神职人员和信众同样都观点各异。
ext.ext_en: Clergy and laity alike are divided in their views.

defs.def_en: The laity are all the people involved in the work of a church who are not clergymen, monks, or nuns.

ext.ext_cn: 这种工作经验的重要性不应该被低估。
ext.ext_en: The value of this work experience should not be underestimated...

ext.ext_cn: 这些治疗是否有效需要进行进一步的研究。
ext.ext_en: Further studies will be needed to see if these therapies have any value...

defs.def_en: The value of something such as a quality, attitude, or method is its importance or usefulness. If you place a particular value on something, that is the importance or usefulness you think it has.

ext.ext_cn: 我以前和韦斯顿先生有过业务往来，我很重视他给我的业务。
ext.ext_en: I've done business with Mr Weston before. I value the work he gives me...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你重视自己的健康，你就要开始对自己好一点。
ext.ext_en: If you value your health then you'll start being a little kinder to yourself.

defs.def_en: If you value something or someone, you think that they are important and you appreciate them.

ext.ext_cn: 他投入的资本已经增值了5万多美元。
ext.ext_en: The value of his investment has risen by more than $50,000...

ext.ext_cn: 该公司的市值涨到了55亿美元。
ext.ext_en: The company's market value rose to $5.5 billion...

defs.def_en: The value of something is how much money it is worth.

ext.ext_cn: 然后贷款方会派他们自己的评估员来对房产进行估价。
ext.ext_en: Your lender will then send their own surveyor to value the property...

ext.ext_cn: 我问他能否给我的珠宝进行保险估价。
ext.ext_en: I asked him if he would have my jewellery valued for insurance purposes...

defs.def_en: When experts value something, they decide how much money it is worth.

ext.ext_cn: 这家餐厅氛围轻松，装修雅致，而且价格非常公道。
ext.ext_en: The restaurant is informal, stylish and extremely good value...

ext.ext_cn: 两家的双人客房都报出了大约90英镑的超值价格。
ext.ext_en: Both offer excellent value at around £90 for a double room...

defs.def_en: You use value in certain expressions to say whether something is worth the money that it costs. For example, if something is or gives good value, it is worth the money that it costs.

ext.ext_cn: 南亚各国也有许多相同的价值观。
ext.ext_en: The countries of South Asia also share many common values...

ext.ext_cn: 卫生部部长呼吁传统家庭价值观的回归。
ext.ext_en: The Health Secretary called for a return to traditional family values.

defs.def_en: The values of a person or group are the moral principles and beliefs that they think are important.

defs.def_cn: 重要特点，显著特点（用于其他名词后）

ext.ext_cn: 时隔24年后，这个剧本已经完全失去了震撼力。
ext.ext_en: The script has lost all of its shock value over the intervening 24 years...

ext.ext_cn: 在上午10点左右开派对一定会增加新鲜感。
ext.ext_en: Having a mid-morning party certainly adds novelty value.

defs.def_en: Value is used after another noun when mentioning an important or noticeable feature about something.
A value is a particular number or quantity that can replace a symbol such as 'x' or 'y' in a mathematical expression.

ext.ext_cn: 她咕哝着：“天知道那个疯子在想什么。”
ext.ext_en: 'God knows what's happening in that madman's mind,' she muttered...

ext.ext_cn: 她能听到那个老妇人小声咕哝说考虑考虑。
ext.ext_en: She can hear the old woman muttering about consideration...

defs.def_en: If you mutter, you speak very quietly so that you cannot easily be heard, often because you are complaining about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一个偏狭、封闭的团体
ext.ext_en: ...an insular and inward-looking community.

defs.def_en: If you describe a people or society as inward-looking, you mean that they are more interested in themselves than in other people or societies.

defs.def_cn: （英国旧时为11岁左右儿童举行的）升中学甄别考试
defs.def_en: The eleven-plus is an exam which was taken by children in Britain at about the age of eleven, in order to decide which secondary school they should go to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 选择性的;有选择的;选取少量的

ext.ext_cn: 选择性交配繁殖有可能培育出比狼速度更快、视力更佳的灵犭是。
ext.ext_en: Selective breeding may result in a greyhound running faster and seeing better than a wolf.

ext.ext_cn: 尖子生教育
ext.ext_en: ...selective education.

defs.def_en: A selective process applies only to a few things or people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 仔细挑选的;严格筛选的

ext.ext_cn: 销量仍在，但购买者更加挑剔。
ext.ext_en: Sales still happen, but buyers are more selective...

ext.ext_cn: 如果公众人物想通过吸引公众的关注来推进事业，他们可能会不加选择。
ext.ext_en: If public figures seek publicity to further their careers, they can't be selective about it.

defs.def_en: When someone is selective, they choose things carefully, for example the things that they buy or do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (记忆)选择性的，只记一部分的

ext.ext_cn: 我们似乎只记得过去最美好的时光。
ext.ext_en: We seem to have a selective memory for the best bits of the past...

ext.ext_cn: 对于自己在该事件中所扮演的角色，罗宾斯先生患上了选择性失忆症，因此几乎在每次庭审中都会受到其他证人的反驳。
ext.ext_en: Mr Robins, suffering from selective amnesia about his role in the affair, was contradicted in nearly every instance by other witnesses.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a selective memory, you disapprove of the fact that they remember certain facts about something and deliberately forget others, often because it is convenient for them to do so.
A typewriter is a machine with keys which are pressed in order to print letters, numbers, or other characters onto paper.

defs.def_cn: (表示赞叹、非常吃惊或喜悦)哇，呀

ext.ext_cn: 我想：“哇，多好的主意呀。”
ext.ext_en: I thought, 'Wow, what a good idea'.

defs.def_en: You can say 'wow' when you are very impressed, surprised, or pleased.

ext.ext_cn: 本·坦卡德的爵士乐使众人为之叫绝。
ext.ext_en: Ben Tankard wowed the crowd with his jazz.

defs.def_en: You say that someone wows people when they give an impressive performance and fill people with enthusiasm and admiration.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为、活动)详细的，全面的，彻底的

ext.ext_cn: 我们正在进行彻底调查。
ext.ext_en: We are making a thorough investigation...

ext.ext_cn: 这个非常全面的调查可追溯到 1784 年。
ext.ext_en: This very thorough survey goes back to 1784...

defs.def_en: A thorough action or activity is one that is done very carefully and in a detailed way so that nothing is forgotten.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我想，马丁将会是个优秀的法官，他做事沉稳，头脑严谨。
ext.ext_en: Martin would be a good judge, I thought. He was calm and thorough...

ext.ext_cn: 那些人业务精通，作风严谨，态度认真。
ext.ext_en: The men were expert, thorough and careful.

defs.def_en: Someone who is thorough is always very careful in their work, so that nothing is forgotten.

defs.def_cn: 完全的，绝对的(用来强调程度)

ext.ext_cn: 我那时是个目空一切、自以为是的小学术愤青。
ext.ext_en: I was a thorough little academic snob...

ext.ext_cn: 我们认为那个乐队一塌糊涂。
ext.ext_en: We regard the band as a thorough shambles.

defs.def_en: Thorough is used to emphasize the great degree or extent of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他生性鲁莽草率，会做出自毁行为。
ext.ext_en: He had a reckless, self-destructive streak.

defs.def_en: Self-destructive behaviour is harmful to the person who behaves in that way.

defs.def_cn: 用打字机(或文字处理器)打出的
defs.def_en: A typewritten document has been typed on a typewriter or word processor.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 外表可能是靠不住的。
ext.ext_en: Appearances can be deceptive.

defs.def_en: If something is deceptive, it encourages you to believe something which is not true.

ext.ext_cn: 刚开始我对那种想法嗤之以鼻。
ext.ext_en: At first I scoffed at the notion...

ext.ext_cn: 你可能不以为然，但我真的认为我狠下心来只是出于一片好意。
ext.ext_en: You may scoff but I honestly feel I'm being cruel only to be kind...

defs.def_en: If you scoff at something, you speak about it in a way that shows you think it is ridiculous or inadequate.

ext.ext_cn: 那些薄饼太好吃了，我狼吞虎咽地都吃下去了。
ext.ext_en: The pancakes were so good that I scoffed the lot.

defs.def_en: If you scoff food, you eat it quickly and greedily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有趣的;引人入胜的;奇怪的

ext.ext_cn: 这本引人入胜的书既有思想性又富知识性。
ext.ext_en: This intriguing book is both thoughtful and informative.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as intriguing, you mean that it is interesting or strange.
A flick-knife is a knife with a blade in the handle that springs out when a button is pressed.

ext.ext_cn: 2,000个人互相推推搡搡，撞在家具上。
ext.ext_en: You get 2,000 people jostling each other and bumping into furniture...

ext.ext_cn: 我们购物的时候，花了1个钟头在人群中挤来挤去。
ext.ext_en: We spent an hour jostling with the crowds as we did our shopping...

defs.def_en: If people jostle you, they bump against you or push you in a way that annoys you, usually because you are in a crowd and they are trying to get past you.

ext.ext_cn: 一直在争夺这一高级职位的竞争者们
ext.ext_en: ...the contenders who have been jostling for the top job...

ext.ext_cn: 有大量各种题材的报道争着上今天报纸的头版。
ext.ext_en: There is a wide spread of stories jostling for coverage on today's front pages.

defs.def_en: If people or things are jostling for something such as attention or a reward, they are competing with other people or things in order to get it.
A pouch is a flexible container like a small bag.
The pouch of an animal such as a kangaroo or a koala bear is the pocket of skin on its stomach in which its baby grows.

ext.ext_cn: 选择防晒护唇膏来增强保护。
ext.ext_en: For added protection choose a lipstick with a sun screen.

defs.def_en: You use added to say that something has more of a particular thing or quality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他甚至令对手也不得不尊重他。
ext.ext_en: He even earned his opponents' grudging respect...

ext.ext_cn: 这一局面看来已经被勉强接受。
ext.ext_en: There seems to be a grudging acceptance of the situation.

defs.def_en: A grudging feeling or action is felt or done very unwillingly.

ext.ext_cn: 他走到当地的投票中心投了票。
ext.ext_en: He walked to the local polling centre to cast his vote...

ext.ext_cn: 政府获得了远远超过400票赞成的绝大多数票。
ext.ext_en: The government got a massive majority — well over 400 votes...

defs.def_en: A vote is a choice made by a particular person or group in a meeting or an election.

ext.ext_cn: 为什么你认为我们应该对那件事进行表决？
ext.ext_en: Why do you think we should have a vote on that?...

ext.ext_cn: 他们进行了表决，决定放弃。
ext.ext_en: They took a vote and decided not to do it.

defs.def_en: A vote is an occasion when a group of people make a decision by each person indicating his or her choice. The choice that most people support is accepted by the group.

ext.ext_cn: 反对党大约赢得了55％的选票。
ext.ext_en: Opposition parties won about fifty-five per cent of the vote...

ext.ext_cn: 压倒多数的选票投给了民主党。
ext.ext_en: The vote was overwhelmingly in favour of the Democratic Party.

defs.def_en: The vote is the total number of votes or voters in an election, or the number of votes received or cast by a particular group.

ext.ext_cn: 当然了，我们连投票权都没有，不是吗？
ext.ext_en: And of course we didn't even have the vote, did we?...

ext.ext_cn: 在那之前，妇女连选举权都没有。
ext.ext_en: Before that, women did not have a vote at all...

defs.def_en: If you have the vote in an election, or have a vote in a meeting, you have the legal right to indicate your choice.

ext.ext_cn: 全国选民的2/3有机会在这些选举中投票。
ext.ext_en: Two-thirds of the national electorate had the chance to vote in these elections...

ext.ext_cn: 如果有一个新领导人的话，大选时似乎许多人都会投票支持政府。
ext.ext_en: It seems many people would vote for the government, at a general election, if there was a new leader...

defs.def_en: When you vote, you indicate your choice officially at a meeting or in an election, for example by raising your hand or writing on a piece of paper.

defs.def_cn: 投…的票；投（赞成或反对）票

ext.ext_cn: 52.5％的受访者表示他们会投工党的票。
ext.ext_en: 52.5% of those questioned said they'd vote Labour...

ext.ext_cn: 无论如何我可能都会那样投票。
ext.ext_en: I probably would have voted that way anyway...

defs.def_en: If you vote a particular political party or leader, or vote yes or no, you make that choice with the vote that you have.

defs.def_cn: （通过投票）决定给予（资助），同意提供（款项）

ext.ext_cn: 州议会投票决定拨款2,500美元为他建一座纪念碑。
ext.ext_en: The General Court had voted $2,500 for a monument to be erected to his memory...

ext.ext_cn: 国会投票同意拨出更多资金来维持美国军队的开支。
ext.ext_en: The Parliament voted more funds to help maintain American forces.

defs.def_en: If a government or other organization votes money for something or to do something, they decide to spend the money in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 他被班里评选为“为耶鲁作出最大贡献”的人。
ext.ext_en: His class voted him the man 'who had done the most for Yale.'...

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔被评为“年度最佳球员”。
ext.ext_en: Michael has been voted Player of the Year.

defs.def_en: If people vote someone a particular title, they choose that person to have that title.

defs.def_cn: 以退席（或退出组织）表示反对

ext.ext_cn: 成千上万的公民正准备离开这个国家，以这一举动表示反对。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of citizens are already voting with their feet, and leaving the country...

ext.ext_cn: 作者依然可以通过退出并加盟规模小些的公司来表明他们的反对立场。
ext.ext_en: Authors still have power to vote with their feet by leaving to join smaller companies.

defs.def_en: If you vote with your feet, you show that you do not support something by leaving the place where it is happening or leaving the organization that is supporting it.

ext.ext_cn: 我建议我们全都立刻前往荷兰。
ext.ext_en: I vote that we all go to Holland immediately...

ext.ext_cn: 我提议由你来选我们该走哪条小路。
ext.ext_en: I vote that you try to pick out the trail for us.

defs.def_en: If you say 'vote that' a particular thing should happen, you are suggesting that this is what should happen.

ext.ext_cn: 古尔德先生号召采取“一人一票制”。
ext.ext_en: Mr Gould called for a move towards 'one man one vote'...

ext.ext_cn: 非洲国民大会坚持实行一人一票的制度。
ext.ext_en: The African National Congress insists on a one-man, one-vote system.

defs.def_en: One man one vote or one person one vote is a system of voting in which every person in a group or country has the right to cast their vote, and in which each individual's  vote is counted and has equal value.

ext.ext_cn: 他需要的是征询别人的意见，而不是独自思考。
ext.ext_en: He needed a sounding board rather than thinking alone.

defs.def_en: If you use someone as a sounding board, you discuss your ideas with them in order to get another opinion.
The rhythm section of a band is the musicians whose main job is to supply the rhythm. It usually consists of bass and drums, and sometimes keyboard instruments.

ext.ext_cn: 摔跤锦标赛比赛
ext.ext_en: ...a championship wrestling match.

defs.def_en: Wrestling is a sport in which two people wrestle and try to throw each other to the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 猎人潜行追踪猎物。
ext.ext_en: The hunters stalked their prey.

ext.ext_cn: 猎鹿人
ext.ext_en: ...a deer hunter.

defs.def_en: A hunter is a person who hunts wild animals for food or as a sport.

ext.ext_cn: 求职者
ext.ext_en: ...job-hunters.

ext.ext_cn: 寻宝人
ext.ext_en: ...treasure hunters.

defs.def_en: See also:bargain hunter;headhunter;People who are searching for things of a particular kind are often referred to as hunters .

defs.def_cn: （英国猎狐者乘骑的强壮的）猎狐马
defs.def_en: A hunter is a type of fast strong horse that is used in Britain by people who hunt foxes.
