defs.def_cn: （表示确信对方说的不对）敢打赌吗？

ext.ext_cn: “金钱买不到幸福。”——“敢打赌吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'Money can't buy happiness.' — 'Want to bet?'

defs.def_en: If you reply 'Do you want to bet?' or 'Want a bet?' to someone, you mean you are certain that what they have said is wrong.

ext.ext_cn: “那么，就这么定了？”——“定了。”
ext.ext_en: 'It's settled, then?' — 'You bet.'...

ext.ext_cn: “你怕蛇吗？”——“这还用问，我当然怕啦。”
ext.ext_en: 'Are you afraid of snakes?' — 'You bet your life I'm afraid of snakes.'

defs.def_en: You use 'You bet' or 'you bet your life' to say yes in an emphatic way or to emphasize a reply or statement.

ext.ext_cn: 回教学校
ext.ext_en: ...Koranic schools.

defs.def_en: Koranic is used to describe something which belongs or relates to the Koran.
A whore is the same as a prostitute .
If you call a woman a whore, you disapprove of her because you consider her sexual behaviour to be immoral or unacceptable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 味道强烈的；气味刺激的

ext.ext_cn: 用的香草越多，调味汁的味道就越浓烈。
ext.ext_en: The more herbs you use, the more pungent the sauce will be.

ext.ext_cn: 橡胶燃烧产生的刺鼻气味
ext.ext_en: ...the pungent smell of burning rubber.

defs.def_en: Something that is pungent has a strong, sharp smell or taste which is often so strong that it is unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 一语道破的；一针见血的

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢剧中尖锐机敏、一针见血的社会分析。
ext.ext_en: He enjoyed the play's shrewd and pungent social analysis.

defs.def_en: If you describe what someone has said or written as pungent, you approve of it because it has a direct and powerful effect and often criticizes something very cleverly.

ext.ext_cn: 他突然勃然大怒。
ext.ext_en: He exploded in a paroxysm of rage.

ext.ext_cn: 突然悲痛欲绝
ext.ext_en: ...a paroxysm of grief.

defs.def_en: A paroxysm of emotion is a sudden, very strong occurrence of it.

defs.def_cn: （咳嗽、大笑或剧痛引起的）身体震颤；阵发

ext.ext_cn: 他突然猛咳了一阵。
ext.ext_en: He broke into a paroxysm of coughing.

defs.def_en: A paroxysm is a series of sudden, violent, uncontrollable movements that your body makes because you are coughing, laughing, or in great pain.

ext.ext_cn: 有 20 万份菌类标本被保存在科马罗夫植物研究所。
ext.ext_en: 200,000 specimens of fungus are kept at the Komarov Botanical Institute.

ext.ext_cn: 北美化石标本
ext.ext_en: ...North American fossil specimens...

defs.def_en: A specimen is a single plant or animal which is an example of a particular species or type and is examined by scientists.

ext.ext_cn: 求职者必须要提交一份笔迹样本。
ext.ext_en: Job applicants have to submit a specimen of handwriting.

ext.ext_cn: 样钞
ext.ext_en: ...a specimen bank note.

defs.def_en: A specimen of something is an example of it which gives an idea of what the whole of it is like.

defs.def_cn: (供检验用的尿、血液等体液的)抽样，样本

ext.ext_cn: 他拒绝提供血样。
ext.ext_en: He refused to provide a specimen...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你的尿样显示有细菌存在，医生会给你开抗生素。
ext.ext_en: If your urine specimen shows the presence of bacteria, you'll be prescribed antibiotics.

defs.def_en: A specimen is a small quantity of someone's urine, blood, or other body fluid which is examined in a medical laboratory, in order to find out if they are ill or if they have been drinking alcohol or taking drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 那孩子真不幸！
ext.ext_en: What a poor specimen that child is!...

ext.ext_cn: 他是他那类人的典型代表。
ext.ext_en: He is a fine specimen of his class.

defs.def_en: You can use specimen to refer to someone who has a quality of a particular kind.

ext.ext_cn: 科学机构一直不愿作出更正。
ext.ext_en: Scientific institutions have been reluctant to take corrective action...

ext.ext_cn: 他的头骨做过大面积的矫形手术。
ext.ext_en: He has received extensive corrective surgery to his skull.

defs.def_en: Corrective measures or techniques are intended to put right something that is wrong.

defs.def_cn: 起纠正作用的东西;修正

ext.ext_cn: 对所有的心理学者都是行为主义者这一错误观点的有效纠正
ext.ext_en: ...a useful corrective to the mistaken view that all psychologists are behaviourists.

defs.def_en: If something is a corrective to a particular view or account, it gives a more accurate or fairer picture than there would have been without it.

ext.ext_cn: 尼娜将银餐具收拾到盒子里去的时候发现少了一把调羹。
ext.ext_en: There was a serving spoon missing when Nina put the silverware back in its box.

defs.def_en: You can use silverware to refer to all the things in a house that are made of silver, especially the cutlery and dishes.

defs.def_cn: (新闻用语中有时指体育比赛中的)银杯

ext.ext_cn: 埃弗顿展示了他们最近获得的银杯。
ext.ext_en: Everton paraded their recently acquired silverware.

defs.def_en: Journalists sometimes use silverware to refer to silver cups and other prizes won by sports teams or players.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 非典型的；不突出的；泛泛的

ext.ext_cn: 在许多方面，安妮塔·卢斯看着都不像是从事剧本创作这一行的。
ext.ext_en: Anita Loos was in many respects untypical of the screenwriting trade...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为我们的成绩算是突出的。
ext.ext_en: I believe our results are not untypical.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is untypical of a particular type of person or thing, they are not a good example of the way that type of person or thing normally is. People sometimes say something is not untypical when they mean that it is quite normal.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们的制服破破烂烂的，沾满了烟尘。
ext.ext_en: Their uniforms are torn and sooty.

defs.def_en: Something that is sooty is covered with soot.
A steamboat is a boat or ship that has an engine powered by steam.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的帅是一种放荡不羁的帅。
ext.ext_en: He was handsome in a raffish kind of way...

ext.ext_cn: 剧院俗丽的观众席让人想起早先的时代。
ext.ext_en: The theatre's raffish auditorium recalls an earlier era.

defs.def_en: Raffish people and places are not very respectable but are attractive and stylish in spite of this.

ext.ext_cn: 仓库的税前利润为310万。
ext.ext_en: Storehouse made pre-tax profits of 3.1m.

ext.ext_cn: 去年其税前收入为250万。
ext.ext_en: Last year it made 2.5m pre-tax.

defs.def_en: Pre-tax profits or losses are the total profits or losses made by a company before tax has been taken away.

defs.def_cn: 对（尤指女性或儿童）进行性骚扰;猥亵

ext.ext_cn: 他被指控对一位女同事进行性骚扰。
ext.ext_en: He was accused of sexually molesting a female colleague.

defs.def_en: A person who molests someone, especially a woman or a child, interferes with them in a sexual way against their will.

ext.ext_cn: 乌鸦在头顶盘旋,寻觅着腐肉。
ext.ext_en: Crows circled overhead, looking for carrion.

defs.def_en: Carrion is the decaying flesh of dead animals.

defs.def_cn: 酒后驾车者;醉酒驾驶者

ext.ext_cn: 酒后驾车引起的车祸
ext.ext_en: ...a car accident caused by a drunk driver.

defs.def_en: A drunk driver is someone who drives after drinking more than the amount of alcohol that is legally allowed.
Illiteracy is the state of not knowing how to read or write.
A person's business card or their card is a small card which they give to other people, and which has their name and details of their job and company printed on it.
An off-road vehicle is a vehicle that is designed to travel over rough ground.

ext.ext_cn: 工会和石油公司之间仍然存在着相当大的敌意。
ext.ext_en: There is still much antagonism between trades unions and the oil companies...

ext.ext_cn: 旧怨重生。
ext.ext_en: Old antagonisms resurfaced.

defs.def_en: Antagonism between people is hatred or dislike between them. Antagonisms are instances of this.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不直截了当的;拐弯抹角的

ext.ext_cn: 这影射到了他的母亲。
ext.ext_en: It was an oblique reference to his mother...

ext.ext_cn: 戈尔丁先生谈及草率行事的危险，这是他在委婉地发出警告。
ext.ext_en: Mr Golding delivered an oblique warning, talking of the danger of sudden action.

defs.def_en: If you describe a statement as oblique, you mean that is not expressed directly or openly, making it difficult to understand.

ext.ext_cn: 它位于平原与大海之间，跟海岸线形成一个斜角。
ext.ext_en: It lies between the plain and the sea at an oblique angle to the coastline.

defs.def_en: An oblique line is a straight line that is not horizontal or vertical. An oblique angle is any angle other than a right angle.

ext.ext_cn: 法国西南部绵延起伏的乡村
ext.ext_en: ...the rolling countryside of south western France.

defs.def_en: Rolling hills are small hills with gentle slopes that extend a long way into the distance.

ext.ext_cn: 伯恩斯是一个走起路来一摇一晃的高大小伙子。
ext.ext_en: Burns is a big lad with a rolling gait.

defs.def_en: If someone has a rolling walk, they move from side to side as they walk.
If you say that someone is rolling in it or is rolling in money, you mean that they are very rich.

ext.ext_cn: 她写了本国际法教材。
ext.ext_en: She wrote a textbook on international law.

ext.ext_cn: 化学课本
ext.ext_en: ...a chemistry textbook.

defs.def_en: A textbook is a book containing facts about a particular subject that is used by people studying that subject.

ext.ext_cn: 这所房子是典型的中世纪民居。
ext.ext_en: The house is a textbook example of medieval domestic architecture...

ext.ext_cn: 法国电信是国有公司成功的典范。
ext.ext_en: France Telecom is a textbook model of what can be achieved by a state-owned company.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a textbook case or example, you are emphasizing that it provides a clear example of a type of situation or event.

defs.def_cn: 政治家风范;政治家的才干;政治家活动

ext.ext_cn: 他热情地称赞了两位领导人的政治家风范。
ext.ext_en: He praised the two leaders warmly for their statesmanship.

defs.def_en: Statesmanship is the skill and activities of a statesman.

ext.ext_cn: 进来后务必关上大门。
ext.ext_en: Just make sure you shut the gate after you...

ext.ext_cn: 纱门轻轻关上了。
ext.ext_en: The screen door shut gently.

defs.def_en: If you shut something such as a door or if it shuts, it moves so that it fills a hole or a space.

ext.ext_cn: 露西闭上了眼睛，这样就不会看到它发生了。
ext.ext_en: Lucy shut her eyes so she wouldn't see it happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他眼睛闭着，似乎睡着了。
ext.ext_en: His eyes were shut and he seemed to have fallen asleep.

defs.def_en: If you shut your eyes, you lower your eyelids so that you cannot see anything.

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼尔嘴巴张了张又合上了。
ext.ext_en: Daniel's mouth opened, and then shut again...

ext.ext_cn: 他张了张嘴，欲言又止。
ext.ext_en: He opened and shut his mouth, unspeaking.

defs.def_en: If your mouth shuts or if you shut your mouth, you place your lips firmly together.

defs.def_cn: (使)(商店、酒吧等公共场所)关门，停止营业，休息

ext.ext_cn: 现在博物馆或商店有一种说关就关的趋势。
ext.ext_en: There is a tendency to shut museums or shops at a moment's notice...

ext.ext_cn: 商店通常中午到下午 3 点关门，然后营业到很晚。
ext.ext_en: Shops usually shut from noon-3pm, and stay open late...

defs.def_en: When a store, bar, or other public building shuts or when someone shuts it, it is closed and you cannot use it until it is open again.

defs.def_cn: 故意忽视;故意不予理会;对…视若罔闻

ext.ext_cn: 我们对最浅显的事实视而不见，拒绝承认真相。
ext.ext_en: We shut our eyes to the plainest facts, refusing to admit the truth...

ext.ext_en: She was shutting her eyes to reality, just as she had done after Matthew died.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone shuts their eyes to something, you mean that they deliberately ignore something which they should deal with.

ext.ext_cn: 我不用告诉你，你自己也知道对所有这些事保密有多重要了吧。
ext.ext_en: I don't have to tell you how important it is for you to keep your mouth shut about all this...

ext.ext_cn: 他花钱雇我兄弟去杀了诺顿并给了他封口费。
ext.ext_en: He paid my brother to kill Norton and keep his mouth shut.

defs.def_en: If someone tells you to keep your mouth shut about something, they are telling you not to let anyone else know about it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果她当时保持沉默的话，她现在工作也就不会丢。
ext.ext_en: If she had kept her mouth shut she would still have her job now.

defs.def_en: If you keep your mouth shut, you do not express your opinions about something, even though you would like to.

ext.ext_cn: “喂， 闭嘴，对长者要尊重，”兰达对那男孩说。
ext.ext_en: 'Oi, shut your mouth and have respect for elders,' Langda said to the boy.

defs.def_en: If someone tells you to shut your mouth or shut your face, they are telling you very rudely to stop talking.

ext.ext_cn: 她的中心照顾着大约50名儿童，是全国众多非营利机构的典型代表。
ext.ext_en: Her center is typical of many across the country — a non-profit organization that cares for about 50 children.

defs.def_en: A non-profit organization is one which is not run with the aim of making a profit.

ext.ext_cn: 这样，其成员就可以不必诉诸战争来解决分歧。
ext.ext_en: It enabled its members to settle their differences without recourse to war...

ext.ext_cn: 公众认为唯一的办法就是上街游行。
ext.ext_en: The public believes its only recourse is to take to the streets.

defs.def_en: If you achieve something without recourse to a particular course of action, you succeed without carrying out that action. To have recourse to a particular course of action means to have to do that action in order to achieve something.

ext.ext_cn: 他们将会出名，但如果照现在这样发展下去，他们会自毁前程。
ext.ext_en: They're going to be famous, but unless something happens, they're going to self-destruct...

ext.ext_cn: 民主党在初选中自毁长城，所以才让他赢得了选举。
ext.ext_en: He won the election because the Democrats self-destructed in their primary.

defs.def_en: If someone self-destructs, they do something that seriously damages their chances of success.

defs.def_cn: 美女，美人（尤指聚会或群体中最漂亮的女人）

ext.ext_cn: 在主日学校她是她们班的班花。
ext.ext_en: She was the belle of her Sunday School class.

defs.def_en: A belle is a beautiful woman, especially the most beautiful woman at a party or in a group.

ext.ext_cn: 她羡慕罗伯特的聪明睿智。
ext.ext_en: She admired Robert's brainpower.

defs.def_en: Brainpower is intelligence or the ability to think.

defs.def_cn: （某组织或国家的）人才队伍，人才

ext.ext_cn: 一个国家的首要资源是其人才资源。
ext.ext_en: A country's principal resource is its brainpower.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the intelligent people in an organization or country as its brainpower .

ext.ext_cn: 他显然喜欢缀着闪闪亮片的夹克。
ext.ext_en: He certainly liked spangly jackets.

defs.def_en: Spangly clothes are decorated with a lot of small shiny objects.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 超然的;冷漠的;不带感情的

ext.ext_cn: 他试图不带感情地对待那些犯人，但是做不到。
ext.ext_en: He tries to remain emotionally detached from the prisoners, but fails...

ext.ext_cn: 行文冷静客观，一针见血。
ext.ext_en: It is written in a detached, precise style.

defs.def_en: Someone who is detached is not personally involved in something or has no emotional interest in it.
A detached house is one that is not joined to any other house.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人厌恶的;令人作呕的

ext.ext_cn: 这味道令人作呕。
ext.ext_en: It tasted disgusting...

ext.ext_cn: 吸烟是一个不良嗜好。
ext.ext_en: Smoking is a disgusting habit.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is disgusting, you are criticizing it because it is extremely unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 完全不能接受的;可怕的

ext.ext_cn: 由纳税人来资助这一项目实在是说不过去。
ext.ext_en: It's disgusting that the taxpayer is subsidising this project.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is disgusting, you mean that you find it completely unacceptable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 与多人发生性关系的；淫乱的；滥交的

ext.ext_en: She is perceived as vain, spoilt and promiscuous...

ext.ext_cn: 你知道滥交的危险。
ext.ext_en: You know the risks of promiscuous sex.

defs.def_en: Someone  who is promiscuous has sex with many different people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the dazzling, promiscuous display of new styles.

ext.ext_cn: 50年来博览群书以图一乐
ext.ext_en: ...fifty years of promiscuous reading in pursuit of pleasure.

defs.def_en: Promiscuous means including a wide range of different things.

defs.def_cn: 现实主义；现实态度；务实精神

ext.ext_cn: 现在是拿出更多政治务实精神的时候了。
ext.ext_en: It was time now to show more political realism...

ext.ext_cn: 之前年少时对理想抱负怀有的一腔热情很快便被现实浇灭。
ext.ext_en: The early ambitions of youthful enthusiasm soon become tempered with realism.

defs.def_en: When people show realism in their behaviour, they recognize and accept the true nature of a situation and try to deal with it in a practical way.

defs.def_cn: （绘画、小说或电影的）现实主义

ext.ext_cn: 格林的小说带有现实主义色彩，很容易让人忘记它们是虚构的。
ext.ext_en: Greene's stories had an edge of realism that made it easy to forget they were fiction...

ext.ext_cn: 真诚的表演和对波士顿这一背景城市的真实刻画增添了电影的现实主义色彩。
ext.ext_en: Sincere performances and gritty Boston settings add to the film's realism.

ext.ext_cn: 如果他落败，那他在那些投票支持他的人眼中基本就没有什么借口了。
ext.ext_en: If he fails, then he will have little excuse in the eyes of those who voted him in...

ext.ext_cn: 国民议会成员将以简单多数的方式选出一个首相。
ext.ext_en: The members of the national assembly will vote in a prime minister by a simple majority.

defs.def_en: If people vote in a particular person or political party, they give enough votes to that person or party in an official election for them to hold a position of power.

ext.ext_cn: 手工制作的猪皮皮箱
ext.ext_en: ...handmade pigskin luggage.

defs.def_en: Pigskin is leather made from the skin of a pig.

ext.ext_cn: 政府非法窃听了他的电话。
ext.ext_en: The government illegally eavesdropped on his telephone conversations...

ext.ext_cn: 女佣在厨房门后偷听。
ext.ext_en: The housemaid eavesdropped from behind the kitchen door.

defs.def_en: If you eavesdrop on someone, you listen secretly to what they are saying.

defs.def_cn: 太空人(主要为儿童用语)
defs.def_en: A spaceman is a male astronaut; used mainly by children.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的名字叫汉森，在挪威是一个常见的名字。
ext.ext_en: His name was Hansen, a common name in Norway...

ext.ext_cn: 石油污染是造成海鸟死亡最常见的原因。
ext.ext_en: Oil pollution is the commonest cause of death for seabirds...

defs.def_en: If something is common, it is found in large numbers or it happens often.

ext.ext_cn: 摩尔达维亚人和罗马尼亚人使用同一种语言。
ext.ext_en: Moldavians and Romanians share a common language...

ext.ext_cn: 这种行为在年轻人中司空见惯。
ext.ext_en: Such behaviour is common to all young people.

ext.ext_en: ...the common house fly.

defs.def_en: When there are more animals or plants of a particular species than there are of related species, then the first species is called common .

ext.ext_cn: 民主也许能提升普通人的政治地位，让他们产生优越感。
ext.ext_en: Democracy might elevate the common man to a position of political superiority...

ext.ext_en: Common salt is made up of 40% sodium and 60% chloride.

defs.def_en: Common is used to indicate that someone or something is of the ordinary kind and not special in any way.

defs.def_cn: 处境艰难;即将放弃;濒临失败;走投无路

ext.ext_cn: 军队声称叛军支撑不了多久了。
ext.ext_en: The army claims the rebels are on the ropes.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is on the ropes, you mean that they are very near to giving up or being defeated.

defs.def_cn: 教…如何做;教…方法;教…诀窍
defs.def_en: If you show someone the ropes, you show them how to do a particular job or task.

ext.ext_cn: 我们很快就注意到东北方有一个圆锥形的庞然大物。
ext.ext_en: We were soon aware of a great conical shape to the north-east.

defs.def_en: A conical object is shaped like a cone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 很多难民村落都在偏远地区。
ext.ext_en: Many of the refugee villages are in isolated areas...

ext.ext_cn: 奥布里家的农场非常偏僻。
ext.ext_en: Aubrey's family's farm is very isolated.

defs.def_en: An isolated place is a long way away from large towns and is difficult to reach.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 孤独的;孤寂的;孤立无援的

ext.ext_cn: 人们工作时可能感到孤立无助。
ext.ext_en: Men can feel isolated at work...

ext.ext_cn: 一些病人可能变得非常孤独沮丧。
ext.ext_en: Some patients may become very isolated and depressed.

defs.def_en: If you feel isolated, you feel lonely and without friends or help.

ext.ext_cn: 他们说这些指控与另一件欺诈案有关。
ext.ext_en: They said the allegations related to an isolated case of cheating.

defs.def_en: An isolated example is an example of something that is not very common.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If someone is tiddly, they are slightly drunk.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一张小图
ext.ext_en: ...a tiddly picture.

defs.def_en: If you describe a thing as tiddly, you mean that it is very small.

defs.def_cn: 一定会赢的;稳操胜券的;万无一失的

ext.ext_cn: 真奇怪，人们居然用了这么长时间才把握住一个万无一失的机会。
ext.ext_en: It is surprising that it has taken people so long to take advantage of what is a win-win opportunity.

defs.def_en: A win-win situation is one where you are certain to do well or be successful.

ext.ext_cn: 他将继续留在公司总经理这个不好坐的位子上。
ext.ext_en: He is to remain in the hot seat as chief executive.

defs.def_en: If you are in the hot seat, you are responsible for making important and difficult decisions.
Meteorology is the study of the processes in the Earth's atmosphere that cause particular weather conditions, especially in order to predict the weather.
A chopping board is a wooden or plastic board that you chop meat and vegetables on.

ext.ext_cn: 女权主义只是使女性陷入圈套的另一种手段。
ext.ext_en: Feminism is simply another device to ensnare women...

ext.ext_cn: 我们发现自己陷入了雇佣法案的圈套之中，因为它们并不能帮助解决劳资争端。
ext.ext_en: We find ourselves ensnared in employment acts which do not help resolve industrial disputes.

defs.def_en: If you ensnare someone, you gain power over them, especially by using dishonest or deceitful methods.

ext.ext_cn: 蜘蛛必须等待猎物被它的蛛网困住。
ext.ext_en: The spider must wait for prey to be ensnared on its web.

defs.def_en: If an animal is ensnared, it is caught in a trap.

ext.ext_cn: 事实证明，因特网对许多公司而言是一条行不通的路。
ext.ext_en: The Internet has proved a blind alley for many firms.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as a blind alley, you mean that progress is not possible or that the situation can have no useful results.

ext.ext_cn: 斯图尔特跳到海里给救生艇充气。
ext.ext_en: Stuart jumped into the sea and inflated the liferaft...

ext.ext_cn: 唐的救生衣未能充气膨胀。
ext.ext_en: Don's lifejacket had failed to inflate.

defs.def_en: If you inflate something such as a balloon or tyre, or if it inflates, it becomes bigger as it is filled with air or a gas.

ext.ext_cn: 大规模发行所需的广告宣传会增加一部电影的最终成本。
ext.ext_en: The promotion of a big release can inflate a film's final cost...

ext.ext_cn: 服装价格的涨幅不及汽车那么高。
ext.ext_en: Clothing prices have not inflated as much as automobiles.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone inflates the price of something, or that the price inflates, you mean that the price increases.

ext.ext_cn: 他们夸大客户伤势的严重性和治疗情形以欺骗保险公司。
ext.ext_en: They inflated clients' medical treatment to defraud insurance companies...

ext.ext_cn: 甚至他的参战履历也是夸大其词，充满谎言。
ext.ext_en: Even his war record was fraudulently inflated.

defs.def_en: If someone inflates the amount or effect of something, they say it is bigger, better, or more important than it really is, usually so that they can profit from it.
A thumbtack is a short pin with a broad flat top which is used for fastening papers or pictures to a board, wall, or other surface.
A circuit board is the same as a printed circuit board .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他看到了敌人冷酷的眼神。
ext.ext_en: He saw the pitiless eyes of his enemy...

ext.ext_cn: 他判决立下，毫不留情。
ext.ext_en: His judgments are immediate, pitiless.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is pitiless shows no pity or kindness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·斯坦贝克把尘土和烈日炙烤的天空用作小说的背景。
ext.ext_en: John Steinbeck used the dust and the pitiless skies as the backcloth to his novel.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as the weather or the heat as pitiless, you mean that it is very extreme.

defs.def_cn: (通常指按照法庭决议)扣押，查封(债务人资产)

ext.ext_cn: 他试图阻止法院扣押工会的资产。
ext.ext_en: He tried to prevent union money from being sequestrated by the courts.

defs.def_en: When property is sequestrated, it is taken officially from someone who has debts, usually after a decision in a court of law. If the debts are paid off, the property is returned to its owner.

ext.ext_cn: 我和这家人是好几年的邻居了，中间就隔着两家。
ext.ext_en: I had lived two doors away from this family for several years...

ext.ext_cn: 窗下的几个蓝色塑料盒里装满了唱片。
ext.ext_en: Several blue plastic boxes under the window were filled with record albums...

defs.def_en: Several is used to refer to an imprecise number of people or things that is not large but is greater than two.

ext.ext_cn: 含铁的金属
ext.ext_en: ...ferrous metals.

ext.ext_cn: 氯化铁
ext.ext_en: ...ferrous chloride.

defs.def_en: Ferrous means containing or relating to iron.

defs.def_cn: 结晶的;晶状的;含水晶的

ext.ext_cn: 钻石是碳元素的晶体结构。
ext.ext_en: Diamond is the crystalline form of the element carbon.

ext.ext_cn: 坚硬的水晶石
ext.ext_en: ...hard, crystalline rock.

defs.def_en: A crystalline substance is in the form of crystals or contains crystals.

ext.ext_cn: 辽阔的平原上遍布着清澈的湖泊
ext.ext_en: ...a huge plain dotted with crystalline lakes.

defs.def_en: Crystalline means clear or bright.

defs.def_cn: 缺乏某种特定知识（或经验）的人；不熟悉某种特定情况的人

ext.ext_cn: 对于外行人来说，西部摇摆是爵士乐、节奏布鲁斯、摇滚乐和乡村音乐的融合。
ext.ext_en: For the uninitiated, Western Swing is a fusion of jazz, rhythm & blues, rock & roll and country music...

ext.ext_cn: 不熟悉的人很难一下子体会到它的魅力。
ext.ext_en: Its appeal may not be immediately obvious to the uninitiated.

defs.def_en: You can refer to people who have no knowledge or experience of a particular subject or activity as the uninitiated .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他做了一个简单的手势，近乎霸道地指着椅子。
ext.ext_en: With a brief, almost peremptory gesture he pointed to a chair.

defs.def_en: Someone who does something in a peremptory way does it in a way that shows that they expect to be obeyed immediately.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 诵读困难的;阅读困难的

ext.ext_cn: 他被诊断患有严重的阅读困难症,但是却绝顶聪明。
ext.ext_en: He was diagnosed as severely dyslexic but extraordinarily bright.

defs.def_en: If someone is dyslexic, they have difficulty with reading because of a slight disorder of their brain.
A carriageway is one side of a road on which traffic travelling in opposite directions is separated by a barrier.
A druggist is someone who is qualified to sell medicines and drugs ordered by a doctor.
A druggist or a druggist's is a store where medicines and drugs ordered by a doctor are sold.

defs.def_cn: 全权；自由处理权；便宜行事权

ext.ext_cn: 他们授权他全权决定。
ext.ext_en: They gave him carte blanche to make decisions...

ext.ext_cn: 重新装修的事宜完全委托给她了。
ext.ext_en: She was given carte blanche with the redecoration.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you carte blanche, they give you the authority to do whatever you think is right.

defs.def_cn: 严格管理；严格控制；管制

ext.ext_cn: 受到过度的、官僚化的管制的社会生活中不存在民主。
ext.ext_en: Democracy is incompatible with excessive, bureaucratic regimentation of social life.

defs.def_en: Regimentation is very strict control over the way a group of people behave or the way something is done.

ext.ext_cn: 他近乎发疯般地追求着打破体育纪录。
ext.ext_en: He was almost maniacal in his pursuit of sporting records...

ext.ext_cn: 她弓身伏在方向盘前，表情像疯了一样。
ext.ext_en: She is hunched forward over the wheel with a maniacal expression.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as maniacal, you mean that it is extreme, violent, or very determined, as if the person were insane.

ext.ext_cn: 员工说他极度疲劳。
ext.ext_en: Staff say he is suffering from exhaustion.

ext.ext_cn: 神经疲惫不堪
ext.ext_en: ...nervous exhaustion.

defs.def_en: Exhaustion is the state of being so tired that you have no energy left.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的主要目标是将孩子安然无恙地找回来。
ext.ext_en: Our main objective was the recovery of the child safe and well...

ext.ext_cn: 他的目标是参加高尔夫球比赛并赢得胜利。
ext.ext_en: His objective was to play golf and win.

defs.def_en: Your objective is what you are trying to achieve.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有客观证据表明正在发生什么不同寻常之事。
ext.ext_en: He had no objective evidence that anything extraordinary was happening.

defs.def_en: Objective information is based on facts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （观点）客观的，不带个人感情的，没有个人偏见的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为新闻记者不应当有丝毫偏见。
ext.ext_en: I believe that a journalist should be completely objective...

ext.ext_cn: 我很想听听你对此事的客观见解。
ext.ext_en: I would really like to have your objective opinion on this.

defs.def_en: If someone is objective, they base their opinions on facts rather than on their personal feelings.

defs.def_cn: 臆造的事物;虚构的事物

ext.ext_cn: 袭击可不是我凭空想象出来的。
ext.ext_en: The attack wasn't just a figment of my imagination.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a figment of someone's imagination, you mean that it does not really exist and that they are just imagining it.

ext.ext_cn: 保障房的短缺
ext.ext_en: ...a shortage of affordable housing...

ext.ext_cn: 住房条件差、家庭压力大会影响身心两方面的健康。
ext.ext_en: Poor housing and family stress can affect both physical and mental health.

defs.def_en: You refer to the buildings in which people live as housing when you are talking about their standard, price, or availability.

ext.ext_cn: 住房建设和公共管理的研究生课程
ext.ext_en: ...graduate courses in housing and public administration...

ext.ext_cn: 市建住房租户请就该问题致电住房部。
ext.ext_en: If you are a council tenant call the housing department about it.

defs.def_en: Housing is the job of providing houses for people to live in.

ext.ext_cn: 两个机罩的防水深度均为两米。
ext.ext_en: Both housings are waterproof to a depth of two metres.

defs.def_en: A housing is a case or covering which protects parts of a machine.

ext.ext_cn: 我肯定是睡着了。
ext.ext_en: I must have dropped off to sleep...

ext.ext_cn: 就在我打瞌睡的时候,一个奇怪的念头闪过我的脑海。
ext.ext_en: Just as I was dropping off, a strange thought crossed my mind.

defs.def_en: If you drop off to sleep, you go to sleep.

ext.ext_cn: 预计对英国军队的销售量会减少。
ext.ext_en: Sales to the British forces are expected to drop off...

ext.ext_cn: 每日伤亡人数已经大大减少。
ext.ext_en: The daily toll of casualties has dropped off sharply.

defs.def_en: If the level of something drops off, it becomes less.

defs.def_cn: （往返于港口间接送旅客的）港口联运火车，水陆联运列车
defs.def_en: A boat train is a train that takes you to or from a port.
Lactose is a type of sugar which is found in milk and which is sometimes added to food.

ext.ext_cn: 像托特纳姆和佩卡姆这样的内陆地区失业人口达1/4。
ext.ext_en: One in four people are now jobless in inner areas like Tottenham and Peckham.

ext.ext_cn: 失业人数
ext.ext_en: ...the number of jobless people.

defs.def_en: Someone who is jobless does not have a job, although they would like one.

defs.def_cn: (基于 20 世纪 20 年代爵士乐的)传统爵士乐
defs.def_en: Trad or trad jazz is a kind of jazz based on the jazz that was played in the 1920s.

ext.ext_cn: 旗子是红色的，中央有个白色大圆圈。
ext.ext_en: The flag was red, with a large white circle in the center...

ext.ext_cn: 我写下46这个数字，又画了个圆将它圈起来。
ext.ext_en: I wrote down the number 46 and drew a circle around it.

defs.def_en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

ext.ext_cn: 切出四块圆形油酥面饼。
ext.ext_en: Cut out 4 circles of pastry.

ext.ext_cn: 圆形黄光区
ext.ext_en: ...a circle of yellow light.

defs.def_en: A circle of something is a round flat piece or area of it.

ext.ext_cn: 纪念碑由一圈巨石组成。
ext.ext_en: The monument consists of a circle of gigantic stones...

ext.ext_cn: 我们站成一圈，手牵着手。
ext.ext_en: We stood in a circle holding hands.

defs.def_en: A circle of objects or people is a group of them arranged in the shape of a circle.

ext.ext_cn: 这是环绕市区的环路。
ext.ext_en: This is the ring road that circles the city.

ext.ext_cn: 围绕着大片修剪过的草坪的长长的弧形车道
ext.ext_en: ...the long curving driveway that circled around the vast clipped lawn.

defs.def_en: If something circles an object or a place, or circles around it, it forms a circle around it.

ext.ext_cn: 飞机在天上盘旋，等候着陆许可。
ext.ext_en: The plane circled, awaiting permission to land...

ext.ext_cn: 有两架直升机在空中盘旋。
ext.ext_en: There were two helicopters circling around.

defs.def_en: If an aircraft or a bird circles or circles something, it moves round in a circle in the air.

ext.ext_cn: 埃米莉围着她妈妈转个不停。
ext.ext_en: Emily kept circling around her mother...

ext.ext_cn: 悄无声息的群狼会跟踪并包围他们。
ext.ext_en: The silent wolves would track and circle them.

defs.def_en: To circle around someone or something, or to circle them, means to move around them.

ext.ext_cn: 将下面参赛券上的正确答案圈出来。
ext.ext_en: Circle the correct answers on the coupon below.

defs.def_en: If you circle something on a piece of paper, you draw a circle around it.

defs.def_cn: (指朋友或有相同兴趣或职业的人组成的)圈子，界

ext.ext_cn: 他的朋友圈子很小。
ext.ext_en: He has a small circle of friends...

ext.ext_cn: 奥尔顿把自己搞得在某些圈子里极其不受欢迎。
ext.ext_en: Alton has made himself fiercely unpopular in certain circles.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a group of people as a circle when they meet each other regularly because they are friends or because they belong to the same profession or share the same interests.
In a theatre or cinema, the circle is an area of seats on the upper floor.

defs.def_cn: 兜了一圈回到原地;循环

ext.ext_cn: 风水轮流转，时下最流行的又是深蓝色牛仔裤了。
ext.ext_en: We've come full circle and dark-blue jeans are once again the height of style.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have come full circle or have turned full circle, you mean that after a long series of events or changes the same situation that you started with still exists.

defs.def_cn: 在原地兜圈子;原地踏步;毫无进展
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is going round in circles or around in circles, you mean that they are not achieving anything because they keep coming back to the same point or problem.

defs.def_cn: (声音)合成的，用合成器制作的

ext.ext_cn: 如果车开得太快，会有一个合成人声告诉司机减速。
ext.ext_en: If the vehicle is going too fast, a synthesised voice tells the driver to slow down.

ext.ext_cn: 合成舞曲
ext.ext_en: ...synthesised dance music.

defs.def_en: Synthesized sounds are produced electronically using a synthesizer.

ext.ext_cn: 专家们认为即将发生的旱灾将侵袭大片地区。
ext.ext_en: Experts believe that the coming drought will be extensive...

ext.ext_cn: 我想你拿了我什么东西。
ext.ext_en: I believe you have something of mine...

defs.def_en: If you believe that something is true, you think that it is true, but you are not sure.

ext.ext_cn: 他听起来似乎并不相信她。
ext.ext_en: He did not sound as if he believed her...

ext.ext_cn: 永远不要相信一个已婚男人说的任何有关他妻子的话。
ext.ext_en: Never believe anything a married man says about his wife...

defs.def_en: If you believe someone or if you believe what they say or write, you accept that they are telling the truth.

ext.ext_cn: 我不相信有鬼。
ext.ext_en: I don't believe in ghosts...

ext.ext_cn: 你相信魔法真的存在吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you believe in magic?

defs.def_en: If you believe in fairies, ghosts, or miracles, you are sure that they exist or happen. If you believe in a god, you are sure of the existence of that god.

defs.def_cn: 认为…是应该的（或正确的）

ext.ext_cn: 他认为婚内应该忠诚。
ext.ext_en: He believed in marital fidelity.

ext.ext_cn: 信奉民主政治的正派候选人
ext.ext_en: ...decent candidates who believed in democracy.

defs.def_en: If you believe in a way of life or an idea, you are in favour of it because you think it is good or right.

ext.ext_cn: 只要自信，就能成功。
ext.ext_en: If you believe in yourself you can succeed.

defs.def_en: If you believe in someone or what they are doing, you have confidence in them and think that they will be successful.

ext.ext_cn: 很多和我谈过的官员都觉得发生在他们周围的事情令人难以置信。
ext.ext_en: Many officers I spoke to found it hard to believe what was happening around them...

ext.ext_cn: 我那时身心俱疲——现在还难以相信我是怎么把一些事情做成的。
ext.ext_en: I was a physical and emotional wreck — I still can't believe how I ever got any work done.

defs.def_en: Believe is used in expressions such as I can't believe how or it's hard to believe that in order to express surprise, for example because something bad has happened or something very difficult has been achieved.

defs.def_cn: （表示对所见所闻惊讶不已）相信自己的眼睛/耳朵

ext.ext_cn: 我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。她比我想象的漂亮多了。
ext.ext_en: I could not believe my eyes. She was far more beautiful than I had imagined.

defs.def_en: If you say that you cannot believe your eyes or cannot believe your ears, you are emphasizing that you are very surprised about something you have seen or heard.

defs.def_cn: （强调刚才所述之事令人吃惊）信不信由你

ext.ext_cn: 那很正常，信不信由你。
ext.ext_en: That's normal, believe it or not.

defs.def_en: You can use believe it or not to emphasize that what you have just said is surprising.

defs.def_cn: （强调对某事感到惊讶）你会相信吗？

ext.ext_cn: 你信吗？他比我年轻！
ext.ext_en: And would you believe it, he's younger than me!

defs.def_en: If you say would you believe it, you are emphasizing your surprise about something.

ext.ext_cn: 这太不可思议了，真的。
ext.ext_en: It's absolutely amazing, believe you me.

defs.def_en: You can use believe you me to emphasize that what you are saying is true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她母亲糊里糊涂，丢三落四。
ext.ext_en: Her mother is scatty and absent-minded.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as scatty, you mean that they often forget things or behave in a silly way.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个无耻的骗子！
ext.ext_en: He is a lying scoundrel!
