ext.ext_en: The gallant soldiers lost their lives so that peace might reign again.

defs.def_en: If someone is gallant, they behave bravely and honourably in a dangerous or difficult situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他在与疾病进行了顽强的抗争后故去，享年82岁。
ext.ext_en: He died at the age of 82, after a gallant fight against illness.

defs.def_en: A gallant effort or fight is one in which someone tried very hard to do something difficult, although in the end they failed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 道格拉斯让人捉摸不透，他体贴周到，对女孩子颇为殷勤，而且慷慨大方。
ext.ext_en: Douglas was a complex man, thoughtful, gallant, and generous.

defs.def_en: If a man is gallant, he is kind, polite, and considerate towards women.

defs.def_cn: 未尝试过的;未经试验的

ext.ext_cn: 他年纪轻，经验浅，没名气。
ext.ext_en: He was young and untried, with no reputation of his own.

ext.ext_cn: 在新的法律领域进行的一场长久的法律战
ext.ext_en: ...a long legal battle through untried areas of law.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is untried, they have not yet experienced certain situations or have not yet been tried out, so you do not know what they will be like.
A fish knife is a knife that you use when you eat fish. It has a wide flat blade and does not have a sharp edge.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 毫无激情的学者
ext.ext_en: ...a passionless academic.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经结束的那段明显毫无激情的婚姻
ext.ext_en: ...their late and apparently passionless marriage.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as passionless, you mean that they do not have or show strong feelings.

defs.def_cn: 极乐鸟，天堂鸟（一种鸣禽，主要见于新几内亚，雄鸟羽毛颜色极鲜艳）
defs.def_en: A bird of paradise is a songbird which is found mainly in New Guinea. The male birds have very brightly coloured feathers.

ext.ext_cn: 一幢木屋的建筑模型
ext.ext_en: ...an architect's model of a wooden house.

ext.ext_cn: 实际应用的整个旧金山湾区比例模型
ext.ext_en: ...a working scale model of the whole Bay Area...

defs.def_en: A model of an object is a physical representation that shows what it looks like or how it works. The model is often smaller than the object it represents.

ext.ext_cn: 我们认为这可以作为管理活动的普遍范例。
ext.ext_en: We believe that this is a general model of managerial activity...

ext.ext_cn: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。
ext.ext_en: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.

defs.def_en: A model is a system that is being used and that people might want to copy in order to achieve similar results.

ext.ext_cn: 达尔文最终提出了生物进化的模型。
ext.ext_en: Darwin eventually put forward a model of biological evolution...

ext.ext_cn: 他提出了一个人体内应激反应的模型。
ext.ext_en: He proposed a model of stress reaction in the body.

defs.def_en: A model of a system or process is a theoretical description that can help you understand how the system or process works, or how it might work.

defs.def_cn: 创立(系统或过程）的（理论描述)模型

ext.ext_cn: 创立诸如大气层之类的非线性系统的模型所需的数学知识
ext.ext_en: ...the mathematics needed to model a nonlinear system like an atmosphere.

defs.def_en: If someone such as a scientist models a system or process, they make an accurate theoretical description of it in order to understand or explain how it works.

ext.ext_cn: 作为一个非常懂礼貌的人，他已经学会了克制内心的任何愤怒情绪。
ext.ext_en: A model of good manners, he has conquered any inward fury...

ext.ext_cn: 他的婚姻和家庭生活都是规规矩矩的。
ext.ext_en: His marriage and family life is a model of propriety.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is a model of a particular quality, you are showing approval of them because they have that quality to a large degree.

ext.ext_cn: 还是个小女孩的时候，她就是一个模范学生。
ext.ext_en: As a girl she had been a model pupil...

ext.ext_cn: 医务人员说他是一个模范病人。
ext.ext_en: Hospital staff say he is a model patient.

defs.def_en: You use model to express approval of someone when you think that they perform their role or duties extremely well.

defs.def_cn: 按特定模型制造;仿特定样式做出

ext.ext_cn: 该配额制度是仿照美国以及欧洲大陆国家的同类制度制定的。
ext.ext_en: The quota system was modelled on those operated in America and continental Europe...

ext.ext_cn: 这个节目将仿照英国广播公司的人气系列剧《阿彻一家》制作。
ext.ext_en: The program will be modeled after a popular BBC series called 'The Archers'...

defs.def_en: If one thing is modelled on another, the first thing is made so that it is like the second thing in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 以年纪较长的女性作为自己仿效的对象绝没有什么不对。
ext.ext_en: There's absolutely nothing wrong in modelling yourself on an older woman...

ext.ext_cn: 他们会倾向于模仿老师的行为举止。
ext.ext_en: They will tend to model their behaviour on the teacher's behaviour.

defs.def_en: If you model yourself on someone, you copy the way that they do things, because you admire them and want to be like them.

ext.ext_cn: 要想花钱少些，就选择基本的型号。
ext.ext_en: To keep the cost down, opt for a basic model...

ext.ext_cn: 该型号的编号为1870/285。
ext.ext_en: The model number is 1870/285.

defs.def_en: A particular model of a machine is a particular version of it.  →see usage note at:brand
An artist's model is a person who stays still in a particular position so that the artist can make a picture or sculpture of them.

ext.ext_cn: 图利奥已为桑德拉做了11年的模特儿。
ext.ext_en: Tullio has been modelling for Sandra for eleven years.

defs.def_en: If someone models for an artist, they stay still in a particular position so that the artist can make a picture or sculpture  of them.

ext.ext_cn: 巴黎顶尖时装摄影模特儿
ext.ext_en: ...Paris's top photographic fashion model.

defs.def_en: A fashion model is a person whose job is to display clothes by wearing them.

ext.ext_cn: 我不是到这里来当时装模特儿的。
ext.ext_en: I wasn't here to model clothes...

ext.ext_cn: 她15岁就开始在巴黎做时装模特儿。
ext.ext_en: She began modelling in Paris aged 15.

defs.def_en: If someone models clothes, they display them by wearing them.

defs.def_cn: (用黏土、木头等)做…的模型;塑造

ext.ext_cn: 在那儿她开始用黏土做模型。
ext.ext_en: There she began to model in clay...

ext.ext_cn: 她有时刻木雕，有时刻石雕，有时塑泥塑。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes she carved wood and sometimes stone; sometimes she modelled clay...

defs.def_en: If you model shapes or figures, you make them out of a substance such as clay or wood.

defs.def_cn: (尤指身居要职的)一本正经的人，古板的人，保守的人

ext.ext_cn: 穿上一套细条纹西装后，他马上就显得一本正经起来。
ext.ext_en: In a pinstriped suit he instantly looked like a stuffed shirt.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone, especially someone with an important position, as a stuffed shirt, you mean that they are extremely formal and old-fashioned.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 穿着牛仔服和运动鞋、瘦高又笨拙的几个年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...a gangly youth dressed in jeans and trainers.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as gangly, you mean that they are tall and thin and have a slightly awkward or clumsy manner.
Compressed air or gas is squeezed into a small space or container and is therefore at a higher pressure than normal. It is used especially as a source of power for machines.

defs.def_cn: (与名词连用构成形容词)表示“呈…形状的”

ext.ext_cn: 心形的大树叶
ext.ext_en: ...large, heart-shaped leaves.

ext.ext_cn: L 形长沙发
ext.ext_en: ...an L-shaped settee.

defs.def_en: -shaped combines with nouns to form adjectives that describe the shape of an object.

ext.ext_cn: 狱吏冲进牢房把他吊死了。
ext.ext_en: Guards rushed into his cell and strung him up.

defs.def_en: To string someone up means to kill them by hanging them.
An SUV is a powerful vehicle with four-wheel drive that can be driven over rough ground. SUV is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'sport utility vehicle'.

defs.def_cn: （有先天性心脏缺陷的）青紫婴儿
defs.def_en: A blue baby is a baby whose skin is slightly blue because it has been born with something wrong with its heart.
Silage is food for cattle that is made by cutting a crop such as grass or corn when it is green and then keeping it covered.

defs.def_cn: 蝇量级拳击手，次最轻量级拳击手(体重不超过 112 磅)
defs.def_en: A flyweight is a boxer who weighs 112 pounds or less.
A tech is the same as a technical college .

ext.ext_cn: 8月份这个国家的平均收入又上了一个台阶。
ext.ext_en: Average earnings in the economy moved up another notch in August...

ext.ext_cn: 在这个国家，优秀选手的水平降了一两个档次。
ext.ext_en: In this country the good players are pulled down a notch or two...

defs.def_en: You can refer to a level on a scale of measurement or achievement as a notch .

ext.ext_cn: 史蒂夫·布尔为狼队攻入了他的第200粒进球，他们以3比0击败了莱斯特队。
ext.ext_en: Steve Bull notched his 200th goal for Wolves as they beat Leicester 3-0...

ext.ext_cn: 总统渴望获得政治胜利，以促使世界贸易更为自由，经济发展更为迅速。
ext.ext_en: The President is keen to notch a political triumph that would foster freer world trade and faster economic growth.

defs.def_en: If you notch a success, especially in a sporting contest, you achieve it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们每杀一个人就在枪托上刻下一个V形记号。
ext.ext_en: They cut notches in the handle of their pistol for each man they shot.

defs.def_en: A notch is a small V-shaped or circular cut in the surface or edge of something.
If you refer to someone as a toady, you disapprove of them because they flatter or are pleasant towards an important or powerful person in the hope of getting some advantage from them.

ext.ext_cn: 她们随后来到后台，对他娇语谄媚。
ext.ext_en: They came backstage afterward, cooing and toadying to him.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is toadying to an important or powerful person, you disapprove of them because they are flattering or being pleasant towards that person in the hope of getting some advantage from them.
A signal box is a small building near a railway, which contains the switches used to control the signals.

defs.def_cn: 增补性的;补充性的;额外的

ext.ext_cn: 是否需要补充维生素的问题
ext.ext_en: ...the question of whether or not we need to take supplementary vitamins...

ext.ext_cn: 给他们提供额外的背景资料或补充信息。
ext.ext_en: Provide them with additional background or with supplementary information.

defs.def_en: Supplementary things are added to something in order to improve it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无忧无虑的;毫无牵挂的

ext.ext_cn: 他们让人明显感觉是一对无牵无挂只求长相厮守的夫妻。
ext.ext_en: They certainly gave the impression of a carefree couple who delighted in each other's company...

ext.ext_cn: 钱特尔记起了从前在海滩上度过的无忧无虑的夏日时光。
ext.ext_en: Chantal remembered carefree past summers at the beach.

defs.def_en: A carefree person or period of time doesn't have or involve any problems, worries, or responsibilities.

ext.ext_cn: 1979年，Liquor Barn 烈酒折扣店的生意十分红火。
ext.ext_en: In 1979, Liquor Barn thrived as a discount merchandiser.

defs.def_en: A merchandiser is a person or company that sells goods to the public.

defs.def_cn: (用缆索牵引车辆的)缆索铁路,登山铁道
defs.def_en: A funicular or a funicular railway is a type of railway which goes up a very steep hill or mountain. A machine at the top of the slope pulls the carriage up the rails by a steel rope.

ext.ext_cn: 那个年轻人依然傻乎乎地望着她，没有答话。
ext.ext_en: The youth continued to gawk at her and did not answer...

ext.ext_cn: 成千上万的人赶来看热闹。
ext.ext_en: Tens of thousands came to gawk.

defs.def_en: To gawk at someone or something means to stare at them in a rude, stupid, or unthinking way.

defs.def_cn: 内斜视的;对眼的;斗鸡眼的
defs.def_en: Someone who is cross-eyed has eyes that seem to look towards each other.
The biosphere is the part of the earth's surface and atmosphere where there are living things.

ext.ext_cn: 支撑屋顶的柱子
ext.ext_en: ...the pillars supporting the roof.

defs.def_en: A pillar is a tall solid structure, which is usually used to support part of a building.

ext.ext_cn: 她经济政策的核心是严格控制货币的供应。
ext.ext_en: The pillar of her economic policy was keeping tight control over money supply.

ext.ext_cn: 种族隔离制最后的支柱
ext.ext_en: ...the last pillar of apartheid.

defs.def_en: If something is the pillar of a system or agreement, it is the most important part of it or what makes it strong and successful.

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲一直是社区的顶梁柱。
ext.ext_en: My father had been a pillar of the community.

ext.ext_cn: 深受尊重的社会栋梁
ext.ext_en: ...well-respected pillars of society.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a pillar of society or as a pillar of the community, you approve of them because they play an important and active part in society or in the community.
A dale is a valley.

defs.def_cn: 社会科学课程(英国中学和大学里开设的一门课程，包括社会学、政治学和经济学)
defs.def_en: In Britain, social studies is a subject that is taught in schools and colleges, and includes sociology, politics, and economics.

defs.def_cn: 社会科学课程(美国中学里开设的一门课程，包括历史、地理、社会学和政治学)
defs.def_en: In the United States, social studies is a subject that is taught in schools, and that includes history, geography, sociology, and politics.

defs.def_cn: (尤指衣服上的)扣子，拉链，钩扣，紧固物，扣件
defs.def_en: A fastener is a device such as a button, zip, or small hook that fastens something, especially clothing.
Someone's sexual preference is the same as their sexual orientation .

ext.ext_cn: 他们乐意和新任美国特使合作
ext.ext_en: ...their readiness to co-operate with the new US envoy.

defs.def_en: If someone is very willing to do something, you can talk about their readiness to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 首都加强了警备，准备迎接总统的到来。
ext.ext_en: Security tightened in the capital in readiness for the president's arrival.

defs.def_en: If you do something in readiness for a future event, you do it so that you are prepared for that event.

ext.ext_cn: 其他建议涉及此类信息储存方面的一些细节。
ext.ext_en: Other recommendations relate to the details of how such data is stored...

ext.ext_cn: 不管你的问题是由食物、饮料、吸烟引起，或仅仅是生活引起，都无关紧要。
ext.ext_en: It does not matter whether the problem you have relates to food, drink, smoking or just living...

defs.def_en: If something relates to a particular subject, it concerns that subject.

ext.ext_cn: 要弄清这些基因的功能以及它们彼此之间是否关联，我们还需要开展更多的研究。
ext.ext_en: More studies will be required before we know what the functions of these genes are and whether they relate to each other...

ext.ext_cn: 康奈尔大学开设了一门研究语言与特定文化符号之间如何关联的课程。
ext.ext_en: Cornell University offers a course that investigates how language relates to particular cultural codes...

defs.def_en: The way that two things relate, or the way that one thing relates to another, is the sort of connection that exists between them.

ext.ext_cn: 他无法理解他人的想法。
ext.ext_en: He is unable to relate to other people...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为对孩子们来讲有可以相互理解沟通的兄弟姐妹很重要。
ext.ext_en: I think it is important for children to have brothers and sisters they can relate to...

defs.def_en: If you can relate to someone, you can understand how they feel or behave so that you are able to communicate with them or deal with them easily.

ext.ext_cn: 有一些官员会听他讲述整个故事。
ext.ext_en: There were officials to whom he could relate the whole story...

ext.ext_cn: 她讲述了自己艰苦谋生的故事。
ext.ext_en: She related her tale of living rough.

defs.def_en: If you relate a story, you tell it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 诡计多端的;狡诈的;狡猾的

ext.ext_cn: 他之所以被任命为总理，很大程度上是因为总统在阴谋操纵。
ext.ext_en: His appointment as prime minister owed much to the wily manoeuvring of the President.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or their behaviour as wily, you mean that they are clever at achieving what they want, especially by tricking people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 女孩子们害怕蛇，走路时格外小心。
ext.ext_en: The girls were afraid of snakes and picked their way along with extreme caution.

ext.ext_cn: 生活极度贫困的人们
ext.ext_en: ...people living in extreme poverty.

defs.def_en: Extreme means very great in degree or intensity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 极端的例子是波兰，共有29个政党拥有议席。
ext.ext_en: The extreme case was Poland, where 29 parties won seats...

ext.ext_cn: 很难想象莱恩克尔能做出如此极端的事情。
ext.ext_en: It is hard to imagine Lineker capable of anything so extreme...

defs.def_en: You use extreme to describe situations and behaviour which are much more severe or unusual than you would expect, especially when you disapprove of them because of this.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这种偏激的观点未被大众接受。
ext.ext_en: This extreme view hasn't captured popular opinion.

ext.ext_cn: 极右派的种族主义政治
ext.ext_en: ...the racist politics of the extreme right.

defs.def_en: You use extreme to describe opinions, beliefs, or political movements which you disapprove of because they are very different from those that most people would accept as reasonable or normal.

ext.ext_cn: 成功和失败这两个极端之间的“中间地带”
ext.ext_en: ...a 'middle way' between the extremes of success and failure...

ext.ext_cn: 它们能够经受极端的气温和天气状况而不褪色、不破裂。
ext.ext_en: They can withstand extremes of temperature and weather without fading or cracking.

defs.def_en: You can use extremes to refer to situations or types of behaviour that have opposite qualities to each other, especially when each situation or type of behaviour has such a quality to the greatest degree possible.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在走廊尽头的那个房间
ext.ext_en: ...the room at the extreme end of the corridor.

ext.ext_cn: 从极北吹来的风
ext.ext_en: ...winds from the extreme north.

defs.def_en: The extreme end or edge of something is its furthest end or edge.

ext.ext_cn: 警方采取极端措施，在那个男子家里安装了最先进的安全装置。
ext.ext_en: The police went to the extremes of installing the most advanced safety devices in the man's house...

ext.ext_cn: 医生告诉我不要跟她提节食的事儿，免得她走极端。
ext.ext_en: The doctor told me not to mention dieting to her in case she took it to the extreme...

defs.def_en: If a person goes to extremes or takes something to extremes, they do or say something in a way that people consider to be unacceptable, unreasonable, or foolish.

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词后，尤用于强调不好或令人惊讶的事）极其，极度

ext.ext_cn: 事实证明它极具争议。
ext.ext_en: It is proving controversial in the extreme...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的争吵变得极其有害。
ext.ext_en: Our rows become unhealthy in the extreme.

defs.def_en: You use in the extreme after an adjective in order to emphasize what you are saying, especially when you want to indicate that it is something which is undesirable or very surprising.

ext.ext_cn: 你最好明天赶赴赫尔辛基。
ext.ext_en: You had better travel to Helsinki tomorrow...

ext.ext_cn: 奶奶是乘火车过来的。
ext.ext_en: Granny travelled down by train…

defs.def_en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

ext.ext_cn: 新西兰的旅行信息可以在宾馆获取。
ext.ext_en: Information on travel in New Zealand is available at the hotel…

ext.ext_cn: 他厌恶乘飞机旅行。
ext.ext_en: He detested air travel.

defs.def_en: Travel is the activity of travelling.

ext.ext_cn: 瑞安博士周游世界为他的书搜集资料。
ext.ext_en: Dr Ryan travelled the world gathering material for his book...

ext.ext_cn: 他不得不走遍全国寻找工作。
ext.ext_en: He has had to travel the country in search of work.

defs.def_en: If you travel the world, the country, or the area, you go to many different places in the world or in a particular country or area.

ext.ext_cn: 当声音在水中传播时，可能会发生奇怪的现象。
ext.ext_en: When sound travels through water, strange things can happen...

ext.ext_cn: 光以每秒约 30 万公里的速度传播。
ext.ext_en: Light travels at around 300,000,000 metres per second.

defs.def_en: When light or sound from one place reaches another, you say that it travels to the other place.

ext.ext_cn: 有关他研究成果的消息一路传到了亚洲。
ext.ext_en: News of his work traveled all the way to Asia...

ext.ext_cn: 这里似乎消息传播得很快。
ext.ext_en: Seems like news travels pretty fast around here.

defs.def_en: When news becomes known by people in different places, you can say that it travels to them.

ext.ext_cn: 他在国外旅游时也为家宅搜集物品作为摆设。
ext.ext_en: He also collects things for the house on his travels abroad.

defs.def_en: Someone's travels are the journeys that they make to places a long way from their home.
If you travel light, you travel without taking much luggage.

defs.def_cn: (食品等货物)宜于长途运输，经得起长途运输

ext.ext_cn: 熟透的水果不宜长途运输，但未成熟的水果却可以运往全世界。
ext.ext_en: Ripe fruit does not travel well, but unripe fruit can be transported worldwide.

defs.def_en: If goods such as food products travel well, they can be transported a long way without being damaged or their quality being spoiled.

defs.def_cn: (思想、方法或样式)广为流传，盛行各地

ext.ext_cn: 那种风格的幽默通常在各地都喜闻乐见。
ext.ext_en: That brand of humour generally travels well.

defs.def_en: If you say that an idea, a method, or a style travels well, you mean that it can be appreciated or used by people in several different countries, and not just in the country where it began.

ext.ext_cn: 无线电操纵的模型飞机
ext.ext_en: ...radio-controlled model planes.

defs.def_en: A radio-controlled device works by receiving radio signals which operate it.

ext.ext_cn: 研究表明高纤维饮食可预防肠癌。
ext.ext_en: Research shows that a high-fibre diet may protect you from bowel cancer...

ext.ext_cn: 呼吸测醉检测显示其饮酒量是法定驾车饮酒限量的两倍多，他随即在南安普顿的家中被捕。
ext.ext_en: He was arrested at his home in Southampton after a breath test showed he had drunk more than twice the legal limit for driving...

defs.def_en: If something shows that a state of affairs exists, it gives information that proves it or makes it clear to people.

defs.def_cn: (图画、图表、影像或文章)描绘，描述，展示，说明

ext.ext_cn: 图表 4.1 所示为呼吸系统。
ext.ext_en: Figure 4.1 shows the respiratory system...

ext.ext_cn: 刻有克娄巴特拉头像的硬币
ext.ext_en: ...a coin showing Cleopatra...

defs.def_en: If a picture, chart, film, or piece of writing shows something, it represents it or gives information about it.

defs.def_cn: 给…看;向…出示(或展示);指给…看

ext.ext_cn: 将这篇文章剪下来，拿给你的银行经理看。
ext.ext_en: Cut out this article and show it to your bank manager...

ext.ext_cn: 他带我看了他和埃丝特合住的公寓。
ext.ext_en: He showed me the flat he shares with Esther...

defs.def_en: If you show someone something, you give it to them, take them to it, or point to it, so that they can see it or know what you are referring to.

ext.ext_cn: 我带你去我的书房。
ext.ext_en: Let me show you to my study...

ext.ext_cn: 米尔顿被领到了办公室。
ext.ext_en: Milton was shown into the office...

defs.def_en: If you show someone to a room or seat, you lead them there.

ext.ext_cn: 克莱尔给我们示范了如何做巧克力卷。
ext.ext_en: Claire showed us how to make a chocolate roulade...

ext.ext_cn: 有经验丰富的专家教你，并向你演示怎么做。
ext.ext_en: There are seasoned professionals who can teach you and show you what to do...

defs.def_en: If you show someone how to do something, you do it yourself so that they can watch you and learn how to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他一本正经地咧嘴笑了笑。
ext.ext_en: He showed his teeth in a humourless grin...

ext.ext_cn: 他的胡子才刚有点泛白。
ext.ext_en: His beard was just beginning to show signs of grey...

defs.def_en: If something shows or if you show it, it is visible or noticeable.

defs.def_cn: 表现，体现，流露出(态度、品质或情感);(态度等)体现，流露

ext.ext_cn: 埃尔茜有足够的时间来表达她的感激之情。
ext.ext_en: Elsie has had enough time to show her gratitude...

ext.ext_cn: 她对自己的孩子毫无兴趣。
ext.ext_en: She showed no interest in her children...

defs.def_en: If you show a particular attitude, quality, or feeling, or if it shows, you behave in a way that makes this attitude, quality, or feeling clear to other people.

defs.def_cn: 显示出，表露出，流露出(某种品质或特征);(品质或特征)表露，显示

ext.ext_cn: 这个故事显示了作者较强的叙事能力和对细节的观察入微。
ext.ext_en: The story shows a strong narrative gift and a vivid eye for detail...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天在华盛顿举行的中东和谈有了取得进展的迹象。
ext.ext_en: Middle East peace talks in Washington showed signs of progress yesterday...

defs.def_en: If something shows a quality or characteristic or if that quality or characteristic shows itself, it can be noticed or observed.

defs.def_cn: (情感、品质等的)流露，表露，体现

ext.ext_cn: 矿工们聚集在布加勒斯特市中心以表示对政府的支持。
ext.ext_en: Miners gathered in the centre of Bucharest in a show of support for the government...

ext.ext_cn: 已经有 10,000 多人聚集起来以显示他们的力量。
ext.ext_en: A crowd of more than 10,000 has gathered in a show of strength...

defs.def_en: A show of a feeling or quality is an attempt by someone to make it clear that they have that feeling or quality.

ext.ext_cn: 政府的转变更多的是装装样子，而不是真的。
ext.ext_en: The change in government is more for show than for real...

ext.ext_cn: “全是装的，”莱纳斯说。“女孩子们不会拿它当真的。”
ext.ext_en: 'It's all show,' said Linus. 'The girls don't take it seriously.'

defs.def_en: If you say that something is for show, you mean that it has no real purpose and is done just to give a good impression.

ext.ext_cn: 那是3个公司中唯一一家预计会在本季度盈利的公司。
ext.ext_en: It is the only one of the three companies expected to show a profit for the quarter...

ext.ext_cn: 朗荷公司的采矿及矿产业务有了些起色。
ext.ext_en: Lonrho's mining and minerals businesses showed some improvement.

defs.def_en: If a company shows a profit or a loss, its accounts indicate that it has made a profit or a loss.

ext.ext_cn: 他总是有可能不出现。
ext.ext_en: There was always a chance he wouldn't show.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一直等到了 5 点，但是他始终没有露面。
ext.ext_en: We waited until five o'clock, but he did not show up...

defs.def_en: If a person you are expecting to meet does not show, they do not arrive at the place where you expect to meet them.

ext.ext_cn: 我有自己的电视节目。
ext.ext_en: I had my own TV show...

ext.ext_cn: 这就是劳埃德·格罗斯曼拜访名人家庭的那档节目。
ext.ext_en: This is the show in which Loyd Grossman visits the houses of the famous.

defs.def_en: A television or radio show is a programme on television or radio.

defs.def_cn: (尤指包括音乐、舞蹈、滑稽剧等不同内容的)演出，表演

ext.ext_cn: 去伦敦购物再看场演出怎么样？
ext.ext_en: How about going shopping and seeing a show in London?...

ext.ext_cn: 他因可以用一则恶评毙掉一场演出而闻名。
ext.ext_en: He has earned a reputation as the man who can close a show with a bad review...

defs.def_en: A show in a theatre is an entertainment or concert, especially one that includes different items such as music, dancing, and comedy.

ext.ext_cn: 英国广播公司对外电视频道的新闻节目播放了同样的电影剪辑片段。
ext.ext_en: The BBC World Service Television news showed the same film clip...

ext.ext_cn: 明年这部剧将在美国电视台播出。
ext.ext_en: The drama will be shown on American TV next year...

defs.def_en: If someone shows a film or television programme, it is broadcast or appears on television or in the cinema.

ext.ext_cn: 展览地点在伯明翰国家展览中心大厅。
ext.ext_en: The venue for the show is Birmingham's National Exhibition Centre Hall...

ext.ext_cn: 古奇将举办时装发布会推出他们的秋装系列。
ext.ext_en: Gucci will be holding fashion shows to present their autumn collection...

defs.def_en: A show is a public exhibition of things, such as works of art, fashionable clothes, or things that have been entered in a competition.

ext.ext_cn: 50 名艺术品经销商将展出 1900 年到1992 年间的油画、水彩画、素描和版画。
ext.ext_en: 50 dealers will show oils, watercolours, drawings and prints from 1900 to 1992.

ext.ext_cn: 他曾在那儿展销作品的东村著名的美术馆之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of East Village's better-known galleries, where he showed and sold his work.

defs.def_en: To show things such as works of art means to put them in an exhibition where they can be seen by the public.

defs.def_cn: (赛马比赛中赛马)名列前三甲
defs.def_en: In a horse race, if a horse shows, it finishes first, second, or third.
A show home, house, or flat is one of a group of new homes. The building company decorates it and puts furniture in it, and people who want to buy one of the homes come and look round it.

ext.ext_cn: 议会领导人同意所有这样的决定都要举手表决。
ext.ext_en: Parliamentary leaders agreed to take all such decisions by a show of hands...

ext.ext_cn: 拉塞尔然后要求对每个目标进行举手表决。
ext.ext_en: Russell then asked for a show of hands concerning each of the targets.

defs.def_en: If a question is decided by a show of hands, people vote on it by raising their hands to indicate whether they vote yes or no.

defs.def_cn: 在…方面做出了成绩;在…方面有结果

ext.ext_cn: 我快 31 岁了,是该在工作上做出一番成绩的时候了。
ext.ext_en: I'm nearly 31 and it's about time I had something to show for my time in my job...

ext.ext_cn: 她的付出那么多，收获却那样少，这一直让她惊诧不已。
ext.ext_en: It always amazed her how little she had to show for the amount she spent.

defs.def_en: If you have something to show for your efforts, you have achieved something as a result of what you have done.

defs.def_cn: (用来威胁或警告别人)我要让你看看，你就等着瞧吧

ext.ext_cn: 她挥了挥拳头，“我要让你看看，”她说。
ext.ext_en: She shook her fist. 'I'll show you,' she said...

ext.ext_cn: 我会让他好看的，交给我好了。
ext.ext_en: I'll show him, leave it to me.

defs.def_en: You can say 'I'll show you' to threaten or warn someone that you are going to make them admit that they are wrong.

defs.def_cn: 这恰恰证明;这正好表明

ext.ext_cn: 这恰恰证明了在学校得高分并不意味着聪明。
ext.ext_en: This just goes to show that getting good grades in school doesn't mean you're clever...

ext.ext_cn: 这太荒唐了，不过恰恰证明了裁判的前后矛盾。
ext.ext_en: It's crazy and just shows the inconsistency of refereeing.

defs.def_en: If you say it just goes to show or it just shows that something is the case, you mean that what you have just said or experienced demonstrates that it is the case.

ext.ext_cn: 他们清楚地表明了现在是谁在掌控一切。
ext.ext_en: They made it clear who is now running the show...

ext.ext_cn: 国家领导班子的治国方式存在一些严重的问题。
ext.ext_en: There's some serious problems with the way the state's leadership has been running the show.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is running the show, you mean that they are in control or in charge of a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 比赛的第一天中国女队表现抢眼。
ext.ext_en: It was Chinese women who stole the show on the first day of competition...

ext.ext_cn: 布拉德·皮特扮演一名因对生命怀有极大热情而注定在劫难逃的年轻人，抢尽了镜头。
ext.ext_en: Brad Pitt steals the show as the young man doomed by his zest for life.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone steals the show, you mean that they get a lot of attention or praise because they perform better than anyone else in a show or other event.

defs.def_cn: 在(尸体)上涂敷香料再裹布保存;将(尸体)制成木乃伊

ext.ext_cn: 在美国，死后将尸体制成木乃伊的费用高达15万美元。
ext.ext_en: In America, people are paying up to $150,000 to be mummified after death.

ext.ext_cn: 法老木乃伊
ext.ext_en: ...the mummified pharaoh.

defs.def_en: If a dead body is mummified, it is preserved, for example by rubbing it with special oils and wrapping it in cloth.

ext.ext_cn: 我不喜欢自己没胡子的样子。
ext.ext_en: I don't like myself without a beard...

ext.ext_cn: 她穿着一件熨烫得没有一点儿褶儿的棕色衬衫。
ext.ext_en: She wore a brown shirt pressed without a wrinkle.

defs.def_en: You use without to indicate that someone or something does not have or use the thing mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 在没有(发生或做某事)的情况下

ext.ext_cn: 他如果一声不吭地离开，就会获得一笔丰厚的养老金。
ext.ext_en: He was offered a generous pension provided he left without a fuss...

ext.ext_cn: 他们一刻不停地干到晚上8点钟左右。
ext.ext_en: They worked without a break until about eight in the evening...

defs.def_en: If one thing happens without another thing, or if you do something without doing something else, the second thing does not happen or occur.

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮特·马格努森冷冷地看着他走过来。
ext.ext_en: Janet Magnusson watched his approach without enthusiasm...

ext.ext_cn: “你好，斯旺森。”他说话的时候并未显得惊讶。
ext.ext_en: 'Hello, Swanson,' he said without surprise.

defs.def_en: If you do something without a particular feeling, you do not have that feeling when you do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉富兰克林吃晚饭不必等我。
ext.ext_en: I told Franklin he would have to start dinner without me...

ext.ext_cn: 失去丈夫后我怎么才能重新开始生活？
ext.ext_en: How can I rebuild my life without my husband?...

defs.def_en: If you do something without someone else, they are not in the same place as you are or are not involved in the same action as you.

ext.ext_cn: 真是一派胡言。
ext.ext_en: This is a load of codswallop.

defs.def_en: If you describe something that someone has just said as codswallop, you mean that you think it is nonsense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 活跃的;活泼的;欢蹦乱跳的

ext.ext_cn: 马儿欢蹦乱跳，他不得不紧勒缰绳。
ext.ext_en: His horse was feeling frisky, and he had to hold the reins tightly.

defs.def_en: A frisky animal or person is energetic and playful, and may be difficult to control.
A splint is a long piece of wood or metal that is fastened to a broken arm, leg, or back to keep it still.

ext.ext_cn: 经济失败主义的情绪
ext.ext_en: ...the mood of economic defeatism.

defs.def_en: Defeatism is a way of thinking or talking which suggests that you expect to be unsuccessful.

ext.ext_cn: 小屋看上去像是被疯子在那撒过野一样。
ext.ext_en: The cabin looked as if a maniac had been let loose there.

ext.ext_cn: 瘾君子
ext.ext_en: ...a drug-crazed maniac.

defs.def_en: A maniac is a mad person who is violent and dangerous.

ext.ext_cn: 一个疯狂的司机以每小时110英里的速度在高速公路上逆行飙车35英里。
ext.ext_en: A maniac driver sped 35 miles along the wrong side of a motorway at 110 mph.

ext.ext_cn: 疯狂骑自行车的人
ext.ext_en: ...a maniac cyclist.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as maniac, you are emphasizing that it is extremely foolish and uncontrolled.

defs.def_cn: (宗教或体育的)狂热分子，过激分子

ext.ext_cn: 我妈妈正在变为一个宗教狂热分子。
ext.ext_en: My mum is turning into a religious maniac.

ext.ext_cn: 足球迷
ext.ext_en: ...football maniacs.

defs.def_en: If you call someone, for example, a religious maniac or a sports maniac, you are critical of them because they have such a strong interest in religion or sport.

ext.ext_cn: 俄国女贵族和皇室成员的宗教静修之地
ext.ext_en: ...a religious retreat for Russian noblewomen and members of royalty.

defs.def_en: In former times, a noblewoman was a woman who was a member of the nobility.

defs.def_cn: (未经过精加工、无人工添加剂的)粗制食物，全天然食物

ext.ext_cn: 避免摄入食物添加剂而只吃全天然食物是有好处的。
ext.ext_en: It pays to avoid food additives and eat only wholefoods...

ext.ext_cn: 健康饮食应由全天然食物构成。
ext.ext_en: A healthy diet should consist of wholefood.

defs.def_en: Wholefoods are foods which have not been processed much and which have not had artificial ingredients added.

defs.def_cn: （载有重要人物的）车队，汽车行列

ext.ext_cn: 有时总统车队放慢速度缓缓而行。
ext.ext_en: At times the president's motorcade slowed to a crawl.

defs.def_en: A motorcade is a line of slow-moving cars carrying important people, usually as part of a public ceremony.

defs.def_cn: （组织中的成员）忠实的，积极的，得到承认的

ext.ext_cn: 我们未来要想维持独立国家的地位就必须成为欧洲的正式一员。
ext.ext_en: ...our future as an independent nation lies as a fully paid-up member of Europe.

defs.def_en: If a person or country is a paid-up member of a group, they are an enthusiastic member or are recognized by most people as being a member of it.

defs.def_cn: （政党或组织成员）已缴清会费的，正式的

ext.ext_cn: 已缴清党费的工党正式党员
ext.ext_en: ...a fully paid-up member of the Labour Party.

defs.def_en: If someone is a paid-up member of a political party or other organization, they have paid the money needed to become an official member.

defs.def_cn: 非官方的；未经正式批准的；非正式的

ext.ext_cn: 职工投票决定继续进行非正式罢工，以支持上周被解雇的7名同事。
ext.ext_en: Staff voted to continue an unofficial strike in support of seven colleagues who were dismissed last week...

ext.ext_cn: 官方报道说死亡人数在100人以下，但非官方估计至少有200人死亡。
ext.ext_en: Official reports put the death toll at under one hundred, but unofficial estimates speak of at least two hundred dead.

defs.def_en: An unofficial action or statement is not organized or approved by a person or group in authority.
Voyeurism is the practice of getting sexual pleasure by secretly watching other people having sex or taking their clothes off.

ext.ext_cn: 英国广播公司昨日为一部生动再现犯罪活动的电视系列剧进行了辩护，称其并没有窥探他人隐私之嫌。
ext.ext_en: The BBC yesterday defended a series featuring dramatic crime reconstructions against suggestions of voyeurism.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as voyeurism, you disapprove of them because you think they enjoy watching other people's suffering or problems.

ext.ext_cn: 警察很容易就成了暴徒下手袭击的对象,这是一个社会的悲哀。
ext.ext_en: It's a sad indictment of society that policemen are regarded as easy targets by thugs.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing is an indictment of another thing, you mean that it shows how bad the other thing is.

ext.ext_cn: 检举官可能不久就会以敲诈勒索与欺诈罪名提起诉讼。
ext.ext_en: Prosecutors may soon seek an indictment on racketeering and fraud charges...

ext.ext_cn: 政府在对这三个人的起诉书中指控他们从事非法贸易。
ext.ext_en: The government's indictment against the three men alleged unlawful trading.

defs.def_en: An indictment is a formal accusation that someone has committed a crime.
Treason is the crime of betraying your country, for example by helping its enemies or by trying to remove its government using violence.

ext.ext_cn: 他对斗牛的迷恋
ext.ext_en: ...his infatuation with bullfighting...

ext.ext_cn: 黛西对医生的迷恋
ext.ext_en: ...Daisy's infatuation for the doctor...

defs.def_en: If you have an infatuation for a person or thing, you have strong feelings of love or passion for them which make you unable to think clearly or sensibly about them.

defs.def_cn: 西里尔字母的(指书写俄语、保加利亚语等斯拉夫语言时所用的字母)
defs.def_en: The Cyrillic alphabet is the alphabet that is used to write some Slavonic languages, such as Russian and Bulgarian.

ext.ext_cn: 用西里尔字母写的符号
ext.ext_en: ...signs written in Cyrillic.

defs.def_en: Cyrillic is the Cyrillic alphabet.

Inverted commas are punctuation marks that are used in writing to show where speech or a quotation begins and ends. They are usually written or printed as ' ' or “ ”. Inverted commas are also sometimes used around the titles of books, plays, or songs, or around a word or phrase that is being discussed.

defs.def_cn: (表示不够准确、无法接受或引用别人的话)加引号的，所谓的

ext.ext_cn: 他们被要求对这些陈述作所谓“客观”的评价。
ext.ext_en: They're asked to make objective, in inverted commas, evaluations of these statements.

defs.def_en: If you say in inverted commas after a word or phrase, you are indicating that it is inaccurate or unacceptable in some way, or that you are quoting someone else.
A chassis is the framework that a vehicle is built on.

defs.def_cn: 踮起脚走;蹑手蹑脚地走

ext.ext_cn: 她溜下床，蹑手蹑脚地走到窗户旁边。
ext.ext_en: She slipped out of bed and tiptoed to the window.

defs.def_en: If you tiptoe somewhere, you walk there very quietly without putting your heels on the floor when you walk.

ext.ext_cn: 她把自行车斜靠在石墙上，踮起脚往墙内张望。
ext.ext_en: She leaned her bike against the stone wall and stood on tiptoe to peer over it.

defs.def_en: If you do something on tiptoe or on tiptoes, you do it standing or walking on the front part of your foot, without putting your heels on the ground.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 没有人缘的；不受欢迎的；不得人心的

ext.ext_cn: 那是一个痛苦又不得人心的决定。
ext.ext_en: It was a painful and unpopular decision...

ext.ext_cn: 上中学的时候，我很不受欢迎，确实受到了一些歧视。
ext.ext_en: In high school, I was very unpopular, and I did encounter a little prejudice...

defs.def_en: If something or someone is unpopular, most people do not like them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们对它完全是一见倾心。
ext.ext_en: We fell for it hook, line, and sinker...

ext.ext_cn: 我被深深吸引了。
ext.ext_en: I was caught hook, line and sinker.

defs.def_en: You can use hook, line, and sinker to emphasize that someone is tricked or forced into a situation completely.

ext.ext_cn: 议会采纳了要求全部撤军的决议。
ext.ext_en: Parliament adopted a resolution calling for the complete withdrawal of troops...

ext.ext_cn: 应帮助学生对环境采取积极的态度。
ext.ext_en: Pupils should be helped to adopt a positive approach to the environment.

defs.def_en: If you adopt a new attitude, plan, or way of behaving, you begin to have it.

ext.ext_cn: 有数以百计的人渴望领养孩子。
ext.ext_en: There are hundreds of people desperate to adopt a child...

ext.ext_cn: 被收养的孩子有权看自己的出生证明。
ext.ext_en: The adopted child has the right to see his birth certificate.

defs.def_en: If you adopt someone else's child, you take it into your own family and make it legally your son or daughter.

ext.ext_cn: 我努力保持蜷曲的姿势以免四肢受伤。
ext.ext_en: I tried to adopt a curled-up position to avoid damaging my limbs.

defs.def_en: If you adopt a physical position, you move yourself into it.

defs.def_cn: 移居（某国）;选择（某国）定居

ext.ext_cn: 波度尔斯基加入美国海军当上了飞行员，不仅改了国籍还换了行当。
ext.ext_en: Podulski had joined the U.S. Navy as an aviator, adopting a new country and a new profession.

ext.ext_cn: 他们移居英国的家
ext.ext_en: ...their adopted home in England.

defs.def_en: If you adopt a country, you choose it as a place to live.

ext.ext_cn: 他承袭了二战时期播音员的口音。
ext.ext_en: He has adopted the accent of a Second World War newscaster...

ext.ext_cn: 女孩不知道该做什么，也不知道该用什么口气说。
ext.ext_en: The girl was uncertain what to do, or what tone of voice to adopt.

defs.def_en: If you adopt an accent or a particular tone of voice, you speak differently from normal, especially to create an effect in a particular situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 阿谀奉承的;谄媚的;拍马屁的

ext.ext_cn: 他那些互相吹捧的朋党
ext.ext_en: ...his clique of sycophantic friends...

ext.ext_cn: 我们听到了谄媚的笑声。
ext.ext_en: We heard the sound of sycophantic laughter.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as sycophantic, you disapprove of them because they flatter people who are more important and powerful than they are in order to gain an advantage for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰，我们受够了。我们要退出。
ext.ext_en: We've had enough, John. We want out...

ext.ext_cn: 我只想结束这段感情。
ext.ext_en: I just want out of the relationship.

defs.def_en: If you want out, you no longer want to be involved in a plan, project, or situation that you are part of.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人鼓舞的;振奋人心的;给人希望的

ext.ext_cn: 出现了鼓舞人心的艺术复兴的迹象。
ext.ext_en: There are encouraging signs of an artistic revival...

ext.ext_cn: 结果令人振奋。
ext.ext_en: The results have been encouraging...

defs.def_en: Something that is encouraging gives people hope or confidence.
A workaholic is a person who works most of the time and finds it difficult to stop working in order to do other things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可执行的;可强制执行的

ext.ext_cn: 具有法律效力的合同的签订
ext.ext_en: ...the creation of legally enforceable contracts...

ext.ext_cn: 这项《人权法案》适用于普通法庭。
ext.ext_en: This Human Rights Act is enforceable in the ordinary courts.

defs.def_en: If something such as a law or agreement is enforceable, it can be enforced.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 伤人感情的;使人痛苦的;刻薄的

ext.ext_cn: 她的话只会使格林夫人的家人感到伤心。
ext.ext_en: Her comments can only be hurtful to Mrs Green's family.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's comments or actions are hurtful, you mean that they are unkind and upsetting.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人厌恶的；恐怖的；令人震惊的

ext.ext_cn: 在首都发生了一连串让人毛骨悚然的谋杀案。
ext.ext_en: There has been a series of gruesome murders in the capital.

defs.def_en: Something that is gruesome is extremely unpleasant and shocking.

An indirect object is an object which is used with a transitive verb to indicate who benefits from an action or gets something as a result. For example, in 'She gave him her address', 'him' is the indirect object.

defs.def_cn: 女孩子气的男孩;胆小怯懦的男孩

ext.ext_cn: 他们那帮孩子野蛮得很，还认为我们太女孩子气。
ext.ext_en: They were rough kids, and thought we were sissies...

ext.ext_cn: 伊德里斯大声地宣告说：“在海里，谁落在最后谁就不是爷儿们。”
ext.ext_en: 'Last one in the sea is a sissy,' proclaimed Idris.

defs.def_en: Some people, especially men, describe a boy as a sissy when they disapprove of him because he does not like rough, physical activities or is afraid to do things which might be dangerous.

ext.ext_cn: 只有真正的男人才会接受自己并非完美无缺的事实，这绝不是什么女孩子气。
ext.ext_en: Far from being sissy, it takes a real man to accept that he is not perfect.

ext.ext_cn: 把写作看成基本上是娘儿们家所为的男人
ext.ext_en: ...men who feel that writing is essentially a sissy occupation.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action or activity as sissy, you disapprove of it because you think it is only appropriate for girls or women.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 唱片难听极了。
ext.ext_en: The record sounds horrible.

ext.ext_cn: 讨厌的小男孩
ext.ext_en: ...a horrible small boy.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as horrible, you do not like them at all.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人震惊的;使人恐惧的;让人极度反感的

ext.ext_cn: 他的嘴里还是发出了恐怖的尖叫声。
ext.ext_en: Still the horrible shrieking came out of his mouth.

defs.def_en: You can call something horrible when it causes you to feel great shock, fear, and disgust.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 看起来那像是个会拖延多年的大烂摊子。
ext.ext_en: That seems like a horrible mess that will drag on for years...

ext.ext_cn: 如果不尊重别人的宗教信仰，就会祷下大错，酿成冲突。
ext.ext_en: Unless you respect other people's religions, horrible mistakes and conflict will occur.

defs.def_en: Horrible is used to emphasize how bad something is.

ext.ext_cn: 托马斯先生患有抑郁症。
ext.ext_en: Mr Thomas was suffering from depression...

ext.ext_cn: 我陷入消沉，开始对死亡有种病态的迷恋。
ext.ext_en: I slid into a depression and became morbidly fascinated with death.

defs.def_en: Depression is a mental state in which you are sad and feel that you cannot enjoy anything, because your situation is so difficult and unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 他永远不会忘记 20 世纪 30 年代经济大萧条时期他所亲眼目睹的困苦情形。
ext.ext_en: He never forgot the hardships he witnessed during the Great Depression of the 1930s.

defs.def_en: A depression is a time when there is very little economic activity, which causes a lot of unemployment and poverty.

ext.ext_cn: 密布着雨水洼的地区
ext.ext_en: ...an area pockmarked by rain-filled depressions.

defs.def_en: A depression in a surface is an area which is lower than the parts surrounding it.
A depression is a mass of air that has a low pressure and that often causes rain.

defs.def_cn: (电话，尤指手机的)铃音，呼叫声，响声

ext.ext_cn: 这些手机可待机70小时，通话时长达2小时50分钟，并提供15种铃音。
ext.ext_en: They offer 70 hours' standby time, 2hr 50min talk time, and 15 ring tones.

defs.def_en: The ring tone is the sound made by a telephone, especially a mobile phone, when it rings.

ext.ext_cn: 他将对这一学科进行概述。
ext.ext_en: He's giving a broad brush approach to the subject.

defs.def_en: A broad-brush approach, strategy, or solution deals with a problem in a general way rather than concentrating on details.

ext.ext_cn: 配米饭或印度烤饼吃的传统菜肴，如咖喱羊肉等
ext.ext_en: ...traditional dishes, such as rogan josh, served with rice or naan.

defs.def_en: Naan or naan bread is a type of bread that comes in a large, round, flat piece and is usually eaten with Indian food.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (赞扬、道歉、感激等)虚伪的，夸张的，过度的

ext.ext_cn: 报纸上对前总统都是些溢美之词。
ext.ext_en: Newspapers have been fulsome in their praise of the former president.

defs.def_en: If you describe expressions of praise, apology, or gratitude as fulsome, you disapprove of them because they are exaggerated and elaborate, so that they sound insincere.

defs.def_cn: 阳光地带(尤指美国南部地区)

ext.ext_cn: 在上个经济萧条期，人们向美国南部阳光地带移民的速度加快了。
ext.ext_en: During the last recession, migration to the sunbelt accelerated.

defs.def_en: The warmer, sunnier parts of a country or continent, especially the southern United States, are sometimes referred to as the sunbelt .
A sturgeon is a large fish which lives in northern parts of the world. Sturgeon are usually caught for their eggs, which are known as caviar.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (政治观点或政策)温和的，不激进的

ext.ext_cn: 他的观点非常温和，容易相处。
ext.ext_en: He was an easygoing man of very moderate views...

ext.ext_cn: 两国都呼吁不要滥用武力。
ext.ext_en: Both countries have called for a moderate approach to the use of force.

defs.def_en: Moderate political opinions or policies are not extreme.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 温和的民主党人
ext.ext_en: ...a moderate Democrat.

ext.ext_cn: 军队中的稳健派
ext.ext_en: ...the moderate wing of the army.

defs.def_en: You use moderate to describe people or groups who have moderate political opinions or policies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 中等的;普通的;适度的；适量的

ext.ext_cn: 适度的压力是有好处的，但是压力太大会把人压垮。
ext.ext_en: While a moderate amount of stress can be beneficial, too much stress can exhaust you.

ext.ext_cn: 适度的锻炼
ext.ext_en: ...moderate exercise.

defs.def_en: You use moderate to describe something that is neither large nor small in amount or degree.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数药物要么不能使病情真正好转，要么最多只能带来轻微的改善。
ext.ext_en: Most drugs offer either no real improvement or, at best, only moderate improvements.

defs.def_en: A moderate change in something is a change that is not great.

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望等他一上台，可以说服他观点别那么激进。
ext.ext_en: They are hoping that once in office he can be persuaded to moderate his views...

ext.ext_cn: 救援人员的紧迫危机感已经有所减弱。
ext.ext_en: Amongst relief workers, the immediate sense of crisis has moderated somewhat...

defs.def_en: If you moderate something or if it moderates, it becomes less extreme or violent and easier to deal with or accept.

ext.ext_cn: 在抗议者和骄傲地展示勋章的退伍老兵中，就有奥布里·罗斯。
ext.ext_en: Among the protesters and war veterans proudly displaying their medals was Aubrey Rose...

ext.ext_cn: 展柜中陈列着17世纪的青花瓷。
ext.ext_en: The cabinets display seventeenth-century blue-and-white porcelain.

defs.def_en: If you display something that you want people to see, you put it in a particular place, so that people can see it easily.

ext.ext_cn: 她给陪审团的 12 位男士看了她的伤口。
ext.ext_en: She displayed her wound to the twelve gentlemen of the jury...

ext.ext_cn: 这张图就会显示出这些群体之间的关联。
ext.ext_en: The chart can then display the links connecting these groups.

defs.def_en: If you display something, you show it to people.

defs.def_cn: 显示，显露，表现(特性或情感)

ext.ext_cn: 戈登不太可能表露他的情感。
ext.ext_en: It was unlike Gordon to display his feelings...

ext.ext_cn: 在政党改革中，他表现出了非凡的勇气。
ext.ext_en: He has displayed remarkable courage in his efforts to reform the party.

defs.def_en: If you display a characteristic, quality, or emotion, you behave in a way which shows that you have it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们开始在显示那些图像的电脑屏幕上寻找。
ext.ext_en: They started out by looking at the computer screens which display the images...

ext.ext_cn: 选用纯文本显示可以使速度大幅提升。
ext.ext_en: Using the option to display only text speeds things up a lot.

defs.def_en: When a computer displays information, it shows it on a screen.

ext.ext_cn: 你的成果展示
ext.ext_en: ...a display of your work...

ext.ext_cn: 她正倚靠在一个展示巴黎照片的陈列柜上。
ext.ext_en: She was leaning against a display case of prints of Paris.

defs.def_en: A display is an arrangement of things that have been put in a particular place, so that people can see them easily.

ext.ext_cn: 烟火表演
ext.ext_en: ...the firework display.

ext.ext_cn: 体操表演
ext.ext_en: ...gymnastic displays.

defs.def_en: A display is a public performance or other event which is intended to entertain people.

defs.def_cn: (计算机屏幕上的)显示，显像;显示器

ext.ext_cn: 屏幕上显示的内容也可以通过打印机打印一份。
ext.ext_en: A hard copy of the screen display can also be obtained from a printer.

ext.ext_cn: 显示器上出现的令人费解的错误信息
ext.ext_en: ...obscure error messages appearing on the display.

defs.def_en: See also:liquid crystal display;The display on a computer screen is the information that is shown there. The screen itself can also be referred to as the display .

ext.ext_cn: 该修正案对贬损某一宗教教物或信仰的淫秽或不雅内容予以禁止。
ext.ext_en: The amendment prohibits obscene or indecent materials which denigrate the objects or beliefs of a particular religion...

ext.ext_cn: 加拿大最高法院裁定国家有权查禁“侮辱女性”的色情图片。
ext.ext_en: The Canadian Supreme Court ruled that the State can ban pornographic images which 'denigrate women'.

defs.def_en: If you denigrate someone or something, you criticize them unfairly or insult them.

ext.ext_cn: 和第一任丈夫离婚以后，她的事业就开始一路高歌猛进。
ext.ext_en: Her soaraway career took off after she was divorced from her first husband.

ext.ext_cn: 直线上升的销售额
ext.ext_en: ...soaraway sales.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a soaraway success, you mean that its success has suddenly increased.

ext.ext_cn: 时间是 6点 30 分，天几乎要破晓了。
ext.ext_en: It was six-thirty, almost daybreak...

ext.ext_cn: 佩德罗每天早上天还没亮就起床了。
ext.ext_en: Pedro got up every morning before daybreak.

defs.def_en: Daybreak is the time in the morning when light first appears.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 色情的;淫秽的;惹火的;挑逗的

ext.ext_cn: 她新拍的惹火电影
ext.ext_en: ...her raunchy new movie.

ext.ext_cn: 弹奏慢拍挑逗舞曲的乐队
ext.ext_en: ...bands playing slow raunchy dance tunes.

defs.def_en: If a film, a person, or the way that someone is dressed is raunchy, they are sexually exciting.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 绝妙的;非凡的;不可思议的

ext.ext_cn: 他真是个很棒的演员。
ext.ext_en: He certainly is a marvellous actor...

ext.ext_cn: 她做的鱼饼味美可口。
ext.ext_en: She made marvellous fish pie...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as marvellous, you are emphasizing that they are very good.

ext.ext_cn: 登记表显示他的出生日期是 1979年 8 月 2 号。
ext.ext_en: The registration form showed his date of birth as August 2, 1979.

defs.def_en: Your date of birth is the exact date on which you were born, including the year.

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们已经发现了一种约有马驹般大小的有蹄草食性动物的骨骼。
ext.ext_en: Scientists have found the bones of a hoofed grazing animal about the size of a small horse...

ext.ext_cn: 1970 年，法国农场的平均规模为 19 公顷。
ext.ext_en: In 1970 the average size of a French farm was 19 hectares...

defs.def_en: The size of something is how big or small it is. Something's size is determined by comparing it to other things, counting it, or measuring it.

ext.ext_cn: 他明白这个任务有多艰巨。
ext.ext_en: He knows the size of the task...

ext.ext_cn: 杰克在宾馆里四处转了转，为其宏伟气势所倾倒。
ext.ext_en: Jack walked around the hotel and was mesmerized by its sheer size.

defs.def_en: The size of something is the fact that it is very large.

defs.def_cn: (尤指衣服、鞋子等的)尺寸，尺码，号

ext.ext_cn: 我姐姐是一样的身高，不过只穿 12 号的。
ext.ext_en: My sister is the same height but only a size 12...

ext.ext_cn: 我试穿了一下，大小正合适。
ext.ext_en: I tried them on and they were the right size.

defs.def_en: A size is one of a series of graded measurements, especially for things such as clothes or shoes.

defs.def_cn: 使有自知之明;灭…的嚣张气焰

ext.ext_cn: 一度很强势的邮政联盟已经威风不再。
ext.ext_en: The once-powerful post unions have been cut down to size.

defs.def_en: If someone is cut down to size, something happens to make them realize that they are not as important as they think they are.

ext.ext_cn: 每根木材都被刨平了，切割成一定尺寸，并涂上了雪松防腐剂。
ext.ext_en: Every piece of timber was planed, cut to size and stained with cedar preservative.

defs.def_en: If an object is cut to size, its size is altered to make it suitable for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 她正在试穿一件价值 8,000 美元的短外套。
ext.ext_en: She was trying on an $8,000 jacket for size...

ext.ext_cn: 他的言下之意是尼采当时正在尝试每一种风格。
ext.ext_en: He suggests that Nietzsche was trying each style on for size.

defs.def_en: If you try something on for size, you try it to see if it is suitable for you.

defs.def_cn: 用枪击穿膝盖骨（恐怖组织中使用的一种刑罚）
defs.def_en: Knee-capping is the act of shooting someone in the knee and is carried out by some terrorist organizations as a form of punishment.

ext.ext_cn: 勇士的壮举将永远为后人缅怀，正如缭绕群山的薄雾永远不会消散。
ext.ext_en: As long as mist hangs o'er the mountains, the deeds of the brave will be remembered.

defs.def_en: O'er means the same as 'over'.

defs.def_cn: 预示（好事或坏事）；是…的兆头

ext.ext_cn: 她说，从该法案被通过的情形来看，民主的前景惨淡。
ext.ext_en: She says the way the bill was passed bodes ill for democracy...

ext.ext_cn: 格雷丝已擦干了眼泪，应该没事了。
ext.ext_en: Grace had dried her eyes. That boded well.

defs.def_en: If something bodes ill, it makes you think that something bad will happen in the future. If something bodes well, it makes you think that something good will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 大致切一下蔬菜，留下一点切细用作饰菜。
ext.ext_en: Roughly chop the vegetables, and keep back a little to chop finely and serve as a garnish.

defs.def_en: If you keep back part of something, you do not use or give away all of it, so that you still have some to use at a later time.

ext.ext_cn: 他俩谁也没把全部实情都说出来。他们总是要隐瞒些什么。
ext.ext_en: Neither of them is telling the whole truth. Invariably, they keep something back.

defs.def_en: If you keep some information back, you do not tell all that you know about something.

defs.def_cn: 西班牙的;西班牙人的;西班牙语(或文化)的

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙雪利酒
ext.ext_en: ...a Spanish sherry.

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙大使
ext.ext_en: ...the Spanish Ambassador.

defs.def_en: Spanish means belonging or relating to Spain, or to its people, language, or culture.
Spanish is the main language spoken in Spain, and in many countries in South and Central America.
The Spanish are the people who come from Spain.

ext.ext_cn: 沿虚线裁开。
ext.ext_en: Cut along the dotted line.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦你签字同意，这份地产就交由你照管了。
ext.ext_en: Once you sign on the dotted line you are committed to that property.

defs.def_en: A dotted line is a line which is made of a row of dots.

ext.ext_cn: 地图上散布着小城镇的名字。
ext.ext_en: The maps were dotted with the names of small towns.

ext.ext_cn: 开满睡莲的池塘
ext.ext_en: ...a pond that's dotted with water lilies.

defs.def_en: If a place or object is dotted with things, it has many of those things scattered over its surface.

ext.ext_cn: 多件雕塑作品散落在房子各处。
ext.ext_en: Many pieces of sculpture are dotted around the house.

defs.def_en: If things are dotted around a place, they can be found in many different parts of that place.

ext.ext_cn: 大圆点蝶形领结
ext.ext_en: ...a dotted bow tie.

defs.def_en: You use dotted to describe something that is covered with large dots.

ext.ext_cn: 关于女王生活的写实纪录片
ext.ext_en: ...a fly-on-the-wall documentary about the Queen's life.

defs.def_en: A fly-on-the-wall documentary is made by filming people as they do the things they normally do, rather than by interviewing them or asking them to talk directly to the camera.  a fly on the wall→see: fly;

defs.def_cn: （初到某地或初出茅庐却）自命不凡的家伙

ext.ext_cn: 很多人都更愿意跟自己熟悉的权威人物打交道，而不是一个年纪轻轻却自命不凡的家伙。
ext.ext_en: Many prefer a familiar authority figure to a young upstart.

ext.ext_cn: 原本是个无名之辈的目中无人的新丁
ext.ext_en: ...an upstart who had come from nowhere.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone as an upstart when they behave as if they are important, but you think that they are too new in a place or job to be treated as important.
A vestry is a room in a church which the clergy use as an office or to change into their ceremonial clothes for church services.

defs.def_cn: 救护车驾驶员；救护车护理人员
defs.def_en: An ambulanceman is a man who drives an ambulance or takes care of people in an ambulance on the way to hospital.

defs.def_cn: （交响乐团）演奏古典音乐的，爱乐的

ext.ext_cn: 立陶宛爱乐交响乐团演奏了贝多芬的《第九交响曲》。
ext.ext_en: The Lithuanian Philharmonic Orchestra played Beethoven's Ninth Symphony.

ext.ext_cn: 他将在演出季闭幕音乐会上指挥维也纳爱乐乐团演奏。
ext.ext_en: He will conduct the Vienna Philharmonic in the final concert of the season.

defs.def_en: A philharmonic orchestra is a large orchestra which plays classical music.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 骇人听闻的;极不公正的

ext.ext_cn: 多年来，她一直忍受着这种骇人听闻的暴行。
ext.ext_en: She endured the monstrous behaviour for years...

ext.ext_cn: 我只是希望犯下这种骇人罪行的人能承受良心的谴责。
ext.ext_en: I just hope the people who committed this monstrous evil will be able to live with themselves.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation or event as monstrous, you mean that it is extremely shocking or unfair.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （令人不悦之物）巨大的;特大规模的

ext.ext_cn: 又大又难看的铜制建筑物
ext.ext_en: ...a monstrous copper edifice...

ext.ext_cn: 狂风肆虐。
ext.ext_en: It was blowing a monstrous gale.

defs.def_en: If you describe an unpleasant thing as monstrous, you mean that it is extremely large in size or extent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 电影里虚构出来的恐怖形象
ext.ext_en: ...the film's monstrous fantasy figure.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as monstrous, you mean that it is extremely frightening because it appears unnatural or ugly.

defs.def_cn: (政府部门或其他组织的)长官，要人

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲委员会外事专员
ext.ext_en: ...the European Commissioner for External Affairs.

ext.ext_cn: 警察局局长
ext.ext_en: ...police commissioner...

defs.def_en: See also:High Commissioner;A commissioner is an important official in a government department or other organization.

defs.def_cn: 不可避免地;必然(发生)地

ext.ext_cn: 技术变革必然会导致失业。
ext.ext_en: Technological changes will inevitably lead to unemployment...

ext.ext_cn: 提案不可避免地遭遇了麻烦。
ext.ext_en: Inevitably, the proposal is running into difficulties.

defs.def_en: If something will inevitably happen, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

defs.def_cn: 半真半假的陈述;真伪混同的欺骗性陈述

ext.ext_cn: 这篇文章里尽是些错误和真假参半的内容。
ext.ext_en: The article had been full of errors and half truths.

defs.def_en: If you describe statements as half-truths, you mean that they are only partly based on fact and are intended or likely to deceive people.

ext.ext_cn: 最近的调查发现，20%的私人租住房屋并不适合人居住。
ext.ext_en: The recent survey found that 20 per cent of private-rented dwellings are unfit for human habitation...

ext.ext_cn: 屋宇起平地，耕野生人烟。
ext.ext_en: Signs of habitation appeared and the fields gave way to houses.

defs.def_en: Habitation is the activity of living somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 在居住区后面，北边和西边陡然高耸着砂岩悬崖。
ext.ext_en: Behind the habitations, the sandstone cliffs rose abruptly to the north and west.

defs.def_en: A habitation is a place where people live.

ext.ext_cn: 该公路货运公司负责将机械零件运往土耳其。
ext.ext_en: The haulage company was a carrier of machine parts to Turkey.

defs.def_en: Haulage is the business of transporting goods by road.

ext.ext_cn: 坚果和种子里含有丰富的维生素E。
ext.ext_en: Nuts and seeds are good sources of vitamin E.

defs.def_en: See also:groundnut;hazelnut;peanut;The firm shelled fruit of some trees and bushes are called nuts. Some nuts can be eaten.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你想修理轮子，只需拧开这4个螺母就行了。
ext.ext_en: If you want to repair the wheels you just undo the four nuts.

ext.ext_cn: 没有拧紧的螺母和螺栓
ext.ext_en: ...nuts and bolts that haven't been tightened up.

defs.def_en: A nut is a thick metal ring which you screw onto a metal rod called a bolt. Nuts and bolts are used to hold things such as pieces of machinery together.

ext.ext_cn: 花上几千英镑四处去看比赛的足球迷
ext.ext_en: ...a football nut who spends thousands of pounds travelling to watch games.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as, for example, a football nut or a health nut, you mean that they are extremely enthusiastic about the thing mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 他们对汽车非常痴迷。
ext.ext_en: They're nuts about the car...

ext.ext_cn: 她迷恋上你了。
ext.ext_en: She's nuts about you.

defs.def_en: If you are nuts about something or someone, you like them very much.

ext.ext_cn: 外边有个拿着枪的疯子。
ext.ext_en: There's some nut out there with a gun.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a nut, you mean that they are mad.

ext.ext_cn: 你们这些人简直是有毛病。
ext.ext_en: You guys are nuts...

ext.ext_cn: 有几个法国运动员简直是疯了，完全失去了控制。
ext.ext_en: A number of the French players went nuts, completely out of control.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone goes nuts or is nuts, you mean that they go crazy or are very foolish.
A man's testicles can be referred to as his nuts .
Your head can be referred to as your nut .

ext.ext_cn: 如果我爸爸看到我脸上有伤痕，他会气疯的。
ext.ext_en: My father would go nuts if he saw bruises on me...

ext.ext_cn: 我们听到你妹妹在大发脾气。
ext.ext_en: We heard your sister doing her nut.

defs.def_en: If someone goes nuts, or in British English does their nut, they become extremely angry.

ext.ext_cn: 他更为担忧的是外景拍摄的具体内容。
ext.ext_en: He's more concerned about the nuts and bolts of location work.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the nuts and bolts of a subject or an activity, you are referring to the detailed practical aspects of it rather than abstract ideas about it.

ext.ext_cn: 《每日快报》把凯里医生说成是特别难对付的家伙。
ext.ext_en: The Daily Express describes Dr Carey as a pretty tough nut.

defs.def_en: If you think someone is difficult to deal with, you can say they are a tough nut or a hard nut .

defs.def_cn: 棘手的事;难以解决(或理解)的问题

ext.ext_cn: 从很多方面来说，出去交际是最难以做到的事了。
ext.ext_en: Getting out there is in many ways the hardest nut to crack.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a hard nut to crack or a tough nut to crack, you mean that it is difficult to do or to understand.

ext.ext_cn: 他蹲在那儿，双膝的伤痛得他直哼哼。
ext.ext_en: He squatted, grunting at the pain in his knees...

ext.ext_cn: 我们蹲在水池旁，看着潜水者慢慢沉下水。
ext.ext_en: We squatted beside the pool and watched the diver sink slowly down...

defs.def_en: If you squat, you lower yourself towards the ground, balancing on your feet with your legs bent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 埃迪四十多岁，矮矮胖胖的，头发日渐稀疏。
ext.ext_en: Eddie was a short squat fellow in his forties with thinning hair.

ext.ext_cn: 矮墩墩的石马
ext.ext_en: ...squat stone houses.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as squat, you mean they are short and thick, usually in an unattractive way.

defs.def_cn: 擅自占用(闲置房屋或土地)

ext.ext_cn: 你不能这样到处乱窜，擅自占用别人的地产。
ext.ext_en: You can't simply wander around squatting on other people's property...

ext.ext_cn: 他们靠擅自占用土地，按种地的收益分成为生。
ext.ext_en: They earn their living by squatting the land and sharecropping.

defs.def_en: People who squat occupy an unused building or unused land without having a legal right to do so.

ext.ext_cn: 从巴黎回来后，戴维搬进了布里克斯顿的一座空房里住下了。
ext.ext_en: After returning from Paris, David moved to a squat in Brixton...

ext.ext_cn: 托马斯现在要被从他占住的房子里驱赶出来。
ext.ext_en: Thomas now faces eviction from his squat.

defs.def_en: A squat is an empty building that people are living in illegally, without paying any rent or any property tax.

ext.ext_cn: 笑是最具感染力的情感表达方式之一。
ext.ext_en: Laughter is one of the most infectious expressions of emotion...

ext.ext_cn: 开罗对此次攻击表示遗憾。
ext.ext_en: From Cairo came expressions of regret at the attack.

defs.def_en: The expression of ideas or feelings is the showing of them through words, actions, or artistic activities.

ext.ext_cn: 然而，那位公务员的表情还是那样，丝毫没变。
ext.ext_en: The civil servant's expression, however, did not change, not so much as by a flicker...

ext.ext_cn: 莱文坐在那里，神情悲伤。
ext.ext_en: Levin sat there, an expression of sadness on his face...

defs.def_en: Your expression is the way that your face looks at a particular moment. It shows what you are thinking or feeling.

defs.def_cn: （表演、歌唱或演奏时的）情感表现

ext.ext_cn: 我唱歌不是特别合拍，但我认为我唱得比其他很多歌手都更富感情。
ext.ext_en: I don't sing perfectly in tune, but I think I put more expression into my lyrics than a lot of other singers do.

defs.def_en: Expression is the showing of feeling when you are acting, singing, or playing a musical instrument.

ext.ext_cn: 她说话声音很小，但是用了些特别粗俗的字眼儿。
ext.ext_en: She spoke in a quiet voice but used remarkably coarse expressions.

defs.def_en: An expression is a word or phrase.

ext.ext_cn: 这是电场数学表达式的基础。
ext.ext_en: This forms the basis for our mathematical expression for the electric field.

defs.def_en: In mathematics, an expression is a symbol or equation which represents a quantity or problem.

ext.ext_cn: 住院后不久，他就死于大面积脑溢血。
ext.ext_en: Shortly after his admission into hospital he had a massive brain haemorrhage and died...

ext.ext_cn: 药品禁忌症：出血性中风忌用。
ext.ext_en: These drugs will not be used if hemorrhage is the cause of the stroke.

defs.def_en: A haemorrhage is serious bleeding inside a person's body.

ext.ext_cn: 生我3个儿子时，我每次都出现产后大出血。
ext.ext_en: I haemorrhaged badly after the birth of all three of my sons...

ext.ext_cn: 如果这种情况得不到治疗的话，人就会因失血过多而死亡。
ext.ext_en: If this is left untreated, one can actually haemorrhage to death.

defs.def_en: If someone is haemorrhaging, there is serious bleeding inside their body.

ext.ext_cn: 他表示这一举措势必会抑制殖民地人才和企业严重流失的现象。
ext.ext_en: He said the move would definitely stem the haemorrhage of talent and enterprise from the colony.

defs.def_en: A haemorrhage of people or resources is a rapid loss of them from a group or place, seriously weakening its position.

ext.ext_cn: 威尼斯正在丧失它的立足之本，那就是它的人民。
ext.ext_en: Venice is haemorrhaging the very resource which could save it: its own people...

ext.ext_cn: 数据表明，这家集团的现金正在大量流失。
ext.ext_en: The figures showed that cash was haemorrhaging from the conglomerate.

defs.def_en: To haemorrhage people or resources means to lose them rapidly and become weak. You can also say that people or resources haemorrhage from a place or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 一条面包的价钱增长了4倍。
ext.ext_en: The cost of a loaf of bread has increased five-fold...

ext.ext_cn: 1989年咖啡的价格跌至低谷，在很多国家甚至连生产成本都收不回来。
ext.ext_en: In 1989 the price of coffee fell so low that in many countries it did not even cover the cost of production...

defs.def_en: The cost of something is the amount of money that is needed in order to buy, do, or make it.

ext.ext_cn: 该课程只招收12人，学费为50英镑。
ext.ext_en: This course is limited to 12 people and costs £50...

ext.ext_cn: 彩绘墙壁看上去更有趣而且花费也不高。
ext.ext_en: Painted walls look much more interesting and doesn't cost much...

defs.def_en: If something costs a particular amount of money, you can buy, do, or make it for that amount.

ext.ext_cn: 成本降低了30%到50%。
ext.ext_en: Costs have been cut by 30 to 50 per cent...

ext.ext_cn: 该公司承认其成本仍然过高。
ext.ext_en: The company admits its costs are still too high.

defs.def_en: Your costs are the total amount of money that you must spend on running your home or business.

ext.ext_cn: 制作节目的所有成本：人工、租用场地、灯光现在都已经估算了。
ext.ext_en: Everything that goes into making a programme, staff, rent, lighting, is now costed.

ext.ext_cn: 估价约为1,000万英镑的70套公寓、店铺、办公室、一家大饭店
ext.ext_en: ...seventy apartments, shops, offices, a restaurant and hotel, costed at around 10 million pounds.

defs.def_en: When something that you plan to do or make is costed, the amount of money you need is calculated in advance.

ext.ext_cn: 他被监禁了18个月，还责令他支付550英镑的诉讼费。
ext.ext_en: He was jailed for 18 months and ordered to pay £550 costs.

defs.def_en: If someone is ordered by a court of law to pay costs, they have to pay a sum of money towards the expenses of a court case they are involved in.

ext.ext_cn: 按成本价出售香烟和糖果的商店
ext.ext_en: ...a store that provided cigarettes and candy bars at cost.

ext.ext_cn: 倾销行为——即通过以低于成本的价格销售产品来挤垮竞争对手
ext.ext_en: ...a practice known as dumping – that is, selling below cost to drive competition out of business.

defs.def_en: If something is sold at cost, it is sold for the same price as it cost the seller to buy it.

ext.ext_cn: 3月份，萨利纳斯先生关闭了该市的炼油场，造成5亿美元的损失，并使5,000人失去了工作。
ext.ext_en: In March Mr Salinas shut down the city's oil refinery at a cost of $500 million and 5,000 jobs.

ext.ext_cn: 如此地害怕某事觉得必须避开它，无论自己的生活方式因此受到怎样的影响都在所不惜
ext.ext_en: ...being so afraid of something that you feel you have to avoid it whatever the cost to your lifestyle.

defs.def_en: The cost of something is the loss, damage, or injury that is involved in trying to achieve it.

ext.ext_cn: 手术救了一名6岁男孩的命，却使他失明了
ext.ext_en: ...a six-year-old boy whose life was saved by an operation that cost him his sight...

ext.ext_cn: 这种增长会使小企业受损并使成千上万的人失去工作。
ext.ext_en: The increase will hurt small business and cost many thousands of jobs.

defs.def_en: If an event or mistake costs you something, you lose that thing as the result of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们告诉雅克·德洛尔必须不惜任何代价避免一场毁灭性的世界贸易战。
ext.ext_en: They told Jacques Delors a disastrous world trade war must be avoided at all costs.

defs.def_en: If you say that something must be avoided at all costs, you are emphasizing that it must not be allowed to happen under any circumstances.

defs.def_cn: 无论如何;在任何代价下

ext.ext_cn: 这本书非常重要，无论如何也要出版。
ext.ext_en: This book is of such importance that it must be published at any cost...

ext.ext_cn: 他命令军队无论如何也要夺回营地。
ext.ext_en: He ordered the army to recapture the camp at any cost.

defs.def_en: If you say that something must be done at any cost, you are emphasizing that it must be done, even if this requires a lot of effort or money.

ext.ext_cn: 东欧的几个国家正在计算昨天的地震带来的损失。
ext.ext_en: Several countries in eastern Europe are counting the cost of yesterday's earthquake...

ext.ext_cn: 很多人不考虑后果就莽撞行事。
ext.ext_en: Many people act on impulse without counting the cost.

defs.def_en: If someone counts the cost of something that has happened or will happen, they consider how the consequences of that action or event affect them.

ext.ext_cn: 设计精美的服装价格昂贵。
ext.ext_en: Well-designed clothes cost money.

defs.def_en: If you say that something costs money, you mean that it has to be paid for, and perhaps cannot be afforded.

ext.ext_cn: 凯瑟琳吃了苦头才知道服过刑会给一个人带来什么影响。
ext.ext_en: Kathryn knows to her cost the effect of having served a jail sentence...

ext.ext_cn: 他吃了亏后才发现自己真正能够交心的人寥寥无几。
ext.ext_en: There are very few people he can talk to in total confidence, as he has discovered to his cost.

defs.def_en: If you know something to your cost, you know it because of an unpleasant experience that you have had.
A truant is a pupil who stays away from school without permission.

ext.ext_cn: 上四年级时，他频频旷课。
ext.ext_en: In his fourth year he was truanting regularly.

defs.def_en: If a pupil truants, he or she stays away from school without permission.

ext.ext_cn: 她因逃课而惹了麻烦。
ext.ext_en: She was getting into trouble over playing truant from school.

defs.def_en: If a pupil plays truant, he or she stays away from school without permission.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在我看来，罗伯特爵士的争辩纯属瞎说。
ext.ext_en: It seemed to me that Sir Robert's  arguments were nonsensical...

ext.ext_cn: 复苏经济的承诺是千真万确的。
ext.ext_en: There were no nonsensical promises about reviving the economy.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is nonsensical, you think it is stupid, ridiculous, or untrue.

defs.def_cn: (听众、观众参与的)电话热线节目,互动节目

ext.ext_cn: 洛杉矶KABC广播电台播出的听众热线节目
ext.ext_en: ...a call-in show on Los Angeles radio station KABC.

defs.def_en: A call-in is a programme on radio or television in which people telephone with questions or opinions and their calls are broadcast.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指女孩）漂亮的，好看的，标致的

ext.ext_cn: 她是一个非常迷人的漂亮女孩。
ext.ext_en: She's a very charming and very pretty girl.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone, especially a girl, as pretty, you mean that they look nice and are attractive in a delicate way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （地方或事物）漂亮的，美丽的（但无特殊之处）

ext.ext_cn: 惠特斯特布尔仍然是一个非常漂亮的小镇。
ext.ext_en: Whitstable is still a very pretty little town.

ext.ext_cn: 罩着漂亮的印花布的舒适沙发
ext.ext_en: ...comfortable sofas covered in a pretty floral print.

defs.def_en: A place or a thing that is pretty is attractive and pleasant, in a charming but not particularly unusual way.

ext.ext_cn: 我很清楚她会怎么做。
ext.ext_en: I had a pretty good idea what she was going to do...

ext.ext_cn: 我到达之后，很快就找到了住处。
ext.ext_en: Pretty soon after my arrival I found lodgings.

defs.def_en: You can use pretty before an adjective or adverb to mean 'quite' or 'rather'.  →see usage note at:fairly

ext.ext_cn: 他的新政府看起来和旧政府没什么两样。
ext.ext_en: His new government looks pretty much like the old one...

ext.ext_cn: 我几乎每周都出去旅行。
ext.ext_en: I travel pretty well every week.

defs.def_en: Pretty much or pretty well means 'almost'.

defs.def_cn: 处于有利的位置；处境优越

ext.ext_cn: 战争开始的时候，他们认为自己境况不错，因为他们粮食准备充足。
ext.ext_en: When the war started, they thought they were sitting pretty, because they had all that extra grain.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is sitting pretty, you mean that they are in a good, safe, or comfortable position.

defs.def_cn: 跟班儿；手下；羽翼；喽啰；走卒

ext.ext_cn: 所有的手下都怕他。
ext.ext_en: Every underling feared him.

ext.ext_cn: 行卑劣之事的走卒
ext.ext_en: ...underlings who do the dirty work.

ext.ext_en: A clearly quantifiable measure of quality is not necessary.

defs.def_en: Something that is quantifiable can be measured or counted in a scientific way.

ext.ext_cn: 她把水槽的塞子塞上，注满凉水。
ext.ext_en: She put the plug in the sink and filled it with cold water.

defs.def_en: A plug is a thick, circular piece of rubber or plastic that you use to block the hole in a bath or sink when it is filled with water.

defs.def_cn: （木头、塑料或蜡制的堵洞）塞子，栓

ext.ext_cn: 钻孔已塞上了塞子。
ext.ext_en: A plug had been inserted in the drill hole.

defs.def_en: A plug is a small, round piece of wood, plastic, or wax which is used to block holes.

ext.ext_en: Crews are working to plug a major oil leak.

defs.def_en: If you plug a hole, you block it with something.

defs.def_cn: 大肆宣传（尤指书或电影）；为…大做广告

ext.ext_cn: 我们不想让那些只想为书或电影做广告的人上节目。
ext.ext_en: We did not want people on the show who are purely interested in plugging a book or film.

ext.ext_cn: 我们今晚做这个节目吧，它会是一次很好的宣传、有力的推介。
ext.ext_en: Let's do this show tonight and it'll be a great plug, a great promotion.

defs.def_en: If someone plugs a commercial product, especially a book or a film, they praise it in order to encourage people to buy it or see it because they have an interest in it doing well.

ext.ext_cn: 银行能让该工程下马。
ext.ext_en: The banks have the power to pull the plug on the project.

defs.def_en: If someone in a position of power pulls the plug on a project or on someone's activities, they use their power to stop them continuing.

ext.ext_cn: 也有迹象表明今晚可能会发生大规模的坦克战。
ext.ext_en: There are also indications that a major tank battle may be shaping up for tonight...

ext.ext_cn: 这次事故已经造成严重的环境灾难。
ext.ext_en: The accident is already shaping up as a significant environmental disaster...

defs.def_en: If something is shaping up, it is starting to develop or seems likely to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 我对休和我将如何为人父母确实有些忧虑。
ext.ext_en: I did have a few worries about how Hugh and I would shape up as parents...

ext.ext_cn: 现在开始招女兵了，我听说她们表现很好。
ext.ext_en: Girls are being recruited now. I heard they are shaping up very well.

defs.def_en: If you ask how someone or something is shaping up, you want to know how well they are doing in a particular situation or activity.

defs.def_cn: 端正行为;好自为之;好好干

ext.ext_cn: 仅仅告诉青少年要品行端正，做有意义的事，是没有用的。
ext.ext_en: It is no use simply to tell adolescents to shape up and do something useful.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to shape up, you are telling them to start behaving in a sensible and responsible way.

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉晚餐时只吃一盘奶酪，但她并没有真觉得饿。
ext.ext_en: Sarah picked at a plate of cheese for supper, but she wasn't really hungry.

defs.def_en: If you pick at the food that you are eating, you eat only very small amounts of it.

defs.def_cn: 指出…的错误;揭穿…的吹嘘（或虚假）

ext.ext_cn: 历史学家迈克尔·贝施洛斯破除了几个不实传言。
ext.ext_en: Historian Michael Beschloss debunks a few myths.

ext.ext_cn: 揭露教会和王室真相的启蒙运动时期的法国人
ext.ext_en: ...the Frenchmen of the enlightenment who debunked the church and the crown.

defs.def_en: If you debunk a widely held belief, you show that it is false. If you debunk something that is widely admired, you show that it is not as good as people think it is.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有事业心的;有创新精神的;有胆识的

ext.ext_en: Debra is a very enterprising young black businesswoman who is involved in a lot of activities...

ext.ext_cn: 一些有创新精神的成员找到各种增收减支的方法。
ext.ext_en: Some enterprising members found ways of reducing their expenses or raising their incomes.

defs.def_en: An enterprising person is willing to try out new, unusual ways of doing or achieving something.
A ragout is a strongly flavoured stew of meat or vegetables or both.

ext.ext_cn: 立陶宛人开始意识到物资日益匮乏。
ext.ext_en: Lithuanians are waking up to a world of increasing shortages...

ext.ext_en: People should wake up to the fact that people with disabilities have got a vote as well.

defs.def_en: If you wake up to something, you become aware of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 简洁扼要的；言简意赅的

ext.ext_en: His pithy advice to young painters was, 'Above all, keep your colours fresh.'...

ext.ext_cn: 他们中很多人特别赞扬了影片精炼的对白。
ext.ext_en: Many of them made a point of praising the film's pithy dialogue.

defs.def_en: A pithy comment or piece of writing is short, direct, and full of meaning.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你这个没良心的小坏蛋。
ext.ext_en: You ungrateful brat.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as ungrateful, you are criticizing them for not showing thanks or for being unkind to someone who has helped them or done them a favour.

defs.def_cn: （对观点、指责或理论的）驳斥，反驳

ext.ext_en: He prepared a complete refutation of the Republicans' most serious charges.

defs.def_en: A refutation of an argument, accusation, or theory is something that proves it is wrong or untrue.

ext.ext_en: When I had my first baby friends warned me that children were expensive...

ext.ext_cn: 他们警告他说独自航行危险重重。
ext.ext_en: They warned him of the dangers of sailing alone...

defs.def_en: If you warn someone about something such as a possible danger or problem, you tell them about it so that they are aware of it.

ext.ext_en: Mrs. Blount warned me not to interfere...

ext.ext_cn: 必须警告孩子们远离交通要道。
ext.ext_en: Children must be warned to stay away from main roads...

defs.def_en: If you warn someone not to do something, you advise them not to do it so that they can avoid possible danger or punishment.  →see usage note at:avoid

ext.ext_cn: 但要慎重：这个选择代价不菲。
ext.ext_en: But be warned: this is not a cheap option.

defs.def_en: If someone says to you 'be warned', they are advising you to be cautious, because there are risks that you may not have thought about.

defs.def_en: If you feel snug or are in a snug place, you are very warm and comfortable, especially because you are protected from cold weather.

ext.ext_en: ...a snug black T-shirt and skin-tight black jeans...

ext.ext_en: Every dress is lined, ensuring a snug, firm fit.

defs.def_en: Something such as a piece of clothing that is snug fits very closely or tightly.

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯经过重生成为强国。
ext.ext_en: Russia was being reborn as a great power.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has been reborn, you mean that they have become active again after a period of being inactive.

defs.def_cn: （设于桌边或汽车内等供幼儿坐的）增高椅，增高垫

defs.def_en: A proverb is a short sentence that people often quote, which gives advice or tells you something about life.

ext.ext_cn: 他挽起了衬衫袖子。

ext.ext_en: ...pan-fried chicken breast.

ext.ext_en: The railroad finally reached Santa Barbara in 1877.
