ext.ext_en: ...The Chicago and Northwestern Railroad.

defs.def_en: A railroad is a company or organization that operates railway routes.

defs.def_cn: 强迫，迫使（某人仓促行事）

ext.ext_en: He more or less railroaded the rest of Europe into recognising the new 'independent' states...

ext.ext_cn: 他强制性地推行了改革。
ext.ext_en: He railroaded the reforms through.

defs.def_en: If you railroad someone into doing something, you make them do it although they do not really want to, by hurrying them and putting pressure on them.

ext.ext_en: I took a great dislike to the clock, so I chucked it in the dustbin...

ext.ext_en: That second night, Sid Vicious chucked a bottle at the stage.

defs.def_en: When you chuck something somewhere, you throw it there in a casual or careless way.

ext.ext_en: Last summer, he chucked his 10-year career as a London stockbroker and headed for the mountains.

ext.ext_en: Almost half the British public think about chucking in their jobs and doing their own thing at least once a month.

ext.ext_cn: 石料开始被用作盖屋顶的材料。
ext.ext_en: Stone began to be used as a roofing material.

defs.def_en: Roofing is material used for making or covering roofs.

ext.ext_cn: 屋顶修葺公司
ext.ext_en: ...a roofing company.

defs.def_en: Roofing is the work of putting new roofs on houses.

defs.def_cn: 纺织品;布料;线;零星服饰用品
defs.def_en: Dry goods are cloth, thread, and other things that are sold at a draper's shop.

defs.def_cn: (正式或明确的口头或书面)陈述，声明

ext.ext_en: 'Things are moving ahead.'— I found that statement vague and unclear.

ext.ext_en: The statement by the military denied any involvement in last night's attack.

ext.ext_en: ...the backroom of the officers' club.

defs.def_en: A backroom is a room that is situated at the back of a building, especially a private room.

defs.def_cn: 幕后人物；幕后活动场所

ext.ext_cn: 他确信原先的幕后智囊能够填补暂时的空缺。
ext.ext_en: He is confident the backroom can step into the temporary void...

ext.ext_cn: 公众监督把公务员从幕后带到了公众关注之下。
ext.ext_en: Public scrutiny had brought civil servants out from the backroom and into the spotlight.

defs.def_en: You can use backroom to refer to people in an organization who do important work but are not seen or known about by the public. You can also use backroom to refer to a place where such people work.

ext.ext_cn: 他们称总统人选问题是个幕后交易。
ext.ext_en: They have been calling the Presidency decision a backroom deal.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a deal made by someone such as a politician as a backroom deal, you disapprove of it because it has been made in a secret, dishonest way.

ext.ext_cn: 还没有家用小器具和省时的家用电器的时候，准备食物得花大半天时间。
ext.ext_en: In the days before domestic gadgetry and time-saving appliances, food preparation took up most of the day.

ext.ext_cn: 对时新电子小玩意的痴迷
ext.ext_en: ...a passion for the latest electronic gadgetry.

defs.def_en: Gadgetry is small machines or devices which do something useful.

defs.def_cn: （尤指因头发乱糟糟而）不顺心的一天，紧张的一天

ext.ext_cn: 就因为卡萝尔今天不太顺心，所以弄得大家鸡飞狗跳。
ext.ext_en: All this fuss is because Carol is having a bad hair day.

defs.def_en: People sometimes say they are having a bad hair day when they do not feel very happy or relaxed, especially because their hair does not look good.

defs.def_cn: (法国的)乡间别墅(或城堡)的女主人
defs.def_en: A chatelaine is the female owner, or the wife of the owner, of a castle or large country house.

defs.def_cn: （科幻小说或电影中部分器官被电子机械替代的）超人的

ext.ext_cn: 女超人
ext.ext_en: ...the Bionic Woman.

defs.def_en: In science fiction books or films, a bionic person is someone who has special powers, such as being exceptionally strong or having exceptionally good sight, because parts of their body have been replaced by electronic machinery.

ext.ext_cn: 隐瞒利息收入的逃税者
ext.ext_en: ...tax dodgers who hide their interest earnings.

ext.ext_cn: 对逃票者的严打
ext.ext_en: ...a crackdown on fare dodgers.

defs.def_en: See also:draft dodger;A dodger is someone who avoids doing a duty or paying a charge, for example paying taxes or for train travel.
A heuristic method of learning involves discovery and problem-solving, using reasoning and past experience.
See also:algorithm;A heuristic computer program uses rules based on previous experience in order to solve a problem, rather than using a mathematical procedure.
A scarecrow is an object in the shape of a person, which is put in a field where crops are growing in order to frighten birds away.

ext.ext_cn: 多数民主国家已经废除了死刑。
ext.ext_en: Most democracies have abolished capital punishment.

defs.def_en: Capital punishment is punishment which involves the legal killing of a person who has committed a serious crime such as murder.

ext.ext_cn: 他在人行横道上被撞倒。
ext.ext_en: He was knocked down on a pedestrian crossing.

defs.def_en: A pedestrian crossing is a place where pedestrians can cross a street and where motorists must stop to let them cross.

ext.ext_cn: “如果他们宣战却无人应战该怎么办？”是他那一代人钟爱的格言。
ext.ext_en: 'What if they gave a war and nobody came?' was one of his generation's favored aphorisms.

defs.def_en: An aphorism is a short witty sentence which expresses a general truth or comment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他年龄在25至30岁之间，中等个，灰褐色的头发长至衣领。
ext.ext_en: He was aged between 25 and 30, with a medium build and collar-length mousy hair.

defs.def_en: Mousy hair is a dull light brown colour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 安静的;羞怯的;不引人注意的

ext.ext_cn: 检察官记得，她是一个矮小、羞怯、总是闷闷不乐的人。
ext.ext_en: The Inspector remembered her as a small, mousy woman, invariably worried.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as mousy, you mean that they are quiet and shy and that people do not notice them.

defs.def_cn: 夸脱(容量单位，等于2品脱)

ext.ext_cn: 拿1夸脱牛奶或一条面包。
ext.ext_en: Pick up a quart of milk or a loaf of bread.

defs.def_en: A quart is a unit of volume that is equal to two pints.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不名誉的;可耻的;不光彩的

ext.ext_cn: 马克没有做任何不光彩的事。
ext.ext_en: Mark had done nothing dishonourable...

ext.ext_cn: 他不是个不知羞耻的人，他只是个专业人士。
ext.ext_en: He was not a dishonourable man, he was merely a professional.

defs.def_en: Someone who is dishonourable is not honest and does things which you consider to be morally unacceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 满头银发、个子矮小的热情男子
ext.ext_en: ...a small, intense man with silvery hair...

ext.ext_cn: 满月当空，银色的清辉透过窗帘照进来。
ext.ext_en: There was a full moon and its silvery light seeped through the curtains.

defs.def_en: Silvery things look like silver or are the colour of silver.
Toilet paper is thin soft paper that people use to clean themselves after they have got rid of urine or faeces from their body.

ext.ext_cn: 芬兰语的名词单数形式的 15 种格尾
ext.ext_en: ...the fifteen case endings of the singular form of the Finnish noun...

ext.ext_cn: 单词 you 可以是单数也可以是复数。
ext.ext_en: The word 'you' can be singular or plural.

defs.def_en: The singular form of a word is the form that is used when referring to one person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: Inuit (依努依特人)的单数形式是 Inuk。
ext.ext_en: The singular of Inuit is Inuk.

defs.def_en: The singular of a noun is the form of it that is used to refer to one person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 无比甜美的微笑
ext.ext_en: ...a smile of singular sweetness...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管胜算微乎其微，巴雷还是很快被身不由己地推到了选举的舞台上。
ext.ext_en: Barre was quickly drawn into the electoral arena, although with singular lack of success.

defs.def_en: Singular means very great and remarkable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 红衣主教梅斯基亚无疑是个怪人。
ext.ext_en: Cardinal Meschia was without doubt a singular character...

ext.ext_cn: 我真想不出来他从哪来的那种奇怪念头。
ext.ext_en: Where he got that singular notion I just can't think.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as singular, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

ext.ext_cn: 今年，吉姆将重考没有及格的科目。
ext.ext_en: This year, Jim is resitting the exams he failed...

ext.ext_cn: 如果没有通过的话，他们常常可以在第二年补考。
ext.ext_en: If they fail, they can often resit the next year.

defs.def_en: If someone resits a test or examination, they take it again, usually because they failed the first time.

defs.def_cn: 浣熊（见于中北美洲及西印度群岛）
defs.def_en: A raccoon is a small animal that has dark-coloured fur with white stripes on its face and on its long tail. Raccoons live in forests in North and Central America and the West Indies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我对猫过敏。
ext.ext_en: I'm allergic to cats.

defs.def_en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

ext.ext_cn: 有些孩子会对豆浆过敏。
ext.ext_en: Soya milk can cause allergic reactions in some children.

defs.def_en: If you have an allergic reaction to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他极其厌恶冒险。
ext.ext_en: He was allergic to risk.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are allergic to something or someone, you mean that you dislike them very strongly and try to avoid them.

ext.ext_cn: 航班晚点会引发连锁反应。仅仅一趟晚点的航班就可能运载着许多需要转机的乘客。
ext.ext_en: Delayed flights have a ripple effect. Just one late flight could be carrying passengers for a dozen connecting services.

defs.def_en: If an event or action has a ripple effect, it causes several other events to happen one after the other.

ext.ext_cn: 国王虽说沮丧，但仍一往无前。
ext.ext_en: The King, however dispirited, ploughs on...

ext.ext_cn: 总理选择了苦苦执行可能使他的联合政府触礁的政策。
ext.ext_en: The Chancellor has opted to plough on with policies that could run his coalition on to the rocks.

defs.def_en: If you plough on, you continue moving or trying to complete something, even though it takes a lot of effort to go on.

ext.ext_cn: 岛上壮丽的风景
ext.ext_en: ...the island's spectacular scenery...

ext.ext_cn: 有时他们只是沿着小路慢慢地开车，欣赏两旁的风景。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes they just drive slowly down the lane enjoying the scenery.

defs.def_en: The scenery in a country area is the land, water, or plants that you can see around you.  →see usage note at:countryside
In a theatre, the scenery consists of the structures and painted backgrounds that show where the action in the play takes place.

ext.ext_cn: 换个地方或许对你大有裨益。
ext.ext_en: A change of scenery might do you the power of good.

defs.def_en: If you have a change of scenery, you go somewhere different after being in a particular place for a long time.
A valve is a device attached to a pipe or a tube which controls the flow of air or liquid through the pipe or tube.

ext.ext_cn: 他的一个心瓣也有毛病。
ext.ext_en: He also has problems with a heart valve.

defs.def_en: A valve is a small piece of tissue in your heart or in a vein which controls the flow of blood and keeps it flowing in one direction only.
A businessman is a man who works in business.

defs.def_cn: （度假公司派出照料度假者的）度假代理
defs.def_en: A holiday rep is someone employed by a holiday company to help look after people when they are on holiday.

defs.def_cn: (安排)没有落实;(计划)未能实现;(交易)没有达成

ext.ext_cn: 他们出价两千万英镑，想把这块地变成高尔夫球场，但交易泡汤了。
ext.ext_en: They wanted to turn the estate into a private golf course and offered £20 million, but the deal fell through.

defs.def_en: If an arrangement, plan, or deal falls through, it fails to happen.

defs.def_cn: 升（米制容量单位，等于1.76英国品脱或2.11美国品脱）

ext.ext_cn: 15升水
ext.ext_en: ...15 litres of water...

ext.ext_cn: 这项税收会使每升汽油价格提高约3.5便士。
ext.ext_en: This tax would raise petrol prices by about 3.5p per litre.

defs.def_en: A litre is a metric unit of volume that is a thousand cubic centimetres. It is equal to 1.76 British pints or 2.11 American pints.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 受喜爱的；受欢迎的；当红的

ext.ext_cn: 这是有史以来发明出的最受欢迎的球类运动。
ext.ext_en: This is the most popular ball game ever devised...

ext.ext_cn: 巧克力酱总是深受年轻人的喜爱。
ext.ext_en: Chocolate sauce is always popular with youngsters.

defs.def_en: Something that is popular is enjoyed or liked by a lot of people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他一直是法国最受人爱戴的政治家。
ext.ext_en: He remained  the most popular politician in France...

ext.ext_cn: 他不仅才华横溢，而且深受同事的喜爱。
ext.ext_en: He was not only talented but immensely popular with his colleagues.

defs.def_en: Someone who is popular is liked by most people, or by most people in a particular group.

defs.def_cn: （报纸、电视节目、艺术形式等）通俗的，流行的，大众化的

ext.ext_cn: 英国通俗报刊又一次对他们的婚姻进行了铺天盖地的报道。
ext.ext_en: Once again the popular press in Britain has been rife with stories about their marriage.

ext.ext_cn: 现代流行音乐的经典之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the classics of modern popular music.

defs.def_en: Popular newspapers, television programmes, or forms of art are aimed at ordinary people and not at experts or intellectuals.

ext.ext_cn: 与人们普遍的看法相反，石油公司并不能控制原油价格。
ext.ext_en: Contrary to popular belief, the oil companies can't control the price of crude...

ext.ext_cn: 军政府一直未能赢得广泛的支持。
ext.ext_en: The military government has been unable to win popular support...

defs.def_en: Popular ideas, feelings, or attitudes are approved of or held by most people.

ext.ext_cn: 已故总统费迪南德·马科斯于1986年被民众起义赶下了台。
ext.ext_en: The late President Ferdinand Marcos was overthrown by a popular uprising in 1986.

defs.def_en: Popular is used to describe political activities which involve the ordinary people of a country, and not just members of political parties.

defs.def_cn: (面部或身体局部的)抽搐，痉挛

ext.ext_cn: 患神经性痉挛的人
ext.ext_en: ...people with nervous tics...

ext.ext_cn: 她左眼处的肌肉出现抽搐。
ext.ext_en: She developed a tic in her left eye.

defs.def_en: If someone has a tic, a part of their face or body keeps making a small uncontrollable movement, for example because they are tired or have a nervous illness.

defs.def_cn: 白兰地姜饼，姜味薄脆卷心饼（常带奶油夹心）
defs.def_en: Brandy snaps are very thin crisp biscuits in the shape of hollow cylinders. They are flavoured with ginger and are often filled with cream.
A cookbook is a book that contains recipes for preparing food.

defs.def_cn: (使)清晰;(使)变得明显;(使)显现出来

ext.ext_cn: 你可能患有某种 10 年或者 15 年都看不出什么症状来的怪病。
ext.ext_en: You may have some strange disease that may not show up for 10 or 15 years...

ext.ext_cn: 橙色的尖端在大多数背景下都很醒目。
ext.ext_en: The orange tip shows up well against most backgrounds.

defs.def_en: If something shows up or if something shows it up, it can be clearly seen or noticed.

ext.ext_cn: 她在列昂诺夫面前让他难堪，他要教训她一通。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to teach her a lesson for showing him up in front of Leonov...

ext.ext_cn: 她一直说我应该尝一尝，但我可不想丢人。
ext.ext_en: She kept saying I ought to try some, but I wasn't going to show myself up...

defs.def_en: If someone or something shows you up, they make you feel embarrassed or ashamed of them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我能清楚地回想起我女儿来医院看我和她刚出生的弟弟的那一刻。
ext.ext_en: I can remember the precise moment when my daughter came to see me and her new baby brother in hospital...

ext.ext_cn: 残骸的确切位置是在1988年发现的。
ext.ext_en: The precise location of the wreck was discovered in 1988...

defs.def_en: You use precise to emphasize that you are referring to an exact thing, rather than something vague.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们讲一口非常地道的英语。
ext.ext_en: They speak very precise English...

ext.ext_cn: 他话不多，但他说的话既准确又中肯。
ext.ext_en: He does not talk too much and what he has to say is precise and to the point.

defs.def_en: Something that is precise is exact and accurate in all its details.

ext.ext_cn: 一个多星期以前，确切地说是周四晚上，苏珊在夜校上课。
ext.ext_en: More than a week ago, Thursday evening to be precise, Susanne was at her evening class...

ext.ext_cn: 那天晚上我们去吃饭的那家餐馆晚上11点时比10点时人更多，准确地说多了51人。
ext.ext_en: The restaurant in which we ate that night had more people in it at 11pm, 51 more to be precise, than it did at 10pm.

defs.def_en: You say 'to be precise' to indicate that you are giving more detailed or accurate information than you have just given.
Your eyelashes are the hairs which grow on the edges of your eyelids.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 缺乏创造力的；单调乏味的

ext.ext_cn: 这个剧本极其没有创意。
ext.ext_en: The script was singularly uninspired...

ext.ext_cn: 诚实正直但却缺乏创见的领袖
ext.ext_en: ...an honest if uninspired leader...

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as uninspired, you are criticizing them because they do not seem to have any original or exciting qualities.
A fox is a wild animal which looks like a dog and has reddish-brown fur, a pointed face and ears, and a thick tail. Foxes eat smaller animals.

ext.ext_cn: 我承认我一度被难住了。
ext.ext_en: I admit I was foxed for some time...

ext.ext_cn: 我们只碰到过一个把一位专家也难住了的问题。
ext.ext_en: Only once did we hit on a question which foxed one of the experts...

defs.def_en: If you are foxed by something, you cannot understand it or solve it.

ext.ext_cn: 恩里科很有心计，是一只狡猾的老狐狸。
ext.ext_en: Enrico was too good, an old fox, cunning.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a fox, you mean they are very clever and deceitful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 该事件发生在竞选活动的关键时期。
ext.ext_en: The incident happened at a critical point in the campaign...

ext.ext_cn: 环境保护主义者说造成该城市污染问题的一个关键因素是其人口数量。
ext.ext_en: Environmentalists say a critical factor in the city's pollution is its population...

defs.def_en: A critical time, factor, or situation is extremely important.

ext.ext_cn: 如果局势变得危急，德国当局将考虑实施空运。
ext.ext_en: The German authorities are considering an airlift if the situation becomes critical...

ext.ext_cn: 其日常财务状况十分糟糕。
ext.ext_en: Its day-to-day finances are in a critical state.

defs.def_en: A critical situation is very serious and dangerous.

ext.ext_cn: 据说伤者中有10人情况危急。
ext.ext_en: Ten of the injured are said to be in critical condition.

defs.def_en: If a person is critical or in a critical condition in hospital, they are seriously ill.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他在报告中对主审法官有颇多批评。
ext.ext_en: His report is highly critical of the trial judge...

ext.ext_cn: 几十名一直批判该政权的知识分子
ext.ext_en: ...a few dozen intellectuals who've been critical of the regime...

defs.def_en: To be critical of someone or something means to criticize them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们需要培养对文章的评判能力。
ext.ext_en: We need to become critical text-readers...

ext.ext_cn: 马克思的著作不仅仅是对资本主义生产的批判性研究。
ext.ext_en: Marx's work was more than a critical study of capitalist production.

defs.def_en: A critical approach to something involves examining and judging it carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 该影片受到了影评人和公众的高度评价。
ext.ext_en: The film met with considerable critical and public acclaim...

ext.ext_cn: 这次演出同样好评如潮。
ext.ext_en: The show was also a resounding critical success.

defs.def_en: If something or someone receives critical acclaim, critics say that they are very good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极坏的;极差的;极其恶劣的

ext.ext_cn: 对人权的严重践踏
ext.ext_en: ...the most egregious abuses of human rights.

defs.def_en: Egregious means very bad indeed.
A ring road is a road that goes round the edge of a town so that traffic does not have to go through the town centre.

defs.def_cn: （penny的复数，通常仅指硬币，不指数量）
defs.def_en: Pennies is the plural of penny .Pennies is mainly used to refer only to coins, rather than to amounts.

ext.ext_cn: 上星期她卷入了一场严重的车祸。
ext.ext_en: She was involved in a serious car accident last week...

ext.ext_cn: 六名乘客在车祸中丧生。
ext.ext_en: Six passengers were killed in the accident.

defs.def_en: An accident happens when a vehicle hits a person, an object, or another vehicle, causing injury or damage.

defs.def_cn: （不幸的）意外遭遇，不测事件;事故

ext.ext_cn: 每年有5,000人死于家中的意外事故。
ext.ext_en: 5,000 people die every year because of accidents in the home...

ext.ext_cn: 警方说这个年轻人被杀是一个意外。
ext.ext_en: The police say the killing of the young man was an accident.

defs.def_en: If someone has an accident, something unpleasant happens to them that was not intended, sometimes causing injury or death.

ext.ext_cn: 她碰巧发现了这个问题。
ext.ext_en: She discovered the problem by accident...

ext.ext_cn: 就像是天缘巧合，这个家族不可思议地人才辈出。
ext.ext_en: Almost like an accident of nature, this family has produced more talent than seems possible.

defs.def_en: If something happens by accident, it happens completely by chance.

defs.def_cn: 可能发生意外的事物（或人）

ext.ext_cn: 该城市中许多楼房都存在事故隐患。
ext.ext_en: A lot of the city's buildings are accidents waiting to happen.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as an accident waiting to happen, you mean that they are likely to be a cause of danger in the future, for example because they are in poor condition or behave in an unpredictable way.

ext.ext_cn: 警匪剧在电视上盛行之时恰好是西部片衰退之际，这并非偶然。
ext.ext_en: It's no accident that the boom in police series on TV coincided with the decline of the Western.

defs.def_en: You begin a sentence with 'it's no accident' if you want to suggest that something was done deliberately or has a logical explanation, although it might give the impression of having happened by chance.

ext.ext_cn: 一瓶香槟
ext.ext_en: ...a bottle of fizz.

defs.def_en: Champagne or sparkling wine is sometimes called fizz .

ext.ext_cn: 40欧姆的电阻
ext.ext_en: ...a resistance of 40 ohms.

defs.def_en: An ohm is a unit which is used to measure electrical resistance.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他在家里对父母十分恭敬顺从。
ext.ext_en: He was very respectful at home and obedient to his parents...

ext.ext_cn: 她上六年级的时候是个多么可爱温顺的小女孩啊！
ext.ext_en: What a sweet, obedient little girl she was in the sixth grade.

defs.def_en: A person or animal who is obedient does what they are told to do.
A vial is a very small bottle which is used to hold something such as perfume or medicine.

ext.ext_cn: 这些13世纪的回廊是意大利中部最美的建筑。
ext.ext_en: The thirteenth-century cloisters are amongst the most beautiful in central Italy.

defs.def_en: A cloister is a covered area round a square in a monastery or a cathedral.

ext.ext_cn: 军事政变
ext.ext_en: ...a military coup...

ext.ext_cn: 他们因参与了4月份的政变而被判处死刑。
ext.ext_en: They were sentenced to death for their part in April's coup attempt.

defs.def_en: When there is a coup, a group of people seize power in a country.

defs.def_cn: 了不起的成就;成功之举

ext.ext_cn: 这笔交易是该拍卖行的一大成功之举。
ext.ext_en: The sale is a big coup for the auction house...

ext.ext_cn: 雷根希歌剧院说服她扮演这一角色从而取得了巨大成功。
ext.ext_en: Regency Opera have scored something of a coup by persuading her to undertake the role.

defs.def_en: A coup is an achievement which is thought to be especially good because it was very difficult.

ext.ext_cn: 有传闻说他向慈善机构慷慨解囊，捐献巨款。
ext.ext_en: There are stories about his generosity, the massive amounts of money he gave to charities.

ext.ext_cn: 宽容大度的人
ext.ext_en: ...a man of great generosity of spirit.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's generosity, you mean that they are generous, especially in doing or giving more than is usual or expected.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他总是这样傻傻地咧嘴笑。
ext.ext_en: He always had this inane grin...

ext.ext_cn: 她开始问我愚蠢的问题。
ext.ext_en: She started asking me inane questions.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour or actions as inane, you think they are very silly or stupid.

defs.def_cn: (供居无定所的穷人住宿的)廉价旅店，简陋客栈
defs.def_en: A doss-house is a kind of cheap hotel in a city for people who have no home and very little money.
A trombonist is someone who plays the trombone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 万分恐慌的；惊慌失措的

ext.ext_cn: 惊慌失措的旅行者逃往边境。
ext.ext_en: Panic-stricken travellers fled for the borders...

ext.ext_cn: 一堵墙倒了，慌乱中有39人死于踩踏事故。
ext.ext_en: A wall collapsed and 39 people, were killed in the panic-stricken stampede.

defs.def_en: If someone is panic-stricken or is behaving in a panic-stricken way, they are so anxious or afraid that they may act without thinking carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 很多家庭都将老式的黑胶唱机束之高阁了。
ext.ext_en: Many households have dispensed with their old-fashioned vinyl turntable.

defs.def_en: If you dispense with something, you stop using it or get rid of it completely, especially because you no longer need it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 斯佩罗先生不愿意寻求帮助。
ext.ext_en: Mr Spero was reluctant to ask for help...

ext.ext_cn: 警方很不愿意卷入这类事情。
ext.ext_en: The police are very reluctant to get involved in this sort of thing.

defs.def_en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他脾气暴躁。
ext.ext_en: He had an irascible temper.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as irascible, you mean that they become angry very easily.

ext.ext_cn: 一颗脉动的恒星
ext.ext_en: ...a star that pulsates.

ext.ext_cn: 搏动着的血管
ext.ext_en: ...a pulsating blood vessel.

defs.def_en: If something pulsates, it beats, moves in and out, or shakes with strong, regular movements.
Wisteria is a type of climbing plant which has pale purple or white flowers.

A relative pronoun is a word such as 'who', 'that', or 'which' that is used to introduce a relative clause. 'Whose', 'when', 'where', and 'why' are generally called relative pronouns, though they are actually adverbs.

defs.def_cn: (通常指徒步)艰难旅行，跋涉，远足

ext.ext_cn: 徒步穿过丛林
ext.ext_en: ...trekking through the jungles...

ext.ext_cn: 今年我们准备去尼泊尔远足。
ext.ext_en: This year we're going trekking in Nepal.

defs.def_en: If you trek somewhere, you go on a journey across difficult country, usually on foot.

defs.def_cn: (通常因疲惫而缓慢勉强地)行进，拖着腿走

ext.ext_cn: 他们拖着步子从一家商店走到另一家，寻找齐膝的白袜子。
ext.ext_en: They trekked from shop to shop in search of white knee-length socks.

ext.ext_cn: 从苏豪区到世贸中心走起来是有点远，但还是值得的。
ext.ext_en: The World Trade Centre is a bit of a trek from Soho, but it's worth it.

defs.def_en: If you trek somewhere, you go there rather slowly and unwillingly, usually because you are tired.

ext.ext_cn: 他竟然敢搬出马丁·路德·金和马尔科姆·艾克斯的名字来为自己的行为辩解。
ext.ext_en: He has even had the temerity to invoke the names of Martin Luther King Jr and Malcolm X in defence of his actions.

ext.ext_cn: 胆敢不遵医嘱的“难缠”病人
ext.ext_en: ...'difficult' patients who have the temerity to challenge their doctors' decisions.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person has the temerity to do something, you are annoyed about something they have done which you think showed a lack of respect.

defs.def_cn: 隐名合伙人，隐名股东(在企业中投入资金却不积极参与经营的人)
defs.def_en: A silent partner is a person who provides some of the capital for a business but who does not take an active part in managing the business.
A voyeur is someone who gets sexual pleasure from secretly watching other people having sex or taking their clothes off.

ext.ext_cn: 媒体把我们所有人都变成了无情刺探他人隐私的人。
ext.ext_en: The media has made unfeeling voyeurs of all of us.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a voyeur, you disapprove of them because you think they enjoy watching other people's suffering or problems.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 使人蒙受耻辱的;让人出丑的;丢脸的

ext.ext_cn: 保守党人遭受到了一次颜面尽失的失败。
ext.ext_en: The Conservatives have suffered a humiliating defeat...

ext.ext_cn: 这件事如此丢脸，深深地挫伤了我的自尊心。
ext.ext_en: It was so humiliating, a terrible blow to my self-esteem.

defs.def_en: If something is humiliating, it embarrasses you and makes you feel ashamed and stupid.

ext.ext_cn: 警方已经花了数周对湖底清淤,但还是没有发现他的尸体。
ext.ext_en: Police have spent weeks dredging the lake but have not found his body.

defs.def_en: When people dredge a harbour, river, or other area of water, they remove mud and unwanted material from the bottom with a special machine in order to make it deeper or to look for something.

ext.ext_cn: 很多人说，要是能选择，他们宁愿选择休假来恢复活力。
ext.ext_en: Many say that, given a choice, they would opt for a holiday to put the pep back in their lives.

defs.def_en: Pep is liveliness and energy.

defs.def_cn: 情景喜剧(缩略形式为 sitcom)

ext.ext_cn: 以一家针灸诊所为背景的情景喜剧
ext.ext_en: ...a situation comedy that was set in an acupuncture clinic.

defs.def_en: A situation comedy is an amusing television drama series about a set of characters. The abbreviation sitcom is also used.

defs.def_cn: 新加坡的;新加坡人的;新加坡文化的

ext.ext_cn: 新加坡经济
ext.ext_en: ...the Singaporean economy.

defs.def_en: Singaporean means belonging or relating to Singapore, or to its people or culture.

ext.ext_cn: 所有新加坡人都必须通过他们自己民族的官方语言及英语的考试。
ext.ext_en: All Singaporeans have to pass exams in the official language of their ethnic group as well as English.

defs.def_en: A Singaporean is a citizen of Singapore or a person of Singaporean origin.

defs.def_cn: 侨居英国有亚洲血统的；亚裔英国的

ext.ext_cn: 亚裔英国人群体
ext.ext_en: ...the Anglo-Asian community.

defs.def_en: An Anglo-Asian person is someone of Indian, Pakistani, or Bangladeshi origin who has grown up in Britain.

ext.ext_cn: 灯彩装饰着庙宇。
ext.ext_en: The temples are festooned with lights.

ext.ext_cn: 贴满政治招贴画的电线杆
ext.ext_en: ...a lamppost festooned in political stickers.

defs.def_en: If something is festooned with, for example, lights, balloons, or flowers, large numbers of these things are hung from it or wrapped around it, especially in order to decorate it.

ext.ext_cn: 我起身走到他那边。
ext.ext_en: I got up and walked over to where he was.

defs.def_en: When someone who is sitting or lying down gets up, they rise to a standing position.

ext.ext_cn: 他们大清早就得起床。
ext.ext_en: They have to get up early in the morning.

defs.def_en: When you get up, you get out of bed.

ext.ext_cn: 那时候，他们懂得打扮。
ext.ext_en: They knew how to get themselves up in those days.

ext.ext_cn: 身穿一件天鹅绒吸烟服的老流浪汉
ext.ext_en: ...an old tramp got up in a velvet smoking-jacket.

defs.def_en: See also:get-up;If you get yourself up in a particular kind of clothing, you dress in that clothing.

ext.ext_cn: 它的大叶子往往带点紫色。
ext.ext_en: Its large leaves often show a delicate purple tint...

ext.ext_cn: 绿色分很多不同的色度与色调。
ext.ext_en: Green has many different shades and tints.

defs.def_en: A tint is a small amount of colour.

ext.ext_cn: 你已经染过头发了。
ext.ext_en: You've had a tint on your hair...

ext.ext_cn: 理发 2 英镑，染发 6 英镑。
ext.ext_en: Haircuts cost £2, tints £6.

defs.def_en: If you put a tint on your hair, you dye it a slightly different colour.

defs.def_cn: 将…轻微染色;使略有…颜色

ext.ext_cn: 眉毛可以染成同样的颜色。
ext.ext_en: Eyebrows can be tinted with the same dye...

ext.ext_cn: 玻璃瓶中盛满了被食用色素染过色的水。
ext.ext_en: Glass bottles are filled with water tinted with food colourings…

defs.def_en: If something is tinted, it has a small amount of a particular colour or dye in it.
Vinegar is a sharp-tasting liquid, usually made from sour wine or malt, which is used to make things such as salad dressing.

defs.def_cn: （指用安慰剂治疗后病人病情好转的）安慰剂效果

ext.ext_cn: 只有我们承认身心一体，安慰剂效果才能被理解。
ext.ext_en: The placebo effect can be understood only if we acknowledge the unity of mind and body.

defs.def_en: The placebo effect is the fact that some patients' health improves after taking what they believe is an effective drug but which is in fact only a placebo.
Your eardrums are the thin pieces of tightly stretched skin inside each ear, which vibrate when sound waves reach them.

defs.def_cn: (尤指最高法院的)首席法官，大法官

ext.ext_cn: 马歇尔大法官
ext.ext_en: ...Chief Justice Marshall.

defs.def_en: A Chief Justice is the most important judge of a court of law, especially a supreme court.

ext.ext_cn: 自助午餐
ext.ext_en: ...a buffet lunch...

ext.ext_cn: 餐厅里已经摆好了自助冷食。
ext.ext_en: A cold buffet had been laid out in the dining-room.

defs.def_en: A buffet is a meal of cold food that is displayed on a long table at a party or public occasion. Guests usually serve themselves from the table.

defs.def_cn: （通常指旅馆或车站的）餐饮部，小餐馆

ext.ext_cn: 我们坐在车站的自助餐厅里喝茶。
ext.ext_en: We sat in the station buffet sipping tea.

defs.def_en: A buffet is a café, usually in a hotel or station.
On a train, the buffet or the buffet car is the carriage or car where meals and snacks are sold.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的飞机遭受到风暴的重创。
ext.ext_en: Their plane had been severely buffeted by storms...

ext.ext_cn: 暴风雨席卷全国，使道路无法通行，渡船受袭，多达30人遇难。
ext.ext_en: Storms swept the country, closing roads, buffeting ferries and killing as many as 30 people.

defs.def_en: If something is buffeted by strong winds or by stormy seas, it is repeatedly struck or blown around by them.

ext.ext_cn: 整个非洲都经受了社会和政治动荡之苦。
ext.ext_en: The whole of Africa had been buffeted by social and political upheavals.

defs.def_en: If an economy or government is buffeted by difficult or unpleasant situations, it experiences many of them.

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯娜站在舞台前部的开阔区域。
ext.ext_en: Krishna stands downstage in the open area.

ext.ext_cn: 前台演职人员
ext.ext_en: ...downstage members of the cast.

defs.def_en: When an actor is downstage or moves downstage, he or she is or moves towards the front part of the stage.

ext.ext_cn: 基因决定每个生物的特征。
ext.ext_en: Genes determine the characteristics of every living thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的身体特征
ext.ext_en: ...their physical characteristics.

defs.def_en: The characteristics of a person or thing are the qualities or features that belong to them and make them recognizable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (品质、特点)明显的，显著的，典型的

ext.ext_cn: 这些社会中典型的代际冲突的缺失
ext.ext_en: ...the absence of strife between the generations that was so characteristic of such societies...

ext.ext_cn: 风车是马略卡岛风光的一大特色。
ext.ext_en: Windmills are a characteristic feature of the Mallorcan landscape...

defs.def_en: A quality or feature that is characteristic of someone or something is one which is often seen in them and seems typical of them.

ext.ext_cn: 一条硬皮面包
ext.ext_en: ...a loaf of crusty bread.

ext.ext_cn: 新鲜出炉的面包
ext.ext_en: ...freshly baked loaves.

defs.def_en: A loaf of bread is bread which has been shaped and baked in one piece. It is usually large enough for more than one person and can be cut into slices.

ext.ext_cn: 士兵们在街角逛荡。
ext.ext_en: Soldiers loafed at street corners.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一起在剑桥呆过。她学医，我则无所事事。
ext.ext_en: We had been at Cambridge together, she studying medicine and me loafing around.

defs.def_en: If you loaf, you stand or wait in a place, not doing anything interesting or useful.

defs.def_cn: (引起大量企业倒闭或大批工人失业的体制或组织的)重大变革，重组

ext.ext_cn: 本年度意大利银行业将进行大规模重组。
ext.ext_en: This should be the year of a big shake-out in Italian banking...

ext.ext_cn: 如果想要成为新政治的主力，该政党就需要进行重大变革。
ext.ext_en: The party needs a shake-out, if it is to be the driving-force of the new politics.

defs.def_en: A shake-out is a major set of changes in a system or an organization which results in a large number of companies closing or a large number of people losing their jobs.

defs.def_cn: 难以形容的;无法描述的

ext.ext_cn: 儿子活着的消息得到确认后她难以形容的喜悦
ext.ext_en: ...her indescribable joy when it was confirmed her son was alive...

ext.ext_cn: 下水道发出一股说不出的恶臭。
ext.ext_en: The stench from the sewer is indescribable.

defs.def_en: You use indescribable to emphasize that a quality or condition is very intense or extreme, and therefore cannot be properly described.
Danish pastries are cakes made from sweet pastry. They are often filled with things such as apple or almond paste.

ext.ext_cn: 在其全盛时期，该制片公司夸口说，他们旗下的明星比天上的星星还要多。
ext.ext_en: In its heyday, the studio's boast was that it had more stars than there are in heaven.

defs.def_en: Someone's heyday is the time when they are most powerful, successful, or popular.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无益的；无意义的；无目的的

ext.ext_cn: 暴力总是毫无意义的。
ext.ext_en: Violence is always pointless...

ext.ext_cn: 没有观众，表演就不成其为表演了。
ext.ext_en: Without an audience the performance is pointless.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is pointless, you are criticizing it because it has no sense or purpose.
A mugger is a person who attacks someone violently in a street in order to steal money from them.
A tricolour is a flag which is made up of blocks of three different colours.

ext.ext_cn: 种族问题是该作品里多次出现的主题。
ext.ext_en: Race is a recurrent theme in the work.

ext.ext_cn: 里面的员工经常生病的建筑
ext.ext_en: ...buildings in which staff suffer recurrent illness.

defs.def_en: A recurrent event or feeling happens or is experienced more than once.

ext.ext_cn: 他们打着实现远大理想的幌子为他们的每件恶行开脱。
ext.ext_en: They justify every villainy in the name of high ideals.

defs.def_en: Villainy is very bad or criminal behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 收获伊始地里大概有3亿吨粮食。
ext.ext_en: There were about 300 million tons of grain in the fields at the start of the harvest.

defs.def_en: The harvest is the gathering of a crop.

ext.ext_cn: 马铃薯大丰收
ext.ext_en: ...a bumper potato harvest...

ext.ext_cn: 几百万人因干旱和歉收而受到饥饿的威胁。
ext.ext_en: Millions of people are threatened with starvation as a result of drought and poor harvests.

defs.def_en: A harvest is the crop that is gathered in.

ext.ext_cn: 很多农民正拒绝收割甘蔗。
ext.ext_en: Many farmers are refusing to harvest the cane.

ext.ext_cn: 刚挖的甜菜根
ext.ext_en: ...freshly harvested beetroot.

defs.def_en: When you harvest a crop, you gather it in.

ext.ext_cn: 转行经营餐饮之后，他在事业上大获成功并获得了许多奖项。
ext.ext_en: In his new career as a restaurateur he has blossomed and harvested many awards.

defs.def_en: If you harvest a large number of things, you collect them, often by making great efforts.

ext.ext_cn: 必须说服以色列总理，若在10月份前就尽早走近选民，他会赢得更多选票。
ext.ext_en: The Israeli Prime Minister must be convinced that he will reap a richer harvest of votes by going to the electorate well before October.

defs.def_en: If you reap the harvest, you benefit or suffer from the results of your past actions or of someone else's past actions.

ext.ext_cn: 今天早些时候的炸弹爆炸案发生后，警探正与德比郡警方紧密合作。
ext.ext_en: Detectives are liaising with Derbyshire police following the bomb explosion early today...

ext.ext_cn: 这3个团体之间会互通信息，共同帮助那个孩子。
ext.ext_en: The three groups will all liaise with each other to help the child...

defs.def_en: When organizations or people liaise, or when one organization liaises with another, they work together and keep each other informed about what is happening.

defs.def_cn: (用于动词和名词前，构成新的动词和名词)表示“坏的”，“错误的”，“糟糕地”，“不当地”

ext.ext_cn: 当地报纸报道有误，称这些房屋已经出租了。
ext.ext_en: The local newspaper misreported the story by claiming the premises were rented...

ext.ext_cn: 最终他因滥用公款被判有罪。
ext.ext_en: He was eventually convicted for the misuse of official funds.

defs.def_en: Mis- is added to some verbs and nouns to form new verbs and nouns which indicate that something is done badly or wrongly.

ext.ext_cn: 煮豆荚时别加盐，因为这常会使豆壳变硬。
ext.ext_en: Do not add salt to beans when cooking as this tends to toughen the skins.

ext.ext_cn: 钢化玻璃
ext.ext_en: …toughened glass.

defs.def_en: If you toughen something or if it toughens, you make it stronger so that it will not break easily.

defs.def_cn: 加强，强化（政策、规章或惩罚）；使强硬

ext.ext_cn: 加强贸易限制的会谈正在进行中。
ext.ext_en: Talks are under way to toughen trade restrictions...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已对政府施加了相当大的压力，要求其采取强硬立场。
ext.ext_en: They have put considerable pressure on the Government to toughen its stance…

defs.def_en: If a person, institution, or law toughens its policies, regulations, or punishments, it makes them firmer or stricter.

ext.ext_cn: 他们认为参与打架会使男孩子变得坚强，教会他们怎样成为男人。
ext.ext_en: They believe that participating in fights toughens boys and shows them how to be men.

ext.ext_cn: 被日常境况磨砺得坚韧顽强的人们
ext.ext_en: …people who have been toughened by their daily circumstances.

defs.def_en: If an experience toughens you, it makes you stronger and more independent in character.

ext.ext_cn: 他们容忍了儿子的行为，如果换作别人他们可做不到。
ext.ext_en: They had put up with behaviour from their son which they would not have tolerated from anyone else.

defs.def_en: If you put up with something, you tolerate or accept it, even though you find it unpleasant or unsatisfactory.

ext.ext_cn: 月亮透过薄雾洒下微光。
ext.ext_en: The moon glimmered faintly through the mists.

ext.ext_cn: 波光粼粼的大海
ext.ext_en: ...the glimmering ocean.

defs.def_en: If something glimmers, it produces or reflects a faint, gentle, often unsteady light.

ext.ext_cn: 东方闪现出一丝微光。
ext.ext_en: In the east there is the slightest glimmer of light.

defs.def_en: A glimmer is a faint, gentle, often unsteady light.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然偶尔会闪现一丝希望，但是这场宣传活动目前并无任何效果。
ext.ext_en: Despite an occasional glimmer of hope, this campaign has not produced any results...

ext.ext_cn: 他正为看到一线成功的曙光而欢欣鼓舞。
ext.ext_en: He is celebrating his first glimmer of success.

defs.def_en: A glimmer of something is a faint sign of it.

ext.ext_cn: 两国之间宿怨已久。
ext.ext_en: There's a long history of animosity between the two nations...

ext.ext_cn: 杰弗里爵士对首相并无私人恩怨。
ext.ext_en: Sir Geoffrey had no personal animosity towards the Prime Minister.

defs.def_en: Animosity is a strong feeling of dislike and anger. Animosities are feelings of this kind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无理由的；不必要的；无缘无故的

ext.ext_cn: 电视里充斥着犯罪和无端的暴力。
ext.ext_en: There's too much crime and gratuitous violence on TV.

ext.ext_cn: 他坚持要提供一些无谓的建议
ext.ext_en: ...his insistence on offering gratuitous advice.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as gratuitous, you mean that it is unnecessary, and often harmful or upsetting.

defs.def_cn: 重新录制(电影);重新灌录(唱片)

ext.ext_cn: 重新录制的特别版《卡萨布兰卡》发行了。
ext.ext_en: A special remastered version of Casablanca is being released.

defs.def_en: If a film or musical recording is remastered, a new recording is made of the old version, using modern technology to improve the quality.

ext.ext_cn: 一艘英国渔船的船长
ext.ext_en: ...the skipper of an English fishing boat...

ext.ext_cn: 开火，船长！
ext.ext_en: Gunfire, skipper!

defs.def_en: You can use skipper to refer to the captain of a ship or boat.

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队的队长信心十足。
ext.ext_en: The England skipper is confident.

defs.def_en: You can use skipper to refer to the captain of a sports team.

ext.ext_cn: 他担任了橄榄球 15 人联队的第二任队长。
ext.ext_en: He skippered the second Rugby XV...

ext.ext_cn: 这艘游艇的船长是皮埃尔·马斯。
ext.ext_en: The yacht was skippered by Pierre Mas.

defs.def_en: To skipper a team or a boat means to be the captain of it.

ext.ext_cn: 体力劳动者身体消耗巨大，早餐要丰盛一些。
ext.ext_en: Manual workers need a good breakfast for high-energy output...

ext.ext_cn: 政府统计数据显示这是10年来工业产量最大幅度的滑坡。
ext.ext_en: Government statistics show the largest drop in industrial output for ten years.

defs.def_en: Output is used to refer to the amount of something that a person or thing produces.

defs.def_cn: （计算机、文字处理器等的）输出信息，输出文件

ext.ext_cn: 运行该软件，查看输出结果并进行修正。
ext.ext_en: You run the software, you look at the output, you make modifications.

defs.def_en: The output of a computer or word processor is the information that it displays on a screen or prints on paper as a result of a particular program.

ext.ext_cn: 保险公司赔付了遭窃的珠宝和银器。
ext.ext_en: The insurance company paid out for the stolen jewellery and silver...

ext.ext_cn: 我们建议您为所有假期都购买旅行保险。
ext.ext_en: We recommend that you take out travel insurance on all holidays.

defs.def_en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

ext.ext_cn: 国家需要有一定的防御能力，以应对不可预知的情况。
ext.ext_en: The country needs a defence capability as insurance against the unexpected.

defs.def_en: If you do something as insurance against something unpleasant happening, you do it to protect yourself in case the unpleasant thing happens.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对蛇的原始恐惧
ext.ext_en: ...an atavistic fear of snakes.

defs.def_en: Atavistic feelings or behaviour seem to be very primitive, like the feelings or behaviour of our earliest ancestors.

defs.def_cn: 腹语术表演者;口技表演者

ext.ext_cn: 他看上去像腹语术表演者用的人偶。
ext.ext_en: He looked like a ventriloquist's dummy.

defs.def_en: A ventriloquist is someone who can speak without moving their lips and who entertains people by making their words appear to be spoken by a puppet

defs.def_cn: 不可否认的；无可争议的；确凿无疑的

ext.ext_cn: 她的魅力毋庸置疑。
ext.ext_en: Her charm is undeniable.

ext.ext_cn: 无可否认的事实：她酒后驾车，血液中的酒精含量几乎是法定限量的两倍
ext.ext_en: ...the undeniable fact that she was driving with almost twice the legal limit of alcohol in her blood.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is undeniable, you mean that it is definitely true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 油价会在 1992 年剩下的时间里保持稳定。
ext.ext_en: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.

ext.ext_cn: 稳定的婚姻
ext.ext_en: ...a stable marriage.

defs.def_en: If something is stable, it is not likely to change or come to an end suddenly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们的性格已经完全形成，两人都是非常持重的孩子。
ext.ext_en: Their characters are fully formed and they are both very stable children.

defs.def_en: If someone has a stable personality, they are calm and reasonable and their mood does not change suddenly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 伤者情况稳定。
ext.ext_en: The injured man was in a stable condition.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone who is seriously ill as stable when their condition has stopped getting worse.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不太稳定的化合物被转换成了一种叫做Delta-A THC的化合物。
ext.ext_en: The less stable compounds were converted into a compound called Delta-A THC.

defs.def_en: Chemical substances are described as stable when they tend to remain in the same chemical or atomic state.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这一结构必须得很稳固。
ext.ext_en: This structure must be stable.

defs.def_en: If an object is stable, it is firmly fixed in position and is not likely to move or fall.
A stable or stables is a building in which horses are kept.

ext.ext_cn: 柯林小姐在来自米克·特里齐养马场的两匹马身上下了注，结果她赢了。
ext.ext_en: Miss Curling won on two horses from Mick Trickey's stable.

defs.def_en: A stable or stables is an organization that breeds and trains horses for racing.

ext.ext_cn: 牲畜已经喂好并关进厩里了。
ext.ext_en: The animals had been fed and stabled...

ext.ext_cn: 你应该每天把关在马厩里的马放出来自由活动几个小时。
ext.ext_en: You should allow your stabled horse a couple of hours' freedom per day.

defs.def_en: When horses are stabled, they are put into a stable.

defs.def_cn: 接受同一经纪人服务的一群人

ext.ext_cn: 作为首席执行官，他手下云集了一批优雅的名人名士。
ext.ext_en: As chief executive, he assembled a polished stable of celebrities.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone has a stable of people when they manage and promote the careers of that group of people.

If you say that someone has closed or shut the stable door after the horse has bolted, you mean that they have tried to prevent something happening but they have done so too late to prevent damage being done.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 适得其反的;弄巧成拙的;事与愿违的

ext.ext_cn: 弄虚作假最终会自食其果。
ext.ext_en: Dishonesty is ultimately self-defeating.

ext.ext_cn: 适得其反的想法和行为模式
ext.ext_en: ...self-defeating patterns of thought and behavior.

defs.def_en: A plan or action that is self-defeating is likely to cause problems or difficulties instead of producing useful results.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 更好的；更可取的；更合适的

ext.ext_cn: 远处发生大地震总比在附近发生小地震好。
ext.ext_en: A big earthquake a long way off is preferable to a smaller one nearby...

ext.ext_cn: 经营剧院的风险似乎比加入家族涂料产业的风险要小一些。
ext.ext_en: The hazards of the theatre seemed preferable to joining the family paint business...

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing is preferable to another, you mean that it is more desirable or suitable.

defs.def_cn: （尤指反对使用新的机器和方法的）反对技术进步者

ext.ext_cn: 大部分人天生有种反对技术进步的心理。他们抗拒变革。
ext.ext_en: The majority have a built-in Luddite mentality; they are resistant to change.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a Luddite, you are criticizing them for opposing changes in industrial methods, especially the introduction of new machines and modern methods.

ext.ext_cn: 游击队突袭了银行，摧毁了一处警察驻地和一个变电站。
ext.ext_en: The guerrillas raided banks and destroyed a police barracks and an electricity substation.

ext.ext_cn: 叛军试图突袭一处军营。
ext.ext_en: The rebels attempted a surprise raid on a military camp...

defs.def_en: See also:air raid;When soldiers raid a place, they make a sudden armed attack against it, with the aim of causing damage rather than occupying any of the enemy's land.

ext.ext_cn: 反欺诈小组的工作人员突击搜查了这家公司的办公室。
ext.ext_en: Fraud squad officers raided the firm's offices.

ext.ext_cn: 今天早上30名武装警察突击搜查一所房子后将他们逮捕。
ext.ext_en: They were arrested early this morning after a raid on a house by thirty armed police.

defs.def_en: If the police raid a building, they enter it suddenly and by force in order to look for dangerous criminals or for evidence of something illegal, such as drugs or weapons.

ext.ext_cn: 一个19岁的男子被判抢劫银行罪。
ext.ext_en: A 19-year-old man has been found guilty of raiding a bank.

ext.ext_cn: 对一家小邮局实施的武装抢劫
ext.ext_en: ...an armed raid on a small Post Office...

defs.def_en: If someone raids a building or place, they enter it by force in order to steal something.

defs.def_cn: 扫荡（冰箱、食品柜等处）的食物

ext.ext_cn: 她走向厨房去扫荡冰箱。
ext.ext_en: She made her way to the kitchen to raid the fridge.

defs.def_en: If you raid the fridge or the larder, you take food from it to eat instead of a meal or in between meals.
The bill of fare at a restaurant is a list of the food for a meal from which you may choose what you want to eat.

defs.def_cn: 极有魅力的女人;大美人

ext.ext_cn: 其中有一个女孩非常迷人。
ext.ext_en: One of the girls was an absolute stunner.

defs.def_en: A stunner is an extremely attractive woman.

defs.def_cn: 令人震惊的事情;令人印象深刻的事物

ext.ext_cn: 他们的首张单曲成绩斐然。
ext.ext_en: Their debut single is a stunner.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a stunner, you mean that it is very surprising or impressive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 满怀敬意的;恭敬的;虔诚的

ext.ext_cn: “那是老护林人的花园，”她用充满敬意的语气说。
ext.ext_en: 'That's the old foresters' garden,' she said in reverential tones.

defs.def_en: Something that is reverential has the qualities of respect and admiration.

ext.ext_cn: 每条大街上都冒出很多素食餐馆和保健食品店。
ext.ext_en: Vegetarian restaurants and health food shops are springing up in every high street.

ext.ext_cn: 西布罗米奇的主要街道
ext.ext_en: ...West Bromwich high street.

defs.def_en: The high street of a town is the main street where most of the shops and banks are.

defs.def_cn: （大型银行、大型商业企业）开在商业区大街的，设在城市主要商业区的

ext.ext_cn: 扫描仪在大型商店有售。
ext.ext_en: The scanners are available from high street stores.

defs.def_en: High street banks and businesses are companies which have branches in the main shopping areas of most towns.

ext.ext_cn: 英国和美国之间的双边会谈
ext.ext_en: ...bilateral talks between Britain and America.

defs.def_en: Bilateral negotiations, meetings, or agreements, involve only the two groups or countries that are directly concerned.

ext.ext_cn: 他们计划从长山滑翔而下。
ext.ext_en: They planned to paraglide from Long Mountain.

defs.def_en: If a person paraglides, they jump from an aircraft or off a hill or tall building while wearing a special parachute which allows them to control the way they float to the ground.
Buckwheat is a type of small black grain used for feeding animals and making flour. Buckwheat also refers to the flour itself.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的调查显示这些过敏多为一次性反应。
ext.ext_en: Our survey revealed that these allergies were mainly one-offs.

defs.def_en: You can refer to something as a one-off when it is made or happens only once.

ext.ext_cn: 一次性的现金补助
ext.ext_en: ...one-off cash benefits.

defs.def_en: A one-off thing is made or happens only once.

defs.def_cn: （在最后时刻）因胆怯而放弃，打退堂鼓

ext.ext_cn: 我一路走来不是为了在最后关头打退堂鼓。
ext.ext_en: I haven't come all this way to bottle out.

defs.def_en: If you bottle out, you lose your courage at the last moment and do not do something you intended to do.
A dumper truck is the same as a dump truck .

defs.def_cn: 可自由参加的活动;众人同时争抢的情形
defs.def_en: A free-for-all is a situation in which several people or groups are trying to get something for themselves and there are no controls on how they do it.

defs.def_cn: 混战;群架;众人都参与的争吵
defs.def_en: A free-for-all is a disorganized fight or argument which lots of people join in.
A jerkin is a sleeveless jacket worn by men or women.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这种病症在女性当中比在男性当中更为普遍。
ext.ext_en: This condition is more prevalent in women than in men...

ext.ext_cn: 抽烟在年轻女性中变得越来越常见。
ext.ext_en: Smoking is becoming increasingly prevalent among younger women...

defs.def_en: A condition, practice, or belief that is prevalent is common.

ext.ext_cn: 他提倡以无政府主义来解决社会问题。
ext.ext_en: He advocated anarchism as the answer to social problems.

defs.def_en: Anarchism is the belief that the laws and power of governments should be replaced by people working together freely.

defs.def_cn: （网球或棒球比赛中负责拾球的）球童，捡球员
defs.def_en: In a tennis match, the ball boys pick up any balls that go into the net or off the court and throw them back to the players. In a baseball game, the ball boys are in charge of collecting the balls that are hit out of the field.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 技法娴熟的;灵巧的;巧妙的

ext.ext_cn: 业余人士拍摄的视频片段和制作精良的好莱坞影片之间存在着巨大的差距。
ext.ext_en: There's a big difference between an amateur video and a slick Hollywood production...

ext.ext_cn: 他的演技娴熟，赏心悦目。
ext.ext_en: His style is slick and visually exciting.

defs.def_en: A slick performance, production, or advertisement is skilful and impressive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 利索的;流畅的;不费力的

ext.ext_cn: 哥伦比亚队凭借流畅的传球和终场前的制胜进球击败了他们。
ext.ext_en: They were outplayed by the Colombians' slick passing and decisive finishing.

ext.ext_cn: 轻松流畅的换挡
ext.ext_en: ...a slick gear change.

defs.def_en: A slick action is done quickly and smoothly, and without any obvious effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 别被那些巧舌如簧的政客蒙骗了。
ext.ext_en: Don't be fooled by slick politicians.

ext.ext_cn: 油嘴滑舌、西装笔挺的侦探
ext.ext_en: ...a slick, suit-wearing detective.

defs.def_en: A slick person speaks easily in a way that is likely to convince people, but is not sincere.

ext.ext_cn: 专家们正想方设法清除这片面积巨大的浮油。
ext.ext_en: Experts are trying to devise ways to clean up the huge slick.

defs.def_en: A slick is the same as an oil slick .

ext.ext_cn: 她把头发往后梳得光溜溜的。
ext.ext_en: She had slicked her hair back...

ext.ext_cn: 他捋平了自己仅剩的几绺白发。
ext.ext_en: He slicked down his few remaining wisps of gray hair...

defs.def_en: If someone slicks their hair back, they make it flat, smooth, and shiny by putting oil or water on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 改革主义的；改良主义的

ext.ext_cn: 改良主义政策的坚定支持者
ext.ext_en: ...a strong supporter of reformist policies.

defs.def_en: Reformist groups or policies are trying to reform a system or law.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 芳香精油和香水
ext.ext_en: ...fragrant oils and perfumes...

ext.ext_cn: 空气里弥漫着橘子花的香气。
ext.ext_en: The air was fragrant with the smell of orange blossoms.

defs.def_en: Something that is fragrant has a pleasant, sweet smell.

ext.ext_cn: 他在一场决斗中杀了一名男子。
ext.ext_en: He had killed a man in a duel.

defs.def_en: A duel is a formal fight between two people in which they use guns or swords in order to settle a quarrel.

ext.ext_cn: 在过去的 6 周中,该地区曾经发生过零星的炮击。
ext.ext_en: The area has been the scene of sporadic artillery duels over the last six weeks.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a conflict between two people or groups as a duel .

ext.ext_cn: 我们争斗了两年，彼得森充分利用这点挑拨我俩对阵。
ext.ext_en: We duelled for two years and Peterson made the most of it, playing us off against each other.

ext.ext_cn: 两把银制法国决斗手枪
ext.ext_en: ...two silver French duelling pistols.

defs.def_en: To duel means to fight a duel or be involved in a conflict.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 敢闻敢干、决心要出人头地的毕业生
ext.ext_en: ...the venturesome graduate who is determined to succeed.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as venturesome, you mean that they are willing to take risks and try out new things.
Herbaceous plants have green stems, not hard, woody stems.
Runner beans are long green beans that are eaten as a vegetable. They grow on a tall climbing plant and are the cases that contain the seeds of the plant.

defs.def_cn: 啊哈（书面语中用于表示满意、惊讶等）

ext.ext_cn: 啊哈，我的问题到这儿终于有了答案。
ext.ext_en: Aha! Here at last, the answer to my question.

defs.def_en: Aha is used in writing to represent a noise that people make in conversation, for example to express satisfaction or surprise.

ext.ext_cn: 是金钱驱使这些渔民驾着破旧小船冒险出海远航。
ext.ext_en: It's the money that spurs these fishermen to risk a long ocean journey in their flimsy boats...

ext.ext_cn: 朋友的困境促使他投身参与。
ext.ext_en: His friend's  plight had spurred him into taking part.

defs.def_en: If one thing spurs you to do another, it encourages you to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 政府可能会更加重视推动经济增长。
ext.ext_en: The administration may put more emphasis on spurring economic growth...

ext.ext_cn: 这些贸易协定将会促使大批美国企业涌向墨西哥。
ext.ext_en: The trade pacts will spur an exodus of US businesses to Mexico.

defs.def_en: If something spurs a change or event, it makes it happen faster or sooner.

ext.ext_cn: 认为竞争会促进效率的信念
ext.ext_en: ...a belief in competition as a spur to efficiency...

ext.ext_cn: 裁员促使很多人开始从事新事业。
ext.ext_en: Redundancy is the spur for many to embark on new careers.

defs.def_en: Something that acts as a spur to something else encourages a person or organization to do that thing or makes it happen more quickly.
Spurs are small metal wheels with sharp points that are attached to the heels of a rider's boots. The rider uses them to make their horse go faster.
The spur of a hill or mountain is a piece of ground which sticks out from its side.

ext.ext_cn: 他们承认是一时冲动偷走了一辆车。
ext.ext_en: They admitted they had taken a vehicle on the spur of the moment...

ext.ext_cn: 这可不是头脑一热作出的决定。我们事先仔细地讨论过。
ext.ext_en: It wasn't a spur-of-the-moment decision. We discussed it in detail beforehand.

defs.def_en: If you do something on the spur of the moment, you do it suddenly, without planning it beforehand.

ext.ext_cn: 年轻的指挥家们在小乐队或小歌剧院里崭露头角。
ext.ext_en: Young conductors earn their spurs in a small orchestra or opera house.

defs.def_en: If you win your spurs or earn your spurs, you achieve a particular status by proving that you can do something skilfully.

ext.ext_cn: 我当时以为他要亲我，所以吓得直往后退。
ext.ext_en: For a moment I thought he was going to kiss me. I recoiled in horror...

ext.ext_cn: 我们会被好闻的味道吸引，难闻的味道则会让我们退避三舍。
ext.ext_en: We are attracted by nice smells and recoil from nasty ones.

defs.def_en: If something makes you recoil, you move your body quickly away from it because it frightens, offends, or hurts you.

defs.def_cn: （因为不喜欢而）拒绝，回绝，退避

ext.ext_cn: 过去人们不能接受欠债这种事情。
ext.ext_en: People used to recoil from the idea of getting into debt...

ext.ext_cn: 那么多年轻的女孩不得不靠出卖肉体谋生，她觉得难以接受。
ext.ext_en: She recoiled at the number of young girls who had to live by selling their bodies.

defs.def_en: If you recoil from doing something or recoil at the idea of something, you refuse to do it or accept it because you dislike it so much.

ext.ext_cn: 警察再次开火，紧抵着反冲机构，不断向袭击他的人射击。
ext.ext_en: The policeman fires again, tensed against the recoil, unleashing round after round at his assailant...

ext.ext_cn: 我把家伙组装起来，检查了一下击发和反冲机构，装上子弹。
ext.ext_en: I assembled the weapon, checked the firing and recoil mechanism and loaded it.

defs.def_en: The recoil of a gun is the quick backward movement that it makes when it is fired.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是一位敬业、优秀而且非常称职的公务员。
ext.ext_en: He was a loyal, distinguished and very competent civil servant.

ext.ext_cn: 令人满意的表现
ext.ext_en: ...a competent performance.

defs.def_en: Someone who is competent is efficient and effective.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 大部分成年人不懂得如何对儿童实施急救。
ext.ext_en: Most adults do not feel competent to deal with a medical emergency involving a child.

defs.def_en: If you are competent to do something, you have the skills, abilities, or experience necessary to do it well.

ext.ext_cn: 他舀了一匙炖菜吃了。
ext.ext_en: He took a spoonful of the stew and ate it.

ext.ext_cn: 3匙糖
ext.ext_en: ...three spoonfuls of sugar.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an amount of food resting on a spoon as a spoonful of food.
A transitive verb has a direct object.

ext.ext_cn: 清晨的阳光透过玻璃屋顶，斜照了进来。
ext.ext_en: The morning sun slanted through the glass roof...

ext.ext_cn: 破旧的松木地板歪歪斜斜地铺到一个乔治王时代风格的窗户跟前。
ext.ext_en: Battered pine floors slanted down to a Georgian window.

defs.def_en: Something that slants is sloping, rather than horizontal or vertical.

ext.ext_cn: 由于房子是倾斜的，所以你的位置稍微高于花园。
ext.ext_en: You're slightly above the garden because the house is on a slant.

ext.ext_cn: 斜裁的长口袋
ext.ext_en: ...long pockets cut on the slant.

defs.def_en: If something is on a slant, it is in a slanting position.

defs.def_cn: 使有倾向性;使有偏向性

ext.ext_cn: 这个节目故意偏向主场队，以使他们看上去表现还不错。
ext.ext_en: The programme was deliberately slanted to make the home team look good.

defs.def_en: If information or a system is slanted, it is made to show favour towards a particular group or opinion.

defs.def_cn: (尤指有失偏颇的)观点，看法;偏向;偏袒

ext.ext_cn: 《焦点》杂志的政治立场可以称为中间偏右。
ext.ext_en: The political slant at Focus can be described as centre-right...

ext.ext_cn: 他们播放的每一则新闻都有所偏向。
ext.ext_en: They give a slant to every single news item that's put on the air.

defs.def_en: A particular slant on a subject is a particular way of thinking about it, especially one that is unfair.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无动于衷的；冷漠的；无同情心的

ext.ext_cn: 伯德先生对贪污指控一直无动于衷。
ext.ext_en: Mr Bird remained unmoved by the corruption allegations...

ext.ext_cn: 他脸上没有丝毫表情，但嘴角流露出一丝不悦。
ext.ext_en: His face was unmoved, but on his lips there was a trace of displeasure.

defs.def_en: If you are unmoved by something, you are not emotionally affected by it.

defs.def_cn: 给…施洗礼;(施洗时)为…命名

ext.ext_cn: 她3月出生，6月受洗。
ext.ext_en: She was born in March and christened in June...

ext.ext_cn: 她受洗时取名苏珊。
ext.ext_en: She was christened Susan.

defs.def_en: When a baby is christened, he or she is given a name during the Christian ceremony of baptism.

ext.ext_cn: 那两人在一次聚会上都穿了黑裙子，从此就被叫做“黑衣姐妹花”。
ext.ext_en: The pair were christened 'The Women in Black' after they both wore black dresses at a party.

ext.ext_cn: 我们有一个非常小的房间，取名哈得斯。
ext.ext_en: We had a tiny little room which was christened Hades.

defs.def_en: You say that you christen a person, place, or object a particular name if you choose a name for them and start calling them by that name.

ext.ext_cn: 几个著名交响乐团受邀演出，以庆祝新音乐厅的启用。
ext.ext_en: To christen the new hall, a number of great orchestras have been invited to play.

defs.def_en: You say that you christen something new when you use it for the first time, especially if you do something special to mark the occasion.
A liquid crystal is a liquid that has some of the qualities of crystals, for example reflecting light from different directions in different ways.

ext.ext_cn: 硝酸盐在食品加工业中被用作防腐剂。
ext.ext_en: Nitrates are used as preservatives in food manufacture...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然这些镶板运来时经过了预处理，但是还需要涂上两层防腐剂进行最后的密封。
ext.ext_en: Though the panels come pre-treated, they needed a final sealing with two coats of preservative.

defs.def_en: A preservative is a chemical that prevents things from decaying. Some preservatives are added to food, and others are used to treat wood or metal.

ext.ext_cn: “我不是为希特勒辩护，”皮亚说。
ext.ext_en: 'I am no apologist for Hitler,' observed Pyat.

ext.ext_cn: 伟大的基督教辩护士奥利金
ext.ext_en: ...the great Christian apologist Origen.

defs.def_en: An apologist is a person who writes or speaks in defence of a belief, a cause, or a person's life.

ext.ext_cn: 什么时候改善饮食都为时不晚。
ext.ext_en: It's never too late to improve your diet.

ext.ext_cn: 富含水果和蔬菜的健康饮食
ext.ext_en: ...a healthy diet rich in fruit and vegetables...

defs.def_en: Your diet is the type and range of food that you regularly eat.

defs.def_cn: (医生指定的)特别饮食，规定饮食

ext.ext_cn: 他按照医嘱要食用乳制品。
ext.ext_en: He was put on a diet of milky food.

ext.ext_cn: 专为胆固醇高的孩子准备的特别饮食
ext.ext_en: ...a special diet for children with high cholesterol.

defs.def_en: If a doctor puts someone on a diet, he or she makes them eat a special type or range of foods in order to improve their health.

defs.def_cn: （为减轻体重的）限制饮食，节食

ext.ext_cn: 你最近在节食吗？你瘦了好多。
ext.ext_en: Have you been on a diet? You've lost a lot of weight...

ext.ext_cn: 节食和锻炼会改变你的体形。
ext.ext_en: Diet and exercise will alter your shape...

defs.def_en: If you are on a diet, you eat special kinds of food or you eat less food than usual because you are trying to lose weight.

defs.def_cn: (为减轻体重而)限制饮食，节食

ext.ext_cn: 我生完第四个孩子后就一直在节食。
ext.ext_en: I've been dieting ever since the birth of my fourth child...

ext.ext_cn: 我们大多数人都曾在人生的某个时期为减肥而节食过。
ext.ext_en: Most of us have dieted at some time in our lives.

defs.def_en: If you are dieting, you eat special kinds of food or you eat less food than usual because you are trying to lose weight.

defs.def_cn: (饮料或食物)有助于减肥的，低热量的，低卡路里的

ext.ext_cn: 无糖低热量饮料
ext.ext_en: ...sugar-free diet drinks.

ext.ext_cn: 低卡路里的人造黄油
ext.ext_en: ...diet margarine.

defs.def_en: Diet drinks or foods have been specially produced so that they do not contain many calories.

defs.def_cn: (尤指令人不快或劣质的东西的)大量

ext.ext_cn: 他从广播里听到的都是千篇一律的流行歌曲。
ext.ext_en: The radio had fed him a diet of pop songs...

ext.ext_cn: 人们开始拒绝这种没完没了的绝望情绪。
ext.ext_en: People are rejecting this constant diet of despair.

defs.def_en: If you are fed on a diet of something, especially something unpleasant or of poor quality, you receive or experience a very large amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 大批犹太与非犹太裔德国难民
ext.ext_en: ...a flood of Jewish and Gentile German refugees.

ext.ext_cn: 大批犹太与非犹太裔德国难民
ext.ext_en: ...a flood of Jewish and Gentile German refugees.

defs.def_en: also gentile. A Gentile is a person who is not Jewish.

ext.ext_cn: 冷冻干燥的速食土豆泥
ext.ext_en: ...freeze-dried instant mashed potato.

ext.ext_cn: 冻干咖啡粒
ext.ext_en: ...freeze-dried coffee granules.

defs.def_en: Freeze-dried food has been preserved by a process of rapid freezing and drying.
Snakeskin is the skin of snakes used to make shoes and clothes.

defs.def_cn: 中间值的;中位数的;中间的
defs.def_en: The median value of a set of values is the middle one when they are arranged in order. For example, if a group of five students take a test and their marks are 5, 7, 7, 8, and 10, the median mark is 7.
A median is the same as a median strip .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不稳定的；不可靠的；动荡的

ext.ext_cn: 1801年皮特倒台后，政府经历了10年的动荡。
ext.ext_en: After the fall of Pitt in 1801 there was a decade of unstable government...

ext.ext_cn: 情况不稳定，可能有危险。
ext.ext_en: The situation is unstable and potentially dangerous.

defs.def_en: You can describe something as unstable if it is likely to change suddenly, especially if this creates difficulty or danger.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 黏土和砂岩都是不牢固的岩石构造。
ext.ext_en: Both clay and sandstone are unstable rock formations.

defs.def_en: Unstable objects are likely to move or fall.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他情绪不稳定。
ext.ext_en: He was emotionally unstable...

ext.ext_cn: 科尔里奇还是个情绪非常不稳定的人。
ext.ext_en: Coleridge was also a highly unstable person.

defs.def_en: If people are unstable, their emotions and behaviour keep changing because their minds are disturbed or upset.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我明白我以前错怪你了。
ext.ext_en: I see I was mistaken about you...

ext.ext_cn: 亚历克斯，你真是大错特错，你对局势的判断根本不对。
ext.ext_en: You couldn't be more mistaken, Alex. You've utterly misread the situation.

defs.def_en: If you are mistaken about something, you are wrong about it.

ext.ext_cn: 我对当时发生的事情曾有一种错误的认识。
ext.ext_en: I had a mistaken view of what was happening.

ext.ext_cn: 对上瘾的有限认识和关于如何将其戒除的错误观念
ext.ext_en: ...a limited understanding of addiction and mistaken beliefs about how it can be overcome.

defs.def_en: A mistaken belief or opinion is incorrect.

ext.ext_cn: 客户服务口碑很好的邮购公司
ext.ext_en: ...a mail-order business with a strong reputation for customer service...

ext.ext_cn: 该公司有一个非常出色的客户服务部。
ext.ext_en: The firm has an excellent customer service department.

defs.def_en: Customer service refers to the way that companies behave towards their customers, for example how well they treat them.

ext.ext_cn: 具有情绪感召力是所有政治的一个方面。
ext.ext_en: The existence of an emotional undertow is an aspect of all politics.

ext.ext_cn: 隐隐的悲伤
ext.ext_en: ...an undertow of sadness.

defs.def_en: If there is an undertow of a feeling, that feeling exists in such a weak form that you are hardly aware of it, but it influences the way you think or behave.

ext.ext_cn: 由于存在着危险的下层逆流，在大部分海岸线附近游泳都不安全。
ext.ext_en: Dangerous undertows make swimming unsafe along most of the coastline.

defs.def_en: An undertow is a strong current of water that is moving below the surface current and in a different direction to it.

ext.ext_cn: 一杯葡萄汽酒
ext.ext_en: ...a glass of sparkling wine.

ext.ext_cn: 一杯刚刚斟上的微微冒着泡的饮料
ext.ext_en: ...a new lightly sparkling drink.

defs.def_en: Sparkling drinks are slightly fizzy.

ext.ext_cn: 零售巨头玛莎百货再次凭借一系列耀眼的成绩轻松胜出。
ext.ext_en: Top retailer Marks & Spencer has romped in with another set of sparkling results.

defs.def_en: If a company is described as having sparkling figures or sparkling results, it has performed very well and made a lot of money.

ext.ext_cn: 梅格觉得老太太那双圆溜溜的小眼睛正盯着她。
ext.ext_en: Meg felt the old woman's beady eyes on her.

defs.def_en: Beady eyes are small, round, and bright.

ext.ext_cn: 主席小心地看管着这些东西。
ext.ext_en: The chairman keeps a beady eye on things.

defs.def_en: If someone keeps a beady eye on a person or organization, they watch them carefully and suspiciously.
Agnosticism is the belief that it is not possible to say definitely whether or not there is a God.
Chamois are small animals rather like goats that live in the mountains of Europe and South West Asia.
A chamois or a chamois leather is a soft leather cloth used for cleaning and polishing.

ext.ext_cn: 我左手击球，右手投球。
ext.ext_en: I batted left-handed and bowled right-handed.

ext.ext_cn: 我左手击球，右手投球。
ext.ext_en: I batted left-handed and bowled right-handed.

defs.def_en: Someone who is right-handed uses their right hand rather than their left hand for activities such as writing and sports, and for picking things up.

defs.def_cn: 命中注定的；上天安排的

ext.ext_cn: 认为我们的行为只是揭开了冥冥中注定的命运的观点
ext.ext_en: ...the belief that our actions are the unfolding of a preordained destiny.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is preordained, you mean you believe it to be happening in the way that has been decided by a power such as God or fate.

ext.ext_cn: 不管当官儿的职权有多大，都不要被他们吓倒。
ext.ext_en: Don't be overawed by people in authority, however important they are...

ext.ext_cn: 各种大场合都没让他犯过憷。
ext.ext_en: He's never been overawed or intimidated by big occasions.

defs.def_en: If you are overawed by something or someone, you are very impressed by them and a little afraid of them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个星期国会里一直乱哄哄的，让人心烦。
ext.ext_en: It's all been very noisy and bothersome in Parliament this week.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is bothersome is annoying or irritating.

ext.ext_cn: 自封的专家
ext.ext_en: ...a self-proclaimed expert...

ext.ext_cn: 他是其自己宣布成立的共和国的总统。
ext.ext_en: He is President of his own self-proclaimed republic.

defs.def_en: Self-proclaimed is used to show that someone has given themselves a particular title or status rather than being given it by other people.

defs.def_cn: 不吝承认的;无耻自称的

ext.ext_cn: 其中一名囚犯恬不知耻地自称是种族主义者，他曾在四年前向一群人开枪射击。
ext.ext_en: One of the prisoners is a self-proclaimed racist who opened fire on a crowd four years ago.

ext.ext_cn: 不吝承认的崇英者
ext.ext_en: ...a self-proclaimed Anglophile.

defs.def_en: Self-proclaimed is used to show that someone says themselves that they are a type of person which most people would be embarrassed or ashamed to be.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 旨在确保将食物和药品送至贫困的索马里民众手中的多国部队
ext.ext_en: ...a multinational force aimed at ensuring that food and medicine get to needy Somalis.

ext.ext_cn: 将努力为贫困者筹措更多的食品。
ext.ext_en: There will be efforts to get larger amounts of food to the needy.

defs.def_en: Needy people do not have enough food, medicine, or clothing, or adequate houses.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (因寒冷、恐惧、生病)颤抖的，战栗的，哆嗦的

ext.ext_cn: 她感到身体发抖,而且有点恶心。
ext.ext_en: She felt shivery and a little sick.

defs.def_en: If you are shivery, you cannot stop shivering because you feel cold, frightened, or ill.

defs.def_cn: (和名词连用，构成新名词)表示“做出某动作的人”

ext.ext_cn: 这些人当中，有 40% 的人告诉人口普查员说自己是穆斯林。
ext.ext_en: Of these, 40% told census-takers they were Muslims...

ext.ext_cn: 他们有几个技术一流的罚球手。
ext.ext_en: They've got some terrific penalty-takers.

defs.def_en: -taker combines with nouns to form other nouns which refer to people who take things, for example decisions or notes.

ext.ext_cn: 她进来喝了杯咖啡，并向我谈起了她的朋友肖纳。
ext.ext_en: She came in for a coffee, and told me about her friend Shona...

ext.ext_cn: 她对食物很在行。
ext.ext_en: She knew a lot about food...

defs.def_en: You use about to introduce who or what something relates to or concerns.

ext.ext_cn: 领导才能就是要有实施变革的能力。
ext.ext_en: Leadership is about the ability to implement change.

defs.def_en: When you mention the things that an activity or institution is about, you are saying what it involves or what its aims are.

ext.ext_cn: “我为帕特里克感到难过，”她说。
ext.ext_en: 'I'm sorry about Patrick,' she said...

ext.ext_cn: 我对整件事深感内疚和气愤。
ext.ext_en: I feel so guilty and angry about the whole issue.

defs.def_en: You use about after some adjectives to indicate the person or thing that a feeling or state of mind relates to.

ext.ext_cn: 蕾切尔将对雅各布有所行动。
ext.ext_en: Rachel was going to do something about Jacob...

ext.ext_cn: 他说会跟尼娜提出离婚，可是他却从未付诸实际。
ext.ext_en: He said he'd ask Nina for a divorce, but he never did anything about it.

defs.def_en: If you do something about a problem, you take action in order to solve it.

defs.def_cn: （某人或某事物）具有（某种特性）

ext.ext_cn: 他身上有一股我从不知道的热情和激情。
ext.ext_en: There was a warmth and passion about him I never knew existed...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为你的化验结果有点不对劲。
ext.ext_en: I think there's something a little peculiar about the results of your test.

defs.def_en: When you say that there is a particular quality about someone or something, you mean that they have this quality.

ext.ext_cn: 我们本地的保健中心约有40个停车位。
ext.ext_en: In my local health centre there's about forty parking spaces...

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀率大约为2.7%。
ext.ext_en: The rate of inflation is running at about 2.7 percent.

defs.def_en: About is used in front of a number to show that the number is not exact.

ext.ext_cn: 大家都在跑来跑去。
ext.ext_en: Everyone was running about.

ext.ext_cn: 从1879到1888年，他游历于德国、瑞士和意大利等地。
ext.ext_en: From 1879 to 1888 he wandered about Germany, Switzerland, and Italy...

defs.def_en: If someone or something moves about, they keep moving in different directions.

ext.ext_cn: 海伦张开双臂拥抱他。
ext.ext_en: Helen threw her arms about him...

ext.ext_cn: 她着装典雅，搭配着一条双层珍珠项链。
ext.ext_en: She was elegantly dressed with a double strand of pearls about her neck.

defs.def_en: If you put something about a person or thing, you put it around them.

defs.def_cn: 在手头的;现成的;能得到的

ext.ext_cn: 近来这类计划资金充足。
ext.ext_en: There's lots of money about these days for schemes like this.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is about, they are present or available.

ext.ext_cn: 我看他要走了。
ext.ext_en: I think he's about to leave...

ext.ext_cn: 阿根廷已经取消所有贸易限制，签证制也将废止。
ext.ext_en: Argentina has lifted all restrictions on trade and visas are about to be abolished...

defs.def_en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon. If something is about to happen, it will happen very soon.

defs.def_en: When someone or something lands, they come down to the ground after moving through the air or falling.

defs.def_en: When someone lands a plane, ship, or spacecraft, or when it lands, it arrives somewhere after a journey.
