defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他筋疲力尽，累得都无法集中注意力做作业。
ext.ext_en: He was shattered and too tired to concentrate on schoolwork.

defs.def_en: If you say you are shattered, you mean you are extremely tired and have no energy left.

ext.ext_cn: 在北非的一些前法属殖民地国家，反法情绪日益增长。
ext.ext_en: In France's former North African colonies, anti-French feeling is growing...

ext.ext_cn: 波多黎各尽管自称共和国，但实际上是有自治权的美国殖民地。
ext.ext_en: Puerto Rico, though it calls itself a Commonwealth, is really a self-governing American colony.

defs.def_en: A colony is a country which is controlled by a more powerful country.

ext.ext_cn: 1932年，他在艾奥瓦州的石头城创建了一所学校，那儿成了艺术家的聚居地。
ext.ext_en: In 1932, he established a school and artists' colony in Stone City, Iowa.

ext.ext_cn: 罪犯流放地
ext.ext_en: ...a penal colony.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a place where a particular group of people lives as a particular kind of colony .

ext.ext_cn: 我们的很多部队和军官分驻世界各地的英属殖民地，为英王效力。
ext.ext_en: Many of our troops and officers were scattered around the world in the service of His Majesty in the colonies.

defs.def_en: The colonies means all the countries that used to be British colonies.

ext.ext_cn: 独立战争前夕，北美十三州每年生产3万吨生铁。
ext.ext_en: On the eve of the Revolution, the colonies produced thirty thousand tons of crude iron a year.

defs.def_en: The colonies means the 13 British colonies in North America which formed the original United States.

defs.def_cn: (鸟、昆虫或动物的)群体，集群，群落

ext.ext_cn: 设得兰群岛以其众多的海鸟而闻名。
ext.ext_en: The Shetlands are famed for their colonies of sea birds...

ext.ext_cn: 毛毛虫总是成群进食。
ext.ext_en: The caterpillars feed in large colonies.

defs.def_en: A colony of birds, insects, or animals is a group of them that live together.

ext.ext_cn: “爸，”他说，“我觉得不舒服。”
ext.ext_en: 'Pa,' he said, 'I don't feel well.'...

ext.ext_cn: 老爸当过兵。
ext.ext_en: Pa used to be in the army.

defs.def_en: Some people address or refer to their father as pa .

defs.def_cn: 对臭氧层无害的;不损害臭氧层的

ext.ext_cn: 用于冰箱和空调、对臭氧层无害的化学品
ext.ext_en: ...ozone-friendly chemicals for fridges and air conditioners.

defs.def_en: Ozone-friendly chemicals, products, or technology do not cause harm to the ozone layer.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 过分拘泥于细节（或传统）的；学究气的；迂腐的

ext.ext_cn: 他的讲座学究气太浓，没意思。
ext.ext_en: His lecture was so pedantic and uninteresting.

defs.def_en: If you think someone is pedantic, you mean that they are too concerned with unimportant details or traditional rules, especially in connection with academic subjects.
A clamp is a device that holds two things firmly together.

ext.ext_cn: 有人忘了带把麦克风固定在支架上的U形螺栓。
ext.ext_en: Somebody forgot to bring along the U-bolts to clamp the microphones to the pole.

defs.def_en: When you clamp one thing to another, you fasten the two things together with a clamp.

defs.def_cn: 将…固定(在某处)；紧紧抓住

ext.ext_cn: 西蒙拨完号，把听筒贴在耳边。
ext.ext_en: Simon finished dialing and clamped the phone to his ear...

ext.ext_cn: 他紧闭双唇。
ext.ext_en: He clamped his lips together...

defs.def_en: To clamp something in a particular place means to put it or hold it there firmly and tightly.

defs.def_cn: (将违章停放的车辆扣在原地的)夹钳，车轮固定夹
defs.def_en: A clamp is a large metal device which is fitted to the wheel of an illegally parked car or other vehicle in order to prevent it from being driven away. The driver has to pay to have the clamp removed.

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰法院裁定，将停在私人地界上的车辆上夹钳并索要罚款的行为是违法的。
ext.ext_en: Courts in Scotland have ruled it illegal to clamp a car parked on private ground and then to demand a fine.

defs.def_en: To clamp a car means to fit a clamp to one of its wheels so that it cannot be driven away.

ext.ext_cn: 他们不得不同一切困境做斗争。
ext.ext_en: They had to struggle against all kinds of adversity...

ext.ext_cn: 那些失业的人们想方设法以支付超市的账单。
ext.ext_en: Those who have lost their jobs struggle to pay their supermarket bills.

defs.def_en: If you struggle to do something, you try hard to do it, even though other people or things may be making it difficult for you to succeed.

ext.ext_cn: 生活成了一场奋力求生的斗争。
ext.ext_en: Life became a struggle for survival.

ext.ext_cn: 年轻的小伙子为了支撑他贫困的家庭所作的努力
ext.ext_en: ...a young lad's struggle to support his poverty-stricken family...

defs.def_en: A struggle is a long and difficult attempt to achieve something such as freedom or political rights.

ext.ext_cn: 我使劲挣扎，但他又高又壮。
ext.ext_en: I struggled, but he was a tall man, well-built.

defs.def_en: If you struggle when you are being held, you twist, kick, and move violently in order to get free.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在地上扭打成一团，她向他尖叫着“别打了”。
ext.ext_en: She screamed at him to 'stop it' as they struggled on the ground...

ext.ext_cn: 我们正在争夺那把枪，这时它突然走火了！
ext.ext_en: We were struggling for the gun when it went off!...

defs.def_en: If two people struggle with each other, they fight.

ext.ext_cn: 我看到小男孩正在奋力挣脱。
ext.ext_en: I could see the young boy struggling to free himself...

ext.ext_cn: 我提着行李艰难地走着，迫切地寻找着搬运工。
ext.ext_en: I struggled with my bags, desperately looking for a porter.

defs.def_en: If you struggle to move yourself or to move a heavy object, you try to do it, but it is difficult.

ext.ext_cn: 飞行员艰难地从失事的飞机中爬出来，几乎没有受伤。
ext.ext_en: The pilot struggled out of the wreck almost uninjured...

ext.ext_cn: 凯瑟琳艰难地站起来。
ext.ext_en: Catherine struggled to her feet...

defs.def_en: If you struggle somewhere, you succeed in moving there, but only with great difficulty.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司正竭力为其新产品寻找买主。
ext.ext_en: The company is struggling to find buyers for its new product...

ext.ext_cn: 的年轻人做日常的数学计算都费劲。
ext.ext_en: One in five young adults was struggling with everyday mathematics... 1/5

defs.def_en: If a person or organization is struggling, they are likely to fail in what they are doing, even though they might be trying very hard.

ext.ext_cn: 减肥是一件非常艰难的事。
ext.ext_en: Losing weight was a terrible struggle.

defs.def_en: An action or activity that is a struggle is very difficult to do.

defs.def_cn: 迂腐；过分拘泥于细节（或传统）；学究气
defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of pedantry, you mean that you disapprove of them because they pay excessive attention to unimportant details or traditional rules, especially in connection with academic subjects.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我的英语说得不错，但是口音很重。
ext.ext_en: I spoke rather good, but heavily accented English...

ext.ext_cn: “别那么做，”他带着口音轻声细气地说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Don't do that,' he says in his soft, accented voice.

defs.def_en: See also:accent;Language or speech that is accented is spoken with a particular accent.

ext.ext_cn: 防护手套可以减少皮肤对化学物质的吸收。
ext.ext_en: Protective gloves reduce the absorption of chemicals through the skin...

ext.ext_cn: 要保存城市古迹必须采取一些维护性措施。
ext.ext_en: Protective measures are necessary if the city's monuments are to be preserved.

defs.def_en: Protective means designed or intended to protect something or someone from harm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对他的母亲呵护备至。
ext.ext_en: He is very protective towards his mother...

ext.ext_cn: 格莉妮丝在她身边，呵护地用胳膊搂住她的肩膀。
ext.ext_en: Glynis was beside her, putting a protective arm around her shoulders.

defs.def_en: If someone is protective towards you, they look after you and show a strong desire to keep you safe.

ext.ext_cn: 烤雉肉
ext.ext_en: ...roast pheasant.

ext.ext_cn: 烤雉肉
ext.ext_en: ...roast pheasant.

defs.def_en: A pheasant is a bird with a long tail. Pheasants are often shot as a sport and then eaten.

ext.ext_cn: 种姓制度决定了印度生活的几乎每一个方面。
ext.ext_en: The caste system shapes nearly every facet of Indian life.

defs.def_en: A facet of something is a single part or aspect of it.

defs.def_cn: (钻石等宝石的)琢面，饰面，切面
defs.def_en: The facets of a diamond or other precious stone are the flat surfaces that have been cut on its outside.

ext.ext_cn: 对其他政党的无作为他多有挖苦。
ext.ext_en: He is bitter about the inaction of the other political parties.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's inaction, you disapprove of the fact that they are doing nothing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 美丽的弗洛拉·蒙哥马利小姐
ext.ext_en: ...the beauteous Miss Flora Montgomery.

defs.def_en: Beauteous means the same as beautiful.

ext.ext_cn: 他用袖子擦掉玻璃上凝结的水珠。
ext.ext_en: He used his sleeve to wipe the condensation off the glass.

defs.def_en: Condensation consists of small drops of water which form when warm water vapour or steam touches a cold surface such as a window.

ext.ext_cn: 晚上看不见颜色。
ext.ext_en: You can't see colours at night...

ext.ext_cn: 我看到一名男子向我走来。
ext.ext_en: I saw a man making his way towards me...

defs.def_en: When you see something, you notice it using your eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 我昨天见到他了。
ext.ext_en: I saw him yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 米克要你马上去他的办公室见他。
ext.ext_en: Mick wants to see you in his office right away...

defs.def_en: If you see someone, you visit them or meet them.

ext.ext_cn: 他看过一场足总杯半决赛。
ext.ext_en: He had been to see a Semi-Final of the FA Cup...

ext.ext_cn: 这是我看过的最精彩的电影之一。
ext.ext_en: It was one of the most amazing films I've ever seen.

defs.def_en: If you see an entertainment such as a play, film, concert, or sports game, you watch it.

ext.ext_cn: 我能看出她很寂寞。
ext.ext_en: I could see she was lonely.

ext.ext_cn: 很多人都看出发生了什么事却袖手旁观。
ext.ext_en: ...a lot of people saw what was happening but did nothing about it...

defs.def_en: If you see that something is true or exists, you realize by observing it that it is true or exists.

ext.ext_cn: 哦，我明白你的意思了。
ext.ext_en: Oh, I see what you're saying...

ext.ext_cn: 我不明白你有什么可抱怨的。
ext.ext_en: I don't see why you're complaining...

defs.def_en: If you see what someone means or see why something happened, you understand what they mean or understand why it happened.

ext.ext_cn: 她认为他是一个有眼光的人，但是她父亲却认为他没有谋生的能力。
ext.ext_en: She saw him as a visionary, but her father saw him as a man who couldn't make a living...

ext.ext_cn: 他们体重正常，但自认为偏胖。
ext.ext_en: They have a normal body weight but see themselves as being fat...

defs.def_en: If you see someone or something as a certain thing, you have the opinion that they are that thing.

defs.def_cn: 看出;看上，欣赏(某种特质)

ext.ext_cn: 坦白地说，我不知道保罗看上她什么了。
ext.ext_en: Frankly, I don't know what Paul sees in her...

ext.ext_cn: 无论老少都看出他是种族隔离制度的坚决反对者。
ext.ext_en: Young and old saw in him an implacable opponent of apartheid.

defs.def_en: If you see a particular quality in someone, you believe they have that quality. If you ask what someone sees in a particular person or thing, you want to know what they find attractive about that person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 主意不错，不过你认为泰勒会尝试它吗？
ext.ext_en: A good idea, but can you see Taylor trying it?...

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以想象有那么一天所有人都和睦地生活在一起。
ext.ext_en: We can see a day where all people live side by side.

defs.def_en: If you see something happening in the future, you imagine it, or predict that it will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天代理内政部长辞职了。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday saw the resignation of the acting Interior Minister...

ext.ext_cn: 他与将军共事了 3 年，看他离去觉得很难过。
ext.ext_en: He had worked with the General for three years and was sorry to see him go...

defs.def_en: If a period of time or a person sees a particular change or event, it takes place during that period of time or while that person is alive.

ext.ext_cn: 我来看看下一首歌是什么。
ext.ext_en: Let me just see what the next song is...

ext.ext_cn: 每次我们问母亲，她总是说：“噢，看你爸爸怎么说。”
ext.ext_en: Every time we asked our mother, she said, 'Well, see what your father says.'...

defs.def_en: You can use see in expressions to do with finding out information. For example, if you say 'I'll see what's happening', you mean that you intend to find out what is happening.

ext.ext_cn: 我会尽力帮你把她叫来。
ext.ext_en: I'll see if I can call her for you...

ext.ext_cn: 我们会尽量想办法，小姐。
ext.ext_en: We'll see what we can do, miss.

defs.def_en: You can use see to promise to try and help someone. For example, if you say 'I'll see if I can do it', you mean that you will try to do the thing concerned.

ext.ext_cn: 一定要照顾好他。
ext.ext_en: See that you take care of him...

ext.ext_cn: 凯瑟琳确保这条消息直接传达给了沃尔特。
ext.ext_en: Catherine saw to it that the information went directly to Walter.

defs.def_en: If you see that something is done or if you see to it that it is done, you make sure that it is done.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有提出要陪她去取车。
ext.ext_en: He didn't offer to see her to her car...

ext.ext_cn: “晚安。”——“我送你出去。”
ext.ext_en: 'Goodnight.' — 'I'll see you out.'

defs.def_en: If you see someone to a particular place, you accompany them to make sure that they get there safely, or to show politeness.

ext.ext_cn: 我们以前经常见到他的妻子卡罗琳。
ext.ext_en: We used to see quite a lot of his wife, Carolyn...

ext.ext_cn: 从那之后我们没怎么见过面，因为他去旅行了。
ext.ext_en: We didn't see much of each other after that because he was touring.

defs.def_en: If you see a lot of someone, you often meet each other or visit each other.

ext.ext_cn: 我的丈夫仍在和她来往，而且两人还搞婚外情。
ext.ext_en: My husband was still seeing her and he was having an affair with her.

defs.def_en: If you are seeing someone, you spend time with them socially, and are having a romantic or sexual relationship.

ext.ext_cn: 在第 16 章我们了解了年度现金预算是怎样制订的。
ext.ext_en: We saw in Chapter 16 how annual cash budgets are produced...

ext.ext_cn: 从以上的数字我们可以看出，机器A在两年后就收回了最初的投资。
ext.ext_en: Using the figures given above, it can be seen that machine A pays back the initial investment in two years...

defs.def_en: Some writers use see in expressions such as we saw and as we have seen to refer to something that has already been explained or described.

ext.ext_cn: 多项调查一致显示，男性认为天黑后在大街上行走是安全的。比如，参见欣德朗和加罗法洛(1978)。
ext.ext_en: Surveys consistently find that men report feeling safe on the street after dark. See, for example, Hindelang and Garofalo (1978)...

ext.ext_cn: 有关纺织业的更多评论请参看下面第 7 章。
ext.ext_en: See Chapter 7 below for further comments on the textile industry.

defs.def_en: See is used in books to indicate to readers that they should look at another part of the book, or at another book, because more information is given there.

ext.ext_cn: 他从事婚姻介绍工作，这多少有点讽刺意味，因为他最大的愿望就是自己能结婚。
ext.ext_en: He is in the marriage bureau business, which is mildly ironic seeing that his dearest wish is to get married himself...

ext.ext_cn: 既然莫尔顿先生是位医生，我想他应该有点聪明才智。
ext.ext_en: Seeing as Mr Moreton is a doctor, I would assume he has a modicum of intelligence.

defs.def_en: You can use seeing that or seeing as to introduce a reason for what you are saying.

ext.ext_cn: “他坐我的车回家来的。”——“哦，是这样。”
ext.ext_en: 'He came home in my car.' — 'I see.'

defs.def_en: You can say 'I see' to indicate that you understand what someone is telling you.

defs.def_cn: (表示暂不作决定)看看吧，再说吧

ext.ext_cn: 再说吧，可能会的。
ext.ext_en: We'll see. It's a possibility.

defs.def_en: People say 'I'll see' or 'We'll see' to indicate that they do not intend to make a decision immediately, and will decide later.

defs.def_cn: (表示试图记起某事或找到某物)让我想一想，让我看看

ext.ext_cn: 让我想一想，他们比我们早 6 个——不，就算是早 5 个小时完成。
ext.ext_en: Let's see, they're six — no, make that five hours ahead of us...

ext.ext_cn: 现在让我看一看，谁是我们要找的人？
ext.ext_en: Now let me see, who's the man we want?

defs.def_en: People say 'let me see' or 'let's see' when they are trying to remember something, or are trying to find something.

ext.ext_cn: 他希望他们坐到一起，彼此能清醒理智，和睦为邻。
ext.ext_en: He was hopeful that by sitting together they could both see sense and live as good neighbours...

ext.ext_cn: 他再次试图让她明白自己错了。
ext.ext_en: He tried again to get her to see reason.

defs.def_en: If you try to make someone see sense or see reason, you try to make them realize that they are wrong or are being stupid.

defs.def_cn: (用于向某人解释某事物并鼓励其倾听和理解)你瞧，你知道，看吧

ext.ext_cn: 好了，知道吗，对那件事你真的不应该那么想。
ext.ext_en: Well, you see, you shouldn't really feel that way about it...

ext.ext_cn: 她是敲诈的主要目标。你难道看不出来吗？
ext.ext_en: She was a prime target for blackmail, don't you see?

defs.def_en: You can say 'you see' when you are explaining something to someone, to encourage them to listen and understand.

ext.ext_cn: “ 回头再跟你谈。”——“好的。再见，亲爱的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Talk to you later.' — 'All right. See you love.'

ext.ext_cn: “现在没空闲聊。”——“那么回见。”
ext.ext_en: 'No time for chattering now.' — 'Be seeing you, then.'

defs.def_en: 'See you', 'be seeing you', and 'see you later' are ways of saying goodbye to someone when you expect to meet them again soon.

defs.def_cn: 到时候你就知道了;你等着瞧吧

ext.ext_cn: 婚后几年这种兴奋感就会逐渐消逝。你等着瞧吧。
ext.ext_en: The thrill wears off after a few years of marriage. You'll see.

defs.def_en: You can say 'You'll see' to someone if they do not agree with you about what you think will happen in the future, and you believe that you will be proved right.

ext.ext_cn: 到下个发薪日前，我真的没有一点儿钱了。
ext.ext_en: Until next payday, I was literally without any money.

defs.def_en: Pay day is the day of the week or month on which you receive your wages or salary.

defs.def_cn: （运动员赢得比赛或参加比赛的）奖金丰收日
defs.def_en: If a sports player has a big pay day, he or she earns a lot of money from winning or taking part in a game or contest.

ext.ext_cn: 很多克罗地亚人和斯洛文尼亚人把独立看作通往民主的捷径。
ext.ext_en: Many Croats and Slovenes saw independence as the fast track to democracy...

ext.ext_cn: 有人告诉他，28 岁的他已经过了破格提升的年龄。
ext.ext_en: He was told that, at 28, he was too old for fast-track promotion.

defs.def_en: The fast track to a particular goal, especially in politics or in your career, is the quickest route to achieving it.

ext.ext_cn: 联邦法庭的一桩案件提前到星期三审理。
ext.ext_en: A Federal Court case had been fast tracked to Wednesday...

ext.ext_cn: 伍德沃德担任教练后破格起用了一些年轻人出场。
ext.ext_en: Woodward has fast-tracked a number of youngsters into the line-up since he became coach.

defs.def_en: To fast track something means to make it happen or progress faster or earlier than normal.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 技法娴熟的;灵巧的;巧妙的

ext.ext_cn: 业余人士拍摄的视频片段和制作精良的好莱坞影片之间存在着巨大的差距。
ext.ext_en: There's a big difference between an amateur video and a slick Hollywood production...

ext.ext_cn: 他的演技娴熟，赏心悦目。
ext.ext_en: His style is slick and visually exciting.

defs.def_en: A slick performance, production, or advertisement is skilful and impressive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 利索的;流畅的;不费力的

ext.ext_cn: 哥伦比亚队凭借流畅的传球和终场前的制胜进球击败了他们。
ext.ext_en: They were outplayed by the Colombians' slick passing and decisive finishing.

ext.ext_cn: 轻松流畅的换挡
ext.ext_en: ...a slick gear change.

defs.def_en: A slick action is done quickly and smoothly, and without any obvious effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 别被那些巧舌如簧的政客蒙骗了。
ext.ext_en: Don't be fooled by slick politicians.

ext.ext_cn: 油嘴滑舌、西装笔挺的侦探
ext.ext_en: ...a slick, suit-wearing detective.

defs.def_en: A slick person speaks easily in a way that is likely to convince people, but is not sincere.

ext.ext_cn: 专家们正想方设法清除这片面积巨大的浮油。
ext.ext_en: Experts are trying to devise ways to clean up the huge slick.

defs.def_en: A slick is the same as an oil slick .

ext.ext_cn: 她把头发往后梳得光溜溜的。
ext.ext_en: She had slicked her hair back...

ext.ext_cn: 他捋平了自己仅剩的几绺白发。
ext.ext_en: He slicked down his few remaining wisps of gray hair...

defs.def_en: If someone slicks their hair back, they make it flat, smooth, and shiny by putting oil or water on it.
Ice water is very cold water served as a drink.

ext.ext_cn: 他在她耳边低声说了些什么。
ext.ext_en: He whispered something in her ear...

ext.ext_cn: 我打算穿耳洞。
ext.ext_en: I'm having my ears pierced.

defs.def_en: Your ears are the two parts of your body, one on each side of your head, with which you hear sounds.

ext.ext_cn: 莫比无疑具有很好的乐感。
ext.ext_en: Moby certainly has a fine ear for a tune...

ext.ext_cn: 能够听懂外语是种优势。
ext.ext_en: An ear for foreign languages is advantageous.

defs.def_en: If you have an ear for music or language, you are able to hear its sounds accurately and to interpret them or reproduce them well.

ext.ext_cn: 怎样才能使民众以更加体谅的心态倾听他的话呢？
ext.ext_en: What would cause the masses to give him a far more sympathetic ear?...

ext.ext_cn: 他们对一切都视而不见，充耳不闻。
ext.ext_en: They had shut their eyes and ears to everything.

defs.def_en: Ear is often used to refer to people's willingness to listen to what someone is saying.
The ears of a cereal plant such as wheat or barley are the parts at the top of the stem, which contain the seeds or grains.

defs.def_cn: . 洗耳恭听;全神贯注地听
defs.def_en: If someone says that they are all ears, they mean that they are ready and eager to listen

defs.def_cn: （尤指让人恼火地）缠住…喋喋不休

ext.ext_cn: 人们一个劲儿地跟他说要继续留在学校念书，这让他烦透了。
ext.ext_en: He was fed up with people bending his ear about staying on at school.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is bending  your ear about something, you mean that they keep talking to you about it because they think it is important; used especially when you are irritated by this.
If someone boxes a child's ears, they hit them on the side of their head as a punishment.

defs.def_cn: (要求)未被理睬，不被听取/(某人对要求)不予理睬，充耳不闻

ext.ext_cn: 我希望我们的呼吁不会没人理睬。
ext.ext_en: I hope that our appeals will not fall on deaf ears...

ext.ext_cn: 他对美国提出的行动要求完全不理不睬。
ext.ext_en: He has turned a resolutely deaf ear to American demands for action.

defs.def_en: If a request falls on deaf ears or if the person to whom the request is made turns a deaf ear to it, they take no notice of it.

ext.ext_cn: 制造业的就业机会相对很少，但是我时刻留意着信息。
ext.ext_en: Jobs in manufacturing are relatively scarce but I keep my ear to the ground.

defs.def_en: If you keep or have your ear to the ground, you make sure that you find out about the things that people are doing or saying.
If you listen to something or someone with only half an ear, you do not give your full attention to what is being said.

ext.ext_cn: 他们总是愿意认真倾听并尽量提出建议。
ext.ext_en: They are always willing to lend an ear and offer what advice they can.

defs.def_en: If you lend an ear to someone or their problems, you listen to them carefully and sympathetically.

defs.def_cn: 左耳进，右耳出;听过即忘

ext.ext_cn: 那种废话都是左耳进，右耳出。
ext.ext_en: That rubbish goes in one ear and out the other.

defs.def_en: If you say that something goes in one ear and out the other, you mean that someone pays no attention to it, or forgets about it immediately.

defs.def_cn: 突然被解雇;突然被赶走

ext.ext_cn: 我们从未反对过，如果我们真的反对，早就被扫地出门，另谋高就了。
ext.ext_en: We never objected. We'd have been out on our ears looking for another job if we had.

defs.def_en: If someone says that you will be out on your ear, they mean that you will be forced to leave a job, an organization or a place suddenly.

defs.def_cn: （不看乐谱而）凭记忆演奏(乐曲)

ext.ext_cn: 尼尔凭着记忆弹奏他曾听到姐姐练习时弹的曲子。
ext.ext_en: Neil played, by ear, the music he'd heard his older sister practicing.

defs.def_en: If you play by ear or play a piece of music by ear, you play music by relying on your memory rather than by reading printed music.
If you play it by ear, you decide what to say or do in a situation by responding to events rather than by following a plan which you have decided on in advance.

defs.def_cn: 深陷于;深深卷入；埋头于

ext.ext_cn: “怎么不跟我一起来呀？”——“不行，我忙着写报告呢。”
ext.ext_en: 'Why don't you come with me?' — 'I can't. I'm up to my ears in reports.'...

ext.ext_cn: 他负债累累，走投无路。
ext.ext_en: He was desperate. He was in debt up to his ears.

defs.def_en: If you are up to your ears in something, it is taking up all of your time, attention, or resources.

defs.def_cn: (令人心情愉快但可能无益健康的)安慰食品

ext.ext_cn: 意大利肉酱面是绝好的安慰食物。
ext.ext_en: For me, spaghetti bolognese is the ultimate comfort food.

defs.def_en: If you call something comfort food, you mean it is enjoyable to eat and makes you feel happier, although it may not be very good for your health.
A pow-wow is a meeting or conference of Native Americans.

ext.ext_cn: 每年我父亲都会召开一次家庭会议，讨论我们要去哪儿度假。
ext.ext_en: Every year my father would call a family powwow to discuss where we were going on vacation.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to a meeting or discussion as a pow-wow .

ext.ext_cn: 霍华德站在房间中央，小口抿着一杯咖啡。
ext.ext_en: Howard stood in the middle of the room sipping a cup of coffee...

ext.ext_cn: 海德加速驶离路边，突然向街道中央一个急转弯。
ext.ext_en: Hyde accelerated away from the kerb, swerving out into the middle of the street...

defs.def_en: The middle of something is the part of it that is furthest from its edges, ends, or outside surface.  the middle of nowhere→see: nowhere;

ext.ext_cn: 制服上装中间的纽扣在他的肚子上绷得紧紧的。
ext.ext_en: The middle button of his uniform jacket was strained over his belly.

ext.ext_cn: 她左手的中指
ext.ext_en: ...the middle finger of her left hand.

defs.def_en: The middle object in a row of objects is the one that has an equal number of  objects on each side.

ext.ext_cn: 53岁的他腰间长了几磅赘肉。
ext.ext_en: At age fifty-three, he now has a few extra pounds around his middle...

ext.ext_cn: 厨用围裙裹着她的腰部。
ext.ext_en: The cook's apron covered her middle.

defs.def_en: Your middle is the part of your body around your stomach.

ext.ext_cn: 我半夜里醒来，听见有敲窗户的声音。
ext.ext_en: I woke up in the middle of the night and could hear a tapping on the window...

ext.ext_cn: 现在是11月中旬，天气寒冷而且经常有雾。
ext.ext_en: It was now the middle of November, cold and often foggy...

defs.def_en: The middle of an event or period of time is the part that comes after the first part and before the last part.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管他看上去年轻得多，她知道他在55岁左右。
ext.ext_en: She knew he was in his middle fifties, although he looked much younger...

ext.ext_cn: 我继续参赛，直到45岁左右。
ext.ext_en: I went on competing till I was in my middle forties.

defs.def_en: If someone is in their middle thirties, for example, they are aged somewhere approximately between thirty-four and thirty-six.

defs.def_cn: (兄弟姐妹中)年龄居中的，排行居中的

ext.ext_cn: 他排行居中的那个儿子5年前意外溺水身亡。
ext.ext_en: His middle son died in a drowning accident five years back.

defs.def_en: The middle child in a family has equal numbers of younger and older brothers and sisters.

defs.def_cn: 折中的;中庸之道的;不走极端的

ext.ext_cn: 他更倾向于在自由经营与国家干预之间走一条中庸之道。
ext.ext_en: He favoured a middle course between free enterprise and state intervention...

ext.ext_cn: 耶路撒冷市市长对各宗教采取折中的态度，力图使冲突最小化。
ext.ext_en: The Mayor of Jerusalem has tried to minimise conflict by maintaining a middle way between the various religions.

defs.def_en: The middle course or way is a moderate course of action that lies between two opposite and extreme courses.

ext.ext_cn: 他们同意均摊费用。
ext.ext_en: They agreed to split the bill down the middle...

ext.ext_cn: 如果不除掉保守势力，那么这个党几乎肯定会分裂成两派。
ext.ext_en: If the conservatives are not removed, then the party will almost certainly split down the middle.

defs.def_en: If you divide or split something down the middle, you divide or split it into two equal halves or groups.

ext.ext_cn: 我正忙着为9个人做饭呢，有点儿忙不过来。
ext.ext_en: It's a bit hectic. I'm in the middle of cooking for nine people...

ext.ext_cn: 他总是忙着做生意。
ext.ext_en: He was always in the middle of a business transaction.

defs.def_en: If you are in the middle of doing something, you are busy doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个设备具有诸如混响之类的内置数码音效。
ext.ext_en: The unit includes built-in digital effects like reverb.

defs.def_en: Reverb is a shaking or echoing effect that is added to a sound, often by an electronic device.

defs.def_cn: （人）尖声尖气地说；（鸟）唧唧（或吱吱）叫

ext.ext_cn: “我的天！”她尖声叫道。
ext.ext_en: 'My gosh,' she chirruped...

ext.ext_cn: 百灵鸟的叽叽喳喳声把我给吵醒了。
ext.ext_en: I woke up to the sound of larks chirruping.

defs.def_en: If a person or bird chirrups, they make short high-pitched sounds.

defs.def_cn: 将…反拧双臂强行押走;挟持而行

ext.ext_cn: 他被扭住双臂强推着走过厨房，来到院子里。
ext.ext_en: He was frog-marched through the kitchen and out into the yard...

ext.ext_cn: 他们逮捕了这些人，并把他们押送到当地警察局。
ext.ext_en: They arrested the men and frog-marched them to the local police station.

defs.def_en: If you are frog-marched somewhere, someone takes you there by force, holding you by the arms or another part of your body so that you have to walk along with them.

ext.ext_cn: 她甚至宣称那对夫妇的女儿被魔鬼附了体。
ext.ext_en: She even claimed the couple's daughter was possessed by the devil...

ext.ext_cn: 他行为举止像是魔怔了。
ext.ext_en: He behaved like someone possessed.

defs.def_en: If someone is described as being possessed by an evil spirit, it is believed that their mind and body are controlled by an evil spirit.

ext.ext_cn: 他才华横溢。
ext.ext_en: He is possessed of the most brilliant talents...

ext.ext_cn: 她有一种可怕的感觉，自己的生命正在慢慢凋零。
ext.ext_en: She was possessed of a terrifying sensation that the life was being squeezed slowly out of her.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is possessed of a particular quality, ability, or feature, they have that quality, ability, or feature. If someone is possessed of a particular feeling or belief, they have that feeling or belief.

defs.def_cn: 尽力同时应付；尽量兼顾

ext.ext_cn: 管理团队一周碰头几次，以同时兼顾预算和资源。
ext.ext_en: The management team meets several times a week to juggle budgets and resources...

ext.ext_cn: 身为电视记者的迈克同时尽力照料着一个11口之家。
ext.ext_en: Mike juggled the demands of a family of 11 with a career as a TV reporter.

defs.def_en: If you juggle lots of different things, for example your work and your family, you try to give enough time or attention to all of them.

defs.def_cn: 玩杂耍（指连续向空中抛接多个物体）

ext.ext_cn: 没多会儿她就开始抛接5个鸡蛋了。
ext.ext_en: Soon she was juggling five eggs...

ext.ext_cn: 我不会玩杂耍。
ext.ext_en: I can't juggle.

defs.def_en: If you juggle, you entertain people by throwing things into the air, catching each one and throwing it up again so that there are several of them in the air at the same time.

defs.def_cn: （陪审团或法官的）裁决，裁定，裁断

ext.ext_cn: 陪审团一致作出了有罪裁决。
ext.ext_en: The jury returned a unanimous guilty verdict...

ext.ext_cn: 3名法官将在10月份作出裁决。
ext.ext_en: Three judges will deliver their verdict in October.

defs.def_en: In a court of law, the verdict is the decision that is given by the jury or judge at the end of a trial.

defs.def_cn: （经过思考或调查后的）意见，结论

ext.ext_cn: 医生的结论是他完全健康。
ext.ext_en: The doctor's verdict was that he was entirely healthy...

ext.ext_cn: 评论家们给我们下定论未免太操之过急了。
ext.ext_en: The critics were too quick to give their verdict on us.

defs.def_en: Someone's verdict on something is their opinion of it, after thinking about it or investigating it.

ext.ext_cn: 在精神病患者中，只有一小部分有可能会伤害自己或他人。
ext.ext_en: Only a small minority of the mentally ill are liable to harm themselves or others.

defs.def_en: When something is liable to happen, it is very likely to happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有…危险的；可能遭受…的；有…倾向的

ext.ext_cn: 她长大成人后会特别容易患抑郁症。
ext.ext_en: She will grow into a woman particularly liable to depression...

ext.ext_cn: 类固醇用于消除可能导致气道肌肉收缩的炎症。
ext.ext_en: Steroids are used to reduce the inflammation, which makes the muscles of the airways liable to constriction.

defs.def_en: If people or things are liable to something unpleasant, they are likely to experience it or do it.

defs.def_cn: （在法律上）有责任的，有义务的

ext.ext_cn: 航空公司所投的保险公司有责任向受害者家属赔付损害赔偿金。
ext.ext_en: The airline's insurer is liable for damages to the victims' families...

ext.ext_cn: 谋杀案发生在英国司法管辖范围外，故国防部无须对其负责。
ext.ext_en: As the killings took place outside British jurisdiction, the Ministry of Defence could not be held liable.

defs.def_en: If you are liable for something such as a debt, you are legally responsible for it.

defs.def_cn: 有扇形饰边的;带荷叶边的

ext.ext_cn: 这条被子有漂亮的荷叶饰边，而且绗缝活做得也很精致。
ext.ext_en: The quilt has pretty, scalloped edges and intricate quilting.

defs.def_en: Scalloped objects are decorated with a series of small curves along the edges.
A pawpaw is a fruit with green skin, sweet yellow flesh, and black seeds and grows in hot countries such as the West Indies.

ext.ext_cn: 火山喷发已导致200多人丧生。
ext.ext_en: Over 200 people have been killed by volcanic eruptions...

ext.ext_cn: 云仙山今天一直在向外喷涌火山灰、气体和火山岩。
ext.ext_en: Mount Unzen has been spewing out volcanic ash, gas, and rock today...

defs.def_en: Volcanic means coming from or created by volcanoes.

ext.ext_cn: 奥森·韦尔斯使得许多美国人相信他们正遭到火星人的入侵。
ext.ext_en: Orson Welles managed to convince many Americans that they were being invaded by Martians.

defs.def_en: A Martian is an imaginary creature from the planet Mars.

ext.ext_cn: 火星的大气层中只含有极少量的水。
ext.ext_en: The Martian atmosphere contains only tiny amounts of water.

defs.def_en: Something that is Martian exists on or relates to the planet Mars.

ext.ext_cn: 喜欢戴墨镜的时髦女子
ext.ext_en: ...a stylish woman with a penchant for dark glasses...

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢拿人开玩笑。
ext.ext_en: He had a penchant for playing jokes on people.

defs.def_en: If someone has a penchant for something, they have a special liking for it or a tendency to do it.

defs.def_cn: (戏剧、书的)场面，片段;(电影)镜头

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得珀西向奥利芙求婚的一幕太让人心酸了。
ext.ext_en: I found the scene in which Percy proposed to Olive tremendously poignant.

ext.ext_cn: 《圣诞颂歌》的开篇场景
ext.ext_en: ...the opening scene of 'A Christmas Carol'.

defs.def_en: A scene in a play, film, or book is part of it in which a series of events happen in the same place.

defs.def_cn: (给人以某种印象的)景象，场景，场面

ext.ext_cn: 那是一副满目疮痍的景象。
ext.ext_en: It's a scene of complete devastation...

ext.ext_cn: 在这一场景中浓浓的黑烟滚滚升起。
ext.ext_en: Thick black smoke billowed over the scene...

defs.def_en: You refer to a place as a scene when you are describing its appearance and indicating what impression it makes on you.

defs.def_cn: (通过画面显示的或看到的)事件，场面，情景

ext.ext_cn: 当难民们呼吸到第一口自由的空气时，有许多感人至深的场面。
ext.ext_en: There were emotional scenes as the refugees enjoyed their first breath of freedom...

ext.ext_cn: 电视台受到警告，要求对暴力场面的描绘采取谨慎态度。
ext.ext_en: Television broadcasters were warned to exercise caution over depicting scenes of violence...

defs.def_en: You can describe an event that you see, or that is broadcast or shown in a picture, as a scene of a particular kind.

ext.ext_cn: 这一地区 3 个月以来不断发生激战。
ext.ext_en: The area has been the scene of fierce fighting for three months...

ext.ext_cn: 犯罪现场留下的痕迹
ext.ext_en: ...traces left at the scene of a crime...

defs.def_en: The scene of an event is the place where it happened.

ext.ext_cn: 桑德曼是当地音乐界的偶像人物。
ext.ext_en: Sandman is a cult figure on the local music scene.

ext.ext_cn: 当他在 28 岁刚刚闯入国家政坛时
ext.ext_en: ...when he first burst onto the national political scene at age 28.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an area of activity as a particular type of scene .

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯·林奇的乡村风景画
ext.ext_en: ...James Lynch's country scenes.

defs.def_en: Paintings and drawings of places are sometimes called scenes .

ext.ext_cn: 对不起，我失态了。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry I made such a scene.

defs.def_en: If you make a scene, you embarrass people by publicly showing your anger about something.

defs.def_cn: 在幕后;秘密地;不公开地

ext.ext_cn: 但是，凯恩先生将背地里偷偷行动以争取达成交易。
ext.ext_en: But behind the scenes Mr Cain will be working quietly to try to get a deal done.

ext.ext_cn: 秘密讨论
ext.ext_en: ...behind-the-scenes discussions.

defs.def_en: If something is done behind the scenes, it is done secretly rather than publicly.

defs.def_cn: (电影、戏剧、广播电视节目的制作)在幕后,在后台

ext.ext_cn: 可以有机会了解幕后的工作，令人非常兴奋。
ext.ext_en: It's an exciting opportunity to learn what goes on behind the scenes.

defs.def_en: If you refer to what happens behind the scenes, you are referring to what happens during the making of a film, play, or radio or television programme.

ext.ext_cn: 你需要换换环境。为什么不乘船去旅行呢？
ext.ext_en: What you need is a change of scene. Why not go on a cruise?

defs.def_en: If you have a change of scene, you go somewhere different after being in a particular place for a long time.

defs.def_cn: 介绍背景;事先介绍情况

ext.ext_cn: 不过首先介绍一下背景：我当时正在和前男友喝饮料。
ext.ext_en: But first to set the scene: I was having a drink with my ex-boyfriend.

defs.def_en: If you set the scene for someone, you tell them what they need to know in order to understand what is going to happen or be said next.

defs.def_cn: 为…铺平道路;为…做好准备

ext.ext_cn: 吉莱斯皮的进球为下半场的精彩比赛铺平了道路。
ext.ext_en: Gillespie's goal set the scene for an exciting second half.

defs.def_en: Something that sets the scene for a particular event creates the conditions in which the event is likely to happen.

defs.def_cn: 登场/离场;到场/消失;介入/摆脱

ext.ext_cn: 如果别的孩子也加入其中，他可能会表现得相当嫉妒。
ext.ext_en: He could react rather jealously when and if another child comes on the scene...

ext.ext_cn: 哈里斯突然出现，又突然消失了。
ext.ext_en: Harris disappeared from the scene as suddenly as he had appeared.

defs.def_en: When a person or thing appears on the scene, they come into being or become involved in something. When they disappear from the scene, they are no longer there or are no longer involved.

ext.ext_cn: 我不喜欢整个星期都躺在沙滩上。
ext.ext_en: Lying on the beach all week isn't my scene.

defs.def_en: If you say that an activity or place is not your scene, you mean that you do not like it or enjoy it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 西方资本主义的扩张将第三世界并入了剥削性的世界体系中。
ext.ext_en: The expansion of Western capitalism incorporated the Third World into an exploitative world system.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as exploitative, you disapprove of it because it treats people unfairly by using their work or ideas for its own advantage, and giving them very little in return.

defs.def_cn: 大警犬，大侦探犬，大猎犬（嗅觉灵敏，常用于追踪）
defs.def_en: A bloodhound is a large dog with a very good sense of smell. Bloodhounds are often used to find people or other animals by following their scent.

defs.def_cn: (电影、电视演员)在私人生活中，在银幕（或荧屏）外

ext.ext_en: He was immensely attractive to women, onscreen and offscreen...

ext.ext_en: Off-screen, Kathy is under the watchful eye of her father Terry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不易察觉的;不明显的;微妙的

ext.ext_cn: 发生在所有生物身上的缓慢而细微的变化
ext.ext_en: ...the slow and subtle changes that take place in all living things...

ext.ext_en: Intolerance can take subtler forms too.

defs.def_en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: I even began to exploit him in subtle ways...

ext.ext_cn: 你知道他为人狡猾。
ext.ext_en: He is a subtle character, you know.

defs.def_en: A subtle person cleverly uses indirect methods to achieve something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 淡棕色
ext.ext_en: ...subtle shades of brown.

ext.ext_cn: 怡人的淡淡香气
ext.ext_en: ...delightfully subtle scents.

defs.def_en: Subtle smells, tastes, sounds, or colours are pleasantly complex and delicate.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我认为是该你清醒过来把思想集中到更为现实的问题上的时候了。
ext.ext_en: I think it is time you woke up and focused your thoughts on more worldly matters...

ext.ext_cn: 他一再批评西方教会过于世俗，消费主义观念过于顽固。
ext.ext_en: He has repeatedly criticized Western churches as too worldly and too entrenched in consumerism.

defs.def_en: Worldly is used to describe things relating to the ordinary activities of life, rather than to spiritual things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他不同于我认识的任何一个人，非常老成，与德莫特完全相反。
ext.ext_en: He was different from anyone I had known, very worldly, everything that Dermot was not...

ext.ext_cn: 他阅历丰富，老于世故。
ext.ext_en: He was worldly and sophisticated.

defs.def_en: Someone who is worldly is experienced and knows about the practical or social aspects of life.

ext.ext_cn: 现在，媒体使得运动员认为追名逐利是很重要的。
ext.ext_en: Today the media drive athletes to the view that the important thing is to gain worldly success.

defs.def_en: Worldly is used to describe things relating to success, wealth, and possessions.

ext.ext_cn: 放弃了所有财产的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a man who had given up all his worldly goods...

ext.ext_cn: 他们愿意签字放弃所有财产。
ext.ext_en: They are willing to sign away their entire worldly possessions.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's possessions as their worldly goods or possessions.

ext.ext_cn: 他们居住的曼哈顿公寓大楼
ext.ext_en: ...the Manhattan apartment house where they live.

defs.def_en: An apartment building or apartment house is a tall building which contains different apartments on different floors.

defs.def_cn: 执政不善;蠹政;治理不当

ext.ext_cn: 他因受到贪污和蠹政的指控于去年12月被捕。
ext.ext_en: He was arrested last December, accused of corruption and misrule...

ext.ext_cn: 他17年执政不善，这期间饥荒加剧，暴乱迭起。
ext.ext_en: In the 17 years of his misrule, famines intensified and rebellions multiplied.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's government of a country as misrule, you are critical of them for governing their country badly or unfairly.

ext.ext_cn: 迪士尼的游客在本世纪末将会超过10亿。
ext.ext_en: Disney will claim its one billionth visitor before the end of the century.

defs.def_en: The billionth item in a series is the one you count as number one billion.

ext.ext_cn: 十亿分之一秒
ext.ext_en: ...a billionth of a second.

defs.def_en: A billionth is one of a billion equal parts of something.

defs.def_cn: 巴基斯坦的；巴基斯坦人的；巴基斯坦文化的

ext.ext_cn: 巴基斯坦城市海得拉巴
ext.ext_en: ...the Pakistani city of Hyderabad.

ext.ext_cn: 巴基斯坦板球运动员
ext.ext_en: ...Pakistani cricketers.

defs.def_en: Pakistani means belonging or relating to Pakistan, or to its people or culture.

defs.def_cn: 巴基斯坦人；巴基斯坦裔人
defs.def_en: A Pakistani is a Pakistani citizen, or a person of Pakistani origin.

ext.ext_cn: 一层薄薄的氧化硅
ext.ext_en: ...a thin layer of silicon oxide...

ext.ext_cn: 芯片就是一枚邮票大小的硅片。
ext.ext_en: A chip is a piece of silicon about the size of a postage stamp.

defs.def_en: Silicon is an element that is found in sand and in minerals such as quartz and granite. Silicon is used to make parts of computers and other electronic equipment.

ext.ext_cn: 那位官员敦促政府不要放弃送上门的机会。
ext.ext_en: The official urged the government not to pass up the opportunity that has now presented itself...

ext.ext_cn: “我不能错过这个机会，”她挥舞着请帖说。
ext.ext_en: 'I can't pass this up.' She waved the invitation.

defs.def_en: If you pass up a chance or an opportunity, you do not take advantage of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉他我主要是对他电影的结尾有保留意见。
ext.ext_en: I told him my main reservation about his film was the ending...

ext.ext_cn: 3天以后，罢工人员的要求几乎全部得到了满足。
ext.ext_en: After three days, the strikers' demands were met almost without reservation.

defs.def_en: If you have reservations about something, you are not sure that it is entirely good or right.

ext.ext_cn: 他到服务台进行了预订。
ext.ext_en: He went to the desk to make a reservation...

ext.ext_cn: 铺位有限，所以有必要进行预订。
ext.ext_en: Accommodation is restricted so a reservation is essential.

defs.def_en: If you make a reservation, you arrange for something such as a table in a restaurant or a room in a hotel to be kept for you.

ext.ext_cn: 1.7万印第安人生活在亚利桑那州的保留地。
ext.ext_en: Seventeen thousand Indians live in Arizona on a reservation.

defs.def_en: A reservation is an area of land that is kept separate for a particular group of people to live in.

ext.ext_cn: 北约领导人在最近召开的伦敦首脑会议上提出的新的战略思想
ext.ext_en: ...the new strategic thinking which NATO leaders produced at the recent London summit...

ext.ext_cn: 降低婴儿死亡率的战略计划
ext.ext_en: ...a strategic plan for reducing the rate of infant mortality...

defs.def_en: Strategic means relating to the most important, general aspects of something such as a military operation or political policy, especially when these are decided in advance.

ext.ext_cn: 战略性核武器
ext.ext_en: ...strategic nuclear weapons.

defs.def_en: Strategic weapons are very powerful missiles that can be fired only after a decision to use them has been made by a political leader.

defs.def_cn: (位置)具有战略意义的，重要的，合适的

ext.ext_cn: 伊芙在各花园景色迷人的地方巧妙安置的大理石长凳
ext.ext_en: ...the marble benches Eve had placed at strategic points throughout the gardens, where the views were spectacular.

defs.def_en: If you put something in a strategic position, you place it cleverly in a position where it will be most useful or have the most effect.

defs.def_cn: 限制性条件；附文；（附带）条件；但书

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉诺曼只要他答应一个附带条件，我就会为他的项目投资。
ext.ext_en: I told Norman I would invest in his venture as long as he agreed to one proviso...

ext.ext_cn: 好，如果简答应，我就接受。
ext.ext_en: Okay, with the proviso that Jane agrees, I accept.

defs.def_en: A proviso is a condition in an agreement. You agree to do something if this condition is fulfilled.
A palisade is a fence of wooden posts which are driven into the ground in order to protect people from attack.

ext.ext_cn: 教皇无误论
ext.ext_en: ...the doctrine of papal infallibility.

defs.def_en: Papal is used to describe things relating to the Pope.

ext.ext_cn: 我欠款5,000英镑，其中一部分是累计的利息。
ext.ext_en: I owed £5,000 — part of this was accrued interest...

ext.ext_cn: 如果28天之内不付款，就会自然生息。
ext.ext_en: If you do not pay within 28 days, interest will accrue...

defs.def_en: If money or interest accrues or if you accrue it, it gradually increases in amount over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 希望利润会增加的期待
ext.ext_en: ...the expectation that profits will accrue.

ext.ext_cn: 使社区持续受益的项目
ext.ext_en: ...a project from which considerable benefit will accrue to the community...

defs.def_en: If things such as profits or benefits accrue to someone, they are added to over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 他把手伸进身边的纸板盒里。
ext.ext_en: He reached into the cardboard box beside him...

ext.ext_cn: 他们坐在木箱子上。
ext.ext_en: They sat on wooden boxes.

defs.def_en: A box is a square or rectangular container with hard or stiff sides. Boxes often have lids.

defs.def_cn: （在纸张、道路等上印制或画出的）方格，方框
defs.def_en: A box is a square or rectangle that is printed or drawn on a piece of paper, a road, or on some other surface.

ext.ext_cn: 在罚球区内被违规撞倒后，他罚点球破门得分。
ext.ext_en: He scored from the penalty spot after being brought down in the box.

defs.def_en: In football, the box is the penalty area of the field.
A box is a small separate area in a theatre or at a sports ground or stadium, where a small number of people can sit to watch the performance or game.

ext.ext_cn: 你是在现场看还是在电视上看？
ext.ext_en: Do you watch it live at all or do you watch it on the box?

defs.def_en: Television is sometimes referred to as the box .

defs.def_cn: （用在数字前表示邮政地址）邮政信箱，邮箱

ext.ext_cn: 兰蒂斯维尔111号信箱，乡村工艺社
ext.ext_en: ...Country Crafts, Box 111, Landisville.

defs.def_en: Box is used before a number as a postal address by organizations that receive a lot of mail.

ext.ext_cn: 黄杨篱笆
ext.ext_en: ...box hedges.

defs.def_en: Box is a small evergreen tree with dark leaves which is often used to form hedges.

ext.ext_cn: 在学校时我既打拳击又玩橄榄球。
ext.ext_en: At school I boxed and played rugby...

ext.ext_cn: 这两位拳击手之前已经打了一场12回合的比赛。
ext.ext_en: The two fighters had previously boxed a 12-round match.

defs.def_en: To box means to fight someone according to the rules of boxing.

ext.ext_cn: 他把她哄到家里，用他父亲的枪射杀了她。
ext.ext_en: He lured her to his home and shot her with his father's gun...

ext.ext_cn: 他们没有意识到自己正被诱入圈套。
ext.ext_en: They did not realise that they were being lured into a trap...

defs.def_en: To lure someone means to trick them into a particular place or to trick them into doing something that they should not do.
A lure is an object which is used to attract animals so that they can be caught.

ext.ext_cn: 到非洲猎取大型野生动物的刺激两百年来一直吸引着欧洲人。
ext.ext_en: The excitement of hunting big game in Africa has been a lure to Europeans for 200 years...

ext.ext_cn: 事实证明，乡村生活的魅力丝毫未减。
ext.ext_en: The lure of rural life is proving as strong as ever.

defs.def_en: A lure is  an attractive quality that something has, or something that you find attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 每人可购买的票的限额已经由四张降至两张。
ext.ext_en: The quota of four tickets per person had been reduced to two.

defs.def_en: A quota is the limited number or quantity of something which is officially allowed.

ext.ext_cn: 该法案将迫使雇主在招聘工人时采取限额制度。
ext.ext_en: The bill would force employers to adopt a quota system when recruiting workers.

defs.def_en: A quota is a fixed maximum or minimum proportion of people from a particular group who are allowed to do something, such as come and live in a country or work for the government.

ext.ext_cn: 毫无疑问，他们身上也有人所共有的弱点。
ext.ext_en: They have the usual quota of human weaknesses, no doubt.

defs.def_en: Someone's quota of something is their expected or deserved share of it.

defs.def_cn: 自以为是的人;妄自尊大的人

ext.ext_cn: 这群不负责任自以为是的年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...this bunch of irresponsible young whippersnappers.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a young person as a whippersnapper, you disapprove of them because you think that they are behaving more confidently than they should.

ext.ext_cn: 种树苗的时候，我喜欢事先划出行来。
ext.ext_en: When planting seedlings I prefer to mark out the rows in advance.

defs.def_en: To mark out an area or shape means to show where it begins and ends.

defs.def_cn: 使具有…特色;使…与众不同

ext.ext_cn: 那晚因几件事情显得非同寻常。
ext.ext_en: There were several things about that evening that marked it out as very unusual...

ext.ext_cn: 它似乎没有一处明显的标志让它看上去像一家饭店。
ext.ext_en: It does not appear to possess any of the obvious signs that would mark it out as a restaurant...

defs.def_en: If a particular quality or feature marks someone or something out, it makes them obviously different from other people or things.

defs.def_cn: 为快速赚钱而粗制滥造的书籍（或电影）
defs.def_en: If you describe a book or film as a potboiler, you mean that it has been created in order to earn money quickly and is of poor quality.

ext.ext_cn: 该运动之疏解所有乌克兰人怒气的能力

ext.ext_en: Turkey plans to harness the waters of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers for big hydro-electric power projects.

defs.def_en: If you harness something such as an emotion or natural source of energy, you bring it under your control and use it.

defs.def_cn: （系在身上用以携带装备或限制其移动的）系带，背带
defs.def_en: A harness is a set of straps which fit under a person's arms and fasten round their body in order to keep a piece of equipment in place or to prevent the person moving from a place.
A harness is a set of leather straps and metal links fastened round a horse's head or body so that the horse can have a carriage, cart, or plough fastened to it.

ext.ext_cn: 星期天，马匹被套在一辆沉重的马车上，准备踏上长达一天的穿越边境之旅。
ext.ext_en: On Sunday the horses were harnessed to a heavy wagon for a daylong ride over the Border.

defs.def_en: If a horse or other animal is harnessed, a harness is put on it, especially so that it can pull a carriage, cart, or plough.

ext.ext_cn: 在北方歌剧公司，他将和去年指挥指定的音乐总监保罗·丹尼尔通力合作。
ext.ext_en: At Opera North he will be in harness with Paul Daniel, the conductor appointed music director last year.

defs.def_en: People or things who are working in harness are working together in order to achieve a particular aim.

defs.def_cn: （常指停止工作一段时间后）正常工作的

ext.ext_cn: 你可以休息三四个月，然后又会开始渴望工作，并能很快回到正常的工作状态。
ext.ext_en: You can rest for three or four months and then the longing for work will return and you will be right back in harness.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in harness, you mean that they are working, often after a period of not working.
Tortilla chips are thick crisps made from corn which are often served with dips such as salsa.

ext.ext_cn: 她的任性妄为和喜怒无常让我整天提心吊胆。
ext.ext_en: I lived in terror of her sudden caprices and moods.

defs.def_en: A caprice is an unexpected action or decision which has no strong reason or purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 投资者和外汇交易商被德意志联邦银行的这一举措打了个措手不及。
ext.ext_en: Investors and currency dealers were caught completely unawares by the Bundesbank's action...

ext.ext_cn: 嫌疑人被弄了个措手不及，根本来不及销毁证据。
ext.ext_en: The suspect was taken unawares, without the chance to dispose of the evidence.

defs.def_en: If something catches you unawares or takes you unawares, it happens when you are not expecting it.
A toddler is a young child who has only just learned to walk or who still walks unsteadily with small, quick steps.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数家庭由女性掌握财政大权。
ext.ext_en: Women control the purse-strings of most families...

ext.ext_cn: 银行一直迟迟不愿放开资金。
ext.ext_en: The bank has been too slow in loosening the purse strings.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone holds or controls the purse strings, you mean that they control the way that money is spent in a particular family, group, or country.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (法律、规则、条件)严格的，严厉的，受严格约束的

ext.ext_cn: 他宣布将对武器的持有实行更严格的控制。
ext.ext_en: He announced that there would be more stringent controls on the possession of weapons...

ext.ext_cn: 其药物检测程序是世界上最严格的。
ext.ext_en: Its  drugtesting procedures are the most stringent in the world.

defs.def_en: Stringent laws, rules, or conditions are very severe or are strictly controlled.

ext.ext_cn: 就从茎节下面，沿茎干把它们全砍掉。
ext.ext_en: Cut them off cleanly through the stem just below the node.

ext.ext_cn: 神经结
ext.ext_en: ...nerve nodes.

defs.def_en: A node is a point, especially in the form of lump or swelling, where one thing joins another.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 保罗是一个羞怯、友善、惯于独处的男人。
ext.ext_en: Paul was a shy, pleasant, solitary man...

ext.ext_cn: 他们常常过一种独居的孤独生活。
ext.ext_en: They often have a lonely and solitary life to lead.

defs.def_en: A person or animal that is solitary spends a lot of time alone.

ext.ext_cn: 他晚上的时间都是靠独自喝闷酒打发。
ext.ext_en: His evenings were spent in solitary drinking.

defs.def_en: A solitary activity is one that you do alone.

ext.ext_cn: 偶尔出现的研究野花野草的孤单身影
ext.ext_en: ...the occasional solitary figure making a study of wildflowers or grasses.

defs.def_en: A solitary person or object is alone, with no others near them.

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆在我对面被单独监禁。
ext.ext_en: Tom was in solitary across the way from me.

defs.def_en: Solitary is the same as solitary confinement .

defs.def_cn: 如此，这样(指已经提到的事)

ext.ext_cn: “你认为那会给这个家庭带来很大的变化吗?”——“我认为是这样的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Do you think that made much of a difference to the family?' — 'I think so.'...

ext.ext_cn: 要是你无法做到诚实坦率，就直说吧。
ext.ext_en: If you can't play straight, then say so...

defs.def_en: You use so to refer back to something that has just been mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 同样，也一样(指后者跟前者一样)

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢和安在一起，马丁也一样。
ext.ext_en: I enjoy Ann's company and so does Martin...

ext.ext_cn: 他们玩得很开心，我也一样。
ext.ext_en: They had a wonderful time and so did I...

defs.def_en: You use so when you are saying that something which has just been said about one person or thing is also true of another one.

defs.def_cn: (表示两个事件或情况在某方面相似)正如…，也…

ext.ext_cn: 正如计算机系统变得越来越先进，开发计算机技术的人所用的方法也日益先进了。
ext.ext_en: As computer systems become even more sophisticated, so too do the methods of those who exploit the technology...

ext.ext_cn: 约翰变了，他的妻子也变了。
ext.ext_en: Just as John has changed, so has his wife...

defs.def_en: You use the structures as...so and just as...so when you want to indicate that two events or situations are similar in some way.

defs.def_cn: (指某一情况)就是这样，事实如此

ext.ext_cn: 最近 20 年来投资黄金的收益很差，今后仍会如此。
ext.ext_en: Gold has been a poor investment over the past 20 years, and will continue to be so...

ext.ext_cn: 那时学校里教授英国舞蹈和英语歌曲，可是现在的情形似乎不再是这样了。
ext.ext_en: In those days English dances as well as songs were taught at school, but that seems no longer to be so...

defs.def_en: If you say that a state of affairs is so, you mean that it is the way it has been described.

defs.def_cn: (向别人示范)这样，像这样;(用手势比划大小、高度或长度)这么，那么

ext.ext_cn: 像这样扣上链子。
ext.ext_en: Clasp the chain like so.

ext.ext_cn: 手指指甲又长又红，就这样握着香槟酒杯
ext.ext_en: ...holding the champagne glass with long red nails positioned just so.

defs.def_en: You can use so with actions and gestures to show a person how to do something, or to indicate the size, height, or length of something.

ext.ext_cn: 我不是一个感情外露的人，因此不会主动告诉他我爱他。
ext.ext_en: I am not an emotional type and so cannot bring myself to tell him I love him...

ext.ext_cn: 人们的寿命比以前任何时候都长了，所以即便到了 65 岁或 70 岁，余下的光阴也还很长。
ext.ext_en: People are living longer than ever before, so even people who are 65 or 70 have a surprising amount of time left...

defs.def_en: You use so and so that to introduce the result of the situation you have just mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 到我的套房来吧，这样我就可以跟你好好讲讲我在波士顿看的这部非常棒的戏了。
ext.ext_en: Come to my suite so I can tell you all about this wonderful play I saw in Boston...

ext.ext_cn: 他挽起她的手臂，带她匆匆上了楼，这样别人就听不见他们说的话了。
ext.ext_en: He took her arm and hurried her upstairs so that they wouldn't be overheard...

defs.def_en: You use so ,so that, and so as to introduce the reason for doing the thing that you have just mentioned.

defs.def_cn: (在叙述过程中引出一系列事件中的下一件或说明两件事情之间的联系)此后，于是

ext.ext_cn: 女人问他能否给她修一修篱笆，于是他留了下来。
ext.ext_en: The woman asked if he could perhaps mend her fences, and so he stayed...

ext.ext_cn: 她从圣诞夜开始有整整 5 天的自由时间，于是她准备去查尔斯跟家人呆在一起。
ext.ext_en: She was free for five whole days, from Christmas Eve. And so she would be going to Charles, to join her family...

defs.def_en: You can use so in stories and accounts to introduce the next event in a series of events or to suggest a connection between two events.

defs.def_cn: (表示开始新话题、引入新问题或对刚说过的问题进行评论)那么，这么

ext.ext_cn: 那么，你今天过得怎么样？
ext.ext_en: So how was your day?...

ext.ext_cn: 这么说，你是个跑步爱好者喽？
ext.ext_en: So you're a runner, huh?...

defs.def_en: You can use so in conversations to introduce a new topic, or to introduce a question or comment about something that has been said.

defs.def_cn: (谈话中表示接受别人的说法)的确，确实

ext.ext_cn: “这使我觉得自己，嗯，很重要。”——“的确如此。”
ext.ext_en: 'It makes me feel, well, important.' — 'And so you are.'...

ext.ext_cn: “你绝不会使用这样的字眼。”——“我的确不会。”
ext.ext_en: 'You can't possibly use this word.' — 'So I won't.'...

defs.def_en: You can use so in conversations to show that you are accepting what someone has just said.

defs.def_cn: (表示某人说的话无关紧要)那又怎样呢？

ext.ext_cn: “我是布鲁诺。”——“那又怎样?”
ext.ext_en: 'My name's Bruno.' — 'So?'...

ext.ext_cn: “如果到英国度假，天气好不好得要碰运气。”——“那又如何？”
ext.ext_en: 'You take a chance on the weather if you holiday in the UK.' — 'So what?'...

defs.def_en: You say 'So?' and 'So what?' to indicate that you think that something that someone has said is unimportant.

defs.def_cn: (用于形容词和副词之前强调所描述的特性)如此，这么，多么，太

ext.ext_cn: 弗朗西斯心想：“我害怕极了。”
ext.ext_en: 'I am so afraid,' Francis thought...

ext.ext_cn: 他俩居然结婚了——这让他非常惊讶，因为他们实在是太不一样了。
ext.ext_en: He was surprised they had married — they had seemed so different...

defs.def_en: You can use so in front of adjectives and adverbs to emphasize the quality that they are describing.

defs.def_cn: 如此…(以致…);到…的程度(以致…)

ext.ext_cn: 眼泪哗哗地流下来，她的视线一下子就模糊了。
ext.ext_en: The tears were streaming so fast she could not see...

ext.ext_cn: 这笔交易看上去太诱人了，要是拒绝它简直是笑话。
ext.ext_en: The deal seems so attractive it would be ridiculous to say no...

defs.def_en: You can use so...that and so...as to emphasize the degree of something by mentioning the result or consequence of it.

ext.ext_cn: 政府在卫生、教育、税收等等重大问题上的政策
ext.ext_en: ...the Government's policies on such important issues as health, education, tax and so on...

ext.ext_cn: 病人可以食用苹果、苹果汁、苹果酱等。
ext.ext_en: The patient can have apples, apple juice, apple sauce, and so forth.

defs.def_en: You use and so on or and so forth at the end of a list to indicate that there are other items that you could also mention.

defs.def_cn: (指某事有一定限度，但未言明具体限度)这么多，这么些，到这种程度

ext.ext_cn: 白天回复信件的时间只有这么多。
ext.ext_en: There is only so much time in the day for answering letters...

ext.ext_cn: 油箱里面的油只有这么多了，你要是太快把油耗光可就麻烦了。
ext.ext_en: There is only so much fuel in the tank and if you burn it up too quickly you are in trouble...

defs.def_en: You use so much and so many when you are saying that there is a definite limit to something but you are not saying what this limit is.

ext.ext_cn: 我与其说是反感威尔的行为，不如说是讨厌他的为人。
ext.ext_en: I did not really object to Will's behaviour so much as his personality...

ext.ext_cn: 好的出身与其说是取决于你的身份，还不如说是取决于你的生活环境和知识水平。
ext.ext_en: A good birth depends not so much on who you are but where you are and how much you know.

defs.def_en: You use the structures not...so much and not so much...as to say that something is one kind of thing rather than another kind.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管利率在下降，它们仍然能提供 8%左右的实际收益率。
ext.ext_en: Though rates are heading down, they still offer real returns of 8% or so...

ext.ext_cn: 我初次来到这里的时候，马特找了个房间让我住了大约一个星期。
ext.ext_en: Matt got me a room there for a week or so when I first came here...

defs.def_en: You use or so when you are giving an approximate amount.

ext.ext_cn: 我每天服用干酵母片以净化血液。
ext.ext_en: I take wheat and yeast tablets daily to purify the blood...

ext.ext_cn: 只使用纯净水。
ext.ext_en: Only purified water is used.

defs.def_en: If you purify a substance, you make it pure by removing any harmful, dirty, or inferior substances from it.
A nursemaid is a woman or girl who is paid to look after young children.
Cornflour is a fine white powder made from maize and is used to make sauces thicker.

ext.ext_cn: 叛军提出一个五点计划。
ext.ext_en: The rebels put forth a five-point plan.

defs.def_en: If someone puts forth a plan or proposal, they suggest it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 男性的;有男子气概的;阳刚的

ext.ext_cn: 他希望他的儿子们能长得像他一样强壮、阳刚而又健美。
ext.ext_en: He wanted his sons to become strong, virile, and athletic like himself.

ext.ext_cn: 身材高大、体魄健壮、相貌粗犷英俊的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a tall, virile man with rugged good looks.

defs.def_en: If you describe a man as virile, you mean that he has the qualities that a man is traditionally expected to have, such as strength and sexual power.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 普罗科菲耶夫的最强劲有力的音乐
ext.ext_en: ...Prokofiev's  most virile, aggressive music.

ext.ext_cn: 克服困难的有力手段
ext.ext_en: ...a virile approach to difficulties.

defs.def_en: Something that is described as virile is considered to be very strong and forceful.

ext.ext_cn: 饭好了吗？我都饿坏了。
ext.ext_en: Isn't dinner ready? I'm famished.

defs.def_en: If you are famished, you are very hungry.
A shawl is a large piece of woollen cloth which a woman wears over her shoulders or head, or which is wrapped around a baby to keep it warm.

defs.def_cn: （尤指政治或宗教信仰方面的）狂热分子，极端分子

ext.ext_cn: 他个性坚定，但绝不是什么狂热分子。
ext.ext_en: He was forceful, but by no means a zealot.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a zealot, you think that their views and actions are very extreme, especially in following a particular political or religious belief.

ext.ext_cn: 他们喂肥了鹅鸭。
ext.ext_en: They fattened up ducks and geese...

ext.ext_cn: 你太瘦了，我们要把你养胖些。
ext.ext_en: You're too skinny — we'll have to fatten you up.

defs.def_en: See also:fatten;To fatten up an animal or person means to make them fatter, by forcing or encouraging them to eat more food.

defs.def_cn: (身体某部分因紧张或上了年纪而)发僵，无法动弹

ext.ext_cn: 两天的辛苦劳累过后，发僵的是胳膊和双手，腿倒没事。
ext.ext_en: After two days' exertions, it's the arms and hands that seize up, not the legs...

ext.ext_cn: 我们刚生下来时身体都很灵活，但随着年龄的增长，手脚会变得有些僵硬。
ext.ext_en: We are all born flexible but as we grow older, we tend to seize up a little.

defs.def_en: If a part of your body seizes up, it suddenly stops working, because you have strained it or because you are getting old.

defs.def_cn: (发动机等)停止运转，发生故障

ext.ext_cn: 她往油箱里加了些柴油而不是汽油，致使发动机发生故障。
ext.ext_en: She put diesel fuel, instead of petrol, into the tank causing the motor to seize up.

defs.def_en: If something such as an engine seizes up, it stops working, because it has not been properly cared for.
An archer is someone who shoots arrows using a bow.

ext.ext_cn: 正确答案在第8页末尾。
ext.ext_en: The correct answers can be found at the bottom of page 8...

ext.ext_cn: 下列信息在付印时准确无误。
ext.ext_en: The following information was correct at time of going to press...

defs.def_en: If something is correct, it is in accordance with the facts and has no mistakes.

ext.ext_cn: 你说得很对，这是月桂树的叶子。
ext.ext_en: You are absolutely correct. The leaves are from a bay tree...

ext.ext_cn: 如果凯西是对的，清理的总花费将达1,100亿美元。
ext.ext_en: If Casey is correct, the total cost of the cleanup would come to $110 billion.

defs.def_en: If someone is correct, what they have said or thought is true.

ext.ext_cn: 使用恰当的材料至关重要。
ext.ext_en: The use of the correct materials was crucial...

ext.ext_cn: 怀特确信裁判作出了公正的判罚。
ext.ext_en: White was in no doubt the referee made the correct decision.

defs.def_en: The correct thing or method is the thing or method that is required or is most suitable in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 你试图让自己的母亲变得越来越独立，这样做很正确。
ext.ext_en: You are perfectly correct in trying to steer your mother towards increased independence...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为总统拒绝这一提议是正确的。
ext.ext_en: I think the president was correct to reject the offer.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is correct in doing something, you approve of their action.

defs.def_cn: 纠正(问题);改正，修正(错误)

ext.ext_cn: 要解决这个问题，他可能需要做外科手术。
ext.ext_en: He may need surgery to correct the problem...

ext.ext_cn: 他批评政府在纠正过去的错误问题上效率低下，并且拖拖拉拉。
ext.ext_en: He has criticised the government for inefficiency and delays in correcting past mistakes.

defs.def_en: If you correct a problem, mistake, or fault, you do something which puts it right.

ext.ext_cn: “实际上，并不是那样，”乔治纠正我。
ext.ext_en: 'Actually, that isn't what happened,' George corrects me...

ext.ext_cn: 我必须纠正他的一处小错误。
ext.ext_en: I must correct him on a minor point.

defs.def_en: If you correct someone, you say something which you think is more accurate or appropriate than what they have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 备课和批改学生的作业花费了他很多精力。
ext.ext_en: It took an extraordinary effort to focus on preparing his classes or correcting his students' work.

defs.def_en: When someone corrects a piece of writing, they look at it and mark the mistakes in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为)符合社会公认标准的，得体的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为英国人很有礼貌，举止非常得体。
ext.ext_en: I think English men are very polite and very correct...

ext.ext_cn: 他们富有体育精神而且举止得体，让我们感到相当惊讶。
ext.ext_en: We were rather surprised by their sporting and correct behaviour.

defs.def_en: If a person or their behaviour is correct, their behaviour is in accordance with social or other rules.

defs.def_cn: 若是我说错了就请指出

ext.ext_cn: 如果我没记错的话，那是在卡马森的一个停车场内。
ext.ext_en: As I recall, but correct me if I'm wrong, it was in a car park in Carmarthen.

defs.def_en: You say 'correct me if I'm wrong' to indicate that you are not entirely sure that what you are about to say is true.

ext.ext_cn: 北冰洋的鱼受到过污染吗？
ext.ext_en: Have any fish been contaminated in the Arctic Ocean?

ext.ext_cn: 大片撂荒的土地，其中大部分由于经年累月的战火而受到了污染
ext.ext_en: ...vast tracts of empty land, much of it contaminated by years of army activity.

defs.def_en: If something is contaminated by dirt, chemicals, or radiation, they make it dirty or harmful.

defs.def_cn: （尤用作名称）首字母缩拼词，首字母缩略词
defs.def_en: An acronym is a word composed of the first letters of the words in a phrase, especially when this is used as a name. An example of an acronym is NATO which is made up of the first letters of the 'North Atlantic Treaty Organization'.
Your bronchial tubes are the two tubes which connect your windpipe to your lungs.

ext.ext_cn: 今天他将正式宣布参加总统竞选。
ext.ext_en: Today he is formally announcing his candidacy for President.

defs.def_en: Someone's candidacy is their position of being a candidate in an election.

ext.ext_cn: 使人类彰显高尚的经久不衰的人生基本准则
ext.ext_en: ...the enduring fundamental principles of life that ennoble mankind.

defs.def_en: To ennoble someone or something means to make them more dignified and morally better.

ext.ext_cn: 被封为贵族的金融家之子
ext.ext_en: ...the son of a financier who had been ennobled.

ext.ext_cn: 新近被封为贵族的阿彻男爵
ext.ext_en: ...the newly ennobled Lord Archer.

defs.def_en: If someone is ennobled, they are made a member of the nobility.

defs.def_cn: (通常因做错事而)使无资格，取消…的资格

ext.ext_cn: 他被判犯有贪污罪，以后7年里将无资格担任公职。
ext.ext_en: He was convicted of corruption, and will be disqualified from office for seven years...

ext.ext_cn: 负责人商议之后，最终决定取消我们的资格。
ext.ext_en: The stewards conferred and eventually decided to disqualify us.

defs.def_en: When someone is disqualified, they are officially stopped from taking part in a particular event, activity, or competition, usually because they have done something wrong.

defs.def_cn: 硬水软化器，硬水软化剂(可以去除水中某些矿物质，使洗衣时容易产生肥皂泡)
defs.def_en: A water softener is a device or substance which removes certain minerals, for example calcium, from water, so that it makes bubbles easily when you use soap to wash things.

defs.def_cn: 织物软化剂，柔顺剂(洗衣时加入水中的一种化学物质，可使衣物手感柔和)
defs.def_en: A fabric softener is a chemical substance that you add to water when you wash clothes in order to make the clothes feel softer.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 干净整洁的;纤尘不染的

ext.ext_cn: 她的客厅一尘不染。
ext.ext_en: Her front room was kept immaculate.

ext.ext_cn: 身着干净套装、蝴蝶领结一尘不染的侍者
ext.ext_en: ...the waiter, dressed in immaculate bow tie and suit...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as immaculate, you mean that it is extremely clean, tidy, or neat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 守门员的表现堪称完美。
ext.ext_en: The goalkeeper's performance was immaculate.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is immaculate, you are emphasizing that it is perfect, without any mistakes or bad parts at all.
A wharf is a platform by a river or the sea where ships can be tied up.

defs.def_cn: 太空站;航天站;宇宙空间站
defs.def_en: A space station is a place built for astronauts to live and work in, which is sent into space and then keeps going around the earth.

ext.ext_cn: 传统上男人把自己的生活划分清楚，他们不会让私生活影响其工作。
ext.ext_en: Traditionally men have compartmentalized their lives, never letting their personal lives encroach upon their professional lives.

defs.def_en: To compartmentalize something means to divide it into separate sections.

ext.ext_cn: 他的爱情生活很复杂，几段感情都是轰轰烈烈。
ext.ext_en: His love life was complicated, and involved intense relationships.

defs.def_en: Someone's love life is the part of their life that consists of their romantic and sexual relationships.
A snack bar is a place where you can buy drinks and simple meals such as sandwiches.

ext.ext_cn: 铺油毡的地板
ext.ext_en: ...lino floors.

ext.ext_cn: 厨房地板上肮脏的油毡
ext.ext_en: ...the dirty lino on the floor of the kitchen.

defs.def_en: Lino is the same as linoleum .
The whiskers of an animal such as a cat or a mouse are the long stiff hairs that grow near its mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 长着浓密的络腮胡子，胡须未刮且脸上脏兮兮的看起来很粗野的家伙
ext.ext_en: ...wild, savage-looking fellows, with large whiskers, unshaven beards, and dirty faces.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the hair on a man's face, especially on the sides of his face, as his whiskers .

defs.def_cn: 微小的数量；一丝；一点儿

ext.ext_cn: 新的宠物普查显示出猫的数量略微超过了狗的数量(700万比690万)。
ext.ext_en: A new pet census showed that cats now outnumber dogs by a whisker (7 million to 6.9 million)...

ext.ext_cn: 她离金牌只有一步之遥。
ext.ext_en: She came within a whisker of taking a gold medal...

defs.def_en: You can use whisker in expressions such as by a whisker or within a whisker of to indicate that something happened or is true, but only by a very small amount or degree.

defs.def_cn: （用于墙上瓷砖间抹缝的）勾缝剂，薄胶泥
defs.def_en: Grout is a thin mixture of sand, water, and cement or lime, which is used to fill in the spaces between tiles that are fixed to a wall.

defs.def_cn: 给（瓷砖等）灌浆；为…涂薄胶泥

ext.ext_cn: 要确保这些瓷砖经过彻底灌浆并且密封好。
ext.ext_en: Make sure that your tiles are thoroughly grouted and sealed.

defs.def_en: If you grout the tiles on a wall, you use grout to fill in the spaces between the tiles.

ext.ext_cn: 大家对政府的幻想渐渐破灭了。
ext.ext_en: There's growing disenchantment with the Government.

defs.def_en: Disenchantment is the feeling of being disappointed with something, and no longer believing that it is good or worthwhile.
A handlebar moustache is a long thick moustache with curled ends.

ext.ext_cn: 挺大的房间
ext.ext_en: ...a biggish room.

defs.def_en: Something that is biggish is fairly big.

ext.ext_cn: 较厚的熔岩需要两周的时间才能凝固。
ext.ext_en: The thicker lava would have taken two weeks to solidify...

ext.ext_cn: 能源部计划在造价几十亿美元的高科技工厂里将那些致命的废料固态化。
ext.ext_en: The Energy Department plans to solidify the deadly waste in a high-tech billion-dollar factory.

defs.def_en: When a liquid solidifies or is solidified, it changes into a solid.

defs.def_cn: 巩固;(使)变可靠;(使)变稳固

ext.ext_cn: 由于特权和习惯使然,她的看法变得越来越难以改变。
ext.ext_en: Her attitudes solidified through privilege and habit.

ext.ext_cn: 他为巩固自己的主席地位所作的努力
ext.ext_en: ...his attempt to solidify his position as chairman...

defs.def_en: If something such as a position or opinion solidifies, or if something solidifies it, it becomes firmer and more definite and unlikely to change.
An exclusion zone is an area where people are not allowed to go or where they are not allowed to do a particular thing, for example because it would be dangerous.

ext.ext_cn: 作为世界上最富庶的城市之一，它的精致和优雅…
ext.ext_en: ...the sophistication of one of the world's richest cities...

ext.ext_cn: 鉴于现代机器的先进程度，几乎没有什么东西是在家里洗不了的。
ext.ext_en: Given the sophistication of modern machines, there is little that cannot be successfully washed at home.

defs.def_en: The sophistication of machines or methods is their quality of being more advanced or complex than others.

ext.ext_cn: 举止优雅、风度翩翩且派头十足是詹姆斯·邦德一贯的形象。
ext.ext_en: James Bond is known for his sophistication, his style and his sense of class.

defs.def_en: Sophistication is the quality of being comfortable in social situations and knowing about culture, fashion, and other matters that are considered socially important.

ext.ext_cn: 斯威夫特说，生物科技领域的投资人越来越精明了，这也为我们获得一个更专业的投资基金提供了机会。
ext.ext_en: Swift said the growing sophistication among biotech investors presented an opportunity for a more specialist investment fund.

defs.def_en: Sophistication is the quality of being intelligent and knowing a lot, so that you are able to understand complicated situations.

defs.def_cn: 爱尔兰女人;爱尔兰女后裔
defs.def_en: An Irishwoman is a woman who is an Irish citizen or is of Irish origin.
Mouthwash is a liquid that you put in your mouth and then spit out in order to clean your mouth and make your breath smell pleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 比较擅长贸易的文明其财富也随之增长。
ext.ext_en: Cultures that were better at trading saw a concomitant increase in their wealth...
