ext.ext_en: This approach was concomitant with the move away from relying solely on official records.

defs.def_en: Concomitant is used to describe something that happens at the same time as another thing and is connected with it.

ext.ext_cn: 故意篡改引文的权利并不是新闻自由的产物。
ext.ext_en: The right to deliberately alter quotations is not a concomitant of a free press.

defs.def_en: A concomitant of something is another thing that happens at the same time and is connected with it.
Balsamic vinegar is a type of vinegar which tastes sweet and is made from grape juice.

ext.ext_cn: 他还没有掌握基本的语法规则。
ext.ext_en: He  doesn't have mastery of the basic rules of grammar.

ext.ext_cn: 梵文语法与英文语法的区别
ext.ext_en: ...the difference between Sanskrit and English grammar.

defs.def_en: Grammar is the ways that words can be put together in order to make sentences.

ext.ext_cn: 他的词汇丰富，语法也很精通。
ext.ext_en: His vocabulary was sound and his grammar excellent.

ext.ext_cn: 青少年拼写能力和语法知识的下降
ext.ext_en: ...a deterioration in spelling and grammar among teenagers.

defs.def_en: Someone's grammar is the way in which they obey or do not obey the rules of grammar when they write or speak.

ext.ext_cn: 高阶英语语法书
ext.ext_en: ...an advanced English grammar.

defs.def_en: A grammar is a book that describes the rules of a language.

ext.ext_cn: 转换生成语法局限性更大。
ext.ext_en: Transformational grammars are more restrictive.

defs.def_en: A particular grammar is a particular theory that is intended to explain the rules of a language.

ext.ext_cn: 印度尼西亚妇女已经获得了现代离婚法的保护，享有和丈夫同等的权利。
ext.ext_en: Women in Indonesia have secured modern divorce laws that equalize the rights of husbands and wives...

ext.ext_cn: 需要采取这样的措施实现各国工资率的均等。
ext.ext_en: Such measures are needed to equalize wage rates between countries.

defs.def_en: To equalize a situation means to give everyone the same rights or opportunities, for example in education, wealth, or social status.

defs.def_cn: （体育运动中）追平比分；打成平局

ext.ext_cn: 基根在仅剩下16分钟时追平了比分。
ext.ext_en: Keegan equalized with only 16 minutes remaining...

ext.ext_cn: 丝毫没有迹象表明他们会追平朴次茅斯队前锋在第55分钟时的精彩进球。
ext.ext_en: They showed little sign of equalising the Portsmouth striker's glorious 55th-minute shot.

defs.def_en: In sports such as football, if a player equalizes, he or she scores a goal that makes the scores of the two teams equal.

defs.def_cn: （乡间或山里的）度假屋，小舍（尤用于狩猎或钓鱼时暂住）

ext.ext_cn: 维多利亚式狩猎度假屋
ext.ext_en: ...a Victorian hunting lodge.

ext.ext_cn: 滑雪度假屋
ext.ext_en: ...a ski lodge.

defs.def_en: A lodge is a house or hut in the country or in the mountains where people stay on holiday, especially when they want to shoot or fish.

ext.ext_cn: 我驶出大门，经过守门人的小屋。
ext.ext_en: I drove out of the gates, past the keeper's  lodge.

defs.def_en: A lodge is a small house at the entrance to the grounds of a large house.

defs.def_cn: 地方分会；地方分部；分会集会处

ext.ext_cn: 我爸爸偶尔会到他的共济会分会那里去。
ext.ext_en: My father would occasionally go to his Masonic lodge.

defs.def_en: In some organizations, a lodge is a local branch or meeting place of the organization.

defs.def_cn: （正式）提出（投诉、抗议、指控、索赔等）

ext.ext_cn: 他有4个星期的时间提出上诉。
ext.ext_en: He has four weeks in which to lodge an appeal.

defs.def_en: If you lodge a complaint, protest, accusation, or claim, you officially make it.

ext.ext_cn: 她还是一名年轻教师时所寄宿的那个农家的故事
ext.ext_en: ...the story of the farming family she lodged with as a young teacher...

ext.ext_cn: 原来，他租住的那栋建筑是一座教堂。
ext.ext_en: The building he was lodged in turned out to be a church.

defs.def_en: If you lodge somewhere, such as in someone else's house or if you are lodged there, you live there, usually paying rent.

ext.ext_cn: 他们把我关起来，问完我话后又将我安置在儿童院。
ext.ext_en: They took me into custody, questioned me, then lodged me in a children's  home...

ext.ext_cn: 他们把代表团的成员安顿在不同的酒店。
ext.ext_en: They lodged the delegates in different hotels.

defs.def_en: If someone lodges you somewhere, they give you a place to stay, for example because they are responsible for your safety or comfort.

ext.ext_cn: 子弹嵌进了中士的腿里，使其股骨碎裂。
ext.ext_en: The bullet lodged in the sergeant's leg, shattering his thigh bone...

ext.ext_cn: 他的车在客座位的门上嵌着一颗子弹。
ext.ext_en: His car has a bullet lodged in the passenger door.

defs.def_en: If an object lodges somewhere, it becomes stuck there.

ext.ext_cn: 这首歌令人感怀不已，我已牢牢记住。
ext.ext_en: It just lodged in my mind as a very sentimental song...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你有话要说，那就要让他们最终将这些话牢记于心。
ext.ext_en: If you've got something to say it's got to be lodged in their brains at the end...

defs.def_en: If a fact or feeling lodges in your mind or is lodged there, you remember it for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 打折的汽车保险
ext.ext_en: ...cut-rate auto insurance.

defs.def_en: Cut-rate goods or services are cheaper than usual.
In a cathedral or church, the transept is the part which projects to the north or south of the main part of the building.

ext.ext_cn: 他满嘴胡说八道。
ext.ext_en: He talks such a load of piffle.

defs.def_en: If you describe what someone says as piffle, you think that it is nonsense.
A moat is a deep, wide channel dug round a place such as a castle and filled with water, in order to protect the place from attack.

defs.def_cn: 亵渎，玷污(神圣或特别的事物)

ext.ext_cn: 她不该亵渎宗教领袖的画像。
ext.ext_en: She shouldn't have desecrated the picture of a religious leader...

ext.ext_cn: 大地应该受到敬仰，而不该被亵渎。
ext.ext_en: The earth is to be honoured; it is not to be desecrated.

defs.def_en: If someone desecrates something which is considered to be holy or very special, they deliberately damage or insult it.

ext.ext_cn: 你从市中心乘有轨电车到海滩会很方便。
ext.ext_en: You can get to the beach easily from the centre of town by tram.

defs.def_en: A tram is a public transport vehicle, usually powered by electricity from wires above it, which travels along rails laid in the surface of a street.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (对曾经支持过的组织或政治信仰)不再支持的，不满的，不忠的

ext.ext_cn: 他吸引了心怀不满的选民们。
ext.ext_en: He attracts disaffected voters...

ext.ext_cn: 环境问题把对政府不满的人们凝聚了起来。
ext.ext_en: Environmental issues provided a rallying point for people disaffected with the government.

defs.def_en: Disaffected people no longer fully support something such as an organization or political ideal which they previously supported.

defs.def_cn: 私下地；只是你我之间说说

ext.ext_cn: 私底下说，我不敢肯定他们明白了。
ext.ext_en: Confidentially, I am not sure that it wasn't above their heads.

defs.def_en: See also:confidential;Confidentially is used to say that what you are telling someone is a secret and should not be discussed with anyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 手机现在已经成了孩子们的必备品。
ext.ext_en: The mobile phone is now a must-have for children.

ext.ext_cn: 必备时尚饰品
ext.ext_en: ...a must-have fashion accessory.

defs.def_en: A must-have is something modern that many people want to have.

ext.ext_cn: 她使出浑身的力气拧他的胳膊。
ext.ext_en: She pinched his arm as hard as she could...

ext.ext_cn: 我们两个都一直在掐自己，证明这不是在做梦。
ext.ext_en: We both kept pinching ourselves to prove that it wasn't all a dream.

defs.def_en: If you pinch a part of someone's body, you take a piece of their skin between your thumb and first finger and give it a short squeeze.

ext.ext_cn: 把包括一撮盐在内的所有配料放入食品加工机。
ext.ext_en: Put all the ingredients, including a pinch of salt, into a food processor.

ext.ext_cn: 一撮肉豆蔻
ext.ext_en: ...a pinch of nutmeg.

defs.def_en: A pinch of an ingredient such as salt is the amount of it that you can hold between your thumb and your first finger.  to take something with a pinch of salt→see: salt;

defs.def_cn: 偷取，偷盗（尤指不贵重的物品）

ext.ext_cn: 你还记得我偷你眼镜的事儿吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you remember when I pinched your glasses?

ext.ext_cn: 偷走他钱包的扒手
ext.ext_en: ...pickpockets who pinched his wallet.

defs.def_en: To pinch something, especially something of little value, means to steal it.

ext.ext_cn: 这张桌子可以很舒服地坐6个人，而且必要时多坐几个也不会挤。
ext.ext_en: Six people, and more at a pinch, could be seated comfortably at the table.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is possible at a pinch, or in American English if you say that something is possible in a pinch, you mean that it would be possible if it was necessary, but it might not be very comfortable or convenient.

defs.def_cn: 感到手头拮据；感到囊中羞涩

ext.ext_cn: 消费者支出在减少，商人感觉手头拮据。
ext.ext_en: Consumers are spending less and traders are feeling the pinch.

defs.def_en: If a person or company is feeling the pinch, they do not have as much money as they used to, and so they cannot buy the things they would like to buy.

ext.ext_cn: 身处困境时，我信任她。
ext.ext_en: I'd trust her in a pinch...

ext.ext_cn: 每个人都知道他境况艰难。
ext.ext_en: Everyone knew he was in a pinch.

defs.def_en: If you are in a pinch, you are in a difficult situation.
Old codger is a disrespectful way of referring to an old man.

ext.ext_cn: 在汽水厂工作的一个男子夺去了诺拉的童贞。
ext.ext_en: Nora was deflowered by a man who worked in a soda-water factory.

defs.def_en: When a woman is deflowered, she has sexual intercourse with a man for the first time.

ext.ext_cn: 它的价目表适合4个基本类别的顾客。
ext.ext_en: Its tariffs cater for four basic classifications of customer.

defs.def_en: See also:classify;A classification is a division or category in a system which divides things into groups or types.

defs.def_cn: 竖起大拇指(表示赞成或满意)

ext.ext_cn: 她查看了一下大厅，然后冲其他人竖了一下大拇指。
ext.ext_en: She checked the hall, then gave the others a thumbs-up sign.

defs.def_en: A thumbs-up or a thumbs-up sign is a sign that you make by raising your thumb to show that you agree with someone, that you are happy with an idea or situation, or that everything is all right.

ext.ext_cn: 金融市场已经接受了新政策。
ext.ext_en: The financial markets have given the thumbs up to the new policy...

ext.ext_cn: 它多多少少得到了每个人的支持。
ext.ext_en: It more or less gets the thumbs up from everyone.

defs.def_en: If you give a plan, idea, or suggestion the thumbs-up, you indicate that you approve of it and are willing to accept it.

ext.ext_cn: 要不是因为这一不幸变故，他可能永远都不会迫于无奈地开始流水线式创作小说养家糊口。
ext.ext_en: Were it not for this misfortune, he might never have been forced into the business of grinding out novels to support his family.

defs.def_en: To grind something out means to produce it in a boring or routine manner.

ext.ext_cn: 因为没有支付租金，她已经收到了市政会发给她的驱逐令。
ext.ext_en: She has received an eviction order from the council for non-payment of rent.

defs.def_en: Non-payment is a failure to pay a sum of money that you owe.

ext.ext_cn: 旧的留声机唱片
ext.ext_en: ...old phonograph records.

defs.def_en: A phonograph is a record player.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些蛋糕绵软可口。
ext.ext_en: These cakes are fudgy, gooey, and delicious.

ext.ext_cn: 松软香糯的一团
ext.ext_en: ...a lovely, gooey, sticky mess.

defs.def_en: If you describe a food or other substance as gooey, you mean that it is very soft and sticky.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 过于煽情的；黏腻缠绵的

ext.ext_cn: 我要给你写一封情意绵绵的长信。
ext.ext_en: I'm gonna write you a long, gooey letter...

ext.ext_cn: 女人们对他缠绵多情。
ext.ext_en: Women went gooey over him.

defs.def_en: Gooey is sometimes used to describe very foolish, exaggerated ways of expressing love or affection.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一些孩子比其他孩子更好斗。
ext.ext_en: Some children are much more aggressive than others...

ext.ext_cn: 这些鱼极具攻击性。
ext.ext_en: These fish are very aggressive...

defs.def_en: An aggressive person or animal has a quality of anger and determination that makes them ready to attack other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He is respected as a very aggressive and competitive executive...

ext.ext_cn: 赞比亚的这种运动比欧式足球要激烈得多。
ext.ext_en: The Zambian game is much more aggressive than European soccer.

defs.def_en: People who are aggressive in their work or other activities behave in a forceful way because they are very eager to succeed.

ext.ext_cn: 花卉市场
ext.ext_en: ...the flower mart.

defs.def_en: A mart is a place such as a market where things are bought and sold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 预知的；预见性的；能预见未来的

ext.ext_cn: 《天生赢家》，一部关于一位拥有数千万家财的平民党政治候选人的怪诞预言性喜剧
ext.ext_en: ...'Bob Roberts', an eerily prescient comedy about a populist multimillionaire political candidate.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something was prescient, you mean that they were able to know or predict what was going to happen in the future.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 枯燥的；乏味的；平淡无奇的

ext.ext_cn: 对于利息的急剧增加，他的导师给出了一个更为平淡无奇的解释。
ext.ext_en: His instructor offered a more prosaic explanation for the surge in interest...

ext.ext_cn: 真相更加乏味。
ext.ext_en: The truth is more prosaic.

defs.def_en: Something that is prosaic is dull and uninteresting.

defs.def_cn: 呼吸机; 生命维持设备

ext.ext_cn: 他处于昏迷中，靠呼吸机维持生命。
ext.ext_en: He is in a coma and on a life-support machine.

defs.def_en: A life-support machine is the equipment that is used to keep a person alive when they are very ill and cannot breathe without help.
A bulletin board is a board which is usually attached to a wall in order to display notices giving information about something.

defs.def_cn: 电子布告栏；电子公告系统

ext.ext_cn: 因特网是世界上最大的计算机公告系统。
ext.ext_en: The Internet is the largest computer bulletin board in the world.

defs.def_en: In computing, a bulletin board is a system that enables users to send and receive messages of general interest.
A building site is an area of land on which a building or a group of buildings is in the process of being built or altered.

ext.ext_cn: 海湾在阳光下闪闪发光。
ext.ext_en: The bay glittered in the sunshine...

ext.ext_cn: 宫殿灯光璀璨。
ext.ext_en: The Palace glittered with lights.

defs.def_en: If something glitters, light comes from or is reflected off different parts of it.

defs.def_cn: （激动、感兴趣等情感）闪现，流露

ext.ext_cn: 他眼里流露出一丝紧张和愉悦。
ext.ext_en: His eyes glittered with a tense amusement.

defs.def_en: If someone's eyes glitter, they are bright and express a particular emotion such as excitement or interest.

defs.def_cn: （粘在物体上作装饰用的）小发光物

ext.ext_cn: 用些圆形小金属片或发光小亮片装饰这件女式短上衣。
ext.ext_en: Decorate the tunic with sequins or glitter.

defs.def_en: Glitter consists of tiny shining pieces of metal. It is glued to things for decoration.

ext.ext_cn: 她被自己的生活中表面上的光鲜与奢华所蒙蔽。
ext.ext_en: She was blinded by the glitter and the glamour of her own life.

defs.def_en: You can use glitter to refer to superficial attractiveness or to the excitement connected with something.

defs.def_cn: (使)学习新技能;(使)进行再培训

ext.ext_cn: 我们得让工人学习新技能，以应对巨大的技术变革。
ext.ext_en: We needed to reskill our workforce to cope with massive technological change...

ext.ext_cn: 你必须乐于学习新技术。
ext.ext_en: You must be willing to reskill.

defs.def_en: If you reskill, or if someone reskills you, you learn new skills, so that you can do a different job or do your old job in a different way.

defs.def_cn: (屋外花园等处的)木质铺面（板）
defs.def_en: Decking is wooden boards that are fixed to the ground in a garden or other outdoor area for people to walk on.

ext.ext_cn: 几位当地官员因被控勾结黑手党而入狱。
ext.ext_en: Several local officials are in jail on charges of colluding with the Mafia...

ext.ext_cn: 我母亲和别人串通，把他杜撰成一个阔气的商人。
ext.ext_en: My mother colluded in the myth of him as the swanky businessman...

defs.def_en: If one person colludes with another, they co-operate with them secretly or illegally.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天他去给自己买了一辆崭新的小汽车。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday he went off to buy himself a brand-new car.

defs.def_en: A brand-new object is completely new.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 男孩张大了嘴巴。
ext.ext_en: The boy's jaw went slack.

defs.def_en: Something that is slack is loose and not firmly stretched or tightly in position.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 萧条的;清淡的;不景气的

ext.ext_cn: 商其工作量可以平均开来，不像商店那样有时很忙，有时很闲。
ext.ext_en: The workload can be evened out, instead of the shop having busy times and slack periods.

defs.def_en: A slack period is one in which there is not much work or activity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 许多出版商就是变得过于懈怠了。
ext.ext_en: Many publishers have simply become far too slack.

defs.def_en: Someone who is slack in their work does not do it properly.

ext.ext_cn: 他从未在哪个工头面前表现出丝毫懈怠。
ext.ext_en: He had never let a foreman see him slacking.

ext.ext_cn: 如果有人怠工，比尔就会严厉地加以斥责。
ext.ext_en: If someone slacks off, Bill comes down hard.

defs.def_en: If someone is slacking, they are not working as hard as they should.

defs.def_cn: 接手他人不再做的工作;补位提供

ext.ext_cn: 由于大型航空公司放弃了乘客较少的路线，一些较小的飞机正在加紧补位。
ext.ext_en: As major airlines give up less-traveled routes, smaller planes are picking up the slack.

defs.def_en: To take up the slack or pick up the slack means to do or provide something that another person or organization is no longer doing or providing.

defs.def_cn: 恢复，回复(到以前的状态、制度或行为)

ext.ext_cn: 杰克逊说她的老板情绪越来越低落，又开始拼命抽烟了。
ext.ext_en: Jackson said her boss became increasingly depressed and reverted to smoking heavily.

defs.def_en: When people or things revert to a previous state, system, or type of behaviour, they go back to it.

defs.def_cn: 回到，重提，重新考虑(某个话题)

ext.ext_cn: 在车里，她又提起了她最关心的话题。
ext.ext_en: In the car she reverted to the subject uppermost in her mind.

defs.def_en: When someone reverts to a previous topic, they start talking or thinking about it again.

ext.ext_cn: 这么多年后，她又开始讲威尼托方言，没有人能听懂她的话。
ext.ext_en: After all these years she had reverted to her Veneto dialect and nobody could understand what she was saying.

defs.def_en: If you revert to your usual language, you start using that language again.

ext.ext_cn: 租期结束后，该房产会归还给其终身所有者。
ext.ext_en: When the lease ends, the property reverts to the freeholder.

defs.def_en: If property, rights, or money revert to someone, they become that person's again after someone else has had them for a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 他坚持认为这次挫折并不意味着他已经回到原来的样子。
ext.ext_en: He was adamant that this setback does not mean he has reverted to type.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has reverted to type, you mean that they are now behaving as you would expect them to, after having behaved in an unexpected and better way.

ext.ext_cn: 到1973年，政府财政赤字相当于国民生产总值的30%。
ext.ext_en: By 1973 the government deficit equalled thirty per cent of GNP.

defs.def_en: In economics, a country's GNP is the total value of all the goods produced and services provided by that country in one year. GNP is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'gross national product'.
A fracas is a rough, noisy quarrel or fight.

ext.ext_cn: 我们最烦那些用汽车后备箱摆摊卖旧货的。
ext.ext_en: Our real bete noire is the car boot sale.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone or something as your bete noire, you mean that you have a particular dislike for them or that they annoy you a great deal.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 摊主是个野蛮凶狠的大块头，他一把抓住了戴的衣领。
ext.ext_en: The owner of the stall, a large, thuggish man, grabbed Dai by the collar.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as thuggish, you mean they behave in a violent, rough, or threatening way.

ext.ext_cn: 当别的孩子相互交流、一起玩耍的时候,泰德对他们不予理睬。
ext.ext_en: While the other children interacted and played together, Ted ignored them.

ext.ext_cn: 帮助父母与婴儿进行互动的童谣与歌曲
ext.ext_en: ...rhymes and songs to help parents interact with their babies.

defs.def_en: When people interact with each other or interact, they communicate as they work or spend time together.

defs.def_cn: (人与计算机或计算机与其他机器之间)交互作用，互动

ext.ext_cn: 数以百万计的人们想要新的简化方式实现人机交互。
ext.ext_en: Millions of people want new, simplified ways of interacting with a computer...

ext.ext_cn: 将会出现一个电话、电脑、电视互动的真正的地球村。
ext.ext_en: There will be a true global village in which telephones, computers and televisions interact.

defs.def_en: When people interact with computers, or when computers interact with other machines, information or instructions are exchanged.

ext.ext_cn: 你必须明白细胞是怎样相互作用的。
ext.ext_en: You have to understand how cells interact...

ext.ext_cn: 液体中的原子与形成颗粒的矿物质相互作用。
ext.ext_en: Atoms within the fluid interact with the minerals that form the grains.

defs.def_en: When one thing interacts with another or two things interact, the two things affect each other's behaviour or condition.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 简洁有力的；言简意赅的

ext.ext_cn: 想要听起来很自信，使用简短有力的句子不失为一个好方法。
ext.ext_en: A good way to sound confident is to use short punchy sentences.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as punchy, you mean that it expresses its meaning in a forceful or effective way.

defs.def_cn: （电视、广播等）纪实节目;纪录片

ext.ext_cn: 探讨无家可归问题的电视纪录片
ext.ext_en: ...a TV documentary on homelessness.

defs.def_en: A documentary is a television or radio programme, or a film, which shows real events or provides information about a particular subject.

defs.def_cn: （证据）有文件记录的，来源于文件的，书面的

ext.ext_cn: 我们有书面证据证明他们正在策划军事行动。
ext.ext_en: We have documentary evidence that they were planning military action.

defs.def_en: Documentary evidence consists of things that are written down.
A semi-skilled worker has some training and skills, but not enough to do specialized work.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 没人知道如何治疗这种可怕的疾病。
ext.ext_en: No one knew how to treat this dreaded disease.

defs.def_en: Dreaded means terrible and greatly feared.

defs.def_cn: 令人恼火的;不方便的;不想要的

ext.ext_cn: 她患上了花粉热这种讨厌的病症。
ext.ext_en: She's a victim of the dreaded hay fever...

ext.ext_cn: 最后一天，队里的指示就是不惜一切代价实现零的突破。
ext.ext_en: Team orders on the final day were to avoid the dreaded blank at all costs.

defs.def_en: You can use the dreaded to describe something that you, or a particular group of people, find annoying, inconvenient, or undesirable.

ext.ext_cn: 在更多人质获得自由之前他们期望看到对方也有相应的表示。
ext.ext_en: They expected a reciprocal gesture before more hostages could be freed...

ext.ext_cn: 该部门称许多国家和英国签订了医疗卫生互惠协议。
ext.ext_en: The department said many countries had reciprocal agreements for health care with Britain.

defs.def_en: A reciprocal action or agreement involves two people or groups who do the same thing to each other or agree to help each another in a similar way.

ext.ext_cn: 一年后我的狗死了。
ext.ext_en: A year later my dog died...

ext.ext_cn: 非常不幸的是，他和我母亲都死于癌症。
ext.ext_en: Sadly, both he and my mother died of cancer...

defs.def_en: When people, animals, and plants die, they stop living.  →see usage note at:dead

ext.ext_cn: 那些榆树全都奄奄一息了。
ext.ext_en: The elm trees are all dying...

ext.ext_cn: 每天上班我都要医治那些因吸烟患上肺病的垂危患者。
ext.ext_en: Every working day I treat people who are dying from lung diseases caused by smoking.

defs.def_en: If a person, animal, or plant is dying, they are so ill or so badly injured that they will not live very much longer.

ext.ext_cn: 他无助地看着母亲痛苦地死去。
ext.ext_en: He watched helplessly as his mother died an agonizing death...

ext.ext_cn: 我不是什么专家，但我不认为特蕾西是自然死亡。
ext.ext_en: I'm no expert, but I don't think Tracy died a natural death.

defs.def_en: If someone dies a violent, unnatural, or painful death, they die in a violent, unnatural, or painful way.

ext.ext_cn: 然后，发动机突然咔咔地响着，发出一阵噼啪声，接着就彻底熄火了。
ext.ext_en: Then suddenly, the engine coughed, spluttered and died.

defs.def_en: If a machine or device dies, it stops completely, especially after a period of working more and more slowly or inefficiently.

ext.ext_cn: 她的香烟燃起一阵亮光，然后就熄灭了。
ext.ext_en: Her cigarette glowed brightly, then died.

defs.def_en: If a fire or light dies, it stops burning or shining.

ext.ext_cn: 我对你的爱永不止息。
ext.ext_en: My love for you will never die...

ext.ext_cn: 凯瑟琳低头看向地板，笑容从她的嘴角消失了。
ext.ext_en: Kathryn looked down at the floor and the smile died on her lips.

defs.def_en: If an emotion or facial expression dies, it disappears completely, usually after a period of gradually becoming weaker and less noticeable.

defs.def_cn: (渴、饿、闷或好奇)得要命;…得要死

ext.ext_cn: 给我来一壶茶，我快要渴死了。
ext.ext_en: Order me a pot of tea, I'm dying of thirst.

defs.def_en: You can say that you are dying of thirst, hunger, boredom, or curiosity to emphasize that you are very thirsty, hungry, bored, or curious.

ext.ext_cn: 我非常渴望能呼吸到新鲜空气。
ext.ext_en: I'm dying for a breath of fresh air...

ext.ext_cn: 她很想同弗兰克谈谈。
ext.ext_en: She was dying to talk to Frank.

defs.def_en: You can say that you are dying for something or are dying to do something to emphasize that you very much want to have it or do it.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调震惊、不安、窘迫或好笑等)我差点要死/（如果发生某事）我会死的

ext.ext_cn: 得知自己到了哪里时，我简直要晕过去了。
ext.ext_en: I nearly died when I learned where I was ending up...

ext.ext_cn: 我羞愧难当。
ext.ext_en: I nearly died of shame...

defs.def_en: You can use die in expressions such as 'I almost died' or 'I'd die if anything happened' where you are emphasizing your feelings about a situation, for example to say that it is very shocking, upsetting, embarrassing, or amusing.
A die is a specially shaped or patterned block of metal which is used to press or cut other metal into a particular shape.

ext.ext_cn: 现在为时已晚，来不及回头。事情已成定局了。
ext.ext_en: It was too late and too urgent to turn back. The die was cast.

defs.def_en: You can say that the die is cast to draw attention to the importance of an event or decision which is going to affect your future and which cannot be changed or avoided.

defs.def_cn: (习惯或观念)难以改掉，很难摆脱

ext.ext_cn: 积习难改。
ext.ext_en: Old habits die hard...

ext.ext_cn: 这些偏见很难消除。
ext.ext_en: Such prejudices die hard.

defs.def_en: If you say that habits or attitudes die hard, you mean that they take a very long time to disappear or change, so that it may not be possible to get rid of them completely.

ext.ext_cn: 最可能的结果是将大量的工作分包出去。
ext.ext_en: The most likely outcome may be to subcontract much of the work to an outsider.

defs.def_en: An outsider is someone who does not belong to a particular group or organization.

defs.def_cn: （不为某一团体所接受或感觉不属其中的）外人

ext.ext_cn: 马隆是个警察，他跟他们一样都觉得自己像个外人。
ext.ext_en: Malone, a cop, felt as much an outsider as any of them.

defs.def_en: An outsider is someone who is not accepted by a particular group, or who feels that they do not belong in it.

defs.def_cn: （在竞赛中）不大可能获胜的人（或队伍）

ext.ext_cn: 在新一任联合国秘书长的角逐中，他的胜算很小。
ext.ext_en: He was an outsider in the race to be the new UN Secretary-General.

defs.def_en: In a competition, an outsider is a competitor who is unlikely to win.

defs.def_cn: 人，人们（通常用作person的复数）

ext.ext_cn: 数百万人流离失所。
ext.ext_en: Millions of people have lost their homes.

ext.ext_cn: 安哥拉人
ext.ext_en: ...the people of Angola.

defs.def_en: People are men, women, and children. People is normally used as the plural of person, instead of 'persons'.

defs.def_cn: （与政府或上流社会相对的）人民，民众，大众

ext.ext_cn: 人民的意愿
ext.ext_en: ...the will of the people.

ext.ext_cn: 民众和领导层之间的巨大裂痕
ext.ext_en: ...a tremendous rift between the people and their leadership.

defs.def_en: The people is sometimes used to refer to ordinary men and women, in contrast to the government or the upper classes.

ext.ext_cn: 中南美洲的土著民族
ext.ext_en: ...the native peoples of Central and South America...

ext.ext_cn: 这是美国人民的胜利。
ext.ext_en: It's a triumph for the American people.

defs.def_en: A people is all the men, women, and children of a particular country or race.

ext.ext_cn: 那里住着一个与世隔绝的种族，人们都是爱好和平的佛教徒。
ext.ext_en: It was peopled by a fiercely independent race of peace-loving Buddhists.

ext.ext_cn: 普通工人和家庭居住的小镇
ext.ext_en: ...a small town peopled by lay workers and families.

defs.def_en: If a place or country is peopled by a particular group of people, that group of people live there.

defs.def_cn: （某种类型的人）出现，存在，充斥于（故事或历史时期）

ext.ext_cn: 格拉斯的小说里都是些稀奇古怪的人物。
ext.ext_en: Grass's novels are peopled with outlandish characters...

ext.ext_cn: 19世纪英国史上积极改革者层出不穷。
ext.ext_en: British history of the 19th century is peopled by energetic reformers...

defs.def_en: If something such as a story or a time in history is peopled with people of a particular kind, those people occur or exist in it.

ext.ext_cn: 她在研究生院攻读社会福利工作学硕士学位。
ext.ext_en: She was in graduate school, studying for a master's degree in social work.

defs.def_en: In the United States, a graduate school is a department in a university or college where postgraduate students are taught.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 虫蛀的豹皮夹克
ext.ext_en: ...a moth-eaten leopardskin jacket.

defs.def_en: Moth-eaten clothes look very old and have holes in them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们驾车穿过有些破旧的鹿苑。
ext.ext_en: We drove through a somewhat moth-eaten deer park...

ext.ext_cn: 这种策略愈来愈显得老套。
ext.ext_en: This strategy looks increasingly moth-eaten.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as moth-eaten, you mean that it seems unattractive or useless because it is old or has been used too much.

defs.def_cn: 很快弄到，匆匆准备好(食物或饮料)

ext.ext_cn: 让我们看看有没有人能很快弄到一杯咖啡。
ext.ext_en: Let's see if somebody can rustle up a cup of coffee...

ext.ext_cn: 转眼之间就能准备好很多营养可口的饭菜。
ext.ext_en: Many tasty and nutritious meals can be rustled up in next to no time.

defs.def_en: If you rustle up something to eat or drink, you make or prepare it quickly, with very little planning.

ext.ext_cn: 他很快想办法弄到了几张毯子。
ext.ext_en: He managed to rustle up a couple of blankets...

ext.ext_cn: 他很快便邀请到35个朋友和同事参加他的婚礼。
ext.ext_en: He has had no trouble rustling up 35 friends and colleagues to invite to his wedding.

defs.def_en: If you rustle something up, you provide or obtain it quickly, with very little planning.

ext.ext_cn: 主流媒体上的辩论是英国式虚伪的典型例子。
ext.ext_en: The debate in the mainstream press has been a classic example of British hypocrisy...

ext.ext_cn: 他的头两粒进球是站位和时机把握的典范。
ext.ext_en: His first two goals were classic cases of being in the right place at the right time.

defs.def_en: A classic example of a thing or situation has all the features which you expect such a thing or situation to have.

defs.def_cn: (电影、著作、音乐)经典的，典范的，最优秀的

ext.ext_cn: 经典儿童电影《哈克贝利·费恩历险记》
ext.ext_en: ...the classic children's film Huckleberry Finn.

ext.ext_cn: 对美国刑罚制度研究的典范
ext.ext_en: ...a classic study of the American penal system.

defs.def_en: A classic film, piece of writing, or piece of music is of very high quality and has become a standard against which similar things are judged.

ext.ext_cn: 随着年龄渐长，我喜欢经常重读经典著作。
ext.ext_en: As I grow older, I like to reread the classics regularly.

defs.def_en: A classic is a book which is well-known and considered to be of a high literary standard. You can refer to such books generally as the classics .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 穿些舒适而又好看的传统服装。
ext.ext_en: Wear classic clothes which feel good and look good...

ext.ext_cn: 这是些百搭的古雅图案。
ext.ext_en: These are classic designs which will fit in well anywhere.

defs.def_en: Classic style is simple and traditional and is not affected by changes in fashion.

A classic car is a model of car that is greatly admired because of its style, and is considered to be one of the best of its kind; used especially to talk about cars which are no longer being produced.

defs.def_cn: (尤指对古希腊、古罗马的语言、文学、哲学的)古典文化研究

ext.ext_cn: 古典文化研究学位
ext.ext_en: ...a Classics degree.

defs.def_en: Classics is the study of the ancient Greek and Roman civilizations, especially their languages, literature, and philosophy.

defs.def_cn: （学校的）男舍监，男性宿管老师
defs.def_en: A housemaster is a male teacher who is in charge of one of the houses in a school.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (通常指年轻人)易受影响的,无主见的,无判断力的

ext.ext_cn: 该法律意图保护那些年轻且无判断力的电视观众。
ext.ext_en: The law is intended to protect young and impressionable viewers.

ext.ext_cn: 7 岁,明显是一个最易受人影响的年龄
ext.ext_en: ...seven years old, which is apparently the age at which you are most impressionable.

defs.def_en: Someone who is impressionable, usually a young person, is not very critical and is therefore easy to influence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们喜欢五星级的宾馆和毕恭毕敬的接待。
ext.ext_en: They like five-star hotels and deferential treatment.

ext.ext_cn: 亚洲妇女要对男人顺从和恭敬的传统要求
ext.ext_en: ...the traditional requirement for Asian women to be submissive and deferential to men.

defs.def_en: Someone who is deferential is polite and respectful towards someone else.
School lunches are midday meals provided for children at a school.
A steamroller is a large, heavy vehicle with wide, solid metal wheels, which is used to make the surface of a road flat. In the past steamrollers were powered by steam.

ext.ext_cn: 他们可以直接镇压所有反抗。
ext.ext_en: They could simply steamroller all opposition.

ext.ext_cn: 首相试图迫使将军接受他不愿意接受的职位
ext.ext_en: ...the Prime Minister's attempt to steamroller the general into a job he did not want.

defs.def_en: If you steamroller someone who disagrees with you or opposes you, you defeat them or you force them to do what you want by using your power or by putting a lot of pressure on them.
A bird-watcher is a person whose hobby is watching and studying wild birds in their natural surroundings.

ext.ext_cn: 较重的货物可用驳船运到上游。
ext.ext_en: Heavy goods could be brought up-river in barges...

ext.ext_cn: 他在那里有一栋房子，但在河上游几英里处。
ext.ext_en: He has a house down there but it's miles up river...

defs.def_en: Something that is moving up-river is moving towards the source of a river, from a point down the river. Something that is up-river is towards the source of a river.

defs.def_cn: (动植物的)自然色彩，自然花纹

ext.ext_cn: 黄色或红色植物
ext.ext_en: ...plants with yellow or red coloration.

defs.def_en: The coloration of an animal or a plant is the colours and patterns on it.

defs.def_cn: 劳工行动(如怠工、罢工等)

ext.ext_cn: 狱警们已决定举行罢工。
ext.ext_en: Prison officers have decided to take industrial action.

defs.def_en: If workers take industrial action, they join together and do something to show that they are unhappy with their pay or working conditions, for example refusing to work.

ext.ext_cn: 他到伦敦小画廊兜售自己的画作，结果碰了一鼻子灰。
ext.ext_en: His attempts to peddle his paintings around London's tiny gallery scene proved unsuccessful.

defs.def_en: Someone who peddles things goes from place to place trying to sell them.

ext.ext_cn: 一个毒贩给杰克100美元让他贩卖毒品时，这个洛杉矶少年拒绝了。
ext.ext_en: When a drug pusher offered the Los Angeles youngster $100 to peddle drugs, Jack refused.

defs.def_en: Someone who peddles drugs sells illegal drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 他们甚至设立了自己的通讯社来宣扬反孤立主义。
ext.ext_en: They even set up their own news agency to peddle anti-isolationist propaganda.

defs.def_en: If someone peddles an idea or a piece of information, they try very hard to get people to accept it.
Springtime is the period of time during which spring lasts.

ext.ext_cn: 兼作库存和销售控制系统的售货点销售系统
ext.ext_en: ...a POS system that doubles as a stock and sales control system.

defs.def_en: The POS is the place in a shop where a product is passed from the seller to the customer. POS is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'point of sale'.
A washer is a thin flat ring of metal or rubber which is placed over a bolt before the nut is screwed on.
A washer is the same as a washing machine .

ext.ext_cn: 据说在那些被捕的人员中有两人自称是地区指挥官。
ext.ext_en: Two of those arrested are said to be self-styled area commanders...

ext.ext_cn: 他强烈批评那些无视莎士比亚的自诩为教育专家的人。
ext.ext_en: He fiercely criticised self-styled educational experts for ignoring Shakespeare.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a self-styled leader or expert, you disapprove of them because they claim to be a leader or expert but they do not actually have the right to call themselves this.

defs.def_cn: 典型德国人的;日耳曼人所独具的

ext.ext_cn: 汗水顺着她那张典型的德国人的脸往下淌。
ext.ext_en: There was sweat pouring over her Teutonic face...

ext.ext_cn: 这种长途汽车是体现德国工程设计水平的杰作。
ext.ext_en: The coach was a masterpiece of Teutonic engineering.

defs.def_en: Teutonic means typical of or relating to German people.

ext.ext_cn: 卢旺达下周将与周边国家的领导人举行会谈。
ext.ext_en: Rwanda is to hold talks with leaders of neighbouring countries next week.

ext.ext_cn: 宾馆里的精品店和附近的商店
ext.ext_en: ...the hotel's boutique and neighboring shops.

defs.def_en: Neighbouring places or things are near other things of the same kind.

ext.ext_cn: 丹麦队获胜进入了决赛。
ext.ext_en: A win for the Danes put them in the finals.

defs.def_en: A Dane is a person who comes from Denmark.

ext.ext_cn: 二月一个寒冷的早晨
ext.ext_en: ...one cold February morn.

defs.def_en: Morn means the same as morning.

ext.ext_cn: 这项从欧洲战场抽身退出的政策遭到了非议。
ext.ext_en: This policy of disengagement from the European war had its critics.

defs.def_en: Disengagement is a process by which people gradually stop being involved in a conflict, activity, or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 他在上周末的会议上出了洋相，狼狈不堪。
ext.ext_en: He made an embarrassing gaffe at the convention last weekend.

ext.ext_cn: 高层人士在社交场合的一些失态行为
ext.ext_en: ...social gaffes committed by high-ranking individuals.

defs.def_en: A gaffe is  a stupid or careless mistake, for example when you say or do something that offends or upsets people.
If you blow the gaffe or blow the gaff, you tell someone something that other people wanted you to keep secret.

ext.ext_cn: 他用微型声波发射器开启了门。
ext.ext_en: He activated the door with the miniature sonic transmitter.

defs.def_en: Sonic is used to describe things related to sound.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 现在你的权力超过了多年以来任何时候。
ext.ext_en: Right now you're in a more commanding position than you have been for ages...

ext.ext_cn: 法国舰艇遥遥领先。
ext.ext_en: The French vessel has a commanding lead.

defs.def_en: If you are in a commanding position or situation, you are in a strong or powerful position or situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 洛维特是个威严的高个男人，蓄着灰白的八字胡。
ext.ext_en: Lovett was a tall, commanding man with a waxed gray mustache...

ext.ext_cn: 电话另一端传来庄重而威严的声音。
ext.ext_en: The voice  at the other end of the line was serious and commanding.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as commanding, you mean that they are powerful and confident.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 居高临下的;视野开阔的

ext.ext_cn: 城堡很大，加上其居高临下的位置，至今仍让参观者赞叹不已。
ext.ext_en: The size of the castle and its commanding position still impress the visitor today...

ext.ext_cn: 还有其他的房子能像这幢一样俯瞰首都吗？
ext.ext_en: What other home offers such a commanding view of the capital?

defs.def_en: If a building has a commanding position, it is high up and has good views of the surrounding area.

ext.ext_cn: 他们当前的抗议完全是受一己之利驱使的。
ext.ext_en: Their current protests are motivated purely by self-interest.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of self-interest, you disapprove of them because they always want to do what is best for themselves rather than for anyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 一个逃学的无忧无虑的男孩所遭遇的不幸
ext.ext_en: ...the misadventures of a happy-go-lucky boy who plays hooky from school.

defs.def_en: If a child plays hooky, they stay away from school without permission.

defs.def_cn: （尤指专业或实用的）技巧，技能

ext.ext_cn: 他没有经营农场的专业知识。
ext.ext_en: He hasn't got the know-how to run a farm.

ext.ext_cn: 专业技术知识
ext.ext_en: ...technical know-how.

defs.def_en: Know-how is knowledge of the methods or techniques of doing something, especially something technical or practical.

ext.ext_cn: 一位医院的管理人员辞职了，因为有人指责他为了得到这份工作而撒了谎。
ext.ext_en: A hospital administrator has resigned over claims he lied to get the job...

ext.ext_cn: 罗布先生上个月辞职了。
ext.ext_en: Mr Robb resigned his position last month.

defs.def_en: If you resign from a job or position, you formally announce that you are leaving it.

defs.def_cn: 屈从;顺从;安于;勉强接受

ext.ext_cn: 我和帕特在没有船的情况下勉强又凑合了一个夏天。
ext.ext_en: Pat and I resigned ourselves to yet another summer without a boat...

ext.ext_cn: 他只好将就着在电视上看欧洲锦标赛。
ext.ext_en: He had resigned himself to watching the European Championships on television.

defs.def_en: If you resign yourself to an unpleasant situation or fact, you accept it because you realize that you cannot change it.
USN is an abbreviation for (缩略=) United States Navy .

defs.def_cn: 侵入住宅者;入室行窃者
defs.def_en: A housebreaker is someone who enters another person's house by force, for example by breaking the locks or windows, in order to steal their possessions.

ext.ext_cn: 加一满勺盐。
ext.ext_en: Add one heaped tablespoon of salt.

defs.def_en: A heaped spoonful has the contents of the spoon piled up above the edge.

ext.ext_cn: 大书桌上堆满了文件。
ext.ext_en: The large desk was heaped with papers.

ext.ext_cn: 堆满了烟头的烟灰缸
ext.ext_en: ...ashtrays heaped with cigarette butts.

defs.def_en: A container or a surface that is heaped with things has a lot of them in it or on it in a pile, often so many that it cannot hold any more.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他意识到他们国家的货币在这个国家一文不值。
ext.ext_en: He realised that their money was useless in this country...

ext.ext_cn: 没有编软件的人，计算机就会毫无价值。
ext.ext_en: Computers would be useless without software writers.

defs.def_en: If something is useless, you cannot use it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无益的；无效的；不能收到效果的

ext.ext_cn: 她知道抗议是没有意义的。
ext.ext_en: She knew it was useless to protest.

ext.ext_cn: 无法制止贩毒活动的无效惩罚
ext.ext_en: ...a useless punishment which fails to stop drug trafficking.

defs.def_en: If something is useless, it does not achieve anything helpful or good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们的教育体制真差劲。
ext.ext_en: Their education system is useless...

ext.ext_cn: 任何球类运动他都玩不好。
ext.ext_en: He was useless at any game with a ball.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is useless, you mean that they are no good at all.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她整天坐在家里，看着电视，觉得自己一无是处。
ext.ext_en: She sits at home all day, watching TV and feeling useless.

defs.def_en: If someone feels useless, they feel bad because they are unable to help someone or achieve anything.

defs.def_cn: （对法官、主教和男性贵族的尊称）阁下，大人

ext.ext_cn: 尊敬的阁下，我叫理查德·萨维奇。
ext.ext_en: My name is Richard Savage, your Lordship...

ext.ext_cn: 大人表达了他的愿望，希望法律委员会研究一下这一问题。
ext.ext_en: His Lordship expressed the hope that the Law Commission might look at the subject.

defs.def_en: You use the expressions Your Lordship ,His Lordship, or Their Lordships when you are addressing or referring to a judge, bishop, or male member of the nobility.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 常生病的;虚弱的;健康欠佳的

ext.ext_cn: 他曾是个体弱多病的孩子。
ext.ext_en: He had been a sickly child.

defs.def_en: A sickly person or animal is weak, unhealthy, and often ill.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (通常指因为太甜而)让人恶心的，令人作呕的

ext.ext_cn: 朗姆酒甜得发腻的气味
ext.ext_en: ...the sickly smell of rum.

defs.def_en: A sickly smell or taste is unpleasant and makes you feel slightly sick, often because it is extremely sweet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (颜色、灯光等)暗淡的，苍白的，微弱的

ext.ext_cn: 给孩子们用的墙纸往往颜色苍白暗淡。
ext.ext_en: Wallpapers for children too often come only in sickly pastel shades.

defs.def_en: A sickly colour or light is unpleasantly pale or weak.

ext.ext_cn: 我们兴高采烈地聊起了在他农场度过的那段往昔时光。
ext.ext_en: We had a delightful time talking about the olden days on his farm.

ext.ext_cn: 画得很美的旧时铁路
ext.ext_en: ...the nicely painted railways of olden times.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a period in the past as the olden days, you feel affection for it.
Inside a car, the rear-view mirror is the mirror that enables you to see the traffic behind when you are driving.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人信服的;使人心悦诚服的;有说服力的

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们说，并没有确凿的证据表明输电线和癌症之间有什么联系。
ext.ext_en: Scientists say there is no convincing evidence that power lines have anything to do with cancer...

ext.ext_cn: 他的话听起来很有说服力。
ext.ext_en: He sounded very convincing.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as convincing, you mean that they make you believe that a particular thing is true, correct, or genuine.

ext.ext_cn: 来自乍得的报告显示叛军正向首都推进。
ext.ext_en: Reports from Chad suggest that rebel forces are advancing on the capital...

ext.ext_cn: 水位正以每天5厘米的速度上升。
ext.ext_en: The water is advancing at a rate of 5cm a day...

defs.def_en: To advance means to move forward, often in order to attack someone.

ext.ext_cn: 医学技术突飞猛进。
ext.ext_en: Medical technology has advanced considerably...

ext.ext_cn: 日本已从封建农业社会发展成一个城市化工业强国。
ext.ext_en: Japan has advanced from a rural, feudal society to an urban, industrial power.

defs.def_en: See also:advanced;To advance means to make progress, especially in your knowledge of something.

ext.ext_cn: 我先借给他一些钱，在我们回家的路上他会还给我的。
ext.ext_en: I advanced him some money, which he would repay on our way home...

ext.ext_cn: 银行预支12亿美元帮助该国偿还债务。
ext.ext_en: The bank advanced $1.2 billion to help the country with debt repayments.

defs.def_en: If you advance someone a sum of money, you lend it to them, or pay it to them earlier than arranged.

ext.ext_cn: 她接下来的两部小说得到了10万英镑的预付稿费。
ext.ext_en: She was paid a £100,000 advance for her next two novels.

defs.def_en: An advance is money which is lent or paid to someone before they would normally receive it.

defs.def_cn: 提前（未来事件的日期）；使（未来事件）提前发生

ext.ext_cn: 饮食中摄入过量蛋白质可能会加速衰老。
ext.ext_en: Too much protein in the diet may advance the ageing process...

ext.ext_cn: 该国的选举委员会将议会选举日期提前了3天。
ext.ext_en: The country's election commission has advanced the date of parliamentary elections by three days.

defs.def_en: To advance an event, or the time or date of an event, means to bring it forward to an earlier time or date.

defs.def_cn: 促进，推动（事业、利益或主张）；使加速

ext.ext_cn: 奥利弗在不搞自己的艺术创作时，就会忙着帮助别人完成作品。
ext.ext_en: When not producing art of his own, Oliver was busy advancing the work of others.

defs.def_en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help to make it successful.

ext.ext_cn: 就一些女性患抑郁症的原因，各种说法纷至沓来。
ext.ext_en: Many theories have been advanced as to why some women suffer from depression...

ext.ext_cn: 生物学家鲁珀特·谢尔德雷克已提出了一整套重要的观点。
ext.ext_en: An important set of ideas have been advanced by the biologist Rupert Sheldrake.

defs.def_en: When a theory or argument is advanced, it is put forward for discussion.

defs.def_cn: （常指军事行动中的）前进，行进，推进

ext.ext_cn: 向敌方阵地推进
ext.ext_en: ...an advance on enemy positions...

ext.ext_cn: 这些防御工事用于阻止坦克等车辆前进。
ext.ext_en: The defences are intended to obstruct any advance by tanks and other vehicles.

defs.def_en: An advance is a forward movement of people or vehicles, usually as part of a military operation.

ext.ext_cn: 马克追她已经有一段时间了。
ext.ext_en: Mark had for some time been making advances towards her...

ext.ext_cn: 在去往戛纳的途中，她拒绝了他的挑逗。
ext.ext_en: She rejected his advances during the trip to Cannes.

defs.def_en: If you make advances to someone, you try to start a sexual relationship with them.

ext.ext_cn: 航空安全自从20世纪70年代得到显著提高之后，至今再没有任何改善。
ext.ext_en: Air safety has not improved since the dramatic advances of the 1970s...

ext.ext_cn: 子女在学业上有所进步，他们在工作上也就会有所起色。
ext.ext_en: Their progress at work was mirrored by their children's educational advance.

defs.def_en: An advance in a particular subject or activity is progress in understanding it or in doing it well.

ext.ext_cn: 这样可能会改善当前状况。
ext.ext_en: This could be an advance on the present situation.

defs.def_en: If something is an advance on what was previously available or done, it is better in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 他们一般不会预先通知检查哪座大楼。
ext.ext_en: They don't normally give any advance notice about which building they're going to inspect...

ext.ext_cn: 关于该事件事先几乎没有报道。
ext.ext_en: The event received little advance publicity.

defs.def_en: Advance booking, notice, or warning is done or given before an event happens.

ext.ext_cn: 作为联合国救援行动的一部分，在这支由20多人组成的先头部队之后还将增派600名士兵。
ext.ext_en: The 20-strong advance party will be followed by another 600 soldiers as part of UN relief efforts.

defs.def_en: An advance party or group is a small group of people who go on ahead of the main group.

ext.ext_cn: 我已请每个人在会议之前提交问题。
ext.ext_en: I had asked everyone to submit questions in advance of the meeting.

defs.def_en: If one thing happens or is done in advance of another, it happens or is done before the other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 会谈的主题已提前一周宣布。
ext.ext_en: The subject of the talk is announced a week in advance.

defs.def_en: If you do something in advance, you do it before a particular date or event.

ext.ext_cn: 他慢慢往前开，发动机低速运转。
ext.ext_en: Very slowly he moved forward, the engine ticking over.

defs.def_en: If an engine is ticking over, it is running at a low speed or rate, for example when it is switched on but you are not actually using it.

defs.def_cn: (人、系统、业务)慢吞吞地工作，进展缓慢

ext.ext_cn: 至少市场还在缓慢发展。
ext.ext_en: The market is at least ticking over...

ext.ext_cn: 这使你进展缓慢，得意不起来。
ext.ext_en: It keeps you ticking over, stops you being complacent.

defs.def_en: If a person, system, or business is ticking over, they are working steadily, but not producing very much or making much progress.
A gerund is a noun formed from a verb which refers to an action, process, or state. In English, gerunds end in '-ing', for example 'running' and 'thinking'.

ext.ext_cn: 我教过六年级学生并监考。
ext.ext_en: I've taught sixth formers and invigilated exams.

defs.def_en: Someone who invigilates an examination supervises the people who are taking it in order to ensure that it starts and finishes at the correct time, and that there is no cheating.
A defector is someone who leaves their country, political party, or other group, and joins an opposing country, party, or group.

ext.ext_cn: 他在航运事业的巅峰时期拥有将近60艘远洋轮船。
ext.ext_en: At the height of his shipping career he owned about 60 ocean-going vessels.

defs.def_en: Ocean-going ships are designed for travelling on the sea rather than on rivers, canals, or lakes.

ext.ext_cn: 奇怪的祈祷与咒语
ext.ext_en: ...strange prayers and incantations.

defs.def_en: An incantation is a series of words that a person says or sings as a magic spell.

ext.ext_en: In a few years we may no longer have a monarchy.

ext.ext_cn: 关于君主政体前途的严肃辩论
ext.ext_en: ...a serious debate on the future of the monarchy.

defs.def_en: A monarchy is a system in which a country has a monarch.
A monarchy is a country that has a monarch.

ext.ext_cn: 皇室成员不得不在公众生活和私生活之间建立起一种平衡。
ext.ext_en: The monarchy has to create a balance between its public and private lives.

defs.def_en: The monarchy is used to refer to the monarch and his or her family.

ext.ext_cn: 行政官员将候选名单筛减至3人。
ext.ext_en: Administration officials have winnowed the list of candidates to three.

defs.def_en: If you winnow a group of things or people, you reduce its size by separating the ones that are useful or relevant from the ones that are not.

ext.ext_cn: 马路对面18世纪的教堂
ext.ext_en: ...the eighteenth-century kirk across the road.

defs.def_en: A kirk is a church.

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰教会的牧师们
ext.ext_en: ...ministers of the Kirk.

defs.def_en: The Kirk is the Church of Scotland, the main Protestant church in Scotland.

defs.def_cn: (供演职人员使用的)剧场后门（或边门）
defs.def_en: The stage door of a theatre is the entrance used by actors and actresses and by employees of the theatre.

ext.ext_cn: 这里似乎到处都是女性主管。
ext.ext_en: The place appears to be bursting with women directors.

ext.ext_cn: 种满了蔬菜的梯田形菜园
ext.ext_en: ...a terraced vegetable garden, bursting with produce.

defs.def_en: If a place is bursting with people or things, it is full of them.

ext.ext_cn: 我充满了好奇。
ext.ext_en: I was bursting with curiosity.

ext.ext_cn: 充满了活力和生气的角色
ext.ext_en: ...a character bursting with energy and vivacity.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is bursting with a feeling or quality, you mean that they have a great deal of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她急于告诉每个人。
ext.ext_en: She was bursting to tell everyone...

ext.ext_cn: 我们将去那里，渴望献出我们的一切。
ext.ext_en: We'll go there bursting to give it our all.

defs.def_en: If you are bursting to do something, you are very eager to do it.
If someone says they are bursting, they are emphasizing that they need to urinate very soon.

ext.ext_cn: 据说帐篷的缝合处快炸线了。
ext.ext_en: The camps are said to be bursting at the seams...

ext.ext_cn: 房间快要挤爆了。
ext.ext_en: The room was full to bursting.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place is bursting at the seams or full to bursting, you are emphasizing that it is very full indeed.
A widower is a man whose wife has died and who has not married again.
Thyme is a type of herb used in cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 这份报告建立在谣言、臆断和含沙射影的基础之上。
ext.ext_en: The report was based on rumours, speculation, and innuendo.

ext.ext_cn: 充满性暗示的杂志
ext.ext_en: ...magazines which are full of sexual innuendo.

defs.def_en: Innuendo is indirect reference to something rude or unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第11个字母
defs.def_en: K is the eleventh letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_cn: （用于首字母为k的一些单词的缩写，如kilometre，kilobyte和king）
defs.def_en: K or k is used as an abbreviation for words beginning with k, such as 'kilometre', 'kilobyte', or 'king'.

ext.ext_cn: 我过去挣4万多。
ext.ext_en: I used to make over 40k.

defs.def_en: K or k is sometimes used to represent the number 1000, especially when referring to sums of money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 任性的；故意作对的；无理取闹的

ext.ext_cn: 阻止这种健康发展的趋势是没有道理的。
ext.ext_en: It would be perverse to stop this healthy trend...

ext.ext_en: Psychotherapists often take a perverse delight in criticizing other psychotherapists...

defs.def_en: Someone who is perverse deliberately does things that are unreasonable or that result in harm for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 他得把门砸烂。
ext.ext_en: He would have to batter the door down...

ext.ext_cn: 他们用卡车撞破使馆的大门。
ext.ext_en: They used lorries to batter down embassy gates.

defs.def_en: If you batter a door down, you hit it so hard that it falls to pieces.

ext.ext_cn: 那些大吵大闹的顾客得到了退款。
ext.ext_en: Those customers who have kicked up a fuss have received refunds...

ext.ext_cn: 他们吵了起来并互相朝对方扔东西。
ext.ext_en: They kick up a rumpus and throw things at each other.

defs.def_en: If you kick up a fuss about something, you make it very obvious that you are annoyed or dissatisfied.

ext.ext_en: She shuffled along, kicking up clouds of dust.

defs.def_en: If you kick up dust or dirt, you create a cloud of dust or dirt as you move along a dusty road.

ext.ext_cn: 他的练习本上尽是些红钩钩，都是他应得的。
ext.ext_en: His exercise books were full of well deserved red ticks...

ext.ext_cn: 在相应的方框里打钩。
ext.ext_en: Place a tick in the appropriate box.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你不想收到此类邮件，请在这个方框里打钩。
ext.ext_en: Please tick this box if you do not wish to receive such mailings...

ext.ext_cn: 随着男孩们依次答到，他在他们的名字旁打了钩。
ext.ext_en: As each boy said yes, he ticked their name.

defs.def_en: If you tick something that is written on a piece of paper, you put a tick next to it.

ext.ext_cn: 一只上了弦的钟在厨房的案子上嘀嗒响个不停。
ext.ext_en: A wind-up clock ticked busily from the kitchen counter.

ext.ext_cn: 一只落地式大摆钟在墙角嘀嗒作响。
ext.ext_en: A grandfather clock ticked away in a corner.

defs.def_en: When a clock or watch ticks, it makes a regular series of short sounds as it works.

ext.ext_cn: 他坐在那儿，听着落地式大摆钟嘀嗒作响。
ext.ext_en: He sat listening to the tick of the grandfather clock.

defs.def_en: The tick of a clock or watch is the series of short sounds it makes when it is working, or one of those sounds.

ext.ext_cn: 稍等一会儿，我们或许能帮上忙。
ext.ext_en: Just hang on a tick, we may be able to help...

ext.ext_cn: 我马上就回来。
ext.ext_en: I'll be back in a tick...

defs.def_en: You can use tick to refer to a very short period of time.

defs.def_cn: (某人的思想、愿望或情感使其)做出…举动;有…的行为

ext.ext_cn: 他想搞清楚他们为什么会那样。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to find out what made them tick...

ext.ext_cn: 我对人们的所思所想很感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: I'm interested in how people tick.

defs.def_en: If you talk about what makes someone tick, you are talking about the beliefs, wishes, and feelings that make them behave in the way that they do.

ext.ext_cn: 杀灭蜱和螨虫的化学品
ext.ext_en: ...chemicals that destroy ticks and mites...

ext.ext_cn: 被蜱叮咬会引发莱姆病。
ext.ext_en: Tick bites can cause Lyme disease.

defs.def_en: A tick is a small creature which lives on the bodies of people or animals and uses their blood as food.
If someone has a club foot, they are born with a badly twisted foot.
Kohlrabi is a green vegetable that has a round ball of leaves like a cabbage. It has a thick stem that you boil in water before eating.

ext.ext_cn: 学龄儿童的信息需求
ext.ext_en: ...the informational needs of school-age children.

ext.ext_cn: 资讯类电视节目
ext.ext_en: ...informational television.

defs.def_en: Informational means relating to information.

ext.ext_cn: 他正在探询中东国家的政府要如何解决这次冲突。
ext.ext_en: He is sounding out Middle Eastern governments on ways to resolve the conflict...

ext.ext_cn: 要慢慢地打探他的口风，要确保是他的心里话。
ext.ext_en: Sound him out gradually. Make sure it is what he really wants.

defs.def_en: If you sound someone out, you question them in order to find out what their opinion is about something.

defs.def_cn: 应激反应的;本能反应的;条件反射的

ext.ext_cn: 想要躲藏起来的本能冲动
ext.ext_en: ...that reflexive urge for concealment.

defs.def_en: A reflexive reaction or movement occurs immediately in response to something that happens.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沉思的;默想的;认真思考的

ext.ext_cn: 南希沉思了一会儿，突然开口说话了。
ext.ext_en: Nancy, who had been thoughtful for some time, suddenly spoke...

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎在静静思考着什么。
ext.ext_en: He was looking very thoughtful...

defs.def_en: If you are thoughtful, you are quiet and serious because you are thinking about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 体贴入微的;考虑周到的

ext.ext_cn: 体贴入微、关心他人的男人
ext.ext_en: ...a thoughtful and caring man...

ext.ext_cn: 谢谢你，你想的真周到。
ext.ext_en: Thank you. That's very thoughtful of you...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as thoughtful, you approve of them because they remember what other people want, need, or feel, and try not to upset them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (书籍、电影、讲话等)严肃的，思想性强的

ext.ext_cn: 一本兼具思想性和学术性的书
ext.ext_en: ...a thoughtful and scholarly book.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a book, film, or speech as thoughtful, you mean that it is serious and well thought out.

ext.ext_cn: 城市居民的数量正在增长。
ext.ext_en: The number of city dwellers is growing...

ext.ext_cn: 但是在某些方面穴居人要比我们聪明得多。
ext.ext_en: But in some respects cave dwellers were far cleverer than us.

defs.def_en: A city dweller or slum dweller, for example, is a person who lives in the kind of place or house indicated.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰对那些在他家附近泊车堵住通道的司机感到恼火。
ext.ext_en: John was irritated by drivers parking near his house and causing an obstruction.

defs.def_en: An obstruction is something that blocks a road or path.

ext.ext_cn: 这个男孩因患肠梗阻死去了。
ext.ext_en: The boy was suffering from a bowel obstruction and he died.

defs.def_en: An obstruction is something that blocks a passage in your body.

defs.def_cn: （通常指对生意、法律或政府的）阻挠，妨碍

ext.ext_cn: 格斯特先生因为将他们拒之门外，现在面临妨碍公务的刑事指控。
ext.ext_en: Mr Guest refused to let them in and now faces a criminal charge of obstruction.

defs.def_en: Obstruction is the act of deliberately delaying something or preventing something from happening, usually in business, law, or government.
A washing machine is a machine that you use to wash clothes in.

defs.def_cn: （旧时日本男子为免受羞辱而进行的）剖腹自尽
defs.def_en: In former times, if a Japanese man committed hara-kiri, he killed himself by cutting his own stomach open, in order to avoid dishonour.
A tourniquet is a strip of cloth that is tied tightly round an injured arm or leg in order to stop it bleeding.

ext.ext_cn: 十几名骑警进入了广场。
ext.ext_en: A dozen mounted police rode into the square.

defs.def_en: See also:mount;Mounted police or soldiers ride horses when they are on duty.

ext.ext_cn: 今天早上，首相告诉记者他打算全面改组内阁。
ext.ext_en: The prime minister told reporters this morning that he plans to reshuffle his entire cabinet.

ext.ext_cn: 预计首相会在今天晚些时候宣布政府改组的细节。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister is expected to announce details of a government reshuffle later today...

defs.def_en: When a political leader reshuffles the ministers in a government, he or she changes their jobs so that some of the ministers change their responsibilities.

defs.def_cn: 排他地;独占地;专有地;完全地

ext.ext_cn: 男性专属的领域
ext.ext_en: ...an exclusively male domain...

ext.ext_cn: 本科生的这几门课程几乎完全是通过讲座教授的。
ext.ext_en: Instruction in these subjects in undergraduate classes is almost exclusively by lecture.

defs.def_en: Exclusively is used to refer to situations or activities that involve only the thing or things mentioned, and nothing else.

defs.def_cn: （车或驾车者）驶离路边，开向路中间

ext.ext_cn: 她开车来到大街上。
ext.ext_en: She pulled out into the street...

ext.ext_cn: 他正要驶离车流超前面那人的车。
ext.ext_en: He was about to pull out to overtake the guy in front of him.

defs.def_en: When a vehicle or driver pulls out, the vehicle moves out into the road or nearer the centre of the road.

defs.def_cn: 退出，撤出（协议、比赛或组织）

ext.ext_cn: 世界银行应从该项目中撤出。
ext.ext_en: The World Bank should pull out of the project...

ext.ext_cn: 法国打算退出北约。
ext.ext_en: France was going to pull out of NATO...

defs.def_en: If you pull out of an agreement, a contest, or an organization, you withdraw from it.

ext.ext_cn: 黎巴嫩的民兵组织已经同意从贝鲁特撤出。
ext.ext_en: The militia in Lebanon has agreed to pull out of Beirut...

ext.ext_cn: 他们一旦撤出其2/3的军队，经济制裁就会被取消。
ext.ext_en: Economic sanctions will be lifted once two-thirds of their forces have pulled out...

defs.def_en: If troops pull out of a place or if their leader pulls them out, they leave it.

ext.ext_cn: 经济未能走出衰退，英镑因此受到了打击。
ext.ext_en: Sterling has been hit by the economy's failure to pull out of recession...

ext.ext_cn: 目前我们想看到的是能使我们走出这次经济衰退的政策。
ext.ext_en: What we want to see today are policies to pull us out of this recession.

defs.def_en: If a country pulls out of recession or if someone pulls it out, it begins to recover from it.

ext.ext_cn: 莫利笑话我糟糕的方向感。
ext.ext_en: Molly razzed me about my rotten sense of direction.

defs.def_en: To razz someone means to tease them, especially in an unkind way.
Rubella is a disease. The symptoms are a cough, a sore throat, and red spots on your skin.

defs.def_cn: (通常在大城市中或近郊的)棚户区，贫民窟
defs.def_en: A shanty town is a collection of rough huts which poor people live in, usually in or near a large city.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人讨厌的；使人反感的；可憎的

ext.ext_cn: 其中一位家长极为惹人厌，没人喜欢他。
ext.ext_en: One of the parents was a most obnoxious character. No-one liked him...

ext.ext_cn: 我那桌的人如此讨厌，我只好换了座位。
ext.ext_en: The people at my table were so obnoxious I simply had to change my seat.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as obnoxious, you think that they are very unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不自然的；诡异的；反常的

ext.ext_cn: 那架飞机以反常的速度起飞升空。
ext.ext_en: The aircraft rose with unnatural speed on take-off...

ext.ext_cn: 改造后的景观看起来很不自然，极其怪异。
ext.ext_en: The altered landscape looks unnatural and weird.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unnatural, you mean that it is strange and often frightening, because it is different from what you normally expect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她对他开朗、坚定地一笑，但笑得有点不自然。
ext.ext_en: She gave him a bright, determined smile which seemed unnatural.

defs.def_en: Behaviour that is unnatural seems artificial and not normal or genuine.
A bit part is a small and unimportant role for an actor in a film or play.
Crepe paper is stretchy paper with an uneven surface. Coloured crepe paper is often used for making decorations.
Banditry is used to refer to acts of robbery and violence in areas where the rule of law has broken down.

defs.def_cn: （花园中存放种子、园艺工具等的）盆栽棚
defs.def_en: A potting shed is a small building in a garden, in which you can keep things such as seeds or garden tools.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 眼下我们确实有点人手不足。
ext.ext_en: We're actually a bit short-handed at the moment.

defs.def_en: If a company, organization, or group is short-handed, it does not have enough people to work on a particular job or for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 以前的房主没有留下任何转递地址。
ext.ext_en: The former owner had not left any forwarding address.

defs.def_en: A forwarding address is an address that you give to someone when you go and live somewhere else so that they can send your mail on to you.
In computing, parallel processing is a system in which several instructions are carried out at the same time instead of one after the other.
Someone's bum is the part of their body which they sit on.
A bum is a person who has no permanent home or job and who gets money by working occasionally or by asking people for money.

ext.ext_cn: 你们都是一群废物。
ext.ext_en: You're all a bunch of bums.

defs.def_en: If someone refers to another person as a bum, they think that person is worthless or irresponsible.

ext.ext_cn: 他知道你在做一笔烂生意。
ext.ext_en: He knows you're getting a bum deal.

defs.def_en: Some people use bum to describe a situation that they find unpleasant or annoying.

ext.ext_cn: 能给我一支烟吗？
ext.ext_en: Mind if I bum a cigarette?

defs.def_en: If you bum something off someone, you ask them for it and they give it to you.

ext.ext_cn: 我想他们目前只是在四处闲逛，没做多少事。
ext.ext_en: I think they're just bumming around at the moment, not doing a lot...

ext.ext_cn: 她动身和一个男友去周游世界了。
ext.ext_en: She went off to bum round the world with a boyfriend.

defs.def_en: If you bum around, you go from place to place without any particular destination, either for enjoyment or because you have nothing else to do.

ext.ext_cn: 他是少数几个知道招揽观众的演员之一。
ext.ext_en: He is one of the few players who puts bums on seats.

defs.def_en: If the organizers of an event such as a concert want to put bums on seats, they want a lot of people to attend it.

ext.ext_cn: 还有要买奖券的吗？每张25便士，1英镑5张。
ext.ext_en: Any more raffle tickets? Twenty-five pence each or five for a pound.

defs.def_en: A raffle is a competition in which you buy tickets with numbers on them. Afterwards some numbers are chosen, and if your ticket has one of these numbers on it, you win a prize.

ext.ext_cn: 每场表演期间，我们将以抽彩方法送出大奖。
ext.ext_en: During each show we will be raffling a fabulous prize.

defs.def_en: If someone raffles something, they give it as a prize in a raffle.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (虽常事与愿违但)出于好心的,善意的,本意良好的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个空有一番好意但能力很差的主管。
ext.ext_en: He is well-intentioned but a poor administrator.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管出发点很好却往往完全不切实际的规定
ext.ext_en: ...rules that, however well-intentioned, are often hopelessly impractical.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or their actions are well-intentioned, you mean that they intend to be helpful or kind but they are unsuccessful or cause problems.
Bracken is a large plant with leaves that are divided into many thin sections. It grows on hills and in woods.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对每项调查我都采用分析方法。
ext.ext_en: I have an analytical approach to every survey.

defs.def_en: An analytical way of doing something involves the use of logical reasoning.

ext.ext_cn: 所有的原材料都将用我们最新的分析技术进行解析。
ext.ext_en: All raw materials are subjected to our latest analytical techniques.

defs.def_en: Analytical research involves using chemical analysis.

defs.def_cn: (尤指计算机所进行的)数据处理，资料处理

ext.ext_cn: 泰勒的公司开发数据处理系统。
ext.ext_en: Taylor's company makes data-processing systems.

defs.def_en: Data processing is the series of operations that are carried out on data, especially by computers, in order to present, interpret, or obtain information.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦被保险人卖出保单,他就自然失去了上面所有的权利。
ext.ext_en: Once the insured has sold his policy, he naturally loses all rights to it.

defs.def_en: The insured is the person who is insured by a particular policy.

ext.ext_cn: 那座火山在1980年喷发，摧毁了华盛顿州大片地区。
ext.ext_en: The volcano erupted in 1980, devastating a large area of Washington state...

ext.ext_cn: 科学家说皮纳图博山近期可能会再次喷发。
ext.ext_en: Scientists say Mount Pinatubo could erupt again soon.

defs.def_en: When a volcano erupts, it throws out a lot of hot, melted rock called lava, as well as ash and steam.

defs.def_cn: （冲突、战斗等）突然发生，爆发，突然加剧

ext.ext_cn: 在停火两天后，今天那里爆发了激烈的战斗。
ext.ext_en: Heavy fighting erupted there today after a two-day ceasefire...

ext.ext_cn: 两辆警车将男孩们带走时突然发生了暴力冲突。
ext.ext_en: Violence erupted as the boys were driven away in two police vans.

defs.def_en: If violence or fighting erupts, it suddenly begins or gets worse in an unexpected, violent way.

defs.def_cn: （某地）爆发动乱;（人群）突然暴怒，发生骚乱

ext.ext_cn: 在洛杉矶，一个叫做沃茨的街区爆发了动乱。
ext.ext_en: In Los Angeles, the neighborhood known as Watts erupted into riots...

ext.ext_cn: 已经相对平静的这个地区今年春天再次爆发暴力事件。
ext.ext_en: This region which had been relatively calm erupted in violence again this spring.

defs.def_en: When people in a place suddenly become angry or violent, you can say that they erupt or that the place erupts .

defs.def_cn: （感情）迸发，突然转变;（常指）变得狂躁

ext.ext_cn: 然后在没有任何征兆的情况下，她突然大笑起来。
ext.ext_en: Then, without warning, she erupts into laughter...

ext.ext_cn: 被戴绿帽的丈夫勃然大怒，纽曼吓得光着脚逃走了。
ext.ext_en: Newman fled barefoot as the cheated husband erupted in fury.

defs.def_en: You say that someone erupts when they suddenly have a change in mood, usually becoming quite noisy.

ext.ext_cn: 第二周周末，我的皮肤上突然出现了丘疹。
ext.ext_en: At the end of the second week, my skin erupted in pimples.

defs.def_en: If your skin erupts, sores or spots suddenly appear there.

defs.def_cn: （一段时间后）失去吸引力，变得乏味

ext.ext_cn: 饭店里的饭菜已经不像以前那样诱人。
ext.ext_en: Already the allure of meals in restaurants had begun to pall.

defs.def_en: If something palls, it becomes less interesting or less enjoyable after a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 一团油腻的黑色烟雾飘到悬崖顶上。
ext.ext_en: A pall of oily black smoke drifted over the clifftop.

defs.def_en: If a pall of smoke hangs over a place, there is a thick cloud of smoke above it.

ext.ext_cn: 动荡的局势给往常举国欢庆的日子蒙上了阴影。
ext.ext_en: The unrest has cast a pall over what is usually a day of national rejoicing...

ext.ext_cn: 我们不想给庆典蒙上阴影。
ext.ext_en: We don't want to cast a pall over the festivities.

defs.def_en: If something unpleasant casts a pall over an event or occasion, it makes it less enjoyable than it should be.

defs.def_cn: 强盗贵族，强盗资本家（指用非法或不道德手段攫取大量钱财的权贵）

ext.ext_cn: 美国的强盗资本家从工业和交通业上积累的巨大财富
ext.ext_en: ...the vast wealth accumulated by America's robber barons from industry and transport.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a robber baron, you mean that they have made a very large amount of money and have been prepared to act illegally or in an immoral way in order to do so.

ext.ext_cn: 他为什么就不能讲些有新意的话，而不是喋喋不休地说些老生常谈呢？
ext.ext_en: Why couldn't he say something original instead of spouting the same old platitudes?

ext.ext_cn: 概述了很多问题、但几乎没有提出解决办法的一串陈词滥调
ext.ext_en: ...a stream of platitudes, outlining many problems but offering few solutions.

defs.def_en: A platitude is a statement which is considered meaningless and boring because it has been made many times before in similar situations.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 松懈的；马虎的；不严格的

ext.ext_cn: 问题之一是对机场员工的安检措施马虎松懈。
ext.ext_en: One of the problem areas is lax security for airport personnel...

ext.ext_cn: 生还者一直指责安全标准执行不严。
ext.ext_en: There have been allegations from survivors that safety standards had been lax...

defs.def_en: If you say that a person's  behaviour or a system is lax, you mean they are not careful or strict about maintaining high standards.

ext.ext_cn: 他把纸揉成一团扔进火里。
ext.ext_en: He screwed the paper into a ball and tossed it into the fire...

ext.ext_cn: 他把毯子掀到一边起了身。
ext.ext_en: He tossed his blanket aside and got up…

defs.def_en: If you toss something somewhere, you throw it there lightly, often in a rather careless way.

defs.def_cn: (常表示愤怒或轻蔑地)甩(头或头发)

ext.ext_cn: “我确信我不知道。”库克一甩头说。
ext.ext_en: 'I'm sure I don't know.' Cook tossed her head...

ext.ext_cn: 她气喘吁吁地把头发从脸上甩开。
ext.ext_en: Gasping, she tossed her hair out of her face.

defs.def_en: If you toss your head or toss your hair, you move your head backwards, quickly and suddenly, often as a way of expressing an emotion such as anger or contempt.

ext.ext_cn: 我们掷硬币决定谁出去买小圆面包。
ext.ext_en: We tossed a coin to decide who would go out and buy the buns.

ext.ext_cn: 还不如用抛硬币的方法来决定。
ext.ext_en: It would be better to decide it on the toss of a coin.

defs.def_en: In sports and informal situations, if you decide something by tossing a coin, you spin a coin into the air and guess which side of the coin will face upwards when it lands.

ext.ext_cn: 孟加拉国队掷硬币赢了，决定先击球。
ext.ext_en: Bangladesh won the toss and decided to bat first.

defs.def_en: The toss is a way of deciding something, such as who is going to go first in a game, that consists of spinning a coin into the air and guessing which side of the coin will face upwards when it lands.

ext.ext_cn: 海浪变得汹涌澎湃，把小船像漂浮的软木塞一样抛来甩去。
ext.ext_en: The seas grew turbulent, tossing the small boat like a cork...

ext.ext_cn: 飞机上下颠簸，飞行员试图将其稳住。
ext.ext_en: As the plane was tossed up and down, the pilot tried to stabilise it.

defs.def_en: If something such as the wind or sea tosses an object, it causes it to move from side to side or up and down.

ext.ext_cn: 到快上菜时再轻轻搅拌色拉。
ext.ext_en: Do not toss the salad until you're ready to serve...

ext.ext_cn: 加入磨碎的橙皮，再将苹果片在其中轻拌。
ext.ext_en: Add the grated orange rind and toss the apple slices in the mixture...

defs.def_en: If you toss food while preparing it, you put pieces of it into a liquid and lightly shake them so that they become covered with the liquid.

defs.def_cn: 为不重要的事争论不休

ext.ext_cn: 他们仍在为第一个进球争论不休。
ext.ext_en: They were still arguing the toss about the first goal...

ext.ext_cn: 他们花了这么多时间为无关紧要的事争个没完。
ext.ext_en: They spend so much time arguing the toss over inconsequential matters.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone argues the toss, you are criticizing them for continuing to argue for longer than is necessary about something that is not very important.

ext.ext_cn: 嗯，不管怎样，谁会在意高雅时髦呢？
ext.ext_en: Well, who gives a toss about sophistication anyway?...

ext.ext_cn: 我才不在乎人们怎么想呢。
ext.ext_en: I don't give a toss what people think…

defs.def_en: If you say that you do not give a toss about someone or something, you are emphasizing that you do not care about them at all.

ext.ext_cn: 感觉就像整夜翻来覆去睡不着、醒来时浑身疲惫一样。
ext.ext_en: You feel as if you've been tossing and turning all night, and wake up feeling worn out.

defs.def_en: If you toss and turn, you keep moving around in bed and cannot sleep properly, for example because you are ill or worried.

ext.ext_cn: 旁路边的树丛
ext.ext_en: ...a clump of trees bordering a side road.

defs.def_cn: 古巴的;古巴人的;古巴文化的

defs.def_en: An emblem is something that represents a quality or idea.

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙仍是我们最喜爱的度假去处。
ext.ext_en: Spain is still our most popular holiday destination...

ext.ext_cn: 仅有一半的紧急救援物资运抵了目的地。
ext.ext_en: Only half of the emergency supplies have reached their destination.

defs.def_en: The destination of someone or something is the place to which they are going or being sent.

defs.def_cn: (通常在炎热天气里穿的)瑟法里装，旅游装，猎装
defs.def_en: A safari suit is a casual suit made from a light-coloured material such as linen or cotton. Safari suits are usually worn in hot weather.

defs.def_cn: （尤指不得体或不认真的）性行为;调情

ext.ext_en: Does this mean no hanky-panky after lights out?

ext.ext_cn: 政府一直在搞税额抵免、加速折旧及其他一些经济上的花招。
ext.ext_en: The government has been offering tax credits, accelerated depreciation, and other economic hanky-panky.

defs.def_en: If you describe behaviour as hanky-panky, you disapprove of it because it is dishonest or breaks rules.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The country needs a period of calm without more surges of radical change...

ext.ext_en: The Football League has announced its proposals for a radical reform of the way football is run in England.

defs.def_en: Radical changes and differences are very important and great in degree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...threats by left-wing radical groups to disrupt the proceedings.

ext.ext_cn: 激进派和保守派政治人士之间的紧张对峙
ext.ext_en: ...political tension between radical and conservative politicians.

defs.def_en: Radical people believe that there should be great changes in society and try to bring about these changes.

defs.def_cn: (希腊、罗马神话中居于山林水泽的)仙女
defs.def_en: In Greek and Roman mythology, nymphs were spirits of nature who appeared as young women.
A nymph is the larva, or young form, of an insect such as a dragonfly.

ext.ext_cn: 随着政治声望的降低，他变得更加依赖军队了。
ext.ext_en: As his political stature has shrunk, he has grown correspondingly more dependent on the army.

defs.def_en: You use correspondingly when describing a situation which is closely connected with one you have just mentioned or is similar to it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人厌恶的;讨厌的;可憎的

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得他们的观点十分可憎。
ext.ext_en: I find their views detestable.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is detestable, you mean you dislike them very much.

defs.def_cn: 保险精算师的;保险计算的

ext.ext_cn: 该公司的精算报告可随时索取。
ext.ext_en: The company's actuarial report is available on demand.

defs.def_en: Actuarial means relating to the work of an actuary.
A submariner is a sailor or other person who goes in a submarine.

defs.def_cn: 演员（单数形式的actor通常指男演员，但有些女演员喜欢被称为actor而不是actress)

ext.ext_cn: 他的父亲是粤剧团的演员。
ext.ext_en: His father was an actor in the Cantonese Opera Company...

ext.ext_cn: 要想演那个角色，你必须是个非常出色的演员。
ext.ext_en: You have to be a very good actor to play that part.

defs.def_en: An actor is someone whose job is acting in plays or films. 'Actor' in the singular usually refers to a man, but some women who act prefer to be called 'actors' rather than 'actresses'.

ext.ext_cn: 机场路
ext.ext_en: ...the access road to the airport.

defs.def_en: An access road is a road which enables traffic to reach a particular place or area.
Your toenails are the thin hard areas at the end of each of your toes.
A patrol car is a police car used for patrolling streets and roads.

ext.ext_cn: 塔罗牌里的各种花色
ext.ext_en: ...the suits of the Tarot...

ext.ext_cn: 如今塔罗牌又广为流行起来了。
ext.ext_en: Today there is a considerable revival of tarot.

defs.def_en: The Tarot is a pack of cards with pictures on them that is used to predict what will happen to people in the future. Tarot is also used to refer to the system of predicting people's futures using these cards.

ext.ext_cn: 在银行的放纵之下，赤字增加了。
ext.ext_en: The deficit had grown with the connivance of the banks...

ext.ext_cn: 这些商品是在官方的默许下出口的。
ext.ext_en: The goods were exported with official connivance.

defs.def_en: Connivance is a willingness to allow or assist something to happen even though you know it is wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 有两名人质可望在几天后获释。
ext.ext_en: It is hopeful that two hostages will be freed in the next few days.

defs.def_en: A hostage is someone who has been captured by a person or organization and who may be killed or injured if people do not do what that person or organization demands.

ext.ext_cn: 他第一次作为电视记者出国采访时就被扣作人质。
ext.ext_en: He was taken hostage while on his first foreign assignment as a television journalist.

defs.def_en: If someone is taken hostage or is held hostage, they are captured and kept as a hostage.

defs.def_cn: 受限制的人;不由自主的人

ext.ext_cn: 随着外资的减少，政府将更加受制于起伏不定的国际油价。
ext.ext_en: With the reduction in foreign investments, the government will be even more a hostage to the whims of the international oil price...

ext.ext_cn: 葡萄种植兼酿酒者说他们一直都为谷物和大豆种植者的利益所绑架。
ext.ext_en: Wine growers say they've been held hostage to the interests of the cereal and soybean farmers.

defs.def_en: If you say you are hostage to something, you mean that your freedom to take action is restricted by things that you cannot control.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you describe a woman as busty, you mean that she has large breasts.

ext.ext_cn: 安东尼的怪笑让萨克利夫不知所措。
ext.ext_en: Antony's wry smile disconcerted Sutcliffe...

ext.ext_cn: 显然，英国的反应让这位大使很不安。
ext.ext_en: The ambassador was clearly disconcerted by the British reaction.

defs.def_en: If something disconcerts you, it makes you feel anxious, confused, or embarrassed.

ext.ext_cn: 我非常渴望能够帮助和照顾他人。
ext.ext_en: I had a strong desire to help and care for people...

ext.ext_cn: 他们似乎已丧失了对生活的热望。
ext.ext_en: They seem to have lost their desire for life.

defs.def_en: A desire is a strong wish to do or have something.

ext.ext_en: She had remarried and desired a child with her new husband...

ext.ext_en: But Fred was bored and desired to go home...

defs.def_en: If you desire something, you want it.
