ext.ext_en: Teenage sex, for instance, may come not out of genuine desire but from a need to get love.

defs.def_en: Desire for someone is a strong feeling of wanting to have sex with them.

ext.ext_cn: 他从没有想过她可能不想跟他上床。
ext.ext_en: It never occurred to him that she might not desire him.

defs.def_en: If you desire someone, you want to have sex with them.

defs.def_cn: （用于说明性的书面语中）如果需要的话,如果愿意的话

ext.ext_cn: 如有需要可选修额外的课程。
ext.ext_en: Additional courses may be taken if desired...

ext.ext_cn: 如果愿意的话，可以把这些调味汁倒入一只单独的长柄锅里。
ext.ext_en: Transfer this sauce to a separate saucepan, if desired.

defs.def_en: If desired is used in instructions in written English to indicate that someone can choose to take the course of action mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 心里想望之人;心中渴望之物

ext.ext_en: He was extremely devious in his efforts to achieve his heart's desire.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is your heart's desire, you mean that you want that person or thing very much.

ext.ext_en: Food seems to have been available, even if the quality left much to be desired...

defs.def_en: If you say that something leaves a lot to be desired, you mean that it is not as good as it should be.

ext.ext_en: ...an 8 per cent average rate of return.

defs.def_en: The rate of return on an investment is the amount of profit it makes, often shown as a percentage of the original investment.

defs.def_en: Fretwork is wood or metal that has been decorated by cutting bits of it out to make a pattern.

ext.ext_en: ...a most phlegmatic man, steadily working on as the rain splashed down.

ext.ext_en: I am planning a 25th birthday party for my nephew.

defs.def_cn: 食欲缺乏的;厌食的;瘦骨嶙峋的

ext.ext_en: Claire had been anorexic for three years.

ext.ext_cn: 患有厌食症的少年
ext.ext_en: ...an anorexic teenager.

defs.def_en: If someone is anorexic, they are suffering from anorexia and so are very thin.

ext.ext_cn: 麦加圣地
ext.ext_en: ...the holy shrine of Mecca.

defs.def_en: A shrine is a place of worship which is associated with a particular holy person or object.

ext.ext_en: The monument has been turned into a shrine to the dead and the missing.

defs.def_en: A shrine is a place that people visit and treat with respect because it is connected with a dead person or with dead people that they want to remember.

ext.ext_cn: 那两名警卫被人勒死了。
ext.ext_en: The two guards had been garrotted.

defs.def_en: A garrotte is a piece of wire or cord used to garrotte someone.

ext.ext_cn: 英勇的首领高举利剑投入了战斗，准备狠狠地打击敌人。
ext.ext_en: ...the heroic leader charging into battle, sword held high, ready to smite the enemy.

defs.def_en: See also:smitten;To smite something means to hit it hard.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 病态的;不正常的；心理不健康的

ext.ext_cn: 一些人对犯罪有一种病态的痴迷。
ext.ext_en: Some people have a morbid fascination with crime.

ext.ext_cn: 对被定罪的杀人犯病态的好奇
ext.ext_en: ...morbid curiosity about the convicted murderer.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their interest in something as morbid, you mean that they are very interested in unpleasant things, especially death, and you think this is strange.

ext.ext_cn: 她直挺挺地举着手。
ext.ext_en: She held up her hand stiffly...

ext.ext_cn: 把它举起来让我们看看。
ext.ext_en: Hold it up so that we can see it.

defs.def_en: If you hold up your hand or something you have in your hand, you move it upwards into a particular position and keep it there.

ext.ext_cn: 工厂里四处都立有铁柱支撑着房顶。
ext.ext_en: Mills have iron pillars all over the place holding up the roof...

ext.ext_cn: 她双腿都站不住了。
ext.ext_en: Her legs wouldn't hold her up.

defs.def_en: If one thing holds up another, it is placed under the other thing in order to support it and prevent it from falling.

ext.ext_cn: 你为什么耽搁了大家？
ext.ext_en: Why were you holding everyone up?...

ext.ext_cn: 持续的暴力活动可能会阻延改革的进程。
ext.ext_en: Continuing violence could hold up progress towards reform.

defs.def_en: To hold up a person or process means to make them late or delay them.  →see usage note at:cancel

ext.ext_cn: 一名窃贼昨天持械抢劫一家加油站后带着数百英镑逃跑了。
ext.ext_en: A thief ran off with hundreds of pounds yesterday after holding up a petrol station.

defs.def_en: If someone holds up a place such as a bank or a shop, they point a weapon at someone there to make them give them money or valuable goods.

defs.def_cn: 举出…作为批评（或赞扬）的对象

ext.ext_cn: 她说一份周日的报纸上刊登的照片使她备受嘲讽。
ext.ext_en: She said the picture that had appeared in a Sunday newspaper had held her up to ridicule...

ext.ext_cn: 他总是被树为弟妹学习的榜样。
ext.ext_en: He had always been held up as an example to the younger ones.

defs.def_en: If you hold up something such as someone's behaviour, you make it known to other people, so that they can criticize or praise it.

ext.ext_cn: 童装是经济衰退中仍然保持良好发展的一个领域。
ext.ext_en: Children's wear is one area that is holding up well in the recession.

defs.def_en: If something such as a type of business holds up in difficult conditions, it stays in a reasonably good state.

ext.ext_cn: 我不能肯定该论点是否经得起检验，但它很有新意。
ext.ext_en: I'm not sure if the argument holds up, but it's stimulating.

defs.def_en: If an argument or theory holds up, it is true or valid, even after close examination.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 屋顶大幅倾斜的相当老式别致的小屋
ext.ext_en: ...a rather quaint lodge with a steeply-pitched roof.

defs.def_en: See also:high-pitched;low-pitched;A pitched roof is one that slopes as opposed to one that is flat.

ext.ext_cn: 这一年来，我真的进行了许多深刻的反思，努力地找出自己的生活中到底哪里出了问题。
ext.ext_en: My year was really spent doing a lot of soul-searching and trying to find out what had gone wrong in my life.

defs.def_en: Soul-searching is a long and careful examination of your thoughts and feelings, especially when you are trying to make a difficult moral decision or thinking about something that has gone wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 英国广播公司交响乐团演奏起来挥洒自如。
ext.ext_en: The BBC Symphony Orchestra played with great panache...

ext.ext_cn: 她应付世界媒体的派头非常令人吃惊。
ext.ext_en: Her panache at dealing with the world's media is quite astonishing.

defs.def_en: If you do something with panache, you do it in a confident, stylish, and elegant way.

ext.ext_cn: 他把自行车藏在山楂树篱中。
ext.ext_en: He hid the bicycle in the hawthorn hedge...

ext.ext_cn: 他们能看出我很害怕，就把我藏起来，直到没有危险了才让我出来。
ext.ext_en: They could see that I was terrified, and hid me until the coast was clear.

defs.def_en: If you hide something or someone, you put them in a place where they cannot easily be seen or found.

ext.ext_cn: 他们走近时，小男孩急忙跑开藏了起来。
ext.ext_en: At their approach the little boy scurried away and hid...

ext.ext_cn: 他们躲到一棵树后。
ext.ext_en: They hid themselves behind a tree.

defs.def_en: If you hide or if you hide yourself, you go somewhere where you cannot easily be seen or found.

ext.ext_cn: 她将脸埋在他外套的衣领下，开始哭了起来。
ext.ext_en: She hid her face under the collar of his jacket and she started to cry...

ext.ext_cn: 他又用双手捂住脸，陷入了沉思。
ext.ext_en: He hid his face in his hands again, lost in his own thoughts.

defs.def_en: If you hide your face, you press your face against something or cover your face with something, so that people cannot see it.

ext.ext_cn: 李试图掩饰自己的激动心情。
ext.ext_en: Lee tried to hide his excitement...

ext.ext_cn: 我绝对没有什么好隐瞒的，我没有做错什么。
ext.ext_en: I have absolutely nothing to hide, I have done nothing wrong...

defs.def_en: If you hide what you feel or know, you keep it a secret, so that no one knows about it.

ext.ext_cn: 那个男人浓密的髭须完全遮住了他的上唇。
ext.ext_en: The man's heavy moustache hid his upper lip completely...

ext.ext_cn: 大院掩映在树木灌丛之中。
ext.ext_en: The compound was hidden by trees and shrubs.

defs.def_en: If something hides an object, it covers it and prevents it from being seen.

defs.def_en: A hide is a place which is built to look like its surroundings. Hides are used by people who want to watch or photograph animals and birds without being seen by them.

ext.ext_cn: 鞣制兽皮的工序
ext.ext_en: ...the process of tanning animal hides.

ext.ext_cn: 袋鼠皮
ext.ext_en: ...kangaroo hide.

defs.def_en: A hide is the skin of a large animal such as a cow, horse, or elephant, which can be used for making leather.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （声音、形象、话语等）令人难忘的，萦绕心头的

ext.ext_cn: 红木树林中野鸟令人难忘的鸣叫声
ext.ext_en: ...the haunting calls of wild birds in the mahogany trees.

ext.ext_cn: 令人难忘的散文
ext.ext_en: ...haunting prose.

defs.def_en: Haunting sounds, images, or words remain in your thoughts because they are very beautiful or sad.

ext.ext_cn: 嘉宝饰演王后，陶醉于和安东尼奥的热恋中。
ext.ext_en: Garbo plays the Queen, rejoicing in the love she has found with Antonio...

ext.ext_cn: 外交部的声明称法国政府很高兴看到事件得到圆满解决。
ext.ext_en: A Foreign Ministry statement said that the French government rejoiced at the happy outcome to events...

defs.def_en: If you rejoice, you are very pleased about something and you show it in your behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 他们养的龟有个搞笑的名字——卡拉瑟斯
ext.ext_en: ...their tortoise, who rejoiced in the name of Carruthers.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or thing rejoices in the name of something, you mean that they have a silly or amusing name.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她那位前途远大、身为报纸主编的丈夫
ext.ext_en: ...her high-flying newspaper-editor husband.

defs.def_en: A high-flying person is successful or is likely to be successful in their career.

ext.ext_cn: 他几乎打记事起就认识这个老人。
ext.ext_en: He'd known the old man practically all his life...

ext.ext_cn: 我认识一些人，他们觉得戒烟几乎是不可能的。
ext.ext_en: I know people who find it practically impossible to give up smoking.

defs.def_en: Practically means almost, but not completely or exactly.

ext.ext_cn: 该课程比硕士学位课程更注重实践。
ext.ext_en: The course is more practically based than the Masters degree...

ext.ext_cn: 英国人不是以其哲学思想闻名，而是往往更注重实际。
ext.ext_en: The British are not famed for their philosophy and tend to be more practically minded.

defs.def_en: You use practically to describe something which involves real actions or events rather than ideas or theories.

ext.ext_cn: “对不起，”他说。
ext.ext_en: 'I'm sorry,' he said...

ext.ext_cn: 她说他们被深深打动了。
ext.ext_en: She said they were very impressed...

defs.def_en: When you say something, you speak words.

defs.def_cn: (表达观点或陈述事实，否定用法表示婉转暗示某事并非事实)说，表示

ext.ext_cn: 我只想说这是我这辈子听说过的最虚伪的事情。
ext.ext_en: I would just like to say that this is the most hypocritical thing I have ever heard in my life...

ext.ext_cn: 我必须承认直到四五年前我才知道有福克斯巷警察局 。
ext.ext_en: I have to say I didn't even know Fox Lane Police Station existed till about four or five years ago...

defs.def_en: You use say in expressions such as I would just like to say to introduce what you are actually saying, or to indicate that you are expressing an opinion or admitting a fact. If you state that you can't say something or you wouldn't say something, you are indicating in a polite or indirect way that it is not the case.

ext.ext_cn: 这份报告称该国一直普遍存在折磨政治犯的现象。
ext.ext_en: The report says there is widespread and routine torture of political prisoners in the country...

ext.ext_cn: 温妮姨妈回信说妈妈身体尚未康复，无法写信。
ext.ext_en: Auntie Winnie wrote back saying Mam wasn't well enough to write...

defs.def_en: You can mention the contents of a piece of writing by mentioning what it says or what someone says in it.

ext.ext_cn: 也许我还在做梦，我心里想。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps I'm still dreaming, I said to myself...

ext.ext_cn: “别生气，”他暗暗告诉自己。
ext.ext_en: 'Keep your temper,' he said to himself.

defs.def_en: If you say something to yourself, you think it.

ext.ext_cn: 你 16 岁时可以结婚，但还无权参与国家政事。
ext.ext_en: You can get married at sixteen, and yet you haven't got a say in the running of the country...

ext.ext_cn: 学生们想更多地参与大学的管理。
ext.ext_en: The students wanted more say in the government of the university.

defs.def_en: If you have a say in something, you have the right to give your opinion and influence decisions relating to it.

defs.def_cn: (钟、刻度盘、地图等)表明，指向，显示

ext.ext_cn: 钟显示时间是 11 点 4 分。
ext.ext_en: The clock said four minutes past eleven...

ext.ext_cn: 地图上显示共有六处。
ext.ext_en: The map says there's six of them.

defs.def_en: You indicate the information given by something such as a clock, dial, or map by mentioning what it says .

ext.ext_cn: 我认为那很能说明塞勒斯表现得有多出色。
ext.ext_en: I think that says a lot about how well Seles is playing...

ext.ext_cn: 从周边环境和这幢大楼的外观可以看出这个项目的举足轻重。
ext.ext_en: The appearance of the place and the building says something about the importance of the project.

defs.def_en: If something says something about a person, situation, or thing, it gives important information about them.

ext.ext_cn: 他将比赛技能提至所要求的水平，这说明他颇有能耐。
ext.ext_en: It says a lot for him that he has raised his game to the level required...

ext.ext_cn: 这本书笔调忧伤，却并不令人沮丧，这很能说明布鲁克纳超群的写作技巧。
ext.ext_en: It says much for Brookner's skill that the book is sad, but never depressing.

defs.def_en: If something says a lot for a person or thing, it shows that this person or thing is very good or has a lot of good qualities.

defs.def_cn: (通常表示说话者认为某人优点不多)我会这样形容他们/你可以这样形容他们

ext.ext_cn: 我能说的是，至少他通常穿着入时。
ext.ext_en: He's usually smartly-dressed, I'll say that for him...

ext.ext_cn: 至少还可以说，他对自己是深信不疑的。
ext.ext_en: At the very least, he is devastatingly sure of himself, you can say that.

defs.def_en: You use say in expressions such as I'll say that for them and you can say this for them after or before you mention a good quality that someone has, usually when you think they do not have many good qualities.

ext.ext_cn: 假定你能对我们所生活的这个世界作出任意改变，你会改变什么呢？
ext.ext_en: Say you could change anything about the world we live in, what would it be?

defs.def_en: You can use say when you want to discuss something that might possibly happen or be true.

ext.ext_cn: 为更清晰地理解此处的问题，我们来看一种不同的生物系统，比如说，橡子。
ext.ext_en: To see the problem here more clearly, let's look at a different biological system, say, an acorn...

ext.ext_cn: 比方说，拥有 300 到 500 英亩地的人，可能每年会损失几千英镑。
ext.ext_en: Someone with, say, between 300 and 500 acres could be losing thousands of pounds a year.

defs.def_en: You can use say or let's say when you mention something as an example.

defs.def_cn: (用以唤起注意或表示惊讶、高兴、崇敬)嘿，喂，哎呀，啊

ext.ext_cn: 哎，利奥，找个晚上一起吃顿饭如何，就你和我？
ext.ext_en: Say, Leo, how would you like to have dinner one night, just you and me?

defs.def_en: Say is used to attract someone's attention or to express surprise, pleasure, or admiration.

defs.def_cn: 清楚说明事实;明确表达(…的)感觉

ext.ext_cn: 这是我一周内第3次拜访，这说明了一切。
ext.ext_en: This is my third visit in a week, which says it all.

defs.def_en: If you say that something says it all, you mean that it shows you very clearly the truth about a situation or someone's feelings.

defs.def_cn: (表示吃惊)不会吧;(亦常表示事实上并不吃惊)我一点也不觉得奇怪，用不着你说也知道

ext.ext_cn: “我是作家。”——“不会吧。你写哪方面的书？”
ext.ext_en: 'I'm a writer.' — 'You don't say. What kind of book are you writing?'

defs.def_en: You can use 'You don't say' to express surprise at what someone has told you. People often use this expression to indicate that in fact they are not surprised.

ext.ext_cn: 把总部设在该国有很多优势。
ext.ext_en: There's a lot to be said for being based in the country.

defs.def_en: If you say there is a lot to be said for something, you mean you think it has a lot of good qualities or aspects.

ext.ext_cn: 他向来寡言少语。
ext.ext_en: He's never got much to say for himself.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone doesn't have much to say for himself or herself, you mean that they are not speaking very much during a conversation.

defs.def_cn: 你有什么好说的;你有什么要辩解的

ext.ext_cn: “那么”，她最后说，“你有什么好说的？”
ext.ext_en: 'Well,' she said eventually, 'what have you to say for yourself?'

defs.def_en: If someone asks what you have to say for yourself, they are asking what excuse you have for what you have done.

defs.def_cn: 显而易见;不言而喻;不用说

ext.ext_cn: 不用说，有肺病的人不应吸烟。
ext.ext_en: It goes without saying that if someone has lung problems they should not smoke.

defs.def_en: If something goes without saying, it is obvious.

ext.ext_cn: 足协已经发表了意见。
ext.ext_en: The Football Association have had their say.

defs.def_en: When one of the people or groups involved in a discussion has their say, they give their opinion.

defs.def_cn: (用于对很多人不喜欢的人或事物表示赞赏时)随你怎么说,不管你怎么认为

ext.ext_cn: 随你怎么说，但他们确实爱自己的妈妈。
ext.ext_en: Say what you like about them, but they did love their Mum.

defs.def_en: You use 'Say what you like about someone or something' when you are about to mention one good thing about a person or thing that many people do not like.

defs.def_cn: (尤指乐于接受他人刚刚提出要给予自己的东西)我不反对，我没意见，好哇

ext.ext_cn: 我倒想喝一杯。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't say no to a drink.

defs.def_en: You use 'I wouldn't say no' to indicate that you would like something, especially something that has just been offered to you.

defs.def_cn: (引出语气更重或更极端的描述)即使不说是…,虽不能说…

ext.ext_cn: 对于那些从没有收到过上百万美元版权费的人来说，这听起来就算不令人反感，至少也让人觉得有点儿怪。
ext.ext_en: To those who've never received million dollar royalty cheques, this sounded a little odd, not to say offensive.

defs.def_en: You can use not to say when adding a stronger or more extreme description than the one you have just used.

ext.ext_cn: 失业会让人觉得自己一无是处，更何况还会带来经济问题。
ext.ext_en: Unemployment leads to a sense of uselessness, to say nothing of financial problems.

defs.def_en: You use to say nothing of when you mention an additional thing which gives even more strength to the point you are making.

defs.def_cn: (用于提醒别人所说话可能会具有冒犯性或令人震惊)可以说

ext.ext_cn: 然而随着年纪渐长，可以说，你的大局已定了。
ext.ext_en: ...whereas when you get older you're rather set in your ways, shall I say...

ext.ext_cn: 可以说，我的参与还不是完全合乎道德。
ext.ext_en: My involvement has not been altogether, shall we say, ethical.

defs.def_en: You use shall I say and shall we say in order to warn someone that what you are about to say may cause offence or be surprising.

defs.def_cn: 亦即;也就是说;换句话说

ext.ext_cn: 1967年被占的领土，也就是约旦河西岸和加沙地带的被占领土
ext.ext_en: ...territories that were occupied in 1967, that is to say, in the West Bank and Gaza.

defs.def_en: You use that is to say or that's to say to indicate that you are about to express the same idea more clearly or precisely.

defs.def_cn: 让你说对了;一点没错;我同意;说得太对了

ext.ext_cn: “那一定是件精细活。”——“说得太对了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Must have been a fiddly job.' — 'You can say that again.'

defs.def_en: You can use 'You can say that again' to express strong agreement with what someone has just said.

ext.ext_cn: 美欧均势的变化
ext.ext_en: ...changes in the balance of power between the United States and Europe.

defs.def_en: The balance of power is the way in which power is distributed between rival groups or countries.

defs.def_cn: （小政党能够使某一较大政党成为政府中多数派的）举足轻重的地位

ext.ext_cn: 比例代表制使得少数党在议会中频频拥有举足轻重的地位。
ext.ext_en: The system of proportional representation has led to the minority parties continually holding the balance of power in the parliament.

defs.def_en: If a small political party holds the balance of power in a government, it is able to give a larger party a majority by supporting this larger party.

ext.ext_cn: 她声称在晋升时自己被一次又一次地排除在外。
ext.ext_en: She claimed she was repeatedly passed over for promotion...

ext.ext_cn: 他们遭到拒绝，满心失望，备受冷落，无人理会。
ext.ext_en: They've been rejected, disappointed, ignored, passed over.

defs.def_en: If someone is passed over for a job or position, they do not get the job or position and someone younger or  less experienced is chosen instead.

defs.def_cn: （在谈话或演讲中）不提及，忽略，跳过

ext.ext_cn: 他基本没有提及政府政绩。
ext.ext_en: He largely passed over the government's record...

ext.ext_cn: 他们似乎认为应该对她的罪行保持沉默。
ext.ext_en: They seem to think her crimes should be passed over in silence.

defs.def_en: If you pass over a topic in a conversation or speech, you do not talk about it.

defs.def_cn: （规则、信息等）固定不变的，明确的

ext.ext_cn: 关于谁来支付什么费用并没有明确的规定，只是遵循传统的准则罢了。
ext.ext_en: There are no hard and fast rules, but rather traditional guidelines as to who pays for what...

ext.ext_cn: 目前还没有明确的时间表。
ext.ext_en: At the moment there's no hard and fast timetable.

defs.def_en: If you say that there are no hard and fast rules, or that there is no hard and fast information about something, you are indicating that there are no fixed or definite rules or facts.
Vol. is used as a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) volume when you are referring to one or more books in a series of books.

ext.ext_cn: 他被任命为天主教的助祭。
ext.ext_en: He had been ordained as a deacon in the Roman Catholic Church.

ext.ext_cn: 天主教牧师
ext.ext_en: ...a Roman Catholic priest.

defs.def_en: The Roman Catholic Church is the same as the Catholic Church.

ext.ext_cn: 和她一样，玛丽亚也是天主教徒。
ext.ext_en: Like her, Maria was a Roman Catholic.

defs.def_en: A Roman Catholic is the same as a Catholic .

ext.ext_cn: 交通堵塞丝毫不见缓解，街道被堵得水泄不通。
ext.ext_en: The streets are wedged solid with near-constant traffic gridlock.

defs.def_en: Gridlock is the situation that exists when all the roads in a particular place are so full of vehicles that none of them can move.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为这些政策将来会导致僵局。
ext.ext_en: He agreed that these policies will lead to gridlock in the future.

defs.def_en: You can use gridlock to refer to a situation in an argument or dispute when neither side is prepared to give in, so no agreement can be reached.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不时髦的;没有品位的;不老练的

ext.ext_cn: 这音乐真是太土了。
ext.ext_en: The music's really naff.

ext.ext_cn: 土得掉渣的情侣装
ext.ext_en: ...naff 'his and hers' matching outfits.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is naff, you mean it is very unfashionable or unsophisticated.

ext.ext_cn: 她毫不客气地叫那些烦人的摄影者“滚开”。
ext.ext_en: She didn't hesitate to tell intrusive photographers to 'naff off'.

defs.def_en: If someone tells you to naff off, they are rudely telling you to go away.

ext.ext_cn: 要达到这个限度，还有很多技术问题必须解决。
ext.ext_en: In order to reach this limit a number of technical problems will have to be solved.

ext.ext_cn: 要求具备技术知识的工作岗位
ext.ext_en: ...jobs that require technical knowledge...

defs.def_en: Technical means involving the sorts of machines, processes, and materials that are used in industry, transport, and communications.

ext.ext_cn: 他们技艺超群。
ext.ext_en: Their technical ability is exceptional...

ext.ext_cn: 在雕塑领域，外国艺术家的技艺也早已得到认可。
ext.ext_en: In the realm of sculpture too, the technical skill of foreign artists was long recognised.

defs.def_en: You use technical to describe the practical skills and methods used to do an activity such as an art, a craft, or a sport.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 晒斑的专业术语叫红斑。
ext.ext_en: The technical term for sunburn is erythema...

ext.ext_cn: 他刚出了本书：大开本，插图精美，专业性也不太强。
ext.ext_en: He's just written a book: large format, nicely illustrated and not too technical.

defs.def_en: Technical language involves using special words to describe the details of a specialized activity.

defs.def_cn: (事件、行动、程序)象征的，象征性的

ext.ext_cn: 许多拉丁美洲的官员都在强调此行的重要象征意义。
ext.ext_en: A lot of Latin-American officials are stressing the symbolic importance of the trip...

ext.ext_cn: 今天的举动在很大程度上只是象征性的。
ext.ext_en: The move today was largely symbolic.

defs.def_en: If you describe an event, action, or procedure as symbolic, you mean that it represents an important change, although it has little practical effect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 穿上黄色的衣服象征着春天来了。
ext.ext_en: Yellow clothes are worn as symbolic of spring...

ext.ext_cn: 一个女人把长发剪短就表示她想要改变生活。
ext.ext_en: The change from long to short hair is symbolic of the woman's need for change in her whole life.

defs.def_en: Something that is symbolic of a person or thing is regarded or used as a symbol of them.

ext.ext_cn: 地貌的符号化呈现
ext.ext_en: ...symbolic representations of landscape.

defs.def_en: Symbolic is used to describe things involving or relating to symbols.

defs.def_cn: (为博取同情或赞赏而)假装可怜的，满脸苦相的

ext.ext_cn: “老样子，”他那故作可怜的妻子嘟囔道。
ext.ext_en: 'As usual,' muttered his martyred wife...

ext.ext_cn: 你一脸可怜状，叹息道：“要是你真打算……”
ext.ext_en: You put on your martyred expression, sigh and say, 'If you really want to...'.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as martyred, you mean that they often exaggerate their suffering in order to gain sympathy or praise.

ext.ext_cn: 带尖顶的栅栏
ext.ext_en: ...spiked railings.

ext.ext_cn: 带鞋钉的高尔夫球鞋
ext.ext_en: ...spiked golf shoes.

defs.def_en: Something that is spiked has one or more spikes on it.
If someone has spiked hair, their hair is short and sticks up all over their head.

ext.ext_cn: 通过采取更好的坐姿，你的腹部马上就会看起来平坦一些。
ext.ext_en: You can make your stomach look flatter instantly by improving your posture...

ext.ext_cn: 锻炼、新鲜空气和好的坐立姿势都很有益。
ext.ext_en: Exercise, fresh air, and good posture are all helpful...

defs.def_en: Your posture is the position in which you stand or sit.

ext.ext_cn: 军方随时准备由防御立场转向备战立场。
ext.ext_en: The military machine is ready to change its defensive posture to one prepared for action...

ext.ext_cn: 没有一家银行因为这次调查而对该交易改变立场。
ext.ext_en: None of the banks changed their posture on the deal as a result of the inquiry.

defs.def_en: A posture is an attitude that you have towards something.

defs.def_cn: 故作姿态；装腔作势；装模作样

ext.ext_cn: 她说总统也许只是在做样子而已。
ext.ext_en: She says the President may just be posturing.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone is posturing when you disapprove of their behaviour because you think they are trying to give a particular impression in order to deceive people.

defs.def_cn: 印式炸菜饼；印式炸菜团

ext.ext_cn: 印式松炸洋葱圈
ext.ext_en: ...an onion bhaji.

defs.def_en: A bhaji is a small piece of food of Indian origin, made of vegetables fried in batter with spices.

defs.def_cn: （计算机）影视成像技术，图像渐变技术
defs.def_en: Morphing is a technique which involves using a computer to make an image on film or television appear to change shape or change into something else.

ext.ext_cn: 有些工作很可能会对家庭生活产生不良影响。
ext.ext_en: Some jobs are quite likely to have a negative spillover into family life...

ext.ext_cn: 拆除这座大楼带来的损失仅仅是一些玻璃被震碎了。
ext.ext_en: Spillover damage from the building's demolition was confined to some broken glass.

defs.def_en: A spillover is a situation or feeling that starts in one place but then begins to happen or have an effect somewhere else.

ext.ext_cn: 乔安妮刚要作保证，丹尼尔就把她打断了。
ext.ext_en: Immediately, Daniel cut in on Joanne's attempts at reassurance...

ext.ext_cn: “不是真的，”公爵夫人插话道。
ext.ext_en: 'Not true,' the Duchess cut in.

defs.def_en: If you cut in on someone, you interrupt them when they are speaking.

ext.ext_cn: 工作机会少，尤其是对应届毕业生而言
ext.ext_en: ...the lack of job opportunities, particularly for school-leavers.

defs.def_en: School leavers are young people who have just left school, because they have completed their time there.

defs.def_cn: 市民（尤指比较富有和受人尊敬的人）

ext.ext_cn: 普拉托市民
ext.ext_en: ...the burghers of Prato.

defs.def_en: The burghers of a town or city are the people who live there, especially the richer or more respectable people.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的船在暴风雨中倾覆后有 48 人溺亡。

defs.def_en: If two things entwine or are entwined, they closely resemble or are linked to each other, and they are difficult to separate or identify.

defs.def_en: If you think a man's sense of humour is silly or rude, you can describe it as schoolboy humour.

defs.def_cn: 相互独立的;彼此不关联的

ext.ext_en: Your questions should be independent of each other...

ext.ext_en: We're going independent from the university and setting up our own group...

defs.def_en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

ext.ext_cn: 菲尔现在不那么依赖父母了。
ext.ext_en: Phil was now much more independent of his parents...

ext.ext_cn: 她希望在经济上能够自立。
ext.ext_en: She would like to be financially independent...

defs.def_en: If someone is independent, they do not need help or money from anyone else.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一个完全独立的国家
ext.ext_en: ...a fully independent state...

ext.ext_en: Papua New Guinea became independent from Australia in 1975.

defs.def_en: Independent countries and states are not ruled by other countries but have their own government.

defs.def_cn: (组织)独立的，不受他人控制的

ext.ext_cn: 独立电视台
ext.ext_en: ...an independent television station.

ext.ext_cn: 政风处,一个独立的机构
ext.ext_en: ...the Office of Government Ethics, an independent agency.

defs.def_en: An independent organization or other body is one that controls its own finances and operations, rather than being controlled by someone else.

ext.ext_en: He taught chemistry at a leading independent school.

defs.def_en: An independent school does not receive money from the government or local council, but from the fees paid by its students' parents or from charities.

ext.ext_en: The government ordered an independent inquiry into the affair...

ext.ext_en: An independent opinion poll published today shows growing discontent with the government.

defs.def_en: An independent inquiry or opinion is one that involves people who are not connected with a particular situation, and should therefore be fair.

ext.ext_cn: 最近一位无党派候选人的支持率迅速上升。
ext.ext_en: There's been a late surge of support for an independent candidate.

ext.ext_cn: 法国最有影响力的无党派政治家

defs.def_en: An independent politician is one who does not represent any political party.

ext.ext_en: …the motorway tunnels under the Hudson river.

defs.def_en: A tunnel is a long passage which has been made under the ground, usually through a hill or under the sea.

ext.ext_cn: 叛乱者挖地道逃离了戒备最为森严的监狱。
ext.ext_en: The rebels tunnelled out of a maximum security jail...

ext.ext_en: The caterpillars tunnel into the fruit to grow and mature.

defs.def_en: To tunnel somewhere means to make a tunnel there.

ext.ext_cn: 他晚年成了一个艺术赞助人。
ext.ext_en: In his old age he became a benefactor of the arts.

defs.def_en: A benefactor is a person who helps a person or organization by giving them money.

ext.ext_cn: 他听我诉说悲伤的故事。
ext.ext_en: He listened to my tale of woe...

ext.ext_en: All around women wailed their woe or screamed abuse.

defs.def_en: Woe is very great sadness.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有告诉亲友自己的烦恼。
ext.ext_en: He did not tell his relatives and friends about his woes.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's problems as their woes .

ext.ext_cn: 昨天从拉斯维加斯到圣迭戈都感觉到了这几股冲击波。
ext.ext_en: The shock waves yesterday were felt from Las Vegas to San Diego.

defs.def_en: A shock wave is an area of very high pressure moving through the air, earth, or water. It is caused by an explosion or an earthquake, or by an object travelling faster than sound.

ext.ext_cn: 这一罪行在全国上下引起一片轰动。
ext.ext_en: The crime sent shock waves throughout the country.

defs.def_en: A shock wave is the effect of something surprising, such as a piece of unpleasant news, that causes strong reactions when it spreads through a place.

defs.def_cn: (基督教)贵格会教徒，公谊会教徒，教友会教徒
defs.def_en: A Quaker is a person who belongs to a Christian group called the Society of Friends.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个慷慨大方、勇于自我牺牲的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a generous self-sacrificing man.

defs.def_en: Someone who is self-sacrificing gives up what they want so that other people can have what they need or want.

defs.def_cn: 国内的;内政的;(组织)内部的

ext.ext_cn: 该国加强了国内安保。
ext.ext_en: The country stepped up internal security...

ext.ext_cn: 我们如今拥有一个内部没有边界的欧洲。
ext.ext_en: We now have a Europe without internal borders...

defs.def_en: Internal is used to describe things that exist or happen inside a country or organization.

ext.ext_en: Some of the internal walls of my house are made of plasterboard.

defs.def_en: Internal is used to describe things that exist or happen inside a particular person, object, or place.

ext.ext_en: The notions we children were able to form of the great world beyond were exceedingly nebulous...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as nebulous, you mean that it is vague and not clearly defined or not easy to describe.

ext.ext_en: She's taken surplus goods and throwaways and given them useful new lives with the aid of paint and imagination.

defs.def_en: A throwaway product is intended to be used only for a short time, and then to be thrown away.

ext.ext_en: ...a throwaway remark she later regretted...

ext.ext_en: The humour and throwaway lines ensure that the piece never loses its pace.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone makes a throwaway remark or gesture, you mean that they make it in a casual way, although it may be important, or have some serious or humorous effect.

ext.ext_en: Mr Lloyd specialised in aftercare services.

ext.ext_en: ...the BBC's current affairs programme 'Panorama'.

ext.ext_en: I had a case of the jitters during my first two speeches...

ext.ext_en: Officials feared that any public announcements would only increase market jitters.

ext.ext_en: ...a gang of hyenas, stalking about the veldt.

defs.def_en: The veldt is a high area of flat grassy land with very few trees in southern Africa.

ext.ext_en: I shall not reveal the movie's final reel.

ext.ext_en: In the old days the woman stayed at home and the man earned the money.

defs.def_en: If you stay where you are, you continue to be there and do not leave.

ext.ext_en: He tried to stay a few months every year in Scotland.

defs.def_en: If you stay in a town, or hotel, or at someone's house, you live there for a short time.

defs.def_en: If someone or something stays in a particular state or situation, they continue to be in it.

ext.ext_en: Government employees and officers also stayed away from work during the strike...

ext.ext_en: Every single employee turned up at the meeting, even people who usually stayed away.

ext.ext_cn: 在过去，除非有国家提出请求,否则联合国不会干涉各国内政。
ext.ext_en: In the past, the UN has stayed out of the internal affairs of countries unless invited in...

ext.ext_en: After months of staying well out of the problem, Washington has expressed a willingness to help find a solution.

ext.ext_cn: 情况已然明朗，工会无法和政府抗衡。
ext.ext_en: It became clear that the Union was not going to beat the government...

ext.ext_cn: 他们认识到这一严厉举措是战胜通货膨胀的唯一希望。
ext.ext_en: They recognise that tough action offers the only hope of beating inflation...

defs.def_en: If you beat something that you are fighting against, for example an organization, a problem, or a disease, you defeat it.

ext.ext_cn: 救援人员因风浪太大而被迫中断工作。
ext.ext_en: The rescuers were beaten back by strong winds and currents...

ext.ext_cn: 南非执政的国民党已经击退了右翼分子的一次挑战。
ext.ext_en: South Africa's  ruling National Party has beaten off a right-wing challenge.

defs.def_en: If an attack or an attempt is beaten off or is beaten back, it is stopped, often temporarily.

ext.ext_cn: 当软件公司的老板比卖保险强多了。
ext.ext_en: Being boss of a software firm beats selling insurance...

ext.ext_cn: 辛苦一天之后美美地泡个热水澡比什么都强。
ext.ext_en: Nothing quite beats the luxury of soaking in a long, hot bath at the end of a tiring day...

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing beats another, you mean that it is better than it.

defs.def_cn: 没有比…更好的；什么也比不上；最好的莫过于

ext.ext_cn: 做清洁没有比用肥皂和水更好的了。
ext.ext_en: You can't beat soap and water for cleansing.

defs.def_en: If you say you can't beat a particular thing you mean that it is the best thing of its kind.

ext.ext_cn: 他们要努力赶在午夜的最后期限之前完成。
ext.ext_en: They were trying to beat the midnight deadline...

ext.ext_cn: 那些为了在抢购高峰前下手而在星期天购物的人是在浪费时间。
ext.ext_en: Those who shop on Sunday to beat the rush are wasting their time.

defs.def_en: To beat a time limit or an event means to achieve something before that time or event.

defs.def_cn: （警察的）辖区，巡逻区；（记者的）负责采访的区域

ext.ext_cn: 小分队的警察比那些负责大片区域的警察更了解自己管片的群众。
ext.ext_en: The team police get to know the people in their patrol areas better than cops who must cover a larger beat.

defs.def_en: A police officer's or journalist's beat is the area for which he or she is responsible.

defs.def_cn: 把…难住；使不明白；使无法解释

ext.ext_cn: “不管怎样，我到底做错了什么？”——“这我也不知道，刘易斯。”
ext.ext_en: 'What am I doing wrong, anyway?' — 'Beats me, Lewis.'...

ext.ext_cn: 我真搞不懂你怎么会这么麻木。
ext.ext_en: How you can be so insensitive absolutely beats me.

defs.def_en: You use beat in expressions such as 'It beats me' or 'What beats me is' to indicate that you cannot understand or explain something.

ext.ext_cn: 趁早滚开。
ext.ext_en: Beat it before it's too late.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to beat it, you are telling them to go away.

defs.def_cn: （表示惊讶或恼怒）竟然有这种事？岂有此理！

ext.ext_cn: 真是岂有此理！格雷厄姆·格林在弗里敦，而我却在非洲的另一边。
ext.ext_en: Can you beat it; there was Graham Greene in Freetown and there was I on the other side of Africa.

defs.def_en: You can say Can you beat it? or Can you beat that? to show that you are surprised and perhaps annoyed about something.

defs.def_cn: 比…抢先行动；赶在…前面（做某事）

ext.ext_cn: 别拖得太久，不然就会有人捷足先登了。
ext.ext_en: Don't  be too long about it or you'll find someone has beaten you to it.

defs.def_en: If you intend to do something but someone beats you to it, they do it before you do.
If you can't beat them, join them means that, if someone is too strong for you to defeat, it is better to be on the same side as them.

ext.ext_cn: “你眼红吗？”——“除非我把持不住自己，”他毫不犹豫地说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Are you jealous?' — 'Only when I'm not in control,' he says, not missing a beat.

defs.def_en: If you say or do something without missing a beat, you continue to speak or do it, even though people might have expected you to hesitate or stop.

ext.ext_cn: 丝凯作为黄金海岸大红大紫的模特儿，自结婚以后从来就没有错失过任何机会。
ext.ext_en: Skye has scarcely missed a beat as one of the Gold Coast's spectacular models since her marriage.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone never misses a beat, you mean that they always know what is going on and how they can take advantage of it.

ext.ext_cn: 值勤警员注意观察情况，对救援呼叫及时反应，确保让百姓有一种安全感。
ext.ext_en: The officer on the beat picks up information; hears cries for help; makes people feel safe.

defs.def_en: A police officer on the beat is on duty, walking around the area for which he or she is responsible.

ext.ext_cn: 他手脚并用地打着拍子。
ext.ext_en: He beats time with hands and feet.

defs.def_en: If you beat time to a piece of music, you move your hand or foot up and down in time with the music. A conductor beats time to show the choir or orchestra how fast they should sing or play the music.

defs.def_cn: (肥皂、洗发液等)含药物的，药制的
defs.def_en: A medicated soap or shampoo contains substances which are intended to kill bacteria and therefore make your skin or hair healthier.
A beast of burden is an animal such as an ox or a donkey that is used for carrying or pulling things.

ext.ext_cn: 她咬了咬下唇。
ext.ext_en: She bit her lower lip.

ext.ext_cn: 公共汽车的下层
ext.ext_en: ...the lower deck of the bus...

defs.def_en: You can use lower to refer to the bottom one of a pair of things.

ext.ext_cn: 用一个小靠垫帮助支撑腰部。
ext.ext_en: Use a small cushion to help give support to the lower back.

ext.ext_cn: 从塔楼底部开始烧起的大火
ext.ext_en: ...fires which started in the lower part of a tower block.

defs.def_en: You can use lower to refer to the bottom part of something.

ext.ext_cn: 奖项已使政务委员会的低层官员们愤愤不平。
ext.ext_en: Already the awards are causing resentment in the lower ranks of council officers...

ext.ext_cn: 该国最高法院已推翻了下级法院的判决。
ext.ext_en: The nation's  highest court reversed the lower court's  decision...

defs.def_en: You can use lower to refer to people or things that are less important than similar people or things.

ext.ext_cn: 两名记者不得不帮忙把灵柩慢慢地放进墓穴中。
ext.ext_en: Two reporters had to help lower the coffin into the grave...

ext.ext_cn: 索科洛夫斯基缓缓地坐到黑色皮椅上。
ext.ext_en: Sokolowski lowered himself into the black leather chair...

defs.def_en: If you lower something, you move it slowly downwards.

ext.ext_cn: 中央银行已将利率调低了两个百分点。
ext.ext_en: The Central Bank has lowered interest rates by 2 percent...

ext.ext_cn: 这种药通过黏合肠内的脂肪降低胆固醇水平。
ext.ext_en: This drug lowers cholesterol levels by binding fats in the intestine.

defs.def_en: If you lower something, you make it less in amount, degree, value, or quality.

ext.ext_cn: 她再次回到里面时低着头，与摄影师擦身而过。
ext.ext_en: She lowered her head and brushed past photographers as she went back inside...

ext.ext_cn: 她低头盯着放在大腿上的双手。
ext.ext_en: She lowered her gaze to the hands in her lap.

defs.def_en: If someone lowers their head or eyes, they look downwards, for example because they are sad or embarrassed.

ext.ext_cn: 不要自贬身份,不要学他们那样。
ext.ext_en: Don't lower yourself, don't be the way they are...

ext.ext_cn: 为得到我想要的东西，我一点都不忌讳把自己降格到跟莱麦尔一样。
ext.ext_en: I've got no qualms about lowering myself to Lemmer's level to get what I want.

defs.def_en: If you say that you would not lower yourself by doing something, you mean that you would not behave in a way that would make you or other people respect you less.

ext.ext_cn: 那个男子靠上前去，压低了声音。
ext.ext_en: The man moved closer, lowering his voice...

ext.ext_cn: 他神秘地压低了嗓音。
ext.ext_en: His voice lowers confidentially.

defs.def_en: If you lower your voice or if your voice lowers, you speak more quietly.

ext.ext_cn: 我姐姐在身上抹了防晒油，躺在游泳池边睡着了。
ext.ext_en: My sister smeared herself with suntan oil and slept by the swimming pool...

ext.ext_cn: 在色拉碗的内壁上抹一点橄榄油。
ext.ext_en: Smear a little olive oil over the inside of the salad bowl.

defs.def_en: If you smear a surface with an oily or sticky substance or smear the substance onto the surface, you spread a layer of the substance over the surface.

ext.ext_cn: 他的下巴上粘着肉汁。
ext.ext_en: There was a smear of gravy on his chin.

defs.def_en: A smear is a dirty or oily mark.

ext.ext_cn: 污蔑英国广播公司主管的企图
ext.ext_en: ...an attempt to smear the director-general of the BBC.

defs.def_en: To smear someone means to spread unpleasant and untrue rumours or accusations about them in order to damage their reputation.

ext.ext_cn: 他把所有的指责都归结为政治对手们的造谣攻势。
ext.ext_en: He puts all the accusations down to a smear campaign by his political opponents.

defs.def_en: A smear is an unpleasant and untrue rumour or accusation that is intended to damage someone's reputation.

defs.def_cn: 涂片检查(对妇女子宫颈取样检查癌变的一种方法)
defs.def_en: A smear or a smear test is a medical test in which a few cells are taken from a woman's cervix and examined to see if any cancer cells are present.
A biscuit is a small flat cake that is crisp and usually sweet.
A biscuit is a small round dry cake that is made with baking powder, baking soda, or yeast.

defs.def_cn: （强调吃惊）竟然做出这种（愚蠢、粗野或自私的）事情
defs.def_en: If someone has done something very stupid, rude, or selfish, you can say that they take the biscuit or that what they have done takes the biscuit, to emphasize your surprise at their behaviour.

defs.def_cn: （用于书面表示突然感到疼痛时的叫喊声）哎哟

ext.ext_cn: 哎哟！别那样！
ext.ext_en: Ow! Don't do that!

defs.def_en: 'Ow!' is used in writing to represent the noise that people make when they suddenly feel pain.

ext.ext_cn: 他称毒品是这个时代最大的祸害。
ext.ext_en: He described drugs as the greatest calamity of the age...

ext.ext_cn: 兵燹战祸
ext.ext_en: ...the calamity of war...

defs.def_en: A calamity is an event that causes a great deal of damage, destruction, or personal distress.

ext.ext_cn: 把没种庄稼和植物的土地都深翻一遍。
ext.ext_en: Dig over any ground that is clear of crops and plants...

ext.ext_cn: 把土地彻底犁开。
ext.ext_en: Dig the soil over thoroughly.

defs.def_en: If you dig over an area of soil, you dig it thoroughly, so that the soil becomes looser and free from lumps.

ext.ext_cn: 我意外发现了一个非常简单却能精确了解我所花钱去向的方法。
ext.ext_en: I stumbled across an extremely simple but very exact method for understanding where my money went...

ext.ext_cn: 历史上记载他们曾意外地发现了一处壮观的瀑布。
ext.ext_en: History relates that they stumbled on a magnificent waterfall.

defs.def_en: If you stumble across something or stumble on it, you find it or discover it unexpectedly.

ext.ext_cn: 此行将会结束两国多年来的疏远关系。
ext.ext_en: The trip will bring to an end years of estrangement between the two countries...

ext.ext_cn: 从那一天开始了长达20年的互不往来。
ext.ext_en: That day marked the beginning of a 20-year estrangement.

defs.def_en: Estrangement is the state of being estranged from someone or the length of time for which you are estranged.

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮弗高兴地尖叫起来，然后拥抱了我。
ext.ext_en: Jennifer squealed with delight and hugged me...

ext.ext_cn: 汽车快速驶过拐角时，轮胎又一次发出嘎吱声。
ext.ext_en: The car's tires squealed again as it sped around the corner.

defs.def_en: If someone or something squeals, they make a long, high-pitched sound.
An apothecary was a person who prepared medicines for people.

ext.ext_cn: 芝麻籽
ext.ext_en: ...sesame seeds...

ext.ext_cn: 我已经把几片芝麻脆饼放进烤箱里烤了。
ext.ext_en: I've put some sesame crackers in the oven to bake.

defs.def_en: Sesame is a plant grown for its seeds and oil, which are used in cooking.

defs.def_cn: 诺龙(可提高运动成绩的违禁药品)
defs.def_en: Nandrolone is type of drug that can improve performance in sports and is used illegally by some sportspeople.

ext.ext_cn: 警方告诫驾车者出门上班要留出富余时间。
ext.ext_en: Police warned motorists to allow extra time to get to work...

ext.ext_cn: 额外雇用了一些员工来应付繁忙时期。
ext.ext_en: Extra staff have been taken on to cover busy periods...

defs.def_en: You use extra to describe an amount, person, or thing that is added to others of the same kind, or that can be added to others of the same kind.

defs.def_cn: 费用另计的；额外收费的

ext.ext_cn: 国外订单邮费另计。
ext.ext_en: For foreign orders postage is extra...

ext.ext_cn: 你的餐费另计。
ext.ext_en: The price of your meal is extra.

defs.def_en: If something is extra, you have to pay more money for it in addition to what you are already paying for something.

ext.ext_cn: 她非常厌恶大酒店额外收取这么多费用，账单金额都快翻倍了。
ext.ext_en: She is disgusted by big hotels adding so many extras to the bill that it nearly doubles...

ext.ext_cn: 没有隐性的额外费用。
ext.ext_en: There are no hidden extras.

defs.def_en: Extras are additional amounts of money that are added to the price that you have to pay for something.

ext.ext_cn: 可选的额外项目包括在顶级餐厅学习厨艺。
ext.ext_en: Optional extras include cooking tuition at a top restaurant...

ext.ext_cn: 他们花在下馆子等额外消费上的钱也少多了。
ext.ext_en: They are also spending much less on extras like meals in restaurants.

defs.def_en: Extras are things which are not necessary in a situation, activity, or object, but which make it more comfortable, useful, or enjoyable.

defs.def_cn: （电影中的）临时演员，群众演员
defs.def_en: The extras in a film are the people who play unimportant parts, for example as members of a crowd.

ext.ext_cn: 我不得不格外小心。
ext.ext_en: I'd have to be extra careful...

ext.ext_cn: 是什么让华丽的花园格外特别？
ext.ext_en: What makes a magnificent garden extra special?...

defs.def_en: You can use extra in front of adjectives and adverbs to emphasize the quality that they are describing.

ext.ext_cn: 用来增稠的玉米面
ext.ext_en: ...cornstarch, used as a thickener...

ext.ext_cn: 用多少增稠剂？
ext.ext_en: How much thickener is used?

defs.def_en: A thickener is a substance that is added to a liquid in order to make it stiffer and more solid.

ext.ext_cn: 猎户大星云
ext.ext_en: ...the Great Nebula.

defs.def_en: A nebula is a cloud of dust and gas in space. New stars are produced from nebulae.
A spacecraft is a rocket or other vehicle that can travel in space.

ext.ext_cn: 他通过弑君登上了沙皇宝座。
ext.ext_en: He had become czar through regicide.

defs.def_en: Regicide is the act of killing a king.

ext.ext_cn: 一些弑君者被判处死刑。
ext.ext_en: Some of the regicides were sentenced to death.

defs.def_en: A regicide is a person who kills a king.

ext.ext_cn: 从巴黎有快车前往波尔多，全程不到4个小时。
ext.ext_en: There is an express service from Paris which completes the journey to Bordeaux in under 4 hours.

defs.def_en: When you make a journey, you travel from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 我们该如何开始这个“心灵历程”来了解自己呢？
ext.ext_en: How do we go about embarking on this  'inner journey' to understand ourselves?...

ext.ext_cn: 我的电影试图为我自己也为观众描述一个自我发现的心灵之旅。
ext.ext_en: My films try to describe a journey of discovery, both for myself and the watcher.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a person's experience of changing or developing from one state of mind to another as a journey.

ext.ext_cn: 1935年2月，娜奥米第一次来到美国旅行。
ext.ext_en: In February 1935, Naomi journeyed to the United States for the first time...

ext.ext_cn: 她骑马游历了非洲和土耳其。
ext.ext_en: She has journeyed on horseback through Africa and Turkey.

defs.def_en: If you journey somewhere, you travel there.

defs.def_cn: 导致，造成（某种感觉、气氛、状况等）

ext.ext_cn: 这有助于营造一种博爱的感觉。
ext.ext_en: It helps engender a sense of common humanity...

ext.ext_cn: 鲍尔斯先生能够让学生和音乐家都感到快乐。
ext.ext_en: Mr Bowles could engender delight in students and musicians alike.

defs.def_en: If someone or something engenders a particular feeling, atmosphere, or situation, they cause it to occur.

ext.ext_cn: 公园位于一片煤田上。
ext.ext_en: The park lies on top of a coalfield.

defs.def_en: A coalfield is a region where there is coal under the ground.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我的腿的确比较瘦长。
ext.ext_en: I did have rather spindly legs.

defs.def_en: Something that is spindly is long and thin and looks very weak.
Ice-skates are boots with a thin metal bar underneath that people wear to move quickly on ice.

ext.ext_cn: 埃丝特·兰森，一场全国性的反抗暴力运动的领导者
ext.ext_en: ...Esther Rantzen, who is spearheading a national campaign against bullying...

ext.ext_cn: 直升机可以担任空中进攻的前锋，从而在某种程度上取代坦克的地位。
ext.ext_en: Helicopters can to some extent take the place of tanks by spearheading the airborne attack.

defs.def_en: If someone spearheads a campaign or an attack, they lead it.

ext.ext_cn: 今天早晨，海军陆战队作为先头部队率先登陆以占领主要目标。
ext.ext_en: The marines went ashore as a spearhead this morning to capture key targets.

defs.def_en: The spearhead of a campaign is the person or group that leads it.

defs.def_cn: (疾病)使人消瘦衰弱的，消耗性的
defs.def_en: A wasting disease is one which makes you gradually become thinner and weaker.

ext.ext_cn: 他几乎喘不过气来。
ext.ext_en: He could scarcely breathe...

ext.ext_cn: 我几乎不认识他。
ext.ext_en: I scarcely knew him...

defs.def_en: You use scarcely to emphasize that something is only just true or only just the case.

ext.ext_cn: 它不太可能是巧合。
ext.ext_en: It can scarcely be coincidence...

ext.ext_cn: 然而，昨天他的观点似乎毫无关联。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday, however, his views seemed scarcely relevant...

defs.def_en: You can use scarcely to say that something is not true or is not the case, in a humorous or critical way.

ext.ext_cn: 他们刚离开，扛着步枪的士兵们就到了。
ext.ext_en: Scarcely had they left before soldiers arrived armed with rifles...

ext.ext_cn: 布鲁斯刚和我们握了握手，电话就响了。
ext.ext_en: Bruce had scarcely shaken our hands when the phone rang.

defs.def_en: If you say scarcely had one thing happened when something else happened, you mean that the first event was followed immediately by the second.
A pathogen is any organism which can cause disease in a person, animal, or plant.
A GI is a soldier in the United States army.

defs.def_cn: 做买卖的人;生意人;商人
defs.def_en: A marketer is someone whose job involves marketing.

defs.def_cn: (标在门上、墙上或桌上的)名牌，标示牌
defs.def_en: A nameplate is a sign on a door, wall, or desk which shows the name of the person or organization that occupies a particular place.

defs.def_cn: 靠他人养活的人;寄生虫
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a sponger, you mean that they sponge off other people or organizations.
A cavern is a large deep cave.

defs.def_cn: 黑洞洞的大厦(或大房间)

ext.ext_cn: 厨房现在黑洞洞的，角落里有只破旧的黑色炉子。
ext.ext_en: The kitchen now is a dark cavern, with an antiquated black stove in a corner.

defs.def_en: If you describe the inside of a building or a room as a cavern, you mean that it is very large and, usually, dark or without much furniture.

ext.ext_cn: 土耳其安全部队已经开始搜寻失踪人员。
ext.ext_en: The Turkish security forces have started searching for the missing men...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在地板上寻找一处能够坐下的地方。
ext.ext_en: They searched for a spot where they could sit on the floor...

defs.def_en: If you search for something or someone, you look carefully for them.

defs.def_cn: 在…中搜寻(或搜索);搜查(某地)

ext.ext_cn: 武装部队昨天搜查了该医院。
ext.ext_en: Armed troops searched the hospital yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 她在她的书桌上搜寻必要的信息。
ext.ext_en: She searched her desk for the necessary information...

defs.def_en: If you search a place, you look carefully for something or someone there.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有生还的可能，因此人们放弃了搜寻。
ext.ext_en: There was no chance of him being found alive and the search was abandoned...

ext.ext_cn: 埃及称寻求中东和解刻不容缓。
ext.ext_en: Egypt has said there is no time to lose in the search for a Middle East settlement.

defs.def_en: A search is an attempt to find something or someone by looking for them carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 那名男子拿过她手中的提箱，然后对她搜身。
ext.ext_en: The man took her suitcase from her and then searched her...

ext.ext_cn: 他首先要搜查他们身上是否携带武器。
ext.ext_en: His first task was to search them for weapons.

defs.def_en: If a police officer or someone else in authority searches you, they look carefully to see whether you have something hidden on you.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以利用因特网的目录服务搜索人名。
ext.ext_en: You can use a directory service to search for people on the Internet.

ext.ext_cn: 他在电脑上搜索当地的新闻报道。
ext.ext_en: He was doing a computer search of local news articles.

defs.def_en: If you search for information on a computer, you give the computer an instruction to find that information.

ext.ext_cn: 内心痛苦、突感寂寞的她去寻找琼－保罗。
ext.ext_en: Miserable, and unexpectedly lonely, she went in search of Jean-Paul...

ext.ext_cn: 法律已经将那些逐寻更好商机的人们拒之门外。
ext.ext_en: The law already denies entry to people in search of better economic opportunities.

defs.def_en: If you go in search of something or someone, you try to find them.

ext.ext_cn: “那他为什么突然感兴趣了？”——“我怎么知道。”
ext.ext_en: 'So why did he get interested all of a sudden?' — 'Search me.'

defs.def_en: You say 'search me' when someone asks you a question and you want to emphasize that you do not know the answer.

ext.ext_cn: 走开，去玩一会吧。
ext.ext_en: Run along now and play for a bit.

defs.def_en: If you tell a child to run along, you mean that you want them to go away.

ext.ext_cn: 有人认为总统忽视了经济，总统正试图消除这种看法。
ext.ext_en: The President is attempting to dispel the notion that he has neglected the economy.

defs.def_en: To dispel an idea or feeling that people have means to stop them having it.
Archaeology is the study of the societies and peoples of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

ext.ext_cn: 语法规则中并没有规定句子以介词结尾是错误的。
ext.ext_en: There is nothing in the rules of grammar to suggest that ending a sentence with a preposition is wrong.

defs.def_en: A preposition is a word such as 'by', 'for', 'into', or 'with' which usually has a noun group as its object.

ext.ext_cn: 一沓钞票
ext.ext_en: ...a wad of banknotes.

ext.ext_cn: 一团浸泡了清洁剂的棉花
ext.ext_en: ...a wad of cotton soaked in cleaning fluid.

defs.def_en: A wad of something such as paper or cloth is a tight bundle or ball of it.
A quisling is someone who helps an enemy army that has taken control of their country.

ext.ext_cn: 她深深地吸了口气。
ext.ext_en: She breathed in deeply.

defs.def_en: When you breathe in, you take some air into your lungs.

ext.ext_cn: 他手触额发假装尊敬。
ext.ext_en: He touched his forelock in mock deference.

defs.def_en: A forelock is a piece of hair that falls over your forehead. People often used to pull their forelocks to show respect for other people of a higher class than they were.
If you say that a person tugs their forelock to another person, you are criticizing them for showing too much respect to the second person or being unnecessarily worried about their opinions.

ext.ext_cn: 人寿保险单
ext.ext_en: ...a life assurance policy.

defs.def_en: Life assurance is the same as life insurance .

defs.def_cn: 出资人;出资方;金融(资本)家
defs.def_en: A financier is a person, company, or government that provides money for projects or businesses.

defs.def_cn: (汽车车顶可开启的)活动顶板，天窗
defs.def_en: A sunroof is a panel in the roof of a car that opens to let sunshine and air enter the car.

defs.def_cn: 既得利益;既定权利;好处

ext.ext_cn: 只有那些在当前的体制中有既得利益的人才会忽略改革的必要性。
ext.ext_en: Only those with vested interests in the current system could ignore the need for change...

ext.ext_cn: 在证明公立学校好坏方面，行政部门不存在既得利益。
ext.ext_en: The administration has no vested interest in proving whether public schools were good or bad.

defs.def_en: If you have a vested interest in something, you have a very strong reason for acting in a particular way, for example to protect your money, power, or reputation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 狂喜的;极乐的;欣喜若狂的

ext.ext_cn: 妻子生下了他们的第一个孩子，他欣喜若狂。
ext.ext_en: His wife gave birth to their first child, and he was ecstatic about it...

ext.ext_cn: 狂喜的人群欢呼着迎接他们。
ext.ext_en: They were greeted by the cheers of an ecstatic crowd.

defs.def_en: If you are ecstatic, you feel very happy and full of excitement.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们兴致勃勃地聆听了演讲。
ext.ext_en: They gave an ecstatic reception to the speech...

ext.ext_cn: 那部上演的戏备受好评，让观众潸然泪下。
ext.ext_en: The production received ecstatic reviews and had audiences weeping.

defs.def_en: You can use ecstatic to describe reactions that are very enthusiastic and excited. For example, if someone receives an ecstatic reception or an ecstatic welcome, they are greeted with great enthusiasm and excitement.
A sheath is a covering for the blade of a knife.
A sheath is a rubber covering for a man's penis and is used during sex as a contraceptive or as a protection against disease.

ext.ext_cn: 英国的非裔加勒比人社团
ext.ext_en: ...Britain's Afro-Caribbean community.

defs.def_en: Afro-Caribbean refers to people from the Caribbean whose ancestors came from Africa.

defs.def_cn: 暂停活动的;暂搁不用的;休眠的;蛰伏的

ext.ext_cn: 当长期休眠的圣海伦斯火山在 1980 年爆发时
ext.ext_en: ...when the long dormant volcano of Mount St Helens erupted in 1980...

ext.ext_cn: 病毒潜伏于神经组织里直到被激活。
ext.ext_en: The virus remains dormant in nerve tissue until activated...

defs.def_en: Something that is dormant is not active, growing, or being used at the present time but is capable of becoming active later on.

defs.def_cn: (尤指父母离异后孩子的)监护权

ext.ext_cn: 我将起诉，要求获得孩子们的监护权。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to go to court to get custody of the children...

ext.ext_cn: 孩子的监护权通常判给母亲。
ext.ext_en: Child custody is normally granted to the mother.

defs.def_en: Custody is the legal right to keep and look after a child, especially the right given to a child's mother or father when they get divorced.

ext.ext_cn: 有3个人出庭，其中两个被还押候审。
ext.ext_en: Three people appeared in court and two of them were remanded in custody...

ext.ext_cn: 她那天后来被拘留了。
ext.ext_en: She was taken into custody later that day.

defs.def_en: Someone who is in custody or has been taken into custody has been arrested and is being kept in prison until they can be tried in a court.

ext.ext_cn: 这个少年被处以9个月的管教。
ext.ext_en: The youngster got nine months' youth custody...

ext.ext_cn: 巴雷特被保护性地监禁起来。
ext.ext_en: Barrett was taken into protective custody.

defs.def_en: If someone is being held in a particular type of custody, they are being kept in a place that is similar to a prison.

ext.ext_cn: 他们吵了一架，于是她把他锁在公寓外面。
ext.ext_en: They had had a row, and she had locked him out of the apartment...

ext.ext_cn: 我丈夫把我关在了外面。
ext.ext_en: My husband's locked me out.

defs.def_en: If someone locks you out of a place, they prevent you entering it by locking the doors.

ext.ext_cn: 新房客被自己反锁在屋外，于是只好破门进去。
ext.ext_en: The new tenants locked themselves out of their apartment and had to break in...

ext.ext_cn: 外面有敲门声，她去开门，结果把自己反锁在了外面。
ext.ext_en: There had been a knock at the door and when she opened it she locked herself out...

defs.def_en: If you lock yourself out of a place, such as your house, you cannot get in because the door is locked and you do not have your keys.

defs.def_cn: （在劳资纠纷中公司）不准（工人）进入工作场所

ext.ext_cn: 公司禁止工人入厂，其余工人便开始罢工。
ext.ext_en: The company locked out the workers, and then the rest of the work force went on strike.

defs.def_en: In an industrial dispute, if a company locks its workers out, it closes the factory or office in order to prevent the employees coming to work.

ext.ext_cn: 信用卡业务出现了下滑，而且越来越多的借款者都不按期还款。
ext.ext_en: The credit card business is down, and more borrowers are defaulting on loans...

ext.ext_cn: 第一次出现警示信号是在3月份，当时该公司未能按时交纳3,000万英镑的首期付款。
ext.ext_en: The first warning signals came in March when the company defaulted on its initial payment of £30 million.

defs.def_en: If a person, company, or country defaults on something that they have legally agreed to do, such as paying some money or doing a piece of work before a particular time, they fail to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 商用机器上设置的默认口令
ext.ext_en: ...default passwords installed on commercial machines...

ext.ext_cn: 细胞的常态是死亡而不是存活。
ext.ext_en: Death, not life, is the default state of cells.

defs.def_en: A default situation is what exists or happens unless someone or something changes it.

ext.ext_cn: 默认选项通常是大多数用户都会选择的设置。
ext.ext_en: The default is usually the setting that most users would probably choose.

ext.ext_cn: 默认设置
ext.ext_en: ...default settings.

defs.def_en: In computing, the default is a particular set of instructions which the computer always uses unless the person using the computer gives other instructions.

defs.def_cn: (事情的发生)自动地(因可能阻止或改变结果之事未发生)

ext.ext_cn: 斯帕斯基赢了第一局，又因菲舍尔第二局未能上场而再胜一局。
ext.ext_en: Spassky won the first game, and was awarded by the second by default, when Fischer failed to put in an appearance...

ext.ext_cn: 我宁愿把这些钱付给个人，也不愿它们因未作任何处置而自动地归国家所有。
ext.ext_en: I would rather pay the individuals than let the money go to the State by default.

defs.def_en: If something happens by default, it happens only because something else which might have prevented it or changed it has not happened.

ext.ext_cn: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。
ext.ext_en: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.

defs.def_en: If something happens in default of something else, it happens because that other thing does not happen or proves to be impossible.

ext.ext_cn: 为了能进入一流学校，学生们会忍不住想作弊。
ext.ext_en: Students may be tempted to cheat in order to get into top schools.

defs.def_en: When someone cheats, they do not obey a set of rules which they should be obeying, for example in a game or exam.

ext.ext_cn: 弄虚作假者将被取消资格。
ext.ext_en: Cheats will be disqualified.

defs.def_en: Someone who is a cheat does not obey a set of rules which they should be obeying.

ext.ext_cn: 公司涉嫌蓄意骗取他们的养老金。
ext.ext_en: The company engaged in a deliberate effort to cheat them out of their pensions...

ext.ext_cn: 许多经纪人被指控在商品交易中欺骗顾客。
ext.ext_en: Many brokers were charged with cheating customers in commodity trades.

defs.def_en: If someone cheats you out of something, they get it from you by behaving dishonestly.

ext.ext_cn: 他被人从他那熊熊燃烧的棚屋顶上救了下来，捡了条命。
ext.ext_en: He cheated death when he was rescued from the roof of his blazing cottage.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone cheats death, you mean they only just avoid being killed.

ext.ext_cn: 故事结尾让人很失望，这样的结尾严重削弱了故事情节。
ext.ext_en: The storyline is fatally compromised by an ending that leaves you feeling horribly cheated.

defs.def_en: If you feel cheated, you feel that you have been let down or treated unfairly.

defs.def_cn: 庸俗之辈，平庸之人（指不喜欢或不了解严肃艺术、文学和音乐的人）
defs.def_en: If you call someone a philistine, you mean that they do not care about or understand good art, music, or literature, and do not think that they are important.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 任由艺术衰颓的庸俗政府
ext.ext_en: ...a philistine government that allowed the arts to decline.

ext.ext_cn: 难登大雅之堂的平庸城市
ext.ext_en: ...a philistine city lacking in elegance.

defs.def_en: You can use philistine to describe people or organizations who you think do not care about or understand the value of good art, music, or literature.

ext.ext_cn: 他们原以为只需切除小肿块的手术最后变成了一次大手术。
ext.ext_en: What they expected to be the removal of a small lump turned out to be major surgery...

ext.ext_cn: 国会决议认为他的免职是非法的。
ext.ext_en: Parliament had decided that his removal from power was illegal.

defs.def_en: The removal of something is the act of removing it.

ext.ext_cn: 最好在天气凉爽时搬家。
ext.ext_en: Home removals are best done in cool weather...

ext.ext_cn: 他们做家具搬运生意。
ext.ext_en: They were in the furniture removal business.

defs.def_en: Removal is the process of transporting furniture or equipment from one building to another.

defs.def_cn: （以小块刻花玻璃制成、看似钻石的）闪光饰品

ext.ext_cn: 珠光耳环
ext.ext_en: ...diamante earrings.

defs.def_en: Diamante jewellery is made from small pieces of cut glass which look like diamonds.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (食物)干巴巴的，干燥的,粉状的

ext.ext_cn: 豆子、谷物和土豆等干巴巴的不易消化的食物
ext.ext_en: ...the mealy stodge of pulse, grain and potato dishes.

defs.def_en: Food that is dry and powdery can be described as mealy .

defs.def_cn: (为处理危险或紧急情况而召开的)紧急会议
defs.def_en: A council of war is a meeting that is held in order to decide how a particular threat or emergency should be dealt with.
A green belt is an area of land with fields or parks around a town or city, where people are not allowed to build houses or factories by law.
A miller is a person who owns or operates a mill in which grain is crushed to make flour.
In the Scottish legal system, the procurator fiscal is a public official who puts people on trial.

defs.def_cn: (用于名词短语之前，指代已经提及或指明的人或物)

ext.ext_cn: 一个侍者走了过来，候在附近。约翰领会了我的眼神，我们两个都站了起来，没有理睬那个侍者，朝自助餐台走去。
ext.ext_en: A waiter came and hovered. John caught my look and we both got up and, ignoring the waiter, made our way to the buffet...

ext.ext_cn: 38 个人中有 6 个是俄罗斯公民。
ext.ext_en: Six of the 38 people were Russian citizens.

defs.def_en: You use the at the beginning of noun groups to refer to someone or something that you have already mentioned or identified.

defs.def_cn: (当名词后接 of 短语或表明身份的从句时，该名词前用the)

ext.ext_cn: 肉类消费量略有增长。
ext.ext_en: There has been a slight increase in the consumption of meat...

ext.ext_cn: 去年受理的 9,660 宗案件中，只有 10% 被完全驳回。
ext.ext_en: Of the 9,660 cases processed last year, only 10 per cent were totally rejected.

defs.def_en: You use the at the beginning of a noun group when the first noun is followed by an 'of' phrase or a clause which identifies the person or thing.

defs.def_cn: (用于某些表示人们共有经历的名词前)

ext.ext_cn: 未来一向很难预测。
ext.ext_en: It's always hard to speculate about the future...

ext.ext_cn: 埃米坐在外面太阳底下。
ext.ext_en: Amy sat outside in the sun...

defs.def_en: You use the in front of some nouns that refer to something in our general experience of the world.

defs.def_cn: (用于和日常生活相关的人、物、服务、机构的名词前)

ext.ext_cn: 医生正在路上。
ext.ext_en: The doctor's on his way...

ext.ext_cn: 刚才打电话的是谁啊？
ext.ext_en: Who was that on the phone?...

defs.def_en: You use the in front of nouns that refer to people, things, services, or institutions that are associated with everyday life.

defs.def_cn: (用于代替所有格限定词，尤在谈论身体某一部分或家庭某一成员时)

ext.ext_cn: “家里人都好吧？”——“都好，谢谢。”
ext.ext_en: 'How's the family?' — 'Just fine, thank you.'...

ext.ext_cn: 我拍了拍他的头。
ext.ext_en: I patted him on the head...

defs.def_en: You use the instead of a possessive determiner, especially when you are talking about a part of someone's body or a member of their family.

defs.def_cn: (用于单数名词前，表示一类人或事物)

ext.ext_cn: 近年来，计算机应用取得长足进步的一个领域是国际象棋。
ext.ext_en: An area in which the computer has made considerable strides in recent years is in playing chess...

ext.ext_cn: 除了狗以外，就数马和人的关系最密切了。
ext.ext_en: After dogs, the horse has had the closest relationship with man.

defs.def_en: You use the in front of a singular noun when you want to make a general statement about things or people of that type.

defs.def_cn: (谈论是否会演奏乐器时，用于乐器名称前)

ext.ext_cn: 你小时候弹过钢琴吗？
ext.ext_en: Did you play the piano as a child?...

ext.ext_cn: 她在试着教他弹吉他。
ext.ext_en: She was trying to teach him to play the guitar.

defs.def_en: You use the with the name of a musical instrument when you are talking about someone's ability to play the instrument.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示国籍的形容词和名词以谈论一国全体国民)

ext.ext_cn: 日本人、美国人，甚至法国人和德国人，都依据结果来评判经济政策的好坏。
ext.ext_en: The Japanese, Americans, and even the French and Germans, judge economic policies by results.

defs.def_en: You use the with nationality adjectives and nouns to talk about the people who live in a country.

defs.def_cn: (与 rich, poor, old, unemployed 等形容词连用，表示某一类人)

ext.ext_cn: 洛杉矶穷人的境况仍未得到改善。
ext.ext_en: Conditions for the poor in Los Angeles have not improved.

ext.ext_cn: 对老人和残疾人的照顾
ext.ext_en: ...care for the elderly and the disabled.

defs.def_en: You use the with words such as 'rich', 'poor', 'old', or 'unemployed' to refer to all people of a particular type.

defs.def_cn: (用于姓氏的复数前，表示一家人或夫妻)

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦家的一个面积为 400 英亩的农场
ext.ext_en: ...a 400 acre farm owned by the Allens...

ext.ext_cn: 泰勒家决定雇个建筑师来干这个活。
ext.ext_en: The Taylors decided that they would employ an architect to do the work.

defs.def_en: If you want to refer to a whole family or to a married couple, you can make their surname into a plural and use the in front of it.

defs.def_cn: (用于形容词前，表示其修饰的某个事物)

ext.ext_cn: 他清楚他在期盼一件不可能发生的事。
ext.ext_en: He knows he's wishing for the impossible...

ext.ext_cn: 我想你或许想要读一下信封里的内容。
ext.ext_en: I thought you might like to read the enclosed.

defs.def_en: You use the in front of an adjective when you are referring to a particular thing that is described by that adjective.

defs.def_cn: (表示拥有为某一特定目的所需的足够的某物)

ext.ext_cn: 她可能没有足够的钱来维护或修葺她的房产。
ext.ext_en: She may not have the money to maintain or restore her property...

ext.ext_cn: 我们一定要耐下心来继续努力，直到找出和平的解决方案为止。
ext.ext_en: We must have the patience to continue to work until we will find a peaceful solution...

defs.def_en: You use the to indicate that you have enough of the thing mentioned for a particular purpose.

defs.def_cn: (与某些称号、地名和其他名称连用)

ext.ext_cn: 据称，那家公司将消息透露给了《每日邮报》。
ext.ext_en: The company was alleged to have leaked the news to the Daily Mail.

ext.ext_cn: 艾伯特音乐厅
ext.ext_en: ...the Albert Hall...

defs.def_en: You use the with some titles, place names, and other names.

ext.ext_cn: 会议将会于 5 月 5 日举行。
ext.ext_en: The meeting should take place on the fifth of May...

ext.ext_cn: 据说，13 世纪时，马可·波罗在去爪哇岛的途中在太平洋上航行过。
ext.ext_en: Marco Polo is said to have sailed on the Pacific on his way to Java in the thirteenth century...

defs.def_en: You use the in front of numbers such as first, second, and third.

ext.ext_cn: 有时很难想象 30 年代的日子有多么困难。
ext.ext_en: It's sometimes hard to imagine how bad things were in the thirties.

defs.def_en: You use the in front of numbers when they refer to decades.

defs.def_cn: (用于形容词和副词的最高级前)

ext.ext_cn: 不管年轻人还是老人，每天快步行走仍是最好的锻炼方式。
ext.ext_en: Brisk daily walks are still the best exercise for young and old alike...

ext.ext_cn: 西柏林市长称德国人是世界上最幸福的人。
ext.ext_en: The Mayor of West Berlin described the Germans as the happiest people in the world...

defs.def_en: You use the in front of superlative adjectives and adverbs.

defs.def_cn: 越…越…(用于两个比较级前，表示其中一个随另一个发生量或质的变化)

ext.ext_cn: 过去健美身形保持的时间越长，将来身材恢复得就越快。
ext.ext_en: The longer you have been in shape in the past, the quicker you will regain fitness in future...

ext.ext_cn: 树立的自信心越强，成功的把握就越大。
ext.ext_en: The more confidence you build up in yourself, the greater are your chances of success.

defs.def_en: You use the in front of each of two comparative adjectives or adverbs when you are describing how one amount or quality changes in relation to another.

defs.def_cn: 每，一(表示速度、价格、度量等)

ext.ext_cn: 1981 年，新型的日产汽车平均每升汽油能跑 13 千米。
ext.ext_en: New Japanese cars averaged 13 km to the litre in 1981...

ext.ext_cn: 一些分析人士预测，英镑对美元的汇率将很快达到1:2。
