ext.ext_en: There's just nothing more blissful than lying by that pool.

defs.def_en: A blissful situation or period of time is one in which you are extremely happy.

defs.def_cn: （对不好或严重的事情）丝毫没有察觉的，毫不知情的

ext.ext_cn: 庆幸的是，许多乡村教区仍然没有感受到战后的犯罪浪潮。
ext.ext_en: Many country parishes were still living in blissful ignorance of the post-war crime wave.

defs.def_en: If someone is in blissful ignorance of something unpleasant or serious, they are totally unaware of it.

ext.ext_cn: 你得自己把那株植物挖出来。
ext.ext_en: You would have to dig up the plant yourself...

ext.ext_cn: 在那个地点又挖掘出几具尸体。
ext.ext_en: More bodies have been dug up at the site...

defs.def_en: If you dig up something, you remove it from the ground where it has been buried or planted.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天他们继续搜寻，在一座警察局的后院里挖掘寻找。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday they continued the search, digging up the back yard of a police station.

defs.def_en: If you dig up an area of land, you dig holes in it.

ext.ext_cn: 经理的薪金过高，职责太过重大，不能将时间浪费在挖掘市场信息上。
ext.ext_en: Managers are too expensive and important to spend time digging up market information...

ext.ext_cn: 他的描述和克莱德发现的证据正好吻合。
ext.ext_en: His description fits perfectly the evidence dug up by Clyde.

defs.def_en: If you dig up information or facts, you discover something that has not previously been widely known.

ext.ext_cn: 世界上任何一个角落一有新闻发生，全国公共广播电台就会不知从什么地方挖个专家出来。
ext.ext_en: When something happens anywhere in the world, NPR digs up an expert from someplace or other...

ext.ext_cn: 如果找一本 20 世纪 60 年代的旧医学书出来的话，它会告诉你儿童白血病是不治之症。
ext.ext_en: If you dug up an old medical book from the sixties, it would tell you that childhood leukemia is incurable.

defs.def_en: If you dig up something or someone, you find them and use or employ them.

ext.ext_cn: 他穿着凉鞋、旧仔裤，衬衫下摆也没塞进裤子里。
ext.ext_en: He wore sandals and old jeans and his shirt-tails weren't tucked in.

defs.def_en: Shirt-tails are the long parts of a shirt below the waist.

defs.def_cn: (基督教圣父、圣子、圣灵的)三位一体
defs.def_en: In the Christian religion, the Trinity or the Holy Trinity is the union of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit in one God.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （经历或工作）亲身实践的，实际操作的

ext.ext_cn: 现在99%的小学生都亲手操作过电脑。
ext.ext_en: Ninety-nine per cent of primary pupils now have hands-on experience of computers...

ext.ext_cn: 这种亲历亲为的管理方法经常让他从早上6点一直工作到晚上11点。
ext.ext_en: This hands-on management approach often stretches his workday from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.

defs.def_en: Hands-on experience or work involves actually doing a particular thing, rather than just talking about it or getting someone else to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 她开始给我们讲在公共汽车上我们的孩子们把售票员痛扁一顿。
ext.ext_en: She began telling us about some fight on a bus in which our kids had duffed up the bus conductor.

defs.def_en: duff someone up means to hit them many times and injure them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 系着满是花边的围裙的女佣们
ext.ext_en: ...maids in frilly aprons.

defs.def_en: Frilly items of clothing or fabric have a lot of frills on them.

defs.def_cn: 对的;正确的;符合事实的

ext.ext_cn: 那绝对正确。
ext.ext_en: That's absolutely right...

ext.ext_cn: 钟表显示的时间从来都不准确。
ext.ext_en: Clocks never told the right time...

defs.def_en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

ext.ext_cn: 走路，如果方法正确的话，也是一种有氧健身运动。
ext.ext_en: Walking, done in the right way, is a form of aerobic exercise...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经实现了系统的计算机化，以保证比萨的送货准确无误。
ext.ext_en: They have computerized systems to ensure delivery of the right pizza to the right place...

defs.def_en: If you do something in the right way or in the right place, you do it as or where it should be done or was planned to be done.

defs.def_cn: (地方)为大众接受的;(人)正派的，体面的

ext.ext_cn: 他总是会出现在一些体面的地方。
ext.ext_en: He was always to be seen in the right places...

ext.ext_cn: 他通过父亲认识了很多正派的人。
ext.ext_en: Through his father, he had met all the right people.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is seen in all the right places or knows all the right people, you mean that they go to places which are socially acceptable or know people who are socially acceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 罗恩对于历届大选结果都预测对了，只有一次除外。
ext.ext_en: Ron has been right about the result of every General Election but one...

ext.ext_cn: 那是真的吗？她说得没错吗？
ext.ext_en: Is that true? Was she right?...

defs.def_en: If someone is right about something, they are correct in what they say or think about it.

defs.def_cn: (选择、行动、决定等)正确的，最好的，最合适的

ext.ext_cn: 她离开纽约的决定是正确的。
ext.ext_en: She'd made the right choice in leaving New York...

ext.ext_cn: 作出的决定是正确的，但理由可能是错误的。
ext.ext_en: The right decision was made, but probably for the wrong reasons...

defs.def_en: If something such as a choice, action, or decision is the right one, it is the best or most suitable one.

defs.def_cn: 正常的;没有问题的;令人满意的

ext.ext_cn: 普罗旺斯杂烩用其他任何油炒出来的味道都不正宗。
ext.ext_en: Ratatouille doesn't taste right with any other oil...

ext.ext_cn: 莫莉总觉得休·安妮这个名字不太好听。
ext.ext_en: The name Sue Anne never seemed quite right to Molly...

defs.def_en: If something is not right, there is something unsatisfactory about the situation or thing that you are talking about.

defs.def_cn: 对的;正当的;有理的;合乎道德的

ext.ext_cn: 在这种情况下，你做的是对的。
ext.ext_en: You were right to do what you did, under the circumstances...

ext.ext_cn: 总统下令发动空袭是绝对合乎道义的。
ext.ext_en: The president was absolutely right in ordering the bombing raid.

defs.def_en: If you think that someone was right to do something, you think that there were good moral reasons why they did it.

defs.def_cn: (活动或行动)符合道德的，正当的

ext.ext_cn: 就这样离开她是不对的。
ext.ext_en: It's not right, leaving her like this...

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家有些人喜欢猎狐，但是这并不能使其变得名正言顺。
ext.ext_en: Fox hunting is popular among some people in this country. It doesn't make it right though...

defs.def_en: Right is used to refer to activities or actions that are considered to be morally good and acceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 他们认识到了复苏经济的紧迫性。
ext.ext_en: They recognise the urgency of righting the economy...

ext.ext_cn: 你的视力恢复得非常快。
ext.ext_en: Your eyesight rights itself very quickly.

defs.def_en: If you right something or if it rights itself, it returns to its normal or correct state, after being in an undesirable state.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在纠正过去的错误方面取得了进展。
ext.ext_en: We've made progress in righting the wrongs of the past...

ext.ext_cn: 他花了25年的时间弥补自己的过失，因此他非常渴望孩子们不要错失良机。
ext.ext_en: Having spent 25 years righting his own mistakes, he is anxious that children should not waste opportunities.

defs.def_en: If you right a wrong, you do something to make up for a mistake or something bad that you did in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 他调正了快艇，继续比赛。
ext.ext_en: He righted the yacht and continued the race...

ext.ext_cn: 直升机在恢复平稳之前倾斜得很厉害。
ext.ext_en: The helicopter turned at an awful angle before righting itself.

defs.def_en: If you right something that has fallen or rolled over, or if it rights itself, it returns to its normal upright position.
The right side of a material is the side that is intended to be seen and that faces outwards when it is made into something.

ext.ext_cn: 我想不起我的生活中有任何一帆风顺的事情。
ext.ext_en: I can't think of anything in my life that's going right...

ext.ext_cn: 我对自己星期六的表现挺满意——一切顺利。
ext.ext_en: I was pleased with my performance on Saturday — everything went right.

defs.def_en: If you say that things are going right, you mean that your life or a situation is developing as you intended or expected and you are pleased with it.

defs.def_cn: (道德上或法律上)有理的，合理的，正确的，说得通的

ext.ext_cn: 她并非完全占理。
ext.ext_en: She wasn't entirely in the right...

ext.ext_cn: 从法律的角度来说，当地税务局的做法是无可厚非的。
ext.ext_en: Legally, the local tax office is in the right.

defs.def_en: If someone has behaved in a way which is morally or legally right, you can say that they are in the right. You usually use this expression when the person is involved in an argument or dispute.

ext.ext_cn: 我们已经发现了存在的问题，准备加以纠正。
ext.ext_en: We've discovered what's gone wrong and are going to put it right.

defs.def_en: If you put something right, you correct something that was wrong or that was causing problems.

defs.def_cn: 白马王子;梦中情人;理想的伴侣

ext.ext_cn: 她承认找不到自己的白马王子。
ext.ext_en: She confesses to having trouble finding Mr Right.

ext.ext_cn: 寻找真命天女的单身汉们
ext.ext_en: ...bachelors searching for Ms Right.

defs.def_en: You can use Mr Right ,Miss Right, or Ms Right to talk about the kind of person that you imagine you will marry or spend the rest of your life with.

ext.ext_cn: 在你右前方会有一个美丽的花园。
ext.ext_en: Ahead of you on the right will be a lovely garden...

ext.ext_cn: 他朝左边看了看，抬头望向屏幕，然后又看了看右边。
ext.ext_en: He looks to his left, up at the screen, then to his right.

defs.def_en: The right is one of two opposite directions, sides, or positions. If you are facing north and you turn to the right, you will be facing east. In the word 'to', the 'o' is to the right of the 't'.
Your right arm, leg, or ear, for example, is the one which is on the right side of your body. Your right shoe or glove is the one which is intended to be worn on your right foot or hand.

ext.ext_cn: 保守党右翼分子鄙视他。
ext.ext_en: The Tory Right despise him...

ext.ext_cn: 右翼分子抨击我没有宗教信仰。
ext.ext_en: The right attacks me for being irreligious.

defs.def_en: You can refer to people who support the political ideals of capitalism and conservatism as the right. They are often contrasted with the left, who support the political ideals of socialism.

ext.ext_cn: 他们认为政治上的右翼倾向是一个世界现象。
ext.ext_en: They see the shift to the right as a worldwide phenomenon.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has moved to the right, you mean that their political beliefs have become more right-wing.

defs.def_cn: 是…的得力助手;是…的左膀右臂

ext.ext_cn: 我想他应该成为总统的得力助手。
ext.ext_en: I think he ought to be at the right hand of the president.

defs.def_en: If someone is at a person's right hand, they work closely with that person so they can help and advise them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们不知道自己的权利。
ext.ext_en: They don't know their rights...

ext.ext_cn: 你必须维护自己的权利。
ext.ext_en: You must stand up for your rights.

defs.def_en: Your rights are what you are morally or legally entitled to do or to have.

ext.ext_cn: 女性的选择权
ext.ext_en: ...a woman's right to choose...

ext.ext_cn: 人们有权利阅读自己喜欢的任何东西。
ext.ext_en: People have the right to read any kind of material they wish.

defs.def_en: If you have a right to do or to have something, you are morally or legally entitled to do it or to have it.

ext.ext_cn: 一个经纪人购买了他的传记的出版权。
ext.ext_en: An agent bought the rights to his life...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾尝试买下萧伯纳所有戏剧的电影改编权。
ext.ext_en: He'd tried to buy the film rights of all George Bernard Shaw's plays.

defs.def_en: If someone has the rights to a story or book, they are legally allowed to publish it or reproduce it in another form, and nobody else can do so without their permission.

ext.ext_cn: 她做了理应由别人做的事情。
ext.ext_en: She did work which by rights should be done by someone else.

defs.def_en: If something is not the case but you think that it should be, you can say that by rights it should be the case.

defs.def_cn: 靠自己努力;凭借自身才能

ext.ext_cn: 虽然女演员琳恩·雷德格雷夫现在依靠自己的能力出了名，但她明白生活在大名鼎鼎的姐姐的阴影里有多不容易。
ext.ext_en: Although now a celebrity in her own right, actress Lynn Redgrave knows the difficulties of living in the shadow of her famous older sister...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的宝宝是个很独立的人。
ext.ext_en: Their baby is a person in his own right.

defs.def_en: If someone is a successful or respected person in their own right, they are successful or respected because of their own efforts and talents rather than those of the people they are closely connected with.

ext.ext_cn: 他保留了改变主意的权利。
ext.ext_en: He reserved the right to change his mind...

ext.ext_cn: 该部表示保留采取任何必要行动的权利。
ext.ext_en: The ministry said it reserved the right to take whatever action necessary.

defs.def_en: If you say that you reserve the right to do something, you mean that you will do it if you feel that it is necessary.

ext.ext_cn: 你完全有权拒绝跟他合作。
ext.ext_en: You were quite within your rights to refuse to co-operate with him.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is within their rights to do something, you mean that they are morally or legally entitled to do it.

defs.def_cn: (用于引起注意或表示已经完成一件事情，接下来可以开始另一件事情)好的，对

ext.ext_cn: 好的，我一会儿就回来。
ext.ext_en: Right, I'll be back in a minute...

ext.ext_cn: 太棒了。好的，我们接听下一个电话。
ext.ext_en: Wonderful. Right, let's go to our next caller.

defs.def_en: You use right in order to attract someone's attention or to indicate that you have dealt with one thing so you can go on to another.

defs.def_cn: （用于确认所说的话是否正确）对吗，是吗，对吧

ext.ext_cn: 他们有一架小飞机，对吧？
ext.ext_en: They have a small plane, right?

ext.ext_cn: 如果它现在不在那里，就在凶手那里。是吧？
ext.ext_en: So if it's not there now, the killer has it. Right?

defs.def_en: You can use right to check whether what you have just said is correct.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示倾听某人的话并表示接受或理解)嗯，对，是

ext.ext_cn: “你的孩子们走的时候可能会带点儿浓重的乡下口音。”——“嗯。”——“因为他们现在和乡下孩子打成一片。”
ext.ext_en: 'Your children may well come away speaking with a bit of a broad country accent' — 'Right.' — 'because they're mixing with country children.'

defs.def_en: You can say 'right' to show that you are listening to what someone is saying and that you accept it or understand it.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为这些想法有很多根本就不会奏效。但是他说话的大意却是“好极了！请告诉我们怎么让它们见效”。
ext.ext_en: He suggested that many of the ideas just would not work. But the tenor of his input was 'Right on! Please show us how to make them work'.

defs.def_en: You say 'right on' to express your support or approval.

ext.ext_cn: “等你停下来的时候，我想跟你说句话。”——“好的。”
ext.ext_en: 'I want a word with you when you stop.' — 'Right you are.'

defs.def_en: If someone says 'right you are', they are agreeing to do something in a very willing and happy way.

defs.def_cn: (地方、位置或时间)准确地，恰当地，精确地

ext.ext_cn: 汽车尾部正对着他。
ext.ext_en: The back of a car appeared right in front of him.

ext.ext_cn: 就在意大利边境上的一个美丽的度假胜地
ext.ext_en: ...a charming resort right on the Italian frontier...

defs.def_en: You can use right to emphasize the precise place, position, or time of something.

ext.ext_cn: 穿过印第安人居住区直达军队阵地的公路
ext.ext_en: ...the highway that runs through the Indian zone right to the army positions...

ext.ext_cn: 她一直忙得不可开交，直到出发的那一刻还在忙。
ext.ext_en: She was kept very busy right up to the moment of her departure...

defs.def_en: You can use right to emphasize how far something moves or extends or how long it continues.

ext.ext_cn: 这根蜡烛完全烧尽了。
ext.ext_en: The candle had burned right down...

ext.ext_cn: 把手一下子就从我的手中脱落。
ext.ext_en: The handle came right off in my hand.

defs.def_en: You can use right to emphasize that an action or state is complete.

defs.def_cn: 完全的;彻头彻尾的;严重的

ext.ext_cn: 他狠狠地责备了他们一通。
ext.ext_en: He gave them a right telling off...

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队的欧洲锦标赛作战计划乱七八糟。
ext.ext_en: England's European Championship plans are in a right mess.

defs.def_en: You can use right to emphasize a noun, usually a noun referring to something bad.

ext.ext_cn: 突然，刚过夏天，妈妈就结婚了。
ext.ext_en: All of a sudden, right after the summer, Mother gets married...

ext.ext_cn: 然后就在开幕式开始之前，她决定要宣布一件激动人心的事情。
ext.ext_en: She then decided right before the opening to make a dramatic announcement.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happened right after a particular time or event or right before it, you mean that it happened immediately after or before it.

defs.def_cn: 我马上就到/我马上回来

ext.ext_cn: 我去拿点水。马上就回来。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to get some water. I'll be right back.

defs.def_en: If you say I'll be right there or I'll be right back, you mean that you will get to a place or get back to it in a very short time.

ext.ext_cn: 他想马上见你。
ext.ext_en: He wants to see you right away...

ext.ext_cn: 我马上就知道她死了。
ext.ext_en: I knew right away she was dead...

defs.def_en: If you do something right away or right off, you do it immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 现在，我觉得非常激动。
ext.ext_en: Right now I'm feeling very excited...

ext.ext_cn: 我警告你，马上住手！
ext.ext_en: I'm warning you; stop it right now!

defs.def_en: You can use right now to emphasize that you are referring to the present moment.

defs.def_cn: （用于英国的某些尊称中，表示级别或地位高）

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·贝克牧师阁下
ext.ext_en: ...The Right Reverend John Baker.

ext.ext_cn: 尊敬的林恩·琼斯议员阁下
ext.ext_en: ...the Right Honourable Lynn Jones MP.

defs.def_en: Right is used in some British titles. It indicates high rank or status.
A potter's wheel is a piece of equipment with a flat disc which spins round, on which a potter puts soft clay in order to shape it into a pot.

ext.ext_cn: 飞行员明智地决定尽快返回法恩伯勒。
ext.ext_en: The pilot wisely decided to return to Farnborough post haste.

defs.def_en: If you go somewhere or do something post-haste, you go there or do it as quickly as you can.

ext.ext_cn: 电视通俗的语言风格
ext.ext_en: ...television's demotic style of language.

defs.def_en: Demotic language is the type of informal language used by ordinary people.

ext.ext_cn: 大众娱乐形式，诸如肥皂剧等
ext.ext_en: ...demotic entertainments such as TV soap operas.

defs.def_en: Demotic is used to describe something or someone that is typical of ordinary people.

ext.ext_cn: 萨德侯爵的施虐受虐性格
ext.ext_en: ...the sado-masochism of the Marquis de Sade.

defs.def_en: Sado-masochism is the enjoyment of hurting people and being hurt.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (通常指因为发生某些不好的事而)非常震惊的，极度惊恐的

ext.ext_cn: 切尔西队领先让我们十分震惊。
ext.ext_en: We were shell-shocked when Chelsea took the lead.

ext.ext_cn: 惊呆了的投资者们
ext.ext_en: ...shell-shocked investors.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is shell-shocked, you mean that they are very shocked, usually because something bad has happened.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 患了炮弹休克症的退伍老兵
ext.ext_en: ...a shell-shocked war veteran.

defs.def_en: If someone is shell-shocked, they have a confused or nervous mental condition as a result of a shocking experience such as being in a war or an accident.

ext.ext_cn: 狗必须接种犬瘟热疫苗。
ext.ext_en: Dogs must be vaccinated against distemper...

ext.ext_cn: 你给你的孩子打过百日咳疫苗了吗？
ext.ext_en: Have you had your child vaccinated against whooping cough?...

defs.def_en: If a person or animal is vaccinated, they are given a vaccine, usually by injection, to prevent them from getting a disease.

ext.ext_cn: 阿姆斯特朗在离目的地还有300米的地方被堵住不能动弹。
ext.ext_en: Armstrong was boxed in with 300 metres to go...

ext.ext_cn: 那些黑色出租车超到他们前面，企图堵住他们。
ext.ext_en: The black cabs cut in front of them, trying to box them in.

defs.def_en: If you are boxed in, you are unable to move from a particular place because you are surrounded by other people or cars.

ext.ext_cn: 要想取得授权，需要制定明确的目标，但不能束缚住自己的手脚。
ext.ext_en: Part of winning a mandate is having clear goals and not boxing yourself in...

ext.ext_cn: 我们并不是要限制任何人，我们是在努力寻找一个令人满意的出路。

ext.ext_en: Seven men, all from Bristol, admitted conspiracy to commit arson...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为1963年肯尼迪总统遇刺身亡可能是一个阴谋。
ext.ext_en: He believes there probably was a conspiracy to kill President Kennedy in 1963.

defs.def_en: Conspiracy is the secret planning by a group of people to do something illegal.

ext.ext_cn: 彻底抛开市中心而把所有东西都搬到梅多霍尔购物中心，这完全是一场阴谋的一部分。
ext.ext_en: It's all part of a conspiracy to dispense with the town centre all together and move everything out to Meadowhall...

ext.ext_cn: 没有证据表明这帮人对布什先生图谋不轨。
ext.ext_en: There was no evidence to link the brigade to any conspiracy against Mr Bush.

defs.def_en: A conspiracy is an agreement between a group of people which other people think is wrong or is likely to be harmful.

ext.ext_cn: 侦探们犯了难，半岛上各个群体抱成一团，达成了保持缄默的密约。
ext.ext_en: Detectives have run into a conspiracy of silence in the tight-knit communities of the peninsula.

defs.def_en: If there is a conspiracy of silence about something, people who know about it have agreed that they will not talk publicly about it, although it would probably be a good thing if people in general knew about it.

defs.def_cn: 难以回答（或解决）的小问题；令人迷惑的事情；智力测验题
defs.def_en: A brain teaser is a question, problem, or puzzle that is difficult to answer or solve, but is not serious or important.

defs.def_cn: 勿忘我，勿忘草（一种开蓝色小花的植物）
defs.def_en: A forget-me-not is a small plant with tiny blue flowers.
A row house is one of a row of similar houses that are joined together by both of their side walls.
Culottes are knee-length women's trousers that look like a skirt.
Cappuccino is coffee which is made using milk and has froth and sometimes powdered chocolate on top.

ext.ext_cn: 他高度赞扬了联合国难民事务高级专员的工作。
ext.ext_en: He lauded the work of the UN High Commissioner for Refugees...

ext.ext_cn: 他们颂扬前总统为英雄。
ext.ext_en: They lauded the former president as a hero...

defs.def_en: If people laud someone, they praise and admire them.

ext.ext_cn: 老式的镀铬龙头
ext.ext_en: ...old-fashioned chrome taps.

defs.def_en: Chrome is metal plated with chromium.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定句和疑问句）在任何时候，从来

ext.ext_cn: 我不确定自己是否还会再相信任何人。
ext.ext_en: I'm not sure I'll ever trust people again...

ext.ext_cn: 我们两个都从未滑过雪。
ext.ext_en: Neither of us had ever skied...

defs.def_en: Ever means at any time. It is used in questions and negative statements.  →see usage note at:always. 见 always 用法说明

defs.def_cn: （表示惊讶、震惊，尤用于希望别人赞同时）曾否，可曾

ext.ext_cn: 你可曾见过像它这样的东西？
ext.ext_en: Have you ever seen anything like it?...

ext.ext_cn: 你可曾听过谁的声音如此奇特？
ext.ext_en: Did you ever hear anyone sound so peculiar?

defs.def_en: You use ever in expressions such as 'did you ever' and 'have you ever' to express surprise or shock at something you have just seen, heard, or experienced, especially when you expect people to agree with you.

defs.def_cn: （用于比较级和最高级后表示强调）以往任何时候，曾经

ext.ext_cn: 她的嗓音非常好，现在的唱功比以往任何时候都要好。
ext.ext_en: She's got a great voice and is singing better than ever...

ext.ext_cn: 日本比以往任何时候都更加富有和强大。
ext.ext_en: Japan is wealthier and more powerful than ever before...

defs.def_en: You use ever after comparatives and superlatives to emphasize the degree to which something is true or when you are comparing a present situation with the past or the future.

ext.ext_cn: 他一向都认真检查剧本。
ext.ext_en: He was ever careful to check his scripts...

ext.ext_cn: 一向充当和事佬的妈妈用手指着弟弟说：“看到了没？快住手！”
ext.ext_en: Mother, ever the peacemaker, pointed her finger at my little brother and said, 'See? Now stop!'

defs.def_en: You use ever to indicate that a person is showing a particular quality that is typical of them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们变得越来越疏远了。
ext.ext_en: They grew ever further apart...

ext.ext_cn: 我想工作会越来越多，而且更加复杂。
ext.ext_en: I think the amount of work will increase and that it will become ever more complex.

defs.def_en: You use ever to say that something happens more all the time.

ext.ext_cn: 我永远无法原谅我自己。
ext.ext_en: I can never, ever, forgive myself...

ext.ext_cn: 费利克斯从来都未向我倾诉过。
ext.ext_en: Felix has never, ever confided in me.

defs.def_en: You can use ever for emphasis after 'never'.

defs.def_cn: （用于以why，when，who等开头的疑问句中表示强调）究竟，到底

ext.ext_cn: 你究竟为什么不告诉我？
ext.ext_en: Why ever didn't you tell me?...

ext.ext_cn: 我到底什么时候再见到你？
ext.ext_en: When ever am I going to see you again?...

defs.def_en: You use ever in questions beginning with words such as 'why', 'when', and 'who' when you want to emphasize your surprise or shock.

ext.ext_cn: 自从你离开后他就一直在那里！
ext.ext_en: He's been there ever since you left!...

ext.ext_cn: 自从去年我们搬家，我就一直非常担心能否做好这份新工作。
ext.ext_en: Ever since we moved last year, I worry a lot about whether I can handle this new job...

defs.def_en: If something has been the case ever since a particular time, it has been the case all the time from then until now.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于表示非常感兴趣或感激时）非常，太

ext.ext_cn: 我认识德里克时，他是个非常出色的舞者。
ext.ext_en: When I met Derek he was ever such a good dancer...

ext.ext_cn: 它保存得非常好。
ext.ext_en: This is in ever such good condition...

defs.def_en: You use ever in the expressions ever such and ever so to emphasize that someone or something has a particular quality, especially when you are expressing enthusiasm or gratitude.

ext.ext_cn: 她就会发牢骚抱怨。
ext.ext_en: All she ever does is whinge and complain...

ext.ext_cn: 他就会翻来覆去讨论同一个无聊的药品单。
ext.ext_en: All he ever does is discuss the same boring list of medications.

defs.def_en: You use the expression all someone ever does when you want to emphasize that they do the same thing all the time, and this annoys you.

ext.ext_cn: 像往常一样，饭菜主要是鱼。
ext.ext_en: As ever, the meals are primarily fish-based...

ext.ext_cn: 他独自一人，一如往常。
ext.ext_en: He was by himself, alone, as ever.

defs.def_en: You say as ever in order to indicate that something or someone's behaviour is not unusual because it is like that all the time or very often.

defs.def_cn: （用于书信结尾署名之前）你永远的朋友
defs.def_en: You can write 'Yours ever' or 'Ever yours' at the end of a letter before you sign your name, as an affectionate way of ending the letter.

defs.def_cn: (二手物品)八成新的，状况仍不错的;(商店)出售品相好的二手物品的

ext.ext_cn: 八成新的车
ext.ext_en: ...nearly new cars.

defs.def_en: Nearly new items are items for sale that have belonged to another person but have not been used much and are still in very good condition. A nearly new shop sells nearly new items.
An egg whisk is a piece of kitchen equipment used for mixing the different parts of an egg together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻率的；欠考虑的；漫不经心的

ext.ext_cn: 没有考虑最科学的做法就轻率地这么做了。
ext.ext_en: It does so with blithe disregard for best scientific practice.

defs.def_en: You use blithe to indicate that something is done casually, without serious or careful thought.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无忧无虑的；快乐无忧的

ext.ext_cn: 她高兴地说了声“嗨”，好像确信大家非常想念她似的。
ext.ext_en: She said 'hi' with the blithe assurance of someone who knew how much she'd been missed.

defs.def_en: Someone who is blithe is cheerful and has no serious problems.

defs.def_cn: 分肥拨款（指为赢得当地选民的选票而在地方工程上花费的大笔政府拨款）

ext.ext_cn: 搞分肥拨款的政客为获得选票、影响民情而发放房租补贴。
ext.ext_en: Pork-barrel politicians hand out rents to win votes and influence people.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is using pork barrel politics, you mean that they are spending a lot of government money on a local project in order to win the votes of the people who live in that area.

defs.def_cn: （能成功吸引女人但很快抛弃她们的）情场杀手
defs.def_en: If you refer to a man as a lady-killer, you mean that you think he is very successful at attracting women but quickly leaves them.

ext.ext_cn: 美国在军事和经济上都称得上是超级大国。
ext.ext_en: The United States could claim to be both a military and an economic superpower.

defs.def_en: A superpower is a very powerful and influential country, usually one that is rich and has nuclear weapons.
The sales tax on things that you buy is the amount of money that you pay to the national government, or, in the United States, to the local or state government.

defs.def_cn: 强有力的；巨大的；令人惊叹的

ext.ext_cn: 将他的书付印本身就是一件浩大的工程。
ext.ext_en: Getting his book into print has been an Olympian task in itself.

defs.def_en: Olympian means very powerful, large, or impressive.

defs.def_cn: 奥运会选手；奥运会运动员

ext.ext_cn: 参加奥运会对每个运动员而言意义不同。
ext.ext_en: The importance of being an Olympian will vary from athlete to athlete.

defs.def_en: An Olympian is a competitor in the Olympic Games.

defs.def_cn: 精英管理（制度）；贤能统治（社会）
defs.def_en: A meritocracy is a society or social system in which people get status or rewards because of what they achieve, rather than because of their wealth or social status.

defs.def_cn: 不容置疑的；无可争议的

ext.ext_cn: 他的忠诚是不容置疑的。
ext.ext_en: His commitment has been unquestioned...

ext.ext_cn: 这个戏剧迅速在伦敦获得了无可争议的成功。
ext.ext_en: The play was an immediate and unquestioned success in London.

defs.def_en: You use unquestioned to emphasize that something is so obvious, real, or great that nobody can doubt it or disagree with it.

ext.ext_cn: 他是一支优秀球队中最好的球员，也是大家公认的领袖。
ext.ext_en: He is the best player on an excellent team and their unquestioned leader.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is unquestioned, they are accepted by everyone, without anyone doubting or disagreeing.

defs.def_cn: 毫无异议的;毫无疑问的

ext.ext_cn: 王室成员毫无争议地受到尊重。
ext.ext_en: Royalty is regarded with unquestioned reverence.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's belief or attitude as unquestioned, you are emphasizing that they accept something without any doubt or disagreement.
A high chair is a chair with long legs for a small child to sit in while they are eating.
Triplets are three children born at the same time to the same mother.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极佳的;卓越的;质量极高的

ext.ext_cn: 6 英里外有一个一流的 18 洞高尔夫球场。
ext.ext_en: There is a superb 18-hole golf course 6 miles away...

ext.ext_cn: 这片水域水质清澈，是游泳的绝佳场所。
ext.ext_en: The waters are crystal clear and offer a superb opportunity for swimming.

defs.def_en: If something is superb, its quality is very good indeed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (信心、控制力、技巧)非同一般的，超凡的

ext.ext_cn: 他凭借超凡的技术实现了完美着陆。
ext.ext_en: With superb skill he managed to make a perfect landing.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has superb confidence, control, or skill, you mean that they have very great confidence, control, or skill.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 达比开着一辆漂亮的老式菲亚特跑车。
ext.ext_en: Darby drove a dinky old Fiat sports car.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as dinky, you mean that it is attractive and appealing, usually because it is quite small and well-designed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 宾馆已经客满了，客人们不得不到斯图尔特街上这家偏远的小汽车旅馆里来。
ext.ext_en: The hotels are full up, and the guests have had to go to this dinky little motel way out on Stewart Avenue.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as dinky, you mean that it is small and unimportant.

ext.ext_cn: 不过说真的，马上赶到那里去打探一下情况会有什么坏处呢？
ext.ext_en: But really, what harm could it possibly do to pop down there and just sniff around?...

ext.ext_cn: 几名便衣男子一直在他的公寓周边打探。
ext.ext_en: A couple of plain-clothes men had been sniffing round his apartment.

defs.def_en: If a person is sniffing around, they are trying to find out information about something, especially information that someone else does not want known.

defs.def_cn: 试图抢走(心上人);企图挖走(员工、顾客等)

ext.ext_cn: 当我不得不离开去上大学的时候，我很清楚别的男人会打她的主意。
ext.ext_en: When I had to go away to university, I was convinced that other men would be sniffing round her...

ext.ext_cn: 里奥克知道那些大俱乐部一直在企图挖走安迪·沃克。
ext.ext_en: Rioch knows the big clubs have been sniffing around Andy Walker.

defs.def_en: If a person or organization is sniffing around someone, they are trying to get them, for example as a lover, employee, or client.

ext.ext_cn: 普遍接受的观点
ext.ext_en: ...a universally accepted point of view...

ext.ext_cn: 现在全世界的人都已认识到了这个问题的严重性。
ext.ext_en: The scale of the problem is now universally recognised.

defs.def_en: If something is universally believed or accepted, it is believed or accepted by everyone with no disagreement.

defs.def_cn: 到处；在所有情况下；无一例外地

ext.ext_cn: 缺点在于它并不是随处都可获得。
ext.ext_en: The disadvantage is that it is not universally available...

ext.ext_cn: 酸雨也并非在任何情况下都是坏事。
ext.ext_en: Nor is acid rain always, and universally, a bad thing.

defs.def_en: If something is universally true, it is true everywhere in the world or in all situations.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 早期的;处于萌芽阶段的;胚胎期的

ext.ext_cn: 罗马尼亚处于萌芽阶段的民主政体
ext.ext_en: ...Romania's embryonic democracy.

ext.ext_cn: 处于酝酿阶段的欧洲中央银行
ext.ext_en: ...the embryonic European central bank.

defs.def_en: An embryonic process, idea, organization, or organism is one at a very early stage in its development.
A goods train is a train that transports goods and not people.

ext.ext_cn: 我被困在了黑莓灌木丛里。
ext.ext_en: I became caught in the brambles.

defs.def_en: Brambles are wild prickly bushes that produce blackberries.
A marrow is a long, thick, green vegetable with soft white flesh that is eaten cooked.

ext.ext_cn: 骨髓捐献者是她14个月大的妹妹。
ext.ext_en: The marrow donor is her 14-month-old sister.

defs.def_en: Marrow is the same as bone marrow .

ext.ext_cn: 我们就要进入这部电影最精彩的部分了。
ext.ext_en: We're getting into the marrow of the film.

defs.def_en: The marrow of something is the most important and basic part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我早上大约10点钟回来的时候感到寒气透骨。
ext.ext_en: When I got back at about ten a.m. I was frozen to the marrow...

ext.ext_cn: 一想到这个我就不寒而栗。
ext.ext_en: The very thought of it chilled me to the marrow.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are chilled to the marrow, you are emphasizing that you are extremely cold or extremely frightened.

ext.ext_cn: 十二指肠溃疡
ext.ext_en: ...duodenal ulcers.

defs.def_en: Duodenal means relating to or contained in the duodenum.

defs.def_cn: 情绪资本（指公司全部的心理资产和资源，如员工对公司的看法）

ext.ext_cn: 英国机构没有维护其智力资本和情绪资本。
ext.ext_en: UK organisations are not nourishing their intellectual and emotional capital.

defs.def_en: When people refer to the emotional capital of a company, they mean all the psychological assets and resources of the company, such as how the employees feel about the company.

defs.def_cn: 使大吃一惊;使惊骇;使震惊

ext.ext_cn: 过去，他表现出来的惊人耐力常让朋友们大吃一惊。
ext.ext_en: He used to astound his friends with feats of physical endurance.

defs.def_en: If something astounds you, you are very surprised by it.
A spongebag is a small bag in which you keep things such as soap and a toothbrush when you are travelling.
A snap fastener is a small metal object used to fasten clothes, made up of two parts which can be pressed together.

ext.ext_cn: 她舒适地窝在枕头里。
ext.ext_en: She is comfortably cocooned in pillows.

ext.ext_cn: 我的小宝贝包裹得舒舒服服的，正睡在婴儿车里
ext.ext_en: ...my snugly cocooned baby sleeping in his pram.

defs.def_en: If someone is cocooned in blankets or clothes, they are completely wrapped in them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她生活在一个与世隔绝的特权世界里。
ext.ext_en: She was cocooned in a private world of privilege...

ext.ext_cn: 他们没受过穷。
ext.ext_en: They were cocooned from the experience of poverty.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is cocooned, you mean that they are isolated and protected from everyday life and problems.

ext.ext_cn: 人员和军火短缺
ext.ext_en: ...the shortage of men and munitions.

ext.ext_cn: 军工厂
ext.ext_en: ...a munitions factory.

defs.def_en: Munitions are military equipment and supplies, especially bombs, shells, and guns.
A mini is the same as a mini-skirt .

ext.ext_cn: 进一步从整体上加强社会生活民主化的需要
ext.ext_en: ...a further need to democratize the life of society as a whole...

ext.ext_cn: 离开祖国时，他说直到国家完全实现民主化后他才会回来。
ext.ext_en: When he left his native country, he said he would not return until it had been fully democratised.

defs.def_en: If a country or a system is democratized, it is made democratic.
A beautician is a person whose job is giving people beauty treatments such as doing their nails, treating their skin, and putting on their make-up.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我敢打赌他们有非常好吃的冰激凌。
ext.ext_en: I'll bet they have yummy ice cream...

ext.ext_cn: 它闻起来很香。
ext.ext_en: It smells yummy.

defs.def_en: Yummy food tastes very good.
Fibre optics is the use of long thin threads of glass to carry information in the form of light.

defs.def_cn: 与光导纤维有关的;涉及光导纤维的

ext.ext_cn: 光缆
ext.ext_en: ...fibre optic cables.

defs.def_en: Fibre optic means relating to or involved in fibre optics.

defs.def_cn: 未被动过的；未被移动的；未用过的

ext.ext_cn: 那张桌子看上去没人动过。
ext.ext_en: The desk looked undisturbed...

ext.ext_cn: 牡丹花不宜挪移，最好别去动它。
ext.ext_en: Peonies react badly to being moved and are best left undisturbed.

defs.def_en: Something that remains undisturbed is not touched, moved, or used by anyone.

ext.ext_cn: 在巴利阿里群岛上，零星散布在岛内的村庄和那里的生活平静而祥和。
ext.ext_en: In the Balearics pockets of rural life and inland villages are undisturbed...

ext.ext_cn: 巴盖特古城门未能躲过战火的荼毒。
ext.ext_en: The war had not left Bargate undisturbed.

defs.def_en: A place that is undisturbed is peaceful and has not been affected by changes that have happened in other places.

ext.ext_cn: 我可以一整天都呆在仓库里而不受打扰。
ext.ext_en: I can spend the whole day undisturbed at the warehouse...

ext.ext_cn: 沙利文大街上有一家小餐馆，我们可以在那里不受打扰地聊。
ext.ext_en: There was a small restaurant on Sullivan Street where we could talk undisturbed...

defs.def_en: If you are undisturbed in something that you are doing, you are able to continue doing it and are not affected by something that is happening.

defs.def_cn: 不烦恼的；不着急的；不担忧的

ext.ext_cn: 尽管丈夫和家人都吓坏了，维多利亚却对这一症状出奇地淡定。
ext.ext_en: Victoria was strangely undisturbed by this symptom, even though her husband and family were frightened.

defs.def_en: If someone is undisturbed by something, it does not affect, bother, or upset them.
A receptacle is an object which you use to put or keep things in.
Carpentry is the activity of making and repairing wooden things.
A commercial break is the interval during a commercial television programme, or between programmes, during which advertisements are shown.

ext.ext_cn: 毒品走私犯
ext.ext_en: ...drug smugglers.

defs.def_en: Smugglers are people who take goods into or out of a country illegally.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 具有非凡才能的孩子们
ext.ext_en: ...children with exceptional ability...

ext.ext_cn: 他的译作非常有诗意。
ext.ext_en: His translation is exceptional in its poetic quality.

defs.def_en: You use exceptional to describe someone or something that has a particular quality, usually a good quality, to an unusually high degree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如果法庭认为这是个特殊案例
ext.ext_en: ...if the courts hold that this case is exceptional...

ext.ext_cn: 督学可以酌情允许父母在特殊情况下让学生退学。
ext.ext_en: School governors have the discretion to allow parents to withdraw pupils in exceptional circumstances.

defs.def_en: Exceptional situations and incidents are unusual and only likely to happen very infrequently.

defs.def_cn: “极可意”涡流式浴缸；按摩浴缸
defs.def_en: A Jacuzzi is a large circular bath which is fitted with a device that makes the water move around.

defs.def_cn: 把…改造成…；改变，转变(功能或用途)

ext.ext_cn: 20 世纪 70 年代末他刚租得那片土地的时候，曾计划把它改作谷物生产地。
ext.ext_en: When he first leased the land in the late 1970s, he planned to turn it over to cereal production.

defs.def_en: If you turn something over to a different function or use, you change its function or use.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 法官说仲裁是公平且迅速有效的判决过程。
ext.ext_en: The judge said that arbitration was a fair and expeditious decision-making process.

defs.def_en: Expeditious means quick and efficient.
Gastroenteritis is an illness in which the lining of your stomach and intestines becomes swollen and painful.

ext.ext_cn: 你是谁？要去哪里？
ext.ext_en: Who are you and whither are you bound?

ext.ext_cn: 他们不知要去哪里。
ext.ext_en: They knew not whither they went.

defs.def_en: Whither means to where.

ext.ext_cn: 她有一点私房钱，所以他们过得很舒心。
ext.ext_en: She has a bit of private money, so they manage quite nicely...

ext.ext_cn: 这群人都浑身湿透，现在谢天谢地快晾干了。
ext.ext_en: The crowds had been soaked and were now nicely drying out.

defs.def_en: See also:nice;If something is happening or working nicely, it is happening or working in a satisfactory way or in the way that you want it to.

ext.ext_cn: 又一个成功的酒店老板
ext.ext_en: ...another hotel owner who is doing very nicely.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is doing nicely, they are being successful.

ext.ext_cn: 一件衬衫和毛衣，再加一条普通的裤子就很不错，谢谢你。
ext.ext_en: A shirt and jersey and an ordinary pair of trousers will do nicely, thank you...

ext.ext_cn: 要是当时立即点头同意就好了。
ext.ext_en: A quick nod of approval would have done nicely.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will do nicely, you mean that it is good enough for the situation.

ext.ext_cn: 银行正重新评估其贷款标准。
ext.ext_en: The bank is reassessing its criteria for lending money...

ext.ext_cn: 我只好借给他10英镑，让他带孩子们去看电影。
ext.ext_en: I had to lend him ten pounds to take his children to the pictures.

defs.def_en: When people or organizations such as banks lend you money, they give it to you and you agree to pay it back at a future date, often with an extra amount as interest.

ext.ext_cn: 你能把上衣借给我穿一会儿吗？
ext.ext_en: Will you lend me your jacket for a little while?...

ext.ext_cn: 他把那间平房借给康拉德一家住了两三个星期。
ext.ext_en: He had lent the bungalow to the Conrads for a couple of weeks.

defs.def_en: If you lend something that you own, you allow someone to have it or use it for a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 主办方找过他，希望他能对慈善音乐会给予支持。
ext.ext_en: He was approached by the organisers to lend support to a benefit concert...

ext.ext_cn: 斯蒂普出席了昨天的新闻发布会以示支持。
ext.ext_en: Stipe attended yesterday's news conference to lend his support.

defs.def_en: If you lend your support to someone or something, you help them with what they are doing or with a problem that they have.

defs.def_cn: 使适合；使有帮助；使易遭受

ext.ext_cn: 这个房间又亮堂又通风，夏天在此用餐最合适不过。
ext.ext_en: The room lends itself well to summer eating with its light, airy atmosphere.

defs.def_en: If something lends itself to a particular activity or result, it is easy for it to be used for that activity or to achieve that result.

ext.ext_cn: 热烈的掌声给活动平添了几分隆重的色彩。
ext.ext_en: Enthusiastic applause lent a sense of occasion to the proceedings...

ext.ext_cn: 由于管理较为宽松而且经常从事劳动，这里的囚犯因此多了一份其他监狱的囚犯所没有的尊严感。
ext.ext_en: A more relaxed regime and regular work lends the inmates a dignity not seen in other prisons.

defs.def_en: If something lends a particular quality to something else, it adds that quality to it.
A dresser is a chest of drawers, usually with a mirror on the top.

defs.def_cn: (通常指用来存放瓷器的)碗橱,餐具柜
defs.def_en: A dresser is a piece of furniture which has cupboards or drawers in the lower part and shelves in the top part. It is usually used for storing china.

defs.def_cn: (剧院中协助演员穿戏服的)换装师,服装师

ext.ext_cn: “特雷莎,告诉他们我所有的电话都别挂。”她吩咐她的服装师。
ext.ext_en: 'Tell them to hold all my calls, Theresa,' she instructed her dresser.

defs.def_en: A dresser is someone who works in a theatre and helps the actors and actresses to dress.

ext.ext_cn: 她一向衣着讲究,这回穿的是她众多亚麻连衣裙中的一条。
ext.ext_en: She had always been a smart dresser and had on one of her linen frocks.

ext.ext_cn: 仅买过一次“常规”衣服的着装标新立异的传奇美女
ext.ext_en: ...a legendary beauty and unconventional dresser who only once bought 'normal' clothes.

defs.def_en: You can use dresser to refer to the kind of clothes that a person wears. For example, if you say that someone is a smart dresser, you mean that they wear smart clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 做完急性阑尾炎手术后，他正在医院康复。
ext.ext_en: He is recovering in hospital after an operation for acute appendicitis.

defs.def_en: Appendicitis is an illness in which a person's appendix is infected and painful.

defs.def_cn: 玷污，败坏，损害(名誉或形象)

ext.ext_cn: 这一事件可能有损首相的名誉。
ext.ext_en: The affair could tarnish the reputation of the prime minister...

ext.ext_cn: 他的形象因为那桩储蓄信贷丑闻而受损。
ext.ext_en: His image was tarnished by the savings and loan scandal.

defs.def_en: If you say that something tarnishes someone's reputation or image, you mean that it causes people to have a worse opinion of them than they would otherwise have had.

defs.def_cn: (使)有污迹;(使)失去光泽;(使)变暗淡

ext.ext_cn: 它从不生锈，也不会失去光泽。
ext.ext_en: It never rusts or tarnishes...

ext.ext_cn: 清洁银器时要戴上棉手套，因为你皮肤里的酸性物质会使它失去光泽。
ext.ext_en: Wear cotton gloves when cleaning silver, because the acid in your skin can tarnish the metal.

defs.def_en: If a metal tarnishes or if something tarnishes it, it becomes stained and loses its brightness.

ext.ext_cn: 戒指内侧有一层厚厚的锈斑。
ext.ext_en: The tarnish lay thick on the inside of the ring.

defs.def_en: Tarnish is a substance which forms of the surface of some metals and which stains them or causes them to lose their brightness.

defs.def_cn: （裁缝等手艺人）专门提供定做服务的

ext.ext_cn: 由专做定制服装的裁缝做的套装
ext.ext_en: ...suits made by a bespoke tailor.

defs.def_en: A bespoke craftsman such as a tailor makes and sells things that are specially made for the customer who ordered them.

ext.ext_cn: 在地下室里，15名员工正在忙着缝制定做的外套。
ext.ext_en: In the basement fifteen employees are busy making bespoke coats.

defs.def_en: Bespoke things such as clothes have been specially made for the customer who ordered them.
A bison is a large hairy animal with a large head that is a member of the cattle family. They used to be very common in North America and Europe.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我与密友们讨论是否我要马上生孩子。
ext.ext_en: I discussed with my intimate friends whether I would immediately have a baby.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的婚礼将在秋季举行,这对情侣的一位密友透露说。
ext.ext_en: They are to have an autumn wedding, an intimate of the couple confides.

defs.def_en: If you have an intimate friendship with someone, you know them very well and like them a lot.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有恋爱关系的;有性关系的

ext.ext_cn: 我就是不想讨论我的恋爱关系。
ext.ext_en: I just won't discuss my intimate relationships.

ext.ext_cn: 她们与男友共浴爱河的时刻
ext.ext_en: ...their intimate moments with their boyfriends.

defs.def_en: If two people are in an intimate relationship, they are involved with each other in a loving or sexual way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他写到了关于他家庭生活的一些不为人知的细节。
ext.ext_en: He wrote about the intimate details of his family life...

ext.ext_cn: 我实在不愿打断你们的私人谈话,但是我们确实有事要谈。
ext.ext_en: I hate to interrupt your intimate conversation but we do have an assignment to discuss.

defs.def_en: An intimate conversation or detail, for example, is very personal and private.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 温馨的二人烛光晚餐
ext.ext_en: ...an intimate candlelit dinner for two.

defs.def_en: If you use intimate to describe an occasion or the atmosphere of a place, you like it because it is quiet and pleasant, and seems suitable for close conversations between friends.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 疯狂与智慧的密切关联
ext.ext_en: ...an intimate connection between madness and wisdom...

ext.ext_cn: 法国与其前非洲属地一直保持着最密切的联系。
ext.ext_en: France has kept the most intimate links with its former African territories.

defs.def_en: An intimate connection between ideas or organizations, for example, is a very strong link between them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对克尔恺郭尔与叔本华的深刻了解让我很吃惊。
ext.ext_en: He surprised me with his intimate knowledge of Kierkegaard and Schopenhauer.

defs.def_en: An intimate knowledge of something is a deep and detailed knowledge of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他继续暗示他确实在考虑对公司进行一次大改组。
ext.ext_en: He went on to intimate that he was indeed contemplating a shake-up of the company...

ext.ext_cn: 他已经向法国人和俄国人暗示他愿意达成协议。
ext.ext_en: He had intimated to the French and Russians his readiness to come to a settlement.

defs.def_en: If you intimate something, you say it in an indirect way.

defs.def_cn: 禁不住(哭起来或笑起来)

ext.ext_cn: 一提到芒雅的名字她就禁不住哭了起来。
ext.ext_en: She dissolved into tears at the mention of Munya's name.

defs.def_en: If you dissolve into or dissolve in tears or laughter, you begin to cry or laugh, because you cannot control yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 司法部在将非暴力犯罪者投入监狱前必须经过审慎的考虑。
ext.ext_en: The judiciary must think very hard before jailing non-violent offenders.

defs.def_en: The judiciary is the branch of authority in a country which is concerned with law and the legal system.
A viper is a small poisonous snake found mainly in Europe.

ext.ext_cn: 尼科尔斯动身去他在康涅狄格州的偏僻农舍了。
ext.ext_en: Nichols set off for his remote farmhouse in Connecticut...

ext.ext_cn: 总统的使节开始了又一次外交之旅。
ext.ext_en: The President's envoy set off on another diplomatic trip...

defs.def_en: When you set off, you start a journey.

defs.def_cn: 引爆(炸弹);触发，拉响(警报等)

ext.ext_cn: 一旦发现有泄漏，警报就会响起来。
ext.ext_en: Any escape, once it's detected, sets off the alarm...

ext.ext_cn: 有人打开了灭火器。
ext.ext_en: Someone set off a fire extinguisher...

defs.def_en: If something sets off something such as an alarm or a bomb, it makes it start working so that, for example, the alarm rings or the bomb explodes.

ext.ext_cn: 救济物资车的到来引发了小小的骚乱,村民们争先恐后地想抢到一份援助物资。
ext.ext_en: The arrival of the charity van set off a minor riot as villagers scrambled for a share of the aid...

ext.ext_cn: 如果他没和妻子一块儿出席宴会，便会招致各种猜测满天飞。
ext.ext_en: If he attended a party without his wife, it set off a storm of speculation.

defs.def_en: If something sets off an event or a series of events, it causes it to start happening.

defs.def_cn: 使发怒;使回忆起来;使侃侃而谈

ext.ext_cn: 一件微不足道的小事都能打开他的话匣子，他会滔滔不绝地讲述他的童年。
ext.ext_en: The smallest thing sets him off, and he can't stop talking about his childhood.

defs.def_en: If something sets a person off, it makes them angry, or makes them remember something and they start talking a lot.

defs.def_cn: 衬托;(通常指通过对比)使显得更漂亮

ext.ext_cn: 蓝色很适合你，能衬托出你的发色。
ext.ext_en: Blue suits you, sets off the colour of your hair.

ext.ext_cn: 结构匀称完美、能最有效地凸显其展品的展览馆
ext.ext_en: ...perfectly proportioned galleries that set off the contents to their best advantage.

defs.def_en: If one colour, flavour, or object sets off another, it makes it look more attractive, often by providing a contrast.

defs.def_cn: 重新考虑；再次决定；再次评价

ext.ext_cn: 我们重新审视自己的时刻
ext.ext_en: ...the moment when we make a reassessment of ourselves.

defs.def_en: If you make a reassessment of something, you think about it and decide whether you need to change your opinion about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们一直在尝试改造他们的零售店。
ext.ext_en: They have tried to reinvent their retail stores...

ext.ext_cn: 他下决心把自己重塑成一个诗人兼作家。
ext.ext_en: He was determined to reinvent himself as a poet and writer.

defs.def_en: To reinvent something means to change it so that it seems different and new.

ext.ext_cn: 这些观点中有些值得进一步探究，但是没有必要全盘重来。
ext.ext_en: Some of these ideas are worth pursuing, but there is no need to reinvent the wheel.

defs.def_en: If someone is trying to reinvent the wheel, they are trying to do something that has already been done successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 夏日凉爽的微风
ext.ext_en: ...a cool summer breeze.

defs.def_en: A breeze is a gentle wind.

defs.def_cn: 随意轻松地进入；漫步走入

ext.ext_cn: 洛佩斯轻松打入了锦标赛的四分之一决赛。
ext.ext_en: Lopez breezed into the quarter-finals of the tournament...

ext.ext_cn: “你没事吧？”芙朗辛拿着邮件踱步走进来，问道。
ext.ext_en: 'Are you all right?' Francine asked as she breezed in with the mail.

defs.def_en: If you breeze into a place or a position, you enter it in a very casual or relaxed manner.

defs.def_cn: 轻松过关，轻易通过（比赛或测试）

ext.ext_cn: 约翰似乎不费吹灰之力就完成了很多工作任务。
ext.ext_en: John seems to breeze effortlessly through his many commitments at work.

defs.def_en: If you breeze through something such as a game or test, you cope with it easily.

ext.ext_cn: 我曾经是管理着20个人的办公室经理，现在领导区区3名员工不费吹灰之力！
ext.ext_en: And after being an office manager for 20 people, handling my own tiny staff of three is a breeze!...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你有食品加工机，做这种点心轻而易举。
ext.ext_en: Making the pastry is a breeze if you have a food processor.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a breeze, you mean that it is very easy to do or to achieve.

ext.ext_cn: 他凝视着利奥一眨不眨的双眼。
ext.ext_en: He stared into Leo's unblinking eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 毫无表情、目不转睛的凝视
ext.ext_en: ...an expressionless, unblinking stare.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's eyes or expression as unblinking, you mean that they are looking steadily at something without blinking.

ext.ext_cn: 阳光下的海面波光粼粼。
ext.ext_en: The sea glinted in the sun...

ext.ext_cn: 阳光照射下，他的眼镜片闪着光。
ext.ext_en: Sunlight glinted on his spectacles.

defs.def_en: If something glints, it produces or reflects a quick flash of light.

ext.ext_cn: 银光闪闪
ext.ext_en: ...a glint of silver.

ext.ext_cn: 阳光闪耀
ext.ext_en: ...glints of sunlight.

defs.def_en: A glint is a quick flash of light.

ext.ext_cn: 她眼里流露出激动的神情。
ext.ext_en: Her eyes glinted wildly...

ext.ext_cn: 他眼中闪现出一丝顽皮的神情。
ext.ext_en: A mischievous spark glinted in his eyes.

defs.def_en: If someone's eyes glint, they shine and express a particular emotion.

ext.ext_cn: 他向我走来，眼里闪现出一丝胜利的神情。
ext.ext_en: He came up to me with the glint of triumph in his eye.

defs.def_en: A glint in someone's eyes is a brightness that expresses a particular emotion.

ext.ext_cn: 罗马教廷对堕胎的教义非常清楚：这是罪过。
ext.ext_en: The Vatican's teaching on abortion is clear: it is a sin...

ext.ext_cn: 他们过分自信，这是否犯了骄纵之罪？
ext.ext_en: Was it the sin of pride to have believed too much in themselves?

defs.def_en: Sin or a sin is an action or type of behaviour which is believed to break the laws of God.

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙宗教法庭指控他亵渎上帝和人类。
ext.ext_en: The Spanish Inquisition charged him with sinning against God and man...

ext.ext_cn: 你犯了罪，必须为你的所作所为作出忏悔。
ext.ext_en: You have sinned and must repent your ways.

defs.def_en: If you sin, you do something that is believed to break the laws of God.

defs.def_cn: 罪恶;恶行;不道德的行为

ext.ext_cn: 傲慢无情的恶行
ext.ext_en: ...the sin of arrogant hard-heartedness...

ext.ext_cn: 最大的罪过不是通奸而是公众议论，是它导致了丑闻的发生。
ext.ext_en: The ultimate sin was not infidelity, but public mention which led to scandal.

defs.def_en: A sin is any action or behaviour that people disapprove of or consider morally wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 她和男友同居。
ext.ext_en: She was living in sin with her boyfriend.

defs.def_en: If you say that a man and a woman are living in sin, you mean that they are living together as a couple although they are not married.
Mosquitos are small flying insects which bite people and animals in order to suck their blood.

defs.def_cn: 胡椒粉喷雾剂（可用于反抗暴力和攻击）

ext.ext_cn: 警察用胡椒粉喷雾剂喷他。
ext.ext_en: The officers blasted him with pepper spray.

defs.def_en: Pepper spray is a device that causes tears and sickness and is sometimes used against rioters and attackers.

ext.ext_cn: 游行队伍长达数英里。
ext.ext_en: The procession stretched for several miles...

ext.ext_cn: 他从脖子到臀部均被烧伤。
ext.ext_en: He had burns that stretched from his neck to his hips.

defs.def_en: Something that stretches over an area or distance covers or exists in the whole of that area or distance.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一段非常危险的路。
ext.ext_en: It's a very dangerous stretch of road...

ext.ext_cn: 洛斯特里弗的这片水域又宽又深。
ext.ext_en: This stretch of Lost River was broader and deeper.

defs.def_en: A stretch of road, water, or land is a length or area of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他打了个呵欠，伸了伸懒腰。
ext.ext_en: He yawned and stretched...

ext.ext_cn: 试着双腿伸直并且向上拉伸脚趾。
ext.ext_en: Try stretching your legs and pulling your toes upwards...

defs.def_en: When you stretch, you put your arms or legs out straight and tighten your muscles.

ext.ext_cn: 他曾在法国南部呆过一段时间，法语流利。
ext.ext_en: He was fluent in French, having spent stretches of time in Southern France.

ext.ext_cn: 在部队生活了 18 个月后
ext.ext_en: ...after an 18-month stretch in the army...

defs.def_en: A stretch of time is a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 随着反堕胎抗议进入第二周
ext.ext_en: ...as anti-abortion protests stretched into their second week...

ext.ext_cn: 该谈判可能会延续至 1993 年夏天。
ext.ext_en: The talks could be stretched into the summer of 1993.

defs.def_en: If an event or activity stretches or is stretched into a further period of time, it continues into that period, which is later than expected.

defs.def_cn: (从一个时间)持续(至另一个时间)

ext.ext_cn: 从早上 7 点持续到晚上 8 点的工作日
ext.ext_en: ...a working day that stretches from seven in the morning to eight at night.

defs.def_en: If something stretches from one time to another, it begins at the first time and ends at the second, which is longer than expected.

ext.ext_cn: 从化学制品到食糖均有涉足的贸易帝国
ext.ext_en: ...a trading empire, with interests that stretched from chemicals to sugar.

defs.def_en: If a group of things stretch from one type of thing to another, the group includes a wide range of things.

ext.ext_cn: 该电缆不能拉伸。
ext.ext_en: The cables are designed not to stretch...

ext.ext_cn: 将油酥面团小心地移至烤盘的各角，注意不要把它拉长。
ext.ext_en: Ease the pastry into the corners of the tin, making sure you don't stretch it.

defs.def_en: When something soft or elastic stretches or is stretched, it becomes longer or bigger as well as thinner, usually because it is pulled.

ext.ext_cn: 莱卡等有弹性的织物
ext.ext_en: ...stretch fabrics such as Lycra.

ext.ext_cn: 弹力棉制泳衣
ext.ext_en: ...stretch cotton swimsuits.

defs.def_en: If you stretch an amount of something or if it stretches, you make it last longer than it usually would by being careful and not wasting any of it.

defs.def_cn: 刚能够节约下来(或支付)

defs.def_en: If you are at full stretch, you are using the maximum amount of effort or energy.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not true or possible by any stretch of the imagination, you are emphasizing that it is completely untrue or absolutely impossible.

defs.def_en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

ext.ext_cn: 他们要求他离开。
ext.ext_en: They requested him to leave...

ext.ext_cn: 学生必须把车停在该系后面。
ext.ext_en: Students are requested to park at the rear of the Department.

defs.def_en: If you request someone to do something, you politely or formally ask them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 法国已经同意了他寻求政治庇护的请求。
ext.ext_en: France had agreed to his request for political asylum...

ext.ext_en: Vietnam made an official request that the meeting be postponed.

defs.def_en: If you make a request, you politely or formally ask someone to do something.

ext.ext_en: If you have any requests, I'd be happy to play them for you.

defs.def_en: A request is a song or piece of music which someone has asked a performer or disc jockey to play.

defs.def_cn: 应邀;应…的请求;按照…的要求

ext.ext_en: The evacuation is being organised at the request of the United Nations Secretary General.

ext.ext_en: Leaflets giving details are available on request...

ext.ext_en: Chambermaids will bring an iron or hair dryer on request.

defs.def_en: If something is given or done on request, it is given or done whenever you ask for it.

ext.ext_cn: 早餐是麦片粥配佐餐黄油。
ext.ext_en: Breakfast consisted of porridge served with butter.

ext.ext_cn: 她的团队由来自德文郡和康沃尔郡的孩子们组成。
ext.ext_en: Her crew consisted of children from Devon and Cornwall.

defs.def_en: Something that consists of particular things or people is formed from them.

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名顾问，他的工作是为外国公司在新厂选址问题上提供建议。
ext.ext_en: His work as a consultant consisted in advising foreign companies on the siting of new factories.

ext.ext_cn: 波德莱尔认为天才在于唤起童年的能力的观点
ext.ext_en: ...Baudelaire's idea that genius consists in the ability to summon up childhood.

defs.def_en: Something that consists in something else has that thing as its main or only part.

defs.def_cn: 靠自己奋斗成功的;(尤指)白手起家的

ext.ext_en: He is a self-made man.

ext.ext_cn: 一个靠双手打拼的百万富翁
ext.ext_en: ...a self-made millionaire.

defs.def_en: Self-made is used to describe people who have become successful and rich through their own efforts, especially if they started life without money, education, or high social status.
The words 'a' and 'an' are sometimes called the indefinite article .

ext.ext_cn: 装了消音器的手枪
ext.ext_en: ...a pistol that was equipped with a silencer.

defs.def_en: A silencer is a device that is fitted onto a gun to make it very quiet when it is fired.
A silencer is a device on a car exhaust that makes it quieter.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If someone is tanked or tanked up, they are drunk.

defs.def_cn: （尤指从事无关紧要或乏味工作的）仆从，下属，小卒

ext.ext_cn: 她把这份工作委派给她的一个手下。
ext.ext_en: She delegated the job to one of her minions.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's minions, you are referring to people who have to do what that person tells them to do, especially unimportant or boring tasks.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人无法容忍的；骇人的

ext.ext_en: Charges for local telephone calls are particularly outrageous.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as outrageous, you are emphasizing that it is unacceptable or very shocking.

ext.ext_en: The powers of the European Commission to regulate competition are increasing...

ext.ext_en: As we get older the temperature-regulating mechanisms in the body tend to become a little less efficient.

defs.def_en: To regulate an activity or process means to control it, especially by means of rules.
A menage a trois is a situation where three people live together, especially when one of them is having a sexual relationship with both of the others.

defs.def_cn: 非劳动收入；非劳动所得

ext.ext_en: Reduction in the tax on unearned income could be a boost for small businesses.

defs.def_en: Unearned income is money that people gain from interest or profit from property or investment, rather than money that they earn from a job.

ext.ext_cn: 不是所有的妇女都能选择是否用母乳哺育自己的孩子。
ext.ext_en: Not all women have the choice whether or not to breast-feed their babies...

ext.ext_en: Leading scientists claim breast-fed babies are intellectually brighter.

defs.def_en: When a woman breast-feeds her baby, she feeds it with milk from her breasts, rather than from a bottle.

ext.ext_en: A declaration will be issued at the end of the aforementioned UN conference.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the aforementioned person or subject, you mean the person or subject that has already been mentioned.

ext.ext_en: His mood of deep pessimism cannot have been leavened by his mode of transport—a black cab...

ext.ext_cn: 他找到了懂得用狂欢来冲淡战争的严酷的志趣相投的军官。
ext.ext_en: He found congenial officers who knew how to leaven war's rigours with riotous enjoyment.

defs.def_en: If a situation or activity is leavened by or with something, it is made more interesting or cheerful.

ext.ext_cn: 我核实了我所获消息的来源。
ext.ext_en: I verified the source from  which I had that information...

ext.ext_en: A clerk simply verifies that the payment and invoice amount match.

defs.def_en: If you verify something, you check that it is true by careful examination or investigation.

ext.ext_en: The government has not verified any of those reports...

ext.ext_en: I can verify that it takes about thirty seconds.

defs.def_en: If you verify something, you state or confirm that it is true.

ext.ext_en: 'I am a sinful man,' he said.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as sinful, you mean that they are wicked or immoral.

ext.ext_en: In order  to maximize profit the firm would seek to maximize output...

ext.ext_en: They were looking for suitable ways of maximising their electoral support.

defs.def_en: If you maximize something, you make it as great in amount or importance as you can.

ext.ext_en: Click on the square icon to maximize the window.

defs.def_en: If you maximize a window on a computer screen, you make it as large as possible.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: She had made their childhood so joyous and carefree.

ext.ext_en: ...a joyous celebration of life.

defs.def_en: Joyous means extremely happy.

ext.ext_en: Most adult education centres offer computing courses.

ext.ext_cn: 嗜睡症的一次发作
ext.ext_en: ...an attack of narcolepsy.

defs.def_en: Narcolepsy is a rare medical condition. It causes people who suffer from it to fall into a deep sleep at any time without any warning.

ext.ext_en: ...the values society depends upon, such as honesty, sobriety and trust.

defs.def_en: Sobriety is serious and thoughtful behaviour.

ext.ext_en: 'Whew,' he said. 'It's hot.'...

ext.ext_en: You were just in time. Whew! What a close call...

defs.def_en: Whew is used in writing to represent a sound that you make when you breathe out quickly, for example because you are very hot, very relieved, or very surprised.

ext.ext_en: ...allegations of police entrapment.

ext.ext_en: Temperature becomes uniform by heat conduction until finally a permanent state is reached.

defs.def_en: Conduction is the process by which heat or electricity passes through or along something.

ext.ext_en: The decision will leave her in a peculiar predicament.

defs.def_en: If you are in a predicament, you are in an unpleasant situation that is difficult to get out of.

ext.ext_en: Moving to Germany, he became a stalwart of the revered Kurt Edelhagen Orchestra.

defs.def_en: A stalwart is a loyal worker or supporter of an organization, especially a political party.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 忠实的;坚定的;完全可靠的

ext.ext_cn: 殖民政府的忠实拥护者
ext.ext_en: ...a stalwart supporter of the colonial government...

ext.ext_en: The stalwart volunteers marched in this morning ready to go to work.

defs.def_en: A stalwart supporter or worker is loyal, steady, and completely reliable.

ext.ext_en: I knew I was never in any danger with my stalwart bodyguard around me.

defs.def_en: A stalwart man is strong.

ext.ext_en: Many voters were alarmed by the President's new stridency.

defs.def_en: Stridency is the quality of being strident.

ext.ext_cn: 安妮公主的钱并非多得取之不尽，用之不竭。
ext.ext_en: Princess Anne does not have a bottomless purse.

defs.def_en: If you describe a supply of something as bottomless, you mean that it seems so large that it will never run out.

defs.def_cn: 深不见底的；深不可测的

ext.ext_en: His eyes were like bottomless brown pools.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as bottomless, you mean that it is so deep that it seems to have no bottom.

ext.ext_en: A gold mine is not a bottomless pit, the gold runs out...

ext.ext_en: The problem is we don't have a bottomless pit of resources...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a bottomless pit, you mean that it seems as if you can take things from it and it will never be empty or put things in it and it will never be full.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: She herself insists she is no slavish follower of fashion.

defs.def_en: You use slavish to describe things that copy or imitate something exactly, without any attempt to be original.

ext.ext_en: Total devotion it certainly was, slavish devotion some would say.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as slavish, you are critical of the fact that they behave like a slave, for example by always doing what another person wants.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the cacophonous beat of pop music.

defs.def_en: If you describe a mixture of sounds as cacophonous, you mean that they are loud and unpleasant.

ext.ext_en: The letter had a very salutary effect.

ext.ext_en: She inducts Nina into the cult.

defs.def_en: If someone is inducted into the army, they are officially made to join the army.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the appetising smell of freshly baked bread...

ext.ext_en: Kippers are dyed yellow to make them more appetizing.

defs.def_en: Appetizing food looks and smells good, so that you want to eat it.

ext.ext_cn: 被美化的历史

ext.ext_cn: 黑白斑小型马

ext.ext_en: ...lime-rich sand.

ext.ext_cn: 卡拉正蜷缩在沙发上，一边吸着烟，一边轻抚着她的猫咪。
