ext.ext_en: Fill in gaps by using short, upward strokes of the pencil.

defs.def_en: The strokes of a pen or brush are the movements or marks that you make with it when you are writing or painting.

defs.def_cn: 划水动作;划桨动作;(游泳或划船的)一次划水

ext.ext_cn: 我转身向海里又游了几下。
ext.ext_en: I turned and swam a few strokes further out to sea...

ext.ext_cn: 船夫们一边划桨一边喊号子。
ext.ext_en: The boatmen accompany the stroke of their oars with the sound of their voices.

defs.def_en: When you are swimming or rowing, your strokes are the repeated movements that you make with your arms or the oars.

ext.ext_cn: 她花了数小时练习蛙泳。
ext.ext_en: She spent hours practising the breast stroke.

defs.def_en: A swimming stroke is a particular style or method of swimming.

ext.ext_cn: 12 点的钟声刚敲响，焰火便在夜空中绽放。
ext.ext_en: On the stroke of 12, fireworks suddenly exploded into the night.

defs.def_en: The strokes of a clock are the sounds that indicate each hour.

ext.ext_cn: 康普顿一会将球打到这里，一会打到那里，每一拍的落点都不同。
ext.ext_en: Compton was sending the ball here, there, and everywhere with each stroke.

defs.def_en: In sports such as tennis, baseball, cricket, and golf, a stroke is the action of hitting the ball.

ext.ext_cn: 天没下雨，结果成了件幸事。
ext.ext_en: It didn't rain, which turned out to be a stroke of luck.

defs.def_en: A stroke of luck or good fortune is something lucky that happens.

ext.ext_cn: 当时，对他的任命犹如神来之笔。
ext.ext_en: At the time, his appointment seemed a stroke of genius.

defs.def_en: A stroke of genius or inspiration is a very good idea that someone suddenly has.

ext.ext_cn: 该疾病一下子就使 4,000 万只兔子丧命。
ext.ext_en: The disease wiped out 40 million rabbits at a stroke...

ext.ext_cn: 英国如何能一下子减少其监狱服刑人数?
ext.ext_en: How can Britain reduce its prison population in one stroke?

defs.def_en: If something happens at a stroke or in one stroke, it happens suddenly and completely because of one single action.

ext.ext_cn: 我在上大学时懒得要命。
ext.ext_en: I never did a stroke of work at college.

defs.def_en: If someone does not do a stroke of work, they are very lazy and do no work at all.

ext.ext_cn: 她似乎无法作出决定。
ext.ext_en: She seemed incapable of taking decisions...

ext.ext_cn: 他不是个会施暴的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a man incapable of violence.

defs.def_en: Someone who is incapable of doing something is unable to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 据说他由于软弱无能而丢掉了工作。
ext.ext_en: He lost his job for allegedly being incapable.

defs.def_en: An incapable person is weak or stupid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不受风雨侵袭的;有遮蔽物的

ext.ext_cn: 有天然屏障的海湾旁的一个缓坡海滩
ext.ext_en: ...a shallow-sloping beach next to a sheltered bay.

defs.def_en: A sheltered place is protected from wind and rain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 受庇护的;处处受保护的

ext.ext_cn: 也许我一直过的就是一种呵护备至的生活。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps I've just led a really sheltered life...

ext.ext_cn: 我妈妈在呵护下长大，对童年有着非常美好的回忆。
ext.ext_en: My mother, who had a sheltered upbringing, has fantastic memories of childhood.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has led a sheltered life, you mean that they have been protected from difficult or unpleasant experiences.

defs.def_cn: (住所或工作)适于老人(或残疾人)的，福利性的

ext.ext_cn: 最近几年我一直住在福利院里。
ext.ext_en: For the last few years I have been living in sheltered accommodation.

ext.ext_cn: 为身体严重残疾的人提供的福利性工作
ext.ext_en: ...sheltered employment for people with severe disabilities.

defs.def_en: Sheltered accommodation or work is designed for old or disabled people. It allows them to be independent but also allows them to get help when they need it.

defs.def_cn: （用于制作药物或香水的）香树脂
defs.def_en: Balsam is a sweet-smelling oil that is obtained from certain trees or bushes and used to make medicines and perfumes.

ext.ext_cn: 你睡前想喝杯茶吗？
ext.ext_en: Would you like some tea before you turn in?

defs.def_en: When you turn in, you go to bed.

defs.def_cn: 把（犯罪嫌疑人）交给警方;告发;检举;自首

ext.ext_cn: 他被要求在今天中午前向当局投案自首。
ext.ext_en: He has been given until noon today to turn himself in to authorities...

ext.ext_cn: 向警方举报某人将获重赏。
ext.ext_en: There would be strong incentives to turn someone in...

defs.def_en: If you turn someone in, you take them to the police or tell the police where they are because they are suspected of committing a crime. If you turn yourself in, you go to the police because you have been involved in a crime.

ext.ext_cn: 现在我们等着他们交上作文。
ext.ext_en: Now we wait for them to turn in their essays...

ext.ext_cn: 我希望每个人都上交一份报告。
ext.ext_en: I want everybody to turn a report in.

defs.def_en: When you turn in a completed piece of work, especially written work, you give it to the person who asked you to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我回到警局交还警徽和佩枪。
ext.ext_en: I went back to the station-house to turn in my badge and gun...

ext.ext_cn: 那名管理人员出面让她返还所借图书馆的书。
ext.ext_en: The official showed up to tell her to turn in her library books.

defs.def_en: If you turn something in, you return it to the place or person you borrowed it from.

ext.ext_cn: 他们消失在天边的雾霾中。
ext.ext_en: They vanished into the haze near the horizon...

ext.ext_cn: 太阳透过夏日的薄雾散发着苍白无力的光。
ext.ext_en: The sun smouldered through a thin summer haze.

defs.def_en: Haze is light mist, caused by particles of water or dust in the air, which prevents you from seeing distant objects clearly. Haze often forms in hot weather.

ext.ext_cn: 丹透过烟雾和咖啡的热气朝他笑了笑。
ext.ext_en: Dan smiled at him through a haze of smoke and steaming coffee...

ext.ext_cn: 空气中弥漫着刺鼻的浓烟。
ext.ext_en: A thick haze of acrid smoke hung in the air.

defs.def_en: If there is a haze of something such as smoke or steam, you cannot see clearly through it.

ext.ext_cn: 由于害怕和困惑，他当时处于一种混沌状态。
ext.ext_en: His mind was a haze of fear and confusion.

ext.ext_cn: 让大家根据对过去的模糊印象忆起逝去的往昔。
ext.ext_en: ...asking people to recollect a vanished past through a nostalgic haze.

defs.def_en: If someone is in a haze, they are not thinking clearly or not really noticing what is happening around them.

ext.ext_cn: 大型自选超市
ext.ext_en: ...a Do-It-Yourself superstore.

defs.def_en: Superstores are very large supermarkets or shops selling household goods and equipment. Superstores are usually built outside city centres away from other shops.

defs.def_cn: 寄生虫;吃白食的人;利用别人好心揩油的人
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a freeloader, you disapprove of them because they take advantage of other people's kindness, for example by accepting food or accommodation from them, without giving anything in return.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 刻板模仿的;毫无创意的;照搬的

ext.ext_cn: 她坚称自己绝不会一味地追随时尚。
ext.ext_en: She herself insists she is no slavish follower of fashion.

defs.def_en: You use slavish to describe things that copy or imitate something exactly, without any attempt to be original.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 奴性十足的;俯首帖耳的

ext.ext_cn: 这当然是绝对的忠诚，有人也许会称之为俯首帖耳，唯命是从。
ext.ext_en: Total devotion it certainly was, slavish devotion some would say.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as slavish, you are critical of the fact that they behave like a slave, for example by always doing what another person wants.

ext.ext_cn: 他怀疑那位精神科医生试图刺激他作出一些本能的反应。
ext.ext_en: He wondered if the psychiatrist was trying to goad him into some unguarded response...

ext.ext_cn: 查尔斯总是招惹我。
ext.ext_en: Charles was always goading me.

defs.def_en: If you goad someone, you deliberately make them feel angry or irritated, often causing them to react by doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 埃莉运用自己的机智风趣启发人们，努力使他们看清眼前的东西。
ext.ext_en: Ellie uses wit as a goad to try to force people to see what is in front of them.

defs.def_en: A goad is something that makes someone do a particular thing.
A goad is a sharp, pointed stick that is used for driving cattle.

ext.ext_cn: 他困惑地皱着眉头。
ext.ext_en: He frowned in puzzlement.

defs.def_en: Puzzlement is the confusion that you feel when you do not understand something.

ext.ext_cn: 晚餐前他洗了澡，刮了脸。
ext.ext_en: He took a bath and shaved before dinner...

ext.ext_cn: 他把脸上的胡子刮得干干净净。
ext.ext_en: He had shaved his face until it was smooth...

defs.def_en: When a man shaves, he removes the hair from his face using a razor or shaver so that his face is smooth.

ext.ext_cn: 很多女性都刮腿毛。
ext.ext_en: Many women shave their legs...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你有一头卷曲的长发，不要剪掉。
ext.ext_en: If you have long curly hair, don't shave it off.

defs.def_en: If someone shaves a part of their body, they remove the hair from it so that it is smooth.

ext.ext_cn: 医生将他的头发剃去了。
ext.ext_en: The doctors shaved his head...

ext.ext_cn: 她不得不叫个理发师来给他刮脸。
ext.ext_en: She had to call a barber to shave him.

defs.def_en: If you shave someone, you remove the hair from their face or another part of their body so that it is smooth.

ext.ext_cn: 我将原木放到了地上，刨掉了树皮。
ext.ext_en: I set the log on the ground and shaved off the bark...

ext.ext_cn: 她正将小胡瓜切成薄片。
ext.ext_en: She was shaving thin slices off a courgette.

defs.def_en: If you shave off part of a piece of wood or other material, you cut very thin pieces from it.

defs.def_cn: (少量地)削减，缩减;使(略)有下降

ext.ext_cn: 她已经将一英里赛跑的国家纪录缩短了 4 秒。
ext.ext_en: She's already shaved four seconds off the national record for the mile...

ext.ext_cn: 超市连锁店已经稍稍降价。
ext.ext_en: Supermarket chains have shaved prices.

defs.def_en: If you shave a small amount off something such as a record, cost, or price, you reduce it by that amount.

ext.ext_cn: 我真是无法相信就在最近自己侥幸逃过了几场大难。
ext.ext_en: I can't quite believe the close shaves I've had just recently.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as a close shave, you mean that there was nearly an accident or a disaster but it was avoided.

defs.def_cn: （通常指战争中或处决犯人时用的）毒气，毒瓦斯
defs.def_en: Poison gas is a gas that is poisonous and is usually used to kill people in war or to execute criminals.

ext.ext_cn: 我们要求公众为自家的狗做绝育手术，并严格看管。
ext.ext_en: We ask the public to have their dogs neutered and keep them under close supervision.

defs.def_en: When an animal is neutered, its reproductive organs are removed so that it cannot create babies.

ext.ext_cn: 削夺地方政府权力的政府“秘密议程”
ext.ext_en: ...the Government's 'hidden agenda' to neuter local authorities...

ext.ext_cn: 任务开始之前他们的空军就已经丧失了威力。
ext.ext_en: Their air force had been neutered before the work began.

defs.def_en: To neuter an organization, group, or person means to make them powerless and ineffective.

defs.def_cn: (某些语言中名词、代词、形容词等)中性的
defs.def_en: In some languages, a neuter noun, pronoun, or adjective has a different form from a masculine or feminine one, or behaves in a different way.
A CD burner is the same as a CD writer .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无止境的;无边无际的;无休止的

ext.ext_cn: 他们转入一条看不到尽头的街道。
ext.ext_en: They turned into an endless street...

ext.ext_cn: 那是场无休止的战争。
ext.ext_en: The war was endless.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is endless, you mean that it is very large or lasts for a very long time, and it seems as if it will never stop.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她一副无事不登三宝殿的神情，很明显，这不是一次随意造访。
ext.ext_en: She had a purposeful air, and it became evident that this was not a casual visit.

defs.def_en: If someone is purposeful, they show that they have a definite aim and a strong desire to achieve it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 缺乏的;不足的;供不应求的

ext.ext_cn: 食物供不应求，而且价格昂贵。
ext.ext_en: Food was scarce and expensive...

ext.ext_cn: 工作机会越来越少。
ext.ext_en: Jobs are becoming increasingly scarce.

defs.def_en: If something is scarce, there is not enough of it.

defs.def_cn: (通常为避开难事或僵局)躲开，溜走，回避

ext.ext_cn: 你最好回避一下。
ext.ext_en: It probably would be a good idea if you made yourself scarce.

defs.def_en: If you make yourself scarce, you quickly leave the place you are in, usually in order to avoid a difficult or embarrassing situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （常指因情感或社会问题而）头脑混乱的，迷惑不解的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为他是一个思想有障碍的孩子。
ext.ext_en: I think he's a rather mixed up kid...

ext.ext_cn: 我没有时间感和方位感。
ext.ext_en: I get mixed up about times and places.

defs.def_en: If you are mixed up, you are confused, often because of emotional or social problems.

defs.def_cn: 卷入…的;牵连进…的;与…厮混在一起的

ext.ext_cn: 戴维怎么会卷进一宗谋杀案呢？
ext.ext_en: How could David be mixed up in a murder?...

ext.ext_cn: 我怎么会曾经跟你混在一起呢？
ext.ext_en: Why did I ever get mixed up with you?

defs.def_en: To be mixed up in something bad, or with someone you disapprove of, means to be involved in it or with them.
See also:Achilles tendon;A tendon is a strong cord in a person's or animal's body which joins a muscle to a bone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指因为回忆起过去而开心或感伤得）泪眼蒙眬的

ext.ext_cn: 聆听着唱片里鲁比·默里演唱《丹尼男孩》的时候，他们泪眼模糊。
ext.ext_en: They got misty-eyed listening to records of Ruby Murray singing 'Danny Boy'.

defs.def_en: If you say that something makes you misty-eyed, you mean that it makes you feel so happy or sentimental, especially about the past, that you feel as if you are going to cry.

defs.def_cn: 缓和剂；治标剂；姑息疗法
defs.def_en: A palliative is a drug or medical treatment that relieves suffering without treating the cause of the suffering.

ext.ext_cn: 对于越来越多的财政问题，贷款只是权宜之计，不是解决方法。
ext.ext_en: The loan was a palliative, not a cure, for ever-increasing financial troubles...

ext.ext_cn: 私宅中可用房间数的增加缓解了客房总体不足的问题。
ext.ext_en: The increase in the number of rooms available in private homes acted as a palliative to the general accommodation shortage.

defs.def_en: A palliative is an action that is intended to make the effects of a problem less severe but does not actually solve the problem.
The United Nations is an organization which most countries belong to. Its role is to encourage international peace, co-operation, and friendship.

ext.ext_cn: 他们以前每年去她的墓前凭吊两次。
ext.ext_en: They used to visit her grave twice a year.

defs.def_en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried.

ext.ext_cn: 纵酒而自折其寿
ext.ext_en: ...drinking yourself to an early grave...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数男人宁死都不愿承认有依赖感。
ext.ext_en: Most men would rather go to the grave than own up to feelings of dependency.

defs.def_en: You can refer to some-one's death as their grave or to death as the grave .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他说他的国家情况十分危急。
ext.ext_en: He said that the situation in his country is very grave...

ext.ext_cn: 我对这些文件能否说明所有的问题深表怀疑。
ext.ext_en: I have grave doubts that the documents tell the whole story.

defs.def_en: A grave event or situation is very serious, important, and worrying.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 威廉在屋顶上呆了一段时间，他下来的时候面色凝重。
ext.ext_en: William was up on the roof for some time and when he came down he looked grave...

ext.ext_cn: 她忐忑不安地审视着他异常严肃的脸色。
ext.ext_en: Anxiously, she examined his unusually grave face.

defs.def_en: A grave person is quiet and serious in their appearance or behaviour.

In some languages such as French, a grave accent is a symbol that is placed over a vowel in a word to show how the vowel is pronounced. For example, the word 'mère' has a grave accent over the first 'e'

ext.ext_cn: 这份杂志并非想断送他的事业，而他拒绝接受采访就是在自毁前程。
ext.ext_en: The magazine isn't trying to ruin his career, the man's digging his own grave by refusing an interview.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is digging their own grave, you are warning them that they are doing something foolish or dangerous that will cause their own failure.

ext.ext_cn: 一想到冒他之名所做下的那些事，达尔文在九泉之下一定不得安宁。
ext.ext_en: Darwin must be turning in his grave at the thought of what is being perpetrated in his name.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone who is dead would turn in their grave at something that is happening now, you mean that they would be very shocked or upset by it, if they were alive.
A Popsicle is a piece of flavoured ice or ice cream on a stick.
A sonata is a piece of classical music written either for a single instrument, or for one instrument and a piano.

defs.def_cn: （使)(某地或某事）有生气；（使）变热闹

ext.ext_cn: 我们怎么才能把这房间装饰得更有生气呢？
ext.ext_en: How could we decorate the room to liven it up?...

ext.ext_cn: 选择这块五彩缤纷的碎呢小毯是为了给这灰色的地毯添些生气。
ext.ext_en: The multicoloured rag rug was chosen to liven up the grey carpet...

defs.def_en: If a place or event livens up, or if something livens it up, it becomes more interesting and exciting.

defs.def_cn: （使）（某人）愉快起来；（使）活跃起来

ext.ext_cn: 谈到她的女儿时，她的心情愉快起来。
ext.ext_en: Talking about her daughters livens her up...

ext.ext_cn: 午夜过后，乔治来了劲，人也活跃起来。
ext.ext_en: George livens up after midnight, relaxing a little.

defs.def_en: If people liven up, or if something livens them up, they become more cheerful and energetic.

defs.def_cn: （尤指驾驶昂贵的高性能汽车的）飙车小子，飙车手

ext.ext_cn: 不良驾驶不仅仅是飙车小子们才会做的事。
ext.ext_en: Bad driving is not just the preserve of boy racers...

ext.ext_cn: 汽车制造商们必须停止迎合飙车手对汽车动力和速度的狂热迷恋。
ext.ext_en: Car manufacturers must stop pandering to the boy racers' fantasies about power and speed.

defs.def_en: British journalists sometimes refer to young men who drive very fast, especially in expensive and powerful cars, as boy racers.

ext.ext_cn: 静脉滴注器
ext.ext_en: ...an intravenous drip.

ext.ext_cn: 通过静脉注射的吸毒者
ext.ext_en: ...intravenous drug users.

defs.def_en: Intravenous foods or drugs are given to sick people through their veins, rather than their mouths.

ext.ext_cn: 政治家们谴责媒体夸大了发生骚乱的可能性。
ext.ext_en: Politicians accuse the media of talking up the possibility of a riot...

ext.ext_cn: 他会大肆吹捧自己制定的经济计划。
ext.ext_en: He'll be talking up his plans for the economy.

defs.def_en: If someone talks up a particular thing, they make it sound more interesting, valuable, or likely than it originally seemed.

defs.def_cn: 说服…提高出价;抬高…的价格

ext.ext_cn: 克拉克不断把价格向上抬，而威尔金森则不断往下压。
ext.ext_en: Clarke kept talking the price up, while Wilkinson kept knocking it down.

defs.def_en: To talk someone or something up in negotiations means to persuade someone to pay more money than they originally offered or wanted to.

ext.ext_cn: 我奶奶和外婆都是孤寡一人。
ext.ext_en: My grandmothers are both widows.

defs.def_en: Your grandmother is the mother of your father or mother.

ext.ext_cn: 这本杂志绝对没有美化混混们。
ext.ext_en: This magazine in no way glorifies gangs.

ext.ext_cn: 对吹捧战争和种族歧视的歌曲的禁播令
ext.ext_en: ...the banning of songs glorifying war and racism.

defs.def_en: To glorify something means to praise it or make it seem good or special, usually when it is not.

ext.ext_cn: 我们全心全意敬奉上帝，竭尽所能颂扬他的美名。
ext.ext_en: We are all committed to serving the Lord and glorifying His name in the best way we know.

defs.def_en: If you glorify God, you praise Him.

defs.def_cn: (包括地面建筑及相应设备的)煤矿
defs.def_en: A colliery is a coal mine and all the buildings and equipment which are connected with it.

defs.def_cn: （板球投手投出的）外曲线球，变向曲线球
defs.def_en: When a cricketer bowls a googly, he or she spins the ball and makes it bounce in a different direction from the direction that the batsman is expecting.

ext.ext_cn: 会谈推迟是因为对会谈地点存在争议。
ext.ext_en: The postponement was due to a dispute over where the talks should be held.

defs.def_en: The postponement of an event is the act of delaying it happening or arranging for it to take place at a later time than  originally planned.

ext.ext_cn: 这种药增加了血液里的红细胞数量，从而将摄氧量提高了10%。
ext.ext_en: The drug increases the number of red cells in the blood, enhancing oxygen uptake by 10 percent.

ext.ext_cn: 关于蔬菜中硝酸盐含量的研究
ext.ext_en: ...research in relation to the uptake of nitrate into vegetables.

defs.def_en: A person's uptake of something is the amount of it that they use.

ext.ext_cn: 她并不是个才智非凡的人，但理解力很强。
ext.ext_en: She is not an intellectual, but is quick on the uptake...

ext.ext_cn: 卡萝尔心不在焉，反应有点迟钝。
ext.ext_en: Carol was absent-minded and a little slow on the uptake.

defs.def_en: You say that someone is quick on the uptake when they understand things quickly. You say that someone is slow on the uptake when they have difficulty understanding simple or obvious things.

ext.ext_cn: 重要的是不要让错误毁了你的生活。
ext.ext_en: It's important not to let mistakes spoil your life...

ext.ext_cn: 宁静的夏夜可能会被蚊子破坏掉。
ext.ext_en: Peaceful summer evenings can be spoilt by mosquitoes.

defs.def_en: If you spoil something, you prevent it from being successful or satisfactory.

ext.ext_cn: 祖父母每次来访都往往禁不住要娇惯孙辈。
ext.ext_en: Grandparents are often tempted to spoil their grandchildren whenever they come to visit.

defs.def_en: If you spoil children, you give them everything they want or ask for. This is considered to have a bad effect on a child's character.

ext.ext_cn: 今年夏天买瓶新香水慰劳一下自己吧。
ext.ext_en: Spoil yourself with a new perfume this summer...

ext.ext_cn: 也许我可以雇别人来熨他的衬衫，但我想好好宠他。他是我爱的男人。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps I could employ someone to iron his shirts, but I wanted to spoil him. He was my man.

defs.def_en: If you spoil yourself or spoil another person, you give yourself or them something nice as a treat or do something special for them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都知道油脂变质后会发臭。
ext.ext_en: We all know that fats spoil by becoming rancid...

ext.ext_cn: 有些生物会导致食物变质并引起食物中毒。
ext.ext_en: Some organisms are responsible for spoiling food and cause food poisoning...

defs.def_en: If food spoils or if it is spoilt, it is no longer fit to be eaten.

defs.def_cn: (因在其上写违法的内容而)使(选票)无效

ext.ext_cn: 他们通过广播呼吁选民们投无效选票。
ext.ext_en: They had broadcast calls for voters to spoil their ballot papers...

ext.ext_cn: 结果显示，7.2 %的选民投了空白或无效票。
ext.ext_en: The results showed that 7.2% of the voters cast blank or spoiled ballots.

defs.def_en: If someone spoils their vote, they write something illegal on their voting paper, usually as a protest about the election, and their vote is not accepted.

defs.def_cn: 战利品;因成功获得的好处

ext.ext_cn: 按照军事惯例，胜者正在分享战利品。
ext.ext_en: True to military tradition, the victors are now treating themselves to the spoils of war...

ext.ext_cn: 相互争斗的军阀及外国列强们正在争夺政治上的收益。
ext.ext_en: Competing warlords and foreign powers scrambled for political spoils.

defs.def_en: The spoils of something are things that people get as a result of winning a battle or of doing something successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 到了午餐时间，议员们有 26 家之多的餐厅和酒吧可供选择。
ext.ext_en: At lunchtime, MPs are spoilt for choice in 26 restaurants and bars.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is spoilt for choice or spoiled for choice, you mean that they have a great many things of the same type to choose from.

defs.def_cn: 无法居住的；不适合居住的

ext.ext_cn: 该市约90％的独户住宅都不适合居住。
ext.ext_en: About 90 percent of the city's single-family homes are uninhabitable...

ext.ext_cn: 随着世界的一些地方变得不适人居，数以百万计的人将会试图迁移到环境更加宜人的地区。
ext.ext_en: As parts of the world become uninhabitable, millions of people will try to migrate to more hospitable areas.

defs.def_en: If a place is uninhabitable, it is impossible for people to live there, for example because it is dangerous or unhealthy.

ext.ext_cn: 蚂蚁从地下成群地钻出来，爬满了她的鞋子和双腿。
ext.ext_en: Ants swarmed up out of the ground and covered her shoes and legs.

defs.def_en: Ants are small crawling insects that live in large groups.

ext.ext_cn: 和平没有为依赖海外贸易的经济问题带来解决办法。
ext.ext_en: Peace brought no solution to the economic problems that pivoted on overseas trade.

defs.def_en: If one thing pivots on another, it depends on it.

ext.ext_cn: 他得了一种罕见的癌症。
ext.ext_en: He contracted a rare form of cancer...

ext.ext_cn: 医生们愿意采取某种形式的劳工行动。
ext.ext_en: Doctors are willing to take some form of industrial action...

defs.def_en: A form of something is a type or kind of it.

ext.ext_cn: 山谷经常以深峡谷的形态存在。
ext.ext_en: Valleys often take the form of deep canyons...

ext.ext_cn: 他们获得了减税优惠。
ext.ext_en: They received a benefit in the form of a tax reduction...

defs.def_en: When something can exist or happen in several possible ways, you can use form to refer to one particular way in which it exists or happens.

defs.def_cn: 形成;(使)排列成;组成…形状

ext.ext_cn: 彼得书房外面排起了队。
ext.ext_en: A queue forms outside Peter's study...

ext.ext_cn: 他们围成一个圆圈，唱起了《友谊地久天长》。
ext.ext_en: They formed a circle and sang 'Auld Lang Syne'...

defs.def_en: When a particular shape forms or is formed, people or things move or are arranged so that this shape is made.

ext.ext_cn: 体形
ext.ext_en: ...the form of the body.

defs.def_en: The form of something is its shape.

ext.ext_cn: 她想她从来没有因看到他那肥胖的身躯而如此高兴。
ext.ext_en: She thought she'd never been so glad to see his bulky form.

defs.def_en: You can refer to something that you can see as a form if you cannot see it clearly, or if its outline is the clearest or most striking aspect of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些嵌板折起来组成了一个约 5 英尺高的屏风。
ext.ext_en: These panels folded up to form a screen some five feet tall...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的建筑都有名称，连在一起构成了一个半圆。
ext.ext_en: All the buildings have names and form a half circle.

defs.def_en: If something is arranged or changed so that it becomes similar to a thing with a particular structure or function, you can say that it forms that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 构成伦道夫此书的基础的那些文章
ext.ext_en: ...the articles that formed the basis of Randolph's book...

ext.ext_cn: 谷类是世界范围内很大一部分人的主要食物。
ext.ext_en: Cereals form the staple diet of an enormous number of people around the world.

defs.def_en: If something consists of particular things, people, or features, you can say that they form that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他们试图组建一个人权问题研究小组。
ext.ext_en: They tried to form a study group on human rights...

ext.ext_cn: 他们组成了几个队。
ext.ext_en: They formed themselves into teams.

defs.def_en: If you form an organization, group, or company, you start it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些恒星一定是形成于 100 到 150 亿年前。
ext.ext_en: The stars must have formed 10 to 15 billion years ago...

ext.ext_cn: 巨大的冰层形成了。
ext.ext_en: Huge ice sheets were formed.

defs.def_en: When something natural forms or is formed, it begins to exist and develop.

defs.def_cn: (使)(关系、习惯或想法)形成;(使)产生

ext.ext_cn: 这应该能帮助他建立持久的关系。
ext.ext_en: This should help him form lasting relationships...

ext.ext_cn: 她已经养成了对男人投怀送抱的习惯。
ext.ext_en: She had formed the habit of giving herself freely to men...

defs.def_en: If you form a relationship, a habit, or an idea, or if it forms, it begins to exist and develop.

ext.ext_cn: 对不公正现象的愤怒塑造了他的性格。
ext.ext_en: Anger at injustice formed his character.

defs.def_en: If you say that something forms a person's character or personality, you mean that it has a strong influence on them and causes them to develop in a particular way.

defs.def_cn: (运动员或参赛动物的)竞技状态,表现状态

ext.ext_cn: 他这一赛季状态非常不错。
ext.ext_en: His form this season has been brilliant...

ext.ext_cn: 勒孔特表现出良好的状态。
ext.ext_en: Leconte showed good form.

defs.def_en: In sport, form refers to the ability or success of a person or animal over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 你将需要填写一张有关生日和职业详情的表格。
ext.ext_en: You will be asked to fill in a form with details of your birth and occupation.

ext.ext_cn: 申请表
ext.ext_en: ...application forms.

defs.def_en: See also:sixth form;A form is a paper with questions on it and spaces marked where you should write the answers. Forms usually ask you to give details about yourself, for example when you are applying for a job or joining an organization.

defs.def_cn: 讨厌的行为;不礼貌的行为

ext.ext_cn: 在社交场合讨论生意被认为是不礼貌的。
ext.ext_en: It was thought bad form to discuss business on social occasions.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is bad form to behave in a particular way, you mean that it is rude and impolite.

defs.def_cn: 身体健康;情况良好;心情愉悦
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in good form, you mean that they seem healthy and cheerful.
If you say that someone is off form, you think they are not performing as well as they usually do.

defs.def_cn: 状态良好;表现出色;发挥正常

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯特·雷德福在新片《通天神偷》中恢复了表演水准。
ext.ext_en: Robert Redford is back on form in his new movie 'Sneakers'.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is on form, you think that they are performing their usual activity very well.

ext.ext_cn: 随着计划在脑海里逐渐成形，她意识到需要找一个帮手。
ext.ext_en: As plans took form in her mind, she realized the need for an accomplice...

ext.ext_cn: 昏暗中，里斯本夫人的脸慢慢变得清晰起来。
ext.ext_en: The face of Mrs Lisbon took form in the dimness.

defs.def_en: When something takes form, it develops or begins to be visible.

ext.ext_cn: 一如往常，列车还没驶出伦敦郊区，他就开始和别人聊起天来。
ext.ext_en: Before the train had left the outskirts of London he behaved true to form and began a conversation...

ext.ext_cn: 我的运气和往常一样。
ext.ext_en: My luck was running true to form...

defs.def_en: If someone or something behaves true to form, they do what is expected and is typical of them.

ext.ext_cn: 纽曼独自走在街上。
ext.ext_en: Newman walked along the street alone...

ext.ext_cn: 那个年轻人领着马克·赖尔沿走廊而去。
ext.ext_en: The young man led Mark Ryle along a corridor...

defs.def_en: If you move or look along something such as a road, you move or look towards one end of it.

ext.ext_cn: 马路上严重的交通阻塞
ext.ext_en: ...enormous traffic jams all along the roads.

ext.ext_cn: 沿河打桩盖的房子
ext.ext_en: ...houses built on piles along the river...

defs.def_en: If something is situated along a road, river, or corridor, it is situated in it or beside it.

ext.ext_cn: 她蹦蹦跳跳地往前走着。
ext.ext_en: She skipped and danced along...

ext.ext_cn: 他们往前走时，他略微提高了嗓音，迎着风说话。
ext.ext_en: He raised his voice a little, talking into the wind as they walked along...

defs.def_en: When someone or something moves along, they keep moving in a particular direction.

ext.ext_cn: 一直在无休止拖延的谈判
ext.ext_en: ...the negotiations which have been dragging along interminably...

ext.ext_cn: 一切居然进行得很顺利。
ext.ext_en: Everything was coming along fine after all...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is going along in a particular way, you mean that it is progressing in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 这对所有年龄段的女性开放，所以请带上你的朋友和同事一起光临。
ext.ext_en: This is open to women of all ages, so bring along your friends and colleagues...

ext.ext_cn: 已婚妇女必须携带结婚证。
ext.ext_en: Wives will have to bring along their marriage certificate.

defs.def_en: If you take someone or something along when you go somewhere, you take them with you.

ext.ext_cn: 她邀请了每一个她认识的人前来。
ext.ext_en: She invited everyone she knew to come along...

ext.ext_cn: 他对材料做了检验并送出了检验结果。
ext.ext_en: He had the material tested and sent along the results.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is coming along or is sent along, they are coming or being sent to a particular place.

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿的母亲和另外两个孩子一起逃离了火海。
ext.ext_en: The baby's mother escaped from the fire along with two other children...

ext.ext_cn: 有32种不同的巧克力与面包和蛋糕一起出售。
ext.ext_en: There are 32 different kinds of chocolate on sale along with the bread and cakes.

defs.def_en: You use along with to mention someone or something else that is also involved in an action or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我一直在欺骗自己。
ext.ext_en: I've been fooling myself all along...

ext.ext_cn: 我想她一直在计划离开匈牙利。
ext.ext_en: I think she had been planning all along to leave Hungary.

defs.def_en: If something has been true or been present all along, it has been true or been present throughout a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 曾经是一个媒体帝国当仁不让的继任人的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a man who was once the heir apparent to a media empire...

ext.ext_cn: 他被视为奥尔森先生理所当然的继任者。
ext.ext_en: He was seen as Mr Olsen's heir apparent.

defs.def_en: The heir apparent to a particular job or position is the person who is expected to have it after the person who has it now.
A loganberry is a purplish red fruit that is similar to a raspberry.

defs.def_cn: (正常尺寸、标准量度的)四分之三的

ext.ext_cn: 夏天穿短袖或七分袖的衣服。
ext.ext_en: Choose short or three-quarter sleeves for summer.

ext.ext_cn: 持续 1 小时 45 分钟的会议
ext.ext_en: ...a session which lasted one and three-quarter hours.

defs.def_en: You can use three-quarter to describe something which is three fourths of the usual size or three fourths of a standard measurement.

ext.ext_cn: 埃及石棺
ext.ext_en: ...an Egyptian sarcophagus.

defs.def_en: A sarcophagus is a large decorative container in which a dead body was placed in ancient times.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她腺体肿痛。
ext.ext_en: Her glands were swollen and painful...

ext.ext_cn: 桑普拉斯等待着疼痛的左腿胫骨的骨骼扫描结果。
ext.ext_en: Sampras awaits the results of a bone scan on a painful left shin.

defs.def_en: If a part of your body is painful, it hurts because it is injured or because there is something wrong with  it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （病、伤、手术等）令人疼痛的，引起疼痛的

ext.ext_cn: 疼痛的背伤
ext.ext_en: ...a painful back injury...

ext.ext_cn: 晒伤不仅疼，还有潜在危险。
ext.ext_en: Sunburn is painful and potentially dangerous.

defs.def_en: If something such as an illness, injury, or operation is painful, it causes you a lot of physical pain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （情形、记忆或经历）痛苦的，难受的，恼人的

ext.ext_cn: 那样的话勾起了痛苦的回忆。
ext.ext_en: Remarks like that brought back painful memories...

ext.ext_cn: 向民主的艰难转变
ext.ext_en: ...the painful transition to democracy...

defs.def_en: Situations, memories, or experiences that are painful are difficult and unpleasant to deal with, and often make you feel sad and upset.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 观看那次访谈让人难堪。
ext.ext_en: The interview was painful to watch.

defs.def_en: If a performance or interview is painful, it is so bad that it makes you feel embarrassed for the people taking part in it.
Sheet metal is metal which has been made into thin sheets.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 同种类的;同性质的;由相同成分（或部分）组成的

ext.ext_cn: 失业者不能一概而论。
ext.ext_en: The unemployed are not a homogeneous group...

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯是个民族成分相对单一的国家。
ext.ext_en: Russia is ethnically relatively homogeneous.

defs.def_en: Homogeneous is used to describe a group or thing which has members or parts that are all the same.

ext.ext_cn: 土豆削皮器
ext.ext_en: ...a potato peeler.

defs.def_en: A peeler is a special tool used for removing the skin from fruit and vegetables.

defs.def_cn: 赛特种猎犬(一种长毛猎狗，经训练后可以发现猎物位置)
defs.def_en: A setter is a long-haired dog that can be trained to show hunters where birds and animals are.
Windsurfing is a sport in which you move along the surface of the sea or a lake on a long narrow board with a sail on it.

defs.def_cn: 一瘸一拐地走；跛行；蹒跚

ext.ext_cn: 我伤得不重，但一条大腿伤到了，只好一瘸一拐地走。
ext.ext_en: I wasn't badly hurt, but I injured my thigh and had to limp...

ext.ext_cn: 他腿上有伤，离开时只能一瘸一拐地走。
ext.ext_en: He had to limp off with a leg injury.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal limps, they walk with difficulty or in an uneven way because one of their legs or feet is hurt.

ext.ext_cn: 近年来这家报社一直在靠有限的资源艰难维持。
ext.ext_en: In recent years the newspaper had been limping along on limited resources...

ext.ext_cn: 一艘在克里特岛战役中严重受损的英国战舰艰难缓慢地驶进珍珠港。
ext.ext_en: A British battleship, which had been damaged severely in the battle of Crete, came limping into Pearl Harbor.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as an organization, process, or vehicle limps along, you mean that it continues slowly or with difficulty, for example because it has been weakened or damaged.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她被告知要回绝掉那些握手软弱无力的申请者。
ext.ext_en: She was told to reject applicants with limp handshakes...

ext.ext_cn: 残留物会积聚在头发上，使头发看起来软塌塌的，而且毫无光泽。
ext.ext_en: A residue can build up on the hair shaft, leaving the hair limp and dull looking.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as limp, you mean that it is soft or weak when it should be firm or strong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 四肢无力的；身体一动不动的

ext.ext_cn: 他把绵软无力的她抱进房间，放在床上。
ext.ext_en: He carried her limp body into the room and laid her on the bed...

ext.ext_cn: 他的头撞到一块岩石上，身子软了下来。
ext.ext_en: He hit his head against a rock and went limp.

defs.def_en: If someone is limp, their body has no strength and is not moving, for example because they are asleep or unconscious.
You can refer to someone's possessions, especially their clothes, as their clobber .

ext.ext_cn: 希拉里用花瓶打了他。
ext.ext_en: Hillary clobbered him with a vase.

defs.def_en: If you clobber someone, you hit them.

defs.def_cn: 使受到严重影响;使遭受沉重打击

ext.ext_cn: 建筑业受到经济衰退的严重影响。
ext.ext_en: The construction industry was clobbered by recession...

ext.ext_cn: 五六月湿热的天气严重影响了桑顿巧克力的销售。
ext.ext_en: Sticky weather in May and June clobbered sales of Thorntons' chocolates.

defs.def_en: If a person or company is clobbered by something, they are very badly affected by it.
A power station is a place where electricity is produced.

ext.ext_cn: 这些领导人被民族主义者赶下了台。
ext.ext_en: The leaders have been ousted from power by nationalists...

ext.ext_cn: 上周，他们试图通过议会的不信任投票将他罢免。
ext.ext_en: Last week they tried to oust him in a parliamentary vote of no confidence.

defs.def_en: If someone is ousted from a position of power, job, or place, they are forced to leave it.

defs.def_cn: （备有谷物升运器的）谷仓，粮仓
defs.def_en: A grain elevator is a building in which grain such as corn is stored and which contains machinery for moving the grain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他总是愁眉苦脸的，常因小事发怒。
ext.ext_en: He was miserable all the time and rows would start over petty things.

ext.ext_cn: 没完没了的规则和繁复琐碎的规定
ext.ext_en: ...endless rules and petty regulations...

defs.def_en: You can use petty to describe things such as problems, rules, or arguments which you think are unimportant or relate to unimportant things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 小题大做的；过于关注琐事的

ext.ext_cn: 他小肚鸡肠，满脑子都是鸡毛蒜皮的事儿。
ext.ext_en: He was petty-minded and obsessed with detail...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得那种态度有点小题大做。
ext.ext_en: I think that attitude is a bit petty.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as petty, you mean that they care too much about small, unimportant things and perhaps that they are unnecessarily unkind.

defs.def_cn: 下级的；次要的；小规模的

ext.ext_cn: 威尔逊不是个与小官小吏打交道的人。
ext.ext_en: Wilson was not a man who dealt with petty officials.

ext.ext_cn: 抢手提包和入室盗窃等轻罪
ext.ext_en: ...petty crime, such as handbag-snatching and minor break-ins.

defs.def_en: Petty is used of people or actions that are less important, serious, or great than others.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 高官们可能会策划一场政变来复辟独裁统治。
ext.ext_en: Senior officers could be considering a coup to restore authoritarian rule.

ext.ext_cn: 顿成为了一个他觉得哥哥需要的极度刻薄的独裁者。
ext.ext_en: Don became the overly strict authoritarian he felt his brother needed.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or an organization as authoritarian, you are critical of them controlling everything rather than letting people decide things for themselves.

defs.def_cn: 摧毁，拆毁，拆除(建筑物等)

ext.ext_cn: 暴风雨径直席卷该岛，摧毁了建筑，淹没了街道。
ext.ext_en: A storm moved directly over the island, demolishing buildings and flooding streets...

ext.ext_cn: 为修建高速公路，现正拆除这栋建筑。
ext.ext_en: The building is now being demolished to make way for a motorway.

defs.def_en: To demolish something such as a building means to destroy it completely.

defs.def_cn: 驳倒，推翻(某人的观点或论点)

ext.ext_cn: 我们的目的是要彻底击破围绕他的那些谣言。
ext.ext_en: Our intention was to demolish the rumours that have surrounded him...

ext.ext_cn: 关于日本对外界的关注不予理会的谬论，我认为，一下子就被驳倒了。
ext.ext_en: The myth that Japan is not open to concerns from outside has, I think, been demolished at a stroke.

defs.def_en: If you demolish someone's ideas or arguments, you prove that they are completely wrong or unreasonable.

ext.ext_cn: 周六米尔沃尔队以 6 比 0 大败诺茨郡队。
ext.ext_en: Millwall demolished Notts County 6-0 on Saturday.

defs.def_en: If a person or team demolishes their opponents, they defeat them by a great amount.

ext.ext_cn: 你意识到他在嘲弄自己以及周围的一切。
ext.ext_en: You sense he's sending himself up as well as everything else.

ext.ext_cn: 嘲讽战斗机飞行员个个硬派男子作风的滑稽模仿
ext.ext_en: ...a spoof that sends up the macho world of fighter pilots.

defs.def_en: See also:send-up;If you send someone or something up, you imitate them in an amusing way that makes them appear foolish.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我会因杀一个人而坐牢，那我还不如再杀3个呢。
ext.ext_en: If I'm going to be sent up for killing one guy, then I might as well kill three more.

defs.def_en: If someone who is on trial is sent up, they are found guilty and sent to prison.
A parley is a discussion between two opposing people or groups in which both sides try to come to an agreement.

ext.ext_cn: 我们见面协商的地方
ext.ext_en: ...a place where we meet and parley...

ext.ext_cn: 我想你没有尝试和格利德谈和过，是吗？
ext.ext_en: I don't think you've ever tried parleying with Gleed, have you?

defs.def_en: When two opposing people or groups parley, they meet to discuss something in order to come to an agreement.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 印第安人带了精美的珠饰来卖。
ext.ext_en: The Indians brought in exquisite beadwork to sell...

ext.ext_cn: 张先生的摄影作品非常精美。
ext.ext_en: Mr Zhang's photography is exquisite.

defs.def_en: Something that is exquisite is extremely beautiful or pleasant, especially in a delicate way.

ext.ext_cn: 听到从她嘴里说出来的话，他感到极大的快乐。
ext.ext_en: The words issuing from her lips gave exquisite pleasure as they flowed over him...

ext.ext_cn: 她小心翼翼地削皮。
ext.ext_en: She peeled it with exquisite care.

defs.def_en: Exquisite is used to emphasize that a feeling or quality is very great or intense.

defs.def_cn: （尤见于天主教徒）圣母马利亚

ext.ext_cn: 你能为我向圣母马利亚祈祷吗？
ext.ext_en: Will you pray to Our Lady for me?

defs.def_en: Some Christians, especially Catholics, refer to Mary, the mother of Jesus Christ, as Our Lady.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 政府在弗纳德存放放射性废料已达50年之久。
ext.ext_en: The government has been storing radioactive waste at Fernald for 50 years.

defs.def_en: Something that is radioactive contains a substance that produces energy in the form of powerful and harmful rays.

ext.ext_cn: 伊罗步履蹒跚地走近，肚子鼓胀凸出。
ext.ext_en: Jiro waddled closer, his belly bulging and distended...

ext.ext_cn: 他的肚子在黑色T恤衫下鼓鼓地挺着。
ext.ext_en: He bulges out of his black T-shirt...

defs.def_en: If something such as a person's stomach bulges, it sticks out.

ext.ext_cn: 他的眼睛鼓得像癞蛤蟆。
ext.ext_en: His eyes seemed to bulge like those of a toad...

ext.ext_cn: 他朝他的兄弟吼叫，脖子上青筋暴突。
ext.ext_en: He shouted at his brother, his neck veins bulging.

defs.def_en: If someone's eyes or veins are bulging, they seem to stick out a lot, often because the person is making a strong physical effort or is experiencing a strong emotion.

ext.ext_cn: 他们车里满载大包小盒，回到了家。
ext.ext_en: They returned home with the car bulging with boxes.

ext.ext_cn: 一个塞得满满的公文包
ext.ext_en: ...a bulging briefcase.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is bulging with things, you are emphasizing that it is full of them.

ext.ext_cn: 你屁股和大腿上的肿块怎么还不消下去？
ext.ext_en: Why won't those bulges on your hips and thighs go?

defs.def_en: Bulges are lumps that stick out from a surface which is otherwise flat or smooth.

ext.ext_cn: 飞机销量的猛增
ext.ext_en: ...a bulge in aircraft sales.

ext.ext_cn: 今后两年陆续到期的巨额支付款项
ext.ext_en: ...the huge bulge of payments due over the next two years.

defs.def_en: If there is a bulge in something, there is a sudden large increase in it.

ext.ext_cn: 头发生长的速度可能极其缓慢。
ext.ext_en: The rate at which hair grows can be agonisingly slow...

ext.ext_cn: 世界上热带森林消失的速度比专家们预想的还要快。
ext.ext_en: The world's tropical forests are disappearing at an even faster rate than experts had thought.

defs.def_en: The rate at which something happens is the speed with which it happens.

ext.ext_cn: 新的饮食类书籍差不多一周出一本。
ext.ext_en: New diet books appear at a rate of nearly one a week...

ext.ext_cn: 他的心率每分钟慢了30次。
ext.ext_en: His heart rate was 30 beats per minute slower...

defs.def_en: The rate at which something happens is the number of times it happens over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 优惠时段的话费是每分钟36便士，其他时段是48便士。
ext.ext_en: Calls cost 36p per minute cheap rate and 48p at all other times.

ext.ext_cn: 为在盖特威克机场进出港的乘客提供的优惠价格
ext.ext_en: ...specially reduced rates for travellers using Gatwick Airport...

defs.def_en: See also:exchange rate;A rate is the amount of money that is charged for goods or services.

ext.ext_cn: 政府坚称不会陷入恐慌而匆忙降息。
ext.ext_en: The government insisted that it would not be panicked into interest rate cuts.

defs.def_en: The rate of taxation or interest is the amount of tax or interest that needs to be paid. It is expressed as a percentage of the amount that is earned, gained as profit, or borrowed.

defs.def_cn: （英国）地方税，不动产税，房地产税

ext.ext_cn: 士兵免缴地方税。
ext.ext_en: Soldiers were exempt from paying rates...

ext.ext_cn: 新的家庭税合并了人头税和地方税两个税种。
ext.ext_en: The new council tax combines elements of both the community charge and the rates.

defs.def_en: In Britain, the rates were a local tax which you paid if you owned property or if you rented property without furniture.

ext.ext_cn: 在所有参加调查的人中，他们认为自己最不贪玩、最负责任。
ext.ext_en: Of all the men in the survey, they rate themselves the least fun-loving and the most responsible...

ext.ext_cn: 90%的孩子都表示这部电影很精彩。
ext.ext_en: The film was rated excellent by 90 per cent of children...

defs.def_en: If you rate someone or something as good or bad, you consider them to be good or bad. You can also say that someone or something rates as good or bad.

ext.ext_cn: 得知其他俱乐部对我感兴趣并看好我令我受宠若惊。
ext.ext_en: It's flattering to know that other clubs have shown interest and seem to rate me...

ext.ext_cn: 它的艺术价值没能打动帕迪·克莱格。“我不知道这样大惊小怪是为什么。我一点儿也不看好它，”他说道。
ext.ext_en: Its artistic value failed to move Paddy Clegg. 'I don't know what all the fuss is about. I didn't rate it at all,' he said.

defs.def_en: If you rate someone or something, you think that they are good.

defs.def_cn: 把…评为;把…认定为;把…列为

ext.ext_cn: 他被公认为意大利第三大实业家。
ext.ext_en: He is generally rated Italy's No. 3 industrialist...

ext.ext_cn: 他以网坛排名第100名的身份来到这里。
ext.ext_en: He came here rated 100th on the tennis computer.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is rated at a particular position or rank, they are calculated or considered to be in that position on a list.

ext.ext_cn: 这简直不可思议，应该得到一枚奖章以及总统的电话祝贺。
ext.ext_en: This is so extraordinary, it rates a medal and a phone call from the President...

ext.ext_cn: 在那些拥挤的街道她的穿着并未引起注意。
ext.ext_en: In those crowded streets her attire did not rate a second glance.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something rates a particular reaction, you mean that this is the reaction you consider to be appropriate.

ext.ext_cn: 她谨慎地提出“性别，至少是男女的性征，也许能解释这个差异”。
ext.ext_en: She modestly suggests that 'sex, or at any rate gender, may account for the difference'...

ext.ext_cn: 他是其中最没有吸引力的角色，至少对我来说是这样。
ext.ext_en: He is the least appealing character, to me at any rate.

defs.def_en: You use at any rate to indicate that what you have just said might be incorrect or unclear in some way, and that you are now being more precise.

defs.def_cn: 不管怎样，无论如何（表示现在所说的话更为重要、而非之前所言）

ext.ext_cn: 不管怎样，潘金说两国之间的关系将在会谈之前恢复。
ext.ext_en: At any rate, Pankin said that relations between the two nations will be restored before the conference...

ext.ext_cn: 好吧，不管怎样，还是要感谢你所做的一切。
ext.ext_en: Well, at any rate, let me thank you for all you did.

defs.def_en: You use at any rate to indicate that the important thing is what you are saying now, and not what was said before.

defs.def_cn: 这样下去；长此以往；如此一来

ext.ext_cn: 这样下去，她到时将有7英尺高了。
ext.ext_en: At this rate, she would be almost seven feet tall by then...

ext.ext_cn: 这样看来他们能在8点半或是9点以前到家就算幸运了。
ext.ext_en: At this rate they'd be lucky to get home before eight-thirty or nine.

defs.def_en: If you say that at this rate something bad or extreme will happen, you mean that it will happen if things continue to develop as they have been doing.

ext.ext_cn: 我们每人都有一个自己想成为什么样的人的想法。
ext.ext_en: We each have a notion of just what kind of person we'd like to be...

ext.ext_cn: 我绝对不能接受我们这一产业的私有化目前已成必然的看法。
ext.ext_en: I reject absolutely the notion that privatisation of our industry is now inevitable...

defs.def_en: A notion is an idea or belief about something.

defs.def_cn: 针头线脑(指针线、纽扣、拉链等小件缝纫用品)
defs.def_en: Notions are small articles for sewing, such as buttons, zips, and thread.
A social club is a club where members go in order to meet each other and enjoy leisure activities.

defs.def_cn: 不知怎样;用某种方法;不知什么缘故;不知怎的

ext.ext_cn: 我和你，我们总能应付过去的。我知道我们会的。
ext.ext_en: We'll  manage somehow, you and me. I know we will...

ext.ext_cn: 第四频道开播了，它在某种程度上为电视创造了一个不同的角色。
ext.ext_en: Channel 4 arrived and somehow created a different role for television...

defs.def_en: You use somehow to say that you do not know or cannot say how something was done or will be done.

ext.ext_cn: 压力和睡眠不足会使情况恶化。
ext.ext_en: Stress and lack of sleep can aggravate the situation...

ext.ext_cn: 他揉擦伤口只会使伤势加重。
ext.ext_en: He would only aggravate the injury by rubbing it.

defs.def_en: If someone or something aggravates a situation, they make it worse.

ext.ext_cn: 该国的哪一点让你最恼火？
ext.ext_en: What aggravates you most about this country?

defs.def_en: If someone or something aggravates you, they make you annoyed.

ext.ext_cn: 他的勤务兵送来的早茶
ext.ext_en: ...morning tea brought by his batman.

defs.def_en: In the British armed forces, an officer's batman is his personal servant.

ext.ext_cn: 铬补充剂被成功运用于治疗糖尿病(见第4章)。
ext.ext_en: Chromium supplements were used successfully in the treatment of diabetes (see Chapter 4)...

ext.ext_cn: 我这章的标题来自我最喜欢的一本书。
ext.ext_en: I took the title of this chapter from one of my favorite books.

defs.def_en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

defs.def_cn: (人生或历史上的)阶段，时期，篇章

ext.ext_cn: 这在黎巴嫩的近代史上是个特别困难的时期。
ext.ext_en: This had been a particularly difficult chapter in Lebanon's recent history.

ext.ext_cn: 英国政治近来最富戏剧性的阶段之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the most dramatic chapters of recent British politics.

defs.def_en: A chapter in someone's life or in history is a period of time during which a major event or series of related events takes place.

defs.def_cn: 大教堂全体教士(或全体相关神职人员)

ext.ext_cn: 大主教在开始演讲之前，首先感谢威斯敏斯特大教堂的主教和全体教士邀请他来到这里。
ext.ext_en: The Archbishop began his address, thanking the Dean and Chapter of Westminster for inviting him to the Abbey.

defs.def_en: A chapter is a group of Christian clergy who work in or who are connected with a cathedral.

ext.ext_cn: 想要了解更多有关癌症的征兆，请给美国癌症协会本地分会打电话。
ext.ext_en: To find out more about cancer warning signs call your local chapter of the American Cancer Society.

defs.def_en: A chapter is a branch of a society or club.

ext.ext_cn: 整个晚上，他向我详细讲述艾莱岛泥炭沼泽地上的各种青苔。
ext.ext_en: In the course of the evening he gave me chapter and verse on the mosses of the Islay peat bogs.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone gives you chapter and verse on a particular subject, you are emphasizing that they tell you every detail about it.
A contusion is a bruise .

ext.ext_cn: 如果不想让艾滋病成为 20 世纪又一常见疾病，我们必须让人们对它产生恐惧。
ext.ext_en: We must use shock tactics if we are to stop Aids becoming another accepted 20th-century disease.

defs.def_en: Shock tactics are a way of trying to influence people's attitudes to a particular matter by shocking them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不起作用的;无效果的;无效率的

ext.ext_cn: 经济改革仍将举步维艰,毫无成效。
ext.ext_en: Economic reform will continue to be painful and ineffective...

ext.ext_cn: 用这种方法控制你的狗不起作用。
ext.ext_en: This is an ineffective method of controlling your dog.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is ineffective, you mean that it has no effect on a process or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 为什么像大学这样人才济济的社区要害怕虚无主义呢？
ext.ext_en: Why should a great community like a university be afraid of nihilism?

defs.def_en: Nihilism is a belief which rejects all political and religious authority and current ideas in favour of the individual.

defs.def_cn: 对…实行再教育;重新教育

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在不得不尽快对公众进行再教育，因为他们一直都认为这是理所当然的。
ext.ext_en: We are having to re-educate the public very quickly about something they have always taken for granted.

defs.def_en: If an organization such as a government tries to re-educate a group of people, they try to make them adopt new attitudes, beliefs, or types of behaviour.
An Airbus is an aeroplane which is designed to carry a large number of passengers for fairly short distances.

defs.def_cn: (尤指赴他国的)使命，重要任务

ext.ext_cn: 索尔兹伯里派他到北美执行一项外交任务。
ext.ext_en: Salisbury sent him on a diplomatic mission to North America...

ext.ext_cn: 他已经被派执行一项旨在帮助结束黎巴嫩政治危机的使命。
ext.ext_en: He has been on a mission to help end Lebanon's political crisis.

defs.def_en: A mission is an important task that people are given to do, especially one that involves travelling to another country.

ext.ext_cn: 驻南非代表团团长
ext.ext_en: ...the head of the mission in South Africa.

ext.ext_cn: 外交使团的高级成员
ext.ext_en: ...a senior member of a diplomatic mission.

defs.def_en: A mission is a group of people who have been sent to a foreign country to carry out an official task.

defs.def_cn: （军用飞机或航天火箭的）飞行任务

ext.ext_cn: 在得克萨斯州西部山区执行训练任务时坠毁的轰炸机
ext.ext_en: ...a bomber that crashed during a training mission in the west Texas mountains.

ext.ext_cn: 首次航天飞行任务
ext.ext_en: ...the first shuttle mission.

defs.def_en: A mission is a special journey made by a military aeroplane or space rocket.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为自己毕生的使命就是保护弱者不受邪恶势力的欺凌。
ext.ext_en: He viewed his mission in life as protecting the weak from the evil...

ext.ext_cn: 他的一言一行都带着强烈的使命感。
ext.ext_en: There is an enormous sense of mission in his speech and gesture.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have a mission, you mean that you have a strong commitment and sense of duty to do or achieve something.

ext.ext_cn: 他们说上帝让他们去西半球最贫困的国家传播教义。
ext.ext_en: They say God spoke to them and told them to go on a mission to the poorest country in the Western Hemisphere.

defs.def_en: A mission is the activities of a group of Christians who have been sent to a place to teach people about Christianity.

ext.ext_cn: 我住在圣·米歇尔教堂的传道会里。
ext.ext_en: I reside at the mission at St Michael's.

ext.ext_cn: 学校、修道院及其他布道场所
ext.ext_en: ...schools, monasteries and other mission buildings.

defs.def_en: A mission is a building or group of buildings in which missionary work is carried out.

defs.def_cn: （车辆）开始驶离；（驾车者）开走车辆

ext.ext_cn: 我站在车道上，看着他把车倒出来然后开走。
ext.ext_en: I stood in the driveway and watched him back out and pull away.

defs.def_en: When a vehicle or driver pulls away, the vehicle starts moving forward.

ext.ext_cn: 面对母亲的情感渴求，其他几个女儿都疏远了她。
ext.ext_en: Other daughters, faced with their mother's emotional hunger, pull away...

ext.ext_cn: 他离她远远的，好像她得了麻风病似的。
ext.ext_en: He'd pulled away from her as if she had leprosy.

defs.def_en: If you pull away from someone that you have had close links with, you deliberately become less close to them.

ext.ext_cn: 1957年，苏联将“卫星一号”发射到外太空。
ext.ext_en: In 1957, the Soviets launched Sputnik 1 into outer space.

defs.def_en: Outer space is the area outside the earth's atmosphere where the other planets and stars are situated.
Masonry is bricks or pieces of stone which have been stuck together with cement as part of a wall or building.
A nature trail is a route through an area of countryside which has signs drawing attention to interesting animals, plants, or rocks.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已加入一个宗教团体，终生都将祈祷和行善。
ext.ext_en: They had joined a religious order and dedicated their lives to prayer and good works...

ext.ext_cn: 整个晚上都在祷告。
ext.ext_en: The night was spent in prayer.

defs.def_en: Prayer is the activity of speaking to God.

ext.ext_cn: 他们应该花点时间，为双方的人祈祷。
ext.ext_en: They should take a little time and say a prayer for the people on both sides.

ext.ext_cn: 感恩节祈祷文
ext.ext_en: ...prayers of thanksgiving.

defs.def_en: A prayer is the words a person says when they speak to God.

ext.ext_cn: 这种药或许可以满足我们的祈望。
ext.ext_en: This drug could be the answer to our prayers.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a strong hope that you have as your prayer .

ext.ext_cn: 他保证男孩会及时回到学校参加晚祈祷。
ext.ext_en: He promised that the boy would be back at school in time for evening prayers.

ext.ext_cn: 在大清真寺参加祈祷的穆斯林

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: You can use deadly to emphasize that something has a particular quality, especially an unpleasant or undesirable quality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you describe an activity or an organization as directionless, you mean that it does not seem to have any point or purpose. If you describe a person as directionless, you mean that they do not seem to have any plans or ideas.

ext.ext_en: I was doing quite well, but I wasn't earning a lot of money...

defs.def_en: You use quite to indicate that something is the case to a fairly great extent. Quite is less emphatic than 'very' and 'extremely'.

ext.ext_cn: 事实很清楚，我们开枪是出于自卫。
ext.ext_en: It is quite clear that we were firing in self defence...

ext.ext_en: That's a general British failing. In the USA it's quite different...

defs.def_en: You use quite to emphasize what you are saying.

ext.ext_en: Something here is not quite right...

ext.ext_cn: 治疗之后他又可以继续下去了，可是再也恢复不到从前的状态了。

defs.def_en: You use quite in front of a noun group to emphasize that a person or thing is very impressive or unusual.

ext.ext_en: 'And if you buy the record it's your choice isn't it.' — 'Quite'...

defs.def_en: You can say 'quite' to express your agreement with someone.
