ext.ext_en: She laughs, blushes and twitters: 'Oh, doesn't Giles have just the most charming sense of humour?'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is twittering about something, you mean that they are speaking about silly or unimportant things, usually rather fast or in a high-pitched voice.
A cudgel is a thick, short stick that is used as a weapon.

ext.ext_cn: 工会极力支持被裁的367名员工。
ext.ext_en: The trade unions took up the cudgels for the 367 staff made redundant.

defs.def_en: If you take up the cudgels for someone or something, you speak or fight in support of them.

defs.def_cn: 不使用语言的;非言语的

ext.ext_cn: 文化在非语言交流中起着很大的作用。
ext.ext_en: Culture plays a large part in non-verbal communication...

ext.ext_cn: 根据心理学家马丁·劳埃德·埃利奥特的研究，人们之间90％的交流是非语言的。
ext.ext_en: According to psychologist Martin Lloyd-Elliott, 90 per cent of communication between people is non-verbal.

defs.def_en: Non-verbal communication consists of things such as the expression on your face, your arm movements, or your tone of voice, which show how you feel about something without using words.

ext.ext_cn: 他们只需置身事外，享受生活。
ext.ext_en: They didn't have to do anything except sit back and enjoy life...

ext.ext_cn: 美国公司把技术移交给了合作方，然后就坐等着收钱了。
ext.ext_en: American firms handed over technologies to their partners and then sat back to enjoy the cash flow.

defs.def_en: If you sit back while something is happening, you relax and do not become involved in it.

defs.def_cn: 缅甸的；缅甸人的；缅甸语的；缅甸文化的
defs.def_en: Burmese means belonging or relating to Burma, or to its people, language, or culture. Burma is now known as Myanmar.
A Burmese is a Burmese citizen or a person of Burmese origin.
Burmese is the main language spoken by the people who live in Burma, now known as Myanmar.
Tabasco is a hot spicy sauce made from peppers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 滑稽的;（尤指）幽默的,诙谐的

ext.ext_cn: 他很幽默，我喜欢他这一点。
ext.ext_en: He was quite humorous, and I liked that about him.

ext.ext_cn: 幽默杂志
ext.ext_en: ...a humorous magazine.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is humorous, they are amusing, especially in a clever or witty way.
A monkey is an animal with a long tail which lives in hot countries and climbs trees.

ext.ext_cn: 她真是一个小捣蛋鬼。
ext.ext_en: She's such a little monkey.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a child as a monkey, you are saying in an affectionate way that he or she is very lively and naughty.

ext.ext_cn: 1945至1946年的那段时间是杜鲁门总统执政最艰难的时期。
ext.ext_en: 1945 to 1946 was the nadir of Truman's presidency.

defs.def_en: The nadir of something such as someone's career or the history of an organization is its worst time.
In astronomy, the nadir is the point at which the sun or moon is directly below you, on the other side of the earth.

ext.ext_cn: 摄影师往后退开，好让我们查看尸体。
ext.ext_en: The photographers drew back to let us view the body...

ext.ext_cn: 她满怀期待地从门口退了回来。
ext.ext_en: She stepped back from the door expectantly...

defs.def_en: If you move back, you move in the opposite direction to the one in which you are facing or in which you were moving before.

ext.ext_cn: 我回到床上。
ext.ext_en: I went back to bed...

ext.ext_cn: 我预计下午晚些时候回到伦敦。
ext.ext_en: I'm  due back in London by late afternoon...

defs.def_en: If you go back somewhere, you return to where you were before.

defs.def_cn: 恢复原状；回到原来的状态

ext.ext_cn: 铁路公司表示，其运输服务将慢慢恢复正常。
ext.ext_en: The rail company said it expected services to get slowly back to normal...

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼丝希望等女儿满周岁就回去工作。
ext.ext_en: Denise hopes to be back at work by the time her daughter is one...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is back in a particular state, they were in that state before and are now in it again.

ext.ext_cn: 她递还刀子。
ext.ext_en: She handed the knife back...

ext.ext_cn: 把它放回冰箱。
ext.ext_en: Put it back in the freezer...

defs.def_en: If you give or put something back, you return it to the person who had it or to the place where it was before you took it. If you get or take something back, you then have it again after not having it for a while.
If you put a clock or watch back, you change the time shown on it so that it shows an earlier time, for example when the time changes to winter time or standard time.

ext.ext_cn: 他们回信告诉我说不必那么做。
ext.ext_en: They wrote back to me and they told me that I didn't have to do it...

ext.ext_cn: 如果有电话打来，就说你吃完饭再回电话。
ext.ext_en: If the phone rings say you'll  call back after dinner...

defs.def_en: If you write or call back, you write to or telephone someone after they have written to or telephoned you. If you look back at someone, you look at them after they have started looking at you.

ext.ext_cn: 我能再回到维护治安的问题上来吗？
ext.ext_en: Can I come back to the question of policing once again?...

ext.ext_cn: 回到我在导言中所说的，19世纪的西班牙是欧洲整体的一部分。
ext.ext_en: To come back to what I said in the Introduction, in the nineteenth century Spain was fully a part of Europe...

defs.def_en: You can say that you go or come back to a particular point in a conversation to show that you are mentioning or discussing it again.

defs.def_cn: 再次流行；再度成为潮流

ext.ext_cn: 短裙又流行起来了。
ext.ext_en: Short skirts are back...

ext.ext_cn: 共识政治很可能再度兴起。
ext.ext_en: Consensus politics could easily come back into fashion.

defs.def_en: If something is or comes back, it is fashionable again after it has been unfashionable for some time.

ext.ext_cn: 请勿靠近站台边缘。
ext.ext_en: Keep back from the edge of the platform...

ext.ext_cn: 我距离边境数英里。
ext.ext_en: I'm  a few miles back from the border...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is kept or situated back from a place, they are at a distance away from it.

ext.ext_cn: 她的头发扎了起来。
ext.ext_en: Her hair was tied back...

ext.ext_cn: 窗帘用穗子拢了起来。
ext.ext_en: The curtains were held back by tassels.

defs.def_en: If something is held or tied back, it is held or tied so that it does not hang loosely over something.

ext.ext_cn: 她躺下盯着天花板。
ext.ext_en: She lay back and stared at the ceiling...

ext.ext_cn: 她靠在椅背上，微笑起来。
ext.ext_en: She leaned back in her chair and smiled.

defs.def_en: If you lie or sit back, you move your body backwards into a relaxed sloping or flat position, with your head and body resting on something.

ext.ext_cn: 尼克回头看了看，又皱着眉头停了下来。
ext.ext_en: Nick looked back over his shoulder and then stopped, frowning...

ext.ext_cn: 他转身叫她。
ext.ext_en: He called back to her.

defs.def_en: If you look or shout back at someone or something, you turn to look or shout at them when they are behind you.

defs.def_cn: （表示描述场所的转换）在曾提到过的地方

ext.ext_cn: 与此同时，伦敦的皇宫影业公司也正在分崩离析。
ext.ext_en: Meanwhile, back in London, Palace Pictures was collapsing...

ext.ext_cn: 随后，家里的电话响了。
ext.ext_en: Later, back at home, the telephone rang.

defs.def_en: You use back in expressions like back in London or back at the house when you are giving an account, to show that you are going to start talking about what happened or was happening in the place you mention.

ext.ext_cn: 故事可以追溯到1950年，那时我才5岁。
ext.ext_en: The story starts back in 1950, when I was five...

ext.ext_cn: 今年1月份我在圣卢西亚。
ext.ext_en: I was in St. Lucia back in January of this year...

defs.def_en: If you talk about something that happened back in the past or several years back, you are emphasizing that it happened quite a long time ago.

ext.ext_cn: 我回想起1975年我儿子病得奄奄一息的那段时间。
ext.ext_en: I thought back to the time in 1975 when my son was desperately ill...

ext.ext_cn: 我回想起曾听到过的关于文妮的那些传闻。
ext.ext_en: My mind flew back to stories I had heard about Vinnie.

defs.def_en: If you think back to something that happened in the past, you remember it or try to remember it.

ext.ext_cn: 他来回踱步。
ext.ext_en: He paced back and forth...

ext.ext_cn: 两个男孩在街上来来回回地投接棒球。
ext.ext_en: Two boys were in the street, tossing a baseball back and forth.

defs.def_en: If someone moves back and forth, they repeatedly move in one direction and then in the opposite direction.

ext.ext_cn: 她儿子安静地仰面躺着。
ext.ext_en: Her son was lying peacefully on his back...

ext.ext_cn: 她转过身背对着观众。
ext.ext_en: She turned her back to the audience...

defs.def_en: A person's or animal's  back is the part of their body between their head and their legs that is on the opposite side to their chest and stomach.

ext.ext_cn: 商店后部的一个房间
ext.ext_en: ...a room at the back of the shop...

ext.ext_cn: 她举起双手放于颈后。
ext.ext_en: She raised her hands to the back of her neck...

defs.def_en: The back of something is the side or part of it that is towards the rear or farthest from the front. The back of something is normally not used or seen as much as the front.

ext.ext_cn: 他打开了后门。
ext.ext_en: He opened the back door...

ext.ext_cn: 安记得自己坐在他们车的后座上。
ext.ext_en: Ann could remember sitting in the back seat of their car.

defs.def_en: Back is used to refer to the side or part of something that is towards the rear or farthest from the front.

ext.ext_cn: 椅子的靠背上搭着一件叠得整整齐齐的粉色毛衫。
ext.ext_en: There was a neatly folded pink sweater on the back of the chair.

defs.def_en: The back of a chair or sofa is the part that you lean against when you sit on it.

ext.ext_cn: 将答案写在明信片背面寄出。
ext.ext_en: Send your answers on the back of a postcard.

defs.def_en: The back of something such as a piece of paper or an envelope is the side which is less important.

ext.ext_cn: 书末索引
ext.ext_en: ...the index at the back of the book...

ext.ext_cn: 你已经在末尾完整地列出了名字和地址。
ext.ext_en: You've given a whole list of names and addresses at the back.

defs.def_en: The back of a book is the part nearest the end, where you can find the index or the notes, for example.

defs.def_cn: （用于round the back, out the back等表达方式中）房屋（或其他建筑物）后的区域

ext.ext_cn: 他在房子后面养了些鸡啊什么的。
ext.ext_en: He had chickens and things round the back...

ext.ext_cn: 厕所在房子后面。
ext.ext_en: The privy's  out the back.

defs.def_en: You can use back in expressions such as round the back and out the back to refer generally to the area behind a house or other building.

defs.def_cn: （用于out back等表达方式中）房屋（或其他建筑物）后的区域；（用于in back等表达方式中）汽车（或建筑物等）的后部

ext.ext_cn: 丹告诉她说他要去房子后面的露台上擦鞋。
ext.ext_en: Dan informed her that he would be out back on the patio cleaning his shoes...

ext.ext_cn: 卡特利特开车，我坐在车子后面。
ext.ext_en: Catlett got behind the wheel and I sat in back...

defs.def_en: You use back in expressions such as out back to refer to the area behind a house or other building. You also use in back to refer to the rear part of something, especially a car or building.

defs.def_cn: （足球、曲棍球等运动中的）后卫
defs.def_en: In team games such as football and hockey, a back is a player who is concerned mainly with preventing the other team from scoring goals, rather than scoring goals for their own team.

defs.def_cn: （美式橄榄球运动中的）进攻后卫
defs.def_en: In American football, a back is a player who stands behind the front line, runs with the ball and attacks rather than defends.

ext.ext_cn: 你吃着她的食物，享受着她的款待，然后还在背地里指责她。
ext.ext_en: You eat her food, enjoy her hospitality and then criticize her behind her back.

defs.def_en: If you say that something was  done behind someone's back, you disapprove of it because it was done without them knowing about it, in an unfair or dishonest way.

ext.ext_cn: 看起来至少我们已经解决了这个国家通货膨胀中最棘手的问题。
ext.ext_en: It seems at least that we've broken the back of inflation in this country...

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以运送物资，努力解决饥荒中最关键的问题。
ext.ext_en: We can deliver supplies and work to break the back of the famine.

defs.def_en: If you break the back of a task or problem, you do the most difficult part of what is necessary to complete the task or solve the problem.

ext.ext_cn: 连续播放的两档半小时节目
ext.ext_en: ...two half-hour shows, which will be screened back to back.

defs.def_en: If two or more things are done back to back, one follows immediately after the other without any interruption.

defs.def_cn: （衣服）前后穿反；（顺序）前后颠倒

ext.ext_cn: 他把棒球帽反戴着。
ext.ext_en: He wears his baseball cap back to front...

ext.ext_cn: 图片印反了。
ext.ext_en: The picture was printed back to front.

defs.def_en: If you are wearing something back to front, you are wearing it with the back of it at the front of your body. If you do something back to front, you do it the wrong way around, starting with the part that should come last.

defs.def_cn: 不再（对某人）批评（或施压等）

ext.ext_cn: 他一直对我唠叨个没完，有时我真希望他不要再烦我了。
ext.ext_en: He kept on at me to such an extent that occasionally I wished he would get off my back.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to get off your back you are telling them angrily to stop criticizing you or putting pressure on you.

ext.ext_cn: 8年的艰难时期刚刚过去，在此期间，伦敦有3家消防站遭关闭。如获批准，裁减又会接踵而至。
ext.ext_en: The cuts, if approved, come on the back of a difficult eight years that have seen three London fire stations closed.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing happens on the back of another thing, you mean that it happens  after that other thing and in addition to it.

defs.def_cn: （使）受到威胁；（使）处于不利地位

ext.ext_cn: 今后工党在福利问题上将处于下风。
ext.ext_en: From now on Labour will be on the back foot on the subject of welfare.

ext.ext_cn: 另一项纯粹旨在让苏格兰民族党人被迫退居守势的计划
ext.ext_en: ...another scheme designed purely to put the Scots Nationalists on the back foot.

defs.def_en: If someone is on the back foot, or if something puts them on the back foot, they feel threatened and act defensively.

defs.def_cn: 互相帮助；与人方便，与己方便
defs.def_en: People say 'You scratch my back and I'll scratch yours' to mean that one person helps another on condition that the second person helps them in return.

ext.ext_cn: 我的表现如此差劲，相信她会很高兴看到我离开。
ext.ext_en: I was so badly behaved I was convinced she would be glad to see the back of me.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will be glad to see the back of someone, you mean that you want them to leave.

defs.def_cn: 忽略；背弃；拒绝；对…不予理睬

ext.ext_cn: 斯泰茜·拉蒂索抛弃了自己在摩城唱片公司的演唱事业，成为了一名福音歌手。
ext.ext_en: Stacey Lattisaw has turned her back on her singing career with Motown Records to become a gospel singer...

ext.ext_cn: 冈内尔不是那种将指导了自己12年的教练拒之门外的人。
ext.ext_en: Gunnell is not the sort to turn her back on someone who has coached her for 12 years.

defs.def_en: If you turn your back on someone or something, you ignore them, leave them, or reject them.

ext.ext_cn: 有些食物标签的贴法实在让我生气。
ext.ext_en: Some food labelling practices really get my back up.

defs.def_en: If someone or something puts your back up or gets your back up, they annoy you.

ext.ext_cn: 我们住在一楼的一套公寓房里，背对着一条繁忙的街道。
ext.ext_en: We live in a ground floor flat which backs onto a busy street...

ext.ext_cn: 他的花园背朝一所学校。
ext.ext_en: His garden backs onto a school.

defs.def_en: If a building backs onto something, the back of it faces in the direction of that thing or touches the edge of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他把车倒出了私人车道。
ext.ext_en: He backed his car out of the drive...

ext.ext_cn: 火车倒出了阿德莱德调车场，开上了都柏林-贝尔法斯特线。
ext.ext_en: The train backed out of Adelaide Yard on to the Dublin-Belfast line...

defs.def_en: When you back a car or other vehicle somewhere or when it backs somewhere, it moves backwards.

ext.ext_cn: 有新的目击证人证明他的说法，他是被错认了。
ext.ext_en: There is a new witness to back his claim that he is a victim of mistaken identity.

ext.ext_cn: 如果法国不能说服安理会五个常任理事国都支持该计划
ext.ext_en: ...if France cannot persuade all five permanent members of the Security Council to back the plan...

defs.def_en: If you back a person or a course of action, you support them, for example by voting for them or giving them money.

defs.def_cn: 预测…获胜；（通常指）下赌注于

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚罗兰·尼尔森打赌谢菲尔德周三队会捧得欧洲联盟杯。
ext.ext_en: Roland Nilsson last night backed Sheffield Wednesday to win the UEFA Cup...

ext.ext_cn: 马的主人希钦斯先生以200比1的赔率赌它获得前三名。
ext.ext_en: The horse's owner Mr Hitchins backed him at 200-1 to finish in the first three...

defs.def_en: If you back a particular person, team, or horse in a competition, you predict that they will win, and usually you bet money that they will win.

ext.ext_cn: 原声吉他、贝斯和康茄鼓为她伴奏。
ext.ext_en: She was backed by acoustic guitar, bass and congas.

defs.def_en: If a singer is backed by a band or by other singers, they provide the musical background for the singer.

ext.ext_cn: 他于1935年就任圣职。
ext.ext_en: He took holy orders in 1935.

defs.def_en: Someone who is in holy orders is a member of the Christian clergy.

ext.ext_cn: 人们可以取指纹和捐献血样的特设流动点
ext.ext_en: ...special mobile units where men can have their fingerprints taken and donate a specimen of blood.

ext.ext_cn: 有400个座位的流动剧场
ext.ext_en: ...the four hundred seat mobile theatre.

defs.def_en: You use mobile to describe something large that can be moved easily from place to place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 走动方便的；行动自如的；出行方便的

ext.ext_cn: 我仍然行动自如。
ext.ext_en: I'm still very mobile.

defs.def_en: If you are mobile, you can move or travel easily from place to place, for example because you are not physically disabled or because you have your own transport.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (社会)流动性的;(在职业、住所或社会阶层间)自由流动的

ext.ext_cn: 我们的社会具有很大的流动性，离婚以后人们就会搬家离开。
ext.ext_en: We're a very mobile society, and people move after they get divorced.

ext.ext_cn: 流动性大的年轻专业人员
ext.ext_en: ...young, mobile professionals.

defs.def_en: In a mobile society, people move easily from one job, home, or social class to another.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 罗宾有一张更加善变、表情更加丰富的脸。
ext.ext_en: Robyn had the more mobile, more expressive face.

defs.def_en: If someone has a mobile face, the expression on their face changes quickly as their feelings change.

defs.def_cn: (悬挂在天花板上的)风动小饰物
defs.def_en: A mobile is a decoration which you hang from a ceiling. It usually consists of several small objects which move as the air around them moves.
A mobile is the same as a mobile phone .

ext.ext_cn: 粉色绸料的女式晨衣
ext.ext_en: ...a pink satin negligee.

defs.def_en: A negligee is a very thin garment which a woman wears over her nightclothes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人恐惧的;令人厌恶的;令人作呕的

ext.ext_cn: 这一起对毫无防御能力的孕妇的袭击，令人无比震惊。
ext.ext_en: This was a sickening attack on a pregnant and defenceless woman...

ext.ext_cn: 他称外交部的决议令人不齿、见利忘义。
ext.ext_en: He described the Foreign Office's decision as sickening and cynical.

defs.def_en: You describe something as sickening when it gives you feelings of horror or disgust, or makes you feel sick in your stomach.

ext.ext_cn: 他到英格兰的第二天
ext.ext_en: ...the day after his arrival in England...

ext.ext_cn: 到达附近的医院时他已经死亡。
ext.ext_en: He was dead on arrival at the nearby hospital.

defs.def_en: When a person or vehicle arrives at a place, you can refer to their arrival .

ext.ext_cn: 新主席接任造成的权力真空
ext.ext_en: ...the power vacuum created by the arrival of a new president...

ext.ext_cn: 在1980至1989年间，公司管理委员会离职8人，新吸收11人。
ext.ext_en: The company had eight departures and 11 new arrivals on its management board in 1980-1989.

defs.def_en: When someone starts a new job, you can refer to their arrival in that job.

ext.ext_cn: 我一边无所事事地翻着报纸，一边等着我点的橙汁和咖啡。
ext.ext_en: I was flicking idly through a newspaper while awaiting the arrival of orange juice and coffee...

ext.ext_cn: 加冕典礼的转播标志着电视时代的到来。
ext.ext_en: The coronation broadcast marked the arrival of television.

defs.def_en: When something is brought to you or becomes available, you can refer to its arrival .

defs.def_cn: （某一时间的）到来；（某一事件的）发生

ext.ext_cn: 他为朋友们举行了一个聚会，庆祝新年的到来。
ext.ext_en: He celebrated the arrival of the New Year with a party for his friends.

defs.def_en: When a particular time comes or a particular event happens, you can refer to its arrival.

ext.ext_cn: 新来的人中很大一部分是技术熟练的专业人士。
ext.ext_en: A high proportion of the new arrivals are skilled professionals...

ext.ext_cn: 在大使馆里，他是职位最低也是入职最晚的一位。
ext.ext_en: He was the most junior and most recent arrival at the embassy.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone who has just arrived at a place as a new arrival .

ext.ext_cn: 盼望着孩子出生的一对夫妇
ext.ext_en: ...a couple anticipating the arrival of a new child.

defs.def_en: When a baby is born, you can refer to its arrival.

ext.ext_cn: 她的父亲完全沉浸在新生儿带来的喜悦中。
ext.ext_en: Her father was besotted with the new arrival.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a baby who has just been born as a new arrival .

ext.ext_cn: 定量供应很久以前就结束了饼干过剩的状况。
ext.ext_en: Rationing had put an end to a surfeit of biscuits long ago.

defs.def_en: A surfeit of something is an amount which is too large.
A godmother is a female godparent.
A chimp is the same as a chimpanzee .

ext.ext_cn: 焖兔肉
ext.ext_en: ...rabbit stew.

ext.ext_cn: 焖兔肉
ext.ext_en: ...rabbit stew.

defs.def_en: A rabbit is a small furry animal with long ears. Rabbits are sometimes kept as pets, or live wild in holes in the ground.

defs.def_cn: 迅速做成的事；匆匆完成的事;急就章

ext.ext_cn: 闪电离婚
ext.ext_en: ...a quickie divorce...

ext.ext_cn: 我要去酒吧畅饮一杯。
ext.ext_en: I'm off down to the pub for a quickie.

defs.def_en: A quickie is something that only takes a very short time.

ext.ext_cn: 她的容貌让他惊叹，而更让他惊讶的是她的沉着。
ext.ext_en: What amazed him even more than her appearance was her poise...

ext.ext_cn: 马克过了一会儿才恢复镇静。
ext.ext_en: It took a moment for Mark to recover his poise.

defs.def_en: If someone has poise, they are calm, dignified, and self-controlled.

ext.ext_cn: 芭蕾课对培养优雅的姿仪非常重要。
ext.ext_en: Ballet classes are important for poise and grace...

ext.ext_cn: 他就连走起路来也姿势难看。
ext.ext_en: Even when he moved he did so without poise.

defs.def_en: Poise is a graceful, very controlled way of standing and moving.

defs.def_cn: (美国兼售化妆品、家居用品、饮料、小吃等的)药店,药房
defs.def_en: In the United States, a drugstore is a shop where drugs and medicines are sold or given out, and where you can buy cosmetics, some household goods, and also drinks and snacks.  →see usage note at:chemist
Draughtsmanship is the ability to draw well or the art of drawing.

defs.def_cn: 左右为难；进退两难的处境

ext.ext_cn: 真叫人左右为难啊——你不成功就没人想支持你，可是没有人支持，你哪天才能成功呢？
ext.ext_en: It's a Catch 22 situation here. Nobody wants to support you until you're successful, but without the support how can you ever be successful?

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as a Catch-22, you mean it is an impossible situation because you cannot do one thing until you do another thing, but you cannot do the second thing until you do the first thing.
Zinc is a bluish-white metal which is used to make other metals such as brass, or to cover other metals such as iron to stop a brown substance called rust from forming.

ext.ext_cn: 下雨的时候，我用油布草草搭了一个能简单避雨的棚子。
ext.ext_en: When it rained I rigged up a partial shelter with a tarpaulin...

ext.ext_cn: 负责选举的官员们已经临时安了几个喇叭，让投票者可以同时享受音乐。
ext.ext_en: Election officials have rigged up speakers to provide voters with music.

defs.def_en: If you rig up a device or structure, you make it or fix it in place using any materials that are available.
A wig is a covering of false hair which you wear on your head, for example because you have little hair of your own or because you want to cover up your own hair.

ext.ext_cn: 她高兴地发现自己具备一种能把其他客人逗笑的才能。
ext.ext_en: She discovered to her pleasure, a talent for making her fellow guests laugh...

ext.ext_cn: 就算在监狱里，狱友们对我也很友善。
ext.ext_en: Even in jail, my fellow inmates treated me with kindness.

defs.def_en: You use fellow to describe people who are in the same situation as you, or people you feel you have something in common with.

ext.ext_cn: 据说，罗杰是个好小伙。
ext.ext_en: By all accounts, Rodger would appear to be a fine fellow.

defs.def_en: A fellow is a man or boy.

ext.ext_cn: 他在能力上远远胜过其他同事。
ext.ext_en: He stood out in terms of competence from all his fellows...

ext.ext_cn: 人们守望相助，关心着彼此的幸福。
ext.ext_en: People looked out for one another and were concerned about the welfare of their fellows.

defs.def_en: Your fellows are the people who you work with, do things with, or who are like you in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦动物协会会员
ext.ext_en: ...the fellows of the Zoological Society of London.

defs.def_en: A fellow of an academic or professional association is someone who is a specially elected member of it, usually because of their work or achievements or as a mark of honour.

defs.def_cn: （常因可能具有冒犯性而）删除，删节

ext.ext_cn: 电影的最终版本会剪掉他的声音。
ext.ext_en: His voice will be edited out of the final film...

ext.ext_cn: 她再次删掉了那句台词。
ext.ext_en: She edited that line out again.

defs.def_en: If you edit something out of a book or film, you remove it, often because it might be offensive to some people.

ext.ext_cn: 东西方可以为彼此共同的利益和发展而合作。
ext.ext_en: The East and the West can work together for their mutual benefit and progress...

ext.ext_cn: 明摆着他很喜欢自己的女儿，而且女儿也喜欢他。
ext.ext_en: It's plain that he adores his daughter, and the feeling is mutual.

defs.def_en: You use mutual to  describe a situation, feeling, or action that is experienced, felt, or done by both of two people mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 不过他们确实都对设计感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: They do, however, share a mutual interest in design...

ext.ext_cn: 我们一个共同的朋友介绍我们认识了。
ext.ext_en: We were introduced by a mutual friend.

defs.def_en: You use mutual to describe something such as an interest which two or more people share.

defs.def_cn: (指建屋互助会或保险公司)互助的，相互保险的

ext.ext_cn: 英国第三大建屋互助会准备放弃其互助性质，转变为银行。
ext.ext_en: Britain's third largest building society abandoned its mutual status and became a bank.

defs.def_en: If a building society or an insurance company has mutual status, it is not owned by shareholders but by its customers, who receive a share of the profits.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极度失望的；非常沮丧的

ext.ext_cn: 如果他转会的话，伯明翰城队的支持者绝对会失望透顶。
ext.ext_en: Birmingham City supporters will be absolutely gutted if he leaves the club.

defs.def_en: If you are gutted, you feel extremely disappointed or depressed about something that has happened.

ext.ext_cn: 肥胖会增加高血压和中风发作的几率。
ext.ext_en: Obesity correlates with increased risk for hypertension and stroke...

ext.ext_cn: 配偶之间政治观点上的相似度要大于他们身高的相似程度。
ext.ext_en: The political opinions of spouses correlate more closely than their heights...

defs.def_en: If one thing correlates with another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one thing causes the other. You can also say that two things correlate .

defs.def_cn: 使显示联系;使相互关联

ext.ext_cn: 人们试图把特定的语言功能与大脑的某些特定部位联系起来，这一努力目前还没有取得很大进展。
ext.ext_en: Attempts to correlate specific language functions with particular parts of the brain have not advanced very far...

ext.ext_cn: 瑞安中尉闭上眼睛，先是在脑海里回想了一遍不同的犯罪现场，然后将这些信息联系起来。
ext.ext_en: Lieutenant Ryan closed his eyes, first mentally viewing the different crime scenes, then correlating the data.

defs.def_en: If you correlate things, you work out the way in which they are connected or the way they influence each other.

ext.ext_cn: 卵子排出后可存活12至36小时。
ext.ext_en: Once the ovum is released it has a lifespan of 12 to 36 hours.

defs.def_en: An ovum is one of the eggs of a woman or female animal.

ext.ext_cn: 日常生活的磨炼与艰难
ext.ext_en: ...the trials and tribulations of everyday life.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the suffering or difficulty that you experience in a particular situation as tribulations .

defs.def_cn: 同时发生的;同时出现的;同步的

ext.ext_cn: 书和唱片专辑的同步发行
ext.ext_en: ...the simultaneous release of the book and the album...

ext.ext_cn: 剧院将提供英语和汉语的同声翻译。
ext.ext_en: The theatre will provide simultaneous translation in both English and Chinese.

defs.def_en: Things which are simultaneous happen or exist at the same time.

defs.def_cn: 英里里程;(旅程的)英里数

ext.ext_cn: 他们开车大多数时候是在城里和城市周边转悠。
ext.ext_en: Most of their mileage is in and around town.

defs.def_en: Mileage refers to the distance that you have travelled, measured in miles.

defs.def_cn: (车辆消耗一加仑或一升汽油所行驶的)英里数

ext.ext_cn: 他们愿意多出500美元来购买更省油的汽车。
ext.ext_en: They are willing to pay up to $500 more for cars that get better mileage.

defs.def_en: The mileage of a vehicle is the number of miles that it can travel using one gallon or litre of fuel.

ext.ext_cn: 很明显，从这项协议中获取尽可能多的利益十分重要。
ext.ext_en: It's obviously important to get as much mileage out of the convention as possible...

ext.ext_cn: 显然，政府认定和国会大起冲突是没有好处的。
ext.ext_en: The administration clearly decided there was no mileage in provoking a huge row with Congress.

defs.def_en: The mileage in a particular course of action is its usefulness in getting you what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 撒哈拉大沙漠
ext.ext_en: ...the Sahara Desert.

ext.ext_cn: 沙漠中火辣辣的太阳
ext.ext_en: ...the burning desert sun...

defs.def_en: A desert is a large area of land, usually in a hot region, where there is almost no water, rain, trees, or plants.

defs.def_cn: 枯燥乏味的地方（或境况）

ext.ext_cn: 他们居住的地方是坐落于一片钢筋水泥丛林中的12栋高层公寓楼。
ext.ext_en: They live in 12 high-rise apartment buildings that sit in a desert of concrete...

ext.ext_cn: 酒馆是文化沙漠。
ext.ext_en: Pubs are a cultural desert.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a place or situation as a desert, you think it is bad for people because it is not interesting, exciting, or useful in any way.

ext.ext_cn: 小农场主正舍弃他们的土地，到这里来寻找工作。
ext.ext_en: Farmers are deserting their fields and coming here looking for jobs...

ext.ext_cn: 演出结束后，观众从布莱克浦的大街上消失了踪迹。
ext.ext_en: After the show, the audience deserts the Blackpool streets.

defs.def_en: If people or animals desert a place, they leave it and it becomes empty.

ext.ext_cn: 罗丁太太的丈夫数年前抛弃了她。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Roding's husband deserted her years ago...

ext.ext_cn: 他的大多数顾问都弃他而去。
ext.ext_en: He has been deserted by most of his advisers.

defs.def_en: If someone deserts you, they go away and leave you, and no longer help or support you.

ext.ext_cn: 报纸价格的上涨将导致更多的读者不再订阅。
ext.ext_en: The paper's price rise will encourage readers to desert in even greater numbers...

ext.ext_cn: 看到那么多的年轻人放弃了合作农场的生活，他感到很痛心。
ext.ext_en: He was pained to see many youngsters deserting kibbutz life...

defs.def_en: If you desert something that you support, use, or are involved with, you stop supporting it, using it, or being involved with it.

ext.ext_cn: 即使在他看上去很沮丧的时候，他也从没有丧失过自己的冷面幽默。
ext.ext_en: Even when he appeared to be depressed, a dry sense of humour never deserted him...

ext.ext_cn: 她突然自信心全失，接下来连败 5 局，并最终丢了这一盘。
ext.ext_en: She lost the next five games, and the set, as her confidence abruptly deserted her.

defs.def_en: If a quality or skill that you normally have deserts you, you suddenly find that you do not have it when you need it or want it.

defs.def_cn: 擅离(职守);（尤指从军队)开小差

ext.ext_cn: 他在擅离部队之前是一名陆军少尉。
ext.ext_en: He was a second-lieutenant in the army until he deserted...

ext.ext_cn: 上个月他从陆军情报机关开小差跑了。
ext.ext_en: He deserted from army intelligence last month...

defs.def_en: If someone deserts, or deserts a job, especially a job in the armed forces, they leave that job without permission.

ext.ext_cn: 在书的结尾，那个孩子的真实身份大白于世，坏人则得到了应有的惩罚。
ext.ext_en: At the end of the book the child's true identity is discovered, and the bad guys get their just deserts.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has got their just deserts, you mean that they deserved the unpleasant things that have happened to them, because they did something bad.

defs.def_cn: 更多;较多(该词前可使用 a little，a lot，a bit，far和much)

ext.ext_cn: 越来越多的心脏病患者存活下来。
ext.ext_en: More and more people are surviving heart attacks...

ext.ext_cn: 他把更多的时间用于完善舞蹈动作，而不是健身训练。
ext.ext_en: He spent more time perfecting his dance moves instead of gym work.

defs.def_en: You use more to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'a little', 'a lot', 'a bit', 'far', and 'much' in front of more .

ext.ext_cn: 阿富汗当局称，该机场已经关闭一年多了。
ext.ext_en: The Afghan authorities say the airport had been closed for more than a year.

ext.ext_cn: 价格在250英镑以上的时髦皮革和丝绸夹克
ext.ext_en: ...classy leather and silk jackets at more than £250.

defs.def_en: You use more than before a number or amount to say that the actual number or amount is even greater.

ext.ext_cn: 监狱条件变得更加严酷。
ext.ext_en: Prison conditions have become more brutal...

ext.ext_cn: 现在我们的基本需求可以比过去更容易得到满足。
ext.ext_en: We can satisfy our basic wants more easily than in the past.

defs.def_en: You use more to indicate that something or someone has a greater amount of a quality than they used to or than is average or usual.

defs.def_cn: 更像（前者）地;与其说（是）…，倒不如说（是）

ext.ext_cn: 波士顿美术博物馆的展览与其说是一次博物馆展出，倒不如说是一场精心设计的展演活动。
ext.ext_en: The exhibition at Boston's Museum of Fine Arts is more a production than it is a museum display...

ext.ext_cn: 真的，与其说他像救生员，不如说他更像电影明星。
ext.ext_en: He's more like a film star than a lifeguard, really...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is more one thing than another, you mean that it is like the first thing rather than the second.

ext.ext_cn: 当我们劳累、紧张、沮丧或生病时，疼痛感更明显。
ext.ext_en: When we are tired, tense, depressed or unwell, we feel pain much more...

ext.ext_cn: 让我印象更深的是她认识田纳西·威廉斯。
ext.ext_en: What impressed me more was that she knew Tennessee Williams.

defs.def_en: If you do something more than before or more than someone else, you do it to a greater extent or more often.

ext.ext_cn: 如果当时我再多说一点的话，结果或许会不一样。
ext.ext_en: Things might have been different if I'd talked a bit more.

ext.ext_cn: 我们又继续走了一段。
ext.ext_en: We walked some more.

defs.def_en: You can use more to indicate that something continues to happen for a further period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 火车向东南驶往慕尼黑前，会在郊区再停两站。
ext.ext_en: This train would stop twice more in the suburbs before rolling southeast toward Munich...

ext.ext_cn: 呼吸练习应该再多重复几次。
ext.ext_en: The breathing exercises should be repeated several times more.

defs.def_en: You use more to indicate that something is repeated. For example, if you do something 'once more', you do it again once.

defs.def_cn: 另外的;附加的(该词前可使用 a little，a lot，a bit，far 和 much)

ext.ext_cn: 他们需要更多的时间来考虑是否进行调查。
ext.ext_en: They needed more time to consider whether to hold an inquiry.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在丹维尔多呆了两天。
ext.ext_en: We stayed in Danville two more days...

defs.def_en: You use more to refer to an additional thing or amount. You can use 'a little', 'a lot', 'a bit', 'far' and 'much' in front of more .

defs.def_cn: (用于 no more，no less, neither more nor less 等短语中，表示所说完全无误)多了的部分

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉了他真相，未加任何演绎。
ext.ext_en: I told him the truth. No more, no less...

ext.ext_cn: 我现在62岁了，感觉自己也确实到这把年纪了。
ext.ext_en: I'm sixty-two. I feel sixty-two, neither more nor less.

defs.def_en: You can use more in expressions like 'no more, no less' and 'neither more nor less' to indicate that what you are saying is exactly true or correct.

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲的经济已在多个领域互相趋同;更有意思的是，各国经济增长率也渐趋一致。
ext.ext_en: Europe's economies have converged in several areas. More interestingly, there has been convergence in economic growth rates...

ext.ext_cn: 对他来说更严重的是，有成员说他在这个问题上错了。
ext.ext_en: More seriously for him, there are members who say he is wrong on this issue.

defs.def_en: You use more in conversations when you want to draw someone's attention to something interesting or important that you are about to say.

ext.ext_cn: 她的生活越来越接近她理想的目标。
ext.ext_en: Her life was heading more and more where she wanted it to go...

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃火气越来越大。
ext.ext_en: Bob became more and more furious...

defs.def_en: You can use more and more to indicate that something is becoming greater in amount, extent, or degree all the time.

ext.ext_cn: 会议快结束了。
ext.ext_en: The Conference is more or less  over...

ext.ext_cn: 他基本上启动了公司的业务。
ext.ext_en: He more or less started the firm...

defs.def_en: If something is more or less true, it is true in a general way, but is not completely true.

ext.ext_cn: 他不只是教练，更是朋友。
ext.ext_en: He's more than a coach, he's a friend.

defs.def_en: If something is more than a particular thing, it has greater value or importance than this thing.

ext.ext_cn: 立陶宛的粮食生产供大于求。
ext.ext_en: Lithuania produces more than enough food to feed itself.

ext.ext_cn: 住宿宽敞，储藏空间绰绰有余
ext.ext_en: ...accommodation which is roomy and offers more than generous stowage.

defs.def_en: You use more than to say that something is true to a greater degree than is necessary or than average.

ext.ext_cn: 做成一个盒子不超过几个小时。
ext.ext_en: Each box requires no more than a few hours of labor to build...

ext.ext_cn: 他实际上还是个孩子，最多不过十八九岁。
ext.ext_en: He was a kid really, not more than eighteen or nineteen.

defs.def_en: You use no more than or not more than when you want to emphasize how small a number or amount is.

ext.ext_cn: 新发现的笔记只不过是朗的个人日志。
ext.ext_en: The newly discovered notes are nothing more than Lang's personal journal.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is nothing more than a particular thing, you are emphasizing that they are only that thing, and nothing more interesting or important.

defs.def_cn: 更有甚者;更为重要的是;此外

ext.ext_cn: 允许更多的机构，尤其是银行推出抵押贷款;此外，银行发放的贷款可以超过其实际持有资金。
ext.ext_en: Many more institutions, especially banks, were allowed to lend money for mortgages, and what was more, banks could lend out more money than they actually held...

ext.ext_cn: 你应该记住它，更重要的是，应该正确理解它。
ext.ext_en: You should remember it, and what's more, you should get it right.

defs.def_en: You can use what is more or what's more to introduce an extra piece of information which supports or emphasizes the point you are making.

ext.ext_cn: 政府官员显然也应当承担部分责任。
ext.ext_en: Government officials clearly deserve some of the blame as well...

ext.ext_cn: 他们对这项体育运动了如指掌，我们也给予了他们应有的尊重。
ext.ext_en: They know the sport inside out, and we treat them with the respect they deserve...

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or thing deserves something, you mean that they should have it or receive it because of their actions or qualities.

ext.ext_cn: 他们中的一个人说这两名开偷来的车去兜风的人死得活该。
ext.ext_en: One of them said the two dead joy riders got what they deserved.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone got what they deserved, you mean that they deserved the bad thing that happened to them, and you have no sympathy for them.

ext.ext_cn: 胡乱梳头只会使头发鬈得厉害。
ext.ext_en: Manic brushing will only cause frizz.

defs.def_en: Frizz is frizzy hair.

ext.ext_cn: 他自豪地高举起奖杯。
ext.ext_en: He held the trophy proudly aloft.

ext.ext_cn: 9个开幕气球第二天还有4个飘在空中。
ext.ext_en: Four of the nine starting balloons were still aloft the next day.

defs.def_en: Something that is aloft is in the air or off the ground.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 正义等抽象原则
ext.ext_en: ...abstract principles such as justice...

ext.ext_cn: 这不是某个抽象概念的问题。
ext.ext_en: It's not a question of some abstract concept.

defs.def_en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

ext.ext_en: Money was a commodity she never thought about except in the abstract.

defs.def_en: When you talk or think about something in the abstract, you talk or think about it in a general way, rather than considering particular things or events.

ext.ext_cn: 抽象名词，如光荣、荣耀和勇气
ext.ext_en: ...abstract words such as glory, honor, and courage.

defs.def_en: In grammar, an abstract noun refers to a quality or idea rather than to a physical object.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一幅现代派抽象画
ext.ext_en: ...a modern abstract painting.

defs.def_en: Abstract art makes use of shapes and patterns rather than showing people or things.
An abstract is an abstract work of art.
An abstract of an article, document, or speech is a short piece of writing that gives the main points of it.

ext.ext_cn: 从阿克斯河中抽水的许可证
ext.ext_en: ...a licence to abstract water from the River Axe...

ext.ext_cn: 作者从以前的书中摘取了一些诗作。
ext.ext_en: The author has abstracted poems from earlier books.

defs.def_en: If you abstract something from a place, you take it from there.

defs.def_cn: 遗产税（现在称作 inheritance tax)
defs.def_en: Death taxes were a tax which had to be paid on the money and property of someone who had died. This tax is now called inheritance tax .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他表演了一套惊人的杂技功夫。
ext.ext_en: He performed a sensational acrobatic feat.

defs.def_en: An acrobatic movement or display involves difficult physical acts such as jumping and balancing, especially in a circus.

ext.ext_cn: 人们所指控的他的政府在财政方面的失误政策
ext.ext_en: ...the alleged financial misdeeds of his government.

defs.def_en: A misdeed is a bad or evil act.

ext.ext_cn: 你仔细听,就会注意到每一个词都是那么的神奇，令人惊叹。
ext.ext_en: As you listen, you notice how every single word is imbued with a breathless sense of wonder.

ext.ext_cn: 能够激发听众热情的人
ext.ext_en: ...men who can imbue their hearers with enthusiasm.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is imbued with an idea, feeling, or quality, they become filled with it.

defs.def_cn: (尤指对不寻常或意外事物的)所见，目睹

ext.ext_cn: 在兰迪岛上看到一种珍稀海鸟
ext.ext_en: ...the sighting of a rare sea bird at Lundy island...

ext.ext_cn: 美国国家气象局报道说在伊利诺伊州出现了几次龙卷风。
ext.ext_en: The National Weather Service has reported several tornado sightings in Illinois.

defs.def_en: A sighting of something, especially something unusual or unexpected is an occasion on which it is seen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻浮的;见异思迁的;反复无常的

ext.ext_cn: 伊莎贝尔是个轻佻、没头脑的小女人，非常虚荣又反复无常。
ext.ext_en: Isabelle was a frivolous little fool, vain and flighty.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is flighty, you disapprove of them because they are not very serious or reliable and keep changing from one activity, idea, or partner to another.
CFCs are gases that are used in things such as aerosols and refrigerators and can cause damage to the ozone layer. CFC is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'chlorofluorocarbon'.

ext.ext_cn: 那个问题不在工作组的职权范围之内。
ext.ext_en: That issue is not within the remit of the working group...

ext.ext_cn: 这个中心有为亚洲的企业和企业家提供建议的职能。
ext.ext_en: The centre has a remit to advise Asian businesses and entrepreneurs.

defs.def_en: Someone's remit is the area of activity which they are expected to deal with, or which they have authority to deal with.

ext.ext_cn: 许多移民定期给他们的家人汇款。
ext.ext_en: Many immigrants regularly remit money to their families.

defs.def_en: If you remit money to someone, you send it to them.

defs.def_cn: 将(案件)发回原审判法庭（重审）

ext.ext_cn: 这一案件被发回法官处重新审理。
ext.ext_en: The matter was remitted to the justices for a rehearing.

defs.def_en: In an appeal court, if a case is remitted to the court where it was originally dealt with, it is sent back to be dealt with there.
An immovable object is fixed and cannot be moved.

ext.ext_cn: 但是在一个问题上她态度坚决。
ext.ext_en: On one issue, however, she was immovable.

defs.def_en: If someone is immovable in their attitude to something, they will not change their mind.
A finance company is a business which lends money to people and charges them interest while they pay it back.
A bald eagle is a large eagle with a white head that lives in North America. It is the national bird of the United States of America.

defs.def_cn: 持怀疑态度的人;怀疑论者

ext.ext_cn: 他天生多疑。
ext.ext_en: He was a born sceptic...

ext.ext_cn: 但是他现在得让怀疑者相信他有一个严肃的计划。
ext.ext_en: But he now has to convince sceptics that he has a serious plan.

defs.def_en: A sceptic is a person who has doubts about things that other people believe.
An ice-breaker is a large ship which sails through frozen waters, breaking the ice as it goes, in order to create a passage for other ships.

defs.def_cn: 打破僵局的事物;活跃气氛的话

ext.ext_cn: 这个活动可以有效地活跃新群体内的气氛。
ext.ext_en: This exercise can be quite a useful ice-breaker for new groups.

defs.def_en: An ice-breaker is something that someone says or does in order to make it easier for people who have never met before to talk to each other.

ext.ext_cn: 他们问了一大堆有关英格兰的问题。
ext.ext_en: They asked a great many questions about England...

ext.ext_cn: 总统拒绝就这个话题再回答问题。
ext.ext_en: The President refused to answer further questions on the subject...

defs.def_en: A question is something that you say or write in order to ask a person about something.

ext.ext_cn: 这让治疗专家问起了吉姆有关他父母及他们婚姻的情况。
ext.ext_en: This led the therapist to question Jim about his parents and their marriage...

ext.ext_cn: 警方正在询问一名涉嫌袭击一位残疾女性的男子。
ext.ext_en: A man is being questioned by police in connection with an attack on a disabled woman.

defs.def_en: If you question someone, you ask them a lot of questions about something.

ext.ext_cn: 他们从未想过要怀疑医生的决定。
ext.ext_en: It never occurs to them to question the doctor's decisions...

ext.ext_cn: 韦伯正要求观众们反思质疑各自的信仰。
ext.ext_en: Weber is challenging his audience to question their own beliefs.

defs.def_en: If you question something, you have or express doubts about whether it is true, reasonable, or worthwhile.

ext.ext_cn: 他们一定会成功。
ext.ext_en: There's no question about their success...

ext.ext_cn: 他是否会签署这项决议还不能确定。
ext.ext_en: There's some question as to whether he will sign this resolution...

defs.def_en: If you say that there is some question about something, you mean that there is doubt or uncertainty about it. If something is in question or has been called into question, doubt or uncertainty has been expressed about it.

ext.ext_cn: 但是整个援助问题是个非常复杂的政治问题。
ext.ext_en: But the whole question of aid is a tricky political one...

ext.ext_cn: 那个决定引起人们对国务卿的权力及其做法的公平性的质疑。
ext.ext_en: That decision raised questions about the secretary of state's powers and the fairness of his procedure.

defs.def_en: A question is a problem, matter, or point which needs to be considered.

ext.ext_cn: 他从某处听说经济学考试的考题年年都一样。
ext.ext_en: He'd heard somewhere that the questions in economics examination papers stayed the same from year to year...

ext.ext_cn: 那道题确实在考试中出现了。
ext.ext_en: That question did come up in the examination.

defs.def_en: The questions in an examination are the problems which are set in order to test your knowledge or ability.

defs.def_cn: 问得好，问得真有水平(用于问题难以回答、不便回答或不知道答案时)

ext.ext_cn: “你为什么12个月前不任命罗恩呢？”——“问得好。”
ext.ext_en: 'Why didn't you appoint Ron twelve months ago?'—'Good question.'

defs.def_en: If you say 'Good question' in reply to a question, you mean that it is a difficult question to answer, or perhaps that you are embarrassed about the answer or do not know the answer.

defs.def_cn: 被提及的;讨论中的;相关的

ext.ext_cn: 我们所说的那个选手是马克·威廉斯。
ext.ext_en: The player in question is Mark Williams...

ext.ext_cn: 把那个时期里你拿到的所有收入加在一起。
ext.ext_en: Add up all the income you've received over the period in question.

defs.def_en: The person, thing, or time in question is one which you have just been talking about or which is relevant.

defs.def_cn: 不可能;办不到;无法接受

ext.ext_cn: 对于无家可归的人而言，私人医疗纯粹是天方夜谭。
ext.ext_en: For the homeless, private medical care is simply out of the question...

ext.ext_cn: 增加税收仍然是不可能的事吗？
ext.ext_en: Is a tax increase still out of the question?

defs.def_en: If you say that something is out of the question, you are emphasizing that it is completely impossible or unacceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 斯图尔特很快认真起来，6个月之后便求婚了。
ext.ext_en: Stuart got serious quickly and popped the question six months later.

defs.def_en: If you pop the question, you ask someone to marry you.

ext.ext_cn: 就他而言，背叛自己的同志是不可能的。
ext.ext_en: As far as he was concerned there was no question of betraying his own comrades...

ext.ext_cn: 要纳税人为该党买单是不可能的。
ext.ext_en: There is no question of the taxpayer picking up the bill for the party.

defs.def_en: If you say there is no question of something happening, you are emphasizing that it is not going to happen.

defs.def_cn: 毫无疑问地;毫无异议地

ext.ext_cn: 毫无异议地执行上级军官的战斗命令的部队编队
ext.ext_en: ...military formations, carrying out without question the battle orders of superior officers.

defs.def_en: If you do something without question, you do it without arguing or asking why it is necessary.

defs.def_cn: 毫无疑问(表示强调自己的观点)

ext.ext_cn: 毫无疑问，他是我们最会讲故事的人。
ext.ext_en: He was our greatest storyteller, without question.

defs.def_en: You use without question to emphasize the opinion you are expressing.

ext.ext_cn: 一个亚热带的岛屿
ext.ext_en: ...a semi-tropical island.

defs.def_en: Semi-tropical places have warm, wet air.

defs.def_cn: (花草、树木)副热带的，亚热带的

ext.ext_cn: 这家小酒店的花园里种着亚热带植物。
ext.ext_en: The inn has a garden of semi-tropical vegetation.

defs.def_en: Semi-tropical plants and trees grow in places where the air is warm and wet.

defs.def_en: A woman's bikini line is the edges of the area where her pubic hair grows.

ext.ext_cn: 摇滚和流行音乐界的所有名人
ext.ext_en: ...all the big names in rock and pop.

defs.def_en: A big name is a person who is successful and famous because of their work.
A north-westerly point, area, or direction is to the north-west or towards the north-west.

ext.ext_cn: 我的灵感源于像波德莱尔和雅克·普雷韦这样的诗人。
ext.ext_en: My inspiration comes from poets like Baudelaire and Jacques Prévert...

ext.ext_cn: 还有什么比参观别人花园更好的获取灵感、扮靓自家花园的方法呢。
ext.ext_en: What better way of finding inspiration for your own garden than by visiting others.

defs.def_en: Inspiration is a feeling of enthusiasm you get from someone or something, which gives you new and creative ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 鲍威尔升任高官的不寻常历程对数以百万计的人都是一个激励。
ext.ext_en: Powell's unusual journey to high office is an inspiration to millions...

ext.ext_cn: 她极大地鼓舞了我们，让我们深刻了解到研究的重要性。
ext.ext_en: She was a great inspiration. She was the person who impressed us with the importance of research.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something good as an inspiration, you mean that they make you or other people want to do or achieve something.

ext.ext_cn: 印度的神话与歌曲是她那些书的灵感来源。
ext.ext_en: India's myths and songs are the inspiration for her books...

ext.ext_cn: 改革的想法源于 1985 年的一篇论文。
ext.ext_en: The inspiration behind the reforms was a paper written in 1985.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is the inspiration for a particular book, work of art, or action, they are the source of the ideas in it or act as a model for it.

ext.ext_cn: 艾莉森有了条妙计。
ext.ext_en: Alison had an inspiration.

defs.def_en: If you suddenly have an inspiration, you suddenly think of an idea of what to do or say.

ext.ext_cn: 把茄子纵向切成两半。
ext.ext_en: Cut the aubergines in half lengthways...

ext.ext_en: She tore off two sections of paper towel and folded them lengthwise.

defs.def_en: Lengthways or lengthwise means in a direction or position along the length of something.

ext.ext_en: The house is crammed with priceless furniture and works of art...

ext.ext_en: Living in a divided city crammed with foreign soldiers is not a matter we joke about.

ext.ext_en: Between two and three thousand refugees were crammed into the church buildings.

defs.def_en: If people or things are crammed into a place or vehicle, it is full of them.

ext.ext_en: In this country it is illegal to pay for surrogacy.

ext.ext_en: Many trains have been cancelled and a limited service is operating on other lines...

ext.ext_en: She learned her insurance had been canceled by Pacific Mutual Insurance Company...

defs.def_en: If someone in authority cancels a document, an insurance policy, or a debt, they officially declare that it is no longer valid or no longer legally exists.

ext.ext_cn: 盖销（邮）票
ext.ext_en: ...cancelled stamps.

defs.def_en: To cancel a stamp or a cheque means to mark it to show that it has already been used and cannot be used again.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is bitching about something, you mean that you disapprove of the fact that they are complaining about it in an unpleasant way.

ext.ext_en: ...a stocky man who did everything at the run, even when burdened with heavy camera gear...

ext.ext_en: ...the best chance in 20 years to end the scourge of terrorism...

ext.ext_en: Economic anarchy scourged the post-war world.

ext.ext_en: Clarke says his team could have lasted another 15 days before fatigue would have begun to take a toll.
