ext.ext_cn: 没完没了的电视节目和名人呼吁而导致的同情心疲劳
ext.ext_en: ...compassion fatigue caused by endless TV and celebrity appeals.

ext.ext_cn: 4 个月的战斗疲劳带来的后果
ext.ext_en: ...the result of four months of battle fatigue.

defs.def_en: You can say that people are suffering from a particular kind of fatigue when they have been doing something for a long time and feel they can no longer continue to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他从没想到会穿着美国军服回家。
ext.ext_en: He never expected to return home wearing US combat fatigues.

defs.def_en: Fatigues are clothes that soldiers wear when they are fighting or when they are doing routine jobs.

ext.ext_cn: 问题原来是飞机机身出现金属疲劳。
ext.ext_en: The problem turned out to be metal fatigue in the fuselage.

defs.def_en: Fatigue in metal or wood is a weakness in it that is caused by repeated stress. Fatigue can cause the metal or wood to break.

ext.ext_cn: 菲律宾人民已投票选举出了一位新总统。
ext.ext_en: The people of the Philippines have voted to elect a new president...

ext.ext_cn: 曼彻斯特学院于1956年推选他做院长。
ext.ext_en: Manchester College elected him Principal in 1956...

defs.def_en: When people elect someone, they choose that person to represent them, by voting for them.

ext.ext_cn: 那些想吸烟的人将坐在后排。
ext.ext_en: Those electing to smoke will be seated at the rear.

defs.def_en: If you elect to do something, you choose to do it.

defs.def_cn: 已当选但未就任的;候任的

ext.ext_cn: 候任总统就职日
ext.ext_en: ...the date when the president-elect takes office.

defs.def_en: Elect is added after words such as 'president' or 'governor' to indicate that a person has been elected to the post but has not officially started to carry out the duties involved.

ext.ext_cn: 杰克正坐在地板上看电视。
ext.ext_en: Jack's sitting on the floor watching TV...

ext.ext_cn: 我们把木地板刷成了白色。
ext.ext_en: We painted the wooden floor with a white stain.

defs.def_en: The floor of a room is the part of it that you walk on.

ext.ext_cn: 它位于医院的5层。
ext.ext_en: It is on the fifth floor of the hospital...

ext.ext_cn: 他们占用了塔楼的头两层。
ext.ext_en: They occupied the first two floors of the tower.

defs.def_en: A floor of a building is all the rooms that are on a particular level.

ext.ext_cn: 它们花好几个小时在海底进食。
ext.ext_en: They spend hours feeding on the ocean floor.

ext.ext_cn: 从谷底向上攀登两个小时
ext.ext_en: ...a two-hour climb from the valley floor.

defs.def_en: The ocean floor is the ground at the bottom of an ocean. The valley floor is the ground at the bottom of a valley.

ext.ext_cn: 这些问题在议院的议员席进行了讨论。
ext.ext_en: The issues were debated on the floor of the House.

defs.def_en: The place where official debates and discussions are held, especially between members of parliament, is referred to as the floor .

ext.ext_cn: 总统正接受来自听众席的提问。
ext.ext_en: The president is taking questions from the floor.

defs.def_en: In a debate or discussion, the floor is the people who are listening to the arguments being put forward but who are not among the main speakers.

ext.ext_cn: 渣打银行的交易大厅
ext.ext_en: ...the dealing floor at Standard Chartered Bank.

defs.def_en: The floor of a stock exchange is the large open area where trading is done.
The floor in a place such as a club or disco is the area where people dance.

ext.ext_cn: 这个通告使他不知所措。
ext.ext_en: He was floored by the announcement...

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎被一连串的丑闻搞得茫然失措。
ext.ext_en: He seemed floored by a string of scandals.

defs.def_en: If you are floored by something, you are unable to respond to it because you are so surprised by it.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在拳击比赛中)打倒，击倒

ext.ext_cn: 在第二轮中他两次被打倒在地。
ext.ext_en: He was floored twice in the second round.

defs.def_en: See also:floored;flooring;dance floor;first floor;ground floor;shop floor;If someone is floored, especially in boxing, they are hit so hard that they fall over.

defs.def_cn: (在辩论或讨论中)发言/给予…发言权

ext.ext_cn: 几位部长发言谴责暂停宪制的决定。
ext.ext_en: Ministers took the floor to denounce the decision to suspend constitutional rule...

ext.ext_cn: 只有会员才拥有发言权。
ext.ext_en: Only members would be given the floor.

defs.def_en: If you take the floor, you start speaking in a debate or discussion. If you are given the floor, you are allowed to do this.

ext.ext_cn: 这对幸福的新人和他们各自的父母在舞池中翩翩起舞。
ext.ext_en: The happy couple and their respective parents took to the floor.

defs.def_en: If you take to the floor, you start dancing at a dance or disco.

ext.ext_cn: 房地产价格骤降。
ext.ext_en: Property prices have dropped through the floor...

ext.ext_cn: 去年，销售突然下滑。
ext.ext_en: Last year, sales went through the floor.

defs.def_en: If you say that prices or sales have fallen through the floor, you mean that they have suddenly decreased.

ext.ext_cn: 他能彻底击败首相。
ext.ext_en: He could wipe the floor with the Prime Minister.

defs.def_en: See also:factory floor;If you wipe the floor with someone, you defeat them completely in a competition or discussion.

defs.def_cn: 很，非常（用于修饰形容词或副词，表示强调）

ext.ext_cn: 问题和答案都非常简单。
ext.ext_en: The problem and the answer are very simple...

ext.ext_cn: 这的确是非常非常有力的证据。
ext.ext_en: It is very, very strong evidence indeed...

defs.def_en: Very is used to give emphasis to an adjective or adverb.

ext.ext_cn: 她对他们没什么印象。
ext.ext_en: She's not very impressed with them...

ext.ext_cn: 我不太善于为自己辩解。
ext.ext_en: I'm not very good at explaining myself...

defs.def_en: Not very is used with an adjective or adverb to say that something is not at all true, or that it is true only to a small degree.

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮特看上去显然是怀孕了。
ext.ext_en: Janet looked very pregnant...

ext.ext_cn: 他的品位让英国人觉得他是个地道的法国人。
ext.ext_en: His taste strikes the English as very French...

defs.def_en: You use very to give emphasis to an adjective that is not usually graded, when you want to say that a quality is very obvious.

defs.def_cn: 完全，最（用于修饰形容词或副词最高级,表示强调）

ext.ext_cn: 他们将会受益于最新的导航系统。
ext.ext_en: They will be helped by the very latest in navigation aids...

ext.ext_cn: 我感觉自己的精神状态绝佳。
ext.ext_en: I am feeling in the very best of spirits...

defs.def_en: You use very to give emphasis to a superlative adjective or adverb. For example, if you say that something is the very best, you are emphasizing that it is the best.

defs.def_cn: （与某些名词连用，以确指最远的某一位置或时点）极端的

ext.ext_cn: 在院子的最后面离伦尼几英尺远的地方有一个小木屋。
ext.ext_en: At the very back of the yard, several feet from Lenny, was a wooden shack...

ext.ext_cn: 我翻到书的最后一页去读最后的文字。
ext.ext_en: I turned to the very end of the book, to read the final words...

defs.def_en: You use very with certain nouns in order to specify an extreme position or extreme point in time.

ext.ext_cn: 每个人都说他是接手这个案子的最佳人选。
ext.ext_en: Everybody says he is the very man for the case...

ext.ext_cn: 她正是在这间屋子里死去的。
ext.ext_en: She died in this very house...

defs.def_en: You use very with nouns to emphasize that something is exactly the right one or exactly the same one.

defs.def_cn: （与名词连用，强调重要性或严重性）仅仅的，唯独的，甚至于，就连

ext.ext_cn: 他的生命都曾一度处于危险之中。
ext.ext_en: At one stage his very life was in danger...

ext.ext_cn: 甚至于印度的政治基础都被改变了。
ext.ext_en: The very basis of Indian politics has been transformed...

defs.def_en: You use very with nouns to emphasize the importance or seriousness of what you are saying.

defs.def_cn: 好的，是（用于表示对上级的指示或命令遵照执行）

ext.ext_cn: “现在给我讲述一下你的航程吧。”——“非常乐意，先生。”
ext.ext_en: 'Now give me some account of your voyage.' — 'Very good, sir.'

defs.def_en: Very good is used to tell someone in authority that you agree to carry out a suggestion or order.

ext.ext_cn: “你的假期过得愉快吗？”——“非常愉快。”
ext.ext_en: 'Are you enjoying your holiday?' — 'Very much so.'

defs.def_en: The expression very much so is an emphatic way of answering 'yes' to something or saying that it is true or correct.

defs.def_cn: 那好吧，行（用于表示同意或接受，即使不是完全满意）

ext.ext_cn: “我们需要证据，先生。”又是一个短暂停顿。然后，“那好吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'We need proof, sir.' Another pause. Then, 'Very well.'...

ext.ext_cn: 好的，你自己随意。
ext.ext_en: Very well, please yourself.

defs.def_en: Very well is used to say that you agree to do something or you accept someone's answer, even though you might not be completely satisfied with it.

ext.ext_cn: 他不能去她的办公室强迫她开支票。
ext.ext_en: He couldn't very well go to her office and force her to write a check...

ext.ext_cn: 我答应了。我没法拒绝。
ext.ext_en: I said yes. I can't very well say no.

defs.def_en: If you say that you cannot very well do something, you mean that it would not be right or possible to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 腋下除臭剂
ext.ext_en: ...underarm deodorants.

ext.ext_cn: 用肥皂洗洗脚、腋下及全身。
ext.ext_en: Wash the feet, underarms and body surface using a soap.

defs.def_en: Underarm means in or for the areas under your arms, where they are joined to your body.

ext.ext_cn: 低手投球
ext.ext_en: ...an underarm throw.

ext.ext_cn: 练习低手投球。
ext.ext_en: Practise throwing a ball underarm.

defs.def_en: You use underarm to describe actions, such as throwing a ball, in which you do not raise your arm above your shoulder.

defs.def_cn: 不合法的；非法的；违法的

ext.ext_cn: 认为将他们解雇是违法行为的雇员
ext.ext_en: ...employees who believe their dismissal was unlawful...

ext.ext_cn: 往里推开的窗户表明有人非法入内。
ext.ext_en: A pushed-in window indicated unlawful entry.

defs.def_en: If something is unlawful, the law does not allow you to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （军事装备或运载工具）远程的

ext.ext_cn: 他很想和美国达成协议，减少远程核导弹的数量。
ext.ext_en: He is very keen to reach agreement with the US on reducing long-range nuclear missiles.

ext.ext_cn: 远程双引擎飞机在北大西洋航线上越来越多的使用
ext.ext_en: ...the growing use on the North Atlantic routes of long-range twin-engined aircraft.

defs.def_en: A long-range piece of military equipment or vehicle is able to hit or detect a target a long way away or to travel a long way in order to do something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 艾森豪威尔深谙长远规划的必要性。
ext.ext_en: Eisenhower was intensely aware of the need for long-range planning.

ext.ext_cn: 一项大胆、复杂的改善美国教育水平的长远策略
ext.ext_en: ...a bold, complex, and long-range strategy for improving US education.

defs.def_en: A long-range plan or prediction relates to a period extending a long time into the future.
A billy or billy club is a short heavy stick which is sometimes used as a weapon by the police.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 绒羽覆盖的;填满绒羽的;毛茸茸的

ext.ext_cn: 暖和的羽绒被
ext.ext_en: ...the warm downy quilt.

ext.ext_cn: 两只小鸡仔白色的毛茸茸的身体
ext.ext_en: ...the white downy bodies of two chicks.

defs.def_en: Something that is downy is filled or covered with small soft feathers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 被绒毛覆盖的;毛茸茸的

ext.ext_cn: 小小的脚趾和手指，他那毛茸茸的脑袋和光洁的皮肤
ext.ext_en: ...tiny toes and fingers, his downy head and beautiful skin.

ext.ext_cn: 底部常常多茸毛的树叶
ext.ext_en: ...leaves that are often downy underneath.

defs.def_en: Something that is downy is covered with very fine hairs.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 年轻幼稚的;涉世不深的；乳臭未干的

ext.ext_cn: 涉世不深的毛头小子
ext.ext_en: ...a callow youth.

defs.def_en: A callow young person has very little experience or knowledge of the way they should behave as an adult.

ext.ext_cn: 他心不在焉地看着镜中的自己。
ext.ext_en: He absent-mindedly looked at himself in the mirror...

ext.ext_cn: 他看了一下后视镜，发现一辆深色货车紧随其后。
ext.ext_en: He checked his mirror and saw that a dark coloured van was immediately behind him.

defs.def_en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

ext.ext_cn: 这本书不可避免地反映出我个人的喜好与经历。
ext.ext_en: The book inevitably mirrors my own interests and experiences...

ext.ext_cn: 他和她面面相觑。
ext.ext_en: His own shock was mirrored on her face.

defs.def_en: If something mirrors something else, it has similar features to it, and therefore seems like a copy or representation of it.

ext.ext_cn: 刚刚被洪水淹没的田野映照出了天空，那里突然泛起亮光
ext.ext_en: ...the sudden glitter where a newly-flooded field mirrors the sky...

ext.ext_cn: 船会停靠在那里，映衬在一片波澜不兴的湛蓝海水之中。
ext.ext_en: The ship would lie there mirrored in a perfectly unmoving glossy sea.

defs.def_en: If you see something reflected in water, you can say that the water mirrors it.

ext.ext_cn: 伍德为他们的故事勾勒出了一个合理的梗概。
ext.ext_en: Wood roughed out a possible framework for their story.

defs.def_en: If you rough out a drawing or an idea, you draw or write the main features of it before you do it in detail.

defs.def_cn: (板球、棒球或圆场棒球的)接球手，防守队员，接球高手

ext.ext_cn: 防守队员蹲伏在击球手守卫的三柱门周围。
ext.ext_en: The fielders crouch around the batsman's wicket.

defs.def_en: A fielder is a player in cricket, baseball, or rounders who is fielding or one who has a particular skill at fielding.

ext.ext_cn: 本·琼森的仆人理查德·布罗姆在1641年写了《一伙快活人》。
ext.ext_en: Richard Brome, an acolyte of Ben Jonson's, wrote 'The Jovial Crew' in 1641...

ext.ext_cn: 他被手下人简称为“老板”。
ext.ext_en: To his acolytes, he is known simply as 'the Boss'.

defs.def_en: An acolyte is a follower or assistant of an important person.

ext.ext_cn: 当驳船抵达圣地时，辅祭除去了柩衣。
ext.ext_en: When the barge reached the shrine, acolytes removed the pall.

defs.def_en: An acolyte is someone who assists a priest in performing certain religious services.
Macaroni cheese is a dish made from macaroni and cheese sauce.

defs.def_cn: （在优先股之后享受红利的）股票，普通股

ext.ext_cn: 投资者投入大量资金购买美国股票。
ext.ext_en: Investors have poured money into US equities.

defs.def_en: See also:preference shares;Equities are shares in a company that are owned by people who have a right to vote at the company's meetings and to receive part of the company's profits after the holders of preference shares have been paid.

ext.ext_cn: 那是私人之间的谈话，我不想透露其中的细节。
ext.ext_en: It was a private conversation and I don't want to go into details about what was said.

defs.def_en: If you go into something, you describe or examine it fully or in detail.

ext.ext_cn: 波克先生现在从事旅游业。
ext.ext_en: Mr Pok has now gone into the tourism business.

defs.def_en: If you go into something, you decide to do it as your job or career.

ext.ext_cn: 这种研究目前是否有大量的人力和资金投入？
ext.ext_en: Is there a lot of effort and money going into this sort of research?

defs.def_en: If an amount of time, effort, or money goes into something, it is spent or used to do it, get it, or make it.

defs.def_cn: (对所立遗嘱主要内容加以增补的)遗嘱附录
defs.def_en: A codicil is an instruction that is added to a will after the main part of it has been written.
Tax evasion is the crime of not paying the full amount of tax that you should pay.

defs.def_cn: 非人类的;不属于人类的

ext.ext_cn: 对外来者怀有敌意是人类和其他动物共有的特征。
ext.ext_en: Hostility towards outsiders is characteristic of both human and non-human animals.

defs.def_en: Non-human means not human or not produced by humans.
Rubber boots are long boots made of rubber that you wear to keep your feet dry.
Anti-virus software is software that protects a computer against viruses.

defs.def_cn: 英国佬（可能具冒犯意味）
defs.def_en: A pommy is an English person. This use could cause offence.
Glassware consists of objects made of glass, such as bowls, drinking containers, and ornaments.

ext.ext_cn: 用半面墙在房间里隔出了厨房。
ext.ext_en: The kitchen is sectioned off from the rest of the room by a half wall.

defs.def_en: If an area is sectioned off, it is separated by a wall, fence, or other barrier from the surrounding area.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 造成不和的;引起分歧的;制造争端的

ext.ext_cn: 人工流产一直是个引发争议的问题。
ext.ext_en: Abortion has always been a divisive issue...

ext.ext_cn: 公投将产生分歧。
ext.ext_en: A referendum would be divisive.

defs.def_en: Something that is divisive causes unfriendliness and argument between people.

ext.ext_cn: 像M. C. 哈默那样的说唱乐手
ext.ext_en: ...rappers like MC Hammer.

defs.def_en: A rapper is a person who performs rap music.

ext.ext_cn: 这些症状尤其与偏头痛相关。
ext.ext_en: These symptoms are particularly associated with migraine headaches.

defs.def_en: If one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected with each other.

defs.def_cn: （用于公司名称）联合的，联营的

ext.ext_cn: 美联社
ext.ext_en: ...the Associated Press.

defs.def_en: Associated is used in the name of a company that is made up of a number of smaller companies which have joined together.

ext.ext_cn: 亨丽埃塔女士的孔雀蓝丝绸燕尾礼服
ext.ext_en: ...Lady Henrietta's peacock blue, silk cocktail frock.

defs.def_en: Something that is peacock blue is a deep, bright, greeny-blue in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 1988年，电视转播权合同该重新谈判了。
ext.ext_en: The TV rights contract came up for renegotiation in 1988...

ext.ext_cn: 要更新执照的时候，这3家夜总会可能会受到严格审查。
ext.ext_en: These three clubs could come under close scrutiny when their licenses come up for renewal.

defs.def_en: When someone or something comes up for consideration or action of some kind, the time arrives when they have to be considered or dealt with.
Bedclothes are the sheets and covers which you put over yourself when you get into bed.

defs.def_cn: 作恶的人;坏人;邪恶之人
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as an evildoer, you mean that they are wicked, and that they deliberately cause harm or suffering to others.

ext.ext_cn: 基督教福音派信徒
ext.ext_en: ...an evangelical Christian.

defs.def_en: Evangelical Christians emphasize the importance of the Bible and the need for personal belief in Christ.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 几乎是凭着一股疯狂的热情，马克斯警告人们不要刻意追求晒成一身古铜色。
ext.ext_en: With almost evangelical fervour, Marks warns against deliberately seeking a tan...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as evangelical, you mean that it is very enthusiastic.

ext.ext_cn: 美丽的沙滩
ext.ext_en: ...a beautiful sandy beach...

ext.ext_cn: 我只想躺在海滩上晒晒太阳。
ext.ext_en: I just want to lie on the beach in the sun.

defs.def_en: A beach is an area of sand or stones beside the sea.

ext.ext_cn: 我们把独木舟径直划到岸边，并拖上岸。
ext.ext_en: We beached the canoe, running it right up the bank...

ext.ext_cn: 船搁浅在一片淤泥滩上。
ext.ext_en: The boat beached on a mud flat...

defs.def_en: If something such as a boat beaches, or if it is beached, it is pulled or forced out of the water and onto land.

ext.ext_cn: 山体滑坡掩埋了一栋公寓楼，造成一名7岁男孩丧生。
ext.ext_en: A seven-year-old boy was found dead after a landslide engulfed a block of flats...

ext.ext_cn: 那套公寓被火焰吞噬。
ext.ext_en: The flat is engulfed in flames.

defs.def_en: If one thing engulfs another, it completely covers or hides it, often in a sudden and unexpected way.

defs.def_cn: 使陷入（某种感觉或情绪）

ext.ext_cn: 将他吞噬的苦痛
ext.ext_en: ...the pain that engulfed him...

ext.ext_cn: 他环顾自己昏暗杂乱的办公室，陷入一阵空虚之中。
ext.ext_en: He looked around his dark, cluttered office and was engulfed by a feeling of emptiness.

defs.def_en: If a feeling or emotion engulfs you, you are strongly affected by it.

ext.ext_cn: 坦克开动时扬起大量尘土。
ext.ext_en: Tanks raise huge trails of dust when they move...

ext.ext_cn: 他在一阵尘土中将车倒进了围栏。
ext.ext_en: He reversed into the stockade in a cloud of dust.

defs.def_en: Dust is very small dry particles of earth or sand.

ext.ext_cn: 我可以看见楼梯上有一层厚厚的灰尘。
ext.ext_en: I could see a thick layer of dust on the stairs...

ext.ext_cn: 房间里没有家具,到处都是灰尘。
ext.ext_en: The rooms were empty of furniture and dust lay everywhere.

defs.def_en: Dust is the very small pieces of dirt which you find inside buildings, for example on furniture, floors, or lights.

ext.ext_cn: 空气中充斥着柴油烟雾和煤尘粉末,黑乎乎的,我几乎什么都看不见。
ext.ext_en: The air is so black with diesel fumes and coal dust, I can barely see.

defs.def_en: Dust is a fine powder which consists of very small particles of a substance such as gold, wood, or coal.

ext.ext_cn: 我用吸尘器打扫了客厅,擦了擦灰尘。
ext.ext_en: I vacuumed and dusted the living room...

ext.ext_cn: 她擦掉灰尘，打扫卫生，还清洗了餐具。
ext.ext_en: She dusted, she cleaned, and she did the washing-up.

defs.def_en: When you dust something such as furniture, you remove dust from it, usually using a cloth.

ext.ext_cn: 在鱼上撒上少许面粉。
ext.ext_en: Lightly dust the fish with flour...

ext.ext_cn: 将胭脂调匀涂在你脸颊红润的地方。
ext.ext_en: Dust and blend blusher on the apples of your cheeks...

defs.def_en: If you dust something with a fine substance such as powder or if you dust a fine substance onto something, you cover it lightly with that substance.

ext.ext_cn: 在过去的 30 年中,许多珍贵的价值观已经消失殆尽。
ext.ext_en: In the last 30 years many cherished values have bitten the dust...

ext.ext_cn: 这项指控断送了一名讲师的前程。
ext.ext_en: The allegation has caused one lecturer's career to bite the dust.

defs.def_en: If you say that something has bitten the dust, you are emphasizing that it no longer exists or that it has failed.

defs.def_cn: 尘埃落定;形势明朗;事态平息

ext.ext_cn: 事态一旦平息,贝克就为他的决定辩白。
ext.ext_en: Once the dust had settled Beck defended his decision...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为我们需要等事态平息之后再看看会发生什么。
ext.ext_en: I think we need to let the dust settle and see what's going to happen after that.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen when the dust settles, you mean that a situation will be clearer after it has calmed down. If you let the dust settle before doing something, you let a situation calm down before you try to do anything else.

ext.ext_cn: 许多机器尘封在地下室里。
ext.ext_en: Many of the machines are gathering dust in basements...

ext.ext_cn: 尘封了一年多后,专辑终于在 10 月发行。
ext.ext_en: The album is finally being released in October after gathering dust for over a year.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is gathering dust, you mean that it has been left somewhere and nobody is using it or doing anything with it.

defs.def_cn: 出席人数;到场人数;参加人数

ext.ext_cn: 在这个重要的夜晚，有大批人出席。
ext.ext_en: On the big night there was a massive turnout...

ext.ext_cn: 那是个美妙的下午，出席人数众多。
ext.ext_en: It was a marvellous afternoon with a huge turnout of people.

defs.def_en: The turnout at an event is the number of people who go to it or take part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 1988 年的投票率为 50%。
ext.ext_en: In 1988 the turnout was 50%…

ext.ext_cn: 选举官员称选民的投票率很低。
ext.ext_en: Election officials said the turnout of voters was low...

defs.def_en: The turnout in an election is the number of people who vote in it, as a proportion of the number of people who have the right to vote in it.

ext.ext_cn: 所有参赛者都一丝不挂地参加比赛。
ext.ext_en: All contestants competed stark naked.

defs.def_en: Someone who is stark naked is completely naked.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有负罪感的；深感歉疚的

ext.ext_cn: 在元月的第一个星期，成千上万的人在负疚感的驱使下报名参加健身班或者开始节食。
ext.ext_en: In the first week of January, thousands of guilt-ridden people signed up for fitness courses or embarked on diets.

defs.def_en: If a person is guilt-ridden, they feel very guilty about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 起初我对丢掉工作感到非常怨恨和恼怒。
ext.ext_en: At first I felt very resentful and angry about losing my job...

ext.ext_cn: 他闷闷不乐、心怀怨恨、一言不发地转过身去了。
ext.ext_en: He turned away in sullen, resentful silence.

defs.def_en: If you are resentful, you feel resentment.
Pollen is a fine powder produced by flowers. It fertilizes other flowers of the same species so that they produce seeds.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 磨损的小地毯会使人更容易绊倒。
ext.ext_en: Worn rugs increase the danger of tripping...

ext.ext_cn: 大部分时候都是沿着被人踩得坑坑洼洼的小路跋涉。
ext.ext_en: Most of the trek is along worn paths.

defs.def_en: Worn is used to describe something that is damaged or thin because it is old and has been used a lot.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她看上去非常憔悴和疲惫。
ext.ext_en: She was looking very haggard and worn.

defs.def_en: If someone looks worn, they look tired and old.

defs.def_cn: (尤用于测试新汽车、新飞机等的)风洞
defs.def_en: A wind tunnel is a room or passage through which air can be made to flow at controlled speeds. Wind tunnels are used to test new equipment or machinery, especially cars and aeroplanes.

ext.ext_cn: 那时我还在上小学，但是我记得非常清楚。
ext.ext_en: I was just in grade school at the time, but I remember it perfectly.

defs.def_en: In the United States, a grade school is the same as an elementary school.

ext.ext_cn: 这种植物被用作治疗神经痛时的镇静药。
ext.ext_en: The plant acts as a sedative in treating neuralgia.

defs.def_en: Neuralgia is very severe pain along the whole length of a nerve caused when the nerve is damaged or not working properly.

defs.def_cn: （本职工作之外获得的）酬金，谢礼

ext.ext_cn: 我看到各种各样的人都因为承担他们所指派的各种额外工作而获得酬金。
ext.ext_en: All sorts of people I found were getting honoraria for various extra duties that they had assigned to them.

defs.def_en: An honorarium is a fee that someone receives for doing something which is not a normal part of their job, for example giving a talk.

defs.def_cn: 公路暴怒（由于其他人违章驾驶或交通拥堵而引起的暴力行为）

ext.ext_cn: 殴打一名男性司机的公路暴力行为
ext.ext_en: ...a road rage attack on a male motorist...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天一位《泰晤士报》的记者成了公路泄愤的又一名受害者。
ext.ext_en: A Times reporter yesterday became another victim of road rage.

defs.def_en: Road rage is anger or violent behaviour caused by someone else's bad driving or the stress of being in heavy traffic.

ext.ext_cn: 法国针对手枪有严格的枪支管制法规，但并不限制猎枪。
ext.ext_en: France has tight gun-control laws for handguns, but not for hunting rifles.

defs.def_en: Gun control refers to the laws that restrict the possession and use of guns.
A paperboy is a boy who delivers newspapers to people's homes.

defs.def_cn: (尤指老式的或有欠缺的)解决方案;未必奏效的计策

ext.ext_cn: 对上世纪的招数紧抓不放
ext.ext_en: ...clinging to the nostrums of the dying century.

defs.def_en: You can refer to ideas or theories about how something should be done as nostrums, especially when you think they are old-fashioned or wrong in some way.

defs.def_cn: (未经科学证明有效的)灵丹妙药，神药

ext.ext_cn: 声称包治百病的药丸、药片和其他灵丹妙药
ext.ext_en: ...pills, tablets, and other nostrums claiming to be magic potions.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a medicine as a nostrum, you mean that it is not effective or has not been tested in a proper scientific way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 眼花缭乱的；迷乱的；迷醉的

ext.ext_cn: 许多人为名所困。
ext.ext_en: Many people are bedazzled by fame.

defs.def_en: If you are bedazzled by someone or something, you are so amazed and impressed by them that you feel confused.

ext.ext_cn: 可怕的骚乱、盗窃和纵火事件接连发生
ext.ext_en: ...a terrible wave of rioting, theft and arson...

ext.ext_cn: 他们四处纵火以泄愤。
ext.ext_en: They vented their anger by carrying out arson attacks.

defs.def_en: Arson is the crime of deliberately setting fire to a building or vehicle.

defs.def_cn: 废弃物；被胡乱扔掉的东西；垃圾

ext.ext_cn: 在过道里看到垃圾的话请捡起来。
ext.ext_en: If you see litter in the corridor, pick it up...

ext.ext_cn: 星期三我们清理了一块海滨林地的垃圾。
ext.ext_en: On Wednesday we cleared a beach and woodland of litter.

defs.def_en: Litter is rubbish that is left lying around outside.

ext.ext_cn: 他把桌子上凌乱堆放着的书本和报纸推开，摆了两套餐具。
ext.ext_en: He pushed aside the litter of books and papers and laid two places at the table.

defs.def_en: A litter of things is a quantity of them that are lying around in a disorganized way.

ext.ext_cn: 人行道上满是破碎瓶子的玻璃渣。
ext.ext_en: Glass from broken bottles litters the pavement.

defs.def_en: If a number of things litter a place, they are scattered untidily around it or over it.

ext.ext_cn: 历史上因为被父亲漠视而发奋成功的儿女数不胜数。
ext.ext_en: History is littered with men and women spurred into achievement by a father's disregard...

ext.ext_cn: 查尔斯的演讲充斥着“包装”、“产品”之类的营销领域流行用语。
ext.ext_en: Charles' speech is littered with lots of marketing buzzwords like 'package' and 'product'.

defs.def_en: If something is littered with things, it contains many examples of it.

ext.ext_cn: 一窝小狗
ext.ext_en: ...a litter of pups.

defs.def_en: A litter is a group of animals born to the same mother at the same time.
Litter is a dry substance that you put in the container where you want your cat to go to the toilet.

ext.ext_cn: 起初他的小心眼表现得不是十分明显——他并不介意我和其他男人说话。
ext.ext_en: At first his jealousy only showed in small ways — he didn't mind me talking to other guys.

defs.def_en: Jealousy is the feeling of anger or bitterness which someone has when they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

ext.ext_cn: 她的美貌惹来嫉妒和羡慕。
ext.ext_en: Her beauty causes envy and jealousy.

defs.def_en: Jealousy is the feeling of anger or bitterness which someone has when they wish that they could have the qualities or possessions that another person has.

defs.def_cn: (进行体育运动和社交的)乡村俱乐部
defs.def_en: A country club is a club in the country where you can play sports and attend social events.

ext.ext_cn: 合成材料制成的靴子通常可以机洗。
ext.ext_en: Boots made from synthetic materials can usually be washed in a machine.

ext.ext_cn: 合成橡胶
ext.ext_en: ...synthetic rubber.

defs.def_en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

defs.def_cn: （课程）校外的，面向非全日制学生的

ext.ext_cn: 1948年我在考文垂第一次上校外课，虽然当时我在伯明翰工作。
ext.ext_en: I took my first extra-mural course in 1948 in Coventry, even though I was working in Birmingham...

ext.ext_cn: 成人教育是和大学对外教学部合办的。
ext.ext_en: Adult education is run in cooperation with the extra-mural departments of the universities.

defs.def_en: Extra-mural courses are courses at a college or university which are taken mainly by part-time students.

ext.ext_cn: 苹果树盘绕的根
ext.ext_en: ...the twisted roots of an apple tree.

defs.def_en: The roots of a plant are the parts of it that grow under the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数植物都会在6到8周内生根。
ext.ext_en: Most plants will root in about six to eight weeks...

ext.ext_cn: 把插条放在加热的培育箱里生根。
ext.ext_en: Root the cuttings in a heated propagator.

defs.def_en: If you root a plant or cutting or if it roots, roots form on the bottom of its stem and it starts to grow.

defs.def_cn: (蔬菜、作物等)块根的，根茎可食用的

ext.ext_cn: 诸如胡萝卜和马铃薯之类的块根作物
ext.ext_en: ...root crops such as carrots and potatoes.

defs.def_en: Root vegetables or root crops are grown for their roots which are large and can be eaten.

ext.ext_cn: 牙根周围的腐蚀
ext.ext_en: ...decay around the roots of teeth.

ext.ext_cn: 能彻底将毛发连根清除的脱毛蜡
ext.ext_en: ...wax strips which remove hairs cleanly from the root.

defs.def_en: The root of a hair or tooth is the part of it that is underneath the skin.

ext.ext_cn: 我为我的巴西血统感到自豪。
ext.ext_en: I am proud of my Brazilian roots...

ext.ext_cn: 她从黎巴嫩搬到英国已经有21年了，但她从未忘记自己的根。
ext.ext_en: It's 21 years since she first moved to Britain from the Lebanon, but she hasn't forgotten her roots.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the place or culture that a person or their family comes from as their roots .

defs.def_cn: 根音乐（受传统文化强烈影响的流行音乐，尤指雷盖音乐)

ext.ext_cn: 像小罗伊、“哭泣灵魂”等这一类音乐人表演的极棒的老根雷盖乐
ext.ext_en: ...superb roots reggae by the likes of Little Roy and Wailing Souls.

defs.def_en: Roots is used to refer to pop music, especially reggae, that is strongly influenced by the traditional music of the culture that it originally came from.

defs.def_cn: (问题、困境等的)根源，起因，祸根

ext.ext_cn: 我们找到了问题的根源。
ext.ext_en: We got to the root of the problem...

ext.ext_cn: 这种不被承认就是这次纷争的根源。
ext.ext_en: This lack of recognition was at the root of the dispute...

defs.def_en: You can refer to the cause of a problem or of an unpleasant situation as the root of it or the roots of it.

ext.ext_cn: 单词secretary和secret有同样的拉丁词根。
ext.ext_en: The word 'secretary' comes from the same Latin root as the word 'secret'.

defs.def_en: The root of a word is the part that contains its meaning and to which other parts can be added.

ext.ext_cn: 她在包里翻了一阵，找到了想要的东西，然后朝门口走去。
ext.ext_en: She rooted through the bag, found what she wanted, and headed toward the door...

ext.ext_cn: 狗在路边的垃圾里觅食。
ext.ext_en: Dogs root in the debris at the roadside.

defs.def_en: If you root through or in something, you search for something by moving other things around.

ext.ext_cn: 纳粹主义势力当时正在彻底改变德国。
ext.ext_en: The forces of National Socialism were transforming Germany root and branch...

ext.ext_cn: 有些监狱的做法需要彻底改革。
ext.ext_en: Some prison practices are in need of root and branch reform.

defs.def_en: If something has been completely changed or destroyed, you can say that it has been changed or destroyed root and branch .

ext.ext_cn: 到了蒙大拿后，他们便在那里扎根并过上了新生活。
ext.ext_en: When they got to Montana, they put down roots and built a life.

defs.def_en: If someone puts down roots, they make a place their home, for example by taking part in activities there or by making a lot of friends there.

defs.def_cn: (想法、信念或风俗)深入人心，根深蒂固

ext.ext_cn: 民主观念要深入人心需要时间。
ext.ext_en: Time would be needed for democracy to take root...

ext.ext_cn: 没有合理的性教育，各种各样奇怪荒诞的说法都会有人相信。
ext.ext_en: Without a sensible sex education all kinds of strange and fantastic ideas will take root.

defs.def_en: If an idea, belief, or custom takes root, it becomes established among a group of people.

defs.def_cn: B级电影（指制作匆忙的廉价影片）

ext.ext_cn: 一些好莱坞的老B级片
ext.ext_en: ...some old Hollywood B-movie.

defs.def_en: A B-movie is a film which is produced quickly and cheaply and is often considered to have little artistic value.
Something that is tragi-comic is both sad and amusing at the same time.

defs.def_cn: （用于构成形容词）表示“对…感到厌恶的”，“对…感到恐惧的”

ext.ext_cn: 我对统计数据感到恐惧，对药物一窍不通。
ext.ext_en: I'm statistic-phobic, and hopelessly ignorant of medicine.

defs.def_en: -phobic occurs in words which describe something relating to a strong, irrational fear or hatred of people or things of a particular kind.
A blackberry is a small, soft black or dark purple fruit.

ext.ext_cn: 球滚进了网中。
ext.ext_en: The ball rolled into the net...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的车冲出公路，翻倒在一旁。
ext.ext_en: Their car went off the road and rolled over...

defs.def_en: When something rolls or when you roll it, it moves along a surface, turning over many times.

ext.ext_cn: 我小时候从一座山坡上滚了下来，把腿摔断了。
ext.ext_en: When I was a little kid I rolled down a hill and broke my leg...

ext.ext_cn: 他们像小学生一样，在地板上滚来滚去，互相挥着拳头揍对方。
ext.ext_en: They just rolled about on the floor punching each other like schoolboys...

defs.def_en: If you roll somewhere, you move on a surface while lying down, turning your body over and over, so that you are sometimes on your back, sometimes on your side, and sometimes on your front.

ext.ext_cn: 卡车静静地缓慢前行。
ext.ext_en: The lorry quietly rolled forward.

defs.def_en: When vehicles roll along, they move along slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 在摄像时他不慎滑倒在飞机座位间的通道上。
ext.ext_en: He slipped and fell on an airplane gangway as the cameras rolled...

ext.ext_cn: 今天，匹兹堡的报纸又开始印刷了。
ext.ext_en: The newspaper presses are rolling in Pittsburgh again today.

defs.def_en: If a machine rolls, it is operating.

ext.ext_cn: 她看着金尼，泪水滑落脸庞。
ext.ext_en: She looked at Ginny and tears rolled down her cheeks.

defs.def_en: If drops of liquid roll down a surface, they move quickly down it.

ext.ext_cn: 他脱下毛衣，将它卷成一个枕头，然后在草地上躺了下来。
ext.ext_en: He took off his sweater, rolled it into a pillow and lay down on the grass...

ext.ext_cn: 他又卷了一支烟并点着了。
ext.ext_en: He rolled and lit another cigarette.

defs.def_en: If you roll something flexible into a cylinder or a ball, you form it into a cylinder or a ball by wrapping it several times around itself or by shaping it between your hands.

ext.ext_cn: 摄影师们已经照了一打胶卷了。
ext.ext_en: The photographers had already shot a dozen rolls of film.

ext.ext_cn: 一卷蓝色的绝缘电线
ext.ext_en: ...a roll of blue insulated wire.

defs.def_en: See also:toilet roll;A roll of paper, plastic, cloth, or wire is a long piece of it that has been wrapped many times around itself or around a tube.

ext.ext_cn: 下午三时左右，店主们开始放下百叶窗。
ext.ext_en: In mid-afternoon, shopkeepers began to roll down their shutters...

ext.ext_cn: 她把车窗摇上来，继续开车。
ext.ext_en: She rolled up the window and drove on...

defs.def_en: If you roll up something such as a car window or a blind, you cause it to move upwards by turning a handle. If you roll it down, you cause it to move downwards by turning a handle.

defs.def_cn: 转动(眼睛)；(眼珠)骨碌碌地转

ext.ext_cn: 人们可能会翻着白眼谈论那些溺爱儿孙、样样都要插手的祖母。
ext.ext_en: People may roll their eyes and talk about overprotective, interfering grandmothers...

ext.ext_cn: 他转了转眼睛，呜咽起来。
ext.ext_en: His eyes rolled and he sobbed.

defs.def_en: If you roll your eyes or if your eyes roll, they move round and upwards. People sometimes roll their eyes when they are frightened, bored, or annoyed.

ext.ext_cn: 他把黄油抹在小圆面包上。
ext.ext_en: He spread butter on a roll.

defs.def_en: A roll is a small piece of bread that is round or long and is made to be eaten by one person. Rolls can be eaten plain, with butter, or with a filling.

defs.def_cn: （鼓的）咚咚声,隆隆声,持续的轰鸣声

ext.ext_cn: 当小镇的时钟敲响两点钟时，他们听到了隆隆的鼓声。
ext.ext_en: As the town clock struck two, they heard the roll of drums.

defs.def_en: See also:drum roll;A roll of drums is a long, low, fairly loud sound made by drums.

ext.ext_cn: 选民名单
ext.ext_en: ...the electoral roll.

defs.def_en: A roll is an official list of people's names.

ext.ext_cn: 我靠自己的能力成名了，接二连三地获得成功，我觉得一切似乎一帆风顺。
ext.ext_en: I made a name for myself and I was on a roll, I couldn't see anything going wrong.

defs.def_en: If someone is on a roll, they are having great success which seems likely to continue.

ext.ext_cn: 盼望有一天有人会研制出一种能有效预防疟疾的疫苗。
ext.ext_en: Roll on the day someone develops an effective vaccine against malaria.

defs.def_en: If you say roll on something, you mean that you would like it to come soon, because you are looking forward to it.

ext.ext_cn: 你当过兵吗？
ext.ext_en: Did you serve in the military?

defs.def_en: The military are the armed forces of a country, especially officers of high rank.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 需要对你的工作日进行精确有序的安排。
ext.ext_en: Your working day will need to be organized with military precision.

ext.ext_cn: 他有一种军人的风姿，身板总是挺得笔直。
ext.ext_en: He has a military bearing, never failing to carry himself erect.

defs.def_en: Military means well-organized, controlled, or neat, in a way that is typical of a soldier.

defs.def_cn: 桑巴舞(一种欢快的巴西舞蹈)
defs.def_en: A samba is a lively Brazilian dance.

defs.def_cn: (光碟、唱片、磁带上的)标题歌，标题曲

ext.ext_cn: 他们来自蒂厄姆，就是那个在他们专辑同名歌曲《一路行自蒂厄姆》中提及的地方。
ext.ext_en: They come from Tuam, a place they refer to on the title track of their album, 'All the Way From Tuam'.

defs.def_en: The title track on a CD, record, or tape is a song or piece of music that has the same title as the CD, record, or tape.

defs.def_cn: (农舍、房屋)出租的，供雇工租住的

ext.ext_cn: 他和妻子住在哈姆西的雇工农舍里。
ext.ext_en: He lives with his wife in a tied cottage in Hamsey.

defs.def_en: A tied cottage or house belongs to a farmer or other employer and is rented to someone who works for him or her.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 政府在弗纳德存放放射性废料已达50年之久。
ext.ext_en: The government has been storing radioactive waste at Fernald for 50 years.

defs.def_en: Something that is radioactive contains a substance that produces energy in the form of powerful and harmful rays.

ext.ext_cn: 工会代表
ext.ext_en: ...trade union representatives...

ext.ext_cn: 每个部门的员工选举一名代表。
ext.ext_en: Employees from each department elect a representative.

defs.def_en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名销售代表，她的工作压力很大。
ext.ext_en: She had a stressful job as a sales representative.

defs.def_en: A representative is a person whose job is to sell a company's products or services, especially by travelling round and visiting other companies.

defs.def_cn: 由代表组成的;代议制的

ext.ext_cn: 新的国家元首应该由包括87名成员的代表委员会选出。
ext.ext_en: The new head of state should be chosen by an 87 member representative council.

ext.ext_cn: 代议制政府的各个机构
ext.ext_en: ...the institutions of a representative government.

defs.def_en: A representative group consists of a small number of people who have been chosen to make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他远不是一般意义上的驯狗师。
ext.ext_en: He was in no way representative of dog-trainers in general.

ext.ext_cn: 相当典型的成年人群体
ext.ext_en: ...fairly representative groups of adults.

defs.def_en: Someone who is typical of the group to which they belong can be described as representative .
In the United States, a Representative is a member of the House of Representatives, the less powerful of the two parts of Congress.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 直言不讳的；直截了当的

ext.ext_cn: 看不惯炫耀和虚伪、直言不讳的一个美国人
ext.ext_en: ...a plain-spoken American full of scorn for pomp and pretense.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is plain-spoken, you mean that they say exactly what they think, even when they know that what they say may not please other people.

ext.ext_cn: “在那里，”杰克向上指着说。
ext.ext_en: 'There,' said Jack, pointing upwards...

ext.ext_cn: 他们沿着村庄周围的陡峭悬崖往上爬。
ext.ext_en: They climbed upward along the steep cliffs surrounding the village...

defs.def_en: If someone moves or looks upwards, they move or look up towards a higher place.

ext.ext_cn: 商业大街上商店里的价格迅速上涨
ext.ext_en: ...with prices soon heading upwards in high street stores...

ext.ext_cn: 今年的大部分时间失业率仍将上升。
ext.ext_en: Unemployment will continue upward for much of this year...

defs.def_en: If an amount or rate moves upwards, it increases.

ext.ext_cn: 价值2亿多英镑的项目
ext.ext_en: ...projects worth upwards of 200 million pounds...

ext.ext_cn: 关押某些犯人一年的成本超过4万美元。
ext.ext_en: It costs upward of $40,000 a year to keep some prisoners in prison.

defs.def_en: A quantity that is upwards of a particular number is more than that number.

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词后构成形容词）表示“装某种枪管的”

ext.ext_cn: 短筒步枪
ext.ext_en: ...a short-barreled rifle.

ext.ext_cn: 双管猎枪
ext.ext_en: ...a double-barrelled shotgun.

defs.def_en: See also:double-barrelled;-barrelled combines with adjectives to form adjectives that describe a gun which has a barrel or barrels of the specified type.
A steamer is a ship that has an engine powered by steam.
A steamer is a special container used for steaming food such as vegetables and fish.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有适应能力的;能适应的;适应性强的

ext.ext_cn: 一支适应能力及技能更强的劳动大军
ext.ext_en: ...a more adaptable and skilled workforce...

ext.ext_cn: 它们是适应能力很强的觅食者，赖以生存的食物来源很广。
ext.ext_en: They are adaptable foragers that learn to survive on a wide range of food sources.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or animal as adaptable, you mean that they are able to change their ideas or behaviour in order to deal with new situations.

defs.def_cn: 线下促销；非大众媒体促销

ext.ext_cn: 广告宣传活动将采取公关和线下促销的形式。
ext.ext_en: The advertising campaign will be supported by a PR and below-the-line promotion...

defs.def_en: Below-the-line promotion is the use of promotional methods that can be controlled by the company selling the goods or service, such as in-store offers and direct selling.
Gold-rimmed glasses have gold-coloured frames.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 造成不和的;引起分歧的;制造争端的

ext.ext_cn: 人工流产一直是个引发争议的问题。
ext.ext_en: Abortion has always been a divisive issue...

ext.ext_cn: 公投将产生分歧。
ext.ext_en: A referendum would be divisive.

defs.def_en: Something that is divisive causes unfriendliness and argument between people.

ext.ext_cn: 警方为抓捕两名恐怖嫌疑人而展开的大规模拉网式搜查
ext.ext_en: ...a massive police dragnet for two suspected terrorists.

defs.def_en: A dragnet is a method used by police to catch suspected criminals. A large number of police officers search a specific area, in the hope that they will eventually find the person they are looking for.

ext.ext_cn: 购买部分磨损轮胎时要格外当心。
ext.ext_en: Extreme caution should be exercised when buying part-worn tyres...

ext.ext_cn: 财政大臣为人处世谨慎。
ext.ext_en: The Chancellor is a man of caution.

defs.def_en: Caution is great care which you take in order to avoid possible danger.

ext.ext_cn: 托尼告诫说不要歪曲形势。
ext.ext_en: Tony cautioned against misrepresenting the situation...

ext.ext_cn: 显然，这个声明的目的是要警告首尔不要尝试再次阻拦委员会的行动。
ext.ext_en: The statement clearly was intended to caution Seoul against attempting to block the council's action again...

defs.def_en: If someone cautions you, they warn you about problems or danger.

ext.ext_cn: 那两个人受到了警告，不过警方说不会对他们提出指控。
ext.ext_en: The two men were cautioned but police say they will not be charged...

ext.ext_cn: 最后，塔普因浪费警方时间而受到警告。
ext.ext_en: Tapp was eventually cautioned for wasting police time.

defs.def_en: If someone who has broken the law is cautioned by the police, they are warned that if they break the law again official action will be taken against them.

defs.def_cn: 向…告知其法律权利(即嫌疑人所说的任何话都可能成为呈堂证据)

ext.ext_cn: 被捕后，没有人被告知其法律权利。
ext.ext_en: Nobody was cautioned after arrest.

defs.def_en: If someone who has been arrested is cautioned, the police warn them that anything they say may be used as evidence in a trial.

defs.def_cn: 把理智抛至脑后;鲁莽行事;恣意妄为

ext.ext_cn: 我不顾一切，骑得飞快。
ext.ext_en: I threw caution to the wind and rode as fast as I could.

defs.def_en: If you throw caution to the wind, you behave in a way that is not considered sensible or careful.

defs.def_cn: (尤指刚从大国中独立出来的)小国
defs.def_en: A statelet is a small independent state, especially one that until recently was part of a larger country.
In grammar, a modal or a modal auxiliary is a word such as 'can' or 'would' which is used with a main verb to express ideas such as possibility, intention, or necessity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有教育意义的;教育性的

ext.ext_cn: 允许电视台进入他们的审判庭所具有的教育意义
ext.ext_en: ...the educative value of allowing broadcasters into their courts.

defs.def_en: Something that has an educative role teaches you something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可怜的；令人怜悯的；悲惨的

ext.ext_cn: 可怜的卷尾巴小狗
ext.ext_en: ...a pathetic little dog with a curly tail...

ext.ext_cn: 这一小群旁观者看起来真是让人悲哀。
ext.ext_en: The small group of onlookers presented a pathetic sight...

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or animal as pathetic, you mean that they are sad and weak or helpless, and they make you feel very sorry for them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 差劲的；软弱的；令人生厌的

ext.ext_cn: 多差劲的借口啊！
ext.ext_en: What pathetic excuses...

ext.ext_cn: 一小杯葡萄酒要1英镑，真差劲。
ext.ext_en: It's a pound for a small glass of wine, which is pathetic.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as pathetic, you mean that they make you feel impatient or angry, often because they are weak or not very good.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在让伦敦地铁旧貌换新颜的 10 年规划
ext.ext_en: ...a 10-year programme to smarten up the London Underground...

ext.ext_cn: 她很聪明地把自己修饰打扮了一番。
ext.ext_en: She had wisely smartened herself up.

defs.def_en: If you smarten yourself or a place up, you make yourself or the place look neater and tidier.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Close-fitting clothes fit tightly and show the shape of your body.
Farther is a comparative form of far .
A conduit is a small tunnel, pipe, or channel through which water or electrical wires go.

ext.ext_cn: 巴基斯坦成了阿富汗毒品的贩运通道。
ext.ext_en: Pakistan became a conduit for drugs produced in Afghanistan.

defs.def_en: A conduit is a person or country that links two or more other people or countries.

ext.ext_cn: 彩色和黑白显示器
ext.ext_en: ...color and monochrome monitors.

ext.ext_cn: 带有沙沙声的黑白电影
ext.ext_en: ...scratchy monochrome movies.

defs.def_en: A monochrome film, photograph, or television shows black, white, and shades of grey, but no other colours.

ext.ext_cn: 一幅陈旧的描绘啤酒厂的单色蚀刻画
ext.ext_en: ...an old monochrome etching of a brewery.

defs.def_en: A monochrome picture uses only one colour in various shades.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (巨大、复杂、极端得)令人难以想象的

ext.ext_cn: 相关的书面工作量大得令人难以想象。
ext.ext_en: The amount of paperwork involved is mind-boggling.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is mind-boggling, you mean that it is so large, complicated, or extreme that it is very hard to imagine.

defs.def_cn: 绿色革命（尤指发展中国家为增加粮食产量而采用新品种和新耕种方法的举措）
defs.def_en: The green revolution is the increase in agricultural production that has been made possible by the use of new types of crops and new farming methods, especially in developing countries.

defs.def_cn: （一心想跨入社会权贵阶层的）攀高结贵者，野心勃勃的人

ext.ext_cn: 被一些人认为是一心想攀龙附骥的女人
ext.ext_en: A woman regarded by some as a pushy arriviste.

ext.ext_cn: 政治野心家
ext.ext_en: ...political arrivistes.

defs.def_en: You describe someone as an arriviste when you are criticizing them because they are trying very hard to belong to an influential or important social group which you feel they have no right to belong to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不礼貌的;无礼的;粗鲁的

ext.ext_cn: 提出过多的问题是不礼貌的。
ext.ext_en: It is impolite to ask too many questions.

ext.ext_cn: 连与他共进晚餐这样的简单邀请都拒绝会显得非常失礼,没有教养。
ext.ext_en: It would be most ungracious and impolite to refuse a simple invitation to supper with him.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is impolite, you mean that they are rather rude and do not have good manners.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在离房子不远处停了下来。
ext.ext_en: They halted at a short distance from the house...

ext.ext_cn: 发动机的声音随着飞机着陆、滑行和停下一直在变化。
ext.ext_en: The engine note changed as the aircraft landed, taxied and halted...

defs.def_en: When a person or a vehicle halts or when something halts them, they stop moving in the direction they were going and stand still.

defs.def_cn: （使）（生长、发展、活动等）停止（或中止）

ext.ext_cn: 罢工工人于昨日停止了汽车厂的生产。
ext.ext_en: Striking workers halted production at the auto plant yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 他批评政府未能遏止经济下滑。
ext.ext_en: He criticised the government for failing to halt economic decline...

defs.def_en: When something such as growth, development, or activity halts or when you halt it, it stops completely.

defs.def_cn: （军队口令）立定！站住！停止前进！

ext.ext_cn: 上校命令道：“立定！”
ext.ext_en: The colonel ordered 'Halt!'

defs.def_en: 'Halt!' is a military order to stop walking or marching and stand still.

defs.def_cn: （只有小型站台、无建筑物的)小火车站
defs.def_en: A halt is a very small station on a country railway line, which often consists only of a short platform and no building.

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯政府已叫停了罗斯托夫地区的一个新工程。
ext.ext_en: The Russian government had called a halt to the construction of a new project in the Rostov region.

defs.def_en: If someone calls a halt to something such as an activity, they decide not to continue with it or to end it immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 索菲娅和亚历克斯停了下来，两人都想喘口气。
ext.ext_en: Sofia and Alex came to a halt and both tried to regain their breath...

ext.ext_cn: 电梯嘎吱一声停在了一层。
ext.ext_en: The elevator creaked to a halt at the ground floor.

defs.def_en: If someone or something comes to a halt, they stop moving.

defs.def_cn: （使）（生长、发展、活动等）完全停止

ext.ext_cn: 她的政治生涯于1988年12月画上了句号。
ext.ext_en: Her political career came to a halt in December 1988...

ext.ext_cn: 由于航空调度员罢工，波兰的空中交通已完全瘫痪。
ext.ext_en: Air traffic in Poland has been brought to a halt by an air traffic controllers' strike.

defs.def_en: If something such as growth, development, or activity comes or grinds to a halt or is brought to a halt, it stops completely.

ext.ext_cn: 各种颜色和样式都有。
ext.ext_en: A wide range of colours and patterns are available...

ext.ext_cn: 那两个人讨论了一系列问题。
ext.ext_en: The two men discussed a range of issues...

defs.def_en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

ext.ext_cn: 平均年龄在35岁到55岁之间。
ext.ext_en: The average age range is between 35 and 55.

ext.ext_cn: 在他们寻求的价格范围内的房产
ext.ext_en: ...properties available in the price range they are looking for.

defs.def_en: A range is the complete group that is included between two points on a scale of measurement or quality.

ext.ext_cn: 口径为120毫米的迫击炮的射程是1.8万码。
ext.ext_en: The 120mm mortar has a range of 18,000 yards...

ext.ext_cn: 山上我视野范围内的树木都被砍倒了。
ext.ext_en: The trees on the mountains within my range of vision had all been felled...

defs.def_en: The range of something is the maximum area in which it can reach things or detect things.

ext.ext_cn: 它们的价格从3美元到15美元不等。
ext.ext_en: They range in price from $3 to $15.

ext.ext_cn: 供应从日常用品到专业用具等各种商品
ext.ext_en: ...offering merchandise ranging from the everyday to the esoteric.

defs.def_en: If things range between two points or range from one point to another, they vary within these points on a scale of measurement or quality.

ext.ext_cn: 谈话涉及了这类餐馆的吸引人之处、男人的弱点，还有为什么只用15分钟就跨越了一个大洲。
ext.ext_en: The conversation ranged over the desirability of such restaurants, the shortcomings of men, and why it had only taken 15 minutes to cross a continent.

defs.def_en: If a piece of writing or speech ranges over a group of topics, it includes all those topics.

ext.ext_cn: 沿着绿篱栽种着大约300棵树。
ext.ext_en: Some 300 trees have been ranged along the perimeter hedge...

ext.ext_cn: 1,500多名警察和士兵列队与他们对峙。
ext.ext_en: More than 1,500 police and troops are ranged against them.

defs.def_en: If people or things are ranged somewhere, they are arranged in a row or in lines.

ext.ext_cn: 这种鸟活动的范围很大，因此觅食不成问题。
ext.ext_en: Feeding is not a problem because the birds range over such a large area...

ext.ext_cn: 它们在广阔的区域内搜寻腐肉。
ext.ext_en: They range widely in search of carrion.

defs.def_en: If animals or people range somewhere, they move around in a place without having a particular destination in mind.

ext.ext_cn: 向北延伸的巨大山脉
ext.ext_en: ...the massive mountain ranges to the north.

ext.ext_cn: 山顶覆盖着树木的绵绵山峦
ext.ext_en: ...an impressive range of hills topped with trees.

defs.def_en: A range of mountains or hills is a line of them.
A range is a large area of open land, especially land in the United States where cattle are kept.

ext.ext_cn: 它使我想起了在靶场练习射击准备去越南服役的日子。
ext.ext_en: It reminds me of my days on the rifle range preparing for duty in Vietnam.

ext.ext_cn: 陆军射击场
ext.ext_en: ...an Army firing range.

defs.def_en: A rifle range or a shooting range is a place where people can practise shooting at targets.
A range or kitchen range is an old-fashioned metal cooker.
A range or kitchen range is a large metal device for cooking food using gas or electricity. A range consists of a grill, an oven, and some gas or electric rings.

defs.def_cn: 在可及的范围内/在可及的范围外

ext.ext_cn: 车从脏水里驶过，溅了周围所有人一身水。
ext.ext_en: Cars are driven through the mess, splashing everyone in range.

ext.ext_cn: 在敌人导弹射程内的基地
ext.ext_en: ...a base within range of enemy missiles...

defs.def_en: If something is in range or within range, it is near enough to be reached or detected. If it is out of range, it is too far away to be reached or detected.

defs.def_cn: 接近地/靠近地/以…的距离

ext.ext_cn: 他在近距离内被人用枪击中头部。
ext.ext_en: He was shot in the head at close range...

ext.ext_cn: 麦克科伊斯特门前近距离将球攻入。
ext.ext_en: McCoist knocked the ball in from close range.

defs.def_en: If you see or hit something at close range or from close range, you are very close to it when you see it or hit it. If you do something at a range of half a mile, for example, you are half a mile away from it when you do it.

ext.ext_cn: 铺满碎树皮的小路有助于制造林间小道的印象。
ext.ext_en: Paths of bark chippings will help to give the impression of a woodland walkway.

defs.def_en: Wood chippings or stone chippings are small pieces of wood or stone which are used, for example, to cover surfaces such as paths or roads.

ext.ext_cn: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳并从土壤中汲取水分。
ext.ext_en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air and moisture from the soil...

ext.ext_cn: 精制糖迅速吸收进血液中。
ext.ext_en: Refined sugars are absorbed into the bloodstream very quickly.

defs.def_en: If something absorbs a liquid, gas, or other substance, it soaks it up or takes it in.

ext.ext_cn: 家用取暖器吸收电流能量，再以热量的形式释放出来。
ext.ext_en: A household radiator absorbs energy in the form of electric current and releases it in the form of heat.

defs.def_en: If something absorbs light, heat, or another form of energy, it takes it in.

ext.ext_cn: 殖民部被并入了外交部。
ext.ext_en: The Colonial Office was absorbed into the Foreign Office.

ext.ext_cn: 能够吸纳数千移民的经济实体
