Pinball is a game in which a player presses two buttons on each side of a pinball machine in order to hit a small ball to the top of the machine. The aim of the game is to prevent the ball reaching the bottom of the machine by pressing the buttons.

defs.def_cn: 犹太教的；与犹太教有关的
defs.def_en: Judaic means belonging or relating to Judaism.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可战胜的;所向披靡的

ext.ext_cn: 索托马约尔状态好时几乎无人可敌。
ext.ext_en: When Sotomayor is on form he is virtually invincible.

defs.def_en: If you describe an army or sports team as invincible, you believe that they cannot be defeated.

defs.def_cn: (信念、态度)不可动摇的，不可改变的

ext.ext_cn: 他同时也对大蒜的医学功效深信不疑。
ext.ext_en: He also had an invincible faith in the medicinal virtues of garlic.

defs.def_en: If someone has an invincible belief or attitude, it cannot be changed.

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲 3 年前去世的时候，我从写作中找到了安慰。
ext.ext_en: I found solace in writing when my father died three years ago...

ext.ext_cn: 亨利往往借酒消愁。
ext.ext_en: Henry was inclined to seek solace in drink.

defs.def_en: Solace is a feeling of comfort that makes you feel less sad.

ext.ext_cn: 她觉得马西娅的陪伴是莫大的安慰。
ext.ext_en: She found the companionship of Marcia a solace.

defs.def_en: If something is a solace to you, it makes you feel less sad.

defs.def_cn: 四肢摊开地坐着(或躺着)的

ext.ext_cn: 人们懒散地躺在食堂里搭起的临时床铺上。
ext.ext_en: People are sprawled on makeshift beds in the cafeteria...

ext.ext_cn: 罗兰多趴着睡着了，四肢摊开，打着呼噜。
ext.ext_en: Rolando lay sprawled on his stomach, snoring.

defs.def_en: If you are sprawled somewhere, you are sitting or lying with your legs and arms spread out in a careless way.

ext.ext_cn: 随着移居者南移,人口出现膨胀，至少是暂时性膨胀。
ext.ext_en: The human population swelled, at least temporarily, as migrants moved south...

ext.ext_cn: 到这个月底，参加该任务的人员规模将有望增至 280 人。
ext.ext_en: By the end of this month the size of the mission is expected to swell to 280 people...

defs.def_en: If the amount or size of something swells or if something swells it, it becomes larger than it was before.

ext.ext_cn: 你夜里脚踝肿吗？
ext.ext_en: Do your ankles swell at night?...

ext.ext_cn: 四肢肿得不得了。
ext.ext_en: The limbs swell to an enormous size.

defs.def_en: If something such as a part of your body swells, it becomes larger and rounder than normal.

ext.ext_cn: 她能看出她的两个儿子充满了骄傲。
ext.ext_en: She could see her two sons swell with pride.

defs.def_en: If you swell with a feeling, you are suddenly full of that feeling.

ext.ext_cn: 不知从何处响起天籁般的音乐。
ext.ext_en: Heavenly music swelled from nowhere.

defs.def_en: If sounds swell, they get louder.

ext.ext_cn: 我们随着涨潮的浪涌轻轻地起伏。
ext.ext_en: We bobbed gently up and down on the swell of the incoming tide.

defs.def_en: A swell is the regular movement of waves up and down in the open sea.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极好的;了不起的;非常棒的

ext.ext_cn: 我过得极为开心。
ext.ext_en: I've had a swell time.

defs.def_en: You can describe something as swell if you think it is really nice.
A greetings card is a folded card with a picture on the front and greetings inside that you give or send to someone, for example on their birthday.

ext.ext_cn: 这个花园用女贞树篱圈了起来。
ext.ext_en: The garden was enclosed by a privet hedge.

defs.def_en: Privet is a type of bush with small leaves that stay green all year round. It is often grown in gardens to form hedges.

ext.ext_cn: 他们拖着脚步沿着草皮慢慢地走向悬崖边。
ext.ext_en: They shuffled slowly down the turf towards the cliff's edge.

defs.def_en: Turf is short, thick, even grass.

ext.ext_cn: 抬草皮时小心点——它们还能在别处重新利用。
ext.ext_en: Lift the turfs carefully — they can be reused elsewhere.

defs.def_en: A turf is a small rectangular piece of grass which you lay on the ground in order to make a lawn.

ext.ext_cn: 巴黎是他们的地盘：那里熟悉的大街、剧院、住宅和公园。
ext.ext_en: Their turf was Paris: its streets, theaters, homes, and parks...

ext.ext_cn: 那家联合银行在它自己的地盘上就无可匹敌了。
ext.ext_en: On its home turf, the combined bank would be unrivalled.

defs.def_en: Someone's turf is the area which is most familiar to them or where they feel most confident.

defs.def_cn: 尼日利亚的;尼日利亚人的;尼日利亚文化的

ext.ext_cn: 尼日利亚政府
ext.ext_en: ...the Nigerian government.

ext.ext_cn: 尼日利亚口音
ext.ext_en: ...a Nigerian accent.

defs.def_en: Nigerian means belonging or relating to Nigeria, its people, or its culture.
A Nigerian is a Nigerian citizen, or a person of Nigerian origin.

ext.ext_cn: 我该怎么办？我能向谁求助？妈妈还没回来。
ext.ext_en: What would I do? Whom would I run to? Momma was still away...

ext.ext_cn: 如果参加聚会的时候有人喝醉了，可别向警察求助。
ext.ext_en: If you were at a party and somebody was getting high, you didn't go running to a cop.

defs.def_en: If you run to someone, you go to them for help or to tell them something.

ext.ext_cn: 完成的手稿占了双面都写满字的足足50页纸。
ext.ext_en: The finished manuscript ran to the best part of fifty double-sided pages.

defs.def_en: If something runs to a particular amount or size, it is that amount or size.

ext.ext_cn: 如果买不起香槟酒，就买汽酒好了。
ext.ext_en: If you can't run to champagne, buy sparkling wine.

defs.def_en: If you cannot run to a particular item, you cannot afford to buy it or pay for it.

ext.ext_cn: 我个人更喜欢现代化的大楼里舒适的高层公寓。
ext.ext_en: My own tastes run to a comfortable apartment, somewhere high in a modern building.

defs.def_en: If your tastes or interests run to a particular type of thing, that is the type of thing you like.
A skating rink is the same as a rink .

ext.ext_cn: 虐待马的马夫
ext.ext_en: ...a lad who mistreats a horse...

ext.ext_cn: 以前她受过男人的虐待。
ext.ext_en: She has been mistreated by men in the past.

defs.def_en: If someone mistreats a person or an animal, they treat them badly, especially by making them suffer physically.

ext.ext_cn: 他鼓动他的同胞们报仇雪恨。
ext.ext_en: He incited his fellow citizens to take their revenge...

ext.ext_cn: 该党同意不鼓动其支持者使用暴力。
ext.ext_en: The party agreed not to incite its supporters to violence...

defs.def_en: If someone incites people to behave in a violent or illegal way, they encourage people to behave in that way, usually by making them excited or angry.

defs.def_cn: 侥幸躲过(或逃过)一劫;死里逃生

ext.ext_cn: 本周早些时候两架客机在英格兰南部险些相撞，有关细节现已公布。
ext.ext_en: Details have been given of a near miss between two airliners over southern England earlier this week...

ext.ext_cn: 在袭击中有几次我们险些被击中，我想你已经注意到了。
ext.ext_en: We've had a few near misses in the raids, as I expect you've noticed.

defs.def_en: You can say that there is a near miss when something is nearly hit by another thing, for example by a vehicle or a bomb.

defs.def_cn: 功败垂成之事;功亏一篑之事

ext.ext_cn: 米兰队对欧洲冠军杯的成功卫冕以及在上个赛季意甲联赛中的差点夺冠
ext.ext_en: ...Milan's successful defence of the European Cup and near-miss in the Italian championship last season.

defs.def_en: A near miss is an attempt to do something which fails by a very small amount.

defs.def_cn: （用于构成形容词和名词）表示“多”，“众”

ext.ext_cn: 在他的描绘中精神是多中心的。
ext.ext_en: He portrays the psyche as poly- centric.

ext.ext_cn: 同时提供初级和二级医疗卫生服务的综合性诊所
ext.ext_en: ...polyclinics that integrate primary and secondary health care.

defs.def_en: Poly- is used to form adjectives and nouns which indicate that many things or types of something are involved in something. For example, a polysyllabic word contains many syllables.

ext.ext_cn: 他踮着脚尖走到门口，只穿着袜子没穿鞋。
ext.ext_en: He tiptoed to the door in his stockinged feet.

defs.def_en: If someone is in their stockinged feet, they are wearing socks, tights, or stockings, but no shoes.

ext.ext_cn: 一小袋好东西
ext.ext_en: ...a little bag of goodies...

ext.ext_cn: 英国的音乐之都伯明翰将展示其精美的艺术珍品。
ext.ext_en: Birmingham, the 'UK City of Music', will be parading its finest artistic goodies.

defs.def_en: You can refer to pleasant, exciting, or attractive things as goodies .

defs.def_cn: （电影、小说或真实生活中的）正面人物，好人

ext.ext_cn: 惊悚小说，一种依赖于好人和坏人之间矛盾冲突的文学类型
ext.ext_en: ...the thriller, a genre which depends on goodies and baddies...

ext.ext_cn: 在这次劳资纠纷中几乎没有绝对的好人与坏人。
ext.ext_en: There are few goodies and baddies in this industrial dispute.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the heroes or the morally good characters in a film or story as the goodies. You can also refer to the goodies in a situation in real life.

defs.def_cn: （尤为儿童用语，表示高兴或赞许）太好喽

ext.ext_cn: 哦，太好喽，我喜欢玩游戏。
ext.ext_en: Oh, goody, I like games.

defs.def_en: People, especially children, say goody in order to express their pleasure or approval of something.

ext.ext_cn: 新当选的总统紧随其后，乘坐一辆由6匹漂亮的灰马拉着的敞篷马车。
ext.ext_en: The President-elect followed in an open carriage drawn by six beautiful gray horses.

defs.def_en: A carriage is an old-fashioned vehicle, usually for a small number of passengers, which is pulled by horses.
A carriage is one of the separate, long sections of a train that carries passengers.
A carriage is the same as a baby carriage .

ext.ext_cn: 连运费在内,每升花费10.86英镑。
ext.ext_en: It costs £10.86 for one litre including carriage...

ext.ext_cn: 如果政府开始对公路运输征收碳税,那么水运就会变得更加具有吸引力。
ext.ext_en: If the Government introduces a carbon tax on road haulage, then carriage by water will become more attractive.

defs.def_en: Carriage is the cost or action of transporting or delivering goods.

ext.ext_cn: 她长腿细臀，身姿笔直。
ext.ext_en: Her legs were long and fine, her hips slender, her carriage erect.

defs.def_en: Your carriage is the way you hold your body and head when you are walking, standing, or sitting.

ext.ext_cn: 个体户的资金通常来自个人积蓄或者来自亲朋好友。
ext.ext_en: Finance for a sole trader usually comes from the individual's own savings or from family and friends.

defs.def_en: A sole trader is a person who owns their own business and does not have a partner or any shareholders.

ext.ext_cn: 根本没有法规来确保香烟不含有毒物质。
ext.ext_en: There's absolutely no regulation of cigarettes to make sure that they don't include poisonous substances...

ext.ext_cn: 引起该问题的物质来自大麦。
ext.ext_en: The substance that's causing the problem comes from the barley.

defs.def_en: A substance is a solid, powder, liquid, or gas with particular properties.

ext.ext_cn: 是否已经取得了任何实质性进展还是个问题。
ext.ext_en: It's questionable whether anything of substance has been achieved...

ext.ext_cn: 只有在谈判涉及重大问题时叙利亚才会参加。
ext.ext_en: Syria will attend only if the negotiations deal with issues of substance.

defs.def_en: Substance is the quality of being important or significant.

defs.def_cn: 主旨;要点;实质;基本内容

ext.ext_cn: 他讨论的要点实际上根本不重要。
ext.ext_en: The substance of his discussions doesn't really matter.

defs.def_en: The substance of what someone says or writes is the main thing that they are trying to say.

ext.ext_cn: 这些指控都毫无根据。
ext.ext_en: There is no substance in any of these allegations.

defs.def_en: If you say that something has no substance, you mean that it is not true.

defs.def_cn: 财力雄厚的;有权有势的；有影响力的

ext.ext_cn: 有钱有势的成熟男人
ext.ext_en: ...mature men of substance.

defs.def_en: A person of substance has a lot of money, power, or influence.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的人均收入居世界之首。
ext.ext_en: They have the world's largest per capita income...

ext.ext_cn: 在过去两年里，人均酒品消费量降低了。
ext.ext_en: The per capita consumption of alcohol has dropped over the past two years.

defs.def_en: The per capita amount of something is the total amount of it in a country or area divided by the number of people in that country or area.

ext.ext_cn: 他的业余爱好是自由落体式跳伞。
ext.ext_en: His hobby is freefall parachuting.

defs.def_en: Parachuting is the activity or sport of jumping from an aircraft with a parachute.

defs.def_cn: 编纂;整理;将(法规等)整理成典

ext.ext_cn: 最新的协议草案把专家小组的决定加以整理，形成了条文。
ext.ext_en: The latest draft of the agreement codifies the panel's decision.

defs.def_en: If you codify a set of rules, you define them or present them in a clear and ordered way.

defs.def_cn: 支付(某人已出的费用或开支)

ext.ext_cn: 政府已承诺拨款数十亿支付战争的开支。
ext.ext_en: The government has committed billions toward defraying the costs of the war.

defs.def_en: If you defray someone's costs or expenses, you give them money which represents the amount that they have spent, for example while they have been doing something for you or acting on your behalf.

ext.ext_cn: 特罗尔专用的、个性化的行李箱是按照我们自己严格的规格要求用耐用聚氯乙烯/尼龙材料定制的。
ext.ext_en: Troll's exclusive, personalized luggage is made to our own exacting specifications in heavy-duty PVC/nylon...

ext.ext_cn: 法规将要求英国的汽油公司必须达到欧盟对汽油的规格要求。
ext.ext_en: Legislation will require UK petrol companies to meet an EU specification for petrol.

defs.def_en: A specification is a requirement which is clearly stated, for example about the necessary features in the design of something.

ext.ext_cn: 脊神经
ext.ext_en: ...spinal nerves.

ext.ext_cn: 在一些神经纤维被割断的病例中
ext.ext_en: ...in cases where the nerve fibres are severed.

defs.def_en: Nerves are long thin fibres that transmit messages between your brain and other parts of your body.

ext.ext_cn: 吉尔的神经绷紧到了极点。
ext.ext_en: Jill's nerves are stretched to breaking point...

ext.ext_cn: 我很有耐心，可如果我的承受力到了极限，我就撑不住了。
ext.ext_en: I can be very patient, and then I can burst if my nerves are worn out.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's nerves, you mean their ability to cope with problems such as stress, worry, and danger.

ext.ext_cn: 我只是打得很糟，不是紧张造成的。
ext.ext_en: I just played badly. It wasn't nerves.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's feelings of anxiety or tension as nerves .

ext.ext_cn: 虽说白兰地呛了他一下，却让他恢复了勇气。
ext.ext_en: The brandy made him choke, but it restored his nerve...

ext.ext_cn: 他从没有足够的胆量来见我。
ext.ext_en: He never got up enough nerve to meet me.

defs.def_en: Nerve is the courage that you need in order to do something difficult or dangerous.

defs.def_cn: 使鼓起勇气;使振作精神

ext.ext_cn: 我鼓足勇气去面对痛苦。
ext.ext_en: I nerved myself to face the pain.

defs.def_en: If you nerve yourself to do something difficult or frightening, you prepare yourself for it by trying to be brave.

ext.ext_cn: 近来他没有干任何坏事，这让我心神不定起来。
ext.ext_en: Lately he's  not done a bloody thing and it's getting on my nerves.

defs.def_en: If someone or something gets on your nerves, they annoy or irritate you.

ext.ext_cn: 他们竟敢对我们的行为表示不满。
ext.ext_en: They've got a nerve, complaining about our behaviour...

ext.ext_cn: 他竟敢要求我证明我自己的身份。
ext.ext_en: He had the nerve to ask me to prove who I was.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a nerve or has the nerve to do something, you are criticizing them for doing something which you feel they had no right to do.

ext.ext_cn: 他镇定自若，在1号场地惊心动魄的5盘3胜对决中击败了安德鲁·阿加西。
ext.ext_en: He held his nerve to beat Andre Agassi in a five-set thriller on Court One...

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在需要保持镇静。
ext.ext_en: We need to keep our nerve now.

defs.def_en: If you hold your nerve or keep your nerve, you remain calm and determined in a difficult situation.

defs.def_cn: 紧张不安地度日;神经紧张

ext.ext_cn: 艾琳是3个孩子的母亲，已有相当一段时间总是感到紧张不安。
ext.ext_en: Eileen, mother of three, had been living on her nerves for some considerable time.

defs.def_en: If someone is living on their nerves, they are continually worried and anxious about the situation that they are in.

defs.def_cn: 失去勇气;变得胆怯;惊慌失措

ext.ext_cn: 放炸弹的人没了胆子，逃之夭夭。
ext.ext_en: The bomber had lost his nerve and fled.

defs.def_en: If you lose your nerve, you suddenly panic and become too afraid to do something that you were about to do.

ext.ext_cn: 阿利斯泰尔看到亨利向后缩了一下，好像那些话触到了他的痛处。
ext.ext_en: Alistair saw Henry shrink, as if the words had touched a nerve...

ext.ext_cn: 提到约翰就真的让人心痛。
ext.ext_en: The mere mention of John had touched a very raw nerve indeed.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have touched a nerve or touched a raw nerve, you mean that you have accidentally upset someone by talking about something that they feel strongly about or are very sensitive about.
A time bomb is a bomb with a mechanism that causes it to explode at a particular time.

ext.ext_cn: 这个议案是政坛的一颗定时炸弹，足以使现任政府输掉下次竞选。
ext.ext_en: This proposal is a political time bomb that could cost the government the next election...

ext.ext_cn: 失业问题在工业化国家日益严重，演化成了社会上的一颗定时炸弹。
ext.ext_en: Unemployment is building up into a social time bomb across the industrialised world.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a time bomb, you mean that it is likely to have a serious effect on a person or situation at a later date, especially if you think it will cause a lot of damage.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 当他又开口说话时，语气带有了更多的安抚性。
ext.ext_en: When next he spoke he was more placatory...

ext.ext_cn: 他作抚慰状地举起一只手说：“好吧，我们看看我们能做什么。”
ext.ext_en: He raised a placatory hand. 'All right, we'll see what we can do.'

defs.def_en: A placatory remark or action is intended to make someone stop feeling angry.

ext.ext_cn: 她请我们去她家吃晚餐。
ext.ext_en: She invited us to her house for dinner...

ext.ext_cn: 你留下来一起吃饭好吗？
ext.ext_en: Would you like to stay and have dinner?...

defs.def_en: See also:TV dinner;Dinner is the main meal of the day, usually served in the early part of the evening.
Any meal you eat in the middle of the day can be referred to as dinner .  →see usage note at:meal

ext.ext_cn: 一系列的正式午餐和晚宴
ext.ext_en: ...a series of official lunches and dinners...

ext.ext_cn: 职业板球运动员协会在伦敦举办了自己的年度宴会。
ext.ext_en: The Professional Cricketers' Association held its annual dinner in London.

defs.def_en: A dinner is a formal social event at which a meal is served. It is held in the evening.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 毫无特色的;毫无吸引力的

ext.ext_cn: 欧罗巴大楼是巴斯大道沿路那些成百上千幢毫无特色的建筑之一。
ext.ext_en: Europa House is one of those hundreds of nondescript buildings along the Bath Road.

ext.ext_cn: 年龄不详、相貌平庸的女士
ext.ext_en: ...a nondescript woman of uncertain age...

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as nondescript, you mean that their appearance is rather dull, and not at all interesting or attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的女儿乔安娜在当地的一所学院念商科。
ext.ext_en: Their daughter Joanna is doing business studies at a local college...

ext.ext_cn: 斯蒂芬妮今年夏天离开艺术学院后开始从事珠宝制作。
ext.ext_en: Stephanie took up making jewellery after leaving art college this summer...

defs.def_en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school.

ext.ext_cn: 他上的是牛津大学的贝利奥尔学院。
ext.ext_en: He was educated at Balliol College, Oxford.

defs.def_en: A college is one of the institutions which some British universities are divided into.

ext.ext_cn: 佛罗里达大学法学院的一位教授
ext.ext_en: ...a professor at the University of Florida College of Law.

defs.def_en: At some universities in the United States, colleges are divisions which offer degrees in particular subjects.

defs.def_cn: (用于英国某些收费中学的名称中)中学，公学

ext.ext_cn: 1854年，切尔滕纳姆女子中学成为第一所女子公学。
ext.ext_en: In 1854, Cheltenham Ladies' College became the first girls' public school.

defs.def_en: College is used in Britain in the names of some secondary schools which charge fees.

ext.ext_cn: 他是皇家内科医师协会的成员。
ext.ext_en: He is a member of the Royal College of Physicians...

ext.ext_cn: 一群来自世界各地的主管在一起工作。
ext.ext_en: There is a college of international supervisors working together.

defs.def_en: A college of a particular kind is an organized group of people who have special duties and powers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 时至今日，我的希伯来语仍很流利，但阿拉伯语却糟透了。
ext.ext_en: I remain to this day fluent in Hebrew, while my Arabic is atrocious...

ext.ext_cn: 这里的食物难以下咽。
ext.ext_en: The food here is atrocious.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as atrocious, you are emphasizing that its quality is very bad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行为、行动）残暴的，凶恶的，残忍的

ext.ext_cn: 法官说他对妇女犯下了滔天罪行。
ext.ext_en: The judge said he had committed atrocious crimes against women...

ext.ext_cn: 俘获者对待囚犯异常凶残，违反一切国际法律。
ext.ext_en: The treatment of the prisoners by their captors is atrocious and breaks all international laws.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour or their actions as atrocious, you mean that it is unacceptable because it is extremely violent or cruel.

ext.ext_cn: 道路封锁，天气恶劣：山区雪花纷飞，其他地方大雨倾盆
ext.ext_en: ...closed roads and atrocious weather: snow in the mountains, torrential rain elsewhere.

defs.def_en: If you say that weather conditions are atrocious, you mean they are very bad, for example that it is extremely cold, wet, or windy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 玛格丽特一直是个早熟的孩子。
ext.ext_en: Margaret was always a precocious child...

ext.ext_cn: 她14岁时就作为一名网球神童闯入了世界网坛。
ext.ext_en: She burst on to the world tennis scene as a precocious 14-year old...

defs.def_en: A precocious child is very clever, mature, or good at something, often in a way that you usually only expect to find in an adult.
A consonant is a sound such as 'p', 'f', 'n', or 't' which you pronounce by stopping the air flowing freely through your mouth.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我发现他们的工作与这种思维方式非常一致。
ext.ext_en: I found their work very much consonant with this way of thinking.

defs.def_en: Something that is consonant with something else fits or agrees with it very well.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (语言或动作）令人放心的，令人欣慰的

ext.ext_cn: 听到约翰熟悉的声音让人放心。
ext.ext_en: It was reassuring to hear John's familiar voice...

ext.ext_cn: 她告诉了我一些令我欣慰的消息。
ext.ext_en: She gave me some reassuring news.

defs.def_en: If you find some-one's words or actions reassuring, they make you feel less worried about something.

ext.ext_cn: 这些排列可以增加到无穷大。
ext.ext_en: These permutations multiply towards infinity...

ext.ext_cn: 任何两个数字之间都存在无穷多的数字。
ext.ext_en: There is always an infinity of numbers between any two numbers.

defs.def_en: Infinity is a number that is larger than any other number and can never be given an exact value.

ext.ext_cn: 没有星星的夜晚，黑暗无边无际
ext.ext_en: ...the darkness of a starless night stretching to infinity.

defs.def_en: Infinity is a point that is further away than any other point and can never be reached.

ext.ext_cn: 他发下守贞禁欲的誓言。
ext.ext_en: He took a vow of chastity and celibacy.

defs.def_en: Chastity is the state of not having sex with anyone, or of only having sex with your husband or wife.
See also:phrasal verb;A verb is a word such as 'sing', 'feel', or 'die' which is used with a subject to say what someone or something does or what happens to them, or to give information about them.
A guinea fowl is a large grey African bird that is often eaten as food.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在放纵的生活中将遗产挥霍一空的贵族
ext.ext_en: ...aristocrats who wasted their inheritances in riotous living.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a riotous lifestyle, you mean that they frequently behave in a excessive and uncontrolled way, for example by eating or drinking too much.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为或事件)狂欢的，喧闹的，放纵的

ext.ext_cn: 宴会常常会因为一些非常诙谐的讲话而气氛活跃，热闹非凡。
ext.ext_en: The dinner was often a riotous affair enlivened by superbly witty speeches.

ext.ext_cn: 欢闹的布吉乐钢琴演奏会
ext.ext_en: ...a riotous exhibition of boogie-woogie piano playing.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone's behaviour or an event as riotous when it is noisy and lively in a rather wild way.

defs.def_cn: 色彩丰富的;五颜六色的;装饰华丽的

ext.ext_cn: 各种各样花哨而华丽的服装
ext.ext_en: ...a riotous collection of gaudy and glamorous dresses.

defs.def_en: You can describe things as riotous when they are very colourful or decorative rather than plain or simple.

ext.ext_cn: 省略菜谱中放盐这一步。
ext.ext_en: Omit the salt in this recipe...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在上周的文章里漏掉了戴维·潘尼克的名字，特此向他致歉。
ext.ext_en: Our apologies to David Pannick for omitting his name from last week's article.

defs.def_en: If you omit something, you do not include it in an activity or piece of work, deliberately or accidentally.

ext.ext_cn: 他的新女友未把自己已婚的事实告诉他。
ext.ext_en: His new girlfriend had omitted to tell him she was married.

defs.def_en: If you omit to do something, you do not do it.

defs.def_cn: 短而卷曲的毛发;细毛;绒毛

ext.ext_cn: 他的下巴上长着细细的胡须。
ext.ext_en: He had a baby fuzz round his jaw.

defs.def_en: Fuzz is a mass of short, curly hairs.
The fuzz are the police.

ext.ext_cn: 他的上一本书《必需品》尽在重复些老掉牙的内容。
ext.ext_en: His last book, 'Needful Things', was a retread of tired material.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a book, film, or song as a retread, you mean that it contains ideas or elements that have been used before, and that it is not very interesting or original.
A retread is an old tyre which has been given a new surface or tread and can be used again.
A labor union is an organization that represents the rights and interests of workers to their employers, for example in order to improve working conditions or wages.

defs.def_cn: 割破;在…上留下深长的切口

ext.ext_cn: 若再晚两分钟割腕的他就会因失血过多而死。
ext.ext_en: He came within two minutes of bleeding to death after slashing his wrists.

ext.ext_cn: 在肉上切出深深的口子，再把辣酱塞进切口中。
ext.ext_en: Make deep slashes in the meat and push in the spice paste.

defs.def_en: If you slash something, you make a long, deep cut in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他仔细地瞄准她劈了过去。
ext.ext_en: He slashed at her, aiming carefully.

defs.def_en: If you slash at a person or thing, you quickly hit at them with something such as a knife.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天被指控要价太高之后，汽车生产商可能会被迫大幅度降价。
ext.ext_en: Car makers could be forced to slash prices after being accused of overcharging yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 所有人都同意必须大幅度削减补贴。
ext.ext_en: Everyone agrees that subsidies have to be slashed.

defs.def_en: To slash something such as costs or jobs means to reduce them by a large amount.
You say slash to refer to a sloping line that separates letters, words, or numbers. For example, if you are giving the number 340/2/K you say 'Three four zero, slash two, slash K.'

ext.ext_cn: 他们看见一道强光和一个巨大的火球冲向数百英尺的高空。
ext.ext_en: They saw a big flash and a huge ball of fire reaching hundreds of feet into the sky...

ext.ext_cn: 许多学生被浓烟和大火困在了较高的一层上。
ext.ext_en: Many students were trapped by smoke and fire on an upper floor.

defs.def_en: Fire is the hot, bright flames produced by things that are burning.

ext.ext_cn: 87 人在乐土社交俱乐部的火灾中丧生。
ext.ext_en: 87 people died in a fire at the Happy Land Social Club...

ext.ext_cn: 今晚一场森林大火正席卷缅因州北部的部分地区。
ext.ext_en: A forest fire is sweeping across portions of north Maine this evening...

defs.def_en: Fire or a fire is an occurrence of uncontrolled burning which destroys buildings, forests, or other things.

ext.ext_cn: 壁炉内燃着火。
ext.ext_en: There was a fire in the grate...

ext.ext_cn: 杀人后，他镇定地点起火销毁罪证。
ext.ext_en: After the killing, he calmly lit a fire to destroy evidence.

defs.def_en: A fire is a burning pile of wood, coal, or other fuel that you make, for example to use for heat, light, or cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 燃气取暖器还在烧着。
ext.ext_en: The gas fire was still alight...

ext.ext_cn: 她打开了一片电暖器。
ext.ext_en: She switched on one bar of the electric fire.

defs.def_en: A fire is a device that uses electricity or gas to give out heat and warm a room.

ext.ext_cn: 陶罐在这一混合料中浸过之后就拿去烧制。
ext.ext_en: After the pot is dipped in this mixture, it is fired...

ext.ext_cn: 我见过制陶工人捏塑、烧制碗碟花瓶，并在上面涂绘各种宗教图案。
ext.ext_en: I have watched the potters mold, fire and paint their bowls, plates and vases with sacred designs.

defs.def_en: When a pot or clay object is fired, it is heated at a high temperature in a special oven, as part of the process of making it.

ext.ext_cn: 点着引擎后我们就开走了。
ext.ext_en: The engine fired and we moved off.

defs.def_en: When the engine of a motor vehicle fires, an electrical spark is produced which causes the fuel to burn and the engine to work.

ext.ext_cn: 这些发动机烧煤，并且需要加水以不断产生蒸汽。
ext.ext_en: The engines were fired with coal and needed water to keep the steam up.

defs.def_en: If a machine is fired with a particular fuel, it operates by means of that fuel.

defs.def_cn: 激起;唤起;使充满激情;激发(想象力)

ext.ext_cn: 能够激发整整一代人想象力的潜能
ext.ext_en: ...the potential to fire the imagination of an entire generation...

ext.ext_cn: 是艾伦为这场较量注入了激情。
ext.ext_en: It was Allen who fired this rivalry with real passion...

defs.def_en: If you fire someone with enthusiasm, you make them feel very enthusiastic. If you fire someone's imagination, you make them feel interested and excited.

ext.ext_cn: 我去听了他的讲话，结果留下了非常深刻的印象。他看上去充满了激情。
ext.ext_en: I went to hear him speak and was very impressed. He seemed so full of fire...

ext.ext_cn: 繁忙的日程似乎有时让他精力不济。
ext.ext_en: His punishing schedule seemed to dim his fire at times.

defs.def_en: You can use fire to refer in an approving way to someone's energy and enthusiasm.

ext.ext_cn: 我家失了火，所有的东西都烧毁了。
ext.ext_en: My home catches fire and everything is destroyed...

ext.ext_cn: 飞机起飞后不久就着火了。
ext.ext_en: The aircraft caught fire soon after take-off.

defs.def_en: If an object or substance catches fire, it starts burning.

ext.ext_cn: 这部剧直到阿申巴赫堕入情网后才真正开始精彩起来。
ext.ext_en: The play only really catches fire once Aschenbach falls in love.

defs.def_en: If a situation or event catches fire, it begins to be exciting and successful.

defs.def_cn: 以火攻火;以毒攻毒;以其人之道还治其人之身

ext.ext_cn: 他们打击犯罪的唯一方法就是以牙还牙。
ext.ext_en: The only way they can deal with crime is to fight fire with fire.

defs.def_en: If you fight fire with fire, you deal with people attacking or threatening you by using similar methods to the ones that they are using.

ext.ext_cn: 罗科不像他父亲那样充满激情。
ext.ext_en: Rocco does not have the same fire in his belly as his father.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has fire in their belly, you are expressing approval of them because they are energetic, enthusiastic, and have very strong feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 船长发无线电说船着火了。
ext.ext_en: The captain radioed that the ship was on fire.

defs.def_en: If something is on fire, it is burning and being damaged or destroyed by an uncontrolled fire.

defs.def_cn: 热情似火;激动万分;激情澎湃

ext.ext_cn: 看到这一令人叹为观止的景象，他激动万分。
ext.ext_en: He was on fire with this marvelous sight.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is on fire, you mean they are very enthusiastic, excited, or passionate about something.

ext.ext_cn: 舒尔特警告政府和业界领袖说，哪怕只是动动大规模裁员念头的人都是在玩火。
ext.ext_en: Schulte warned government and industrial leaders that those who even venture to think about mass layoffs are playing with fire.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is playing with fire, you mean that they are doing something dangerous that may result in great harm for them and cause many problems.

ext.ext_cn: 他们纵火焚烧了停在那幢大楼外的车辆。
ext.ext_en: They set fire to vehicles outside that building...

ext.ext_cn: 闪电燃着了几栋大楼。
ext.ext_en: Lightning set several buildings on fire.

defs.def_en: If you set fire to something or if you set it on fire, you start it burning in order to damage or destroy it.

ext.ext_cn: 戴上头盔，发动引擎，开上乡村干道。
ext.ext_en: Put on a helmet, fire up your engine and head out on the open road.

defs.def_en: If you fire up a machine, you switch it on.

ext.ext_cn: 总统知道自己的任务就是唤起代表的热情。
ext.ext_en: The president knows his task is to fire up the delegates.

defs.def_en: If you fire someone up, you make them feel very enthusiastic or motivated.

ext.ext_cn: 士兵发射橡皮子弹驱散人群时有7个人受了伤。
ext.ext_en: Seven people were wounded when soldiers fired rubber bullets to disperse crowds...

ext.ext_cn: 发射高爆弹的新型大炮在战场上得到了使用。
ext.ext_en: New guns firing high explosive shells were incorporated into the battlefield...

defs.def_en: If someone fires a gun or a bullet, or if they fire, a bullet is sent from a gun that they are using.

ext.ext_cn: 他的车遭到自动武器火力的扫射。
ext.ext_en: His car was raked with fire from automatic weapons...

ext.ext_cn: 据报道，这两人在警方突击搜查时发生的交火中被打死。
ext.ext_en: The two were reportedly killed in an exchange of fire during a police raid.

defs.def_en: You can use fire to refer to the shots fired from a gun or guns.

ext.ext_cn: 他将箭射向林中的一片空地。
ext.ext_en: He fired an arrow into a clearing in the forest.

defs.def_en: If you fire an arrow, you send it from a bow.

ext.ext_cn: 100多名代表针对污染问题向他们发起连珠炮似的提问。
ext.ext_en: They were bombarded by more than 100 representatives firing questions on pollution.

defs.def_en: If you fire questions at someone, you ask them a lot of questions very quickly, one after another.

defs.def_cn: 猛烈的批评(或抨击、指责)

ext.ext_cn: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。
ext.ext_en: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.

defs.def_en: You can use fire to refer to someone's strong criticisms of something.

ext.ext_cn: 其他地方的人群吸引了军队的火力。
ext.ext_en: Crowds elsewhere drew fire from troops.

defs.def_en: If you draw fire from someone, you cause them to shoot at you, for example because they think that you are threatening them.

ext.ext_cn: 委员会最近因为介入该起争端而遭到批评。
ext.ext_en: The council recently drew fire for its intervention in the dispute...

ext.ext_cn: 该活动正受到禁烟倡导者的攻击。
ext.ext_en: The campaign is drawing fire from anti-smoking advocates.

defs.def_en: If you draw fire for something that you have done, you cause people to criticize you or attack you because of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我的建议就是，先缓一缓，等上一两分钟再试一次。
ext.ext_en: All I can suggest is that you just hang fire and wait a minute or two and try again...

ext.ext_cn: 上周，银行和建屋互助会推迟了就利率问题作出决定。
ext.ext_en: Last week, banks and building societies were hanging fire on interest rates.

defs.def_en: If you hang fire, you delay making a decision about something.

defs.def_cn: 停止射击;等待射击开始

ext.ext_cn: 德弗罗命令士兵等船靠近了再开火。
ext.ext_en: Devereux ordered his men to hold their fire until the ships got closer.

defs.def_en: If someone holds their fire or holds fire, they stop shooting or they wait before they start shooting.

ext.ext_cn: 观察家认为英格兰银行会推迟到更加接近预算案出台时再采取措施。
ext.ext_en: Observers reckon the Bank of England will hold fire until nearer the Budget.

defs.def_en: If you hold fire in a situation, you delay before taking action.

ext.ext_cn: 他兴高采烈地将蠢到撞上他枪口的坏家伙全都干掉。
ext.ext_en: He cheerfully blows away any bad guy stupid enough to get in his line of fire...

ext.ext_cn: 父子俩被那些掳走他们的人推到了枪口前。
ext.ext_en: The man and his son had been pushed into the line of fire by their captors.

defs.def_en: If you are in the line of fire, you are in a position where someone is aiming their gun at you. If you move into their line of fire, you move into a position between them and the thing they were aiming at.

ext.ext_cn: 接着军队未作警示便向人群开了火。
ext.ext_en: Then without warning, the troops opened fire on the crowd.

defs.def_en: If you open fire on someone, you start shooting at them.

ext.ext_cn: 士兵们在遇袭后予以还击。
ext.ext_en: The soldiers returned fire after being attacked.

defs.def_en: If you return fire or you return someone's fire, you shoot back at someone who has shot at you.

defs.def_cn: 遭到射击;受到火力攻击

ext.ext_cn: 步兵团受到火力攻击时比利时人向后撤退。
ext.ext_en: The Belgians fell back as the infantry came under fire.

ext.ext_cn: 向那些现已连续数周遭受炮火袭击的城市提供援助
ext.ext_en: ...sending aid to cities which have been under fire for weeks now.

defs.def_en: If you come under fire or are under fire, someone starts shooting at you.

defs.def_cn: 遭到猛烈批评;受到强烈抨击

ext.ext_cn: 总统的计划先是遭到批评者的猛烈抨击，他们称开支削减力度不够。
ext.ext_en: The president's plan first came under fire from critics who said he hadn't included enough spending cuts.

defs.def_en: If you come under fire from someone or are under fire, they criticize you strongly.

ext.ext_cn: “我可以问你一个问题吗？”——“当然可以。尽管问吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'May I ask you something?' — 'Sure. Fire away.'

defs.def_en: If someone wants to say or ask something, you can say 'fire away' as a way of showing that you are ready for them to speak.

ext.ext_cn: 持枪歹徒朝天扫射了一排子弹。
ext.ext_en: A gunman fired off a volley of shots into the air...

ext.ext_cn: 塞西尔此时开始慌张起来,连忙发射了两枚遇险信号火箭。
ext.ext_en: Cecil now began to panic and fired off two distress rockets.

defs.def_en: If you fire off a shot, you send a bullet or other missile from a gun.

defs.def_cn: (常指作为一系列之一地迅速)发出(信件)，提出(问题),讲出(话语)

ext.ext_cn: 他立即给部里的同事发了一封怒气冲冲的信。
ext.ext_en: He immediately fired off an angry letter to his ministry colleagues...

ext.ext_cn: 普通警员愤怒地向政府提出了一连串增加工资、提高地位和改善条件的要求。
ext.ext_en: Ordinary officers fired off a string of angry demands to the government, to improve their pay, status, and conditions.

defs.def_en: If you fire off a letter, question, or remark, you send or say it very quickly, often as part of a series.

ext.ext_cn: 如果不是因为他在工作的其他方面做得如此之好，我可能就把他开除了。
ext.ext_en: If he hadn't been so good at the rest of his job, I probably would have fired him...

ext.ext_cn: 她收到一盒巧克力和一封信，信上说她被解雇了。
ext.ext_en: She was sent a box of chocolates along with a letter saying she was fired.

defs.def_en: If an employer fires you, they dismiss you from your job.
An off-roader is the same as an off-road vehicle .

defs.def_cn: （尤指儿童的）注意力缺乏症（常使用缩略形式ADD）
defs.def_en: Attention deficit disorder is a condition where people, especially children, are unable to concentrate on anything for very long and so find it difficult to learn and often behave in inappropriate ways. The abbreviation ADD is often used.

ext.ext_cn: 从该星系中心收到的无线电信号证实了黑洞理论。
ext.ext_en: Radio signals received from the galaxy's centre back up the black hole theory...

ext.ext_cn: 1989年内政部的一份犯罪报告印证了她的观点。
ext.ext_en: Her views are backed up by a 1989 Home Office report on crime.

defs.def_en: If someone or something backs up a statement, they supply evidence to suggest that it is true.

ext.ext_cn: 一定要定期备份文件。
ext.ext_en: Make a point of backing up your files at regular intervals...

ext.ext_cn: 当我因为忘了备份把完成的工作弄丢时，真是懊恼极了。
ext.ext_en: I get so annoyed when I lose work because I've forgotten to back it up.

defs.def_en: If you back up a computer file, you make a copy of it which you can use if the original file is damaged or lost.

ext.ext_cn: 秘书长说现在必须将宣言付诸具体有效的行动。
ext.ext_en: The Secretary General says the declaration must now be backed up by concrete and effective actions...

ext.ext_en: ...the government's threadbare domestic policies.

ext.ext_en: Cells are being constantly renewed.

ext.ext_en: An investigation exonerated the school from any blame.

defs.def_en: If a court, report, or person in authority exonerates someone, they officially say or show that that person is not responsible for something wrong or unpleasant that has happened.

ext.ext_en: The company undertakes mechanical work on all types of cars...

defs.def_en: Mechanical means relating to machines and engines and the way they work.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人）精通机械的;擅长于机械原理的

ext.ext_en: He was a very mechanical person, who knew a lot about sound...

ext.ext_en: I'm not mechanical like my father; I have to follow the instructions.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as mechanical, you mean they are naturally good at understanding how machines work.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行为）机械的，呆板的，不动脑筋的

ext.ext_cn: 这是真正的祈祷，不是机械的重复。
ext.ext_en: It is real prayer, and not mechanical repetition...

ext.ext_en: Many girls have a kind of mechanical attitude towards sex...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's action as mechanical, you mean that they do it automatically, without thinking about it.

defs.def_cn: （经济或公司）变得更加强大，变得更加成功

ext.ext_en: The most widely held view is the market will continue to power ahead...

ext.ext_cn: 这一切为乐购的进一步发展扫清了障碍。
ext.ext_en: It all leaves the way clear for Tesco to power ahead.

defs.def_en: If an economy or company powers ahead, it becomes stronger and more successful.

ext.ext_cn: 感染的可能性极小。
ext.ext_en: The likelihood of infection is minimal...

ext.ext_cn: 这种事情发生的可能性不大。
ext.ext_en: There didn't seem much likelihood of it happening...

defs.def_en: The likelihood of something happening is how likely it is to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 但如果人们确切知道自己的钱会用于做善事，他们就可能更愿意掏腰包。
ext.ext_en: But the likelihood is that people would be willing to pay if they were certain that their money was going to a good cause...

ext.ext_cn: 众所周知，那不仅可能发生，而且是很可能发生。
ext.ext_en: That, as we all know, is not only a possibility but a likelihood.

defs.def_en: If something is a likelihood, it is likely to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 十有八九，委员会将不得不与每一位曾和托马斯共过事的女性面谈。
ext.ext_en: In all likelihood, the committee will have to interview every woman who's worked with Thomas.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen in all likelihood, you mean that it will probably happen.

ext.ext_en: The raiders escaped with cash and jewellery.

defs.def_en: Raiders are people who enter a building or place by force in order to steal something.

ext.ext_cn: 突击队员继续执行着他们的任务——搜寻并摧毁美国空军、海军力量。
ext.ext_en: The raiders continued on their mission — to seek out and destroy American air and sea forces.

defs.def_en: Raiders are soldiers who make a sudden armed attack on a place, with the aim of causing damage or taking something, rather than occupying any of the enemy's land.

ext.ext_cn: 她又友好地微笑了一下。
ext.ext_en: She smiled again in a friendly manner...

ext.ext_cn: 我是专业人士，必须以专业的态度行事。
ext.ext_en: I'm a professional and I have to conduct myself in a professional manner...

defs.def_en: The manner in which you do something is the way that you do it.

ext.ext_en: It's a satire somewhat in the  manner of Dickens...

ext.ext_en: We kissed each other's cheeks in the European manner.

defs.def_en: If something is done in the manner of something else, it is done in the style of that thing.

ext.ext_en: His manner was self-assured and brusque...

ext.ext_en: Her manner offstage, like her manner on, is somewhat surly.

defs.def_en: Someone's manner is the way in which they behave and talk when they are with other people, for example whether they are polite, confident, or bad-tempered.

ext.ext_cn: 他衣冠楚楚，待人接物无可挑剔。
ext.ext_en: He dressed well and had impeccable manners...

ext.ext_cn: 许多医生态度恶劣。
ext.ext_en: The manners of many doctors were appalling...

defs.def_en: If someone has good manners, they are polite and observe social customs. If someone has bad manners, they are impolite and do not observe these customs.

defs.def_cn: 各种各样的;形形色色的

ext.ext_en: Mr Winchester is impressively knowledgeable about all manner of things.

ext.ext_en: ...her pictures of all manner of wildlife.

defs.def_en: If you refer to all manner of objects or people, you are talking about objects or people of many different kinds.

defs.def_en: You say in a manner of speaking to indicate that what you have just said is true, but not absolutely or exactly true.

ext.ext_cn: 全班突然大笑起来。

ext.ext_en: Then the applause burst out...

defs.def_en: If someone bursts out laughing, crying, or making another noise, they suddenly start making that noise. You can also say that a noise bursts out .

ext.ext_en: 'I want to be just like you', she bursts out.

defs.def_en: If someone bursts out something, they say it suddenly and loudly.

ext.ext_en: Malaria is bursting out again all over the world...

ext.ext_en: Then war burst out.

defs.def_en: If a situation or problem bursts out, it suddenly appears.

ext.ext_en: ...dusky pink carpet.

ext.ext_en: It was the beginning of the end and Watson duly went on to win his fourth Open Golf Championship...

ext.ext_en: ...the plastic containers in which fish are stored and sold.

ext.ext_cn: 不锈钢或玻璃容器

ext.ext_cn: 如果不想闲躺在沙滩上，可以让导游带你走一走观光小径。
ext.ext_en: If you don't  want to lounge on the beach, you can go on a guided walk along the nature trail.

ext.ext_en: All that she would have to do was warm up the pudding...

defs.def_en: If you warm something up or if it warms up, it gets hotter.

ext.ext_en: In an hour the drivers will be warming up for the main event...

ext.ext_en: He waited for his car to warm up...

ext.ext_en: A writer is suing director Steven Spielberg for allegedly stealing his film idea...

ext.ext_en: His team solved the engineering problem by stealing an idea from nature.

ext.ext_en: They can steal away at night and join us...

ext.ext_cn: 勒罗伊偷偷穿过门厅走到客厅。
ext.ext_en: Leroy stole up the hall to the parlor.

defs.def_en: If someone steals somewhere, they move there quietly, in a secret way.

ext.ext_cn: 这瓶香槟酒只卖 3.50英镑，太便宜了。
ext.ext_en: At only £3.50, this champagne is a steal.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a steal, you mean that it is very good value.

ext.ext_cn: 月亮升起在墨似的夜空中。
ext.ext_en: The moon was rising in the inky sky.

ext.ext_cn: 漆黑的夜晚
ext.ext_en: ...the inky black of night.

defs.def_en: Inky means black or very dark blue.

ext.ext_cn: 沾了墨水的手指

defs.def_en: If something is inky, it is covered in ink.

defs.def_cn: 图雷特综合征，抽动秽语综合征(脑神经紊乱，患者身体肌肉不自主地抽动，有时咒骂、吐唾沫)

ext.ext_cn: 图雷特综合征患者
ext.ext_en: ...a Tourette's sufferer

defs.def_en: Tourette's syndrome is a brain disorder that causes the sufferer to make sudden uncontrolled movements and sometimes swear and spit.
A frog is a small creature with smooth skin, big eyes, and long back legs which it uses for jumping. Frogs usually live near water.

defs.def_cn: 法国佬(可能具冒犯意味)
defs.def_en: Frogs is sometimes used to refer to French people. This use could cause offence.

defs.def_cn: (以肉、蔬菜为原料做成的)炖菜，砂锅菜

ext.ext_cn: 一大份加满了香料、蔬菜和葡萄酒的牛腩煲
ext.ext_en: ...a huge beef casserole, full of herbs, vegetables and wine.

defs.def_en: A casserole is a dish made of meat and vegetables that have been cooked slowly in a liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 把所有切好的蔬菜放入砂锅。
ext.ext_en: Place all the chopped vegetables into a casserole dish.

ext.ext_cn: 耐火砂锅
ext.ext_en: ...a flameproof casserole.

defs.def_en: A casserole or a casserole dish is a large heavy container with a lid. You cook casseroles and other dishes in it.

ext.ext_cn: 要是炖鸡块的话，先去掉鸡皮。
ext.ext_en: If you casserole chicken pieces, take the skin off first.

ext.ext_cn: 鸡煲
ext.ext_en: ...casseroled chicken.

defs.def_en: If you casserole meat and vegetables, you cook them slowly in a liquid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 考虑不周的;不妥的;不明智的

ext.ext_cn: 他们对成本发表了一些很不妥当的评论。
ext.ext_en: He made some ill-considered remarks about the cost.

defs.def_en: If you describe something that someone says or does as ill-considered, you mean that it is not sensible or not appropriate.

defs.def_cn: (用在形容词前构成反义形容词）表示“非”，“无”

ext.ext_cn: 我对政治毫无兴趣。
ext.ext_en: I'm a completely apolitical man...

ext.ext_cn: 她是个真小人。
ext.ext_en: She was amoral but honest.

defs.def_en: A- is added to the beginning of some adjectives in order to form adjectives that describe someone or something that does not have the feature or quality indicated by the original word.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不招人喜欢的；不可爱的
defs.def_en: If someone is unlovable, they are not likely to be loved by anyone, because they do not have any attractive qualities.

ext.ext_cn: 一位大胆鲁莽的跳伞者今天从伦敦塔桥的桥顶跳了下去。
ext.ext_en: A daredevil parachutist jumped from the top of Tower Bridge today.

ext.ext_cn: 他年轻时一身蛮勇。
ext.ext_en: He was a daredevil when young.

defs.def_en: Daredevil people enjoy doing physically dangerous things.

ext.ext_cn: 表演中有很多惊险的特技。
ext.ext_en: The show's full of daredevil feats.

defs.def_en: You use daredevil to describe actions that are physically dangerous and require courage.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人疲倦的;使人身心疲惫的

ext.ext_cn: 她发现持续的对峙让人精疲力竭。
ext.ext_en: She finds the continual confrontation very wearing...

ext.ext_cn: 受欢迎也可能是件累人的事。
ext.ext_en: Being in demand can be rather wearing.

defs.def_en: If you say that a situation or activity is wearing, you mean that it requires a lot of energy and makes you feel mentally or physically tired.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 大规模的；大范围的；大型的

ext.ext_cn: 大规模的军事行动
ext.ext_en: ...a large scale military operation.

defs.def_en: A large-scale action or event happens over a very wide area or involves a lot of people or things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一张大比例尺的郡地图
ext.ext_en: ...a large-scale map of the county.

defs.def_en: A large-scale map or diagram represents a small area of land or a building or machine on a scale that is large enough for small details to be shown.

ext.ext_cn: 梅里克先生瘦瘦的，不怎么说话，戴着副眼镜。
ext.ext_en: Mr Merrick was a slim, quiet, bespectacled man.

defs.def_en: Someone who is bespectacled is wearing glasses.

ext.ext_cn: 他再次表演了他在连续剧中的情节。
ext.ext_en: He re-enacted scenes from his TV series.

defs.def_en: If you re-enact a scene or incident, you repeat the actions that occurred in the scene or incident.

defs.def_cn: (涨潮时被海水淹没的)海边淤泥地，潮泥滩
defs.def_en: Mudflats are areas of flat empty land at the coast which are covered by the sea only when the tide is in.

defs.def_cn: 所见即所得，直接可视数据(指计算机屏幕上显示的和打印出来的材料完全一致)

ext.ext_cn: 第一款制作网络文件的所见即所得应用软件
ext.ext_en: ...the first WYSIWYG application for creating documents on the Web.

defs.def_en: WYSIWYG is used to refer to a computer screen display which exactly matches the way that a document will appear when it is printed. WYSIWYG is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'what you see is what you get'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 希望如此有悖传统观念的思想会发展普及，这是不是太理想化了？
ext.ext_en: Is it utopian to hope that such iconoclastic ideas will gain ground?...

ext.ext_cn: 他与传统信仰相悖的思想倾向可能会给他带来麻烦。
ext.ext_en: His iconoclastic tendencies can get him into trouble.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or their words or ideas as iconoclastic, you mean that they contradict established beliefs.

defs.def_cn: 发出，排放，散发（热、光、气或气味）

ext.ext_cn: 新设备发出明亮的圆形光柱。
ext.ext_en: The new device emits a powerful circular column of light.

ext.ext_cn: 二氧化碳排放量
ext.ext_en: ...the amount of carbon dioxide emitted.

defs.def_en: If something emits heat, light, gas, or a smell, it produces it and sends it out by means of a physical or chemical process.

ext.ext_cn: 波莉眨了眨眼，吹了一声低沉而悠长的口哨。
ext.ext_en: Polly blinked and emitted a long, low whistle.

defs.def_en: To emit a sound or noise means to produce it.

defs.def_cn: 察觉不出的;感觉不到的;难以察觉的

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩的犹豫几乎难以察觉。
ext.ext_en: Brian's hesitation was almost imperceptible.

defs.def_en: Something that is imperceptible is so small that it is not noticed or cannot be seen.

ext.ext_cn: 麦卡特尼也热衷于古典风格而不是通俗风格的创作。
ext.ext_en: McCartney was also keen to write in a classical idiom, rather than a pop one...

ext.ext_cn: 那是一座具有当地风格的古建筑。
ext.ext_en: It was an old building in the local idiom.

defs.def_en: A particular idiom is a particular style of something such as music, dance, or architecture.

ext.ext_cn: 谚语和习语会由于使用过多而变得俗套。
ext.ext_en: Proverbs and idioms may become worn with overuse...

ext.ext_cn: 实际上，她很好地诠释了“欣然接纳自我”这一法语习语的意思。
ext.ext_en: She is, in fact, a perfect illustration of the French idiom 'to be comfortable in one's own skin.'

defs.def_en: An idiom is a group of words which have a different meaning when used together from the one they would have if you took the meaning of each word separately.

ext.ext_cn: 没什么比他使用过时的方言时那种自负的神态更气人的了。
ext.ext_en: And nothing was so irritating as the confident way he used archaic idiom.

ext.ext_cn: 她对汉语方言的掌握
ext.ext_en: ...her command of the Chinese idiom.

defs.def_en: Idiom of a particular kind is the language that people use at a particular time or in a particular place.

defs.def_cn: 自我剥夺;自我牺牲;克己忘我

ext.ext_cn: 做母亲就一定要牺牲和忘我吗？
ext.ext_en: Should motherhood necessarily mean sacrifice and self-denial?

ext.ext_cn: 闻所未闻的克己行为
ext.ext_en: ...an unprecedented act of self-denial.

defs.def_en: Self-denial is the habit of refusing to do or have things that you would like, either because you cannot afford them, or because you believe it is morally good for you not to do them or have them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 灵活而方便的业务费用支付方式
ext.ext_en: ...a flexible and convenient way of paying for business expenses...

ext.ext_cn: 这家人认为在厨房吃饭更方便。
ext.ext_en: The family thought it was more convenient to eat in the kitchen.

defs.def_en: If a way of doing something is convenient, it is easy, or very useful or suitable for a particular purpose.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 附近的;方便到达的;近便的

ext.ext_cn: 这座城市地理位置优越，到伦敦和希思罗机场都很方便。
ext.ext_en: The town is well placed for easy access to London and convenient for Heathrow Airport...

ext.ext_cn: 马丁一直往前开，直到找到了一个方便的停车场。
ext.ext_en: Martin drove along until he found a convenient parking place.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as convenient, you are pleased because it is near to where you are, or because you can reach another place from there quickly and easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她会尽力安排一个双方都方便的时间和地点进行面试。
ext.ext_en: She will try to arrange a mutually convenient time and place for an interview...

ext.ext_cn: 今天晚上你方便吗？
ext.ext_en: Would this evening be convenient for you?

defs.def_en: A convenient time to do something, for example to meet someone, is a time when you are free to do it or would like to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (态度、行为等)方便的，省力的，省事的

ext.ext_cn: 我们不能拿少数这几个人作为一种方便的借口而对此置之不理。
ext.ext_en: We cannot make this minority a convenient excuse to turn our backs...

ext.ext_cn: 随手抓来的替罪羊
ext.ext_en: ...a convenient scapegoat...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's attitudes or actions as convenient, you think they are only adopting those attitudes or performing those actions in order to avoid something difficult or unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: （表示愤怒、吃惊或激动，可能具冒犯意味）该死的，要命的
defs.def_en: Some people use goddamn when they are angry, surprised, or excited. This use could cause offence.

ext.ext_cn: 到了晚上，瞳孔就会扩大以接收更多光线。
ext.ext_en: At night, the pupils dilate to allow in more light...

ext.ext_cn: 运动会使大脑表层的血管扩张。
ext.ext_en: Exercise dilates blood vessels on the surface of the brain.

defs.def_en: When things such as blood vessels or the pupils of your eyes dilate or when something dilates them, they become wider or bigger.

defs.def_cn: （补助金等）经过收入调查的，根据收入调查结果而确定的

ext.ext_cn: 根据收入调查结果发放的福利金
ext.ext_en: ...means-tested benefits.

defs.def_en: A grant or benefit that is means-tested varies in amount depending on a means test.

ext.ext_cn: 战争期间，他在国民警卫队呆过一段时间。
ext.ext_en: He spent part of the war in the National Guard...

ext.ext_cn: 战争与和平的问题
ext.ext_en: ...matters of war and peace...

defs.def_en: A war is a period of fighting or conflict between countries or states.

defs.def_cn: (国家或组织之间的)经济竞争

ext.ext_cn: 最重要的是达成协议，避免贸易战。
ext.ext_en: The most important thing is to reach an agreement and to avoid a trade war.

defs.def_en: War is intense economic competition between countries or organizations.

ext.ext_cn: 她参与了打击有组织犯罪的斗争。
ext.ext_en: She has been involved in the war against organised crime.

ext.ext_cn: 如果美国想在反毒斗争中获得胜利…
ext.ext_en: ...if the United States is to be successful in its war on drugs.

defs.def_en: If you make war on someone or something that you are opposed to, you do things to stop them succeeding.

ext.ext_cn: 本也受了伤。他摔断了一条腿，现在还打着石膏。
ext.ext_en: Ben has also been in the wars. He is still in plaster after breaking a leg.

defs.def_en: If someone has been in the wars, they have been injured, for example in a fight or in an accident.

ext.ext_cn: 你认为这场危机能和平解决吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you think this crisis can be settled without going to war?

defs.def_en: If a country goes to war, it starts fighting a war.

ext.ext_cn: 动物权利保护者和该国多家动物园展开了越来越激烈的论战。
ext.ext_en: Animal rights activists have been engaged in an increasingly bitter war of words with many of the nation's zoos.

defs.def_en: If two people, countries, or organizations have a war of words, they criticize each other because they strongly disagree about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （文章、电影等）晦涩难懂的，索然无味的

ext.ext_cn: 他过去常作些极其乏味、晦涩难懂而且令人非常厌烦的演讲。
ext.ext_en: He used to make extremely dull, turgid and frankly boring speeches...

ext.ext_cn: 比较而言，艺术界的其他领域看起来越发索然无味。
ext.ext_en: The rest of the arts scene looks increasingly turgid by comparison.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a piece of writing or a film as turgid, you think it is boring and difficult to understand.

ext.ext_cn: 词典和语法书的编纂者
ext.ext_en: ...the compilers of dictionaries and grammars.

defs.def_en: A compiler is someone who compiles books, reports, or lists of information.
A compiler is a computer program which converts language that people can use into a code that the computer can understand.

ext.ext_cn: 鳕鱼肝油胶囊
ext.ext_en: ...cod liver oil capsules...

ext.ext_cn: 你也可以选择便于服用的红参片或红参胶囊。
ext.ext_en: You can also take red ginseng in convenient tablet or capsule form.

defs.def_en: A capsule is a very small tube containing powdered or liquid medicine, which you swallow.

defs.def_cn: (医用或科学研究用的)密封小容器

ext.ext_cn: 他们首先将密封管植入动物的大脑。
ext.ext_en: They first implanted capsules into the animals' brains...

ext.ext_cn: 那些透明密闭容器一浸入湖水中就开始溶解。
ext.ext_en: The clear capsules start dissolving as soon as they are immersed in the lake.

defs.def_en: A capsule is a small container with a drug or other substance inside it, which is used for medical or scientific purposes.

ext.ext_cn: 一个硕大发亮的褐色坚果，包裹在一个多刺的大种子荚内
ext.ext_en: ...a large shiny brown nut, enclosed in a large spiny seed capsule.

defs.def_en: In some plants, a capsule is a part which forms a case or container for seeds, fruit, or spores.

ext.ext_cn: 一个俄罗斯太空舱目前正在绕地球轨道飞行。
ext.ext_en: A Russian space capsule is currently orbiting the Earth.

defs.def_en: A space capsule is the part of a spacecraft in which people travel, and which often separates from the main rocket.

defs.def_cn: 萨满教(认为世界由善良和邪恶的神灵掌管，而拥有特殊能力的人可以控制这些神灵)
defs.def_en: Shamanism is a religion which is based on the belief that the world is controlled by good and evil spirits, and that these spirits can be directed by people with special powers.
Peat is decaying plant material which is found under the ground in some cool, wet regions. Peat can be added to soil to help plants grow, or can be burnt on fires instead of coal.
A woodlouse is a very small grey creature with a hard body and fourteen legs. Woodlice live in damp places.

ext.ext_cn: 沉降池中的废水中加入了消毒剂，以消灭所有有害微生物。
ext.ext_en: Effluent from the sedimentation tank is dosed with disinfectant to kill any harmful organisms...

ext.ext_cn: 盐是天然的消毒剂。
ext.ext_en: Salt is a natural disinfectant.

defs.def_en: Disinfectant is a substance that kills germs. It is used, for example, for cleaning kitchens and bathrooms.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示某一城市或国家总人口的数字前）

ext.ext_cn: 索马里，人口790万，人均收入大约每周1.60英镑。
ext.ext_en: Somalia, pop. 7.9 million, income per head about £1.60 a week.

defs.def_en: pop. is an abbreviation for (缩略=) population. It is used before a number when indicating the total population of a city or country.
When the sun beats down, it is very hot and bright.

ext.ext_cn: 即使在大雨倾盆的冬天，那里也非常舒适。
ext.ext_en: Even in the winter with the rain beating down, it's nice and cosy in there.

defs.def_en: When the rain beats down, it rains very hard.

ext.ext_cn: 一个公道的雇主在商定木匠的工钱时不会使劲压价。
ext.ext_en: A fair employer, when arranging for the pay of a carpenter, does not try to beat him down...

ext.ext_cn: 把卖家的要价砍到你能接受的价格。
ext.ext_en: Beat down the seller to the price that suits you.

defs.def_en: If you beat down a person who is selling you something, you force them to accept a lower price for it than they wanted to get.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坚强的;吃苦耐劳的;坚韧不拔的

ext.ext_cn: 他树立了铁面生意人的名声。
ext.ext_en: He built up a reputation as a tough businessman...

ext.ext_cn: 她坚韧顽强，满怀抱负。
ext.ext_en: She is tough and ambitious.

defs.def_en: A tough person is strong and determined, and can tolerate difficulty or suffering.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他因枪杀三人得到了暴徒的恶名。
ext.ext_en: He had shot three people dead earning himself a reputation as a tough guy.

ext.ext_cn: 三个膀粗腰圆的恶汉挤到了前面。
ext.ext_en: Three burly toughs elbowed their way to the front.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as tough, you mean that they are rough and violent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 治安很差的；充满犯罪与暴力的

ext.ext_cn: 她似乎不适合在这个治安恶劣的社区生活。
ext.ext_en: She doesn't seem cut out for this tough neighbourhood...

ext.ext_cn: 阿瑟在一个到处是暴力与犯罪的城市长大。
ext.ext_en: Arthur grew up in a tough city.

defs.def_en: A tough place or area is considered to have a lot of crime and violence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的童年非常不幸。
ext.ext_en: She had a pretty tough childhood…

ext.ext_cn: 这是难熬的一天。
ext.ext_en: It's been a tough day…

defs.def_en: A tough way of life or period of time is difficult or full of suffering.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 棘手的;难办的;难解决的

ext.ext_cn: 这是个困难的决定，但是我们认为我们做出了正确的选择。
ext.ext_en: It was a very tough decision but we feel we made the right one...

ext.ext_cn: 不管是谁赢得选举都将面对复苏经济的棘手任务。
ext.ext_en: Whoever wins the election is going to have a tough job getting the economy back on its feet…

defs.def_en: A tough task or problem is difficult to do or solve.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他因在安全问题上采取强硬路线而闻名。
ext.ext_en: He is known for taking a tough line on security...

ext.ext_cn: 他公布了限制货币供应的严厉措施。
ext.ext_en: He announced tough measures to limit the money supply.

defs.def_en: Tough policies or actions are strict and firm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在工业上，金刚石可以用作工具表面坚固、耐腐蚀的覆盖层。
ext.ext_en: In industry, diamond can form a tough, non-corrosive coating for tools.

ext.ext_cn: 有着相当坚韧外壳的深棕色豆类
ext.ext_en: …dark brown beans with a rather tough outer skin.

defs.def_en: A tough substance is strong, and difficult to break, cut, or tear.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (肉)非常老的，切不下的，嚼不动的

ext.ext_cn: 牛排老得嚼不动，豌豆像子弹一样硬。
ext.ext_en: The steak was tough and the peas were like bullets.

defs.def_en: Tough meat is difficult to cut and chew.

ext.ext_cn: 白宫为达成一项有利协议寸步不让。
ext.ext_en: The White House is hanging tough for a good agreement to be reached.

defs.def_en: If someone who is trying to achieve something hangs tough, they remain determined and do not give up, even when there are difficulties or problems.
If someone has a cleft palate, they were born with a narrow opening along the roof of their mouth which makes it difficult for them to speak properly.

defs.def_cn: (把…)打扮得花枝招展，装扮得漂漂亮亮

ext.ext_cn: 我们那时常常打扮得漂漂亮亮然后进城去。
ext.ext_en: We used to doll ourselves up and go into town.

defs.def_en: If a woman dolls herself up, she puts on smart or fashionable clothes in order to try and look attractive for a particular occasion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 极其喧闹活跃的课堂
ext.ext_en: ...a very rambunctious and energetic class.

defs.def_en: A rambunctious person is energetic in a cheerful, noisy way.

ext.ext_cn: 猪油或牛油
ext.ext_en: ...lard or beef fat.

defs.def_en: Lard is soft white fat obtained from pigs. It is used in cooking.

defs.def_cn: （在言谈或文章中）充斥，大量夹杂（某类词语）

ext.ext_cn: 近日官方在讲话中满口对民主的承诺。
ext.ext_en: Official speeches in recent days have been larded with promises of democracy.

ext.ext_cn: 一句一个“亲爱的”且充斥着令人反胃的儿语情话的电话粥
ext.ext_en: ...a long phone call, larded with 'darlings' and a sickening amount of baby-talk.

defs.def_en: If speech or writing is larded with particular types of words, it contains a lot of them or too many of them.

defs.def_cn: 相互独立的;彼此不关联的

ext.ext_cn: 你的问题应该彼此无关。
ext.ext_en: Your questions should be independent of each other...

ext.ext_cn: 我们马上就将从大学分离出去,成立我们自己的团体。
ext.ext_en: We're going independent from the university and setting up our own group...

defs.def_en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 菲尔现在不那么依赖父母了。
ext.ext_en: Phil was now much more independent of his parents...

ext.ext_cn: 她希望在经济上能够自立。
ext.ext_en: She would like to be financially independent...

defs.def_en: If someone is independent, they do not need help or money from anyone else.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一个完全独立的国家
ext.ext_en: ...a fully independent state...

ext.ext_cn: 巴布亚新几内亚 1975 年脱离澳大利亚正式独立。
ext.ext_en: Papua New Guinea became independent from Australia in 1975.

defs.def_en: Independent countries and states are not ruled by other countries but have their own government.

defs.def_cn: (组织)独立的，不受他人控制的

ext.ext_cn: 独立电视台
ext.ext_en: ...an independent television station.

ext.ext_cn: 政风处,一个独立的机构
ext.ext_en: ...the Office of Government Ethics, an independent agency.

defs.def_en: An independent organization or other body is one that controls its own finances and operations, rather than being controlled by someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 他在一所重点私立中学教化学。
ext.ext_en: He taught chemistry at a leading independent school.

defs.def_en: An independent school does not receive money from the government or local council, but from the fees paid by its students' parents or from charities.

defs.def_cn: (调查、意见)独立的，不偏不倚的

ext.ext_cn: 政府下令对该事件进行独立调查。
ext.ext_en: The government ordered an independent inquiry into the affair...

ext.ext_cn: 今天发表的一项独立民意测验表明民众对政府的不满正与日俱增。
ext.ext_en: An independent opinion poll published today shows growing discontent with the government.

defs.def_en: An independent inquiry or opinion is one that involves people who are not connected with a particular situation, and should therefore be fair.

ext.ext_cn: 最近一位无党派候选人的支持率迅速上升。
ext.ext_en: There's been a late surge of support for an independent candidate.

ext.ext_cn: 法国最有影响力的无党派政治家
ext.ext_en: ...the most powerful independent politician in France.

defs.def_en: An independent politician is one who does not represent any political party.

ext.ext_cn: 他编造了数不清的借口和谎话。
ext.ext_en: He has invented innumerable excuses, told endless lies.

defs.def_en: Innumerable means very many, or too many to be counted.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们知道艺术品位因人而异。
ext.ext_en: We know that taste in art is a subjective matter...

ext.ext_cn: 他们解释其过去的方式太主观。
ext.ext_en: The way they interpreted their past was highly subjective.

defs.def_en: Something that is subjective is based on personal opinions and feelings rather than on facts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无能为力的;不起作用的

ext.ext_cn: 暴徒的侵犯令人们感到痛心、愤怒却又无能为力。
ext.ext_en: The aggression of a bully leaves people feeling hurt, angry and impotent...

ext.ext_cn: 他怒气冲冲地站起来,却又无计可施，只能在公寓里走来走去。
ext.ext_en: In impotent rage he got up and stalked up and down the flat.

defs.def_en: If someone feels impotent, they feel that they have no power to influence people or events.
If a man is impotent, he is unable to have sex normally, because his penis fails to get hard or stay hard.

defs.def_cn: 斋月（伊斯兰历9月，该月内穆斯林从日出到日落禁食）
defs.def_en: Ramadan is the ninth month of the Muslim year, when Muslims do not eat between the rising and setting of the sun. During Ramadan, Muslims celebrate the fact that it was in this month that God first revealed the words of the Quran to Mohammed.

defs.def_cn: 歼灭；消灭；毁灭；彻底击溃

ext.ext_cn: 毁灭地球有很多方法。
ext.ext_en: There are lots of ways of annihilating the planet...

ext.ext_cn: 陆军被彻底击溃了。
ext.ext_en: The Army was annihilated.

defs.def_en: To annihilate something means to destroy it completely.

defs.def_cn: （在竞赛或争论中）彻底击败，大胜

ext.ext_cn: 荷兰队以5比0完胜奥运冠军队。
ext.ext_en: The Dutch annihilated the Olympic champions 5-0.

defs.def_en: If you annihilate someone in a contest or argument, you totally defeat them.

ext.ext_cn: 加拿大将从今年晚些时候起在办公场所全面禁烟。
ext.ext_en: Canada will ban smoking in all offices later this year.

ext.ext_cn: 去年武器遭禁售。
ext.ext_en: Last year arms sales were banned.

defs.def_en: To ban something means to state officially that it must not be done, shown, or used.

ext.ext_cn: 将军同时取消了对政党的禁令。
ext.ext_en: The General also lifted a ban on political parties.

defs.def_en: A ban is an official ruling that something must not be done, shown, or used.

ext.ext_cn: 他被吊扣驾照3年。
ext.ext_en: He was banned from driving for three years.

defs.def_en: If you are banned from doing something, you are officially prevented from doing it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 符合礼仪的;得体的;庄重的

ext.ext_cn: 他们每天都和保姆一起在公园里散步，表现得很有教养。
ext.ext_en: They go for decorous walks every day in parks with their nanny.

defs.def_en: Decorous behaviour is very respectable, calm, and polite.

defs.def_cn: 几尼（英国旧货币单位，价值1.05英镑，现有时见于拍卖会）
defs.def_en: A guinea is an old British unit of money that was worth £1.05. Guineas are still sometimes used, for example in auctions.

ext.ext_cn: 莫莉已经努力克服了对飞行的恐惧。
ext.ext_en: Molly had fought and overcome her fear of flying...

ext.ext_cn: 找出办法战胜困难。
ext.ext_en: Find a way to overcome your difficulties.

defs.def_en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

defs.def_cn: （感情上）受到极大影响，承受不起

ext.ext_cn: 考试前的晚上，恐惧和绝望让我内心无比惊慌。
ext.ext_en: The night before the test I was overcome by fear and despair...

ext.ext_cn: 他感到一阵眩晕，眼前发黑。
ext.ext_en: A dizziness overcame him, blurring his vision.

defs.def_en: If you are overcome by a feeling or event, it is so strong or has such a strong effect that you cannot think clearly.

ext.ext_cn: 居民试图逃离火场，却被浓烟熏倒了。
ext.ext_en: The residents were trying to escape from the fire but were overcome by smoke.

defs.def_en: If you are overcome by smoke or a poisonous gas, you become very ill or die from breathing it in.

defs.def_cn: 现代主义的;现代派的；现代风格的

ext.ext_cn: 现代主义建筑
ext.ext_en: ...modernist architecture.

ext.ext_cn: 现代主义艺术
ext.ext_en: ...modernist art...

defs.def_en: See also:post-modernist;Modernist means relating to the ideas and methods of modern art.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 荤段子
ext.ext_en: ...smutty jokes...

ext.ext_cn: 我对淫秽书刊痛恨之极。
ext.ext_en: I detest smutty books.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a joke, book, or film as smutty, you disapprove of it because it shows naked people or refers to sex in a rude or unpleasant way.

ext.ext_cn: 他公然在超市偷窃。
ext.ext_en: He openly shoplifted from a supermarket...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经偷了商店价值好几千美元的商品。
ext.ext_en: They had shoplifted thousands of dollars' worth of merchandise.

defs.def_en: If someone shoplifts, they steal goods from a shop by hiding them in a bag or in their clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 他到那里抄电表。
ext.ext_en: He was there to read the electricity meter...

ext.ext_cn: 他们有权进来查表。
ext.ext_en: They have the right to come in and inspect the meter.

defs.def_en: A meter is a device that measures and records something such as the amount of gas or electricity that you have used.

defs.def_cn: 用表计量(耗用的煤气、电等)

ext.ext_cn: 这些家庭当中只有三分之一认为用水表计量是合理的。
ext.ext_en: Only a third of these households thought it reasonable to meter water...

ext.ext_cn: 打表计价的出租车相对便宜。
ext.ext_en: Metered taxis are relatively inexpensive.

defs.def_en: To meter something such as gas or electricity means to use a meter to measure how much of it people use, usually in order to calculate how much they have to pay.
A meter is the same as a parking meter .
In chess, checkmate is a situation in which you cannot stop your king being captured and so you lose the game.

defs.def_cn: (尤指供病人使用的)座椅式便桶
defs.def_en: A commode is a movable piece of furniture shaped like a chair, which has a large pot below or inside it. It is used as a toilet, especially by people who are too ill to be able to walk easily.
A commode is a toilet.

ext.ext_cn: 没有采取禁酒措施。
ext.ext_en: There is no move to criminalise alcohol.

ext.ext_cn: 蓄意给前政府成员定罪的运动
ext.ext_en: ...a deliberate campaign to criminalise members of the former government.

defs.def_en: If a government criminalizes an action or person, it officially declares that the action or the person's behaviour is illegal.

ext.ext_cn: 那个男子穿着浴袍，显然是刚刚从浴室出来。
ext.ext_en: The man wore a bathrobe and had evidently just come from the bathroom...

ext.ext_cn: 那两个俄罗斯人明显彼此相识。
ext.ext_en: The two Russians evidently knew each other.

defs.def_en: You use evidently to say that something is obviously true, for example because you have seen evidence of it yourself.

defs.def_cn: 显然地（但不十分确定）；据说

ext.ext_cn: 从儿时起，他就明显地既叛逆又早熟。
ext.ext_en: From childhood, he was evidently at once rebellious and precocious...

ext.ext_cn: 埃利斯显然希望在阿特金森制定了指导方针后继续往下协商。
ext.ext_en: Ellis evidently wished to negotiate downwards after Atkinson had set the guidelines.

defs.def_en: You use evidently to show that you think something is true or have been told something is true, but that you are not sure, because you do not have enough information or proof.

defs.def_cn: （用于引出陈述或观点，强调其真实性或正确性）显然，肯定

ext.ext_cn: 很显然这与社会背景没有任何关系。
ext.ext_en: Quite evidently, it has nothing to do with social background.

defs.def_en: You can use evidently to introduce a statement or opinion and to emphasize that you feel that it is true or correct.
A snifter is a small amount of an alcoholic drink.

defs.def_cn: (盛白兰地用的)小口大肚酒杯
defs.def_en: A snifter is a bowl-shaped glass used for drinking brandy.
Trotters are pig's feet which you can cook and eat.
A trotter is a horse that has been trained to move fast and to pull a carriage in races.

ext.ext_cn: 他的研究是为全人类造福。
ext.ext_en: His research is for the betterment of mankind.

defs.def_en: The betterment of something is the act or process of improving its standard or status.

ext.ext_cn: 在剧院里，他们正在演出比才的作品《卡门》。
ext.ext_en: Inside the theatre, they were giving a performance of Bizet's Carmen.

ext.ext_cn: 她所演绎的遭人背叛的美狄亚
ext.ext_en: ...her performance as the betrayed Medea...

defs.def_en: A performance involves entertaining an audience by doing something such as singing, dancing, or acting.

defs.def_cn: 表现；业绩；性能；运行情况

ext.ext_cn: 那项研究调查了18名外科医生的工作表现。
ext.ext_en: That study looked at the performance of 18 surgeons...

ext.ext_cn: 业绩不佳的原因被归咎于经济衰退和低价跑车的进口。
ext.ext_en: The poor performance has been blamed on the recession and cheaper sports car imports...

defs.def_en: Someone's or something's performance is how successful they are or how well they do something.
A car's performance is its ability to go fast and to increase its speed quickly.
See also:high-performance;A performance car is one that can go very fast and can increase its speed very quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 为了完成任务，他每周工作70多个小时。
ext.ext_en: He devoted in excess of seventy hours a week to the performance of his duties...

ext.ext_cn: 该部族的人认为举行这种仪式是大神的意志。
ext.ext_en: The people believe that the performance of this ritual is the will of the Great Spirit.

defs.def_en: The performance of a task is the fact or action of doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 整个过程相当复杂。
ext.ext_en: The whole process is quite a performance...

ext.ext_cn: 她费了不少劲才把所有的香料都撒在上面。
ext.ext_en: She made a big performance of sprinkling all the spices on.

defs.def_en: You can describe something that is or looks complicated or difficult to do as a performance .

defs.def_cn: （旨在研究效率最高的工作方法的）时间与动作（研究）
defs.def_en: A time and motion study is a study of the way that people do a particular job, or the way they work in a particular place in order to discover the most efficient methods of working.

ext.ext_cn: 经济增长的速度明显放慢。
ext.ext_en: There has been a sharp slowdown in economic growth.

defs.def_en: A slowdown is a reduction in speed or activity.

ext.ext_cn: 要估算出究竟多少高级职员参与了怠工是不可能的。
ext.ext_en: It's impossible to assess how many officers are participating in the slowdown.

defs.def_en: A slowdown is a protest in which workers deliberately work slowly and cause problems for their employers.

defs.def_cn: （表示震惊、惊讶或引出言论或回答，为Jesus的简称）天哪，哎呀（可能具冒犯意味）

ext.ext_cn: 天哪，我希望他们能告诉我们到底是怎么回事。
ext.ext_en: Jeez, I wish they'd tell us what the hell is going on...

ext.ext_cn: 天哪，这是什么破烂儿！
ext.ext_en: Jeez, what garbage!

defs.def_en: Some people say Jeez when they are shocked or surprised about something, or to introduce a remark or response. Jeez is short for 'Jesus'. This use could cause offence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （眼神、话语、语气等）谴责的，指责的，非难的

ext.ext_cn: 提问中带刺
ext.ext_en: ...the accusatory tone of the questions.

defs.def_en: An accusatory look, remark, or tone of voice suggests blame or criticism.

ext.ext_cn: 浓缩铀是核武器的关键组成部分。
ext.ext_en: Enriched uranium is a key component of a nuclear weapon...

ext.ext_cn: 管理计划有4个主要部分。
ext.ext_en: The management plan has four main components...

defs.def_en: The components of something are the parts that it is made of.

ext.ext_cn: 戈尔巴乔夫没能把苏联各成员国团结在一起。
ext.ext_en: Gorbachev failed to keep the component parts of the Soviet Union together...

ext.ext_cn: 现在波音757飞机的组成部件将由波兰工人制造。
ext.ext_en: Polish workers will now be making component parts for Boeing 757s.

defs.def_en: The component parts of something are the parts that make it up.
A potty is a deep bowl which a small child uses instead of a toilet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is potty, you think that they are crazy or foolish.

defs.def_cn: 毫无表情的脸；不动声色的脸；扑克脸

ext.ext_cn: 生意场上，不动声色会非常有用。
ext.ext_en: In business a poker face can be very useful...

ext.ext_cn: 她一直努力板着脸。
ext.ext_en: She managed to keep a poker face.

defs.def_en: A poker face is an expression on your face that shows none of your feelings.

defs.def_cn: （墙壁和地板相连处的）踢脚板，壁脚板，护壁板
defs.def_en: A baseboard is a narrow length of wood which goes along the bottom of a wall in a room and makes a border between the walls and the floor.

ext.ext_cn: 政府对新英格兰银行的接管
ext.ext_en: ...the government's takeover of the Bank of New England Corporation.

ext.ext_cn: 针对美国第五大计算机制造商——NCR 公司的恶意收购投标
ext.ext_en: ...a hostile takeover bid for NCR, America's fifth-biggest computer-maker.

defs.def_en: A takeover is the act of gaining control of a company by buying more of its shares than anyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 发生了类似军事接管的事件。
ext.ext_en: There's been a military takeover of some kind.

defs.def_en: A takeover is the act of taking control of a country, political party, or movement by force.
A housekeeper is a person whose job is to cook, clean, and look after a house for its owner.

ext.ext_cn: 议员指责政府顽固不化，呼吁部长们改变决定。
ext.ext_en: MPs have accused the government of obduracy and called on ministers to reverse their decision.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of obduracy, you think their refusal to change their decision or opinion is unreasonable.
A jawbone is the bone in the lower jaw of a person or animal.

ext.ext_cn: 斯帕斯基以往从未输给过他的对手。
ext.ext_en: Spassky had never previously lost to his antagonist.

defs.def_en: Your antagonist is your opponent or enemy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她作为一个老板所具有的愤世嫉俗和坏脾气
ext.ext_en: ...her curmudgeonly cynic of a boss...

ext.ext_cn: 他态度恶劣，显得很不情愿接受选举人的意见。
ext.ext_en: He displayed a curmudgeonly unwillingness to accept the voters' verdict.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as curmudgeonly, you do not like them because they are mean or bad-tempered.
Diabetes is a medical condition in which someone has too much sugar in their blood.

defs.def_cn: (不能)轻慢;(不可）小看;(不可)怠慢

ext.ext_cn: 对他可不能小觑。
ext.ext_en: He was not someone to be trifled with...

ext.ext_cn: 在大不里士没人敢轻视行刑者。
ext.ext_en: No man in Tabriz trifled with the executioner.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is not a person to be trifled with, you are indicating to other people that they must treat that person with respect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 闪亮的;反光的;有光泽的

ext.ext_cn: 她的金发干净而有光泽。
ext.ext_en: Her blonde hair was shiny and clean.

ext.ext_cn: 一款闪亮的新跑车
ext.ext_en: ...a shiny new sports car.

defs.def_en: Shiny things are bright and reflect light.
A person's mental age is the age which they are considered to have reached in their ability to think or reason.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 疏忽的;玩忽职守的;失职的

ext.ext_cn: 陪审团裁定航空公司在对全体机组人员的培训和管理问题上存在疏漏。
ext.ext_en: The jury determined that the airline was negligent in training and supervising the crew...

ext.ext_cn: 市政会的做法属于失职。
ext.ext_en: The Council had acted in a negligent manner.

defs.def_en: If someone in a position of responsibility is negligent, they do not do something which they ought to do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 随便的;放松的;不修边幅的

ext.ext_cn: 劳拉随意挥了挥左手算是听到了这个赞扬。
ext.ext_en: Laura acknowledged this compliment with a negligent wave of her left hand...

ext.ext_cn: 她站在门口，一只手放在头上，很随意的样子。
ext.ext_en: She stood in the doorway, one hand above her head in a negligent pose.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person's movements or manner as negligent, you mean that they look relaxed and informal.

defs.def_cn: 现代主义(产生于20世纪上半叶的艺术运动，摒弃传统的价值观和表现手法，强调个人体验的重要性)
defs.def_en: See also:post-modernism;Modernism was a movement in the arts in the first half of the twentieth century that rejected traditional values and techniques, and emphasized the importance of individual experience.

ext.ext_cn: 在中国的民间传说中蝙蝠是好运的象征。
ext.ext_en: In Chinese folklore the bat is an emblem of good fortune.

defs.def_en: Folklore is the traditional stories, customs, and habits of a particular community or nation.

defs.def_cn: (广播、电视中的)资讯娱乐节目
defs.def_en: Infotainment is used to refer to radio or television programmes that are intended both to entertain people and to give information. The word is formed from 'information' and 'entertainment'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在这个市场里，一些人可能根本不讲道德原则，非常令人厌恶。
ext.ext_en: It is a market where people can be very unprincipled and unpleasant.
