ext.ext_cn: 在危机期间检察院的不道德行为
ext.ext_en: ...the unprincipled behaviour of the prosecutor's office during the crisis.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their actions as unprincipled, you are criticizing them for their lack of moral principles and because they do things which are immoral or dishonest.
A walkie-talkie is a small portable radio which you can talk into and hear messages through so that you can communicate with someone far away.

defs.def_cn: (加在动词后构成现在分词;现在分词可与助动词一起构成进行时态或像形容词一样使用)

ext.ext_cn: 他沿街走着。
ext.ext_en: He was walking along the street...

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们围坐在小桌子旁,相互说着话。
ext.ext_en: Children sit round small tables, talking to each other...

defs.def_en: -ing is added to verbs to form present participles. Present participles are used with auxiliary verbs to make continuous tenses. They are also used like adjectives, describing a person or thing as doing something.

defs.def_cn: (用于动词后构成表示活动的不可数名词)

ext.ext_cn: 园艺在英国非常受欢迎。
ext.ext_en: Gardening is very popular in Britain...

ext.ext_cn: 这一宣传推广是广告史上最为成功的活动之一。
ext.ext_en: This campaign is one of the most successful in the history of advertising.

defs.def_en: -ing is added to verbs to form uncount nouns referring to activities.
A speech therapist is a person whose job is to help people to overcome speech and language problems.

ext.ext_cn: 该场景具有丰富的象征意义，任何解释都可能破坏其效果。
ext.ext_en: The scene is so rich in symbolism that any explanation risks spoiling the effect.

ext.ext_cn: 由于其视觉上的象征主义而在当时大受褒扬的电影
ext.ext_en: ...a film much praised at the time for its visual symbolism.

defs.def_en: Symbolism is the use of symbols in order to represent something.

ext.ext_cn: 在这次短暂的国事访问期间，一举一动都将有着至关重要的象征意义。
ext.ext_en: The symbolism of every gesture will be of vital importance during the short state visit.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the symbolism of an event or action when it seems to show something important about a situation.

defs.def_cn: (中间有隔离带的)双向车道,双车道公路
defs.def_en: A dual carriageway is a road which has two lanes of traffic travelling in each direction with a strip of grass or concrete down the middle to separate the two lots of traffic.

defs.def_cn: (通常指因紧张不安或不适而)扭动，动来动去

ext.ext_cn: 父亲给他洗脸时，他扭来扭去，尖声喊叫。
ext.ext_en: He had squirmed and wriggled and screeched when his father had washed his face...

ext.ext_cn: 他无力地耸耸肩，扭动身体想要挣脱。
ext.ext_en: He gave a feeble shrug and tried to squirm free...

defs.def_en: If you squirm, you move your body from side to side, usually because you are nervous or uncomfortable.

ext.ext_cn: 一提宗教就肯定会让他感到窘迫不安。
ext.ext_en: Mentioning religion is a sure way to make him squirm.

ext.ext_cn: 使政客尴尬不安的那种糟糕场合
ext.ext_en: ...the type of awful occasion that makes politicians squirm with embarrassment.

defs.def_en: If you squirm, you are very embarrassed or ashamed.

ext.ext_cn: 一年之中，产羔期最令羊农高兴。
ext.ext_en: Lambing is the climax of the sheep farmer's year.

ext.ext_cn: 产羔季节
ext.ext_en: ...the lambing season.

defs.def_en: Lambing is the time in the spring when female sheep give birth to lambs.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 混杂的;五花八门的;各式各样的

ext.ext_cn: 收藏的一堆乱七八糟的破烂
ext.ext_en: ...a hoard of miscellaneous junk...

ext.ext_cn: 他们吃了大量的肉和奶制品，还有许多不知道该归为什么类别的杂七杂八的东西。
ext.ext_en: They eat a lot of meats and dairy foods, along with a lot of miscellaneous items that don't fall into any group.

defs.def_en: A miscellaneous group consists of many different kinds of things or people that are difficult to put into a particular category.

ext.ext_cn: 克劳克纳公司计划出售其亏损的钢铁业务。
ext.ext_en: Klockner plans to hive off its loss-making steel businesses...

ext.ext_cn: 汉莎航空公司本来计划将其国内业务分立出去，成立一个子公司“汉莎运通”。
ext.ext_en: Lufthansa had originally planned to hive off its domestic operations into a subsidiary, Lufthansa Express.

defs.def_en: If someone hives off part of a business, they transfer it to new ownership, usually by selling it.

defs.def_cn: 反对犹太人的人；歧视犹太人的人
defs.def_en: An anti-Semite is someone who strongly dislikes and is prejudiced against Jewish people.

ext.ext_cn: 对戒酒的好处赞不绝口的已成功戒酒的酒徒
ext.ext_en: ...a reformed alcoholic extolling the joys of temperance.

defs.def_en: If you believe in temperance, you disapprove of drinking alcohol.

ext.ext_cn: 享乐主义时代正让位于一个注重节制的时代。
ext.ext_en: The age of hedonism is being ushered out by a new era of temperance.

defs.def_en: A person who shows temperance has a strong mind and does not eat too much, drink too much, or do too much of anything.

ext.ext_cn: 严格遵守宪法
ext.ext_en: ...strict adherence to the constitution.

defs.def_en: Adherence is the fact of adhering to a particular rule, agreement, or belief.

ext.ext_cn: 在国际象棋中，一般来说从棋盘任何位置都可以移动大约36步。
ext.ext_en: In chess there are typically about 36 legal moves from any given board position...

ext.ext_cn: 股票的价值在某一特定的时期内会有涨跌。
ext.ext_en: Over a given period, the value of shares will rise and fall.

defs.def_en: If you talk about, for example, any given position or a given time, you mean the particular position or time that you are discussing.

ext.ext_cn: 写下有机会的话你想做的事情。
ext.ext_en: Write down the sort of thing you would like to do, given the opportunity...

ext.ext_cn: 只要有耐心，是能成功培育出这一品种的。
ext.ext_en: Given patience, successful breeding of this species can be achieved.

defs.def_en: Given is used when indicating a possible situation in which someone has the opportunity or ability to do something. For example, given the chance means 'if I had the chance'.

ext.ext_cn: 考虑到自己挣得不多，我用钱通常比较精打细算，这也是迫不得已。
ext.ext_en: Usually, I am sensible with money, as I have to be, given that I don't earn that much.

defs.def_en: If you say given that something is the case, you mean taking that fact into account.

ext.ext_cn: 考虑到利前途未卜，我没有什么选择余地。
ext.ext_en: Given the uncertainty over Leigh's future I was left with little other choice.

defs.def_en: If you say given something, you mean taking that thing into account.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我不习惯表露自己的感情。
ext.ext_en: I am not very given to emotional displays.

defs.def_en: If you are given to doing something, you often do it.

defs.def_cn: 普通金属，贱金属（如铜、锌、锡和铅等）
defs.def_en: A base metal is a metal such as copper, zinc, tin, or lead that is not a precious metal.

defs.def_cn: 使（通常指不好的事件或形势）突然发生；加速

ext.ext_cn: 维尔纽斯的几起谋杀事件导致了迄今为止最严重的危机。
ext.ext_en: The killings in Vilnius have precipitated the worst crisis yet...

ext.ext_cn: 小错误可能会招致大灾难。
ext.ext_en: A slight mistake could precipitate a disaster.

defs.def_en: If something precipitates an event or situation, usually a bad one, it causes it to happen suddenly or sooner than normal.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行动或决定）仓猝的，贸然的，突然的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为我们不应该贸然作出决定。
ext.ext_en: I don't think we should make precipitate decisions...

ext.ext_cn: 我们目前的很多问题都是由过去仓猝制定的政策导致的。
ext.ext_en: Many of our current problems have been caused by precipitate policy making in the past.

defs.def_en: A precipitate action or decision happens or is made more quickly or suddenly than most people think is sensible.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那些窗帘纯粹是作装饰用的，不能拉开或合上。
ext.ext_en: The curtains are for purely decorative purposes and do not open or close.

ext.ext_cn: 装饰性很强的铁支架
ext.ext_en: ...highly decorative iron brackets.

defs.def_en: Something that is decorative is intended to look pretty or attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可感知的；易察觉的；明显的

ext.ext_cn: 埃米和吉姆之间明显关系紧张。
ext.ext_en: The tension between Amy and Jim is palpable...

ext.ext_cn: 几乎明显有种无望的感觉。
ext.ext_en: There is an almost palpable feeling of hopelessness.

defs.def_en: You describe something as palpable when it is obvious or intense and easily noticed.

ext.ext_cn: 这些方案需要时间才能取得成果。
ext.ext_en: These plans take time to come to fruition...

ext.ext_cn: 他期盼出现一个新政党的愿望几乎不可能实现。
ext.ext_en: His hopes for a new political party have little chance of reaching fruition.

defs.def_en: If something comes to fruition, it starts to succeed and produce the results that were intended or hoped for.
A spanner is a metal tool whose end fits round a nut so that you can turn it to loosen or tighten it.

defs.def_cn: 从中捣乱;横加阻拦;搅局

ext.ext_cn: 糟糕的成绩肯定会坏事的。
ext.ext_en: A bad result is sure to throw a spanner in the works.

defs.def_en: If someone throws a spanner in the works, they prevent something happening smoothly in the way that it was planned, by causing a problem or difficulty.

ext.ext_cn: 他陷入了深深的忧郁之中。
ext.ext_en: He sank into deep melancholia.

defs.def_en: Melancholia is a feeling of great sadness, especially one that lasts a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 这是自1948年以来他首次回到自己的祖国。
ext.ext_en: It was his first visit to his native country since 1948...

ext.ext_cn: 特雷莎修女访问了她的祖国阿尔巴尼亚。
ext.ext_en: Mother Teresa visited her native Albania.

defs.def_en: Your native country or area is the country or area where you were born and brought up

ext.ext_cn: 奥宾博士是圣布莱斯人。
ext.ext_en: Dr Aubin is a native of St Blaise.

ext.ext_cn: 来自蒂尔堡的两个荷兰志愿工人
ext.ext_en: ...two Dutch volunteer workmen, natives of Tilburg.

defs.def_en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

defs.def_cn: 土人，土著(一些欧洲人指非西方国家的原住民，可能具冒犯意味)

ext.ext_cn: 他们使用武力把土著居民驱逐出了比较肥沃的土地。
ext.ext_en: They used force to banish the natives from the more fertile land.

ext.ext_cn: 当地原住民获准可以保留一些自己的传统文化和宗教。
ext.ext_en: Native people were allowed to retain some sense of their traditional culture and religion.

defs.def_en: Some European people use native to refer to a person living in a non-Western country who belongs to the race or tribe that the majority of people there belong to. This use could cause offence.

ext.ext_cn: 她不仅讲自己的母语瑞典语，还讲英语和法语。
ext.ext_en: She spoke not only her native language, Swedish, but also English and French...

ext.ext_cn: 法语不是我的母语。
ext.ext_en: French is not my native tongue.

defs.def_en: Your native language or tongue is the first language that you learned to speak when you were a child.

defs.def_cn: (动植物)当地土生的，原产地的

ext.ext_cn: 营造50英亩喀里多尼亚土生松树林的项目
ext.ext_en: ...a project to create a 50 acre forest of native Caledonian pines...

ext.ext_cn: 这些植物中有很多原产地在巴西。
ext.ext_en: Many of the plants are native to Brazil.

defs.def_en: Plants or animals that are native to a particular region live or grow there naturally and were not brought there.

defs.def_cn: (能力或品质)生来就有的，天赋的

ext.ext_cn: 我们有天生的才能，但我们却几乎未曾使用过。
ext.ext_en: We have our native inborn talent, yet we hardly use it.

defs.def_en: A native ability or quality is one that you possess naturally without having to learn it.

defs.def_cn: (移居他国的人)入乡随俗，同化

ext.ext_cn: 你觉得他并没有入乡随俗，是吗？可能他和那里的人结了婚，认定回不了家了。
ext.ext_en: You don't think he's gone native, do you? Perhaps he has married out there and decided he can't come home.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone who is living away from their own country goes native, you mean that they try to live and dress like the local people.

defs.def_cn: （通常指因恐惧、疲惫或兴奋而）呼吸急促，通气过度

ext.ext_cn: 当他们拿着注射针走近我时，我的呼吸急速加快。
ext.ext_en: I hyperventilate when they come near me with the needle.

defs.def_en: If someone hyperventilates, they begin to breathe very fast in an uncontrollable way, usually because they are very frightened, tired, or excited.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们的蜜月是在拉斯维加斯一家名为“海市蜃楼”的豪华酒店住了两天。
ext.ext_en: Our honeymoon was two days in Las Vegas at a luxurious hotel called Le Mirage...

ext.ext_cn: 她渐渐地喜欢上了罗伯托奢侈的生活方式。
ext.ext_en: She had come to enjoy Roberto's luxurious lifestyle.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as luxurious, you mean that it is very comfortable and expensive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 心满意足的；惬意的；舒适的

ext.ext_cn: 埃米微倾酒杯晃了晃酒，惬意地舒了一口气。
ext.ext_en: Amy tilted her wine in her glass with a luxurious sigh.

defs.def_en: Luxurious means feeling or expressing great pleasure and comfort.

defs.def_cn: 吉格舞（一种轻快的舞蹈）

ext.ext_cn: 她跳起了爱尔兰吉格舞。
ext.ext_en: She danced an Irish jig.

defs.def_en: A jig is a lively dance.

defs.def_cn: 精力充沛地跳舞（或走动）；（尤指）蹦跳

ext.ext_cn: 你可不是一个人在那儿瞎蹦，我的意思是你跳得很不错。
ext.ext_en: You didn't just jig about by yourself, I mean you danced properly.

defs.def_en: To jig means to dance or move energetically, especially bouncing up and down.
A jig is a device that holds something in position when it is being machined by a tool such as a drill.

ext.ext_cn: 她有点固执。
ext.ext_en: She had a little core of self-will.

defs.def_en: Someone's self-will is their determination to do what they want without caring what other people think.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们经济的严峻形势
ext.ext_en: ...the parlous state of our economy.

defs.def_en: If something is in a parlous state, it is in a bad or dangerous condition.
A helicopter is an aircraft with long blades on top that go round very fast. It is able to stay still in the air and to move straight upwards or downwards.

ext.ext_cn: 举世皆知现在是滋生种族褊狭的温床的国家
ext.ext_en: ...a state now known worldwide as a hotbed of racial intolerance.

defs.def_en: If you say that somewhere is a hotbed of an undesirable activity, you are emphasizing that a lot of the activity is going on there or being started there.

ext.ext_cn: 随着美国的电影观众人数在二三十年里首次下跌，好莱坞正在为萧条期做好准备。
ext.ext_en: With audiences in the US falling for the first time in a generation, Hollywood is girding itself for recession.

defs.def_en: If you gird yourself for a battle or contest, you prepare yourself for it.  to gird your loins→see: loin;

ext.ext_cn: 该手册正被译成数种语言，将在临近圣诞节时出版。
ext.ext_en: The guide is being translated into several languages for publication near Christmas...

ext.ext_cn: 他的诗集的出版可能说是一件大事。
ext.ext_en: The publication of his collected poems was approaching the status of an event.

defs.def_en: The publication of a book or magazine is the act of printing it and sending it to shops to be sold.

ext.ext_cn: 他们开始对两本提及一桩婚外情的出版物提起法律诉讼。
ext.ext_en: They have started legal proceedings against two publications which spoke of an affair.

defs.def_en: A publication is a book or magazine that has been published.

ext.ext_cn: 一位发言人说，“对于这些照片的公之于众，我们不予置评。”
ext.ext_en: A spokesman said: 'We have no comment regarding the publication of these photographs.'

defs.def_en: The publication of something such as information is the act of making it known to the public, for example by informing journalists or by publishing a government document.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰斯顿中士
ext.ext_en: ...Sgt Johnston.

defs.def_en: Sgt is the written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) Sergeant when it is used as a title.

ext.ext_cn: 一家英国报纸称，英国航空公司计划接管环球航空公司。
ext.ext_en: A British newspaper says British Airways plan to take over Trans World Airways.

defs.def_en: If you take over a company, you get control of it, for example by buying its shares.

ext.ext_cn: 比利时人依照国际联盟的授权接管了卢旺达。
ext.ext_en: The Belgians took over Rwanda under a League of Nations mandate...

ext.ext_cn: 马德里议会大厦被国民警卫队接管了。
ext.ext_en: The parliament in Madrid was taken over by civil guards.

defs.def_en: If someone takes over a country or building, they get control of it by force, for example with the help of the army.

ext.ext_cn: 他的遗孀已接手管理他创下的帝国，其中包括 6 家伦敦剧院。
ext.ext_en: His widow has taken over the running of his empire, including six London theatres...

ext.ext_cn: 1966 年，帕斯特·艾伯茨接替他担任主管市长。
ext.ext_en: In 1966, Pastor Albertz took over from him as governing mayor...

defs.def_en: If you take over a job or role or if you take over, you become responsible for the job after someone else has stopped doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车逐渐替代了马匹。
ext.ext_en: Cars gradually took over from horses...

ext.ext_cn: 最后一轮投票时，理性占了上风。
ext.ext_en: When the final vote came, rationality took over.

defs.def_en: If one thing takes over from something else, it becomes more important, successful, or powerful than the other thing, and eventually replaces it.
A dime is an American coin worth ten cents.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她在城郊找了一家便宜的小汽车旅馆，那旅馆既简陋又难看。
ext.ext_en: She found a small, inexpensive motel on the outskirts of the town; it was barren and unlovely.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unlovely, you mean that it is unattractive or unpleasant in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 他的身体因为严重的肾衰竭而垮掉了。
ext.ext_en: He collapsed from acute renal failure...

ext.ext_cn: 血液通过肾动脉流进肾脏。
ext.ext_en: Blood enters the kidneys via the renal artery.

defs.def_en: Renal describes things that concern or are related to the kidneys.

ext.ext_cn: 传统的草坪已经被低成本梯田所取代，梯田上有个高位水塘和瀑布似的水流。
ext.ext_en: The traditional lawn has been replaced by low-cost terracing, with a raised pool and waterfall.

defs.def_en: Terracing is a sloping piece of land that has had flat areas like steps built on it, for example so that people can grow crops there.

defs.def_cn: (足球赛观众可站立的)阶梯看台
defs.def_en: At a football stadium, terracing is an area of wide steps that people can stand on when they are watching the game.
A line drawing is a drawing which consists only of lines.
A hexagonal object or shape has six straight sides.

defs.def_cn: 简单地;只不过;仅仅;纯粹

ext.ext_cn: 这张桌子只不过是在底座上安了一块圆形刨花板。
ext.ext_en: The table is simply a chipboard circle on a base...

ext.ext_cn: 目前大部分损坏都是因为倒下的树木造成的。
ext.ext_en: Most of the damage that's occurred was simply because of fallen trees...

defs.def_en: You use simply to emphasize that something consists of only one thing, happens for only one reason, or is done in only one way.

ext.ext_cn: 这种增长根本就不合理。
ext.ext_en: This sort of increase simply cannot be justified...

ext.ext_cn: 这些问题有很多根本就没有答案。
ext.ext_en: So many of these questions simply don't have answers...

defs.def_en: You use simply to emphasize what you are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 船长在船尾，假装睡着了。
ext.ext_en: The captain was astern, pretending he was sleeping.

defs.def_en: Something that is astern is at the back of a ship or behind the back part.

ext.ext_cn: 在关键时刻，驳船不能向后驶。
ext.ext_en: At the crucial moment, the barge would not go astern.

defs.def_en: A ship that is moving astern is moving backwards.

ext.ext_cn: 他一意孤行，真是蠢透了。
ext.ext_en: He's a first-class dolt who insists on doing things his way.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a dolt, you think they are stupid, or have done something stupid.

defs.def_cn: (艺术家或艺术团体的)录音作品目录
defs.def_en: A discography is a list of all the recordings made by a particular artist or group.

ext.ext_cn: 然后他全家搬到了一个稍微大一点的房子里。
ext.ext_en: His family then moved to a slightly larger house...

ext.ext_cn: 它们的价钱要贵一些，可是更加耐用。
ext.ext_en: They will be slightly more expensive but they last a lot longer...

defs.def_en: Slightly means to some degree but not to a very large degree.

ext.ext_cn: 观看赛马比赛的观众将获得一个与某一匹赛马相对应的号码。
ext.ext_en: Racegoers will be given a number which will correspond to a horse running in a race...

ext.ext_cn: 乘车出行者的比率上升了22%，与之相对应，人均骑自行车的行驶里程下降了19%。
ext.ext_en: A 22 per cent increase in car travel corresponds with a 19 per cent drop in cycle mileage per person...

defs.def_en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them. You can also say that two things correspond .

ext.ext_cn: 她仍与9年前在马略卡岛结识的美国朋友们通信。
ext.ext_en: She still corresponds with American friends she met in Majorca nine years ago...

ext.ext_cn: 我们定期通信。
ext.ext_en: We corresponded regularly.

defs.def_en: If you correspond with someone, you write letters to them. You can also say that two people correspond .

defs.def_cn: 香料，佐料，调料，调味品(如肉桂、姜、辣椒粉等)

ext.ext_cn: 香草和香料
ext.ext_en: ...herbs and spices.

ext.ext_cn: 一排调料罐
ext.ext_en: ...a row of spice jars.

defs.def_en: A spice is a part of a plant, or a powder made from that part, which you put in food to give it flavour. Cinnamon, ginger, and paprika are spices.

defs.def_cn: 使活泼生动;给…增添趣味

ext.ext_cn: 他们的谈话和讨论透着些许的神秘。
ext.ext_en: They spiced their conversations and discussions with intrigue.

ext.ext_cn: 仅有几处笑点的无聊影片
ext.ext_en: ...a boring film spiced with the occasional funny moment.

defs.def_en: If you spice something that you say or do, you add excitement or interest to it.

ext.ext_cn: 多样化使生活更有情趣！
ext.ext_en: Variety is the spice of life!...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在方法和观念上都持不同意见，这使辩论精彩了很多。
ext.ext_en: To add spice to the debate, they disagreed about method and ideology.

defs.def_en: Spice is something which makes life more exciting.

defs.def_cn: 公爵的;与公爵有关的;公爵领地的
defs.def_en: Ducal places or things belong to or are connected with a duke.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是个害羞、说话轻声细语的女孩。
ext.ext_en: She was a shy, quiet-spoken girl...

ext.ext_cn: 她在现实生活中是个腼腆而且不善社交的人。
ext.ext_en: She was a shy and retiring person off-stage...

defs.def_en: A shy person is nervous and uncomfortable in the company of other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 犹豫的;不情愿的;害怕的;有所顾忌的

ext.ext_cn: 在管理学校方面，你应该毫无顾忌地发表你的意见。
ext.ext_en: You should not be shy of having your say in the running of the school.

defs.def_en: If you are shy of doing something, you are unwilling to do it because you are afraid of what might happen.

ext.ext_cn: 风一吹来，火星四溅，卢埃林的种马惊跳起来。
ext.ext_en: Llewelyn's stallion shied as the wind sent sparks flying.

defs.def_en: When a horse shies, it moves away suddenly, because something has frightened it.

defs.def_cn: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井绳;一回吃亏两回学乖
defs.def_en: You say 'once bitten, twice shy' when you want to indicate that someone will not do something a second time because they had a bad experience the first time they did it.

ext.ext_cn: 一边对做宣传避之不及，一边又抱怨赞助人与我们擦身而过，这样做是没有用的。
ext.ext_en: It is no use fighting shy of publicity and then complaining when sponsors pass us by...

ext.ext_cn: 迄今为止电视台一直竭力避免报道补缺选举。
ext.ext_en: Until now television had fought shy of covering by-elections.

defs.def_en: If you fight shy of something, you try very hard to avoid it.

ext.ext_cn: 几近53％的中学辍学率
ext.ext_en: ...a high-school dropout rate just shy of 53%...

ext.ext_cn: 他在离 95 岁寿辰仅差两天时去世了。
ext.ext_en: He died two days shy of his 95th birthday.

defs.def_en: A number or amount that is just shy of another number or amount is just under it.

defs.def_cn: 浓烈刺鼻的气味(或味道)

ext.ext_cn: 她能闻到海水浓烈的咸味。
ext.ext_en: She could smell the salty tang of the sea.

defs.def_en: A tang is a strong, sharp smell or taste.

defs.def_cn: (词或名字的)内涵意义，隐含意义，联想意义

ext.ext_cn: 这只是那种有太多负面含义的词之一。
ext.ext_en: It's just one of those words that's got so many negative connotations...

ext.ext_cn: 有淘气的含义，可能不是一个特别恰当的词。
ext.ext_en: 'Urchin', with its connotation of mischievousness, may not be a particularly apt word. urchin

defs.def_en: The connotations of a particular word or name are the ideas or qualities which it makes you think of.

defs.def_cn: 挨家挨户送牛奶的工作

ext.ext_cn: 随着顾客转而从超市购买牛奶，送牛奶的生意受到了威胁。
ext.ext_en: Milk rounds are threatened as customers switch to buying from supermarkets.

defs.def_en: If someone has a milk round, they work as a milkman, going from house to house delivering milk.

defs.def_cn: （每年一度的）校园招聘，巡回招聘

ext.ext_cn: 他在校园招聘会上找到了第一份工作。
ext.ext_en: He obtained his first job through the milk round.

defs.def_en: The milk round is an event that happens once a year when people from large companies visit colleges and universities and interview students who are interested in working for them.

ext.ext_cn: 顾客们知道我们的清仓大甩卖是实实在在的全场降价。
ext.ext_en: Customers know that our stocktake sales offer genuine markdowns across the store.

defs.def_en: A markdown is a reduction in the price of something.

defs.def_cn: 黎巴嫩的；黎巴嫩人的；黎巴嫩文化的

ext.ext_cn: 与黎巴嫩政府的谈判
ext.ext_en: ...talks with the Lebanese government.

defs.def_en: Lebanese means belonging or relating to Lebanon, or to its people or culture.
A Lebanese is a Lebanese citizen, or a person of Lebanese origin.
A merchant banker is someone who works for a merchant bank.

defs.def_cn: 开颜；露出喜色；快乐起来

ext.ext_cn: 看到他后，她似乎露出点儿喜色。
ext.ext_en: Seeing him, she seemed to brighten a little...

ext.ext_cn: “哦，我们很乐意！”南希面露喜色，大声说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Oh, we'd love to!' cried Nancy, her face brightening.

defs.def_en: If someone brightens or their face brightens, they suddenly look happier.

ext.ext_cn: 他眼睛一亮，笑了起来
ext.ext_en: His eyes brightened and he laughed...

ext.ext_cn: 她含着泪水的双眼因为好奇而闪闪发亮。
ext.ext_en: Her tearful eyes brightened with interest.

defs.def_en: If your eyes brighten, you suddenly look interested or excited.

ext.ext_cn: 桂竹香盆栽为门外的景致增色不少。
ext.ext_en: Tubs planted with wallflowers brightened the area outside the door.

ext.ext_cn: 戴维在一家商店里发现了这款粉色丝绸灯罩，觉得它会让房间亮丽起来。
ext.ext_en: David spotted the pink silk lampshade in a shop and thought it would brighten up the room.

defs.def_en: If someone or something brightens a place, they make it more colourful and attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 那并不能使城里孩子们的前途更光明些。
ext.ext_en: That does not do much to brighten the prospects of kids in the city...

ext.ext_cn: 不可否认经济状况正在好转。
ext.ext_en: It is undeniable that the economic picture is brightening.

defs.def_en: If someone or something brightens a situation or the situation brightens, it becomes more pleasant, enjoyable, or favourable.

ext.ext_cn: 山脊上方的天空变得明亮起来。
ext.ext_en: The sky above the ridge of mountains brightened...

ext.ext_cn: 傍晚的太阳照亮了教堂内部。
ext.ext_en: The late afternoon sun brightened the interior of the church.

defs.def_en: When a light brightens a place or when a place brightens, it becomes brighter or lighter.

ext.ext_cn: 中午刚过，天就放晴了。
ext.ext_en: By early afternoon the weather had brightened.

ext.ext_cn: 希望天会放晴，否则我们就要提早回来。
ext.ext_en: Hopefully it will brighten up, or we'll  be coming back early.

defs.def_en: If the weather brightens, it becomes less cloudy or rainy, and the sun starts to shine.

ext.ext_cn: 我妹妹把车停在马路那头。
ext.ext_en: My sister was parked down the road...

ext.ext_cn: 我们把车停在屋前。
ext.ext_en: We're parked out front.

defs.def_en: If you are parked somewhere, you have parked your car there.

defs.def_cn: (常置于室外且带盖子的)垃圾箱,垃圾桶
defs.def_en: A dustbin is a large container with a lid which people put their rubbish in and which is usually kept outside their house.

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个被宠坏了的调皮孩子。
ext.ext_en: He's a spoilt brat.

defs.def_en: If you call someone, especially a child, a brat, you mean that he or she behaves badly or annoys you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 矫正明显不公的需要
ext.ext_en: ...the need to rectify what is an obvious injustice...

ext.ext_cn: 这位民主党挑战者将如何履行总统职务还不能明确判断。
ext.ext_en: Determining how the Democratic challenger would conduct his presidency isn't quite so obvious.

defs.def_en: If something is obvious, it is easy to see or understand.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不必要的;无新意的；缺乏想象力的

ext.ext_cn: 我们都知道或是肯定应该知道有些说法已毫无新意，最好避免使用。
ext.ext_en: There are some very obvious phrases that we all know or certainly should know better than to use.

defs.def_en: If you describe something that someone says as obvious, you are being critical of it because you think it is unnecessary or shows lack of imagination.

defs.def_cn: (挑选运动队员或参赛运动员的)选拔委员，选拔人

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰板球队的选拔委员
ext.ext_en: ...the England cricket selectors.

defs.def_en: A selector is someone whose job is to choose which people will be in a particular sports team or will take part in a particular sports contest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 爽快的;干脆的;不忸怩作态的

ext.ext_cn: 她是个很粗犷的年轻女子，快人快语，非常热情。
ext.ext_en: She is a very physical young woman, earthy, and very intense.

ext.ext_cn: 他非常率直的幽默
ext.ext_en: ...his extremely earthy humour.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as earthy, you mean that they are open and direct, and talk about subjects which other people avoid or feel ashamed about.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢那种泥土般色调的暖色。
ext.ext_en: I'm attracted to warm, earthy colours...

ext.ext_cn: 这些房间有湿黏土散发出来的清新泥土气息。
ext.ext_en: The rooms had the clean earthy smell of wet clay.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as earthy, you mean it looks, smells, or feels like earth.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坚不可摧的；无懈可击的

ext.ext_cn: 那足以让曼塞尔获得别人无法撼动的领先地位。
ext.ext_en: That was enough to give Mansell an unassailable lead...

ext.ext_cn: 他的合法地位是不容置疑的。
ext.ext_en: His legal position is unassailable...

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as unassailable, you mean that nothing can alter, destroy, or challenge them.

ext.ext_cn: 至少一人死亡，还有几个人受伤。
ext.ext_en: At least one person died and several others were injured...

ext.ext_cn: 人人都知道他是唯一能做这项工作的人。
ext.ext_en: Everyone knows he's the only person who can do the job...

defs.def_en: A person is a man, woman, or child.

defs.def_cn: （person的复数形式，用于正式、法律、技术文体中）

ext.ext_cn: 剥夺被告人保持沉默的权利
ext.ext_en: ...removal of the right of accused persons to remain silent...

ext.ext_cn: 想收养孩子的人可以与当地社会公益部门联系。
ext.ext_en: Persons who wish to adopt a child may contact their local social services department.

defs.def_en: Persons is used as the plural of person in formal, legal, and technical writing.

ext.ext_cn: 现在我有充分的时间去了解他的人品。
ext.ext_en: I've a lot of time for him as a person now...

ext.ext_cn: 罗宾不喜欢自己的为人。
ext.ext_en: Robin didn't feel good about herself as a person.

defs.def_en: If you talk about someone as a person, you are considering them from the point of view of their real nature.

ext.ext_cn: 我根本不喜欢乡村生活，我喜欢城市。
ext.ext_en: I am not a country person at all. I prefer the cities.

defs.def_en: If someone says, for example, 'I'm an outdoor person ' or 'I'm not a coffee person', they are saying whether or not they like that particular activity or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 你必须携带本人身份证明亲自来取邮件。
ext.ext_en: You must collect the mail in person and take along some form of identification...

ext.ext_cn: 她亲自前往纽约领奖。
ext.ext_en: She went to New York to receive the award in person.

defs.def_en: If you do something in person, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it for you.

ext.ext_cn: 这是她第一次见到他本人。
ext.ext_en: It was the first time she had seen him in person.

ext.ext_cn: 去好莱坞亲自面见他最喜欢的演员的旅程
ext.ext_en: ...a trip to Hollywood to meet his favorite actor in person...

defs.def_en: If you meet, hear, or see someone in person, you are in the same place as them, rather than, for example, speaking to them on the telephone, writing to them, or seeing them on television.

ext.ext_cn: 嫌疑犯拒绝说出他的具体身份，而且身上没有携带任何身份证明。
ext.ext_en: The suspect had refused to give any details of his identity and had carried no documents on his person.

defs.def_en: Your person is your body.

ext.ext_cn: 我们有一位见识广博的导游乔治·亚当斯。
ext.ext_en: We had a knowledgeable guide in the person of George Adams.

defs.def_en: You can use in the person of when mentioning the name of someone you have just referred to in a more general or indirect way.

See also:first person;second person;third person;In grammar, we use the term first person when referring to 'I' and 'we', second person when referring to 'you', and third person when referring to 'he', 'she', 'it', 'they', and all other noun groups. Person is also used like this when referring to the verb forms that go with these pronouns and noun groups.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的学生的需要和志向
ext.ext_en: ...the needs and aspirations of our pupils...

ext.ext_cn: 他不可能派兵去扼杀民族主义理想。
ext.ext_en: He is unlikely to send in the army to quell nationalist aspirations.

defs.def_en: Some-one's aspirations are their desire to achieve things.

ext.ext_cn: 然后比萨饼做出来大约要用20分钟的时间。
ext.ext_en: The pizza will then take about twenty minutes to cook...

ext.ext_cn: 妈妈，一会儿见。
ext.ext_en: Bye Mum, see you in a minute...

defs.def_en: A minute is one of the sixty parts that an hour is divided into. People often say 'a minute' or 'minutes' when they mean a short length of time.

ext.ext_cn: 他刚才一直在阅读上次会议的记录。
ext.ext_en: He'd been reading the minutes of the last meeting.

defs.def_en: The minutes of a meeting are the written records of the things that are discussed or decided at it.

ext.ext_cn: 你不必把那一点记入会议记录。
ext.ext_en: You don't need to minute that.

defs.def_en: When someone minutes something that is discussed or decided at a meeting, they make a written record of it.

ext.ext_cn: 等一下，伙计们，这里有点不对劲。
ext.ext_en: Wait a minute, folks, something is wrong here...

ext.ext_cn: 嗨，等一下！
ext.ext_en: Hey, just a minute!

defs.def_en: People often use expressions such as wait a minute or just a minute when they want to stop you doing or saying something.

ext.ext_cn: 看上去好像马上就要下雨了。
ext.ext_en: It looked as though it might rain at any minute...

ext.ext_cn: 他应该随时都会回来。
ext.ext_en: He ought to be back any minute...

defs.def_en: If you say that something will or  may happen at any minute or any minute now, you are emphasizing that it is likely to happen very soon.

ext.ext_cn: 我压根不认为她会有所畏惧。
ext.ext_en: I don't believe for one minute she would have been scared...

ext.ext_cn: 我一点也不相信他。
ext.ext_en: I don't believe him for a minute.

defs.def_en: If you say that you do not believe for a minute or for one minute that something is true, you are emphasizing that you do not believe that it is true.

defs.def_cn: 最后关头; 最后一刻

ext.ext_cn: 她在为考试进行最后的复习。
ext.ext_en: She was doing some last-minute revision for her exams...

ext.ext_cn: 在最后一刻改变了地点。
ext.ext_en: The location has been changed at the last minute...

defs.def_en: A last-minute action is one that is done at the latest time possible.

defs.def_cn: 下一刻(强调事情发生得很突然)

ext.ext_cn: 接着我父亲突然进来了。
ext.ext_en: The next minute my father came in...

ext.ext_cn: 工作机会稍纵即逝。
ext.ext_en: Jobs are there one minute, gone the next.

defs.def_en: You use the expression the next minute or expressions such as 'one minute he was there, the next he was gone' to emphasize that something happens suddenly.

ext.ext_cn: 你一旦做了这件事，就会失去控制。
ext.ext_en: The minute you do this, you'll lose control...

ext.ext_cn: 战事一起，所有人都盯紧了电视报道。
ext.ext_en: The minute that the war started, everybody was glued to the television.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens the minute something else happens, you are emphasizing that it happens immediately after the other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我现在就需要跟她谈谈。
ext.ext_en: I need to speak with her right this minute...

ext.ext_cn: 安娜，住手。马上坐下。
ext.ext_en: Anna, stop that. Sit down this minute.

defs.def_en: If you say that something must be done this minute, you are emphasizing that it must be done immediately.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 非常细小的;十分微小的

ext.ext_cn: 只需要很少的一点点。
ext.ext_en: Only a minute amount is needed...

ext.ext_cn: 晚会策划极为详细。
ext.ext_en: The party was planned in the minutest detail.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is minute, you mean that it is very small.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 渡船是苏格兰边远地区的生命线。
ext.ext_en: Ferries are a lifeline to the far-flung corners of Scotland.

ext.ext_cn: 古罗马帝国最偏远的一个边境
ext.ext_en: ...one of the farthest-flung outposts of the old Roman Empire.

defs.def_en: Far-flung places are a very long distance away from where you are or from important places.

ext.ext_cn: 庞大的阴谋颠覆网络
ext.ext_en: ...a far-flung network of conspirators.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as organization or system as far-flung, you mean that it extends over a very large area.

ext.ext_cn: 月经周期
ext.ext_en: ...the menstrual cycle.

defs.def_en: Menstrual means relating to menstruation.

ext.ext_cn: 那对你来说不够吗？
ext.ext_en: Isn't that enough for you?...

ext.ext_cn: 我可以为你提供免费咨询。
ext.ext_en: I have some free advice for you.

defs.def_en: If something is for someone, they are intended to have it or benefit from it.

ext.ext_cn: 我知道他在一家保安公司工作。
ext.ext_en: I knew he worked for a security firm...

ext.ext_cn: 你有给电台写稿子的经验吗？
ext.ext_en: Have you had any experience writing for radio?

defs.def_en: If you work or do a job for someone, you are employed by them.

ext.ext_cn: 她作为国务院的发言人，每晚都会出现在电视新闻中。
ext.ext_en: She appears nightly on the television news, speaking for the State Department.

ext.ext_cn: 民主党发言人
ext.ext_en: ...the spokesman for the Democrats.

defs.def_en: If you speak or act for a particular group or organization, you represent them.

ext.ext_cn: 如果药店没有你想要的药品，让他们为你订购。
ext.ext_en: If your pharmacy doesn't stock the product you want, have them order it for you...

ext.ext_cn: 我帮一位老人把住店门。
ext.ext_en: I hold a shop door open for an old person...

defs.def_en: If someone does something for you, they do it so that you do not have to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这是你做得最棒的一件事——我为你感到高兴！
ext.ext_en: This is the best thing you've ever done – I am so happy for you!...

ext.ext_cn: 他为这个小女孩深感悲哀。
ext.ext_en: He felt a great sadness for this little girl.

defs.def_en: If you feel a particular emotion for someone, you feel it on their behalf.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰，我为史蒂夫感到难过，但是我想你的决定是正确的。
ext.ext_en: John, I'm sorry for Steve, but I think you've made the right decisions...

ext.ext_cn: 麦克对她没有同情，只有鄙夷。
ext.ext_en: Mack felt a pitiless contempt for her.

defs.def_en: If you feel a particular emotion for someone or something, they are the object of that emotion, and you feel it when you think about them.

ext.ext_cn: 许多新型列车为坐轮椅者留有空间。
ext.ext_en: Many new trains have space for wheelchair users...

ext.ext_cn: 往返行程需要 3 到 6 个小时。
ext.ext_en: It would take three to six hours for a round trip...

defs.def_en: You use for after words such as 'time', 'space', 'money', or 'energy' when you say how much there is or whether there is enough of it in order to be able to do or use a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 摆摊卖淡水鱼的鱼贩
ext.ext_en: ...fishmongers displaying freshwater fish for sale...

ext.ext_cn: 雪橇可以按天租用。
ext.ext_en: Skis are available for hire on a daily basis.

defs.def_en: If something is for sale, hire, or use, it is available to be sold, hired, or used.

ext.ext_cn: 使用未经消毒的注射器注射毒品的吸毒者
ext.ext_en: ...drug users who use unsterile equipment for injections of drugs...

ext.ext_cn: 切香肠用的刀放在水槽里。
ext.ext_en: The knife for cutting sausage was sitting in the sink.

defs.def_en: You use for when you state or explain the purpose of an object, action, or activity.

ext.ext_cn: 他很快要在议会发表讲话，说明他辞职的原因。
ext.ext_en: He's soon to make a speech in parliament explaining his reasons for going...

ext.ext_cn: 关于萨姆纳的问题，县医院查不出任何生理上的原因。
ext.ext_en: The county hospital could find no physical cause for Sumner's problems...

defs.def_en: You use for after nouns expressing reason or cause.

ext.ext_cn: 他强烈渴望拥有一个属于自己的家，因为他一直和我祖母住在一起。
ext.ext_en: He had a great desire to have a home of his own for he had always lived with my grandmother.

defs.def_en: You can use for to introduce a clause which gives the reason why you made the statement in the main clause.

ext.ext_cn: 做别人不愿意做的没有技术含量的工作
ext.ext_en: ...doing jobs that others turn down for lack of skill...

ext.ext_cn: 他们饿得睡不着。
ext.ext_en: They cannot sleep for hunger.

defs.def_en: You can use for to introduce the cause of the fact that you have just mentioned.

defs.def_cn: (用于条件句中)如果不是为了，要不是

ext.ext_cn: 要不是因为约翰，布赖恩也不可能知道真相。
ext.ext_en: If not for John, Brian wouldn't have learned the truth...

ext.ext_cn: 如果没有太阳辐射的热量，地球就会变成一个冰球。
ext.ext_en: The earth would be a frozen ball if it were not for the radiant heat of the sun...

defs.def_en: For is used in conditional sentences, in expressions such as 'if not for' and 'were it not for', to introduce the only thing which prevents the main part of the sentence from being true.

ext.ext_cn: 烤面包机持续开了一个多小时。
ext.ext_en: The toaster remained on for more than an hour...

ext.ext_cn: 她坐在床上盯着时钟看了几分钟。
ext.ext_en: For a few minutes she sat on her bed watching the clock...

defs.def_en: You use for to say how long something lasts or continues.

ext.ext_cn: 我们继续往前开了几公里。
ext.ext_en: We drove on for a few miles...

ext.ext_cn: 大片的黑色烟云升至大约几百英尺的空中。
ext.ext_en: Great clouds of black smoke were rising for several hundred feet or so.

defs.def_en: You use for to say how far something extends.

ext.ext_cn: 我们花了 30 美分坐公共汽车回到坦格。
ext.ext_en: We got the bus back to Tange for 30 cents...

ext.ext_cn: 马丁夫妇把他们的房子卖了 140 万英镑。
ext.ext_en: The Martins sold their house for about 1.4 million pounds...

defs.def_en: If something is bought, sold, or done for a particular amount of money, that amount of money is its price.

ext.ext_cn: 预定于 7 月 30 日至 8 月 1 日期间举办的威尔士船展
ext.ext_en: ...the Welsh Boat Show, planned for July 30–August 1...

ext.ext_cn: 玛莎百货的最新款秋冬季时装即将亮相。
ext.ext_en: Marks & Spencer will be unveiling its latest fashions for autumn and winter...

defs.def_en: If something is planned for a particular time, it is planned to happen then.

ext.ext_cn: 他问女儿过生日想要什么。
ext.ext_en: He asked his daughter what she would like for her birthday...

ext.ext_cn: 我会回家过圣诞节。
ext.ext_en: I'll be home for Christmas.

defs.def_en: If you do something for a particular occasion, you do it on that occasion or to celebrate that occasion.

ext.ext_cn: 他们第二天一早要去里约。
ext.ext_en: They would be leaving for Rio early the next morning.

defs.def_en: If you leave for a particular place or if you take a bus, train, plane, or boat for a place, you are going there.

ext.ext_cn: 对多数科学家来说，资金和设备是至关重要的。
ext.ext_en: What matters for most scientists is money and facilities...

ext.ext_cn: 对她来说，书就像面包一样，是生活必需品。
ext.ext_en: For her, books were as necessary to life as bread...

defs.def_en: You use for when you make a statement about something in order to say how it affects or relates to someone, or what their attitude to it is.

defs.def_cn: (用于形容词、名词和动词短语后，引出其后动词不定式的主语)

ext.ext_cn: 有可能会接受单身女子作为领养人。
ext.ext_en: It might be possible for a single woman to be accepted as a foster parent...

ext.ext_cn: 我已经安排我的一个孩子处理我的事务。
ext.ext_en: I had made arrangements for my affairs to be dealt with by one of my children...

defs.def_en: After some adjective, noun, and verb phrases, you use for to introduce the subject of the action indicated by the following infinitive verb.

defs.def_cn: 就…而言(表示相对来说不寻常)

ext.ext_cn: 对一个 8 岁的孩子而言，他长得很高。
ext.ext_en: He was tall for an eight-year-old...

ext.ext_cn: 对于一个年轻人来说，他太有钱了。
ext.ext_en: He had too much money for a young man.

defs.def_en: You use for when you say that an aspect of something or someone is surprising in relation to other aspects of them.

ext.ext_cn: 好吧，谁想要吐司三明治？
ext.ext_en: Right, who's for a toasted sandwich then?...

ext.ext_cn: “要吃什么？”保罗说。——“我要吃大比目鱼。”
ext.ext_en: 'What'll it be?' Paul said. —'I'm for halibut.'

defs.def_en: If you say that you are for a particular activity, you mean that this is what you want or intend to do.

ext.ext_cn: 温迪认定这项运动不适合她。
ext.ext_en: Wendy decided the sport was not for her...

ext.ext_cn: 安定的生活并不适合我。
ext.ext_en: Not for me the settled life...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not for you, you mean that you do not enjoy it or that it is not suitable for you.

defs.def_cn: (表示负有责任或享有权利)由…

ext.ext_cn: 我希望你能和我们一起回华盛顿，但是这由你决定。
ext.ext_en: I wish you would come back to Washington with us, but that's for you to decide...

ext.ext_cn: 我无权安排这些事情。
ext.ext_en: It is not for me to arrange such matters.

defs.def_en: If it is for you to do something, it is your responsibility or right to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 你是支持还是反对公共交通？
ext.ext_en: Are you for or against public transport?...

ext.ext_cn: 我拥护一个受到人民尊重并且尊重人民的政府。
ext.ext_en: I'm for a government that the people respect and that respects the people...

defs.def_en: If you are for something, you agree with it or support it.

defs.def_cn: (用于 argue, case, evidence, vote 等词后，引出所支持或被证明之事)

ext.ext_cn: 另一个工会已经投票赞成采取要求加薪的劳工行动。
ext.ext_en: Another union has voted for industrial action in support of a pay claim...

ext.ext_cn: 这个支持核能的案例令人印象深刻。
ext.ext_en: The case for nuclear power is impressive...

defs.def_en: You use for after words such as 'argue', 'case', 'evidence', or 'vote' in order to introduce the thing that is being supported or proved.

defs.def_cn: (置于某些名词、形容词或动词后，引出更多信息或与某性质、事物或行为相关的事物)

ext.ext_cn: 低卡路里干酪是奶油干酪的极佳替代品。
ext.ext_en: Reduced-calorie cheese is a great substitute for cream cheese...

ext.ext_cn: 停车场场主有保护停放车辆的法律责任。
ext.ext_en: Car park owners should be legally responsible for protecting vehicles...

defs.def_en: For is the preposition that is used after some nouns, adjectives, or verbs in order to introduce more information or to indicate what a quality, thing, or action relates to.

ext.ext_cn: 布雷迪法案是以前白宫新闻秘书詹姆斯·布雷迪的名字命名的。
ext.ext_en: The Brady Bill is named for former White House Press Secretary James Brady...

ext.ext_cn: 艾尔在1869 年成立了 N. W. 艾尔父子公司，公司以他父亲的名字命名。
ext.ext_en: Ayer started N. W. Ayer & Son in 1869, naming the firm for his father.

defs.def_en: To be named for someone means to be given the same name as them.

defs.def_cn: (与 every 连用，引出比率)每…(就有…)

ext.ext_cn: 在该地区每有一个农民失去工作，另外两到三个从事其他工作的人就会面临失业的危险。
ext.ext_en: For every farm job that is lost, two or three other jobs in the area are put at risk...

ext.ext_cn: 战前每100对夫妇中有一对离婚，现在则是 5 对。
ext.ext_en: Where there had been one divorce for every 100 marriages before the war, now there were five.

defs.def_en: You use for with 'every' when you are stating a ratio, to introduce one of the things in the ratio.

defs.def_cn: (用于比较)每镑对每镑/每英里对每英里

ext.ext_cn: 南极洲的每一寸土地和世界上其他地方相比都是最荒芜的
ext.ext_en: ...the Antarctic, mile for mile one of the planet's most lifeless areas...

ext.ext_cn: 他坚持每一项减税都要和支出削减一一对应。
ext.ext_en: He insists any tax cut be matched dollar-for-dollar with cuts in spending.

defs.def_en: You can use for in expressions such as pound for pound or mile for mile when you are making comparisons between the values or qualities of different things.

ext.ext_cn: 晒斑的专业术语是红斑。
ext.ext_en: The technical term for sunburn is erythema...

ext.ext_cn: cancer 这个词派生自希腊语中表示螃蟹的 karkinos 一词
ext.ext_en: Cancer is derived from the Greek word for crab, karkinos.

defs.def_en: If a word or expression has the same meaning as another word or expression, you can say that the first one is another word or expression for the second one.

defs.def_cn: (引出可在其他地方找到的信息)至于，对于

ext.ext_cn: 想了解关于威廉·詹姆斯·西迪斯生平的更多信息，请参阅埃米·华莱士所著《神童》。
ext.ext_en: For further information on the life of William James Sidis, see Amy Wallace, 'The Prodigy'.

defs.def_en: You use for in a piece of writing when you mention information which will be found somewhere else.

defs.def_cn: (尽管有不同意见或实际困难)完全赞成,坚信

ext.ext_cn: 我完全赞成减少二氧化碳的排放，但是，相比发展核能，对发展风能提供补贴更容易实现这一目标。
ext.ext_en: I am all for cutting carbon dioxide emissions, but that would be much more easily achieved by giving subsidies to windpower, than with nuclear power...

ext.ext_cn: 他完全赞成现役运动员尽可能多赚钱。
ext.ext_en: He is all for players earning what they can while they are in the game...

defs.def_en: If you say that you are all for doing something, you agree or strongly believe that it should be done, but you are also often suggesting that other people disagree with you or that there are practical difficulties.
If you are in for it or, in British English, if you are for it, you are likely to get into trouble because of something you have done.

ext.ext_cn: 他第二次结婚，这一次是和一个比利时人。
ext.ext_en: He was married for the second time, this time to a Belgian...

ext.ext_cn: 我职业生涯中第一次经历失败。
ext.ext_en: For the first time in my career, I was failing.

defs.def_en: You use expressions such as for the first time and for the last time when you are talking about how often something has happened before.  as for→see: as;

defs.def_cn: (大团体中的)派系，派别，小集团

ext.ext_cn: 该国各敌对派系领导人将签署和平协议。
ext.ext_en: A peace agreement will be signed by the leaders of the country's warring factions.

defs.def_en: A faction is an organized group of people within a larger group, which opposes some of the ideas of the larger group and fights for its own ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 派系之争和自私自利看来非常普遍。
ext.ext_en: Faction and self-interest appear to be the norm.

defs.def_en: Faction is also used to describe argument and disagreement within a group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 剧本当初就是为电视而写的。
ext.ext_en: The original script was written with the idiot box in mind.

defs.def_en: The idiot box is the television.

ext.ext_cn: 两人都知道关键时刻到了。
ext.ext_en: Both men knew the moment of truth had arrived.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a time or event as the moment of truth, you mean that it is an important time when you must make a decision quickly, and whatever you decide will have important consequences in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 他们家里的每件家具都和房子的风格相得益彰。
ext.ext_en: Each piece of furniture in their home suited the style of the house.

defs.def_en: Furniture consists of large objects such as tables, chairs, or beds that are used in a room for sitting or lying on or for putting things on or in.

defs.def_cn: 被认作当然的人(或事物);习以为常的人(或事物)
defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as part of the furniture, you are suggesting that they have been somewhere such as their place of work for such a long time that it is hard to imagine that place without them.

ext.ext_cn: 他习惯了妻子对他的百般关注，但孩子出生后这种关注就会不可避免地减少。
ext.ext_en: He is used to a lot of attention from his wife, which will inevitably lessen when the baby is born...

ext.ext_cn: 要确保接种最新的疫苗，以降低患上严重疾病的危险。
ext.ext_en: Make sure that your immunisations are up to date to lessen the risk of serious illness.

defs.def_en: If something lessens or you lessen it, it becomes smaller in size, amount, degree, or importance.
A publican is a person who owns or manages a pub.
A catkin is a long, thin, soft flower that hangs on some trees, for example birch trees and hazel trees.

defs.def_cn: （尤指某人的昵称或艺名）又名，亦称

ext.ext_cn: 作家芭芭拉·瓦因，又名露丝·伦德尔
ext.ext_en: ...the writer Barbara Vine, aka Ruth Rendell.

defs.def_en: aka is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'also known as'. aka is used especially when referring to someone's nickname or stage name.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 硬心肠的;冷酷无情的;麻木不仁的

ext.ext_cn: 冷酷无情的罪犯
ext.ext_en: ...hardened criminals.

ext.ext_cn: 麻木不仁的政客
ext.ext_en: ...hardened politicians.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as hardened, you mean that they have had so much experience of something bad or unpleasant that they are no longer affected by it in the way that other people would be.

ext.ext_cn: 他和安吉的关系属第一种，即肉欲加友谊。
ext.ext_en: His relationship with Angie was the first which combined lust with friendship...

ext.ext_cn: 他企图在肉体上占有她的欲望变得一发不可收拾。
ext.ext_en: His lust for her grew until it was overpowering.

defs.def_en: Lust is a feeling of strong sexual desire for someone.

ext.ext_cn: 是弗雷德对浮华、奢靡生活的强烈欲望使他们越走越远。
ext.ext_en: It was Fred's lust for glitz and glamour that was driving them apart.

defs.def_en: A lust for something is a very strong and eager desire to have it.

defs.def_cn: 使不敏感;使麻木;使无情

ext.ext_cn: 旨在让我们对战争的残酷现实无动于衷的语言
ext.ext_en: ...the language that is used to desensitize us to the terrible reality of war...

ext.ext_cn: 你的免疫系统已经因习惯了这种物质而不再敏感。
ext.ext_en: Your immune system has been desensitized because it has become used to the substance.

defs.def_en: To desensitize someone to things such as pain, anxiety, or other people's suffering, means to cause them to react less strongly to them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 妙极的;惹人喜爱的;了不起的

ext.ext_cn: 这场雨过后,野花会变得美不胜收。
ext.ext_en: The wildflowers will be incredible after this rain...

ext.ext_cn: 谢谢你带我去,我玩得非常开心。
ext.ext_en: Thanks for taking me, I had an incredible time...

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as incredible, you like them very much or are impressed by them, because they are extremely or unusually good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可思议的;难以置信的

ext.ext_cn: 在战时人们仍然想踢足球,这似乎不可思议。
ext.ext_en: It seemed incredible that people would still want to play football during a war...

ext.ext_cn: 我们不应把孩子们告诉我们的一些不可思议的故事当成谎话而不予理睬。
ext.ext_en: We should not dismiss as lies the incredible stories that children may tell us.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is incredible, you mean that it is very unusual or surprising, and you cannot believe it is really true, although it may be.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们从欧洲大陆进口数量惊人的奶酪。
ext.ext_en: We import an incredible amount of cheese from the Continent...

ext.ext_cn: 声音异常嘈杂。
ext.ext_en: There was an incredible din...

defs.def_en: You use incredible to emphasize the degree, amount, or intensity of something.

ext.ext_cn: 政客和国王，人类法律上的领导者
ext.ext_en: ...politicians and kings, de jure leaders of men.

ext.ext_cn: 直到宗教改革时期，教会会议的声明在天主教会中都仍然只是法律上认可，而非事实上通行。
ext.ext_en: The Synod's declarations prevailed de jure but not de facto in the Roman Catholic Church down to the Reformation era.

defs.def_en: De jure is used to indicate that something legally exists or is a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 但是那些并无接受继续教育这种家庭传统的人仍然面临着困难。
ext.ext_en: But those lacking a family tradition of continuing education still face difficulties.

defs.def_en: Continuing education is education for adults in a variety of subjects, most of which are practical, not academic.
Disinflation is a reduction in the rate of inflation, especially as a result of government policies.
Synchronized swimming is a sport in which two or more people perform complicated and carefully planned movements in water in time to music.

defs.def_cn: 军国主义者；穷兵黩武者

ext.ext_cn: 他们变成了过分狂热的民族主义分子和军国主义分子，并想要征服别国。
ext.ext_en: They became overheated nationalists, militarists, and they were out to conquer.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a militarist, you mean that they want their country's armed forces to be strengthened in order to make it more powerful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 军国主义政策
ext.ext_en: ...militarist policies.

defs.def_en: Militarist means the same as militaristic .

defs.def_cn: (组织内部的)实力派，帮派，小集团

ext.ext_cn: 少数派议员中的黑人集团
ext.ext_en: ...the Black Caucus of minority congressmen.

defs.def_en: A caucus is a group of people within an organization who share similar aims and interests or who have a lot of influence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 汽水
ext.ext_en: ...fizzy water.

ext.ext_cn: 一罐汽水
ext.ext_en: ...a can of fizzy drink.

defs.def_en: Fizzy drinks are drinks that contain small bubbles of carbon dioxide. They make a sound like a long 's' when you pour them.

defs.def_cn: (英国英语中指)能手，高手，行家

ext.ext_cn: 她擅长自己动手。
ext.ext_en: She's a dab hand at DIY.

defs.def_en: In British English, if you are a dab hand at something, you are very good at doing it.

defs.def_cn: （小说、戏剧或电影中的）反英雄，非正统派主角
defs.def_en: An anti-hero is the main character in a novel, play, or film who is not morally good and does not behave like a typical hero.
A kestrel is a small bird of prey.

defs.def_cn: (尤指音乐或时尚风格上的)混合，融合

ext.ext_cn: 当今流行音乐、爵士乐和乡土爵士乐的融合
ext.ext_en: ...the contemporary crossover of pop, jazz and funk.

ext.ext_cn: 结合舞蹈和摇滚乐的乐队
ext.ext_en: ...dance/rock crossover bands.

defs.def_en: A crossover of one style and another, especially in music or fashion, is a combination of the two different styles.

defs.def_cn: (在音乐或时尚上的)转型，改变风格

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉她从演员转型到歌手比从歌手转型到演员更容易。
ext.ext_en: I told her the crossover from actress to singer is easier than singer to actress.

defs.def_en: In music or fashion, if someone makes a crossover from one style to another, they become successful outside the style they were originally known for.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的脸棱角分明，颧骨突出。
ext.ext_en: He had an angular face with prominent cheekbones.

defs.def_en: Angular things have shapes that seem to contain a lot of straight lines and sharp points.

ext.ext_cn: 打零工的建筑工人
ext.ext_en: ...a jobbing builder.

defs.def_en: A jobbing worker does not work for someone on a regular basis, but does particular jobs when they are asked to.

defs.def_cn: （尤指因特网上的）自动程序，机器人程序
defs.def_en: A bot is a computer program that carries out tasks for other programs or users, especially on the Internet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指录音或广播)吱吱啦啦的

ext.ext_cn: 装有发条的留声机发出的吱啦声
ext.ext_en: ...the crackly sound of a wind-up gramophone.

ext.ext_cn: 沙沙作响的电话线
ext.ext_en: ...a crackly phone line.

defs.def_en: Something that is crackly, especially a recording or broadcast, has or makes a lot of short, harsh noises.

ext.ext_cn: 但是也已经强调过，此次会议预计不会带来重大政策转变。
ext.ext_en: But it's also been emphasized that no major policy changes can be expected to come out of the meeting...

ext.ext_cn: 和孩子讨论污染问题，强调清洁的街道、草地或公园有多么美丽。
ext.ext_en: Discuss pollution with your child, emphasizing how nice a clean street, lawn, or park looks.

defs.def_en: To emphasize something means to indicate that it is particularly important or true, or to draw special attention to it.

ext.ext_cn: 她可能觉得没有准备好承担为人父母的责任。
ext.ext_en: She may feel unready for the responsibilities of parenthood.

defs.def_en: Parenthood is the state of being a parent.

defs.def_cn: （防止汽车驶入私人领地或进入某段公路的）水泥隔离柱，短柱，护柱
defs.def_en: Bollards are short thick concrete posts that are used to prevent cars from going on to someone's land or on to part of a road.

defs.def_cn: （河岸或港口的）系船柱，系缆桩
defs.def_en: Bollards are strong wooden or metal posts on the side of a river or harbour. Boats are tied to them.
The Tote is a system of betting money on horses in races.

ext.ext_cn: 当持有机枪的士兵向人群进逼时，示威者逃散了。
ext.ext_en: The demonstrators fled when soldiers toting machine guns advanced on the crowd.

defs.def_en: To tote something, especially a gun, means to carry it with you in such a way that people can see it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 到一个全新的环境中是很有意思的。
ext.ext_en: It was interesting to be in a different environment...

ext.ext_cn: 城镇一分为二，两两相望,各自都有颇具趣味的教堂。
ext.ext_en: The two halves of the town face each other, and both have interesting churches...

defs.def_en: If you find something interesting, it attracts your attention, for example because you think it is exciting or unusual.

ext.ext_cn: 在混合物还没有变硬之前，趁热将它塑成形。
ext.ext_en: Mould the mixture into shape while hot, before it hardens...

ext.ext_cn: 在纸板上涂两三层清漆使其变硬。
ext.ext_en: Give the cardboard two or three coats of varnish to harden it.

defs.def_en: When something hardens or when you harden it, it becomes stiff or firm.

defs.def_cn: （使）（态度、想法）变得更坚定;（使）变得更强硬

ext.ext_cn: 他们的行动只会让土地拥有者的态度变得更坚定。
ext.ext_en: Their action can only serve to harden the attitude of landowners...

ext.ext_cn: 团结工会内部已产生的不愉快分歧可能会进一步演变为分裂。
ext.ext_en: The bitter split which has developed within Solidarity is likely to harden further into separation.

defs.def_en: When an attitude or opinion hardens or is hardened, it becomes harsher, stronger, or fixed.

ext.ext_cn: 房地产价格刚开始重新趋于稳定。
ext.ext_en: Property prices are just beginning to harden again.

defs.def_en: When prices and economies harden, they become much more stable than they were.

defs.def_cn: （使）变得坚强;（使）变得冷酷无情;（使）变得麻木不仁

ext.ext_cn: 她多年来醉酒寻衅的恶习让我变得麻木。
ext.ext_en: Her years of drunken bickering hardened my heart...

ext.ext_cn: 西伯利亚大草原的艰苦环境使她变得坚强起来。
ext.ext_en: She was hardened by the rigours of the Siberian steppes...

defs.def_en: When events harden people or when people harden, they become less easily affected emotionally and less sympathetic and gentle than they were before.

defs.def_cn: （表情、眼神）变得严肃，变得不快

ext.ext_cn: 他的笑容消失了，脸上的表情严肃了起来。
ext.ext_en: His smile died and the look in his face hardened.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's face or eyes harden, you mean that they suddenly look serious or angry.
A spigot is a faucet or tap.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 糟糕的;恶劣的;应受谴责的

ext.ext_cn: 他们中很多人的生活条件极其恶劣。
ext.ext_en: Many of them live under deplorable conditions...

ext.ext_cn: 郡警察局长说性骚扰应受谴责。
ext.ext_en: The Chief Constable said that sexual harassment was deplorable.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is deplorable, you think that it is very bad and unacceptable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 博学的；有见识的；知识渊博的

ext.ext_cn: 我们雇佣友善的、在行的员工。
ext.ext_en: We employ friendly and knowledgeable staff.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你不太了解汽车，带一个懂行的朋友一起去。
ext.ext_en: If you don't know much about cars, take a knowledgeable friend along.

defs.def_en: Someone who is knowledgeable has or shows a clear understanding of many different facts about the world or about a particular subject.

ext.ext_cn: 飞机从希思罗机场起飞后坠毁在一个水库里。
ext.ext_en: The aircraft crashed after takeoff from Heathrow in a reservoir...

ext.ext_cn: 通勤飞机在等候起飞。
ext.ext_en: The commuter plane was waiting for takeoff...

defs.def_en: Takeoff is the beginning of a flight, when an aircraft leaves the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 这个节目值得一看，因为有对柯林斯姐妹的滑稽创意模仿。
ext.ext_en: The programme was worth watching for an inspired takeoff of the Collins sisters.

defs.def_en: A takeoff of someone is a humorous imitation of the way in which they behave.

defs.def_cn: (经济、生意等的)开始腾飞，迅速发展

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪50年代是香港工业开始快速发展的10年。
ext.ext_en: The 1950s were the decade of Hong Kong's industrial take-off.

defs.def_en: Takeoff is the point in the development of something, such as an economy or a business, when it begins to be successful.

defs.def_cn: （依靠打猎捕鱼和采集果实为生的）狩猎采集者，采猎者
defs.def_en: Hunter-gatherers were people who lived by hunting and collecting food rather than by farming. There are still groups of hunter-gatherers living in some parts of the world.
A shotgun is a gun used for shooting birds and animals which fires a lot of small metal balls at one time.

ext.ext_cn: 一般认为，稀释血液可降低血栓形成的可能性。
ext.ext_en: It is generally accepted that thinning of the blood reduces the chances of thrombosis.

ext.ext_cn: 肺部有血栓的女士
ext.ext_en: ...a lady with a thrombosis in her lung.

defs.def_en: See also:coronary thrombosis;deep vein thrombosis;Thrombosis is the formation of a blood clot in a person's heart or in one of their blood vessels, which can cause death.
A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an event in history or of a famous person.

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士的名胜古迹
ext.ext_en: ...the ancient monuments of England, Scotland and Wales.

defs.def_en: A monument is something such as a  castle or bridge which was built a very long time ago and is regarded as an important part of a country's history.

ext.ext_cn: 他在国际上的成就为其信念作出了最好的注解。
ext.ext_en: By his international achievements he leaves a fitting monument to his beliefs.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a monument to someone's qualities, you mean that it is a very good example of the results or effects of those qualities.

ext.ext_cn: 王权专制
ext.ext_en: ...royal absolutism.

defs.def_en: Absolutism is a political system in which one ruler or leader has complete power and authority over a country.

defs.def_cn: （尤指被认为错误的）绝对主义，绝对论

ext.ext_cn: 他们都多多少少带有些绝对地说动物根本不该被拿来利用。
ext.ext_en: They are saying, with varying degrees of absolutism, that animals should not be exploited at all.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's beliefs as absolutism if they think that their beliefs are true, right, or relevant in all situations, especially if you think they are wrong to behave in this way.

ext.ext_cn: 奇切斯特大教堂内的主祭坛
ext.ext_en: ...the high altar at Chichester Cathedral.

defs.def_en: An altar is a holy table in a church or temple.

defs.def_cn: 作…的祭品；成为…的牺牲品

ext.ext_cn: 在灾难性的俄国战役中，拿破仑的军队成了这一愚蠢之举的牺牲品。
ext.ext_en: Napoleon's army was sacrificed on the altar of folly in the disastrous Russian campaign.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is sacrificed at the altar of another thing, you mean they suffer or are destroyed because of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 按一下锁上的小柄。
ext.ext_en: Push the tiny lever on the lock...

ext.ext_cn: 水阀上有一个手柄控制冷热水。
ext.ext_en: The taps have a lever to control the mix of hot and cold water.

defs.def_en: See also:gear lever;A lever is a handle or bar that is attached to a piece of machinery and which you push or pull in order to operate the machinery.
A lever is a long bar, one end of which is placed under a heavy object so that when you press down on the other end you can move the object.

ext.ext_cn: 邻居们最终用一根铁撬把门撬开了。
ext.ext_en: Neighbours eventually levered open the door with a crowbar...

ext.ext_cn: 将耙子插入到离根部约6英寸的地方并同时向后扳。
ext.ext_en: Insert the fork about 6in. from the root and simultaneously lever it backwards...

defs.def_en: If you lever something in a particular direction, you move it there, especially by using a lot of effort.

defs.def_cn: （用作施加压力等的）手段，方法

ext.ext_cn: 激进的好战派想要继续利用人质作筹码来换取西方的让步。
ext.ext_en: Radical, militant factions want to continue using the hostages as a lever to gain concessions from the west.

defs.def_en: A lever is an idea or action that you can use to make people do what you want them to do, rather than what they want to do.
A go-kart is a very small motor vehicle with four wheels, used for racing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 神经紧张的;焦躁不安的

ext.ext_cn: 他仍然焦虑不安，我们担心地等着安回来。
ext.ext_en: He was still twitchy and we awaited Ann's return anxiously…

ext.ext_cn: 该部门害怕出现负面宣传，在面对记者时突然变得手足无措。
ext.ext_en: Afraid of bad publicity, the department had suddenly become very twitchy about journalists.

defs.def_en: If you are twitchy, you are behaving in a rather nervous way that shows you feel anxious and cannot relax.

ext.ext_cn: 我想来点咖啡，如果你只有速溶的那种也可以。
ext.ext_en: I'd like some coffee, and I don't object to the powdered stuff if it's all you've got...

ext.ext_cn: 我对于这种古玩物件一无所知。
ext.ext_en: I don't know anything about this antique stuff...

defs.def_en: You can use stuff to refer to things such as a substance, a collection of things, events, or ideas, or the contents of something in a general way without mentioning the thing itself by name.

ext.ext_cn: 我把手插进口袋里。
ext.ext_en: I stuffed my hands in my pockets...

ext.ext_cn: 他把报纸塞进了垃圾箱，然后沿街往前走了。
ext.ext_en: He stuffed the newspapers into a litter bin and headed down the street...

defs.def_en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly.

ext.ext_cn: 他抢过我的钱包，打开并塞满钱，然后还给了我。
ext.ext_en: He grabbed my purse, opened it and stuffed it full, then gave it back to me...

ext.ext_cn: 他仍站在收银机后，嘴里塞满了爆米花。
ext.ext_en: He still stood behind his cash register stuffing his mouth with popcorn.

defs.def_en: If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it with something or with a quantity of things until it is full.

ext.ext_cn: 我可以一口气吃10块巧克力，半小时后再吃一顿大餐。
ext.ext_en: I could stuff myself with ten chocolate bars and half an hour later eat a big meal.

defs.def_en: If you stuff yourself, you eat a lot of food.

defs.def_cn: 给…装馅儿;给(鸡、辣椒等食物里)加填料

ext.ext_cn: 你能帮我给火鸡填上料然后放进烤箱里吗？
ext.ext_en: Will you stuff the turkey and shove it in the oven for me?

ext.ext_cn: 酿西红柿
ext.ext_en: ...stuffed tomatoes.

defs.def_en: If you stuff a bird such as a chicken or a vegetable such as a pepper, you put a mixture of food inside it before cooking it.

ext.ext_cn: 一条 1878 年捕获的重 29 磅 8 盎司的梭子鱼被制成标本陈列在庄园管理处。
ext.ext_en: A pike weighing 29 lb 8 oz taken in 1878 was stuffed and is on display at the estate office...

ext.ext_cn: 他不是很喜欢墙上挂的那些动物头颅标本。
ext.ext_en: He didn't much care for the stuffed animal heads that hung on the walls.

defs.def_en: If a dead animal is stuffed, it is filled with a substance so that it can be preserved and displayed.

defs.def_cn: 基本特征;特质;根本;基础

ext.ext_cn: 每个人皆无所不能，这一理念已经成为电视广告的精髓。
ext.ext_en: The idea that we can be whatever we want has become the stuff of television commercials.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing is the stuff of another, you mean that the first thing is a very important feature or characteristic of the second thing, or that the second thing can be based or built on the first thing.
If you are angry with someone for something that they have said or done, you might say 'Get stuffed!' to them.

defs.def_cn: (用在名词前表示强调)不稀罕，不在乎

ext.ext_cn: 我最终的态度是：去他们的。
ext.ext_en: Ultimately my attitude was: stuff them...

ext.ext_cn: 收起你的钱，我们不需要施舍。
ext.ext_en: Stuff your money. We don't want a handout.

defs.def_en: Stuff is used in front of nouns to emphasize that you do not care about something, or do not want it.

defs.def_cn: 露一手;施展自己的本事

ext.ext_cn: 我一上场就知道是我大显身手的时候了。
ext.ext_en: Once I get on the pitch I know I can do my stuff...

ext.ext_cn: 剩下的就只是栽上玫瑰，然后等大自然施展她的神奇魔力。
ext.ext_en: All that was left was to plant the roses and wait for nature to do her stuff.

defs.def_en: If you do your stuff, you perform an activity in the way that people expect.

ext.ext_cn: 7年的战争过后，这些家伙都成了作战行家。
ext.ext_en: These chaps know their stuff after seven years of war.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone knows their stuff, you mean that they are good at doing something because they know a lot about it.

ext.ext_cn: 听！我听见我爱人回来的脚步声了。
ext.ext_en: Hark. I hear the returning footsteps of my love.

defs.def_en: 'Hark!' means 'Listen!'.
See also:plastic bullet;rubber bullet;A bullet is a small piece of metal with a pointed or rounded end, which is fired out of a gun.

defs.def_cn: 硬着头皮做；咬紧牙关应付

ext.ext_cn: 旅行社的经营者们可能不得不忍痛降价。
ext.ext_en: Tour operators may be forced to bite the bullet and cut prices.

defs.def_en: If someone bites the bullet, they accept that they have to do something unpleasant but necessary.
The forecastle is the part at the front of a ship where the sailors live.

ext.ext_cn: 伯克特先生已经揭穿了数百个冒名顶替者。
ext.ext_en: Mr Burkett has unmasked several hundred impostors.

ext.ext_cn: 在1974年被揭穿身份的数年里，他设法成功地把一些绝密文件交给了东柏林。
ext.ext_en: He managed to pass top secret documents to East Berlin for many years before he was unmasked in 1974.

defs.def_en: If you unmask someone or something bad, you show or make known their true nature or character, when they had previously been thought to be good.

ext.ext_cn: 实验室里明亮的日光灯照明
ext.ext_en: ...the bright fluorescent lighting of the laboratory...

ext.ext_cn: 整个房间沐浴在柔光之中。
ext.ext_en: The whole room is bathed in soft lighting.

defs.def_en: The lighting in a place is the way that it is lit, for example by electric lights, by candles, or by windows, or the quality of the light in it.

ext.ext_cn: 彼得·芒福德的灯光和戴维·弗里曼的导演对演出的成功功不可没。
ext.ext_en: Peter Mumford's lighting and David Freeman's direction make a crucial contribution to the success of the staging.

defs.def_en: The lighting in a film or play is the use of different electric lights to give a particular effect.
An MEP is a person who has been elected to the European Parliament. MEP is an abbreviation for (缩略 =) 'Member of the European Parliament'.

ext.ext_cn: 她自杀过好几次。
ext.ext_en: She tried to commit suicide on several occasions.

ext.ext_cn: 自杀未遂事件
ext.ext_en: ...a case of attempted suicide.

defs.def_en: People who commit suicide deliberately kill themselves because they do not want to continue living.

defs.def_cn: 自杀性行为;自毁;自取灭亡的行为

ext.ext_cn: 有一些人因为写那些枯燥无味的回忆录而毁了自己的社会形象。
ext.ext_en: Quite a few have committed social suicide by writing their boring memoirs...

ext.ext_cn: 他们说这个政党弃权无异于自毁政治前程。
ext.ext_en: They say it would be political suicide for the party to abstain.

defs.def_en: You say that people commit suicide when they deliberately do something which ruins their career or position in society.

ext.ext_cn: 军方消息称，这个少年说他正在为这次运动执行“自杀性任务”。
ext.ext_en: According to the army, the teenager said he was on a 'suicide mission' for the movement.

ext.ext_cn: 自杀性炸弹袭击者
ext.ext_en: ...a suicide bomber.

defs.def_en: The people involved in a suicide attack, mission, or bombing do not expect to survive.

ext.ext_cn: 这么说你现在又开始四处走动了？不把自己关在家里了？
ext.ext_en: So you're getting about a bit again? Not shutting yourself away?

defs.def_en: If you get about, you go to different places and visit different people.

ext.ext_cn: 她发现出去走动越来越困难了。
ext.ext_en: She was finding it increasingly difficult to get about.

defs.def_en: The way that someone gets about is the way that they walk or go from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 这些谣言是怎么传开的？
ext.ext_en: How did the rumours get about?...

ext.ext_cn: 他被停职的消息迅速传开了。
ext.ext_en: The story had soon got about that he had been suspended.

defs.def_en: If news gets about, it becomes well known as a result of being told to lots of people.
A countertop is a flat surface in a kitchen which is easily cleaned and on which you can prepare food.

defs.def_cn: （有特殊用途的）木板，塑料板，板材

ext.ext_cn: 砧板
ext.ext_en: ...a chopping board.

defs.def_en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or plastic which is used for a particular purpose.

defs.def_cn: （下棋等用的）木板，硬纸板，棋盘

ext.ext_cn: 跳棋棋盘
ext.ext_en: ...a draughts board...

ext.ext_cn: 廷斯利博士在棋盘上还有5枚棋子，对手钦诺克还有4枚。
ext.ext_en: Dr Tinsley had five pieces on the board against Chinook's four.

defs.def_en: A board is a square piece of wood or stiff cardboard that you use for playing games such as chess.

ext.ext_cn: 他在黑板上又写了几条注释。
ext.ext_en: He wrote a few more notes on the board.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a blackboard or a noticeboard as a board.

defs.def_cn: （用来铺地板、筑围墙等的）长条木板

ext.ext_cn: 地面铺的是透气性好的实木地板。
ext.ext_en: The floor was draughty bare boards.

defs.def_en: Boards are long flat pieces of wood which are used, for example, to make floors or walls.

ext.ext_cn: 阿瑟希望在明天的会议上把自己的建议书提交董事会。
ext.ext_en: Arthur wants to put his recommendation before the board at a meeting tomorrow.

ext.ext_cn: 9月12日董事会议的议程
ext.ext_en: ...the agenda for the September 12 board meeting.

defs.def_en: See also:board of directors;The board of a company or organization is the group of people who control it and direct it.

defs.def_cn: （用于机构名称中）局，所，中心，委员会

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰旅游局宣称去年有33,000名日本人到苏格兰旅游。
ext.ext_en: The Scottish Tourist Board said 33,000 Japanese visited Scotland last year.

ext.ext_cn: 美国国家交通运输安全委员会
ext.ext_en: ...the US National Transportation Safety Board.

defs.def_en: Board is used in the names of various organizations which are involved in dealing with a particular kind of activity.

defs.def_cn: 上，登上（火车、轮船或飞机）

ext.ext_cn: 我登上了飞往英格兰的飞机。
ext.ext_en: I boarded the plane bound for England.

defs.def_en: When you board a train, ship, or aircraft, you get on it in order to travel somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 宾馆的所有员工都可享受免费膳宿。
ext.ext_en: Free room and board are provided for all hotel staff.

defs.def_en: Board is the food which is provided when you stay somewhere, for example in a hotel.

defs.def_cn: （协议或交易）合法诚信的，公开的，光明正大的

ext.ext_cn: 据我所知，安东尼经手的金融交易一直是公开透明的。
ext.ext_en: All I knew about were Antony's own financial dealings, which were always above board.

defs.def_en: An arrangement or deal that is above board is legal and is being carried out honestly and openly.

ext.ext_cn: 各处对单程租赁的收费都很高。
ext.ext_en: There are hefty charges across the board for one-way rental...

ext.ext_cn: 总统许诺如果能再次当选将采取全面的减税措施。
ext.ext_en: The President promised across-the-board tax cuts if re-elected.

defs.def_en: If a policy or a situation applies across the board, it affects everything or everyone in a particular group.

ext.ext_cn: 在当今这个世界，重要的不是你知道什么而是你认识谁，能力才干根本派不上用场。
ext.ext_en: It's a case of not what you know but who you know in this world today and qualifications quite go by the board.

defs.def_en: If something goes by the board, it is rejected or ignored, or is no longer possible.

ext.ext_cn: 他们乘坐意大利政府的包机到达盖特威克机场。
ext.ext_en: They arrived at Gatwick airport on board a plane chartered by the Italian government...

ext.ext_cn: 由2,000名海军陆战队士兵组成的海军特遣队
ext.ext_en: ...a naval task force with two thousand marines on board.

defs.def_en: When you are on board a train, ship, or aircraft, you are on it or in it.

defs.def_cn: （在竞赛或选举中）取得压倒性胜利，大获全胜

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙队在男子团体比赛中大获全胜。
ext.ext_en: Spain swept the board in boys' team competitions.

defs.def_en: If someone sweeps the board in a competition or election, they win nearly everything that it is possible to win.

ext.ext_cn: 我希望他们能采纳你们所提出的部分想法。
ext.ext_en: I hope that they will take on board some of what you have said.

defs.def_en: If you take on board an idea or a problem, you begin to accept it or understand it.

defs.def_cn: (包括说话者或笔者在内的)我们

ext.ext_cn: 我俩都发誓从此以后永远是朋友。
ext.ext_en: We both swore we'd be friends ever after...

ext.ext_cn: 我们又点了一瓶香槟。
ext.ext_en: We ordered another bottle of champagne...

defs.def_en: A speaker or writer uses we to refer both to himself or herself and to one or more other people as a group. You can use we before a noun to make it clear which group of people you are referring to.

ext.ext_cn: 我们需要注意身体。
ext.ext_en: We need to take care of our bodies.

ext.ext_cn: 在一段长期的亲密感情结束时大家都会体会到的难以割舍的痛苦
ext.ext_en: ...the withdrawal symptoms that we all experience at the end of a long, close relationship.

defs.def_en: We is sometimes used to refer to people in general.

defs.def_cn: (不仅指自己也指听者或读者)我们

ext.ext_cn: 现在我们来细想一下为身体提供能量的原料。
ext.ext_en: We will now consider the raw materials from which the body derives energy.

defs.def_en: A speaker or writer may use we instead of 'I' in order to include the audience or reader in what they are saying, especially when discussing how a talk or book is organized.

ext.ext_cn: 沃伦就此言论起诉他诽谤。
ext.ext_en: Warren sued him for libel over the remarks...

ext.ext_cn: 如果陪审团裁定诽谤罪成立，那就必须考虑其对史密斯小姐的职位的影响。
ext.ext_en: If the jury decided there was a libel, it would have to consider its effect on Miss Smith's position.

defs.def_en: Libel is a written statement which wrongly accuses someone of something, and which is therefore against the law.

ext.ext_cn: 诽谤他的报纸已经向他提出支付赔偿金。
ext.ext_en: The newspaper which libelled him had already offered compensation.

defs.def_en: To libel someone means to write or print something in a book, newspaper, or magazine which wrongly damages that person's reputation and is therefore against the law.

ext.ext_cn: 你竟敢跟我顶嘴!
ext.ext_en: How dare you talk back to me!...

ext.ext_cn: 我顶了嘴，反问了几句。
ext.ext_en: I talked back and asked questions.

defs.def_en: If you talk back to someone in authority such as a parent or teacher, you answer them in a rude way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 使人想起的;使人忆起的

ext.ext_cn: 这种布置让人想起都市里的艺术休闲中心。
ext.ext_en: The decor was reminiscent of a municipal arts-and-leisure centre...

ext.ext_cn: 她低头的姿势让人想起皇室风范。
ext.ext_en: She bowed her head in a gesture somehow reminiscent of royalty.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing is reminiscent of another, you mean that it reminds you of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 怀旧的微笑慢慢浮现在她脸上。
ext.ext_en: A slow, reminiscent smile spread over her face.

defs.def_en: A reminiscent look or smile is a look or smile which shows that you are remembering something from the past, usually with pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 他的领带扯松了，领口也敞着。
ext.ext_en: His tie was pulled loose and his collar hung open.

ext.ext_cn: 配有一个大大的假毛皮领的大衣
ext.ext_en: ...a coat with a huge fake fur collar.

defs.def_en: See also:blue-collar;dog-collar;white-collar;The collar of a shirt or coat is the part which fits round the neck and is usually folded over.
A collar is a band of leather or plastic which is put round the neck of a dog or cat.

ext.ext_cn: 克尔往出口方向逃窜，博伊科特在验票口逮住了他。
ext.ext_en: As Kerr fled towards the exit, Boycott collared him at the ticket barrier.

defs.def_en: If you collar someone who has done something wrong or who is running away, you catch them and hold them so that they cannot escape.

ext.ext_cn: 贝蒂设法在走廊里拦住了阿特金斯，和他谈了几句话。
ext.ext_en: Beattie managed to collar Atkins in a hallway...

ext.ext_cn: 有一次，伯纳德在索霍区被一个气势汹汹的陌生人拦住，硬要与他说话。
ext.ext_en: Bernard was once collared by an aggressive stranger in Soho.

defs.def_en: If you collar someone, you stop them and make them listen  to you.

ext.ext_cn: 你们当中有些人对皇室成员非常恼火。
ext.ext_en: Some of you were getting very hot under the collar about Royals.

defs.def_en: If someone gets hot under the collar about something, they get very annoyed, angry, or excited about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我几个儿子都很挑食。
ext.ext_en: My boys have always been faddy eaters.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as faddy, you mean that they have very strong likes and dislikes, especially about what they eat, which you think are rather silly.

defs.def_cn: (英格兰南部及威尔士的)睡鼠，榛睡鼠
defs.def_en: A dormouse is a small animal that looks like a mouse. It is found in southern England and Wales.
A fire extinguisher is a metal cylinder which contains water or chemicals at high pressure which can put out fires.

ext.ext_cn: 呃——真是可怕极了。
ext.ext_en: Ugh — it was horrible.

defs.def_en: Ugh is used in writing to represent the sound that people make if they think something is unpleasant, horrible, or disgusting.

ext.ext_cn: 关于此事，公众当然已经听腻了。
ext.ext_en: The public is certainly getting tired of hearing about it...

ext.ext_cn: 几乎可以肯定，这些炸弹是一个更大的阴谋的一部分。
ext.ext_en: The bombs are almost certainly part of a much bigger conspiracy...

defs.def_en: You use certainly to emphasize what you are saying when you are making a statement.

ext.ext_cn: “无论如何，你们都是好朋友吧。”——“那当然。”
ext.ext_en: 'In any case you remained friends.' — 'Certainly.'...

ext.ext_cn: “你会离他们远远的，是吧？”——“一点儿不假。”
