ext.ext_en: 'You keep out of their way don't you?' — 'I certainly do.'

defs.def_en: You use certainly when you are agreeing with what someone has said.

ext.ext_cn: “也许，我完全退出更好吧。”——“当然不是！”
ext.ext_en: 'Perhaps it would be better if I withdrew altogether.' — 'Certainly not!'

defs.def_en: You say certainly not when you want to say 'no' in a strong way.

defs.def_cn: (人或车)被大雪困住的，因大雪而受阻的

ext.ext_cn: 这个村子被大雪封住了。
ext.ext_en: The village became snowbound.

defs.def_en: If people or vehicles are snowbound, they cannot go anywhere because of heavy snow.
In a dictionary, a headword is a word which is followed by an explanation of its meaning.

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩的秃顶
ext.ext_en: ...Bryan's bald pate.

defs.def_en: Your pate is the top of your head.

defs.def_cn: 疟疾的；患疟疾的；（地区）感染疟疾的

ext.ext_cn: 疟疾寄生虫
ext.ext_en: ...malarial parasites.

defs.def_en: You can use malarial to refer to things connected with malaria or areas which are affected by malaria.

defs.def_cn: 捣鼓数字的人;和数字打交道的人

ext.ext_cn: 即便经济已经开始复苏，仍要过一段时间官方统计数字才能确认这一点。
ext.ext_en: Even if the recovery is under way, it may be some time before the official number crunchers confirm it.

defs.def_en: If you refer to number crunchers, you mean people whose jobs involve dealing with numbers or mathematical calculations, for example in finance or statistics.

defs.def_cn: 银根紧缩;财政紧缩;手头紧

ext.ext_cn: 财政紧缩时期，无疑要对公共支出进行严格审查。
ext.ext_en: In times of financial stringency it is clear that public expenditure has to be closely scrutinized.

defs.def_en: Financial stringency is a situation in which a government or person does not have much money or is trying not to spend much.

defs.def_cn: 喧嚣之地;热闹的娱乐场所

ext.ext_cn: 曼哈顿一家热闹喧哗的高级娱乐场所
ext.ext_en: ...a fancy Manhattan hot spot.

ext.ext_cn: 广受欢迎、意趣盎然的包价旅游热点
ext.ext_en: ...a popular and lively package tour hotspot.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an exciting place where there is a lot of activity or entertainment as a hot spot .

defs.def_cn: （发生战斗或政治动乱的）热点地区，多事之地

ext.ext_cn: 该地区有很多处于交火状态的热点。
ext.ext_en: There were many hot spots in the region, where fighting had been going on.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an area where there is fighting or serious political trouble as a hot spot.

defs.def_cn: 堡垒（指固守一种生活方式等的体制或组织）

ext.ext_cn: 一度固守着白人偏见的城镇
ext.ext_en: ...a town which had been a bastion of white prejudice...

ext.ext_cn: 精神自由的堡垒
ext.ext_en: ...a bastion of spiritual freedom...

defs.def_en: If a system or organization is described as a bastion of a particular way of life, it is seen as being important and effective in defending that way of life. Bastion can be used both when you think that this way of life should be ended and when you think it should be defended.
A zygote is an egg that has been fertilized by sperm, and which could develop into an embryo.

ext.ext_cn: 当顾问的精髓就在于倾听并考虑咨询者的观点。
ext.ext_en: The essence of consultation is to listen to, and take account of, the views of those consulted.

ext.ext_cn: 生活的本质
ext.ext_en: ...the essence of life...

defs.def_en: The essence of something is its basic and most important characteristic which gives it its individual identity.

ext.ext_cn: 几滴香草精油
ext.ext_en: ...a few drops of vanilla essence.

ext.ext_cn: 具有异国情调的沐浴香精
ext.ext_en: ...exotic bath essences.

defs.def_en: Essence is a very concentrated liquid that is used for flavouring food or for its smell.

ext.ext_cn: 一首18世纪的关于几个迷路小孩的叙事诗，名为《树林中的宝贝》
ext.ext_en: ...an eighteenth century ballad about some lost children called the Babes in the Wood.

defs.def_en: A ballad is a long song or poem which tells a story in simple language.

defs.def_cn: （节奏舒缓的）流行抒情歌曲，情歌

ext.ext_cn: 《猜不透的巴黎》是他创作的最为优美动听的情歌之一。
ext.ext_en: 'You Don't Know Paris' is one of the most beautiful ballads that he ever wrote.

defs.def_en: A ballad is a slow, romantic, popular song.
VD is used to refer to diseases such as syphilis and gonorrhoea which are passed on by sexual intercourse. VD is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'venereal disease'.

defs.def_cn: (用于指代可能存在但无法辨别性别的人)她或他

ext.ext_cn: 和你的医生谈谈，看其是否知道一些当地的组织。
ext.ext_en: Talk to your doctor and see if s/he knows of any local groups.

defs.def_en: Some writers use s/he instead of either 'he' or 'she' when they are referring to someone who might exist but who has not been identified. By using s/he, the writer does not need to say whether the person is male or female.

ext.ext_cn: 柏林市民喝香槟、放焰火、鸣车笛。
ext.ext_en: Berlin people drank champagne, set off fireworks and tooted their car horns.

ext.ext_cn: 焰火表演
ext.ext_en: ...a firework display.

defs.def_en: Fireworks are small objects that are lit to entertain people on special occasions. They contain chemicals and burn brightly or attractively, often with a loud noise, when you light them.

ext.ext_cn: 观看焰火表演的那天晚上，我们找了一个非常好的位置。
ext.ext_en: On the night of the fireworks we had a really good spot.

defs.def_en: You use fireworks to refer to an occasion on which fireworks are lit to entertain people.

defs.def_cn: 精彩难忘的演出(或作品)

ext.ext_cn: 该剧在制作上一如既往地花费了心思，舞台演出效果也相当精彩。
ext.ext_en: It is given a typically thoughtful production with just enough theatrical fireworks.

defs.def_en: An exciting and impressive performance or piece of writing can be referred to as fireworks .

ext.ext_cn: 该国的经济问题很大程度上是因为复苏乏力。
ext.ext_en: The country's economic problems are largely due to the weakness of the recovery...

ext.ext_cn: 如果说这次旅行获得了成功,那很大程度上要归功于格林先生的努力。
ext.ext_en: If the trip is a success, a lot of this will be due to Mr Green's efforts.

defs.def_en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

defs.def_cn: 由于,因为(构成原因状语,有些英语国家的人认为该用法不正确)

ext.ext_cn: 因信件数量繁多,戴夫无法亲自答复提出的问题，他为此表示歉意。
ext.ext_en: Due to the large volume of letters he receives Dave regrets he is unable to answer queries personally...

ext.ext_cn: 因横扫欧洲的政治变故,国防行业中有些人可能会失业。
ext.ext_en: Jobs could be lost in the defence industry due to political changes sweeping Europe.

defs.def_en: You can say due to to introduce the reason for something happening. Some speakers of English believe that it is not correct to use due to in this way.

defs.def_cn: 到期的;预期的;预定到达的

ext.ext_cn: 预计月底会有结果。
ext.ext_en: The results are due at the end of the month...

ext.ext_cn: 第一批提价预计将在7月开始执行。
ext.ext_en: The first price increases are due to come into force in July...

defs.def_en: If something is due at a particular time, it is expected to happen, be done, or arrive at that time.

ext.ext_cn: 充分考虑之后决定将他送到养父母那儿生活。
ext.ext_en: After due consideration it was decided to send him away to live with foster parents...

ext.ext_cn: 我真希望人们使用人行道并给予应有的关注。
ext.ext_en: I do hope that people will make use of footpaths and treat them with due attention that is needed.

defs.def_en: Due attention or consideration is the proper, reasonable, or deserved amount of it under the circumstances.

defs.def_cn: 应有的;应得的;应得到的

ext.ext_cn: 我收到了一张 1,525 英镑的支票，并被告知我应得的养老金到此为止。
ext.ext_en: I was sent a cheque for £1,525 and advised that no further pension was due...

ext.ext_cn: 我打算利用应享有的假期去塔斯马尼亚呆两周。
ext.ext_en: I've got some leave due to me and I was going to Tasmania for a fortnight.

defs.def_en: Something that is due, or that is due to someone, is owed to them, either as a debt or because they have a right to it.

defs.def_cn: (期待很长时间后)预期应得的,预计应到的

ext.ext_cn: 副总督察给我打电话说,“史密斯小姐,你知道你要搬家了吗？”
ext.ext_en: The deputy chief inspector rang me up and said, 'Miss Smith, you know you are due for a move?'...

ext.ext_cn: 他要到 2020 年才能被释放。
ext.ext_en: He is not due for release until 2020.

defs.def_en: If someone is due for something, that thing is planned to happen or be given to them now, or very soon, often after they have been waiting for it for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 在一月最后期限前联合国 180 个成员国只有 18 个缴纳了会费。
ext.ext_en: Only 18 of the UN's 180 members had paid their dues by the January deadline.

defs.def_en: Dues are sums of money that you give regularly to an organization that you belong to, for example a social club or trade union, in order to pay for being a member.

ext.ext_cn: 他们朝正北方向行进了。
ext.ext_en: They headed due north...

ext.ext_cn: 泰晤士河从牛津向正南方向流去，穿过阿宾顿的集镇。
ext.ext_en: The Thames flows due south from Oxford, through the market town of Abingdon.

defs.def_en: Due is used before the words 'north', 'south', 'east', or 'west' to indicate that something is in exactly the direction mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 在适当的时候;到一定的时候

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿足月降生了。
ext.ext_en: In due course the baby was born...

ext.ext_cn: 计划将在适当的时候公布。
ext.ext_en: The arrangements will be published in due course.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen or take place in due course, you mean that you cannot make it happen any quicker and it will happen when the time is right for it.

defs.def_cn: 给…以应有的评价;公道地对待…

ext.ext_cn: 说句公道话,琳达努力规劝过约翰要好好学习。
ext.ext_en: To give Linda her due, she had tried to encourage John in his school work.

ext.ext_cn: (发表不同意见前的谦语)恕我冒昧,恕我直言
ext.ext_en: You can say 'with due respect' when you are about to disagree politely with someone.

defs.def_en: You can say 'to give him his due', or 'giving him his due' when you are admitting that there are some good things about someone, even though there are things that you do not like about them.

defs.def_cn: （心脏）悸动，急速而不规则地跳动

ext.ext_cn: 他突然感到眩晕，心脏开始悸动。
ext.ext_en: He felt suddenly faint, and his heart began to palpitate.

defs.def_en: If someone's heart palpitates, it beats very fast in an irregular way, because they are frightened or anxious.

ext.ext_cn: 她躺在床上，闭着眼，胸部起伏不定。
ext.ext_en: She lay on the bed, her eyes closed and her bosom palpitating.

defs.def_en: If something palpitates,  it shakes or seems to shake.

ext.ext_cn: 温和派散布说人们不应该把共和党大会上说的话太当真。
ext.ext_en: Moderates are putting it about that people shouldn't take the things said at the Republican Convention too seriously...

ext.ext_cn: 国王连续数月都在散布骇人听闻的谣言。
ext.ext_en: The King had been putting about lurid rumours for months.

defs.def_en: If you put something about, you tell it to people that you meet and cause it to become well-known.
A pleasure boat is a large boat which takes people for trips on rivers, lakes, or on the sea for pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 新闻和广播报道之间的出入
ext.ext_en: ...the discrepancy between press and radio reports.

ext.ext_cn: 同类情况下索赔人所获款项的巨大差异
ext.ext_en: ...major discrepancies in payments made to claimants in similar circumstances.

defs.def_en: If there is a discrepancy between two things that ought to be the same, there is a noticeable difference between them.

ext.ext_cn: 女人们处理羊毛,纺羊毛并给羊毛染色。
ext.ext_en: The women prepared, spun and dyed the wool...

ext.ext_cn: 她将她的黑头发染了色。
ext.ext_en: She had dyed black hair.

defs.def_en: If you dye something such as hair or cloth, you change its colour by soaking it in a special liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 一瓶瓶染发剂
ext.ext_en: ...bottles of hair dye.

defs.def_en: Dye is a substance made from plants or chemicals which is mixed into a liquid and used to change the colour of something such as cloth or hair.

defs.def_cn: 骗人的鬼话;空话;诡计;花招

ext.ext_cn: 全都是些部长们常说的骗人鬼话和少不了的奉承恭维。
ext.ext_en: There was all the usual humbug and obligatory compliments from ministers...

ext.ext_cn: 英国的同性恋法律都是虚伪的空话连篇。
ext.ext_en: Britain's laws on homosexuality are hypocritical humbug.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's language or behaviour as humbug, you mean that it is dishonest or insincere.

ext.ext_cn: 那人真是个令人作呕的伪君子！
ext.ext_en: What a revolting humbug the man was!

defs.def_en: You can refer to a person as a humbug when you think they are being dishonest, insincere, or pretending to be someone who they are not.
A humbug is a hard, striped sweet that tastes of peppermint.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (局势、时期)令人紧张的，让人焦虑的

ext.ext_cn: 这一友好姿态基本上没有改善会谈的紧张气氛。
ext.ext_en: This gesture of goodwill did little to improve the tense atmosphere at the talks...

ext.ext_en: For ten days I continued in this state.

defs.def_en: If you continue in a particular direction, you keep walking or travelling in that direction.

ext.ext_en: The main road continues towards Viterbo before turning right to Bolsena.

defs.def_en: If a road or path continues somewhere, it goes there after the place you have mentioned.

ext.ext_en: In Italy, as elsewhere, television has made deep inroads into cinema.

defs.def_cn: 毛里求斯的;毛里求斯人的;毛里求斯文化的
defs.def_en: Mauritian means belonging or relating  to Mauritius, or to its people or culture.

defs.def_en: A Mauritian is a Mauritian citizen, or a person of Mauritian origin.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （气候或条件）艰苦的，恶劣的，严峻的

ext.ext_cn: 恶劣的沙漠环境
ext.ext_en: ...the harsh desert environment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the cold, harsh cruelty of her husband...

ext.ext_cn: 他以尖刻恶毒的语言大肆抨击自己的对手。
ext.ext_en: He said many harsh and unkind things about his opponents.

defs.def_en: Harsh actions or speech are unkind and show no understanding or sympathy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Tropical colours may look rather harsh in our dull northern light.

ext.ext_cn: 会让发质变脆弱的刺激性较强的洗发水
ext.ext_en: ...harsher detergents that can leave hair brittle.

defs.def_en: Something that is harsh is so hard, bright, or rough that it seems unpleasant or harmful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 可惜她的嗓门太大太难听了。
ext.ext_en: It's a pity she has such a loud harsh voice.

defs.def_en: Harsh voices and sounds are ones that are rough and unpleasant to listen to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 残酷的事实是，谁死谁活在很大程度上要靠运气。
ext.ext_en: The harsh truth is that luck plays a big part in who will live or die.

defs.def_en: If you talk about harsh realities or facts, or the harsh truth, you are emphasizing that they are true or real, although they are unpleasant and people try to avoid thinking about them.

defs.def_cn: 从理论上说明;建立理论

ext.ext_cn: 警方推测那些杀手可能会假装成搭便车的人。
ext.ext_en: Police are theorizing that the killers may be posing as hitchhikers...

ext.ext_cn: 通过研究人们的行为方式，我们可以从中推断他们内心的想法。
ext.ext_en: By studying the way people behave, we can theorize about what is going on in their mind.

defs.def_en: If you theorize that something is true or theorize about it, you develop an abstract idea or set of ideas about something in order to explain it.

defs.def_cn: 拖车式活动房屋停车场
defs.def_en: A trailer park is an area where people can pay to park their trailers and live in them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自然的;正常的;合乎常情的

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人追求开快车的刺激是太正常不过的事情。
ext.ext_en: It is only natural for youngsters to crave the excitement of driving a fast car...

ext.ext_cn: 他怨恨你是很自然的事。
ext.ext_en: It is only natural that he should resent you...

defs.def_en: If you say that it is natural for someone to act in a particular way or for something to happen in that way, you mean that it is reasonable in the circumstances.

defs.def_cn: (行为)出于本性的，生来就有的

ext.ext_cn: 昆虫进食的本能
ext.ext_en: ...the insect's natural instinct to feed...

ext.ext_cn: 我们觉得受到威胁或遭受挫折时本能地会感到气愤。
ext.ext_en: Anger is the natural reaction we experience when we feel threatened or frustrated.

defs.def_en: Natural behaviour is shared by all people or all animals of a particular type and has not been learned.

ext.ext_cn: 她有一种洞察他人动机的天赋。
ext.ext_en: She has a natural ability to understand the motives of others...

ext.ext_cn: 他有做生意的天分。
ext.ext_en: He had a natural flair for business.

defs.def_en: Someone with a natural ability or skill was born with that ability and did not have to learn it.

ext.ext_cn: 他天生就会摆弄各种发动机。
ext.ext_en: He's a natural with any kind of engine...

ext.ext_cn: 事实证明她在镜头前很有表演天赋。
ext.ext_en: She proved to be a natural on camera.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a natural, you mean that they do something very well and very easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻松自如的;不局促的;不做作的

ext.ext_cn: 贝唐的妹妹和她家的其他人一样友好、随意。
ext.ext_en: Bethan's sister was as friendly and natural as the rest of the family...

ext.ext_cn: 汉娜轻松自然的举止消除了她的疑虑，于是她放松了下来。
ext.ext_en: Hannah's natural manner reassured her, and she relaxed.

defs.def_en: If someone's behaviour is natural, they appear to be relaxed and are not trying to hide anything.

defs.def_cn: 非人为的;自然的;天然的

ext.ext_cn: 它称这次台风为韩国多年来最严重的自然灾害。
ext.ext_en: It has called the typhoon the worst natural disaster in South Korea in many years...

ext.ext_cn: 巨型天然港普尔港是船只的避风港。
ext.ext_en: The gigantic natural harbour of Poole is a haven for boats.

defs.def_en: Natural things exist or occur in nature and are not made or caused by people.

defs.def_cn: (父母或子女)亲生的，有血缘关系的

ext.ext_cn: 她和亲生母亲团聚了。
ext.ext_en: She has been reunited with her natural mother...

ext.ext_cn: 他对继子女的关爱和投入不会减少他对亲生孩子的责任。
ext.ext_en: His commitments to the stepchildren will not reduce his obligation to his natural children.

defs.def_en: Someone's natural parent is their biological father or mother, as opposed to an adult who is looking after them or has adopted them. Someone's natural child is their biological son or daughter, as opposed to a child they are looking after or have adopted.

defs.def_cn: (音符)本位音的，标有还原号的

ext.ext_cn: 本位音
ext.ext_en: ...B natural. B

ext.ext_cn: 那个F是本位音还是升半音？
ext.ext_en: Is that F a natural or a sharp?

defs.def_en: In music, a natural note is the ordinary note, not its sharp or flat form.

ext.ext_cn: 根据内政部的调查，你哥哥属正常死亡。
ext.ext_en: According to the Home Office, your brother died of natural causes...

ext.ext_cn: 一名囚犯昨天突然倒下死了，看上去像是正常死亡。
ext.ext_en: A prisoner collapsed and died yesterday, apparently from natural causes.

defs.def_en: If someone dies of or from natural causes, they die because they are ill or old rather than because of an accident or violence.

ext.ext_cn: 现在将开始在老鼠身上做实验以验证该假设。
ext.ext_en: Work will now begin to test the hypothesis in rats...

ext.ext_cn: 人们已经提出不同的假说来解释为什么这些食物更有可能带来问题。
ext.ext_en: Different hypotheses have been put forward to explain why these foods are more likely to cause problems.

defs.def_en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

defs.def_cn: 自然主义，写实主义(一种文学和艺术理论)
defs.def_en: Naturalism is a theory in art and literature which states that people and things should be shown in a realistic way.

defs.def_cn: （尤指下午在大型私家花园举行的）游园会，露天招待会
defs.def_en: A garden party is a formal party that is held out of doors, especially in a large private garden, during the afternoon.

ext.ext_cn: 他们相信巫术。
ext.ext_en: They believe in magic...

ext.ext_cn: 利用法术与强敌或敌对势力作战
ext.ext_en: ...the use of magic to combat any adverse powers or influences...

defs.def_en: Magic is the power to use supernatural forces to make impossible things happen, such as making people disappear or controlling events in nature.

ext.ext_cn: 这一切被认为会创造奇迹。
ext.ext_en: All this was supposed to work magic...

ext.ext_cn: 这幅画立刻就会出现，好像变魔术一般！
ext.ext_en: The picture will now appear, as if by magic!

defs.def_en: You can use magic when you are referring to an event that is so wonderful, strange, or unexpected that it seems as if supernatural powers have caused it. You can also say that something happens as if by magic or like magic .

defs.def_cn: (似)用魔法变成的;(似)用魔术变出的

ext.ext_cn: 那么，这是个神药？
ext.ext_en: So it's a magic potion?

ext.ext_cn: 有助于保持肌肤光滑的奇效成分
ext.ext_en: ...the magic ingredient that helps to keep skin looking smooth.

defs.def_en: You use magic to describe something that does things, or appears to do things, by magic.

ext.ext_cn: 他私底下有变戏法的嗜好。
ext.ext_en: His secret hobby: performing magic tricks.

defs.def_en: Magic is the art and skill of performing mysterious tricks to entertain people, for example by making things appear and disappear.

ext.ext_cn: 逝去的岁月让他们平添了几分魅力。
ext.ext_en: It infected them with some of the magic of a lost age...

ext.ext_cn: 爱情的魔力也许根本无法解释。
ext.ext_en: There can be a magic about love that defies all explanation...

defs.def_en: If you refer to the magic of something, you mean that it has a special mysterious quality which makes it seem wonderful and exciting to you and which makes you feel happy.

ext.ext_cn: 这位斗士相信自己仍然可以恢复从前的一些魔力。
ext.ext_en: The fighter believes he can still regain some of his old magic.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a person's magic, you mean a special talent or ability that they have, which you admire or consider very impressive.

defs.def_cn: （数目、词语等）重要的，关键的，举足轻重的

ext.ext_en: ...their quest to gain the magic number of 270 electoral votes on Election Day.

ext.ext_cn: 开启私人世界的咒语
ext.ext_en: ...the magic word that opened doors onto private worlds.

defs.def_en: You can use expressions such as the magic number and the magic word to indicate that a number or word is the one which is significant or desirable in a particular situation.

ext.ext_en: There is no magic formula for producing winning products...

ext.ext_en: There is no magic cure.

defs.def_en: Magic is used in expressions such as there is no magic formula and there is no magic solution to say that someone will have to make an effort to solve a problem, because it will not solve itself.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极好的;了不起的;非常棒的

ext.ext_cn: 真是太棒了——这是我生命中最美好的一天。
ext.ext_en: It was magic—one of the best days of my life.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is magic, you think it is very good or enjoyable.

ext.ext_en: Airlines would prefer to update rather than retrain crews.

ext.ext_en: ...a weather update.

ext.ext_en: I would just update them on any news we might have.

ext.ext_en: The nation's electronics industry made important strides this year to even up its balance of trade...

ext.ext_en: I would like to see the championship evened up a little bit more.

ext.ext_en: Michael knelt next to her and scooped her into his arms.

ext.ext_en: ...the sound of a spoon scooping dog food out of a can.

ext.ext_en: All the newspapers really want to do is scoop the opposition.

ext.ext_en: This discovery seems to validate the claims of popular astrology.

ext.ext_en: ...how that evidence was evaluated and validated by historians.

ext.ext_en: The Academy Awards appear to validate his career.

defs.def_en: To validate a person, state, or system means to prove or confirm that they are valuable or worthwhile.

ext.ext_cn: 特别内阁委员会包括布朗先生、曼德尔森先生和斯特劳先生。

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone being given a particular task or job as their assignment to the task or job.

defs.def_cn: 意想不到的事;突如其来的事;令人惊奇的事(或消息等)

ext.ext_en: The Foreign Office in London has expressed surprise at these allegations...

ext.ext_en: 'You mean he's going to vote against her?' Scobie asked in surprise...

defs.def_cn: 使惊奇;使诧异;使感到意外

ext.ext_en: Surprise a new neighbour with one of your favourite home-made dishes.

defs.def_en: If you surprise someone, you give them, tell them, or do something pleasant that they are not expecting.

defs.def_cn: 使人惊异(或意想不到)的事物;让人大吃一惊的人

ext.ext_cn: 森加·麦克菲，三个月前世界锦标赛上的一匹黑马
ext.ext_en: ...Senga MacFie, one of the surprises of the World Championships three months ago...

ext.ext_cn: 为了给我一个惊喜，父亲决定往我的钱包里多塞一些零花钱。
ext.ext_en: My father decided to slip a little extra spending money into my purse as a surprise.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as a surprise, you mean that they are very good or pleasant although you were not expecting this.

defs.def_cn: 突袭;使措手不及;使毫无防备

ext.ext_cn: 马尔伯勒带领他的部队穿过莱茵河，在离布莱尼姆村不远的地方向法国和巴伐利亚联军发动了突袭。
ext.ext_en: Marlborough led his armies across the Rhine and surprised the French and Bavarian armies near the village of Blenheim.

defs.def_en: If you surprise someone, you attack, capture, or find them when they are not expecting it.

defs.def_cn: 一点儿都不稀奇;可想而知

ext.ext_cn: 胡萝卜紧缺，于是大家都去种胡萝卜。等到来年这个时候，可想而知，胡萝卜就会过剩。
ext.ext_en: There is a shortage of carrots. So everybody starts growing carrots. Next season, surprise, surprise, there is a glut of carrots.

defs.def_en: You can say 'surprise, surprise' if you disapprove of something because it is not surprising or original, or could easily have been predicted.

defs.def_cn: (用于遇见熟人或给别人一些意想不到的东西时)想不到吧

ext.ext_cn: 我正要去淋浴时他回来了。“想不到吧，”他说。
ext.ext_en: He came back in as I was heading up to the shower. 'Surprise, surprise,' he said.

defs.def_en: You can say 'surprise, surprise' if you meet someone you know or give them something when they are not expecting it.

ext.ext_cn: 他提的问题让他的两个伙伴都愣住了。
ext.ext_en: His question took his two companions by surprise...

ext.ext_cn: 每次英国下雪，我们都会感到惊讶。
ext.ext_en: Whenever it snows in Britain we are taken by surprise.

defs.def_en: If something takes you by surprise, it happens when you are not expecting it or when you are not prepared for it.

defs.def_cn: (理论或故事的)可信性，真实性

ext.ext_cn: 需要进行认真的研究，以让人们相信在这一重要领域可以取得真正的进展。
ext.ext_en: Good studies are needed to lend credence to the notion that genuine progress can be made in this important field.

defs.def_en: If something lends or gives credence to a theory or story, it makes it easier to believe.

ext.ext_cn: 你肯定不会相信海斯的说法吧？
ext.ext_en: You're surely not giving any credence to this story of Hythe's?

defs.def_en: If you give credence to a theory or story, you believe it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 盈利的；有利润的；赚钱的

ext.ext_cn: 制药业是美国利润最丰厚的业务。
ext.ext_en: Drug manufacturing is the most profitable business in America...

ext.ext_cn: 生产大量的食物能让他们获利。
ext.ext_en: It was profitable for them to produce large amounts of food.

defs.def_en: A profitable organization or practice makes a profit.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有利可图的；有益的；有用的

ext.ext_cn: 有利于人员和观念交流的合作
ext.ext_en: ...collaboration which leads to a profitable exchange of personnel and ideas.

defs.def_en: Something that is profitable results in some benefit for you.
A ski jump is a specially-built steep slope covered in snow whose lower end curves upwards. People ski down it and go into the air at the end.

ext.ext_cn: 要是一天23小时被关在一间牢房里，谁都会造反的。
ext.ext_en: You become a rebel if you are banged up in a cell 23 hours a day.

defs.def_en: When a prisoner is banged up, they are put in prison and locked in a cell.

defs.def_cn: (尤指出于政治原因的)拘留，扣押，监禁

ext.ext_cn: 对政府批评者未经审讯的关押
ext.ext_en: ...the detention without trial of government critics...

ext.ext_cn: 他们从6月底以来就一直受到监禁。
ext.ext_en: They have been held in detention since the end of June...

defs.def_en: Detention is when someone is arrested or put into prison, especially for political reasons.

defs.def_cn: (惩罚顽皮学童的)放学后留校

ext.ext_cn: 老师将这些男生课后留堂。
ext.ext_en: The teacher kept the boys in detention after school.

defs.def_en: Detention is a punishment for naughty schoolchildren, who are made to stay at school after the other children have gone home.

defs.def_cn: (商店)适合驾车购物的;（餐馆）提供免下车服务的

ext.ext_cn: 得来速汉堡屋
ext.ext_en: ...a drive-through burger bar.

defs.def_en: A drive-through shop or restaurant is one where you can buy things without leaving your car.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沉闷的;枯燥无味的;令人沮丧的

ext.ext_cn: 位于中西部的沉闷的小镇
ext.ext_en: ...a dreary little town in the Midwest...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的生活如此乏味！
ext.ext_en: They live such dreary lives.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as dreary, you mean that it is dull and depressing.

defs.def_cn: (未到庭证人提供的)作证书，书面证词

ext.ext_cn: 陪审团听取了长达 200 页的书面证词。
ext.ext_en: The jury heard 200 pages of depositions.

defs.def_en: A deposition is a formal written statement, made for example by a witness to a crime, which can be used in a court of law if the witness cannot be present.

ext.ext_cn: 海岸边泥沙的不断沉积对于抑制海平面的上升起着至关重要的作用。
ext.ext_en: Continued deposition of silt along the coast is crucial in counteracting the rise in sea level...

ext.ext_cn: 这导致钙在血管中沉积。
ext.ext_en: This leads to calcium deposition in the blood-vessels.

defs.def_en: Deposition is a process in which layers of a substance are formed inside something or on its surface over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 正是这件事导致了国王被废黜。
ext.ext_en: It was this issue which led to the deposition of the king.

defs.def_en: The deposition of a political leader is the removal of him or her from office.

defs.def_cn: 泰国的;泰国人的;泰语的;泰国文化的

ext.ext_cn: 泰国菜棒极了。
ext.ext_en: Thai food is terrific.

ext.ext_cn: 泰国商人
ext.ext_en: ...Thai businessmen.

defs.def_en: Thai means belonging or relating to Thailand, or to its people, language, or culture.
A Thai is a citizen of Thailand, or a person of Thai origin.
Thai is the language spoken in Thailand.

ext.ext_cn: 你在电影院消费的一大部分钱都会回到电影发行商手里。
ext.ext_en: A lot of the money that you pay at the cinema goes back to the film distributors...

ext.ext_cn: 应该允许运动员拍广告挣钱。
ext.ext_en: Players should be allowed to earn money from advertising...

defs.def_en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the sum that you have in a bank account.

ext.ext_cn: 我们起草了一份剩余欠款的还款计划。
ext.ext_en: We drew up a schedule of payments for the rest of the monies owed.

ext.ext_cn: 养老基金对资金的投资与管理
ext.ext_en: ...the investment and management of monies by pension funds.

defs.def_en: Monies is used to refer to several separate sums of money that form part of a larger amount that is received or spent.

defs.def_cn: 有花不完的钱;钱多得烫手;钱多得烧包

ext.ext_cn: 他是高收入的经纪人，有花不完的钱。
ext.ext_en: He was a high-earning broker with money to burn.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has  money to burn, you mean that they have more money than they need or that they spend their money on things that you think are unnecessary.

defs.def_cn: 非常有钱的;手头宽裕的

ext.ext_cn: 如果你有幸成为其中一个被选中参加表演的来电者，就可能会赚大钱。
ext.ext_en: If you are one of the lucky callers chosen to play, you could be in the money.

defs.def_en: If you are in the money, you have a lot of money to spend.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在城市找不到工作，也赚不到钱。
ext.ext_en: They couldn't find work or make money in the cities.

ext.ext_cn: 公司唯一一直赚钱的一小块业务
ext.ext_en: ...the only bit of the firm that consistently made money.

defs.def_en: If you make money, you obtain money by earning it or by making a profit.

defs.def_cn: 用行动证明自己的话；说到做到;说给钱就给钱

ext.ext_cn: 政府也许会被迫付出行动，以兑现承诺。
ext.ext_en: The government might be obliged to put its money where its mouth is to prove its commitment.

defs.def_en: If you say that you want someone to put their money where their mouth is, you want them to spend money to improve a bad situation, instead of just talking about improving it.

defs.def_cn: (因掌握内情而下的)高明赌注

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队没有参赛，所以人们看好德国队应该会赢。
ext.ext_en: With England not playing, the smart money was on the Germans...

defs.def_en: If you say that the smart money is on a particular person or thing, you mean that people who know a lot about it think that this person will be successful, or this thing will happen.

defs.def_cn: 金钱万能;有钱能使鬼推磨

ext.ext_cn: 好莱坞的生存规则很简单，就是金钱万能。
ext.ext_en: The formula in Hollywood is simple—money talks.

defs.def_en: If you say that money talks, you mean that if someone has a lot of money, they also have a lot of power.

ext.ext_cn: 澳大利亚政府对这个问题的解决方案一直就是大把往里扔钱。
ext.ext_en: The Australian government's answer to the problem has been to throw money at it.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is throwing money at a problem, you are critical of them for trying to improve it by spending money on it, instead of doing more thoughtful and practical things to  improve it.

defs.def_cn: 花钱填无底洞;继续砸钱

ext.ext_cn: 进一步加大干预的力度只会是继续白扔钱。
ext.ext_en: Further heavy intervention would be throwing good money after bad.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is throwing good money after bad, you are critical of them for trying to improve a bad situation by spending more money on it, instead of doing more thoughtful or practical things to improve it.

defs.def_cn: 钱花得值;物有所值；没白忙活

ext.ext_cn: 粉丝们的钱没白花。
ext.ext_en: The fans get their money's worth.

defs.def_en: If you get your money's worth, you get something which is worth the money that it costs or the effort you have put in.

defs.def_cn: 动乱国家;动荡地区;不安定地区
defs.def_en: A trouble spot is a country or an area of a country where there is repeated fighting between two or more groups of people.

ext.ext_cn: 风增强变冷了。
ext.ext_en: The wind had freshened.

defs.def_en: If the wind freshens, it becomes stronger and colder.

ext.ext_cn: 彻底刷牙有助于口气清新。
ext.ext_en: A thorough brushing helps to freshen up your mouth...

ext.ext_cn: 我的房间只要刷一点油漆就能焕然一新。
ext.ext_en: My room needed a lick of paint to freshen it up.

defs.def_en: If you freshen something up, you make it clean and pleasant in appearance or smell.

ext.ext_cn: 马蒂娜梳洗完毕后，他们出去散了一个长步。
ext.ext_en: After Martine had freshened up, they went for a long walk.

defs.def_en: If you freshen up, you wash your hands and face and make yourself look neat and tidy.

ext.ext_cn: 城堡仅有一小部分受损。
ext.ext_en: Damage was confined to a small portion of the castle...

ext.ext_cn: 我生命中相当长的一段时光是在这里度过的。
ext.ext_en: I have spent a fairly considerable portion of my life here...

defs.def_en: A portion of something is a part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 餐后甜点可以用一份新鲜水果代替。
ext.ext_en: Desserts can be substituted by a portion of fresh fruit...

ext.ext_cn: 每份饭菜分量都很足。
ext.ext_en: The portions were generous.

defs.def_en: A portion is the amount of food that is given to one person at a meal.

defs.def_cn: （衣服）上下身相连的，连体式的

ext.ext_cn: 蓝色的一件式泳装
ext.ext_en: ...a blue one-piece bathing suit.

defs.def_en: A one-piece article of clothing consists of one piece only, rather than two or more separate parts.

ext.ext_cn: 一件式泳装比比基尼穿上去更好看。
ext.ext_en: A one-piece is more flattering than a bikini.

defs.def_en: A one-piece is a type of woman's swimming costume that consists of one piece of material and which covers her chest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是个又高又胖、头发灰白的男子。
ext.ext_en: He was a tall, stout man with gray hair.

defs.def_en: A stout person is rather fat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我希望你们俩都有结实的鞋子。
ext.ext_en: I hope you've both got stout shoes...

ext.ext_cn: 老头捡起脚边的一根粗棍子。
ext.ext_en: The old man picked up a stout stick that lay by his feet.

defs.def_en: Stout shoes, branches, or other objects are thick and strong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行动、态度或信念)坚定的，坚决的，强有力的

ext.ext_cn: 他为汽车业进行了坚决的辩护。
ext.ext_en: He produced a stout defence of the car business...

ext.ext_cn: 入侵行动因遭遇到了出乎意料的顽强抵抗而受阻。
ext.ext_en: The invasion was held up by unexpectedly stout resistance.

defs.def_en: If you use stout to describe someone's actions, attitudes, or beliefs, you approve of them because they are strong and determined.

ext.ext_cn: 吉尼斯黑啤酒及其他爱尔兰烈性黑啤酒
ext.ext_en: ...Guinness and other Irish stouts.

defs.def_en: Stout is a strong dark-coloured beer.

ext.ext_cn: 他嘴唇的曲线
ext.ext_en: ...the curve of his lips.

ext.ext_cn: 道路的转弯
ext.ext_en: ...a curve in the road.

defs.def_en: A curve is a smooth, gradually bending line, for example part of the edge of a circle.

ext.ext_cn: 她的脊柱弯曲了。
ext.ext_en: Her spine curved...

ext.ext_cn: 他脚下的小径蜿蜒地伸向远方。
ext.ext_en: The track curved away below him.

defs.def_en: If something curves, or if someone or something curves it, it has the shape of a curve.

ext.ext_cn: 球在空中划出一道奇异的弧线。
ext.ext_en: The ball curved strangely in the air.

defs.def_en: If something curves, it moves in a curve, for example through the air.

defs.def_cn: (尤指用图表表示的)曲线变化

ext.ext_en: Each firm will face a downward-sloping demand curve...

ext.ext_cn: 这是否是原本良好的增长曲线中暂时的偏离？
ext.ext_en: Was it just a temporary blip on an otherwise healthy growth curve?

defs.def_en: See also:learning curve;You can refer to a change in something as a particular curve, especially when it is represented on a graph.

defs.def_cn: 使惊奇;使感到意外;给…出难题

ext.ext_cn: 在最后一刻，我给他们出了一个难题，说：“我们要带家属来。”
ext.ext_en: At the last minute, I threw them a curve ball by saying, 'We're going to bring spouses'.

defs.def_en: If someone throws you a curve or if they throw you a curve ball, they surprise you by doing something you do not expect.

defs.def_cn: (通常与 five,six,seven 等数词连用构成形容词)表示“…位数的”

ext.ext_cn: 哥伦比亚影业公司付给他一笔 6 位数的电影版权费。
ext.ext_en: Columbia Pictures paid him a six-figure sum for the film rights.

ext.ext_cn: 以总额达 5 位数的价格易手的珍藏品
ext.ext_en: ...collectors' pieces which change hands for five-figure sums.

defs.def_en: -figure combines with a number, usually 'five', 'six', or 'seven', to form adjectives which say how many figures are in a number. These adjectives usually describe a large amount of money. For example, a six-figure sum is between 100,000 and 999,999.
If someone has double glazing in their house, their windows are fitted with two layers of glass. People put in double glazing in order to keep buildings warmer or to keep out noise.

ext.ext_cn: 帆布包
ext.ext_en: ...a canvas bag.

defs.def_en: Canvas is a strong, heavy cloth that is used for making things such as tents, sails, and bags.
A canvas is a piece of canvas or similar material on which an oil painting can be done.

ext.ext_cn: 画展上有卡尔帕乔、卡纳莱托和瓜尔迪等大师们的油画作品。
ext.ext_en: The show includes canvases by masters like Carpaccio, Canaletto and Guardi.

defs.def_en: A canvas is a painting that has been done on canvas.

ext.ext_cn: 随着成千上万的人决定到户外宿营度假,新福里斯特的野营地很快人满为患。
ext.ext_en: Campsites in the New Forest quickly filled up as thousands decided to spend the holiday under canvas.

defs.def_en: If you are living and sleeping under canvas, you are living and sleeping in a tent.
A youth hostel is a place where people can stay cheaply when they are travelling.

defs.def_cn: 背叛(信仰)者;背信弃义者

ext.ext_cn: 一些人说他是工人阶级的叛徒。
ext.ext_en: Some say he's a traitor to the working class.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a traitor, you mean that they have betrayed beliefs that they used to hold, or that their friends hold, by their words or actions.

ext.ext_cn: 关于我们中间有叛徒向敌人通风报信的传言
ext.ext_en: ...rumours that there were traitors among us who were sending messages to the enemy.

defs.def_en: If someone is a traitor, they betray their country or a group of which they are a member by helping its enemies, especially during time of war.
A waiting room is a room in a place such as a railway station or a clinic, where people can sit down while they wait.
The sun's corona is its outer atmosphere.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 原始的；远古的；未开化的

ext.ext_cn: 对原始社会的研究
ext.ext_en: ...studies of primitive societies.

ext.ext_cn: 原始部落
ext.ext_en: ...primitive tribes.

defs.def_en: Primitive means belonging to a society in which people live in a very simple way, usually without industries or a writing system.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （动植物）原始的，低等的，进化初期的

ext.ext_cn: 原始鲸
ext.ext_en: ...primitive whales...

ext.ext_cn: 原始人必须要能作出这样的反应以逃避危险的动物。
ext.ext_en: Primitive humans needed to be able to react like this  to escape from dangerous animals...

defs.def_en: Primitive means belonging to a very early period in the development of an animal or plant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 无论用什么标准来衡量，其条件都很简陋。
ext.ext_en: The conditions are primitive by any standards...

ext.ext_cn: 那时候简陋的外科手术让他一只耳朵几乎失聪。
ext.ext_en: The primitive surgery of those days left him virtually deaf in one ear...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as primitive, you mean that it is very simple in style or very old-fashioned.

defs.def_cn: 不知情的；不知不觉的；无意的

ext.ext_cn: 我们都是该系统的不知情的受害者。
ext.ext_en: We're unwitting victims of the system...

ext.ext_cn: 它曾是布莱尔的无心之失。
ext.ext_en: It had been an unwitting blunder on Blair's part.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their actions as unwitting, you mean that the person does something or is involved in something without realizing it.
Shower gel is a type of liquid soap designed for use in the shower.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 军国主义的;好战的;黩武的

ext.ext_cn: 带有侵略性的军国主义政府
ext.ext_en: ...aggressive militaristic governments.

defs.def_en: Militaristic is used to describe groups, ideas, or policies which support the strengthening of the armed forces of their country in order to make it more powerful.

ext.ext_cn: 我们把工人和大学生安排在一起工作，对他们一视同仁。
ext.ext_en: We had proles working alongside university types as equals.

defs.def_en: A prole is someone in a low social class.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 皲裂的双手
ext.ext_en: ...chapped hands...

ext.ext_cn: 她的皮肤摸上去有些粗糙。
ext.ext_en: Her skin felt chapped.

defs.def_en: If your skin is chapped, it is dry, cracked, and sore.

ext.ext_cn: 25 名警察在被指控于调查谋杀案期间有非法行为之后受到调查。
ext.ext_en: 25 officers were investigated following allegations of improper conduct during the murder inquiry...

ext.ext_cn: 马修斯先生坚称他没有做过非法的事情。
ext.ext_en: Mr Matthews maintained that he had done nothing improper.

defs.def_en: Improper activities are illegal or dishonest.

ext.ext_cn: 用药不当会产生严重的不良反应。
ext.ext_en: The improper use of medicine could lead to severe adverse reactions.

defs.def_en: Improper conditions or methods of treatment are not suitable or good enough for a particular purpose.

defs.def_en: If something is compulsory, you must do it or accept it, because it is the law or because someone in a position of authority says you must.

defs.def_en: You can describe people and things as sexy if you think they are sexually exciting or sexually attractive.

defs.def_en: The announcer at a railway station or airport is the person who makes the announcements.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has shown fortitude, you admire them for being brave, calm, and uncomplaining when they have experienced something unpleasant or painful.

defs.def_cn: 使系统化;使成体系;使条理化

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

Blood money is money that is paid to someone for murdering someone.

defs.def_en: If someone mass-produces something, they make it in large quantities, usually by machine. This means that the product can be sold cheaply.

defs.def_en: If someone lurks somewhere, they wait there secretly so that they cannot be seen, usually because they intend to do something bad.

ext.ext_cn: 每部家庭式双排座小轿车都存在隐患。
ext.ext_en: Hidden dangers lurk in every family saloon car...

ext.ext_cn: 每个角落都暗藏着疑虑和不安。
ext.ext_en: Around every corner lurked doubt and uncertainty.

defs.def_en: If something such as a danger, doubt, or fear lurks somewhere, it exists but is not obvious or easily recognized.

ext.ext_cn: 这与其说是责备，还不如说是句玩笑呢。
ext.ext_en: It was a jest rather than a reproach...

ext.ext_cn: 男人们像往常一样高兴地聊着，彼此间随意开着玩笑。
ext.ext_en: The men talk as cheerfully as ever; jests are bandied about freely.

defs.def_en: A jest is something that you say that is intended to be amusing.

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢和老朋友喝喝酒、开开玩笑。
ext.ext_en: He enjoyed drinking and jesting with his cronies...

ext.ext_cn: 一份报纸半开玩笑地写道：要不是喝酒已经要了他的命，这肯定会让他想要喝上一杯。
ext.ext_en: A newspaper half jested: Had alcohol not already killed him, this would surely drive him to drink.

defs.def_en: If you jest, you tell jokes or say amusing things.

ext.ext_cn: 爷爷当时还没有从战场归来。
ext.ext_en: Grandpa was not yet back from the war.

defs.def_en: Your grandpa is your grandfather.

defs.def_cn: 不合适举止;不正当行为

ext.ext_cn: 他在财务作假的质疑声中辞职了。
ext.ext_en: He resigned amid allegations of financial impropriety.

defs.def_en: Impropriety is improper behaviour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有人暗示他们可能是特务,这让他非常气愤。
ext.ext_en: He is indignant at suggestions that they were secret agents...

ext.ext_cn: 政府没有事先征求他们的意见,下院议员们感到很愤怒。
ext.ext_en: MPs were indignant that the government had not consulted them...

defs.def_en: If you are indignant, you are shocked and angry, because you think that something is unjust or unfair.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在欧洲接受教育且思想已经完全西化的非洲人
ext.ext_en: ...Africans educated in Europe, and thoroughly Westernized in their thinking...

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须阻止我们的国家被逐渐西化。
ext.ext_en: We must stop our country becoming Westernized.

defs.def_en: A westernized country, place, or person has adopted ideas and behaviour typical of Europe and North America, rather than preserving the ideas and behaviour that are traditional in their culture.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有用的；可用的；有助益的

ext.ext_cn: 慢炖锅对于整天都不在家的人来说很有用。
ext.ext_en: The slow cooker is very useful for people who go out all day...

ext.ext_cn: 催眠疗法可能有助于你戒烟。
ext.ext_en: Hypnotherapy can be useful in helping you give up smoking...

defs.def_en: If something is useful, you can use it to do something or to help you in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 住处离会所有一段距离，所以租一辆车会很有用。
ext.ext_en: The accommodation is some distance from the clubhouse, so a hire car comes in useful.

defs.def_en: If an object or skill comes in useful, it can help you achieve something in a particular situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 种族（或民族）中心主义的;种族（或民族）优越感的

ext.ext_cn: 她的作品可能会被指责带有种族中心主义色彩。
ext.ext_en: Her work is open to the criticism that it is ethnocentric.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ethnocentric, you disagree with it because it is based on the belief that one particular race or nationality of people is superior to all others.
Fever blisters are small sore spots that sometimes appear on or near someone's lips and nose when they have a cold.

ext.ext_cn: 进入睡眠状态时，我们的脑电波振幅慢慢变大。
ext.ext_en: As we fall asleep the amplitude of brain waves slowly becomes greater.

defs.def_en: In physics, the amplitude of a sound wave or electrical signal is its strength.

ext.ext_cn: 有着19世纪的广阔思维的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a man of nineteenth-century amplitude.

defs.def_en: Amplitude is the quality of being large in size or quantity.

ext.ext_cn: 梅森回家睡了几个小时。
ext.ext_en: Mason went home for a couple of hours' kip.

defs.def_en: Kip is sleep.

defs.def_cn: （通常指不是在自己家或床上）睡觉

ext.ext_cn: 他从一个朋友的公寓搬到另一个朋友处，最初是睡在西奥多工作室的地板上。
ext.ext_en: He moved from one friend's flat to another, first kipping on the floor of Theodore's studio.

defs.def_en: If you kip somewhere, usually somewhere that is not your own home or bed, you sleep there.

defs.def_cn: 穿上特殊的套装;穿上制服

ext.ext_cn: “奋进”号的两名宇航员将穿上太空服进行太空行走。
ext.ext_en: Two members of Endeavour's crew will suit up for a space walk...

ext.ext_cn: 美国联邦调查局威名远扬的人质救援小组整装待命。
ext.ext_en: The FBI's renowned hostage rescue team was suited up and ready to go.

defs.def_en: If someone suits up, they put on a special suit or uniform in order to take part in a special activity or be part of a team.
Santa Claus or Santa is an imaginary old man with a long white beard and a red coat. Traditionally, young children in many countries are told that he brings their Christmas presents.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她身穿迷你裙和紧身上衣走下了飞机。
ext.ext_en: She walked off the plane in a miniskirt and tight top...

ext.ext_cn: 他的牛仔裤太紧了。
ext.ext_en: His jeans were too tight.

defs.def_en: Tight clothes or shoes are rather small and fit closely to your body.

ext.ext_cn: 她正好跌进我的怀里，一时间紧紧地抓着我。
ext.ext_en: She just fell into my arms, clutching me tight for a moment...

ext.ext_cn: 抓紧我的手，跟着我。
ext.ext_en: Just hold tight to my hand and follow along...

defs.def_en: If you hold someone or something tight, you hold them firmly and securely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那些措施包括对媒体报道的严格管制。
ext.ext_en: The measures include tight control of media coverage...

ext.ext_cn: 政府准备严格控制公共部门的工资增长。
ext.ext_en: The Government were prepared to keep a tight hold on public sector pay rises...

defs.def_en: Tight controls or rules are very strict.

defs.def_cn: 紧紧地;密不透风地;滴水不漏地

ext.ext_cn: 那个婴儿仰面躺着，两眼紧闭。
ext.ext_en: The baby lay on his back with his eyes closed tight...

ext.ext_cn: 我把面粉和食糖分别放在罐子里，并将玻璃盖子紧紧地盖上。
ext.ext_en: I keep the flour and sugar in individual jars, sealed tight with their glass lids...

defs.def_en: Something that is shut tight is shut very firmly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我的皮肤感觉紧巴巴的，缺少水分。
ext.ext_en: My skin feels tight and lacking in moisture...

ext.ext_cn: 把橡皮筋拽紧，两头打上结。
ext.ext_en: Pull the elastic tight and knot the ends.

defs.def_en: Skin, cloth, or string that is tight is stretched or pulled so that it is smooth or straight.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 紧密的;密集的;装得满满的

ext.ext_cn: 她蜷缩成一团，膝盖抵着下巴。
ext.ext_en: She curled up in a tight ball, with her knees tucked up at her chin...

ext.ext_cn: 那些男人密密匝匝地来了。
ext.ext_en: The men came in a tight group.

defs.def_en: Tight is used to describe a group of things or an amount of something that is closely packed together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 最好先伸展一下僵硬的肌肉。
ext.ext_en: It is better to stretch the tight muscles first...

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉走上前来，紧绷着脸，怒气冲冲。
ext.ext_en: Sarah came forward with a tight and angry face...

defs.def_en: If a part of your body is tight, it feels rather uncomfortable and painful, for example because you are ill, anxious, or angry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们关系很铁，所以的确保持着联系。
ext.ext_en: We're a tight group, so we do keep in touch.

defs.def_en: A tight group of people is one whose members are closely linked by beliefs, feelings, or interests.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们在一个急转弯处相撞，两辆车均严重受损。
ext.ext_en: They collided on a tight bend and both cars were extensively damaged.

defs.def_en: A tight bend or corner is one that changes direction very quickly so that you cannot see very far round it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (日程、预算)紧张的，回旋余地不大的

ext.ext_cn: 日程紧，很难把所有事情都安排进去。
ext.ext_en: It's difficult to cram everything into a tight schedule...

ext.ext_cn: 埃玛预算很紧，没有多少钱买衣裳。
ext.ext_en: Emma is on a tight budget for clothes...

defs.def_en: A tight schedule or budget allows very little time or money for unexpected events or expenses.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (比赛双方)比分接近的，不相上下的，势均力敌的

ext.ext_cn: 参赛双方不分伯仲。
ext.ext_en: It was a very tight match...

ext.ext_cn: 最近的调查显示，这将是一场三方激烈角逐的比赛。
ext.ext_en: The most recent polls predict a tight three-way race.

defs.def_en: A tight contest is one where none of the competitors has a clear advantage or looks likely to win, so that it is difficult to say who the winner will be.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 小气的;抠门儿的;吝啬的

ext.ext_cn: 买些新的怎样——你就小气到连3个卢布也不肯掏吗？
ext.ext_en: What about getting new ones — Are you so tight you won't even spend three roubles?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is tight, you disapprove of them because they are unwilling to spend their money.

ext.ext_cn: 如果投票结果不是一个响亮的“是”，总统的处境就不妙了。
ext.ext_en: That puts the president in a tight spot if the vote is not a resounding 'yes'...

ext.ext_cn: 他们教你开动脑筋，摆脱困境。
ext.ext_en: They teach you to use your head to get out of a tight corner.

defs.def_en: If you are in a tight corner or in a tight spot, you are in a difficult situation.

ext.ext_cn: 晚安，戴维。睡个好觉。
ext.ext_en: Good night, Davey. Sleep tight.

defs.def_en: You can say 'sleep tight' to someone when they are going to bed as an affectionate way of saying that you hope they will sleep well.

defs.def_cn: (新想法或新设备)太复杂的，不必要的，时髦复杂的

ext.ext_cn: 戈斯先生一点儿都不相信有关瘦肉的这种“奇谈怪论”。
ext.ext_en: Mr Goss does not believe in any of this 'new-fangled nonsense' about lean meat.

ext.ext_cn: 过于复杂的税收结构
ext.ext_en: ...a newfangled tax structure.

defs.def_en: If someone describes a new idea or a new piece of equipment as new-fangled, they mean that it is too complicated or is unnecessary.

defs.def_cn: 疯狂的；语无伦次的；神志不清的；精神错乱的

ext.ext_cn: 马尔科姆看着她好像在看一个精神错乱的疯子。
ext.ext_en: Malcolm looked at her as if she were a raving lunatic.

ext.ext_cn: 恐怕让－保罗已经完全失去理智了。
ext.ext_en: I'm afraid Jean-Paul has gone raving mad.

defs.def_en: You use raving to describe someone who you think is completely mad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她在两耳后分别擦上一小滴麝香香水。
ext.ext_en: She dabbed a drop of the musky perfume behind each ear.

defs.def_en: A musky smell is strong, warm, and sweet.

ext.ext_cn: 首相现年64岁，这多半将会是他可能参加的最后一次选举了。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister is now 64 years old and in all probability this will be the last election that he is likely to contest...

ext.ext_cn: 在学校的自助餐厅里你会发现有很多饮食可供选择。
ext.ext_en: You will find a wide variety of choices available in school cafeterias...

defs.def_en: You use will to indicate that you hope, think, or have evidence that something is going to happen or be the case in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 演出下午两点开始，入场费50便士。
ext.ext_en: The show will be open to the public at 2pm; admission will be 50p...

ext.ext_cn: 什么时候放我出去，先生？
ext.ext_en: When will I be released, sir?

defs.def_en: You use will in order to make statements about official arrangements in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 我晚上会给你打电话。
ext.ext_en: I'll call you tonight...

ext.ext_cn: 所选产品类别的报价承索即寄。
ext.ext_en: Price quotes on selected product categories will be sent on request...

defs.def_en: You use will in order to make promises and threats about what is going to happen or be the case in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然这些事很重要，我也不想再说什么了。
ext.ext_en: I will say no more on these matters, important though they are...

ext.ext_cn: 在这一节，我们将说明有关烟、酒和大麻的常见谬论。
ext.ext_en: In this section we will describe common myths about cigarettes, alcohol, and marijuana...

defs.def_en: You use will to indicate someone's intention to do something.

defs.def_cn: (用于问句，表示礼貌地邀请或提议)愿否，…好吗

ext.ext_cn: 你愿意留下吃晚饭吗？
ext.ext_en: Will you stay for supper?...

ext.ext_cn: 你愿意跟我一起喝一杯吗？
ext.ext_en: Will you join me for a drink?...

defs.def_en: You use will in questions in order to make polite invitations or offers.

defs.def_cn: (用于问句中，表示请求或让某人做某事)…好吗，…行吗

ext.ext_cn: 你开车送我回家好吗？
ext.ext_en: Will you drive me home?...

ext.ext_cn: 安德鲁，再听一遍好吗？
ext.ext_en: Will you listen again, Andrew?...

defs.def_en: You use will in questions in order to ask or tell someone to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 请按我的要求做。
ext.ext_en: You will do as I request, if you please...

ext.ext_cn: 现在请保持无线电静默。
ext.ext_en: You will now maintain radio silence...

defs.def_en: You can use will in statements to give an order to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 好吧，我愿意原谅你。
ext.ext_en: All right, I'll forgive you...

ext.ext_cn: 我来接电话。
ext.ext_en: I'll answer the phone...

defs.def_en: See also:willing;You use will to say that someone is willing to do something. You use will not or won't to indicate that someone refuses to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 国家将来如何能自卫已经变得越来越重要了。
ext.ext_en: How the country will defend itself in the future has become increasingly important...

ext.ext_cn: 我怎样才能认出你呢？
ext.ext_en: How will I recognize you?

defs.def_en: You use will to say that a person or thing is able to do something in the future.

defs.def_cn: (表示行为发生的经常性、习惯性)经常，惯于，总是

ext.ext_cn: 布料越厚实，衣服就越不容易浸湿。
ext.ext_en: The thicker the material, the less susceptible the garment will be to wet conditions...

ext.ext_cn: 除非自己的生命受到了威胁，已知的蛇中还没有习惯性地攻击人类的。
ext.ext_en: There's no snake known that will habitually attack human beings unless threatened with its life...

defs.def_en: You use will to indicate that an action usually happens in the particular way mentioned.

defs.def_cn: (用于含有 if 和 unless 的句子的主句中，表示非常可能发生)会，就

ext.ext_cn: 如果薄饼烙久了，就很难卷起来。
ext.ext_en: If you overcook the pancakes they will be difficult to roll...

ext.ext_cn: 如果核战争爆发，地球上的所有生物都会被毁灭。
ext.ext_en: If a nuclear war breaks out, every living thing will be wiped off the face of the Earth...

defs.def_en: You use will in the main clause of some 'if' and 'unless' sentences to indicate something that you consider to be fairly likely to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他非要把袜子扔得到处都是，这简直要让我疯掉了。
ext.ext_en: He will leave his socks lying all over the place and it drives me mad.

defs.def_en: You use will to say that someone insists on behaving or doing something in a particular way and you cannot change them. You emphasize will when you use it in this way.

defs.def_cn: (与过去分词连用，表示非常肯定将来会发生某事)定会

ext.ext_cn: 到这个十年结束时，多达千万的儿童将会感染上这种病毒。
ext.ext_en: As many as ten-million children will have been infected with the virus by the end of the decade...

ext.ext_cn: 到1月15日他肯定已经离开了。
ext.ext_en: He will have left by January the fifteenth.

defs.def_en: You use will have with a past participle when you are saying that you are fairly certain that something will be true by a particular time in the future.

defs.def_cn: (与过去分词连用，表示相当肯定)会，将

ext.ext_cn: 如果某人遭到长时间囚禁，他会因为他的经历而有所改变。
ext.ext_en: If someone has been in captivity for a long time, he will have changed as a result of his experience...

ext.ext_cn: 假期定会对他大有好处。
ext.ext_en: The holiday will have done him the world of good.

defs.def_en: You use will have with a past participle to indicate that you are fairly sure that something is the case.

ext.ext_cn: 据说他已经失去了生存的意志。
ext.ext_en: He was said to have lost his will to live.

ext.ext_cn: 当孩子意识到他不能随心所欲地想干什么就干什么、想要什么就有什么的时候，他和父母之间意志的较量就不可避免
ext.ext_en: ...the inevitable battle of wills as your child realizes that he can't do or have everything he wants...

defs.def_en: See also:free will;Will is the determination to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 他让自己听从上帝的意志。
ext.ext_en: He has submitted himself to the will of God...

ext.ext_cn: 民主响应并顺应人民的意志。
ext.ext_en: Democracy responds and adjusts to the will of the people...

defs.def_en: If something is the will of a person or group of people with authority, they want it to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 我看着电话，希望它响起来。
ext.ext_en: I looked at the telephone, willing it to ring...

ext.ext_cn: 他凝视着她，希望她也看他。
ext.ext_en: He was watching her fixedly, willing her to look at him.

defs.def_en: If you will something to happen, you try to make it happen by using mental effort rather than physical effort.

ext.ext_cn: 和遗嘱附在一起的是一封他去世前几天写给妻子的信。
ext.ext_en: Attached to his will was a letter he had written to his wife just days before his death.

defs.def_en: A will is a document in which you declare what you want to happen to your money and property when you die.

ext.ext_cn: 她去世时他继承的那一大笔钱数额惊人，但他在自己身上未花分文，而是将其遗赠给了弗兰克。
ext.ext_en: The large sum of money that came to him when she died was a shock, and he had not spent a penny of it on himself. He had, however, willed it to Frank.

defs.def_en: If you will something to someone, you say in your will that they should have it when you die.

defs.def_cn: 违背…的意志;违背…的愿望

ext.ext_cn: 无疑，他是不情愿地被迫离家的。
ext.ext_en: No doubt he was forced to leave his family against his will.

defs.def_en: If something is done against your will, it is done even though you do not want it to be done.

ext.ext_cn: 可以任意对实验进行调整的科学家
ext.ext_en: ...scientists who can adjust their experiments at will.

defs.def_en: If you can do something at will, you can do it when you want and as much as you want.

ext.ext_cn: 干活时卖力干，干了多少都满意。
ext.ext_en: Set to work with a will and be pleased with the amount you get done...

ext.ext_cn: 这一段起始赛道十分平缓，但车手们都铆足了劲往前冲。
ext.ext_en: It was an easy opening circuit, but the riders attacked it with a will.

defs.def_en: If you do something with a will, you do it with a lot of enthusiasm and energy.

ext.ext_cn: 数学和几何学极有条理的描述自然的方式
ext.ext_en: ...the very ordered way in which mathematics and geometry describe nature.

defs.def_en: Geometry is the branch of mathematics concerned with the properties and relationships of lines, angles, curves, and shapes.

defs.def_cn: 形状；外形；几何图形；几何结构

ext.ext_cn: 他们对车头的外观进行了改进。
ext.ext_en: They have tinkered with the geometry of the car's nose.

defs.def_en: The geometry of an object is its shape or the relationship of its parts to each other.

ext.ext_cn: 酒起着利尿剂的作用，会使你更加脱水。
ext.ext_en: Alcohol acts as a diuretic, making you even more dehydrated.

ext.ext_cn: 许多对关节病有效的药品主要含有利尿成分。

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to do something, you order or advise them to do it.
