ext.ext_cn: 在窗户边游荡的食尸鬼的幻影
ext.ext_en: ...the ghoulish apparitions at the window.

defs.def_en: Something that is ghoulish looks or behaves like a ghoul.

ext.ext_cn: 纵情享乐的聚会
ext.ext_en: ...an orgiastic party.

defs.def_en: An orgiastic event is one in which people enjoy themselves in an extreme, uncontrolled way.

defs.def_cn: 做手势；用手势表达；用动作示意

ext.ext_cn: 一个戴纸帽的男子在拼命地打手势。
ext.ext_en: A man with a paper hat upon his head was gesticulating wildly...

ext.ext_cn: 那位建筑师在指着地上的一个洞打手势。
ext.ext_en: The architect was gesticulating at a hole in the ground.

defs.def_en: If you gesticulate, you make movements with your arms or hands, often while you are describing something that is difficult to express in words.

defs.def_cn: 蓝色风铃草；野风信子；蓝铃花
defs.def_en: Bluebells are plants that have blue bell-shaped flowers on thin upright stems. Bluebells flower in the spring.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (部位、问题、题目等)特定的，特别的

ext.ext_cn: 按摩有助于增加身体特定部位的血液流量。
ext.ext_en: Massage may help to increase blood flow to specific areas of the body...

ext.ext_cn: 有几个特定问题需要解决。
ext.ext_en: There are several specific problems to be dealt with...

defs.def_en: You use specific to refer to a particular fixed area, problem, or subject.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我要求他说得更具体些。
ext.ext_en: I asked him to be more specific...

ext.ext_cn: 这些神经中心产生有节奏的运动，或者更确切地说，是有节奏的肠胃蠕动。
ext.ext_en: These nerve centres generate rhythmic movements; or to be more specific, rhythmic stomach movements...

defs.def_en: If someone is specific, they give a description that is precise and exact. You can also use specific to describe their description.

defs.def_cn: 特有的;独特的;只与…有关的

ext.ext_cn: 寄出你的简历并附上一份针对那个特定工作岗位的附函。
ext.ext_en: Send your resume with a cover letter that is specific to that particular job.

ext.ext_cn: 有关贸易的多数研究都是针对某个具体国家的。
ext.ext_en: Most studies of trade have been country-specific.

defs.def_en: Something that is specific to a particular thing is connected with that thing only.

defs.def_cn: 他们自己;她们自己;它们自己

ext.ext_cn: 他们好像玩得都很开心。
ext.ext_en: They all seemed to be enjoying themselves...

ext.ext_cn: 那些男人一起聊着天。
ext.ext_en: The men talked amongst themselves...

defs.def_en: You use themselves to refer to people, animals, or things when the object of a verb or preposition refers to the same people or things as the subject of the verb.

defs.def_cn: 他们自己，她们自己，它们自己(强调所指的人或物，有时用作动词或介词宾语，代替 them)

ext.ext_cn: 许多精神病患者本身不喜欢社区护理。
ext.ext_en: Many mentally ill people are themselves unhappy about the idea of community care...

ext.ext_cn: 城市自身在日新月异地变化。
ext.ext_en: Cities themselves are changing rapidly...

defs.def_en: You use themselves to emphasize the people or things that you are referring to. Themselves is also sometimes used instead of 'them' as the object of a verb or preposition.

defs.def_cn: (用以代替himself or herself，指代句子的主语，而不指明是男是女;有人认为这种用法不对)

ext.ext_cn: 肺气肿病人能做些什么来帮助自己恢复健康？
ext.ext_en: What can a patient with emphysema do to help themselves?...

ext.ext_cn: 谁都不愿作出承诺。
ext.ext_en: Nobody was prepared to commit themselves.

defs.def_en: You use themselves instead of 'himself or herself' to refer back to the person who is the subject of sentence without saying whether it is a man or a woman. Some people think this use is incorrect.

defs.def_cn: (用以代替 himself or herself，强调所指代的人，但是不指明是男是女; themselves 有时也用作动词或介词的宾语;有人认为这种用法不对)

ext.ext_cn: 每个学生自己只做一项。
ext.ext_en: Each student makes only one item themselves...

ext.ext_cn: 毕竟，人们除了做自己又能怎样呢？
ext.ext_en: After all, what more can anyone be than themselves?

defs.def_en: You use themselves instead of 'himself or herself' to emphasize the person you are referring to without saying whether it is a man or a woman. Themselves is also sometimes used as the object of a verb or preposition. Some people think this use is incorrect.
A bobsleigh is a vehicle with long thin strips of metal fixed to the bottom, which is used for racing downhill on ice.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 和蔼可亲的；令人愉悦的

ext.ext_cn: 看到他如此和蔼可亲、彬彬有礼，她非常惊讶。
ext.ext_en: She had been surprised at how amiable and polite he had seemed.

defs.def_en: Someone who is amiable is friendly and pleasant to be with.
Bathing trunks are shorts that a man wears when he goes swimming.

ext.ext_cn: 巨大的铁矿山
ext.ext_en: ...a huge iron ore mine.

defs.def_en: Ore is rock or earth from which metal can be obtained.

defs.def_cn: 言语难以表达的;不可言喻的

ext.ext_cn: 许多肖像流露出的难以形容的悲伤
ext.ext_en: ...the ineffable sadness of many of the portraits.

defs.def_en: You use ineffable to say that something is so great or extreme that it cannot be described in words.
Talc is the same as talcum powder .

ext.ext_cn: 全体一致同意尽快开始和平进程。
ext.ext_en: There was total agreement to start the peace process as soon as possible...

ext.ext_cn: 他们决定用3年时间建成。
ext.ext_en: They decided to spread the building process over three years...

defs.def_en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

ext.ext_cn: 这种情况出现在老年人当中，显然是衰老过程的一部分。
ext.ext_en: It occurs in elderly men, apparently as part of the ageing process...

ext.ext_cn: 这种现象出现的规律性表明这个过程是由基因决定的。
ext.ext_en: The regularity with which this occurs suggests that the process is genetically determined.

defs.def_en: A process is a series of things which happen naturally and result in a biological or chemical change.

ext.ext_cn: 经过冷冻、罐装或熏制处理的鱼
ext.ext_en: ...fish which are processed by freezing, canning or smoking...

ext.ext_cn: 这些材料将会被加工成塑料小球。
ext.ext_en: The material will be processed into plastic pellets.

defs.def_en: When raw materials or foods are processed, they are prepared in factories before they are used or sold.

ext.ext_cn: 处理数据的设备和公开其结果的权利
ext.ext_en: ...facilities to process the data, and the right to publish the results...

ext.ext_cn: 通过望远镜获得的信息将由计算机进行处理。
ext.ext_en: The information gathered by the telescopes will be processed by computers.

defs.def_en: When people process information, they put it through a system or into a computer in order to deal with it.

defs.def_cn: 审核；审议；检查；使接受处理

ext.ext_cn: 病人在这个科看病需要两个多小时的时间。
ext.ext_en: Patients took more than two hours to be processed through the department.

defs.def_en: When people are processed by officials, their case is dealt with in stages and they pass from one stage of the process to the next.

ext.ext_cn: 政府正在起草和平计划。
ext.ext_en: The administration is in the process of drawing up a peace plan...

ext.ext_cn: 她的小说正被拍成电视连续剧。
ext.ext_en: Her novel is in the process of being turned into a television series.

defs.def_en: If you are in the process of doing something, you have started to do it and are still doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 他领先那个西班牙人到达终点，同时也首次作为职业选手获得计时赛的胜利。
ext.ext_en: He finished ahead of the Spaniard, and in the process picked up his first time trial win as a pro...

ext.ext_cn: 你得让我们为自己拼搏，哪怕我们会在这个过程中死去。
ext.ext_en: You have to let us struggle for ourselves, even if we must die in the process.

defs.def_en: If you are doing something and you do something else in the process, you do the second thing as part of doing the first thing.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你所做的工作能让你很忙，那要坚持下去。
ext.ext_en: If you're in a job that keeps you busy, stick with it...

ext.ext_cn: 他们最终选择了继续做自己熟悉的事。
ext.ext_en: They prefer, in the end, to stick with what they know.

defs.def_en: If you stick with something, you do not change to something else.

ext.ext_cn: 她拽着那个女人的胳膊，将她拉到自己身边说：“亲爱的，你就跟我呆在一起。”
ext.ext_en: Tugging the woman's arm, she pulled her to her side saying: 'You just stick with me, dear.'

defs.def_en: If you stick with someone, you stay close to them.
A gosling is a baby goose.

ext.ext_cn: 我痛骂了他一顿。
ext.ext_en: I gave him a good dressing-down.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you a dressing-down, they speak angrily to you because you have done something bad or foolish.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不道德的；（尤指）放荡的，淫乱的

ext.ext_cn: 关于放荡淫乱行为的骇人听闻的故事
ext.ext_en: ...alarming stories of licentious behaviour.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as licentious, you mean that they are very immoral, especially in their sexual behaviour.
A cave-in is the sudden collapse of the roof of a cave or mine.
A brothel is a building where men can go to pay to have sex with prostitutes.

defs.def_cn: 加大(引擎)的马力;改装;改写(音乐作品等)使更富吸引力

ext.ext_cn: 他16岁的时候有了第一部车，是一部迷你车，被他改装后撞坏了。
ext.ext_en: He had his first car at sixteen, a Mini, which he souped up and crashed.

defs.def_en: To soup up something such as a car engine means to make it more powerful. To soup up something such as a piece of music or writing means to make it more interesting and exciting.

ext.ext_cn: 他伤心得讲不出话来。
ext.ext_en: He was too distressed to talk...

ext.ext_cn: 老师斥责了一个在课堂上说话的女生。
ext.ext_en: A teacher reprimanded a girl for talking in class...

defs.def_en: When you talk, you use spoken language to express your thoughts, ideas, or feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 我们说笑了很久。
ext.ext_en: We talked and laughed a great deal...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天我和他谈过了。
ext.ext_en: I talked to him yesterday...

defs.def_en: If you talk to someone, you have a conversation with them. You can also say that two people talk .

ext.ext_cn: 你第一步应该是去找老师或学校辅导员谈谈。
ext.ext_en: Your first step should be to talk to a teacher or school counselor...

ext.ext_cn: 她找不到一个可以倾诉的对象，快要崩溃了。
ext.ext_en: There's no one she can talk to, and she's on the verge of collapse...

defs.def_en: If you talk to someone, you tell them about the things that are worrying you. You can also say that two people talk .

ext.ext_cn: 她将会谈一些自己十分感兴趣的话题，包括教育和幼儿护理。
ext.ext_en: She will talk on the issues she cares passionately about including education and nursery care...

ext.ext_cn: 他打算和青年人谈谈艾滋病的危害。
ext.ext_en: He intends to talk to young people about the dangers of AIDS.

defs.def_en: If you talk on or about something, you make an informal speech telling people what you know or think about it.

defs.def_cn: (通常指国家、劳资间为达成某种协定的)谈判，商谈

ext.ext_cn: 下一轮中东和平谈判
ext.ext_en: ...the next round of Middle East peace talks...

ext.ext_cn: 罢工的铁路工人和波兰政府间举行的谈判已经破裂了。
ext.ext_en: Talks between striking railway workers and the Polish government have broken down...

defs.def_en: Talks are formal discussions intended to produce an agreement, usually between different countries or between employers and employees.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在和一些人讨论在伦敦设立办事处的事儿。
ext.ext_en: We're talking to some people about opening an office in London...

ext.ext_cn: 公司和许多潜在的投资人举行了磋商。
ext.ext_en: The company talked with many potential investors...

defs.def_en: If one group of people talks to another, or if two groups talk, they have formal discussions in order to do a deal or produce an agreement.

ext.ext_cn: 外交部长说他愿意和任何不怀敌意的国家举行会谈。
ext.ext_en: The Foreign Minister said he was ready to talk to any country that had no hostile intentions...

ext.ext_cn: 他们正在收集情报，为双方坐下来谈判的那一天做准备。
ext.ext_en: They are collecting information in preparation for the day when the two sides sit down and talk...

defs.def_en: When different countries or different sides in a dispute talk, or talk to each other, they discuss their differences in order to try and settle the dispute.

ext.ext_cn: 人人都在议论他。
ext.ext_en: Everyone is talking about him...

ext.ext_cn: 人们会有议论，但日子还得过下去。
ext.ext_en: People will talk, but you have to get on with your life.

defs.def_en: If people are talking about another person or are talking, they are discussing that person.

defs.def_cn: (通常指不情愿地)供出，招认，招供

ext.ext_cn: 他们会招供的，他们会把我牵连进去的。
ext.ext_en: They'll talk, they'll implicate me.

defs.def_en: If someone talks when they are being held by police or soldiers, they reveal important or secret information, usually unwillingly.

defs.def_cn: 讲，说，操(某种语言或口音)

ext.ext_cn: 听你讲英语，不像是外国人。
ext.ext_en: You don't sound like a foreigner talking English...

ext.ext_cn: 我说话带爱尔兰口音让他们感到很惊奇。
ext.ext_en: They were amazed that I was talking in an Irish accent.

defs.def_en: If you talk a particular language or talk with a particular accent, you use that language or have that accent when you speak.

ext.ext_cn: 顾客多数是些谈正事的中年男子。
ext.ext_en: The guests were mostly middle-aged men talking business.

defs.def_en: If you talk something such as politics or sport, you discuss it.

ext.ext_cn: 乔治，你得承认你说的全都是废话。
ext.ext_en: You must admit George, you're talking absolute rubbish.

defs.def_en: You can use talk to say what you think of the ideas that someone is expressing. For example, if you say that someone is talking sense, you mean that you think the opinions they are expressing are sensible.

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在讨论的不是谋杀，而是扑克机或赌博——这些在多数州只能算轻罪了。
ext.ext_en: We're not talking a murder here; we're talking poker machines or gambling — things that are misdemeanors in most states...

ext.ext_cn: 我们这次谈的可是上百万的买卖。
ext.ext_en: We're talking megabucks this time.

defs.def_en: You can say that you are talking a particular thing to draw attention to your topic or to point out a characteristic of what you are discussing.

ext.ext_cn: 这个多半已经真正尝试过了吗？还是仅仅说说而已？
ext.ext_en: Has much of this actually been tried here? Or is it just talk?...

ext.ext_cn: 应该先定下条件，否则全是空谈。
ext.ext_en: Conditions should be laid down. Otherwise it's all talk.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as an idea or threat is just talk, or all talk, you mean that it does not mean or matter much, because people are exaggerating about it or do not really intend to do anything about it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们用了很长时间才走到今天这步，是吧？这就叫命运难测啊！
ext.ext_en: Took us quite a while to get here, didn't it? Talk about Fate moving in a mysterious way!...

ext.ext_cn: 她把我做的蛋糕扔到地上，然后踩在了上面。真是欺人太甚！
ext.ext_en: She threw the cake I'd made on the floor and stood on it. Talk about being humiliated!

defs.def_en: You can say talk about before mentioning a particular expression or situation, when you mean that something is a very striking or clear example of that expression or situation.

defs.def_cn: 我说，说到，谈到(用于引出新话题)

ext.ext_cn: 贝尔沃农场生产一种非常好喝的接骨木花茶。说到接骨木花，你兴许想尝尝接骨木花香槟酒。
ext.ext_en: Belvoir Farms produce a delicious elderflower tea. Talking of elderflower, you might wish to try Elderflower Champagne.

ext.ext_cn: 正如《圣经》所说，给我恩赐太多了，我的杯子已经满满当当了。说到杯子，我得去给你倒杯茶来。
ext.ext_en: As it says in the Bible, my cup is running over. Talking of which, I must get you a cup of tea.

defs.def_en: You can use the expression talking of to introduce a new topic that you want to discuss, and to link it to something that has already been mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 只是将 10 号衣服改大的话结果往往会很不理想。
ext.ext_en: Simply scaling up a size 10 garment often leads to disaster...

ext.ext_cn: 从那以后，威康公司一直在增加产量，为临床试验作准备。
ext.ext_en: Since then, Wellcome has been scaling up production to prepare for clinical trials.

defs.def_en: If you scale up something, you make it greater in size, amount, or extent than it used to be.

ext.ext_cn: 经营银行的大亨们
ext.ext_en: ...the fat cats who run the bank.

ext.ext_cn: 企业大亨的类型
ext.ext_en: ...fat-cat corporate types.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a businessman or politician as a fat cat, you are indicating that you disapprove of the way they use their wealth and power.

ext.ext_cn: 人们常常把我同其他演员弄混。
ext.ext_en: People often mix me up with other actors...

ext.ext_cn: 心情抑郁的人可能会前言不搭后语。
ext.ext_en: Depressed people may mix up their words...

defs.def_en: If you mix up two things or people, you confuse them, so that you think that one of them is the other one.

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢把各种名牌服装混搭在一起。
ext.ext_en: I like to mix up designer clothes...

ext.ext_cn: 计划的一部分是：这座城市不应该划分为办公区、工业区和居住区，而应把三个部分融合在一起。
ext.ext_en: Part of the plan was that the town should not fall into office, industrial and residential zones, but mix the three up together...

defs.def_en: If you mix up a number of things, you put things of different kinds together or place things so that they are not in order.

ext.ext_cn: 因为最高仅为56厘米，这种矮种山羊基本上作为宠物来养。
ext.ext_en: Reaching a maximum height of 56cm the pygmy goat is essentially a pet.

defs.def_en: Pygmy means belonging to a species of animal which is the smallest of a group of related species.

defs.def_cn: 俾格米人（非洲和东南亚的一种矮小人种）

ext.ext_cn: 巴布亚新几内亚的俾格米人部落
ext.ext_en: ...the pygmy tribes of Papua New Guinea.

defs.def_en: A pygmy is a member of a group of very short people who live in Africa or southeast Asia.
In stories and films, a werewolf is a person who changes into a wolf.

defs.def_cn: 蒲式耳（农作物的容量单位，相当于8加仑）
defs.def_en: A bushel is a unit of volume that is used for measuring agricultural produce such as corn or beans. A bushel is equivalent in volume to eight gallons.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 油炸食品非常难消化。
ext.ext_en: Fried food is very indigestible.

defs.def_en: Food that is indigestible cannot be digested easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一本冗长难懂的厚书
ext.ext_en: ...a dense, indigestible and wordy book.

defs.def_en: If you describe facts or ideas as indigestible, you mean that they are difficult to understand, complicated, and dull.

defs.def_cn: 用偷来的车开快车兜风；偷开车（罪）
defs.def_en: Joyriding is the crime of stealing a car and driving around in it at high speed.

ext.ext_cn: 毛巾、肥皂、刮胡刀片、牙膏等一应俱全
ext.ext_en: ...an adequate supply of towels, soap, razor blades, toothpaste, etc.

ext.ext_cn: 用剃须刀片削的铅笔
ext.ext_en: ...a pencil sharpened with a razor blade.

defs.def_en: A razor blade is a small flat piece of metal with a very sharp edge which is put into a razor and used for shaving.

ext.ext_cn: 那个人向后摔倒了。
ext.ext_en: The man tumbled over backwards.

defs.def_en: If someone or something tumbles over, they fall, often with a rolling or bouncing movement.

ext.ext_cn: 霍乱是一种细菌感染。
ext.ext_en: Cholera is a bacterial infection.

defs.def_en: Bacterial is used to describe things that relate to or are caused by bacteria.

defs.def_cn: 新世界，新大陆(指北美和南美大陆)

ext.ext_cn: 来自新大陆和澳大拉西亚的优质葡萄酒进口的大幅增长
ext.ext_en: ...the massive growth in imports of good wines from the New World and Australasia.

defs.def_en: The New World is used to refer to the continents of North and South America.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 酒精会引发暴力和破坏性行为。
ext.ext_en: Alcohol can produce violent, disruptive behavior...

ext.ext_cn: 对于小公司来说，实行这些变革可能会带来灭顶之灾。
ext.ext_en: The process of implementing these changes can be very disruptive to a small company.

defs.def_en: To be disruptive means to prevent something from continuing or operating in a normal way.

ext.ext_cn: 这笔钱将用于物业维护。
ext.ext_en: The money will be used for the estate's upkeep...

ext.ext_cn: 维护部负责公园的一般养护。
ext.ext_en: The maintenance department is responsible for the general upkeep of the park.

defs.def_en: The upkeep of a building or place is the work of keeping it in good condition.

defs.def_cn: 赡养；供养；（公共事业的）维持

ext.ext_cn: 他愿意每月付100英镑作为儿子的抚养费。
ext.ext_en: He offered to pay £100 a month towards his son's upkeep.

ext.ext_cn: 用于维持幼儿园和孤儿院日常运转的补助
ext.ext_en: ...subsidies for the upkeep of kindergartens and orphanages.

defs.def_en: The upkeep of a group of people or services is the process of providing them with the things that they need.

defs.def_cn: 银行（贷款）利率；（尤指国家中央银行规定的）银行贴现率，最低贷率

ext.ext_cn: 迫使银行贴现率上调的英镑危机
ext.ext_en: ...a sterling crisis that forced the bank rate up.

defs.def_en: The bank rate is the rate of interest at which a bank lends money, especially the minimum rate of interest that banks are allowed to charge, which is decided from time to time by the country's central bank.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的社交礼仪意识淡薄。
ext.ext_en: Their sense of social propriety is eroded.

defs.def_en: Propriety is the quality of being socially or morally acceptable.
A cornet is a musical instrument that looks like a small trumpet.
An ice cream cornet is a soft thin biscuit shaped like a cone with ice cream in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他高声反对保守主义。
ext.ext_en: He was a vociferous opponent of Conservatism...

ext.ext_cn: 他越来越大声地表达对她行为的厌恶。
ext.ext_en: His resentment of her behaviour was becoming more vociferous.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as vociferous, you mean that they speak with great energy and determination, because they want their views to be heard.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你可能会认为他起码应该大方地承认自己是撞上了好运。
ext.ext_en: You'd think that at least he'd have the good grace to admit his blinding, jammy luck.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as jammy, you mean that they are very lucky because something good has happened to them, without their making much effort or deserving such luck.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔累了，他在长途旅行以后必须休息。
ext.ext_en: Michael is tired and he has to rest after his long trip.

defs.def_en: If you are tired, you feel that you want to rest or sleep.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (身体部位)显出倦意的，感到疲乏的

ext.ext_cn: 黄瓜有助于舒缓眼部疲劳。
ext.ext_en: Cucumber is good for soothing tired eyes…

ext.ext_cn: 我的胳膊很累，背部肌肉紧绷得难受。
ext.ext_en: My arms are tired, and my back is tense.

defs.def_en: You can describe a part of your body as tired if it looks or feels as if you need to rest it or to sleep.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我厌烦了所有的推测。
ext.ext_en: I am tired of all the speculation...

ext.ext_cn: 我厌倦了当簿记员。
ext.ext_en: I was tired of being a bookkeeper.

defs.def_en: If you are tired of something, you do not want it to continue because you are bored of it or unhappy with it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我不想听他的又一个老掉牙的借口。
ext.ext_en: I didn't want to hear another one of his tired excuses...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在威斯敏斯特教堂看到的是一种经年不变的古旧仪式。
ext.ext_en: What we see at Westminster is a tired old ritual.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as tired, you are critical of it because you have heard it or seen it many times.

defs.def_cn: 兴奋;激动;刺激;令人兴奋的事物

ext.ext_cn: 每个人都大为兴奋。
ext.ext_en: Everyone is in a state of great excitement.

ext.ext_cn: 雷雨交加的刺激
ext.ext_en: ...the excitement of a thunderstorm...

defs.def_en: You use excitement to refer to the state of being excited, or to something that excites you.

defs.def_cn: 与…保持友好关系;与…友好相处

ext.ext_cn: 南北双方都有官员参加了这次会议，而且他们勉强和平相处。
ext.ext_en: North and South had officials at the meeting and they rubbed along tolerably...

ext.ext_cn: 尼科尔森先生对士兵很尊重，而且跟他们相处融洽。
ext.ext_en: Mr Nicholson respects soldiers, and he rubs along with them.

defs.def_en: If two people rub along or if one person rubs along with another, they are able to live or work together in a fairly friendly way, usually when you would not expect them to.
Didn't is the usual spoken form of 'did not'.

defs.def_cn: 大男子主义;大男子作风
defs.def_en: If you accuse a man of male chauvinism, you disapprove of him because his beliefs and behaviour show that he thinks men are naturally superior to women.

ext.ext_cn: 以成本价出售非常时尚的鞋子的厂家直营店
ext.ext_en: ...a factory shop where you can buy very fashionable shoes at cost price...

ext.ext_cn: 该商店自称3年来一直以低于生产成本的价格出售电脑。
ext.ext_en: The shop claims to have sold computers below the manufacturer's cost price for three years.

defs.def_en: If something is sold at cost price, it is sold for the same price as it cost the seller to buy it.

defs.def_cn: （德语等语言中加于元音之上的）变音符，曲音符号
defs.def_en: An umlaut is a symbol that is written over vowels in German and some other languages to indicate the way in which they should be pronounced. For example, the word 'für' has an umlaut over the 'u'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （头发）乱成一团的,乱蓬蓬的,缠结在一起的

ext.ext_cn: 她蓬头乱发，衣衫褴褛，满是灰尘。
ext.ext_en: She had matted hair and torn dusty clothes.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's hair as matted, you mean that it has become a thick untidy mass, often because it is wet or dirty.
A flashbulb is a small bulb that can be fixed to a camera. It makes a bright flash of light so that you can take photographs indoors.

ext.ext_cn: 一场全明星比赛可能勉强会激起一点点兴趣。
ext.ext_en: An all-star game might scare up a little interest...

ext.ext_cn: 你看看能不能好歹沏一杯咖啡？
ext.ext_en: Why don't you see if you can scare up a cup of coffee?

defs.def_en: If you scare up something, you provide, produce, or obtain it, often when it is difficult to do so or when you do not have many resources.

ext.ext_cn: 锌被用来保护其他金属不受腐蚀。
ext.ext_en: Zinc is used to protect other metals from corrosion.

defs.def_en: Corrosion is the damage that is caused when something is corroded.

defs.def_cn: 不知情的；不知底细的；不明真相的

ext.ext_cn: 此案的共同被告因向数千不明真相的存款人出售毫无价值的垃圾债券而被起诉。
ext.ext_en: The co-defendants are charged with selling worthless junk bonds to thousands of unsuspecting depositors.

ext.ext_cn: 他的不明真相的受害人
ext.ext_en: ...his unsuspecting victim.

defs.def_en: You can use unsuspecting to describe someone who is not at all aware of something that is happening or going to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 一群秃鹫蹲伏在一具野牛的尸体上。
ext.ext_en: A cluster of vultures crouched on the carcass of a dead buffalo...

ext.ext_cn: 做鸡汤的用料有鸡肉、切成块的蔬菜和香料。
ext.ext_en: Prepare the chicken stock using the carcases, the diced vegetables and herbs.

defs.def_en: A carcass is the body of a dead animal.

defs.def_cn: (车辆、建筑物破损或被毁后的)骨架,残体

ext.ext_cn: 一辆生锈的拖拉机残骸
ext.ext_en: ...the carcass of a rusted tractor.

defs.def_en: The carcass of a vehicle or building is its remains after most of it has decayed or been destroyed.

defs.def_cn: 与（过去的某事物）类似;以（过去的某事物）为模型

ext.ext_cn: 仿效维多利亚时代建筑风格的尖屋顶
ext.ext_en: ...pitched roofs, which hark back to the Victorian era.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing harks back to another thing in the past, you mean it is similar to it or takes it as a model.

ext.ext_cn: 当时的结果让我伤心欲绝，即便是现在我仍记得那一幕。
ext.ext_en: The result devastated me at the time. Even now I hark back to it.

defs.def_en: When people hark back to something in the past, they remember it or remind someone of it.
Outbuildings are small buildings for keeping things in or working in which are near a house, on the land belonging to it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是个有教养、和蔼可亲的正人君子。
ext.ext_en: He is an educated, amiable and decent man.

defs.def_en: Someone who is educated has a high standard of learning.

ext.ext_cn: 研究表明高纤维饮食可预防肠癌。
ext.ext_en: Research shows that a high-fibre diet may protect you from bowel cancer...

ext.ext_cn: 呼吸测醉检测显示其饮酒量是法定驾车饮酒限量的两倍多，他随即在南安普顿的家中被捕。
ext.ext_en: He was arrested at his home in Southampton after a breath test showed he had drunk more than twice the legal limit for driving...

defs.def_en: If something shows that a state of affairs exists, it gives information that proves it or makes it clear to people.

defs.def_cn: (图画、图表、影像或文章)描绘，描述，展示，说明

ext.ext_cn: 图表 4.1 所示为呼吸系统。
ext.ext_en: Figure 4.1 shows the respiratory system...

ext.ext_cn: 刻有克娄巴特拉头像的硬币
ext.ext_en: ...a coin showing Cleopatra...

defs.def_en: If a picture, chart, film, or piece of writing shows something, it represents it or gives information about it.

defs.def_cn: 给…看;向…出示(或展示);指给…看

ext.ext_cn: 将这篇文章剪下来，拿给你的银行经理看。
ext.ext_en: Cut out this article and show it to your bank manager...

ext.ext_cn: 他带我看了他和埃丝特合住的公寓。
ext.ext_en: He showed me the flat he shares with Esther...

defs.def_en: If you show someone something, you give it to them, take them to it, or point to it, so that they can see it or know what you are referring to.

ext.ext_cn: 我带你去我的书房。
ext.ext_en: Let me show you to my study...

ext.ext_cn: 米尔顿被领到了办公室。
ext.ext_en: Milton was shown into the office...

defs.def_en: If you show someone to a room or seat, you lead them there.

ext.ext_cn: 克莱尔给我们示范了如何做巧克力卷。
ext.ext_en: Claire showed us how to make a chocolate roulade...

ext.ext_cn: 有经验丰富的专家教你，并向你演示怎么做。
ext.ext_en: There are seasoned professionals who can teach you and show you what to do...

defs.def_en: If you show someone how to do something, you do it yourself so that they can watch you and learn how to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他一本正经地咧嘴笑了笑。
ext.ext_en: He showed his teeth in a humourless grin...

ext.ext_cn: 他的胡子才刚有点泛白。
ext.ext_en: His beard was just beginning to show signs of grey...

defs.def_en: If something shows or if you show it, it is visible or noticeable.

defs.def_cn: 表现，体现，流露出(态度、品质或情感);(态度等)体现，流露

ext.ext_cn: 埃尔茜有足够的时间来表达她的感激之情。
ext.ext_en: Elsie has had enough time to show her gratitude...

ext.ext_cn: 她对自己的孩子毫无兴趣。
ext.ext_en: She showed no interest in her children...

defs.def_en: If you show a particular attitude, quality, or feeling, or if it shows, you behave in a way that makes this attitude, quality, or feeling clear to other people.

defs.def_cn: 显示出，表露出，流露出(某种品质或特征);(品质或特征)表露，显示

ext.ext_cn: 这个故事显示了作者较强的叙事能力和对细节的观察入微。
ext.ext_en: The story shows a strong narrative gift and a vivid eye for detail...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天在华盛顿举行的中东和谈有了取得进展的迹象。
ext.ext_en: Middle East peace talks in Washington showed signs of progress yesterday...

defs.def_en: If something shows a quality or characteristic or if that quality or characteristic shows itself, it can be noticed or observed.

defs.def_cn: (情感、品质等的)流露，表露，体现

ext.ext_cn: 矿工们聚集在布加勒斯特市中心以表示对政府的支持。
ext.ext_en: Miners gathered in the centre of Bucharest in a show of support for the government...

ext.ext_cn: 已经有 10,000 多人聚集起来以显示他们的力量。
ext.ext_en: A crowd of more than 10,000 has gathered in a show of strength...

defs.def_en: A show of a feeling or quality is an attempt by someone to make it clear that they have that feeling or quality.

ext.ext_cn: 政府的转变更多的是装装样子，而不是真的。
ext.ext_en: The change in government is more for show than for real...

ext.ext_cn: “全是装的，”莱纳斯说。“女孩子们不会拿它当真的。”
ext.ext_en: 'It's all show,' said Linus. 'The girls don't take it seriously.'

defs.def_en: If you say that something is for show, you mean that it has no real purpose and is done just to give a good impression.

ext.ext_cn: 那是3个公司中唯一一家预计会在本季度盈利的公司。
ext.ext_en: It is the only one of the three companies expected to show a profit for the quarter...

ext.ext_cn: 朗荷公司的采矿及矿产业务有了些起色。
ext.ext_en: Lonrho's mining and minerals businesses showed some improvement.

defs.def_en: If a company shows a profit or a loss, its accounts indicate that it has made a profit or a loss.

ext.ext_cn: 他总是有可能不出现。
ext.ext_en: There was always a chance he wouldn't show.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一直等到了 5 点，但是他始终没有露面。
ext.ext_en: We waited until five o'clock, but he did not show up...

defs.def_en: If a person you are expecting to meet does not show, they do not arrive at the place where you expect to meet them.

ext.ext_cn: 我有自己的电视节目。
ext.ext_en: I had my own TV show...

ext.ext_cn: 这就是劳埃德·格罗斯曼拜访名人家庭的那档节目。
ext.ext_en: This is the show in which Loyd Grossman visits the houses of the famous.

defs.def_en: A television or radio show is a programme on television or radio.

defs.def_cn: (尤指包括音乐、舞蹈、滑稽剧等不同内容的)演出，表演

ext.ext_cn: 去伦敦购物再看场演出怎么样？
ext.ext_en: How about going shopping and seeing a show in London?...

ext.ext_cn: 他因可以用一则恶评毙掉一场演出而闻名。
ext.ext_en: He has earned a reputation as the man who can close a show with a bad review...

defs.def_en: A show in a theatre is an entertainment or concert, especially one that includes different items such as music, dancing, and comedy.

ext.ext_cn: 英国广播公司对外电视频道的新闻节目播放了同样的电影剪辑片段。
ext.ext_en: The BBC World Service Television news showed the same film clip...

ext.ext_cn: 明年这部剧将在美国电视台播出。
ext.ext_en: The drama will be shown on American TV next year...

defs.def_en: If someone shows a film or television programme, it is broadcast or appears on television or in the cinema.

ext.ext_cn: 展览地点在伯明翰国家展览中心大厅。
ext.ext_en: The venue for the show is Birmingham's National Exhibition Centre Hall...

ext.ext_cn: 古奇将举办时装发布会推出他们的秋装系列。
ext.ext_en: Gucci will be holding fashion shows to present their autumn collection...

defs.def_en: A show is a public exhibition of things, such as works of art, fashionable clothes, or things that have been entered in a competition.

ext.ext_cn: 50 名艺术品经销商将展出 1900 年到1992 年间的油画、水彩画、素描和版画。
ext.ext_en: 50 dealers will show oils, watercolours, drawings and prints from 1900 to 1992.

ext.ext_cn: 他曾在那儿展销作品的东村著名的美术馆之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of East Village's better-known galleries, where he showed and sold his work.

defs.def_en: To show things such as works of art means to put them in an exhibition where they can be seen by the public.

defs.def_cn: (赛马比赛中赛马)名列前三甲
defs.def_en: In a horse race, if a horse shows, it finishes first, second, or third.
A show home, house, or flat is one of a group of new homes. The building company decorates it and puts furniture in it, and people who want to buy one of the homes come and look round it.

ext.ext_cn: 议会领导人同意所有这样的决定都要举手表决。
ext.ext_en: Parliamentary leaders agreed to take all such decisions by a show of hands...

ext.ext_cn: 拉塞尔然后要求对每个目标进行举手表决。
ext.ext_en: Russell then asked for a show of hands concerning each of the targets.

defs.def_en: If a question is decided by a show of hands, people vote on it by raising their hands to indicate whether they vote yes or no.

defs.def_cn: 在…方面做出了成绩;在…方面有结果

ext.ext_cn: 我快 31 岁了,是该在工作上做出一番成绩的时候了。
ext.ext_en: I'm nearly 31 and it's about time I had something to show for my time in my job...

ext.ext_cn: 她的付出那么多，收获却那样少，这一直让她惊诧不已。
ext.ext_en: It always amazed her how little she had to show for the amount she spent.

defs.def_en: If you have something to show for your efforts, you have achieved something as a result of what you have done.

defs.def_cn: (用来威胁或警告别人)我要让你看看，你就等着瞧吧

ext.ext_cn: 她挥了挥拳头，“我要让你看看，”她说。
ext.ext_en: She shook her fist. 'I'll show you,' she said...

ext.ext_cn: 我会让他好看的，交给我好了。
ext.ext_en: I'll show him, leave it to me.

defs.def_en: You can say 'I'll show you' to threaten or warn someone that you are going to make them admit that they are wrong.

defs.def_cn: 这恰恰证明;这正好表明

ext.ext_cn: 这恰恰证明了在学校得高分并不意味着聪明。
ext.ext_en: This just goes to show that getting good grades in school doesn't mean you're clever...

ext.ext_cn: 这太荒唐了，不过恰恰证明了裁判的前后矛盾。
ext.ext_en: It's crazy and just shows the inconsistency of refereeing.

defs.def_en: If you say it just goes to show or it just shows that something is the case, you mean that what you have just said or experienced demonstrates that it is the case.

ext.ext_cn: 他们清楚地表明了现在是谁在掌控一切。
ext.ext_en: They made it clear who is now running the show...

ext.ext_cn: 国家领导班子的治国方式存在一些严重的问题。
ext.ext_en: There's some serious problems with the way the state's leadership has been running the show.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is running the show, you mean that they are in control or in charge of a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 比赛的第一天中国女队表现抢眼。
ext.ext_en: It was Chinese women who stole the show on the first day of competition...

ext.ext_cn: 布拉德·皮特扮演一名因对生命怀有极大热情而注定在劫难逃的年轻人，抢尽了镜头。
ext.ext_en: Brad Pitt steals the show as the young man doomed by his zest for life.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone steals the show, you mean that they get a lot of attention or praise because they perform better than anyone else in a show or other event.

ext.ext_cn: 他对一个已婚女子的暗恋
ext.ext_en: ...his unrequited love for a married woman.

defs.def_en: If you have unrequited love for someone, they do not love you.

ext.ext_cn: 20 世纪整个 60 年代和 70 年代初期是风云变幻、动荡不安的一个时期。
ext.ext_en: The 1960s and early 1970s were a time of change and turbulence.

ext.ext_cn: 经常遭受政治动乱的一个地区
ext.ext_en: …a region often beset by political turbulence.

defs.def_en: Turbulence is a state of confusion and disorganized change.

defs.def_cn: (空气、液体或气体的)湍流,涡流，紊流

ext.ext_cn: 他的飞机遭遇强气流和时速近 200 英里的强风。
ext.ext_en: His plane encountered severe turbulence and winds of nearly two-hundred miles an hour.

defs.def_en: Turbulence is violent and uneven movement within a particular area of air, liquid, or gas.

defs.def_cn: （通常为纽结状或棒状的）咸脆饼干
defs.def_en: A pretzel is a small, crisp, shiny biscuit, which has salt on the outside. Pretzels are usually shaped like knots or sticks.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 粗布制成的夹克
ext.ext_en: ...a jacket made of very coarse cloth.

ext.ext_cn: 粗沙海滩
ext.ext_en: ...a beach of coarse sand.

defs.def_en: Coarse things have a rough texture because they consist of thick threads or large pieces.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她在的时候，士兵们还是照样说粗俗的笑话，都懒得收敛。
ext.ext_en: The soldiers did not bother to moderate their coarse humour in her presence.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as coarse, you mean that he or she talks and behaves in a rude and offensive way.

defs.def_cn: 突然遇到(问题);突然碰到(困难)

ext.ext_cn: 我突然遇到了这样的问题：虽然还没有成为作家，却过早受到了重视。
ext.ext_en: I ran up against the problem of getting taken seriously long before I became a writer...

ext.ext_cn: 当涉及党派特权这样敏感的问题时，他遭到了坚决的反对。
ext.ext_en: He ran up against a solid wall of opposition when it came to the sensitive issue of party privileges.

defs.def_en: If you run up against problems, you suddenly begin to experience them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （改变或区别）显著的，显而易见的

ext.ext_cn: 侵财案件明显增加了。
ext.ext_en: There has been a marked increase in crimes against property...

ext.ext_cn: 他处事严谨，与他爱张扬的妻子形成了鲜明的对比。
ext.ext_en: He was a man of austere habits, in marked contrast to his more flamboyant wife...

defs.def_en: A marked change or difference is very obvious and easily noticed.

defs.def_cn: 成为攻击对象的;处境危险的

ext.ext_cn: 他只消打一个电话，我就大难临头了。
ext.ext_en: All he needs to do is make one phone call and I'm a marked man.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a marked man or woman, you mean that they are in danger from someone who wants to harm or kill them.

ext.ext_cn: 其强行推销手段被一个消费者节目曝光的双层玻璃窗生产公司
ext.ext_en: ...a double-glazing firm whose hard-sell techniques were exposed by a consumer programme.

defs.def_en: A hard sell is a method of selling in which the salesperson puts a lot of pressure on someone to make them buy something.

ext.ext_cn: 他嗓音低沉。
ext.ext_en: His voice had a deep timbre...

ext.ext_cn: 小提琴的音色远比口琴丰富。
ext.ext_en: The timbre of the violin is far richer than that of the mouth organ.

defs.def_en: The timbre of someone's voice or of a musical instrument is the particular quality of sound that it has.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （作家、画家或作曲家）多产的，作品丰富的

ext.ext_cn: 她是一位多产的作家，写了很多小说和短篇故事。
ext.ext_en: She is a prolific writer of novels and short stories...

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪70年代，伦德格伦的作品多得惊人。
ext.ext_en: During the Seventies, Rundgren was astonishingly prolific.

defs.def_en: A prolific writer, artist, or composer produces a large number of works.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （运动员）得分多的，比赛中获胜多的

ext.ext_cn: 另外一个得分高手是迪安·桑德斯。
ext.ext_en: Another prolific scorer is Dean Saunders.

defs.def_en: A prolific sports player scores a lot of goals or wins a lot of matches or races.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人、动物、植物）多育的，多产的，高产的

ext.ext_cn: 他们都是多产的饲养员，养的母鸡很多都可以下6个蛋之多。
ext.ext_en: They are prolific breeders, with many hens laying up to six eggs.

ext.ext_cn: 结淡黄色豆荚的高产作物
ext.ext_en: ...a prolific crop of creamy gold coloured pods.

defs.def_en: An animal, person, or plant that is prolific produces a large number of babies, young plants, or fruit.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 所有的大型野兽都聚集在这里，鸟类尤其丰富。
ext.ext_en: All the big game congregate here, and birdlife is particularly prolific.

defs.def_en: If animals are prolific somewhere, there are a lot of them there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 交通拥挤，车流缓慢。
ext.ext_en: The traffic is heavy and slow...

ext.ext_cn: 使用自动搅拌器时应该选用慢挡。
ext.ext_en: Electric whisks should be used on a slow speed.

defs.def_en: Something that is slow moves, happens, or is done without much speed.

defs.def_cn: (用于非正式英语中)缓慢地，慢吞吞地

ext.ext_cn: 我走得越来越慢。
ext.ext_en: I began to walk slower and slower...

ext.ext_cn: 我们开着车去了那里，一路上开得很慢。
ext.ext_en: We got there by driving slow all the way.

defs.def_en: In informal English, slower is used to mean 'at a slower speed' and slowest is used to mean 'at the slowest speed'. In non-standard English, slow is used to mean 'with little speed'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 费时间的;时间长的;迟缓的

ext.ext_cn: 颁发护照的过程非常缓慢。
ext.ext_en: The distribution of passports has been a slow process.

defs.def_en: Something that is slow takes a long time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 国际社会对这次危机反应迟缓。
ext.ext_en: The world community has been slow to respond to the crisis...

ext.ext_cn: 我下决心有些慢。
ext.ext_en: I've been a bit slow in making up my mind.

defs.def_en: If someone is slow to do something, they do it after a delay.

ext.ext_cn: 轰炸的速度明显慢了下来。
ext.ext_en: The rate of bombing has slowed considerably...

ext.ext_cn: 她放慢车速，开始驶上一条狭窄的道路。
ext.ext_en: She slowed the car and began driving up a narrow road...

defs.def_en: If something slows or if you slow it, it starts to move or happen more slowly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的脑袋受过撞击，从那以后，他的反应变得有些迟钝。
ext.ext_en: He got hit on the head and he's been a bit slow since.

defs.def_en: Someone who is slow is not very clever and takes a long time to understand things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 呆滞的;不景气的;沉闷的

ext.ext_cn: 事情变得有点沉闷无聊的时候，不要胆怯。
ext.ext_en: Don't be faint-hearted when things seem a bit slow or boring...

ext.ext_cn: 这个岛太沉闷了，不合她的胃口。
ext.ext_en: The island is too slow for her liking.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation, place, or activity as slow, you mean that it is not very exciting.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If a clock or watch is slow, it shows a time that is earlier than the correct time.
A lullaby is a quiet song which is intended to be sung to babies and young children to help them go to sleep.

defs.def_cn: 重新审视（观点、信仰或态度）

ext.ext_cn: 我们可能会重新审视我们的目标或我们实现目标的方法。
ext.ext_en: We may reexamine our goals or our methods for attaining our goals...

ext.ext_cn: 她的丈夫和孩子也都要重新审视他们的期望。
ext.ext_en: Her husband and children will also have to re-examine their expectations.

defs.def_en: If a person or group of people re-examines their ideas, beliefs, or attitudes, they think about them carefully because they are no longer sure if they are correct.

ext.ext_cn: 仍然有许多女性为了抚养孩子而离职。
ext.ext_en: Many women still take career breaks to bring up children.

defs.def_en: If someone takes a career break, they stop working in their particular profession for a period of time, with the intention of returning to it later.
A parasol is an object like an umbrella that provides shade from the sun.

ext.ext_cn: 总水管破裂了，整条街道发了大水。
ext.ext_en: A water main burst and the street was flooded.

defs.def_en: A water main is a very large underground pipe used for supplying water to houses and factories.

defs.def_cn: 影响…的准确性;歪曲;扭曲

ext.ext_cn: 核运营成本的计算由于其他燃料的降价而出现了偏差。
ext.ext_en: The arithmetic of nuclear running costs has been skewed by the fall in the cost of other fuels...

ext.ext_cn: 今天的选举将使结果有利于这个郡的北部地区。
ext.ext_en: Today's election will skew the results in favor of the northern end of the county.

defs.def_en: If something is skewed, it is changed or affected to some extent by a new or unusual factor, and so is not correct or normal.
Egoism is the same as egotism .

ext.ext_cn: 外科医生们在做手术前开始用肥皂和水清洗双手和胳膊。
ext.ext_en: Surgeons began to scrub their hands and arms with soap and water before operating...

ext.ext_cn: 走廊擦得很干净。
ext.ext_en: The corridors are scrubbed clean.

defs.def_en: If you scrub something, you rub it hard in order to clean it, using a stiff brush and water.

ext.ext_cn: 我开始用力擦拭灰尘。
ext.ext_en: I started to scrub off the dirt...

ext.ext_cn: 马修擦掉了脸上的煤灰。
ext.ext_en: Matthew scrubbed the coal dust from his face.

defs.def_en: If you scrub dirt or stains off something, you remove them by rubbing hard.

defs.def_cn: (尤指少雨地区的)低矮丛林，灌木丛

ext.ext_cn: 一片丛林遍布之地
ext.ext_en: ...an area of scrub and woodland.

defs.def_en: Scrub consists of low trees and bushes, especially in an area that has very little rain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （常指为小事）生气的，恼怒的，愠怒的

ext.ext_cn: 奶奶很吃惊，我想还有点儿生气，因为所有这些安排都没有告诉过她。
ext.ext_en: Granny was astounded and a little piqued, I think, because it had all been arranged without her knowledge...

ext.ext_cn: 她皱皱鼻子，为他毫无热情而感到不快。
ext.ext_en: She wrinkled her nose, piqued by his total lack of enthusiasm.

defs.def_en: If someone is piqued, they are offended or annoyed, often by something that is not very important.
April Fool's Day is the 1st of April, the day on which people traditionally play tricks on each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 透明有色塑料板
ext.ext_en: ...a sheet of transparent coloured plastic...

ext.ext_cn: 我看着他清瘦的脸，脸上肌肤几近透明。
ext.ext_en: I looked at his thin face with its almost transparent skin.

defs.def_en: If an object or substance is transparent, you can see through it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 易懂的;明晰的;一目了然的

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在正努力建立明晰的议会民主制。
ext.ext_en: We are now striving hard to establish a transparent parliamentary democracy…

ext.ext_cn: 公司必须使其账目与运作尽可能地清晰透明。
ext.ext_en: The company has to make its accounts and operations as transparent as possible.

defs.def_en: If a situation, system, or activity is transparent, it is easily understood or recognized.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 官员指摘外国人的明显企图
ext.ext_en: …a transparent effort by officials to blame foreigners…

ext.ext_cn: 他以为他能用那些可以一眼看穿的鬼把戏愚弄人。
ext.ext_en: He thought he could fool people with transparent deceptions.

defs.def_en: You use transparent to describe a statement or action that is obviously dishonest or wrong, and that you think will not deceive people.
A Frenchwoman is a woman who comes from France.

ext.ext_cn: 他接到传票要出庭应诉。
ext.ext_en: He has been served with a subpoena to answer the charges in court.

defs.def_en: A subpoena is a legal document telling someone that they must attend a court of law and give evidence as a witness.

defs.def_cn: (以传票)传唤…出庭作证;要求当庭出示(证据)

ext.ext_cn: 特别委员会有权传唤证人出庭作证。
ext.ext_en: Select committees have the power to subpoena witnesses...

ext.ext_cn: 该调查将凭借现有权力要求将各种相关文件呈堂。
ext.ext_en: The investigation will rely on existing powers to subpoena documents.

defs.def_en: If someone subpoenas a person, they give them a legal document telling them to attend a court of law and give evidence. If someone subpoenas a piece of evidence, the evidence must be produced in a court of law.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 公务员办事拖沓，你可能认为政治家会把事情顺利解决。
ext.ext_en: You might expect politicians to smooth things out when civil servants are being dilatory.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is dilatory is slow and causes delay.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 暴露于风雨的;无遮蔽措施的

ext.ext_cn: 康涅狄格一处暴露于风雨中的小山坡
ext.ext_en: ...an exposed hillside in Connecticut...

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰西海岸的这一段完全暴露在大西洋海风前。
ext.ext_en: This part of the west coast of Scotland is very exposed to Atlantic winds.

defs.def_en: If a place is exposed, it has no natural protection against bad weather or enemies, for example because it has no trees or is on very high ground.

ext.ext_cn: 战争期间海军的船只在这里进行修理。
ext.ext_en: During the war, Navy ships were refitted here.

ext.ext_cn: 这艘船去年进行了大修。
ext.ext_en: The ship finished an extensive refit last year.

defs.def_en: When a ship is refitted, it is repaired or is given new parts, equipment, or furniture.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 骄傲自大的;自以为是的

ext.ext_cn: 11岁左右的时候，他就有点自以为是，因为他那时从未失败过。
ext.ext_en: He was a little bit cocky when he was about 11 because he was winning everything.

defs.def_en: Someone who is cocky is so confident and sure of their abilities that they annoy other people.

ext.ext_cn: 约克郡多岩石的荒原
ext.ext_en: ...rugged Yorkshire moorland.

defs.def_en: Moorland is land which consists of moors.

ext.ext_cn: 小艺术品，各式各样的金、银、象牙制品，瓷器一类的东西
ext.ext_en: ...objets d'art, gold, silver, and ivory assortments, ceramics, and suchlike...

ext.ext_cn: 我想你可能更愿意呆在芝加哥，吃着华夫饼干和汉堡包之类的东西，对吗？
ext.ext_en: I suppose you'd rather be in Chicago, eating waffles and hamburgers, or suchlike?

defs.def_en: You use suchlike to refer to other things that are like the ones you have already mentioned.

defs.def_cn: (尤指为商业或政治目的而组成的)联盟，同盟,联合会

ext.ext_cn: 印度产业联合会
ext.ext_en: ...the Confederation of Indian Industry.

ext.ext_cn: 把共和国分割成小国邦联的计划
ext.ext_en: ...plans to partition the republic into a confederation of mini-states.

defs.def_en: A confederation is an organization or group consisting of smaller groups or states, especially one that exists for business or political purposes.
Marksmanship is the ability to shoot accurately.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 杂七杂八的一堆车，有运货车、旧公共汽车、运牛车，甚至救火车
ext.ext_en: ...a motley collection of vans, old buses, cattle-trucks, and even a fire engine...

ext.ext_cn: 志愿者里似乎什么人都有。
ext.ext_en: The volunteers seem a motley crew.

defs.def_en: You can describe a group of things as a motley collection if you think they seem strange together because they are all very different.

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在别在小事上浪费时间了，可以吗？
ext.ext_en: Now, let's stop pissing about, shall we?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone pisses around or pisses about, you mean they waste a lot of time doing unimportant things.

ext.ext_cn: 我们只是胡闹，大笑。
ext.ext_en: We just pissed about, laughing.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone pisses around or pisses about, you mean they behave in a silly, childish way.

ext.ext_cn: 这一决定会给东伦敦的经济复苏带来新的推动力。
ext.ext_en: This decision will give renewed impetus to the economic regeneration of east London...

ext.ext_cn: 她躁动不安,需要为自己的才华找到新的突破口。
ext.ext_en: She was restless and needed a new impetus for her talent.

defs.def_en: Something that gives a process impetus or an impetus makes it happen or progress more quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 家庭和工作的双重负担耗费了他的时间。
ext.ext_en: Responsibilities at home and work eat into his time...

ext.ext_cn: 工资的涨幅高过了生产率增长的速度，从而消耗了利润所得。
ext.ext_en: Wages were rising faster than productivity and this was eating into profits.

defs.def_en: If something eats into your time or your resources, it uses them, when they should be used for other things.

ext.ext_cn: 胃酸侵蚀胃内壁引发溃疡。
ext.ext_en: Ulcers occur when the stomach's natural acids eat into the lining of the stomach.

defs.def_en: If a substance such as acid or rust eats into something, it destroys or damages its surface.
When a doctor or other trained person anaesthetizes a patient, they make the patient unconscious or unable to feel pain by giving them an anaesthetic.

ext.ext_cn: 酒精是一种能麻醉大脑的烈性药物。
ext.ext_en: Alcohol is a potent drug that anaesthetizes the brain.

defs.def_en: If something such as a drug anaesthetizes part or all of your body, it makes you unable to feel anything in that part of your body.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为)愚蠢而无同情心的，不为他人考虑的

ext.ext_cn: 该政府行事愚蠢而且麻木不仁。
ext.ext_en: The government has behaved with crass insensitivity...

ext.ext_cn: 流行音乐唱片可能会是冷漠而且愤世嫉俗的。
ext.ext_en: Pop records can be crass and cynical.

defs.def_en: Crass behaviour is stupid and does not show consideration for other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人痛苦的；辛酸的；惨痛的

ext.ext_cn: 美丽山水和悲惨历史让人黯然神伤的结合
ext.ext_en: ...a poignant combination of beautiful surroundings and tragic history.

ext.ext_cn: 辛酸的爱情故事
ext.ext_en: ...a poignant love story...

defs.def_en: Something that is poignant affects you deeply and makes you feel sadness or regret.

defs.def_cn: 先生(对男子的称呼，尤为儿语或用于称呼不知姓名的男子)

ext.ext_cn: 嘿，先生，我们知道自己该干什么，不用你指挥。
ext.ext_en: Look, Mister, we know our job, so don't try to tell us what to do.

defs.def_en: Men are sometimes addressed as mister, especially by children and especially when the person talking to them does not know their name.

ext.ext_cn: 左岸那些鹅卵石铺成的窄窄的街道
ext.ext_en: ...the narrow, cobblestone streets of the Left Bank.

defs.def_en: Cobblestones are stones with a rounded upper surface which used to be used for making streets.

ext.ext_cn: 病毒会在携带者体内发生变异。
ext.ext_en: The virus mutates in the carrier's body...

ext.ext_cn: 一种叫作吡啶酮的新型抗艾滋病药物能促使艾滋病毒变异，使其不能繁殖，也不会再感染新的细胞。
ext.ext_en: A newer anti-HIV drug called pyridinone caused HIV to mutate into a form which could not reproduce or infect new cells...

defs.def_en: If an animal or plant mutates, or something mutates it, it develops different characteristics as the result of a change in its genes.

ext.ext_cn: 一夜之间，传闻变成了报纸的头条新闻。
ext.ext_en: Overnight, the gossip begins to mutate into headlines.

defs.def_en: If something mutates into something different, it changes into that thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 双方充满火药味的声明引发了人们对战争的担心
ext.ext_en: ...the belligerent statements from both sides which have led to fears of war...

ext.ext_cn: 他故态复萌，几乎又像一年前那样咄咄逼人了。
ext.ext_en: He was almost back to his belligerent mood of twelve months ago.

defs.def_en: A belligerent person is hostile and aggressive.

ext.ext_cn: 预计交战双方要再一次试图解决彼此的分歧了。
ext.ext_en: The belligerents were due, once again, to try to settle their differences.

defs.def_en: The belligerents in a war are the countries or groups that are fighting each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 之后是几小时的忙活。要竖起帐篷，搭好货摊。
ext.ext_en: Hours of feverish activity lay ahead. The tents had to be erected, the stalls set up.

defs.def_en: Feverish activity is done extremely quickly, often in a state of nervousness or excitement because you want to finish it as soon as possible.

defs.def_cn: (情绪)极度紧张兴奋的，极度焦虑狂躁的

ext.ext_cn: 他将带着紧张兴奋的期待出席下周的美国格莱美奖颁奖。
ext.ext_en: He will be attending next week's American Grammy Awards in feverish anticipation.

ext.ext_cn: 紧张激动的状态
ext.ext_en: ...a state of feverish excitement.

defs.def_en: Feverish emotion is characterized by extreme nervousness or excitement.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 发烧的孩子不愿吃东西，只会要冷饮。
ext.ext_en: A feverish child refuses to eat and asks only for cold drinks...

ext.ext_cn: 她看上去像是发烧了，两眼闪着光。
ext.ext_en: She looked feverish, her eyes glistened.

defs.def_en: If you are feverish, you are suffering from a fever.
Sacking is rough woven material that is used to make sacks.

ext.ext_en: ...the sacking of twenty-three thousand miners.

defs.def_en: You use what in questions when you ask for specific information about something that you do not know.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于动词和形容词后以引导关系从句）

ext.ext_cn: 你可以想象汽车以每小时30英里的速度撞向一堵砖墙结果会怎样。
ext.ext_en: You can imagine what it would be like driving a car into a brick wall at 30 miles an hour...

ext.ext_cn: 我想知道诺曼怎么了。
ext.ext_en: I want to know what happened to Norman...

defs.def_en: You use what after certain words, especially verbs and adjectives, when you are referring to a situation that is unknown or has not been specified.

defs.def_cn: (用在强调句型的句首)所…的(是…)

ext.ext_cn: 究竟是什么引发了昨天的骚乱还不清楚。
ext.ext_en: What precisely triggered off yesterday's riot is still unclear...

ext.ext_cn: 我最想要的就是能休息几天。
ext.ext_en: What I wanted, more than anything, was a few days' rest...

defs.def_en: You use what at the beginning of a clause in structures where you are changing the order of the information to give special emphasis to something.

ext.ext_cn: 她处于医生所说的不可逆性植物人状态已经5年了。
ext.ext_en: She had been in what doctors described as an irreversible vegetative state for five years...

ext.ext_cn: 同时，人们认为西方的大多数年轻人把婚姻这一可能是人生最重要的决定几乎完全交由命运来安排。
ext.ext_en: Meanwhile, most young people in the West are expected to leave what could be life's most momentous decision—marriage—almost entirely up to luck.

defs.def_en: You use what in expressions such as what is called and what amounts to when you are giving a description of something.

ext.ext_cn: 他把杯子里剩下的东西当水一样全喝了下去。
ext.ext_en: He drinks what is left in his glass as if it were water...

ext.ext_cn: 他小心翼翼地跨过残余的隔墙。
ext.ext_en: He moved carefully over what remained of partition walls.

defs.def_en: You use what to indicate that you are talking about the whole of an amount that is available to you.

defs.def_cn: (表示已经听到对方的话，并请其继续说)什么事

ext.ext_cn: “爸爸？”——“什么事？”——“我今晚能用车吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'Dad?' — 'What?' — 'Can I have the car tonight?'

defs.def_en: You say 'What?' to tell someone who has indicated that they want to speak to you that you have heard them and are inviting them to continue.

defs.def_cn: (用于没有听清或听懂时，请求他人再重复一遍刚说的话;不如 pardon，excuse me 等正式和礼貌)什么

ext.ext_cn: “他们可以粉刷这个地方，”她说。“什么？”他问。
ext.ext_en: 'They could paint this place,' she said. 'What?' he asked.

defs.def_en: You say 'What?' when you ask someone to repeat the thing that they have just said because you did not hear or understand it properly. 'What?' is more informal and less polite than expressions such as 'Pardon?' and 'Excuse me?'.

ext.ext_cn: “阿道弗斯·克林，我以贩毒的罪名逮捕你。”——“什么？”
ext.ext_en: 'Adolphus Kelling, I arrest you on a charge of trafficking in narcotics.'—'What?'

ext.ext_cn: “我们已经找到撞死迈拉·莫斯的车了。”——“真的！”
ext.ext_en: 'We've got the car that killed Myra Moss.' — 'What!'

defs.def_en: You say 'What' to express surprise.

defs.def_cn: (用在感叹句中强调某种意见或反应)多么

ext.ext_cn: 做这样的事简直太可怕了！
ext.ext_en: What a horrible thing to do...

ext.ext_cn: 多么忙碌的一天啊。
ext.ext_en: What a busy day.

defs.def_en: You use what in exclamations to emphasize an opinion or reaction.

ext.ext_cn: 打从他上次见他，已有，嗯，11年甚至更久了。
ext.ext_en: It's, what, eleven years or more since he's seen him...

ext.ext_cn: 这首曲子有，嗯，大约半个小时那么长，对吗？
ext.ext_en: This piece is, what, about a half an hour long?

defs.def_en: You use what to indicate that you are making a guess about something such as an amount or value.

defs.def_cn: 你猜怎么着，你知道吗(表示接下来的信息令人惊讶，很少有人知道或者需要强调 )

ext.ext_cn: 你猜怎么着？今晚我要去康伯利夫人家里赴宴。
ext.ext_en: Guess what? I'm going to dinner at Mrs. Combley's tonight...

ext.ext_cn: 你知道吗？我下午要去看马戏。
ext.ext_en: Do you know what? I'm going to the circus this afternoon.

defs.def_en: You say guess what or do you know what to introduce a piece of information which is surprising, which is not generally known, or which you want to emphasize.

defs.def_cn: (用于疑问句后，表示语气强烈地陈述观点，并希望他人赞同)难道不是吗，是不是啊

ext.ext_cn: 看看那月亮，它真漂亮，不是吗？
ext.ext_en: Look at that moon. Is that beautiful or what?...

ext.ext_cn: 我是在这儿浪费时间吗，是不是啊？
ext.ext_en: Am I wasting my time here, or what?

defs.def_en: In conversation, you say or what? after a question as a way of stating an opinion forcefully and showing that you expect other people to agree.

defs.def_cn: (用来暗指之前的话不重要、无趣或与己无关)那又怎样，那又如何

ext.ext_cn: “我今天逃学了。”——“那又怎样？有什么特别的吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'I skipped off school today,' — 'So what? What's so special about that?'...

ext.ext_cn: “记住，这是美国的好莱坞，所有那些影片都是在这里制作的。”——“那又如何？”
ext.ext_en: 'This is Hollywood, U.S.A., where they make all the movies, remember.' — 'What of it?'...

defs.def_en: You say so what? or what of it? to indicate that the previous remark seems unimportant, uninteresting, or irrelevant to you.

defs.def_cn: (用于提出建议)我有个主意，你听我说

ext.ext_cn: 我想，我们可以在这里再呆一天。
ext.ext_en: Tell you what, let's stay here another day.

defs.def_en: You say 'Tell you what' to introduce a suggestion or offer.

defs.def_cn: (用于问句句首，表示提出建议或请求)…怎么样

ext.ext_cn: 明天和我一起出去怎么样？
ext.ext_en: What about going out with me tomorrow?...

ext.ext_cn: “周日晚上在弗兰克家怎么样？”——“好啊，几点？”
ext.ext_en: 'What about Sunday evening at Frank's?' — 'Sure. What time?'...

defs.def_en: You use what about at the beginning of a question when you make a suggestion, offer, or request.

defs.def_cn: (用于引出与之前内容相关的新的话题或观点)那么…怎么样

ext.ext_cn: 既然你们已谈到了种植水仙花，那么其他具有重要商业价值的花卉呢，比如玫瑰？
ext.ext_en: Now you've talked about work on daffodils, what about other commercially important flowers, like roses?...

ext.ext_cn: 那么在你五年级时，有人就上大学给过你择业方面的建议吗？
ext.ext_en: And what about when you were in the fifth year, did people give you careers advice on coming to college?...

defs.def_en: You use what about or what of when you introduce a new topic or a point which seems relevant to a previous remark.

defs.def_cn: (用于请某人解释原因)…怎么了

ext.ext_cn: “是跟那个科比特家的女人有关的事。”——“哦，是吗，她怎么了？”
ext.ext_en: 'This thing with the Corbett woman.'—'Oh, yeah. What about her?'

defs.def_en: You say what about a particular person or thing when you ask someone to explain why they have asked you about that person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 现如今很多食品都不安全——牛奶、蓝莓酱等等。
ext.ext_en: So many things are unsafe these days—milk, cranberry sauce, what have you...

ext.ext_cn: 我曾祖父打制马掌、铁钉等诸如此类的东西。
ext.ext_en: My great-grandfather made horseshoes and nails and what have you.

defs.def_en: You say what have you at the end of a list in order to refer generally to other things of the same kind.

defs.def_cn: (用于疑问句句首，尤用于询问不希望看到的事发生时的结果)如果…怎么办

ext.ext_cn: 如果这个不行怎么办？
ext.ext_en: What if this doesn't work out?...

ext.ext_cn: 如果他快要死了该怎么办？
ext.ext_en: What if he was going to die!...

defs.def_en: You say what if at the beginning of a question when you ask about the consequences of something happening, especially something undesirable.

ext.ext_cn: 你必须搞清状况以及自己的底线。
ext.ext_en: You have to know what's what and when to draw the line...

ext.ext_cn: 你应该和我们一起过河，那时你就会了解实情了。
ext.ext_en: You should come across the river with us. Then you will really see what's what.

defs.def_en: If you know what's what, you know the important things that need to be known about a situation.

defs.def_cn: (尤指不想看到的情况的发生)由于，因为

ext.ext_cn: 也许他们是太累了，考虑到他们成宿成宿地熬夜。
ext.ext_en: Maybe they are tired, what with all the sleep they're losing staying up night after night...

ext.ext_cn: 由于这事那事，那天我们返回什鲁斯伯里时已经很晚了。
ext.ext_en: What with one thing and another, it was fairly late in the day when we returned to Shrewsbury.

defs.def_en: You say what with in order to introduce the reasons for a particular situation, especially an undesirable one.

defs.def_cn: (表示不相信或不能接受某人刚说的话，或没有听清或完全理解)你说什么？

ext.ext_cn: “今晚我可能睡不着。”——“不会吧？”
ext.ext_en: 'I'm going to have problems sleeping tonight.' — 'You what?'...

ext.ext_cn: “你在这儿干什么呢？”——“哦，我现在在这里工作。”——“你说什么？”
ext.ext_en: 'What are you doing here?' — 'Oh I work here now.' — 'You what?'

defs.def_en: People say 'you what?' to indicate that they do not believe or accept the remark that someone has just made, or that they have not heard or understood it properly.

ext.ext_cn: 马萨伊马拉禁猎区和安博塞利国家公园
ext.ext_en: ...the Masai Mara game reserve and Amboseli national park.

defs.def_en: A national park is a large area of land which is protected by the government because of its natural beauty, plants, or animals, and which the public can usually visit.

ext.ext_cn: 如果在淡季出游，就有可能去一些价格较为昂贵的旅游胜地度假。
ext.ext_en: It is possible to vacation at some of the more expensive resorts if you go in the off-season...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然处于淡季，这家饭店却客满了。
ext.ext_en: Although it was off-season, the hotel was fully occupied.

defs.def_en: The off season is the time of the year when not many people go on holiday and when things such as hotels and plane tickets are often cheaper.

defs.def_cn: （某一体育运动的）非赛季，休赛期

ext.ext_cn: 他趁澳大利亚的休赛期在意大利执教并参加比赛。
ext.ext_en: He has coached and played in Italy during the Australian off-season.

ext.ext_cn: 休赛期间的强化训练
ext.ext_en: ...intensive off-season training.

defs.def_en: The off season is the time of the year when a particular sport is not played.

defs.def_cn: 惊叫;感叹;感叹词;感叹句

ext.ext_cn: 我们清楚看到那所房子时，休惊叹不已。
ext.ext_en: Sue gave an exclamation as we got a clear sight of the house.

defs.def_en: An exclamation is a sound, word, or sentence that is spoken suddenly, loudly, or emphatically and that expresses excitement, admiration, shock, or anger.

defs.def_cn: 故作天真地;佯装无知地

ext.ext_cn: 我与克丽茜对视了一眼,但她只是一脸天真地对我微笑。
ext.ext_en: I caught Chrissie's eye, but she only smiled back at me innocently...

ext.ext_cn: “你很快会再往那边去吗?”我故作不知地问道。
ext.ext_en: 'Any chance you'd be heading out that way again, soon?' I asked innocently.

defs.def_en: See also:innocent;If you say that someone does or says something innocently, you mean that they are pretending not to know something about a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 利率可能很快就会下调，从而刺激美国经济。
ext.ext_en: Interest rates could fall soon and be a stimulus to the US economy...

ext.ext_cn: 我们是通过神经系统使自己适应环境及所有外部刺激的。
ext.ext_en: It is through our nervous system that we adapt ourselves to our environment and to all external stimuli.

defs.def_en: A stimulus is something that encourages activity in people or things.

In economics, a country's GDP is the total value of goods and services produced within a country in a year, not including its income from investments in other countries. GDP is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'gross domestic product'.

ext.ext_cn: 冷水澡可以刺激身体，促进血液循环。
ext.ext_en: A cool shower wakes up the body and boosts circulation.

defs.def_en: See also:wake;If something such as an activity wakes you up, it makes you more alert and ready to do things after you have been lazy or inactive.

ext.ext_cn: 这个方案在上周的中央委员会全体会议上获得了通过。
ext.ext_en: The programme was approved at a plenary session of the Central Committee last week.

ext.ext_cn: 今天下午五六点钟在研讨会结束后还有一次全体会议。
ext.ext_en: There'll be another plenary at the end of the afternoon after the workshop.

defs.def_en: A plenary session or plenary meeting is one that is attended by everyone who has the right to attend.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她站在昏暗的光线下等待。
ext.ext_en: She stood waiting, in the dim light...

ext.ext_cn: 船舱里灯光昏暗。
ext.ext_en: Below decks, the lights were dim.

defs.def_en: Dim light is not bright.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 房间里阴暗、清冷，静悄悄的。
ext.ext_en: The room was dim and cool and quiet.

defs.def_en: A dim place is rather dark because there is not much light in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人影、物体)隐约的，蒙眬的，不分明的

ext.ext_cn: 皮特的火把映出了鲍勃和张的模糊身影。
ext.ext_en: Pete's torch picked out the dim figures of Bob and Chang.

defs.def_en: A dim figure or object is not very easy to see, either because it is in shadow or darkness, or because it is far away.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (记忆、理解)模糊的，依稀的，不清晰的

ext.ext_cn: 20 世纪 60 年代的社会激进主义似乎只是一个模糊的记忆。
ext.ext_en: It seems that the '60s era of social activism is all but a dim memory.

defs.def_en: If you have a dim memory or understanding of something, it is difficult to remember or is unclear in your mind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (前景)灰暗的，渺茫的，不光明的

ext.ext_cn: 和平解决的希望非常渺茫。
ext.ext_en: The prospects for a peaceful solution are dim.

defs.def_en: If the future of something is dim, you have no reason to feel hopeful or positive about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as dim, you think that they are stupid.

ext.ext_cn: 把灯光调暗一些——躺着时眼前灯光太强很不舒服。
ext.ext_en: Dim the lighting – it is unpleasant to lie with a bright light shining in your eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 观众席的灯暗了下来。
ext.ext_en: The houselights dimmed.

defs.def_en: If you dim a light or if it dims, it becomes less bright.

defs.def_cn: 将(汽车前灯)调为近光;使减光

ext.ext_cn: 开到那辆车后面时将前灯调为近光。
ext.ext_en: Dim your lights behind that car.

defs.def_en: If you are driving a car and dim the headlights, you operate a switch that makes them shine downwards, so that they do not shine directly into the eyes of other drivers.

defs.def_cn: (使)(前景、希望等)变渺茫;(使)（感情等）淡化

ext.ext_cn: 他们的经济前景变得很暗淡。
ext.ext_en: Their economic prospects have dimmed...

ext.ext_cn: 48 年的婚姻生活并没消磨掉比尔和海伦之间的激情。
ext.ext_en: Forty eight years of marriage have not dimmed the passion between Bill and Helen.

defs.def_en: If your future, hopes, or emotions dim or if something dims them, they become less good or less strong.

ext.ext_cn: 悲痛之下，她泪眼蒙眬。
ext.ext_en: Her eyes dimmed with sorrow...

ext.ext_cn: 他眼中闪烁的光芒被泪水模糊了。
ext.ext_en: The twinkle in his eyes was dimmed by tears.

defs.def_en: If your eyes dim or are dimmed by something, they become weaker or unable to see clearly.

defs.def_cn: (使)(记忆)变模糊;(使)变得不清晰

ext.ext_cn: 他们对所发生事情的记忆变得模糊了。
ext.ext_en: Their memory of what happened has dimmed...

ext.ext_cn: 经过了其间那么多年他的记忆已经不大清楚了。
ext.ext_en: The intervening years had dimmed his memory.

defs.def_en: If your memories dim or if something dims them, they become less clear in your mind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 愤世嫉俗的简单化解释
ext.ext_en: ...a cynical, reductive interpretation.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a theory or a work of art as reductive, you disapprove of it because it reduces complex things to simple elements.

ext.ext_cn: 那笔资金被地方当局用来支付公共事业的开支。
ext.ext_en: The money is used by local authorities to pay for public services.

ext.ext_cn: 从事公共事业的工人举行的罢工
ext.ext_en: ...a strike by public service workers.

defs.def_en: A public service is something such as health care, transport, or the removal of waste which is organized by the government or an official body in order to benefit all the people  in a particular society or community.

defs.def_cn: （政府部门，尤指行政部门的）公务，公职，公共岗位

ext.ext_cn: 杰出的公务员生涯
ext.ext_en: ...a distinguished career in public service.

ext.ext_cn: 公共岗位工资低的观点
ext.ext_en: ...the idea of low-wage public service jobs.

defs.def_en: You use public service to refer to activities and jobs which are provided or paid for by a government, especially through the civil service.

defs.def_cn: （广播事业）为公共服务的，公益的
defs.def_en: Public service broadcasting consists of television and radio programmes supplied by an official or government organization, rather than by a commercial company. Such programmes often provide information or education, as well as entertainment.

ext.ext_cn: 受到备受攻击的关于公益事业和义务的观念
ext.ext_en: ...the notion of public service and obligation which has been under such attack.

ext.ext_cn: 以合作和公益事业为基础的平等主义社会
ext.ext_en: ...an egalitarian society based on cooperation and public service.

defs.def_en: Public service activities and types of work are concerned with helping people and providing them with what they need, rather than making a profit.

ext.ext_cn: 运动员们正在进行一项公益活动，将打大联盟棒球比赛的快乐带到了社区。
ext.ext_en: Sportsmen are performing a public service by bringing the joys of major-league baseball to their communities.

defs.def_en: If you perform a public service, you do something that helps or benefits the people in a particular community.

defs.def_cn: （情感、事件等）使不知所措，使难以承受

ext.ext_cn: 他一心渴望回到从前。
ext.ext_en: He was overwhelmed by a longing for times past...

ext.ext_cn: 她迫不及待地要找个人说说话，随便是谁都行。
ext.ext_en: The need to talk to someone, anyone, overwhelmed her.

defs.def_en: If you are overwhelmed by a feeling or event, it affects you very strongly, and you do not know how to deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 毫无疑问，盟军一次大规模的进攻就会击溃已是强弩之末的敌军。
ext.ext_en: It was clear that one massive Allied offensive would overwhelm the weakened enemy.

defs.def_en: If a group of people overwhelm a place or another group, they gain complete control or victory over them.
A recruitment consultant is a person or service that helps professional people to find work by introducing them to potential employers.

defs.def_cn: 卢比（印度、巴基斯坦等国的货币单位）

ext.ext_cn: 他一天挣20卢比。
ext.ext_en: He earns 20 rupees a day.

defs.def_en: A rupee is a unit of money that is used in India, Pakistan, and some other countries.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 被动的；顺从的；听之任之的

ext.ext_cn: 他顺从的态度让我做起事来要轻松些。
ext.ext_en: His passive attitude made things easier for me...

ext.ext_cn: 即使被动接受该政权也是一种通敌行为。
ext.ext_en: Even passive acceptance of the regime was a kind of collaboration.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as passive, you mean that they do not take action but instead let things happen to them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们想找些更为积极的方式来打发时间。
ext.ext_en: They want less passive ways of filling their time.

ext.ext_cn: 观看绘画或雕塑获得的被动享受
ext.ext_en: ...the passive enjoyment one gets from  looking at a painting or sculpture.

defs.def_en: A passive activity involves watching, looking at, or listening to things rather than doing things.

ext.ext_cn: 他们声明一旦发生军事接管，他们只会采取非暴力抵抗。
ext.ext_en: They made it clear that they would only exercise passive resistance in the event of a military takeover.

defs.def_en: Passive resistance involves showing opposition to the people in power in your country by not co-operating with them and protesting in non-violent ways.

In grammar, the passive or the passive voice is formed using 'be' and the past participle of a verb. The subject of a passive clause does not perform the action expressed by the verb but is affected by it. For example, in 'He's been murdered', the verb is in the passive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 低椅座的印花棉布扶手椅
ext.ext_en: ...a low-slung chintz-armchair.
