defs.def_cn: 为…祈求上帝保佑；为…祈神赐福

ext.ext_cn: 就让在场的所有人祝福这对夫妇以及他们对彼此爱的承诺
ext.ext_en: ...asking for all present to bless this couple and their loving commitment to one another.

defs.def_en: When someone such as a priest blesses people or things, he asks for God's favour and protection for them.

defs.def_cn: （用于表达爱意、感谢或祝愿）愿上帝保佑

ext.ext_cn: “愿上帝保佑你，伊娃，”他低声说。
ext.ext_en: 'Bless you, Eva,' he whispered...

ext.ext_cn: 愿上帝保佑你们，非常感谢。
ext.ext_en: God bless and thank you all so much.

defs.def_en: Bless is used in expressions such as 'God bless' or 'bless you' to express affection, thanks, or good wishes.

defs.def_cn: （对刚打喷嚏的人说）长命百岁
defs.def_en: You can say 'bless you' to someone who has just sneezed.

defs.def_cn: （用于名词之后构成形容词）在…之后

ext.ext_cn: 餐后演说
ext.ext_en: ...an after-dinner speech...

ext.ext_cn: 表演结束后在芝兰街一家餐馆吃到的一顿美味晚餐
ext.ext_en: ...a delicious after-show supper at a restaurant in Gerard Street...

defs.def_en: After- is added to nouns to form adjectives which indicate that something takes place or exists after an event or process.
Your breastbone is the long, flat bone which goes from your throat to the bottom of your ribs and to which your ribs are attached.

ext.ext_cn: 他们不会让我抽烟的。
ext.ext_en: They wouldn't allow me to smoke.

defs.def_en: Wouldn't is the usual spoken form of 'would not'.

ext.ext_cn: 我希望每个人都能够加入进来，玩得开心。
ext.ext_en: I hope that everyone will be able to join in the fun...

ext.ext_cn: 他开始唱起歌来，然后我也跟着唱起来。
ext.ext_en: He started to sing and I joined in.

defs.def_en: If you join in an activity, you take part in it or become involved in it.

defs.def_cn: （在律师或会计师事务所）签约当学徒的，见习的

ext.ext_cn: 他最初订约给一位律师当学徒。
ext.ext_en: He was initially articled to a solicitor.

ext.ext_cn: 实习文员
ext.ext_en: ...an articled clerk.

defs.def_en: In Britain, someone who is articled to a firm of lawyers or accountants is employed by the firm and is training to become qualified.

ext.ext_cn: 她还是个小姑娘的时候就分担起照顾弟弟的责任。
ext.ext_en: She had shared responsibility for her brother since girlhood...

ext.ext_cn: 少女时期的她曾梦想过学习绘画。
ext.ext_en: Her girlhood dream had been to study painting.

defs.def_en: Girlhood is the period of a female person's life during which she is a girl.

ext.ext_cn: 他的头脑似乎还清楚，听觉也很好。
ext.ext_en: His mind still seemed clear and his hearing was excellent.

defs.def_en: A person's or animal's hearing is the sense which makes it possible for them to be aware of sounds.

ext.ext_cn: 法官宣布休庭至下周二再审。
ext.ext_en: The judge adjourned the hearing until next Tuesday.

defs.def_en: A hearing is an official meeting which is held in order to collect facts about an incident or problem.

ext.ext_cn: 韦伯让持不同意见的人都能有机会发表意见。
ext.ext_en: Weber gave a fair hearing to anyone who held a different opinion.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you a fair hearing or a hearing, they listen to you when you give your opinion about something.

ext.ext_cn: 没有人在她跟前说过她父亲的坏话。
ext.ext_en: No one spoke disparagingly of her father in her hearing.

defs.def_en: If someone says something in your hearing or within your hearing, you can hear what they say because they are with you or near you.

ext.ext_cn: 一条长长的茎秆的每个节上都会长出一朵浅蓝色的花。
ext.ext_en: A single pale blue flower grows up from each joint on a long stalk.

ext.ext_cn: 玉米秆
ext.ext_en: ...corn stalks.

defs.def_en: The stalk of a flower, leaf, or fruit is the thin part that joins it to the plant or tree.

ext.ext_cn: 他像猎手跟踪鹿一样悄悄跟踪受害人。
ext.ext_en: He stalks his victims like a hunter after a deer.

defs.def_en: If you stalk a person or a wild animal, you follow them quietly in order to kill them, catch them, or observe them carefully.

defs.def_cn: 跟踪骚扰，不断纠缠(名人、分手恋人等)

ext.ext_cn: 即使在离婚后他仍继续纠缠和威胁她。
ext.ext_en: Even after their divorce he continued to stalk and threaten her.

defs.def_en: If someone stalks someone else, especially a famous person or a person they used to have a relationship with, they keep following them or contacting them in an annoying and frightening way.

defs.def_cn: 高视阔步;怒气冲冲地走

ext.ext_cn: 大家都知道如果他在会议上失去耐心，便会愤怒离席。
ext.ext_en: If his patience is tried at meetings he has been known to stalk out.

defs.def_en: If you stalk somewhere, you walk there in a stiff, proud, or angry way.

defs.def_cn: (死亡、恐惧、罪恶等)笼罩，蔓延，肆虐

ext.ext_cn: 用他的话来说，新法西斯主义的幽灵正在索非亚和其他大城市中游荡。
ext.ext_en: The spectre of neo-fascism, as he put it, was stalking the streets of Sofia and other big cities.

defs.def_en: If you say that something bad such as death, fear, or evil stalks a place, you mean it is there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (常指因年迈而)体弱的,虚弱的

ext.ext_cn: 她年迈体弱的丈夫
ext.ext_en: ...her aging, infirm husband.

ext.ext_cn: 我们来这里保护、帮助年迈体弱者。
ext.ext_en: We are here to protect and assist the weak and infirm.

defs.def_en: A person who is infirm is weak or ill, and usually old.

defs.def_cn: 学科间的;涉及若干学科的;跨学科的

ext.ext_cn: 综合了心理学、哲学与语言学的跨学科课程
ext.ext_en: ...interdisciplinary courses combining psychology, philosophy and linguistics.

defs.def_en: Interdisciplinary means involving more than one academic subject.

ext.ext_cn: 波士顿超高频频道
ext.ext_en: ...Boston UHF channels.

defs.def_en: UHF is a range of radio waves which allows a radio or television receiver to produce a good quality of sound. UHF is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'ultra-high frequency'.

ext.ext_cn: 四五十个女人盘腿坐在地上。
ext.ext_en: Forty or fifty women were sitting cross-legged on the ground...

ext.ext_cn: 我们沿着屋顶滑了下来，落到地上。
ext.ext_en: We slid down the roof and dropped to the ground.

defs.def_en: The ground is the surface of the earth.

ext.ext_cn: 协调地面的航空交通与管理空中交通一样复杂。
ext.ext_en: Coordinating airline traffic on the ground is as complicated as managing the traffic in the air.

defs.def_en: If you say that something takes place on the ground, you mean it takes place on the surface of the earth and not in the air.

ext.ext_cn: 这片土壤遭到侵蚀。
ext.ext_en: The ground had eroded.

ext.ext_cn: 河流三角洲的沼泽地
ext.ext_en: ...the marshy ground of the river delta.

defs.def_en: The ground is the soil and rock on the earth's surface.

defs.def_cn: （尤指建筑物极少或具有某种特性的）土地

ext.ext_cn: 一块荒地
ext.ext_en: ...a stretch of waste ground...

ext.ext_cn: 这块纪念碑屹立于圣地之上。
ext.ext_en: This memorial stands on sacred ground.

defs.def_en: You can refer to land as ground, especially when it has very few buildings or when it is considered to be special in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 印第安人的狩猎场
ext.ext_en: ...Indian hunting grounds...

ext.ext_cn: 最好的渔场在这些岛屿周围。
ext.ext_en: The best fishing grounds are around the islands.

defs.def_en: You can use ground to refer to an area of land, sea, or air which is used for a particular activity.

defs.def_cn: 运动场，…场（美国英语中亦作grounds）

ext.ext_cn: 该市的足球场
ext.ext_en: ...the city's football ground.

ext.ext_cn: 阅兵场
ext.ext_en: ...a parade ground.

defs.def_en: A ground is an area of land which is specially designed and made for playing sport or for some other activity. In American English grounds is also used.

defs.def_cn: （大型或重要建筑周围的）场地，庭院，花园

ext.ext_cn: 皇家花园
ext.ext_en: ...the palace grounds.

ext.ext_cn: 大学校区
ext.ext_en: ...the grounds of the University.

defs.def_en: The grounds of a large or important building are the garden or area of land which surrounds it.

defs.def_cn: （适于方法、思想等发展的）地方

ext.ext_cn: 该公司一直享有新技术研发基地的美誉。
ext.ext_en: The company has maintained its reputation as the developing ground for new techniques...

ext.ext_cn: 西雅图是适合小型企业发展的沃土。
ext.ext_en: Seattle is fertile ground for small businesses.

defs.def_en: You can use ground to refer to a place or situation in which particular methods or ideas can develop and be successful.

ext.ext_cn: 感到自己的观点站不住脚，玛丽于是换了个话题。
ext.ext_en: Sensing she was on shaky ground, Marie changed the subject...

ext.ext_cn: 法国人认为不能以提高竞争力为由进行贬值，他们是有道理的。
ext.ext_en: The French are on solid ground when they argue that competitiveness is no reason for devaluation...

defs.def_en: You can use ground in expressions such as on shaky ground and the same ground to refer to a particular subject, area of experience, or basis for an argument.

ext.ext_cn: 有迹象表明该党在最新一轮投票中正逐渐领先。
ext.ext_en: There are signs that the party is gaining ground in the latest polls...

ext.ext_cn: 美元失去了更多的优势。
ext.ext_en: The US dollar lost more ground.

defs.def_en: Ground is used in expressions such as gain ground ,lose ground, and give ground in order to indicate that someone gets or loses an advantage.

ext.ext_cn: 他接受采访时阐述了持乐观态度的理由。
ext.ext_en: In the interview he gave some grounds for optimism...

ext.ext_cn: 法庭以检控方拒绝出示关键证据为由撤销了那项判决。
ext.ext_en: The court overturned that decision on the grounds that the Prosecution had withheld crucial evidence...

defs.def_en: If something is grounds for a feeling or action, it is a reason for it. If you do something on the grounds of a particular thing, that thing is the reason for your action.

defs.def_cn: 以…为根据；建立在…基础上

ext.ext_cn: 她的观点有事实根据。
ext.ext_en: Her argument was grounded in fact...

ext.ext_cn: 基于对人类精神神圣性的信仰，他们认为灵魂是永恒的。
ext.ext_en: They believe the soul is immortal, grounding this belief on the Divine nature of the human spirit.

defs.def_en: If an argument, belief, or opinion is grounded in something, that thing is used to justify it.

ext.ext_cn: 民航部长下令所有飞机不得起飞。
ext.ext_en: The civil aviation minister ordered all the planes to be grounded...

ext.ext_cn: 氢气泄漏迫使美国国家航空航天局停止了航天飞机的发射。
ext.ext_en: A hydrogen leak forced NASA to ground the space shuttle.

defs.def_en: If an aircraft or its passengers are grounded, they are made to stay on the ground and are not allowed to take off.

ext.ext_cn: 汤普森罚他一个月不能出门，并禁止看电视。
ext.ext_en: Thompson grounded him for a month, and banned television.

defs.def_en: When parents ground a child, they forbid them to go out and enjoy themselves for a period of time, as a punishment.

ext.ext_cn: 居民们被告知不要靠近船只搁浅的区域。
ext.ext_en: Residents have been told to stay away from the region where the ship was grounded...

ext.ext_cn: 那条船最终在松软的水下浅滩搁浅了。
ext.ext_en: The boat finally grounded on a soft, underwater bank.

defs.def_en: If a ship or boat is grounded or if it grounds, it touches the bottom of the sea, lake, or river it is on, and is unable to move off.
The ground in an electric plug or piece of electrical equipment is the wire through which electricity passes into the ground and which makes the equipment safe.

ext.ext_cn: 绞碎的牛肉
ext.ext_en: ...ground beef.

ext.ext_cn: 这些香肠用切得较粗的猪肉制成。
ext.ext_en: ...The sausages are made of coarsely ground pork.

defs.def_en: Ground meat has been cut into very small pieces in a machine.

defs.def_cn: 开辟新领域；开创新方法

ext.ext_cn: 当盖尔霍恩发出她第一篇关于西班牙内战的报道时，她也许已经开辟了一片新的天地。
ext.ext_en: Gellhorn may have broken new ground when she filed her first report on the Spanish Civil War.

defs.def_en: If you break new ground, you do something completely different or you do something in a completely different way.

ext.ext_cn: 该镇在法国大革命后被夷为平地。
ext.ext_en: The town was razed to the ground after the French Revolution.

defs.def_en: If you say that a town or building is burnt to the ground or is razed to the ground, you are emphasizing that it has been completely destroyed by fire.
If two people or groups find common ground, they agree about something, especially when they do not agree about other things.

ext.ext_cn: 东贝鲁特的市民们躲进了地下室和掩体中。
ext.ext_en: Citizens of East Beirut went to ground in basements and shelters.

defs.def_en: If you go to ground, you hide somewhere where you cannot easily be found.

ext.ext_cn: 她似乎已经找到了实现相互支持而非完全依赖其中一方的中间立场。
ext.ext_en: She seems to have found a middle ground in which mutual support, rather than complete dependency, is possible.

defs.def_en: The middle ground between two groups, ideas, or plans involves things which do not belong to either of these groups, ideas, or plans but have elements of each, often in a less extreme form.

ext.ext_cn: 我们帮助一些小公司顺利起步。
ext.ext_en: We help small companies to get off the ground.

defs.def_en: If something such as a project gets off the ground, it begins or starts functioning.

defs.def_cn: 在自己熟悉的领域里；在自己的地盘

ext.ext_cn: 她在自己熟悉的领域里对自己的行为有十足的把握。
ext.ext_en: On her own ground she knows exactly what she's doing.

defs.def_en: If you are on your own ground, you are in a place or situation in which you feel confident because you are very familiar with it.

ext.ext_cn: 为战争埋下了伏笔的政治倡议
ext.ext_en: ...a political initiative which would prepare the ground for war.

defs.def_en: If you prepare the ground for a future event, course of action, or development, you make it easier for it to happen.
If you shift your ground or change your ground, you change the basis on which you are arguing.

ext.ext_cn: 萨哈罗夫坚持立场、坦率直言的样子让我看到了希望。
ext.ext_en: The spectacle of Sakharov standing his ground and speaking his mind gave me hope.

defs.def_en: If you stand your ground or hold your ground, you continue to support a particular argument or to have a particular opinion when other people are opposing you or trying to make you change your mind.

ext.ext_cn: 听到有人走近，她只好强迫自己鼓起勇气，绝不退缩。
ext.ext_en: She had to force herself to stand her ground when she heard someone approaching.

defs.def_en: If you stand your ground or hold your ground, you do not run away from a situation, but face it bravely.
If you say that something such as a job or piece of clothing suits someone down to the ground, you mean that it is completely suitable or right for them.

ext.ext_cn: 优秀的经理人常常寥寥无几。
ext.ext_en: Good managers are often thin on the ground.

defs.def_en: If people or things of a particular kind are thin on the ground, there are very few of them.

ext.ext_cn: 她现在正着手开发多个项目。
ext.ext_en: She is presently developing a number of projects...

ext.ext_cn: 这座岛屿目前无人居住。
ext.ext_en: The island is presently uninhabited...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is presently happening, you mean that it is happening now.

ext.ext_cn: 很快，一个穿着白色外套的年轻女子走了进来。
ext.ext_en: Presently, a young woman in a white coat came in...

ext.ext_cn: “托马斯，你看起来气色不太好，”他脱口而出。
ext.ext_en: 'You're not looking too well, Thomas,' he said presently.

defs.def_en: You use presently to indicate that something happened quite a short time after the time or event that you have just mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: “谁是阿格尼丝？”——“你很快就会见到她。”
ext.ext_en: 'Who's Agnes?' — 'You'll be meeting her presently.'...

ext.ext_cn: “放松点，”戴维说，“你很快就会觉得更舒服些。”
ext.ext_en: 'Just take it easy,' David said. 'You'll feel better presently.'

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen presently, you mean that it will happen quite soon.

ext.ext_cn: 牧师对病人的关怀
ext.ext_en: ...the pastoral care of the sick...

ext.ext_cn: 很多教堂提供出色的牧灵辅导。
ext.ext_en: Many churches provide excellent pastoral counselling.

defs.def_en: The pastoral duties of a priest or other religious leader involve looking after the people he or she has responsibility for, especially by helping them with their personal problems.

ext.ext_cn: 一些学校现在开设咨询课；所有学校都有某种教导关怀体制。
ext.ext_en: A few schools now offer counselling sessions; all have some system of pastoral care.

defs.def_en: If a school offers pastoral care, it is concerned with the personal needs and problems of its pupils, not just with their schoolwork.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 公园里的田园式美景
ext.ext_en: ...the pastoral beauty of a park.

ext.ext_cn: 恬静的田园风光
ext.ext_en: ...a tranquil pastoral scene.

defs.def_en: A pastoral place, atmosphere, or idea is characteristic of peaceful country life and scenery.

ext.ext_cn: 曾经是游牧民族的以色列人
ext.ext_en: ...the Israelites, who were a pastoral people.

ext.ext_cn: 畜牧体系
ext.ext_en: ...a system of pastoral farming.

defs.def_en: A pastoral way of life is one in which people keep animals such as cows and sheep that feed off the land.

defs.def_cn: 两手空空的;一无所获的

ext.ext_cn: 交战各方的代表进行了新一轮的和谈，但是毫无成果。
ext.ext_en: Delegates from the warring sides held a new round of peace talks but went away empty-handed...

ext.ext_cn: 雪莉出去购物，回家时却两手空空。
ext.ext_en: Shirley returned home empty-handed from her shopping trip.

defs.def_en: If you come away from somewhere empty-handed, you have failed to get what you wanted.

defs.def_cn: (常用于治疗癌症的)化学疗法，化疗
defs.def_en: Chemotherapy is the treatment of disease using chemicals. It is often used in treating cancer.
A lighthouse is a tower containing a powerful flashing lamp that is built on the coast or on a small island. Lighthouses are used to guide ships or to warn them of danger.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有雄心的；有抱负的；有野心的

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯踌躇满志，决心要将它都做完。
ext.ext_en: Chris is so ambitious, so determined to do it all...

ext.ext_cn: 他是个很有抱负的小伙子，想参加最高水平的比赛。
ext.ext_en: He's a very ambitious lad and he wants to play at the highest level.

defs.def_en: Someone who is ambitious has a strong desire to be successful, rich, or powerful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个规模宏大的项目只用了9个月就完成了。
ext.ext_en: The ambitious project was completed in only nine months...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的目标极其宏伟。
ext.ext_en: Their goal was extraordinarily ambitious.

defs.def_en: An ambitious idea or plan is on a large scale and needs a lot of work to be carried out successfully.

defs.def_cn: 负有责任的;应承担责任的

ext.ext_cn: 他仍然觉得自己对她的死负有责任。
ext.ext_en: He still felt responsible for her death...

ext.ext_cn: 我希望你能尽一切可能找出责任人。
ext.ext_en: I want you to do everything you can to find out who's responsible.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is responsible for a particular event or situation, they are the cause of it or they can be blamed for it.

ext.ext_cn: 负责环境工作的部长
ext.ext_en: ...the minister responsible for the environment...

ext.ext_cn: 负责寻找志愿者的人是查尔斯·韦伯博士。
ext.ext_en: The man responsible for finding the volunteers is Dr. Charles Weber.

defs.def_en: If you are responsible for something, it is your job or duty to deal with it and make decisions relating to it.

defs.def_cn: 对(某人或某团体)负责的

ext.ext_cn: 我对董事会负责。
ext.ext_en: I'm responsible to my board of directors...

ext.ext_cn: 政府只对总统一人负责。
ext.ext_en: The government will be responsible to the President alone.

defs.def_en: If you are responsible to a person or group, they have authority over you and you have to report to them about what you do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 负责的;有责任心的;可靠的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个非常有责任心的人。
ext.ext_en: He's a very responsible sort of person...

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得媒体应该对报道的内容更负责任些。
ext.ext_en: He feels that the media should be more responsible in what they report.

defs.def_en: Responsible people behave properly and sensibly, without needing to be supervised.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我在政府机关工作。我想那是一个责任重大的职位，但并不是很有意思。
ext.ext_en: I work in a government office. It's a responsible position, I suppose, but not very exciting...

ext.ext_cn: 他们被降职去做不太重要的工作。
ext.ext_en: They have been demoted to less responsible jobs.

defs.def_en: Responsible jobs involve making important decisions or carrying out important tasks.

ext.ext_cn: 闯入她家的一伙歹徒用枪胁迫她和她的两个女儿。
ext.ext_en: She and her two daughters were held at gunpoint by a gang who burst into their home.

defs.def_en: If you are held at gunpoint, someone is threatening to shoot and kill you if you do not obey them.
A racecourse is a track on which horses race.

ext.ext_en: ...adjustments needed to rejig the industry.

defs.def_en: If someone rejigs an organization or a piece of work, they arrange or organize it in a different way, in order to improve it.
A bookshelf is a shelf on which you keep books.

defs.def_cn: （选举或投票时的）压倒性多数票，绝对多数票
defs.def_en: If a political party wins an overall majority in an election or vote, they get more votes than the total number of votes or seats won by all their opponents.
In a rowing boat, the cox is the person who gives instructions to the rowers.

defs.def_cn: (船只)适于航海的，远洋航行的
defs.def_en: Seagoing boats and ships are designed for travelling on the sea, rather than on lakes, rivers, or canals.

ext.ext_cn: 蜜饯橘皮
ext.ext_en: ...candied orange peel.

defs.def_en: Food such as candied fruit has been covered with sugar or has been cooked in sugar syrup.

defs.def_cn: （与数字连用构成名词）表示“重…磅的动物（或鱼）”

ext.ext_cn: 我的鱼平均每条重2磅8盎司，还有过两条重8磅的。
ext.ext_en: My fish average 2 lb 8 oz and I've had two eight-pounders.

defs.def_en: -pounder can be added to numbers to form nouns that refer to animals or fish that weigh a particular number of pounds.

defs.def_cn: （与数字连用构成名词）表示“发射…磅重炮弹的大炮”

ext.ext_cn: 这些大炮发射12磅重的炮弹。
ext.ext_en: The guns were twelve-pounders.

defs.def_en: -pounder can be added to numbers to  form nouns that refer to guns that fire shells weighing a particular number of pounds.

ext.ext_cn: 中西部种植小麦的农场主
ext.ext_en: ...wheat farmers in the Middle West.

defs.def_en: The Middle West is the central part of the United States.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 酒醉引起的;与酒醉有关的

ext.ext_cn: 他喝得烂醉如泥,而后一阵疼痛把他疼醒了。
ext.ext_en: The pain roused him from his drunken stupor...

ext.ext_cn: 他酒后耍酒疯用平底锅打了她。
ext.ext_en: He hit her with a frying pan during a drunken brawl.

defs.def_en: Drunken is used to describe events and situations that involve people who are drunk.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一群群醉醺醺的小流氓砸碎商店的橱窗，还投掷石块。
ext.ext_en: Groups of drunken hooligans smashed shop windows and threw stones.

defs.def_en: A drunken person is drunk or is frequently drunk.

ext.ext_cn: 现代火车装有自动门。
ext.ext_en: Modern trains have automatic doors.

defs.def_en: An automatic machine or device is one which has controls that enable it to perform a task without needing to be constantly operated by a person. Automatic methods and processes involve the use of such machines.

ext.ext_cn: 他拔出自动手枪，向声音传来的方向跑去。
ext.ext_en: He drew his automatic and began running in the direction of the sounds...

ext.ext_cn: 歹徒用自动武器开火了。
ext.ext_en: The gunmen opened fire with automatic weapons.

defs.def_en: An automatic is a gun that keeps firing shots until you stop pulling the trigger.

defs.def_cn: 自动挡汽车;自动变速汽车
defs.def_en: An automatic is a car in which the gears change automatically as the car's speed increases or decreases.

ext.ext_cn: 身体所有的无意识功能，甚至呼吸，都受到影响。
ext.ext_en: All of the automatic body functions, even breathing, are affected.

defs.def_en: An automatic action is one that you do without thinking about it.

ext.ext_cn: 那些司机必然会受到过失杀人的指控。
ext.ext_en: Those drivers should face an automatic charge of manslaughter...

ext.ext_cn: 以色列为所有希望获得公民身份的犹太人敞开大门。
ext.ext_en: Israel offers automatic citizenship to all Jews who want it.

defs.def_en: If something such as an action or a punishment is automatic, it happens without people needing to think about it because it is the result of a fixed rule or method.

ext.ext_cn: 用双手捧起叶子。
ext.ext_en: Use both hands to scoop up the leaves...

ext.ext_cn: 他开始手忙脚乱地捡起他的东西。
ext.ext_en: He began to scoop his things up frantically.

defs.def_en: If you scoop something up, you put your hands or arms under it and lift it in a quick movement.

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司的雇员期待着发放大笔奖金。
ext.ext_en: The firm's employees were expecting large bonuses.

ext.ext_cn: 供暖工程公司
ext.ext_en: ...a firm of heating engineers.

defs.def_en: A firm is an organization which sells or produces something or which provides a service which people pay for.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 水果应该硬实完好。
ext.ext_en: Fruit should be firm and in excellent condition...

ext.ext_cn: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。
ext.ext_en: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.

defs.def_en: If something is firm, it does not change much in shape when it is pressed but is not completely hard.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如果非要爬上去，就踩在一个稳固的台子上或者找把结实的梯子。
ext.ext_en: If you have to climb up, use a firm platform or a sturdy ladder.

defs.def_en: If something is firm, it does not shake or move when you put weight or pressure on it, because it is strongly made or securely fastened.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (抓握或动作)强有力的，使上劲的

ext.ext_cn: 短暂的握手有力沉稳。
ext.ext_en: The quick handshake was firm and cool...

ext.ext_cn: 他设法牢牢抓住了那个金属物，把整个身子往上提。
ext.ext_en: He managed to grasp the metal, get a firm grip of it and heave his body upwards.

defs.def_en: If someone's grip is firm or if they perform a physical action in a firm way, they do it with quite a lot of force or pressure but also in a controlled way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她不得不对他狠下心来：“我不想再见到你。”
ext.ext_en: She had to be firm with him. 'I don't want to see you again.'...

ext.ext_cn: 也许他们需要一个父亲般严格的指引者。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps they need the guiding hand of a firm father figure.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as firm, you mean they behave in a way that shows that they are not going to change their mind, or that they are the person who is in control.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (决定或意见)确定的,不会更改的

ext.ext_cn: 他打定主意乘船离开穆尔特里堡。
ext.ext_en: He made a firm decision to leave Fort Multry by boat...

ext.ext_cn: 我坚信警民之间进行有效合作是绝对必要的。
ext.ext_en: It is my firm belief that an effective partnership approach between police and the public is absolutely necessary.

defs.def_en: A firm decision or opinion is definite and unlikely to change.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (证据或信息)确切的，确实的，确凿的

ext.ext_cn: 这名男子可能还杀害过其他人，只可惜我们没有确凿的证据。
ext.ext_en: This man may have killed others but unfortunately we have no firm evidence...

ext.ext_cn: 一段时间内都不大可能会有关于车队行进情况的确切消息。
ext.ext_en: There's unlikely to be firm news about the convoy's progress for some time.

defs.def_en: Firm evidence or information is based on facts and so is likely to be true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (控制、基础、位置等)坚实的，不可动摇的

ext.ext_cn: 尽管雅库特人是少数民族，但他们却牢牢地掌控着这块版图。
ext.ext_en: Although the Yakutians are a minority, they have firm control of the territory...

ext.ext_cn: 这家美国国内家喻户晓的公司在英国市场上站稳了脚跟。
ext.ext_en: The company, a household name in the States, has a firm foothold in the British market.

defs.def_en: You use firm to describe control or a basis or position when it is strong and unlikely to be ended or removed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这对夫妇大约两年前相遇，很快就成了知交。
ext.ext_en: The couple met about two years ago and soon became firm friends.

defs.def_en: If people are firm friends, they have been close friends for a long time and their friendship is likely to continue.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (价格、价值、货币等)坚挺的，稳定的，居高不下的

ext.ext_cn: 棉花价格始终保持坚挺，需求旺盛。
ext.ext_en: Cotton prices remain firm and demand is strong...

ext.ext_cn: 股价稳稳地维持在280便士。
ext.ext_en: The shares held firm at 280p...

defs.def_en: If a price, value, or currency is firm, it is not decreasing in value or amount.

ext.ext_cn: 在根上再多培些土，用水浇透。
ext.ext_en: Firm more soil over the roots and water thoroughly.

defs.def_en: If you firm soil around a plant, you press it so that it is fairly solid rather than loose.

defs.def_cn: 坚定不移;坚持己见;拒不让步

ext.ext_cn: 委员会面对接二连三的抗议拒不让步。
ext.ext_en: The council is standing firm against the barrage of protest...

ext.ext_cn: 总统已经呼吁其欧洲伙伴在此问题上站稳立场。
ext.ext_en: The President has appealed to his European partners to stand firm on the issue.

defs.def_en: If someone stands firm, they refuse to change their mind about something.

defs.def_cn: (使)更坚固;(使)更坚硬;(使)更结实

ext.ext_cn: 该治疗有助于强身健体、紧致皮肤。
ext.ext_en: This treatment helps tone the body, firm up muscles and tighten the skin...

ext.ext_cn: 我现在每周游5次泳，这对强身健体很有益处。
ext.ext_en: I now go swimming five times a week, which helps firm me up...

defs.def_en: If you firm up something or if it firms up, it becomes firmer and more solid.

ext.ext_cn: 展望未来，政府将更加明确其计划，建设一个更清洁、更环保、更安全的英国。
ext.ext_en: Looking to the future, the Government will firm up their plans for a cleaner, greener, safer Britain...

ext.ext_cn: 基本原则已得到进一步强化。
ext.ext_en: The ground rules have been firmed up...

defs.def_en: If you firm something up or if it firms up, it becomes clearer, stronger, or more definite.

defs.def_cn: 使(价格、价值等)保持坚挺(或稳定)

ext.ext_cn: 石油输出国组织已同意对全球石油生产稍加冻结，以稳定原油价格。
ext.ext_en: OPEC has agreed to freeze its global oil production slightly in order to firm up crude prices.

defs.def_en: If a financial institution firms up the price or value of something, they take action to protect and maintain its price or value.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: A well-travelled person has travelled a lot in foreign countries.

defs.def_cn: 明目张胆的打劫;漫天要价;敲竹杠

ext.ext_cn: 他们这是在盘剥歌迷，简直是明目张胆的打劫。
ext.ext_en: They're just ripping the fans off; it's daylight robbery.

defs.def_en: If someone charges you a great deal of money for something and you think this is unfair or unreasonable, you can refer to this as daylight robbery .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个暴风雨之夜，大雨倾盆，强风呼啸。
ext.ext_en: It had been a night of stormy weather, with torrential rain and high winds.

ext.ext_cn: 1942 年风雪交加的漫长冬天
ext.ext_en: ...the long stormy winter of 1942.

defs.def_en: If there is stormy weather, there are strong winds and heavy rain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (大海)波涛汹涌的，波浪滔天的

ext.ext_cn: 他们穿越了波浪滔天的大海，完成了这次危险之旅。
ext.ext_en: They make the treacherous journey across stormy seas.

ext.ext_cn: 不列颠群岛周围波浪滔天的水域
ext.ext_en: ...the stormy waters that surround the British Isles.

defs.def_en: Stormy seas have very large strong waves because there are strong winds.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 争吵激烈的;群情激愤的

ext.ext_cn: 这封信是在一次争吵激烈的会议上念的。
ext.ext_en: The letter was read at a stormy meeting...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在工作中关系有时也闹得很僵。
ext.ext_en: Their working relationship was stormy at times.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as stormy, you mean it involves a lot of angry argument or criticism.

ext.ext_cn: 那位女士否认疏于照管自己的孩子。
ext.ext_en: The woman denied that she had neglected her child...

ext.ext_cn: 人勤地生宝;人懒地长草。
ext.ext_en: Feed plants and they grow, neglect them and they suffer.

defs.def_en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to look after them properly.

ext.ext_cn: 他为事业付出太多，长时间地工作，忽视了她。
ext.ext_en: He'd given too much to his career, worked long hours, neglected her...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你不注意的话，孩子们往往会不重视他们的家庭作业。
ext.ext_en: If you are not careful, children tend to neglect their homework.

defs.def_en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to give them the amount of attention that they deserve.

ext.ext_cn: 我们经常忘记该合理地使用我们的身体。
ext.ext_en: We often neglect to make proper use of our bodies...

ext.ext_cn: 他们从未玩忽职守。
ext.ext_en: They never neglect their duties.

defs.def_en: If you neglect to do something that you ought to do or neglect your duty, you fail to do it.

defs.def_cn: （广播或电视节目中的）公众采访，街头民意调查

ext.ext_cn: 电影还利用了新闻片片段和街头采访的表现手法。
ext.ext_en: The film also made use of newsreel footage and vox pop.

defs.def_en: In a radio or television programme, a vox pop is an item consisting of a series of short interviews with ordinary members of the public.

ext.ext_cn: 他利用自己的影响力阻挠她当选议员候选人。
ext.ext_en: He used his influence to make sure she was not selected as a parliamentary candidate.

defs.def_en: Parliamentary is used to describe things that are connected with a parliament or with Members of Parliament.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的扩张性外交政策的预期受害者
ext.ext_en: ...the intended victim of his expansionist foreign policy.

defs.def_en: If you describe a country or organization as expansionist, you disapprove of it because it has a policy of increasing its land or power.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那个时期最敏锐、最有洞察力的历史学家之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the most perspicacious and perceptive historians of that period.

defs.def_en: Someone who is perspicacious notices, realizes, and understands things quickly.

defs.def_cn: 运用通货复胀刺激（经济）

ext.ext_cn: 政府明年可能会采取通货复胀来刺激经济。
ext.ext_en: The administration may try to reflate the economy next year.

defs.def_en: If a government tries to reflate its country's economy, it increases the amount of money that is available in order to encourage more economic activity.

ext.ext_cn: 没有给他们提供助听设备，也没教过他们唇读。
ext.ext_en: They are not given hearing aids or taught to lip-read.

defs.def_en: If someone can lip-read, they are able to understand what someone else is saying by looking at the way the other person's lips move as they speak, without actually hearing any of the words.

ext.ext_cn: 二等兵欧文·巴特勒
ext.ext_en: ...Pte Owen Butler.

defs.def_en: Pte is used before a person's name as a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) the military title Private.

defs.def_cn: 醒悟;不再抱幻想;理想破灭

ext.ext_cn: 他对他的工作越来越不抱幻想
ext.ext_en: ...his growing disillusionment with his work.

ext.ext_cn: 我们视作偶像的人辜负了我们的信任时，我们所体会到的痛苦、失望和绝望
ext.ext_en: ...the pain, disillusionment and despair we experience when someone we idolized has betrayed our trust.

defs.def_en: Disillusionment is the disappointment that you feel when you discover that something is not as good as you had expected or thought.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我从没见过更笨拙、动作更不协调的拳击手。
ext.ext_en: I'd never seen a clumsier, less coordinated boxer...

ext.ext_cn: 令人遗憾的是我开起吉普来还是笨手笨脚。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately, I was still very clumsy behind the wheel of the jeep.

defs.def_en: A  clumsy person moves or handles things in a careless, awkward way, often so that things are knocked over or broken.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为或措词)不得体的，拙劣的

ext.ext_cn: 这一试图推翻人民党政府的行动似乎缺乏策略。
ext.ext_en: The action seemed a clumsy attempt to topple the Janata Dal government...

ext.ext_cn: 他否认声明不得体、不近人情。
ext.ext_en: He denied the announcement was clumsy and insensitive.

defs.def_en: A clumsy action or statement is not skilful or is likely to upset people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (设计或外表)粗糙的，难用的;设计欠佳的

ext.ext_cn: 就手提电脑而言，键盘就显得大而笨重了。
ext.ext_en: The keyboard is a large and clumsy instrument as far as portable computers are concerned...

ext.ext_cn: 那架飞机样子很难看。
ext.ext_en: It was a clumsy looking aeroplane.

defs.def_en: An object that is clumsy is not neat in design or appearance, and is often awkward to use.

ext.ext_cn: 我去了隔壁的卫生间。
ext.ext_en: I went next door to the bathroom...

ext.ext_cn: 那时她就住隔壁。
ext.ext_en: She was next door at the time.

defs.def_en: If a room or building is next door, it is the next one to the right or left.

ext.ext_cn: 邻居们认为隔壁的那户人家已经搬走了。
ext.ext_en: The neighbors thought the family next door had moved.

ext.ext_cn: 我们隔壁邻居敲门说，我们的车被偷了。
ext.ext_en: Our next door neighbour knocked on the door to say that our car had been stolen.

defs.def_en: The people next door are the people who live in the house or flat to the right or left of yours.

ext.ext_cn: 他可靠、坦率，是邻家男孩那种类型。
ext.ext_en: He was dependable, straightforward, the boy next door...

ext.ext_cn: 她是邻家女孩那种类型的。
ext.ext_en: She was the girl-next-door type.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as the boy next door or the girl next door, you mean that they are pleasant and respectable but rather dull.

ext.ext_cn: 路变得陡直起来，然后又突然变平坦了。
ext.ext_en: The road steepened and then levelled out suddenly.

defs.def_en: If a slope or an angle steepens, it becomes steeper.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司租下了这栋大楼，占用了一部分并转租了其余的部分。
ext.ext_en: The company rented the building, occupied part and sublet the rest.

defs.def_en: If you sublet a building or part of a building, you allow someone to use it and you take rent from them, although you are not the owner and pay rent for it yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 汉娜抬头看见戴维和另一个男的站在门口。
ext.ext_en: Hannah looked up to see David and another man standing in the doorway...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在人陪同下穿过一条低矮的门道。
ext.ext_en: We were escorted through a low doorway.

defs.def_en: A doorway is a space in a wall where a door opens and closes.

ext.ext_cn: 睡在商店门口无家可归的人们
ext.ext_en: ...homeless people sleeping in shop doorways.

defs.def_en: A doorway is a covered space just outside the door of a building.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们通常观看时比较温和。
ext.ext_en: They are normally a more benign audience...

ext.ext_cn: 对该方案的批评就没有这么温和了。
ext.ext_en: Critics of the scheme take a less benign view.

defs.def_en: You use benign to describe someone who is kind, gentle, and harmless.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们服的药相对来说药性温和，但是我们却在把它们变成毒药。
ext.ext_en: We're taking relatively benign medicines and we're turning them into poisons.

defs.def_en: A benign substance or process does not have any harmful effects.

ext.ext_cn: 这不是癌症，只是良性肿瘤。
ext.ext_en: It wasn't cancer, only a benign tumour.

defs.def_en: A benign tumour will not cause death or serious harm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们那里的气候非常宜人。
ext.ext_en: They enjoyed an especially benign climate...

ext.ext_cn: 这次大跌出现在相对良好的经济环境下。
ext.ext_en: This plunge came in a time of relatively benign economic conditions.

defs.def_en: Benign conditions are pleasant or make it easy for something to happen.

defs.def_cn: 不作为；善意忽视；顺其自然

ext.ext_cn: 美国和日本又回到了不作为货币政策的老路。
ext.ext_en: America and Japan have settled back into a policy of benign neglect of their currencies.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's  approach to a problem as one of benign neglect, you disapprove of the fact that they are doing nothing and hoping that the problem will solve itself.

defs.def_cn: 生物的；与生命过程有关的

ext.ext_cn: 生命体通过某种生物过程聚集矿物质。
ext.ext_en: The living organisms somehow concentrated the minerals by biological processes...

ext.ext_cn: 这是自然的生物反应。
ext.ext_en: This is a natural biological response.

defs.def_en: Biological is used to describe processes and states that occur in the bodies and cells of living things.

ext.ext_cn: 与麻风病相关的生物学研究的各个方面
ext.ext_en: ...all aspects of biological research associated with leprosy.

ext.ext_cn: 这所大学的生命科学学院
ext.ext_en: ...the university's school of biological sciences.

defs.def_en: Biological is used to describe activities concerned with the study of living things.

defs.def_cn: （武器、战争）生物性的，使用细菌的

ext.ext_cn: 这样的战争可能导致使用生化武器。
ext.ext_en: Such a war could result in the use of chemical and biological weapons.

defs.def_en: Biological weapons and biological warfare involve the use of bacteria or other living organisms in order to attack human beings, animals, or plants.

ext.ext_cn: 农业虫害生物防治顾问吉姆·利钦格
ext.ext_en: ...Jim Litsinger, a consultant on biological control of agricultural pests.

defs.def_en: Biological pest control is the use of bacteria or other living organisms in order to destroy other organisms which are harmful to plants or crops.

ext.ext_cn: 被亲生父母抛弃的青少年的养父母
ext.ext_en: ...foster parents for young teenagers whose biological parents have rejected them.

defs.def_en: A child's biological parents are the man and woman who caused him or her to be born, rather than other adults who look after him or her.
A biological washing powder contains substances called enzymes which dissolve dirt.
Electrical engineering is the designing, constructing, and maintenance of electrical devices.

ext.ext_cn: 东西方可以为彼此共同的利益和发展而合作。
ext.ext_en: The East and the West can work together for their mutual benefit and progress...

ext.ext_cn: 明摆着他很喜欢自己的女儿，而且女儿也喜欢他。
ext.ext_en: It's plain that he adores his daughter, and the feeling is mutual.

defs.def_en: You use mutual to  describe a situation, feeling, or action that is experienced, felt, or done by both of two people mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 不过他们确实都对设计感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: They do, however, share a mutual interest in design...

ext.ext_cn: 我们一个共同的朋友介绍我们认识了。
ext.ext_en: We were introduced by a mutual friend.

defs.def_en: You use mutual to describe something such as an interest which two or more people share.

defs.def_cn: (指建屋互助会或保险公司)互助的，相互保险的

ext.ext_cn: 英国第三大建屋互助会准备放弃其互助性质，转变为银行。
ext.ext_en: Britain's third largest building society abandoned its mutual status and became a bank.

defs.def_en: If a building society or an insurance company has mutual status, it is not owned by shareholders but by its customers, who receive a share of the profits.
A bedsitter is the same as a bedsit .
The pituitary gland or the pituitary is a gland that is attached to the base of the brain. It produces hormones which affect growth, sexual development, and other functions of the body.

ext.ext_cn: 他现在居住在他母亲的故乡牛津郡。
ext.ext_en: He is living now in his mother's home county of Oxfordshire...

ext.ext_cn: 全县共筹划了50多次活动。
ext.ext_en: Over 50 events are planned throughout the county.

defs.def_en: A county is a region of Britain, Ireland, or the USA which has its own local government.

ext.ext_cn: 他折回到他丢下箱子的地方。
ext.ext_en: He retraced his steps to the spot where he'd left the case.

defs.def_en: If you retrace your steps or retrace your way, you return to the place you started from by going back along the same route.

ext.ext_cn: 屋子因木材干腐而变得千疮百孔。
ext.ext_en: The house was riddled with dry rot.

defs.def_en: Dry rot is a serious disease of wood. It is caused by a fungus and causes wood to decay.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （攻击、事故、伤势等）令人震惊的，极其可怕的，十分严重的

ext.ext_cn: 我从来没有见过如此严重的伤势。
ext.ext_en: I have never seen such horrific injuries...

ext.ext_cn: 屠杀令人震惊。
ext.ext_en: The slaughter was horrific.

defs.def_en: If you describe a physical attack, accident, or injury as horrific, you mean that it is very bad, so that people are shocked when they see it or think about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在你原来债务的基础上又高筑债台
ext.ext_en: ...piling up horrific extra amounts of money on top of your original debt.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as horrific, you mean that it is so big that it is extremely unpleasant.
An industrial park is the same as an industrial estate .
A sword is a weapon with a handle and a long sharp blade.

ext.ext_cn: 因为支持自由贸易协定而与工党交锋的候选人
ext.ext_en: ...a candidate who's crossed swords with Labor by supporting the free-trade pact...

ext.ext_cn: 这对争得你死我活的竞争对手的最后一次交锋是在 20 世纪 80 年代。
ext.ext_en: The fiercest of rivals, the last time they crossed swords was during the 1980s.

defs.def_en: If you cross swords with someone, you disagree with them and argue with them about something.

defs.def_cn: (指兼有正面和负面影响的)双刃剑
defs.def_en: If you say that something is a double-edged sword or a two-edged sword, you mean that it has negative effects as well as positive effects.

defs.def_cn: 十几岁的，青少年的(指从13到19岁)

ext.ext_cn: 她有两个十几岁的女儿。
ext.ext_en: She is the mother of two teenaged daughters.

defs.def_en: Teenaged people are aged between thirteen and nineteen.

ext.ext_cn: 巴尔比厄开博时并没抱多大的期望； 他只是希望和一些人聊聊天。
ext.ext_en: When Barbieux started his blog, his aspirations were small; he simply hoped to communicate with a few people.

defs.def_en: A blog is a website containing a diary or journal on a particular subject.
A water chestnut is the thick bottom part of the stem of a plant which grows in China. It is used in Chinese cookery.

ext.ext_cn: 该船因触犯联合国贸易禁运条款而被扣押。
ext.ext_en: The ship was impounded under the terms of the UN trade embargo...

ext.ext_cn: 警察冲进去将他拘捕并没收了可卡因。
ext.ext_en: The police moved in, arrested him and impounded the cocaine.

defs.def_en: If something is impounded by policemen, customs officers or other officials, they officially take possession of it because a law or rule has been broken.
Worsted is a kind of woollen cloth.

ext.ext_cn: 一家名为纽彻奇的咨询公司对57家医院所作的调查显示改善十分明显。
ext.ext_en: A survey of 57 hospitals by Newchurch, a consultancy, reveals striking improvements.

ext.ext_cn: 来自瑞士的管理咨询公司
ext.ext_en: ...a management consultancy from Switzerland.

defs.def_en: A consultancy is a company that gives expert advice on a particular subject.

ext.ext_cn: 他是根据专家意见采取行动的。
ext.ext_en: He is acting on a consultancy basis...

ext.ext_cn: 这个项目既提供咨询服务也提供培训。
ext.ext_en: The project provides both consultancy and training.

defs.def_en: Consultancy is expert advice on a particular subject which a person or group is paid to provide to a company or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 他们有 2,500 吨纸存放在仓库里。
ext.ext_en: They have 2,500 tons of paper stored in their depository.

defs.def_en: A depository is a place where objects can be stored safely.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的策略是扩张性的、带有帝国主义特色，当没有抗衡力量的时候自然也就被发挥到了极致。
ext.ext_en: Their strategy is expansionist and imperialist, and it is greatest in effect, of course, when there is no countervailing power...

ext.ext_cn: 在尼古拉·特斯拉的生活中存在着两股非常重要而且相互抗衡的力量。
ext.ext_en: There were two central and countervailing forces in the life of Nikola Tesla.

defs.def_en: A countervailing force, power, or opinion is one which is of equal strength to another one but is its opposite or opposes it.
A day nursery is a place where children who are too young to go to school can be left all day while their parents are at work.

ext.ext_cn: “纯红”乐队主唱米克·赫克纳尔
ext.ext_en: ...Mick Hucknall, lead singer of Simply Red...

ext.ext_cn: 我曾是“级长”乐队前身的主唱。
ext.ext_en: I was the lead singer in the band that became the Prefects.

defs.def_en: The lead singer of a pop group is the person who sings most of the songs.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 绒毛似的;松软的;蓬松的

ext.ext_cn: 柔软的白毛巾
ext.ext_en: ...fluffy white towels...

ext.ext_cn: 这种羊毛质地非常柔软。
ext.ext_en: It's a very fluffy kind of wool.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a towel or a toy animal as fluffy, you mean that it is very soft.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 用一只木勺把人造黄油和糖搅拌成稀松的糊状。
ext.ext_en: Cream together the margarine and sugar with a wooden spoon until light and fluffy.

defs.def_en: A cake or other food that is fluffy is very light because it has a lot of air in it.

ext.ext_cn: 在整个炎热、安静的假日，埃米一直在晒太阳。
ext.ext_en: All through the hot, still days of their holiday Amy basked in the sun...

ext.ext_cn: 鳄鱼在小沙滩上晒太阳。
ext.ext_en: Crocodiles bask on the small sandy beaches.

defs.def_en: If you bask in the sunshine, you lie somewhere sunny and enjoy the heat.

defs.def_cn: 沉浸于，尽情享受（赞美、宠爱或崇拜）

ext.ext_cn: 他整整一个月都沉浸在牙买加影迷们的追捧中。
ext.ext_en: He has spent a month basking in the adulation of the fans back in Jamaica...

ext.ext_cn: 莉薇微笑着，雷切尔的赞许令她如沐春风。
ext.ext_en: Livy smiled and basked in Rachel's approval.

defs.def_en: If you bask in someone's  approval, favour, or admiration, you greatly enjoy their positive reaction towards you.

defs.def_cn: (通常指士兵或水手的)反叛，哗变，暴动

ext.ext_cn: 军队内部一连串的政变图谋和暴动动摇了该政权。
ext.ext_en: A series of coup attempts and mutinies within the armed forces destabilized the regime...

ext.ext_cn: 在被宣判犯有叛乱罪和叛国罪后，他们昨天被枪决了。
ext.ext_en: They were shot yesterday after being convicted of mutiny and high treason.

defs.def_en: A mutiny is a refusal by people, usually soldiers or sailors, to continue obeying a person in authority.

defs.def_cn: (通常指士兵或水手)反叛，哗变，暴动

ext.ext_cn: 驻扎在首府周边的部队因9个月没有领到军饷而哗变。
ext.ext_en: Units stationed around the capital mutinied because they had received no pay for nine months...

ext.ext_cn: 某海军基地的士兵不服从军官领导，发生了兵变。
ext.ext_en: Sailors at a naval base had mutinied against their officers.

defs.def_en: If a group of people, usually soldiers or sailors, mutiny, they refuse to continue obeying a person in authority.
A stapler is a device used for putting staples into sheets of paper.
A begonia is a garden plant which has large brightly coloured leaves.

ext.ext_cn: 由此产生的内疚感在他灵魂深处挥之不去。
ext.ext_en: The associative guilt was ingrained in his soul...

ext.ext_cn: 真实的画面更恐怖也更震撼，但是它带来的种种感受和情绪需要你自己去联想。
ext.ext_en: The real picture is more horrific and stronger but one must conjure up all the associative thoughts and emotions it evokes.

defs.def_en: Associative thoughts are things that you think of because you see, hear, or think of something that reminds you of those things or which you associate with those things.

defs.def_cn: 强行挤入（以便分享利益）;强行插手

ext.ext_cn: 科恩抱怨克拉维斯非要在他的买卖中插上一脚。
ext.ext_en: Cohen complained that Kravis was muscling in on his deal...

ext.ext_cn: 如果黑手党不插上一脚，那反倒令人奇怪了。
ext.ext_en: It would be surprising were the Mafia not to have muscled in.

defs.def_en: If someone muscles in on something, they force their way into a situation where they have no right to be and where they are not welcome, in order to gain some advantage for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 公司目前财政困难。
ext.ext_en: The company is in financial difficulties.

ext.ext_cn: 政府的财政顾问
ext.ext_en: ...the government's financial advisers.

defs.def_en: Financial means relating to or involving money.
Buddhism is a religion which teaches that the way to end suffering is by overcoming your desires.

ext.ext_cn: 淡淡的新月
ext.ext_en: ...the pale crescent of a new moon...

ext.ext_cn: 在埃及，新月之时是欢庆之日。
ext.ext_en: The new moon was the occasion of festivals of rejoicing in Egypt.

defs.def_en: A new moon is the moon when it first appears as a thin curved shape at the start of its four-week cycle. The new moon is also the time of the month when the moon appears in this way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我从来没有见过一张如此面无表情的脸。
ext.ext_en: I have never looked on a face that was so devoid of feeling...

ext.ext_cn: 天空中几乎没有任何鸟的踪迹。
ext.ext_en: The skies are virtually devoid of birdlife.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is devoid of a quality or thing, you are emphasizing that they have none of it.

defs.def_cn: 耸肩(表示不感兴趣、不知道或不在乎)

ext.ext_cn: 我耸了耸肩，仿佛在说，“为什么不?”
ext.ext_en: I shrugged, as if to say, 'Why not?'...

ext.ext_cn: 那男子耸了耸肩。
ext.ext_en: The man shrugged his shoulders.

defs.def_en: If you shrug, you raise your shoulders to show that you are not interested in something or that you do not know or care about something.
Free radicals are atoms that contain one or more unpaired electrons. Free radicals are believed to be a cause of ageing, heart disease, and some cancers.

ext.ext_cn: 他跨坐在椅子上。
ext.ext_en: He sat down, straddling the chair.

defs.def_en: If you straddle something, you put or have one leg on either side of it.

defs.def_cn: 横跨，跨越(河流、道路、边境等)

ext.ext_cn: 一座小木桥横跨在排水渠上。
ext.ext_en: A small wooden bridge straddled the dike.

ext.ext_cn: 这座跨越美国和墨西哥边境的小镇
ext.ext_en: ...this town that straddles the US-Mexico border.

defs.def_en: If something straddles a river, road, border, or other place, it stretches across it or exists on both sides of it.

defs.def_cn: 横跨，跨越，同属(不同时期、群体或活动领域等)

ext.ext_cn: 我们生活的这个时期所经历的变革可能是罗马帝国灭亡以来最巨大的。
ext.ext_en: Our lives have straddled a period of greater change than perhaps any since the end of the Roman Empire...

ext.ext_cn: 他具有两种文化背景，先是在英国长大，后又皈依了伊斯兰教。
ext.ext_en: He straddles two cultures, having been brought up in Britain and later converted to Islam.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that straddles different periods, groups, or fields of activity exists in, belongs to, or takes elements from them all.

defs.def_cn: 舞蹈演员;舞蹈家;跳舞者

ext.ext_cn: 他的前女友是皇家芭蕾舞团的舞蹈演员。
ext.ext_en: His previous girlfriend was a dancer with the Royal Ballet...

ext.ext_cn: 跳舞的人们开始离开舞池。
ext.ext_en: The dancers began to walk away from the floor.

defs.def_en: A dancer is a person who earns money by dancing, or a person who is dancing.

ext.ext_cn: 他是洛杉矶舞跳得最好的人。
ext.ext_en: He was the best dancer in LA.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a good dancer or a bad dancer, you are saying how well or badly they can dance.

defs.def_cn: 诗篇（《圣经》中《诗篇》卷150篇中的任何一篇）

ext.ext_cn: 他背诵了《诗篇》第23篇中的一节。
ext.ext_en: He recited a verse of the twenty-third psalm.

defs.def_en: The Psalms are the 150 songs, poems, and prayers which together form the Book of Psalms in the Bible.

ext.ext_cn: 外面，一只渡鸦尖叫了一声。
ext.ext_en: Outside, a raven cawed.

defs.def_en: When a bird such as a crow or a rook caws, it makes a loud harsh sound.

defs.def_cn: (团体中)自行其是的人，特立独行的人,标新立异的人

ext.ext_cn: 他太特立独行，永远不可能做高官。
ext.ext_en: He was too much of a maverick ever to hold high office.

ext.ext_cn: 就治疗这种疾病与医学界普遍观点相左的一群标新立异的科学家
ext.ext_en: ...a maverick group of scientists, who oppose the prevailing medical opinion on the disease...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a maverick, you mean that they are unconventional and independent, and do not think or behave in the same way as other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他一向是政府政策最热情的支持者之一。
ext.ext_en: He's been one of the most ardent supporters of the administration's policy.

ext.ext_cn: 越南战争的强烈反对者
ext.ext_en: ...an ardent opponent of the Vietnam War.

defs.def_en: Ardent is used to describe someone who has extremely strong feelings about something or someone.

defs.def_cn: 毁掉…的森林;砍伐…的林木

ext.ext_cn: 亚马孙河流域已有40万平方公里的森林遭到滥伐。
ext.ext_en: 400,000 square kilometres of the Amazon basin have already been deforested.

defs.def_en: If an area is deforested, all the trees there are cut down or destroyed.

defs.def_cn: （旧时派往英属殖民地的）总督

ext.ext_cn: 新西兰前总督
ext.ext_en: ...the former Governor-General of New Zealand.

defs.def_en: A Governor-General is a person who is sent to a former British colony as the chief representative of Britain.
A luge is an object that is designed to be used for racing downhill over snow or ice. Riders lie on their backs and travel with their feet pointing towards the front of the luge.
A piggery is a farm or building where pigs are kept.

ext.ext_cn: 柳木家具
ext.ext_en: ...willow furniture.

ext.ext_cn: 柳木家具
ext.ext_en: ...willow furniture.

defs.def_en: A willow or a willow tree is a type of tree with long branches and long narrow leaves that grows near water.

defs.def_cn: （以扇形面积表示比例的）饼分图，圆形分析图
defs.def_en: A pie chart is a circle divided into sections to show the relative proportions of a set of things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 献身的;一心一意的;热忱的

ext.ext_cn: 她的曾祖父显然是一位非常投入而且坚忍不拔的旅行爱好者。
ext.ext_en: Her great-grandfather had clearly been a dedicated and stoical traveller.

ext.ext_cn: 古典音乐的忠实追随者
ext.ext_en: ...dedicated followers of classical music.

defs.def_en: You use dedicated to describe someone who enjoys a particular activity very much and spends a lot of time doing it.

defs.def_cn: 专用（于…）的;专门（为…而）设计制造的

ext.ext_cn: 这些区域也应该设专门的自行车道。
ext.ext_en: Such areas should also be served by dedicated cycle routes.

ext.ext_cn: 世界上第一个专门的生态博物馆
ext.ext_en: ...the world's  first museum dedicated to ecology.

defs.def_en: You use dedicated to describe something that is made, built, or designed for one particular purpose or thing.

defs.def_cn: (普通人为赢取奖项的)才艺表演，大奖赛

ext.ext_cn: 他的音乐生涯始于才艺表演。
ext.ext_en: He began his musical career in talent shows...

ext.ext_cn: 18 岁那年，她在一次大奖赛中获得一等奖。
ext.ext_en: At the age of 18, she won first prize in a talent contest.

defs.def_en: A talent show ,talent competition, or talent contest is a show where ordinary people perform an act on stage, usually in order to try to win a prize for the best performance.

ext.ext_cn: 两个小女孩正在拾柴火。
ext.ext_en: Two young girls were collecting firewood...

ext.ext_cn: 伊丽莎白一直在为完成学校的一份课题作业收集蜗牛。
ext.ext_en: Elizabeth had been collecting snails for a school project...

defs.def_en: If you collect a number of things, you bring them together from several places or from several people.

ext.ext_cn: 我曾经集过邮。
ext.ext_en: I used to collect stamps...

ext.ext_cn: 托尼的业余爱好之一是搜集稀有鸟类。
ext.ext_en: One of Tony's hobbies was collecting rare birds.

defs.def_en: If you collect things, such as stamps or books, as a hobby, you get a large number of them over a period of time because they interest you.

ext.ext_cn: 戴维总是星期三去学校接阿利斯泰尔。
ext.ext_en: David always collects Alistair from school on Wednesdays...

ext.ext_cn: 她刚去邮局取了养老金。
ext.ext_en: She had just collected her pension from the post office...

defs.def_en: When you collect someone or something, you go and get them from the place where they are waiting for you or have been left for you.

ext.ext_cn: 周围的矿井里的确有沼气聚积。
ext.ext_en: Methane gas does collect in the mines around here.

ext.ext_cn: 积存屋顶雨水的水箱
ext.ext_en: ...water tanks which collect rainwater from the house roof.

defs.def_en: If a substance collects somewhere, or if something collects it, it keeps arriving over a period of time and is held in that place or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 和望远镜一样，它有一个曲面镜可以积聚阳光。
ext.ext_en: Like a telescope it has a curved mirror to collect the sunlight.

defs.def_en: If something collects light, energy, or heat, it attracts it.

defs.def_cn: (为慈善事业或礼品)筹款，集资;募捐

ext.ext_cn: 你是在为慈善事业筹款吗？
ext.ext_en: Are you collecting for charity?...

ext.ext_cn: 他们为一个旨在帮助军人家属的基金筹集捐款。
ext.ext_en: They collected donations for a fund to help military families.

defs.def_en: If you collect for a charity or for a present for someone, you ask people to give you money for it.

defs.def_cn: 尽力镇静下来;整理(思绪)

ext.ext_cn: 她停了一会儿，让自己镇定下来。

ext.ext_en: He was grateful for a chance to relax and collect his thoughts.

defs.def_en: If you collect yourself or collect your thoughts, you make an effort to calm yourself or prepare yourself mentally.

ext.ext_cn: 她接到一个从阿拉斯加打来的付费电话。

ext.ext_en: Should you lose your ticket call collect on STA's helpline.

defs.def_en: A collect call is a telephone call that is paid for by the person receiving it, not the person making it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: More people are habituated to cigarettes than to drugs or alcohol in this country.

ext.ext_en: ...a chain of stores selling automotive parts.

defs.def_en: Automotive is used to refer to things relating to cars.

ext.ext_cn: 首批进驻的公司采取了雇佣东德人并对他们进行全面培训的方针。
ext.ext_en: The first companies to go in took a policy of employing East Germans and training them up...

ext.ext_en: He usually preferred to train up a crew of enthusiastic young sailors from scratch.

defs.def_en: If someone trains you up, they teach you new skills or give you the necessary preparation so that you will reach the standard required for a particular job or activity.

ext.ext_en: The Baltics' own democratic traditions would help them to regain their rightful place in Europe...

ext.ext_en: He had been denied what he believed to be his rightful position at the center of things...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has returned to its rightful place or position, they have returned to the place or position that you think they should have.

ext.ext_cn: 他们恪尽职守。
ext.ext_en: They stuck to their task manfully.

ext.ext_cn: 勇于承受贫苦命运的淳朴的人们
ext.ext_en: ...simple people who manfully bear the deprivations that are their lot.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone, especially a man, does something manfully, you mean that they do it in a very determined or brave way.
An aircraft carrier is a warship with a long, flat deck where aircraft can take off and land.

ext.ext_cn: 希尔顿8点半敲门把他叫醒了。
ext.ext_en: Hilton roused him at eight-thirty by rapping on the door...

ext.ext_cn: 当我把手放到他手上时，他动了动，但并没有完全醒来。
ext.ext_en: When I put my hand on his, he stirs but doesn't quite rouse.

defs.def_en: If someone rouses you when you are sleeping or if you rouse, you wake up.

defs.def_cn: 使自己活跃起来;让自己振作

ext.ext_cn: 她似乎打不起精神去做任何事情。
ext.ext_en: She seemed to be unable to rouse herself to do anything...

ext.ext_cn: 他不再懒洋洋地注视着下面的景色。
ext.ext_en: He roused himself from his lazy contemplation of the scene beneath him...

defs.def_en: If you rouse yourself, you stop being inactive and start doing something.

defs.def_cn: 使激动;鼓动;煽动;使振奋

ext.ext_cn: 他比其他任何人都更积极地鼓动那里的群众。
ext.ext_en: He did more to rouse the crowd there than anybody else...

ext.ext_cn: 本说他父亲的脾气温和，不轻易发火或是发表尖锐的意见。
ext.ext_en: Ben says his father was good-natured, a man not quickly roused to anger or harsh opinions.

defs.def_en: If something or someone rouses you, they make you very emotional or excited.

ext.ext_cn: 这激起了他的叛逆感。
ext.ext_en: It roused a feeling of rebellion in him...

ext.ext_cn: 这激发了我对政治的兴趣，于是我开始效力于民主党。
ext.ext_en: This roused my interest in politics and I went to work for the Democrats.

defs.def_en: If something rouses a feeling in you, it causes you to have that feeling.

ext.ext_cn: 留守的警察随后把夫妇俩打发到邻居家去了。
ext.ext_en: The pair were then bundled off to a neighbour's house by waiting police...

ext.ext_cn: 我们想尽快打发他们上床睡觉。
ext.ext_en: We want to bundle them off to bed quickly.

defs.def_en: If someone is bundled off somewhere, they are sent there or taken there in a hurry.

ext.ext_cn: 吉尔完全正确。
ext.ext_en: Jill is absolutely right...

ext.ext_cn: 我决不结婚。
ext.ext_en: I absolutely refuse to get married...

defs.def_en: Absolutely means totally and completely.

ext.ext_cn: “这让人担忧，不是吗？”——“确实是。”
ext.ext_en: 'It's worrying, isn't it?' – 'Absolutely.'...

ext.ext_cn: “他们找过你了吗？”——“没有，绝对没有。”
ext.ext_en: 'Did they approach you?' – 'No, absolutely not.'

defs.def_en: Some people say absolutely as an emphatic way of saying yes or of agreeing with someone. They say absolutely not as an emphatic way of saying no or of disagreeing with someone.

defs.def_cn: 工会主义者;工会运动积极分子
defs.def_en: A trade unionist is an active member of a trade union.

defs.def_cn: （用于数字后构成形容词）表示“（枪管）…口径的”

ext.ext_cn: 他有一支12毫米口径的霰弹猎枪。
ext.ext_en: He had a 12-bore shotgun.

defs.def_en: -bore combines with numbers to form adjectives which indicate the size of the barrel of a gun.

ext.ext_cn: 德拉戈把他推到墙边搜他的身。
ext.ext_en: Drago pushed him up against the wall and frisked him.

defs.def_en: If someone frisks you, they search you, usually with their hands in order to see if you are hiding a weapon or something else such as drugs in your clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 招待客户去看足球比赛
ext.ext_en: ...corporate hospitality at football grounds.

ext.ext_cn: 商务接待帐篷里的经理们
ext.ext_en: ...executives in a corporate hospitality tent.

defs.def_en: Corporate hospitality is the entertainment that a company offers to its most valued clients, for example by inviting them to sporting events and providing them with food and drink.
Inside a car, the rear-view mirror is the mirror that enables you to see the traffic behind when you are driving.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人愉快的；使人高兴的

ext.ext_cn: 生小孩是件既痛苦又令人高兴的事。
ext.ext_en: Giving birth to a child is both painful and joyful...

ext.ext_cn: 婚礼就是快乐的爱情庆典。
ext.ext_en: A wedding is a joyful celebration of love.

defs.def_en: Something that is joyful causes happiness and pleasure.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们是非常快乐的民族；我们能歌善舞，热爱音乐。
ext.ext_en: We're a very joyful people; we're very musical people and we love music.

defs.def_en: Someone who is joyful is extremely happy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 怠惰的；懒洋洋的；不热心的

ext.ext_cn: 琼森医生有时候似乎有点懈怠。
ext.ext_en: Dr. Jonsen seemed a little lackadaisical at times.

ext.ext_cn: 几名主力队员的懒散态度
ext.ext_en: ...the lackadaisical attitude of a number of the principal players.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is lackadaisical, you mean that they are rather lazy and do not show much interest or enthusiasm in what they do.

ext.ext_cn: 有些人在青春期会变得异常害羞。
ext.ext_en: Some people become very self-conscious in adolescence.

defs.def_en: Adolescence is the period of your life in which you develop from being a child into being an adult.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 起说明作用的;解说性的

ext.ext_cn: 另一个说明性的例子摘自《观察家报》。
ext.ext_en: A second illustrative example was taken from The Observer newspaper...

ext.ext_cn: 接下来的节选部分可以说明她与学生的互动情况。
ext.ext_en: The following excerpt is illustrative of her interaction with students.

defs.def_en: If you use something as an illustrative example, or for illustrative purposes, you use it to show that what you are saying is true or to make your meaning clearer.

ext.ext_en: Every Thursday she would meet her lover Leon...

ext.ext_en: He and Liz became lovers soon after they first met.

defs.def_en: Someone's lover is someone who they are having a sexual relationship with but are not married to.

ext.ext_en: She is a great lover of horses and horse racing...

ext.ext_cn: 你是歌剧发烧友吗？
ext.ext_en: Are you an opera lover?

defs.def_en: If you are a lover of something such as animals or the arts, you enjoy them very much and take great pleasure in them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 胖乎乎的;圆胖的;肥胖的

ext.ext_en: A rotund, smiling, red-faced gentleman appeared.

defs.def_en: If someone is rotund, they are round and fat.

defs.def_cn: （汽车或飞机上的）凹背单人座椅
defs.def_en: A bucket seat is a seat for one person in a car or aeroplane which has rounded sides that partly enclose and support the body.
Empiricism is the belief that people should rely on practical experience and experiments, rather than on theories as, a basis for knowledge.

defs.def_cn: 使新生;使复兴;使恢复活力（或健康）

ext.ext_cn: 这种护发素能够非常有效地修复干枯的头发。
ext.ext_en: This hair conditioner is excellent for revitalizing dry, lifeless hair.

ext.ext_en: ...the revitalized Democratic Party.

defs.def_en: To revitalize something that has lost its activity or its health means to make it active or healthy again.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the frenetic pace of life in New York...

ext.ext_cn: 这种发了疯似的行为活动是一个人极度焦虑的表现。
ext.ext_en: This frenetic activity is the sign of a worried man.

defs.def_en: If you describe an activity as frenetic, you mean that it is fast and energetic, but rather uncontrolled.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: His face assumed a sort of dreamy expression.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a dreamy expression, you mean that they are not paying attention to things around them and look as if they are thinking about something pleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻柔的;柔和的;梦幻（般）的

ext.ext_cn: 梦幻般的美丽晚霞的照片
ext.ext_en: ...dreamy shots of beautiful sunsets.

ext.ext_cn: 一首轻柔美妙的歌曲
ext.ext_en: ...a dreamy, delicate song.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as dreamy, you mean that you like it and that it seems gentle and soft, like something in a dream.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他就像是个自娱自乐的爱幻想的孩子。
ext.ext_en: He's like some dreamy kid playing on his own...

ext.ext_cn: 这些变革将使该党摆脱不切实际的“左倾”思想的影响,正是这些“左倾”思想让很多日本人离他们而去。
ext.ext_en: The changes would move the party away from the dreamy leftism that alienated many Japanese.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or an idea as dreamy, you mean that they are not very practical.

ext.ext_en: While many models vow to go back to college, few do...

ext.ext_en: I solemnly vowed that someday I would return to live in Europe...

defs.def_en: If you vow to do something, you make a serious promise or decision that you will do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我暗暗发誓，日后要倍加小心。
ext.ext_en: I made a silent vow to be more careful in the future...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维发誓要离开这个项目，我不得不对他表示钦佩。
ext.ext_en: I had to admire David's  vow that he would leave the programme.

defs.def_en: A vow is a serious promise or decision to do a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我结婚时许下誓言，并一直信守。
ext.ext_en: I took my marriage vows and kept them.

ext.ext_cn: 已立誓出家的尼姑
ext.ext_en: ...a nun who had taken final vows...

defs.def_en: Vows are a particular set of serious promises, such as the promises two people make when they are getting married.

defs.def_cn: （表示通常、显见或众所周知的事实）当然，自然

ext.ext_cn: 当然，展览上还有很多其他有趣的展品。
ext.ext_en: Of course there were lots of other interesting things at the exhibition...

ext.ext_cn: “当然我已经在报纸上看过一些关于你的报道了，”查利说道。
ext.ext_en: 'I have read about you in the newspapers of course,' Charlie said...

defs.def_en: You say of course to suggest that something is normal, obvious, or well-known, and should therefore not surprise the person you are talking to.

defs.def_cn: （表示允许的客气说法）当然（可以）

ext.ext_cn: “我能说点儿周六杯赛的事情吗？”——“当然可以。”
ext.ext_en: 'Can I just say something about the cup game on Saturday?' — 'Yes of course you can.'...

ext.ext_cn: “我能看看这些文件吗？”——“当然。”
ext.ext_en: 'Could I see these documents?' — 'Of course.'

defs.def_en: You use of course as a polite way of giving permission.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于同意或不赞同某人时强调自己的陈述）当然，自然

ext.ext_cn: “我想你是对的。”——“我当然是对的。”
ext.ext_en: 'I expect you're right.' — 'Of course I'm right.'...

ext.ext_cn: 我当然不害怕！
ext.ext_en: Of course I'm not afraid!...

defs.def_en: You use of course in order to emphasize a statement that you are making, especially when you are agreeing or disagreeing with someone.

defs.def_cn: （表示否定的强调说法）当然不，怎么会

ext.ext_cn: “你不是真的在认真考虑这件事，是吧？”——“没有，当然没有。”
ext.ext_en: 'You're not really seriously considering this thing, are you?' — 'No, of course not.'

ext.ext_cn: “如果你不介意，我想跟小伙子们谈一谈。” —— “当然不会，头儿。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'd like to talk to the lads if you don't mind.' — 'Of course not, Chief.'

defs.def_en: Of course not is an emphatic way of saying no.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第23个字母
defs.def_en: W is the twenty-third letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_cn: （用于首字母为w的一些单词的缩写，如west和watt）
defs.def_en: W or w is an abbreviation for words beginning with w, such as 'west' or 'watt'.
An eddy is a movement in water or in the air which goes round and round instead of flowing in one continuous direction.

defs.def_cn: 起漩涡;旋转;杂乱无章地移动

ext.ext_cn: 灰尘在阳光下旋转翻腾。
ext.ext_en: The dust whirled and eddied in the sunlight...

ext.ext_cn: 人群乱哄哄地涌上街头。
ext.ext_en: The crowds were eddying into the road.

defs.def_en: To eddy means to move round and round, or to move in a disorganized way.

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词或动词后）表示“过分”，“过度”

ext.ext_cn: 托尼看起来很疲惫而且过分焦虑。
ext.ext_en: Tony looked tired and over-anxious...

ext.ext_cn: 情绪低落的时候，她们就疯狂地猛吃巧克力和糖果。
ext.ext_en: When depressed, they dramatically overindulge in chocolate and sweets.

defs.def_en: You can add over- to an adjective or verb to indicate that a quality exists or an action is done to too great an extent. For example, if you say that someone is being over-cautious, you mean that they are being too cautious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 滑溜的米线
ext.ext_en: ...slithery rice noodles.

ext.ext_cn: 面料顺滑的连衣裙
ext.ext_en: ...dresses in slithery fabrics.

defs.def_en: Something that is slithery is wet or smooth, and so slides easily over things or is easy to slip on.

defs.def_cn: (试图用暴力推翻政府的)自由战士
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a freedom fighter, you mean that they belong to a group that is trying to change the government of their country using violent methods, and you agree with or approve of this.

defs.def_cn: （安装在厨房水槽下方的）废物处理器
defs.def_en: A waste disposal or a waste disposal unit is a small machine in a kitchen sink that chops up vegetable waste.

defs.def_cn: （政党等团体中的）强硬派，拒不妥协者

ext.ext_cn: 统一派强硬分子警告美国总统，他是不会受欢迎的。
ext.ext_en: Unionist hardliners warned the U.S. President he would not be welcome...

defs.def_en: The hardliners in a group such as a political party are the people who support a strict, fixed set of ideas that are often extreme, and who refuse to accept any change in them.

ext.ext_cn: 在教堂入口旁向右转。
ext.ext_en: Beside the entrance to the church, turn right...

ext.ext_en: He was driven out of a side entrance with his hand covering his face...

defs.def_en: The entrance to a place is the way into it, for example a door or gate.

defs.def_cn: 到达;（尤指有意引人注目的）驾到，莅临

ext.ext_cn: 就算她已经注意到了父亲的到来，她也会不动声色。
ext.ext_en: If she had noticed her father's entrance, she gave no indication.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's arrival in a place as their entrance, especially when you think that they are trying to be noticed and admired.

ext.ext_cn: 他走向赛马准备区。
ext.ext_en: He made his entrance into the parade ring.

defs.def_en: When a performer makes his or her entrance on to the stage, he or she comes on to the stage.

ext.ext_cn: 休伊特装扮成供热工程师从而进入大厅。
ext.ext_en: Hewitt had gained entrance to the Hall by pretending to be a heating engineer.

defs.def_en: If you gain entrance to a particular place, you manage to get in there.

defs.def_cn: 入会资格;入学资格;入行资格

ext.ext_cn: 进入大学或高中的资格受到限制。
ext.ext_en: Entrance to universities and senior secondary schools was restricted.

ext.ext_cn: 法国公务员资格考试
ext.ext_en: ...entrance exams for the French civil service.

defs.def_en: If you gain entrance to a particular profession, society, or institution, you are accepted as a member of it.

ext.ext_cn: 那项并购帮助国际商业信贷银行首次跻身美国市场。
ext.ext_en: The acquisition helped BCCI make its initial entrance into the US market.

ext.ext_cn: 他于1993年涉足政坛
ext.ext_en: ...his entrance into politics in 1993.

defs.def_en: If you make an entrance into a particular activity or system, you succeed in becoming involved in it.

ext.ext_cn: 我一遇到迪克，就被他那动听的声音迷住了。
ext.ext_en: As soon as I met Dick, he entranced me because he has a lovely voice...

ext.ext_cn: 上周五她演唱的经典印度歌曲让听众如痴如醉。
ext.ext_en: Last Friday she entranced the audience with her classical Indian singing.

defs.def_en: If something or someone entrances you, they cause you to feel delight and wonder, often so that all your attention is taken up and you cannot think about anything else.
