ext.ext_cn: 他需要那样一笔钱以生存下去。
ext.ext_en: He needs that amount of money to survive...

ext.ext_cn: 我仍然为他们做一些工作。
ext.ext_en: I still do a certain amount of work for them...

defs.def_en: The amount of something is how much there is, or how much you have, need, or get.

ext.ext_cn: 消费者在体育相关产品上的花费共计97.5亿英镑。
ext.ext_en: Consumer spending on sports-related items amounted to £9.75 billion.

defs.def_en: If something amounts to a particular total, all the parts of it add up to that total.

ext.ext_cn: 多少钱我都可以马上弄到。
ext.ext_en: I'm able to lay my hands on any amount of cash at a minute's notice...

ext.ext_cn: 有无数个俱乐部你可以加入。
ext.ext_en: There are any amount of clubs you could join.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is any amount of something, there is a lot of it. If you say that there are any amount of people or things, there are many people or things.

ext.ext_cn: 为了揭发他，委员会尝试过几十种不同的方法。
ext.ext_en: The committee have tried dozens of different ways to smoke him out.

ext.ext_cn: 让逃税者无处遁形的技术
ext.ext_en: ...technology to smoke out tax evaders.

defs.def_en: If you smoke out someone who is hiding, you discover them and make them publicly known.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 缺乏幽默感的;一本正经的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个一脸严肃相、缺乏幽默感的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a straight-faced, humourless character.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of being humourless, you mean that they are very serious about everything and do not find things amusing.

defs.def_cn: 海上的;海事的;航海的;船舶的

ext.ext_cn: 同类中最大的海洋博物馆
ext.ext_en: ...the largest maritime museum of its kind.

defs.def_en: Maritime is used to describe things relating to the sea and to ships.

defs.def_cn: 驾驶游艇（或快艇）的女子;帆船比赛女选手
defs.def_en: A yachtswoman is a woman who sails a yacht.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 荒谬的；荒唐的；不合理的

ext.ext_cn: 讨论针对教师的强制裁员政策真是滑稽可笑。
ext.ext_en: It is absurd to be discussing compulsory redundancy policies for teachers...

ext.ext_cn: 我知道我的一些客户就为了少付我几英镑，可谓无所不用其极。
ext.ext_en: I've known clients of mine go to absurd lengths, just to avoid paying me a few pounds...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is absurd, you are criticizing it because you think that it is ridiculous or that it does not make sense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有几个位高权重的朋友很有好处。
ext.ext_en: It helps to have influential friends.

ext.ext_cn: 很有影响力的议院议长之位
ext.ext_en: ...the influential position of president of the chamber...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is influential has a lot of influence over people or events.

defs.def_cn: （书面英语中用于代表old的特定发音）

ext.ext_cn: “我开始为穷孩子修理旧自行车。”
ext.ext_en: 'I started fixin' up ole bicycles fer poor kids.'

defs.def_en: Ole is used in written English to represent the word 'old' pronounced in a particular way.

defs.def_cn: （使）撕开;（使）扯开;（使）撕裂;（使）划破

ext.ext_cn: 当我们被推向相反的方向时，我感觉横幅被撕裂了。
ext.ext_en: I felt the banner rip as we were pushed in opposite directions...

ext.ext_cn: 我把纸打开的时候，尽量不把它撕破。
ext.ext_en: I tried not to rip the paper as I unwrapped it.

defs.def_en: When something rips or when you rip it, you tear it forcefully with your hands or with a tool such as a knife.

ext.ext_cn: 看到新连衣裙上的口子，她勃然大怒。
ext.ext_en: Looking at the rip in her new dress, she flew into a rage.

defs.def_en: A rip is a long cut or split in something made of cloth or paper.

ext.ext_cn: 他把连着报警按钮的电线扯掉了。
ext.ext_en: He ripped away a wire that led to the alarm button...

ext.ext_cn: 她一把扯下连衣裙，任其滑落到地上。
ext.ext_en: She ripped off her dress and let it fall to the floor...

defs.def_en: If you rip something away, you remove it quickly and forcefully.

ext.ext_cn: 一排子弹射进对面的墙上。
ext.ext_en: A volley of bullets ripped into the facing wall...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的面包车被炸弹炸得粉碎。
ext.ext_en: Their minibus was ripped apart by a bomb...

defs.def_en: If something rips into someone or something or rips through them, it enters that person or thing so quickly and forcefully that it often goes completely through them.

defs.def_cn: 尽情地做;忘乎所以地做;用尽力气做

ext.ext_cn: 把吉他的音量调到最大，尽情欢乐吧。
ext.ext_en: Turn the guitars up full and let rip...

ext.ext_cn: “呀——”卡拉放开喉咙，发出女武神瓦尔基里一般的嘶喊声。
ext.ext_en: 'Yaaaaaaa,' Carla let rip with the cry of the Valkyries.

defs.def_en: If you let rip, you do something forcefully and without trying to control yourself.

defs.def_cn: 迅速地做;强有力地做;(车辆)全速前进，开足马力

ext.ext_cn: 出现生态灾难的部分原因是人们为了增产而不惜一切代价。
ext.ext_en: The ecological disaster is partly a product of letting everything rip in order to increase production.

defs.def_en: If you let something rip, you do it as quickly or as forcefully as possible. You can say 'let it rip' or 'let her rip' to someone when you want them to make a vehicle go as fast as it possibly can.

defs.def_cn: （尤指地面之上的）电源线，输电线
defs.def_en: A power line is a cable, especially above ground, along which electricity is passed to an area or building.

ext.ext_cn: 从未有人因为高估公众的好色之心而赔钱。
ext.ext_en: Nobody ever lost money by overestimating the public's prurience.

defs.def_en: Prurience is a strong interest that someone shows in sexual matters.

defs.def_cn: 精力充沛之人；生龙活虎之人
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a live wire, you mean that they are lively and energetic.

ext.ext_cn: 将军没有乱了方寸。
ext.ext_en: The General refused to be flustered...

ext.ext_cn: 她是个非常沉着的人。没什么能让她惊慌的。
ext.ext_en: She was a very calm person. Nothing could fluster her.

defs.def_en: If you fluster someone, you make them feel nervous and confused by rushing them and preventing them from concentrating on what they are doing.
A thermo-nuclear weapon or device is one which uses the high temperatures that result from a nuclear reaction in order to cause it to explode.
Traditionalism is behaviour and ideas that support established customs and beliefs, rather than modern ones.

ext.ext_cn: 他的黑发在阳光下闪着光泽。
ext.ext_en: His black hair gleamed in the sun.

ext.ext_cn: 锃亮的红色跑车
ext.ext_en: ...a gleaming red sports car.

defs.def_en: If an object or a surface gleams, it reflects light because it is shiny and clean.

ext.ext_cn: 黑黝黝的河流上闪烁的波光
ext.ext_en: ...the gleam of the dark river...

ext.ext_cn: 在大厅灯光的照射下，她的头发闪着金色的光芒。
ext.ext_en: In the light from the hall, her hair had a golden gleam.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the light reflected from something as a gleam .

ext.ext_cn: 霓虹灯在渐浓的雾霭中隐约闪烁。
ext.ext_en: Neon lights gleamed in the deepening mists.

defs.def_en: If a light or the sun or moon gleams, it shines faintly.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车头灯的微光
ext.ext_en: ...the gleam of the headlights.

defs.def_en: A gleam of light is a pale, clear light.

ext.ext_cn: 他狡黠的双眼闪闪发亮。
ext.ext_en: His eyes gleamed almost wickedly.

defs.def_en: If your eyes gleam, they look bright and show that you are excited or happy.

ext.ext_cn: 她朝我看时眼中流露出某种神情。
ext.ext_en: There was a gleam in her eye when she looked at me.

defs.def_en: If someone has a gleam in their eye, their eyes show a particular feeling.

ext.ext_cn: 还有一线和平解决的希望。
ext.ext_en: There was a gleam of hope for a peaceful settlement.

ext.ext_cn: 些许机智幽默
ext.ext_en: ...gleams of wit.

defs.def_en: A gleam of something is a faint sign of it.

defs.def_cn: 尚未成形的想法；蒙眬的想法

ext.ext_cn: 该产品还只是工程师头脑中尚未成形的想法。
ext.ext_en: The product is still only a gleam in an engineer's eye.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is only a gleam in someone's eye at present, you mean that it is only being planned or considered, and has not yet been properly begun.

ext.ext_cn: 作者的论点与自由市场本身无关，而是与自由市场所处的西方社会有关。
ext.ext_en: The authors' argument is not with the free market per se but with the western society in which it works...

ext.ext_cn: 全球变暖本身并不是真正的问题；可能由它引发的灾害性天气变化才是问题所在。
ext.ext_en: Global warming per se is not really the problem; the catastrophic climate changes which might be caused by it are.

defs.def_en: Per se means 'by itself' or 'in itself', and is used when you are talking about the qualities of one thing considered on its own, rather than in connection with other things.

ext.ext_cn: 工会敦促制定一个退休金方案。
ext.ext_en: The union pressed for a superannuation scheme.

defs.def_en: Superannuation is money which people pay regularly into a special fund so that when they retire from their job they will receive money regularly as a pension.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (性格、外貌或举止)孩子般的，单纯的

ext.ext_cn: 他最具持久魅力的特质就是他那孩子般的天真无邪。
ext.ext_en: His most enduring quality is his childlike innocence...

ext.ext_cn: 她的言行举止像个孩子，依赖性强。
ext.ext_en: Her behaviour was childlike and dependent.

defs.def_en: You describe someone as childlike when they seem like a child in their character, appearance, or behaviour.
A newsreader is a person who reads the news on the radio or on television.

ext.ext_cn: 有很多可以骑车的宁静小路。
ext.ext_en: There are a multitude of small quiet roads to cycle along...

ext.ext_cn: 毒瘾会带来许多其他问题。
ext.ext_en: Addiction to drugs can bring a multitude of other problems.

defs.def_en: A multitude of things or people is a very large number of them.

ext.ext_cn: 被喧闹的人群围着
ext.ext_en: ...surrounded by a noisy multitude.

ext.ext_cn: 围在主教周围的人群
ext.ext_en: ...the multitudes that throng around  the Pope.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a very large number of people as a multitude .

ext.ext_cn: 向大众隐瞒了骇人听闻的真相。
ext.ext_en: The hideous truth was hidden from the multitude...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的任务是要让民众相信，我们是在用合法的方式来从事一种合法的爱好。
ext.ext_en: It is our task to convince the multitudes that we are pursuing a lawful hobby in a lawful way.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the great majority of people in a particular country or situation as the multitude or the multitudes .

ext.ext_cn: 和蜡染相似的工序
ext.ext_en: ...a process similar to that used in batik.

ext.ext_cn: 蜡防印花床罩
ext.ext_en: ...batik bedspreads.

defs.def_en: Batik is a process for printing designs on cloth. Wax is put on those areas of the cloth that you do not want to be coloured by dye.

ext.ext_cn: 用当地的蜡防印花布装饰的四柱床
ext.ext_en: ...a four-poster bed decorated with local batiks.

ext.ext_cn: 产自巴厘岛的蜡防印花布
ext.ext_en: ...batik from Bali.

defs.def_en: A batik is a cloth which has been printed with a batik design.
Yellow Pages is a book that contains advertisements and telephone numbers for businesses and organizations in a particular area, grouped according to the type of business they do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 隐伏的;潜在的;不知不觉间加剧的

ext.ext_cn: 变化是悄然发生的,15 到 20 年间不会产生明显影响。
ext.ext_en: The changes are insidious, and will not produce a noticeable effect for 15 to 20 years...

ext.ext_cn: 他们关注的是公开的歧视,而不是种族主义的一些潜在问题。
ext.ext_en: They focus on overt discrimination rather than insidious aspects of racism.

defs.def_en: Something that is insidious is unpleasant or dangerous and develops gradually without being noticed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 曾经辛辛苦苦地养育过任性难缠的孩子的父母亲
ext.ext_en: ...parents who have had the onerous task of bringing up a very difficult child.

defs.def_en: If you describe a task as onerous, you dislike having to do it because you find it difficult or unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (看、听)不清楚的;模糊的;难以清楚辨认的

ext.ext_cn: 书写的文字模糊难认。
ext.ext_en: The lettering is fuzzy and indistinct.

ext.ext_cn: 模糊不清的低语声
ext.ext_en: ...the indistinct murmur of voices.

defs.def_en: Something that is indistinct is unclear and difficult to see, hear, or recognize.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 疼痛是身体在告诉我们有地方出问题了。
ext.ext_en: Pain is the body's way of telling us that something is wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 似乎没有人注意到出了问题。
ext.ext_en: Nobody seemed to notice anything wrong...

defs.def_en: If you say there is something wrong, you mean there is something unsatisfactory about the situation, person, or thing you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 他去错了房子。
ext.ext_en: He went to the wrong house...

ext.ext_cn: 罚错了人。
ext.ext_en: The wrong man had been punished...

defs.def_en: If you choose the wrong thing, person, or method, you make a mistake and do not choose the one that you really want.

defs.def_cn: (决定、选择、行动等)错误的，不适当的

ext.ext_cn: 在那点上我的决定确实错了。
ext.ext_en: I really made the wrong decision there...

ext.ext_cn: 选错俱乐部也许会限制你成功的机会。
ext.ext_en: The wrong choice of club might limit your chances of success...

defs.def_en: If something such as a decision, choice, or action is the wrong one, it is not the best or most suitable one.

defs.def_cn: 不正确的;与事实不符的

ext.ext_cn: 你怎么知道这个解释是错误的呢？
ext.ext_en: How do you know that this explanation is wrong?...

ext.ext_cn: 这些计算有20%是错误的。
ext.ext_en: 20 per cent of the calculations are wrong.

defs.def_en: If something is wrong, it is incorrect and not in accordance with the facts.

defs.def_cn: （机器设备）出毛病的，出故障的

ext.ext_cn: 我们认为计算机出了故障。
ext.ext_en: We think there's something wrong with the computer...

ext.ext_cn: 卫星连接一定出了毛病。
ext.ext_en: Something must have gone wrong with the satellite link.

defs.def_en: If something is wrong or goes wrong with a machine or piece of equipment, it stops working properly.

ext.ext_cn: 我误以为这是个非正式会议。
ext.ext_en: I was wrong about it being a casual meeting...

ext.ext_cn: 我这么想错了吗？
ext.ext_en: Am I wrong in thinking that?...

defs.def_en: If you are wrong about something, what you say or think about it is not correct.

defs.def_cn: (通常用于生气时)你想错了／你听错了

ext.ext_cn: “我以为我和你要一起过夜呢。”他小声说。“你想错了。”南茜小声回应道。
ext.ext_en: 'I thought you and I were going to spend the night together,' he whispered. 'You thought wrong,' Nancy whispered back.

defs.def_en: You can use wrong in expressions such as you thought wrong and you heard wrong to tell someone that what they thought or were told is incorrect, usually when you are annoyed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她不该把孩子单独留在那儿。
ext.ext_en: She was wrong to leave her child alone...

ext.ext_cn: 我们认为我们没有做错什么。
ext.ext_en: We don't consider we did anything wrong.

defs.def_en: If you think that someone was wrong to do something, you think that they should not have done it because it was bad or immoral.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (活动或行动)不道德的，不可取的

ext.ext_cn: 尽力挽救所爱之人的生命难道错了吗？
ext.ext_en: Is it wrong to try to save the life of someone you love?...

ext.ext_cn: 我们不得不让病人到别处求医的做法是不可取的。
ext.ext_en: It is wrong that we have to tell ill people to go somewhere else to look for treatment...

defs.def_en: Wrong is used to refer to activities or actions that are considered to be morally bad and unacceptable.

defs.def_cn: 不公平行为;不道德行为

ext.ext_cn: 我打算纠正那个错误。
ext.ext_en: I intend to right that wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 保险公司不应该为其中一名保险代理所犯的错误负责。
ext.ext_en: The insurance company should not be held liable for the wrongs of one of its agents.

defs.def_en: A wrong is an unfair or immoral action.

ext.ext_cn: 你冤枉了我妈妈。
ext.ext_en: You have wronged my mother...

ext.ext_cn: 她觉得受委屈了。
ext.ext_en: She felt she'd been wronged...

defs.def_en: If someone wrongs you, they treat you in an unfair way.

defs.def_cn: 不能被社会所接受的;不可取的

ext.ext_cn: 如果你进错了学校，就得不到这份工作。
ext.ext_en: If you went to the wrong school, you won't get the job...

ext.ext_cn: 轻松捞取利润的可能性吸引了一拨不良商人。
ext.ext_en: The prospect of easy profits has attracted the wrong kind of businessman.

defs.def_en: You use wrong to describe something which is not thought to be socially acceptable or desirable.

ext.ext_cn: 别误会我的意思，这个工作很有意思，可惜不是长期性的。
ext.ext_en: Don't get me wrong, it's interesting work. But it's not permanent...

ext.ext_cn: 别误会，我的意思是乔安妮是我最好的朋友，但她有时候可能有点儿招人烦。
ext.ext_en: I mean, don't get me wrong. Joanie's my best friend, but she can be kind of a pain sometimes.

defs.def_en: You say 'Don't get me wrong' when you want to make sure that someone does not get an incorrect idea about what you are doing or saying, or about why you are doing or saying it.

ext.ext_cn: 情况完全变得一团糟。
ext.ext_en: It all went horribly wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 差不多可能出乱子的地方都出了乱子。
ext.ext_en: Nearly everything that could go wrong has gone wrong.

defs.def_en: If a situation goes wrong, it stops progressing in the way that you expected or intended, and becomes much worse.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有起诉，因为过错在他。
ext.ext_en: He didn't press charges because he was in the wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 她是有过错的一方。
ext.ext_en: She was the one in the wrong.

defs.def_en: If someone who is involved in an argument or dispute has behaved in a way which is morally or legally wrong, you can say that they are in the wrong .
If someone says 'Two wrongs don't make a right', they mean that you should not do harm to a person who has done harm to you, even if you think that person deserves it.
Scampi are large prawns, often served fried in breadcrumbs.
A thesaurus is a reference book in which words with similar meanings are grouped together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有教养的;有涵养的;知书达理的

ext.ext_cn: 她很有涵养，不想去伤害小男孩的感情。
ext.ext_en: She was too well bred to want to hurt the little boy's feelings.

defs.def_en: A well-bred person is very polite and has good manners.

defs.def_cn: （广播、电视的）汇播节目，综合节目

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢看《伦敦东区》的周日连播版。
ext.ext_en: I enjoy the omnibus edition of Eastenders on Sunday.

defs.def_en: An omnibus edition of a radio or television programme contains two or more similar programmes that were originally broadcast separately.

defs.def_cn: （某一作家或主题作品的）选集，汇编

ext.ext_cn: 露丝·伦德尔3篇恐怖故事的新选集
ext.ext_en: ...a new omnibus edition of three Ruth Rendell chillers.

defs.def_en: An omnibus is a book which contains a large collection of stories or articles, often by a particular person or about a particular subject.
An omnibus is a bus .

defs.def_cn: 狮子宫，狮子座（黄道十二宫之一。出生于7月23日至8月22日之间的人属此星座）
defs.def_en: Leo is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac. Its symbol is a lion. People who are born approximately between the 23rd of July and the 22nd of August come under this sign.

defs.def_cn: 出生于狮子宫时段的人
defs.def_en: A Leo is a person whose sign of the zodiac is Leo.
Nuclear fission is the splitting of the nucleus of an atom to produce a large amount of energy or cause a large explosion.

ext.ext_cn: 我花了几个星期才从他那儿套出事情的真相。
ext.ext_en: It took me weeks to worm the facts out of him...

ext.ext_cn: 不久，在她的盘问之下，他承认还有其他婚外情。
ext.ext_en: It didn't take long before she'd wormed out of him confessions of his other infidelity.

defs.def_en: If you worm information out of someone, you gradually find it out by constantly asking them about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （外貌或举止）男孩子气的，稚气的

ext.ext_cn: 看到他脸上现出孩子气的笑容，她总算松了口气。
ext.ext_en: She was relieved to see his face light up with a boyish grin...

ext.ext_cn: 他热爱学习，对生活有一种少年般纯真的热情。
ext.ext_en: He loves to learn, and has a boyish enthusiasm for life.

defs.def_en: If you describe a man as boyish, you mean that he is like a boy in his appearance or behaviour, and you find this characteristic quite attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （女子）长得像男孩子的，假小子的

ext.ext_cn: 她高挑的男孩子般的身材
ext.ext_en: ...her tall, boyish figure.

defs.def_en: If you describe a girl or woman as boyish, you mean that she looks like a boy, for example because she has short hair or small breasts.

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮吃早餐时坐在她对面。
ext.ext_en: Jennie had sat opposite her at breakfast.

ext.ext_cn: 他抬头看向对面那些楼，但没有看见哪扇窗户开着。
ext.ext_en: He looked up at the buildings opposite, but could see no open window...

defs.def_en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

ext.ext_cn: 房间的对角
ext.ext_en: ...the opposite corner of the room.

defs.def_en: The opposite side or part of something is the side or part that is furthest away from you.

defs.def_cn: （同一类事物）截然相反的，全然不同的

ext.ext_cn: 对面开来的车都打着头灯。
ext.ext_en: All the cars driving in the opposite direction had their headlights on...

ext.ext_cn: 我本应按相反的顺序记笔记的。
ext.ext_en: I should have written the notes in the opposite order...

defs.def_en: Opposite is used to describe things of the same kind which are completely different in a particular way. For example, north and south are opposite directions, and winning and losing are opposite results in a game.

ext.ext_cn: 里特城府颇深，而马里厄斯恰恰相反，是个心地淳朴的农民。
ext.ext_en: Ritter was a very complex man but Marius was the opposite, a simple farmer...

ext.ext_cn: 呃，不管他说什么，你都可以肯定他想的完全是另一套。
ext.ext_en: Well, whatever he says you can bet he's thinking the opposite...

defs.def_en: The opposite of someone or something is the person or thing that is most different from them.

defs.def_cn: （为推销某项产品或服务而推行的)营销组合,综合营销策略

ext.ext_cn: 营销组合的重点将放在价格与配送上。
ext.ext_en: The key focus of the marketing mix will be on price and distribution.

defs.def_en: A company's marketing mix is the combination of marketing activities it uses in order to promote a particular product or service.
Your larynx is the top part of the passage that leads from your throat to your lungs and contains your vocal cords.

defs.def_cn: (个人、公司、产品在各自领域活动的)成绩记录

ext.ext_cn: 这项工作需要有良好投资业绩的人来担当。
ext.ext_en: The job needs someone with a good track record in investment...

ext.ext_cn: 他作为校长的工作履历非常突出。
ext.ext_en: His track record as a headmaster was excellent.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the track record of a person, company, or product, you are referring to their past performance, achievements, or failures in it.

defs.def_cn: （由动词和副词或介词组成的）短语动词，动词词组
defs.def_en: A phrasal verb is a combination of a verb and an adverb or preposition, for example 'shut up' or 'look after', which together have a particular meaning.

defs.def_cn: 偷偷摸摸的；不正当的；后门的

ext.ext_cn: 他通过幕后交易使政府预算按时通过了议会批准。
ext.ext_en: He did the backdoor deals that allowed the government to get its budget through Parliament on time...

ext.ext_cn: 他没有理会贪婪的下院议员们投票为他们自己悄悄加薪的传闻。
ext.ext_en: He brushed aside talk of greedy MPs voting themselves a backdoor pay rise.

defs.def_en: You can use backdoor to describe an action or process if you disapprove of it because you think it has been done in a secret, indirect, or dishonest way.

defs.def_cn: 不正当的秘密途径；后门

ext.ext_cn: 牙医声称政府正通过暗箱操作将牙医业私有化。
ext.ext_en: Dentists claim the Government is privatising dentistry through the back door.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is doing something through or by the backdoor, you disapprove of them because they are doing it in a secret, indirect, or dishonest way.

ext.ext_cn: 他想退休后有份收入;在那以前，他并不需要额外的钱。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to have a source of income after his retirement; until then, he wouldn't require additional money...

ext.ext_cn: 该诊所去年 10 月开业，从那以后已经接诊 200 多人。
ext.ext_en: The clinic opened for business last October and since then has treated more than 200 people.

defs.def_en: Then means at a particular time in the past or in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 1976 年的《种族关系法》(由当时的工党政府颁布施行)
ext.ext_en: ...the Race Relations Act of 1976 (enacted by the then Labour Government)...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾因参与 1963 年 8 月那起发生在从格拉斯哥开往伦敦的邮政列车上的特大抢劫案而恶名昭著。
ext.ext_en: He was known by many for his role in the then record-breaking robbery of the mail train from Glasgow to London in August 1963.

defs.def_en: Then is used when you refer to something which was true at a particular time in the past but is not true now.

ext.ext_cn: 先在锅里放油，然后放入扇贝，留点地方搁蒜。
ext.ext_en: Add the oil and then the scallops to the pan, leaving a little space for the garlic...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得自己的脸红了，接着我吸吸鼻子,不让眼泪掉下来。
ext.ext_en: I felt myself blush. Then I sniffed back a tear...

defs.def_en: You use then to say that one thing happens after another, or is after another on a list.

ext.ext_cn: “我在学校时成绩不大好。”——“那么你当时最喜欢做什么呢？”
ext.ext_en: 'I wasn't a very good scholar at school.' — 'What did you like doing best then?'...

ext.ext_cn: 你不打算告诉我，是吧？那么，我只好猜猜了？
ext.ext_en: You're not gonna tell me, are you? Do I have to guess, then?...

defs.def_en: You use then in conversation to indicate that what you are about to say follows logically in some way from what has just been said or implied.

ext.ext_cn: “我下班后可以和你碰面。6 点可以吗？”——“行啊。”——“那就定 6 点啦？”
ext.ext_en: 'I can meet you after work. Six o'clock?'— 'Fine.' — 'Six o'clock, then?'...

ext.ext_cn: 他站起身说，“就这么定了。”
ext.ext_en: He stood up. 'That's settled then.'...

defs.def_en: You use then at the end of a topic or at the end of a conversation.

defs.def_cn: (和 now，well，okay 等连用，引出新话题或新观点)

ext.ext_cn: 那么，你说你在后面的田地里散步？
ext.ext_en: Now then, you say you walk on the fields out the back?

ext.ext_cn: 好吧，我来烧壶水，我们沏点茶喝。
ext.ext_en: Well then, I'll put the kettle on and make us some tea...

defs.def_en: You use then with words like 'now', 'well', and 'okay', to introduce a new topic or a new point of view.

defs.def_cn: 也就是说，总之(引出总结或结论)

ext.ext_cn: 这就是 20 世纪 60 年代中期严肃的管弦乐中的主流音乐。
ext.ext_en: This, then, was the music that appeared to dominate the world of serious concert music in the mid-1960s...

ext.ext_cn: 也就是说，到 1931 年的时候，法国是欧洲唯一一个拥有大量移民的国家。
ext.ext_en: By 1931, then, France alone in Europe was a country of massive immigration.

defs.def_en: You use then to introduce a summary of what you have said or the conclusions that you are drawing from it.

defs.def_cn: 那么，则(引导if开头的句子的第二部分，第一部分描述可能的情况，第二部分引入结果)

ext.ext_cn: 如果答案是肯定的，那么我们必须商定合适的行动方案。
ext.ext_en: If the answer is 'yes', then we must decide on an appropriate course of action...

defs.def_en: You use then to introduce the second part of a sentence which begins with 'if'. The first part of the sentence describes a possible situation, and then introduces the result of the situation.

defs.def_cn: 毕竟，话说回来，而且(用于句首，或用于 and，but 之后引出对之前所说话的评论或补充)

ext.ext_cn: 我们要进行大量阅读，而且手头有一篇论文要写。
ext.ext_en: We have to do quite a bit of reading, and then we have our ongoing work which would be an essay...

ext.ext_cn: 他听起来很真诚，可是话说回来，他向来如此。
ext.ext_en: He sounded sincere, but then, he always did.

defs.def_en: You use then at the beginning of a sentence or after 'and' or 'but' to introduce a comment or an extra piece of information to what you have already said.
A machete is a large knife with a broad blade.

ext.ext_cn: 特纳是作家兼批评家。
ext.ext_en: Turner is a writer and critic.

ext.ext_cn: 美国作家创作的侦探小说
ext.ext_en: ...detective stories by American writers.

defs.def_en: A writer is a person who writes books, stories, or articles as a job.

defs.def_cn: （特定文章、报告、信件或故事的）作者，撰写者

ext.ext_cn: 此报告未经作者允许，任何人不得翻阅。
ext.ext_en: No-one is to see the document without the permission of the writer of the report...

ext.ext_cn: 我不能赞同写信人所称恢复死刑就是侵犯人权的说法。
ext.ext_en: I can't agree with the letter writer who claims bringing back the death penalty would be an abuse of human rights.

defs.def_en: The writer of a particular article, report, letter, or story is the person who wrote it.

ext.ext_cn: 他曾面对众人，把他们镇住了。
ext.ext_en: He's confronted crowds before and faced them down.

defs.def_en: If you face someone down, you oppose them or defeat them by being confident and looking at them boldly.

ext.ext_cn: 亚速尔群岛，由9个小岛组成的多岩石的火山群岛
ext.ext_en: ...the Azores, a rugged, volcanic archipelago of nine islands.

defs.def_en: An archipelago is a group of islands, especially small islands.

ext.ext_en: In France you cannot be gazumped...

defs.def_en: If you are gazumped by someone, they agree to sell their house to you, but then sell it to someone else who offers to pay a higher price.

ext.ext_en: I'm married, but we're separated...

ext.ext_en: We're thinking of going to a jazz club tonight.

defs.def_en: We're is the usual spoken form of 'we are'.

ext.ext_cn: 该市警察设置了路障以检查过往车辆。
ext.ext_en: The city police set up roadblocks to check passing vehicles.

defs.def_en: When the police or the army put a roadblock across a road, they stop all the traffic going through, for example because they are looking for a criminal.
A lumpectomy is an operation in which a woman has a lump such as a tumour removed from one of her breasts, rather than having the whole breast removed.

ext.ext_cn: 他公然在超市偷窃。
ext.ext_en: He openly shoplifted from a supermarket...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经偷了商店价值好几千美元的商品。
ext.ext_en: They had shoplifted thousands of dollars' worth of merchandise.

defs.def_en: If someone shoplifts, they steal goods from a shop by hiding them in a bag or in their clothes.
Bicarbonate of soda is a white powder which is used in baking to make cakes rise, and also as a medicine for your stomach.
A razor is a tool that people use for shaving.

ext.ext_cn: 废弃的教堂
ext.ext_en: ...a church which has fallen into disuse...

ext.ext_cn: 多年不用的车轮早已锈迹斑斑。
ext.ext_en: The wheel had long since rusted from years of disuse.

defs.def_en: If something falls into disuse, people stop using it. If something becomes worse as a result of disuse, it becomes worse because no one uses it.

ext.ext_cn: 先天畸形发生率高的婴儿
ext.ext_en: ...babies with a high incidence of congenital malformations.

defs.def_en: A malformation in a person's body is a part which does not have the proper shape or form, especially when it has been like this since birth.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无助的;无力量的;无能力的;不由自主的

ext.ext_cn: 父母经常感到无能为力，因为他们知道无论多少次拥抱也无法止住眼泪。
ext.ext_en: Parents often feel helpless, knowing that all the cuddles in the world won't stop the tears...

ext.ext_en: Children are dying, and I am helpless to do anything...

defs.def_en: If you are helpless, you do not have the strength or power to do anything useful or to control or protect yourself.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 感到惊讶的;十分惊奇的

ext.ext_cn: 他的愚笨让我大跌眼镜。
ext.ext_en: I was astonished by his stupidity...

ext.ext_en: They were astonished to find the driver was a six-year-old boy.

defs.def_en: If you are astonished by something, you are very surprised about it.
The keyboard of a typewriter or computer is the set of keys that you press in order to operate it.

ext.ext_cn: 塔尼娅的双手在琴键上翻飞。
ext.ext_en: Tanya's hands rippled over the keyboard.

defs.def_en: The keyboard of a piano or organ is the set of black and white keys that you press in order to play it.

ext.ext_cn: 键盘手肖恩·奥黑根
ext.ext_en: ...Sean O'Hagan on keyboards.

ext.ext_cn: 键盘乐器演奏者
ext.ext_en: ...the keyboard player.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to musical instruments that have a keyboard as keyboards .

ext.ext_cn: 相扑运动员
ext.ext_en: ...a sumo wrestler.

defs.def_en: Sumo is the Japanese style of wrestling.

ext.ext_cn: 政府许诺实施新的制度来控制金融贷款机构。
ext.ext_en: The government promised to implement a new system to control financial loan institutions...

ext.ext_cn: 报告规定了严格的检查程序，以确保建议得到切实执行。
ext.ext_en: The report sets out strict inspection procedures to ensure that the recommendations are properly implemented.

defs.def_en: If you implement something such as a plan, you ensure that what has been planned is done.

ext.ext_cn: 刀子和其他有用工具
ext.ext_en: ...knives and other useful implements.

ext.ext_cn: 书写用具
ext.ext_en: ...writing implements.

defs.def_en: An implement is a tool or other piece of equipment.
Chamber music is classical music written for a small number of instruments.

ext.ext_cn: 要是有树桩的话，检查一下上面有没有长菌类。
ext.ext_en: If you have a tree stump, check it for fungus...

ext.ext_cn: 流浪汉从深口袋里掏出了一截蜡烛。
ext.ext_en: The tramp produced a stump of candle from his deep pockets.

defs.def_en: A stump is a small part of something that remains when the rest of it has been removed or broken off.
In cricket, the stumps are the three wooden sticks that are placed upright in the ground to form the wicket.

defs.def_cn: 把…难住;难倒;使…一筹莫展

ext.ext_cn: 一个意想不到的问题把约翰难住了。
ext.ext_en: John is stumped by an unexpected question...

ext.ext_cn: 好吧，也许我在那件事上使你为难了。
ext.ext_en: Well, maybe I stumped you on that one.

defs.def_en: If you are stumped by a question or problem, you cannot think of any solution or answer to it.

defs.def_cn: 迈着沉重的步子走;跺着脚走

ext.ext_cn: 元帅迈过真空吸尘器，脚步沉重地走出了房间。
ext.ext_en: The Marshal stepped over the vacuum-cleaner and stumped out of the room.

defs.def_en: If you stump somewhere, you walk there with heavy steps.

ext.ext_cn: 当竞选人在全国作巡回演说时，人们会步行、骑马或坐车数英里赶去听他们的演讲。
ext.ext_en: When candidates went stumping around the country, people traveled for miles on foot, by horse, by carriage to hear them speak...

ext.ext_cn: 他正在佐治亚州为民主党参议员威奇·福勒作巡回演说。
ext.ext_en: He was in Georgia stumping for Senator Wyche Fowler, a Democrat.

ext.ext_cn: 总统候选人今天在作巡回演说。
ext.ext_en: The presidential candidates are on the stump today.

defs.def_en: If politicians are on the stump, they are campaigning for an election.

defs.def_cn: 成员组织；附属机构；分会

ext.ext_cn: 12家公司，包括得克萨斯一家石油公司的3家分公司
ext.ext_en: ...twelve companies, including three affiliates of a Texas oil firm...

ext.ext_cn: 国际象棋联合会在大约120个国家设有分支机构。
ext.ext_en: The World Chess Federation has affiliates in around 120 countries.

defs.def_en: An affiliate is an organization which is officially connected with another, larger organization or is a member of it.

ext.ext_cn: 所有青年团体必须并入全国青年事务处。
ext.ext_en: All youth groups will have to affiliate to the National Youth Agency...

ext.ext_cn: 政府不会允许其公务员协会与外部工会有紧密联系。
ext.ext_en: The Government will not allow the staff association to affiliate with outside unions.

defs.def_en: If an organization affiliates to or with another larger organization, it forms a close connection with the larger organization or becomes a member of it.

defs.def_cn: （医生或律师等专业人士）与…有正式关系

ext.ext_cn: 他说他因为需要“在法律事务上得到专家的意见和建议”，所以想与一家美国律师事务所建立合作关系。
ext.ext_en: He said he wanted to affiliate with a U.S. firm because he needed 'expert advice and counsel in legal affairs'.

defs.def_en: If a professional person such as a lawyer or doctor affiliates with an organization, they become officially connected with that organization.
A spear is a weapon consisting of a long pole with a sharp metal point attached to the end.

ext.ext_cn: 用切肉叉叉一片鱼肉，在面糊里蘸一下。
ext.ext_en: Spear a piece of fish with a carving fork and dip it in the batter...

ext.ext_cn: 一名警官被刺死了。
ext.ext_en: A police officer was speared to death.

defs.def_en: If you spear something, you push or throw a pointed object into it.

defs.def_cn: 贬低;轻视;使显得琐碎(或简单)

ext.ext_cn: 商界一直不重视世界环境问题，总让我惊讶不已。
ext.ext_en: It never ceases to amaze me how the business world continues to trivialize the world's environmental problems.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone trivializes something important, you disapprove of them because they make it seem less important, serious, and complex than it is.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: She saw a hideous face at the window and screamed.

ext.ext_cn: 奇丑无比的新式欧洲建筑和糟糕透顶的金属雕塑
ext.ext_en: ...hideous new Europe architecture, and horrible metal sculptures.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is hideous, you mean that they are very ugly or unattractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （事件、经历或行动）极可恶的，非常痛苦的，令人难以忍受的

ext.ext_en: His family was subjected to a hideous attack by the gang...

ext.ext_cn: 这一天真是糟糕透了。
ext.ext_en: It's been a perfectly hideous day.

Swag is stolen goods, or money obtained illegally.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 当然他很不放心见我，直到我再一次向他保证我不是在写他。
ext.ext_en: He was rightly suspicious of meeting me until I reassured him I was not writing about him...

ext.ext_cn: 他像他父亲一样生性多疑。
ext.ext_en: He has his father's suspicious nature.

defs.def_en: If you are suspicious of someone or something, you do not trust them, and are careful when dealing with them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Two officers on patrol became suspicious of two men in a car...

ext.ext_cn: 觉得情况可疑的邻居们报警后，被囚禁在地下室里的一名女子获了救。
ext.ext_en: A woman kept prisoner in a basement was rescued after suspicious neighbours tipped off police.

defs.def_en: If you are suspicious of someone or something, you believe that they are probably involved in a crime or some dishonest activity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他报告说两个形迹可疑的人曾跟卡伦德接触过。
ext.ext_en: He reported that two suspicious-looking characters had approached Callendar...

ext.ext_cn: 诺丁汉警方昨晚找到了他们声称的可疑包裹。
ext.ext_en: Nottingham police last night found what they described as a suspicious package.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as suspicious, you mean that there is some aspect of them which makes you think that they are involved in a crime or a dishonest activity.

defs.def_cn: 认为世人皆自私的人;愤世嫉俗者

ext.ext_cn: 在这些事上我变得相当愤世嫉俗。
ext.ext_en: I have come to be very much of a cynic in these matters.

defs.def_en: A cynic is someone who believes that people always act selfishly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 吓呆的;惊得目瞪口呆的

ext.ext_cn: 我们惊呆了。她出现时我们简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。
ext.ext_en: We were dumbstruck. We just couldn't believe our eyes when she appeared.

defs.def_en: If you are dumbstruck, you are so shocked or surprised that you cannot speak.
A wristwatch is a watch with a strap which you wear round your wrist.

defs.def_cn: 由颗粒组成的;含颗粒的;颗粒状的

ext.ext_cn: 颗粒状化肥
ext.ext_en: ...a granular fertiliser.

defs.def_en: Granular substances are composed of a lot of granules, or feel or look as if they are composed of a lot of granules.
A stopwatch is a watch with buttons which you press at the beginning and end of an event, so that you can measure exactly how long it takes.
If you ask for a doggie bag in a restaurant, you ask for any food you have not eaten to be put into a bag for you to take home.
A vector is a variable quantity, such as force, that has size and direction.

defs.def_cn: （传播疾病的）媒介昆虫，带菌生物
defs.def_en: A vector is an insect or other organism that causes a disease by carrying a germ or parasite from one person or animal to another.

ext.ext_cn: 他儿子是个吸毒者，这孩子一年前吸食了过量毒品。
ext.ext_en: His son was a junkie, the kid OD'd a year ago.

ext.ext_cn: “我曾有一个朋友因吸毒过量死了，”她说道。
ext.ext_en: 'I had a friend died of an OD,' she said.

defs.def_en: To OD means the same as to overdose .

defs.def_cn: 坚定的意志;坚强的品质

ext.ext_cn: 意志坚定、毫不动摇的男人
ext.ext_en: ...a man of stern moral fibre.

ext.ext_cn: 摧垮国民意志
ext.ext_en: ...the destruction of the moral fibre of the nation.

defs.def_en: Moral fibre is the quality of being determined to do what you think is right.

defs.def_cn: 解开（皮带、鞋子等）的搭扣

ext.ext_cn: 他解开了坐椅安全带。
ext.ext_en: He unbuckled his seat belt...

ext.ext_cn: 她弯下腰解开了凉鞋搭扣。
ext.ext_en: She bent over and unbuckled her sandals.

defs.def_en: If you unbuckle something such as a belt or a shoe, you undo the buckle fastening it.

defs.def_cn: 生意人；商界人员；企业界人士

ext.ext_cn: 为安全部队提供服务或物资的商界人士
ext.ext_en: ...business people who serve or supply the security forces.

ext.ext_cn: 私营企业家
ext.ext_en: ...a self-employed business person.

defs.def_en: Business people are people who work in business.

ext.ext_cn: 人们大多憎恨他，但不敢说，因为他仍在统治这个国家。
ext.ext_en: Most people hate him, but they don't dare to say so, because he still rules the country...

ext.ext_cn: 我恨自己写了那封信。
ext.ext_en: I hated myself for writing that letter.

defs.def_en: If you hate someone or something, you have an extremely strong feeling of dislike for them.

ext.ext_cn: 特德讨厌各种派对，即便是他自己喜欢的人的聚会也不例外。
ext.ext_en: Ted hated parties, even gatherings of people he liked individually...

ext.ext_cn: 她讨厌医院，也不想做手术。
ext.ext_en: She hated hospitals and didn't like the idea of having an operation...

defs.def_en: If you say that you hate something such as a particular activity, you mean that you find it very unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 我真不愿麻烦你/我真不想打扰你

ext.ext_cn: 我真不想催你，但我稍后还有一个约会。
ext.ext_en: I hate to rush you but I have another appointment later on.

defs.def_en: You can use hate in expressions such as 'I hate to trouble you' or 'I hate to bother you' when you are apologizing to someone for interrupting them or asking them to do something.

defs.def_cn: 我很抱歉这么说/我很遗憾地通知你

ext.ext_cn: 我很抱歉地通知你，明天是你的最后一天了。
ext.ext_en: I hate to tell you this, but tomorrow's your last day...

ext.ext_cn: 我不得不承认，你是对的。
ext.ext_en: I hate to admit it, but you were right.

defs.def_en: You can use hate in expressions such as 'I hate to say it' or 'I hate to tell you' when you want to express regret about what you are about to say, because you think it is unpleasant or should not be the case.

defs.def_cn: 我很不愿意看到/我很不愿意想

ext.ext_cn: 我真不愿意看到你这样对待自己。
ext.ext_en: I just hate to see you doing this to yourself.

defs.def_en: You can use hate in expressions such as 'I hate to see' or 'I hate to think' when you are emphasizing that you find a situation or an idea unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 真希望…不是真的（或不会发生）

ext.ext_cn: 希望我的工作不会因为我暂时休假而不保。
ext.ext_en: I'd hate to think my job would not be secure if I left it temporarily.

defs.def_en: You can use hate in expressions such as 'I'd hate to think' when you hope that something is not true or that something will not happen.

defs.def_cn: (通常指为慈善筹款而举行的)咖啡早茶会
defs.def_en: A coffee morning is a social event at which coffee and tea are served. It takes place in the morning, and is usually intended to raise money for charity.

defs.def_cn: 向河口;朝下游方向;顺流而下

ext.ext_cn: 9点30分时我们就解缆向下游出发了。
ext.ext_en: By 09.30 we had cast off and were heading down-river.

ext.ext_cn: 下游几百码处的一家大型旅游酒店
ext.ext_en: ...a big tourist hotel a few hundred yards down-river...

defs.def_en: Something that is moving down-river is moving towards the mouth of a river, from a point further up the river. Something that is down-river is towards the mouth of a river.

ext.ext_cn: 他声称父母遗弃了他。
ext.ext_en: He claimed that his parents had abandoned him...

ext.ext_cn: 道路上满是弃置的车辆。
ext.ext_en: The road is strewn with abandoned vehicles.

defs.def_en: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

defs.def_cn: 中途放弃，中止（活动、工作等）

ext.ext_cn: 当局中止了分发食物的尝试。
ext.ext_en: The authorities have abandoned any attempt to distribute food...

ext.ext_cn: 因为担心破产，该计划的投资者决定放弃这个项目。
ext.ext_en: The scheme's investors, fearful of bankruptcy, decided to abandon the project.

defs.def_en: If you abandon an activity or piece of work, you stop doing it before it is finished.

ext.ext_cn: 最终理智占了上风，他打消了那个念头。
ext.ext_en: Logic had prevailed and he had abandoned the idea.

defs.def_en: If you abandon an idea or way of thinking, you stop having that idea or thinking in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不敢放纵自己的情感，以免显得太过软弱或缺乏自制。
ext.ext_en: We are scared to abandon ourselves to our feelings in case we seem weak or out of control.

defs.def_en: If you abandon yourself to an emotion, you think about it a lot and feel it strongly, especially when other people might think you are wrong to do so.

ext.ext_cn: 他肆意挥霍钱财。
ext.ext_en: He has spent money with gay abandon...

ext.ext_cn: 他们对孩子的放任折射出他们自身生活的放浪形骸。
ext.ext_en: Their permissiveness toward their children reflects the wild abandon of their own lives.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something with abandon, you mean that they behave in a wild, uncontrolled way and do not think or care about how they should behave.

ext.ext_cn: 全体船员秩序井然地准备弃船。
ext.ext_en: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.

defs.def_en: If people abandon ship, they get off a ship because it is sinking.
Beefsteak is steak .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 间接表示的;含蓄的;不明言的

ext.ext_cn: 他只是含蓄地提到了国际社会对人权问题的关注。
ext.ext_en: He made only a veiled reference to international concerns over human rights issues...

ext.ext_cn: 这最后一项条款明显是对那些可能会无视法令之人的威慑。
ext.ext_en: This last clause is a thinly-veiled threat to those who might choose to ignore the decree.

defs.def_en: A veiled comment is expressed in a disguised form rather than directly and openly.

ext.ext_cn: 一位戴面纱的女士朝我友好地微笑。
ext.ext_en: A veiled woman gave me a kindly smile.

defs.def_en: A woman or girl who is veiled is wearing a veil.

ext.ext_cn: 莉莲正从博物馆那边的斜坡上走下来。
ext.ext_en: Lillian was coming down the ramp from the museum.

ext.ext_cn: 为方便乘轮椅者进入泳池而设的斜面
ext.ext_en: ...a ramp to facilitate entry into the pool from a wheelchair.

defs.def_en: A ramp is a sloping surface between two places that are at different levels.

defs.def_cn: （车辆进出主路时用的）匝道，坡道
defs.def_en: An entrance ramp is a road which cars use to drive onto a major road, and an exit ramp is a road which cars use to drive off a major road.
A reindeer is a deer with large horns called antlers that lives in northern areas of Europe, Asia, and America.

defs.def_cn: 能说会道的;巧舌如簧的

ext.ext_cn: 这个凭借三寸不烂之舌毁掉了他们的生活的骗子
ext.ext_en: ...the smooth-talking conman who has wrecked their lives.

defs.def_en: A smooth-talking man talks very confidently in a way that is likely to persuade people, but may not be sincere or honest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 世界性的，国际化的;受各国文化影响的

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦一直是一个国际化都市。
ext.ext_en: London has always been a cosmopolitan city.

defs.def_en: A cosmopolitan place or society is full of people from many different countries and cultures.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 见过世面的;见识广的;开明的

ext.ext_cn: 这家人很富有，老于世故，而且见多识广。
ext.ext_en: The family are rich, and extremely sophisticated and cosmopolitan.

defs.def_en: Someone who is cosmopolitan has had a lot of contact with people and things from many different countries and as a result is very open to different ideas and ways of doing things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 高个子、黑皮肤的英俊养羊人
ext.ext_en: ...a tall, dark, handsome sheep farmer.

defs.def_en: A handsome man has an attractive face with regular features.  →see usage note at:pretty

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有着甜美嗓音的非常健美的女子
ext.ext_en: ...an extremely handsome woman with a beautiful voice.

defs.def_en: A handsome woman has an attractive appearance with features that are large and regular rather than small and delicate.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （金额）相当大的，可观的，优厚的

ext.ext_cn: 他们会从这片地产中赚取丰厚的利润。
ext.ext_en: They will make a handsome profit on the property.

defs.def_en: A handsome sum of money is a large or generous amount.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （建筑物、庭院等）宽敞而美观的，堂皇的，雄伟的

ext.ext_cn: 拥有雄伟的文艺复兴时期建筑的杜布罗夫尼克港和扎达尔港
ext.ext_en: ...the ports of Dubrovnik and Zadar, with their handsome Renaissance buildings.

defs.def_en: A place such as a building or garden that is handsome is large and well made with an attractive appearance.

defs.def_cn: （获胜）比分悬殊的，遥遥领先的

ext.ext_cn: 反对党在竞选中以高票获胜。
ext.ext_en: The opposition won a handsome victory in the election.

defs.def_en: If someone has a handsome win or a handsome victory, they get many more points or votes than their opponent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 受尊敬的;受敬重的;受仰慕的

ext.ext_cn: 邻居们很敬重他。
ext.ext_en: He was esteemed by his neighbours...

ext.ext_cn: 在如此受人尊敬的岗位上为我的国家服务的确是一种荣誉。
ext.ext_en: It is indeed an honour to serve my country in such an esteemed position.

defs.def_en: You use esteemed to describe someone who you greatly admire and respect.
A greengage is a greenish-yellow plum with a sweet taste.

ext.ext_cn: 人群试图撞倒警察局的大门。
ext.ext_en: The crowd tried to smash down the door of the police station.

defs.def_en: If you smash down a door, building, or other large heavy object, you hit it hard and break it until it falls on the ground.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不祥的；恶兆的；不吉利的

ext.ext_cn: 电话那头出现了不祥的沉默。
ext.ext_en: There was an ominous silence at the other end of the phone...

ext.ext_cn: 远处隆隆的雷声听着愈发惊心，要变天了。
ext.ext_en: The rolls of distant thunder were growing more ominous.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ominous, you mean that it worries you because it makes you think that something unpleasant is going to happen.
The dress circle is the lowest of the curved rows of seats upstairs in a theatre.

ext.ext_cn: 一家著名的英国超市每年投放1,000多种新产品。
ext.ext_en: A well-known UK supermarket launches more than 1,000 new product lines each year.

defs.def_en: A product line is a group of related products produced by one manufacturer, for example products that are intended to be used for similar purposes or to be sold in similar types of shops.

ext.ext_cn: 今年早些时候他父亲去世，他继为第4代伯爵。
ext.ext_en: He became the fourth earl on the death of his father earlier this year.

ext.ext_cn: 伯肯黑德伯爵一世
ext.ext_en: ...the first Earl of Birkenhead.

defs.def_en: An earl is a British nobleman.
A wallflower is a plant that is grown in gardens and has sweet-smelling yellow, red, orange, or purple flowers.

defs.def_cn: 墙花(在社交场合因害羞而没有舞伴或不与人交谈的人）

ext.ext_cn: 我算是朵墙花，因为我特别害羞。
ext.ext_en: I was something of a wallflower; I was terribly shy.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a wallflower, you mean that they are shy and do not get involved in dancing or talking to people at social events.
Autism is a mental disorder that affects children, particularly their ability to relate to other people.
A wooden spoon is a spoon that is used for stirring sauces and for mixing ingredients in cooking. It is made of wood and has a long handle.

defs.def_cn: 末名;最后一名;倒数第一

ext.ext_cn: 贾维斯在第一次锦标赛上垫底。
ext.ext_en: Jarvis took the wooden spoon in the first tournament.

defs.def_en: If someone gets the wooden spoon, they come last in a race or competition.
A quad bike is a kind of motorbike with four large wheels that people ride for fun or in races.

ext.ext_cn: 我没觉得是自己把想法强加在他们身上。
ext.ext_en: I don't see my role as foisting my beliefs on them...

ext.ext_cn: 这就等于是把减少“犯罪机会”的责任强加在了女性身上，要求她们改变行为。
ext.ext_en: What this amounts to is foisting onto women the responsibility for reducing 'the opportunities for crime' by changing their behaviour.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone foists something on you, or foists it upon you, you dislike the way that they force you to listen to it or experience it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 宿命论的;宿命主义的;听天由命的

ext.ext_cn: 今天和我们交谈的人对将会发生的事情都表现得相当听天由命。
ext.ext_en: People we spoke to today were really rather fatalistic about what's going to happen.

defs.def_en: If someone is fatalistic about something, especially an unpleasant event or situation, they feel that they cannot change or control it, and therefore that there is no purpose in trying.

defs.def_cn: (陈述、声明)宣过誓的，宣誓证明的

ext.ext_cn: 在调查取得的宣誓证词中对他们提出了指控。
ext.ext_en: The allegations against them were made in sworn evidence to the inquiry.

defs.def_en: If you make a sworn statement or declaration, you swear that everything that you have said in it is true.

defs.def_cn: (仇敌)不共戴天的,势不两立的

ext.ext_cn: 现在普莱耶女士成了他不共戴天的仇敌反倒让人觉得不足为奇了。
ext.ext_en: It somehow seems hardly surprising that Ms Player is now his sworn enemy.

defs.def_en: If two people or two groups of people are sworn enemies, they dislike each other very much.

ext.ext_cn: 我被安排到缝纫车间，结果我很喜欢这项工作，后来还晋升为工头。
ext.ext_en: I was put in the tailor shop, and I loved it. I was promoted to overseer.

defs.def_en: An overseer is someone whose job is to make sure that employees are working properly.

defs.def_cn: （某一体系、活动等的）监督人，监管人，负责人

ext.ext_cn: 该部门作为监管石油生产与安全的机构的双重身份
ext.ext_en: ...the department's dual role as overseer of oil production and safety.

defs.def_en: If a person or organization is the overseer of a particular system or activity, they are responsible for making sure that the system or activity works properly and is successful.

defs.def_cn: （为击垮竞争对手而制定的）掠夺性定价

ext.ext_cn: 大型超市的掠夺性价格正威胁着小商店的生计。
ext.ext_en: Predatory pricing by large supermarkets was threatening the livelihood of smaller businesses.

defs.def_en: If a company practises predatory pricing, it charges a much lower price for its products or services than its competitors in order to force them out of the market.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 该州采取的越来越严厉的高压手段
ext.ext_en: ...increasingly coercive measures on the part of the state...

ext.ext_cn: 18世纪的英国海军部对其军官没有什么强制力。
ext.ext_en: The eighteenth-century Admiralty had few coercive powers over its officers.

defs.def_en: Coercive measures are intended to force people to do something that they do not want to do.

ext.ext_cn: 嫉妒作祟
ext.ext_en: ...the canker of jealousy.

defs.def_en: A canker is something evil that spreads and affects things or people.

ext.ext_cn: 花园里,苹果树和梨树患枯枝病最明显。
ext.ext_en: In gardens, cankers are most prominent on apples and pear trees.

defs.def_en: Canker is a disease which affects the wood of shrubs and trees, making the outer layer come away to expose the inside of the stem.

ext.ext_cn: 房子里摆放着笨重的旧式家具。
ext.ext_en: The interior of the house was furnished with heavy, old-fashioned pieces...

ext.ext_cn: 该船内部亟需油漆。
ext.ext_en: The boat's interior badly needed painting.

defs.def_en: The interior of something is the inside part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 内墙漆成了绿色。
ext.ext_en: The interior walls were painted green...

ext.ext_cn: 车内空间比有些同类车宽敞。
ext.ext_en: There is more interior space than in some rival cars...

defs.def_en: You use interior to describe something that is inside a building or vehicle.

ext.ext_cn: 为期 5 天、深入内地的远足
ext.ext_en: ...a 5-day hike into the interior.

ext.ext_cn: 南美洲不为人知的腹地
ext.ext_en: ...the unknown interior of South America...

defs.def_en: The interior of a country or continent is the central area of it.

ext.ext_cn: 法国内政部长对一起涉及秘密警察部队所扮演角色的丑闻进行了干预。
ext.ext_en: The French Interior Minister has intervened in a scandal over the role of a secret police force.

defs.def_en: A country's interior minister, ministry, or department deals with affairs within that country, such as law and order.

ext.ext_cn: 内政部的一位官员说已有 6 人丧生。
ext.ext_en: An official from the Ministry of the Interior said six people had died.

defs.def_en: A country's minister or ministry of the interior deals with affairs within that country, such as law and order.

ext.ext_cn: 她描写人类的内心生活,尤其是他们所承受的道德压力。
ext.ext_en: She depicted the interior life of human beings, and particularly their moral stresses and strains.

ext.ext_cn: 心灵的内在空间
ext.ext_en: ...the mind's interior space.

defs.def_en: Interior thoughts or processes go on inside someone's head and are not expressed aloud.
A picture library is a collection of photographs that is held by a particular company or organization. Newspapers or publishers can pay to use the photographs in their publications.

ext.ext_cn: 鲜有景致能与温暖夜色下风平浪静的大海媲美。
ext.ext_en: There were few sights as beautiful as the calm ocean on a warm night.

defs.def_en: The ocean is the sea.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在北太平洋航行了很多天。
ext.ext_en: They spent many days cruising the northern Pacific Ocean.

ext.ext_cn: 印度洋
ext.ext_en: ...the Indian Ocean.

defs.def_en: An ocean is one of the five very large areas of sea on the Earth's surface.

ext.ext_cn: 我泪流成河。
ext.ext_en: I had cried oceans of tears...

ext.ext_cn: 亚太经合组织似乎为一大堆空洞的胡言乱语所淹没。
ext.ext_en: APEC seems be drowning in an ocean of jargon.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is an ocean of something, you are emphasizing that there is a very large amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 同播出的实际开支相比较，他那点酬金不过是九牛一毛。
ext.ext_en: His fee is a drop in the ocean compared with the real cost of broadcasting.
