ext.ext_cn: 你将有4个月的时间把这些新兵训练出来。
ext.ext_en: You'll have four months in which to lick the recruits into shape...

ext.ext_cn: 几乎无人怀疑他整顿经济的能力。
ext.ext_en: Few people doubt his ability to whip the economy into shape.

defs.def_en: If you lick ,knock, or whip someone or something into shape, you use whatever methods are necessary to change or improve them so that they are in the condition that you want them to be in.

defs.def_cn: (因受损、处理不当等)变形的，走样的

ext.ext_cn: 大多数金属丝一旦弯曲变形就无法恢复原状。
ext.ext_en: Once most wires are bent out of shape, they don't return to the original position.

defs.def_en: If something is out of shape, it is no longer in its proper or original shape, for example because it has been damaged or wrongly handled.
If you are out of shape, you are unhealthy and unable to do a lot of physical activity without getting tired.

ext.ext_cn: 学院和大学林林总总，一应俱全。
ext.ext_en: Colleges and universities come in all shapes and sizes.

defs.def_en: If you say that things or people of a certain type come in all shapes and sizes, you mean that there are a large number of them, and that they are often very different from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 1912 年增加了女子比赛项目，现代奥林匹克运动会开始初具雏形。
ext.ext_en: In 1912 women's events were added, and the modern Olympic programme began to take shape.

defs.def_en: When something takes shape, it develops or starts to appear in such a way that it becomes fairly clear what its final form will be.

ext.ext_cn: 所有成年男子都有义务应征入伍。
ext.ext_en: All adult males will be liable for conscription.

defs.def_en: Conscription is officially making people in a particular country join the armed forces.

ext.ext_cn: 利比里亚没有石油，这一事实似乎解释了为什么外部势力无意过问其内政。
ext.ext_en: The fact Liberia has no oil seems to explain foreign disinterest in its internal affairs...

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须全力对付很多医疗界人士对这一话题的冷漠。
ext.ext_en: We have had to contend with the disinterest of much of the medical profession about this topic.

defs.def_en: If there is disinterest in something, people are not interested in it.

defs.def_cn: 噩梦般的镜头;梦魇般的场景

ext.ext_cn: 对大多数父母来说，发现自己的孩子吸毒简直就是场噩梦。
ext.ext_en: Discovering your child takes drugs is a nightmare scenario for most parents.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation or event as a nightmare scenario, you mean that it is the worst possible thing that could happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他的一件夹克衫挂在衣钩上。
ext.ext_en: One of his jackets hung from a hook.

ext.ext_cn: 窗帘挂钩
ext.ext_en: ...curtain hooks...

defs.def_en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things up.

ext.ext_cn: 保罗把自己的拖拉机挂在汽车上，然后把它拉到了安全的地方。
ext.ext_en: Paul hooked his tractor to the car and pulled it to safety.

ext.ext_cn: 那些挂在墙上的开罐器中的一个
ext.ext_en: ...one of those can openers that hooked onto the wall.

defs.def_en: If you hook one thing to another, you attach it there using a hook. If something hooks somewhere, it can be hooked there.

ext.ext_cn: 她拽住他的胳膊不放，另一只胳膊抱紧一棵树。
ext.ext_en: She latched on to his arm, hooking her other arm around a tree...

ext.ext_cn: 我用左臂钩住小划艇的船舷。
ext.ext_en: I hooked my left arm over the side of the dinghy.

defs.def_en: If you hook your arm, leg, or foot round an object, you place it like a hook round the object in order to move it or hold it.

ext.ext_cn: 第一次抛下钓线，我就钓了一条大鱼。
ext.ext_en: At the first cast I hooked a huge fish.

defs.def_en: If you hook a fish, you catch it with a hook on the end of a line.

ext.ext_cn: 刘易斯无论如何得躲开拉多克凌厉的左钩拳才行。
ext.ext_en: Lewis desperately needs to keep clear of Ruddock's big left hook.

defs.def_en: A hook is a short sharp blow with your fist that you make with your elbow bent, usually in a boxing match.

ext.ext_cn: 我现在又是在猜测了，因为我没有涉足政界。
ext.ext_en: I'm guessing again now because I'm not hooked into the political circles...

ext.ext_cn: 急于干一番事业，但又找不到适合自己的？
ext.ext_en: Eager to hook into a career but can't find one right for you?

defs.def_en: If you are hooked into something, or hook into something, you get involved with it.

ext.ext_cn: 人们可以上网的互动式媒体帐篷区
ext.ext_en: ...an interactive media tent where people will be able to hook into the internet.

ext.ext_cn: 为英国人提供联网服务的英国公司
ext.ext_en: ...a UK firm that lets Britons hook up to the Internet.

defs.def_en: If you hook into the Internet, you make a connection with the Internet on a particular occasion so that you can use it.

ext.ext_cn: 被指控贪污受贿的政府官员无一例外总能脱身。
ext.ext_en: Government officials accused of bribery and corruption get off the hook with monotonous regularity...

ext.ext_cn: 在他同意马上离职之前，他的对手不打算放过他。
ext.ext_en: His opponents have no intention of letting him off the hook until he agrees to leave office immediately.

defs.def_en: If someone gets off the hook or is let off the hook, they manage to get out of the awkward or unpleasant situation that they are in.
If you take a phone off the hook, you take the receiver off the part that it normally rests on, so that the phone will not ring.

ext.ext_cn: 自从战争爆发以来，捐赠中心的电话就一直响个不停。
ext.ext_en: Since war broke out, the phones at donation centers have been ringing off the hook.

defs.def_en: If your phone is ringing off the hook, so many people are trying to telephone you that it is ringing constantly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不屈不挠的;不气馁的;不服输的

ext.ext_cn: 波兰人民不屈不挠的精神
ext.ext_en: ...the indomitable spirit of the Polish people.

ext.ext_cn: 有着不屈意志的女人
ext.ext_en: ...a woman of indomitable will...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has an indomitable spirit, you admire them because they never give up or admit that they have been defeated.

defs.def_cn: 碳中和的，碳平衡的（指不会增加空气中的二氧化碳总量）

ext.ext_cn: 可以通过植树对航空飞行进行碳中和，以抵消温室气体的排放。
ext.ext_en: You can make your flights carbon neutral by planting trees to make up for the greenhouse gas emissions.

defs.def_en: A carbon neutral lifestyle, company, or activity does not cause an increase in the overall amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.

defs.def_cn: 无与伦比的；无可匹敌的；无双的

ext.ext_cn: 他对南阿拉伯社会、宗教、法律和风俗的了解无人可比。
ext.ext_en: He had an unrivalled knowledge of south Arabian society, religion, law and customs...

ext.ext_cn: 这个团队的名声、专业技能和信誉都是无可匹敌的。
ext.ext_en: It's a team unrivalled in stature, expertise and credibility.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unrivalled, you are emphasizing that it is better than anything else of the same kind.

ext.ext_cn: 公元106年罗马吞并了纳巴泰王国。
ext.ext_en: Rome annexed the Nabatean kingdom in 106 AD...

ext.ext_cn: 希特勒决定将奥地利并入德国。
ext.ext_en: Hitler was determined to annex Austria to Germany.

defs.def_en: If a country annexes another country or an area of land, it seizes it and takes control of it.
An icicle is a long pointed piece of ice hanging down from a surface. It forms when water comes slowly off the surface, and freezes as it falls.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指女性)意志坚强的，果断的，有主见的

ext.ext_cn: 她是一个独立、有主见的女人。
ext.ext_en: She is a strong-minded, independent woman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone, especially a woman, as strong-minded, you approve of them because they have their own firm attitudes and opinions, and are not easily influenced by other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 现在不是怯懦的时候。
ext.ext_en: This is no time to be faint-hearted...

ext.ext_cn: 选民们也许已经作好准备，去惩罚那些制订了懦弱的团结协定的政客。
ext.ext_en: The voters may be ready to punish the politicians who devised a faint-hearted solidarity pact.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or their behaviour as faint-hearted, you mean that they are not very confident and do not take strong action because they are afraid of failing.

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影是讲一个连环杀手的，不适合胆小的人看。
ext.ext_en: It's a film about a serial killer and not for the faint-hearted.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not for the faint-hearted, you mean that it is an extreme or very unusual example of its kind, and is not suitable for people who like only safe and familiar things.

ext.ext_cn: 鉴于检察长已公开表示反对，他的机会看来不大了。
ext.ext_en: His chances do not seem good in view of the fact that the Chief Prosecutor has already voiced his public disapproval...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管疾病肆虐，治疗却远不尽如人意。
ext.ext_en: Despite the fact that the disease is so prevalent, treatment is still far from satisfactory...

defs.def_en: You use the fact that after some verbs or prepositions, especially in expressions such as in view of the fact that ,apart from the fact that, and despite the fact that, to link the verb or preposition with a clause.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调或当从句为句子主语时)

ext.ext_cn: 我的家人现在都接受了我不吃糖和面包这件事。
ext.ext_en: My family now accepts the fact that I don't eat sugar or bread...

ext.ext_cn: 他主动离开她这件事向我证明了他所言句句属实。
ext.ext_en: The fact that he had left her of his own accord proved to me that everything he'd said was true.

defs.def_en: You use the fact that instead of a simple that-clause either for emphasis or because the clause is the subject of your sentence.

ext.ext_cn: 你不在的时候我们相处得很不愉快，确切地说这次我们差点就分手了。
ext.ext_en: We've had a pretty bad time while you were away. In fact, we very nearly split up this time...

ext.ext_cn: 意识到自己的所作所为后他马上就道歉了，而且还给我写了一张温馨的小条儿。
ext.ext_en: He apologised as soon as he realised what he had done. In actual fact he wrote a nice little note to me...

defs.def_en: You use in fact ,in actual fact, or in point of fact to indicate that you are giving more detailed information about what you have just said.

defs.def_cn: (用于修正、引出相反意见或对比等)事实上，其实

ext.ext_cn: 那听来简单，但实际上很难。
ext.ext_en: That sounds rather simple, but in fact it's very difficult...

ext.ext_cn: 他们抱怨说被困在了警察局里，但实际上，有人看见他们大多数人通过毗邻的屋顶，安全地逃到了附近的建筑物内。
ext.ext_en: They complained that they had been trapped inside the police station, but in fact most were seen escaping over the adjacent roofs to safety in nearby buildings...

defs.def_en: You use in fact ,in actual fact, or in point of fact to introduce or draw attention to a comment that modifies, contradicts, or contrasts with a previous statement.

ext.ext_cn: 对有据可查的史实的讲述
ext.ext_en: ...a statement of verifiable historical fact...

ext.ext_cn: 几多虚实，无人知晓。
ext.ext_en: How much was fact and how much fancy no one knew.

defs.def_en: When you refer to something as a fact or as fact, you mean that you think it is true or correct.

ext.ext_cn: 资料这么多，你几乎可以毫不费力地找到事实真相。
ext.ext_en: There is so much information you can almost effortlessly find the facts for yourself...

ext.ext_cn: 他的对手抛出精确的资料和数据，使他难以招架。
ext.ext_en: His opponent swamped him with facts and figures...

defs.def_en: Facts are pieces of information that can be discovered.

defs.def_cn: 确切地说;事实上;恰恰相反

ext.ext_cn: 这并不那么困难，实际上，容易得很。
ext.ext_en: It's not that difficult. As a matter of fact, it's quite easy...

ext.ext_cn: “我想你还没吃吧？”“正好相反，我已经吃了。”亨特说道。
ext.ext_en: 'I guess you haven't eaten yet.' — 'As a matter of fact, I have,' said Hunter.

defs.def_en: You use as a matter of fact to introduce a statement that gives more details about what has just been said, or an explanation of it, or something that contrasts with it.

defs.def_cn: (强调对真实性确信无疑)确确实实，的的确确

ext.ext_cn: 我知道玉米笋在欧洲的确价格不菲。
ext.ext_en: I know for a fact that baby corn is very expensive in Europe...

ext.ext_cn: 我知道格雷厄姆确实与艾伦保持着密切的联系。
ext.ext_en: I know for a fact that Graham has kept in close touch with Alan.

defs.def_en: If you say that you know something for a fact, you are emphasizing that you are completely certain that it is true.

defs.def_cn: (用于引出对所说重点的概括或陈述，或引起注意)总而言之，最重要的是，关键是

ext.ext_cn: 实际上，失明并没有妨碍这些孩子去做健全孩子喜欢做的事情。
ext.ext_en: The fact is blindness hadn't stopped the children doing many of the things that sighted children enjoy...

ext.ext_cn: 关键是奖学金有限。
ext.ext_en: The fact of the matter is that student finances are stretched.

defs.def_en: You use the fact is or the fact of the matter is to introduce and draw attention to a summary or statement of the most important point about what you have been saying.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调必须接受某种情况)必须承认，无可否认

ext.ext_cn: 必须承认，无论怎么衡量，通货膨胀率都高得难以接受。
ext.ext_en: The fact remains that inflation, however you measure it, is unacceptably high...

ext.ext_cn: 他的崇拜者称他的上台是完全合法的，但必须承认，他是利用了一次非法事件上台的。
ext.ext_en: His admirers claim that he came to power perfectly legally, but the fact remains that he did so by exploiting an illegal situation.

defs.def_en: You say the fact remains that something is the case when you want to emphasize that the situation must be accepted.

defs.def_cn: (用以强调所说内容的真实性或正确性)事实就是如此，本来就是这样，说得一点不错

ext.ext_cn: 我们作为一个球队打得并不好，事实就是如此。
ext.ext_en: We aren't playing well as a team, and that's a fact...

ext.ext_cn: 他写的东西很没意思，真的。
ext.ext_en: He is a dull writer and that's a fact.

defs.def_en: You say and that's a fact to emphasize the truth or correctness of a statement that you have just made.

ext.ext_cn: “我还是参谋上校。”——“不会吧？”
ext.ext_en: 'I'm still staff colonel.' — 'Is that a fact?'

defs.def_en: You say is that a fact? as a response to a statement which you find surprising, interesting, or unlikely.

ext.ext_cn: 开赛时间是1点30分。
ext.ext_en: The kick-off is at 1.30.

defs.def_en: In football, the kick-off is the time at which a particular game starts.
In American football, a kickoff is the kick that begins a play, for example at the beginning of a half or after a touchdown or field goal.

ext.ext_cn: 人们站着等候游行的开始。
ext.ext_en: People stood waiting for the kick-off of the parade.

defs.def_en: The kick-off of an event or activity is its beginning.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 警觉的；警惕的；留神的；机敏的

ext.ext_cn: 我们大家都必须保持警惕。
ext.ext_en: We all have to stay alert...

ext.ext_cn: 一个警觉的邻居发现了他。
ext.ext_en: He had been spotted by an alert neighbour.

defs.def_en: If you are alert, you are paying full attention to things around you and are able to deal with anything that might happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 充分意识到…的;完全感觉到…的

ext.ext_cn: 银行充分意识到了危险。
ext.ext_en: The bank is alert to the danger.

defs.def_en: If you are alert to something, you are fully aware of it.

ext.ext_cn: 由于安全戒备的原因，该次列车在“牛津街口广场”站将不停留。
ext.ext_en: Due to a security alert, this train will not be stopping at Oxford Circus.

defs.def_en: An alert is a situation in which people prepare themselves for something dangerous that might happen soon.

defs.def_cn: 向…报警；使警觉；使警惕；使注意

ext.ext_cn: 他想提醒人们小心该团体的活动。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to alert people to the activities of the group...

ext.ext_cn: 我当时希望他会报警。
ext.ext_en: I was hoping he'd alert the police.

defs.def_en: If you alert someone to a situation, especially a dangerous or unpleasant situation, you tell them about it.

defs.def_cn: 处于警戒状态;保持戒备

ext.ext_cn: 士兵和警方都已进入警戒状态。
ext.ext_en: Soldiers and police have been put on alert.

defs.def_en: If soldiers or police are on alert, they are ready to deal with anything that may happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望随时掌握有关类似购买机会的信息。
ext.ext_en: They want to be on the alert for similar buying opportunities.

defs.def_en: If you are on the alert for something, you are ready to deal with it if it happens.

ext.ext_cn: 患白化病的兔子
ext.ext_en: ...an albino rabbit.

ext.ext_cn: 患白化病的兔子
ext.ext_en: ...an albino rabbit.

defs.def_en: An albino is a person or animal with very white skin, white hair, and pink eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 我两边各有一个穿卡其布服装的人。
ext.ext_en: On each side of me was a figure in khaki.

defs.def_en: Khaki is a strong material of a greenish brown colour, used especially to make uniforms for soldiers.

ext.ext_cn: 他穿着暗绿色的裤子。
ext.ext_en: He was dressed in khaki trousers.

defs.def_en: Something that is khaki is greenish brown in colour.

defs.def_cn: 麦芽酒（一种酒精含量较高的啤酒）

ext.ext_cn: 我们可供选择的麦芽酒和烈性酒
ext.ext_en: ...our selection of ales and spirits.

defs.def_en: See also:ginger ale;real ale;Ale is a kind of strong beer.

defs.def_cn: 阿米巴，变形虫（单细胞生物）
defs.def_en: An amoeba is the smallest kind of living creature. Amoebae consist of only one cell, and are found in water or soil.

defs.def_cn: （尤指度假的费用或价格）无所不包的，包括一切的

ext.ext_cn: 为期两周、包括所有费用的度假大约每人花费880英镑。
ext.ext_en: An all-inclusive two-week holiday costs around £880 per person.

defs.def_en: All-inclusive is used to indicate that a price, especially the price of a holiday, includes all the charges and all the services offered.

defs.def_cn: （旧时英国的）少年犯管教所，少年犯教养院
defs.def_en: In Britain in the past, an approved school was a boarding school where young people could be sent to stay if they had been found guilty of a crime.

ext.ext_cn: 卧室是他的一方净土。
ext.ext_en: His bedroom's his inner sanctum.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's inner sanctum, you mean a room which is private and sometimes secret, where they can be quiet and alone.
A sanctum is the holiest place inside a holy building such as a temple or mosque.
A bar graph is the same as a bar chart .
A playschool is an informal type of school for very young children where they learn things by playing.
In mathematics, a prime number is a whole number greater than 1 that cannot be divided exactly by any whole number except itself and the number 1, for example 17.

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦劳埃德保险社的经营者昨天受到了严厉批评。
ext.ext_en: The people who run Lloyd's of London took a pasting yesterday.

ext.ext_cn: 那部电影受到的严厉批评
ext.ext_en: ...the critical pasting that the film received.

defs.def_en: If something or someone takes a pasting, they are severely criticized.
If a sports team or political party is given a pasting, they are heavily defeated.

defs.def_cn: 有因果关系的;存在因果联系的

ext.ext_cn: 罗林斯强调无法证明这种药物和多起死亡事件之间存在因果关系。
ext.ext_en: Rawlins stresses that it is impossible to prove a causal link between the drug and the deaths...

ext.ext_cn: 他倒是十分想揭示文化与帝国主义之间的因果联系，可是却无能为力。
ext.ext_en: He would dearly love to show a causal relationship between culture and imperialism, but cannot.

defs.def_en: If there is a causal relationship between two things, one thing is responsible for causing the other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 她一改朴素简约的装饰风格，将自己家里布置得温暖舒适，色彩温馨。
ext.ext_en: In her own home, she replaced austere minimalism with cosy warmth and colour.

defs.def_en: Minimalism is a style in which a small number of very simple things are used to create a particular effect.

ext.ext_cn: 去年，这个集团的纯利润率为30%。
ext.ext_en: The group had a net profit margin of 30% last year.

defs.def_en: A profit margin is the difference between the selling price of a product and the cost of producing and marketing it.

ext.ext_cn: 你得接受一年两次的例行检查。
ext.ext_en: You will need to have a routine biannual examination.

defs.def_en: A biannual event happens twice a year.

defs.def_cn: (政府)财政的;国库的;(尤指)税收的

ext.ext_cn: 在1987 年，当时政府紧缩财政政策
ext.ext_en: ...in 1987, when the government tightened fiscal policy.

defs.def_en: Fiscal is used to describe something that relates to government money or public money, especially taxes.
A vet is someone who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals.

ext.ext_cn: 波士顿的新英格兰收容所将为200名老兵提供圣诞晚餐。
ext.ext_en: The New England Shelter in Boston will serve Christmas dinner for 200 vets...

ext.ext_cn: 这三位都是越战老兵。
ext.ext_en: All three are Vietnam vets.

defs.def_en: A vet is someone who has served in the armed forces of their country, especially during a war.

ext.ext_cn: 他找不到任何要求研究成果在发表前需经审查的规定。
ext.ext_en: He can find no trace of a rule requiring research to be vetted before publication...

ext.ext_cn: 所有物品都交由一个著名的专家小组检查鉴定。
ext.ext_en: All objects are vetted by a distinguished panel of experts...

defs.def_en: If something is vetted, it is checked carefully to make sure that it  is acceptable to people in authority.

defs.def_cn: （尤指对将要从事涉及军事或政治机密工作人员的）调查，审查，考查

ext.ext_cn: 她在为我工作以前曾受到过秘密考查。
ext.ext_en: She was secretly vetted before she ever undertook any work for me...

ext.ext_cn: 那些与皇室成员结婚的人未来将受到更细致的调查。
ext.ext_en: People who marry into the Royal Family will have to be vetted much more carefully in future.

defs.def_en: If someone is vetted, they are investigated fully before being given a particular job, role, or position, especially one which involves military or political secrets.

defs.def_cn: （使）有一定减少;（使）有一定降低

ext.ext_cn: 我们正在想法控制管理成本。
ext.ext_en: We're trying to ratchet down the administrative costs...

defs.def_en: If something ratchets down or is ratcheted down, it decreases by a fixed amount or degree, and seems unlikely to increase again.

defs.def_cn: (用棉、丝或羊毛织的)绉布，绉绸

ext.ext_cn: 用强力绷带托住伤处。
ext.ext_en: Use a crepe bandage to support the affected area.

defs.def_en: Crepe is a thin fabric with an uneven surface and is made of cotton, silk, or wool.

ext.ext_cn: 薄煎饼鸡肉卷
ext.ext_en: ...chicken-filled crepes.

defs.def_en: A crepe is a thin pancake .

ext.ext_cn: 一双绉胶底的短靴
ext.ext_en: ...a pair of crepe-soled ankle-boots.

defs.def_en: Crepe is a type of rubber with a rough surface.

defs.def_cn: （马克思主义理论中的）资产阶级

ext.ext_cn: 资产阶级对无产阶级的压迫
ext.ext_en: ...the suppression of the proletariat by the bourgeoisie.

defs.def_en: See also:petit bourgeoisie;In Marxist theory, the bourgeoisie are the middle-class people who own most of the wealth in a capitalist system.

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家被严重的经济问题所困扰。
ext.ext_en: The country is beset by severe economic problems.

ext.ext_cn: 讨论困难重重。
ext.ext_en: The discussions were beset with difficulties.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is beset by problems or fears, they have many problems or fears which affect them severely.

defs.def_cn: 单间附加费(一人住双人间时所付的额外费用)

ext.ext_cn: 你若同意合住双人房间就可以省下单间附加费了。
ext.ext_en: You can avoid the single supplement by agreeing to share a twin room.

defs.def_en: A single supplement is an additional sum of money that a hotel charges for one person to stay in a room meant for two people.

defs.def_cn: 急促不清地说；语无伦次地说

ext.ext_cn: 随着开演时间逼近，大家都紧张起来，慌里慌张地念着台词。
ext.ext_en: Everyone is gibbering insanely, nerves frayed as showtime approaches...

ext.ext_cn: 我到这时候说话已颠三倒四，神经高度紧张。
ext.ext_en: I was a gibbering wreck by this stage.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is gibbering, you mean that they are talking very fast and in a confused manner.

defs.def_cn: 超脱禅定（法）；超脱静坐(缩略形式为 TM)
defs.def_en: Transcendental meditation is a kind of meditation in which people mentally relax by silently repeating special words over and over again. The abbreviation TM is also used.
Your forename is your first name. Your forenames are your names other than your surname.

defs.def_cn: （通常在一周内分两至三集播完的）电视连续短片，迷你剧
defs.def_en: A mini-series is a drama shown on television in two or three parts, usually in one week.

ext.ext_cn: 已经冲击到该地区两个最大就业制造者的防御开支削减
ext.ext_en: ...the cuts in defence spending that have impinged on two of the region's largest employers.

defs.def_en: Something that impinges on you affects you to some extent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (表情、神态)调侃的，戏谑的，开玩笑的

ext.ext_cn: “可是我们现在玩得很开心，不是吗？”他戏谑地笑着抗议道。
ext.ext_en: 'But we're having such fun, aren't we?' he protested with a teasing smile...

ext.ext_cn: 史密斯完全是在开玩笑。
ext.ext_en: Smith was at his most teasing.

defs.def_en: A teasing expression or manner shows that the person is not completely serious about what they are saying or doing.

ext.ext_cn: 我挂断电话，开始哭了起来。
ext.ext_en: I hung up the phone and started to cry...

ext.ext_cn: 拜托不要哭。
ext.ext_en: Please don't cry...

defs.def_en: When you cry, tears come from your eyes, usually because you are unhappy or hurt.

ext.ext_cn: “南茜·朱尔，”她喊道，“你被捕了！”
ext.ext_en: 'Nancy Drew,' she cried, 'you're under arrest!'...

ext.ext_cn: 我叫道：“真是个好消息！”
ext.ext_en: I cried: 'It's wonderful news!'

defs.def_en: If you cry something, you shout it or say it loudly.

ext.ext_cn: 我吓得大叫了一声。
ext.ext_en: A cry of horror broke from me...

ext.ext_cn: 她哥哥认了出来，惊呼了一声。
ext.ext_en: Her brother gave a cry of recognition...

defs.def_en: A cry is a loud, high sound that you make when you feel a strong emotion such as fear, pain, or pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 成千上万的乌克兰人聚集在议会门前高喊“好啊”。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of Ukrainians burst into cries of 'bravo' on the steps of the parliament...

ext.ext_cn: 路过的人听到了他求救的呼喊。
ext.ext_en: Passers-by heard his cries for help.

defs.def_en: See also:battle cry;rallying cry;A cry is a shouted word or phrase, usually one that is intended to attract someone's attention.

ext.ext_cn: 这项开支遭到了一些人愤怒的指责。
ext.ext_en: There have been cries of outrage about this expenditure...

ext.ext_cn: 很多其他国家对他们的求助置若罔闻。
ext.ext_en: Many other countries have turned a deaf ear to their cries for help.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a public protest about something or an appeal for something as a cry of some kind.

defs.def_cn: (鸟的)鸣叫，啼叫;(动物的)嗥叫，吠

ext.ext_cn: 海鸥的鸣叫
ext.ext_en: ...the cry of a seagull.

defs.def_en: A bird's or animal's cry is the loud, high sound that it makes.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的生活与他那贫苦的童年生活相比大相径庭。
ext.ext_en: Their lives are a far cry from his own poor childhood.

defs.def_en: Something that is a far cry from something else is very different from it.

ext.ext_cn: 主要反对党已经对这起安全事故的错误处理进行了猛烈抨击。
ext.ext_en: The main opposition party is already in full cry over this mishandling of security.

defs.def_en: When someone is in full cry, they are expressing their views very strongly or are very active.

defs.def_cn: 天啊，哎呀，岂有此理(用来表示恼怒或不耐烦，或加强提问或请求的语气)

ext.ext_cn: 我的意思是，天啊，他一生中到底做过什么呀？
ext.ext_en: I mean, what's he ever done in his life, for crying out loud?

defs.def_en: You use the expression for crying out loud in order to show that you are annoyed or impatient, or to add force to a question or request.

defs.def_cn: 重新唤起;使再度复苏;再次引发

ext.ext_cn: 国王的立场必然会再次引发关于堕胎的令人头痛的辩论。
ext.ext_en: The King's stand is bound to reawaken the painful debate about abortion...

ext.ext_cn: 这种食物使他们再次想起母亲曾经做过的菜。
ext.ext_en: The food reawakens memories of dishes that their mothers once cooked.

defs.def_en: If something reawakens an issue, or an interest or feeling that you used to have, it makes you think about it or feel it again.

ext.ext_cn: 他患支气管炎卧病在床。
ext.ext_en: He was in bed with bronchitis.

defs.def_en: Bronchitis is an illness like a very bad cough, in which your bronchial tubes become sore and infected.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (态度、观点等)不明朗的;不表态的

ext.ext_cn: 霍尔先生并未明确说明开发公司已创造的岗位数量。
ext.ext_en: Mr Hall is non-committal about the number of jobs that the development corporation has created...

ext.ext_cn: 西尔维娅一脸不置可否。
ext.ext_en: Sylvia's face was noncommittal...

defs.def_en: You can describe someone as noncommittal when they deliberately do not express their opinion or intentions clearly.

ext.ext_cn: 这些柱子必须用混凝土固定。
ext.ext_en: The posts have to be set in concrete...

ext.ext_cn: 他们就躺在铺在混凝土地面上的睡袋上。
ext.ext_en: They had lain on sleeping bags on the concrete floor.

defs.def_en: Concrete is a substance used for building which is made by mixing together cement, sand, small stones, and water.

ext.ext_cn: 他只是把地面清理之后浇上了混凝土。
ext.ext_en: He merely cleared and concreted the floors.

defs.def_en: When you concrete something such as a path, you cover it with concrete.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他没有确凿的证据。
ext.ext_en: He had no concrete evidence...

ext.ext_cn: 没有具体的提议可供讨论。
ext.ext_en: There were no concrete proposals on the table...

defs.def_en: You use concrete to indicate that something is definite and specific.

ext.ext_cn: 用实物来教加减法
ext.ext_en: ...using concrete objects to teach addition and subtraction.

defs.def_en: A concrete object is a real, physical object.
A concrete noun is a noun that refers to a physical object rather than to a quality or idea.

ext.ext_cn: 正如布伦基特先生所强调的，一切都还没有定下来。
ext.ext_en: As Mr Blunkett emphasised, nothing is yet set in concrete.

defs.def_en: If a plan or idea is set in concrete or embedded in concrete, it is fixed and cannot be changed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那篇文章侮辱了英国公民家庭。
ext.ext_en: The article was insulting to the families of British citizens...

ext.ext_cn: 其中一名学徒对着一名路过的警官说了一句侮辱他的话。
ext.ext_en: One of the apprentices made an insulting remark to a passing officer.

defs.def_en: Something that is insulting is rude or offensive.

ext.ext_cn: 英语中 3 个常见的构句方法
ext.ext_en: ...three common syntactic devices in English.

defs.def_en: Syntactic means relating to syntax.

ext.ext_cn: 性情温和的斯坦利变了，成了充满信心、笑口常开的英雄。
ext.ext_en: Mild-mannered Stanley morphs into a confident, grinning hero.

defs.def_en: If one thing morphs into another thing, especially something very different, the first thing changes into the second.

ext.ext_cn: 所有的陈列室在开放时间都有工作人员。
ext.ext_en: All showrooms are staffed during business hours.

defs.def_en: Business hours are the hours of the day in which a shop or a company is open for business.
Your spinal column is your spine.

ext.ext_cn: 氮氧化物
ext.ext_en: ...nitrous oxides.

defs.def_en: Nitrous means coming from, relating to, or containing nitrogen.
A brasserie is a small and usually cheap restaurant or bar.

ext.ext_cn: 她纤细的长发在脑后梳成了马尾辫。
ext.ext_en: Her long, fine hair was swept back in a ponytail.

defs.def_en: A ponytail is a hairstyle in which someone's hair is tied up at the back of the head and hangs down like a tail.

ext.ext_cn: 我太依赖方便食品了。
ext.ext_en: I rely too much on convenience food.

defs.def_en: Convenience food is frozen, dried, or canned food that can be heated and prepared very quickly and easily.

ext.ext_cn: 小道越过一处傍树的大圆丘，然后沿着一条大路向前延伸。
ext.ext_en: The path goes over a large hump by a tree before running near a road.

defs.def_en: A hump is a small hill or raised area.

ext.ext_cn: 骆驼在自己的驼峰内重新贮备了脂肪。
ext.ext_en: Camels rebuild fat stores in their hump.

defs.def_en: A camel's hump is the large lump on its back.

defs.def_cn: （通常指人因疾病或年老形成的）驼背
defs.def_en: A hump is a large lump on a person's back, usually caused by illness or old age.

ext.ext_cn: 查利费力地将背包背到楼上自己的公寓里。
ext.ext_en: Charlie humped his rucksack up the stairs to his flat.

defs.def_en: If you hump something heavy, you carry it from one place to another with great difficulty.
To hump someone means to have sex with them.

ext.ext_cn: 如果他们输了，球迷便会很恼火。
ext.ext_en: Fans just get the hump when they lose.

defs.def_en: If someone gets the hump, they get very annoyed about something.

defs.def_cn: 已渡过难关;已克服困难;已解决麻烦

ext.ext_cn: 我们基本上渡过了难关。我们明年的经济增长速度甚至可能会超过1992年。
ext.ext_en: We're basically over the hump. We've got an economy that's likely to grow next year even more than it did in 1992.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are over the hump, you mean that you no longer have a problem or difficulty that was stopping you being successful or happy.

ext.ext_cn: 我唯一一次引起他们注意是我把全优成绩单带回家的时候。
ext.ext_en: The only time I got their attention was when I brought home straight A's on my report card.

defs.def_en: A report card is an official written account of how well or how badly a pupil has done during the term or year that has just finished.

ext.ext_cn: 总统今天发表了关于经济状况的最终报告。
ext.ext_en: The President today issued his final report card on the state of the economy.

defs.def_en: A report card is a report on how well a person, organization, or country has been doing recently.
A best seller is a book of which a great number of copies has been sold.

ext.ext_cn: 那个地带很快就从耕地变成了沙漠。
ext.ext_en: The terrain changed quickly from arable land to desert.

ext.ext_cn: 在崎岖不平的地势上拐了 1,200 个弯、长达 8 小时的冗长的长途汽车旅行
ext.ext_en: ...a tortuous eight-hour coach ride around 1,200 bends of rough terrain.

defs.def_en: Terrain is used to refer to an area of land or a type of land when you are considering its physical features.

defs.def_cn: 反对堕胎者；反对流产者

ext.ext_cn: 反堕胎者所作的加强法规的尝试失败了。
ext.ext_en: An attempt by anti-abortionists to tighten the rules was defeated.

defs.def_en: An anti-abortionist is someone who wants to limit or prevent the legal availability of abortions.

ext.ext_cn: 带上防水的衣服吧——奥克尼的天气可是变幻莫测的。
ext.ext_en: Take waterproof clothing — Orkney weather is unpredictable...

ext.ext_cn: 为了彻底防水，这些灯具均采用重型塑料制成。
ext.ext_en: Designed to be completely waterproof, the lights are manufactured from heavy duty plastic.

defs.def_en: Something which is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

ext.ext_cn: 为了不被淋湿，你需要在皮衣的外面套上一件轻便的防水服。
ext.ext_en: For staying dry you'll want nice lightweight waterproofs to wear over your leathers.

defs.def_en: Waterproofs are items of clothing which do not let water in.

ext.ext_cn: 整条船全部经过防水处理。
ext.ext_en: The whole boat has been totally waterproofed...

ext.ext_cn: 防水纤维短裤比塑料短裤贵多了。
ext.ext_en: Waterproofed fabric pants are more expensive than plastic pants.

defs.def_en: If something is waterproofed, it is treated so that water cannot pass through it or damage it.

defs.def_cn: (尤指 16 至 19 世纪时贩卖非洲黑人的)奴隶买卖,奴隶贸易

ext.ext_cn: 从贩奴贸易中得到的利益
ext.ext_en: ...profits from the slave trade.

defs.def_en: The slave trade is the buying and selling of slaves, especially Black Africans, from the 16th to the 19th centuries.

ext.ext_cn: 没有他我们肯定彻底玩完了。
ext.ext_en: Without him we'd be well and truly sunk.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is sunk, you mean that they have no hope of avoiding trouble or failure.

ext.ext_cn: 他不再去听那些讲座完全是出于厌倦。
ext.ext_en: He had given up attending lectures out of sheer boredom...

ext.ext_cn: 他们发现自己常常是为了打发飞行途中的无聊才开始聊天。
ext.ext_en: They often find they begin to chat to relieve the boredom of the flight.

defs.def_en: Boredom is the state of being bored.

ext.ext_cn: 他终于在针对每场新的政治变革的反应中发现了与大多数德国人的本能反应相吻合的一种。
ext.ext_en: He has managed to find a response to each new political development that chimes in with most Germans' instinct...

ext.ext_cn: 总统发表的讲话和美英政治家所说的不完全一致。
ext.ext_en: The president's remarks do not entirely chime with those coming from American and British politicians.

defs.def_en: If one thing chimes in with another thing or chimes with it, the two things are similar or consistent with each other.

ext.ext_cn: 该部门负责提供家庭护理服务。
ext.ext_en: The department is responsible for the provision of residential care services.

ext.ext_cn: 为有特殊需要的儿童提供护理
ext.ext_en: ...nursery provision for children with special needs.

defs.def_en: The provision of something is the act of giving it or making it available to people who need or want it.

defs.def_cn: 预备；准备；预先采取的措施

ext.ext_cn: 金先生问她是否曾想过要为自己的养老金预先作安排。
ext.ext_en: Mr King asked if it had ever occurred to her to make provision for her own pension...

ext.ext_cn: 没有为与业绩挂钩的加薪预作资金准备。
ext.ext_en: There is no provision for funding performance-related pay rises.

defs.def_en: If you make provision for something that might happen or that might need to be done, you make arrangements to deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 应给孩子在经济上专门作好安排。
ext.ext_en: Special provision should be made for children...

ext.ext_cn: 这位母亲在物质上得到了很好的赡养。
ext.ext_en: There are very generous provisions for the mother.

defs.def_en: If you make provision for someone, you support them financially and make sure that they have the things that they need.

defs.def_cn: （法律或协议的）条文，条款，规定

ext.ext_cn: 他赞成一项允许法官在一些情况下延迟作出离婚判决的法律条款。
ext.ext_en: He backed a provision that would allow judges to delay granting a divorce decree in some cases...

ext.ext_cn: 该法案关于土地买卖的规定遭到保守派的强硬反对。
ext.ext_en: The bill's provision for the sale and purchase of land faces stiff opposition from conservatives.

defs.def_en: A provision in a law or an agreement is an arrangement which is included in it.

ext.ext_cn: 船上有足够两周吃的食物。
ext.ext_en: On board were enough provisions for two weeks.

defs.def_en: Provisions are supplies of food.
Toxicology is the study of poisons.
Psychiatry is the branch of medicine concerned with the treatment of mental illness.

defs.def_cn: 使原形毕露;抓住…的短处

ext.ext_cn: 侦探们跟踪了他几个月，希望能当场抓住他行骗。
ext.ext_en: Detectives followed him for months hoping to catch him out in some deception...

ext.ext_cn: 他不喜欢在细节上被人抓住把柄。
ext.ext_en: He did not like to be caught out on details...

defs.def_en: To catch someone out means to cause them to make a mistake that reveals that they are lying about something, do not know something, or cannot do something.

defs.def_cn: 奉承话；花言巧语；甜言蜜语

ext.ext_cn: 起初，刘易斯并没有听信他们的甜言蜜语。
ext.ext_en: At first Lewis resisted their blandishments.

defs.def_en: Blandishments are pleasant things that someone says to another person in order to persuade them to do something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不起作用的;徒劳无益的

ext.ext_cn: 市长打击毒品的努力未见成效。
ext.ext_en: The mayor had become ineffectual in the struggle to clamp down on drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 过去的一些出发点很好但却无成效的就业计划
ext.ext_en: ...the well-meaning but ineffectual jobs programs of the past.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is ineffectual, they fail to do what they are expected to do or are trying to do.

ext.ext_cn: 教会不应与政治结盟。
ext.ext_en: The church should have no political alignment...

ext.ext_cn: 与里根政府日益紧密的关系差点让他失去了连任的机会。
ext.ext_en: His increasing alignment with the Reagan administration nearly cost him re-election.

defs.def_en: An alignment is support for a particular group, especially in politics, or for a side in a quarrel or struggle.

ext.ext_cn: 校正望远镜中的镜片
ext.ext_en: ...the alignment of mirrors in the telescope.

defs.def_en: The alignment of something is its position in relation to something else or to its correct position.

ext.ext_cn: 他因有外遇而要面临纪律听证会的裁决。
ext.ext_en: He will now face a disciplinary hearing for having an affair...

ext.ext_cn: 他对没有任何纪律惩罚而心生不满。
ext.ext_en: He was unhappy that no disciplinary action was being taken.

defs.def_en: Disciplinary bodies or actions are concerned with making sure that people obey rules or regulations and that they are punished if they do not.
In chemistry, the periodic table is a table showing the chemical elements arranged according to their atomic numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 威胁从未加剧，因此我们没有必要真采取什么对策。
ext.ext_en: Because the threat never developed, we didn't need to take any real countermeasures.

defs.def_en: A counter-measure is an action that you take in order to weaken the effect of another action or a situation, or to make it harmless.

ext.ext_cn: 摄政公园
ext.ext_en: ...Regent's Park...

ext.ext_cn: 牵着狗在公园里轻快地散步
ext.ext_en: ...a brisk walk with the dog around the park...

ext.ext_en: You're going to be a very rich man...

ext.ext_en: Their one aim in life is to get rich...

defs.def_en: A rich person has a lot of money or valuable possessions.

ext.ext_en: An Olympic gold medal can lead to untold riches for an athlete...

ext.ext_en: Some people want fame or riches — I just wanted a baby.

defs.def_en: Riches are valuable possessions or large amounts of money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 世界上很多地方，甚至在富有的国家里，都有人忍饥挨饿。
ext.ext_en: There is hunger in many parts of the world, even in rich countries.

defs.def_en: A rich country has a strong economy and produces a lot of wealth, so many people who live there have a high standard of living.

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯丰富的自然资源
ext.ext_en: ...Russia's vast natural riches.

ext.ext_cn: 中东的石油资源
ext.ext_en: ...the oil riches of the Middle East.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the earth's riches, you are referring to things that exist naturally in large quantities and that are useful and valuable, for example minerals, wood, and oil.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 肝脏和肾脏的维生素A含量尤其丰富。
ext.ext_en: Liver and kidney are particularly rich in vitamin A...

ext.ext_cn: 鱼肉富含蛋白质。
ext.ext_en: Fish is a rich source of protein.

defs.def_en: If something is rich in a useful or valuable substance or is a rich source of it, it contains a lot of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 加斯科涅丰盛而油腻的食物
ext.ext_en: ...the hearty, rich foods of Gascony...

ext.ext_cn: 再加奶油会让它过于油腻。
ext.ext_en: Additional cream would make it too rich.

defs.def_en: Rich food contains a lot of fat or oil.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 农民们在肥沃的土地上种植稻子。
ext.ext_en: Farmers grow rice in the rich soil.

defs.def_en: Rich soil contains large amounts of substances that make it good for growing crops or flowers in.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家丰富的锂金属矿藏
ext.ext_en: ...the country's rich deposits of the metal, lithium.

defs.def_en: A rich deposit of a mineral or other substance is a large amount of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 充满（幽默感、创意等）的;（信息）丰富的

ext.ext_cn: 导演发现了一个丰富的情感源泉。
ext.ext_en: The director discovered a rich vein of sentimentality...

ext.ext_cn: 我收藏的维多利亚时代的文学作品竟成了一个资源丰富的信息宝库，而且内容常常令人捧腹。
ext.ext_en: My collection of Victorian literature turned out to be a rich and often hilarious source of information.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a rich vein or source of something such as humour, ideas, or information, you mean that it can provide a lot of that thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (气味)浓郁的，香浓的;(颜色)浓艳的，强烈的，鲜艳的;（声音）低沉的，浑厚的

ext.ext_cn: 香味浓郁的沐浴香精
ext.ext_en: ...a rich and luxuriously perfumed bath essence.

ext.ext_cn: 迷人而富有光泽的艳红色
ext.ext_en: ...an attractive, glossy rich red colour.

defs.def_en: Rich smells are strong and very pleasant. Rich colours and sounds are deep and very pleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 丰富多样的文化生活对这对夫妇而言至关重要。
ext.ext_en: A rich and varied cultural life is essential for this couple.

ext.ext_cn: 这个岛屿灿烂的历史
ext.ext_en: ...the rich history of the island...

defs.def_en: A rich life or history is one that is interesting because it is full of different events and activities.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (收藏或混合物)丰富的，各种各样的

ext.ext_cn: 游客们可以看到一系列各种各样、色彩斑斓的水生动植物。
ext.ext_en: Visitors can view a rich and colorful array of aquatic plants and animals...

ext.ext_cn: 澳大利亚拥有丰富多样的文化。
ext.ext_en: Australia has a rich cultural mix.

defs.def_en: A rich collection or mixture contains a wide and interesting variety of different things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不合情理的;荒谬的;荒唐的

ext.ext_cn: 吉尔说女人不能保守秘密。这话从他这样一个整天打小报告的人嘴里说出来真是太荒谬了。
ext.ext_en: Gil says that women can't keep secrets. That's rich, coming from him, the professional sneak.

defs.def_en: If you say that something a person says or does is rich, you are making fun of it because you think it is a surprising and inappropriate thing for them to say or do.

ext.ext_cn: 他现在已经有几个臭钱了，但仍然和以前一样没什么才能。
ext.ext_en: He's stinking rich, and with no more talent than he ever had before.

ext.ext_cn: 少数几个每年只工作8个月的腰缠万贯的年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...a handful of filthy rich young men who work eight months a year.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is filthy rich or stinking rich, you disapprove of them because they have a lot of money.
Pliers are a tool with two handles at one end and two hard, flat, metal parts at the other. Pliers are used for holding or pulling out things such as nails, or for bending or cutting wire.
A binder is a hard cover with metal rings inside, which is used to hold loose pieces of paper.

defs.def_cn: 作为理想的做法;合乎理想地

ext.ext_cn: 理想情况下，人们应食用比现在少得多的脂肪。
ext.ext_en: People should, ideally, eat much less fat.

defs.def_en: If you say that ideally a particular thing should happen or be done, you mean that this is what you would like to happen or be done, but you know that this is may not be possible or practical.

defs.def_cn: 最适合地;绝好地;完美地

ext.ext_cn: 他们是极其幸福、无比般配的一对。
ext.ext_en: They were an extremely happy couple, ideally suited...

ext.ext_cn: 宾馆坐落的位置非常适合乡间散步。
ext.ext_en: The hotel is ideally situated for country walks...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is ideally suited, ideally located, or ideally qualified, you mean that they are as well suited, located, or qualified as they could possibly be.

ext.ext_cn: 总统号召教育家和政治家们帮助他重新调整美国的教育体系。
ext.ext_en: The President called on educators and politicians to help him restructure American education...

ext.ext_cn: 我怎样才能开始调整自己的生活，让自己更快乐一些？
ext.ext_en: How can I begin to restructure my life so that I'm happier with it?

defs.def_en: To restructure an organization or system means to change the way it is organized, usually in order to make it work more effectively.
A hot-air balloon is a large balloon with a basket underneath in which people can travel. The balloon is filled with hot air in order to make it float in the air.
The South Pole is the place on the surface of the earth which is farthest towards the south.

ext.ext_cn: 球员可以给烤菜豆做广告，但不能代言橄榄球靴。
ext.ext_en: The players can advertise baked beans, but not rugby boots...

ext.ext_cn: 1991年，这座房子登广告出售，售价为49,000美元。
ext.ext_en: In 1991, the house was advertised for sale at $49,000...

defs.def_en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

defs.def_cn: （在报纸、电视、公告栏上）登广告招募，登广告征求

ext.ext_cn: 我们在一家地方报纸上刊登了招聘广告。
ext.ext_en: We advertised for staff in a local newspaper...

ext.ext_cn: 我将登广告寻人和我同去。
ext.ext_en: I shall advertise for someone to go with me.

defs.def_en: If you advertise for someone to do something for you, for example to work for you or share your accommodation, you announce it in a newspaper, on television, or on a notice board.

defs.def_cn: （通过外表或行为）显示（某种特质）；使变得显眼

ext.ext_cn: 他健硕的身体使他显得意志尤为坚强。
ext.ext_en: His hard sinewy body advertised his ruthlessness of purpose.

defs.def_en: If someone or something advertises a particular quality, they show it in their appearance or behaviour.

defs.def_cn: 宣扬；张扬；引起对…的注意

ext.ext_cn: 没有必要张扬你是一个单身女性。
ext.ext_en: There is no need to advertise the fact that you are a single woman...

ext.ext_cn: 我不想宣扬他没有开车送我去机场的事。
ext.ext_en: I didn't want to advertise the fact that he hadn't driven me to the airport.

defs.def_en: See also:advertising;If you do not advertise the fact that something is the case, you try not to let other people know about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他又矮又胖，挺着个大啤酒肚。
ext.ext_en: He was short and fat, with a large beer belly.

defs.def_en: If a man has a beer belly, he has a fat stomach because of drinking too much beer.
A loudspeaker is a piece of equipment, for example part of a radio or hi-fi system, through which sound comes out.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Construction remains a relatively labour-intensive industry.

defs.def_en: Labour-intensive industries or methods of making things involve a lot of workers.

ext.ext_cn: 邮票册
ext.ext_en: ...a book of stamps...
