ext.ext_en: It's FREEPOST, so there's  no need for a stamp.

defs.def_en: See also:food stamp;A stamp or a postage stamp is a small piece of paper which you lick and stick on an envelope or package before you post it to pay for the cost of the postage.

ext.ext_cn: 日期章和印台
ext.ext_en: ...a date stamp and an ink pad...

ext.ext_cn: 你只能在你护照上盖的印记所规定的地点居住。
ext.ext_en: You may live only where the stamp in your passport says you may.

defs.def_en: A stamp is a small block of wood or metal which has a pattern or a group of letters on one side. You press it onto an pad of ink and then onto a piece of paper in order to produce a mark on the paper. The mark that you produce is also called a stamp .

ext.ext_cn: 汽车制造商在新车的好几处地方打上车辆识别号码，以便于追查被偷车辆。
ext.ext_en: Car manufacturers stamp a vehicle identification number at several places on new cars to help track down stolen vehicles...

ext.ext_cn: 在百货公司里,凡是已经兑换的礼券都会在上面盖上将其注销的商店的详细信息。
ext.ext_en: In a department store when a gift voucher is exchanged it's stamped with the details of the store to cancel it...

defs.def_en: If you stamp a mark or word on an object, you press the mark or word onto the object using a stamp or other device.

ext.ext_cn: 他经常和我开玩笑，直到我生气地跺脚尖叫，却又无可奈何。
ext.ext_en: Often he teased me till my temper went and I stamped and screamed, feeling furiously helpless...

ext.ext_cn: 他一脚踩下油门。
ext.ext_en: His foot stamped down on the accelerator...

defs.def_en: If you stamp or stamp your foot, you lift your foot and put it down very hard on the ground, for example because you are angry or because your feet are cold.

ext.ext_cn: “我要走了，省得看见事情变得更糟！”他大叫着，噔噔地走出了卧室。
ext.ext_en: 'I'm going before things get any worse!' he shouted as he stamped out of the bedroom...

ext.ext_cn: 她很胖，在潮湿的天气里浑身大汗，烦躁地在各个房间之间噔噔地走来走去。
ext.ext_en: Overweight and sweating in the humid weather, she stamped from room to room.

defs.def_en: If you stamp somewhere, you walk there putting your feet down very hard on the ground because you are angry.

ext.ext_cn: 他在超级杯决赛中踩踏裁判的脚后，于上周收到了书面的禁赛通知。
ext.ext_en: He received the original ban last week after stamping on the referee's foot during the supercup final.

defs.def_en: If you stamp on something, you put your foot down on it very hard.

ext.ext_cn: 显然多年来一直受到精心照料的草地和花床
ext.ext_en: ...lawns and flowerbeds that bore the stamp of years of confident care...

ext.ext_cn: 我们大多数人都想把自己的家装饰成一个温馨的地方，并在墙上展示自己的个性。
ext.ext_en: Most of us want to make our home a familiar place and put the stamp of our personality on its walls.

defs.def_en: If something bears the stamp of a particular quality or person, it clearly has that quality or was done by that person.

ext.ext_cn: 我和社会福利工作者及警方都谈过话——因此我便成了坏女人。
ext.ext_en: I talked to social workers and the police — that had stamped me as a bad woman...

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯·博德曼昨晚在巴塞罗那创下室外世界纪录，证明了自己是 4,000 米赛最有实力的竞争者。
ext.ext_en: Chris Boardman stamped himself as the 4,000m favourite by setting the world's fastest outdoor time in Barcelona last night.

defs.def_en: A quality, feature, or action that stamps someone or something as a particular thing shows clearly that they are this thing.
Someone who is smashed is extremely drunk.

ext.ext_cn: 体制中存在的缺陷为金融丑闻的出现提供了土壤。
ext.ext_en: Flaws in the system have created a breeding ground for financial scandals...

ext.ext_cn: 目前政治环境的动荡是消费者丧失信心的根本原因。
ext.ext_en: The current political turbulence represents the ideal breeding ground for this sort of collapse in consumer confidence.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a situation or place as a breeding ground for something bad such as crime, you mean that this thing can easily develop in that situation or place.

ext.ext_cn: 温牛奶是细菌理想的滋生地。
ext.ext_en: Warm milk is the ideal breeding ground for bacteria.

defs.def_en: The breeding ground for a particular type of creature is the place where this creature breeds easily.

defs.def_cn: 马来西亚的;马来西亚人的

ext.ext_cn: 马来西亚海岸
ext.ext_en: ...the Malaysian coast.

ext.ext_cn: 马来西亚学生
ext.ext_en: ...a Malaysian student.

defs.def_en: Something that is Malaysian belongs or relates to Malaysia or to its people.

ext.ext_cn: 他静静地坐着沉思。
ext.ext_en: He sat silently cogitating.

ext.ext_cn: 认真思考生命的意义
ext.ext_en: ...to cogitate on the meaning of life.

defs.def_en: If you are cogitating, you are thinking deeply about something.

ext.ext_cn: 潜水员向后翻身入水。
ext.ext_en: The diver flipped over backwards into the water...

ext.ext_cn: 他后退了两步。
ext.ext_en: He took two steps backward...

defs.def_en: If you move or look backwards, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing.

ext.ext_cn: 他把工序倒过来了，从上往下建房子。
ext.ext_en: He works backwards, building a house from the top downwards.

defs.def_en: If you do something backwards, you do it in the opposite way to the usual way.

ext.ext_cn: 政府加强对企业的干涉将是一种倒退。
ext.ext_en: Greater government intervention in businesses would represent a step backwards.

ext.ext_cn: 迫使我们时时后顾的责难
ext.ext_en: ...the blaming that keeps us looking backward.

defs.def_en: You use backwards to indicate that something changes or develops in a way that is not an improvement, but is a return to old ideas or methods.

ext.ext_cn: 将牙线在齿间来回拉动。
ext.ext_en: Draw the floss backwards and forwards between the teeth.

ext.ext_cn: 往返于伦敦的人
ext.ext_en: ...people travelling backwards and forwards to and from London.

defs.def_en: If someone or something moves backwards and forwards, they move repeatedly first in one direction and then in the opposite direction.

defs.def_cn: 熟知，对…了如指掌（美国英语中作know something backward and forward）

ext.ext_cn: 我问了一两样我感兴趣的东西，她的确都了如指掌。
ext.ext_en: I asked about one or two things that interest me and she really did know it all backwards.

defs.def_en: In British English, if you say that someone knows something backwards, you are emphasizing that they know it very well. In American English, you say that someone knows something backward and forward .

ext.ext_cn: 在此类情况下需要对形势有一个冷静的评估。
ext.ext_en: What is needed in such cases is a calm appraisal of the situation...

ext.ext_cn: 进行自我评价向来很难。
ext.ext_en: Self-appraisal is never easy.

defs.def_en: If you make an appraisal of something, you consider it carefully and form an opinion about it.

defs.def_cn: （官方或正式的常带考核性质的）评定，评价

ext.ext_cn: 职员问题应该通过培训和考核评定来解决。
ext.ext_en: Staff problems should be addressed through training and appraisals.

ext.ext_cn: 对你的财务状况的评估
ext.ext_en: ...an appraisal of your financial standing.

defs.def_en: Appraisal is the official or formal assessment of the strengths and weaknesses of someone or something. Appraisal often involves observation or some kind of testing.

defs.def_cn: 居第二位的;次于最好的

ext.ext_cn: 他穿上了自己那套第二好的西装。
ext.ext_en: He put on his second best suit...

ext.ext_cn: 我们把自己次好的靴子擦亮后穿上了。
ext.ext_en: We polished and wore our second-best boots.

defs.def_en: Second best is used to describe something that is not as good as the best thing of its kind but is better than all the other things of that kind.

ext.ext_cn: 一个复杂混乱的二流解决方案
ext.ext_en: ...a messy, second-best solution...

ext.ext_cn: 他拒绝退而求其次。
ext.ext_en: He refused to settle for anything that was second best.

defs.def_en: You can use second best to describe something that you have to accept even though you would have preferred something else.

ext.ext_cn: 过去，许多对发展中国家的援助计划没有得到合理实施。
ext.ext_en: Many of the aid projects in the developing world have been misdirected in the past.

defs.def_en: If resources or efforts are misdirected, they are used in the wrong way or for the wrong purposes.

defs.def_cn: 将…引错方向;给…指错方向

ext.ext_cn: 他故意给记者们指错方向。
ext.ext_en: He had deliberately misdirected the reporters.

defs.def_en: If you misdirect someone, you send them in the wrong direction.

defs.def_cn: (娱乐圈、体育明星等的)复出，东山再起

ext.ext_cn: 60年代的歌星佩杜拉·克拉克复出了。
ext.ext_en: Sixties singing star Petula Clark is making a comeback.

defs.def_en: If someone such as an entertainer or sports personality makes a comeback, they return to their profession or sport after a period away.

ext.ext_cn: 紧身T恤再度流行起来。
ext.ext_en: Tight fitting T-shirts are making a comeback.

defs.def_en: If something makes a comeback, it becomes fashionable again.

defs.def_cn: 因受到伤害而追究他人的责任
defs.def_en: If you have no comeback when someone has done something wrong to you, there is nothing you can do to have them punished or held responsible.

ext.ext_cn: 中期经济前景仍然黯淡。
ext.ext_en: The medium-term economic prospects remained poor...

ext.ext_cn: 如果一个女人放弃工作去照看宝宝，她不但将面临在中期内领不到薪水的危险，而且有可能严重影响她事业的长期发展。
ext.ext_en: If a woman gives up her job to look after her baby, she will risk losing her salary in the medium-term and may seriously damage her long-term career prospects.

defs.def_en: The medium-term is the period of time which lasts a few months or years beyond the present time, in contrast with the short term or the long term.

defs.def_cn: (加在名词后构成其他名词)表示“…观察”，“…研究”

ext.ext_cn: 观鲸业已经成为一个快速发展的休闲产业。
ext.ext_en: Whale-watching has become a growth leisure industry...

ext.ext_cn: 据说是他发明了观赏名人这项活动。
ext.ext_en: He is said to have invented the sport of celebrity-watching.

defs.def_en: -watching combines with nouns to form other nouns which refer to the activity of looking at a group of animals or people and studying them because they interest you.

ext.ext_cn: 炸猪排
ext.ext_en: ...fried pork chops.

ext.ext_cn: 一包猪肉香肠
ext.ext_en: ...a packet of pork sausages.

defs.def_en: Pork is meat from a pig, usually fresh and not smoked or salted.

defs.def_cn: 西番莲果；鸡蛋果；百香果
defs.def_en: A passion fruit is a small, round, brown fruit that is produced by certain types of tropical flower.

ext.ext_cn: 通过给高级议员发薪水而将地方政府职业化的可能性
ext.ext_en: ...the possibility of professionalising local government by offering salaries to senior councillors.

defs.def_en: To professionalize an organization, an institution, or an activity means to make it more professional, for example by paying the people who are involved in it.

ext.ext_cn: 倒一些糖浆进去，但别全倒，因为可能会溢出来。
ext.ext_en: Pour in some of the syrup, but not all of it, as it will probably overflow...

ext.ext_cn: 在许多地方，河流与小溪都已经决堤。
ext.ext_en: Rivers and streams have overflowed their banks in countless places.

defs.def_en: If a liquid or a river overflows, it flows over the edges of the container or place it is in.

ext.ext_cn: 大礼堂里挤满了人。
ext.ext_en: The great hall was overflowing with people...

ext.ext_cn: 监狱和临时拘留所里人满为患。
ext.ext_en: Jails and temporary detention camps are overflowing...

defs.def_en: If a place or container is overflowing with people or things, it is too full of them.

defs.def_cn: 洋溢着（情感）；（情感）溢于言表

ext.ext_cn: 肯尼思满怀友善好客之情。
ext.ext_en: Kenneth overflowed with friendliness and hospitality...

ext.ext_cn: 里德利终于按捺不住满腔的怒火。
ext.ext_en: Ridley's anger finally overflowed.

defs.def_en: If someone is overflowing with a feeling or if the feeling overflows, the person is experiencing it very strongly and shows this in their behaviour.

defs.def_cn: （过多而）容纳不下的人（或东西）

ext.ext_cn: 医院旁搭起了帐篷以安置容纳不下的人员。
ext.ext_en: Tents have been set up next to hospitals to handle the overflow...

ext.ext_cn: 溢出的湖水倾泻而下，形成了一座日式水景花园的瀑布。
ext.ext_en: The loch's overflow cascades into the waterfalls of a Japanese water garden.

defs.def_en: The overflow is the extra people or things that something cannot contain or deal with because it is not large enough.

ext.ext_cn: 溢流管
ext.ext_en: ...the overflow pipe.

defs.def_en: An overflow is a hole or pipe through which liquid can flow out of a container when it gets too full.

ext.ext_cn: 家庭菜园里种满了新鲜蔬菜。
ext.ext_en: The kitchen garden was full to overflowing with fresh vegetables...

ext.ext_cn: 他是为数不多的课堂场场爆满的老师之一。
ext.ext_en: He was one of the few teachers who always filled the lecture room to overflowing.

defs.def_en: If a place or container is filled to overflowing, it is so full of people or things that no more can fit in.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 尽管财政部部长采取了一系列果决措施，通货膨胀率还是涨到了36%。
ext.ext_en: Despite valiant efforts by the finance minister, inflation rose to 36%.

ext.ext_cn: 为把生意维持下去而作的勇敢尝试
ext.ext_en: ...a valiant attempt to keep the business going.

defs.def_en: A valiant action is very brave and determined, though it may lead to failure or defeat.

ext.ext_cn: 眼中的异物
ext.ext_en: ...a foreign body in the eye.

defs.def_en: A foreign body is an object that has come into something else, usually by accident, and should not be in it.

defs.def_cn: 万圣节前夕（10月31日晚，传说此时可见鬼巫。当晚儿童常化装成鬼巫尽情玩闹）

ext.ext_cn: 他执意要她来劳福德参加万圣节聚会。
ext.ext_en: He had insisted that she come up to Lawford for the Halloween party.

defs.def_en: Halloween is the night of the 31st of October and is traditionally said to be the time when ghosts and witches can be seen. On Halloween, children often dress up as ghosts and witches.
A pathologist is someone who studies or investigates diseases and illnesses, and examines dead bodies in order to find out the cause of death.

defs.def_cn: （职场上）激烈的竞争，你死我活的竞争

ext.ext_cn: 我得从疯狂的竞争中解脱出来，重新审视真实的世界。
ext.ext_en: I had to get out of the rat race and take a look at the real world again.

defs.def_en: If you talk about getting out of the rat race, you mean leaving a job or way of life in which people compete aggressively with each other to be successful.

ext.ext_cn: 他拒绝降低对这起丑闻的调查力度。
ext.ext_en: He refused to soft-pedal an investigation into the scandal.

defs.def_en: If you soft-pedal something, you deliberately reduce the amount of activity or pressure that you have been using to get something done or seen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 产生相反效果的;事与愿违的;适得其反的

ext.ext_cn: 然而，实际上这种态度只会适得其反。
ext.ext_en: In practice, however, such an attitude is counter-productive...

ext.ext_cn: 以盛气凌人的语气同面试者讲话将会适得其反。
ext.ext_en: It is counter-productive to address an interviewee in patronizing tones.

defs.def_en: Something that is counter-productive achieves the opposite result from the one that you want to achieve.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于修饰体育活动或体育比赛代表队）大学的

ext.ext_cn: 学校没有给她们与男生同样多的参加大学体育活动的机会。
ext.ext_en: The school has not given them the same opportunities to participate in varsity sports that men receive.

defs.def_en: People sometimes use varsity to describe things that relate to universities, especially sports activities or teams at a university or competitions between universities.

ext.ext_cn: 自从加入校队后，她每年都能参加季后赛。
ext.ext_en: She has been in the playoffs every year since she made the varsity...

ext.ext_cn: 肖恩·麦卡利斯特也为校篮球队效过力。
ext.ext_en: Shaun McCalister also played for the varsity basketball team.

defs.def_en: The varsity is the main or first team for a particular sport  at a high school, college, or university.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 忠实的;忠诚的;忠贞不渝的

ext.ext_cn: 她一直信守承诺，保守着这个秘密。
ext.ext_en: She had been faithful to her promise to guard this secret...

ext.ext_cn: 较年长的美国人是这个国家最忠实的选民群体之一。
ext.ext_en: Older Americans are among this country's most faithful voters.

defs.def_en: Someone who is faithful to a person, organization, idea, or activity remains firm in their belief in them or support for them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (对丈夫、妻子或恋人)忠诚的，忠贞的

ext.ext_cn: 她坚持说自己对丈夫一直是忠诚的。
ext.ext_en: She insisted that she had remained faithful to her husband...

ext.ext_cn: 我爱一个人是会非常忠贞的。
ext.ext_en: I'm very faithful when I love someone.

defs.def_en: Someone who is faithful to their husband, wife, or lover does not have a sexual relationship with anyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 那时，信徒们尊他为先知。
ext.ext_en: The faithful revered him then as a prophet.

defs.def_en: The faithful are the group of people who believe in a particular religion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (叙述、翻译或抄本)如实的，忠实原文的

ext.ext_cn: 科林·韦兰的电影剧本忠实于原小说。
ext.ext_en: Colin Welland's screenplay is faithful to the novel.

ext.ext_cn: 19世纪中期家庭用品的逼真仿制品
ext.ext_en: ...faithful copies of household items used in the mid-1800s.

defs.def_en: A faithful account, translation, or copy of something represents or reproduces the original accurately.

defs.def_cn: (尤指值得信赖的)旧有物品，老牌产品

ext.ext_cn: 我们测试了各种真空吸尘器，从值得信赖的老牌子到有着最新特色的产品，不一而足。
ext.ext_en: We tested a selection of vacuum cleaners, from old faithfuls to those with the latest features.

defs.def_en: You can refer to something that has been used or has existed for a long time as an old faithful, especially when it is something you can rely on.
A snail is a small animal with a long, soft body, no legs, and a spiral-shaped shell. Snails move very slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 火车这会儿走得跟蜗牛一样慢。
ext.ext_en: The train was moving now at a snail's pace...

ext.ext_cn: 今年第一季度经济增速缓慢。
ext.ext_en: The economy grew at a snail's pace in the first three months of this year.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something at a snail's pace, you are emphasizing that they are doing it very slowly, usually when you think it would be better if they did it much more quickly.
A systems analyst is someone whose job is to decide what computer equipment and software a company needs, and to provide it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不仁慈的；不友善的；不厚道的；刻薄的

ext.ext_cn: 去年整个夏天他都对她很恶劣。
ext.ext_en: All last summer he'd been unkind to her...

ext.ext_cn: 所有人说起他来都没有一句坏话。
ext.ext_en: No one has an unkind word to say about him...

defs.def_en: If someone is unkind, they behave in an unpleasant, unfriendly, or slightly cruel way. You can also describe someone's words or actions as unkind .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 坏天气对上午那些风笛吹奏者毫不容情。
ext.ext_en: The weather was unkind to those pipers who played in the morning.

ext.ext_cn: 彼此坚信是无情的命运或机缘让他们一再错过
ext.ext_en: ...a shared conviction that some unkind fate or chance is keeping them apart.

defs.def_en: If you describe something bad that happens to someone as unkind, you mean that they do not deserve it.
A reception room is a room in a house, for example a living room, where people can sit. This expression is often used in descriptions of houses that are for sale.
In recipes, tbsp. is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) tablespoonful .

ext.ext_cn: 我转了一下门把手，发现门开着。
ext.ext_en: I turned the handle and found the door was open.

defs.def_en: A handle is a small round object or a lever that is attached to a door and is used for opening and closing it.

ext.ext_cn: 一个板球拍柄从他的胳肢窝下面伸了出来。
ext.ext_en: The handle of a cricket bat protruded from under his arm.

ext.ext_cn: 扫帚柄
ext.ext_en: ...a broom handle.

defs.def_en: A handle is the part of an object such as a tool, bag, or cup that you hold in order to be able to pick up and use the object.

defs.def_cn: 有能力应付;（成功地）处理

ext.ext_cn: 说实话，我不知道自己是否能做好这份工作。
ext.ext_en: To tell the truth, I don't know if I can handle the job...

ext.ext_cn: 她承受不了压力。
ext.ext_en: She cannot handle pressure...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone can handle a problem or situation, you mean that they have the ability to deal with it successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得和西格尔先生会谈我可能会搞得一团糟。
ext.ext_en: I think I would handle a meeting with Mr. Siegel very badly...

ext.ext_cn: 她心里承认自己不知道该如何处理这个问题。
ext.ext_en: She admitted to herself she didn't know how to handle the problem.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the way that someone handles a problem or situation, you mention whether or not they are successful in achieving the result they want.

ext.ext_cn: 她负责了总统竞选活动期间新闻报道团的行程安排。
ext.ext_en: She handled travel arrangements for the press corps during the presidential campaign...

ext.ext_cn: 调查由伦敦警察厅反恐部门负责。
ext.ext_en: The investigation is being handled by Scotland Yard's anti-terrorist branch.

defs.def_en: If you handle a particular area of work, you have responsibility for it.

defs.def_cn: 使用，操纵（武器、车辆等）;训练，使唤（动物）

ext.ext_cn: 我从未用过自动手枪。
ext.ext_en: I had never handled an automatic.

defs.def_en: When you handle something such as a weapon, vehicle, or animal, you use it or control it, especially by using your hands.

ext.ext_cn: 他的船操纵起来非常灵便。
ext.ext_en: His ship had handled like a dream!

defs.def_en: If something such as a vehicle handles well, it is easy to use or control.

ext.ext_cn: 清理猫粪时要带上橡胶手套。
ext.ext_en: Wear rubber gloves when handling cat litter.

defs.def_en: When you handle something, you hold it or move it with your hands.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦了解了自己焦虑的原因，你就开始能控制它了。
ext.ext_en: When you have got a handle on your anxiety you can begin to control it.

defs.def_en: If you have a handle on a subject or problem, you have a way of approaching it that helps you to understand it or deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 他为一点小事就大发脾气。
ext.ext_en: He flew off the handle at the slightest thing.

defs.def_en: If you fly off the handle, you suddenly and completely lose your temper.

ext.ext_cn: 一名政府官员透露他们已被列入一份秘密黑名单。
ext.ext_en: A government official disclosed that they were on a secret blacklist...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数信贷机构都有一份为期15年的黑名单，以有效阻止破产者得到贷款。
ext.ext_en: Most credit agencies run a 15-year blacklist effectively barring bankrupts from receiving credit.

defs.def_en: If someone is on a blacklist, they are seen by a government or other organization as being one of a number of people who cannot be trusted or who have done something wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 他自从1969年因持有大麻而被定罪后就被列入了黑名单。
ext.ext_en: He has been blacklisted since being convicted of possessing marijuana in 1969.

ext.ext_cn: 列入黑名单的机场的完整清单
ext.ext_en: ...the full list of blacklisted airports.

defs.def_en: If someone is blacklisted by a government or organization, they are put on a blacklist.

ext.ext_cn: 伊里安查亚，印度尼西亚最东边的省
ext.ext_en: ...Irian Jaya, the easternmost province of Indonesia.

defs.def_en: The easternmost part of an area or the easternmost place is the one that is farthest towards the east.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 看着不可靠的;狡诈的;鬼鬼祟祟的

ext.ext_cn: 他看起来贼眉鼠眼，而且有犯罪前科。
ext.ext_en: He had a shifty face and previous convictions.

defs.def_en: Someone who looks shifty gives the impression of being dishonest.

ext.ext_cn: 我们有两个全职秘书，其中一人是临时从皇家海军调来的。
ext.ext_en: We have two full-time secretaries, one of whom is on secondment from the Royal Navy.

defs.def_en: Someone who is on secondment from their normal employer has been sent somewhere else temporarily in order to do special duties.
A stalagmite is a long piece of rock which sticks up from the floor of a cave. Stalagmites are formed by the slow dropping of water containing the mineral lime.
A rickshaw is a simple vehicle that is used in Asia for carrying passengers. Some rickshaws are pulled by a man who walks or runs in front.

ext.ext_cn: 16票赞成、3票反对、1票弃权
ext.ext_en: ...a vote of sixteen in favor, three against, and one abstention...

ext.ext_cn: 弃权票数很可能起决定性作用。
ext.ext_en: The number of abstentions is likely to be crucial...

defs.def_en: Abstention is a formal act of not voting either for or against a proposal.

ext.ext_cn: 目标是彻底戒绝所有致幻物质。
ext.ext_en: The goal is complete abstention from all mind-altering substances.

defs.def_en: Abstention is the same as abstinence.
In a game or sport, your team-mates are the other members of your team.

ext.ext_cn: 真的，我只在晚上抽烟。
ext.ext_en: Seriously, I only smoke in the evenings.

defs.def_en: You use seriously to indicate that you are not joking and that you really mean what you say.

defs.def_cn: (用以询问对方的话是否是认真的)当真,真的.

ext.ext_cn: “我在杂货店里试图跟他搭讪来着。”他笑着说。“真的?”
ext.ext_en: 'I tried to chat him up at the general store.' He laughed. 'Seriously?'

defs.def_en: You say 'seriously' when you are surprised by what someone has said, as a way of asking them if they really mean it.

defs.def_cn: 认真对待;把…看得很重要

ext.ext_cn: 他们穿着帅气的灰色制服时，很难对他们郑重其事起来。
ext.ext_en: It's hard to take them seriously in their pretty grey uniforms...

ext.ext_cn: 此话不必当真。
ext.ext_en: The phrase was not meant to be taken seriously.

defs.def_en: If you take someone or something seriously, you believe that they are important and deserve attention.

defs.def_cn: （在语言或风俗习惯方面）使英语化，使英国化

ext.ext_cn: 他已将他的姓氏英语化了。
ext.ext_en: He had anglicized his surname...

ext.ext_cn: 荷兰殖民统治在19世纪结束时，文职部门已被英国化了。
ext.ext_en: When Dutch colonial rule ended in the 19th century the civil service was anglicised.

defs.def_en: If you anglicize something, you change it so that it resembles or becomes part of the English language or English culture.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 纽曼阴险得很，明里一套，暗里一套。
ext.ext_en: Newman was devious, prepared to say one thing in print and another in private...

ext.ext_cn: 她通过不正当的手段追查到了另外那个女人。
ext.ext_en: By devious means she tracked down the other woman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as devious you do not like them because you think they are are dishonest and like to keep things secret, often in a complicated way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他走了一条迂回路线。
ext.ext_en: He followed a devious route.

defs.def_en: A devious route or path to a place involves many changes in direction, rather than being as straight and direct as possible.
A brolly is the same as an umbrella .

ext.ext_cn: 恫吓将迫使他们把兵力铺得更广。
ext.ext_en: The threat will force greater dispersion of their forces.

defs.def_en: Dispersion is the spreading of people or things over a wide area.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 毁灭性的;极具破坏力的

ext.ext_cn: 奥马克城受到了狂风和灾难性洪水的猛烈袭击。
ext.ext_en: The city of Ormac took the full force of the winds and devastating floods...

ext.ext_cn: 婚外情确实会对婚姻造成毁灭性的影响。
ext.ext_en: Affairs do have a devastating effect on marriages.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as devastating, you are emphasizing that it is very harmful or damaging.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人极为震惊的;使人极度不安的;可怕的

ext.ext_cn: 诊断结果令人震惊：她得了癌症。
ext.ext_en: The diagnosis was devastating. She had cancer.

defs.def_en: You can use devastating to emphasize that something is very shocking, upsetting, or terrible.

defs.def_cn: 极其引人注目的;令人印象深刻的

ext.ext_cn: 令人难忘的骑马飞奔和跳跃表演
ext.ext_en: ...a devastating display of galloping and jumping...

ext.ext_cn: 如果让我来说的话，我真是棒极了。
ext.ext_en: I was devastating, if I do say so myself.

defs.def_en: You can use devastating to emphasize that something or someone is very impressive.

ext.ext_cn: 我们去了罗马。
ext.ext_en: We went to Rome...

ext.ext_cn: 格拉迪丝刚进厨房。
ext.ext_en: Gladys had just gone into the kitchen...

defs.def_en: When you go somewhere, you move or travel there.

ext.ext_cn: 我们走吧。
ext.ext_en: Let's go...

ext.ext_cn: 她明天走。
ext.ext_en: She's  going tomorrow.

defs.def_en: When you go, you leave the place where you are.

ext.ext_cn: 我们很早就去游泳了。
ext.ext_en: We went swimming very early...

ext.ext_cn: 或许他们刚去购物了。
ext.ext_en: Maybe they've just gone shopping...

defs.def_en: You use go to say that someone leaves the place where they are and does an activity, often a leisure activity.

defs.def_cn: 去做…（可用go to do, 也可用go and do，美国英语中还可用go do，然而一般说 went and did）

ext.ext_cn: 他的二儿子帕迪去加拿大生活了。
ext.ext_en: His second son, Paddy, had gone to live in Canada...

ext.ext_cn: 我一定要去看这部电影。
ext.ext_en: I must go and see this film...

defs.def_en: When you go to do something, you move to a place in order to do it and you do it. You can also go and do something, and in American English, you can go do something. However, you always say that someone went and did something.

ext.ext_cn: 她将不得不去上学。
ext.ext_en: She will have to go to school...

ext.ext_cn: 他的儿子上了美国的一所顶级大学。
ext.ext_en: His son went to a top university in America.

defs.def_en: If you go to school, work, or church, you attend it regularly as part of your normal life.

ext.ext_cn: 有一条山路从布莱尔斯敦通向米尔布鲁克村。
ext.ext_en: There's a mountain road that goes from Blairstown to Millbrook Village.

defs.def_en: When you say where a road or path goes, you are saying where it begins or ends, or what places it is in.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定表达中，表示对所提到行为不赞成或不允许某人有这种行为）

ext.ext_cn: 用不着她一来电话你就往楼上跑。
ext.ext_en: You don't have to go running upstairs every time she rings...

ext.ext_cn: 别觉得是你的错。
ext.ext_en: Don't you go thinking it was your fault.

defs.def_en: You can use go in expressions such as 'don't go telling everybody', in order to express disapproval of the kind of behaviour you mention, or to tell someone not to behave in that way.

defs.def_cn: （与further,beyond等词连用，表示某事的进展或程度）

ext.ext_cn: 他在大会发言中作了更进一步的阐述。
ext.ext_en: He went even further in his speech to the conference...

ext.ext_cn: 一些物理学家竟然提出整个宇宙就像一台巨型计算机。
ext.ext_en: Some physicists have gone so far as to suggest that the entire Universe is a sort of gigantic computer.

defs.def_en: You can use go with words like 'further' and 'beyond' to show the degree or extent of something.

ext.ext_cn: 这几周过得真快！
ext.ext_en: The weeks go so quickly!

defs.def_en: If you say that a period of time goes quickly or slowly, you mean that it seems to pass quickly or slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 我的钱大部分用来支付各种账单。
ext.ext_en: Most of my money goes on bills...

ext.ext_cn: 这笔钱将用于由更广泛的社会群体所选出的项目。
ext.ext_en: The money goes to projects chosen by the wider community.

defs.def_en: If you say where money goes, you are saying what it is spent on.

ext.ext_cn: 很大一部分功劳应归于主席和他的父亲。
ext.ext_en: A lot of credit must go to the chairman and his father...

ext.ext_cn: 尤里·斯科科夫得到了这份工作，他是一位能干的管理人员。
ext.ext_en: The job went to Yuri Skokov, a capable administrator.

defs.def_en: If you say that something goes to someone, you mean that it is given to them.

defs.def_cn: 上，参加（电视或电台节目）

ext.ext_cn: 土耳其总统上电视为严格的新安全措施进行辩护。
ext.ext_en: The Turkish president has gone on television to defend stringent new security measures...

ext.ext_cn: 我们上了7点30分进行的现场直播。
ext.ext_en: We went on the air, live, at 7.30.

defs.def_en: If someone goes on television or radio, they take part in a television or radio programme.

ext.ext_cn: 现在出口协会担心将失去10万个工作机会。
ext.ext_en: The Institute of Export now fears that 100,000 jobs will go...

ext.ext_cn: 如果人们坚决抵制这项税收，它的废止就仅仅是个时间问题。
ext.ext_en: If people stand firm against the tax, it is only a matter of time before it has to go.

defs.def_en: If something goes, someone gets rid of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他犯了一个让他颜面尽失的战术错误，只得引咎辞职。
ext.ext_en: He had made a humiliating tactical error and he had to go.

defs.def_en: If someone goes, they leave their job, usually because they are forced to.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都爱吃的菜肴里所放入的十分有趣的原料
ext.ext_en: ...the really interesting ingredients that go into the dishes that we all love to eat.

defs.def_en: If something goes into something else, it is put in it as one of the parts or elements that form it.

ext.ext_cn: 他想将它从这个洞里推过去，但却怎么也过不去。
ext.ext_en: He was trying to push it through the hole and it wouldn't go.

ext.ext_cn: 这个拉手要装在这里。
ext.ext_en: ...This knob goes here.

defs.def_en: If something goes in a particular place, it fits in that place or should be put there because it is the right size or shape.

ext.ext_cn: 鞋子放在鞋架上。
ext.ext_en: The shoes go on the shoe shelf...

ext.ext_cn: “东西都到哪儿去了？”
ext.ext_en: 'Where does everything go?'

defs.def_en: If something goes in a particular place, it belongs there or should be put there, because that is where you normally keep it.

ext.ext_en: Six goes into thirty five times.

defs.def_en: If you say that one number goes into another number a particular number of times, you are dividing the second number by the first.

ext.ext_cn: 他的视力在下降，他说自己得了青光眼。
ext.ext_en: His eyes are going; he says he has glaucoma...

ext.ext_cn: 他近来老犯错误，胆子也开始变小了。
ext.ext_en: Lately he'd been making mistakes; his nerve was beginning to go.

defs.def_en: If one of a person's senses, such as their sight or hearing, is going, it is getting weak and they may soon lose it completely.

defs.def_cn: （灯泡、引擎等)损坏，报废，无法正常运转

ext.ext_cn: 我看电池好像该换了。
ext.ext_en: I thought it looked as though the battery was going.

defs.def_en: If something such as a light bulb or a part of an engine is going, it is no longer working properly and will soon need to be replaced.

ext.ext_cn: “还有希望吗？”——“没有，他已经死了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Any hope?' — 'No, he's gone.'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is going or has gone, you are saying in an indirect way that they are dying or are dead.

ext.ext_cn: 我开始秃头了。
ext.ext_en: I'm going bald...

ext.ext_cn: 你最好趁热给他们端上桌。
ext.ext_en: You'd better serve it to them before it goes cold...

defs.def_en: You can use go to say that a person or thing changes to another state or condition. For example, if someone goes crazy, they become crazy, and if something goes green, it changes colour and becomes green.

ext.ext_cn: 这个小宝贝光着身子在沙滩上。
ext.ext_en: The baby went naked on the beach...

ext.ext_cn: 但是，如果你给警察配备武器，难道不会出现更多配备武器的罪犯吗？
ext.ext_en: But if you arm the police won't more criminals go armed?

defs.def_en: You can use go when indicating whether or not someone wears or has something. For example, if someone goes barefoot, they do not wear any shoes.

defs.def_cn: （用在以un开头的形容词之前表示某事没有发生）

ext.ext_cn: 他以总统的名义宣称没有对任何暴行置若罔闻。
ext.ext_en: As President, he affirmed that no tyranny went unnoticed.

defs.def_en: You can use go before adjectives beginning with 'un-' to say that something does not happen. For example, if something goes unheard, nobody hears it.

ext.ext_cn: 她说一切进展顺利。
ext.ext_en: She says everything is going smoothly...

ext.ext_cn: 你去理发店理得还算满意吗？
ext.ext_en: How did it go at the hairdresser's?

defs.def_en: You use go to talk about the way something happens. For example, if an event or situation goes well, it is successful.

ext.ext_cn: 我的复印机怎么样了？你能把它修好吗？
ext.ext_en: What about my copier? Can you get it going again?...

ext.ext_cn: 我说：“我的车在雾天里没法开。”
ext.ext_en: I said, 'My car won't  go in fog'.

defs.def_en: If a machine or device is going, it is working.

ext.ext_cn: 课间休息铃响了。
ext.ext_en: The bell went for the break.

defs.def_en: If a bell goes, it makes a noise, usually as a signal for you to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 我在找一副跟我的新礼服相配的灰色手套。
ext.ext_en: I was searching for a pair of grey gloves to go with my new gown...

ext.ext_cn: 我看得出来有些颜色相配，有些却不协调。
ext.ext_en: I can see that some colours go together and some don't...

defs.def_en: If something goes with something else, or if two things go together, they look or taste nice together.

ext.ext_cn: 据说她那天晚上跟他一起回了家。
ext.ext_en: The story goes that she went home with him that night...

ext.ext_cn: 事情据说是这样的。
ext.ext_en: The story goes like this...

defs.def_en: You use go to introduce something you are quoting. For example, you say the story goes or the argument goes just before you quote all or part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她在一幅狗的画像前停下来，开始“汪汪”地学起狗叫来。
ext.ext_en: She stopped in front of a painting of a dog and she started going 'woof woof'...

ext.ext_cn: 他牛仔服上的纽扣发出“啪”的响声。
ext.ext_en: The button on his jeans went POP.

defs.def_en: You use go when indicating that something makes or produces a sound. For example, if you say that something goes 'bang', you mean it produces the sound 'bang'.

defs.def_cn: 说（代替say，表示引述他人的话或认为他们要说的话）

ext.ext_cn: 他们说：“汤姆，你闭嘴！”我说：“才不呢，你们闭嘴！”
ext.ext_en: They say 'Tom, shut up' and I go 'No, you shut up'...

ext.ext_cn: 他问我：“哦，你想要什么？”
ext.ext_en: He goes to me: 'Oh, what do you want?'

defs.def_en: You can use go instead of 'say' when you are quoting what someone has said or what you think they will say.

ext.ext_cn: 我一直都想试试踢足球。
ext.ext_en: I always wanted to have a go at football...

ext.ext_cn: 她第一次尝试就赢了。
ext.ext_en: She won on her first go...

defs.def_en: A go is an attempt at doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 我落后你两步，但现在轮到你走了。
ext.ext_en: I'm two behind you but it's your go...

ext.ext_cn: 现在轮到谁了？
ext.ext_en: Now whose go is it?

defs.def_en: If it is your go in a game, it is your turn to do something, for example to play a card or move a piece.

defs.def_cn: 全力以赴；不遗余力地做

ext.ext_cn: 他们将尽最大努力实现自己的愿望。
ext.ext_en: They will go all out to get exactly what they want...

ext.ext_cn: 他们准备全力以赴，夺取下赛季的超级联赛冠军。
ext.ext_en: They're  ready to go all out for the Premier League title next season.

defs.def_en: If you go all out to do something or go all out for something, you make the greatest possible effort to do it or get it.

defs.def_cn: 干（或说）什么都行；什么事都不新鲜

ext.ext_cn: 在90年代几乎无奇不有。
ext.ext_en: In the 90s, almost anything goes.

defs.def_en: If people say 'anything goes', they mean that anything people say or do is considered acceptable, and usually they mean that they do not approve of this.

defs.def_cn: 与同类的事物相比/跟其他小孩相比

ext.ext_cn: 同其他同类情况相比，这件事还算简单。
ext.ext_en: This is a straightforward case, as these things go...

ext.ext_cn: 与其他小男孩相比，他挺好相处。
ext.ext_en: He's  good company, as small boys go.

defs.def_en: You use expressions like as things go  or as children go when you are describing one person or thing and comparing them with others of the same kind.

ext.ext_cn: 学会如何为人父母需要时间，这种技能只能边经历边学习。
ext.ext_en: Learning how to become a parent takes time. It's a skill you learn as you go along.

defs.def_en: If you do something as you go along, you do it while you are doing another thing, without preparing it beforehand.

ext.ext_cn: 噢，他又干傻事了，是吧？
ext.ext_en: Well, he's gone and done it again, hasn't he?...

ext.ext_cn: 总有人干这种没头没脑的事，把你的事情全弄砸。
ext.ext_en: Somebody goes and does something mindless like that and just destroys everything for you.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has gone and done something, you are expressing your annoyance at the foolish thing they have done.
You say 'Go for it' to encourage someone to increase their efforts to achieve or win something.

ext.ext_cn: 一些人因为此事攻击我们，这使我们更加气愤。
ext.ext_en: Some people had a go at us for it, which made us more angry.

defs.def_en: If someone has a go at you, they criticize you, often in a way that you feel is unfair.
If someone says 'Where do we go from here?' they are asking what should be done next, usually because a problem has not been solved in a satisfactory way.

ext.ext_cn: 我知道我们能做成这件事并且会很开心。
ext.ext_en: I knew we could make a go of it and be happy.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is making a go of something such as a business or relationship, you mean that they are having some success with it.

ext.ext_cn: 我今年找了份新工作，一直忙得不可开交。
ext.ext_en: I got a new job this year where I am on the go all the time.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is always on the go, you mean that they are always busy and active.

ext.ext_cn: 你喜欢一次忙多个项目吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you like to have many projects on the go at any one time?

defs.def_en: If you have something on the go, you have started it and are busy doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 我还有5例手术要做。
ext.ext_en: I still had another five operations to go.

defs.def_en: If you say that there are a particular number of things to go, you mean that they still remain to be dealt with.

ext.ext_cn: 离选举还有一周的时间。
ext.ext_en: There is a week to go until the elections.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is a certain amount of time to go, you mean that there is that amount of time left before something happens or ends.

ext.ext_cn: 大份炸薯条带走。
ext.ext_en: Large fries to go.

defs.def_en: If you are in a café or restaurant and ask for an item of food to go, you mean that you want to take it away with you and not eat it there.
Durable goods or durables are goods such as televisions or cars which are expected to last a long time, and are bought infrequently.

defs.def_cn: 插入(或夹入、挤入)…之间的

ext.ext_cn: 厨房最初夹在早餐厅和厕所之间。
ext.ext_en: The original kitchen was sandwiched between the breakfast room and the toilet.

defs.def_en: See also:sandwich;If something is sandwiched between two other things, it is in a narrow space between them.
A bathtub is a long, usually rectangular container which you fill with water and sit in to wash your body.

ext.ext_cn: 我们每个人偶尔都会渴望有点变化。
ext.ext_en: From time to time we all get a hankering for something a little different...

ext.ext_cn: 你是否一直渴望成为一名演员？
ext.ext_en: Have you always had a hankering to be an actress?

defs.def_en: A hankering for something is a desire or longing for it.

defs.def_cn: 蹒跚行走;摇摇晃晃地行走

ext.ext_cn: 麦金尼斯吃力地从椅子上站起来，摇摇晃晃地走到了窗前。
ext.ext_en: McGinnis pushed himself laboriously out of the chair and waddled to the window...

ext.ext_cn: 傍晚时分，鸭子们摇摇摆摆地来到前门进食。
ext.ext_en: In the evenings, ducks waddle up to the front door to be fed.

defs.def_en: To waddle somewhere means to walk there with short, quick steps, swinging slightly from side to side. A person or animal that waddles usually has short legs and a fat body.

ext.ext_cn: 他们闲暇时就在格拉斯哥的阿盖尔街上演唱卖艺。
ext.ext_en: They spent their free time in Glasgow busking in Argyle Street.

defs.def_en: People who busk play music or sing for money in the streets or other public places.

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦幼儿园的分布非常不均衡。
ext.ext_en: The availability of nursery school places varies widely across London.

defs.def_en: A nursery school or a nursery is a school for very young children.

defs.def_cn: 无人地带;无人管辖地区

ext.ext_cn: 他带领巡逻队在图卜鲁格无人区巡逻时遭迫击炮弹击中身亡。
ext.ext_en: In Tobruk, leading a patrol in no-man's land, he was blown up by a mortar bomb.

ext.ext_cn: 约旦和伊拉克边境哨所之间的无人地带
ext.ext_en: ...the no-man's land between the Jordanian and Iraqi frontier posts.

defs.def_en: No-man's land is an area of land that is not owned or controlled by anyone, for example the area of land between two opposing armies.

defs.def_cn: 尚未确定的情况;中间状态

ext.ext_cn: 这部戏描写的是青年时期和青春期之间那段危险、暖昧的时光。
ext.ext_en: The play is set in the dangerous no-man's land between youth and adolescence...

ext.ext_cn: 失败使得工党内部的意识形态混乱局面进一步加剧。
ext.ext_en: The failure has helped to drive Labour even further into a no-man's land of ideological muddle.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a situation as a no-man's land between different things, you mean that it seems unclear because it does not fit into any of the categories.

ext.ext_cn: 星期四上午，政府官员视察地震灾区，以协调救援工作。
ext.ext_en: Government officials visited the earthquake zone on Thursday morning to co-ordinate the relief effort.

ext.ext_cn: 建立咨询委员会以协调警务工作
ext.ext_en: ...the setting up of an advisory committee to co-ordinate police work.

defs.def_en: If you co-ordinate an activity, you organize the various people and things involved in it.

ext.ext_cn: 她会教你如何搭配款式和颜色。
ext.ext_en: She'll show you how to co-ordinate pattern and colours...

ext.ext_cn: 系上与其他装饰相配的布质蝴蝶结。
ext.ext_en: Tie it with fabric bows that co-ordinate with other furnishings...

defs.def_en: If you co-ordinate clothes or furnishings that are used together, or if they co-ordinate, they are similar in some way and look nice together.

ext.ext_cn: 新的内衣套装
ext.ext_en: ...new lingerie co-ordinates.

defs.def_en: Co-ordinates are pieces of clothing or soft furnishings which are similar and which are intended to be worn or used together.

ext.ext_cn: 他们每年都花费几周的时间接受强化治疗，以使四肢能够更好地协调。
ext.ext_en: They spend several weeks each year undergoing intensive treatment which enables them to coordinate their limbs better.

defs.def_en: If you co-ordinate the different parts of your body, you make them work together efficiently to perform particular movements.

ext.ext_cn: 您能告诉我您的坐标吗？
ext.ext_en: Can you give me your co-ordinates?

ext.ext_cn: 世界各地的经纬坐标
ext.ext_en: ...the latitude and longitude co-ordinates of any location in the world.

defs.def_en: The co-ordinates of a point on a map or graph are the two sets of numbers or letters that you need in order to find that point.

defs.def_cn: (加在动词之前）表示“否定”，“相反”

ext.ext_cn: 对暴力的有害影响变得麻木
ext.ext_en: ...becoming desensitized to the harmful consequences of violence.

ext.ext_cn: 如何清除工业垃圾场的污染
ext.ext_en: ...how to decontaminate industrial waste sites.

defs.def_en: De- is added to a verb in order to change the meaning of the verb to its opposite.

defs.def_cn: (加在名词之前构成动词)表示“除去”，“除掉”

ext.ext_cn: 我已经给冷冻柜除过霜了。
ext.ext_en: I've defrosted the freezer...

ext.ext_cn: 这些火灾很可能会彻底毁掉这片土地上的森林。
ext.ext_en: The fires are likely to permanently deforest the land.

defs.def_en: De- is added to a noun in order to make it a verb referring to the removal of the thing described by the noun.

ext.ext_cn: 垂死的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a dying man.

ext.ext_cn: 到处都是死尸和奄奄一息的人。
ext.ext_en: The dead and the dying were everywhere.

defs.def_en: A dying person or animal is very ill and likely to die soon.

ext.ext_cn: 它将长存我心，直到生命的终点。
ext.ext_en: It'll stay in my mind till my dying day...

ext.ext_cn: 她不得不去实现她母亲的临终遗愿。
ext.ext_en: She was compelled to fulfil the dying wishes of her mother.

defs.def_en: You use dying to describe something which happens at the time when someone dies, or is connected with that time.

defs.def_cn: 行将结束的;最后时刻的;末期的

ext.ext_cn: 这些岛屿是在二战末期被苏联军队占领的。
ext.ext_en: The islands were seized by the Soviet army in the dying days of the second world war...

ext.ext_cn: 蒂里·拉克鲁瓦的点球在比赛结束前的最后时刻打破了僵局。
ext.ext_en: A penalty by Thierry Lacroix broke the deadlock in the dying minutes of the game.

defs.def_en: The dying days or dying minutes of a state of affairs or an activity are its last days or minutes.

ext.ext_cn: 造船业是夕阳产业。
ext.ext_en: Shipbuilding is a dying business.

defs.def_en: A dying tradition or industry is becoming less important and is likely to disappear completely.
A dying fire is no longer hot and bright and will not burn for much longer.

defs.def_cn: 出乎意料的；未预见到的

ext.ext_cn: 辐射可能以一种我们过去未能预见到的方式破坏细胞。
ext.ext_en: Radiation may damage cells in a way that was previously unforeseen...

ext.ext_cn: 遗憾的是，由于一些意外情况，今年的演出被取消了。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately, due to unforeseen circumstances, this year's show has been cancelled...

defs.def_en: If something that has happened was unforeseen, it was not expected to happen or known about beforehand.
If the air is windless, or if it is a windless day, it is very calm and still.

defs.def_cn: (通常指为检查是否携带毒品或武器而)对…进行裸体搜查

ext.ext_cn: 他们 23 个人均被裸体搜查，看是否携带毒品。
ext.ext_en: All 23 of them were strip-searched for drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 他们怀疑他可能携带武器，命令对其进行裸体搜查。
ext.ext_en: They suspected that he might be carrying a weapon and ordered a strip search.

defs.def_en: If a person is strip-searched, someone such as a police officer makes them take off all their clothes and searches them, usually to see if they are carrying drugs or weapons.
A windsurfer is a long narrow board with a sail attached to it. You stand on a windsurfer in the sea or on a lake and are blown along by the wind.
A windsurfer is a person who rides on a windsurfer.
A halibut is a large flat fish.

defs.def_cn: 国家元首（如总统、国王或女王）

ext.ext_cn: 一棵结方形苹果的树令专家大惑不解。
ext.ext_en: An apple tree producing square fruit is baffling experts.

defs.def_en: If something baffles you, you cannot understand it or explain it.
A stonemason is a person who is skilled at cutting and preparing stone so that it can be used for walls and buildings.

ext.ext_cn: 好在她没有受伤。
ext.ext_en: Thankfully, she was not injured...

ext.ext_cn: 幸运的是，第二天天亮时，风浪平静了些。
ext.ext_en: The next day dawned, thankfully with a drop in wind and waves.

defs.def_en: You use thankfully in order to express approval or happiness about a statement that you are making.

defs.def_cn: 未被提出的；未被问及的

ext.ext_cn: 她看上去营养不良，这一发现又引出了一个未被问及的问题。
ext.ext_en: She was undernourished, an observation that prompted yet another unasked question...

ext.ext_cn: 重大问题不会问到。
ext.ext_en: Significant questions will go unasked.

defs.def_en: An unasked question is one that has not been asked, although people are wondering what the answer is.

defs.def_cn: 未被要求的；未受邀请的；主动的

ext.ext_cn: 他主动给她提出的建议是呆在家里尽量做些事。
ext.ext_en: His advice, offered to her unasked, was to stay home and make the best of things.

defs.def_en: If someone says or does something unasked, they say or do it without being asked to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这种药物的禁忌证包括肝脏或肾脏损伤。
ext.ext_en: Contraindications for this drug include liver or kidney impairment.

defs.def_en: Contraindications are specific medical reasons for not using a particular treatment for a medical condition in the usual way.

defs.def_cn: (与动词连用构成否定句)不，非，没有

ext.ext_cn: 制裁没有发挥预期的作用。
ext.ext_en: The sanctions are not working the way they were intended...

ext.ext_cn: 当时我不在英国。
ext.ext_en: I was not in Britain at the time...

defs.def_en: You use not with verbs to form negative statements.

defs.def_cn: (构成期望得到肯定回答的疑问句)

ext.ext_cn: 难道他们那儿的问题还少吗？
ext.ext_en: Haven't they got enough problems there already?...

ext.ext_cn: 我在上周的聚会上见过你，对不对？
ext.ext_en: Didn't I see you at the party last week?...

defs.def_en: You use not to form questions to which you expect the answer 'yes'.

defs.def_cn: (通常以 n't 的形式出现在问句中，用于推断某人应已做某事或表示惊讶)

ext.ext_cn: 几个月以前你为什么不做呢？
ext.ext_en: Why didn't you do it months ago?...

ext.ext_cn: 他为什么不能听她的呢？
ext.ext_en: Why couldn't  he listen to her?...

defs.def_en: You use not, usually in the form n't, in questions which imply that someone should have done something, or to express surprise that something is not the case.

defs.def_cn: (通常用 n't 的形式，用于肯定陈述后的附加疑问句)是吗? 不是吗?

ext.ext_cn: “可这是一件漂亮的首饰，不是吗?”
ext.ext_en: 'It's a nice piece of jewellery though, isn't it?'...

ext.ext_cn: 我一直是个很不错的丈夫，不是吗？
ext.ext_en: I've been a great husband, haven't I?...

defs.def_en: You use not, usually in the form n't, in question tags after a positive statement.

defs.def_cn: (通常以 n't 的形式，表示礼貌的建议)

ext.ext_cn: 实际上我们的确在考虑一个职位，你先填一下我们的求职表好吗？
ext.ext_en: Actually we do have a position in mind. Why don't you fill out our application?...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不能用火车运过来吗？
ext.ext_en: Couldn't they send it by train?

defs.def_en: You use not, usually in the form n't, in polite suggestions.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示对刚提及的单词、词组或从句的否定)不，没有

ext.ext_cn: “你找到葆拉了吗？”——“很遗憾，没有，凯特。”
ext.ext_en: 'Have you found Paula?'—'I'm afraid not, Kate.'...

ext.ext_cn: 起先我真的不在乎他是否会来。
ext.ext_en: At first I really didn't care whether he came or not.

defs.def_en: You use not to represent the negative of a word, group, or clause that has just been used.

defs.def_cn: (用于 all 或 every 前，表示部分否定)并非，不是

ext.ext_cn: 说得好听些，不是所有的钱都花得是地方。
ext.ext_en: Not all the money, to put it mildly, has been used wisely...

ext.ext_cn: 不是所有的求职者都有学位。
ext.ext_en: Not every applicant had a degree.

defs.def_en: You can use not in front of 'all' or 'every' when you want to say something that applies only to some members of the group that you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 他并非在争辩中总是能赢，但他经常是对的。
ext.ext_en: He didn't always win the arguments, but he often was right...

ext.ext_cn: 她并不是总能请得起临时保姆。
ext.ext_en: She couldn't always afford a babysitter...

defs.def_en: If something is not always the case, you mean that sometimes it is the case and sometimes it is not.

defs.def_cn: (用于 a 或 one 前加强语气)(一个…)也不，(一个…)也没有

ext.ext_cn: 这些房子很漂亮，但周围没有商店，甚至连一个酒馆都没有。
ext.ext_en: The houses are beautiful, but there's no shop, not even a pub to go into...

ext.ext_cn: 我寄了一篇又一篇的报告，但一个字都没有发表。
ext.ext_en: I sent report after report. But not one word was published...

defs.def_en: You can use not or not even in front of 'a' or 'one' to emphasize that there is none at all of what is being mentioned.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示距离、时间或其他数量的词前)不到，少于

ext.ext_cn: 拖船擦着我们的船尾开了过去，距离不到50码。
ext.ext_en: The tug crossed our stern not fifty yards away...

ext.ext_cn: 不到10码远的地方有一大群等公共汽车的人
ext.ext_en: ...a large crowd not ten yards away waiting for a bus...

defs.def_en: You can use not in front of a word referring to a distance, length of time, or other amount to say that the actual distance, time, or amount is less than the one mentioned.

defs.def_cn: (用于对比真实和不真实的情况，尤用于可能使人产生误解的陈述)不是

ext.ext_cn: 他在这支亚洲球队中占有一席之地，不是因为他是白人，而是因为他确实出色。
ext.ext_en: He has his place in the Asian team not because he is white but because he is good...

ext.ext_cn: 培训是一种投资，而不是花费。
ext.ext_en: Training is an investment not a cost...

defs.def_en: You use not when you are contrasting something that is true with something that is untrue. You use this especially to indicate that people might think that the untrue statement is true.

defs.def_cn: (用于not only，not just, not simply 等短语中，强调某事物的真实性，但不是全部事实)

ext.ext_cn: 这些电影不仅赚钱，而且被视为具有原创性。
ext.ext_en: These movies were not only making money; they were also perceived to be original...

ext.ext_cn: 黑市一直存在，不只是在英国，整个欧洲也是。
ext.ext_en: There is always a 'black market' not just in Britain but in Europe as a whole...

defs.def_en: You use not in expressions such as 'not only', 'not just', and 'not simply' to emphasize that something is true, but it is not the whole truth.

defs.def_cn: (用于引出否定从句)并不是说，并非

ext.ext_cn: 我用一年时间慢慢接受了他去世的事实，但其实你永远不会真正完全忘掉。
ext.ext_en: His death took me a year to get over; not that you're ever really over it...

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆突然想到简是不是值得信任，并不是说他认为简有些热衷于政治。
ext.ext_en: It occurred to Tom to wonder whether Jane was quite trustworthy. Not that he thought she was in any way politically active.

defs.def_en: You use not that to introduce a negative clause that contradicts something that the previous statement implies.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示强调)一点不，根本没有

ext.ext_cn: “抱歉，我讲起话来像阿比，是不是？”——“不，一点不像。”
ext.ext_en: 'Sorry. I sound like Abby, don't I?' — 'No. Not at all.'...

ext.ext_cn: “你认为你没有背叛自己的国家。”——“我没有，根本没有。”
ext.ext_en: 'You don't  think that you've betrayed your country.' — 'No I don't. No, not at all.'

defs.def_en: Not at all is an emphatic way of saying 'No' or of agreeing that the answer to a question is 'No'.

ext.ext_cn: “非常感谢您能和我们交谈。”——“不客气。”
ext.ext_en: 'Thank you very much for speaking with us.' — 'Not at all.'

defs.def_en: Not at all is a polite way of acknowledging a person's thanks.

ext.ext_cn: 官方统计数字表明实际工资下降了 24%。
ext.ext_en: Official statistics show real wages declining by 24%...

ext.ext_cn: 关于阵亡人数没有可靠的统计数字。
ext.ext_en: There are no reliable statistics for the number of deaths in the battle.

defs.def_en: See also:vital statistics;Statistics are facts which are obtained from analysing information expressed in numbers, for example information about the number of times that something happens.

ext.ext_cn: 数学统计学教授
ext.ext_en: ...a professor of Mathematical Statistics.

defs.def_en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics concerned with the study of information that is expressed in numbers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 天真的;易信的;不切实际的

ext.ext_cn: 我无论如何也不能理解为什么一说起过去人们就会那么容易动情和伤感。
ext.ext_en: I can never understand why people become dewy-eyed and sentimental about the past.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is dewy-eyed, you are criticizing them because you think that they are unrealistic and think events and situations are better than they really are.
A doodad is the same as a doodah .

ext.ext_cn: 下一个财年的预算
ext.ext_en: ...the budget for the coming fiscal year.

defs.def_en: The fiscal year is the same as the financial year .

ext.ext_cn: 该中心已经成了许多人前来倾诉心事、谈论心中希望与忧惧的地方。
ext.ext_en: The Centre became a place where many came to unburden themselves, to talk about their hopes and fears...

ext.ext_cn: 不管怎样，他需要找个人倾诉一番，而这个人不可能是劳拉。
ext.ext_en: Somehow he had to unburden his soul to somebody, and it couldn't be to Laura...

defs.def_en: If you unburden yourself or your problems to someone, you tell them about something which you have been secretly worrying about.

defs.def_cn: (制作和修理木制轮子及手推车、马车、门等其他木制品的)轮匠
defs.def_en: A wheelwright is someone who makes and repairs wooden wheels and other wooden things such as carts, carriages, and gates.
A right-hand drive vehicle has its steering wheel on the right side. It is designed to be driven in countries such as Britain, Japan, and Australia where people drive on the left side of the road.

ext.ext_cn: 摩根建议的筹资方法均未奏效。
ext.ext_en: None of Morgan's proposed financings panned out.

defs.def_en: If something, for example a project or some information, pans out, it produces something useful or valuable.
A cottonwood or a cottonwood tree is a kind of tree that grows in North America and has seeds that are covered with hairs that look like cotton.

defs.def_cn: 性感的人;激起情欲的事物

ext.ext_cn: 他的情书貌似写得很火辣。
ext.ext_en: His love letters were hot stuff, apparently.

defs.def_en: If you think that someone or something is hot stuff, you find them exciting or sexually attractive.

defs.def_cn: 以色相诱骗他人钱财的人
defs.def_en: A gold-digger is a person who has a relationship with someone who is rich in order to get money or expensive things from them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以置信的;不像真实的

ext.ext_cn: 我得承认那听起来像是个难以叫人相信的借口。
ext.ext_en: I had to admit it sounded like an implausible excuse...

ext.ext_cn: 这些项目没有得到她的支持就开始进行了，这似乎不合情理。
ext.ext_en: It seems implausible that the projects would have gone ahead without her backing.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as implausible, you believe that it is unlikely to be true.

ext.ext_cn: 真是一群吝啬鬼。
ext.ext_en: What a bunch of Scrooges.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a Scrooge, you disapprove of them because they are very mean and hate spending money.

ext.ext_cn: 她拥有那种天生的优雅，举手投足都彬彬有礼。
ext.ext_en: She had that inbred politeness, it was a part of her.

ext.ext_cn: 与生俱来的行为模式
ext.ext_en: ...behaviour patterns that are inbred.

defs.def_en: Inbred means the same as inborn .

defs.def_cn: 同系交配的;近亲繁殖的

ext.ext_cn: 整个族群都是同系繁殖，以至于根本不存在基因差异。
ext.ext_en: The whole population is so inbred that no genetic differences remain...

ext.ext_cn: 他来自一个古老的近亲通婚的家族。
ext.ext_en: He came from an old inbred family.

defs.def_en: People who are inbred have ancestors who are all closely related to each other.
Injury time is the period of time added to the end of a football game because play was stopped during the match when players were injured.

ext.ext_cn: 仍可以由原件复印出无数份副本来。
ext.ext_en: An unlimited number of copies can still be made from the original...

ext.ext_cn: 进泳池的次数是没有限制的。
ext.ext_en: You'll also have unlimited access to the swimming pool...

defs.def_en: If there is an unlimited quantity of something, you can have as much or as many of that thing as you want.

defs.def_cn: 简直（一些用词谨慎者认为此用法不正确）

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须设法控制经济，不然它非把我们吞噬了不可。
ext.ext_en: We've  got to get the economy under control or it will literally eat us up...

ext.ext_cn: 景色美得简直让人窒息。
ext.ext_en: The views are literally breath-taking.

defs.def_en: You can use literally to emphasize a statement. Some careful speakers of English think that this use is incorrect.

defs.def_cn: 确实地；真正地；不加夸张地

ext.ext_cn: 上演一台歌剧是一项浩大的工程，说要涉及数以百计的人真是一点都不夸张。
ext.ext_en: Putting on an opera is a tremendous enterprise involving literally hundreds of people...

ext.ext_cn: 我真的是爬到车那边去的。
ext.ext_en: I literally crawled to the car.

defs.def_en: You use literally to emphasize that what you are saying is true, even though it seems exaggerated or surprising.

ext.ext_cn: volk这个单词直译过来为folk（人们）。
ext.ext_en: The word 'volk' translates literally as 'folk'...

ext.ext_cn: stanza（诗节）的原意为“房间”。
ext.ext_en: A stanza is, literally, a room.

defs.def_en: If a word or expression is translated literally, its most simple or basic meaning is translated.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你告诉一个人step on it（“加速；加快”，字面意义“踩在上面”）或者throw on your coat（“赶快穿上外套”，字面意义“扔在你的外套上”），他们可能会按字面理解你的话，那就会引起灾难性的后果。
ext.ext_en: If you tell a person to 'step on it' or 'throw on your coat,' they may take you literally, with disastrous consequences.

defs.def_en: If you take something literally, you think that a word or expression is being used with its most simple or basic meaning.

ext.ext_cn: 如果政府镇压抗议者，从长远来看，这将只能使他们更加坚决。
ext.ext_en: If the government clamps down on the protestors, that will only serve to strengthen them in the long run...

ext.ext_cn: 银行监管机构直到本月初才开始严格管制。
ext.ext_en: Banking regulators failed to clamp down until earlier this month.

defs.def_en: To clamp down on people or activities means to take strong official action to stop or control them.

ext.ext_cn: 这对夫妇花了几千元来翻新房子。
ext.ext_en: The couple spent thousands renovating the house...

ext.ext_cn: 她住在一个宽敞的翻新过的农舍里。
ext.ext_en: She lives in a large, renovated farmhouse.

defs.def_en: If someone renovates an old building, they repair and improve it and get it back into good condition.
Zoology is the scientific study of animals.

ext.ext_cn: “你在暗示我和那些袭击有关吗？”她冷冷地问。
ext.ext_en: 'Are you implying that I have something to do with those attacks?' she asked coldly...

ext.ext_cn: 她觉得这一含沙射影的批评对自己造成了不利影响。
ext.ext_en: She felt undermined by the implied criticism.

defs.def_en: If you imply that something is the case, you say something which indicates that it is the case in an indirect way.

ext.ext_cn: 6 月份出口上升 1.5%,表明经济比许多投资者所认为的更要坚挺。
ext.ext_en: Exports in June rose 1.5%, implying that the economy was stronger than many investors had realized...

ext.ext_cn: “无国界的”欧洲对所有经营者来说都意味着一个大大扩展了的市场。
ext.ext_en: A 'frontier-free' Europe implies a greatly increased market for all economic operators.

defs.def_en: If an event or situation implies that something is the case, it makes you think it likely that it is the case.

defs.def_cn: 即将离职的；快要卸任的

ext.ext_cn: 即将卸任的爱丁堡国际艺术节主席
ext.ext_en: ...the outgoing director of the Edinburgh International Festival.

defs.def_en: You use outgoing to describe a person in charge of something who is soon going to leave that position.

ext.ext_cn: 所有离港航班皆已停飞。
ext.ext_en: All outgoing flights were grounded.

defs.def_en: Outgoing things such as planes, mail, and passengers are leaving or being sent somewhere.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 外向的；友好的；喜欢交际的

ext.ext_cn: 她很外向。
ext.ext_en: She's very outgoing.

ext.ext_cn: 他友好的行为
ext.ext_en: ...his outgoing behaviour.

defs.def_en: Someone who is outgoing is very friendly and likes meeting and talking to people.

defs.def_cn: （机器）失灵，出故障；（人体器官）机能失常，出现功能障碍

ext.ext_cn: 辐射会损坏微处理器和电脑内存，使之失灵。
ext.ext_en: The radiation can damage microprocessors and computer memories, causing them to malfunction...

ext.ext_cn: 早年间的医生会把机能失常的器官摘除掉。
ext.ext_en: Early physicians removed the malfunctioning organs.

defs.def_en: If a machine or part of the body malfunctions, it fails to work properly.

ext.ext_cn: 它有助于让一个重要问题重新引起关注。
ext.ext_en: It helps to put an important issue back on the front burner...

ext.ext_cn: 我们有一个迫在眉睫、需要优先处理的公共卫生问题。
ext.ext_en: We have an urgent front-burner public health problem.

defs.def_en: If an issue is on the front burner, it receives a lot of attention because it is considered to be more urgent or important than other issues.

defs.def_cn: 迷幻品（有迷幻效果的服装、音乐等）
defs.def_en: Psychedelia refers to psychedelic objects, clothes, and music.

ext.ext_cn: 那人十足的厚颜无耻让人们吃惊得无话可说。
ext.ext_en: One could only gasp at the sheer effrontery of the man.

defs.def_en: Effrontery is behaviour that is bold, rude, or disrespectful.

ext.ext_cn: 这段采访反映了总统和政府之间的裂痕越来越大。
ext.ext_en: The interview reflected a growing rift between the President and the government...

ext.ext_cn: 他已经发出了警告，国家内部严重的不和可能会引发内战。
ext.ext_en: He has warned that the serious rifts within the country could lead to civil war...

defs.def_en: A rift between people or countries is a serious quarrel or disagreement that stops them having a good relationship.
A rift is a split that appears in something solid, especially in the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 对独裁主义的长期反抗
ext.ext_en: ...the long revolt against authoritarianism.

defs.def_en: Authoritarianism is the state of being authoritarian or the belief that people with power, especially the State, have the right to control other people's actions.

defs.def_cn: 难以形容的;无法描述的

ext.ext_cn: 儿子活着的消息得到确认后她难以形容的喜悦
ext.ext_en: ...her indescribable joy when it was confirmed her son was alive...

ext.ext_cn: 下水道发出一股说不出的恶臭。
ext.ext_en: The stench from the sewer is indescribable.

defs.def_en: You use indescribable to emphasize that a quality or condition is very intense or extreme, and therefore cannot be properly described.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 尊重人的;有礼貌的;恭敬的

ext.ext_cn: 他总是彬彬有礼，尊敬他人。
ext.ext_en: He was always so polite and respectful...

ext.ext_cn: 我们家的孩子对长辈总是恭恭敬敬的。
ext.ext_en: The children in our family are always respectful to their elders...

defs.def_en: If you are respectful, you show respect for someone.

ext.ext_cn: 政府没有察觉到他们的抗议。
ext.ext_en: The government failed to take cognisance of their protest.

defs.def_en: If you take cognizance of something, you take notice of it or acknowledge it.

ext.ext_cn: 老师对孩子智力活动的逐步认知
ext.ext_en: ...the teacher's developing cognizance of the child's intellectual activity.

defs.def_en: Cognizance is knowledge or understanding.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 语无伦次的;(言语)不连贯的,混乱的

ext.ext_cn: 随着夜色加深,他说话越来越前言不搭后语了。
ext.ext_en: As the evening progressed, he became increasingly incoherent...

ext.ext_cn: 那个人吓得几乎语无伦次了。
ext.ext_en: The man was almost incoherent with fear...

defs.def_en: If someone is incoherent, they are talking in a confused and unclear way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一组前后不一的目标
ext.ext_en: ...an incoherent set of objectives.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is making a row, you mean that they are making a loud, unpleasant noise.

defs.def_en: If you waive your right to something, for example legal representation, you choose not to have it or do it.

defs.def_en: If someone waives a rule, they say that people do not have to obey it in a particular situation.

ext.ext_en: She could hear the voices of her friends as they splashed in a nearby rock pool...

ext.ext_en: He closed his eyes tight, and splashed the water on his face...

ext.ext_en: A little wave, the first of many, splashed in my face...

ext.ext_en: There was a splash and something fell clumsily into the water.

defs.def_en: A splash is the sound made when something hits water or falls into it.

ext.ext_cn: 她偶尔会狂饮一通。

ext.ext_en: The soldiers opened fire without warning...

ext.ext_cn: 他没有受到任何警告，就被解雇了。
ext.ext_en: With no warning, he was fired from his job...

ext.ext_en: Some fog warning signs had been put up with flashing yellow lights.

defs.def_en: Warning actions or signs give a warning.
Hooves is a plural of hoof.

ext.ext_en: ...an arrogant, big-headed man.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as big-headed, you disapprove of them because they think they are very clever and know everything.

ext.ext_en: The Tory Party called the bill 'the most squalid measure ever put before the Commons'.

ext.ext_en: ...the squalid pursuit of profit.

defs.def_en: Squalid activities are unpleasant and often dishonest.

ext.ext_cn: 供水以及其他公用事业受到了严重影响。

defs.def_en: Public utilities are services provided by the government or state, such as the supply of electricity and gas, or the train network.

ext.ext_en: Police have released an E-fit picture of the suspected gunman.

defs.def_en: An e-fit is a computer-generated picture of someone who is suspected of a crime.

ext.ext_cn: 她醒来感到脚上火辣辣地痛。
ext.ext_en: She woke to feel a searing pain in her feet.

ext.ext_cn: 沙特阿拉伯沙漠的灼热
ext.ext_en: ...the searing heat of the Saudi Arabian desert.

defs.def_en: Searing is used to indicate that something such as pain or heat is very intense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (言谈、文章)吹毛求疵的，尖刻的,苛责的

ext.ext_cn: 尖刻的批评
ext.ext_en: ...searing criticism.

defs.def_en: A searing speech or piece of writing is very critical.

defs.def_cn: 开创新风尚的人(或机构);领导新潮流的人(或机构)
defs.def_en: A trend-setter is a person or institution that starts a new fashion or trend.

ext.ext_en: Most orthodox doctors however dismiss this as complete nonsense.

ext.ext_cn: 所有那些关于爱情的充满诗情画意的假话
ext.ext_en: ...all that poetic nonsense about love...

defs.def_en: If you say that something spoken or written is nonsense, you mean that you consider it to be untrue or silly.

defs.def_cn: 愚蠢的举动;冒失(或轻浮)的行为

ext.ext_cn: 耗尽世界的自然资源毋庸置疑是愚蠢的经济行为。
ext.ext_en: Surely it is an economic nonsense to deplete the world of natural resources...

ext.ext_en: I think there is a limit to how much of this nonsense people are going to put up with.

defs.def_en: You can use nonsense to refer to something that you think is foolish or that you disapprove of.

ext.ext_cn: 查尔斯·E.卡里尔写的一首儿童打油诗
ext.ext_en: ...a children's nonsense poem by Charles E Carryl.

defs.def_en: You can refer to spoken or written words that do not mean anything because they do not make sense as nonsense .

defs.def_cn: 使变得荒唐;使失去意义

ext.ext_en: The fighting made a nonsense of peace pledges made in London last week...

ext.ext_en: It makes nonsense of our own rules governing laws of adoption in this country.

defs.def_en: To make a nonsense of something or to make nonsense of it means to make it seem ridiculous or pointless.

ext.ext_en: It gradually dawned upon me that I still had talent and ought to run again...

ext.ext_cn: 接着加里·斯内夫利船长意识到了这个令人不寒而栗的事实。
ext.ext_en: Then the chilling truth dawned on Captain Gary Snavely.

defs.def_en: If a fact or idea dawns on you, you realize it.

ext.ext_cn: 用润滑良好的铰链固定的盖子一旋转就打开了。
ext.ext_en: The top swung open on well-oiled hinges.

defs.def_en: A hinge is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is used to join a door to its frame or to join two things together so that one of them can swing freely.

defs.def_cn: (博物馆或美术馆的)馆长，负责人

ext.ext_en: Peter Forey is curator of fossil fishes at the Natural History Museum.

defs.def_en: A curator is someone who is in charge of the objects or works of art in a museum or art gallery.

ext.ext_en: The company has now gone into receivership with debts of several million...

ext.ext_en: Accountants Touche Ross say that there were 45 receiverships among hotels and caterers.

defs.def_en: If a company goes into receivership, it faces financial failure and the administration of its business is handled by the receiver.

ext.ext_cn: 政府在很大程度上没有弄清楚全体选民的情绪。
ext.ext_en: The government largely misread the mood of the electorate...

defs.def_en: If you misread a situation or someone's behaviour, you do not understand it properly.

ext.ext_en: His chauffeur misread his route and took a wrong turning.

defs.def_en: If you misread something that has been written or printed, you look at it and think that it says something that it does not say.

ext.ext_en: ...the outbreak of war in the Middle East...

defs.def_en: If there is an outbreak of something unpleasant, such as violence or a disease, it suddenly starts to happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The attack on Charles was deeply unjust...

defs.def_en: If you describe an action, system, or law as unjust, you think that it treats a person or group badly in a way that they do not deserve.

ext.ext_en: Some new arrivals lose hope even before they start hunting for a job...

defs.def_en: If you hunt for something or someone, you try to find them by searching carefully or thoroughly.

ext.ext_en: Detectives have been hunting him for seven months...

ext.ext_cn: 她暴怒的丈夫正拿着一把枪追杀他。
ext.ext_en: Her irate husband was hunting him with a gun.

defs.def_en: If you hunt a criminal or an enemy, you search for them in order to catch or harm them.

ext.ext_en: A leopard hunts alone, and an injured leopard cannot hunt...

ext.ext_en: She liked to hunt as often as she could.

ext.ext_en: The hunt was held on land owned by the Duke of Marlborough.

defs.def_cn: 非写实的;有艺术效果的

ext.ext_cn: 其中一些与最近几部有着浓厚艺术气息的舞台音乐剧有关。
ext.ext_en: Some of it has to do with recent stage musicals, which have been very, very stylised.

ext.ext_en: ...fabric designs which featured stylized flowers and foliage.

defs.def_en: Something that is stylized is shown or done in a way that is not natural in order to create an artistic effect.

ext.ext_cn: 生活在虚假繁荣的虚幻幸福中
ext.ext_en: ...living in a fool's paradise of false prosperity.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is living in a fool's paradise, you are criticizing them because they are not aware that their present happy situation is likely to change and get worse.

defs.def_cn: 夸大的;夸张的;言过其实的

ext.ext_en: They should be sceptical of exaggerated claims for what such courses can achieve...

ext.ext_en: Western fears, he insists, are greatly exaggerated.

defs.def_en: Something that is exaggerated is or seems larger, better, worse, or more important than it actually needs to be.

ext.ext_cn: 马丁代为当起了霍华德·科塞尔的儿子。
ext.ext_en: Martin had become Howard Cosell's surrogate son...

ext.ext_cn: 在一系列曾在女王维多利亚的一生中扮演过代理父亲角色的人物中，约翰·布朗是最近的一位。

Calico is plain white fabric made from cotton.

defs.def_cn: 基层群众；平民百姓;草根阶层

ext.ext_en: You have to join the party at grass-roots level.

ext.ext_cn: 他按响了汽车喇叭。
ext.ext_en: He sounded the car horn.

defs.def_en: On a vehicle such as a car, the horn is the device that makes a loud noise as a signal or warning.

ext.ext_cn: 成年奶牛有犄角。
ext.ext_en: A mature cow has horns.

defs.def_en: The horns of an animal such as a cow or deer are the hard pointed things that grow from its head.
See also:horn-rimmed;Horn is the hard substance that the horns of animals are made of. Horn is sometimes used to make objects such as spoons, buttons, or ornaments.

defs.def_cn: 号（角）（一种简单乐器，由一根金属管组成，一端宽，一端窄）

ext.ext_cn: 猎号
ext.ext_en: ...a hunting horn.

ext.ext_cn: 带有一个大喇叭形扬声器的发条式留声机
ext.ext_en: ...a wind-up gramophone with a big horn.

defs.def_en: A horn is a hollow curved object that is narrow at one end and wide at the other.
If you blow your own horn, you boast about yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 在任的6年中，塞德曼经常和立法议员争得不可开交。
ext.ext_en: During his six years in office, Seidman has often locked horns with lawmakers.

defs.def_en: If two people lock horns, they argue about something.

ext.ext_cn: 这只鸟进退维谷。是应该冒着生命危险攻击捕食者呢？还是应该及早逃命？
ext.ext_en: The bird is caught on the horns of a dilemma. Should it attack the predator, even though it then risks its own life? Or should it get out while the going is good?

defs.def_en: If you are on the horns of a dilemma, you have to choose between two things, both of which are unpleasant or difficult.

defs.def_cn: 变得谨慎行事；（尤指）紧缩开支

ext.ext_cn: 消费者在高利率时期都在紧缩开支。
ext.ext_en: Customers are drawing in their horns at a time of high interest rates.

defs.def_en: If someone pulls in their horns or draws in their horns, they start behaving more cautiously than they did before, especially by spending less money.

ext.ext_cn: 日食
ext.ext_en: ...an eclipse of the sun.

ext.ext_cn: 5月21日的日食
ext.ext_en: ...the solar eclipse on May 21st.

defs.def_en: An eclipse of the sun is an occasion when the moon is between the earth and the sun, so that for a short time you cannot see part or all of the sun. defs.def_cn: 使黯然失色;使相形见绌;盖过

defs.def_en: If one thing is eclipsed by a second thing that is bigger, newer, or more important than it, the first thing is no longer noticed because the second thing gets all the attention.

ext.ext_en: A thin cable carries the signal to a computer...

ext.ext_en: He was a tall, thin man with grey hair...

ext.ext_cn: 他个头瘦小，肤色苍白。
ext.ext_en: He is small and very thin and has pale-white skin.

defs.def_en: A person or animal that is thin has no extra fat on their body .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一本用纸轻薄、字体精细的蓝皮小书
ext.ext_en: ...a small, blue-bound book printed in fine type on thin paper...

ext.ext_cn: 薄薄的一层表土被冲走了。
ext.ext_en: A thin layer of topsoil was swept away.

defs.def_en: Something such as paper or cloth that is thin is flat and has only a very small distance between its two opposite surfaces.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 汤又稀又清，味道却出奇地浓。
ext.ext_en: The soup was thin and clear, yet mysteriously rich...

ext.ext_cn: 他们搅动着架在木炭火堆上的大罐米饭和蔬菜清汤。
ext.ext_en: They are stirring huge pots of rice and thin vegetable soup over a fire made of charcoal.

defs.def_en: Liquids that are thin are weak and watery.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 比赛前半段观众还稀稀拉拉的，这时明显增多了。
ext.ext_en: The crowd, which had been thin for the first half of the race, had now grown considerably.

defs.def_en: A crowd or audience that is thin does not have many people in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (微笑)冷淡的，牵强的，不幽默的

ext.ext_cn: 她极力挤出了一丝勉强的苦笑。
ext.ext_en: All she could manage was a thin, wan smile.

defs.def_en: A thin smile is one that is not friendly or humorous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的礼服很薄，浑身在发抖，一半是冻的。
ext.ext_en: Her gown was thin, and she shivered, partly from cold.

defs.def_en: Thin clothes are made from light cloth and are not warm to wear.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (论点、解释)浅薄的，不足信的，说服力差的

ext.ext_cn: 然而，这个证据难以令人信服，而且有点模棱两可。
ext.ext_en: However, the evidence is thin and, to some extent, ambiguous...

ext.ext_en: Even if the optimists' theory is true, it still seems a thin argument against reform.

defs.def_en: If you describe an argument or explanation as thin, you mean that it is weak and difficult to believe.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她抱怨时抬高了尖细的嗓音。
ext.ext_en: Her thin voice rose high in complaint.

defs.def_en: A voice or sound that is thin is high-pitched and not very loud.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她把一头稀疏的浅黄色头发向后梳，挽成了个圆髻。
ext.ext_en: She had pale thin yellow hair she pulled back into a bun.

defs.def_en: If someone's hair is described as thin, they do not have a lot of hair.

ext.ext_cn: 当初要是分几个冬天疏剪树木，会比一下子疏剪完效果好。
ext.ext_en: It would have been better to have thinned the trees over several winters rather than all at one time...

ext.ext_cn: 半夜时分，人群渐渐散去了。
ext.ext_en: By midnight the crowd had thinned.

defs.def_en: When you thin something or when it thins, it becomes less crowded because people or things have been removed from it.

defs.def_cn: 使（调味汁或液体）变稀薄;使变淡

ext.ext_en: It may be necessary to thin the sauce slightly...

ext.ext_cn: 阿司匹林可以稀释血液，使其在变窄的血管里更顺畅地流动。
ext.ext_en: Aspirin thins the blood, letting it flow more easily through narrowed blood vessels.

defs.def_en: To thin a sauce or liquid means to make it weaker and more watery by adding another liquid to it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的头发开始脱落，皮肤也老化了。
ext.ext_en: His hair is thinning and his skin has lost all hint of youth.

defs.def_en: If a man's hair is thinning, it has begun to fall out.  thin on top→see: top;

ext.ext_cn: 议会还没有着手应对日益严重的经济危机，公众日渐失去了耐心。
ext.ext_en: Parliament has not yet begun to combat the deepening economic crisis, and public patience is wearing thin.

defs.def_en: If someone's patience, for example, is wearing thin, they are beginning to become impatient or angry with someone.

defs.def_cn: (用于否定句，起强调作用)极小的，些微的，一丁点儿的

ext.ext_en: I haven't the faintest idea how to care for a snake...

ext.ext_cn: 他昨天说政府推行这样的措施连“微乎其微的可能性”都没有。
ext.ext_en: He said yesterday that there was not 'the faintest possibility' that the government would bring in such a measure.

defs.def_en: You can use faintest for emphasis in negative statements. For example, if you say that someone hasn't the faintest idea what to do, you are emphasizing that they do not know what to do.

ext.ext_en: Mark snoozed in front of the television...

ext.ext_en: Patients are given an extra 15 minutes to snooze before being woken gently.

defs.def_en: If you snooze, you sleep lightly for a short period of time.

ext.ext_en: When I explained everything to my mum and dad, there were no histrionics.

defs.def_en: If you disapprove of someone's dramatic and exaggerated behaviour, you can describe it as histrionics .

defs.def_cn: 偷牲口的贼(尤指偷牛、马和羊的人)

defs.def_en: Rustlers are people who steal farm animals, especially cattle, horses, and sheep.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Volunteers from all walks of life are feeling put upon.

defs.def_en: If you are put-upon, you are treated badly by someone who takes advantage of your willingness to help them.

You can refer to your friends and family as your kith and kin .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as self-obsessed, you are criticizing them for spending too much time thinking about themselves or their own problems.

ext.ext_en: I was too cowardly to complain.

ext.ext_cn: 懦弱的暴力行为

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as cowardly, you disapprove of them because they are easily frightened and avoid doing dangerous and difficult things.
See also:chickenpox;smallpox;People sometimes refer to the disease syphilis as the pox .

defs.def_en: Lifelong means existing or happening for the whole of a person's life.

defs.def_en: A prequel is a film that is made about an earlier stage of a story or a character's life when the later part of it has already been made into a successful film.

Dentures are artificial teeth worn by people who no longer have all their own teeth.

ext.ext_en: Bob was always genial and welcoming...

ext.ext_en: ...potted plants.

ext.ext_en: British Rail has indeed become more commercial over the past decade...

ext.ext_cn: 对森林的商业开发所带来的影响让智利的自然资源保护者们感到忧心忡忡。
ext.ext_en: Conservationists in Chile are concerned over the effect of commercial exploitation of forests...

defs.def_en: A commercial product is made to be sold to the public.

ext.ext_en: Commercial vehicles, coaches and lorries are required by law to be fitted with tachographs.

ext.ext_en: ...the fastest crossing of the Atlantic by a commercial passenger vessel.
