ext.ext_en: ...Classic FM, the first national commercial radio station.

defs.def_en: Commercial is used to describe something such as a film or a type of music that it is intended to be popular with the public, and is not very original or of high quality.

ext.ext_cn: 政府通过电视广告和传单的形式发起了宣传活动。

defs.def_en: A commercial is an advertisement that is broadcast on television or radio.

ext.ext_en: Eldest children are the only ones to have experienced the undivided attention of their parents...

ext.ext_cn: 成年人很少会专心地看电视。
ext.ext_en: Adults rarely give the television their undivided attention.

defs.def_en: If you give someone or something your undivided attention, you concentrate on them fully and do not think about anything else.

ext.ext_cn: 她那几个月里创作的画作备受推崇。
ext.ext_en: The paintings she produced in those months won undivided admiration...

ext.ext_cn: 我对他忠心耿耿。
ext.ext_en: He has my undivided loyalty.

defs.def_en: Undivided feelings are ones that are very strong and not mixed with other feelings.

defs.def_cn: （国家或组织）统一的，未分裂的

ext.ext_en: Mandela said, 'We want a united, undivided South Africa'.

ext.ext_cn: 一统基督教教会的目标
ext.ext_en: ...the goal of an undivided Church.

defs.def_en: An undivided country or organization is one that is not separated into smaller parts or groups.

ext.ext_en: When he finished he lifted his eyes and looked out the window.

defs.def_en: If something gives you a lift, it gives you a feeling of greater confidence, energy, or enthusiasm.

ext.ext_en: They took the lift to the fourth floor.

defs.def_en: A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside tall buildings.

ext.ext_en: He had a car and often gave me a lift home.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a lift somewhere, you take them there in your car as a favour to them.

defs.def_cn: （尤指在战争中）空运（居民或货物）

ext.ext_en: The army lifted people off rooftops where they had climbed to escape the flooding...

ext.ext_en: The helicopters are designed to quickly lift soldiers and equipment to the battlefield.

defs.def_en: If a government or organization lifts people or goods in or out of an area, it transports them there by aircraft, especially when there is a war.

defs.def_en: To lift something means to increase its amount or to increase the level or the rate at which it happens.

ext.ext_en: The fog had lifted and revealed a warm, sunny day.

defs.def_en: If fog, cloud, or mist lifts, it reduces, for example by moving upwards or by becoming less thick.

defs.def_cn: 掘出，挖出，拔起（根菜或球茎）

ext.ext_en: Nothing can be done to ameliorate the situation...

ext.ext_en: He expected me to do something to ameliorate his depression.

defs.def_en: If someone or something ameliorates a situation, they make it better or easier in some way.

defs.def_en: The secretary-general of an international political organization is the person in charge of its administration.

ext.ext_cn: 经校订的演讲稿

defs.def_en: If you edit a text such as an article or a book, you correct and adapt it so that it is suitable for publishing.

ext.ext_en: She has edited the media studies quarterly, Screen.

defs.def_en: If you edit a book or a series of books, you collect several pieces of writing by different authors and prepare them for publishing.

ext.ext_en: He is editing together excerpts of some of his films.

defs.def_en: If you edit a film or a television or radio programme, you choose some of what has been filmed or recorded and arrange it in a particular order.

ext.ext_en: I used to edit the college paper in the old days.

defs.def_en: Someone who edits a newspaper, magazine, or journal is in charge of it.

ext.ext_en: The purpose of the edit is fairly simple—to chop out the boring bits from the original.

defs.def_en: An edit is the process of examining and correcting a text so that it is suitable for publishing.

defs.def_en: The eightieth item in a series is the one that you count as number eighty.

defs.def_en: If you defend someone or something, you take action in order to protect them.

ext.ext_cn: 克拉伦斯的决定，不管对错，马特都予以维护。
ext.ext_en: Matt defended all of Clarence's decisions, right or wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 面对种族主义指控，作者替自己辩护说黑人只是她的抨击目标之一。
ext.ext_en: The author defends herself against charges of racism by noting that blacks are only one of her targets...

defs.def_en: If you defend someone or something when they have been criticized, you argue in support of them.

ext.ext_cn: 在军人政权时期为政治犯辩护的律师
ext.ext_en: ...a lawyer who defended political prisoners during the military regime...

ext.ext_cn: 他已聘请了一位律师针对这些指控为自己辩护。
ext.ext_en: He has hired a lawyer to defend him against the allegations...

defs.def_en: When a lawyer defends a person who has been accused of something, the lawyer argues on their behalf in a court of law that the charges are not true.

ext.ext_cn: 托伦斯希望在下届奥运会上能够卫冕成功。
ext.ext_en: Torrence expects to defend her title successfully in the next Olympics...

ext.ext_cn: 印度队苦战之下才以 2 比 0 击败卫冕冠军韩国队。
ext.ext_en: India had to struggle to beat defending champions South Korea 2-0.

defs.def_en: When a sports player plays in the tournament which they won the previous time it was held, you can say that they are defending their title.

defs.def_cn: 淀粉质食物;高碳水化合物食物

ext.ext_cn: 食用多种碳水化合物食物、水果和蔬菜。
ext.ext_en: Eat a wide variety of carbs, fruit, and vegetables.

defs.def_en: Carbs are foods such as potatoes, pasta, and bread, that contain a lot of carbohydrate.

ext.ext_cn: 离边界约20公里
ext.ext_en: ...about twenty kilometres from the border...

ext.ext_cn: 大火烧毁了大约4万平方公里的森林。
ext.ext_en: The fire destroyed some 40,000 square kilometres of forest.

defs.def_en: A kilometre is a metric unit of distance or length. One kilometre is a thousand metres and is equal to 0.62 miles.
A ghoul is an imaginary evil spirit. Ghouls are said to steal bodies from graves and eat them.

defs.def_cn: 以他人的苦难为乐的人；对死亡（或死人）感兴趣的变态者
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a ghoul, you mean that they show an unnatural interest in things such as human suffering, death, or dead bodies.

defs.def_cn: 沙文主义;本国至上主义

ext.ext_cn: 它可能也迎合了许多普通人心中的沙文主义情结。
ext.ext_en: It may also appeal to the latent chauvinism of many ordinary people.

defs.def_en: See also:male chauvinism;Chauvinism is a strong, unreasonable belief that your own country is more important and morally better than other people's.

defs.def_cn: 威慑力量;威慑因素;遏制物

ext.ext_cn: 他们真的相信死刑具有威慑作用。
ext.ext_en: They seriously believe that capital punishment is a deterrent...

ext.ext_cn: 这项严厉的新法将起到威慑作用。
ext.ext_en: The tough new law should act as a deterrent.

defs.def_en: A deterrent is something that prevents people from doing something by making them afraid of what will happen to them if they do it.

ext.ext_cn: 核威慑武器
ext.ext_en: ...a nuclear deterrent.

defs.def_en: A deterrent is a weapon or set of weapons designed to prevent enemies from attacking by making them afraid to do so.

ext.ext_cn: 希望这能在将来对贩毒集团起到威慑作用。
ext.ext_en: Hopefully, that will have a deterrent effect on drug syndicates in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 他相信死刑的威慑力
ext.ext_en: ...his belief in the deterrent value of capital punishment.

defs.def_en: If something has a deterrent effect, it has the effect of preventing people from doing certain things.
A particle accelerator is a machine used for research in nuclear physics which can make particles that are smaller than atoms move very fast.
A pickaxe is a large tool consisting of a curved, pointed piece of metal with a long handle joined to the middle. Pickaxes are used for breaking up rocks or the ground.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我发现他一直在看黄色录像。
ext.ext_en: I found out he'd been watching pornographic videos.

defs.def_en: Pornographic materials such as films, videos, and magazines are designed to cause sexual excitement by showing naked people or referring to sexual acts.

defs.def_cn: （英格兰和威尔士的）高等法院
defs.def_en: In England and Wales, the High Court is a court of law which deals with very serious or important cases.

ext.ext_cn: 没有证据表明疯牛病与最近确诊的猫类脑病有关联。
ext.ext_en: There was no evidence of a connection between BSE and the brain diseases recently confirmed in cats...

ext.ext_cn: 警方说他与安全部队没有关系。
ext.ext_en: The police say he had no connection with the security forces...

defs.def_en: A connection is a relationship between two things, people, or groups.

defs.def_cn: (电线或管道的)连接部分，接头

ext.ext_cn: 检查所有的暖气片，看有没有小裂缝，尤其是管道连接处附近。
ext.ext_en: Check all radiators for small leaks, especially round pipework connections.

defs.def_en: A connection is a joint where two wires or pipes are joined together.

defs.def_cn: (公路、铁路或空中的)交通连接，交通线

ext.ext_cn: 福冈与国内其他城市之间有非常便捷的空运和铁路运输系统。
ext.ext_en: Fukuoka has excellent air and rail connections to the rest of the country.

defs.def_en: If a place has good road, rail, or air connections, many places can be directly reached from there by car, train, or plane.

ext.ext_cn: 航班晚点，我没赶上转机。
ext.ext_en: My flight was late and I missed the connection.

defs.def_en: If you get a connection at a station or airport, you catch a train, bus, or plane, after getting off another train, bus, or plane, in order to continue your journey.

ext.ext_cn: 她充分利用了自己的人脉。
ext.ext_en: She used her connections to full advantage.

defs.def_en: Your connections are the people who you know or are related to, especially when they are in a position to help you.

ext.ext_cn: 关于迈克尔·肖尔的来信，现复信如下。
ext.ext_en: I am writing in connection with Michael Shower's letter...

ext.ext_cn: 有13名男子因谋杀案受到盘问。
ext.ext_en: 13 men have been questioned in connection with the murder.

defs.def_en: If you write or talk to someone in connection with something, you write or talk to them about that thing.

defs.def_cn: 关于这/那一点;在这/那方面

ext.ext_cn: 今天是他逝世100周年纪念日，我们为此在这里举行盛大的纪念活动。
ext.ext_en: It is the 100th anniversary of his death. We here are having very great celebrations in this connection.

defs.def_en: You say in this connection or in that connection to indicate that what you are talking about is related to what you have just mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 一名警察和一位护理人员先后试图救活她。
ext.ext_en: A policeman and then a paramedic tried to resuscitate her.

defs.def_en: If you resuscitate someone who has stopped breathing, you cause them to start breathing again.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经投标来拯救这个岌岌可危的周刊。
ext.ext_en: He has submitted a bid to resuscitate the struggling magazine.

defs.def_en: If you resuscitate something, you cause it to become active or successful again.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在这里可以听见各不相同的盖尔语。
ext.ext_en: Gaelic can be heard here in manifold forms...

ext.ext_cn: 困难是多种多样的。
ext.ext_en: The difficulties are manifold.

defs.def_en: Things that are manifold are of many different kinds.

ext.ext_cn: 那座房子坐落于茂密的树林中，四周布有带电围栏。
ext.ext_en: The house was set amid dense trees and surrounded by an electrified fence.

defs.def_en: An electrified fence or other barrier has been connected to a supply of electricity, so that a person or animal that touches it will get an electric shock.

ext.ext_cn: 11月份一个雾蒙蒙的早晨，天空昏暗阴沉
ext.ext_en: ...the gloom of a foggy November morning...

ext.ext_cn: 我在暗处端详着自己。
ext.ext_en: I was peering about me in the gloom.

defs.def_en: The gloom is a state of near darkness.

ext.ext_cn: 对经济的忧虑日益加重
ext.ext_en: ...the deepening gloom over the economy.

defs.def_en: Gloom is a feeling of sadness and lack of hope.

defs.def_cn: 使显得矮小;使相形见绌

ext.ext_cn: 在巨大的红色麦当劳标志牌下，他显得很矮小。
ext.ext_en: His figure is dwarfed by the huge red McDonald's sign...

ext.ext_cn: 与美国航空旅行市场比起来，英国的航空旅行市场相形见绌。
ext.ext_en: The US air travel market dwarfs that of Britain.

defs.def_en: If one person or thing is dwarfed by another, the second is so much bigger than the first that it makes them look very small.

defs.def_cn: (星系中较小的、不是很亮的)矮星

ext.ext_cn: 白色的矮星
ext.ext_en: ...a white dwarf star.

ext.ext_cn: 红色的矮星
ext.ext_en: ...a red dwarf.

defs.def_en: Dwarf is used to describe a particular kind of star which is quite small and not very bright.

ext.ext_cn: 矮灌木丛
ext.ext_en: ...dwarf shrubs.

defs.def_en: Dwarf is used to describe varieties or species of plants and animals which are much smaller than the usual size for their kind.
In children's stories, a dwarf is an imaginary creature that is like a small man. Dwarfs often have magical powers.
In former times, people who were much smaller than normal were called dwarfs .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有明确目标的;注意力集中的

ext.ext_cn: 接下来的一年我一直在闲逛。没有什么明确的目标。
ext.ext_en: I spent the next year just wandering. I wasn't focused...

ext.ext_cn: 这个乐队的第三张专辑似乎表现更为节制、基调更为清晰。
ext.ext_en: The band's third album seems more disciplined and focussed...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as focused, you approve of the fact that they have a clear and definite purpose.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一个小时、两个小时过去了,他不耐烦了。
ext.ext_en: He is impatient as the first hour passes and then another...

ext.ext_cn: 大牌俱乐部对缓慢的进展越来越不耐烦了。
ext.ext_en: The big clubs are becoming increasingly impatient at the rate of progress.

defs.def_en: If you are impatient, you are annoyed because you have to wait too long for something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 注意不要对人不耐烦。
ext.ext_en: Beware of being too impatient with others...

ext.ext_cn: 他不耐烦地把它扔到一边,又骂了一句,然后走开了。
ext.ext_en: He threw it aside with an impatient gesture and another oath and walked off.

defs.def_en: If you are impatient, you are easily irritated by things.

defs.def_cn: 迫不及待的;切望的;急不可耐的

ext.ext_cn: 他迫不及待想要回家。
ext.ext_en: He was impatient to get home...

ext.ext_cn: 他们渴望得到工作，获取安全感。
ext.ext_en: They are impatient for jobs and security.

defs.def_en: If you are impatient to do something or impatient for something to happen, you are eager to do it or for it to happen and do not want to wait.

ext.ext_cn: 士兵们看管着救济食品。
ext.ext_en: Soldiers oversee the food handouts...

ext.ext_cn: 每户都领到6,000卢比的救济金。
ext.ext_en: Each family is being given a cash handout of six thousand rupees.

defs.def_en: A handout is a gift of money, clothing, or food, which is given free to poor people.

defs.def_cn: 白给的钱;不劳而获的钱

ext.ext_cn: 政客把钱用于可以拉选票的福利上而不是用作未来投资的趋势
ext.ext_en: ...the tendency of politicians to use money on vote-buying handouts rather than on investment in the future...

ext.ext_cn: 总统认为外援是不劳而获之财，会助长本国对富国的依赖性。
ext.ext_en: The president called foreign aid a handout that fosters dependence on wealthy nations.

defs.def_en: If you call money that is given to someone a handout, you disapprove of it because you believe that the person who receives it has done nothing to earn or deserve it.

ext.ext_cn: 官方印发的材料将皇帝描述为“尤以学识渊博而著称”。
ext.ext_en: Official handouts describe the Emperor as 'particularly noted as a scholar'.

defs.def_en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or members of the public.
A handout is a paper containing a summary of information or topics which will be dealt with in a lecture or talk.
In ballet, a pas de deux is a dance sequence for two dancers.
A postman is a man whose job is to collect and deliver letters and packages that are sent by post.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他受到如此对待让我气愤。
ext.ext_en: I'm  disgusted with the way that he was treated...

ext.ext_cn: 他对一位英国大臣竟有如此丢人的举止感到厌恶。
ext.ext_en: He was disgusted that a British minister could have behaved so disgracefully.

defs.def_en: If you are disgusted, you feel a strong sense of dislike and disapproval at something.

ext.ext_cn: 无论谁杀了他,都是除掉了一个既勇猛又残忍的人。
ext.ext_en: Whoever did him in removed a man who was brave as well as ruthless.

defs.def_en: To do someone in means to kill them.

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉合上书，把它放在了一边。
ext.ext_en: Sarah closed the book and laid it aside.

defs.def_en: If you move something aside, you move it to one side of you.

ext.ext_cn: 比利·尤因拉着他的胳膊肘把他带到了一边。
ext.ext_en: Billy Ewing grabbed him by the elbow and took him aside...

ext.ext_cn: 威尔一只胳膊搂着她的肩膀，把她拉到了一边。
ext.ext_en: Will put his arm around her shoulders and drew her aside.

defs.def_en: If you take or draw someone aside, you take them a little way away from a group of people in order to talk to them in private.

ext.ext_cn: 她一直在门口站着，但是现在闪到了一边，让他们过去了。
ext.ext_en: She had been standing in the doorway, but now she stepped aside to let them pass.

defs.def_en: If you move aside, you get out of someone's way.

ext.ext_cn: 她想把零花钱攒起来用于度假。
ext.ext_en: She wants to put her pocket-money aside for holidays.

ext.ext_cn: 为建新的大教堂留出的空地
ext.ext_en: ...the ground set aside for the new cathedral.

defs.def_en: If you set something such as time, money, or space aside for a particular purpose, you save it and do not use it for anything else.

ext.ext_cn: 和一个能真正倾听你诉说并重视你感受的朋友谈谈。
ext.ext_en: Talk to a friend who will really listen and not brush aside your feelings...

ext.ext_cn: 首相对按揭费用上涨的忧虑置之不理。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister swept aside concern about the rising cost of mortgages.

defs.def_en: If you brush or sweep aside a feeling or suggestion, you reject it.

ext.ext_cn: 撇开极少数临床抑郁症患者不谈，大多数情绪低落的人也有心情非常愉快的时候。
ext.ext_en: Leaving aside the tiny minority who are clinically depressed, most people who have bad moods also have very good moods...

ext.ext_cn: 撇开那些情绪化的争论不谈，下面只说客观事实。
ext.ext_en: Emotional arguments aside, here are the facts.

defs.def_en: You use aside to indicate that you have finished talking about something, or that you are leaving it out of your discussion, and that you are about to talk about something else.

ext.ext_cn: 在被她的孩子们激怒后，她翻了一下白眼对着镜头嘀咕道，“难怪我会酗酒！”
ext.ext_en: Exasperated with her children, she rolls her eyes and mutters an aside to the camera, 'No wonder I drink!'

defs.def_en: An aside is a comment that a character in a play makes to the audience, which the other characters are supposed not to be able to hear.

ext.ext_cn: 这本书节奏明快，另外还穿插了一些趣味盎然的文史掌故。
ext.ext_en: The pace of the book is leisurely, with enjoyable literary and historical asides.

defs.def_en: An aside is something that you say that is not directly connected with what you are talking about.

defs.def_cn: 同apart from（通常用于美国英语）
defs.def_en: Aside from means the same as apart from. This form is more usual in American English.

ext.ext_cn: 毫无意义的打油诗的片段
ext.ext_en: ...fragments of meaningless doggerel.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a poem as doggerel, you are emphasizing that you think it is very bad poetry.

ext.ext_cn: 那里其他所有政党已被彻底取缔。
ext.ext_en: All other political parties there have been completely banned...

ext.ext_cn: 加拿大政府面临着又一场政治危机。
ext.ext_en: The Canadian government is facing another political crisis.

defs.def_en: See also:party political;Political means relating to the way power is achieved and used in a country or society.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 对政治感兴趣的；从事政治的

ext.ext_cn: 噢，我不关心政治，对政治一点也不感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: Oh I'm not political, I take no interest in politics...

ext.ext_cn: 这部戏政治味太浓。
ext.ext_en: This play is very political.

defs.def_en: Someone who is political is interested or involved in politics and holds strong beliefs about it.

defs.def_cn: （和咖啡一起上的）饭后小甜点，花式小点心，小茶点
defs.def_en: Petits fours are very small sweet cakes. They are sometimes served with coffee at the end of a meal.
If you refer to someone as a wally, you think that they are stupid or foolish.

defs.def_cn: 未经授权的；未经许可的

ext.ext_cn: 一本新的未经授权的俄罗斯总统传记
ext.ext_en: ...a new unauthorized biography of the Russian President.

ext.ext_cn: 未经许可使用军车
ext.ext_en: ...the unauthorized use of a military vehicle...

defs.def_en: If something is unauthorized, it has been produced or is happening without official permission.

ext.ext_cn: 一位巴西利亚的选民将人们的心情一言概之——“政客们已无信誉可言”，他抱怨道。
ext.ext_en: One voter in Brasilia summed up the mood — 'Politicians have lost credibility,' he complained...

ext.ext_cn: 奥布瑞用一个词总结了他的周末经历：“灾难。”
ext.ext_en: Obree summed his weekend up in one word: 'Disastrous.'

defs.def_en: If you sum something up, you describe it as briefly as possible.

ext.ext_cn: 他说：“我爱我的妻子、我的马和我的狗。”他大致上就是这么一个人。
ext.ext_en: 'I love my wife, my horse and my dog,' he said, and that summed him up...

ext.ext_cn: 不幸的是，巴思勋爵和他的继任者之间的关系只能用“积怨已久”来概括。
ext.ext_en: Sadly, the feud sums up the relationship between Lord Bath and the man who succeeds him.

defs.def_en: If something sums a person or situation up, it represents their most typical characteristics.

defs.def_cn: (在发言后或文章结尾处)作总结;(法官审理结束前)作结案陈词

ext.ext_cn: 当法官作结案陈词时，他明显想作出有罪裁决。
ext.ext_en: When the judge summed up, it was clear he wanted a guilty verdict...

ext.ext_cn: 最后，我们欣然接受政府的声明，并感谢其愿同我们合作的意愿和承诺。
ext.ext_en: To sum up: We welcome the statement of the Government and appreciate its willingness and commitment to work cooperatively with us.

defs.def_en: If you sum up after a speech or at the end of a piece of writing, you briefly state the main points again. When a judge sums up after a trial, he reminds the jury of the evidence and the main arguments of the case they have heard.

ext.ext_cn: 有酬工作的机会
ext.ext_en: ...opportunities for gainful employment.

defs.def_en: If you are in gainful employment, you have a job for which you are paid.

defs.def_cn: 你自己;您自己;你们自己

ext.ext_cn: 要有勇气对自己坦诚，同时对别人也要开诚布公。
ext.ext_en: Have the courage to be honest with yourself and about yourself...

ext.ext_cn: 你怀孕的时候，你的孩子指望着你好好照顾自己。
ext.ext_en: Your baby depends on you to look after yourself properly while you are pregnant...

defs.def_en: A speaker or writer uses yourself to refer to the person that they are talking or writing to. Yourself is used when the object of a verb or preposition refers to the same person as the subject of the verb.

defs.def_cn: （用于强调所指对象）你自己，你本人，你们自己，你们本人

ext.ext_cn: 先生，他们两个打算等您本人离开后瓜分这个企业。
ext.ext_en: They mean to share the business between them, after you yourself are gone, Sir...

ext.ext_cn: 我一直在想，你们自己是否知道她为什么来。
ext.ext_en: I've been wondering if you yourselves have any idea why she came.

defs.def_en: You use yourself to emphasize the person that you are referring to.

defs.def_cn: （代替作宾语的you，用于强调或表示礼貌）你（自己），你们（自己）

ext.ext_cn: 像你这样的有钱人，一路走来注定会结下一两个仇人的。
ext.ext_en: A wealthy man like yourself is bound to make an enemy or two along the way...

ext.ext_cn: 我不想给你们这样的大人物添任何麻烦。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't want to cause such important people as yourselves any bother.

defs.def_en: You use yourself instead of 'you' for emphasis or in order to be more polite when 'you' is the object of a verb or preposition.  by yourself→see: by;

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 年少时，他是个狂热的爱国者。
ext.ext_en: As a boy he was a fanatical patriot.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as fanatical, you disapprove of them because you consider their behaviour or opinions to be very extreme.

ext.ext_cn: 能阻止海洛因在体内起作用并让吸毒成瘾者迅速脱瘾的药物
ext.ext_en: ...drugs which block the effects of heroin use and rapidly detoxify addicts...

ext.ext_en: Vitamin C helps to detoxify pollutants in the body.

An adjective is a word such as 'big', 'dead', or 'financial' that describes a person or thing, or gives extra information about them. Adjectives usually come before nouns or after link verbs.

ext.ext_en: He's always very punctual. I'll see if he's here yet.

defs.def_en: If you are punctual, you do something or arrive somewhere at the right time and are not late.

ext.ext_en: Jimmy turned maudlin after three drinks.

ext.ext_en: ...maudlin self-pity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (歌曲、书、电影等)伤感的，凄哀的

ext.ext_en: ...the most maudlin song of all time.

ext.ext_en: ...a hugely entertaining (if overlong and maudlin) movie.

ext.ext_cn: 与地毯协调搭配的粉色和米色相间的石板
ext.ext_en: ...slabs of pink and beige stone that harmonize with the carpet...

ext.ext_en: Barbara White and her mother like to listen to music together, though their tastes don't harmonize.

defs.def_en: If two or more things harmonize with each other, they fit in well with each other.

ext.ext_en: How far will members have progressed towards harmonising their economies?

defs.def_en: When governments or organizations harmonize laws, systems, or regulations, they agree in a friendly way to make them the same or similar.

ext.ext_en: Bremer and Garland harmonize on the title song, 'Meet Me in St. Louis'.

defs.def_en: When people harmonize, they sing or play notes which are different from the main tune but which sound nice with it.

defs.def_en: Baize is a thick woollen material which is used for covering tables on which games such as cards and snooker are played.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第 20 个字母。
defs.def_en: T is the twentieth letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_en: T or t is a written abbreviation for words beginning with 't', such as 'ton' and 'time'.

ext.ext_en: The description fits us to a tee...

ext.ext_en: Lucy was a stickler for perfection, and everything had to be exactly right, rehearsed down to a T.

defs.def_en: You can use to a T or to a tee to mean perfectly or exactly right. For example, if something suits you to a T, it suits you perfectly. If you have got an activity or a skill down to a T, you have succeeded in doing it exactly right.
Ironmongery is articles for the house and garden such as tools, nails, and pans which are sold in an ironmonger's shop.

ext.ext_en: ...a hurried breakfast.

defs.def_en: A hurried action is done quickly, because you do not have much time to do it in.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行动）仓促的，突然的，急于应对的

ext.ext_en: Downing Street denied there had been a hurried overnight redrafting of the text.

defs.def_en: A hurried action is done suddenly, in reaction to something that has just happened.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 巴黎街上的路人往往看上去忧心忡忡、匆匆忙忙而且不太友善。
ext.ext_en: Parisians on the street often looked worried, hurried and unfriendly.

defs.def_en: Someone who is hurried does things more quickly than they should because they do not have much time to do them.

ext.ext_cn: 猥亵和恐吓电话都是违法的。
ext.ext_en: Obscene and threatening phone calls are against the law...

ext.ext_en: They are seeking permission to begin criminal proceedings against him for breaking the law on financing political parties...

defs.def_en: The law is a system of rules that a society or government develops in order to deal with crime, business agreements, and social relationships. You can also use the law to refer to the people who work in this system.

defs.def_cn: （用于指某一种法律）刑法/公司法

ext.ext_cn: 他是哈佛大学法学院的刑法学教授。
ext.ext_en: He was a professor of criminal law at Harvard University law school...

ext.ext_cn: 根据国际法，驻外外交官员免受刑事检控。
ext.ext_en: Under international law, diplomats living in foreign countries are exempt from criminal prosecution...

defs.def_en: Law is used to refer to a particular  branch of the law, such as criminal law or company law.

defs.def_cn: （针对某种协议、关系或罪行的）法律，法

ext.ext_cn: 该国开明的政治庇护法
ext.ext_en: ...the country's  liberal political asylum law...

ext.ext_cn: 此法在第二次表决时通过。
ext.ext_en: The law was passed on a second vote.

defs.def_en: A law is one of the rules in a system of law which deals with a particular type of agreement, relationship, or crime.

defs.def_cn: （组织或活动的）规则，规章，条例

ext.ext_cn: 英国国教会的教规
ext.ext_en: ...the laws of the Church of England...

ext.ext_en: Match officials should not tolerate such behaviour but instead enforce the laws of the game.

defs.def_en: The laws of an organization or activity are its rules, which are used to organize and control it.

ext.ext_cn: 不容改变的道德准则
ext.ext_en: ...inflexible moral laws.

defs.def_en: A law is a rule or set of rules for good behaviour which is considered right and important by the majority of people for moral, religious, or emotional reasons.

ext.ext_cn: 自然法则至高无上。
ext.ext_en: The laws of nature are absolute.

defs.def_en: A law is a natural process in which a particular event or thing always leads to a particular result.

ext.ext_cn: 万有引力定律
ext.ext_en: ...the law of gravity.

defs.def_en: A law is a scientific rule that someone has invented to explain a particular natural process.

ext.ext_cn: 法律行业对年轻人的吸引力越来越大。
ext.ext_en: A career in law is becoming increasingly attractive to young people...

ext.ext_cn: 近百家律师事务所被送上律师纪律法庭。
ext.ext_en: Nearly 100 law firms are being referred to the Solicitors' Disciplinary Tribunal.

defs.def_en: Law or the law is all the professions which deal with Advising people about the law, representing people in court, or giving decisions and punishments.

ext.ext_en: He came to Oxford and studied law...

ext.ext_cn: 他拥有布里斯托尔大学的法律学位。
ext.ext_en: He holds a law degree from Bristol University.

defs.def_en: Law is the study of systems of law and how laws work.

defs.def_cn: 凌驾于法律之上；高于法律

ext.ext_en: One opposition member of parliament accuses the government of wanting to be above the law...

ext.ext_cn: 他自以为比法还大。
ext.ext_en: He considered himself above the law.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of thinking they are above the law, you criticize them for thinking that they are so clever or important that they do not need to obey the law.

ext.ext_cn: 根据平均律，我们不会再输下去了。
ext.ext_en: On the law of averages we just can't go on losing.

defs.def_en: The law of averages is the idea that something is sure to happen at some time, because of the number of times it generally happens or is expected to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 根据法律，所有餐厅都必须在店外明示用餐价格。
ext.ext_en: By law all restaurants must display their prices outside...

ext.ext_cn: 无标志的预约型出租车沿街拉客是非法的。
ext.ext_en: Minicabs are prohibited by law from touting passers-by for business.

defs.def_en: If you have to do something by law or if you are not allowed to do something by law, the law states that you have to do it or that you are not allowed to do it.

defs.def_cn: 诉诸法律；提起诉讼；打官司

ext.ext_cn: 他告上了法庭，但没有告赢我们。
ext.ext_en: He went to law and did not succeed in his claim against us.

defs.def_en: If you go to law, you go to court in order to get a legal judgment on a dispute.

ext.ext_cn: 认为应对子女发号施令的传统的家长们
ext.ext_en: ...traditional parents, who believed in laying down the law for their offspring.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone lays down the law, you are critical of them because they give other people orders and they think that they are always right.

ext.ext_en: The speeding motorist was pinned to the ground by angry locals who took the law into their own hands until police arrived.

defs.def_en: If someone takes the law into their own hands, they punish someone or do something to put a situation right, instead of waiting for the police or the legal system to take action.

ext.ext_en: Some of the landowners were a law unto themselves. There was nobody to check their excesses and they exploited the people.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a law unto himself or herself, you mean that they behave in an independent way, ignoring laws, rules, or conventional ways of doing things.

ext.ext_cn: 极为肤浅、令人作呕的新闻报道
ext.ext_en: ...a witless, nasty piece of journalism.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as witless, you mean that they are very foolish or stupid.

ext.ext_en: Don't assume your baby automatically needs feeding if she's fretful.

defs.def_en: If someone is fretful, they behave in a way that shows that they worried or unhappy about something.

defs.def_en: The social chapter is an agreement between countries in the European Union concerning workers' rights and working conditions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He is a clubbable chap.

defs.def_en: A clubbable person is friendly and likes being with other people, which makes them good members of social clubs.

defs.def_cn: 计算机操作;计算机应用

ext.ext_cn: 课程多种多样，从烹调到计算机操作应有尽有。
ext.ext_en: Courses range from cookery to computing.

defs.def_en: Computing is  the activity of using a computer and writing programs for it.

defs.def_cn: 计算机的;计算机应用的

ext.ext_cn: 很多毕业生就职于电子和计算机行业。
ext.ext_en: Many graduates are employed in the electronics and computing industries.

defs.def_en: Computing means relating to computers and their use.

defs.def_cn: （置于形容词和副词前，表示强调）

ext.ext_cn: 他成了巨富。
ext.ext_en: He has become mega rich...

ext.ext_cn: 罗伊巨丑特丑。
ext.ext_en: Roy was tremendously ugly, mega ugly.

defs.def_en: Young people sometimes use mega in front of adjectives or adverbs in order to emphasize them.

defs.def_cn: (用于名词前)特别好的，异常巨大的，非常重要的

ext.ext_en: ...her newly acquired mega salary.

ext.ext_cn: 超级巨星麦当娜
ext.ext_en: ...the mega superstar Madonna.

defs.def_en: Young people sometimes use mega in front of nouns in order to emphasize that the thing they are talking about is very good, very large, or very impressive.

ext.ext_cn: 学生们遵照这一评语修改了他们的论文，并交上去进行最后的评审。
ext.ext_en: Following this critique, students rewrite their papers and submit them for final evaluation...

ext.ext_cn: 在拍摄期间，剧本一直在进行修改。
ext.ext_en: The script was rewritten constantly during filming.

defs.def_en: If someone rewrites a piece of writing such as a book, an article, or a law, they write it in a different way in order to improve it.

ext.ext_cn: 不管他们如何篡改历史，我们一直都是一个独立的民族。
ext.ext_en: We have always been an independent people, no matter how they rewrite history...

ext.ext_cn: 正如奥威尔指出的那样，历史能够而且经常被改写以迎合当下的需要。
ext.ext_en: As Orwell pointed out, history can be and often is rewritten to suit the needs of the present.

defs.def_en: If you accuse a government of rewriting history, you are criticizing them for selecting and presenting particular historical events in a way that suits their own purposes.

ext.ext_cn: 在此3年间刷新了所有纪录的超级西南球队
ext.ext_en: ...the extraordinary West Country team that have rewritten all the record books in those three years...

ext.ext_cn: 库尔尼科娃决心改写网球史。
ext.ext_en: Kournikova is poised to rewrite the tennis history books.

defs.def_en: When journalists say that a sports player has rewritten the record books or the history books, they mean that the player has broken a record or several records.

ext.ext_cn: 只有经过了无数次修改后，约翰才认为剧本写好了。
ext.ext_en: Only after countless rewrites did John consider the script ready.

defs.def_en: In the film and television industries, a rewrite is the writing of parts of a film again in order to improve it.

defs.def_cn: （能轻松解决难题的）灵丹妙药

ext.ext_en: A lot of people are looking for some sort of magic bullet that will solve this problem.

defs.def_en: A magic bullet is an easy solution to a difficult problem.

ext.ext_cn: 古董商
ext.ext_en: ...an antique dealer.

ext.ext_cn: 商品和金融证券交易商
ext.ext_en: ...dealers in commodities and financial securities.

defs.def_en: See also:wheeler-dealer;A dealer is a person whose business involves buying and selling things.

defs.def_en: A dealer is someone who buys and sells illegal drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 救济品被分发给困难人群。
ext.ext_en: Alms were distributed to those in need.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He'd always been odd, but not to this extent...

ext.ext_cn: 他居然认识你的家人，真是太巧了。
ext.ext_en: What an odd coincidence that he should have known your family...

ext.ext_en: He had various odd cleaning jobs around the place...

defs.def_en: You use odd before a noun to indicate that you are not mentioning the type, size, or quality of something because it is not important.

ext.ext_en: How many pages was it, 500 odd?...

ext.ext_en: He has now appeared in sixty odd films...

defs.def_en: You use odd after a number to indicate that it is only approximate.

ext.ext_en: The odd numbers are on the left as you walk up the street...

ext.ext_cn: 候选人总数为单数。
ext.ext_en: There's an odd number of candidates.

defs.def_en: Odd numbers, such as 3 and 17, are those which cannot be divided exactly by the number two.

defs.def_cn: 不同类的；不成对的；单只的

ext.ext_cn: 顺便提一下，我今天穿的袜子不成对。
ext.ext_en: I'm wearing odd socks today by the way.

defs.def_en: You say that two things are odd when they do not belong to the same set or pair.

defs.def_cn: 与集体不合的人；剩下孤零零的一人；异类

ext.ext_cn: 阿塞拜疆没有举行民主选举，是这些共和国中的异类。
ext.ext_en: Azerbaijan has been the odd man out, the one republic not to hold democratic elections...

ext.ext_cn: 只剩下马克和里克声称喜欢喝这种樱桃啤酒。
ext.ext_en: Mark and Rick were the odd ones out in claiming to like this cherry beer.

defs.def_en: The odd man out ,the odd woman out, or the odd one out in a particular situation is a person who is different from the other people in it.

ext.ext_cn: “车是什么颜色？”“红色。”
ext.ext_en: 'What colour is the car?' — 'Red.'...

ext.ext_cn: 她的丝绸连衣裙是天蓝色的，和她眼睛的颜色一样。
ext.ext_en: Her silk dress was sky-blue, the colour of her eyes...

defs.def_en: The colour of something is the appearance that it has as a result of the way in which it reflects light. Red, blue, and green are colours.

ext.ext_cn: 美体小铺草本染发剂
ext.ext_en: ...The Body Shop Herbal Hair Colour...

ext.ext_cn: 最好不要吃任何食用色素。
ext.ext_en: It is better to avoid all food colours.

defs.def_en: A colour is a substance you use to give something a particular colour. Dyes and make-up are sometimes referred to as colours .

defs.def_cn: (用染料、颜料等)给…着色(或染色)

ext.ext_cn: 很多女人在三十五岁左右开始染发。
ext.ext_en: Many women begin colouring their hair in their mid-30s...

ext.ext_cn: 我们一直在做蛋糕，给海报上色。
ext.ext_en: We'd been making cakes and colouring the posters...

defs.def_en: If you colour something, you use something such as dyes or paint to change its colour.

ext.ext_cn: 安德鲁不禁注意到她有点脸红了。
ext.ext_en: Andrew couldn't help noticing that she coloured slightly.

defs.def_en: If someone colours, their face becomes redder than it normally is, usually because they are embarrassed.

ext.ext_cn: 我不在乎她的肤色。
ext.ext_en: I don't care what colour she is...

ext.ext_cn: 他承认在这种情况下泰勒先生的肤色和种族出身完全无关紧要。
ext.ext_en: He acknowledged that Mr Taylor's colour and ethnic origins were utterly irrelevant in the circumstances.

defs.def_en: Someone's colour is the colour of their skin. People often use colour in this way to refer to a person's race.

ext.ext_cn: 现在，日本99%的家庭都拥有彩色电视机。
ext.ext_en: In Japan 99 per cent of all households now have a colour television set.

defs.def_en: A colour television, photograph, or picture is one that shows things in all their colours, and not just in black, white, and grey.

ext.ext_cn: 她重新开始了旅行，那是增加自己小说的深度和趣味性所必不可少的。
ext.ext_en: She had resumed the travel necessary to add depth and colour to her novels.

defs.def_en: See also:local colour;Colour is a quality that makes something especially interesting or exciting.

ext.ext_cn: 媒体往往描绘的只是爱尔兰的负面形象，影响了大家的看法，掩盖了这个国家的真实面貌。
ext.ext_en: All too often it is only the negative images of Ireland that are portrayed, colouring opinions and hiding the true nature of the country...

ext.ext_cn: 父母对学知识是否有用的态度必定会影响孩子对待学业的态度。
ext.ext_en: The attitude of the parents toward the usefulness of what is learned must colour the way children approach school.

defs.def_en: If something colours your opinion, it affects the way that you think about something.

ext.ext_cn: 歌剧院是以匈牙利国旗的颜色——绿、红、白三色装饰的。
ext.ext_en: The Opera House is decorated with the Hungarian national colours: green, red and white.

defs.def_en: A country's national colours are the colours of its national flag.

ext.ext_cn: 部队在一个特殊的仪式上升起了国旗。
ext.ext_en: Troops raised the country's colors in a special ceremony.

ext.ext_cn: 营旗
ext.ext_en: ...the battalion's colours.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to the flag of a particular part of an army, navy, or air force, or the flag of a particular country as its colours .

ext.ext_cn: 我穿着该队队衣。
ext.ext_en: I was wearing the team's colours.

defs.def_en: A sports team's colours are the colours of the clothes they wear when they play.

defs.def_cn: (考试考得)极好地，成绩出色地

ext.ext_cn: 到目前为止，麦卡利斯特似乎所有的考试都考得非常好。
ext.ext_en: So far McAllister seemed to have passed all the tests with flying colors.

defs.def_en: If you pass a test with flying colours, you have done very well in the test.

ext.ext_cn: 他会放那部电影吗？是彩色的吗？
ext.ext_en: Was he going to show the film? Was it in colour?...

ext.ext_cn: 之后你就可以回家，看彩色版的电视连续剧《摩斯警长》。
ext.ext_en: You can go home afterwards and watch Inspector Morse in colour.

defs.def_en: If a film or television programme is in colour, it has been made so that you see the picture in all its colours, and not just in black, white, or grey.

ext.ext_cn: 我要非常明确地表明自己对这个主题的看法：作为一名女权主义者我认为这类电影是对女性的侮辱。
ext.ext_en: I shall nail my colours firmly to the mast on this subject — as a feminist I find movies like this offensive.

defs.def_en: If someone nails their colours to the mast, they say what they really think about something.

ext.ext_cn: 他表示坚决支持多布森先生。
ext.ext_en: He has nailed his colours firmly to Mr Dobson's mast...

ext.ext_cn: 肯尼迪先生表示支持单一货币制。
ext.ext_en: Mr Kennedy nailed his colours to the mast of the single currency.

defs.def_en: If you nail your colours to someone's mast, or if you nail your colours to a particular mast, you show that you support a particular person or issue.

defs.def_cn: 看(某人)有没有足够的支付能力

ext.ext_cn: 他心里暗暗记住，顾客至少要看上去能付得起钱，他才会去和他们搭话。
ext.ext_en: He made a mental note never to enter into conversation with a customer until he'd at least seen the colour of his money.

defs.def_en: If you say that you want to see the colour of someone's money, you mean that you are not prepared to sell them something or do something for them until they have proved that they have the money to pay for it.

ext.ext_cn: 黑人群体大声疾呼，要求维护有色人种的权利。
ext.ext_en: Black communities spoke up to defend the rights of all people of color.

defs.def_en: People of colour are people who belong to a race with dark skins.

defs.def_cn: (看到)…的真面目;露出…的真面目

ext.ext_cn: 现在，孩子们第一次看到他的真面目。
ext.ext_en: The children are seeing him in his true colours for the first time now...

ext.ext_cn: 现在时间一长，这个机构就露出了真面目，效率低下，差错百出。
ext.ext_en: Here, the organization has had time to show its true colours, to show its inefficiency and its bungling.

defs.def_en: If you see someone in their true colours or if they show their true colours, you realize what they are really like.

ext.ext_cn: 不幸的是，几乎不可能看到这些重大问题得到回复。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately, there is little prospect of seeing these big questions answered...

ext.ext_cn: 该国经历8年内战之后重归和平的前景正逐渐变得光明。
ext.ext_en: The prospects for peace in the country's eight-year civil war are becoming brighter...

defs.def_en: If there is some prospect of something happening, there is a possibility that it will happen.

defs.def_cn: 期望中的事；将要发生的事；预期；展望

ext.ext_cn: 他们现在面临的情形是：不久将需要依法佩戴摩托车头盔。
ext.ext_en: They now face the prospect of having to wear a cycling helmet by law...

ext.ext_cn: 晚饭后，他会架起脚来看书。想起来就让人愉快。
ext.ext_en: After supper he'd put his feet up and read. It was a pleasant prospect.

defs.def_en: A particular prospect is something that you expect or know is going to happen.

defs.def_cn: （尤指事业的）成功机会，前景，前途

ext.ext_cn: 我选择出国工作以求在事业上有更好的发展。
ext.ext_en: I chose to work abroad to improve my career prospects.

ext.ext_cn: 对该公司前景的详细考查
ext.ext_en: ...a detailed review of the company's prospects.

defs.def_en: Someone's prospects are their chances of being successful, especially in their career.

ext.ext_cn: 他已在从戈壁沙漠到德兰士瓦的无数地方勘探过矿藏。
ext.ext_en: He had prospected for minerals everywhere from the Gobi Desert to the Transvaal...

ext.ext_cn: 事实上，石油公司已经在离此不远处进行勘探。
ext.ext_en: In fact, the oil companies are already prospecting not far from here.

defs.def_en: When people prospect for oil, gold, or some other valuable substance, they look for it in the ground or under the sea.

ext.ext_cn: 对布尔什维克主义理想的信奉
ext.ext_en: ...commitment to the ideals of Bolshevism.

defs.def_en: Commitment is a strong belief in an idea or system.

ext.ext_cn: 我承担了很多责任。
ext.ext_en: I've got a lot of commitments...

ext.ext_cn: 她的工作迫使她和儿子从雷克雅未克搬走。
ext.ext_en: Work commitments forced her to uproot herself and her son from Reykjavik.

defs.def_en: A commitment is something which regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

ext.ext_cn: 我们承诺继续合作。
ext.ext_en: We made a commitment to keep working together...

ext.ext_cn: 他们承诺要维护和平。
ext.ext_en: They made a commitment to peace.

defs.def_en: If you make a commitment to do something, you promise that you will do it.
Commitment is the process of officially sending someone to a prison or to hospital.

ext.ext_cn: 两个小毛孩在他们前面屁颠屁颠地跑开了。
ext.ext_en: Two very small children scuttled away in front of them...

ext.ext_cn: 几只螃蟹沿着泥泞的河堤快速横行。
ext.ext_en: Crabs scuttle along the muddy bank.

defs.def_en: When people or small animals scuttle somewhere, they run there with short quick steps.

ext.ext_cn: 这种威胁会阻挠和平会议。
ext.ext_en: Such threats could scuttle the peace conference.

defs.def_en: To scuttle a plan or a proposal means to make it fail or cause it to stop.

ext.ext_cn: 他个人已收到莱曼司令要求凿沉轮船的命令。
ext.ext_en: He personally had received orders from Commander Lehmann to scuttle the ship.

defs.def_en: To scuttle a ship means to sink it deliberately by making holes in the bottom.
A scuttle is the same as a coal scuttle .

ext.ext_cn: 偏僻的当风山坡
ext.ext_en: ...the remote and windswept hillside.

defs.def_en: A windswept place has no shelter and is not protected against strong winds.

ext.ext_cn: 我打发空余时间的轻松办法
ext.ext_en: ...a relaxing way to fill my leisure time.

ext.ext_cn: 英国最受欢迎的休闲活动之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of Britain's most popular leisure activities.

defs.def_en: Leisure is the time when you are not working and you can relax and do things that you enjoy.

defs.def_cn: 从容不迫；不慌不忙；慢悠悠

ext.ext_cn: 您可在花园里闲逛。
ext.ext_en: You will be able to stroll at leisure through the gardens...

ext.ext_cn: 他可以悠然阅读所有的全国性报纸。
ext.ext_en: He could read all the national papers at his leisure.

defs.def_en: If someone does something at leisure or at their leisure, they enjoy themselves by doing it when they want to, without hurrying.

defs.def_cn: （尤指心生怀疑时）评估，品评，对…作出评价

ext.ext_cn: 当我第一次走进招募官的办公室时，他考量了我一番。
ext.ext_en: My recruiting sergeant weighed me up when I first walked into his office.

defs.def_en: If you weigh someone up, you try and find out what they are like and form an opinion of them, especially when you are suspicious of them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 从事重复性工作的工厂工人
ext.ext_en: ...factory workers who do repetitive jobs...

ext.ext_cn: 突然间，似乎索然无味且反反复复的音乐生动了起来。
ext.ext_en: Suddenly music that seemed dull and repetitive comes alive.

defs.def_en: Something that is repetitive involves actions or elements that are repeated many times and is therefore boring.

ext.ext_cn: 反复运动引起的问题
ext.ext_en: ...problems that occur as the result of repetitive movements.

defs.def_en: Repetitive movements or sounds are repeated many times.

defs.def_cn: 专题调查委员会;特别工作组

ext.ext_cn: 他们设立了一个特别工作组来调查这个问题。
ext.ext_en: They set up a working party to look into the issue.

ext.ext_cn: 财政调查委员会
ext.ext_en: ...a finance working party.

defs.def_en: A working party is a committee which is formed to investigate a particular situation or problem and to produce a report containing its opinions and suggestions.

ext.ext_cn: 米克一把夺过阿奇手里的牌。
ext.ext_en: Mick snatched the cards from Archie's hand...

ext.ext_cn: 他迅速地抓起了话筒。
ext.ext_en: He snatched up the telephone...

defs.def_en: If you snatch something or snatch at something, you take it or pull it away quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 要是有人抢你的包，就让他拿去。
ext.ext_en: If your bag is snatched, let it go...

ext.ext_cn: 上周四希尔曼先生被绑匪劫走了。
ext.ext_en: Mr Hillman was snatched by kidnappers last Thursday.

defs.def_en: If something is snatched from you, it is stolen, usually using force. If a person is snatched, they are taken away by force.

defs.def_cn: 抓住(机会);抓紧时间(吃东西、休息等);抽空做

ext.ext_cn: 我乘机瞥了一眼镜子。
ext.ext_en: I snatched a glance at the mirror...

ext.ext_cn: 你甚至可以抓紧时间休息几个小时。
ext.ext_en: You can even snatch a few hours off...

defs.def_en: If you snatch an opportunity, you take it quickly. If you snatch something to eat or a rest, you have it quickly in between doing other things.

ext.ext_cn: 美国人后来居上，仅以 8 秒钟的优势赢得了胜利。
ext.ext_en: The American came from behind to snatch victory by a mere eight seconds...

ext.ext_cn: 切斯特菲尔德攻入第三粒进球。
ext.ext_en: Chesterfield snatched a third goal.

defs.def_en: If you snatch victory in a competition, you defeat your opponent by a small amount or just before the end of the contest.

ext.ext_cn: 我听见了一点谈话内容。
ext.ext_en: I heard snatches of the conversation.

defs.def_en: A snatch of a conversation or a song is a very small piece of it.

If someone snatches victory from the jaws of defeat, they win when it seems that they are certain to lose. If someone snatches defeat from the jaws of victory, they lose when it seems that they are certain to win.

defs.def_cn: 消遣;帮人逃避现实的事物

ext.ext_cn: 占星术只不过是让人逃避越发令人沮丧的世界的无害消遣罢了。
ext.ext_en: Horoscopes are merely harmless escapism from an ever-bleaker world.

defs.def_en: If you describe an activity or type of entertainment as escapism, you mean that it makes people think about pleasant things instead of the uninteresting or unpleasant aspects of their life.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你决定不买，你在调查上花的钱是收不回来的。
ext.ext_en: If you decide not to buy, the money you have spent on the survey is not recoverable.

defs.def_en: If something is recoverable, it is possible for you to get it back.

ext.ext_cn: 政府官员的无能令人震惊。
ext.ext_en: The incompetence of government officials is appalling.

ext.ext_cn: 他未能实施全面调查
ext.ext_en: ...his incompetence in failing to conduct full inquiries.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's incompetence, you are criticizing them because they are unable to do their job or a task properly.

ext.ext_cn: 她那时在服用兴奋剂和抑制剂。
ext.ext_en: She was taking uppers and downers at the time.

defs.def_en: Downers are drugs that make you feel sleepy or very calm.

defs.def_cn: 令人悲伤(或沮丧)的情景

ext.ext_cn: 对离异的人来说，圣诞节令人感伤。
ext.ext_en: For divorced people, Christmas can be a downer.

ext.ext_cn: 自从利物浦比赛以来，我们一直有点沮丧。
ext.ext_en: We've been on a bit of a downer since the Liverpool game.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as a downer, you think that it is very depressing.

ext.ext_cn: 她站在那儿，望着小汽车的尾灯消失在车道尽头。
ext.ext_en: She stood watching the car's tail-lights disappear down the drive.

defs.def_en: The tail-lights on a car or other vehicle are the two red lights at the back.

ext.ext_cn: 高速公路限速每小时 55 英里。
ext.ext_en: The speed limit on the freeway is 55mph.

ext.ext_cn: 波士顿的高速公路系统
ext.ext_en: ...Boston's freeway system.

defs.def_en: A freeway is a major road that has been specially built for fast travel over long distances. Freeways have several lanes and special places where traffic gets on and leaves.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自命不凡的；自负的；矫饰的；炫耀的

ext.ext_cn: 他的答复是一派荒谬的虚夸之词。
ext.ext_en: His response was full of pretentious nonsense...

ext.ext_cn: 这个酒吧风格独特，面积不大，比较低调。
ext.ext_en: This pub was of a very different type, smaller, less pretentious.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is pretentious, you mean that they try to seem important or significant, but you do not think that they are.
A pager is a small electronic device which you can carry around with you and which gives you a number or a message when someone is trying to contact you.

defs.def_cn: （以开车撞碎商店玻璃的方式进行的）飞车抢劫

ext.ext_cn: 昨天清晨车站路的一家商店遭到了飞车抢劫。
ext.ext_en: A shop in Station Road was the target of a ram-raid early yesterday.

defs.def_en: A ram-raid is the crime of using a car to drive into and break a shop window in order to steal things from the shop.

defs.def_cn: （以开车撞碎商店玻璃的方式进行）飞车抢劫

ext.ext_cn: 那些开偷来的车狂飙和驾车抢劫的年轻人都是无业游民。
ext.ext_en: The kids who are joyriding and ram-raiding are unemployed.

defs.def_en: If people ram-raid, they use a car to drive into and break a shop window in order to steal things from the shop.

defs.def_cn: (警方为侦破重大案件或处理突发事件成立的)专案室

ext.ext_cn: 警方已经设立了专案室，开始调查今天早上的枪击事件。
ext.ext_en: Police have set up an incident room as they begin to investigate this morning's fire.

defs.def_en: An incident room is a room used by the police while they are dealing with a major crime or accident.

defs.def_cn: (用于储存园艺工具等的)简易房，小棚屋，小屋

ext.ext_cn: 园艺工艺棚
ext.ext_en: ...a garden shed.

defs.def_en: A shed is a small building that is used for storing things such as garden tools.

defs.def_cn: (车站、港口、工厂等里面的)棚式建筑物，厂房,工棚,库房

ext.ext_cn: 废弃的铁路工棚
ext.ext_en: ...disused railway sheds.

defs.def_en: A shed is a large shelter or building, for example at a railway station, port, or factory.

ext.ext_cn: 有些树已经开始落叶了。
ext.ext_en: Some of the trees were already beginning to shed their leaves.

ext.ext_cn: 已经蜕皮的蛇
ext.ext_en: ...a snake who has shed its skin.

defs.def_en: When a tree sheds its leaves, its leaves fall off in the autumn. When an animal sheds hair or skin, some of its hair or skin drops off.

ext.ext_cn: 公司将裁员 700 人。
ext.ext_en: The firm is to shed 700 jobs...

ext.ext_cn: 他严格地坚持节食，减了差不多 20  磅。
ext.ext_en: He had maintained a rigid diet, shedding some twenty pounds.

defs.def_en: To shed something means to get rid of it.

ext.ext_cn: 一辆载满废金属的卡车掉货了。
ext.ext_en: A lorry piled with scrap metal had shed its load.

defs.def_en: If a lorry sheds its load, the goods that it is carrying accidentally fall onto the road.

ext.ext_cn: 他们会在女儿的婚礼上落泪的。
ext.ext_en: They will shed a few tears at their daughter's wedding.

defs.def_en: If you shed tears, you cry.

defs.def_cn: 屠杀;导致惨死;(通常指在战争中)流血死亡,惨死

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔斯特的持枪歹徒制造了新一年的首起流血事件。
ext.ext_en: Gunmen in Ulster shed the first blood of the new year...

ext.ext_cn: 其他人承诺要“抛头颅、洒热血、抗击侵略者”。
ext.ext_en: Others promised to 'shed our blood and sacrifice our lives to oppose the invaders'.

defs.def_en: To shed blood means to kill people in a violent way. If someone sheds their blood, they are killed in a violent way, usually when they are fighting in a war.

ext.ext_cn: 饥饿使他产生了幻觉。
ext.ext_en: Hunger made him hallucinate.

ext.ext_cn: 如果长时间目不转睛地盯着看，你甚至会产生幻觉，看到一些小岛的出现。
ext.ext_en: If you stared long enough and hard, you could even begin to hallucinate the appearance of small islands.

defs.def_en: If you hallucinate, you see things that are not really there, either because you are ill or because you have taken a drug.
Bovine means relating to cattle.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 蠢笨的；反应迟钝的；呆头呆脑的

ext.ext_cn: 人群毫无热情的迟钝反应使我感到很沮丧。
ext.ext_en: I'm depressed by the bovine enthusiasm of the crowd's response.

ext.ext_en: Many people thrive on a stressful lifestyle...

ext.ext_en: Creative people are usually very determined and thrive on overcoming obstacles.

ext.ext_en: 'This is not good,' he said with great seriousness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the tedious business of line-by-line programming.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a job, task, or situation as tedious, you mean it is boring and rather frustrating.

ext.ext_en: For the past few days Corinne has been living on an emotional tightrope.

ext.ext_en: She muttered something unintelligible and lapsed into silence...

ext.ext_en: Teenagers occasionally find it all too much to cope with and lapse into bad behaviour.

defs.def_en: If someone lapses into a particular way of speaking, or behaving, they start speaking or behaving in that way, usually for a short period.

ext.ext_en: There is usually a time lapse between receipt of new information and its publication.

ext.ext_en: The rooms are admirably cool and shady after the hot brown monotony of the countryside.

defs.def_en: You can describe a place as shady when you like the fact that it is sheltered from bright sunlight, for example by trees or buildings.

ext.ext_cn: 克拉拉一直坐在树阴下的躺椅上看书。
ext.ext_en: Clara had been reading in a lounge chair under a shady tree.

defs.def_en: Shady trees provide a lot of shade.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可疑的;鬼鬼祟祟的;不正当的

ext.ext_cn: 该公司因其不法交易而臭名昭著。
ext.ext_en: The company was notorious for shady deals...

ext.ext_cn: 约瑟夫看到一群可疑的人在密西西比河的一艘轮船上打牌。
ext.ext_en: Joseph watched a shady-looking bunch playing cards aboard a Mississippi steamer.

defs.def_en: You can describe activities as shady when you think that they might be dishonest or illegal. You can also use shady to describe people who are involved in such activities.

defs.def_cn: 竭力争取(支持);兜揽(生意)

ext.ext_cn: 联合国秘书长抵达东京竭力为国际维和争取支持。
ext.ext_en: The UN secretary-general arrived in Tokyo to drum up support for international peacekeeping...

ext.ext_cn: 但愿他只是在招揽生意。
ext.ext_en: It is to be hoped that he is merely drumming up business.

defs.def_en: If you drum up support or business, you try to get it.

ext.ext_cn: 基本上所有交到邮局柜台的文件都会加盖橡皮图章。
ext.ext_en: In Post Offices, virtually every document that's passed across the counter is stamped with a rubber stamp.

defs.def_en: A rubber stamp is a small device with a name, date, or symbol on it. You press it on to an ink pad and then on to a document in order to show that the document has been officially dealt with.

defs.def_cn: 随便同意;不加思索就批准

ext.ext_cn: 国会的工作就是例行公事式地批准他作出的决定。
ext.ext_en: Parliament's job is to rubber-stamp his decisions...

ext.ext_cn: 将近60家银行已经不加思索地批准了一项重新融资的交易。
ext.ext_en: Nearly 60 banks have rubber-stamped a refinancing deal.

defs.def_en: When someone in authority rubber-stamps a decision, plan, or law, they agree to it without thinking about it much.

defs.def_cn: (讨论或谈判中的)僵持点，障碍;(问题的)症结

ext.ext_cn: 主要的症结是税收问题。
ext.ext_en: The main sticking point was the question of taxes.

defs.def_en: A sticking point in a discussion or series of negotiations is a point on which the people involved cannot agree and which may delay or stop the talks. A sticking point is also one aspect of a problem which you have trouble dealing with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 古怪的;乖僻的;滑稽可笑的

ext.ext_cn: 新的搞笑电视系列喜剧
ext.ext_en: ...a wacky new television comedy series...

ext.ext_cn: 太空科学家想法古怪是不足为奇的。
ext.ext_en: Wacky ideas are commonplace among space scientists.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as wacky, you mean that they are eccentric, unusual, and often funny.

RP is a way of pronouncing British English that is often considered to be the standard accent. Pronunciations in this dictionary are given in RP. RP is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'Received Pronunciation'.

ext.ext_cn: 苏珊·汉金森博士对5万多名女性的饮食习惯进行了研究。
ext.ext_en: Dr Susan Hankinson has studied the dietary habits of more than 50,000 women...

ext.ext_cn: 像所有改变饮食结构的情况一样，减少盐的摄入量也应当采取渐进的方式。
ext.ext_en: As with all dietary changes, reducing salt should be done gradually.

defs.def_en: You can use dietary to describe anything that concerns a person's diet.

ext.ext_cn: 膳食纤维的一种来源
ext.ext_en: ...a source of dietary fibre.

defs.def_en: You can use the word dietary to describe substances such as fibre and fat that are found in food.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我明白我以前错怪你了。
ext.ext_en: I see I was mistaken about you...

ext.ext_cn: 亚历克斯，你真是大错特错，你对局势的判断根本不对。
ext.ext_en: You couldn't be more mistaken, Alex. You've utterly misread the situation.

defs.def_en: If you are mistaken about something, you are wrong about it.

ext.ext_cn: 我对当时发生的事情曾有一种错误的认识。
ext.ext_en: I had a mistaken view of what was happening.

ext.ext_cn: 对上瘾的有限认识和关于如何将其戒除的错误观念
ext.ext_en: ...a limited understanding of addiction and mistaken beliefs about how it can be overcome.

defs.def_en: A mistaken belief or opinion is incorrect.
A borrower is a person or organization that borrows money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们有时候在户外吃饭。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes we eat out of doors...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在室外的时候，你不担心吗？
ext.ext_en: Don't you worry about them when they're out of doors?

defs.def_en: also out-of-doors. If you are out of doors, you are outside a building rather than inside it.

defs.def_cn: （使）（地方、经济、兴趣领域等）开放

ext.ext_cn: 随着市场的放开，我认为人们将能够增加用于消费品的支出。
ext.ext_en: As the market opens up, I think people are going to be able to spend more money on consumer goods...

ext.ext_cn: 他说他想看看阿尔巴尼亚是如何对外开放的。
ext.ext_en: He said he wanted to see how Albania was opening up to the world...

defs.def_en: If a place, economy, or area of interest opens up, or if someone opens it up, more people can go there or become involved in it.

defs.def_cn: （使）（机会、可能性等）出现；（使）产生

ext.ext_cn: 人们也认为这一制度的崩溃带来了各种新的可能性。
ext.ext_en: It was also felt that the collapse of the system opened up new possibilities...

ext.ext_cn: 希望更加直接地参股海外公司的投资者获得了新的机会。
ext.ext_en: New opportunities are opening up for investors who want a more direct stake in overseas companies.

defs.def_en: If something opens up opportunities or possibilities, or if they open up, they are created.

defs.def_cn: （通常指大幅度地在比赛中）取得（领先地位）

ext.ext_cn: 中国队取得了两分多钟的领先优势。
ext.ext_en: The Chinese team had opened up a lead of more than two minutes.

defs.def_en: If you open up a lead in a race or competition, you get yourself into a position where you are leading, usually by quite a long way.

ext.ext_cn: 当邮政局长和妻子到邮局开门营业时，3名持械男子正等着他们。
ext.ext_en: Three armed men were waiting when the postmaster and his wife arrived to open up the shop...

ext.ext_cn: 把门打开，不然我要砸门了！
ext.ext_en: Open up, or I break in!

defs.def_en: When you open up a building, you unlock and open the door so that people can get in.

defs.def_cn: 畅谈；无拘无束地谈；自由自在地谈

ext.ext_cn: 洛娜发现人们愿意对她畅所欲言。
ext.ext_en: Lorna found that people were willing to open up to her.

defs.def_en: If someone opens up, they start to say exactly what they think or feel.

ext.ext_cn: 东西柏林之间经济上的悬殊
ext.ext_en: ...the economic disparities between East and West Berlin.

ext.ext_cn: 贫富国家间的财富鸿沟
ext.ext_en: ...the great disparity of wealth between rich and poor countries.

defs.def_en: If there is a disparity between two or more things, there is a noticeable difference between them.

ext.ext_cn: 那么，你认为她怎么样？
ext.ext_en: Well, what did you make of her?...

ext.ext_cn: 南希不知应该如何理解米克的道歉。
ext.ext_en: Nancy wasn't sure what to make of Mick's apology.

defs.def_en: If you ask a person what they make of something, you want to know what their impression, opinion, or understanding of it is.

ext.ext_cn: 健康食品商店
ext.ext_en: ...health food shops.

ext.ext_cn: 音像店
ext.ext_en: ...a record shop...

defs.def_en: A shop is a building or part of a building where things are sold.

ext.ext_cn: 他一直在合作社买东西。
ext.ext_en: He always shopped at the Co-op.

ext.ext_cn: 买新地毯时值得参考的一些建议
ext.ext_en: ...some advice that's worth bearing in mind when shopping for a new carpet.

defs.def_en: When you shop, you go to shops and buy things.

ext.ext_cn: 罗德尼有时去理发的那家理发店
ext.ext_en: ...the barber shop where Rodney sometimes had his hair cut.

ext.ext_cn: 彩票销售点
ext.ext_en: ...betting shops.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a place where a particular service is offered as a particular type of shop .

ext.ext_cn: 铁匠作坊
ext.ext_en: ...the blacksmith's shop.

ext.ext_cn: 修理厂
ext.ext_en: ...a repair shop.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a place where things are made or done as a particular kind of shop .

ext.ext_cn: 他父亲发现儿子在贩毒时深感憎恶，就向警察告发了他。
ext.ext_en: His father was so disgusted to discover his son was dealing drugs he shopped him to police...

ext.ext_cn: 诈骗犯经常会被正直守法的朋友和邻居告发。
ext.ext_en: Fraudsters are often shopped by honest friends and neighbours.

defs.def_en: If you shop someone, you report them to the police for doing something illegal.

ext.ext_cn: 这使他们可以肆意到处惹是生非，而不用担心受到惩罚。
ext.ext_en: This gave them the freedom to make trouble all over the shop without fear of retribution.

defs.def_en: If something is happening all over the shop, it is happening in many different places or throughout a wide area.

ext.ext_cn: 他自己开公司，做起了独立公共关系顾问。
ext.ext_en: He set up shop as an independent PR consultant...

ext.ext_cn: 他刚刚在瑟堡开业不久。
ext.ext_en: He has just set up shop in Cherbourg.

defs.def_en: If you set up shop, you start a business.

defs.def_cn: (商店、办事处、公司)休息，下班，打烊，停业，歇业

ext.ext_cn: 他们要是看到这账单，早就关门歇业逃到国外去了。
ext.ext_en: If they had been faced with the bill they'd have shut up shop and fled the country.

defs.def_en: When a shop, office, or firm shuts up shop, it stops doing business and closes, either at the end of the day or permanently.

defs.def_cn: 谈论本行工作;三句话不离本行

ext.ext_cn: 如果整天和同事泡在一起的话，你最终就会变得开口闭口都是工作。
ext.ext_en: If you hang around with colleagues all the time you just end up talking shop.

defs.def_en: If you say that people are talking shop, you mean that they are talking about their work, and this is boring for other people who do not do the same work.

ext.ext_cn: 青瘀在6周内就消退了，但伤却是6个月后才全好了。
ext.ext_en: Within six weeks the bruising had gone, but it was six months before it all healed...

ext.ext_cn: 如果他们当时马上就给她的胳膊做手术并用钢针固定，她现在可能已经痊愈了。
ext.ext_en: If they'd operated and pinned her arm at once, she might have healed by now...

defs.def_en: When a broken bone or other injury heals or when something heals it, it becomes healthy and normal again.

defs.def_cn: （感情创伤）愈合;（情感）恢复常态

ext.ext_cn: 一年以后，她的感情创伤已慢慢愈合，至少能考虑和另一个男性开始恋爱关系了。
ext.ext_en: A year later, she had healed to the point of at least being able to consider a romantic relationship with another man...

ext.ext_cn: 只有充分感受了深切的痛苦，我们才能从中走出，并将它抛诸脑后。
ext.ext_en: Only by fully experiencing the depth of our pain can we be healed from it and be done with it.

defs.def_en: When someone's emotional pain heals, they feel normal and happy again.

ext.ext_cn: 如今索菲和她的姐姐已经和家人和好，每个周末都回家探望他们。
ext.ext_en: Today Sophie and her sister have healed the family rift and visit their family every weekend...

ext.ext_cn: 对美国造成的心理影响是巨大的，在华盛顿创伤仍未完全弥合。
ext.ext_en: The psychological effects on the United States were immense and in Washington the wounds have still not fully healed.

defs.def_en: If you heal something such as a rift or a wound, or if it heals, the situation is put right so that people are friendly or happy again.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 卷入的;参与的;与…有密切关联的

ext.ext_cn: 如果她投身商业的话,她会是一个很有能力的总裁。
ext.ext_en: If she were involved in business, she would make a strong chief executive...

ext.ext_cn: 在切尔诺贝利核泄漏灾难发生以后,她开始投身政界。
ext.ext_en: She became involved with political causes after the Chernobyl nuclear disaster...

defs.def_en: If you are involved in a situation or activity, you are taking part in it or have a strong connection with it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这家人非常注重学习犹太文化。
ext.ext_en: The family were deeply involved in Jewish culture.

ext.ext_cn: 忙于事业以至于无暇顾及友谊的女性
ext.ext_en: ...women who are so involved in their careers that they have no time for friendship.

defs.def_en: If you are involved in something, you give a lot of time, effort, or attention to it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们认为完成这项任务所必须付出的时间与辛苦都是值得的。
ext.ext_en: We believe the time and hard work involved in completing such an assignment are worthwhile...

ext.ext_cn: 他不能透露该计划投入了多少钱。
ext.ext_en: He cannot reveal how much money is involved in the scheme...

defs.def_en: The things involved in something such as a job or system are the necessary parts or consequences of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 复杂难懂的;棘手的;难处理的

ext.ext_cn: 手术可能非常复杂,需要对多处进行手术。
ext.ext_en: The operations can be quite involved, requiring many procedures.

defs.def_en: If a situation or activity is involved, it has a lot of different parts or aspects, often making it difficult to understand, explain, or do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 关系暧昧的;有情爱关系的

ext.ext_cn: 他与一位已婚妇女产生了恋情。
ext.ext_en: He became romantically involved with a married woman.

defs.def_en: If one person is involved with another, especially someone they are not married to, they are having a sexual or romantic relationship.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 固执己见的；一意孤行的；爱出风头的

ext.ext_cn: 她是个自信又固执己见的年轻女性。
ext.ext_en: She was a confident and pushy young woman...

ext.ext_cn: 我的母亲鼓励我们但从不强迫我们。
ext.ext_en: My mother encouraged us, but was never pushy.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as pushy, you mean that they try in a forceful way to get things done as they would like or to increase their status or influence.

defs.def_cn: (贴在汽车、摩托车上的)圆形纳税凭证
defs.def_en: In Britain, a tax disc is a small round piece of paper displayed on cars and motorcycles which proves that the owner has paid road tax.

defs.def_cn: 法利赛人（《圣经·新约》中提到的严守犹太教律法的犹太人）
defs.def_en: The Pharisees were a group of Jews, mentioned in the New Testament of the Bible, who believed in strictly obeying the laws of Judaism.

ext.ext_cn: 邀请孩子们来玩
ext.ext_en: ...invite the children round to play...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在小花园里玩耍。
ext.ext_en: They played in the little garden...

defs.def_en: When children, animals, or perhaps adults play, they spend time doing enjoyable things, such as using toys and taking part in games.

ext.ext_cn: 那对双胞胎玩扑克牌的时候，弗朗西斯坐着看书。
ext.ext_en: While the twins played cards, Francis sat reading...

ext.ext_cn: 阿兰正和朋友打扑克牌。
ext.ext_en: Alain was playing cards with his friends...

defs.def_en: When you play a sport, game, or match, you take part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 北爱尔兰队将对阵拉脱维亚队。
ext.ext_en: Northern Ireland will play Latvia...

ext.ext_cn: 我已多次和他交手。
ext.ext_en: I've played against him a few times.

defs.def_en: When one person or team plays another or plays against them, they compete against them in a sport or game.

ext.ext_cn: 踢出球前先想一想。
ext.ext_en: Think first before playing the ball...

ext.ext_cn: 西坎德尔·巴克特击出一记坏球。
ext.ext_en: Sikander Bakht played a bad shot...

defs.def_en: When you play the ball or play a shot in a game or sport, you kick or hit the ball.

defs.def_cn: 开（玩笑）；耍（花招）；搞（恶作剧）

ext.ext_cn: 有人搞恶作剧整她，在最高的台阶上拉了一根绳子。
ext.ext_en: Someone had played a trick on her, stretched a piece of string at the top of those steps...

ext.ext_cn: 我想：“这不可能发生，肯定是谁在开玩笑。”
ext.ext_en: I thought: 'This cannot be happening, somebody must be playing a joke'.

defs.def_en: If you play a joke or a trick on someone, you deceive them or give them a surprise in a way that you think is funny, but that often causes problems for them or annoys them.

ext.ext_cn: 她眼睛盯着地板，漫不经心地摆弄着手提包的带子。
ext.ext_en: She stared at the floor, idly playing with the strap of her handbag.

defs.def_en: If you play with an object or with your hair, you keep moving it or touching it with your fingers, perhaps because you are bored or nervous.

ext.ext_cn: 这家剧团上演了一出讲述无家可归者的戏。
ext.ext_en: The company put on a play about the homeless...

ext.ext_cn: 它是我最喜欢的一部莎士比亚戏剧。
ext.ext_en: It's my favourite Shakespeare play.

defs.def_en: A play is a piece of writing which is performed in a theatre, on the radio, or on television.

ext.ext_cn: 他在其中饰演海德一角的《化身博士》
ext.ext_en: ...Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde, in which he played Hyde...

ext.ext_cn: 他渴望扮演德拉库拉。
ext.ext_en: His ambition is to play the part of Dracula.

defs.def_en: If an actor plays a role or character in a play or film, he or she performs the part of that character.

ext.ext_cn: 希尔想要充当和事佬。
ext.ext_en: Hill tried to play the peacemaker...

ext.ext_cn: 她只是装得像个尽心尽责的母亲似的。
ext.ext_en: She was just playing the devoted mother...

defs.def_en: You can use play to describe how someone behaves, when they are deliberately behaving in a certain way or like a certain type of person. For example, to play the innocent, means to pretend to be innocent, and to play deaf means to pretend not to hear something.

ext.ext_cn: 投资者审慎精明地行事。
ext.ext_en: Investors are playing it cautious, and they're playing it smart.

defs.def_en: You can describe how someone deals with a situation by saying that they play it in a certain way. For example, if someone plays it cool, they keep calm and do not show much emotion, and if someone plays it straight, they behave in an honest and direct way.

ext.ext_cn: 尼娜一直都在弹钢琴。
ext.ext_en: Nina had been playing the piano...

ext.ext_cn: 两人联手在一架钢琴上演奏爵士乐。
ext.ext_en: Two people played jazz on a piano...

defs.def_en: If you play a musical instrument or play a tune on a musical instrument, or if a musical instrument plays, music is produced from it.

ext.ext_cn: 她播放唱片时音量太大了。
ext.ext_en: She played her records too loudly...

ext.ext_cn: 那些日子里，英国广播公司每天晚上都会播放《天佑吾王》。
ext.ext_en: Every evening in those days the BBC played 'God Save The King'...

defs.def_en: If you play a record, a CD, or a tape, you put it into a machine and sound is produced. If a record, CD, or tape is playing, sound is being produced from it.

defs.def_cn: （音乐家、乐队等）表演；举办（音乐会）

ext.ext_cn: 乐队在表演。
ext.ext_en: A band was playing...

ext.ext_cn: 他将在阿姆斯特丹和巴黎举办音乐会。
ext.ext_en: He will play concerts in Amsterdam and Paris.

defs.def_en: If a musician or group of musicians plays or plays a concert, they perform music for people to listen or dance to.

ext.ext_cn: 阳光在结霜的屋顶上闪烁变幻。
ext.ext_en: The sun played on the frosty roofs.

defs.def_en: When light plays somewhere, it moves about on a surface in an unsteady way.

defs.def_cn: 搞什么名堂；干什么蠢事

ext.ext_cn: 你究竟在搞什么名堂？
ext.ext_en: What the hell are you playing at?

defs.def_en: If you ask what someone is playing at, you are angry because you think they are doing something stupid or wrong.

defs.def_cn: （使）开始活动；（使）投入使用； （使）开始起作用

ext.ext_cn: 存在选择军事手段的切实可能这一点将会起到作用。
ext.ext_en: The real existence of a military option will come into play...

ext.ext_cn: 呼吸使很多肌肉活动起来。
ext.ext_en: Breathing brings many muscles into play.

defs.def_en: When something comes into play or is brought into play, it begins to be used or to have an effect.

ext.ext_cn: 他们参与到了自己社区的生活中。
ext.ext_en: They played a part in the life of their community...
