ext.ext_en: ...political and economic systems that keep women poor and powerless.

defs.def_en: Someone who is powerless is unable to control or influence events.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 每天都有人被杀，而我却无力阻止。
ext.ext_en: People are being murdered every day and I am powerless to stop it...

ext.ext_cn: 他表示同情，但爱莫能助。
ext.ext_en: He was sympathetic, but powerless to help.

defs.def_en: If you are powerless to do something, you are completely unable to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 儿童不准收看含暴力内容的电视节目。
ext.ext_en: The children are not allowed to watch violent TV programmes...

ext.ext_cn: 政府将准许他们在广播和电视上做广告。
ext.ext_en: The Government will allow them to advertise on radio and television...

defs.def_en: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

ext.ext_cn: 巧克力、鲜花等礼物在允许之列。
ext.ext_en: Gifts like chocolates or flowers are allowed...

ext.ext_cn: 应该准许他偶尔也轻松一下。
ext.ext_en: He should be allowed the occasional treat.

defs.def_en: If you are allowed something, you are given permission to have it or are given it.

ext.ext_cn: 他不会任由自己失败的。
ext.ext_en: He won't allow himself to fail...

ext.ext_cn: 如果听任土壤变干，树木可能会枯死。
ext.ext_en: If the soil is allowed to dry out the tree could die.

defs.def_en: If you allow something to happen, you do not prevent it.

ext.ext_cn: 妥协将使他得以继续他的自由市场改革。
ext.ext_en: The compromise will allow him to continue his free market reforms.

ext.ext_cn: 使穆斯林多数派拥有更大权力的尝试
ext.ext_en: ...an attempt to allow the Moslem majority a greater share of power...

defs.def_en: If one thing allows another thing to happen, the first thing creates the opportunity for the second thing to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 请留出28天的送货时间。
ext.ext_en: Please allow 28 days for delivery...

ext.ext_cn: 每6份酌加约75毫升(3液盎司)。
ext.ext_en: Allow about 75ml (3fl oz) per six servings.

defs.def_en: If you allow a particular length of time or a particular amount of something for a particular purpose, you include it in your planning.

ext.ext_cn: 沃伦也承认资本主义发展初级阶段可能会导致社会不平等现象加剧。
ext.ext_en: Warren also allows that capitalist development may, in its early stages, result in increased social inequality.

defs.def_en: If you allow that something is true, you admit or agree that it is true.

defs.def_cn: 请允许我（用以礼貌地表示为某人提供服务）

ext.ext_cn: 让我来请你喝一杯。
ext.ext_en: Allow me to buy you a drink at the bar.

defs.def_en: Some people say 'Allow me' as a polite way of offering to do something for someone.

defs.def_cn: 请允许我（用以引出要说的话）

ext.ext_cn: 请允许我介绍安伯格博士。
ext.ext_en: Allow me to introduce Dr Amberg.

defs.def_en: Some people use Allow me to... as a way of introducing something that they want to say or do.
A sex aid is an object or piece of equipment that is designed to make sex easier or more enjoyable.

ext.ext_cn: 维克·塞克萨斯和多丽丝·哈特赢得了混合双打冠军。
ext.ext_en: Vic Seixas and Doris Hart won the mixed doubles.

ext.ext_cn: 混双决赛
ext.ext_en: ...the mixed doubles final.

defs.def_en: In some sports, such as tennis and badminton, mixed doubles is a match in which a man and a woman play as partners against another man and woman.

ext.ext_cn: 瑟堡有一个由绵延海堤环绕的美轮美奂的港口。
ext.ext_en: Cherbourg had a splendid harbour enclosed by a long sea wall.

defs.def_en: A sea wall is a wall built along the edge of the sea to stop the sea flowing over the land or destroying it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无益的；无意义的；无目的的

ext.ext_cn: 暴力总是毫无意义的。
ext.ext_en: Violence is always pointless...

ext.ext_cn: 没有观众，表演就不成其为表演了。
ext.ext_en: Without an audience the performance is pointless.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is pointless, you are criticizing it because it has no sense or purpose.
Something that is salmon pink or salmon is the orangey-pink colour of a salmon's flesh.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 长期忍受的；饱受磨难的

ext.ext_cn: 他回到约克郡，与对他忠贞不贰、饱受磨难的妻子团聚。
ext.ext_en: He went back to Yorkshire to join his loyal, long-suffering wife.

defs.def_en: Someone who is long-suffering patiently puts up with a lot of trouble or unhappiness, especially when it is caused by someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 他摇下车窗，把头探了出去。
ext.ext_en: He rolled down his window and stuck his face out...

ext.ext_cn: 一阵劲风迎面吹来。
ext.ext_en: A strong wind was blowing right in my face...

defs.def_en: Your face is the front part of your head from your chin to the top of your forehead, where your mouth, eyes, nose, and other features are.

ext.ext_cn: 他四处走着，神色哀伤。
ext.ext_en: He was walking around with a sad face...

ext.ext_cn: 神父在亮光下皱起了眉头，一脸疑惑。
ext.ext_en: The priest frowned into the light, his face puzzled.

defs.def_en: If your face is happy, sad, or serious, for example, the expression on your face shows that you are happy, sad, or serious.

defs.def_cn: 崖面;山侧;(建筑物的)墙面

ext.ext_cn: 艾格尔山北坡
ext.ext_en: ...the north face of the Eiger...

ext.ext_cn: 他沿着崖面向上攀登了200英尺。
ext.ext_en: He scrambled 200 feet up the cliff face.

defs.def_en: The face of a cliff, mountain, or building is a vertical surface or side of it.
The face of a clock or watch is the surface with the numbers or hands on it, which shows the time.

defs.def_cn: (地区、机构或活动领域的)外观，面貌

ext.ext_cn: 英国乡村的日新月异
ext.ext_en: ...the changing face of the British countryside...

ext.ext_cn: 这将改变马来西亚的政治面貌。
ext.ext_en: This would change the face of Malaysian politics.

defs.def_en: If you say that the face of an area, institution, or field of activity is changing, you mean its appearance or nature is changing.

ext.ext_cn: 她坚持认为，妓院是卖淫可为人接受的一种形式。
ext.ext_en: Brothels, she insists, are the acceptable face of prostitution...

ext.ext_cn: 谁会想到人们会认为足球之道可如阿森纳队呢？
ext.ext_en: Who ever thought people would see Arsenal as the acceptable face of football?

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as the particular face of an activity, belief, or system, you mean that it is one particular aspect of it, in contrast to other aspects.

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰不想打仗，但也不想丢面子。
ext.ext_en: England doesn't want a war but it doesn't want to lose face...

ext.ext_cn: 撤销机场对现任州长来说将是件丢脸的事情。
ext.ext_en: To cancel the airport would mean a loss of face for the present governor...

defs.def_en: If you lose face, you do something which makes you appear weak and makes people respect or admire you less. If you do something in order to save face, you do it in order to avoid appearing weak and losing people's respect or admiration.

defs.def_cn: (计划之事出乎意料地)告吹，砸锅，泡汤

ext.ext_cn: 你难道看不出这事会砸锅？
ext.ext_en: Can't you see this could blow up in your face?

defs.def_en: If something that you have planned blows up in your face, it goes wrong unexpectedly, with the result that you suffer.

defs.def_cn: 徒劳拼命地干;徒劳无功

ext.ext_cn: 即使你苦口婆心地批评他，也改变不了他的个性。
ext.ext_en: You can criticise him until you're blue in the face, but you'll never change his personality.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone can do something until they are blue in the face, you are emphasizing that however much they do it, it will not make any difference.

ext.ext_cn: 斯蒂芬一直脸朝下趴在浴缸里，不省人事。
ext.ext_en: All the time Stephen was lying face down and unconscious in the bath tub...

ext.ext_cn: 查尔斯将手中的牌摊了出来。
ext.ext_en: Charles laid down his cards face up.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is face down, their face or front points downwards. If they are face up, their face or front points upwards.

ext.ext_cn: 世界上再没有人能做出比他更坏的事情来。
ext.ext_en: No human being on the face of the earth could do anything worse than what he did.

defs.def_en: You can use the expression 'on the face of the earth' to mean 'in the whole world', when you are emphasizing a statement that you are making or making a very exaggerated statement.

ext.ext_cn: 如果爆发核战争，地球上的所有生物都将灭绝。
ext.ext_en: If a nuclear war breaks out, every living thing will be wiped off the face of the Earth.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will be wiped off the face of the earth or disappear from the face of the earth, you mean that it will stop existing.

ext.ext_cn: 我们信步向镇子走去，迎面碰上雅克·杜波依斯。
ext.ext_en: We were strolling into the town when we came face to face with Jacques DuBois...

ext.ext_cn: 这是两人首次当面会晤。
ext.ext_en: It was the first face-to-face meeting between the two men.

defs.def_en: If you come face to face with someone, you meet them and can talk to them or look at them directly.

ext.ext_cn: 最终，他又一次遭遇歧视。
ext.ext_en: Eventually, he came face to face with discrimination again...

ext.ext_cn: 我渐渐开始面对这个事实，那就是我几乎一事无成。
ext.ext_en: I was gradually being brought face to face with the fact that I had very little success.

defs.def_en: If you come face to face with a difficulty or reality, you cannot avoid it and have to deal with it.

defs.def_cn: 完全违背;与(公认的观念或规则)相冲突

ext.ext_cn: 似乎有悖常识的科学原理
ext.ext_en: ...scientific principles that seem to fly in the face of common sense...

ext.ext_cn: 他说这个决定有悖天理。
ext.ext_en: He said that the decision flew in the face of natural justice.

defs.def_en: If an action or belief flies in the face of accepted ideas or rules, it seems to completely oppose or contradict them.

ext.ext_cn: 面对强烈的反政府抗议，首相呼吁全国团结一致。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister has called for national unity in the face of the violent anti-government protests...

ext.ext_cn: 对这个坏消息，罗斯福毫不理会。
ext.ext_en: Roosevelt was defiant in the face of the bad news.

defs.def_en: If you take a particular action or attitude in the face of a problem or difficulty, you respond to that problem or difficulty in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 对18岁以下的青少年，我们几乎无计可施。我们不能拘留他们。他们只会公然嘲笑你。
ext.ext_en: With juveniles under eighteen, there's little we can do. We can't keep them in custody. They just laugh in your face.

defs.def_en: If someone laughs in your face, they are openly disrespectful towards you.

defs.def_cn: 不高兴的神情;严肃的神情;板起的脸

ext.ext_cn: 他拉长了脸来找我。
ext.ext_en: He came to me with a very long face.

defs.def_en: If you have a long face, you look very unhappy or serious.

defs.def_cn: 做鬼脸,扮鬼脸（英国英语中亦使用pull a face）

ext.ext_cn: 她打开门后闻到一股难闻的霉味，不禁做了个鬼脸。
ext.ext_en: Opening the door, she made a face at the musty smell...

ext.ext_cn: 凯瑟琳在托马斯身后冲他做了个鬼脸。
ext.ext_en: Kathryn pulled a face at Thomas behind his back.

defs.def_en: If you make a face, you show a feeling such as dislike or disgust by putting an exaggerated expression on your face, for example by sticking out your tongue. In British English, you can also say pull a face .

ext.ext_cn: 乍一看,似乎讲得通，但这些数字对不起来。
ext.ext_en: On the face of it that seems to make sense. But the figures don't add up...

ext.ext_cn: 初看起来，很难理解西方为何会立场突变。
ext.ext_en: It is, on the face of it, difficult to see how the West could radically change its position.

defs.def_en: You say on the face of it when you are describing how something seems when it is first considered, in order to suggest that people's opinion may change when they know or think more about the subject.

defs.def_cn: （对坏情况）显得满不在乎，做出无所谓的样子(美国英语中亦作 put on a good face)

ext.ext_cn: 朋友们看到你一脸轻松，也许会以为你已经走出悲伤。
ext.ext_en: Friends will see you are putting on a brave face and might assume you've got over your grief...

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们对这些困难似乎不以为意。
ext.ext_en: Scientists are putting a good face on the troubles.

defs.def_en: If you put a brave face on a bad situation or put on a brave face, you try not to show how disappointed or upset you are about the situation. In American English you can also say put on a good face.

ext.ext_cn: 这届政府执意反对提高所得税。
ext.ext_en: This Government has set its face against putting up income tax.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone has set their face against something to indicate that they are opposed to it, especially when you want to suggest that they are wrong.

defs.def_cn: (不受欢迎地、不情愿地或再次)露面，到场

ext.ext_cn: 如果她重又在马萨诸塞州露面，等待她的将是一纸拘捕令。
ext.ext_en: If she shows her face again back in Massachusetts she'll find a warrant for her arrest waiting...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得我应该去参加她父亲的葬礼。
ext.ext_en: I felt I ought to show my face at her father's funeral.

defs.def_en: If you show your face somewhere, you go there and see people, although you are not welcome, are rather unwilling to go, or have not been there for some time.

ext.ext_cn: 不知道汤姆想到了啥，但他确实忍住没笑。
ext.ext_en: What went through Tom's mind I can't imagine, but he did manage to keep a straight face...

ext.ext_cn: 你一定会惊奇怎么会有人能绷着脸、一本正经地说出那些话。
ext.ext_en: You have to wonder how anyone could say that seriously and with a straight face.

defs.def_en: If you manage to keep a straight face, you manage to look serious, although you want to laugh.

ext.ext_cn: 她的对手当着她面说她是撒谎精。
ext.ext_en: Her opponent called her a liar to her face.

defs.def_en: If you say something to someone's face you say it openly in their presence.

ext.ext_cn: 他一脸释然与感激。
ext.ext_en: Relief and gratitude were written all over his face...

ext.ext_cn: 我都可以看出他脸上写满了痛苦。
ext.ext_en: I could just see the pain written across her face.

defs.def_en: If a feeling is written all over your face or is written across your face, it is very obvious to other people from your expression.

ext.ext_cn: 他们面对面站着。
ext.ext_en: They stood facing each other...

ext.ext_cn: 花园朝南。
ext.ext_en: The garden faces south.

defs.def_en: If someone or something faces a particular thing, person, or direction, they are positioned opposite them or are looking in that direction.

ext.ext_cn: 她从桌前站起来，面对着他。
ext.ext_en: She stood up from the table and faced him...

ext.ext_cn: 起立，面向墙壁。
ext.ext_en: Stand up. Face the wall.

defs.def_en: If you face someone or something, you turn so that you are looking at them.

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯蒂面对记者，显得镇定自若。
ext.ext_en: Christie looked relaxed and calm as he faced the press...

ext.ext_cn: 他被带了进来，面对法官。
ext.ext_en: He was hauled in to face the judge.

defs.def_en: If you have to face a person or group, you have to stand or sit in front of them and talk to them, although it may be difficult and unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 如被判谋杀未遂，威廉斯将面临终身监禁。
ext.ext_en: Williams faces life in prison if convicted of attempted murder...

ext.ext_cn: 在俄罗斯的欧洲商人所面临的巨大困难是显而易见的。
ext.ext_en: The immense difficulties facing European businessmen in Russia were only too evident...

defs.def_en: If you face or are faced with something difficult or unpleasant, or if it faces you, it is going to affect you and you have to deal with it.

defs.def_cn: (使)直面，接受，正视(真理或事实等)

ext.ext_cn: 虽然你伤透了心，但也必须面对现实，一段感情已结束了。
ext.ext_en: Although your heart is breaking, you must face the truth that a relationship has ended...

ext.ext_cn: 他指责政府不能在经济问题上面对现实。
ext.ext_en: He accused the Government of refusing to face facts about the economy...

defs.def_en: If you face the truth or face the facts, you accept that something is true. If you face someone with the truth or with the facts, you try to make them accept that something is true.

ext.ext_cn: 想到周六晚上要在那儿度过我就受不了，于是我决定要抓紧。
ext.ext_en: I couldn't face the prospect of spending a Saturday night there, so I decided to press on...

ext.ext_cn: 我的孩子们想要我跟他们一起过圣诞节，但我办不到。
ext.ext_en: My children want me with them for Christmas Day, but I can't face it...

defs.def_en: If you cannot face something, you do not feel able to do it because it seems so difficult or unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 让我们面对现实;承认(事实)吧

ext.ext_cn: 她总是会被较年轻的男人吸引。不过，说实话，谁又不是呢？
ext.ext_en: She was always attracted to younger men. But, let's face it, who is not?

defs.def_en: You use the expression 'let's face it' when you are stating a fact or making a comment about something which you think the person you are talking to may find unpleasant or be unwilling to admit.
A walking stick is a long wooden stick which a person can lean on while walking.

defs.def_cn: 奇思异想;不同寻常的行为
defs.def_en: Whimsy is behaviour which is unusual, playful, and unpredictable, rather than having any serious reason or purpose behind it.

ext.ext_cn: 他十分震惊地发现自己竟然完全误解了情况。
ext.ext_en: He was amazed that he'd misinterpreted the situation so completely...

ext.ext_cn: 亲王的话遭到了曲解。
ext.ext_en: The Prince's words had been misinterpreted.

defs.def_en: If you misinterpret something, you understand it wrongly.

ext.ext_cn: 诺娃女士拥有一副美妙动听的好嗓音，对此她深以为豪。
ext.ext_en: Ms Nova is the proud possessor of a truly incredible voice.

defs.def_en: The possessor of something is the person who has it.

ext.ext_cn: 该案件将移交上诉法院审理。
ext.ext_en: The case is being referred to the Court of Appeal.

defs.def_en: A Court of Appeal is a court which deals with appeals against legal judgments.

ext.ext_cn: 新款汽车会有若干重大改进。
ext.ext_en: The new cars will incorporate a number of major improvements.

defs.def_en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 协议将允许把叛军收编入一支新的国家警备部队。
ext.ext_en: The agreement would allow the rebels to be incorporated into a new national police force...

ext.ext_cn: 该党宣誓要把环境因素纳入它所有的政策当中。
ext.ext_en: The party vowed to incorporate environmental considerations into all its policies.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is incorporated into a large group, system, or area, they become a part of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指在琐事上）饶舌的，喋喋不休的，絮絮叨叨的

ext.ext_cn: 喋喋不休的老妇人
ext.ext_en: ...a garrulous old woman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as garrulous, you mean that they talk a great deal, especially about unimportant things.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的支持是以他的提案得到他们的批准为条件的。
ext.ext_en: Their support is conditional on his proposals meeting their approval.

ext.ext_cn: 有条件要约
ext.ext_en: ...a conditional offer.

defs.def_en: If a situation or agreement is conditional on something, it will only happen or continue if this thing happens.

In grammar, a conditional clause is a subordinate clause which refers to a situation which may exist or whose possible consequences you are considering. Most conditional clauses begin with 'if' or 'unless', for example 'If that happens, we'll be in big trouble' and 'You don't have to come unless you want to'.

defs.def_cn: (政治家当选为议员后在议会作的)第一次演说，首次演讲
defs.def_en: A politician's maiden speech is the first speech that he or she makes in parliament after becoming a member of it.

ext.ext_cn: 生日快乐，亲爱的。
ext.ext_en: Happy birthday, sweetheart.

defs.def_en: You call someone sweetheart if you are very fond of them.

ext.ext_cn: 我在利物浦和我青梅竹马的恋人舒拉结婚了。
ext.ext_en: I married Shurla, my childhood sweetheart, in Liverpool.

defs.def_en: Your sweetheart is your boyfriend or your girlfriend.

ext.ext_cn: 和她曾经享有的名气相比，这样的角色真的算不了什么。
ext.ext_en: Such roles are small beer compared with the fame she once enjoyed.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is small beer, you mean that it is unimportant in comparison with something else.
Melanin is a dark substance in the skin, eyes, and hair of people and animals, which gives them colour and can protect them against strong sunlight.

ext.ext_cn: 一块块肉
ext.ext_en: ...gobbets of meat.

defs.def_en: A gobbet of something soft, especially food, is a small lump or piece of it.
A gobbet of information is a small piece of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她有个微波炉，不过主要用来解冻面包。
ext.ext_en: She has a microwave, but uses it mainly for defrosting bread...

ext.ext_cn: 一旦火鸡解冻了之后，就把其内脏清除掉。
ext.ext_en: Once the turkey has defrosted, remove the giblets.

defs.def_en: When you defrost frozen food or when it defrosts, you allow or cause it to become unfrozen so that you can eat it or cook it.

ext.ext_cn: 定期给冰箱除霜，以便它能发挥其最高效率。
ext.ext_en: Defrost the fridge regularly so that it works at maximum efficiency.

defs.def_en: When you defrost a fridge or freezer, you switch it off or press a special switch so that the ice inside it can melt. You can also say that a fridge or freezer is defrosting .
A dustman is a person whose job is to empty the rubbish from people's dustbins and take it away to be disposed of.

defs.def_cn: 小型船队;(通常指)小舰队
defs.def_en: A flotilla is a group of small ships, usually military ships.

defs.def_cn: (尤指)女店员,女售货员;女销售员
defs.def_en: A salesgirl is a young woman who sells things, especially in a shop. Many women prefer to be called a saleswoman or a salesperson rather than a salesgirl.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Homogenous means the same as homogeneous .

defs.def_cn: 和…混在一起;和…好上了;和…关系暧昧

ext.ext_cn: 桑迪和一个比他小 21 岁的寡妇搞上了。
ext.ext_en: Sandy took up with a widow 21 years his junior...

ext.ext_cn: 他和走私犯混到一块儿去了。
ext.ext_en: He took up with smugglers.

defs.def_en: You say that someone has taken up with someone unsuitable when they have begun a sexual or friendly relationship with them, and you disapprove of this.

ext.ext_cn: 他满脑子都在想这个问题。
ext.ext_en: His mind was wholly taken up with the question.

defs.def_en: If you are taken up with something, it keeps you busy or fully occupied.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 清晰的;清楚的;容易识别的

ext.ext_cn: 这个案例中明显是原土地所有人有理。
ext.ext_en: This was a clear-cut case of the original land owner being in the right...

ext.ext_cn: 这个问题不是那么清楚。
ext.ext_en: The issue is not so clear cut.

defs.def_en: Something that is clear-cut is easy to recognize and quite distinct.

ext.ext_cn: 锤子和凿子
ext.ext_en: ...a hammer and chisel.

defs.def_en: A chisel is a tool that has a long metal blade with a sharp edge at the end. It is used for cutting and shaping wood and stone.

ext.ext_cn: 他们坐下来把石头凿成合适的大小。
ext.ext_en: They sit and chisel the stone to size.

defs.def_en: If you chisel wood or stone, you cut and shape it using a chisel.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 当时把这项任务给他是大错特错了。
ext.ext_en: It had been a monumental blunder to give him the assignment.

ext.ext_cn: 一连串的巨大失望
ext.ext_en: ...a series of monumental disappointments.

defs.def_en: You can use monumental to emphasize the size or extent of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (书或音乐)丰碑式的，意义深远的，不朽的

ext.ext_cn: 他关于中国天文学的不朽巨著
ext.ext_en: ...his monumental work on Chinese astronomy.

defs.def_en: If you describe a book or musical work as monumental, you are emphasizing that it is very large and impressive, and is likely to be important for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 我对高大的雕塑没什么兴趣。
ext.ext_en: I take no real interest in monumental sculpture.

defs.def_en: A monumental building or sculpture is very large and impressive.

defs.def_cn: （英国旧时的）少年管教所，少年犯感化院
defs.def_en: In Britain in the past, a borstal was a kind of prison for young criminals, who were not old enough to be sent to ordinary prisons.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在处理任何内部政治分歧的苗头时，总统都毫不留情。
ext.ext_en: The President was ruthless in dealing with any hint of internal political dissent.

ext.ext_cn: 残忍的极权主义国家的侵略
ext.ext_en: ...an invasion by a ruthless totalitarian power...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is ruthless, you mean that you disapprove of them because they are very harsh or cruel, and will do anything that is necessary to achieve what they want.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为等)坚决的，果断的，不留情面的

ext.ext_cn: 她的律师在讨论离婚协议的过程中表现得非常坚决。
ext.ext_en: Her lawyers have been ruthless in thrashing out a divorce settlement...

ext.ext_cn: 成功合并两家银行需要坚决快速地着手解决费用问题。
ext.ext_en: Successfully merging two banks requires a fast and ruthless attack on costs.

defs.def_en: A ruthless action or activity is done forcefully and thoroughly, without much concern for its effects on other people.

defs.def_cn: 大量提供的东西；慷慨的赠予

ext.ext_cn: 秋天丰富的水果、种子和浆果
ext.ext_en: ...autumn's bounty of fruits, seeds and berries.

defs.def_en: You can refer to something that is provided in large amounts as bounty .

defs.def_cn: （尤指为找到或杀死某人而悬赏的）赏金，奖金

ext.ext_cn: 有人悬赏50,000美元买阿尔瓦雷斯博士的人头。
ext.ext_en: A bounty of $50,000 was put on Dr. Alvarez's head...

ext.ext_cn: 他们向放下武器的人发放赏金。
ext.ext_en: They paid bounties for people to give up their weapons.

defs.def_en: A bounty is money that is offered as a  reward for doing something, especially for finding or killing a particular person.

ext.ext_cn: 火星与地球的运行轨道随着时间而变化。
ext.ext_en: Mars and Earth have orbits which change with time...

ext.ext_cn: 这颗行星可能正环绕着一颗小恒星运行。
ext.ext_en: The planet is probably in orbit around a small star.

defs.def_en: An orbit is the curved path in space that is followed by an object going round and round a planet, moon, or star.

ext.ext_cn: 1957年，苏联发射了第一颗绕地卫星。
ext.ext_en: In 1957 the Soviet Union launched the first satellite to orbit the earth.

defs.def_en: If something such as a satellite orbits a planet, moon, or sun, it moves around it in a continuous, curving path.

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪70年代末，老挝被纳入了越南和苏联的势力范围。
ext.ext_en: In the late 1970s Laos fell within the orbit of Vietnam and the Soviet Union.

defs.def_en: The orbit of a particular person, group, or institution is the area over which they have influence.

defs.def_cn: （do 的第三人称单数形式，过时用法）
defs.def_en: Doth is an old-fashioned third person singular form of the verb 'do'.

defs.def_cn: 五金经销商;五金店店主
defs.def_en: An ironmonger is a shopkeeper who sells articles for the house and garden such as tools, nails, and pans.
An ironmonger or an ironmonger's is a shop where articles for the house and garden such as tools, nails, and pans are sold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (任务或难题)费力的，费劲的，劳神的

ext.ext_cn: 他们就解决人类所面临的最大难题，即人类基因组之谜的进展情况交换了意见。
ext.ext_en: They were comparing notes on each other's progress towards solving that most taxing of all puzzles: the riddle of the human genome...

ext.ext_cn: 不大可能叫你做什么太费劲的事儿。
ext.ext_en: It's unlikely that you'll be asked to do anything too taxing.

defs.def_en: A taxing task or problem is one that requires a lot of mental or physical effort.

ext.ext_cn: 子弹在离安德烈亚的心脏不到一英寸的地方穿过。
ext.ext_en: The bullet had passed less than an inch from Andrea's heart...

ext.ext_cn: 屋内唯一的声音就是他的心跳声。
ext.ext_en: The only sound inside was the beating of his heart...

defs.def_en: Your heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

ext.ext_cn: 亚利克的话让她心感自豪。
ext.ext_en: Alik's words filled her heart with pride...

ext.ext_cn: 我就是无法迫使自己承认心里知道的事实。
ext.ext_en: I just couldn't bring myself to admit what I knew in my heart to be true.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's heart when you are talking about their deep feelings and beliefs.

ext.ext_cn: 她深爱他的才华横溢和古道热肠。
ext.ext_en: She loved his brilliance and his generous heart...

ext.ext_cn: 她心地善良，但却工于心计。
ext.ext_en: She's got a good heart but she's calculating.

defs.def_en: You use heart when you are talking about someone's character and attitude towards other people, especially when they are kind and generous.

ext.ext_cn: 这是谈情说爱的绝佳时机。
ext.ext_en: This is an excellent time for affairs of the heart.

defs.def_en: If you refer to things of the heart, you mean love and relationships.

ext.ext_cn: 问题的核心是供求关系。
ext.ext_en: The heart of the problem is supply and demand...

ext.ext_cn: 资金是空运安全争论中的实质问题。
ext.ext_en: Money lies at the heart of the debate over airline safety.

defs.def_en: The heart of something is the most central and important part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 位于伦敦西区中心的一个繁忙的牙科诊所
ext.ext_en: ...a busy dentists' practice in the heart of London's West End.

defs.def_en: The heart of a place is its centre.
The heart of a lettuce, cabbage, or other vegetable is its centre leaves.

ext.ext_cn: 心形巧克力
ext.ext_en: ...heart-shaped chocolates.

defs.def_en: A heart is a shape that is used as a symbol of love: ♥.

ext.ext_cn: 韦斯特必须决定是否要出一张红桃。
ext.ext_en: West had to decide whether to play a heart.

ext.ext_cn: 韦斯特必须决定是否要出一张红桃。
ext.ext_en: West had to decide whether to play a heart.

defs.def_en: Hearts is one of the four suits in a pack of playing cards. Each card in the suit is marked with one or more red symbols in the shape of a heart.

defs.def_cn: 全心全意地;真心实意地

ext.ext_cn: 我真心实意地爱我全家人。
ext.ext_en: My own family I loved with all my heart.

defs.def_en: If you feel or believe something with all your heart, you feel or believe it very strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 他实际上是个非常温柔的男生。
ext.ext_en: He was a very gentle boy at heart.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a particular kind of person at heart, you mean that that is what they are really like, even though they may seem very different.

defs.def_cn: 十分关心（某人的利益或福祉）

ext.ext_cn: 她告诉他自己万事都是为了他好。
ext.ext_en: She told him she only had his interests at heart.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has your interests or your welfare at heart, you mean that they are concerned about you and that is why they are doing something.

defs.def_cn: （通常指因感情破裂而）使…伤心，使…心碎
defs.def_en: If someone breaks your heart, they make you very sad and unhappy, usually because they end a love affair or close relationship with you.

defs.def_cn: （尤指因对他人的苦难无能为力而）使…伤心，使…心碎

ext.ext_cn: 看到他们这个样子可真让我伤心。
ext.ext_en: It really breaks my heart to see them this way.

defs.def_en: If something breaks your heart, it makes you feel very sad and depressed, especially because people are suffering but you can do nothing to help them.

ext.ext_cn: 她心上的伤再也没能愈合。
ext.ext_en: She never recovered from her broken heart.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a broken heart, you mean that they are very sad, for example because a love affair has ended unhappily.

ext.ext_cn: 麦克会背这一段。
ext.ext_en: Mack knew this passage by heart.

defs.def_en: If you know something such as a poem by heart, you have learned it so well that you can remember it without having to read it.

ext.ext_cn: 几位经纪人对该公司前景的看法已经有所改变。
ext.ext_en: Several brokers have had a change of heart about prospects for the company...

ext.ext_cn: 为什么变了态度？
ext.ext_en: Why the change of heart?

defs.def_en: If someone has a change of heart, their attitude towards something changes.

ext.ext_cn: 动物福利是我非常关注的一个问题。
ext.ext_en: Animal welfare is a subject very close to my heart.

defs.def_en: If something such as a subject or project is close to your heart or near to your heart, it is very important to you and you are very interested in it and concerned about it.

ext.ext_cn: 我很高兴能够痛痛快快地吃我最喜爱的菜。
ext.ext_en: I was delighted to be able to eat my favorite dishes to my heart's content.

defs.def_en: If you can do something to your heart's content, you can do it as much as you want.

defs.def_cn: 我发誓（所说的是真的）/你敢发誓（所说的是真的）吗？

ext.ext_cn: 我不会把你告诉我的事告诉任何其他女孩。我发誓，保证不会。
ext.ext_en: And I won't tell any of the other girls anything you tell me about it. I promise, cross my heart.

defs.def_en: You can say 'cross my heart' when you want someone to believe that you are telling the truth. You can also ask 'cross your heart?', when you are asking someone if they are really telling the truth.

ext.ext_cn: 他的话充满信心，发自心坎。
ext.ext_en: He spoke with confidence, from the heart...

ext.ext_cn: 我离开之前一定要先衷心地感谢你。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to go away without thanking you from the bottom of my heart.

defs.def_en: If you say something from the heart or from the bottom of your heart, you sincerely mean what you say.

ext.ext_cn: 看到一个恶棍罪有应得真是大快我心。
ext.ext_en: It gave me heart to see one thug get what he deserves.

defs.def_en: If something gives you heart, it makes you feel more confident or happy about something.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一直都知道，但却不忍心告诉她。
ext.ext_en: We knew all along but didn'thave the heart to tell her.

defs.def_en: If you want to do something but do not have the heart to do it, you do not do it because you know it will make someone unhappy or disappointed.

ext.ext_cn: 我心里深知我是完成那项任务的合适人选。
ext.ext_en: I know in my heart of hearts that I am the right man for that mission.

defs.def_en: If you believe or know something in your heart of hearts, that is what you really believe or think, even though it may sometimes seem that you do not.

ext.ext_cn: 我想要背几句台词，但我的心根本不在那上面。
ext.ext_en: I tried to learn some lines but my heart wasn't really in it.

defs.def_en: If your heart isn't in the thing you are doing, you have very little enthusiasm for it, usually because you are depressed or are thinking about something else.

ext.ext_cn: 他呼吁自己的同胞不要丧失信心。
ext.ext_en: He appealed to his countrymen not to lose heart.

defs.def_en: If you lose heart, you become sad and depressed and are no longer interested in something, especially because it is not progressing as you would like.
If you lose your heart to someone, you fall in love with them.

defs.def_cn: 激动非常;焦急万分;害怕得要命

ext.ext_cn: 我走进她的办公室时，紧张得心都到了喉咙口。
ext.ext_en: My heart was in my mouth when I walked into her office.

defs.def_en: If your heart is in your mouth, you feel very excited, worried, or frightened.

ext.ext_cn: 她昨天在数成百万人面前倾吐心声，讲述了自己是如何差点轻生的。
ext.ext_en: She opened her heart to millions yesterday and told how she came close to suicide.

defs.def_en: If you open your heart or pour out your heart to someone, you tell them your most private thoughts and feelings.

defs.def_cn: （尽管有其他缺点但）心地善良，心眼儿好

ext.ext_cn: 他是有点像个阿飞，但心眼儿不错。
ext.ext_en: He is a bit of a tearaway but his heart is in the right place.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's heart is in the right place, you mean that they are kind, considerate, and generous, although you may disapprove of other aspects of their character.

defs.def_cn: 一心想要得到;一心想要做

ext.ext_cn: 他一直以来都一心想把美术作为自己的事业。
ext.ext_en: He had always set his heart on a career in the fine arts.

defs.def_en: If you have set your heart on something, you want it very much or want to do it very much.
If you wear your heart on your sleeve, you openly show your feelings or emotions rather than keeping them hidden.

defs.def_cn: 全心全意地;尽心尽力地

ext.ext_cn: 当他专心想干某件事时，他总是能成功，因为他会全心全意地投入其中。
ext.ext_en: He will always be successful when he puts his mind to something, because he puts his heart and soul into it.

defs.def_en: If you put your heart and soul into something, you do it with a great deal of enthusiasm and energy.
If you take heart from something, you are encouraged and made to feel optimistic by it.

defs.def_cn: 对…耿耿于怀;为…感到不快

ext.ext_cn: 如果有人提出批评，我会十分介意。
ext.ext_en: If someone says something critical I take it to heart.

defs.def_en: If you take something to heart, for example someone's behaviour, you are deeply affected and upset by it.

ext.ext_cn: 诸如生态环境、人权等社会政治问题
ext.ext_en: ...sociopolitical issues such as ecology and human rights.

defs.def_en: Socio-political systems and problems involve a combination of social and political factors.

defs.def_cn: (园艺等用的) 手推车，独轮推车
defs.def_en: A wheelbarrow is a small open cart with one wheel and handles that is used for carrying things, for example in the garden.

defs.def_cn: （相似或从属但）相形见绌的东西

ext.ext_cn: 水彩画似乎仍比油画略逊一筹。
ext.ext_en: Watercolour still seems somehow to be the poor relation of oil painting.

defs.def_en: If you describe one thing as a poor relation of another, you mean that it is similar to or part of the other thing, but is considered to be inferior to it.

defs.def_cn: 恺撒色拉(食材包括莴苣、鸡蛋、奶酪、炸面包屑,佐以食油、醋和香料)
defs.def_en: Caesar salad is a type of salad containing lettuce, eggs, cheese, and small pieces of fried bread, served with a dressing of oil, vinegar, and herbs.

defs.def_cn: 易如反掌的事;小事一桩

ext.ext_cn: 这听上去有难度，可是比起全职工作来，就是小意思了。
ext.ext_en: It sounds difficult, but compared to full-time work it was a cinch.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a cinch, you mean that you think it is very easy to do.

defs.def_cn: (老)处女;未婚中年(或老年)女子
defs.def_en: A spinster is a woman who has never been married; used especially when talking about an old or middle-aged woman.

ext.ext_cn: 放射性废物就是用后的燃料。
ext.ext_en: Radioactive waste is simply spent fuel...

ext.ext_cn: 几个空弹壳已经被找到。
ext.ext_en: Several spent cartridges have already been found.

defs.def_en: Spent substances or containers have been used and cannot be used again.
A squaddie is a soldier of the lowest rank in the army.
The heptathlon is an athletics competition for women in which each athlete competes in seven different events.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: pd is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) paid. It is written on a bill to indicate that it has been paid.
If you say that someone is thunderstruck, you mean that they are extremely surprised or shocked.

defs.def_cn: 未停止的；未减弱的；不懈的

ext.ext_cn: 我被送到寄宿学校呆了6年，其间我的生活一直很悲惨。
ext.ext_en: I was sent to boarding school, where I spent six years of unremitting misery...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直全神贯注地注视着她。
ext.ext_en: He watched her with unremitting attention.

defs.def_en: Something that is unremitting continues without stopping or becoming less intense.
A GMO is an animal, plant, or other organism whose genetic structure has been changed by genetic engineering. GMO is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'genetically modified organism'.

defs.def_cn: 阻塞;使…陷于混乱(或停顿)

ext.ext_cn: 随后的争吵把联合和平委员会的工作搅得一团糟。
ext.ext_en: The ensuing row snarled up the work of the joint peace commission.

defs.def_en: To snarl something up means to cause problems which prevent it continuing or making progress.

defs.def_cn: 阿门（基督教徒祈祷结束时用语）

ext.ext_cn: 以圣父、圣子和圣灵的名义，阿门。
ext.ext_en: In the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Ghost, Amen.

defs.def_en: Amen is said by Christians at the end of a prayer.

defs.def_cn: (行动、计划)战术上的，策略性的

ext.ext_cn: 现在还不清楚首相提出辞职是认真的，还是仅仅作为一种策略。
ext.ext_en: It's not yet clear whether the Prime Minister's resignation offer is a serious one, or whether it's simply a tactical move...

ext.ext_cn: 安全部队已从该地区战术性撤军。
ext.ext_en: The security forces had made a tactical withdrawal from the area.

defs.def_en: You use tactical to describe an action or plan which is intended to help someone achieve what they want in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经拆除所有能够袭击欧洲的战术核导弹。
ext.ext_en: They have removed all tactical nuclear missiles that could strike Europe.

ext.ext_cn: 美国战术空中战斗机中队
ext.ext_en: ...U.S. tactical air fighter squadrons.

defs.def_en: Tactical weapons or forces are those which a military leader can decide for themselves to use in a battle, rather than waiting for a decision by a political leader.

ext.ext_cn: 热带风暴“马可”正沿佛罗里达海岸向北推进。
ext.ext_en: Tropical storm Marco is pushing northward up Florida's coast.

ext.ext_cn: 向北推进的移民潮
ext.ext_en: ...the flow of immigrants northward.

defs.def_en: Northward or northwards means towards the north.

ext.ext_cn: 双方都没有抓俘虏，也没有表现出丝毫的心慈手软。
ext.ext_en: Neither side took prisoners or showed any mercy...

ext.ext_cn: 他们哭喊着请求宽恕，可是他们的恳求却遭到了谩骂和嘲笑。
ext.ext_en: They cried for mercy but their pleas were met with abuse and laughter...

defs.def_en: If someone in  authority shows mercy, they choose not to harm someone they have power over, or they forgive someone they have the right to punish.

ext.ext_cn: 9个月前她在去西非的慈善之旅中消失了。
ext.ext_en: She vanished nine months ago while on a mercy mission to West Africa...

ext.ext_cn: 美国人一直在等人坐满一架747飞机，这便是第一次为期两周的所谓慈善飞行。
ext.ext_en: It's the first so-called mercy flight for a fortnight as the Americans have been waiting for enough people to fill a 747 jet.

defs.def_en: Mercy is used to describe a special journey to help someone in great need, such as people who are sick or made homeless by war.

ext.ext_cn: 他最后去得那么快，真是谢天谢地。
ext.ext_en: It really was a mercy that he'd died so rapidly at the end...

ext.ext_cn: 两辆车最后都停在了缓冲区，避开了赛车道，真是万幸。
ext.ext_en: The two cars finished up in a run-off area, clear of the circuit, and that was a mercy.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an event or situation as a mercy, you mean that it makes you feel happy or relieved, usually because it stops something unpleasant happening.

ext.ext_cn: 建筑物因人为的肆意破坏及日晒雨淋而日益破败。
ext.ext_en: Buildings are left to decay at the mercy of vandals and the weather...

ext.ext_cn: 皇帝必须意识到我们任由他处置。
ext.ext_en: The Emperor must realize that he has us at his mercy.

defs.def_en: If one person or thing is at the mercy of another, the first person or thing is in a situation where they cannot prevent themselves being harmed or affected by the second.

defs.def_cn: 为坏情况没有变得更糟而庆幸

ext.ext_cn: 士气如此低沉，一丁点的好运都会让队员和球迷庆幸不已。
ext.ext_en: But so low has morale sunk that the team and the fans would have been grateful for small mercies.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone who is  in an unpleasant situation that they should be grateful or thankful for small mercies, you mean that although their situation is bad, it could be even worse, and so they should be happy.

ext.ext_cn: 他准备听凭法庭发落。
ext.ext_en: He's going to throw himself on the mercy of the court.

defs.def_en: If you throw yourself on someone's mercy, you put yourself in a situation where they will have complete power to decide how to treat you, for example whether to punish or forgive you.

ext.ext_cn: 他们决定在滨海区会面。
ext.ext_en: They decided to meet on the seafront.

defs.def_en: The seafront is the part of a seaside town that is nearest to the sea. It usually consists of a road with buildings that face the sea.

ext.ext_cn: 她尽情享受刚刚获得的自由。
ext.ext_en: She savored her newfound freedom...

ext.ext_cn: 我们不会装作我们满心盼望着在监狱中度过一个月。
ext.ext_en: We won't pretend we savour the prospect of a month in prison...

defs.def_en: If you savour an experience, you enjoy it as much as you can.

ext.ext_cn: 细细品尝每一口的味道，充分咀嚼。
ext.ext_en: Savour the flavour of each mouthful, and chew your food well.

defs.def_en: If you savour food or drink, you eat or drink it slowly in order to taste its full flavour and to enjoy it properly.

ext.ext_cn: 大量消耗臭氧层的物质
ext.ext_en: ...substances that deplete the ozone layer...

ext.ext_cn: 他们长时间开火，耗尽了弹药。
ext.ext_en: They fired in long bursts, which depleted their ammunition...

defs.def_en: To deplete a stock or amount of something means to reduce it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个党开始进行经济改革。
ext.ext_en: The party embarked on a programme of economic reform...

ext.ext_cn: 他极力主张进行福利制度改革。
ext.ext_en: He has urged reform of the welfare system...

defs.def_en: Reform consists of changes and improvements to a law, social system, or institution. A reform is an instance of such a change or improvement.

ext.ext_cn: 他的国家经济改革计划
ext.ext_en: ...his plans to reform the country's economy...

ext.ext_cn: 一个革新的政党需要赢得人民的认可。
ext.ext_en: A reformed party would have to win the approval of the people.

defs.def_en: If someone reforms something such as a law, social system, or institution, they change or improve it.

defs.def_cn: （人）洗心革面；(使)改过自新；改造

ext.ext_cn: 他的案子即将开审的时候，詹姆斯保证会改过自新。
ext.ext_en: When his court case was coming up, James promised to reform...

ext.ext_cn: 我们将尽力在社区内部对他进行改造。
ext.ext_en: We will try to reform him within the community.

defs.def_en: When someone reforms or when something reforms them, they stop doing things that society does not approve of, such as breaking the law or drinking too much alcohol.

ext.ext_cn: 我们给了他油漆和几把刷子。
ext.ext_en: We gave him paint and brushes...

ext.ext_cn: 污渍是用几桶肥皂水和几把硬毛刷除去的。
ext.ext_en: Stains are removed with buckets of soapy water and scrubbing brushes.

defs.def_en: A brush is an object which has a large number of bristles or hairs fixed to it. You use brushes for painting, for cleaning things, and for tidying your hair.

ext.ext_cn: 你刷牙了吗？
ext.ext_en: Have you brushed your teeth?...

ext.ext_cn: 她把头发上的粉末刷掉了。
ext.ext_en: She brushed the powder out of her hair...

defs.def_en: If you brush something or brush something such as dirt off it, you clean it or tidy it using a brush.

ext.ext_cn: 取一张擀得很薄的油酥面皮，上面刷上一层熔化的牛油。
ext.ext_en: Take a sheet of filo pastry and brush it with melted butter.

defs.def_en: If you brush something with a liquid, you apply a layer of that liquid using a brush.

ext.ext_cn: 他用两手把头发往后捋。
ext.ext_en: He brushed his hair back with both hands...

ext.ext_cn: 谈到他时，她拭去了脸上的泪水。
ext.ext_en: She brushed away tears as she spoke of him...

defs.def_en: If you brush something somewhere, you remove it with quick light movements of your hands.

ext.ext_cn: 有什么东西扫了一下她的腿。
ext.ext_en: Something brushed against her leg...

ext.ext_cn: 我感觉到她深褐色的头发拂过我的肩。
ext.ext_en: I felt her dark brown hair brushing the back of my shoulder...

defs.def_en: If one thing brushes against another or if you brush one thing against another, the first thing touches the second thing lightly while passing it.

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲会紧贴着母亲擦身而过，冲进厨房。
ext.ext_en: My father would burst into the kitchen, brushing past my mother...

ext.ext_cn: 他擦身而过，朝人群敷衍地挥了挥手。
ext.ext_en: He brushed by with a perfunctory wave to the crowd.

defs.def_en: If you brush past someone or brush by them, you almost touch them as you go past them.

ext.ext_cn: 我跟校长的第一次冲突发生在6年前。
ext.ext_en: My first brush with a headmaster came six years ago...

ext.ext_cn: 这已是他在不到一年的时间里第三次触犯法律了。
ext.ext_en: It is his third brush with the law in less than a year.

defs.def_en: If you have a brush with someone, you have an argument or disagreement with them. You use brush when you want to make an argument or disagreement sound less serious than it really is.

ext.ext_cn: 和死神擦肩而过的心灵创伤
ext.ext_en: ...the trauma of a brush with death...

ext.ext_cn: 公司正在努力摆脱自身遭遇的第二次破产危机。
ext.ext_en: The corporation is fighting to survive its second brush with bankruptcy.

defs.def_en: If you have a brush with a particular situation, usually an unpleasant one, you almost experience it.

ext.ext_cn: 焚毁了近500亩灌木丛的大火
ext.ext_en: ...the brush fire that destroyed nearly 500 acres.

ext.ext_cn: 长有低矮灌木和草的牧场
ext.ext_en: ...a meadow of low brush and grass.

defs.def_en: Brush is an area of rough open land covered with small bushes and trees. You also use brush to refer to the bushes and trees on this land.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 基本的;简陋的;不完善的

ext.ext_cn: 略显简陋的厨房
ext.ext_en: ...a kind of rudimentary kitchen...

ext.ext_cn: 他们被剥夺了行使最基本的工人权利的资格。
ext.ext_en: They are deprived of the ability to exercise the most rudimentary workers' rights.

defs.def_en: Rudimentary things are very basic or simple and are therefore unsatisfactory.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对法语只是略知皮毛。
ext.ext_en: He had only a rudimentary knowledge of French.

ext.ext_cn: 对经济学知识的初步掌握
ext.ext_en: ...a rudimentary grasp of economics.

defs.def_en: Rudimentary knowledge includes only the simplest and most basic facts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人或事物）悲惨的，忧伤的，哀伤的

ext.ext_cn: 忧伤的情歌
ext.ext_en: ...a woeful ballad.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is woeful, they are very sad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 恶劣的;糟糕的;不合意的

ext.ext_cn: 这样的态度是极度无知造成的。
ext.ext_en: Such attitudes are the product of woeful ignorance.

ext.ext_cn: 糟糕的经济状况
ext.ext_en: ...the woeful state of the economy.

defs.def_en: You can use woeful to emphasize that something is very bad or undesirable.

ext.ext_cn: 一群群身着正装的男人
ext.ext_en: ...clusters of men in formal clothes...

ext.ext_cn: 这儿没有城镇，只在公路边上有一片商店、小木屋和汽车旅馆。
ext.ext_en: There's no town here, just a cluster of shops, cabins and motels at the side of the highway.

defs.def_en: A cluster of people or things is a small group of them close together.

ext.ext_cn: 乘客们三五成群聚在一起。
ext.ext_en: The passengers clustered together in small groups...

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们聚集在我的周围。
ext.ext_en: The children clustered around me.

defs.def_en: See also:clustered;If people cluster together, they gather together in a small group.

defs.def_cn: 识别能力;洞察力;鉴赏能力

ext.ext_cn: 他们不识货，接受了劣质品
ext.ext_en: ...their lack of discernment and acceptance of inferior quality.

defs.def_en: Discernment is the ability to judge which things of a particular kind are good and which are bad.

ext.ext_cn: 为了能进入一流学校，学生们会忍不住想作弊。
ext.ext_en: Students may be tempted to cheat in order to get into top schools.

defs.def_en: When someone cheats, they do not obey a set of rules which they should be obeying, for example in a game or exam.

ext.ext_cn: 弄虚作假者将被取消资格。
ext.ext_en: Cheats will be disqualified.

defs.def_en: Someone who is a cheat does not obey a set of rules which they should be obeying.

ext.ext_cn: 公司涉嫌蓄意骗取他们的养老金。
ext.ext_en: The company engaged in a deliberate effort to cheat them out of their pensions...

ext.ext_cn: 许多经纪人被指控在商品交易中欺骗顾客。
ext.ext_en: Many brokers were charged with cheating customers in commodity trades.

defs.def_en: If someone cheats you out of something, they get it from you by behaving dishonestly.

ext.ext_cn: 他被人从他那熊熊燃烧的棚屋顶上救了下来，捡了条命。
ext.ext_en: He cheated death when he was rescued from the roof of his blazing cottage.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone cheats death, you mean they only just avoid being killed.

ext.ext_cn: 故事结尾让人很失望，这样的结尾严重削弱了故事情节。
ext.ext_en: The storyline is fatally compromised by an ending that leaves you feeling horribly cheated.

defs.def_en: If you feel cheated, you feel that you have been let down or treated unfairly.

defs.def_cn: 跳蚤市场;（露天的）旧货市场
defs.def_en: A flea market is an outdoor market which sells cheap used goods and sometimes also very old furniture.
Ermine is expensive white fur that comes from small animals called stoats.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他低声下气、卑躬屈膝。
ext.ext_en: He was subservient and servile...

ext.ext_cn: 他们说她对她的老板阿谀逢迎。
ext.ext_en: They said she had a servile attitude to her employer.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is servile, you disapprove of them because they are too eager to obey someone or do things for them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在国外呆了4个月后，在家的每一刻都是宝贵的。
ext.ext_en: After four months in foreign parts, every hour at home was precious...

ext.ext_cn: 家庭度假会让你们一起度过宝贵的时光。
ext.ext_en: A family break allows you to spend precious time together...

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她妈妈的珠宝和珍奇物品
ext.ext_en: ...jewellery and precious objects belonging to her mother.

defs.def_en: Precious objects and materials are worth a lot of money because they are rare.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 值得珍视的；可贵的；重要的

ext.ext_cn: 家庭的支持对乔茜来说尤为可贵。
ext.ext_en: Her family's support is particularly precious to Josie...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽把她最珍视的财产——一个小书架，留给了她的侄女。
ext.ext_en: Mary left her most precious possession — a small bookcase — to her niece.

defs.def_en: If something is precious to you, you regard it as important and do not want to lose it.

defs.def_cn: 宝贝似的（强调对别人珍视的东西表示厌恶）

ext.ext_cn: 你什么都不关心，除了你自己和你那张娇贵的脸。
ext.ext_en: You don't care about anything but yourself and your precious face.

defs.def_en: People sometimes use precious to emphasize their dislike for things which other people think are important.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 矫揉造作的；一本正经的

ext.ext_cn: 他认定演员们太做作，并且都神经兮兮的。
ext.ext_en: Actors, he decided, were too precious and neurotic.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as precious, you mean that they behave in a formal and unnatural way.

ext.ext_cn: 银行最近没几件值得庆贺的事。
ext.ext_en: The banks have had precious little to celebrate recently...

ext.ext_cn: 极少数购房者会注意到他们月还款额的减少。
ext.ext_en: Precious few homebuyers will notice any reduction in their monthly repayments.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is precious little of something, you are emphasizing that there is very little of it, and that it would be better if there were more. Precious few has a similar meaning.

defs.def_cn: 吓坏;使极度恐慌;使非常害怕

ext.ext_cn: 坐飞机让他害怕得要命。
ext.ext_en: Flying terrifies him...

ext.ext_cn: 缓慢而痛苦地死去的想法使我恐惧不已。
ext.ext_en: The thought of dying slowly and painfully terrified me.

defs.def_en: If something terrifies you, it makes you feel extremely frightened.

ext.ext_cn: 他将该党的失败归因于过分强调意识形态和理念。
ext.ext_en: He attributed the party's lack of success to an overemphasis on ideology and ideas.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is an overemphasis on a particular thing, you mean that more importance or attention is given to it than is necessary.
Cannot is the negative form of can.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指在困难形势下)头脑清楚的，清醒的，明事理的

ext.ext_cn: 他对经济规律的清楚把握
ext.ext_en: ...his clear-headed grasp of the laws of economics.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as clear-headed, you mean that they are sensible and think clearly, especially in difficult situations.

defs.def_cn: (尤指青少年的)违法行为，犯罪行为

ext.ext_cn: 他没有违法记录。
ext.ext_en: He had no history of delinquency.

ext.ext_cn: 各种违法犯罪行为
ext.ext_en: ...a whole range of crimes and delinquencies.

defs.def_en: See also:juvenile delinquency;Delinquency is criminal behaviour, especially that of young people.

defs.def_cn: 逾期未还债务（或未缴税款）

ext.ext_cn: 并不是所有未按时还债的情形都会导致丧失抵押品的赎回权。
ext.ext_en: Not all delinquencies lead to foreclosure.

ext.ext_cn: 抵押贷款拖欠率的上升
ext.ext_en: ...increases in mortgage delinquency rates.

defs.def_en: Delinquency is failure to pay a debt or tax.

defs.def_cn: (尤指产于苏格兰、由大麦或黑麦酿制的)威士忌酒

ext.ext_cn: 一瓶威士忌
ext.ext_en: ...a bottle of whisky.

ext.ext_cn: 昂贵的威士忌和白兰地
ext.ext_en: ...expensive whiskies and brandies.

defs.def_en: Whisky is a strong alcoholic drink made, especially in Scotland, from grain such as barley or rye.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 尽管现在很宽裕，他却没打算退休。
ext.ext_en: He had no plans to retire even though he is now very comfortably off.

defs.def_en: If someone is comfortably off, they have enough money to be able to live without financial problems.

ext.ext_cn: 安德鲁狠狠掴了他一巴掌，声音响亮干脆。
ext.ext_en: There was a resounding slap as Andrew struck him violently across the face...

ext.ext_cn: 她赢得一片热烈掌声。
ext.ext_en: She got a resounding round of applause...

defs.def_en: A resounding sound is loud and clear.

defs.def_cn: (成功)彻底的，完全的，辉煌的，巨大的

ext.ext_cn: 天公作美，使得这次活动获得了巨大成功。
ext.ext_en: The good weather helped to make the occasion a resounding success.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a very great success as a resounding success.

ext.ext_cn: 这种有追溯力的法规鲜有先例。
ext.ext_en: There are few precedents for this sort of retroactive legislation.

defs.def_en: If a decision or action is retroactive, it is intended to take effect from a date in the past.

defs.def_cn: 变为现实;实现;发生;出现

ext.ext_cn: 激进分子的叛乱没有得逞。
ext.ext_en: A rebellion by radicals failed to materialize...

ext.ext_cn: 预想中的困难全都没有出现。
ext.ext_en: None of the anticipated difficulties materialized.

defs.def_en: If a possible or expected event does not materialize, it does not happen.

ext.ext_cn: 塔姆辛从她身旁冒了出来，且备好了笔记本。
ext.ext_en: Tamsin materialized at her side, notebook at the ready...

ext.ext_cn: 片刻之后，他们身边出现了一只装着香槟的冰桶。
ext.ext_en: A moment or two later champagne in an ice-bucket materialized beside them.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing materializes, they suddenly appear, after they have been invisible or in another place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对所涉及的问题态度极为乐观。
ext.ext_en: He's remarkably sanguine about the problems involved...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的看法已经开始变得乐观起来。
ext.ext_en: They have begun to take a more sanguine view.

defs.def_en: If you are sanguine about something, you are cheerful and confident that things will happen in the way you want them to.
Ballroom dancing is a type of dancing in which a man and a woman dance together using fixed sequences of steps and movements.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （对令人不快之事的描述）形象的，具体的，活灵活现的

ext.ext_cn: 这些性虐待的描写绘声绘色。
ext.ext_en: The descriptions of sexual abuse are graphic.

ext.ext_cn: 赤裸裸的吸毒场景
ext.ext_en: ...graphic scenes of drug taking.

defs.def_en: If you say that a description or account of something unpleasant is graphic, you are emphasizing that it is clear and detailed.

ext.ext_cn: 美术与平面艺术
ext.ext_en: ...fine and graphic arts.

defs.def_en: Graphic means concerned with drawing or pictures, especially in publishing, industry, or computing.

defs.def_cn: 绘画；(尤指出版、工业或计算机领域的)制图,图形设计

ext.ext_cn: 专注于图形设计的计算机制造商
ext.ext_en: ...a computer manufacturer which specialises in graphics.

defs.def_en: Graphics is the activity of drawing or making pictures, especially in publishing, industry, or computing.

ext.ext_cn: 这些文章明显短了许多，并且配上了醒目的标题和图表。
ext.ext_en: The articles are noticeably shorter with strong headlines and graphics...

ext.ext_cn: 农业部今天发布了一个新图标以取代旧标志。
ext.ext_en: The Agriculture Department today released a new graphic to replace the old symbol.

defs.def_en: Graphics are drawings and pictures that are composed using simple lines and sometimes strong colours.

ext.ext_cn: 他们是最初的英格兰和苏格兰定居者的后代。
ext.ext_en: They are descendants of the original English and Scottish settlers.

ext.ext_cn: 科克伦勋爵及其后裔
ext.ext_en: ...Lord Cochrane and his descendants.

defs.def_en: Someone's descendants are the people in later generations who are related to them.

defs.def_cn: 派生物;衍生物;后代产物

ext.ext_cn: 他的设计是从一个 1956 年的装置衍生而来的。
ext.ext_en: His design was a descendant of a 1956 device...

ext.ext_cn: 它们是早期移民带来的一些植物的后代。
ext.ext_en: They are the descendants of plants imported by the early settlers.

defs.def_en: Something modern which developed from an older thing can be called a descendant of it.

defs.def_cn: 大惊小怪的人，谨小慎微的人，婆婆妈妈的人（尤指男人）
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone, especially a man, as an old woman, you are critical of them because you think they are too anxious about things.

defs.def_cn: 把…关在(房间)里面;把…关起来

ext.ext_cn: 有了这扇门，天气不好时我们就可以将鸟关进鸟屋。
ext.ext_en: The door enables us to shut the birds in the shelter in bad weather.

defs.def_en: If you shut someone or something in a room, you close the door so that they cannot leave it.

ext.ext_cn: 一个特别糟的结果出来后，他将自己关在淋浴间里关了一小时。
ext.ext_en: After one particular bad result, he shut himself in the shower room for an hour...

ext.ext_cn: 他把自己关在办公室里，并告诉秘书所有的电话都不要转给他。

ext.ext_en: In late May, government forces began the 'ethnic cleansing' of the area around the town.

ext.ext_en: ...the obnoxious policy of ethnic cleansing.

defs.def_en: Ethnic cleansing is the process of using violent methods to force certain groups of people out of a particular area or country.

ext.ext_cn: 只要你能从这些单词中找到四种鸟的名称你就赢了。
ext.ext_en: All you have to do to win is unscramble the words here to find four names of birds.

ext.ext_cn: 可以编程让用户来调试出传输信号的电路
ext.ext_en: ...electronic circuits which can be programmed to allow the user to unscramble transmitted signals.

defs.def_en: To unscramble things that are in a state of confusion or disorder means to arrange them so that they can be understood or seen clearly.

defs.def_cn: （通常指双色）格子的;有格子图案的

ext.ext_cn: 他穿着蓝色牛仔裤和格子衬衫。
ext.ext_en: He was wearing blue jeans and checked shirt.

defs.def_en: Something that is checked has a pattern of small squares, usually of two colours.

ext.ext_cn: 他去看一场戏剧的预演了。
ext.ext_en: He had gone to see the preview of a play.

ext.ext_cn: 可能在10年内普及的车型的内部预展
ext.ext_en: ...a sneak preview of the type of car that could be commonplace within ten years.

defs.def_en: A preview is an opportunity to see something such as a film, exhibition, or invention before it is open or available to the public.

defs.def_cn: 预先观看；为（电影等）写预评

ext.ext_cn: 这篇访谈在发表以前他就已经知道了，并且实际上还预先阅览过。
ext.ext_en: He knew about the interview prior to its publication and had actually previewed the piece...

ext.ext_cn: 尼克·沙利文对这一季来自巴黎和米兰的时装系列作了预评。
ext.ext_en: Nick Sullivan previews this season's collections from Paris and Milan.

defs.def_en: If a journalist previews something such as a film, exhibition, or invention, they see it and describe it to the public before the public see it for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 他脱掉湿衣服走进浴室。
ext.ext_en: He stripped off his wet clothes and stepped into the shower.

defs.def_en: See also:strip;If you strip off your clothes, you take them off.

defs.def_cn: 健美运动员；健身爱好者
defs.def_en: A bodybuilder is a person who does special exercises regularly in order to make his or her muscles grow bigger.
Goose pimples are the same as goose bumps .

defs.def_cn: (常指招徕生意的)叫卖词，推销套话
defs.def_en: Someone's spiel is a well-prepared speech that they make, and that they have usually made many times before, often in order to persuade you to buy something.
To wank means to masturbate.

defs.def_cn: （步子小而轻地）奔跑，疾走;蹦蹦跳跳

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们欢快地跑下黄色的校车，冲进运动场。
ext.ext_en: Children scampered off the yellow school bus and into the playground...

ext.ext_cn: 闪光惊得狐狸四处逃窜。
ext.ext_en: The flash sent the foxes scampering away.

defs.def_en: When people or small animals scamper somewhere, they move there quickly with small, light steps.

defs.def_cn: （表示两件事情同时发生）当…的时候，在…的同时

ext.ext_cn: 今早又有一名警员在冲突中受伤。
ext.ext_en: Another policeman has been injured as fighting continued this morning...

ext.ext_cn: 在他继续陈述的时候，全体陪审员的目光都集中在他身上。
ext.ext_en: All the jury's eyes were on him as he continued...

defs.def_en: If something happens as something else happens, it happens at the same time.

ext.ext_cn: 我从来没有碰到过像那次那么难的期末考试。
ext.ext_en: I never went through a final exam that was as difficult as that one...

ext.ext_cn: 找不出明显的理由来解释为什么这部片子拍得不如原先的好。
ext.ext_en: There was no obvious reason why this could not be as good a film as the original.

defs.def_en: You use the structure as...as when you are comparing things.

ext.ext_cn: 只要每个月存下区区10英镑，你就有希望得到相当可观的现金收益。
ext.ext_en: You can look forward to a significant cash return by saving from as little as £10 a month...

ext.ext_cn: 她一个月里收到的信件多达8,000封。
ext.ext_en: She gets as many as eight thousand letters a month.

defs.def_en: You use as...as to emphasize amounts of something.

ext.ext_cn: 他曾任驻美国、苏丹和沙特阿拉伯的外交官。
ext.ext_en: He has worked as a diplomat in the US, Sudan and Saudi Arabia...

ext.ext_cn: 这个消息显然让人大吃一惊。
ext.ext_en: The news apparently came as a complete surprise...

defs.def_en: You use as when you are indicating what someone or something is or is thought to be, or what function they have.

ext.ext_cn: 她从小就喜欢唱歌，12岁开始了声乐训练。
ext.ext_en: She loved singing as a child and started vocal training at 12.

defs.def_en: If you do something as a child or as a teenager, for example, you do it when you are a child or a teenager.

ext.ext_cn: 我会以希望别人对待我的方式来对待他们。
ext.ext_en: I'll behave toward them as I would like to be treated...

ext.ext_cn: 像往常一样，他今天穿的是三件套。
ext.ext_en: Today, as usual, he was wearing a three-piece suit...

defs.def_en: You use as to say how something happens or is done, or to indicate that something happens or is done in the same way as something else.

ext.ext_cn: 因为越来越担心住宅安全，更多的人在出门的时候会在家中留人。
ext.ext_en: As a result of the growing fears about home security, more people are arranging for someone to stay in their home when they're away...

ext.ext_cn: 在当今变幻莫测的商业环境下，员工被提出各种不同的要求。因此，教育体系有必要随之改变。
ext.ext_en: In this changing business environment, different demands are being placed on employees. As a consequence, the education system needs to change.

defs.def_en: You use as in expressions like as a result and as a consequence to indicate how two situations or events are related to each other.

ext.ext_cn: 如你所见，我们仍在工作。
ext.ext_en: As you can see, we're still working...

ext.ext_cn: 我记得我们当时是坐在一个河畔的餐馆里。
ext.ext_en: We were sitting, as I remember, in a riverside restaurant.

defs.def_en: You use as to introduce short clauses which comment on the truth of what you are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 他们经常会收到关于人身安全问题的宣传册，但因为大量文案工作缠身，他们几乎无暇阅读。
ext.ext_en: They are regularly sent booklets about personal safety, but they barely read them as they have so much paperwork to deal with...

ext.ext_cn: 好好享受每天的第一个小时。这之所以重要是因为它会决定你一整天的心情。
ext.ext_en: Enjoy the first hour of the day. This is important as it sets the mood for the rest of the day.

defs.def_en: You can use as to mean 'because' when you are explaining the reason for something.

ext.ext_cn: 字面的意思我懂了，但是可以说我并不能理解这个问题。
ext.ext_en: I'd understood the words, but I didn't, as it were, understand the question.

defs.def_en: You say as it were in order to make what you are saying sound less definite.

defs.def_cn: 事实上，实际上（表示实际情况和可能情况的对比）

ext.ext_cn: 我想周二在家工作，但实际上有时却是周三或是周四。
ext.ext_en: I want to work at home on a Tuesday but as it turns out sometimes it's a Wednesday or a Thursday.

defs.def_en: You use expressions such as as it is ,as it turns out, and as things stand when you are making a contrast between a possible situation and what actually happened or is the case.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得给警员的压力太大了。至于让他们佩枪，我并不认为是一个明智之举。
ext.ext_en: I feel that there's a lot of pressure put on policemen. And as for putting guns in their hands, I don't think that's a very good idea at all.

defs.def_en: You use as for and as to at the beginning of a sentence in order to introduce a slightly different subject that is still connected to the previous one.

ext.ext_cn: 他们应该决定学生是否需要更多的帮助。
ext.ext_en: They should make decisions as to whether the student needs more help...

ext.ext_cn: 安迪在桌边落座，询问出了什么问题。
ext.ext_en: Andy sat down at the table and inquired as to what the problem was.

defs.def_en: You use as to to indicate what something refers to.

ext.ext_cn: 实质上从1981年就已关闭的边境将于1月1日开放。
ext.ext_en: The border, effectively closed since 1981, will be opened as of January the 1st...

ext.ext_cn: 她将于10月1日退休。
ext.ext_en: She is to retire as from 1 October.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen as of, or in British English as from, a particular date or time, you mean that it will happen from that time on.

ext.ext_cn: 安妮耸了耸肩，好像她并不知晓。
ext.ext_en: Anne shrugged, as if she didn't know...

ext.ext_cn: 他突然放声大笑，好像讲了什么好笑的事似的。
ext.ext_en: He burst into a high-pitched laugh, as though he'd said something funny.

defs.def_en: You use as if and as though when you are giving a possible explanation for something or saying that something appears to be the case when it is not.

ext.ext_cn: 鳞次栉比的建筑群
ext.ext_en: ...a conglomeration of buildings, all tightly packed together.

ext.ext_cn: 汇聚一地的南腔北调的民族
ext.ext_en: ...a conglomeration of peoples speaking different languages.

defs.def_en: A conglomeration of things is a group of many different things, gathered together.

defs.def_cn: (通常在圣诞节由儿童表演的)耶稣诞生剧，圣诞剧
defs.def_en: A nativity play is a play about the birth of Jesus, usually one performed by children at Christmas time.

ext.ext_cn: 把土豆大致切一下，煮成半熟。
ext.ext_en: Roughly chop and parboil the potatoes.

defs.def_en: If you parboil food, especially vegetables, you boil it until it is partly cooked.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 值得尊敬的;值得敬仰的;值得仰慕的

ext.ext_cn: 令人仰慕的卡特赖特小姐
ext.ext_en: ...the estimable Miss Cartwright.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as estimable, you mean that they deserve admiration.

ext.ext_cn: 该调查在英格兰和威尔士随机抽样了2,000人。
ext.ext_en: The survey used a random sample of two thousand people across England and Wales...

ext.ext_cn: 参赛者将要接受随机药检。
ext.ext_en: The competitors will be subject to random drug testing.

defs.def_en: A random sample or method is one in which all the people or things involved have an equal chance of being chosen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 加诸无辜受害者的无端暴行
ext.ext_en: ...random violence against innocent victims...

ext.ext_cn: 小孩子的言行常常是随性而为。
ext.ext_en: Children's words and actions are often fairly random.

defs.def_en: If you describe events as random, you mean that they do not seem to follow a definite plan or pattern.

ext.ext_cn: 我们收到了一些答复，并从中随机挑选了一个。
ext.ext_en: We received several answers, and we picked one at random.

defs.def_en: If you choose people or things at random, you do not use any particular method, so they all have an equal chance of being chosen.

ext.ext_cn: 3名黑人被从一辆面包车里胡乱射出的子弹打死了。
ext.ext_en: Three black people were killed by shots fired at random from a minibus.

defs.def_en: If something happens at random, it happens without a definite plan or pattern.
An overcoat is a thick warm coat that you wear in winter.

defs.def_cn: 溶媒滥用(指为获得醉感而吸入有害气体)
defs.def_en: Solvent abuse is the dangerous practice of breathing in the gases from substances such as glue in order to feel as if you are drunk.

defs.def_cn: （卷绕之物）展开，伸展；展开，将…伸展开

ext.ext_cn: 他把软管铺展开来，把它们彻底冲洗了一下。
ext.ext_en: He uncoiled the hose and gave them a thorough drenching...

ext.ext_cn: 丹摆弄着那片橘子皮，将它不停地展开来卷回去。
ext.ext_en: Dan played with the tangerine peel, letting it uncoil and then coil again...

defs.def_en: If something uncoils or if you uncoil it, it becomes straight after it has been wound or curled up. If someone who is curled up uncoils, they move so that their body becomes straight.

ext.ext_cn: 他被认为是现代最为成功的财政大臣。
ext.ext_en: He was regarded as the most successful Chancellor of modern times...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为创造力既是一种天赋也是一种技巧。
ext.ext_en: I regard creativity both as a gift and as a skill.

defs.def_en: If you regard someone or something as being a particular thing or as having a particular quality, you believe that they are that thing or have that quality.

defs.def_cn: 对…怀有（某种感情）;以（某种感情）看待

ext.ext_cn: 他对贩毒分子深恶痛绝。
ext.ext_en: He regarded drug dealers with loathing...

ext.ext_cn: 情感的流露会招致猜疑。
ext.ext_en: Displays of emotion are regarded with suspicion...

defs.def_en: If you regard something or someone with a feeling such as dislike or respect, you have that feeling about them.

ext.ext_cn: 她好奇地看了他一会儿。
ext.ext_en: She regarded him curiously for a moment...

ext.ext_cn: 这个职员好心而又饶有兴趣地看着他。
ext.ext_en: The clerk regarded him with benevolent amusement.

defs.def_en: If you regard someone in a certain way, you look at them in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 我非常钦佩他的为人和成就。
ext.ext_en: I have a very high regard for him and what he has achieved...

ext.ext_cn: 到处都是武装分子，视人命如草芥。
ext.ext_en: There were armed people about, people with little regard for human life...

defs.def_en: If you have regard for someone or something, you respect them and care about them. If you hold someone in high regard, you have a lot of respect for them.

defs.def_cn: 问候，致意（尤用于信中表示问好）

ext.ext_cn: 请代我向你家人问好。
ext.ext_en: Give my regards to your family...

ext.ext_cn: 请转达我对玛丽的良好祝愿。
ext.ext_en: My best regards to Mary.

defs.def_en: Regards are greetings. You use regards in expressions such as best regards and with kind regards as a way of expressing friendly feelings towards someone, especially in a letter.

ext.ext_cn: 至于这场战争，黑格认为要不惜任何代价取得胜利。
ext.ext_en: As regards the war, Haig believed in victory at any price.

defs.def_en: You can use as regards to indicate the subject that is being talked or written about.

ext.ext_cn: 这个部门正在审度其有关疫苗接种的政策。
ext.ext_en: The department is reviewing its policy with regard to immunisation.

defs.def_en: You can use with regard to or in regard to to indicate the subject that is being talked or written about.

defs.def_cn: 在这/那方面；就这/那一点

ext.ext_cn: 在这方面没什么变化。
ext.ext_en: In this regard nothing has changed...

ext.ext_cn: 我在那一点上可能已经犯了一个错误。
ext.ext_en: I may have made a mistake in that regard.

defs.def_en: You can use in this regard or in that regard to refer back to something that you have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 唱诗班的演唱准确无误。
ext.ext_en: The choir sang with precision...

ext.ext_cn: 内部设计一丝不苟，足以让军方引以为豪。
ext.ext_en: The interior is planned with a precision the military would be proud of.

defs.def_en: If you do something with precision, you do it exactly as it should be done.

defs.def_cn: (教士和唱诗班成员穿的)白色罩衣

ext.ext_cn: 穿着蕾丝白色罩袍的教士和唱诗班
ext.ext_en: ...the priest and choir in their lace surplices.

defs.def_en: A surplice is a loose white knee-length garment which is worn over a longer garment by priests and members of the choir in some churches.
A packing house is a company that processes and packs food, especially meat, to be sold.
A wastepaper basket is a container for rubbish, especially paper, which is usually placed on the floor in the corner of a room or next to a desk.

ext.ext_cn: 他讨厌艺术应由知识分子所掌控的观点。
ext.ext_en: The notion that art should be controlled by intellectuals sickened him...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管他干了多年的警察工作，但在那里所见的一切还是让他感到恶心。
ext.ext_en: What he saw there sickened him, despite all his years of police work.

defs.def_en: If something sickens you, it makes you feel disgusted.

ext.ext_cn: 他们中的很多人都患病身亡。
ext.ext_en: Many of them sickened and died.

defs.def_en: If you sicken, you become ill.

ext.ext_cn: 各个小组都想要控制其他小组的企图
ext.ext_en: ...an attempt by each group to establish dominance over the other...

ext.ext_cn: 这些经济制度将毫无疑问地维持他们在金融市场上的主导权。
ext.ext_en: These economies will no doubt maintain their dominance of financial markets...

defs.def_en: The dominance of a particular person or thing is the fact that they are more powerful, successful, or important than other people or things.

defs.def_cn: (策略、方法)强硬的，铁拳的，使用暴力强制的，横施淫威的

ext.ext_cn: 没有恶语相向也没有大动干戈就把这笔钱要回来了。
ext.ext_en: The money has been recovered without resorting to verbal abuse or strong-arm tactics...

ext.ext_cn: 该报纸对这位铁腕总统进行公开的批评。
ext.ext_en: The paper is openly critical of the strong-arm president.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's behaviour as strong-arm tactics or methods, you disapprove of it because it consists of using threats or force in order to achieve something.
A cortege is a procession of people who are walking or riding in cars to a funeral.
A churchyard is an area of land around a church where dead people are buried.

ext.ext_cn: 个人的自由意志
ext.ext_en: ...the free will of the individual.

defs.def_en: If you believe in free will, you believe that people have a choice in what they do and that their actions have not been decided in advance by God or by any other power.

defs.def_cn: 出于自愿;出于自由选择地

ext.ext_cn: 贝萨妮会像她承诺的那样自愿回来吗？
ext.ext_en: Would Bethany return of her own free will, as she had promised?

defs.def_en: If you do something of your own free will, you do it by choice and not because you are forced to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 1952年她嫁给了电影导演罗杰·瓦丹 。
ext.ext_en: In 1952 she wed film director Roger Vadim...

ext.ext_cn: 深夜这对情侣在仅有的9位宾客面前举行了婚礼。
ext.ext_en: The couple wed late at night in front of just nine guests...

defs.def_en: newlywed;wedded;If one person weds another or if two people wed or are wed, they get married.

ext.ext_cn: 就是这样一种情况，“只要干某某事，你就能拿到钱”。
ext.ext_en: It would be a case of 'just do so-and-so and here's your cash'...

ext.ext_cn: 如果某某太太病了，那么她的街坊某某太太就会来为她打扫卫生。
ext.ext_en: If Mrs So-and-so was ill then Mrs So-and-so down the street would go and clean for her.

defs.def_en: You use so-and-so instead of a word, expression, or name when you are talking generally rather than giving a specific example of a particular thing.

defs.def_cn: 讨厌鬼，笨蛋(用以代替脏字眼)

ext.ext_cn: 都是她的错，这个小坏东西。
ext.ext_en: All her fault, the wicked little so-and-so.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to another person as a so-and-so when they are annoyed with them or think that they are foolish. People often use so-and-so in order to avoid using a swear word.

ext.ext_cn: 滚烫的水喷了出来。
ext.ext_en: Piping-hot water gushed out...

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙海岸附近的一艘超级油轮仍在大量漏油。
ext.ext_en: A supertanker continues to gush oil off the coast of Spain.

defs.def_en: When liquid gushes out of something, or when something gushes a liquid, the liquid flows out very quickly and in large quantities.

ext.ext_cn: 我听到一股水流涌出。
ext.ext_en: I heard a gush of water.

defs.def_en: A gush of liquid is a sudden, rapid flow of liquid, or a quantity of it that suddenly flows out.

defs.def_cn: 过分称赞；吹捧；装腔作势地说

ext.ext_cn: “哦，棒极了。”他夸张地说。
ext.ext_en: 'Oh, it was brilliant,' he gushes...

ext.ext_cn: 他吹嘘自己如何爱妻子。
ext.ext_en: He gushed about his love for his wife.

defs.def_en: If someone gushes, they express their admiration or pleasure in an exaggerated way.

ext.ext_cn: 对母亲的爱突然涌上她的心头。
ext.ext_en: She felt a gush of pure affection for her mother...

ext.ext_cn: 他们最初怀有的深切同情渐渐地消失了。
ext.ext_en: Their initial gush of sympathy gradually dried up.

defs.def_en: You can use gush in expressions such as a gush of enthusiasm to refer to a sudden intense feeling or an expression of a feeling.

ext.ext_cn: 我很想庆祝一下。
ext.ext_en: I was in a mood to celebrate...

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆两天前庆祝了他的24岁生日。
ext.ext_en: Tom celebrated his 24th birthday two days ago.

defs.def_en: If you celebrate, you do something enjoyable because of a special occasion or to mark someone's success.

ext.ext_cn: 这个协会今年将举办成立10周年庆典。
ext.ext_en: The Society is celebrating its tenth anniversary this year.

defs.def_en: If an organization or country is celebrating an anniversary, it has existed for that length of time and is doing something special because of it.

ext.ext_cn: 教皇保罗二世今天在波兰中部的一个城市主持了弥撒。
ext.ext_en: Pope John Paul celebrated mass today in a city in central Poland.

defs.def_en: When priests celebrate Holy Communion or Mass, they officially perform the actions and ceremonies that are involved.

ext.ext_cn: 星期六早上她在录音室接到他打来的电话。
ext.ext_en: She had a call from him on Saturday morning at the studio...

ext.ext_cn: 每个星期六爸爸都做美味的豌豆火腿汤。
ext.ext_en: Every Saturday dad made a beautiful pea and ham soup...

defs.def_en: Saturday is the day after Friday and before Sunday.
A full-page advertisement, picture, or article in a newspaper or magazine uses a whole page.

ext.ext_cn: 我不该抱怨妈妈——她真的很好。
ext.ext_en: I shouldn't grumble about Mum — she's lovely really...

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the perfect setting for a nostalgic memorable day...

ext.ext_en: ...a sporting rifle fitted with a telescopic sight.

defs.def_en: Telescopic lenses and instruments are used to make things seem larger and nearer, and are usually longer than others of the same type.

ext.ext_en: ...this new lightweight telescopic ladder.

defs.def_en: A telescopic object is made of cylindrical sections that fit or slide into each other, so that it can be made longer or shorter, for example to save space when it is not being used.

defs.def_cn: 罪犯；恶棍；社会渣滓；下层社会生活

ext.ext_en: ...the sort of low-life characters who populate this film.

defs.def_en: People sometimes use low life to refer in a disapproving way to people who are involved in criminal, dishonest, or immoral activities, or to these activities.

defs.def_cn: 删除，删改（书或电影中的部分）

ext.ext_cn: 我在对它作些改动——只是改换个别字眼，好让听众更容易接受。
ext.ext_en: I'm bowdlerizing it — just slightly changing one or two words so listeners won't be upset.

ext.ext_cn: 这首歌曲的删节版
ext.ext_en: ...a bowdlerised version of the song.

defs.def_en: To bowdlerize a book or film means to take parts of it out before publishing it or showing it.

defs.def_cn: (供观看比赛的人记录运动员成绩的)记分卡
defs.def_en: A scorecard is a printed card that tells you who is taking part in a match, and on which officials, players, or people watching can record each player's score.

ext.ext_cn: 该委员会将对联合国的成员国采用环境记录卡制。
ext.ext_en: This commission would keep environmental scorecards on UN member nations.

ext.ext_cn: 一套获得认可的标准，一种可用于检测任何特定计算机系统的安全特征记录卡系统
ext.ext_en: ...a set of recognized standards, a sort of scorecard of security features that can be used to test any given computer system.

defs.def_en: A scorecard is a system or procedure that is used for checking or testing something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Amy thought she caught the faintest drift of Isabel's flowery perfume.

defs.def_en: A flowery smell is strong and sweet, like flowers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The baby, dressed in a flowery jumpsuit, waved her rattle.

defs.def_en: Flowery cloth, paper, or china has a lot of flowers printed or painted on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: They were using uncommonly flowery language.

defs.def_en: Flowery speech or writing contains long or literary words and expressions.

defs.def_cn: 使改变宗教（或政治）信仰

ext.ext_en: I assured him we didn't come here to proselytize...

ext.ext_cn: 基督徒因为试图改变他人信仰而被捕。
ext.ext_en: Christians were arrested for trying to convert people, to proselytise them.

defs.def_en: If you proselytize, you try to persuade someone to share your beliefs, especially religious or political beliefs.

defs.def_cn: （教堂等公共建筑物里座席间或超市货架间的）纵直通道，走道
