ext.ext_en: He started down the centre aisle.

ext.ext_cn: 冷冻食物通道
ext.ext_en: ...the frozen food aisle.

defs.def_en: An aisle is a long narrow gap that people can walk along between rows of seats in a public building such as a church or between rows of shelves in a supermarket.

defs.def_cn: （用于walking down the aisle等短语中）行婚礼的仪式

ext.ext_cn: 他并不急于结婚。
ext.ext_en: He was in no hurry to walk down the aisle.

defs.def_en: The aisle is used in expressions such as walking down the aisle to refer to the activity of getting married.

defs.def_cn: 所得税预扣制（英国所得税制，雇主直接从员工工资中扣除应缴税款并上缴政府）
defs.def_en: In Britain, PAYE is a system of paying income tax in which your employer pays your tax directly to the government, and then takes this amount from your salary or wages. PAYE is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'pay as you earn'.

In grammar, a relative clause is a subordinate clause which specifies or gives information about a person or thing. Relative clauses come after a noun or pronoun and, in English, often begin with a relative pronoun such as 'who', 'which', or 'that'.

ext.ext_cn: 高额的边际税率可能会对加班起到抑制作用。
ext.ext_en: High marginal tax rates may act as a disincentive to working longer hours.

defs.def_en: A disincentive is something which discourages people from behaving or acting in a particular way.

defs.def_cn: 收回，撤回(所说的话或写的东西)

ext.ext_cn: 史密斯先生想赶快收回这项声明，但它刚刚已经在国家电台播出了。
ext.ext_en: Mr Smith hurriedly sought to retract the statement, but it had just been broadcast on national radio...

ext.ext_en: He's hoping that if he makes me feel guilty, I'll retract.

defs.def_en: If you retract something that you have said or written, you say that you did not mean it.

ext.ext_en: Torn muscles retract, and lose strength, structure, and tightness.

ext.ext_cn: 当飞机的轮子收起来的时候
ext.ext_en: ...when the aircraft's wheels were retracted.

defs.def_en: When a part of a machine or a part of a person's body retracts or is retracted, it moves inwards or becomes shorter.

ext.ext_en: ...the United States pavilion at the Expo '70 exhibition in Japan.

defs.def_en: A pavilion is a large temporary structure such as a tent, which is used at outdoor public events.

ext.ext_en: ...Humphrey Repton's design for a garden pavilion at Durham Park.

defs.def_en: Sunshine is the light and heat that comes from the sun.

defs.def_en: If a newspaper or magazine prints a piece of writing, it includes it or publishes it.

ext.ext_en: The company has for some time printed its phone number on its products...

ext.ext_en: In this living room we've mixed glorious floral prints.

ext.ext_en: I selected two negatives to print from.

defs.def_en: When you print a photograph, you produce it from a negative.

ext.ext_en: ...black and white prints of Margaret and Jean as children.

ext.ext_cn: 35毫米的彩色胶片
ext.ext_en: ...35mm colour print films.

ext.ext_en: First released in 1957, the movie now appears in a new print.

defs.def_en: A print of a cinema film is a particular copy or set of copies of it.

ext.ext_cn: 威廉·霍加斯著名的版画系列
ext.ext_en: ...William Hogarth's famous series of prints.

defs.def_en: A print is one of a number of copies of a particular picture. It can be either a photograph, something such as a painting, or a picture made by an artist who puts ink on a prepared surface and presses it against paper.

defs.def_cn: 印出的字； 印刷字体

ext.ext_en: Laser printers give high quality print.

defs.def_en: Print is used to refer to letters and numbers as they appear on the pages of a book, newspaper, or printed document.

ext.ext_cn: 我已经确信印刷媒体比电视更准确、更可靠。
ext.ext_en: I have been convinced that the print media are more accurate and more reliable than television.

ext.ext_cn: 报刊业记者
ext.ext_en: ...print journalists.

defs.def_en: The print media consists of newspapers and magazines, but not television or radio.

ext.ext_en: Print your name and address on a postcard and send it to us.

defs.def_en: If you print words, you write in letters that are not joined together and that look like the letters in a book or newspaper.

ext.ext_cn: 它沿着脚印向前爬，在地面上嗅着，追踪着路上留下的气味。
ext.ext_en: He crawled from print to print, sniffing at the earth, following the scent left in the tracks.

ext.ext_cn: 靴印
ext.ext_en: ...boot prints.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a mark left by someone's foot as a print .

ext.ext_en: Fresh prints of both girls were found in the flat.

defs.def_en: You can refer to invisible marks left by someone's fingers as their prints .

ext.ext_cn: 这些诗人中有很多都是在去世很久以后作品才得以发表的。

ext.ext_cn: 这些日记近期不会发表。
ext.ext_en: There was no immediate prospect of the diaries getting into print.

defs.def_en: If you appear in print, or get into print, what you say or write is published in a book, newspaper, or magazine.

ext.ext_en: Many of their books have been in print for nearly 40 years.

defs.def_en: If a book is in print, copies of it are still being produced.

ext.ext_en: I believe the book is now out of print, but it can easily be borrowed from libraries.

defs.def_en: If a book is out of print, copies of it are no longer being produced.

ext.ext_en: This might be a good time for Button's management to study the fine print of his contract.

defs.def_en: The small print or the fine print of something such as an advertisement or a contract consists of the technical details and legal conditions, which are often printed in much smaller letters than the rest of the text.

defs.def_cn: 独奏会，诗歌朗诵会，个人演唱会

defs.def_en: A recital is a performance of music or poetry, usually given by one person.

ext.ext_en: They spent a great deal of time watching television.

defs.def_en: If you watch something on television or an event such as a sports match, you spend time looking at it, especially when you see it from the beginning to the end.

defs.def_en: If you watch people, especially children or animals, you are responsible for them, and make sure that they are not in danger.

ext.ext_en: Ella was scared that someone was watching her...

ext.ext_en: I always had the feeling we were being watched.

ext.ext_en: You really ought to watch these quiet types...

ext.ext_en: If you're watching the calories, don't have mayonnaise.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to watch a particular person or thing, you are warning them to be careful that the person or thing does not get out of control or do something unpleasant.

ext.ext_en: I had the first watch that May evening.

defs.def_en: A watch is a period of carefully looking and listening, often while other people are asleep and often as a military duty, so that you can warn them of danger or an attack.

ext.ext_en: Jose, as usual, had climbed a tree to keep watch.

defs.def_en: If someone keeps watch, they look and listen all the time, while other people are asleep or doing something else, so that they can warn them of danger or an attack.

ext.ext_cn: 美国官员一直密切注意着事态的发展。
ext.ext_en: US officials have been keeping close watch on the situation.

defs.def_en: If you keep watch on events or a situation, you pay attention to what is happening, so that you can take action at the right moment.

ext.ext_cn: “留点神，帕齐。”中士提醒她。
ext.ext_en: 'Now watch it, Patsy,' the Sergeant told her.

defs.def_en: You say 'watch it' in order to warn someone to be careful, especially when you want to threaten them about what will happen if they are not careful.

defs.def_cn: （通常指军队夜间的）警戒，值夜

ext.ext_en: Apart from two men on watch in the engine-room, everyone was asleep.

defs.def_en: If someone is on watch, they have the job of carefully looking and listening, often while other people are asleep and often as a military duty, so that they can warn them of danger or an attack.

ext.ext_en: Environmentalists will be on the watch for damage to wildlife.

defs.def_en: If you are on the watch for something, you are expecting it to happen and you therefore pay attention to events so that you will notice it when it does happen.

defs.def_cn: 受到保卫;受到监视;被密切关注
defs.def_en: If someone is being kept under watch, they are being guarded or observed all the time.

ext.ext_en: You watch. Things will get worse before they get better.

defs.def_en: You say to someone 'you watch' or 'just watch' when you are predicting that something will happen, and you are very confident that it will happen as you say.

An encyclopedia is a book or set of books in which facts about many different subjects or about one particular subject are arranged for reference, usually in alphabetical order.

defs.def_en: If you hear one sound above another, it is louder or clearer than the second one.

ext.ext_en: I know you're above me socially, but I must say I find your attitude offensive...

defs.def_en: If someone is above you, they are in a higher social position than you or in a position of authority over you.

ext.ext_en: I just think you're getting a little bit above yourself.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is getting above themself, you disapprove of them because they think they are better than everyone else.

ext.ext_en: This was clearly a failure by someone who thought he was above failure...

ext.ext_cn: 我很乐意自己做扫除。

defs.def_en: If you say that someone thinks they are above something, you mean that they act as if they are too good or important for it.

ext.ext_en: I want to be honest, honest above everything else.

ext.ext_cn: 一位身材高大的中年女士拍了拍我的后背说：“很高兴再次见到你。”
ext.ext_en: A large middle-aged lady slapped me on the back and said 'Nice to see you again.'

defs.def_en: If you slap someone on the back, you hit them in a friendly manner on their back.

ext.ext_cn: 酒吧服务生麻利地把茶杯放在了茶碟上。
ext.ext_en: The barman slapped the cup on to the waiting saucer.

defs.def_en: If you slap something onto a surface, you put it there quickly, roughly, or carelessly.

defs.def_cn: (不合理或草率地)施加(赋税、禁令等)

ext.ext_cn: 政府贸然禁止出口未加工过的原木。
ext.ext_en: The government slapped a ban on the export of unprocessed logs...

ext.ext_cn: 谢天谢地，政府还没有找到对爱情、阳光和空气课税的方法。
ext.ext_en: Thankfully the Government still hasn't discovered a way of slapping a tax on love, sunshine or air.

defs.def_en: If journalists say that the authorities slap something such as a tax or a ban on something, they think it is unreasonable or put on without careful thought.

ext.ext_cn: 《太阳报》称之为打在美国政府脸上的一记重重的耳光。
ext.ext_en: 'The Sun' calls it a massive slap in the face for the United States government...

ext.ext_cn: 英国人坚持认为加薪不到 5%不啻于一种羞辱。
ext.ext_en: Britons persist in treating any pay rise of less than 5% as a slap in the face.

defs.def_en: If you describe something that someone does as a slap in the face, you mean that it shocks or upsets you because it shows that they do not support you or respect you.

defs.def_cn: 轻微的警告;轻微的惩罚

ext.ext_cn: 他们对她开出的罚金不过是一个轻微的警告而已。
ext.ext_en: The fine they gave her is just more or less a slap on the wrist.

defs.def_en: A slap on the wrist is a warning or a punishment that is not very severe.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 吸引人的;迷人的;引人注目的

ext.ext_cn: 休坐在床上，穿着印花宽松短睡衣，显得非常迷人。
ext.ext_en: Sue was sitting up in bed, looking very fetching in a flowered bedjacket...

ext.ext_cn: 贝克汉姆穿了一件抢眼的紫绿两色套装。
ext.ext_en: Beckham wore a fetching outfit in purple and green.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as fetching, you think that they look very attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 当前的这一系列政治谋杀乃是那些想阻挠和平谈判的人所为。
ext.ext_en: The present wave of political killings is the work of people trying to derail peace talks.

defs.def_en: To derail something such as a plan or a series of negotiations means to prevent it from continuing as planned.

ext.ext_cn: 今天有数人在一列火车出轨时受了伤。
ext.ext_en: Several people were injured today when a train was derailed...

ext.ext_cn: 没人知道火车为什么会脱轨。
ext.ext_en: No-one knows why the train derailed.

defs.def_en: If a train is derailed or if it derails, it comes off the track on which it is running.

defs.def_cn: 含沙射影地说;旁敲侧击地指出;暗示

ext.ext_cn: 一篇文章因含沙射影声称总统撒谎而遭到诽谤索赔。
ext.ext_en: The libel claim followed an article which insinuated that the President was lying...

ext.ext_cn: 你是在旁敲侧击地说我身上有臭味吗？
ext.ext_en: Are you insinuating that I smell?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone insinuates that something bad is the case, you mean that they say it in an indirect way.

defs.def_cn: 使逐渐而巧妙地取得;使迂回潜入(或挤入)

ext.ext_cn: 他处心积虑终于一步步走进了她的生活。
ext.ext_en: He gradually insinuated himself into her life.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone insinuates themselves into a particular situation, you mean that they manage very cleverly, and perhaps dishonestly, to get into that situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我非常希望这起事件能催生变革。
ext.ext_en: I very much hope that this case will prove to be a catalyst for change...

ext.ext_cn: 他说，他认为银行就应该起到刺激外国直接投资的作用。
ext.ext_en: He said he saw the bank's role as a catalyst to encourage foreign direct investment.

defs.def_en: You can describe a person or thing that causes a change or event to happen as a catalyst .
In chemistry, a catalyst is a substance that causes a chemical reaction to take place more quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 巴赫的一曲众赞歌
ext.ext_en: ...a Bach chorale.

defs.def_en: A chorale is a piece of music sung as part of a church service.
A chorale is a group of people who sing together.
An evolutionist is someone who accepts the scientific theory that all living things evolved from a few simple life forms.

ext.ext_cn: 趴着睡的婴儿似乎患婴儿猝死综合征的几率更高。
ext.ext_en: SIDS appears to be somewhat more common among babies who sleep on their stomachs.

defs.def_en: SIDS is used to talk about the sudden death of a baby while it is asleep, when it had not previously been ill. SIDS is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'sudden infant death syndrome'.

ext.ext_cn: 美国总统赞扬了土耳其的勇气。
ext.ext_en: The American president praised Turkey for its courage...

ext.ext_cn: 其他很多人称赞桑福德立场坚定。
ext.ext_en: Many others praised Sanford for taking a strong stand...

defs.def_en: If you praise someone or something, you express approval for their achievements or qualities.

ext.ext_cn: 所有女士都高度赞扬了工作人员和他们所提供的服务。
ext.ext_en: All the ladies are full of praise for the staff and service they received...

ext.ext_cn: 我对警方唯有称赞。
ext.ext_en: I have nothing but praise for the police...

defs.def_en: Praise is what you say or write about someone when you are praising them.

ext.ext_cn: 她请求教会赞美上帝。
ext.ext_en: She asked the church to praise God.

defs.def_en: If you praise God, you express your respect, honour, and thanks to God.

ext.ext_cn: 印度教教徒在唱圣歌赞美罗摩神。
ext.ext_en: Hindus were singing hymns in praise of the god Rama.

defs.def_en: Praise is the expression of respect, honour, and thanks to God.

defs.def_cn: 用冷漠的赞许贬低；明褒实贬

ext.ext_cn: 认为美国对调停努力明褒实贬是表明其政策已发生转变的观点
ext.ext_en: ...the belief that the US had signalled a policy shift by damning with faint praise the mediation efforts.

defs.def_en: If someone damns something with faint praise, they say something about it which sounds quite nice but is not enthusiastic, and shows that they do not have a high opinion of it.

ext.ext_cn: 奥特肖多年来对你一直高度赞赏。
ext.ext_en: Ottershaw's been singing your praises for years...

ext.ext_cn: 安迪·辛顿不是一个惯于吹嘘自我的人。
ext.ext_en: Andy Sinton is not a man given to singing his own praises.

defs.def_en: If you sing someone's praises, you praise them in an enthusiastic way.

defs.def_cn: 人马宫，人马座(黄道十二宫之一。出生于11月22日至12月21日之间的人属比星座)
defs.def_en: Sagittarius is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac. Its symbol is a creature that is half horse, half man, shooting an arrow. People who are born approximately between the 22nd of November and the 21st of December come under this sign.

defs.def_cn: 出生于人马宫时段的人
defs.def_en: A Sagittarius is a person whose sign of the zodiac is Sagittarius.

ext.ext_cn: 净利润暴跌了 41%。
ext.ext_en: Net profits slumped by 41%...

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰政府的支持率骤跌至 20 世纪 70 年代以来的最低水平。 Slump is also a noun.
ext.ext_en: Government popularity in Scotland has slumped to its lowest level since the 1970s.

defs.def_en: If something such as the value of something slumps, it falls suddenly and by a large amount.

ext.ext_cn: 20 世纪 80 年代初的大萧条
ext.ext_en: ...the slump of the early 1980s.

defs.def_en: A slump is a time when many people in a country are unemployed and poor.

defs.def_cn: (因疲劳、生病等而重重)倒下，跌倒

ext.ext_cn: 她轰然倒在了椅子上。
ext.ext_en: She slumped into a chair...

ext.ext_cn: 他看见司机一头栽在了方向盘上。
ext.ext_en: He saw the driver slumped over the wheel.

defs.def_en: If you slump somewhere, you fall or sit down there heavily, for example because you are very tired or you feel ill.

ext.ext_cn: 过去8个月的痛苦煎熬
ext.ext_en: ...the painful ordeal of the last eight months...

ext.ext_cn: 她描述了自己备受折磨的苦难经历。
ext.ext_en: She described her agonising ordeal.

defs.def_en: If you describe an experience or situation as an ordeal, you think it is difficult and unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 一些公司把工人薪水减至低于合同规定的水平，这种做法在德国是非法的。
ext.ext_en: Some firms have cut workers' pay below the level set in their contract, a practice that is illegal in Germany...

ext.ext_cn: 戈登·布朗已要求对银行的惯例做法进行公开调查。
ext.ext_en: Gordon Brown has demanded a public inquiry into bank practices.

defs.def_en: You can refer to something that people do regularly as a practice .

ext.ext_cn: 她每天都带3个女儿进行篮球训练。
ext.ext_en: She was taking all three of her daughters to basketball practice every day...

ext.ext_cn: 从初学者成长为有造诣的音乐家所必需的艰苦训练
ext.ext_en: ...the hard practice necessary to develop from a learner to an accomplished musician...

defs.def_en: Practice means doing something regularly in order to be able to do it better. A practice is one of these periods of doing something.

defs.def_cn: （医生或律师的）业务活动，工作；宗教活动

ext.ext_cn: 内科业务
ext.ext_en: ...the practice of internal medicine...

ext.ext_cn: 我终于认识到自己不得不改变对医务工作的看法。
ext.ext_en: I eventually realized I had to change my attitude toward medical practice.

defs.def_en: The work done by doctors and lawyers is referred to as the practice of medicine and law. People's religious activities are referred to as the practice of a religion.

ext.ext_cn: 新开的诊所离我住的地方有几英里远。
ext.ext_en: The new doctor's practice was miles away from where I lived...

ext.ext_cn: 你知道，我的律师事务所不是我生活里最重要的事情。
ext.ext_en: My law practice isn't the most important thing in my life, you know.

defs.def_en: A doctor's or lawyer's practice is his or her business, often shared with other doctors or lawyers.

ext.ext_cn: 公布于众的外交政策和实际外交政策的区别
ext.ext_en: ...the difference between foreign policy as presented to the public and foreign policy in actual practice...

ext.ext_cn: 事实上，工人工作并不是为了满足本身的需要。
ext.ext_en: In practice, workers do not work to satisfy their needs.

defs.def_en: What happens in practice is what actually happens, in contrast to what is supposed to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 不透露患者病情的细节是惯常的做法。
ext.ext_en: It is normal practice not to reveal details of a patient's condition...

ext.ext_cn: 抄本上全是密码，这种做法是所有军队的惯例。
ext.ext_en: The transcript is full of codewords, which is standard practice in any army.

defs.def_en: If something such as a procedure is normal practice or standard practice, it is the usual thing that is done in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: “你的德语如何？”——“还行，只是长时间没练习了。”
ext.ext_en: 'How's your German?' — 'Not bad, but I'm out of practice.'

defs.def_en: If you are out of practice at doing something, you have not had much experience of it recently, although you used to do it a lot or be quite good at it.
If you say 'practice makes perfect ', you mean that it is possible to learn something or develop a skill if you practise enough. People often say this to encourage someone to keep practising.

ext.ext_cn: 既然首相又掌权了，他就重新有机会实施他的新想法。
ext.ext_en: Now that he is back, the prime minister has another chance to put his new ideas into practice...

ext.ext_cn: 我们不能够将所受的教义在日常生活中付诸实践。
ext.ext_en: We weren't allowed to put into practice in our daily lives the teachings we received.

defs.def_en: If you put a belief or method into practice, you behave or act in accordance with it.
A spotlight is a powerful light, for example in a theatre, which can be directed so that it lights up a small area.

ext.ext_cn: 预算危机也突显了正在衰退的美国经济。
ext.ext_en: The budget crisis also spotlighted a weakening American economy.

ext.ext_cn: 一本关注女企业家的新书
ext.ext_en: ...a new book spotlighting female entrepreneurs.

defs.def_en: If something spotlights a particular problem or situation, it makes people notice it and think about it.

defs.def_cn: 成为公众关注的焦点;受到瞩目

ext.ext_cn: 韦布又重新成为焦点。
ext.ext_en: Webb is back in the spotlight.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is in the spotlight is getting a great deal of public attention.

defs.def_cn: 备受(媒体和公众的)关注

ext.ext_cn: 经济将会成为今天工会代表大会会议上的焦点。
ext.ext_en: The economy will come under the spotlight today at the conference of the Trades Union Congress.

defs.def_en: If someone or something comes under the spotlight, they are thoroughly examined, especially by journalists and the public.

defs.def_cn: (使)(身体部位，尤指喉咙)收紧，收缩

ext.ext_cn: 严重的偏头疼可以用一种收缩血管的药物进行治疗。
ext.ext_en: Severe migraine can be treated with a drug which constricts the blood vessels...

ext.ext_cn: 我的嗓子发紧，所以我不得不把注意力集中在呼吸上。
ext.ext_en: My throat constricted, so that I had to concentrate on breathing.

defs.def_en: If a part of your body, especially your throat, is constricted or if it constricts, something causes it to become narrower.

ext.ext_cn: 她反对政府顾问设计的考试，因为这些考试限制了她的教学风格。
ext.ext_en: She objects to the tests the Government's advisers have devised because they constrict her teaching style...

ext.ext_cn: 男性和女性同样受到传统性别角色的束缚。
ext.ext_en: Men and women alike have been constricted by traditional sexual roles.

defs.def_en: If something constricts you, it limits your actions so that you cannot do what you want to do.

ext.ext_cn: 尽量将自己与前配偶之间的摩擦减到最小。
ext.ext_en: Try to keep any conflict between you and your ex-partner to a minimum...

ext.ext_cn: 雇员已经就裁员一事与管理层发生了争执。
ext.ext_en: Employees already are in conflict with management over job cuts...

defs.def_en: Conflict is serious disagreement and argument about something important. If two people or groups are in conflict, they have had a serious disagreement or argument and have not yet reached agreement.

ext.ext_cn: 内心矛盾给他带来的极大痛苦
ext.ext_en: ...the anguish of his own inner conflict.

defs.def_en: Conflict is a state of mind in which you find it impossible to make a decision.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在结束持续了40年的冲突的会谈
ext.ext_en: ...talks aimed at ending four decades of conflict...

ext.ext_cn: 国家安全委员会开会讨论防止发生军事冲突的办法。
ext.ext_en: The National Security Council has met to discuss ways of preventing a military conflict.

defs.def_en: Conflict is fighting between countries or groups of people.

defs.def_cn: (信仰、观念或利益之间的)严重分歧，冲突

ext.ext_cn: 他们所做的与你想要的之间存在冲突。
ext.ext_en: There is a conflict between what they are doing and what you want...

ext.ext_cn: 有没有觉得两面效忠存在冲突？
ext.ext_en: Do you feel any conflict of loyalties?...

defs.def_en: A conflict is a serious difference between two or more beliefs, ideas, or interests. If two beliefs, ideas, or interests are in conflict, they are very different.

defs.def_cn: (想法、信仰或陈述)冲突，抵触，相互矛盾

ext.ext_cn: 个人道德和职业道德有时会相互抵触。
ext.ext_en: Personal ethics and professional ethics sometimes conflict...

ext.ext_cn: 他所持的观点通常与我的相左，而且很难改变。
ext.ext_en: He held firm opinions which usually conflicted with my own...

defs.def_en: If ideas, beliefs, or accounts conflict, they are very different from each other and it seems impossible for them to exist together or to each be true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 楼下有一个早餐间，宾客们可以在温馨的酒吧间休息一下。
ext.ext_en: Downstairs there's a breakfast room and guests can relax in the cosy bar.

defs.def_en: A house or room that is cosy is comfortable and warm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望确保客人们感到舒适温暖。
ext.ext_en: They like to make sure their guests are comfortable and cosy.

defs.def_en: If you are cosy, you are comfortable and warm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 朋友间亲切的闲聊
ext.ext_en: ...a cosy  chat between friends...

ext.ext_cn: 我今年想过一个温馨、愉快并且绝对健康的圣诞节。
ext.ext_en: My mood this year is for a cosy, nice and thoroughly wholesome Christmas.

defs.def_en: You use cosy to describe activities that are pleasant and friendly, and involve people who know each other well.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对疼痛的耐受程度因人而异，差别很大。
ext.ext_en: The levels of tolerable pain vary greatly from individual to individual…

ext.ext_cn: 他把他们的生活条件描述为“尚可忍受”。
ext.ext_en: He described their living conditions as tolerable.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as tolerable, you mean that you can bear it, even though it is unpleasant or painful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他刚过午夜就睡着了，睡得还算安稳。
ext.ext_en: He fell asleep just past midnight with tolerable ease...

ext.ext_cn: 城里有什么过得去的地方可以吃饭吗？
ext.ext_en: Is there anywhere tolerable to eat in town?

defs.def_en: If you describe something as tolerable, you mean that it is fairly good and reasonably satisfactory, but not of the highest quality or standard.
In a coal mine, the coalface is the part where the coal is being cut out of the rock.

ext.ext_cn: 我单脚跳下了3级台阶。
ext.ext_en: I hopped down three steps...

ext.ext_cn: 马尔科姆与其说是用走的不如说是用单脚跳的。
ext.ext_en: Malcolm hopped rather than walked.

defs.def_en: If you hop, you move along by jumping on one foot.

ext.ext_cn: 一只棕色的小鹿蹦跳着穿过他们面前的那条小路。
ext.ext_en: A small brown fawn hopped across the trail in front of them.

ext.ext_cn: 兔子直起身来，蹦跳了4下，又转回头。
ext.ext_en: The rabbit got up, took four hops and turned round.

defs.def_en: When birds and some small animals hop, they move along by jumping on both feet.

ext.ext_cn: 我和妻子是最早赶到登船的。
ext.ext_en: My wife and I were the first to arrive and hopped on board...

ext.ext_cn: 我迅速跳下床。
ext.ext_en: I hopped out of bed quickly.

defs.def_en: If you hop somewhere, you move there quickly or suddenly.

defs.def_cn: （通常指乘飞机的）短途快速旅程

ext.ext_cn: 从日内瓦开车要3小时，但坐私人直升机只要20分钟就到了。
ext.ext_en: It is a three-hour drive from Geneva but can be reached by a 20-minute hop in a private helicopter.

defs.def_en: A hop is a short, quick journey, usually by plane.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在中学社交舞会上邀请女孩子跳舞时，害怕会遭到拒绝。
ext.ext_en: They were afraid of being turned down when they asked girls to dance at high school hops.

defs.def_en: A hop is a social event at which people mix together and dance in an informal way.
Hops are flowers that are dried and used for making beer.

ext.ext_cn: “滚开，”我厉声对那家伙说，“她是和我一起的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Hop it', I snapped at the bloke. 'She's with me.'

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to hop it, you are telling them in a rude way to go away.

defs.def_cn: 非常生气的;暴跳如雷的

ext.ext_cn: 这家人因为她什么也没有给他们留下而气得跳脚。
ext.ext_en: The family's hopping mad that she left them nothing.

defs.def_en: Someone who is hopping mad is very angry.

defs.def_cn: 措手不及地;出其不意地

ext.ext_cn: 他的计划几乎让安全主管和饭店工作人员都措手不及。
ext.ext_en: His plans almost caught security chiefs and hotel staff on the hop.

defs.def_en: If you are caught on the hop, you are surprised by someone doing something when you were not expecting them to and so you are not prepared for it.

ext.ext_cn: 当她走上台时，观众起立鼓掌欢迎。
ext.ext_en: When she walked onstage she was given a standing ovation...

ext.ext_cn: 你务必8点钟上台演出。
ext.ext_en: You have to be onstage at eight o'clock...

defs.def_en: When someone such as an actor or musician goes onstage, they go onto the stage in a theatre to give a performance.

ext.ext_cn: 远途夜路
ext.ext_en: ...long nocturnal walks.

ext.ext_cn: 夜空的浩瀚
ext.ext_en: ...the immensity of the nocturnal sky.

defs.def_en: Nocturnal means occurring at night.

ext.ext_cn: 月圆之夜，这种夜间活动的啮齿类动物会小心地呆在地洞里不出来。
ext.ext_en: When there is a full moon, this nocturnal rodent is careful to stay in its burrow.

defs.def_en: Nocturnal creatures are active mainly at night.

ext.ext_cn: 陪审团作出意外死亡的正式裁决。
ext.ext_en: The jury returned a verdict of accidental death...

ext.ext_cn: 就在有意无意间，他的手轻轻拂过她的手。
ext.ext_en: His hand brushed against hers; it could have been either accidental or deliberate.

defs.def_en: An accidental event happens by chance or as the result of an accident, and is not deliberately intended.
A garbage truck is a large truck which collects the garbage from outside people's houses.

ext.ext_cn: 这些自然风干的花会比一束鲜花更加持久。
ext.ext_en: These naturally dried flowers will outlast a bouquet of fresh blooms...

ext.ext_cn: 人们应该听听他的音乐——它会是超越时间的经典。

ext.ext_en: What kink did he have in his character?

defs.def_en: A kink is a particular quality or feature of a person's mind or character, especially one which is thought to be unusual or abnormal.

defs.def_en: Newsprint is the text that is printed in newspapers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 简洁扼要的；言简意赅的

ext.ext_en: A good way to break the habit of eating too quickly is to put your knife and fork down after each mouthful...

ext.ext_cn: 四周有高高的砖墙环绕的小花园
ext.ext_en: ...a tiny garden surrounded by high brick walls.

defs.def_en: Bricks are rectangular blocks of baked clay used for building walls, which are usually red or brown. Brick is the material made up of these blocks.

ext.ext_cn: 你很够朋友，是真正的患难之交。
ext.ext_en: You were a brick, a real friend in need.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a brick, you mean that they have helped you or supported you when you were in a difficult situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我曾想跟他把这个问题给解决了，但结果徒劳无功。
ext.ext_en: I wanted to sort out this problem with him, but it was like banging my head against a brick wall.

defs.def_en: If you are banging your head against a brick wall, what you are saying or doing is not having any effect although you keep saying or doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 在那之后我的事业似乎就陷入了困境。
ext.ext_en: After that my career just seemed to hit a brick wall...

ext.ext_cn: 在布鲁塞尔进行的商谈进展受阻。
ext.ext_en: The discussions in Brussels hit a brick wall.

defs.def_en: If you hit a brick wall or come up against a brick wall, you are unable to continue or make progress because something stops you.

ext.ext_cn: 租房子只会鼓了房东的腰包，自己投资买房要合算得多。
ext.ext_en: Paying rent simply helps to line the pockets of landlords. It's far better to put your money into bricks and mortar of your own...

ext.ext_cn: 作为一种投资，房产不再是从前意义上的房产。
ext.ext_en: As an investment, bricks and mortar are not what they were.

defs.def_en: You can use bricks and mortar to refer to houses and other buildings, especially when they are considered as an investment.

ext.ext_cn: 她开始怀疑自己会不会被枯燥的工作逼疯。
ext.ext_en: She began to wonder whether she wouldn't go mad with the tedium of the job.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the tedium of a job, task, or situation, you think it is boring and rather frustrating.
DAT is a type of magnetic tape used to make very high quality recordings of sound by recording it in digital form. DAT is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'digital audio tape'.

ext.ext_cn: 娜塔莎拿起外套披在肩上。
ext.ext_en: Natasha took the coat and draped it over her shoulders...

ext.ext_cn: 一件柔软的白袍子搭在椅子上，供乔安娜使用。
ext.ext_en: A soft white robe had been draped over a chair for Joanna's use...

defs.def_en: If you drape a piece of cloth somewhere, you place it there so that it hangs down in a casual and graceful way.

ext.ext_cn: 灵柩上覆盖着英国国旗。
ext.ext_en: The coffin had been draped in a Union Jack...

ext.ext_cn: 他身披加拿大国旗绕跑道奔跑。
ext.ext_en: He draped himself in the Canadian flag and went round the track...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is draped in a piece of cloth, they are loosely covered by it.

defs.def_cn: 将(身体的某部位)随意搭在…上

ext.ext_cn: 妮古拉慢慢地靠在了长沙发上。
ext.ext_en: Nicola slowly draped herself across the couch...

ext.ext_cn: 他把手臂搭在丹尼尔的肩膀上。
ext.ext_en: He draped his arm over Daniels' shoulder...

defs.def_en: If you drape a part of your body somewhere, you lay it there in a relaxed and graceful way.

ext.ext_cn: 他把帘子拉严，转身把门锁好。
ext.ext_en: He pulled the drapes shut, locked the door behind him.

defs.def_en: Drapes are pieces of heavy fabric that you hang from the top of a window and can close to keep the light out or stop people looking in.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 备受非议的;备受批评的;饱受诟病的

ext.ext_cn: 我们不要忘了备受非议的英国铁路在电子通讯领域有一项重要的技术专利。
ext.ext_en: Let us not forget that the much-maligned British Rail has a major expertise in electronic communications...

ext.ext_cn: 我为詹姆士感到高兴，他虽然是一位饱受争议的球员，但他仍斗志昂扬。
ext.ext_en: I'm happy for James. He's a much-maligned player but has tremendous spirit.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as much-maligned, you mean that they are often criticized by people, but you think the criticism is unfair or exaggerated because they have good qualities too.

ext.ext_cn: 去年的冠军、来自美国的格雷格·莱蒙德现在排名第 4。
ext.ext_en: Last year's winner Greg Lemond of the United States is in fourth place.

defs.def_en: The fourth item in a series is the one that you count as number four.

ext.ext_cn: 四分之三的公众表示希望就这个问题进行全民公决。
ext.ext_en: Three-fourths of the public say they favor a national referendum on the issue.

defs.def_en: A fourth is one of four equal parts of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这种病症在女性当中比在男性当中更为普遍。
ext.ext_en: This condition is more prevalent in women than in men...

ext.ext_cn: 抽烟在年轻女性中变得越来越常见。
ext.ext_en: Smoking is becoming increasingly prevalent among younger women...

defs.def_en: A condition, practice, or belief that is prevalent is common.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 紧张不安的;焦虑不安的;神经质的

ext.ext_cn: 爸爸有时对我们很好，但有时他脾气暴躁，焦虑不安。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes dad was nice to us, but sometimes he was bad-tempered and nervy...

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦很急躁，很明显他处于紧张不安的状态。
ext.ext_en: Alan was irritable, and very evidently in a nervy state.

defs.def_en: If someone is nervy, their behaviour shows that they are very tense or anxious, or they are the type of person who is easily upset.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 约翰喜欢他，因为他胆大，约翰想干掉谁他就会出门去一枪把那人干掉。
ext.ext_en: John liked him because he was a nervy guy and would go out and shoot anybody who John wanted him to shoot.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is nervy, you mean that their behaviour is bold or daring.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 5位幸存者最终到达安全之地时已经衣衫褴褛、饥肠辘辘、精疲力尽。
ext.ext_en: The five survivors eventually reached safety, ragged, half-starved and exhausted.

defs.def_en: Someone who is ragged looks untidy and is wearing clothes that are old and torn.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Ragged clothes are old and torn.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 高低不平的；参差不齐的；犬牙交错的

ext.ext_cn: 她能听到他不均匀的呼吸声，似乎他是跑着过来的。
ext.ext_en: She could hear his ragged breathing, as if he had been running...

ext.ext_cn: 奥布赖恩让那些人排成了参差不齐的一列。
ext.ext_en: O'Brien formed the men into a ragged line.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is ragged when it is untidy or uneven.

ext.ext_cn: 他们让我到这儿、到那儿，哪儿都跑遍了，我累得筋疲力尽却没有任何进展。
ext.ext_en: They'd send me here, there and everywhere and I'd run myself ragged and get no place...

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙队先是猛烈进攻，使英格兰队疲于奔命，但守门员伊恩·沃克防守甚严。
ext.ext_en: Spain ran England ragged early on but goalkeeper Ian Walker proved a formidable barrier.

defs.def_en: If someone runs you ragged, they make you do so much that you become exhausted.
A fire engine is a large vehicle which carries firefighters and equipment for putting out fires.

defs.def_cn: (许多宗教中指上帝的)创世，创造天地

ext.ext_cn: 《创世记》第一章所述的上帝创造世界万物
ext.ext_en: ...the Creation of the universe as told in Genesis Chapter One...

ext.ext_cn: 自宇宙形成以来，地球的存亡第一次完全掌握在我们手中。
ext.ext_en: For the first time since creation, the survival of the Earth is entirely in our hands.

defs.def_en: In many religions, creation is the making of the universe, earth, and creatures by God.
People sometimes refer to the whole universe as creation .

defs.def_cn: 创造物;(尤指)艺术作品，富于想象力的作品

ext.ext_cn: 浴室完全是由我设计的。
ext.ext_en: The bathroom is entirely my own creation...

ext.ext_cn: 他的经典作品和最新创作都很独特。
ext.ext_en: Featured are both his classics and his latest creations...

defs.def_en: You can refer to something that someone has made as a creation, especially if it shows skill, imagination, or artistic ability.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 恐怖的;吓人的;令人害怕的

ext.ext_cn: 他绘声绘色地描述他们又一次吵架的时候，他是如何痛揍她的，让人听得胆战心惊。
ext.ext_en: He described in chilling detail how he attacked her during one of their frequent rows.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as chilling, you mean it is frightening.

ext.ext_cn: 他们黄昏时分回来，然后去了一家步行街酒吧。
ext.ext_en: They returned at twilight, and set off for one of the promenade bars.

defs.def_en: Twilight is the time just before night when the daylight has almost gone but when it is not completely dark.

ext.ext_cn: 渐浓的秋日暮色
ext.ext_en: ...the deepening autumn twilight.

defs.def_en: Twilight is the small amount of light that there is outside just after the sun has gone down.

ext.ext_cn: 现在两人的事业都到了没落期。
ext.ext_en: Now both men are in the twilight of their careers...

ext.ext_cn: 我老了，到了生命的暮年。
ext.ext_en: I am getting old. I am in the twilight of my life.

defs.def_en: The twilight of a particular period of time is the final stages of it, when the most important events have already happened.

defs.def_cn: 蒙眬的;含混的;界限模糊的

ext.ext_cn: 他们成了军队人员与平民雇员之间身份界定不清的人。
ext.ext_en: They fell into that twilight zone between military personnel and civilian employees.

defs.def_en: A twilight state or a twilight zone is a situation of confusion or uncertainty, which seems to exist between two different states or categories.

defs.def_cn: (办公室存放待处理信件或公文的)收文盘
defs.def_en: An in tray is a shallow container used in offices to put letters and documents in before they are dealt with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 理应得到的;当之无愧的

ext.ext_cn: 你理应休息一下，出去好好玩玩。
ext.ext_en: Take a well-earned rest and go out and enjoy yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 周日的比赛中他当之无愧的胜利
ext.ext_en: ...his well-earned win in Sunday's race.

defs.def_en: You can use well-earned to indicate that you think something is deserved, usually because the person who gets it has been working very hard.

ext.ext_cn: 我们偶尔会吃顿大餐。
ext.ext_en: Once in a while we had a major blowout.

defs.def_en: A blowout is a large meal, often a celebration with family or friends, at which people may eat too much.

ext.ext_cn: 一辆南行的卡车爆胎并撞车了。
ext.ext_en: A lorry travelling south had a blow-out and crashed.

defs.def_en: If you have a blowout while you are driving a car, one of the tyres suddenly bursts.

ext.ext_cn: 外科手术费的蹿升
ext.ext_en: ...a blowout in surgery costs.

ext.ext_cn: 国际收支差额的井喷
ext.ext_en: ...a blow-out in the balance of payments.

defs.def_en: A blowout in an amount or a price is a sudden increase in it.
An equation is a mathematical statement saying that two amounts or values are the same, for example 6x4=12x2.

defs.def_cn: （多种因素需加以综合考虑的）平衡，综合体

ext.ext_cn: 情况很简单：研究产生新产品。
ext.ext_en: The equation is simple: research breeds new products...

ext.ext_cn: 该党担心难以平衡更多支出和更高税率之间的综合关系。
ext.ext_en: The party fears the equation between higher spending and higher taxes...

defs.def_en: An equation is a situation in which two or more parts have to be considered together so that the whole situation can be understood or explained.

ext.ext_cn: 法官做总结时，法庭里一片混乱。
ext.ext_en: There was pandemonium in court as the judge gave his summing up...

ext.ext_cn: 他们叫嚷着冲到大街上，大街上顿时乱作一团。
ext.ext_en: Pandemonium broke out as they ran into the street shouting.

defs.def_en: If there is pandemonium in a place, the people there are behaving in a very noisy and uncontrolled way.

ext.ext_cn: 家常的鸡汤
ext.ext_en: ...home-made chicken soup.

defs.def_en: Soup is liquid food made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water.

ext.ext_cn: 她老是让自己的处境很尴尬。
ext.ext_en: She has a knack of landing herself right in the soup.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in the soup, you mean they are in trouble.

defs.def_cn: (获取某工作或奖项的)入围名单，候选名单

ext.ext_cn: 如果通知你去面试，你就很可能上了不超过6人的候选名单。
ext.ext_en: If you've been asked for an interview you are probably on a short list of no more than six.

defs.def_en: If someone is on a shortlist, for example for a job or a prize, they are one of a small group of people who have been chosen from a larger group. The successful person is then chosen from the small group.

defs.def_cn: 把…列入入围名单;把…列入候选名单;提名

ext.ext_cn: 他已经数次获诺贝尔文学奖提名。
ext.ext_en: He was shortlisted for the Nobel Prize for literature several times...

ext.ext_cn: 巴利莫尔橄榄球联盟球场已经被列为昆士兰垒球队的候选主场之一。
ext.ext_en: Ballymore rugby union ground has been shortlisted as a possible home for Queensland softball.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is shortlisted for a job or a prize, they are put on a shortlist.
A palette is a flat piece of wood or plastic on which an artist mixes paints.

defs.def_cn: （画家使用的）一组颜色，色彩范围

ext.ext_cn: 戴维·芬彻几乎只用灰色和土褐色作画。
ext.ext_en: David Fincher paints from a palette consisting almost exclusively of grey and mud brown.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the range of colours that are used by a particular artist or group of artists as their palette.

ext.ext_cn: 动物每次进食后都会排粪。
ext.ext_en: Animals defecate after every meal.

defs.def_en: When people and animals defecate, they get rid of waste matter from their body through their anus.

defs.def_cn: 主张女性有权选择人工流产的

ext.ext_cn: 主张女性有权选择人工流产的运动
ext.ext_en: ...the pro-choice movement...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数选民都主张女性有权选择人工流产。
ext.ext_en: ...most of the electorate is pro-choice.

defs.def_en: Someone who is pro-choice thinks that women have a right to choose whether or not to give birth to a child they have conceived, and to have an abortion if they do not want the child.

ext.ext_cn: 度假者们可以在乘游轮游览之前或之后再在马略卡岛呆上一星期。
ext.ext_en: Holiday-makers can also add on a week in Majorca before or after the cruise...

ext.ext_cn: 后边是一个大餐厅——本世纪早期增建的。
ext.ext_en: To the rear is a large dining room — added on early this century.

defs.def_en: If one thing is added on to another, it is attached to the other thing, or is made a part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 许多贷款申请表自动附加保险。
ext.ext_en: Many loan application forms automatically add on insurance.

defs.def_en: If you add on an extra amount or item to a list or total, you include it.

defs.def_cn: （通常指在同一楼层的）公寓套房

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯蒂娜有自己的公寓和汽车。
ext.ext_en: Christina has her own apartment, with her own car.

ext.ext_cn: 到处是水泥公寓楼群的沉闷的城市
ext.ext_en: ...bleak cities of concrete apartment blocks.

defs.def_en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

defs.def_cn: （国王、王后、总统等要人居住的）套间，套房

ext.ext_cn: 威尔士亲王在圣詹姆斯宫的私人套房
ext.ext_en: ...the private apartments of the Prince of Wales at St James's Palace.

defs.def_en: The apartments of an important person such as a king, queen, or president are a set of large rooms which are used by them.

ext.ext_cn: 有酬工作的机会
ext.ext_en: ...opportunities for gainful employment.

defs.def_en: If you are in gainful employment, you have a job for which you are paid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可印刷的；适于出版的；适于刊印的

ext.ext_cn: 他的队友打开了酒店的窗户，大叫着“跳！”，还开了一些上不了台面的玩笑。
ext.ext_en: His team-mates opened hotel windows, shouting 'Jump!' and somewhat less printable banter.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's words or remarks are not printable, you mean that they are likely to offend people, and are therefore not suitable to be repeated in writing or speech.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 标准的血压测量是评估患心脏病或中风几率的一个重要但不精确的方法。
ext.ext_en: Standard measurements of blood pressure are an important but crude way of assessing the risk of heart disease or strokes...

ext.ext_cn: 出生地信息只能非常粗略地显示实际移民过程。
ext.ext_en: Birthplace data are only the crudest indicator of actual migration paths.

defs.def_en: A crude method or measurement is not exact or detailed, but may be useful or correct in a rough, general way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 简陋的木盒子
ext.ext_en: ...crude wooden boxes.

defs.def_en: If you describe an object that someone has made as crude, you mean that it has been made in a very simple way or from very simple parts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 冒犯的;粗鲁的;不精明的

ext.ext_cn: 尼夫！你非得那么粗俗吗？
ext.ext_en: Nev! Must you be quite so crude?

ext.ext_cn: 粗俗的语言
ext.ext_en: ...crude language.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as crude, you disapprove of them because they speak or behave in a rude, offensive, or unsophisticated way.

ext.ext_cn: 850万吨粗钢
ext.ext_en: ...8.5 million tonnes of crude steel.

defs.def_en: Crude substances are in a natural or unrefined state, and have not yet been used in manufacturing processes.
Crude is the same as crude oil .

ext.ext_cn: 他由于患轻度眼疾而不再担任队长一职。
ext.ext_en: His captaincy of the team was ended by mild eye trouble.

defs.def_en: The captaincy of a team is the position of being captain.

ext.ext_cn: 色情电影
ext.ext_en: ...a porn cinema.

defs.def_en: See also:soft porn;hard porn;Porn is the same as pornography .

ext.ext_cn: 他与安德鲁·布洛尔斯合著了《国际政治视角下的核废料》一书。
ext.ext_en: He is co-author, with Andrew Blowers, of 'The International Politics of Nuclear Waste'.

defs.def_en: The co-authors of a book, play, or report are the people who have written it together.

ext.ext_cn: 他与人合著了一本有关旅游业政策的书。
ext.ext_en: He's co-authored a book on Policy for Tourism...

ext.ext_cn: 卡伦·马修斯与刘易斯·库勒斯合作完成了这个研究课题。
ext.ext_en: Karen Matthews co-authored the study with Lewis Kullers.

defs.def_en: If two or more people co-author a book, play, or report, they write it together.

ext.ext_cn: 这家银行最近在德国开设了分行。
ext.ext_en: The bank recently opened a branch in Germany...

ext.ext_cn: 只是到最近历史学家才开始探究这个问题。
ext.ext_en: It is only fairly recently that historians have begun to investigate the question...

defs.def_en: If you have done something recently or if something happened recently, it happened only a short time ago.

ext.ext_cn: 女性往往受到家庭责任和低期望值的束缚。
ext.ext_en: Women are too often constrained by family commitments and by low expectations...

ext.ext_cn: 大学的财力有限，提供的薪酬仅能吸引水平一般的教师，在这种情况下，我们如何能培养出一流的工程师？
ext.ext_en: How can we produce top-class engineers when universities are constrained to offer salaries that can only attract mediocre staff?...

defs.def_en: To constrain someone or something means to limit their development or force them to behave in a particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 不知怎么的，他觉得自己必须得压低声音。
ext.ext_en: For some reason he felt constrained to lower his voice.

defs.def_en: If you feel constrained to do something, you feel that you must do it, even though you would prefer not to.

ext.ext_cn: 自那以后，我就一直在观望事情的发展。
ext.ext_en: Since then I've been waiting on events...

ext.ext_cn: 我们不可能等待政府按照它自己的步调作出改变。
ext.ext_en: We cannot wait on the government to make changes at its own pace.

defs.def_en: If you are waiting on something, you are waiting for it to happen, for example before you do or decide anything.

defs.def_cn: 对…过分痴迷;对…垂涎欲滴

ext.ext_cn: 时尚编辑们兴奋地注视着每一件东西。
ext.ext_en: Fashion editors drooled over every item...

ext.ext_cn: 广告商听闻这或许会带来2,000万美元的收益后已是垂涎欲滴了。
ext.ext_en: Advertisers are already drooling at reports that this might bring 20 million dollars.

defs.def_en: To drool over someone or something means to look at them with great pleasure, perhaps in an exaggerated or ridiculous way.

ext.ext_cn: 我想往回走，但天色已晚，只好继续前行。
ext.ext_en: I considered turning back, but it was getting late, so I pressed on.

A cheeseboard is a board from which cheese is served at a meal.

ext.ext_cn: 然后仔细检查了这块金属，以确保没有裂缝。
ext.ext_en: The metal is then minutely examined to ensure there are no cracks...

ext.ext_en: They follow minutely the news from abroad on Cable News Network.

defs.def_en: You use minutely to indicate that something is done in great detail.

ext.ext_cn: X光的好处远远大于其在很小程度上增加的罹患癌症的风险。
ext.ext_en: The benefit of an x-ray far outweighs the minutely increased risk of cancer.

defs.def_en: You use minutely to indicate that the size or extent of something is very small.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: She was known to have had personal problems unconnected with her marriage...

ext.ext_en: I can't believe that those two murders are unconnected.

defs.def_en: If one thing is unconnected with another or the two things are unconnected, the things are not related to each other in any way.
A rambler is a person whose hobby is going on long walks in the countryside, often as part of an organized group.

ext.ext_en: Currency-conversion costs remain one of the biggest obstacles to cross-border trade...

ext.ext_en: The stock market is convinced more cross-border deals will take place.

defs.def_en: Cross-border trade occurs between companies in different countries.

ext.ext_cn: 进入赞比亚境内的越境袭击
ext.ext_en: ...a cross-border raid into Zambian territory.

defs.def_en: Cross-border attacks involve people crossing a border and going a short way into another country.
A multiplication sign is the sign x which is put between two numbers to show that they are being multiplied.

defs.def_cn: (与数字连用构成副词)表示“…倍”

ext.ext_cn: 到 80 年代末的时候，他们的数量已是原来的 4 倍。
ext.ext_en: By the late eighties their number had grown fourfold...

ext.ext_en: Pretax profit surged almost twelvefold.

defs.def_en: -fold combines with numbers to form adverbs which say how much an amount has increased by. For example, if an amount increases fourfold, it is four times greater than it was originally.

ext.ext_cn: 150磅塞姆汀塑胶炸药
ext.ext_en: ...one-hundred-and-fifty pounds of Semtex explosive...

ext.ext_cn: 卧室里有炸药的痕迹。
ext.ext_en: There were traces of explosives in the bedroom.

defs.def_en: An explosive is a substance or device that can cause an explosion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 会爆炸的;能引起爆炸的

ext.ext_cn: 爆炸装置被设定在高峰时间引爆。
ext.ext_en: The explosive device was timed to go off at the rush hour...

ext.ext_cn: 煤矿中天然存有高爆气体。
ext.ext_en: Highly explosive gas is naturally found in coal mines.

defs.def_en: Something that is explosive is capable of causing an explosion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The explosive growth in casinos is one of the most conspicuous signs of Westernisation.

defs.def_en: An explosive growth is a sudden, rapid increase in the size or quantity of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （局面等）一触即发的，千钧一发的

ext.ext_en: He appeared to be treating the potentially explosive situation with some sensitivity...

ext.ext_en: Nobody knows what explosive arguments the future of Europe will bring.

defs.def_en: An explosive situation is likely to have difficult, serious, or dangerous effects.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: She was unpredictable, explosive, impulsive and easily distracted...

ext.ext_en: He's inherited his father's explosive temper.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as explosive, you mean that they tend to express sudden violent anger.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He made a loud, explosive noise of disgust.

ext.ext_cn: 爆发的鼓声
ext.ext_en: ...an explosive drumbeat.

defs.def_en: A sudden loud noise can be described as explosive.
Quicksilver is the same as mercury .

ext.ext_en: ...her quicksilver changes of mood.

defs.def_en: Quicksilver movements or changes are very fast and unpredictable.

ext.ext_en: 'Go and have a word with her, Ken,' Webb instructed...

defs.def_en: If you instruct someone to do something, you formally tell them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他教给家人护理技巧。
ext.ext_en: He instructed family members in nursing techniques.

defs.def_en: Someone who instructs people in a subject or skill teaches it to them.
A rhino is the same as a rhinoceros .

defs.def_cn: （用偷来的车）开快车兜风的人
defs.def_en: A joyrider is someone who steals cars in order to drive around in them at high speed.

ext.ext_cn: 大理石柱和镀金塔尖

defs.def_en: A gilt object is covered with a thin layer of gold or gold paint.

defs.def_cn: 基督教青年会（或女青年会）旅馆

ext.ext_en: I took him to the Y.

defs.def_en: A YMCA or YWCA hostel is sometimes referred to as the Y .
A haberdasher or a haberdasher's is a shop where small articles for sewing are sold.

defs.def_cn: 男装制作销售商;男装裁缝
defs.def_en: A haberdasher is a shopkeeper who makes and sells men's clothes.
A haberdasher or a haberdasher's is a shop where men's clothes are sold.

ext.ext_cn: 看到计划拆除酒馆的新闻，他非常愤怒。

defs.def_en: If you are enraged by something, it makes you extremely angry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （政变或胜利）不流血的，无伤亡的

ext.ext_en: Reports from the area indicate that it was a bloodless coup...

defs.def_en: A bloodless coup or victory is one in which nobody is killed.

ext.ext_en: ...her face grey and bloodless.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's face or skin as bloodless, you mean that it is very pale.

ext.ext_en: A spot of rain fell on her hand.

defs.def_en: Rain is water that falls from the clouds in small drops.

ext.ext_en: ...the spring, when the rains came...

ext.ext_cn: 雨季又没有光顾非洲之角。
ext.ext_en: The rains have failed again in the Horn of Africa.

defs.def_en: In countries where rain only falls in certain seasons, this rain is referred to as the rains .

ext.ext_en: It rained the whole weekend...

ext.ext_cn: 雨下得很大，但她没有雨伞。
ext.ext_en: It was raining hard, and she hadn't an umbrella.

defs.def_en: When rain falls, you can say that it is raining .

ext.ext_en: The police, raining blows on rioters and spectators alike, cleared the park...

ext.ext_en: Rockets, mortars and artillery rounds rained on buildings.

defs.def_en: If someone rains blows, kicks, or bombs on a person or place, the person or place is attacked by many blows, kicks, or bombs. You can also say that blows, kicks, or bombs rain on a person or place.

ext.ext_cn: 一阵乱石砸向警察。
ext.ext_en: A rain of stones descended on the police.

defs.def_en: A rain of things is a large number of things that fall from the sky at the same time.

ext.ext_en: You'll be as right as rain as soon as you are back in your own home with your baby.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is as right as rain, you mean that they are completely well or healthy again, for example when they have recovered from an illness or a shock.

defs.def_cn: 不管晴天或下雨;风雨无阻

ext.ext_en: Frances took her daughter walking every day, rain or shine.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something rain or shine, you mean that they do it regularly, without being affected by the weather or other circumstances.

ext.ext_en: ...an old quayside warehouse.

defs.def_en: A quayside is the same as a quay .

defs.def_cn: (尤指使用电脑或网络的)新人，新手，菜鸟

ext.ext_en: All newbies are offered an individually tailored training and development programme.

defs.def_en: A newbie is someone who is new to an activity, especially in computing or on the Internet.

defs.def_cn: 沙袋鼠(产于澳大利亚和新几内亚)

defs.def_cn: (通常指按照法庭决议)扣押，查封(债务人资产)

ext.ext_cn: 他试图阻止法院扣押工会的资产。
ext.ext_en: He tried to prevent union money from being sequestrated by the courts.

defs.def_en: When property is sequestrated, it is taken officially from someone who has debts, usually after a decision in a court of law. If the debts are paid off, the property is returned to its owner.

defs.def_cn: (动物或人体内的)寄生虫，肠虫
defs.def_en: If animals or people have worms, worms are living in their intestines.

ext.ext_cn: 早春的时候我给我所有的鸟打虫。
ext.ext_en: I worm all my birds in early spring...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的成年狗至少每半年要例行打一次虫。
ext.ext_en: All adult dogs are routinely wormed at least every six months.

defs.def_en: If you worm an animal, you give it medicine in order to kill the worms that are living in its intestines.

defs.def_cn: 艰难地移动；蜷缩着身子走

ext.ext_cn: 我侧着身子艰难地从长凳上移开，那个样子很可笑，很不雅观。
ext.ext_en: I had to worm my way out sideways from the bench in a ridiculous, undignified fashion...

ext.ext_cn: 小猫缩着身子从刚开了一点儿的门中挤过来。
ext.ext_en: The kitten wormed its way through the just-open door.

defs.def_en: If you worm your way somewhere, you move there with difficulty, twisting or bending your body or making it narrow.

defs.def_cn: (通常为欺骗别人或得到好处)逐渐取得(成功或好感)

ext.ext_en: She never misses a chance to worm her way into the public's hearts...

ext.ext_en: Everyone knows people who have wormed their way up on old school connections.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is worming their way to success, or is worming their way into someone else's affection, you disapprove of the way that they are gradually making someone trust them or like them, often in order to deceive them or gain some advantage.

defs.def_cn: 可怜虫;软蛋;卑鄙的家伙
defs.def_en: If you call a person a worm, you are insulting them by saying that they have a very weak or unpleasant character and you have no respect for them.

ext.ext_en: You've opened up a whole new can of worms here I think. We could have a whole debate on student loans and grants...

ext.ext_en: Drug abuse is a can of worms nobody wants to open at sporting events.

ext.ext_en: Now the worm turns, and his wife Elizabeth chucks him out and takes a lover herself.

defs.def_en: If you say that the worm turns, you mean that someone who usually obeys another person or accepts their bad behaviour unexpectedly starts resisting that person or expresses their anger.

defs.def_en: If you seize on something or seize upon it, you show great interest in it, often because it is useful to you.

defs.def_en: TV means the same as television .

defs.def_cn: 逐渐减少;逐渐压缩…的人数

defs.def_en: The guardian of something is someone who defends and protects it.
