ext.ext_en: Five minutes after he had arrived for the interview, I had abandoned my preconceived ideas about boxers...

ext.ext_cn: 我们开始时都对自己想从生活中得到什么抱有一些预想。
ext.ext_en: We all start with preconceived notions of what we want from life.

defs.def_en: If you have preconceived ideas about something, you have already formed an opinion about it before you have enough information or experience.

defs.def_cn: 存有陷阱的问题;带套问题
defs.def_en: If someone asks you a trick question, they ask you a question which is very difficult to answer, for example because there is a hidden difficulty or because the answer that seems obvious is not the correct one.

defs.def_cn: (与数词连用构成形容词，表示人数）

ext.ext_cn: 拖网渔船上的四名水手
ext.ext_en: The four-man crew on board the fishing trawler...

ext.ext_cn: 他成立了一个三人小组为他出谋划策。
ext.ext_en: He set up a three-man panel to advise him.

defs.def_en: -man combines with numbers to make adjectives which indicate that something involves or is intended for that number of people.

ext.ext_cn: 两个男人互相看不顺眼。
ext.ext_en: The two men loathe each other...

ext.ext_cn: 她憎恨自己是贫困工人的孩子。
ext.ext_en: She loathed being the child of impoverished labourers.

defs.def_en: If you loathe something or someone, you dislike them very much.
A carbine is a light automatic rifle.

ext.ext_cn: 有时候，他会在深夜里偷偷溜出家与我相会。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes he would sneak out of his house late at night to be with me...

ext.ext_cn: 别溜走藏起来。
ext.ext_en: Don't sneak away and hide.

defs.def_en: If you sneak somewhere, you go there very quietly on foot, trying to avoid being seen or heard.

ext.ext_cn: 他每天都把文件偷偷地带出去复印，然后再偷偷地拿回来。
ext.ext_en: He smuggled papers out each day, photocopied them, and snuck them back...

ext.ext_cn: 你居然偷偷塞给我一支烟。
ext.ext_en: You even snuck me a cigarette.

defs.def_en: If you sneak something somewhere, you take it there secretly.

ext.ext_cn: 你偷偷地望一眼手表，看看要等多长时间。
ext.ext_en: You sneak a look at your watch to see how long you've got to wait.

defs.def_en: If you sneak a look at someone or something, you secretly have a quick look at them.
Plimsolls are canvas shoes with flat rubber soles. People wear plimsolls for sports and leisure activities.

defs.def_cn: （表示有礼貌地请求或邀请）请，烦劳

ext.ext_cn: 能请你帮帮我们吗？
ext.ext_en: Can you help us please?...

ext.ext_cn: 请你开一下门好吗？
ext.ext_en: Would you please open the door?...

defs.def_en: You say please when you are politely asking or inviting someone to do something.

ext.ext_cn: “要茶吗？”——“好的，谢谢。”
ext.ext_en: 'Tea?' — 'Yes, please.'...

ext.ext_cn: “要不要加个苹果和奶酪一起吃？”——“行啊。”
ext.ext_en: 'You want an apple with your cheese?' — 'Please.'

defs.def_en: You say please when you are accepting something politely.

defs.def_cn: （表示要求对方停止做某事或别再开口）请别，请不必

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽，请不要这样，这完全没必要。
ext.ext_en: Please, Mary, this is all so unnecessary...

ext.ext_cn: 伊莎贝拉，别再说了，我没有时间听这个。
ext.ext_en: Isabella. Please. I don't have time for this.

defs.def_en: You can say please to indicate that you want someone to stop doing something or stop speaking. You would say this if, for example, what they are doing or saying makes you angry or upset.

defs.def_cn: （用于吸引对方注意、特别是儿童对老师或其他成人时）请问，对不起

ext.ext_cn: 请问，先生，我们能再要一些吗？
ext.ext_en: Please sir, can we have some more?...

ext.ext_cn: 对不起，史密斯小姐，能耽误你一会儿吗？
ext.ext_en: Please, Miss Smith, a moment.

defs.def_en: You can say please in order to attract someone's attention politely. Children in particular say 'please ' to attract the attention of a teacher or other adult.

ext.ext_cn: 最重要的是，我想让你高兴。
ext.ext_en: More than anything, I want to please you...

ext.ext_cn: 这些食物中许多只是让人满意，但并不让人兴奋。
ext.ext_en: Much of the food pleases rather than excites...

defs.def_en: If someone or something pleases you, they make you feel happy and satisfied.

ext.ext_cn: 女性应该有穿衣和行动的自由。
ext.ext_en: Women should be free to dress and act as they please...

ext.ext_cn: 他想干什么就干什么。
ext.ext_en: He does whatever he pleases...

defs.def_en: You use please in expressions such as as she pleases ,whatever you please, and anything he pleases to indicate that someone can do or have whatever they want.

defs.def_cn: （用于强调）极尽…，…的程度怎么说都不为过

ext.ext_cn: 他走到我的桌旁，非常随意地拿起了我的通讯录。
ext.ext_en: He walked by my table and, casually as you please, picked up my address book...

ext.ext_cn: 她真够大胆的，竟抓住了我的衣袖。
ext.ext_en: Bold as you please, she grabbed me by the sleeve.

defs.def_en: You can use as you please in expressions such as bold as you please or casually as you please or charming as you please in order to emphasize what you are saying.

defs.def_cn: （表示很有礼貌和正式地吸引对方注意或提出请求）对不起，烦请

ext.ext_cn: 女士们，先生们，烦请泰勒小姐为我们表演。
ext.ext_en: Ladies and gentlemen, if you please. Miss Taylor's going to play for us...

ext.ext_cn: 哈里爵士！对不起，请等一下！
ext.ext_en: Sir Harry! Stop, if you please!

defs.def_en: If you please is sometimes used as a very polite and formal way of attracting someone's attention or of asking them to do something.

defs.def_cn: （表示惊讶、恼怒或难以置信）竟然，你说怪不怪

ext.ext_cn: 她爱搭不理地把萨莉晾在一边，直到她为塞尔比做好午饭，你说怪不怪。
ext.ext_en: She was pretty unforthcoming. Made Sally wait till she'd cooked Selby's lunch, if you please.

defs.def_en: You can say if you please to indicate that a situation surprises or annoys you, or is difficult to believe.

defs.def_cn: （无礼地表示不在意或不关心）请便，随你的便

ext.ext_cn: 我问道：“要不我等会儿吧？”梅拉妮耸耸肩说：“随你便。”
ext.ext_en: 'Do you mind if I wait?' I asked. Melanie shrugged: 'Please yourself.'

defs.def_en: You say 'please yourself ' to indicate in a rather rude way that you do not mind or care whether the person you are talking to does a particular thing or not.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 以正人君子自居的;自以为是的

ext.ext_cn: 他对僧侣们颇有微词，认为他们思想偏狭，自视清高。
ext.ext_en: He is critical of the monks, whom he considers narrow-minded and self-righteous.

ext.ext_cn: 自以为是的改革者们
ext.ext_en: ...self-righteous reformers.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as self-righteous, you disapprove of them because they are convinced that they are right in their beliefs, attitudes, and behaviour and that other people are wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 在管理上花费了太多时间。
ext.ext_en: Too much time is spent on administration.

ext.ext_cn: 工商管理的硕士学位
ext.ext_en: ...a master's degree in business administration.

defs.def_en: Administration is the range of activities connected with organizing and supervising the way that an organization or institution functions.

ext.ext_cn: 执法标准下降了。
ext.ext_en: Standards in the administration of justice have degenerated...

ext.ext_cn: 监管费约为500英镑。
ext.ext_en: The cost of administration is around £500.

defs.def_en: The administration of something is the process of organizing and supervising it.

defs.def_cn: （公司或机构的）管理部门，行政部门

ext.ext_cn: 学院行政部门的成员
ext.ext_en: ... a member of the college administration.

defs.def_en: The administration of a company or institution is the group of people who organize and supervise it.

ext.ext_cn: 在福特和卡特两届政府执政期间，奥利里都在联邦能源机构中任职。
ext.ext_en: O'Leary served in federal energy posts in both the Ford and Carter administrations...

ext.ext_cn: 他敦促政府和国会出台一整套切实可行的方案，以缩减预算赤字。
ext.ext_en: He urged the administration and Congress to come up with a credible package to reduce the budget deficit.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a country's government as the administration; used especially in the United States.  →see usage note at:government
A swimming cap is a rubber cap which you wear to keep your hair dry when you are swimming.

defs.def_cn: (鞋或靴尖起保护或加固作用的)外包头
defs.def_en: A toecap is a piece of leather or metal which is fitted over the end of a shoe or boot in order to protect or strengthen it.

defs.def_cn: (战时军需品的)补给线，运输线

ext.ext_cn: 这次轰炸看起来意在切断德国和占领法国的德军部队之间的补给线。
ext.ext_en: The bombing campaign appears aimed at cutting the supply lines between Germany and its army in occupied France.

defs.def_en: A supply line is a route along which goods and equipment are transported to an army during a war.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 紧张不安的；忧虑的;易怒的

ext.ext_cn: 彭妮从来不会因为考试而紧张。
ext.ext_en: Penny never got uptight about exams...

ext.ext_cn: 比赛时我总会紧张得不行。
ext.ext_en: I tend to get very uptight during a match.

defs.def_en: Someone who is uptight is tense, nervous, or annoyed about something and so is difficult to be with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 移情的;有同感的;能产生共鸣的

ext.ext_cn: 克林顿作为倾听者能够与对方感同身受的本领
ext.ext_en: ...Clinton's skills as an empathetic listener.

defs.def_en: Someone who is empathetic has the ability to share another person's feelings or emotions as if they were their own.
A breakwater is a wooden or stone wall that extends from the shore into the sea and is built in order to protect a harbour or beach from the force of the waves.

defs.def_cn: 使免于罪责;证明…无罪;宣布…无罪

ext.ext_cn: 官方报道基本上宣布所有人无罪。
ext.ext_en: The official report basically exonerated everyone...

ext.ext_cn: 一项调查证明该学校没有任何过失。
ext.ext_en: An investigation exonerated the school from any blame.

defs.def_en: If a court, report, or person in authority exonerates someone, they officially say or show that that person is not responsible for something wrong or unpleasant that has happened.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这座建筑完全用半透明瓦楞塑料封顶。
ext.ext_en: The building is roofed entirely with translucent corrugated plastic.

defs.def_en: If a material is translucent, some light can pass through it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她金发碧眼，皮肤透亮。
ext.ext_en: She had fair hair, blue eyes and translucent skin...

ext.ext_cn: 天空由通透的湛蓝色变成了暗灰色。
ext.ext_en: The sky was changing from translucent blue to thicker grey.

defs.def_en: You use translucent to describe something that has a glowing appearance, as if light is passing through it.

defs.def_cn: 明确无疑的;毋庸置疑的

ext.ext_cn: 他的出色表现让这部电影成为了毋庸置疑的经典。
ext.ext_en: His brilliance renders this film an indubitable classic.

defs.def_en: You use indubitable to describe something when you want to emphasize that it is definite and cannot be doubted.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 定时的;定期的;有规律的

ext.ext_cn: 定期进行锻炼。
ext.ext_en: Take regular exercise...

ext.ext_cn: 现在我们再来关注一下国际体坛的消息。
ext.ext_en: Now it's time for our regular look at the world of international sport...

defs.def_en: Regular events have equal amounts of time between them, so that they happen, for example, at the same time each day or each week.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 过了枪声阵阵的早上之后
ext.ext_en: ...after a morning punctuated by regular volleys of gunfire...

ext.ext_cn: 这种情形通常多用香波洗洗头即可消除。
ext.ext_en: This condition usually clears up with regular shampooing.

defs.def_en: Regular events happen often.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: “告诉我，门塔基斯先生，萨瓦拉斯夫人是您的常客吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'Tell me, Mr Mentakis, was Mrs Savalas one of your regular customers?'...

ext.ext_cn: 她已经成了霍顿府的常客。
ext.ext_en: She has become a regular visitor to Houghton Hall.

defs.def_en: If you are, for example, a regular customer at a shop or a regular visitor to a place, you go there often.

defs.def_cn: 常客;老顾客;固定成员;正式成员

ext.ext_cn: 经常光顾他的酒吧的人伸出援手成立了一个基金会。
ext.ext_en: Regulars at his local pub have set up a fund to help out...

ext.ext_cn: 我并不是他们的正式成员。
ext.ext_en: I wasn't one of their regulars.

defs.def_en: The regulars at a place or in a team are the people who often go to the place or are often in the team.

ext.ext_cn: 这个人坐在他固定的靠窗的位置。
ext.ext_en: The man sat at his regular table near the window.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的一个固定供货商提供的样品
ext.ext_en: ...samples from one of their regular suppliers.

defs.def_en: You use regular when referring to the thing, person, time, or place that is usually used by someone. For example, someone's regular place is the place where they usually sit.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 非常规律的节拍
ext.ext_en: ...a very regular beat...

ext.ext_cn: 他站在走道里，听着她那沉静而规律的呼吸声。
ext.ext_en: He stood in the doorway, listening to her quiet, regular breathing.

defs.def_en: A regular rhythm consists of a series of sounds or movements with equal periods of time between them.

ext.ext_cn: 这种产品看起来和点燃后都与常见的香烟没什么两样。
ext.ext_en: The product looks and burns like a regular cigarette...

ext.ext_cn: 他说自己就是一个从芝加哥郊区来的普通人。
ext.ext_en: He describes himself as just a regular guy from suburban Chicago.

defs.def_en: Regular is used to mean 'normal'.

defs.def_cn: (饮品或食物)分量适中的，中份的

ext.ext_cn: 一个奶酪汉堡和中份薯条
ext.ext_en: ...a cheeseburger and regular fries.

defs.def_en: In some restaurants, a regular drink or quantity of food is of medium size.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 整齐排列的;（空距）均匀的

ext.ext_cn: 奇怪的圆形小沙丘，看上去好像是被整齐地散放在地上似的
ext.ext_en: ...strange small rounded sandy hillocks, that look as if they've been scattered in a regular pattern on the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 整齐的一排排小木屋
ext.ext_en: ...regular rows of wooden huts.

defs.def_en: A regular pattern or arrangement consists of a series of things with equal spaces between them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一些对称的几何图形
ext.ext_en: ...some regular geometrical shape.

defs.def_en: If something has a regular shape, both halves are the same and it has straight edges or a smooth outline.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数方案都试图通过缩减常备军的规模来降低国防支出。
ext.ext_en: Most schemes attempt to reduce the cost of defence through a smaller regular army...

ext.ext_cn: 增援部队中仅有约1/3是常备军。
ext.ext_en: Only about a third of the reinforcements will be regular troops.

defs.def_en: Regular troops are professional soldiers who are a permanent part of an official national army.

defs.def_cn: (语法中)按规则变化的，规则的
defs.def_en: In grammar, a regular verb, noun, or adjective inflects in the same way as most verbs, nouns, or adjectives in the language.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 头发乌黑亮丽、身材丰满性感的女士
ext.ext_en: ...a voluptuous, well-rounded lady with glossy black hair.

defs.def_en: If you describe a woman as voluptuous, you mean that she has large breasts and hips and is considered attractive in a sexual way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 给人以感官享受的;满足感官的

ext.ext_cn: “鸦片”是一种刺激性的、能引起感官快感的香料，能使你所有的感官兴奋起来。
ext.ext_en: 'Opium' is a provocative, sensual, and voluptuous fragrance which makes all your senses vibrate.

defs.def_en: Something that is voluptuous gives you a great deal of pleasure from the rich way it is experienced through your senses.

defs.def_cn: 狰狞的持镰收割者（指死神，形如骷髅，身披黑色斗篷，手持镰刀）
defs.def_en: The Grim Reaper is an imaginary character who represents death. He looks like a skeleton, wears a long, black cloak with a hood, and carries a scythe.

ext.ext_cn: 该装置使点火器自动断开。
ext.ext_en: The device automatically disconnects the ignition.

defs.def_en: In a car engine, the ignition is the part where the fuel is ignited.
Inside a car, the ignition is the part where you turn the key so that the engine starts.

ext.ext_cn: 甲烷起火，致使 8 人丧生。
ext.ext_en: The ignition of methane gas killed eight men.

defs.def_en: Ignition is the process of something starting to burn.

ext.ext_cn: 在墙的这边，沿着墙根有一条自行车道。
ext.ext_en: There was a cycle path running along this side of the wall, right at its base...

ext.ext_cn: 把一个20厘米深的圆形糕饼盒的底部和四周都垫上纸。
ext.ext_en: Line the base and sides of a 20cm deep round cake tin with paper.

defs.def_en: The base of something is its lowest edge or part.

ext.ext_cn: 外科医生在脑根部的静脉和动脉中放置了导管。
ext.ext_en: The surgeon placed catheters through the veins and arteries near the base of the head.

defs.def_en: The base of something is the lowest part of it, where it is attached to something else.

ext.ext_cn: 先把锅从炉子上拿开，然后把锅底浸入一盆冷水中。
ext.ext_en: Remove from the heat and plunge the base of the pan into a bowl of very cold water.

defs.def_en: The base of an object such as a box or vase is the lower surface of it that touches the surface it rests on.

ext.ext_cn: 这种床垫最好放在结实的床板上。
ext.ext_en: The mattress is best on a solid bed base...

ext.ext_cn: 钟放在椭圆形的大理石基座上，外罩玻璃罩。
ext.ext_en: The clock stands on an oval marble base, enclosed by a glass dome.

defs.def_en: The base of an object that has several sections and that rests on a surface is the lower section of it.

ext.ext_cn: 把混合好的糊糊舀到饼干坯上，然后放入已预热的烤箱烘烤。
ext.ext_en: Spoon the mixture on to the biscuit base and cook in a preheated oven...

ext.ext_cn: 很多现代的木船将采用环氧涂层作底漆。
ext.ext_en: On many modern wooden boats, epoxy coatings will have been used as a base for varnishing.

defs.def_en: A base is a layer of something which will have another layer added to it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个职位将给他提供一个强有力的政治基点来挑战克里姆林宫。
ext.ext_en: The post will give him a powerful political base from which to challenge the Kremlin...

ext.ext_cn: 家庭基础对我的发展至关重要。
ext.ext_en: The family base was crucial to my development.

defs.def_en: A position or thing that is a base for something is one from which that thing can be developed or achieved.

ext.ext_cn: 他根据被俘囚犯提供的证据得出了这个结论。
ext.ext_en: He based his conclusions on the evidence given by the captured prisoners.

defs.def_en: If you base one thing on another thing, the first thing develops from the second thing.

defs.def_cn: （公司的）客户基础，主要（客户）群体

ext.ext_cn: 公司一直通过在商业杂志上刊登广告扩展客户群。
ext.ext_en: The company has been expanding its customer base using trade magazine advertising.

defs.def_en: A company's client base or customer base is the group of regular clients or customers that the company gets most of its income from.

ext.ext_cn: 机场附近的军事基地传出了炮火声。
ext.ext_en: Gunfire was heard at an army base close to the airport.

ext.ext_cn: 沙特阿拉伯东部的一个大型空军基地
ext.ext_en: ...a massive air base in eastern Saudi Arabia.

defs.def_en: A military base is a place which part of the armed forces works from.

ext.ext_cn: 春天和初夏的大部分时间，她都是在苏格兰的家里度过的。
ext.ext_en: For most of the spring and early summer her base was her home in Scotland.

defs.def_en: Your base is the main place where you work, stay, or live.

ext.ext_cn: 对于去托斯卡纳东南部探险的人们来说，这两家酒店是很有吸引力的驻扎地。
ext.ext_en: The two hotel-restaurants are attractive bases from which to explore southeast Tuscany...

ext.ext_cn: 洛杉矶仍然是我的财务中心。我还在那里做生意。
ext.ext_en: Los Angeles was still my financial base. I was still doing business there.

defs.def_en: If a place is a base for a certain activity, the activity can be carried out at that place or from that place.

defs.def_cn: 基础成分；主要成分；主料

ext.ext_cn: 先滗出多余的卤汁，把它当作浇汁的主料。
ext.ext_en: Drain off any excess marinade and use it as a base for a pouring sauce...

ext.ext_cn: 将油和基础油混合，按摩直至皮肤吸收。
ext.ext_en: Oils may be mixed with a base oil and massaged into the skin.

defs.def_en: The base of a substance such as paint or food is the main ingredient of it, to which other substances can be added.
A base is a system of counting and expressing numbers. The decimal system uses base 10, and the binary system uses base 2.
A base in baseball, softball, or rounders is one of the places at each corner of the square on the pitch.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 爱能够战胜邪念。
ext.ext_en: Love has the power to overcome the baser emotions.

defs.def_en: Base behaviour is behaviour that is immoral or dishonest.

ext.ext_cn: 我错了吗？我大错特错了吗？因为如果我不对的话，我希望你能纠正我的错误。
ext.ext_en: Am I wrong? Am I way off base? Because I want you to set me straight if you think I'm wrong.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is off base, you mean that they are wrong.

defs.def_cn: （尤指在近期没有联系的情况下与某人）取得联系

ext.ext_cn: 在那里，让我有机会和一年没见面的三个朋友取得了联系。
ext.ext_en: Being there gave me a chance to touch base with three friends whom I had not seen for a year.

defs.def_en: If you communicate with someone, especially someone you have not communicated with recently, you can say that you touch base with them.

defs.def_cn: 面面俱到；应付各种情况

ext.ext_cn: 他想方设法把所有必要的事情都处理妥当，生意也维持了下来。
ext.ext_en: He has managed to touch all the bases necessary, and trade goes on...

ext.ext_cn: 老板设立一个工作岗位时，需要方方面面都考虑到。
ext.ext_en: The boss covers all bases when he sets up a job.

defs.def_en: If someone touches all the bases or covers the bases, they deal with everyone or everything involved in a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 清楚易操作的菜单控制式屏幕显示
ext.ext_en: ...a clear and easy-to-follow menu-driven on-screen display...

ext.ext_cn: 跟着屏幕上的歌词一起唱。
ext.ext_en: Read the on-screen lyrics and sing along.

defs.def_en: On-screen means appearing on the screen of a television, cinema, or computer.

defs.def_cn: 电影（或电视）中的；非现实中的

ext.ext_cn: 制片人决定结束她在影片中与皮尔斯·劳顿的恋情。
ext.ext_en: Producers decided to end her on-screen romance with Pierce Lawton.

ext.ext_cn: 她的银屏初吻
ext.ext_en: ...her first onscreen kiss.

defs.def_en: On-screen means relating to the roles played by film or television actors, in contrast with their real lives.

ext.ext_cn: 汉德先生声称该公司将在美国作进一步的追加采购。
ext.ext_en: Mr Hand said the company would make further bolt-on acquisitions in the US.

defs.def_en: Bolt-on buys are purchases of other companies that a company makes in order to add them to its existing business.

defs.def_cn: 紧急情况;危急关头;迫切需要

ext.ext_cn: 战时经济的紧急情况
ext.ext_en: ...the exigencies of a wartime economy.

defs.def_en: The exigencies of a situation or a job are the demands or difficulties that you have to deal with as part of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (房屋等)不太大的，不算昂贵的，普通的

ext.ext_cn: 靠土地过活的一户人家的简朴住房
ext.ext_en: ...the modest home of a family who lived off the land...

ext.ext_cn: 在普通的旅店里过一夜要花费约35英镑。
ext.ext_en: A one-night stay in a modest hotel costs around £35.

defs.def_en: A modest house or other building is not large or expensive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (数量、比率或改进程度)不太高的，适度的，适中的

ext.ext_cn: 瑞士的失业率上升到了0.7%，这个百分比仍然不算太高。
ext.ext_en: Swiss unemployment rose to the still modest rate of 0.7%...

ext.ext_cn: 民主改革的力度并不太大。
ext.ext_en: The democratic reforms have been modest...

defs.def_en: You use modest to describe something such as an amount, rate, or improvement which is fairly small.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是一名谦虚而伟大的运动员。
ext.ext_en: He's modest, as well as being a great player...

ext.ext_cn: 卡林顿勋爵对自己取得的成绩非常谦虚。
ext.ext_en: Lord Carrington is modest about his achievements.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is modest, you approve of them because they do not talk much about their abilities or achievements.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (女性或其衣着)端庄的，保守的;(行为)正派的，检点的

ext.ext_cn: 亚洲女性表现得更为端庄腼腆，却往往外柔内刚。
ext.ext_en: Asian women are more modest and shy, yet they tend to have an inner force...

ext.ext_cn: 要尊重当地的礼节。朴素端庄的衣着往往比暴露的短裤和紧身上衣更合适。
ext.ext_en: Respect the local etiquete. Modest clothing is often preferable to revealing shorts and tight-fitting tops.

defs.def_en: You can describe a woman as modest when she avoids doing or wearing anything that might cause men to have sexual feelings towards her. You can also describe her clothes or behaviour as modest .

defs.def_cn: （在英国用作对女贵族或爵士妻子的尊称）夫人阁下

ext.ext_cn: 夫人阁下正等着您呢，先生。
ext.ext_en: Her Ladyship's expecting you, sir.

defs.def_en: In Britain, you use the expressions Your Ladyship ,Her Ladyship, or Their Ladyships when you are addressing or referring to female members of the nobility or the wives of knights.

defs.def_cn: (飞机、轮船、机场等地出售的商品)免税的,免关税的

ext.ext_cn: 免税的香烟
ext.ext_en: ...duty-free cigarettes.

defs.def_en: Duty-free goods are sold at airports or on planes or ships at a cheaper price than usual because you do not have to pay import tax on them.

defs.def_cn: (作为体育运动的)洞穴探险者
defs.def_en: A caver is someone who goes into underground caves as a sport.

defs.def_cn: 大致上；总体上；一般地说

ext.ext_cn: 该基金大致上由政府借款支持。
ext.ext_en: The fund is largely financed through government borrowing...

ext.ext_cn: 我大多和积极主动的人一起工作。
ext.ext_en: I largely work with people who already are motivated...

defs.def_en: You use largely to say that a statement is not completely true but is mostly true.

ext.ext_cn: 上月零售额下降了千分之六，主要是因为美国人买汽车少了。
ext.ext_en: Retail sales dipped 6/10ths of a percent last month, largely because Americans were buying fewer cars...

ext.ext_cn: 法兰西帝国的扩张主要靠军事征服。
ext.ext_en: The French empire had expanded largely through military conquest.

defs.def_en: Largely is used to introduce the main reason for a particular event or situation.
Andante written above a piece of music means that it should be played fairly slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 中间部动听的行板
ext.ext_en: ...the lovely central Andante.

ext.ext_cn: 中提琴的行板主旋律
ext.ext_en: ...the violas' Andante theme.

defs.def_en: An andante is a piece of music that is played fairly slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 达比一直在寻找改善铁质的方法，他猛然想到可以不用木炭熔炼，而改用焦炭。
ext.ext_en: Darby was looking for a way to improve iron when he hit upon the idea of smelting it with coke instead of charcoal.

defs.def_en: To smelt a substance containing metal means to process it by heating it until it melts, so that the metal is extracted and changed chemically.
War games are military exercises that are carried out for the purpose of training, and that are designed to imitate a real war as closely as possible.
A war game is a game in which model soldiers are used to recreate battles that happened in the past. War games can also be played on computers.

defs.def_cn: 天体观察;天文学;占星学
defs.def_en: Star-gazing is the activity of studying the stars as an astronomer or astrologer.
Your femur is the large bone in the upper part of your leg.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个练习对减除小肚子上的赘肉极为有效。
ext.ext_en: This exercise is brilliant for getting rid of flabby tums.

ext.ext_cn: 我大腿太粗，肚子上也净是赘肉，让我很发愁。
ext.ext_en: My bulging thighs and flabby stomach made me depressed.

defs.def_en: Flabby people are rather fat, with loose flesh over their bodies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你会听到有关美国经济发展无序、后劲乏力的议论。
ext.ext_en: You hear talk about American business being flabby.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as flabby, you are criticizing it for being disorganized or wasteful.

ext.ext_cn: 除了到欧洲工作外，我本来什么都不会接受。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't have accepted anything except a job in Europe...

ext.ext_cn: 我什么药都不吃，除了感冒时吃阿司匹林。
ext.ext_en: I don't take any drugs whatsoever, except aspirin for colds...

defs.def_en: You use except to introduce the only thing or person that a statement does not apply to, or a fact that prevents a statement from being completely true.

ext.ext_cn: 除了一餐叉色拉，他什么都没吃。
ext.ext_en: He hadn't eaten a thing except for one forkful of salad...

ext.ext_cn: 除了理查德，其他所有人都迟到了。
ext.ext_en: Everyone was late, except for Richard.

defs.def_en: You use except for to introduce the only thing or person that prevents a statement from being completely true.

ext.ext_cn: 等蛋糕温热或凉至室温时切成四方块端上桌。
ext.ext_en: Serve the cake warm or at room temperature, cut in squares...

ext.ext_cn: 墙上有一幅日历，每个日期都用大方框框着。
ext.ext_en: There was a calendar on the wall, with large squares around the dates...

defs.def_en: A square is a shape with four sides that are all the same length and four corners that are all right angles.

ext.ext_cn: 房子位于皮姆利科最美丽的一个花园广场上。
ext.ext_en: The house is located in one of Pimlico's prettiest garden squares...

ext.ext_cn: 市中心随处都是教堂和被咖啡店包围的广场。
ext.ext_en: The town centre is thick with churches and cafe-lined squares.

defs.def_en: In a town or city, a square is a flat open place, often in the shape of a square.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在相同的空间里，圆桌比起方桌可以坐下更多的人。
ext.ext_en: Round tables seat more people in the same space as a square table...

ext.ext_cn: 他的手指甲是方形的，修剪得很齐。
ext.ext_en: His finger nails were square and cut neatly across.

defs.def_en: Something that is square has a shape the same as a square or similar to a square.

defs.def_cn: (用于长度单位前表示面积)平方的

ext.ext_cn: 金丝雀码头计划要提供 1,000 万平方英尺的办公面积。
ext.ext_en: Canary Wharf was set to provide 10 million square feet of office space...

ext.ext_cn: 菲律宾只剩下 6,000 平方公里的森林了。
ext.ext_en: The Philippines has just 6,000 square kilometres of forest left.

defs.def_en: Square is used before units of length when referring to the area of something. For example, if something is three metres long and two metres wide, its area is six square metres.

defs.def_cn: (用于长度面积后表示四方形物的边长)长宽为…的

ext.ext_cn: 一个亚麻靠垫套，长宽为 45 厘米
ext.ext_en: ...a linen cushion cover, 45 cm square.

ext.ext_cn: 两块长宽均为 4 英寸的木片
ext.ext_en: ...two pieces of wood 4 inches square.

defs.def_en: Square is used after units of length when you are giving the length of each side of something that is square in shape.

defs.def_cn: 使成二次幂;将(数字)平方

ext.ext_cn: 记下用了多少秒时间，将其平方，再乘以5.12。
ext.ext_en: Take the time in seconds, square it, and multiply by 5.12...

ext.ext_cn: A 的平方加上 B 的平方等于 C 的平方。
ext.ext_en: A squared plus B squared equals C squared.

defs.def_en: To square a number means to multiply it by itself. For example, 3 squared is 3 x 3, or 9. 3 squared is usually written as 32.

ext.ext_cn: 光速的平方，一个天文数字
ext.ext_en: ...the square of the speed of light, an exceedingly large number.

defs.def_en: The square of a number is the number produced when you multiply that number by itself. For example, the square of 3 is 9.

defs.def_cn: (使)(不同想法或行动)协调一致

ext.ext_cn: 那个解释和事实相符，不是吗？
ext.ext_en: That explanation squares with the facts, doesn't it...

ext.ext_cn: 他开始让自己的梦想接近现实。
ext.ext_en: He set out to square his dreams with reality.

defs.def_en: If you square two different ideas or actions with each other or if they square with each other, they fit or match each other.

ext.ext_cn: 我征得了丹的同意，他说只要我下周一早上能回来就行。
ext.ext_en: I squared it with Dan, who said it was all right so long as I was back next Monday morning...

ext.ext_cn: 她本该在和沃克联手进入这一行之前先征得杰伊的同意。
ext.ext_en: She should have squared things with Jay before she went into this business with Walker.

defs.def_en: If you square something with someone, you ask their permission or check with them that what you are doing is acceptable to them.

defs.def_cn: 将圆的变成方的;做不可能做到的事

ext.ext_cn: 他做到了不可能做到的事，既让伦敦城满意，又增加了企业的现金流量。
ext.ext_en: He has squared the circle of keeping the City happy and doing something to improve business cash flow...

ext.ext_cn: “涅磐”乐队做到了不可能做到的事，录制了一张既有流行风又带有摇滚范儿的唱片。
ext.ext_en: 'Nirvana' squared the circle by making a record that was both superb pop and rock music at the same time.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone squares the circle, you mean that they bring together two things which are normally thought to be so different that they cannot exist together.

defs.def_cn: (因行动失败而)重新开始，重起炉灶

ext.ext_cn: 如果你的投诉没有得到支持，你可能会感到自己又得重新开始。
ext.ext_en: If your complaint is not upheld, you may feel you are back to square one...

ext.ext_cn: 我们接到了律师的一个电话，一切又得从头开始。
ext.ext_en: We got a phone call from the lawyers and is was back to square one.

defs.def_en: If you are back to square one, you have to start dealing with something from the beginning again because the way you were dealing with it has failed.

defs.def_cn: 不适宜做某工作的人;与环境格格不入的人

ext.ext_cn: 泰勒显然不是做这份工作的合适人选——简直就是方枘圆凿。
ext.ext_en: Taylor is clearly the wrong man for the job—a square peg in a round hole.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a square peg in a round hole, you mean that they are completely unsuitable for the job they are doing or the situation they are in.

defs.def_cn: 滑稽讽刺的模仿作品(或表演)

ext.ext_cn: 他那部模仿并讽刺60年代摇滚乐的经典电影——《狂热》
ext.ext_en: ...his classic send-up of sixties rock, 'Get Crazy'.

defs.def_en: A send-up is a piece of writing or acting in which someone or something is imitated in an amusing way that makes them appear foolish.

ext.ext_cn: 重要的历史人物
ext.ext_en: ...an important historical figure.

ext.ext_cn: 西方资本主义对世界历史的影响
ext.ext_en: ...the historical impact of Western capitalism on the world...

defs.def_en: Historical people, situations, or things existed in the past and are considered to be a part of history.

defs.def_cn: （书籍、电影或图片）描述历史的，基于史实的

ext.ext_cn: 他正在写一本描述19世纪法国的历史小说。
ext.ext_en: He is writing a historical novel about nineteenth-century France.

ext.ext_cn: 爱森斯坦的另一部杰出的历史片
ext.ext_en: ...another great Eisenstein historical film.

defs.def_en: Historical books, films, or pictures describe or represent people, situations, or things that existed in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 史籍
ext.ext_en: ...historical records.

ext.ext_cn: 现代史学研究
ext.ext_en: ...modern historical research.

defs.def_en: Historical information, research, and discussion is related to the study of history.

defs.def_cn: 历史背景的;历史视角的

ext.ext_cn: 莫里斯的作品正是基于这样一种历史背景。
ext.ext_en: It was this kind of historical context that Morris brought to his work...

ext.ext_cn: 《电讯报》从历史的角度对该工会进行了报道。
ext.ext_en: The Telegraph puts the union in a historical perspective.

defs.def_en: If you look at an event within a historical context, you look at what was happening at that time and what had happened previously, in order to judge the event and its importance.
A stabbing is an incident in which someone stabs someone else with a knife.

ext.ext_cn: 他突然感到腹部一阵剧烈疼痛。
ext.ext_en: He was struck by a stabbing pain in his midriff.

defs.def_en: A stabbing pain is a sudden sharp pain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个温顺随和的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a meek, mild-mannered fellow.

ext.ext_cn: 众人之中最温顺驯良的一个
ext.ext_en: ...the meekest and most docile of people.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as meek, you think that they are gentle and quiet, and likely to do what other people say.

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰克以恳求的眼神看着吉姆。
ext.ext_en: Frank looked at Jim with imploring eyes.

defs.def_en: An imploring look, cry, or letter shows that you very much want someone to do something and are afraid they may not do it.

defs.def_cn: 同…打招呼;向…问好；欢迎；迎接

ext.ext_cn: 她喜欢呆在家里迎接放学回家的史蒂夫。
ext.ext_en: She liked to be home to greet Steve when he came in from school.

defs.def_en: When you greet someone, you say 'Hello' or shake hands with them.

ext.ext_cn: 渔民对欧洲法庭的裁决感到失望。
ext.ext_en: The European Court's decision has been greeted with dismay by fishermen...

ext.ext_cn: 该提议不大可能在波罗的海诸国得到热烈响应。
ext.ext_en: It is unlikely that this suggestion will be greeted enthusiastically in the Baltic States.

defs.def_en: If something is greeted in a particular way, people react to it in that way.

defs.def_cn: 呈现在…面前；映入…眼帘；最先被…感觉到

ext.ext_cn: 一幅令人震惊的画面映入我的眼帘。
ext.ext_en: I was greeted by a shocking sight...

ext.ext_cn: 他们进门时一阵香味扑鼻而来。
ext.ext_en: The savoury smell greeted them as they went through the door.

defs.def_en: If you are greeted by something, it is the first thing you notice in a particular place.

ext.ext_cn: 你什么时候回家？
ext.ext_en: When are you going home?...

ext.ext_cn: 你什么时候结的婚？
ext.ext_en: When did you get married?...

defs.def_en: You use when to ask questions about the time at which things happen.

defs.def_cn: (表示两事同时发生)在…时，当…时

ext.ext_cn: 吃一整条鱼时，切忌把它翻过来去吃另一面的肉。
ext.ext_en: When eating a whole cooked fish, you should never turn it over to get at the flesh on the other side...

ext.ext_cn: 芥菜要在地里长杂草而不是长庄稼时种植。
ext.ext_en: Mustard is grown in the field when weeds are there, rather than when the growing crops are there.

defs.def_en: If something happens when something else is happening, the two things are happening at the same time.

defs.def_cn: (引导从句，表示某事发生于另一活动、事件或情形期间)在…的过程中

ext.ext_cn: 遇到吉尔一家时我已经做了近10年的园艺工作。
ext.ext_en: When I met the Gills, I had been gardening for nearly ten years.

defs.def_en: You use when to introduce a clause in which you mention something which happens at some point during an activity, event, or situation.

defs.def_cn: (引导从句，说明主句动作已经发生或将要发生时的情况)其时

ext.ext_cn: 当他把饮料拿给艾梅尔达时，她真诚而甜美地向他微笑以示感谢。
ext.ext_en: When he brought Imelda her drink she gave him a genuine, sweet smile of thanks...

ext.ext_cn: 我要写报告时会对此予以考虑的。
ext.ext_en: I'll start to think about it when I have to write my report.

defs.def_en: You use when to introduce a clause where you mention the circumstances under which the event in the main clause happened or will happen.

defs.def_cn: (尤用于动词和形容词后引导从句，表示某事发生的时间)什么时候,何时

ext.ext_cn: 我问他什么时候回来接我。
ext.ext_en: I asked him when he'd be back to pick me up...

ext.ext_cn: 我不知道决定是什么时候作出的。
ext.ext_en: I don't know when the decision was made...

defs.def_en: You use when after certain words, especially verbs and adjectives, to introduce a clause where you mention the time at which something happens.

defs.def_cn: (用于引导从句，限定或指示某事发生的时间)…的时候

ext.ext_cn: 他还能记得自己一度工作起来也是那个样子。
ext.ext_en: He could remember a time when he had worked like that himself...

ext.ext_cn: 她清楚地记得她去岩石区潮水潭探险的那天。
ext.ext_en: She remembered clearly that day when she'd gone exploring the rockpools...

defs.def_en: You use when to introduce a clause which specifies or refers to the time at which something happens.

defs.def_cn: (用于引出某个观点、评论或问题的原因)既然，考虑到

ext.ext_cn: 我这个样子，怎么能对自己满意呢？
ext.ext_en: How can I love myself when I look like this?...

ext.ext_cn: 与同类的其他鸟相比，翠辉椋鸟要小很多。
ext.ext_en: Emerald starlings are fairly small when compared with other such birds.

defs.def_en: You use when to introduce the reason for an opinion, comment, or question.

defs.def_cn: (用于引出使句子的其他部分显得让人吃惊或不大可能的事实或评论)虽然，然而,可是

ext.ext_cn: 我们的母亲让我们坐下来读书和画画，而我们真正想做的却是打打闹闹。
ext.ext_en: Our mothers sat us down to read and paint, when all we really wanted to do was to make a mess...

ext.ext_cn: 温度传感器发给计算机的信息为发动机是冷却的，可实际上它的温度很高。
ext.ext_en: The temperature sensor is making the computer think the engine is cold when, in fact, it's hot.

defs.def_en: You use when in order to introduce a fact or comment which makes the other part of the sentence rather surprising or unlikely.

defs.def_cn: （出售三明治或报纸等的）售货亭，小亭

ext.ext_cn: 我正在售货亭买烟。
ext.ext_en: I was getting cigarettes at the kiosk.

defs.def_en: A kiosk is a small building or structure from which people can buy things such as sandwiches or newspapers through an open window.

ext.ext_cn: 他在公用电话亭给我打了电话。
ext.ext_en: He phoned me from a kiosk.

defs.def_en: A kiosk or a telephone kiosk is a public telephone box.

ext.ext_cn: 对于当地广播台来说，过去的12个月很艰难。
ext.ext_en: The last 12 months have been difficult ones for local radio...

ext.ext_cn: 通知已在广播和电视上发布。
ext.ext_en: The announcement was broadcast on radio and television.

defs.def_en: Radio is the broadcasting of programmes for the public to listen to, by sending out signals from a transmitter.

ext.ext_cn: 许多人喜欢在早上听广播。
ext.ext_en: A lot of people tend to listen to the radio in the mornings...

ext.ext_cn: 最近总能在广播节目中听到他的声音。
ext.ext_en: He's been on the radio a lot recently...

defs.def_en: You can refer to the programmes broadcast by radio stations as the radio .

ext.ext_cn: 他在扶手椅中坐下，打开了收音机。
ext.ext_en: He sat down in the armchair and turned on the radio.

defs.def_en: A radio is the piece of equipment that you use in order to listen to radio programmes.

ext.ext_cn: 他们每天用无线电和叛军首领联系两次。
ext.ext_en: They are in twice daily radio contact with the rebel leader.

ext.ext_cn: 无线电波
ext.ext_en: ...radio waves.

defs.def_en: Radio is a system of sending sound over a distance by transmitting electrical signals.

ext.ext_cn: 通过无线电设备发出警报的年轻警官
ext.ext_en: ...the young constable who managed to raise the alarm on his radio...

ext.ext_cn: 无线电报消息很简短。
ext.ext_en: The radio message was brief.

defs.def_en: A radio is a piece of equipment that is used for sending and receiving messages.

ext.ext_cn: 军官发来无线电报请求指示。
ext.ext_en: The officer radioed for advice...

ext.ext_cn: 起飞几分钟后，飞行员用无线电报告说飞机内突然起火。
ext.ext_en: A few minutes after take-off, the pilot radioed that a fire had broken out.

defs.def_en: If you radio someone, you send a message to them by radio.

ext.ext_cn: 韦恩·戈斯州长揭开诗人巴尼奥·佩特森的等身塑像时，人群欢呼起来。
ext.ext_en: The crowd cheered as Premier Wayne Goss unveiled a lifesize statue of poet Banjo Paterson...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天，瑞士球迷在雅各布·赫拉塞克对阵库里耶的比赛中为赫拉塞克喝彩加油。
ext.ext_en: Swiss fans cheered Jakob Hlasek during yesterday's match with Courier.

defs.def_en: When people cheer, they shout loudly to show their approval or to encourage someone who is doing something such as taking part in a game.

ext.ext_cn: 斯蒂芬注意到，周围的人们似乎因为他的到来而受到鼓舞。
ext.ext_en: Stephen noticed that the people around him looked cheered by his presence...

ext.ext_cn: 他告诉自己，那样的天气出去野餐再合适不过了，可是，这丝毫不能让他提起精神来。
ext.ext_en: The weather was perfect for a picnic, he told himself, but the thought did nothing to cheer him.

defs.def_en: If you are cheered by something, it makes you happier or less worried.

ext.ext_cn: 他整天笑呵呵的样子给他们留下很深的印象。
ext.ext_en: They were impressed by his steadfast good cheer...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天玩宾戈赢了一把，适时地给朱丽叶·利特尔一家带来些许的欢快心情。
ext.ext_en: A timely bingo win brought some cheer to Juliet Little's family yesterday.

defs.def_en: Cheer is a feeling of cheerfulness.
People sometimes say 'Cheers' to each other just before they drink an alcoholic drink.
Some people say 'Cheers' as a way of saying 'thank you' or 'goodbye'.
A lassie is a young woman or girl.

ext.ext_cn: 很多年纪更大的矿工也许再也不干活了。
ext.ext_en: Many of the older pitmen may never work again.

defs.def_en: Pitmen are coal miners .

ext.ext_cn: 罐头番茄
ext.ext_en: ...tinned tomatoes.

ext.ext_cn: 听装鲑鱼
ext.ext_en: ...tinned salmon.

defs.def_en: Tinned food is food that has been preserved by being sealed in a tin.

ext.ext_cn: 娱乐界的诱惑
ext.ext_en: ...the glamour of show biz.

defs.def_en: Glamour is the quality of being more attractive, exciting, or interesting than ordinary people or things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的脸有些肿胀。
ext.ext_en: His face was a little puffed...

ext.ext_cn: 他的嘴上挨了枪托的地方都肿了起来。
ext.ext_en: His mouth was all puffed up where he had taken a rifle butt.

defs.def_en: If a part of your body is puffed or puffed up, it is swollen because of an injury or because you are unwell.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 气喘吁吁的；上气不接下气的

ext.ext_cn: 你要是在楼梯上跑上跑下的会不会喘不过气来？
ext.ext_en: Do you get puffed out running up and down the stairs?

defs.def_en: If you are puffed or puffed out, you are breathing with difficulty because you have been using a lot of energy.
Chlorine is a strong-smelling gas that is used to clean water and to make cleaning products.

ext.ext_cn: 纽约拉扎德兄弟公司
ext.ext_en: ...Lazard Bros. of New York.

defs.def_en: Bros. is an abbreviation for (缩略=) brothers. It is usually used as part of the name of a company.
A turnip is a round vegetable with a greenish-white skin that is the root of a crop.

defs.def_cn: （尤指当had为助动词时，you had的常用口语形式）

ext.ext_cn: 我想你最好告诉我们你为什么要问这些问题。
ext.ext_en: I think you'd better tell us why you're asking these questions.

defs.def_en: You'd is the usual spoken form of 'you had', especially when 'had' is an auxiliary verb.

ext.ext_cn: 以你的发色和漂亮的肤色，穿红色或者其他亮色的衣服会很好看的。
ext.ext_en: With your hair and your beautiful skin, you'd look good in red and other bright colors.

defs.def_en: You'd is the usual spoken form of 'you would'.
Unsweetened food or drink does not have any sugar or other sweet substance added to it.

defs.def_cn: 破坏罢工者;顶替罢工者工作的人;工贼
defs.def_en: A strike-breaker is a person who continues to work during a strike, or someone who takes over the work of a person who is on strike.

defs.def_cn: 最高的;最上面的；顶端的

ext.ext_cn: 一棵巨大橡树的梢枝
ext.ext_en: ...the topmost branches of a gigantic oak tree.

defs.def_en: The topmost thing in a number of things is the one that is highest or nearest the top.

ext.ext_cn: 我们没有冰箱、炊具、刀具或餐具。
ext.ext_en: We had no fridge, cooker, cutlery or crockery.

defs.def_en: Crockery is the plates, cups, saucers, and dishes that you use at meals.
If an electric plug or circuit is fused, it has a fuse in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他教科学和数学这两门课。
ext.ext_en: He taught science and maths.

defs.def_en: Maths is the same as mathematics .

defs.def_cn: 对（尤指女性或儿童）进行性骚扰;猥亵

ext.ext_cn: 他被指控对一位女同事进行性骚扰。
ext.ext_en: He was accused of sexually molesting a female colleague.

defs.def_en: A person who molests someone, especially a woman or a child, interferes with them in a sexual way against their will.

defs.def_cn: （药物）作用于精神的，影响心理状态的

ext.ext_cn: 尼古丁是一种影响精神活动的毒物。
ext.ext_en: Nicotine is a psychoactive drug.

defs.def_en: Psychoactive drugs are drugs that affect your mind.
An anteater is an animal with a long nose that eats termites or ants. Anteaters live in warm countries.

defs.def_cn: 在内地(或内陆);向内地(或内陆)

ext.ext_cn: 大部分人住在更远的内地。
ext.ext_en: The vast majority live further inland...

ext.ext_cn: 从戛纳向内陆方向开车走约需 15 分钟。
ext.ext_en: It's about 15 minutes' drive inland from Cannes...

defs.def_en: If something is situated inland, it is away from the coast, towards or near the middle of a country. If you go inland, you go away from the coast, towards the middle of a country.

ext.ext_cn: 颇为宁静的内陆城镇
ext.ext_en: ...a rather quiet inland town.

defs.def_en: Inland areas, lakes, and places are not on the coast, but in or near the middle of a country.

ext.ext_cn: 对不起。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry...

ext.ext_cn: 下一个约会我已经晚了。
ext.ext_en: I'm already late for my next appointment...

defs.def_en: I'm is the usual spoken form of 'I am'.

ext.ext_cn: 来自宾夕法尼亚州拉克万纳的迈克尔·休斯20年前参军，在第82空降师服役。
ext.ext_en: Michael Hughes of Lackawanna, Pennsylvania, enlisted in the 82nd Airborne 20 years ago...

ext.ext_cn: 在墨西哥战争中他参军成为一名二等兵。
ext.ext_en: He enlisted as a private in the Mexican War...

defs.def_en: If someone enlists or is enlisted, they join the army, navy, marines, or air force.

ext.ext_cn: 我不得不砍掉一棵树，并叫来7位邻居帮忙把树抬出花园！
ext.ext_en: I had to cut down a tree and enlist the help of seven neighbours to get it out of the garden!...

ext.ext_cn: 我读到你让一些12岁的孩子在宣传活动中做帮手。
ext.ext_en: I've read that you've enlisted some 12-year-olds to help out in your campaign...

defs.def_en: If you enlist the help of someone, you persuade them to help or support you in doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 据称年销售额下滑幅度最大的零售商中包括家具和地毯零售商。
ext.ext_en: Furniture and carpet retailers are among those reporting the sharpest annual decline in sales.

defs.def_en: A retailer is a person or business that sells goods to the public.

ext.ext_cn: 穿着一身黑西装的打扮帅气的年轻小伙子
ext.ext_en: ...a well-turned-out young chap in a black suit.

ext.ext_cn: 穿着花格裙和绿色上装、打扮得漂漂亮亮的女子
ext.ext_en: …a woman, smartly turned out in patterned skirt and green top.

defs.def_en: If you are well turned out or smartly turned out, you are dressed smartly.

ext.ext_cn: 文科课程的报名人数有所下降，而以商业为主、针对高薪职业的高度专业化培训课程则越来越受欢迎。
ext.ext_en: There has been a decline in enrollment in liberal arts courses in favor of highly specialized training for high-paying careers, mostly in business.

defs.def_en: At a university or college, liberal arts courses are on subjects such as history or literature rather than science, law, medicine, or business.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 大声说出的;直言不讳的;激烈表达意见的

ext.ext_cn: 他直言不讳地表达了他对结果的不满。
ext.ext_en: He has been very vocal in his displeasure over the results...

ext.ext_cn: 今年早些时候进行的一次公众调查显示居民对此强烈抗议。
ext.ext_en: A public inquiry earlier this year produced vocal opposition from residents.

defs.def_en: You say that people are vocal when they speak forcefully about something that they feel strongly about.

defs.def_cn: 嗓音的;发声的;（尤指）歌唱的

ext.ext_cn: 更多样的歌唱风格
ext.ext_en: ...a wider range of vocal styles.

ext.ext_cn: 发声训练
ext.ext_en: ...vocal training.

defs.def_en: Vocal means involving the use of the human voice, especially in singing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无节制的;过度的;过激的

ext.ext_cn: 文章的语气过激了。
ext.ext_en: The tone of the article is intemperate.

ext.ext_cn: 该党主席愚蠢失当的言辞
ext.ext_en: ...the unwisely intemperate language of the party chairman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's words as intemperate, you are critical of them because they are too forceful and uncontrolled.

defs.def_cn: （色彩、图案、形状等）千变万化的，瞬息万变的

ext.ext_cn: 由美国罗伯特·艾伦设计工作室设计的一系列图案繁多的布料
ext.ext_en: ...a kaleidoscopic range of fabrics by American design house, Robert Allen.

ext.ext_cn: 对不断变化的法国民族主义思想及象征的多角度研究
ext.ext_en: ...a kaleidoscopic study of the shifting ideas and symbols of French nationhood.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as kaleidoscopic, you mean that it consists of a lot of very different parts, such as different colours, patterns, or shapes.

ext.ext_cn: 他那张安详的亚洲人的脸庞
ext.ext_en: ...his placid Asiatic face.

defs.def_en: Asiatic means belonging or relating to Asia or its people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不害怕的；不气馁的；不沮丧的

ext.ext_cn: 想到可能会失败，他并不气馁。
ext.ext_en: He was undismayed by the prospect of failure.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is undismayed by something unpleasant or unexpected, you mean that they do not feel any fear, worry, or sadness about it.
A non-finite clause is a clause which is based on an infinitive or a participle and has no tense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 能控制感情的;有自制力的

ext.ext_cn: 平素一直非常自制的父亲变得暴躁了。
ext.ext_en: My father, who had always been very self-controlled, became bad-tempered.

defs.def_en: Someone who is self-controlled is able to not show their feelings or not do the things that their feelings make them want to do.

defs.def_cn: 西西里的;西西里人的;西西里文化的

ext.ext_cn: 西西里岛科莱奥内镇的村庄
ext.ext_en: ...the Sicilian village of Corleone.

defs.def_en: Sicilian means belonging or relating to Sicily, or to its people or culture.

defs.def_cn: 西西里人;西西里岛人的后裔
defs.def_en: A Sicilian is a Sicilian citizen, or a person of Sicilian origin.

defs.def_cn: 混凝土丛林(指充斥着现代建筑的丑陋不堪、不宜居住的城市)
defs.def_en: If you refer to a city or area as a concrete jungle, you mean that it has a lot of modern buildings and you think it is ugly or unpleasant to live in.
A barrel organ is a large machine that plays music when you turn the handle on the side. Barrel organs used to be played in the street to entertain people.
High explosive is an extremely powerful explosive substance.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (艺术或写作)自然主义的，写实主义的

ext.ext_cn: 这几幅画是最能体现他自然主义手法的作品。
ext.ext_en: These drawings are among his most naturalistic.

defs.def_en: Naturalistic art or writing tries to show people and things in a realistic way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 模仿自然的;根据自然的

ext.ext_cn: 需要在更自然的条件下进行进一步研究。
ext.ext_en: Further research is needed under rather more naturalistic conditions.

defs.def_en: Naturalistic means resembling something that exists or occurs in nature.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他过于骄矜自大，被虚荣心冲昏了头脑，根本不能接受他们对他的意见。
ext.ext_en: He was too puffed up with his own importance, too blinded by vanity to accept their verdict on him.

defs.def_en: See also:puffed;If you describe someone as puffed up, you disapprove of them because they are very proud of themselves and think that they are very important.

ext.ext_cn: 包装好的熟鸭和橙汁
ext.ext_en: ...pre-packaged duck and orange sauce.

defs.def_en: Pre-packaged foods have been prepared in advance and put in plastic or cardboard containers to be sold.

defs.def_cn: 金婚纪念（结婚50周年纪念）
defs.def_en: A golden wedding or a golden wedding anniversary is the 50th anniversary of a wedding.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自高自大的;目空一切的;傲慢的

ext.ext_cn: 他非常傲慢自大。
ext.ext_en: His manner is supercilious and arrogant...

ext.ext_cn: 大吃一惊的她高傲地扬起了眉毛。
ext.ext_en: Her eyebrows were arched in supercilious surprise.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is supercilious, you disapprove of them because they behave in a way that shows they think they are better than other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她指责他们泄露其私生活的秘密。
ext.ext_en: She accused them of leaking confidential information about her private life...

ext.ext_cn: 莱恩先生，我们会非常小心，对您告诉我们的事严格保密。
ext.ext_en: We'll take good care and keep what you've told us strictly confidential, Mr. Lane.

defs.def_en: Information that is confidential is meant to be kept secret or private.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: “听着，”他悄声说，“我想让你知道我和乔伊是警察。”
ext.ext_en: 'Look,' he said in a confidential tone, 'I want you to know that me and Joey are cops.'...

ext.ext_cn: 他脸上的神情突然严肃起来，声音也压低了。
ext.ext_en: His face suddenly turned solemn, his voice confidential.

defs.def_en: If you talk to someone in a confidential way, you talk to them quietly because what you are saying is secret or private.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 面庞小巧清秀的小男孩
ext.ext_en: ...a little boy with an elfin face.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as elfin, you think that they are attractive because they are small and have delicate features.

ext.ext_cn: 我们应要求每个学生都注射乙肝疫苗。
ext.ext_en: We should require that every student is immunized against hepatitis B...

ext.ext_cn: 这些猴子已经注射了由受感染的细胞培养而成的疫苗。
ext.ext_en: The monkeys had been immunized with a vaccine made from infected cells...

defs.def_en: If people or animals are immunized, they are made immune to a particular disease, often by being given an injection.

ext.ext_cn: 他对人权和公民自由事业的奉献
ext.ext_en: ...his commitment to human rights and civil liberties.

ext.ext_cn: 争取公民自由的活动家
ext.ext_en: ...civil liberty campaigners.

defs.def_en: A person's civil liberties are the rights they have to say, think, and do what they want as long as they respect other people's rights.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不真实的；怪异的；难以相信的

ext.ext_cn: 这不是真的，就像儿时的某个荒唐的噩梦一样。
ext.ext_en: It was unreal. Like some crazy childhood nightmare...

ext.ext_cn: 真不敢相信我们会这样谈论我们的儿子。
ext.ext_en: It felt so unreal to be talking about our son like this.

defs.def_en: If you say that a situation is unreal, you mean that it is so strange that you find it difficult to believe it is happening.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不切实际的理财目标
ext.ext_en: ...unreal financial targets...

ext.ext_cn: 几乎所有小说中的侦探都是虚构的。
ext.ext_en: Almost all fictional detectives are unreal.
