ext.ext_en: I spent a fruitless ten minutes walking up and down the high street, desperately avoiding eye contact with passers-by.

defs.def_en: If you make eye contact with someone, you look at them at the same time as they look at you, so that you are both aware that you are looking at each other. If you avoid eye contact with someone, you deliberately do not look straight at them because you feel awkward or embarrassed.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数政府肯定会索性对那个问题视而不见。
ext.ext_en: Most governments must simply be shutting their eyes to the problem.

defs.def_en: If you close your eyes to something bad or if you shut your eyes to it, you ignore it.
If you cry your eyes out, you cry very hard.

defs.def_cn: 以眼还眼;以牙还牙;一报还一报

ext.ext_cn: 非常简单的以眼还眼的惩罚法则
ext.ext_en: ...a very simple punishment code based on an-eye-for-an-eye.

defs.def_en: You say 'an eye for an eye' or 'an eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth' to refer to the idea that people should be punished according to the way in which they offended, for example if they hurt someone, they should be hurt equally badly in return.

ext.ext_cn: 在这里，巨大的沙丘向四面八方延绵不绝，一望无垠。
ext.ext_en: Here, massive dunes stretched in every direction as far as the eye could see...

ext.ext_cn: 放眼望去，除了松树还是松树。
ext.ext_en: There are pine trees as far as the eye can see.

defs.def_en: If there is something as far as the eye can see, there is a lot of it and you cannot see anything else beyond it.

ext.ext_cn: 苏珊对细节精益求精，所以每件衣裙都做得非常漂亮。
ext.ext_en: Susan has a keen eye for detail, so each dress is beautifully finished off.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has an eye for something, you mean that they are good at noticing it or making judgments about it.

ext.ext_cn: 在新政府看来，另一个严重问题是社群主义。
ext.ext_en: The other serious problem in the eyes of the new government is communalism...

ext.ext_cn: 在他们眼中，理查德·多林顿是个非常可靠的明白人。
ext.ext_en: Richard Dorrington was, in their eyes, a very sensible and reliable man...

defs.def_en: You use expressions such as in his eyes or to her eyes to indicate that you are reporting someone's opinion and that other people might think differently.

defs.def_cn: 留意;瞪大眼睛;密切注意

ext.ext_cn: 我让骑警瞪大眼睛。
ext.ext_en: I ask the mounted patrol to keep their eyes open...

ext.ext_cn: 你和你的朋友要留意——一有问题，我们就跑。
ext.ext_en: You and your friends keep an eye out—if there's any trouble we'll make a break for it.

defs.def_en: If you keep your eyes open or keep an eye out for someone or something, you watch for them carefully.
If you tell someone to keep their eyes peeled for something, you are telling them to watch very carefully for it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须密切关注所有的运营成本，这一点我想您肯定会赞同。
ext.ext_en: I'm sure you will appreciate that we must keep a careful eye on all our running costs...

ext.ext_cn: 我去那里跑步，期间一直留意着孩子们。
ext.ext_en: I went for a run there, keeping an eye on the children the whole time...

defs.def_en: If you keep an eye on something or someone, you watch them carefully, for example to make sure that they are satisfactory or safe, or not causing trouble.

defs.def_cn: 含情脉脉地看着；向…抛媚眼
defs.def_en: If you make eyes at someone, you look at them in a way which shows that you find them attractive and which is intended to get their attention.

ext.ext_cn: 整件事非常令人费解，远比看起来复杂。
ext.ext_en: This whole business is very puzzling. There is a lot more to it than meets the eye.

defs.def_en: You say 'there's more to this than meets the eye' when you think a situation is not as simple as it seems to be.

defs.def_cn: （尤指令人吃惊的或印象深刻的事情）映入…的眼帘，呈现在…眼前

ext.ext_cn: 赶到前门时，我第一眼看到的就是被大火吞没的教堂。
ext.ext_en: The first sight that met my eyes on reaching the front door was the church enveloped in flames.

defs.def_en: If something, especially something surprising or impressive, meets your eyes, you see it.

defs.def_cn: 所有目光都聚集在…上；所有人都在关注

ext.ext_cn: 所有目光都将聚集在明天的投票上。
ext.ext_en: All eyes will be on tomorrow's vote...

ext.ext_cn: 这时所有的目光都聚焦在警方。
ext.ext_en: The eyes of the world were now on the police.

defs.def_en: If you say that all eyes are on something or that the eyes of the world are on something, you mean that everyone is paying careful attention to it and what will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 那艘船缓慢驶入英国水域，沿英吉利海峡向北时，海关一直密切关注着它。
ext.ext_en: As the boat plodded into British waters and up the English Channel, Customs had their eye on her.

defs.def_en: If someone has their eye on you, they are watching you carefully to see what you do.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你在攒钱买一套你看中的新衣服
ext.ext_en: ...if you're saving up for a new outfit you've had your eye on.

defs.def_en: If you have your eye on something, you want to have it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们希望所有成员都能够负责地开始这次旅程，做到心中有数。
ext.ext_en: We want all our members to undertake this trip responsibly, with their eyes open.

defs.def_en: If you say that you did something with your eyes open or with your eyes wide open, you mean that you knew about the problems and difficulties that you were likely to have.

ext.ext_cn: 看着孩子探索她身边的世界能让你体会到早已忘记的快乐。
ext.ext_en: Watching your child explore the world about her can open your eyes to delights long forgotten.

defs.def_en: If something opens your eyes, it makes you aware that something is different from the way that you thought it was.

ext.ext_cn: 百合子和尤尔几乎在生产的每个方面都看法一致。
ext.ext_en: Yuriko saw eye to eye with Yul on almost every aspect of the production...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的看法从来就没有一致过。
ext.ext_en: We've never seen eye to eye.

defs.def_en: If you see eye to eye with someone, you agree with them and have the same opinions and views.

ext.ext_cn: 处于风口浪尖的那些投手不见了踪影。
ext.ext_en: The bowlers at the eye of the storm were nowhere in evidence.

ext.ext_cn: 备受指责的那位部长
ext.ext_en: ...the minister in the eye of the storm.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is at the eye of the storm, you mean they are the main subject of a public disagreement.

ext.ext_cn: 她把视线从公路上移开，扫了我一眼。
ext.ext_en: She took her eyes off the road to glance at me...

ext.ext_cn: 尼娜无法将她的视线从菲利普身上移开。
ext.ext_en: Nina couldn't take her eyes off Philip.

defs.def_en: When you take your eyes off the thing you have been watching or looking at, you stop looking at it.

ext.ext_cn: 她尽力从他的视角看问题。
ext.ext_en: She tried to see things through his eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 这个故事是从西蒙·波特巡官的视角讲述的。
ext.ext_en: The story is told through the eyes of Inspector Simon Potter.

defs.def_en: If someone sees or considers something through your eyes, they consider it in the way that you do, from your point of view.

defs.def_cn: 深陷于…中；（常指）忙得不可开交

ext.ext_cn: 我工作忙得不可开交。
ext.ext_en: I am up to my eyes in work...

ext.ext_cn: 那些女人债台高筑。
ext.ext_en: The women are just up to their eyes in debt.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are up to your eyes in something, you are emphasizing that you have a lot of it to deal with, and often that you are very busy.

ext.ext_cn: 他们将督促国际社会采取行动保护臭氧层。
ext.ext_en: They will press for international action to safeguard the ozone layer...

ext.ext_cn: 新宪法必须能保护少数群体的利益。
ext.ext_en: The interests of minorities will have to be safeguarded under a new constitution...

defs.def_en: To safeguard something or someone means to protect them from being harmed, lost, or badly treated.

defs.def_cn: 预防性条款(或法规);保障措施

ext.ext_cn: 许多人为防失业都干两份工作。
ext.ext_en: Many people took second jobs as a safeguard against unemployment...

ext.ext_cn: 我们这样的制度缺乏有效保护公民自由的条款。
ext.ext_en: A system like ours lacks adequate safeguards for civil liberties.

defs.def_en: A safeguard is a law, rule, or measure intended to prevent someone or something from being harmed.

defs.def_cn: 回头见,再见(主要用于短信或电子邮件)
defs.def_en: CYA is the written abbreviation for (书面缩略 =) 'see you', mainly used in text messages and e-mails.

ext.ext_cn: 当局征用旅馆房间安顿了3,000多名无处落脚的圣诞度假者。
ext.ext_en: Authorities requisitioned hotel rooms to lodge more than 3,000 stranded Christmas vacationers.

defs.def_en: If people in authority requisition a vehicle, building, or food, they formally demand it and take it for official use.

ext.ext_cn: 更换影印机的授权书
ext.ext_en: ...a requisition for a replacement photocopier.

defs.def_en: A requisition is a written document which allows a person or organization to obtain goods.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 棕榈泉有高档的餐厅和奢华的夜生活。
ext.ext_en: Palm Springs has ritzy restaurants and glitzy nightlife.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ritzy, you mean that it is fashionable or expensive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 爱打听的;好探问的;过于好奇的

ext.ext_cn: 巴罗天生就爱打听别人隐私。
ext.ext_en: Barrow had an inquisitive nature...

ext.ext_cn: 熊非常好奇,必须不断地给予其智力上的刺激。
ext.ext_en: Bears are very inquisitive and must be kept mentally stimulated.

defs.def_en: An inquisitive person likes finding out about things, especially secret things.

defs.def_cn: 预定的；预先确定的；预先决定的

ext.ext_cn: 从出生的那一刻起，王子的命运就已经被预先决定了。
ext.ext_en: The Prince's destiny was predetermined from the moment of his birth...

ext.ext_cn: 可以使这些胶囊在预定的时间释放杀虫剂。
ext.ext_en: The capsules can be made to release the pesticides at a predetermined time.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is predetermined, you mean that its form or nature was decided by previous events or by people rather than by chance.

defs.def_cn: （两个或两个以上的敌对大国之间的）缓冲国

ext.ext_cn: 土耳其和希腊是前苏联与反苏国家之间的缓冲国。
ext.ext_en: Turkey and Greece were buffer states against the former Soviet Union.

defs.def_en: A buffer state is a peaceful country situated between two or more larger hostile countries.

ext.ext_cn: 防弹玻璃
ext.ext_en: ...bullet-proof glass.

ext.ext_cn: 防弹背心
ext.ext_en: ...a bullet-proof vest.

defs.def_en: Something that is bullet-proof is made of a strong material that bullets cannot pass through.
Black pepper is pepper which is dark in colour and has been made from the dried berries of the pepper plant, including their black outer cases.

ext.ext_cn: （盒式)收放音机
ext.ext_en: ...a radio cassette player.

defs.def_en: A radio cassette is a radio and a cassette player together in a single machine.
A vending machine is a machine from which you can get things such as cigarettes, chocolate, or coffee by putting in money and pressing a button.

ext.ext_cn: 他们不是只同情地倾听，而是还时不时地插话进来：“如果我是你…”
ext.ext_en: They don't just listen sympathetically, they wade in with remarks like, 'If I were you...'...

ext.ext_cn: 我本想插进去帮忙，结果却被踢倒在地。
ext.ext_en: I waded in to help, but got kicked to the ground...

defs.def_en: If someone wades in or wades into something, they get involved in a very determined and forceful way, often without thinking enough about the consequences of their actions.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你试图控制他，让他什么都听你的，十有八九你们会吵架。
ext.ext_en: If you try to keep him under control and tethered to your apron strings there will almost certainly be a row.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你试图控制他，让他什么都听你的，十有八九你们会吵架。
ext.ext_en: If you try to keep him under control and tethered to your apron strings there will almost certainly be a row.

defs.def_en: An apron is a piece of clothing that you put on over the front of your normal clothes and tie round your waist, especially when you are cooking, in order to prevent your clothes from getting dirty.
At an airport, the apron is the area of hard ground where aircraft are parked.

ext.ext_cn: 休闲健身中心晚上9点关门。
ext.ext_en: The spa closes at 9:00 pm.

defs.def_en: p.m. is used after a number to show that you are referring to a particular time between 12 noon and 12 midnight.

ext.ext_cn: 一次严重跌伤使这位 68 岁的国会议员丧失了行动能力。
ext.ext_en: A serious fall incapacitated the 68-year-old congressman.

defs.def_en: If something incapacitates you, it weakens you in some way, so that you cannot do certain things.
A cuckoo is a bird that has a call of two quick notes, and lays its eggs in other birds' nests.
A video recorder or a video cassette recorder is the same as a VCR .

ext.ext_cn: 这些包的肩带可以调整。
ext.ext_en: The bags have adjustable shoulder straps...

ext.ext_cn: 座位可以全方位调节。
ext.ext_en: The seats are fully adjustable.

defs.def_en: If something is adjustable, it can be changed to different positions or sizes.

ext.ext_cn: 我想我永远都不会富有，但是我在工作上很有满足感。
ext.ext_en: I doubt I'll ever get rich, but I get job satisfaction.

defs.def_en: Job satisfaction is the pleasure that you get from doing your job.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 喋喋不休的；话多的；饶舌的

ext.ext_cn: 平常话多的奥赖利先生几乎没说什么。
ext.ext_en: The normally loquacious Mr O'Reilly has said little.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as loquacious, you mean that they talk a lot.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 国王似的；国王的；君主的

ext.ext_cn: 拥有国王般地位的贵族
ext.ext_en: ...a noble man, kingly in stature...

ext.ext_cn: 他们认为他应该继续履行君主的职责。
ext.ext_en: They thought that he should resume his kingly duties.

defs.def_en: Kingly means like a king, or related to the duties of a king.
Basil is a strong-smelling and strong-tasting herb that is used in cooking, especially with tomatoes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 感伤的;多情的;多愁善感的

ext.ext_cn: 我努力不让自己表现得感怀过去。
ext.ext_en: I'm trying not to be sentimental about the past...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一部十分煽情的戏。
ext.ext_en: It's a very sentimental play.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is sentimental feels or shows pity or love, sometimes to an extent that is considered exaggerated and foolish.

defs.def_cn: 情感(上)的;(尤指)(出于)怀旧的

ext.ext_cn: 我们的画作和照片仅有纪念价值。
ext.ext_en: Our paintings and photographs are of sentimental value only...

ext.ext_cn: 也许他是出于情感上的原因才回来的。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps he has returned for sentimental reasons.

defs.def_en: Sentimental means relating to or involving feelings such as pity or love, especially for things in the past.

defs.def_cn: 使振奋；使活跃；使更有趣；使更强大

ext.ext_cn: 首相发表了一些刺激本地区贸易的想法。
ext.ext_en: The prime minister aired some ideas about pepping up trade in the region...

ext.ext_cn: 在素色瓷砖上印制一些图案使其更吸引人如何？
ext.ext_en: How about pepping up plain tiles with transfers?

defs.def_en: If you try to pep something up, you try to make it more lively, more interesting, or stronger.

defs.def_cn: (用于制作饮料或药物的)聚合草
defs.def_en: Comfrey is a herb that is used to make drinks and medicines.
In banking, a company's pro forma balance or earnings are their expected balance or earnings.

defs.def_cn: 澳大利亚的;澳大利亚人的;澳大利亚文化的

ext.ext_cn: 她独自在澳大利亚内陆地区进行了8个月的徒步旅行。
ext.ext_en: She went solo backpacking for eight months in the Australian outback.

defs.def_en: Something that is Australian belongs or relates to Australia, or to its people or culture.
An Australian is someone who comes from Australia.

ext.ext_cn: 他骗得默瑟认了输。
ext.ext_en: He bamboozled Mercer into defeat...

ext.ext_cn: 他被骗子骗了。
ext.ext_en: He was bamboozled by con men.

defs.def_en: To bamboozle someone means to confuse them greatly and often trick them.

defs.def_cn: （与副词连用构成形容词）表示“具有…能力（做）的”

ext.ext_cn: 作为刑事司法皇家专门调查委员会的成员，拉弗蒂小姐发表评论恰如其分。
ext.ext_en: A member of the Royal Commission on Criminal Justice, Miss Rafferty is well-placed to comment...

ext.ext_cn: 我想他认为你所处的位置使你比大多数人都更了解真相。
ext.ext_en: I imagine he thought you were better-placed than most to know the truth...

defs.def_en: -placed combines with adverbs to form adjectives which describe how well or badly someone is able to do a particular task.

defs.def_cn: （与副词连用构成形容词）表示“位置…的”

ext.ext_cn: 这家宾馆的位置极佳，离市中心步行只需1分钟。
ext.ext_en: The hotel is wonderfully placed only a minute's walk from the city centre...

ext.ext_cn: 芝加哥所处的位置是乘火车了解美国的最佳之处。
ext.ext_en: Chicago is perfectly-placed for exploring the US by rail...

defs.def_en: -placed combines with adverbs to form adjectives which indicate how good or bad the position of a building or area is considered to be.

ext.ext_cn: 德国是西方富裕国家中给予援助最多的国家。
ext.ext_en: Germany is the largest giver of aid among the wealthy countries of the West.

ext.ext_cn: 关于捐赠者与受援者的复杂的社会礼仪
ext.ext_en: ...a complex social ritual that says a lot about both the giver and the receiver.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a person or organization that gives or supplies a particular thing as a giver of that thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不负责任的;无责任感的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为鼓吹毒品合法化是不负责任的行为。
ext.ext_en: I felt that it was irresponsible to advocate the legalisation of drugs...

ext.ext_cn: 若我不建议公司放弃这个项目，那我就是不负责任。
ext.ext_en: It would be irresponsible of me not to advise my company to abandon this project...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as irresponsible, you are criticizing them because they do things without properly considering their possible consequences.

defs.def_cn: (使）(死去的动植物)腐烂;（使）分解

ext.ext_cn: 在树林里发现的一具正在腐烂的尸体
ext.ext_en: ...a dead body found decomposing in a wood...

ext.ext_cn: 这些垃圾慢慢地分解成了堆肥。
ext.ext_en: The debris slowly decomposes into compost...

defs.def_en: When things such as dead plants or animals decompose, or when something decomposes them, they change chemically and begin to decay.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 穿过该镇狭窄的街道
ext.ext_en: ...through the town's narrow streets...

ext.ext_cn: 她的双脚瘦长。
ext.ext_en: She had long, narrow feet.

defs.def_en: Something that is narrow measures a very small distance from one side to the other, especially compared to its length or height.

ext.ext_cn: 宽宽的小径在穿过另一条小溪前逐渐收窄。
ext.ext_en: The wide track narrows before crossing another stream.

defs.def_en: If something narrows, it becomes less wide.

ext.ext_cn: 科金斯气得眯起眼睛。“你认为我会告诉你？”
ext.ext_en: Coggins' eyes narrowed angrily. 'You think I'd tell you?'...

ext.ext_cn: 他停下来，眯起眼睛专注地看着。
ext.ext_en: He paused and narrowed his eyes in concentration.

defs.def_en: If your eyes narrow or if you narrow your eyes, you almost close them, for example because you are angry or because you are trying to concentrate on something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (想法、态度或信仰)狭隘的，有局限的

ext.ext_cn: 对家庭生活狭隘过时的看法
ext.ext_en: ...a narrow and outdated view of family life...

ext.ext_cn: 我会更倾向于一个思路开阔些的人，他的想法太狭隘了。
ext.ext_en: I would have preferred somebody who had wider ideas, and he was rather narrow.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's ideas, attitudes, or beliefs as narrow, you disapprove of them because they are restricted in some way, and often ignore the more important aspects of an argument or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 最新的民意测验显示这两大主要政党之间的差距已经缩小了。
ext.ext_en: Most recent opinion polls suggest that the gap between the two main parties has narrowed...

ext.ext_cn: 关于联邦政府在反毒品项目上的支出问题，参议院的谈判代表们进一步缩小了分歧。
ext.ext_en: Senate negotiators further narrowed their differences over the level of federal spending for anti-drug programs.

defs.def_en: If something narrows or if you narrow it, its extent or range becomes smaller.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (胜利)勉强的;(胜负)差距微弱的;险胜的

ext.ext_cn: 代表们投票表决，以微弱多数票赞同考虑选举制度的改革。
ext.ext_en: Delegates have voted by a narrow majority in favour of considering electoral reform.

defs.def_en: If you have a narrow victory, you succeed in winning but only by a small amount.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 分裂主义者袭击他们的车辆时，两名警官死里逃生。
ext.ext_en: Two police officers had a narrow escape when separatists attacked their vehicles.

defs.def_en: If you have a narrow escape, something unpleasant nearly happens to you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （情形）没有希望的，前景暗淡的

ext.ext_cn: 近期前景依然暗淡。
ext.ext_en: The immediate outlook remains bleak...

ext.ext_cn: 很多人都预测前景暗淡。
ext.ext_en: Many predicted a bleak future.

defs.def_en: If a situation is bleak, it is bad, and seems unlikely to improve.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这座岛屿一片荒凉。
ext.ext_en: The island's pretty bleak.

ext.ext_cn: 凄清的旧城区街道
ext.ext_en: ...bleak inner-city streets.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as bleak, you mean that it looks cold, empty, and unattractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 沿海地区的天气会非常阴冷。
ext.ext_en: The weather can be quite bleak on the coast.

defs.def_en: When the weather is bleak, it is cold, dull, and unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人）无精打采的，沮丧的，阴郁的

ext.ext_cn: 他脸色阴郁。
ext.ext_en: His face was bleak...

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔伯格沮丧地凝视着他。
ext.ext_en: Alberg gave him a bleak stare.

defs.def_en: If someone looks or sounds bleak, they look or sound depressed, as if they have no hope or energy.

ext.ext_cn: 顾客们已充分了解这些好处吗？
ext.ext_en: Have customers been fully apprised of the advantages?...

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须告诉他们可能涉及的危险。
ext.ext_en: We must apprise them of the dangers that may be involved.

defs.def_en: When you are apprised of something, someone tells you about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在一家小餐馆歇脚，吃了顿干酪火锅。
ext.ext_en: They stopped at a little cafe and had a fondue.

defs.def_en: A fondue is a sauce made from melted cheese into which you dip bread, or a pot of hot oil into which you dip pieces of meat or vegetables.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 日本的相机制造商不断推出最新的电子模型。
ext.ext_en: Japanese camera makers continually introduce whizzy new electronic models.

defs.def_en: Whizzy is used to describe products and activities that are new, exciting, and based on the latest technology.

defs.def_cn: 安瓿（装注射药液的小玻璃瓶，缩略形式为amp）
defs.def_en: An ampoule is a small container, usually made of glass, that contains a drug which will be injected into someone. The abbreviation amp is also used.

ext.ext_cn: 有熏鲑鱼的丰盛午餐
ext.ext_en: ... a splendid lunch of smoked salmon.

ext.ext_cn: 有熏鲑鱼的丰盛午餐
ext.ext_en: ... a splendid lunch of smoked salmon.

defs.def_en: A salmon is a large silver-coloured fish.

ext.ext_cn: 只消片刻你就会见到他。
ext.ext_en: You shall see him anon.

defs.def_en: Anon means quite soon.

ext.ext_cn: 英国谈判代表已经担保由此而签订的条约将是方向上的重大改变。
ext.ext_en: Britain's negotiators had ensured that the treaty which resulted was a significant change in direction...

ext.ext_cn: 确保把这一点写入合同中。
ext.ext_en: Ensure that it is written into your contract.

defs.def_en: To ensure something, or to ensure that something happens, means to make certain that it happens.

ext.ext_cn: “弗兰克怎么样了？”他问道。
ext.ext_en: 'How is Frank?' he asked...

ext.ext_cn: 我询问了他的名字。
ext.ext_en: I asked him his name...

defs.def_en: If you ask someone something, you say something to them in the form of a question because you want to know the answer.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不得不要求他离开。
ext.ext_en: We had to ask him to leave...

ext.ext_cn: 她说有个名叫肖恩的男人要她带两个手提箱去非洲。
ext.ext_en: She said she had been asked to take two suitcases to Africa by a man called Sean.

defs.def_en: If you ask someone to do something, you tell them that you want them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我要求见主任。
ext.ext_en: I asked to see the Director.

defs.def_en: If you ask to do something, you tell someone that you want to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我决定去隔壁那家要点吃的。
ext.ext_en: I decided to go to the next house and ask for food...

ext.ext_cn: 谁问你的意见了？
ext.ext_en: Who asked for your opinion?

defs.def_en: If you ask for something, you say that you would like it.

ext.ext_cn: 门口有个人想见你。
ext.ext_en: There's a man at the gate asking for you.

defs.def_en: If you ask for someone, you say that you would like to speak to them.

defs.def_cn: 请求，征求（许可、意见、谅解）

ext.ext_cn: 打电话前请先征得话费支付方的同意。
ext.ext_en: Please ask permission from whoever pays the phone bill before making your call.

defs.def_en: If you ask someone's permission, opinion, or forgiveness, you try to obtain it by putting a request to them.

ext.ext_cn: 你不能邀请乔恩参加聚会吗？
ext.ext_en: Couldn't you ask Jon to the party?...

ext.ext_cn: 她又邀请我去了她家。
ext.ext_en: She asked me back to her house.

defs.def_en: If you ask someone to an event or place, you invite them to go there.

ext.ext_cn: 潘特莱拉斯先生为他的藏品要价6,000英镑。
ext.ext_en: Mr Pantelaras was asking £6,000 for his collection.

defs.def_en: If someone is asking a particular price for something, they are selling it for that price.

defs.def_cn: （通常用于表示对询问感到恼怒或惊讶）不要问我

ext.ext_cn: “她还有别的心事，你不觉得吗？”“别问我，”克里斯嘀咕道，“我从未见过她。”
ext.ext_en: 'She's got other things on her mind, wouldn't you think?' 'Don't ask me,' murmured Chris. 'I've never met her.'

defs.def_en: You reply 'don't ask me' when you do not know the answer to a question, usually when you are annoyed or surprised that you have been asked.

defs.def_cn: 只要开口（便可得到）；唾手可得

ext.ext_cn: 他知道只要他开口就能得到那项提名。
ext.ext_en: He knew the nomination was his for the asking.

defs.def_en: If something is yours for the asking, you could get it very easily if you wanted to.

defs.def_cn: （强调反对）请问，真是，这还了得

ext.ext_cn: 那个老蠢货。我倒要问一问，她以为她是谁呀？
ext.ext_en: That silly old bat. I ask you, who'd she think she was?

defs.def_en: If you say 'I ask you', you are emphasizing how much you disapprove of someone or something.

defs.def_cn: （一种正式的询问方式，表示感到困扰或心生疑虑）请问

ext.ext_cn: 先生，请问您要去哪？
ext.ext_en: May I ask where you're going, sir?

defs.def_en: You can say 'may I ask' as a formal way of asking a question, which shows you are annoyed or suspicious about something.

ext.ext_cn: 要我说的话，他是个疯子。
ext.ext_en: He was nuts, if you ask me.

defs.def_en: You can say 'if you ask me' to emphasize that you are stating your personal opinion.

ext.ext_cn: 都劝说得这么明白了还要继续比赛，这简直就是自讨苦吃。
ext.ext_en: To go ahead with the match after such clear advice had been asking for trouble.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is asking for trouble or is asking for it, you mean that they are behaving in a way that makes it very likely that they will get into trouble.

defs.def_cn: (组织机构的)负责人，头儿，首领

ext.ext_cn: 警察局局长任命的委员会
ext.ext_en: ...a commission appointed by the police chief.

ext.ext_cn: 普金的安全部长
ext.ext_en: ...Putin's chief of security.

defs.def_en: The chief of an organization is the person who is in charge of it.

ext.ext_cn: 坐牛，大平原地区苏人部族的酋长
ext.ext_en: ...Sitting Bull, chief of the Sioux tribes of the Great Plains.

defs.def_en: The chief of a tribe is its leader.

defs.def_cn: (用于职位头衔)主管的，首席的

ext.ext_cn: 首席试飞员
ext.ext_en: ...the chief test pilot.

defs.def_en: Chief is used in the job titles of the most senior worker or workers of a particular kind in an organization.

ext.ext_cn: 经济压力被确认是导致离婚的首要原因。
ext.ext_en: Financial stress is well established as a chief reason for divorce...

ext.ext_cn: 那份工作被他的一个主要对手抢去了。
ext.ext_en: The job went to one of his chief rivals.

defs.def_en: The chief cause, part, or member of something is the most important one.

ext.ext_cn: 她把他们俩的杯子倒空，烧上了电水壶。
ext.ext_en: She emptied both their mugs and switched on the electric kettle...

ext.ext_cn: 他把灯对准自己的脚，试图打开它。
ext.ext_en: He pointed the light at his feet and tried to switch it on.

defs.def_en: If you switch on a light or other electrical device, you make it start working by operating a switch.

defs.def_cn: 级别（或地位）高的;高级的;显要的

ext.ext_cn: 医疗队里的高级军官
ext.ext_en: ...a high-ranking officer in the medical corps.

defs.def_en: A high-ranking person has an important position in a particular organization.

ext.ext_cn: 国会周围的一些大楼今天还在冒烟。
ext.ext_en: A number of buildings around the Parliament were still smouldering today...

ext.ext_cn: 整座整座的街区都变成了一堆冒着青烟的瓦砾。
ext.ext_en: Whole blocks had been turned into smouldering rubble.

defs.def_en: If something smoulders, it burns slowly, producing smoke but not flames.

ext.ext_cn: 巴克斯特开车回家吃午饭的路上，心里一直憋着一团火。
ext.ext_en: Baxter smouldered as he drove home for lunch...

ext.ext_cn: 许多人的心里都在愤愤不平。
ext.ext_en: That's a lot of people smouldering with resentment...

defs.def_en: If a feeling such as anger or hatred smoulders inside you, you continue to feel it but do not show it.

ext.ext_cn: 梅拉妮·格里菲思显得很性感。
ext.ext_en: Melanie Griffith seems to smoulder with sexuality...

ext.ext_cn: 他那双性感迷人的黑眼睛一直盯着她的面庞。
ext.ext_en: His darkly smouldering eyes never left her face.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone smoulders, you mean that they are sexually attractive, usually in a mysterious or very intense way.

defs.def_cn: (两院制议会的)上议院;(英国)贵族院;(美国)参议院,众议院
defs.def_en: The second chamber is one of the two groups that a parliament is divided into. In Britain, the second chamber is the House of Lords. In the United States, the second chamber can be either the Senate or the House of Representatives.

ext.ext_cn: 我们可能会去萨利纳斯的一家餐馆吃饭，然后去看场电影——算作庆祝，你知道吧。
ext.ext_en: We might go into Salinas for dinner at a restaurant, and then to a picture show — to celebrate, you see.

ext.ext_cn: 《洛基恐怖秀》
ext.ext_en: ...The Rocky Horror Picture Show.

defs.def_en: A picture show is a film or cinema.

ext.ext_cn: 他的智商只有 77。
ext.ext_en: He possesses an IQ of only 77...

ext.ext_cn: 他的智商属于中等以上。
ext.ext_en: His IQ is above average.

defs.def_en: Your IQ is your level of intelligence, as indicated by a special test that you do. IQ is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'intelligence quotient'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （衣服、颜色、发型等）合适的，相配的，好看的

ext.ext_cn: 软面料要比硬面料合身得多。
ext.ext_en: Softer fabrics are much more becoming than stiffer ones.

defs.def_en: A piece of clothing, a colour, or a hairstyle that is becoming makes the person who is wearing it look attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这种行为对于我们的政治家和选民来说都不合适。
ext.ext_en: This behaviour is not any more becoming among our politicians than it is among our voters.

defs.def_en: Behaviour that is becoming is appropriate and proper in the circumstances.

defs.def_cn: 锋利的；锐利的；如刀锋般的

ext.ext_cn: 锋利的屠刀
ext.ext_en: ...a razor sharp butcher's knife.

ext.ext_cn: 锋利的牙齿
ext.ext_en: ...razor-sharp teeth.

defs.def_en: A cutting tool that is razor-sharp is extremely sharp.

defs.def_cn: （思路或头脑）敏捷的，反应快的

ext.ext_cn: 他敏捷的才智
ext.ext_en: ...his razor-sharp intelligence.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or someone's mind as razor-sharp, you mean that they have a very accurate and clear understanding of things.

ext.ext_cn: 在田里发现了她的尸体，全身赤裸，裹在一条床单里。
ext.ext_en: Her naked body was found wrapped in a sheet in a field...

ext.ext_cn: 烫人的铺路石灼烤着我的一双赤脚。
ext.ext_en: The hot paving stones scorched my naked feet...

defs.def_en: Someone who is naked is not wearing any clothes.

defs.def_cn: (动物)没有皮毛的，没有羽毛的

ext.ext_cn: 窝里有8只还没长毛、眼睛尚未睁开的小老鼠。
ext.ext_en: The nest contained eight little mice that were naked and blind.

defs.def_en: If an animal or part of an animal is naked, it has no fur or feathers on it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果报道属实，此交易的确使当局和总统猝不及防。
ext.ext_en: If the reports are accurate, the deal leaves the authorities and the President virtually naked.

ext.ext_cn: 贝文“不要毫无准备地走进会议室”的呼吁
ext.ext_en: ...Bevan's appeal against going 'naked into the conference chamber'.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is naked or feels naked, you mean they are powerless or have no way of protecting themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 空荡荡的房间里吊着的一只没有灯罩的灯泡
ext.ext_en: ...a naked bulb dangling in a bare room...

ext.ext_cn: 水是用燃气明火加热的。
ext.ext_en: The water was heated by a naked gas flame.

defs.def_en: You can describe an object as naked when it does not have its normal covering.

ext.ext_cn: 那位女士一脸毫不掩饰的憎恨让我震惊。
ext.ext_en: The naked hatred in the woman's face shocked me...

ext.ext_cn: 她说起那封信时，声音里流露出明显的痛苦。
ext.ext_en: There had been naked misery in her voice when she'd  spoken about the letter.

defs.def_en: Naked emotions are easy to recognize, because they are very strongly felt.

ext.ext_cn: 公然的侵略和企图用武力改变边界的行径是不能置之不理的。
ext.ext_en: Naked aggression and an attempt to change frontiers by force could not go unchallenged.

ext.ext_cn: 暴力以及对权力赤裸裸的追求
ext.ext_en: ...violence and the naked pursuit of power.

defs.def_en: You can use naked to describe unpleasant or violent actions and behaviour which are not disguised or hidden in any way.

ext.ext_cn: 这些虫子用肉眼看不见。
ext.ext_en: The worms cannot be seen by the naked eye...

ext.ext_cn: 整周都可以用肉眼观察到火星。
ext.ext_en: The planet Mars will be visible to the naked eye all week...

defs.def_en: If you say that something cannot be seen by the naked eye, you mean that it cannot be seen without the help of equipment such as a telescope or microscope.

ext.ext_cn: 大家操着不同的语言喋喋不休地说着。
ext.ext_en: Everyone's chattering away in different languages...

ext.ext_cn: 埃丽卡很和气，不停地念叨着安德鲁的孩子们。
ext.ext_en: Erica was friendly and chattered about Andrew's children...

defs.def_en: If you chatter, you talk quickly and continuously, usually about things which are not important.

ext.ext_cn: 她冻得牙齿咯咯响。
ext.ext_en: She was so cold her teeth chattered.

defs.def_en: If your teeth chatter, they keep knocking together because you are very cold or very nervous.

ext.ext_cn: 电传机没日没夜“嗒嗒嗒”地接收新闻稿。
ext.ext_en: The telex chattered all day and night with news bulletins.

ext.ext_cn: 升降椅的缆绳在滑轮上发出的咯吱声盖过其他一切声响的群山
ext.ext_en: ...the mountains where the chatter of the chairlift cable over the pulley wheel is the loudest noise.

defs.def_en: If objects chatter, they make short repeated sounds.

defs.def_cn: (鸟)鸣叫，啁啾;(动物)唧唧叫，吱吱叫

ext.ext_cn: 鸟儿在某处唧唧喳喳地叫着。
ext.ext_en: Birds were chattering  somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 伴随蟋蟀的叫声颤动的杏树
ext.ext_en: ...almond trees vibrating with the chatter of crickets.

defs.def_en: When birds or animals chatter, they make high-pitched noises.

ext.ext_cn: 与其他数百个法国小镇不同的是它拥有巨大的工厂。
ext.ext_en: What sets it apart from hundreds of similar small French towns is the huge factory...

ext.ext_cn: 李完全融入到这群青少年当中，只有他的口音跟他们不一样。
ext.ext_en: Li blends right into the crowd of teenagers. Only his accent sets him apart.

defs.def_en: If a characteristic sets you apart from other people, it makes you different from the others in a noticeable way.

ext.ext_cn: 懂得如何做出佳肴并如何上菜的人
ext.ext_en: ...a man who knows what constitutes decent tucker and how to go about serving it up.

defs.def_en: Tucker is food.

defs.def_cn: 恋母情结；俄狄浦斯情结
defs.def_en: If a boy or man has an Oedipus complex, he feels sexual desire for his mother and has hostile feelings towards his father.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 暖人心房的;使人愉快的

ext.ext_cn: 敌对双方发现了共通人性的感人故事
ext.ext_en: ...the heart-warming story of enemies who discover a shared humanity.

defs.def_en: Something that is heart-warming causes you to feel happy, usually because something nice has happened to people.

ext.ext_cn: 他们默不作声地站着。
ext.ext_en: They stood in silence...

ext.ext_cn: 他从不会让晚餐时出现长时间的沉默。
ext.ext_en: He never lets those long silences develop during dinner...

defs.def_en: If there is silence, nobody is speaking.

ext.ext_cn: 滴雨未下、隐藏一切的大雾静默无声
ext.ext_en: ...the silence of that rainless, all-concealing fog...

ext.ext_cn: 她深深地吸了口气，细细品味着这宁静。
ext.ext_en: She breathed deeply, savouring the silence.

defs.def_en: The silence of a place is the extreme quietness there.

defs.def_cn: 缄默;绝口不提;闭口不谈

ext.ext_cn: 区法院裁定今天波珀在法庭上的缄默将被视作是进行无罪抗辩。
ext.ext_en: The district court ruled that Popper's silence in court today should be entered as a plea of not guilty.

ext.ext_cn: 加里决定对儿子遭受的痛苦不再保持沉默，以期望能帮助其他家庭。
ext.ext_en: Gary decided to break his silence about his son's suffering in the hope of helping other families.

defs.def_en: Someone's silence about something is their failure or refusal to speak to other people about it.

defs.def_cn: 使安静;使无声;使不说话

ext.ext_cn: 响起的电话铃声让她安静了下来。
ext.ext_en: A ringing phone silenced her...

ext.ext_cn: 他惊得哑口无言。
ext.ext_en: The shock silenced him completely.

defs.def_en: To silence someone or something means to stop them speaking or making a noise.

defs.def_cn: 制止，使不再发表(反对意见)

ext.ext_cn: 像其他暴君一样，他力图压制任何公开反对他的人。
ext.ext_en: Like other tyrants, he tried to silence anyone who spoke out against him.

ext.ext_cn: 政府试图压制争论但未果
ext.ext_en: ...an unsuccessful attempt by the government to silence the debate.

defs.def_en: If someone silences you, they stop you expressing opinions that they do not agree with.

ext.ext_cn: 为了掩盖这件事，已经派出一名职业杀手去杀她灭口。
ext.ext_en: A hit man had been sent to silence her over the affair.

defs.def_en: To silence someone means to kill them in order to stop them revealing something secret.

ext.ext_cn: 从霍西到大雅茅斯和曼斯利的距离相等。
ext.ext_en: Horsey is equidistant from Great Yarmouth and Mundesley.

defs.def_en: A place that is equidistant from two other places is the same distance away from each of these places.

ext.ext_cn: 在禁区边缘他两次将球踢飞。
ext.ext_en: He miskicked the ball twice at the edge of the penalty box...

ext.ext_cn: 由于失去重心，他脚头完全没有了准星。
ext.ext_en: He miskicked completely as he lost his footing.

defs.def_en: To miskick the ball in a game such as football means to kick it badly so that it does not go in the direction you want it to.

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫承认有婚外情。
ext.ext_en: Her husband has admitted having an extra-marital affair.

ext.ext_cn: 婚外情关系
ext.ext_en: ...an extra-marital relationship.

defs.def_en: An extra-marital affair is a sexual relationship between a married person and another person who is not their husband or wife.

defs.def_cn: (建筑物在天空映衬下的)轮廓线,天际线

ext.ext_cn: 乡村教堂在天空映衬下的轮廓非常醒目。
ext.ext_en: The village church dominates the skyline.

defs.def_en: The skyline is the line or shape that is formed where the sky meets buildings or the land.

ext.ext_cn: 世界会变得不同，我们必须做好准备以适应其变化。

ext.ext_en: ...the modest home of a family who lived off the land...

ext.ext_cn: 在普通的旅店里过一夜要花费约35英镑。
ext.ext_en: A one-night stay in a modest hotel costs around £35.

defs.def_en: A modest house or other building is not large or expensive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (数量、比率或改进程度)不太高的，适度的，适中的

ext.ext_cn: 瑞士的失业率上升到了0.7%，这个百分比仍然不算太高。
ext.ext_en: Swiss unemployment rose to the still modest rate of 0.7%...

ext.ext_cn: 民主改革的力度并不太大。
ext.ext_en: The democratic reforms have been modest...

defs.def_en: You use modest to describe something such as an amount, rate, or improvement which is fairly small.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是一名谦虚而伟大的运动员。
ext.ext_en: He's modest, as well as being a great player...

ext.ext_cn: 卡林顿勋爵对自己取得的成绩非常谦虚。
ext.ext_en: Lord Carrington is modest about his achievements.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is modest, you approve of them because they do not talk much about their abilities or achievements.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (女性或其衣着)端庄的，保守的;(行为)正派的，检点的

ext.ext_cn: 亚洲女性表现得更为端庄腼腆，却往往外柔内刚。
ext.ext_en: Asian women are more modest and shy, yet they tend to have an inner force...

ext.ext_cn: 要尊重当地的礼节。朴素端庄的衣着往往比暴露的短裤和紧身上衣更合适。
ext.ext_en: Respect the local etiquete. Modest clothing is often preferable to revealing shorts and tight-fitting tops.

defs.def_en: You can describe a woman as modest when she avoids doing or wearing anything that might cause men to have sexual feelings towards her. You can also describe her clothes or behaviour as modest .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人兴奋的；激动人心的；壮观的

ext.ext_cn: 这所房子的每个房间都能看到令人惊叹的美景。
ext.ext_en: The house has breathtaking views from every room...

ext.ext_cn: 他们踢的一些比赛非常精彩，极具观赏性。
ext.ext_en: Some of their football was breathtaking, a delight to watch...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is breathtaking, you are emphasizing that it  is extremely beautiful or amazing.

ext.ext_cn: 镇上已停水断电。
ext.ext_en: The town is without electricity and the water supply has been cut off.

defs.def_en: The water supply in an area is the water which is collected and passed through pipes to buildings for people to use.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他看起来很悲伤，几乎要流泪了。
ext.ext_en: He looked mournful, even near to tears...

ext.ext_cn: 迪克曼小姐个子高高的，看上去有些苦相。
ext.ext_en: Miss Dickerman was tall and somewhat mournful-looking.

defs.def_en: If you are mournful, you are very sad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 风笛凄厉的哀诉声
ext.ext_en: ...the mournful wail of bagpipes.

defs.def_en: A mournful sound seems very sad.

ext.ext_cn: 韦纳就职于美国交通部。
ext.ext_en: Weiner works for the US Department of Transport...

ext.ext_cn: 我开始在一个录音棚工作。
ext.ext_en: I started working in a recording studio...

defs.def_en: People who work have a job, usually one which they are paid to do.

ext.ext_cn: 就业人数越来越少。
ext.ext_en: Fewer and fewer people are in work...

ext.ext_cn: 那时我失业了。
ext.ext_en: I was out of work at the time...

defs.def_en: People who have work or who are in work have a job, usually one which they are paid to do.

ext.ext_cn: 这会儿我不能跟你说话——我在干活儿。
ext.ext_en: I can't talk to you right now—I'm working...

ext.ext_cn: 他正在桌前用功。
ext.ext_en: He was working at his desk...

defs.def_en: When you work, you do the things that you are paid or required to do in your job.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在这里应该是要经营公司。我有一堆的事情要做。
ext.ext_en: We're supposed to be running a business here. I've got work to do...

ext.ext_cn: 我过去常把活儿带回家干，不过我如今再也不这么做了。
ext.ext_en: I used to take work home, but I don't do it any more...

defs.def_en: Your work consists of the things you are paid or required to do in your job.

ext.ext_cn: 琳达把所有时间都花在打理花园上。
ext.ext_en: Linda spends all her time working on the garden...

ext.ext_cn: 我正在写信，电话铃响了。
ext.ext_en: While I was working on my letter the telephone rang...

defs.def_en: When you work, you spend time and effort doing a task that needs to be done or trying to achieve something.

ext.ext_cn: 很多人开车去上班。
ext.ext_en: Many people travel to work by car...

ext.ext_cn: 她跟单位的朋友说她在努力减肥。
ext.ext_en: She told her friends at work that she was trying to lose weight.

defs.def_en: Work is the place where you do your job.

ext.ext_cn: 让客观公正的第三方看一下你的成果会有助益。
ext.ext_en: It can help to have an impartial third party look over your work...

ext.ext_cn: 工作间干净整洁对于生产出好的产品非常重要。
ext.ext_en: Tidiness in the workshop is really essential for producing good work...

defs.def_en: Work is something which you produce as a result of an activity or as a result of doing your job.

defs.def_cn: (艺术家、作家、作曲家等的)作品；著作

ext.ext_cn: 我认为这是伦勃朗最伟大的作品。
ext.ext_en: In my opinion, this is Rembrandt's greatest work...

ext.ext_cn: 他胳膊底下夹着一本书，看上去就像是夹了《莎士比亚全集》。
ext.ext_en: Under his arm, there was a book which looked like the complete works of Shakespeare...

defs.def_en: A work is something such as a painting, book, or piece of music produced by an artist, writer, or composer.

ext.ext_cn: 邦尼特教授多年来一直在从事这种分子的研究工作。
ext.ext_en: Professor Bonnet has been working for many years on molecules of this type.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的研究表明，如果父母中有一人吸烟，一岁婴儿患过敏的可能性就会大大增加。
ext.ext_en: Their work shows that one-year-olds are much more likely to have allergies if either parent smokes.

defs.def_en: If someone is working on a particular subject or question, they are studying or researching it.

ext.ext_cn: 她有一段时间曾帮助垂危的癌症患者。
ext.ext_en: She spent a period of time working with people dying of cancer...

ext.ext_cn: 他那时明白了自己想帮助穷人。
ext.ext_en: He knew then that he wanted to work among the poor.

defs.def_en: If you work with a person or a group of people, you spend time and effort trying to help them in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 水泵坏了，我们没有自来水了。
ext.ext_en: The pump doesn't work and we have no running water...

ext.ext_cn: 电话今天能用吗？
ext.ext_en: Is the telephone working today?...

defs.def_en: If a machine or piece of equipment works, it operates and performs a particular function.

ext.ext_cn: 这些节食方法95%都不起作用。
ext.ext_en: 95 per cent of these diets do not work...

ext.ext_cn: 如果肉欲是你们在一起的唯一理由，这种关系是不会持久的。
ext.ext_en: If lust is all there is to hold you together, the relationship will never work...

defs.def_en: If an idea, system, or way of doing something works, it is successful, effective, or satisfactory.

ext.ext_cn: 安眠药的药效不会超过9个小时，所以我清晨6点就醒了。
ext.ext_en: I wake at 6 am as the sleeping pill doesn't work for more than nine hours...

ext.ext_cn: 这种药物通过提高大脑中血清素的含量来产生疗效。
ext.ext_en: The drug works by increasing levels of serotonin in the brain.

defs.def_en: If a drug or medicine works, it produces a particular physical effect.

defs.def_cn: 产生(有利或不利的)影响

ext.ext_cn: 据认为，一个帮上了他的因素就是他的工人阶级形象。
ext.ext_en: One factor thought to have worked in his favour is his working class image...

ext.ext_cn: 这显然会对孩子不利。
ext.ext_en: This obviously works against the interests of the child.

defs.def_en: If something works in your favour, it helps you in some way. If something works to your disadvantage, it causes problems for you in some way.

defs.def_cn: 对…产生(神奇的影响);使…深受（魅力感染）

ext.ext_cn: 虽然如此，她总是乐观地抱持希望，并能深深地感染那些心灰意冷的人。
ext.ext_en: Nevertheless, she is always optimistic about the possibilities and can work her charm on the disenchanted...

ext.ext_cn: 苦中带甜的酒发挥了奇效，我们的精神随之振奋起来。
ext.ext_en: Our spirits rallied as the bitter-sweet alcohol worked its magic.

defs.def_en: If something or someone works their magic or works their charms on a person, they have a powerful positive effect on them.

ext.ext_cn: 我的大脑疯狂地运转，把那晚发生的事情飞快地一幕幕重演。
ext.ext_en: My mind was working frantically, running over the events of the evening.

defs.def_en: If your mind or brain is working, you are thinking about something or trying to solve a problem.

defs.def_cn: 以(某种假定或思想)为基础(或前提)

ext.ext_cn: 我们假设这是一场燃气爆炸事故。
ext.ext_en: We are working on the assumption that it was a gas explosion.

defs.def_en: If you work on an assumption or idea, you act as if it were true or base other ideas on it, until you have more information.

defs.def_cn: 在(某地或某类场所)工作;在…奔波

ext.ext_cn: 布兰德自1986年以来一直在俱乐部和酒吧表演，提高她的喜剧演技。
ext.ext_en: Brand has been working the clubs and the pubs since 1986, developing her comedy act...

ext.ext_cn: 这是他在曼哈顿街头献艺的第7个年头。
ext.ext_en: This is the seventh year that he has worked the streets of Manhattan.

defs.def_en: If you work a particular area or type of place, you travel around that area or work in those places as part of your job, for example trying to sell something there.

ext.ext_cn: 他们把我用得太狠了，我老了，干不了这种活儿啦。
ext.ext_en: They're working me too hard. I'm too old for this...

ext.ext_cn: 他们没有把我爸爸带走，而是一直让他在村里干活，把他活活累死了。
ext.ext_en: They didn't take my father away, but kept him in the village and worked him to death.

defs.def_en: If you work someone, you make them spend time and effort doing a particular activity or job.

defs.def_cn: (常指政客或艺人)博得，赢得(众人的支持或欢心)

ext.ext_cn: 首相有种感召人群的本事——有些人甚至认为这是一种魅力。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister has an ability to work a crowd — some might even suggest it is a kind of charm...

ext.ext_cn: 他又是握手，又是拍背，像个政客一样把一屋子的人都笼络了一番。
ext.ext_en: He worked the room like a politician, gripping hands, and slapping backs.

defs.def_en: If someone, often a politician or entertainer, works a crowd, they create a good relationship with the people in the crowd and get their support or interest.

ext.ext_cn: 农民们在肥沃的山谷里耕种。
ext.ext_en: Farmers worked the fertile valleys.

defs.def_en: When people work the land, they do all the tasks involved in growing crops.

ext.ext_cn: 1849年加利福尼亚发现金矿时，这些矿第一次被开采。
ext.ext_en: The mines had first been worked in 1849, when gold was discovered in California...

ext.ext_cn: 只有少数得到批准的人可以在特定时间开采特定的矿层。
ext.ext_en: Only an agreed number of men was allowed to work any given seam at any given time.

defs.def_en: When a mine is worked, minerals such as coal or gold are removed from it.

ext.ext_cn: 很多成年人仍然要靠孩子来操作录像机。
ext.ext_en: Many adults still depend on their children to work the video.

defs.def_en: If you work a machine or piece of equipment, you use or control it.

ext.ext_cn: 我眼镜上有一个螺丝松了。
ext.ext_en: A screw had worked loose from my glasses.

defs.def_en: If something works into a particular state or condition, it gradually moves so that it is in that state or condition.

ext.ext_cn: 用手掌将面团揉至光滑为止。
ext.ext_en: Work the dough with the palm of your hand until it is very smooth...

ext.ext_cn: 将奶酪的外皮去掉，用叉子将其压成硬硬的膏状。
ext.ext_en: Remove rind from the cheese and work it to a firm paste, with a fork.

defs.def_en: If you work a substance such as dough or clay, you keep pressing it to make it have a particular texture.

ext.ext_cn: 开采加工原石的机器
ext.ext_en: ...the machines needed to extract and work the raw stone.

ext.ext_cn: 一条跨度长且阴凉的石凿隧道
ext.ext_en: ...a long, cool tunnel of worked stone.

defs.def_en: If you work a material such as metal, leather, or stone, you cut, sew, or shape it in order to make something or to create a design.

defs.def_cn: 使用，采用(某种材料或物质)

ext.ext_cn: 他学习雕塑是因为他喜欢玩黏土。
ext.ext_en: He studied sculpture because he enjoyed working with clay.

defs.def_en: If you work with a particular substance or material, you use it in order to make something or to create a design.

ext.ext_cn: 每种姿势都会以不同方式活动肌肉。
ext.ext_en: Each position will work the muscles in a different way...

ext.ext_cn: 她睡着的时候嘴巴还在动。
ext.ext_en: Her mouth was working in her sleep.

defs.def_en: If you work a part of your body, or if it works, you move it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个钢厂几英里外都能看见。
ext.ext_en: The steel works could be seen for miles.

ext.ext_cn: 回收工厂
ext.ext_en: ...a recycling works.

defs.def_en: A works is a place where something is manufactured or where an industrial process is carried out. Works is used to refer to one or to more than one of these places.

ext.ext_cn: 6年间进行的破坏性的建筑工程、道路修筑和城市扩建
ext.ext_en: ...six years of disruptive building works, road construction and urban development.

defs.def_en: Works are activities such as digging the ground or building on a large scale.

defs.def_cn: (某种类型的)全部物件，全套物品

ext.ext_cn: 他的那个地方真是太棒了——壁球场、游泳池、按摩浴池，一应俱全。
ext.ext_en: Amazing place he's got there—squash courts, swimming pool, jacuzzi, the works.

defs.def_en: You can say the works after listing things such as someone's possessions or requirements, to emphasize that they possess or require everything you can think of in a particular category.

defs.def_cn: 干活儿;做工作;忙着做事

ext.ext_cn: 救援队已经在紧张地设法处理溢出的石油。
ext.ext_en: The salvage teams are already hard at work trying to deal with the spilled oil...

ext.ext_cn: 他这会儿正忙着写一篇小说。
ext.ext_en: He is currently at work on a novel...

defs.def_en: If someone is at work they are doing their job or are busy doing a particular activity.

ext.ext_cn: 这份报告表明，同一趋势也在影响着政治。
ext.ext_en: The report suggested that the same trend was at work in politics...

ext.ext_cn: 重要的是，要理解在我们自身行动背后起作用的强大的经济和社会力量。
ext.ext_en: It is important to understand the powerful economic and social forces at work behind our own actions.

defs.def_en: If a force or process is at work, it is having a particular influence or effect.

ext.ext_cn: 新一届政府面临重重困难。在这种环境下创造就业机会绝非易事。
ext.ext_en: The new administration has its work cut out for it. Creating jobs in this kind of environment is not going to be easy...

ext.ext_cn: 他要进入该队困难重重。
ext.ext_en: He will have his work cut out to get into the team.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will have your work cut out to do something, you mean that it will be a very difficult task.

ext.ext_cn: 他说有几十项经济计划已经开始实施。
ext.ext_en: He said there were dozens of economic plans in the works...

ext.ext_cn: 不应该有人对此感到惊奇，这事已经张罗了有一阵子了。
ext.ext_en: Nobody should be surprised by this. It's been in the works for some time.

defs.def_en: If something is in the works, it has already been planned or begun.

ext.ext_cn: 用喷罐来喷涂，不好对付的物品也能轻松搞定。
ext.ext_en: An aerosol spray will make short work of painting awkward objects...

ext.ext_cn: 这匹马轻松地跑完了越野赛程。
ext.ext_en: This horse made light work of the cross-country course...

defs.def_en: You can use work to talk about how easily or quickly a particular task is done. For example, if a person or thing makes short work of doing something or makes light work of it, they do it quickly and easily.

ext.ext_cn: 内心里我觉得他是个非常讨厌的家伙。
ext.ext_en: Underneath I think he's actually a rather nasty piece of work.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a nasty piece of work, you think they are very unpleasant or cruel.

ext.ext_cn: 我们将通过刺激经济让人们实现就业。
ext.ext_en: By stimulating the economy, we're going to put people to work...

ext.ext_cn: 我们没有把他们送进监狱，而是让他们帮种柠檬的果农干活儿。
ext.ext_en: Instead of sending them to prison, we have set them to work helping the lemon growers.

defs.def_en: If you put someone to work or set them to work, you give them a job or task to do.

ext.ext_cn: 他承诺着手解决国家庞大的财政赤字问题。
ext.ext_en: He promised to get to work on the state's massive deficit...

ext.ext_cn: 他返回美国，开始写一部新小说。
ext.ext_en: He returned to America where he set to work on a new novel.

defs.def_en: If you get to work ,go to work, or set to work on a job, task, or problem, you start doing it or dealing with it.

defs.def_cn: 艰难地移动；缓慢地取得进展

ext.ext_cn: 营救人员仍在艰难地向被困者靠拢。
ext.ext_en: Rescuers were still working their way towards the trapped men...

ext.ext_cn: 很多人事经理最初是从秘书或人事助理做起，然后慢慢升上去的。
ext.ext_en: Many personnel managers started as secretaries or personnel assistants and worked their way up.

defs.def_en: If you work your way somewhere, you move or progress there slowly, and with a lot of effort or work.

ext.ext_cn: 干得好，马修。我知道你能行。
ext.ext_en: Nice work, Matthew. I knew you could do it.

defs.def_en: You can say to someone 'nice work' or 'good work' in order to thank or praise them for doing something well or quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 我会给你买些冰激凌。
ext.ext_en: I'll get you some ice cream.

ext.ext_cn: 香草冰激凌
ext.ext_en: ...vanilla ice cream.

defs.def_en: Ice cream is a very cold sweet food which is made from frozen cream or a substance like cream and has a flavour such as vanilla, chocolate, or strawberry.

defs.def_cn: 一客冰激凌;一份冰激凌

ext.ext_cn: 想来份冰激凌吗？…
ext.ext_en: Do you want an ice cream?...

ext.ext_cn: 他们填了一肚子的冰激凌、巧克力和棒棒糖。
ext.ext_en: They stuffed themselves with ice creams, chocolate and lollies.

defs.def_en: An ice cream is an amount of ice cream sold in a small container or a cone made of thin biscuit.

ext.ext_cn: 安妮塔把自己的盘子推开;她几乎什么都没吃。
ext.ext_en: Anita pushed her plate away; she had eaten virtually nothing.

ext.ext_cn: 一大盘咸肉煎蛋
ext.ext_en: ...a huge plate of bacon and eggs.

defs.def_en: A plate is a round or oval flat dish that is used to hold food.

defs.def_cn: （尤指用于机械或建筑上金属制的）平板，薄板
defs.def_en: A plate is a flat piece of metal, especially on machinery or a building.

defs.def_cn: （通常置于办公室或住宅门边上的）金属姓名牌
defs.def_en: A plate is a small, flat piece of metal with someone's name written on it, which you usually find beside the front door of an office or house.

ext.ext_cn: 落满灰尘、挂着新泽西州牌照的汽车
ext.ext_en: ...dusty-looking cars with New Jersey plates.

defs.def_en: See also:number plate;license plate;On a road vehicle, the plates are the panels at the front and back which display the license number in the United States, and the registration number in Britain.

ext.ext_cn: 金银餐具、珠宝，还有整屋整屋的古董家具
ext.ext_en: ...gold and silver plate, jewellery, and roomfuls of antique furniture.

defs.def_en: Plate is dishes, bowls, and cups that are made of precious metal, especially silver or gold.
In printing, a plate is a sheet of metal which is carved or specially treated with chemicals so that it can be used to print text or pictures.
In photography, a plate is a thin sheet of glass that is covered with a layer of chemicals which react to the light and on which an image can be formed.

ext.ext_cn: 弗莫尔的书里有55页整版彩色插图。
ext.ext_en: Fermor's book has 55 colour plates.

defs.def_en: A plate in a book is a picture or photograph which takes up a whole page and is usually printed on better quality paper than the rest of the book.

defs.def_cn: （显微镜下的长方形）载物片，玻璃片
defs.def_en: In a microscope, the plate is a small rectangular piece of glass onto which you put a small amount of the substance that you want to look at. You then slide the plate under the microscope to look at the substance.
A dental plate is a piece of plastic which is shaped to fit inside a person's mouth and which a set of false teeth is attached to.

ext.ext_cn: 美国地质调查局揭示了此次地震并非由大陆板块间简单的水平交错运动所引起。
ext.ext_en: The United States Geological Survey has revealed that the earthquake was not caused by a simple horizontal movement of one plate past another.

defs.def_en: In geology, a plate is a large piece of the earth's surface, perhaps as large as a continent, which moves very slowly.

defs.def_cn: （棒球运动中）the plate 同 home plate
defs.def_en: In baseball, the plate is the same as the home plate.

defs.def_cn: 有很多工作要做；有很多事要处理

ext.ext_cn: 我们有很多工作要做。仅是手头现有的事情就已经有的忙了。
ext.ext_en: We have enough on our plate. There is plenty of work to be done on what we have.

defs.def_en: If you have enough on your plate or have a lot on your plate, you have a lot of work to do or a lot of things to deal with.

ext.ext_cn: 他甚至连总统之位都是得来全不费工夫。
ext.ext_en: Even the presidency was handed to him on a plate.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has things handed to them on a plate, you disapprove of them because they get good things easily.

ext.ext_cn: 仿照维多利亚风格建立的购物区
ext.ext_en: ...an ersatz Victorian shopping precinct...

ext.ext_cn: 对《星期天的爱情》这首歌的即兴模仿听起来尤其空洞。
ext.ext_en: The ersatz spontaneity of 'Sunday Love' sounds especially hollow.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ersatz, you dislike it because it is not genuine and is a poor imitation of something better.

ext.ext_cn: 可以用来换取粮票的食物只有这些：代用咖啡、通心粉和小块的人造黄油。
ext.ext_en: There were few provisions available in exchange for food stamps: ersatz coffee, macaroni, small cubes of margarine.

defs.def_en: An ersatz product is a poor quality product that is used to replace something that is not available.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 很多美国人认为他们的司法体系已经乱套了。
ext.ext_en: Many Americans think their legal system has gone haywire.

defs.def_en: If something goes haywire, it goes out of control or starts doing the wrong thing.

ext.ext_cn: 山谷里有无数野猪出没。
ext.ext_en: Wild boar are numerous in the valleys.

defs.def_en: A boar or a wild boar is a wild pig.
A boar is a male pig.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Close-cropped hair or grass is cut very short.

ext.ext_cn: 明摆着，他今天心情不错。
ext.ext_en: He is clearly in a good mood today...

ext.ext_cn: 他回来时，心情糟透了。
ext.ext_en: When he came back, he was in a foul mood...

defs.def_en: Your mood is the way you are feeling at a particular time. If you are in a good mood, you feel cheerful. If you are in a bad mood, you feel angry and impatient.

ext.ext_cn: 她显然情绪不佳。
ext.ext_en: She was obviously in a mood.

defs.def_en: If someone is in a mood, the way they are behaving shows that they are feeling angry and impatient.

ext.ext_cn: 政府似乎和民众的意愿是一致的。
ext.ext_en: The government seemed to be in tune with the popular mood...

ext.ext_cn: 他们很大程度上误读了选民的意图。
ext.ext_en: They largely misread the mood of the electorate.

defs.def_en: The mood of a group of people is the way that they think and feel about an idea, event, or question at a particular time.

ext.ext_cn: 首先用音乐烘托气氛。
ext.ext_en: First set the mood with music...

ext.ext_cn: 我想让每个房间都感觉不一样。
ext.ext_en: I wanted different moods in each room.

defs.def_en: The mood of a place is the general impression that you get of it.
In grammar, the mood of a clause is the way in which the verb forms are used to show whether the clause is, for example, a statement, a question, or an instruction.

defs.def_cn: 不正确的;虚假的;错误的

ext.ext_cn: 很明显，总统身边的人在不断向他传递错误信息。
ext.ext_en: It was quite clear the President was being given false information by those around him...

ext.ext_cn: 你不知道听到的是真还是假。
ext.ext_en: You do not know whether what you're told is true or false...

defs.def_en: If something is false, it is incorrect, untrue, or mistaken.

ext.ext_cn: 她藏在手提箱底部暗格中的物品
ext.ext_en: ...the items she'd secreted in the false bottom of her suitcase.

ext.ext_cn: 一副假牙
ext.ext_en: ...a set of false teeth...

defs.def_en: You use false to describe objects which are artificial but which are intended to look like the real thing or to be used instead of the real thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她低着头，故作谦卑地笑着。
ext.ext_en: She bowed her head and smiled in false modesty...

ext.ext_cn: “谢谢你，”她假装热情地说。
ext.ext_en: 'Thank you,' she said with false enthusiasm...

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as false, you are criticizing them for being insincere or for hiding their real feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 我带着些许惶恐考虑了一下骑自行车周游乌干达的可能性。
ext.ext_en: It was with some trepidation that I viewed the prospect of cycling across Uganda.

defs.def_en: Trepidation is fear or anxiety about something that you are going to do or experience.

ext.ext_cn: 遣返真正的难民回国并非政府的政策。
ext.ext_en: It was not the policy of the government to repatriate genuine refugees...

ext.ext_cn: 大约300名法国人质即将被遣送回国。
ext.ext_en: About 300 French hostages are to be repatriated.

defs.def_en: If a country repatriates someone, it sends them back to their home country.

ext.ext_cn: 外国投资者将被允许将利润额超过10亿卢比的部分调回国内。
ext.ext_en: Foreign investors are to be allowed  to repatriate profits over one billion rupees.

defs.def_en: If a company repatriates profits that it has made in another country, it brings them back into its home country.
Mice is the plural of mouse.

ext.ext_cn: 病人越早接受治疗，康复的可能性就越大。
ext.ext_en: The earlier the treatment is given, the better the patient's chances...

ext.ext_cn: 她很严厉，但对患者却很好。
ext.ext_en: She was tough but wonderful with her patients...

defs.def_en: A patient is a person who is receiving medical treatment from a doctor or hospital. A patient is also someone who is registered with a particular doctor.  →see usage note at:client

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 请耐心点——你的支票会来的。
ext.ext_en: Please be patient — your cheque will arrive...

ext.ext_cn: 他对孩子们总是非常好，很有耐心。
ext.ext_en: He was endlessly kind and patient with children.

defs.def_en: If you are patient, you stay calm and do not get annoyed, for example when something takes a long time, or when someone is not doing what you want them to do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 使人耳目一新的；新鲜的

ext.ext_cn: 听到有人说话通情达理真是令人耳目一新。
ext.ext_en: It's refreshing to hear somebody speaking common sense...

ext.ext_cn: 换换口味，看一部经典的老式电影会让人觉得耳目一新。
ext.ext_en: It made a refreshing change to see a good old-fashioned movie.

defs.def_en: You say that something is refreshing when it is pleasantly different from what you are used to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （沐浴或饮料）使人精神焕发的，提神的，清凉的

ext.ext_cn: 草药用于调制提神饮品已有好几个世纪了。
ext.ext_en: Herbs have been used for centuries to make refreshing drinks.

defs.def_en: A refreshing bath or drink makes you feel energetic or cool again after you have been tired or hot.

defs.def_cn: 放轻松；开心一些；别那么严肃

ext.ext_cn: 别这样，这是个聚会。高兴点。
ext.ext_en: Come on, this is a party. Lighten up.

defs.def_en: If someone tells you to lighten up, they think you should be less serious and make an effort to be more relaxed and happy.

defs.def_cn: （食品）真空包装的，真空密封的
defs.def_en: Food that is vacuum-packed is packed in a bag from which most of the air has been removed, in order to keep the food fresh.

defs.def_cn: 残羹剩饭；剩菜；吃剩的食物

ext.ext_cn: 把剩菜放进冰箱里。
ext.ext_en: Refrigerate any leftovers...

ext.ext_cn: 我所得到的唯一食物就是这家人的残羹剩饭。
ext.ext_en: The only food I ever got was the family's leftovers.

defs.def_en: You can refer to food that has not been eaten after a meal as leftovers .

ext.ext_cn: 剩下的墙纸
ext.ext_en: ...leftover pieces of wallpaper...

ext.ext_cn: 剩下的鸡肉可做成一盘美味色拉。
ext.ext_en: Leftover chicken makes a wonderful salad.

defs.def_en: You use leftover to describe an amount of something that remains after the rest of it has been used or eaten.

ext.ext_cn: 我们这个星球形成之初的遗迹
ext.ext_en: ...a leftover from the time our planet was first formed...

ext.ext_cn: 他走路时一瘸一拐的，那是小儿麻痹的后遗症。
ext.ext_en: He dragged a foot when he walked, a leftover from polio.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a leftover from a past period of time, you mean that it has its origin there and still exists even though most other things connected to that time have disappeared.

ext.ext_cn: 别担心，我们会很快把你从这儿弄出去的。
ext.ext_en: Don't worry. We'll have you out of here double-quick.

ext.ext_cn: 我飞快地越过了篱笆。
ext.ext_en: I was over the fence in double-quick time.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will do something double-quick, you are emphasizing that you will do it very quickly.

defs.def_cn: 星象（指某人诞生时各天体的位置，用以占卜命运）
defs.def_en: Your horoscope is a prediction of events which some people believe will happen to you in the future. Horoscopes are based on the position of the stars when you were born.
A hairbrush is a brush that you use to brush your hair.

defs.def_cn: （表示在两者或多者中择其一）或者，要么

ext.ext_cn: 他们要么以个人名义要么通过他们的公司捐钱给了保守党。
ext.ext_en: They gave money to the Conservative Party either personally or through their companies...

ext.ext_cn: 最好是乘坐旅游巴士或骑自行车观光。
ext.ext_en: Sightseeing is best done either by tour bus or by bicycles...

defs.def_en: You use either in front of the first of two or more alternatives, when you are stating the only possibilities or choices that there are. The other alternatives are introduced by 'or'.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定句中）两者都（不），既（不）

ext.ext_cn: 既无趣又没有强烈节奏的音乐
ext.ext_en: ...music that fails to be either funny or funky...

ext.ext_cn: 他去世前并未出现呼吸困难或意识不清的迹象。
ext.ext_en: There had been no indication of either breathlessness or any loss of mental faculties right until his death.

defs.def_en: You use either in a negative statement in front of the first of two alternatives to indicate that the negative statement refers to both the alternatives.

ext.ext_cn: 这里有香槟和雪茄，但两样东西都没怎么动。
ext.ext_en: There were glasses of champagne and cigars, but not many of either were consumed...

ext.ext_cn: 二人中任意一个遇害，都会严重扰乱本已非常棘手的谈判。
ext.ext_en: If either were killed, delicate negotiations would be seriously disrupted.

defs.def_en: You can use either to refer to one of two things, people, or situations, when you want to say that they are both possible and it does not matter which one is chosen or considered.

ext.ext_cn: 她告诫我千万不要结婚，也别要孩子。——“这两样我都不想要。”
ext.ext_en: She warned me that I'd never marry or have children.—'I don't want either.'

ext.ext_cn: 两个问题都不容易回答。
ext.ext_en: There are no simple answers to either of those questions.

defs.def_en: You use either in a negative statement to refer to each of two things, people, or situations to indicate that the negative statement includes both of them.

ext.ext_cn: 他甚至一句话也没跟她说，她也没跟他说话。
ext.ext_en: He did not even say anything to her, and she did not speak to him either...

ext.ext_cn: “恐怕我没去过那里。”——“嗯，那当然，我也没有去过。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'm afraid I've never been there.'—'Well, of course, I haven't myself either.'

defs.def_en: You use either by itself in negative statements to indicate that there is a similarity or connection with a person or thing that you have just mentioned.

defs.def_cn: （用于两个连续否定句的第二句之后，强调两种观点同样重要）而且，还

ext.ext_cn: 别同意，但是也别争辩。
ext.ext_en: Don't agree, but don't argue either...

ext.ext_cn: 我一个人没法做那事，我也不明白为什么得要我去做。
ext.ext_en: I can't manage that by myself and I don't see why it should be expected of me either.

defs.def_en: When one negative statement follows another, you can use either at the end of the second one to indicate that you are adding an extra piece of information, and to emphasize that both are equally important.

ext.ext_cn: 篮筐分别从体育馆两头的天花板上悬吊下来。
ext.ext_en: The basketball nets hung down from the ceiling at either end of the gymnasium...

ext.ext_cn: 我突然意识到我对两队都没有一句称得上有见地的话可讲。
ext.ext_en: I suddenly realized that I didn't have a single intelligent thing to say about either team.

defs.def_en: You can use either to introduce a noun that refers to each of two things when you are talking about both of them.

ext.ext_cn: 他用猎枪捅了捅默里。
ext.ext_en: He prodded Murray with the shotgun...

ext.ext_cn: 戳一戳窗台板看看有没有朽烂的迹象。
ext.ext_en: Prod the windowsills to check for signs of rot...

defs.def_en: If you prod someone or something, you give them a quick push with your finger or with a pointed object.

ext.ext_cn: 这份报告将督促政府加大在卫生服务方面的支出。
ext.ext_en: The report should prod the Government into spending more on the Health Service...

ext.ext_cn: 他的话提醒了她，她问莫拉去哪里了。
ext.ext_en: His remark prodded her to ask where Mora had gone.

defs.def_en: If you prod someone into doing something, you remind or persuade them to do it.
A chat room is a site on the Internet where people can exchange messages about a particular subject.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 活泼的；精力充沛的；生气勃勃的

ext.ext_cn: 她的性格可爱活泼。
ext.ext_en: She had a sweet, lively personality...

ext.ext_cn: 约瑟芬聪明、活泼、开朗。
ext.ext_en: Josephine was bright, lively and cheerful.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone as lively when they behave in an enthusiastic and cheerful way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （事件、讨论等）热闹的，热烈的，激烈的

ext.ext_cn: 结果这成了一场非常有意思的、气氛热烈的辩论会。
ext.ext_en: It turned out to be a very interesting session with a lively debate...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在洪都拉斯以4比1获胜的那场比赛尤其激动人心。
ext.ext_en: Their 4-1 win in Honduras was a particularly lively affair.

defs.def_en: A lively event or a lively discussion, for example, has lots of interesting and exciting things happening or being said in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 才思敏捷的；思维活跃的；兴趣广泛的

ext.ext_cn: 她是个受过良好教育、思维敏捷、抱负远大的女孩子。
ext.ext_en: She was a very well educated girl with a lively mind, a girl with ambition.

ext.ext_cn: 她那活跃奔放的想象力
ext.ext_en: ...her very lively imagination.

defs.def_en: Someone who has a lively mind is intelligent and interested in a lot of different things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 论文对欧洲的动向亦表现出浓厚的兴趣。
ext.ext_en: The papers also show a lively interest in European developments.

defs.def_en: A lively feeling or awareness is a strong or enthusiastic one.
Endive is a type of plant with crisp curly leaves that is eaten in salads.
Endive is a type of a plant with crisp bitter leaves that can be cooked or eaten raw in salads.
An ambulance is a vehicle for taking people to and from hospital.

defs.def_cn: （产品、服务等的）独特卖点，与众不同之处，出众之处

ext.ext_cn: 对沃尔沃而言，安全永远是其卖点。
ext.ext_en: With Volvo, safety was always the USP.

defs.def_en: The USP of a product or service is a particular feature of it which can be used in advertising to show how it is different from, and better than, other similar products or services. USP is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'Unique Selling Point'.
A tunic is a sleeveless garment that is worn on the top part of your body.

defs.def_cn: （各自发表不同观点的）辩论，争论，讨论

ext.ext_cn: 以色列政府内部正在进行激烈的辩论。
ext.ext_en: An intense debate is going on within the Israeli government...

ext.ext_cn: 学者之间对此一直争论纷纷。
ext.ext_en: There has been a lot of debate among scholars about this.

defs.def_en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

defs.def_cn: (议会或其他机构就某问题在投票前进行的)辩论

ext.ext_cn: 预计接下来的几天里议会将会进行一些激烈的辩论。
ext.ext_en: There are expected to be some heated debates in parliament over the next few days.

defs.def_en: A debate is a formal discussion, for example in a parliament or institution, in which people express different opinions about a particular subject and then vote on it.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国安理会今天将就这个问题展开讨论。
ext.ext_en: The United Nations Security Council will debate the issue today...

ext.ext_cn: 关于厌食的起因存在颇多争论。
ext.ext_en: The causes of anorexia are much debated...

defs.def_en: If people debate a topic, they discuss it fairly formally, putting forward different views. You can also say that one person debates a topic with another person.

ext.ext_cn: 塔格特思忖着是否再要一杯双份伏特加。
ext.ext_en: Taggart debated whether to have yet another double vodka...

ext.ext_cn: 我们眼下正盘算着为房子购置什么样的家具。
ext.ext_en: At the moment we are debating what furniture to buy for the house...

defs.def_en: If you debate whether to do something or what to do, you think or talk about possible courses of action before deciding exactly what you are going to do.

defs.def_cn: 存在争论的;有待讨论的;未确定的

ext.ext_cn: 他们之中谁更有音乐天赋还未有定论。
ext.ext_en: Which of them has more musical talent is open to debate.

defs.def_en: If you say that a matter is open to debate, you mean that people have different opinions about it, or it has not yet been firmly decided.

defs.def_cn: 形同虚设的法律（或协议）；空文

ext.ext_cn: 没有人执行它，该法律变成了一纸空文。
ext.ext_en: No one does anything about it and the law becomes a dead letter.

defs.def_en: If you say that a law or agreement is a dead letter, you mean that it still exists but people ignore it.

defs.def_cn: 随乐声抢椅子的游戏(游戏者随乐声围着椅子绕圈走，乐声停止时未抢到椅子者被淘汰)
defs.def_en: Musical chairs is a game that children play at parties. They run round a row of chairs while music plays and try to sit down on one when the music stops.

defs.def_cn: (像抢椅子游戏似的)人员频繁的更动，频繁调换职位

ext.ext_cn: 像抢椅子游戏，有能力的人为挣更多的钱而不断跳槽。
ext.ext_en: It was musical chairs. Creative people would switch jobs just to get more money.

defs.def_en: If you describe the situation within a particular organization or area of activity as musical chairs, you are critical of the fact that people in that organization or area exchange jobs or positions very often.
A boy band is a band consisting of young men who sing pop music and dance. Boy bands are especially popular with teenage girls.

ext.ext_cn: 价值3,640万美元、为期5年的期票
ext.ext_en: ...a $36.4 million, five-year promissory note.

defs.def_en: A promissory note is a written promise to pay a specific sum of money to a particular person.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （姿态或人）嬉戏的，闹着玩的，不当真的

ext.ext_cn: 在他鼻尖上的戏吻
ext.ext_en: ...a playful kiss on the tip of his nose.

ext.ext_cn: 嬉戏的打闹
ext.ext_en: ...a playful fight...

defs.def_en: A playful gesture or person is friendly or humorous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 顽皮的小狗
ext.ext_en: ...a playful puppy.

defs.def_en: A playful animal is lively and cheerful.

defs.def_cn: （通常指为了挣钱的）采摘者，采集者
defs.def_en: A fruit picker or cotton picker, for example, is a person who picks fruit or cotton, usually for money.

defs.def_cn: 误述;对…作不准确的叙述;歪曲

ext.ext_cn: 他说新闻媒体把他歪曲成了一个傲慢而又霸道的人。
ext.ext_en: He said that the press had misrepresented him as arrogant and bullying...

ext.ext_cn: 好莱坞电影把我们歪曲成酒鬼、疯子和杀人凶手。
ext.ext_en: Hollywood films misrepresented us as drunks, maniacs and murderers...

defs.def_en: If someone misrepresents a person or situation, they give a wrong or inaccurate account of what the person or situation is like.

ext.ext_cn: 煤气系统的官员正在调查一起瓦斯爆炸的起因,这起事故严重毁坏了汉普郡的一所房屋。
ext.ext_en: Gas officials are investigating the cause of an explosion which badly damaged a house in Hampshire...

ext.ext_cn: 两名警官正在接受检察官的审查。
ext.ext_en: The two officers were being investigated by the director of public prosecutions...

defs.def_en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

ext.ext_en: ...relations between Islam and the West.

ext.ext_en: ...a man in a blue-grey uniform and peaked cap.

defs.def_en: A peaked cap has a pointed or rounded part that sticks out above your eyes.

defs.def_cn: 逗引;使兴奋;(尤指在性方面)挑逗

ext.ext_cn: 图片本意不是为了挑逗观众。
ext.ext_en: The pictures were not meant to titillate audiences.

ext.ext_en: …food to titillate the most jaded of palates.

defs.def_en: If something titillates someone, it pleases and excites them, especially in a sexual way.
A terrapin is a reptile which has a thick shell covering its body and which lives partly in water and partly on land.

A farmhand is a person who is employed to work on a farm.

Flying fish are a type of fish that live in warm seas. They have large fins that enable them to move forward in the air when they jump out of the water.

defs.def_cn: 使分散思路;使转变话题;使转移目标

ext.ext_cn: 他最终总算没有因施奈德的问题而分心。

ext.ext_cn: 领导层采取行动来转移对该提议的关注。
ext.ext_en: The leadership moved to sidetrack the proposal...

defs.def_en: If you are sidetracked by something, it makes you forget what you intended to do or say, and start instead doing or talking about a different thing.
See also:Grim Reaper;A reaper is a machine used to cut and gather crops.
