Sweets are small sweet things such as toffees, chocolates, and mints.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在餐厅吃饭时饭后的)甜食，甜点

ext.ext_cn: 甜点是威士忌口味的慕斯。
ext.ext_en: The sweet was a mousse flavoured with whisky.

defs.def_en: A sweet is something sweet, such as fruit or a pudding, that you eat at the end of a meal, especially in a restaurant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的洗发水的芳香
ext.ext_en: ...the sweet smell of her shampoo...

ext.ext_cn: 她刚烤制了一些面包，空气里都弥漫着一股香味。
ext.ext_en: She'd baked some bread which made the air smell sweet.

defs.def_en: A sweet smell is a pleasant one, for example the smell of a flower.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (空气等)新鲜的,清新的;(水)纯净的,清澈的

ext.ext_cn: 我吸了一大口清新的空气。
ext.ext_en: I gulped a breath of sweet air.

ext.ext_cn: 一股纯净的水
ext.ext_en: ...a stream of sweet water.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as air or water as sweet, you mean that it smells or tastes pleasantly fresh and clean.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的声音如少女般柔美悦耳。
ext.ext_en: Her voice was as soft and sweet as a young girl's.

ext.ext_cn: 莫扎特音乐优美的旋律
ext.ext_en: ...the sweet sounds of Mozart.

defs.def_en: A sweet sound is pleasant, smooth, and gentle.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 几乎没有比复仇更爽的事情了。
ext.ext_en: There are few things quite as sweet as revenge.

ext.ext_cn: 婚外情带来的快感
ext.ext_en: ...the sweet taste of illicit love...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as sweet, you mean that it gives you great pleasure and satisfaction.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 温和的;善良的;温柔的;可亲的

ext.ext_cn: 他平时是一个温和的人，但喝了酒后往往就会又吵又闹。
ext.ext_en: He was a sweet man but when he drank he tended to quarrel...

ext.ext_cn: 你能想着我真是太好了！
ext.ext_en: How sweet of you to think of me!

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as sweet, you mean that they are pleasant, kind, and gentle towards other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (小孩，小东西)迷人的，漂亮的，可爱的

ext.ext_cn: 漂亮的小女孩
ext.ext_en: ...a sweet little baby girl...

ext.ext_cn: 这房子太漂亮了。
ext.ext_en: The house was really sweet.

defs.def_en: If you describe a small person or thing as sweet, you mean that they are attractive in a simple or unsophisticated way.

defs.def_cn: 亲爱的,宝贝儿(用作爱称)

ext.ext_cn: 我真为你骄傲，亲爱的！
ext.ext_en: I am so proud of you, my sweet!

defs.def_en: You can address someone as sweet or my sweet if you are very fond of them.

ext.ext_cn: 用来讨好我们的钱在哪呢？
ext.ext_en: Where's the money to keep us sweet?

defs.def_en: If you keep someone sweet, you do something to please them in order to prevent them from becoming annoyed or dissatisfied.

defs.def_cn: 面食（如意大利面条、通心粉等）
defs.def_en: Pasta is a type of food made from a mixture of flour, eggs, and water that is formed into different shapes and then boiled. Spaghetti, macaroni, and noodles are types of pasta.

ext.ext_cn: 这事儿只需稍费工夫就可以了。
ext.ext_en: All it required was a bit of work...

ext.ext_cn: 我只领到了一点点钱。
ext.ext_en: I got paid a little bit of money.

defs.def_en: A bit of something is a small amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个女孩有点儿古怪。
ext.ext_en: This girl was a bit strange...

ext.ext_cn: 我想人们应该觉得稍微自信了一点儿。
ext.ext_en: I think people feel a bit more confident...

defs.def_en: A bit means to a small extent or degree. It is sometimes used to make a statement less extreme.

ext.ext_cn: 有点儿乱七八糟。
ext.ext_en: It's all a bit of a mess...

ext.ext_cn: 学生们总是被描述为有点儿可笑的人。
ext.ext_en: Students have always been portrayed as a bit of a joke...

defs.def_en: You can use a bit of to make a statement less forceful. For example, the statement 'It's a bit of a nuisance' is less forceful than 'It's a nuisance'.

ext.ext_cn: 它们值不少钱。
ext.ext_en: They're worth quite a bit of money...

ext.ext_cn: 情况发生了相当大的变化。
ext.ext_en: Things have changed quite a bit...

defs.def_en: Quite a bit means quite a lot.

ext.ext_cn: 我还是认为我能再稍微多付出一点儿。
ext.ext_en: I still think I have a bit more to offer...

ext.ext_cn: 也许我们听到的噪音会稍微少一点儿。
ext.ext_en: Maybe we'll hear a little bit less noise.

defs.def_en: You use a bit before 'more' or 'less' to mean a small amount more or a small amount less.

defs.def_cn: 一会儿，片刻（英国英语中亦用for a bit）

ext.ext_cn: 我们等一会儿吧。
ext.ext_en: Let's wait a bit...

ext.ext_cn: 我希望能有时间谈一谈。
ext.ext_en: I hope there will be time to talk a bit...

defs.def_en: If you do something a bit, you do it for a short time. In British English, you can also say that you do something for a bit .

ext.ext_cn: 那就是会议上我错过的那一小段。
ext.ext_en: That's the bit of the meeting that I missed...

ext.ext_cn: 下面是非常重要的部分。
ext.ext_en: Now comes the really important bit...

defs.def_en: A bit of something is a small part or section of it.

ext.ext_cn: 仅仅是靠缠在门柱钉子上的一小段细绳把门关紧。
ext.ext_en: Only a bit of string looped round a nail in the doorpost held it shut.

ext.ext_cn: 皱皱巴巴的小纸片
ext.ext_en: ...crumpled bits of paper.

defs.def_en: A bit of something is a small piece of it.

defs.def_cn: （一组事物中的）一个，一项，一件

ext.ext_cn: 一个关键的证据帮助打赢了这场官司。
ext.ext_en: There was one bit of vital evidence which helped win the case...

ext.ext_cn: 这条路的修缮工作一丁点儿都还没开始。
ext.ext_en: Not one single bit of work has been started towards the repair of this road.

defs.def_en: You can use bit to refer to a particular item or to one of a group or set of things. For example, a bit of information is an item of information.

defs.def_cn: （表示不重要）所有相关的零七碎八
defs.def_en: You use bit in expressions such as the charity bit and the whole marriage bit to refer to everything that is involved in something, when you do not think it is important.

defs.def_cn: 位，比特（计算机的最小信息量单位）
defs.def_en: In computing, a bit is the smallest unit of information that is held in a computer's memory. It is either 1 or 0. Several bits form a byte.
A bit is 12 1/2 cents; mainly used in expressions such as two bits, which means 25 cents, or four bits, which means 50 cents.
A bit is a piece of metal that is held in a horse's mouth and is used to control the horse when you are riding.

ext.ext_cn: 我逐渐明白了他们想要干什么。
ext.ext_en: Bit by bit I began to understand what they were trying to do.

defs.def_en: If something happens bit by bit, it happens in stages.

defs.def_cn: 急欲摆脱束缚做事；急于开始

ext.ext_en: I expect you're champing at the bit, so we'll get things going as soon as we can.

defs.def_en: If someone is champing at the bit or is chomping at the bit, they are very impatient to do something, but they are prevented from doing it, usually by circumstances that they have no control over.
If you do your bit, you do something that, to a small or limited extent, helps to achieve something.

ext.ext_cn: 玛茜总是努力尽一份力。
ext.ext_en: Marcie always tried to do her bit.

defs.def_cn: 完全和…一样…；…程度丝毫不逊色于…

ext.ext_cn: 我的晚礼服和他的一样好。
ext.ext_en: My dinner jacket is every bit as good as his.

defs.def_en: You say that one thing is every bit as good, interesting, or important as another to emphasize that the first thing is just as good, interesting, or important as the second.

ext.ext_cn: 指望我替你甩掉你的男朋友，有点儿过分了吧？
ext.ext_en: It's a bit much expecting me to dump your boyfriend for you.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a bit much, you are annoyed because you think someone has behaved in an unreasonable way.

ext.ext_cn: 我真的一点儿也不觉得惊讶。
ext.ext_en: I'm really not a bit surprised...

ext.ext_cn: “你失望了吗？”——“一点儿也不。”
ext.ext_en: 'Are you disappointed?'—'Not a bit.'

defs.def_en: You use not a bit when you want to make a strong negative statement.

defs.def_cn: 并非如此；根本没有；一点儿没有

ext.ext_cn: 他放弃了吗？根本没有！
ext.ext_en: Did he give up? Not a bit of it!

defs.def_en: You say not a bit of it to emphasize that something that you might expect to be the case is not the case.

defs.def_cn: 各种零碎东西；七零八碎的东西
defs.def_en: You can use bits and pieces or bits and bobs to refer to a collection of different things.

defs.def_en: If you get the bit between your teeth, or take the bit between your teeth, you become very enthusiastic about a job you have to do.

ext.ext_en: She found a pretty yellow jug smashed to bits.

defs.def_en: If something is smashed or blown to bits, it is broken into a number of pieces. If something falls to bits, it comes apart so that it is in a number of pieces.

ext.ext_cn: 冬天冰雪覆盖大地，北方的地面变得非常寒冷。
ext.ext_en: In the north the ground becomes very cold as the winter snow and ice covers the ground...

ext.ext_cn: 鸟类通常由北向南迁徙。
ext.ext_en: Birds usually migrate from north to south.

defs.def_en: The north is the direction which is on your left when you are looking towards the direction where the sun rises.

ext.ext_cn: 该方案主要的受益者是北部和中部地区的人们。
ext.ext_en: The scheme mostly benefits people in the North and Midlands.

ext.ext_cn: 法国北部村庄里的一所小房子
ext.ext_en: ...a tiny house in a village in the north of France.

defs.def_en: The north of a place, country, or region is the part which is in the north.

ext.ext_cn: 安妮塔驱车沿太平洋公路向北行驶。
ext.ext_en: Anita drove north up Pacific Highway.

defs.def_en: If you go north, you travel towards the north.

ext.ext_cn: 位于朴次茅斯以北几英里处的小村庄
ext.ext_en: ...a little village a few miles north of Portsmouth.

defs.def_en: Something that is north of a place is positioned to the north of it.

defs.def_cn: 在北方的;北部的;向北方的;面朝北的

ext.ext_cn: 山的北面
ext.ext_en: ...the north side of the mountain...

ext.ext_cn: 他们将从克里特岛北海岸登陆上岛。
ext.ext_en: They were coming in to land on the north coast of Crete.

defs.def_en: The north edge, corner, or part of a place or country is the part which is towards the north.

defs.def_cn: (用在国家、州和地区名中)北(的)

ext.ext_cn: 本周末在北美、亚洲和欧洲的多个城市举行了示威游行。
ext.ext_en: There were demonstrations this weekend in cities throughout North America, Asia and Europe.

defs.def_en: 'North' is used in the names of some countries, states, and regions in the north of a larger area.

ext.ext_cn: 凛冽的北风
ext.ext_en: ...a bitterly cold north wind.

defs.def_en: A north wind is a wind that blows from the north.

defs.def_cn: 北方发达国家(指大部分位于北半球的富裕、发达国家)

ext.ext_cn: 马来西亚已成为对北方发达国家环保态度最严厉的批评者。
ext.ext_en: Malaysia has emerged as the toughest critic of the North's environmental attitudes.

defs.def_en: The North is used to refer to the richer, more developed countries of the world.

ext.ext_cn: 这次危机可能持续很长时间。
ext.ext_en: This crisis might last for a long period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 几个月时间
ext.ext_en: ...a period of a few months.

defs.def_en: A period is a length of time.

defs.def_cn: （个人、组织或社会的）阶段，时期，时代

ext.ext_cn: 经济健康发展并且不断扩张的一段时期
ext.ext_en: ...a period of economic good health and expansion...

ext.ext_cn: 有一段时间他很想被人接受。
ext.ext_en: He went through a period of wanting to be accepted...

defs.def_en: A period in the life of a person, organization, or society is a length of time which is remembered for a particular situation or activity.

ext.ext_cn: 罗马帝国时代
ext.ext_en: ...the Roman period...

ext.ext_cn: 这一时期的文学作品中都没有提及他们的存在。
ext.ext_en: No reference to their existence appears in any literature of the period.

defs.def_en: A particular length of time in history is sometimes called a period. For example, you can talk about the Victorian period or the Elizabethan period in Britain.

defs.def_cn: （服装、家具、乐器）过去的，古代的，具有某个时代特征的

ext.ext_cn: 穿着宽松的古装
ext.ext_en: ...dressed in full period costume.

ext.ext_cn: 古乐器的复制品
ext.ext_en: ...replicas of period instruments.

defs.def_en: Period costumes, furniture, and instruments were made at an earlier time in history, or look as if they were made then.

ext.ext_cn: 练习的时候他们陪着他。
ext.ext_en: They accompanied him during his exercise periods.

defs.def_en: Exercise, training, or study periods are lengths of time that are set aside for exercise, training, or study.

ext.ext_cn: 自习课
ext.ext_en: ...periods of private study.

ext.ext_cn: 把他的剧本带到学校以便空闲的时候背台词
ext.ext_en: ...taking his scripts to school in order to learn the lines in free periods.

defs.def_en: At a school or college, a period is one of the parts that the day is divided into during which lessons or other activities take place.
When a woman has a period, she bleeds from her womb. This usually happens once a month, unless she is pregnant.

ext.ext_cn: 我不想做，这事就到此为止吧。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to do it, period.

defs.def_en: Some people say period after stating a fact or opinion when they want to emphasize that they are definite about something and do not want to discuss it further.
A period is the punctuation mark (.) which you use at the end of a sentence when it is not a question or an exclamation.
When a group of people have a whip-round, money is collected from each person so that it can be used to buy something for all of them or for someone they all know.
A key ring is a metal ring which you use to keep your keys together. You pass the ring through the holes in your keys.
Taxpayers are people who pay a percentage of their income to the government as tax.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不要给它们施肥过多，以防其长得柔软多汁。
ext.ext_en: Do not overfeed them, as this will encourage soft sappy growth.

defs.def_en: Sappy stems or leaves contain a lot of liquid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我写了这首相当花痴的爱情歌曲。
ext.ext_en: I wrote this sappy love song.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as sappy, you think they are foolish.

ext.ext_cn: 联邦制意味着存在众多各自都拥有权力的政治管理机构。
ext.ext_en: Federalism implies a plurality of political authorities, each with its own powers.

defs.def_en: If there is a plurality of things, a number of them exist.

ext.ext_cn: 保守党保住了选票的多数优势。
ext.ext_en: The Conservative party retained a plurality of the votes...

ext.ext_cn: 有35%的多数民众认为，经济改革不会带来实质性的变革。
ext.ext_en: 35% of the population, a plurality, believed that the economic reforms would result in only insignificant change.

defs.def_en: If a candidate, political party, or idea has the support of a plurality of people, they have more support than any other candidate, party, or idea.

defs.def_cn: （指选举中获胜者得到的不及其他所有候选人得票总和的）相对多数（票）

ext.ext_cn: 他在11月3号的选举中仅获得了49%的相对多数票。
ext.ext_en: He only got a plurality on November 3rd, just 49 percent.

defs.def_en: A plurality in an election is the number of votes that the winner gets, when this is less than the total number of votes for all the other candidates.

defs.def_cn: （指选举中获得最多票数的候选人与得票数第二的候选人之间的）票数差额

ext.ext_cn: 富兰克林在选举团投票中以449票比82票的差额胜出。
ext.ext_en: Franklin had won with a plurality in electoral votes of 449 to 82.

defs.def_en: A plurality in an election is the difference in the number of votes between the candidate who gets the most votes and the candidate who comes second.

ext.ext_cn: 她的身段每一个血气方刚的男人都不可能视而不见。
ext.ext_en: Hers is a body which every red-blooded male cannot fail to have noticed.

defs.def_en: If a man is described as red-blooded, he is considered to be strong and healthy and have a strong interest in sex.

ext.ext_cn: 养儿育女没有得到社会的充分重视。
ext.ext_en: Parenting is not fully valued by society.

ext.ext_cn: 育儿课程
ext.ext_en: ...parenting classes.

defs.def_en: Parenting is the activity of bringing up and looking after your child.

defs.def_cn: (蜜蜂等昆虫的)一大群，一大窝
defs.def_en: A swarm of bees or other insects is a large group of them flying together.

ext.ext_cn: 黑压压的一大群蜜蜂从蜂巢中飞出来。
ext.ext_en: A dark cloud of bees comes swarming out of the hive.

defs.def_en: When bees or other insects swarm, they move or fly in a large group.

ext.ext_cn: 人们成群地涌向商店，见什么买什么。
ext.ext_en: People swarmed to the shops, buying up everything in sight.

defs.def_en: When people swarm somewhere, they move there quickly in a large group.

ext.ext_cn: 一大群人围住了这个酒店。
ext.ext_en: A swarm of people encircled the hotel...

ext.ext_cn: 今天在十字路口有大群的游客在拍照。
ext.ext_en: Today at the crossing there were swarms of tourists taking photographs.

defs.def_en: A swarm of people is a large group of them moving about quickly.

defs.def_cn: 挤满，聚集(来来往往的人)

ext.ext_cn: 几分钟内很多警察就来到了这一地区，开始搜查附近的树林。
ext.ext_en: Within minutes the area was swarming with officers who began searching a nearby wood.

defs.def_en: If a place is swarming with people, it is full of people moving about in a busy way.

ext.ext_cn: 《忍者神龟》的风靡一时
ext.ext_en: ...the craze for Mutant Ninja Turtles...

ext.ext_cn: 散步是最近非常流行的健身方式。
ext.ext_en: Walking is the latest fitness craze.

defs.def_en: If there is a craze for something, it is very popular for a short time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 装模作样的;浮夸的;矫饰的

ext.ext_cn: 这不是一件纯粹为艺术而艺术的华而不实的东西，而是进行了大胆创新的非凡作品。
ext.ext_en: This isn't highfalutin art-about-art. It's marvellous and adventurous stuff.

defs.def_en: People sometimes use highfalutin to describe something that they think is being made to sound complicated or important in order to impress people.

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们正成批地离开这个国家。
ext.ext_en: Scientists are leaving the country in droves...

ext.ext_cn: 在这个温暖的夜晚里，空气中弥漫着汽油的味道，成群结队的年轻男女或是漫步在码头边或是泡在酒吧间。
ext.ext_en: In the warm petrol-scented night, droves of young men and girls were strolling along the quays and packing the bars.

defs.def_en: If you say that people are going somewhere or doing something in droves, you are emphasizing that there is a very large number of them.

ext.ext_cn: 她给人一种很有权威的感觉。
ext.ext_en: She had an aura of authority.

defs.def_en: An aura is a quality or feeling that seems to surround a person or place or to come from them.

defs.def_cn: 违法行为;犯罪行为;不道德行为

ext.ext_cn: 市检察官办公室尚未发现任何刑事犯罪的证据。
ext.ext_en: The city attorney's office hasn't found any evidence of criminal wrongdoing.

defs.def_en: Wrongdoing is behaviour that is illegal or immoral.

defs.def_cn: （电视或技术）高清晰度的，高分辨率的

ext.ext_cn: 图像更为清晰、音效更为出众的高清电视
ext.ext_en: ...high-definition TV, with its sharper images and better sound.

ext.ext_cn: 这些游戏现在有了高清版，更受欢迎了。
ext.ext_en: These games are more popular now that they are available in high definition.

defs.def_en: High-definition television or technology is a digital system that gives a much clearer picture than traditional television systems.
Journalists sometimes use wild child to refer to a teenage girl who enjoys herself in an uncontrolled way, for example by going to a lot of parties.

ext.ext_cn: 我是天生的悲观主义者。我总是做最坏的打算。
ext.ext_en: I'm a natural pessimist; I usually expect the worst...

ext.ext_cn: 现在看来似乎悲观论者是正确的。
ext.ext_en: It looks as if the pessimists are being proved right.

defs.def_en: A pessimist is someone who thinks that bad things are going to happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的礼服颇具法国风情，非常别致。
ext.ext_en: Her gown was very French and very chic.

defs.def_en: Something or someone that is chic is fashionable and sophisticated.

ext.ext_cn: 法国设计时尚
ext.ext_en: ...French designer chic...

ext.ext_cn: 他魅力四射，风度翩翩。
ext.ext_en: He radiates charm and chic.

defs.def_en: Chic is used to refer to a particular style or to the quality of being chic.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有礼貌的;谦恭的;恭敬的;客气的

ext.ext_cn: 他为人友善，而且彬彬有礼。
ext.ext_en: He was a kind and courteous man...

ext.ext_cn: 我朋友的回答很客气，但很坚决。
ext.ext_en: My friend's reply was courteous but firm.

defs.def_en: Someone who is courteous is polite and respectful to other people.
A marquis is a male member of the nobility who has a rank between duke and earl.

defs.def_cn: 持有资格证书的;有等级证书的

ext.ext_cn: 货真价实的具有执业资格的医师
ext.ext_en: ...a genuine certificated physician.

defs.def_en: A certificated person has been awarded a certificate to prove that they have achieved a certain level or standard.

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰军队的一个营正沿街行进。
ext.ext_en: A Scottish battalion was marching down the street...

ext.ext_cn: 拉米雷斯上尉命令他们立正，然后齐步走到主营地。
ext.ext_en: Captain Ramirez called them to attention and marched them off to the main camp...

defs.def_en: When soldiers march somewhere, or when a commanding officer marches them somewhere, they walk there with very regular steps, as a group.

ext.ext_cn: 示威者然后穿越首都游行，他们反复高喊口号要求进行自由选举。
ext.ext_en: The demonstrators then marched through the capital chanting slogans and demanding free elections...

ext.ext_cn: 数百名积极分子以呼吁和平与裁军的游行纪念了这个神圣的日子。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of activists marked the holy day by marching for peace and disarmament.

defs.def_en: When a large group of people march for a cause, they walk somewhere together in order to express their ideas or to protest about something.

defs.def_cn: (因生气等快速毅然地)走，行走

ext.ext_cn: 他没敲门就闯进了厨房。
ext.ext_en: He marched into the kitchen without knocking.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone marches somewhere, you mean that they walk there quickly and in a determined way, for example because they are angry.

ext.ext_cn: 他们被押着穿过一个鳄鱼成群的地方，要是步子稍有放慢，便会遭棍打。
ext.ext_en: They were marched through a crocodile-infested area and, if they slowed down, were beaten with sticks...

ext.ext_cn: 我拽着他穿过房间和大厅，来到门阶上。
ext.ext_en: I marched him across the room, down the hall and out onto the doorstep.

defs.def_en: If you march someone somewhere, you force them to walk there with you, for example by holding their arm tightly.

ext.ext_cn: 随着科技发展的日新月异，人们容易感到无所适从。
ext.ext_en: It is easy to feel trampled by the relentless march of technology...

ext.ext_cn: 社会继续向日益高涨的物质享乐主义方向发展。
ext.ext_en: Society's march toward ever-increasing materialism was continuing.

defs.def_en: The march of something is its steady development or progress.

ext.ext_cn: 一支军乐队演奏了俄罗斯的进行曲与民乐。
ext.ext_en: A military band played Russian marches and folk tunes.

defs.def_en: A march is a piece of music with a regular rhythm that you can march to.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经收到了辞退的通知。
ext.ext_en: They've had their marching orders...

ext.ext_cn: 女人要如何才能开得了口，对她的恋人说出“我受够了”，让他走人？
ext.ext_en: What does it take for a woman to say 'that's enough' and give her man his marching orders?

defs.def_en: If you give someone their marching orders, you tell them that you no longer want or need them, for example as your employee or as your lover.

ext.ext_cn: 如果策略得当，墨西哥甚至可以赶在其北部邻国之前抢得先机。
ext.ext_en: If its strategy succeeds, Mexico could even steal a march on its northern neighbour.

defs.def_en: If you steal a march on someone, you start doing something before they do it in order to gain an advantage over them.

defs.def_cn: 天然保健食品，绿色食品（不含人造原料）
defs.def_en: Health foods are natural foods without artificial ingredients which people buy because they consider them to be good for them.
A treasure chest is a box containing treasure.

defs.def_cn: (为某物提供丰富来源的)百宝箱

ext.ext_cn: 这本书是个信息百宝箱。
ext.ext_en: This book is a treasure chest of information.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a treasure chest of a particular thing, you mean that it is very good source of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他们请我父亲为他们向国王求情。
ext.ext_en: They asked my father to intercede with the king on their behalf...

ext.ext_cn: 他有时候也极力为我说情。
ext.ext_en: He had occasionally tried to intercede for me...

defs.def_en: If you intercede with someone, you try to persuade them to forgive someone or end their disagreement with them.

defs.def_cn: 另一个自我；个性的另一面
defs.def_en: Your alter ego is the other side of your personality from the one which people normally see.

ext.ext_cn: 巴里·汉弗莱斯凭借埃德娜夫人一角轰动全美。
ext.ext_en: Barry Humphries's alter ego Dame Edna has taken the US by storm.

defs.def_en: You can describe the character that an actor usually plays on television or in films as his or her alter ego.

ext.ext_cn: 她首先是丈夫的知己。
ext.ext_en: She is, first and foremost, her husband's alter ego.

defs.def_en: An alter ego is a very close and intimate friend whose character is often the opposite of your own.

defs.def_cn: （车辆的）手闸，手刹车，手制动器
defs.def_en: In a vehicle, the handbrake is a brake which the driver operates with his or her hand, for example when parking.
A thundercloud is a large dark cloud that is likely to produce thunder and lightning.

defs.def_cn: （称号、成员资格）荣誉的，名誉的

ext.ext_cn: 他将在纽卡斯尔大学的一个仪式上获授荣誉学位。
ext.ext_en: He will be awarded the honorary degree in a ceremony at Newcastle University.

ext.ext_cn: 高尔夫球俱乐部的名誉会员
ext.ext_en: ...an honorary member of the Golf Club.

defs.def_en: An honorary title or membership of a group is given to someone without their needing to have the necessary qualifications, usually because of their public achievements.

ext.ext_cn: 柴郡养蜂人协会名誉秘书
ext.ext_en: ...the honorary secretary of the Cheshire Beekeepers' Association.

defs.def_en: Honorary is used to describe an official job that is done without payment.

ext.ext_cn: 无赖！骗子！
ext.ext_en: The cad! The bounder!

defs.def_en: If you call a man a bounder, you mean he behaves in an unkind, deceitful, or selfish way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 怕照相的;怕上镜头的;怯镜头的
defs.def_en: Someone who is camera-shy is nervous and uncomfortable about being filmed or about having their photograph taken.

ext.ext_cn: 尤其是在四五月份，不计其数的野花盛开，山谷里一片绚烂色彩。
ext.ext_en: Millions of wild flowers colour the valleys, especially in April and May...

ext.ext_cn: 每两个小时重新涂一次防晒油，尤其是在游泳的时候。
ext.ext_en: Re-apply sunscreen every two hours, especially if you have been swimming.

defs.def_en: You use especially to emphasize that what you are saying applies more to one person, thing, or area than to any others.

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿散热比成年人快得多，在出生后的头一个月特别容易感冒。
ext.ext_en: Babies lose heat much faster than adults, and are especially vulnerable to the cold in their first month.

defs.def_en: You use especially to emphasize a characteristic or quality.

ext.ext_cn: 她清澈的蓝眼睛
ext.ext_en: ...her pellucid blue eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 温暖清澈的水
ext.ext_en: ...the warm pellucid water.

defs.def_en: Something that is pellucid is extremely clear.

ext.ext_cn: 尽情狂欢、山吃海喝、走亲访友的时刻
ext.ext_en: ...a time of merry-making, feasting and visiting friends.

defs.def_en: Merry-making is the activities of people who are enjoying themselves together in a lively way, for example by eating, drinking, or dancing.

ext.ext_cn: 她有一口漂亮整齐的牙齿。
ext.ext_en: She had very pretty straight teeth...

ext.ext_cn: 如果某颗牙松动得很厉害，牙医会建议把它拔掉。
ext.ext_en: If a tooth feels very loose, your dentist may recommend that it's taken out.

defs.def_en: Your teeth are the hard white objects in your mouth, which you use for biting and chewing.

defs.def_cn: 齿状物;(梳子、锯、齿轮、拉链等的)齿

ext.ext_cn: 前齿轮有 44 个齿。
ext.ext_en: The front cog has 44 teeth.

defs.def_en: The teeth of something such as a comb, saw, cog, or zip are the parts that stick out in a row on its edge.

defs.def_cn: (官方组织、法律等的)威力，效力

ext.ext_cn: 反对派争辩说新委员会不但违反宪法，而且没有效力。
ext.ext_en: The opposition argues that the new council will be unconstitutional and without teeth...

ext.ext_cn: 法律必须拥有效力，而且必须强制实施。
ext.ext_en: The law must have teeth, and it must be enforced.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as an official group or a law has teeth, you mean that it has power and is able to be effective.

ext.ext_cn: 双方都全副武装。
ext.ext_en: Both sides were armed to the teeth.

defs.def_en: Someone who is armed to the teeth is armed with a lot of weapons or with very effective weapons.

defs.def_cn: 获得初步经验(或训练);起步

ext.ext_cn: 从邦德电影开始初试牛刀的导演约翰·格伦
ext.ext_en: ...director John Glen, who cut his teeth on Bond movies...

ext.ext_cn: 他 60 年代刚出道时在爱丁堡特拉弗斯剧院担任导演。
ext.ext_en: He cut his teeth in the sixties as director of Edinburgh's Traverse Theatre.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone cut their teeth doing a particular thing, at a particular time, or in a particular place, you mean that that is how, when, or where they began their career and learned some of their skills.

defs.def_cn: 使人感到极其不舒服(或恼怒)

ext.ext_cn: 他们的声音让你浑身不舒服。
ext.ext_en: Their voices set your teeth on edge.

defs.def_en: If you say that something sets your teeth on edge, you mean that you find it extremely unpleasant or irritating.

defs.def_cn: 奋力争取/竭尽全力阻止

ext.ext_cn: 他竭尽全力保住自己的工作。
ext.ext_en: He fought tooth and nail to keep his job...

ext.ext_cn: 工会许诺会“竭尽所能地”阻止任何强制裁员。
ext.ext_en: Unions pledged to fight any compulsory redundancies 'tooth and nail'.

defs.def_en: If you fight tooth and nail to do something, you do everything you can in order to achieve it. If you fight something tooth and nail, you do everything you can in order to prevent it.

ext.ext_cn: 这一角色让她全情投入其中。
ext.ext_en: This role gave her something to get her teeth into...

ext.ext_cn: 他们必须参与进来，全力投入到一些警务工作中。
ext.ext_en: They have to get involved and get their teeth into some police work.

defs.def_en: If you describe a task or activity as something you can get your teeth into, you mean that you like it because it is interesting, complex, and makes you think hard.

ext.ext_cn: 我不顾十级大风沿着步行街挣扎前行。
ext.ext_en: I was battling my way along the promenade in the teeth of a force ten gale...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管面对 20 世纪 30 年代以来持续时间最长的经济衰退，这家公司却一直经营良好。
ext.ext_en: In the teeth of the longest recession since the 1930s, the company continues to perform well.

defs.def_en: If you do something in the teeth of a difficulty or danger, you do it in spite of the difficulty or danger.

defs.def_cn: 满口谎话;睁着眼说瞎话
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is lying through their teeth, you are emphasizing that they are telling lies.

ext.ext_cn: 我现在才去读大学本科不是有点太老了吗？
ext.ext_en: Aren't I a bit long in the tooth to start being an undergraduate?

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as long in the tooth, you are saying unkindly or humorously that they are old or getting old.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你喜欢吃甜的就多加点蜂蜜。
ext.ext_en: Add more honey if you have a sweet tooth.

defs.def_en: If you have a sweet tooth, you like sweet food very much.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (书、解释或信息)压缩的，精简的

ext.ext_cn: 地方议会只得到了华盛顿已披露内容的压缩版。
ext.ext_en: The Council was merely given a condensed version of what had already been disclosed in Washington.

defs.def_en: A condensed book, explanation, or piece of information has been made shorter, usually by including only the most important parts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 蘑菇浓汤
ext.ext_en: ...condensed mushroom soup.

defs.def_en: Condensed liquids have been made thicker by removing some of the water in them.

ext.ext_cn: 美国的航天工业
ext.ext_en: ...the US aerospace industry.

defs.def_en: Aerospace companies are involved in developing and making rockets, missiles, space vehicles, and related equipment.

ext.ext_cn: 他们等待团体作决定而不是各自作出决定。
ext.ext_en: They wait for the group to decide rather than making individual decisions...

ext.ext_cn: 对个别国家的援助会与其民主进程相挂钩。
ext.ext_en: Aid to individual countries would be linked to progress towards democracy...

defs.def_en: Individual means relating to one person or thing, rather than to a large group.

ext.ext_cn: 一些在我们社区内做好事却不留名的个人
ext.ext_en: ...anonymous individuals who are doing good things within our community.

ext.ext_cn: 个人的权利和责任
ext.ext_en: ...the rights and responsibilities of the individual...

defs.def_en: An individual is a person.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那其实都是她独特个性的表现。
ext.ext_en: It was really all part of her very individual personality...

ext.ext_cn: 语言非常独特。
ext.ext_en: The language is highly individual.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as individual, you mean that you admire them because they are very unusual and do not try to imitate other people or things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 百科全书般的;知识丰富的

ext.ext_cn: 他在药品方面学识广博。
ext.ext_en: He had an encyclopaedic knowledge of drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎包罗万象的卷册
ext.ext_en: ...an almost overwhelmingly encyclopaedic volume.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as encyclopedic, you mean that it is very full, complete, and thorough in the amount of knowledge or information that it has.

defs.def_cn: 强制性的; 法定的;义务的

ext.ext_cn: 65岁的法定退休年龄
ext.ext_en: ...the mandatory retirement age of 65...

ext.ext_cn: 务必参加。
ext.ext_en: Attendance is mandatory.

defs.def_en: If an action or procedure is mandatory, people have to do it, because it is a rule or a law.

ext.ext_cn: 谋杀罪必然会面临的终身监禁
ext.ext_en: ...the mandatory life sentence for murder.

ext.ext_cn: 为期四年的强制禁令
ext.ext_en: ...the four-year ban which is mandatory.

defs.def_en: If a crime carries a mandatory punishment, that punishment is fixed by law for all cases, in contrast to crimes for which the judge or magistrate has to decide the punishment for each particular case.

defs.def_cn: 例如（用于名词前或引出另一个句子）

ext.ext_cn: 我们需要各方面的帮手：工程师、科学家（例如地质学家）和教师。
ext.ext_en: We need helpers of all types, engineers, scientists (e.g. geologists) and teachers...

ext.ext_cn: 或者考虑你该如何获取这些技术，比如再修读几门课程。
ext.ext_en: Or consider how you can acquire these skills, e.g. by taking extra courses.

defs.def_en: e.g. is an abbreviation that means 'for example'. It is used before a noun, or to introduce another sentence.

defs.def_cn: 冷冻剂;冷却液;散热剂;制冷剂
defs.def_en: Coolant is a liquid used to keep a machine or engine cool while it is operating.
A best-selling product such as a book is very popular and a large quantity of it has been sold.
A best-selling author is an author who has sold a very large number of copies of his or her book.

defs.def_cn: (演讲或表演结束后观众的)起立鼓掌
defs.def_en: If a speaker or performer gets a standing ovation when they have finished speaking or performing, the audience stands up to clap in order to show its admiration or support.

ext.ext_cn: 众议院投票表决将核试验暂停一年。
ext.ext_en: The House voted to impose a one-year moratorium on nuclear testing.

defs.def_en: A moratorium on a particular activity or process is the stopping of it for a fixed period of time, usually as a result of an official agreement.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数监事会一年只开两次会议。
ext.ext_en: Most supervisory boards meet only twice a year.

ext.ext_cn: 辅助监督工作的职员
ext.ext_en: ...staff with a minor supervisory role.

defs.def_en: Supervisory means involved in supervising people, activities, or places.

ext.ext_cn: 逆风骑车
ext.ext_en: ...riding a bike upwind...

ext.ext_cn: 有钱人搬去伦敦西区住，远离尘世的喧嚣。
ext.ext_en: The rich went to live in the west of London, upwind of the smell of people and industry.

defs.def_en: If something moves upwind, it moves in the opposite direction to the wind. If something is upwind, the wind is blowing away from it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不会丢失的;志在必得的;稳操胜券的

ext.ext_cn: 我们作为消费者在把闲钱花掉之前，需要确信自己不会失业。
ext.ext_en: We as consumers need to feel confident that our jobs are safe before we will spend spare cash...

ext.ext_cn: 保守党能否继续实行国民医疗保健制度？
ext.ext_en: Is the National Health Service safe with the Conservative party?...

defs.def_en: If something you have or expect to obtain is safe, you cannot lose it or be prevented from having it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行动)风险小的，万无一失的，保险的

ext.ext_cn: 电力股仍然是低风险投资。
ext.ext_en: Electricity shares are still a safe investment...

ext.ext_cn: 总统离开国家可能会有政治上的危险。
ext.ext_en: It might not be safe politically for the President to leave the country.

defs.def_en: A safe course of action is one in which there is very little risk of loss or failure.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 四平八稳的;缺乏新意的;不够刺激的

ext.ext_cn: 趁年轻改行从事律师这一看似稳定的职业的失意落泊的艺术家们
ext.ext_en: ...frustrated artists who became lawyers at an early age because it seemed a safe option...

ext.ext_cn: 摇滚乐自从朋克乐以后就已经过于商业化而缺乏新意了。
ext.ext_en: Rock'n'roll has become so commercialised and safe since punk.

defs.def_en: If you disapprove of something because you think it is not very exciting or original, you can describe it as safe .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有把握的;不会有错的;可以肯定的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为可以肯定地说学校里很少有学生肯为学好功课下功夫。
ext.ext_en: I think it is safe to say that very few students expend the effort to do quality work in school...

ext.ext_cn: 唯一可以断定的是世界金融市场将不得不自己寻找出路。
ext.ext_en: The only safe assumption is that the world's financial markets will have to find solutions themselves.

defs.def_en: If it is safe to say or assume something, you can say it with very little risk of being wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (秘密)不会被泄漏的，会被保守的，安全的

ext.ext_cn: 别担心，佩林先生，我会保守你的秘密。
ext.ext_en: Don't worry, Mr Palin, your secret is safe with me.

defs.def_en: If you say to someone that their secret is safe with you, you are promising not to tell it to anyone.

ext.ext_cn: 文件目前放在一个只有他才能打开的保险柜里。
ext.ext_en: The files are now in a safe to which only he has the key.

defs.def_en: A safe is a strong metal cupboard with special locks, in which you keep money, jewellery, or other valuable things.

defs.def_cn: 得到妥善照顾的;由可靠的人保护(或保管)的

ext.ext_cn: 我负有确保这些包裹得到妥善保管的重大责任。
ext.ext_en: I had a huge responsibility to ensure these packets remained in safe hands...

ext.ext_cn: 别担心，蒂姆大叔，你将来由我们照顾。
ext.ext_en: Don't worry, Uncle Tim, your future is safe in our hands.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or thing is in safe hands, or is safe in someone's hands, you mean that they are being looked after by a reliable person and will not be harmed.

defs.def_cn: 非常安全的;绝对安全的

ext.ext_cn: 英国政府坚称英国的核电站非常安全。
ext.ext_en: The Government insisted that Britain's nuclear power stations are as safe as houses.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is as safe as houses, you mean that they are completely safe.

defs.def_cn: 使(某地)适合开展(某活动);使适宜

ext.ext_cn: 为什么这些人战死了呢？据说，是为了在全世界实现民主。
ext.ext_en: Why did these men fight and die? Supposedly it was to make the world safe for democracy.

defs.def_en: If someone tries to make a place safe for a particular activity, they try to make the place suitable for that activity, although their efforts may have very undesirable effects.

ext.ext_cn: 如果想要谨慎点的话，就减少盐的摄入量。
ext.ext_en: If you want to play safe, cut down on the amount of salt you eat...

ext.ext_cn: 飞行员认为克赖斯特彻奇距离太远，为求稳妥，就降落在了惠灵顿。
ext.ext_en: The pilot decided that Christchurch was too far away, and played it safe and landed at Wellington.

defs.def_en: If you play safe or play it safe, you do not take any risks.

defs.def_cn: 谨慎为是;以防万一;为安全起见

ext.ext_cn: 不过，为稳妥起见，你可能还想要照一个 X 光。
ext.ext_en: You might still want to go for an X-ray, however, just to be on the safe side.

defs.def_en: If you say you are doing something to be on the safe side, you mean that you are doing it in case something undesirable happens, even though this may be unnecessary.

defs.def_cn: 宁可事先谨慎有余，不要事后追悔莫及

ext.ext_cn: 不要害怕找医生检查一下——宁求稳妥以免后悔！
ext.ext_en: Don't be afraid to have this checked by a doctor — better safe than sorry!

defs.def_en: If you say 'it's better to be safe than sorry', you are advising someone to take action in order to avoid possible unpleasant consequences later, even if this seems unnecessary.

defs.def_cn: 平平安安的;安然无恙的

ext.ext_cn: 我只希望不管特雷弗在哪里，他都能平平安安回家。
ext.ext_en: All I'm hoping for is that wherever Trevor is he will come home safe and sound.

defs.def_en: You say that someone is safe and sound when they are still alive or unharmed after being in danger.

ext.ext_cn: 贝蒂蹲坐在地板上。
ext.ext_en: Betty hunkered down on the floor...

ext.ext_cn: 他最终在她身边蹲了下来。
ext.ext_en: He ended up hunkering down beside her.

defs.def_en: If you hunker down, you bend your knees so that you are in a low position, balancing on your feet.

defs.def_cn: 保持低调;避免引人注目

ext.ext_cn: 他们目前的策略是保持低调，让事态慢慢平息。
ext.ext_en: Their strategy for the moment is to hunker down and let the fuss die down.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone hunkers down, you mean that they are trying to avoid doing things that will make them noticed or put them in danger.

defs.def_cn: (运输或储藏物品的)板条箱，大木箱

ext.ext_cn: 一堆大木箱
ext.ext_en: ...a pile of wooden crates...

ext.ext_cn: 起重机已经开始卸载木箱和托盘了。
ext.ext_en: A crane was already unloading crates and pallets.

defs.def_en: A crate is a large box used for transporting or storing things.

ext.ext_cn: 经过大修的刨子被装入木箱运回去。
ext.ext_en: The much repaired plane was crated for the return journey.

defs.def_en: If something is crated, it is packed in a crate so that it can be transported or stored somewhere safely.

defs.def_cn: (运送瓶子用的)塑料分格箱，金属分隔箱

ext.ext_cn: 我们还获得了一次参加有奖智力竞赛的机会，奖品是成箱的啤酒！
ext.ext_en: We've also got a bonus quiz with crates of beer as prizes!

ext.ext_cn: 我们还获得了一次参加有奖智力竞赛的机会，奖品是成箱的啤酒！
ext.ext_en: We've also got a bonus quiz with crates of beer as prizes!

defs.def_en: A crate is a plastic or wire box divided into sections which is used for carrying bottles.

ext.ext_cn: 他向其中一个指控他的人发了传票。
ext.ext_en: He issued a writ against one of his accusers.

defs.def_en: A writ is a legal document that orders a person to do a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他们现在不得不处理由于过去工作不力所遗留下的问题,这在资产负债表上一看便知。
ext.ext_en: They now have to cope with the legacy of their past incompetence writ large on their balance sheets.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is writ large, you mean that it is very obvious.

ext.ext_cn: 她的生活是她性格放大了的写照。
ext.ext_en: Her life was her personality writ large.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing is another thing writ large, you mean that the first thing is a larger or more exaggerated version of the second thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 容易注意到的;显著的;明显的

ext.ext_cn: 显而易见，女性不像男人们那样好勇斗狠。
ext.ext_en: It is noticeable that women do not have the rivalry that men have...

ext.ext_cn: 这些变化带来的最明显效果体现在人们现在一起工作的方式上。
ext.ext_en: The most noticeable effect of these changes is in the way people are now working together.

defs.def_en: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

defs.def_cn: 选择;(尤指)勉强接受,将就

ext.ext_cn: 弗吉尼娅是个完美主义者，她根本不愿意拿任何普普通通毫无特色的东西将就。
ext.ext_en: Virginia was a perfectionist. She was just not prepared to settle for anything mediocre...

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰将只好接受第三或第四的排名。
ext.ext_en: England will have to settle for third or fourth place.

defs.def_en: If you settle for something, you choose or accept it, especially when it is not what you really want but there is nothing else available.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 色彩鲜艳的;富于色彩的

ext.ext_cn: 花儿五颜六色，景色蔚为壮观。
ext.ext_en: The flowers were colourful and the scenery magnificent...

ext.ext_cn: 人们穿着五颜六色的衣服，似乎玩得很开心。
ext.ext_en: People wore colorful clothes and seemed to be having a good time.

defs.def_en: Something that is colourful has bright colours or a lot of different colours.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 生动有趣的;丰富多彩的

ext.ext_cn: 她讲的故事确实很有趣，涉及了她在英格兰、德国和西班牙的生活。
ext.ext_en: The story she told was certainly colourful, and extended over her life in England, Germany and Spain.

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家丰富多彩而又常常充满暴力的历史
ext.ext_en: ...the country's colourful and often violent history.

defs.def_en: A colourful story is full of exciting details.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 凯西·施滕格尔可能是棒球界最有趣的人物。
ext.ext_en: Casey Stengel was probably the most colorful character in baseball.

defs.def_en: A colourful character is a person who behaves in an interesting and amusing way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 多姿多彩的;富于刺激性的

ext.ext_cn: 随着故事的发展，更多有关她不同寻常的过去的细节开始为人所知。
ext.ext_en: More details surfaced of her colourful past as the story developed.

ext.ext_cn: 经历相当丰富的伦敦知名企业家
ext.ext_en: ...a well-known City business man with a rather colourful background.

defs.def_en: If someone has had a colourful past or a colourful career, they have been involved in exciting but often slightly shocking things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 据称布赖恩特言语粗鲁。
ext.ext_en: Bryant is alleged to have used colourful language.

defs.def_en: Colourful language is rude or offensive language.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有复仇心理的；图谋报复的;想报仇的

ext.ext_cn: 他被图谋报复的妻子拿刀捅死了。
ext.ext_en: He was stabbed to death by his vengeful wife...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为自己并不比其他人更冷酷，也不比别人更爱报复。
ext.ext_en: He did not think he was any more cruel, any more vengeful than other men.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as vengeful, you are critical of them because they feel a great desire for revenge.

defs.def_cn: 鸿沟；严重分歧；巨大的差距

ext.ext_cn: 社会上的贫富差距正在逐渐加大。
ext.ext_en: Within society, there is a growing gulf between rich and poor.

ext.ext_cn: 城乡生活的巨大差异
ext.ext_en: ...the gulf between rural and urban life.

defs.def_en: A gulf is an important or significant difference between two people, things, or groups.

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚，飓风“安德鲁”进入了墨西哥湾。
ext.ext_en: Hurricane Andrew was last night heading into the Gulf of Mexico.

defs.def_en: A gulf is a large area of sea which extends a long way into the surrounding land.

defs.def_cn: 神话的;只存在于神话中的

ext.ext_cn: 亚瑟王这一传奇人物
ext.ext_en: ...the mythic figure of King  Arthur.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is mythic exists only in myths and is therefore imaginary.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 声名显赫的球队
ext.ext_en: ...a team whose reputation has achieved mythic proportions...

ext.ext_cn: 他迅速升任要职，这让他在业界近乎被神化了。
ext.ext_en: His rapid rise to power has given him a near-mythic status in the industry.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as mythic, you mean that they have become very famous or important.

defs.def_cn: （门上的）信件投递孔；（建筑物入口处的）信箱
defs.def_en: A letterbox is a rectangular hole in a door or a small box at the entrance to a building into which letters and small parcels are delivered.

defs.def_cn: （电视或计算机显示）信箱格式的，上下黑边的，宽屏的
defs.def_en: If something is displayed on a television or computer screen in letterbox format, it is displayed across the middle of the screen with dark bands at the top and bottom of the screen.
Digital television is television in which the signals are transmitted in digital form and decoded by the television receiver.

ext.ext_cn: 宽屏数字电视机
ext.ext_en: ...wide screen digital televisions.

defs.def_en: A digital television is a television that can receive digital signals.

defs.def_cn: （尤指汽车前座上的）头靠，头枕
defs.def_en: A headrest is the part of the back of a seat on which you can lean your head, especially one on the front seat of a car.

ext.ext_cn: 妇女儿童受压迫的主要原因是父权制。
ext.ext_en: The main cause of women's and children's oppression is patriarchy.

defs.def_en: Patriarchy is a system in which men have all or most of the power and importance in a society or group.
A patriarchy is a patriarchal society.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她被逼谈论此事时开始泪如雨下。
ext.ext_en: She became very tearful when pressed to talk about it.

ext.ext_cn: 含泪道别
ext.ext_en: ...a tearful farewell.

defs.def_en: If someone is tearful, their face or voice shows signs that they have been crying or that they want to cry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她学习了8种外语，但是只能流利地说其中 6 种。
ext.ext_en: She studied eight foreign languages but is fluent in only six of them...

ext.ext_cn: 他说一口流利的俄语。
ext.ext_en: He speaks fluent Russian.

defs.def_en: Someone who is fluent in a particular language can speak the language easily and correctly. You can also say that someone speaks fluent French, Chinese, or some other language.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (语言或文字)流畅的，熟练的;文笔好的

ext.ext_cn: 他从一个吞吞吐吐、缺乏自信的候选人成长为口若悬河的辩论者。
ext.ext_en: He had emerged from being a hesitant and unsure candidate into a fluent debater.

defs.def_en: If your speech, reading, or writing is fluent, you speak, read, or write easily, smoothly, and clearly with no mistakes.

ext.ext_cn: 所以萨拉把她旧的毛衣和长裙打包寄给了简。
ext.ext_en: So Sarah bagged up her old woollies and frocks and sent a parcel off to Jane.

defs.def_en: If you bag up a quantity of something, you put it into bags.
A serviceman is a man who is in the army, navy, or air force.

defs.def_cn: 使措手不及;使仓皇失措;使方寸大乱

ext.ext_cn: 他最新发布的声明让支持者大呼意外,令反对者方寸大乱。
ext.ext_en: He has surprised his supporters and wrong-footed his opponents with his latest announcement.

defs.def_en: If you wrong-foot someone, you surprise them by putting them into an unexpected or difficult situation.

defs.def_cn: 严格执行纪律的人;主张服从命令的人

ext.ext_cn: 他是个退役中校，有点军人作风。
ext.ext_en: He's a retired Lieutenant Colonel and a bit of a martinet.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a martinet, you are criticizing them because they are very strict and demand that people obey their rules and orders.

ext.ext_cn: 他们幸福无忧地呆在自己的社交圈子里。
ext.ext_en: They stayed, safe and happy, within their own social milieu...

ext.ext_cn: 他生于艺术之家。
ext.ext_en: His natural milieu is that of the arts.

defs.def_en: Your milieu is the group of people or activities that you live among or are familiar with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 该机器的精妙之处在于其构架呈流线型。
ext.ext_en: The secret of the machine lies in the aerodynamic shape of the frame.

defs.def_en: If something such as a car has an aerodynamic shape or design, it goes faster and uses less fuel than other cars because the air passes over it more easily.

defs.def_cn: 从政者，政治家（尤指议会或国会成员）

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经逮捕了数名反对党领袖。
ext.ext_en: They have arrested a number of leading opposition politicians.

defs.def_en: A politician is a person whose job is in politics, especially a member of parliament or congress.

defs.def_cn: 无意的;并非故意的;因疏忽造成的

ext.ext_cn: 政府声称那是因疏忽造成的过失。
ext.ext_en: The government has said it was an inadvertent error.

defs.def_en: An inadvertent action is one that you do without realizing what you are doing.
Liniment is a liquid that you rub into your skin in order to reduce pain or stiffness.
Baking powder is an ingredient used in cake making. It causes cakes to rise when they are in the oven.

defs.def_cn: (因其政治观点或活动而)被拘留者，被扣押者
defs.def_en: A detainee is someone who is held prisoner by a government because of his or her political views or activities.

defs.def_cn: 独裁政府;独裁统治;专政

ext.ext_cn: 该国长期军事独裁后迎来的一个新的民主时代
ext.ext_en: ...a new era of democracy after a long period of military dictatorship in the country.

ext.ext_cn: 由独裁政府统治的国家
ext.ext_en: ...countries which are ruled by dictatorships.

defs.def_en: Dictatorship is government by a dictator.

ext.ext_cn: 该地区的所有国家都是军事独裁国家。
ext.ext_en: Every country in the region was a military dictatorship.

defs.def_en: A dictatorship is a country which is ruled by a dictator or by a very strict and harsh government.

defs.def_cn: 可以起诉的；可提起诉讼的
defs.def_en: If something that you do or say to someone is actionable, it gives them a valid reason for bringing a legal case against you.

ext.ext_cn: 他走开去把湿衬衫拧干。
ext.ext_en: He turned away to wring out the wet shirt...

ext.ext_cn: 将一块小毛巾浸在液体中，拧干后敷在腹部。
ext.ext_en: Soak a small towel in the liquid, wring it out, then apply to the abdomen.

defs.def_en: When you wring out a wet cloth or a wet piece of clothing, you squeeze the water out of it by twisting it strongly.

defs.def_cn: （船舶航行途中的）停靠港，靠泊港

ext.ext_cn: 他们的第一个停靠港将是开普敦。
ext.ext_en: Their first port of call will be Cape Town.

defs.def_en: A port of call is a place where a ship stops during a journey.

defs.def_cn: （途中）逗留的地方，临时落脚点

ext.ext_cn: 当地旅游局应该是你到任何一个城市后的第一站。
ext.ext_en: The local tourist office should be your first port of call in any town.

defs.def_en: A port of call is any place where you stop for a short time when you are visiting several places, shops, or people.

ext.ext_cn: 他做了个鬼脸，然后仔细打量着同事。
ext.ext_en: He grimaced and looked narrowly at his colleague.

defs.def_en: See also:narrow;If you look at someone narrowly, you look at them in a concentrated way, often because you think they are not giving you full information about something.

defs.def_cn: 寡头组织；寡头统治集团；寡头统治的国家

ext.ext_cn: 雅典当时饱受寡头集团的统治，他们对人民的福祉毫不关心。
ext.ext_en: Athens was suffering under the rule of an oligarchy that had no concern for the people's welfare.

defs.def_en: An oligarchy is a small group of people who control and run a particular country or organization. You can also refer to a country which is governed in this way as an oligarchy .

ext.ext_cn: 对该地区帝国主义和寡头政治的抗议
ext.ext_en: ...a protest against imperialism and oligarchy in the region.

defs.def_en: Oligarchy is a situation in which a country or organization is run by an oligarchy.
The recessional is a religious song which is sung at the end of a church service.

defs.def_cn: 经济衰退的;经济不景气的

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The current electoral law is still heavily weighted in favour of the ruling party...

ext.ext_cn: 他们说和平进程对他们十分不利，根本不会取得任何成果。
ext.ext_en: They say the peace process is so heavily weighted against them that it will never achieve results.

defs.def_en: A system that is weighted in favour of a particular person or group is organized so that this person or group has an advantage.
A masseur is a person whose job is to give massages.

ext.ext_cn: 传统歌曲集锦
ext.ext_en: ...a medley of traditional songs.

defs.def_en: In music, a  medley is a collection of different tunes or songs that are played one after the other as a single piece of music.

ext.ext_cn: 日本赢得了男子200米个人混合泳比赛。
ext.ext_en: Japan won the Men's 200 metres Individual Medley.

defs.def_en: In sport, a medley is a swimming race in which the four main strokes are used one after the other.

ext.ext_cn: 奶油四喜鱼
ext.ext_en: ...a medley of four fish in a cream sauce...

ext.ext_cn: 我们边说着外语，边打着通用的手势进行交流。
ext.ext_en: We communicated in a medley of foreign words and universal gestures.

defs.def_en: A medley of different foods or other things is a mixture of them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 过分沉溺的;过分迷恋的

ext.ext_cn: 但在那之前，当局并没有特别注意，因为高层官员们都一门心思扑在科威特上。
ext.ext_en: But by then the administration wasn't paying attention, for top officials were fixated on Kuwait.

ext.ext_cn: 痴迷于流行乐的音乐记者
ext.ext_en: ...a pop-fixated music journalist.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of being fixated on a particular thing, you mean that they think about it to an extreme and excessive degree.

defs.def_cn: 名义上的;有名无实的;徒有虚名的

ext.ext_cn: 他是名义上的首脑，不过偶尔签字批准法律法规。
ext.ext_en: He is titular head, and merely signs laws occasionally.

defs.def_en: A titular job or position has a name that makes it seem important, although the person who has it is not really important or powerful.

ext.ext_cn: 皇家莎士比亚剧院——许多到这座城镇来旅游的游客的观光重点
ext.ext_en: ...the focal point for the town's many visitors—the Royal Shakespeare Theatre.

defs.def_en: The focal point of something is the thing that people concentrate on or pay most attention to.

ext.ext_cn: “和你谈话很高兴。”——“我也一样。”
ext.ext_en: 'Nice to talk to you.' — 'Nice to talk to you too.'...

ext.ext_cn: “我感觉这次一定没问题。”——“我也是。”
ext.ext_en: 'I've got a great feeling about it.'  — 'Me too.'...

defs.def_en: You use too after mentioning another person, thing, or aspect that a previous statement applies to or includes.

defs.def_cn: (用于补充性信息或评论之后，表示强调)而且，还

ext.ext_cn: 我们确实学会了阅读，而且学得很快。
ext.ext_en: We did learn to read, and quickly too...

ext.ext_cn: 人们通常把它看作“男孩读物”，它当然是，而且还是本很不错的男孩读物。
ext.ext_en: People usually think of it as a 'boys' book', which of course it is, and a very good one too.

defs.def_en: You use too after adding a piece of information or a comment to a statement, in order to emphasize that it is surprising or important.

ext.ext_cn: “那笔钱是我的。”——“当然是你的，而且也理应如此。”
ext.ext_en: 'That money's mine.' — 'Of course it is, and quite right too.'...

ext.ext_cn: “哦，请原谅。”——“你确实应该感到抱歉。”
ext.ext_en: 'Oh excuse me.' — 'I should think so too.'...

defs.def_en: You use too at the end of a sentence to emphasize an opinion that you have added after a statement made by you or by another person.

defs.def_cn: (幽默或孩子气地坚持己见)确实地，无可否认地

ext.ext_cn: “我过生日想要一辆自行车。”——“不行。”——“我就要。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'm getting a bike for my birthday.' — 'You are not.' – 'I am too.'

defs.def_en: You use too in order to emphasize in a humorous or childish way that you disagree with what someone else has said or that you refuse to obey them.

ext.ext_cn: 过于肥大的皮裤会让你看起来块头更大。
ext.ext_en: Leather jeans that are too big will make you look larger...

ext.ext_cn: 鸡蛋不应保存在冰箱里，温度太低了。
ext.ext_en: Eggs shouldn't be kept in the fridge, it's too cold...

defs.def_en: You use too in order to indicate that there is a greater amount or degree of something than is desirable, necessary, or acceptable.

defs.def_cn: (与否定词连用，表示缓和语气、礼貌或谨慎)太，十分

ext.ext_cn: 美国人从不急于离开他们热爱的国家。
ext.ext_en: Americans are never too keen to leave their beloved country…

ext.ext_cn: 我对于目前已写完的这些并不太满意。
ext.ext_en: I wasn't too happy with what I'd written so far...

defs.def_en: You use too with a negative to make what you are saying sound less forceful or more polite or cautious.

defs.def_cn: (表示感谢，较为正式)极其，非常

ext.ext_cn: “我会设法为你弄来一个蛋糕。”——“噢，安，你真是太好了。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'll try and get you a cake.' — 'Oh Ann you're too kind.'

defs.def_en: You use too when you want to emphasize in a fairly formal way your thanks to someone for something that they have done for you.

ext.ext_cn: 她记得太清楚了。
ext.ext_en: She remembered it all too well...

ext.ext_cn: 我们应对健康的身体心存感恩，这一点她太清楚了。
ext.ext_en: She is all too aware that we should be grateful for good health…

defs.def_en: You use all too or only too to emphasize that something happens to a greater extent or degree than is pleasant or desirable.

ext.ext_cn: 他们认为这已经为时已晚了。
ext.ext_en: They think this is too little too late…

ext.ext_cn: 政府如今正引入法律以减少空气污染。但这是否为时已晚了呢？
ext.ext_en: The government is now bringing in laws to reduce air pollution. But, is it a case of too little, too late?

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as too little too late, you are blaming someone for not doing enough to prevent a problem and for taking action only after the problem had become very bad.

ext.ext_cn: 他很有可能会把这事弄得一团糟。
ext.ext_en: He was in danger of making a real cock-up of this...

ext.ext_cn: 这纯粹是管理上的混乱。
ext.ext_en: This was just an administrative cock-up.

defs.def_en: If you make a cock-up of something, you ruin it by doing something wrong.

defs.def_cn: （某活动或信仰占优势的）中心区域，核心地区

ext.ext_cn: 他在美国工业中心区域的大巴6日游
ext.ext_en: ...his six-day bus tour around the industrial heartland of America...

ext.ext_cn: 受影响最严重的是伦敦及英国东南部的保守党核心势力地区。
ext.ext_en: Worst-hit areas were Tory heartlands in London and the South-East.

defs.def_en: Journalists use heartland or heartlands to refer to the area or region where a particular set of activities or beliefs is most significant.

defs.def_cn: （国家或大陆的）心脏地带，腹地

ext.ext_cn: 我们随后朝西前往波兰中部。
ext.ext_en: We then headed west towards the heartland of Poland...

ext.ext_cn: 对很多人来说，深入乡村腹地才能体验到真正的法国生活。
ext.ext_en: For many, the essence of French living is to be found in the rural heartlands.

defs.def_en: The most central area of a country or continent can be referred to as its heartland or heartlands.

ext.ext_cn: 他们将继续与不公平现象作斗争。
ext.ext_en: They'll continue to fight injustice...

ext.ext_cn: 他们怨恨制度的种种不公。
ext.ext_en: They resented the injustices of the system.

defs.def_en: Injustice is a lack of fairness in a situation.

defs.def_cn: 不公正地评判;不公正地对待

ext.ext_cn: 那篇文章对他们俩都不公。
ext.ext_en: The article does them both an injustice.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has done you an injustice, you mean that they have been unfair in the way that they have judged you or treated you.
Blusher is a coloured substance that women put on their cheeks.

defs.def_cn: 主题;题目;话题;题材;问题

ext.ext_cn: 是我第一个提到整形手术这个话题的。
ext.ext_en: It was I who first raised the subject of plastic surgery.

ext.ext_cn: 总统在此问题上的个人观点
ext.ext_en: ...the president's own views on the subject.

defs.def_en: The subject of something such as a conversation, letter, or book is the thing that is being discussed or written about.

ext.ext_cn: 在过去的几年里，梅雷迪思先生所采取的某些立场使他成为了批评的对象。
ext.ext_en: Over the past few years, some of the positions Mr. Meredith has adopted have made him the subject of criticism...

ext.ext_cn: 他现在是官方调查的对象。
ext.ext_en: He's now the subject of an official inquiry.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is the subject of criticism, study, or an investigation is being criticized, studied, or investigated.

defs.def_cn: (知识、研究)领域;(尤指)学科，科目，课程

ext.ext_cn: 令人惊讶的是，数学课被选为他们最喜欢的科目。
ext.ext_en: Surprisingly, mathematics was voted their favourite subject.

ext.ext_cn: 辅导数学和理科课程的家教
ext.ext_en: ...a tutor in maths and science subjects.

defs.def_en: A subject is an area of knowledge or study, especially one that you study at school, college, or university.

ext.ext_cn: 让受试者通过耳机听“白噪声”。
ext.ext_en: 'White noise' was played into the subject's ears through headphones...

ext.ext_cn: 要求研究对象按改进的食谱进食。
ext.ext_en: Subjects in the study were asked to follow a modified diet.

defs.def_en: In an experiment or piece of research, the subject is the person or animal that is being tested or studied.

defs.def_cn: (艺术的)表现对象;绘画(或拍摄)题材

ext.ext_cn: 她最喜爱的题材是那些在海边散步时发现的贝壳。
ext.ext_en: Her favourite subjects are shells spotted on beach walks.

defs.def_en: An artist's subjects are the people, animals, or objects that he or she paints, models, or photographs.

In grammar, the subject of a clause is the noun group that refers to the person or thing that is doing the action expressed by the verb. For example, in 'My cat keeps catching birds', 'my cat' is the subject.

defs.def_cn: 可能受…影响的;易遭受…的

ext.ext_cn: 价格可能会有所变动。
ext.ext_en: Prices may be subject to alteration...

ext.ext_cn: 另外，国债利息不需缴纳政府和地方所得税。
ext.ext_en: In addition, interest on Treasury issues isn't subject to state and local income taxes.

defs.def_en: To be subject to something means to be affected by it or to be likely to be affected by it.

ext.ext_cn: 因为琼斯先生不受一般的治安条例法规约束，所以专门设立了特别法庭。
ext.ext_en: The tribunal is unique because Mr Jones is not subject to the normal police discipline code.

ext.ext_cn: 争论说作为一个主权国家其不受其他国家法律的约束
ext.ext_en: ...arguing that as a sovereign state it could not be subject to another country's laws.

defs.def_en: If someone is subject to a particular set of rules or laws, they have to obey those rules or laws.

ext.ext_cn: 使她遭受了 4 年毒打和辱骂的男人
ext.ext_en: ...the man who had subjected her to four years of beatings and abuse...

ext.ext_cn: 无辜的平民正被逮捕并遭受非人的虐待。
ext.ext_en: Innocent civilians are being arrested and subjected to inhumane treatment.

defs.def_en: If you subject someone to something unpleasant, you make them experience it.

defs.def_cn: (通常指君主制国家的)国民，臣民

ext.ext_cn: 他的臣民把他视为伟大而英明的君主
ext.ext_en: ...his subjects regarded him as a great and wise monarch...

ext.ext_cn: 他们中大约有一半是英国国民。
ext.ext_en: Roughly half of them are British subjects.

defs.def_en: The people who live in or belong to a particular country, usually one ruled by a monarch, are the subjects of that monarch or country.

ext.ext_cn: 她的帝国中被迫向她臣服的民族迫切渴望自身的独立。
ext.ext_en: The subject peoples of her empire were anxious for their own independence.

ext.ext_cn: 殖民地和其他臣服的属地
ext.ext_en: ...colonies and other subject territories.

defs.def_en: Subject peoples and countries are ruled or controlled by the government of another country.

defs.def_cn: (通常因为谈论的话题令人尴尬而)转换话题

ext.ext_cn: 他努力想换个话题，但她却兴趣正浓。
ext.ext_en: He tried to change the subject, but she wasn't to be put off.

defs.def_en: When someone involved in a conversation changes the subject, they start talking about something else, often because the previous subject was embarrassing.

ext.ext_cn: 他们否认了宣称埃及已同意在特定条件下参加峰会的报道。
ext.ext_en: They denied a report that Egypt had agreed to a summit, subject to certain conditions.

defs.def_en: If an event will take place subject to a condition, it will take place only if that thing happens.

ext.ext_cn: 他身穿一件褪了色的红色法兰绒衬衫。
ext.ext_en: He wore a faded red flannel shirt.

defs.def_en: Flannel is a soft cloth, usually made of cotton or wool, that is used for making clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 穿着法兰绒裤子和夹克的体面小伙子们
ext.ext_en: ...respectable young chaps, dressed in flannels and blazers.

defs.def_en: Flannels are men's trousers made of flannel.
A flannel is a small cloth that you use for washing yourself.

defs.def_cn: 废话;敷衍的话;兜圈子的话

ext.ext_cn: 说多少废话都无法掩饰这最多只是一个极简主义的解决方案。
ext.ext_en: No amount of flannel could disguise that this was, at best, a minimalist solution.

defs.def_en: If you describe what someone has said as flannel, you disapprove because they have said a lot but they have avoided telling you what you wanted to know.

ext.ext_cn: 她带他参观了这处空房子的底楼。
ext.ext_en: She showed him around the ground floor of the empty house...

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮现住在一幢连排公寓的一层。
ext.ext_en: Jenny now lives in a terraced ground floor flat.

defs.def_en: The ground floor of a building is the floor that is level or almost level with the ground outside.

ext.ext_cn: 很多学生不在选民名册中。
ext.ext_en: Many students are not on the electoral register.

defs.def_en: An electoral register is an official list of all the people who have the right to vote in an election.

defs.def_cn: 康康舞(一种由女性表演的带有高踢腿动作的快节奏舞蹈)

ext.ext_cn: 从“红磨坊”来的康康舞演员
ext.ext_en: ...can-can dancers from the Moulin Rouge.

defs.def_en: The can-can is a dance in which women kick their legs in the air to fast music.

defs.def_cn: (不同思想、群体或社会的)趋同，融合

ext.ext_cn: 朝着经济进一步融合发展的需要
ext.ext_en: ...the need to move towards greater economic convergence...

ext.ext_cn: 资本主义公司和合作企业在经营战略方面趋于一致。
ext.ext_en: There is a convergence between capitalist firms and co-operatives in terms of business strategy.

defs.def_en: The convergence of different ideas, groups, or societies is the process by which they stop being different and become more similar.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 增进知识的;有教育意义的;有启发性的

ext.ext_cn: 把他的手法与艾伦·贝内特进行比较很富启发意义。
ext.ext_en: It's instructive to compare his technique with Alan Bennett's.

ext.ext_cn: 既富娱乐性又有教育意义的纪录片
ext.ext_en: ...an entertaining and instructive documentary.

defs.def_en: Something that is instructive gives useful information.

defs.def_cn: （美国大学或中学的）高年级生
defs.def_en: An upperclassman is a junior or senior student in an American high school, college, or university.

defs.def_cn: （罢工等时由纠察队员等组成的）纠察线

ext.ext_cn: 矿工正设法让工厂工人加入他们的纠察队人墙。
ext.ext_en: The miners are trying to get factory workers to join them on the picket line...

ext.ext_cn: 没人试图穿过纠察线。
ext.ext_en: No one tried to cross the picket lines.

defs.def_en: A picket line is a group of pickets outside a place of work.

ext.ext_cn: 现在在英国，几乎所有长途电话都通过光纤而非电缆传输。
ext.ext_en: Nearly every long-distance call made in Britain now travels on optical fibre instead of cable.

ext.ext_cn: 可连接所有家庭与办公室的光纤网络
ext.ext_en: ...an optical fibre network to which every home and office can be connected.

defs.def_en: An optical fibre is a very thin thread of glass inside a protective coating. Optical fibres are used to carry information in the form of light.

defs.def_cn: (使)(尤指身体部位)抽搐;(使)抽动;急拉;急扯

ext.ext_cn: 当我作出反抗时，她右侧脸庞就会开始抽搐。
ext.ext_en: When I stood up to her, her right cheek would begin to twitch...

ext.ext_cn: 他的左眼皮不由自主地跳动。
ext.ext_en: His left eyelid twitched involuntarily…

defs.def_en: If something, especially a part of your body, twitches or if you twitch it, it makes a little jumping movement.

ext.ext_cn: 他被指控为英国间谍，入狱关押了 5 年。
ext.ext_en: He was jailed for five years as an alleged British spy...

ext.ext_cn: 该间谍团伙向敌方传送秘密情报。
ext.ext_en: The spy ring passed secrets to the enemy.

defs.def_en: A spy is a person whose job is to find out secret information about another country or organization.
A spy satellite or spy plane obtains secret information about another country by taking photographs from the sky.

defs.def_cn: 从事间谍活动;充当间谍

ext.ext_cn: 该特工人员为东德做了 20 多年的间谍。
ext.ext_en: The agent spied for East Germany for more than twenty years...

ext.ext_cn: 东西方仍在互相进行间谍活动。
ext.ext_en: East and West are still spying on one another...

defs.def_en: Someone who spies for a country or organization tries to find out secret information about another country or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 那天，他假装在修剪灌木，秘密对她进行监视。
ext.ext_en: That day he spied on her while pretending to work on the shrubs...

ext.ext_cn: 他请人秘密监视自己的妻子，为离婚案搜集证据。
ext.ext_en: He had his wife spied on for evidence in a divorce case.

defs.def_en: If you spy on someone, you watch them secretly.

ext.ext_cn: 他正沿街走着，突然看见了一位老朋友。
ext.ext_en: He was walking down the street when he spied an old friend.

defs.def_en: If you spy someone or something, you notice them.

defs.def_cn: 拦畜沟栅(铺在路面上的金属架，防止牲畜通过，人、车可通行)
defs.def_en: A cattle grid is a set of metal bars in the surface of a road which prevents cattle and sheep from walking along the road, but allows people and vehicles to pass.
A press stud is a small metal object used to fasten clothes and is made up of two parts which can be pressed together.

defs.def_cn: (通常在船上玩的)掷环游戏，套圈游戏
defs.def_en: Quoits is a game which is played by throwing rings over a small post. Quoits is usually played on board ships.
A quoit is a ring used in the game of quoits.

ext.ext_cn: 谁是作者尚无定论。
ext.ext_en: Its authorship has been disputed.

defs.def_en: The authorship of a piece of writing is the identity of the person who wrote it.

ext.ext_cn: 这是她第一次尝试写作，结果证明非常成功。
ext.ext_en: It was her first try at authorship and proved a great success.

defs.def_en: Authorship is the activity or job of writing books or articles.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无最后结果的;无结论的

ext.ext_cn: 目前研究尚无定论。
ext.ext_en: Research has so far proved inconclusive...

ext.ext_cn: 我发现证据无说服力。
ext.ext_en: I find the evidence inconclusive.

defs.def_en: If research or evidence is inconclusive, it has not proved anything.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (竞赛、冲突)胜负不明的,无最后结果的

ext.ext_cn: 之前的两次选举都没有结果。
ext.ext_en: The past two elections were inconclusive.

ext.ext_cn: 8年没完没了的血腥战争
ext.ext_en: ...eight years of bloody and inconclusive war.

defs.def_en: If a contest or conflict is inconclusive, it is not clear who has won or who is winning.

ext.ext_cn: 人类生命的神圣
ext.ext_en: ...the sanctity of human life.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the sanctity of something, you mean that it is very important and must be treated with respect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 卡罗尔对没有升职很有情绪。
ext.ext_en: Carol is bolshy at not getting promotion.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is bolshy, you mean that they easily get angry and often do not do what other people want them to do.

defs.def_cn: 康塔塔(适合歌唱及演奏的短小音乐作品)
defs.def_en: A cantata is a fairly short musical work for singers and instruments.

ext.ext_cn: 红细胞生成不足是由缺铁引起的。
ext.ext_en: Deficiency of red corpuscles is caused by a lack of iron.

defs.def_en: Corpuscles are red or white blood cells.

defs.def_cn: （据信会搬动家具、乱扔东西等的）促狭鬼
defs.def_en: A poltergeist is a ghost or supernatural force which is believed to move furniture or throw objects around.

ext.ext_cn: 工会受法律的制约。
ext.ext_en: The trade unions are shackled by the law.

ext.ext_cn: 发现自己被高压工作所束缚的人们
ext.ext_en: ...people who find themselves shackled to a high-stress job.

ext.ext_cn: 决定摆脱过去殖民束缚的国家
ext.ext_en: ...a country ready to throw off the shackles of its colonial past.

defs.def_en: If you throw off the shackles of something, you reject it or free yourself from it because it was preventing you from doing what you wanted to do.

ext.ext_en: He unbolted the shackles on Billy's hands.

defs.def_en: Shackles are two metal rings joined by a chain which are fastened around someone's wrists or ankles in order to prevent them from moving or escaping.

ext.ext_en: ...the chains that were shackling his legs...

ext.ext_cn: 她被铐在一面墙上。
ext.ext_en: She was shackled to a wall.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他并没有像没头脑的人那样说蠢话。
ext.ext_en: He doesn't say those silly things that unthinking people say...

ext.ext_en: Bruce was no unthinking vandal.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is unthinking, you are critical of them because you consider that they do not think carefully about the effects of their behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 瑞士伯尔尼地区
ext.ext_en: ...the Swiss canton of Berne.

defs.def_en: A canton is a political or administrative region in some countries, for example Switzerland.

defs.def_cn: 把…不当回事;对…置之不理;对…满不在乎

ext.ext_en: He shrugged off the criticism...

ext.ext_cn: 他只是一笑了之,对此满不在乎。
ext.ext_en: He just laughed and shrugged it off.

defs.def_en: If you shrug something off, you ignore it or treat it as if it is not really important or serious.
A shroud is a cloth which is used for wrapping a dead body.

ext.ext_cn: 车身上覆着一层灰白色积雪的停放着的汽车
ext.ext_en: ...a parked car huddled under a shroud of grey snow...

ext.ext_cn: 部长们都一如既往地迫切想要将他们的行动搞得神神秘秘的。
ext.ext_en: Ministers are as keen as ever to wrap their activities in a shroud of secrecy.

defs.def_en: You can refer to something that surrounds an object or situation as a shroud of something.

ext.ext_cn: 多年以来表演教学一直蒙着神秘的面纱。
ext.ext_en: For years the teaching of acting has been shrouded in mystery.

ext.ext_cn: 笼罩着整件事的诡秘气氛
ext.ext_en: ...the secrecy which has shrouded the whole affair.

defs.def_en: If something has been shrouded in mystery or secrecy, very little information about it has been made available.

ext.ext_cn: 雾霭蒙蒙，白金汉宫若隐若现。
ext.ext_en: Mist shrouded the outline of Buckingham Palace.

defs.def_en: If darkness, fog, or smoke shrouds an area, it covers it so that it is difficult to see.

defs.def_cn: 无法控制的；控制不住的

ext.ext_cn: 那是一个几乎难以抑制亢奋的时期。
ext.ext_en: It had been a time of almost uncontrollable excitement...

ext.ext_cn: 威廉怒不可遏。
ext.ext_en: William was seized with uncontrollable rage...

defs.def_en: If you describe a feeling or physical action as uncontrollable, you mean that you cannot control it or prevent yourself from feeling or doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 马克沉默寡言，难以管束。
ext.ext_en: Mark was withdrawn and uncontrollable...

ext.ext_cn: 任性放肆的孩子会变成年轻的罪犯。
ext.ext_en: Uncontrollable children grow into young criminals.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as uncontrollable, you mean that their behaviour is bad and that nobody can make them behave more sensibly.

ext.ext_cn: 如果政治和民族问题得不到解决，局面可能会失控。
ext.ext_en: If political and ethnic problems are not resolved the situation could become uncontrollable.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation or series of events as uncontrollable, you believe that nothing can be done to control them or to prevent things from getting worse.
Turpentine is a colourless liquid used, for example, for cleaning paint off brushes.

ext.ext_cn: 在上周的火车撞车事故中有3人窒息死亡。
ext.ext_en: Three people were asphyxiated in the crush for last week's train...

ext.ext_en: John Doe died in his bath, asphyxiated by the fumes from a gas water-heater.

defs.def_en: If someone is asphyxiated, they die or lose consciousness because they are unable to breathe properly.
The men's room is a toilet for men in a public building.

defs.def_cn: (因疼痛或因看到、听到或记起不快之事而)皱起脸，皱眉蹙额

ext.ext_en: Every time he put any weight on his left leg he winced in pain...

ext.ext_cn: 一想到要跟卡米拉一起吃饭，他皱起了眉头。
ext.ext_en: He winced at the thought of dining with Camilla...

defs.def_en: If you wince, the muscles of your face tighten suddenly because you have felt a pain or because you have just seen, heard, or remembered something unpleasant.

A toolbar is a narrow grey strip across a computer screen containing pictures, called icons, which represent different computer functions. When you want to use a particular function, you move the cursor onto its icon using a mouse.

defs.def_cn: （尤指高尔夫锦标赛的）选手积分榜

ext.ext_cn: 在明星云集的锦标赛上位列积分榜第一，我非常高兴。
ext.ext_en: I'm delighted to be on top of the leaderboard in a tournament that has so many star names playing.

defs.def_en: The leaderboard is a board that shows the names and positions of the leading competitors in a competition, especially a golf tournament.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The luminous dial on the clock showed five minutes to seven.

ext.ext_en: ...one of the most luminous and unstable stars in our Galaxy.

defs.def_en: Something that is luminous shines or glows in the dark.

A dice is a small cube which has between one and six spots or numbers on its sides, and which is used in games to provide random numbers. In old-fashioned English, 'dice' was used only as a plural form, and the singular was die, but now 'dice' is used as both the singular and the plural form.
Dice is a game which is played using dice.

defs.def_cn: 把(食物)切成小块;将…切丁

ext.ext_cn: 把洋葱切成丁。
ext.ext_en: Dice the onion...

ext.ext_cn: 加入捣碎的大蒜和剩余的蔬菜丁。
ext.ext_en: Add the crushed garlic and remaining diced vegetables.

defs.def_en: If you dice food, you cut it into small cubes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我的婚姻破裂了。这让我变得孤僻、不愿与人来往。
ext.ext_en: My marriage has broken up. It has made me reclusive and unsociable...

ext.ext_cn: 我绝对不是一个不合群的人。
ext.ext_en: I am by no means an unsociable person.

defs.def_en: Someone who is unsociable does not like talking to other people and tries to avoid meeting them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都暗暗嘲笑斯温森太太。
ext.ext_en: We all snickered at Mrs. Swenson.

ext.ext_cn: 一阵嗤笑
ext.ext_en: ...a chorus of jeers and snickers.

defs.def_en: If you snicker, you laugh quietly in a disrespectful way, for example at something rude or embarrassing.

defs.def_cn: 软性屋内陈设(如靠垫、窗帘、布幔等)
defs.def_en: Soft furnishings are cushions, curtains, and furniture covers.

ext.ext_cn: 她说等那本书出平装本时再买。
ext.ext_en: She said she would buy the book when it comes out in paperback.

defs.def_en: A paperback is a book with a thin cardboard or paper cover.
The stratosphere is the layer of the earth's atmosphere which lies between 10 and 50 kilometres above the earth.

ext.ext_cn: 这足以让他们的事业平步青云了。
ext.ext_en: This was enough to launch their careers into the stratosphere...

ext.ext_cn: 一旦石油供应被中断，美国的石油进口额就会大幅度增加。
ext.ext_en: If oil supplies were ever disrupted, it would send U.S. oil-import bills into the stratosphere.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something climbs or is sent into the stratosphere, you mean that they reach a very high level.

ext.ext_cn: 有可能把事实与虚构分开吗？
ext.ext_en: Is it possible to separate truth from fiction?…

ext.ext_cn: 我必须告诉你这件事的真相。
ext.ext_en: I must tell you the truth about this business...

defs.def_en: The truth about something is all the facts about it, rather than things that are imagined or invented.

ext.ext_cn: 这个故事纯属虚构。
ext.ext_en: There is no truth in this story...

ext.ext_cn: 那些谣言有什么事实依据吗？
ext.ext_en: Is there any truth to the rumors?...

defs.def_en: If you say that there is some truth in a statement or story, you mean that it is true, or at least partly true.

ext.ext_cn: 这几乎是一条普遍的真理：我们在某一工作中越往上晋升，实际运用那些当初在工作中经常实践的技能的机会就越少。
ext.ext_en: It is an almost universal truth that the more we are promoted in a job, the less we actually exercise the skills we initially used to perform it.

defs.def_en: A truth is something that is believed to be true.

ext.ext_cn: 事实上，我们俩都不快乐。
ext.ext_en: In truth, we were both unhappy.

defs.def_en: You say in truth in order to indicate that you are giving your honest opinion about something.

ext.ext_cn: 坦白说，我害怕见他。
ext.ext_en: To tell you the truth, I was afraid to see him...

ext.ext_cn: 说实在的，约翰不想韦罗妮卡参加他的婚礼。
ext.ext_en: Truth to tell, John did not want Veronica at his wedding.

defs.def_en: You say to tell you the truth or truth to tell in order to indicate that you are telling someone something in an open and honest way, without trying to hide anything.

ext.ext_cn: 它的爪子挠伤了他的大腿。
ext.ext_en: Its claws lacerated his thighs.

defs.def_en: If something lacerates your skin, it cuts it badly and deeply.
A combine harvester is a large machine which is used on farms to cut, sort, and clean grain.
