ext.ext_en: ...a cruet set.

defs.def_en: A cruet is a small container, or set of containers, for salt, pepper, or mustard which is used at meals.

defs.def_cn: (餐桌上盛油或醋的)调味品瓶
defs.def_en: A cruet is a small glass bottle that contains oil or vinegar and is used at the table at meals.

ext.ext_cn: 在正常情况下，太平洋的热带洋流自东向西流。
ext.ext_en: Under normal conditions, the ocean currents of the tropical Pacific travel from east to west...

ext.ext_cn: 这对夫妻被巨大的水流卷走了。
ext.ext_en: The couple were swept away by the strong current.

defs.def_en: A current is a steady and continuous flowing movement of some of the water in a river, lake, or sea.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得脸上有一阵冷风吹过。
ext.ext_en: I felt a current of cool air blowing in my face.

defs.def_en: A current is a steady flowing movement of air.

ext.ext_cn: 给一块石墨通入强电流。
ext.ext_en: A powerful electric current is passed through a piece of graphite.

defs.def_en: An electric current is a flow of electricity through a wire or circuit.

ext.ext_cn: 每个党派代表一种不同的思潮。
ext.ext_en: Each party represents a distinct current of thought...

ext.ext_cn: 一股强烈的民族主义思潮涌入阿拉伯世界的思想体系和政治体系。
ext.ext_en: A strong current of nationalism runs through ideology and politics in the Arab world.

defs.def_en: A particular current is a particular feeling, idea, or quality that exists within a group of people.

defs.def_cn: 现时的;当前的;进行中的

ext.ext_cn: 当前的形势与1990年截然不同。
ext.ext_en: The current situation is very different to that in 1990...

ext.ext_cn: 他计划废除一些当前的政策。
ext.ext_en: He plans to repeal a number of current policies...

defs.def_en: Current means happening, being used, or being done at the present time.

ext.ext_cn: 目前普遍认为，毒素对皮下脂肪团堆积影响不大。
ext.ext_en: Current thinking suggests that toxins only have a small part to play in the build up of cellulite...

ext.ext_cn: 这种习俗在20世纪60年代末仍然很普遍。
ext.ext_en: This custom was still current in the late 1960s.

defs.def_en: Ideas and customs that are current are generally accepted and used by most people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 安恬的;田园诗般的;质朴宜人的

ext.ext_cn: 适于夏日恋曲的质朴宜人的环境
ext.ext_en: ...an idyllic setting for a summer romance...

ext.ext_cn: 婚姻生活并不像他想象的那么浪漫美好。
ext.ext_en: Married life was not as idyllic as he had imagined.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as idyllic, you mean that it is extremely pleasant, simple, and peaceful without any difficulties or dangers.

ext.ext_en: His arms were flailing in all directions...

defs.def_en: If your arms or legs flail or if you flail them about, they wave about in an energetic but uncontrolled way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He made a surreptitious entrance to the club through the little door in the brick wall...

ext.ext_en: They had several surreptitious conversations.

defs.def_en: A surreptitious action is done secretly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻率的；欠考虑的；漫不经心的

ext.ext_cn: 没有考虑最科学的做法就轻率地这么做了。
ext.ext_en: It does so with blithe disregard for best scientific practice.

defs.def_en: You use blithe to indicate that something is done casually, without serious or careful thought.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无忧无虑的；快乐无忧的

ext.ext_cn: 她高兴地说了声“嗨”，好像确信大家非常想念她似的。
ext.ext_en: She said 'hi' with the blithe assurance of someone who knew how much she'd been missed.

defs.def_en: Someone who is blithe is cheerful and has no serious problems.

ext.ext_cn: 我们有不同的背景和不同的历史。因此，我们有权拥有不同的未来。
ext.ext_en: We have a different background, a different history. Accordingly, we have the right to different futures...

ext.ext_cn: 工人们最近一直在呼吁缩短工作时间。许多公司于是转成了一周五天工作制。
ext.ext_en: The workforce have recently been calling for their working hours to be reduced. Many companies have accordingly switched to a five-day week.

defs.def_en: You use accordingly to introduce a fact or situation which is a result or consequence of something that you have just referred to.

ext.ext_cn: 这是份棘手的工作，他们应得到相应的报酬。
ext.ext_en: It is a difficult job and they should be paid accordingly...

ext.ext_cn: 新政府将对其利害得失作出判断，并采取相应的行动。
ext.ext_en: The new government will make a judgment about its interests and act accordingly.

defs.def_en: If you consider a situation and then act accordingly, the way you act depends on the nature of the situation.

defs.def_cn: 清除…的有害物质;对…消毒;给…去污;净化

ext.ext_cn: 为被化学武器击中的飞行员消毒的程序
ext.ext_en: ...procedures for decontaminating pilots hit by chemical weapons.

defs.def_en: To decontaminate something means to remove all germs or dangerous substances from it.

ext.ext_en: ...the role of vegetable fibres, vitamins, minerals and other essential nutrients.

defs.def_en: Nutrients are substances that help plants and animals to grow.

ext.ext_cn: 你每次连接到网络都会留下你的 IP 地址。
ext.ext_en: Every connection that you make to the network is stamped with your IP address.

defs.def_en: An IP address is a series of numbers that identifies which particular computer or network is connected to the Internet. IP is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'Internet Protocol'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...deluded fanatics.

ext.ext_cn: 你这个上当受骗的傻瓜！
ext.ext_en: You poor deluded fool!

defs.def_en: Someone who is deluded believes something that is not true.

ext.ext_cn: 制造商们遇到的一个问题是，重量较轻的汽车往往噪音大。
ext.ext_en: A problem for manufacturers is that lighter cars tend to be noisy...

ext.ext_en: In older age groups women predominate because men tend to die younger...

defs.def_en: If something tends to happen, it usually happens or it often happens.

defs.def_cn: 倾向于，容易表现出(某种特性)

ext.ext_cn: 搞艺术的人和知识分子容易持“左倾”观点。
ext.ext_en: Artistic and intellectual people tend towards left-wing views.

defs.def_en: If you tend towards a particular characteristic, you often display that characteristic.

ext.ext_cn: 我个人觉得，议会议员总体上工作还是不错的。
ext.ext_en: I tend to think that members of parliament by and large do a good job.

defs.def_en: You can say that you tend to think something when you want to give your opinion, but do not want it to seem too forceful or definite.

ext.ext_cn: 多年来她一直受到病痛的折磨，都是他在照料。
ext.ext_en: For years he tended her in her painful illness...

ext.ext_cn: 他打理着他栽在车道两旁的花坛和常青树。
ext.ext_en: He tends the flower beds and evergreens that he has planted in the driveway.

defs.def_en: If you tend someone or something, you do what is necessary to keep them in a good condition or to improve their condition.

ext.ext_en: In our culture, girls are brought up to tend to the needs of others...

ext.ext_en: She hurried away to pour more coffee and tend to the grill.

defs.def_en: If you tend to someone or something, you pay attention to them and deal with their problems and needs.

ext.ext_cn: 浅的咸水池
ext.ext_en: ...shallow pools of brackish water.

defs.def_en: Brackish water is slightly salty and unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 无畏的太空旅行者
ext.ext_en: ...an intrepid space traveller.

defs.def_en: An intrepid person acts in a brave way.

ext.ext_cn: 天主教徒和新教徒之间达成和解的诉求
ext.ext_en: ...an appeal for reconciliation between Catholics and Protestants...

ext.ext_cn: 夫妇俩已经分居了，但是他想要和解。
ext.ext_en: The couple have separated but he wants a reconciliation...

defs.def_en: Reconciliation between two people or countries who have quarrelled is the process of their becoming friends again. A reconciliation is an instance of this.

defs.def_cn: （两种貌似对立的信仰、事实或要求的）和谐，调和，一致

ext.ext_cn: 建立在平等和自由两种价值观和谐统一基础上的民主理想
ext.ext_en: ...the ideal of democracy based upon a reconciliation of the values of equality and liberty.

defs.def_en: The reconciliation of two beliefs, facts, or demands that seem to be opposed is the process of finding a way in which they can both be true or both be successful.

ext.ext_cn: 卡鲁佐斯的诗歌表明他对东正教的执着。
ext.ext_en: Karouzos's poetry shows a profound preoccupation with the Orthodox Church...

ext.ext_cn: 克鲁克一心想着罗宾，忽略了其他一切事情。
ext.ext_en: In his preoccupation with Robyn, Crook had neglected everything.

defs.def_en: If you have a preoccupation with something or someone, you keep thinking about them because they are important to you.

ext.ext_cn: 他很难意识到她的存在；他一直沉浸在沮丧中。
ext.ext_en: It was hard for him to be aware of her; he kept sinking back into black preoccupation.

defs.def_en: Preoccupation is a state of mind in which you think about something so much that you do not consider other things to be important.

ext.ext_en: ...Americans of Slavic descent.

ext.ext_cn: 斯拉夫文化
ext.ext_en: ...Slavic culture.

defs.def_en: Something that is Slavic belongs or relates to Slavs.

ext.ext_en: Results from market tests in the US and Europe show little enthusiasm for the product.

ext.ext_cn: 这些坚果已经做过市场测试，结果发现它们最合澳大利亚人的口味。
ext.ext_en: These nuts have been market tested and found to be most suited to the Australian palate...

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司使用模拟装置对新设计进行市场测试。
ext.ext_en: The company uses the simulator to market test new designs.

defs.def_en: If a new product or service is market tested, a group of people are asked to try it and then asked for their opinions on it.
A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs. Most birds can fly.

defs.def_cn: 小妞儿（可能具冒犯意味）
defs.def_en: Some men refer to young women as birds. This use could cause offence.
Some people refer to the birds and the bees when they are talking about sex, especially to children.

ext.ext_cn: 他们警告他下次他可能就要进监狱了。
ext.ext_en: They warned him that next time he'd find himself doing bird.

defs.def_en: Someone who is doing bird is in prison.
If you refer to two people as birds of a feather, you mean that they have the same interests or are very similar.
If an audience gives someone the bird, they shout loudly in order to show their disappointment or disapproval.

defs.def_cn: （表示侮辱）被竖中指/冲…竖中指
defs.def_en: If you get the bird or if someone gives you the bird, they make a rude gesture with their middle finger at you.
A bird in the hand is something that you already have and do not want to risk losing by trying to get something else.
If you say that a little bird told you about something, you mean that someone has told you about it, but you do not want to say who it was.

ext.ext_cn: 和往常一样，惠勒——一个非常聪明的人——又做对了。
ext.ext_en: As usual, Wheeler, a wise old bird, got it right...

ext.ext_cn: 她是一个如此端庄的女人。
ext.ext_en: She was such a decent old bird.

defs.def_en: Some people use the phrase old bird to refer to someone and say what they are like.

defs.def_cn: 少见的人；稀有之物；凤毛麟角
defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is a rare bird, you mean that they are very unusual.

defs.def_cn: 一石二鸟；一箭双雕；一举两得
defs.def_en: If you say that doing something will kill two birds with one stone, you mean that it will enable you to achieve two things that you want to achieve, rather than just one.

ext.ext_cn: 我放了一些热水把餐具洗了。
ext.ext_en: I ran some hot water and washed up...

ext.ext_cn: 我肯定是你做的早餐并且清洗了他们的餐具。
ext.ext_en: I bet you make breakfast and wash up their plates, too.

defs.def_en: If you wash up, you wash the plates, cups, cutlery, and pans which have been used for cooking and eating a meal.

ext.ext_cn: 他走进洗手间去洗漱。
ext.ext_en: He headed to the bathroom to wash up.

defs.def_en: If you wash up, you clean part of your body with soap and water, especially your hands and face.

defs.def_cn: 退潮留下;(海水或河水)冲刷后留下

ext.ext_cn: 每次暴风雨过后海滩上都会留下数不尽的鲱鱼和螃蟹。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of herring and crab are washed up on the beaches during every storm...

ext.ext_cn: 这些化石看上去是被海水冲上岸的一种早期的水藻。
ext.ext_en: The fossils appear to be an early form of seaweed washed up on a beach.

defs.def_en: If something is washed up on a piece of land, it is carried by a river or sea and left there.
The pluperfect is the same as the past perfect .
Stricken is the past participle of some meanings of strike .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 受煎熬的;患病的;遭受挫折的;受灾的

ext.ext_cn: 受遗传性癌症折磨的一家
ext.ext_en: ...a family stricken by genetically inherited cancer...

ext.ext_cn: 国外救援人员不准进入灾区。
ext.ext_en: Foreign aid workers will not be allowed into the stricken areas.

defs.def_en: If a person or place is stricken by something such as an unpleasant feeling, an illness, or a natural disaster, they are severely affected by it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些花也许只开一天，但植物本身却很长寿。
ext.ext_en: The flowers may only last a day but the plants are long-lived.

ext.ext_cn: 一大堆耐久的放射性物质
ext.ext_en: ...huge piles of long-lived radioactive material.

defs.def_en: Something that is long-lived lives or lasts for a long time.

defs.def_cn: 孩子；子女；后代；（动物的）崽

ext.ext_cn: 埃莉诺现在不像以往那样为孩子忧心了。
ext.ext_en: Eleanor was now less anxious about her offspring than she had once been.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a person's children or to an animal's young as their offspring .

ext.ext_cn: 年轻的新生
ext.ext_en: ...a young school entrant.

defs.def_en: An entrant is a person who has recently become a member of an institution such as a university.

ext.ext_cn: 所有参赛作品必须是参赛者本人的作品。
ext.ext_en: All items entered for the competition must be the entrant's own work.

defs.def_en: An entrant is a person who is taking part in a competition.

ext.ext_cn: 他在国立神经内科医院接受神经病学的训练。
ext.ext_en: He trained in neurology at the National Hospital for Nervous Diseases.

defs.def_en: Neurology is the study of the structure, function, and diseases of the nervous system.

ext.ext_cn: 马列维奇的很多作品在苏联博物馆的地下室里堆了几十年。
ext.ext_en: For decades, many of Malevich's works were consigned to the basements of Soviet museums...

ext.ext_cn: 该把他的球棒和手套搁进柜子里了。
ext.ext_en: It was time to consign his bat and glove to the cupboard...

defs.def_en: To consign something or someone to a place where they will be forgotten about, or to an unpleasant situation or place, means to put them there.

defs.def_cn: （战争、惩罚犯罪等的）相称原则，恰当性

ext.ext_cn: 核武器似乎违背了正义战争的罚当其罪原则。
ext.ext_en: Nuclear weapons seem to violate the just war principle of proportionality...

ext.ext_cn: 他说量刑时应当做到罚罪相当。
ext.ext_en: He said there was a need for proportionality in sentencing.

defs.def_en: The principle of proportionality is the idea that an action should not be more severe than is necessary, especially in a war or when punishing someone for a crime.
Worst is the superlative of bad .
Worst is the superlative of badly .

ext.ext_cn: 尽管矿井的安全状况有了很大改善，矿工的家属仍然害怕最糟的情况会发生。
ext.ext_en: Though mine safety has much improved, miners' families still fear the worst...

ext.ext_cn: 该国已经度过了经济衰退最糟糕的时期。
ext.ext_en: The country had come through the worst of the recession.

defs.def_en: The worst is the most unpleasant or unfavourable thing that could happen or does happen.

defs.def_cn: (用于构成以 bad 和 badly 开头的复合形容词的最高级，如badly-affected的最高级是worst-affected)
defs.def_en: Worst is used to form the superlative of compound adjectives beginning with 'bad' and 'badly'. For example, the superlative of 'badly-affected' is 'worst-affected'.

ext.ext_cn: 受影响最大的是受伤的乘客，那些失去亲人的乘客尤为甚。
ext.ext_en: The people most closely affected are the passengers who were injured and, worst of all, those who lost relatives.

defs.def_en: You say worst of all to indicate that what you are about to mention is the most unpleasant or has the most disadvantages out of all the things you are mentioning.

ext.ext_cn: 内拉往好里说会落下残疾，往坏处说可能会生命不保。
ext.ext_en: At best Nella would be an invalid; at worst she would die...

ext.ext_cn: 最不济他会在第二天晚上之前到那儿。
ext.ext_en: At the worst he would be there by the following night.

defs.def_en: You use at worst or at the worst to indicate that you are mentioning the worst thing that might happen in a situation.

defs.def_cn: 在（心情、境况）最糟糕的时候

ext.ext_cn: 这是他们的母亲情绪最坏之时，她说话咄咄逼人，随时会对任何人发火。
ext.ext_en: This was their mother at her worst. Her voice was strident, she was ready to be angry at anyone.

defs.def_en: When someone is at their worst, they are as unpleasant, bad, or unsuccessful as it is possible for them to be.

defs.def_cn: 如果发生最坏的情况（if worst comes to worst 主要用于美国英语）

ext.ext_cn: 到了一筹莫展的时候，我想我总还是能给琼打电话。
ext.ext_en: If the worst comes to the worst I guess I can always ring Jean...

ext.ext_cn: 他被问到如果发生最坏的情况他是否会退席。
ext.ext_en: He was asked whether he would walk out if the worst came to the worst.

defs.def_en: You use if the worst comes to the worst to say what you might do if a situation develops in the most unfavourable way possible. The form if worst comes to worst is also used, mainly in American English.

defs.def_cn: 不择手段；使出一切手段;有什么手段尽管使出来

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得要是说“瞧，我们现在有一大群人——你有什么手段尽管使出来吧”，可能会引起麻烦。
ext.ext_en: I think it was dangerous to say: look, we've got an army now — do your worst.

defs.def_en: If someone does their worst, they do everything unpleasant that they can possibly do. You can say 'do your worst' to show someone that you are not frightened of what they may do.

ext.ext_cn: 他失去平衡，往后趔趄了一下，撞到栏杆摔倒了。
ext.ext_en: He lost his balance, staggered back against the rail and toppled over...

ext.ext_cn: 他走路摇摇晃晃，不得不靠在吧台上。
ext.ext_en: He was staggering and had to lean on the bar.

defs.def_en: If you stagger, you walk very unsteadily, for example because you are ill or drunk.

ext.ext_cn: 杜鲁门允许他又硬撑了近两年。
ext.ext_en: Truman allowed him to stagger on for nearly another two years.

ext.ext_cn: 在一次又一次危机中勉强维持的政府
ext.ext_en: ...a government that staggered from crisis to crisis.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something staggers on, you mean that it is only just succeeds in continuing.

ext.ext_cn: 整个事件让我震惊。
ext.ext_en: The whole thing staggers me.

defs.def_en: If something staggers you, it surprises you very much.

defs.def_cn: 使(假期或工作时间)错开

ext.ext_cn: 在过去几年里，政府将学生放暑假的时间相互错开。
ext.ext_en: During the past few years the government has staggered the summer vacation periods for students.

defs.def_en: To stagger things such as people's holidays or hours of work means to arrange them so that they do not all happen at the same time.

defs.def_cn: （报刊中的）漫画，连环画，幽默画

ext.ext_cn: 英国最受欢迎的漫画形象之一——鲁珀特熊
ext.ext_en: ...one of Britain's best-loved cartoon characters, Rupert the Bear.

defs.def_en: See also:strip cartoon;A cartoon is a humorous drawing or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine.

ext.ext_cn: 星期六上午的动画片
ext.ext_en: ...the Saturday morning cartoons.

defs.def_en: A cartoon is a film in which all the characters and scenes are drawn rather than being real people or objects.

ext.ext_cn: 我前天刚刚辞了工作。
ext.ext_en: I'd just packed in a job the day before...

ext.ext_cn: 别闹了，不要恶意伤人。
ext.ext_en: Pack it in. Stop being spiteful.

defs.def_en: If you pack something in, you stop doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 监狱只好拼命往里面塞犯人。
ext.ext_en: Prisons are having to pack in as many inmates as possible...

ext.ext_cn: 这算是全民公决，虽然牵涉到很多问题。
ext.ext_en: It's kind of a referendum, though a lot of issues are packed in.

defs.def_en: If someone packs in things or people, they fit a lot of them into a limited space or time.

defs.def_cn: （戏剧、电影、活动等）吸引大批观众

ext.ext_cn: 每个星期五晚上，“爆头”乐队在卡姆登爵士咖啡馆仍然人气十足。
ext.ext_en: 'Blow your head!' is still packing them in at Camden's Jazz Café every Friday night.

defs.def_en: If a play, film or event packs them in, lots of people go to see it.

Traffic lights are sets of red, amber, and green lights at the places where roads meet. They control the traffic by signalling when vehicles have to stop and when they can go. Traffic lights can also be referred to as a traffic light .

ext.ext_cn: 他们故意隐瞒消息。
ext.ext_en: They are purposely withholding information.

defs.def_en: If you do something purposely, you do it intentionally.

ext.ext_cn: 很长一段时间以来我去过的最棒的夜总会
ext.ext_en: ...the most wonderful club I've been to for yonks.

defs.def_en: Yonks means a very long time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 戴安娜的家里挤满了兴奋的人们，他们伴着欢快的音乐不由自主地引吭高歌。
ext.ext_en: Diana's house was crowded with happy people whose spontaneous outbursts of song were accompanied by lively music...

ext.ext_cn: 我跟着也自然而然地鼓起掌来。
ext.ext_en: I joined in the spontaneous applause.

defs.def_en: Spontaneous acts are not planned or arranged, but are done because someone suddenly wants to do them.

defs.def_cn: 自然的，自发的(指由于内部原因而非外界影响所引起的)

ext.ext_cn: 我在大约第 16 至 18 孕周时又经历了一次自然流产。
ext.ext_en: I had another spontaneous miscarriage at around the 16th to 18th week.

ext.ext_cn: 自爆
ext.ext_en: ...a spontaneous explosion.

defs.def_en: A spontaneous event happens because of processes within something rather than being caused by things outside it.

defs.def_cn: 没有考虑到…；没把…算在内

ext.ext_cn: 我原以为只要辛苦点儿，驾车一天就可以到达成都。但是我没有考虑到山体滑坡。
ext.ext_en: I thought that it would take only a day of hard driving to reach Chengdu. But I had reckoned without the landslides.

defs.def_en: If you say that you had reckoned without something, you mean that you had not expected it and so were not prepared for it.

ext.ext_cn: 点餐时可以大胆征求意见。
ext.ext_en: Don't be afraid to ask for advice about ordering the meal...

ext.ext_cn: 社区工作人员能就如何预防社区内犯罪提供一些忠告。
ext.ext_en: Your community officer can give you advice on how to prevent crime in your area...

defs.def_en: If you give someone advice, you tell them what you think they should do in a particular situation.

defs.def_cn: 听取律师的意见;咨询律师

ext.ext_cn: 我们正在就追回该款项所需的法律程序咨询律师。
ext.ext_en: We are taking advice on legal steps to recover the money...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你受到警方起诉，至关重要的是你要听取专业律师的意见。
ext.ext_en: If you are prosecuted by the police, then it is essential that you take specialist legal advice.

defs.def_en: If you take advice or take legal advice, you ask a lawyer for his or her professional opinion on a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 斜纹图案
ext.ext_en: ...a pattern of diagonal lines.

defs.def_en: A diagonal line or movement goes in a sloping direction, for example, from one corner of a square across to the opposite corner.

ext.ext_cn: 床单有漂亮的方格形、条纹、斜纹和三角形图案。
ext.ext_en: The bed linen is patterned in stylish checks, stripes, diagonals and triangles.

defs.def_en: A diagonal is a line that goes in a sloping direction.

ext.ext_cn: 在对角线上等距地标出5点。
ext.ext_en: Mark five points an equal distance apart along the diagonals.

defs.def_en: In geometry, a diagonal is a straight line that joins two opposite corners in a flat four-sided shape such as a square.
An executor is someone whose name you write in your will when you want them to be responsible for dealing with your affairs after your death.
A villain is someone who deliberately harms other people or breaks the law in order to get what he or she wants.

defs.def_cn: （小说、电影或戏剧中的）主要反面人物，反派主角
defs.def_en: The villain in a novel, film, or play is the main bad character.

ext.ext_cn: 如果丹尼先生真像警察说的那样是犯罪元凶，就应该对其进行更加严密的监视。
ext.ext_en: If Mr Denny is indeed the villain of the piece, as the police claim he is, he should have been more carefully watched.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is the villain of the piece, you are saying in a slightly humorous way that they are seen by some people as the cause of all the trouble in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 他开始在护士面前痛斥我。
ext.ext_en: He proceeded to excoriate me in front of the nurses.

defs.def_en: To excoriate a person or organization means to criticize them severely, usually in public.

ext.ext_cn: 然后我遇上了一个人，嘭的一下，我就坠入了爱河。
ext.ext_en: Then I met someone and wham, bam, I was completely in love...

ext.ext_cn: 你正开车走着——嘭，撞到了一个坑。
ext.ext_en: There you are driving along and wham! You hit a pothole.

defs.def_en: You use wham to indicate that something happens suddenly or forcefully.

ext.ext_cn: 接着他开始了自己不可阻挡的攻击。
ext.ext_en: Then he unleashed his own, unstoppable, attack...

ext.ext_cn: 军官们仍不愿发兵乘胜追击溃败的敌人。
ext.ext_en: The officers were still reluctant to unleash their troops in pursuit of a defeated enemy.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something unleashes a powerful force, feeling, activity, or group, you mean that they suddenly start it or send it somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 那种型号在20世纪90年代末以前不会批量生产。
ext.ext_en: That model won't go into production before late 1990.

ext.ext_cn: 鼓励国内石油生产的税收优惠政策
ext.ext_en: ...tax incentives to encourage domestic production of oil.

defs.def_en: Production is the process of manufacturing or growing something in large quantities.

ext.ext_cn: 我们需要提高产量。
ext.ext_en: We needed to increase the volume of production...

ext.ext_cn: 预期今年汽车的产量会和去年持平。
ext.ext_en: It expected to maintain production of cars at the same level as last year.

defs.def_en: Production is the amount of goods manufactured or grown by a company or country.

ext.ext_cn: 这些蛋白质会刺激血细胞的产生。
ext.ext_en: These proteins stimulate the production of blood cells.

defs.def_en: The production of something is its creation as the result of a natural process.

defs.def_cn: （戏剧的）排演；（电影、电视节目的）制作；（唱片的）灌制

ext.ext_cn: 在影片摄制期间，导演想拍摄一个暴乱场面，但是被禁止了。
ext.ext_en: During the film's production, the director wanted to shoot a riot scene but the filming was blocked...

ext.ext_cn: 她是制片公司的负责人。
ext.ext_en: She is head of the production company.

defs.def_en: Production is the process of organizing and preparing a play, film, programme, or CD, in order to present it to the public.

ext.ext_cn: 为了这次演出，她已经学会了用西班牙语演这个角色。
ext.ext_en: For this production she has learnt the role in Spanish.

ext.ext_cn: 获得好评的《奥赛罗》
ext.ext_en: ...a critically acclaimed production of Othello.

defs.def_en: A production is a play, opera, or other show that is performed in a theatre.

defs.def_cn: 通过出示；通过展示；通过亮出

ext.ext_cn: 会员只要出示会员卡就可以免费观看演出。
ext.ext_en: Entry to the show is free to members on production of their membership cards.

defs.def_en: When you can do something on production of or on the production of documents, you need to show someone those documents in order to be able to do that thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可抵抗的;不可抗拒的;不能压制的

ext.ext_cn: 事实证明回去对霍尔是个不可抗拒的诱惑。
ext.ext_en: It proved an irresistible temptation to Hall to go back.

ext.ext_cn: 来自金融市场的不可抗拒的压力
ext.ext_en: ...irresistible pressure from the financial markets...

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a desire or force as irresistible, you mean that it is so powerful that it makes you act in a certain way, and there is nothing you can do to prevent this.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 吸引人的;富有诱惑力的

ext.ext_cn: 音乐非常好听，令人难以抗拒。
ext.ext_en: The music is irresistible.

ext.ext_cn: 诱人的全麦面包
ext.ext_en: ...irresistible granary bread.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as irresistible, you mean that they are so good or attractive that you cannot stop yourself from liking them or wanting them.

defs.def_cn: （用于称呼非常喜爱的人）最亲爱的

ext.ext_cn: 出什么事了，我最亲爱的？你看起来很疲惫。
ext.ext_en: What's wrong, my dearest? You look tired.

defs.def_en: You can call someone dearest when you are very fond of them.

defs.def_cn: (用于信函抬头的名字或称谓前)最亲爱的

ext.ext_cn: 最亲爱的玛丽亚，我没有遵守承诺回来，是不是很差劲？
ext.ext_en: Dearest Maria, Aren't I terrible, not coming back like I promised?

defs.def_en: When you are writing to someone you are very fond of, you can use dearest at the beginning of the letter before the person's name or the word you are using to address them.

ext.ext_cn: 我最大的期望就是她有一天能够找到真正应得的幸福。
ext.ext_en: It is my dearest hope that one day she will find the happiness she truly deserves.

defs.def_en: Your dearest wishes or hopes are things that you hope very much will happen.

defs.def_cn: 怪异的行为；有趣的事；令人发笑的举动；见不得人的行为

ext.ext_cn: 这个女孩已经发现了工厂里的勾当。
ext.ext_en: The girl had found out about the goings-on in the factory.

ext.ext_cn: 坎特雷尔和他的手下之间的反常表现
ext.ext_en: ...strange goings-on between Cantrell and his men.

defs.def_en: If you describe events or activities as goings-on, you mean that they are strange, interesting, amusing, or dishonest.

ext.ext_cn: 他不习惯政治或哲学讨论。
ext.ext_en: He was not accustomed to political or philosophical discussions.

defs.def_en: Philosophical means concerned with or relating to philosophy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对于生活，刘易斯变得豁达洒脱了。
ext.ext_en: Lewis has grown philosophical about life.

defs.def_en: Someone who is philosophical does not get upset when disappointing or disturbing things happen.

ext.ext_en: That really teed off the old boy.

defs.def_en: If someone or something tees you off, they make you angry or annoyed.

ext.ext_en: In a few hours time most of the world's top golfers tee off in the US Masters.

defs.def_en: Someone's life's work or life work is the main activity that they have been involved in during their life, or their most important achievement.

ext.ext_en: He missed his last bus home...

ext.ext_en: They had to travel everywhere by bus.

ext.ext_cn: 过去在五一劳动节这天，数十万人常常乘坐大巴到东柏林游行。

ext.ext_en: To get our Colombian visas we bussed back to Medellin...

ext.ext_en: Many schools were in danger of closing because the children were bused out to other neighborhoods.

Jade is a hard stone, usually green in colour, that is used for making jewellery and ornaments.
Something that is jade or jade green is bright green in colour.

defs.def_cn: (战争或冲突中具有的)优势;优越(性)

ext.ext_en: The US will need a three-to-one superiority in forces to be sure of a successful attack...

ext.ext_en: We have air superiority.

defs.def_en: See also:superior;If one side in a war or conflict has superiority, it has an advantage over its enemy, for example because it has more soldiers or better equipment.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的经济徘徊在崩溃的边缘。
ext.ext_en: Their economy is teetering on the brink of collapse...

defs.def_en: If you are on the brink of something, usually something important, terrible, or exciting, you are just about to do it or experience it.

ext.ext_en: A flexible retirement age is being considered by Ministers to unify men's and women's pension rights...

ext.ext_en: He said he would seek to unify the Conservative Party and win the next general election...

defs.def_en: If someone unifies different things or parts, or if the things or parts unify, they are brought together to form one thing.
A postbox is a metal box in a public place, where you put letters and packets to be collected. They are then sorted and delivered.

defs.def_cn: (因短暂、突然的兴奋或恐惧而引起的)颤抖，战栗

ext.ext_cn: 剧场里顿时泛起一片疑惧。
ext.ext_en: A frisson of apprehension rippled round the theatre.

ext.ext_cn: 织纹状与网眼状交织的针脚

ext.ext_en: The shoe's sole had a slightly textured surface.

defs.def_en: A textured surface is not smooth, but has a particular texture, for example, it feels rough.

ext.ext_cn: 人们过去每天都来拜访他。

defs.def_en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

defs.def_cn: 过去不曾（亦作did not use to 或 did not used to，尤用于口语）

ext.ext_cn: 过去是不建议借贷的。
ext.ext_en: Borrowing used not to be recommended...

ext.ext_en: At some point kids start doing things they didn't use to do. They get more independent...

defs.def_en: If something used not to be done or used not to be the case, it was not done in the past or was not the case in the past. The forms did not use to and did not used to are also found, especially in spoken English.

ext.ext_cn: 我习惯了睡觉时被吵醒。
ext.ext_en: I'm used to having my sleep interrupted...

ext.ext_cn: 这可吓不倒他们。他们已经习惯了。
ext.ext_en: It doesn't frighten them. They're used to it.

defs.def_en: If you are used to something, you are familiar with it because you have done it or experienced it many times before.

ext.ext_cn: 我们这里就是这么做事的。你很快就会习惯的。
ext.ext_en: This is how we do things here. You'll soon get used to it...

ext.ext_cn: 他过了一段时间才慢慢适应。
ext.ext_en: He took some getting used to...

defs.def_en: If you get used to something or someone, you become familiar with it or get to know them, so that you no longer feel that the thing or person is unusual or surprising.

defs.def_cn: 用过的;不干净的；损坏的

ext.ext_en: ...a used cotton ball stained with makeup...

ext.ext_cn: 他拿了一个盖着爱尔兰邮戳的旧信封。
ext.ext_en: He took a used envelope bearing an Irish postmark.

defs.def_en: A used object is dirty or spoiled because it has been used, and usually needs to be thrown away or washed.

ext.ext_en: His only big purchase has been a used Ford.

defs.def_en: A used car has already had one or more owners.

defs.def_en: Embarrassment is the feeling you have when you are embarrassed.

ext.ext_en: The poverty figures were undoubtedly an embarrassment to the president.

defs.def_en: An embarrassment is an action, event, or situation which causes problems for a politician, political party, government, or other public group.

ext.ext_en: You have been an embarrassment to us from the day Douglas married you.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a person as an embarrassment, you mean that you disapprove of them but cannot avoid your connection with them.

defs.def_cn: 好东西太多而成了问题

ext.ext_en: The art gallery's problem is an embarrassment of riches, with nowhere to put most of them.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has an embarrassment of riches, you mean that they have so many good things that these things are a problem.

defs.def_cn: 在水中的;淹没的;水下的

ext.ext_en: He also had an invincible faith in the medicinal virtues of garlic.

defs.def_en: If someone has an invincible belief or attitude, it cannot be changed.

ext.ext_en: ...a London landmark, Nelson's Column in Trafalgar Square.

defs.def_en: A column is a tall, often decorated cylinder of stone which is built to honour someone or forms part of a building.

ext.ext_cn: 爆炸在空中形成了几千英尺高的烟柱。
ext.ext_en: The explosion sent a column of smoke thousands of feet into the air.

defs.def_en: A column is something that has a tall narrow shape.

ext.ext_en: A dense column of smoke rose several miles into the air.

defs.def_en: Dense fog or smoke is difficult to see through because it is very heavy and dark.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (文章、电影等因信息量大而)难懂的，费解的

ext.ext_en: His prose is vigorous and dense, occasionally to the point of obscurity.

defs.def_en: If you describe writing or a film as dense, you mean that it is difficult to understand because it contains a lot of information and ideas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他人不坏，就是有点儿愚钝。
ext.ext_en: He's not a bad man, just a bit dense.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is dense, you mean that you think they are stupid and that they take a long time to understand simple things.

ext.ext_en: He owed Vince money for drugs, so he scarpered.

ext.ext_en: The animal may have some white markings.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第5个字母

defs.def_en: E or e is an abbreviation for words beginning with e, such as 'English', 'east', and 'eastern'.
E is the drug ecstasy, or a tablet of ecstasy.

ext.ext_en: Reaching down, he unfastened the latch on the gate...

defs.def_en: If you unfasten something that is closed, tied, or held together, or if you unfasten the thing holding it, you loosen or remove the thing holding it.

defs.def_cn: 不变的;始终如一的;一贯的

ext.ext_en: It was his invariable custom to have one whisky before his supper.

defs.def_en: You use invariable to describe something that never changes.

defs.def_cn: 夜间警卫员;值夜者;守夜者
defs.def_en: A nightwatchman is a person whose job is to guard buildings at night.

ext.ext_cn: 他想要亲吻她，抚摸她。
ext.ext_en: He tried to kiss her and fondle her.

defs.def_en: If you fondle someone or something, you touch them gently with a stroking movement, usually in a sexual way.

ext.ext_cn: 这些指控纯属捏造。
ext.ext_en: The allegations were completely untrue...

ext.ext_cn: 并不是所有政治犯都被释放了。
ext.ext_en: It was untrue to say that all political prisoners have been released...

defs.def_en: If a statement or idea is untrue, it is false and not based on facts.

ext.ext_cn: 一大块甜腻腻的海绵蛋糕
ext.ext_en: ...a wodge of syrupy sponge.

defs.def_en: A wodge of something is a large amount of it or a large piece of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我刚刚在那里度过假，很想把它推荐给每一个人。
ext.ext_en: I have just spent a holiday there and would recommend it to anyone...

ext.ext_cn: “你是个好员工，孩子，”他告诉他，“我将推荐你升职。”
ext.ext_en: 'You're a good worker, boy,' he told him. 'I'll recommend you for a promotion.'...

defs.def_en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find that person or thing good or useful.

ext.ext_cn: 法官建议判处他20年监禁。
ext.ext_en: The judge recommended that he serve 20 years in prison...

ext.ext_cn: 我们强烈建议报警。
ext.ext_en: We strongly recommend reporting the incident to the police...

defs.def_en: If you recommend that something is done, you suggest that it should be done.

ext.ext_cn: “贵族”餐馆有很多值得称道之处。
ext.ext_en: La Noblesse restaurant has much to recommend it...

ext.ext_cn: 他拥有的优势只有他的热情。
ext.ext_en: He had little but his enthusiasm to recommend him...

defs.def_en: If something or someone has a particular quality to recommend them, that quality makes them attractive or gives them an advantage over similar things or people.

ext.ext_cn: 沃尔沙姆夺得20公里比赛冠军的那一刻无比荣耀。
ext.ext_en: Walsham had his moment of glory when he won a 20km race.

ext.ext_en: ...we were still basking in the glory of our Championship win.

defs.def_en: Glory is the fame and admiration that you gain by doing something impressive.

ext.ext_cn: 这张专辑使他们重温了昔日的辉煌，但实际上没有任何新的突破。
ext.ext_en: The album sees them reliving past glories but not really breaking any new ground.

ext.ext_cn: 腓特烈大帝军事上的巅峰时刻
ext.ext_en: ...the military glories of Frederick the Great.

defs.def_en: A person's  glories are the occasions when they have done something people greatly admire which makes them famous.

ext.ext_cn: 在他的脑海中这一想法变得越来越宏大。
ext.ext_en: The glory of the idea blossomed in his mind.

defs.def_en: The glory of something is its great beauty or impressive nature.

ext.ext_cn: 领略意大利文艺复兴时期伟大艺术成就的佛罗伦萨之旅
ext.ext_en: ...a tour of Florence, to enjoy the artistic glories of the Italian Renaissance...

ext.ext_en: One of the glories of the island has always been its bird population.

defs.def_en: The glories of a culture or place are the things that people admire most about it.

ext.ext_cn: 工人们因才获得的自由而无比喜悦。
ext.ext_en: The workers were glorying in their new-found freedom...

ext.ext_en: He does not glory in his past successes and looks forward to achieving more.

defs.def_en: If you glory in a situation or activity, you enjoy it very much.

ext.ext_en: I am never going back to prison. I am going to make national news headlines and go out in a blaze of glory.

defs.def_en: If you go out in a blaze of glory, you do something very dramatic at the end of your career or your life which makes you famous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...a series of monumental disappointments.

defs.def_en: You can use monumental to emphasize the size or extent of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...his monumental work on Chinese astronomy.

defs.def_en: If you describe a book or musical work as monumental, you are emphasizing that it is very large and impressive, and is likely to be important for a long time.

ext.ext_en: I take no real interest in monumental sculpture.

defs.def_en: A monumental building or sculpture is very large and impressive.

ext.ext_en: ...a young blue spruce.

ext.ext_en: Chris was looking spruce in his stiff-collared black shirt and new short hair cut.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a telling-off, you tell them that you are very angry with them about something they have done.

A cornfield is a field in which corn is being grown.

ext.ext_en: His family are completely behind him, whatever he decides...

defs.def_en: A family is a group of people who are related to each other, especially parents and their children.

ext.ext_en: Her family came to Los Angeles at the turn of the century.

ext.ext_en: I was working in the family business.

ext.ext_en: It had been designed as a family house...

ext.ext_en: A wedding is a family event.

defs.def_en: You can use family to describe things that are designed to be used or enjoyed by both parents and children.

ext.ext_en: ...foods in the cabbage family, such as Brussels sprouts.

defs.def_en: A family of animals or plants is a group of related species.

defs.def_cn: 草草记下，匆匆写下（地址等）

ext.ext_en: Could you just jot his name on there?

ext.ext_en: It doesn't affect my judgement one jot...

ext.ext_en: It matters not a jot.

defs.def_cn: 古代，古时（尤指古埃及、古希腊、古罗马时期）

ext.ext_en: The town was famous in antiquity for its white bulls.

defs.def_en: Antiquities are things such as buildings, statues, or coins that were made in ancient times and have survived to the present day.

defs.def_en: The antiquity of something is its great age.

ext.ext_en: Lister's dead. Ditto three Miami drug dealers and a lady.

ext.ext_en: Molly leapt to her feet, spluttering and howling with rage.

defs.def_en: If someone splutters, they make short sounds and have difficulty speaking clearly, for example because they are embarrassed or angry.

ext.ext_en: Suddenly the engine coughed, spluttered and died.

defs.def_en: If something splutters, it makes a series of short, sharp sounds.

defs.def_en: If you pre-empt an action, you prevent it from happening by doing something which makes it unnecessary or impossible.

defs.def_en: If you play people off against each other, you make them compete or argue, so that you gain some advantage.

defs.def_cn: 玷污，毁坏，损害，败坏(地位、名誉)

ext.ext_cn: 反对派领导人说，选举中存在舞弊现象。
ext.ext_en: Opposition leaders said that the elections had been tainted by corruption.

ext.ext_cn: 令一整代政治明星声名染上污点的一系列政治丑闻
ext.ext_en: ...a series of political scandals that has tainted the political stars of a generation.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is tainted by something bad or undesirable, their status or reputation is harmed because they are associated with it.

ext.ext_cn: 她的政府从来没有真正摆脱掉腐败的阴影。
ext.ext_en: Her government never really shook off the taint of corruption...

ext.ext_en: She could smell the taint of sin in the most innocent of passions.

defs.def_en: A taint is an undesirable quality which spoils the status or reputation of someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 变质的油会破坏味道。
ext.ext_en: Rancid oil will taint the flavour.

ext.ext_cn: 被艾滋病毒和肝炎病毒污染的血液
ext.ext_en: ...blood tainted with the AIDS and hepatitis viruses.

defs.def_en: If an unpleasant substance taints food or medicine, the food or medicine is spoiled or damaged by it.

defs.def_cn: (尤指发展中国家的)部落，部族(一些人不赞成此用法)

ext.ext_en: ...three-hundred members of the Xhosa tribe.

ext.ext_cn: 标有印第安部落名称的马里兰州地图
ext.ext_en: …a map of Maryland marked with the names of Indian tribes.

defs.def_en: Tribe is sometimes used to refer to a group of people of the same race, language, and customs, especially in a developing country. Some people disapprove of this use.

defs.def_cn: (从事相同活动或行为相同的)一伙(人)，一帮(人)

ext.ext_cn: 一群群才华出众的年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...tribes of talented young people.

ext.ext_cn: 那帮为分摊吃喝账单而争吵的令人非常讨厌的家伙
ext.ext_en: …the particularly unpleasant tribe who argue over the splitting of restaurant and bar bills.

defs.def_en: You can use tribe to refer to a group of people who are all doing the same thing or who all behave in the same way.

ext.ext_cn: 只有不断练习，有耐心有毅力，才能学会一门技艺。
ext.ext_en: Skill comes only with practice, patience and persistence...

ext.ext_cn: 钱德拉决心做一名医生，她的坚持不懈得到了回报。
ext.ext_en: Chandra was determined to become a doctor and her persistence paid off.

defs.def_en: If you have persistence, you continue to do something even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

defs.def_cn: （尤指不好事物的）持续存在，延续

ext.ext_cn: 对持续通货膨胀和高利率表现出的关注
ext.ext_en: ...an expression of concern at the persistence of inflation and high interest rates.

defs.def_en: The persistence of something, especially something bad, is the fact of its continuing to exist for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 我是个素食主义者，日常烹饪时会用到很多小扁豆。
ext.ext_en: I am a vegetarian and use a lot of lentils in my day-to-day cooking.

defs.def_en: Day-to-day things or activities exist or happen every day as part of ordinary life.

ext.ext_cn: 他需要进行紧急手术以清除脑部的一处血块。
ext.ext_en: He needed emergency surgery to remove a blood clot from his brain.

defs.def_en: A clot is a sticky lump that forms when blood dries up or becomes thick.

ext.ext_cn: 病人的血液无法凝结。
ext.ext_en: The patient's blood refused to clot...

ext.ext_cn: 阿司匹林能显著地稀释血液、抑制血液凝结。
ext.ext_en: Aspirin apparently thins the blood and inhibits clotting.

defs.def_en: When blood clots, it becomes thick and forms a lump.

ext.ext_cn: 非洲人国民大会宣布他们正在开展一次大规模政治抗议活动。
ext.ext_en: The ANC announced it was mounting a major campaign of mass political protests.

ext.ext_cn: 军队开展的维护安全军事行动
ext.ext_en: ...a security operation mounted by the army.

defs.def_en: If you mount a campaign or event, you organize it and make it take place.

ext.ext_cn: 有几个小时，紧张局势有所加剧。
ext.ext_en: For several hours, tension mounted...

ext.ext_cn: 噪音在增强。
ext.ext_en: The decibel level was mounting...

defs.def_en: If something mounts, it increases in intensity.

ext.ext_cn: 未收的垃圾在市区街道上越积越多。
ext.ext_en: The uncollected garbage mounts in city streets...

ext.ext_cn: 他对日益增加的债务置之不理。
ext.ext_en: He ignored his mounting debts.

defs.def_en: If something mounts, it increases in quantity.

ext.ext_cn: 卢埃林登上台阶，走进城堡主楼。
ext.ext_en: Llewelyn was mounting the stairs up into the keep...

ext.ext_cn: 机动车开上了人行道。
ext.ext_en: The vehicle mounted the pavement.

defs.def_en: If you mount the stairs or a platform, you go up the stairs or go up onto the platform.

ext.ext_cn: 他骑上马走了。
ext.ext_en: He mounted his horse and rode away...

ext.ext_cn: 一位戴头盔的男子正跨上摩托车。
ext.ext_en: A man in a crash helmet was mounting a motorbike...

defs.def_en: If you mount a horse or cycle, you climb on to it so that you can ride it.

ext.ext_cn: 愿意照料老马的马主的数量
ext.ext_en: ...the number of owners who care for older mounts.

defs.def_en: A mount is a horse.

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫把作品装裱在绒纸上，并制作了画框。
ext.ext_en: Her husband mounts the work on velour paper and makes the frame...

ext.ext_cn: 篱笆的支撑部分安装在桌子延长出的地方。
ext.ext_en: The support for the fence is mounted on an extension to the table.

defs.def_en: If you mount an object on something, you fix it there firmly.

ext.ext_cn: 画廊已举办了一场爱尔兰女画家的作品展。
ext.ext_en: The gallery has mounted an exhibition of art by Irish women painters.

defs.def_en: If you mount an exhibition or display, you organize and present it.

ext.ext_cn: 乞力马扎罗山
ext.ext_en: ...Mount Kilimanjaro.

defs.def_en: Mount is used as part of the name of a mountain.

defs.def_cn: (通常指用机器)批量生产，大量生产

ext.ext_cn: 批量制鞋机器的发明
ext.ext_en: ...the invention of machinery to mass-produce footwear.

defs.def_en: If someone mass-produces something, they make it in large quantities, usually by machine. This means that the product can be sold cheaply.

defs.def_cn: (通常指因位置改变而)消失,不见

ext.ext_cn: 那辆黑色轿车驶离了他们的视线。
ext.ext_en: The black car drove away from them and disappeared...

ext.ext_cn: 克莱夫独自一人进了屋。
ext.ext_en: Clive disappeared into a room by himself...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something disappears, you mean that you can no longer see them, usually because you or they have changed position.

ext.ext_cn: 一个 13 年前失踪的日本女人
ext.ext_en: ...a Japanese woman who disappeared thirteen years ago...

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮特的丈夫和她的姐姐发现厨房里的小物件经常不翼而飞，而且次数愈发频繁。
ext.ext_en: Janet's husband and sister noticed that small kitchen objects were disappearing with increasing regularity.

defs.def_en: If someone or something disappears, they go away or are taken away somewhere where nobody can find them.

ext.ext_cn: 直接的安全威胁已不复存在了。
ext.ext_en: The immediate security threat has disappeared.

defs.def_en: If something disappears, it stops existing or happening.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 它的很多习俗显得落伍过时。
ext.ext_en: Many of its practices seem anachronistic.

defs.def_en: You say that something is anachronistic when you think that it is out of date or old-fashioned.
A piece of writing that is handwritten is one that someone has written using a pen or pencil rather than by typing it.

ext.ext_cn: 这一治疗需要在内耳放置22个电极。
ext.ext_en: The treatment involves the placement of twenty-two electrodes in the inner ear.

defs.def_en: The placement of something or someone is the act of putting them in a particular place or position.

ext.ext_cn: 他被安排在日本政府部门实习了6个月。
ext.ext_en: He had a six-month work placement with the Japanese government.

defs.def_en: If someone who is training gets a placement, they get a job for a period of time which is intended to give them experience in the work they are training for.

ext.ext_cn: 这些孩子在抚育院等待安置。
ext.ext_en: The children were waiting for placement in a foster care home...

ext.ext_cn: 就业安置计划是为了帮助那些失业者。
ext.ext_en: A job placement program exists to help those who are unemployed.

defs.def_en: The placement of someone in a job, home, or school is the act or process of finding them a job, home, or school.

ext.ext_cn: 这家养育院对萨拉来说似乎是一个合适的收容之所。
ext.ext_en: This home seemed like a good placement for Sarah.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a home that is found for someone who is unable to look after themselves, for example a child, as a placement .

ext.ext_cn: 让国王变成纯粹发挥典礼仪式上象征作用的元首会不会更好？
ext.ext_en: Might it not be better to relegate the King to a purely ceremonial function?...

ext.ext_cn: 其他的报纸把这条消息降格报道，放到了中间版面。
ext.ext_en: Other newspapers relegated the item to the middle pages.

defs.def_en: If you relegate someone or something to a less important position, you give them this position.

ext.ext_cn: 如果利失球，他们将会降级。
ext.ext_en: If Leigh lose, they'll be relegated.

ext.ext_cn: 即将被降到乙级的球队。
ext.ext_en: ...a team about to be relegated to the second division.

defs.def_en: If a sports team that competes in a league is relegated, it has to compete in a lower division in the next competition, because it was one of the least successful teams in the higher division.

ext.ext_cn: 他只听见了自己的回音。
ext.ext_en: He heard nothing but the echoes of his own voice.

defs.def_en: An echo is a sound which is caused by a noise being reflected off a surface such as a wall.

ext.ext_cn: 他的脚步声在没铺地毯的木地板上发出回响。
ext.ext_en: His feet echoed on the bare board floor...

ext.ext_cn: 突如其来的一声巨响在建筑物间回荡着，震碎了玻璃。
ext.ext_en: The bang came suddenly, echoing across the buildings, shattering glass.

defs.def_en: If a sound echoes, it is reflected off a surface and can be heard again after the original sound has stopped.

ext.ext_cn: 屋子里回荡着声音。
ext.ext_en: The room echoed...

ext.ext_cn: 十来只狗的叫声在走廊里回响。
ext.ext_en: The corridor echoed with the barking of a dozen dogs.

defs.def_en: In a place that echoes, a sound is reflected off a surface, and is repeated after the original sound has stopped.

ext.ext_cn: 最后两章中的很多说法是对前面段落的呼应。
ext.ext_en: Many phrases in the last two chapters echo earlier passages...

ext.ext_cn: 他们常常你唱我和。
ext.ext_en: Their views often echo each other...

defs.def_en: If you echo someone's words, you repeat them or express agreement with their attitude or opinion.

defs.def_cn: （态度、观点或说法的）重复，附和

ext.ext_cn: 我听到有人重提那个最先使我们陷入这一困境的想法。
ext.ext_en: I hear an echo of the thinking that got us into this mess in the first place...

ext.ext_cn: 政治攻击只有在选民中引起共鸣才会有作用。
ext.ext_en: Political attacks work only if they find an echo with voters.

defs.def_en: An echo is an expression of an attitude, opinion, or statement which has already been expressed.

ext.ext_cn: 那起事故仿佛是过去灾难的重现。
ext.ext_en: The accident has echoes of past disasters.

defs.def_en: A detail or feature which reminds you of something else can be referred to as an echo .

ext.ext_cn: 选用了粉红色和米色，以跟从天花板的颜色。
ext.ext_en: Pinks and beiges were chosen to echo the colours of the ceiling.

defs.def_en: If one thing echoes another, the first is a copy of a particular detail or feature of the other.

ext.ext_cn: 这则古老的寓言流传了数个世纪。
ext.ext_en: The old fable continues to echo down the centuries.

defs.def_en: If something echoes, it continues to be discussed and remains important or influential in a particular situation or among a particular group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 鸡块的大小将决定烹饪时间的长短。
ext.ext_en: The size of the chicken pieces will determine the cooking time...

ext.ext_cn: 社会地位很大程度上是由家里经济支柱的职业决定的。
ext.ext_en: Social status is largely determined by the occupation of the main breadwinner...

defs.def_en: If a particular factor determines the nature of a thing or event, it causes it to be of a particular kind.

ext.ext_cn: 调查会查明到底发生了什么事情。
ext.ext_en: The investigation will determine what really happened...

ext.ext_cn: 需要进行检测以确定其对人的长期影响。
ext.ext_en: Testing needs to be done to determine the long-term effects on humans...

defs.def_en: To determine a fact means to discover it as a result of investigation.

ext.ext_en: The Baltic people have a right to determine their own future...

ext.ext_cn: 最终措辞仍未敲定。
ext.ext_en: The final wording had not yet been determined...

defs.def_en: If you determine something, you decide it or settle it.

ext.ext_cn: 他决意营救自己的两名同胞。
ext.ext_en: He determined to rescue his two countrymen...

ext.ext_cn: 我下定决心要直截了当地问他。
ext.ext_en: I determined that I would ask him outright.

defs.def_en: If you determine to do something, you make a firm decision to do it.

defs.def_cn: (尤指为获得性快感而)穿异性服装

ext.ext_cn: 如果他们想做异性装扮，可以。
ext.ext_en: If they want to cross-dress that's fine.

defs.def_en: If someone cross-dresses, they wear the clothes of the opposite sex, especially for sexual pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 他仔细斟酌着这个问题。
ext.ext_en: He meditated on the problem...

ext.ext_cn: 儿子开始上学的那一天，她就在考虑他未来的种种不确定因素了。
ext.ext_en: On the day her son began school, she meditated on the uncertainties of his future.

defs.def_en: If you meditate on something, you think about it very carefully and deeply for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 我在冥想，并进入了一个更高的意识境界。
ext.ext_en: I was meditating, and reached a higher state of consciousness.

defs.def_en: If you meditate you remain in a silent and calm state for a period of time, as part of a religious training or so that you are more able to deal with the problems and difficulties of everyday life.

defs.def_cn: 逐字逐句地;一字不差地

ext.ext_en: The President's speeches are regularly reproduced verbatim in the state-run newspapers.

ext.ext_en: I was treated to a verbatim report of every conversation she's taken part in over the past week.

defs.def_en: If you repeat something verbatim, you use exactly the same words as were used originally.

ext.ext_en: ...a pictorial history of the Special Air Service.

ext.ext_cn: 图片形象
ext.ext_en: ...pictorial images.

defs.def_en: Pictorial means using or relating to pictures.

ext.ext_cn: 她又重返大银幕，扮演坎迪专横的母亲罗丝。
ext.ext_en: She returns to the big screen to play Candy's overbearing mother, Rose.

defs.def_en: When people talk about the big screen, they are referring to films that are made for cinema rather than for television.

ext.ext_cn: 新的地铁系统设计为使用无铅燃料。
ext.ext_en: The new Metro is designed to run on unleaded fuel.

ext.ext_cn: 其所有的V8引擎使用无铅汽油都将运转顺畅。
ext.ext_en: All its V8 engines will run happily on unleaded.

defs.def_en: Unleaded fuel contains a smaller amount of lead than most fuels so that it produces fewer harmful substances when it is burned.

defs.def_cn: (化学物质)起催化作用的，有催化性的

ext.ext_cn: 具有特殊化学性质和催化性的碳分子
ext.ext_en: ...carbon molecules with unusual chemical and catalytic properties.

defs.def_en: In chemistry, a catalytic substance or a substance with catalytic properties is a substance which increases the speed of a chemical reaction.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 催化性的；促进性的；刺激性的

ext.ext_cn: 然而，政府在组织协调救援行动上确实发挥了重要的促进作用。
ext.ext_en: Governments do, however, have a vital catalytic role in orchestrating rescue operations.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or thing as having a catalytic effect, you mean that they cause things to happen or they increase the speed at which things happen.

ext.ext_cn: 她只是偶尔才喝杯红酒,让自己享受一下。
ext.ext_en: Only rarely will she indulge in a glass of wine...

ext.ext_cn: 他重返英国，为的是可以尽情释放自己对足球的激情。
ext.ext_en: He returned to Britain so that he could indulge his passion for football...

defs.def_en: If you indulge in something or if you indulge yourself, you allow yourself to have or do something that you know you will enjoy.

ext.ext_cn: 他反对纵容娇惯孩子。
ext.ext_en: He did not agree with indulging children.

defs.def_en: If you indulge someone, you let them have or do what they want, even if this is not good for them.

ext.ext_cn: 几年前，她被一个骗子骗过。
ext.ext_en: A few years ago she was the victim of a con man.

defs.def_en: A con man is a man who persuades people to give him their money or property by lying to them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 黑颈鹤，世界最稀有的物种之一
ext.ext_en: ...the black-necked crane, one of the rarest species in the world...

ext.ext_cn: 她收集稀有植物。
ext.ext_en: She collects rare plants...

defs.def_en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在那些极其少见的、他的确单独吃饭的时候
ext.ext_en: ...on those rare occasions when he did eat alone...

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿极少有心脏病发作的情况，他说。
ext.ext_en: Heart attacks were extremely rare in babies, he said...

defs.def_en: An event or situation that is rare does not occur very often.

ext.ext_cn: 费里斯具备把自己的观察结果记录下来的超强能力。
ext.ext_en: Ferris has a rare ability to record her observations on paper...

ext.ext_cn: 看他打球是一种享受。
ext.ext_en: It was a rare pleasure to see him in action.

defs.def_en: You use rare to emphasize an extremely good or remarkable quality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Thick tuna steaks are eaten rare, like beef...

ext.ext_en: Waiter, I specifically asked for this steak rare.

defs.def_en: Meat that is rare is cooked very lightly so that the inside is still red.

defs.def_cn: （官方因种族或宗教原因而进行的有组织的）集体迫害，大屠杀

ext.ext_cn: 针对南部毛里塔尼亚黑人有组织的、野蛮的集体迫害
ext.ext_en: ...a systematic and brutal pogrom against southern black Mauritanians.

defs.def_en: A pogrom is organized, official violence against a group of people for racial or religious reasons.

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司赢得了一份极为重要的合同，参与建设欧洲最高的大厦。
ext.ext_en: The company won a prestigious contract for work on Europe's tallest building...

ext.ext_cn: 他签下了一份为期7年的合同，年薪为15万美元。
ext.ext_en: He was given a seven-year contract with an annual salary of $150,000.

defs.def_en: A contract is a legal agreement, usually between two companies or between an employer and employee, which involves doing work for a stated sum of money.

defs.def_cn: 签合同，订立契约(做某事)

ext.ext_cn: 你可以跟我们签订送货合同。
ext.ext_en: You can contract with us to deliver your cargo...

ext.ext_cn: 波士顿美术博物馆已经签订合同，将其部分藏品租借给日本一家博物馆。
ext.ext_en: The Boston Museum of Fine Arts has already contracted to lease part of its collection to a museum in Japan.

defs.def_en: If you contract with someone to do something, you legally agree to do it for them or for them to do it for you.

ext.ext_cn: 血液在心脏收缩的时候从心脏流出。
ext.ext_en: Blood is only expelled from the heart when it contracts...

ext.ext_cn: 新的研究表明，过量食用肉类和盐可能会导致肌肉收缩。
ext.ext_en: New research shows that an excess of meat and salt can contract muscles.

defs.def_en: When something contracts or when something contracts it, it becomes smaller or shorter.

ext.ext_cn: 10月，制造业经济已经连续第6个月出现萎缩状况。
ext.ext_en: The manufacturing economy contracted in October for the sixth consecutive month.

defs.def_en: When something such as an economy or market contracts, it becomes smaller.

ext.ext_cn: 他因为输血而感染了艾滋病。
ext.ext_en: He contracted AIDS from a blood transfusion...

ext.ext_cn: 卵巢癌是女性常患的第六大癌症。
ext.ext_en: Ovarian cancer is the sixth most common cancer contracted by women.

defs.def_en: If you contract a serious illness, you become ill with it.

ext.ext_cn: 她和一个英国退役军人正式订婚了。
ext.ext_en: She contracted a formal marriage to a British ex-serviceman.

defs.def_en: If you contract a marriage, alliance, or other relationship with someone, you arrange to have that relationship with them.

ext.ext_cn: 这些判罪导致当地犯罪团伙的老大们要雇凶杀他。
ext.ext_en: The convictions resulted in the local crime bosses putting a contract on him...

ext.ext_cn: 警察建议她离开这个城市，因为有人雇杀手杀她。
ext.ext_en: The police advised her to get out of town because there was a contract on her life.

defs.def_en: If there is a contract on a person or on their life, someone has made an arrangement to have them killed.

ext.ext_cn: 导演想要当时签约于华纳兄弟娱乐公司旗下的奥利维娅·德哈维兰出演。
ext.ext_en: The director wanted Olivia de Havilland, then under contract to Warner Brothers.

defs.def_en: If you are under contract to someone, you have signed a contract agreeing to work for them, and for no-one else, during a fixed period of time.
Your family name is your surname.

defs.def_cn: (加在某些动词后构成名词)表示“动作”、“过程”、“状态”

ext.ext_cn: 这项服务开始实施后不久
ext.ext_en: ...shortly after the commencement of the service.

ext.ext_cn: 铀浓缩
ext.ext_en: ...the enrichment of uranium.

defs.def_en: -ment is added to some verbs to form nouns that refer to actions, processes, or states.

defs.def_cn: 荒唐地;荒谬地;可笑地;令人惊奇地

ext.ext_cn: 德娜买了几卷看起来非常次的丝绸。
ext.ext_en: Dena bought rolls of silk that seemed ridiculously cheap...

ext.ext_cn: 她作为妈妈实在是太年轻了。
ext.ext_en: She looked ridiculously young to be a mother.

defs.def_en: You use ridiculously to emphasize the fact that you think something is unreasonable or very surprising.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (政客或组织的行为)炫耀胜利(或成功)的，洋洋得意的，耀武扬威的

ext.ext_cn: 对他们霸主地位的耀武扬威的庆祝
ext.ext_en: ...a triumphalist celebration of their supremacy.

defs.def_en: Triumphalist behaviour is behaviour in which politicians or organizations celebrate a victory or a great success, especially when this is intended to upset the people they have defeated.

defs.def_cn: 不能和谐相处的;不协调的;不一致的

ext.ext_cn: 他们强烈感受到他们的宗教信仰与政治体制不相称。
ext.ext_en: They feel strongly that their religion is incompatible with the political system...

ext.ext_cn: 他的行为与他的国家领袖身份不相称。
ext.ext_en: His behavior has been incompatible with his role as head of state...

defs.def_en: If one thing or person is incompatible with another, they are very different in important ways, and do not suit each other or agree with each other.

defs.def_cn: 不兼容的;不相容的;互斥的

ext.ext_cn: 这就使得它的微型计算机与它的大型主机不兼容。
ext.ext_en: This made its mini-computers incompatible with its mainframes...

ext.ext_cn: 由于计算机系统不兼容，许多机构通过人工方式进行信息交换。
ext.ext_en: Many institutions exchange information by hand because of incompatible computer systems.

defs.def_en: If one type of computer or computer system is incompatible with another, they cannot use the same programs or be linked up together.

ext.ext_cn: 原味脱脂酸奶
ext.ext_en: ...plain non-fat yogurt...

ext.ext_cn: 脱脂乳制品能提供身体所需的营养，而不含过多的热量。
ext.ext_en: Non-fat dairy products supply the needed nutrients without excessive calories.

defs.def_en: Non-fat foods have very low amounts of fat in them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 奇怪的；古怪的；不寻常的

ext.ext_cn: 肯尼特先生有种很奇怪的幽默感。
ext.ext_en: Mr Kennet has a rather peculiar sense of humour...

ext.ext_cn: 雷切尔觉得它味道古怪。
ext.ext_en: Rachel thought it tasted peculiar.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as peculiar, you think that they are strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way.

ext.ext_cn: 这个问题绝对不只限于美国。
ext.ext_en: The problem is by no means peculiar to America.

defs.def_en: If something is peculiar to a particular thing, person, or situation, it belongs or relates only to that thing, person, or situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有点不舒服的；稍感眩晕的

ext.ext_cn: 这一切令我觉得有点儿不舒服。
ext.ext_en: All this has made me feel quite peculiar.

defs.def_en: If you say that you feel peculiar, you mean that you feel slightly ill or unsteady.

defs.def_cn: 演出时间;节目播出时间

ext.ext_cn: 开演时间快到了，你得进化装间了。
ext.ext_en: It's close to showtime now, so you retire into the dressing room.

defs.def_en: Showtime is the time when a particular stage or television show starts.

defs.def_cn: 凌驾于；优先于；比…更重要

ext.ext_cn: 孩子的幸福安康应该永远比父母的愿望来得更重要。
ext.ext_en: The welfare of a child should always override the wishes of its parents...

ext.ext_cn: 他们对工作的痴迷常常超乎其他一切。
ext.ext_en: Their work is frequently an obsession that overrides all other considerations.

defs.def_en: If one thing in a situation overrides other things, it is more important than them.

defs.def_cn: （以更大的权力）撤销，推翻，否决

ext.ext_cn: 总统否决了该议案，而参议院以一票之差未能推翻他的否决。
ext.ext_en: The president vetoed the bill, and the Senate failed by a single vote to override his veto...

ext.ext_cn: 我提前申请当局对他进行否决。
ext.ext_en: I'm applying in advance for the authority to override him...

defs.def_en: If someone in authority overrides a person or their decisions, they cancel their decisions.

ext.ext_cn: 该议案现在提交到众议院，在这里否决投票预计不会获得通过。
ext.ext_en: The bill now goes to the House where an override vote is expected to fail...

ext.ext_cn: 看来推翻这项否决的可能性很小。
ext.ext_en: An override of the veto appears unlikely.

defs.def_en: An override is an attempt to cancel someone's decisions by using your authority over them or by gaining more votes than them in an election or contest.

defs.def_cn: 神经网络(模拟人脑功能设计的计算机程序或系统)
defs.def_en: In computing, a neural network is a program or system which is modelled on the human brain and is designed to imitate the brain's method of functioning, particularly the process of learning.

defs.def_cn: (尤指小孩)不在家过夜,在外过夜

ext.ext_cn: 她说他的朋友们可以在楼下的大房间里住一晚。
ext.ext_en: She said his friends could sleep over in the big room downstairs.

defs.def_en: If someone, especially a child, sleeps over in a place such as a friend's home, they stay there for one night.

defs.def_cn: 予以(打击);使遭受(损伤、苦痛等)

ext.ext_cn: 反叛武装称他们使政府军遭受重创。
ext.ext_en: Rebels say they have inflicted heavy casualties on government forces...

ext.ext_cn: 经济衰退使英国工业遭受的损失
ext.ext_en: ...the damage being inflicted on Britain's industries by the recession...

defs.def_en: To inflict harm or damage on someone or something means to make them suffer it.

ext.ext_cn: 三方将在下个月会面，以解决余下的分歧。
ext.ext_en: The three parties will meet next month to work out remaining differences...

ext.ext_cn: 美国已经撤回了大使馆的剩余人员。
ext.ext_en: The United States has withdrawn the remaining staff from its embassy...

defs.def_en: The remaining things or people out of a group are the things or people that still exist, are still present, or have not yet been dealt with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我的喉咙已经好几年没有像昨晚那样疼了。
ext.ext_en: It's years since  I've had a sore throat like I did last night...

ext.ext_cn: 手术过后我的胸口还在作痛。
ext.ext_en: My chest is still sore from the surgery.

defs.def_en: If part of your body is sore, it causes you pain and discomfort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 结果就是，现在他们都对你感到十分恼火。
ext.ext_en: The result is that they are now all feeling very sore at you...

ext.ext_cn: 他们对在四分之一决赛里输给英格兰队这件事感到非常懊恼。
ext.ext_en: They are sore about losing to England in the quarter-finals.

defs.def_en: If you are sore about something, you are angry and upset about it.

defs.def_cn: 皮肤发炎疼痛处;疮肿;溃疡
defs.def_en: See also:cold sore;A sore is a painful place on the body where the skin is infected.

defs.def_cn: 痛处;惹人生气的话题;令人难堪的话题

ext.ext_cn: 美国军队继续驻扎在韩国领土上这一事实仍然让这些学生深感气愤。
ext.ext_en: The continuing presence of American troops on Korean soil remains a very sore point with these students.

defs.def_en: If something is a sore point with someone, it is likely to make them angry or embarrassed if you try to discuss it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 单调乏味的;缺乏生气的

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽穿着同一件毫无朝气的灰色裙子。
ext.ext_en: Mary was wearing the same drab grey dress.

ext.ext_cn: 他死气沉沉的小办公室
ext.ext_en: ...his drab little office...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as drab, you think that it is dull and boring to look at or experience.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 感染的其中一个长期后果是使心脏瓣膜受损。
ext.ext_en: One of the long-lasting effects of the infection is damage to a valve in the heart...

ext.ext_cn: 民用飞机的发动机必须静音、无污染、可靠、耐用。
ext.ext_en: Civil aircraft engines must be quiet, non-polluting, reliable and long-lasting.

defs.def_en: Something that is long-lasting lasts for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 80匹马小跑起来。
ext.ext_en: Eighty horses trotted up.

defs.def_en: Eighty is the number 80.

ext.ext_cn: 他年近九旬，已成为该国最受尊崇的政界元老。
ext.ext_en: He was in his late eighties and had become the country's most respected elder statesman.

defs.def_en: When you talk about the eighties, you are referring to numbers between 80 and 89. For example, if you are in your eighties, you are aged between 80 and 89. If the temperature is in the eighties, the temperature is between 80 and 89 degrees.

ext.ext_cn: 他在20世纪80年代经营着一家房地产开发公司。
ext.ext_en: He ran a property development business in the eighties.

defs.def_en: The eighties is the decade between 1980 and 1989.

ext.ext_cn: 大幅减少我们固体废料问题的可能性
ext.ext_en: ...the potential of greatly reducing our solid waste problem...

ext.ext_cn: 他数周以来都没有食用固体食物。
ext.ext_en: He did not eat solid food for several weeks.

defs.def_en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

ext.ext_cn: 固体在一定的温度下会变为液体。
ext.ext_en: Solids turn to liquids at certain temperatures.

ext.ext_cn: 固体的分解
ext.ext_en: ...the decomposition of solids.

defs.def_en: A solid is a substance that stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 雪已经融化了，湖面却依然冻得硬邦邦的。
ext.ext_en: The snow had melted, but the lake was still frozen solid...

ext.ext_cn: 混凝土会像岩石一样坚固。
ext.ext_en: The concrete will stay as solid as a rock.

defs.def_en: A substance that is solid is very hard or firm.

defs.def_cn: 无空隙的;实心的;非中空的

ext.ext_cn: 打通了 50 英尺厚的实心岩石修建而成的隧道
ext.ext_en: ...a tunnel carved through 50ft of solid rock.

ext.ext_cn: 五彩缤纷、密密实实的林带
ext.ext_en: ...a solid wall of multicoloured trees.

defs.def_en: A solid object or mass does not have a space inside it, or holes or gaps in it.

ext.ext_cn: 水龙头似乎是用纯金制成的。
ext.ext_en: The taps appeared to be made of solid gold.

ext.ext_cn: 实木门
ext.ext_en: ...solid wood doors.

defs.def_en: If an object is made of solid gold or solid wood, for example, it is made of gold or wood all the way through, rather than just on the outside.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 银行往往建得看上去很坚固，好让顾客放心。
ext.ext_en: Banks are built to look solid to reassure their customers...

ext.ext_cn: 这部车子令人感觉十分皮实。
ext.ext_en: The car feels very solid.

defs.def_en: A structure that is solid is strong and is not likely to collapse or fall over.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你要的是一个可靠而稳重的丈夫——一个全心全意对你的人。
ext.ext_en: You want a husband who is solid and stable, someone who will devote himself to you...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的乐手都来自值得我们尊敬的工人阶级。
ext.ext_en: All the band come from good, solid, working-class backgrounds...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as solid, you mean that they are very reliable and respectable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (证据、消息等)可靠的，确凿的，有根有据的

ext.ext_cn: 我们还没有得到关于大家现在所处位置的确切消息。
ext.ext_en: We don't have good solid information on where the people are...

ext.ext_cn: 需要的是一些确凿的证据。
ext.ext_en: Some solid evidence was what was required...

defs.def_en: Solid evidence or information is reliable because it is based on facts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (工作、意见等)切实有用的，充实的，实实在在的

ext.ext_cn: 哥伦比亚国际大学为教堂在许多问题上提供了切实有用的建议。
ext.ext_en: The CIU provides churches with solid advice on a wide range of subjects...

ext.ext_cn: 我就希望能有一个上佳的表现。
ext.ext_en: All I am looking for is a good solid performance...

defs.def_en: You use solid to describe something such as advice or a piece of work which is useful and reliable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (政策的依据、对组织的支持)牢固的，坚实的，充分的

ext.ext_cn: 我决定在这个坚实的基础之上继续努力。
ext.ext_en: I am determined to build on this solid foundation.

ext.ext_cn: 拥有党内成员的强力支持、受到党外民众广泛欢迎的民主党提名人
ext.ext_en: ...a Democratic nominee with solid support within the party and broad appeal beyond.

defs.def_en: You use solid to describe something such as the basis for a policy or support for an organization when it is strong, because it has been developed carefully and slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一起共事了整整两年时间。
ext.ext_en: We had worked together for two solid years.

defs.def_en: If you do something for a solid period of time, you do it without any pause or interruption throughout that time.

ext.ext_cn: 科技日新月异。
ext.ext_en: Technology is changing fast...

ext.ext_cn: 应该允许他们等到更廉价的技术被开发出来。
ext.ext_en: They should be allowed to wait for cheaper technologies to be developed.

defs.def_en: Technology refers to methods, systems, and devices which are the result of scientific knowledge being used for practical purposes.

ext.ext_cn: 我们试图让独木舟靠他更近一些。
ext.ext_en: We attempted to manoeuvre the canoe closer to him...

ext.ext_cn: 我在桌子中间穿行，来到后面的角落里。
ext.ext_en: I manoeuvred my way among the tables to the back corner of the place...

defs.def_en: If you manoeuvre something into or out of an awkward position, you skilfully move it there.

ext.ext_cn: 当局不得不干预市场，迫其提出削减利率的要求。
ext.ext_en: The authorities have to manoeuvre the markets into demanding a cut in interest rates...

ext.ext_cn: 他依靠手腕巧妙地重掌权力。
ext.ext_en: He brilliantly manoeuvred himself back to power...

defs.def_en: If you manoeuvre a situation, you change it in a clever and skilful way so that you can benefit from it.

ext.ext_cn: 盟军明日演习，来展示一旦发生新的入侵，其集结速度之快。
ext.ext_en: Allied troops begin maneuvers tomorrow to show how quickly forces could be mobilized in case of a new invasion...

ext.ext_cn: 这个营地被用于军事演习。
ext.ext_en: The camp was used for military manoeuvres.

defs.def_en: Military manoeuvres are training exercises which involve the movement of soldiers and equipment over a large area.

defs.def_cn: 阿亚图拉（伊斯兰教派的宗教领袖）
defs.def_en: An ayatollah is a type of Muslim religious leader.

ext.ext_cn: 杰克逊已经是连续第二年获胜了。
ext.ext_en: Jackson was the winner for a second successive year...

ext.ext_cn: 接连几届政府都没能协调出一个全国性的交通运输政策，英国因此而深受其苦。
ext.ext_en: Britain was suffering from the failure of successive governments to co-ordinate a national transport policy.

defs.def_en: Successive means happening or existing one after another without a break.

defs.def_cn: 不可逆转的;不可挽回的;不可撤销的

ext.ext_cn: 如果她在 7 天之内没有得到治疗,她的大脑有可能遭受不可逆转的损伤。
ext.ext_en: She could suffer irreversible brain damage if she is not treated within seven days...

ext.ext_cn: 改革没有回头路。
ext.ext_en: The reforms are irreversible.

defs.def_en: If a change is irreversible, things cannot be changed back to the way they were before.

defs.def_cn: (旨在诋毁他人的)不实的报道

ext.ext_cn: 关于哈丁是个政治走狗的指控可能是个谣传。
ext.ext_en: The charge that Harding was a political stooge may be a canard.

defs.def_en: A canard is an idea or a piece of information that is false, especially one that is spread deliberately in order to harm someone or their work.

ext.ext_cn: 眼球晶状体的混浊可由缺乏某些维生素造成。
ext.ext_en: Opacity of the eye lens can be induced by deficiency of certain vitamins...

ext.ext_cn: 他坚持认为水的清澈程度取决于其中矿物质的含量。
ext.ext_en: He insisted that the mineral content of the water determined the opacity.

defs.def_en: Opacity is the quality of being difficult to see through.

ext.ext_cn: 它那戏剧性的微妙之处常被含糊处理到了晦涩的地步。
ext.ext_en: Its dramatic nuances were often generalised to the point of opacity.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something's opacity, you mean that it is difficult to understand.

defs.def_cn: (穿越水域或湿地的)堤道，砌道
defs.def_en: A causeway is a raised path or road that crosses water or wet land.
Biotechnology is the use of living parts such as cells or bacteria in industry and technology.
Oilseed rape is a plant with yellow flowers which is grown as a crop. Its seeds are crushed to make cooking oil.
A meteor is a piece of rock or metal that burns very brightly when it enters the earth's atmosphere from space.

ext.ext_cn: 她追求精神上的满足，完全生活在一个诗歌和想象的世界里。
ext.ext_en: She lived entirely by spiritual values, in a world of poetry and imagination.

defs.def_en: Spiritual means relating to people's thoughts and beliefs, rather than to their bodies and physical surroundings.

defs.def_cn: 宗教(上)的；宗教信仰(上)的

ext.ext_cn: 爱尔兰 370 万天主教徒的宗教领袖
ext.ext_en: The spiritual leader of Ireland's 3.7 million Catholics...

ext.ext_cn: 一位身着牧师袍服的男子进行了宗教布道。
ext.ext_en: A man in priestly clothes offered spiritual guidance.

defs.def_en: Spiritual means relating to people's  religious beliefs.

defs.def_cn: 灵歌(原为美国黑奴所唱的一种宗教歌曲)
defs.def_en: A spiritual is a religious song of  the type originally sung by black slaves in America.
Your spiritual home is the place where you feel that you belong, usually because your ideas or attitudes are the same as those of the people who live there.

ext.ext_cn: 他训斥了那个球员，我再次看见那个球员时，他道了歉。
ext.ext_en: He chewed out the player, who apologized the next time I saw him...

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆回到达拉斯时，佩罗把他叫过去，骂了他一顿。
ext.ext_en: When Tom got back to Dallas, Perot called him over and chewed him out.

defs.def_en: If you chew someone out, you tell them off in a very angry way.

ext.ext_cn: 每本书都配有精美的插图。
ext.ext_en: Each book is beautifully illustrated...

ext.ext_cn: 每年都有数百只动物被这样杀掉。
ext.ext_en: Each year, hundreds of animals are killed in this way...

defs.def_en: If you refer to each thing or  each person in a group, you are referring to every member of the group and considering them as individuals.

ext.ext_cn: 他从这些出版物中挑选了40本，逐一阅读。
ext.ext_en: He picked up forty of these publications and read each one of them.

defs.def_en: If you refer to each one of the members of a group, you are emphasizing that something applies to every one of them.

ext.ext_cn: 所有参与谋杀他的人都会被绳之以法。
ext.ext_en: Each and every person responsible for his murder will be brought to justice...

ext.ext_cn: 除非他们将我们赶尽杀绝，否则真理不灭。
ext.ext_en: They can't destroy truth without destroying each and every one of us.

defs.def_en: You can refer to each and every member of a group to emphasize that you mean all the members of that group.
