ext.ext_en: The cars then weaved in and out of traffic at top speed...

ext.ext_cn: 他绕过一张张桌子，走到她和鲍勃坐着的地方。
ext.ext_en: He weaved around the tables to where she sat with Bob...

defs.def_en: If you weave your way somewhere, you move between and around things as you go there.

ext.ext_cn: 简·罗伯茨编了一个引人入胜的故事，诱骗一位年轻女性进入了黑手党的地盘。
ext.ext_en: Jan Roberts weaves a compelling tale which traps a young woman in a world run by the Mafia.

defs.def_en: If you weave a story, you invent a complicated story.

defs.def_cn: 将(素材等)编入（故事或设计中）

ext.ext_cn: 她在诗中编织着奇思妙想。
ext.ext_en: She weaves imaginative elements into her poems...

ext.ext_cn: 布拉格把他主要人物的身世都串在一起。
ext.ext_en: Bragg weaves together the histories of his main characters.

defs.def_en: If you weave details into a story or design, you include them, so that they are closely linked together or become an important part of the story or design.

ext.ext_cn: 70 年代的经典情景喜剧《旧楼记》
ext.ext_en: ...the classic '70s TV sitcom 'Rising Damp'.

defs.def_en: A sitcom is an amusing television drama series about a set of characters. Sitcom is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'situation comedy'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们知道艺术品位因人而异。
ext.ext_en: We know that taste in art is a subjective matter...

ext.ext_cn: 他们解释其过去的方式太主观。
ext.ext_en: The way they interpreted their past was highly subjective.

defs.def_en: Something that is subjective is based on personal opinions and feelings rather than on facts.

defs.def_cn: 蓝皮书（指政府官方报告或统计）
defs.def_en: A blue book is an official government report or register of statistics.

defs.def_cn: 反主流文化;反正统文化

ext.ext_cn: 英国反主流文化的历史
ext.ext_en: ...a history of British counter-culture.

defs.def_en: Counter-culture is a set of values, ideas, and ways of behaving that are completely different from those of the rest of society.

ext.ext_cn: 不是所有人都加入反主流文化群体，不是所有人都示威游行，退学，吸毒，或逃避服兵役。
ext.ext_en: Not everyone joined the counterculture, not everyone demonstrated, dropped out, took drugs, or dodged the draft.

defs.def_en: A counter-culture is a group in society whose values, ideas, and ways of behaving are completely different from those of the rest of society.

defs.def_cn: （簿记中的）在产品（价值），半成品（价值）

ext.ext_cn: 价值500万英镑的成品和价值200万英镑的在产品
ext.ext_en: ...five million pounds' worth of finished goods and two million pounds' worth of work-in-progress.

defs.def_en: In book-keeping, work-in-progress refers to the monetary value of work that has not yet been paid for because it has not yet been completed.

ext.ext_cn: 伯德1928年前往南极洲的探险
ext.ext_en: ...Byrd's 1928 expedition to Antarctica.

defs.def_en: An expedition is an organized journey that is made for a particular purpose such as exploration.

ext.ext_cn: 探险队中43名成员遇难。
ext.ext_en: Forty-three members of the expedition were killed.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a group of people who are going on an expedition as an expedition .

ext.ext_cn: 卡罗琳加入了他们的购物之旅。
ext.ext_en: Caroline joined them on the shopping expeditions.

ext.ext_cn: 垂钓之旅
ext.ext_en: ...a fishing expedition.

defs.def_en: An expedition is a short journey or trip that you make for pleasure.

DNA is an acid in the chromosomes in the centre of the cells of living things. DNA determines the particular structure and functions of every cell and is responsible for characteristics being passed on from parents to their children. DNA is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'deoxyribonucleic acid'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无害的;（尤指对健康）不造成伤害的

ext.ext_cn: 该行业一直在努力开发一些可以替代这些气体的无害物质。
ext.ext_en: Industry has been working at developing harmless substitutes for these gases...

ext.ext_cn: 这个试验不会对动物造成伤害。
ext.ext_en: This experiment was harmless to the animals.

defs.def_en: Something that is harmless does not have any bad effects, especially on people's health.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无关紧要的;不讨人厌的;不会惹麻烦的

ext.ext_cn: 他看起来不会惹什么麻烦。
ext.ext_en: He seemed harmless enough...

ext.ext_cn: 我不想剥夺他们这点无伤大雅的乐趣。
ext.ext_en: I would not want to deny them a harmless pleasure.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as harmless, you mean that they are not important and therefore unlikely to annoy other people or cause trouble.

defs.def_cn: 摩托车手;骑摩托车的人
defs.def_en: A motorcyclist is a person who rides a motorcycle.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 奥布里睡眠不足，这让他总是易怒。
ext.ext_en: Aubrey had slept little and that always made him peevish...

ext.ext_cn: 她低头瞪着我，一脸怒气。
ext.ext_en: She glared down at me with a peevish expression on her face.

defs.def_en: Someone who is peevish is bad-tempered.

ext.ext_cn: 法官最终作出判定，没有足够证据证明那是有预谋的。
ext.ext_en: The judge finally concluded there was insufficient evidence of premeditation.

defs.def_en: Premeditation is thinking about something or planning it before you actually do it.

ext.ext_cn: 带有手绘圆点的绿色和蓝色茶杯和茶托
ext.ext_en: ...hand-painted spotted cups and saucers in green and blue...

ext.ext_cn: 他的双颊上长了一些黑头。
ext.ext_en: His cheeks were spotted with blackheads.

defs.def_en: Something that is spotted has a pattern of spots on it.

ext.ext_cn: 流入美国的资本大幅下降
ext.ext_en: ...a large drop in the capital inflow into America.

defs.def_en: In economics, capital inflow is the amount of capital coming into a country, for example in the form of foreign investment.

defs.def_cn: 废马屠夫（买下老马并将其屠宰以获取其肉、骨、皮的人）

ext.ext_cn: 她的马擅长跨越障碍，是家人从废马屠宰场挽救回来的。
ext.ext_en: Her horse was a show jumper whom the family rescued from the knacker's yard.

defs.def_en: A knacker is someone who buys up old horses and then kills them for their meat, bones, or leather.

ext.ext_cn: 他在拉赫蒂附近的一个乡村里过着平静的日子。
ext.ext_en: He lives quietly in the country in a village near Lahti.

ext.ext_cn: 乡村学校
ext.ext_en: ...the village school.

defs.def_en: A village consists of a group of houses, together with other buildings such as a church and a school, in a country area.

defs.def_cn: 乱兜圈子的;成群乱转的

ext.ext_cn: 他们穿过乱哄哄的人群时目的明确，行动坚决。
ext.ext_en: They moved purposefully through the milling crowd.

defs.def_en: The people in a milling crowd move around within a particular place or area, so that the movement of the whole crowd looks very confused.
A revolver is a kind of hand gun. Its bullets are kept in a revolving cylinder in the gun.
A feather duster is a stick with a bunch of real or artificial feathers attached to one end. It is used for dusting and cleaning things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 缺乏声调的;平板的;单调的

ext.ext_cn: “我们该怎么办？”米尔顿又用平板而单调的声音问道。
ext.ext_en: 'What shall we do?' Milton said again in a toneless voice.

defs.def_en: A toneless voice is dull and does not express any feeling.

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人纵酒现象增多，令人不安
ext.ext_en: ...a disturbing rise in binge drinking among young people.

defs.def_en: Binge drinking is the consumption of large amounts of alcohol within a short period of time.
A golf course is a large area of grass which is specially designed for people to play golf on.

ext.ext_cn: 也许他给他们造成了小小的误导，但他不是有意的。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps he had slightly misled them, but it was quite unintentional...

ext.ext_cn: 有几个并非出于本意的引人发笑之处。
ext.ext_en: There are moments of unintentional humour.

defs.def_en: Something that is unintentional is not done deliberately, but happens by accident.
A toothbrush is a small brush that you use for cleaning your teeth.

ext.ext_cn: 少数几个旁观者站在现场观看。
ext.ext_en: A handful of onlookers stand in the field watching.

defs.def_en: An onlooker is someone who watches an event take place but does not take part in it.

defs.def_cn: 不加掩饰的；表露无遗的

ext.ext_cn: 他的口信引起了公开的愤怒。
ext.ext_en: His message was received with unconcealed anger.

ext.ext_cn: 他们对彼此毫不掩饰的嫌恶之情
ext.ext_en: ...their unconcealed dislike of each other.

defs.def_en: An unconcealed emotion is one that someone has made no attempt to hide.

defs.def_cn: (报刊等上的)分类广告，招聘广告

ext.ext_cn: 我从分类广告上购置物品，布置了我的第一间公寓。
ext.ext_en: I furnished my first apartment with items from the want ads...

ext.ext_cn: 小组中几乎所有人都认为，在这个就业市场，搜寻招聘广告这类老路是走不通的。
ext.ext_en: Nearly everybody in the group agreed that in this job market the usual avenues, like searching the want ads, are useless.

defs.def_en: The want ads in a newspaper or magazine are small advertisements, usually offering things for sale or offering jobs.

ext.ext_cn: 经过和第一任丈夫离婚的伤心经历后
ext.ext_en: ...after suffering the heartache of her divorce from her first husband.

ext.ext_cn: 为人父母的所有快乐和痛苦
ext.ext_en: ...all the joys and heartaches of parenthood.

defs.def_en: Heartache is very great sadness and emotional suffering.

ext.ext_cn: 他在丹麦上空被击落，在集中营呆了3年。
ext.ext_en: He was shot down over Denmark and spent three years in a prison camp.

defs.def_en: A prison camp is a guarded camp where prisoners of war or political prisoners are kept.

defs.def_cn: （囚禁一般犯人并允许其外出服劳役的）拘禁营地
defs.def_en: A prison camp is a prison where the prisoners are not considered dangerous and are allowed to work outside the prison.

ext.ext_cn: 你知道他们要找你的麻烦，但是你是否想过他们会做出如此卑劣的事情？
ext.ext_en: You knew that they were gunning for you, but did you ever imagine that it would be as bad as this?

defs.def_en: If someone is gunning for you, they are trying to find a way to harm you or cause you trouble.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可想象的；难以理解的；异乎寻常的

ext.ext_cn: 战斗的规模几乎无法想象。
ext.ext_en: The scale of the fighting is almost unimaginable...

ext.ext_cn: 这里的孩子经历了难以想象的恐惧。
ext.ext_en: The children here have lived through unimaginable horrors.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unimaginable, you are emphasizing that it is difficult to imagine or understand properly, because it is not part of people's normal experience.

ext.ext_cn: 一次严重跌伤使这位 68 岁的国会议员丧失了行动能力。
ext.ext_en: A serious fall incapacitated the 68-year-old congressman.

defs.def_en: If something incapacitates you, it weakens you in some way, so that you cannot do certain things.

ext.ext_cn: 他被指控为一些毒贩运毒。
ext.ext_en: He was accused of acting as a carrier for drug pushers.

defs.def_en: A pusher is a person who sells illegal drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 拍卖商买卖赃物，违反了行规。
ext.ext_en: The auctioneers are violating a code of practice by dealing in stolen goods.

defs.def_en: A code of practice is a set of written rules which explains how people working in a particular profession should behave.
A SWAT team is a group of policemen who have been specially trained to deal with very dangerous or violent situations. SWAT is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'Special Weapons and Tactics'.
A roost is a place where birds or bats rest or sleep.

ext.ext_cn: 孔雀栖息在附近的灌木丛里。
ext.ext_en: The peacocks roost in nearby shrubs.

defs.def_en: When birds or bats roost somewhere, they rest or sleep there.

defs.def_cn: 自食苦果;得到惩罚;遭到报应

ext.ext_cn: 绥靖政策的恶果已经显现出来了。
ext.ext_en: Appeasement has come home to roost...

ext.ext_cn: 政客们有时能够愚弄一些人，但最终他们都会自食恶果。
ext.ext_en: Politicians can fool some people some of the time, but in the end, the chickens will come home to roost.

defs.def_en: If bad or wrong things that someone has done in the past have come home to roost, or if their chickens have come home to roost, they are now experiencing the unpleasant effects of these actions.

ext.ext_cn: 现今，这个国家由民族主义者掌权并分派工作。
ext.ext_en: Today the country's nationalists rule the roost and hand out the jobs.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone rules the roost in a particular place, you mean that they have control and authority over the people there.

ext.ext_cn: 直径不足人的头发直径1/5的电子管
ext.ext_en: ...a tube less than a fifth of the diameter of a human hair.

ext.ext_cn: 一段直径为 22 毫米的钢管
ext.ext_en: ...a length of 22-mm diameter steel pipe.

defs.def_en: The diameter of a round object is the length of a straight line that can be drawn across it, passing through the middle of it.
A pugilist is a boxer.

defs.def_cn: (企业一定时期的)销售额，收入

ext.ext_cn: 这家酒馆说，它一周的营业额在 1.5 万到 2 万英镑之间。
ext.ext_en: The pub said that their takings were fifteen to twenty thousand pounds a week.

defs.def_en: You can use takings to refer to the amount of money that a business such as a shop or a cinema gets from selling its goods or tickets during a particular period.
An indentation is the space at the beginning of a line of writing when it starts further away from the edge of the paper than all the other lines.

ext.ext_cn: 用刀子绕馅饼边沿刻小锯齿。
ext.ext_en: Using a knife, make slight indentations around the edges of the pastry.

defs.def_en: An indentation is a shallow hole or cut in the surface or edge of something.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得她新剪的短发看上去真是太美了。
ext.ext_en: I think her new short hairstyle looks simply great.

defs.def_en: Your hairstyle is the style in which your hair has been cut or arranged.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 神奇的;奇迹般的;不可思议的

ext.ext_cn: 这匹马奇迹般地恢复了状态，以微弱的劣势位居第三。
ext.ext_en: The horse made a miraculous recovery to finish a close third.

ext.ext_cn: 奇迹般的逃脱
ext.ext_en: ...a miraculous escape...

defs.def_en: If you describe a good event as miraculous, you mean that it is very surprising and unexpected.

ext.ext_cn: 奇迹般的痊愈
ext.ext_en: ...miraculous healing.

ext.ext_cn: 神奇的力量
ext.ext_en: ...miraculous powers.

defs.def_en: If someone describes a wonderful event as miraculous, they believe that the event was caused by God.

ext.ext_cn: 这一设计由淡色的 3 个长方形和 3 个三角形构成。
ext.ext_en: This design is in pastel colours with three rectangles and three triangles…

ext.ext_cn: 它的轮廓大致形成一个等边三角形。
ext.ext_en: Its outline roughly forms an equilateral triangle.

defs.def_en: A triangle is an object, arrangement, or flat shape with three straight sides and three angles.
The triangle is a musical instrument that consists of a piece of metal shaped like a triangle. You play it by hitting it with a short metal bar.

ext.ext_cn: 她扮演一位与乔纳森·普赖斯和克里斯托弗·沃肯有三角恋关系的法国女子。
ext.ext_en: She plays a French woman in a love triangle with Jonathan Pryce and Christopher Walken.

ext.ext_cn: 丈夫、妻子与情妇的典型三角关系
ext.ext_en: …the classic triangle of husband, wife and mistress.

defs.def_en: See also:eternal triangle;If you describe a group of three people as a triangle, you mean that they are all connected with each other in a particular situation, but often have different interests.
If you rent an unfurnished house, flat, or apartment, no furniture is provided by the owner.

ext.ext_cn: 工厂里的空气要经过过滤，以清除其中的杂质。
ext.ext_en: The air in the factory is filtered to remove impurities.

defs.def_en: Impurities are substances that are present in small quantities in another substance and make it dirty or of an unacceptable quality.
Impurity is the state of being no longer pure, especially sexually pure.

ext.ext_cn: 太太，试穿一下吧！
ext.ext_en: Try them on, madam.

defs.def_en: People sometimes say Madam as a very formal and polite way of addressing a woman whose name they do not know or a woman of superior rank. For example, a shop assistant might address a woman customer as Madam .

defs.def_cn: (正式或商业信函的开头称呼语)尊敬的女士

ext.ext_cn: 尊敬的女士，感谢您对我们的纪念方案的关注。
ext.ext_en: Dear Madam, Thank you for your interest in our Memorial Scheme.

defs.def_en: You use the expression 'Dear madam' at the beginning of a formal letter or a business letter when you are writing to a woman.

defs.def_cn: (用于Chairman一类词语前称呼担任这一职位的女性)夫人

ext.ext_cn: 主席夫人，我不得不这么说。
ext.ext_en: I have to say this, Madam  Chairman.

defs.def_en: Madam is sometimes used in front of words such as 'Chairman' to address the woman who holds the position mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 顽皮的小女孩；自以为是的小姑娘；喜欢使唤他人的女孩

ext.ext_cn: 休确实是个少见的早熟的小丫头。
ext.ext_en: Sue is a thoroughly precocious little madam if ever there was one...

ext.ext_cn: 等着我把你接回家来吧，大小姐。
ext.ext_en: Wait till I get you home, young madam.

defs.def_en: You can call a little girl a madam if you are annoyed because she is being naughty and behaving as if she expects other people to do what she wants.

ext.ext_cn: 他迈着大步穿过沙滩缓缓向南希跑去。
ext.ext_en: He was loping across the sand toward Nancy...

ext.ext_cn: 马蒂看着他大步慢慢跑远。
ext.ext_en: Matty saw him go loping off, running low.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal lopes somewhere, they run in an easy and relaxed way, taking long steps.

ext.ext_cn: 墨汁颗粒附着在气泡上，浮到表面上。
ext.ext_en: Ink particles attach themselves to air bubbles and rise to the surface.

ext.ext_cn: 困在液面下的一个气泡
ext.ext_en: ...a bubble of gas trapped under the surface.

defs.def_en: Bubbles are small balls of air or gas in a liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 有了肥皂、水、泡泡和小船，孩子们都喜欢洗澡。
ext.ext_en: With soap and water, bubbles and boats, children love bathtime.

defs.def_en: A bubble is a hollow ball of soapy liquid that is floating in the air or standing on a surface.

ext.ext_cn: 每个人都希望这些高科技公司能成为未来的微软。目前它们看上去更像是投机泡沫的中心。
ext.ext_en: Everyone is hoping that these hi-tech companies will turn out to be the Microsofts of the future. At the moment they look more like the focus of a speculative bubble...

ext.ext_cn: 房地产开发泡沫破灭后，联邦监管机构开始调查审计各家大型银行的资产负债表。
ext.ext_en: When the development bubble burst, federal regulators started probing the balance sheets of the biggest banks.

defs.def_en: A bubble is a situation in which large numbers of people want to buy shares in a company that is new or not yet financially successful, and pay more than the shares are worth. When it becomes clear that the shares are worth less than people paid for them, you can say that the bubble has burst.

defs.def_cn: （漫画中显示人物对白的）气泡框，圆框
defs.def_en: In a cartoon, a speech bubble is the shape which surrounds the words which a character is thinking or saying.

ext.ext_cn: 将调好味的肉汤加热至沸腾。
ext.ext_en: Heat the seasoned stock until it is bubbling...

ext.ext_cn: 咖啡煮开了，满屋子都是香味。
ext.ext_en: The coffeepot bubbled, filling the room with fragrance...

defs.def_en: When a liquid bubbles, bubbles move in it, for example because it is boiling or moving quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 与此同时，报纸上登满了俄罗斯向塞尔维亚出售武器的报道。
ext.ext_en: At the same time, the press bubbles with stories of the sale of Russian arms to Serbia...

ext.ext_cn: 这个节目满眼都是包装漂亮的粉红香槟、华美的服装和迷人的舞蹈。
ext.ext_en: The show bubbles like pink champagne with pretty sets, exquisite costumes and enchanting dance routines.

defs.def_en: If something bubbles, it is very busy or lively.

ext.ext_cn: …持续多年的政治紧张局势
ext.ext_en: ... political tensions that have been bubbling away for years

ext.ext_cn: 有关财务丑闻的谣言接连不断地冒出来。
ext.ext_en: Rumours of financial scandals have come bubbling back to the surface...

defs.def_en: A feeling, influence, or activity that is bubbling away continues to occur.

defs.def_cn: 滔滔不绝地说；洋溢着（某种感情）

ext.ext_cn: 她走到电话旁，兴奋地说个不停。
ext.ext_en: She came to the phone bubbling with excitement...

ext.ext_cn: 她带着满脑子的想法回来了。
ext.ext_en: She came back bubbling with ideas.

defs.def_en: Someone who is bubbling with a good feeling is so full of it that they keep expressing the way they feel to everyone around them.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得他和蔼可亲，富有魅力。
ext.ext_en: I found his amiability charming.

defs.def_en: Amiability is the quality of being friendly and pleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 卓越的；杰出的；超凡的；有支配地位的

ext.ext_cn: 他50年来一直都是这个国家政界的显赫人物
ext.ext_en: ...his fifty years as the pre-eminent political figure in the country...

ext.ext_cn: 10年来，“X”乐队一直都是洛杉矶最杰出的朋克乐队。
ext.ext_en: For a decade 'X' was the pre-eminent punk band in Los Angeles.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is pre-eminent in a group, they are more important, powerful, or capable than other people or things in the group.

ext.ext_cn: 也许有必要采取军事行动。
ext.ext_en: Military action may become necessary...

ext.ext_cn: 总统将派出近2万名军事人员协助救灾工作。
ext.ext_en: The president is sending in almost 20,000 military personnel to help with the relief efforts.

defs.def_en: Military means relating to the armed forces of a country.

ext.ext_cn: 这次攻击给美国的海军和陆军都造成了重创。
ext.ext_en: The attack has caused severe damage to American naval and military forces.

defs.def_en: Military means relating to or belonging to the army, rather than to the navy or the air force.

defs.def_cn: 军队;军人;(尤指)高级军官

ext.ext_cn: 轰炸的范围远远大于军方愿意承认的范围。
ext.ext_en: The bombing has been far more widespread than the military will admit...

ext.ext_cn: 你当过兵吗？
ext.ext_en: Did you serve in the military?

defs.def_en: The military are the armed forces of a country, especially officers of high rank.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 需要对你的工作日进行精确有序的安排。
ext.ext_en: Your working day will need to be organized with military precision.

ext.ext_cn: 他有一种军人的风姿，身板总是挺得笔直。
ext.ext_en: He has a military bearing, never failing to carry himself erect.

defs.def_en: Military means well-organized, controlled, or neat, in a way that is typical of a soldier.

ext.ext_cn: 地球围绕太阳转。
ext.ext_en: The Earth rotates round the sun...

ext.ext_cn: 双手抓住自己的双脚，转动一下，以放松脚踝。
ext.ext_en: Take each foot in both your hands and rotate it to loosen and relax the ankle.

defs.def_en: When something rotates or when you rotate it, it turns with a circular movement.

ext.ext_cn: 俱乐部的成员可以轮流工作，而且一个人就能做好晚上的所有准备工作。
ext.ext_en: The members of the club can rotate and one person can do all the preparation for the evening...

ext.ext_cn: 根据轮流担任领导的新政党章程，他们在一年后会轮换职位。
ext.ext_en: They will swap posts in a year's time, according to new party rules which rotate the leadership.

defs.def_en: If people or things rotate, or if someone rotates them, they take it in turns to do a particular job or serve a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 警察遭到愤怒的人群的袭击。
ext.ext_en: The police came under attack from angry crowds...

ext.ext_cn: 财政部长上星期在议会背负着巨大的辞职压力。
ext.ext_en: In parliament last week the Finance Minister came under heavy pressure to resign...

defs.def_en: If you come under attack or pressure, for example, people attack you or put pressure on you.

ext.ext_cn: 以前他们被人忽视是因为不受国防部管辖。
ext.ext_en: They were neglected before because they did not come under the Ministry of Defence.

defs.def_en: If something comes under a particular authority, it is managed or controlled by that authority.

ext.ext_cn: 还有更多关于英国的新闻，不过被列在了“人情”的标题下。
ext.ext_en: There was more news about Britain, but it came under the heading of human interest.

defs.def_en: If something comes under a particular heading, it is in the category mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 引述句;引出间接引语的主句
defs.def_en: A reporting clause is a clause which indicates that you are talking about what someone said or thought. For example, in 'She said that she was hungry', 'She said' is a reporting clause.
Lithography is a method of printing in which a piece of stone or metal is specially treated so that ink sticks to some parts of it and not to others.

defs.def_cn: 撤销对…的管制规定;解除对…的控制

ext.ext_cn: 撤销对美国航空业管制的需要
ext.ext_en: ...the need to deregulate the US airline industry...

ext.ext_cn: 一旦批发价格放开，零售价格也会随之上涨。
ext.ext_en: Once wholesale prices are deregulated, consumer prices will also rise.

defs.def_en: To deregulate something means to remove controls and regulations from it.
A road map is a map which shows the roads in a particular area in detail.

ext.ext_cn: 这个想法就是为万维网做一个详细全面的说明。
ext.ext_en: The idea was to create a comprehensive road map of the Web.

defs.def_en: A road map of something is a detailed account of it, often intended to help people use or understand it.

defs.def_cn: （和平或民主的）路线图，准则，指导方针

ext.ext_cn: 他对美国达成和平协议的路线图也提出了质疑。
ext.ext_en: He also raised doubts about the American road map to a peace settlement.

defs.def_en: When politicians or journalists speak about a road map to or for peace or democracy, they mean a set of general principles that can be used as a basis for achieving peace or democracy.

An hourglass is a device that was used to measure the passing of an hour. It has two round glass sections linked by a narrow channel, and contains sand which takes an hour to flow from the top section into the lower one.

ext.ext_cn: 莫霍克印第安人和魁北克省警方之间的僵持局面仍没有结束的迹象。
ext.ext_en: There is no sign of an end to the stand-off between Mohawk Indians and the Quebec provincial police...

ext.ext_cn: 国务院警告说这可能会引发新的外交僵局。
ext.ext_en: The State Department was warning that this could lead to another diplomatic stand-off.

defs.def_en: See also:Mexican stand-off;A stand-off is a situation in which neither of two opposing groups or forces will make a move until the other one does something, so nothing can happen until one of them gives way.
A belly dancer is a woman who performs a Middle Eastern dance in which she moves her hips and abdomen about.

ext.ext_cn: 圣玛丽阿斯科特女子寄宿学校校友团聚午餐
ext.ext_en: ...the St Mary's Ascot Old Girls' Reunion Lunch.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a woman who used to be a pupil at a particular school or university as an old girl .

ext.ext_cn: 那边的那个老女人晚上负责照看酒馆里的雅座酒吧。
ext.ext_en: The old girl in there runs the saloon bar at the pub in the evenings.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an old or middle-aged woman as an old girl, you are referring to her in a disrespectful way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 总统称这些血案为令人发指的罪行。
ext.ext_en: The President described the killings as an abominable crime...

ext.ext_cn: 英国也有美食，只是一般的日常饮食太过糟糕。
ext.ext_en: English food can be wonderful but the normal English diet is abominable.

defs.def_en: Something that is abominable is very unpleasant or bad.

ext.ext_cn: 很多儿童都怕狗。
ext.ext_en: Many children acquire a phobic horror of dogs.

defs.def_en: A phobic feeling or reaction results from or is related to a strong, irrational fear or hatred of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在维多利亚时代，人们对坐火车怕得要命。他们对此还不习惯。
ext.ext_en: In Victorian times people were phobic about getting on trains. They weren't used to it.

ext.ext_cn: 患有社交恐惧症的人一想到要见陌生人就发抖。
ext.ext_en: Social phobics quake at the thought of meeting strangers.

defs.def_en: Someone who is phobic has a strong, irrational fear or hatred of something.

defs.def_cn: 使康复;使戒毒(或戒酒);改造(罪犯)

ext.ext_cn: 为帮助遭受这种病痛折磨的病人康复付出了巨大努力。
ext.ext_en: Considerable efforts have been made to rehabilitate patients who have suffered in this way.

defs.def_en: To rehabilitate someone who has been ill or in prison means to help them to live a normal life again. To rehabilitate someone who has a drug or alcohol problem means to help them stop using drugs or alcohol.

defs.def_cn: 使恢复名誉;给…平反昭雪

ext.ext_cn: 10年之后，德雷福斯的冤情得以昭雪。
ext.ext_en: Ten years later, Dreyfus was rehabilitated...

ext.ext_cn: 他的候选资格使该党出现分化;其中大多数人都嘲弄他，而另外一些人则想办法为他恢复名誉。
ext.ext_en: His candidacy has divided the party; while most have scorned him, others have sought to rehabilitate him.

defs.def_en: If someone is rehabilitated, they begin to be considered acceptable again after a period during which they have been rejected or severely criticized.

defs.def_cn: 复原，修葺，整修，修复(建筑物或某区域)

ext.ext_cn: 对低收入者的住房进行整修的项目
ext.ext_en: ...a program for rehabilitating low-income housing.

defs.def_en: To rehabilitate a building or an area means to improve its condition so that it can be used again.

defs.def_cn: （因生病或吸毒所致的）幻觉（体验）

ext.ext_cn: 大剂量地服用该药会致幻。
ext.ext_en: The drug induces hallucinations at high doses...

ext.ext_cn: 脑部受损的病人常会产生幻觉。
ext.ext_en: Hallucination is common in patients who have suffered damage to the brain.

defs.def_en: A hallucination is the experience of seeing something that is not really there because you are ill or have taken a drug.

defs.def_cn: （因生病或吸毒所见到的）幻象

ext.ext_cn: 脚印可能只是幻象。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps the footprint was a hallucination.

defs.def_en: A hallucination is something that is not real that someone sees because they are ill or have taken a drug.
An ice rink is a level area of ice, usually inside a building, that has been made artificially and kept frozen so that people can skate on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 神秘莫测的;难以捉摸的;难以理解的

ext.ext_cn: 在公开场合他一直像一个谜。
ext.ext_en: In public he remained inscrutable.

defs.def_en: If a person or their expression is inscrutable, it is very hard to know what they are really thinking or what they mean.

defs.def_cn: 可输出的;可出口的;可外销的

ext.ext_cn: 他们依赖数量非常有限的外销产品。
ext.ext_en: They are reliant on a very limited number of exportable products.

defs.def_en: Exportable products are suitable for being exported.

defs.def_cn: 山姆大叔（指美国或美国政府）

ext.ext_cn: 他们已做好抗击美国帝国主义政策的准备。
ext.ext_en: They are ready to defend themselves against Uncle Sam's imperialist policies...

ext.ext_cn: 多年以来我们都被教导美国和外资乃是问题所在。
ext.ext_en: For years we were taught that Uncle Sam and foreign investment were the problem.

defs.def_en: Some people refer to the United States of America or its government as Uncle Sam .

defs.def_cn: 不能模仿的;无与伦比的

ext.ext_cn: 无人能比的彼得·亨宁格尔自然是主要的票房吸引力所在。
ext.ext_en: The major box office attraction was, of course, the inimitable Peter Hunningale...

ext.ext_cn: 他以他独一无二的方式表明了自己的观点。
ext.ext_en: He makes his own point in his own inimitable way.

defs.def_en: You use inimitable to describe someone, especially a performer, when you like or admire them because of their special qualities.

ext.ext_cn: 熟练的体力劳动者
ext.ext_en: ...skilled manual workers...

ext.ext_cn: 他们对在工厂做工人或者干体力活都没有意见。
ext.ext_en: They have no reservations about taking factory or manual jobs.

defs.def_en: Manual work is work in which you use your hands or your physical strength rather than your mind.

ext.ext_cn: 用来培养手的灵活性的玩具
ext.ext_en: ...toys designed to help develop manual dexterity.

defs.def_en: Manual is used to talk about movements which are made by someone's hands.

ext.ext_cn: 有一只手摇水泵用来排水。
ext.ext_en: There is a manual pump to get rid of the water.

defs.def_en: Manual means operated by hand, rather than by electricity or a motor.

ext.ext_cn: 使用说明书
ext.ext_en: ...the instruction manual.

defs.def_en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

ext.ext_cn: 一罐西红柿酱
ext.ext_en: ...a can of tomato puree...

ext.ext_cn: 用漏勺轧土豆做成土豆泥。
ext.ext_en: Push the potatoes through a sieve to make a puree.

defs.def_en: Puree is food which has been crushed or beaten so that it forms a thick, smooth liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 用榨汁机将杏打成糊状，直至完全搅匀。
ext.ext_en: Puree the apricots in a liquidiser until completely smooth.

defs.def_en: If you puree food, you make it into a puree.

defs.def_cn: (苏格兰议会或北爱尔兰议会的)首席大臣，执政党领袖
defs.def_en: In the Scottish Assembly and the Northern Ireland Assembly, the First Minister is the leader of the ruling party.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （声明、评论）简短的,短促的,无礼的

ext.ext_cn: 他发表了简短声明，称他正在和同事讨论他的未来，并将于星期一宣布他的决定。
ext.ext_en: He issued a terse statement, saying he is discussing his future with colleagues before announcing his decision on Monday...

ext.ext_cn: 他提问时语气生硬。
ext.ext_en: His tone was terse as he asked the question.

defs.def_en: A terse statement or comment is brief and unfriendly.
An Irishman is a man who is an Irish citizen or is of Irish origin.
See also:cerebral palsy;Palsy is a loss of feeling in part of your body.

defs.def_cn: (数学中的)微分;(经济学中的)差价，差额

ext.ext_cn: 德国和法国承诺保持两国货币之间的差别汇率。
ext.ext_en: Germany and France pledged to maintain the differential between their two currencies.

defs.def_en: In mathematics and economics, a differential is a difference between two values in a scale.

ext.ext_cn: 第二次世界大战期间，英国的劳工工资级差进一步拉大了。
ext.ext_en: During the Second World War, industrial wage differentials in Britain widened.

defs.def_en: A differential is a difference between things, especially rates of pay.

defs.def_cn: 差别的;级差的;依差别而定的

ext.ext_cn: 差别投票
ext.ext_en: ...differential voting rights.

defs.def_en: Differential means relating to or using a difference between groups or things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 傻呵呵的;无忧无虑的;不负责任的

ext.ext_cn: 成天嘻嘻哈哈的厨师
ext.ext_en: ...a slap-happy kind of cook.

ext.ext_cn: 傻呵呵的对危险浑然不觉
ext.ext_en: ...a slap-happy ignorance of the danger.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as slap-happy, you believe they are irresponsible and careless.
A confidence man is a man who persuades people to give him their money or property by lying to them.

ext.ext_cn: 光速
ext.ext_en: ...the velocity of light.

ext.ext_cn: 恒星沿轨道运行的速度
ext.ext_en: ...the velocities at which the stars orbit.

defs.def_en: Velocity is the speed at which something moves in a particular direction.

ext.ext_cn: 许多静脉血管就在皮肤下面。
ext.ext_en: Many veins are found just under the skin.

defs.def_en: See also:varicose vein;Your veins are the thin tubes in your body through which your blood flows towards your heart.

defs.def_cn: （行文的）风格;（说话的）语气，情绪

ext.ext_cn: 这是他行文风格轻松活泼的作品中最出色的作品之一。
ext.ext_en: It is one  of his finest works in a lighter vein...

ext.ext_cn: 这个女孩现在以相似的口吻回答。
ext.ext_en: The girl now replies in similar vein.

defs.def_en: Something that is written or spoken in a particular vein is written or spoken in that style or mood.

defs.def_cn: 几分，若干（指在某人的行为或工作中常表现出的某种品质）

ext.ext_cn: 这位前锋本赛季状态奇佳，进球已达到32个。
ext.ext_en: The striker's  rich vein of form this season has seen him net 32 goals...

ext.ext_cn: 这出西班牙戏剧自始至终都带有几分黑色幽默。
ext.ext_en: This Spanish drama has a vein of black humour running through it.

defs.def_en: A vein of a particular quality is evidence of that quality which someone often shows in their behaviour or work.

ext.ext_cn: 铜矿层
ext.ext_en: ...a vein of copper.

ext.ext_cn: 储量丰富的深层石灰石矿脉
ext.ext_en: ...a rich and deep vein of limestone.

defs.def_en: A vein of a particular metal or mineral is a layer of it lying in rock.

ext.ext_cn: 羽状叶子的锯齿边沿和纹理
ext.ext_en: ...the serrated edges and veins of the feathery leaves.

defs.def_en: The veins on a leaf are the thin lines on it.

ext.ext_cn: 阿德布雷克尼什的马凯爵士如是说。
ext.ext_en: Thus spake the Lord Mackay of Ardbrecknish.

defs.def_en: Spake is the very old-fashioned form of the past tense of speak.

ext.ext_cn: 他的政府由于一起金融丑闻而开始瓦解。
ext.ext_en: His government began to unravel because of a banking scandal...

ext.ext_cn: 她回到美国的时候，婚姻破裂了。
ext.ext_en: When she returned to America, the marriage unravelled.

defs.def_en: If something such as a plan or system unravels, it breaks up or begins to fail.

ext.ext_cn: 他的手很灵巧，其他人甚至都不敢尝试的一些难解的绳结或缠在一起的纱线，他都能解开。
ext.ext_en: He was good with his hands and could unravel a knot or untangle yarn that others wouldn't even attempt...

ext.ext_cn: 铺在楼梯上的地毯磨损得很厉害，都快散了。
ext.ext_en: The stairway carpet is so frayed it threatens to unravel.

defs.def_en: If you unravel something that is knotted, woven, or knitted, or if it unravels, it becomes one straight piece again or separates into its different threads.

ext.ext_cn: 一位年轻的母亲飞抵冰岛，要揭开她丈夫失踪之谜。
ext.ext_en: A young mother has flown to Iceland to unravel the mystery of her husband's disappearance...

ext.ext_cn: 通过巧妙运用倒叙手法，伊夫的故事慢慢呈现出来。
ext.ext_en: Gradually, with an intelligent use of flashbacks, Yves' story unravels.

defs.def_en: If you unravel a mystery or puzzle, or if it unravels, it gradually becomes clearer and you can work out the answer to it.

ext.ext_cn: 哈里走进过道，随手关上了门。
ext.ext_en: Harry stepped into the passage and closed the door behind him.

ext.ext_cn: 上几级楼梯，沿着一条狭窄的走廊来到一个门口
ext.ext_en: ...up some stairs and along a narrow passage towards a door.

defs.def_en: A passage is a long narrow space with walls or fences on both sides, which connects one place or room with another.

ext.ext_cn: 他读了一节弥尔顿的诗。
ext.ext_en: He reads a passage from Milton.

ext.ext_cn: 布莱克谈及幻想世界的那一段
ext.ext_en: ...the passage in which Blake spoke of the world of imagination...

defs.def_en: A passage in a book, speech, or piece of music is a section of it that you are considering separately from the rest.

ext.ext_cn: 气管内壁上的细胞
ext.ext_en: ...cells that line the air passages.

ext.ext_cn: 堵塞了的鼻腔
ext.ext_en: ...blocked nasal passages.

defs.def_en: A passage is a long narrow hole or tube in your body, which air or liquid can pass along.

ext.ext_cn: 他在拥挤的街道上挤出了一条通路。
ext.ext_en: He cleared a passage for himself through the crammed streets...

ext.ext_cn: 两名男子突然用肘在购物者中挤出一条路。
ext.ext_en: Two men suddenly elbowed a passage through the shoppers.

defs.def_en: A passage through a crowd of people or things is an empty space that allows you to move through them.

ext.ext_cn: 德国没有征求佛朗哥的同意便让军队通过了西班牙。
ext.ext_en: Germany had not requested Franco's consent for the passage of troops through Spain...

ext.ext_cn: 热在岩石中传导得极慢。
ext.ext_en: The passage of heat through rock is extremely slow.

defs.def_en: The passage of someone or something is their movement from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 使他们更顺利地过渡到市场经济
ext.ext_en: ...to ease their passage to a market economy.

ext.ext_cn: 从中学到大学的过渡
ext.ext_en: ...the passage from school to college.

defs.def_en: The passage of someone or something is their progress from one situation or one stage in their development to another.

ext.ext_cn: 《人权法案》通过已经200年了。
ext.ext_en: It's been 200 years since the passage of the Bill of Rights.

defs.def_en: The passage of a bill or act is the official acceptance of it by a parliament or legislature.

ext.ext_cn: 价值与日俱增的资产
ext.ext_en: An asset that increases in value with the passage of time.

ext.ext_cn: 18个月过去后
ext.ext_en: ...after the passage of eighteen months.

defs.def_en: The passage of a period of time is its passing.

ext.ext_cn: 从斯旺西出发航行10小时后，我们于前天到达。
ext.ext_en: We'd arrived the day before after a 10-hour passage from Swansea.

defs.def_en: A passage is a journey by ship.

ext.ext_cn: 托马斯先生可以安全地往来于贾夫纳。
ext.ext_en: Mr Thomas would be given safe passage to and from Jaffna...

ext.ext_cn: 无论你什么时候需要，都可以自由穿过我们的领地。
ext.ext_en: You may have free passage across our territory whenever you require it.

defs.def_en: If you are granted passage through a country or area of land, you are given permission to go through it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们打点行囊，回家了。
ext.ext_en: They packed up and went home...

ext.ext_cn: 他开始收拾行李。
ext.ext_en: He began packing up his things.

defs.def_en: If you pack up or if you pack up your things, you put your possessions or the things you have been using in a case or bag, because you are leaving.

defs.def_cn: （机器）出故障，停止工作；（身体部位）衰竭

ext.ext_cn: 最后，他的胃和肺衰竭了。
ext.ext_en: In the end it was his stomach and lungs that packed up...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的车抛锚了。
ext.ext_en: Our car packed up.

defs.def_en: If a machine or a part of the body packs up, it stops working.
A personal stereo is a small cassette or CD player with very light headphones, which people carry round so that they can listen to music while doing something else.

A stethoscope is an instrument that a doctor uses to listen to your heart and breathing. It consists of a small disc that is placed on your body, connected to a hollow tube with two pieces that the doctor puts in his or her ears.
Shellac is a kind of natural varnish which you paint on to wood to give it a shiny surface.
Race riots are violent fights between people of different races living in the same community.
A rag doll is a soft doll made of cloth.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 使人想起…的;引起联想的;暗示的

ext.ext_cn: 手指粗糙，关节突出，指甲又长又弯，让人想起动物的爪子。
ext.ext_en: The fingers were gnarled, lumpy, with long, curving nails suggestive of animal claws...

ext.ext_cn: 这类头痛多是血压升高的征兆。
ext.ext_en: These headaches were most suggestive of raised blood pressure.

defs.def_en: Something that is suggestive of something else is quite like it or may be a sign of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 另一位声称托马斯曾对她言语挑逗的前职员
ext.ext_en: ...another former employee who claims Thomas made suggestive remarks to her.

ext.ext_cn: 含有挑逗性文字或图片的广告
ext.ext_en: ...advertisements containing words or pictures of a sexually suggestive nature.

defs.def_en: Suggestive remarks or looks cause people to think about sex, often in a way that makes them feel uncomfortable.
A guarantor is a person who gives a guarantee or who is bound by one.

ext.ext_cn: 他锲而不舍、百折不挠的劲头儿
ext.ext_en: ...his ability to persevere despite obstacles and setbacks.

ext.ext_cn: 因对捣乱难管的学生不离不弃而闻名的学校
ext.ext_en: ...a school with a reputation for persevering with difficult and disruptive children...

defs.def_en: If you persevere with something, you keep trying to do it and do not give up, even though it is difficult.
In the Christian religion, the Redeemer is Jesus Christ.

ext.ext_cn: 那听起来像是空袭警报。
ext.ext_en: It sounds like an air raid siren.

defs.def_en: A siren is a warning device which makes a long, loud noise. Most fire engines, ambulances, and police cars have sirens.

defs.def_cn: 妖艳而危险的女人;妖妇

ext.ext_cn: 他把她描述成是红颜祸水——就是她毁掉了自己。
ext.ext_en: He depicts her as a siren who has drawn him to his ruin.

ext.ext_cn: 这个声音沙哑、性感迷人的妖女
ext.ext_en: ...the voluptuous siren with a husky voice.

defs.def_en: Some people refer to a woman as a siren when they think that she is attractive to men but dangerous in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 他无法抵挡赌牌的诱惑，便提取了他们的存款前往拉斯韦加斯。
ext.ext_en: Unable to resist the siren call of the cards, he withdrew their savings and headed for Las Vegas...

ext.ext_cn: 他说美国不愿意参与仅仅解决部分问题的方案的探索——按照他的说法，这种做法就是向诱惑低头。
ext.ext_en: He said the United States was not willing to engage in a search for partial solutions — to succumb, as he put it, to a siren song.

defs.def_en: A siren call or siren song is the appeal that something has although it is harmful or dangerous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 多数时候我只是庆幸自己有份工作。
ext.ext_en: Most of the time I'm just thankful that I've got a job...

ext.ext_cn: 我对他的支持非常感激。
ext.ext_en: I was so thankful for his support...

defs.def_en: When you are thankful, you are very happy and relieved that something has happened.

ext.ext_cn: 给我杯水。
ext.ext_en: Get me a glass of water.

ext.ext_cn: 雨水敲打金属屋顶发出的声响
ext.ext_en: ...the sound of water hammering on the metal roof.

defs.def_en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and people need water in order to live.

ext.ext_cn: 这艘船将继续呆在中国领海之外。
ext.ext_en: The ship will remain outside Chinese territorial waters.

ext.ext_cn: 北冰洋的公共海域
ext.ext_en: ...the open waters of the Arctic Ocean.

defs.def_en: You use waters to refer to a large area of sea, especially the area of sea which is near to a country and which is regarded as belonging to it.

ext.ext_cn: 被请来帮助他渡过难关的人
ext.ext_en: ...the man brought in to guide him through troubled waters...

ext.ext_cn: 英国政府可能陷入了动荡的经济困境中。
ext.ext_en: The British Government may be in stormy economic waters.

defs.def_en: You sometimes use waters to refer to a situation which is very complex or difficult.

ext.ext_cn: 他出去给植物浇水。
ext.ext_en: He went out to water the plants.

defs.def_en: If you water plants, you pour water over them in order to help them to grow.

ext.ext_cn: 他的眼睛被香烟熏得直流泪。
ext.ext_en: His eyes watered from cigarette smoke.

defs.def_en: If your eyes water, tears build up in them because they are hurting or because you are upset.

ext.ext_cn: 令人垂涎的饼干
ext.ext_en: ...cookies to make your mouth water.

defs.def_en: See also:mouth-watering;If you say that your mouth is watering, you mean that you can smell or see some nice food and you might mean that your mouth is producing a liquid.

defs.def_cn: （孕妇）羊水破裂;（医生或接生员）给（孕妇）破羊水

ext.ext_cn: 我是凌晨6点破水的，不到4个小时杰米就出生了。
ext.ext_en: My waters broke at six in the morning and within four hours Jamie was born.

defs.def_en: When a pregnant woman's waters break, the fluid in her womb that surrounds the baby passes out of her body, showing that the baby is ready to be born. A doctor or midwife can break a woman's waters so that the birth can begin.

defs.def_cn: 泼出之水;不可改变的既成事实;无法挽回的过去

ext.ext_cn: 他为服刑期满而感到如释重负，而且觉得既已无可更改，过去的就让它过去吧。
ext.ext_en: He was relieved his time in jail was over and regarded it as water under the bridge.

defs.def_en: If you say that an event or incident is water under the bridge, you mean that it has happened and cannot now be changed, so there is no point in worrying about it any more.

ext.ext_cn: 你看起来无疑是陷入了困境。
ext.ext_en: You certainly seem to be in deep water...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得我们在跑题并已陷入尴尬境地。
ext.ext_en: I could tell that we were getting off the subject and into deep water.

defs.def_en: If you are in deep water, you are in a difficult or awkward situation.

defs.def_cn: (论点或理论)符合逻辑，站得住脚，经得起考验

ext.ext_cn: 这个论点在欧洲根本就站不住脚。
ext.ext_en: This argument simply cannot hold water in Europe.

defs.def_en: If an argument or theory does not hold water, it does not seem to be reasonable or be in accordance with the facts.

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司今年由于价格过高已经陷入困境。
ext.ext_en: The company has already been in hot water over high prices this year.

defs.def_en: If you are in hot water, you are in trouble.

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦金融城的经济学家给经济开始复苏的说法泼了冷水。
ext.ext_en: City economists pour cold water on the idea that the economic recovery has begun.

defs.def_en: If you pour cold water on an idea or suggestion, you show that you have a low opinion of it.

ext.ext_cn: 参与其中时一定要小心谨慎，表态之前最好试探一下。
ext.ext_en: You should be cautious when getting involved and test the water before committing yourself.

defs.def_en: If you test the water or test the waters, you try to find out what reaction an action or idea will get before you do it or tell it to people.

ext.ext_cn: 这块围场如此之大，几乎看不见最远端的围墙。
ext.ext_en: This enclosure was so vast that the outermost wall could hardly be seen.

defs.def_en: An enclosure is an area of land that is surrounded by a wall or fence and that is used for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 这个杀人狂会毫不犹豫地把他俩都杀了。
ext.ext_en: This murderous lunatic could kill them both without a second thought.

defs.def_en: Someone who is murderous is likely to murder someone and may already have murdered someone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他那天晚上想置妻子于死地。
ext.ext_en: He made a murderous attack on his wife that evening.

defs.def_en: A murderous attack or other action is very violent and intended to result in someone's death.

ext.ext_cn: 向海湾伸出的海角
ext.ext_en: ...a promontory jutting out into the bay.

defs.def_en: A promontory is a cliff that stretches out into the sea.

defs.def_cn: 职业体育总会;(尤指美国)职业棒球联合会，职业棒球大联盟

ext.ext_cn: 在杰基·罗宾逊成为职业棒球联合会第一名黑人球员的过程中，钱德勒起到了重要作用。
ext.ext_en: Chandler was instrumental in making Jackie Robinson the first black player in the major leagues.

defs.def_en: The major leagues are groups of professional sports teams that compete against each other, especially in American baseball.

ext.ext_cn: 没有一支加入职业棒球联合会的球队的小镇
ext.ext_en: ...a town with no major league baseball.

defs.def_en: Major league means connected with the major leagues in baseball.

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯·霍斯的电影处女作明星云集，阵容强大。
ext.ext_en: James Hawes's first film boasts major-league stars.

defs.def_en: Major league people or institutions are important or successful.

ext.ext_cn: 女孩子一旦打响名气，事无巨细全会由她的经纪公司来安排。
ext.ext_en: Once a girl has made it into the major league every detail is mapped out by her agency.

defs.def_en: If someone moves into the major league or makes it into the major league, they become very successful in their career.
A saloon or a saloon car is a car with seats for four or more people, a fixed roof, and a boot that is separated from the rear seats.
A saloon is a place where alcoholic drinks are sold and drunk.

defs.def_cn: 酒吧雅座;(宾馆的)高级酒廊
defs.def_en: The saloon or saloon bar in a pub or hotel is a comfortable bar where the drinks are more expensive than in the other bars.
Arsenic is a very strong poison which can kill people.
Wordplay involves making jokes by using the meanings of words in an amusing or clever way.

ext.ext_cn: 警方赶到了凶杀现场。
ext.ext_en: The police arrived at the scene of the homicide.

defs.def_en: Homicide is the illegal killing of a person.
Gumboots are long rubber boots which you wear to keep your feet dry.

ext.ext_cn: 工党党员
ext.ext_en: ...a member of the Labour party.

ext.ext_cn: 印度执政党
ext.ext_en: ...India's ruling party.

defs.def_en: A party is a political organization whose members have similar aims and beliefs. Usually the organization tries to get its members elected to the government of a country.

ext.ext_cn: 那对情侣是在一个派对上认识的。
ext.ext_en: The couple met at a party...

ext.ext_cn: 我们举办了盛大的生日聚会。
ext.ext_en: We threw a huge birthday party...

defs.def_en: See also:dinner party;garden party;hen party;stag party;A party is a social event, often in someone's home, at which people enjoy themselves doing things such as eating, drinking, dancing, talking, or playing games.

ext.ext_cn: 他们来吃喝、游泳、狂欢，有时都不睡觉。
ext.ext_en: They come to eat and drink, to swim, to party. Sometimes they never go to bed...

ext.ext_cn: 纵情狂欢了一夜后，他看起来累了。
ext.ext_en: After a long evening of partying he looked tired.

defs.def_en: If you party, you enjoy yourself doing things such as going out to parties, drinking, dancing, and talking to people.

ext.ext_cn: 他们和伙伴们分开了。
ext.ext_en: They became separated from their party.

ext.ext_cn: 一群观光客
ext.ext_en: ...a party of sightseers.

defs.def_en: See also:search party;working party;A party of people is a group of people who are doing something together, for example travelling together.

ext.ext_cn: 必须证明他们是过错方。
ext.ext_en: It has to be proved that they are the guilty party.

ext.ext_cn: 他是受害方。
ext.ext_en: ...he was the injured party.

defs.def_en: See also:third party;One of the people involved in a legal agreement or dispute can be referred to as a particular party.

ext.ext_cn: 克鲁克已经辞职了，不愿参与这种背信弃义的行为。
ext.ext_en: Crook had resigned his post rather than be party to such treachery.

defs.def_en: Someone who is a party to or is party to an action or agreement is involved in it, and therefore partly responsible for it.
A croupier is the person in charge of a gambling table in a casino, who collects the bets and pays money to the people who have won.

defs.def_cn: （英国为防止市议会随意提高地方税率，促其削减开支或提高效率而）限定…的地方税额

ext.ext_cn: 诺丁汉郡议会将削减200个工作岗位，以逃避地方税限额。
ext.ext_en: Notts County Council is to cut 200 jobs in a bid to escape being rate-capped.

defs.def_en: In Britain, when a local council was rate-capped, the government prevented it from increasing local taxes called rates, in order to force the council to reduce its spending or make it more efficient.
A rate cap is a limit placed by the government on the amount of interest that banks or credit card companies can charge their customers.

ext.ext_cn: 油画挂倒了。
ext.ext_en: The painting was hung upside down...

ext.ext_cn: 索尔特捏住包的外角，把它倒过来晃了晃。
ext.ext_en: Salter held the bag by the corners and shook it upside down.

defs.def_en: If something has been moved upside down, it has been turned round so that the part that is usually lowest is above the part that is usually highest.

defs.def_cn: 梦寐以求的；朝思暮想的

ext.ext_cn: 使你们朝思暮想的野餐计划泡汤的下雨天
ext.ext_en: ...the wet weather that prevents your longed-for picnic.

defs.def_en: A longed-for thing or event is one that someone wants very much.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些花也许只开一天，但植物本身却很长寿。
ext.ext_en: The flowers may only last a day but the plants are long-lived.

ext.ext_cn: 一大堆耐久的放射性物质
ext.ext_en: ...huge piles of long-lived radioactive material.

defs.def_en: Something that is long-lived lives or lasts for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 一片齐膝高的向日葵
ext.ext_en: ...a field of knee-high sunflowers.

defs.def_en: Something that is knee-high is as tall or high as an adult's knees.

defs.def_cn: 奸商；投机商；牟取暴利的人

ext.ext_cn: 主要由战争投机商和强盗组成的新的社会阶层
ext.ext_en: ...a new social class composed largely of war profiteers and gangsters.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a profiteer, you are critical of them because they make large profits by charging high prices for goods that are hard to get.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一名年轻的女示威者独自一人坐在人行路上。
ext.ext_en: One of the demonstrators, a young woman, sat forlorn on the pavement...

ext.ext_cn: 26 分钟之后他一瘸一拐地走出来，显得孤单凄凉。
ext.ext_en: He looked a forlorn figure as he limped off after 26 minutes.

defs.def_en: If someone is forlorn, they feel alone and unhappy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无人居住的;荒凉的;废弃的

ext.ext_cn: 他们沿着一条坑坑洼洼布满车辙印的荒凉小路向内地进发。
ext.ext_en: They headed inland on a forlorn road that was rutted and pocked...

ext.ext_cn: 昔日金碧辉煌的宫殿显得空寂而又荒凉。
ext.ext_en: The once glorious palaces stood empty and forlorn.

defs.def_en: If a place is forlorn, it is deserted and not cared for, or has little in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (希望、尝试等)没有成功机会的，无谓的

ext.ext_cn: 农民离开土地，希望能在城市找到更好的生活，却不知道这根本难以实现。
ext.ext_en: Peasants have left the land in the forlorn hope of finding a better life in cities.

ext.ext_cn: 试图不让自己丧失理智的无谓努力
ext.ext_en: ...a forlorn effort to keep from losing my mind.

defs.def_en: A forlorn hope or attempt is one that you think has no chance of success.

defs.def_cn: 强盗;抢劫者;攫食的动物

ext.ext_cn: 她吓得呆若木鸡，眼睁睁地看着劫匪们离去。
ext.ext_en: Numb with terror, she stared at the departing marauders...

ext.ext_cn: 他们遭到了流窜作案的抢劫团伙的袭击。
ext.ext_en: They were raided by roaming bands of marauders.

defs.def_en: If you describe a group of people or animals as marauders, you mean they are unpleasant and dangerous, because they wander around looking for opportunities to steal or kill.

ext.ext_cn: 祝你好运，我们会支持你的。
ext.ext_en: Good luck, we'll be rooting for you...

ext.ext_cn: 这是那种让人不得不为坏人叫好的电影。
ext.ext_en: It's one of those movies in which you're forced to root for the villain.

defs.def_en: If you are rooting for someone, you are giving them your support while they are doing something difficult or trying to defeat another person.

ext.ext_cn: 卢克津津有味地吃着鸡肉三明治。
ext.ext_en: Luke munched the chicken sandwiches...

ext.ext_cn: 桌子对面，他儿子本吉有滋有味地吃着。
ext.ext_en: Across the table, his son Benjie munched appreciatively...

defs.def_en: If you munch food, you eat it by chewing it slowly, thoroughly, and rather noisily.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数哮喘或肺炎患者无需住院。
ext.ext_en: Most people do not have to be hospitalized for asthma or pneumonia.

defs.def_en: If someone is hospitalized, they are sent or admitted to hospital.

defs.def_cn: (用来制作强力肥皂的)烧碱，苛性钠
defs.def_en: Caustic soda is a powerful chemical substance used to make strong soaps and clean drains.

ext.ext_cn: 一定要慢慢吃，要细细咀嚼。
ext.ext_en: Be certain to eat slowly and chew your food extremely well...

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼尔倚在沙发上，嘴里还在嚼着苹果。
ext.ext_en: Daniel leaned back on the sofa, still chewing on his apple.

defs.def_en: When you chew food, you use your teeth to break it up in your mouth so that it becomes easier to swallow.

ext.ext_cn: 一个女孩在嚼口香糖。
ext.ext_en: One girl was chewing gum...

ext.ext_cn: 他不停地嚼烟草。
ext.ext_en: He chews tobacco constantly.

defs.def_en: If you chew gum or tobacco, you keep biting it and moving it around your mouth to taste the flavour of it. You do not swallow it.

ext.ext_cn: 他紧张地咬着下嘴唇。
ext.ext_en: He chewed his lower lip nervously.

defs.def_en: If you chew your lips or your fingernails, you keep biting them because you are nervous.

ext.ext_cn: 他们停了下来，咬着铅笔。
ext.ext_en: They pause and chew their pencils...

ext.ext_cn: 有个人把宠物放在楼梯下面，结果它在那儿把电线咬断了。
ext.ext_en: One owner left his pet under the stairs where the animal chewed through electric cables.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal chews an object, they bite it with their teeth.

ext.ext_cn: 各式各样可供选择的便宜口嚼糖
ext.ext_en: ...a selection of penny chews.

defs.def_en: A chew is a sweet that you have to chew very hard before it becomes soft.

defs.def_cn: 试图承担力不能及的事

ext.ext_cn: 米基本来是善于处理棘手交易的，可是这回他可能会力有不逮。
ext.ext_en: Micky is used to handling dodgy deals but this time fears he may have bitten off more than he can chew.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has bitten off more than they can chew, you mean that they are trying to do something which is too difficult for them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们东游西逛，瞎扯了两三个钟头。
ext.ext_en: We'd been lounging around, chewing the fat for a couple of hours.

defs.def_en: If people chew the fat, they talk in a relaxed, informal way.

ext.ext_cn: 我们把包扔在附近的格兰德酒店后就匆匆赶往集市。
ext.ext_en: We dumped our bags at the nearby Grand Hotel and hurried towards the market...

ext.ext_cn: 他把我的背包从出租车上取来丢到我脚下。
ext.ext_en: He got my haversack from the cab and dumped it at my feet.

defs.def_en: If you dump something somewhere, you put it or unload it there quickly and carelessly.

ext.ext_cn: 逃亡用的车被丢弃在高速公路隧道附近。
ext.ext_en: The getaway car was dumped near a motorway tunnel...

ext.ext_cn: 一百万吨未经处理的污水被倾倒进了海里。
ext.ext_en: A million tonnes of untreated sewage is dumped into the sea...

defs.def_en: If something is dumped somewhere, it is put or left there because it is no longer wanted or needed.

ext.ext_cn: 将其废弃物直接运送至垃圾场的公司
ext.ext_en: ...companies that bring their rubbish straight to the dump...

ext.ext_cn: 带围墙的花园被用作了垃圾场。
ext.ext_en: The walled garden was used as a dump.

defs.def_en: A dump is a place where rubbish is left, for example on open ground outside a town.

defs.def_cn: 肮脏的地方;乱七八糟的地方

ext.ext_cn: “真够脏乱的！”克丽丝特布尔站在青年旅社的门口说道。

defs.def_cn: 极有魅力的;给人以深刻印象的;绝妙的

ext.ext_cn: 她已经 55 岁了，但依然美艳动人。
ext.ext_en: She was 55 and still a stunning woman...

ext.ext_cn: 美轮美奂的焰火表演照亮了夜空。
ext.ext_en: A stunning display of fireworks lit up the sky.

defs.def_en: A stunning person or thing is extremely beautiful or impressive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人惊奇万分的;令人震惊的;极不寻常的

ext.ext_cn: 在周日的选举中意外惨败后，部长于昨晚辞职。
ext.ext_en: The minister resigned last night after a stunning defeat in Sunday's vote...

ext.ext_cn: 神父吐露给他的秘密真是条惊天大新闻。
ext.ext_en: The secret that the priest had confided to him was a stunning piece of news.

defs.def_en: A stunning event is extremely unusual or unexpected.

ext.ext_cn: 因为他仍未获准经营公司，他妻子成了名义上的老板。
ext.ext_en: As he was still not allowed to run a company, his wife became its nominal head...

ext.ext_cn: 我成长为名不副实的基督徒。
ext.ext_en: I was brought up a nominal Christian.

defs.def_en: You use nominal to indicate that someone or something is supposed to have a particular identity or status, but in reality does not have it.

defs.def_cn: (价格或款项)微不足道的，象征性的

ext.ext_cn: 我做好了以极低价格卖掉自己股份的准备。
ext.ext_en: I am prepared to sell my shares at a nominal price...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的渡船都免费或以极低的收费运载自行车。
ext.ext_en: All the ferries carry bicycles free or for a nominal charge.

defs.def_en: A nominal price or sum of money is very small in comparison with the real cost or value of the thing that is being bought or sold.

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀会更低，因此名义利率换算成实际利率会更具吸引力。
ext.ext_en: Inflation would be lower and so nominal rates would be rather more attractive in real terms...

ext.ext_cn: 1990年个人收入名义上增长了6.8％。
ext.ext_en: In 1990 personal incomes grew a nominal 6.8 per cent.

defs.def_en: In economics, the nominal value, rate, or level of something is the one expressed in terms of current prices or figures, without taking into account general changes in prices that take place over time.
A jellyfish is a sea creature that has a clear soft body and can sting you.

ext.ext_cn: 我永远不会原谅他。我鄙视他。
ext.ext_en: I can never, ever forgive him. I despise him...

ext.ext_cn: 她暗地里瞧不起他的工作。
ext.ext_en: She secretly despises his work...

defs.def_en: If you despise something or someone, you dislike them and have a very low opinion of them.

ext.ext_cn: 1987年，加西亚立法将秘鲁银行业和金融系统收归国有。
ext.ext_en: In 1987, Garcia introduced legislation to nationalize Peru's banking and financial systems...

ext.ext_cn: 国家取得独立时，咖啡行业被收归国有。
ext.ext_en: The coffee industry was nationalised at the time of independence.

defs.def_en: If a government nationalizes a private company or industry, that company or industry becomes owned by the state and controlled by the government.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 客人每位付了250英镑，可不是一笔小数目。
ext.ext_en: The guests had each paid £250, no trifling sum…

ext.ext_cn: 在别处，加利福尼亚的这些困难可能看起来相当微不足道。
ext.ext_en: Outside California these difficulties may seem fairly trifling.

defs.def_en: A trifling matter is small and unimportant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 将蜂蜜加热直到它变稀。
ext.ext_en: Warm the honey until it becomes runny.

ext.ext_cn: 松软的奶酪
ext.ext_en: ...a runny soft cheese.

defs.def_en: Something that is runny is more liquid than usual or than was intended.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 症状包括流泪、流鼻涕、头痛和咳嗽。
ext.ext_en: Symptoms are streaming eyes, a runny nose, headache and a cough.

defs.def_en: If someone has a runny nose or runny eyes, liquid is flowing from their nose or eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 活动人士派发了有关被动吸烟的宣传页。
ext.ext_en: Campaigners handed out leaflets on passive smoking.

ext.ext_cn: 名为《工作中的性骚扰》的小册子
ext.ext_en: ...a leaflet called 'Sexual Harassment at Work'.

defs.def_en: A leaflet is a little book or a piece of paper containing information about a particular subject.

defs.def_cn: 在（某处）散发传单（或小册子）

ext.ext_cn: 我们今天在大学散发了传单，希望能争取到支持。
ext.ext_en: We've leafleted the university today to try to drum up some support...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在犹太新年派传单，纯粹是因为那天去犹太教堂的人比平日多。
ext.ext_en: The only reason we leafleted on the Jewish New Year was because more people than usual go to the synagogue on that day.

defs.def_en: If you leaflet a place, you distribute leaflets there, for example by handing them to people, or by putting them through letter boxes.
A cruise missile is a missile which carries a nuclear warhead and which is guided by a computer.

ext.ext_cn: 她送儿子上了东部的一所寄宿学校。
ext.ext_en: She sent her son to a boarding school in the East...

ext.ext_cn: 当然，她现在住在寄宿学校那边。
ext.ext_en: Of course, now she is away at boarding school.

defs.def_en: A boarding school is a school which some or all of the pupils live in during the school term.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 亲爱的，你对我来说很重要。
ext.ext_en: You're very special to me, darling...

ext.ext_cn: 支持复活节和圣诞节放假是有充分论据的，因为这些节日都是特殊的时刻。
ext.ext_en: There are strong arguments for holidays at Easter and Christmas because these are special occasions...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is special is better or more important than other people or things.

ext.ext_cn: 在特殊情况下，丈夫可以扣除陪同出差的妻子的旅费。
ext.ext_en: In special cases, a husband can deduct the travel expenses of his wife who accompanies him on a business trip...

ext.ext_cn: 这么说你并没有发现他有什么异常之处了？
ext.ext_en: So you didn't notice anything special about him?...

defs.def_en: Special means different from normal.

ext.ext_cn: 由于妻子生病，他回到了国务院，出任总统的特别顾问。
ext.ext_en: Due to his wife's  illness, he returned to the State Department as special adviser to the President...

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰克·德福特是《新闻周刊》杂志的特派记者。
ext.ext_en: Frank Deford is a special correspondent for Newsweek magazine.

defs.def_en: You use special to describe someone who is officially appointed or who has a particular position specially created for them.

defs.def_cn: (为残疾人或有心理障碍者)特设的，专门的

ext.ext_cn: 警方仍然在搜寻昨天从布罗德莫尔专科医院逃跑的一名强奸犯。
ext.ext_en: Police are still searching for a convicted rapist, who escaped from Broadmoor special hospital yesterday.

defs.def_en: Special institutions are for people who have serious physical or mental problems.

ext.ext_cn: 每一个焦虑的人都会有自己的问题或者担心。
ext.ext_en: Every anxious person will have his or her own special problems or fears.

ext.ext_cn: 与独裁者作斗争需要非同寻常的勇气。
ext.ext_en: ...it requires a very special brand of courage to fight dictators.

defs.def_en: You use special to describe something that relates to one particular person, group, or place.

ext.ext_cn: 对英国广播公司的万圣节特别节目《幽灵观察》的投诉
ext.ext_en: ...complaints about the BBC's Hallowe'en special, 'Ghostwatch'...

ext.ext_cn: 杂货店为了招揽顾客不得不推出多种特色产品。
ext.ext_en: Grocery stores have to offer enough specials to bring people into the store.

defs.def_en: A special is a product, programme, or meal which is not normally available, or which is made for a particular purpose.

defs.def_cn: (尤指衣服)两件套的，两部分的

ext.ext_cn: 她穿了身朴素的浅灰色两件式套装。
ext.ext_en: She was wearing a simple light-grey two-piece suit.

ext.ext_cn: 两件套的泳装
ext.ext_en: ...a two-piece bathing suit.

defs.def_en: You can use two-piece to describe something, especially a set of clothing, that is in two parts.

defs.def_cn: (上衣配裙子或裤子的)两件套女式套装

ext.ext_cn: 身穿格子两件式套装的女子
ext.ext_en: …a woman in a check two-piece.

defs.def_en: A two-piece is a woman's suit which consists of a jacket and a skirt or pair of trousers.
Haemorrhoids are painful swellings that can appear in the veins inside the anus.

defs.def_cn: 三K党（美国的白人新教徒秘密组织，利用暴力迫害黑人、犹太人以及其他少数民族）
defs.def_en: The Ku Klux Klan is a secret organization of white Protestant men in the United States which promotes violence against black people, Jews, and other minorities.

ext.ext_cn: 测量一下窗户的全宽。
ext.ext_en: Measure the full width of the window...

ext.ext_cn: 这条路增加了停车区后宽度缩减到了18英尺。
ext.ext_en: The road was reduced to 18ft in width by adding parking bays...

defs.def_en: The width of something is the distance it measures from one side or edge to the other.

ext.ext_cn: 锅是蒸鱼的最好器具，因为它很宽，可以轻松放下一整条鱼。
ext.ext_en: The best utensil for steaming is a wok because its width easily accommodates a whole fish.

defs.def_en: The width of something is its quality of being wide.

ext.ext_cn: 我们游了好几个来回。
ext.ext_en: We swam several widths.

defs.def_en: A width is the distance from one side of a swimming pool to the other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 聪明的;聪颖的;智商高的

ext.ext_cn: 他非常聪明。
ext.ext_en: He's a very clever man...

ext.ext_cn: 我妹妹向来比我聪明许多。
ext.ext_en: My sister was always a lot cleverer than I was...

defs.def_en: Someone who is clever is intelligent and able to understand things easily or plan things well.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 构思巧妙、扣人心弦的小说
ext.ext_en: ...a clever and gripping novel.

ext.ext_cn: 我在米兰的一个同事设计了下面这个非常巧妙的小实验。
ext.ext_en: A colleague of mine in Milan devised the following very clever little experiment.

defs.def_en: A clever idea, book, or invention is extremely effective and shows the skill of the people involved.

defs.def_cn: 聪明过头的;过分聪明的

ext.ext_cn: 崇拜他的人很多说他聪明;恨他的人则说他聪明过了头。
ext.ext_en: His many admirers describe him as clever: his enemies as too clever by half.

defs.def_en: If someone is too clever by half, they are very clever and they show their cleverness in a way that annoys other people.

defs.pos_cn: 单数集合名词；专有集合名词
defs.def_cn: （主张严守道德和宗教标准的）道德多数派；（美国的）“道德多数”运动团体

ext.ext_cn: 除非作家开始写正派的喜剧，并不再迎合那些道德多数派
ext.ext_en: ...unless the writers begin to write decent comedy and stop pandering to the moral majority.

defs.def_en: If there is a large group in society that holds strong, conservative opinions on matters of morality and religion, you can refer to these people as the moral majority. In the United States, there is an organized group called the Moral Majority .

ext.ext_cn: 备好船后，他们就驶向了南边的卡洛福泰。
ext.ext_en: After prepping the boat, they sailed it down to Carloforte.

defs.def_en: If you prep something, you prepare it.

ext.ext_cn: 我已经做好了接受外科手术的准备，于是就直接进入了手术室。
ext.ext_en: I was already prepped for surgery so I went straight into theatre.

defs.def_en: If a doctor or nurse preps a patient, they get them ready for surgery or another procedure.

defs.def_cn: （英国一些私立学校的）家庭作业

ext.ext_cn: 安妮努力帮助彼得和扎拉完成他们的家庭作业。
ext.ext_en: Anne struggled to help Peter and Zara with their prep.

defs.def_en: In some British private schools, prep is the name given to school work that children do in the evening after school has finished.
Someone who is stone deaf cannot hear at all.

ext.ext_cn: 从洪都拉斯归航的专机
ext.ext_en: ...a special inbound flight from Honduras.

defs.def_en: An inbound flight is one that is arriving from another place.

defs.def_cn: (国家、组织)自治的，自己管理自己的

ext.ext_cn: 自治省
ext.ext_en: ...a self-governing province...

ext.ext_cn: 当地的医院是首批申请独立经营管理的单位之一。
ext.ext_en: The local hospital was one of the first to apply to become self-governing.

defs.def_en: A self-governing region or organization is governed or run by its own people rather than by the people of another region or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 一系列镀了一层22开无镍黄金的首饰
ext.ext_en: ...a range of jewellery, plated with 22-carat nickel-free gold.

defs.def_en: If something made of metal is plated with a thin layer of another type of metal, it is covered with it.

ext.ext_cn: 他看来对某些选手怀恨在心。
ext.ext_en: He appears to have a grudge against certain players...

ext.ext_cn: 这无疑是个意外，我没有怨言。
ext.ext_en: There is no doubt it was an accident and I bear no grudges.

defs.def_en: If you have or bear a grudge against someone, you have unfriendly feelings towards them because of something they did in the past.

defs.def_cn: （同居者分居时一方付给另一方的）生活费
defs.def_en: Palimony is money that a person pays to a partner they have lived with for a long time and are now separated from.

ext.ext_cn: 奥尔特曼揭去了电影产业的伪装和神秘光环，暴露了其与其他产业并无二致的商业本质。
ext.ext_en: Altman strips away the pretence and mythology to expose the film industry as a business like any other.

defs.def_en: To strip away something, especially something that hides the true nature of a thing, means to remove it completely.

ext.ext_cn: 敏感肌肤专用面霜不会破坏皮肤表面的保护层。
ext.ext_en: Sensitive Cream will not strip away the skin's protective layer...

ext.ext_cn: 她已经设法将内利身上沾满血污的破烂衣衫脱掉了。
ext.ext_en: She'd managed to strip the bloodied rags away from Nellie's body.

defs.def_en: To strip away a layer of something means to remove it completely.

ext.ext_cn: 在国际社会强力打击下活动依然猖獗的贩毒分子
ext.ext_en: ...drug traffickers, who continue to flourish despite international attempts to suppress them...

ext.ext_cn: 在进行7周后遭到军队镇压的全国性民主示威活动
ext.ext_en: ...nationwide demonstrations for democracy, suppressed after 7 weeks by the army.

defs.def_en: If someone in authority suppresses an activity, they prevent it from continuing, by using force or making it illegal.

defs.def_cn: 制止，阻止，抑制(身体的功能或反应)

ext.ext_cn: 可以通过放疗杀死癌细胞来抑制其再生和扩散。
ext.ext_en: The reproduction and growth of the cancerous cells can be suppressed by bombarding them with radiation.

ext.ext_cn: 迄今为止可证明紫外线能抑制人体免疫反应的最有力证据
ext.ext_en: ...the strongest evidence so far that ultraviolet light can suppress human immune responses.

defs.def_en: If a natural function or reaction of your body is suppressed, it is stopped, for example by drugs or illness.

defs.def_cn: 抑制，控制，克制(感情或反应);忍住

ext.ext_cn: 莉兹想起了巴里，忍住没笑。
ext.ext_en: Liz thought of Barry and suppressed a smile...

ext.ext_cn: 教授说深度睡眠可以使压抑的焦虑情绪得以释放。
ext.ext_en: The Professor said that deep sleep allowed suppressed anxieties to surface.

defs.def_en: If you suppress your feelings or reactions, you do not express them, even though you might want to.

ext.ext_cn: 他们从没有试图劝我隐瞒这个消息。
ext.ext_en: At no time did they try to persuade me to suppress the information...

ext.ext_cn: 冤案错案的出现，要么是因为确实弄错了，要么是因为证据被隐瞒。
ext.ext_en: The wrong criminal is in the dock either because a genuine mistake has been made or because evidence has been suppressed.

defs.def_en: If someone suppresses a piece of information, they prevent other people from learning it.

defs.def_cn: 压制，抑制，阻止(进程或活动)

ext.ext_cn: 他说，“政府正在通过破坏经济来抑制通货膨胀。”
ext.ext_en: 'The Government is suppressing inflation by devastating the economy,' he said...

ext.ext_cn: 律师们称今天的裁决将会抬升价格，并抑制新产品的创新。
ext.ext_en: Lawyers said today's ruling would lead to higher prices and would suppress innovation of new products.

defs.def_en: If someone or something suppresses a process or activity, they stop it continuing or developing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 妻子受到的待遇让他感到异常愤怒。
ext.ext_en: He is furious at the way his wife has been treated...

ext.ext_cn: 花了这么长的时间才弄清楚究竟发生了什么事，这让我怒向胆边生。
ext.ext_en: I am furious that it has taken so long to uncover what really happened.

defs.def_en: Someone who is furious is extremely angry.

ext.ext_cn: 一场激烈的枪战随之爆发。
ext.ext_en: A furious gunbattle ensued.

defs.def_en: Furious is also used to describe something that is done with great energy, effort, speed, or violence.

defs.def_cn: 连续的炮火；弹幕；火力网

ext.ext_cn: 针对市中心的炮火是停战以来最猛烈的。
ext.ext_en: The artillery barrage on the city centre was the heaviest since the ceasefire...

ext.ext_cn: 两架战斗机被防空火力网逼退。
ext.ext_en: The two fighters were driven off by a barrage of anti-aircraft fire.

defs.def_en: A barrage is continuous firing on an area with large guns and tanks.

defs.def_cn: 接二连三，一连串（的批评、抱怨等）

ext.ext_cn: 他受到了与会者一连串愤怒的质询。
ext.ext_en: He was faced with a barrage of angry questions from the floor.

defs.def_en: A barrage of something such as criticism or complaints is a large number of them directed at someone, often in an aggressive way.

defs.def_cn: （大批人或事物）包围；使穷于应付

ext.ext_cn: 医生们抱怨他们疲于应付医药公司的销售人员。
ext.ext_en: Doctors are complaining about being barraged by drug-company salesmen...

ext.ext_cn: 休斯的电话快被他的朋友打爆了，就因为他一不小心说漏了嘴而惹恼了他们。
ext.ext_en: Hughes was barraged with phone calls from friends who were furious at the indiscreet disclosures.

defs.def_en: If you are barraged by people or things, you have to deal with a great number of people or things you would rather avoid.

ext.ext_cn: 潮汐水电站
ext.ext_en: ...a hydro-electric tidal barrage.

defs.def_en: A barrage is a structure that is built across a river to control the level of the water.

ext.ext_cn: 学校开除了数量空前的难以管教的小学生。
ext.ext_en: Schools are booting out record numbers of unruly pupils.

defs.def_en: If someone boots you out of a job, organization, or place, you are forced to leave it.
A juror is a member of a jury.

ext.ext_cn: 圣诞节？呸！都是骗人的！
ext.ext_en: Christmas? Bah! Humbug!

defs.def_en: 'Bah' is used in writing to represent a noise that people make in order to express contempt, disappointment, or annoyance.

ext.ext_cn: 她保留了许多副本以便作进一步的注解。
ext.ext_en: She retained a number of copies for further annotation.

defs.def_en: Annotation is the activity of annotating something.

ext.ext_cn: 他给近1.5万部音乐作品作过注解。
ext.ext_en: He supplied annotations to nearly 15,000 musical works.

defs.def_en: An annotation is a note that is added to a text or diagram, often in order to explain it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们社会标准的性行为仍旧是异性间的。
ext.ext_en: Normative sexual behaviour in our society remains heterosexual.

ext.ext_cn: 教学的标准模式
ext.ext_en: ...a normative model of teaching.

defs.def_en: Normative means creating or stating particular rules of behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 我悄悄地设法解开了包裹的一角。
ext.ext_en: I managed secretly to undo a corner of the parcel...

ext.ext_cn: 我解开了自己黄灰相间的衬衫上最下面的两个纽扣。
ext.ext_en: I undid the bottom two buttons of my yellow and grey shirt...

defs.def_en: If you undo something that is closed, tied, or held together, or if you undo the thing holding it, you loosen or remove the thing holding it.

ext.ext_cn: 警方采取高压手段可能会毁掉之前留下的好印象。
ext.ext_en: A heavy-handed approach from the police could undo that good impression...

ext.ext_cn: 她知道想要消除已经造成的损害是很难的。
ext.ext_en: She knew it would be difficult to undo the damage that had been done...

defs.def_en: To undo something that has been done means to reverse its effect.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·巴恩斯的一粒进球使他们落败。
ext.ext_en: They were undone by a goal from John Barnes...

ext.ext_cn: 《麦克白》讲述的是一个苏格兰士兵当上了国王，却毁于自己的野心。
ext.ext_en: Macbeth is the story of a Scottish soldier who becomes king but is undone by his own ambition.

defs.def_en: If a person, organization, or plan is undone by something, that thing causes their failure.

ext.ext_en: ...a largely uncharted area of medical science.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation, experience, or activity as uncharted territory or waters, you mean that it is new or unfamiliar.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The gang finally fled with a large amount of cash and jewellery...

ext.ext_en: There are a large number of centres where you can take full-time courses...

defs.def_en: A large amount or number of people or things is more than the average amount or number.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 芝加哥一家大公司
ext.ext_en: ...a large company in Chicago...

ext.ext_cn: 许多大企业为旗下员工开办课程。
ext.ext_en: Many large organizations run courses for their employees.

defs.def_en: A large organization or business does a lot of work or commercial activity and employs a lot of people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 已经很严重的未成年人饮酒问题
ext.ext_en: ...the already large problem of under-age drinking...

ext.ext_cn: 报纸能否办下去是一个重大问题。
ext.ext_en: There's a very large question about the viability of the newspaper.

defs.def_en: Large is used to indicate that a problem or issue which is being discussed is very important or serious.

ext.ext_en: I think the chances of getting reforms accepted by the community at large remain extremely remote...

ext.ext_en: Amongst the population at large the support for the present regime is virtually zero.

defs.def_en: You use at large to indicate that you are talking in a general way about most of the people mentioned.

ext.ext_en: The man who tried to have her killed is still at large.

defs.def_en: If you say that a dangerous person, thing, or animal is at large, you mean that they have not been captured or made safe.

defs.def_cn: 大致上；总体上；总的说来

ext.ext_cn: 总体上，报界对政府的新政策文件将信将疑。
ext.ext_en: By and large, the papers greet the government's  new policy document with a certain amount of scepticism.

defs.def_en: You use by and large to indicate that a statement is mostly but not completely true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有礼貌的；客气的；文雅的

ext.ext_cn: 他周围的每一个人都极力表现出彬彬有礼的样子，但能够看出他们都感到厌烦。
ext.ext_en: Everyone around him was trying to be polite, but you could tell they were all bored...

ext.ext_en: It's not polite to point or talk about strangers in public...

defs.def_en: Someone who is polite has good manners and behaves in a way that is socially correct and not rude to other people.

ext.ext_cn: 有些字眼较粗俗，不为上流社会所接受。
ext.ext_en: Certain words are vulgar and not acceptable in polite society.

defs.def_en: You can refer to people who consider themselves to be socially superior and to set standards of behaviour for everyone else as polite society or polite company .

defs.def_cn: (电台或电视台)体育节目主持人,体育比赛解说员

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人非常惊愕难过的;给人以极大打击的

ext.ext_cn: 女儿的死让他们肝肠寸断。
ext.ext_en: The experience of their daughter's death had been absolutely shattering...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天的决议又是一个惨痛的打击。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday's decision was another shattering blow.

defs.def_en: Something that is shattering shocks and upsets you very much.

ext.ext_cn: 这确实是我能想象到的最糟糕的事情。
ext.ext_en: This is positively the worst thing that I can even imagine...

ext.ext_cn: 这绝对是该产业建立这样一个体系的最后机会了。
ext.ext_en: This is positively the last chance for the industry to establish such a system.

defs.def_en: You use positively to emphasize that you really mean what you are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 他回来后变了个样，看起来确实很高兴。
ext.ext_en: He's changed since he came back — he seems positively cheerful...

ext.ext_cn: 我们非常鼓励父母无论何时，只要可能就去求学。
ext.ext_en: Parents are positively encouraged to be at school whenever possible.

defs.def_en: You use positively to emphasize that something really is the case, although it may sound surprising or extreme.

ext.ext_cn: 我男朋友过去常常叫我“邋遢的懒小胖”。
ext.ext_en: My boyfriend used to call me a fat slob.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a slob, you mean that they are very lazy and untidy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这间房有一扇巨大的凸窗。
ext.ext_en: The room had a great bay window.

ext.ext_cn: 长度和高度与教堂相当的大厅
ext.ext_en: ...a great hall as long and high as a church.

defs.def_en: You use great to describe something that is very large. Great is more formal than big .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （数量或程度）大的，巨大的，超乎寻常的

ext.ext_cn: 我会加倍爱惜它的。
ext.ext_en: I'll take great care of it...

ext.ext_cn: 本杰明·布里顿并未活到很大的年纪。
ext.ext_en: Benjamin Britten did not live to a great age.

defs.def_en: Great means large in amount or degree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 重大的；闻名的；令人激动的

ext.ext_cn: 昔日辉煌的文化成就
ext.ext_en: ...the great cultural achievements of the past...

ext.ext_cn: 美国会再度崛起。
ext.ext_en: America can be great again.

defs.def_en: You use great to describe something that is important, famous, or exciting.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 伟大的；著名的； 卓越的；优秀的

ext.ext_cn: 韦斯·霍尔曾经是西印度群岛伟大的板球运动员之一。
ext.ext_en: Wes Hall was once one of the West Indies' great cricketers.

ext.ext_cn: 伟大的乔治·帕德莫尔
ext.ext_en: ...the great George Padmore.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone who is successful and famous for their actions, knowledge, or skill as great .

ext.ext_cn: 所有的好莱坞名流
ext.ext_en: ...all the greats of Hollywood.

ext.ext_cn: 空前杰出的自行车运动员
ext.ext_en: ...cycling's all-time greats.

defs.def_en: The greats in a particular subject or field of activity are the people who have been most successful or famous in it.

ext.ext_cn: 摇滚金曲大联唱
ext.ext_en: ...a medley of rock'n'roll greats.

defs.def_en: The greats of popular modern music are records that have been successful and that continue to be popular.

defs.def_cn: 美妙的；好极了的；了不起的
