ext.ext_en: Arturo has this great place in Cazadero...

ext.ext_cn: 他们是一群很棒的小伙子。
ext.ext_en: They're a great bunch of guys...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as great, you approve of them or admire them.

defs.def_cn: 十分健康的；精力旺盛的；充满热情的

ext.ext_cn: 我感觉好极了。
ext.ext_en: I feel just great.

defs.def_en: If you feel great, you feel very healthy, energetic, and enthusiastic.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...a great big Italian wedding.

ext.ext_en: ...her sense of colour and great eye for detail.

defs.def_en: You use great in order to emphasize the size or degree of a characteristic or quality.

ext.ext_en: Oh great! That'll be good for Fergus.

defs.def_en: You say great in order to emphasize that you are pleased or enthusiastic about something.

ext.ext_en: 'Oh great,' I thought. 'Just what I need.'

defs.def_en: You say great in order to emphasize that you are angry or annoyed about something.

defs.def_cn: （用于同类动植物中较大者的名称前）大

ext.ext_cn: 大白鲨
ext.ext_en: ...the great white shark.

ext.ext_en: ...the tedious shadow boxing that we normally see between bosses and unions in Britain.

ext.ext_en: ...a Victorian-style family portrait.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指对良好行为的评判标准和道德观）有维多利亚时代特点的，传统的

ext.ext_en: Victorian values are much misunderstood...

ext.ext_cn: 我的祖父非常传统。
ext.ext_en: My grandfather was very Victorian.

ext.ext_en: The zoo was budgeting for 850,000 visitors this year.

ext.ext_en: ...Raeder's insistence that naval uniform be worn...

ext.ext_cn: 他敬佩你弄清楚问题、说服别人接受你的主张的那份坚持,即便有时他更倾向于自己的见解。
ext.ext_en: He admired your insistence on understanding things and making your point, even when he preferred his own...

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you disport yourself somewhere, you amuse yourself there in a happy and energetic way.

defs.def_en: If you kick against a situation you dislike but cannot control, you react against it in a violent, sudden, or extreme way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If someone is grouchy, they are very bad-tempered and complain a lot.

ext.ext_cn: 劳拉输给了汤姆。
ext.ext_en: Laura lost out to Tom...

ext.ext_en: The next phase of the operation will involve the deployment of more than 35,000 troops from a dozen countries...

ext.ext_en: There were reports of troop movements.

ext.ext_en: ...a troop of enemy cavalry trotting towards the Dutch right flank.

defs.def_en: A troop is a group of soldiers within a cavalry or armoured regiment.

ext.ext_cn: 一队童子军

defs.def_en: A troop of boy scouts is a local group of them that meets regularly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 满腹怨言的退伍军人
ext.ext_en: ...retired military men with splenetic opinions.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as splenetic, you mean that they easily become very angry about things.

defs.def_cn: 高深的事;难做的事;考验智力的事

defs.def_en: If you build up to something you want to do or say, you try to prepare people for it by starting to do it or introducing the subject gradually.

defs.def_cn: 统一的；集中的；中央集权制的

Onomatopoeia refers to the use of words which sound like the noise they refer to. 'Hiss', 'buzz', and 'rat-a-tat-tat' are examples of onomatopoeia.

ext.ext_en: ...ornamental trees.

ext.ext_en: ...ornamental plaster mouldings.

defs.def_en: Something that is ornamental is attractive and decorative.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Beyton is an admirable character...

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影叙事简练，令人叹服。
ext.ext_en: The film tells its story with admirable economy.

defs.def_en: An admirable quality or action is one that deserves to be praised and admired.

ext.ext_cn: 毫无表情、目不转睛的凝视
ext.ext_en: ...an expressionless, unblinking stare.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's eyes or expression as unblinking, you mean that they are looking steadily at something without blinking.

defs.def_en: The hard shoulder is the area at the side of a motorway or other road where you are allowed to stop if your car breaks down.

ext.ext_en: 'Hey! Look out!' shouted Patty...

ext.ext_en: Hey, can I ask you a question?

defs.def_en: In informal situations, you say or shout 'hey' to attract someone's attention, or to show surprise, interest, or annoyance.

defs.def_cn: 使迷失方向;使觉得迷惘

ext.ext_en: An overnight stay at a friend's house disorients me...

ext.ext_en: They were disorientated by the smoke and were firing blindly into it.

defs.def_en: If something disorients you, you lose your sense of direction, or you generally feel lost and uncertain, for example because you are in an unfamiliar environment.

ext.ext_cn: 这本小说的序言是以报纸报道的形式写的。
ext.ext_en: The prologue to the novel is written in the form of a newspaper account.

defs.def_en: A prologue is a speech or section of text that introduces a play or book.

ext.ext_cn: 这拉开了当今不流血革命的序幕。
ext.ext_en: This was a prologue to today's bloodless revolution.

defs.def_en: If one event is a prologue to another event, it leads to it.

ext.ext_cn: 他以诽谤罪提出起诉。
ext.ext_en: He sued for defamation.

defs.def_en: Defamation is the damaging of someone's good reputation by saying something bad and untrue about them.

ext.ext_cn: 接下来发生了一场争论，各位乐团成员你一言我一语地花了两个多小时试图说服辛普森和他的女友。
ext.ext_en: An argument ensued, with various band members joining in and haranguing Simpson and his girlfriend for over two hours.

defs.def_en: If someone harangues you, they try to persuade you to accept their opinions or ideas in a forceful way.

defs.def_cn: 慷慨激昂的劝说;喋喋不休的劝说
defs.def_en: A harangue is a long, forceful speech that someone makes to try and persuade other people to accept their opinions.

ext.ext_cn: 女运动员穿着短上衣和紧身短裤。

defs.def_cn: 灵乐(一种主要由美国黑人音乐家表演的流行音乐，源出福音唱诗及布鲁斯乐曲)
defs.def_en: Soul music or soul is a type of pop music performed mainly by black American musicians. It developed from gospel and blues music and often expresses deep emotions.
If someone has an electrocardiogram, doctors use special equipment to measure the electric currents produced by that person's heart in order to see whether it is working normally.

ext.ext_en: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.

ext.ext_en: ...patients with flu symptoms...

defs.def_en: A symptom of an illness is something wrong with your body or mind that is a sign of the illness.

ext.ext_en: Your problem with keeping boyfriends is just a symptom of a larger problem: making and keeping friends...

ext.ext_en: The contradictory statements are symptoms of disarray in the administration.

defs.def_en: A symptom of a bad situation is something that happens which is considered to be a sign of this situation.

ext.ext_cn: 警方干预后，局势平息下来。
ext.ext_en: The situation calmed down when police intervened...

ext.ext_cn: 政府没有采取任何行动对这次危机进行干预。
ext.ext_en: The Government is doing nothing to intervene in the crisis.

defs.def_en: If you intervene in a situation, you become involved in it and try to change it.

ext.ext_cn: 哈蒂打断我，叫我停下来。
ext.ext_en: Hattie intervened and told me to stop it...

ext.ext_en: 'I've told you he's not here,' Irena intervened.

defs.def_en: If you intervene, you interrupt a conversation in order to add something to it.

ext.ext_en: The South African mailboat arrived on Friday mornings unless bad weather intervened...

ext.ext_en: I pray that death may not intervene to prevent our meeting with my darling children.

defs.def_en: If an event intervenes, it happens suddenly in a way that stops, delays, or prevents something from happening.

ext.ext_en: He stands for freeing the country from the grip of dogma.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a belief or a system of beliefs as a dogma, you disapprove of it because people are expected to accept that it is true, without questioning it.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as an issue or a decision as weighty, you mean that it is serious or important.

ext.ext_en: Simon lifted a weighty volume from the shelf.

ext.ext_en: ...the mad old lady from down the street.

ext.ext_cn: 那难道不是一个愚蠢透顶的想法吗？
ext.ext_en: Isn't that a rather mad idea?

defs.def_en: You use mad to describe people or things that you think are very foolish.

ext.ext_en: You're just mad at me because I don't want to go...

ext.ext_en: I'm pretty mad about it, I can tell you.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is mad, you mean that they are very angry.

ext.ext_en: She's not as mad about sport as I am...

ext.ext_en: He's mad about you...

defs.def_en: If you are mad about or mad on something or someone, you like them very much indeed.

ext.ext_en: The audience went mad.

defs.def_en: Mad behaviour is wild and uncontrolled.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something drives you mad, you mean that you find them extremely annoying.

ext.ext_en: He was weight training like mad.

defs.def_en: If you do something like mad, you do it very energetically or enthusiastically.

ext.ext_en: The stool comes in several sizes in walnut or mahogany.

ext.ext_en: Each week Dr Buczacki chooses a listener's question and gives a detailed answer.

ext.ext_en: If you can be a sympathetic listener, it may put your own problems in perspective.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a good listener, you mean that they listen carefully and sympathetically to you when you talk, for example about your problems.

ext.ext_en: Energy consumption rises as countries industrialise...

ext.ext_en: Stalin's methods had industrialized the Russian economy...

ext.ext_en: The NCAA basketball championship was won by North Carolina.

ext.ext_en: That sort of gain for Labour is nothing like good enough to win them the general election...

ext.ext_en: Graham is more determined than ever to win the club its third Championship under his command.

ext.ext_en: The first correct entry wins the prize...

ext.ext_en: She won bronze for Great Britain in the European Championships.

ext.ext_en: The feat won them a prize of £85,000...

ext.ext_en: Slash the tops of the loaves with a sharp serrated knife in a criss-cross pattern.

ext.ext_en: ...the smoggy sprawl of Los Angeles.

defs.def_en: A rain-swept place is a place where it is raining heavily.

ext.ext_en: ...the sprightly 85-year-old President.

defs.def_en: A sprightly person, especially an old person, is lively and active.

ext.ext_cn: 那座机场由法国空降兵控制。
ext.ext_en: The airport is in the hands of French paratroops.

ext.ext_en: ...filmy nightgowns.

ext.ext_en: 'Your Eminence,' Pantieri broke in, 'I wonder if you would allow me a word.'...

ext.ext_en: ...when the photographer sets off onto the moors...

ext.ext_en: The colours rotated round on a disc and were reflected onto the wall behind.

ext.ext_en: ...windows opening onto carved black-wood balconies...

defs.def_en: When you change the position of your body, you use onto to introduce the part your body which is now supporting you.

defs.def_en: If someone asks you for some identification, they want to see something such as a driving licence, which proves who you are.

ext.ext_cn: 整个巴尔干半岛上，国家地位与语言有着非常密切的联系。
ext.ext_en: Throughout the Balkans, there is a close identification of nationhood with language.

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙与天主教的密切联系
ext.ext_en: ...the identification of Spain with Catholicism.

defs.def_en: The identification of one person or thing with another is the close association of one with the other.

ext.ext_cn: 我需要你对我、对此问题都有充分的情感认同与支持。
ext.ext_en: I need your full, emotional identification with the problem and with me...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽莲非常怜爱动物。
ext.ext_en: Marilyn had an intense identification with animals.

defs.def_en: Identification with someone or something is the feeling of sympathy and support for them.

ext.ext_cn: 卡迈勒是埃及露天集市里的一个小贩。
ext.ext_en: Kamal was a vendor in Egypt's open-air bazaar.

defs.def_en: In areas such as the Middle East and India, a bazaar is a place where there are many small shops and stalls.

ext.ext_cn: 教堂义卖
ext.ext_en: ...a church bazaar.

defs.def_en: A bazaar is a sale to raise money for charity.
A lotus or a lotus flower is a type of water lily that grows in Africa and Asia.

ext.ext_cn: 从车道上的痕迹来看，他似乎在急转弯时打滑了。
ext.ext_en: Marks in the roadway seem to indicate that he skidded taking a sharp turn.

defs.def_en: The roadway is the part of a road that is used by traffic.

ext.ext_cn: 技艺高超的手艺人
ext.ext_en: ...highly skilled craftspeople.

defs.def_en: Craftspeople are people who make things skilfully with their hands.

ext.ext_cn: 飞行昆虫的种类
ext.ext_en: ...species of flying insects.

defs.def_en: A flying animal has wings and is able to fly.

defs.def_cn: 有良好的开端;顺利开始

ext.ext_cn: 广告收入在新财年取得了开门红。
ext.ext_en: Advertising revenue in the new financial year has got off to a flying start...

ext.ext_cn: 亨德利在决赛中取得梦幻开局。
ext.ext_en: Hendry made a flying start to the final.

defs.def_en: If someone or something gets off to a flying start, or makes a flying start, they start very well, for example in a race or a new job.
The lapels of a jacket or coat are the two top parts at the front that are folded back on each side and join on to the collar.
A gerbil is a small, furry animal that is often kept as a pet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 按主题将这些材料整理分类
ext.ext_en: ...assembling this material into thematic groups.

ext.ext_cn: 整个主题学习法
ext.ext_en: ...the whole thematic approach to learning.

defs.def_en: Thematic means concerned with the subject or theme of something, or with themes and topics in general.

defs.def_cn: 挂钥匙的（形容儿童因父母都是上班族放学回家后不得不自行开门）
defs.def_en: If you refer to a child as a latchkey kid, you disapprove of the fact that they have to let themselves into their home when returning from school because their parents are out at work.

ext.ext_cn: 他偷乘渡船到了北希尔兹。
ext.ext_en: He stowed away on a ferry and landed in North Shields.

defs.def_en: If someone stows away, they hide in a ship, aeroplane, or other vehicle in order to make a journey secretly or without paying.

defs.def_cn: （会导致世界或人类毁灭的）大决战；善恶大决战
defs.def_en: Armageddon is a terrible battle or war that some people think will lead to the total destruction of the world or the human race.
An informant is someone who gives another person a piece of information.
An informant is the same as an informer .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不能想象的;不可思议的

ext.ext_cn: 真想不到托比竟会是袭击我的人。
ext.ext_en: It was inconceivable to me that Toby could have been my attacker...

ext.ext_cn: 直到现在,美元的贬值似乎都无法想象。
ext.ext_en: Until now, a devaluation of the dollar seemed inconceivable.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as inconceivable, you think it is very unlikely to happen or be true.

defs.def_cn: 文学士学位（英国英语中亦可指文学士；缩略形式为 BA或B.A.）
defs.def_en: A Bachelor of Arts is a first degree in an arts or social science subject. In British English, it can also mean a person with that degree. The abbreviation BA or B.A. is also used.

ext.ext_cn: 人们已经开始表露出对改革步伐缓慢的不满。
ext.ext_en: The population has already begun to show its displeasure at the slow pace of change.

defs.def_en: Someone's displeasure is a feeling of annoyance that they have about something that has happened.

ext.ext_cn: 埃米走过走廊时，鞋子踩在地砖上嘎吱作响。
ext.ext_en: Amy's shoes squeaked on the tiles as she walked down the corridor...

ext.ext_cn: 船舱地上铺着油毡。
ext.ext_en: The cabins had linoleum tile floors.

defs.def_en: Tiles are flat, square pieces of baked clay, carpet, cork, or other substance, which are fixed as a covering onto a floor or wall.

ext.ext_cn: 一幢精致的建筑，有齐整的小巧柱廊，屋顶上覆着装饰瓦
ext.ext_en: ...a fine building, with a neat little porch and ornamental tiles on the roof.

defs.def_en: Tiles are flat pieces of baked clay which are used for covering roofs.

ext.ext_cn: 他想在浴室里铺瓷砖。
ext.ext_en: He wants to tile the bathroom...

ext.ext_cn: 陶瓦地板使这个地方给人一种非常舒适温馨的感觉。
ext.ext_en: The terracotta tiled floor gives the place a wonderfully homely character.

defs.def_en: When someone tiles a surface such as a roof or floor, they cover it with tiles.

defs.def_cn: 纵情玩乐，花天酒地(到深夜)

ext.ext_cn: 夏洛特为彻夜狂欢精心打扮了一番。
ext.ext_en: Charlotte was dressed for a night on the tiles...

ext.ext_cn: 我曾每晚都在外面花天酒地。
ext.ext_en: I used to be out on the tiles every night.

defs.def_en: If someone has a night on the tiles or is out on the tiles, they go out in the evening, for example to a bar or a club, and do not return home until very late.

ext.ext_cn: 汇聚世界各地喜剧天才的戏剧节
ext.ext_en: ...a festival of comedic talent from around the world.

defs.def_en: Comedic means relating to comedy.

ext.ext_cn: 我家小女儿是剖腹产的。
ext.ext_en: My youngest daughter was born by Caesarean.

defs.def_en: A Caesarean or a Caesarean section is an operation in which a baby is lifted out of a woman's womb through an opening cut in her abdomen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在和克里斯蒂娜共同生活的4年中，詹姆斯一直对她不忠。
ext.ext_en: James had been unfaithful to Christine for the entire four years they'd been together.

ext.ext_cn: 她出轨的丈夫
ext.ext_en: ...her unfaithful husband.

defs.def_en: If someone is unfaithful to their lover or to the person they are married to, they have a sexual relationship with someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩键入了他的个人密码。
ext.ext_en: Brian keyed in his personal code.

defs.def_en: If you key something in, you put information into a computer or you give the computer a particular instruction by typing the information or instruction on the keyboard.

ext.ext_cn: 安保人员已经多次挨家挨户地搜查。
ext.ext_en: Security officers have carried out a number of house-to-house searches.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正挨家挨户将居民集中到一起。
ext.ext_en: They're going house to house, rounding up the residents.

defs.def_en: A house-to-house activity involves going to all the houses in an area one after another.

ext.ext_cn: 他的袖子卷到了肘部。
ext.ext_en: His sleeves were rolled up to his elbows...

ext.ext_cn: 他在夹克衫的左袖上戴了一条黑箍儿。
ext.ext_en: He wore a black band on the left sleeve of his jacket.

defs.def_en: The sleeves of a coat, shirt, or other item of clothing are the parts that cover your arms.

ext.ext_cn: 新唱片的封套上不会出现他的照片。
ext.ext_en: There are to be no pictures of him on the sleeve of the new record.

ext.ext_cn: 唱片套
ext.ext_en: ...an album sleeve.

defs.def_en: A record sleeve is the stiff envelope in which a record is kept.

defs.def_cn: 流露自己的感情;把喜怒挂在脸上
defs.def_en: If someone wears their heart on their sleeve, they behave in a way that makes their feelings very obvious, for example when they are in love with someone.

defs.def_cn: 藏有…想法;留有锦囊妙计;心中另有…高招

ext.ext_cn: 他暗自猜度希尔森究竟有什么高招。
ext.ext_en: He wondered what Shearson had up his sleeve...

ext.ext_cn: 与此同时，我不动声色地展开了调查，掌握了一张王牌。
ext.ext_en: I'd been doing some quiet investigating in the meantime and had an ace up my sleeve.

defs.def_en: If you have something up your sleeve, you have an idea or plan which you have not told anyone about. You can also say that someone has an ace, card, or trick up their sleeve .

defs.def_cn: 普拉提（类似瑜伽的一种健身锻炼）

ext.ext_cn: 她以前从没练过普拉提。
ext.ext_en: She'd never done Pilates before.

defs.def_en: Pilates is a type of exercise that is similar to yoga.

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮 17 岁了。
ext.ext_en: Jenny is seventeen years old.

defs.def_en: Seventeen is the number 17.

ext.ext_cn: 朱迪·加兰电影回顾展
ext.ext_en: ...a retrospective of the films of Judy Garland...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在1987年为他举办了一次回顾展，以示敬意。
ext.ext_en: They honoured him with a retrospective exhibition in 1987.

defs.def_en: A retrospective is an exhibition or showing of work done by an artist over many years, rather than his or her most recent work.

ext.ext_cn: 后来，回想起要负的责任她几乎会吓晕过去。
ext.ext_en: Afterwards, retrospective fear of the responsibility would make her feel almost faint.

defs.def_en: Retrospective feelings or opinions concern things that happened in the past.

defs.def_cn: (法律、法律行为等)有追溯效力的

ext.ext_cn: 银行家们立即声讨有追溯效力的税收立法。
ext.ext_en: Bankers are quick to condemn retrospective tax legislation.

defs.def_en: Retrospective laws or legal actions take effect from a date before the date when they are officially approved.

ext.ext_cn: 他尚未缴纳电视机使用许可费。
ext.ext_en: He hadn't paid his television licence fee.

defs.def_en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 弄清你要向鉴定员和律师支付多少费用。
ext.ext_en: Find out how much your surveyor's and solicitor's fees will be.

defs.def_en: A fee is the amount of money that a person or organization is paid for a particular job or service that they provide.

defs.def_cn: 拼成的;混合成的;复合的

ext.ext_cn: 高尔顿发明了一种把不同人的五官相互叠加在一起的制作合成照片的方法。
ext.ext_en: Galton devised a method of creating composite pictures in which the features of different faces were superimposed over one another.

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙是一个汇集了多种传统和民族的国家。
ext.ext_en: Spain is a composite of diverse traditions and people.

defs.def_en: A composite object or item is made up of several different things, parts, or substances.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第1个字母
defs.def_en: A is the first letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_cn: C大调音阶中的第六音；A音
defs.def_en: In music, A is the sixth note in the scale of C major.
If you get an A as a mark for a piece of work or in an exam, your work is extremely good.

defs.def_cn: （用于首字母为 a 的一些单词的缩写，如 acceleration，ampère和answer）
defs.def_en: A or a is used as an abbreviation for words beginning with a, such as 'acceleration', 'ampère', or 'answer'.

defs.def_cn: 从一处到另一处；从甲地到乙地

ext.ext_cn: 汽车用于将人们尽可能安全地从一地送往另一地。
ext.ext_en: Cars are for getting people from A to B in maximum safety.

defs.def_en: People talk about getting from A to B when they are referring generally to journeys they need to make, without saying where the journeys will take them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他为弱势群体奔走呼号，赢得了全国的尊敬。
ext.ext_en: His doughty campaigns for the underprivileged have earned him national respect.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a doughty fighter, you mean they are brave, determined, and not easily defeated.
If you have an alibi, you can prove that you were somewhere else when a crime was committed.

ext.ext_cn: 高级外交官的角色将是他缺席的上佳托词。
ext.ext_en: A role as senior diplomat would be a good alibi for his absence.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone has an alibi when they can prove that something was not their fault.

ext.ext_cn: 我和两个朋友在大学春假期间开车去了佛罗里达。
ext.ext_en: Two friends and I drove to Florida during college spring break...

ext.ext_cn: 拉姆齐第二次访问意大利。
ext.ext_en: Ramsay made a second visit to Italy.

defs.def_en: You use to when indicating the place that someone or something visits, moves towards, or points at.

ext.ext_cn: 我们去休闲活动中心参加了一个聚会。
ext.ext_en: We went to a party at the leisure centre...

ext.ext_cn: 他来赴晚宴了。
ext.ext_en: He came to dinner...

defs.def_en: If you go to an event, you go where it is taking place.

ext.ext_cn: 狗项圈上系着一条布。
ext.ext_en: There was a piece of cloth tied to the dog's collar...

ext.ext_cn: 很多病人更喜欢手握式的淋浴喷头而不是固定在墙上的那种。
ext.ext_en: Many patients prefer hand-held shower heads rather than those fixed to the wall…

defs.def_en: If something is attached to something larger or fixed to it, the two things are joined together.

ext.ext_cn: 海明威的工作室在右面。
ext.ext_en: Hemingway's studio is to the right...

ext.ext_cn: 你会看见那座小教堂在你左侧的山上。
ext.ext_en: You will see the chapel on the hill to your left…

defs.def_en: You use to when indicating the position of something. For example, if something is to your left, it is nearer your left side than your right side.

ext.ext_cn: 他捡起刀子递给我。
ext.ext_en: He picked up the knife and gave it to me...

ext.ext_cn: 公司应获许以较低的工资给长期失业的人提供岗位。
ext.ext_en: Firms should be allowed to offer jobs to the long-term unemployed at a lower wage.

defs.def_en: When you give something to someone, they receive it.

defs.def_cn: (表示动作或情感的对象)对，于

ext.ext_cn: 马库斯今天对我非常无礼。
ext.ext_en: Marcus has been most unkind to me today...

ext.ext_cn: 忠于政府的军队
ext.ext_en: …troops loyal to the government.

defs.def_en: You use to to indicate who or what an action or a feeling is directed towards.

defs.def_cn: (与某些名词、形容词连用，表示关联)对于，关于

ext.ext_cn: 他机智风趣，鼓舞激励着我们所有人。
ext.ext_en: He is a witty man, and an inspiration to all of us...

ext.ext_cn: 婚姻并不能解决一切问题。
ext.ext_en: Marriage is not the answer to everything...

defs.def_en: You use to with certain nouns and adjectives to show that a following noun is related to them.

ext.ext_cn: 我将不得不向他们解释我不能付钱给他们。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to have to explain to them that I can't pay them.

defs.def_en: If you say something to someone, you want that person to listen and understand what you are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 令他吃惊的是，卧室门锁上了。
ext.ext_en: To his surprise, the bedroom door was locked…

ext.ext_cn: 令外科医生惊讶的是，他竟活下来了。
ext.ext_en: He survived, to the amazement of surgeons.

defs.def_en: You use to when indicating someone's reaction to something or their feelings about a situation or event. For example, if you say that something happens to someone's surprise you mean that they are surprised when it happens.

ext.ext_cn: 在我看来他显然很尊重他的上司。
ext.ext_en: It was clear to me that he respected his boss...

ext.ext_cn: 每个人对她来说都善良得不可思议。
ext.ext_en: Everyone seemed to her to be amazingly kind.

defs.def_en: You use to when indicating the person whose opinion you are stating.

ext.ext_cn: 喊叫声变成了惊恐的尖叫声。
ext.ext_en: The shouts changed to screams of terror.

ext.ext_cn: 被改建成自然中心的旧农场主住宅
ext.ext_en: ...an old ranch house that has been converted to a nature centre.

defs.def_en: You use to when indicating what something or someone is becoming, or the state or situation that they are progressing towards.

ext.ext_cn: 里克曼曾是奈杰尔·霍索恩的服装师。
ext.ext_en: Rickman worked as a dresser to Nigel Hawthorne...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾是尼泊尔政府的官方译员。
ext.ext_en: He was an official interpreter to the government of Nepal.

defs.def_en: To can be used as a way of introducing the person or organization you are employed by, when you perform some service for them.

ext.ext_cn: 每周一到周五期间都会有一天禁止所有车辆进入墨西哥城。
ext.ext_en: Every vehicle was banned from coming into Mexico City one day a week from Monday to Friday…

ext.ext_cn: 从1977到1985年，美国的国民生产总值增长了 21%。
ext.ext_en: From 1977 to 1985 the United States gross national product grew 21 percent...

defs.def_en: You use to to indicate that something happens until the time or amount mentioned is reached.

ext.ext_cn: 从小说到历史，我什么书都读。
ext.ext_en: I read everything from fiction to history.

ext.ext_cn: 从打字机到玩具汽车这样的机械玩具和小巧装置
ext.ext_en: …mechanical toys and gadgets, from typewriters to toy cars.

defs.def_en: You use to when indicating the last thing in a range of things, usually when you are giving two extreme examples of something.

ext.ext_cn: 拉里和安迪从一处漂泊到另一处，干点这个又干点那个。
ext.ext_en: Larry and Andy had drifted from place to place, worked at this and that.

defs.def_en: If someone goes from place to place or from job to job, they go to several places, or work in several jobs, and spend only a short time in each one.

ext.ext_cn: 她站起身，开始来回踱步。
ext.ext_en: She stood up and began to pace to and fro...

ext.ext_cn: 小船在水中轻轻地来回摇荡。
ext.ext_en: The boat was rocking gently to and fro in the water.

defs.def_en: See also:toing and fro-ing;If someone moves to and fro, they move repeatedly from one place to another and back again, or from side to side.

ext.ext_cn: 5 点 40 分我正在车站入口处等着。
ext.ext_en: At twenty to six I was waiting by the entrance to the station...

ext.ext_cn: 安在刚好8点55分时下车进了楼。
ext.ext_en: At exactly five minutes to nine, Ann left her car and entered the building.

defs.def_en: You use to when you are stating a time which is less than thirty minutes before an hour. For example, if it is 'five to eight', it is five minutes before eight o'clock.

ext.ext_cn: 每加仑油跑 60 英里的发动机
ext.ext_en: ...engines that can run at 60 miles to the gallon.

ext.ext_cn: 由一份牛奶和两份水兑成的混合物
ext.ext_en: …a mixture of one part milk to two parts water.

defs.def_en: You use to when giving ratios and rates.

ext.ext_cn: 罗密欧在热烈的掌声中离开了舞台。
ext.ext_en: Romeo left the stage, to enthusiastic applause...

ext.ext_cn: 随着门铃叮当作响，埃米醒来了。
ext.ext_en: Amy woke up to the sound of her doorbell ringing...

defs.def_en: You use to when indicating that two things happen at the same time. For example, if something is done to music, it is done at the same time as music is being played.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦他们试着种植兰花，就会发现那并不是什么难事。
ext.ext_en: Once they have tried growing orchids, they will see there is really nothing to it.

ext.ext_cn: 她正经历一个困难时期。就这么简单。
ext.ext_en: She's going through a difficult time. That's all there is to it.

defs.def_en: If you say 'There's nothing to it', 'There's not much to it', or 'That's  all there is to it', you are emphasizing how simple you think something is.

ext.ext_cn: 他溜了出去，虚掩上门。
ext.ext_en: He slipped out, pulling the door to.

defs.def_en: If you push or shut a door to, you close it but may not shut it completely.

defs.def_cn: (用于动词原形前构成不定式;不定式用于某些动词、名词、形容词以及 how，which,  where 等词之后)。

ext.ext_cn: 管理层想知道我在那里做什么。
ext.ext_en: The management wanted to know what I was doing there...

ext.ext_cn: 她告诉了部长们她准备辞职的决定。
ext.ext_en: She told ministers of her decision to resign...

defs.def_en: You use to before the base form of a verb to form the to-infinitive. You use the to-infinitive after certain verbs, nouns, and adjectives, and after words such as 'how', 'which', and 'where'.

defs.def_cn: (用于动词原形前，表示动作的目的或意图)

ext.ext_cn: 利用大公司的经验帮助小企业
ext.ext_en: ...using the experience of big companies to help small businesses...

ext.ext_cn: 他这么做是为了使我更放松。
ext.ext_en: He was doing this to make me more relaxed...

defs.def_en: You use to before the base form of a verb to indicate the purpose or intention of an action.  in order to→see: order;

defs.def_cn: (用于动词原形前，表示对自己要说的话加以说明)

ext.ext_cn: 说实话，我很失望。
ext.ext_en: I'm disappointed, to be honest...

ext.ext_cn: 那么，概括来说，你想要传达的信息到底是什么？
ext.ext_en: Well, to sum up, what is the message that you are trying to get across?

defs.def_en: You use to before the base form of a verb when you are commenting on a statement that you are making, for example when saying that you are being honest or brief, or that you are summing up or giving an example.

defs.def_cn: (用于感叹句中的动词原形前，强调某一强烈情感)
