ext.ext_cn: 贾尔思没有料想到萨利对他的感情如此强烈。
ext.ext_en: Giles had not reckoned with the strength of Sally's feelings for him.

defs.def_en: If you say that you had not reckoned with something, you mean that you had not expected it and so were not prepared for it.

ext.ext_cn: 此举等于告诉其受害者的朋友们他不好对付。
ext.ext_en: This act was a signal to his victim's friends that he was someone to be reckoned with...

ext.ext_cn: 他得证明他的民主运动在阿尔及利亚政坛确实是一股不可忽视的力量。
ext.ext_en: He will have to demonstrate that his Movement for Democracy is really a force to be reckoned with in Algerian politics.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is someone or something to be reckoned with, you mean that they must be dealt with and it will be difficult.

ext.ext_cn: 为了谁做主角的问题爆发了一场吵闹。
ext.ext_en: A catfight has erupted over who will get top billing.

defs.def_en: A catfight is an angry fight or quarrel, especially between women.

defs.def_cn: (指车轮、车灯或车门)靠近路边的;(在英国指)左边的

ext.ext_cn: 左前轮胎被割破了。
ext.ext_en: The nearside front tyre had been slashed.

defs.def_en: The nearside wheels, lights, or doors of a vehicle are those nearest the edge of the road when the vehicle is being driven on the correct side of the road. In Britain, the nearside is on the left.

defs.def_cn: (车辆)靠路边的一侧，内侧，左边

ext.ext_cn: 车的左侧撞到路缘上，似乎飞弹了起来，靠两只车轮越过了马路。
ext.ext_en: It hit the kerb on the nearside and seemed to ricochet across the road on two wheels.

defs.def_en: The nearside of a vehicle is the side that is nearest the edge of the road when the vehicle is being driven on the correct side of the road.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (成功或获胜后)欢欣鼓舞的，狂喜的

ext.ext_cn: 邓肯和他那些欢欣鼓舞的士兵们庆祝他们取得了军事胜利。
ext.ext_en: Duncan and his triumphant soldiers celebrate their military victory…

ext.ext_cn: 上校的声音听上去万分得意。
ext.ext_en: The captain's voice was triumphant...

defs.def_en: Someone who is triumphant has gained a victory or succeeded in something and feels very happy about it.

ext.ext_cn: 在外汇交易中，美元上涨了 0.45 个百分点。
ext.ext_en: On the foreign exchanges, the US dollar is up point forty-five.

defs.def_en: Foreign exchanges are the institutions or systems involved with changing one currency into another.

ext.ext_cn: 外汇的重要来源
ext.ext_en: ...an important source of foreign exchange.

ext.ext_cn: 外汇交易者
ext.ext_en: ...foreign-exchange traders.

defs.def_en: Foreign exchange is used to refer to foreign currency that is obtained through the foreign exchange system.

ext.ext_cn: 很少有吉他手唱歌像弹吉他那么好，然而埃迪是个例外。
ext.ext_en: Few guitarists can sing as well as they can play; Eddie, however, is an exception...

ext.ext_cn: 除了一朵红色玫瑰花外，仪式上没有任何献花。
ext.ext_en: There were no floral offerings at the ceremony, with the exception of a single red rose...

defs.def_en: An exception is a particular thing, person, or situation that is not included in a general statement, judgment, or rule.

ext.ext_cn: 现在市场营销已无处不在，图书也不例外。
ext.ext_en: Marketing is applied to everything these days, and books are no exception...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数人并不真正清楚究竟如何转而食用健康食品，莫琳也是如此。
ext.ext_en: Most people have no real idea how to change to healthy food, and Maureen was no exception.

defs.def_en: If you make a general statement, and then say that something or someone is no exception, you are emphasizing that they are included in that statement.

defs.def_cn: 证明普遍性的例外；规则必有例外

ext.ext_cn: 酿酒和会计通常不搭边，而蒂埃里·阿萨尔却是普遍中的例外。
ext.ext_en: Wine-making and accountants don't usually go together, but Thierry Hasard is an exception that proves the rule.

defs.def_en: If you are making a general statement and you say that something is the exception that proves the rule, you mean that although it seems to contradict your statement, in most other cases your statement will be true.

ext.ext_cn: 他也讨厌被暗中监视。
ext.ext_en: He also took exception to having been spied on...

ext.ext_cn: 问题是他们反感任何形式的噪音。
ext.ext_en: And the problem is that they take exception to any kind of noise whatsoever.

defs.def_en: If you take exception to something, you feel offended or annoyed by it, usually with the result that you complain about it.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天所有人都放一天假，劳伦斯除外。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday was a day off for everybody, with the exception of Lawrence...

ext.ext_cn: 几乎在所有体育运动中，可能除女子体操外，现在的运动员都要比过去更加高大强壮。
ext.ext_en: In virtually every sport, with the possible exception of women's gymnastics, the players are now bigger and stronger than before.

defs.def_en: You use with the exception of to introduce a thing or person that is not included in a general statement that you are making.

ext.ext_cn: 那些车辆一律都很破旧，锈迹斑斑，布满凹痕。
ext.ext_en: The vehicles are without exception old, rusty and dented...

ext.ext_cn: 那些被判有罪的人几乎无一例外都是我们的朋友和同事。
ext.ext_en: Almost without exception those convicted were our friends and colleagues.

defs.def_en: You use without exception to emphasize that the statement you are making is true in all cases.

ext.ext_cn: 一名男子问他们想不想买些毒品。
ext.ext_en: A man asked them if they wanted to buy some dope...

ext.ext_cn: 他未能通过可卡因药检。
ext.ext_en: He has failed a dope test for cocaine...

defs.def_en: Dope is a drug, usually an illegal drug such as marijuana or cocaine.

defs.def_cn: 给…服麻醉剂（或毒品）；在…中掺麻醉剂（或毒品）

ext.ext_cn: 任何人都可能会进来在酒中掺麻醉剂。
ext.ext_en: Anyone could have got in and doped the wine...

ext.ext_cn: 我被人下了安眠药。
ext.ext_en: I'd been doped with Somnolin...

defs.def_en: If someone dopes a person or animal or dopes their food, they put drugs into their food or force them to take drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 我和他们在一起更自在，也觉得自己没那么傻。
ext.ext_en: I'm more comfortable with them. I don't feel I'm such a dope.

defs.def_en: If someone calls a person a dope, they think that the person is stupid.

ext.ext_cn: 政府掌握大量关于他的内部消息。
ext.ext_en: The government had plenty of dope on him.

defs.def_en: Dope is information which you have been given illegally or secretly.

defs.def_cn: 合成纤维织物;合成纤维;合成物

ext.ext_cn: 丝绸和羊毛之类的纯天然织物比合成纤维的保暖性更好。
ext.ext_en: Natural fabrics like silk and wool are better insulators than synthetics.

defs.def_en: You can refer to synthetic clothing, fabric, or materials as synthetics .
The bleachers are a part of an outdoor sports stadium, or the seats in that area, which are usually uncovered and are the least expensive place where people can sit.

ext.ext_cn: 一堆沙子
ext.ext_en: ...a pile of sand...

ext.ext_cn: 一小堆面包屑
ext.ext_en: ...a little pile of crumbs...

defs.def_en: A pile of things is a mass of them that is high in the middle and has sloping sides.

defs.def_cn: （一个压着一个摆放整齐的）叠，摞

ext.ext_cn: 一叠盒子
ext.ext_en: ...a pile of boxes...

ext.ext_cn: 我们坐在萨姆的书房里，身边是一堆一堆的书。
ext.ext_en: We sat in Sam's study, among the piles of books...

defs.def_en: A pile of things is a quantity of things that have been put neatly somewhere so that each thing is on top of the one below.

ext.ext_cn: 他在把衣服一件件叠放进手提箱中。
ext.ext_en: He was piling clothes into the  suitcase...

ext.ext_cn: 几份报纸和杂志堆在桌上。
ext.ext_en: A few newspapers and magazines were piled on a table.

defs.def_en: If you pile things somewhere, you put them there so that they form a pile.

ext.ext_cn: 桌上高高堆放着当地的农产品。
ext.ext_en: Tables were piled high with local produce.

ext.ext_cn: 塞满成堆行李的卡车
ext.ext_en: ...trucks piled with luggage.

defs.def_en: If something is piled with things, it is covered or filled with piles of things.

ext.ext_cn: 我有一大堆的问题等着过后问你。
ext.ext_en: I've got a pile of questions afterwards for you.

ext.ext_cn: 灾难迭至
ext.ext_en: ...a whole pile of disasters.

defs.def_en: If you talk about a pile of something or piles of something, you mean a large amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们一窝蜂地挤进杰罗尔德的车里。
ext.ext_en: They all piled into Jerrold's car...

ext.ext_cn: 突然开来一队警车，数十个警察一拥而出。
ext.ext_en: A fleet of police cars suddenly arrived. Dozens of officers piled out.

defs.def_en: If a group of people pile into or out of a vehicle, they all get into it or out of it in a disorganized way.

defs.def_cn: （尤指富人或要人居住的）高大宏伟的建筑物

ext.ext_cn: 乡下某座恢宏气派的建筑
ext.ext_en: ...some stately pile in the country.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a large impressive building as a pile, especially when it is the home of a rich important person.

ext.ext_cn: 建在沿岸桩柱上的木制房屋居住区
ext.ext_en: ...settlements of wooden houses, set on piles along the shore.

defs.def_en: Piles are wooden, concrete, or metal posts which are pushed into the ground and on which buildings or bridges are built. Piles are often used in very wet areas so that the buildings do not flood.
Piles are painful swellings that can appear in the veins inside a person's anus.

defs.def_cn: （地毯或织物的）绒面，绒毛，绒头

ext.ext_cn: 地毯的厚绒
ext.ext_en: ...the carpet's thick pile.

defs.def_en: The pile of a carpet or of a fabric such as velvet is its soft surface. It consists of a lot of little threads standing on end.

defs.def_cn: 处于（社会或某组织的）下层/上层
defs.def_en: Someone who is at the bottom of the pile is low down in society or low down in an organization. Someone who is at the top of the pile is high up in society or high up in an organization.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 充满爱的；钟爱的；关爱的

ext.ext_cn: 吉姆是个非常体贴的丈夫和慈爱的父亲。
ext.ext_en: Jim was a most loving husband and father...

ext.ext_cn: 那里的孩子都很爱我。
ext.ext_en: The children there were very loving to me.

defs.def_en: Someone who is loving feels or shows love to other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行为）爱护有加的，细心周到的

ext.ext_cn: 此屋已被悉心修复。
ext.ext_en: The house has been restored with loving care.

defs.def_en: Loving actions are done with great enjoyment and care.

ext.ext_cn: 他获得了社会心理学博士学位。
ext.ext_en: He obtained his doctorate in Social Psychology.

defs.def_en: A doctorate is the highest degree awarded by a university.

defs.def_cn: 一时的兴致;心血来潮;突发的奇想

ext.ext_cn: 我们多少有点心血来潮，决定航海去摩洛哥。
ext.ext_en: We decided, more or less on a whim, to sail to Morocco...

ext.ext_cn: 保险公司可以随时提高保费。
ext.ext_en: The premium can increase at the whim of the insurers...

defs.def_en: A whim is a wish to do or have something which seems to have no serious reason or purpose behind it, and often occurs suddenly.

ext.ext_cn: 医院工作人员推迟了罗森鲍姆的X光检查。
ext.ext_en: The hospital staff held off taking Rosenbaum in for an X-ray...

ext.ext_cn: 他们扬言要采取军事行动，但一直拖到现在。
ext.ext_en: They have threatened military action but held off until now.

defs.def_en: If you hold off doing something, you delay doing it or delay making a decision about it.

defs.def_cn: （在比赛或竞赛中）抵挡住（对手的挑战）

ext.ext_cn: 1987至1990年间，施特菲·格拉芙基本上抵挡住了纳芙拉蒂洛娃对其冠军地位的挑战。
ext.ext_en: Between 1987 and 1990, Steffi Graf largely held off Navratilova's challenge for the crown.

defs.def_en: If you hold off a challenge in a race or competition, you do not allow someone to pass you.

defs.def_cn: (下午或傍晚的)茶点时间，喝茶时间

ext.ext_cn: 我们是在下午晚些时候动身的。
ext.ext_en: We left at teatime.

defs.def_en: Teatime is the period of the day when people have their tea. It can be eaten in the late afternoon or in the early part of the evening.

ext.ext_cn: 中波流行音乐电台
ext.ext_en: ...a station broadcasting pop music on medium wave.

defs.def_en: Medium wave is a range of radio waves which are used for broadcasting.

ext.ext_cn: 马尔科姆海军上尉说她没有发现人们大批逃离海地有减缓的迹象。
ext.ext_en: Lieutenant Malcolm said she saw no sign that the exodus from Haiti was abating...

ext.ext_cn: 由于医生大批离去，医疗系统面临崩溃。
ext.ext_en: The medical system is facing collapse because of an exodus of doctors.

defs.def_en: If there is an exodus of people from a place, a lot of people leave that place at the same time.

defs.def_cn: 超自然的；异常的；非同寻常的

ext.ext_cn: 他们的父母有着一种近乎神奇的能力，能够洞悉他们的孩子脑子里在想些什么。
ext.ext_en: Their parents had an almost preternatural ability to understand what was going on in their children's minds.

defs.def_en: Preternatural abilities, qualities, or events are very unusual in a way that might make you think that unknown forces are involved.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 德鲁整天就盯着女人看，说些下流话。
ext.ext_en: Drew spends all day eyeing up the women and making lewd comments.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's  behaviour as lewd, you are critical of it because it is sexual in a rude and unpleasant way.

ext.ext_cn: 马路上到处是水洼，闪着光，不过雨停了。
ext.ext_en: The road was shiny with puddles, but the rain was at an end.

ext.ext_cn: 一摊摊油
ext.ext_en: ...puddles of oil.

defs.def_en: A puddle is a small, shallow pool of liquid that has spread on the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 席卷美国东海岸的猛烈暴风雨
ext.ext_en: ...the violent storms which whipped America's East Coast.

defs.def_en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

defs.def_cn: 强烈的反应;群情激愤;激动人心

ext.ext_cn: 照片最初刊登出来时曾引起了一片公愤。
ext.ext_en: The photos caused a storm when they were first published...

ext.ext_cn: 公告一发布就引发了一场强烈的抗议。
ext.ext_en: The announcement provoked an immediate storm of protest.

defs.def_en: If something causes a storm, it causes an angry or excited reaction from a large number of people.

ext.ext_cn: 人们对他的演讲报以雷鸣般的掌声。
ext.ext_en: His speech was greeted with a storm of applause...

ext.ext_cn: 自1968 年奥运会以来，没有哪次颁奖仪式引起过如此哗然的一片嘘声。
ext.ext_en: Not since the 1968 Olympic Games has a medals ceremony caused such a storm of booing.

defs.def_en: A storm of applause or other noise is a sudden loud amount of it made by an audience or other group of people in reaction to something.

ext.ext_cn: 争吵了几句后，他气冲冲地走了出去。
ext.ext_en: After a bit of an argument, he stormed out...

ext.ext_cn: 他气冲冲地闯进一间办公室，质问部门经理在哪里。
ext.ext_en: He stormed into an office, demanding to know where the head of department was.

defs.def_en: If you storm into or out of a place, you enter or leave it quickly and noisily, because you are angry.

ext.ext_cn: “这是场彻底的失败，”他怒吼道。
ext.ext_en: 'It's a fiasco,' he stormed.

defs.def_en: If you storm, you say something in a very loud voice, because you are extremely angry.

ext.ext_cn: 政府大楼遭到了攻击和抢劫。
ext.ext_en: Government buildings have been stormed and looted...

ext.ext_cn: 难民们决定冲进大使馆。
ext.ext_en: The refugees decided to storm the embassy.

defs.def_en: If a place that is being defended is stormed, a group of people attack it, usually in order to get inside it.

ext.ext_cn: 肯尼亚的长跑运动员在田径界获得了巨大成功。
ext.ext_en: Kenya's long distance runners have taken the athletics world by storm.

defs.def_en: If someone or something takes a place by storm, they are extremely successful.

ext.ext_cn: 他坚称自己不会辞职，一定渡过难关。
ext.ext_en: He insists he will not resign and will weather the storm.

defs.def_en: If someone weathers the storm, they succeed in reaching the end of a very difficult period without much harm or damage.

ext.ext_cn: 对轻刑罪犯的非监禁惩罚
ext.ext_en: ...non-custodial punishments for minor criminals.

defs.def_en: If someone who has been found guilty of a crime or offence is given a non-custodial sentence, their punishment does not involve going to prison.

defs.def_cn: (分居或离异夫妇中)非监护人的，无监护权的

ext.ext_cn: 超出半数的离婚家庭的孩子没有定期与无监护权的家长见面。
ext.ext_en: More than half the children of divorce did not see the non-custodial parent on a regular basis.

defs.def_en: The non-custodial parent in a couple who are separated or divorced is the parent who does not live with the children.
In mathematics, the logarithm of a number is a number that it can be represented by in order to make a difficult multiplication or division sum simpler.
Calisthenics are simple exercises that you can do to keep fit and healthy.

defs.def_cn: 习惯法;不成文法;判例法

ext.ext_cn: 加拿大的诽谤法是以英国的习惯法为基础的。
ext.ext_en: Canadian libel law is based on English common law.

defs.def_en: Common law is the system of law which is based on judges' decisions and on custom rather than on written laws.

defs.def_cn: (未履行正式结婚手续)属于事实婚姻的

ext.ext_cn: 他的事实婚姻妻子
ext.ext_en: ...his common law wife.

defs.def_en: A common law relationship is regarded as a marriage because it has lasted a long time, although no official marriage contract has been signed.
A docker is a person who works in the docks, loading and unloading ships.

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿期的攻击行为
ext.ext_en: ...infantile aggression.

ext.ext_cn: 患婴儿湿疹的儿童
ext.ext_en: ...children with infantile eczema.

defs.def_en: Infantile behaviour or illnesses are typical of very young children.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这种幽默既幼稚又无聊。
ext.ext_en: This kind of humour is infantile and boring.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone or something of being infantile, you think that they are foolish and childish.

ext.ext_cn: 所有的饮料都必须装在可回收的容器中出售。
ext.ext_en: All beverages must be sold in returnable containers.

defs.def_en: Returnable containers are intended to be taken back to the place they came from so that they can be used again.

defs.def_cn: (金钱、文件等)可退还的，可归还的

ext.ext_cn: 房东可以收取一笔可退还的押金。
ext.ext_en: Landlords can charge a returnable deposit.

defs.def_en: If something such as a sum of money or a document is returnable, it will eventually be given back to the person who provided it.
A foxhound is a type of dog that is trained to hunt foxes.

ext.ext_cn: 他不停地看表。
ext.ext_en: He checked his watch for the umpteenth time...

ext.ext_cn: 她已喝了无数杯杜松子酒了。
ext.ext_en: She was now on her umpteenth gin.

defs.def_en: You use umpteenth to indicate that an occasion, thing, or person happens or comes after many others.

defs.def_cn: 定会成功的;稳妥保险的

ext.ext_cn: 事实证明，性和背叛的话题结合起来无疑大大增加了发行量。
ext.ext_en: The combination of sex and treachery proved a copper-bottomed circulation booster...

ext.ext_cn: 他们认为自己的计划万无一失，结果一败涂地。
ext.ext_en: Their copper-bottomed scheme went badly wrong.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as copper-bottomed, you believe that it is certain to be successful.

defs.def_cn: (网球比赛中各胜6局后的)决胜局，抢七局
defs.def_en: A tie-break is an extra game which is played in a tennis match when the score in a set is 6-6. The player who wins the tie-break wins the set.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们可能只有有限的时间来说明自己的意思。
ext.ext_en: They may only have a limited amount of time to get their points across...

ext.ext_cn: 商店里的选择非常有限。
ext.ext_en: Shops have a very limited selection.

defs.def_en: Something that is limited is not very great in amount, range, or degree.

ext.ext_cn: 他们计划将这个俱乐部变为一家股份有限公司。
ext.ext_en: They had plans to turn the club into a limited company...

ext.ext_cn: 他是国际体育管理有限公司的创始人。
ext.ext_en: He is the founder of International Sports Management Limited.

defs.def_en: A limited company is one whose owners are legally responsible for only a part of any money that it may owe if it goes bankrupt.

defs.def_cn: 生命统计，人口动态统计（对出生、死亡、婚姻等人口信息的统计）
defs.def_en: The vital statistics of a population are statistics such as the number of births, deaths, or marriages which take place in it.
Someone's vital statistics, especially a woman's, are the measurements of their body at certain points, for example at their chest, waist, and hips.

ext.ext_cn: 他的晋升是证明了少数族裔的进步，还是仅仅为了装点门面？
ext.ext_en: Is his promotion evidence of the minorities' advance, or mere tokenism?

defs.def_en: If you refer to an action as tokenism, you disapprove of it because you think it is just done for effect, in order to show a particular intention or to impress a particular type of person.
An alchemist was a scientist in the Middle Ages who tried to discover how to change ordinary metals into gold.

ext.ext_cn: 政府已经声称要改革宪兵部队。
ext.ext_en: The government has said it will reform the military police.

defs.def_en: The military police are the part of an army, navy, or air force that act as its police force.

ext.ext_cn: 营地周围架着尖利的铁丝网，且有宪兵看守。
ext.ext_en: The camp is surrounded by razor-wire fences and guarded by military police.

defs.def_en: Military police are men and women who are members of the part of an army, navy, or air force that act as its police force.

ext.ext_cn: 第三产业劳动力比例缓慢提高的经济体
ext.ext_en: ...economies that are slowly increasing the proportion of their labour force in the tertiary sector.

defs.def_en: The tertiary sector consists of industries which provide a service, such as transport and finance.

defs.def_cn: 命名法;专门名词确定法

ext.ext_cn: 因不了解木本植物命名法而产生的错误
ext.ext_en: ...mistakes arising from ignorance of the nomenclature of woody plants.

ext.ext_cn: 国际公认的化学命名规则
ext.ext_en: ...the internationally agreed rules of chemical nomenclature.

defs.def_en: The nomenclature of a particular set of things is the system of naming those things.

ext.ext_cn: 许多低收入家庭将会买不起自己的房子。
ext.ext_en: Many families on low incomes will be unable to afford to buy their own home...

ext.ext_cn: 公司年收入需要达到500万英镑才能收支平衡。
ext.ext_en: To cover its costs, the company will need an annual income of £5 million...

defs.def_en: A person's or organization's income is the money that they earn or receive, as opposed to the money that they have to spend or pay out.  →see usage note at:salary

defs.def_cn: (尤指工作方面的)导师，指导者
defs.def_en: A person's mentor is someone who gives them help and advice over a period of time, especially help and advice related to their job.

ext.ext_cn: 他指导过许多更年轻的医生。
ext.ext_en: He had mentored scores of younger doctors.

defs.def_en: To mentor someone means to give them help and advice over a period of time, especially help and advice related to their job.

ext.ext_cn: 社会道德和正义的标准
ext.ext_en: ...standards of morality and justice in society.

ext.ext_cn: 维护传统道德的努力
ext.ext_en: ...an effort to preserve traditional morality.

defs.def_en: Morality is the belief that some behaviour is right and acceptable and that other behaviour is wrong.

defs.def_cn: 道义准则;道德规范;伦理学

ext.ext_cn: 存在性别歧视的道德规范
ext.ext_en: ...a morality that is sexist.

ext.ext_cn: 社区和其共同的道义准则
ext.ext_en: ...communities and their shared moralities.

defs.def_en: A morality is a system of principles and values concerning people's behaviour, which is generally accepted by a society or by a particular group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 有关猎杀动物行为是否道德的争论
ext.ext_en: ...the arguments about the morality of blood sports.

defs.def_en: The morality of something is how right or acceptable it is.
A dredger is a boat which is fitted with a special machine that is used to increase the size of harbours, rivers, and canals.

defs.def_cn: 因特网中继聊天;在线聊天
defs.def_en: IRC is a way of having conversations with people who are using the Internet, especially people you do not know. IRC is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'Internet Relay Chat'.

ext.ext_cn: 这是世界上很美的一个地区。
ext.ext_en: It's a beautiful part of the world...

ext.ext_cn: 我最想做的事是开车周游世界。
ext.ext_en: More than anything, I'd like to drive around the world...

defs.def_en: The world is the planet that we live on.

ext.ext_cn: 世人当时感到震惊，现在仍然如此。
ext.ext_en: The world was, and remains, shocked...

ext.ext_cn: 他想向世人表明任何人都能通过学习而成为一名大使。
ext.ext_en: He wants to show the world that anyone can learn to be an ambassador.

defs.def_en: The world refers to all the people who live on this planet, and our societies, institutions, and ways of life.

defs.def_cn: 世界上最重要的;举世瞩目的

ext.ext_cn: 在国外，布什先生被看作一位国际上举足轻重的政治家。
ext.ext_en: Abroad, Mr Bush was seen as a world statesman...

ext.ext_cn: 中国又一次以世界强国的姿态崛起。
ext.ext_en: China has once again emerged as a world power...

defs.def_en: You can use world to describe someone or something that is one of the most important or significant of its kind on earth.

defs.def_cn: (指某一群国家或历史时期)世界，国家，时代

ext.ext_cn: 雅典与阿拉伯世界关系密切。
ext.ext_en: Athens had strong ties to the Arab world.

ext.ext_cn: 发展中国家
ext.ext_en: ...the developing world...

defs.def_en: You can use world in expressions such as the Arab world ,the western world, and the ancient world to refer to a particular group of countries or a particular period in history.

ext.ext_cn: 他的生活圈子和我的似乎有天壤之别。
ext.ext_en: His world seemed so different from mine...

ext.ext_cn: 我丢了工作，我的世界好像都垮掉了。
ext.ext_en: I lost my job and it was like my world collapsed...

defs.def_en: Someone's world is the life they lead, the people they have contact with, and the things they experience.

ext.ext_cn: 出版界以前确实没有遇见过类似这样的事。
ext.ext_en: The publishing world had certainly never seen an event quite like this.

ext.ext_cn: 来自金融界的最新消息
ext.ext_en: ...the latest news from the world of finance.

defs.def_en: You can use world to refer to a particular field of activity, and the people involved in it.

defs.def_cn: （有某种特色的）地方，环境；（某种生活的）世界，境况

ext.ext_cn: 位于一处有公共绿地、森林和湖泊的隐秘之地的高尔夫球场
ext.ext_en: ...a golf course set in a hidden world of parkland, forest and lakes...

ext.ext_cn: 患者必须再次进入充满问题和压力的世界。
ext.ext_en: The patient must re-enter a world full of problems and stresses.

defs.def_en: You can use world to refer to a place or way of life by describing its strongest features.

ext.ext_cn: 无论今世还是来生，好运都会伴随你。
ext.ext_en: Good fortune will follow you, both in this world and the next.

defs.def_en: You can use world in expressions such as this world ,the next world, and the world to come to refer to the state of being alive or a state of existence after death.
You can use world to refer to a particular group of living things, for example the animal world ,the plant world, and the insect world.

ext.ext_cn: 他看上去像是从另一个星球来的。
ext.ext_en: He looked like something from another world...

ext.ext_cn: 人类在接近各个星球，探索新的天体。
ext.ext_en: Man was drawing closer to the stars, opening new worlds.

defs.def_en: A world is a planet.

ext.ext_cn: 在智力上，我和这个男子有天壤之别。
ext.ext_en: Intellectually, this man and I are worlds apart...

ext.ext_cn: 这本小说和他的学术著作截然不同。
ext.ext_en: The novel is worlds apart from his academic writings.

defs.def_en: If you say that two people or things are worlds apart, you are emphasizing that they are very different from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 她家客厅一头是办公处，一头是舒适的沙发，真是两全其美。
ext.ext_en: Her living room provides the best of both worlds, with an office at one end and comfortable sofas at the other.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has the best of both worlds, you mean that they have only the benefits of two things and none of the disadvantages.

ext.ext_cn: 除了生了几个孩子，我从未觉得自己这辈子取得了很大成就。
ext.ext_en: I never felt I achieved a great deal in my life, apart from bringing my children into the world.

defs.def_en: If a woman brings a child into the world, she gives birth to it.

ext.ext_cn: 业余制作的录像短片与好莱坞制作精湛的电影作品有天壤之别。
ext.ext_en: There's a world of difference between an amateur video and a slick Hollywood production.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is a world of difference between one thing and another, you are emphasizing that they are very different from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 我决不会错过这个。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't have missed this for the world.

defs.def_en: If you say that you would not do something for the world, you are emphasizing that you definitely would not do it.

defs.def_cn: 让…感觉好很多；对…大有好处

ext.ext_cn: 睡一觉你就会感觉舒服多了。
ext.ext_en: A sleep will do you the world of good.

ext.ext_cn: 肯定为他的事业打开了一片坦途的成熟表演
ext.ext_en: ...a mature performance which must have done his career prospects a world of good.

defs.def_en: If you say that something has done someone the world of good or a world of good, you mean that it has made them feel better or improved their life.

ext.ext_cn: 世上最让人难受的莫过于小婴儿遭到遗弃。
ext.ext_en: The saddest thing in the world is a little baby nobody wants...

ext.ext_cn: 除了她，他再也没有任何亲人。
ext.ext_en: He had no one in the world but her.

defs.def_en: You use in the world to emphasize a statement that you are making.

defs.def_cn: (尤用于强调惊讶或愤怒)究竟，到底

ext.ext_cn: 他究竟在干什么？
ext.ext_en: What in the world is he doing?...

ext.ext_cn: 我挣扎求生的时候，你究竟在哪儿？
ext.ext_en: Where in the world were you when I was struggling for my life?

defs.def_en: You can use in the world in expressions such as what in the world and who in the world to emphasize a question, especially when expressing surprise or anger.

defs.def_cn: 在理想（或完美）的世界中；在理想状况下

ext.ext_cn: 卡伦·史蒂文斯说在理想的生活中，她非常愿意呆在家里照料两岁半的儿子。
ext.ext_en: In an ideal world Karen Stevens says she would love to stay at home with her two-and-half-year old son...

ext.ext_cn: 理想的状况是有足够的设备和财力治疗每一位病人。
ext.ext_en: In a perfect world, there would be the facilities and money to treat every sick person.

defs.def_en: You can use in an ideal world or in a perfect world when you are talking about things that you would like to happen, although you realize that they are not likely to happen.

defs.def_cn: 认为（自己）生来就该享福

ext.ext_cn: 所有的年轻人都必须接受现实，不要自欺欺人，觉得生来就该享清福。
ext.ext_en: All young people must face up to reality and not kid themselves that the world owes them a living.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone thinks that the world owes them a living, you are criticizing them because they think it is their right to have a comfortable life without having to make any effort at all.

defs.def_cn: 阅历丰富的人;见过世面的人；老成稳重的人

ext.ext_cn: 听着，我们都是见过世面的人，真有人会介意吗？
ext.ext_en: Look, we are both men of the world, would anyone really mind?

ext.ext_cn: 优雅、聪明、顽强并且阅历丰富的女人
ext.ext_en: ...an elegant, clever and tough woman of the world.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a man of the world or a woman of the world, you mean that they are experienced and know about the practical or social aspects of life, and are not easily shocked by immoral or dishonest actions.

defs.def_cn: 极好的;一流的；非常棒的

ext.ext_cn: 这些新火车太棒了。
ext.ext_en: These new trains are out of this world.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is out of this world, you are emphasizing that it is extremely good or impressive.

ext.ext_cn: 对很多人来说，这个邮局是与外界联系的唯一纽带。
ext.ext_en: For many, the post office is the only link with the outside world...

ext.ext_cn: 至少在外界看来情况是这样的。
ext.ext_en: This, at least, was the situation as it appeared to the outside world.

defs.def_en: You can use the outside world to refer to all the people who do not live in a particular place or who are not involved in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 有些问题在全世界都一样。
ext.ext_en: Some problems are the same the world over...

ext.ext_cn: 世界各国政府应该对此采取行动。
ext.ext_en: Governments the world over should do something about it.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens or exists the world over, you mean that it happens or exists in every part of the world.

defs.def_cn: 在自己的世界里;在自己的小天地里

ext.ext_cn: 游泳的时候，我沉浸在自己的世界里。
ext.ext_en: When I'm swimming I'm in a world of my own...

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉当时9岁，之前她一直封闭在自己的世界里。
ext.ext_en: Sarah was nine years old and until that moment she had been locked in a world of her own.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in a world of their own, you mean that they seem not to notice other people or the things going on around them.

ext.ext_cn: 我很在乎他，但是某种感觉告诉我这不是爱。
ext.ext_en: I think the world of him, but something tells me it's not love...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的确很亲近，非常在乎对方。
ext.ext_en: We were really close. We thought the world of each other.

defs.def_en: If you think the world of someone, you like them or care about them very much.

defs.def_cn: 发迹/落魄;飞黄腾达/潦倒

ext.ext_cn: 他们开始发家的时候，搬进了伦敦的一所公寓。
ext.ext_en: When they started to go up in the world, they moved to a flat in London.

ext.ext_cn: 出身于落魄的中产阶级家庭的年轻女子
ext.ext_en: ...young women of middle class families which had come down in the world.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has gone up in the world, you mean they have become richer or have a higher social status than before. If you say they have come down in the world, you mean they have become poorer or have a lower social status.

ext.ext_cn: 议会于今天批准了这项政策，但尚未成为法律。
ext.ext_en: Parliament today approved the policy, but it has not yet become law.

defs.def_en: See also:Houses of Parliament;Member of Parliament;The parliament of some countries, for example Britain, is the group of people who make or change its laws, and decide what policies the country should follow.  →see usage note at:parliament

ext.ext_cn: 预计这项法案将在下一届议会中通过。
ext.ext_en: The legislation is expected to be passed in the next parliament.

defs.def_en: A particular parliament is a particular period of time in which a parliament is doing its work, between two elections or between two periods of holiday.

defs.def_cn: 讲故事的人;说书人;小说作家

ext.ext_cn: 他是首位将凯尔特说书人讲的故事记载下来的人。
ext.ext_en: He was the one who first set down the stories of the Celtic storytellers.

defs.def_en: A storyteller is someone who tells or writes stories.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 合法的；依法的；法律认可的

ext.ext_cn: 法国政府对海地政变表示谴责，并要求恢复合法政府的地位。
ext.ext_en: The French government has condemned the coup in Haiti and has demanded the restoration of the legitimate government...

ext.ext_cn: 政府无意干扰被告的合法经营活动。
ext.ext_en: The government will not seek to disrupt the legitimate business activities of the defendant.

defs.def_en: Something that is legitimate is acceptable according to the law.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 合情理的；有道理的；正当的

ext.ext_cn: 怀有这种恐惧完全在情理之中。
ext.ext_en: That's a perfectly legitimate fear...

ext.ext_cn: 《纽约时报》有理由称自己是一份全国性报纸。
ext.ext_en: The New York Times has a legitimate claim to be a national newspaper.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a feeling or claim is legitimate, you think that it is reasonable and justified.

ext.ext_cn: 我们结婚纯粹是为了给孩子一个合法身份。
ext.ext_en: We only married in order that the child should be legitimate.

defs.def_en: A legitimate child is one whose parents were married before he or she was born.

ext.ext_cn: 我们希望通过立法来使这一程序合法化。
ext.ext_en: We want to legitimate this process by passing a law.

defs.def_en: To legitimate something means the same as to legitimize it.

ext.ext_cn: 她从来没有透露过有什么不妥。
ext.ext_en: She never let on that anything was wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 我没有将谈话内容向员工们透露。
ext.ext_en: I didn't let on to the staff what my conversation was...

defs.def_en: If you do not let on that something is true, you do not tell anyone that it is true, and you keep it a secret.

defs.def_cn: (尤指游泳、摔跤、滑雪等体育竞赛)自由式的

ext.ext_cn: 100 米自由泳比赛
ext.ext_en: ...the 100m freestyle swimming event.

ext.ext_cn: 本届欧洲自由式冠军
ext.ext_en: ...the reigning European Freestyle Champion.

defs.def_en: Freestyle is used to describe sports competitions, especially in swimming, wrestling, and skiing, in which competitors can use any style or method that they like when they take part.

defs.def_cn: 背着(配偶、性伴侣)乱搞;对(配偶、性伴侣)不忠

ext.ext_cn: 发觉菲利普对我不忠后，我又气愤又伤心。
ext.ext_en: I'd found Philippe was cheating on me and I was angry and hurt.

defs.def_en: If someone cheats on their husband, wife, or partner, they have a sexual relationship with another person.

defs.def_cn: 违背，违反(约定);逃避(纳税)

ext.ext_cn: 他们的工作就是进行检查，确保所有签约国遵守协议。
ext.ext_en: Their job is to check that none of the signatory countries is cheating on the agreement.

defs.def_en: If someone cheats on something such as an agreement or their taxes, they do not do what they should do under a set of rules.
A hangman is a man whose job is to execute people by hanging them.

ext.ext_cn: 扎辫子的小女孩
ext.ext_en: ...a little girl with pigtails.

defs.def_en: If someone has a pigtail or pigtails, their hair is plaited or braided into one or two lengths.

ext.ext_cn: 他一脚漂亮的凌空抽射，把球踢进了球门的远角。
ext.ext_en: He volleyed the ball spectacularly into the far corner of the net...

ext.ext_cn: 在第二局中，麦克尼尔对球的截击更加成功。
ext.ext_en: McNeil volleyed more effectively in the second set.

defs.def_en: In sport, if someone volleys the ball, they hit it before it touches the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 现在还不知道有多少人在枪林弹雨中身亡。
ext.ext_en: It's  still not known how many died in the volleys of gunfire...

ext.ext_cn: 枪炮一起开火后，3名军官骑着马冲进战场。
ext.ext_en: Three mounted officers rode into the field after the volley.

defs.def_en: A volley of gunfire is a lot of bullets that travel through the air at the same time.

defs.def_cn: 无核小果，浆果(如草莓、醋栗等)
defs.def_en: Soft fruits are small fruits with soft skins, such as strawberries and currants.

ext.ext_cn: 他们拒绝把公寓租给未婚情侣。
ext.ext_en: They refused to rent an apartment to an unmarried couple.

defs.def_en: Someone who is unmarried is not married.

ext.ext_cn: 她免受性别歧视法的追究。
ext.ext_en: She is exempt from sex discrimination laws.

ext.ext_cn: 对移民的歧视
ext.ext_en: ...discrimination against immigrants.

defs.def_en: Discrimination is the practice of treating one person or group of people less fairly or less well than other people or groups.

ext.ext_cn: 他们烹调手艺不高，也不挑食。
ext.ext_en: They cooked without skill and ate without discrimination.

defs.def_en: Discrimination is knowing what is good or of high quality.

ext.ext_cn: 辨色能力
ext.ext_en: ...colour discrimination.

ext.ext_cn: 可以让母羊辨别她自己的小羊和外来羊羔的系统
ext.ext_en: ...the system that allows a mother to make the discrimination between her own and alien lambs.

defs.def_en: Discrimination is the ability to recognize and understand the differences between two things.

ext.ext_cn: 柱子完全腐烂以后换了新的。
ext.ext_en: The pillars rotted away and were replaced.

defs.def_en: When something rots away, it decays until it falls to pieces or none of it remains.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 现在亟需食物和水。
ext.ext_en: There is an urgent need for food and water...

ext.ext_cn: 他在纽约有急事。
ext.ext_en: He had urgent business in New York.

defs.def_en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的嗓音低沉而急切。
ext.ext_en: His voice was low and urgent...

ext.ext_cn: 他母亲身子前倾，小声而急切地跟他说话。
ext.ext_en: His mother leaned forward and spoke to him in urgent undertones.

defs.def_en: If you speak in an urgent way, you show that you are anxious for people to notice something or to do something.

defs.def_cn: (用于击碎岩石和混凝土的)大锤
defs.def_en: A sledgehammer is a large, heavy hammer with a long handle, used for breaking up rocks and concrete.
If you say that someone is using a sledgehammer to crack a nut, you mean that they are using stronger measures than are really necessary to solve a problem.

ext.ext_cn: 用在小型便携式计算机上的最新光盘转速为每分钟 3,600 转。
ext.ext_en: The latest discs, used for small portable computers, spin 3600 times a minute...

ext.ext_cn: 地球绕着地轴自转。
ext.ext_en: The Earth spins on its own axis...

defs.def_en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

defs.def_cn: (用甩干机或洗衣机)甩干（衣服），给…脱水

ext.ext_cn: 只需要将洗好的衣物脱水，它就差不多干了。
ext.ext_en: Just spin the washing and it's nearly dry.

ext.ext_cn: 设定用凉水洗衣，最后短时脱水。
ext.ext_en: Set on a cool wash and finish with a short spin.

defs.def_en: When you spin washing, it is turned round and round quickly in a spin drier or a washing machine to get the water out.

ext.ext_cn: 我喝了葡萄酒后晕乎乎的。
ext.ext_en: My head was spinning from the wine...

ext.ext_cn: 那么多数字把我搞得头昏脑胀。
ext.ext_en: All those figures make my poor head spin.

defs.def_en: If your head is spinning, you feel unsteady or confused, for example because you are drunk, ill, or excited.

defs.def_cn: 带倾向性的解释(或说法)

ext.ext_cn: 他把这次投票解释为对宪法的支持，这也是他的支持者对今天的投票结果所作的解释。
ext.ext_en: He interpreted the vote as support for the constitution and that is the spin his supporters are putting on the results today.

ext.ext_cn: 报道中带有的根本不恰当的政治倾向，特别是《纽约时报》的报道
ext.ext_en: ...the wholly improper political spin given to the report, particularly by The New York Times.

defs.def_en: See also:spin doctor;If someone puts a certain spin on an event or situation, they interpret it and try to present it in a particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 公众厌烦了那些有倾向性的报道和种种许诺。该是用政绩说话的时候了。
ext.ext_en: The public is sick of spin and tired of promises. It's time for politicians to act.

defs.def_en: In politics, spin is the way in which political parties try to present everything they do in a positive way to the public and the media.
If you go for a spin or take a car for a spin, you make a short journey in a car just to enjoy yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 他很惊讶，也很生气，因为她编的故事太真实了，甚至不能被斥为一个简单的谎言。
ext.ext_en: He was surprised, and annoyed that she had spun a story which was too good to be condemned as a simple lie.

defs.def_en: If someone spins a story, they give you an account of something that is untrue or only partly true.

ext.ext_cn: 米歇尔也会按顾客的要求为其纺羊毛呢，每盎司收费 2.25 美元。
ext.ext_en: Michelle will also spin a customer's wool fleece to specification at a cost of $2.25 an ounce.

defs.def_en: When people spin, they make thread by twisting together pieces of a fibre such as wool or cotton using a device or machine.

defs.def_cn: (飞机的)螺旋式急遽下坠，向下旋冲
defs.def_en: If a plane goes into a spin, it falls very rapidly towards the ground in a spiral movement.

defs.def_cn: (网球或板球运动中球的）快速旋转，旋转运动
defs.def_en: In a game such as tennis or cricket, if you put spin on a ball, you deliberately make it spin rapidly when you hit it or throw it.

ext.ext_cn: 可怜的简对这次聚会真有些不知所措。
ext.ext_en: Poor Jane was in rather a spin about the party.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in a spin or in a flat spin, you mean that they are confused and unable to act sensibly because of something that has happened.

defs.def_cn: (每一套公寓归居住者所有的)公寓楼
defs.def_en: A condominium is an apartment building in which each apartment is owned by the person who lives there.
A condominium is one of the privately owned apartments in a condominium.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 勤奋的;勤勉的;孜孜不倦的;细致彻底的

ext.ext_cn: 迈耶斯是个勤奋多产的工人。
ext.ext_en: Meyers is a diligent and prolific worker...

ext.ext_cn: 该项历史研究非常地认真、彻底。
ext.ext_en: The historical research was impressively diligent.

defs.def_en: Someone who is diligent works hard in a careful and thorough way.

ext.ext_cn: 我们女性拥有很多出色的商业技巧，只是我们往往会看轻自己。
ext.ext_en: We women have a lot of good business skills, although we tend to underrate ourselves...

ext.ext_cn: 他低估了威廉头部伤势的严重性。
ext.ext_en: He underrated the seriousness of William's head injury.

defs.def_en: If you underrate someone or something, you do not recognize how clever, important, or significant they are.

ext.ext_cn: 他去后台跟她要了签名。
ext.ext_en: He went backstage and asked for her autograph...

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人都挤在演员入口处索要签名。
ext.ext_en: Young autograph hunters clustered around the players' entrance.

defs.def_en: An autograph is the signature of someone famous which is specially written for a fan to keep.

ext.ext_cn: 我在自己的一本书上签了名。
ext.ext_en: I autographed a copy of one of my books.

ext.ext_cn: 克拉克·盖博的签名照片
ext.ext_en: ...an autographed photo of Clark Gable.

defs.def_en: If someone famous autographs something, they put their signature on it.

ext.ext_cn: 在实验室用老鼠进行的实验证明了这一点。
ext.ext_en: This was demonstrated in a laboratory experiment with rats.

ext.ext_cn: 鼠灾泛滥的废弃建筑
ext.ext_en: ...a rat-infested derelict building.

defs.def_en: A rat is an animal which has a long tail and looks like a large mouse.

defs.def_cn: 卑劣的人；不忠实的人；小人

ext.ext_cn: 你是怎么处理从那个叫特纳的小叛徒手里得到的枪的？
ext.ext_en: What did you do with the gun you took from that little rat Turner?

defs.def_en: If you call someone a rat, you mean that you are angry with them or dislike them, often because they have cheated you or betrayed you.

ext.ext_cn: 他们被指控唆使儿童告发自己的父母。
ext.ext_en: They were accused of encouraging children to rat on their parents.

defs.def_en: If someone rats on you, they tell someone in authority about things that you have done, especially bad things.

ext.ext_cn: 她声称他违反了他们的离婚协议。
ext.ext_en: She claims he ratted on their divorce settlement.

defs.def_en: If someone rats on an agreement, they do not do what they said they would do.

defs.def_cn: 怀疑有问题；发现不对头；有所警觉

ext.ext_cn: 如果我不寄出照片，他将有所察觉。
ext.ext_en: If I don't send a picture, he will smell a rat...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管劳埃德·乔治的行为古怪，黑格仍然没有任何怀疑。
ext.ext_en: Though Lloyd George's behaviour seemed curious, Haig still did not smell a rat.

defs.def_en: If you smell a rat, you begin to suspect or realize that something is wrong in a particular situation, for example that someone is trying to deceive you or harm you.

ext.ext_cn: 谢谢你，亲爱的。
ext.ext_en: Thank you, darling...

ext.ext_cn: 啊，宝贝儿，我爱你。
ext.ext_en: Oh darling, I love you.

defs.def_en: You call someone darling if you love them or like them very much.

defs.def_cn: (英国一些地方用于表示友善的称呼）亲爱的
defs.def_en: In some parts of Britain, people call other people darling as a sign of friendliness.

ext.ext_cn: 生一个可爱的男孩是我能想到的最好的礼物。
ext.ext_en: To have a darling baby boy was the greatest gift I could imagine...

ext.ext_cn: 多么令人着迷的一部电影啊——所有人都非常喜欢。
ext.ext_en: What a darling film — everyone adored it.

defs.def_en: Some people use darling to describe someone or something that they love or like very much.

ext.ext_cn: 他真是个可爱的人。
ext.ext_en: He's such a darling.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a darling, you are fond of them and think that they are nice.

ext.ext_cn: 罗杰尼希是一个富有家庭的宠儿。
ext.ext_en: Rajneesh was the darling of a prosperous family.

defs.def_en: The darling of a group of people is someone who is especially liked by that group.

ext.ext_cn: 不管是谁干的这事，早晚要被抓住并受到惩罚。
ext.ext_en: Whoever did this will sooner or later be caught and will be punished...

ext.ext_cn: 不管是谁赢得了大选，都将面临恢复经济的严峻任务。
ext.ext_en: Whoever wins the election is going to have a tough job getting the economy back on its feet...

defs.def_en: You use whoever to refer to someone when their identity is not yet known.

defs.def_cn: (指与人的身份无关)无论是谁

ext.ext_cn: 你想要谁来拜访你都可以。
ext.ext_en: You can have whoever you like to visit you...

ext.ext_cn: 进入这个地区的人，不管是谁，都有被劫为人质的危险。
ext.ext_en: Everybody who goes into this region, whoever they are, is at risk of being taken hostage.

defs.def_en: You use whoever to indicate that the actual identity of the person who does something will not affect a situation.

defs.def_cn: (用在疑问句中代替who作为强调，通常表示惊讶)究竟是谁

ext.ext_cn: 到底是谁想出的这个笑话？
ext.ext_en: Whoever thought up that joke?...

ext.ext_cn: 荒唐！究竟是谁提出了这样的建议？
ext.ext_en: Ridiculous! Whoever suggested such a thing?

defs.def_en: You use whoever in questions as an emphatic way of saying 'who', usually when you are surprised about something.

defs.def_cn: (表示不确定)或是别的什么人（或组织）

ext.ext_cn: 我们并不仅仅是某个像美孚、IBM或别的什么公司一样的大公司。
ext.ext_en: We're not just some big business like Mobil or IBM or whoever...

ext.ext_cn: 无论是警方还是其他什么人都不会想到来这里找他。
ext.ext_en: The police, or whoever, would not think of looking for him here.

defs.def_en: You say or whoever to refer vaguely to another person or organization, especially when you are not sure if you have mentioned the right person or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 酒后驾车死亡人数在过去 10 年中下降了 10%以上。
ext.ext_en: Drunk driving fatalities have declined more than 10 percent over the past 10 years.

defs.def_en: A fatality is a death caused by an accident or by violence.

ext.ext_cn: 怀着宿命感
ext.ext_en: ...with a feeling of fatality.

defs.def_en: Fatality is the feeling or belief that human beings cannot influence or control events.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 该镇坐落在陡峭险峻的悬崖边上。
ext.ext_en: The town is perched on the edge of a steep, precipitous cliff.

defs.def_en: A precipitous slope or drop is very steep and often dangerous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 股票市场的猛跌吓坏了国外投资者。
ext.ext_en: The stock market's precipitous drop frightened foreign investors...

ext.ext_cn: 梅里尔的健康状况开始急剧下降。
ext.ext_en: Meryl's health started a precipitous decline.

defs.def_en: A precipitous change is sudden and unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 轻率的决定
ext.ext_en: ...a precipitous decision.

defs.def_en: A precipitous action happens very quickly and often without being planned.

ext.ext_cn: 一些小技术故障解决后，演出终于开始了。
ext.ext_en: After some technical hitches the show finally got under way...

ext.ext_cn: 5小时的手术进行得非常顺利。
ext.ext_en: The five-hour operation went without a hitch.

defs.def_en: A hitch is a slight problem or difficulty which causes a short delay.

ext.ext_cn: 放眼望去看不到修车厂，所以我就搭顺风车进了城。
ext.ext_en: There was no garage in sight, so I hitched a lift into town...

ext.ext_cn: 让－菲利普在20世纪60年代曾搭便车游遍欧洲。
ext.ext_en: Jean-Phillippe had hitched all over Europe in the 1960s.

defs.def_en: If you hitch ,hitch a lift, or hitch a ride, you hitchhike.

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚我们套上马车，拉着东西搬到了这里。
ext.ext_en: Last night we hitched the horse to the cart and moved here.

defs.def_en: If you hitch something to something else, you hook it or fasten it there.

ext.ext_cn: 报告显示，结婚的人数呈下降趋势。
ext.ext_en: The report shows that fewer couples are getting hitched.

defs.def_en: If you get hitched, you get married.

ext.ext_cn: 鼻腔喷剂或滴剂能减轻症状，但请勿使用过频，否则鼻塞可能会加重。
ext.ext_en: A nasal spray or drops would ease your symptoms, but don't overuse them or further congestion could result...

ext.ext_cn: 不要过多地使用电热器具弄头发。
ext.ext_en: Don't overuse heated appliances on you hair.

defs.def_en: If someone overuses something, they use more of it than necessary, or use it more often than necessary.

defs.def_cn: 滥用（词语等）；使成为陈词滥调

ext.ext_cn: 你最为常用的词或词组有哪些？
ext.ext_en: Which words or phrases do you most overuse?

defs.def_en: If you say that people overuse a word or idea, you mean that they use it so often that it no longer has any real meaning or effect.

ext.ext_cn: 奥斯本子爵和子爵夫人
ext.ext_en: ...Viscount and Viscountess Osborne.

defs.def_en: A viscountess is the wife of a viscount or a woman who holds the same position as a viscount.

ext.ext_cn: 这全是他的错，这是无法回避的事实。
ext.ext_en: There was no escaping the fact: it was all his fault...

ext.ext_cn: 一些借款人会发现，他们还款遇到了麻烦，但根本不是由于自身的过失造成的。
ext.ext_en: A few borrowers will find themselves in trouble with their repayments through no fault of their own.

defs.def_en: If a bad or undesirable situation is your fault, you caused it or are responsible for it.

ext.ext_cn: 以为在商学院能学会如何管理人是一大错误。
ext.ext_en: It is a big fault to think that you can learn how to manage people in business school.

defs.def_en: A fault is a mistake in what someone is doing or in what they have done.

ext.ext_cn: 他的彬彬有礼总是使她对他的缺点视而不见。
ext.ext_en: His manners had always made her blind to his faults.

ext.ext_cn: 一个技术上的小故障引起的短暂延误
ext.ext_en: ...a short delay due to a minor technical fault...

defs.def_en: A fault in someone or something is a weakness in them or something that is not perfect.

ext.ext_cn: 你不能因为他们缺乏创新就指责他们。
ext.ext_en: You can't fault them for lack of invention...

ext.ext_cn: 他经营自己公司的方式无可指摘。
ext.ext_en: It is hard to fault the way he runs his own operation.

defs.def_en: If you cannot fault someone, you cannot find any reason for criticizing them or the things that they are doing.

ext.ext_cn: 圣安德烈亚斯断层
ext.ext_en: ...the San Andreas Fault.

defs.def_en: A fault is a large crack in the surface of the earth.
A fault in tennis is a service that is wrong according to the rules.

ext.ext_cn: 他怎么也无法承认是他的错。
ext.ext_en: He could never accept that he had been at fault...

ext.ext_cn: 没有迹象表明例行的保安措施存在问题。
ext.ext_en: There are no indications that standard security arrangements were at fault.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is at fault, they are to blame or are responsible for a particular situation that has gone wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 每当厨师挑剔我干的活儿时，我都非常沮丧。
ext.ext_en: I was disappointed whenever the cook found fault with my work.

defs.def_en: If you find fault with something or someone, you look for mistakes and complain about them.

ext.ext_cn: 杰斐逊大方得过了头。
ext.ext_en: Jefferson was generous to a fault...

ext.ext_cn: 别人会告诉你她有趣、聪明又热情，谦逊得过了头。
ext.ext_en: Others will tell you that she is modest to a fault, funny, clever and warm.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a particular good quality to a fault, you are emphasizing that they have more of this quality than is usual or necessary.

ext.ext_cn: 皮特狼吞虎咽，把炖牛肉吃了个精光。
ext.ext_en: Pete gobbled all the beef stew.

ext.ext_cn: 河里有吃人的危险动物。
ext.ext_en: There were dangerous beasts in the river that might gobble you up.

defs.def_en: If you gobble food, you eat it quickly and greedily.

defs.def_cn: 过气的人物;风光不再的人

ext.ext_cn: 将观点强加给我们的所谓专家和各式过气人物
ext.ext_en: ...the so-called experts and various has-beens who foist opinions on us.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a has-been, you are indicating in an unkind way that they were important or respected in the past, but they are not now.

defs.def_cn: 被迫的;强迫的;非自愿的

ext.ext_cn: 可可种植园中曾实行强迫劳役制。
ext.ext_en: A system of forced labour was used on the cocoa plantations.

defs.def_en: A forced action is something that you do because someone else makes you do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他迫降在了公路上。
ext.ext_en: He made a forced landing on a highway.

defs.def_en: A forced action is something that you do because circumstances make it necessary.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 强挤出来的微笑
ext.ext_en: ...a forced smile...

ext.ext_cn: 她称他为亲爱的。听起来很不自然。
ext.ext_en: She called him darling. It sounded so forced.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as forced, you mean it does not happen naturally and easily.

ext.ext_cn: 完全用桃红色和象牙白装饰的浪漫塔楼套房
ext.ext_en: ...the romantic Tower Suite, decorated throughout in peach and ivory.

ext.ext_cn: 桃红色的丝绸上衣
ext.ext_en: ...a peach silk blouse.

defs.def_en: Something that is peach is pale pinky-orange in colour.

defs.def_cn: 极可爱的人（或事物）；非常迷人的人（或事物）

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰克在那儿，他是个非常可爱的人。
ext.ext_en: Frank was there and he is a perfect peach.

ext.ext_cn: 比尔兹利的绝妙进球
ext.ext_en: ...a peach of a goal from Beardsley.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as a peach, you find them very pleasing or attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 药品可以用不同的商标在欧盟各国出售。
ext.ext_en: Drugs can be sold under different brand names throughout the EU...

ext.ext_cn: 说到软饮料，可口可乐在英国是最大的畅销品牌。
ext.ext_en: When it comes to soft drinks Coca-Cola is the biggest selling brand name in Britain.

defs.def_en: The brand name of a product is the name the manufacturer gives it and under which it is sold.

defs.def_cn: 派莱克斯耐热玻璃（用于制作碗和盘子等，用其烹饪时不会破碎）
defs.def_en: Pyrex is a type of strong glass which is used for making bowls and dishes that do not break when you cook things in them.
Goldfish are small gold or orange fish which are often kept as pets.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我与密友们讨论是否我要马上生孩子。
ext.ext_en: I discussed with my intimate friends whether I would immediately have a baby.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的婚礼将在秋季举行,这对情侣的一位密友透露说。
ext.ext_en: They are to have an autumn wedding, an intimate of the couple confides.

defs.def_en: If you have an intimate friendship with someone, you know them very well and like them a lot.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有恋爱关系的;有性关系的

ext.ext_cn: 我就是不想讨论我的恋爱关系。
ext.ext_en: I just won't discuss my intimate relationships.

ext.ext_cn: 她们与男友共浴爱河的时刻
ext.ext_en: ...their intimate moments with their boyfriends.

defs.def_en: If two people are in an intimate relationship, they are involved with each other in a loving or sexual way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他写到了关于他家庭生活的一些不为人知的细节。
ext.ext_en: He wrote about the intimate details of his family life...

ext.ext_cn: 我实在不愿打断你们的私人谈话,但是我们确实有事要谈。
ext.ext_en: I hate to interrupt your intimate conversation but we do have an assignment to discuss.

defs.def_en: An intimate conversation or detail, for example, is very personal and private.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 温馨的二人烛光晚餐
ext.ext_en: ...an intimate candlelit dinner for two.

defs.def_en: If you use intimate to describe an occasion or the atmosphere of a place, you like it because it is quiet and pleasant, and seems suitable for close conversations between friends.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 疯狂与智慧的密切关联
ext.ext_en: ...an intimate connection between madness and wisdom...

ext.ext_cn: 法国与其前非洲属地一直保持着最密切的联系。
ext.ext_en: France has kept the most intimate links with its former African territories.

defs.def_en: An intimate connection between ideas or organizations, for example, is a very strong link between them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对克尔恺郭尔与叔本华的深刻了解让我很吃惊。
ext.ext_en: He surprised me with his intimate knowledge of Kierkegaard and Schopenhauer.

defs.def_en: An intimate knowledge of something is a deep and detailed knowledge of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他继续暗示他确实在考虑对公司进行一次大改组。
ext.ext_en: He went on to intimate that he was indeed contemplating a shake-up of the company...

ext.ext_cn: 他已经向法国人和俄国人暗示他愿意达成协议。
ext.ext_en: He had intimated to the French and Russians his readiness to come to a settlement.

defs.def_en: You use where after certain words, especially verbs and adjectives, to introduce a clause in which you mention a situation, a stage in something, or an aspect of something.

defs.def_cn: (尤指令人不快的事意外发生造成的)惊骇，恐惧

defs.def_en: Fright is a sudden feeling of fear, especially the fear that you feel when something unpleasant surprises you.

ext.ext_en: The snake picked up its head and stuck out its tongue which gave everyone a fright...

ext.ext_en: The last time you had a real fright, you nearly crashed the car.

defs.def_en: A fright is an experience which makes you suddenly afraid.

ext.ext_en: When costs soared, the studio took fright and recalled the company from Rome.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...a bilious shade of green.

defs.def_en: If someone describes the appearance of something as bilious, they mean that they think it looks unpleasant and rather disgusting.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 暴躁的；狂怒的；脾气坏的

ext.ext_en: His speech was a bilious, rancorous attack on young people.

defs.def_en: Bilious is sometimes used to describe the feelings or behaviour of someone who is extremely angry or bad-tempered.

ext.ext_en: The premiere on Monday is sold out.

defs.def_en: If a performance, sports event, or other entertainment is sold out, all the tickets for it have been sold.

ext.ext_cn: 有时商店里的某些杂货会有脱销的现象。
ext.ext_en: The stores are sometimes sold out of certain groceries.

defs.def_en: See also:sell out;If a shop is sold out of something, it has sold all of it that it had.

ext.ext_cn: 一转眼他就不见了。
ext.ext_en: In a moment he was gone...

ext.ext_en: She stared at him a moment, then turned away...

defs.def_en: You can refer to a very short period of time, for example a few seconds, as a moment or moments .

ext.ext_cn: 就在这时，一辆轿车在房前停下了。
ext.ext_en: At this moment a car stopped at the house...

ext.ext_cn: 很多人仍然记得听到肯尼迪总统遇刺的那一刻。
ext.ext_en: Many people still remember the moment when they heard that President Kennedy had been assassinated.

defs.def_en: A particular moment is the point in time at which something happens.

ext.ext_cn: 他们冒着随时会中弹的危险。
ext.ext_en: They ran the risk of being shot at any moment...

ext.ext_cn: 他马上就会来这儿看你。
ext.ext_en: He'll be here to see you any moment now.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will or may happen at any moment or any moment now, you are emphasizing that it is likely to happen very soon.

ext.ext_cn: 此刻没人跟我说话。
ext.ext_en: At the moment, no one is talking to me...

ext.ext_cn: 目前这件事正在计划中。
ext.ext_en: This is being planned at the present moment...

defs.def_en: You use expressions such as at the moment ,at this moment, and at the present moment to indicate that a particular situation exists at the time when you are speaking.

ext.ext_cn: 我从来没想过将来会离婚。
ext.ext_en: I don't for a moment think there'll be a divorce.

defs.def_en: If you say that you do not believe for a moment or for one moment that something is true, you are emphasizing that you do not believe that it could possibly be true.

ext.ext_cn: 不过目前政府对此还乐于容忍。
ext.ext_en: For the moment, however, the government is happy to live with it.

defs.def_en: You use for the moment to indicate that something is true now, even if it will not be true in the future.

defs.def_cn: 有成功(或得意)的时刻；有吸引人的时刻

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影有其吸引人之处。
ext.ext_en: The film has its moments...

ext.ext_en: He's not the thoroughly outgoing character you'd predict, although he has his moments.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has their moments, you are indicating that there are times when they are successful or interesting, but that this does not happen very often.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在最后一刻改变主意，决定不去了。
ext.ext_en: They changed their minds at the last moment and refused to go.

defs.def_en: If someone does something at the last moment, they do it at the latest time possible.

defs.def_cn: 下一刻，一会儿，紧接着（尤指突然发生很大变化）

ext.ext_cn: 接着发生了剧烈的撞击。
ext.ext_en: The next moment there was an almighty crash...

ext.ext_cn: 他喜怒无常，一会儿哭，一会儿笑。
ext.ext_en: He is unpredictable, weeping one moment, laughing the next.

defs.def_en: You use the expression the next moment, or expressions such as 'one moment he was there, the next he was gone', to emphasize that something happens suddenly, especially when it is very different from what was happening before.

ext.ext_cn: 他现在很红，不是吗？
ext.ext_en: He's the man of the moment, isn't he?

ext.ext_en: He calls it a 'contraption', using his favourite word of the moment.

defs.def_en: You use of the moment to describe someone or something that is or was especially popular at a particular time, especially when you want to suggest that their popularity is unlikely to last long or did not last long.

ext.ext_cn: 我闭上眼睛就睡着了。
ext.ext_en: The moment I closed my eyes, I fell asleep.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens the moment something else happens, you are emphasizing that it happens immediately after the other thing.
