defs.def_en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (颜色)柔和的;(味道)鲜美的，清淡可口的;（气味）清香的

ext.ext_cn: 嫩菜豆口感细腻，味道清香、淡雅。
ext.ext_en: Young haricot beans have a tender texture and a delicate, subtle flavour...

ext.ext_cn: 这些颜色柔和且闪烁微光。
ext.ext_en: The colours are delicate and shimmering.

defs.def_en: Something that is delicate has a colour, taste, or smell which is pleasant and not strong or intense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 珊瑚虽然看上去坚固，实际上非常易碎。
ext.ext_en: Although the coral looks hard, it is very delicate.

ext.ext_cn: 适合洗涤各种织物的洗衣机——即使是最易损的也没问题
ext.ext_en: ...a washing machine catering for every fabric — even the most delicate.

defs.def_en: If something is delicate, it is easy to harm, damage, or break, and needs to be handled or treated carefully.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她身体孱弱，心理上也不够稳定。
ext.ext_en: She was physically delicate and psychologically unstable.

defs.def_en: Someone who is delicate is not healthy and strong, and becomes ill easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 微妙的;棘手的;需要小心处理的

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲成员国害怕会打乱各政治利益集团间的微妙平衡。
ext.ext_en: The European members are afraid of upsetting the delicate balance of political interests...

ext.ext_cn: 这本敏感的书谨慎、简洁地讨论了收养这一微妙问题。
ext.ext_en: This sensitive book tackles the delicate issue of adoption with care and simplicity...

defs.def_en: You use delicate to describe a situation, problem, matter, or discussion that needs to be dealt with carefully and sensitively in order to avoid upsetting things or offending people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 技巧性很强的;注重细节的

ext.ext_cn: 在佛罗伦萨一家医院里进行的一场耗时长、难度高的手术
ext.ext_en: ...a long and delicate operation carried out at a hospital in Florence...

ext.ext_cn: 每一个动作都必须小心、准确，一点点地移动。
ext.ext_en: Each motion must be delicate and precise, involving tiny movements.

defs.def_en: A delicate task, movement, action, or product needs or shows great skill and attention to detail.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们消耗很多能量，可能比成年人需要更多高能量的食物。
ext.ext_en: Children expend a lot of energy and may need more high-energy food than adults.

defs.def_en: To expend something, especially energy, time, or money, means to use it or spend it.

ext.ext_cn: 我相信自己死后会升入天堂，见到上帝。
ext.ext_en: I believed that when I died I would go to heaven and see God.

defs.def_en: In some religions, heaven is said to be the place where God lives, where good people go when they die, and where everyone is always happy. It is usually imagined as being high up in the sky.

defs.def_cn: 极乐（之地）；天堂般美好（的世界）

ext.ext_cn: 我们去了威尔士和爱尔兰旅游。那里真是人间仙境。
ext.ext_en: We went touring in Wales and Ireland. It was heaven...

ext.ext_cn: 我简直是到了观影者的天堂。
ext.ext_en: I was in cinematic heaven.

defs.def_en: You can use heaven to refer to a place or situation that you like very much.

ext.ext_cn: 他走出去站在大路中间，抬头仰望着天空。
ext.ext_en: He walked out into the middle of the road, looking up at the heavens.

ext.ext_cn: 详细的星空图
ext.ext_en: ...a detailed map of the heavens.

defs.def_en: The heavens are the sky.

defs.def_cn: 但愿不会这样;千万不要这样;苍天不容;老天不许

ext.ext_cn: 但愿他不会因为我而离开！
ext.ext_en: Heaven forbid that he should leave because of me!

defs.def_en: You say 'Heaven forbid!' to emphasize that you very much hope that something will not happen.

ext.ext_cn: 天哪！这下我明白了！
ext.ext_en: Good Heavens! That explains a lot!...

ext.ext_cn: “我以为你会带来的。”——“天哪，不会吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'I thought you were bringing it.'  — 'Heavens, no.'

defs.def_en: You say 'Good heavens!' or 'Heavens!' to express surprise or to emphasize that you agree or disagree with someone.

defs.def_cn: …只有靠天帮忙了;谁也帮不了…了

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们的领导人认为这是合情合理的，那么谁也帮不了我们了。
ext.ext_en: If this makes sense to our leaders, then heaven help us all...

ext.ext_cn: 谁要娶了她就只有靠老天保佑了。
ext.ext_en: Heaven help the man she marries.

defs.def_en: You say 'Heaven help someone' when you are worried that something bad is going to happen to them, often because you disapprove of what they are doing or the way they are behaving.

ext.ext_cn: 天知道他们在里面放了些什么。
ext.ext_en: Heaven knows what they put in it.

defs.def_en: You can say 'Heaven knows' to emphasize that you do not know something, or that you find something very surprising.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的钱够多了。
ext.ext_en: Heaven knows they have enough money...

ext.ext_cn: 这为我赢得了一点思考的时间，而我确实非常需要它。
ext.ext_en: This gained me some thinking time, and heaven knows I needed it.

defs.def_en: You can say 'Heaven knows' to emphasize something that you feel or believe very strongly.

defs.def_cn: 想尽一切办法;竭尽全力;千方百计

ext.ext_cn: 可能的话，他们会千方百计地阻止我。
ext.ext_en: They would move heaven and earth to stop me if they could.

defs.def_en: If you move heaven and earth to do something, you try as hard as you can to do it.

defs.def_cn: （用于以 what、when、who、why 及 how 开头的疑问句中表示强调）到底，究竟

ext.ext_cn: 她到底在哪儿？
ext.ext_en: Where in heaven's name was she?

defs.def_en: You can use in heaven's name in questions beginning with 'what', 'when', 'who', 'why' and 'how' to add emphasis in a way that shows that you are very angry or surprised.

ext.ext_cn: 比赛刚刚开始就突然下起倾盆大雨，所以只好暂停了。
ext.ext_en: The match had just begun when the heavens opened and play was suspended.

defs.def_en: If the heavens open, it suddenly starts raining very heavily.

ext.ext_cn: 我们继续向河流的上游漂流。
ext.ext_en: We proceeded to drift on up the river...

ext.ext_cn: 不断上升的气球静静地飘过乡间。
ext.ext_en: The climbing balloon drifted silently over the countryside...

defs.def_en: When something drifts somewhere, it is carried there by the movement of wind or water.

defs.def_cn: 无意间进入;不知不觉陷入

ext.ext_cn: 我们需要给那些无意间犯了罪的年轻人灌输另一套价值观。
ext.ext_en: We need to offer young people drifting into crime an alternative set of values...

ext.ext_cn: 她和她丈夫渐行渐远,最后他们离婚了。
ext.ext_en: She and her husband drifted apart and, eventually, they divorced...

defs.def_en: If someone or something drifts into a situation, they get into that situation in a way that is not planned or controlled.

ext.ext_cn: 你一直在无目的地更换工作，从未真正投入进去。
ext.ext_en: You've been drifting from job to job without any real commitment.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone drifts around, you mean that they travel from place to place without a plan or settled way of life.

defs.def_cn: 移动;动向;趋势;逐渐变化

ext.ext_cn: 涌向城市的趋势
ext.ext_en: ...the drift towards the cities.

defs.def_en: A drift is a movement away from somewhere or something, or a movement towards somewhere or something different.

ext.ext_cn: 由于农村的工厂纷纷裁员,人们逐渐流向城市。
ext.ext_en: As rural factories shed labour, people drift towards the cities.

defs.def_en: To drift somewhere means to move there slowly or gradually.

ext.ext_cn: 清凉的夏日舞曲的声音从室内音响中传了出来。
ext.ext_en: Cool summer dance sounds are drifting from the stereo indoors.

defs.def_en: If sounds drift somewhere, they can be heard but they are not very loud.

ext.ext_cn: 除了吹得堆积起来的地方,雪只有小腿肚深。
ext.ext_en: The snow, except where it drifted, was only calf-deep...

ext.ext_cn: 暴风雪造成了严重的积雪现象。
ext.ext_en: The storm caused severe drifting.

defs.def_en: If snow drifts, it builds up into piles as a result of the movement of the wind.

ext.ext_cn: 9英尺深的雪堆
ext.ext_en: ...a nine-foot snow drift.

defs.def_en: A drift is a mass of snow that has built up into a pile as a result of the movement of wind.

ext.ext_cn: 树林上空飘浮着一股烟。
ext.ext_en: There was a drift of smoke above the trees.

defs.def_en: A drift of something is an amount of it that has been created by the movement of wind or water.

ext.ext_cn: 格雷丝慢慢明白了他的意思。
ext.ext_en: Grace was beginning to get his drift...

ext.ext_cn: 任何一个在专心听的人都会领悟他所说的大意。
ext.ext_en: Anybody who's listening will get the drift of what he was saying...

defs.def_en: The drift of an argument or speech is the general point that is being made in it.

defs.def_cn: 公开招认的；公开认错（或认罪）的

ext.ext_cn: 她公开承认自己拥护君主制度。
ext.ext_en: She is a confessed monarchist.

defs.def_en: You use confessed to describe someone who openly admits that they have a particular fault or have done something wrong.

ext.ext_cn: “先生们，告辞了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Gentlemen, I bid you adieu.'

defs.def_en: Adieu means the same as goodbye .

defs.def_cn: （无线电台上）乐曲的播放次数

ext.ext_cn: 我们的第一首单曲在电台播放过很多次。
ext.ext_en: Our first single got a lot of airplay.

defs.def_en: The airplay which a piece of popular music receives is the number of times it is played on the radio.

ext.ext_cn: 人在心情沮丧时就吃东西。
ext.ext_en: People eat when they're depressed.

defs.def_en: They're is the usual spoken form of 'they are'.

ext.ext_cn: 欧盟已经就其雇员工作时间的控制问题拟定了新的规章。
ext.ext_en: The European Union has proposed new regulations to control the hours worked by its employees...

ext.ext_cn: 在美国政府的压力之下，菲亚特和其他汽车制造商同意遵守新的安全规定。
ext.ext_en: Under pressure from the American government, Fiat and other manufacturers obeyed the new safety regulations.

defs.def_en: Regulations are rules made by a government or other authority in order to control the way something is done or the way people behave.

defs.def_cn: (常指通过规章制度进行的)调控，管理，控制

ext.ext_cn: 社会福利部门也有责任对托儿所进行管理。
ext.ext_en: Social services also have responsibility for the regulation of nurseries...

ext.ext_cn: 现在一些市场人士希望政府实施调控，以降低成本。
ext.ext_en: Some in the market now want government regulation in order to reduce costs.

defs.def_en: Regulation is the controlling of an activity or process, usually by means of rules.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 智力迟钝的;智力发育迟缓的

ext.ext_cn: 为智障孩子设立的特殊学校
ext.ext_en: ...a special school for mentally retarded children.

defs.def_en: Someone who is retarded is much less advanced mentally than most people of their age.

ext.ext_cn: 在混合物还没有变硬之前，趁热将它塑成形。
ext.ext_en: Mould the mixture into shape while hot, before it hardens...

ext.ext_cn: 在纸板上涂两三层清漆使其变硬。
ext.ext_en: Give the cardboard two or three coats of varnish to harden it.

defs.def_en: When something hardens or when you harden it, it becomes stiff or firm.

defs.def_cn: （使）（态度、想法）变得更坚定;（使）变得更强硬

ext.ext_cn: 他们的行动只会让土地拥有者的态度变得更坚定。
ext.ext_en: Their action can only serve to harden the attitude of landowners...

ext.ext_cn: 团结工会内部已产生的不愉快分歧可能会进一步演变为分裂。
ext.ext_en: The bitter split which has developed within Solidarity is likely to harden further into separation.

defs.def_en: When an attitude or opinion hardens or is hardened, it becomes harsher, stronger, or fixed.

ext.ext_cn: 房地产价格刚开始重新趋于稳定。
ext.ext_en: Property prices are just beginning to harden again.

defs.def_en: When prices and economies harden, they become much more stable than they were.

defs.def_cn: （使）变得坚强;（使）变得冷酷无情;（使）变得麻木不仁

ext.ext_cn: 她多年来醉酒寻衅的恶习让我变得麻木。
ext.ext_en: Her years of drunken bickering hardened my heart...

ext.ext_cn: 西伯利亚大草原的艰苦环境使她变得坚强起来。
ext.ext_en: She was hardened by the rigours of the Siberian steppes...

defs.def_en: When events harden people or when people harden, they become less easily affected emotionally and less sympathetic and gentle than they were before.

defs.def_cn: （表情、眼神）变得严肃，变得不快

ext.ext_cn: 他的笑容消失了，脸上的表情严肃了起来。
ext.ext_en: His smile died and the look in his face hardened.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's face or eyes harden, you mean that they suddenly look serious or angry.
Viscera are the large organs inside the body, such as the heart, liver, and stomach.

ext.ext_cn: 我不得不在泥泞的雪地里更换内胎。
ext.ext_en: I had to change the inner tube, in the mud and the snow.

defs.def_en: An inner tube is a rubber tube containing air which is inside a car tyre or a bicycle tyre.
Capsicums are peppers .

defs.def_cn: (对选举结果起决定性作用的)独立选票，关键选票

ext.ext_cn: 在该委员会的选举中握有独立选票的民主党人
ext.ext_en: ...a Democrat who holds the swing vote on the committee.

defs.def_en: In a situation when people are about to vote, the swing vote is used to talk about the vote of a person or group which is difficult to predict and which will be important in deciding the result.

defs.def_cn: 免费电话;对方付费电话

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦的免费应急住房热线
ext.ext_en: ...London's Freefone emergency housing helpline.

defs.def_en: A Freefone telephone number is one which you can dial without having to pay for the call.

ext.ext_cn: “这地方没有人气，没有活力。”他抱怨道。
ext.ext_en: 'There's no buzz, there's no oomph about the place,' he complained.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has oomph, you mean that they are energetic and exciting.

ext.ext_cn: 运土卡车和混凝土搅拌机闲置着。
ext.ext_en: The earth-moving trucks and cement mixers lay idle.

defs.def_en: Earth-moving equipment is machinery that is used for digging and moving large amounts of soil.

defs.def_cn: (网球比赛中取胜所需的最后一分)决胜分，赛点
defs.def_en: In a game of tennis, match point is the situation when the player who is in the lead can win the whole match if they win the next point.

ext.ext_cn: 非洲人国民大会宣布他们正在开展一次大规模政治抗议活动。
ext.ext_en: The ANC announced it was mounting a major campaign of mass political protests.

ext.ext_cn: 军队开展的维护安全军事行动
ext.ext_en: ...a security operation mounted by the army.

defs.def_en: If you mount a campaign or event, you organize it and make it take place.

ext.ext_cn: 有几个小时，紧张局势有所加剧。
ext.ext_en: For several hours, tension mounted...

ext.ext_cn: 噪音在增强。
ext.ext_en: The decibel level was mounting...

defs.def_en: If something mounts, it increases in intensity.

ext.ext_cn: 未收的垃圾在市区街道上越积越多。
ext.ext_en: The uncollected garbage mounts in city streets...

ext.ext_cn: 他对日益增加的债务置之不理。
ext.ext_en: He ignored his mounting debts.

defs.def_en: If something mounts, it increases in quantity.

ext.ext_cn: 卢埃林登上台阶，走进城堡主楼。
ext.ext_en: Llewelyn was mounting the stairs up into the keep...

ext.ext_cn: 机动车开上了人行道。
ext.ext_en: The vehicle mounted the pavement.

defs.def_en: If you mount the stairs or a platform, you go up the stairs or go up onto the platform.

ext.ext_cn: 他骑上马走了。
ext.ext_en: He mounted his horse and rode away...

ext.ext_cn: 一位戴头盔的男子正跨上摩托车。
ext.ext_en: A man in a crash helmet was mounting a motorbike...

defs.def_en: If you mount a horse or cycle, you climb on to it so that you can ride it.

ext.ext_cn: 愿意照料老马的马主的数量
ext.ext_en: ...the number of owners who care for older mounts.

defs.def_en: A mount is a horse.

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫把作品装裱在绒纸上，并制作了画框。
ext.ext_en: Her husband mounts the work on velour paper and makes the frame...

ext.ext_cn: 篱笆的支撑部分安装在桌子延长出的地方。
ext.ext_en: The support for the fence is mounted on an extension to the table.

defs.def_en: If you mount an object on something, you fix it there firmly.

ext.ext_cn: 画廊已举办了一场爱尔兰女画家的作品展。
ext.ext_en: The gallery has mounted an exhibition of art by Irish women painters.

defs.def_en: If you mount an exhibition or display, you organize and present it.

ext.ext_cn: 乞力马扎罗山
ext.ext_en: ...Mount Kilimanjaro.

defs.def_en: Mount is used as part of the name of a mountain.

ext.ext_cn: 评论家们几乎一致贬抑这本书。
ext.ext_en: Reviewers have been almost unanimous in their disparagement of this book.

defs.def_en: Disparagement is the act of speaking about someone or something in a way which shows that you do not have a good opinion of them.
A blotter is a large sheet of blotting paper kept in a special holder on a desk.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 缎子拖鞋轻盈地踏过沾着露珠的草地。
ext.ext_en: The satin slippers tread daintily through the dewy grass.

defs.def_en: Something that is dewy is wet with dew.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If your skin looks dewy, it looks soft and glows healthily.

ext.ext_cn: 钻心的疼痛
ext.ext_en: ...pain that rends the heart.

ext.ext_cn: 反常的狂乱撕扯的冲动
ext.ext_en: ...a twisted urge to rend and tear.

defs.def_en: To rend something means to tear it.

ext.ext_cn: 他咆哮着，痛苦的喊声划破长空。
ext.ext_en: He bellows, rends the air with anguish.

defs.def_en: If a loud sound rends the air, it is sudden and violent.
An equal sign is the sign =, which is used in arithmetic to indicate that two numbers or sets of numbers are equal.

defs.def_cn: 优秀的;极好的;顶呱呱的

ext.ext_cn: 这是一部很优秀的小说。
ext.ext_en: It's a cracking novel...

ext.ext_cn: 利物浦队的打法再加上我们的打法，我想那会是一场很精彩的比赛。
ext.ext_en: The way Liverpool play, and the way we play, I think it will be a cracking game.

defs.def_en: You use cracking to describe something you think is very good or exciting.

ext.ext_cn: 马克，你最好尽快开始，越快越好。
ext.ext_en: Mark, you'd better get cracking, the sooner the better...

ext.ext_cn: 代金券必须于9月14日之前兑现，所以你最好快点。
ext.ext_en: Vouchers must be redeemed before September 14th so you'd better get cracking to cash in.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to get cracking, you are telling them to start doing something immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 她飞速赶往拉姆赞先生的大型商场。
ext.ext_en: She set off at a cracking pace to Mr Ramzan's Superstore...

ext.ext_cn: 影片节奏紧凑。
ext.ext_en: The film belts along at a cracking pace.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is moving at a cracking pace, you mean that they are moving very quickly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我从未见过像这样明目张胆地歪曲事实。
ext.ext_en: I never saw such a glaring example of misrepresentation.

defs.def_en: If you describe something bad as glaring, you are emphasizing that it is very obvious and easily seen or noticed.
An airlock is a small room that is used to move between areas which do not have the same air pressure, for example in a spacecraft or submarine.
An airlock is a bubble of air in a pipe that prevents liquid from flowing through.

ext.ext_cn: 政府正设法阻止医院自行焚烧垃圾废物。
ext.ext_en: The government is trying to stop hospitals incinerating their own waste.

defs.def_en: When authorities incinerate rubbish or waste material, they burn it completely in a special container.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车受撞击起火,一些人被烧死。
ext.ext_en: The cars caught fire on impact and some of the victims were incinerated.

defs.def_en: If people are incinerated, for example in a bomb attack or a fire, they are burnt to death.

defs.def_cn: 压缩空气推动（操作）的；风动的；气动的

ext.ext_cn: 风钻钻个不停的轰鸣声
ext.ext_en: ...the sound of a pneumatic drill hammering away.

defs.def_en: A pneumatic drill is operated by air under pressure and is very powerful. Pneumatic drills are often used for digging up roads.

ext.ext_cn: 充气轮胎
ext.ext_en: ...pneumatic tyres.

defs.def_en: Pneumatic means filled with air.

ext.ext_cn: 这个小女孩喜欢和她的伙伴一起玩。
ext.ext_en: The young girl loved to play with her playmates.

defs.def_en: A child's playmate is another child who often plays with him or her.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 非凡的；不寻常的；惊人的

ext.ext_cn: 澳大利亚葡萄酒出口正在以惊人的速度增长。
ext.ext_en: Exports of Australian wine are growing at a phenomenal rate...

ext.ext_cn: 表演绝对精彩。
ext.ext_en: The performances have been absolutely phenomenal.

defs.def_en: Something that is phenomenal is so great or good that it is very unusual indeed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 很瘦的;皮包骨头的;骨瘦如柴的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个瘦得皮包骨头的小男孩。
ext.ext_en: He was quite a skinny little boy...

ext.ext_cn: 她的长发稀疏，毫无光泽，两条腿跟竹竿似的。
ext.ext_en: She had stringy hair and skinny legs.

defs.def_en: A skinny person is extremely thin, often in a way that you find unattractive.

ext.ext_cn: 他突然再次出现一定引起了震动。
ext.ext_en: His sudden reappearance must have been a shock.

ext.ext_cn: 哥萨克文化在俄罗斯的重现
ext.ext_en: ...the reappearance of Cossack culture in Russia.

defs.def_en: The reappearance of someone or something is their return after they have been away or out of sight for some time.

defs.def_cn: 撒;散播;在…上布满(或撒满)

ext.ext_cn: 浣熊弄翻垃圾箱找吃的，把垃圾弄得满地都是。
ext.ext_en: The racoons knock over the rubbish bins in search of food, and strew the contents all over the ground...

ext.ext_cn: 一位老妇人正在往地板上撒滑石粉以防止舞鞋打滑。
ext.ext_en: An elderly woman was strewing the floor with French chalk so that the dancing shoes would not slip...

defs.def_en: To strew things somewhere, or to strew a place with things, means to scatter them there.

ext.ext_cn: 美国空军
ext.ext_en: ...the United States Air Force...

ext.ext_cn: 杰克·曼在第二次世界大战时期是英国皇家空军的战斗机飞行员。
ext.ext_en: Jack Mann was a Royal Air Force fighter pilot during World War II.

defs.def_en: An air force is the part of a country's armed forces that is concerned with fighting in the air.
Ova is the plural of ovum.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 让船保持直线航行。
ext.ext_en: Keep the boat in a straight line...

ext.ext_cn: 用直尺比照着，将布料裁剪成合适的尺寸。
ext.ext_en: Using the straight edge as a guide, trim the cloth to size...

defs.def_en: A straight line or edge continues in the same direction and does not bend or curve.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 格雷斯把一头长长的黑色直发盘成发髻。
ext.ext_en: Grace had long straight dark hair which she wore in a bun.

defs.def_en: Straight hair has no curls or waves in it.

ext.ext_cn: 球直接落到了克林斯曼的脚上。
ext.ext_en: The ball fell straight to the feet of Klinsmann...

ext.ext_cn: 他说完话站起来，直视着我。
ext.ext_en: He finished his conversation and stood up, looking straight at me...

defs.def_en: You use straight to indicate that the way from one place to another is very direct, with no changes of direction.

ext.ext_cn: 像往常一样，我们马上去找专家咨询。
ext.ext_en: As always, we went straight to the experts for advice...

ext.ext_cn: 我们将去伯明翰参加会议，然后马上回来。
ext.ext_en: We'll go to a meeting in Birmingham and come straight back.

defs.def_en: If you go straight to a place, you go there immediately.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 直截了当的;直率的;坦诚的

ext.ext_cn: 他真是个狡诈的辩论家，总是拒绝给出直截了当的回答。
ext.ext_en: What a shifty arguer he is, refusing ever to give a straight answer.

ext.ext_cn: 我生气了，直截了当地告诉他我压根儿就没在找工作。
ext.ext_en: I lost my temper and told him straight that I hadn't been looking for any job.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a straight answer, you answer them clearly and honestly.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在输掉比赛之前已连续赢了12场。
ext.ext_en: They'd won 12 straight games before they lost.

ext.ext_cn: 他从韦丁顿打电话过来时已在那儿呆了整整 31 个小时了。
ext.ext_en: He called from Weddington, having been there for 31 hours straight.

defs.def_en: Straight means following one after the other, with no gaps or intervals.

defs.def_cn: 只涉及两人(或两物)的;(选择)非此即彼的

ext.ext_cn: 只有两个选择：要么是报酬很低的工作，要么就是失业。
ext.ext_en: It's a straight choice between low-paid jobs and no jobs...

ext.ext_cn: 双方都曾在单打比赛中击败过对方几次。
ext.ext_en: Each has several times beaten the other in a straight fight.

defs.def_en: A straight choice or a straight fight involves only two people or things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 正经的;正统的;规矩本分的

ext.ext_cn: 多萝西被形容成一个非常正统的女人，一个尽职尽责、非常虔诚的基督徒。
ext.ext_en: Dorothy was described as a very straight woman, a very strict Christian who was married to her job.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as straight, you mean that they are normal and conventional, for example in their opinions and in the way they live.

ext.ext_cn: 从他的性取向来看，他不像异性恋，更像个同性恋。
ext.ext_en: His sexual orientation was a lot more gay than straight...

ext.ext_cn: 纽约的马蒂称自己不是女同性恋者。
ext.ext_en: Marty of New York describes herself as a straight female.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as straight, you mean that they are heterosexual rather than homosexual.

defs.def_cn: (尤指酒精饮料)纯的，不掺水的

ext.ext_cn: 不加冰的大杯纯威士忌
ext.ext_en: ...a large straight whiskey without ice...

ext.ext_cn: 儿童不应该喝纯果汁。
ext.ext_en: Children should not drink fruit juices straight.

defs.def_en: A straight drink, especially an alcoholic drink, has not had another liquid such as water added to it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的赛车在直道上跑得显然太慢了。
ext.ext_en: Our cars were clearly too slow along the straights...

ext.ext_cn: 最后一圈时我在非终点直道上超过了他。
ext.ext_en: I went to overtake him on the back straight on the last lap.

defs.def_en: See also:home straight;On a racetrack, a straight is a section of the track that is straight, rather than curved.

ext.ext_cn: 你需要讲清楚你的情况。
ext.ext_en: You need to get your facts straight...

ext.ext_cn: 咱们把事情说清楚。我没有和她一起吃午饭。
ext.ext_en: Let's get things straight. I didn't lunch with her.

defs.def_en: If you get something straight, you make sure that you understand it properly or that someone else does.

defs.def_cn: 改过自新;改邪归正;重新做人
defs.def_en: If a criminal is going straight, they are no longer involved in crime.

ext.ext_cn: 她为了让他走正道所作出的一切努力都得到了回报。
ext.ext_en: All her efforts to keep him on the straight and narrow have been rewarded.

defs.def_en: If something keeps people on the straight and narrow, it helps to keep them living an honest or healthy life.

defs.def_cn: 相互补充的;相辅相成的

ext.ext_cn: 想通过工作提高生活质量，需要两个相辅相成的策略。
ext.ext_en: To improve the quality of life through work, two complementary strategies are necessary...

ext.ext_cn: 多种素色的瓷砖和配套的腰线也在售
ext.ext_en: Many plain tiles and complementary borders are also available...

defs.def_en: Complementary things are different from each other but make a good combination.

defs.def_cn: 补充医学的(不同于西医的治疗方法，如针灸、顺势疗法)

ext.ext_cn: 把传统的治疗方法与各种补充疗法结合
ext.ext_en: ...combining orthodox treatment with a wide range of complementary therapies.

defs.def_en: Complementary medicine refers to ways of treating patients which are different from the ones used by most Western doctors, for example acupuncture and homoeopathy.

ext.ext_cn: 典型的工薪阶层
ext.ext_en: ...a typical wage earner...

ext.ext_cn: 糖是斐济第二大出口创汇产品。
ext.ext_en: Sugar is Fiji's second biggest export earner.

defs.def_en: An earner is someone or something that earns money or produces profit.

ext.ext_cn: 卖T恤衫来钱容易，比领救济金好。
ext.ext_en: T-shirts are a nice little earner and it's better than the dole.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a nice little earner, you mean that it is something that you can make money from easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如果工作忙、难度大，要想保持桌面整洁似乎不太可能。
ext.ext_en: Having a tidy desk can seem impossible if you have a busy, demanding job...

ext.ext_cn: 我会帮你弄弄花园，帮你保持它的整洁。
ext.ext_en: I'll do your garden, I'll keep that tidy for you.

defs.def_en: Something that is tidy is neat and is arranged in an organized way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她有洁癖，整天不是用吸尘器吸尘，就是擦来擦去。
ext.ext_en: She's obsessively tidy, always hoovering and polishing.

defs.def_en: Someone who is tidy likes everything to be neat and arranged in an organized way.

ext.ext_cn: 她整理了床铺，收拾了自己的房间。
ext.ext_en: She made her bed, and tidied her room.

defs.def_en: When you tidy a place such as a room or cupboard, you make it neat by putting things in their proper places.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 赚大钱的机会就在那儿摆着。
ext.ext_en: The opportunities are there to make a tidy profit.

defs.def_en: A tidy amount of money is a large amount.

ext.ext_cn: 他们唯一的目的就是要动摇印度政府的统治。
ext.ext_en: Their sole aim is to destabilize the Indian government.

defs.def_en: The sole thing or person of a particular type is the only one of that type.

defs.def_cn: (控制权或所有权)唯一的，独占的

ext.ext_cn: 许多女人在丈夫去世之后只好独自供养一家人。
ext.ext_en: Many women are left as the sole providers in families after their husband has died...

ext.ext_cn: 哈特主任独自掌控那笔资金。
ext.ext_en: Chief Hart had sole control over that fund.

defs.def_en: If you have sole charge or ownership of something, you are the only person in charge of it or who owns it.

ext.ext_cn: 橡胶底的鞋子
ext.ext_en: ...shoes with rubber soles...

ext.ext_cn: 他的一只脚脚底被灼伤了。
ext.ext_en: He had burned the sole of his foot.

defs.def_en: The sole of your foot or of a shoe or sock is the underneath surface of it.
A sole is a kind of flat fish that you can eat.

ext.ext_cn: 这些领导人被民族主义者赶下了台。
ext.ext_en: The leaders have been ousted from power by nationalists...

ext.ext_cn: 上周，他们试图通过议会的不信任投票将他罢免。
ext.ext_en: Last week they tried to oust him in a parliamentary vote of no confidence.

defs.def_en: If someone is ousted from a position of power, job, or place, they are forced to leave it.

defs.def_cn: (与过去分词连用构成形容词)表示“新近”

ext.ext_cn: 他特别喜欢刚修剪过的草地的味道。
ext.ext_en: He loved the smell of new-mown grass...

ext.ext_cn: 杰拉尔德珍视自己刚赢得的自立。
ext.ext_en: Gerald treasures his new-won independence.

defs.def_en: New- combines with the past participle of some verbs to form adjectives which indicate that an action has been done or completed very recently.

defs.def_cn: 没有明确目标的;无人领导的

ext.ext_cn: 政治上，这个国家已将近3个月群龙无首了。
ext.ext_en: The country was politically rudderless for almost three months.

ext.ext_cn: 国内有这样一种感觉：政府没有明确的目标
ext.ext_en: ...a feeling in the country that the Government was drifting rudderless.

defs.def_en: A country or a person that is rudderless does not have a clear aim or a strong leader to follow.
B.O. is an unpleasant smell caused by sweat on a person's body. B.O. is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'body odour'.

defs.def_cn: （体育比赛或竞赛中的）裁判，裁判员

ext.ext_cn: 裁判的裁定是不可更改的。
ext.ext_en: The umpire's decision is final.

defs.def_en: An umpire is a person whose job is to make sure that a sports match or contest is played fairly and that the rules are not broken.

ext.ext_cn: 他担任棒球比赛的裁判。
ext.ext_en: He umpired baseball games...

ext.ext_cn: 他担任校际足球比赛的裁判一直到年近花甲。
ext.ext_en: He umpired for school football matches until he was in his late 50s.

defs.def_en: To umpire means to be the umpire in a sports match or contest.
A countable noun is the same as a count noun .

defs.def_cn: 有伤风化的露体(尤指性器官裸露)
defs.def_en: Indecent exposure is a criminal offence that is committed when someone exposes their genitals in public.

defs.def_cn: 先生（用于男子姓名后表尊敬，尤用于信封上）
defs.def_en: Esquire is a formal title that can be used after a man's name if he has no other title, especially on an envelope that is addressed to him.
A chrysalis is a butterfly or moth in the stage between being a larva and an adult.

ext.ext_cn: 从蛹壳中羽化而出的蝴蝶
ext.ext_en: ...a butterfly emerging from its chrysalis.

defs.def_en: A chrysalis is the hard, protective covering that a chrysalis has.

ext.ext_cn: 他的演讲并没有夸大其词和自吹自擂。
ext.ext_en: There was no bombast or conceit in his speech.

defs.def_en: Bombast is trying to impress people by saying things that sound impressive but have little meaning.

defs.def_cn: 发出难听（或刺耳）的声音;尖声叫嚷

ext.ext_cn: “你把它放在哪里了？”他尖声叫道。
ext.ext_en: 'Where've you put it?' he rasped...

ext.ext_cn: 他仰面跌进了水中，胸部起伏，呼吸急促。
ext.ext_en: He fell back into the water, his breath rasping in his heaving chest...

defs.def_en: If someone rasps, their voice or breathing is harsh and unpleasant to listen to.

defs.def_cn: （物体摩擦时）发出刺耳的声音

ext.ext_cn: 马刀在刀鞘里咔嗒作响，骑手催马向前。
ext.ext_en: Sabres rasped from scabbards and the horsemen spurred forward...

ext.ext_cn: 福登用手蹭得下巴刺刺响。
ext.ext_en: Foden rasped a hand across his chin...

defs.def_en: If something rasps or if you rasp it, it makes a harsh, unpleasant sound as it rubs against something hard or rough.
A rasp is a long metal tool with rough surfaces, used to rub solid objects and give them smooth surfaces.

ext.ext_cn: 好莱坞人气女星
ext.ext_en: ...an A-list Hollywood actress.

ext.ext_cn: 奎因所交往的人都是最有名气的。
ext.ext_en: Quinn's connections are strictly A-list.

defs.def_en: An A-list celebrity is a celebrity who is very famous indeed.

defs.def_cn: 最具人气的名人榜;一线明星红人榜

ext.ext_cn: 好莱坞一线明星
ext.ext_en: ...the A-list of Hollywood stars.

defs.def_en: An A-list of celebrities is a group of celebrities who are very famous indeed.

ext.ext_cn: 新年第一天，我在美国开始了一次新的冒险。
ext.ext_en: I set off for a new adventure in the United States on the first day of the new year.

defs.def_en: If someone has an adventure, they become involved in an unusual, exciting, and rather dangerous journey or series of events.

defs.def_cn: 冒险的刺激；大胆的开拓；勇敢的闯荡

ext.ext_cn: 他们的文化背景赋予了他们一种冒险精神。
ext.ext_en: Their cultural backgrounds gave them a spirit of adventure.

ext.ext_cn: 惊险刺激的感觉
ext.ext_en: ...a feeling of adventure and excitement.

defs.def_en: Adventure is excitement and willingness to do new, unusual, or rather dangerous things.

ext.ext_cn: 该队伍的探险之旅远至奥地利的阿尔卑斯山。
ext.ext_en: The group has adventured as far as the Austrian alps.

defs.def_en: If you adventure somewhere, you go somewhere new, unusual, and exciting.
Oars are long poles with a wide, flat blade at one end which are used for rowing a boat.

ext.ext_cn: 这部小说是一部意识流作品，描绘了一个为出嫁而离家的印度女人内心强烈的情感。
ext.ext_en: The novel is an intensely lyrical stream-of-consciousness about an Indian woman who leaves her family home to be married...

ext.ext_cn: 他们并不希望总统像朋友一样和他们随心漫谈。
ext.ext_en: The stream-of-consciousness they expect of a friend over coffee is not really what they need of their president.

defs.def_en: If you describe what someone writes or says as a stream of consciousness, you mean that it expresses their thoughts as they occur, rather than in a structured way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 随着年龄的增长，人通常会变得不再那么手巧。
ext.ext_en: As people grow older they generally become less dexterous.

ext.ext_cn: 指法纯熟的布鲁斯钢琴演奏者
ext.ext_en: ...a dextrous blues pianist.

defs.def_en: Someone who is dexterous is very skilful and clever with their hands.
A pram is a small vehicle in which a baby can lie as it is pushed along.

defs.def_cn: （连接两个以上的单词、词组或子句）和，与，同

ext.ext_cn: 他回来时，她和西蒙已经走了。
ext.ext_en: When he returned, she and Simon had already gone...

ext.ext_cn: 在1914年至1920年间阿尔巴尼亚的大部分地区被意大利人占据。
ext.ext_en: Between 1914 and 1920 large parts of Albania were occupied by the Italians...

defs.def_en: You use and to link two or more words, groups, or clauses.

defs.def_cn: （连接两个相同的单词或短语，以强调某事物的程度、暗示某事继续发生或在一段时间内不断增加）接连，越…越…

ext.ext_cn: 随着年龄增长，学习变得越来越难。
ext.ext_en: Learning becomes more and more difficult as we get older...

ext.ext_cn: 我在一天天地好转。
ext.ext_en: Day by day I am getting better and better...

defs.def_en: You use and to link two words or phrases that are the same in order to emphasize the degree of something, or to suggest that something continues or increases over a period of time.

defs.def_cn: （连接两件相继发生的事件）然后，就

ext.ext_cn: 我挥手告别，然后走下港口石阶。
ext.ext_en: I waved goodbye and went down the stone harbour steps...

ext.ext_cn: 他要求给他的威士忌里面加冰，接着喝得大醉。
ext.ext_en: He asked for ice for his whiskey and proceeded to get drunk.

defs.def_en: You use and to link two statements about events when one of the events follows the other.

defs.def_cn: （连接两句话，第二句话的意思是第一句的延伸）则，而

ext.ext_cn: 真的，这种病只能在很久以后才能看出它的影响，而5年的时间还不够长。
ext.ext_en: You could only really tell the effects of the disease in the long term, and five years wasn't long enough...

ext.ext_cn: 解决教学质量差的办法就是请好的教师，但请好的教师是需要花钱的。
ext.ext_en: The cure for bad teaching is good teachers, and good teachers cost money.

defs.def_en: You use and to link two statements when the second statement continues the point that has been made in the first statement.

defs.def_cn: （连接两个从句，表示因果关系）那么，于是

ext.ext_cn: 昨天陆续有大批人到来，午夜时有几千人聚集在广场上。
ext.ext_en: All through yesterday crowds have been arriving and by midnight thousands of people packed the square.

defs.def_en: You use and to link two clauses when the second clause is a result of the first clause.

defs.def_cn: （表示停顿，以便对所说的话进行评论）再说，而

ext.ext_cn: 如唐宁所说，也正如我们前文所指出的，当孩子对语言非常熟悉时，阅读的效果最佳。
ext.ext_en: As Downing claims, and as we noted above, reading is best established when the child has an intimate knowledge of the language...

ext.ext_cn: 最后——我确实应该停一下——我想作以下推荐。
ext.ext_en: Finally — and I really ought to stop in a minute — I wish to make the following recommendations.

defs.def_en: You use and to interrupt yourself in order to make a comment on what you are saying.

defs.def_cn: （用于句首，引出补充说明）还有，不过

ext.ext_cn: 支线航空公司航班飞往偏僻地区。商务旅客就是会前往那些地区的人。
ext.ext_en: Commuter airlines fly to out-of-the-way places. And business travelers are the ones who go to those locations.

defs.def_en: You use and at the beginning of a sentence to introduce something else that you want to add to what you have just said. Some people think that starting a sentence with and is ungrammatical, but it is now quite common in both spoken and written English.

defs.def_cn: （用以引导与某人之谈话有关的问句）那么，还有

ext.ext_cn: “他以前是那么英俊。”——“那么现在呢？”

ext.ext_en: A map and a bird-watchers' field checklist are available at the front desk.

defs.def_en: The place in a hotel, hospital, airport, or other building where you check in or obtain information is referred to as a particular desk .

ext.ext_en: Let our news desk know as quickly as possible on 414 3926...

ext.ext_en: Over now to Simon Ingram at the sports desk.

defs.def_en: A particular department of a broadcasting company, or of a newspaper or magazine company, can be referred to as a particular desk .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 高热量食物
ext.ext_en: ...food with a high calorific value.

ext.ext_cn: 高热量脂肪
ext.ext_en: ...highly calorific fats.

defs.def_en: The calorific value of something, or its calorific content, is the number of calories it contains.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 心情多变的;闷闷不乐的

ext.ext_cn: 戴维的妈妈情绪不稳定，心情也不好。
ext.ext_en: David's mother was unstable and moody...

ext.ext_cn: 雷是一个表面上嘻嘻哈哈，但内心复杂且情绪多变的人。
ext.ext_en: Ray is a complicated, moody man behind the joking front.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as moody, you mean that their feelings and behaviour change frequently, and in particular that they often become depressed or angry without any warning.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 令人伤感的黑白照片
ext.ext_en: ...moody black and white photographs.

ext.ext_cn: 伤感的歌词伴着幽幽吉他声
ext.ext_en: ...a blend of melancholy guitars and moody lyrics.

defs.def_en: If you describe a picture, film, or piece of music as moody, you mean that it suggests particular emotions, especially sad ones.

defs.def_cn: 无家可归的流浪儿;小乞丐
defs.def_en: Street children are homeless children who live outdoors in a city and live by begging or stealing.

defs.def_cn: 女式贴身内衣裤；女内衣；女睡衣
defs.def_en: Lingerie is women's underwear and nightclothes.

defs.def_cn: （足球、板球、曲棍球等运动的）球场

ext.ext_cn: 有一个游泳池、几个板球场和运动场。
ext.ext_en: There was a swimming-pool, cricket pitches, playing fields...

ext.ext_cn: 他们场上场下都表现出众。
ext.ext_en: Their conduct both on and off the pitch was excellent.

defs.def_en: A pitch is an area of ground that is marked out and used for playing a game such as football, cricket, or hockey.

defs.def_cn: （通常指仔细瞄准后用力）投，掷，扔，抛

ext.ext_cn: 西蒙把空瓶子扔到湖里。
ext.ext_en: Simon pitched the empty bottle into the lake.

defs.def_en: If you pitch something somewhere, you throw it with quite a lot of force, usually aiming it carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 这一动使他冷不防地向前摔倒。
ext.ext_en: The movement took him by surprise, and he pitched forward...

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦身子倒向一侧，一头栽过矮墙，跌进了湖里。
ext.ext_en: Alan staggered sideways, pitched head-first over the low wall and fell into the lake...

defs.def_en: To pitch somewhere means to fall forwards suddenly and with a lot of force.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正被抛入一场新的冒险。
ext.ext_en: They were being pitched into a new adventure...

ext.ext_cn: 这有可能把政府推向与工人正面交锋的境地。
ext.ext_en: This could pitch the government into confrontation with the workforce.

defs.def_en: If someone is pitched into a new situation, they are suddenly forced into it.

defs.def_cn: （棒球或跑柱式棒球运动中）把（球）投给击球员

ext.ext_cn: 我们通过投棒球玩打发了一个个漫长、炎热的下午。
ext.ext_en: We passed long, hot afternoons pitching a baseball.

defs.def_en: In the game of baseball or rounders, when you pitch the ball, you throw it to the batter for them to hit it.

ext.ext_cn: 他把音调抬得更高了。
ext.ext_en: He raised his voice to an even higher pitch.

defs.def_en: See also:perfect pitch;The pitch of a sound is how high or low it is.

ext.ext_cn: 他的哭喊声之大让人没法不理睬。
ext.ext_en: His cry is pitched at a level that makes it impossible to ignore...

ext.ext_cn: 他的声音很高，嘴里的话因哭泣而含混不清。
ext.ext_en: His voice was pitched high, the words muffled by his crying...

defs.def_en: See also:high-pitched;low-pitched;If a sound is pitched at a particular level, it is produced at the level indicated.

defs.def_cn: 把…定（在特定的水平、难易程度等上）

ext.ext_cn: 我想相对于我们的意图来说，内容定得过难了。
ext.ext_en: I think the material is pitched at too high a level for our purposes...

ext.ext_cn: 政府已设定了新的商业利率水平。
ext.ext_en: The government has pitched High Street interest rates at a new level.

defs.def_en: If something is pitched at a particular level or degree of difficulty, it is set at that level.

ext.ext_cn: 我为第一天就已耗费相当大体力的参赛者感到非常惋惜。
ext.ext_en: I feel very sorry for the competitors who have all worked themselves up to a very high pitch for this first day...

ext.ext_cn: 紧张关系已达白热化程度，武装部队说士兵有可能不得不使用武器保护自己不受当地民众的伤害。
ext.ext_en: Tension has reached such a pitch that the armed forces say soldiers may have to use their weapons to defend themselves against local people.

defs.def_en: See also:fever pitch;If something such as a feeling or a situation rises to a high pitch, it rises to a high level.

ext.ext_cn: 他在院子里搭起了帐篷。
ext.ext_en: He had pitched his tent in the yard...

ext.ext_cn: 黄昏时分，我们在茫茫荒野中扎了营。
ext.ext_en: At dusk we pitched camp in the middle of nowhere.

defs.def_en: If you pitch your tent, or pitch camp, you put up your tent in a place where you are going to stay.

defs.def_cn: （船只在海浪中）上下颠簸，纵摇

ext.ext_cn: 这只船在看起来约有15英尺高的海浪中上下左右颠簸。
ext.ext_en: The ship is pitching and rolling in what looks like about fifteen foot seas.

defs.def_en: If a boat pitches, it moves violently up and down with the movement of the waves when the sea is rough.

ext.ext_cn: 类似房屋所用的栋木刷了沥青。
ext.ext_en: The timbers of similar houses were painted with pitch.

defs.def_en: See also:pitch-black;Pitch is a black substance that is sticky when it is hot and very hard when it is dry. Pitch is used on the bottoms of boats and on the roofs of houses to prevent water getting in.

ext.ext_cn: 总统今天在纽约发表讲话，再一次为他的经济计划作宣传。
ext.ext_en: The President speaks in New York today, making another pitch for his economic program...

ext.ext_cn: 普吕邀请该杂志的编辑共进午餐，推销自己的点子。
ext.ext_en: Prue invited the magazine's editor to lunch and made her pitch.

defs.def_en: See also:sales pitch;If someone makes a pitch for something, they try to persuade people to do or buy it.

ext.ext_cn: 她将为你设计一个超级棒的新厨房，而且绝不会超出你的预算。
ext.ext_en: She will design a fantastic new kitchen for you — and all within your budget...

ext.ext_cn: 有人没花多少钱简单地把这个地方布置了一下。
ext.ext_en: Someone had furnished the place on a tight budget...

defs.def_en: Your budget is the amount of money that you have available to spend. The budget for something is the amount of money that a person, organization, or country has available to spend on it.

ext.ext_cn: 很明显，医院每年都要平衡其收支预算。
ext.ext_en: The hospital obviously needs to balance the budget each year.

ext.ext_cn: 他已准备把增加税收作为削减预算赤字的措施之一
ext.ext_en: ...his readiness to raise taxes as part of an effort to cut the budget deficit.

defs.def_en: The budget of an organization or country is its financial situation, considered as the difference between the money it receives and the money it spends.

defs.def_cn: （英国的）政府年度预算案，政府年度预算演讲

ext.ext_cn: 财政大臣可以利用政府年度预算演讲的机会提出税收改革事宜。
ext.ext_en: The Chancellor could use the Budget to bring in taxation reforms.

ext.ext_cn: 在政府预算中公布的其他间接税收变动
ext.ext_en: ...other indirect tax changes announced in the Budget.

defs.def_en: In Britain, the Budget is the financial plan in which the government states how much money it intends to raise through taxes and how it intends to spend it. The Budget is also the speech in which this plan is announced.

ext.ext_cn: 公司已经做了1,000万美元的广告预算。
ext.ext_en: The company has budgeted $10 million for advertising...

ext.ext_cn: 该电影的预算只有1,000万美元。
ext.ext_en: The movie is only budgeted at $10 million...

defs.def_en: If you budget certain amounts of money for particular things, you decide that you can afford to spend those amounts on those things.

ext.ext_cn: 收费低廉的旅行社可以提供240英镑起的低价机票。
ext.ext_en: Cheap flights are available from budget travel agent from £240.

defs.def_en: Budget is used in advertising to suggest that something is being sold cheaply.

ext.ext_cn: 18世纪中叶食物的产量远远超过人口的增长。
ext.ext_en: In the mid-eighteenth century the production of food far outstripped the rise in population...

ext.ext_cn: 1989年和1990年出现了供不应求的状况，物价上涨了三分之一还要多。
ext.ext_en: In 1989 and 1990 demand outstripped supply, and prices went up by more than a third.

defs.def_en: If one thing outstrips another, the first thing becomes larger in amount, or more successful or important, than the second thing.
Your thyroid or your thyroid gland is a gland in your neck that produces chemicals which control the way your body grows and functions.

defs.def_cn: 沉睡中的巨人(指力量巨大但没有充分展示其威力的人)

ext.ext_en: The trust, which has 2.3 million members, has been characterised as a sleeping giant of the environment movement.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone or something as a sleeping giant, you mean that they are powerful but they have not yet shown the full extent of their power.
If you refer to someone as a beach bum, you mean that they spend a lot of time enjoying themselves on the beach or in the sea.

defs.def_cn: （对建筑物外墙砖、石砌缝的）勾嵌

ext.ext_cn: 他自己完成了建筑石造部分的勾嵌。
ext.ext_en: He did the pointing in the stonework himself.

defs.def_en: Pointing is a way of filling in the gaps between the bricks or stones on the outside of a building so that the surface becomes sealed.

ext.ext_cn: 裂缝、凸起、剥落的勾缝和湿斑都意味着存在问题。
ext.ext_en: Cracks, bulges, crumbling pointing and damp patches mean trouble.

defs.def_en: Pointing is the cement between the bricks or stones in a wall.

ext.ext_cn: 自杀经常与社会经济权利的丧失有关。
ext.ext_en: Suicide is often connected with socio-economic deprivation.

ext.ext_cn: 西欧社会经济发展的历史模式
ext.ext_en: ...the western European historical model of socio-economic development.

defs.def_en: Socio-economic circumstances or developments involve a combination of social and economic factors.

ext.ext_cn: 新电子书将包括大量的简明指南。
ext.ext_en: The new e-books will include a host of Rough Guide titles.

defs.def_en: An e-book is a book which is produced for reading on a computer screen. E-book is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'electronic book'

defs.def_cn: （电话或自动柜员机等的）键盘
defs.def_en: The keypad on a modern telephone is the set of buttons that you press in order to operate it. Some other machines, such as cash dispensers, also have a keypad.

ext.ext_cn: 我母亲对他很是厌恶。
ext.ext_en: My mother detested him...

ext.ext_cn: 琼非常讨厌拍照。
ext.ext_en: Jean detested being photographed.

defs.def_en: If you detest someone or something, you dislike them very much.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 作噱头的；故意引人关注的

ext.ext_cn: 这次运动虽然大搞噱头，但也有其严肃的一面。
ext.ext_en: The campaign was gimmicky, but it had a serious side to it.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as gimmicky, you think it has features which are not necessary or useful, and whose only purpose is to attract attention or publicity.

ext.ext_cn: 我一定会腾出时间去钓鱼，因为这是我减压放松的方法。
ext.ext_en: I make sure I make time for fishing because it's how I de-stress.

ext.ext_cn: 所有这些都能帮助放松身心，缓解日常生活的辛苦带来的压力。
ext.ext_en: All of these help relax and de-stress you from the rigors of daily life.

defs.def_en: If you de-stress or if something de-stresses you, you do something that helps you to relax.

defs.def_cn: 险情解除的信号；警报解除的信号

ext.ext_cn: 警报发出10分钟后又响起解除的信号。
ext.ext_en: The all clear was sounded about 10 minutes after the alert was given.

ext.ext_cn: “警报解除，”米莎吼道。
ext.ext_en: 'All clear,' Misha growled.

defs.def_en: The all clear is a signal that a dangerous situation, for example an air raid, has ended.

ext.ext_cn: 医生准许我重新开始训练。
ext.ext_en: I was given the all clear by the doctor to resume playing.

defs.def_en: If someone in authority gives you the all clear, they give you permission to continue with a plan or activity, usually after a problem has been sorted out.

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫后来接受了颅骨骨折治疗。
ext.ext_en: Her husband was later treated for a fractured skull.

defs.def_en: Your skull is the bony part of your head which encloses your brain.

ext.ext_en: Banc One of Ohio has built an empire in the midwest by gobbling up smaller banks.

defs.def_en: If an organization gobbles up a smaller organization, it takes control of it or destroys it.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司的支出占其收入的44%。
ext.ext_en: The firm's  expenses gobbled up 44% of revenues.

defs.def_en: To gobble up something such as money means to use or waste a lot of it.

defs.def_cn: 地质构造的;地壳构造的

ext.ext_cn: 太平洋地区的地壳构造板块
ext.ext_en: ...the tectonic plates of the Pacific region.

defs.def_en: Tectonic means relating to the structure of the earth's surface or crust.

ext.ext_cn: 我奶奶送给我们一些苹果酱。
ext.ext_en: My gran's given us some apple jam.

defs.def_en: Some people refer to or address their grandmother as gran .

ext.ext_cn: 他们遭逢了巨大的个人不幸。
ext.ext_en: They have suffered an enormous personal tragedy...

ext.ext_cn: 马斯克尔的生活亦有过变故。
ext.ext_en: Maskell's life had not been without tragedy.

defs.def_en: A tragedy is an extremely sad event or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 这个故事兼有悲剧与闹剧的元素。
ext.ext_en: The story has elements of tragedy and farce.

ext.ext_cn: 古典希腊悲剧
ext.ext_en: …a classic Greek tragedy.

defs.def_en: Tragedy is a type of literature, especially drama, that is serious and sad, and often ends with the death of the main character.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 荒废的;破旧失修的;衣衫褴褛的;穷困潦倒的

ext.ext_cn: 在东柏林中心地区的一家破旧的迪斯科舞厅
ext.ext_en: ...a down-at-heel disco in central East Berlin.

ext.ext_cn: 纽约一家腻糊糊的小餐馆里的衣着破旧的女服务员
ext.ext_en: ...a down-at-heel waitress in a greasy New York diner.

defs.def_en: Something that is down-at-heel is in bad condition because it has been used too much or has not been looked after properly. If you say that someone is down-at-heel, you mean that they are wearing old, worn clothes because they have little money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她抬起头来，用哀求的目光看着他。
ext.ext_en: She looked up at him with beseeching eyes.

defs.def_en: A beseeching expression, gesture, or tone of voice suggests that the person who has or makes it very much wants someone to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 她从事零售业长达14年。
ext.ext_en: She spent fourteen years in retailing.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车零售业
ext.ext_en: ...the car retailing industry.

defs.def_en: Retailing is the activity of selling goods direct to the public, usually in small quantities.
A cookery book is the same as a cookbook .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极强烈的；势不可挡的；令人不知所措的

ext.ext_cn: 如果将这个任务细分为简单易行的若干步骤来做，便不会感到如此无所适从。
ext.ext_en: The task won't feel so overwhelming if you break it down into small, easy-to-accomplish steps...

ext.ext_cn: 她一心想再要一个孩子。
ext.ext_en: She felt an overwhelming desire to have another child.

defs.def_en: If something is overwhelming, it affects you very strongly, and you do not know how to deal with it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 绝大多数小企业在头两年内就破产了。
ext.ext_en: The overwhelming majority of small businesses go broke within the first twenty-four months...

ext.ext_cn: 去年5月，该党在缅甸大选中获得了压倒性的胜利。
ext.ext_en: The party won an overwhelming victory in Burma's general elections last May...

defs.def_en: You can use overwhelming to emphasize that an amount or quantity is much greater than other amounts or quantities.

ext.ext_cn: 辛苦了一天后，多数人想在电视机前放松一下。
ext.ext_en: After a hard day's work most people want to relax in front of the telly.

defs.def_en: A telly is a television.

ext.ext_cn: 两个人都一再否认指控。
ext.ext_en: Both men have repeatedly denied the allegations...

ext.ext_cn: 叛军屡次尝试强攻这座建筑。
ext.ext_en: The rebel soldiers tried repeatedly to storm the building.

defs.def_en: If you do something repeatedly, you do it many times.

ext.ext_cn: 买主们千方百计想从供货商那儿无息赊购。
ext.ext_en: Buyers use different ruses to wring free credit out of their suppliers...

ext.ext_cn: 他希望通过这种方式向英国人施压，从而迫使他们让步。
ext.ext_en: In this way, he hoped to put pressure on the British and thus to wring concessions from them.

defs.def_en: If you wring something out of someone, you manage to make them give it to you even though they do not want to.

defs.def_cn: (通常因忧愁、焦虑而)绞扭双手（干叹息)

ext.ext_cn: 政府必须采取切实行动，一味搓着手感叹说这是个全球性问题是远远不够的。
ext.ext_en: The Government has got to get a grip. Wringing its hands and saying it is a world problem just isn't good enough.

defs.def_en: If someone wrings their hands, they hold them together and twist and turn them, usually because they are very worried or upset about something. You can also say that someone is wringing their hands when they are expressing sorrow that a situation is so bad but are saying that they are unable to change it.

defs.def_cn: 扭断…的脖子(表示非常生某人的气)

ext.ext_cn: 黛比那个疯子！他会为这把她的脖子拧断的！
ext.ext_en: That crazy Debbie! He could wring her neck for this!...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然我想掐死你，但我还是爱你的。
ext.ext_en: I still love you even though I'd like to wring your neck.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will wring someone's neck or that you would like to wring their neck, you mean that you are very angry or irritated with them.

defs.def_cn: 毛料的；羊毛制的;羊毛混纺的

ext.ext_cn: 厚厚的羊毛袜
ext.ext_en: ...thick woollen socks.

defs.def_en: Woollen clothes or materials are made from wool or from a mixture of wool and artificial fibres.

defs.def_cn: 毛料衣服;(尤指)毛衣,羊毛衫

ext.ext_cn: 冬天穿的毛衣
ext.ext_en: ...winter woollens.

defs.def_en: Woollens are clothes, especially sweaters, that are made of wool.
In Christian belief, the Resurrection is the event in which Jesus Christ came back to life after he had been killed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 永恒不变的真理

ext.ext_cn: 然而，我们脚下的地面却似乎是坚实而恒久不变的。
ext.ext_en: The ground beneath us, however, appears solid and unchanging.

defs.def_en: Something that is unchanging always stays the same.

defs.def_cn: （女士出席正式舞会时穿的）长舞裙
defs.def_en: A ballgown is a long dress that women wear to formal dances.

defs.def_cn: （为了熟悉某地的情况）踩点，侦察

ext.ext_cn: 主管的第一项任务是熟悉所在地区的情况。
ext.ext_en: The first duty of a director is to recce his location.
