ext.ext_en: Uncle Jim took the air rifle and went on a recce to the far end of the quarry.

defs.def_en: If you recce an area, you visit that place in order to become familiar with it. People usually recce an area when they are going to return at a later time to do something there.

ext.ext_cn: 你到底想干什么？
ext.ext_en: What do you fancy doing, anyway?...

ext.ext_cn: 你想不想有空去看场电影？
ext.ext_en: Do you fancy going to see a movie sometime?...

defs.def_en: If you fancy something, you want to have it or to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 她相信这不过是他一时兴起。
ext.ext_en: She did not suspect that his interest was just a passing fancy.

defs.def_en: A fancy is a liking or desire for someone or something, especially one that does not last long.

ext.ext_cn: 如果男孩们不喜欢你的话，他们就会狠狠地捉弄你。
ext.ext_en: The boys would tease you to death if they didn't fancy you...

ext.ext_cn: 我想他以为我爱慕他或什么的。
ext.ext_en: I think he thinks I fancy him or something.

defs.def_en: If you fancy someone, you feel attracted to them, especially in a sexual way.

defs.def_cn: 想让自己成为;想让自己做

ext.ext_cn: 这么说，你是想有一天自己当上老板喽？
ext.ext_en: So you fancy yourself as the boss someday?...

ext.ext_cn: 我不想穿褶裥短裙。
ext.ext_en: I didn't fancy myself wearing a kilt.

defs.def_en: If you fancy yourself as a particular kind of person or fancy yourself doing a particular thing, you like the idea of being that kind of person or doing that thing.

defs.def_cn: 以为(自己)是;把(自己)当成

ext.ext_cn: 她自以为是放荡不羁的艺术家。
ext.ext_en: She fancies herself a bohemian...

ext.ext_cn: 她知道费利克斯把他自己当成鉴赏家。
ext.ext_en: She knew Felix fancied himself as a connoisseur.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone fancies themselves (as) a particular kind of person, you mean that they think, often wrongly, that they have the good qualities which that kind of person has.

defs.def_cn: 相信(参赛的某队或某人)会赢

ext.ext_cn: 巴斯队一定会赢，因为他们是英格兰表现最稳定的球队。
ext.ext_en: You have to fancy Bath because they are the most consistent team in England...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为英格兰队会一路胜出。
ext.ext_en: I fancy England to win through.

defs.def_en: If you say that you fancy a particular competitor or team in a competition, you think they will win.

ext.ext_cn: 费里斯抬头向上看，感觉看见一个影子在窗子近旁经过。
ext.ext_en: When Ferris looked up he fancied that he saw a shadow pass close to the window...

ext.ext_cn: 她猜想他正在尽力掩饰笑容。
ext.ext_en: She fancied he was trying to hide a smile.

defs.def_en: If you fancy that something is the case, you think or suppose that it is so.

ext.ext_cn: 他的最后一部书把现实与梦幻大胆糅合在一起，有些地方表现出超现实主义色彩。
ext.ext_en: His last book is a bold, at times surrealistic mixture of fact and fancy.

ext.ext_cn: 儿时的幻想
ext.ext_en: ...a childhood fancy.

defs.def_en: A fancy is an idea that is unlikely, untrue, or imaginary.

defs.def_cn: (表达惊奇或不赞成)真想不到，太意外

ext.ext_cn: 这真是太不得体了。真想不到在他尸骨未寒时就那么说话。
ext.ext_en: It was very tasteless. Fancy talking like that so soon after his death...

ext.ext_cn: “真想不到！”康蒂笑着说。
ext.ext_en: 'Fancy that!' smiled Conti.

defs.def_en: You say 'fancy' or 'fancy that' when you want to express surprise or disapproval.

defs.def_cn: (通常指不知何故就)爱上，喜欢上

ext.ext_cn: 西尔维娅深深爱上了他。
ext.ext_en: Sylvia took quite a fancy to him...

ext.ext_cn: 国王迷上了订购化装用品和面具。
ext.ext_en: The King took a fancy to ordering disguises and masks.

defs.def_en: If you take a fancy to someone or something, you start liking them, usually for no understandable reason.

ext.ext_cn: 她的衣服多是仿照她喜爱的时装自己缝制的。
ext.ext_en: She makes most of her own clothes, copying any fashion which takes her fancy.

defs.def_en: If something takes your fancy or tickles your fancy, you like it a lot when you see it or think of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 它装在一个别致的有漂亮图纹的塑料盒子里。
ext.ext_en: It was packaged in a fancy plastic case with attractive graphics.

ext.ext_cn: 精美的珠宝
ext.ext_en: ...fancy jewellery.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, for example because it has a lot of decoration.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他在阿格瓦姆湖畔拥有一座豪宅。
ext.ext_en: He owned a fancy house out on Lake Agawam...

ext.ext_cn: 他们把我送到一所昂贵的私立学校学习。
ext.ext_en: They sent me to a fancy private school.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is very expensive or of very high quality, and you often dislike it because of this.

defs.def_cn: 无所顾忌的;满不在乎的;逍遥自在的

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢意大利的食物、美酒和人们那种天塌当被盖的心态。
ext.ext_en: I love Italian food and wine and the devil-may-care attitude of the people.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a devil-may-care attitude, you mean that they seem relaxed and do not seem worried about the consequences of their actions.

ext.ext_cn: 蛇是食肉动物。
ext.ext_en: Snakes are carnivorous.

defs.def_en: Carnivorous animals eat meat.
Carnivorous can be used, especially humorously, to describe someone who eats meat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 高温酷热让他大汗淋漓。
ext.ext_en: He was sweating from the intense heat...

ext.ext_cn: 突然,刺眼的强光照亮了整个房间。
ext.ext_en: Suddenly the room filled with intense light...

defs.def_en: Intense is used to describe something that is very great or extreme in strength or degree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 第三名的争夺紧张激烈。
ext.ext_en: The battle for third place was intense...

ext.ext_cn: 双方的武装力量都有密集动作。
ext.ext_en: The military on both sides are involved in intense activity.

defs.def_en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (目光)有穿透力的，洞悉一切的

ext.ext_cn: 在卢克母亲审视的目光下,我感到极不自在。
ext.ext_en: I felt so self-conscious under Luke's mother's intense gaze...

ext.ext_cn: 他用那双深邃的蓝眼睛凝视着我。
ext.ext_en: He gazed at me with those intense blue eyes.

defs.def_en: If you describe the way someone looks at you as intense, you mean that they look at you very directly and seem to know what you are thinking or feeling.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我知道他是个拼命三郎,但他确实喜欢自己所做的事。
ext.ext_en: I know he's an intense player, but he does enjoy what he's doing...

ext.ext_cn: 她比我想象的更高、更成熟、更热切。
ext.ext_en: She is taller than I imagined, more adult, more intense.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as intense, you mean that they appear to concentrate very hard on everything that they do, and they feel and show their emotions in a very extreme way.

defs.def_cn: 诡辩的论点;似是而非的观点

ext.ext_cn: 他们驳斥了“经济学家们似是而非的观点”。
ext.ext_en: They refuted the 'sophistries of the economists'.

defs.def_en: Sophistries are clever arguments that sound convincing but are in fact false.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有油渍的；油污的；涂了油脂的

ext.ext_cn: 油性头发的问题
ext.ext_en: ...the problem of greasy hair...

ext.ext_cn: 他的双肘撑在满是油污的柜台上。
ext.ext_en: He propped his elbows upon a greasy counter.

defs.def_en: Something that is greasy has grease on it or in it.
Brain death occurs when someone's brain stops functioning, even though their heart may be kept beating using a machine.

ext.ext_cn: 贫血症状包括全身疲劳和困乏。
ext.ext_en: Symptoms of anaemia include general fatigue and lassitude.

ext.ext_cn: 阶段性的乏力懒怠
ext.ext_en: ...periods of lassitude and inactivity.

defs.def_en: Lassitude is a state of tiredness, laziness, or lack of interest.

ext.ext_cn: 我参加了在克赖斯特彻奇举办的英联邦运动会，那是我的告别比赛。
ext.ext_en: I competed in the Commonwealth Games in Christchurch, which was my swan song.

defs.def_en: Someone's swan song is the last time that they do something for which they are famous, for example the last time that an actor gives a performance in the theatre.

ext.ext_cn: 哎，这张唱片会激怒一些人的。
ext.ext_en: Oh boy, this record's going to raise a few hackles...

ext.ext_cn: 看得出来，她在听他大致介绍他的计划时很是恼火。
ext.ext_en: You could see her hackles rising as she heard him outline his plan.

defs.def_en: If something raises your hackles or makes your hackles rise, it makes you feel angry and hostile.

defs.def_cn: 老年病学的；老年医学的

ext.ext_cn: 老年保健医学的前景还是一个问号。
ext.ext_en: There is a question mark over the future of geriatric care...

ext.ext_cn: 老年病人将会搬出去。
ext.ext_en: The geriatric patients will be moved out.

defs.def_en: Geriatric is used to describe things relating to the illnesses and medical care of old people.
Geriatrics is the study of the illnesses that affect old people and the medical care of old people.

defs.def_cn: 老家伙，老头子，老朽（可能具有冒犯意味）

ext.ext_cn: 得跟这么一群无聊的老家伙呆在一起，他会满腹牢骚的。
ext.ext_en: He will complain about having to spend time with such a boring bunch of geriatrics.

ext.ext_cn: 怎么能让一群老朽的评委说了算呢？
ext.ext_en: ...how can it be acceptable to have a load of geriatric judges deciding what should happen?

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a geriatric, you are implying that they are old and that their mental or physical condition is poor. This use could cause offence.

defs.def_cn: 预言性事物；借以作出预测的事物

ext.ext_cn: 民意测验并不能对选举结果进行可靠预测。
ext.ext_en: Opinion polls are an unreliable predictor of election outcomes...

ext.ext_cn: 通过观察孩子对新生儿到来的反应能很好预测在接下来的一年中他们会不会相处融洽。
ext.ext_en: The child's reaction to the arrival of the new baby was a very good predictor of how they would get on during the year that followed.

defs.def_en: You can refer to something that helps you predict something that will happen in the future as a predictor of that thing.
Manacles are metal devices attached to a prisoner's wrists or legs in order to prevent him or her from moving or escaping.

ext.ext_cn: 他的双手被铐在了身后。
ext.ext_en: His hands were manacled behind his back...

ext.ext_cn: 他让警察给铐了起来。
ext.ext_en: He was manacled by the police.

defs.def_en: If a prisoner is manacled, their wrists or legs are put in manacles in order to prevent them from moving or escaping.
A soup plate is a deep plate with a wide edge in which soup is served.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 抱有希望的；有信心的；积极的

ext.ext_cn: 要对自己的未来充满信心，继续过一种正常的生活。
ext.ext_en: Be positive about your future and get on with living a normal life...

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫自信大增，不久便重新开始全职工作。
ext.ext_en: Her husband became much more positive and was soon back in full-time employment.

defs.def_en: If you are positive  about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 和姐姐分开对约翰来说有好处。
ext.ext_en: The parting from his sister had a positive effect on John...

ext.ext_cn: 在海外工作对所有相关人员来说都应该是一段让人兴奋而愉快的经历。
ext.ext_en: Working abroad should be an exciting and positive experience for all concerned.

defs.def_en: A positive fact, situation, or experience is pleasant and helpful to you in some way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 应该对动物饲养进行明确的改革。
ext.ext_en: There are positive changes that should be implemented in the rearing of animals...

ext.ext_cn: 人们期待他为1996年奥运会的组织做出积极的贡献。
ext.ext_en: He was expected to make a very positive contribution to the 1996 Games organisation...

defs.def_en: If you make a positive decision or take positive action, you do something definite in order to deal with a task or problem.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 联合国秘书长近期为和平所作出的努力得到了积极的回应。
ext.ext_en: There's been a positive response to the UN Secretary-General's recent peace efforts.

defs.def_en: A positive response to something indicates agreement, approval, or encouragement.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我对它有绝对的把握。
ext.ext_en: I'm as positive as I can be about it...

ext.ext_cn: “她从不迟到，你肯定她说的是8点？”——“肯定。”
ext.ext_en: 'She's never late. You sure she said eight?' — 'Positive.'

defs.def_en: If you are positive about something, you are completely sure about it.

ext.ext_cn: 没有确凿证据证明，摄取维生素A会导致出生缺陷。
ext.ext_en: There was no positive evidence that any birth defects had arisen as a result of Vitamin A intake.

defs.def_en: Positive evidence gives definite proof of the truth or identity of something.

ext.ext_cn: 如果化验结果呈阳性，可能会开一个疗程的抗生素。
ext.ext_en: If the test is positive, a course of antibiotics may be prescribed...

ext.ext_cn: 类固醇检测呈阳性后，他的奥运百米金牌被收回。
ext.ext_en: He was stripped of his Olympic Hundred Metres gold medal after testing positive for steroids.

defs.def_en: If a medical or scientific test is positive, it shows that something has happened or is present.  HIV positive→see: HIV;

defs.def_cn: （强调名词）完完全全的，千真万确的，实实在在的

ext.ext_cn: 你好，伯纳德！见到你真高兴。
ext.ext_en: Good day to you, Bernard! It's a positive delight to see you...

ext.ext_cn: 他确实发怒了。
ext.ext_en: He was in a positive fury...

defs.def_en: See also:positively;You can use positive to emphasize a noun.

ext.ext_cn: 它其实就是正负数的简单数字游戏。
ext.ext_en: It's really a simple numbers game with negative and positive numbers.

defs.def_en: A positive number is greater than zero.
If something has a positive electrical charge, it has the same charge as a proton and the opposite charge to an electron.

ext.ext_cn: 她最终沦为妓女。
ext.ext_en: She eventually drifts into prostitution.

ext.ext_cn: 贩毒和卖淫团伙的头目
ext.ext_en: ...the leader of a drugs and prostitution ring.

defs.def_en: Prostitution means having sex with people in exchange for money.

defs.def_cn: (湖)淡水的;(生物)淡水中生长的

ext.ext_cn: 巴拉顿湖，欧洲最大的淡水湖
ext.ext_en: ...Lake Balaton, the largest freshwater lake in Europe...

ext.ext_cn: 鲈鱼是淡水鱼。
ext.ext_en: The perch is a freshwater fish.

defs.def_en: A freshwater lake contains water that is not salty, usually in contrast to the sea. Freshwater creatures live in water that is not salty.

ext.ext_cn: 著名时尚杂志
ext.ext_en: ...a well-known glossy mag.

defs.def_en: A mag is the same as a magazine.

ext.ext_cn: 他和儿子劳伦斯分吃了一张比萨饼。
ext.ext_en: He shared a pizza with his son Laurence...

ext.ext_cn: 萨姆是埃里克·戴维斯 7 岁的儿子。
ext.ext_en: Sam is the seven-year-old son of Eric Davies...

defs.def_en: Someone's son is their male child.

defs.def_cn: (某地)之子(籍贯为某地的人，尤指名人)

ext.ext_cn: 新奥尔良最著名的人物——路易斯·阿姆斯特朗
ext.ext_en: ...New Orleans's most famous son, Louis Armstrong.

ext.ext_cn: 非洲之子
ext.ext_en: ...sons of Africa.

defs.def_en: A man, especially a famous man, can be described as a son of the place he comes from.

defs.def_cn: 年轻人，孩子(对男孩或比自己年轻的男子的昵称)

ext.ext_cn: 孩子，不要害怕失败。
ext.ext_en: Don't be frightened by failure, son.

defs.def_en: Some people use son as a form of address when they are showing kindness or affection to a boy or a man who is younger than them.

ext.ext_cn: 对他的指控包括诈骗、行贿和伪造商业记录。
ext.ext_en: The charges against him include fraud, bribery, and falsifying business records.

defs.def_en: If someone falsifies something, they change it or add untrue details to it in order to deceive people.

ext.ext_cn: 我仍然记得从栏杆上滑下来的事。
ext.ext_en: I still remember sliding down the banisters.

defs.def_en: A banister is a rail supported by posts and fixed along the side of a staircase. The plural banisters can be used to refer to one of these rails.

defs.def_cn: 结核病的;患结核病的;引发结核病的

ext.ext_cn: 结核病患者
ext.ext_en: ...tubercular patients...

ext.ext_cn: 他死于结核性脑膜炎。
ext.ext_en: He died of tubercular meningitis.

defs.def_en: Tubercular means suffering from, relating to, or causing tuberculosis.

ext.ext_cn: 他是约旦大学的地质学客座教授。
ext.ext_en: He was visiting professor of geology at the University of Jordan.

defs.def_en: Geology is the study of the Earth's structure, surface, and origins.

ext.ext_cn: 研究东南亚地质状况的专家
ext.ext_en: ...an expert on the geology of southeast Asia.

defs.def_en: The geology of an area is the structure of its land, together with the types of rocks and minerals that exist within it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 过度满足的;过多享用的;餍腻的

ext.ext_cn: 尽情享用冰激凌的孩子们
ext.ext_en: ...children happily sated with ice cream.

defs.def_en: If you are sated with something, you have had more of it than you can enjoy at one time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 严重的;危急的;令人担忧的

ext.ext_cn: 犯罪猖獗是俄罗斯社会面临的一个日益严重的问题。
ext.ext_en: Crime is an increasingly serious problem in Russian society...

ext.ext_cn: 政府仍然面临着非常严峻的困难。
ext.ext_en: The government still face very serious difficulties...

defs.def_en: Serious problems or situations are very bad and cause people to be worried or afraid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 重要的;需要认真考虑的;严肃的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为这件事很重要。
ext.ext_en: I regard this as a serious matter...

ext.ext_cn: 小伙子，别笑，这很严肃。
ext.ext_en: Don't laugh boy. This is serious.

defs.def_en: Serious matters are important and deserve careful and thoughtful consideration.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我父母从未认真地正视过我的吸毒问题。
ext.ext_en: My parents never really faced up to my drug use in any serious way...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个值得认真考虑的问题。
ext.ext_en: It was a question which deserved serious consideration.

defs.def_en: When important matters are dealt with in a serious way, they are given careful and thoughtful consideration.

defs.def_cn: (音乐、文学作品)严肃的，非供消遣(或娱乐)的

ext.ext_cn: 严肃的古典音乐
ext.ext_en: ...serious classical music...

ext.ext_cn: 为一部大片写影评时，没必要像为一部严肃小说写书评那样认真谨慎。
ext.ext_en: There is no point reviewing a blockbuster as you might review a serious novel.

defs.def_en: Serious music or literature requires concentration to understand or appreciate it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 认真的;当真的;真心的;郑重其事的

ext.ext_cn: 你这话的确是发自内心的，是不是？
ext.ext_en: You really are serious about this, aren't you?...

ext.ext_cn: 我希望你不是认真的。
ext.ext_en: I hope you're not serious.

defs.def_en: If someone is serious about something, they are sincere about what they are saying, doing, or intending to do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人)若有所思的，庄重的，严肃的

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个非常一本正经的人。
ext.ext_en: He's quite a serious person...

ext.ext_cn: 她睁大眼睛若有所思地看着我。
ext.ext_en: She looked at me with big, serious eyes.

defs.def_en: Serious people are thoughtful and quiet, and do not laugh very often.

ext.ext_cn: 他在 60 年代才开始挣大钱。
ext.ext_en: He started earning serious money only in the sixties.

defs.def_en: Serious money is a very large amount of money.

ext.ext_cn: 20 世纪
ext.ext_en: ...the twentieth century.

defs.def_en: The twentieth item in a series is the one that you count as number twenty.

ext.ext_cn: 即使重量仅有1克的二十分之几都可能是关键性的。
ext.ext_en: A few twentieths of a gram can be critical.

defs.def_en: A twentieth is one of twenty equal parts of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 木柴冒出的烟把亮着灯的大房间弄得烟雾弥漫。
ext.ext_en: The large lamplit room was murky with woodsmoke...

ext.ext_cn: 这发生在11月一个阴沉的下午，斯坦福德桥上。
ext.ext_en: It happened at Stamford Bridge one murky November afternoon.

defs.def_en: A murky place or time of day is dark and rather unpleasant because there is not enough light.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 内斯湖幽深浑浊的湖水
ext.ext_en: ...the deep, murky waters of Loch Ness.

defs.def_en: Murky water or fog is so dark and dirty that you cannot see through it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 暧昧可疑的;不可告人的

ext.ext_cn: 有人策划了一个不可告人的阴谋要将他们排斥在权力中心之外。
ext.ext_en: There has been a murky conspiracy to keep them out of power.

defs.def_en: If you describe an activity or situation as murky, you suspect that it is dishonest or morally wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 含糊不清的;难以理解的

ext.ext_cn: 此处的法律条文有点含糊不清。
ext.ext_en: The law here is a little bit murky...

ext.ext_cn: 骑牛赛没有实际意义，其起源比较令人费解。
ext.ext_en: The origins of bull-riding, which serves no practical purpose, are murkier.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as murky, you mean that the details of it are not clear or that it is difficult to understand.
Vacationers are people who are on vacation in a particular place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （某物的特性或特定方面）令人讨厌的，惹人不快的，让人避而远之的

ext.ext_cn: 然而，很多顾客觉得该产品有一股异味，非常难闻。
ext.ext_en: However, many customers found the smell of this product distinctly off-putting.

defs.def_en: If you describe a quality or feature of something as off-putting, you mean that it makes you dislike that thing or not want to get involved with it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可阻挡的;不容变更的

ext.ext_cn: 看似不可阻挡的失业增长
ext.ext_en: ...the seemingly inexorable rise in unemployment.

ext.ext_cn: 他的身体状况一天不如一天
ext.ext_en: ...his steady, inexorable decline.

defs.def_en: You use inexorable to describe a process which cannot be prevented from continuing or progressing.
Soda water is fizzy water used for mixing with alcoholic drinks and fruit juice.

defs.def_cn: 木栓，软木(一种地中海树皮)

ext.ext_cn: 软木地板
ext.ext_en: ...cork floors.

ext.ext_cn: 软木底木屐
ext.ext_en: ...cork-soled clogs.

defs.def_en: Cork is a soft, light substance which forms the bark of a type of Mediterranean tree.
A cork is a piece of cork or plastic that is pushed into the opening of a bottle to close it.

ext.ext_cn: 与当地妇女同居的逃兵
ext.ext_en: ...the deserters who had shacked up with local women...

ext.ext_cn: 政府非常希望人们能正常结婚而不是未婚同居。
ext.ext_en: The Government was keen for people to get married rather than shack up...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has shacked up with someone else or that two people have shacked up together, you disapprove of the fact that they have started living together as lovers.

defs.def_cn: 不哭的;无泪的;哭不出的

ext.ext_cn: 葬礼上她没有哭,也很镇定。
ext.ext_en: At the funeral she was dry-eyed and composed.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is dry-eyed, you mean that although they are in a very sad situation they are not actually crying.

defs.def_cn: (电视画面的)即时重播，慢镜头回放
defs.def_en: An instant replay is a repeated showing, usually in slow motion, of an event that has just been on television.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她变得很不合作：不愿做作业，也不愿帮着做家务。
ext.ext_en: She became uncooperative: unwilling to do her homework or help with any household chores.

ext.ext_cn: 一群老朽愚昧、乖戾不合作的蠢货
ext.ext_en: ...a bunch of stupid, cranky, uncooperative old fools.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as uncooperative, you mean that they make no effort at all to help other people or to make other people's lives easier.

ext.ext_cn: 教育还处于不断变化中，需要一段时间才能稳定下来。
ext.ext_en: Education remains in a state of flux which will take some time to settle down.

ext.ext_cn: 一段时间的经济波动
ext.ext_en: ...a period of economic flux.

defs.def_en: If something is in a state of flux, it is constantly changing.

ext.ext_cn: 宇宙射线流
ext.ext_en: ...the flux of cosmic rays.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a flowing mass as a flux .

ext.ext_cn: 经济增长 2.25% 的预测
ext.ext_en: ...a forecast of a 2.25 per cent growth in the economy...

ext.ext_cn: 他公布了自己对选举的预测。
ext.ext_en: He delivered his election forecast...

defs.def_en: A forecast is a statement of what is expected to happen in the future, especially in relation to a particular event or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 他们预言首相将遭遇惨败。
ext.ext_en: They forecast a humiliating defeat for the Prime Minister...

ext.ext_cn: 他预测平均工资增幅将保持在 4%左右。
ext.ext_en: He forecasts that average salary increases will remain around 4 per cent.

defs.def_en: See also:weather forecast;If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 刘易斯当时的心情不适合继续下去。
ext.ext_en: Lewis was not in the right frame of mind to continue.

defs.def_en: Your frame of mind is the mood that you are in, which causes you to have a particular attitude to something.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·唐斯巡官
ext.ext_en: ...Insp John Downs.

defs.def_en: Insp .is the written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) Inspector when it is used as a title.

defs.def_cn: 低音吉他手；低音提琴手
defs.def_en: A bassist is someone who plays the bass guitar or the double bass.

defs.def_cn: （注册出生、婚姻或死亡的）登记处，登记办公室
defs.def_en: A register office is a place where births, marriages, and deaths are officially recorded, and where people can get married without a religious ceremony.

ext.ext_cn: 我离开剑桥时，透支了1万英镑。
ext.ext_en: When I left Cambridge I had a £10,000 overdraft...

ext.ext_cn: 银行警告她如果不偿还透支钱款，她将面临诉讼。
ext.ext_en: Her bank warned that unless she repaid the overdraft she could face legal action.

defs.def_en: If you have an overdraft, you have spent more money than you have in your bank account, and so you are in debt to the bank.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 豪华的；奢侈的；富丽堂皇的

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦西区温波尔街上的一间豪华办公室
ext.ext_en: ...an opulent office on Wimpole Street in London's West End.

defs.def_en: Opulent things or places look grand and expensive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 富有的；阔绰的；挥金如土的

ext.ext_cn: 大部分现金都花在了维系他挥金如土的生活方式上。
ext.ext_en: Most of the cash went on supporting his opulent lifestyle.

defs.def_en: Opulent people are very wealthy and spend a lot of money.

ext.ext_cn: 他一个人坐着，抽着一支大雪茄。
ext.ext_en: He was sitting alone smoking a big cigar.

defs.def_en: Cigars are rolls of dried tobacco leaves which people smoke.

ext.ext_cn: 这个血检会显示你是否对这种疾病具有免疫力。
ext.ext_en: This blood test will show whether or not you're immune to the disease...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数成人对风疹具有免疫力。
ext.ext_en: Most adults are immune to Rubella.

defs.def_en: If you are immune to a particular disease, you cannot be affected by it.

ext.ext_cn: 希望这一治疗会激发免疫反应,清除感染了艾滋病病毒的细胞，同时又不损伤未感染细胞。
ext.ext_en: It is hoped the procedure will trigger an immune response that will wipe out HIV-infected cells while leaving non-infected cells unharmed.

defs.def_en: An immune response or reaction is a reaction by the body's immune system to something harmful that is affecting it.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管马克逐渐对贫困现象无动于衷,但他对于死亡的惨象还是不免动容。
ext.ext_en: Whilst Marc did gradually harden himself to the poverty, he did not become immune to the sight of death...

ext.ext_cn: 足球不可能不受到经济衰退的影响。
ext.ext_en: Football is not immune to economic recession.

defs.def_en: If you are immune to something that happens or is done, you are not affected by it.

ext.ext_cn: 德国联邦议院的成员可免受贪腐罪的起诉。
ext.ext_en: Members of the Bundestag are immune from prosecution for corruption...

ext.ext_cn: 谁都难免会有丑闻。
ext.ext_en: No one is immune from scandal.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is immune from a particular process or situation is able to escape it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正密谋发动武装起义。
ext.ext_en: They were plotting to stage an armed insurrection.

ext.ext_cn: 那些被判决犯有谋反叛乱罪的人将被处以终身监禁。
ext.ext_en: Those found guilty of rebellion and insurrection will be sentenced to life imprisonment.

defs.def_en: An insurrection is violent action that is taken by a large group of people against the rulers of their country, usually in order to remove them from office.

ext.ext_cn: “红毛”的绰号源于他的红头发。
ext.ext_en: Red got his nickname for his red hair.

defs.def_en: A nickname is an informal name for someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 当他大一点时，我给他起了个“小阿尔夫”的绰号。
ext.ext_en: When he got older I nicknamed him Little Alf...

ext.ext_cn: 哪家报纸一度被称为“怒吼者”？
ext.ext_en: Which newspaper was once nicknamed The Thunderer?

defs.def_en: If you nickname someone or something, you give them an informal name.

ext.ext_cn: 军队在5月1号又接管了另一长条领土。
ext.ext_en: On May 1st the army took over another swathe of territory...

ext.ext_cn: 年复一年,这个小国家的乡村面积正在一片片地大量消失。
ext.ext_en: Year by year great swathes of this small nation's countryside disappear.

defs.def_en: A swathe of land is a long strip of land.

defs.def_cn: 一长条(尤指用来包裹某人或某物的布料)

ext.ext_cn: 几条白丝缎
ext.ext_en: ...swathes of white silk.

defs.def_en: A swathe of cloth is a long strip of cloth, especially one that is wrapped around someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 她用薄薄的黑色织物裹住了自己硕大的身躯。
ext.ext_en: She swathed her enormous body in thin black fabrics...

ext.ext_cn: 他的头上缠满了一层层用床单撕成的绷带。
ext.ext_en: His head was swathed in bandages made from a torn sheet.

defs.def_en: To swathe someone or something in cloth means to wrap them in it completely.

defs.def_cn: 使遭到严重破坏;使发生巨变

ext.ext_cn: 风暴重创了英格兰南部。
ext.ext_en: The storm cut a swathe through southern England...

ext.ext_cn: 基冈的球队在甲级赛中所向披靡。
ext.ext_en: Keegan's team have been cutting an irresistible swathe through the first division.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing cuts a swathe through something, they pass through it causing great destruction or change.

ext.ext_cn: 人们在街头载歌载舞的民族狂欢节
ext.ext_en: ...a people's carnival, with singing and dancing in the streets.

ext.ext_cn: 传统赞美诗的演唱
ext.ext_en: ...the singing of a traditional hymn...

defs.def_en: Singing is the activity of making musical sounds with your voice.

defs.def_cn: （窗帘、衣服等）有褶子的，带褶边的，有褶饰的
defs.def_en: Ruched curtains or garments are gathered so that they hang in soft folds.

defs.def_cn: （以廉价向会员出租或出售房屋的）住房协会
defs.def_en: A housing association is an organization which owns houses and helps its members to rent or buy them more cheaply than on the open market.

ext.ext_cn: 沃尔什在口袋里摸索着，这是他抽烟时养成的习惯动作。
ext.ext_en: Walsh fumbled in his pocket, a reflex from his smoking days...

ext.ext_cn: 我习惯性地转过身往房子里看了看。
ext.ext_en: I turned to look inside the house in a reflex action.

defs.def_en: A reflex or a reflex action is something that you do automatically and without thinking, as a habit or as a reaction to something.

ext.ext_cn: 如用橡胶槌敲击膝盖或脚跟那样的反射性动作测试
ext.ext_en: ...tests for reflexes, like tapping the knee or the heel with a rubber hammer.

ext.ext_cn: 肾上腺条件反射释放出来的应激荷尔蒙肾上腺素
ext.ext_en: ...the stress hormone adrenaline, released by reflex action from the adrenal glands.

defs.def_en: A reflex or a reflex action is a normal, uncontrollable reaction of your body to something that you feel, see, or experience.

ext.ext_cn: 那需要运动员有高超的技巧、冷静的头脑和迅速的反应能力。
ext.ext_en: It takes great skill, cool nerves and the reflexes of an athlete.

defs.def_en: Your reflexes are your ability to react quickly with your body when something unexpected happens, for example when you are involved in sport or when you are driving a car.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不妥协的；不让步的；坚定的

ext.ext_cn: 撒切尔夫人是一位态度强硬、不轻易妥协的政治家。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Thatcher was a tough and uncompromising politician.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as uncompromising, you mean that they are determined not to change their opinions or aims in any way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 极度血腥的影片
ext.ext_en: ...a film of uncompromising brutality.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as uncompromising, you mean that it does not attempt to make something that is shocking or unpleasant any more acceptable to people.

defs.def_cn: （建筑物、办公室、房间等）开敞式的，大开间的，无隔断的

ext.ext_cn: 该公司的高层管理人员共用一间开敞式办公室。
ext.ext_en: The firm's top managers share the same open-plan office.

defs.def_en: An open-plan building, office, or room has no internal walls dividing it into smaller areas.

ext.ext_cn: 逆他者亡。
ext.ext_en: Woe betide anyone who got in his way.

defs.def_en: If you say woe betide anyone who does a particular thing, you mean that something unpleasant will happen to them if they do it.

defs.def_cn: (若干人或公司组成的)财团，联合企业

ext.ext_cn: 该联合企业包括英国最大的一些建筑承包商。
ext.ext_en: The consortium includes some of the biggest building contractors in Britain.

defs.def_en: A consortium is a group of people or firms who have agreed to co-operate with each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （政变或胜利）不流血的，无伤亡的

ext.ext_cn: 发自该地区的报道表明这是一次不流血的政变。
ext.ext_en: Reports from the area indicate that it was a bloodless coup...

ext.ext_cn: 这场战役应该是速战速决，基本没什么伤亡。
ext.ext_en: The campaign would be short and relatively bloodless.

defs.def_en: A bloodless coup or victory is one in which nobody is killed.

defs.def_cn: （人的面容或肤色）苍白的，无血色的

ext.ext_cn: 她的脸色苍白，没有血色
ext.ext_en: ...her face grey and bloodless.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's face or skin as bloodless, you mean that it is very pale.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有说服力的；令人信服的

ext.ext_cn: 你认为对方哪些观点更有说服力？
ext.ext_en: What do you think were some of the more persuasive arguments on the other side?...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我愿意的话，我会非常有说服力的。
ext.ext_en: I can be very persuasive when I want to be...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is persuasive is likely to persuade a person to believe or do a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 为确保孩子充分摄取营养，通常推荐使用维生素滴剂。
ext.ext_en: To make sure the children are well-nourished, vitamin drops are usually recommended.

ext.ext_cn: 营养不良、破衣烂衫的孤儿
ext.ext_en: ...undernourished and poorly dressed orphans.

defs.def_en: -nourished is used with adverbs such as 'well' or 'under' to indicate how much food someone eats or whether it is the right kind of food.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我坐在楼梯上出神地观望。
ext.ext_en: I sat on the stairs and watched, fascinated...

ext.ext_cn: 新一代科学家对恐龙研究着了迷。
ext.ext_en: A new generation of scientists became fascinated by dinosaurs.

defs.def_en: If you are fascinated by something, you find it very interesting and attractive, and your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

ext.ext_cn: 英国的教育体制
ext.ext_en: ...the British educational system.

ext.ext_cn: 需要特殊教育的学生
ext.ext_en: ...pupils with special educational needs.

defs.def_en: Educational matters or institutions are concerned with or relate to education.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有教育意义的;教育性的

ext.ext_cn: 老师们应该确保孩子们度过愉快而有教育意义的一天。
ext.ext_en: The staff should make sure the kids have an enjoyable and educational day.

defs.def_en: An educational experience teaches you something.
A patrol wagon is a van or truck which the police use for transporting prisoners.

ext.ext_cn: 英国吸收借鉴外来影响的绝好例证
ext.ext_en: ...a perfect illustration of the way Britain absorbs and adapts external influences.

defs.def_en: An illustration is an example or a story which is used to make a point clear.

ext.ext_cn: 她看起来像19世纪插图读物中的公主。
ext.ext_en: She looked like a princess in a nineteenth-century illustration.

defs.def_en: An illustration in a book is a picture, design, or diagram.

ext.ext_cn: 两人都是在近距离扫射中丧命的。
ext.ext_en: Both were killed in a fusillade of bullets fired at close range.

defs.def_en: A fusillade of shots or objects is a large number of them fired or thrown at the same time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指地面或植物）焦干的，焦枯的

ext.ext_cn: 乌云聚涌，倾盆大雨落在焦干的大地上。
ext.ext_en: The clouds gathered and showers poured down upon the parched earth.

ext.ext_cn: 满山的褐色枯草
ext.ext_en: ...a hill of parched brown grass.

defs.def_en: If something, especially the ground or a plant, is parched, it is very dry, because there has been no rain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If your mouth, throat, or lips are parched, they are unpleasantly dry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you say that you are parched, you mean that you are very thirsty.

ext.ext_cn: 这么大的手术实施起来十分困难。
ext.ext_en: An operation of this magnitude is going to be difficult...

ext.ext_cn: 这些问题极为重要。
ext.ext_en: These are issues of great magnitude...

defs.def_en: If you talk about the magnitude of something, you are talking about its great size, scale, or importance.

defs.def_cn: 星等(指星的亮度);震级;(爆炸的)强度

ext.ext_cn: 星等为1.2 的北落师门星
ext.ext_en: ...the 1.2 magnitude star Fomalhaut...

ext.ext_cn: 1906年旧金山地震的震级为8.3级。
ext.ext_en: The San Francisco earthquake of 1906 had a magnitude of 8.3.

defs.def_en: Magnitude is used in stating the size or extent of something such as a star, earthquake, or explosion.

ext.ext_cn: 美俄两国所面临问题的重要性与日本的不可同日而语。
ext.ext_en: America and Russia do not face a problem of the same order of magnitude as Japan.

defs.def_en: You can use order of magnitude when you are giving an approximate idea of the amount or importance of something.

ext.ext_cn: 如果按8个数量级来看，延时量会显得小一些。
ext.ext_en: The time delay would be smaller by eight orders of magnitude.

defs.def_en: In mathematics, if one amount is an order of magnitude larger than another, it is ten times larger than the other. If it is two orders of magnitude larger, it is a hundred times larger.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在商场和政治上)玩弄于腕者，工于心计的人，投机钻营者
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone, especially in business or politics, as a wheeler-dealer, you disapprove of the way that they try to succeed or to get what they want, often by dishonest or unfair methods.

defs.def_cn: （学校、大学或其他机构的）开放日，接待日，参观日
defs.def_en: An open day is a day on which members of the public are encouraged to visit a particular school, university, or other institution to see what it is like.

defs.def_cn: 被任命的人；被委派的人

ext.ext_cn: 贝克特，最高法院新任命的一员
ext.ext_en: ...Becket, a recent appointee to the Supreme Court.

ext.ext_cn: 黛安娜·拉维奇，一个受政府委派负责联邦教育研究的人
ext.ext_en: ...Diane Ravitch, a political appointee in charge of federal education research.

defs.def_en: An appointee is someone who has been chosen for a particular job or position of responsibility.
Merriment means laughter.
An attic is a room at the top of a house just below the roof.

ext.ext_cn: 他们每年对我们进行账务审核，以确保其真实无误。
ext.ext_en: Each year they audit our accounts and certify them as being true and fair.

ext.ext_cn: 银行是在进行内部审计的时候首次发现了这个问题。
ext.ext_en: The bank first learned of the problem when it carried out an internal audit.

defs.def_en: When an accountant audits an organization's accounts, he or she examines the accounts officially in order to make sure that they have been done correctly.

defs.def_cn: 大惊小怪的人;小题大做者

ext.ext_cn: 不用担心，他只不过是在小题大做罢了。
ext.ext_en: Don't worry, he's just being a drama queen.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a drama queen, you mean they react to situations in an unnecessarily dramatic or exaggerated way.

ext.ext_cn: 诺贝尔文学奖
ext.ext_en: ...the Nobel Prize for literature.

defs.def_en: A Nobel Prize is one of a set of prizes that are awarded each year to people who have done important work in science, literature, or economics, or for world peace.

ext.ext_cn: 他冒充成资深心理学家。
ext.ext_en: He passed himself off as a senior psychologist...

ext.ext_cn: 我努力将口音装成女修会学校的口音。
ext.ext_en: I've tried to pass off my accent as a convent school accent.

defs.def_en: If you pass something off as another thing, you convince people that it is that other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他在神学和政治事务上都是最终的仲裁人。
ext.ext_en: He was the ultimate arbiter on both theological and political matters.

ext.ext_cn: 法庭在制定法律过程中担任裁决机构的角色
ext.ext_en: ...the court's role as arbiter in the law-making process.

defs.def_en: An arbiter is a person or institution that judges and settles a quarrel between two other people or groups.

ext.ext_cn: 闪光装饰片经常引起时尚引领者的鄙视。
ext.ext_en: Sequins have often aroused the scorn of arbiters of taste.

defs.def_en: An arbiter of taste or style is someone who has a lot of influence in deciding what is fashionable or socially desirable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 每一件东西都是莫莉灵巧的双手缝制出来的。
ext.ext_en: Everything had been stitched by Molly's nimble fingers...

ext.ext_cn: 脚步轻盈灵活的瓦尔学会了跳探戈舞。
ext.ext_en: Val, who was light and nimble on her feet, learnt to dance the tango.

defs.def_en: Someone who is nimble is able to move their fingers, hands, or legs quickly and easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 机敏的头脑再加上经济学学位作后盾使他对金融问题把握非常准。
ext.ext_en: A nimble mind backed by a degree in economics gave him a firm grasp of financial matters...

ext.ext_cn: 老年人被告知，要想保持头脑灵敏，就必须要多动脑。
ext.ext_en: Elderly people are told that if they want to keep their minds nimble, they must use them.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a nimble mind, you mean they are clever and can think very quickly.

defs.def_cn: 杂乱无章的一堆东西;大杂烩

ext.ext_cn: 这座宫殿完全是各种建筑风格的大杂烩。
ext.ext_en: The palace is a complete hotch-potch of architectural styles.

defs.def_en: A hotch-potch is an untidy mixture of different types of things.

ext.ext_cn: 特拉维夫的国王广场更名为伊扎克·拉宾广场。
ext.ext_en: Tel Aviv's Kings Square was renamed Yitzhak Rabin Square...

ext.ext_cn: 政党领导人说这条街道应该重新命名为自由大道。
ext.ext_en: The party leader said the street should be renamed Freedom Avenue...

defs.def_en: If you rename something, you change its name to a new name.

ext.ext_cn: 工程学的职业培训课程
ext.ext_en: ...a course designed to provide vocational training in engineering...

ext.ext_cn: 职业技术类课程通常能够获得比艺术或哲学类课程更多的重视和资助。
ext.ext_en: Vocational courses are often given more respect and funding than arts or philosophy.

defs.def_en: Vocational training and skills are the training and skills needed for a particular job or profession.

ext.ext_cn: 虚构和现实越来越难以区分了。
ext.ext_en: Fiction and reality were increasingly blurred...

ext.ext_cn: 精神病专家太纠结于理论，无法很好地处理现实问题。
ext.ext_en: Psychiatrists become too caught up in their theories to deal adequately with reality.

defs.def_en: See also:virtual reality;You use reality to refer to real things or the real nature of things rather than imagined, invented, or theoretical ideas.

defs.def_cn: （尤指不愉快的或困难的）真实情况，实际情形

ext.ext_cn: 高层次的国际竞争的严酷现实
ext.ext_en: ...the harsh reality of top international competition...

ext.ext_cn: 其他心理分析师确实接受了儿童性侵犯的现实。
ext.ext_en: Other psychoanalysts do accept the reality of child sexual abuse.

defs.def_en: The reality of a situation is the truth about it, especially when it is unpleasant or difficult to deal with.

defs.def_cn: 现实存在;真实发生的事

ext.ext_cn: 本书成书的整个过程
ext.ext_en: ...the whole procedure that made this book become a reality...

ext.ext_cn: 现状是他们很贫穷。
ext.ext_en: The reality is that they are poor.

defs.def_en: You say that something has become a reality when it actually exists or is actually happening.

ext.ext_cn: 他给人的印象是很适应都市生活，但实际上并非如此。
ext.ext_en: He came across as streetwise, but in reality he was not.

defs.def_en: You can use in reality to introduce a statement about the real nature of something, when it contrasts with something incorrect that has just been described.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 应受责备的;难辞其咎的

ext.ext_cn: 他们不采取任何行动的决定使他们难辞其咎。
ext.ext_en: Their decision to do nothing makes them culpable.

ext.ext_cn: 应该受到处罚的因为疏忽导致的过失杀人罪
ext.ext_en: ...manslaughter resulting from culpable negligence.

defs.def_en: If someone or their conduct is culpable, they are responsible for something wrong or bad that has happened.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是一位严谨的学者，一个真正的学问家。
ext.ext_en: He is a serious scholar, a genuinely learned man.

defs.def_en: A learned person has gained a lot of knowledge by studying.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （书或论文）学者（撰写）的，学问精深的；学术性的

ext.ext_cn: 这部学术性著作应该会引发一场关于西方对波罗的海国家政策的大辩论。
ext.ext_en: This learned book should start a real debate on Western policy towards the Baltics.

defs.def_en: Learned books or papers have been written by someone who has gained a lot of knowledge by studying.

defs.def_cn: 后天的；通过学习（或经验）获得的

ext.ext_cn: 人的焦虑是后天反应，由日常生活中的事件催生和维系。
ext.ext_en: Your anxiety is a learned reaction, and it is nurtured and sustained by the events of your everyday life.

defs.def_en: A learned reaction, response, or ability is one that you acquire from experience or from your environment, not one that you were born with.

ext.ext_cn: 杰克和斯蒂芬正在码头上等他们。
ext.ext_en: Jack and Stephen were waiting for them on the quay.

defs.def_en: A quay is a long platform beside the sea or a river where boats can be tied up and loaded or unloaded.
A grandfather clock is an old-fashioned type of clock in a tall wooden case which stands upright on the floor.

ext.ext_cn: 比较图60中的两幅插图。
ext.ext_en: Compare the two illustrations in Fig 60...

ext.ext_cn: 拿私立学校与州立学校相比，这样公平吗？
ext.ext_en: Was it fair to compare independent schools with state schools?...

defs.def_en: When you compare things, you consider them and discover the differences or similarities between them.  to compare notes→see: note;

ext.ext_cn: 有些评注者把他的作品与詹姆斯·乔伊斯的作品相提并论。
ext.ext_en: Some commentators compared his work to that of James Joyce...

ext.ext_cn: 我只能把这段经历比作坠入爱河。
ext.ext_en: I can only compare the experience to falling in love.

defs.def_en: If you compare one person or thing to another, you say that they are like the other person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的道路安全纪录比欧洲其他国家要好。
ext.ext_en: Our road safety record compares favourably with that of other European countries...

ext.ext_cn: 这两种手法实际运用起来哪个好一些？
ext.ext_en: How do the two techniques compare in terms of application?

defs.def_en: If one thing compares favourably with another, it is better than the other thing. If it compares unfavourably, it is worse than the other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 这儿的花比不上家乡的花。
ext.ext_en: The flowers here do not compare with those at home...

ext.ext_cn: 年代较近的针叶树林场还比不上年代久远的林场。
ext.ext_en: The more recent conifer plantations cannot yet compare with the old woodlands.

defs.def_en: If you say that something does not compare with something else, you mean that it is much worse.

ext.ext_cn: 她是个无与伦比的讲故事高手。
ext.ext_en: She was a storyteller beyond compare.

ext.ext_cn: 无与伦比的财富
ext.ext_en: ...riches beyond compare.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as beyond compare, you mean that it is extremely good or extremely great.

ext.ext_cn: 制动器开始锁定。
ext.ext_en: The brakes began locking...

ext.ext_cn: 一只海鸥突然扑到她的车前，她急忙猛踩刹车。
ext.ext_en: A seagull swooped down in front of her car, causing her to slam on the brakes.

defs.def_en: Brakes are devices in a vehicle that make it go slower or stop.

defs.def_cn: 刹车；用刹车使（车）减速；刹住（车）

ext.ext_cn: 为避免相撞而刹车时，他听到了轮胎与地面刺耳的摩擦声。
ext.ext_en: He heard tires squeal as the car braked to avoid a collision...

ext.ext_cn: 她为了躲另一辆车而紧急刹车。
ext.ext_en: She braked sharply to avoid another car...

defs.def_en: When a vehicle or its driver brakes, or when a driver brakes a vehicle, the driver makes it slow down or stop by using the brakes.

ext.ext_cn: 疾病使他的进展放缓。
ext.ext_en: Illness had put a brake on his progress...

ext.ext_cn: 6月份可以放开金融管制。
ext.ext_en: You can take the financial brakes off in June.

defs.def_en: You can use brake in a number of expressions to indicate that something has slowed down or stopped.

defs.def_cn: 这样的;那样的;上述的;诸如此类的

ext.ext_cn: 以前也有人试图发动政变。我们绝对不能接受这种做法。
ext.ext_en: There have been previous attempts at coups. We regard such methods as entirely unacceptable...

ext.ext_cn: 你说自己感觉是在被迫作选择，确实如此，而这样的选择是自由的附带品。
ext.ext_en: You say you feel that you're being made to choose, and so you are. Such choices as this are a by-product of freedom...

defs.def_en: You use such to refer back to the thing or person that you have just mentioned, or a thing or person like the one that you have just mentioned. You use such as and such...as to introduce a reference to the person or thing that has just been mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 该联盟的每一位成员国都同意采取其认为必要的行动，包括动用武力。
ext.ext_en: Each member of the alliance agrees to take such action as it deems necessary, including the use of armed force...

ext.ext_cn: 英国现在已经不像 20 世纪 80 年代中期那么繁荣昌盛。
ext.ext_en: Britain is not enjoying such prosperity as it was in the mid-1980s.

defs.def_en: You use such...as to link something or someone with a clause in which you give a description of the kind of thing or person that you mean.

ext.ext_cn: 据说他曾经写过《蝗虫之日》和《寂寞芳心小姐》之类的小说。
ext.ext_en: He was said to have written such books as The Day of Locusts and Miss Lonely Hearts.

ext.ext_cn: 教书、护理、美发和餐饮之类的工作
ext.ext_en: ...such careers as teaching, nursing, hairdressing and catering.

defs.def_en: You use such...as to introduce one or more examples of the kind of thing or person that you have just mentioned.

defs.def_cn: (用于名词词组前强调某事的程度或某事了不起)如此，这样，非常

ext.ext_cn: 我想我们大多数人无论如何都不想如此仔细地去读报纸。
ext.ext_en: I think most of us don't want to read what's in the newspaper anyway in such detail...

ext.ext_cn: 人们永远也不会明白为什么这些政治问题会有如此大的影响力。
ext.ext_en: One will never be able to understand why these political issues can acquire such force...

defs.def_en: You use such before noun groups to emphasize the extent of something or to emphasize that something is remarkable.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调程度)如此…，非常…(以至于…)

ext.ext_cn: 天气状况使得对啤酒的需求大增，一家啤酒厂周末要加班了。
ext.ext_en: The weather has brought such a demand for beer that one brewery will operate over the weekend...

ext.ext_cn: 这可以让你挣一大笔钱，而且没有任何赔钱的风险。
ext.ext_en: This is something where you can earn such a lot of money that there is not any risk that you will lose it...

defs.def_en: You use such...that in order to emphasize the degree of something by mentioning the result or consequence of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这次行动破获了这样的地下销赃活动，现在警方可能会因此敦促修改法律。
ext.ext_en: The operation has uncovered such backstreet dealing in stolen property that police might now press for changes in the law.

ext.ext_cn: 他能把观点表达得让艾伦认为那是他自己的主意。
ext.ext_en: He could put an idea in such a way that Alan would believe it was his own.

defs.def_en: You use such...that or such...as in order to say what the result or consequence of something that you have just mentioned is.

defs.def_cn: (用于不想明确指出时)某，某个

ext.ext_cn: 我说：“那么我什么时候才能到利兹?”他说了一个时间，但是我没赶上联运车。
ext.ext_en: I said, 'Well what time'll I get to Leeds?' and he said such and such a time but I missed my connection...

ext.ext_cn: 他们被告知我们已经拿到了这笔钱并将用它来做什么。
ext.ext_en: They're informed that we've got this money to spend and we will do such and such with it.

defs.def_en: You use such and such to refer to a thing or person when you do not want to be exact or precise.

defs.def_cn: 就是这样;就是如此;就是这么回事儿

ext.ext_cn: 我的马桶堵死了，脏水全都涌到屋子里，家里脏得一塌糊涂，情况就是这样。
ext.ext_en: Well my toilet's all blocked up and I've got it all coming into my flat and it'll ruin my home, such as it is...

ext.ext_cn: 如今波澜不惊的英国妇女运动提出要在下议院发表演讲的计划。
ext.ext_en: The British Women's Movement, such as it is these days, came up with a programme of speeches at the House of Commons.

defs.def_en: You use such as it is or such as they are to suggest that the thing you have just mentioned is not very good, important, or useful.

defs.def_cn: (与否定词连用)严格来说，真正意义上

ext.ext_cn: 严格说来，我并不完全是一个初学者——几年前我经常骑自行车。
ext.ext_en: I am not a learner as such —I used to ride a bike years ago...

ext.ext_cn: 马克在14岁的时候以勤杂员的身份进入公司，他当时根本就没有任何学历。
ext.ext_en: Mark joined as an office boy at the age of fourteen with no academic qualifications as such at all...

defs.def_en: You use as such with a negative to indicate that a word or expression is not a very accurate description of the actual situation.

ext.ext_cn: 房价很容易受与地产本身无关的因素所影响。东南部房价的下跌很大程度上是由于抵押贷款利率的上涨所引起的。
ext.ext_en: House prices are easily upset by factors which have nothing to do with property as such. The fall in prices in the South-East results largely from the high rate of interest on mortgages...

ext.ext_cn: 西蒙先生说他对税收本身并不反对，“但是我反对以虚假不实的理由巧立明目收税，”他说。
ext.ext_en: Mr Simon said he was not against taxes as such, 'but I do object when taxation is justified on spurious or dishonest grounds,' he says.

defs.def_en: You use as such after a noun to indicate that you are considering that thing on its own, separately from other things or factors.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自鸣得意的;沾沾自喜的

ext.ext_cn: 你也太自鸣得意了。
ext.ext_en: You're so bloody self-satisfied...

ext.ext_cn: 她得意地笑着把雪茄给贾森递了回去。
ext.ext_en: She handed the cigar back to Jason with a self-satisfied smile.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as self-satisfied, you mean that they are too pleased with themselves about their achievements or their situation and they think that nothing better is possible.

defs.def_cn: 提供生活来源的人;赖以为生的手段

ext.ext_cn: 他选的这一行是不可能赖以为生的。
ext.ext_en: His chosen field was unlikely to be a meal ticket for life...

ext.ext_cn: 我无意供养任何人。
ext.ext_en: I don't intend to be a meal-ticket for anyone.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is a meal ticket, you mean that they provide a person with money or a lifestyle which they would not otherwise have.

ext.ext_cn: 很多病人没有得到他们需要的医治。
ext.ext_en: Many patients are not getting the medical treatment they need.

ext.ext_cn: 专门诊治笼养鸟类的兽医
ext.ext_en: …a veterinary surgeon who specialises in the treatment of cage birds.

defs.def_en: Treatment is medical attention given to a sick or injured person or animal.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不想要任何特殊待遇。
ext.ext_en: We don't want any special treatment...

ext.ext_cn: 金尼起初因他对待克丽丝的态度而怒火中烧，后来这种愤怒慢慢沉淀为了憎恶。
ext.ext_en: Ginny's initial rage at his treatment of Chris had simmered down to resentment.

defs.def_en: Your treatment of someone is the way you behave towards them or deal with them.

ext.ext_cn: 污水排放之前应该进行更充分的处理。
ext.ext_en: There should be greater treatment of sewage before it is discharged...

ext.ext_cn: 跟所有油性头发的护理一样，必须要先用洗发露。
ext.ext_en: As with all oily hair treatments, shampoo needs to be applied first.

defs.def_en: Treatment of something involves putting a particular substance onto or into it, in order to clean it, to protect it, or to give it special properties.

defs.def_cn: 盛情款待;特别严厉的对待

ext.ext_cn: 如果你有朋友或家人要过来住，那就搞得特别一些，给予他们以热情款待。
ext.ext_en: If you've got friends or family coming to stay, make it really special by giving them the full treatment...

ext.ext_cn: 她将被审问，监禁，然后再被提审，接受通常所说的“全套款待”。
ext.ext_en: She'll be interrogated, jailed, interrogated again, get what's usually known as the full treatment.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is given the full treatment, you mean either that they are treated extremely well or that they are treated extremely severely.

defs.def_cn: （建筑物、房间等的）居住者，使用者

ext.ext_cn: 大部分住户在火灾发生前就已经离开。
ext.ext_en: Most of the occupants had left before the fire broke out...

ext.ext_cn: 那些文件柜都被之前的用户搬了个精光。
ext.ext_en: The filing cabinets had all gone with the previous occupants.

defs.def_en: The occupants of a building or room are the people who live or work there.

defs.def_cn: （某一时刻房间、交通工具、床等的）占用者

ext.ext_cn: 他想让车上的乘客下车。
ext.ext_en: He wanted the occupants of the vehicle to get out...

ext.ext_cn: 救生艇倾覆，艇里的人被掀入水中。
ext.ext_en: The lifeboat capsized, throwing the occupants into the water.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the people who are in a place such as a room, vehicle, or bed at a particular time as the occupants.

ext.ext_cn: 除了购置所用开支，洗碗机实际上能为你省钱。
ext.ext_en: Apart from the capital outlay of buying the machine, dishwashers can actually save you money...

ext.ext_cn: 初学者只需每月花上100到120英镑便能真正享受到这种爱好带来的乐趣。
ext.ext_en: A beginner could really enjoy the hobby for an outlay of between £100 or £120 a month.

defs.def_en: Outlay is the amount of money that you have to spend in order to buy something or start a project.

ext.ext_cn: 第一次空袭警报和空袭警报解除信号之间间隔了 15 分钟。
ext.ext_en: There were 15 minutes between the first air raid alert and the sounding of the all-clear signal.

defs.def_en: The sounding of a bell or a horn is the act of causing it to make a sound.

ext.ext_cn: 在决定行动方针之前，她会对人们的愿望作一番调查。
ext.ext_en: She will take soundings of the people's wishes before deciding on a course of action.

ext.ext_en: Audiences were going to be polled on which of three pieces of contemporary music they liked best...

defs.def_en: If you are polled on something, you are asked what you think about it as part of a survey.

defs.def_en: Gestation is the process in which an idea or plan develops.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If something is feathery, it has an edge divided into a lot of thin parts so that it looks soft.

defs.def_en: If you say that a business, product, or investment is a money-maker, you mean that it makes a big profit.

ext.ext_en: Protons are nearly 2000 times as heavy as electrons.

ext.ext_en: The waters continue to rise as more than 1,000 people are evacuated.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He is especially emphatic about the value of a precise routine.

defs.def_en: If you are emphatic about something, you use forceful language which shows that you feel very strongly about what you are saying.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Yesterday's emphatic victory was their fifth in succession.

ext.ext_en: Altogether, it was a delightful town garden, peaceful and secluded.

ext.ext_en: The shuttle programme has now been mothballed to save money.

defs.def_en: If you learn something, you obtain knowledge or a skill through studying or training.

ext.ext_cn: 一直到他死后她才知道他和贝蒂有染。
ext.ext_en: It was only after his death that she learned of his affair with Betty...

ext.ext_cn: 燃油和冷却系统是造成故障的最常见的原因，这一点不奇怪。
ext.ext_en: It didn't  come as a shock to learn that the fuel and cooling systems are the most common causes of breakdown...

defs.def_en: If you learn of something, you find out about it.

defs.def_cn: 学会（以某种方式行事或反应）

ext.ext_cn: 你要学会面对自己的问题。
ext.ext_en: You have to learn to face your problem...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在学习如何直面死亡，而非回避死亡这一现实。
ext.ext_en: We are learning how to confront death instead of avoiding its reality.

defs.def_en: If people learn to behave or react in a particular way, they gradually start to behave in that way as a result of a change in attitudes.

ext.ext_cn: 我深信他已从错误中吸取了教训。
ext.ext_en: I am convinced that he has learned from his mistakes...

ext.ext_cn: 公司未能从这次经历中吸取任何教训。
ext.ext_en: The company failed to learn any lessons from this experience.

defs.def_en: If you learn from an unpleasant experience, you change the way you behave so that it does not happen again or so that, if it happens again, you can deal with it better.

ext.ext_cn: 他在得克萨斯监狱服刑时学会了这首歌。
ext.ext_en: He learned this song as an inmate at a Texas prison.

defs.def_en: If you learn something such as a poem or a role in a play, you study or repeat the words so that you can remember them.

defs.def_cn: 东方人；东部人；（尤指）美国东海岸人
defs.def_en: An easterner is a person who was born in or who lives in the eastern part of a place or country, especially an American from the East Coast of the USA.

ext.ext_cn: 这辆车报废了，但人员全部安全逃离。
ext.ext_en: The car was a write-off, but everyone escaped unharmed.

defs.def_en: Something such as a vehicle that is a write-off has been so badly damaged in an accident that it is not worth repairing.

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯先生说服银行同意注销一大笔债务。
ext.ext_en: Mr James persuaded the banks to accept a large write-off of debt.

defs.def_en: A write-off is the decision by a company or government to accept that they will never recover a debt or an amount of money that has been spent on something.

defs.def_cn: 失败的计划;白费的时间

ext.ext_cn: 今天对我来说真的有点儿白白浪费了。
ext.ext_en: Today was really a bit of a write-off for me...

ext.ext_cn: 对他来说，这个十年所余下的时间是一段创作空白。
ext.ext_en: For him, the rest of the decade was a creative write-off.

defs.def_en: If you describe a plan or period of time as a write-off, you mean that it has been a failure and you have achieved nothing.
In small towns in the United States, the street where most of the shops are is often called Main Street .

defs.def_cn: （新闻用语，指居住在小城镇的或并不富裕的）普通大众，老百姓

ext.ext_cn: 这次金融危机对老百姓的影响更为深远。
ext.ext_en: This financial crisis had a much greater impact on Main Street.

defs.def_en: Main Street is used by journalists to refer to the ordinary people of America who live in small towns rather than big cities or are not very rich.

ext.ext_cn: 普赛尔逝世 300 周年纪念日
ext.ext_en: ...the tercentenary of Purcell's death.

defs.def_en: A tercentenary is a day or a year which is exactly three hundred years after an important event such as the birth of a famous person.
Bipolar disorder is a mental illness in which a person's state of mind changes between extreme happiness and extreme depression.
In the Bible, a seraph is a kind of angel.

defs.def_cn: （养老院及旧时医院中的）女护士长

ext.ext_cn: 养老院的护士长说她愿意参加。
ext.ext_en: The Matron at the nursing home expressed a wish to attend...

ext.ext_cn: 你告诉护士长了吗？
ext.ext_en: Have you told Matron?

defs.def_en: The matron in a nursing home is the woman who is in charge of all the nurses. In the past, the woman in charge of the nurses in a hospital was also called a matron.

ext.ext_cn: 女舍监人很善良，但做事干脆利落、风风火火。
ext.ext_en: Matron was quite kind but brisk and hurried.

ext.ext_cn: 预备学校里的女舍监
ext.ext_en: ...a prep school matron.

defs.def_en: In boarding schools, the matron is the woman who looks after the health of the children.

defs.def_cn: (医院等机构的)女负责人，女总管;(监狱的)女看管，女看守
defs.def_en: The matron in a hospital or other institution is the woman who is in charge of domestic matters. Matron is also used to refer to a female officer in a prison.
People sometimes refer to middle-aged women as matrons .

ext.ext_cn: 另一个在约克郡盛行的民间传统是做泡菜和酸辣酱。
ext.ext_en: Another strong Yorkshire country tradition is making pickles and chutneys.

defs.def_en: Pickles are vegetables or fruit, sometimes cut into pieces, which have been kept in vinegar or salt water for a long time so that they have a strong, sharp taste.

ext.ext_cn: 一罐罐菜酱
ext.ext_en: ...jars of pickle.

defs.def_en: Pickle is a cold spicy sauce with pieces of vegetables and fruit in it.

ext.ext_cn: 挑选最喜欢的水果或蔬菜，趁着新鲜把它们腌起来。
ext.ext_en: Select your favourite fruit or veg and pickle them while they are still fresh...

ext.ext_cn: 鲱鱼可以盐腌、熏制和泡制。
ext.ext_en: Herrings can be salted, smoked and pickled.

defs.def_en: When you pickle food, you keep it in vinegar or salt water so that it does not go bad and it develops a strong, sharp taste.

ext.ext_cn: 公司在市场发生变化时会发现自己身陷困境。
ext.ext_en: Companies find themselves in a pickle when their markets change...

ext.ext_cn: 卡罗琳这次真是惹了大麻烦。
ext.ext_en: Caroline had sure as hell got herself into a pickle this time.

defs.def_en: If you are in a pickle, you are in a difficult and awkward situation.

defs.def_cn: 迷(尤指对某位名人或某项体育运动极为喜爱和感兴趣的人)

ext.ext_cn: 如果你是比利·克里斯托的影迷，你会喜爱这部影片。
ext.ext_en: If you're a Billy Crystal fan, you'll love this movie...

ext.ext_cn: 小时候，他是曼联队的球迷。
ext.ext_en: As a boy he was a Manchester United fan...

defs.def_en: If you are a fan of someone or something, especially a famous person or a sport, you like them very much and are very interested in them.
A fan is a flat object that you hold in your hand and wave in order to move the air and make yourself feel cooler.

ext.ext_cn: 她只得在卡车里等着，用一块纸板给自己扇风。
ext.ext_en: She would have to wait in the truck, fanning herself with a piece of cardboard...

ext.ext_cn: 天气太热了，莫不停地给我拿饮料出来，还拿扇子给我扇风。
ext.ext_en: Mo kept bringing me out refreshments and fanning me as it was that hot.

defs.def_en: If you fan yourself or your face when you are hot, you wave a fan or other flat object in order to make yourself feel cooler.

ext.ext_cn: 他在电扇前让自己凉快些。
ext.ext_en: He cools himself in front of an electric fan.

ext.ext_cn: 排风扇
ext.ext_en: ...an extractor fan.

defs.def_en: A fan is a piece of electrical or mechanical equipment with blades that go round and round. It keeps a room or machine cool or gets rid of unpleasant smells.

ext.ext_cn: 它扇形的尾羽
ext.ext_en: ...its fan of tail feathers.

ext.ext_cn: 有华丽扇形屋顶的温室
ext.ext_en: ...a conservatory with an ornate fan-shaped roof.

defs.def_en: You can describe anything that has the shape of a wide 'V' with a curved part above it as a fan .

ext.ext_cn: 老玛丽亚跪在壁炉前的空地上，扇着闷燃的炉火。
ext.ext_en: Kneeling in front of the open hearth, old Maria was fanning the smoldering fire...

ext.ext_cn: 下午，热风使火苗越燃越旺。
ext.ext_en: During the afternoon, hot winds fan the flames.

defs.def_en: If you fan a fire, you wave something flat next to it in order to make it burn more strongly. If a wind fans a fire, it blows on it and makes it burn more strongly.

defs.def_cn: (故意)煽动，激发(恐惧、仇恨、热情等)

ext.ext_cn: 他说学生们的暴力抗议会煽动起社会动乱。
ext.ext_en: He said students were fanning social unrest with their violent protests.

ext.ext_cn: 那些常常煽起仇恨的经济问题
ext.ext_en: ...economic problems which often fan hatred.

defs.def_en: If someone fans an emotion such as fear, hatred, or passion, they deliberately do things to make people feel the emotion more strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 英、美、法部队的主力已经向西面散开。
ext.ext_en: The main body of British, American, and French troops had fanned out to the west...

ext.ext_cn: 我们三三两两从农舍散去。
ext.ext_en: We fanned out from the farmhouse in twos and threes.

defs.def_en: If a group of people or things fan out, they move forwards away from a particular point in different directions.

defs.def_cn: (使)展开(或打开)成圆形(或半圆形)

ext.ext_cn: 她突然举起双臂旋转起来，连衣裙的裙身呈圆形完全展开，明艳照人。
ext.ext_en: She suddenly raised her arms and spun, so the dress's full skirt fanned out in a bright circle...

ext.ext_cn: 科龙奇斯慢慢抬起手，一张一张地把牌展开。
ext.ext_en: Korontzis picked up his hand slowly and fanned out the cards one by one...

defs.def_en: If something fans out, or if you fan it out, it spreads out or opens out into the shape of a circle or half circle.

defs.def_cn: 单个地;单独地;一个接一个地

ext.ext_cn: 他们一个一个地或成双成对地走出来。
ext.ext_en: They marched out singly or in pairs...

ext.ext_cn: 病人一个接一个地进入诊疗室。
ext.ext_en: Patients went singly into the consulting room.

defs.def_en: If people do something singly, they each do it on their own, or do it one by one.

ext.ext_cn: 按照他的要求，代表们起立唱国歌。
ext.ext_en: At his bidding, the delegates rose and sang the national anthem.

defs.def_en: If you do something at someone's bidding, you do it because they have asked you to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 她很善于让男人听她的吩咐！
ext.ext_en: She is very clever at getting men to do her bidding!

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does another person's bidding, you disapprove of the fact that they do exactly what the other person asks them to do, even when they do not want to.

ext.ext_cn: 含各种钠盐的水溶液
ext.ext_en: ...an aqueous solution containing various sodium salts.

ext.ext_cn: 药店出售的水质乳液之类的香皂替代品
ext.ext_en: ...a soap substitute such as an aqueous cream, available from chemists.

defs.def_en: In chemistry, an aqueous solution or cream has water as its base.

ext.ext_cn: 唯独她俏皮的眼神使事情露馅儿了。
ext.ext_en: The only giveaway was the look of amusement in her eyes.

defs.def_en: A giveaway is something that makes you realize the truth about a particular person or situation.

defs.def_cn: （通常为吸引顾客而派发的）赠品

ext.ext_cn: 下周，《今日》杂志将举行庆祝活动，免费赠送大量花种。
ext.ext_en: Next week TODAY is celebrating with a great giveaway of FREE garden seeds.

defs.def_en: A giveaway is something that a company or organization gives to someone, usually in order to encourage people to buy a particular product.

ext.ext_cn: 随处都能买到价格低廉而质量上乘的酒和食品。
ext.ext_en: Wine and food of superlative quality are available everywhere at giveaway prices.

defs.def_en: When you talk about giveaway prices, you are emphasizing that the prices are very low.

ext.ext_cn: 鞋上的擦痕很难除掉。
ext.ext_en: Scuff marks from shoes are difficult to remove.

defs.def_en: Scuff marks are marks made on a smooth surface when something is rubbed against it.
The dashboard in a car is the panel facing the driver's seat where most of the instruments and switches are.
An exercise book is a small book that students use for writing in.

ext.ext_cn: 最近几天的交战结束了，双方达成了暂时的休战协议。
ext.ext_en: The fighting of recent days has given way to an uneasy truce between the two sides...

ext.ext_cn: 我们别争论了。
ext.ext_en: Let's call a truce.

defs.def_en: A truce is an agreement between two people or groups of people to stop fighting or quarrelling for a short time.

ext.ext_cn: 她猛地掉转车头，往回开。
ext.ext_en: Making a sharp U-turn, she headed back...

ext.ext_cn: 最后，他驶离主道，来了一个急掉头。
ext.ext_en: Eventually, he turned off the main route and suddenly did a U-turn.

defs.def_en: If you make a U-turn when you are driving or cycling, you turn in a half circle in one movement, so that you are then going in the opposite direction.

defs.def_cn: （政治家在政策、计划、行动方面的）180度大转弯，彻底转变

ext.ext_cn: 首相极不光彩的180度大转变
ext.ext_en: ...a humiliating U-turn by the Prime Minister.

ext.ext_cn: 他在经济政策和煤窑关闭方面的那些180度大转变
ext.ext_en: ...the U-turns he made on economic policy and pit closures.

defs.def_en: If you describe a change in a politician's policy, plans, or actions as a U-turn, you mean that it is a complete change and that they made the change because they were weak or were wrong.
If you stand arms akimbo or with arms akimbo, you stand with your hands on your hips and your elbows pointing outwards.
A locker room is a room in which there are a lot of lockers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 肮脏的工业城市
ext.ext_en: ...a grimy industrial city.

defs.def_en: Something that is grimy is very dirty.

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯托弗指责我太宠着安德鲁。
ext.ext_en: Christopher accused me of mollycoddling Andrew.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of mollycoddling someone else, you are critical of them for doing too many things for the other person and protecting them too much from unpleasant experiences.

defs.def_cn: (出于政治目的而非为查明真相而进行的)作秀审判

ext.ext_cn: 对持不同政见者的审判秀
ext.ext_en: ...the show trials of political dissidents.

defs.def_en: People describe a trial as a show trial if they believe that the trial is unfair and is held for political reasons rather than in order to find out the truth.

ext.ext_cn: 住宿免费——你只需付早餐和正餐的钱。
ext.ext_en: Accommodation is free — all you pay for is breakfast and dinner...

ext.ext_cn: 我们每张票付了35英镑。
ext.ext_en: We paid £35 for each ticket...

defs.def_en: When you pay an amount of money to someone, you give it to them because you are buying something from them or because you owe it to them. When you pay something such as a bill or a debt, you pay the amount that you owe.

ext.ext_cn: 那位律师薪酬很高。
ext.ext_en: The lawyer was paid a huge salary...

ext.ext_cn: 我按月领工资。
ext.ext_en: I get paid monthly...

defs.def_en: When you are paid, you get your wages or salary from your employer.

ext.ext_cn: 他们对薪水和工作条件的不满
ext.ext_en: ...their complaints about their pay and conditions.

ext.ext_cn: 工人要求加薪20%
ext.ext_en: ...the workers' demand for a twenty per cent pay rise.

defs.def_en: Your pay is the money that you get from your employer as wages or salary.  →see usage note at:salary

ext.ext_cn: 学生们得到了一大笔钱，而所要做的就是整天躺在床上什么也不做。
ext.ext_en: Students were paid substantial sums of money to do nothing all day but lie in bed...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你帮我，你要多少钱我都给。
ext.ext_en: If you help me, I'll pay you anything.

defs.def_en: If you are paid to do something, someone gives you some money so that you will help them or perform some service for them.

defs.def_cn: （政府或机构通过提高价格、税率等使某人）为…买单

ext.ext_cn: 规定谁该为环境破坏买单的有法律约束力的国际条约
ext.ext_en: ...a legally binding international treaty that establishes who must pay for environmental damage...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你不为芭蕾和歌剧提供补贴，就得提高剧场票价来为此买单。
ext.ext_en: If you don't subsidize ballet and opera, seat prices will have to go up to pay for it.

defs.def_en: If a government or organization makes someone pay for something, it makes them responsible for providing the money for it, for example by increasing prices or taxes.

defs.def_cn: （工作、交易或投资）有…报酬，产生…利润

ext.ext_cn: 我们深陷在工资低廉的工作中。
ext.ext_en: We're stuck in jobs that don't pay very well...

ext.ext_cn: 这个账户的贷方余额没有利息。
ext.ext_en: The account does not pay interest on a credit balance.

defs.def_en: If a job, deal, or investment pays a particular amount, it brings you that amount of money.

defs.def_cn: （工作、交易或投资）有收益，盈利

ext.ext_cn: 现在有些机构专门帮助年龄较大的人找有报酬的工作。
ext.ext_en: There are some agencies now specialising in helping older people to find jobs which pay...

ext.ext_cn: 他们拥有土地；他们让土地生钱。
ext.ext_en: They owned land; they made it pay.

defs.def_en: If a job, deal, or investment pays, it brings you a profit or earns you some money.

ext.ext_cn: 他往自己的储蓄账户上存了20英镑。
ext.ext_en: He paid £20 into his savings account...

ext.ext_cn: 没有比你只想存几张支票还得排队更令人恼火的了。
ext.ext_en: There is nothing more annoying than queueing when you only want to pay in a few cheques.

defs.def_en: When you pay money into a bank account, you put the money in the account.

ext.ext_cn: 在防护服上投资是值得的。
ext.ext_en: It pays to invest in protective clothing...

ext.ext_cn: 他谈到了保卫小国家，绝不让侵略得逞。
ext.ext_en: He talked of defending small nations, of ensuring that aggression does not pay.

defs.def_en: If a course of action pays, it results in some advantage or benefit for you.

ext.ext_cn: 英国将为缺乏决心付出惨痛的代价。
ext.ext_en: Britain was to pay dearly for its lack of resolve...

ext.ext_cn: 为什么我要代人受过？
ext.ext_en: Why should I pay the penalty for somebody else's mistake?...

defs.def_en: If you pay for something that you do or have, you suffer as a result of it.

defs.def_cn: （与某些名词连用，表示施予某物或做某事）进行（访问）/给予（注意）

ext.ext_cn: 下次你来伯明翰一定要来看看我们。
ext.ext_en: Do pay us a visit next time you're in Birmingham...

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得起了个大包，但是没有理会。
ext.ext_en: He felt a heavy bump, but paid no attention to it...

defs.def_en: You use pay with some nouns, for example in the expressions pay a visit and pay attention, to indicate that something is given or done.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司已在比利时、西班牙和德国设立了合资付费电视频道。
ext.ext_en: The company has set up joint-venture pay-TV channels in Belgium, Spain, and Germany.

defs.def_en: Pay television consists of programmes and channels which are not part of a public broadcasting system, and for which people have to pay.

ext.ext_cn: 将在5年内收回成本的能效投资
ext.ext_en: ...investments in energy efficiency that would pay for themselves within five years.

defs.def_en: If something that you buy or invest in pays for itself after a period of time, the money you gain from it, or save because you have it, is greater than the amount you originally spent or invested.

ext.ext_cn: 他在一场总统竞选集会上被毒品贩子雇用的枪手谋杀了。
ext.ext_en: He was murdered at a presidential rally by gunmen in the pay of drug traffickers.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in the pay of a certain person or group, you disapprove of the fact that they are being paid by and are working for that person or group, often secretly or illegally.

ext.ext_cn: 总之我上了大学，半工半读，自食其力。
ext.ext_en: I went to college anyway, as a part-time student, paying my own way...

ext.ext_cn: 没有广阔的出口市场，英国电影工业无以为继。
ext.ext_en: The British film industry could not pay its way without a substantial export market.

defs.def_en: If you pay your way, you have or earn enough money to pay for what you need, without needing other people to give or lend you money.

defs.def_cn: 假山花园;岩石庭园;假山园林
defs.def_en: A rock garden is a garden which consists of rocks with small plants growing among them.

ext.ext_cn: 登上月球的第一人
ext.ext_en: ...the first man on the moon...

ext.ext_cn: 月亮不会出来了。
ext.ext_en: There will be no moon.

defs.def_en: See also:new moon;The moon is the object that you can often see in the sky at night. It goes round the Earth once every four weeks, and as it does so its appearance changes from a circle to part of a circle.

ext.ext_cn: 海王星的大卫星
ext.ext_en: ...Neptune's large moon.

defs.def_en: A moon is an object similar to a small planet that travels around a planet.

defs.def_cn: 虚度光阴;懒散度日;闲逛

ext.ext_cn: 莱蒂混了一上午，什么也没干。
ext.ext_en: Lettie was mooning around all  morning, doing nothing...

ext.ext_cn: 上班时我在他的部门转来转去，暗中寻找巧遇他的机会。
ext.ext_en: My working days were spent mooning round his department, trying to sneak a chance encounter.

defs.def_en: If you are mooning around, you are spending time doing nothing in particular, for example because you feel unhappy or lazy, or are worried about something.
If you moon at someone, you turn your back to them and show them your bare bottom.

ext.ext_cn: 极少会碰到麻烦。
ext.ext_en: Once in a blue moon you get some problems.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens once in a blue moon, you are emphasizing that it does not happen very often at all.

defs.def_cn: 非常高兴;乐翻了天;狂喜
defs.def_en: If you say that you are over the moon, you mean that you are very pleased about something.

ext.ext_cn: 我不知道家人是生是死，感觉自己茫然无措。
ext.ext_en: I didn't know whether my family was alive or dead. I felt as if I was in limbo...
