ext.ext_cn: 金发细腰的她太引人注目了，他们很难不注意到她。
ext.ext_en: Blonde and slender, she was too striking to escape their attention.

defs.def_en: If something escapes you or escapes your attention, you do not know about it, do not remember it, or do not notice it.

defs.def_cn: （气体、液体、热量等）泄露，逸出，露出

ext.ext_cn: 打开一个通风口，让潮气逸出一些。
ext.ext_en: Leave a vent open to let some moist air escape.

defs.def_en: When gas, liquid, or heat escapes, it comes out from a pipe, container, or place.

ext.ext_cn: 乘渡船横渡海湾的短途旅行
ext.ext_en: ...a short ferry ride across the bay.

ext.ext_cn: 孟加拉海湾
ext.ext_en: ...the Bay of Bengal.

defs.def_en: A bay is a part of a coast where the land curves inwards.

ext.ext_cn: 动物们被赶到一个隔间里，然后进行宰杀。
ext.ext_en: The animals are herded into a bay, then butchered...

ext.ext_cn: 汽车倒入装卸间。
ext.ext_en: The car reversed into the loading bay.

defs.def_en: A bay is a partly enclosed area, inside or outside a building, that is used for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 在飞机的货舱里
ext.ext_en: ...in the cargo bays of aircraft.

defs.def_en: On an aircraft or ship, a bay is a section that is used for carrying cargo or equipment.

defs.def_cn: （建筑物的）凸出部分；（尤指）飘窗，凸窗
defs.def_en: A bay is an area of a room which extends beyond the main walls of a house, especially an area with a large window at the front of a house.
A bay horse is reddish-brown in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 裁判对要求判罚点球的叫喊声不予理睬。
ext.ext_en: The referee ignored voices baying for a penalty.

ext.ext_cn: 反对派的政治家们一直呼吁对其严惩。
ext.ext_en: Opposition politicians have been baying for his blood.

defs.def_en: If a number of people are baying for something, they are demanding something angrily, usually that someone should be punished.

ext.ext_cn: 一只狗突然对着月亮狂吠不止。
ext.ext_en: A dog suddenly howled, baying at the moon.

defs.def_en: If a dog or wolf bays, it makes loud, long cries.

ext.ext_cn: 吃橘子可以预防感冒。
ext.ext_en: Eating oranges keeps colds at bay...

ext.ext_cn: 手持棒球棒的囚犯们挟持了人质，使警察无法靠近。
ext.ext_en: Prisoners armed with baseball bats used the hostages to hold police at bay.

defs.def_en: If you keep something or someone at bay, or hold them at bay, you prevent them from reaching, attacking, or affecting you.

ext.ext_cn: 他接受了剑桥大学的研究员一职。
ext.ext_en: He has accepted a research professorship at Cambridge University.

defs.def_en: A professorship is the post of professor in a university or college.

defs.def_cn: （学校的）操场，运动场；（儿童）游乐场
defs.def_en: See also:adventure playground;A playground is a piece of land, at school or in a public area, where children can play.

defs.def_cn: （某一群体的）游憩胜地，度假场所

ext.ext_cn: 圣特罗佩，富豪和名流的游憩胜地
ext.ext_en: ...St Tropez, playground of the rich and famous.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as a playground for a certain group of people, you mean that those people like to enjoy themselves there or go on holiday there.

ext.ext_cn: 不必为了促进经济增长而牺牲环境保护。
ext.ext_en: You don't have to sacrifice environmental protection to promote economic growth...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的社会从多个方面助长了酗酒的风气。
ext.ext_en: In many ways, our society actively promotes alcoholism.

defs.def_en: If people promote something, they help or encourage it to happen, increase, or spread.

ext.ext_cn: 保罗·韦勒已经宣布到英国巡演，以推广他的第二张专辑。
ext.ext_en: Paul Weller has announced a full British tour to promote his second solo album.

ext.ext_cn: 在特殊的圣卢西亚活动周期间这个岛屿可以作为旅游胜地进行宣传推广
ext.ext_en: ...a special St Lucia week where the island could be promoted as a tourist destination.

defs.def_en: If a firm promotes a product, it tries to increase the sales or popularity of that product.

ext.ext_cn: 我先是被提升为编辑，然后又晋升为编务总监。
ext.ext_en: I was promoted to editor and then editorial director...

ext.ext_cn: 事实上，那些人已经升职了。
ext.ext_en: In fact, those people have been promoted.

defs.def_en: If someone is promoted, they are given a more important job or rank in the organization that they work for.

ext.ext_cn: 伍德福德格林队赢得了乙级联赛的冠军，成功升甲。
ext.ext_en: Woodford Green won the Second Division title and are promoted to the First Division.

defs.def_en: If a team that competes in a league is promoted, it starts competing in a higher division in the next season because it was one of the most successful teams in the lower division.

defs.def_cn: 紧急事件;意外事件;（尤指）事故

ext.ext_cn: 他迅速处理突发事件。
ext.ext_en: He deals with emergencies promptly...

ext.ext_cn: 那家医院只看急诊。
ext.ext_en: The hospital will cater only for emergencies.

defs.def_en: An emergency is an unexpected and difficult or dangerous situation, especially an accident, which happens suddenly and which requires quick action to deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 首相已召集议会召开紧急会议。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister has called an emergency meeting of parliament...

ext.ext_cn: 她挂了急诊。
ext.ext_en: She made an emergency appointment.

defs.def_en: An emergency action is one that is done or arranged quickly and not in the normal way, because an emergency has occurred.

defs.def_cn: （设备、供应品等）救急用的，应急的

ext.ext_cn: 那架飞机正在为难民运送应急物资。
ext.ext_en: The plane is carrying emergency supplies for refugees...

ext.ext_cn: 他们从紧急出口逃脱，并报了警。
ext.ext_en: They escaped through an emergency exit and called the police.

defs.def_en: Emergency equipment or supplies are those intended for use in an emergency.
Deck shoes are flat casual shoes made of canvas or leather.

ext.ext_cn: 尼古丁会对心脏及动脉功能造成损害。
ext.ext_en: Nicotine adversely affects the functioning of the heart and arteries...

ext.ext_cn: 已有超过700万的民众受到旱灾的影响。
ext.ext_en: More than seven million people have been affected by drought.

defs.def_en: If something affects a person or thing, it influences them or causes them to change in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 关节炎是一种会危害全人类健康的致残性疾病。
ext.ext_en: Arthritis is a crippling disease which affects people all over the world.

defs.def_en: If a disease affects someone, it causes them to become ill.

defs.def_cn: （感情上）打动，震动，使悲伤（或怜悯）

ext.ext_cn: 离婚对吉姆打击很大。
ext.ext_en: The divorce affected Jim deeply...

ext.ext_cn: 格雷戈尔爱他的姐姐，她的去世显然仍令他悲伤不已。
ext.ext_en: Gregor loved his sister, and her loss clearly still affects him.

defs.def_en: If something or someone affects you, they make you feel a strong emotion, especially sadness or pity.

ext.ext_cn: 他装作饶有兴致地听他们说话。
ext.ext_en: He listened to them, affecting an amused interest...

ext.ext_cn: 雷德格雷夫女士假装带有浓重的意大利口音。
ext.ext_en: Ms. Redgrave affects a heavy Italian accent.

defs.def_en: If you affect a particular characteristic or way of behaving, you pretend that it is genuine, or natural for you.
The seafloor is the ground under the sea.

defs.def_cn: 死亡陷阱;危险场所（或车辆）

ext.ext_cn: 质量低劣的组装车可能会有安全隐患。
ext.ext_en: Badly-built kit cars can be death traps.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place or vehicle is a death trap, you mean it is in such bad condition that it might cause someone's death.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不慌不忙的；从容不迫的；悠闲的

ext.ext_cn: 悠闲的生活节奏
ext.ext_en: ...an unhurried pace of life.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unhurried, you approve of it because it is relaxed and slow, and is not rushed or anxious.
A side road is a road which leads off a busier, more important road.

ext.ext_cn: 美国正向该地区增兵。
ext.ext_en: The US is sending additional troops to the region...

ext.ext_cn: 保险公司将不得不支付审判的额外费用。
ext.ext_en: The insurer will also have to pay the additional costs of the trial.

defs.def_en: Additional things are extra things apart from the ones already present.

ext.ext_cn: 这些问题让我沮丧。
ext.ext_en: These questions frustrated me...

ext.ext_cn: 观众在剧场里要受到如此多的限制，这难道不令人恼火吗？
ext.ext_en: Doesn't it frustrate you that audiences in the theatre are so restricted?

defs.def_en: If something frustrates you, it upsets or angers you because you are unable to do anything about the problems it creates.

ext.ext_cn: 政府故意阻挠他为自己的外籍员工申请工作许可证的努力。
ext.ext_en: The government has deliberately frustrated his efforts to gain work permits for his foreign staff.

ext.ext_cn: 她竞选州长的受挫之举
ext.ext_en: ...her frustrated attempt to become governor.

defs.def_en: If someone or something frustrates a plan or attempt to do something, they prevent it from succeeding.

ext.ext_cn: 一个名叫佩图尼娅的女仆
ext.ext_en: ...a serving wench called Petunia.

defs.def_en: A wench was a girl or young woman who worked as a servant or served people food or drink.

defs.def_cn: 史前的；有文字记载以前的

ext.ext_cn: 拉斯科著名的史前山洞壁画
ext.ext_en: ...the famous prehistoric cave paintings of Lascaux.

defs.def_en: Prehistoric people and things existed at a time before information was written down.

ext.ext_cn: 它还将培养工会的女性成员公开演讲和决策的能力。
ext.ext_en: It would also train women union members in public speaking and decision-making...

ext.ext_cn: 他的工作日程表上还包括演讲安排和在其他公开场合的露面。
ext.ext_en: His work schedule still includes speaking engagements and other public appearances.

defs.def_en: Speaking is the activity of giving speeches and talks.

ext.ext_cn: 嗯，作为一名新闻记者，拍摄战争场面的巨大压力让我深感不安。
ext.ext_en: Well, speaking as a journalist I'm dismayed by the amount of pressure there is for pictures of combat.

defs.def_en: You can say 'speaking as a parent' or 'speaking as a teacher', for example, to indicate that the opinion you are giving is based on your experience as a parent or as a teacher.

defs.def_cn: (接过话头引入新话题)说到…，谈到…

ext.ext_cn: 还有足够的时间去暗示自己想要的圣诞礼物！说到礼物，我们有 100 份限量版香水要赠送。
ext.ext_en: There's plenty of time to drop hints for Christmas presents! And speaking of presents, we have 100 exclusive fragrance collections to give away.

defs.def_en: You can say speaking of something that has just been mentioned as a way of introducing a new topic which has some connection with that thing.

defs.def_cn: 一般说来/从技术角度说来

ext.ext_cn: 一般说来，没有人会反对这个观点。
ext.ext_en: Generally speaking there was no resistance to the idea...

ext.ext_cn: 从政治角度来说，你认为这些举措有效吗？
ext.ext_en: Politically speaking, do you think that these moves have been effective?

defs.def_en: You use speaking in expressions such as generally speaking and technically speaking to indicate which things or which particular aspect of something you are talking about.
A fortune-teller is a person who tells you what they think will happen to you in the future, after looking at something such as the lines on your hand.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 难看的小帽子
ext.ext_en: ...an ugly little hat...

ext.ext_cn: 她让我自惭形秽。
ext.ext_en: She makes me feel dowdy and ugly.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is ugly, you mean that they are very unattractive and unpleasant to look at.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （通常因涉及暴力、挑衅行为而）令人厌恶的，邪恶的，恶性的

ext.ext_cn: 出现了一些恶性事件。
ext.ext_en: There have been some ugly scenes...

ext.ext_cn: 对抗局面进一步激化。
ext.ext_en: The confrontation turned ugly.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an event or situation as ugly, you mean that it is very unpleasant, usually because it involves violent or aggressive behaviour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的衣服又旧又破。
ext.ext_en: His clothes were old and shabby...

ext.ext_cn: 他从她身边经过，走进了一个狭小简陋的房间。
ext.ext_en: He walked past her into a tiny, shabby room.

defs.def_en: Shabby things or places look old and in bad condition.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一个黑眼睛、高个子、穿得破破烂烂的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a shabby, tall man with dark eyes.

defs.def_en: A person who is shabby is wearing old, worn clothes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为)不公正的，卑鄙的，卑劣的,令人无法接受的

ext.ext_cn: 真搞不懂为什么这个人就该受到如此不公正的待遇。
ext.ext_en: It was hard to say why the man deserved such shabby treatment...

ext.ext_cn: 我知道我不应该这么想，但我还是不禁觉得有点失望。
ext.ext_en: I knew it was shabby of me, but I couldn't help feeling slightly disappointed.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as shabby, you think they behave in an unfair or unacceptable way.

ext.ext_cn: 她正在索赔医药费和其他花费。
ext.ext_en: She is demanding reimbursement for medical and other expenses...

ext.ext_cn: 最长要等6个月才能得到赔付。
ext.ext_en: It can take up to six months before reimbursements are paid.

defs.def_en: If you receive reimbursement for money that you have spent, you get your money back, for example because the money should have been paid by someone else.

defs.def_cn: 非常坚硬的;硬如岩石的

ext.ext_cn: 土地在旱季会非常坚硬。
ext.ext_en: During the dry season the land is rock hard.

defs.def_en: Something that is rock-hard is very hard indeed.
A tattoo is a design that is drawn on someone's skin using needles to make little holes and filling them with coloured dye.

ext.ext_cn: 过去，他们举行各种仪式前会在身上进行彩绘、文身。
ext.ext_en: In the old days, they would paint and tattoo their bodies for ceremonies...

ext.ext_cn: 他在左小腿上文了“安吉爱伊恩”几个字。
ext.ext_en: He had the words 'Angie loves Ian' tattooed on his left shin.

defs.def_en: If someone tattoos you, they give you a tattoo.
A military tattoo is a public display of exercises and music given by members of the armed forces.

defs.def_cn: 快速的击打;不停的敲击
defs.def_en: If you beat a tattoo, you hit something quickly and repeatedly.

ext.ext_cn: 这事发生前她曾是个大美人。
ext.ext_en: She was quite a looker before this happened.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an attractive man or woman as a looker or a good looker .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 光子没有质量——它们是无重的。
ext.ext_en: Photons have no mass—they are weightless.

ext.ext_cn: 轻柔的丝质窗帘
ext.ext_en: ...weightless silk curtains.

defs.def_en: Something that is weightless weighs nothing or seems to weigh nothing.

ext.ext_cn: 海伦描述了她身处太空时失重状态下的生活。
ext.ext_en: Helen described life in a weightless environment during her period in space.

defs.def_en: A person or object is weightless when they are in space and the earth's gravity does not affect them, so that they float around.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她固执地坚持认为自己是对的，别人都是错的。
ext.ext_en: She, in her pig-headed way, insists that she is right and that everyone else is wrong.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as pig-headed, you are critical of them because they refuse to change their mind about things, and you think they are unreasonable.
A kennel is a small building made especially for a dog to sleep in.

ext.ext_cn: 这条看门狗不好斗，因此正在养狗场受训。
ext.ext_en: The guard dog was now in kennels as it was not aggressive...

ext.ext_cn: 保利娜经营着一个养狗场。
ext.ext_en: Pauline runs a kennels...

defs.def_en: Kennels or a kennels or a kennel is a place where dogs are bred and trained, or looked after when their owners are away.

defs.def_cn: 未出版的；未发表的；未公开的；从未发表过作品的
defs.def_en: An unpublished book, letter, or report has never been published. An unpublished writer has never had his or her work published.
A hatchway is the same as a hatch.
A stallion is a male horse, especially one kept for breeding.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 赤贫的;贫困的;一无所有的

ext.ext_cn: 流落街头的贫困儿童
ext.ext_en: ...destitute children who live on the streets.

defs.def_en: Someone who is destitute has no money or possessions.

ext.ext_cn: 在他头顶上一架隐形飞机嗡嗡地飞过夜空。
ext.ext_en: Above him an invisible plane droned through the night sky.

ext.ext_cn: 背景中几乎从未间断的嗡嗡声
ext.ext_en: ...a virtually non-stop droning noise in the background.

defs.def_en: If something drones, it makes a low, continuous, dull noise.

defs.def_cn: (人)絮絮叨叨地说,喋喋不休地说

ext.ext_cn: 钱伯斯一直在他耳边嗡嗡地说个不停，他都快疯了。
ext.ext_en: Chambers' voice droned, maddening as an insect around his head...

ext.ext_cn: 卧室里医生喋喋不休的低语声已经停下了。
ext.ext_en: The droning murmur of the doctor's voice in the bedroom had ceased.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone drones, you mean that they keep talking about something in a boring way.

ext.ext_cn: 有几个是愚笨的寄生虫,但是大多数是有才能却不得志而自暴自弃的人。
ext.ext_en: A few are dim-witted drones, but most are talented, frustrated, wasted people.

defs.def_en: People who do not contribute anything to society or to an organization are sometimes described as drones .
A drone is a male bee.
A shopping trolley is a large metal basket on wheels which is provided by shops such as supermarkets for customers to use while they are in the shop.
Wadding is soft material which is put around things to protect them, for example in packing.

defs.def_cn: 人体模型,假人(常用于陈列服装)

ext.ext_cn: 商店橱窗里假人模特的下半身
ext.ext_en: ...the bottom half of a shop-window dummy.

ext.ext_cn: 表演口技用的傀儡
ext.ext_en: ...the ventriloquist's dummy.

defs.def_en: A dummy is a model of a person, often used to display clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 高速公路旁将安装仿真巡逻车以威慑那些超速驾车者。
ext.ext_en: Dummy patrol cars will be set up beside motorways to frighten speeding motorists...

ext.ext_cn: 他们让她为一本新杂志攒一份小样。
ext.ext_en: They asked her to put together a dummy for a new magazine...

defs.def_en: You can use dummy to refer to things that are not real, but have been made to look or behave as if they are real.

defs.def_cn: (婴儿用的)橡皮奶嘴,橡皮奶头
defs.def_en: A baby's dummy is a rubber or plastic object that you give the baby to suck so that he or she feels comforted.

ext.ext_cn: “你是个蠢货,麦克。”她叫嚷着。
ext.ext_en: 'You're a dummy, Mack,' she yelled.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a dummy, you mean that you think they are stupid.
A dummy or dummy hand is a hand of cards in a card game such as bridge or whist which is placed on the table so all the players can see it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些指控很严重，有必要进行一番调查。
ext.ext_en: The allegations are serious enough to warrant an investigation...

ext.ext_cn: 再小的事也会引起他的注意。
ext.ext_en: No matter was too small to warrant his attention.

defs.def_en: If something warrants a particular action, it makes the action seem necessary or appropriate for the circumstances.

ext.ext_cn: 警方证实他们已经签发了对他的拘捕令。
ext.ext_en: Police confirmed that they had issued a warrant for his arrest.

ext.ext_cn: 搜查令
ext.ext_en: ...a search warrant...

defs.def_en: A warrant is a legal document that allows someone to do something, especially one that is signed by a judge or magistrate and gives the police permission to arrest someone or search their house.

ext.ext_cn: 有理由不进行全面援助。
ext.ext_en: There is some warrant for holding back on full-scale aid.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is no warrant for something, you mean that there is no good reason to justify it.

ext.ext_cn: 所有参赛者必须保证其参赛作品完全是自己创作的。
ext.ext_en: All entrants must warrant that their entry is entirely their own work...

ext.ext_cn: 合同确保一位富有经验的人会一直呆在船上。
ext.ext_en: The contract warrants that an experienced person is on board all the time.

defs.def_en: If you warrant that something is true or will happen, you say officially that it is true, or guarantee that it will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他能说8种语言，是个出了名的讲故事高手。
ext.ext_en: He spoke eight languages and was a noted raconteur.

defs.def_en: A raconteur is someone, usually a man, who can tell stories in an interesting or amusing way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 僵化过时的文化
ext.ext_en: ...a stagnant, backward-looking culture...

ext.ext_cn: 历史也许会证明这一雄心勃勃的计划过于保守了。
ext.ext_en: History may judge the enterprise to have been rather backward-looking.

ext.ext_cn: 诺丁汉郡议会将削减200个工作岗位，以逃避地方税限额。
ext.ext_en: Notts County Council is to cut 200 jobs in a bid to escape being rate-capped.

defs.def_en: In Britain, when a local council was rate-capped, the government prevented it from increasing local taxes called rates, in order to force the council to reduce its spending or make it more efficient.
A rate cap is a limit placed by the government on the amount of interest that banks or credit card companies can charge their customers.

ext.ext_cn: 他8点在希腊街的一个餐厅有个约会。
ext.ext_en: He had an engagement at a restaurant in Greek Street at eight.

ext.ext_cn: 与公事有关的社交约会
ext.ext_en: ...business-related social engagements.

defs.def_en: An engagement is an arrangement that you have made to do something at a particular time.

ext.ext_cn: 我已经解除了与阿瑟的婚约。
ext.ext_en: I've broken off my engagement to Arthur...

ext.ext_cn: 宣布婚约让我们松了一口气。
ext.ext_en: Announcing our engagement was a relief.

defs.def_en: An engagement is an agreement that two people have made with each other to get married.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得我们订婚期间非常不愉快。
ext.ext_en: I felt our engagement was quite an unhappy time.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the period of time during which two people are engaged as their engagement .

ext.ext_cn: 宪法禁止他们在外国采取军事行动。
ext.ext_en: The constitution prohibits them from military engagement on foreign soil.

defs.def_en: A military engagement is an armed conflict between two enemies.

ext.ext_cn: 我想我在找的是一份具有冒险性的工作。
ext.ext_en: I suppose I was looking for an occupation which was going to be an adventure...

ext.ext_cn: 职业：行政助理
ext.ext_en: Occupation: administrative assistant.

defs.def_en: Your occupation is your job or profession.

ext.ext_cn: 跳伞是一项危险的消遣运动。
ext.ext_en: Parachuting is a dangerous occupation.

defs.def_en: An occupation is something that you spend time doing, either for pleasure or because it needs to be done.

ext.ext_cn: 在1942年德军侵占爱沙尼亚期间，普里学得了一口流利的德语。
ext.ext_en: Prii had become fluent in German during the Wehrmacht's occupation of Estonia in 1942...

ext.ext_cn: 德国人占领巴黎期间对犹太人的驱逐
ext.ext_en: ...the deportation of Jews from Paris during the German occupation.

defs.def_en: The occupation of a country happens when it is entered and controlled by a foreign army.

ext.ext_cn: 出售房屋再另购一套自住的人
ext.ext_en: ...people who sell their home and buy another one for their own occupation.

defs.def_en: The occupation of a building is the act or fact of someone living or working in it.

defs.def_cn: (演出、产品等)令人赞叹的，让人印象深刻的，十分出色的
defs.def_en: A show-stopping performance or product is very impressive.

ext.ext_cn: 萨德侯爵的施虐受虐性格
ext.ext_en: ...the sado-masochism of the Marquis de Sade.

defs.def_en: Sado-masochism is the enjoyment of hurting people and being hurt.

ext.ext_cn: 他们发现那3个人在练习打靶。
ext.ext_en: They found the three engaged in target practice.

ext.ext_cn: 他参与的各种项目
ext.ext_en: ...the various projects he was engaged on.

defs.def_en: Someone who is engaged in or engaged on a particular activity is doing that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 在我18岁生日那天我们订婚了。
ext.ext_en: We got engaged on my eighteenth birthday...

ext.ext_cn: 他和朱莉娅·玛丽亚·博德曼小姐订婚了。
ext.ext_en: He was engaged to Miss Julia Maria Boardman.

defs.def_en: When two people are engaged, they have agreed to marry each other.

ext.ext_cn: 电话占线。
ext.ext_en: The line is engaged...

ext.ext_cn: 我们试着给你回电，但是你正在通话中。
ext.ext_en: We tried to call you back but you were engaged.

defs.def_en: If a telephone or a telephone line is engaged, it is already being used by someone else so that you are unable to speak to the person you are phoning.

defs.def_cn: （公共厕所）被占用的，使用中的
defs.def_en: If a public toilet is engaged, it is already being used by someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 两月一次的集会
ext.ext_en: ...bimonthly assemblies.

ext.ext_cn: 双月业务通讯
ext.ext_en: ...bimonthly newsletters.

defs.def_en: A bimonthly event or publication happens or appears every two months.

ext.ext_cn: 她把头别过去，不再看他。
ext.ext_en: She turned her head away from him...

ext.ext_cn: 他抽了口烟斗，摇了摇头。
ext.ext_en: He took a puff on his pipe and shook his head.

defs.def_en: Your head is the top part of your body, which has your eyes, mouth, and brain in it.

ext.ext_cn: 那首歌在我脑海中挥之不去。
ext.ext_en: I can't get that song out of my head.

ext.ext_cn: 会心算复杂数学题的杰出分析家
ext.ext_en: ...an exceptional analyst who could do complex maths in his head.

defs.def_en: You can use head to refer to your mind and your mental abilities.

defs.def_cn: （队伍中的）领头位置;队首;排头

ext.ext_cn: 队首
ext.ext_en: ...the head of the queue...

ext.ext_cn: 我们排在护送队伍的最前面。
ext.ext_en: We took our place at the head of the convoy.

defs.def_en: The head of a line of people or vehicles is the front of it, or the first person or vehicle in the line.

ext.ext_cn: 走在行进队伍最前面的教区牧师刚刚向右转弯，朝着教堂墓地走去。
ext.ext_en: The parson, heading the procession, had just turned right towards the churchyard.

defs.def_en: If someone or something heads a line or procession, they are at the front of it.

ext.ext_cn: 在《好管家》杂志采访过的1,000人中，创立自己的公司在理想抱负中列在首位。
ext.ext_en: Running a business heads the list of ambitions among the 1,000 people interviewed by Good Housekeeping magazine.

defs.def_en: If something heads a list or group, it is at the top of it.

ext.ext_cn: 楼梯的顶部
ext.ext_en: ...the head of the stairs...

ext.ext_cn: 每天都有一个不同的名字被列在这张表的最上端。
ext.ext_en: Every day a different name was placed at the head of the chart.

defs.def_en: The head of something is the highest or top part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 螺钉顶端不应该外露。
ext.ext_en: There should be no exposed screw heads...

ext.ext_cn: 整个挥杆过程中要使杆头始终保持在同一高度。
ext.ext_en: Keep the head of the club the same height throughout the swing.

defs.def_en: The head of something long and thin is the end which is wider than or a different shape from the rest, and which is often considered to be the most important part.

ext.ext_cn: 她对校长和教师们满心钦佩。
ext.ext_en: She is full of admiration for the head and teachers.

defs.def_en: The head of a school is the teacher who is in charge.

defs.def_cn: （公司、组织的）负责人，领导人，首脑，长，主任

ext.ext_cn: 来自100多个国家的政府首脑明日将齐聚日内瓦。
ext.ext_en: Heads of government from more than 100 countries gather in Geneva tomorrow.

ext.ext_cn: 侍者领班
ext.ext_en: ...the head waiter.

defs.def_en: The head of a company or organization is the person in charge of it and in charge of the people in it.

ext.ext_cn: 负责该部民权处的迈克尔·威廉斯
ext.ext_en: ...Michael Williams, who heads the department's Office of Civil Rights.

ext.ext_cn: 由弗朗兹·弗拉尼兹基博士领导的执政社会党
ext.ext_en: ...the ruling Socialist Party, headed by Dr Franz Vranitzky.

defs.def_en: If you head a department, company, or organization, you are the person in charge of it.
The head of an infected spot is its white or yellow centre.
The head on a glass of beer is the layer of small bubbles that form on the top of the beer.
You can use head to say how many animals of a particular type a farmer has. For example, if they have fifty head of cattle, they have fifty cows.

ext.ext_cn: 我头很痛，已经酩酊大醉。
ext.ext_en: I had a terrible head and was extraordinarily drunk.

defs.def_en: If you have a bad head, you have a headache.

defs.def_cn: （硬币的）有人头像的一面，正面

ext.ext_cn: “我们可以掷硬币来决定。”特德建议道，“如果是正面，我们就谈谈。”
ext.ext_en: 'We might toss up for it,' suggested Ted. 'If it's heads, then we'll talk.'...

ext.ext_cn: 你猜是正面还是反面？
ext.ext_en: Heads or tails?

defs.def_en: If you toss a coin and it comes down heads, you can see the side of the coin which has a picture of a head on it.

defs.def_cn: 朝着（某一地点）行进（美国英语中亦作 are headed）

ext.ext_cn: 他朝着公共汽车站走去。
ext.ext_en: He headed for the bus stop...

ext.ext_cn: 开往巴士拉港的一艘伊拉克船
ext.ext_en: ...an Iraqi vessel heading for the port of Basra...

defs.def_en: If you are heading for a particular place, you are going towards that place. In American English, you can also say that you are headed for a particular place.

defs.def_cn: 很可能要遭受，会招致（美国英语中亦作 is headed for）

ext.ext_cn: 为结束内战而进行的最新谈判好像要陷入僵局。
ext.ext_en: The latest talks aimed at ending the civil war appear to be heading for deadlock...

ext.ext_cn: 他说任何不尊重人民意愿而发号施令的人都注定会走向灭亡。
ext.ext_en: He said anyone giving orders without respecting the wishes of his people is heading for disaster...

defs.def_en: If something or someone is heading for a particular result, the situation they are in is developing in a way that makes that result very likely. In American English, you can also say that something or someone is headed for a particular result.

ext.ext_cn: 有一章的标题为“战胜考试”。
ext.ext_en: One chapter is headed, 'Beating the Test'.

defs.def_en: If a piece of writing is headed a particular title, it has that title written at the beginning of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他一个头球，球从球门前横飞而过。
ext.ext_en: He headed the ball across the face of the goal.

defs.def_en: If you head a ball in football, you hit it with your head in order to make it go in a particular direction.

ext.ext_cn: 这道简单的鸡肉菜肴每人的花费还不到1英镑。
ext.ext_en: This simple chicken dish costs less than £1 a head...

ext.ext_cn: 比如说，埃塞俄比亚每年的人均消费支出仅相当于20公斤的石油。
ext.ext_en: Ethiopia, for instance uses the equivalent of just twenty kilos of oil per head a year.

defs.def_en: You use a head or per head after stating a cost or amount in order to indicate that that cost or amount is for each person in a particular group.

ext.ext_cn: 和父母住在一起让我很沮丧。
ext.ext_en: Living with my parents is doing my head in.

defs.def_en: If something or someone does your head in, they make you angry or frustrated.

ext.ext_cn: 科林被放进浴缸，从头到脚仔仔细细洗了个干净。
ext.ext_en: Colin had been put into a bath and been scrubbed from head to foot.

defs.def_en: From head to foot means all over your body.

ext.ext_cn: 我没有生意头脑。
ext.ext_en: I don't have a head for business.

ext.ext_cn: 很有算术头脑、工作效率极高的组织者
ext.ext_en: ...an extraordinarily effective organiser with a remarkable head for figures.

defs.def_en: If you have a head for something, you can deal with it easily. For example, if you have a head for figures, you can do arithmetic easily, and if you have a head for heights, you can climb to a great height without feeling afraid.

defs.def_cn: 充分理解并接受;打定（主意）

ext.ext_cn: 一旦接受了一个想法，他们就永远不会放弃。
ext.ext_en: Once they get an idea into their heads, they never give up.

defs.def_en: If you get a fact or idea into your head, you suddenly realize or think that it is true and you usually do not change your opinion about it.

ext.ext_cn: 管理者们终于意识到自己不能再安于低效率的运营了。
ext.ext_en: Managers have at last got it into their heads that they can no longer accept inefficient operations.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has got something into their head, you mean that they have finally understood or accepted it, and you are usually criticizing them because it has taken them a long time to do this.

defs.def_cn: 让…自由行动;对…不加约束

ext.ext_cn: 他发现别人的才能，并且让他们自由发挥。
ext.ext_en: He recognised ability and gave people their heads.

defs.def_en: If you give someone their head, you allow them to do what they want to do, without trying to advise or stop them.

ext.ext_cn: 那酒劲儿很大，喝了会上头。
ext.ext_en: That wine was strong, it went to your head.

defs.def_en: If alcoholic drink goes to your head, it makes you feel drunk.

defs.def_cn: （赞扬或成功）冲昏…的头脑，使…骄傲自满

ext.ext_cn: 福特绝对不是那种会被一点点成功冲昏头脑的人。
ext.ext_en: Ford is definitely not a man to let a little success go to his head.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as praise or success goes to someone's head, you are criticizing them because you think that it makes them too proud or confident.

ext.ext_cn: 我很容易被男性吸引，曾多次深陷情网。
ext.ext_en: I was very attracted to men and fell head over heels many times.

defs.def_en: If you are head over heels or head over heels in love, you are very much in love.

ext.ext_cn: 她设法保持镇静，没有陷入恐慌。
ext.ext_en: She was able to keep her head and not panic...

ext.ext_cn: 她惊慌失措，开始向我大声尖叫。
ext.ext_en: She lost her head and started screaming at me.

defs.def_en: If you keep your head, you remain calm in a difficult situation. If you lose your head, you panic or do not remain calm in a difficult situation.

ext.ext_cn: 等玩够了，我们就会结束。
ext.ext_en: When we stop enjoying ourselves we'll knock it on the head.

defs.def_en: If you knock something on the head, you stop it.

ext.ext_cn: 他继续讲笑话，自己笑得前仰后合。
ext.ext_en: He carried on telling a joke, laughing his head off.

defs.def_en: Phrases such as laugh your head off and scream your head off can be used to emphasize that someone is laughing or screaming a lot or very loudly.

defs.def_cn: （吸毒后）昏头昏脑的，神志不清的
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is off their head, you mean that they have taken so many drugs that they do not know what they are doing.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经完全昏了头了。
ext.ext_en: He's gone completely off his head.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is off their head, you think that their ideas or behaviour are very strange, foolish, or dangerous.

defs.def_cn: 倒过来想;从全新的角度理解

ext.ext_cn: 他们的关系完全颠覆了传统的婚姻观念。
ext.ext_en: Their relationship turned the standard notion of marriage on its head.

defs.def_en: If you stand an idea or argument on its head or turn it on its head, you think about it or treat it in a completely new and different way.

ext.ext_cn: 我承认那些想法中有很多远远超出了我的理解力。
ext.ext_en: I admit that a lot of the ideas went way over my head.

defs.def_en: If something such as an idea, joke, or comment goes over someone's head, it is too difficult for them to understand.

ext.ext_cn: 他因试图越过高层官员自作主张而受到斥责。
ext.ext_en: He was reprimanded for trying to go over the heads of senior officers.

defs.def_en: If someone does something over another person's head, they do it without asking them or discussing it with them, especially when they should do so because the other person is in a position of authority.

defs.def_cn: （不好的事情）再次出现，重新抬头

ext.ext_cn: 她搬回来大约一周之后，一个问题又重新出现了。
ext.ext_en: There was a problem which reared its ugly head about a week after she moved back in...

ext.ext_cn: 永远不能让种族主义暴政的祸患重新抬头。
ext.ext_en: The scourge of racial tyranny should never again be allowed to raise its ugly head.

defs.def_en: If you say that something unpleasant or embarrassing rears its ugly head or raises its ugly head, you mean that it occurs, often after not occurring for some time.
If you stand on your head, you balance upside down with the top of your head and your hands on the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 这部该死的影片我一点儿都看不懂。
ext.ext_en: I couldn't make head nor tail of the damn film.

defs.def_en: If you say that you cannot make head nor tail of something or you cannot make head or tail of it, you are emphasizing that you cannot understand it at all.

defs.def_cn: 突然决定（做某事，尤指古怪或愚蠢的事）；心血来潮

ext.ext_cn: 他突然心血来潮，打算去澳大利亚和儿子一起住。
ext.ext_en: He suddenly took it into his head to go out to Australia to stay with his son.

defs.def_en: If somebody takes it into their head to do something, especially something strange or foolish, they suddenly decide to do it.

defs.def_cn: 到了危急关头;到达关键点

ext.ext_cn: 这些问题在9月变得十分尖锐，当时该台有5名记者遭到辞退。
ext.ext_en: These problems came to a head in September when five of the station's journalists were sacked.

defs.def_en: If a problem or disagreement comes to a head or is brought to a head, it becomes so bad that something must be done about it.

ext.ext_cn: 现在该是他敲打敲打同事们的时候了。
ext.ext_en: It is now high time he banged his colleagues' heads together.

defs.def_en: If you bang peoples' heads together or knock their heads together, you tell them off severely for doing something wrong or for not doing something they were asked to do.

ext.ext_cn: 因此大家集思广益，最终作出了妥善的安排。
ext.ext_en: So everyone put their heads together and eventually an amicable arrangement was reached.

defs.def_en: If two or more people put their heads together, they talk about a problem they have and try to solve it.

defs.def_cn: （尤指在生意方面）勉强逃脱困境

ext.ext_cn: 我们正努力避免陷入困境，但我们的现金流动情况不太好。
ext.ext_en: We are keeping our head above water, but our cash flow position is not too good.

defs.def_en: If you keep your head above water, you just avoid getting into difficulties; used especially to talk about business.

defs.def_cn: 有人会遭殃，有人会（因此）受到惩罚（尤指被解雇）

ext.ext_cn: 已经有人猜测，该集团的问题会导致一些人被解雇。
ext.ext_en: The group's problems have led to speculation that heads will roll.

defs.def_en: If you say that heads will roll as a result of something bad that has happened, you mean that people will be punished for it, especially by losing their jobs.

defs.def_cn: 使政治化；使具有政治性；使关心（或参与）政治

ext.ext_cn: 可能唤醒工人阶级的政治意识、并促使他们质疑现状的思想
ext.ext_en: ...ideas which might politicize the labouring classes and cause them to question the status quo...

ext.ext_cn: 一些女权主义者尝试过将个人生活政治化。
ext.ext_en: Some feminists had attempted to politicize personal life.

defs.def_en: If you politicize someone or something, you make them more interested in politics or more involved with politics.

ext.ext_cn: 可能来自一些危险国家和恐怖分子的导弹袭击
ext.ext_en: ...possible missile attacks from rogue states and terrorists.

defs.def_en: When politicians or journalists talk about a rogue state, they mean a country that they regard as a threat to their own country's security, for example because it supports terrorism.

ext.ext_cn: 矿物油被用来润滑机器。
ext.ext_en: Mineral oils are used to lubricate machinery.

ext.ext_cn: 润滑油
ext.ext_en: ...lubricating oil.

defs.def_en: If you lubricate something such as a part of a machine, you put a substance such as oil on it so that it moves smoothly.

ext.ext_cn: 富兰克林的任务是促使与法国方面的会谈顺畅进行。
ext.ext_en: Franklin's task was to lubricate the discussions with the French.

defs.def_en: If you say that something lubricates a particular situation, you mean that it helps things to happen without any problems.
A clamp is a device that holds two things firmly together.

ext.ext_cn: 有人忘了带把麦克风固定在支架上的U形螺栓。
ext.ext_en: Somebody forgot to bring along the U-bolts to clamp the microphones to the pole.

defs.def_en: When you clamp one thing to another, you fasten the two things together with a clamp.

defs.def_cn: 将…固定(在某处)；紧紧抓住

ext.ext_cn: 西蒙拨完号，把听筒贴在耳边。
ext.ext_en: Simon finished dialing and clamped the phone to his ear...

ext.ext_cn: 他紧闭双唇。
ext.ext_en: He clamped his lips together...

defs.def_en: To clamp something in a particular place means to put it or hold it there firmly and tightly.

defs.def_cn: (将违章停放的车辆扣在原地的)夹钳，车轮固定夹
defs.def_en: A clamp is a large metal device which is fitted to the wheel of an illegally parked car or other vehicle in order to prevent it from being driven away. The driver has to pay to have the clamp removed.

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰法院裁定，将停在私人地界上的车辆上夹钳并索要罚款的行为是违法的。
ext.ext_en: Courts in Scotland have ruled it illegal to clamp a car parked on private ground and then to demand a fine.

defs.def_en: To clamp a car means to fit a clamp to one of its wheels so that it cannot be driven away.

defs.def_cn: 使非国有化;使转为私营

ext.ext_cn: 政府开始对金融机构进行私有化。
ext.ext_en: The government started to denationalize financial institutions...

ext.ext_cn: 桑德兰造船厂最终转为了私营。
ext.ext_en: Eventually Sunderland Shipbuilders was denationalised.

defs.def_en: To denationalize an industry or business means to transfer it into private ownership so that it is no longer owned and controlled by the state.

ext.ext_cn: 民歌中的自然意象
ext.ext_en: ...the nature imagery of the ballad.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the descriptions in something such as a poem or song, and the pictures they create in your mind, as its imagery .

defs.def_cn: (尤指具有象征意义的)图片,意象,形象

ext.ext_cn: 这是一部气势恢宏、引人入胜的电影,充满了动人心魄的瑰丽意象。
ext.ext_en: This is an ambitious and intriguing movie, full of striking imagery.

defs.def_en: You can refer to pictures and representations of things as imagery, especially when they act as symbols.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们在常规体检中发现了扩散性的癌变。
ext.ext_en: They found invasive cancer during a routine examination.

defs.def_en: You use invasive to describe something undesirable which spreads very quickly and which is very difficult to stop from spreading.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 焦虑不安的;心力交瘁的

ext.ext_cn: 课堂上灵活互动的教学
ext.ext_en: ...flexible, interactive teaching in the classroom.

defs.def_en: If you describe a group of people or their activities as interactive, you mean that the people communicate with each other.

defs.def_cn: （委员会、法庭或政府等的）休会期间，休息期间

ext.ext_en: Some in Congress are concerned the war option could be adopted in November when Congress is in recess...

ext.ext_en: ...a discreet recess next to a fireplace.

defs.def_en: In a room, a recess is part of a wall which is built further back than the rest of the wall. Recesses are often used as a place to put furniture such as shelves.

ext.ext_en: He emerged from the dark recesses of the garage...

Green onions are small onions with long green leaves.

defs.def_cn: 不能忍受的;难以承受的;无法接受的

ext.ext_en: That victory put the Ukrainians beyond the reach of their nearest challengers, Dynamo Moscow.

ext.ext_cn: 接近马厩时，他勒马缓行，轻拍它的脖颈。
ext.ext_en: As he neared the stable, he slowed the horse and patted it on the neck...

ext.ext_en: We were nearing the top of the pass to Tsagochen Thang when the van spluttered and died.

defs.def_en: When you near a place, you get quite near to it.

ext.ext_en: As half time neared, Hardyman almost scored twice...

ext.ext_cn: 随着选举日的临近，这一因素将愈发重要。
ext.ext_en: This factor will come increasingly to the fore as election day nears.

defs.def_en: You say that an important time or event nears when it is going to occur quite soon.

ext.ext_en: ...that English convention of not showing your feelings, even to your nearest and dearest.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to their close relatives and friends as their nearest and dearest .

defs.def_en: You use near and far to indicate that you are referring to a very large area or distance.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen in the near future, you mean that it will happen quite soon.

defs.def_en: If you want to indicate that something almost happened, you can use the expression damned near. In British English, you can also say as near as dammit .

ext.ext_en: ...her long silken hair.

ext.ext_cn: 她那光洁修长的双腿
ext.ext_en: ...her long, silken legs.

defs.def_en: Silken is used to describe things that are very pleasantly smooth and soft.

ext.ext_cn: 丝绸睡衣
ext.ext_en: ...a silken nightshirt.

ext.ext_cn: 丝绸垫子
ext.ext_en: ...silken cushions.

defs.def_en: A silken garment, fabric, or rope is made of silk or a material that looks like silk.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有分寸的;考虑周全的;圆通的

ext.ext_cn: 他在处理这个财务问题时很有分寸。
ext.ext_en: He had been extremely tactful in dealing with the financial question...

ext.ext_en: I decided it wouldn't be tactful to order another beer.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or what they say as tactful you approve of them because they are careful not to offend or upset another person.

defs.def_cn: （用于代替记不起或因为有些无礼而难以启口的名称或名字）那个什么

ext.ext_en: We wanted to be here early in case the whatsit, maintenance supervisor had forgotten to deal with it...

ext.ext_cn: 他有一副能把所有人都吓得那个什么滚什么流的火爆脾气。
ext.ext_en: He's got that fiery temper which scares the whatsit out of everybody.

defs.def_en: You use whatsit instead of a noun or name which you cannot remember or which you do not want to say because it is rude.

ext.ext_cn: 她担心自己会疯掉。
ext.ext_en: She was afraid of going mad.

ext.ext_cn: 沿街走来的那位精神失常的老太太
ext.ext_en: ...the mad old lady from down the street.

defs.def_en: Someone who is mad has a mind that does not work in a normal way, with the result that their behaviour is very strange.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你要再和他一起工作那简直是疯了。
ext.ext_en: You'd be mad to work with him again...

ext.ext_cn: 那难道不是一个愚蠢透顶的想法吗？
ext.ext_en: Isn't that a rather mad idea?

defs.def_en: You use mad to describe people or things that you think are very foolish.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 因为我不想去，你就对我火冒三丈。
ext.ext_en: You're just mad at me because I don't want to go...

ext.ext_cn: 告诉你，我对这件事感到非常恼火。
ext.ext_en: I'm pretty mad about it, I can tell you.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is mad, you mean that they are very angry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她不像我对体育那么痴迷。
ext.ext_en: She's not as mad about sport as I am...

ext.ext_cn: 他很迷恋你。
ext.ext_en: He's mad about you...

defs.def_en: If you are mad about or mad on something or someone, you like them very much indeed.

ext.ext_cn: 你只有一个小时来完成这场比赛，所以得铆足劲头争分夺秒。
ext.ext_en: You only have an hour to complete the game so it's a mad dash against the clock...

ext.ext_cn: 观众们十分狂热。
ext.ext_en: The audience went mad.

defs.def_en: Mad behaviour is wild and uncontrolled.

ext.ext_cn: 他的某些举动让我很生气。
ext.ext_en: There are certain things he does that drive me mad...

ext.ext_cn: 这种瘙痒简直快把我折磨疯了。
ext.ext_en: This itching is driving me mad.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something drives you mad, you mean that you find them extremely annoying.

ext.ext_cn: 他在拼命地进行负重训练。
ext.ext_en: He was weight training like mad.

defs.def_en: If you do something like mad, you do it very energetically or enthusiastically.

defs.def_cn: (尤指对某些不愉快的事表示惊讶时说)哎呀，哎哟
defs.def_en: Some people say crikey in order to express surprise, especially at something unpleasant.

ext.ext_en: He uttered a snorting laugh...

ext.ext_cn: 他们一言不发地离开了。
ext.ext_en: They departed without uttering a word.

defs.def_en: If someone utters sounds or words, they say them.

ext.ext_cn: 这当然是一派胡言。
ext.ext_en: This, of course, is utter nonsense.

ext.ext_cn: 这种完全没有责任感的表现
ext.ext_en: ...this utter lack of responsibility...

defs.def_en: You use utter to emphasize that something is great in extent, degree, or amount.

defs.def_cn: 不合法的；非法的；违法的

ext.ext_cn: 认为将他们解雇是违法行为的雇员
ext.ext_en: ...employees who believe their dismissal was unlawful...

ext.ext_cn: 往里推开的窗户表明有人非法入内。
ext.ext_en: A pushed-in window indicated unlawful entry.

defs.def_en: If something is unlawful, the law does not allow you to do it.

defs.def_cn: （尤指可用于分析的）资料，材料，数据（美国英语中通常用作复数名词;在专业或正式的英国英语中有时用作复数名词，有时用作不可数名词)

ext.ext_en: ...the latest year for which data is available...

defs.def_en: You can refer to information as data, especially when it is in the form of facts or statistics that you can analyse. In American English, data is usually a plural noun. In technical or formal British English, data is sometimes a plural noun, but at other times, it is an uncount noun.

defs.def_cn: (可存储并为计算机程序所用的）数据

ext.ext_en: You can compress huge amounts of data on to a CD-ROM.

defs.def_en: Data is information that can be stored and used by a computer program.

ext.ext_en: The window had been replaced last week during routine maintenance.

defs.def_en: The maintenance of a building, vehicle, road, or machine is the process of keeping it in good condition by regularly checking it and repairing it when necessary.

ext.ext_cn: 使弃家的父亲支付孩子抚养费的政府计划
ext.ext_en: ...the government's plan to make absent fathers pay maintenance for their children.

defs.def_en: Maintenance is money that someone gives regularly to another person to pay for the things that the person needs.

ext.ext_cn: 维护亚洲的和平与稳定
ext.ext_en: ...the maintenance of peace and stability in Asia.

ext.ext_cn: 天然食品对保持健康的重要性
ext.ext_en: ...the importance of natural food to the maintenance of health.

defs.def_en: If you ensure the maintenance of a state or process, you make sure that it continues.

Ginseng is the root of a plant found in China, Korea, and America which some people believe is good for your health.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为说他们是受自身利益的驱使是对事实的严重歪曲。
ext.ext_en: I think it would be a gross distortion of reality to say that they were motivated by self-interest...

ext.ext_en: He later accused reporters of wilful distortion and bias.

defs.def_en: Distortion is the changing of something into something that is not true or not acceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 声音信号可以通过电缆传送而不失真。
ext.ext_en: Audio signals can be transmitted along cables without distortion.

defs.def_en: Distortion is the changing of the appearance or sound of something in a way that makes it seem strange or unclear.

ext.ext_cn: 他们坚决支持自己的领导，而且不允许任何压力迫使其辞职。
ext.ext_en: They stood four-square behind their chief, and they would not accept pressure on him to resign...

ext.ext_en: He was still certain that Franklin was four-square for reform.

defs.def_en: To stand four-square behind someone or something means to be firm in your support of that person or thing.

ext.ext_en: ...a strapping six-footer.

ext.ext_cn: 一个身高 6 英尺、深褐色头发的女人
ext.ext_en: ...the brunette six-footer.

defs.def_en: Someone who is six foot tall can be called a six-footer .

ext.ext_cn: 在临死的那些日子里，年迈的女王态度稍缓和了一些。
ext.ext_en: In her dying days the old Queen unbent a little.

defs.def_en: If someone unbends, their attitude becomes less strict than it was.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （时间或金钱）紧缺的，短缺的，拮据的

ext.ext_cn: 他手头会有点儿紧。
ext.ext_en: He's going to be a bit pushed for money.

defs.def_en: If you are pushed for something such as time or money, you do not have enough of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我发觉很难教他什么东西。
ext.ext_en: I'd be hard pushed to teach him anything.

defs.def_en: If you are hard pushed to do something, you find it very difficult to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...probably the most severely deprived children in the country.

ext.ext_cn: 与市中心贫民区生活联系在一起的问题
ext.ext_en: ...the problems associated with life in a deprived inner city area.

defs.def_en: Deprived people or people from deprived areas do not have the things that people consider to be essential in life, for example acceptable living conditions or education.

defs.def_cn: 按字母顺序的；字母（表）的

ext.ext_en: Their herbs and spices are arranged in alphabetical order.

defs.def_en: Alphabetical means arranged according to the normal order of the letters in the alphabet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 放肆的；冒昧的；自作主张的

ext.ext_en: It would be presumptuous to judge what the outcome will be.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or their behaviour as presumptuous, you disapprove of them because they are doing something that they have no right or authority to do.

ext.ext_en: The result is that the lungs clog up with a thick mucus.

defs.def_en: When something clogs up a place, or when it clogs up, it becomes blocked so that little or nothing can pass through.

ext.ext_en: The pilot began to talk him down by giving instructions over the radio.

ext.ext_en: Businessmen are tired of politicians talking the economy down.

defs.def_en: If someone talks down a particular thing, they make it less interesting, valuable, or likely than it originally seemed.

ext.ext_en: We talked them down and struck a deal...

ext.ext_en: When he makes you an offer, you send me in and I'll talk him down another thousand...

defs.def_en: The people who are attending a church service or who regularly attend a church service are referred to as the congregation .
Pharmacology is the branch of science relating to drugs and medicines.

defs.def_cn: (通常指军方、警察等为抓捕）上门找，带走（某人）

ext.ext_en: Lotte was getting ready to fight if they came for her.

defs.def_en: If people such as soldiers or police come for you, they come to find you, usually in order to harm you or take you away, for example to prison.

defs.def_cn: 讥讽；冷嘲热讽；极力挖苦

ext.ext_cn: 他以冷嘲热讽自以为是的有钱人来愉悦读者。
ext.ext_en: He entertained his readers by lampooning the pretensions of the rich...

ext.ext_cn: 他的矮小身材和政治观点使他成了受奚落的对象。
ext.ext_en: He was lampooned for his short stature and political views.

defs.def_en: If you lampoon someone or something, you criticize them very strongly, using humorous means.

defs.def_cn: 辛辣的讽刺文章（或言论）

ext.ext_en: ...his scathing lampoons of consumer culture...

ext.ext_cn: 这里雪莱用的是通俗的嘲讽手法。
ext.ext_en: The style Shelley is using here is that of popular lampoon.

defs.def_en: A lampoon is a piece of writing or speech which criticizes someone or something very strongly, using humorous means.

ext.ext_cn: 如果在怀孕后期出现问题
ext.ext_en: ...if a problem arises later in the pregnancy...

ext.ext_en: The birds also attack crops when the opportunity arises.

defs.def_en: If a situation or problem arises, it begins to exist or people start to become aware of it.

ext.ext_en: ...an overwhelming sense of guilt arising from my actions...

ext.ext_cn: 这些指控是默西赛德郡警方对诈骗案进行长期调查后提出的。
ext.ext_en: The charges arise out of a long-running fraud enquiry by Merseyside police.

ext.ext_cn: 重金属音乐真正形成于60年代后期。
ext.ext_en: Heavy Metal music really arose in the late 60s.

defs.def_en: If something such as a new species, organization, or system arises, it begins to exist and develop.

ext.ext_cn: 同往常一样，他在早上6:30起了床。
ext.ext_en: He arose at 6:30 a.m. as usual.

defs.def_en: When you arise, you get out of bed in the morning.

ext.ext_en: When I arose from the chair, my father and Eleanor's father were in deep conversation...

ext.ext_cn: 起立，威廉爵士。
ext.ext_en: Arise, Sir William.

defs.def_en: When you arise from a sitting or kneeling position, you stand up.

ext.ext_cn: 上面矗立着立方形房屋的露天平台
ext.ext_en: ...the flat terrace, from which arises the cubic volume of the house.

defs.def_en: You can say that something tall such as a building or mountain arises from the ground around it.

ext.ext_en: They see it as an infringement on their own freedom of action.

defs.def_en: An infringement is an action or situation that interferes with your rights and the freedom you are entitled to.

ext.ext_cn: 违反规则应处以罚款。
ext.ext_en: Infringement of the regulation is punishable by a fine.

ext.ext_en: ...a double-decker pleasure boat.

ext.ext_en: I shouted out 'I'm OK'...

defs.def_en: If you shout something out, you say it very loudly so that people can hear you clearly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the country's rapid economic growth in the 1980's...

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...whether the Tunnel will provide more rapid car transport than ferries...

defs.def_en: A rapid movement is one that is very fast.
A corpse is a dead body, especially the body of a human being.

ext.ext_en: The band are remixing some tracks...

ext.ext_en: Both tracks are remixed versions of tracks from her forthcoming album.

ext.ext_cn: 给他服了大剂量的维生素 C。

ext.ext_cn: 美国的例子证明了这一点。

ext.ext_en: Throughout, she illustrates her analysis with excerpts from discussions.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is nice, you mean that you find it attractive, pleasant, or enjoyable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (常用于表示谢意)好心的，体贴人的

ext.ext_cn: 你真是太好了，大老远来看我。
ext.ext_en: It's awfully nice of you to come all this way to see me...

ext.ext_cn: “你的几个儿子好么？”——“谢谢关心。”
ext.ext_en: 'How are your boys?' — 'How nice of you to ask.'...

defs.def_en: If you say that it is nice of someone to say or do something, you are saying that they are being kind and thoughtful. This is often used as a way of thanking someone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我已经见过你爸爸了，他非常和蔼可亲。
ext.ext_en: I've met your father and he's rather nice...

ext.ext_cn: 他是个好小伙，非常温和，彬彬有礼。
ext.ext_en: He was a nice fellow, very quiet and courteous.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is nice, you mean that you like them because they are friendly and pleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她见到了里恰尔迪夫妇，他们对她非常友好。
ext.ext_en: She met Mr and Mrs Ricciardi, who were very nice to her.

defs.def_en: If you are nice to people, you are friendly, pleasant, or polite towards them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他冲我们点点头，说道：“天气真不错。”
ext.ext_en: He nodded to us and said, 'Nice weather we're having.'

defs.def_en: When the weather is nice, it is warm and pleasant.

defs.def_cn: (用于加强语气)美好的，令人喜爱的

ext.ext_cn: 这种葡萄酒色泽深暗悦目，是中等浓郁至浓香型的。
ext.ext_en: With a nice dark colour, the wine is medium to full bodied...

ext.ext_cn: 人们已经习惯了用精美的亮光纸印刷的杂志了。
ext.ext_en: People have got used to nice glossy magazines...

defs.def_en: You can use nice to emphasize a particular quality that you like.

defs.def_cn: (观点、区别等)细致的，微妙的，精细的

ext.ext_cn: 那些是微妙的学术上的辩论，但不久的将来怎么办？
ext.ext_en: Those are nice academic arguments, but what about the immediate future?

defs.def_en: A nice point or distinction is very clear, precise, and based on good reasoning.

ext.ext_cn: 早上好！见到你真高兴，感谢你和我们共度这个周末。
ext.ext_en: Good morning. Nice to meet you and thanks for being with us this weekend...

ext.ext_cn: 查尔斯说：“见到你真是太高兴了。”
ext.ext_en: 'It's so nice to see you,' said Charles.

defs.def_en: You can use nice when you are greeting people. For example, you can say 'Nice to meet you', 'Nice to have met you', or 'Nice to see you'.

ext.ext_cn: 诺尔斯成了托奇酒店的经理，干得很棒。
ext.ext_en: Knowles became Torquay's manager. Nice one.

defs.def_en: See also:nicely;If someone says nice one, they are showing their approval of something clever or funny that they have just seen or heard.

defs.def_cn: （住宅旁的）花园，菜园，庭园，园子（美国英语中表示此义时常用yard，而garden仅用来指花园和菜园）

ext.ext_cn: 世界上最漂亮的花园
ext.ext_en: ...the most beautiful garden on Earth.

defs.def_en: In British English, a garden is a piece of land next to a house, with flowers, vegetables, other plants, and often grass. In American English, the usual word is yard, and a garden refers only to land which is used for growing flowers and vegetables.

ext.ext_cn: 吉姆周末帮忙打理朋友家的花园。
ext.ext_en: Jim gardened at the homes of friends on weekends.

defs.def_en: If you garden, you do work in your garden such as weeding or planting.

ext.ext_cn: 公园从上午10点半到下午5点之间开放。
ext.ext_en: The Gardens are open from 10.30am until 5pm.

ext.ext_cn: 肯辛顿公园
ext.ext_en: ...Kensington Gardens.

defs.def_en: Gardens are places like a park that have areas of plants, trees, and grass, and that people can visit and walk around.

ext.ext_cn: 他住在金合欢街9号。
ext.ext_en: He lives at 9, Acacia Gardens.

defs.def_en: Gardens is sometimes used as part of the name of a street.
The RDA of a particular vitamin or mineral is the amount that people need each day to stay healthy. RDA is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'recommended daily amount'.

defs.def_cn: 密封胶;密封剂;密封材料
defs.def_en: A sealant is a substance that is used to seal holes, cracks, or gaps.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 乱七八糟的;杂乱无章的

ext.ext_cn: 书本经常乱七八糟地堆在地板上。
ext.ext_en: Books are often stacked in higgledy-piggledy piles on the floor.

ext.ext_cn: 整个山谷里巨石翻滚，就像有巨人在狂扔乱掷。
ext.ext_en: A whole valley of boulders tossed higgledy-piggledy as though by some giant.

defs.def_en: If you say that things are higgledy-piggledy, you mean that they are very disorganized and untidy.

ext.ext_cn: 我个人更愿意烤整只鸡。
ext.ext_en: I personally would rather roast a chicken whole.

defs.def_en: When you roast meat or other food, you cook it by dry heat in an oven or over a fire.

ext.ext_cn: 烤牛肉
ext.ext_en: ...roast beef.

defs.def_en: Roast meat has been cooked by roasting.

ext.ext_cn: 到厨房来。我得把烤肉放进去。
ext.ext_en: Come into the kitchen. I've got to put the roast in.

defs.def_en: A roast is a piece of meat that is cooked by roasting.  →see usage note at:cook

ext.ext_cn: 他呼吁任何看见袭击者的人提供信息。
ext.ext_en: He appealed for information from anyone who saw the attackers.

ext.ext_cn: 他妻子送的纪念日礼物
ext.ext_en: ...an anniversary present from his wife...

defs.def_en: If something comes from a particular person or thing, or if you get something from them, they give it to you or they are the source of it.

ext.ext_cn: 来自苏黎世的艺术品商人
ext.ext_en: ...an art dealer from Zurich...

ext.ext_cn: 凯蒂·琼斯 19 岁，是伯明翰人。
ext.ext_en: Katy Jones is nineteen and comes from Birmingham.

defs.def_en: Someone who comes from a particular place lives in that place or originally lived there. Something that comes from a particular place was made in that place.

ext.ext_cn: 以色列大使馆的代表
ext.ext_en: ...a representative from the Israeli embassy.

ext.ext_cn: 在贝尔格莱德的联邦国防部工作的米兰·格韦罗上校
ext.ext_en: ...Colonel Milan Gvero, who is from the federal Defense Ministry in Belgrade.

defs.def_en: A person from a particular organization works for that organization.

ext.ext_cn: 客人们看着她逃离了房间。
ext.ext_en: The guests watched as she fled from the room.

defs.def_en: If someone or something moves or is moved from a place, they leave it or are removed, so that they are no longer there.

ext.ext_cn: 在许多骨移植手术中，可以从病人身体的其他部位取骨。
ext.ext_en: In many bone transplants, bone can be taken from other parts of the patient's body...

ext.ext_cn: 从冰里把碗取出，搅入奶油。
ext.ext_en: Remove the bowl from the ice and stir in the cream.

defs.def_en: If you take one thing or person from another, you move that thing or person so that they are no longer with the other or attached to the other.

ext.ext_cn: 这 103 英镑每月从亚当斯夫人的工资里扣掉。
ext.ext_en: The £103 is deducted from Mrs Adams' salary every month...

ext.ext_cn: 6 减去 3 得 3。
ext.ext_en: Three from six leaves three.

defs.def_en: If you take something from an amount, you reduce the amount by that much.

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫经常离家在外工作。
ext.ext_en: Her husband worked away from home a lot...

ext.ext_cn: 乔第二天一整天都不在家。
ext.ext_en: Jo was absent from the house all the next day.

defs.def_en: From is used in expressions such as away from or absent from to say that someone or something is not present in a place where they are usually found.

ext.ext_cn: 我儿子科林刚从阿姆斯特丹回来。
ext.ext_en: My son Colin has just returned from Amsterdam.

ext.ext_cn: 一群参加完飞镖比赛正在返家途中的男人
ext.ext_en: ...a group of men travelling home from a darts match.

defs.def_en: If you return from a place or an activity, you return after being in that place or doing that activity.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的财经记者詹姆斯·摩根刚刚从德国回来。
ext.ext_en: Our economics correspondent, James Morgan, is just back from Germany...

ext.ext_cn: 一天下午我放了学在家的时候，他邀请我去和他一起看电影。
ext.ext_en: One afternoon when I was home from school, he asked me to come to see a movie with him.

defs.def_en: If you are back from a place or activity, you have left it and have returned to your former place.

ext.ext_cn: 参观者隔着平板玻璃橱窗欣赏那幅画。
ext.ext_en: Visitors see the painting from behind a plate glass window...

ext.ext_cn: 从上往下俯瞰，山谷呈现出人形轮廓。
ext.ext_en: Viewed from above, the valleys form the shape of a man.

defs.def_en: If you see or hear something from a particular place, you are in that place when you see it or hear it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的右腕上戴着一只沉甸甸的金手镯。
ext.ext_en: Hanging from his right wrist is a heavy gold bracelet.

ext.ext_cn: 吊挂在天花板上的大风扇
ext.ext_en: ...large fans hanging from ceilings...

defs.def_en: If something hangs or sticks out from an object, it is attached to it or held by it.

ext.ext_cn: 市中心距离车站 4 公里远。
ext.ext_en: The centre of the town is 4 kilometres from the station...

ext.ext_cn: 距离苏黎世主要购物中心只有几百码远的一个小公园
ext.ext_en: ...a small park only a few hundred yards from Zurich's main shopping centre...

defs.def_en: You can use from when giving distances. For example, if a place is fifty miles from another place, the distance between the two places is fifty miles.

ext.ext_cn: 从圣彼得堡到塔林的路
ext.ext_en: ...the road from St Petersburg to Tallinn.

defs.def_en: If a road or railway line goes from one place to another, you can travel along it between the two places.

ext.ext_cn: 精白面粉做的面包
ext.ext_en: ...bread made from white flour.

ext.ext_cn: 用岛上天然的珊瑚石建造的豪华度假村
ext.ext_en: ...a luxurious resort built from the island's native coral stone.

defs.def_en: From is used, especially in the expression made from, to say what substance has been used to make something.

ext.ext_cn: 她从 1926 年起开始学画，同时还从事着商业艺术家的工作。
ext.ext_en: She studied painting from 1926 and also worked as a commercial artist...

ext.ext_cn: 从早上 6 点开始向渔民提供早餐。
ext.ext_en: Breakfast is available to fishermen from 6 a.m...

defs.def_en: You can use from when you are talking about the beginning of a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 包括从阿尔及利亚到津巴布韦的 94 个国家在巴塞罗那设有代表处。
ext.ext_en: There are 94 countries represented in Barcelona, from Algeria to Zimbabwe...

ext.ext_cn: 将有超过150 家公司出席，涉及领域从金融到室内设备，应有尽有。
ext.ext_en: Over 150 companies will be there, covering everything from finance to fixtures and fittings.

defs.def_en: You say from one thing to another when you are stating the range of things that are possible, or when saying that the range of things includes everything in a certain category.

ext.ext_cn: 他脸上的表情从同情变为惊讶。
ext.ext_en: The expression on his face changed from sympathy to surprise...

ext.ext_cn: 失业率从 7.5％降到7.2％。
ext.ext_en: Unemployment has fallen from 7.5% to 7.2%...

defs.def_en: If something changes from one thing to another, it stops being the first thing and becomes the second thing.

ext.ext_cn: 这个问题仅仅是由于意见分歧引起的。
ext.ext_en: The problem simply resulted from a difference of opinion...

ext.ext_cn: 他眼部溃疡，是因澳大利亚强烈的日光照射造成的。
ext.ext_en: He is suffering from eye ulcers, brought on by the intense light in Australia...

defs.def_en: You use from after some verbs and nouns when mentioning the cause of something.

ext.ext_cn: 经验告诉她戴夫就要对她说出实情了。
ext.ext_en: She knew from experience that Dave was about to tell her the truth...

ext.ext_cn: 从她脸上的表情他感觉到她有话要说。
ext.ext_en: He sensed from the expression on her face that she had something to say...

defs.def_en: You use from when you are giving the reason for an opinion.

defs.def_cn: (用于 protect, free, keep, prevent 等动词后)免于

ext.ext_cn: 这样的法规可以保护消费者免受有害或者危险药品的威胁。
ext.ext_en: Such laws could protect the consumer from harmful or dangerous remedies...

ext.ext_cn: 300吨秘鲁芒果被禁止进入法国。
ext.ext_en: 300 tons of Peruvian mangoes were kept from entering France.

defs.def_en: From is used after verbs with meanings such as 'protect', 'free', 'keep', and 'prevent' to introduce the action that does not happen, or that someone does not want to happen.
A deckhand is a person who does the cleaning and other work on the deck of a ship.

defs.def_cn: （法官、拍卖人、会议主席等用的）小木槌

ext.ext_cn: “现在休庭10分钟。”法官敲了一记木槌说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Let's take a ten-minute recess', the judge said, pounding his gavel.

defs.def_en: A gavel is a small wooden hammer that the person in charge of a law court, an auction, or a meeting bangs on a table to get people's attention.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不诚恳的;不坦率的;狡猾的

ext.ext_cn: 称这是艺术瑰宝是言不由衷。
ext.ext_en: It would be disingenuous to claim that this is great art.

defs.def_en: Someone who is disingenuous is slightly dishonest and insincere in what they say.

defs.def_cn: 蒿，洋艾，苦艾(味苦，可入药及制酒)
defs.def_en: Wormwood is a plant that has a very bitter taste and is used in making medicines and alcoholic drinks.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎所有的房子都一模一样。
ext.ext_en: Nearly all the houses were identical...

ext.ext_cn: 两个政党以几乎完全相同的竞选宣言参加了上次竞选。
ext.ext_en: The two parties fought the last election on almost identical manifestos.

defs.def_en: Things that are identical are exactly the same.

defs.def_cn: （英国英语的）标准发音（缩略形式为 RP)
defs.def_en: Received Pronunciation is a way of pronouncing British English that is often used as a standard in the Teaching of English as a Foreign Language. The abbreviation RP is also used. The accent represented by the pronunciations in this dictionary is Received Pronunciation.
A defendant is a person who has been accused of breaking the law and is being tried in court.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 粗布制成的夹克
ext.ext_en: ...a jacket made of very coarse cloth.

ext.ext_cn: 粗沙海滩
ext.ext_en: ...a beach of coarse sand.

defs.def_en: Coarse things have a rough texture because they consist of thick threads or large pieces.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她在的时候，士兵们还是照样说粗俗的笑话，都懒得收敛。
ext.ext_en: The soldiers did not bother to moderate their coarse humour in her presence.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as coarse, you mean that he or she talks and behaves in a rude and offensive way.

ext.ext_cn: 马费特博士强调说，他反对学校中的恃强凌弱现象，将会采取行动杜绝该现象。
ext.ext_en: Dr Muffett stressed that he was opposed to bullying in schools and that action would be taken to stamp it out.

ext.ext_cn: 为根除这些问题采取的当场罚款
ext.ext_en: ...on-the-spot fines to stamp the problems out.

defs.def_en: If you stamp out something bad that is happening, you make it stop.

ext.ext_cn: 根据欧盟的一项新指令，杀虫剂的标签标注将更加明确。
ext.ext_en: Thanks to a new EU directive, insecticide labelling will be more specific.

defs.def_en: A directive is an official instruction that is given by someone in authority.

defs.def_cn: 小（应用）程序；（网页上的）小程序
defs.def_en: An applet is a computer program which is contained within a page on the World Wide Web, and which transfers itself to your computer and runs automatically while you are looking at that Web page.

defs.def_cn: 爱恨交加的关系；又爱又恨的关系

ext.ext_cn: 一本关于两个男孩爱恨交加的亲密关系的书
ext.ext_en: ...a book about the close love-hate relationship between two boys.

defs.def_en: If you have a love-hate relationship with someone or something, your feelings towards them change suddenly and often from love to hate.

ext.ext_cn: 从某个地方传来猫咪喵喵的叫声。
ext.ext_en: From somewhere, the kitten mewed.

defs.def_en: When a cat mews, it makes a soft high-pitched noise.

ext.ext_cn: 在需要时，亨利会毫不迟疑地伪装自己。
ext.ext_en: Henry was not slow to dissemble when it served his purposes.

defs.def_en: When people dissemble, they hide their real intentions or emotions.

defs.def_cn: (尤指英国皇家海军中的)准将
defs.def_en: A commodore is an officer of senior rank in the navy, especially the British Royal Navy.

defs.def_cn: 巴巴多斯的；巴巴多斯人的
defs.def_en: Barbadian means belonging or relating to Barbados or its people.

ext.ext_cn: 他现在娶了个巴巴多斯人。
ext.ext_en: He is now married to a Barbadian.

defs.def_en: A Barbadian is someone who comes from Barbados.

ext.ext_cn: 该国总统会向代表们展示他构想的国家未来发展的蓝图。
ext.ext_en: The country's  president will offer delegates his blueprint for the country's future.

ext.ext_cn: 有关经济改革新计划的设想
ext.ext_en: ...the blueprint of a new plan of economic reform.

defs.def_en: A blueprint for something is a plan or set of proposals that shows how it is expected to work.

ext.ext_cn: 整个地方的规划图，包括暖气管和布线
ext.ext_en: ...a blueprint of the whole place, complete with heating ducts and wiring...

ext.ext_cn: 文件内附有一张核装置的设计蓝图。
ext.ext_en: The documents contain a blueprint for a nuclear device.

defs.def_en: A blueprint of an architect's  building plans or a designer's pattern is a photographic print consisting of white lines on a blue background. Blueprints contain all of the information that is needed to build or make something.

ext.ext_cn: 子女身上遗传了父母双方的基因型板。
ext.ext_en: The offspring contain a mixture of the genetic blueprint of each parent...

ext.ext_cn: 脱氧核糖核酸是存在于每个细胞内的基因物质，它承载从头发颜色到致癌风险等各种遗传型板。
ext.ext_en: DNA is the genetic material inside every cell that carries the blueprints for everything from hair color to the risk of cancer.

defs.def_en: A genetic blueprint is a pattern which is contained within all living cells. This pattern decides how the organism develops and what it looks like.

ext.ext_cn: 特地为他预留了一间带阳台的海景双人房。
ext.ext_en: A double room with a balcony overlooking the sea had been reserved for him...

ext.ext_cn: 在美国，多人乘坐的汽车有专行道。
ext.ext_en: In the United States lanes are reserved for cars with more than one occupant.

defs.def_en: If something is reserved for a particular person or purpose, it is kept specially for that person or purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 我要预订一张5人的桌子。
ext.ext_en: I'll reserve a table for five...

ext.ext_cn: 需求量会很大，所以今天得请卖报摊主为你预留出你那份。
ext.ext_en: Demand will be huge, so ask your newsagent to reserve your copy today.

defs.def_en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept specially for you, rather than sold or given to someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 海湾地区拥有全世界65％的石油储藏。
ext.ext_en: The Gulf has 65 per cent of the world's oil reserves...

ext.ext_cn: 朋友可以在困难的时候提供帮助。
ext.ext_en: A friend can be a reserve of help in times of trouble.

defs.def_en: A reserve is a supply of something that is available for use when it is needed.

ext.ext_cn: 他最后成了替补队员，但仍有资格获得团体金牌。
ext.ext_en: He ended up as a reserve, but still qualified for a team gold medal.

defs.def_en: In sports, a reserve is someone who is available to play as part of a team if one of the members is ill or cannot play.

ext.ext_cn: 海洋生物学家号召将卡迪根湾建成一个海洋自然保护区，以保护那里的海豚。
ext.ext_en: Marine biologists are calling for Cardigan Bay to be created a marine nature reserve to protect the dolphins.

defs.def_en: A nature reserve is an area of land where the animals, birds, and plants are officially protected.

ext.ext_cn: 对这个话题必须进行慎重的讨论。
ext.ext_en: The subject is one which must be discussed with reserve...

ext.ext_cn: 他天生的内敛性格让他显得有些拘谨。
ext.ext_en: His natural reserve made him appear self-conscious.

defs.def_en: If someone shows reserve, they keep their feelings hidden.

ext.ext_cn: 他特地留的那瓶威士忌
ext.ext_en: ...the bottle of whisky that he kept in reserve...

ext.ext_cn: 巡逻车在街上守候，防暴警察也在一旁待命。
ext.ext_en: There were patrol cars on the streets and riot police standing by in reserve.

defs.def_en: If you have something in reserve, you have it available for use when it is needed.
A military reserve is a group of soldiers who are ready to join a military operation if they are needed.

defs.def_cn: (可折叠成椅的)日本床垫;沙发床
defs.def_en: A futon is a piece of furniture which consists of a thin mattress on a low wooden frame which can be used as a bed or folded up to make a chair.

ext.ext_en: He said chemical weapons had never been sited in Germany.

defs.def_en: If something is sited in a particular place or position, it is put there or built there.

ext.ext_en: There is ample car parking off site.

ext.ext_cn: 住在校外
ext.ext_en: ...off-site accommodation.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is off site, they are away from a particular area or group of buildings where people work, study, or stay.

A lightning bug is a type of beetle that produces light from its body.

ext.ext_cn: 选民对所有的政客都深表怀疑。
ext.ext_en: Voters are deeply distrustful of all politicians...

ext.ext_en: The older you get the more distrustful you become.

defs.def_en: If you are distrustful of someone or something, you think that they are not honest, reliable, or safe.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 观点明确的；坚决主张的

ext.ext_cn: 女性在过去十年中已变得更加自信。
ext.ext_en: Women have become more assertive in the past decade.

ext.ext_cn: 果断的管理作风
ext.ext_en: ...an assertive style of management.

defs.def_en: Someone who is assertive states their needs and opinions clearly, so that people take notice.

ext.ext_cn: 军队得到授权,在行动中可以开枪射杀。
ext.ext_en: The army is now empowered to operate on a shoot-to-kill basis...

ext.ext_en: His position does not empower him to cite our views without consultation.

defs.def_en: If someone is empowered to do something, they have the authority or power to do it.

defs.def_cn: 给予…力量；使有能力(实现…)

ext.ext_cn: 帮助贫困人民就要让他们相信教育是真正的力量源泉。
ext.ext_en: Empowering the underprivileged lies in assuring them that education holds the real source of power...

ext.ext_en: What I'm trying to do is to empower people, to give them ways to help them get well.

defs.def_en: To empower someone means to give them the means to achieve something, for example to become stronger or more successful.

ext.ext_cn: 我叔叔吉姆发了高烧。
ext.ext_en: My Uncle Jim had a high fever...

ext.ext_cn: 这种疾病的症状包括发烧和体重减轻。
ext.ext_en: Symptoms of the disease include fever and weight loss.

ext.ext_cn: 安吉在极度兴奋中等待着。
ext.ext_en: Angie waited in a fever of excitement.

defs.def_en: A fever is extreme excitement or nervousness about something.

ext.ext_cn: 他破窗而入，偷走了很多银杯。
ext.ext_en: He smashed a window to get in and nicked a load of silver cups...

ext.ext_en: We used to nick biscuits from the kitchen.

defs.def_en: If someone nicks something, they steal it.

ext.ext_en: The police nicked me for carrying an offensive weapon...

ext.ext_cn: 别出声，要不然我们都会被抓住的。
ext.ext_en: Keep quiet or we'll  all get nicked.

defs.def_en: If the police nick someone, they arrest them.

ext.ext_en: After several years banged up in the nick, even you might start to go mad.

defs.def_en: The nick is a prison, or a police station.

ext.ext_cn: 我把车从车位开出来时，蹭到了前面那辆车的后保险杠。
ext.ext_en: When I pulled out of the space, I nicked the rear bumper of the car in front of me...

ext.ext_cn: 锋利的刀刃可能会划伤皮肤，导致出血。
ext.ext_en: A sharp blade is likely to nick the skin and draw blood...

defs.def_en: If you nick something or nick yourself, you accidentally make a small cut in the surface of the object or your skin.

ext.ext_cn: 带刺铁丝网在我的右眼正下方只留了非常小的划痕。
ext.ext_en: The barbed wire had left only the tiniest nick just below my right eye.

defs.def_en: A nick is a small cut made in the surface of something, usually in someone's skin.

ext.ext_cn: 大学生已经上了当，但他们或许还没有意识到。
ext.ext_en: College students already are being nicked, but probably don't realize it.

defs.def_en: If you are nicked by someone, they cheat you, for example by charging you too much money.

defs.def_cn: 处于良好状态/处于糟糕状态

ext.ext_cn: 他的肋骨受了损伤，但除此之外一切都还好。
ext.ext_en: His ribs were damaged, but other than that he's in good nick...

ext.ext_cn: 说实在的，汤姆家房子的状况比我家的强。
ext.ext_en: Tom's house is actually in better nick than mine.

defs.def_en: Nick is used in expressions such as 'in good nick' or 'in bad nick' to describe the physical condition of someone or something.

defs.def_cn: 在事情正好发生的时候;关键时刻

ext.ext_en: Seems we got here just in the nick of time...

ext.ext_en: News of interest cuts came in the nick of time for borrowers.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens in the nick of time, you are emphasizing that it happens at the last possible moment.

defs.def_cn: (尤指窘迫时)干笑，傻笑，窃笑，哧哧地笑

ext.ext_en: Mention sex therapy and most people will titter in embarrassment.

ext.ext_en: Their attraction to each other as friends is reciprocated...

defs.def_en: If your feelings or actions towards someone are reciprocated, the other person feels or behaves in the same way towards you as you have felt or behaved towards them.

ext.ext_en: ...the lower slopes of the Himalayas.

ext.ext_en: The street must have been on a slope.

defs.def_en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

ext.ext_cn: 河岸到河面的斜坡非常陡。
ext.ext_en: The bank sloped down sharply to the river...

ext.ext_cn: 花园的斜坡颇为陡峭。
ext.ext_en: The garden sloped quite steeply.

defs.def_en: If a surface slopes, it is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

ext.ext_en: He wonders why the digits on his calculator slope to the right.

defs.def_en: If something slopes, it leans to the right or to the left rather than being upright.

ext.ext_en: The slope increases as you go up the curve.

ext.ext_cn: 一段坡度为 10° 的斜坡
ext.ext_en: ...a slope of ten degrees.

defs.def_en: The slope of something is the angle at which it slopes.

ext.ext_en: ...a ring of cliffs that walled off the surrounding wilderness.

defs.def_en: If part of a place is walled off, it is separated from the rest of the place by a wall.

ext.ext_cn: 威尔特郡丘陵地
ext.ext_en: ...the Wiltshire downs.

defs.def_en: Downs are areas of gentle hills with few trees.

ext.ext_en: He was in his car.

ext.ext_cn: 挂在衣柜里的衣服
ext.ext_en: ...clothes hanging in the wardrobe...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is in something else is enclosed by it or surrounded by it. If you put something in a container, you move it so that it is enclosed by the container.

ext.ext_en: We spent a few days in a hotel...

ext.ext_cn: 他本打算去美国度假。
ext.ext_en: He had intended to take a holiday in America...

defs.def_en: If something happens in a place, it happens there.

ext.ext_en: My flatmate was in at the time...

ext.ext_cn: 他每天都得坐班。
ext.ext_en: He has had to be in every day.

defs.def_en: If you are in, you are present at your home or place of work.

ext.ext_cn: 他进来的时候,她焦虑不安地抬起头来看了看。
ext.ext_en: She looked up anxiously as he came in...

ext.ext_cn: 他们握了手,走了进去。
ext.ext_en: They shook hands and went in.

defs.def_en: When someone comes in, they enter a room or building.

ext.ext_en: We'd be watching every plane coming in from Melbourne...

ext.ext_en: Look. The train's in. We'll have to run for it now.

defs.def_en: If a train, boat, or plane has come in or is in, it has arrived at a station, port, or airport.

ext.ext_cn: 如果涨潮了,他们就去游泳。
ext.ext_en: If the tide was in they went swimming.

defs.def_en: When the sea or tide comes in, the sea moves towards the shore rather than away from it.

ext.ext_cn: 橱窗里的灯熄灭了。
ext.ext_en: The light in the window went out...

ext.ext_cn: 橱窗里有一架相机待售。
ext.ext_en: There was a camera for sale in the window.

defs.def_en: Something that is in a window, especially a shop window, is just behind the window so that you can see it from outside.

ext.ext_en: He caught sight of his hair in a mirror.

defs.def_en: When you see something in a mirror, the mirror shows an image of it.
