ext.ext_en: He was a big man, smartly dressed in a suit and tie.

ext.ext_cn: 3 个黑衣女子
ext.ext_en: ...three women in black.

defs.def_en: If you are dressed in a piece of clothing, you are wearing it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的腿上满是泥浆。
ext.ext_en: His legs were covered in mud.

ext.ext_cn: 包在报纸里的胡萝卜
ext.ext_en: ...carrots wrapped in newspaper.

defs.def_en: Something that is covered or wrapped in something else has that thing over or round its surface.

ext.ext_cn: 在他头顶的天花板上有一道很深的裂缝。
ext.ext_en: There was a deep crack in the ceiling above him.

ext.ext_cn: 花园里一个很不雅观的洞
ext.ext_en: ...an unsightly hole in the garden.

defs.def_en: If there is something such as a crack or hole in something, there is a crack or hole on its surface.

defs.def_cn: 在(书、电影、戏剧、图片)之中

ext.ext_cn: 不要过分拘泥于书上所说的。
ext.ext_en: Don't stick too precisely to what it says in the book.

ext.ext_cn: 电影中最滑稽的场景之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the funniest scenes in the film.

defs.def_en: If something is in a book, film, play, or picture, you can read it or see it there.

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔夫在他导演的戏中给她安排了一个角色。
ext.ext_en: Alf offered her a part in the play he was directing...

ext.ext_cn: 公主受邀参加一场慈善性质的赛马比赛。
ext.ext_en: The Princess had been invited to ride in a charity race...

defs.def_en: If you are in something such as a play or a race, you are one of the people taking part.

ext.ext_cn: 新英格兰队是联盟中最差的队。
ext.ext_en: The New England team are the worst in the league.

ext.ext_cn: 收藏品中最受瞩目的一幅画
ext.ext_en: ...the most spectacular painting in the collection.

defs.def_en: Something that is in a group or collection is a member of it or part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 国防工业领域从业者
ext.ext_en: ...those working in the defence industry.

ext.ext_cn: 医学未来的发展
ext.ext_en: ...future developments in medicine.

defs.def_en: You use in to specify a general subject or field of activity.

ext.ext_cn: 1949 年4月早春的那一天
ext.ext_en: ...that early spring day in April 1949...

ext.ext_cn: 上个月出口订单增加了。
ext.ext_en: Export orders improved in the last month...

defs.def_en: If something happens in a particular year, month, or other period of time, it happens during that time.

ext.ext_cn: 在上次战争中，他的父亲受了重伤。
ext.ext_en: His father had been badly wounded in the last war.

ext.ext_cn: 你在日常生活中费力应对的问题
ext.ext_en: ...issues you struggle with in your daily life.

defs.def_en: If something happens in a particular situation, it happens while that situation is going on.

ext.ext_cn: 他在8天里走了260英里的路。
ext.ext_en: He walked two hundred and sixty miles in eight days.

defs.def_en: If you do something in a particular period of time, that is how long it takes you to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 几分钟后我就能做点儿早饭出来。
ext.ext_en: I'll have some breakfast ready in a few minutes...

ext.ext_cn: 6个月之后他们就会回来。
ext.ext_en: They'll be back in six months.

defs.def_en: If something will happen in a particular length of time, it will happen after that length of time.

ext.ext_cn: 20多岁的年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...young people in their twenties.

ext.ext_cn: 莫莉,一位60出头的高个女士
ext.ext_en: ...Molly, a tall woman in her early sixties.

defs.def_en: You use in to indicate roughly how old someone is. For example, if someone is in their fifties, they are between 50 and 59 years old.

ext.ext_cn: 成群结队到那里的人
ext.ext_en: ...men who came there in droves...

ext.ext_cn: 数以百计的孩子们被集合起来。
ext.ext_en: The children were assembled in hundreds...

defs.def_en: You use in to indicate roughly how many people or things do something.

ext.ext_cn: 去年，五分之一的男孩没有获得资格证书就离校了。
ext.ext_en: Last year, one in five boys left school without a qualification...

ext.ext_cn: 他被告知有五百分之一的生存机会。
ext.ext_en: He was told that he had a one in 500 chance of survival.

defs.def_en: You use in to express a ratio, proportion, or probability.

ext.ext_cn: 经济处于困境中。
ext.ext_en: The economy was in trouble...

ext.ext_cn: 戴夫急于回到工作岗位。
ext.ext_en: Dave was in a hurry to get back to work...

defs.def_en: If something or someone is in a particular state or situation, that is their present state or situation.

defs.def_cn: 带着，充满(某种情感或愿望)

ext.ext_cn: 辛普森惊讶地看着他们。
ext.ext_en: Simpson looked at them in surprise...

ext.ext_cn: 克丽丝悲愤交加,失声痛哭。
ext.ext_en: Chris was weeping in anger and grief...

defs.def_en: You use in to indicate the feeling or desire which someone has when they do something, or which causes them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他天性温和。
ext.ext_en: Violence is not in his nature...

ext.ext_cn: 我打心眼里不想拥抱他。
ext.ext_en: I couldn't find it in me to embrace him.

defs.def_en: If a particular quality or ability is in you, you naturally have it.

ext.ext_cn: 他具有我要找的伴侣应该具备的所有品质。
ext.ext_en: He had all the qualities I was looking for in a partner...

ext.ext_cn: “我不同意,”她说道,对自己的声音如此响亮有力而感到惊讶。
ext.ext_en: 'I don't agree,' she said, surprised at the strength in her own voice...

defs.def_en: You use in when saying that someone or something has a particular quality.

ext.ext_cn: 用口头和书面的形式向病人提供信息。
ext.ext_en: Information is given to the patient verbally and in writing.

ext.ext_cn: 用西班牙语以外的语言讲授的课程
ext.ext_en: ...lessons in languages other than Spanish.

defs.def_en: You use in to indicate how someone is expressing something.

defs.def_cn: (表示排列或形状)成一排/呈球形

ext.ext_cn: 这些卡片需要排成两行。
ext.ext_en: The cards need to be laid out in two rows...

ext.ext_cn: 她的耳朵、肩膀和髋部呈一条直线。
ext.ext_en: Her ear, shoulder and hip are in a straight line...

defs.def_en: You use in in expressions such as in a row or in a ball to describe the arrangement or shape of something.

ext.ext_cn: 粉边白花
ext.ext_en: ...white flowers edged in pink...

ext.ext_cn: 他看见墓碑上有一些黑字写的东西。
ext.ext_en: He saw something written in black on the gravestones.

defs.def_en: If something is in a particular colour, it has that colour.

ext.ext_en: If we had been spotted at that point, I don't know what would have happened to us...

ext.ext_cn: 这是我所遇到的最好的事情了。
ext.ext_en: It's the best thing that ever happened to me.

defs.def_en: When something, especially something unpleasant, happens to you, it takes place and affects you.

ext.ext_cn: 我们凑巧发现我们有一个共同的朋友。
ext.ext_en: We happened to discover we had a friend in common...

ext.ext_cn: 我仔细看了一下离自己最近的那份报纸，正巧是份《每日邮报》。
ext.ext_en: I looked in the nearest paper, which happened to be the Daily Mail...

defs.def_en: If you happen to do something, you do it by chance. If it happens that something is the case, it occurs by chance.

defs.def_cn: 碰巧，恰恰（尤引出令人意外的事）

ext.ext_cn: 她打电话给埃米，看她是否知道自己儿子的行踪。埃米还真就知道。
ext.ext_en: She called Amy to see if she had any idea of her son's whereabouts. As it happened, Amy had.

defs.def_en: You use as it happens in order to introduce a statement, especially one that is rather surprising.
A cigarette butt or a cigarette end is the part of a cigarette that you throw away when you have finished smoking it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻松愉快的;安逸的;不费劲的

ext.ext_cn: 一份轻松的公务员工作
ext.ext_en: ...a cushy job in the civil service...

ext.ext_cn: 他的成长过程相当快乐。
ext.ext_en: He had a fairly cushy upbringing.

defs.def_en: A cushy job or situation is pleasant because it does not involve much work or effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我已尽力了，但是她母亲贻害颇深。
ext.ext_en: I did what I could, but her mother's influence was pernicious...

ext.ext_cn: 对于优秀存在着一种认识的误区：一切都务求最好。
ext.ext_en: There is a pernicious culture of excellence: everything has to be not merely good but the best.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as pernicious, you mean that it is very harmful.
Earrings are pieces of jewellery which you attach to your ears.

ext.ext_cn: 素食汉堡是一种迅速传到了英国的新开发食品。
ext.ext_en: The vegetarian burger was an innovation which was rapidly exported to Britain.

ext.ext_cn: 由工业时代的新技术方法促成的变化
ext.ext_en: ...the transformation wrought by the technological innovations of the industrial age.

defs.def_en: An innovation is a new thing or a new method of doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须提倡创意,鼓励革新。
ext.ext_en: We must promote originality and encourage innovation.

defs.def_en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

ext.ext_cn: 那是肯特一家的生活中一段幸福的插曲。
ext.ext_en: It was a happy interlude in the Kents' life...

ext.ext_cn: 辛克莱献上了精彩的幕间音乐表演。
ext.ext_en: Superb musical interludes were provided by Sinclair.

defs.def_en: An interlude is a short period of time when an activity or situation stops and something else happens.

ext.ext_cn: 邦格提倡一种相对论的观点。在他看来，是不是不道德取决于社会结构。
ext.ext_en: Bonger advocated a relativist position. In his view, what is considered immoral depends on the social structure.

defs.def_en: A relativist position or argument is one according to which the truth is not always the same, but varies according to circumstances.

defs.def_cn: 不再做(…)的;(同…)不再打交道的;(对…)不再感兴趣的

ext.ext_cn: 人们猜想他不会再打拳了。
ext.ext_en: One suspects he will be finished with boxing.

defs.def_en: Someone who is finished with something is no longer doing it or dealing with it or is no longer interested in it.

defs.def_cn: 不复存在的;不再发生的

ext.ext_cn: 狩猎季节过后，我又重靠领取救济金过活。
ext.ext_en: I go back on the dole when the shooting season's finished.

defs.def_en: Something that is finished no longer exists or is no longer happening.

defs.def_cn: 垮台的;完蛋的;失势的;失效的

ext.ext_cn: 她再也不能控制我了。
ext.ext_en: Her power over me is finished...

ext.ext_cn: 他承认道：“我以为自己已经完了。”
ext.ext_en: He confessed: 'I thought I was finished.'

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is finished is no longer important, powerful, or effective.

defs.def_cn: (以某种方式的外观或装饰)最后呈现的

ext.ext_cn: 餐厅装饰成了深红色。
ext.ext_en: The dining room is finished in deep red...

ext.ext_cn: 每件连衣裙最后线缝都滚了边，并且加上了合身的衬裙，看起来非常漂亮。
ext.ext_en: Each dress is beautifully finished off with piped seams and fitted underskirts.

defs.def_en: Something that is finished or finished off in a particular way has been given a particular appearance or decoration.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她那袭大胆的低胸裙使观众大为震惊。
ext.ext_en: Her daringly low-cut dress scandalised audiences.

defs.def_en: Low-cut dresses and blouses do not cover the top part of a woman's chest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 因为没人知道密码,所以任何人都不可能进得去。
ext.ext_en: It was impossible for anyone to get in because no one knew the password...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为税金没法管理。
ext.ext_en: He thinks the tax is impossible to administer...

defs.def_en: Something that is impossible cannot be done or cannot happen.

ext.ext_cn: 政府现在几乎陷入了进退维谷的境地。
ext.ext_en: The Government was now in an almost impossible position.

defs.def_en: An impossible situation or an impossible position is one that is very difficult to deal with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以忍受的;让人受不了的

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰妮想,这个女人真让人受不了。
ext.ext_en: The woman is impossible, thought Frannie.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as impossible, you are annoyed that their bad behaviour or strong views make them difficult to deal with.

defs.def_cn: 僧侣政体的;神权政体的

ext.ext_cn: 这是场威胁到人民选择权的运动，是场有可能建立神权政体的运动。
ext.ext_en: It is a movement that threatens the choice of the people and threatens to install a theocratic state.

defs.def_en: A theocratic society is ruled by priests who represent a god.

ext.ext_cn: 曼彻斯特的商人和市政官员
ext.ext_en: ...the businessmen and civic leaders of Manchester.

ext.ext_cn: 布罗姆利市政中心
ext.ext_en: ...Bromley Civic Centre.

defs.def_en: You use civic to describe people or things that have an official status in a town or city.

ext.ext_cn: 公民的自豪感
ext.ext_en: ...a sense of civic pride.

defs.def_en: You use civic to describe the duties or feelings that people have because they belong to a particular community.

ext.ext_cn: 煤焦油染料
ext.ext_en: ...coal tar dyes.

defs.def_en: Coal tar is a thick black liquid made from coal which is used for making drugs and chemical products.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个乡下小伙儿，参军是出于爱国之心和冒险精神。
ext.ext_en: He was a country boy who had joined the army out of a sense of patriotism and adventure...

ext.ext_cn: 我们生活在一个爱国主义常常被嗤之以鼻的时代。
ext.ext_en: We live in an age when patriotism is often sneered at.

defs.def_en: Patriotism is love for your country and loyalty towards it.

ext.ext_cn: 久松教授既不会讲英语，也不会讲德语。
ext.ext_en: Professor Hisamatsu spoke neither English nor German...

ext.ext_cn: 这部戏既不像塔博里想象的那么滑稽，也不像他想象的那么让人讨厌。
ext.ext_en: The play is neither as funny nor as disturbing as Tabori thinks it is.

defs.def_en: You use neither in front of the first of two or more words or expressions when you are linking two or more things which are not true or do not happen. The other thing is introduced by 'nor'.

defs.def_cn: 两个都不;(两者之中)无一个

ext.ext_cn: 起初，两个人都不会说。
ext.ext_en: At first, neither man could speak.

ext.ext_cn: 我俩都不想外出。
ext.ext_en: Neither of us felt like going out.

defs.def_en: You use neither to refer to each of two things or people, when you are making a negative statement that includes both of them.

ext.ext_cn: 我从没学过游泳，他们也没有。
ext.ext_en: I never learned to swim and neither did they...

ext.ext_cn: 英国不同意，丹麦、葡萄牙和爱尔兰也持反对意见。
ext.ext_en: Britain does not agree and neither do Denmark, Portugal and Ireland.

defs.def_en: If you say that one person or thing does not do something and neither does another, what you say is true of all the people or things that you are mentioning.

defs.def_cn: (用于否定陈述后，强调要引出另一否定陈述)也不

ext.ext_cn: 我不记得爸爸曾经抱过我，我也没在他膝盖上坐过。
ext.ext_en: I can't ever recall Dad hugging me. Neither did I sit on his knee.

defs.def_en: You use neither after a negative statement to emphasize that you are introducing another negative statement.

ext.ext_cn: “来之前我从未听说过她。”——“那没什么。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'd never heard of her before I came here.' — 'That is neither here nor there.'

ext.ext_cn: 他是否认识到事实真相无关紧要。
ext.ext_en: Whether or not he realised the fact was neither here nor there.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is neither here nor there, you mean that it does not matter because it is not a relevant point.

ext.ext_cn: 任何一个懂行的葡萄酒商人都可以给你提出建议。
ext.ext_en: Any knowledgeable wine merchant would be able to advise you.

defs.def_en: A merchant is a person who buys or sells goods in large quantities, especially one who imports and exports them.

ext.ext_cn: 这家人不得不靠向当地商人赊账生活。
ext.ext_en: The family was forced to live on credit from local merchants.

defs.def_en: A merchant is a person who owns or runs a shop, store, or other business.

ext.ext_cn: 近些年来英国商船队伍的规模大为缩减。
ext.ext_en: There's been a big reduction in the size of the British merchant fleet in recent years.

defs.def_en: Merchant seamen or ships are involved in carrying goods for trade.

ext.ext_cn: 相传生活在苏格兰一个漆黑深水湖中的妖怪
ext.ext_en: The monster, which is reputed to live in the deep dark water of a Scottish loch...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is reputed to be true, you mean that people say it is true, but you do not know if it is definitely true.

ext.ext_cn: 将汤搅和几秒钟。
ext.ext_en: Stir the soup for a few seconds...

ext.ext_cn: 贝林厄姆太太正在那里将糖搅进茶里。
ext.ext_en: There was Mrs Bellingham, stirring sugar into her tea...

defs.def_en: If you stir a liquid or other substance, you move it around or mix it in a container using something such as a spoon.

defs.def_cn: (因不舒服)稍稍活动;(睡醒前)挪动身体

ext.ext_cn: 艾琳晃了晃他，他开始醒过来。
ext.ext_en: Eileen shook him, and he started to stir...

ext.ext_cn: 两名妇女一动不动地仰面躺着。
ext.ext_en: The two women lay on their backs, not stirring.

defs.def_en: If you stir, you move slightly, for example because you are uncomfortable or beginning to wake up.

ext.ext_cn: 她那天晚上没有离开过那座房子。
ext.ext_en: She had not stirred from the house that evening...

ext.ext_cn: 有些东西你不用离开这个房间也可以学习。
ext.ext_en: There's something you could study without stirring from this room.

defs.def_en: If you do not stir from a place, you do not move from it.

ext.ext_cn: 棕榈树在太平洋和煦的微风中轻轻地摇动。
ext.ext_en: Palm trees stir in the soft Pacific breeze...

ext.ext_cn: 连一丝风也没有，白色的长窗帘一动不动。
ext.ext_en: Not a breath of fresh air stirred the long white curtains.

defs.def_en: If something stirs or if the wind stirs it, it moves gently in the wind.

ext.ext_cn: 动起来！有客人来了。
ext.ext_en: Stir yourself! We've got a visitor...

ext.ext_cn: 你甚至都懒得去和他们喝一杯。
ext.ext_en: You can't even stir yourself to have a drink with them...

defs.def_en: If you stir yourself, or if something stirs you into action, you move in order to start doing something.

defs.def_cn: 打动;激起，激发(强烈的感情)

ext.ext_cn: 现在那声音已不那么刺耳，它又如当年一样让她怦然心动。
ext.ext_en: The voice, less coarse now, stirred her as it had then...

ext.ext_cn: 我被他的聪明才智所打动，对他产生了好奇心。
ext.ext_en: I was intrigued by him, stirred by his intellect.

defs.def_en: If something stirs you, it makes you react with a strong emotion.

defs.def_cn: (回忆、感情或情绪)产生，苏醒，萌动;引发;唤起

ext.ext_cn: 接着一段回忆涌上心头，你开始感到焦虑不安。
ext.ext_en: Then a memory stirs in you and you start feeling anxious...

ext.ext_cn: 埃米还记得他曾怎样惹自己生气。
ext.ext_en: Amy remembered the anger he had stirred in her...

defs.def_en: If a particular memory, feeling, or mood stirs or is stirred in you, you begin to think about it or feel it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的电影已在美国引起了轰动。
ext.ext_en: His film has caused a stir in America.

defs.def_en: If an event causes a stir, it causes great excitement, shock, or anger among people.

defs.def_cn: 受到轻微影响;小受打击

ext.ext_cn: 在农场补贴问题上和美国之间的冲突使得欧洲人以及其共同的农业政策略受冲击。
ext.ext_en: A clash with America over farm subsidies had left the Europeans and their common agricultural policy shaken but not stirred.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has been shaken but not stirred by an experience, you mean that they have been slightly disturbed or emotionally affected by it, but not deeply enough to change their behaviour or way of thinking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人痛苦的；辛酸的；惨痛的

ext.ext_cn: 美丽山水和悲惨历史让人黯然神伤的结合
ext.ext_en: ...a poignant combination of beautiful surroundings and tragic history.

ext.ext_cn: 辛酸的爱情故事
ext.ext_en: ...a poignant love story...

defs.def_en: Something that is poignant affects you deeply and makes you feel sadness or regret.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我坚信一切终究都会好起来。
ext.ext_en: I am confident that everything will come out right in time...

ext.ext_cn: 瑞安先生坚信一定会成功。
ext.ext_en: Mr Ryan is confident of success...

defs.def_en: If you are confident about something, you are certain that it will happen in the way you want it to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 过了一段时间，他变得更加自信、更为放松。
ext.ext_en: In time he became more confident and relaxed...

ext.ext_cn: 她是一位充满自信的女性，对自己的观点深信不疑。
ext.ext_en: She is a confident woman who is certain of her views.

defs.def_en: If a person or their manner is confident, they feel sure about their own abilities, qualities, or ideas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她确信所有人都站在她这边。
ext.ext_en: She is confident that everybody is on her side...

ext.ext_cn: “我肯定行。”传来一个很有把握的回答。
ext.ext_en: 'Bet you I can', comes the confident reply.

defs.def_en: If you are confident that something is true, you are sure that it is true. A confident statement is one that the speaker is sure is true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 安妮处乱不惊，十分冷静沉着。
ext.ext_en: Anne had remained unruffled, very cool and controlled.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as unruffled, you mean that they are calm and do not seem to be affected by surprising or frightening events.

ext.ext_cn: 我戴上乳罩，穿上内裤。
ext.ext_en: I put on my bra and pants.

defs.def_en: Pants are a piece of underwear which have two holes to put your legs through and elastic around the top to hold them up round your waist or hips.

ext.ext_cn: 他身着棕色灯芯绒裤子和白色棉衬衫。
ext.ext_en: He wore brown corduroy pants and a white cotton shirt.

defs.def_en: Pants are a piece of clothing that covers the lower part of your body and each leg.

ext.ext_cn: 那个地方很糟糕，却很受欢迎。
ext.ext_en: The place is pants, yet so popular.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is pants, you mean that it is very poor in quality.

defs.def_cn: 使…（烦）得要死；把…（吓）得要命

ext.ext_cn: 你会把孙辈们烦透的。
ext.ext_en: You'll bore the pants off your grandchildren...

ext.ext_cn: 我们都喜欢乘坐游乐场那些让人毛发直竖的游乐设施，把自己吓得魂不附体。
ext.ext_en: We all love to frighten the pants off ourselves by going on hair-raising rides at funfairs.

defs.def_en: If someone bores, charms, or scares the pants off you, for example, they bore, charm, or scare you a lot.

If you fly by the seat of your pants or do something by the seat of your pants, you use your instincts to tell you what to do in a new or difficult situation rather than following a plan or relying on equipment.
To play upon something means the same as to play on it.
A hillside is the sloping side of a hill.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她醒来时已是晚上，天已经黑了。
ext.ext_en: When she awoke it was evening and already dark...

ext.ext_cn: 里面太暗，看不太清。
ext.ext_en: It was too dark inside to see much...

defs.def_en: When it is dark, there is not enough light to see properly, for example because it is night.

ext.ext_cn: 她母亲坐在炉边暗处的摇椅里。
ext.ext_en: Her mother was sitting in the dark by the stove in her rocking chair...

ext.ext_cn: 我一直很怕黑。
ext.ext_en: I've always been afraid of the dark.

defs.def_en: The dark is the lack of light in a place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他身穿暗色西服，手提黑色公文包。
ext.ext_en: He wore a dark suit and carried a black attaché case...

ext.ext_cn: 笨重的深色桌子上嵌有颜色较浅的木头。
ext.ext_en: The heavy dark table is inlaid with lighter wood.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as dark, you mean that it is black in colour, or a shade that is close to black.

ext.ext_cn: 她穿着一件深蓝色的礼服。
ext.ext_en: She was wearing a dark blue dress.

defs.def_en: When you use dark to describe a colour, you are referring to a shade of that colour which is close to black, or seems to have some black in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (头发、眼睛或肤色)棕色的，黑色的

ext.ext_cn: 他有一头卷曲的黑发。
ext.ext_en: He had dark, curly hair...

ext.ext_cn: 利奥接着说下去，他的黑眼睛瞪得大大的，充满怜悯和关切。
ext.ext_en: Leo went on, his dark eyes wide with pity and concern.

defs.def_en: If someone has dark hair, eyes, or skin, they have brown or black hair, eyes, or skin.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (白人）有着棕色（或黑色）头发（且皮肤略带棕色）的，肤色深的

ext.ext_cn: 卡萝尔身材高大，黑发棕肤，是个有着拉丁风情的女子。
ext.ext_en: Carol is a tall, dark, Latin type of woman...

ext.ext_cn: 司机一头乌发、肤色黝黑，可能是个马耳他人。
ext.ext_en: The driver was very dark. Maltese, maybe.

defs.def_en: If you describe a white person as dark, you mean that they have brown or black hair, and often a brownish skin.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 又有传言说以后的日子会非常艰难。
ext.ext_en: Once again there's talk of very dark days ahead...

ext.ext_cn: 这是那次战争中最黑暗的时期。
ext.ext_en: This was the darkest period of the war.

defs.def_en: A dark period of time is unpleasant or frightening.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这艘宇宙飞船可能会让人们对太阳系中的一个神秘角落有更新的认识。
ext.ext_en: The spacecraft is set to throw new light on to a dark corner of the solar system.

ext.ext_cn: 隐秘的思想深处
ext.ext_en: ...the dark recesses of the mind.

defs.def_en: A dark place or area is mysterious and not fully known about.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 特洛伊的喋喋不休让我暂时收起了阴郁思绪。
ext.ext_en: Troy's chatter kept me from thinking dark thoughts.

defs.def_en: Dark thoughts are sad, and show that you are expecting something unpleasant to happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (眼神或话语）阴险的，邪恶的，不祥的

ext.ext_cn: 加林恶狠狠地瞪了他一眼，似乎是在警告。
ext.ext_en: Garin shot him a dark glance, as if in warning.

ext.ext_cn: 恶毒的威胁
ext.ext_en: ...dark threats.

ext.ext_en: ...the Honourable Member for Billericay.

defs.def_en: In debates in the British parliament, one member of parliament refers to another as the honourable member, the honourable gentleman, the honourable lady, or their honourable friend.

ext.ext_en: The old-timers and established families clutched the reins of power.

defs.def_en: An old man is sometimes referred to as an old-timer .

defs.def_en: A barnstorming performance is full of energy and very exciting to watch.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 选择性的;有选择的;选取少量的

ext.ext_en: Selective breeding may result in a greyhound running faster and seeing better than a wolf.

ext.ext_cn: 尖子生教育
ext.ext_en: ...selective education.

defs.def_en: A selective process applies only to a few things or people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 仔细挑选的;严格筛选的

ext.ext_en: If public figures seek publicity to further their careers, they can't be selective about it.

defs.def_en: When someone is selective, they choose things carefully, for example the things that they buy or do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: We seem to have a selective memory for the best bits of the past...

ext.ext_cn: 对于自己在该事件中所扮演的角色，罗宾斯先生患上了选择性失忆症，因此几乎在每次庭审中都会受到其他证人的反驳。
ext.ext_en: Mr Robins, suffering from selective amnesia about his role in the affair, was contradicted in nearly every instance by other witnesses.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a selective memory, you disapprove of the fact that they remember certain facts about something and deliberately forget others, often because it is convenient for them to do so.

ext.ext_cn: 工作进展得一直很顺利。
ext.ext_en: The work has been going swimmingly.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is going swimmingly, you mean that everything is happening in a satisfactory way, without any problems.

ext.ext_cn: 我常和他们混在一起，但是从来没觉得跟他们是一类人。
ext.ext_en: I went around with them, but never felt like one of them.

defs.def_en: If you go around with a person or group of people, you regularly meet them and go to different places with them.

ext.ext_cn: 中厅开有两扇门。
ext.ext_en: There were two doors leading off the central room...

ext.ext_cn: 从游泳池可以通到治疗室。
ext.ext_en: The treatment rooms lead off from the swimming pool...

defs.def_en: If a door, room, or path leads off a place or leads off from a place, you can go directly from that place through that door, into that room, or along that path.

ext.ext_cn: 任何一支舞都是我和他领跳。
ext.ext_en: Whenever there was a dance he and I led off...

defs.def_en: If someone leads off in an activity, meeting, or conversation, they start it.

defs.def_en: In baseball, the player who leads off is the first player to bat for their team in a game or inning.

defs.def_cn: 在公共厕所里的男同性恋性行为;泡公厕

defs.def_en: An orbital road goes all the way round a large city.

ext.ext_en: The newly discovered world followed an orbital path unlike that of any other planet.

defs.def_en: Orbital describes things relating to the orbit of an object in space.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极重要的;必要的;紧急的

ext.ext_en: It was imperative that he act as naturally as possible...

ext.ext_en: That's why it is imperative to know what your rights are at such a time...

defs.def_en: If it is imperative that something is done, that thing is extremely important and must be done.

ext.ext_cn: 现在的头等政治大事就是要控制美国人的伤亡人数。
ext.ext_en: The most important political imperative is to limit the number of US casualties.

ext.ext_en: ...the needs of those unable to respond to the imperatives of an enterprise culture.

defs.def_en: An imperative is something that is extremely important and must be done.

In grammar, a clause that is in the imperative, or in the imperative mood, contains the base form of a verb and usually has no subject. Examples are 'Go away' and 'Please be careful'. Clauses of this kind are typically used to tell someone to do something.
An imperative is a verb in the base form that is used, usually without a subject, in an imperative clause.

ext.ext_cn: 濒临死亡的征兆

defs.def_en: An intimation is an indirect suggestion or sign that something is likely to happen or be true.

ext.ext_en: ...a solitary, unshaded bulb dangling from a long flex.

defs.def_en: An unshaded light or light bulb has no shade fitted to it.

defs.def_en: If you tie an animal up, you fasten it to a fixed object with a piece of rope so that it cannot run away.

ext.ext_en: The older child should be able to prepare a simple meal...

ext.ext_en: You'll be able to read in peace...

ext.ext_en: Have you been able to have any kind of contact?...

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 聪明能干的；能力出众的

ext.ext_en: ...one of the brightest and ablest members of the government...

ext.ext_cn: 他们聪明又智慧，能干又自信。
ext.ext_en: They are bright, intelligent, able and confident.

defs.def_cn: 从不出错的；一贯正确的

ext.ext_en: These designs demonstrate her unerring eye for colour and detail...

ext.ext_cn: 保罗十分讨人喜欢，开玩笑时很有分寸。
ext.ext_en: Paul is a thoroughly likeable man with an unerring sense of comedy...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's judgment or ability as unerring, you mean that they are always correct and never mistaken.

ext.ext_cn: 敞篷马车
ext.ext_en: ...a horse-drawn open-topped carriage.

defs.def_en: A horse-drawn carriage, cart, or other vehicle is one that is pulled by one or more horses.

ext.ext_en: As speech develops, the child starts to string more words together...

ext.ext_en: The speaker strung together a series of jokes.

defs.def_en: If you string things together, you form something from them by adding them to each other, one at a time.

ext.ext_en: ...industrial dinosaurs.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an organization as a dinosaur, you mean that it is large, inefficient, and out of date.

ext.ext_en: ...a pair of double doors into the room from the new entrance hall.

ext.ext_en: ...a lone skier gliding along smooth double tracks.

ext.ext_en: The government committed a double blunder...

defs.def_en: You use double before a singular noun to refer to two things of the same type that occur together, or that are connected in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 所提供的工作机会是创建一个新的研究实验室，待遇是他当时所得工资的两倍。
ext.ext_en: The offer was to start a new research laboratory at double the salary he was then getting...

ext.ext_cn: 据报道利兹监狱里犯人的数量几乎已达该监狱设计可容纳人数的两倍了。
ext.ext_en: Leeds Prison is reported to have almost double the number of prisoners it's designed to accommodate.

defs.def_en: If something is double the amount or size of another thing, it is twice as large.

defs.def_cn: 加倍的;双料的;可容纳两个的

ext.ext_cn: 双份的冰激凌
ext.ext_en: ...a double helping of ice cream.

ext.ext_cn: 能停放两辆车的大车库
ext.ext_en: ...a large double garage...

defs.def_en: You use double to describe something which is twice the normal size or can hold twice the normal quantity of something.

ext.ext_en: ...bed and breakfast for £180 for two people in a double room.

ext.ext_en: The Great Western Hotel costs around £60 a night for a double.

defs.def_en: A double room is a room intended for two people, usually a couple, to stay or live in.

ext.ext_cn: 他猛灌着双份威士忌，脸色阴沉。

ext.ext_cn: 给我来杯威士忌，双份的。
ext.ext_en: Give me a whisky, a double.

ext.ext_en: Ring four two double two double two if you'd like to speak to our financial adviser.

defs.def_en: Double is used when you are spelling a word or telling someone a number to show that a letter or digit is repeated.

ext.ext_en: The program will double the amount of money available to help pay for child care.

defs.def_en: When something doubles or when you double it, it becomes twice as great in number, amount, or size.

ext.ext_en: Your mother sees you as her double.

ext.ext_en: Lots of homes in town double as businesses.

ext.ext_cn: 两名士兵立即进来敬礼。
ext.ext_en: Two soldiers entered at the double and saluted...

ext.ext_en: Come to my office, please, at the double.

defs.def_en: If you do something at the double or on the double, you do it very quickly or immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 空间太小无法站直，他不得不弓着身子。
ext.ext_en: There wasn't room to stand up and he had to bend double.

defs.def_en: When you bend double, you bend the top half of your body downwards a long way.

ext.ext_cn: 采花人弓着身子飞快地摘着花。
ext.ext_en: Pickers are bent double, plucking each flower with lightning speed.

defs.def_en: If you are bent double, the top half of your body is bent downwards so that your head is close to your knees.

ext.ext_cn: 我一阵眩晕，看到的都是重影。
ext.ext_en: I was dizzy, seeing double.

defs.def_en: If you are seeing double, there is something wrong with your eyes, and you can see two images instead of one.

defs.def_cn: 震惊;惊愕;令人震惊的事

ext.ext_cn: 暴力程度令人震惊。
ext.ext_en: The extent of the violence came as a shock...

ext.ext_cn: 他从未从你哥哥去世的打击中恢复过来。
ext.ext_en: He has never recovered from the shock of your brother's death...

defs.def_en: If you have a shock, something suddenly happens which is unpleasant, upsetting, or very surprising.

ext.ext_cn: 那小男孩惊得说不出话来。
ext.ext_en: The little boy was speechless with shock...

ext.ext_cn: 她仍惊魂未定。
ext.ext_en: She's still in a state of shock.

defs.def_en: Shock is a person's emotional and physical condition when something very frightening or upsetting has happened to them.

ext.ext_cn: 发现他被打得休克了。
ext.ext_en: He was found beaten and in shock...

ext.ext_cn: 他们逃离了火海,却因休克而被迅速送往医院。
ext.ext_en: They escaped the blaze but were rushed to hospital suffering from shock.

defs.def_en: If someone is in shock, they are suffering from a serious physical condition in which their blood is not flowing round their body properly, for example because they have had a bad injury.

ext.ext_cn: 在警队呆了 40 年后，我对什么都见怪不怪了。
ext.ext_en: After forty years in the police force nothing much shocks me...

ext.ext_cn: 救援人员被眼前的景象惊呆了。
ext.ext_en: Relief workers were shocked by what they saw.

defs.def_en: If something shocks you, it makes you feel very upset, because it involves death or suffering and because you had not expected it.

defs.def_cn: (因行为粗鲁或不道德而)使不快，使气愤，使厌恶，使反感

ext.ext_cn: 我不会被你激怒的。
ext.ext_en: You can't shock me...

ext.ext_cn: 在那个年代，他们动不动就对一些事情看不顺眼。
ext.ext_en: They were easily shocked in those days...

defs.def_en: If someone or something shocks you, it upsets or offends you because you think it is rude or morally wrong.

defs.def_cn: (通告、事件等)令人惊愕的，令人震惊的

ext.ext_cn: 她将要辞职的惊人声明
ext.ext_en: ...the shock announcement that she is to resign.

ext.ext_cn: 令人震惊的落败
ext.ext_en: ...a shock defeat.

defs.def_en: A shock announcement or event is one which shocks people because it is unexpected.

defs.def_cn: (对经济、传统、生活方式的)冲击，撞击

ext.ext_cn: 这是一系列对斯堪的纳维亚银行系统的冲击中最近的一次。
ext.ext_en: This is the latest in a series of shocks to the Scandinavian banking system.

ext.ext_cn: 两次原油冲击下的经济萧条
ext.ext_en: ...the economic pain of two oil shocks.

defs.def_en: A shock is something sudden and unexpected that threatens the economy, traditions, or way of life of a group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 钢制栅栏可以弯曲并能吸收冲击力。
ext.ext_en: Steel barriers can bend and absorb the shock.

defs.def_en: A shock is the force of something suddenly hitting or pulling something else.
A shock is the same as an electric shock .

ext.ext_cn: 你认为我需要换新的减震器吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you think I need new shocks?

defs.def_en: A shock is a shock absorber .

ext.ext_cn: 满头白发、年事已高的神父
ext.ext_en: ...a very old priest with a shock of white hair.

defs.def_en: A shock of hair is a very thick mass of hair on a person's head.
A short, sharp shock is a punishment that is fairly harsh and severe but only lasts for a short time.

defs.def_cn: 外交豁免（外交官在所驻国内无需承担法律责任和缴税义务的特权）

ext.ext_cn: 那名使馆官员申请外交豁免，随后被释放。
ext.ext_en: The embassy official claimed diplomatic immunity and was later released.

defs.def_en: Diplomatic immunity is the freedom from legal action and from paying taxes that a diplomat has in the country in which he or she is working.

defs.def_cn: (花费等)极其昂贵的，贵得离谱的

ext.ext_cn: 很多英国人仍然会对其司法体系可能产生的高昂费用表示担忧。
ext.ext_en: Many Britons will still fear the potentially ruinous costs of their legal system.

defs.def_en: If you describe the cost of something as ruinous, you mean that it costs far more money than you can afford or than is reasonable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家的经济正受到这次冲突的毁灭性影响。
ext.ext_en: The economy of the state is experiencing the ruinous effects of the conflict.

defs.def_en: A ruinous process or course of action is one that is likely to lead to ruin.
A blue ribbon is the same as a blue riband .

defs.def_cn: 将…妖魔化;把…想象成魔鬼

ext.ext_cn: 双方都开始把对方妖魔化。
ext.ext_en: Each side began to demonize the other.

defs.def_en: If people demonize someone, they convince themselves that that person is evil.

ext.ext_cn: 已接触过 100 多个买主或投资人，不过没人愿意接受。
ext.ext_en: Over 100 buyers or investors were approached, but there were no takers...

ext.ext_cn: 他还没有找到愿意接受那个想法的人。
ext.ext_en: He hasn't found any takers for that idea.

defs.def_en: If there are no takers for something such as an investment or a challenge, nobody is willing to accept it.

defs.def_cn: 精彩演出;精心杰作；绝活

ext.ext_cn: 史蒂文森感人肺腑的表演真是绝了。
ext.ext_en: Stevenson's deeply felt performance is a tour-de-force...

ext.ext_cn: 他的精心之作是一件大象雕塑。
ext.ext_en: His tour de force is an elephant sculpture.

defs.def_en: If you call something such as a performance, speech, or production a tour de force, you are emphasizing that it is extremely good or extremely well done or made.
Clansmen are people who are members of the same clan .

defs.def_cn: 灵应牌，灵乩板（上面刻有字母、用于向亡灵提问的板牌）
defs.def_en: A ouija board is a board with the letters of the alphabet written on it. It is used to ask questions which are thought to be answered by the spirits of dead people.

defs.def_cn: (四周有过去建的马厩的)庭院，小街，小巷

ext.ext_cn: 这座房子坐落在一个偏僻的院子里。
ext.ext_en: The house is in a secluded mews.

ext.ext_cn: 她在伦敦的由旧时马厩改建的住房
ext.ext_en: ...her London mews house

defs.def_en: A mews is a street or small area surrounded by houses that were originally built as stables.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他操着一口带有德国腔的英语问我在法国玩得是否愉快。
ext.ext_en: He asked in his Germanic English if I was enjoying France.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as Germanic, you think that their appearance or behaviour is typical of German people or things.

defs.def_cn: 日耳曼文化的；日耳曼语的

ext.ext_cn: 基督教创立之前定居在欧洲的日耳曼部落
ext.ext_en: ...the Germanic tribes of pre-Christian Europe.

defs.def_en: Germanic is used to describe the ancient culture and language of the peoples of northern Europe.
kHz is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) kilohertz. It is often written on radios beside a range of numbers to help you find a particular radio station.

ext.ext_cn: 他用自己最喜欢的几位体育明星的照片装饰房间。
ext.ext_en: He decorated his room with pictures of all his favorite sports figures...

ext.ext_cn: 用贝壳来装点盒子、托盘、镜子甚至是花盆。
ext.ext_en: Use shells to decorate boxes, trays, mirrors or even pots.

defs.def_en: If you decorate something, you make it more attractive by adding things to it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们装修后面的卧室时，是耶马最后说了算。
ext.ext_en: When they came to decorate the rear bedroom, it was Jemma who had the final say...

ext.ext_cn: 小伙子们正打算有时间油漆一下。
ext.ext_en: The boys are planning to decorate when they get the time...

defs.def_en: If you decorate a room or the inside of a building, you put new paint or wallpaper on the walls and ceiling, and paint the woodwork.

ext.ext_cn: 康斯太布尔风景画的海报装点着那些墙面。
ext.ext_en: Constable posters decorate the walls.

defs.def_en: If something decorates a place or an object, it makes it look more attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 他因为作战英勇而被授予奖章。
ext.ext_en: He was decorated for bravery in battle.

defs.def_en: If someone is decorated, they are given a medal or other honour as an official reward for something that they have done.

ext.ext_cn: 他派侦察兵打头阵。
ext.ext_en: He dispatched scouts ahead...

ext.ext_cn: 意大利政府正准备派遣 4,000 名士兵搜索该岛。
ext.ext_en: The Italian government was preparing to dispatch 4,000 soldiers to search the island.

defs.def_en: If you dispatch someone to a place, you send them there for a particular reason.

defs.def_cn: 发送，发出（信息、信件或包裹）

ext.ext_cn: 胜利促使他给罗斯福发了封喜报。
ext.ext_en: The victory inspired him to dispatch a gleeful telegram to Roosevelt...

ext.ext_cn: 赠品会分开发送，所以请预留28天的送货期。
ext.ext_en: Free gifts are dispatched separately so please allow 28 days for delivery.

defs.def_en: If you dispatch a message, letter, or parcel, you send it to a particular person or destination.

defs.def_cn: (身在另一城市或国家的记者发送的)电讯，新闻报道

ext.ext_cn: 我台驻西非记者发来的这一报道
ext.ext_en: ...this despatch from our West Africa correspondent.

defs.def_en: A dispatch is a special report that is sent to a newspaper or broadcasting organization by a journalist who is in a different town or country.

defs.def_cn: (军官或政府官员发送给总部的)急件，快信

ext.ext_cn: 我正拿着大使的急件。
ext.ext_en: I was carrying dispatches from the ambassador.

ext.ext_cn: 他被誉为英雄，得到了通报表彰，最后还获得了一枚勋章。
ext.ext_en: He was hailed as a hero, mentioned in dispatches and finally given a medal.

defs.def_en: A dispatch is a message or report that is sent, for example, by army officers or government officials to their headquarters.

ext.ext_cn: 那只狐狸和一群随时可能置其于死地的猎狗冒险周旋。
ext.ext_en: The fox takes his chance with a pack of hounds which may catch him and despatch him immediately.

defs.def_en: To dispatch a person or an animal means to kill them.

ext.ext_cn: 埃米坐在外面晒太阳，而杰拉尔德则忙着处理个人事务。
ext.ext_en: Amy sat outside in the sun while Gerald despatched his business.

defs.def_en: To dispatch a job or task means to finish it quickly and efficiently without wasting time.

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得我们应该迅速行动。
ext.ext_en: He feels we should act with despatch.

defs.def_en: If you do something with dispatch, you do it very quickly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 认为老师们总那么宽容是幼稚的。
ext.ext_en: It's naive to think that teachers are always tolerant...

ext.ext_cn: 我一定太天真了，竟认为我们会得到我父母的祝福。
ext.ext_en: I must have been naive to think we would get my parents' blessing.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as naive, you think they lack experience and so expect things to be easy or people to be honest or kind.

ext.ext_cn: 我弟弟和我的大儿子长得惊人地相似
ext.ext_en: The astonishing similarity between my brother and my first-born son...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的人生哲学在根本上很相似。
ext.ext_en: There was a very basic similarity in our philosophy...

defs.def_en: If there is a similarity between two or more things, they are similar to each other.

defs.def_cn: 相似处;相似点;类似的地方

ext.ext_cn: 母子之间有很多相像的地方。
ext.ext_en: There were significant similarities between mother and son...

ext.ext_cn: 火星和地球之间的诸多相似处足以让人们对火星上存在某种生物抱以希望。
ext.ext_en: The similarities between Mars and Earth were enough to keep alive hopes of some form of Martian life.

defs.def_en: Similarities are features that things have which make them similar to each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不拘俗套的；潇洒得意的

ext.ext_cn: 他潇洒地歪戴着的一顶软边帽
ext.ext_en: ...a soft-brimmed hat which he wore at a rakish angle.

ext.ext_cn: 潇洒的年轻绅士
ext.ext_en: ...rakish young gentlemen.

defs.def_en: A rakish person or appearance is stylish in a confident, bold way.

ext.ext_cn: 1986年，他们取得了恢复南非公民身份的权利。
ext.ext_en: In 1986, they got the right to reclaim South African citizenship...

ext.ext_cn: “我来要求归还我的房产，”她向接待人员宣布。
ext.ext_en: 'I've come to reclaim my property,' she announced to the desk clerk.

defs.def_en: If you reclaim something that you have lost or that has been taken away from you, you succeed in getting it back.

ext.ext_cn: 估计现在有800万人有资格申请所得税退税。
ext.ext_en: There are an estimated eight million people currently thought to be eligible to reclaim income tax.

defs.def_en: If you reclaim an amount of money, for example tax that you have paid, you claim it back.

defs.def_cn: 开垦（荒地）；开拓（耕地或建筑用地）

ext.ext_cn: 荷兰人一直在围海造地。
ext.ext_en: The Netherlands has been reclaiming farmland from water.

ext.ext_cn: 在东京湾通过围海造地开拓的1,100英亩土地上建造住宅区的计划
ext.ext_en: ...a scheme to build a residential development on 1,100 acres of reclaimed land in Tokyo Bay.

defs.def_en: When people reclaim land, they make it suitable for a purpose such as farming or building, for example by draining it or by building a barrier against the sea.

defs.def_cn: 使（农田、建筑用地）重新变成（沙漠、森林或海洋）

ext.ext_cn: 这些钻石城镇正逐渐重归沙漠。
ext.ext_en: The diamond towns are gradually being reclaimed by the desert...

ext.ext_cn: 这种喷洒法可以使土地重新变成雨林。
ext.ext_en: This method of spraying would allow the land to be reclaimed by the rain forests.

defs.def_en: If a piece of land that was used for farming or building is reclaimed by a desert, forest, or the sea, it turns back into desert, forest, or sea.

ext.ext_cn: 他从挽救当地帮派的一个年轻人入手着力消除奥马哈的毒品泛滥问题。
ext.ext_en: He set out to fight the drug infestation of Omaha by reclaiming a youth from the local gangs.

defs.def_en: If you reclaim a person who has been involved in bad or criminal behaviour, you cause them to stop acting in that way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自命不凡的；自负的；矫饰的；炫耀的

ext.ext_cn: 他的答复是一派荒谬的虚夸之词。
ext.ext_en: His response was full of pretentious nonsense...

ext.ext_cn: 这个酒吧风格独特，面积不大，比较低调。
ext.ext_en: This pub was of a very different type, smaller, less pretentious.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is pretentious, you mean that they try to seem important or significant, but you do not think that they are.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 兴奋过头的；兴奋得忘乎所以的

ext.ext_cn: 你要提供连贯有序的娱乐活动，否则孩子们就有可能兴奋过头。
ext.ext_en: You'll need to provide continuous, organised entertainment or children may get over-excited.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is over-excited, you mean that they are more excited than you think is desirable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不动感情的；不带偏见的

ext.ext_cn: 作为检察官，我们对经手的案件会尽力做到不偏不倚。
ext.ext_en: We, as prosecutors, try to be dispassionate about the cases we bring...

ext.ext_cn: 他以一个讲师般平板、不动感情的口吻说话。
ext.ext_en: He spoke in the flat, dispassionate tone of a lecturer.

defs.def_en: Someone who is dispassionate is calm and reasonable, and not affected by emotions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 1986年发行的《勇于冒险》是一张风格更为统一也更为成功的专辑。
ext.ext_en: 'Daring Adventures' from '86 is a far more cohesive and successful album...

ext.ext_cn: 休斯顿聚集起了一个非常默契和讨喜的演员团队。
ext.ext_en: Huston had assembled a remarkably cohesive and sympathetic cast.

defs.def_en: Something that is cohesive consists of parts that fit together well and form a united whole.

ext.ext_cn: 安德鲁很快就整理好了手提箱。
ext.ext_en: It did not take Andrew long to pack a suitcase.

defs.def_en: A suitcase is a box or bag with a handle and a hard frame in which you carry your clothes when you are travelling.

defs.def_cn: 居住，使用（建筑物或某地）

ext.ext_cn: 共有40多位房客，他们全部住在这家医院的一个病区。
ext.ext_en: There were over 40 tenants, all occupying one wing of the hospital...

ext.ext_cn: 在大多数情况下，土地都是由其使用者购得。
ext.ext_en: Land is, in most instances, purchased by those who occupy it.

defs.def_en: The people who occupy a building or a place are the people who live or work there.

ext.ext_cn: 他的妻子不在这张病床上了。
ext.ext_en: The hospital bed is no longer occupied by his wife...

ext.ext_cn: 我看见了3张折叠床，其中两张已有人占了。
ext.ext_en: I saw three camp beds, two of which were occupied.

defs.def_en: If a room or something such as a seat is occupied, someone is using it, so that it is not available for anyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 美国军队现在占领了该国的一部分。
ext.ext_en: U.S. forces now occupy a part of the country...

ext.ext_cn: 土耳其溃败之后，亚历山大勒塔在1918年被法国人占领。
ext.ext_en: Alexandretta had been occupied by the French in 1918 after the defeat of Turkey.

defs.def_en: If a group of people or an army occupies a place or country, they move into it, using force in order to gain control of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在市场上居于高端地位。
ext.ext_en: We occupy a quality position in the market place...

ext.ext_cn: 担任要职的男性仍然比女性多。
ext.ext_en: Men still occupy more positions of power than women.

defs.def_en: If someone or something occupies a particular place in a system, process, or plan, they have that place.

ext.ext_cn: 她整日忙于议会的工作。
ext.ext_en: Her parliamentary career has occupied all of her time...

ext.ext_cn: 他急匆匆地去拎手提箱，忙着往车里装。
ext.ext_en: He hurried to take the suitcases and occupy himself with packing the car...

defs.def_en: If something occupies you, or if you occupy yourself, your time, or your mind with it, you are busy doing that thing or thinking about it.

defs.def_cn: 使从事；使关注；使花费时间

ext.ext_cn: 至少白天我还有别的事情要做。
ext.ext_en: I had other matters to occupy me, during the day at least...

ext.ext_cn: 这将是欧洲在未来二三十年或者更长的时间里所要面临的挑战。
ext.ext_en: This challenge will occupy Europe for a generation or more.

defs.def_en: If something occupies you, it requires your efforts, attention, or time.

ext.ext_cn: 哪怕很小的飞机也要占很大的空间。
ext.ext_en: Even quite small aircraft occupy a lot of space...

ext.ext_cn: 这些书架占了起居室的大部分墙面。
ext.ext_en: Bookshelves occupied most of the living room walls.

defs.def_en: If something occupies a particular area or place, it fills or covers it, or exists there.

ext.ext_cn: 她在星期一晚上抵达了卡拉奇，这段行程耗时3天9小时。
ext.ext_en: She reached Karachi on Monday evening, the journey having occupied three days and nine hours.

defs.def_en: If something such as a journey occupies a particular period of time, it takes that amount of time to complete.

Treacle is a thick, sweet, sticky liquid that is obtained when sugar is processed. It is used in making cakes and puddings.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 傲慢无礼的;自命不凡的

ext.ext_cn: 她是著名演员，却丝毫没有明星架子。
ext.ext_en: She was a famous actress, but she wasn't a bit stuck-up.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is stuck-up, you mean that are very proud and unfriendly because they think they are very important.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他向她投以钦慕的目光。
ext.ext_en: He cast her an admiring glance...

ext.ext_cn: 不出片刻，他就赢得了全场观众的倾心。
ext.ext_en: Within moments, he'd attracted an admiring audience.

defs.def_en: An admiring expression shows that you like or respect someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 是内部检举和调查性报道揭露了这一腐败事实。
ext.ext_en: It took internal whistle-blowing and investigative journalism to uncover the rot.

ext.ext_cn: 一份印证了该公务员全部检举内容的长达144页的报告
ext.ext_en: ...a 144-page report which confirmed everything the whistle-blowing civil servant had alleged.

defs.def_en: Whistle-blowing is the act of telling the authorities or the public that the organization you are working for is doing something immoral or illegal.

defs.def_cn: 使（国王、女王、皇帝、主教等）登位;使登基

ext.ext_cn: 她突然哭了，跑出了厨房。
ext.ext_en: She burst into tears and ran from the kitchen...

defs.def_en: You can use tears in expressions such as in tears ,burst into tears, and close to tears to indicate that someone is crying or is almost crying.

ext.ext_cn: 她差点把我的大衣扯破了。
ext.ext_en: She very nearly tore my overcoat...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽·安撕掉了餐巾的边儿。
ext.ext_en: Mary Ann tore the edge off her napkin...

defs.def_en: If you tear paper, cloth, or another material, or if it tears, you pull it into two pieces or you pull it so that a hole appears in it.

ext.ext_cn: 我通过篷车帘子的破洞窥视。
ext.ext_en: I peered through a tear in the van's curtains.

defs.def_en: A tear in paper, cloth, or another material is a hole that has been made in it.

ext.ext_cn: 犬齿用来咬穿、咬死猎物，还可以撕肉。
ext.ext_en: Canine teeth are for piercing and killing prey, and tearing flesh...

ext.ext_cn: 他绊倒在地，膝盖上蹭破了皮。
ext.ext_en: He had stumbled down and torn the skin from his knees.

defs.def_en: If something tears your flesh or skin, it cuts it badly.

ext.ext_cn: 他右大腿的一块肌肉拉伤了。
ext.ext_en: He tore a muscle in his right thigh...

ext.ext_cn: 这块肌肉要是再拉伸的话，甚至可能会撕裂。
ext.ext_en: If the muscle is stretched again it could even tear.

defs.def_en: If you tear one of your muscles or ligaments, or if it tears, you injure it by accidentally moving it in the wrong way.

ext.ext_cn: 她猛地扯掉他车上的雨刷。
ext.ext_en: She tore the windscreen wipers from his car...

ext.ext_cn: 他一把扯下那女孩的照片，将它揉成一团。
ext.ext_en: He tore down the girl's photograph, and crumpled it into a ball.

defs.def_en: To tear something from somewhere means to remove it roughly and violently.

ext.ext_cn: 女粉丝冲破保安的阻拦，撕扯他的衣裳。
ext.ext_en: Female fans fought their way past bodyguards and tore at his clothes.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal tears at something, they pull it violently and try to break it into pieces.

ext.ext_cn: 门猛地开了，米兰达闯进房间。
ext.ext_en: The door flew open and Miranda tore into the room...

ext.ext_cn: 他也不朝两边看，就在路上开始狂奔。
ext.ext_en: Without looking to left or to right, he tore off down the road.

defs.def_en: If you tear somewhere, you move there very quickly, often in an uncontrolled or dangerous way.

defs.def_cn: 使饱经创伤;使经受磨难

ext.ext_cn: 自独立以来就饱受内战和外敌入侵之苦的国家
ext.ext_en: ...a country that has been torn by civil war and foreign invasion since its independence.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place is torn by particular events, you mean that unpleasant events which cause suffering and division among people are happening there.

defs.def_cn: 无比的；空前的；无双的；绝无仅有的

ext.ext_cn: 德国空前的繁荣是建立在明智的投资基础之上的。
ext.ext_en: Germany's unparalleled prosperity is based on wise investments...

ext.ext_cn: 该国正面临着一场二战以来前所未有的危机。
ext.ext_en: The country is facing a crisis unparalleled since the Second World War.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unparalleled, you are emphasizing that it is, for example, bigger, better, or worse than anything else of its kind, or anything that has happened before.
A knapsack is a canvas or leather bag that you carry on your back or over your shoulder, for example when you are walking in the countryside.

ext.ext_cn: 他穿着黑色上衣和条纹裤子，简直无可挑剔。
ext.ext_en: He was faultlessly attired in black coat and striped trousers.

defs.def_en: If you describe how someone is attired, you are describing how they are dressed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一旦我们的服务对他们不再有用，我们就可能被抛弃。
ext.ext_en: Once our services cease to be useful to them, we're expendable...

ext.ext_cn: 在经济衰退期间，培训预算被认为是一项可以节省下来的奢侈费用。
ext.ext_en: During the recession, training budgets were seen as an expendable luxury.

defs.def_en: If you regard someone or something as expendable, you think it is acceptable to get rid of them, abandon them, or allow them to be destroyed when they are no longer needed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 通情达理的;头脑清醒的;情绪稳定的

ext.ext_cn: 喜欢玩乐、通情达理的人
ext.ext_en: ...a fun-loving, well-balanced individual.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as well-balanced, you mean that they are sensible and do not have many emotional problems.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 均衡的膳食
ext.ext_en: ...a well balanced diet.

defs.def_en: If you describe something that is made up of several parts as well-balanced, you mean that the way that the different parts are put together is good, because there is not too much or too little of any one part.

defs.def_cn: 将…还押候审;使取保候审

ext.ext_cn: 卡特在押候审7天。
ext.ext_en: Carter was remanded in custody for seven days...

ext.ext_cn: 两个人都被雷克瑟姆的地方治安官批准保释，直到3月24日审判。
ext.ext_en: Both were remanded on bail by Wrexham magistrates until March 24.

defs.def_en: If a person who is accused of a crime is remanded in custody or on bail, they are told to return to the court at a later date, when their trial will take place.

defs.def_cn: 还押候审（期）；取保候审（期）

ext.ext_cn: 取保候审听证会通常在3分钟内结束。
ext.ext_en: The remand hearing is often over in three minutes...

ext.ext_cn: 这将意味着更多候审犯人会被拘押在警局拘留室。
ext.ext_en: This will mean more remand prisoners being held in police cells...

defs.def_en: Remand is used to refer to the process of remanding someone in custody or on bail, or to the period of time until their trial begins.

defs.def_cn: 引起，导致（疾病、痛苦或某种感觉）

ext.ext_cn: 严重的惊吓会造成痤疮突发。
ext.ext_en: Severe shock can bring on an attack of acne...

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃死于由他的生活方式引起的心脏病突发。
ext.ext_en: Bob died of a heart attack, brought on by his lifestyle.

defs.def_en: If something brings on an illness, pain, or feeling, especially one that you often suffer from, it causes you to have it.
A ballroom is a very large room that is used for dancing.

defs.def_cn: (用于疑问句，询问人的姓名或身份)谁

ext.ext_cn: “我想发份电报。”——“好的，发给谁？”
ext.ext_en: 'I want to send a telegram.' — 'Fine, to whom?'...

ext.ext_cn: 他希望由谁来接电话？
ext.ext_en: Whom did he expect to answer his phone?...

defs.def_en: You use whom in questions when you ask about the name or identity of a person or group of people.

defs.def_cn: (尤用于某些动词和形容词后，引导谈论某人或某一群人的姓名或身份的从句)谁

ext.ext_cn: 他问我把他曾离开的消息告诉过谁。
ext.ext_en: He asked whom I'd told about his having been away...

ext.ext_cn: 他想知道你见了谁。
ext.ext_en: He likes to know whom you've met...

defs.def_en: You use whom after certain words, especially verbs and adjectives, to introduce a clause where you talk about the name or identity of a person or a group of people.

defs.def_cn: (用于进行限定说明或提供更多信息的关系从句的句首)

ext.ext_cn: 我感兴趣的其中一位作家是伊曼纽尔·韦利科夫斯基。
ext.ext_en: One writer in whom I had taken an interest was Immanuel Velikovsky...

ext.ext_cn: 我所认识的霍姆伍德的居民没多少钱也没多少闲暇时间。
ext.ext_en: The Homewood residents whom I knew had little money and little free time.

defs.def_en: You use whom at the beginning of a relative clause when specifying the person or group of people you are talking about or when giving more information about them.  →see usage note at:who

ext.ext_cn: 受读者喜爱而遭文人蔑视的澳大利亚作家
ext.ext_en: ...the Australian storyteller who was loved by readers but disdained by the literati.

defs.def_en: Literati are well-educated people who are interested in literature.

defs.def_cn: (用考勤卡)记录上班的时间;打卡上班

ext.ext_cn: 他们到了工厂准备打卡上班，却发现大门没开。
ext.ext_en: They arrived to clock on and found the factory gates locked.

defs.def_en: When workers clock on at a factory or office, they put a special card into a device to show what time they arrived.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不仁慈的；不友善的；不厚道的；刻薄的

ext.ext_cn: 去年整个夏天他都对她很恶劣。
ext.ext_en: All last summer he'd been unkind to her...

ext.ext_cn: 所有人说起他来都没有一句坏话。
ext.ext_en: No one has an unkind word to say about him...

defs.def_en: If someone is unkind, they behave in an unpleasant, unfriendly, or slightly cruel way. You can also describe someone's words or actions as unkind .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 坏天气对上午那些风笛吹奏者毫不容情。
ext.ext_en: The weather was unkind to those pipers who played in the morning.

ext.ext_cn: 彼此坚信是无情的命运或机缘让他们一再错过
ext.ext_en: ...a shared conviction that some unkind fate or chance is keeping them apart.

defs.def_en: If you describe something bad that happens to someone as unkind, you mean that they do not deserve it.

ext.ext_cn: 我能感觉到血从我脸上流下来。我想我是不是要晕过去了。
ext.ext_en: I could feel blood draining from my face. I wondered whether I was about to black out...

ext.ext_cn: 萨马多夫说他感觉很不舒服，然后就晕了过去。
ext.ext_en: Samadov said that he felt so ill that he blacked out.

defs.def_en: If you black out, you lose consciousness for a short time.

defs.def_cn: 对…实行灯火管制；使一片漆黑

ext.ext_cn: 输电塔爆炸以后，首都大片地区陷入一片漆黑。
ext.ext_en: Large parts of the capital were blacked out after electricity pylons were blown up.

defs.def_en: If a place is blacked out, it is in darkness, usually because it has no electricity supply.

defs.def_cn: 禁播（电影等）；禁止发行，禁止出版（文章、图书等）

ext.ext_cn: 示威画面被禁止在电视上播出。
ext.ext_en: TV pictures of the demonstration were blacked out.

defs.def_en: If a film or a piece of writing is blacked out, it is prevented from being broadcast or published, usually because it contains information which is secret or offensive.

ext.ext_cn: 美国政府的专家们审查了每一页内容，涂掉了外国情报专家可能利用的任何信息。
ext.ext_en: U.S. government specialists went through each page, blacking out any information a foreign intelligence expert could use...

ext.ext_cn: 一些威尔士激进分子已经开始涂盖英语路标。
ext.ext_en: Some Welsh activists have started blacking out English language road signs.

defs.def_en: If you black out a piece of writing, you colour over it in black so that it cannot be seen.

ext.ext_cn: 我尽量不去想它，竭力要将它忘掉。
ext.ext_en: I tried not to think about it. I blacked it out.

defs.def_en: See also:blackout;If you black out the memory of something, you try not to remember it because it upsets you.

ext.ext_cn: 袭击者再度凶残地攻击受害人。
ext.ext_en: The attackers launched another vicious onslaught on their victim...

ext.ext_cn: 叛乱分子为报复政府的军事打击，向一处军营发动猛攻。
ext.ext_en: The rebels responded to a military onslaught against them by launching a major assault on an army camp.

defs.def_en: An onslaught on someone or something is a very violent, forceful attack against them.

ext.ext_cn: 纷至沓来的订单应该会让飞机制造商忙碌一段时间。
ext.ext_en: The onslaught of orders should keep aircraft manufacturers busy for some time.

ext.ext_cn: 美国电视上让人应接不暇的广告
ext.ext_en: ...the constant onslaught of ads on American TV.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an onslaught of something, you mean that there is a large amount of it, often so that it is very difficult to deal with.

ext.ext_cn: 该计划完全取决于正在和一家新公司洽谈着的一项交易。
ext.ext_en: The plan hinges on a deal being struck with a new company...

ext.ext_cn: 很多事都取决于海外投资者对我们的看法。
ext.ext_en: A lot hinges on how we are viewed by overseas investors.

defs.def_en: Something that hinges on one thing or event depends entirely on it.

ext.ext_cn: 它们有哑铜的，古铜的和镀银的。
ext.ext_en: They are available in polished brass, antique brass or silver-plate.

ext.ext_cn: 镀银餐具
ext.ext_en: ...silver-plate cutlery.

defs.def_en: Silver plate is metal that has been coated with a thin layer of silver.

ext.ext_cn: 金银餐具、珠宝和满屋的古董家具
ext.ext_en: ...gold and silver plate, jewellery, and roomfuls of antique furniture.

defs.def_en: Silver plate is dishes, bowls, and cups that are made of silver.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正在建立配销网络。
ext.ext_en: What they're doing is setting up distributional networks.

defs.def_en: Distributional means relating to the distribution of goods.

ext.ext_cn: 导致收入不均的自由市场的分配效应
ext.ext_en: ...the distributional effects of free markets, which lead to inequalities in income.

defs.def_en: Distributional effects and policies relate to the share of a country's wealth that different groups of people have.
Training shoes are the same as trainers .
A longitudinal line or structure goes from one end of an object to the other rather than across it from side to side.

ext.ext_cn: 这些香草会激发你去品尝各种异国风味的菜肴！
ext.ext_en: These herbs will inspire you to try out all sorts of exotic-flavoured dishes!...

ext.ext_cn: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。
ext.ext_en: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause...

defs.def_en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

defs.def_cn: 启发;使产生灵感和热情

ext.ext_cn: 吉米·亨德里克斯启发了整整一代吉他演奏者。
ext.ext_en: Jimi Hendrix inspired a generation of guitarists.

defs.def_en: If someone or something inspires you, they give you new ideas and a strong feeling of enthusiasm.

defs.def_cn: 作为…的为灵感来源;是…的原型

ext.ext_cn: 那本书的灵感源于一个真实人物,即塔玛拉·德特罗。
ext.ext_en: The book was inspired by a real person, namely Tamara de Treaux.

ext.ext_cn: 正是由正在毁掉该国的民族主义冲突激发的一起政治谋杀
ext.ext_en: ...a political murder inspired by the same nationalist conflicts now wrecking the country.

defs.def_en: If a book, work of art, or action is inspired by something, that thing is the source of the idea for it.

defs.def_cn: 激起，唤起(某种感情或反应)

ext.ext_cn: 该汽车的性能会很快唤起驾驶者的信心。
ext.ext_en: The car's performance quickly inspires confidence.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that inspires a particular emotion or reaction in people makes them feel this emotion or reaction.

ext.ext_cn: 有时候我不得不代替他下厨。
ext.ext_en: I sometimes had to deputise for him in the kitchen...

ext.ext_cn: 赫尔·舒尔曼无法亲自来迎接您，所以特请我作为代表。
ext.ext_en: Herr Schulmann cannot be here to welcome you and has asked me to deputize.

defs.def_en: If you deputize for someone, you do something on their behalf, for example attend a meeting.
A Launderette is a place where people can pay to use machines to wash and dry their clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 《红胶囊》戏仿了1959年大受欢迎的电视连续剧《夸特马斯试验》。
ext.ext_en: 'The Scarlet Capsule' was a parody of the popular 1959 TV series 'The Quatermass Experiment'...

ext.ext_cn: 整个20年代，拉德纳尝试着想要写出一首走红歌曲，可是都失败了，于是最后转向戏仿他人的作品。
ext.ext_en: Throughout the Twenties, Lardner tried in vain to write a hit song, so at last he turned to parody.

defs.def_en: A parody is a humorous piece of writing, drama, or music which imitates the style of a well-known person or represents a familiar situation in an exaggerated way.

defs.def_cn: 戏仿；滑稽（或夸张）地模仿

ext.ext_cn: 夸张模仿让－马里·勒庞观点的短剧
ext.ext_en: ...a sketch parodying the views of Jean-Marie Le Pen...

ext.ext_cn: 任何风格都能被戏仿。
ext.ext_en: Any style can be parodied.

defs.def_en: When someone parodies a particular work, thing, or person, they imitate it in an amusing or exaggerated way.

ext.ext_cn: 第一次审判是对正义的愚弄。
ext.ext_en: The first trial was a parody of justice.

defs.def_en: When you say that something is a parody of a particular thing, you are criticizing it because you think it is a very poor example or bad imitation of that thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她突然变得激动狂躁，四处乱跳还大喊大叫。
ext.ext_en: She suddenly became very vehement and agitated, jumping around and shouting...

ext.ext_cn: 其中一位言辞激烈的评论家是迈克尔·霍华德。
ext.ext_en: One vehement critic is Michael Howard...

defs.def_en: If a person or their actions or comments are vehement, the person has very strong feelings or opinions and expresses them forcefully.

ext.ext_cn: 多党民主制的实行
ext.ext_en: ...the introduction of multi-party democracy.

ext.ext_cn: 几百万美元的全套装备
ext.ext_en: ...a multi-million-dollar outfit.

defs.def_en: Multi- is used to form adjectives indicating that something consists of many things of a particular kind.

defs.def_cn: 在(某个地区或国家的)东南部的;来自东南部的

ext.ext_cn: 这座位于美国东南边境的城市
ext.ext_en: ...this city on the south-eastern edge of the United States.

defs.def_en: South-eastern means in or from the south-east of a region or country.
A governess is a woman who is employed by a family to live with them and educate their children.

ext.ext_cn: 油已经硬化成柏油了。
ext.ext_en: The oil has hardened to tar...

ext.ext_cn: 他们沿着一条滚烫的柏油路开过了河，来到新罕布什尔州。
ext.ext_en: They drove across the river to New Hampshire on a hot tar road.

defs.def_en: Tar is a thick black sticky substance that is used especially for making roads.
Tar is one of the poisonous substances contained in tobacco.

defs.def_cn: 被当作一丘之貉;被当成一路货色

ext.ext_cn: 我是足球迷，经常要解释我不是那种足球流氓，因为一旦出事，我们就会被当成是一路货色。
ext.ext_en: I am a football supporter and I have to often explain that I'm not one of the hooligan sort because we'll all get tarred with the same brush when there's trouble.

defs.def_en: If some people in a group behave badly and if people then wrongly think that all of the group is equally bad, you can say that the whole group is tarred with the same brush .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 该国处在一个专制暴君的统治之下。
ext.ext_en: The country was ruled by a despotic tyrant.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is despotic, you are emphasizing that they use their power over other people in a very unfair or cruel way.

defs.def_cn: （招贴画上的）性感帅哥（或美女）

ext.ext_cn: 招贴画上的潇洒男孩
ext.ext_en: ...pin-up boys...

ext.ext_cn: 步入影坛时，她已是名模和海报女郎了。
ext.ext_en: She was already a famous model and pin-up by the time she made her film debut.

defs.def_en: A pin-up is an attractive man or woman who appears on posters, often wearing very few clothes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 灾难性的；引起巨大变化的

ext.ext_cn: 摧毁他对人性的信念的灾难性事件
ext.ext_en: ...the cataclysmic events that were destroying his faith in humanity...

ext.ext_cn: 没有几个人料到那个变化会如此翻天覆地。
ext.ext_en: Few had expected that change to be as cataclysmic as it turned out to be.

defs.def_en: A cataclysmic event is one that changes a situation or society very greatly, especially in an unpleasant way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我知道弗兰克见到你会很高兴的。
ext.ext_en: I know Frank will be delighted to see you...

ext.ext_cn: 他说公众的反应让他欣喜。
ext.ext_en: He said that he was delighted with the public response.

defs.def_en: If you are delighted, you are extremely pleased and excited about something.

ext.ext_cn: “你一定要来参加廷斯利的毕业聚会。”——“我很乐意。”
ext.ext_en: 'You must come to Tinsley's graduation party.' — 'I'd be delighted.'

defs.def_en: If someone invites or asks you to do something, you can say that you would be delighted to do it, as a way of showing that you are very willing to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 要学习和静修20到25年才有资格成为喇嘛。
ext.ext_en: It takes twenty to twenty-five years of study and meditation to qualify as a lama.

defs.def_en: A lama is a Buddhist priest or monk.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有权力的；有势力的；有影响力的

ext.ext_cn: 你是有影响力的人，大家会听你的。
ext.ext_en: You're a powerful man — people will listen to you.

ext.ext_cn: 两大强国，俄罗斯和印度
ext.ext_en: ...Russia and India, two large, powerful countries.

defs.def_en: See also:all-powerful;A powerful person or organization is able to control or influence people and events.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 汉斯活动了一下他那强健的肌肉。
ext.ext_en: Hans flexed his powerful muscles...

ext.ext_en: It's such a big powerful dog.

defs.def_en: You say that someone's body is powerful when it is physically strong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （机器）大功率的；强效的；高效能的

ext.ext_cn: 汽车的功率越大，就越难驾驭。
ext.ext_en: The more powerful the car the more difficult it is to handle.

ext.ext_cn: 功能强大的计算机系统
ext.ext_en: ...powerful computer systems...

defs.def_en: A powerful machine or substance is effective because it is very strong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: There was a powerful smell of stale beer.

ext.ext_cn: 散发浓香的淡黄色小花
ext.ext_en: ...tiny creamy flowers with a powerful scent.

defs.def_en: A powerful smell is very strong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 就在那一刻，琼斯夫人响亮的声音打断了他们，说有人来访。
ext.ext_en: At that moment Mrs. Jones's powerful voice interrupted them, announcing a visitor.

defs.def_en: A powerful voice is loud and can be heard from a long way away.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （文章、演讲或艺术品）极具感染力的，有震撼力的

ext.ext_cn: 布利兹戴尔创作的关于一个腐败市领导的极具感染力的电视剧，共有11集
ext.ext_en: ...Bleasdale's powerful 11-part drama about a corrupt city leader.

ext.ext_cn: 威尔第创作的《奥泰罗》，世界最具感染力、最动人的歌剧之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the world's most powerful and moving operas, Verdi's 'Otello'.

defs.def_en: You describe a piece of writing, speech, or work of art as powerful when it has a strong effect on people's feelings or beliefs.

ext.ext_cn: 她不再说话，竖起耳朵听着。
ext.ext_en: She stopped talking to prick up her ears.

ext.ext_cn: 一提到皇室就竖起耳朵的人
ext.ext_en: ...ears which prick up at the mention of royalty.

defs.def_en: If someone pricks up their ears or if their ears prick up, they listen eagerly when they suddenly hear an interesting sound or an important piece of information.

defs.def_cn: （选举中的）操纵选票，投票舞弊

ext.ext_cn: 选举舞弊的指控出现后，这次投票测验受到了广泛质疑。
ext.ext_en: The poll was widely discredited after allegations of ballot rigging.

defs.def_en: Ballot rigging is the act of illegally changing the result of an election by producing a false record of the number of votes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 诡计多端的;不择手段的

ext.ext_cn: 阴险狡诈的决策方式
ext.ext_en: ...the Machiavellian and devious way decisions were made...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as Machiavellian, you are critical of them because they often make clever and secret plans to achieve their aims and are not honest with people.

defs.def_cn: (法律文件等的)分款，分项，分部，分段
defs.def_en: A subsection of a text or a document such as a law is one of the smaller parts into which its main parts are divided.
Amino acids are substances containing nitrogen and hydrogen and which are found in proteins. Amino acids occur naturally in the body.

ext.ext_cn: 终于通知我们登乘了。
ext.ext_en: The word was finally given for us to get on board...

ext.ext_cn: 食品总算在上周末运到并开始分发。
ext.ext_en: The food finally arrived at the end of last week and distribution began...

defs.def_en: You use finally to suggest that something happens after a long period of time, usually later than you wanted or expected it to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 剧情从喜剧逐渐发展为情节剧，最后又演变为悲剧。
ext.ext_en: The action slips from comedy to melodrama and finally to tragedy.

defs.def_en: You use finally to indicate that something is last in a series of actions or events.

defs.def_cn: (用于引出观点等)最后，最后要说的是

ext.ext_en: Finally, who needs the theatre?...

ext.ext_cn: 最后，来谈一谈冠亚军。
ext.ext_en: And finally, a word about the winner and runner-up.

defs.def_en: You use finally in speech or writing to introduce a final point, question, or topic.

ext.ext_cn: 她身上有严重的淤伤，嘴唇也破了。
ext.ext_en: She had quite severe bruising and a cut lip.

defs.def_en: If someone has bruising on their body, they have bruises on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 政府希望避免因民权问题再次发生激烈冲突。
ext.ext_en: The administration hopes to avoid another bruising battle over civil rights.

defs.def_en: In a bruising battle or encounter, people fight or compete with each other in a very aggressive or determined way.

defs.def_cn: 剃光头的年轻人;(通常指有暴力行为和攻击性的)光头仔
defs.def_en: A skinhead is a young person whose hair is shaved or cut very short. Skinheads are usually regarded as violent and aggressive.
When there is a to-do, people are very excited, confused, or angry about something.

defs.def_cn: (通常指某家公司发送的)赠品，免费物品
defs.def_en: A freebie is something that you are given, usually by a company, without having to pay for it.

ext.ext_cn: 无论是下水道里，还是地板下面，都有许多耗子绕着它们蹿来蹿去。
ext.ext_en: The rats skittered around them in the drains and under the floorboards...

ext.ext_cn: 人行道上飞舞着一张张纸片。
ext.ext_en: Pieces of paper were skittering along the sidewalk.

defs.def_en: If something skitters, it moves about very lightly and quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 水果和蔬菜
ext.ext_en: ...fruit and veg.

ext.ext_en: ...youngsters who prefer burgers to meat and two veg.

defs.def_en: Veg are plants such as cabbages, potatoes, and onions which you can cook and eat. Veg is an abbreviation for (缩略=)  'vegetables'.

ext.ext_cn: 道格拉斯·巴德——昔日战场上的无腿战斗机飞行员
ext.ext_en: ...Douglas Bader, the legless wartime fighter pilot...

ext.ext_cn: 蛇蜥其实不是蛇，而是无脚的蜥蜴。
ext.ext_en: The slow-worm is in fact not a snake but a legless lizard.

defs.def_en: A legless person or animal has no legs.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们发现当地人喝龙舌兰喝得酩酊大醉。
ext.ext_en: They found the locals getting legless on tequila.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is legless, you mean that they are extremely drunk.

defs.def_cn: (通常因违法而)偷偷摸摸的，暗地里的，秘密的

ext.ext_cn: 他们的秘密会晤
ext.ext_en: ...their clandestine meetings.

defs.def_en: Something that is clandestine is hidden or kept secret, often because it is illegal.

ext.ext_cn: 卡车撞到了电线杆上。
ext.ext_en: The truck crashed into a telegraph pole...

ext.ext_cn: 他用带钩的杆子把金属护窗拉了下来。
ext.ext_en: He reached up with a hooked pole to roll down the metal shutter.

defs.def_en: A pole is a long thin piece of wood or metal, used especially for supporting things.

ext.ext_cn: 在南北极，每年有6个月时间几乎没有光照。
ext.ext_en: For six months of the year, there is hardly any light at the poles.

defs.def_en: See also:North Pole;South Pole;The earth's poles are the two opposite ends of its axis, its most northern and southern points.

defs.def_cn: （特质、意见或信仰）截然相反的两极之一；极端

ext.ext_cn: 这两位从政者代表了政界的两个极端。
ext.ext_en: The two politicians represent opposite poles of the political spectrum.

defs.def_en: The two poles of a range of qualities, opinions, or beliefs are the completely opposite qualities, opinions, or beliefs at either end of the range.

defs.def_cn: （信仰、意见或性质）截然相反，南辕北辙
defs.def_en: If you say that two people or  things are poles apart, you mean that they have completely different beliefs, opinions, or qualities.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 独裁的;专制的;独断专行的

ext.ext_cn: 最近几周国王的专制行径让民众忍无可忍。
ext.ext_en: The people have grown intolerant in recent weeks of the King's autocratic ways.

defs.def_en: An autocratic person or organization has complete power and makes decisions without asking anyone else's advice.

ext.ext_cn: 为了给电影制造噱头以吸引眼球，他把汽车猛地撞向一辆驶过的卡车。
ext.ext_en: In a bold promotional stunt for the movie, he smashed his car into a passing truck.

defs.def_en: A stunt is something interesting that is done in order to attract attention and get publicity for the person or company responsible for it.

ext.ext_cn: 肖恩·康纳利在他的新片中为求真实，坚持自己出演特技部分。
ext.ext_en: Sean Connery insisted on living dangerously for his new film by performing his own stunts.

defs.def_en: A stunt is a dangerous and exciting piece of action in a film.

defs.def_cn: 阻碍(生长);妨碍(发展);遏制

ext.ext_en: The heart condition had stunted his growth a bit...

ext.ext_cn: 高利率已经阻碍了经济的增长。
ext.ext_en: High interest rates have stunted economic growth.

defs.def_en: If something stunts the growth or development of a person or thing, it prevents it from growing or developing as much as it should.

ext.ext_cn: 他们靠作秀出名的日子早已过去。
ext.ext_en: The days when they needed to pull publicity stunts to get noticed are long gone.

defs.def_en: If someone pulls a stunt, they do something silly or risky.

ext.ext_cn: 警方出动大量警力防止暴力事件再次发生。
ext.ext_en: Police are out in force to prevent a recurrence of the violence.

defs.def_en: If there is a recurrence of something, it happens again.

ext.ext_en: I find it hard to blow-dry my hair...

ext.ext_cn: 他有一头精心吹出发型的金发。
ext.ext_en: He has blow-dried blonde hair.

defs.def_en: If you blow-dry your hair, you dry it with a hairdryer, often to give it a particular style.

ext.ext_en: Moderates are plagiarizing his ideas in hopes of wooing voters...

ext.ext_en: The poem employs as its first lines a verse plagiarized from a billboard.

defs.def_en: If someone plagiarizes another person's idea or work, they use it or copy it and pretend that they thought of it or created it.

defs.def_cn: 使权力中央化;对…集权控制

ext.ext_en: In the mass production era multinational firms tended to centralize their operations...

ext.ext_en: The economy of the times made it difficult to support centralized rule.

defs.def_en: To centralize a country, state, or organization means to create a system in which one central group of people gives instructions to regional groups.

ext.ext_cn: 需要在尘世生活中直面邪恶
ext.ext_en: ...the need to confront evil during the earthly life...

ext.ext_cn: 他们生活在人间天堂。
ext.ext_en: They lived in an earthly paradise.

defs.def_en: Earthly means happening in the material world of our life on earth and not in any spiritual life or life after death.

defs.def_cn: （用于no earthly reason等短语中表示强调）根本，绝对

ext.ext_cn: 他们完全没有必要作出改变。
ext.ext_en: There is no earthly reason why they should ever change...

ext.ext_cn: 他们到底为什么要撒谎呢？
ext.ext_en: What earthly reason would they have for lying?...

defs.def_en: Earthly is used for emphasis in phrases such as no earthly reason. If you say that there is no earthly reason why something should happen, you are emphasizing that there is no reason at all why it should happen.
Tassels are bunches of short pieces of wool or other material tied together at one end and attached as decorations to something such as a piece of clothing or a lampshade.

ext.ext_en: Unable to resist the impulse, he glanced at the sea again...

ext.ext_cn: 他仍然难以理解是什么样的冲动使他向卡桑德拉吐露了秘密。
ext.ext_en: He still couldn't understand the impulse that had made him confide in Cassandra...

defs.def_en: An impulse is a sudden desire to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 窗帘是一时兴起买下的。
ext.ext_en: The curtains were an impulse buy.

defs.def_en: An impulse buy or impulse purchase is something that you decide to buy when you see it, although you had not planned to buy it.

ext.ext_en: After lunch she decided on impulse to take a bath.

defs.def_en: If you do something on impulse, you suddenly decide to do it, without planning it.

ext.ext_cn: 一条面包
ext.ext_en: ...a loaf of bread...

ext.ext_cn: 抹黄油的面包
ext.ext_en: ...bread and butter...

defs.def_en: Bread is a very common food made from flour, water, and yeast.

ext.ext_en: There's not a living soul in Colorado who doesn't depend for his bread on silver.

defs.def_en: If you earn your bread doing a particular job or activity, you earn your money doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 重新粉刷一下是使房子焕然一新的最快方法。

defs.def_en: A facelift is an operation in which a surgeon tightens the skin on someone's face in order to make them look younger.

ext.ext_cn: 英国退伍军人协会筹集款项帮助退役人员和他们的家属。
ext.ext_en: The British Legion raises funds to help ex-service personnel and their dependants.

defs.def_en: Your dependants are the people you support financially, such as your children.

ext.ext_cn: 然后我用耙子的背将土壤拍实。
ext.ext_en: Then I tamp down the soil with the back of a rake...

ext.ext_en: Philpott tamped a wad of tobacco into his pipe.

defs.def_en: If you tamp something, you press it down by tapping it several times so that it becomes flatter and more solid.

ext.ext_cn: 棕熊是杂食性动物，抓到什么吃什么。
ext.ext_en: Brown bears are omnivorous, eating anything that they can get their paws on.

defs.def_en: An omnivorous person or animal eats all kinds of food, including both meat and plants.
