ext.ext_en: As a child, Coleridge developed omnivorous reading habits.

defs.def_en: Omnivorous means liking a wide variety of things of a particular type.

ext.ext_cn: 他努力地保持身体健康。
ext.ext_en: He strives hard to keep himself very fit...

ext.ext_en: She strove to read the name on the stone pillar...

defs.def_en: If you strive to do something or strive for something, you make a great effort to do it or get it.

ext.ext_en: England scored again, but the whistle had gone and the goal was disallowed...

ext.ext_en: The Internal Revenue Service sought to disallow the payments...

defs.def_en: If something is disallowed, it is not allowed or accepted officially, because it has not been done correctly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: There's always a wide selection of delicious meals to choose from...

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: There is a delicious irony in all this.

ext.ext_en: ..that delicious feeling of surprise.

ext.ext_en: In the mid-nineteenth century, Dorothea Dix began to campaign for humane treatment of the mentally ill.

defs.def_en: If something radicalizes a process, situation, or person, it makes them more radical.

ext.ext_cn: 大厅里弥漫着她母亲身上的香水味。
ext.ext_en: The hall smelled of her mother's perfume.

ext.ext_cn: 一瓶香水
ext.ext_en: ...a bottle of perfume.

defs.def_en: Perfume is a pleasant-smelling liquid which women put on their skin to make themselves smell nice.

ext.ext_cn: 不含香料、味道淡雅的白色肥皂
ext.ext_en: ...a delicate white soap without perfume.

ext.ext_cn: 润肤霜中使用的香料
ext.ext_en: ...a perfume for skin creams.

defs.def_en: Perfume is the ingredient that is added to some products to make them smell nice.

ext.ext_cn: 玫瑰花的芳香
ext.ext_en: ...the perfume of roses...

ext.ext_en: ...shower gel perfumed with the popular Paris fragrance.

defs.def_en: If you shake your head, you turn it from side to side in order to say 'no' or to show disbelief or sadness.

defs.def_cn: (因为寒冷或害怕而)发抖，颤抖，战栗，哆嗦

ext.ext_en: He roared with laughter, shaking in his chair...

ext.ext_en: My hand shook so much that I could hardly hold the microphone...

defs.def_en: If you are shaking, or a part of your body is shaking, you are making quick, small movements that you cannot control, for example because you are cold or afraid.

defs.def_cn: (因害怕、生病或喝醉酒而产生的)颤抖，战栗，哆嗦

ext.ext_en: Another man constantly chain-smoked and seemed to have the shakes.

ext.ext_en: The protesters burst through police lines into the cathedral square, shaking clenched fists.

defs.def_en: If you shake your fist or an object such as a stick at someone, you wave it in the air in front of them because you are angry with them.

ext.ext_cn: 使几公里以外的建筑物都感觉到震动的爆炸
ext.ext_en: ...an explosion that shook buildings several kilometers away...

ext.ext_cn: 打嗝可能会让宝宝从头到脚地颤。
ext.ext_en: The hiccups may shake your baby's body from head to foot...

defs.def_en: If a force shakes something, or if something shakes, it moves from side to side or up and down with quick, small, but sometimes violent movements.

ext.ext_cn: 收集小昆虫时可以把它们装进广口瓶里。
ext.ext_en: Small insects can be collected by shaking them into a jar...

ext.ext_cn: 她解开橡皮筋，将浓密的头发披散在肩头。
ext.ext_en: She frees her mass of hair from a rubber band and shakes it off her shoulders...

defs.def_en: To shake something into a certain place or state means to bring it into that place or state by moving it quickly up and down or from side to side.

ext.ext_cn: 他气得声音发抖，质问委员会这样一份报告怎么能向公众隐瞒。
ext.ext_en: His voice shaking with rage, he asked how the committee could keep such a report from the public.

defs.def_en: If your voice is shaking, you cannot control it properly and it sounds very unsteady, for example because you are nervous or angry.

ext.ext_cn: 坦迪逃跑的消息让他们所有人都无比震惊。
ext.ext_en: The news of Tandy's escape had shaken them all...

ext.ext_cn: 她和父母的关系都很亲近，因此毫无疑问，他们的离婚对她打击很大。
ext.ext_en: She was close to both of her parents and was undeniably shaken by their divorce...

defs.def_en: If an event or a piece of news shakes you, or shakes your confidence, it makes you feel upset and unable to think calmly.

ext.ext_en: It won't shake the football world if we beat Torquay...

ext.ext_cn: 当一些事情的发生动摇这些信念时，恐惧就会占据我们的心灵。
ext.ext_en: When events happen that shake these beliefs, our fear takes control...

defs.def_en: If an event shakes a group of people or their beliefs, it causes great uncertainty and makes them question their beliefs.

defs.def_cn: 使摒弃，使改变(态度、信念)

ext.ext_en: No amount of reasoning could shake him out of his conviction...

ext.ext_en: Many businessmen still find it hard to shake themselves out of the old state-dependent habit.

defs.def_en: If you shake someone out of an attitude or belief that you disapprove of, you cause them to change their attitude or belief to one that is more responsible or sensible.

ext.ext_cn: 他让司机去给他买一杯草莓奶昔。
ext.ext_en: He sent his driver to fetch him a strawberry shake.

defs.def_en: A shake is the same as a milkshake .

ext.ext_cn: 很多人认为他们在法庭上不会受到公平的审判。
ext.ext_en: A lot of people think that they're not going to get a fair shake from the courts.

defs.def_en: If you do not get a fair shake, you are not given a reasonable opportunity to succeed or to achieve something.

defs.def_cn: 技术不高的;不出色的;无效的

ext.ext_en: I'm no great shakes as a detective...

ext.ext_en: The protests have failed partly because the opposition politicians are  no great shakes.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is no great shakes, you mean that they are not very skilful or effective.

defs.def_en: If you shake someone's hand or shake someone by the hand, you shake hands with them.

defs.def_en: If you shake hands with someone, you take their right hand in your own for a few moments, often moving it up and down slightly, when you are saying hello or goodbye to them, congratulating them, or agreeing on something. You can also say that two people shake hands .

defs.def_en: A conservative estimate or guess is one in which you are cautious and estimate or guess a low amount which is probably less that the real amount.

ext.ext_cn: 住在附近的人很可能有谁见过他。
ext.ext_en: He might easily have been seen by someone who lived nearby...

ext.ext_cn: 他轻声和站在旁边的一对夫妇说话。
ext.ext_en: He spoke softly to a couple standing nearby...

defs.def_en: If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away.

defs.def_cn: 转基因的（常使用缩略形式GM)

ext.ext_cn: 大品牌超市即将下架许多转基因食品。
ext.ext_en: Top supermarkets are to ban many genetically modified foods.

defs.def_en: Genetically modified plants and animals have had one or more genes changed, for example so that they resist pests and diseases better. Genetically modified food contains ingredients made from genetically modified plants or animals. The abbreviation GM is often used.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （风格、戏剧、文章等）精辟有力的，犀利的，客观理智的

ext.ext_cn: 他的那种澎湃激昂、铿锵有力的原声爵士乐风格
ext.ext_en: ...his fiery, hard-edged acoustic jazz style.

ext.ext_cn: 针砭时弊的戏剧
ext.ext_en: ...hard-edged drama.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a style, play, or article as hard-edged, you mean you admire it because it is powerful, critical, or unsentimental.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 芝士饼干
ext.ext_en: ...cheesy biscuits...

ext.ext_cn: 酱汁太稀，奶酪味不足。
ext.ext_en: The sauce was too runny and not cheesy enough.

defs.def_en: Cheesy food is food that tastes or smells of cheese.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 巴格达的廉价旅馆
ext.ext_en: ...a cheesy Baghdad hotel...

ext.ext_cn: 国王路越来越俗气了。
ext.ext_en: The King's Road was getting increasingly cheesy...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as cheesy, you mean that it is cheap, unpleasant, or insincere.

ext.ext_cn: 一小片没割的草
ext.ext_en: ...a patch of uncut grass...

ext.ext_cn: 树没有修剪，路也没有铺。
ext.ext_en: Trees were to be left uncut, roads unpaved.

defs.def_en: Something that is uncut has not been cut.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在欧洲的时候看过未删节版《罗马帝国艳情史》。
ext.ext_en: We saw the uncut version of 'Caligula' when we were in Europe.

defs.def_en: An uncut book, play, or film has not had parts removed.

defs.def_cn: （钻石等宝石）未雕琢的，未加工的
defs.def_en: Uncut diamonds and other precious stones have not been cut into a regular shape.

ext.ext_cn: 她是个神童，十来岁不到就举办音乐会了。
ext.ext_en: She was a child prodigy, giving concerts before she was a teenager.

defs.def_en: A child prodigy is a child with a very great talent.
Tautology is the use of different words to say the same thing twice in the same statement. 'The money should be adequate enough' is an example of tautology.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她醒来时已是晚上，天已经黑了。
ext.ext_en: When she awoke it was evening and already dark...

ext.ext_cn: 里面太暗，看不太清。
ext.ext_en: It was too dark inside to see much...

defs.def_en: When it is dark, there is not enough light to see properly, for example because it is night.

ext.ext_cn: 她母亲坐在炉边暗处的摇椅里。
ext.ext_en: Her mother was sitting in the dark by the stove in her rocking chair...

ext.ext_cn: 我一直很怕黑。
ext.ext_en: I've always been afraid of the dark.

defs.def_en: The dark is the lack of light in a place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他身穿暗色西服，手提黑色公文包。
ext.ext_en: He wore a dark suit and carried a black attaché case...

ext.ext_cn: 笨重的深色桌子上嵌有颜色较浅的木头。
ext.ext_en: The heavy dark table is inlaid with lighter wood.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as dark, you mean that it is black in colour, or a shade that is close to black.

ext.ext_cn: 她穿着一件深蓝色的礼服。
ext.ext_en: She was wearing a dark blue dress.

defs.def_en: When you use dark to describe a colour, you are referring to a shade of that colour which is close to black, or seems to have some black in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (头发、眼睛或肤色)棕色的，黑色的

ext.ext_cn: 他有一头卷曲的黑发。
ext.ext_en: He had dark, curly hair...

ext.ext_cn: 利奥接着说下去，他的黑眼睛瞪得大大的，充满怜悯和关切。
ext.ext_en: Leo went on, his dark eyes wide with pity and concern.

defs.def_en: If someone has dark hair, eyes, or skin, they have brown or black hair, eyes, or skin.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (白人）有着棕色（或黑色）头发（且皮肤略带棕色）的，肤色深的

ext.ext_cn: 卡萝尔身材高大，黑发棕肤，是个有着拉丁风情的女子。
ext.ext_en: Carol is a tall, dark, Latin type of woman...

ext.ext_cn: 司机一头乌发、肤色黝黑，可能是个马耳他人。
ext.ext_en: The driver was very dark. Maltese, maybe.

defs.def_en: If you describe a white person as dark, you mean that they have brown or black hair, and often a brownish skin.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 又有传言说以后的日子会非常艰难。
ext.ext_en: Once again there's talk of very dark days ahead...

ext.ext_cn: 这是那次战争中最黑暗的时期。
ext.ext_en: This was the darkest period of the war.

defs.def_en: A dark period of time is unpleasant or frightening.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这艘宇宙飞船可能会让人们对太阳系中的一个神秘角落有更新的认识。
ext.ext_en: The spacecraft is set to throw new light on to a dark corner of the solar system.

ext.ext_cn: 隐秘的思想深处
ext.ext_en: ...the dark recesses of the mind.

defs.def_en: A dark place or area is mysterious and not fully known about.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 特洛伊的喋喋不休让我暂时收起了阴郁思绪。
ext.ext_en: Troy's chatter kept me from thinking dark thoughts.

defs.def_en: Dark thoughts are sad, and show that you are expecting something unpleasant to happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (眼神或话语）阴险的，邪恶的，不祥的

ext.ext_cn: 加林恶狠狠地瞪了他一眼，似乎是在警告。
ext.ext_en: Garin shot him a dark glance, as if in warning.

ext.ext_cn: 恶毒的威胁
ext.ext_en: ...dark threats.

defs.def_en: Dark looks or remarks make you think that the person giving them wants to harm you or that something horrible is going to happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （指与严肃或令人不快的事物相关的)黑色的

ext.ext_cn: 他们的黑色幽默总能让他咋舌。
ext.ext_en: Their dark humor never failed to astound him...

ext.ext_cn: 对成了父亲和哥哥紧张关系的焦点，尼娜有点幸灾乐祸。
ext.ext_en: Nina took a kind of dark pleasure in being the focus of the tension between her father and her brother.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as dark, you mean that it is related to things that are serious or unpleasant, rather than light-hearted.

ext.ext_cn: 他们避免在天黑以后独自外出。
ext.ext_en: They avoid going out alone after dark.

defs.def_en: If you do something after dark, you do it when the sun has set and night has begun.

ext.ext_cn: 他们会在天黑前早早返回。
ext.ext_en: They'll be back well before dark.

defs.def_en: If you do something before dark, you do it before the sun sets and night begins.

ext.ext_cn: 调查人员承认他们对这起谋杀一无所知。
ext.ext_en: The investigators admit that they are completely in the dark about the killing...

ext.ext_cn: 我设法对父母瞒下了此事。
ext.ext_en: I managed to keep my parents in the dark about this...

defs.def_en: If you are in the dark about something, you do not know anything about it.

ext.ext_cn: 所有那些凭直觉的猜测都是无根据的瞎猜。
ext.ext_en: Every single one of those inspired guesses had been shots in the dark.

defs.def_en: If you describe something someone says or does as a shot in the dark or a stab in the dark, you mean they are guessing that what they say is correct or that what they do will be successful.
A trattoria is an Italian restaurant.

defs.def_cn: 微量，少许，一丝，几分(颜色、感情或性质)

ext.ext_cn: 他的皮肤有种不健康的淡灰色。
ext.ext_en: His skin had an unhealthy greyish tinge...

ext.ext_cn: 伊娃的声音里可能会有一丝羡慕吗？
ext.ext_en: Could there have been a slight tinge of envy in Eva's voice?

defs.def_en: A tinge of a colour, feeling, or quality is a small amount of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们并不铺张浪费：下馆子是一种奢侈，也不会考虑买名牌衣服。
ext.ext_en: We are not extravagant; restaurant meals are a luxury and designer clothes are out...

ext.ext_cn: 我几乎一整天都开着电热炉，希望你不会觉得我很浪费。
ext.ext_en: I hope you don't think I'm extravagant but I've had the electric fire on for most of the day.

defs.def_en: Someone who is extravagant spends more money than they can afford or uses more of something than is reasonable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 价格过高的;昂贵的;奢侈的

ext.ext_cn: 萨莉姨妈送给她一件贵得离谱的礼物。
ext.ext_en: Her Aunt Sallie gave her an uncharacteristically extravagant gift...

ext.ext_cn: 烤点心时加一整块奶酪似乎太奢侈了。
ext.ext_en: Baking a whole cheese in pastry may seem extravagant.

defs.def_en: Something that is extravagant costs more money than you can afford or uses more of something than is reasonable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他极度向往希腊。
ext.ext_en: He was extravagant in his admiration of Hellas...

ext.ext_cn: 他们可能会表现得过于慷慨。
ext.ext_en: They may make extravagant shows of generosity.

defs.def_en: Extravagant behaviour is extreme behaviour that is often done for a particular effect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们不得不通过更加离谱地吹捧自己的产品来进行竞争。
ext.ext_en: They have to compete by adorning their products with ever more extravagant claims...

ext.ext_cn: 要勇于考虑一些貌似离谱的想法。
ext.ext_en: Don't be afraid to consider apparently extravagant ideas.

defs.def_en: Extravagant claims or ideas are unrealistic or impractical.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦最狂野、最美妙的聚会
ext.ext_en: ...the wildest and most extravagant London parties.

ext.ext_cn: 在木框架上绘制一些精美而又大胆的图案
ext.ext_en: ...painting extravagant and bold designs onto wooden frames.

defs.def_en: Extravagant entertainments or designs are elaborate and impressive.

ext.ext_cn: 我们三人全都匆忙跑进厨房。
ext.ext_en: All three of us rushed pell-mell into the kitchen.

defs.def_en: If you move pell-mell somewhere, you move there in a hurried, uncontrolled way.

defs.def_cn: （某一活动领域的）最前沿，最令人兴奋的发展阶段

ext.ext_cn: 麦克纳利已经在计算技术的最前沿工作了17年。
ext.ext_en: McNally has spent 17 years at the bleeding edge of computing.

defs.def_en: If you are at the bleeding edge of a particular field of activity, you are involved in its most advanced or most exciting developments.

ext.ext_cn: 配备了最先进的电子和通信系统的英国皇家空军设施
ext.ext_en: ...an RAF facility with bleeding-edge electronics and communications systems.

defs.def_en: Bleeding-edge equipment or technology is the most advanced that there is in a particular field.

defs.def_cn: (英国某郡或某个地区的)警察局局长

ext.ext_cn: 大曼彻斯特地区警察局局长
ext.ext_en: ...the Chief Constable of Greater Manchester.

defs.def_en: A Chief Constable is the officer who is in charge of the police force in a particular county or area in Britain.
A brooch is a small piece of jewellery which has a pin at the back so it can be fastened on a dress, blouse, or coat.

ext.ext_cn: 将行星的运行比作两列火车朝同一方向行驶可能更容易些。
ext.ext_en: It is probably easier to make an analogy between the courses of the planets, and two trains travelling in the same direction.

defs.def_en: If you make or draw an analogy between two things, you show that they are similar in some way.
The Roman alphabet is the alphabet that was used by the Romans in ancient times and that is used for writing most western European languages, including English.

ext.ext_cn: 苹果油炸馅饼
ext.ext_en: ...apple fritters.

defs.def_en: Fritters are round pieces of fruit, vegetables, or meat that are dipped in batter and fried.

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司不久就开始挥霍赚来的钱。
ext.ext_en: The firm soon started frittering away the cash it was generating...

ext.ext_cn: 我似乎把时间全都浪费在咖啡早茶会上了。
ext.ext_en: I seem to fritter my time away at coffee mornings.

defs.def_en: If someone fritters away time or money, they waste it on unimportant or unnecessary things.

ext.ext_cn: 为了她方便，他很乐意绕道。
ext.ext_en: He was happy to make a detour for her convenience.

ext.ext_cn: 需要把公民的权利置于当选官员的便利之上
ext.ext_en: ...the need to put the rights of citizens above the convenience of elected officials.

defs.def_en: If something is done for your convenience, it is done in a way that is useful or suitable for you.

ext.ext_cn: 邮购对于那些没有时间逛商店的购物者来说是一项非常方便的服务。
ext.ext_en: Mail order is a convenience for buyers who are too busy to shop.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a convenience, you mean that it is very useful.

ext.ext_cn: 一些特雷沃车型配有动力转向系统以及中央锁和电动窗之类的便利装置。
ext.ext_en: Some TVRs have power steering and conveniences such as central locking and powered windows.

ext.ext_cn: 现代化便利设施一应俱全的公寓
ext.ext_en: ...an apartment with all the modern conveniences.

defs.def_en: Conveniences are pieces of equipment designed to make your life easier.

ext.ext_cn: 公共厕所的小隔间
ext.ext_en: ...the cubicles of a public convenience.

defs.def_en: A public convenience is a building containing toilets which is provided in a public place for anyone to use.
A sugar bowl is a small bowl in which sugar is kept.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经长大成人，到了可以和姑娘上床、让人家怀上孩子的时候了。
ext.ext_en: He was old enough to sleep with a girl and make her pregnant.

defs.def_en: If you sleep with someone, you have sex with them.
A supermodel is a very famous fashion model.
Tasting is used in expressions such as wine tasting to refer to a social event at which people try different kinds of the specified drink or food in small amounts.
If someone tells someone else to sod off, they are telling them in a very rude way to go away or leave them alone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他工作努力，精力充沛。
ext.ext_en: He was hardworking and energetic.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as hard-working, you mean that they work very hard.
Woodland is land with a lot of trees.
A bloodsucker is any creature that sucks blood from a wound that it has made in an animal or person.

ext.ext_cn: 最后他终于摆脱了那些吸金者的经济剥削。
ext.ext_en: At last he was free from the financial bloodsuckers.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a bloodsucker, you disapprove of them because you think they do not do anything worthwhile but live off the efforts of other people.

ext.ext_cn: 他的寻呼机响了，于是他拿起了电话。
ext.ext_en: His beeper sounded and he picked up the telephone.

defs.def_en: A beeper is a portable device that makes a beeping noise, usually to tell you to phone someone or to remind you to do something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 讲求实效的；实用的；务实的

ext.ext_cn: 罗宾实际地考虑了一下她的处境。
ext.ext_en: Robin took a pragmatic look at her situation.

ext.ext_cn: 针对拉美面临问题的切实的解决办法
ext.ext_en: ...a pragmatic approach to the problems faced by Latin America.

defs.def_en: A pragmatic way of dealing with something is based on practical considerations, rather than theoretical ones. A pragmatic person deals with things in a practical way.
Heavy cream is very thick cream.
An egg cup is a small container in which you put a boiled egg while you eat it.

defs.def_cn: (舞蹈)步法;(体育运动的)脚功，脚法

ext.ext_cn: 这项锻炼可以提高协调能力、平衡力、把握时机的能力和脚法。
ext.ext_en: This exercise improves your coordination, balance, timing and footwork.

defs.def_en: Footwork is the way in which you move your feet, especially in sports such as boxing, football, or tennis, or in dancing.

defs.def_cn: (应对困境的)策略，应变能力，手腕

ext.ext_cn: 最后，他高明的法律手腕使他如愿以偿。
ext.ext_en: In the end, his brilliant legal footwork paid off.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's footwork in a difficult situation, you mean the clever way they deal with it.

defs.def_cn: （爱尔兰民间传说中通过哀嚎警告家中将有人死亡的）报丧女妖
defs.def_en: In Irish folk stories, a banshee is a female spirit who warns you by her long, sad cry that someone in your family is going to die.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是个性情温和的孩子，很少哭闹。
ext.ext_en: She was a placid child who rarely cried...

ext.ext_cn: 马库斯面对她的发作保持平静。
ext.ext_en: Marcus remained placid in the face of her outburst.

defs.def_en: A placid person or animal is calm and does not easily become excited, angry, or upset.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 伊利湖宁静的湖水
ext.ext_en: ...the placid waters of Lake Erie...

ext.ext_cn: 他8年来一直过着平静的生活。
ext.ext_en: He had been leading a placid life for the past eight years.

defs.def_en: A placid place, area of water, or life is calm and peaceful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人厌恶的；恐怖的；令人震惊的

ext.ext_cn: 在首都发生了一连串让人毛骨悚然的谋杀案。
ext.ext_en: There has been a series of gruesome murders in the capital.

defs.def_en: Something that is gruesome is extremely unpleasant and shocking.

defs.def_cn: 取代，替代(陈旧或令人不满意的事物)

ext.ext_cn: 手工工具是历史的遗物，现在已经被机器所取代。
ext.ext_en: Hand tools are relics of the past that have now been superseded by the machine.

defs.def_en: If something is superseded by something newer, it is replaced because it has become old-fashioned or unacceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 没过多久，我就意识到自己有多么失态。
ext.ext_en: It was not long before I realised the enormity of my faux pas.

defs.def_en: A faux pas is a socially embarrassing action or mistake.

defs.def_cn: 逐一核对;逐一检查;清点

ext.ext_cn: 清点完所定购的每一件东西后，将这份记录存档。
ext.ext_en: Once you've checked off the items you ordered, put this record in your file...

ext.ext_cn: 我没有逐一核对过，不过，我可以说差不多是这个数。
ext.ext_en: I haven't checked them off but I would say that's about the number.

defs.def_en: When you check things off, you check or count them while referring to a list of them, to make sure you have considered all of them.

defs.def_cn: (用于构成形容词，表示某种能力上的障碍)听力/视力受损的,有听力/视力障碍的

ext.ext_cn: 人口总数的 1/20 强在某种程度上存在听力障碍。
ext.ext_en: More than 1 in 20 of the population is hearing-impaired to some extent...

ext.ext_cn: 英国有 170 万失明和视力受损人口。
ext.ext_en: There are 1.7 million blind and visually impaired people in Britain.

defs.def_en: You use -impaired in adjectives where you are describing someone with a particular disability. For example, someone who is hearing-impaired has a disability affecting their hearing, and someone who is visually-impaired has a disability affecting their sight.

defs.def_cn: 有自动保险装置的;具有自动防故障性能的

ext.ext_cn: 照相机有内置自动防故障装置，该装置确保相机在未接到正确信号时不会启动。
ext.ext_en: The camera has a built-in failsafe device which prevents it from working if the right signals aren't received.

defs.def_en: Something that is fail-safe is designed or made in such a way that nothing dangerous can happen if a part of it goes wrong.

defs.def_cn: 垃圾债券，风险债券（利息高，风险大，用于集资建立、收购新公司等）
defs.def_en: If a company issues junk bonds, it borrows money from investors, usually at a high rate of interest, in order to finance a particular deal, for example the setting up or the taking over of another company.

defs.def_cn: 兼顾各方；左右逢源；两面讨好

ext.ext_cn: 在事业、家庭和为人之母之间小心翼翼地维持平衡
ext.ext_en: ...a delicate balancing act between a career, a home, and motherhood.

defs.def_en: If you perform a balancing act, you try to deal successfully with two or more people, groups, or situations that are in opposition to each other.

defs.def_cn: (有规划地兴建的)新城，新市镇

ext.ext_cn: 巴西尔登新镇
ext.ext_en: ...Basildon New Town.

defs.def_en: A new town is a town that has been planned and built as a single project, including houses, shops, and factories, rather than one that has developed gradually.

ext.ext_cn: 他们非常依赖职业咨询师提供的建议。
ext.ext_en: They relied heavily on the advice of their professional advisers...

ext.ext_cn: 这个协会的收入大部分来自会员的入会费。
ext.ext_en: The Association relies on member subscriptions for most of its income.

defs.def_en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

ext.ext_cn: 我相信你会把它解决好的。
ext.ext_en: I know I can rely on you to sort it out...

ext.ext_cn: 红十字会信赖我们。
ext.ext_en: The Red Cross are relying on us.

defs.def_en: If you can rely on someone to work well or to behave as you want them to, you can trust them to do this.

ext.ext_cn: 她梳理好自己的金发。
ext.ext_en: She combed and arranged her golden hair.

ext.ext_cn: 一望无际的金色沙滩
ext.ext_en: ...an endless golden beach.

defs.def_en: Something that is golden is bright yellow in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 带有金制盒式链坠的金项链
ext.ext_en: ...a golden chain with a golden locket.

defs.def_en: Golden things are made of gold.

defs.def_cn: 极好的；有发展前途的；有益的

ext.ext_cn: 他说务必抓住这个谋求和平的绝佳机会。
ext.ext_en: He says there's a golden opportunity for peace which must be seized.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as golden, you mean it is wonderful because it is likely to be successful and rewarding, or because it is the best of its kind.

defs.def_cn: 大受欢迎（或十分成功）的人

ext.ext_cn: 这部影片上映后，批评家们反响十分热烈，他们将塔拉蒂诺誉为20世纪90年代的金牌男星。
ext.ext_en: When the movie came out the critics went wild, hailing Tarantino as the golden boy of the 1990s.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a man as a golden boy or a woman as a golden girl, you mean that they are especially popular and successful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人失望的;令人沮丧的;令人扫兴的

ext.ext_cn: 酒棒极了，但是饭菜却让人不敢恭维。
ext.ext_en: The wine was excellent, but the food was disappointing...

ext.ext_cn: 对此呼吁的反应令人失望，主要归咎于经济衰退。
ext.ext_en: The recession is largely blamed for the disappointing response to the appeal.

defs.def_en: Something that is disappointing is not as good or as large as you hoped it would be.

defs.def_cn: 丧钟;导致失败（或终结、毁灭）的原因

ext.ext_cn: 税赋的增加为这个企业敲响了丧钟。
ext.ext_en: The tax increase sounded the death knell for the business...

ext.ext_cn: 这将导致马鹿的灭绝。
ext.ext_en: It's going to be the death knell of the red deer.

defs.def_en: If you say that something sounds the death knell for a particular person or thing, you mean it will cause that person or thing to fail, end, or cease to exist.

defs.def_cn: 未被证明为正当的；无法解释的；无法开脱的

ext.ext_cn: 你上周的报告是不公平的。它是基于毫无根据且完全无端的指控。
ext.ext_en: Your report last week was unfair. It was based upon wholly unfounded and totally unjustified allegations...

ext.ext_cn: 委员会判定警方行为不当。
ext.ext_en: The commission concluded that the police action was unjustified.

defs.def_en: If you describe a belief or action as unjustified, you think that there is no good reason for having it or doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 我会努力找到你要的信息。
ext.ext_en: I'll try and hunt out the information you need...

ext.ext_cn: 美国消费者习惯淘一些便宜货。
ext.ext_en: American consumers are accustomed to hunting out bargains.

defs.def_en: If you hunt out something that is hidden or difficult to find, you search for it and eventually find it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 令学生胆怯的身材魁梧、爱嘲讽人的男人
ext.ext_en: ...a big, sardonic man, who intimidated his students.

ext.ext_cn: 冷嘲式的幽默感
ext.ext_en: ...a sardonic sense of humour.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as sardonic, you mean their attitude to people or things is humorous but rather critical.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们播放了最令人尴尬的家庭录像。
ext.ext_en: They showed the most toe-curling home videos.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as toe-curling, you mean that it makes you feel very embarrassed.

ext.ext_cn: 在留言板上留言请点击这里。
ext.ext_en: Have your say on our message board by clicking here.

defs.def_en: In computing, a message board is a system that allows users to send and receive messages of general interest.

ext.ext_cn: 一幅罗里·奥穆尔的画像挂在基尔丹根的餐厅里。
ext.ext_en: A picture of Rory O'Moore hangs in the dining room at Kildangan.

ext.ext_cn: 用彩色粉笔画一张小画
ext.ext_en: ...drawing a small picture with coloured chalks.

defs.def_en: A picture consists of lines and shapes which are drawn, painted, or printed on a surface and show a person, thing, or scene.

ext.ext_cn: 游客无事可做，只能互相拍照。
ext.ext_en: The tourists have nothing to do but take pictures of each other...

ext.ext_cn: 《观察家报》在头版刊登了一张暴乱者聚集在满是垃圾的街头的大幅照片。
ext.ext_en: The Observer carries a big front-page picture of rioters in a litter-strewn street.

defs.def_en: A picture is a photograph.

ext.ext_cn: 令人心碎的人类遭受苦难的电视画面
ext.ext_en: ...heartrending television pictures of human suffering.

defs.def_en: Television pictures are the scenes which you see on a television screen.

defs.def_cn: （在报纸、杂志等上）登载…的照片（或图片）

ext.ext_cn: 许多报纸的头版上都刊登了那个高尔夫球手高高举起奖杯亲吻的照片。
ext.ext_en: The golfer is pictured on many of the front pages, kissing his trophy as he holds it aloft.

ext.ext_cn: 宣称自己在斯特林费洛夜总会和某位名人跳舞的照片上了报纸的女子
ext.ext_en: ...a woman who claimed she had been pictured dancing with a celebrity in Stringfellows nightclub...

defs.def_en: To be pictured somewhere, for example in a newspaper or magazine, means to appear in a photograph or picture.

ext.ext_cn: 华纳通信公司已拒绝在美国发行这部电影。
ext.ext_en: Warner Communications Inc. has refused to distribute the picture in the United States.

ext.ext_cn: 史诗动作片的导演
ext.ext_en: ...a director of epic action pictures.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a film as a picture .

ext.ext_cn: 我们今晚要去看电影。
ext.ext_en: We're going to the pictures tonight...

ext.ext_cn: 我本来就宁可去电影院看，而不是看录像。
ext.ext_en: I'd rather see it at the pictures than on video anyway.

defs.def_en: If you go to the pictures, you go to a cinema to see a film.

defs.def_cn: 想象；印象；心中的形象;头脑中的情景

ext.ext_cn: 他们的心中有一个酒鬼应有的样子。
ext.ext_en: They have in their mind a picture of what an alcoholic should look like...

ext.ext_cn: 我们只是想把整个下午的情形搞清楚。
ext.ext_en: We are just trying to get our picture of the whole afternoon straight...

defs.def_en: If you have a picture of something in your mind, you have a clear idea or memory of it in your mind as if you were actually seeing it.

ext.ext_cn: 他想象她留着黑油油的长辫子的样子。
ext.ext_en: He pictured her with long black braided hair...

ext.ext_cn: 我怎么也想不出她的家会是这样。
ext.ext_en: I never would have pictured this as her home...

defs.def_en: If you picture something in your mind, you think of it and have such a clear memory or idea of it that you seem to be able to see it.

ext.ext_cn: 我会试着更清楚地向你描述一下这些男孩子都干些什么。
ext.ext_en: I'll try and give you a better picture of what the boys do...

ext.ext_cn: 她的书是女性当下所面临问题的凄凉写照。
ext.ext_en: Her book paints a bleak picture of the problems women now face...

defs.def_en: A picture of something is a description of it or an indication of what it is like.

ext.ext_cn: 但和其他慈善机构一样，这些数字掩盖了实情。
ext.ext_en: But as with other charitable bodies, these figures mask the true picture...

ext.ext_cn: 在边界那边的埃塞俄比亚，情况也大致相似。
ext.ext_en: It's a similar picture across the border in Ethiopia.

defs.def_en: When you refer to the picture in a particular place, you are referring to the situation there.

defs.def_cn: （尤指通过他人描述）弄明白情况，了解情形

ext.ext_cn: 卢克从不告诉你事情的来龙去脉，但你总会弄明白是怎么回事。
ext.ext_en: Luke never tells you the whole story, but you always get the picture.

defs.def_en: If you get the picture, you understand the situation, especially one which someone is describing to you.

defs.def_cn: 牵涉其中/不涉其中；在局内/在局外

ext.ext_cn: 迈耶森在7月份消失后现在又掺和了进来了。
ext.ext_en: Meyerson is back in the picture after disappearing in July...

ext.ext_cn: 有时安全措施过于严密，使本来可能会提供重要情况的人成了局外人。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes security was so tight that people who might have had something important to offer were left out of the picture.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in the picture, you mean that they are involved in the situation that you are talking about. If you say that they are out of the picture, you mean that they are not involved in the situation.

defs.def_cn: （形容模样）健康的化身/痛苦的典型

ext.ext_cn: 我们发现她站在一把椅子上，满脸恐惧地发出歇斯底里的尖叫。
ext.ext_en: We found her standing on a chair, the picture of terror, screaming hysterically.

defs.def_en: You use picture to describe what someone looks like. For example, if you say that someone is a picture of health or the picture of misery, you mean that they look extremely healthy or extremely miserable.

defs.def_cn: 使了解内情；向…介绍情况

ext.ext_cn: 法亚尔督察把情况都告诉你了吗？
ext.ext_en: Has Inspector Fayard put you in the picture?

defs.def_en: If you put someone in the picture, you tell them about a situation which they need to know about.
A floor lamp is a tall electric light which stands on the floor in a living room.

ext.ext_cn: 找个建筑师或监理员来监工。
ext.ext_en: Call in an architect or surveyor to oversee the work.

defs.def_en: If you call someone in, you ask them to come and help you or do something for you.

ext.ext_cn: 他只是偶尔过来坐坐。
ext.ext_en: He just calls in occasionally...

ext.ext_cn: 我养成了回家路上顺便去看格洛丽亚的习惯。
ext.ext_en: I got into the habit of calling in on Gloria on my way home.

defs.def_en: If you call in somewhere, you make a short visit there.

defs.def_cn: 新来的人;新参加的人;新手

ext.ext_cn: 他一定是刚到镇上来的，明显不了解我们这儿的风俗。
ext.ext_en: He must be a newcomer to town and he obviously didn't understand our local customs...

ext.ext_cn: 两位候选人相对而言都是政坛新人。
ext.ext_en: The candidates are both relative newcomers to politics.

defs.def_en: A newcomer is a person who has recently arrived in a place, joined an organization, or started a new activity.

defs.def_cn: 新近出现的事物;新得到的东西

ext.ext_cn: 公司最近新到了一辆有2.2升汽油发动机的4 x 4客货两用车。
ext.ext_en: The company's latest newcomer is a 4 x 4 estate with a 2.2 litre petrol engine.

ext.ext_cn: 野营服务新军英国空中旅游公司去年咄咄逼人的大幅削价
ext.ext_en: ...last year's aggressive price slashing by campsite newcomer, Airtours.

defs.def_en: A newcomer is something which has not existed before or been available before.

ext.ext_cn: 她身穿一袭无袖真丝连衣裙。
ext.ext_en: She wore a sleeveless silk dress.

defs.def_en: A sleeveless dress, top, or other item of clothing has no sleeves.

defs.def_cn: (尤指长期存在的)冰盖，冰冠，冰原
defs.def_en: An ice sheet is a large thick area of ice, especially one that exists for a long time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不典型的；不代表…的特征的；反常的

ext.ext_cn: 就这样消失不像她父亲的一贯作风。
ext.ext_en: It was uncharacteristic of her father to disappear like this.

ext.ext_cn: 反常的不谦逊
ext.ext_en: ...an uncharacteristic lack of modesty.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as uncharacteristic of someone, you mean that it is not typical of them.

defs.def_cn: 藏猫猫（逗小孩儿的一种游戏）
defs.def_en: also peekaboo. Peekaboo is a game you play with babies in which you cover your face with your hands or hide behind something and then suddenly show your face, saying 'peekaboo!'

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 未受过良好教育的；没有多少文化的

ext.ext_cn: 查维斯虽然没有受过多少教育，但并不笨。
ext.ext_en: Though an uneducated man, Chavez was not a stupid one.

ext.ext_cn: 穷人和未受过良好教育的人在这些改革中表现最差。
ext.ext_en: The poor and uneducated did worst under these reforms.

defs.def_en: Someone who is uneducated has not received much education.
An ice pick is a small pointed tool that you use for breaking ice.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (男子)有骑士风度的;(尤指对女子)彬彬有礼的，殷勤的

ext.ext_cn: 他长相英俊，为人正直，风度翩翩。
ext.ext_en: He was handsome, upright and chivalrous.

defs.def_en: A chivalrous man is polite, kind, and unselfish, especially towards women.

defs.def_cn: (澳大利亚等国的)立法院议员
defs.def_en: In Australia and some other countries, an MLA is a person who has been elected as a member of parliament. MLA is an abbreviation for (缩略 =) 'member of the legislative assembly'.

defs.def_cn: (写在某人姓名之后表示已经当选的)立法院议员

ext.ext_cn: 立法院议员M.罗丝夫人
ext.ext_en: ...Mrs M Rose, MLA.

defs.def_en: MLA is written after someone's name to indicate that they have been elected as an MLA.

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦梅费尔区精巧的小公寓
ext.ext_en: ...a bijou Mayfair flat.

ext.ext_cn: 精品店和时装屋
ext.ext_en: ...bijou shops and boutiques.

defs.def_en: Small houses are sometimes described as bijou houses in order to make them sound attractive or fashionable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们是搭乘从雅典直飞这里的航班过来的。
ext.ext_en: They'd come on a direct flight from Athens.

ext.ext_cn: 从安曼到孟买的直达线路
ext.ext_en: ...the direct route from Amman to Bombay.

defs.def_en: Direct means moving towards a place or object, without changing direction and without stopping, for example in a journey.

defs.def_cn: (光或热)直接照射的，直接接触的

ext.ext_cn: 药品的储放应避免阳光直射。
ext.ext_en: Medicines should be stored away from direct sunlight...

ext.ext_cn: 直射光照明既刺目又呆板。
ext.ext_en: Direct illumination is harsh and unflattering.

defs.def_en: If something is in direct heat or light, it is strongly affected by the heat or light, because there is nothing between it and the source of heat or light to protect it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (经验、活动或系统)直接的，亲身的

ext.ext_cn: 他对私有化过程有着切身体会。
ext.ext_en: He has direct experience of the process of privatisation...

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎直接和老板联系。
ext.ext_en: He seemed to be in direct contact with the Boss...

defs.def_en: You use direct to describe an experience, activity, or system which only involves the people, actions, or things that are necessary to make it happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们无法证明她的死是由于他的注射直接引起的。
ext.ext_en: They were unable to prove that she died as a direct result of his injection...

ext.ext_cn: 他的到访是他们之间关系已有所改善的明证。
ext.ext_en: His visit is direct evidence of the improvement in their relationship...

defs.def_en: You use direct to emphasize the closeness of a connection between two things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坦率的;率直的;直截了当的

ext.ext_cn: 他避免作出正面回答。
ext.ext_en: He avoided giving a direct answer...

ext.ext_cn: 这些新歌听起来更直入人心。
ext.ext_en: The new songs are more direct...

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as direct, you mean that they are honest and open, and say exactly what they mean.

ext.ext_cn: 我把灭火器对准了火焰，但没起作用。
ext.ext_en: I directed the extinguisher at the fire without effect...

ext.ext_cn: 他把那一小束光对准了屋顶。
ext.ext_en: He directed the tiny beam of light at the roof.

defs.def_en: If you direct something at a particular thing, you aim or point it at that thing.

defs.def_cn: 使(注意力、情感、行为等)转向;使…指向;把…引向

ext.ext_cn: 需要将学习者的注意力引向那些着重点上。
ext.ext_en: The learner's attention needs to be directed to the significant features...

ext.ext_cn: 如果一上来她就冲你发火，不必惊讶。
ext.ext_en: Do not be surprised if, initially, she directs her anger at you...

defs.def_en: If your attention, emotions, or actions are directed at a particular person or thing, you are focusing them on that person or thing.

defs.def_cn: 使(话语或眼神)针对，指向，冲…而来

ext.ext_cn: 她很难相信这个问题是冲她来的。
ext.ext_en: She could hardly believe the question was directed towards her...

ext.ext_cn: 这些辱骂是冲着电视台的工作人员来的。
ext.ext_en: The abuse was directed at the TV crews...

defs.def_en: If a remark or look is directed at you, someone says something to you or looks at you.

ext.ext_cn: 你能告诉他们去拉蒙特医生的办公室怎么走吗？
ext.ext_en: Could you direct them to Dr Lamont's office, please?...

ext.ext_cn: 进去后，一名警卫把他们引向了右边。
ext.ext_en: Inside, a guard directed them to the right.

defs.def_en: If you direct someone somewhere, you tell them how to get there.

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯托弗将管理日常的运营。
ext.ext_en: Christopher will direct day-to-day operations.

ext.ext_cn: 在组织解救9名人质的过程中他所表现出的冷静
ext.ext_en: ...his coolness in directing the rescue of nine hostages.

defs.def_en: When someone directs a project or a group of people, they are responsible for organizing the people and activities that are involved.

defs.def_cn: 导演，执导(电影、戏剧或电视节目)

ext.ext_cn: 他执导过多种题材的电视节目。
ext.ext_en: He directed various TV shows...

ext.ext_cn: 该影片是由霍华德·霍克斯导演的。
ext.ext_en: The film was directed by Howard Hawks.

defs.def_en: When someone directs a film, play, or television programme, they are responsible for the way in which it is performed and for telling the actors and assistants what to do.

ext.ext_cn: 他们得到指示要特别关注贫困问题。
ext.ext_en: They have been directed to give special attention to the problem of poverty...

ext.ext_cn: 主教要求信徒们呆在家中。
ext.ext_en: The Bishop directed the faithful to stay at home.

defs.def_en: If you are directed to do something, someone in authority tells you to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 她是维多利亚女王的嫡系后代。
ext.ext_en: She is a direct descendant of Queen Victoria.

defs.def_en: If you are a direct descendant of someone, you are related to them through your parents and your grandparents and so on.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (声音)轰隆隆的，低沉的，低吼的

ext.ext_cn: 观众报以雷鸣般的掌声。
ext.ext_en: The audience responded with thunderous applause.

defs.def_cn: （酒吧等处的投币式）自动点唱机

ext.ext_cn: 自动点唱机在放我最喜欢的歌。
ext.ext_en: My favorite song is on the jukebox.

defs.def_en: A jukebox is a machine that plays CDs in a place such as a pub or bar. You put money in and choose the song you want to hear.

ext.ext_cn: 双方都同意各自遣散70%的军队。
ext.ext_en: Both sides have agreed to demobilize 70% of their armies...

ext.ext_cn: 叛军不太可能会同意解散武装。
ext.ext_en: It is unlikely that the rebels will agree to demobilise.

defs.def_en: If a country or armed force demobilizes its troops, or if its troops demobilize, its troops are released from service and allowed to go home.

ext.ext_cn: 我在部队里呆了一年，直到复员以后才回到美国。
ext.ext_en: I spent one year in the service and did not come back to the United States until after I was demobilized.

defs.def_en: If someone has been demobilized, they have completed their service in the armed forces of their country.

ext.ext_cn: 几个世纪以来人们一直相信伟大的作家、作曲家和科学家从根本上就与普通人大不相同。
ext.ext_en: It's been believed for centuries that great writers, composers and scientists are essentially quite different from ordinary people...

ext.ext_cn: 最基本的是，葡萄藤和葡萄需要水、热和光。
ext.ext_en: Essentially, vines and grapes need water, heat and light.

defs.def_en: You use essentially to emphasize a quality that someone or something has, and to say that it is their most important or basic quality.

ext.ext_cn: 他有关城市占用农业用地的分析已被证明大体上是正确的。
ext.ext_en: His analysis of urban use of agricultural land has been proved essentially correct...

ext.ext_cn: 基本上，西方只有两种选择。
ext.ext_en: Essentially, the West has only two options...

defs.def_en: You use essentially to indicate that what you are saying is mainly true, although some parts of it are wrong or more complicated than has been stated.

defs.def_cn: 使泄气;挫…的锐气;贬低…的重要性

ext.ext_cn: 跟其他演员一样，他有时也会以自我为中心，但我想自己已经找到了如何挫他锐气的办法。
ext.ext_en: Like any actor he can be self-centred but I think I've worked out how to deflate him...

ext.ext_cn: 英国另外的夺牌希望在那天早些时候受到了打击。
ext.ext_en: Britain's other hopes of medals were deflated earlier in the day.

defs.def_en: If you deflate someone or something, you take away their confidence or make them seem less important.

defs.def_cn: 放(轮胎、气球等)的气;（使）瘪掉

ext.ext_cn: 返回岸上后，救生衣就会瘪掉，恢复成背带状。
ext.ext_en: When it returns to shore, the life-jacket will deflate and revert to a harness...

ext.ext_cn: 瘪了气的救生筏
ext.ext_en: ...a deflated dinghy.

defs.def_en: When something such as a tyre or balloon deflates, or when you deflate it, all the air comes out of it.
A star-gazer is someone who studies the stars as an astronomer or astrologer.
A guesstimate is an approximate calculation which is based mainly or entirely on guessing.

ext.ext_cn: 睡了一夜好觉后，保罗说他已经迫不及待了。
ext.ext_en: After a good night's sleep, Paul said he was raring to go.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are raring to go, you mean that you are very eager to start doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 莎拉来了，她急着要见你。
ext.ext_en: Sarah's here and raring to meet you...

ext.ext_cn: 他急切地想管管这场闹剧，教训他们一顿。
ext.ext_en: He is raring to charge into the fray and lay down the law...

defs.def_en: If you are raring to do something or are raring for it, you are very eager to do it or very eager that it should happen.

defs.def_cn: （铁路和公路交会的）平交道口，平面交叉处
defs.def_en: A level crossing is a place where a railway line crosses a road.

ext.ext_cn: 他怒气冲冲，摔门而去。
ext.ext_en: He scowled, and slammed the door behind him...

ext.ext_cn: 两个男人进屋时，她怒目而视。
ext.ext_en: She scowled at the two men as they entered the room.

defs.def_en: When someone scowls, an angry or hostile expression appears on their face.

ext.ext_cn: 一片赞成声在乌克兰议会中回响。
ext.ext_en: A roar of approval resounded through the Ukrainian parliament...

ext.ext_cn: 士兵的军靴踏在地面上的声音在大街上回响。
ext.ext_en: The soldiers' boots resounded in the street.

defs.def_en: When a noise resounds, it is heard very loudly and clearly.

ext.ext_cn: 整个场地回荡着音乐。
ext.ext_en: The whole place resounded with music...

ext.ext_cn: 卡拉什尼科夫冲锋枪的声音和连续不断的大炮声在喀布尔回荡。
ext.ext_en: Kabul resounded to the crack of Kalashnikov fire and a flood of artillery.

defs.def_en: If a place resounds with or to particular noises, it is filled with them.
A Catherine wheel is a firework in the shape of a circle which spins round and round.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 开色情玩笑的;性幽默的;不雅的

ext.ext_cn: 荤段子
ext.ext_en: ...a saucy joke.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is saucy refers to sex in a light-hearted, amusing way.

defs.def_cn: (某事件或状态的)持续时间,期间

ext.ext_cn: 他的任务是在审讯期间保护她。
ext.ext_en: He was given the task of protecting her for the duration of the trial...

ext.ext_cn: 课程为期两年。
ext.ext_en: Courses are of two years' duration.

defs.def_en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

ext.ext_cn: 他的伤病使他在整个期间都无法参赛。
ext.ext_en: His wounds knocked him out of combat for the duration.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen for the duration, you mean that it will happen for as long as a particular situation continues.

ext.ext_cn: 政府面临着学生通过罢课掀起的新一轮反对浪潮。
ext.ext_en: The government is facing a new wave of opposition in the form of a student strike...

ext.ext_cn: 该计划的主要反对声音来自媒体。
ext.ext_en: Much of the opposition to this plan has come from the media.

defs.def_en: Opposition is strong, angry, or violent disagreement and disapproval.

defs.def_cn: （与政府意见相左的）反对党，在野党，反对派

ext.ext_cn: 主要反对党联合抵制这次选举，认为该选举将缺乏公正性。
ext.ext_en: The main opposition parties boycotted the election, saying it would not be conducted fairly.

defs.def_en: The opposition is the political parties or groups that are opposed to a government.

defs.def_cn: （议会或立法机构中的）反对党，在野党，反对派

ext.ext_cn: 反对党领袖
ext.ext_en: ...the Leader of the Opposition.

defs.def_en: In a country's parliament or legislature, the opposition refers to the politicians or political parties that form part of the parliament or legislature, but are not the government.

defs.def_cn: （体育比赛中的）对手，竞争者，竞争队伍

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰队在国内最后一场热身赛的对手是波兰队。
ext.ext_en: Poland provide the opposition for the Scots' last warm-up match at home.

defs.def_en: The opposition is the person or team you are competing against in a sports event.

ext.ext_cn: 这座宫殿有几座大花园、一处迷宫和几个网球场。
ext.ext_en: The palace has extensive gardens, a maze, and tennis courts.

defs.def_en: A maze is a complex system of passages or paths between walls or hedges and is designed to confuse people who try to find their way through it, often as a form of amusement.

defs.def_cn: （街道、房间、地道）错综复杂;迷津

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们领我穿过迷宫一般的街巷，来到城边。
ext.ext_en: The children lead me through the maze of alleys to the edge of the city.

ext.ext_cn: 灯光黯淡、铺设着棕色地毯的迷宫一般的走廊
ext.ext_en: ...a maze of dimly-lighted, brown-carpeted corridors.

defs.def_en: A maze of streets, rooms, or tunnels is a large number of them that are connected in a complicated way, so that it is difficult to find  your way through them.

defs.def_cn: 错综复杂的想法;复杂难懂的话题;纷繁复杂的规则

ext.ext_cn: 本书旨在就各种非传统疗法为您指点迷津。
ext.ext_en: The book tries to steer you through the maze of alternative therapies.

ext.ext_cn: 各种错综复杂的规章制度
ext.ext_en: ...the maze of rules and regulations.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a set of ideas, topics, or rules as a maze when a large number of them are related to each other in a complicated way that makes them difficult to understand.
A gold card is a special type of credit card that gives you extra benefits such as a higher spending limit.
Spuds are potatoes.

defs.def_cn: (问题)修辞性的，反问的，反诘的

ext.ext_cn: 他微微皱了下眉头，显然并不期待任何人回答他的反问。
ext.ext_en: He grimaced slightly, obviously expecting no answer to his rhetorical question...

ext.ext_cn: 他没有回答司令官的问题，反正司令官只是反问一下。
ext.ext_en: He made no answer to the Commandante's question, which had been rhetorical in any case.

defs.def_en: A rhetorical question is one which is asked in order to make a statement rather than to get an answer.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (语言)夸张的，词藻华丽的，修辞的

ext.ext_cn: 这些论据或许是用来作为一种修辞手段来论证联合国将发挥长久的作用。
ext.ext_en: These arguments may have been used as a rhetorical device to argue for a perpetuation of a United Nations role.

defs.def_en: Rhetorical language is intended to be grand and impressive.
A telephone directory is the same as a telephone book .

ext.ext_cn: 反对派领袖否认与喀布尔政府有任何联系。
ext.ext_en: Opposition leaders are denying any contact with the government in Kabul...

ext.ext_cn: 他禁止董事与管理层绕开他私下进行任何联系。
ext.ext_en: He forbade contacts between directors and executives outside his presence.

defs.def_en: Contact involves meeting or communicating with someone, especially regularly.

ext.ext_cn: 他与绑架者有直接联系。
ext.ext_en: He was in direct contact with the kidnappers...

ext.ext_cn: 我们确实保持着联系。
ext.ext_en: We do keep in contact.

defs.def_en: If you are in contact with someone, you regularly meet them or communicate with them.

ext.ext_cn: 详情请洽旅游信息处。
ext.ext_en: Contact the Tourist Information Bureau for further details...

ext.ext_cn: 弗朗西丝第一次与我联系时很心烦意乱。
ext.ext_en: When she first contacted me Frances was upset.

defs.def_en: If you contact someone, you telephone them, write to them, or go to see them in order to tell or ask them something.

defs.def_cn: (信息、电话号码等)供联系的，供联络的

ext.ext_cn: 打电话时须留下全名与联络信息。
ext.ext_en: You must leave your full name and contact details when you phone.

defs.def_en: Your contact details or number are information such as a telephone number where you can be contacted.

ext.ext_cn: 我接触到的医生都表示了他们的担心。
ext.ext_en: Doctors I came into contact with voiced their concern...

ext.ext_cn: 上大学使我接触了西方的思想。
ext.ext_en: The college has brought me into contact with western ideas.

defs.def_en: If you come into contact with someone or something, you meet that person or thing in the course of your work or other activities.

ext.ext_cn: 后来，她出名之后，他曾试图与她联系。
ext.ext_en: Then, after she had become famous, he tried to make contact with her.

defs.def_en: If you make contact with someone, you find out where they are and talk or write to them.

defs.def_cn: 与…失去联系;与…断了联系

ext.ext_cn: 虽然他们都住在附近，但我很快与他们失去了联系。
ext.ext_en: Though they all live nearby, I lost contact with them really quickly...

ext.ext_cn: 尼古拉斯20岁出头的时候母子就失去了联系。
ext.ext_en: Mother and son lost contact when Nicholas was in his early twenties.

defs.def_en: If you lose contact with someone who you have been friendly with, you no longer see them, speak to them, or write to them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们比较了与不同材料接触时这些生物体的反应。
ext.ext_en: They compared how these organisms behaved when left in contact with different materials...

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿的喉咙接触到空气时，就会哭出来。
ext.ext_en: The cry occurs when air is brought into contact with the baby's larynx...

defs.def_en: When people or things are in contact, they are touching each other.

ext.ext_cn: 他未能进行无线电联络。
ext.ext_en: He failed to make radio contact.

ext.ext_cn: 飞行员与控制塔失去联络前不久报告的技术故障
ext.ext_en: ...a technical problem reported by the pilot moments before he lost contact with the control tower.

defs.def_en: Radio contact is communication by means of radio.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在美国大使馆的熟人叫菲尔。
ext.ext_en: Their contact in the United States Embassy was called Phil.

defs.def_en: A contact is someone you know in an organization or profession who helps you or gives you information.
A pelican is a type of large water bird. It catches fish and keeps them in the bottom part of its beak which is shaped like a large bag.

defs.def_cn: （尤指因为烦恼或不感兴趣）咕噜，嘟哝着说

ext.ext_cn: 司机嘟哝了一声，认定迈克尔是发疯了。
ext.ext_en: The driver grunted, convinced that Michael was crazy...

ext.ext_cn: “废话，”我嘟哝了一声。
ext.ext_en: 'Rubbish,' I grunted...

defs.def_en: If you grunt, you make a low sound, especially because you are annoyed or not interested in something.

ext.ext_cn: 猪发出的呼噜声
ext.ext_en: ...the sound of a pig grunting.

defs.def_en: When an animal grunts, it makes a low rough noise.
When you shift up, you move the gear lever in the vehicle you are driving in order to use a higher gear.

ext.ext_cn: 沿着马路每500码就有一个炮台。
ext.ext_en: There are gun emplacements every five-hundred yards along the road.

defs.def_en: Emplacements are specially prepared positions from which a heavy gun can be fired.

defs.def_cn: 耐甲氧苯青霉素金黄色葡萄球菌；超级细菌

ext.ext_cn: 医院金黄色葡萄球菌的问题
ext.ext_en: ...the problem of MRSA in hospitals.

defs.def_en: MRSA is a bacterium that is resistant to most antibiotics. MRSA is an abbreviation for (缩略 =) 'methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus'.

ext.ext_cn: 镀金手表
ext.ext_en: ...a gold-plated watch.

defs.def_en: Something made of metal that is plated is covered with a thin layer of another type of metal such as gold and silver.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不含糊的；清晰的；明确的

ext.ext_cn: 向该党传递明确信息的选举结果
ext.ext_en: ...an election result that sent the party an unambiguous message...

ext.ext_cn: 那组特写照片和附带的评论一目了然，毫无含糊之处。
ext.ext_en: The close-up photography and commentary are clear and unambiguous.

defs.def_en: If you describe a message or comment as unambiguous, you mean that it is clear and cannot be understood wrongly.
Bugger all is a rude way of saying 'nothing'.

ext.ext_cn: 被告在被证实有罪之前都被视为无罪的假定
ext.ext_en: ...the presumption that a defendant is innocent until proved guilty...

ext.ext_cn: 事实上我对这个案件一无所知，很多观点都只能是假设。
ext.ext_en: I'm having to make a lot of presumptions since I don't really know anything about the case.

defs.def_en: A presumption is something that is accepted as true but is not certain to be true.

ext.ext_cn: 他们对他的放肆感到非常愤怒。
ext.ext_en: They were angered by his presumption.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as presumption, you disapprove of it because they are doing something that they have no right to do.

ext.ext_cn: 我走到街角等校车。
ext.ext_en: I walk to a street corner and wait for the school bus...

ext.ext_cn: 不要坐等事情发生。要创造条件让它们发生。
ext.ext_en: Stop waiting for things to happen. Make them happen...

defs.def_en: When you wait for something or someone, you spend some time doing very little, because you cannot act until that thing happens or that person arrives.

ext.ext_cn: 组织者宣布结果之前长达4小时的等待
ext.ext_en: ...the four-hour wait for the organizers to declare the result.

defs.def_en: A wait is a period of time in which you do very little, before something happens or before you can do something.

defs.def_cn: 准备妥当;可获得;可使用

ext.ext_cn: 会有辆汽车等你。
ext.ext_en: There'll be a car waiting for you...

ext.ext_cn: 我们到家时，有一顿美餐正等着我们享用。
ext.ext_en: When we came home we had a meal waiting for us...

defs.def_en: If something is waiting for you, it is ready for you to use, have, or do.

ext.ext_cn: 我想和你谈谈，但可以晚点再说。
ext.ext_en: I want to talk to you, but it can wait...

ext.ext_cn: 任何改变都要等找到赞助商之后再作决定。
ext.ext_en: Any changes will have to wait until sponsors can be found.

defs.def_en: If you say that something can wait, you mean that it is not important or urgent and so you will deal with it or do it later.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你觉得所有这些听起来令人兴奋，那就等着去读这本书吧。
ext.ext_en: If you think this all sounds very exciting, just wait until you read the book...

ext.ext_cn: 吃点儿东西你就会打起精神的。等着瞧吧。
ext.ext_en: As soon as you get some food inside you, you'll feel more cheerful. Just you wait.

defs.def_en: You can use wait when you are trying to make someone feel excited, or to encourage or threaten them.

ext.ext_cn: “等一下，”他插嘴说，“这没有给她一个公平的解释机会！”
ext.ext_en: 'Wait a minute!' he broke in. 'This is not giving her a fair hearing!'

defs.def_en: Wait is used in expressions such as wait a minute ,wait a second, and wait a moment to interrupt someone when they are speaking, for example because you object to what they are saying or because you want them to repeat something.

ext.ext_cn: 有很多仆人服侍她。
ext.ext_en: There were plenty of servants to wait on her...

ext.ext_cn: 每学期每个学生都要在餐厅服务一周。
ext.ext_en: Each student is expected to wait at table for one week each semester.

defs.def_en: If an employee waits on you, for example in a restaurant or hotel, they take orders from you and bring you what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 我们迫不及待地想开始。
ext.ext_en: We can't wait to get started...

ext.ext_cn: 那一定很棒。我都等不及了。
ext.ext_en: It's gonna be great. I can hardly wait...

defs.def_en: If you say that you can't wait to do something or can hardly wait to do it, you are emphasizing that you are very excited about it and eager to do it.

defs.def_cn: (让人在命令下达前勿提前做某事)等一等

ext.ext_cn: 手臂弯曲。手臂上举。保持一下。伸展。
ext.ext_en: Arms bend. Arms upward. Wait for it. Stretch.

defs.def_en: You say 'wait for it' to stop someone from doing something too soon because you have not yet given them the command to do it.

defs.def_cn: (表示接下来要说的内容非常有趣或令人惊奇)注意了，听好了

ext.ext_cn: 将花费整整50万美元获取货真价实的17世纪的空气，注意了，是从一个内有尸体的铅制棺材里获得。
ext.ext_en: A cool $500,000 is to be spent on obtaining genuine 17th-century air from the inside of, wait for it, an occupied lead coffin.

defs.def_en: You can use 'wait for it' to indicate that you are about to say something that is amusing or surprising.

ext.ext_cn: 我们只好等等看将会发生什么。
ext.ext_en: We'll have to wait and see what happens.

ext.ext_cn: 观望态度
ext.ext_en: ...a wait-and-see attitude.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to wait and see, you tell them that they must be patient or that they must not worry about what is going to happen in the future because they have no control over it.

ext.ext_cn: 那你还等什么呢？难道要我求你吻我吗？
ext.ext_en: Well, what are you waiting for? Do I have to ask you for a kiss?

defs.def_en: If you say to someone 'What are you waiting for?' you are telling them to hurry up and do something.

defs.def_cn: (上面有孔，烤后涂上黄油吃的)小圆烤饼
defs.def_en: Crumpets are round, flat pieces of a substance like bread or batter with small holes in them. You toast them and eat them with butter.
Some men refer to attractive women as crumpet. This use could cause offence.
A mastectomy is a surgical operation to remove a woman's breast.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 预报针对的是变化无常的天气。
ext.ext_en: The forecast is for changeable weather.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is changeable is likely to change many times.

ext.ext_cn: 蓄意杀人依法要判无期徒刑。
ext.ext_en: In a case of premeditated murder a life sentence is mandatory...

ext.ext_cn: 这次袭击是预先策划好的。
ext.ext_en: The attack was premeditated and preplanned.

defs.def_en: A premeditated crime is planned or thought about before it is done.

defs.def_cn: (从行驶的交通工具后面吹来的)顺风

ext.ext_cn: 由于顺风，飞行时间缩短了半小时。
ext.ext_en: A tailwind had cut the flying time by half an hour.

defs.def_en: A tailwind is a wind that is blowing from behind an aeroplane, boat, or other vehicle, making it move faster.

ext.ext_cn: 她把信折好，用力舔了舔信封的折口。
ext.ext_en: She folded up her letter, licking the envelope flap with relish...

ext.ext_cn: 那只狗笨拙地站起来，兴奋地舔着那个男人的手。
ext.ext_en: The dog rose awkwardly to his feet and licked the man's  hand excitedly.

defs.def_en: When people or animals lick something, they move their tongue across its surface.

ext.ext_cn: 如果公平较量，他也许能将我们所有人都轻易打败。
ext.ext_en: He might be able to lick us all in a fair fight...

ext.ext_cn: 总理乐观地声称政府已经一劳永逸地解决了通货膨胀问题，但更多人的失业却令这一消息大为减色。
ext.ext_en: The Chancellor's upbeat message that the Government had licked inflation for good was marred by more job losses.

defs.def_en: If you lick someone or something, you easily defeat them in a fight or competition.

ext.ext_cn: 大火蔓烧过厨房的天花板咆哮而来，红色的火舌朝门厅内卷去。
ext.ext_en: The fire came roaring through the kitchen ceiling and sent its red tongues licking into the entrance hall...

ext.ext_cn: 火焰的舌尖舔卷着绯红色的天空。
ext.ext_en: The apex of the flames licked the crimson sky.

defs.def_en: When flames of a large fire lick somewhere or something, the fire begins to reach that place or thing and the flames touch it lightly and briefly.

ext.ext_cn: 可用少量油彩使四下显得更亮堂。
ext.ext_en: It could do with a lick of paint to brighten up its premises.

defs.def_en: A lick of something is a small amount of it.

defs.def_cn: 小过门（吉他演奏的歌曲）；（即兴插入的）爵士乐装饰乐句

ext.ext_cn: 用重金属吉他演奏的尖厉过门
ext.ext_en: ...the screeching licks of heavy metal guitar.

defs.def_en: A lick is a short piece of music which is part of a song and is played on a guitar. A lick is also a short section in a piece of jazz, which the musician invents while they are playing.
to lick your lips  →see: lip; to lick into shape→see: shape; to lick your wounds→see: wound;

ext.ext_cn: 她与哈迪太太进行了一番女人之间的交心之谈。
ext.ext_en: She had had a woman-to-woman chat with Mrs Hardie.

ext.ext_cn: 也许有一天她会和她妈妈进行一次女人之间的谈心。
ext.ext_en: Maybe she would talk to her mother one day, woman to woman.

defs.def_en: If you talk about a woman-to-woman conversation, you are talking about an honest and open discussion between two women.

defs.def_cn: 轻浮的行为;无聊的活动

ext.ext_cn: 在所有这些闹腾的核心传递着一个严肃的信息。
ext.ext_en: There is a serious message at the core of all this frivolity...

ext.ext_cn: 他是我最有才华的学生之一，只是太容易被一些无聊的事分心。
ext.ext_en: He was one of my most able pupils, but far too easily distracted by frivolities.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an activity as a frivolity, you think that it is amusing and rather silly, rather than serious and sensible.

ext.ext_cn: 他是由海军上将精心挑选出来担任这项工作的。
ext.ext_en: He was hand-picked for this job by the Admiral...

ext.ext_cn: 创价学会可以仔细挑选其继任人。
ext.ext_en: Sokagakkai was able to hand-pick his successor.

defs.def_en: If someone is hand-picked, they are very carefully chosen by someone in authority for a particular purpose or a particular job.
Athlete's foot is a fungal infection in which the skin between the toes becomes cracked or peels off.

ext.ext_cn: 心脏外科医师
ext.ext_en: ...a heart surgeon.

defs.def_en: See also:plastic surgeon;A surgeon is a doctor who is specially trained to perform surgery.
Stirrups are the two metal loops which are attached to a horse's saddle by long pieces of leather. You place your feet in the stirrups when riding a horse.

ext.ext_cn: 每天上午富兰克林都在游泳池中游泳，在池边晒太阳。
ext.ext_en: Franklin swam and sunbathed at the pool every morning.

defs.def_en: When people sunbathe, they sit or lie in a place where the sun shines on them, so that their skin becomes browner.

defs.def_cn: 线轴;(录音带、胶卷的)卷轴
defs.def_en: A spool is a round object onto which thread, tape, or film can be wound, especially before it is put into a machine.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (部位、问题、题目等)特定的，特别的

ext.ext_cn: 按摩有助于增加身体特定部位的血液流量。
ext.ext_en: Massage may help to increase blood flow to specific areas of the body...

ext.ext_cn: 有几个特定问题需要解决。
ext.ext_en: There are several specific problems to be dealt with...

defs.def_en: You use specific to refer to a particular fixed area, problem, or subject.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我要求他说得更具体些。
ext.ext_en: I asked him to be more specific...

ext.ext_cn: 这些神经中心产生有节奏的运动，或者更确切地说，是有节奏的肠胃蠕动。
ext.ext_en: These nerve centres generate rhythmic movements; or to be more specific, rhythmic stomach movements...

defs.def_en: If someone is specific, they give a description that is precise and exact. You can also use specific to describe their description.

defs.def_cn: 特有的;独特的;只与…有关的

ext.ext_cn: 寄出你的简历并附上一份针对那个特定工作岗位的附函。
ext.ext_en: Send your resume with a cover letter that is specific to that particular job.

ext.ext_cn: 有关贸易的多数研究都是针对某个具体国家的。
ext.ext_en: Most studies of trade have been country-specific.

defs.def_en: Something that is specific to a particular thing is connected with that thing only.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人愉快的;有趣的;好玩的

ext.ext_cn: 她最有趣却最不知名的小说之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of her most engaging and least known novels...

ext.ext_cn: 他是个令人愉快的伙伴。
ext.ext_en: He was engaging company.

defs.def_en: An engaging person or thing is pleasant, interesting, and entertaining.
A hibiscus is a tropical bush that has large, brightly-coloured bell-shaped flowers.

ext.ext_cn: 法国作家玛格丽特·杜拉斯的自传体小说
ext.ext_en: ...an autobiographical novella from French writer Marguerite Duras.

defs.def_en: A novella is a short novel or a long short story.

defs.def_cn: 工人阶级;劳动阶级;工薪阶层

ext.ext_cn: 工薪阶层中有1/4的人投票支持他。
ext.ext_en: A quarter of the working class voted for him.

ext.ext_cn: 工薪阶层中住房自有率的提高
ext.ext_en: ...increased levels of home ownership among the working classes.

defs.def_en: The working class or the working classes are the group of people in a society who do not own much property, who have low social status, and who do jobs which involve using physical skills rather than intellectual skills.

defs.def_cn: （岩石、船底等处附着的）甲壳动物，藤壶
defs.def_en: Barnacles are small shellfish that fix themselves tightly to rocks and the bottoms of boats.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无结果的;无成效的;徒劳的

ext.ext_cn: 搜寻工作毫无结果。
ext.ext_en: It was a fruitless search...

ext.ext_cn: 会谈到目前为止未见成果。
ext.ext_en: Talks have so far have been fruitless.

defs.def_en: Fruitless actions, events, or efforts do not achieve anything at all.

ext.ext_cn: 我们能够给予的关怀、关爱和关注是有限的。
ext.ext_en: Our capacity for giving care, love and attention is limited...

ext.ext_cn: 她的才智和气质和他一样出众。
ext.ext_en: Her mental capacity and temperament are as remarkable as his.

defs.def_en: Your capacity for something is your ability to do it, or the amount of it that you are able to do.

defs.def_cn: (工厂、企业、地区的)生产量,生产（或运输）能力

ext.ext_cn: 经济中的剩余生产能力
ext.ext_en: ...the amount of spare capacity in the economy...

ext.ext_cn: 面包厂正在全力生产。
ext.ext_en: Bread factories are working at full capacity...

defs.def_en: The capacity of something such as a factory, industry, or region is the quantity of things that it can produce or deliver with the equipment or resources that are available.

ext.ext_cn: 载弹量为454千克的飞机
ext.ext_en: ...an aircraft with a bomb-carrying capacity of 454 kg.

ext.ext_cn: 使这些车辆的储油量远远超过其他卡车的一个特点
ext.ext_en: ...a feature which gave the vehicles a much greater fuel capacity than other trucks.

defs.def_en: The capacity of a piece of equipment is its size or power, often measured in particular units.

ext.ext_cn: 容量为140升的油箱
ext.ext_en: ...the fuel tanks, which had a capacity of 140 litres...

ext.ext_cn: 将6个容量为150毫升(5至6液盎司)的烤盘涂上油。
ext.ext_en: Grease 6 ramekin dishes of 150 ml (5-6 fl oz) capacity.

defs.def_en: The capacity of a container is its volume, or the amount of liquid it can hold, measured in units such as litres or gallons.

defs.def_cn: (建筑、地方、车辆的)可容纳人数,载客量

ext.ext_cn: 每个体育场均可容纳5万人左右。
ext.ext_en: Each stadium had a seating capacity of about 50,000...

ext.ext_cn: 多伦多医院的产房都已住满了。
ext.ext_en: Toronto hospital maternity wards were filled to capacity.

defs.def_en: The capacity of a building, place, or vehicle is the number of people or things that it can hold. If a place is filled to capacity, it is as full as it can possibly be.

defs.def_cn: 座无虚席的;满场的;挤满的

ext.ext_cn: 温布利球场座无虚席，76,000人前来观看这场比赛。
ext.ext_en: A capacity crowd of 76,000 people was at Wembley football stadium for the event.

defs.def_en: A capacity crowd or audience completely fills a theatre, sports stadium, or other place.

ext.ext_cn: 哈利韦尔女士以联合国儿童基金会特别代表的身份访问了菲律宾。
ext.ext_en: Ms Halliwell visited the Philippines in her capacity as a Special Representative of Unicef...

ext.ext_cn: 本文是以个人名义所写。
ext.ext_en: This article is written in a personal capacity...

defs.def_en: If you do something in a particular capacity, you do it as part of a particular job or duty, or because you are representing a particular organization or person.

ext.ext_cn: 滩头阵地建立起来了。
ext.ext_en: A bridgehead was established.

defs.def_en: A bridgehead is a good position which an army has taken in the enemy's territory and from which it can advance or attack.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我太虚弱了，无法动弹，无法思考，也无法说话。
ext.ext_en: I was too weak to move or think or speak...

ext.ext_cn: 他的四肢虚弱无力。
ext.ext_en: His arms and legs were weak.

defs.def_en: If someone is weak, they are not healthy or do not have good muscles, so that they cannot move quickly or carry heavy things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (器官或感官)功能差的，受损伤的

ext.ext_cn: 挨打前坎坦科的视力就一直很弱，不过也还勉强看得见。
ext.ext_en: Until the beating, Cantanco's eyesight had been weak, but adequate...

ext.ext_cn: 她很容易疲劳，心脏也不好。
ext.ext_en: She tired easily and had a weak heart.

defs.def_en: If someone has an organ or sense that is weak, it is not very effective or powerful, or is likely to fail.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是位为人和蔼的医生，但胆小怕事，不敢冒什么风险。
ext.ext_en: He was a nice doctor, but a weak man who wasn't going to stick his neck out...

ext.ext_cn: 你已经习惯性地认为害怕就是软弱。
ext.ext_en: You have been conditioned to believe that it is weak to be scared.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as weak, you mean that they are not very confident or determined, so that they are often frightened or worried, or easily influenced by other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (声音或笑容)微弱的，不热情的，无力的

ext.ext_cn: 他的声音微弱，几乎听不见。
ext.ext_en: His weak voice was almost inaudible...

ext.ext_cn: 他勉强挤出一丝笑容。
ext.ext_en: He managed a weak smile.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's voice or smile as weak, you mean that it is not very loud or big, suggesting that the person lacks confidence, enthusiasm, or physical strength.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不牢固的;易破的;易坏的

ext.ext_cn: 鸟的主人说这只鸟可能是从鸟舍一处不结实的地方逃走的。
ext.ext_en: The owner said the bird may have escaped through a weak spot in the aviary...

ext.ext_cn: 游泳有助于改善骨质疏松和骨骼脆弱。
ext.ext_en: Swimming is helpful for bones that are porous and weak.

defs.def_en: If an object or surface is weak, it breaks easily and cannot support a lot of weight or resist a lot of strain.

ext.ext_cn: 常规液体里分子之间的键合力相对较弱。
ext.ext_en: The molecules in regular liquids are held together by relatively weak bonds...

ext.ext_cn: 潮水小的时候强风可以让船只改变航向。
ext.ext_en: Strong winds can turn boats when the tide is weak.

defs.def_en: A weak physical force does not have much power or intensity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无权力的;无权威的;无影响力的

ext.ext_cn: 市政会手中无权，对此无能为力。
ext.ext_en: The council was too weak to do anything about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他表示自己同弱势和无助群体站在一起。
ext.ext_en: He voiced his solidarity with the weak and defenceless.

defs.def_en: If individuals or groups are weak, they do not have any power or influence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (政府或领导人) 软弱无力的

ext.ext_cn: 随着对政府软弱和优柔寡断的批评愈演愈烈，情况终于有了变化。
ext.ext_en: The changes come after mounting criticism that the government is weak and indecisive...

ext.ext_cn: 首席社论员也把当前的危机归咎于领导层软弱无力。
ext.ext_en: The chief editorial writer also blames weak leadership for the current crisis.

defs.def_en: A weak government or leader does not have much control, and is not prepared or able to act firmly or severely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (货币、经济、产业、政府等)疲软的，有崩溃危险的

ext.ext_cn: 美元疲软意味着美国的产品对外国人来说相对便宜。
ext.ext_en: The weak dollar means American goods are relative bargains for foreigners...

ext.ext_cn: 经济疲软时供货商很难提价。
ext.ext_en: When the economy is weak, it's very hard for suppliers to raise their prices.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such a country's currency, economy, industry, or government as weak, you mean that it is not successful, and may be likely to fail or collapse.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (论据等)不充分的，没有说服力的;(逻辑)不周密的

ext.ext_cn: 你认为公诉人犯了什么错误呢，还是根本就是证据不足？
ext.ext_en: Do you think the prosecution made any particular errors, or did they just have a weak case?...

ext.ext_cn: 这一主张暴露了支撑他论点的论据结构的一个弱点。
ext.ext_en: The claim exposed a weak point in the structure of facts upon which his argument rested...

defs.def_en: If something such as an argument or case is weak, it is not convincing or there is little evidence to support it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一杯淡茶
ext.ext_en: ...a cup of weak tea...

ext.ext_cn: 高度稀释的漂白剂
ext.ext_en: ...a very weak bleach solution.

defs.def_en: A weak drink, chemical, or drug contains very little of a particular substance, for example because a lot of water has been added to it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你很可能会被问到有什么缺点。不要试图声称自己没有任何缺点。
ext.ext_en: You may very well be asked what your weak points are. Don't try to claim you don't have any...

ext.ext_cn: 地理是我的弱项。
ext.ext_en: Geography was my weak subject...

defs.def_en: Your weak points are the qualities or talents you do not possess, or the things you are not very good at.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （下巴）瘦小的;（尤暗指）性格懦弱的

ext.ext_cn: 她相貌平平，性格懦弱。
ext.ext_en: She was a plain-looking woman with a weak chin.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone has a weak chin to indicate that their chin is not large, especially when you want to suggest that they do not have a strong character.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 托尼因为太专注于自己的工作而毫未察觉。
ext.ext_en: Tony didn't notice because he was too engrossed in his work.

defs.def_en: If you are engrossed in something, it holds your attention completely.

defs.def_cn: （以平民利益和主张为诉求的）平民主义，民粹主义

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯民族主义和经济民粹主义的巧妙融合
ext.ext_en: ...an artful blend of Russian nationalism and economic populism.

ext.ext_cn: 平民主义的浪潮
ext.ext_en: ...a wave of populism.

defs.def_en: Populism refers to political activities or ideas that claim to promote the interests and opinions of ordinary people.

defs.def_cn: 移植(植物);(使)(植物)适应异地生长环境

ext.ext_cn: 一个朋友从墨西哥给我寄来一个根茎，我希望能在这儿把它种活。
ext.ext_en: A friend sent me a root from Mexico, and I hope to naturalize it...

ext.ext_cn: 这种植物适应了这个环境，在草中生长得很好。
ext.ext_en: The plant naturalises well in grass.

defs.def_en: To naturalize a species of plant means to start it growing in an area where it is not usually found. If a plant naturalizes in an area where it was not found before, it starts to grow there naturally.

ext.ext_cn: 没人期待波罗的海各国会让年轻的俄罗斯士兵加入其国籍，但领取抚恤金的军人可获得公民身份。
ext.ext_en: No one expects the Baltic states to naturalise young Russian soldiers, but army pensioners can be given citizenship.

defs.def_en: See also:naturalized;If the government of a country naturalizes someone, they allow a person who was not born in that country to become a citizen of it.

ext.ext_cn: 警方说毒贩是暴力活动重新抬头的罪魁祸首。
ext.ext_en: Police say drugs traffickers are behind the resurgence of violence.

ext.ext_cn: 经济复苏时期
ext.ext_en: ...a period of economic resurgence.

defs.def_en: If there is a resurgence of an attitude or activity, it reappears and grows.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 众所周知的;著名的;出名的

ext.ext_cn: 他混迹于有魅力、有学问或有名气的人当中。
ext.ext_en: He surrounds himself with attractive, intelligent, or well-known people...

ext.ext_cn: 当地警察都知道他。
ext.ext_en: He is well-known to the local police...

defs.def_en: A well-known person or thing is known about by a lot of people and is therefore famous or familiar. If someone is well-known for a particular activity, a lot of people know about them because of their involvement with that activity.  →see usage note at:famous

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这可能是人所共知的事实，但我却不知道。
ext.ext_en: It may be a well-known fact, but I didn't know it...

ext.ext_cn: 竹笋是熊猫的主要食物，这是人所共知的。
ext.ext_en: It is well known that bamboo shoots are a panda's staple diet.

defs.def_en: A well-known fact is a fact that is known by people in general.

ext.ext_cn: 交通拥堵问题不会一下子就消失。
ext.ext_en: The problems of traffic congestion will not disappear in a hurry...

ext.ext_cn: 能源消耗、交通堵塞以及污染状况愈加严重。
ext.ext_en: Energy consumption, congestion and pollution have increased.

defs.def_en: If there is congestion in a place, the place is extremely crowded and blocked with traffic or people.

ext.ext_cn: 鼻塞
ext.ext_en: ...nasal congestion.

defs.def_en: Congestion in a part of the body is a medical condition in which the part becomes blocked.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 比竞争对手更新颖的产品
ext.ext_en: ...products which are more innovative than those of their competitors.

defs.def_en: Something that is innovative is new and original.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是他那代人当中最富创造性与革新精神的工程师之一。
ext.ext_en: He was one of the most creative and innovative engineers of his generation.

defs.def_en: An innovative person introduces changes and new ideas.

defs.def_cn: 不充分的;不足的;缺乏的

ext.ext_cn: 他认定证据不充分无法提起刑事诉讼。
ext.ext_en: He decided there was insufficient evidence to justify criminal proceedings...

ext.ext_cn: 这些努力不足以抑制迅速扩散的危机。
ext.ext_en: These efforts were insufficient to contain the burgeoning crisis.

defs.def_en: Something that is insufficient is not large enough in amount or degree for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_en: The current flows into electric motors that drive the wheels.

defs.def_en: If a liquid, gas, or electrical current flows somewhere, it moves there steadily and continuously.

ext.ext_en: Large numbers of refugees continue to flow from the troubled region into the no-man's land...

ext.ext_en: Troops would patrol major roads to ensure that traffic flows freely throughout the country.

defs.def_en: If a number of people or things flow from one place to another, they move there steadily in large groups, usually without stopping.

defs.def_en: See also:cash flow;If information or money flows somewhere, it moves freely between people or organizations.

ext.ext_cn: 那一刻，一股仇恨在我的血液中翻涌。
ext.ext_en: In that moment a surge of hatred flowed through my blood...

ext.ext_en: Waves of emotion flowed across his huge face.

defs.def_en: If an emotion flows through someone, they feel it very intensely, often so that other people notice it.

ext.ext_cn: 他说得更加流利了。
ext.ext_en: His words flowed more readily.

defs.def_en: If someone's words flow, they are spoken smoothly and continuously.

ext.ext_en: ...a long white dress which flowed over her body.

ext.ext_cn: 飘逸的黑色长发
ext.ext_en: ...long black flowing hair.

defs.def_en: If someone's hair or clothing flows about them, it hangs freely and loosely.

ext.ext_en: The square was packed, and the cobbled streets flowed with coloured petals.

defs.def_en: If you say that something flows or that a place flows with it, you are indicating that there is a great deal of that thing in the place.

defs.def_en: Someone who is in full flow is talking easily and continuously and seems likely to go on talking for some time.

defs.def_cn: (活动)如火如荼地进行;(人)全力以赴，充满激情

ext.ext_en: Lunch at Harry's Bar was in full flow when Irene made a splendid entrance...

ext.ext_en: The Everton keeper needed all his courage to thwart a charging Vinny Jones in full flow.

defs.def_en: If you say that an activity, or the person who is performing the activity, is in full flow, you mean that the activity has started and is being carried out with a great deal of energy and enthusiasm.

defs.def_cn: 使迷失方向;使觉得迷惘

ext.ext_en: An overnight stay at a friend's house disorients me...

ext.ext_en: They were disorientated by the smoke and were firing blindly into it.

defs.def_en: If something disorients you, you lose your sense of direction, or you generally feel lost and uncertain, for example because you are in an unfamiliar environment.

ext.ext_cn: 今年消费税的提高

ext.ext_en: New car buyers and smokers will be hit by increases in taxes and excise.

defs.def_en: Excise is a tax that the government of a country puts on particular goods, such as cigarettes and alcoholic drinks, which are produced for sale in its own country.

ext.ext_cn: 消除报纸中涉及种族和性别歧视内容的个人努力

ext.ext_en: ...the question of permanently excising madness from the world.

defs.def_en: If someone excises something, they remove it deliberately and completely.

ext.ext_cn: 他点了一支雪茄，吸了两口。
