ext.ext_cn: 他问我是否准备好了，我给出肯定的回答。
ext.ext_en: He asked me if I was ready. I answered in the affirmative.

defs.def_en: If you reply to a question in the affirmative, you say 'yes' or make a gesture that means 'yes'.
In grammar, an affirmative clause is positive and does not contain a negative word.

ext.ext_cn: 一些银行把开户弄得很麻烦。
ext.ext_en: Some banks make it difficult to open an account...

ext.ext_cn: 我在国民威斯敏斯特银行有两个账户，一个储蓄账户和一个活期存款账户。
ext.ext_en: I had two accounts with Natwest, a savings account and a current account.

defs.def_en: If you have an account with a bank or a similar organization, you have an arrangement to leave your money there and take some out when you need it.

defs.def_cn: 固定客户，老主顾（尤指公司）

ext.ext_cn: 比加特·唐纳德，这家驻格拉斯哥的营销代理公司已赢得了两个爱丁堡的客户。
ext.ext_en: Biggart Donald, the Glasgow-based marketing agency, has won two Edinburgh accounts.

defs.def_en: In business, a regular customer of a company can be referred to as an account, especially when the customer is another company.

ext.ext_cn: 他记明细账。
ext.ext_en: He kept detailed accounts.

ext.ext_cn: 账本
ext.ext_en: ...an account book.

defs.def_en: Accounts are detailed records of all the money that a person or business receives and spends.

defs.def_cn: （书面或口头的）记述，描述，陈述，报告

ext.ext_cn: 他详细描述了那个灾难性夜晚所发生的事。
ext.ext_en: He gave a detailed account of what happened on the fateful night...

ext.ext_cn: 据警方称，亨特夫妇被发现死在家里厨房的地板上。
ext.ext_en: According to police accounts, Mr and Mrs Hunt were found dead on the floor of their kitchen.

defs.def_en: An account is a written or spoken report of something that has happened.

ext.ext_cn: 这个实用的基础模型较为简略地解释了人类的行为。
ext.ext_en: This basic utilitarian model gives a relatively unsophisticated account of human behaviour...

ext.ext_cn: 按照韦伯的说法，科学在本质上是一种价值无涉的活动。
ext.ext_en: Science, on Weber's account, is an essentially value-free activity.

defs.def_en: An account of something is a theory which is intended to explain or describe it.

ext.ext_cn: 不过，开战的首日仍被认为是成功的。
ext.ext_en: The opening day of the battle was, nevertheless, accounted a success.

ext.ext_cn: 其性行为仍然被教会认为是罪孽深重的同性恋者
ext.ext_en: ...homosexuals, whose sexual behaviour is still accounted sinful by the church.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is accounted a particular thing, you are reporting someone's judgment or opinion that it is that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他是位有口皆碑的好老师。
ext.ext_en: He is, by all accounts, a superb teacher.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is true by all accounts or from all accounts, you believe it is true because other people say so.

defs.def_cn: （尽管未必大获全胜但）出色地表现（自己）

ext.ext_cn: 这支队伍奋力拼搏，表现出色。
ext.ext_en: The team fought hard and gave a good account of themselves.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone gave a good account of themselves in a particular situation, you mean that they performed well, although they may not have been completely successful.

ext.ext_cn: 这些名不见经传的团体在国内政界无足轻重。
ext.ext_en: These obscure groups were of little account in national politics.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is of no account or of little account, you mean that it is very unimportant and is not worth considering.

defs.def_cn: 以赊账方式;以分期付款方式

ext.ext_cn: 他挂账买了两瓶伏特加酒。
ext.ext_en: He bought two bottles of vodka on account.

defs.def_en: If you buy or pay for something on account, you pay nothing or only part of the cost at first, and pay the rest later.

ext.ext_cn: 总统因嗓子不适而婉拒了亲自讲话。
ext.ext_en: The President declined to deliver the speech himself, on account of a sore throat...

ext.ext_cn: 看俩人走路时挨得这么近，他觉得他们是新婚夫妇。
ext.ext_en: A newly-married couple, he thought, on account of their walking so close together.

defs.def_en: You use on account of to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

defs.def_cn: 从（某人的）角度；（尤指）设想处于（某人的）情况

ext.ext_cn: 莫莉告诉我她的所作所为，我真是替她感到后怕。
ext.ext_en: Mollie told me what she'd done and I was really scared on her account.

defs.def_en: Your feelings on someone's account are the feelings you have about what they have experienced or might experience, especially when you imagine yourself to be in their situation.

ext.ext_cn: 别因为我就走了。
ext.ext_en: Don't leave on my account.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone not to do something on your account, you mean that they should do it only if they want to, and not because they think it will please you.

ext.ext_cn: 切勿让这种混合物沸腾。
ext.ext_en: On no account should the mixture boil.

defs.def_en: If you say that something should on no account be done, you are emphasizing that it should not be done under any circumstances.

ext.ext_cn: 酒是有放射性的，可是很少有人因此而戒酒。
ext.ext_en: Wine is radioactive but few people stop drinking it on that account.

defs.def_en: You can use on that account or on this account when you want to say that something happens for the reason you have just mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 据他自己所言，他是个雄心勃勃的工作狂。
ext.ext_en: He was by his own account an ambitious workaholic.

defs.def_en: If you say that something concerning a particular person is true by his or her own account, you mean that you believe it because that person has said it is true.

defs.def_cn: 作为个人地；为自身利益地

ext.ext_cn: 她计划自己创业。
ext.ext_en: She had plans to set up in business on her own account.

defs.def_en: If you take part in a business activity on your own account, you do it for yourself, and not as a representative or employee of a company.

defs.def_cn: 自主自愿地;责任自负地

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉他，如果他退出，责任自负。
ext.ext_en: I told him if he withdrew it was on his own account.

defs.def_en: If you do something on your own account, you do it because you want to and without being asked, and you take responsibility for your own action.

defs.def_cn: （与敌人或对手）决战，算账，了结恩怨

ext.ext_cn: 直到德国人最终能和英国人清算旧账的重大日子的来临
ext.ext_en: ...until the great day came when the Germans could finally settle accounts with the British...

ext.ext_cn: 他们经常被黑帮每晚火拼的枪声所吵醒。
ext.ext_en: Their sleep is regularly disturbed by the sound of gunfire as criminal gangs settle their nightly accounts.

defs.def_en: To settle accounts with an enemy or opponent means to bring your fight or quarrel to an end by defeating them.

ext.ext_cn: 被告要求考虑到类似的21起违法行为的情况。
ext.ext_en: The defendant asked for 21 similar offences to be taken into account...

ext.ext_cn: 城市规划人员在实际工作中必须把社会各利益集团都考虑在内。
ext.ext_en: Urban planners in practice have to take account of many interest groups in society.

defs.def_en: If you take something into account, or take account of something, you consider it when you are thinking about a situation or deciding what to do.

defs.def_cn: （对所做的错事）被要求解释并遭斥责，被问责

ext.ext_cn: 部长们应该对他们的行为作出解释。
ext.ext_en: Ministers should be called to account for their actions.

defs.def_en: If someone is called, held, or brought to account for something they have done wrong, they are made to explain why they did it, and are often criticized or punished for it.

ext.ext_cn: 把核桃放在盐水里泡四五天。
ext.ext_en: Soak the walnuts in brine for four or five days.

defs.def_en: Brine is salty water, especially salty water that is used for preserving food.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 直抒己见的;坦率的;坦诚的
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as forthright, you admire them because they show clearly and strongly what they think and feel.

ext.ext_cn: 学校的道德和伦理标准
ext.ext_en: ...the moral and ethical standards in the school.

ext.ext_cn: 围绕患不治之症的人们的医疗、护理和伦理方面的问题
ext.ext_en: ...the medical, nursing and ethical issues surrounding terminally-ill people.

defs.def_en: Ethical means relating to beliefs about right and wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 合乎道德的;合乎伦理规范的

ext.ext_cn: 合乎道德规范的投资计划
ext.ext_en: ...ethical investment schemes...

ext.ext_cn: 该政党认为将税收政策和党内筹资挂钩是合乎道德的做法吗？
ext.ext_en: Does the party think it is ethical to link tax policy with party fund-raising?

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ethical, you mean that it is morally right or morally acceptable.
A magpie is a large black and white bird with a long tail.

defs.def_cn: 爱收集（无价值物品）的人;爱收藏（破烂）的人

ext.ext_cn: 曼迪天生喜欢收集小玩意，只要是她看上的都会收藏起来。
ext.ext_en: A born magpie, Mandy collects any object that catches her eye.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a magpie, you mean that they like collecting and keeping things, often things that have little value.

defs.def_cn: 喜爱的话题;热衷谈论的观点

ext.ext_cn: 诚信是库罗最喜欢谈论的一个话题。
ext.ext_en: Honesty is a favourite hobby-horse for Courau.

defs.def_en: You describe a subject or idea as your hobby-horse if you have strong feelings on it and like talking about it whenever you have the opportunity.
A lightning rod is the same as a lightning conductor .

ext.ext_cn: 他是个争议性人物。
ext.ext_en: He is a lightning rod for controversy.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a lightning rod for something, you mean that they attract that thing to themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 对于这样的建议，他们应该反复考虑再决定是否拒绝。
ext.ext_en: They should think not twice, but thrice, before ignoring such advice...

ext.ext_cn: 她每星期打 3 次网球。
ext.ext_en: She plays tennis thrice weekly.

defs.def_en: Something that happens thrice happens three times.

ext.ext_cn: 这种金属以前的估价是目前价格的两到三倍。
ext.ext_en: The metal had been valued at twice or thrice its current price.

ext.ext_cn: 以 3 倍音速运动
ext.ext_en: ...moving at thrice the speed of sound.

defs.def_en: You can use thrice to indicate that something is three times the size, value, or intensity of something else.
A rooster is an adult male chicken.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他总是不相信女人。
ext.ext_en: He had always been mistrustful of women.

defs.def_en: If you are mistrustful of someone, you do not trust them.
A horseshoe is a piece of metal shaped like a U, which is fixed with nails to the bottom of a horse's foot in order to protect it.

defs.def_cn: (尤指婚礼上用的）马蹄铁吉祥物
defs.def_en: A horseshoe is an object in the shape of a horseshoe which is used as a symbol of good luck, especially at a wedding.

ext.ext_cn: 他的骸骨起初埋葬的地点
ext.ext_en: ...the spot where his bones were originally interred.

defs.def_en: When a dead person is interred, they are buried.

defs.def_cn: 四人组;四个事物的组合

ext.ext_cn: 来自伦敦的四人组合即将在本月推出他们的第四支单曲。
ext.ext_en: The London-based foursome are set to release their fourth single this month.

defs.def_en: A foursome is a group of four people or things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她那柔软飘逸的金发
ext.ext_en: ...her flyaway blond hair.

defs.def_en: Flyaway hair is very soft and fine.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 西欧一些国家的仇外民族主义有所抬头。
ext.ext_en: Xenophobic nationalism is on the rise in some West European countries...

ext.ext_cn: 谈到烹饪，法国人会颇为得意并且极端排斥外国菜。
ext.ext_en: The French are proud and highly xenophobic when it comes to cooking.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as xenophobic, you disapprove of them because they show strong dislike or fear of people from other countries.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如果你的下一张唱片出点问题,你就被遗忘了。
ext.ext_en: If your next record's a bit iffy, you're forgotten...

ext.ext_cn: 他来自一个不怎么好的社区。
ext.ext_en: He was from an iffy neighborhood.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is iffy, you mean that it is not very good in some way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 今年大部分时间他政治生涯的前景似乎都充满变数。
ext.ext_en: His political future has looked iffy for most of this year.

defs.def_en: If something is iffy, it is uncertain.
A clarinet is a musical instrument in the shape of a pipe. You play the clarinet by blowing into it and covering and uncovering the holes with your fingers.

ext.ext_cn: 她竖起眉毛，满含责备。
ext.ext_en: She raised her eyebrows in reproof.

ext.ext_cn: 她立即作出回应的批评言论
ext.ext_en: ...a reproof that she responded to right away.

defs.def_en: If you say or do something in reproof, you say or do it to show that you disapprove of what someone has done or said.

defs.def_cn: 第五纵队队员;内应;间谍
defs.def_en: A fifth columnist is someone who secretly supports and helps the enemies of the country or organization they are in.
A psychoanalyst is someone who treats people who have mental problems using psychoanalysis.
Pine needles are very thin, sharp leaves that grow on pine trees.

ext.ext_cn: 足协拒绝了一切希望它能承诺支持这次运动的请求。
ext.ext_en: The FA has resisted all entreaties to pledge its support to the campaign.

defs.def_en: An entreaty is a very polite, serious request.

defs.def_cn: (只说不做的)清谈会;清谈委员会
defs.def_en: If you say that a conference or a committee is just a talking shop, you disapprove of it because nothing is achieved as a result of what is discussed.

defs.def_cn: (指英国政府专为无法自理的老人或病人提供的)送餐上门服务
defs.def_en: In Britain, meals on wheels is a service provided by the local authority that delivers hot meals to people who are too old or too sick to cook for themselves.
Farthest is a superlative form of far .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 穿过该镇狭窄的街道
ext.ext_en: ...through the town's narrow streets...

ext.ext_cn: 她的双脚瘦长。
ext.ext_en: She had long, narrow feet.

defs.def_en: Something that is narrow measures a very small distance from one side to the other, especially compared to its length or height.

ext.ext_cn: 宽宽的小径在穿过另一条小溪前逐渐收窄。
ext.ext_en: The wide track narrows before crossing another stream.

defs.def_en: If something narrows, it becomes less wide.

ext.ext_cn: 科金斯气得眯起眼睛。“你认为我会告诉你？”
ext.ext_en: Coggins' eyes narrowed angrily. 'You think I'd tell you?'...

ext.ext_cn: 他停下来，眯起眼睛专注地看着。
ext.ext_en: He paused and narrowed his eyes in concentration.

defs.def_en: If your eyes narrow or if you narrow your eyes, you almost close them, for example because you are angry or because you are trying to concentrate on something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (想法、态度或信仰)狭隘的，有局限的

ext.ext_cn: 对家庭生活狭隘过时的看法
ext.ext_en: ...a narrow and outdated view of family life...

ext.ext_cn: 我会更倾向于一个思路开阔些的人，他的想法太狭隘了。
ext.ext_en: I would have preferred somebody who had wider ideas, and he was rather narrow.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's ideas, attitudes, or beliefs as narrow, you disapprove of them because they are restricted in some way, and often ignore the more important aspects of an argument or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 最新的民意测验显示这两大主要政党之间的差距已经缩小了。
ext.ext_en: Most recent opinion polls suggest that the gap between the two main parties has narrowed...

ext.ext_cn: 关于联邦政府在反毒品项目上的支出问题，参议院的谈判代表们进一步缩小了分歧。
ext.ext_en: Senate negotiators further narrowed their differences over the level of federal spending for anti-drug programs.

defs.def_en: If something narrows or if you narrow it, its extent or range becomes smaller.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (胜利)勉强的;(胜负)差距微弱的;险胜的

ext.ext_cn: 代表们投票表决，以微弱多数票赞同考虑选举制度的改革。
ext.ext_en: Delegates have voted by a narrow majority in favour of considering electoral reform.

defs.def_en: If you have a narrow victory, you succeed in winning but only by a small amount.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 分裂主义者袭击他们的车辆时，两名警官死里逃生。
ext.ext_en: Two police officers had a narrow escape when separatists attacked their vehicles.

defs.def_en: If you have a narrow escape, something unpleasant nearly happens to you.
A roaring fire has large flames and is sending out a lot of heat.

ext.ext_cn: 政府首次实行公司私有化的努力获得了巨大的成功。
ext.ext_en: The government's first effort to privatize a company has been a roaring success.

defs.def_en: If something is a roaring success, it is very successful indeed.

defs.def_cn: 做成一笔大买卖;售出大批货物;生意兴隆

ext.ext_cn: 出售非官方纪念品的推销员的生意也很红火。
ext.ext_en: Salesmen of unofficial souvenirs have also been doing a roaring trade.

defs.def_en: If someone does a roaring trade in a type of goods, they sell a lot of them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 房间里的热气和发言人单调的声音让人昏昏欲睡。
ext.ext_en: The warmth of the room and the monotony of the speaker's voice grew soporific.

ext.ext_cn: 酒精的催眠作用
ext.ext_en: ...the soporific effect of the alcohol.

defs.def_en: Something that is soporific makes you feel sleepy.

ext.ext_cn: 一点威士忌
ext.ext_en: ...a dram of whisky...

ext.ext_cn: 少喝一点？
ext.ext_en: Would you care for a dram?

defs.def_en: A dram is a small measure of whisky.

ext.ext_cn: 政府必须加快改革步伐，避免发生更多的流血事件。
ext.ext_en: The government must increase the pace of reforms to avoid further bloodshed.

defs.def_en: Bloodshed is violence in which people are killed or wounded.

defs.def_cn: 使精神抖擞;使精神振奋;使重新充满活力

ext.ext_cn: 这种润肤液凉爽清新，能够焕发肌肤的活力。
ext.ext_en: The lotion cools and refreshes the skin...

ext.ext_cn: 他们曾在一处泉边停歇休息。
ext.ext_en: They had stopped by a spring to refresh themselves.

defs.def_en: If something refreshes you when you have become hot, tired, or thirsty, it makes you feel cooler or more energetic.

ext.ext_cn: 许多人把这些会面看成是交流想法和保持友谊长青的机会。
ext.ext_en: Many view these meetings as an occasion to share ideas and refresh friendship...

ext.ext_cn: 莱蒂出现了，她重新上过妆。
ext.ext_en: Lettie appeared, her make-up refreshed.

defs.def_en: If you refresh something old or dull, you make it as good as it was when it was new.

ext.ext_cn: 让我帮你回忆吧。
ext.ext_en: Allow me to refresh your memory...

ext.ext_cn: 他走在街的对面，努力回忆这座建筑的原貌。
ext.ext_en: He walked on the opposite side of the street to refresh his memory of the building.

defs.def_en: If someone refreshes your memory, they tell you something that you had forgotten.

ext.ext_cn: 点击网页浏览器上的“刷新”按钮来刷新页面，显示最新的版本。
ext.ext_en: Press the 'reload' button on your web browser to refresh the site and get the most current version.

defs.def_en: If you refresh a web page, you click a button in order to get the most recent version of the page.
Petting is when two people kiss and touch each other in a sexual way, but without having sexual intercourse.

defs.def_cn: （儿童可以触摸动物的）爱畜动物园

ext.ext_cn: 纽约公共图书馆附近公园里的爱畜动物园
ext.ext_en: ...a petting zoo in a park adjacent to the New York Public Library.

defs.def_en: A petting zoo or a petting farm is a place with animals which small children can safely stroke or play with.

ext.ext_cn: 只有米米的密友才被允许进入她的闺房。
ext.ext_en: Only Mimi's intimates were admitted to her boudoir.

defs.def_en: A boudoir is a woman's bedroom or private sitting room.

ext.ext_cn: 防护手套可以减少皮肤对化学物质的吸收。
ext.ext_en: Protective gloves reduce the absorption of chemicals through the skin...

ext.ext_cn: 要保存城市古迹必须采取一些维护性措施。
ext.ext_en: Protective measures are necessary if the city's monuments are to be preserved.

defs.def_en: Protective means designed or intended to protect something or someone from harm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对他的母亲呵护备至。
ext.ext_en: He is very protective towards his mother...

ext.ext_cn: 格莉妮丝在她身边，呵护地用胳膊搂住她的肩膀。

defs.def_cn: 令人失望的事；失望；沮丧

ext.ext_cn: 这套公寓真的很不错，但比起我们以往住的地方，那就差太远了。
ext.ext_en: The flat was really very nice, but compared with what we'd been used to, it was a terrible let-down...

ext.ext_cn: 医生们过去对这些疗法过度自信，导致今天的挫败感尤其强烈。
ext.ext_en: The sense of let-down today is all the greater because in the past doctors have been over-confident about these treatments.

defs.def_en: A let-down is a disappointment that you suffer, usually because something has not happened in the way in which you expected it to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 盟军指挥官战术上的无能
ext.ext_en: ...the tactical ineptitude of the allied commander.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's ineptitude, you are criticizing them because they do something with a complete lack of skill.

ext.ext_cn: 葡萄酒或含糖饮料抑制消化。
ext.ext_en: Wine or sugary drinks inhibit digestion...

ext.ext_cn: 借款的高成本抑制了企业对新设备的投资。
ext.ext_en: The high cost of borrowing is inhibiting investment by industry in new equipment.

defs.def_en: If something inhibits an event or process, it prevents it or slows it down.

ext.ext_cn: 那会使穷人得不到他们所需要的医疗保健。
ext.ext_en: It could inhibit the poor from getting the medical care they need...

ext.ext_cn: 官员们将无法履行职责。
ext.ext_en: Officers will be inhibited from doing their duty.

defs.def_en: To inhibit someone from doing something means to prevent them from doing it, although they want to do it or should be able to do it.
In Greek mythology, Hades was a place under the earth where people went after they died.

defs.def_cn: （游乐场或举行室外活动时摆放的）充气城堡
defs.def_en: A bouncy castle is a large object filled with air, often in the shape of a castle, which children play on at a fairground or other outdoor event.

ext.ext_cn: 他把他的名字写在一张纸上交给我。
ext.ext_en: He wrote his name down on a piece of paper for me...

ext.ext_cn: 她拿着纸笔坐在桌旁。
ext.ext_en: She sat at the table with pen and paper.

defs.def_en: Paper is a material that you write on or wrap things with. The pages of this book are made of paper.

ext.ext_cn: 我或许能在村子里找到一份报纸。
ext.ext_en: I might get a paper in the village...

ext.ext_cn: 我做饭，你看报纸。
ext.ext_en: I'll cook and you read the paper.

defs.def_en: A paper is a newspaper.

ext.ext_cn: 报纸上看到的东西不能全信。
ext.ext_en: You can't believe everything you read in the paper...

ext.ext_cn: 报纸上有很多关于继子女所面临的问题的报道。
ext.ext_en: There's been a lot in the papers about the problems facing stepchildren.

defs.def_en: You can refer to newspapers in general as the paper or the papers .

ext.ext_cn: 她的资料包括未发表的文章和信件。
ext.ext_en: Her papers included unpublished articles and correspondence.

defs.def_en: Your papers are sheets of paper with writing or information on them, which you might keep in a safe place at home.

ext.ext_cn: 一位被警察拦下的摩洛哥青年拒绝出示他的证件。
ext.ext_en: A young Moroccan stopped by police refused to show his papers...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经逮捕了4名企图利用伪造证件离境的人。
ext.ext_en: They have arrested four people who were trying to leave the country with forged papers.

defs.def_en: Your papers are official documents, for example your passport or identity card, which prove who you are or which give you official permission to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 他刚刚在《自然》杂志上发表了一篇分析火灾的论文。
ext.ext_en: He just published a paper in the journal Nature analyzing the fires.

defs.def_en: A paper is a long, formal piece of writing about an academic subject.

ext.ext_cn: 学生论文中最常见的10个错误
ext.ext_en: ...the ten common errors that appear most frequently in student papers.

defs.def_en: See also:term paper;A paper is an essay written by a student.

ext.ext_cn: 我们每一场考试都是在大厅里考的。
ext.ext_en: We sat each paper in the Hall...

ext.ext_cn: 她答完了考卷。
ext.ext_en: She finished the exam paper.

defs.def_en: A paper is a part of a written examination in which you answer a number of questions in a particular period of time.

defs.def_cn: （政府或委员会发表的关于重大问题的）文件，报告

ext.ext_cn: 有关欧洲政策的新政府文件
ext.ext_en: ...a new government paper on European policy.

defs.def_en: See also:Green Paper;White Paper;A paper prepared by a government or a committee is a report on a question they have been considering or a set of proposals for changes in the law.

ext.ext_cn: 他们对书面承诺表现出极度的不信任。
ext.ext_en: They expressed deep mistrust of the paper promises...

ext.ext_cn: 我们要找有经验的人，而不是有文凭的人。
ext.ext_en: We're looking for people who have experience rather than paper qualifications.

defs.def_en: Paper agreements, qualifications, or profits are ones that are stated by official documents to exist, although they may not really be effective or useful.

ext.ext_cn: 我们把4个卧室都贴了墙纸。
ext.ext_en: We papered all four bedrooms...

ext.ext_cn: 我们给这个卧室贴上了极柔和的灰色壁纸。
ext.ext_en: We have papered this bedroom in softest grey...

defs.def_en: If you paper a wall, you put wallpaper on it.

ext.ext_cn: 把一些东西写在纸上很重要。
ext.ext_en: It is important to get something down on paper...

ext.ext_cn: 这是我第一次把所有的东西都写在纸上，我觉得这有帮助。
ext.ext_en: It was the first time I had put it all down on paper. I found it helped.

defs.def_en: If you put your thoughts down on paper, you write them down.

ext.ext_cn: 理论上，我是活着的最健康的人，但是我总感觉不舒服。
ext.ext_en: On paper, I am the healthiest man alive, yet I feel permanently unwell.

ext.ext_cn: 据估计，这个家族理论上至少拥有11亿英镑以上的财富。
ext.ext_en: The family is estimated to have been worth, on paper at least, more than £1.1billion.

defs.def_en: If something seems to be the case on paper, it seems to be the case from what you read or hear about it, but it may not really be the case.

If you say that a promise, an agreement, or a guarantee is not worth the paper it's written on, you mean that although it has been written down and seems to be official, it is in fact worthless because what has been promised will not be done.

ext.ext_cn: 他当然不能穿这么滑稽的衣服上班。
ext.ext_en: Naturally he couldn't work in this get-up.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a set of clothes as a get-up, you think that they are unusual or ridiculous.

ext.ext_cn: 伯明翰现在又要重新建设了。
ext.ext_en: Birmingham is now going to be redeveloped again.

defs.def_en: When an area is redeveloped, existing buildings and roads are removed and new ones are built in their place.
If you describe someone as a Celt, you mean that they are part of the racial group which comes from Scotland, Wales, Ireland, and some other areas such as Brittany.

defs.def_cn: 没有污点的；无瑕疵的；清白的

ext.ext_cn: 加纳在人权方面并非毫无瑕疵。
ext.ext_en: Ghana does not have an unblemished record on human rights.

ext.ext_cn: 李为人诚实、坚持原则的清白名誉
ext.ext_en: ...Lee's unblemished reputation as a man of honor and principle.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as someone's record, reputation, or character as unblemished, you mean it has not been harmed or spoiled.

defs.def_cn: 无斑痕的；无瑕疵的；完好无损的

ext.ext_cn: 一定要选坚实、无疤痕的果子。
ext.ext_en: Be sure to select firm, unblemished fruit.

ext.ext_cn: 皑皑白雪覆盖着的一片旷野
ext.ext_en: ...an open field of unblemished snow.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unblemished, you mean that it has no marks or holes on its surface.

ext.ext_cn: 加拿大将从今年晚些时候起在办公场所全面禁烟。
ext.ext_en: Canada will ban smoking in all offices later this year.

ext.ext_cn: 去年武器遭禁售。
ext.ext_en: Last year arms sales were banned.

defs.def_en: To ban something means to state officially that it must not be done, shown, or used.

ext.ext_cn: 将军同时取消了对政党的禁令。
ext.ext_en: The General also lifted a ban on political parties.

defs.def_en: A ban is an official ruling that something must not be done, shown, or used.

ext.ext_cn: 他被吊扣驾照3年。
ext.ext_en: He was banned from driving for three years.

defs.def_en: If you are banned from doing something, you are officially prevented from doing it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 全速驾驶一辆价格不菲的高性能汽车的兴奋感
ext.ext_en: ...the thrill of taking an expensive high-performance car to its limits.

ext.ext_cn: 高性能计算机
ext.ext_en: ...high-performance computers.

defs.def_en: A high-performance car or other product goes very fast or does a lot.
A watercourse is a stream or river, or the channel that it flows along.

ext.ext_cn: 圣克里斯托教堂坐落在一个山坡上。
ext.ext_en: Saint-Christo is perched on a mountain slope.

ext.ext_cn: 喜马拉雅山脉较低处的山坡
ext.ext_en: ...the lower slopes of the Himalayas.

defs.def_en: A slope is the side of a mountain, hill, or valley.

ext.ext_cn: 这条街一定是建在一个斜坡上。
ext.ext_en: The street must have been on a slope.

defs.def_en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

ext.ext_cn: 河岸到河面的斜坡非常陡。
ext.ext_en: The bank sloped down sharply to the river...

ext.ext_cn: 花园的斜坡颇为陡峭。
ext.ext_en: The garden sloped quite steeply.

defs.def_en: If a surface slopes, it is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

ext.ext_cn: 笔迹朝右倾斜。
ext.ext_en: The writing sloped backwards...

ext.ext_cn: 他不明白为什么他的计算器上面的数字向右倾斜。
ext.ext_en: He wonders why the digits on his calculator slope to the right.

defs.def_en: If something slopes, it leans to the right or to the left rather than being upright.

ext.ext_cn: 上了弯道以后，路越来越陡。
ext.ext_en: The slope increases as you go up the curve.

ext.ext_cn: 一段坡度为 10° 的斜坡
ext.ext_en: ...a slope of ten degrees.

defs.def_en: The slope of something is the angle at which it slopes.

ext.ext_cn: 星期六下午，她脚底抹油，溜之大吉。
ext.ext_en: She sloped off quietly on Saturday afternoon...

ext.ext_cn: 凌晨 6 点，他们悄悄地潜入他们下榻的饭店。
ext.ext_en: They sloped into their hotel at 6am.

defs.def_en: If someone slopes into or out of a place, they enter or leave it quickly and quietly, especially because they are trying to avoid or escape something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽坐在伊莱恩身边，伊莱恩今天似乎有些激动。
ext.ext_en: Mary sat beside Elaine, who today seemed excitable...

ext.ext_cn: 那个情绪激动的男人让职员们感到有些恐慌。
ext.ext_en: The staff were somewhat alarmed by the man, who was in an excitable state.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as excitable, you mean that they behave in a rather nervous way and become excited very easily.
Juvenile delinquency is destruction of property and other criminal behaviour that is committed by young people who are not old enough to be legally considered as adults.
The Customs Service is a United States federal organization which is responsible for collecting taxes on imported and exported goods.

defs.def_cn: （人或事物）小资产阶级的，属于小资产阶级的

ext.ext_cn: 他有小资产阶级思想。
ext.ext_en: He had a petit bourgeois mentality.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is petit bourgeois belongs or relates to the lower middle class.

ext.ext_cn: 加拿大的遗传学家已经发现了解开细胞衰老、死亡之谜的线索。
ext.ext_en: Geneticists in Canada have discovered a clue to the puzzle of why our cells get old and die...

ext.ext_cn: 男人刮胡子的方式也许能泄露其年龄。
ext.ext_en: How a man shaves may be a telling clue to his age.

defs.def_en: A clue to a problem or mystery is something that helps you to find the answer to it.

ext.ext_cn: 查明杀手身份的重要线索是他的外号叫“花生”。
ext.ext_en: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.

defs.def_en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps someone solve a crime.

defs.def_cn: (纵横填字游戏的)提示语，解答提示
defs.def_en: A clue in a crossword or game is information which is given to help you to find the answer to a question.

ext.ext_cn: 我不知道明年卡尔过生日我该送什么。
ext.ext_en: I haven't a clue what I'll give Carl for his birthday next year.

defs.def_en: If you haven't a clue about something, you do not know anything about it or you have no idea what to do about it.

ext.ext_cn: 黑市价格为 200 万英镑的可卡因
ext.ext_en: ...cocaine with a street value of two million pounds.

defs.def_en: The street value of a drug is the price that is paid for it when it is sold illegally to drug users.
See also:gall bladder;Your bladder is the part of your body where urine is stored until it leaves your body.

ext.ext_cn: 黑格和罗伯逊把它看作是一个疯癫政治家的胡言乱语。
ext.ext_en: Haig and Robertson saw it as the lunatic ravings of a mad politician.

defs.def_en: If you describe what someone says or writes as their ravings, you mean that it makes no sense because they are mad or very ill.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对不起，失言了。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry. That was uncalled for.

ext.ext_cn: 利奥关于她表姐的一些不当言辞
ext.ext_en: ...Leo's uncalled-for remarks about her cousin.

defs.def_en: If you describe a remark or criticism as uncalled for, you mean that it should not have been made, because it was unkind or unfair.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是一个极好的伴侣，她对我慷慨大方，一心只为我着想。
ext.ext_en: She was a wonderful companion and her generosity to me was entirely selfless...

ext.ext_cn: 或许唯一持久无私的爱就是母爱。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps the only all-enduring and selfless love was that of a mother for her child.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is selfless, you approve of them because they care about other people more than themselves.

defs.def_cn: （攻击）非因触犯而发生的，无缘无故的
defs.def_en: If someone makes an unprovoked attack, they attack someone who has not tried to harm them in any way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （体育活动）剧烈的，强度大的，强劲的

ext.ext_cn: 运动太过剧烈会增大心脏病发作的风险。
ext.ext_en: Very vigorous exercise can increase the risk of heart attacks...

ext.ext_cn: 非洲舞蹈强劲奔放，但又处处透着细腻。
ext.ext_en: African dance is vigorous, but full of subtlety.

defs.def_en: Vigorous physical activities involve using a lot of energy, usually to do short and repeated actions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯特爵士是位坚定而又活跃的政治家。
ext.ext_en: Sir Robert was a strong and vigorous politician.

ext.ext_cn: 言辞最为激烈的政府批评家们
ext.ext_en: ...the most vigorous critics of the government...

defs.def_en: A vigorous person does things with great energy and enthusiasm. A vigorous campaign or activity is done with great energy and enthusiasm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 精力旺盛的;充满活力的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个精力充沛、年轻帅气的小伙子。
ext.ext_en: He was a vigorous, handsome young man.

defs.def_en: A vigorous person is strong and healthy and full of energy.

ext.ext_cn: 我的视力在下降，看不了书了。
ext.ext_en: My sight is failing, and I can't see to read any more...

ext.ext_cn: 我用听觉比视觉要多得多。
ext.ext_en: I use the sense of sound much more than the sense of sight.

defs.def_en: Someone's sight is their ability to see.

ext.ext_cn: 我一见到血就晕。
ext.ext_en: I faint at the sight of blood...

ext.ext_cn: 见到他进入房间会让她心中欲望澎湃。
ext.ext_en: The sight of him entering a room could flood her with desire.

defs.def_en: The sight of something is the act of seeing it or an occasion on which you see it.

ext.ext_cn: 街边晾晒衣服在这座城市的许多地区随处可见。
ext.ext_en: The practice of hanging clothes across the street is a common sight in many parts of the city...

ext.ext_cn: 我们目睹了一家人正在收拾家当准备离开的凄惨景象。
ext.ext_en: We encountered the pathetic sight of a family packing up its home...

defs.def_en: A sight is something that you see.

ext.ext_cn: 安全部队突然看见一群越过边境的年轻人。
ext.ext_en: The security forces sighted a group of young men that had crossed the border...

ext.ext_cn: 在北海突然发现了一支法国船队。
ext.ext_en: A fleet of French ships was sighted in the North Sea.

defs.def_en: If you sight someone or something, you suddenly see them, often briefly.
The sights of a weapon such as a rifle are the part which helps you aim it more accurately.

ext.ext_cn: 我们游览了巴黎的风景名胜。
ext.ext_en: We'd toured the sights of Paris...

ext.ext_cn: 我会带你浏览我们这座美丽城市的风景名胜。
ext.ext_en: I am going to show you the sights of our wonderful city...

defs.def_en: The sights are the places that are interesting to see and that are often visited by tourists.

ext.ext_cn: 与大多数女儿相比，她并不算太难管，而且比我知道的一些要乖巧得多。
ext.ext_en: She's been no more difficult than most daughters and a sight better than some I could mention...

ext.ext_cn: 我们正在做的事和我们一直在做的别无二致，只不过我们现在动作要快得多。
ext.ext_en: We weren't doing anything different to what we've always done. We're just doing it a damn sight quicker.

defs.def_en: You can use a sight to mean a lot. For example, if you say that something is a sight worse than it was before, you are emphasizing that it is much worse than it was.

ext.ext_cn: 然后他突然在人群中看见了她那顶小巧的黑色天鹅绒帽子。
ext.ext_en: Then he caught sight of her small black velvet hat in the crowd...

ext.ext_cn: 每次我瞥见镜子里的自己就觉得沮丧。
ext.ext_en: Every time I catch sight of myself in the mirror, I feel so disappointed.

defs.def_en: If you catch sight of someone, you suddenly see them, often briefly.

defs.def_cn: 乍一看;一见之下;初看时

ext.ext_cn: 那项任务可能比乍看之下还要困难。
ext.ext_en: It promised to be a more difficult undertaking than might appear at first sight...

ext.ext_cn: 乍一看，它就像个传统的村庄：带阳台的两层楼房坐落于精心照料的花园中。
ext.ext_en: At first sight it resembles a traditional village of two-storeyed, balconied houses, set among well-tended gardens.

defs.def_en: If you say that something seems to have certain characteristics at first sight, you mean that it appears to have the features you describe when you first see it but later it is found to be different.

ext.ext_cn: 沙滩映入眼帘。
ext.ext_en: The sandy beach was in sight...

ext.ext_cn: 从宾馆可以看见大西洋海岸。
ext.ext_en: The Atlantic coast is within sight of the hotel...

defs.def_en: If something is in sight or within sight, you can see it. If it is out of sight, you cannot see it.

defs.def_cn: 在望;在即;临近;即将产生

ext.ext_cn: 一项涉及到贸易政策诸多方面的协议即将达成。
ext.ext_en: An agreement on many aspects of trade policy was in sight...

ext.ext_cn: 权力的争斗近期不会终止。
ext.ext_en: There is no end in sight to the struggle for power...

defs.def_en: If a result or a decision is in sight or within sight, it is likely to happen within a short time.

ext.ext_cn: 某些情况下，美国工业在产品设计上忽略了客户的需求。
ext.ext_en: In some cases, US industry has lost sight of customer needs in designing products...

ext.ext_cn: 教育本身就很重要，我们不应忽视这一事实。
ext.ext_en: We shouldn't lose sight of the fact that education is important for its own sake.

defs.def_en: If you lose sight of an important aspect of something, you no longer pay attention to it because you are worrying about less important things.

ext.ext_cn: 我和他有过几面之缘，但从未说过话。
ext.ext_en: I knew him by sight but had never spoken with him.

defs.def_en: If you know someone by sight, you can recognize them when you see them, although you have never met them and talked to them.

ext.ext_cn: 穷人的问题人们大多看不见——正所谓“眼不见，心不烦”。
ext.ext_en: The problems of the poor are largely invisible—out of sight, out of mind.

defs.def_en: If you say 'out of sight, out of mind', you mean that people quickly forget someone if he or she goes away.

ext.ext_cn: 部队士兵一见到任何可疑的人马上就开枪。
ext.ext_en: Troops shot anyone suspicious on sight...

ext.ext_cn: 马吉被释放了，但是英国当局却被要求一见到他就立即逮捕。
ext.ext_en: Magee was set free but British authorities were asked to arrest him on sight.

defs.def_en: If someone is ordered to do something on sight, they have to do it without delay, as soon as a person or thing is seen.

defs.def_cn: 不好看;不雅观;有碍观瞻

ext.ext_cn: 浴室破旧不堪。墙纸剥落了，瓷砖也裂了。
ext.ext_en: The bathroom is not a pretty sight. The wallpaper's peeling, the tiles are crumbling.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is not a pretty sight, you mean that it is not pleasant to look at.

defs.def_cn: 以…为奋斗目标;志在必得;决心做到

ext.ext_cn: 他们的目标是冲击世界纪录。

defs.def_cn: 传统主义的;因循守旧的

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as a thorn in your side or a thorn in your flesh, you mean that they are a continuous problem to you or annoy you.

ext.ext_cn: 卖花人

defs.def_en: See also:best seller;If you describe a product as, for example, a big seller, you mean that large numbers of it are being sold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The legal aid system should be accessible to more people...

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
