ext.ext_en: My family home is in York-shire and they don't want to move...

ext.ext_cn: 她过去常想搬到伦敦去住。
ext.ext_en: She had often considered moving to London...

defs.def_en: If a person or company moves, they leave the building where they have been living or working, and they go to live or work in a different place, taking their possessions with  them.

ext.ext_cn: 上级把他派往另一个教区。
ext.ext_en: His superiors moved him to another parish...

ext.ext_cn: 克拉克女士仍然在位，没有要调动她的计划。
ext.ext_en: Ms Clark is still in position and there are no plans to move her...

defs.def_en: If people in authority move someone, they make that person go from one place or job to another one.

ext.ext_cn: 他原先是一名校外辅导老师，后调入学校讲授社会史。
ext.ext_en: He moved from being an extramural tutor to being a lecturer in social history...

ext.ext_cn: 起初克里斯蒂娜更换不同的工作来积累经验。
ext.ext_en: In the early days Christina moved jobs to get experience.

defs.def_en: If you move from one job or interest to another, you change to it.

defs.def_cn: 改变(谈话内容);转到（新的话题）

ext.ext_cn: 丹，我们换个话题吧。
ext.ext_en: Let's move to another subject, Dan.

defs.def_en: If you move to a new topic in a conversation, you start talking about something different.

ext.ext_cn: 俱乐部把会议日期改到1月22号，星期六。
ext.ext_en: The club has moved its meeting to Saturday, January 22nd...

ext.ext_cn: 乐队已把去利兹的日期提前至10月27号。
ext.ext_en: The band have moved forward their Leeds date to October 27.

defs.def_en: If you move an event or the date of an event, you change the time at which  it happens.

ext.ext_cn: 工党已右倾化了，变得像你们民主党。
ext.ext_en: The Labour Party has moved to the right and become like your Democrat Party...

ext.ext_cn: 已有可能朝着消除核武器的目标努力。
ext.ext_en: It is already possible to start moving toward the elimination of nuclear weapons...

defs.def_en: If you move towards a particular state, activity, or opinion, you start to be in that state, do that activity, or have that opinion.

ext.ext_cn: 事件进展迅速。
ext.ext_en: Events are moving fast...

ext.ext_cn: 应该有人牵头把事情做起来。
ext.ext_en: Someone has got to get things moving.

defs.def_en: If a situation or process is moving, it is developing or progressing, rather than staying still.

ext.ext_cn: 大家都认为我回去是很不明智的，但我不会动摇。
ext.ext_en: Everyone thought I was mad to go back, but I wouldn't be moved.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will not be moved, you mean that you have come to a decision and nothing will change your mind.

ext.ext_cn: 最初是朋克摇滚乐促使他正式加入了乐队。
ext.ext_en: It was punk that first moved him to join a band seriously...

ext.ext_cn: 听证会促使总统想出了这些建议。
ext.ext_en: The president was moved to come up with these suggestions after the hearings.

defs.def_en: If something moves you to do something, it influences you and causes you to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些故事让我吃惊，也让我感动。
ext.ext_en: These stories surprised and moved me...

ext.ext_cn: 他的祈祷把我感动得热泪盈眶。
ext.ext_en: His prayer moved me to tears.

defs.def_en: If something moves you, it has an effect on your emotions and causes you to feel sadness or sympathy for another person.

defs.def_cn: 活跃，出入，涉足(于某团体、领域或圈子)

ext.ext_cn: 她时常出入伦敦的上流社会。
ext.ext_en: She moves in high-society circles in London...

ext.ext_cn: 他们出没在一个对种族主义者的敌视习以为常的世界里。
ext.ext_en: They moved in a world where hostility to racists was natural.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone moves in a particular society, circle, or world, you mean that they know people in a particular social class or group and spend most of their time with them.

ext.ext_cn: 工党很快提出终止辩论的动议。
ext.ext_en: Labour quickly moved a closure motion to end the debate...

ext.ext_cn: 我提议对该案不予受理。
ext.ext_en: I move that the case be dismissed.

defs.def_en: At a meeting, if you move a motion, you formally suggest it so that everyone present can vote on it.

ext.ext_cn: 我举着棋子，不知下一步该怎么走。
ext.ext_en: With no idea of what to do for my next move, my hand hovered over the board.

defs.def_en: A move is an act of putting a chess piece or other counter in a different position on a board when it is your turn to do so in a game.

ext.ext_cn: 他明白稍有差池就会被置于死地。
ext.ext_en: He knew one false move would end in death.

defs.def_en: If you say that one false move will cause a disaster, you mean that you or someone else must not make any mistakes because the situation is so difficult or dangerous.
If you tell someone to get a move on, you are telling them to hurry.

ext.ext_cn: 他看一眼手表说：“我想我们最好动身吧。”
ext.ext_en: He glanced at his wristwatch. 'I suppose we'd better make a move.'

ext.ext_cn: 他起身离开。
ext.ext_en: He made a move to leave.

defs.def_en: If you make a move, you prepare or begin to leave one place and go somewhere else.

ext.ext_cn: 在预定交易就要结束的前一周，15家日本银行采取行动撤离。
ext.ext_en: The week before the deal was supposed to close, fifteen Japanese banks made a move to pull out...

ext.ext_cn: 别等别人先主动，要先邀请朋友到家来。
ext.ext_en: Don't wait for others to make the first move: invite friends to visit you.

defs.def_en: If you make a move, you take a course of action.

ext.ext_cn: 杰克从不想在一个地方呆太久，所以他们总在奔波辗转。
ext.ext_en: Jack never wanted to stay in one place for very long, so they were always on the move.

defs.def_en: If you are on the move, you are going from one place to another.
An imprecation is something rude, angry, or hostile that is said to or about someone.
Hyperinflation is very severe inflation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她很健谈。
ext.ext_en: She's quite a chatty person.

defs.def_en: Someone who is chatty talks a lot in a friendly, informal way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (写作或说话)随意的，闲谈似的

ext.ext_cn: 他给妻子写了封闲话家常的信。
ext.ext_en: He wrote a chatty letter to his wife.

defs.def_en: A chatty style of writing or talking is friendly and informal.

ext.ext_cn: 他成了英国国民保健制度下所谓追查报复检举者行动的典型牺牲品。
ext.ext_en: He has been a prominent victim of alleged witch-hunts against whistle-blowers in the NHS.

defs.def_en: A whistle-blower is someone who finds out that the organization they are working for is doing something immoral or illegal and tells the authorities or the public about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他把这些政权称作专制与独裁政府。
ext.ext_en: He described these regimes as tyrannies and dictatorships…

ext.ext_cn: 自我表现与追求个性是反抗暴政的最佳武器。
ext.ext_en: Self-expression and individuality are the greatest weapons against tyranny.

defs.def_en: A tyranny is a cruel, harsh, and unfair government in which a person or small group of people have power over everyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 我是唯一受母亲严加管制的人。
ext.ext_en: I'm the sole victim of Mother's tyranny.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour and treatment of others that they have authority over as tyranny, you mean that they are severe with them or unfair to them.

defs.def_cn: (不中意或令人不快的)必需品

ext.ext_cn: 电话是现代生活中让人最反感的必需品之一。
ext.ext_en: The telephone is one of the great tyrannies of modern life.

defs.def_en: You can describe something that you have to use or have as a tyranny if you think it is undesirable or unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 那两个国家间的紧张局面可能会持续下去。
ext.ext_en: The tension between the two countries is likely to remain...

ext.ext_cn: 示威者遇害后的持续紧张局势
ext.ext_en: ...continued tension over the killing of demonstrators...

defs.def_en: Tension is the feeling that is produced in a situation when people are anxious and do not trust each other, and when there is a possibility of sudden violence or conflict.

ext.ext_cn: 她尽力保持镇定，可还是由于紧张、犹豫不决而抖个不停。
ext.ext_en: She has done her best to keep calm but finds herself trembling with tension and indecision...

ext.ext_cn: 事实证明，微笑和大笑能够缓解焦虑和压力。
ext.ext_en: Smiling and laughing has actually been shown to relieve tension and stress.

defs.def_en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax.

defs.def_cn: (势力、观点、影响之间的)冲突，分歧

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影探讨了公共义务和个人情感之间的冲突。
ext.ext_en: The film explored the tension between public duty and personal affections.

defs.def_en: If there is a tension between forces, arguments, or influences, there are differences between them that cause difficulties.
The tension in something such as a rope or wire is the extent to which it is stretched tight.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如果因为法律规定的时速是70英里我就说自己的车速是这么高，那就是虚伪了。
ext.ext_en: It would be hypocritical to say I travel at 70mph simply because that is the law...

ext.ext_cn: 如果有人虚伪矫饰，那就应该暴露他的真面目。
ext.ext_en: If someone is being hypocritical then it is fair to expose that.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of being hypocritical, you mean that they pretend to have qualities, beliefs, or feelings that they do not really have.

defs.def_cn: (问题、任务或困难)降临，使面临

ext.ext_cn: 她面临严峻的资金问题。
ext.ext_en: She was confronted with severe money problems...

ext.ext_cn: 部长们低估了他们所面临的任务的艰巨性。
ext.ext_en: Ministers underestimated the magnitude of the task confronting them.

defs.def_en: If you are confronted with a problem, task, or difficulty, you have to deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们正在学习如何直面死亡。
ext.ext_en: We are learning how to confront death...

ext.ext_cn: 北约国家被迫正视基本的道德问题。
ext.ext_en: NATO countries have been forced to confront fundamental moral questions.

defs.def_en: If you confront a difficult situation or issue, you accept the fact that it exists and try to deal with it.

defs.def_cn: 使面对(有威胁性或困难的事)

ext.ext_cn: 我面对的是一大堆旋钮、控制杆和开关。
ext.ext_en: I was confronted with an array of knobs, levers, and switches.

defs.def_en: If you are confronted by something that you find threatening or difficult to deal with, it is there in front of you.

ext.ext_cn: 她挤过骚动的人群，与他当面对峙。
ext.ext_en: She pushed her way through the mob and confronted him face to face...

ext.ext_cn: 他们遭遇警察时毫不犹豫地开火。
ext.ext_en: They don't hesitate to open fire when confronted by police...

defs.def_en: If you confront someone, you stand or sit in front of them, especially when you are going to fight, argue, or compete with them.

ext.ext_cn: 她决定拿自己了解的事实与凯瑟琳当面对证。
ext.ext_en: She had decided to confront Kathryn with what she had learnt...

ext.ext_cn: 我不忍心就这事和他对质。
ext.ext_en: I could not bring myself to confront him about it...

defs.def_en: If you confront someone with something, you present facts or evidence to them in order to accuse them of something.

ext.ext_cn: 斋戒、补赎和朝圣的时代
ext.ext_en: ...a time of fasting, penance and pilgrimage...

ext.ext_cn: 《古兰经》劝告人们在朝圣前斋戒，以作为一种补赎。
ext.ext_en: The Koran recommends fasting as a penance before pilgrimages.

defs.def_en: If you do penance for something wrong that you have done, you do something that you find unpleasant to show that you are sorry.

ext.ext_cn: 这一冲突实际上很有可能演变成国际化问题。
ext.ext_en: A very real danger exists of the conflict becoming internationalised...

ext.ext_cn: 他们一直想使克什米尔问题国际化。
ext.ext_en: They have been trying to internationalise the Kashmir problem.

defs.def_en: If an issue or a crisis is internationalized, it becomes the concern of many nations throughout the world.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 疯疯癫癫的;半痴的;古怪的

ext.ext_cn: 她显然变得有点疯疯癫癫的了。
ext.ext_en: She was obviously going a bit dotty.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is dotty, you mean that they are slightly mad or likely to do strange things.

defs.def_cn: 抢先行动；预先制止；先发制人

ext.ext_cn: 刚出现征兆时，就服用止痛片来预防疼痛。
ext.ext_en: You can pre-empt pain by taking a painkiller at the first warning sign...

ext.ext_cn: 他预先阻止了所有解雇他的决定。
ext.ext_en: He pre-empted any decision to sack him...

defs.def_en: If you pre-empt an action, you prevent it from happening by doing something which makes it unnecessary or impossible.

ext.ext_cn: 爱德华七世时代
ext.ext_en: ...the Edwardian era.

ext.ext_cn: 他的爱德华七世时代建造的古老办公室
ext.ext_en: ...his old Edwardian office.

defs.def_en: Edwardian means belonging to, connected with, or typical of Britain in the first decade of the 20th century, when Edward VII was King.

ext.ext_cn: 音乐只是增强了她话语的力度。
ext.ext_en: Music is merely an enhancement to the power of her words...

ext.ext_cn: 他关心人类生存环境的改善。
ext.ext_en: He was concerned with the enhancement of the human condition.

defs.def_en: The enhancement of something is the improvement of it in relation to its value, quality, or attractiveness.

ext.ext_cn: 船停靠这个主要港口以装载其常规货物——香蕉。
ext.ext_en: The boat calls at the main port to load its regular cargo of bananas.

ext.ext_cn: 货运飞机
ext.ext_en: ...cargo planes.

defs.def_en: The cargo of a ship or plane is the goods that it is carrying.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 期待这场演讲能结束战争的希望很快便破灭了。
ext.ext_en: Any hope that the speech would end the war was short-lived...

ext.ext_cn: 尚塔尔跟马丁内谈起她短暂的婚姻。
ext.ext_en: Chantal told Martine about her short-lived marriage.

defs.def_en: Something that is short-lived does not last very long.

defs.def_cn: 清算之时;报应到来的日子

ext.ext_cn: 跟自来水公司的主管们算账的日子就要到来了。
ext.ext_en: The day of reckoning is coming for the water company directors.

defs.def_en: If someone talks about the day of reckoning, they mean a day or time in the future when people will be forced to deal with an unpleasant situation which they have avoided until now.

defs.def_cn: (在英国购房时缴纳的)印花税
defs.def_en: In Britain, stamp duty is a tax that you pay to the government when you buy a house.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在新的联邦政府体制中，6 省中的 5 个将成为自治区。
ext.ext_en: Five of the six provinces are to become autonomous regions in a new federal system of government.

defs.def_en: A federal country or system of government is one in which the different states or provinces of the country have important powers to make their own laws and decisions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 中央集权式的;集权式联邦制的

ext.ext_cn: 他认为一个集权式联邦制在欧洲是不可行的。
ext.ext_en: He does not believe in a federal Europe with centralising powers.

defs.def_en: Some people use federal to describe a system of government which they disapprove of, in which the different states or provinces are controlled by a strong central government.

defs.def_cn: 归属联邦政府的;与联邦政府有关的

ext.ext_cn: 联邦政府仅掌控 6％的教育预算。
ext.ext_en: The federal government controls just 6% of the education budget.

ext.ext_cn: 联邦法官
ext.ext_en: ...a federal judge.

defs.def_en: Federal also means belonging or relating to the national government of a federal country rather than to one of the states within it.
Federals are the same as feds .
A zephyr is a gentle wind.

defs.def_cn: （精神病院的）软壁病房；（监狱的）软壁囚室
defs.def_en: A padded cell is a small room with padded walls in a mental hospital or prison, where a person who may behave violently can be put so that they do not hurt themselves.
Ascorbic acid is another name for vitamin C.

ext.ext_cn: 现任总统当选之后，政治暴力进入了一段暂时的平静期。
ext.ext_en: There was a lull in political violence after the election of the current president.

ext.ext_cn: 谈话中的一时沉寂
ext.ext_en: ...a lull in the conversation.

defs.def_en: A lull is a period of quiet or calm in a longer period of activity or excitement.

ext.ext_cn: 很容易就会被麻痹，进而产生一种虚假的安全感。
ext.ext_en: It is easy to be lulled into a false sense of security...

ext.ext_cn: 我错误地相信了媒体的报道只是小事一桩。
ext.ext_en: I had been lulled into thinking the publicity would be a trivial matter...

defs.def_en: If you are lulled into feeling safe, someone or something causes you to feel safe at a time when you are not safe.

ext.ext_cn: 半掩的百叶窗和宁静、通风的高大房间催我入睡，我很快便打起盹来。
ext.ext_en: With the shutters half-closed and the calm airy height of the room to lull me, I soon fell into a doze...

ext.ext_cn: 车轮呼呼地转着，他不一会儿便打起瞌睡来。
ext.ext_en: The swish of the tyres lulled him into a light doze...

defs.def_en: If someone or something lulls you, they cause you to feel calm or sleepy.
If you describe a situation as the lull before the storm, you mean that although it is calm now, there is going to be trouble in the future.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对他的客人们非常关切。
ext.ext_en: He was so solicitous of his guests.

defs.def_en: A person who is solicitous shows anxious concern for someone or something.
If there is a problem of overmanning in an industry, there are more people working there or doing the work than is necessary.
Lychees are Chinese fruit which have white flesh and large stones inside and a pinkish-brown skin.
Categoric means the same as categorical .
Phenomenology is a branch of philosophy which deals with consciousness, thought, and experience.

defs.def_cn: 尖酸刻薄的话；恶意中伤

ext.ext_cn: 他动辄便揶揄挖苦一番——这个人不上档次。
ext.ext_en: He always throws out the tacky comment and the cheap shot. He has no class.

defs.def_en: A cheap shot is a comment someone makes which you think is unfair or unkind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 值得怜悯（或同情）的；可怜的

ext.ext_cn: 祖母在她看来是个可怜的人。
ext.ext_en: Her grandmother seemed to her a pitiable figure.

defs.def_en: Someone who is pitiable is in such a sad or weak state that you feel pity for them.

defs.def_cn: 使震惊;使目瞪口呆;使惊愕

ext.ext_cn: 许多来看电影的人都被这部影片暴力而悲惨的结局所震惊。
ext.ext_en: Many cinema-goers were stunned by the film's violent and tragic end.

defs.def_en: If you are stunned by something, you are extremely shocked or surprised by it and are therefore unable to speak or do anything.

ext.ext_cn: 萨姆站在原地，被一下打昏了。
ext.ext_en: Sam stood his ground and got a blow that stunned him.

defs.def_en: If something such as a blow on the head stuns you, it makes you unconscious or confused and unsteady.

ext.ext_cn: 他会为昨天公布的电话民意调查结果感到鼓舞。
ext.ext_en: He will have been heartened by the telephone opinion poll published yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 该消息让每个人都感到振奋。
ext.ext_en: The news heartened everybody.

defs.def_en: If someone is heartened by something, it encourages them and makes them cheerful.

defs.def_cn: (常由过量饮酒引起的)肝硬化
defs.def_en: Cirrhosis or cirrhosis of the liver is a disease which destroys a person's liver and which can kill them. It is often caused by drinking too much alcohol.

defs.def_cn: （使）(身体)剧烈抖动;(使)抽搐;(使)痉挛

ext.ext_cn: 奥利维娅的脸上一阵抽搐。
ext.ext_en: Olivia's face convulsed in a series of twitches...

ext.ext_cn: 他大叫一声，高大的身躯剧烈地抖了一下，手臂也突然一哆嗦。
ext.ext_en: He let out a cry that convulsed his bulky frame and jerked his arm...

defs.def_en: If someone convulses or if they are convulsed by or with something, their body moves suddenly in an uncontrolled way.

defs.def_cn: (采用蒸馏法的)酿酒者，酿酒公司
defs.def_en: A distiller is a person or a company that makes whisky or a similar strong alcoholic drink by a process of distilling.

defs.def_cn: （情感、力量等）被压抑的，被抑制的

ext.ext_cn: 他还有很多强压的愤怒要发泄。
ext.ext_en: He still had a lot of pent-up anger to release.

defs.def_en: Pent-up emotions, energies, or forces have been held back and not expressed, used, or released.
A prepositional phrase is a structure consisting of a preposition and its object. Examples are 'on the table' and 'by the sea'.

ext.ext_cn: 掺有葡萄干的小圆面包
ext.ext_en: ...a currant bun.

defs.def_en: Buns are small bread rolls. They are sometimes sweet and may contain dried fruit or spices.
Buns are small sweet cakes. They often have icing on the top.
If a woman has her hair in a bun, she has fastened it tightly on top of her head or at the back of her head in the shape of a ball.

ext.ext_cn: 我想掐他的屁股，亲他的脖子。
ext.ext_en: I'd pinch his buns and kiss his neck.

defs.def_en: Your buns are your buttocks.

ext.ext_cn: 克鲁克的眼皮耷拉下来,打了个哈欠。
ext.ext_en: Crook's eyelids drooped and he yawned...

ext.ext_cn: 泛白凋零的玫瑰从蓝色的花瓶里耷拉下来。
ext.ext_en: Pale wilting roses drooped from a blue vase.

defs.def_en: If something droops, it hangs or leans downwards with no strength or firmness.

ext.ext_cn: “那太糟糕了！”特迪并无怨怒地说道。
ext.ext_en: 'That's too bad,' Teddy said without rancour.

defs.def_en: Rancour is a feeling of bitterness and anger.

defs.def_cn: 克林普纶(一种不易起皱的布料)
defs.def_en: Crimplene is an artificial fabric used for making clothes which does not crease easily.

ext.ext_cn: 我的亲生母亲从未和我联系过。
ext.ext_en: My natural mother has never communicated with me...

ext.ext_cn: 中情局官员之间的联系在很大程度上依赖电子邮件。
ext.ext_en: Officials of the CIA depend heavily on electronic mail to communicate with each other...

defs.def_en: If you communicate with someone, you share or exchange information with them, for example by speaking, writing, or using equipment. You can also say that two people communicate .

ext.ext_cn: 他们成功地把知识传授给他人。
ext.ext_en: They successfully communicate their knowledge to others...

ext.ext_cn: 结果会通知父母。
ext.ext_en: The results will be communicated to parents...

defs.def_en: If you communicate information, a feeling, or an idea to someone, you let them know about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他不善于和队员们进行沟通。
ext.ext_en: He was never good at communicating with the players...

ext.ext_cn: 家庭疗法指导我们彼此之间的沟通交流。
ext.ext_en: Family therapy showed us how to communicate with each other.

defs.def_en: If one person communicates with another, they successfully make each other aware of their feelings and ideas. You can also say that two people communicate .

defs.def_cn: 对方付费电话;受话人付费电话
defs.def_en: A reverse charge call is a telephone call which is paid for by the person who receives the call, rather than the person who makes the call.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如果想要发展成功的关系，在需要的时候必须有自信拿出主见。
ext.ext_en: If you want good relationships, you must have the confidence to be self-assertive when required.

defs.def_en: Someone who is self-assertive acts in a confident way, speaking firmly about their opinions and demanding the rights that they believe they should have.
A bay window is a window that sticks out from the outside wall of a house.

defs.def_cn: (政府或机构提供的)资金，款项，拨款

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望政府为这个计划提供资金。
ext.ext_en: They hope for government funding for the scheme...

ext.ext_cn: 许多学院的经费都遭到了削减。
ext.ext_en: Many colleges have seen their funding cut.

defs.def_en: Funding is money which a government or organization provides for a particular purpose.
MD is written after someone's name to indicate that they have been awarded a degree in medicine and are qualified to practise as a doctor.
A trial run is a first attempt at doing something to make sure you can do it properly.

defs.def_cn: (机构中工作内容单调但又不可或缺的)无名小卒，基层职工
defs.def_en: The foot soldiers of a particular organization are people who seem unimportant and who do not have a high position but who do a large amount of very important and often very boring work.

defs.def_cn: （战争、暴乱等时）洗劫，劫掠（商店或民宅）

ext.ext_cn: 一些团伙开始破窗抢劫商店时发生了骚乱。
ext.ext_en: The trouble began when gangs began breaking windows and looting shops...

ext.ext_cn: 有报道说一些年轻人乘局势一片混乱之际抢劫盗窃。
ext.ext_en: There have been reports of youths taking advantage of the general confusion to loot and steal.

defs.def_en: If people loot shops or houses, they steal things from them, for example during a war or riot.

defs.def_cn: （战争、暴乱等时）掠夺，抢劫（财物）

ext.ext_cn: 武装暴徒抢掠食物、恐吓群众，该镇居民深受其苦。
ext.ext_en: The town has been plagued by armed thugs who have looted food supplies and terrorized the population.

ext.ext_cn: 被劫物资清单上，从油桶到办公设施都有。
ext.ext_en: ...lists of looted material ranging from tanks to office fittings.

defs.def_en: If someone loots things, they steal them, for example during a war or riot.

ext.ext_cn: 罪犯盗窃大多是为了把赃物在黑市上卖掉，换取现金。
ext.ext_en: Most criminals steal in order to sell their loot for cash on the black market.

defs.def_en: Loot is stolen money or goods.

defs.def_cn: 塞勒塔普胶黏带;透明胶带
defs.def_en: Sellotape is a clear sticky tape that you use to stick paper or card together or onto a wall.

ext.ext_cn: 我用透明胶带把便条贴在他的门上。
ext.ext_en: I sellotaped the note to his door.

defs.def_en: If you Sellotape one thing to another, you stick them together using Sellotape.

ext.ext_cn: 这是日益显著的趋势。
ext.ext_en: This is a growing trend.

ext.ext_cn: 倾向于兼职就业的趋势
ext.ext_en: ...a trend towards part-time employment.

defs.def_en: A trend is a change or development towards something new or different.

ext.ext_cn: 该唱片已证明大获成功，并且很可能会引导潮流。
ext.ext_en: The record has already proved a success and may well start a trend.

defs.def_en: To set a trend means to do something that becomes accepted or fashionable, and that a lot of other people copy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 即使平凡的工作也乐意承担。
ext.ext_en: Be willing to do even mundane tasks.

ext.ext_cn: 平淡的现实生活
ext.ext_en: ...the mundane realities of life.

defs.def_en: Something that is mundane is very ordinary and not at all interesting or unusual.

ext.ext_cn: “有问题吗？”——“没有，我挺好的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Any problems?' — 'No, I'm O.K.'...

ext.ext_cn: “你难道没有拿到驾照吗？”——“没有。”
ext.ext_en: 'Haven't you got your driver's licence?' — 'No.'

defs.def_en: You use no to give a negative response to a question.

ext.ext_cn: “我们以为你移居国外了。”——“不，没有。”
ext.ext_en: 'We thought you'd emigrated.' — 'No, no.'...

ext.ext_cn: “你比我还糟。”——“不，才不是呢。”
ext.ext_en: 'You're getting worse than me.' — 'No I'm not.'

defs.def_en: You use no to say that something that someone has just said is not true.

defs.def_cn: (用于拒绝建议、请求或拒绝给予许可)不要，不行，不用

ext.ext_cn: “喏，用我的。”——“不用，这就挺好。”
ext.ext_en: 'Here, have mine.' — 'No, this is fine.'...

ext.ext_cn: “你就帮我把话带给皮特，行吗？”——“不，不行，我不能。”
ext.ext_en: 'Can you just get the message through to Pete for me?' — 'No, no I can't.'...

defs.def_en: You use no to refuse an offer or a request, or to refuse permission.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示不想让某人做某事)不要，不可

ext.ext_cn: 不，我不允许那样，你不能…
ext.ext_en: No. I forbid it. You cannot...

ext.ext_cn: 她举起一只手打断他的话。“不，这不对，我们绝不能这样。”
ext.ext_en: She put up a hand to stop him. 'No. It's not right. We mustn't.'

defs.def_en: You use no to indicate that you do not want someone to do something.

defs.def_cn: (表示接受或理解对方的否定说法)对的，是的

ext.ext_cn: “我们不是在主校区。”——“是的，不在。”
ext.ext_en: 'We're not on the main campus.' — 'No.'...

ext.ext_cn: “这不是我喜欢的音乐形式。”——“对，这不是。”
ext.ext_en: 'It's not one of my favourite forms of music.' — 'No.'

defs.def_en: You use no to acknowledge a negative statement or to show that you accept and understand it.

defs.def_cn: (用于纠正刚说的话)噢不，啊不

ext.ext_cn: 我当时22岁，哎呀不对，是21岁。
ext.ext_en: I was twenty-two — no, twenty-one.

defs.def_en: You use no before correcting what you have just said.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示震惊或失望)不会吧，是吗，真的

ext.ext_cn: “约翰打电话说他的电脑坏了。”——“噢，天哪，不会吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'John phoned to say that his computer wasn't working.' — 'Oh God no.'

ext.ext_cn: “我们是和萨拉还有她正在交往的那位已婚男士一起去的。”——“哦，怎么会呢。”
ext.ext_en: 'We went with Sarah and the married man that she's currently seeing.' — 'Oh no.'

defs.def_en: You use no to express shock or disappointment at something you have just been told.

ext.ext_cn: 他根本没有付钱的打算。
ext.ext_en: He had no intention of paying the cash...

ext.ext_cn: 没有哪份工作能对世界的未来有更大的影响。
ext.ext_en: No job has more influence on the future of the world...

defs.def_en: You use no to mean not any or not one person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他完全没有歌唱天分。
ext.ext_en: He is no singer...

ext.ext_cn: 我可以坦白地说，我们最差的顾问挣不到一分钱。
ext.ext_en: I make it no secret that our worst consultants earn nothing...

defs.def_en: You use no to emphasize that someone or something is not the type of thing mentioned.

defs.def_cn: (用于构成比较级的否定形式)根本不，毫不

ext.ext_cn: 开播时间不会晚于明年年底。
ext.ext_en: It is to start broadcasting no later than the end of next year...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天至少30名攀登者登上了顶峰。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday no fewer than thirty climbers reached the summit...

defs.def_en: You can use no to make the negative form of a comparative.

defs.def_cn: (用于形容词和名词前，使其表示相反意义)倒不，并非

ext.ext_cn: 如果能唤起更多自知之明，有时候一点点自私并非坏事。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes a bit of selfishness, if it leads to greater self-knowledge, is no bad thing...

ext.ext_cn: 今天的选举本身并不是很重要。
ext.ext_en: Today's elections are of no great importance in themselves.

defs.def_en: You use no in front of an adjective and noun to make the noun group mean its opposite.

defs.def_cn: (用于布告或指示中)不准，禁止

ext.ext_cn: 队长把“严禁吸烟”的标志牌都翻了过来。
ext.ext_en: The captain turned out the 'no smoking' signs...

ext.ext_cn: 熄灯后禁止交谈。
ext.ext_en: No talking after lights out.

defs.def_en: No is used in notices or instructions to say that a particular activity or thing is forbidden.

defs.def_cn: 作否定回答者;投反对票者;反对票

ext.ext_cn: 根据最新的民意测验，有50％的人反对，35％的人赞成。
ext.ext_en: According to the latest opinion polls, the noes have 50 percent, the yeses 35 percent...

ext.ext_cn: 法国政府官员声称政府已经制定了应急计划，以防持异议者胜出。
ext.ext_en: French officials say the government has made contingency plans in the event that the no's win.

defs.def_en: A no is a person who has answered 'no' to a question or who has voted against something. No is also used to refer to their answer or vote.

ext.ext_cn: 她无法再回到从前的生活。
ext.ext_en: There is no going back to the life she had...

ext.ext_cn: 现在无法怀疑他们。
ext.ext_en: There is no doubting them now.

defs.def_en: If you say there is no doing a particular thing, you mean that it is very difficult or impossible to do that thing.

defs.def_cn: (表现在行为或思想上的)防御机制
defs.def_en: A defence mechanism is a way of behaving or thinking which is not conscious or deliberate and is an automatic reaction to unpleasant experiences or feelings such as anxiety and fear.

ext.ext_cn: 这些人无法赊购到农用机械。
ext.ext_en: The group can't get credit to buy farming machinery...

ext.ext_cn: 无论是付现还是赊购，都可以要求经销商打折。
ext.ext_en: You can ask a dealer for a discount whether you pay cash or buy on credit.

defs.def_en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

ext.ext_cn: 想到账户里有余额时还要收费，我就非常气愤。
ext.ext_en: The idea that I could be charged when I'm in credit makes me very angry...

ext.ext_cn: 我确保账户里有余额。
ext.ext_en: I made sure the account stayed in credit...

defs.def_en: If someone or their bank account is in credit, their bank account has money in it.

ext.ext_cn: 她注意到自己的账户里只存进了80,000美元。
ext.ext_en: She noticed that only $80,000 had been credited to her account...

ext.ext_cn: 米兰银行决定改变付款贷记的方式。
ext.ext_en: Midland decided to change the way it credited payments to accounts...

defs.def_en: When a sum of money is credited to an account, the bank adds that sum of money to the total in the account.

ext.ext_cn: 总借记和总贷记的结算即账户余额。
ext.ext_en: The statement of total debits and credits is known as a balance.

defs.def_en: A credit is a sum of money which is added to an account.

ext.ext_cn: 比尔·布拉德利参议员概述了自己的减税计划，提出每个孩子可为家庭减免350美元的课税。
ext.ext_en: Senator Bill Bradley outlined his own tax cut, giving families $350 in tax credits per child...

ext.ext_cn: 日本向俄罗斯提供了约25亿美元的借款和价值约5,000万美元的直接援助。
ext.ext_en: Japan has provided about $2.5 billion in credits to Russia and about $50 million in direct aid.

defs.def_en: A credit is an amount of money that is given to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 谁受到表扬无所谓，只要我们不挨批就好。
ext.ext_en: We don't mind who gets the credit so long as we don't get the blame...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们把所有功劳都揽到自己身上，那就不对了。
ext.ext_en: It would be wrong for us to take all the credit...

defs.def_en: If you get the credit for something good, people praise you because you are responsible for it, or are thought to be responsible for it.

ext.ext_cn: 职员们称赞他救了海丝的命。
ext.ext_en: The staff are crediting him with having saved Hythe's life...

ext.ext_cn: 洛杉矶成为西海岸的金融中心，那位74岁的市长功不可没。
ext.ext_en: The 74-year-old mayor is credited with helping make Los Angeles the financial capital of the West Coast...

defs.def_en: If people credit someone with an achievement or if it is credited to them, people say or believe that they were responsible for it.

ext.ext_cn: 我想知道你为什么不认为他具有同样崇高的思想境界。
ext.ext_en: I wonder why you can't credit him with the same generosity of spirit...

ext.ext_cn: 他们过分夸大了科学的力量。
ext.ext_en: They are crediting science with power it doesn't possess.

defs.def_en: If you credit someone with a quality, you believe or say that they have it.

defs.def_cn: 为…赢得好感的人(或事物)

ext.ext_cn: 他是近代英国最伟大的运动员之一，是这一体育运动的骄傲。
ext.ext_en: He is one of the greatest British players of recent times and is a credit to his profession.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a credit to someone or something, you mean that their qualities or achievements will make people have a good opinion of the person or thing mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 罗斯福要么是不知道那桩丑闻，要么是不相信他所听到的。
ext.ext_en: Roosevelt either did not learn of the scandal or refused to credit what he heard...

ext.ext_cn: 高级主管中竟发生了这样的事，真是令人难以置信。
ext.ext_en: It seems hard to credit that such things went on among senior Directors.

defs.def_en: If you cannot credit something, you cannot believe that it is true.

defs.def_cn: 演职员表;摄制人员名单

ext.ext_cn: 影星马龙·白兰度要求把他的名字从演职员表中删掉。
ext.ext_en: The star Marlon Brando wants his name removed from the credits.

ext.ext_cn: 直到演职员表播完才离座的影迷
ext.ext_en: ...a moviegoer who remains in his seat until the credits are over.

defs.def_en: The list of people who helped to make a film, a CD, or a television  programme is called the credits .

defs.def_cn: (某些大学获得学位所必需的)学分，学习单元
defs.def_en: A credit is a successfully completed part of a higher education course. At some universities and colleges you need a certain number of credits to be awarded a degree.

ext.ext_cn: 你是个好女孩儿，莱蒂，你的善良值得称赞。
ext.ext_en: You're a nice girl, Lettie, and your kind heart does you credit.

defs.def_en: If you say that something does someone credit, you mean that they should be praised or admired because of it.

defs.def_cn: （某人的成绩或优点）值得表扬，应予肯定

ext.ext_cn: 他的礼物是很友好的表示，这值得称赞。
ext.ext_en: His gift was an extremely kind gesture. Credit where credit's due.

defs.def_en: If you say 'credit where credit's due', you are admitting that you ought to praise someone for something that they have done or for a good quality that they possess.

defs.def_cn: 相信…具有(某种优良品质);称赞;认可

ext.ext_cn: 布拉特巴克比媒体称赞的要有才华。
ext.ext_en: Bratbakk had more ability than the media gave him credit for.

defs.def_en: To give someone credit for a good quality means to believe that they have it.

defs.def_cn: (常用于提出缺点之后)就优点而言

ext.ext_cn: 就优点而言，他对母亲一直很孝顺。
ext.ext_en: On the credit side, he's always been wonderful with his mother.

defs.def_en: You say on the credit side in order to introduce one or more good things about a situation or person, usually when you have already mentioned the bad things about them.

ext.ext_cn: 她已经努力振作起来，而且值得称赞的是，她仍然积极乐观地看待生活。
ext.ext_en: She had managed to pull herself together and, to her credit, continued to look upon life as a positive experience...

ext.ext_cn: 她的犯罪手段很残忍，但她的供认不讳还是可以认可的。
ext.ext_en: Although the offences were horrific it was to her credit that she had owned up.

defs.def_en: If something is to someone's credit, they deserve praise for it.

ext.ext_cn: 我著有20部小说，还在杂志上发表了无数篇文章。
ext.ext_en: I have twenty novels and countless magazine stories to my credit.

defs.def_en: If you already have one or more achievements to your credit, you have achieved them.
If you describe someone as a weirdo, you disapprove of them because they behave in an unusual way which you find difficult to understand or accept.

defs.def_cn: （在do之后、主动词的原形之前加 not，构成主动词的否定式）

ext.ext_cn: 他们不想工作。
ext.ext_en: They don't want to work...

ext.ext_cn: 我不知道杰米有一把刀。
ext.ext_en: I did not know Jamie had a knife...

defs.def_en: Do is used to form the negative of main verbs, by putting 'not' after 'do' and before the main verb in its infinitive form, that is the form without 'to'.

defs.def_cn: （将主语置于do和主动词的原形之间，构成疑问句）

ext.ext_cn: 你喜欢音乐吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you like music?...

ext.ext_cn: 他说了什么？
ext.ext_en: What did he say?...

defs.def_en: Do is used to form questions, by putting the subject after 'do' and before the main verb in its infinitive form, that is the form without 'to'.

ext.ext_cn: 你知道安迪的情况，是不是？
ext.ext_en: You know about Andy, don't you?...

ext.ext_cn: 我确定他们去年遇到过一些同样的问题，是不是？
ext.ext_en: I'm sure they had some of the same questions last year, didn't they?

defs.def_en: Do is used in question tags.

defs.def_cn: （对含有do的陈述句或疑问句作肯定或否定回答）

ext.ext_cn: “他认为有可疑的事发生吗?”——“是的，他认为有。”
ext.ext_en: 'Did he think there was anything suspicious going on?' — 'Yes, he did.'...

ext.ext_cn: “你有金属探测仪吗?”——“不，我没有。”
ext.ext_en: 'Do you have a metal detector?' — 'No, I don't.'...

defs.def_en: You use do when you are confirming or contradicting a statement containing 'do', or giving a negative or positive answer to a question.

defs.def_cn: （用在否定句中，表示不让某人做出某种举动）

ext.ext_cn: 别犯傻了。
ext.ext_en: Don't be silly...

ext.ext_cn: 别碰那个!
ext.ext_en: Don't touch that!

defs.def_en: Do is used with a negative to tell someone not to behave in a certain way.

defs.def_cn: （在没有其他助动词时，用来强调主动词）

ext.ext_cn: 韦罗妮卡，我确实懂了。
ext.ext_en: Veronica, I do understand...

ext.ext_cn: 你确实带了录音机。
ext.ext_en: You did have a tape recorder with you.

defs.def_en: Do is used to give emphasis to the main verb when there is no other auxiliary.

defs.def_cn: （用以礼貌性地邀请或说服某人做某事）

ext.ext_cn: 请坐。
ext.ext_en: Do sit down...

ext.ext_cn: 再来一杯吧。
ext.ext_en: Do help yourself to another drink.

defs.def_en: Do is used as a polite way of inviting or trying to persuade someone to do something.

defs.def_cn: （在进行对比、比较或说明两组事物相同时，用来代替前面的动词词组）

ext.ext_cn: 我挣钱比他多。
ext.ext_en: I make more money than he does...

ext.ext_cn: 总有一天她会离家出走，就像她母亲那样。
ext.ext_en: One day she will walk out, just as her own mother did...

defs.def_en: Do can be used to refer back to another verb group when you are comparing or contrasting two things, or saying that they are the same.

defs.def_cn: （与 so 或 nor 连用，表示两人或两组事物的情况相同）

ext.ext_cn: 你知道那是真的，我也知道。
ext.ext_en: You know that's true, and so do I...

ext.ext_cn: 我们没有忘记那事，他也没有。
ext.ext_en: We don't forget that. Nor does he...

defs.def_en: You use do after 'so' and 'nor' to say that the same statement is true for two people or groups.

defs.def_cn: 做，干，进行(常用于代替某个具体的动词)

ext.ext_cn: 我当时正想要干点活。
ext.ext_en: I was trying to do some work...

ext.ext_cn: 吃过午饭后，我和伊丽莎白洗了碗。
ext.ext_en: After lunch Elizabeth and I did the washing up...

defs.def_en: When you do something, you take some action or perform an activity or task. Do is often used instead of a more specific verb, to talk about a common action involving a particular thing. For example you can say 'do your teeth' instead of 'brush your teeth'.

defs.def_cn: （用来代替任何动词词组或前一个句子中的动词词组）

ext.ext_cn: 你在干什么？
ext.ext_en: What are you doing?...

ext.ext_cn: 那么告诉我这个分子有何作用而使其与众不同。
ext.ext_en: So tell me what this molecule does that makes it special...

defs.def_en: Do can be used to stand for any verb group, or to refer back to another verb group, including one that was in a previous sentence.

defs.def_cn: （用于句首从句中 what，all等词之后，以强调句尾的信息）

ext.ext_cn: 她只知道抱怨。
ext.ext_en: All she does is complain...

ext.ext_cn: 我应该去看她。
ext.ext_en: What I should do is go and see her...

defs.def_en: You can use do in a clause at the beginning of a sentence after words like 'what' and 'all', to give special emphasis to the information that comes at the end of the sentence.

ext.ext_cn: 我可以自由支配自己的生活。
ext.ext_en: I was allowed to do whatever I wanted with my life...

ext.ext_cn: 他用这30英镑干了什么？
ext.ext_en: What did he do with the thirty pounds?...

defs.def_en: If you do a particular thing with something, you use it in that particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 他们拒绝采取措施解决引发犯罪的真正问题：贫穷。
ext.ext_en: They refuse to do anything about the real cause of crime: poverty...

ext.ext_cn: 嗯，你打算怎么处理它呢？
ext.ext_en: Well, what are you going to do about it?...

defs.def_en: If you do something about a problem, you take action to try to solve it.

defs.def_cn: 造成，产生(好的或坏的结果或影响）

ext.ext_cn: 几枚炸弹就可以造成严重破坏。
ext.ext_en: A few bombs can do a lot of damage...

ext.ext_cn: 休息一下对你有好处。
ext.ext_en: It'll do you good to take a rest...

defs.def_en: If an action or event does a particular thing, such as harm or good, it has that result or effect.

ext.ext_cn: 当前的改革对创造这些条件大有帮助。
ext.ext_en: The current reforms will do much to create these conditions...

ext.ext_cn: 他们竭尽所能来帮助我们。
ext.ext_en: They did everything they could to help us...

defs.def_en: You can use do to talk about the degree to which a person, action, or event affects or improves a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我发现烈酒对她伤害很大。
ext.ext_en: I saw what the liquor was doing to her...

ext.ext_cn: 你忽视了你所承受的压力及它带给你的后果。
ext.ext_en: You overlook the pressure you're under and what it does to you.

defs.def_en: You can talk about what someone or something does to a person to mean that they have a very harmful effect on them.

ext.ext_cn: 你父亲做什么工作？
ext.ext_en: What does your father do?...

ext.ext_cn: 他14岁起就知道自己日后干什么了。
ext.ext_en: He knew what he wanted to do from the age of 14.

defs.def_en: If you ask someone what they do, you want to know what their job or profession is.

ext.ext_cn: 你明天晚上有计划吗？
ext.ext_en: Are you doing anything tomorrow night?...

ext.ext_cn: “圣诞节你打算做什么？”埃拉问到。“我们打算去莫莉姨妈家。”
ext.ext_en: 'What are you doing for Christmas?' Ella asked. 'We're going to Aunt Molly's.'...

defs.def_en: If you are doing something, you are busy or active in some way, or have planned an activity for some time in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 康妮在学校表现很好，以优异的成绩毕业了。
ext.ext_en: Connie did well at school and graduated with honours...

ext.ext_cn: 市郊的超市经营良好。
ext.ext_en: Out-of-town superstores are doing well...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something does well or badly, you are talking about how successful or unsuccessful they are.

ext.ext_cn: 他们提供设计服务，还进行印刷和包装。
ext.ext_en: They provide design services and do printing and packaging...

ext.ext_cn: 他们经营种类繁多的花草茶。
ext.ext_en: They do a good range of herbal tea.

defs.def_en: If a person or organization does a particular service or product, they provide that service or sell that product.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的速度达到了每小时 70 英里。
ext.ext_en: They were doing 70 miles an hour.

ext.ext_cn: 他的双体船的速度可以达到 37 节。
ext.ext_en: His catamaran will do 37 knots.

defs.def_en: You can use do when referring to the speed or rate that something or someone achieves or is able to achieve.

ext.ext_cn: 我希望在大学里学数学。
ext.ext_en: I'd like to do maths at university.

ext.ext_cn: “那么你在第一年时学了《麦克白》?”——“不，第一年我们学的是《恺撒大帝》。”
ext.ext_en: So you did 'Macbeth' in the first year?' — 'No, in the first year we did 'Julius Caesar'.'

defs.def_en: If you do a subject, author, or book, you study them at school or college.

ext.ext_cn: 吉娜模仿口音惟妙惟肖。
ext.ext_en: Gina does accents extremely well.

defs.def_en: If you do a particular person, accent, or role, you imitate that person or accent, or act that role.

ext.ext_cn: “难道你不能对你妹妹好一点吗？”——“对她好？我做不到。”
ext.ext_en: 'Can't you be nicer to your sister?' — 'Nice? I don't do nice'.

defs.def_en: You can use do to say that you are able or unable to behave in a particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 我不吸毒。
ext.ext_en: I don't do drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 我看见他在洗手间吃摇头丸。
ext.ext_en: I saw him doing ecstasy in the toilets.

defs.def_en: If someone does drugs, they take illegal drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 任何能引起争吵、吸引注意力的事情都可以。
ext.ext_en: Anything to create a scene and attract attention will do...

ext.ext_cn: 我们需要一场胜利，平局根本不行。
ext.ext_en: We need a win — a draw won't do at all...

defs.def_en: If you say that something will do or will do you, you mean that there is enough of it or that it is of good enough quality to meet your requirements or to satisfy you.

ext.ext_cn: 我需要一杯茶。
ext.ext_en: I could do with a cup of tea...

ext.ext_cn: 范围需要扩展。
ext.ext_en: The range could do with being extended.

defs.def_en: If you say that you could do with something, you mean that you need it or would benefit from it.

ext.ext_cn: 你把那个笔记本放哪儿了？
ext.ext_en: What did you do with that notebook?

defs.def_en: You can ask someone what they did with something as another way of asking them where they put it.

ext.ext_cn: “坎贝尔医生，”他显然很惊讶地说道，“您怎么在这儿?”
ext.ext_en: 'Dr Campbell,' he said, clearly surprised. 'What are you doing here?'

ext.ext_cn: 那么一大早他在海德公园干什么？
ext.ext_en: What was he doing in Hyde Park at that time of the morning?

defs.def_en: If you ask what someone or something is doing in a particular place, you are asking why they are there.

defs.def_cn: (对小孩子所说的话)行啦，够啦
defs.def_en: If you say that will do to a child, you are telling them to stop behaving in the way that they are.

ext.ext_cn: 巴特菲尔德先生否认和此事有关。
ext.ext_en: Mr Butterfield denies having anything to do with the episode...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在吵架，是为了钱的事。
ext.ext_en: They were shouting at each other. It was something to do with money...

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing has something to do with or is something to do with another thing, you mean that the two things are connected or that the first thing is about the second thing.

defs.def_cn: 宴会;社交聚会;社交活动

ext.ext_cn: 他的一位朋友正在斯托克举办宴会。
ext.ext_en: A friend of his is having a do in Stoke...

ext.ext_cn: 他们经常在那儿闹通宵。
ext.ext_en: They always have all-night dos there.

defs.def_en: A do is a party, dinner party, or other social event.

ext.ext_cn: 请向我推荐最合适的彩色胶卷，并告诉我一些注意事项。
ext.ext_en: Please advise me on the most suitable colour print film and some dos and don'ts.

defs.def_en: If someone tells you the dos and don'ts of a particular situation, they advise you what you should and should not do in that situation.
Jockey shorts are a type of men's underpants.

defs.def_cn: 外表;外部特征;表面情况

ext.ext_cn: 游客们看到的只是我们信仰的表面情况。
ext.ext_en: All that the tourists see are the externals of our faith.

defs.def_en: When you talk about externals, you are referring to the features of a situation that are obvious but not important or central.
A cantaloupe is a type of melon .

ext.ext_cn: 一个伟大的艺术家的工作室
ext.ext_en: ...the studio of a great artist...

ext.ext_cn: 每幅海报都有这个艺术家的签名。
ext.ext_en: Each poster is signed by the artist...

defs.def_en: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or a hobby.

defs.def_cn: 艺术家（如小说家、诗人、导演等）

ext.ext_cn: 虽然他是一个不折不扣的艺术家，但是他的作品极其通俗易懂。
ext.ext_en: His books are enormously easy to read, yet he is a serious artist...

ext.ext_cn: 引用恩格尔的话说就是理性的人是成不了艺术家的。
ext.ext_en: Engel is quoted as saying that balanced people do not become artists.

defs.def_en: An artist is a person who creates novels, poems, films, or other things which can be considered as works of art.

ext.ext_cn: 唱片销量达到数百万张的当红音乐家
ext.ext_en: ...a popular artist who has sold millions of records.

defs.def_en: An artist is a performer such as a musician, actor, or dancer.

ext.ext_cn: 他是一名出色的足球运动员，一个足球高手。
ext.ext_en: He is an exceptional footballer — an artist.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is an artist at a particular activity, you mean they are very skilled at it.

defs.def_cn: （某个群体中的）每个人，所有人

ext.ext_cn: 听到那条消息，街上所有的人都震惊了。
ext.ext_en: Everyone in the street was shocked when they heard the news...

ext.ext_cn: 当其他所有人都在晚上5点左右回家时，林恩仍在努力工作。
ext.ext_en: When everyone else goes home around 5 p.m. Lynn is still hard at work...

defs.def_en: You use everyone or everybody to refer to all the people in a particular group.

ext.ext_cn: 人们有时会觉得自己是个失败者。
ext.ext_en: Everyone feels like a failure at times...

ext.ext_cn: 每个人都需要一些休息和放松的自由时间。
ext.ext_en: Everyone needs some free time for rest and relaxation...

defs.def_en: You use everyone or everybody to refer to all people.

ext.ext_cn: 抗议者已经绝食17天了。
ext.ext_en: The protesters have been on hunger strike for 17 days...

ext.ext_cn: 为了抗议卡拉奇的政治暴力，他已开始了绝食。
ext.ext_en: He has begun a hunger strike in protest over political violence in Karachi.

defs.def_en: If someone goes on hunger strike or goes on a hunger strike, they refuse to eat as a way of protesting about something.

ext.ext_cn: 右翼极端政党“国民阵线”支持反犹太主义。
ext.ext_en: The extreme right-wing National Front promoted anti-semitism.

defs.def_en: Anti-Semitism is hostility to and prejudice against Jewish people.

ext.ext_cn: 许多事业有成的女性似乎对她们的男同事构成了一种威胁。
ext.ext_en: Many women achievers appear to pose a threat to their male colleagues...

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦市芭蕾舞团从波修瓦芭蕾舞团聘来了两名男舞蹈演员。
ext.ext_en: The London City Ballet has engaged two male dancers from the Bolshoi...

defs.def_en: Someone who is male is a man or a boy.

ext.ext_cn: 65岁至70岁之间的白人男性的遗骸
ext.ext_en: ...the remains of a Caucasian male, aged 65-70...

ext.ext_cn: 他急于证明自己是一名热血男儿。
ext.ext_en: He was very anxious to prove he was a red-blooded male...

defs.def_en: Men and boys are sometimes referred to as males when they are being considered as a type.

ext.ext_cn: 英国男性的失业率目前高居欧洲第三位。
ext.ext_en: The rate of male unemployment in Britain is now the third worst in Europe.

ext.ext_cn: 男性暴力
ext.ext_en: ...male violence.

defs.def_en: Male means relating, belonging, or affecting men rather than women.

ext.ext_cn: 雄鸟和雌鸟轮流孵蛋。
ext.ext_en: Males and females take turns brooding the eggs.

ext.ext_cn: 交配之后，雄黄峰们就从蜂房的侧面钻出去了。
ext.ext_en: After mating the male wasps tunnel through the sides of their nursery.

defs.def_en: You can refer to any creature that belongs to the sex that cannot lay eggs or have babies as a male .
A male flower or plant fertilizes the part that will become the fruit.

ext.ext_cn: 城市排水系统
ext.ext_en: ...the city's sewer system.

ext.ext_cn: 裸露的下水道
ext.ext_en: ...open sewers.

defs.def_en: A sewer is a large underground channel that carries waste matter and rain water away, usually to a place where it is treated and made harmless.

defs.def_cn: 名人电视促销节目;政客访谈节目

ext.ext_cn: 耗资 75 万美元、有雪儿等艺人出镜的新的名人电视促销节目近来播出了。
ext.ext_en: New $750,000 infomercials, featuring artists like Cher, have recently hit the screens...

ext.ext_cn: 佩罗期待着新一轮的竞选宣传节目的播出。
ext.ext_en: Perot hoped to run another series of campaign infomercials.

defs.def_en: An infomercial is a television programme in which a famous person gives information about a company's products or services, or a politician gives his or her opinions. The word is formed from 'information' and 'commercial'.

defs.def_cn: （一人弯腰、另一人从其背上跳过的）跳背游戏

ext.ext_cn: 在玩骑马、跳背和足球等的孩子们
ext.ext_en: ...children engaged in activities such as riding, playing leapfrog, or football.

defs.def_en: Leapfrog is a game which children play, in which a child bends over, while others jump over their back.

ext.ext_cn: 4个美国系统全部超过了欧洲版本，这已是显见的事实。
ext.ext_en: It is already obvious that all four American systems have leapfrogged over the European versions...

ext.ext_cn: 美国研究人员现已乘日本人之东风赶超而上，将在一两年内研制出一套数字系统。
ext.ext_en: American researchers have now leapfrogged the Japanese and are going to produce a digital system within a year or two.

defs.def_en: If one group of people leapfrogs into a particular position or leapfrogs someone else, they use the achievements of another person or group in order to make advances of their own.

defs.def_cn: 行为;举止;(尤指)步态，仪态

ext.ext_cn: 对妙龄少女来说，仪态身姿和优秀成绩一样重要。
ext.ext_en: Deportment and poise were as important as good marks for young ladies.

defs.def_en: Your deportment is the way you behave, especially the way you walk and move.

ext.ext_cn: 学校需要减少旷课人数。
ext.ext_en: Schools need to reduce levels of truancy.

defs.def_en: Truancy is when children stay away from school without permission.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 紧张的;烦躁不安的;心神不宁的

ext.ext_cn: 她紧张不安，还在一根接一根地抽着烟。
ext.ext_en: She was nervous and edgy, still chain-smoking.

defs.def_en: If someone is edgy, they are nervous and anxious, and seem likely to lose control of themselves.

defs.def_cn: 易如反掌的事;容易做的事

ext.ext_cn: 菲蒂帕尔迪的成功来得太容易了。
ext.ext_en: Fittipaldi's victory was a cakewalk.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a cakewalk, you mean that it is very easy to do or achieve.

ext.ext_cn: 从地理位置上讲，英国处于欧洲边缘，而巴黎却位于欧洲大陆的中心位置。
ext.ext_en: Geographically, the UK is on the periphery of Europe, while Paris is at the heart of the continent...

ext.ext_cn: 味蕾集中于舌尖、舌根和舌头两侧。
ext.ext_en: Taste buds are concentrated at the tip and rear of the tongue and around its periphery.

defs.def_en: If something is on the periphery of an area, place, or thing, it is on the edge of it.

ext.ext_cn: 宗教的社会学研究从社会学的中心学科变成了边缘学科。
ext.ext_en: The sociological study of religion moved from the centre to the periphery of sociology.

defs.def_en: The periphery of a subject or area of interest is the part of it that is not considered to be as important or basic as the main part.

defs.def_cn: (药品或化妆品的)配方;配方产品

ext.ext_cn: 疫苗的配方有些问题。
ext.ext_en: There have been problems with the formulation of the vaccine...

ext.ext_cn: 可以买一种含蜂王浆、花粉和维生素 C 的配方产品。
ext.ext_en: You can buy a formulation containing royal jelly, pollen and vitamin C.

defs.def_en: The formulation of something such as a medicine or a beauty product is the way in which different ingredients are combined to make it. You can also say that the finished product is a formulation .

ext.ext_cn: 政策的制定和实施过程
ext.ext_en: ...the process of policy formulation and implementation.

defs.def_en: The formulation of something such as a policy or plan is the process of creating or inventing it.

ext.ext_cn: 这种表述比所提决议草案中的说法要弱很多。
ext.ext_en: This is a far weaker formulation than is in the draft resolution which is being proposed.

defs.def_en: A formulation is the way in which you express your thoughts and ideas.

defs.def_cn: 似脱离人而存在的;无实体的;脱离现实的

ext.ext_cn: 从柜子后面传来了一个不见其人的声音。
ext.ext_en: A disembodied voice sounded from the back of the cabin.

defs.def_en: Disembodied means seeming not to be attached to or to come from anyone.

defs.def_cn: 脱离肉体的;与躯体分离的

ext.ext_cn: 一颗与躯体分离的头颅
ext.ext_en: ...a disembodied head.

defs.def_en: Disembodied means separated from or existing without a body.

ext.ext_cn: 布兰德摇了摇头。他已经厌烦了和这个男人斗嘴。
ext.ext_en: Brand shook his head. He was tired of bandying words with the man...

ext.ext_cn: 原告和被告你来我往，互相指责。
ext.ext_en: The prosecution and defense were bandying accusations back and forth.

defs.def_en: If you bandy words with someone, you argue with them.
A claims adjuster is someone who is employed by an insurance company to decide how much money a person making a claim should receive.

ext.ext_cn: 在该地区还发现了海鸥的其他亚种。
ext.ext_en: Several other sub-species of gull are found in the region.

defs.def_en: A sub-species of a plant or animal is one of the types that a particular species is divided into.

ext.ext_cn: 观众边笑边鼓掌。
ext.ext_en: The audience laughed and applauded...

ext.ext_cn: 所有人起立为他不可磨灭的英勇之举鼓掌。
ext.ext_en: Every person stood to applaud his unforgettable act of courage.

defs.def_en: When a group of people applaud, they clap their hands in order to show approval, for example when they have enjoyed a play or concert.

ext.ext_cn: 他的勇气值得称道。
ext.ext_en: He should be applauded for his courage...

ext.ext_cn: 最后这招令人拍手叫绝。
ext.ext_en: This last move can only be applauded...

defs.def_en: When an attitude or action is ap-plauded, people praise it.

ext.ext_cn: 当他们接近起止线时，普罗斯特猛向右转，两辆车并排驶过了终点。
ext.ext_en: As they reached the start-finish line Prost jinked right and drew abreast.

defs.def_en: See also:high jinks;To jink somewhere means to move there quickly in an irregular way, rather than by moving in a straight line.

ext.ext_cn: 男孩子们开始感到厌烦。
ext.ext_en: The boys were getting bored...

ext.ext_cn: 苦恼是无谓的。
ext.ext_en: There's no point in getting upset...

defs.def_en: You use get with adjectives to mean 'become'. For example, if someone gets cold, they become cold, and if they get angry, they become angry.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示状况或处境的表达中）陷入，处于

ext.ext_cn: 晚上外出时一半的乐趣在于出门前的准备。
ext.ext_en: Half the pleasure of an evening out is getting ready...

ext.ext_cn: 也许我不该讲那些话——我可能会惹来麻烦。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps I shouldn't say that — I might get into trouble...

defs.def_en: Get is used with expressions referring to states or situations. For example, to get into trouble means to start being in trouble.

defs.def_cn: 使陷入，使处于（某种状况或处境）

ext.ext_cn: 我不知道自己是否能把它清理干净。
ext.ext_en: I don't  know if I can get it clean...

ext.ext_cn: 我感兴趣的是看一份旧的《纽约时报》。
ext.ext_en: What got me interested was looking at an old New York Times...

defs.def_en: To get someone or something into a particular state or situation means to cause them to be in it.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在使美国政界人士更加重视艾滋病流行的长期运动
ext.ext_en: ...a long campaign to get US politicians to take the Aids epidemic more seriously...

ext.ext_cn: 你想了什么办法让他摆姿势照了这张照片？
ext.ext_en: How did you get him to pose for this picture?

defs.def_en: If you get someone to do something, you cause them to do it by asking, persuading, or telling them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 补牙可能对我有好处。
ext.ext_en: I might benefit from getting my teeth fixed...

ext.ext_cn: 最好是赶快把事情弄完。
ext.ext_en: It was best to get things done quickly.

defs.def_en: If you get something done, you cause it to be done.

ext.ext_cn: 我下床把门打开了。
ext.ext_en: I got off the bed and opened the door...

ext.ext_cn: 我怎样才能从她身边经过而又不被她发现呢？
ext.ext_en: How can I get past her without her seeing me?...

defs.def_en: To get somewhere means to move there.

ext.ext_cn: 我通常上午9点半到单位。
ext.ext_en: Generally I get to work at 9.30am...

ext.ext_cn: 她回到家时天已经黑了。
ext.ext_en: It was dark by the time she got home.

defs.def_en: When you get to a place, you arrive there.

ext.ext_cn: 麦克掏出钱包。
ext.ext_en: Mack got his wallet out...

ext.ext_cn: 去把你的外套穿上。
ext.ext_en: Go and get your coat on...

defs.def_en: To get something or someone into a place or position means to cause them to move there.

defs.def_cn: （常用作助动词，代替be构成被动语态）

ext.ext_cn: 有人向她索要过签名吗？
ext.ext_en: Does she ever get asked for her autograph?...

ext.ext_cn: 一块玻璃碎了。
ext.ext_en: A pane of glass got broken.

defs.def_en: Get is often used in place of 'be' as an auxiliary verb to form passives.

ext.ext_cn: 米勒和费林盖蒂渐渐成了朋友。
ext.ext_en: Miller and Ferlinghetti got to be friends...

ext.ext_cn: 谁也不知道他怎么会变得如此富有。
ext.ext_en: No one could figure out how he got to be so wealthy.

defs.def_en: If you get to do something, you eventually or gradually reach a stage at which you do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些人是怎样成为大公司的老总的？
ext.ext_en: How do these people get to be the bosses of major companies?...

ext.ext_cn: 你经常能见到他吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you get to see him often?...

defs.def_en: If you get to do something, you manage to do it or have the opportunity to do it.

defs.def_cn: （让…）迅速行动起来/干起来/工作起来

ext.ext_cn: 我计划黎明前从湖畔出发，大家马上行动起来吧。
ext.ext_en: I aim to be off the lake before dawn, so let's get moving...

ext.ext_cn: 我们得赶紧就此事开动脑筋，展开讨论，并采取行动，否则就来不及了。
ext.ext_en: We need to get thinking, talking and acting on this before it is too late.

defs.def_en: You can use get in expressions like get moving ,get going, and get working when you want to tell people to begin moving, going, or working quickly.

defs.def_cn: 到达（人生、事业的某一阶段）

ext.ext_cn: 我们还未到全面军事冲突的地步。
ext.ext_en: We haven't got to the stage of a full-scale military conflict...

ext.ext_cn: 如果走到那个地步，简也许能得到法律援助去打官司。
ext.ext_en: If she gets that far, Jane may get legal aid to take her case to court...

defs.def_en: If you get to a particular stage in your life or in something you are doing, you reach that stage.

defs.def_cn: （用于谈论进展情况）（使…）取得进展/不会有进展

ext.ext_cn: 激进派宣称谈判没有进展，他们打算退出。
ext.ext_en: Radical factions say the talks are getting nowhere and they want to withdraw...

ext.ext_cn: 我锲而不舍，总算有了一些进展。
ext.ext_en: My perseverance was getting me somewhere.

defs.def_en: You can use get to talk about the progress that you are making. For example, if you say that you are getting somewhere, you mean that you are making progress, and if you say that something won't get you anywhere, you mean it will not help you to progress at all.

ext.ext_cn: 已是凌晨一点多了，我累得筋疲力尽。
ext.ext_en: It got to after 1am and I was exhausted...

ext.ext_cn: 我们回来的时候已经快到晚上了。
ext.ext_en: It was getting towards evening when we got back...

defs.def_en: When it gets to a particular time, it is that time. If it is getting towards a particular time, it is approaching that time.

ext.ext_cn: 干这份工作20年来，我头一次失去了冷静，这一切让我大伤脑筋。
ext.ext_en: That's the first time I lost my cool in 20 years in this job. This whole thing's getting to me.

defs.def_en: If something that has continued for some time gets to you, it starts causing you to suffer.

ext.ext_cn: 让我恼怒的是这么多人都是这样的态度。
ext.ext_en: What gets me is the attitude of so many of the people.

defs.def_en: If something gets you, it annoys you.

ext.ext_cn: 我在锯木厂找了份工作。
ext.ext_en: I got a job at the sawmill...

ext.ext_cn: 问题在于如何找到足够的食物维持生命。
ext.ext_en: The problem was how to get enough food to sustain life...

defs.def_en: If you get something that you want or need, you obtain it.

ext.ext_cn: 我过生日时会得到一辆自行车。
ext.ext_en: I'm  getting a bike for my birthday...

ext.ext_cn: 很多女人给他写信。
ext.ext_en: He gets a lot of letters from women...

defs.def_en: If you get something, you receive it or are given it.

ext.ext_cn: 我今天上午过来取报纸。
ext.ext_en: I came down this morning to get the newspaper...

ext.ext_cn: 去给我拿一大杯白兰地来。
ext.ext_en: Go and get me a large brandy...

defs.def_en: If you get someone or something, you go and bring them to a particular place.

ext.ext_cn: 她像往常一样在准备早餐。
ext.ext_en: She was getting breakfast as usual.

defs.def_en: If you get a meal, you prepare it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果再参加一次那样的赛跑，每次的结果可能都不一样。
ext.ext_en: You could run that race again and get a different result each time...

ext.ext_cn: 6乘以9等于多少？
ext.ext_en: What do you get if you multiply six by nine?

defs.def_en: If you get a particular result, you obtain it from some action that you take, or from a calculation or experiment.

ext.ext_cn: 他的庄稼无法卖个好价钱。
ext.ext_en: He can't get a good price for his crops.

defs.def_en: If you get a particular price for something that you sell, you obtain that amount of money by selling it.

ext.ext_cn: 你在监狱里有时间反省。
ext.ext_en: You get time to think in prison...

ext.ext_cn: 我一有机会便去马克西姆餐厅吃饭。
ext.ext_en: Whenever I get the chance I go to Maxim's for dinner.

defs.def_en: If you get the time or opportunity to do something, you have the time or opportunity to do it.

defs.def_cn: 开始有（想法、印象或感受）

ext.ext_cn: 我开始觉得你是个诚实的人。
ext.ext_en: I get the feeling that you're  an honest man...

ext.ext_cn: 该研究是为了更好地了解人们选择现在居住地的原因。
ext.ext_en: The study is an attempt to get a better idea of why people live where they do...

defs.def_en: If you get an idea, impression, or feeling, you begin to have that idea, impression, or feeling as you learn or understand more about something.

ext.ext_cn: 查尔斯见到他时大吃一惊。
ext.ext_en: Charles got a shock when he saw him...

ext.ext_cn: 做自由职业者让她体会到无穷的快乐。
ext.ext_en: She gets enormous pleasure out of working freelance...

defs.def_en: If you get a feeling or benefit from an activity or experience, the activity or experience gives you that feeling or benefit.

ext.ext_cn: 为了看得更清楚些，年轻人爬上了公共汽车和围墙。
ext.ext_en: Young men climbed on buses and fences to get a better view...

ext.ext_cn: 为了一睹英雄的风采，人群喊叫着，推搡着。
ext.ext_en: Crowds shouted and pushed to get a glimpse of their hero.

defs.def_en: If you get a look, view, or glimpse of something, you manage to see it.

ext.ext_cn: 利雅得在12小时内降水就达25毫米。
ext.ext_en: Riyadh got 25 mm of rain in just 12 hours...

ext.ext_cn: 肯塔基州北部可能有雨夹雪。
ext.ext_en: Northern Kentucky is likely to get snow mixed with sleet.

defs.def_en: If a place gets a particular type of weather, it has that type of weather.

defs.def_cn: 理解，明白（笑话或所说的话）

ext.ext_cn: 安，听懂那个笑话了吗？我过会儿会解释。
ext.ext_en: Did you get that joke, Ann? I'll explain later...

ext.ext_cn: 你好像没有弄明白。
ext.ext_en: You don't  seem to get the point.

defs.def_en: If you get a joke or get the point of something that is said, you understand it.

ext.ext_cn: 我5岁时出过麻疹。
ext.ext_en: When I was five I got measles.

defs.def_en: If you get an illness or disease, you become ill with it.

defs.def_cn: 搭乘，乘（火车、公共汽车、飞机或船）

ext.ext_cn: 乘公共汽车要花两英镑。
ext.ext_en: It'll be two pounds to get the bus...

ext.ext_cn: 你赶几点的火车？
ext.ext_en: What time are you getting your train?

defs.def_en: When you get a train, bus, plane, or boat, you leave a place on a particular train, bus, plane, or boat.

ext.ext_cn: 别担心，我们已经抓住他了，他不会再杀人。
ext.ext_en: Take it easy. We've got him. He's not going to kill anyone else.

defs.def_en: If you get a person or animal, you succeed in catching, killing, or hitting them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不买报纸。
ext.ext_en: We don't get a paper...

ext.ext_cn: 我们已经订了《泰晤士报》。
ext.ext_en: We already get The Times.

defs.def_en: If you get a newspaper or magazine, you regularly buy it.

ext.ext_cn: 我只能收看到第7频道。
ext.ext_en: I only get Channel 7.

defs.def_en: If you can get a particular radio or television channel, you are able to receive broadcasts from it on your radio or television.

ext.ext_cn: 康索特有714名居民，是极其偏僻的乡村地区。
ext.ext_en: Consort has a population of 714 and is about as rural and isolated as you can get.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎可以说是最无可挑剔的饮食
ext.ext_en: ...the diet that is as near to perfect as you can get it.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is, for example, as good as you can get to mean that it is as good as it is possible for that thing to be.

ext.ext_cn: 他属于该党左派的事实无法否认。
ext.ext_en: There is no getting away from the fact that he is on the left of the party.

defs.def_en: If you say you can't get away from something or there is no getting away from something, you are emphasizing that it is true, even though people might prefer it not to be true.

ext.ext_cn: 意大利富人消遣度假的美丽岛屿伊斯基亚
ext.ext_en: ...the ravishing island of Ischia, where rich Italians get away from it all.

defs.def_en: If you get away from it all, you have a holiday in a place that is very different from where you normally live and work.

defs.def_cn: （表示蔑视、不同意或拒绝）滚开，去你的
defs.def_en: Get is used in rude expressions like get stuffed and get lost to express contempt, disagreement, or refusal to do something.

defs.def_cn: 你真是太走运了/你真是蠢得无可救药了

ext.ext_cn: 我是说，你真是太疯狂了。
ext.ext_en: I mean, how crazy can you get?

defs.def_en: You can say, for example, 'How lucky can you get?' or 'How stupid can you get? ' to show your surprise that anyone could be as lucky or stupid as the person that you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 如果有人想那样对待你，你就直截了当地告诉他们别做梦了。
ext.ext_en: If somebody tried to do that to you, you'd just go right up to them and tell them where to get off.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone where to get off, you tell them in a rather rude way that you are not going to do or agree to what they want.

ext.ext_cn: 你现在有很多那样的东西，是吧？
ext.ext_en: You get a lot of things like that now, don't you...

ext.ext_cn: 那就是你们的分歧所在。
ext.ext_en: That's where you get some differences of opinion.

defs.def_en: You can use you get instead of 'there is' or 'there are' to say that something exists, happens, or can be experienced.
A shopping list is a list of the things that you want to buy when you go shopping, which you write on a piece of paper.

ext.ext_cn: 热衷于做菜并不一定会导致腰围增粗。
ext.ext_en: A passion for cooking does not necessarily have to be bad for your waistline.

defs.def_en: Your waistline is your waist measurement.
The waistline of a piece of clothing is the place where the upper and lower parts are sewn together, which is near to your waist when you wear it.

ext.ext_cn: 潜意识的潜在力量
ext.ext_en: ...the hidden power of the subconscious...

ext.ext_cn: 关于它的一切记忆都深植于我的潜意识里。
ext.ext_en: The memory of it all was locked deep in my subconscious.

defs.def_en: Your subconscious is the part of your mind that can influence you or affect your behaviour even though you are not aware of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他下意识地抓住她的胳膊想挽留她。
ext.ext_en: He caught her arm in a subconscious attempt to detain her.

ext.ext_cn: 潜意识里渴望得到关爱
ext.ext_en: ...a subconscious cry for affection.

defs.def_en: A subconscious feeling or action exists in or is influenced by your subconscious.
A hitman is a man who is hired by someone in order to kill another person.

ext.ext_cn: 马丁·邦尼特将军呼吁反叛者投降。
ext.ext_en: General Martin Bonnet called on the rebels to surrender...

ext.ext_cn: 她去年 12 月在伦敦向警方自首。
ext.ext_en: She surrendered to the police in London last December.

defs.def_en: If you surrender, you stop fighting or resisting someone and agree that you have been beaten.

ext.ext_cn: 纳佳不得不填表放弃其全部财产所有权。
ext.ext_en: Nadja had to fill out forms surrendering all rights to her property...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天，摩根将军的部队被迫向比利时和美国军队交出了他们的重型武器。
ext.ext_en: Gen. Morgan's troops yesterday surrendered their heavy weapons to Belgian and US troops.

defs.def_en: If you surrender something you would rather keep, you give it up or let someone else have it, for example after a struggle.

ext.ext_cn: 他们被要求出示护照。
ext.ext_en: They have been ordered to surrender their passports.

defs.def_en: If you surrender something such as a ticket or your passport, you give it to someone in authority when they ask you to.

ext.ext_cn: 需要完全顺从并依靠耶稣
ext.ext_en: ...the need for total personal surrender to and dependence on Jesus...

ext.ext_cn: 沮丧是对死亡的一定妥协。
ext.ext_en: Depression is a partial surrender to death...

defs.def_en: You use surrender to refer to someone's attitude or behaviour when they lose the will to resist their feelings or the demands of other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 懂电脑的;会使用电脑的

ext.ext_cn: 我们对求职者的要求是具备运算能力，熟练使用电脑，精力充沛而且工作积极主动。
ext.ext_en: We look for applicants who are numerate, computer-literate and energetic self-starters.

defs.def_en: If someone is computer-literate, they have enough skill and knowledge to be able to use a computer.
A sphere is an object that is completely round in shape like a ball.

ext.ext_cn: 国际政治领域
ext.ext_en: ...the sphere of international politics.

ext.ext_cn: 在公共医疗保健服务业的各领域工作的护士们
ext.ext_en: ...nurses, working in all spheres of the health service.

defs.def_en: A sphere of activity or interest is a particular area of activity or interest.

defs.def_cn: (社会地位或兴趣等相同的)人群，阶层，圈子

ext.ext_cn: 政府和学术界以外社会阶层的生活现状
ext.ext_en: ...the realities of life outside the government and academic spheres of society.

defs.def_en: A sphere of people is a group of them who are similar in social status or who have the same interests.

defs.def_cn: (国家的)势力范围，影响所及的范围

ext.ext_cn: 基于历史上的联系和共同的语言，他们把该地区看成是自己天然的势力范围。
ext.ext_en: They see the region as their natural sphere of influence due to their historical links and a shared language.

ext.ext_cn: 传统上处于英国或美国势力范围内的国家
ext.ext_en: ...countries traditionally within the British or American spheres of influence.

defs.def_en: A country's sphere of influence is an area of the world where it has a lot of influence.
Fudge is a soft brown sweet that is made from butter, cream, and sugar.

defs.def_cn: 回避;敷衍;搪塞;对…态度暧昧

ext.ext_cn: 两人都对自己的计算结果含糊其词，避免提到具体数字。
ext.ext_en: Both have fudged their calculations and avoided specifics.

ext.ext_cn: 不能再敷衍的某些问题
ext.ext_en: ...certain issues that can no longer be fudged.

defs.def_en: If you fudge something, you avoid making a clear and definite decision, distinction, or statement about it.

defs.def_cn: 辛烷（汽油中的化学物质，用于衡量燃油质量）

ext.ext_cn: 你的发动机很适合烧76号辛烷汽油。
ext.ext_en: Your engine can run happily on 76 octane petrol.

ext.ext_cn: 高辛烷汽车燃油
ext.ext_en: ...high octane fuel for cars.

defs.def_en: See also:high-octane;Octane is a chemical substance that exists in petrol or gasoline and that is used to measure the quality of the fuel.

ext.ext_cn: 抗疟疾的疫苗正在试验阶段。
ext.ext_en: Anti-malarial vaccines are now undergoing trials...

ext.ext_cn: 英国孩子每年要接种7百万剂疫苗。
ext.ext_en: Seven million doses of vaccine are annually given to British children.

defs.def_en: A vaccine is a substance containing a harmless form of the germs that cause a particular disease. It is given to people, usually by injection, to prevent them getting that disease.
A cheater is someone who cheats.

ext.ext_cn: 成群结队的妇女上街抗议逮捕行动。
ext.ext_en: Groups of women took to the streets to  protest against the arrests...

ext.ext_cn: 学生们在抗议大学宿舍过于拥挤。
ext.ext_en: The students were protesting at overcrowding in the university hostels...

defs.def_en: If you protest against something or about something, you say or show publicly that you object to it. In American English, you usually say that you protest it.

ext.ext_cn: 反对党现在似乎势力非常弱小，无法针对政府发起真正的抗议。
ext.ext_en: The opposition now seems too weak to stage any serious protests against the government...

ext.ext_cn: 各工会号召罢工两小时，以对铁路当局所发通告表示抗议。
ext.ext_en: The unions called a two-hour strike in protest at the railway authority's announcement.

defs.def_en: A protest is the act of saying or showing publicly that you object to something.

ext.ext_cn: 我们试图申明莫遭到了毒打，他们却不相信我们。
ext.ext_en: When we tried to protest that Mo was beaten up they didn't believe us...

ext.ext_cn: “我从来没有对她那么说过，”他申辩道。
ext.ext_en: 'I never said any of that to her,' he protested...

defs.def_en: If you protest that something is the case, you insist that it is the case, when other people think that it may not be.

ext.ext_cn: 当他们坚持说她是在溺爱孙儿，她通常会作出那样的回应。
ext.ext_en: That was how she usually dealt with their protests that she was spoiling her grandchildren.

defs.def_en: A protest that something is true is a strong declaration that it is true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坐立不安的；胆战心惊的

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉自己别这么提心吊胆的。
ext.ext_en: I told myself not to be so jumpy...

ext.ext_cn: 他说话的时候声音听起来很紧张。
ext.ext_en: When he spoke his voice was jumpy.

defs.def_en: If you are jumpy, you are nervous or worried about something.

ext.ext_cn: 一辆黑色的梅赛德斯轿车在直升机旁嘎的一声刹住了。
ext.ext_en: A black Mercedes screeched to a halt beside the helicopter...

ext.ext_cn: 车轮在坑坑洼洼的路面上拐弯和颠簸时发出尖锐刺耳的声音。
ext.ext_en: The car wheels screeched as they curved and bounced over the rough broken ground.

defs.def_en: If a vehicle screeches somewhere or if its tyres screech, its tyres make an unpleasant high-pitched noise on the road.

ext.ext_cn: “给我来点水，杰里米！”我尖声喊道。
ext.ext_en: 'Get me some water, Jeremy!' I screeched...

ext.ext_cn: 一名在赛场上向你尖声喊叫的运动员
ext.ext_en: ...a player who screeches at you on the field.

defs.def_en: When you screech something, you shout it in a loud, unpleasant, high-pitched voice.

defs.def_cn: (鸟、动物等)尖叫，尖鸣，发出刺耳声

ext.ext_cn: 一只金刚鹦鹉站在栖木上冲他尖叫。
ext.ext_en: A macaw screeched at him from its perch.

ext.ext_cn: 在鸟舍中尖声鸣叫的热带鸟
ext.ext_en: ...tropical birds screeching in an aviary...

defs.def_en: When a bird, animal, or thing screeches, it makes a loud, unpleasant, high-pitched noise.

ext.ext_cn: 该保险公司将接受仓库库存货物或长期国库券作为担保。
ext.ext_en: The insurance company will take warehouse stocks or treasury bonds as surety...

ext.ext_cn: 英国布里斯托尔刑事法庭准予有条件保释，保证金为 2,500 英镑。
ext.ext_en: Bristol Crown Court granted conditional bail with a surety of £2,500.

defs.def_en: A surety is money or something valuable which you give to someone to show that you will do what you have promised.

ext.ext_cn: 卢克的回应就是把她的肩头抓得更紧了。
ext.ext_en: Luke answered by tightening his grip on her shoulder...

ext.ext_cn: 她充满感激，把他的脖子搂得更紧了。
ext.ext_en: Her arms tightened about his neck in gratitude...

defs.def_en: If you tighten your grip on something, or if your grip tightens, you hold the thing more firmly or securely.
