ext.ext_cn: 我决定收拾些东西，带孩子们去我妈妈家。
ext.ext_en: I decided to pack a few things and take the kids to my Mum's...

defs.def_en: When you pack a bag, you put clothes and other things into it, because you are leaving a place or going on holiday.

ext.ext_cn: 他们给了我一份在货栈打包的工作。
ext.ext_en: They offered me a job packing goods in a warehouse...

ext.ext_cn: 现在可用机器将橄榄装进罐子里。
ext.ext_en: Machines now exist to pack olives in jars.

defs.def_en: When people pack things, for example in a factory, they put them into containers or parcels so that they can be transported and sold.

ext.ext_cn: 几十万人挤进了那座清真寺。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of thousands of people packed into the mosque...

ext.ext_cn: 将有7万人挤满整个体育场。
ext.ext_en: Seventy thousand people will pack the stadium.

defs.def_en: If people or things pack into a place or if they pack a place, there are so many of them that the place is full.

ext.ext_cn: 这家俱乐部会邮寄一个免费资料包。
ext.ext_en: The club will send a free information pack.

ext.ext_cn: 一包烟
ext.ext_en: ...a pack of cigarettes...

defs.def_en: A pack of things is a collection of them that is sold or given together in a box or bag.

ext.ext_cn: 我把钱藏在旅行包里。
ext.ext_en: I hid the money in my pack.

defs.def_en: A pack is a bag containing your possessions that you carry on your back when you are travelling.

ext.ext_cn: 一群急着要问他问题的记者
ext.ext_en: ...a pack of journalists eager to question him...

ext.ext_cn: 萨尔是这伙人的头儿。
ext.ext_en: Sal was the leader of the pack.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a group of people who go around together as a pack, especially when it is a large group that you feel threatened by.
A pack of wolves or dogs is a group of them that hunt together.

ext.ext_cn: 一副纸牌
ext.ext_en: ...a pack of cards.

ext.ext_cn: 洗牌
ext.ext_en: ...shuffle the pack.

defs.def_en: A pack of playing cards is a complete set of playing cards.

ext.ext_cn: 8名保镖，其中至少有1人佩枪
ext.ext_en: ...eight bodyguards, at least one of them packing a pistol.

defs.def_en: If someone packs a gun, they carry it.

defs.def_cn: 在（陪审团、委员会、会议等）中安插支持者

ext.ext_cn: 反对党派抵制了该议程，声称政府在大会上安插了亲信。
ext.ext_en: Opposition parties have boycotted the proceedings, saying the government has packed the conference with its own supporters...

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·梅杰不会在上议院安插亲信。
ext.ext_en: John Major will not try to pack the House of Lords.

defs.def_en: If someone packs a jury, committee, or meeting, they make sure that it includes people who support them.

ext.ext_cn: 你跟我说的都是一派胡言。
ext.ext_en: You told me a pack of lies.

defs.def_en: If you say that an account is a pack of lies, you mean that it is completely untrue.

ext.ext_cn: 威廉·萨默塞特·毛姆的小说仍具有强烈的情感冲击力。
ext.ext_en: W. Somerset Maugham's novel still packs an emotional punch.

ext.ext_cn: 烈酒
ext.ext_en: ...drinks that pack a punch.

defs.def_en: If something packs a punch, it has a very powerful effect.

ext.ext_cn: 我决定要一个人生活，于是叫他走人。
ext.ext_en: I decided I wanted to live alone and I sent him packing.

defs.def_en: If you send someone packing,  you make them go away.

ext.ext_cn: 社会党最终仍可能会领先。
ext.ext_en: The Socialists may still finish ahead of the pack...

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲已经习惯了跟从，而不是领头儿。
ext.ext_en: Europe has got used to following rather than leading the pack.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone is ahead of the pack or leading the pack if they are ahead of everyone else in a race or competition.
A flowerbed is an area of ground in a garden or park which has been specially prepared so that flowers can be grown in it.

defs.def_cn: (通常摆放在显眼的地方，图片丰富，供浏览用的)大开本精装图书
defs.def_en: A coffee-table book is a large expensive book with a lot of pictures, which is designed to be looked at rather than to be read properly, and is usually placed where people can see it easily.

ext.ext_cn: 经验和知识的积累
ext.ext_en: ...an accumulation of experience and knowledge.

ext.ext_cn: 积尘
ext.ext_en: ...accumulations of dirt.

defs.def_en: An accumulation of something is a large number of things which have been collected together or acquired over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 资本的积累和收入的分配
ext.ext_en: ...the accumulation of capital and the distribution of income...

ext.ext_cn: 积累的速度随着时间变慢。
ext.ext_en: The rate of accumulation decreases with time.

defs.def_en: Accumulation is the collecting together of things over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 他开始系鞋带。
ext.ext_en: He began to tie his shoelaces.

defs.def_en: Shoelaces are long, narrow pieces of material like pieces of string that you use to fasten your shoes.

ext.ext_cn: 当地的经济学者们预测到会出现一些相当棘手的问题。
ext.ext_en: Local economists have looked into their crystal balls and seen something rather nasty...

ext.ext_cn: 不要忘了这些只是指导方针：我不能预测未来。
ext.ext_en: Remember that these are only guidelines: I don't have a crystal ball.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone, especially an expert, looks into a crystal ball, you mean that they are trying to predict the future. Crystal balls are traditionally used by fortune-tellers.
Your in-laws are the parents and close relatives of your husband or wife.
The hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle is the side opposite its right angle.

defs.def_cn: 荷兰裔南非白人的；布尔人的

ext.ext_cn: 他们称他背叛了自己的族人南非白人。
ext.ext_en: They called him a traitor to his Afrikaner people.

defs.def_en: Afrikaner means belonging or relating to the white people in South Africa whose ancestors were Dutch.

ext.ext_cn: 他的画把威尔士亲王给迷住了。
ext.ext_en: His paintings beguiled the Prince of Wales...

ext.ext_cn: 我被马拉喀什露天市场的浪漫情调和异域风情深深地吸引了。
ext.ext_en: I was beguiled by the romance and exotic atmosphere of the souks in Marrakech.

defs.def_en: If something beguiles you, you are charmed and attracted by it.

ext.ext_cn: 他利用他的报纸诱骗读者买他公司的股票。
ext.ext_en: He used his newspapers to beguile the readers into buying shares in his company.

defs.def_en: If someone beguiles you into doing something, they trick you into doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 一位全神贯注的观众心存恭敬的静默
ext.ext_en: ...the reverent hush of a rapt audience...

ext.ext_cn: 埃伦看起来近乎虔诚。
ext.ext_en: Ellen looks almost reverent.

defs.def_en: If you describe some-one's behaviour as reverent, you mean that they are showing great respect for a person or thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 饥荒再次席卷了那个蒙昧的国家。
ext.ext_en: Famine hit that benighted country once more.

defs.def_en: If you describe people or the place where they live as benighted, you think they are unfortunate or do not know anything.

ext.ext_cn: 贝多芬的第101和111号奏鸣曲
ext.ext_en: ...Beethoven's Op. 101 and 111 sonatas.

defs.def_en: In music, op. is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) opus.

ext.ext_cn: 他周五过90大寿。
ext.ext_en: He celebrates his ninetieth birthday on Friday.

defs.def_en: The ninetieth item in a series is the one that you count as number ninety.

defs.def_cn: （铁路上的）行李车厢，货车车厢，邮车
defs.def_en: A boxcar is a railway carriage, often without windows, which is used to carry luggage, goods, or mail.

ext.ext_cn: 中午，大家都会下楼去雷吉餐馆。
ext.ext_en: At midday everyone would go down to Reg's Cafe...

ext.ext_cn: 现在的时间是正午过8分钟。
ext.ext_en: It's eight minutes after midday.

defs.def_en: Midday is twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.

defs.def_cn: 中午时分(指中午12点钟前后的一段时间)

ext.ext_cn: 在正午时分的热浪之中，人们开始感到疲倦。
ext.ext_en: People were beginning to tire in the midday heat.

defs.def_en: Midday is the middle part of the day, from late morning to early afternoon.

ext.ext_cn: 这一聚合物的性质目前是个商业机密。
ext.ext_en: The nature of the polymer is currently a trade secret.

defs.def_en: A trade secret is information that is known, used, and kept secret by a particular firm, for example about a method of production or a chemical process.

ext.ext_cn: 我不愿就此多谈，因为我不想泄露秘密。
ext.ext_en: I'd rather not talk about it too much because I don't like giving trade secrets away.

defs.def_en: A trade secret is a piece of knowledge that you have, especially about how to do something, that you are not willing to tell other people.

defs.def_cn: 管理层收购（缩略形式为MBO）

ext.ext_cn: 头三项特许权中有两项给予了由英国铁路公司前管理层负责的管理层收购项目。
ext.ext_en: Of the first three franchises to be awarded, two went to management buyouts led by former BR executives.

defs.def_en: A management buyout is the buying of a company by its managers. The abbreviation MBO is also used.

defs.def_cn: 古老而不寻常的东西;历史文物;珍贵文物

ext.ext_cn: 终有一天，今天这些还是价值不菲的战争武器，明天它们就会进入历史的博物馆。
ext.ext_en: One day these are multi-million dollar war machines and the next they are museum pieces.

defs.def_en: If you describe an object or building as a museum piece, you mean that it is old and unusual.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 神经紧张的;担忧的;焦虑的

ext.ext_cn: 该党对赢得下一次选举的前景深感忧虑。
ext.ext_en: The party has become deeply nervous about its prospects of winning the next election...

ext.ext_cn: 据她描述，哈钦森先生自从妻子失踪后变得神经兮兮、一惊一乍的。
ext.ext_en: She described Mr Hutchinson as nervous and jumpy after his wife's disappearance.

defs.def_en: If someone is nervous, they are frightened or worried about something that is happening or might happen, and show this in their behaviour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她显然是一个很神经质的女人，这一点影响了她的事业。
ext.ext_en: She was apparently a very nervous woman, and that affected her career.

defs.def_en: A nervous person is very tense and easily upset.

ext.ext_cn: 该地区神经紊乱患者的人数在上升。
ext.ext_en: The number of nervous disorders was rising in the region...

ext.ext_cn: 人们开始不停地纠正他的错误，之后他的神经就出现了问题。
ext.ext_en: He developed nervous problems after people began repeatedly correcting him.

defs.def_en: A nervous illness or condition is one that affects your emotions and your mental state.

ext.ext_cn: 宽阔的林阴道
ext.ext_en: ...the broad, tree-lined avenues.

defs.def_en: A tree-lined road or street has trees on either side.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 骇人听闻的;极不公正的

ext.ext_cn: 多年来，她一直忍受着这种骇人听闻的暴行。
ext.ext_en: She endured the monstrous behaviour for years...

ext.ext_cn: 我只是希望犯下这种骇人罪行的人能承受良心的谴责。
ext.ext_en: I just hope the people who committed this monstrous evil will be able to live with themselves.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation or event as monstrous, you mean that it is extremely shocking or unfair.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （令人不悦之物）巨大的;特大规模的

ext.ext_cn: 又大又难看的铜制建筑物
ext.ext_en: ...a monstrous copper edifice...

ext.ext_cn: 狂风肆虐。
ext.ext_en: It was blowing a monstrous gale.

defs.def_en: If you describe an unpleasant thing as monstrous, you mean that it is extremely large in size or extent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 电影里虚构出来的恐怖形象
ext.ext_en: ...the film's monstrous fantasy figure.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as monstrous, you mean that it is extremely frightening because it appears unnatural or ugly.

defs.def_cn: 统治的;支配的;掌权的;执政的

ext.ext_cn: 墨西哥的选民们对执政党越来越多的不满
ext.ext_en: ...the Mexican voters' growing dissatisfaction with the ruling party.

ext.ext_cn: 统治阶级的管制
ext.ext_en: ...the domination of the ruling class.

defs.def_en: The ruling group of people in a country or organization is the group that controls its affairs.

defs.def_cn: (法官或法院作出的)裁决，裁定

ext.ext_cn: 古德温想推翻法院作出的裁决。
ext.ext_en: Goodwin tried to have the court ruling overturned...

ext.ext_cn: 高级法院裁决应强制她进食以挽救她的性命，她对此提起上诉。
ext.ext_en: She appealed against a High Court ruling that she should be forcibly fed to save her life.

defs.def_en: A ruling is an official decision made by a judge or court.

defs.def_cn: （热情或感情）占支配地位的，最强烈的

ext.ext_cn: 他们脑子里只有情欲。
ext.ext_en: Their ruling passion is that of carnal love.

defs.def_en: Someone's ruling passion or emotion is the feeling they have most strongly, which influences their actions.

ext.ext_cn: “本为什么要那样做？”她哽咽着问。
ext.ext_en: 'Why did Ben do that?' she asked, in a choked voice...

ext.ext_cn: 一个年轻的新兵起立致谢，激动得声音哽咽。
ext.ext_en: One young conscript rose with a message of thanks, his voice choked with emotion.

defs.def_en: If you say something in a choked voice or if your voice is choked with emotion, your voice does not have its full sound, because you are upset or frightened.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 非常生气的;非常伤心的

ext.ext_cn: 我还在为他的离去感到难过。
ext.ext_en: I still feel choked about him leaving.

defs.def_en: If you feel choked about something, you are very angry or upset about it.

ext.ext_cn: 这样的丑事，唉，也不是没有。
ext.ext_en: Such scandals have not, alas, been absent...

ext.ext_cn: 哎呀，事情不是那么简单的。
ext.ext_en: Alas, it's not that simple.

defs.def_en: You use alas to say that you think that the facts you are talking about are sad or unfortunate.

defs.def_cn: 资助(金);赞助(金);资金支持

ext.ext_cn: 坎贝尔是越来越多需要得到资助的滑雪运动员之一。
ext.ext_en: Campbell is one of an ever-growing number of skiers in need of sponsorship...

ext.ext_cn: 个人赞助只占去年所有艺术基金的三分之一。
ext.ext_en: Private sponsorships only accounted for a third of all arts funding last year.

defs.def_en: Sponsorship is financial support given by a sponsor.

ext.ext_cn: 如果方式得当的话，艺术赞助可能比做广告更有效。
ext.ext_en: When it is done properly, arts sponsorship can be more effective than advertising.

defs.def_en: Sponsorship of something is the act of sponsoring it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们用钥匙打开门进去了。
ext.ext_en: They put the key in the door and entered...

ext.ext_cn: 她伸手拿外套和汽车钥匙。
ext.ext_en: She reached for her coat and car keys.

defs.def_en: A key is a specially shaped piece of metal that you place in a lock and turn in order to open or lock a door, or to start or stop the engine of a vehicle.
The keys on a computer keyboard or typewriter are the buttons that you press in order to operate it.
The keys of a piano or organ are the long narrow pieces of wood or plastic that you press in order to play it.

ext.ext_cn: A小调
ext.ext_en: ...the key of A minor.

defs.def_en: In music, a key is a scale of musical notes that starts on one specific note.

defs.def_cn: （地图、图解或科技书籍的）略语表，符号表，凡例

ext.ext_cn: 你会在书的前面找到略语表。
ext.ext_en: You will find a key at the front of the book.

defs.def_en: The key on a map or diagram or in a technical book is a list of the symbols or abbreviations used and their meanings.

ext.ext_cn: 他将成为审判的关键证人。
ext.ext_en: He is expected to be the key witness at the trial...

ext.ext_cn: 在下届选举中教育可能成为最重要的一个议题。
ext.ext_en: Education is likely to be a key issue in the next election.

defs.def_en: The key person or thing in a group is the most important one.

ext.ext_cn: 成功的关键在于从一开始就要准备充分。
ext.ext_en: The key to success is to be ready from the start...

ext.ext_cn: 限制饮食和放松身心是保持健康的两个要诀。
ext.ext_en: Diet and relaxation are two important keys to good health.

defs.def_en: The key to a desirable situation or result is the way in which it can be achieved.

ext.ext_cn: 埋葬在伦敦一所古老教堂的地下室的人们
ext.ext_en: ...people buried in the crypt of an old London church.

defs.def_en: A crypt is an underground room underneath a church or cathedral.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 胆小的;害羞的;缺乏自信的

ext.ext_cn: 伊莎贝拉是一个羞怯的孩子，很小就学会了顺从。
ext.ext_en: A timid child, Isabella had learned obedience at an early age.

defs.def_en: Timid people are shy, nervous, and have no courage or confidence in themselves.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 犹豫不决的;瞻前顾后的

ext.ext_cn: 批评总统的人认为他在应对风云变幻的国际局势时过于瞻前顾后。
ext.ext_en: The President's critics say he has been too timid in responding to changing international developments...

ext.ext_cn: 该报称这一计划谨小慎微，毫无想象力。
ext.ext_en: The newspaper called the plan timid and unimaginative.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's attitudes or actions as timid, you are criticizing them for being too cautious or slow to act, because they are nervous about the possible consequences of their actions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 暴躁的;粗暴无礼的;乖戾的

ext.ext_cn: 他变得对我粗暴无礼。
ext.ext_en: He became surly and rude towards me.

defs.def_en: Someone who is surly behaves in a rude bad-tempered way.

defs.def_cn: 按（汽车喇叭）;（汽车喇叭）鸣响

ext.ext_cn: 我开车接女孩出去约会时从不按喇叭。
ext.ext_en: I never hoot my horn when I pick a girl up for a date...

ext.ext_cn: 远处某个地方响起了警报声。
ext.ext_en: Somewhere in the distance a siren hooted...

defs.def_en: If you hoot the horn on a vehicle or if it hoots, it makes a loud noise on one note.

defs.def_cn: 高声大笑;（表示反对而）喊叫

ext.ext_cn: 抗议者喊着口号、吹着哨子，并大声尖叫着皮特·威尔逊州长的名字。
ext.ext_en: The protesters chanted, blew whistles and hooted at the name of Governor Pete Wilson...

ext.ext_cn: 贝夫高声大笑。
ext.ext_en: Bev hooted with laughter.

defs.def_en: If you hoot, you make a loud high-pitched noise when you are laughing or showing disapproval.

ext.ext_cn: 外面的花园里突然有一只猫头鹰呜呜地叫起来。
ext.ext_en: Out in the garden an owl hooted suddenly.

defs.def_en: When an owl hoots, it makes a sound like a long 'oo'.

ext.ext_cn: 我最喜欢迈克尔·菲什。他滑稽逗趣，是个实实在在的人物。
ext.ext_en: Michael Fish is my favourite. He's a hoot, a real character.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is a hoot, you think they are very amusing.

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦对爱尔兰政治毫不关心。
ext.ext_en: Alan doesn't care two hoots about Irish politics...

ext.ext_cn: 他们根本毫不在乎。
ext.ext_en: They just don't give a hoot.

defs.def_en: If you say that you don'tgive a hoot or don't care two hoots about something, you are emphasizing that you do not care at all about it.
If someone goes on a joyride, they steal a car and drive around in it at high speed.

defs.def_cn: 反主流文化;反正统文化

ext.ext_cn: 英国反主流文化的历史
ext.ext_en: ...a history of British counter-culture.

defs.def_en: Counter-culture is a set of values, ideas, and ways of behaving that are completely different from those of the rest of society.

ext.ext_cn: 不是所有人都加入反主流文化群体，不是所有人都示威游行，退学，吸毒，或逃避服兵役。
ext.ext_en: Not everyone joined the counterculture, not everyone demonstrated, dropped out, took drugs, or dodged the draft.

defs.def_en: A counter-culture is a group in society whose values, ideas, and ways of behaving are completely different from those of the rest of society.

ext.ext_cn: 他感到腹部剧痛。
ext.ext_en: He was suffering from pains in his abdomen.

defs.def_en: Your abdomen is the part of your body below your chest where your stomach and intestines are.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 品貌兼优的；英俊潇洒的

ext.ext_cn: 我见到的是一些聪明、成熟、品貌兼优的人。
ext.ext_en: The people I met were intelligent, mature, personable.

defs.def_en: Someone who is personable has a pleasant appearance and character.

ext.ext_cn: 我的衬裙已经蹿到臀部，厚厚地卷成一圈。
ext.ext_en: My underskirt had ridden up into a thick band around my hips.

ext.ext_en: Women are also wearing fur again.

ext.ext_en: There were women in furs and men in comfortable overcoats.

ext.ext_cn: 1922 年委员会上个星期的会议又一次引发了保守党后座议员激烈的争吵。

ext.ext_en: Oxidized cholesterol may be responsible for furring up the arteries.

defs.def_en: If your veins or arteries fur up or are furred up, they become blocked, so that your blood cannot flow properly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 达成协议更是为时尚远。
ext.ext_en: Agreement is even further off.

defs.def_en: If you describe a moment in time as far off, you mean that it is a long time from the present, either in the past or the future.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 遥远星系中的恒星
ext.ext_en: ...stars in far-off galaxies.

ext.ext_en: The band was playing far off in their blue and yellow uniforms.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as far off, you mean that it is a long distance from you or from a particular place.

ext.ext_cn: 一人遭雷击致死。
ext.ext_en: One man died when he was struck by lightning...

ext.ext_en: Another flash of lightning lit up the cave.

defs.def_en: See also:forked lightning;Lightning is the very bright flashes of light in the sky that happen during thunderstorms.

ext.ext_cn: 如今开车需要反应极其迅速。
ext.ext_en: Driving today demands lightning reflexes.

defs.def_en: Lightning describes things that  happen very quickly or last for only a short time.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在他的膝盖上涂了些药膏并打上了绷带。

ext.ext_cn: 他的胸部缠着绷带。
ext.ext_en: His chest was swathed in bandages.

defs.def_en: A bandage is a long strip of cloth which is wrapped around a wounded part of someone's body to protect or support it.

ext.ext_cn: 给伤口盖上敷料并用绷带包扎起来。
ext.ext_en: Apply a dressing to the wound and bandage it.

ext.ext_cn: 缠着绷带的手
ext.ext_en: ...a bandaged hand.

defs.def_en: If you bandage a wound or part of someone's body, you tie a bandage around it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 热烈赞扬的；热情洋溢的

ext.ext_cn: 媒体一直盛赞两国关系。
ext.ext_en: The media has been speaking in glowing terms of the relationship between the two countries...

ext.ext_en: The premieres of his plays brought in glowing reviews.

defs.def_en: See also:glow;A glowing description or opinion about someone or something praises them highly or supports them strongly.

defs.def_cn: (通常指为了避免麻烦和责难而)与…断绝关系，表明与…没有关系

ext.ext_cn: 总统越来越难摆脱这一丑闻了。
ext.ext_en: It is getting harder for the president to dissociate himself from the scandal.

defs.def_en: If you dissociate yourself from something or someone, you say or show that you are not connected with them, usually in order to avoid trouble or blame.

ext.ext_cn: 如何将理智和情感分开几乎可以说是他们所上的第一课。
ext.ext_en: Almost the first lesson they learn is how to dissociate emotion from reason.

defs.def_en: If you dissociate one thing from another, you consider the two things as separate from each other, or you separate them.

ext.ext_cn: 几钵干玫瑰花瓣
ext.ext_en: ...bowls of dried rose petals.

defs.def_en: The petals of a flower are the thin coloured or white parts which together form the flower.

defs.def_cn: 宇宙;大千世界;整个社会；复杂而系统的整体

ext.ext_cn: 心灵天地是万千宇宙的缩影。
ext.ext_en: The macrocosm of the universe is mirrored in the microcosm of the mind.

defs.def_en: A macrocosm is a complex organized system such as the universe or a society, considered as a single unit.

ext.ext_cn: 两名男士微笑着面对镜头，东拉西扯着。
ext.ext_en: Smiling for the cameras, the two men strained to make small- talk.

defs.def_en: Small talk is polite conversation about unimportant things that people make at social occasions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Her cheeks were puffy with crying.

ext.ext_cn: 眼圈发黑、眼泡肿起
ext.ext_en: ...dark-ringed puffy eyes.

defs.def_en: If a part of someone's body, especially their face, is puffy, it has a round, swollen appearance.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 大海一片蔚蓝，朵朵白云飘过。
ext.ext_en: The sea was blue, and white puffy clouds sailed by.

defs.def_en: If you describe a cloud as puffy, you mean that it looks like a large ball of white cotton wool. Puffy clouds appear during fine weather.

ext.ext_cn: 一堆旧照片和剪报
ext.ext_en: ...a stack of old photographs and newspaper cuttings...

ext.ext_en: Here are the press cuttings and reviews.

defs.def_en: A cutting is a  piece of writing which has been cut from a newspaper or magazine.

ext.ext_cn: 7月或8月时从它上边剪一些插枝。
ext.ext_en: Take cuttings from it in July or August.

defs.def_en: A cutting from a plant is a part of the plant that you have cut off so that you can grow a new plant from it.

defs.def_cn: (在山中开凿的供铁路或道路通过的)狭窄通道，路堑
defs.def_en: A cutting is a narrow valley cut through a hill so that a railway line or road can pass through.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 人们说话尖酸刻薄是为了使自己感觉高高在上或是有权有势。
ext.ext_en: People make cutting remarks to help themselves feel superior or powerful.

defs.def_en: A cutting remark is unkind and likely to hurt someone's feelings.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: His dark hair was just tinged with grey...

defs.def_en: If something is tinged with a particular colour, it has a small amount of that colour in it.

ext.ext_en: …the jazz-tinged rock of the early Seventies.

defs.def_en: If something is tinged with a particular feeling or quality, it has or shows a small amount of that feeling or quality. 略

ext.ext_en: He conducted the meeting in his usual combative style, refusing to admit any mistakes.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as brainless, you mean that you think they are stupid.

ext.ext_en: How could she tell beforehand that I was going to go out?...

ext.ext_en: Saunas can be hazardous if misused. Avoid a big meal beforehand.

defs.def_en: If you do something beforehand, you do it earlier than a particular event.

ext.ext_en: She gabbles on about drug dealers and journalists...

defs.def_en: If you gabble, you say things so quickly that it is difficult for people to understand you.

ext.ext_en: The interchange of ideas illumines the debate...

ext.ext_en: The accident was caused by people slowing down to rubber-neck.

defs.def_en: If someone is rubbernecking, they are staring at someone or something, especially in a rude or silly way.

ext.ext_en: These drugs will not be used if hemorrhage is the cause of the stroke.

defs.def_en: A haemorrhage is serious bleeding inside a person's body.

ext.ext_en: I haemorrhaged badly after the birth of all three of my sons...

ext.ext_en: If this is left untreated, one can actually haemorrhage to death.

ext.ext_en: Venice is haemorrhaging the very resource which could save it: its own people...

ext.ext_en: The figures showed that cash was haemorrhaging from the conglomerate.

defs.def_cn: （花园或树林中的）树阴，阴凉处

ext.ext_en: The city bears the imprint of Japanese investment...

ext.ext_en: The ground still bore the imprints of their feet.

defs.def_en: An imprint is a mark or outline made by the pressure of one object on another.

ext.ext_en: Stationery can be imprinted with your message or logo...

defs.def_en: If a surface is imprinted with a mark or design, that mark or design is printed on the surface or pressed into it.

ext.ext_en: ...a slice of wholemeal toast.

ext.ext_cn: 一片白面包和一片全麦面包
ext.ext_en: ...one slice of white and one of wholemeal.

defs.def_en: Wholemeal means wholemeal bread or wholemeal flour.

ext.ext_cn: 谁还要再满上？
ext.ext_en: Anyone ready for a top-up?

defs.def_cn: (贷款或支付款项)补足的，追加的

ext.ext_en: Student grants will be frozen at existing levels and top-up loans made available.

defs.def_en: A top-up loan or payment is added to an amount of money in order to bring it up to a required level.

defs.def_cn: 买主自负其责;货物售出，概不退换
defs.def_en: Caveat emptor means 'let the buyer beware', and is a warning to someone buying something that it is their responsibility to identify and accept any faults in it.

defs.def_cn: (事物或团体间的)显著差距，巨大分歧

ext.ext_cn: 将大学和企业两个世界分隔开的鸿沟
ext.ext_en: ...the chasm that divides the worlds of university and industry.

ext.ext_cn: 美国显著的贫富差距
ext.ext_en: ...the chasm between rich and poor in America.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is a chasm between two things or between two groups of people, you mean that there is a very large difference between them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不敏感的;感觉迟钝的;麻木不仁的

ext.ext_cn: 我感觉丈夫对我的问题麻木不仁。
ext.ext_en: I feel my husband is very insensitive about my problem.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as insensitive, you are criticizing them for being unaware of or unsympathetic to other people's feelings.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 漠视的;不在乎的;毫不在意的

ext.ext_en: Women's and Latino organizations that say he is insensitive to civil rights.

defs.def_en: Someone who is insensitive to a situation or to a need does not think or care about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他对寒冷已经没有感觉了。
ext.ext_en: He had become insensitive to cold.

defs.def_en: Someone who is insensitive to a physical sensation is unable to feel it.

ext.ext_cn: 这一罪行如此卑鄙无耻，大家都不想声张出去。
ext.ext_en: The crime was so base that everyone wanted to hush it up...

ext.ext_cn: 部里拼命想隐瞒整个事件。
ext.ext_en: The Ministry desperately tried to hush up the whole affair.

defs.def_en: If someone hushes something up, they prevent other people from knowing about it.

ext.ext_cn: 保守党政府很快就堵住了他的嘴。
ext.ext_en: The Conservative Government was only too quick to hush him up.

defs.def_en: If people in authority hush someone up, they try to stop that person revealing information which they want to keep secret.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 缺乏才智的；愚蠢的；无知的

ext.ext_en: He believes him to be a weak and unintelligent man...

ext.ext_cn: 他一点不蠢。
ext.ext_en: He certainly was not unintelligent.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as unintelligent, you mean that they are stupid, or do not show any sensible ideas or thoughts.

ext.ext_cn: 为了挽救他的生命，医生们截掉了他的双腿。
ext.ext_en: To save his life, doctors amputated his legs...

ext.ext_en: They were warlike and imperialistic.

ext.ext_cn: 一大瓶香槟
ext.ext_en: ...a magnum of champagne.

ext.ext_cn: 银行的地方市场份额通常会在当地分行和其他各地分行之间平均分配。
ext.ext_en: A bank's local market share tends to be divided equally between the local branch and branches located elsewhere...

ext.ext_cn: 尽量养成每天至少吃3顿小餐的习惯，而且每餐的间隔要相同。
ext.ext_en: Try to get into the habit of eating at least three small meals a day, at equally spaced intervals.

ext.ext_en: Success doesn't only depend on what you do. What you don't do is equally important.

defs.def_en: If you are infatuated with a person or thing, you have strong feelings of love or passion for them which make you unable to think clearly or sensibly about them.

ext.ext_en: To write and publish this poem was a daring, transgressive act.

ext.ext_en: Exorbitant housing prices have created an acute shortage of affordable housing for the poor.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a price or fee as exorbitant, you are emphasizing that it is much greater than it should be.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If one object impacts on another, it hits it with great force.

ext.ext_en: He walks with a stick but still leads his soldiers into battle...

defs.def_en: If you lead a group of people, you walk or ride in front of them.

defs.def_cn: 给…引路（或带路）；带…（到某处）

ext.ext_en: He took Dickon by the hand to lead him into the house...

ext.ext_cn: 她交代人是她杀的，并带警察去他的尸首处。
ext.ext_en: She confessed to the killing and led police to his remains...

defs.def_en: If you lead someone to a particular place or thing, you take them there.

ext.ext_en: ...the doors that led to the yard.

ext.ext_cn: 通往停车场的一小段路
ext.ext_en: ...a short roadway leading to the car park...

defs.def_en: If a road, gate, or door leads somewhere, you can get there by following the road or going through the gate or door.

ext.ext_en: So far Fischer leads by five wins to two...

defs.def_en: If you are leading at a particular point in a race or competition, you are winning at that point.

defs.def_cn: 领先的地位；占先的位置

ext.ext_en: England took the lead after 31 minutes with a goal by Peter Nail...

ext.ext_cn: 工党在民意测验中仍然领先。
ext.ext_en: Labour are still in the lead in the opinion polls.

defs.def_en: If you have the lead or are in the lead in a race or competition, you are winning.

ext.ext_en: ...a commanding lead for the opposition is clearly emerging throughout the country...

ext.ext_cn: 他的进球使森林队以两球领先南安普敦队。
ext.ext_en: His goal gave Forest a two-goal lead against Southampton...

defs.def_en: Someone's lead over a competitor at a particular point in a race or competition is the distance, amount of time, or number of points by which they are ahead of them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不仅引领欧洲而且引领着全球的流行音乐潮流。
ext.ext_en: When it comes to pop music we not only lead Europe, we lead the world.

ext.ext_cn: 玛莎百货等在微波炉食品市场占主导地位的食品卖场
ext.ext_en: ...foodstores such as Marks & Spencer, which led the market in microwaveable meals.

defs.def_en: If one company or country leads others in a particular activity such as scientific research or business, it is more successful or advanced than they are in that activity.

ext.ext_cn: 1949到1984年间他是该国领导人。
ext.ext_en: He led the country between 1949 and 1984...

ext.ext_cn: 门德斯先生正领导一场运动，以拯救遭到乱砍滥伐的巴西热带雨林。
ext.ext_en: Mr Mendes was leading a campaign to save Brazil's rainforest from exploitation.

defs.def_en: If you lead a group of people, an organization, or an activity, you are in control or in charge of the people or the activity.

ext.ext_cn: 需要总统树立一个道德榜样
ext.ext_en: ...the need for the president to give a moral lead...

ext.ext_cn: 美国和日本海军是发展海军航空部队的佼佼者。
ext.ext_en: The American and Japanese navies took the lead in the development of naval aviation...

defs.def_en: If you give a lead, you do something new or develop new ideas or methods that other people consider to be a good example or model to follow.

ext.ext_cn: 她和弟弟妹妹一起过着平凡而幸福的生活。
ext.ext_en: She led a normal, happy life with her sister and brother...

ext.ext_en: Most of the women in here are not people who have led a life of crime.

ext.ext_en: Ethnic tensions among the republics could lead to civil war...

ext.ext_cn: 他昨天警告说，给教师们加薪会导致职位的裁减。
ext.ext_en: He warned yesterday that a pay rise for teachers would lead to job cuts.

defs.def_en: If something leads to a situation or event, usually an unpleasant one, it begins a process which causes that situation or event to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 对种族主义的憎恨促使他写了《阿尔及尔汽车旅馆事件》一书。
ext.ext_en: His abhorrence of racism led him to write The Algiers Motel Incident...

ext.ext_cn: 最终是什么让你离开萨拉热窝前往萨格勒布的？
ext.ext_en: What was it ultimately that led you to leave Sarajevo for Zagreb?

defs.def_en: If something leads you to do something, it influences or affects you in such a way that you do it.

ext.ext_cn: 母亲让我相信新出生的宝宝是给我的一个礼物。
ext.ext_en: Mother had led me to believe the new baby was a kind of present for me...

ext.ext_cn: 这事并非如我们所误以为的那样简单。
ext.ext_en: It was not as straightforward as we were led to believe.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something led you to think something, you mean that they caused you to think it, although it was not true or did not happen.

defs.def_cn: 引导，掌控（谈话或讨论的内容）

ext.ext_en: After a while I led the conversation around to her job...

ext.ext_en: He planned to lead the conversation and keep Matt from changing the subject.

defs.def_en: If you lead a conversation or discussion, you control the way that it develops so that you can introduce a particular subject.

ext.ext_cn: 这个嘛，我看这让我说到正题了。
ext.ext_en: Well, I think that leads me to the real point.

defs.def_en: You can say that one point or topic in a discussion or piece of writing leads you to another in order to introduce a new point or topic that is linked with the previous one.

ext.ext_cn: 在接到民众400个热线电话后，调查组亦在对可能的线索进行追踪。
ext.ext_en: The inquiry team is also following up possible leads after receiving 400 calls from the public.

defs.def_en: A lead is a piece of information or an idea which may help people to discover the facts in a situation where many facts are not known, for example in the investigation of a crime or in a scientific experiment.

defs.def_cn: （戏剧、电影等中的）主角；扮演主角的演员

ext.ext_cn: 由莫斯科大剧院芭蕾舞团的尼娜·阿纳尼阿什维利和阿列克谢·法捷耶切夫担纲演出。
ext.ext_en: Nina Ananiashvili and Alexei Fadeyechev from the Bolshoi Ballet dance the leads...

ext.ext_cn: 杰克·霍金斯和格莉妮斯·约翰斯主演。
ext.ext_en: The leads are Jack Hawkins and Glynis Johns.

defs.def_en: The lead in a play, film, or show is the most important part in it. The person who plays this part can also be called the lead.

ext.ext_cn: 一个年纪较大的男子牵着一条小狗走了出来。
ext.ext_en: An older man came out with a little dog on a lead.

defs.def_en: A  dog's lead is a long, thin chain or piece of leather which you attach to the dog's collar so that you can control the dog.
A lead in a piece of equipment is a piece of wire covered in plastic which supplies electricity to the equipment or carries it from one part of the equipment to another.

defs.def_cn: （报纸或电视、电台的）要闻，头条

ext.ext_cn: 土耳其局势将成为明天《卫报》的头条。
ext.ext_en: The Turkish situation makes the lead in tomorrow's Guardian...

ext.ext_cn: 科西加的反应成了意大利各大媒体的头条新闻。
ext.ext_en: Cossiga's reaction is the lead story in the Italian press.

defs.def_en: The lead story or lead in a newspaper or on the television or radio news is the most important story.

ext.ext_cn: 由老式铅管输送的饮用水
ext.ext_en: ...drinking water supplied by old-fashioned lead pipes.

defs.def_en: Lead is a soft, grey, heavy metal.

ext.ext_cn: 最后博加特开枪扫射，把他打成了马蜂窝。
ext.ext_en: Eventually Bogart pumps him full of lead.

defs.def_en: Lead is sometimes used to refer to bullets.
The lead in a pencil is the centre part of it which makes a mark on paper.

ext.ext_cn: 车灯照亮了路标。
ext.ext_en: The lights of the car lit up a signpost...

ext.ext_cn: 在路标处拐弯去往阿特尔桥。
ext.ext_en: Turn off at the signpost for Attlebridge.

defs.def_en: A signpost is a sign where roads meet that tells you which direction to go in to reach a particular place or different places.

ext.ext_cn: 明天的选举结果会被作为今年大选的选民意愿风向标来仔细研究。
ext.ext_en: The outcome of tomorrow's elections will be studied carefully as a signpost of voter intentions on the really big day this year...

ext.ext_cn: 这些事件都是将要进行变革的征兆。
ext.ext_en: These events were all signposts pointing toward change.

defs.def_en: A signpost is something that helps you to know how a situation or a course of action will develop.

ext.ext_cn: 两名律师被告知不得离开大楼,但对这一命令并没有提供任何理由。
ext.ext_en: Two lawyers were told not to leave the building but no reason for this instruction was given.

defs.def_en: An instruction is something that someone tells you to do.

ext.ext_cn: 向每位申请人都讲授了安全知识。
ext.ext_en: Each candidate is given instruction in safety...

ext.ext_cn: 现在所有的在校儿童都必须接受一定的宗教教育。
ext.ext_en: All schoolchildren must now receive some religious instruction.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you instruction in a subject or skill, they teach it to you.

ext.ext_cn: 在服药之前一定要先阅读说明书。
ext.ext_en: Always read the instructions before you start taking the medicine.

defs.def_en: Instructions are clear and detailed information on how to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 要确保投保金额不能过低。
ext.ext_en: Make sure that you are not underinsured...

ext.ext_cn: 维多利亚时代的雕花玻璃器皿或许是古玩玻璃器皿市场上价值被低估得最严重的一个品种。
ext.ext_en: Victorian cut glass is perhaps the most underpriced area of the antique glass market.

defs.def_en: Under- is used to form words that express the idea that there is not enough of something. For example if people are underfed, they are not getting enough food.

defs.def_cn: （置于表示工作或职位的名词前）表示“副…”，“次…”

ext.ext_cn: 新任的教育部副部长
ext.ext_en: ...the new undersecretary of education.

ext.ext_cn: 不愿与副经理打交道的客户
ext.ext_en: ...clients who wouldn't deal with an undermanager.

defs.def_en: Under- is added to the beginning of nouns that refer to a job or rank in order to form nouns that refer to a less important job or rank.

ext.ext_cn: 在任何国家的犯罪者中，十几二十几岁的青年男性都占了很高的比例。
ext.ext_en: A high proportion of crime in any country is perpetrated by young males in their teens and twenties...

ext.ext_cn: 对最贫穷和最没有特权的人们犯下了大量罪行。
ext.ext_en: Tremendous wrongs were being perpetrated on the poorest and least privileged human beings...

defs.def_en: If someone perpetrates a crime or any other immoral or harmful act, they do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些气垫船行驶速度最高可达35节，能够轻易地超过大多数船只。
ext.ext_en: Travelling at speeds of up to thirty five knots, these hovercraft can easily outpace most boats...

ext.ext_cn: 探险队乘气垫船到达了它的源头。
ext.ext_en: The expedition made the journey to its source by hovercraft.

defs.def_en: A hovercraft is a vehicle that can travel across land and water. It floats above the land or water on a cushion of air.

defs.def_cn: 取巧占上风的伎俩；总是想要胜人一筹的尝试

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个人在无关紧要的较量中取巧获胜时流露出的表情。
ext.ext_en: It was the expression of a man who'd won a trifling game of one-upmanship.

ext.ext_cn: 政治上高人一筹的伎俩
ext.ext_en: ...political one-upmanship.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's behaviour as one-upmanship, you disapprove of them trying to make other people feel inferior in order to make themselves appear more important.

defs.def_cn: 全职的;专职的;全日制的

ext.ext_cn: 全职工作
ext.ext_en: ...a full-time job.

ext.ext_cn: 专职员工
ext.ext_en: ...full-time staff.

defs.def_en: Full-time work or study involves working or studying for the whole of each normal working week rather than for part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 照顾孩子于她是一件不得空闲的苦差事。
ext.ext_en: The way she did it, mothering was a full-time job.

defs.def_en: If you describe a regular activity or task as a full-time job, you mean that it takes up so much of your time it is like doing a paid job.

ext.ext_cn: 比赛结束时阿森纳队和桑普多利亚队 1 比 1 战平。
ext.ext_en: The score at full-time was Arsenal 1, Sampdoria 1.

defs.def_en: In games such as football, full-time is the end of a match.

ext.ext_cn: 他到她家里，试图劝她回心转意。
ext.ext_en: He went to the house to try to talk her round...

ext.ext_cn: 它建议销售人员和犹豫不决、不愿购买的顾客一边喝茶，一边说服他们。
ext.ext_en: It advises salesmen to talk round reluctant customers over a cup of tea.

defs.def_en: If you talk someone round, you persuade them to change their mind so that they agree with you, or agree to do what you want them to do

defs.def_cn: 不怀好意地笑；猥亵地笑；淫笑

ext.ext_cn: 男人们吊儿郎当地站着，大口大口地喝着啤酒，偶尔还对着路过的女性猥亵地笑。
ext.ext_en: Men were standing around, swilling beer and occasionally leering at passing females...

ext.ext_cn: 他回头看了看肯沃西，色迷迷地笑了。
ext.ext_en: He looked back at Kenworthy and leered.

defs.def_en: If someone leers at you, they smile in an unpleasant way, usually because they are sexually interested in you.

ext.ext_cn: 德州仪器的股票因为资金从电信和因特网相关企业外逃而遭受损失。
ext.ext_en: TI has seen its shares suffer because of a flight of capital from telecom and Internet-related businesses...

defs.def_en: When people lose confidence in a particular economy or market and withdraw their investment from it, you can refer to a flight of capital from that economy or market.

defs.def_cn: 非人类的;不属于人类的

ext.ext_cn: 对外来者怀有敌意是人类和其他动物共有的特征。
ext.ext_en: Hostility towards outsiders is characteristic of both human and non-human animals.

defs.def_en: Non-human means not human or not produced by humans.

defs.def_cn: 中国的;汉语的;中国人的
defs.def_en: Something that is Chinese relates or belongs to China or its languages or people.

defs.def_cn: 中国话;汉语;(尤指)普通话
defs.def_en: The languages that are spoken in China, especially Mandarin, are often referred to as Chinese .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 家里有个好动的小孩会是相当累人的。
ext.ext_en: Having an active youngster about the house can be quite wearing.

ext.ext_cn: 漫长而忙碌的一生
ext.ext_en: ...a long and active life.

defs.def_en: Someone who is active moves around a lot or does a lot of things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 因为健康状况衰退而思维受阻的悲剧
ext.ext_en: ...the tragedy of an active mind trapped by failing physical health.

defs.def_en: If you have an active mind or imagination, you are always thinking of new things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 让父亲们更积极地参与育婴的机会
ext.ext_en: ...a chance for fathers to play a more active role in childcare...

ext.ext_cn: 我是保守党的积极分子。
ext.ext_en: I am an active member of the Conservative Party...

defs.def_en: If someone is active in an organization, cause, or campaign, they do things for it rather than just giving it their support.

ext.ext_cn: 各公司需要采取积极措施增加出口。
ext.ext_en: Companies need to take active steps to increase exports.

ext.ext_cn: 教师们的竭力阻挠
ext.ext_en: ...active discouragement from teachers.

defs.def_en: Active is used to emphasize that someone is taking action in order to achieve something, rather than just hoping for it or achieving it in an indirect way.

ext.ext_cn: 游击队在该省很活跃。
ext.ext_en: Guerrilla groups are active in the province.

ext.ext_cn: 夜行动物
ext.ext_en: ...animals which are active at night.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or animal is active in a particular place or at a particular time, you mean that they are performing their usual activities or performing a particular activity.

ext.ext_cn: 活火山喷出的熔岩
ext.ext_en: ...molten lava from an active volcano.

defs.def_en: An active volcano has erupted recently or is expected to erupt quite soon.

defs.def_cn: 起化学(或生物)作用的;活性的;有效的

ext.ext_cn: 某些漱口剂中的有效成分只不过是洗涤剂而已。
ext.ext_en: The active ingredient in some of the mouthwashes was simply detergent.

defs.def_en: An active substance has a chemical or biological effect on things.

In grammar, the active or the active voice means the forms of a verb which are used when the subject refers to a person or thing that does something. For example, in 'I saw her yesterday', the verb is in the active.
A spare tyre is a wheel with a tyre on it that you keep in your car in case you get a flat tyre and need to replace one of your wheels.
If you describe someone as having a spare tyre, you mean that they are fat around the waist.

defs.def_cn: 盎司（英国和美国的重量单位，1磅合16盎司，1盎司等于28.35克）

ext.ext_cn: 4盎司糖
ext.ext_en: ...four ounces of sugar.

defs.def_en: An ounce is a unit of weight used in Britain and the USA. There are sixteen ounces in a pound and one ounce is equal to 28.35 grams.

ext.ext_cn: 要是我父亲有一点点经商的头脑就好了。
ext.ext_en: If only my father had possessed an ounce of business sense...

ext.ext_cn: 我费尽力气想藏起来。
ext.ext_en: I spent every ounce of energy trying to hide.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a very small amount of something, such as a quality or characteristic, as an ounce .

ext.ext_cn: 生物医学研究将会使许多艾滋病患者延长生命、提高生命质量。
ext.ext_en: Biomedical research will enable many individuals infected with HIV to live longer, more comfortable lives.

ext.ext_cn: 生物医学的进步
ext.ext_en: ...the advance of biomedical science.

defs.def_en: Biomedical research examines the effects of drugs and medical techniques on the biological systems of living creatures.

defs.def_cn: 一点点，一小份(尤指食物)

ext.ext_cn: 一小块美味可口的肉
ext.ext_en: ...a delicious little morsel of meat.

defs.def_en: A morsel is a very small amount of something, especially a very small piece of food.

ext.ext_cn: 史蒂夫好像默认了这个决定。
ext.ext_en: Steve seemed to acquiesce in the decision...

ext.ext_cn: 他渐渐顺从了反对派的要求。
ext.ext_en: He has gradually acquiesced to the demands of the opposition...

defs.def_en: If you acquiesce in something, you agree to do what someone wants or to accept what they do.

ext.ext_cn: 警察在这个地区探测饵雷。
ext.ext_en: Police were checking the area for booby traps.

defs.def_en: A booby-trap is something such as a bomb which is hidden or disguised and which causes death or injury when it is touched.

defs.def_cn: 设置陷阱；布下饵雷；安放炸弹

ext.ext_cn: 对该地区可能布有饵雷的忧惧
ext.ext_en: ...fears that the area may have been booby trapped...

ext.ext_cn: 他那辆被安有炸弹的汽车爆炸了。
ext.ext_en: His booby-trapped car exploded.

defs.def_en: If something is booby-trapped, a booby-trap is placed in it or on it.

defs.def_cn: 增加…的品种;从事多种经营;（使）多样化

ext.ext_cn: 当公司增加新产品时，麻烦才开始的。
ext.ext_en: The company's troubles started only when it diversified into new products...

ext.ext_cn: 制造商们被鼓励要做到产品多样化。
ext.ext_en: Manufacturers have been encouraged to diversify...

defs.def_en: When an organization or person diversifies into other things, or diversifies their range of something, they increase the variety of things that they do or make.

defs.def_cn: 幼稚愚蠢的;毫无价值的

ext.ext_cn: 他谴责他称为幼稚愚蠢的改革者鼓吹不缴纳税款。
ext.ext_en: He denounced what he called toytown revolutionaries advocating non-payment of taxes...

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀使得卢布变成了毫无价值的货币。
ext.ext_en: Inflation has turned the rouble into a toytown currency.

defs.def_en: You use toytown to show that you think something is silly, childish, or worthless.

defs.def_cn: (用作正式信函或商业信函末尾署名前的套语)您的忠实的
defs.def_en: See also:faithful;When you start a formal or business letter with 'Dear Sir' or 'Dear Madam', you write Yours faithfully before your signature at the end.

ext.ext_cn: 我6点半醒来时，天又冷又黑。
ext.ext_en: It was cold and dark when I woke at 6.30...

ext.ext_cn: 直到阳光从窗外泻入，鲍勃才慢慢醒来。
ext.ext_en: Bob woke slowly to sunshine pouring in his window...

defs.def_en: When you wake or when someone or something wakes you, you become conscious again after being asleep.

defs.def_cn: (航行中的船等留下的)伴流，尾流，航迹

ext.ext_cn: 航行一直很顺利，直到他们碰上了商船的尾流。
ext.ext_en: The ride was smooth until they got into the merchant ship's wake...

ext.ext_cn: 有时海豚在船的尾流中嬉戏。
ext.ext_en: Dolphins sometimes play in the wake of the boats.

defs.def_en: The wake of a boat or other object moving in water is the track of waves that it makes behind it as it moves through the water.

ext.ext_cn: 正在进行葬礼守灵。
ext.ext_en: A funeral wake was in progress.

defs.def_en: A wake is a gathering or social event that is held before or after someone's funeral.

ext.ext_cn: 上周的大会过后，民意调查显示州长支持率大幅上升。
ext.ext_en: The governor has enjoyed a huge surge in the polls in the wake of last week's convention...

ext.ext_cn: 去年春天开始的罢工一结束，这家公司就进入了破产程序。
ext.ext_en: The company is in bankruptcy proceedings in the wake of a strike that began last spring.

defs.def_en: If one thing follows in the wake of another, it happens after the other thing is over, often as a result of it.

defs.def_cn: 醒着的时间;非睡眠时间

ext.ext_cn: 他醒着的时候大部分时间都在工作。
ext.ext_en: It was work which consumed most of his waking hours...

ext.ext_cn: 他们醒着时大部分时间都在吃东西。
ext.ext_en: Most of their waking hours are spent eating.

defs.def_en: Your waking hours are the times when you are awake rather than asleep.

ext.ext_cn: 亚当蹒跚而行，沿路留下毁坏的痕迹。
ext.ext_en: Adam stumbles on, leaving a trail of devastation in his wake...

ext.ext_cn: 坦克冲过临时搭建的路障，所过之处留下了燃烧的车辆。
ext.ext_en: The tanks left burning vehicles in their wake as they ploughed through makeshift barricades.

defs.def_en: If you leave something or someone in your wake, you leave them behind you as you go.

ext.ext_cn: 一位推着手推车的侍者紧随着他过来。
ext.ext_en: In his wake came a waiter wheeling a trolley.

ext.ext_cn: 无数效仿她发行专辑的女艺术家
ext.ext_en: ...the endless stream of female artists who released albums in her wake.

defs.def_en: If you are following in someone's wake, you are following them or their example.

ext.ext_cn: 艾丽斯·芒罗以文风沉郁闻名。
ext.ext_en: Alice Munro has a reputation for being a very depressing writer.

ext.ext_cn: 巴塞罗那作为一个具有设计意识的艺术城市的声誉
ext.ext_en: ...Barcelona's reputation as a design-conscious, artistic city.

defs.def_en: To have a reputation for something means to be known or remembered for it.

ext.ext_cn: 这所大学有良好的学术声誉。
ext.ext_en: This college has a good academic reputation...

ext.ext_cn: 这些传闻把他的名誉全毁了。
ext.ext_en: The stories ruined his reputation.

defs.def_en: Something's or someone's reputation is the opinion that people have about how good they are. If they have a good reputation, people think they are good.

ext.ext_cn: 听说她的组织能力很强。
ext.ext_en: She was by reputation a good organiser.

defs.def_en: If you know someone by reputation, you have never met them but you have heard of their reputation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一个富有创造力和尖锐幽默感的律师
ext.ext_en: ...a lawyer with an inventive mind and a waspish sense of humour.

defs.def_en: A waspish remark or sense of humour is sharp and critical.

ext.ext_cn: 查帕尔省的亚热带地区
ext.ext_en: ...the sub-tropical region of the Chapare.

defs.def_en: Sub-tropical places have a climate that is warm and wet, and are often near tropical regions.

ext.ext_cn: 景致迷人的亚热带植物园
ext.ext_en: ...a remarkable garden of sub-tropical plants.

defs.def_en: Sub-tropical plants and trees grow in places that are warm and wet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 人们对于将来仍然非常担心。
ext.ext_en: People are still terribly apprehensive about the future.

defs.def_en: Someone who is apprehensive is afraid that something bad may happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无计划的;杂乱无章的;任意的

ext.ext_cn: 调查工作确实看起来缺乏计划。
ext.ext_en: The investigation does seem haphazard...

ext.ext_cn: 他从没有见过像罗伯托那样毫无计划地拍摄电影的人。
ext.ext_en: He had never seen such a haphazard approach to filmmaking as Roberto's.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as haphazard, you are critical of it because it is not at all organized or is not arranged according to a plan.

ext.ext_cn: 委员会很关注运动员的行为，特别是与裁判争吵的行为。
ext.ext_en: The committee is concerned about players' behaviour, especially arguing with referees...

ext.ext_cn: 他们还在争吵；我在马路的那头都能听见他们的声音。
ext.ext_en: They were still arguing; I could hear them down the road.

defs.def_en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue .

ext.ext_cn: 别和我争辩。
ext.ext_en: Don't argue with me...

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们10点半上床睡觉。没有人敢说不。
ext.ext_en: The children go to bed at 10.30. No one dares argue.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone not to argue with you, you want them to do or believe what you say without protest or disagreement.

ext.ext_cn: 他正和国王讨论保留骑兵全部力量的必要性。
ext.ext_en: He was arguing with the King about the need to maintain the cavalry at full strength...

ext.ext_cn: 他们正就外交政策进行讨论。
ext.ext_en: They are arguing over foreign policy...

defs.def_en: If you argue with someone about something, you discuss it with them, with each of you giving your different opinions.

ext.ext_cn: 他的律师正在提出理由说明他不适合出庭受审。
ext.ext_en: His lawyers are arguing that he is unfit to stand trial...

ext.ext_cn: 可以说英国人不够强势。
ext.ext_en: It could be argued that the British are not aggressive enough.

defs.def_en: If you argue that something is true, you state it and give the reasons why you think it is true.

ext.ext_cn: 报告提出理由反对提高税率。
ext.ext_en: The report argues against tax increases...

ext.ext_cn: 我支持设立独立的中央银行。

ext.ext_en: Cockburn's arrival coincided with that of Sir Iain and Lady Noble...

ext.ext_en: His wife was great as well, beautiful-looking and a real lady...

ext.ext_en: At Temple station, Charlotte rushed into the Ladies.

defs.def_en: 'Lady' is sometimes used by men as a form of address when they are talking to a woman that they do not know, especially in shops and in the street.

ext.ext_en: I've been avoiding my folks lately.

defs.def_en: You can refer to your close family, especially your mother and father, as your folks .

ext.ext_en: This is it, folks: the best record guide in the business.

defs.def_en: You can use folks as a term of address when you are talking to several people.

ext.ext_en: ...traditional Chinese folk medicine.

ext.ext_en: ...Irish folk music.

ext.ext_en: ...a variety of music including classical, jazz, and folk.

defs.def_en: Folk music is music which is traditional or typical of a particular community or nation.

ext.ext_en: Folk psychology comes closer to the obvious truth than the most sophisticated theories.

defs.def_en: Folk can be used to describe something that relates to the beliefs and opinions of ordinary people.

ext.ext_en: Howard Hawks hit paydirt with 'Rio Bravo'.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has struck paydirt or has hit paydirt, you mean that they have achieved sudden success or gained a lot of money very quickly.
A gum tree is a tree such as a eucalyptus that produces gum.

defs.def_cn: （录完后）播放，放送（磁带、电影等）

A mobile home is a large caravan that people live in and that usually remains in the same place, but which can be pulled to another place using a car or van.

ext.ext_en: Job security has become the touchstone of a good job for many employees.

defs.def_en: If you use one thing as a touchstone of another, you use it as a test or standard by which you judge the second thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Training makes workers highly productive...

ext.ext_en: More productive farmers have been able to provide cheaper food.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is productive produces or does a lot for the amount of resources used.

ext.ext_en: He was hopeful that the next round of talks would also be productive...

ext.ext_en: I was sorry he had left, although I soon developed a productive relationship with his successors.

defs.def_en: If you say that a relationship between people is productive, you mean that a lot of good or useful things happen as a result of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 土地、劳动和资本都能创造财富。
ext.ext_en: Land, labor and capital are all productive of wealth.

defs.def_en: Something that is productive of a situation or feeling creates it.

defs.def_en: If someone unpicks a plan or policy, they disagree with it and examine it thoroughly in order to find any mistakes that they can use to defeat it.
A fireguard is a screen made of strong wire that you put round a fire so that people cannot accidentally burn themselves.

defs.def_en: If something is located in a particular place, it is present or has been built there.

ext.ext_en: He succeeds by dint of sheer hard work...
