ext.ext_en: Today his programme is syndicated to 500 stations...

ext.ext_cn: 迈茜以其怪趣的食品专栏闻名芬兰，该专栏在全国多家报纸均有刊登。
ext.ext_en: Myssi is well known in Finland for her quirky food column, which is syndicated across the country.

defs.def_en: When newspaper articles or television programmes are syndicated, they are sold to several different newspapers or television stations, who then publish the articles or broadcast the programmes.
A press syndicate is a group of newspapers or magazines that are all owned by the same person or company.

defs.def_cn: (关系)友好;(情况)令人愉快，顺利

ext.ext_cn: 他和首相的关系并不总是那么愉快融洽。
ext.ext_en: It has not all been sweetness and light between him and the Prime Minister.

defs.def_en: If you say that a relationship or situation is not all sweetness and light, you mean that it is not as pleasant as it appears to be.

ext.ext_cn: 爱尔兰主题酒吧
ext.ext_en: ...Irish theme pubs.

defs.def_en: A theme pub is a pub that has been decorated and furnished in a style that is often based on a particular country or type of activity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 小心的;谨慎的;谨言慎行的

ext.ext_cn: 那些银行在交易中本该更加谨慎的。
ext.ext_en: The banks should have been more circumspect in their dealings...

ext.ext_cn: 你好像正以你一贯谨言慎行的方式暗示，那个主意也许不怎么样。
ext.ext_en: You seem to be implying, in your usual circumspect manner, that perhaps it might not be a wonderful idea.

defs.def_en: If you are circumspect, you are cautious in what you do and say and do not take risks.

ext.ext_cn: 周六的杀人事件受到普遍谴责。
ext.ext_en: There was widespread condemnation of Saturday's killings...

ext.ext_cn: 突袭行动受到联合国安理会的强烈谴责。
ext.ext_en: The raids have drawn a strong condemnation from the United Nations Security Council.

defs.def_en: Condemnation is the act of saying that something or someone is very bad and unacceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 该乐队1977年斯堪的纳维亚巡回演唱会的盗版录音带
ext.ext_en: ...a bootleg recording of the band's 1977 tour of Scandinavia.

ext.ext_cn: 私酒
ext.ext_en: ...bootleg liquor.

defs.def_en: Bootleg is used to describe something that is made secretly and sold illegally.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经起诉一个歌迷非法录制他音乐会的节目。
ext.ext_en: He has sued a fan for bootlegging his concerts...

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃·迪伦的疯狂歌迷们对他的盗版唱片视若珍宝。
ext.ext_en: Avid Bob Dylan fans treasure bootlegged recordings.

defs.def_en: To bootleg something such as a recording means to make and sell it illegally.

defs.def_cn: 命运多舛的;不幸的;倒霉的

ext.ext_cn: 因战乱而分离的不幸恋人
ext.ext_en: ...star-crossed lovers parted by war and conflict.

defs.def_en: If someone is star-crossed, they keep having bad luck.

defs.def_cn: (写作、音乐或艺术作品)风格上的，创作技巧的

ext.ext_cn: 这座雕像上的一些风格元素让人完全捉摸不透。
ext.ext_en: There are some stylistic elements in the statue that just don't make sense.

defs.def_en: Stylistic describes things relating to the methods and techniques used in creating a piece of writing, music, or art.

ext.ext_cn: 乔最近结束了第五次澳大利亚之行归来。
ext.ext_en: Joe has recently returned from his fifth trip to Australia.

defs.def_en: The fifth item in a series is the one that you count as number five.

ext.ext_cn: 印度的国防开支占了其财政预算的 1/5 强。
ext.ext_en: India spends over a fifth of its budget on defence.

defs.def_en: A fifth is one of five equal parts of something.

ext.ext_cn: 澳大利亚人有充分的理由为他们的野生动物感到骄傲。
ext.ext_en: Australians are justly proud of their native wildlife.

defs.def_en: See also:just;You use justly to show that you approve of someone's attitude towards something, because it seems to be based on truth or reality.

ext.ext_cn: 我想出了一个方案，可以同时解决两个问题。
ext.ext_en: I dreamed up a plan to solve both problems at once...

ext.ext_cn: 这事是米克·贾格尔的凭空捏造。
ext.ext_en: The event was dreamed up by Mick Jagger...

defs.def_en: If you dream up a plan or idea, you work it out or create it in your mind.

ext.ext_cn: 这台发动机马力超过4,000。
ext.ext_en: The engine has more than 4,000 horsepower.

ext.ext_cn: 300马力的发动机
ext.ext_en: ...a 300-horsepower engine.

defs.def_en: Horsepower is a unit of power used for measuring how powerful an engine is.

ext.ext_cn: 这项政策带来的影响是政府始料未及的。
ext.ext_en: The effects of this policy were more than the government had bargained for...

ext.ext_cn: 他没料到这两个女人会嫉妒得发狂。
ext.ext_en: He had not bargained on the mad jealousy which both women developed.

defs.def_en: If you have not bargained for or bargained on something that happens, you did not expect it to happen and so feel surprised or worried by it.
A sepulchre is a building or room in which a dead person is buried.
Skates are ice-skates.
Skates are roller-skates.

ext.ext_cn: 我真的滑冰了——尽管有些踉跄，但没有跌跟头。
ext.ext_en: I actually skated, and despite some teetering I did not fall on the ice...

ext.ext_cn: 丹滑着冰来到他的面前。
ext.ext_en: Dan skated up to him.

defs.def_en: If you skate, you move about wearing ice-skates or roller-skates.

ext.ext_cn: 那些船上有许多鲭鱼，还有几条鳐鱼。
ext.ext_en: Boats had plenty of mackerel and a few skate.

defs.def_en: A skate is a kind of flat sea fish.

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们往往回避释梦的难题。
ext.ext_en: Scientists have tended to skate over the difficulties of explaining dreams...

ext.ext_cn: 别人逼问他有关他 19 岁时遇到的那些女人的情况时，他就会加以搪塞。
ext.ext_en: When pressed, he skates around the subject of those women who he met as a 19-year-old.

defs.def_en: If you skate over or round a difficult subject, you avoid discussing it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自私的;只为自己着想的

ext.ext_cn: 狭隘自私的行为最终会自拆台脚。
ext.ext_en: Narrowly self-interested behaviour is ultimately self-defeating.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as self-interested, you disapprove of them because they always want to do what is best for themselves rather than for other people.

ext.ext_cn: 从他被捕至今已经过去48小时了。
ext.ext_en: Forty-eight hours have elapsed since his arrest.

defs.def_en: When time elapses, it passes.
A polo shirt is a soft short-sleeved piece of clothing with a collar, which you put on over your head.

ext.ext_cn: 我能听到乐队调音的声音。
ext.ext_en: I could hear the sound of a band tuning up.

defs.def_en: See also:tune;When a group of musicians tune up, they adjust their instruments so that they produce the right notes.

ext.ext_cn: 他的牙齿洁白而整齐，十分好看。
ext.ext_en: He had nice square white teeth...

ext.ext_cn: 伊萨的白色沙滩帽在刺眼的阳光下闪闪发亮。
ext.ext_en: Issa's white beach hat gleamed in the harsh lights...

defs.def_en: Something that is white is the colour of snow or milk.

ext.ext_cn: 和白人共事对我、对他们来说都不是个问题。
ext.ext_en: Working with white people hasn't been a problem for me or for them...

ext.ext_cn: 他是个白人，留着棕色的齐肩发并蓄着小胡子。
ext.ext_en: He was white, with brown shoulder-length hair and a moustache.

defs.def_en: A white person has a pale skin and belongs to a race which is of European origin.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (因情绪变化或生病等)脸色苍白的

ext.ext_cn: 理查德脸都白了，但还是坚持自己的立场。
ext.ext_en: Richard had gone very white, but he stood his ground...

ext.ext_cn: 他脸色发白，说话开始结巴。
ext.ext_en: He turned white and began to stammer...

defs.def_en: If someone goes white, the skin on their face becomes very pale, for example because of fear, shock, anger, or illness.

ext.ext_cn: 格雷戈里又倒了一杯白葡萄酒后回到了卧室。
ext.ext_en: Gregory poured another glass of white wine and went back to his bedroom.

ext.ext_cn: 我买了一瓶加州白葡萄酒。
ext.ext_en: I bought a bottle of Californian white.

defs.def_en: White wine is pale yellow in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 韦恩面前摆着一大杯加了牛奶的咖啡。
ext.ext_en: Wayne has a large white coffee in front of him.

defs.def_en: White coffee has had milk or cream added to it.
White blood cells are the cells in your blood which your body uses to fight infection.

ext.ext_cn: 施善意法术的人
ext.ext_en: ...practitioners of white magic...

ext.ext_cn: 她们自称是善良的女巫。
ext.ext_en: They claim to be white witches.

defs.def_en: People who believe in white magic believe it is possible to use magic to do good things.
The white of an egg is the transparent liquid that surrounds the yellow part called the yolk.
The white of someone's eye is the white part that surrounds the coloured part called the iris.

ext.ext_cn: 邻桌坐着位法国人，穿着非常整洁的白色网球服。
ext.ext_en: There was a Frenchman sitting at the next table, immaculate in tennis whites.

defs.def_en: Whites are white clothes that you wear for playing some sports, for example tennis or cricket.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他吃得很好的孩子们
ext.ext_en: ...his well-fed children.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is well-fed, you mean that they get good food regularly.

ext.ext_cn: 文件粉碎机
ext.ext_en: ...a document shredder.

ext.ext_cn: 园艺碎枝机
ext.ext_en: ...a garden shredder.

defs.def_en: A shredder is a machine for shredding things such as documents or parts of bushes that have been cut off.

defs.def_cn: (与head, feet等名词连用)表示“(移动时身体某一部位)朝前(或在先)地”

ext.ext_cn: 他失去了平衡，一头栽倒在地。
ext.ext_en: He overbalanced and fell head first.

defs.def_en: -first combines with nouns like 'head' and 'feet' to indicate that someone moves with the part that is mentioned pointing in the direction in which they are moving.

ext.ext_cn: 但在上周于伦敦召开的大会上，几乎没有人留意他的警告。
ext.ext_en: But few at the conference in London last week heeded his warning...

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯本应听从那句老话——“千万不要恩将仇报”。
ext.ext_en: Chris would have been well advised to heed the old saying 'Never bite the hand that feeds you.'

defs.def_en: If you heed someone's advice or warning, you pay attention to it and do what they suggest.

ext.ext_cn: 他最近过分重视我侄子汤姆的话了，而汤姆根本不是什么伟大的思想家。
ext.ext_en: He pays too much heed these days to my nephew Tom, and Tom is no great thinker...

ext.ext_cn: 但如果政府不理会该怎么办呢？
ext.ext_en: But what if the government takes no heed?

defs.def_en: If you take heed of what someone says or if you pay heed to them, you pay attention to them and consider carefully what they say.

ext.ext_cn: 我们沿着一条崎岖的山间小路再度出发。
ext.ext_en: We set off once more, over a rough mountain track.

defs.def_en: A track is a narrow road or path.

ext.ext_cn: 那两个男人转身观看赛马沿赛道而行。
ext.ext_en: The two men turned to watch the horses going round the track.

ext.ext_cn: 田径跑道
ext.ext_en: ...the athletics track.

defs.def_en: A track is a piece of ground, often oval-shaped, that is used for races involving athletes, cars, bicycles, horses, or dogs called greyhounds.

ext.ext_cn: 一名女子摔倒在铁轨上。
ext.ext_en: A woman fell on to the tracks.

defs.def_en: Railway tracks are the rails that a train travels along.

defs.def_cn: (CD、唱片或磁带上的一首)歌曲，乐曲

ext.ext_cn: 格雷姆·内史密斯创作了这张专辑十首歌中的两首。
ext.ext_en: Graeme Naysmith has produced two of the ten tracks on this album.

defs.def_en: A track is one of the songs or pieces of music on a CD, record, or tape.

ext.ext_cn: 熊猫活动的唯一迹象是它们留在雪地上的足迹。
ext.ext_en: The only evidence of pandas was their tracks in the snow...

ext.ext_cn: 麦基突然注意到前方岸边的轮胎痕迹。
ext.ext_en: McKee suddenly noticed tire tracks on the bank ahead.

defs.def_en: Tracks are marks left in the ground by the feet of animals or people.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为最好跟踪这只狼，杀了它。
ext.ext_en: He thought he had better track this wolf and kill it...

ext.ext_cn: 我跟着他，在雪地里追踪他，直到他最终体力不支。
ext.ext_en: I followed him, tracking him in the snow until finally he got tired.

defs.def_en: If you track animals or people, you try to follow them by looking for the signs that they have left behind, for example the marks left by their feet.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的雷达开始追踪喷气式飞机的动向。
ext.ext_en: Our radar began tracking the jets...

ext.ext_cn: 气象预报员也在追踪飓风“约瑟芬”的动向。
ext.ext_en: Forecasters are also tracking hurricane Josephine.

defs.def_en: To track someone or something means to follow their movements by means of a special device, such as a satellite or radar.

ext.ext_cn: 如果可能，应追查谣言的源头。
ext.ext_en: If it's possible, track the rumour back to its origin...

ext.ext_cn: 该选手正为尤文图斯队所追踪关注。
ext.ext_en: The player is being tracked by Juventus.

defs.def_en: If you track someone or something, you investigate them, because you are interested in finding out more about them.

defs.def_cn: (同等年龄、能力的孩子组成的)班级，班组
defs.def_en: In a school, a track is a group of children of the same age and ability who are taught together.

defs.def_cn: 把(学生)按能力分班(或组)

ext.ext_cn: 学生已经按能力分班了。
ext.ext_en: Students are already being tracked.

defs.def_en: To track students means to divide them into groups according to their ability.

defs.def_cn: 掩盖行踪;隐匿身份(或活动)

ext.ext_cn: 他掩盖形迹，烧毁了信件与日记。
ext.ext_en: He covered his tracks, burnt letters and diaries...

ext.ext_cn: 凶手可能曾回到犯罪现场掩盖自己的罪行。
ext.ext_en: The killer may have returned to the scene of the crime to cover his tracks.

defs.def_en: If someone covers their tracks, they hide or destroy evidence of their identity or their actions, because they want to keep them secret.

defs.def_cn: 占优势;处于有利地位;了解内情

ext.ext_cn: 丹佛在 10 个被考虑的地点之中具有优势。
ext.ext_en: Denver has the inside track among 10 sites being considered...

ext.ext_cn: 作为代理人，一旦有划算的买卖你恐怕能近水楼台先得月。
ext.ext_en: As an agent, you may have an inside track when good deals become available.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has the inside track, you mean that they have an advantage, for example special knowledge about something.

defs.def_cn: 跟上…的进展;掌握…的最新消息

ext.ext_cn: 对于一支 1.1 万人的员工队伍，很难及时了解到所有有人的动态。
ext.ext_en: With eleven thousand employees, it's very difficult to keep track of them all...

ext.ext_cn: 在这里很容易忘了时间。
ext.ext_en: It's hard to keep track of time in here.

defs.def_en: If you keep track of a situation or a person, you make sure that you have the newest and most accurate information about them all the time.

defs.def_cn: 跟不上…的进展;不再掌握…的最新情况

ext.ext_cn: 你会因过于专注某项活动而失去时间概念。
ext.ext_en: You become so deeply absorbed in an activity that you lose track of time...

ext.ext_cn: 很容易就忘记谁要和谁比赛，什么时候比。
ext.ext_en: It's so easy to lose track of who's playing who and when.

defs.def_en: If you lose track of someone or something, you no longer know where they are or what is happening.

ext.ext_cn: 我们最好马上就走，不是吗？
ext.ext_en: We'd better make tracks soon, hadn't we?

defs.def_en: If you make tracks, you leave the place where you are, especially when you are in a hurry.

ext.ext_cn: 要使英国经济重新回到正轨可能需要一段时间。
ext.ext_en: It may take some time to get the British economy back on track...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维让我重新回到了正轨。
ext.ext_en: David put me back on track…

defs.def_en: If someone or something is on track, they are acting or progressing in a way that is likely to result in success.

ext.ext_cn: 他正在追踪一名逃犯。
ext.ext_en: He was on the track of an escaped criminal...

ext.ext_cn: 研究所正在探究动脉损伤的诱因。
ext.ext_en: The research institute is on the track of what causes the artery damage.

defs.def_en: If you are on the track of someone or something, you are trying to find them, or find information about them.

defs.def_cn: 循着正确/错误的路线;在正确/错误的道路上

ext.ext_cn: 回头客越来越多了——这显然表明我们的路走对了。
ext.ext_en: Guests are returning in increasing numbers — a sure sign that we are on the right track...

ext.ext_cn: 我们需要一场令人信服的大胜，以重回正轨。
ext.ext_en: We need a convincing win to put us back on the right track…

defs.def_en: If you are on the right track, you are acting or progressing in a way that is likely to result in success. If you are on the wrong track, you are acting or progressing in a way that is likely to result in failure.

ext.ext_cn: 这座宏伟的教堂一定会让你止步赞叹。
ext.ext_en: This magnificent church cannot fail to stop you in your tracks…

ext.ext_cn: 他们突然停下，惊讶地盯着他。
ext.ext_en: They stopped in their tracks and stared at him in amazement…

defs.def_en: If someone or something stops you in your tracks, or if you stop dead in your tracks, you suddenly stop moving because you are very surprised, impressed, or frightened.

ext.ext_cn: 弗朗西斯觉得他应该立即打断这一谈话。
ext.ext_en: Francis felt he would like to stop this conversation in its tracks…

ext.ext_cn: 美国制造商将会发现出口热戛然而止。
ext.ext_en: U.S. manufacturers may find the export boom stopping dead in its tracks.

defs.def_en: If someone or something stops a process or activity in its tracks, or if it stops dead in its tracks, they prevent the process or activity from continuing.

defs.def_cn: （英国11至18岁学生就读的）中学，完全中学

ext.ext_cn: 森德兰中学
ext.ext_en: ...Sunderland High School.

defs.def_en: In Britain, a high school is a school for children aged between eleven and eighteen.

ext.ext_cn: 高中辍学、住在市中心贫民区的18岁孩子
ext.ext_en: ...an 18-year-old inner-city kid who dropped out of high school.

ext.ext_cn: 高中足球队
ext.ext_en: ...the high school football team.

defs.def_en: In the United States, a high school is a school for children usually aged between fourteen and eighteen.

ext.ext_cn: 诸如塞尔焦·莱昂内之类的意大利电影制作人
ext.ext_en: ...Italian film-makers like Sergio Leone.

defs.def_en: A film-maker is someone involved in making films, in particular a director or producer.
Porridge is a thick sticky food made from oats cooked in water or milk and eaten hot, especially for breakfast.

ext.ext_cn: 我现在意识到那些曾令我烦恼不快的事情其实无关紧要。
ext.ext_en: I realise now that the things which used to niggle and annoy me just don't really matter...

ext.ext_cn: 自从在尼斯见到内维尔后，我一直忐忑不安。
ext.ext_en: It's been niggling at my mind ever since I met Neville in Nice...

defs.def_en: If something niggles you, it causes you to worry slightly over a long period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 对手找茬惹我时，我不会再理他们。
ext.ext_en: I don't react anymore when opponents try to niggle me...

ext.ext_cn: 你往往会对伴侣吹毛求疵，如果他不拥抱你，就感到受了伤害。
ext.ext_en: You tend to niggle at your partner, and get hurt when he doesn't hug you.

defs.def_en: If someone niggles you, they annoy you by continually criticizing you for what you think are small or unimportant things.
If an army reconquers a country or territory after having lost it, they win control over it again.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她给像惠特尼·休斯敦这样的人写了很多当代音乐作品。
ext.ext_en: She writes a lot of contemporary music for people like Whitney Houston...

ext.ext_cn: 也许他应该有一个更新的形象，更具时代性的风格。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps he should have a more updated look, a more contemporary style...

defs.def_en: Contemporary things are modern and relate to the present time.

defs.def_cn: 同时发生的;同时期的;同时代的

ext.ext_cn: 利用官方的记录与当时的见证者的报告
ext.ext_en: ...drawing upon official records and the reports of contemporary witnesses.

defs.def_en: Contemporary people or things were alive or happened at the same time as something else you are talking about.

defs.def_cn: 同时期的人;同时代的人

ext.ext_cn: 和大多数同辈人一样，我生长在一个截然不同的世界。
ext.ext_en: Like most of my contemporaries, I grew up in a vastly different world.

ext.ext_cn: 莎士比亚及其同时代人音乐术语汇编
ext.ext_en: ...a glossary of musical terms found in Shakespeare and his contemporaries.

defs.def_en: Someone's contemporary is a person who is or was alive at the same time as them.

defs.def_cn: 基督复临安息日会(视星期六为圣日)
defs.def_en: Seventh Day Adventist churches are churches that believe that Jesus Christ will return very soon, and that have Saturday as their holy day.

defs.def_cn: 基督复临安息日会教友
defs.def_en: A Seventh Day Adventist is a member of the Seventh Day Adventist church.

ext.ext_cn: 如果保守党赢得选举，他们可能会决定改变这一现状。
ext.ext_en: If the Conservatives got in they might decide to change it.

defs.def_en: If a political party or a politician gets in, they are elected.

ext.ext_cn: 我打算挤出时间上几节课。
ext.ext_en: I plan to get a few lessons in.

defs.def_en: If you get something in, you manage to do it at a time when you are very busy doing other things.

ext.ext_cn: 我们直到圣诞节时才收割庄稼，因为雪下得实在太多了。
ext.ext_en: We didn't get the harvest in until Christmas, there was so much snow.

defs.def_en: To get crops or the harvest in means to gather them from the land and take them to a particular place.

defs.def_cn: （火车、公共汽车或飞机）到达，抵达

ext.ext_cn: 要不是我们的航班抵达太晚，我们本应直接到这里来的。
ext.ext_en: We would have come straight here, except our flight got in too late.

defs.def_en: When a train, bus, or plane gets in, it arrives.

ext.ext_cn: 想要插上话很难。
ext.ext_en: It was hard to get a word in.

defs.def_en: If you get something in, you eventually succeed in saying it, usually when a lot of people are talking at the same time or one person is talking without stopping.

ext.ext_cn: 对于一个只会机械地重复其搭档观点的朋友，你可能会无比腻烦。
ext.ext_en: You can get sick to death of a friend regurgitating her partner's opinions.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is regurgitating ideas or facts, you mean that they are repeating them without understanding them properly.

ext.ext_cn: 有时他会倒嚼我们喂给他吃的食物，因为他无法吞咽。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes he regurgitates the food we give him because he cannot swallow.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal regurgitates food, they bring it back up from their stomach before it has been digested.

ext.ext_cn: 在昏暗潮湿的工厂辛苦劳作的人们累得无力再去享受家庭生活。
ext.ext_en: People who toiled in dim, dank factories were too exhausted to enjoy their family life...

ext.ext_cn: 工人们长时间辛苦劳动。
ext.ext_en: Workers toiled long hours.

defs.def_en: When people toil, they work very hard doing unpleasant or tiring tasks.

defs.def_cn: (通常指因疲倦而)费劲地行走，艰难地行动

ext.ext_cn: 阿诺德垂着头，一边费劲地往山上爬一边气喘吁吁。
ext.ext_en: Arnold had his head down, gasping as he toiled up the hill.

defs.def_en: If you toil somewhere, you move there slowly and with difficulty, usually because you are very tired.
Toil is unpleasant work that is very tiring physically.

defs.def_cn: 商业企划（尤指为贷款而作的计划）

ext.ext_cn: 她学会了如何为自己想创办的餐饮生意撰写企划书。
ext.ext_en: She learned how to write a business plan for the catering business she wanted to launch.

defs.def_en: A business plan is a detailed plan for setting up or developing a business, especially one that is written in order to borrow money.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的态度激怒了我。
ext.ext_en: Their attitude irritates me...

ext.ext_cn: 也许他们被哭声惹烦了。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps they were irritated by the sound of crying.

defs.def_en: If something irritates you, it keeps annoying you.

defs.def_cn: 刺激(身体部位);使发痒;使疼痛

ext.ext_cn: 切辣椒时要戴橡胶手套,因为辣椒会刺激皮肤。
ext.ext_en: Wear rubber gloves while chopping chillies as they can irritate the skin.

defs.def_en: If something irritates a part of your body, it causes it to itch or become sore.

ext.ext_cn: 有角的牛
ext.ext_en: ...horned cattle.

ext.ext_cn: 角百灵的鸣叫
ext.ext_en: ...the call of a horned lark.

defs.def_en: Horned animals have horns, or parts of their bodies that look like horns.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的白色外套污迹斑斑，简直脏透了。
ext.ext_en: His white coat was grubby and stained.

ext.ext_cn: 脸上脏兮兮的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...kids with grubby faces.

defs.def_en: A grubby person or object is rather dirty.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 肮脏的政治活动
ext.ext_en: ...the grubby business of politics.

defs.def_en: If you call an activity or someone's  behaviour grubby, you mean that it is not completely honest or respectable.

defs.def_cn: 不可否认的；无可争议的；确凿无疑的

ext.ext_cn: 她的魅力毋庸置疑。
ext.ext_en: Her charm is undeniable.

ext.ext_cn: 无可否认的事实：她酒后驾车，血液中的酒精含量几乎是法定限量的两倍
ext.ext_en: ...the undeniable fact that she was driving with almost twice the legal limit of alcohol in her blood.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is undeniable, you mean that it is definitely true.

ext.ext_cn: 我因抑郁症休了 7 个月的病假。
ext.ext_en: I have been on sick leave for seven months with depression.

defs.def_en: Sick leave is the time that a person spends away from work because of illness or injury.

ext.ext_cn: 政府也已负债累累。
ext.ext_en: The government had also incurred huge debts...

ext.ext_cn: 她恋爱了,这引起了父亲的愤怒。
ext.ext_en: She falls in love and incurs the wrath of her father.

defs.def_en: If you incur something unpleasant, it happens to you because of something you have done.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 正直的;有道德原则的;有良心的

ext.ext_cn: 你确实刚正不阿，但图了什么呢？
ext.ext_en: You're being very scrupulous, but to what end?...

ext.ext_cn: 我已经本着良心将危险告知他们。
ext.ext_en: I have been scrupulous about telling them the dangers...

defs.def_en: Someone who is scrupulous takes great care to do what is fair, honest, or morally right.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 细致的;缜密的;一丝不苟的

ext.ext_cn: 两位读者都称赞克努森对细节一丝不苟。
ext.ext_en: Both readers commend Knutson for his scrupulous attention to detail.

defs.def_en: Scrupulous means thorough, exact, and careful about details.

ext.ext_cn: 出售的女装有小号、中号和大号。
ext.ext_en: Women's apparel is offered in petite, regular, and tall models.

defs.def_en: Apparel means clothes, especially formal clothes worn on an important occasion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一些人以低息贷款的形式得到了有力的职业援助。
ext.ext_en: Some received substantial occupational assistance in the form of low-interest loans.

defs.def_en: Occupational means relating to a person's job or profession.

defs.def_cn: （常指公共场所的）废物箱，垃圾箱
defs.def_en: A litter bin is a container, usually in a street, park, or public building, into which people can put rubbish.

defs.def_cn: 转移，引开(批评、注意力等)

ext.ext_cn: 凯奇改了名字以避免别人指责他搞裙带关系。
ext.ext_en: Cage changed his name to deflect accusations of nepotism...

ext.ext_cn: 这是为将公众的注意力从真正发生的事情上转移开而耍的花招。
ext.ext_en: It's a maneuver to deflect the attention of the people from what is really happening.

defs.def_en: If you deflect something such as criticism or attention, you act in a way that prevents it from being directed towards you or affecting you.

ext.ext_cn: 战争并没有使他放弃自己很久以前就选择的道路。
ext.ext_en: The war did not deflect him from the path he had long ago taken...

ext.ext_cn: 决不要因一点小问题就半途而废。
ext.ext_en: Never let a little problem deflect you.

defs.def_en: To deflect someone from a course of action means to make them decide not to continue with it by putting pressure on them or by offering them something desirable.

ext.ext_cn: 就在终场哨响前几秒，他伸脚一挡，使射门的球变向飞过了球门横梁。
ext.ext_en: He stuck out his boot and deflected the shot over the bar seconds before the final whistle...

ext.ext_cn: 我用前臂挡开了第一拳的大部分力道。
ext.ext_en: My forearm deflected most of the first punch.

defs.def_en: If you deflect something that is moving, you make it go in a slightly different direction, for example by hitting or blocking it.

defs.def_cn: 运动场地管理员；公园管理员
defs.def_en: A groundsman is a person whose job is to look after a park or sports ground.

ext.ext_cn: 他绝对有权批准那样的一次警方突袭行动。
ext.ext_en: It would certainly be within his power to authorize a police raid like that...

ext.ext_cn: 我们愿意授权总统在必要的时候使用武力。
ext.ext_en: We are willing to authorize the president to use force if necessary.

defs.def_en: If someone in a position of authority authorizes something, they give their official permission for it to happen.
A farmhouse is the main house on a farm, usually where the farmer lives.

defs.def_cn: (与形容词连用构成形容词)表示“有…气味的”

ext.ext_cn: 芳香扑鼻的干花
ext.ext_en: ...sweet-smelling dried flowers...

ext.ext_cn: 城市被一团恶臭的烟云笼罩着。
ext.ext_en: The city is covered by a foul-smelling cloud of smoke.

defs.def_en: -smelling combines with adjectives to form adjectives which indicate how something smells.
A sundial is a device used for telling the time when the sun is shining. The shadow of an upright rod falls onto a flat surface that is marked with the hours, and points to the correct hour.

defs.def_cn: （摆放在餐桌上供一个人用的）一副餐具

ext.ext_cn: 他看到了餐桌上的那张便条，紧挨着两副餐具中的一副。
ext.ext_en: He saw the note on the kitchen table, next to one of the two place settings.

defs.def_en: A place setting is an arrangement of knives, forks, spoons, and glasses that has been laid out on a table for the use of one person at a meal.

defs.def_cn: （一个人可能用到的）一套餐具

ext.ext_cn: 一套7头餐具要花45英镑。
ext.ext_en: A seven-piece place setting costs about £45.

defs.def_en: A place setting of china or of knives, forks, and spoons is a complete set of all the things that one person might use at a meal.
Acid rain is rain polluted by acid that has been released into the atmosphere from factories and other industrial processes. Acid rain is harmful to the environment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有人短促、嘲弄地笑了一声。
ext.ext_en: There was a short, derisive laugh.

defs.def_en: A derisive noise, expression, or remark expresses contempt.
A heatwave is a period of time during which the weather is much hotter than usual.

ext.ext_cn: 冰箱、电视、自行车等耐用消费品被大批量地生产出来。
ext.ext_en: Consumer durables such as refrigerators, television sets, bicycles and so on were produced in large quantities.

defs.def_en: Consumer durables are goods which are expected to last a long time, and are bought infrequently.
A side street is a quiet, often narrow street which leads off a busier street.
A litigant is a person who is involved in a civil legal case, either because they are making a formal complaint about someone, or because a complaint is being made about them.

defs.def_cn: (I will 或 I shall 的常用口语形式)。

ext.ext_cn: 过几周我就离开城里了。
ext.ext_en: I'll be leaving town in a few weeks...

ext.ext_cn: 明天早上我会解释的。
ext.ext_en: I'll explain tomorrow morning.

defs.def_en: I'll is the usual spoken form of 'I will' or 'I shall'.
A chain store is one of several similar shops that are owned by the same person or company, especially one that sells a variety of things.
Your kidneys are the organs in your body that take waste matter from your blood and send it out of your body as urine.

ext.ext_cn: 羊腰子
ext.ext_en: ...lambs' kidneys.

ext.ext_cn: 牛排和腰花馅饼
ext.ext_en: ...steak and kidney pie.

defs.def_en: Kidneys are the kidneys of an animal, for example a lamb, calf, or pig, that are eaten as meat.
A firebomb is a type of bomb which is designed to cause fires.

ext.ext_cn: 抗议者昨天用燃烧弹焚烧了使馆建筑。
ext.ext_en: Protestors firebombed the embassy building yesterday.

defs.def_en: To firebomb a building, vehicle, or place means to set fire to it using a firebomb.

defs.def_cn: 使处于危险境地；危及；危害；损害

ext.ext_cn: 他的行为已经危及到他这届政府的未来。
ext.ext_en: He has jeopardised the future of his government...

ext.ext_cn: 会谈仍有可能因存在争端而破裂。
ext.ext_en: The talks may still be jeopardized by disputes.

defs.def_en: To jeopardize a situation or activity means to do something that may destroy it or cause it to fail.

defs.def_cn: 第二位的;次要的;从属的

ext.ext_cn: 街上发生了剧烈爆炸，邻近的建筑里也发生了程度较轻的爆炸。
ext.ext_en: The street erupted in a huge explosion, with secondary explosions in the adjoining buildings...

ext.ext_cn: 他们认为人权方面的考虑现在只是第二位的。
ext.ext_en: They argue that human rights considerations are now of only secondary importance...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

defs.def_cn: (疾病、感染)继发性的，第二期的

ext.ext_cn: 他患有肾癌，还有脑部和肺部的继发性肿瘤。
ext.ext_en: He had kidney cancer, with secondary tumours in the brain and lungs.

defs.def_en: Secondary diseases or infections happen as a result of another disease or infection that has already happened.

ext.ext_cn: 在接受中等教育约5年后便可参加普通中等教育证书的考试。
ext.ext_en: Examinations for the GCSE are taken after about five years of secondary education.

defs.def_en: Secondary education is given to pupils between the ages of 11 or 12 and 17 or 18.

defs.def_cn: （国家、政治运动、社会团体等）新兴的，兴起的

ext.ext_cn: 新兴国家
ext.ext_en: ...an emergent state.

ext.ext_cn: 新兴民族主义运动
ext.ext_en: ...an emergent nationalist movement.

defs.def_en: An emergent country, political movement, or social group is one that is becoming powerful or coming into existence.
Seismology is the scientific study of earthquakes.

ext.ext_cn: 诺贝尔医学和生理学奖
ext.ext_en: ...the Nobel Prize for Medicine and Physiology.

defs.def_en: Physiology is the scientific study of how people's and animals' bodies function, and of how plants function.

ext.ext_cn: 呼吸生理
ext.ext_en: ...the physiology of respiration.

ext.ext_cn: 昆虫的生理机能
ext.ext_en: ...insect physiology.

defs.def_en: The physiology of a human or animal's body or of a plant is the way that it functions.

ext.ext_cn: 和平计划并没有被各方全盘接受。
ext.ext_en: The peace plan has not been accepted in its entirety by all parties.

ext.ext_cn: 一些城市将全面遭到轰炸。
ext.ext_en: ...a number of cities were now to be bombed in their entirety.

defs.def_en: If something is used or affected in its entirety, the whole of it is used or affected.
Bookends are a pair of supports used to hold a row of books in an upright position by placing one at each end of the row.

defs.def_cn: 穿脱方便的;不系带子的

ext.ext_cn: 不系鞋带的帆船鞋
ext.ext_en: ...slip-on boat shoes.

ext.ext_cn: 他脱下了棕色的无带鞋。
ext.ext_en: He removed his brown slip-ons.

defs.def_en: Slip-on shoes have nothing fastening them.

defs.def_cn: 科学上的;关于某一科学的

ext.ext_cn: 科学研究被普遍认为是美国高生活水准的源泉。
ext.ext_en: Scientific research is widely claimed to be the source of the high standard of living in the US.

ext.ext_cn: 将动物用于科学实验
ext.ext_en: ...the use of animals in scientific experiments.

defs.def_en: Scientific is used to describe things that relate to science or to a particular science.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 细致严谨的;使用科学方法的

ext.ext_cn: 用这个方法来测试他们的意见不科学。
ext.ext_en: It's not a scientific way to test their opinions.

ext.ext_cn: 对资本主义发展细致严谨的研究
ext.ext_en: ...the scientific study of capitalist development.

defs.def_en: If you do something in a scientific way, you do it carefully and thoroughly, using experiments or tests.
Stone-ground flour or bread is made from grain that has been crushed between two large, heavy pieces of stone.
The antonym of a word is a word which means the opposite.

ext.ext_cn: 丧亲和哀悼的悲伤会持续很久。
ext.ext_en: The period of mourning and bereavement may be long...

ext.ext_cn: 理应感到愤怒、忧伤和不知所措，这些都是哀悼的组成部分。
ext.ext_en: Expect to feel angry, depressed and confused. It's all part of the mourning process...

defs.def_en: Mourning is behaviour in which you show sadness about a person's death.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天希腊全民哀悼。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday the whole of Greece was in mourning...

ext.ext_cn: 男孩身穿黑色燕尾服为乔治三世服丧。
ext.ext_en: The boys wore black tail coats in mourning for George III.

defs.def_en: If you are in mourning, you are dressed or behaving in a particular way because someone you love or respect has died.
A pekinese is a type of small dog with long hair, short legs, and a short, flat nose.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 英国标准（指在英国销售的产品应达到的规定标准）

ext.ext_cn: 你们的电热毯达到英国的3456标准了吗？
ext.ext_en: Does your electric blanket conform to BS 3456?

defs.def_en: BS is an abbreviation for (缩略 =)'British Standard', which is a standard that something sold in Britain must reach in a test to prove that it is satisfactory or safe. Each standard has a number for reference.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: A BS is the same as a BSc .

ext.ext_cn: 他从联邦政府那儿听来的很多消息都是，嗯“屁话”。
ext.ext_en: A lot of what he's been hearing from the federal government is, quote, BS.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as BS, you are saying that it is nonsense or completely untrue. BS is an abbreviation for (缩略 =) 'bullshit'.

ext.ext_cn: 他把车停在了她家车库前的车道上。
ext.ext_en: He pulled into the driveway in front of her garage...

ext.ext_cn: 她将车停进了小路上一个狭窄的停车位里。
ext.ext_en: She pulled the car into a tight parking space on a side street.

defs.def_en: When a vehicle or driver pulls into a place, the vehicle moves into the place and stops there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他经常因为富有而受到辱骂。
ext.ext_en: He is often the victim of vituperative remarks concerning his wealth.

ext.ext_cn: 新闻界最爱发表辱骂攻击言辞的评论家之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of journalism's most vituperative critics.

defs.def_en: Vituperative remarks are full of hate, anger, or insults.

defs.def_cn: （言谈举止的）老练，圆通，得体，乖巧

ext.ext_cn: 媒体此次并没有过多纠缠，表现十分得体。
ext.ext_en: On this occasion the press have not been intrusive and they have shown great tact.

ext.ext_cn: 老练、高效地帮助顺利解决了难题
ext.ext_en: ...helping to smooth over problems with great tact and efficiency.

defs.def_en: Tact is the ability to avoid upsetting or offending people by being careful not to say or do things that would hurt their feelings.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 精力充沛的；生气勃勃的；健壮的

ext.ext_cn: 根部粗大而壮实的植物
ext.ext_en: ...plants with large, lusty roots.

ext.ext_cn: 忆记起他在空旷的公园里放声高歌
ext.ext_en: ...remembering his lusty singing in the open park.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is lusty, you mean that it is healthy and full of strength and energy.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数餐馆加收 10％的服务费。
ext.ext_en: Most restaurants add a 10 per cent service charge.

defs.def_en: A service charge is an amount that is added to your bill in a restaurant to pay for the work of the person who comes and serves you.
A sandstorm is a strong wind in a desert area, which carries sand through the air.

ext.ext_cn: 麦克阿瑟将军曾是太平洋战区盟军的最高统帅。
ext.ext_en: MacArthur was Supreme Commander for the allied powers in the Pacific.

ext.ext_cn: 最高法院
ext.ext_en: ...the Supreme Court.

defs.def_en: Supreme is used in the title of a person or an official group to indicate that they are at the highest level in a particular organization or system.

ext.ext_cn: 她的认可是至关重要的。
ext.ext_en: Her approval was of supreme importance...

ext.ext_cn: 该女士图谋攫取最高权力。
ext.ext_en: The lady conspired to seize supreme power.

defs.def_en: You use supreme to emphasize that a quality or thing is very great.

defs.def_cn: （常指逐渐或反复）削弱，损害（情感、体制等）

ext.ext_cn: 对每个问题都给出建议会令她觉得自己不像个成年人。
ext.ext_en: Offering advice on each and every problem will undermine her feeling of being adult...

ext.ext_cn: 西方情报机构被指责企图动摇该政府的统治。
ext.ext_en: Western intelligence agencies are accused of trying to undermine the government.

defs.def_en: If you undermine something such as a feeling or a system, you make it less strong or less secure than it was before, often by a gradual process or by repeated efforts.

defs.def_cn: （常指间接地）削弱，损害，动摇（某人的地位或权威）

defs.def_en: In an amphibious military operation, army and navy forces attack a place from the sea.

ext.ext_en: ...an amphibious landing craft which can carry helicopters and up to 2,000 troops.

defs.def_en: An amphibious vehicle is able to move on both land and water.
Amphibious animals are animals such as frogs and toads that can live both on land and in water.

ext.ext_cn: 他正在观看一场足球比赛。
ext.ext_en: He was watching a football match...

ext.ext_en: France won the match 28-19.

ext.ext_en: ...a packet of cigarettes  and a box of matches.

defs.def_en: A match is a small wooden stick with a substance on one end that produces a flame when you rub it along the rough side of a matchbox.

ext.ext_cn: 她的指甲涂成了大红色，为的是与裙子相配。
ext.ext_en: Her nails were painted bright red to match her dress...

ext.ext_en: All the chairs matched...

defs.def_en: If something of a particular colour or design matches another thing, they have the same colour or design, or have a pleasing appearance when they are used together.

defs.def_cn: （数量或质量）比得上,与…不相上下,使一致

ext.ext_cn: 他们在记忆力和空间技能方面势均力敌。
ext.ext_en: Their strengths in memory and spatial skills matched...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的价值体系和他们的并不相同。
ext.ext_en: Our value system does not match with their value system.

defs.def_en: If something such as an amount or a quality matches with another amount or quality, they are both the same or equal. If you match two things, you make them the same or equal.

ext.ext_cn: 要求学生把书籍与作者对应起来。
ext.ext_en: The students are asked to match the books with the authors...

ext.ext_cn: 我们会争取为你找到提供你所需职位的用人单位。
ext.ext_en: We will try to match you to employers with the vacancies you are looking for...

defs.def_en: If one thing matches another,  they are connected or suit each other  in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 海伦选择的唇膏很适合她的肤色。
ext.ext_en: Helen's choice of lipstick was a good match for her skin-tone...

ext.ext_cn: 莫伊拉和他简直是绝配。
ext.ext_en: Moira was a perfect match for him.

defs.def_en: If a combination of things or people is a good match, they have a pleasing effect when placed or used together.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的攻势足球踢得不错，不过我认为我们各方面和他们比起来都不逊色。
ext.ext_en: They played some fine attacking football, but I think we matched them in every respect...

ext.ext_cn: 他的纪录尚无人能及。
ext.ext_en: His record has never been matched.

defs.def_en: If you match something, you are as good as it or equal to it, for example in speed, size, or quality.

ext.ext_cn: 锦标赛决赛于今天打响，由美国队对法国队。
ext.ext_en: The finals of the Championship begin today, matching the United States against France...

ext.ext_cn: 刘易斯对决世界拳击组织的重量级拳王汤米·莫里森。
ext.ext_en: Lewis is matched against the WBO's heavyweight champion, Tommy Morrison.

defs.def_en: In a sport or other contest, if you match one person or team against another, in sports or other contests, you make them compete with each other to see which one is better.

defs.def_cn: 遇到强劲的对手;棋逢对手

ext.ext_cn: 我终于遇上了与我在力量与智力上不相上下的劲敌。
ext.ext_en: I had finally met my match in power and intellect.

defs.def_en: If you meet your match, you find that you are competing or fighting against someone who you cannot beat because they are as good as you, or better than you.

ext.ext_cn: 我根本不是这样强大的男人的对手。
ext.ext_en: I was no match for a man with such power...

ext.ext_cn: 结果证明，手持枪械无法同重型装甲抗衡。
ext.ext_en: Hand-held guns proved no match for heavy armor.

defs.def_en: If one person or thing is no match for another, they are unable to compete successfully with the other person or thing.
A lay person is a person who is not trained, qualified, or experienced in a particular subject or activity.

ext.ext_cn: 种族主义的抬头让锡克教徒很担忧，因为他们是力量非常薄弱的少数群体。
ext.ext_en: The rise of racism concerns Sikhs because they are such a visible minority.

ext.ext_cn: 锡克教寺庙
ext.ext_en: ...a Sikh temple.

defs.def_en: A Sikh is a person who follows the Indian religion of Sikhism.

ext.ext_cn: 耗油量在城里是38英里/加仑，在宽阔的路面是55英里/加仑。
ext.ext_en: Fuel consumption is 38 mpg around town, 55 mpg on the open road.

defs.def_en: mpg is written after a number to indicate how many miles a vehicle can travel using one gallon of fuel. mpg is an abbreviation for (缩略 =) 'miles per gallon'.

defs.def_cn: 游离选民(并无坚决拥护的党派的投票者)
defs.def_en: A floating voter is a person who is not a firm supporter of any political party, and whose vote in an election is difficult to predict.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 感人的;令人感伤（或同情）的

ext.ext_cn: 看到陌生人之间这般彼此关照，实在令人感动。
ext.ext_en: It is very moving to see how much strangers can care for each other...

ext.ext_cn: 对玛丽安娜来说，那是动人的一刻。
ext.ext_en: It was a moving moment for Marianne.

defs.def_en: If something is moving, it makes you feel strongly an emotion such as sadness, pity, or sympathy.

defs.def_cn: (模型或机器部件)活动的，可移动的
defs.def_en: A moving model or part of a machine moves or is able to move.

defs.def_cn: 推动力；起激励作用的人(或事)

ext.ext_cn: 肯定是她一个人主使了让我丢掉职位的诉讼。
ext.ext_en: She alone must have been the moving spirit behind the lawsuit that lost me my position...

ext.ext_cn: 克劳斯教授已成为学院艺术批评界的领军人物。
ext.ext_en: Professor Krauss has been a moving force in the world of academic art criticism.

defs.def_en: The moving spirit or moving force behind something is the person or thing that caused it to start and to keep going, or that influenced people to take part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们担心新一轮的霍乱大流行。
ext.ext_en: They feared a new cholera pandemic...

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙流感的大爆发夺去了全球近2,200万人的生命。
ext.ext_en: One pandemic of Spanish flu took nearly 22 million lives worldwide.

defs.def_en: A pandemic is an occurrence of a disease that affects many people over a very wide area.

defs.def_cn: 女工匠;女手艺人;女工艺师
defs.def_en: A craftswoman is a woman who makes things skilfully with her hands.

ext.ext_cn: 贴身束胸并搭配圆形下摆的连衣裙
ext.ext_en: ...dress with a fitted bodice and circle skirt.

defs.def_en: The bodice of a dress is the part above the waist.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以以固定的批发价出售给他们，这样他们可以提高零售价格。
ext.ext_en: You can sell it to them at a set wholesale price, allowing them to mark it up for retail...

ext.ext_cn: 典型的仓储超市仅给商品加价10%至15%。
ext.ext_en: A typical warehouse club marks up its goods by only 10 to 15 percent.

defs.def_en: See also:mark-up;If you mark something up, you increase its price.

defs.def_cn: 使充满活力;使精力充沛

ext.ext_cn: 他帮助激励和动员了全国数百万人。
ext.ext_en: He helped energize and mobilize millions of people around the nation...

ext.ext_cn: 我充满了活力，感觉非常好。
ext.ext_en: I am completely energized and feeling terrific.

defs.def_en: To energize someone means to give them the enthusiasm and determination to do something.

defs.def_cn: 皮洛士式的胜利；得不偿失的胜利
defs.def_en: If you describe a victory as a Pyrrhic victory, you mean that although someone has won or gained something, they have also lost something which was worth even more.
A woman who is a patron of something can be described as a patroness .

defs.def_cn: 可以预防的；可以防止的；可以阻止的

ext.ext_cn: 每天有4万个孩子死于本可以预防的疾病。
ext.ext_en: Forty-thousand children a day die from preventable diseases...

ext.ext_cn: 导致假期泡汤的大多数常见的身体不适都是很容易预防的。
ext.ext_en: Most common health upsets that spoil a holiday are easily preventable.

defs.def_en: Preventable diseases, illnesses, or deaths could be stopped from occurring.

ext.ext_cn: 她径直奔向那辆车。
ext.ext_en: She made a beeline for the car.

defs.def_en: If you make a beeline for a place, you go to it as quickly and directly as possible.

ext.ext_cn: 接着他们对她竟然也是一顿暴打。
ext.ext_en: Then they actually beat her up as well...

ext.ext_cn: 政府的支持者痛打任何一个被他们怀疑支持示威者的人。
ext.ext_en: The government supporters are beating up anyone they suspect of favouring the demonstrators.

defs.def_en: If someone beats a person up, they hit or kick the person many times.

defs.def_cn: 对…忧心忡忡；因为…而自责

ext.ext_cn: 去跟他们说你不想干了。别为了这个难为自己。
ext.ext_en: Tell them you don't want to do it any more. Don't beat yourself up about it...

ext.ext_cn: 我不会为难自己的，力所不及的事我是不会干的。
ext.ext_en: I don't beat myself up. I don't deal with things I can't handle.

defs.def_en: If you beat yourself up about something, you worry about it a lot or blame yourself for it.

defs.def_cn: 对不起,请再说一遍（美国英语用Pardon me?）

ext.ext_cn: “我能打开它吗？”——“请再说一遍？”——“我能打开它吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'Will you let me open it?' — 'Pardon?' — 'Can I open it?'...

ext.ext_cn: “有电线从里面伸出来吗？”——“什么？”——“有电线从里面伸出来吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'Does it have wires coming out of it?' — 'Pardon me?' — 'Does it have wires coming out of it?'

defs.def_en: You say 'Pardon?' or 'I beg your pardon?' or, in American English, 'Pardon me?' when you want someone to repeat what they have just said because you have not heard or understood it.

defs.def_cn: 你说什么？（表示惊讶或者受到冒犯）

ext.ext_cn: “请你脱掉衣服，好吗？”——“你说什么？”——“脱掉衣服，好吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'Would you get undressed, please?' — 'I beg your pardon?' — 'Will you get undressed?'

defs.def_en: People say 'I beg your pardon?' when they are surprised or offended by something that someone has just said.

ext.ext_cn: 我失礼了，真对不起。
ext.ext_en: I was impolite and I do beg your pardon...

ext.ext_cn: “其实我们本意是一季度一次。”——“哦，一季度一次，对不起，我还以为一月一次呢。”
ext.ext_en: 'We're meant to do it quarterly actually.' — 'Oh quarterly, I beg your pardon, I thought it was monthly.'

defs.def_en: You say 'I beg your pardon' or 'I do beg your pardon' as a  way of apologizing for accidentally doing something wrong, such as disturbing someone or making a mistake.

defs.def_cn: 对不起，不好意思打断一下（用于引起他人注意或者打断他人）

ext.ext_cn: 对不起，您用完餐了吗，夫人？
ext.ext_en: Pardon me, are you finished, madam?

defs.def_en: Some people say 'Pardon me' instead of 'Excuse me' when they want to politely get someone's attention or interrupt them.

ext.ext_cn: 恕我直言，那根本就不重要。
ext.ext_en: That, if you'll pardon  my saying so, is neither here nor there.

defs.def_en: You can say things like 'Pardon me for asking' or 'Pardon my frankness' as a way of showing you understand that what you are going to say may sound rude.

defs.def_cn: 请原谅我这么说；说句粗话您别介意

ext.ext_cn: 这足以吓得你尿裤子了，请原谅我这么说。
ext.ext_en: It's enough to make you wet yourself, if you'll pardon the expression.

defs.def_en: Some people say things like 'If you'll pardon the expression' or 'Pardon my French' just before or after saying something which they think might offend people.

ext.ext_en: Hundreds of political prisoners were pardoned and released.

ext.ext_cn: 他得到了总统的赦免。
ext.ext_en: He was granted a presidential pardon.

defs.def_en: If someone who has been found guilty of a crime is pardoned, they are officially allowed  to go free and are not punished.

defs.def_cn: (尤指不打算入睡时)打瞌睡，打盹

ext.ext_cn: 昨天一名证人接受盘问时，法官好像在打盹。
ext.ext_en: The judge appeared to nod off yesterday while a witness was being cross-examined...

ext.ext_cn: 他坐在扶手椅上打盹，睡着了。
ext.ext_en: He was nodding off to sleep in an armchair.

defs.def_en: If you nod off, you fall asleep, especially when you had not intended to.

ext.ext_cn: 我们费力地爬到山上的体育场。
ext.ext_en: We trudged up the hill to the stadium.

ext.ext_cn: 梅普尔山
ext.ext_en: ...Maple Hill.

defs.def_en: A hill is an area of land that is higher than the land that surrounds it.

defs.def_cn: 人老珠黄;在走下坡路;在衰退中;过气

ext.ext_cn: 他不爱听别人说他风光不再。
ext.ext_en: He doesn't take kindly to suggestions that he is over the hill.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is over the hill, you are saying rudely that they are old and no longer fit, attractive, or capable of doing useful work.

defs.def_cn: （因自身长大或改变而）改掉（或戒除）（习惯、爱好等）

ext.ext_cn: 大多数口吃的儿童长大以后就好了。
ext.ext_en: Most children who stammer grow out of it.

defs.def_en: If you grow out of a type of behaviour or an interest, you stop behaving in that way or having that interest, as you develop or change.

defs.def_cn: （孩子）长大穿不下（原来的衣服）

ext.ext_cn: 你又长大了，原来的鞋子再也穿不下了。
ext.ext_en: You've grown out of your shoes again.

defs.def_en: When a child grows out of an item of clothing, they become so tall or big that it no longer fits them properly.
A split-level house or room has part of the ground floor at a different level from another part, usually because the house has been built on ground that slopes.

ext.ext_cn: 他不能容忍自己观点以外的任何观点
ext.ext_en: ...his intolerance of any opinion other than his own.

ext.ext_cn: 宗教信仰上的不容异己
ext.ext_en: ...religious intolerance.

defs.def_en: Intolerance is unwillingness to let other people act in a different way or hold different opinions from you.

defs.def_cn: 必然的想法(或结果);直接推论

ext.ext_cn: 政府决心打击暴力犯罪，直接导致了囚犯数量的增多。
ext.ext_en: The number of prisoners increased as a corollary of the government's determination to combat violent crime.

defs.def_en: A corollary of something is an idea, argument, or fact that results directly from it.
A lock-keeper is a person whose job is to be in charge of and maintain a lock or group of locks on a canal.

defs.def_cn: （通常为了强调）重复讲，反复说，重申

ext.ext_cn: 他重申了自己反对成立央行的立场。
ext.ext_en: He reiterated his opposition to the creation of a central bank...

ext.ext_cn: 我要再次重申，我们的常规武器是一流的。
ext.ext_en: I want to reiterate that our conventional weapons are superior.

defs.def_en: If you reiterate something, you say it again, usually in order to emphasize it.

defs.def_cn: (体内组织的)破裂;(尤指)脱肠，疝气
defs.def_en: A rupture is a severe injury in which an internal part of your body tears or bursts open, especially the part between the bowels and the abdomen.

ext.ext_cn: 他的胃可能因为这些酸液而穿孔。
ext.ext_en: His stomach might rupture from all the acid...

ext.ext_cn: 打羽毛球时，我的跟腱撕裂了。
ext.ext_en: Whilst playing badminton, I ruptured my Achilles tendon.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal ruptures a part of their body or if it ruptures, it tears or bursts open.

defs.def_cn: 使（器官）破裂;形成疝;患脱肠

ext.ext_cn: 他踢足球引发了疝气。
ext.ext_en: He ruptured himself playing football.

defs.def_en: If you rupture yourself, you rupture a part of your body, usually because you have lifted something heavy.

ext.ext_cn: 某些卡车的油箱在碰撞时可能发生爆裂并起火。
ext.ext_en: Certain truck gasoline tanks can rupture and burn in a collision...

ext.ext_cn: 晃动液体可以使容器壁破裂。
ext.ext_en: Sloshing liquids can rupture the walls of their containers.

defs.def_en: If an object ruptures or if something ruptures it, it bursts open.

ext.ext_cn: 这些事件目前尚未造成国家之间政治关系的严重破裂。
ext.ext_en: The incidents have not yet caused a major rupture in the political ties between countries.

ext.ext_cn: 家庭关系的破裂
ext.ext_en: ...a rupture of the family unit.

defs.def_en: If there is a rupture between people, relations between them get much worse or end completely.

defs.def_cn: 使(关系)破裂;使(关系)恶化;使(关系)断绝

ext.ext_cn: 这次事件使最近达成的不堪一击的停火协议破裂。
ext.ext_en: The incident ruptures a recent and fragile ceasefire.

defs.def_en: If someone or something ruptures relations between people, they damage them, causing them to become worse or to end.
Blood is the red liquid that flows inside your body, which you can see if you cut yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 他有希腊血统。
ext.ext_en: There was Greek blood in his veins...

ext.ext_cn: 他出身贵族，是一名军官。
ext.ext_en: He was of noble blood, and an officer.

defs.def_en: You can use blood to refer to the race or social class of someone's parents or ancestors.

ext.ext_cn: 米尔斯和鲍德温一家人好像有些不和。
ext.ext_en: There is, it seems, some bad blood between Mills and the Baldwins.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is bad blood between people, you mean that they have argued about something and dislike each other.

ext.ext_cn: 那么，他又会对那些一直强烈要求制裁他的人说些什么呢？
ext.ext_en: And so what will he say to those who have been baying for his blood?

defs.def_en: If you say that people are baying for blood, you mean that they are demanding that someone should be hurt or punished.
See also:blue-blooded;If you say that someone has blue blood, you mean that they are from a family that has a high social rank.

defs.def_cn: 使怒不可遏；使怒火中烧

ext.ext_cn: 一想到两个暴徒要欺负一个天真的小姑娘，我就满腔怒火。
ext.ext_en: It makes my blood boil to think two thugs decided to pick on an innocent young girl.

defs.def_en: If you say that something makes your blood boil, you are emphasizing that it makes you very angry.

defs.def_cn: 冷酷无情地；冷血地；残忍地

ext.ext_cn: 这一罪行极为残忍。
ext.ext_en: The crime had been committed in cold blood.

defs.def_en: See also:cold-blooded;If something violent and cruel is done in cold blood, it is done deliberately and in an unemotional way.

defs.def_cn: 使人不寒而栗；令人毛骨悚然

ext.ext_cn: 他眼中的怒火吓得她汗毛倒竖。
ext.ext_en: The rage in his eyes made her blood run cold...

ext.ext_cn: 他听到突如其来的一声吼叫，吓得魂不附体。
ext.ext_en: He could hear a sudden roaring. His blood froze.

defs.def_en: If you say that something makes your blood run cold or makes your blood freeze, you mean that it makes you feel very frightened.

defs.def_cn: 手上沾了…的血；对…的死难辞其咎

ext.ext_cn: 他手上沾了我儿子的血。我咒他余生不得安宁。
ext.ext_en: He has my son's  blood on his hands. I hope it haunts him for the rest of his days.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a person's  blood on their hands, you mean that they are responsible for that person's death.

defs.def_cn: 天生的；遗传的；生来就有的

ext.ext_cn: 他天生擅长交际：他的祖先曾是封建领主。
ext.ext_en: Diplomacy was in his blood: his ancestors had been feudal lords...

ext.ext_cn: 他天生具备冒险基因。
ext.ext_en: He has adventure in his blood.

defs.def_en: If a quality or talent is in your blood, it is part of your nature, and other members of your family have it too.

defs.def_cn: 新鲜血液；新生力量；新成员

ext.ext_cn: 内阁进行了重大改组，吸收了一些新鲜血液。
ext.ext_en: There's been a major reshuffle of the cabinet to bring in new blood...

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队的人才选拔委员会必须着手引入一些新生力量。
ext.ext_en: The England selectors must start introducing young blood.

defs.def_en: You can use the expressions new blood ,fresh blood, or young blood to refer to people who are brought into an organization to improve it by thinking of new ideas or new ways of doing things.

defs.def_cn: 向石取血，缘木求鱼（比喻很难办到或徒劳无功）
defs.def_en: If you say that doing something such as getting information or persuading someone to talk to you is like getting blood out of a stone or getting blood from a stone, you are emphasizing that it is very difficult and that people are not being very helpful. In American English, you can also say that it is like getting blood out of a turnip .

ext.ext_cn: 我得拼命争取获得硕士学位。
ext.ext_en: I had to sweat blood for an M.A.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone sweats blood trying to do something, you are emphasizing that they try very hard to do it.

defs.def_cn: 取得初步胜利；最先占上风

ext.ext_cn: 主场球队依靠默里·斯特朗的罚球而旗开得胜。
ext.ext_en: The home side drew first blood with a penalty from Murray Strang.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone draws first blood, you mean that they have had a success at the beginning of a competition or conflict.

ext.ext_cn: 为什么那些看起来神志正常的人会拼了命地要拿到一个博士学位？
ext.ext_en: Why do apparently sane people go through all the blood, sweat, tears and heartache involved in getting a PhD?

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as involving blood, sweat, and tears, you mean that it is a very hard thing to do and requires a lot of effort.

defs.def_cn: 血浓于水；家人总比外人亲

ext.ext_cn: 家家有本难念的经，也都难免互生嫉妒，但总归血浓于水。
ext.ext_en: Families have their problems and jealousies, but blood is thicker than water.

defs.def_en: People say 'blood is thicker than water' when they mean that their loyalty to their family is greater than their loyalty to anyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 水分子间的氢键
ext.ext_en: ...the hydrogen bonds between water molecules.

defs.def_en: A molecule is the smallest amount of a chemical substance which can exist by itself.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他眼神悲伤地久久望着我。
ext.ext_en: He gave me a long, doleful look.

defs.def_en: A doleful expression, manner, or voice is depressing and miserable.

ext.ext_cn: 我们犯了狭隘的错误，抵制变革。
ext.ext_en: We have been guilty of parochialism, of resistance to change.

defs.def_en: Parochialism is the quality of being parochial in your attitude.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有关时事的;时下关注的;热门话题的

ext.ext_cn: 该杂志的宗旨是在基督教框架下讨论时下的热门话题。
ext.ext_en: The magazine's aim is to discuss topical issues within a Christian framework...

ext.ext_cn: 油轮的沉没使得海洋污染的方方面面都成为眼下大家尤为关注的热点话题。
ext.ext_en: The sinking of the tanker has made aspects of marine pollution particularly topical.

defs.def_en: Topical is used to describe something that concerns or relates to events that are happening at the present time.

ext.ext_cn: 这种酶会使啤酒更容易过滤。
ext.ext_en: This enzyme would make the filtration of beer easier.

ext.ext_cn: 滤水系统
ext.ext_en: ...water filtration systems.

defs.def_en: Filtration is the process of filtering a substance.

defs.def_cn: 改变…的方向;改变…的目标

ext.ext_cn: 采用了管控措施来重新分配资源或改变其流向。
ext.ext_en: Controls were used to redistribute or redirect resources.

defs.def_en: If you redirect your energy, resources, or ability, you begin doing something different or trying to achieve something different.

ext.ext_cn: 她指引他们去了男装部。
ext.ext_en: She redirected them to the men's department.

defs.def_en: If you redirect someone or something, you change their course or destination.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 核武器可怕的毁灭性力量
ext.ext_en: ...the awesome destructive power of nuclear weapons...

ext.ext_cn: 负疚感会具有很强的杀伤力。
ext.ext_en: Guilt can be very destructive.

defs.def_en: Something that is destructive causes or is capable of causing great damage, harm, or injury.

ext.ext_cn: 他用自己最喜欢的几位体育明星的照片装饰房间。
ext.ext_en: He decorated his room with pictures of all his favorite sports figures...

ext.ext_cn: 用贝壳来装点盒子、托盘、镜子甚至是花盆。
ext.ext_en: Use shells to decorate boxes, trays, mirrors or even pots.

defs.def_en: If you decorate something, you make it more attractive by adding things to it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们装修后面的卧室时，是耶马最后说了算。
ext.ext_en: When they came to decorate the rear bedroom, it was Jemma who had the final say...

ext.ext_cn: 小伙子们正打算有时间油漆一下。
ext.ext_en: The boys are planning to decorate when they get the time...

defs.def_en: If you decorate a room or the inside of a building, you put new paint or wallpaper on the walls and ceiling, and paint the woodwork.

ext.ext_cn: 康斯太布尔风景画的海报装点着那些墙面。
ext.ext_en: Constable posters decorate the walls.

defs.def_en: If something decorates a place or an object, it makes it look more attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 他因为作战英勇而被授予奖章。
ext.ext_en: He was decorated for bravery in battle.

defs.def_en: If someone is decorated, they are given a medal or other honour as an official reward for something that they have done.

ext.ext_cn: 理查德恳求贝琳达再考虑一下，别坚持离婚。
ext.ext_en: Richard pleaded for Belinda to reconsider and not to go through with the divorce.

defs.def_en: If you go through with an action you have decided on, you do it, even though it may be very unpleasant or difficult for you.
A sophomore is a student in the second year of college or high school.

defs.def_cn: 那，那个(指代前面句子里提到的)

ext.ext_cn: 他们说你特别想和我谈谈。为什么？
ext.ext_en: They said you particularly wanted to talk to me. Why was that?...

ext.ext_cn: “喂，我的姐妹们没事儿吧？”——“你打电话就为这个？”
ext.ext_en: 'Hey, is there anything the matter with my sisters?' — 'Is that why you're phoning?'...

defs.def_en: You use that to refer back to an idea or situation expressed in a previous sentence or sentences.

defs.def_cn: 那个人,那个(用来指代已经提到的人或物)

ext.ext_cn: 委员们每年领取的各种津贴在 5 万到 6 万英镑之间，但最高可达 9 万英镑。
ext.ext_en: The Commissioners get between £50,000 and 60,000 a year in various allowances. But that amount can soar to 90,000 a year...

ext.ext_cn: 涨价最快的是最便宜的车型 CRX-HF，那款车 1990 年的基价是 9,145 美元。
ext.ext_en: The biggest increase was on the cheapest model, the CRX-HF. That car had a 1990 base price of $9,145.

defs.def_en: You use that to refer to someone or something already mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 那，那个(指已经谈到过的特定时期)

ext.ext_cn: 这篇报道于那周晚些时候刊登在一份周日报纸上。
ext.ext_en: The story was published in a Sunday newspaper later that week...

ext.ext_cn: 那天早上，我穿了一条宽松的黑裤子和一件长袖黑衬衫。
ext.ext_en: That morning I had put on a pair of black slacks and a long-sleeved black blouse.

defs.def_en: When you have been talking about a particular period of time, you use that to indicate that you are still referring to the same period. You use expressions such as that morning or that afternoon to indicate that you are referring to an earlier period of the same day.

defs.def_cn: (用于 that of, that which 等短语中引出有关上文提到的某事物的更多信息，而避免重复相关名词)

ext.ext_cn: 像 1973–1974 年间那样的经济衰退能让 1/10 的美国公司破产。
ext.ext_en: A recession like that of 1973–1974 could put one in ten American companies into bankruptcy...

ext.ext_cn: 室内污染分为两种：一种是我们能看得见或闻得着的，另一种是无色无味的。
ext.ext_en: Indoor pollution falls into two categories, that which we can see or smell, and pollution which is invisible and produces no odour.

defs.def_en: You use that in expressions such as that of and that which to introduce more information about something already mentioned, instead of repeating the noun which refers to it.

defs.def_cn: 那个，那(用于对前述内容表示同意或作出应答的词和词组前)

ext.ext_cn: “她说她在英格兰见过你。”——“是的。”
ext.ext_en: 'She said she'd met you in England.' — 'That's  true.'...

ext.ext_cn: “我从没去过巴黎。”——“可惜了，你什么时候应该去一次。”
ext.ext_en: 'I've never been to Paris.' — 'That's a pity. You should go one day.'

defs.def_en: You use that in front of words or expressions which express agreement, responses, or reactions to what has just been said.

defs.def_cn: 那一个，那个(引出将要更加详细介绍的人或物)

ext.ext_cn: 至于我呢，就选择了我认为正确的那条路线。
ext.ext_en: In my case I chose that course which I considered right...

ext.ext_cn: 非法歧视他人的人在事业上应该受到惩戒。
ext.ext_en: That person who violates the law and discriminates should suffer in his career.

defs.def_en: You use that to introduce a person or thing that you are going to give details or information about.

defs.def_cn: 那个(指代在时间、空间上离自己稍远的人或物，尤用于指示;有两个以上的事物时，that 指较远的那个)

ext.ext_cn: 你看那边那个家伙，他穿着双红袜子。
ext.ext_en: Look at that guy. He's got red socks...

ext.ext_cn: 你那顶帽子在哪儿买的？
ext.ext_en: Where did you get that hat?...

defs.def_en: You use that when you are referring to someone or something which is a distance away from you in position or time, especially when you indicate or point to them. When there are two or more things near you, that refers to the more distant one.

ext.ext_cn: 刚才和你说话的人是我老婆。
ext.ext_en: That's my wife you were talking to...

ext.ext_cn: 那个人是约翰·吉布，纽约应急管理办公室的行动总指挥官。
ext.ext_en: That's John Gibb, operations chief for New York Emergency Management...

defs.def_en: You use that when you are identifying someone or asking about their identity.

defs.def_cn: (不需明确指出的情况下谈话对方即可能知道所指的人或物)那个

ext.ext_cn: 我头戴那顶帽子，脚蹬漆皮鞋，当时感觉挺像那么回事儿。
ext.ext_en: I really thought I was something when I wore that hat and my patent leather shoes...

ext.ext_cn: 你收到我寄给你的那张支票了吗？
ext.ext_en: Did you get that cheque I sent?...

defs.def_en: You can use that when you expect the person you are talking to to know what or who you are referring to, without needing to identify the particular person or thing fully.

defs.def_cn: 不太，不那么(坏、滑稽、昂贵等)

ext.ext_cn: 他说，就连加里也没有那么蠢。
ext.ext_en: Not even Gary, he said, was that stupid...

ext.ext_cn: 没有那么好笑。
ext.ext_en: It isn't that funny...

defs.def_en: If something is not that bad, funny, or expensive for example, it is not as bad, funny, or expensive as it might be or as has been suggested.

defs.def_cn: 那么，那样(用于强调感情或品质的程度之深)

ext.ext_cn: 我差点中途退席，我太生气了。
ext.ext_en: I would have walked out, I was that angry...

ext.ext_cn: 我看起来有那么蠢吗？
ext.ext_en: Do I look that stupid?...

defs.def_en: You can use that to emphasize the degree of a feeling or quality.

ext.ext_cn: 我不想讲些难听的话什么的。
ext.ext_en: I hate to be nasty and all that...

ext.ext_cn: 我本人不是厨师，但对营养之类的事很感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: I'm not a cook myself but I am interested in nutrition and that.

defs.def_en: You use and all that or and that to refer generally to everything else which is associated with what you have just mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 此外，而且(用于陈述之后，修饰或强调所说的话)

ext.ext_cn: 不付出艰苦的努力似乎就不会取得成功，而且这一努力通常要劳其筋骨。
ext.ext_en: Success never seems to come but through hard work, often physically demanding work at that...

ext.ext_cn: 那家咖啡馆很受当地人欢迎，不过不包括当地那些更有身份的人。
ext.ext_en: The caféwas popular with locals, and not with the more respectable locals at that.

defs.def_en: You use at that after a statement which modifies or emphasizes what you have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 我虽然总的来说循规蹈矩，但依然是个令人失望的学生，就是说，叫我做什么我就做什么。
ext.ext_en: I am a disappointing, though generally dutiful, student. That is, I do as I'm told...

ext.ext_cn: 教育部长们应该把服务对象——也就是学生——的利益放在首位。
ext.ext_en: Education Ministers ought to have placed the interests of consumers — that is to say pupils — first.

defs.def_en: You use that is or that is to say to indicate that you are about to express the same idea more clearly or precisely.

defs.def_cn: 就这样，好了(表示不必再做什么或目的已经达到)

ext.ext_cn: 他一离开办公室，就此打住，一天的工作就结束了。
ext.ext_en: When he left the office, that was it, the workday was over.

defs.def_en: You use that's it to indicate that nothing more needs to be done or that the end has been reached.

defs.def_cn: 对，是这样(表示同意、赞许)

ext.ext_cn: “你结婚了吧？”——“嗯，结了。”
ext.ext_en: 'You got married, right?' — 'Yeah, that's it.'

defs.def_en: You use that's it to express agreement with or approval of what has just been said or done.

defs.def_cn: 就那样(强调某事突然发生、立即做完或过程很简单，常指未加思考、讨论)

ext.ext_cn: 就那样，我恋爱了。
ext.ext_en: Just like that, I was in love...

ext.ext_cn: 你是说他就那样把你打发回来啦？
ext.ext_en: You mean he sent you back just like that?

defs.def_en: You use just like that to emphasize that something happens or is done immediately or in a very simple way, often without much thought or discussion.

defs.def_cn: 就这样，就这么定了(表示无能为力、无话可说)

ext.ext_cn: “好吧，如果那就是你想要的，”他两眼含泪说道，“我想那就这样吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'Well, if that's the way you want it,' he replied, tears in his eyes, 'I guess that's that.'

ext.ext_cn: “我想让你回家。”——“我就待在这儿，就这么定了。”
ext.ext_en: 'I want you to go home.' — 'I'm  staying here, and that's that.'

defs.def_en: You use that's that to say there is nothing more you can do or say about a particular matter.

defs.def_cn: (用于动词、形容词、名词、短语之后，引导间接引语从句)

ext.ext_cn: 有一天，他给她打电话，说他和妻子要来纽约。
ext.ext_en: He called her up one day and said that he and his wife were coming to New York...

ext.ext_cn: 我们很担心她快要死了。
ext.ext_en: We were worried that she was going to die...

defs.def_en: You can use that after many verbs, adjectives, nouns, and expressions to introduce a clause in which you report what someone has said, or what they think or feel.

defs.def_cn: (用于“it+系动词+形容词”结构之后，表示评论)

ext.ext_cn: 你喜欢他，这真有意思。
ext.ext_en: It's interesting that you like him...

ext.ext_cn: 我已经拿定了主意，但你显然还需要更多时间来考虑。
ext.ext_en: I've made up my mind, but it's obvious that you need more time to think...

defs.def_en: You use that after 'it' and a link verb and an adjective to comment on a situation or fact.

defs.def_cn: (引导从句，以提供更多有关谈论对象的信息)

ext.ext_cn: 能消除该症状的药丸
ext.ext_en: ...pills that will make the problem disappear.

ext.ext_cn: 发动不起来的汽车
ext.ext_en: ...a car that won't start...

defs.def_en: You use that to introduce a clause which gives more information to help identify the person or thing you are talking about.

defs.def_cn: (用在 so，such 之后，引出结果或影响)

ext.ext_cn: 她太紧张了，浑身抖得厉害。
ext.ext_en: She became so nervous that she shook violently...

ext.ext_cn: 她飞快地朝我这边走来，把一张椅子都撞翻了。
ext.ext_en: She came towards me so quickly that she knocked a chair over...

defs.def_en: You use that after expressions with 'so' and 'such' in order to introduce the result or effect of something.

ext.ext_cn: 没有几个大臣具备理解这些后果所需要的理性或直觉。
ext.ext_en: Few ministers have the nous or the instinct required to understand the ramifications...

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个精力非凡、志向远大、政治上很有见识的人。
ext.ext_en: He is a man of extraordinary vitality, driving ambition and political nous.

defs.def_en: Nous is intelligence or common sense.
A veterinary surgeon is someone who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 明确的;最终的;不可更改的;决定性的

ext.ext_cn: 对于为什么应该是这样，还没有人想出最终确定的答案。
ext.ext_en: No one has come up with a definitive answer as to why this should be so...

ext.ext_cn: 对这种病目前还没有决定性的检测手段。
ext.ext_en: There is no definitive test as yet for the condition.

defs.def_en: Something that is definitive provides a firm conclusion that cannot be questioned.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （书籍或表演）最佳的，最具权威的

ext.ext_cn: 他的《奥克尼挂毯》一书仍是关于这些岛屿的最权威著作。
ext.ext_en: His 'An Orkney Tapestry' is still the definitive book on the islands.

defs.def_en: A definitive book or performance is thought to be the best of its kind that has ever been done or that will ever be done.
A palomino is a horse which is yellowish or cream in colour and has a white tail.
A jamb is a post that forms the side part or upright of a door frame or window frame.

defs.def_cn: 把…排挤出去;将…排除在外

ext.ext_cn: 其他董事都因为霍利克勋爵被挤了出去而显得很高兴。
ext.ext_en: Other directors appear happy that Lord Hollick has been squeezed out...

ext.ext_cn: 拉丁语和希腊语将退出学校的课程表。
ext.ext_en: Latin and Greek will be squeezed out of school timetables.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is squeezed out, they are no longer included in something that they were previously involved in.
Your salivary glands are the glands that produce saliva in your mouth.

defs.def_cn: (由于人为错误或疏忽造成的)糟糕的问题，麻烦事

ext.ext_cn: 一系列技术问题延误了新产品的上市。
ext.ext_en: A series of technical foul-ups delayed the launch of the new product.

defs.def_en: A foul-up is something that has gone badly wrong as a result of someone's mistakes or carelessness.
A battle cruiser is a large fast warship that is lighter than a battleship and moves more easily.

ext.ext_cn: 他坚信自由与社会正义是不可分的。
ext.ext_en: He firmly believes liberty is inseparable from social justice...

ext.ext_cn: 对古代墨西哥人来说,生与死是同一整体不可分割的两个部分。
ext.ext_en: For the ancient Mexicans, life and death were inseparable, two halves of the same whole.

defs.def_en: If one thing is inseparable from another, the things are so closely connected that they cannot be considered separately.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她和克里斯廷形影不离。
ext.ext_en: She and Kristin were inseparable.

defs.def_en: If you say that two people are inseparable, you are emphasizing that they are very good friends and spend a great deal of time together.

ext.ext_cn: 他的谦逊值得赞扬，因为他做的食物品质之高显而易见。
ext.ext_en: His modesty does him credit, for the food he produces speaks for itself...

ext.ext_cn: 他表演这个角色时倾注了巨大的心血，而且非常谦虚和善。
ext.ext_en: He plays the character with tremendous concentration combined with a pleasing modesty.

defs.def_en: Someone who shows modesty does not talk much about their abilities or achievements.

ext.ext_cn: 这座城市本身就小得让人惊讶。
ext.ext_en: The modesty of the town itself comes as something of a surprise.

ext.ext_cn: 他们价格的低廉
ext.ext_en: ...the  modesty of their prices.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the modesty of something such as a place or amount when it is fairly small.

ext.ext_cn: 竭力保持着端庄形象的女孩们发出了尴尬的尖叫。
ext.ext_en: There were shrieks of embarrassment as the girls struggled to protect their modesty.

defs.def_en: If someone, especially a woman, shows modesty, they are cautious about the way they dress and behave because they are aware that other people may view them in a sexual way.
A rowing machine is an exercise machine with moving parts which you move as if you were rowing a rowing boat.

defs.def_cn: 内幕交易，内线交易(利用内幕消息买卖公司股票以牟利的不法交易行为)
defs.def_en: Insider trading or insider dealing is the illegal buying or selling of a company's shares by someone who has secret or private information about the company.

ext.ext_cn: 他不可能把骗人的把戏错当成真正的知识。
ext.ext_en: It is unlikely he would have mistaken hocus-pocus for genuine knowledge.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as hocus-pocus, you disapprove of it because you think it is false and intended to trick or deceive people.

defs.def_cn: 雾号，雾角(用于雾天警示水中船只)
defs.def_en: A foghorn is a piece of equipment that makes a loud noise and is used to warn ships about the position of land and other ships in fog.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 总的来说，那些从商的人并不太熟悉基本的科学原理。
ext.ext_en: Those in business are not, on the whole, conversant with basic scientific principles.

defs.def_en: If you are conversant with something, you are familiar with it and able to deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 我在为保守党拉选票。
ext.ext_en: I'm canvassing for the Conservative Party...

defs.def_en: If you canvass for a particular person or political party, you go around an area trying to persuade people to vote for that person or party.

ext.ext_cn: 国会议员这个周末要向所在选区的选民征求意见。
ext.ext_en: Members of Parliament are spending the weekend canvassing opinion in their constituencies.

ext.ext_cn: 民意调查征询了将近80位经济学家的意见。
ext.ext_en: The poll canvassed the views of almost eighty economists.

defs.def_en: If you canvass public opinion, you find out how people feel about a particular subject.
A worktop is a flat surface in a kitchen which is easy to clean and on which you can prepare food.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （报告、演讲）尖锐深刻的，直言不讳的

ext.ext_cn: 在向国际货币基金组织所作的一次言辞激烈的演讲中，他敦促第三世界国家实行彻底改革。
ext.ext_en: In a hard-hitting speech to the IMF, he urged third world countries to undertake sweeping reforms.

ext.ext_cn: 对家庭暴力大胆深入的报道
ext.ext_en: ...a hard-hitting account of violence in the home.

defs.def_en: If you describe a report or speech as hard-hitting, you like the way it talks about difficult or serious matters in a bold and direct way.
See also:bubblegum;chewing gum;Gum is a substance, usually tasting of mint, which you chew for a long time but do not swallow.

ext.ext_cn: 这种牙刷可以温和去除牙菌斑而不损伤齿龈。
ext.ext_en: The toothbrush gently removes plaque without damaging the gums.

ext.ext_cn: 牙龈病
ext.ext_en: ...gum disease.

defs.def_en: Your gums are the areas of firm, pink flesh inside your mouth, which your teeth grow out of.

ext.ext_cn: 他举着一张被撕成两半后又用胶粘在一起的一英镑的钞票。
ext.ext_en: He was holding up a pound note that had been torn in half and stuck together with gum.

defs.def_en: Gum is a type of glue that is used to stick two pieces of paper together.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一种轻微感染，会导致婴儿睫毛粘在一起。
ext.ext_en: It is a mild infection in which a baby's eyelashes can become gummed together.

defs.def_en: If two things are gummed together, they are stuck together.
Gum is a sticky substance which comes from the eucalyptus tree or from various other trees and shrubs.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 起居室非常小。
ext.ext_en: The living room is tiny...

ext.ext_cn: 她虽然个头小，嗓音却非常洪亮。
ext.ext_en: Though she was tiny, she had a very loud voice...

defs.def_en: Something or someone that is tiny is extremely small.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 经济衰退的；衰退期的；引起经济衰退的

ext.ext_cn: 利率的下调将有助于缓解经济衰退的压力。
ext.ext_en: Reduced interest rates would help ease recessionary pressures in the economy.

defs.def_en: Recessionary means relating to an economic recession or having the effect of creating a recession.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示极度高兴或兴奋）哇，啊
defs.def_en: People sometimes shout 'yahoo!' when they are very happy or excited about something.

defs.def_cn: 招摇的年轻人；富家公子

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦商业区典型的奢侈挥霍的年轻商业银行家
ext.ext_en: ..a typical City merchant banking yahoo.

defs.def_en: Some people refer to young rich people as yahoos when they disapprove of them because they behave in a noisy, extravagant, and unpleasant way.

defs.def_cn: 没有父亲的;父亲已不在世的;父亲不在身边的

ext.ext_cn: 孤儿寡母
ext.ext_en: ...widows and fatherless children...

ext.ext_cn: 他们成了没有父亲的孩子。
ext.ext_en: They were left fatherless.

defs.def_en: You describe children as fatherless when their father has died or does not live with them.

ext.ext_cn: 鸟儿使劲地拍打翅膀。
ext.ext_en: The bird flapped its wings furiously...

ext.ext_cn: 她看见蛾子的翅膀偶尔会泛光。
ext.ext_en: She saw the occasional glimmer of a moth's wings.

defs.def_en: The wings of a bird or insect are the two parts of its body that it uses for flying.
The wings of an aeroplane are the long flat parts sticking out of its side which support it while it is flying.

ext.ext_cn: 给我们在空置的大楼西翼分了一间办公室。
ext.ext_en: We were given an office in the empty west wing.

ext.ext_cn: 在伦敦皇家自由医院配楼的儿童精神病部
ext.ext_en: ...in the Child Psychiatry wing of London's Royal Free Hospital.

defs.def_en: A wing of a building is a part of it which sticks out from the main part.

ext.ext_cn: 非洲国民大会的武装派
ext.ext_en: ...the military wing of the African National Congress.

ext.ext_cn: 民主党自由派
ext.ext_en: ...the liberal wing of the Democratic Party.

defs.def_en: See also:left-wing;right-wing;A wing of an organization, especially a political organization, is a group within it which has a particular function or particular beliefs.

defs.def_cn: (舞台两侧用帘幕或布景遮住的)边厢,翼部,侧面

ext.ext_cn: 大多数晚上我都是在边厢观看戏剧的开场。
ext.ext_en: Most nights I watched the start of the play from the wings.

defs.def_en: In a theatre, the wings are the sides of the stage which are hidden from the audience by curtains or scenery.

defs.def_cn: (足球、曲棍球等的)边锋位置；边锋
defs.def_en: In a game such as football or hockey, the left wing and the right wing are the areas on the far left and the far right of the pitch. You can also refer to the players who play in these positions as the left wing and the right wing .
A wing of a car is a part of it on the outside which is over one of the wheels.

defs.def_cn: 飞机驾驶资格；飞行资格

ext.ext_cn: 他刚获得飞行资格，朝鲜战争就爆发了。
ext.ext_en: He had no sooner got his wings than the Korean conflict broke out.

defs.def_en: When pilots get their wings, they become qualified to fly aeroplanes.

ext.ext_cn: 过了一会儿，他们已然搭上飞机赶往南方了。
ext.ext_en: A few moments later they were airborne and winging their way south...

ext.ext_cn: 该方案的60万成员很快将获得一次发财的机会。
ext.ext_en: A cash bonanza will be winging its way to the 600,000 members of the scheme...

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone wings their way somewhere or wings somewhere, you mean that they go there quickly, especially by plane.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在从政治上限制总统的立法
ext.ext_en: ...legislation aimed at clipping the president's political wings.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone clips your wings, you mean that they restrict your freedom to do what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 现有20多家大公司随时准备接手其部分业务。
ext.ext_en: There are now more than 20 big companies waiting in the wings to take over some of its business.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is waiting in the wings, you mean that they are ready and waiting for an opportunity to take action.

ext.ext_cn: 我在村里生活很封闭，所以我想出去闯荡一番。
ext.ext_en: I led a very confined life in my village so I suppose that I wanted to spread my wings.

defs.def_en: If you spread your wings, you do something new and rather difficult or move to a new place, because you feel more confident in your abilities than you used to and you want to gain wider experience.

defs.def_cn: 将…置于羽翼之下；对…呵护有加

ext.ext_cn: 老板充分意识到她的潜力后，对她关怀备至。
ext.ext_en: Her boss took her under his wing after fully realizing her potential.

defs.def_en: If you take someone under your wing, you look after them, help them, and protect them.

defs.def_cn: 拗口的句子(或表达);绕口令
defs.def_en: A tongue-twister is a sentence or expression which is very difficult to say properly, especially when you try to say it quickly. An example of a tongue-twister is 'Red leather, yellow leather'.

defs.def_cn: (演出、产品等)令人赞叹的，让人印象深刻的，十分出色的
defs.def_en: A show-stopping performance or product is very impressive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人不快的;令人厌恶的;恶劣的

ext.ext_cn: 令人发指的谋杀
ext.ext_en: ...an extremely nasty murder...

ext.ext_cn: 这场离婚可能会撕破脸。
ext.ext_en: This divorce could turn nasty.

defs.def_en: Something that is nasty is very unpleasant to see, experience, or feel.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你们全都是些可恶的势利小人。
ext.ext_en: What nasty little snobs you all are...

ext.ext_cn: 卫兵们看起来真凶。
ext.ext_en: The guards looked really nasty...
