defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as nasty, you mean that they behave in an unkind and unpleasant way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 邋遢的;低劣的;下流的;污秽的

ext.ext_cn: 埃米莉在巴勒姆的脏乱小屋
ext.ext_en: ...Emily's nasty little house in Balham...

ext.ext_cn: 那个该死的法雷尔开了些关于莱恩先生的下流玩笑。
ext.ext_en: That damned Farrel made some nasty jokes here about Mr. Lane.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as nasty, you mean it is unattractive, undesirable, or in bad taste.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一位发言人称这一坚决的行动缓和了极为棘手的局面。
ext.ext_en: A spokesman said this firm action had defused a very nasty situation.

defs.def_en: A nasty problem or situation is very worrying and difficult to deal with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我小孙女的脚跟夹到自行车的轮辐里了，伤得很严重。
ext.ext_en: My little granddaughter caught her heel in the spokes of her bicycle — it was a very nasty wound...

ext.ext_cn: 莉莉胸部感染很严重。
ext.ext_en: Lili had a nasty chest infection.

defs.def_en: If you describe an injury or a disease as nasty, you mean that it is serious or looks unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 令人不快的人(或事);危害别人的人(或事)

ext.ext_cn: 充斥着恶棍的邪恶组织
ext.ext_en: ...evil organisations, peopled with nasties...

ext.ext_cn: 脱咖啡因的咖啡仍含一些刺激物和其他可能致癌的有害物质。
ext.ext_en: Decaffeinated coffee still contains some stimulants and other nasties linked with cancer.

defs.def_en: Nasties are unpleasant or harmful people or things.

ext.ext_cn: 他们三人从三个不同的视角讲述了同样的事件。
ext.ext_en: The three of them narrate the same events from three perspectives...

ext.ext_cn: 这本书是以一个叫理查德·巴本的加利福尼亚男孩的口吻讲述的。
ext.ext_en: The book is narrated by Richard Papen, a Californian boy.

defs.def_en: If you narrate a story, you tell it from your own point of view.

ext.ext_cn: 她还为一部关于基洛夫芭蕾舞学院的纪录片作过解说。
ext.ext_en: She also narrated a documentary about the Kirov Ballet School.

defs.def_en: The person who narrates a film or programme speaks the words which accompany the pictures, but does not appear in it.

ext.ext_cn: 标题使用粗黑字体，显著的成就要用着重号标示。
ext.ext_en: Use bold type for headings and bullet points for noteworthy achievements.

defs.def_en: A bullet point is one of a series of important items for discussion or action in a document, usually marked by a square or round symbol.

defs.def_cn: 以…为生活（或工作）中心的；以…为基地的；总部设在…的

ext.ext_cn: 两个公司的总部都设在肯特市。
ext.ext_en: Both firms are based in Kent...

ext.ext_cn: 总部设在马特湖边的阳光游艇公司于1870年开始造船。
ext.ext_en: Based on the edge of Lake Matt, Sunbeam Yachts started boatbuilding in 1870.

defs.def_en: If you are based in a particular place, that is the place where you live or do most of your work. See also base .

defs.def_cn: （学校在学年末举行的）正式舞会

ext.ext_cn: 我不想和克雷格一起参加学年末的舞会。
ext.ext_en: I didn't want to go to the prom with Craig.

ext.ext_cn: 我高中的学年末舞会
ext.ext_en: ...my senior prom.

defs.def_en: A prom is a formal dance at a school or college which is usually held at the end of the academic year.
The prom is the road by the sea where people go for a walk.

ext.ext_cn: 《逍遥音乐会终场之夜》
ext.ext_en: ...the Last Night of the Proms.

ext.ext_cn: 逍遥音乐会上他的压轴曲目——埃尔加的《第一交响曲》
ext.ext_en: ...his final Prom performance of Elgar's First Symphony.

defs.def_en: The Proms are a series of concerts of mainly classical music that are held each year in London and some other cities. There is usually an area at these concerts where people stand, as well as seats.

defs.def_cn: 无人认领的；无人领取的

ext.ext_cn: 她的行李一直放在法兰克福机场，无人认领。
ext.ext_en: Her luggage remained unclaimed at Frankfurt Departures.

ext.ext_cn: 无人领取的奖品
ext.ext_en: ...unclaimed prizes.

defs.def_en: If something is unclaimed, nobody has claimed it or said that it belongs to them.

ext.ext_cn: 克罗斯听得到他对萨拉低声说话。
ext.ext_en: Cross could hear him speaking in low tones to Sarah.

ext.ext_cn: 清亮的铃音
ext.ext_en: ...the clear tone of the bell.

defs.def_en: The tone of a sound is its particular quality.

ext.ext_cn: 我还是不喜欢他说话的语气。
ext.ext_en: I still didn't like his tone of voice...

ext.ext_cn: 突然他又笑了，这次笑得冷漠、刺耳。
ext.ext_en: Suddenly he laughed again, this time with a cold, sharp tone…

defs.def_en: Someone's tone is a quality in their voice which shows what they are feeling or thinking.

ext.ext_cn: 发言人说信函的语气非常友好。
ext.ext_en: The spokesman said the tone of the letter was very friendly...

ext.ext_cn: 他对记者们的讲话带着安抚的口吻。
ext.ext_en: His comments to reporters were conciliatory in tone...

defs.def_en: The tone of a speech or piece of writing is its style and the opinions or ideas expressed in it.

ext.ext_cn: 十几位富有资助人的出席确保了仪式的高格调。
ext.ext_en: The high tone of the occasion was assured by the presence of a dozen wealthy patrons…

ext.ext_cn: 入口处设有服务台，加之友好、热心与高效的服务人员，营造了这家商店的整体氛围。
ext.ext_en: The service desk at the entrance, with its friendly, helpful and efficient staff, sets the tone for the rest of the store.

defs.def_en: The tone of a place or an event is its general atmosphere.

defs.def_cn: （身体的）强健状况；(尤指肌肉的)紧实度，结实度

ext.ext_cn: 旨在提高肌肉结实度的伸展锻炼
ext.ext_en: ...stretch exercises that aim to improve muscle tone...

ext.ext_cn: 保持肌肉强健有力有助于避免背部疾病。
ext.ext_en: Keeping your muscles strong and in tone helps you to avoid back problems.

defs.def_en: The tone of someone's body, especially their muscles, is its degree of firmness and strength.

ext.ext_cn: 这一动作舒展脊椎，使脊神经更加强健。
ext.ext_en: This movement lengthens your spine and tones the spinal nerves...

ext.ext_cn: 在开始一天的活动之前，试着做做这些强身健体的体操。
ext.ext_en: Try these toning exercises before you start the day.

defs.def_en: Something that tones your body makes it firm and strong.

ext.ext_cn: 每块砖在色调、质地与大小上也都略有不同。
ext.ext_en: Each brick also varies slightly in tone, texture and size...

ext.ext_cn: 我是个活泼类型的人，因此喜欢明亮的色调。
ext.ext_en: I'm a cheery sort of person, so I like cheerful tones.

defs.def_en: A tone is one of the lighter, darker, or brighter shades of the same colour.

ext.ext_cn: 玛格丽特公主那条青绿色的印花裙子与她很相配。
ext.ext_en: Princess Margaret toned with her in a turquoise print dress.

ext.ext_cn: 那些碗与杯子巧妙相配。
ext.ext_en: The bowls tone in cleverly with the mugs.

defs.def_en: If one thing tones with another, the two things look nice together because their colours are similar in quality or brightness.
A tone is one of the sounds that you hear when you are using a telephone, for example the sound that tells you that a number is engaged or busy, or no longer exists.
A tone is a difference in pitch between two musical notes equal to two semitones.

ext.ext_cn: 市政会委员说塑料框架的窗户让这个社区掉份儿了。
ext.ext_en: Councillors say plastic-framed windows lower the tone of the neighbourhood.

defs.def_en: If you say that something lowers the tone of a place or event, you mean that it is not appropriate and makes the place or event seem less respectable.

defs.def_cn: 使(颜色)柔和；使(味道)变淡;调和

ext.ext_cn: 当肯·霍姆为英国广播公司写第一本书的时候，他被要求在菜谱里少用些香料和大蒜。
ext.ext_en: When Ken Hom wrote his first book for the BBC he was asked to tone down the spices and garlic in his recipes.

defs.def_en: If you tone down a colour or a flavour, you make it less bright or strong.

ext.ext_cn: 印度尼西亚是世界上第四大人口大国。
ext.ext_en: Indonesia is the fourth most populous country in the world.

ext.ext_cn: 两国之间存有争议的边境地区
ext.ext_en: ...that disputed boundary between the two countries...

defs.def_en: A country is one of the political units which the world is divided into, covering a particular area of land.

ext.ext_cn: 该国国民连续四次选举托利党来执掌政府，这令专家们困惑不已。
ext.ext_en: The country had confounded the pundits by electing a fourth-term Tory government...

ext.ext_cn: 该国70%的人反对猎兽活动。
ext.ext_en: Seventy per cent of this country is opposed to blood sports.

defs.def_en: The people who live in a particular country can be referred to as the country .

ext.ext_cn: 乡下的健康生活
ext.ext_en: ...a healthy life in the country...

ext.ext_cn: 她正骑车行进在贡比涅附近的乡村道路上。
ext.ext_en: She was cycling along a country road near Compiegne...

defs.def_en: The country consists of places such as farms, open fields, and villages which are away from towns and cities.

defs.def_cn: (具有某种特征或与某名人有关的)地区，区域

ext.ext_cn: 瓦雷泽古雷是位于热那亚以东山区的一座小城。
ext.ext_en: Varese Ligure is a small town in mountainous country east of Genoa.

ext.ext_cn: 喜艾拉生态保护区内一些最适宜散步的地区
ext.ext_en: ...some of the best walking country in the Sierras...

defs.def_en: A particular kind of country is an area of land which has particular characteristics or is connected with a particular well-known person.

ext.ext_cn: 有很长一段时间我只想弹奏乡村音乐。
ext.ext_en: For a long time I just wanted to play country music.

ext.ext_cn: 一位名为凯蒂·科克尔的著名乡村乐歌手
ext.ext_en: ...a famous country singer named Katie Cocker.

defs.def_en: Country music is popular music from the southern United States.

ext.ext_cn: 我们从这儿走乡间小路去卡温顿。
ext.ext_en: From here we walked across country to Covington.

defs.def_en: If you travel across country, you travel through country areas, avoiding major roads and towns.

defs.def_cn: 长途;长距离;跨越地区地

ext.ext_cn: 我们刚刚经过长途的搬迁来这里开始一种新生活。
ext.ext_en: We've just moved all the way across country to begin a new life.

defs.def_en: If you travel across country, you travel a long distance, from one part of a country to another.

ext.ext_cn: 首相明年也不用举行大选。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister does not have to go to the country for another year.

defs.def_en: If a head of government or a government goes to the country, they hold a general election.

defs.def_cn: 艏三角帆；主帆前的小帆
defs.def_en: The jib is the small triangular sail that is sometimes used at the front of a sailing boat.

ext.ext_cn: 那些拒绝出让土地的人
ext.ext_en: ...those who jib at the idea of selling their land.

defs.def_en: If you jib at something, you are unwilling to do it or to accept it.

ext.ext_cn: 委员会的建议不大可能公开。
ext.ext_en: The committee's recommendations are unlikely to be made public...

ext.ext_cn: 上诉法院法官伍尔夫将在他的报告中提出改革建议。
ext.ext_en: Lord Justice Woolf will make recommendations for reform in his report...

defs.def_en: The recommendations of a person or a committee are their suggestions or advice on what is the best thing to do.

ext.ext_cn: 在奥利里的推荐下，他们首先点了意大利饺子。
ext.ext_en: On O'Leary's recommendation, they started with tortellini...

ext.ext_cn: 找律师的最好方式是通过熟人介绍。
ext.ext_en: The best way of finding a solicitor is through personal recommendation.

defs.def_en: A recommendation of something is the suggestion that someone should have or use it because it is good.
A skipping rope or skip rope is a piece of rope, usually with handles at each end. You exercise or play with it by turning it round and round and jumping over it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们学校有一个名叫“弗雷迪小鸟”的吉祥物。
ext.ext_en: Our school had a mascot known as Freddy Bird.

ext.ext_cn: 巴塞罗那奥运会的官方吉祥物
ext.ext_en: ...the official mascot of the Barcelona Games.

defs.def_en: A mascot is an animal, toy, or symbol which is associated with a particular organization or event, and which is thought to bring good luck.
A hedonist is someone who believes that having pleasure is the most important thing in life.

defs.def_cn: 民族独立主义的;国家主义的

ext.ext_cn: 这一危机已在魁北克激起了一波民族独立主义情绪。
ext.ext_en: The crisis has set off a wave of nationalist feelings in Quebec.

ext.ext_cn: 斯洛伐克民族独立主义者建立独立国家的要求
ext.ext_en: ...demands by Slovak nationalists for an independent state.

defs.def_en: Nationalist means connected with the desire of a group of people within a country for political independence.

defs.def_cn: 民族主义的;怀有民族优越感的

ext.ext_cn: 政治生活已受到了不断高涨的民族主义情绪的影响。
ext.ext_en: Political life has been infected by growing nationalist sentiment.

ext.ext_cn: 一些民族主义者喜欢把英国的君主政体描绘为纯粹的英格兰制度。
ext.ext_en: Some nationalists would like to depict the British monarchy as a purely English institution.

defs.def_en: Nationalist means connected with a person's great love for their nation. It is often associated with the belief that their nation is better than any other nation, and in this case is often used showing disapproval.

ext.ext_cn: 言论自由
ext.ext_en: ...freedom of speech...

ext.ext_cn: 他们想要更多的政治自由。
ext.ext_en: They want greater political freedom...

defs.def_en: Freedom is the state of being allowed to do what you want to do. Freedoms are instances of this.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国拟定的恢复所有人质和被拘禁者人身自由的协议
ext.ext_en: ...the agreement worked out by the UN, under which all hostages and detainees would gain their freedom.

defs.def_en: When prisoners or slaves are set free or escape, they gain their freedom .

defs.def_cn: 摆脱;免除;不受…影响的状态

ext.ext_cn: 医药可以提供的对痛苦的解脱
ext.ext_en: ...all the freedom from pain that medicine could provide.

ext.ext_cn: 不受政府控制
ext.ext_en: ...freedom from government control.

defs.def_en: Freedom from something you do not want means not being affected by it.

ext.ext_cn: 市长阁下亲自向他颁发了都柏林市荣誉市民称号。
ext.ext_en: He was given the Freedom of the City of Dublin by the Lord Mayor.

defs.def_en: The freedom of a particular city is a special honour which is given to a famous person who is connected with that city, or to someone who has performed some special service for the city.

ext.ext_cn: 男女同工同酬
ext.ext_en: ...paying the same wages to men and women for work of comparable value...

ext.ext_cn: 农民的收入本应该与城里人的收入相当。
ext.ext_en: Farmers were meant to get an income comparable to that of townspeople...

defs.def_en: Something that is comparable to something else is roughly similar, for example in amount or importance.

ext.ext_cn: 在其他具有可比性的国家，实际工资上涨更快。
ext.ext_en: In other comparable countries real wages increased much more rapidly...

ext.ext_cn: 相反，荷兰的相对数字为16%。
ext.ext_en: By contrast, the comparable figure for the Netherlands is 16 per cent...

defs.def_en: If two or more things are comparable, they are of the same kind or are in the same situation, and so they can reasonably be compared.
A minaret is a tall thin tower which is part of a mosque.

ext.ext_cn: 足球流氓参与其中的骚乱
ext.ext_en: ...riots involving football hooligans.

defs.def_en: If you describe people, especially young people, as hooligans, you are critical of them because they behave in a noisy and violent way in a public place.

defs.def_cn: 一瘸一拐地走；跛行；蹒跚

ext.ext_cn: 我伤得不重，但一条大腿伤到了，只好一瘸一拐地走。
ext.ext_en: I wasn't badly hurt, but I injured my thigh and had to limp...

ext.ext_cn: 他腿上有伤，离开时只能一瘸一拐地走。
ext.ext_en: He had to limp off with a leg injury.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal limps, they walk with difficulty or in an uneven way because one of their legs or feet is hurt.

ext.ext_cn: 近年来这家报社一直在靠有限的资源艰难维持。
ext.ext_en: In recent years the newspaper had been limping along on limited resources...

ext.ext_cn: 一艘在克里特岛战役中严重受损的英国战舰艰难缓慢地驶进珍珠港。
ext.ext_en: A British battleship, which had been damaged severely in the battle of Crete, came limping into Pearl Harbor.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as an organization, process, or vehicle limps along, you mean that it continues slowly or with difficulty, for example because it has been weakened or damaged.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她被告知要回绝掉那些握手软弱无力的申请者。
ext.ext_en: She was told to reject applicants with limp handshakes...

ext.ext_cn: 残留物会积聚在头发上，使头发看起来软塌塌的，而且毫无光泽。
ext.ext_en: A residue can build up on the hair shaft, leaving the hair limp and dull looking.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as limp, you mean that it is soft or weak when it should be firm or strong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 四肢无力的；身体一动不动的

ext.ext_cn: 他把绵软无力的她抱进房间，放在床上。
ext.ext_en: He carried her limp body into the room and laid her on the bed...

ext.ext_cn: 他的头撞到一块岩石上，身子软了下来。
ext.ext_en: He hit his head against a rock and went limp.

defs.def_en: If someone is limp, their body has no strength and is not moving, for example because they are asleep or unconscious.

defs.def_cn: 尽力同时应付；尽量兼顾

ext.ext_cn: 管理团队一周碰头几次，以同时兼顾预算和资源。
ext.ext_en: The management team meets several times a week to juggle budgets and resources...

ext.ext_cn: 身为电视记者的迈克同时尽力照料着一个11口之家。
ext.ext_en: Mike juggled the demands of a family of 11 with a career as a TV reporter.

defs.def_en: If you juggle lots of different things, for example your work and your family, you try to give enough time or attention to all of them.

defs.def_cn: 玩杂耍（指连续向空中抛接多个物体）

ext.ext_cn: 没多会儿她就开始抛接5个鸡蛋了。
ext.ext_en: Soon she was juggling five eggs...

ext.ext_cn: 我不会玩杂耍。
ext.ext_en: I can't juggle.

defs.def_en: If you juggle, you entertain people by throwing things into the air, catching each one and throwing it up again so that there are several of them in the air at the same time.
A herbicide is a chemical that is used to destroy plants, especially weeds.
A fuchsia is a plant or a small bush which has pink, purple, or white flowers. The flowers hang downwards, with their outer petals curved backwards.

ext.ext_cn: 他们要是对你好，也不过是为了讨好你罢了。
ext.ext_en: If they'd treated you well it was just to soften you up.

defs.def_en: If you soften someone up, you put them into a good mood before asking them to do something.
Razzamatazz is the same as razzmatazz .

defs.def_cn: 物质名词（通常不可数，但在表示物质种类或类型时可与不定冠词连用，亦可用复数形式）
defs.def_en: A mass noun is a noun such as 'wine' which is usually uncount but is used with 'a' or 'an' or used in the plural when it refers to types of that substance, as in 'a range of Australian wines'.

defs.def_cn: (在某些语法描述文字中)同 uncount noun
defs.def_en: In some descriptions of grammar, a mass noun is the same as an uncount noun .

defs.def_cn: 已经（用already时，英国英语中动词用完成时态，美国英语有时则用一般过去时）

ext.ext_cn: 在第一次投票选举时，他们已经投票给他了。
ext.ext_en: They had already voted for him at the first ballot...

ext.ext_cn: 该集团已经裁去1万个工作岗位。
ext.ext_en: The group has already shed 10,000 jobs...

defs.def_en: You use already to show that something has happened, or that something had happened before the moment you are referring to. Speakers of British English use already with a verb in a perfect tense, putting it after 'have', 'has', or 'had', or at the end of a clause. Some speakers of American English use already with the simple past tense of the verb instead of a perfect tense.

defs.def_cn: 早已（用于be动词或助动词之后，或一般动词之前，表示强调时可置于句首）

ext.ext_cn: 当局相信那些安全措施已经奏效。
ext.ext_en: The authorities believe those security measures are already paying off...

ext.ext_cn: 他已经很富有了。
ext.ext_en: He was already rich...

defs.def_en: You use already to show that a situation exists at this present moment or that it exists at an earlier time than expected. You use already after the verb 'be' or an auxiliary verb, or before a verb if there is no auxiliary. When you want add emphasis, you can put already at the beginning of a sentence.

ext.ext_cn: 一位艺术家按实际大小雕刻了一个她的头部模型。
ext.ext_en: An artist sculpted a full-size replica of her head...

ext.ext_cn: 我的雕刻风格是表现主义。
ext.ext_en: When I sculpt, my style is expressionistic.

defs.def_en: When an artist sculpts something, they carve or shape it out of a material such as stone or clay.

ext.ext_cn: 还有更多熟悉的地貌是因地表侵蚀形成的。
ext.ext_en: More familiar landscapes have been sculpted by surface erosion...

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔把简的头发梳理平整并做出发型。
ext.ext_en: Michael smoothed and sculpted Jane's hair into shape.

defs.def_en: If something is sculpted, it is made into a particular shape.

ext.ext_cn: 她说丈夫不关心她。
ext.ext_en: She said her husband ignored her...

ext.ext_cn: 政府没有理睬他对这一问题的看法。
ext.ext_en: The government had ignored his views on the subject...

defs.def_en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

ext.ext_cn: 这些争论忽略了最终责任由谁来负的问题。
ext.ext_en: Such arguments ignore the question of where ultimate responsibility lay.

defs.def_en: If you say that an argument or theory ignores an important aspect of a situation, you are criticizing it because it fails to consider that aspect or to take it into account.

defs.def_cn: (尤指旧时船上或蒸汽火车上的)添煤工，司炉
defs.def_en: In former times a stoker was a person whose job was to stoke fires, especially on a ship or a steam train.

ext.ext_cn: 房东太太对待他就像对待危险的罪犯、对待社会弃儿一样。
ext.ext_en: His landlady had treated him like a dangerous criminal, a pariah.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a pariah, you mean that other people dislike them so much that they refuse to associate with them.

ext.ext_cn: 她曾两次透过墙缝窥视他。
ext.ext_en: On two occasions she had peeked at him through a crack in the wall.

ext.ext_cn: 美国公司为了一窥这些技术数据一直在支付巨额费用。
ext.ext_en: American firms have been paying outrageous fees for a peek at the technical data.

defs.def_en: If you peek at something or someone, you have a quick look at them, often secretly.

ext.ext_cn: 石油公司被控故意制造石油短缺以名正言顺地提高油价。
ext.ext_en: The oil companies were accused of  contriving a shortage of gasoline to justify price increases.

defs.def_en: If you contrive an event or situation, you succeed in making it happen, often by tricking someone.

defs.def_cn: 发明;(精巧地)设计出，制造

ext.ext_cn: 因此我们得制作一块很大的遮光窗帘。
ext.ext_en: We therefore had to contrive a very large black-out curtain.

defs.def_en: If you contrive something such as a device or piece of equipment, you invent and construct it in a clever or unusual way.

ext.ext_cn: 这支管弦乐队呈现了精彩的演奏，堪称其多年来的巅峰演奏。
ext.ext_en: The orchestra contrived to produce some of its best playing for years.

defs.def_en: If you contrive to do something difficult, you succeed in doing it.

defs.def_cn: (用欺骗的手法)策划，图谋，设法做到

ext.ext_cn: 他们精心策划故意遗失了数万份申请书。
ext.ext_en: They somehow contrived to lose tens of thousands of applications.

defs.def_en: When someone has done something dishonestly, you can say that they have contrived to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 一场短暂的钢琴音乐会
ext.ext_en: ...a short concert of piano music...

ext.ext_cn: 我去现场看过很多摇滚音乐会。
ext.ext_en: I've been to plenty of live rock concerts.

defs.def_en: A concert is a performance of music.

ext.ext_cn: 我希望大家记住现场演唱会上的猫王。
ext.ext_en: I want people to remember Elvis in concert.

defs.def_en: If a musician or group of musicians appears in concert, they are giving a live performance.

ext.ext_cn: 他想和其他国家采取一致行动。
ext.ext_en: He wants to act in concert with other nations.

defs.def_en: If a number of people do something in concert, they do it together.
A smelter is a container for smelting metal.

defs.def_cn: 电子制表程序(主要用于制定财务计划)
defs.def_en: A spreadsheet is a computer program that is used for displaying and dealing with numbers. Spreadsheets are used mainly for financial planning.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不赞成的;表示反对的;不以为然的

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮特不满地看了他一眼。
ext.ext_en: Janet gave him a disapproving look.

defs.def_en: A disapproving action or expression shows that you do not approve of something or someone.

ext.ext_cn: 有一类人似乎被遗忘了，就是那些领养老金的人。
ext.ext_en: One group of people seems to be forgotten, namely pensioners...

ext.ext_cn: 他们几乎没有意识到自己面临的挑战，即再创繁荣。
ext.ext_en: They were hardly aware of the challenge facing them, namely, to re-establish prosperity.

defs.def_en: You use namely to introduce detailed information about the subject you are discussing, or a particular aspect of it.

defs.def_cn: (用考勤卡)记录下班的时间;打卡下班

ext.ext_cn: 值夜班的警员准备打卡下班。
ext.ext_en: The Night Duty Officer was ready to clock off...

ext.ext_cn: 他们打卡下班，于2点50分离开。
ext.ext_en: They clocked off duty and left at ten to three.

defs.def_en: When you clock off at work, you leave work or put a special card into a device to show what time you left.

ext.ext_cn: 每扇门上都有张卡，上面印着客人的名字。
ext.ext_en: There was a card on each door with a guest's name inscribed thereon.

defs.def_en: Thereon means on the object or surface just mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 另外，你还须向银行支付所有损失、成本、花销和法律费用(包括与此相关的增值税)。
ext.ext_en: You will, in addition, pay to the Bank any losses, costs, expenses or legal fees (including VAT thereon).

defs.def_en: Thereon can be used to refer back to a thing that has previously been mentioned to show that the word just used relates to that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 有人给她做了人工呼吸和心脏按压。
ext.ext_en: She was given artificial respiration and cardiac massage.

defs.def_en: Artificial respiration is the forcing of air into the lungs of someone who has stopped breathing, usually by blowing through their mouth or nose, in order to keep them alive and to help them to start breathing again.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个难对付的谈判者。我们没指望说服他，而且也没说服他。
ext.ext_en: He is a tough negotiator. We did not expect to find him a pushover and he has not been one.

defs.def_en: You say that someone is a pushover when you find it easy to persuade them to do what you want.

defs.def_cn: 容易做的工作；易如反掌的事；唾手可得的东西

ext.ext_cn: 你可能认为匈牙利语很容易学。其实不然。
ext.ext_en: You might think Hungarian a pushover to learn. It is not.

defs.def_en: You say that something is a pushover when it is easy to do or easy to get.

defs.def_cn: (上层社会）首次进入社交界的年轻女子

ext.ext_cn: 她首次出现在伦敦社交界便艳惊四座，被视为同龄人里最美丽的年轻女子。
ext.ext_en: She dazzled London society as the most beautiful debutante of her generation.

defs.def_en: A debutante is a young woman from the upper classes who has started going to social events with other young people.
Bait is food which you put on a hook or in a trap in order to catch fish or animals.

defs.def_cn: 装饵于；给（鱼钩或陷阱等）上诱饵

ext.ext_cn: 他在鱼钩上装了点馅饼作钓饵。
ext.ext_en: He baited his hook with pie...

ext.ext_cn: 男孩们挖了坑，埋了饵，这样他们就可以刺杀猎物了。
ext.ext_en: The boys dug pits and baited them so that they could spear their prey.

defs.def_en: If you bait a hook or trap, you put bait on it or in it.

ext.ext_cn: 加油站以汽油为诱饵，吸引开车的人用餐以及使用其他设施。
ext.ext_en: Service stations use petrol as a bait to lure motorists into the restaurants and other facilities...

ext.ext_cn: 从根本上说，电视节目就是吸引观众看广告的诱饵。
ext.ext_en: Television programmes are essentially bait  to attract an audience for advertisements.

defs.def_en: To use something as bait means to use it to trick or persuade someone to do something.

defs.def_cn: 使上当发火；故意逗…生气

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢逗母亲生气。
ext.ext_en: He delighted in baiting his mother.

defs.def_en: If you bait someone, you deliberately try to make them angry by teasing them.

defs.def_cn: 中圈套，上当，中计（亦作rise to the bait,主要用于英国英语中）

ext.ext_cn: 如果她试图让你觉得内疚，不要上当。
ext.ext_en: When she attempts to make you feel guilty, don't  take the bait...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的行为看起来可能很无礼，但千万不要上当生气。
ext.ext_en: Their behaviour may seem insulting, but it's important not to rise to the bait and get cross.

defs.def_en: If you take the bait, you react to something that someone has said or done exactly as they intended you to do. The expression rise to the bait is also used, mainly in British English.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 没有回应的；漠不关心的

ext.ext_cn: 他对大多数人迫切的社会和经济需求漠不关心。
ext.ext_en: He was totally unresponsive to the pressing social and economic needs of the majority of the population.

ext.ext_cn: 冷淡的、对他人漠不关心的男人
ext.ext_en: ...a cold, unresponsive man.

defs.def_en: An unresponsive person does not react or pay enough attention to something, for example to an urgent situation or to people's needs.

ext.ext_cn: 我发现她昏倒了，完全失去了知觉。
ext.ext_en: I found her in a coma, totally unresponsive.

defs.def_en: If a person or their body is unresponsive, they do not react physically in a normal way, or do not make any movements.
A square-rigged sailing ship has large square sails.

ext.ext_cn: 替补队
ext.ext_en: ...a second string team.

ext.ext_cn: 她的备用马
ext.ext_en: ...her second-string horse.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or thing as someone's second string, you mean that they are only used if another person or thing is not available.

ext.ext_cn: 《一世之雄》是一部由卡格尼主演的黑帮片。
ext.ext_en: 'Angels with Dirty Faces' is a Cagney gangster pic.

defs.def_en: A pic is a cinema film.

ext.ext_cn: 摄影师维吉以拍摄30年代纽约罪案的骇人照片而声名鹊起。
ext.ext_en: Photographer Weegee shot to fame with his shocking pics of New York crime in the 30s.

defs.def_en: A pic is a photograph.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 易于保持清洁卫生的、像诊所般洁白的厨房
ext.ext_en: ...a white, clinical-looking kitchen that was easy to keep clean and hygienic.

defs.def_en: Something that is hygienic is clean and unlikely to cause illness.

ext.ext_cn: 火炉两边的凹室里是书架。
ext.ext_en: In the alcoves on either side of the fire were bookshelves.

defs.def_en: An alcove is a small area of a room which is formed by one part of a wall being built further back than the rest of the wall.

ext.ext_cn: 日本新生的富有阶层对犯罪的恐惧迅速加剧。
ext.ext_en: Fear of crime among Japan's new monied classes is rising rapidly.

defs.def_en: A moneyed person has a lot of money.

ext.ext_cn: 同窗和老师们来看望他，送了一大堆礼物和卡片。
ext.ext_en: His school friends and his teachers visited him and he got loads of presents and cards...

ext.ext_cn: 我跟一个老同学一起度过了那个夜晚。
ext.ext_en: I spent the evening with an old school friend.

defs.def_en: A school friend is a friend of yours who is at the same school as you, or who used to be at the same school when you were children.

ext.ext_cn: 要不是重力使箭落向地面，它们将永远以直线往前飞行。
ext.ext_en: Arrows would continue to fly forward forever in a straight line were it not for gravity, which brings them down to earth.

defs.def_en: See also:centre of gravity;Gravity is the force which causes things to drop to the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 应当根据罪行的严重性来惩治他们。
ext.ext_en: They deserve punishment which matches the gravity of their crime...

ext.ext_cn: 并非所有的报复行为都同等恶劣。
ext.ext_en: Not all acts of vengeance are of equal gravity.

defs.def_en: The gravity of a situation or event is its extreme importance or seriousness.

ext.ext_cn: 她说的每句话都带着一种庄严，很能吸引人。
ext.ext_en: There was an appealing gravity to everything she said.

defs.def_en: The gravity of someone's behaviour or speech is the extremely serious way in which they behave or speak.

defs.def_cn: （人们出于某种特殊目的）成群的，聚集的，联合的

ext.ext_cn: 他没法躲开成群的记者。
ext.ext_en: He could not escape the massed ranks of newsmen.

defs.def_en: Massed is used to describe a large number of people who have been brought together for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在日本名古屋的最后一场循环赛中以4比1战胜英格兰队。
ext.ext_en: They beat England 4-1 in their last round-robin match at Nagoya in Japan.

defs.def_en: A round-robin is a sports competition in which each player or team plays against every other player or team.

ext.ext_cn: 他信奉上帝。
ext.ext_en: He believes in God...

ext.ext_cn: 上帝保佑你。
ext.ext_en: God bless you.

defs.def_en: The name God is given to the spirit or being who is worshipped as the creator and ruler of the world, especially by Jews, Christians, and Muslims.

defs.def_cn: （表示强调所说的话，或表示惊讶、恐惧或激动）啊呀，天啊，天哪（可能具冒犯意味）

ext.ext_cn: 啊呀！我恨死他了！
ext.ext_en: God, how I hated him!...

ext.ext_cn: 我的天哪！他开枪打人了。
ext.ext_en: Oh my God he's shot somebody...

defs.def_en: People sometimes use God in exclamations to emphasize something that they are saying, or to express surprise, fear, or excitement. This use could cause offence.

ext.ext_cn: 自然之神，潘
ext.ext_en: ...Pan, the God of nature.

ext.ext_cn: 众神之王，宙斯
ext.ext_en: ...Zeus, king of the gods.

defs.def_en: In many religions, a god is one of the spirits or beings that are believed to have power over a particular part of the world or nature.

defs.def_cn: 极受尊崇的人；影响极大的人

ext.ext_cn: 在追随者眼中，他就是神。
ext.ext_en: To his followers he was a god.

defs.def_en: Someone who is admired very much by a person or group of people, and who influences them a lot, can be referred to as a god .

defs.def_cn: 愿上帝阻止这样的事情；但愿这样的事不会发生

ext.ext_cn: 如果哪儿出点儿岔子，我会不知所措的，但愿这样的事情不会发生。
ext.ext_en: If, God forbid, something goes wrong, I don't know what I would do.

defs.def_en: If you say God forbid, you are expressing your hope that something will not happen.

defs.def_cn: 上帝的恩赐；十全十美的人

ext.ext_cn: 男人是上帝赐予女人的礼物吗？有些男人就是这样认为的。
ext.ext_en: Are men god's gift to women? Some of them think they are.

defs.def_en: If a person thinks they are God's gift to someone or something, they think they are perfect or extremely good.

ext.ext_cn: 他要是跟我作对，那就让上帝保佑他吧。
ext.ext_en: God help him if he gets in my way...

ext.ext_cn: 老板说你得打领带，如果不听你会倒霉的。
ext.ext_en: The boss says you must wear a tie. And God help you if you don't.

defs.def_en: You use God help you to warn someone that something unpleasant will happen to them if they do a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: “愿上帝保佑他们吧，”他说，“谁也帮不了他们了。”
ext.ext_en: 'God help them,' he said. 'They're  beyond help.'

defs.def_en: If you feel sorry for someone because they are in a difficult or unpleasant situation, especially if you think that nobody can help them, you can say God help them.

ext.ext_cn: 第一首歌有11分钟长，最后一首也差不多长，唉，上帝啊，中间还有一个击鼓独奏。
ext.ext_en: The first song is 11 minutes long, the last nearly the same, and, God help us, there's a drum solo along the way.

defs.def_en: If you say God help us, you mean that you have negative feelings about the person or situation you are talking about.

defs.def_cn: （表示强调）只有上帝知道，天晓得

ext.ext_cn: 天晓得贡嘎会讲多少门语言。
ext.ext_en: Gunga spoke God knows how many languages...

ext.ext_cn: 只有天晓得她在想什么。
ext.ext_en: God alone knows what she thinks.

defs.def_en: You can say God knows ,God only knows, or God alone knows to emphasize that you do not know something.

ext.ext_cn: “他现在在哪里？”“天晓得。”
ext.ext_en: 'Where is he now?' 'God knows.'

defs.def_en: If someone says God knows in reply to a question, they mean that they do not know the answer.

ext.ext_cn: 我是个牧师。
ext.ext_en: I am a man of God.

defs.def_en: The term a man of God is sometimes used to refer to Christian priests or ministers.

defs.def_cn: （用来强调生气、懊恼或吃惊）究竟什么/ 究竟为什么/究竟如何

ext.ext_cn: 你究竟要我做什么？
ext.ext_en: What in God's name do you expect me to do?...

ext.ext_cn: 为什么你非得告诉她呢？
ext.ext_en: Why in God's name did you have to tell her?

defs.def_en: If someone uses such expressions as what in God's name ,why in God's name, or how in God's name, they are emphasizing how angry, annoyed, or surprised they are.

defs.def_cn: 俨然一副上帝的样子；表现得无所不能

ext.ext_cn: 你无权对我的人生指手画脚！
ext.ext_en: You have no right to play God in my life!

defs.def_en: If someone plays God, they act as if they have unlimited power and can do anything they want.

defs.def_cn: （强调愿望之强烈）老天保佑，求求上天帮忙

ext.ext_cn: 拜托老天了，让他现在就给我来个电话吧。
ext.ext_en: Please God, let him telephone me now.

defs.def_en: You say please God to emphasize a strong hope, wish, or desire that you have.

defs.def_cn: （表示强调）我向上帝祈祷/我真诚地希望/我向上帝发誓

ext.ext_cn: 我真希望他们给你一份好的酬劳。
ext.ext_en: I hope to God they are paying you well...

ext.ext_cn: 我真希望我不曾认识你。
ext.ext_en: I wish to God I hadn't met you.

defs.def_en: You can use God in expressions such as I hope to God, or I wish to God, or I swear to God, in order to emphasize what you are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 如果一切顺利，将会取得突破性的进展。
ext.ext_en: God willing, there will be a breakthrough.

defs.def_en: If you say God willing, you are saying that something will happen if all goes well.

ext.ext_cn: 光头使他的大圆脸更加突出。
ext.ext_en: His shaven head accentuates his large round face...

ext.ext_cn: 他如此亲切，说话轻声细语，这更加重了威胁的语气。
ext.ext_en: The whole air of menace was accentuated by the fact that he was so cordial and soft-voiced.

defs.def_en: To accentuate something means to emphasize it or make it more noticeable.
Self-rising flour is flour that makes cakes rise when they are cooked because it has chemicals added to it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些再循环方案在多塞特郡的农村地区首先试用。
ext.ext_en: The recycling scheme gets its first try-out in rural Dorset.

defs.def_en: If you give something a tryout, you try it or test it to see how useful it is.

defs.def_cn: (争取入队资格的)角逐赛，选拔赛;(争取角色的)试演

ext.ext_cn: 入选美国国家少年体育队的选拔赛
ext.ext_en: …tryouts for the U.S. junior national athletics team.

defs.def_en: If you are given a tryout for a sports team or an acting role, you compete or you perform a test in an attempt to be chosen.

defs.def_cn: 付款额；支付的款项；支付；付款

ext.ext_cn: 有数千客户拖欠其贷款和抵押贷款还款。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of its customers are in arrears with loans and mortgage payments...

ext.ext_cn: 该基金明年的支付额刚好过10亿英镑。
ext.ext_en: The fund will make payments of just over £1 billion next year.

defs.def_en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

ext.ext_cn: 他声称别人欠他一笔钱，他在想方设法讨要回来。
ext.ext_en: He had sought to obtain payment of a sum which he had claimed was owed to him.

defs.def_en: Payment is the act of paying money to someone or of being paid.

ext.ext_cn: 播音员的声音将霍尔登从幻想中惊醒。
ext.ext_en: The announcer's voice brought Holden out of his reverie.

defs.def_en: A reverie is a state of imagining or thinking about pleasant things, as if you are dreaming.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 崎岖不平的;高低起伏的;多岩石的

ext.ext_cn: 崎岖不平的山地
ext.ext_en: ...rugged mountainous terrain.

defs.def_en: A rugged area of land is uneven and covered with rocks, with few trees or plants.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 尚克利粗犷的脸上掠过一丝完全不信任的表情。
ext.ext_en: A look of pure disbelief crossed Shankly's rugged face.

defs.def_en: If you describe a man as rugged, you mean that he has strong, masculine features.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坚强的;坚毅的;吃苦耐劳的

ext.ext_cn: 坚定的个人主义造就了美国的边疆社会。
ext.ext_en: Rugged individualism forged America's frontier society.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's character as rugged, you mean that they are strong and determined, and have the ability to cope with difficult situations.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这款相机既坚固耐用，又有超凡的光学性能和快门速度。
ext.ext_en: The camera combines rugged reliability with unequalled optical performance and speed.

defs.def_en: A rugged piece of equipment is strong and is designed to last a long time, even if it is treated roughly.

ext.ext_cn: 一副滑雪板
ext.ext_en: ...a pair of skis.

defs.def_en: Skis are long, flat, narrow pieces of wood, metal, or plastic that are fastened to boots so that you can move easily on snow or water.

ext.ext_cn: 他们冲浪，滑雪，还骑马。
ext.ext_en: They surf, ski and ride...

ext.ext_cn: 然后整群人都滑着雪离去。
ext.ext_en: The whole party then skied off.

defs.def_en: When people ski, they move over snow or water on skis.

defs.def_cn: 滑雪用的;滑雪的;滑水的

ext.ext_cn: 瑞士克洛斯特斯滑雪胜地
ext.ext_en: ...the Swiss ski resort of Klosters.

ext.ext_cn: 私人滑雪教练
ext.ext_en: ...a private ski instructor.

defs.def_en: You use ski to refer to things that are concerned with skiing.

defs.def_cn: 值得收藏的东西;珍（藏）品
defs.def_en: A collector's item is an object which is highly valued by collectors because it is rare or beautiful.

ext.ext_cn: 一副驾驶用黑色皮手套
ext.ext_en: ...a pair of black leather driving gauntlets.

defs.def_en: Gauntlets are long, thick, protective gloves.

ext.ext_cn: 在大会主题发言中，她言辞犀利地回应挑战。
ext.ext_en: She picked up the gauntlet in her incisive Keynote Address to the Conference...

ext.ext_cn: 谁要是接受挑战，向首相叫板，都将经历一场鏖战。
ext.ext_en: Whoever decides to take up the gauntlet and challenge the Prime Minister will have a tough battle.

defs.def_en: If you pick up the gauntlet or take up the gauntlet, you accept the challenge that someone has made.

defs.def_cn: 受到严厉批评；受到猛烈攻击

ext.ext_cn: 卡车队试图冲过几帮劫匪的火力网开赴英军基地。
ext.ext_en: The trucks tried to drive to the British base, running the gauntlet of marauding bands of gunmen.

defs.def_en: If you run the gauntlet, you go through an unpleasant experience in which a lot of people criticize or attack you.

ext.ext_cn: 豪华轿车生产商捷豹公司推出了市场上最诱人的保修服务，向竞争对手发出了挑战。
ext.ext_en: Luxury car firm Jaguar has thrown down the gauntlet to competitors by giving the best guarantee on the market.

defs.def_en: If you throw down the gauntlet to someone, you say or do something that challenges them to argue or compete with you.
Someone who is broken-hearted is very sad and upset because they have had a serious disappointment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (自然资源)可持续的，不破坏环境的

ext.ext_cn: 森林的管理、保护和可持续发展
ext.ext_en: ...the management, conservation and sustainable development of forests...

ext.ext_cn: 尽量购买来自可持续发展林的木材。
ext.ext_en: Try to buy wood that you know has come from a sustainable source.

defs.def_en: You use sustainable to describe the use of natural resources when this use is kept at a steady level that is not likely to damage the environment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (计划、方法、体制)可持续的，持续性的

ext.ext_cn: 建立一套高效稳定的交通体系对伦敦的长远发展意义重大。
ext.ext_en: The creation of an efficient and sustainable transport system is critical to the long-term future of London.

ext.ext_cn: 消费支出的持续性复苏
ext.ext_en: ...a sustainable recovery in consumer spending.

defs.def_en: A sustainable plan, method, or system is designed to continue at the same rate or level of activity without any problems.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 爱管闲事的;喜欢打听的;八卦的

ext.ext_cn: 他不得不小声说，免得被爱管闲事的邻居们听到。
ext.ext_en: He was having to whisper in order to avoid being overheard by their nosy neighbours...

ext.ext_cn: 的确，媒体常常过分关注候选人的个人经历。
ext.ext_en: I agree that the press is often too nosy about a candidate's personal history.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as nosy, you mean that they are interested in things which do not concern them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 摇摇欲坠的;破旧不堪的
defs.def_en: A tumbledown building is in such a bad condition that it is partly falling down or has holes in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的故事情节貌似简单，其实不然。
ext.ext_en: The apparent simplicity of his plot is deceptive...

ext.ext_cn: 这种检查非常简单，家庭医生就可以轻松完成。
ext.ext_en: Because of its simplicity, this test could be carried out easily by a family doctor.

defs.def_en: The simplicity of something is the fact that it is not complicated and can be understood or done easily.

ext.ext_cn: 破坏了这款设计简洁风格的过多的细节
ext.ext_en: ...fussy details that ruin the simplicity of the design...

ext.ext_cn: 一对宝石耳环会让这件礼服更出彩而又不失简洁。
ext.ext_en: A pair of jewelled earrings will liven up this dress without detracting from its simplicity.

defs.def_en: When you talk about something's simplicity, you approve of it because it has no unnecessary parts or complicated details.

ext.ext_cn: 厨房非常简洁，这有赖于好的设计、工艺及可体现这种效果的上乘材料。
ext.ext_en: The kitchen is simplicity itself, relying on a combination of good design, craftsmanship and quality materials for its effect...

ext.ext_cn: 用信用卡支付订单再简单不过了。
ext.ext_en: Using a credit card to pay for an order is simplicity itself.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is simplicity itself, you are emphasizing that it is very simple or easy.

defs.def_cn: 南美大草原；潘帕斯群落
defs.def_en: The pampas is the large area of flat, grassy land in South America.

defs.def_cn: 肮脏而衣着破烂的儿童；小乞丐

ext.ext_cn: 我们在集市里，周围一大帮衣衫褴褛的小孩盯着我们看。
ext.ext_en: We were in the bazaar with all the little urchins watching us.

defs.def_en: See also:sea urchin;An urchin is a young child who is dirty and poorly dressed.
A capstan is a machine consisting of a drum that turns round and pulls in a heavy rope or something attached to a rope, for example an anchor.

defs.def_cn: (供射击训练用的)泥鸽，碟形飞靶

ext.ext_cn: 狩猎和泥鸽射击
ext.ext_en: ...hunting and clay-pigeon shooting.

defs.def_en: Clay pigeons are discs of baked clay which are thrown into the air by a machine as targets for gun shooting practice.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (状况、经历)压力大的，令人紧张的

ext.ext_cn: 我想我得到的这份工作是其中最繁重的工作之一。
ext.ext_en: I think I've got one of the most stressful jobs there is.

defs.def_en: If a situation or experience is stressful, it causes the person involved to feel stress.

defs.def_cn: （山羊或兔）安哥拉种的（长有光亮的长毛）
defs.def_en: An angora goat or rabbit is a particular breed that has long silky hair.

defs.def_cn: 安哥拉山羊毛；安哥拉兔毛

ext.ext_cn: 安哥拉山羊毛毛衣
ext.ext_en: ...an angora sweater.

defs.def_en: Angora cloth or clothing is made from the hair of the angora goat or rabbit.

ext.ext_cn: 展览会上最贵重的展品是毕加索的一幅素描。
ext.ext_en: The most valuable item on show will be a Picasso drawing...

ext.ext_cn: 菜单中包括了偶尔会有的非传统菜肴。
ext.ext_en: The menu includes the occasional off-beat item.

defs.def_en: See also:collector's item;An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

ext.ext_cn: 日程中的另一项是旅游。
ext.ext_en: The other item on the agenda is the tour.

defs.def_en: An item is one of a list of things for someone to do, deal with, or talk about.

defs.def_cn: 一篇报道(或文章);(新闻等的)一条,一则

ext.ext_cn: 报纸上有一条关于他的报道。
ext.ext_en: There was an item in the paper about him.

defs.def_en: An item is a report or article in a newspaper or magazine, or on television or radio.

ext.ext_cn: 她和吉诺曾是一对。
ext.ext_en: She and Gino were an item.

defs.def_en: If you say that two people are an item, you mean that they are having a romantic or sexual relationship.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然富人和穷人之间一直差距悬殊，但这种不公在经济萧条期愈加显得令人难以接受。
ext.ext_en: The stark contrast between the haves and have-nots has always existed but in a recession the injustices become more painful...

ext.ext_cn: 穷人的社会地位可能会进一步恶化。
ext.ext_en: The position of the have-nots in our society could deteriorate even further.

defs.def_en: If you refer to two groups of people as haves and have-nots, you mean that the first group are very wealthy and the second group are very poor. You can also refer generally to poor people as have-nots .

defs.def_cn: (用于形容词后构成另一些形容词)表示“最远的”，“最深远的”

ext.ext_cn: 最高处的树枝
ext.ext_en: ...the topmost branches of the trees...

ext.ext_cn: 很多患者告诉过我他们内心深处的想法。
ext.ext_en: Many patients have told me their innermost thoughts.

defs.def_en: -most is added to adjectives in order to form other adjectives that describe something as being further in a particular direction than other things of the same kind.

ext.ext_cn: 它大约70%的利润又重新投回到该投资项目。
ext.ext_en: About 70 per cent of its profits are being ploughed back into the investment programme.

defs.def_en: If profits are ploughed back into a business, they are used to increase the size of the business or to improve it.

ext.ext_cn: 退役的英国陆军军官
ext.ext_en: ...a retired British army officer...

ext.ext_cn: 她的丈夫在内战时期是一名白军的军官。
ext.ext_en: Her husband served during the Civil War as an officer in the White Army.

defs.def_en: In the armed forces, an officer is a person in a position of authority.

defs.def_cn: （机构的）高级职员；（尤指政府机构的）官员，公务员

ext.ext_cn: 当地政府的教育官员
ext.ext_en: ...a local authority education officer.

defs.def_en: An officer is a person who has a responsible position in an organization, especially a government organization.

ext.ext_cn: 西米德兰兹郡警队的高级警官
ext.ext_en: ...senior officers in the West Midlands police force...

ext.ext_cn: 谢谢你，警官。
ext.ext_en: Thank you, Officer.

defs.def_en: Members of the police force can be referred to as officers .

defs.def_cn: (机构)取消种族隔离的，平等对待的

ext.ext_cn: 我们相信在取消种族隔离的学校就读的学生会有更宽容的态度。
ext.ext_en: We believe that pupils of integrated schools will have more tolerant attitudes.

defs.def_en: See also:integrate;An integrated institution is intended for use by all races or religious groups.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他年轻,易于冲动。
ext.ext_en: He was young and impetuous...

ext.ext_cn: 他往往反应过火,急躁冲动。
ext.ext_en: He tended to react in a heated and impetuous way.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as impetuous, you mean that they are likely to act quickly and suddenly without thinking or being careful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不够好的；不能令人满意的；不能接受的

ext.ext_cn: 督察员说只有不到1/3的课程不够好。
ext.ext_en: The inspectors said just under a third of lessons were unsatisfactory...

ext.ext_cn: 他又问了几个问题，得到的答案都不令人满意。
ext.ext_en: He asked a few more questions, to which he received unsatisfactory answers.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unsatisfactory, you mean that it is not as good as it should be, and cannot be considered acceptable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 南部的各种享乐消遣
ext.ext_en: ...the hedonistic pleasures of the South...

ext.ext_cn: 烹饪课既是一件严肃的事又是一种享受。
ext.ext_en: The cookery course was serious and hedonistic at the same time.

defs.def_en: Hedonistic means relating to hedonism.
A pawnbroker is a person who lends people money. People give the pawnbroker something they own, which can be sold if they do not pay back the money before a certain time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我从未见过像这样明目张胆地歪曲事实。
ext.ext_en: I never saw such a glaring example of misrepresentation.

defs.def_en: If you describe something bad as glaring, you are emphasizing that it is very obvious and easily seen or noticed.
A cemetery is a place where dead people's bodies or their ashes are buried.

ext.ext_cn: 许多胸怀抱负的年轻画家被建议通过临摹大师的作品来学习绘画。
ext.ext_en: Many aspiring young artists are advised to learn by copying the masters.

defs.def_en: See also:aspire;If you use aspiring to describe someone who is starting a particular career, you mean that they are trying to become successful in it.

ext.ext_cn: 那些字赫然写在纸上。
ext.ext_en: The words stood out clearly on the page...

ext.ext_cn: ginseng 这个词来自汉语的“人参”。
ext.ext_en: The word 'ginseng' comes from the Chinese word 'ren-shen'.

defs.def_en: A word is a single unit of language that can be represented in writing or speech. In English, a word has a space on either side of it when it is written.

ext.ext_cn: 她的话应验了，我伤心欲绝。
ext.ext_en: I was devastated when her words came true...

ext.ext_cn: 那位年轻女医生的话在他耳畔回响。
ext.ext_en: The words of the young woman doctor echoed in his ears...

defs.def_en: Someone's words are what they say or write.

ext.ext_cn: 你听得清这张专辑中的歌词吗？
ext.ext_en: Can you hear the words on the album?

defs.def_en: The words of a song consist of the text that is sung, in contrast to the music that is played.

defs.def_cn: 短时间的谈话;短暂的聊天

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得你该跟他谈谈了。
ext.ext_en: I think it's time you had a word with him...

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯，我能和你私下说几句吗？
ext.ext_en: James, could I have a quiet word?...

defs.def_en: If you have a word with someone, you have a short conversation with them.

ext.ext_cn: 提醒一句：不要过于迷信书上的话。
ext.ext_en: A word of warning. Don't stick too precisely to what it says in the book...

ext.ext_cn: 请允许我也向所有来信的人表示感谢。
ext.ext_en: May I also say a word of thanks to all the people who sent letters.

defs.def_en: If you offer someone a word of something such as warning, advice, or praise, you warn, advise, or praise them.

defs.def_cn: 一句话，一个字(也没有听到、明白或说)

ext.ext_cn: 她说的我一点儿也不懂。
ext.ext_en: I can't understand a word she says...

ext.ext_cn: 我敢说他一个字都不记得。
ext.ext_en: I bet he doesn't remember a single word...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does not hear, understand, or say a word, you are emphasizing that they hear, understand, or say nothing at all.

ext.ext_cn: 所报道的袭击事件没有得到当局的证实。
ext.ext_en: There is no word from the authorities on the reported attack...

ext.ext_cn: 有关街头骚乱的消息迅速传播开来。
ext.ext_en: Word has been spreading fast of the incidents on the streets...

defs.def_en: If there is word of something, people receive news or information about it.

ext.ext_cn: 一位承诺监护这个男孩的成年男子
ext.ext_en: ...an adult who gave his word the boy would be supervised...

ext.ext_cn: 根本不能相信他会信守诺言。
ext.ext_en: He simply cannot be trusted to keep his word.

defs.def_en: If you give your word, you make a sincere promise to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 没有我的命令，不准议论这件事。
ext.ext_en: I want nothing said about this until I give the word.

defs.def_en: If someone gives the word to do something, they give an order to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果换作我写这封信，我或许会用不同的措辞。
ext.ext_en: If I had written the letter, I might have worded it differently.

defs.def_en: To word something in a particular way means to choose or use particular words to express it.

ext.ext_cn: 这么多人都认为女权主义是个龌龊的字眼。
ext.ext_en: So many people think feminism is a dirty word.

defs.def_en: If you say that people consider something to be a dirty word, you mean that they disapprove of it.

defs.def_cn: 收回前言，承认说错了话(尤指此举令说话人显得愚蠢时)

ext.ext_cn: 他不得不收回他说过的公司能免受经济衰退影响的话。
ext.ext_en: He has had to eat his words about the company being recession-proof.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has to eat their words, you mean that they have to admit that they were wrong about something they said in the past, especially when this makes them look foolish.

defs.def_cn: 沉默寡言的，少言寡语的，话不多的(尤指不谈及自己的意见和感情)

ext.ext_cn: 他是个沉默寡言的人，彬彬有礼，待人谦和。
ext.ext_en: He's a man of few words, very polite and unassuming.

defs.def_en: A person of few words says very little, especially about their opinions or feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 关键是从一开始就作出正确的决定。
ext.ext_en: It's essential you make the right decisions from the word go.

defs.def_en: If you do something from the word go, you do it from the very beginning of a period of time or situation.

defs.def_cn: (因为仰慕或尊敬而)仔细倾听，一字不落地认真听

ext.ext_cn: 梅利娜凝神细听着他的每句话，被深深吸引住了。
ext.ext_en: Melina was hanging on his every word, fascinated.

defs.def_en: If you hang on someone's every word, you listen very carefully to what they are saying, because you admire or respect them.

defs.def_cn: 从来没一句好话／从来没一句坏话

ext.ext_cn: 新闻界从来没说过他们的好话。
ext.ext_en: The press never has a good word to say about them...

ext.ext_cn: 她对谁都是冷言冷语。
ext.ext_en: She doesn't have a kind word for anyone.

defs.def_en: You can use expressions such as never have a good word to say or never have a bad word to say to emphasize that a person always criticizes someone or something, or that they never criticize them.

defs.def_cn: (尤指因为一方抱怨了另一方的行为)与…争论,与…严肃讨论

ext.ext_cn: 我们争执了起来，她夺门而出。
ext.ext_en: We had words and she stormed out...

ext.ext_cn: 我真应该跟我这些愚蠢的朋友理论理论！
ext.ext_en: I shall have words with these stupid friends of mine!

defs.def_en: If one person has words with another, or if two or more people have words, they have a serious discussion or argument, especially because one has complained about the other's behaviour.

defs.def_cn: 用…的话说;引用…的原话说

ext.ext_cn: 就连助理国务卿也不得不承认之前的政策并没有，用他的话说，收到成效。
ext.ext_en: Even the Assistant Secretary of State had to admit that previous policy did not, in his words, produce results.

defs.def_en: You can use in their words or in their own words to indicate that you are reporting what someone said using the exact words that they used.

defs.def_cn: 总而言之;简言之;一句话

ext.ext_cn: 总而言之，维克多越来越厌倦了。
ext.ext_en: Victor, in a word, got increasingly fed up...

ext.ext_cn: “难道不该让他当主角吗？”——“一句话——不行。”
ext.ext_en: 'Shouldn't he be given the leading role?' — 'In a word — No.'

defs.def_en: You use in a word to indicate that you are giving a summary of what you have just been saying, or are giving a reply, in as brief a way as possible.

defs.def_cn: (讨论、争论、分歧中的)最终决定权

ext.ext_cn: 她确实喜欢商量什么事都最终自己说了算。
ext.ext_en: She does like to have the last word in any discussion...

ext.ext_cn: 最后仍然要由国务卿来定夺。
ext.ext_en: The final word will still come from the Secretary of State.

defs.def_en: If someone has the last word or the final word in a discussion, argument, or disagreement, they are the one who wins it or who makes the final decision.

ext.ext_cn: 这家矿泉疗养浴场极尽奢华，功效极高。
ext.ext_en: The spa is the last word in luxury and efficiency.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is the last word in luxury, comfort, or some other quality, you are emphasizing that it has a great deal of this quality.

defs.def_cn: (尤指因非常吃惊而)说不出话来，无以言表

ext.ext_cn: 我无以言表——太精彩了。
ext.ext_en: I'm lost for words — it's fantastic...

ext.ext_cn: 她目瞪口呆地看着这场面，一时语塞。
ext.ext_en: She was gaping at it, lost for words.

defs.def_en: If someone is lost for words, they cannot think of anything to say, especially because they are very surprised by something.

defs.def_cn: 没有直接说;拐弯抹角地说

ext.ext_cn: “她同意跟你一起去了吗？”——“没有直接说，但我知道她是怎么想的。”
ext.ext_en: 'And has she agreed to go with you?' — 'Not in so many words. But I read her thoughts'.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has said something, but not in so many words, you mean that they said it or expressed it, but in a very indirect way.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调刚刚警告对方的话很可能成真，尤其是认为对方应改变态度或行为予以避免时)你听着，记住我的话

ext.ext_cn: 那就是将来你的下场，记住我的话。
ext.ext_en: That's what you'll end up with, you mark my words.

defs.def_en: If you say 'mark my words' to someone, you are emphasizing that something you have just warned them about is very likely to happen, especially when you think they should change their attitude or behaviour to prevent it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个故事是口头流传下来的。
ext.ext_en: The story has been passed down by word of mouth.

defs.def_en: If news or information passes by word of mouth, people tell it to each other rather than it being printed in written form.
If you say that someone is putting words into your mouth or is putting words in your mouth, you mean that they are suggesting that you mean one thing when you really mean something different.

defs.def_cn: 说话算数的人;一诺千金的人
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a man of his word or a woman of her word, you mean that they always keep their promises and can be relied on.

defs.def_cn: 换言之;换句话说;也就是说

ext.ext_cn: 流动图书馆服务重新作了安排——换句话说，他们去的地方减少了。
ext.ext_en: The mobile library services have been reorganised — in other words, they visit fewer places.

defs.def_en: You say in other words in order to introduce a different, and usually simpler, explanation or interpretation of something that has just been said.

ext.ext_cn: 现在你来给我们讲讲星期六的活动吧。
ext.ext_en: Now tell us in your own words about the events of Saturday.

defs.def_en: If you say something in your own words, you express it in your own way, without copying or repeating someone else's description.

ext.ext_cn: 朋友们传话说矿工们想见他。
ext.ext_en: Friends passed the word that the miners wanted to see him.

defs.def_en: If you pass the word, you tell someone something that another person has told you.

defs.def_cn: 发话，下令(示意某事应该开始)

ext.ext_cn: 我一发话，就跟着我下来。
ext.ext_en: When I say the word, follow me down.

defs.def_en: If someone says the word, they give their approval as a sign that something should start to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 社区迅速作出反应，宣传安全性行为。
ext.ext_en: The community reacted quickly and spread the word about safe sex.

defs.def_en: If you spread the word, you tell people about something.

ext.ext_cn: 只要他说“哦，我错了，现在我要改过自新”，他们就愿意当真。
ext.ext_en: They're willing to take him at his word when he says, 'Oh, I made mistakes and now I'll change.'

defs.def_en: If you take someone at their word, you believe what they say, when they did not really mean it or when they meant something slightly different.

ext.ext_cn: 你要是买那栋房子只会买来麻烦，我说的都是真的。
ext.ext_en: You'll buy nothing but trouble if you buy that house, take my word for it.

defs.def_en: If you say to someone 'take my word for it', you mean that they should believe you because you are telling the truth.

defs.def_cn: 极其愚蠢/荒唐得让人无语

ext.ext_cn: 最需要这些机器时却不打开，真是愚蠢至极。
ext.ext_en: It's too stupid for words not having the machines switched on when they're most needed...

ext.ext_cn: 我惊愕万分，不知说什么好。
ext.ext_en: I feel simply too devastated for words.

defs.def_en: You can use expressions such as too silly for words and too ridiculous for words to emphasize that someone or something is extremely silly or ridiculous.

defs.def_cn: 信守诺言;说话算话;说到做到

ext.ext_cn: 我怎么知道他会信守诺言呢？
ext.ext_en: How do I know that he will be true to his word?...

ext.ext_cn: 他们信守诺言，离得远远的。
ext.ext_en: They were as good as their word and stayed away.

defs.def_en: If you are true to your word or as good as your word, you do what you say you will do.

ext.ext_cn: 我不会试图一字不落地记住讲话要说的内容。
ext.ext_en: I don't try to memorize speeches word for word.

defs.def_en: If you repeat something word for word, you repeat it exactly as it was originally said or written.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 揭秘访谈
ext.ext_en: ...a revealing interview.

ext.ext_cn: 索菲·塔克揭露往事的自传
ext.ext_en: ...Sophie Tucker's revealing autobiography.

defs.def_en: A revealing statement, account, or action tells you something that you did not know, especially about the person doing it or making it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她身穿一件暴露的金色紧身连衣裙。
ext.ext_en: She was wearing a tight and revealing gold dress.

defs.def_en: Revealing clothes allow more of a person's body to be seen than is usual.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我已经看腻了女人该如何穿戴来取悦男人的书。
ext.ext_en: I am fed up with reading how women should dress to please men...

ext.ext_cn: 他已经厌倦了城市生活。
ext.ext_en: He had become fed up with city life...

defs.def_en: If you are fed up, you are unhappy, bored, or tired of something, especially something that you have been experiencing for a long time.
A barbecue is a piece of equipment which you use for cooking on in the open air.
If someone has a barbecue, they cook food on a barbecue in the open air.

ext.ext_cn: 金枪鱼可以用烤炉烤、油炸或者烧烤。
ext.ext_en: Tuna can be grilled, fried or barbecued...

ext.ext_cn: 这是我在美国学的一种烤玉米的方法。
ext.ext_en: Here's  a way of barbecuing corn-on-the-cob that I learned in the States.

defs.def_en: If you barbecue food, especially meat, you cook it on a barbecue.

ext.ext_cn: 上学时和我一个班的男孩
ext.ext_en: ...a boy who was in my class at school...

ext.ext_cn: 就连好学生都说上学最讨厌的就是要写家庭作业。
ext.ext_en: Even the good students say homework is what they most dislike about school...

defs.def_en: A school is a place where children are educated. You usually refer to this place as school when you are talking about the time that children spend there and the activities that they do there.

ext.ext_cn: 戴尔德丽，学校里所有人都会恨你的。
ext.ext_en: Deirdre, the whole school's going to hate you.

ext.ext_cn: 可以以学校或个人名义参加的儿童写作比赛
ext.ext_en: ...a children's writing competition open to schools or individuals.

defs.def_en: A school is the pupils or staff at a school.

ext.ext_cn: 在切普斯托附近的一所骑术学校兼马术中心
ext.ext_en: ...a riding school and equestrian centre near Chepstow.

ext.ext_cn: 金斯利英语学校
ext.ext_en: ...the Kingsley School of English.

defs.def_en: A privately-run place where a particular skill or subject is taught can be referred to as a school .

ext.ext_cn: 宾夕法尼亚大学兽医学系的一名讲师
ext.ext_en: ...a lecturer in the school of veterinary medicine at the University of Pennsylvania...

ext.ext_cn: 斯特拉，21 岁，就读于艺术系，正接受时装设计师的培训。
ext.ext_en: Stella, 21, is at art school training to be a fashion designer.

defs.def_en: A university, college, or university department specializing in a particular type of subject can be referred to as a school .

ext.ext_cn: 他连续跳级, 18 岁时就以全美优等生联谊会成员的身份从肯塔基大学毕业。
ext.ext_en: Moving rapidly through school, he graduated Phi Beta Kappa from the University of Kentucky at age 18.

defs.def_en: School is used to refer to university or college.

ext.ext_cn: 芝加哥经济学派
ext.ext_en: ...the Chicago school of economists...

ext.ext_cn: 欧姬芙受多位画家和摄影家的影响，但她从未加入过任何学派。
ext.ext_en: O'Keeffe was influenced by various painters and photographers, but she was never a member of any school.

defs.def_en: A particular school of writers, artists, or thinkers is a group of them whose work, opinions, or theories are similar.
A school of fish or dolphins is a large group of them moving through water together.

ext.ext_cn: 许多母亲把男尊女卑的错误观念传给了她们的女儿。
ext.ext_en: Many mothers schooled their daughters in the myth of female inferiority...

ext.ext_cn: 他受过训练，能够迅速发现问题。
ext.ext_en: He is schooled to spot trouble.

defs.def_en: If you school someone in something, you train or educate them to have a certain skill, type of behaviour, or way of thinking.

ext.ext_cn: 她一直在自己教育孩子。
ext.ext_en: She's been schooling her kids herself.

defs.def_en: To school a child means to educate him or her.

ext.ext_cn: 在它还是 6 个月的小马驹时，她用 1,000 英镑将它买下，并训练它。
ext.ext_en: She bought him as a £1,000 colt of six months and schooled him.

defs.def_en: If you school a horse, you train it so that it can be ridden in races or competitions.

ext.ext_cn: 他思想传统，在别人面前仍然讲究体面。
ext.ext_en: He is one of the old school who still believes in honour in public life.

ext.ext_cn: 年长的老派绅士
ext.ext_en: ...an elderly gentleman of the old school.

defs.def_en: If you approve of someone because they have good qualities that used to be more common in the past, you can describe them as one of the old school .  school of thought→see: thought;

defs.def_cn: 月桂叶（制干后可用作烹饪调料）
defs.def_en: A bay leaf is a leaf of an evergreen tree that can be dried and used as a herb in cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 他引用帕斯捷尔纳克的话来证明自己的论点。
ext.ext_en: He illustrated his argument with quotations from Pasternak...

ext.ext_cn: 第二段引文出自D. H. 劳伦斯20世纪20年代写的一篇文章。
ext.ext_en: The second quotation is from an essay that D H Lawrence wrote in the nineteen-twenties.

defs.def_en: A quotation is a sentence or phrase taken from a book, poem, or play, which is repeated by someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 要几份书面报价，仔细查对费用中包含的内容。
ext.ext_en: Get several written quotations and check exactly what's included in the cost.

defs.def_en: When someone gives you a quotation, they tell you how much they will charge to do a particular piece of work.

ext.ext_cn: 在伦敦股票交易市场挂牌的由美国人主导的投资管理机构
ext.ext_en: ...an American-dominated investment manager with a quotation on the London stock market.

defs.def_en: A company's quotation on the stock exchange is its registration on the stock exchange, which enables its shares to be officially listed and traded.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 金那些华而不实的计划甚至一个都还没有开始实施。
ext.ext_en: Not one of Kim's grandiose plans has even begun.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as grandiose, you mean it is bigger or more elaborate than necessary.

defs.def_cn: (置于名字后表示所属军队)英国皇家海军陆战队

ext.ext_cn: 英国皇家海军陆战队上校阿拉斯泰尔·罗杰斯
ext.ext_en: ...Captain Alastair Rogers, RM.

defs.def_en: RM is written after someone's name to show that they are an officer of the Royal Marines, one of the units which make up the United Kingdom's armed forces.
See also:fountain pen;A pen is a long thin object which you use to write in ink.  ballpoint pen→see: ballpoint; felt-tip pen→see: felt-tip;

ext.ext_cn: 我真的打算今天一大早给你写这封信的。
ext.ext_en: I really intended to pen this letter to you early this morning...

ext.ext_cn: 她给他的私人秘书写了一份简短的备忘录。
ext.ext_en: She penned a short memo to his private secretary.

defs.def_en: If someone pens a letter, article, or book, they write it.

ext.ext_cn: 暂时搭建的羊圈
ext.ext_en: ...a holding pen for sheep...

ext.ext_cn: 他不是十分确定狐狸是怎么进入羊圈的。
ext.ext_en: He wasn't sure exactly how a fox could have got into the sheep's pen.

defs.def_en: See also:playpen;A pen is also a small area with a fence round it in which farm animals are kept for a short time.

ext.ext_cn: 将牛群赶回家，这样就能挤奶并将其关进牛棚过夜
ext.ext_en: ...to drive the cattle back to the house so they could be milked and penned for the night...

ext.ext_cn: 山羊被关进圈里，每天都得铡草运料。
ext.ext_en: The goats are penned in and fodder has to be cut and carried each day...

defs.def_en: If people or animals are penned somewhere or are penned up, they are forced to remain in a very small area.
People sometimes say the pen to refer to a prison.

ext.ext_cn: 他每次一提笔就不知道如何措辞透露这个消息。
ext.ext_en: Whenever he put pen to paper he was at a loss for the right words to break the news.

defs.def_en: If you put pen to paper, you write something.

defs.def_cn: 母亲节(天主教四旬斋的第四个星期日)
defs.def_en: Mothering Sunday is the fourth Sunday in Lent, when children give cards and presents to their mothers as a sign of their love for them.

ext.ext_cn: 汉密尔顿是个伟大的政治家和政治思想家。
ext.ext_en: Hamilton is a great statesman and political thinker.

defs.def_en: See also:elder statesman;A statesman is an important and experienced politician, especially one who is widely known and respected.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个铺位的床垫很硬，毯子也很扎人，而且还有点潮。
ext.ext_en: The bunk mattress was hard, the blankets prickly and slightly damp...

ext.ext_cn: 草地扎人，而且很凉。
ext.ext_en: The grass was prickly and cold.

defs.def_en: Something that is prickly feels rough and uncomfortable, as if it has a lot of prickles.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你知道她有多么爱发脾气。
ext.ext_en: You know how prickly she is.

defs.def_en: Someone who is prickly loses their temper or gets upset very easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 棘手的；麻烦的；难处理的

ext.ext_cn: 这个问题有可能很棘手。
ext.ext_en: The issue is likely to prove a prickly one.

defs.def_en: A prickly issue or subject is one that is rather complicated and difficult to discuss or resolve.

ext.ext_cn: 风钻
ext.ext_en: ...pneumatic drills.

ext.ext_cn: 牙钻
ext.ext_en: ...a dentist's drill.

defs.def_en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes.

ext.ext_cn: 他在莉莉卧室的墙上钻了个孔。
ext.ext_en: He drilled into the wall of Lili's bedroom...

ext.ext_cn: 我钻了 5 个等间距的孔。
ext.ext_en: I drilled five holes at equal distance.

defs.def_en: When you drill into something or drill a hole in something, you make a hole in it using a drill.

ext.ext_cn: 有人提议钻探更多的石油。
ext.ext_en: There have been proposals to drill for more oil...

ext.ext_cn: 钻探队还在钻探。
ext.ext_en: The team is still drilling.

defs.def_en: When people drill for oil or water, they search for it by drilling deep holes in the ground or in the bottom of the sea.

ext.ext_cn: 老师带他们做了反复练习：一周中每一天的叫法、天气和数数。
ext.ext_en: The teacher runs them through a drill — the days of the week, the weather and some counting.

defs.def_en: A drill is a way that teachers teach their students something by making them repeat it many times.

ext.ext_cn: 他将合唱团训练到了一个高水平。
ext.ext_en: He drills the choir to a high standard.

defs.def_en: If you drill people, you teach them to do something by making them repeat it many times.

defs.def_cn: (尤指士兵进行的)练习,训练,操练

ext.ext_cn: 海军陆战队进行了有 18 艘军舰和 90 架飞机参与的训练。
ext.ext_en: The Marines carried out a drill that included 18 ships and 90 aircraft...

ext.ext_cn: 他双手背在身后，像一个教官。
ext.ext_en: His hands were clasped behind him like a drill sergeant.

defs.def_en: A drill is repeated training for a group of people, especially soldiers, so that they can do something quickly and efficiently.

defs.def_cn: (为在危急情况下逃生而进行的)常规训练,演习

ext.ext_cn: 消防演习
ext.ext_en: ...a fire drill.

ext.ext_cn: 防空演习
ext.ext_en: ...air-raid drills.

defs.def_en: A drill is a routine exercise or activity, in which people practise what they should do in dangerous situations.

ext.ext_cn: 厚斜纹棉布
ext.ext_en: ...cotton drill.

defs.def_en: Drill is thick cotton material which is used for making uniforms and trousers.

ext.ext_cn: 在深约 0.5 英寸,间隔 12 英寸的条播沟里播种。
ext.ext_en: Sow the seeds in drills about 1/2in. deep and 12in. apart.

defs.def_en: A drill is a long line in the earth, a few centimetres deep, which a farmer or gardener makes to plant seeds in.

ext.ext_cn: 由于耗时过长，各公司一直未能达成协议。
ext.ext_en: Companies have been stymied by the length of time it takes to reach an agreement...

ext.ext_cn: 最近几周的救援工作一直受到武装分子的阻挠。
ext.ext_en: Relief efforts have been stymied in recent weeks by armed gunmen.

defs.def_en: If you are stymied by something, you find it very difficult to take action or to continue what you are doing.

ext.ext_cn: 遣返真正的难民回国并非政府的政策。
ext.ext_en: It was not the policy of the government to repatriate genuine refugees...

ext.ext_cn: 大约300名法国人质即将被遣送回国。
ext.ext_en: About 300 French hostages are to be repatriated.

defs.def_en: If a country repatriates someone, it sends them back to their home country.

ext.ext_cn: 外国投资者将被允许将利润额超过10亿卢比的部分调回国内。
ext.ext_en: Foreign investors are to be allowed  to repatriate profits over one billion rupees.

defs.def_en: If a company repatriates profits that it has made in another country, it brings them back into its home country.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 赞比亚是撒哈拉沙漠以南的非洲地区城市化程度最高的国家。
ext.ext_en: Zambia is black Africa's most urbanised country...

ext.ext_cn: 佛罗里达所有的那些好去处都在变得越来越都市化。
ext.ext_en: All the nice areas in Florida are becoming more and more urbanized.

defs.def_en: An urbanized country or area has many buildings and a lot of industry and business.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 规模庞大的城镇工业人口
ext.ext_en: ...a large urbanized industrial population.

defs.def_en: An urbanized population consists of people who live and work in a town.

defs.def_cn: （项链上装照片等的）盒式吊坠
defs.def_en: A locket is a piece of jewellery containing something such as a picture, which a woman wears on a chain around her neck.

ext.ext_cn: 她的怠惰和缺乏活力
ext.ext_en: ...her inertia, her lack of energy...

ext.ext_cn: 这可能有助于你克服惰性。
ext.ext_en: This might help you overcome inertia.

defs.def_en: If you have a feeling of inertia, you feel very lazy and unwilling to move or be active.
Inertia is the tendency of a physical object to remain still or to continue moving, unless a force is applied to it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些奖项将要颁发给本年度英国最杰出的戏剧表演作品。
ext.ext_en: These are the prizes given for the most outstanding British theatrical performances of the year.

ext.ext_cn: 戏剧力作
ext.ext_en: ...major theatrical productions.

defs.def_en: Theatrical means relating to the theatre.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为)夸张的，做作的，戏剧性的

ext.ext_cn: 格拉斯做了一个夸张的手势，用一只手将双眼紧紧捂上了。
ext.ext_en: In a theatrical gesture Glass clamped his hand over his eyes.

defs.def_en: Theatrical behaviour is exaggerated and unnatural, and intended to create an effect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 盛大的;壮观的;有戏剧效果的

ext.ext_cn: 整个场面很宏大，深深吸引住了我。
ext.ext_en: There was a theatrical air about the whole scene which had a great appeal for me...

ext.ext_cn: 那些衣服很艳丽很华美，像戏装一样。
ext.ext_en: The clothes were very showy, very theatrical.

defs.def_en: Theatrical can be used to describe something that is grand and dramatic, as if it is part of a performance in a theatre.

defs.def_cn: (尤指业余的)戏剧表演，娱乐表演

ext.ext_cn: 我一向擅长业余表演。
ext.ext_en: I always was good at amateur theatricals.

defs.def_en: Theatricals are performances of plays and other entertainments, especially when they are done by actors who act as a hobby rather than a profession.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不礼貌的;傲慢的;莽撞的

ext.ext_cn: 能冒昧问一下您所在的确切位置吗？
ext.ext_en: Would it be impertinent to ask where exactly you were?...

ext.ext_cn: 我不喜欢冒昧提问的陌生人。
ext.ext_en: I don't like strangers who ask impertinent questions.

defs.def_en: If someone talks or behaves in a rather impolite and disrespectful way, you can say that they are being impertinent .

ext.ext_cn: 她的猫跑上前来，在他们腿上蹭来蹭去。
ext.ext_en: Her cat came up and rubbed itself against their legs...

ext.ext_cn: 他走到我跟前说：“快点，约翰。”
ext.ext_en: He came up to me and said: 'Come on, John.'

defs.def_en: If someone comes up or comes up to you, they approach you until they are standing close to you.

ext.ext_cn: 在与客人喝餐前酒的时候，有人提到了这个话题。
ext.ext_en: The subject came up during a pre-dinner drink with our guests.

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮·柯克帕特里克的名字被多次提到。
ext.ext_en: Jeane Kirkpatrick's name has come up a lot.

defs.def_en: If something comes up in a conversation or meeting, it is mentioned or discussed.

ext.ext_cn: 做好日常规划，这样一旦发生大事，才能够从容不迫。
ext.ext_en: Plan your activities so that you are rested and refreshed when something important is coming up...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的确将要进行选举。
ext.ext_en: We do have elections coming up.

defs.def_en: If something is coming up, it is about to happen or take place.

ext.ext_cn: 我耽搁了些时候——家里出了点事。
ext.ext_en: I was delayed — something came up at home...

ext.ext_cn: 突然来了一些其他的项目，我的工作重点便转移了。
ext.ext_en: Other projects came up and the emphasis of my work altered.

defs.def_en: If something comes up, it happens unexpectedly.

ext.ext_cn: 格顿学院设立了一项研究奖学金，我提出申请并且成功获得。
ext.ext_en: A research fellowship came up at Girton and I applied for it and got it...

ext.ext_cn: 这幢房子放盘，两口子才意识到他们的钱差不多刚够买下它。
ext.ext_en: The house came up for sale and the couple realised they could just about afford it.

defs.def_en: If a job comes up or if something comes up for sale, it becomes available.

ext.ext_cn: 看着太阳冉冉升起将是十分美妙的事情。
ext.ext_en: It will be so great watching the sun come up.

defs.def_en: When the sun or moon comes up, it rises.

ext.ext_cn: 案件开庭审理的时候，这些预备役军人不会认罪，他就是其中一个。
ext.ext_en: He is one of the reservists who will plead not guilty when their cases come up.

defs.def_en: In law, when a case comes up, it is heard in a court of law.

defs.def_cn: (种植蔬菜和水果供出售的)商品果蔬园，果蔬农场
defs.def_en: A market garden is a small farm where vegetables and fruit are grown for sale.

defs.def_cn: (尤指可以赢得奖品的)射击场，打靶场
defs.def_en: A shooting gallery is a place where people use rifles to shoot at targets, especially in order to win prizes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 用凉的自来水清洗这些蔬菜。
ext.ext_en: Rinse the vegetables under cold running water...

ext.ext_cn: 他想要杯不凉不热的茶。
ext.ext_en: He likes his tea neither too hot nor too cold...

defs.def_en: Something that is cold has a very low temperature or a lower temperature than is normal or acceptable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 天冷得刺骨。
ext.ext_en: It was bitterly cold...

ext.ext_cn: 屋里很冷，因为我没钱付暖气费。
ext.ext_en: The house is cold because I can't afford to turn the heat on...

defs.def_en: If it is cold, or if a place is cold, the temperature of the air is very low.

ext.ext_cn: 他肯定是进来避寒的。
ext.ext_en: He must have come inside to get out of the cold...

ext.ext_cn: 他的脚冻得发紫。
ext.ext_en: His feet were blue with cold.

defs.def_en: Cold weather or low temperatures can be referred to as the cold .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我快冻僵了。
ext.ext_en: I was freezing cold...

ext.ext_cn: 我饥寒交迫，甚至连睡觉的地方都没有。
ext.ext_en: I'm hungry, I'm cold and I've nowhere to sleep.

defs.def_en: If you are cold, your body is at an unpleasantly low temperature.

ext.ext_cn: 会有各种冷热小吃。
ext.ext_en: A wide variety of hot and cold snacks will be available.

ext.ext_cn: 冷肉
ext.ext_en: ...cold meats.

defs.def_en: Cold food, such as salad or meat that has been cooked and cooled, is not intended to be eaten hot.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 通常，绘画中暖色调为近感色，而冷色调为远感色。
ext.ext_en: Generally, warm colours advance in painting and cold colours recede.

ext.ext_cn: 街灯发出的幽幽蓝光
ext.ext_en: ...the cold blue light from a streetlamp.

defs.def_en: Cold colours or cold light give an impression of coldness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 冷淡的;冷酷的;不热情的

ext.ext_cn: 她真是个冷酷无情的女人！
ext.ext_en: What a cold, unfeeling woman she was...

ext.ext_cn: “把她打发走。”伊芙冷酷无情地说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Send her away,' Eve said in a cold, hard voice.

defs.def_en: A cold person does not show much emotion, especially affection, and therefore seems unfriendly and unsympathetic. If someone's voice is cold, they speak in an unfriendly unsympathetic way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他能循着地面上甚至是石头上留下的淡淡的痕迹展开追踪。
ext.ext_en: He could follow a cold trail over hard ground and even over stones.

defs.def_en: A cold trail or scent is one which is old and therefore difficult to follow.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is cold when they are trying to guess the answer to a question or puzzle, you mean that they are thinking about it in the wrong way and are going to give a wrong answer.
If you have a cold, you have a mild, very common illness which makes you sneeze a lot and gives you a sore throat or a cough.

ext.ext_cn: 我们把头发吹干，这样就不会感冒。
ext.ext_en: Let's dry our hair so we don't catch cold.

defs.def_en: If you catch cold, or catch a cold, you become ill with a cold.

defs.def_cn: 未能打动;未能激起…的兴趣

ext.ext_cn: 劳伦斯是那种要么让人激动不已，要么让人觉得索然无味的作家。
ext.ext_en: Lawrence is one of those writers who either excite you enormously or leave you cold.

defs.def_en: If something leaves you cold, it fails to excite or interest you.

defs.def_cn: 昏迷的;失去知觉的;睡得很沉的

ext.ext_cn: 她处于昏迷状态，但还有呼吸。
ext.ext_en: She was out cold but still breathing.

defs.def_en: If someone is out cold, they are unconscious or sleeping very heavily.

ext.ext_cn: 在目前的世界贸易洽谈中，发展中国家可能会受到冷落。
ext.ext_en: Developing countries might be left out in the cold in current world trade talks.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person, group, or country has been left out in the cold, you mean that they have been ignored by others rather than being invited to take part in some activity with them.
A chick is a baby bird.

defs.def_cn: 小妞儿(男性用语，可能具冒犯意味)
defs.def_en: Some men refer to women as chicks. This use could cause offence.

ext.ext_cn: 他是这次政变的幕后指使人。
ext.ext_en: He was the prime mover behind the coup...

ext.ext_cn: 他已被公布是阴谋杀害卡罗尔的主谋。
ext.ext_en: He has been named as the prime mover in the conspiracy to murder Carroll.

defs.def_en: The prime mover behind a plan, idea, or situation is someone who has an important influence in starting it.

ext.ext_cn: 袖子遮住了他的手，一直盖到指尖。
ext.ext_en: The sleeves covered his hands to the tips of his fingers...

ext.ext_cn: 她用手杖尖翻拨挪动东西。
ext.ext_en: She poked and shifted things with the tip of her walking stick...

defs.def_en: The tip of something long and narrow is the end of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他倾着身子避开她，她不得不把头向后歪着看他。
ext.ext_en: He leaned away from her, and she had to tip her head back to see him...

ext.ext_cn: 一个小男孩正站在凳子上，伸手够一个曲奇罐子，凳子眼看就要歪了。
ext.ext_en: A young boy is standing on a stool, reaching for a cookie jar, and the stool is about to tip...

defs.def_en: If you tip an object or part of your body or if it tips, it moves into a sloping position with one end or side higher than the other.

ext.ext_cn: 把蔬菜倒进碗里。
ext.ext_en: Tip the vegetables into a bowl...

ext.ext_cn: 她拿出盘子，茫然地望着上面已经干掉的食物，然后把它倒进了垃圾桶。
ext.ext_en: She took out the plate, stared blankly at the dried-up food on it, and tipped it into the bin…

defs.def_en: If you tip something somewhere, you pour it there.

ext.ext_cn: 在废弃物填埋场倾倒垃圾的成本
