ext.ext_en: ...the costs of tipping rubbish in landfills...

ext.ext_cn: 你怎样阻止人们乱倒垃圾呢？
ext.ext_en: How do you stop people tipping?...

defs.def_en: To tip rubbish means to get rid of it by leaving it somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 警察在垃圾场发现了一把很大的面包刀。
ext.ext_en: Officers had found a large bread knife on the rubbish tip…

ext.ext_cn: 我把一堆垃圾与修剪下的碎草运到了垃圾场。
ext.ext_en: I took a load of rubbish and grass cuttings to the tip.

defs.def_en: A tip is a place where rubbish is left.

ext.ext_cn: 这套公寓简直就是个垃圾场。
ext.ext_en: The flat is an absolute tip.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as a tip, you mean it is very untidy.

ext.ext_cn: 你真的认为给侍者小费是约定俗成的吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you really think it's customary to tip the waiters?...

ext.ext_cn: 她给了吧台服务员 10 美元小费，还请在场的所有人喝了酒。
ext.ext_en: She tipped the barmen 10 dollars and bought drinks all round.

defs.def_en: If you tip someone such as a waiter in a restaurant, you give them some money in order to thank them for their services.

ext.ext_cn: 我给了理发师小费。
ext.ext_en: I gave the barber a tip...

ext.ext_cn: 行李员领班扣留了所有人的小费。
ext.ext_en: The Head Porter was keeping all the tips.

defs.def_en: If you give a tip to someone such as a waiter in a restaurant, you give them some money to thank them for their services.

ext.ext_cn: 它说明了如何准备简历，并就如何申请职位提了些建议。
ext.ext_en: It shows how to prepare a CV, and gives tips on applying for jobs.

ext.ext_cn: 给繁忙的经理们的忠告
ext.ext_en: …tips for busy managers…

defs.def_en: A tip is a useful piece of advice.

defs.def_cn: 认定…会(做某事或获得成功)

ext.ext_cn: 他被认定会成为该国下一任外交部长。
ext.ext_en: He is tipped to be the country's next foreign minister...

ext.ext_cn: 大家都认定他会成功。
ext.ext_en: He was widely tipped for success.

defs.def_en: If a person is tipped to do something or is tipped for success at something, experts or journalists believe that they will do that thing or achieve that success.

defs.def_cn: (对赛马、比赛结果的)预测，内幕消息

ext.ext_cn: 我有一条关于赛马比赛的内部消息。
ext.ext_en: I've a tip for the races…

ext.ext_cn: 我仍然认定联队会夺冠。
ext.ext_en: United are still my tip for the Title.

defs.def_en: Someone's tip for a race or competition is their advice on its likely result, especially to someone who wants to bet money on the result.

defs.def_cn: (事物的)端倪，表面一小部分，冰山一角

ext.ext_cn: 除非我们都加倍小心，否则死者的人数会比现在多得多。
ext.ext_en: Unless we're all a lot more careful, the people who have died so far will be just the tip of the iceberg.

defs.def_en: If you say that a problem is the tip of the iceberg, you mean that it is one small part of a much larger problem.

ext.ext_cn: 今天距离稍短的赛跑可能会对他占据优势大有助益。
ext.ext_en: Today's slightly shorter race could well help to tip the scales in his favour...

ext.ext_cn: 如果选拔赛双方打平，报界可能会使形势朝着不利于他们的方向倾斜。
ext.ext_en: If the trial were evenly poised the newspapers might tip the balance against them.

defs.def_en: If something tips the scales or tips the balance, it gives someone a slight advantage.

ext.ext_cn: 马奥尼想说老板出去了，话到嘴边却没说出口。
ext.ext_en: It was on the tip of Mahoney's tongue to say the boss was out...

ext.ext_cn: 挖苦的话到了她嘴边却没说出来。
ext.ext_en: A sarcastic remark was on the tip of her tongue.

defs.def_en: If a comment or question is on the tip of your tongue, you really want to say it or ask it, but you decide not to say it.

defs.def_cn: (动词)原形,不定式(前面常加 to)
defs.def_en: The infinitive of a verb is the basic form, for example 'do', 'be', 'take', and 'eat'. The infinitive is often used with 'to' in front of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她身穿一套裤腿两边有白色条纹的亮绿色慢跑服。
ext.ext_en: She wore a bright green jogging suit with a white stripe down the sides...

ext.ext_cn: 前卧室的墙壁被漆成淡蓝色和白色相间的宽条纹。
ext.ext_en: The walls in the front bedroom are painted with broad, pale blue and white stripes.

defs.def_en: A stripe is a long line which is a different colour from the areas next to it.

defs.def_cn: (军装或警服上表示等级或服役年限的 V 型)臂章

ext.ext_cn: 胳膊上别着下士臂章的士兵
ext.ext_en: ...a soldier with a corporal's stripes on his arms...

ext.ext_cn: 他因散漫、无礼而丢了军职。
ext.ext_en: He'd lost his stripes for slovenliness and cheek.

defs.def_en: In the armed forces or the police, stripes are V-shaped bands of material sewn onto a uniform to indicate the rank of corporal or sergeant. In the United States, stripes can also show the length of time that a person has served in an organization.
A koala or a koala bear is an Australian animal which looks like a small bear with grey fur and lives in trees.

ext.ext_cn: 这样能够让观众舒舒服服地坐着看表演。
ext.ext_en: This will enable the audience to sit in comfort while watching the shows...

ext.ext_cn: 鞋子的鞋帮、鞋跟和鞋舌部位都有衬垫，以增加舒适度。
ext.ext_en: The shoe has padding around the collar, heel and tongue for added comfort.

defs.def_en: If you are doing something in comfort, you are physically relaxed and contented, and are not feeling any pain or other unpleasant sensations.

ext.ext_cn: 总会有办法能安排好我们忙碌的生活，这样就能过得舒服一点，同时还能达到内心的平静。
ext.ext_en: Surely there is some way of ordering our busy lives so that we can live in comfort and find spiritual harmony too.

defs.def_en: Comfort is a style of life in which you have enough money to have everything you need.

ext.ext_cn: 他欣然接受休战，但是指出，那些无法和心爱的人一起过圣诞的家庭并不会由此感到慰藉。
ext.ext_en: He welcomed the truce, but pointed out it was of little comfort to families spending Christmas without a loved one...

ext.ext_cn: 预定星期五发布的通货膨胀数字将会给他一些宽慰。
ext.ext_en: He will be able to take some comfort from inflation figures due on Friday...

defs.def_en: See also:cold comfort;Comfort is what you feel when worries or unhappiness stop.

defs.def_cn: 令人感到安慰的人(或事物)

ext.ext_cn: 至少他留给她一个孩子，这孩子在未来的岁月里对她将是莫大的安慰。
ext.ext_en: At least he has given her a child who will be a great comfort to her in the years ahead...

ext.ext_cn: 跟你聊一聊我好受多了。
ext.ext_en: It's a comfort talking to you...

defs.def_en: If you refer to a person, thing, or idea as a comfort, you mean that it helps you to stop worrying or makes you feel less unhappy.

ext.ext_cn: 内德搂着她，想安慰她。
ext.ext_en: Ned put his arm around her, trying to comfort her.

defs.def_en: If you comfort someone, you make them feel less worried, unhappy, or upset, for example by saying kind things to them.

ext.ext_cn: 她喜欢婚姻生活带给她的物质享受。
ext.ext_en: She enjoys the material comforts married life has brought her...

ext.ext_cn: 电给我们带来了温暖和照明，以及一切现代家庭舒适品。
ext.ext_en: Electricity provides us with warmth and light and all our modern home comforts...

defs.def_en: See also:creature comforts;Comforts are things which make your life easier and more pleasant, such as electrical devices you have in your home.

ext.ext_cn: 这些炸弹落入海中，很多离岸边太近，令人担忧。
ext.ext_en: The bombs fell in the sea, many too close for comfort...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管针对游客的犯罪活动有所减少，但犯罪率还是太高，令人担忧。
ext.ext_en: Although crimes against visitors were falling, the levels of crime were still too high for comfort.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is, for example, too close for comfort, you mean you are worried because it is closer than you would like it to be.

ext.ext_cn: 苏联的扩张主义被认为是真正的威胁。
ext.ext_en: Soviet expansionism was considered a real threat.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a country's expansionism, you disapprove of its policy of increasing its land or power.

ext.ext_cn: 尼古拉斯先生恳请帮助以解决这起凶杀案。
ext.ext_en: Mr Nicholas made his emotional plea for help in solving the killing.

ext.ext_cn: 让人类行动起来拯救这个星球的慷慨激昂的呼吁
ext.ext_en: ...an impassioned plea to mankind to act to save the planet.

defs.def_en: A plea is an appeal or request for something, made in an intense or emotional way.

defs.def_cn: （法庭上表明对于被指控的罪名服或不服的）申诉，答辩，抗辩

ext.ext_cn: 法官就他的认罪答辩进行审问。
ext.ext_en: The judge questioned him about his guilty plea...

ext.ext_cn: 我们将进行无罪抗辩。
ext.ext_en: We will enter a plea of not guilty...

defs.def_en: In a court of law, a person's plea is the answer that they give when they have been charged with a crime, saying whether or not they are guilty of that crime.

ext.ext_cn: 菲利普斯谋杀了他的妻子，但以精神错乱为由逃脱了惩罚。
ext.ext_en: Phillips murdered his wife, but got off on a plea of insanity...

ext.ext_cn: 邓恩先生贫穷的托词只是部分成立。
ext.ext_en: Mr Dunn's pleas of poverty are only partly justified.

defs.def_en: A plea is a reason which is given, to a court of law or to other people, as an excuse for doing something or for not doing something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她被要求对叔叔恭敬顺从。
ext.ext_en: She is expected to be subservient to her uncle.

defs.def_en: If you are subservient, you do whatever someone wants you to do.

ext.ext_cn: 妇女的需求被认为要服从团体的利益。
ext.ext_en: The woman's needs are seen as subservient to the group interest.

defs.def_en: If you treat one thing as subservient to another, you treat it as less important than the other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 母马又嘶鸣了一声，扭头消失在树林里。
ext.ext_en: The mare neighed once more, turned and disappeared amongst the trees.

ext.ext_cn: 这匹马大声嘶叫。
ext.ext_en: The horse gave a loud neigh.

defs.def_en: When a horse neighs, it makes a loud sound with its mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 他注意到,如果父亲遭受过大量辐射,孩子患白血病的情况就更多见。
ext.ext_en: He observed that leukaemia in children was more common if the fathers had been heavily irradiated.

ext.ext_cn: 使欧洲大片地区受到严重核辐射的切尔诺贝利灾难
ext.ext_en: ...the Chernobyl disaster, which irradiated large parts of Europe.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is irradiated, they are exposed to a large amount of radioactivity.

defs.def_cn: 对(食品)进行放射线照射(以杀菌);辐照

ext.ext_cn: 食用经过辐射杀菌处理、延长了保质期的食品是安全的。
ext.ext_en: It's safe to eat foods that have been irradiated to prolong their shelf life.

ext.ext_cn: 辐照食品的风险与优势
ext.ext_en: ...the risks and benefits of irradiated food.

defs.def_en: If food is irradiated, it is treated with radiation to kill bacteria and make it last longer.

ext.ext_cn: 整个展览的重点是一大组水彩画。
ext.ext_en: Forming the pivot of the exhibition is a large group of watercolours.

defs.def_en: The pivot in a situation is the most important thing which everything else is based on or arranged around.

ext.ext_cn: 小船原地掉过头来，直指海港入口。
ext.ext_en: The boat pivoted on its central axis and pointed straight at the harbour entrance...

ext.ext_cn: 她在舞台上优雅地旋转。
ext.ext_en: She pivots gracefully on the stage...

defs.def_en: If something pivots, it balances or turns on a central point.

ext.ext_cn: 踏板在枢轴处断裂了。
ext.ext_en: The pedal had sheared off at the pivot.

defs.def_en: A pivot is the pin or the central point on which something balances or turns.

ext.ext_cn: 成功地扼制制通货膨胀的经历加强了他作为经济学家的才能。
ext.ext_en: His competence as an economist had been reinforced by his successful fight against inflation...

ext.ext_cn: 我们一直都认为他是个正直而且业务能力很强的人。
ext.ext_en: We've always regarded him as a man of integrity and high professional competence.

defs.def_en: Competence is the ability to do something well or effectively.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他依然觉得辛普森一家人很讨厌。
ext.ext_en: He continued to find the Simpsons uncongenial bores...

ext.ext_cn: 好莱坞是个不适宜工作的地方。
ext.ext_en: Hollywood was an uncongenial place to work.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or place as uncongenial, you mean that they are unfriendly and unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 一个多次在赛车比赛中胜出的知名汽车品牌——阿尔法·罗米欧
ext.ext_en: ...a marque long-associated with motor racing success, Alfa Romeo.

defs.def_en: A marque is the name of a famous company that makes motor vehicles, or the vehicles it produces.

defs.def_cn: 错误观念;错误看法;误解

ext.ext_cn: 人们误以为佩吉相当有钱。
ext.ext_en: It is a misconception that Peggy was fabulously wealthy...

ext.ext_cn: 人们对癌症非常恐惧，而且存在许多错误看法。
ext.ext_en: There are many fears and misconceptions about cancer.

defs.def_en: A misconception is an idea that is not correct.

defs.def_cn: 可作两种解释的;模棱两可的

ext.ext_cn: 即使他的赞扬都说得模棱两可。
ext.ext_en: Even his praise is double-edged.

defs.def_en: If you say that a comment is double-edged, you mean that it has two meanings, so that you are not sure whether the person who said it is being critical or is giving praise.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 好坏相抵的;似好实坏的;有双重后果的

ext.ext_cn: 但旅游业具有两面性，既刺激经济增长但又会破坏环境。
ext.ext_en: But tourism is double-edged, boosting the economy but damaging the environment...

ext.ext_cn: 赖利的一早成名后来证明是把双刃剑。
ext.ext_en: Riley's early celebrity proved to be double-edged.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is double-edged, you mean that its positive effects are balanced by its negative effects, or that its negative effects are greater.  a double-edged sword→see: sword;

ext.ext_cn: 高温和潮湿让人难以忍受。
ext.ext_en: The heat and humidity were insufferable.

defs.def_en: You say there is humidity when the air feels very heavy and damp.

ext.ext_cn: 湿度相对较低。
ext.ext_en: The humidity is relatively low.

defs.def_en: Humidity is the amount of water in the air.

defs.def_cn: （尤指威尼斯的）凤尾船，贡多拉
defs.def_en: A gondola is a long narrow boat that is used especially in Venice. It has a flat bottom and curves upwards at both ends. A person stands at one end of the boat and uses a long pole to move and steer it.

defs.def_cn: (巨大金属物)发出咣当声，发出当啷声

ext.ext_cn: 平底锅叮叮咣咣地响。
ext.ext_en: A pan rattled and clanked...

ext.ext_cn: 火车咣当咣当进了小站，“我们到站了，”贝丝说。
ext.ext_en: 'Here we are now,' Beth said, as the train clanked into a tiny station.

defs.def_en: When large metal objects clank, they make a noise because they are hitting together or hitting against something hard.

ext.ext_cn: 我们吃了一顿极为丰盛的午餐。
ext.ext_en: We had an exceedingly good lunch...

ext.ext_cn: 作这个决定非常地难。
ext.ext_en: This was an exceedingly difficult decision to take...

defs.def_en: Exceedingly means very or very much.

defs.def_cn: 金融服务;投资咨询服务

ext.ext_cn: 向消费者提供独立金融服务建议的志愿机构
ext.ext_en: ...voluntary organisations that provide independent advice to consumers on financial services.

ext.ext_cn: 金融服务公司
ext.ext_en: ...financial service companies.

defs.def_en: A company or organization that provides financial services is able to help you do things such as make investments or buy a pension or mortgage.

ext.ext_cn: 瓷制小船
ext.ext_en: ...a small boat made of china.

ext.ext_cn: 瓷杯
ext.ext_en: ...china cups.

defs.def_en: See also:bone china;China is a hard white substance made from clay. It is used to make things such as cups, bowls, plates, and ornaments.

ext.ext_cn: 朱迪收集青花瓷。
ext.ext_en: Judy collects blue and white china.

defs.def_en: Cups, bowls, plates, and ornaments made of china are referred to as china .

ext.ext_cn: 他挤出一丝苦笑。
ext.ext_en: He permitted himself a small mirthless smile.

defs.def_en: If someone gives a mirthless laugh or smile, it is obvious that they are not really amused.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 凉的;凉爽的;温度不高的

ext.ext_cn: 我感觉到一阵凉风。
ext.ext_en: I felt a current of cool air...

ext.ext_cn: 这水比小孩的洗澡水稍微凉一些。
ext.ext_en: The water was slightly cooler than a child's bath...

defs.def_en: Something that is cool has a temperature which is low but not very low.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 谢天谢地，这里面挺凉快。
ext.ext_en: Thank goodness it's cool in here...

ext.ext_cn: 将粮食和谷物储存在阴凉干燥的地方。
ext.ext_en: Store grains and cereals in a cool, dry place.

defs.def_en: If it is cool, or if a place is cool, the temperature of the air is low but not very low.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在热天里，应该穿凉快舒适的衣服。
ext.ext_en: In warm weather, you should wear clothing that is cool and comfortable.

defs.def_en: Clothing that is cool is made of thin material so that you do not become too hot in hot weather.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 选择冷色系，比如乳白色。
ext.ext_en: Choose a cool colour such as cream...

ext.ext_cn: 客厅是冷色调的银绿色。
ext.ext_en: The drawing-room was a cool silver green.

defs.def_en: Cool colours are light colours which give an impression of coolness.

ext.ext_cn: 把肉沥干水，让它冷却。
ext.ext_en: Drain the meat and allow it to cool...

ext.ext_cn: 必须用巨大的风扇来冷却混凝土地面，将其温度控制在150度以下。
ext.ext_en: Huge fans will have to cool the concrete floor to keep it below 150 degrees.

defs.def_en: When something cools or when you cool it, it becomes lower in temperature.

ext.ext_cn: 几分钟之内，火气就变小了。
ext.ext_en: Within a few minutes tempers had cooled...

ext.ext_cn: 他奇怪的举动使得她的激情冷却。
ext.ext_en: His weird behaviour had cooled her passion.

defs.def_en: When a feeling or emotion cools, or when you cool it, it becomes less powerful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人、行为等)冷静的，沉着的，泰然自若的

ext.ext_cn: 他又变得出奇地冷静，微笑着，好像什么也没有发生过。
ext.ext_en: He was marvelously cool again, smiling as if nothing had happened...

ext.ext_cn: 听了那句话，雷诺失去了冷静。
ext.ext_en: At that, Reno lost her cool composure.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or their behaviour is cool, you mean that they are calm and unemotional, especially in a difficult situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人、行为等)冷漠的，冷淡的，不友善的

ext.ext_cn: 我一点也不喜欢他，觉得他冷漠、孤僻而且傲慢。
ext.ext_en: I didn't like him at all. I thought he was cool, aloof, and arrogant...

ext.ext_cn: 人们对这个想法反应冷淡。
ext.ext_en: The idea met with a cool response...

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or their behaviour is cool, you mean that they are unfriendly or not enthusiastic.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人、行为等)酷的，时尚的，吸引人的

ext.ext_cn: 他竭力想扮酷，赶时髦。
ext.ext_en: He was trying to be really cool and trendy.

ext.ext_cn: 认为吸食海洛因很酷的一个15岁的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...some 15-year-old kid who thinks it's cool to do heroin.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or their behaviour is cool, you mean that they are fashionable and attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坦然接受的;心平气和的

ext.ext_cn: 贝芙对这一切都表现得相当平静。
ext.ext_en: Bev was really cool about it all.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is cool about something, you mean that they accept it and are not angry or upset about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 非常好的;特别棒的;绝妙的

ext.ext_cn: 凯瑟琳给了我一件非常漂亮的衣服。
ext.ext_en: Kathleen gave me a really cool dress.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is cool, you think it is very good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指轻易得到的数额)巨大的，整整

ext.ext_cn: 哥伦比亚唱片公司最近以3,000万美元的高价再次签下这个乐队。
ext.ext_en: Columbia recently resigned the band for a cool $30 million.

defs.def_en: You can use cool to emphasize that an amount or figure is very large, especially when it has been obtained easily.

ext.ext_cn: 你们能不能冷静一下？
ext.ext_en: Can't you guys just cool it?

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to cool it, you want them to stop being angry and aggressive and to behave more calmly.

ext.ext_cn: 她保持着冷静与克制，努力使自己走出了这次痛苦的经历。
ext.ext_en: She kept her cool and managed to get herself out of the ordeal...

ext.ext_cn: 那个高大的爱尔兰人快要失去冷静了。
ext.ext_en: The big Irishman was on the verge of losing his cool.

defs.def_en: If you keep your cool in a difficult situation, you manage to remain calm. If you lose your cool, you get angry or upset.

ext.ext_cn: 如果让你生气的人也在生你的气，而你还要假装冷静，那就太可笑了。
ext.ext_en: It's ridiculous to play it cool if someone you're mad about is mad about you too.

defs.def_en: If you play it cool, you deliberately behave in a calm, unemotional way because you do not want people to know you are enthusiastic or angry about something.

ext.ext_cn: 借用梳子据说是虱卵在人之间传播的原因。
ext.ext_en: Borrowed combs were said to be the cause of spreading nits from one to another.

defs.def_en: Nits are the eggs of insects called lice which live in people's hair.

ext.ext_cn: 我宁愿离开公司，也不愿和这样的笨蛋一起工作。
ext.ext_en: I'd rather leave the business than work with such a nit.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a nit, you think they are stupid or silly.

ext.ext_cn: 大概晚上11点半的时候，波拉德最终同意进行搜查。
ext.ext_en: At approximately 11:30 p.m., Pollard finally gave his consent to the search...

ext.ext_cn: 能不经我的同意就对我的孩子进行体检吗？
ext.ext_en: Can my child be medically examined without my consent?

defs.def_en: If you give your consent to something, you give someone permission to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他最终同意去了。
ext.ext_en: He finally consented to go...

ext.ext_cn: 他问金尼是否同意在洗礼之后小小地庆祝一下。
ext.ext_en: He asked Ginny if she would consent to a small celebration after the christening...

defs.def_en: If you consent to something, you agree to do it or to allow it to be done.

defs.def_cn: 经一致同意;经双方同意

ext.ext_cn: 双方达成共识，他们的谈话对他们去那儿的原因完全避而不谈。
ext.ext_en: By common consent their talk avoided the reason for their being there at all...

ext.ext_cn: 去年9月，经双方同意，他离开了公司。
ext.ext_en: He left the company by mutual consent last September.

defs.def_en: If something happens by common consent or by mutual consent, it happens as the result of an agreement between the people or groups involved.

ext.ext_cn: 普遍认为这次选举是迈上民主之路的历史性一步。
ext.ext_en: By common consent this election constituted a historic step on the road to democracy.

defs.def_en: You can use by general consent or by common consent to indicate that most people agree that something is true.

defs.def_cn: 接近，逼近（前面的人或事物）

ext.ext_cn: 他在某些地方比我快，而我会在其他地方追上他。
ext.ext_en: In some places he was quicker and at others I'd gain on him...

ext.ext_cn: 那辆奔驰开始逼近小货车。
ext.ext_en: The Mercedes began to gain on the van.

defs.def_en: If you gain on someone or something that is moving in front of you, you gradually get closer to them.

ext.ext_cn: 曾经担任国王副官的一名上校
ext.ext_en: ...a colonel who had been aide-de-camp to the king.

defs.def_en: An aide-de-camp is an officer in the armed forces who helps an officer of higher rank.

defs.def_cn: （焚烧垃圾的）火堆；（作为庆祝点燃的）篝火，营火

ext.ext_cn: 由于市区明令禁止焚烧垃圾，园丁必须把垃圾运至垃圾场。
ext.ext_en: With bonfires outlawed in urban areas, gardeners must cart their refuse to a dump...

ext.ext_cn: 他们通过举行游行、生起篝火和燃放烟花来庆祝这一事件。
ext.ext_en: They celebrated the event by holding parades, lighting bonfires and setting off fireworks.

defs.def_en: A bonfire is a fire that is made outdoors, usually to burn rubbish. Bonfires are also sometimes lit as part of a celebration.
Archaeology is the study of the societies and peoples of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

In grammar, the present participle of a verb is the form which ends in '-ing'. Present participles are used to form continuous tenses, as in 'She was wearing a neat blue suit'. They are often nouns, as in 'I hate cooking' and 'Cooking can be fun'. Many of them can be used like an adjective in front of a noun, as in 'their smiling faces'.

ext.ext_cn: 耶稣基督的受难、复活和升天
ext.ext_en: ...the crucifixion, resurrection and ascension of Jesus Christ.

ext.ext_cn: 纪念先知穆罕默德升天的双休假日
ext.ext_en: ...the two-day holiday marking the Prophet's ascension to heaven.

defs.def_en: In some religions, when someone goes to heaven, you can refer to their ascension to heaven.

ext.ext_cn: 在他登上柬埔寨王位50年后
ext.ext_en: ...50 years after his ascension to the Cambodian throne.

defs.def_en: The ascension of a person to a high rank or important position is the act of reaching this position.
A pyre is a high pile of wood built outside on which people burn a dead body or other things in a ceremony.

defs.def_cn: 精神创伤;惊骇(或痛苦)经历

ext.ext_cn: 我经历过失去房子的痛苦。
ext.ext_en: I'd been through the trauma of losing a house...

ext.ext_cn: 灾难过后军官们正在要求赔偿精神损失。
ext.ext_en: The officers are claiming compensation for trauma after the disaster.

defs.def_en: Trauma is a very severe shock or very upsetting experience, which may cause psychological damage.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 政府坚称军队不会卷入波斯尼亚的冲突。
ext.ext_en: The Government insisted that troops would not become embroiled in battles in Bosnia.

defs.def_en: If you become embroiled in a fight or argument, you become deeply involved in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 与…有牵连的;与…发生纠葛的

ext.ext_cn: 史密斯和新情人纠缠不清，导致他的婚姻告吹。
ext.ext_en: As Smith became embroiled with his new lover, the marriage was called off.

defs.def_en: If you become embroiled with a person, you become involved in a relationship with them that causes you problems.

ext.ext_cn: 她把那捆报纸挪到合适的地方。
ext.ext_en: She moved the sheaf of papers into position...

ext.ext_cn: 你可以上下左右移动摄像机。
ext.ext_en: You can move the camera both vertically and horizontally...

defs.def_en: When you move something or when it moves, its position changes and it does not remain still.

ext.ext_cn: 她等他起床，但他没动弹。
ext.ext_en: She waited for him to get up, but he didn't move...

ext.ext_cn: 家具太多，稍挪步就会撞到什么东西上。
ext.ext_en: There was so much furniture you could hardly move without bumping into something...

defs.def_en: When you move, you change your position or go to a different place.

ext.ext_cn: 实业家们必须尽快采取行动，抓住东欧的新机遇。
ext.ext_en: Industrialists must move fast to take advantage of new opportunities in Eastern Europe.

defs.def_en: If you move, you act or you begin to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 将利率降低一个点是明智的举措。
ext.ext_en: The one point cut in interest rates was a wise move...

ext.ext_cn: 建议她把事情谈开了也许是不错的做法。
ext.ext_en: It may also be a good move to suggest she talks things over...

defs.def_en: A move is an action that you take in order to achieve something.

ext.ext_cn: 我家人住在约克郡，他们不打算搬家。
ext.ext_en: My family home is in York-shire and they don't want to move...

ext.ext_cn: 她过去常想搬到伦敦去住。
ext.ext_en: She had often considered moving to London...

defs.def_en: If a person or company moves, they leave the building where they have been living or working, and they go to live or work in a different place, taking their possessions with  them.

ext.ext_cn: 上级把他派往另一个教区。
ext.ext_en: His superiors moved him to another parish...

ext.ext_cn: 克拉克女士仍然在位，没有要调动她的计划。
ext.ext_en: Ms Clark is still in position and there are no plans to move her...

defs.def_en: If people in authority move someone, they make that person go from one place or job to another one.

ext.ext_cn: 他原先是一名校外辅导老师，后调入学校讲授社会史。
ext.ext_en: He moved from being an extramural tutor to being a lecturer in social history...

ext.ext_cn: 起初克里斯蒂娜更换不同的工作来积累经验。
ext.ext_en: In the early days Christina moved jobs to get experience.

defs.def_en: If you move from one job or interest to another, you change to it.

defs.def_cn: 改变(谈话内容);转到（新的话题）

ext.ext_cn: 丹，我们换个话题吧。
ext.ext_en: Let's move to another subject, Dan.

defs.def_en: If you move to a new topic in a conversation, you start talking about something different.

ext.ext_cn: 俱乐部把会议日期改到1月22号，星期六。
ext.ext_en: The club has moved its meeting to Saturday, January 22nd...

ext.ext_cn: 乐队已把去利兹的日期提前至10月27号。
ext.ext_en: The band have moved forward their Leeds date to October 27.

defs.def_en: If you move an event or the date of an event, you change the time at which  it happens.

ext.ext_cn: 工党已右倾化了，变得像你们民主党。
ext.ext_en: The Labour Party has moved to the right and become like your Democrat Party...

ext.ext_cn: 已有可能朝着消除核武器的目标努力。
ext.ext_en: It is already possible to start moving toward the elimination of nuclear weapons...

defs.def_en: If you move towards a particular state, activity, or opinion, you start to be in that state, do that activity, or have that opinion.

ext.ext_cn: 事件进展迅速。
ext.ext_en: Events are moving fast...

ext.ext_cn: 应该有人牵头把事情做起来。
ext.ext_en: Someone has got to get things moving.

defs.def_en: If a situation or process is moving, it is developing or progressing, rather than staying still.

ext.ext_cn: 大家都认为我回去是很不明智的，但我不会动摇。
ext.ext_en: Everyone thought I was mad to go back, but I wouldn't be moved.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will not be moved, you mean that you have come to a decision and nothing will change your mind.

ext.ext_cn: 最初是朋克摇滚乐促使他正式加入了乐队。
ext.ext_en: It was punk that first moved him to join a band seriously...

ext.ext_cn: 听证会促使总统想出了这些建议。
ext.ext_en: The president was moved to come up with these suggestions after the hearings.

defs.def_en: If something moves you to do something, it influences you and causes you to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些故事让我吃惊，也让我感动。
ext.ext_en: These stories surprised and moved me...

ext.ext_cn: 他的祈祷把我感动得热泪盈眶。
ext.ext_en: His prayer moved me to tears.

defs.def_en: If something moves you, it has an effect on your emotions and causes you to feel sadness or sympathy for another person.

defs.def_cn: 活跃，出入，涉足(于某团体、领域或圈子)

ext.ext_cn: 她时常出入伦敦的上流社会。
ext.ext_en: She moves in high-society circles in London...

ext.ext_cn: 他们出没在一个对种族主义者的敌视习以为常的世界里。
ext.ext_en: They moved in a world where hostility to racists was natural.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone moves in a particular society, circle, or world, you mean that they know people in a particular social class or group and spend most of their time with them.

ext.ext_cn: 工党很快提出终止辩论的动议。
ext.ext_en: Labour quickly moved a closure motion to end the debate...

ext.ext_cn: 我提议对该案不予受理。
ext.ext_en: I move that the case be dismissed.

defs.def_en: At a meeting, if you move a motion, you formally suggest it so that everyone present can vote on it.

ext.ext_cn: 我举着棋子，不知下一步该怎么走。
ext.ext_en: With no idea of what to do for my next move, my hand hovered over the board.

defs.def_en: A move is an act of putting a chess piece or other counter in a different position on a board when it is your turn to do so in a game.

ext.ext_cn: 他明白稍有差池就会被置于死地。
ext.ext_en: He knew one false move would end in death.

defs.def_en: If you say that one false move will cause a disaster, you mean that you or someone else must not make any mistakes because the situation is so difficult or dangerous.
If you tell someone to get a move on, you are telling them to hurry.

ext.ext_cn: 他看一眼手表说：“我想我们最好动身吧。”
ext.ext_en: He glanced at his wristwatch. 'I suppose we'd better make a move.'

ext.ext_cn: 他起身离开。
ext.ext_en: He made a move to leave.

defs.def_en: If you make a move, you prepare or begin to leave one place and go somewhere else.

ext.ext_cn: 在预定交易就要结束的前一周，15家日本银行采取行动撤离。
ext.ext_en: The week before the deal was supposed to close, fifteen Japanese banks made a move to pull out...

ext.ext_cn: 别等别人先主动，要先邀请朋友到家来。
ext.ext_en: Don't wait for others to make the first move: invite friends to visit you.

defs.def_en: If you make a move, you take a course of action.

ext.ext_cn: 杰克从不想在一个地方呆太久，所以他们总在奔波辗转。
ext.ext_en: Jack never wanted to stay in one place for very long, so they were always on the move.

defs.def_en: If you are on the move, you are going from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 我获得了电影摄制的文学士学位。
ext.ext_en: I did a BA in film making.

defs.def_en: A BA is a first degree in an arts or social science subject. BA is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'Bachelor of Arts'.

ext.ext_cn: …海伦·里奇（荣誉）文学士
ext.ext_en: ...Helen Rich, BA (Hons).

defs.def_en: BA is written after someone's name to indicate that they have a BA.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 苍白的;有倦容的;疲惫的

ext.ext_cn: 他脸色苍白，面带倦容。
ext.ext_en: He looked wan and tired...

ext.ext_cn: 她只能挤出一丝疲惫的笑容。
ext.ext_en: All she could manage was a thin, wan smile.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as wan, you mean that they look pale and tired.

ext.ext_cn: 虫卵很快孵化成幼虫。
ext.ext_en: The eggs quickly hatch into larvae.

ext.ext_cn: 蜻蜓幼虫
ext.ext_en: ...a dragonfly larva.

defs.def_en: A larva is an insect at the stage of its life after it has developed from an egg and before it changes into its adult form.
A stockbroker is a person whose job is to buy and sell stocks and shares for people who want to invest money.

defs.def_cn: （用于名词词组前，指代已提及的人或事物）这些

ext.ext_cn: 转成付息的活期存款账户，并保持账上有余额。多数银行和较大的购房互助会现在都能开立这种账户。
ext.ext_en: Switch to an interest-paying current account and stay in credit. Most banks and larger building societies now offer these accounts...

ext.ext_cn: 已经成立了一个指导委员会。我们通常要几个月才能决定的事，这些人在 10 分钟内就能作出决定。
ext.ext_en: A steering committee has been formed. These people can make decisions in ten minutes which would usually take us months.

defs.def_en: You use these at the beginning of noun groups to refer to someone or something that you have already mentioned or identified.

defs.def_cn: (引出将要提及的人或事物)这些

ext.ext_cn: 你的便携式摄像机应该具备以下基本功能：自动聚焦、回放功能、变焦镜头。
ext.ext_en: Your camcorder should have these basic features: autofocus, playback facility, zoom lens...

ext.ext_cn: 你要是打算改造阁楼，这些地址会派上用场。
ext.ext_en: If you're converting your loft, these addresses will be useful.

defs.def_en: You use these to introduce people or things that you are going to talk about.

defs.def_cn: (口语中用来引出故事中的人或物)一些

ext.ext_cn: 我正一个人走着，一些家伙朝我走过来。
ext.ext_en: I was on my own and these fellows came along towards me...

ext.ext_cn: 她过去喜欢做巧克力夹心布丁，你知道吧，就是里面有巧克力酱之类的东西的。
ext.ext_en: She used to make all these chocolate puddle puddings, you know, with the sauce underneath and all this sort of thing.

defs.def_en: In spoken English, people use these to introduce people or things into a story.

defs.def_cn: 这些，他们(用以说明或询问身份)

ext.ext_cn: 这些都是我的孩子。
ext.ext_en: These are my children.

defs.def_en: You use these when you are identifying someone or asking about their identity.

defs.def_cn: 这些(指离自己近的人或物，尤指所触碰或指向的人或物)

ext.ext_cn: 我把这些图片挂在这儿的目的是想展示一下孩子们解决这个问题的方法是多么千差万别。
ext.ext_en: What I try to do in putting these pictures up here is to show how varied children are in solving the problem...

ext.ext_cn: 这把剪刀重得要命。
ext.ext_en: These scissors are awfully heavy.

defs.def_en: You use these to refer to people or things that are near you, especially when you touch them or point to them.

defs.def_cn: 这些(用于指代认为谈话对象了解具体所指的事物，或确认双方所想的是相同的人或物)

ext.ext_cn: 你知道最近这几个月我们一直盼望着天能暖和一点吧？
ext.ext_en: You know these last few months when we've been expecting it to warm up a little bit?...

ext.ext_cn: 你了解我抽的这些味道怪异的香烟吧？
ext.ext_en: You know these funny cigarettes I smoke?

defs.def_en: You use these when you refer to something which you expect the person you are talking to to know about, or when you are checking that you are both thinking of the same person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 如今住在布萨姆会让人心情抑郁。
ext.ext_en: Living in Bootham these days can be depressing...

ext.ext_cn: 我现在最关心的事情就是作为一个单亲家长，努力把自己的孩子抚养长大。
ext.ext_en: Trying to make it as a single parent raising your children would be the main concern to me these days.

defs.def_en: You use these in the expression these days to mean 'at the present time'.
A honeycomb is a wax structure consisting of rows of six-sided spaces where bees store their honey.
A telegraph pole is a tall wooden pole with telephone wires attached to it, connecting several different buildings to the telephone system.

ext.ext_cn: 他的健康和精力在经历了一次中风后没有受到影响。
ext.ext_en: His health and vigour were unimpaired by a stroke...

ext.ext_cn: 米莱娜女王倾国倾城，她的美貌并没有随着岁月的流逝而褪减。
ext.ext_en: Queen Milena possessed great beauty, which she retained unimpaired in advancing years.

defs.def_en: If something is unimpaired after something bad or unpleasant has happened to it, it is not damaged or made worse.

ext.ext_cn: 潜意识的潜在力量
ext.ext_en: ...the hidden power of the subconscious...

ext.ext_cn: 关于它的一切记忆都深植于我的潜意识里。
ext.ext_en: The memory of it all was locked deep in my subconscious.

defs.def_en: Your subconscious is the part of your mind that can influence you or affect your behaviour even though you are not aware of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他下意识地抓住她的胳膊想挽留她。
ext.ext_en: He caught her arm in a subconscious attempt to detain her.

ext.ext_cn: 潜意识里渴望得到关爱
ext.ext_en: ...a subconscious cry for affection.

defs.def_en: A subconscious feeling or action exists in or is influenced by your subconscious.

ext.ext_cn: 我问她是否允许我采访她，她欣然同意了。
ext.ext_en: I asked her if she would allow me to interview her, and she readily agreed...

ext.ext_cn: 当被邀请参加聚会的时候，我一口答应了。
ext.ext_en: When I was invited to the party, I readily accepted.

defs.def_en: If you do something readily, you do it in a way which shows that you are very willing to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些零件很容易在五金商店买到。
ext.ext_en: The components are readily available in hardware shops...

ext.ext_cn: 我不轻易交友。
ext.ext_en: I don't readily make friends.

defs.def_en: You also use readily to say that something can be done or obtained quickly and easily. For example, if you say that something can be readily understood, you mean that people can understand it quickly and easily.

ext.ext_cn: 奇西克教堂为水手的守护神圣尼古拉而建。
ext.ext_en: Chiswick church is dedicated to St Nicholas, patron saint of sailors.

defs.def_en: The patron saint of a place, an activity, or a group of people is a saint who is believed to give them special help and protection.

ext.ext_cn: 侍女低头痴笑着。
ext.ext_en: The maid lowered her chin and simpered.

ext.ext_cn: “谢谢你，医生，”护士傻笑着说。
ext.ext_en: 'Thank you doctor,' said the nurse with a simper.

defs.def_en: When someone simpers, they smile in a rather silly way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不合逻辑的;有悖逻辑的

ext.ext_cn: 反对把经济移民遣送归国是不合逻辑的。
ext.ext_en: It is illogical to oppose the repatriation of economic migrants...

ext.ext_cn: 她可能觉得你的反应疯狂或者不合逻辑,但她不会否认你的感受。
ext.ext_en: She may think your reaction is crazy or illogical, but she cannot deny what you are feeling.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action, feeling, or belief as illogical, you are critical of it because you think that it does not result from a logical and ordered way of thinking.

ext.ext_cn: 药剂师能帮你治疗一般的病痛。
ext.ext_en: The pharmacist can assist you with the treatment of common ailments.

defs.def_en: An ailment is an illness, especially one that is not very serious.
also prizefighter. A prize fighter is a boxer who fights to win money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 事实上，他的经商生涯从初期就明显前景暗淡。
ext.ext_en: In fact, his business career had distinctly unpromising beginnings...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的土地看上去日后没什么用途，所以殖民者最终把大部分都归还给了他们。
ext.ext_en: Their land looked so unpromising that the colonists eventually gave most of it back.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unpromising, you think that it is unlikely to be successful or produce anything good in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 他们以前每年去她的墓前凭吊两次。
ext.ext_en: They used to visit her grave twice a year.

defs.def_en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried.

ext.ext_cn: 纵酒而自折其寿
ext.ext_en: ...drinking yourself to an early grave...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数男人宁死都不愿承认有依赖感。
ext.ext_en: Most men would rather go to the grave than own up to feelings of dependency.

defs.def_en: You can refer to some-one's death as their grave or to death as the grave .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他说他的国家情况十分危急。
ext.ext_en: He said that the situation in his country is very grave...

ext.ext_cn: 我对这些文件能否说明所有的问题深表怀疑。
ext.ext_en: I have grave doubts that the documents tell the whole story.

defs.def_en: A grave event or situation is very serious, important, and worrying.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 威廉在屋顶上呆了一段时间，他下来的时候面色凝重。
ext.ext_en: William was up on the roof for some time and when he came down he looked grave...

ext.ext_cn: 她忐忑不安地审视着他异常严肃的脸色。
ext.ext_en: Anxiously, she examined his unusually grave face.

defs.def_en: A grave person is quiet and serious in their appearance or behaviour.

In some languages such as French, a grave accent is a symbol that is placed over a vowel in a word to show how the vowel is pronounced. For example, the word 'mère' has a grave accent over the first 'e'

ext.ext_cn: 这份杂志并非想断送他的事业，而他拒绝接受采访就是在自毁前程。
ext.ext_en: The magazine isn't trying to ruin his career, the man's digging his own grave by refusing an interview.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is digging their own grave, you are warning them that they are doing something foolish or dangerous that will cause their own failure.

ext.ext_cn: 一想到冒他之名所做下的那些事，达尔文在九泉之下一定不得安宁。
ext.ext_en: Darwin must be turning in his grave at the thought of what is being perpetrated in his name.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone who is dead would turn in their grave at something that is happening now, you mean that they would be very shocked or upset by it, if they were alive.

ext.ext_cn: 他因自己的笨拙而感到尴尬。
ext.ext_en: His clumsiness embarrassed him...

ext.ext_cn: 对所发生的事情一无所知，这让他很难堪。
ext.ext_en: It embarrassed him that he had no idea of what was going on.

defs.def_en: If something or someone embarrasses you, they make you feel shy or ashamed.

defs.def_cn: 使（公众人物、组织等）难堪;给…出难题

ext.ext_cn: 共和党人企图通过阻挠总统的经济计划使其难堪。
ext.ext_en: The Republicans are trying to embarrass the president by thwarting his economic program...

ext.ext_cn: 这件事给政府出了难题。
ext.ext_en: The Government has been embarrassed by the affair.

defs.def_en: If something embarrasses a public figure such as a politician or an organization such as a political party, it causes problems for them.

defs.def_cn: 使(国家、政府等)不稳定;破坏…的稳定

ext.ext_cn: 他们唯一的目标就是要破坏印度政府的稳定。
ext.ext_en: Their sole aim is to destabilize the Indian government.

defs.def_en: To destabilize something such as a country or government means to create a situation which reduces its power or influence.

defs.def_cn: 按次序的;顺序的;序列的

ext.ext_cn: 宇宙的变迁史
ext.ext_en: ...the sequential story of the universe...

ext.ext_cn: 这样孩子们就会循序渐进地学习。
ext.ext_en: In this way the children are introduced to sequential learning.

defs.def_en: Something that is sequential follows a fixed order.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (味道或气味)强烈的，苦的，冲的

ext.ext_cn: 一种几乎无气味的无色液体,尝起来微甜，味道很冲
ext.ext_en: ...a colourless, almost odourless liquid with a sharp, sweetish taste...

ext.ext_cn: 烈日下，被雨水冲刷过的香草闻起来既冲又香气扑鼻。
ext.ext_en: In the hot sun the rain-washed herbs smelled sharp and spicy and sweet all at once.

defs.def_en: A sharp taste or smell is rather strong or bitter, but is often also clear and fresh.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 风不像刚才那么凛冽和凶猛了。
ext.ext_en: The wind was not as sharp and cruel as it had been.

defs.def_en: A sharp wind, or sharp cold, is so strong or intense that it almost hurts you when you are exposed to it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 现在政界讲究的无非是合适的发型和时髦的衣着。
ext.ext_en: Now politics is all about the right haircut and a sharp suit...

ext.ext_cn: 怀亚特衣着入时，从未有人见过他穿便装。
ext.ext_en: A sharp dresser, Wyatt is never seen in casual clothes.

defs.def_en: Sharp clothes are neat, elegant, and fashionable.

ext.ext_cn: 她打算今天早上 8 点整准时开门营业。
ext.ext_en: She planned to unlock the store at 8.00 sharp this morning.

defs.def_en: Sharp is used after stating a particular time to show that something happens at exactly the time stated.

defs.def_cn: (用于音符后)升半音的(常用＃符号表示)

ext.ext_cn: 一把中提琴独自奏出了一个寂寞柔和的升F 调。
ext.ext_en: A solitary viola plucks a lonely, soft F sharp.

defs.def_en: Sharp is used after a letter representing a musical note to show that the note should be played or sung half a tone higher. Sharp is often represented by the symbol #.

defs.def_cn: (活动或工作中)最困难的部分，最危险的部分

ext.ext_cn: 文森特·弗伦奇在房地产这个艰难行业做了最吃苦受累的不动产经纪人。
ext.ext_en: Vincent French is a real estate broker at the sharp end of a tough and exacting business...

ext.ext_cn: 从事一线工作，我们很多人已经注意到来做手术的病人越来越多。
ext.ext_en: Working at the sharp end, many of us have noted an increase in the number of patients attending surgeries.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is at the sharp end of a particular activity or type of work, you mean that they are involved in the most difficult or dangerous aspects of it.

defs.def_cn: 雉堞状的；建成城堡形的

ext.ext_cn: 19世纪的城堡式大厦
ext.ext_en: ...a 19th-century castellated mansion.

defs.def_en: A castellated wall or building looks like a castle.
A roadster is a car with no roof and only two seats.

ext.ext_cn: 疏远两个团体中的任何一方都是政府承受不起的。
ext.ext_en: The government cannot afford to alienate either group.

defs.def_en: If you alienate someone, you make them become unfriendly or unsympathetic towards you.

ext.ext_cn: 他的第二任妻子艾丽斯，决意要疏远他和两个儿子的感情。
ext.ext_en: His second wife, Alice, was determined to alienate him from his two boys.

defs.def_en: To alienate a person from someone or something that they are normally linked with means to cause them to be emotionally or intellectually separated from them.

ext.ext_cn: 她身兼城镇文书、执业会计师和公证人数职。
ext.ext_en: She is the town clerk and a certified public accountant and notary public.

defs.def_en: A notary or a notary public is a person, usually a lawyer, who has legal authority to witness the signing of documents in order to make them legally valid.

ext.ext_cn: 和别的树不同，它不是越往上越细，而是上下一样粗。
ext.ext_en: Unlike other trees, it doesn't taper very much. It stays fat all the way up...

ext.ext_cn: 手指修长纤细的一双美手
ext.ext_en: ...beautiful hands with long, tapering fingers...

defs.def_en: If something tapers, or if you taper it, it becomes gradually thinner at one end.

ext.ext_cn: 种种迹象显示，通货膨胀率在逐渐下降。
ext.ext_en: There are signs that inflation is tapering...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你一直在服用这些药，停药时一定要逐渐停。
ext.ext_en: If you take these drugs continuously, withdrawal must be tapered.

defs.def_en: If something tapers or is tapered, it gradually becomes reduced in amount, number, or size until it is greatly reduced.
A taper is a long, thin candle or a thin wooden strip that is used for lighting fires.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （通常因古老、重要或有名望而）受崇敬的，受尊崇的

ext.ext_cn: 备受尊崇的特威肯纳姆体育场是米德尔塞克斯七人制橄榄球赛决赛的比赛场地。
ext.ext_en: The hallowed turf of Twickenham is the venue for the Middlesex Rugby Sevens Finals...

ext.ext_cn: 他们抗议说，在他们神圣不可侵犯的学术殿堂里没有商学院的位置。
ext.ext_en: They protested that there was no place for a school of commerce in their hallowed halls of learning.

defs.def_en: Hallowed is used to describe something that is respected and admired, usually because it is old, important, or has a good reputation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 圣地
ext.ext_en: ...hallowed ground.

defs.def_en: Hallowed is used to describe something that is considered to be holy.

defs.def_cn: 顽固分子;死硬派;铁杆支持者

ext.ext_cn: 总统希望那些顽固分子会因为这些改革提案而辞职。
ext.ext_en: The president hopes the diehards will resign over the reform proposals...

ext.ext_cn: 即使是他们的铁杆支持者也无法假装这是一场精彩的比赛。
ext.ext_en: Not even their diehard supporters can pretend that this was a great game.

defs.def_en: A diehard is someone who is very strongly opposed to change and new ideas, or who is a very strong supporter of a person or idea.

ext.ext_cn: 从房子各处看到的景色不断给人以惊奇和欣喜。
ext.ext_en: Throughout the house, the views are a constant source of surprise and delight...

ext.ext_cn: 安德鲁听到雷切尔给婴儿起的绰号时，不禁高兴得大笑起来。
ext.ext_en: Andrew roared with delight when he heard Rachel's nickname for the baby...

defs.def_en: Delight is a feeling of very great pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 黑格显然以证明他的批评者是错误的为乐。
ext.ext_en: Haig took obvious delight in proving his critics wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 看到你父母如此喜欢这些男孩子，我很高兴。
ext.ext_en: I enjoy seeing your parents take such a delight in the boys.

defs.def_en: If someone takes delight or takes a delight in something, they get a lot of pleasure from it.

defs.def_cn: 令人高兴的人(或物);乐事;乐趣

ext.ext_cn: 她真讨人喜欢，不是吗？
ext.ext_en: Isn't she a delight?...

ext.ext_cn: 驾驶这架飞机是一件乐事。
ext.ext_en: The aircraft was a delight to fly...

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone or something that gives you great pleasure or enjoyment as a delight .

ext.ext_cn: 她创造出了一种能令全世界的听众都感到快乐的音乐风格。
ext.ext_en: She has created a style of music that has delighted audiences all over the world...

ext.ext_cn: 这份报告让环境保护主义者欢欣不已。
ext.ext_en: The report has delighted environmentalists.

defs.def_en: If something delights you, it gives you a lot of pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 一代又一代的成年人和儿童都很喜欢这个故事。
ext.ext_en: Generations of adults and children have delighted in the story...

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢与孩子们分享他对鸟类的热爱。
ext.ext_en: He delighted in sharing his love of birds with children.

defs.def_en: If you delight in something, you get a lot of pleasure from it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个节目是否能继续赢得 90 后观众的喜爱，还要拭目以待。
ext.ext_en: It remains to be seen if the show will still find favour with a 1990s audience...

ext.ext_cn: 没有人会赞成继续军政府统治。
ext.ext_en: No one would look with favour on the continuing military rule...

defs.def_en: If you regard something or someone with favour, you like or support them.

ext.ext_cn: 我来这儿是想请你帮个忙。
ext.ext_en: I've come to ask you to do me a favour...

ext.ext_cn: 这是友谊的真正表现，不期待任何回报。
ext.ext_en: These are gestures of genuine friendship with no favours expected in return.

defs.def_en: If you do someone a favour, you do something for them even though you do not have to.

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽亚在非常年轻的时候，曾靠卖淫来赚钱。
ext.ext_en: In her extreme youth, Maria had sold her sexual favours for money.

defs.def_en: If you say that one person gives or sells their favours to another, you mean that they have sex.

ext.ext_cn: 法国人说他们倾向于向民主过渡。
ext.ext_en: The French say they favour a transition to democracy...

ext.ext_cn: 他倾向于让联合国接触“当代现实”。
ext.ext_en: He favours bringing the UN into touch with 'modern realities'.

defs.def_en: If you favour something, you prefer it to the other choices available.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天，政府因为偏袒东南部的一些精英艺术群体而遭到抨击。
ext.ext_en: The Government came under fire yesterday for favouring elitist arts groups in the South-east...

ext.ext_cn: 另一种可能性是亲鸟会偏爱强壮的雏鸟。
ext.ext_en: Another possibility is that parents favour chicks that are strong.

defs.def_en: If you favour someone, you treat them better or in a kinder way than you treat other people.

ext.ext_cn: 我不会支持削减所得税。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't be in favour of income tax cuts...

ext.ext_cn: 但这却是个宣称全力支持开放的政府。
ext.ext_en: Yet this is a Government which proclaims that it is all in favour of openness...

defs.def_en: If you are in favour of something, you support it and think that it is a good thing.

ext.ext_cn: 如果委员会裁定韦尔奇有理，这个案件将送交欧洲人权法庭。
ext.ext_en: If the commission rules in Mr Welch's favour the case will go to the European Court of Human Rights.

defs.def_en: If someone makes a judgment in your favour, they say that you are right about something.

ext.ext_cn: 农民所受的保护几乎变成了对乡村的偏袒。
ext.ext_en: The protection that farmers have enjoyed amounts to a bias in favour of the countryside...

ext.ext_cn: 各公司正在试图让劳动力市场的均势向有利于自己的方向倾斜。
ext.ext_en: Firms are trying to shift the balance of power in the labour market back in their favour.

defs.def_en: If something is in your favour, it helps you or gives you an advantage.

defs.def_cn: (舍弃某物)宁愿选择;选…(而不选…)

ext.ext_cn: 这项政策未被采纳，取而代之的是一项较为谨慎的策略。
ext.ext_en: The policy was rejected in favour of a more cautious approach.

defs.def_en: If one thing is rejected in favour of another, the second thing is done or chosen instead of the first.
If someone or something is in favour, people like or support them. If they are out of favour, people no longer like or support them.

ext.ext_cn: 他向后靠了靠，闭上眼睛。
ext.ext_en: He lay back and closed his eyes.

defs.def_en: If you lie back, you relax and lower yourself from a sitting position so that you are resting on your back.

defs.def_cn: （尤指身体所需物质的）缺乏，缺少，不足

ext.ext_cn: 他们给他验了血，以检查是否有维生素缺乏的迹象。
ext.ext_en: They did blood tests on him for signs of vitamin deficiency...

ext.ext_cn: 符合要求的飞机数量严重不足。
ext.ext_en: There are serious deficiencies in the numbers of suitable aircraft.

defs.def_en: Deficiency in something, especially something that your body needs, is not having enough of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在空防上的严重缺陷
ext.ext_en: ...a serious deficiency in our air defence.

defs.def_en: A deficiency that someone or something has is a weakness or imperfection in them.
A piper is a musician who plays the bagpipes.

defs.def_cn: 谁出钱谁做主；花钱的人说了算
defs.def_en: If you say 'He who pays the piper' or 'He who pays the piper calls the tune', you mean that the person who provides the money for something decides what will be done, or has a right to decide what will be done.

ext.ext_cn: 他将一根根短棍木柴扔进巨大的石壁炉里。
ext.ext_en: He dumped the logs on the big stone hearth.

ext.ext_cn: 林肯诞生的原来那座原木小屋
ext.ext_en: ...the original log cabin where Lincoln was born.

defs.def_en: A log is a piece of a thick branch or of the trunk of a tree that has been cut so that it can be used for fuel or for making things.

ext.ext_cn: 这家人曾向船长正式投诉过，在航海日志里有记录。
ext.ext_en: The family made an official complaint to a ship's officer, which was recorded in the log.

defs.def_en: A log is an official written account of what happens each day, for example on board a ship.

defs.def_cn: （正式地）记载，记录（在纸上或计算机里）

ext.ext_cn: 进出这里的所有人和物他们都会记录。
ext.ext_en: They log everyone and everything that comes in and out of here...

ext.ext_cn: 随后会将罪案的详细情况录入到计算机里。
ext.ext_en: Details of the crime are then logged in the computer.

defs.def_en: If you log an event or fact, you record it officially in writing or on a computer.

ext.ext_cn: 他们为什么不甩开中间商，让我们自己干呢？
ext.ext_en: Why don't they cut out the middleman and let us do it ourselves?

defs.def_en: A  middleman is a person or company which buys things from the people who produce them and sells them to the people who want to buy them.

ext.ext_cn: 双方只会通过中间人间接接触。
ext.ext_en: The two sides would only meet indirectly, through middlemen.

defs.def_en: A middleman is a person who helps in negotiations between people who are unwilling to meet each other directly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 严重的;危急的;令人担忧的

ext.ext_cn: 犯罪猖獗是俄罗斯社会面临的一个日益严重的问题。
ext.ext_en: Crime is an increasingly serious problem in Russian society...

ext.ext_cn: 政府仍然面临着非常严峻的困难。
ext.ext_en: The government still face very serious difficulties...

defs.def_en: Serious problems or situations are very bad and cause people to be worried or afraid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 重要的;需要认真考虑的;严肃的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为这件事很重要。
ext.ext_en: I regard this as a serious matter...

ext.ext_cn: 小伙子，别笑，这很严肃。
ext.ext_en: Don't laugh boy. This is serious.

defs.def_en: Serious matters are important and deserve careful and thoughtful consideration.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我父母从未认真地正视过我的吸毒问题。
ext.ext_en: My parents never really faced up to my drug use in any serious way...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个值得认真考虑的问题。
ext.ext_en: It was a question which deserved serious consideration.

defs.def_en: When important matters are dealt with in a serious way, they are given careful and thoughtful consideration.

defs.def_cn: (音乐、文学作品)严肃的，非供消遣(或娱乐)的

ext.ext_cn: 严肃的古典音乐
ext.ext_en: ...serious classical music...

ext.ext_cn: 为一部大片写影评时，没必要像为一部严肃小说写书评那样认真谨慎。
ext.ext_en: There is no point reviewing a blockbuster as you might review a serious novel.

defs.def_en: Serious music or literature requires concentration to understand or appreciate it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 认真的;当真的;真心的;郑重其事的

ext.ext_cn: 你这话的确是发自内心的，是不是？
ext.ext_en: You really are serious about this, aren't you?...

ext.ext_cn: 我希望你不是认真的。
ext.ext_en: I hope you're not serious.

defs.def_en: If someone is serious about something, they are sincere about what they are saying, doing, or intending to do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人)若有所思的，庄重的，严肃的

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个非常一本正经的人。
ext.ext_en: He's quite a serious person...

ext.ext_cn: 她睁大眼睛若有所思地看着我。
ext.ext_en: She looked at me with big, serious eyes.

defs.def_en: Serious people are thoughtful and quiet, and do not laugh very often.

ext.ext_cn: 他在 60 年代才开始挣大钱。
ext.ext_en: He started earning serious money only in the sixties.

defs.def_en: Serious money is a very large amount of money.
Scurvy is a disease that is caused by a lack of vitamin C.

ext.ext_cn: 许多公司几乎别无选择，只能裁员。
ext.ext_en: Many firms have had little choice but to slim down.

ext.ext_cn: 精减煤炭从业人员的计划
ext.ext_en: ...the plan to slim down the coal industry.

defs.def_en: If a company or other organization slims down or is slimmed down, it employs fewer people, in order to save money or become more efficient.

defs.def_cn: （尤指伊斯兰教徒的）妻妾，女眷
defs.def_en: If a man, especially a Muslim, has several wives or sexual partners living in his house, they can be referred to as his harem.
A harem is a part of a building where a harem lives.

ext.ext_cn: 楼上有一家时尚的餐馆。
ext.ext_en: There is a smart restaurant on the upper floor...

ext.ext_cn: 学生坐廉价的下层舱，游客坐上层舱。
ext.ext_en: Students travel the cheap lower deck and tourists the upper.

defs.def_en: You use upper to describe something that is above something else.

ext.ext_cn: 脚面部分
ext.ext_en: ...the upper part of the foot.

ext.ext_cn: 上背部和胸部的肌肉
ext.ext_en: ...the muscles of the upper back and chest.

defs.def_en: You use upper to describe the higher part of something.

ext.ext_cn: 政府开始占上风。
ext.ext_en: The government was beginning to gain the upper hand...

ext.ext_cn: 不难看出谁占上风。
ext.ext_en: It was easy to see who had the upper hand.

defs.def_en: If you have the upper hand in a situation, you have more power than the other people involved and can make decisions about what happens.

ext.ext_cn: 穿合脚的、系带的软帮鞋。
ext.ext_en: Wear well-fitting, lace-up shoes with soft uppers...

ext.ext_cn: 皮革鞋帮使脚得以透气。
ext.ext_en: Leather uppers allow the feet to breathe.

defs.def_en: The upper of a shoe is the top part of it, which is attached to the sole and the heel.

ext.ext_cn: 酗酒、吸食可卡因、兴奋剂及镇静剂的人
ext.ext_en: ...people crazy on alcohol and cocaine and uppers and downers...

ext.ext_cn: 我吃了几片兴奋剂。
ext.ext_en: I'd taken a handful of uppers.

defs.def_en: Uppers are drugs that make you feel very happy, excited, and full of energy.

defs.def_cn: 酒后驾车者;醉酒驾驶者

ext.ext_cn: 醉酒驾车每周导致10人丧生。
ext.ext_en: Drink drivers cause ten deaths a week.

defs.def_en: A drink-driver is someone who drives after drinking more than the amount of alcohol that is legally allowed.

defs.def_cn: （尤指对年长者）敬仰，钦佩，仰慕

ext.ext_cn: 你很受大家欢迎，格雷丝，很多比你小的女孩子都很崇拜你。
ext.ext_en: You're a popular girl, Grace, and a lot of the younger ones look up to you.

defs.def_en: If you look up to someone, especially someone older than you, you respect and admire them.

ext.ext_cn: 皮特正在给他们讲一件他们母亲的趣闻。
ext.ext_en: Pete was telling them an anecdote about their mother...

ext.ext_cn: 他在记忆力和讲述趣闻轶事方面颇具天赋。
ext.ext_en: He has a talent for recollection and anecdote.

defs.def_en: An anecdote is a short, amusing account of something that has happened.

ext.ext_cn: 狐狸的害人精形象在传闻和民间故事中遭到严重的夸大。
ext.ext_en: The image of the fox as a pest is grossly exaggerated in anecdote and folklore.

defs.def_en: Anecdotes are individual accounts of something that are not reliable evidence.

ext.ext_cn: 法国警方确信她是被拷打致死。
ext.ext_en: French police are convinced that she was tortured and killed...

ext.ext_cn: 该团体中有三个人被拷打致死。
ext.ext_en: Three members of the group had been tortured to death…

defs.def_en: If someone is tortured, another person deliberately causes them great pain over a period of time, in order to punish them or to make them reveal information.

ext.ext_cn: 他不愿与她争辩，让她更痛苦。
ext.ext_en: He would not torture her further by trying to argue with her...

ext.ext_cn: 她想象着鲍勃和他的新女友在一起的情形，心里备受煎熬。
ext.ext_en: She tortured herself with fantasies of Bob and his new girlfriend.

defs.def_en: To torture someone means to cause them to suffer mental pain or anxiety.

defs.def_cn: 折磨;痛苦;苦恼;引起痛苦(或苦恼)的事物

ext.ext_cn: 等待结果的过程是一种折磨。
ext.ext_en: Waiting for the result was torture...

ext.ext_cn: 被单摩擦着他的皮肤，简直像是酷刑。
ext.ext_en: The friction of the sheets against his skin was torture…

defs.def_en: If you say that something is torture or a torture, you mean that it causes you great mental or physical suffering.

defs.def_cn: (软食或黏食的)一团，一勺，一块

ext.ext_cn: 一大勺奶油
ext.ext_en: ...a dollop of cream.

ext.ext_en: ...the artificial line that divides the city.

defs.def_en: If a border or line divides two areas or divides an area into two, it keeps the two areas separate from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 她在分裂保守党这件事上所起的作用比任何人都大。
ext.ext_en: She has done more to divide the Conservatives than anyone else...

ext.ext_cn: 民主党人就是否允许他加入他们的组织意见不一。
ext.ext_en: The democrats are divided over whether to admit him into their group...

defs.def_en: If people divide over something or if something divides them, it causes strong disagreement between them.

defs.def_cn: 明显差异;(常指引起争论的)分歧

ext.ext_cn: 故意在印度的印度教徒和穆斯林之间制造分歧的企图
ext.ext_en: ...a deliberate attempt to create a Hindu-Muslim divide in India.

defs.def_en: A divide is a significant distinction between two groups, often one that causes conflict.

ext.ext_cn: 是时候跨越形式与真理之间的巨大分界线了。
ext.ext_en: The time had come to cross the great divide between formality and truth.

defs.def_en: A divide is a moment in time or a point in a process when there is a complete change from one situation to another.
A divide is a line of high ground between areas that are drained by different rivers.

ext.ext_cn: 政府分而治之的政策只是加剧了该地区的不稳定性。
ext.ext_en: The government's policies of divide and rule have only contributed to the volatility of the region.

defs.def_en: You use divide and rule to refer to a policy which is intended to keep someone in a position of power by causing disagreements between people who might otherwise unite against them.

defs.def_cn: 再见（主要用于手机短信和电子邮件）
defs.def_en: L8R is the written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) 'later', mainly used in text messages and e-mails.

defs.def_cn: 虎头蛇尾地结束;草草收场

ext.ext_cn: 我们的关系无果而终了。
ext.ext_en: Our relationship fizzled into nothing.

ext.ext_cn: 由于司机复工，铁路罢工第二天就草草收场了。
ext.ext_en: The railway strike fizzled out on its second day as drivers returned to work.

defs.def_en: If something fizzles, it ends in a weak or disappointing way after starting off strongly.

defs.def_cn: 默认的;默许的;不言而喻的

ext.ext_cn: 问这个问题实际上等于默认确实出了差错。
ext.ext_en: The question was a tacit admission that a mistake had indeed been made...

ext.ext_cn: 反叛分子得到了军队中部分势力的暗中支持。
ext.ext_en: The rebels enjoyed the tacit support of elements in the army.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's tacit agreement or approval, you mean they are agreeing to something or approving it without actually saying so, often because they are unwilling to admit to doing so.

defs.def_cn: （某一团体或某类活动的）气质，精神特质，风气，思潮

ext.ext_cn: 该酒店的全部理念就是提供轻松的服务。
ext.ext_en: The whole ethos of the hotel is effortless service.

ext.ext_cn: 传统公共服务意识
ext.ext_en: ...the traditional public service ethos.

defs.def_en: An ethos is the set of ideas and attitudes that is associated with a particular group of people or a particular type of activity.

defs.def_cn: （尤指为共同做事）（使）成对，（使）配对

ext.ext_cn: 他们让我们与身边的人配对组成小组。
ext.ext_en: They asked us to pair up with the person next to us and form teams...

ext.ext_cn: 男人和少女结伴跳舞。
ext.ext_en: Men and teenage girls pair up to dance...

defs.def_en: If people pair up or are paired up, they form a pair, especially in order to do something together.

defs.def_cn: 灰色地带，中间区域（界线不明、责任不清、难以处理的领域或情形）

ext.ext_cn: 目前，关于赔偿的法律规定十分不明确。
ext.ext_en: At the moment, the law on compensation is very much a grey area.

ext.ext_cn: 介于蓝领工人和白领专业人士之间的中间地带
ext.ext_en: ...that gray area between blue-collar laborers and white-collar professionals.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as a grey area, you mean that it is unclear, for example because nobody is sure how to deal with it or who is responsible for it, or it falls between two separate categories of things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 热爱的；爱慕的；敬慕的；崇拜的

ext.ext_cn: 她仍然能吸引爱慕的观众。
ext.ext_en: She can still pull in adoring audiences.

defs.def_en: An adoring person is someone who loves and admires another person very much.

ext.ext_cn: 诺伍德中士申诉说这篇文章对他进行了诽谤。
ext.ext_en: Sgt Norwood complained that the article defamed him.

defs.def_en: If someone defames another person or thing, they say bad and untrue things about them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可行的；行不通的；办不成的

ext.ext_cn: 这种合作很有可能会行不通。
ext.ext_en: There is the strong possibility that such cooperation will prove unworkable...

ext.ext_cn: 美国政府对和平计划不满，认为它不可行。
ext.ext_en: Washington is unhappy with the peace plan which it views as unworkable.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a plan, law, or system as unworkable, you believe that it cannot be successful.

ext.ext_cn: 据说她的父母快要离婚了。
ext.ext_en: Her parents are rumoured to be on the verge of splitting up...

ext.ext_cn: 据说他曾在一家精神病院关过一段时间。
ext.ext_en: It was rumoured that he had been interned in an asylum for a while.

defs.def_en: If something is rumoured to be the case, people are suggesting that it is the case, but they do not know for certain.
You can use consumer society to refer to a society where people think that spending money on goods and services is very important.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 欢快的;高兴的;兴高采烈的

ext.ext_cn: 他们俩虽然感冒了，可都兴高采烈的。
ext.ext_en: They are both very cheerful in spite of their colds...

ext.ext_cn: 杰克好像对这个想法很高兴。
ext.ext_en: Jack sounded quite cheerful about the idea.

defs.def_en: Someone who is cheerful is happy and shows this in their behaviour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人愉快的;令人开心的

ext.ext_cn: 托儿所明亮宜人，还有许多玩具。
ext.ext_en: The nursery is bright and cheerful, with plenty of toys.

defs.def_en: Something that is cheerful is pleasant and makes you feel happy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 乐观的;开朗的;满不在乎的

ext.ext_cn: 没有多少证据能支持威尔先生的那些乐观设想。
ext.ext_en: There is little evidence to support many of Mr Will's cheerful assumptions.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's attitude as cheerful, you mean they are not worried about something, and you think that they should be.

defs.def_cn: 过时的观点;陈旧的原则;错误的信念

ext.ext_cn: 是时候摆脱那些传统力量无法遏制的陈规陋习了。
ext.ext_en: It is time to go beyond the shibboleth that conventional forces cannot deter.

defs.def_en: If you describe an idea or belief as a shibboleth, you mean that it is thought important by a group of people but may be old-fashioned or wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 克拉克还向党内的批评人士伸出了橄榄枝。
ext.ext_en: Clarke also offered an olive branch to critics in his party.

defs.def_en: If you offer an olive branch to someone, you say or do something in order to show that you want to end a disagreement or quarrel.

ext.ext_cn: 这家小旅馆里有一个亚热带植物园。
ext.ext_en: The inn has a garden of semi-tropical vegetation.

ext.ext_cn: 一股植物轻微腐烂的味道
ext.ext_en: ...a smell of gently-rotting vegetation.

defs.def_en: Plants, trees, and flowers can be referred to as vegetation .
Penny shares are shares that are offered for sale at a low price.
Facing is fabric which is stitched inside the edges of a piece of clothing in order to make them look neat and strengthen them.

defs.def_cn: (夹克或大衣领口和袖口的)镶边，贴边
defs.def_en: The facings of a garment such as a jacket or coat are the parts around the neck and wrists when they are made of a different fabric from the main part, or are a different colour.
A facing on a wall is a layer of stone, concrete, or other material that is spread over its surface in order to make it look attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 与形容词，名词构成的词
defs.def_cn: (用于构词)表示“靠自身的”，“由自身的”，“对自身的”

ext.ext_cn: 他自称是种族主义者。
ext.ext_en: He is a self-proclaimed racist.

ext.ext_cn: 自残行为
ext.ext_en: ...self-destructive behaviour...

defs.def_en: Self- is used to form words which indicate that you do something to yourself or by yourself.

defs.pos_cn: 与形容词，名词构成的词
defs.def_cn: (用于构词)表示“自动的”，“自行的”

ext.ext_cn: 自动上膛的手枪
ext.ext_en: ...a self-loading pistol.

defs.def_en: Self- is used to form words which describe something such as a device that does something automatically by itself.
A leaseholder is a person who is allowed to use a property according to the terms of a lease.

defs.def_cn: 作出决定;确定（采取某种行动）

ext.ext_cn: 我们还没有针对改组作出任何决定。我们既没有排除也没有确定任何可能的选择。
ext.ext_en: We have made no decisions on restructuring yet. We are ruling nothing out and we are ruling nothing in...

ext.ext_cn: 正如我说过的，我们必须注意不要肯定或否定任何一种解决方案。
ext.ext_en: We must, as I said, take care not to rule in or rule out any one solution.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are not ruling in a particular course of action, you mean that you have not definitely decided to take that action.
Do-it-yourself is the same as DIY .

defs.def_cn: （商店）出售自己动手做所需物品的

ext.ext_cn: 你可以在自己动手做商店里买到所有这些工具。
ext.ext_en: You can buy all these tools at a do-it-yourself store.

defs.def_en: A do-it-yourself shop is one that sells tools, paint, and other equipment needed for DIY.

ext.ext_cn: 自制的架子
ext.ext_en: ...do-it-yourself shelving.

defs.def_en: Do-it-yourself things are things that you make or do yourself, rather than buying them ready-made or paying someone else to make them or do them.

ext.ext_cn: 日本4家最大的代理公司
ext.ext_en: ...Japan's four biggest brokerages.

defs.def_en: A brokerage or a brokerage firm is a company of brokers.

defs.def_cn: （经纪人收取的）佣金，中介费，提成
defs.def_en: A brokerage fee or commission is the money charged by a broker for his or her services.

ext.ext_cn: 这种癌症和遗传无关。
ext.ext_en: Heredity is not a factor in causing the cancer.

defs.def_en: Heredity is the process by which features and characteristics are passed on from parents to their children before the children are born.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （情形）没有希望的，前景暗淡的

ext.ext_cn: 近期前景依然暗淡。
ext.ext_en: The immediate outlook remains bleak...

ext.ext_cn: 很多人都预测前景暗淡。
ext.ext_en: Many predicted a bleak future.

defs.def_en: If a situation is bleak, it is bad, and seems unlikely to improve.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这座岛屿一片荒凉。
ext.ext_en: The island's pretty bleak.

ext.ext_cn: 凄清的旧城区街道
ext.ext_en: ...bleak inner-city streets.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as bleak, you mean that it looks cold, empty, and unattractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 沿海地区的天气会非常阴冷。
ext.ext_en: The weather can be quite bleak on the coast.

defs.def_en: When the weather is bleak, it is cold, dull, and unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人）无精打采的，沮丧的，阴郁的

ext.ext_cn: 他脸色阴郁。
ext.ext_en: His face was bleak...

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔伯格沮丧地凝视着他。
ext.ext_en: Alberg gave him a bleak stare.

defs.def_en: If someone looks or sounds bleak, they look or sound depressed, as if they have no hope or energy.

ext.ext_cn: 专家们普遍认为饮食和健康总体状况密切相关。
ext.ext_en: Experts generally agree that diet has an important bearing on your general health...

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲的成就与我做的事情真的毫无关联。
ext.ext_en: My father's achievements really don't have any bearing on what I do.

defs.def_en: If something has a bearing on a situation or event, it is relevant to it.

ext.ext_cn: 后来她以饱含热情的笔触写到了他的举止和行为。
ext.ext_en: She later wrote warmly of his bearing and behaviour.

defs.def_en: Someone's bearing is the way in which they move or stand.
If you take a bearing with a compass, you use it to work out the direction in which a particular place lies or in which something is moving.

defs.def_cn: 清楚/不清楚所在方位；知道/不知道下一步怎么做

ext.ext_cn: 市区观光游也包含在内，帮助你熟悉一下这里的情况。
ext.ext_en: A sightseeing tour of the city is included to help you get your bearings...

ext.ext_cn: 管理之差从昨天发生的事情就可见一斑了。
ext.ext_en: How badly the administration had lost its bearings was underlined by what happened yesterday.

defs.def_en: If you get your bearings or find your bearings, you find out where you are or what you should do next. If you lose your bearings, you do not know where you are or what you should do next.

ext.ext_cn: 换了一个油封和两个前轮轴承。
ext.ext_en: An oil seal was replaced, along with both front wheel bearings.

defs.def_en: See also:ball bearing;Bearings are small metal balls that are placed between moving parts of a machine in order to make them move smoothly and easily over each other.

ext.ext_cn: 通常父母会申请几个学校，而且如果必要的话会将就接受第四或第五个选择。
ext.ext_en: Typically, parents apply to several schools and settle, if need be, for their fourth or fifth choice…

ext.ext_cn: 一般需要一到两天，取决于其规模。
ext.ext_en: It typically takes a day or two, depending on size...

defs.def_en: You use typically to say that something usually happens in the way that you are describing.

ext.ext_cn: 主菜是地道的瑞士菜。
ext.ext_en: The main course was typically Swiss…

ext.ext_cn: 菲利普在地板上踱来踱去，一副典型的神经紧张的准爸爸形象。
ext.ext_en: Philip paced the floor, a typically nervous expectant father.

defs.def_en: You use typically to say that something shows all the most usual characteristics of a particular type of person or thing.

defs.def_cn: 一贯地;一向如此地;不出所料地

ext.ext_cn: 像往常一样，挪威人比其他所有人都提前两小时进山。
ext.ext_en: Typically, the Norwegians were on the mountain two hours before anyone else...

ext.ext_cn: 罗宾斯在发表有关个人前途的声明时表现出一贯的冷静。
ext.ext_en: Robbins is typically cool in his pronouncements about his future.

defs.def_en: You use typically to indicate that someone has behaved in the way that they normally do.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以把机器连在高保真音响上。
ext.ext_en: You can connect the machine to your hi-fi...

ext.ext_cn: 传统的办法是晚上进入电话局，把线连上。
ext.ext_en: The traditional method is to enter the exchanges at night and connect the wires...

defs.def_en: If something or someone connects one thing to another, or if one thing connects to another, the two things are joined together.

defs.def_cn: 使连接，使接通(电源、水源等)

ext.ext_cn: 这些家用电器不应该接通电源。
ext.ext_en: These appliances should not be connected to power supplies...

ext.ext_cn: 伊斯基亚这时已经通上了大陆的水。
ext.ext_en: Ischia was now connected to the mainland water supply.

defs.def_en: If a piece of equipment or a place is connected to a source of power or water, it is joined to that source so that it has power or water.

ext.ext_cn: 呼叫警察、救护车或消防队，请拨打999，接线员会为您接通电话。
ext.ext_en: To call the police, an ambulance or the fire brigade dial 999 and the operator will connect you...

ext.ext_cn: 他请求接到总机。
ext.ext_en: He asked to be connected to the central switchboard.

defs.def_en: If a telephone operator connects you, he or she enables you to speak to another person by telephone.

ext.ext_cn: 连接各个房间的长过道
ext.ext_en: ...the long hallway that connects the rooms...

ext.ext_cn: 输卵管连接着卵巢和子宫。
ext.ext_en: The fallopian tubes connect the ovaries with the uterus...

defs.def_en: If two things or places connect or if something connects them, they are joined and people or things can pass between them.

ext.ext_cn: 与开往爱尔兰的渡船联运的火车
ext.ext_en: ...a train connecting with a ferry to Ireland...

ext.ext_cn: 我搭乘的联运航班又过了6个小时才起飞。
ext.ext_en: My connecting plane didn't depart for another six hours.

defs.def_en: If one train or plane, for example, connects with another, it arrives at a time which allows passengers to change to the other one in order to continue their journey.

ext.ext_cn: 想换乘长途航班的商务旅行者
ext.ext_en: ...business travellers wanting to connect to a long-haul flight...

ext.ext_cn: 那样时间会有富余，你可以换乘7点的“协和”式客机。
ext.ext_en: That will connect you with time to spare for the seven o'clock Concorde.

defs.def_en: If you connect to a particular plane or train, or if another plane or train connects you to it, you change to that plane or train from another one in order to continue your journey.

ext.ext_cn: 我希望他不会把我和我7年前写的那篇现在看来令人难堪的评论联系起来。
ext.ext_en: I hoped he would not connect me with that now-embarrassing review I'd written seven years earlier...

ext.ext_cn: 我就不会把这两件事联系起来。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't have connected the two things.

defs.def_en: If you connect a person or thing with something, you realize that there is a link or relationship between them.

ext.ext_cn: 对布雷迪住所的搜查没有发现任何能证明他与这些抢劫案有关的东西。
ext.ext_en: A search of Brady's house revealed nothing that could connect him with the robberies...

ext.ext_cn: 他们之间有什么联系？
ext.ext_en: What connects them?

defs.def_en: Something that connects a person or thing with something else shows or provides a link or relationship between them.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你站在舞台上，分享自己对世界的看法，人们会与你产生共鸣的。
ext.ext_en: If you stand on stage and share your view of the world, people will connect with you.

defs.def_en: If you connect with someone, you feel a sense of agreement and familiarity with them because you have the same kind of ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 他上楼换上干净衣服。
ext.ext_en: He went upstairs and changed into fresh clothes...

ext.ext_cn: 我走上楼去，打开前门的锁。

defs.def_en: If you go upstairs in a building, you go up a staircase towards a higher floor.

ext.ext_cn: 饭店在楼上，有一个宽敞的开间。
ext.ext_en: The restaurant is upstairs and consists of a large, open room...

ext.ext_cn: 男孩们蜷缩在楼上的小卧室里睡熟了。
ext.ext_en: The boys are curled asleep in the small bedroom upstairs.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is upstairs in a building, they are on a floor that is higher than the ground floor.

ext.ext_cn: 马萨尼搬进了楼上的公寓里。
ext.ext_en: Marsani moved into the upstairs apartment.

ext.ext_cn: 楼上的阳台
ext.ext_en: ...an upstairs balcony.

defs.def_en: An upstairs room or object is situated on a floor of a building that is higher than the ground floor.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一起走过各层楼。
ext.ext_en: Together we went through the upstairs...

ext.ext_cn: 弗朗西丝邀请他们住在她家的楼上。
ext.ext_en: Frances invited them to occupy the upstairs of her home.

defs.def_en: The upstairs of a building is the floor or floors that are higher than the ground floor.

ext.ext_cn: 他赢得了“反叛牧师”的称号。
ext.ext_en: He  earned the appellation 'rebel priest.'

defs.def_en: An appellation is a name or title that a person, place, or thing is given.

ext.ext_cn: 雪已经融化了，但是湖面上仍然冻得结结实实的。
ext.ext_en: The snow had melted, but the lake was still frozen solid...

ext.ext_en: Meanwhile, melt the white chocolate in a bowl suspended over simmering water...

ext.ext_cn: 他对未知结果的焦虑消散了，这种焦虑过后还会袭上心头，但至少现在还没有。
ext.ext_en: His anxiety about the outcome melted, to return later but not yet...

ext.ext_cn: 他本欲作一番挣扎，却已力不从心。
ext.ext_en: He would have struggled but his strength had melted.

ext.ext_en: The youths dispersed and melted into the darkness...

ext.ext_en: The squadron's armour is draped in sand-coloured nets that melt into the landscape.
