ext.ext_cn: 试图在某些少数民族地区限制生育可能会引起问题。
ext.ext_en: Attempts to limit family size among some minorities are likely to cause problems...

ext.ext_cn: 这是好心办错事，可是确实让我担心了一阵子。
ext.ext_en: This was a genuine mistake, but it did cause me some worry.

defs.def_en: To cause something, usually something bad, means to make it happen.

ext.ext_cn: 只有少数几个人能找到庆祝的理由。
ext.ext_en: Only a few people can find any cause for celebration...

ext.ext_cn: 双方都有充分的理由对英国政府的行事隐秘深表感激。
ext.ext_en: Both had much cause to be grateful for the secretiveness of government in Britain.

defs.def_en: If you have cause for a particular feeling or action, you have good reasons for feeling it or doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 拒绝推举一名领导者对此项事业毫无帮助。
ext.ext_en: Refusing to have one leader has not helped the cause.

defs.def_en: lost cause;A cause is an aim or principle which a group of people supports or is fighting for.

ext.ext_cn: 生物学上因果关系的根本法则
ext.ext_en: ...fundamental laws of biological cause and effect.

defs.def_en: You use cause and effect to talk about the way in which one thing is caused by another.

defs.def_cn: (为了特定目的)与…联手，与…配合

ext.ext_cn: 他们因为几个目的而联手，可是多数情况下，他们追逐着各自的利益。
ext.ext_en: They make common cause for a few purposes, but for the most part, they pursue their own interests.

defs.def_en: If one group of people makes common cause with another, they act together in order to achieve a particular aim even though their aims and beliefs are normally very different.

defs.def_cn: 为了公益事业;为了行善

ext.ext_cn: 想要为公益事业筹集资金的人都可以参加雷利国际自行车比赛。
ext.ext_en: The Raleigh International Bike Ride is open to anyone who wants to raise money for a good cause.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is in a good cause or for a good cause, you mean that it is worth doing or giving to because it will help other people, for example by raising money for charity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人毛骨悚然的；让人深感恐惧的

ext.ext_cn: 令人不寒而栗的故事
ext.ext_en: ...blood-curdling tales.

ext.ext_cn: 让人胆战心惊的战场上的喊杀声
ext.ext_en: ... a bloodcurdling battle cry.

defs.def_en: A blood-curdling sound or story is very frightening and horrible.

ext.ext_cn: “那件衣服很好看，”迈克尔说。“谢谢，”她严肃地回答。
ext.ext_en: 'That's a nice dress,' said Michael. 'Thanks,' she replied solemnly...

ext.ext_cn: 他回复说这是绝对不可能的。
ext.ext_en: He replied that this was absolutely impossible...

defs.def_en: When you reply to something that someone has said or written to you, you say or write an answer to them.

ext.ext_cn: 我提出挑战，但是没人回应。
ext.ext_en: I called out a challenge, but there was no reply...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维的广告已经有12条回复了。
ext.ext_en: David has had 12 replies to his ad...

defs.def_en: A reply is something that you say or write when you answer someone or answer a letter or advertisement.

defs.def_cn: (在体育比赛中)以得分回应，回敬，

ext.ext_cn: 格雷姆·希克未出局拿得58分，从而使伍斯特郡队以132分3人出局的成绩回敬了米德尔塞克斯队的202分。
ext.ext_en: Graeme Hick scored an unbeaten 58 as Worcestershire replied to Middlesex's 202 with 132-3...

ext.ext_cn: 德里克·福克斯在上半场的罚球使费瑟斯通队领先，但是圣徒队很快进行了反击。
ext.ext_en: Deryck Fox gave Featherstone the lead early in the first half with a penalty, but Saints were quick to reply.

defs.def_en: In sports, if you reply to a goal or a number of points scored by your opponents, you also score a goal or a number of points.

ext.ext_cn: 农民向警察扔鸡蛋和空瓶子，警察则以催泪弹回击。
ext.ext_en: Farmers threw eggs and empty bottles at police, who replied with tear gas...

ext.ext_cn: 民族救亡阵线已经组织了示威，以此回击反对派的一系列活动。
ext.ext_en: The National Salvation Front has already replied to this series of opposition moves with its own demonstrations.

defs.def_en: If you reply to something such as an attack with violence or with another action, you do something in response.
An electoral roll is the same as an electoral register .

defs.def_cn: 对（费用、汇率等）定价过高

ext.ext_cn: 对英镑不作高估的比率
ext.ext_en: ...a rate which does not overvalue the pound...

ext.ext_cn: 很多，也许是所有的网络股都被大大高估了。
ext.ext_en: Many, perhaps all, Internet stocks are hugely overvalued.

defs.def_en: To overvalue something, often a cost or rate of exchange, means to fix its value at too high a level compared with other similar things.

defs.def_cn: 使困惑；使糊涂；使不知所措

ext.ext_cn: 亚历克斯的沉默伤害了她，让她不知所措。
ext.ext_en: The silence from Alex had hurt and bewildered her.

defs.def_en: If something bewilders you, it is so confusing or difficult that you cannot understand it.

ext.ext_cn: 不少企业集团一直在向联邦储备委员会施压，要求其放松利率管制。
ext.ext_en: Many business groups have been pressing the Federal Reserve to loosen interest rates...

ext.ext_cn: 钻探条例亦已放宽，以加速油田的开发。
ext.ext_en: Drilling regulations, too, have been loosened to speed the development of the fields.

defs.def_en: If someone loosens restrictions or laws, for example, they make them less strict or severe.

ext.ext_cn: 联邦共和国必须疏远其与美国的关系。
ext.ext_en: The Federal Republic must loosen its ties with the United States...

ext.ext_cn: 该政党的二把手对疏远与工会之间关系一事态度谨慎。
ext.ext_en: The deputy leader is cautious about loosening the links with the unions...

defs.def_en: If someone or something loosens the ties between people or groups of people, or  if the ties loosen, they become weaker.

ext.ext_cn: 他伸手松了松脖子上的围巾。
ext.ext_en: He reached up to loosen the scarf around his neck...

ext.ext_cn: 松一松插销，好转动门闩。
ext.ext_en: Loosen the bolt so the bars can be turned...

defs.def_en: If you loosen your clothing or something that is tied or fastened or if it loosens, you undo it slightly so that it is less tight or less firmly held in place.

ext.ext_cn: 在鸡胸上方插进一把小刀，以使鸡皮不要绷得太紧。
ext.ext_en: Insert a small knife into the top of the chicken breast to loosen the skin.

defs.def_en: If you loosen something that is stretched across something else, you make it less stretched or tight.

ext.ext_cn: 哈里的手稍一放松，安娜便挣脱出来。
ext.ext_en: Harry loosened his grip momentarily and Anna wriggled free...

ext.ext_cn: 他紧抓她的手松了一下，她便抽身而出。
ext.ext_en: When his grip loosened she eased herself away.

defs.def_en: If you loosen your grip on something, or if your grip loosens, you hold it less tightly.

ext.ext_cn: 没有迹象显示该党会放松对国家的严密控制。
ext.ext_en: There is no sign that the Party will loosen its tight grip on the country...

ext.ext_cn: 苏联对东欧的控制已经放松。
ext.ext_en: The Soviet Union's grip on Eastern Europe loosened.

defs.def_en: If a government or organization loosens its grip on a group of people or an activity, or if its grip loosens, it begins to have less control over it.

ext.ext_cn: 酒一下肚，他便打开了话匣。
ext.ext_en: The wine had loosened his tongue.

defs.def_en: If you say that something has loosened someone's tongue, you mean that it has made them talk about something, often when they should have remained silent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有些人认为我是个性情暴躁的老头。
ext.ext_en: Some folk think I'm a grumpy old man.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is grumpy, you mean that they are bad-tempered and miserable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 罗丝说到目前为止她的婚姻并不令人满意。
ext.ext_en: Rose says so far the marriage has been unsatisfying...

ext.ext_cn: 不幸福的家庭生活和失业都会导致心生倦怠。
ext.ext_en: The boredom is caused as much by people's unsatisfying home lives as by lack of work.

defs.def_en: If you find something unsatisfying, you do not get any satisfaction from it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (因求而不得)失意的，伤感的，惆怅的

ext.ext_cn: 我不禁对自己将要放弃的津贴感到有点儿不舍。
ext.ext_en: I can't help feeling slightly wistful about the perks I'm giving up...

ext.ext_cn: 他神情沮丧。
ext.ext_en: He has a wistful look.

defs.def_en: Someone who is wistful is rather sad because they want something and know that they cannot have it.
A punt is a long boat with a flat bottom. You move the boat along by standing at one end and pushing a long pole against the bottom of the river.

ext.ext_cn: 我们乘坐平底长船溯河而上到格兰切斯特，在草地上举行野餐。
ext.ext_en: We punted up towards Grantchester and had a picnic in a meadow.

defs.def_en: When you punt, you travel along a river in a punt.

defs.def_cn: 爱尔兰镑（爱尔兰共和国使用欧元前的货币单位）

ext.ext_cn: 去哈瓦那的往返票价是550爱尔兰镑（673美元）。
ext.ext_en: The round-trip fare to Havana is 550 Irish punts ($673).

ext.ext_cn: 保护爱尔兰镑、打击投机商所付出的代价
ext.ext_en: ...the cost of defending the punt against speculators.

defs.def_en: The punt was the unit of money used in the Republic of Ireland before it was replaced by the euro.

defs.def_cn: （橄榄球或美式足球中的）碰踢，弃踢，落踢

ext.ext_cn: 他接住对方的弃踢球，成功达阵，取得了制胜得分，此时比赛只剩最后一分钟。
ext.ext_en: He caught a punt and scored the winning touchdown, with a minute left to play.

ext.ext_cn: 一个66码的凌空回踢
ext.ext_en: ...a 66-yard punt return

defs.def_en: In rugby and American football, a punt is a kick where you drop the ball and then kick it before it reaches the ground, so that it goes a long way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 两名运动员一直在忍受轻微的伤痛。
ext.ext_en: Both players have been suffering from niggling injuries.

ext.ext_cn: 对廉价轿车会麻烦不断的一丝担忧
ext.ext_en: ...a niggling worry that the cheap car is also the one that will cause endless trouble.

defs.def_en: A niggling injury or worry is small but bothers you over a long period of time.
A waistcoat is a sleeveless piece of clothing with buttons which people usually wear over a shirt.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Someone who is inattentive is not paying complete attention to a person or thing, which often causes an accident or problems.

ext.ext_cn: 法国空中交通管制员因为薪资纠纷已开始了为期 3 天的罢工。
ext.ext_en: French air traffic controllers have begun a three-day strike in a dispute over pay...

ext.ext_cn: 医院员工举行罢工，抗议这几起事件。
ext.ext_en: Staff at the hospital went on strike in protest at the incidents.

defs.def_en: When there is a strike, workers stop doing their work for a period of time, usually in order to try to get better pay or conditions for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 他们对工人罢工权的认同
ext.ext_en: ...their recognition of the workers' right to strike...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不该为了得到更多的钱而罢工。
ext.ext_en: They shouldn't be striking for more money...

defs.def_en: When workers strike, they go on strike.

ext.ext_cn: 她向前紧走两步，上去扇了他一嘴巴。
ext.ext_en: She took two quick steps forward and struck him across the mouth...

ext.ext_cn: 他将球直接打进迎宾帐篷里。
ext.ext_en: He struck the ball straight into the hospitality tents...

defs.def_en: If you strike someone or something, you deliberately hit them.

ext.ext_cn: 他一头扎进 6 英尺深的游泳池时头撞到池底了。
ext.ext_en: His head struck the bottom when he dived into the 6ft end of the pool...

ext.ext_cn: 一枚 16 英寸的炮弹击中了指挥塔台。
ext.ext_en: One 16-inch shell struck the control tower...

defs.def_en: If something that is falling or moving strikes something, it hits it.

ext.ext_cn: 怀尔德摔倒了，头撞在石头地上。
ext.ext_en: Wilde fell and struck his head on the stone floor...

ext.ext_cn: 我的右脚趾踢到水下的一块石头上了。
ext.ext_en: My right toe struck against a submerged rock.

defs.def_en: If you strike one thing against another, or if one thing strikes against another, the first thing hits the second thing.

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰银行官员仍然坚持说英镑不久就会恢复稳定，但结果灾难爆发了。
ext.ext_en: Bank of England officials continued to insist that the pound would soon return to stability but disaster struck...

ext.ext_cn: 他们两个都得了一种罕见的遗传病，这种病在他们30 多岁时发作。
ext.ext_en: Both of them were afflicted with a rare genetic disease, which struck in their thirties...

defs.def_en: If something such as an illness or disaster strikes, it suddenly happens.

ext.ext_cn: 她行走到莫纳卡拉的一个居民区附近时遭人攻击。
ext.ext_en: The attacker struck as she was walking near a housing estate at Monacurra...

ext.ext_cn: 凶手称他还会再次下手。
ext.ext_en: The killer says he will strike again...

defs.def_en: To strike means to attack someone or something quickly and violently.

ext.ext_cn: 惩罚性空袭
ext.ext_en: ...a punitive air strike.

ext.ext_cn: 核武器攻击
ext.ext_en: ...a nuclear strike.

defs.def_en: A military strike is a military attack, especially an air attack.

defs.def_cn: 直击(要害);与…起(原则性)冲突

ext.ext_cn: 对她的核心信念和价值观的否定，也就否定了她存在的根本
ext.ext_en: ...a rejection of her core beliefs and values, which strikes at the very heart of her being...

ext.ext_cn: 该问题直指我们社会的根基。
ext.ext_en: The issue strikes at the very foundation of our community.

defs.def_en: If something strikes at the heart or root of something, it attacks or conflicts with the basic elements or principles of that thing.

defs.def_cn: 突然想到，猛地意识到，一下子想起(想法或念头)

ext.ext_cn: 她猛地冒出一个念头：那么难道她在嫉妒母亲吗？
ext.ext_en: A thought struck her. Was she jealous of her mother, then?...

ext.ext_cn: 在这一刻，我突然意识到自己是在浪费时间。
ext.ext_en: At this point, it suddenly struck me that I was wasting my time.

defs.def_en: If an idea or thought strikes you, it suddenly comes into your mind.

ext.ext_cn: 他让我感觉他是一个十分严肃但友好的人。
ext.ext_en: He struck me as a very serious but friendly person...

ext.ext_cn: 让我觉得很有意思的是我们经常以衣取人。
ext.ext_en: What struck me as interesting is how much we judge other people by the clothes they wear...

defs.def_en: If something strikes you as being a particular thing, it gives you the impression of being that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 她被他那率直、富有鼓动性的口才迷住了。
ext.ext_en: She was struck by his simple, spellbinding eloquence...

ext.ext_cn: 特蕾莎强烈意识到自己事先太欠考虑了。
ext.ext_en: Theresa was struck by her own lack of forethought...

defs.def_en: If you are struck by something, you think it is very impressive, noticeable, or interesting.

ext.ext_cn: 他们同纸张供应商达成协议，可赊购两年的新闻用纸。
ext.ext_en: They struck a deal with their paper supplier, getting two years of newsprint on credit...

ext.ext_cn: 两个人达成协议，伦德尔获得相当于经理所得的一半。
ext.ext_en: The two struck a deal in which Rendell took half of what a manager would...

defs.def_en: If you strike a deal or a bargain with someone, you come to an agreement with them.

defs.def_cn: 达到(两全其美);找到(折中的办法)

ext.ext_cn: 在这种情形下你得在休息和做作业之间找到一种平衡。
ext.ext_en: At times like that you have to strike a balance between sleep and homework.

defs.def_en: If you strike a balance, you do something that is halfway between two extremes.

ext.ext_cn: 她摆了个姿势，一只手叉腰，另一只手夹着一支假想的香烟。
ext.ext_en: She struck a pose, one hand on her hip and the other waving an imaginary cigarette.

defs.def_en: If you strike a pose or attitude, you put yourself in a particular position, for example when someone is taking your photograph.

ext.ext_cn: 如果只有一样东西定能让父母感到恐惧，那就是毒品。
ext.ext_en: If there is a single subject guaranteed to strike fear in the hearts of parents, it is drugs.

defs.def_en: If something strikes fear into people, it makes them very frightened or anxious.

defs.def_cn: 使顿时(看不见或说不出)

ext.ext_cn: 这让我吃惊得说不出话来，我不得不仔细考虑一会儿。
ext.ext_en: I was struck dumb by this and had to think it over for a moment...

ext.ext_cn: 由于揭露此事，他被女神赫拉弄瞎了眼。
ext.ext_en: For this revelation he was struck blind by the goddess Hera.

defs.def_en: If you are struck dumb or blind, you suddenly become unable to speak or to see.

ext.ext_cn: 钟敲了 9 下。
ext.ext_en: The clock struck nine...

ext.ext_cn: 最后，钟敲响了。
ext.ext_en: Finally, the clock strikes.

defs.def_en: When a clock strikes, its bells make a sound to indicate what the time is.

ext.ext_cn: 从备忘录中将之删去。
ext.ext_en: Strike that from the minutes...

ext.ext_cn: 她所取得的成就被从档案中删去了。
ext.ext_en: Her achievements were struck from the record book.

defs.def_en: If you strike words from a document or an official record, you remove them.

ext.ext_cn: 罗比娜划着一根火柴去点壁炉里揉皱的报纸。
ext.ext_en: Robina struck a match and held it to the crumpled newspaper in the grate.

defs.def_en: When you strike a match, you make it produce a flame by moving it quickly against something rough.

ext.ext_cn: 汉密尔顿石油公司宣布其已在爱尔兰海域的利物浦海湾地区开采出石油。
ext.ext_en: Hamilton Oil announced that it had struck oil in the Liverpool Bay area of the Irish Sea.

defs.def_en: If someone strikes oil or gold, they discover it in the ground as a result of mining or drilling.

ext.ext_cn: 专门为他铸造了另一枚奖章。
ext.ext_en: Another medal was specially struck for him.

defs.def_en: When a coin or medal is struck, it is made.

ext.ext_cn: 该旅馆有两个缺点。其一，它是个非常难看的大型混凝土建筑。其二，它位于一个相当偏僻的地段。
ext.ext_en: The Hotel has two strikes against it. One, it's an immense ugly concrete building. Second,  it lies in a rather awkward position...

ext.ext_cn: 我出狱后找不到任何工作，曾经服过刑的身份对我很不利。
ext.ext_en: When I got out I couldn't find any work, and for being an ex-con, that was a strike against me.

defs.def_en: If someone has two strikes against them, things cause them to be in a bad situation or at a disadvantage.

ext.ext_cn: 我相信我们即将达成协议。
ext.ext_en: I believe we are within striking distance of an agreement...

ext.ext_cn: 机场近在咫尺，西行不到 60 英里即到。
ext.ext_en: The airport was within striking distance: no more than sixty miles to the west.

defs.def_en: If you are within striking distance of something, or if something is within striking distance, it is quite near, so it could be reached or achieved quite easily.

defs.def_cn: 打开成功(或财富)之门;踏上通往成功(或财富)之路

ext.ext_cn: 该公司凭借其新开发的“中央公园”度假村而赚了个盆满钵满。
ext.ext_en: The company has struck gold with its new holiday development, Center Parcs.

defs.def_en: If you strike gold, you find, do, or produce something that brings you a lot of money or success.

ext.ext_cn: 他希望通过投资人参发大财。
ext.ext_en: He hoped to strike it rich by investing in ginseng.

defs.def_en: If you strike it rich, you make a lot of money, especially in a short time.

defs.def_cn: 硬通货，强势货币（指价值稳定的货币）

ext.ext_cn: 政府目前缺少可以支付进口产品的硬通货。
ext.ext_en: The government is running short of hard currency to pay for imports.

defs.def_en: A hard currency is one which is unlikely to lose its value and so is considered to be a good one to have or to invest in.

ext.ext_cn: 如果事先稍微多想想，许多事故是可以避免的。
ext.ext_en: With a little forethought many accidents could be avoided.

defs.def_en: If you act with forethought, you think carefully before you act about what will be needed, or about what the consequences will be.

defs.def_cn: (尤指通过借钱)帮助…渡过难关

ext.ext_cn: 他需要钱来渡过难关。
ext.ext_en: He wanted money to tide him over...

ext.ext_cn: 银行准备拿出5,000万欧元帮助那家公司摆脱困境。
ext.ext_en: The banks were prepared to put up 50 million euros to tide over the company.

defs.def_en: If you do something for someone to tide them over, you help them through a period when they are having difficulties, especially by lending them money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Lyle, I'm sure, would have had a very tart comment to make about this new social trend.

defs.def_en: If someone refers to a woman or girl as a tart, they are criticizing her because they think she is sexually immoral or dresses in a way that makes her look sexually immoral.

ext.ext_en: She was especially fond of a little girl named Betsy.

defs.def_en: If you are fond of someone, you feel affection for them.

ext.ext_en: He gave him a fond smile.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她喜欢收集稀罕少见的地毯。
ext.ext_en: She is fond of collecting rare carpets.

defs.def_en: If you are fond of something, you like it or you like doing it very much.

ext.ext_en: I have very fond memories of living in our village.

defs.def_en: If you have fond memories of someone or something, you remember them with pleasure.

ext.ext_en: My fond hope is that we will be ready by Christmastime.

defs.def_en: You use fond to describe hopes, wishes, or beliefs which you think are foolish because they seem unlikely to be fulfilled.

ext.ext_en: ...dramatic eyewitness accounts of the fighting.

ext.ext_cn: 电视机用一个床罩严严实实地盖住了。
ext.ext_en: The television was sheathed in a snug coverlet.

ext.ext_en: ...her long legs, sheathed in sheer black tights.

defs.def_en: If something is sheathed in a material or other covering, it is closely covered with it.

ext.ext_en: He sheathed the knife and strapped it to his shin.

ext.ext_en: ...a long and bitter feud between the state government and the villagers.

defs.def_en: A feud is a quarrel in which two people or groups remain angry with each other for a long time, although they are not always fighting or arguing.

ext.ext_en: He feuded with his ex-wife...

ext.ext_en: Their families had feuded since their teenage daughters quarrelled two years ago.

defs.def_en: If one person or group feuds with another, they have a quarrel that lasts a long time. You can also say that two people or groups feud .

ext.ext_cn: 严重的管理不善和资金浪费
ext.ext_en: ...gross mismanagement and financial extravagance...

ext.ext_cn: 公司破产后，有关他铺张浪费的种种传闻传遍了整个行业。
ext.ext_en: When the company went under, tales of his extravagance surged through the industry.

defs.def_en: Extravagance is the spending of more money than is reasonable or than you can afford.

ext.ext_cn: 她唯一的奢侈品就是马。
ext.ext_en: Her only extravagance was horses...

ext.ext_cn: 为什么把钱浪费在这些奢侈品上呢？
ext.ext_en: Why waste money on such extravagances?

defs.def_en: An extravagance is something that you spend money on but cannot really afford.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: You can use rustic to describe things or people that you approve of because they are simple or unsophisticated in a way that is typical of the countryside.

ext.ext_en: ...lots of opera-loving Italian rustics in from the country.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone who comes from the countryside as a rustic if you find their behaviour amusing or very different from that of people who live in towns and cities.

ext.ext_en: After exploring the old part of town there is a guided tour of the cathedral...

defs.def_en: If you explore a place, you travel around it to find out what it is like.

ext.ext_en: The secretary is expected to explore ideas for post-war reconstruction of the area...

ext.ext_en: The film explores the relationship between artist and instrument.

defs.def_en: If you explore an idea or suggestion, you think about it or comment on it in detail, in order to assess it carefully.

ext.ext_en: The government is allowing the areas of inshore coastal waters to be explored for oil and gas.

defs.def_en: If people explore an area for a substance such as oil or minerals, they study the area and do tests on the land to see whether they can find it.

ext.ext_cn: 他用手指摸了摸伤口，想要确定受伤的程度。
ext.ext_en: He explored the wound with his finger, trying to establish its extent.

defs.def_en: If you explore something with your hands or fingers, you touch it to find out what it feels like.

ext.ext_cn: 冷冷的雨云层
ext.ext_en: ...layers of cold nimbus clouds.

defs.def_en: A nimbus is a large grey cloud that brings rain or snow.
A chemise is a long, loose piece of underwear worn by women in former times.

ext.ext_en: He arrives in his biplane and crash lands it in a tree...

ext.ext_en: A light aircraft crash-landed on a putting green yesterday.

defs.def_en: If a pilot crash-lands an aircraft, or if it crash-lands, it lands more quickly and less safely than usual, for example when there is something wrong with the aircraft, and it cannot land normally.

ext.ext_en: The stadium was 2275 metres above sea level...

ext.ext_en: The whole place is at sea level...

defs.def_en: Sea level is the average level of the sea with respect to the land. The height of mountains or other areas is calculated in relation to sea level .

defs.def_cn: 非常饥饿的;饥肠辘辘的

ext.ext_cn: 埃米意识到自己从离开布鲁顿大街之后什么东西都没吃，她饿极了。
ext.ext_en: Amy realized that she had eaten nothing since leaving Bruton Street, and she was ravenous.

ext.ext_cn: 一群饿极了的动物

ext.ext_en: Such behaviour is unacceptable and will be punished.

defs.def_en: To punish a crime means to punish anyone who commits that crime.

ext.ext_en: He should give way to a younger, more decisive leader.

defs.def_en: If someone is decisive, they have or show an ability to make quick decisions in a difficult or complicated situation.

ext.ext_en: ...steeply gabled roofs.

ext.ext_en: Rachael Carr intends to carry on teaching...

defs.def_en: If you carry on doing something, you continue to do it.

ext.ext_en: The consulate will carryon a political dialogue with Indonesia...

ext.ext_en: He carried on a passionate affair with Mrs Gilbert.

defs.def_en: If you carry on an activity, you do it or take part in it for a period of time.

ext.ext_en: She was yelling and screaming and carrying on...

ext.ext_en: He was carrying on about some stupid television series.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is carrying on, you are irritated with them because they are talking very excitedly and saying a lot of unnecessary things.

ext.ext_en: Every week a fresh scandal emerges about ministers carrying on with film actresses and call girls.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is carrying on with someone else, you mean that they are having a sexual relationship and you do not approve of this, usually because one or both of them is married.
Your spinal cord is a thick cord of nerves inside your spine which connects your brain to nerves in all parts of your body.

ext.ext_en: Da Vinci was methodical in his research, carefully recording his observations and theories...

ext.ext_en: It seemed a sensible and methodical way of proceeding.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as methodical, you mean that they do things carefully, thoroughly, and in order.

ext.ext_en: ...a rather well-to-do family of diamond cutters.

ext.ext_en: ...Bedouin carpets.

defs.def_en: Bedouin means relating to the Bedouin people.

ext.ext_en: It's half past two. I think we had better go home...

ext.ext_en: He recorded a time of 4 minutes 23, bettering the old record of 4-24...

ext.ext_en: As an account of adolescence it could hardly be bettered.

defs.def_en: If someone betters a high achievement or standard, they achieve something higher.

ext.ext_cn: 他毕生致力于改变南非受压迫人民的命运。
ext.ext_en: He had dedicated his life to bettering the lot of the oppressed people of South Africa...

ext.ext_en: You are better eating just a small snack than hurrying a main meal...

ext.ext_en: Wouldn't  it be better putting a time-limit on the task?...

defs.def_en: You can say that someone is better doing one thing than another, or it is better doing one thing than another, to advise someone about what they should do.

ext.ext_cn: 让世界变得更美好的梦想
ext.ext_en: Dreams of changing the world for the better.

defs.def_en: If something changes for the better, it improves.

defs.def_cn: （嫉妒、好奇心、愤怒等感情）使不能自制

ext.ext_cn: 她没有感情用事。
ext.ext_en: She didn't allow her emotions to get the better of her.

defs.def_en: If a feeling such as jealousy, curiosity, or anger gets the better of you, it becomes too strong for you to hide or control.

defs.def_cn: （在比赛、打斗或争论中）战胜，打败

ext.ext_cn: 他习惯了彪悍的后卫，通常都能战而胜之。
ext.ext_en: He is used to tough defenders, and he usually gets the better of them.

defs.def_en: If you get the better of someone, you defeat them in a contest, fight, or argument.

ext.ext_cn: 她不至于和阿德琳发生争执。
ext.ext_en: She knew better than to argue with Adeline...

ext.ext_cn: 拿这么严肃的事情开玩笑已经够糟的了，身为一名警察更不应该这样做。
ext.ext_en: It's  bad enough to have anyone joke about such a serious matter but a member of the police force should know better.

defs.def_en: If someone knows better than to do something, they are old enough or experienced enough to know it is the wrong thing to do.

defs.def_cn: 比…更了解（或更渊博、更有经验）

ext.ext_cn: 虽然他经验远没有我丰富，但他认为他比我懂行。
ext.ext_en: He thought he knew better than I did, though he was much less experienced...

ext.ext_cn: 我妹妹仍然说她和我们玩牌的时候捣了鬼，其实我心知肚明。
ext.ext_en: My sister still claims she cheated on us at cards, but I know better.

defs.def_en: If you know better than someone, you have more information, knowledge, or experience than them.

ext.ext_cn: 你要是大包小包的，不如打的算了。
ext.ext_en: If you've  got bags you're better off taking a taxi...

ext.ext_cn: 他们似乎认为婴儿或者小孩还是呆在自己出生的国家为好。
ext.ext_en: Their stance seems to be that a baby or child is better off in its country of birth.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone would be better off doing something, you are advising them to do it or expressing the opinion that it would benefit them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 现在通用电气公司已经制造出了巧夺天工的钻石，其纯度比最好的天然钻石还要高。
ext.ext_en: Now General Electric have gone one better than nature and made a diamond purer than the best quality natural diamonds.

defs.def_en: If you go one better, you do something better than it has been done before or obtain something better than someone else has.

defs.def_cn: （表示赞成、表扬或鼓励）很好，这就对了

ext.ext_cn: “我来征求你们的意见——不对，请求你们帮助。”——“这还差不多。我们怎么帮助你？”
ext.ext_en: 'I came to ask your advice — no, to ask for your help.' — 'That's better. And how can I help you?'

defs.def_en: You say 'That's  better' in order to express your approval of what someone has said or done, or to praise or encourage them.

ext.ext_cn: 使用高筋白面粉，如果你能弄到硬粒小麦面粉，那就更好了。
ext.ext_en: Use strong white flour, and if you can get hold of durum wheat flour, then so much the better...

ext.ext_cn: 如果有好的滑雪场、令人叹为观止的美景，又不用赶飞机，那就再好不过了。
ext.ext_en: If there's good skiing, breathtaking scenery and you don't  need to catch a plane, all the better!

defs.def_en: You can say 'so much the better' or 'all the better' to indicate that it is desirable that a particular thing is used, done, or available.

ext.ext_cn: 爱尔兰人喜欢聚会，规模越大越好。
ext.ext_en: The Irish love a party, the bigger the better...

ext.ext_cn: 房间里的东西越少越好。
ext.ext_en: The fewer things in the room the better.

defs.def_en: You can use expressions like 'The bigger the better' or 'The sooner the better' to say that you would prefer it if something is big or happens soon.

defs.def_cn: 为了更好地…；以便更有效地…

ext.ext_cn: 每一个骑乘项目她都要亲自试一试，以便更好地指导她那些跃跃欲试的小学生。
ext.ext_en: She came on every ride herself, the better to instruct her eager pupils.

defs.def_en: If you do something the better to do something else, you do the first thing in order to be able to do the second thing more effectively.

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔伯格张了张嘴，似乎想要申辩，但想想又放弃了。
ext.ext_en: Alberg opened his mouth, as if to protest. But he thought better of it.

defs.def_en: If you intend to do something and then think better of it, you decide not to do it because you realize it would not be sensible.

defs.def_cn: 不论好坏；不管结果怎样

ext.ext_cn: 这些问题我都知道，不管怎样我还是嫁给了你。
ext.ext_en: I married you for better or worse, knowing all about these problems.

defs.def_en: If you say that something has happened or been done for better or worse, you mean that you are not sure whether the consequences will be good or bad, but they will have to be accepted because the action cannot be changed.

ext.ext_cn: 民主经历了内战和庞大工业体系的逐渐兴起仍然幸存了下来，并且艰难挺进了20世纪。
ext.ext_en: Democracy survived the Civil War and the developing industrial leviathan and struggled on into the twentieth century.

defs.def_en: A leviathan is something which is extremely large and difficult to control, and which you find rather frightening.
A buzzard is a large bird of prey.
If you refer to someone as a buzzard, you think they are unpleasant or very mean.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有礼貌的;谦恭的;恭敬的;客气的

ext.ext_cn: 他为人友善，而且彬彬有礼。
ext.ext_en: He was a kind and courteous man...

ext.ext_cn: 我朋友的回答很客气，但很坚决。
ext.ext_en: My friend's reply was courteous but firm.

defs.def_en: Someone who is courteous is polite and respectful to other people.
A tool box is a metal or plastic box which contains general tools that you need at home, for example to do repairs in your house or car.

defs.def_cn: （制作简单快捷但无益于健康的）垃圾食品，方便食品
defs.def_en: If you refer to food as junk food, you mean that it is quick and easy to prepare but is not good for your health.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 闷闷不乐的；忧郁的；愁闷的

ext.ext_cn: 她郁郁寡欢，显然在惦念自己的孩子们。
ext.ext_en: She was very glum and was obviously missing her children.

defs.def_en: Someone who is glum is sad and quiet because they are disappointed or unhappy about something.

ext.ext_cn: 他起身开始在屋里来回走动。
ext.ext_en: He stood up and began to move around the room...

ext.ext_cn: 体重下降眼看开始变得愈发厉害了。
ext.ext_en: The weight loss began to look more serious...

defs.def_en: To begin to do something means to start doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 问题在去年11月份开始出现。
ext.ext_en: The problems began last November...

ext.ext_cn: 他东躲西藏的第四个年头刚刚开始。
ext.ext_en: He has just begun his fourth year in hiding...

defs.def_en: When something begins or when you begin it, it takes place from a particular time onwards.

defs.def_cn: 从…开始；从…着手；首先做（某事）

ext.ext_cn: 请允许我开场先讲几句套话。
ext.ext_en: Could I begin with a few formalities?

ext.ext_cn: 靠他的汽车后备箱练摊兜售高尔夫球衫起家的商人
ext.ext_en: ...a businessman who began by selling golf shirts from the boot of his car...

defs.def_en: If you begin with something, or begin by doing something, this is the first thing you do.

ext.ext_cn: “西伦教授，”他开口说道，“很高兴见到您。”
ext.ext_en: 'Professor Theron,' he began, 'I'm very pleased to see you'...

ext.ext_cn: 他不知从何说起。
ext.ext_en: He didn't know how to begin.

defs.def_en: You use begin to mention the first thing that someone says.

ext.ext_cn: 原先的地方节日已经发展成为一项国际性活动。
ext.ext_en: What began as a local festival has blossomed into an international event.

defs.def_en: If one thing began as another, it first existed in the form of the second thing.

ext.ext_cn: 命运线始于接近手腕的地方。
ext.ext_en: The fate line begins close to the wrist...

ext.ext_cn: 吉内梅街始于菲茨拉德故居前。
ext.ext_en: Rue Guynemer begins at the front of the Fitzgerald site.

defs.def_en: If you say that a thing or place begins somewhere, you are talking about one of its limits or edges.

ext.ext_cn: 第一个词的首字母为F。
ext.ext_en: The first word begins with an F.

defs.def_en: If a word begins with a particular letter, that is the first letter of that word.

defs.def_cn: 无法，难以（解释、理解、想象等）

ext.ext_cn: 你都无从想象这让我有多悲伤。
ext.ext_en: You can't begin to imagine how much that saddens me.

defs.def_en: If you say that you cannot begin to imagine, understand, or explain something, you are emphasizing that it is almost impossible to explain, understand, or imagine.

ext.ext_cn: 一开始非常好，但现在可就难了。
ext.ext_en: It was great to begin with but now it's difficult.

defs.def_en: You use to begin with when you are talking about the first stage of a situation, event, or process.

ext.ext_cn: “跟你聊过的科学家是怎么看的？”——“嗯，首先，他们怀疑这能否行得通。”
ext.ext_en: 'What do scientists you've spoken with think about that?' — 'Well, to begin with, they doubt it's going to work.'

defs.def_en: You use to begin with to introduce the first of several things that you want to say.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她拍打着脑门，看上去在生自己的气。
ext.ext_en: She tapped her forehead and looked annoyed with herself...

ext.ext_cn: 当局禁止她从事照管儿童的工作，她为此感到很伤心也很恼怒。
ext.ext_en: She is hurt and annoyed that the authorities have banned her from working with children.

defs.def_en: See also:annoy;If you are annoyed, you are fairly angry about something.

ext.ext_cn: 在电视机前度过的数小时
ext.ext_en: ...hours spent in front of the boob tube.

defs.def_en: The boob tube is the television.
A boob tube is a piece of women's clothing made of stretchy material that covers only her chest.
A handmaiden is a female servant.

defs.def_cn: 起服务作用的东西;辅助;支持

ext.ext_cn: 人们担心的是科学会成为工业的仆人。
ext.ext_en: The fear is that science could become the handmaiden of industry.

defs.def_en: If one thing is the handmaiden of another, the first thing helps the second or makes it possible.
A corsage is a very small bunch of flowers that is fastened to a woman's dress below the shoulder.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对人命的漠视
ext.ext_en: ...his callous disregard for human life.

defs.def_en: A callous person or action is very cruel and shows no concern for other people or their feelings.
A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

ext.ext_cn: 她之前在酒吧工作，负责烹饪和招待。
ext.ext_en: She had been working in a pub, cooking and waitressing.

defs.def_en: A woman who waitresses works in a restaurant serving food and drink.

ext.ext_cn: 这趟行程需要周密计划。
ext.ext_en: The trip needs careful planning...

ext.ext_cn: 新体系仍处于规划阶段。
ext.ext_en: The new system is still in the planning stages.

defs.def_en: See also:family planning;Planning is the process of deciding in detail how to do something before you actually start to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 18世纪城镇规划的杰作
ext.ext_en: ...a masterpiece of 18th-century town planning...

ext.ext_cn: 他支持城镇规划部门拒绝该项申请，因为这会给绿化带带来损害。
ext.ext_en: He supported the planning authority in refusing the application because of pressures on the Green Belt.

defs.def_en: Planning is control by the local government of the way that land is used in an area and of what new buildings are built there.
Sulphuric acid is a colourless, oily, and very powerful acid.

ext.ext_cn: 两年前，国会就此拘留事件正式道歉。
ext.ext_en: Two years ago, Congress formally apologized for the internment...

ext.ext_cn: 我为自己的迟到致歉。
ext.ext_en: I apologize for being late...

defs.def_en: When you apologize to someone, you say that you are sorry that you have hurt them or caused trouble for them. You can say 'I apologize' as a formal way of saying sorry.

defs.def_cn: 伊玛目(指伊斯兰教的宗教领袖,尤指穆斯林社群领袖或清真寺内带领教徒做礼拜的人)
defs.def_en: In Islam, an imam is a religious leader, especially the leader of a Muslim community or the person who leads the prayers in a mosque.

ext.ext_cn: 这些铭文是新刻的，而且刻痕很深。
ext.ext_en: The inscriptions are fresh and deep-grooved.

defs.def_en: Something that is grooved has grooves on its surface.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 游客会遇到炎热潮湿的天气状况。
ext.ext_en: Visitors can expect hot and humid conditions...

ext.ext_cn: 天气多云潮湿。
ext.ext_en: The day is overcast and humid.

defs.def_en: You use humid to describe an atmosphere or climate that is very damp, and usually very hot.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他警告公众要提高警惕，遇到任何可疑情况都要报告。
ext.ext_en: He warned the public to be vigilant and report anything suspicious...

ext.ext_cn: 除了一封漏网之外，警惕的邮局员工截获了其余所有的邮件炸弹。
ext.ext_en: All but one of these letter bombs had been intercepted by vigilant post office staff.

defs.def_en: Someone who is vigilant gives careful attention to a particular problem or situation and concentrates on noticing any danger or trouble that there might be.
Place mats are mats that are put on a table before a meal for people to put their plates or bowls on.

ext.ext_cn: 他和卡西迪中尉正在勘查犯罪现场。
ext.ext_en: He and Lieutenant Cassidy were checking the scene of the crime...

ext.ext_cn: 斯蒂尔先生没有犯罪，并未对公众构成危害。
ext.ext_en: Mr Steele has committed no crime and poses no danger to the public...

defs.def_en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

ext.ext_cn: 语言是一种精心调试的乐器，破坏它就是一种罪过。
ext.ext_en: A language is a finely tuned instrument which it is a crime to damage...

ext.ext_cn: 如果千里迢迢去澳大利亚却不在悉尼停留，那将是一大失误。
ext.ext_en: It would be a crime to travel all the way to Australia and not stop in Sydney.

defs.def_en: If you say that doing something is a crime, you think it is very wrong or a serious mistake.
A mallard is a kind of wild duck which is very common.

ext.ext_cn: 超市可能都在赚大钱。
ext.ext_en: The supermarkets may be making whacking profits.

ext.ext_cn: 极大的洞
ext.ext_en: ...a whacking great hole.

defs.def_en: You can use whacking to emphasize how big something is.

defs.def_cn: 匿名的;无名的;不知名的

ext.ext_cn: 你愿意的话可以不透露姓名。
ext.ext_en: You can remain anonymous if you wish...

ext.ext_cn: 一个匿名捐助者施以援手提供了奖金。
ext.ext_en: An anonymous benefactor stepped in to provide the prize money.

defs.def_en: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

ext.ext_cn: 当然，那必须通过不记名投票的方式。
ext.ext_en: Of course, that would have to be by anonymous vote.

defs.def_en: Something that is anonymous does not reveal who you are.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 华盛顿西北部最无特色的地区
ext.ext_en: ...the most anonymous part of north-west Washington...

ext.ext_cn: 呆在家里比呆在单调乏味的度假别墅里要惬意得多。
ext.ext_en: It's nice to stay in a home rather than in an anonymous holiday villa.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as anonymous, you dislike it because it has no unusual or interesting features and seems unwelcoming.

ext.ext_cn: 1比3的倾斜度
ext.ext_en: ...a gradient of 1 in 3...

ext.ext_cn: 这些赛道既长又有陡坡，极具挑战性。
ext.ext_en: The courses are long and punishing, with steep gradients.

defs.def_en: A gradient is a slope, or the degree to which the ground slopes.
The gradient of a graph or series of measurements is the rate at which one set of amounts changes in relation to another.

ext.ext_cn: 她先挥拳打他的下巴，然后又打他的脑袋。
ext.ext_en: After punching him on the chin she wound up hitting him over the head...

ext.ext_cn: 他生气地用拳捶墙，接着转过身来面对着她。
ext.ext_en: He punched the wall angrily, then spun round to face her.

defs.def_en: If you punch someone or something, you hit them hard with your fist.

ext.ext_cn: 最后，格拉夫高兴得挥动着拳头，脸上笑开了花。
ext.ext_en: At the end, Graf punched the air in delight, a huge grin on her face.

defs.def_en: If you punch the air, you put one or both of your fists forcefully above your shoulders as a gesture of delight or victory.

ext.ext_cn: 贝勒太太迈向电梯，按下按钮。
ext.ext_en: Mrs. Baylor strode to the elevator and punched the button.

defs.def_en: If you punch something such as the buttons on a keyboard, you touch them in order to store information on a machine such as a computer or to give the machine a command to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 我拿了一支圆珠笔，在纸盒上戳了一个洞。
ext.ext_en: I took a ballpoint pen and punched a hole in the carton.

defs.def_en: If you punch holes in something, you make holes in it by pushing or pressing it with something sharp.

ext.ext_cn: 用打孔器打两个孔。
ext.ext_en: Make two holes with a hole punch.

defs.def_en: A punch is a tool that you use for making holes in something.

ext.ext_cn: 我太紧张，没能有效地传达我演说的要点。
ext.ext_en: My nervousness made me deliver the vital points of my address without sufficient punch...

ext.ext_cn: 飓风安德鲁的风力可能会逐渐减弱，但风速仍在每小时100英里左右。
ext.ext_en: Hurricane Andrew may be slowly losing its punch, but its winds are still around 100 miles an hour.

defs.def_en: If you say that something has punch, you mean that it has force or effectiveness.

defs.def_cn: 潘趣酒，宾治酒（各种酒和糖、柠檬、调料等勾兑而成的饮料）
defs.def_en: Punch is a drink made from wine or spirits mixed with things such as sugar, lemons, and spices.

ext.ext_cn: 她论事一针见血是出了名的，从来都是直言不讳。
ext.ext_en: She has a reputation for getting at the guts of a subject and never pulling her punches.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does not pull their punches when they are criticizing a person or thing, you mean that they say exactly what they think, even though this might upset or offend people.  to pack a punch→see: pack;

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人厌恶的;低劣的;糟糕的
defs.def_en: If someone describes something as shitty, they do not like it or think that it is of poor quality.

ext.ext_cn: 她否认对她丈夫的事知情。
ext.ext_en: She disclaims any knowledge of her husband's business.

ext.ext_cn: 政府否认对 6 人的死亡负有责任。
ext.ext_en: The government has disclaimed responsibility for the deaths of six people.

defs.def_en: If you disclaim knowledge of something or disclaim responsibility for something, you say that you did not know about it or are not responsible for it.

ext.ext_cn: 丁香树倚着边墙生长。
ext.ext_en: Lilacs grew against the side wall.

ext.ext_cn: 丁香细枝
ext.ext_en: ...a twig of lilac.

defs.def_en: A lilac or a lilac tree is a small tree which has sweet-smelling purple, pink, or white flowers in large, cone-shaped groups.

ext.ext_cn: 深深浅浅的各种木槿色、丁香色、熏衣草色和紫色都是流行色。
ext.ext_en: All shades of mauve, lilac, lavender and purple were fashionable.

defs.def_en: Something that is lilac is pale pinkish-purple in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 为商业团体和劳工组织做经济研究的无党派组织
ext.ext_en: ...a non-partisan organization that does economic research for business and labor groups.

ext.ext_cn: 总统在感恩节发出的寻求该问题以无党派途径解决的呼吁
ext.ext_en: ...the president's Thanksgiving Day call for a non-partisan approach to the problem.

defs.def_en: A person or group that is non-partisan does not support or help a particular political party or group.

ext.ext_cn: 剥开一只厚皮橙子，用锋利的刀将两端削去使它呈方形。
ext.ext_en: Peel a thick-skinned orange and square off the ends with a sharp knife.

ext.ext_cn: 看起来像是方形结婚蛋糕的白色现代建筑
ext.ext_en: ...white modern buildings that look like squared-off wedding cakes.

defs.def_en: If you square something off, you alter it so that it has the shape of a square.

defs.def_cn: 摆好打斗的架势;准备迎战

ext.ext_cn: 在佛罗里达州，农民正摆好架势，准备和城市争夺地下水的使用权。
ext.ext_en: In Florida, farmers are squaring off against cities for rights to groundwater...

ext.ext_cn: 在一个公路检查站法国士兵摆开架势，准备迎战一名持枪者。
ext.ext_en: French soldiers squared off with a gunman at a road checkpoint...

defs.def_en: If one group or person squares off against or with another, they prepare to fight them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (言辞或行为)非正式的，亲切随便的

ext.ext_cn: 她不拘礼节,让人耳目一新。
ext.ext_en: She is refreshingly informal...

ext.ext_cn: 他的朋友没那么英俊,却随意、放松得多。
ext.ext_en: His friend was less good-looking, but a lot more informal and relaxed.

defs.def_en: Informal speech or behaviour is relaxed and friendly rather than serious, very correct, or official.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我希望把它办得不那么正式。
ext.ext_en: I would like it to be an informal occasion...

ext.ext_cn: 房间里有一种轻松随意的氛围。
ext.ext_en: The house has an informal atmosphere.

defs.def_en: An informal situation is one which is relaxed and friendly and not very serious or official.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (衣服)非正式场合穿的,休闲的

ext.ext_cn: 大部分时间珍妮需要休闲服装。
ext.ext_en: Most of the time Jenny needs informal clothes...

ext.ext_cn: 吃午饭时可以穿休闲服。
ext.ext_en: For lunch, dress is informal.

defs.def_en: Informal clothes are casual and suitable for wearing when you are relaxing, but not on formal occasions.

ext.ext_cn: 两位领导人将到戴维营进行非正式讨论。
ext.ext_en: The two leaders will retire to Camp David for informal discussions.

ext.ext_cn: 欧盟部长非正式会议
ext.ext_en: ...an informal meeting of EU ministers...

defs.def_en: You use informal to describe something that is done unofficially or casually without planning.

ext.ext_cn: 抓捕毒贩的秘密行动
ext.ext_en: ...an undercover operation designed to catch drug smugglers.

ext.ext_cn: 联邦调查局的密探
ext.ext_en: ...undercover FBI agents.

defs.def_en: Undercover work involves secretly obtaining information for the government or the police.

ext.ext_cn: 山顶寒风呼啸。
ext.ext_en: A chill wind blew at the top of the hill...

ext.ext_cn: 我们醒来时发现外面狂风大作。
ext.ext_en: We woke to find a gale blowing outside.

defs.def_en: When a wind or breeze blows, the air moves.

ext.ext_cn: 风把她前额上的头发吹到了后面。
ext.ext_en: The wind blew her hair back from her forehead...

ext.ext_cn: 大风卷走了大部分的尘土。
ext.ext_en: Strong winds blew away most of the dust...

defs.def_en: If the wind blows something somewhere or if it blows there, the wind moves it there.

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼搓着胳膊并向手指上哈气取暖。
ext.ext_en: Danny rubbed his arms and blew on his fingers to warm them...

ext.ext_cn: 深呼吸，吐气。
ext.ext_en: Take a deep breath and blow.

defs.def_en: If you blow, you send out a stream of air from your mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 他端起杯子，吹走了热气。
ext.ext_en: He picked up his mug and blew off the steam.

defs.def_en: If you blow something somewhere, you move it by sending out a stream of air from your mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 他吐出了蓝色的烟圈。
ext.ext_en: He blew a ring of blue smoke.

defs.def_en: If you blow bubbles or smoke rings, you make them by blowing air out of your mouth through liquid or smoke.

ext.ext_cn: 汽笛鸣响，火车向前滑动。
ext.ext_en: The whistle blew and the train slid forward...

ext.ext_cn: 一个警卫正在吹警笛。
ext.ext_en: A guard was blowing his whistle.

defs.def_en: When a whistle or horn blows or someone blows it, they make a sound by blowing into it.

ext.ext_cn: 他掏出一块手帕，擤了擤鼻子。
ext.ext_en: He took out a handkerchief and blew his nose.

defs.def_en: When you blow your nose, you force air out of it through your nostrils in order to clear it.

ext.ext_cn: 罐子爆炸了，不但炸毁了厨房和浴室，还把窗户炸飞了。
ext.ext_en: The can exploded, wrecking the kitchen and bathroom and blowing out windows...

ext.ext_cn: 敌人把这座城市炸成了一片废墟。
ext.ext_en: Rival gunmen blew the city to bits.

defs.def_en: To blow something out ,off, or away means to remove or destroy it violently with an explosion.

ext.ext_cn: 在巴黎召开的令人瞩目的世界汽车运动理事会会议使冠军归属充满各种可能，因为舒马赫也被扣了6分。
ext.ext_en: The dramatic World Motor Sports Council meeting in Paris blew the championship wide open as Schumacher was also docked six points...

ext.ext_cn: 有人不适当地引用我的话，想借此把事情闹大。
ext.ext_en: Someone took an inappropriate use of words on my part and tried to blow it into a major controversy.

defs.def_en: If you say that something blows an event, situation, or argument into a particular extreme state, especially an uncertain or unpleasant state, you mean that it causes it to be in that state.

ext.ext_cn: 在把钱全砸到一趟海上豪华游之前，多少考虑一下日后怎么办。
ext.ext_en: Before you blow it all on a luxury cruise, give a little thought to the future...

ext.ext_cn: 我兄弟借给我一些钱，全被我拿去挥霍了。
ext.ext_en: My brother lent me some money and I went and blew the lot.

defs.def_en: If you blow a large amount of money, you spend it quickly on luxuries.

defs.def_cn: 失去，断送（机会）；搞砸（努力）

ext.ext_cn: 他几乎肯定失去了今冬去印度旅行的机会。
ext.ext_en: He has almost certainly blown his chance of touring India this winter.

ext.ext_cn: 一字不慎就可能会断送整笔交易的高风险的房地产业
ext.ext_en: ...the high-risk world of real estate, where one careless word could blow a whole deal...

defs.def_en: If you blow a chance or attempt to do something, you make a mistake which wastes the chance or causes the attempt to fail.

ext.ext_cn: 他刚一按下按钮，保险丝就烧断了。
ext.ext_en: The fuse blew as he pressed the button.

defs.def_en: If a fuse blows or if something blows it, the fuse melts because too much electricity has been sent through it, and the electrical current is cut off.

ext.ext_cn: 一辆货车爆胎了，向他们猛撞了过去。
ext.ext_en: A lorry blew a tyre and careered into them...

ext.ext_cn: 这辆车爆胎了。
ext.ext_en: The car tyre blew.

defs.def_en: If you blow a tyre or if it blows, a hole suddenly appears in it and all the air comes out of it.

ext.ext_cn: 好莱坞的摄影师们有足够的理由可以自我吹嘘。
ext.ext_en: Hollywood cameramen have good reason to blow their own trumpets.

defs.def_en: If you blow your own trumpet or blow your own horn, you tell people that you are very clever or successful.

ext.ext_cn: 他脸部受到重击之后就去了医院。
ext.ext_en: He went off to hospital after a blow to the face.

defs.def_en: If someone receives a blow, they are hit with a fist or weapon.

ext.ext_cn: 婚姻的最终破裂对索姆斯显然是一个沉重打击。
ext.ext_en: When the marriage finally broke up it was obviously a terrible blow to Soames...

ext.ext_cn: 那项裁决对环境保护论者来说如同一记闷棍。
ext.ext_en: That ruling comes as a blow to environmentalists...

defs.def_en: If something that happens is a blow to someone or something, it is very upsetting, disappointing, or damaging to them.

ext.ext_cn: 代表们在一次会议上差点动起手来。
ext.ext_en: The representatives almost came to blows at a meeting.

defs.def_en: If two people or groups come to blows, they start fighting.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在缓解失业冲击的项目进展得并不太顺利，参议员萨班斯对此表示关切。
ext.ext_en: Senator Sarbanes expressed concern that programs designed to soften the blow of unemployment are not working well.

defs.def_en: Something that softens the blow or cushions the blow makes an unpleasant change or piece of news easier to accept.

ext.ext_cn: 这个小组在比赛中获胜，维护了女性的权利。
ext.ext_en: The team struck a blow for women's rights by winning the match.

defs.def_en: If you strike a blow for a particular cause or principle, you do something that supports it or makes it more likely to succeed.

defs.def_cn: （英国学校）由中央政府拨款（或出资）的(缩略形式为GM)
defs.def_en: In Britain, a grant-maintained school is one which receives money directly from the national government rather than from a local authority. The abbreviation GM is also used.
In Britain, the licensing laws are the laws which control the selling of alcoholic drinks.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人垂涎的;色香俱佳的

ext.ext_cn: 形状、口感和味道各异让人垂涎的数百种奶酪
ext.ext_en: ...hundreds of cheeses, in a mouth-watering variety of shapes, textures and tastes.

ext.ext_cn: 150多种诱人的食谱
ext.ext_en: ...more than 150 mouthwatering recipes.

defs.def_en: Mouth-watering food looks or smells extremely nice.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 价值960万英镑的诱人奖品无人认领。
ext.ext_en: Prizes worth a mouth-watering £9.6 million are unclaimed.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as mouth-watering, you are emphasizing that it is very attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 理查德正沿着小路走过来。
ext.ext_en: Richard was coming up the pathway.

ext.ext_cn: 通往附近河流的小路
ext.ext_en: ...a pathway leading towards the nearby river.

defs.def_en: A pathway is a path which you can walk along or a route which you can take.

ext.ext_cn: 为人圆通会让你成功的道路通畅无阻。
ext.ext_en: Diplomacy will smooth your pathway to success.

ext.ext_cn: 为巴西人民开启了自由之路的武装起来的号召
ext.ext_en: ... the call to arms that opened the pathway to freedom for the Brazilian people.

defs.def_en: A pathway is a particular course of action or a way of achieving something.
A fire hydrant is a pipe in the street from which fire fighters can obtain water for putting out a fire.

defs.def_cn: （通常为更快地实现某事）越过，避开，绕开

ext.ext_cn: 越来越多的雇主试图完全绕过工会行事。
ext.ext_en: A growing number of employers are trying to bypass the unions altogether...

ext.ext_cn: 监管机构担心人们会轻易地摆脱控制。
ext.ext_en: Regulators worry that controls could easily be bypassed.

defs.def_en: If you bypass someone or something that you would normally have to get involved with, you ignore them, often because you want to achieve something more quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 心脏搭桥手术
ext.ext_en: ...heart bypass surgery.

defs.def_en: A bypass is a surgical operation performed on or near the heart, in which the flow of blood is redirected so that it does not flow through a part of the heart which is diseased or blocked.

defs.def_cn: 对（动脉等）作分流术；为…作搭桥术

ext.ext_cn: 从腿部取出一些细小血管，用来对堵塞的冠状动脉进行分流。
ext.ext_en: Small veins are removed from the leg and used to bypass the blocked up stretch of coronary arteries.

defs.def_en: If a surgeon bypasses a diseased artery or other part of the body, he or she performs an operation so that blood or other bodily fluids do not flow through it.

defs.def_cn: （绕过城镇中心的）旁道，外环路

ext.ext_cn: 一条新的绕城环路正在建设当中。
ext.ext_en: A new bypass around the city is being built.

ext.ext_cn: 赫里福德旁道
ext.ext_en: ...the Hereford bypass.

defs.def_en: A bypass is a main road which takes traffic around the edge of a town rather than through its centre.

ext.ext_cn: 建造新的城市外环道所需的资金
ext.ext_en: ...money for new roads to bypass cities.

defs.def_en: If a road bypasses a place, it goes around it rather than through it.

ext.ext_cn: 叛军在向南部挺进时直接绕过了绥德鲁。
ext.ext_en: The rebel forces simply bypassed Zwedru on their way further south.

defs.def_en: If you bypass a place when you are travelling, you avoid going through it.

ext.ext_cn: 赫尔姆先生打算声明该法案违反了宪法第一修正案。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Helm plans to assert that the bill violates the First Amendment...

ext.ext_cn: 各被告仍然坚称无辜，预计会提起上诉。
ext.ext_en: The defendants, who continue to assert their innocence, are expected to appeal...

defs.def_en: If someone asserts a fact or belief, they state it firmly.

ext.ext_cn: 战后，军队试图在该国的南部地区维护其统治地位。
ext.ext_en: After the war, the army made an attempt to assert its authority in the south of the country...

ext.ext_cn: 人民已经维护了其当家作主的权力，这将难以改变。
ext.ext_en: The people have asserted their power and that will be very difficult to reverse.

defs.def_en: If you assert your authority, you make it clear by your behaviour that you have authority.

ext.ext_cn: 各加盟共和国开始要求获得自治权。
ext.ext_en: The republics began asserting their right to govern themselves.

defs.def_en: If you assert your right or claim to something, you insist that you have the right to it.

defs.def_cn: 坚持（自己）的主张;表现坚定

ext.ext_cn: 他明确表态，信心十足地阐述自己的观点。
ext.ext_en: He's speaking up and asserting himself confidently.

defs.def_en: If you assert yourself, you speak and act in a forceful way, so that people take notice of you.

defs.def_cn: 圆周率（通常用希腊字母�表示，近似值为3.142）
defs.def_en: Pi is a number, approximately 3.142, which is equal to the distance round a circle divided by its width. It is usually represented by the Greek letter �.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 懒惰的;怠惰的;好逸恶劳的

ext.ext_cn: 懒惰的青少年们，连举手之劳都不愿意帮
ext.ext_en: ...indolent teenagers who won't lift a finger to help.

defs.def_en: Someone who is indolent is lazy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 因为没人知道密码,所以任何人都不可能进得去。
ext.ext_en: It was impossible for anyone to get in because no one knew the password...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为税金没法管理。
ext.ext_en: He thinks the tax is impossible to administer...

defs.def_en: Something that is impossible cannot be done or cannot happen.

ext.ext_cn: 政府现在几乎陷入了进退维谷的境地。
ext.ext_en: The Government was now in an almost impossible position.

defs.def_en: An impossible situation or an impossible position is one that is very difficult to deal with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以忍受的;让人受不了的

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰妮想,这个女人真让人受不了。
ext.ext_en: The woman is impossible, thought Frannie.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as impossible, you are annoyed that their bad behaviour or strong views make them difficult to deal with.

ext.ext_cn: 结果显示舆论出现一定程度的右倾。
ext.ext_en: The result reflects a modest rightward shift in opinion.

ext.ext_cn: 他继续力劝保守党要进一步右倾。
ext.ext_en: He continued to urge the Conservative Party to tilt rightwards...

defs.def_en: If there is a rightward trend in the politics of a person or party, their views become more right-wing.

ext.ext_cn: 考试成绩和老师的评定各占一半权重。
ext.ext_en: The tests and teacher assessments have equal weighting.

defs.def_en: A weighting is a value which is given to something according to how important or significant it is.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在高消费城市工作的人领取的)额外补贴，生活补贴

ext.ext_cn: 我每年得到2,700英镑的伦敦地区额外津贴。
ext.ext_en: I get an extra £2,700-a-year London weighting.

defs.def_en: A weighting is an advantage that a particular group of people receives in a system, especially an extra sum of money that people receive if they work in a city where the cost of living is very high.

ext.ext_cn: 持枪歹徒不慌不忙地走开,坐上一辆等候的汽车逃走了。
ext.ext_en: The gunmen calmly walked away and escaped in a waiting car.

defs.def_en: See also:calm;You can use calmly to emphasize that someone is behaving in a very controlled or ordinary way in a frightening or unusual situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我们开车经由洛维奇到达了多瑙河畔的古镇鲁塞。
ext.ext_en: We drove via Lovech to the old Danube town of Ruse...

ext.ext_cn: 贝克先生将取道英国和法国回国。
ext.ext_en: Mr Baker will return home via Britain and France.

defs.def_en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

ext.ext_cn: 能够让救援人员通过卫星与外界联系的技术已经存在。
ext.ext_en: The technology to allow relief workers to contact the outside world via satellite already exists...

ext.ext_cn: 翻译人员现在可以利用电子邮件系统在家里工作了。
ext.ext_en: Translators can now work from home, via electronic mail systems...

defs.def_en: If you do something via a particular means or person, you do it by making use of that means or person.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 鬃毛长而柔韧的毛笔
ext.ext_en: ...brushes with long, flexible bristles.

defs.def_en: A flexible object or material can be bent easily without breaking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 易变通的;适应性强的;灵活的

ext.ext_cn: 寻找功能多、适用性强的软件。
ext.ext_en: Look for software that's flexible enough for a range of abilities.

ext.ext_cn: 灵活的工作时间
ext.ext_en: ...flexible working hours.

defs.def_en: Something or someone that is flexible is able to change easily and adapt to different conditions and circumstances as they occur.

ext.ext_cn: 公司总部设在芝加哥。
ext.ext_en: The company is headquartered in Chicago.

defs.def_en: If an organization is headquartered in a particular place, that is where its main offices are.

ext.ext_cn: 那个沙坝并不稳固，他脚下如同踩着流沙一般。
ext.ext_en: The sandbank was uncertain, like quicksand under his feet.

defs.def_en: Quicksand is deep, wet sand that you sink into if you try to walk on it.

defs.def_cn: 难以摆脱的困境；不可靠的局面

ext.ext_cn: 我就要陷入罪孽的深渊了。
ext.ext_en: I was about to sink into the quicksand of sin...

ext.ext_cn: 这项研究犹如建在流沙之上，基础极不稳固。
ext.ext_en: The research seemed founded on quicksand.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a situation as quicksand when you want to suggest that it is dangerous or difficult to escape from, or does not provide a strong basis for what you are doing.

ext.ext_cn: 各家经营各自的农场，收获各自的劳动成果。
ext.ext_en: Each family farms individually and reaps the benefit of its labor...

ext.ext_cn: 我坚信这种治疗形式非常有益。
ext.ext_en: I'm  a great believer in the benefits of this form of therapy...

defs.def_en: The benefit of something is the help that you get from it or the advantage that results from  it.

ext.ext_cn: 这种情况目前对阿尔巴尼亚有利。
ext.ext_en: This could now work to Albania's  benefit...

ext.ext_cn: 我希望我所写的内容能对其他和我有同感的人有所裨益。
ext.ext_en: I hope what I have written will be of benefit to someone else who may feel the same way.

defs.def_en: If something is to your benefit or is of benefit to you, it helps you or improves your life.

ext.ext_cn: 双方都从谈判中获益。
ext.ext_en: Both sides have benefited from the talks.

ext.ext_cn: 有益于儿童的各种政府项目
ext.ext_en: ...a variety of government programs benefiting children.

defs.def_en: If you benefit from something or if it benefits you, it helps you or improves your life.

ext.ext_cn: 史蒂夫没能接受正规的大学教育。
ext.ext_en: Steve didn't have the benefit of a formal college education...

ext.ext_cn: 事后看来，我们显然本该做得更多。
ext.ext_en: With the benefit of hindsight, it is clear we ought to have done more...

defs.def_en: If you have the benefit of some information, knowledge, or equipment, you are able to use it so that you can achieve something.

defs.def_cn: （政府提供给穷人、病人和失业人员的）救济金，补助金

ext.ext_cn: 取消辍学者的补助金
ext.ext_en: ...the removal of benefit from school-leavers...

ext.ext_cn: 我得知要领补助，就得回答一些问题。
ext.ext_en: I was told that in order to get benefit payments I would have to answer some questions.

defs.def_en: Benefit is money that is given by the government to people who are poor, ill, or unemployed.

ext.ext_cn: 我要在布里斯托尔组织一场义演来募集这些资金。
ext.ext_en: I am organising a benefit gig in Bristol to raise these funds.

defs.def_en: A benefit, or a benefit concert or dinner, is an event that is held in order to raise money for a particular charity or person.

ext.ext_cn: 起初，我姑且相信了他。
ext.ext_en: At first I gave him the benefit of the doubt...

ext.ext_cn: 沙尔福德暂且获得了信任。
ext.ext_en: Shalford is entitled to the benefit of the doubt.

defs.def_en: If you give someone the benefit of the doubt, you treat them as if they are telling the truth or as if they have behaved properly, even though you are not sure that this is the case.

ext.ext_cn: 你们需要为社区谋利益的人。
ext.ext_en: You need people working for the benefit of the community...

ext.ext_cn: 他不必为了我作这么详细的展示！
ext.ext_en: He doesn't have to go through this elaborate display for my benefit!

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is doing something for the benefit of a particular person, you mean that they are doing it for that person.

ext.ext_cn: 颅出血
ext.ext_en: ...cranial bleeding.

defs.def_en: Cranial means relating to your cranium.

defs.def_cn: (观点、态度或方法的)彻底转变，完全改变

ext.ext_cn: 随着她自信心的增强，你很可能会看到她的态度有相当大的转变。
ext.ext_en: As her confidence grows you may well see a considerable turnabout in her attitude.

defs.def_en: A turnabout is a complete change in opinion, attitude, or method.

ext.ext_cn: 他忘了带手机充电器。
ext.ext_en: He forgot the charger for his mobile phone.

defs.def_en: A charger is a device used for charging or recharging batteries.
