ext.ext_cn: 女人们穿着牛仔裤、T恤、工装裤等等这类衣服在那个地方。
ext.ext_en: The women were there in their jeans and T-shirts and overalls and whatnot...

ext.ext_cn: 地方议会可以用西班牙文给其选民寄送通知、信件等类似的东西。
ext.ext_en: The council can send messages or letters or whatnot in Spanish to their constituents.

defs.def_en: People sometimes say 'and whatnot' or 'or whatnot' after mentioning one or more things, to refer in a vague way to other things which are similar.

ext.ext_cn: 他为数不多的强项之一就是善于模仿。
ext.ext_en: One of his few strengths was his skill at mimicry.

defs.def_en: Mimicry is the action of mimicking someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 这些文章由公司的职员捉刀。
ext.ext_en: Articles were ghost-written by company employees.

defs.def_en: If a book or other piece of writing is ghost-written, it is written by a writer for another person, for example a politician or sportsman, who then publishes it as his or her own work.

ext.ext_cn: 加的夫海湾项目吸引了众多游客。
ext.ext_en: The Cardiff Bay project is attracting many visitors...

ext.ext_cn: 煦暖的气候将比目鱼引到了近海。
ext.ext_en: Warm weather has attracted the flat fish close to shore...

defs.def_en: If something attracts people or animals, it has features that cause them to come to it.

defs.def_cn: 引起…的注意（或兴趣、赞赏等）；诱惑

ext.ext_cn: 该理论的逻辑性吸引了他，但他不能确定自己的理解是否正确。
ext.ext_en: He wasn't sure he'd got it right, although the theory attracted him by its logic...

ext.ext_cn: 她离奇的人生经历最先吸引了我。
ext.ext_en: What first attracted me to her was her incredible experience of life...

defs.def_en: If someone or something attracts you, they have particular qualities which cause you to like or admire them. If a particular quality attracts you to a person or thing, it is the reason why you like them.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管自己心存敌意，她还是为他所吸引。
ext.ext_en: In spite of her hostility, she was attracted to him...

ext.ext_cn: 我嫁给了一个我已不再钟情的男人。
ext.ext_en: I was married to a man who had ceased to attract me.

defs.def_en: If you are attracted to someone, you are interested in them sexually.

defs.def_cn: 吸引，招引（支持、关注或金钱）

ext.ext_cn: 姆维尼总统说他的国家同样愿意吸收来自私营公司的投资。
ext.ext_en: President Mwinyi said his country would also like to attract investment from private companies...

ext.ext_cn: 民意测验显示两名反对者获得了大量支持。
ext.ext_en: Opinion polls suggest that the two rebels have attracted a lot of sympathy.

defs.def_en: If something attracts support, publicity, or money, it receives support, publicity, or money.

ext.ext_cn: 任何有较强重力的物体都会对其他物体产生引力。
ext.ext_en: Anything with strong gravity attracts other things to it.

defs.def_en: If one object attracts another object, it causes the second object to move towards it.
An alder is a species of tree or shrub that grows especially in cool, damp places and loses its leaves in winter.

ext.ext_cn: 该法案如果能得到内政部各部长的支持，将可能在今年夏天之前被收入法令全书。
ext.ext_en: The Bill could reach the statute book by the summer if it attracts the support of Home Office ministers...

ext.ext_cn: 德国的法律条文中仍未设立内幕交易罪。
ext.ext_en: Germany still has no insider-dealing offence in its statute books.

defs.def_en: The statute book is a record of all the laws made by the government.

defs.def_cn: (通常为表示愤怒或厌烦而从会议、演出等)退席，退场

ext.ext_cn: 几十名政务会委员愤然从会场退席以示抗议。
ext.ext_en: Several dozen councillors walked out of the meeting in protest...

ext.ext_cn: 梅森先生在演出时退场。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Mason walked out during the performance.

defs.def_en: If you walk out of a meeting, a performance, or an unpleasant situation, you leave it suddenly, usually in order to show that you are angry or bored.

defs.def_cn: 突然离开，抛弃(家庭或伴侣);出走

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫抛弃了她。
ext.ext_en: Her husband walked out on her...

ext.ext_cn: 她离家出走后到巴斯与奶奶同住。
ext.ext_en: She had walked out and gone to live in Bath with her granny.

defs.def_en: If someone walks out on their family or their partner, they leave them suddenly and go to live somewhere else.

ext.ext_cn: 本周早些时候多数银行职员举行罢工，遍及全国的劳工行动由此开始。
ext.ext_en: Nationwide industrial action began earlier this week, when staff at most banks walked out.

defs.def_en: If workers walk out, they stop doing their work for a period of time, usually in order to try to get better pay or conditions for themselves.

defs.def_cn: (报社、电台或电视台的)新闻编辑室
defs.def_en: A newsroom is an office in a newspaper, radio, or television organization where news reports are prepared before they are printed or broadcast.

ext.ext_cn: 有时候，力求达到她尽善尽美的标准让人觉得很累。
ext.ext_en: It was fatiguing sometimes to try to measure up to her standard of perfection...

ext.ext_cn: 她总是拿我跟别人相比，不知怎的，我总是不如人家。
ext.ext_en: She's always comparing me to other people, and somehow I never measure up.

defs.def_en: If you do not measure up to a standard or to someone's expectations, you are not good enough to achieve the standard or fulfil the person's expectations.
On a motorway, the fast lane is the part of the road where the vehicles that are travelling fastest go.

defs.def_cn: 快节奏生活;忙碌刺激的生活

ext.ext_cn: 快节奏生活的故事
ext.ext_en: ..a tale of life in the fast lane.

ext.ext_cn: 世界板球的快节奏
ext.ext_en: ...the fast lane of world cricket.

defs.def_en: If someone is living in the fast lane, they have a very busy, exciting life, although they sometimes seem to take a lot of risks.

ext.ext_cn: 他想通过计算机实现流程的自动化。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to use computers to automate the process.

defs.def_en: To automate a factory, office, or industrial process means to put in machines which can do the work instead of people.

defs.def_cn: 铜管乐队（由铜管乐器和打击乐器组成）
defs.def_en: A brass band is a band that is made up of brass and percussion instruments.

ext.ext_cn: 一罐腌渍的水果
ext.ext_en: ...a jar of pickled fruit.

ext.ext_cn: 小听腌鲱鱼
ext.ext_en: ...little tins of pickled herring.

defs.def_en: Pickled food, such as vegetables, fruit, and fish, has been kept in vinegar or salt water to preserve it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is pickled, you mean that they are drunk.

defs.def_cn: (通常由暴雨引起的)骤发洪水，暴洪
defs.def_en: A flash flood is a sudden rush of water over dry land, usually caused by a great deal of rain.

ext.ext_cn: 一家独树一帜的小出版公司
ext.ext_en: ...a small one-of-a-kind publishing house.

defs.def_en: You use one-of-a-kind to describe something that is special because there is nothing else exactly like it.

ext.ext_cn: 我得到我的第一台照相机后开心极了。
ext.ext_en: After I was given my first camera I was in seventh heaven.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are in seventh heaven, you mean that you are in a state of complete happiness.
Budgerigars are small, brightly-coloured birds from Australia that people often keep as pets.
A dust sheet is a large cloth which is used to cover objects such as furniture in order to protect them from dust.

defs.def_cn: (命中)注定的;命运决定的;天定的

ext.ext_cn: 他注定不会进球。
ext.ext_en: He was fated not to score.

ext.ext_cn: 关于绝望、天定的姻缘、背叛和谋杀的故事
ext.ext_en: ...stories of desperation, fated love, treachery and murder.

defs.def_en: See also:ill-fated;If you say that a person is fated to do something, or that something is fated, you mean that it seems to have been decided by fate before it happens, and nothing can be done to avoid or change it.

defs.def_cn: (通常指用肘)轻推，轻碰(以引起注意)

ext.ext_cn: 我轻轻推了推斯坦，又指了一下。
ext.ext_en: I nudged Stan and pointed again...

ext.ext_cn: “别这么干了，”他用膝盖轻轻碰了碰那个男孩说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Stop it,' he said, and nudged the boy lightly with his knee.

defs.def_en: If you nudge someone, you push them gently, usually with your elbow, in order to draw their attention to something.

ext.ext_cn: 埃德娜·斯温森把他推进了起居室。
ext.ext_en: Edna Swinson nudged him into the sitting room...

ext.ext_cn: 那个文职人员向前推了他一把。
ext.ext_en: The civil servant nudged him forward.

defs.def_en: If you nudge someone or something into a place or position, you gently push them there.

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃一步一步劝说弗里茨卖掉了他的控股权益。
ext.ext_en: Bit by bit Bob had nudged Fritz into selling his controlling interest...

ext.ext_cn: 外国人必须动用他们的力量促使这个国家变得更加宽容。
ext.ext_en: Foreigners must use their power to nudge the country towards greater tolerance...

defs.def_en: If you nudge someone into doing something, you gently persuade them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 一个年近四旬、一事无成、寂寂无闻的舞台剧作者兼演员
ext.ext_en: ...a little-known stage play writer and actress who was nudging 40 and going nowhere...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在的时候，那里温度接近80华氏度。
ext.ext_en: The temperature when we were there was nudging 80 degree F.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is nudging a particular amount, level, or state, they have almost reached it.

ext.ext_cn: 文章接下来列举了过去两年间报纸上出现过的一连串性丑闻传言。
ext.ext_en: The article then listed a series of nudge-nudge, wink-wink rumors that have appeared in newspapers over the last two years.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a nudge and a wink or to nudge-nudge wink-wink, you mean that someone is referring to sex, especially immoral sex, in an indirect way.
A glossary of special, unusual, or technical words or expressions is an alphabetical list of them giving their meanings, for example at the end of a book on a particular subject.

ext.ext_cn: 一名侍者尽力抹掉溅出的食物。
ext.ext_en: A waiter mopped up the mess as best he could...

ext.ext_cn: 洗衣机喷出水时，我们至少能把水抹干。
ext.ext_en: When the washing machine spurts out water at least we can mop it up...

defs.def_en: If you mop up a liquid, you clean it with a cloth so that the liquid is absorbed.

ext.ext_cn: 陆军各师肃清了残余的抵抗据点。
ext.ext_en: The infantry divisions mopped up remaining centres of resistance...

ext.ext_cn: 这些活性分子已被维生素E灭活，没有害处了。
ext.ext_en: These reactive molecules are mopped up and made harmless by Vitamin E.

defs.def_en: If you mop up something that you think is undesirable or dangerous, you remove it or deal with it so that it is no longer a problem.

ext.ext_cn: 济慈的《夜莺颂》
ext.ext_en: ...Keats' Ode to a Nightingale.

defs.def_en: An ode is a poem, especially one that is written in praise of a particular person, thing, or event.

defs.def_cn: (肉体或内心的)痛苦，苦难，折磨

ext.ext_cn: 他们开始从痛苦的梦魇中慢慢恢复过来。
ext.ext_en: They began to recover slowly from their nightmare of pain and suffering...

ext.ext_cn: 那给动物们带来了可怕的灾难。
ext.ext_en: It has caused terrible suffering to animals...

defs.def_en: See also:long-suffering;Suffering is serious pain which someone feels in their body or their mind.
A cannery is a factory where food is canned.

ext.ext_cn: 当了4年的模特之后她踏上了演艺之路。
ext.ext_en: She pursued an acting career after four years of modelling.

defs.def_en: Acting is the activity or profession of performing in plays or films.

ext.ext_cn: 新任代总统
ext.ext_en: ...the new acting President.

defs.def_en: You use acting before the title of a job to indicate that someone is doing that job temporarily.

ext.ext_cn: 整个晚上，梅利莎都在等汤姆的电话，其间一支接一支地抽着烟。
ext.ext_en: Melissa had chain-smoked all evening while she waited for a phone call from Tom.

defs.def_en: Someone who chain-smokes smokes cigarettes or cigars continuously.

defs.def_cn: （用于存放食物的有盖的）玻璃罐，罐子， 坛子，广口瓶

ext.ext_cn: 存放在大玻璃罐里的黄瓜
ext.ext_en: ...yellow cucumbers in great glass jars.

defs.def_en: A jar is a glass container with a lid that is used for storing food.

ext.ext_cn: 她打开了装满梅子的玻璃罐。
ext.ext_en: She opened up a glass jar of plums.

ext.ext_cn: 两罐滴漏式咖啡
ext.ext_en: ...two jars of filter coffee.

defs.def_en: You can use jar to refer to a jar and its contents, or to the contents only.

ext.ext_cn: 他们一起喝了几杯。
ext.ext_en: They had a few jars together.

defs.def_en: If you have a jar, you have a drink with friends in a pub.

defs.def_cn: 令人不快；使人不安；让人震惊

ext.ext_cn: 有时候一句玩笑就会令她父亲不快。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes a light remark jarred on her father.

ext.ext_cn: 电视里播放的动摇了全国人民对总统信心的国会听证会
ext.ext_en: ...televised congressional hearings that jarred the nation's faith in the presidency...

defs.def_en: If something jars on you, you find it unpleasant, disturbing, or shocking.

ext.ext_cn: 船微微震动了一下。
ext.ext_en: The ship jarred a little...

ext.ext_cn: 冲击力震伤了他的胳膊。
ext.ext_en: The impact jarred his arm.

defs.def_en: If an object jars, or if something jars it, the object moves with a fairly hard shaking movement.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我赶紧跑到帐篷里，抓起了几件虽然有些皱，但是很干净的衣服。
ext.ext_en: I hurried to the tent and grabbed a few clean, if rumpled, clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 一床皱巴巴的白色被单
ext.ext_en: ...a sprawl of white, rumpled sheets...

defs.def_en: Rumpled means creased or untidy.

defs.def_cn: 概括;重述(要点)；简要回顾

ext.ext_cn: 简要概括起来，一项关于削减预算赤字的协议在10天前遭到了否决。
ext.ext_en: To recap briefly, an agreement negotiated to cut the budget deficit was rejected 10 days ago...

ext.ext_cn: 你能扼要说明一下地区会议上提案的重点吗？
ext.ext_en: Can you recap the points included in the regional conference proposal?

defs.def_en: You can say that you are going to recap when you want to draw people's attention to the fact that you are going to repeat the main points of an explanation, argument, or description, as a summary of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她穿了一件露乳沟的低胸连衣裙。
ext.ext_en: She wears a low-cut dress which reveals her breasts...

ext.ext_cn: 我刚出生的宝宝蜷伏在我胸前，细小的手指触碰着我的肌肤。
ext.ext_en: As my newborn cuddled at my breast, her tiny fingers stroked my skin.

defs.def_en: A woman's breasts are the two soft, round parts on her chest that can produce milk to feed a baby.

ext.ext_cn: 他动作夸张地捶打着自己的胸膛。
ext.ext_en: He struck his breast in a dramatic gesture.

defs.def_en: A person's breast is the upper part of his or her chest.

ext.ext_cn: 这首诗激发了他的灵感。
ext.ext_en: The verse rose up to fire his breast with inspiration...

ext.ext_cn: 战场上吼声震天，意在唤起士兵们最昂扬的斗志。
ext.ext_en: The battle roared; a sound calculated to arouse the sublimest emotions in the breast of the soldier.

defs.def_en: The breast is often considered to be the part of your body where your emotions are.

ext.ext_cn: 这只公鸡胸部羽毛呈浅栗色，带有白色细条纹。
ext.ext_en: The cock's breast is tinged with chestnut.

defs.def_en: A bird's breast is the front part of its body.

ext.ext_cn: 他离开遮阳篷，手伸进大衣前胸部找东西。
ext.ext_en: He moved out from beneath an awning, reaching for something inside the breast of his overcoat...

ext.ext_cn: 他把手伸进胸前口袋里拿雪茄烟盒。
ext.ext_en: He reached into his breast pocket for his cigar case.

defs.def_en: The breast of a shirt, jacket, or coat is the part which covers the top part of the chest.

ext.ext_cn: 鸡脯肉拌蔬菜
ext.ext_en: ...a chicken breast with vegetables.

ext.ext_cn: 羊胸肉
ext.ext_en: ...breast of lamb.

defs.def_en: You can refer to piece of meat that is cut from the front of a bird or lamb as breast.

ext.ext_cn: 总裁捶胸顿足，称那是个错误的交易。
ext.ext_en: The president beat his breast and called that deal a mistake.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone beats their breast, you are emphasizing that they are very angry or upset about something, or that they are pretending to be very angry or upset about it.

ext.ext_cn: 我还是坦白的好。我从1975起就变成女人了。
ext.ext_en: I might as well make a clean breast of it. I have been living as a woman since 1975.

defs.def_en: If you make a clean breast of something, you tell someone the truth about yourself or about something wrong that you have done.
Headphones are a pair of padded speakers which you wear over your ears in order to listen to a radio, CD player, or tape recorder without other people hearing it.

ext.ext_cn: 女王要把那笔钱交给她喜欢的一些慈善机构。
ext.ext_en: The Queen is passing the money on to a selection of her favourite charities...

ext.ext_cn: 有传播病毒的风险。
ext.ext_en: There is a risk of passing the virus on...

defs.def_en: If you pass something on to someone, you give it to them so that they have it instead of you.

ext.ext_cn: 他们将借款成本转嫁，将其算到利润率里面。
ext.ext_en: They pass on their cost of borrowing and add it to their profit margin...

ext.ext_cn: 我发现我们能够做些节省，将节省下来的部分让利于顾客是正确的。
ext.ext_en: I found we could make some saving and it is right to pass the savings on to the customer.

defs.def_en: If you pass on costs or savings to someone else, you make them pay for your costs or allow them to benefit from your savings.

ext.ext_cn: 他72岁去世。
ext.ext_en: He passed on at the age of 72.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone passed on to mean that they died, if you want to avoid using the word 'die' because you think it might upset or offend people.

ext.ext_cn: 就算是能从他叔叔那里骗一块钱，他也会去做。
ext.ext_en: If he could beat his uncle out of a dollar he'd do it.

defs.def_en: If someone beats another person out of something, they get that thing by deceiving the other person or behaving dishonestly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 重大的;关键的;有影响的

ext.ext_cn: 派遣部队的重大决定
ext.ext_en: ...the momentous decision to send in the troops...

ext.ext_cn: 过去的3年是世界历史上最重要的时期之一。
ext.ext_en: The past three years have been among the most momentous in world history.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a decision, event, or change as momentous, you mean that it is very important, often because of the effects that it will have in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 黛安娜表示她对萨姆的爱永远不会变。
ext.ext_en: Dianne declared her undying love for Sam...

ext.ext_cn: 他让她感念一生。
ext.ext_en: He had won her undying gratitude...

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's undying feelings, you mean that the feelings are very strong and are unlikely to change.

ext.ext_cn: 他哥哥
ext.ext_en: ...his elder brother.

ext.ext_cn: 她两个女儿中年长的那个
ext.ext_en: ...the elder of her two daughters.

defs.def_en: The elder of two people is the one who was born first.

defs.def_cn: （尤指年纪大很多的）年长者，长辈

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人不尊重他们的长辈。
ext.ext_en: The young have no respect for their elders.

defs.def_en: A person's elder is someone who is older than them, especially someone quite a lot older.

ext.ext_cn: 部落长老
ext.ext_en: ...tribal elders.

defs.def_en: In some societies, an elder is one of the respected older people who have influence and authority.

defs.def_cn: （某些基督教会中不担任牧师的）长老

ext.ext_cn: 他现在是乡村教会的长老。
ext.ext_en: He is now an elder of the village church.

defs.def_en: In some Christian churches, an elder is one of the people who hold a position of responsibility, but not usually a minister.
An elder is a bush or small tree which has groups of small white flowers and black berries.

ext.ext_cn: 那些牛甩动着尾巴驱赶苍蝇。
ext.ext_en: The cattle were swinging their tails to disperse the flies.

ext.ext_cn: 长尾黑狗
ext.ext_en: ...a black dog with a long tail.

defs.def_en: The tail of an animal, bird, or fish is the part extending beyond the end of its body.

ext.ext_cn: 飞机尾部的水平尾翼
ext.ext_en: ...the horizontal stabilizer bar on the plane's tail...

ext.ext_cn: 埃尔西用力拉了拉她丈夫外套的后摆。
ext.ext_en: Elsie tugged her husband's coat tail.

defs.def_en: You can use tail to refer to the end or back of something, especially something long and thin.
If a man is wearing tails, he is wearing a formal jacket which has two long pieces hanging down at the back.

ext.ext_cn: 在一次重大的秘密调查行动中，警察从伦敦就盯上了那帮匪徒。
ext.ext_en: Officers had tailed the gang from London during a major undercover inquiry...

ext.ext_cn: 他十分不信任她，所以派人跟踪她。
ext.ext_en: He trusted her so little that he had her tailed.

defs.def_en: To tail someone means to follow close behind them and watch where they go and what they do.

ext.ext_cn: 他看看身后——没有人跟着。
ext.ext_en: He checked behind. No tail.

defs.def_en: A tail is someone who is paid to watch and to follow another person.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the insultingly Eurocentric bias in the education system.

ext.ext_en: The article had been full of errors and half truths.

defs.def_en: If you have an active mind or imagination, you are always thinking of new things.

ext.ext_cn: 她正坐在餐桌旁，吃着葡萄干圆面包。
ext.ext_en: She was sitting at the kitchen table eating a currant bun...

ext.ext_cn: 我把他的饮料放在他肘边的小桌子上。
ext.ext_en: I placed his drink on the small table at his elbow.

defs.def_en: A table is a piece of furniture with a flat top that you put things on or sit at.

ext.ext_cn: 我想订一张 8:30 左右的双人桌。
ext.ext_en: I'd like a table for two at about 8:30, please...

ext.ext_cn: 我在萨沃伊烧烤店订了张桌子。
ext.ext_en: I booked a table at the Savoy Grill...

defs.def_en: If you ask for a table in a restaurant, you want to have a meal there.

ext.ext_cn: 他们提交了一项动议，批评政府在该问题上无所作为。
ext.ext_en: They've tabled a motion criticising the Government for doing nothing about the problem.

defs.def_en: If someone tables a proposal, they say formally that they want it to be discussed at a meeting.

ext.ext_cn: 那个问题我们留到以后再讨论吧。
ext.ext_en: We will table that for later.

defs.def_en: If someone tables a proposal or plan which has been put forward, they decide to discuss it or deal with it at a later date, rather than straight away.

ext.ext_cn: 参阅 104 页的表格。
ext.ext_en: Consult the table on page 104...

ext.ext_cn: 其他研究也可证实表 3.3 中的数据。
ext.ext_en: Other research supports the figures in Table 3.3.

defs.def_en: A table is a written set of facts and figures arranged in columns and rows.

ext.ext_cn: 他不知道11的乘法口诀。
ext.ext_en: He didn't know his eleven-times table...

ext.ext_cn: 我努力背诵乘法表。
ext.ext_en: I attempted to learn my tables.

defs.def_en: A table is a list of the multiplications of numbers between one and twelve. Children often have to learn tables at school.

ext.ext_cn: 这是我们几年来提交的最好的几套方案之一。
ext.ext_en: This is one of the best packages we've put on the table in years...

ext.ext_cn: 这就意味着，至少所有的选择都已经摆到了桌面上。
ext.ext_en: It means that all the options are at least on the table.

defs.def_en: If you put something on the table, you present it at a meeting for it to be discussed.

ext.ext_cn: 唯一的问题是，总统能否运用他杰出的政治手腕化被动为主动，击败对手。
ext.ext_en: The only question is whether the President can use his extraordinary political skills to turn the tables on his opponents.

defs.def_en: If you turn the tables on someone, you change the situation completely, so that instead of them causing problems for you, you are causing problems for them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她很会卖弄风骚，非常性感。
ext.ext_en: She is amazingly flirty and sensual...

ext.ext_cn: 她的微笑妩媚动人。
ext.ext_en: She had an appealing flirty smile.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as flirty, you mean that they behave towards people in a way which suggests they are sexually attracted to them, usually in a playful or not very serious way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些短裙长度及膝，很有女人味。
ext.ext_en: The skirts were knee-skimming and flirty.

defs.def_en: Flirty clothes are feminine and sexy.
A microsecond is one millionth of a second.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 整个地方的气氛有点阴森可怖。
ext.ext_en: The whole place has a slightly spooky atmosphere.

defs.def_en: A place that is spooky has a frightening atmosphere, and makes you feel that there are ghosts around.

ext.ext_cn: 微生物学与免疫学教授
ext.ext_en: ...a professor of microbiology and immunology.

defs.def_en: Microbiology is the branch of biology which is concerned with very small living things such as bacteria and their effects on people.
A gravestone is a large stone with words carved into it, which is placed on a grave.

ext.ext_cn: 这是最古老、最神圣的神道教仪式。
ext.ext_en: This is the most ancient, and holiest of the Shinto rituals...

ext.ext_cn: 这些仪式已经成为墨西哥基督教时期以前的宗教仪式的一部分。
ext.ext_en: These ceremonies were already part of pre-Christian ritual in Mexico.

defs.def_en: A ritual is a religious service or other ceremony which involves a series of actions performed in a fixed order.

ext.ext_cn: 斋戒和传统舞蹈
ext.ext_en: ...fastings and ritual dancing.

ext.ext_cn: 仪式性的自杀行为
ext.ext_en: ...an act of ritual suicide.

defs.def_en: Ritual activities happen as part of a ritual or tradition.

ext.ext_cn: 整个意大利的文化都以饮食习惯为中心。
ext.ext_en: The whole Italian culture revolves around the ritual of eating...

ext.ext_cn: 到广场饭店喝鸡尾酒是他们这个高雅时髦的圈子中的人每晚必做的事情。
ext.ext_en: Cocktails at the Plaza was a nightly ritual of their sophisticated world.

defs.def_en: A ritual is a way of behaving or a series of actions which people regularly carry out in a particular situation, because it is their custom to do so.

defs.def_cn: 例行公事般的;习惯性的;老规矩的

ext.ext_cn: 我意识到此时按照惯例我应该说些客套话。
ext.ext_en: I realized that here the conventions required me to make the ritual noises.

defs.def_en: You can describe something as a ritual action when it is done in exactly the same way whenever a particular situation occurs.

defs.def_cn: (用于做布丁或意大利面食的)粗面粉
defs.def_en: Semolina consists of small hard grains of wheat that are used for making sweet puddings with milk and for making pasta.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (成功或获胜后)欢欣鼓舞的，狂喜的

ext.ext_cn: 邓肯和他那些欢欣鼓舞的士兵们庆祝他们取得了军事胜利。
ext.ext_en: Duncan and his triumphant soldiers celebrate their military victory…

ext.ext_cn: 上校的声音听上去万分得意。
ext.ext_en: The captain's voice was triumphant...

defs.def_en: Someone who is triumphant has gained a victory or succeeded in something and feels very happy about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 好色的;淫荡的;性欲冲动的

ext.ext_cn: 场面非常刺激撩人，我感到欲火难耐。
ext.ext_en: It was extremely hot and I was feeling rather randy.

defs.def_en: Someone who is randy is sexually excited and eager to have sex.

ext.ext_cn: 来自世界各地的电视工作者和新闻记者齐聚一堂。
ext.ext_en: There were television crews and pressmen from all around the world.

defs.def_en: A pressman is a journalist, especially a man, who works for a newspaper or magazine.

The Security Council is the committee which governs the United Nations. It has permanent representatives from the United States, Russia, China, France, and the United Kingdom, and temporary representatives from some other countries.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一天24小时最新消息即时播报
ext.ext_en: ...24 hours a day up-to-the-minute instant news...

ext.ext_cn: 计算机为他们提供最新的销量和股票方面的信息。
ext.ext_en: Computers give them up-to-the-minute information on sales and stocks.

defs.def_en: Up-to-the-minute information is the latest information that you can get about something.

defs.def_cn: (用于关系从句的句首，表示与前句所提到的人或事物有所属关系或相关联）

ext.ext_cn: 我看见一个男人正朝一个司机叫嚷，他的车把街道堵塞了。
ext.ext_en: I saw a man shouting at a driver whose car was blocking the street.

ext.ext_cn: 一艘快艇，其上船员15人，声称自己属于意大利海军
ext.ext_en: ...a speedboat, whose fifteen-strong crew claimed to belong to the Italian navy.

defs.def_en: You use whose at the beginning of a relative clause where you mention something that belongs to or is associated with the person or thing mentioned in the previous clause.

defs.def_cn: (用于疑问句中，询问某物所属或其与何人何事有关)谁的

ext.ext_cn: 谁表演得更好?
ext.ext_en: Whose was the better performance?...

ext.ext_cn: “这是谁的？”——“是我的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Whose is this?' — 'It's mine.'...

defs.def_en: You use whose in questions to ask about the person or thing that something belongs to or is associated with.

defs.def_cn: (尤用在动词或形容词等后面，引导谈论某物所属或与何人何事相关的从句)谁的

ext.ext_cn: 我很纳闷，那么她是谁的母亲呢？
ext.ext_en: I'm wondering whose mother she is then...

ext.ext_cn: 我记不清我们再次会面是谁的主意了。
ext.ext_en: I can't remember whose idea it was for us to meet again.

defs.def_en: You use whose after certain words, especially verbs and adjectives, to introduce a clause where you talk about the person or thing that something belongs to or is associated with.

defs.def_cn: 领取养老金（或退休金、抚恤金）的人
defs.def_en: A pensioner is someone who receives a pension, especially a pension paid by the state to retired people.

ext.ext_cn: 爸爸，你感觉怎么样？
ext.ext_en: How do you feel, Dad?...

ext.ext_cn: 我跟爸爸谈了谈。
ext.ext_en: I talked to Dad...

defs.def_en: Your dad is your father.

defs.def_cn: 专题论文;（尤指）学位论文

ext.ext_cn: 他目前正在写一篇关于索马里内战的论文。
ext.ext_en: He is currently writing a dissertation on the Somali civil war.

defs.def_en: A dissertation is a long formal piece of writing on a particular subject, especially for a university degree.

defs.def_cn: (在外表、举止、性格方面)像(某家庭成员)

ext.ext_cn: 肯普先生，特德一直很难相处——像他爸。
ext.ext_en: Ted's always been difficult, Mr Kemp — he takes after his dad.

defs.def_en: If you take after a member of your family, you resemble them in your appearance, your behaviour, or your character.

defs.def_cn: (政府或教会的)高官，显要，要员
defs.def_en: Dignitaries are people who are considered to be important because they have a high rank in government or in the Church.

defs.def_cn: （尤指庆祝成功、表示致意等的）举手击掌
defs.def_en: If you give someone a high five, you put your hand up and hit their open hand with yours, especially after a victory or as a greeting.

ext.ext_cn: 色调柔和的浅绿和淡紫色相间的落地窗帘
ext.ext_en: ...floor-length curtains in restful aqua and lavender colours.

defs.def_en: Aqua is the same as the colour aquamarine .

ext.ext_cn: 谁要是违背了约定，就永远不能再在这里进行交易。
ext.ext_en: If someone reneged on a deal, they could never trade here again.

defs.def_en: If someone reneges on a promise or an agreement, they do not do what they have promised or agreed to do.

ext.ext_cn: 他认真地考虑了美国生活中典型的严重浪费问题。
ext.ext_en: He ruminated on the terrible wastage that typified American life...

ext.ext_cn: 有强迫症的人通常过多地思考死亡的问题。
ext.ext_en: Obsessional personalities commonly ruminate excessively about death.

defs.def_en: If you ruminate on something, you think about it very carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 他想看看那两头牛，它们都在反刍，眼睛都不抬一下。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to have a look at the two oxen, both ruminating without raising their eyes.

defs.def_en: When animals ruminate, they bring food back from their stomach into their mouth and chew it again.

ext.ext_cn: 她深感羞愧。
ext.ext_en: She felt a deep sense of shame...

ext.ext_cn: 他们觉得羞愧和内疚,就好像这是他们的错。
ext.ext_en: They feel shame and guilt as though it is their fault...

defs.def_en: Shame is an uncomfortable feeling that you get when you have done something wrong or embarrassing, or when someone close to you has.

ext.ext_cn: 我不想玷污家族的名声。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to bring shame on the family name...

ext.ext_cn: 他选择了自杀,不愿面对牵扯进这桩丑闻所带来的耻辱。
ext.ext_en: He committed suicide rather than face the shame of being linked to the scandal.

defs.def_en: If someone brings shame on you, they make other people lose their respect for you.

defs.def_cn: 使羞愧;使惭愧;使难为情

ext.ext_cn: 儿子的事让她感到难堪和羞愧。
ext.ext_en: Her son's affair had humiliated and shamed her.

defs.def_en: If something shames you, it causes you to feel shame.

ext.ext_cn: 我不会做那种事让我父亲丢脸。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't shame my father by trying that.

defs.def_en: If you shame someone close to you, you make people lose their respect for that person, by behaving in an unacceptable way.

defs.def_cn: 使…感到羞愧(而不得不做…)

ext.ext_cn: 邻居们试图想让他自感羞愧而从此闭口，他是不会乖乖就范的。
ext.ext_en: He would not let neighbours shame him into silence...

ext.ext_cn: 博物馆现在已经深感羞愧，不再变卖他们收藏的珍宝了。
ext.ext_en: Museums have now been shamed out of selling the treasures from their collections.

defs.def_en: If you shame someone into doing something, you force them to do it by making them feel ashamed not to.

defs.def_cn: 令人惋惜的事;让人遗憾的事

ext.ext_cn: 警察得忍受这些无谓的攻击，真是太不像话了。
ext.ext_en: It's a crying shame that police have to put up with these mindless attacks...

ext.ext_cn: 他们没有足够的钱去收养一个孩子，真让人惋惜。
ext.ext_en: They did not have enough money to adopt a child. It was such a shame.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a shame, you are expressing your regret about it and indicating that you wish it had happened differently.

ext.ext_cn: 他还想抵赖，真不害臊！
ext.ext_en: He tried to deny it. Shame on him!

defs.def_en: You can use shame in expressions such as shame on you and shame on him to indicate that someone ought to feel shame for something they have said or done.

defs.def_cn: 使自惭形秽;使相形见绌;使自愧不如

ext.ext_cn: 他的表演真让我自惭形秽。
ext.ext_en: His playing really put me to shame.

defs.def_en: If someone puts you to shame, they make you feel ashamed because they do something much better than you do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 依靠这样的证据是草率的。
ext.ext_en: It would be rash to rely on such evidence...

ext.ext_cn: 梅杰先生没有作出轻率的承诺。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Major is making no rash promises...

defs.def_en: If someone is rash or does rash things, they act without thinking carefully first, and therefore make mistakes or behave foolishly.

ext.ext_cn: 我发现我腿上长了疹子。
ext.ext_en: I noticed a rash on my leg...

ext.ext_cn: 他吃了这些坚果可能会长皮疹。
ext.ext_en: He may break out in a rash when he eats these nuts...

defs.def_en: A rash is an area of red spots that appears on your skin when you are ill or have a bad reaction to something that you have eaten or touched.

defs.def_cn: 大量，许多（令人不快的事情）

ext.ext_cn: 他们认为今年春天一连串的自杀事件是由这次混乱引起的。
ext.ext_en: They believe this confusion is responsible for a rash of suicides this spring.

ext.ext_cn: 没有受到行业内大量收购风波波及的少数几个重要航空公司之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the few major airlines left untouched by the industry's rash of takeovers...

defs.def_en: If you talk about a rash of events or things, you mean a large number of unpleasant events or undesirable things, which have happened or appeared within a short period of time.

defs.def_cn: 可资弥补的特点;补偿因素;可取之处;仅有的优点

ext.ext_cn: 上了年纪的一个好处是不再那般担心别人的看法。
ext.ext_en: Ageing's one saving grace is you worry less about what people think.

defs.def_en: A saving grace is a good quality or feature in a person or thing that prevents them from being completely bad or worthless.

ext.ext_cn: 开阔的火山坡让人心生怪异地联想起月球的地貌。
ext.ext_en: The vast volcanic slope was eerily reminiscent of a lunar landscape.

ext.ext_cn: 一篇庆祝人类首次登月周年纪念的杂志文章
ext.ext_en: ...a magazine article celebrating the anniversary of man's first lunar landing.

defs.def_en: Lunar means relating to the moon.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 回避的;避而不谈的；含糊其词的

ext.ext_cn: 他避而不谈他和斯坦利·迪安第一次会面的情况。
ext.ext_en: He was evasive about the circumstances of his first meeting with Stanley Dean...

ext.ext_cn: 直接的提问得到的几乎肯定会是含糊其词的回答。
ext.ext_en: Direct questions would almost certainly result in evasive answers.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as evasive, you mean that they deliberately avoid giving clear direct answers to questions.

ext.ext_cn: 至少有4架高空飞行战斗机不得不采取避让行动。
ext.ext_en: At least four high-flying warplanes had to take evasive action.

defs.def_en: If you take evasive action, you deliberately move away from someone or something in order to avoid meeting them or being hit by them.

defs.def_cn: (尤指专业人员的)渎职，不端行为，不当行为

ext.ext_cn: 在把机密文件交给新闻界之后，他就因严重渎职而被解职了。
ext.ext_en: He was dismissed from his job for gross misconduct after handing over confidential documents to the press...

ext.ext_cn: 李医生严重渎职的罪名被撤销了。
ext.ext_en: Dr Lee was cleared of serious professional misconduct.

defs.def_en: Misconduct is bad or unacceptable behaviour, especially by a professional person.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在一堆堆的二手衣服里翻找着合身的衣服。
ext.ext_en: They rummage through piles of second-hand clothes for something that fits...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽安娜在冰箱里翻了翻。
ext.ext_en: Marianne went to rummage in the refrigerator.

defs.def_en: If you rummage through something, you search for something you want by moving things around in a careless or hurried way.

ext.ext_cn: 大量慈善捐赠品
ext.ext_en: ...loads of pitiful rummage.

defs.def_en: Rummage is old or unwanted things that people give away to charities.

ext.ext_cn: 他有一间足以容纳书桌、椅子和视频显示器的办公室。
ext.ext_en: He had an office big enough for his desk and chair, plus his VDU...

ext.ext_cn: 大约下午4点30分，奥德丽到了办公室。
ext.ext_en: At about 4.30 p.m. Audrey arrived at the office...

defs.def_en: An office is a room or a part of a building where people work sitting at desks.

ext.ext_cn: 已有数千人在失业管理处作了登记。
ext.ext_en: Thousands have registered with unemployment offices.

ext.ext_cn: 唐宁街新闻办公室
ext.ext_en: ...Downing Street's press office.

defs.def_en: An office is a department of an organization, especially the government, where people deal with a particular kind of administrative work.

defs.def_cn: （问询、购票或提供服务的）处，所

ext.ext_cn: 这家旅游办事处提供十分实用的住宿查询服务。
ext.ext_en: The tourist office operates a useful room-finding service.

ext.ext_cn: 航空公司售票处
ext.ext_en: ...the airline ticket offices.

defs.def_en: An office is a small building or room where people can go for information, tickets, or a service of some kind.
A doctor's or dentist's office is a place where a doctor or dentist sees their patients.

ext.ext_cn: 总统任职10周年的庆祝活动按计划进行。
ext.ext_en: The events to mark the President's ten years in office went ahead as planned...

ext.ext_cn: 他们再也无法忍受这些政客，希望通过选举把他们赶下台。
ext.ext_en: They are fed up with the politicians and want to vote them out of office...

defs.def_en: If someone holds office in a government, they have an important job or position of authority.

ext.ext_cn: 为了使该法案顺利通过，她寻求总统的帮助。
ext.ext_en: She sought the good offices of the President for the smooth passage of the Bill.

defs.def_en: Someone's good offices are the help that they give to other people who are trying to achieve something.

ext.ext_cn: 杜克在本月的路易斯安那州长竞选中大败而归。
ext.ext_en: Duke was soundly defeated in this month's Louisiana governor's race.

defs.def_en: If someone is soundly defeated or beaten, they are severely defeated or beaten.

defs.def_cn: (决定、观点或陈述等)正确地，明智地，可靠地

ext.ext_cn: 今天的希望是否比 1990 年那些虚幻的希望更靠谱呢？
ext.ext_en: Are today's hopes more soundly based than the false ones of 1990?...

ext.ext_cn: 改革必须以经济现状作为切实的依据。
ext.ext_en: Changes must be soundly based in economic reality.

defs.def_en: If a decision, opinion, or statement is soundly based, there are sensible or reliable reasons behind it.

ext.ext_cn: 他晚上怎么能睡得着觉？
ext.ext_en: How can he sleep soundly at night?...

ext.ext_cn: 她睡得太熟，没有听见斯蒂芬诺回来。
ext.ext_en: She was too soundly asleep to hear Stefano's return.

defs.def_en: If you sleep soundly, you sleep deeply and do not wake during your sleep.

ext.ext_cn: 两家航空公司将在票务和航班安排上展开合作。
ext.ext_en: The two airlines will cooperate on ticketing and schedules.

ext.ext_cn: 自动售票机
ext.ext_en: ...automatic ticketing machines.

defs.def_en: Ticketing is the act or activity of selling tickets.

ext.ext_cn: 我看到他走上前，但很快又缩了回来，紧张地搓着手。
ext.ext_en: I saw him step forward momentarily but then hang back, nervously massaging his hands.

defs.def_en: If you hang back, you move or stay slightly behind a person or group, usually because you are nervous about something.

ext.ext_cn: 他们接着会拖延生意的成交。

ext.ext_cn: 约两万名来看比赛的观众都希望能身处球场之上。
ext.ext_en: The 20,000 or however many who come to watch would love to be out on the pitch...

ext.ext_cn: 等30到60分钟左右。
ext.ext_en: Wait 30 to 60 minutes or however long it takes.

defs.def_en: You use however in expressions such as or however long it takes and or however many there were to indicate that the figure you have just mentioned may not be accurate.

defs.def_cn: 究竟怎样，到底如何（用于强调地询问令人吃惊的事情;一些人认为此用法不正确，用how ever较为妥当）

ext.ext_cn: 你到底是怎样在这样的天气里找到这个地方的？
ext.ext_en: However did you find this place in such weather?

defs.def_en: You can use however to ask in an emphatic way how something has happened which you are very surprised about. Some speakers of English think that this form is incorrect and prefer to use 'how ever'.
Thermodynamics is the branch of physics that is concerned with the relationship between heat and other forms of energy.

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽去世后，安妮并没有像她弟弟那样哀痛。
ext.ext_en: When Mary died Anne did not share her brother's sense of bereavement.

ext.ext_cn: 那些遭受丧亲之痛的人
ext.ext_en: ...those who have suffered a bereavement.

defs.def_en: Bereavement is the sorrow you feel or the state you are in when a relative or close friend dies.
In Britain, the Privy Council is a group of people who are appointed to advise the king or queen on political affairs.

ext.ext_cn: 该政权正是罪恶的化身。
ext.ext_en: The regime was the very incarnation of evil...

ext.ext_cn: 她是魅力的完美化身。
ext.ext_en: She is a perfect incarnation of glamour.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is the incarnation of a particular quality, you mean that they represent that quality or are typical of it in an extreme form.

ext.ext_cn: 她开始回忆起前世的种种情形。
ext.ext_en: She began recalling a series of previous incarnations...

ext.ext_cn: 他的勤奋与坚持表明他前世是只蚂蚁。
ext.ext_en: His industry and persistence suggest that he was an ant in a previous incarnation.

defs.def_en: An incarnation is an instance of being alive on earth in a particular form. Some religions believe that people have several incarnations in different forms.

ext.ext_cn: 你了解这场革命运动吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you know anything about the revolutionary movement?

ext.ext_cn: 古巴革命领导人何塞·马蒂
ext.ext_en: ...the Cuban revolutionary leader, Jose Marti.

defs.def_en: Revolutionary activities, organizations, or people have the aim of causing a political revolution.

ext.ext_cn: 革命者放下了武器，其领导人也自愿流亡他国了。
ext.ext_en: The revolutionaries laid down their arms and its leaders went into voluntary exile.

defs.def_en: A revolutionary is a person who tries to cause a revolution or who takes an active part in one.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 革命性的;突破性的;发生重大变革的

ext.ext_cn: 1951年发明的转缸式发动机是内燃机领域内的革命性概念。
ext.ext_en: Invented in 1951, the rotary engine is a revolutionary concept in internal combustion...

ext.ext_cn: 他的小号演奏独创一格。
ext.ext_en: His playing as a trumpet player was quite revolutionary.

defs.def_en: Revolutionary ideas and developments involve great changes in the way that something is done or made.

ext.ext_cn: 她感觉他的那番话好似给她下了道赦令。
ext.ext_en: She felt as if his words had granted her absolution.

defs.def_en: If someone is given absolution, they are forgiven for something wrong that they have done.
Some people use shit to refer to solid waste matter from the body of a human being or animal.
To shit means to get rid of solid waste matter from the body.
To have a shit means to get rid of solid waste matter from the body.

defs.def_cn: (生病或害怕时的)腹泻,拉肚子
defs.def_en: If someone has the shits, liquid waste matter keeps coming out of their body because they are ill or afraid.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一堆废物。
ext.ext_en: This is a load of shit.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to things that they do not like as shit .
People sometimes insult someone they do not like by referring to them as a shit .

defs.def_cn: （表示愤怒、不耐烦或厌恶)该死,妈的
defs.def_en: Shit is used to express anger, impatience, or disgust.
If someone says they are shitting themselves, they mean that they are very frightened.

defs.def_cn: 狠揍;痛扁;把…打得屁滚尿流
defs.def_en: To beat or kick the shit out of someone means to beat or kick them so violently that they are badly injured.

defs.def_cn: 灾难临头;惹麻烦;走霉运
defs.def_en: If someone says that the shit hit the fan, they mean that there was suddenly a lot of trouble or angry arguments.

defs.def_cn: 一点不在乎;毫不关心;根本不放在心上
defs.def_en: If someone says that they do not give a shit about something, they mean that they do not care about it at all.

defs.def_cn: 遇到大麻烦;陷入困境;倒大霉
defs.def_en: If someone is in the shit or in deep shit, they are in a lot of trouble.

defs.def_cn: (虽然不喜欢却不得不接受)糟透了，倒霉
defs.def_en: Tough shit can be used as a way of telling someone that they will have to accept a situation they do not like because they have no choice.

defs.def_cn: (尤指发展中国家的)小额信贷

ext.ext_cn: 为小型企业提供信贷的小额信贷计划
ext.ext_en: ...a microcredit scheme which provides credit to small businesses.

defs.def_en: Microcredit is credit in the form of small loans offered to local businesses, especially in developing countries.

ext.ext_cn: 威尼斯一日观光游
ext.ext_en: ...a day's sight-seeing in Venice.

ext.ext_cn: 观光旅行
ext.ext_en: ...a sightseeing tour.

defs.def_en: If you go sightseeing or do some sightseeing, you travel around visiting the interesting places that tourists usually visit.

defs.def_cn: 甲壳纲动物(如螃蟹、龙虾和褐虾)
defs.def_en: A crustacean is an animal with a hard shell and several pairs of legs, which usually lives in water. Crabs, lobsters, and shrimps are crustaceans.

ext.ext_cn: 他设法与两个共和国都达成了部分协议。
ext.ext_en: He managed to reach a partial agreement with both republics.

ext.ext_cn: 市内部分地段轿车禁行令
ext.ext_en: ...a partial ban on the use of cars in the city.

defs.def_en: You use partial to refer to something that is not complete or whole.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢爱运动的蓝眼睛女子。
ext.ext_en: He's partial to sporty women with blue eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 莫莉承认她偏爱粉红色。
ext.ext_en: Mollie confesses she is rather partial to pink...

defs.def_en: If you are partial to something, you like it.

ext.ext_cn: 可能会有人骂我偏心。
ext.ext_en: I might be accused of being partial...

ext.ext_cn: 一家报纸批评总统的提议，称该提议偏袒以色列。
ext.ext_en: A newspaper criticized the president's proposal, saying that it was partial to Israel.

defs.def_en: Someone who is partial supports a particular person or thing, for example in a competition or dispute, instead of being completely fair.

defs.def_cn: （用枪或在电脑游戏中等）杀死，摧毁，击中

ext.ext_cn: 一名警卫用眩晕枪击中了他。
ext.ext_en: A guard zapped him with the stun gun.

ext.ext_cn: 彻底消除我喉咙肿痛的咽喉喷雾剂
ext.ext_en: ...throat spray, which absolutely zaps any remnant of my sore throat.

defs.def_en: To zap someone or something means to kill, destroy, or hit them, for example with a gun or in a computer game.

ext.ext_cn: 男人喜欢不停地换台，这会让一些女人抓狂。
ext.ext_en: Men like to zap the TV channels, something that can drive certain women berserk.

defs.def_en: If you zap channels while watching television, you change channels using the remote control.

defs.def_cn: 删除，从屏幕上清除（计算机文件）
defs.def_en: To zap something such as a computer file or document means to to delete it from the computer memory or to clear it from the screen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯特很想谈谈陆军生活。
ext.ext_en: Robert was eager to talk about life in the Army...

ext.ext_cn: 我家儿子5岁的时候，我特别想再要一个孩子。
ext.ext_en: When my own son was five years old, I became eager for another baby...

defs.def_en: If you are eager to do or have something, you want to do or have it very much.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （看起来或听上去）急切的，期盼的

ext.ext_cn: 阿蒂对他身边那些期盼的面孔嗤之以鼻。
ext.ext_en: Arty sneered at the crowd of eager faces around him...

ext.ext_cn: 她的声音像个小姑娘似的，而且带着一股急不可耐。
ext.ext_en: Her voice was girlish and eager.

defs.def_en: If you look or sound eager, you look or sound as if you expect something interesting or enjoyable to happen.
A bank account is an arrangement with a bank which allows you to keep your money in the bank and to take some out when you need it.
Someone's second name is their family name, or the name that comes after their first name and before their family name.

ext.ext_cn: 人口增长率正在以每年 1.4% 的速度下降。
ext.ext_en: Population growth is decreasing by 1.4% each year...

ext.ext_cn: 独立公司的数量从 198 个减少到了 96个。
ext.ext_en: The number of independent firms decreased from 198 to 96...

defs.def_en: When something decreases or when you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

ext.ext_cn: 失业青年人数的减少
ext.ext_en: ...a decrease in the number of young people out of work...

ext.ext_cn: 银行的基本利率已从 10% 降到了 6%，降幅高达 40%。
ext.ext_en: Bank base rates have fallen from 10 per cent to 6 per cent — a decrease of 40 per cent.

defs.def_en: A decrease in the quantity, size, or intensity of something is a reduction in it.

ext.ext_cn: 面对不想做的事情，我们经常拖延。
ext.ext_en: Most often we procrastinate when faced with something we do not want to do.

defs.def_en: If you procrastinate, you keep leaving things you should do until later, often because you do not want to do them.

ext.ext_cn: 他在酒吧里一直呆到打烊。
ext.ext_en: He was in the pub until closing time...

ext.ext_cn: 理查德曾经开过酒吧。
ext.ext_en: Richard used to run a pub.

defs.def_en: A pub is a building where people can have drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, and talk to their friends. Many pubs also serve food.  →see usage note at:bar

ext.ext_cn: 一直有人鼓励她去游泳以强健体魄。
ext.ext_en: She has always been encouraged to swim to build up the strength of her muscles...

ext.ext_cn: 他使尽全力把它扔向前方。
ext.ext_en: He threw it forward with all his strength...

defs.def_en: Your strength is the physical energy that you have, which gives you the ability to perform various actions, such as lifting or moving things.

ext.ext_cn: 有些事给了我克服困难的勇气。
ext.ext_en: Something gave me the strength to overcome the difficulty...

ext.ext_cn: 他的自信是对我人生的一种鼓舞。
ext.ext_en: His strength is an inspiration to me in my life...

defs.def_en: Someone's strength in a difficult situation is their confidence or courage.

ext.ext_cn: 他检查了一下钢索的强度。
ext.ext_en: He checked the strength of the cables.

ext.ext_cn: 一种材料的特性，比如强度或导电性
ext.ext_en: ...the properties of a material, such as strength or electrical conductivity.

defs.def_en: The strength of an object or material is its ability to be treated roughly, or to carry heavy weights, without being damaged or destroyed.

ext.ext_cn: 美国重视其经济领导地位以及随之产生的政治和军事实力。
ext.ext_en: America values its economic leadership, and the political and military strength that goes with it...

ext.ext_cn: 该联盟的第一次实力展示便吸引了 10 万余众参加集会。
ext.ext_en: The Alliance in its first show of strength drew a hundred thousand-strong crowd to a rally...

defs.def_en: The strength of a person, organization, or country is the power or influence that they have.

defs.def_cn: (情感、意见、信念的)深度，强烈程度，影响程度

ext.ext_cn: 他感情之强烈令他自己都很吃惊。
ext.ext_en: He was surprised at the strength of his own feeling...

ext.ext_cn: 内战以及其在西班牙民众中所激发的强烈情感
ext.ext_en: ...the Civil War and the strength of feeling it had engendered among the Spanish people...

defs.def_en: If you refer to the strength of a feeling, opinion, or belief, you are talking about how deeply it is felt or believed by people, or how much they are influenced by it.

ext.ext_cn: 考虑一下你自己的优缺点。
ext.ext_en: Take into account your own strengths and weaknesses...

ext.ext_cn: 目光远大、雄心勃勃是他的两大优点。
ext.ext_en: Vision and ambition are his great strengths...

defs.def_en: Someone's strengths are the qualities and abilities that they have which are an advantage to them, or which make them successful.

ext.ext_cn: 美国经济的长期竞争力
ext.ext_en: ...the long-term competitive strength of the American economy...

ext.ext_cn: 下降的部分原因在于英镑对美元的升值。
ext.ext_en: The drop was caused partly by the pound's strength against the dollar.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the strength of a currency, economy, or industry, you mean that its value or success is steady or increasing.

ext.ext_cn: 约占军队总人数1/10的精锐部队
ext.ext_en: ...elite forces, comprising about one-tenth of the strength of the army.

defs.def_en: The strength of a group of people is the total number of people in it.

ext.ext_cn: 它的振动幅度取决于引力场的强度。
ext.ext_en: Its oscillation depends on the strength of the gravitational field...

ext.ext_cn: 在大西洋东部，一场热带风暴的风力正逐渐增强。
ext.ext_en: A tropical storm is gaining strength in the eastern Atlantic.

defs.def_en: The strength of a wind, current, or other force is its power or speed.

defs.def_cn: (饮料、化学品、药品的)浓度，浓淡程度

ext.ext_cn: 它的酒精浓度很高，有时接近波尔图葡萄酒的浓度。
ext.ext_en: It is very alcoholic, sometimes near the strength of port...

ext.ext_cn: 根据所需剂量的浓度不同，每颗胶囊里含有 30 至 100 个吗啡硫酸盐颗粒。
ext.ext_en: Each capsule contains between 30 and 100 pellets of morphine sulphate according to the strength of dose required...

defs.def_en: The strength of a drink, chemical, or drug is the amount of the particular substance in it that gives it its particular effect.

defs.def_cn: (味道、气味、颜色、声音、光照的)程度

ext.ext_cn: 该酒口味醇厚。
ext.ext_en: The wine has lots of strength of flavour.

defs.def_en: You can talk about the strength of a flavour, smell, colour, sound, or light to describe how intense or easily noticed it is.

defs.def_cn: 日益兴隆;不断取得成功;信心倍增

ext.ext_cn: 做过心肺移植手术后，她的身体不断好转。
ext.ext_en: Since her heart and lung transplant operation she has gone from strength to strength...

ext.ext_cn: 十年后，该公司已经逐渐壮大。
ext.ext_en: A decade later, the company has gone from strength to strength.

defs.def_en: If a person or organization goes from strength to strength, they become more and more successful or confident.

defs.def_cn: (队伍或军队的)全员，满员，最佳阵容

ext.ext_cn: 他需要更多时间来增派兵力，以确保驻扎在那里的美国军队兵力充足。
ext.ext_en: He needed more time to bring US forces there up to full strength.

ext.ext_cn: 阵容齐整的队伍
ext.ext_en: ...a full-strength team.

defs.def_en: If a team or army is at full strength, all the members that it needs or usually has are present.

ext.ext_cn: 戈尔先生号召选民和政党工作人员积极前来投票。
ext.ext_en: Mr Gore called on voters and party workers to turn out in strength...

ext.ext_cn: 已经出动了大批安全部队。
ext.ext_en: Security forces have been out in strength.

defs.def_en: If a group turns out in strength, they arrive in large numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 他凭借其个人魅力而当选掌权。
ext.ext_en: He was elected to power on the strength of his charisma...

ext.ext_cn: 凭借那些成绩，他赢得了锡拉丘兹大学的奖学金。
ext.ext_en: On the strength of those grades, he won a scholarship to Syracuse University.

defs.def_en: If one thing is done on the strength of another, it is done because of the influence of that other thing.

defs.def_cn: (军队或队伍)人员不足，阵容不全

ext.ext_cn: 他的几个团兵力严重不足。
ext.ext_en: His regiments were considerably under strength...

ext.ext_cn: 他们被一支阵容不齐的队伍打败了。
ext.ext_en: They had been beaten by a below-strength side.

defs.def_en: If an army or team is under strength or below strength, it does not have all the members that it needs or usually has.
A tape measure is a strip of metal, plastic, or cloth which has numbers marked on it and is used for measuring.

defs.def_cn: （尤指汽车或其他交通工具座位前）伸腿的空间，放腿的空间

ext.ext_cn: 个子高的司机会没有足够的空间伸腿。
ext.ext_en: Tall drivers won't have enough leg room.

defs.def_en: Leg room is the amount of space, especially in a car or other vehicle, that is available in front of your legs.

ext.ext_cn: 禁止在报刊杂志上刊登香烟广告的法律
ext.ext_en: ...a law that prohibits tobacco advertising in newspapers and magazines...

ext.ext_cn: 禁止钓鱼。
ext.ext_en: Fishing is prohibited...

defs.def_en: If a law or someone in authority prohibits something, they forbid it or make it illegal.

ext.ext_cn: 他前途未卜。
ext.ext_en: His future remains on a knife edge...

ext.ext_cn: 比赛形势扑朔迷离。一个失误或是一点运气就有可能决定胜负。
ext.ext_en: The game is poised on a knife-edge. One mistake or one piece of good luck could decide it.

defs.def_en: To be on a knife-edge means to be in a situation in which nobody knows what is going to happen next, or in which one thing is just as likely to happen as another.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 今晚投票的结果很难预料，双方实力可能会很接近，这令人紧张不安。
ext.ext_en: Tonight's knife-edge vote could be uncomfortably close.

defs.def_en: You can use knife-edge to refer to something that is very exciting or tense because you do not know what is going to happen next.

ext.ext_cn: 他是一位才华横溢的音乐家。
ext.ext_en: He was a brilliant musician.

ext.ext_cn: 英国最知名的摇滚乐手之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of Britain's best known rock musicians.

defs.def_en: A musician is a person who plays a musical instrument as their job or hobby.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as dippy, you mean that they are slightly odd or unusual, but in a way that you find charming and attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 地上结霜了，而且预报说会有雪。
ext.ext_en: There is frost on the ground and snow is forecast...

ext.ext_cn: 风向已经转北，带来了晴朗的天空和严重的霜冻。
ext.ext_en: The wind had veered to north, bringing clear skies and a keen frost.

defs.def_en: When there is frost or a frost, the temperature outside falls below freezing point and the ground becomes covered in ice crystals.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天夜里气温降到了零下 11 度。
ext.ext_en: We had 11 degrees of frost last night.

defs.def_en: When someone says that there are a particular number of degrees of frost they mean that the temperature is that number of degrees below freezing point.

ext.ext_cn: 她双手放在腿上静静等候。
ext.ext_en: She waited quietly with her hands in her lap...

ext.ext_cn: 休瞥了一眼坐在她妈妈膝上的小女孩。
ext.ext_en: Hugh glanced at the child on her mother's lap.

defs.def_en: If you have something on your lap when you are sitting down, it is on top of your legs and near to your body.

ext.ext_cn: 比赛最后一圈
ext.ext_en: ...that last lap of the race...

ext.ext_cn: 第二圈时，贝克悄然赶了上去。
ext.ext_en: On lap two, Baker edged forward.

defs.def_en: In a race, a competitor completes a lap when they have gone round a course once.

ext.ext_cn: 他在套圈超越一位落后的车手时出了错。
ext.ext_en: He was caught out while lapping a slower rider.

defs.def_en: In a race, if you lap another competitor, you go past them while they are still on the previous lap.

ext.ext_cn: 我原以为我们最远能到达橡树谷，结果只走完了第一段路程。
ext.ext_en: I had thought we might travel as far as Oak Valley, but we only managed the first lap of the journey.

defs.def_en: A lap of a long journey is one part of it, between two points where you stop.

ext.ext_cn: 轻拍着船屋支柱的海水
ext.ext_en: ...the water that lapped against the pillars of the boathouse...

ext.ext_cn: 救援人员到达时上涨的潮水已经淹到了他的下巴。
ext.ext_en: With a rising tide the water was lapping at his chin before rescuers arrived...

defs.def_en: When water laps against something such as the shore or the side of a boat, it touches it gently and makes a soft sound.

ext.ext_cn: 猫舔食盘中牛奶。
ext.ext_en: The cat lapped milk from a dish.

ext.ext_cn: 她往一个塑料碗里倒了一些水，她的大丹犬福斯特便美滋滋地舔起来。
ext.ext_en: She poured some water into a plastic bowl. Faust, her Great Dane, lapped it up with relish.

defs.def_en: When an animal laps a drink, it uses short quick movements of its tongue to take liquid up into its mouth.

defs.def_cn: （成败）难以预料，非人力所能左右

ext.ext_cn: 他们不得不停止手术，所以那时的我只能听天由命。
