ext.ext_cn: 《天生赢家》，一部关于一位拥有数千万家财的平民党政治候选人的怪诞预言性喜剧
ext.ext_en: ...'Bob Roberts', an eerily prescient comedy about a populist multimillionaire political candidate.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something was prescient, you mean that they were able to know or predict what was going to happen in the future.
A chatterer is the same as a chatterbox .
A bag is a container made of thin paper or plastic, for example one that is used in shops to put things in that a customer has bought.

ext.ext_cn: 她提着一个购物袋离开了酒店。
ext.ext_en: She left the hotel carrying a shopping bag.

defs.def_en: A bag is a strong container with one or two handles, used to carry things in.
A bag is the same as a handbag .  →see usage note at:baggage
If you have bags under your eyes, you have folds of skin there, usually because you have not had enough sleep.

ext.ext_cn: 很有特色的酒店
ext.ext_en: ...a hotel with bags of character.

defs.def_en: If you say there is bags of something, you mean that there is a large amount of it. If you say that there are bags of things, you mean that there are a large number of them.
If someone calls a woman an old bag or a stupid bag, they are insulting her.

ext.ext_cn: 聪明人早已在座位上放一张卡片占住了位子。
ext.ext_en: The smart ones will have already bagged their seats by placing cards on them.

defs.def_en: If you bag something that a lot of people want, you get it for yourself before anyone else can get it.

defs.def_cn: 囊中之物；稳操胜券；十拿九稳

ext.ext_cn: “我会得到共和党提名的，”他向我保证，“这是十拿九稳的事。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'll get the Republican nomination,' he assured me. 'It's  in the bag.'

defs.def_en: If you say that something is in the bag, you mean that you are certain that you will get it or achieve it.

defs.def_cn: 背别人甩掉的包袱；背黑锅

ext.ext_cn: 如果出了什么问题，我可不想替人背黑锅。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to be left holding the bag if something goes wrong.

defs.def_en: If you are left holding the bag, you are put in a situation where you are responsible for something, often in an unfair way because other people fail or refuse to take responsibility for it.

ext.ext_cn: 警察来到他的酒店，命令他收拾行李走人。
ext.ext_en: Police arrived at his hotel and ordered him to pack his bags.

defs.def_en: If you pack your bags, you leave a place where you have been staying or living.
Conkers are round brown nuts which come from horse chestnut trees.

defs.def_cn: 康克戏(一种儿童游戏，双方用系在细绳上的七叶树果猛击对方的七叶树果，击破对方者获胜）
defs.def_en: Conkers is a children's game in which you tie a conker to a piece of string and try to break your opponent's conker by hitting it as hard as you can with your own.

ext.ext_cn: 黎明时分天气阴沉，云幕低垂。
ext.ext_en: The day dawned sunless and with a low cloud base.

defs.def_en: On sunless days, the sun does not shine.

ext.ext_cn: 卡门留在那个黑漆漆不见阳光的屋子里。
ext.ext_en: Carmen stayed behind in the dark, sunless room.

defs.def_en: Sunless places are not lit by the sun.

ext.ext_cn: 世界冠军领先第二名2秒多钟到达终点。
ext.ext_en: The world champion finished more than two seconds ahead of his nearest rival...

ext.ext_cn: 他在一场残酷的权力争斗中将对手一一铲除。
ext.ext_en: He eliminated his rivals in a brutal struggle for power...

defs.def_en: Your rival is a person, business, or organization who you are competing or fighting against in the same area or for the same things.

defs.def_cn: 没有敌手;独一无二;无人能及

ext.ext_cn: 在罗纳河地区独一无二的无比香醇的葡萄酒
ext.ext_en: ...a wonderfully fragrant wine which has no rivals in the Rhone...

ext.ext_cn: 他是最好的面点师。
ext.ext_en: He is a pastry chef without rival.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has no rivals or is without rival, you mean that it is best of its type.

defs.def_cn: 能与…媲美;与…匹敌;与…不分高低

ext.ext_cn: 卡式磁带录音机的音质无法和CD相媲美。
ext.ext_en: Cassette recorders cannot rival the sound quality of CDs...

ext.ext_cn: 一种流行病可能会袭击英国，其危害程度不亚于1989年导致26,000人丧生的疾病。
ext.ext_en: An epidemic to rival that which killed 26,000 in 1989 may hit the UK.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing rivals another, you mean that they are both of the same standard or quality.

ext.ext_cn: 他要了一瓶葡萄酒。
ext.ext_en: He ordered a carafe of wine.

ext.ext_cn: 晚饭时,和知己分享半壶美酒。
ext.ext_en: At dinner, share a half carafe of agreeable wine with an agreeable companion.

defs.def_en: A carafe is a glass container in which you serve water or wine.

ext.ext_cn: 利用午饭时间坐在椅子上打个盹吧。
ext.ext_en: Use your lunch hour to have a nap in your chair...

ext.ext_cn: 我可能会打个盹。
ext.ext_en: I might take a little nap.

defs.def_en: If you have a nap, you have a short sleep, usually during the day.

ext.ext_cn: 老年人白天会小睡一会儿，然后晚上只睡5个小时。
ext.ext_en: An elderly person may nap during the day and then sleep only five hours a night.

defs.def_en: If you nap, you sleep for a short period of time, usually during the day.

defs.def_cn: (地毯或天鹅绒等表面的)绒毛
defs.def_en: The nap of a carpet or of a cloth such as velvet is the top layer of short threads, which usually lie smoothly in one direction.

defs.def_cn: 被弄得措手不及;猝不及防

ext.ext_cn: 保安工作明显有漏洞。
ext.ext_en: The security services were clearly caught napping.

defs.def_en: If someone is caught napping, something happens when they are not prepared for it, although they should have been.

ext.ext_cn: 不利的气象条件
ext.ext_en: ...adverse meteorological conditions.

defs.def_en: Meteorological means relating to meteorology.

ext.ext_cn: 意大利的建筑传统
ext.ext_en: ...Italy's architectural heritage.

ext.ext_cn: 拉姆这种小镇独特的建筑风格
ext.ext_en: ...the unique architectural style of towns like Lamu.

defs.def_en: Architectural means relating to the design and construction of buildings.
A music box is a box that plays a tune when you open the lid.

ext.ext_cn: 高校及其他研究机构抱怨经费不足。
ext.ext_en: Universities and other research establishments bemoan their lack of funds.

defs.def_en: If you bemoan something, you express sorrow or dissatisfaction about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 花里胡哨的;矫揉造作的;过分煽情的
defs.def_en: If you say that something is twee, it is pretty or sentimental in a way that you think is excessive or silly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 宽松的衬衫很舒服。
ext.ext_en: Loose-fitting shirts are comfy.

ext.ext_cn: 舒适的椅子
ext.ext_en: ...a comfy chair.

defs.def_en: A comfy item of clothing, piece of furniture, room, or position is a comfortable one.

defs.def_cn: 真的;真正的;真实的;真诚的

ext.ext_cn: 真正的意大利食品
ext.ext_en: ...authentic Italian food...

ext.ext_cn: 她散发出真正的魅力，而大多数人只是举止优雅。
ext.ext_en: She has authentic charm whereas most people simply have nice manners...

defs.def_en: An authentic person, object, or emotion is genuine.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （仿制品）能够以假乱真的，逼真的

ext.ext_cn: 制造仿潮流服装所用的图案
ext.ext_en: ...patterns for making authentic frontier-style clothing.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as authentic, you mean that it is such a good imitation that it is almost the same as or as good as the original.

defs.def_cn: (信息或记述）准确的，可靠的，可信的

ext.ext_cn: 我已经掌握了有关该组织诞生的可靠的详细资料。
ext.ext_en: I had obtained the authentic details about the birth of the organization.

defs.def_en: An authentic piece of information or account of something is reliable and accurate.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的消费主义社会
ext.ext_en: ...our consumerist society.

defs.def_en: Consumerist economies are ones which encourage people to consume a lot of goods.

defs.def_cn: 被引述句;间接引语从句
defs.def_en: A reported clause is a subordinate clause that indicates what someone said or thought. For example, in 'She said that she was hungry', 'she was hungry' is a reported clause.

ext.ext_cn: 本周杂志的附赠礼品是有关家庭度假的便捷手册。
ext.ext_en: The covermount with this week's mag is a handy guide to family holidays.

defs.def_en: A covermount is a small gift attached to the front cover of a magazine.

ext.ext_cn: 全体一致同意尽快开始和平进程。
ext.ext_en: There was total agreement to start the peace process as soon as possible...

ext.ext_cn: 他们决定用3年时间建成。
ext.ext_en: They decided to spread the building process over three years...

defs.def_en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

ext.ext_cn: 这种情况出现在老年人当中，显然是衰老过程的一部分。
ext.ext_en: It occurs in elderly men, apparently as part of the ageing process...

ext.ext_cn: 这种现象出现的规律性表明这个过程是由基因决定的。
ext.ext_en: The regularity with which this occurs suggests that the process is genetically determined.

defs.def_en: A process is a series of things which happen naturally and result in a biological or chemical change.

ext.ext_cn: 经过冷冻、罐装或熏制处理的鱼
ext.ext_en: ...fish which are processed by freezing, canning or smoking...

ext.ext_cn: 这些材料将会被加工成塑料小球。
ext.ext_en: The material will be processed into plastic pellets.

defs.def_en: When raw materials or foods are processed, they are prepared in factories before they are used or sold.

ext.ext_cn: 处理数据的设备和公开其结果的权利
ext.ext_en: ...facilities to process the data, and the right to publish the results...

ext.ext_cn: 通过望远镜获得的信息将由计算机进行处理。
ext.ext_en: The information gathered by the telescopes will be processed by computers.

defs.def_en: When people process information, they put it through a system or into a computer in order to deal with it.

defs.def_cn: 审核；审议；检查；使接受处理

ext.ext_cn: 病人在这个科看病需要两个多小时的时间。
ext.ext_en: Patients took more than two hours to be processed through the department.

defs.def_en: When people are processed by officials, their case is dealt with in stages and they pass from one stage of the process to the next.

ext.ext_cn: 政府正在起草和平计划。
ext.ext_en: The administration is in the process of drawing up a peace plan...

ext.ext_cn: 她的小说正被拍成电视连续剧。
ext.ext_en: Her novel is in the process of being turned into a television series.

defs.def_en: If you are in the process of doing something, you have started to do it and are still doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 他领先那个西班牙人到达终点，同时也首次作为职业选手获得计时赛的胜利。
ext.ext_en: He finished ahead of the Spaniard, and in the process picked up his first time trial win as a pro...

ext.ext_cn: 你得让我们为自己拼搏，哪怕我们会在这个过程中死去。
ext.ext_en: You have to let us struggle for ourselves, even if we must die in the process.

defs.def_en: If you are doing something and you do something else in the process, you do the second thing as part of doing the first thing.

defs.def_cn: (包着肉、蔬菜和辣酱的)墨西哥玉米薄饼卷
defs.def_en: A taco is a crispy Mexican pancake made from corn and eggs, which is folded and filled with meat, vegetables, and a spicy sauce.

ext.ext_cn: 年轻的聋哑男子
ext.ext_en: ...a young deaf and dumb man.

defs.def_en: Someone who is dumb is completely unable to speak.

defs.def_cn: (在某种场合下因愤怒或惊讶而)说不出话的,哑口无言的

ext.ext_cn: 一时间我们惊讶得哑口无言。
ext.ext_en: We were all struck dumb for a minute.

defs.def_en: If someone is dumb on a particular occasion, they cannot speak because they are angry, shocked, or surprised.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我遇到过很多笨蛋。
ext.ext_en: I've met a lot of dumb people...

ext.ext_cn: 问题这么设计，就是为了让她出丑。
ext.ext_en: The questions were set up to make her look dumb.

defs.def_en: If you call a person dumb, you mean that they are stupid or foolish.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 愚蠢的;令人心烦的;令人恼火的

ext.ext_cn: 我想出了这个馊主意。
ext.ext_en: I came up with this dumb idea...

ext.ext_cn: 让人恼火的是媒体。
ext.ext_en: It's the media that's dumb.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is dumb, you think that it is silly and annoying.

defs.def_cn: 无声的;无言的;不用言语表达的

ext.ext_cn: 她不语，从她脸上掠过的一丝表情可知她是认得的。
ext.ext_en: An expression of dumb recognition wiggled across her features.

defs.def_en: Something that is dumb is done or expressed without words.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 女孩眯起眼睛看照片。她好像近视。
ext.ext_en: The girl squinted at the photograph. She seemed to be nearsighted.

defs.def_en: Someone who is near-sighted cannot see distant things clearly.
Sooner is the comparative of soon.

ext.ext_cn: 霍尔特侦探说：“绑架者是一名男子，我们必须抓住他，越快越好。”
ext.ext_en: Detective Holt said: 'The kidnapper is a man we must catch and the sooner the better'.

defs.def_en: You say the sooner the better when you think something should be done as soon as possible.

ext.ext_cn: 她迟早会被警方逮住的。
ext.ext_en: Sooner or later she would be caught by the police.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen sooner or later, you mean that it will happen at some time in the future, even though it might take a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 他刚到罗马就遭到了绑架。
ext.ext_en: No sooner had he arrived in Rome than he was kidnapped.

defs.def_en: If you say that no sooner has one thing happened than another thing happens, you mean that the second thing happens immediately after the first thing.

ext.ext_cn: 福特郑重声明他宁可把自己的工厂付之一炬，也不愿意生产一辆用于战争的车辆。
ext.ext_en: Ford vowed that he would sooner burn his factory to the ground than build a single vehicle for war purposes...

ext.ext_cn: 我宁可不去谈论它。
ext.ext_en: I'd sooner not talk about it...

defs.def_en: If you say that you would sooner do something or you'd sooner do it, you mean that you would prefer to do it.
A woman's tresses are her long flowing hair.

defs.def_cn: 能力倾向测验;能力测试
defs.def_en: An aptitude test is a test that is specially designed to find out how easily and how well you can do something.
Exoticism is the quality of seeming unusual or interesting, usually because of associations with a distant country.

defs.def_cn: （表示高兴或兴奋的欢呼声）好啊
defs.def_en: People sometimes shout yippee when they are very pleased or excited.

ext.ext_cn: 委员会在首都里加召开了成立大会。
ext.ext_en: The committee held its founding congress in the capital, Riga...

ext.ext_cn: 他是自然资源保护基金会的创办负责人。
ext.ext_en: He is founding director of The Conservation Foundation.

defs.def_en: See also:found;Founding means relating to the starting of a particular institution or organization.
A showground is a large area of land where events such as farming shows or horse riding competitions are held.
A black marketeer is someone who sells goods on the black market.

defs.def_cn: (用于某些词之前构成新词)表示“坏”，“不良”，“不当”

ext.ext_cn: 人口中有40%的人营养不良。
ext.ext_en: Forty per cent of the population is suffering from malnutrition...

ext.ext_cn: 这些动物遭到残酷的虐待。
ext.ext_en: The animals were seriously maltreated.

defs.def_en: Mal- is added to words in order to form new words which describe things that are bad or unpleasant, or that are unsuccessful or imperfect.

ext.ext_cn: 磷光涂料
ext.ext_en: ...phosphorescent paint.

defs.def_en: A phosphorescent object or colour glows in the dark with a soft light, but gives out little or no heat.

ext.ext_cn: 发动机过热，车子不好操纵。
ext.ext_en: The engine was overheating and the car was not handling well...

ext.ext_cn: 为什么我们要为酒吧和宾馆不必要的暖气开支买单呢？
ext.ext_en: Why do we pay to overheat pubs and hotels?

defs.def_en: If something overheats or if you overheat it, it becomes hotter than is necessary or desirable.

defs.def_cn: （使）（经济）发展过快；（使）发展过热

ext.ext_cn: 私营企业的开支急剧增长造成经济发展过热。
ext.ext_en: The private sector is increasing its spending so sharply that the economy is overheating...

ext.ext_cn: 他们首要考虑的是防止经济发展过快。
ext.ext_en: Their prime consideration has been not to overheat the economy.

defs.def_en: If a country's economy overheats or if conditions overheat it, it grows so rapidly that inflation and interest rates rise very quickly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 每天都有人来参观那栋房子，有时人多得都无法控制。
ext.ext_en: People were visiting the house every day, sometimes in unmanageable numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 她的雀斑和乱糟糟的头发
ext.ext_en: ...her freckles and unmanageable hair.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unmanageable, you mean that it is difficult to use, deal with, or control.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些迹象表明被宠坏的孩子在十几岁的时候往往会变得难以管教。
ext.ext_en: The signs are that indulged children tend to become unmanageable when they reach their teens.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone, especially a young person, as unmanageable, you mean that they behave in an unacceptable way and are difficult to control.

ext.ext_cn: 通用汽车公司以大约4亿美元的价格购得了萨博汽车公司50%的股份。
ext.ext_en: General Motors acquired a 50% stake in Saab for about $400m...

ext.ext_cn: 最近我从一棵冬青树上弄了些木料。
ext.ext_en: I recently acquired some wood from a holly tree...

defs.def_en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

ext.ext_cn: 我一向喝不惯葡萄酒。
ext.ext_en: I've never acquired a taste for wine...

ext.ext_cn: 读完此书，她便能将从书中所得传授给实习教师。
ext.ext_en: Having read the book, she will be able to pass on the acquired knowledge to trainee teachers.

defs.def_en: If you acquire something such as a skill or a habit, you learn it, or develop it through your daily life or experience.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经赢得了该国首席小提琴独奏家的名誉。
ext.ext_en: He has acquired a reputation as this country's premier solo violinist.

defs.def_en: If someone or something acquires a certain reputation, they start to have that reputation.

defs.def_cn: 后天养成的爱好;培养出来的兴趣

ext.ext_cn: 要慢慢适应才能吃得惯蚕豆。
ext.ext_en: Broad beans are very much an acquired taste...

ext.ext_cn: 独处是一种修得的境界。
ext.ext_en: Living alone is an acquired taste.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as an acquired taste, you mean that a lot of people do not like it when they first experience it, but often start to like it more when they get to know it better.

ext.ext_cn: 体力衰竭或感染病毒后引起的虚弱无力
ext.ext_en: ...exhaustion or post-viral debility.

defs.def_en: Debility is a weakness of a person's body or mind, especially one caused by an illness.

defs.def_cn: 未经证实的；无根据的；不确凿的

ext.ext_cn: 我强烈反对他们的说法，那是毫无根据的。
ext.ext_en: I do object to their claim, which I find totally unsubstantiated.

ext.ext_cn: 有关他私生活的捕风捉影的谣言
ext.ext_en: ...unsubstantiated rumours about his private life.

defs.def_en: A claim, accusation, or story that is unsubstantiated has not been proved to be valid or true.
A cellist is someone who plays the cello.
A cycleway is a special road, route, or path intended for use by cyclists.
A chiller is a very frightening film or novel.

ext.ext_cn: 卢布的实际购买力骤然下降。
ext.ext_en: The real purchasing power of the rouble has plummeted.

defs.def_en: The purchasing power of a currency is the amount of goods or services that you can buy with it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们顾客的购买力
ext.ext_en: ...the purchasing power of their customers.

defs.def_en: The purchasing power of a person or group of people is the amount of goods or services that they can afford to buy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 诚挚的;衷心的;真心实意的

ext.ext_cn: 我对所有的亲人表示由衷的慰问。
ext.ext_en: My heartfelt sympathy goes out to all the relatives.

defs.def_en: Heartfelt is used to describe a deep or sincere feeling or wish.
If people send you to Coventry, they avoid speaking to you whenever they meet you, as a way of punishing you for something that you have done.

defs.def_cn: (尤以编织或陶器等为主的)家庭手工业，作坊式小工业

ext.ext_cn: 装订业主要是一种家庭手工业。
ext.ext_en: Bookbinding is largely a cottage industry.

defs.def_en: A cottage industry is a small business that is run from someone's home, especially one that involves a craft such as knitting or pottery.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (版本)缩减的，删节的，截短了的

ext.ext_cn: 该评论机构出版了其年报的删节版本。
ext.ext_en: The review body has produced a truncated version of its annual report.

ext.ext_cn: 高约八英尺，形状像锥台的岩石
ext.ext_en: …a rock about eight feet high, shaped like a truncated cone.

defs.def_en: A truncated version of something is one that has been shortened.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 战争加剧了原本已很严重的经济危机。
ext.ext_en: The war has aggravated an acute economic crisis...

ext.ext_cn: 报告将政府置于窘境。
ext.ext_en: The report has caused acute embarrassment to the government...

defs.def_en: You can use acute to indicate that an undesirable situation or feeling is very severe or intense.

ext.ext_cn: 患急性风湿性关节炎的病人
ext.ext_en: ...a patient with acute rheumatoid arthritis.

ext.ext_cn: 急性痢疾病例
ext.ext_en: ...an acute case of dysentery.

defs.def_en: An acute illness is one that becomes severe very quickly but does not last very long.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 黑暗中我的听觉变得异常灵敏。
ext.ext_en: In the dark my sense of hearing becomes so acute.

defs.def_en: If a person's or animal's sight, hearing, or sense of smell is acute, it is sensitive and powerful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 虽已年届九旬，她依然头脑敏锐，个性很强。
ext.ext_en: Into her nineties, her thinking remained acute and her character forceful...

ext.ext_cn: 他表面上大大咧咧，内心却无比敏锐。
ext.ext_en: His relaxed exterior hides an extremely acute mind.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is acute or has an acute mind, you mean that they are quick to notice things and are able to understand them clearly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: An acute angle is less than 90°.

defs.def_cn: （标在元音等上面的符号）尖音的，重音的
defs.def_en: An acute accent is a symbol that is placed over vowels in some languages in order to indicate how that vowel is pronounced or over one letter in a word to indicate where it is stressed. You refer to a letter with this accent as, for example, e acute. For example, there is an acute accent over the letter 'e' in the French word 'café'.

defs.def_cn: 叫;称呼;将…命名;给…起名字

ext.ext_cn: 不知怎么的,我老想把这条狗唤作穆夫提。
ext.ext_en: I always wanted to call the dog Mufty for some reason...

ext.ext_cn: “大夫…”——“就叫我萨拉好了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Doctor...' — 'Will you please call me Sarah?'...

defs.def_en: If you call someone or something by a particular name or title, you give them that name or title.

ext.ext_cn: 演说被保守党人士打断,他们称他是叛徒。
ext.ext_en: The speech was interrupted by members of the Conservative Party, who called him a traitor...

ext.ext_cn: 我不觉得这是负担;我觉得它是一种责任。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't call it a burden; I call it a responsibility...

defs.def_en: If you call someone or something a particular thing, you suggest they are that thing or describe them as that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他听到其他人从楼下不同地方喊他的名字。
ext.ext_en: He could hear the others downstairs in different parts of the house calling his name...

ext.ext_cn: “小子们!”她又叫道。
ext.ext_en: 'Boys!' she called again.

defs.def_en: If you call something, you say it in a loud voice, because you are trying to attract someone's attention.

ext.ext_cn: 你一弄清楚了就给我打电话好吗?
ext.ext_en: Would you call me as soon as you find out?...

ext.ext_cn: 一个朋友要我打这个号码。
ext.ext_en: A friend of mine gave me this number to call...

defs.def_en: If you call someone, you telephone them.

ext.ext_cn: 他尖叫着让他老婆打电话叫救护车。
ext.ext_en: He screamed for his wife to call an ambulance...

ext.ext_cn: 一天夜里,有人打来电话,请他去给一位患肺结核的妇女看病。
ext.ext_en: One night he was called to see a woman with tuberculosis.

defs.def_en: If you call someone such as a doctor or the police, you ask them to come to you, usually by telephoning them.

ext.ext_cn: 她喊她的小儿子:“喂,斯蒂芬,过来看看这个!”
ext.ext_en: She called her young son: 'Here, Stephen, come and look at this!'...

ext.ext_cn: 他用天朗扩音器喊我。
ext.ext_en: He called me over the Tannoy.

defs.def_en: If you call someone, you ask them to come to you by shouting to them.

ext.ext_cn: 我打电话给美国的一个朋友。
ext.ext_en: I made a phone call to the United States to talk to a friend...

ext.ext_cn: 我已经接到了其他受害人打来的上百个电话。
ext.ext_en: I've had hundreds of calls from other victims...

defs.def_en: When you make a telephone call, you telephone someone.

defs.def_cn: 召集(会议、排练等);宣布举行(选举等)

ext.ext_cn: 委员会决定召开国大党会议。
ext.ext_en: The Committee decided to call a meeting of the All India Congress...

ext.ext_cn: 皇家莎士比亚剧团要召开新闻发布会,宣布剧院关闭。
ext.ext_en: The RSC was calling a press conference to announce the theatre's closure...

defs.def_en: If someone in authority calls something such as a meeting, rehearsal, or election, they arrange for it to take place at a particular time.

ext.ext_cn: 小女孩等了两个小时才被传唤进去作证。
ext.ext_en: The child waited two hours before she was called to give evidence...

ext.ext_cn: 我作为专家证人被传唤出庭。
ext.ext_en: I was called as an expert witness.

defs.def_en: If someone is called before a court or committee, they are ordered to appear there, usually to give evidence.

ext.ext_cn: 一位市场调查人员造访了他的住处。
ext.ext_en: A market researcher called at the house where he was living...

ext.ext_cn: 现在安德鲁几乎每星期都来。
ext.ext_en: Andrew now came almost weekly to call.

defs.def_en: If you call somewhere, you make a short visit there.

defs.def_cn: (火车、公共汽车、船舶)停靠,停留

ext.ext_cn: 一路上,汽船在好几个港口停靠。
ext.ext_en: The steamer calls at several ports along the way.

defs.def_en: When a train, bus, or ship calls somewhere, it stops there for a short time to allow people to get on or off.

ext.ext_cn: 系列赛第二场在十局过后,双方战成3比3平，此时由于天黑,比赛取消。
ext.ext_en: The second game of the series had ended in a 3-3 tie after ten innings when the game was called on account of darkness...

ext.ext_cn: 我们取消了下一场比赛。
ext.ext_en: We called the next game.

defs.def_en: To call a game or sporting event means to cancel it, for example because of rain or bad light.

ext.ext_cn: 不少人呼吁出台新的安全措施。
ext.ext_en: There have been calls for a new kind of security arrangement...

ext.ext_cn: 工会号召工人在罢工期间呆在家里,几乎所有工人都响应了这一号召。
ext.ext_en: Almost all workers heeded a call by the trade unions to stay at home for the duration of the strike.

defs.def_en: If there is a call for something, someone demands that it should happen.

ext.ext_cn: “你们有纯巧克力吗?”——“没有,恐怕那东西没几个人要。”
ext.ext_en: 'Have you got just plain chocolate?' — 'No, I'm afraid there's not much call for that.'

defs.def_en: If there is little or no call for something, very few people want it to be done or provided.

ext.ext_cn: 新鲜事物的魅力一定让你兴奋不已。
ext.ext_en: You must be feeling exhilarated by the call of the new.

defs.def_en: The call of something such as a place is the way it attracts or interests you strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 鲸的哀鸣
ext.ext_en: ...the plaintive call of a whale.

ext.ext_cn: 各种各样的鸟兽叫声
ext.ext_en: ...a wide range of animal noises and bird calls.

defs.def_en: The call of a particular bird or animal is the characteristic sound that it makes.

ext.ext_cn: 凭什么最好的房产尽着他们先挑?
ext.ext_en: Why should they get first call on the best property?

defs.def_en: If you have first call on something, you will be asked before anyone else whether you want to buy or use it.

ext.ext_cn: 这么多人中，他不该专挑你。
ext.ext_en: There was no call for him to single you out from all the others.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is no call for someone to behave in a particular way, you are criticizing their behaviour, usually because you think it is rude.

defs.def_cn: 随时待命的;随叫随到的

ext.ext_cn: 从理论上说,我现在昼夜待命。
ext.ext_en: In theory I'm on call day and night.

ext.ext_cn: 随叫随到的医生
ext.ext_en: ...a doctor on call.

defs.def_en: If someone is on call, they are ready to go to work at any time if they are needed, especially if there is an emergency.

ext.ext_cn: “你今天不是应该上班的吗?”“我打电话请过病假了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Shouldn't you be at work today?' — 'I called in sick.'

defs.def_en: If you call in sick, you telephone the place where you work to tell them you will not be coming to work because you are ill.

defs.def_cn: 天使般可爱的;天使般纯真的

ext.ext_cn: 我出生时胖乎乎的，像天使般可爱。
ext.ext_en: I was born cherubic and chubby.

ext.ext_cn: 她那洋溢着笑容、天真无邪的娃娃脸
ext.ext_en: ...her beaming, cherubic face.

defs.def_en: If someone looks cherubic, they look sweet and innocent like a cherub.

ext.ext_cn: 安妮是兰开夏郡姑娘，老家在普雷斯顿附近的朗顿。
ext.ext_en: Anne is a Lancashire lass from Longton, near Preston...

ext.ext_cn: “怎么回事，小姑娘？”芬利嚷道。
ext.ext_en: 'What is it, lass?' Finlay cried.

defs.def_en: A lass is a young woman or girl.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 没有分量的;不重要的;不入流的;小本经营的

ext.ext_cn: 小毒贩
ext.ext_en: ...small- time drug dealers.

ext.ext_cn: 不入流的女演员兼模特
ext.ext_en: ...a small-time actress and model.

defs.def_en: If you refer to workers or businesses as small-time, you think they are not very important because their work is limited in extent or not very successful.

ext.ext_cn: 他得和家里的其他3个孩子共用洗澡水。
ext.ext_en: He has to share his bath water with the other three children in the family.

defs.def_en: Your bath water is the water in which you sit or lie when you have a bath.  to throw the baby out with the bath water→see: baby;

defs.def_cn: （在英国通常用于公司名称后）公开股份有限公司

ext.ext_cn: 英国电信公开股份有限公司
ext.ext_en: ...British Telecommunications plc...

ext.ext_cn: 这个许可证并不能让他以公开股份有限公司的名义从事贸易。
ext.ext_en: This licence would not allow him to trade as a plc.

defs.def_en: In Britain, plc means a company whose shares can be bought by the public and is usually used after the name of a company. plc is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'public limited company'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一缕微弱的光线透过树枝。
ext.ext_en: A watery light began to show through the branches...

ext.ext_cn: 玛莎勉强挤出一丝笑容。
ext.ext_en: Martha managed to produce a dim, watery smile.

defs.def_en: Something that is watery is weak or pale.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一盘寡淡无味的汤
ext.ext_en: ...a plateful of watery soup.

ext.ext_cn: 味道很淡的啤酒
ext.ext_en: ...watery beer.

defs.def_en: If you describe food or drink as watery, you dislike it because it contains too much water, or has no flavour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 含水的;似水的;由水组成的

ext.ext_cn: 她耳朵里流出水样分泌物。
ext.ext_en: There was a watery discharge from her ear...

ext.ext_cn: 埃玛双眼发红，泪水盈盈。
ext.ext_en: Emma's eyes went red and watery.

defs.def_en: Something that is watery contains, resembles, or consists of water.

ext.ext_cn: 防暴警察驱散了示威的学生。
ext.ext_en: Riot police broke up a demonstration by students.

ext.ext_cn: 群众性示威
ext.ext_en: ...mass demonstrations.

defs.def_en: A demonstration is a march or gathering which people take part in to show their opposition to something or their support for something.

ext.ext_cn: 烹饪示范
ext.ext_en: ...a cookery demonstration.

ext.ext_cn: 新产品的演示
ext.ext_en: ...demonstrations of new products.

defs.def_en: A demonstration of something is a talk by someone who shows you how to do it or how it works.

ext.ext_cn: 这清楚地表明了技术已有了怎样的进步。
ext.ext_en: This is a clear demonstration of how technology has changed...

ext.ext_cn: 这很实际地说明了为什么军队要将士兵训练得遵规守纪。
ext.ext_en: This was a very practical demonstration of why the Army trained people to be disciplined.

defs.def_en: A demonstration of a fact or situation is a clear proof of it.

ext.ext_cn: 没有人对总统公开表示反对。
ext.ext_en: There's been no public demonstration of opposition to the President.

ext.ext_cn: 身体上的亲昵
ext.ext_en: ...physical demonstrations of affection.

defs.def_en: A demonstration of a quality or feeling is an expression of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他已成为军事史上的一个传奇。
ext.ext_en: He has become a legend in the annals of military history.

defs.def_en: If something is in the annals of a nation or field of activity, it is recorded as part of its history.

ext.ext_cn: 它发表在《内科医学年鉴》上。
ext.ext_en: It was published in the 'Annals of Internal Medicine'.

defs.def_en: Annals is used in the titles of journals of a particular field of academic research.
A beauty shop is the same as a beauty parlour .

defs.def_cn: (作为爱好去火车站的)机车号码搜集
defs.def_en: Trainspotting is the hobby of going to railway stations and recording the numbers of the trains that you see.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 将土豆片烤15分钟，直至酥脆。
ext.ext_en: Bake the potatoes for 15 minutes, till they're nice and crisp.

ext.ext_cn: 脆熏肉
ext.ext_en: ...crisp bacon.

defs.def_en: Food that is crisp is pleasantly hard, or has a pleasantly hard surface.

ext.ext_cn: 把熏肉烹至酥脆。
ext.ext_en: Cook the bacon until it begins to crisp...

ext.ext_cn: 把面包屑撒在干燥的烤盘上，然后放在烤箱里烤脆。
ext.ext_en: Spread breadcrumbs on a dry baking sheet and crisp them in the oven.

defs.def_en: If food crisps or if you crisp it, it becomes pleasantly hard, for example because you have heated it at a high temperature.

defs.def_cn: (当零食吃的)油炸土豆片，炸薯片

ext.ext_cn: 一袋炸薯片
ext.ext_en: ...a packet of crisps.

ext.ext_cn: 奶酪和洋葱味炸薯片
ext.ext_en: ...cheese and onion potato crisps.

defs.def_en: Crisps are very thin slices of fried potato that are eaten cold as a snack.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 秋高气爽的一天
ext.ext_en: ...a crisp autumn day.

defs.def_en: Weather that is pleasantly fresh, cold, and dry can be described as crisp .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他戴着一顶巴拿马草帽，穿着一身挺括的白西装。
ext.ext_en: He wore a panama hat and a crisp white suit...

ext.ext_cn: 我钻到崭新洁净的被单底下。
ext.ext_en: I slipped between the crisp clean sheets.

defs.def_en: Crisp cloth or paper is clean and has no creases in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (树叶或雪)发出脆响的，咯吱作响的

ext.ext_cn: 踩上去发出脆响的秋叶
ext.ext_en: ...crisp autumn leaves...

ext.ext_cn: 他咯吱咯吱地踏雪行进着。
ext.ext_en: He crunched through the crisp snow.

defs.def_en: Leaves or snow that make a loud noise when you walk on them can be described as crisp .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (写作或讲话)简短干脆的(可能显得不友好)

ext.ext_cn: “很好，”我用干脆的命令性的语气说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Very well,' I said, adopting a crisp authoritative tone.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's writing or speech as crisp, you mean they write or speak very clearly, without mentioning unnecessary details. This may make them seem unfriendly.
If something is burnt to a crisp, it is completely burnt.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在那个方面，我们的社会已经取得了巨大的进步。
ext.ext_en: We've made extraordinary progress as a society in that regard...

ext.ext_cn: 那项任务需要非凡的耐心和毅力。
ext.ext_en: The task requires extraordinary patience and endurance...

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as extraordinary, you mean that they have some extremely good or special quality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 非常奇特的;令人惊奇的

ext.ext_cn: 这事儿真蹊跷！
ext.ext_en: What an extraordinary thing to happen!...

ext.ext_cn: 他作出举行谈判的决定非同寻常，因为这可能意味着战争真的要结束了。
ext.ext_en: His decision to hold talks is extraordinary because it could mean the real end of the war.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as extraordinary, you mean that it is very unusual or surprising.

ext.ext_cn: 在体育运动管理机构的特别会议上
ext.ext_en: ...at an extraordinary meeting of the sport's ruling body...

ext.ext_cn: 各殖民地代表在一次特别大会上会面。
ext.ext_en: Representatives of the colonies met in an extraordinary congress.

defs.def_en: An extraordinary meeting is arranged specially to deal with a particular situation or problem, rather than happening regularly.

ext.ext_cn: 执政党从事商业和银行业的后台老板
ext.ext_en: ...the ruling party's paymasters in business and banking...

ext.ext_cn: 作为欧盟的大老板，德国每年要出资80亿英镑，比它从欧盟得到的要多。
ext.ext_en: As the main EU paymaster, Germany contributes £8 billion annually more than it gets back from Brussels.

defs.def_en: A paymaster is a person or organization that pays and therefore controls another person or organization.

defs.def_cn: （军队中发放工资、军饷的）出纳员
defs.def_en: A paymaster is an official in the armed forces who is responsible for the payment of wages and salaries.
A brood is a group of baby birds that were born at the same time to the same mother.

defs.def_cn: （某人的)一群孩子，家中所有的子女

ext.ext_cn: 一大群子女
ext.ext_en: ...a large brood of children.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's young children as their brood when you want to emphasize that there are a lot of them.

ext.ext_cn: 我猜想每个人都会不时地琢磨一些事情。
ext.ext_en: I guess everyone broods over things once in a while...

ext.ext_cn: 她一直为她的家人担忧。
ext.ext_en: She constantly broods about her family...

defs.def_en: If someone broods over something, they think about it a lot, seriously and often unhappily.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第25个字母
defs.def_en: Y is the twenty-fifth letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_cn: 基督教青年会（或女青年会）旅馆

ext.ext_cn: 我把他带到了基督教青年会旅馆。
ext.ext_en: I took him to the Y.

defs.def_en: A YMCA or YWCA hostel is sometimes referred to as the Y .
A Baptist is a Christian who believes that people should not be baptized until they are old enough to understand the meaning of baptism.

defs.def_cn: 浸礼会教派的；浸礼会教友的

ext.ext_cn: 浸礼教会
ext.ext_en: ...a Baptist church.

defs.def_en: Baptist means belonging or relating to Baptists.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 幼稚的；不成熟的；头脑简单的

ext.ext_cn: 他们纠正了我不成熟的泛泛之论，帮了我大忙。
ext.ext_en: They were of great service in correcting my jejune generalizations.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as jejune, you are criticizing them for being very simple and unsophisticated.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们很清楚我们注定要过一个乏味单调的漫长夜晚了。
ext.ext_en: We knew we were in for a pretty long, jejune evening.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as jejune, you mean they are dull and boring.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 群山向远处的地平线绵延而去。
ext.ext_en: The mountains rolled away to a distant horizon.

ext.ext_cn: 在那遥远国度的战争
ext.ext_en: ...the war in that distant land.

defs.def_en: Distant means very far away.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不过事情在不久的将来会有所改善，这几乎毋庸置疑。
ext.ext_en: There is little doubt, however, that things will improve in the not too distant future...

ext.ext_cn: 去年夏天的旱灾已成为遥远的记忆。
ext.ext_en: Last summer's drought is a distant memory.

defs.def_en: You use distant to describe a time or event that is very far away in the future or in the past.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是市长的一个远亲。
ext.ext_en: He's a distant relative of the mayor...

ext.ext_cn: 他们是远房表亲。
ext.ext_en: They were distant cousins.

defs.def_en: A distant relative is one who you are not closely related to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 冷淡的;疏远的;不友好的

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得她冷若冰霜，拒人于千里之外。
ext.ext_en: He found her cold, ice-like and distant...

ext.ext_cn: 他直截了当且礼数周全，但是态度冷淡。
ext.ext_en: He is direct and courteous but distant.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as distant, you mean that you find them cold and unfriendly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 恍惚的;心不在焉的;注意力不集中的

ext.ext_cn: 她眼中时时流露出心不在焉的神情，思绪已飘至别处。
ext.ext_en: There was a distant look in her eyes from time to time, her thoughts elsewhere.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as distant, you mean that they are not concentrating on what they are doing because they are thinking about other things.

ext.ext_cn: 委员会认定在休闲胜地的裸体行为弊大于利。
ext.ext_en: Nudism, the council decided, was doing the resort more harm than good.

defs.def_en: Nudism is the practice of not wearing any clothes on beaches and other areas specially set aside for this purpose.

defs.def_cn: 用键盘输入；将信息键入计算机
defs.def_en: Keyboarding is the activity of typing information into a computer or word processor.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 将她父亲排除在外似乎不公平。
ext.ext_en: It didn't seem fair to leave out her father...

ext.ext_cn: 你觉得他们付了该付的那份钱吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you feel they're paying their fair share?...

defs.def_en: Something or someone that is fair is reasonable, right, and just.

defs.def_cn: (数量、程度、尺寸或距离)相当多(或大、长)的

ext.ext_cn: 我街对面的邻居游历甚广。
ext.ext_en: My neighbours across the street travel a fair amount...

ext.ext_cn: 我舅舅住在相当远的地方，所以我们很少见到他和他的家人。
ext.ext_en: My mother's brother lives a fair distance away so we don't see him and his family very often.

defs.def_en: A fair amount, degree, size, or distance is quite a large amount, degree, size, or distance.

ext.ext_cn: 说损失会很严重想必猜得不错。
ext.ext_en: It's a fair guess to say that the damage will be extensive...

ext.ext_cn: 我大致了解情况会有多困难。
ext.ext_en: I have a fair idea of how difficult things can be.

defs.def_en: A fair guess or idea about something is one that is likely to be correct.

defs.def_cn: (水平、质量)一般的，尚可的，不错的

ext.ext_cn: 赖马尔的英语说得还不错。
ext.ext_en: Reimar had a fair command of English.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as fair, you mean that they are average in standard or quality, neither very good nor very bad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 两个孩子都很像罗比娜，但头发颜色比她浅得多。
ext.ext_en: Both children were very like Robina, but were much fairer than she was.

ext.ext_cn: 一个高个子、金色头发的英国人
ext.ext_en: ...a tall, fair-haired Englishman.

defs.def_en: Someone who is fair, or who has fair hair, has light-coloured hair.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 保护我白皙的皮肤不受日晒是很紧要的。
ext.ext_en: It's important to protect my fair skin from the sun.

ext.ext_cn: 皮肤白皙的人如果长期暴露在太阳下，患皮肤癌的可能性最大。
ext.ext_en: Fair-skinned people who spend a great deal of time in the sun have the greatest risk of skin cancer.

defs.def_en: Fair skin is very pale and usually burns easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 天气晴好。
ext.ext_en: Weather conditions were fair.

defs.def_en: When the weather is fair, it is quite sunny and not raining.
A county, state, or country fair is an event where there are, for example, displays of goods and animals, and amusements, games, and competitions.
A fair is the same as a funfair .

defs.def_cn: (尤指某类商品的)展销会,交易会

ext.ext_cn: 古玩交易会
ext.ext_en: ...an antiques fair.

defs.def_en: See also:craft fair;trade fair;A fair is an event at which people display and sell goods, especially goods of a particular type.

ext.ext_cn: 说句公道话，这个队还年轻，还没有成型。
ext.ext_en: To be fair, the team is young and not yet settled...

ext.ext_cn: 而且，说句公道话，有些下院议员工作还是很卖力的。
ext.ext_en: And, let us be fair, some MPs do work hard.

defs.def_en: You use fair in expressions such as to be fair and let's be fair when you want to add a favourable comment about someone or something that you have just mentioned and to correct a false impression that you might have given.

defs.def_cn: (说法、决定或行为)有些道理，说得过去

ext.ext_cn: 如果你不喜欢，这说得过去，但把它批得一无是处就没什么道理了。
ext.ext_en: If you don't like it, fair enough, but that's hardly a justification to attack the whole thing...

ext.ext_cn: 没错，你的童年生活不那么幸福：但它已经过去了。
ext.ext_en: Fair enough, you didn't have a perfectly happy childhood: but your childhood is over now.

defs.def_en: You use fair enough when you want to say that a statement, decision, or action seems reasonable to a certain extent, but that perhaps there is more to be said or done.

ext.ext_cn: “我要告到本地警察局。”——“呵，对，干得有理。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'm taking it to our local police station.' — 'Oh right, fair enough.'...

ext.ext_cn: “这条信息是写给我的，我不明白为什么要给你看。”——“说得在理。”
ext.ext_en: 'The message was addressed to me and I don't see why I should show it to you.' — 'Fair enough.'

defs.def_en: You say fair enough to acknowledge what someone has just said and to indicate that you understand it.

defs.def_cn: 做事光明正大;行事正直

ext.ext_cn: 政府在搞鬼，一位工会官员告诉我。
ext.ext_en: The government is not playing fair, one union official told me.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone plays fair, you mean that they behave or act in a reasonable and honest way.

ext.ext_cn: 可以这么说，他在那里有过一两次不愉快。
ext.ext_en: It would be fair to say he had one or two unhappy moments out there...

ext.ext_cn: 我想应该说那听起来可不太对。
ext.ext_en: I think it's fair to say that it didn't sound quite right.

defs.def_en: You use fair in expressions such as It would be fair to say in order to introduce a statement which you believe to be true and reasonable.

ext.ext_cn: 没话说，我们是给正大光明地打败的。
ext.ext_en: There are no excuses. We were beaten fair and square.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone won a competition fair and square, you mean that they won honestly and without cheating.

defs.def_cn: 先前存在的；先于…而存在的

ext.ext_cn: 两国之间已经存在的紧张局势
ext.ext_en: ...the pre-existing tensions between the two countries.

ext.ext_cn: 因已患疾病接受国民健康保障治疗但在治疗过程中被感染的人
ext.ext_en: ...people who have been infected in the course of their NHS treatment for a pre-existing illness.

defs.def_en: A pre-existing situation or thing exists already or existed before something else.

defs.def_cn: 自由职业者;独立工作者
defs.def_en: A freelancer is someone who does freelance work.

defs.def_cn: (房间或公共汽车上的)站立空间

ext.ext_cn: 人很快就坐满了，不久就只剩下站立的位置了。
ext.ext_en: The place quickly fills up so it's soon standing room only.

defs.def_en: Standing room is space in a room or bus, where people can stand when all the seats have been occupied.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人愉快的；使人高兴的

ext.ext_cn: 生小孩是件既痛苦又令人高兴的事。
ext.ext_en: Giving birth to a child is both painful and joyful...

ext.ext_cn: 婚礼就是快乐的爱情庆典。
ext.ext_en: A wedding is a joyful celebration of love.

defs.def_en: Something that is joyful causes happiness and pleasure.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们是非常快乐的民族；我们能歌善舞，热爱音乐。
ext.ext_en: We're a very joyful people; we're very musical people and we love music.

defs.def_en: Someone who is joyful is extremely happy.

ext.ext_cn: 摄影器材
ext.ext_en: ...photographic equipment...

ext.ext_cn: 银行能提供用过该机器的顾客的影像证据。
ext.ext_en: The bank is able to provide photographic evidence of who used the machine.

defs.def_en: Photographic means connected with photographs or photography.

ext.ext_cn: 他对地图过目不忘。
ext.ext_en: He had a photographic memory for maps.

defs.def_en: If you have a photographic memory, you are able to remember things in great detail after you have seen them.
A condiment is a substance such as salt, pepper, or mustard that you add to food when you eat it in order to improve the flavour.

ext.ext_cn: 为庆祝我30岁生日，朋友们凑钱给我买了块表。
ext.ext_en: For my thirtieth birthday, my friends clubbed together and bought me a watch.

defs.def_en: If people club together to do something, they all give money towards the cost of it.

ext.ext_cn: 情感和行为问题
ext.ext_en: ...emotional and behavioural problems.

ext.ext_cn: 行为科学家
ext.ext_en: ...behavioral scientists.

defs.def_en: Behavioural means relating to the behaviour of a person or animal, or to the study of their behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 一所美国大学1955年的年刊
ext.ext_en: ...an American college yearbook for 1955.

defs.def_en: A yearbook is a book that is published once a year and that contains information about the events and achievements of the previous year, usually concerning a particular place or organization.

defs.def_cn: （常指在宗教仪式中）涂油（或水）于（人体）

ext.ext_cn: 他给我的前额涂上了油。
ext.ext_en: He anointed my forehead...

ext.ext_cn: 教皇给他施了涂油礼，任命其为大主教。
ext.ext_en: The Pope has anointed him as Archbishop.

defs.def_en: To anoint someone means to put oil or water on a part of their body, usually for religious reasons.

ext.ext_cn: 平民党选定他做候选人。
ext.ext_en: The populist party anointed him as its candidate...

ext.ext_cn: 奥尔森先生总是回避指定继任者。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Olsen has always avoided anointing any successor...

defs.def_en: If a person in a position of authority anoints someone, they choose them to do a particular important job.
Reversing lights are the white lights on the back of a motor vehicle which shine when the vehicle is in reverse gear.

ext.ext_cn: 公爵签字放弃继承遗产。
ext.ext_en: The Duke signed away his inheritance...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在将点子出售给 DC 漫画公司时签字放弃了版权。
ext.ext_en: They signed the rights away when they sold their idea to DC Comics.

defs.def_en: If you sign something away, you sign official documents that mean that you no longer own it or have a right to it.

ext.ext_cn: 孤身一人、手持菜刀的袭击者
ext.ext_en: ...a lone assailant wielding a kitchen knife.

defs.def_en: If you wield a weapon, tool, or piece of equipment, you carry and use it.

ext.ext_cn: 他还是主席，但在公司没有什么实权了。
ext.ext_en: He remains chairman, but wields little power at the company.

defs.def_en: If someone wields power, they have it and are able to use it.

defs.def_cn: 自以为是的人；自高自大的人
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a big head, you disapprove of them because they think they are very clever and know everything.

defs.def_cn: （尤指特定阶层的）礼仪，礼节;（尤指特定行业的）行为规范，规矩

ext.ext_cn: 这是严重失礼的行为，他几乎手足无措。
ext.ext_en: This was such a great breach of etiquette, he hardly knew what to do.

ext.ext_cn: 外交礼节的规则
ext.ext_en: ...the rules of diplomatic etiquette.

defs.def_en: Etiquette is a set of customs and rules for polite behaviour, especially among a particular class of people or in a particular profession.

ext.ext_cn: 他有一次殴打了我哥的孩子。
ext.ext_en: He beat up on my brother's kid one time.

defs.def_en: If someone beats up on a person or beats on them, they hit or kick the person many times.

ext.ext_cn: 她不得不威胁每一位顾客，好让他们付款。
ext.ext_en: She had to beat up on every customer just to get the bills paid.

defs.def_en: If someone beats up on another person, they threaten them or treat them unkindly.

ext.ext_cn: 最终，大部队在拉脱维亚赶上了他。
ext.ext_en: Eventually, the army caught up with him in Latvia...

ext.ext_cn: 那个航班推迟了6个小时后终于起飞。
ext.ext_en: The flight eventually got away six hours late.

defs.def_en: Eventually means in the end, especially after a lot of delays, problems, or arguments.

ext.ext_cn: 最后，你的孩子会离开家，作为一个完全独立的成年人过她自己的生活。
ext.ext_en: Eventually your child will leave home to lead her own life as a fully independent adult...

ext.ext_cn: 她把那间酒吧当作一个起点，最终计划是经营自己的乡村旅馆连锁店。
ext.ext_en: She sees the bar as a starting point and eventually plans to run her own chain of country inns.

defs.def_en: Eventually means at the end of a situation or process or as the final result of it.

defs.def_cn: 沉思;冥想;若有所思地说(或写)

ext.ext_cn: 很多报纸都在揣测总统的命运。
ext.ext_en: Many of the papers muse on the fate of the President...

ext.ext_cn: 她沉思道：“总的来说，我不喜欢‘制度森严的教会’。”
ext.ext_en: 'As a whole,' she muses, 'the 'organized church' turns me off'...

defs.def_en: If  you muse on something, you think about it, usually saying or writing what you are thinking at the same time.

defs.def_cn: (给画家、诗人或音乐家带来灵感的)女神，创作女神

ext.ext_cn: 她曾是法国画家亨利·马蒂斯的人体模特和灵感女神。
ext.ext_en: Once she was a nude model and muse to French artist Henri Matisse.

ext.ext_cn: 给他以灵感的人们
ext.ext_en: ...the muses who fuel his inspiration.

defs.def_en: A muse is a person, usually a woman, who gives someone, usually a man, a desire to create art, poetry, or music, and gives them ideas for it.

defs.def_cn: 对…摆出屈尊俯就的样子

ext.ext_cn: 别在我面前摆出一副屈尊俯就的样子！
ext.ext_en: Don't you patronize me!...

ext.ext_cn: 科妮莉亚常常觉得她的老师们对她摆出屈尊俯就的样子。
ext.ext_en: Cornelia often felt patronised by her tutors.

defs.def_en: If someone patronizes you, they speak or behave towards you in a way which seems friendly, but which shows that they think they are superior to you in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 日本皇室资助日本艺术协会。
ext.ext_en: The Japanese Imperial family patronises the Japanese Art Association.

defs.def_en: Someone who patronizes artists, writers, or musicians supports them and gives them money.

ext.ext_cn: 伯尔尼的女士们喜欢去联邦宫殿用茶点。
ext.ext_en: The ladies of Berne liked to patronize the Palace for tea and little cakes.

defs.def_en: If someone patronizes a place such as a pub, bar, or hotel, they are one of its customers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （所有人）一致同意的，全体一致的，无异议的

ext.ext_cn: 编辑人员一致谴责这些提议。
ext.ext_en: Editors were unanimous in their condemnation of the proposals...

ext.ext_cn: 他们一致认为必须对乔特勒斯比庄园加以保护。
ext.ext_en: They were unanimous that Chortlesby Manor must be preserved.

defs.def_en: When a group of people are unanimous, they all agree about something or all vote for the same thing.

defs.def_cn: （投票、决定、协议等）全体同意的，无异议的，一致通过的

ext.ext_cn: 投票一致同意匈牙利成为会员国
ext.ext_en: ...the unanimous vote for Hungarian membership...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的决定是全体一致通过的。
ext.ext_en: Their decision was unanimous.

defs.def_en: A unanimous vote, decision, or agreement is one in which all the people involved agree.

defs.def_cn: 和平主义者；反战主义者
defs.def_en: A pacifist is someone who believes that violence is wrong and refuses to take part in wars.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 和平主义的；反战主义的
defs.def_en: If someone has pacifist views, they believe that war and violence are always wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 没有分出胜负的比赛在三四天后重赛。
ext.ext_en: Drawn matches were replayed three or four days later.

ext.ext_cn: 如果重新比赛，我们有信心取得胜利。
ext.ext_en: If there has to be a replay we are confident of victory.

defs.def_en: If a match between two sports teams is replayed, the two teams play it again, because neither team won the first time, or because the match was stopped because of bad weather.

ext.ext_cn: 他停下机器，重新播放了一遍信息。
ext.ext_en: He stopped the machine and replayed the message.

ext.ext_cn: 我看了一遍录像带上他摔倒时的慢动作重放。
ext.ext_en: I watched a slow-motion videotape replay of his fall.

defs.def_en: If you replay something that you have recorded on film or tape, you play it again in order to watch it or listen to it.

defs.def_cn: (反复在脑海里)重放;不断想起

ext.ext_cn: 她好多个晚上躺在床上，不断想起火灾场面。
ext.ext_en: She spends her nights lying in bed, replaying the fire in her mind.

defs.def_en: If you replay an event in your mind, you think about it again and again.

defs.def_cn: （基督教的）棕榈主日（复活节前的星期日）
defs.def_en: Palm Sunday is the Sunday before Easter. It is the day when Christians remember Jesus Christ's arrival in Jerusalem a few days before he was killed.

ext.ext_cn: 到处散落着玩具的凌乱的花园
ext.ext_en: ...an untidy garden scattered with children's playthings.

defs.def_en: A plaything is a toy or other object that a child plays with.

ext.ext_cn: 把女人当玩物的不忠丈夫
ext.ext_en: ...an unfaithful husband who treated women as playthings...

ext.ext_cn: 他不会允许任何人为了达到其自身目的把他变成政治玩物。
ext.ext_en: He would not allow anyone to make him into a political plaything for their own ends.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is treating you as a plaything, you think that they are using you for their amusement or advantage, and do not care about you.

ext.ext_cn: 仿效和接受新事物的无限能力
ext.ext_en: ...an unbounded capacity to imitate and adopt the new...

ext.ext_cn: 他的建议总是很明智，他的精力似乎永远也用不完。
ext.ext_en: His advice was always sensible and his energy unbounded.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unbounded, you mean that it has, or seems to have, no limits.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 警察涉嫌滥用武力
ext.ext_en: ...the alleged use of excessive force by police...

ext.ext_cn: 政府称地方当局开支过大。
ext.ext_en: The government says that local authority spending is excessive.

defs.def_en: If you describe the amount or level of something as excessive, you disapprove of it because it is more or higher than is necessary or reasonable.

ext.ext_cn: 辛格尔顿是个牛皮大王，他自称有一条空手道黑带。
ext.ext_en: Singleton was a fantasist who claimed to have a karate blackbelt.

defs.def_en: A fantasist is someone who constantly tells lies about their life and achievements in order to make them sound more exciting than they really are.

defs.def_cn: 特技表演者;(电影中的)特技替身演员

ext.ext_cn: 英国特技表演者埃迪·基德骑摩托车飞越了中国长城。
ext.ext_en: The British stunt man Eddie Kidd jumped over the Great Wall of China on a motorcycle.

defs.def_en: A stunt man is a man whose job is to do dangerous things, either for publicity, or in a film instead of an actor so that the actor does not risk being injured.
When women refer to their menfolk, they mean the men in their family or society.

defs.def_cn: 能击败强大对手的人（或运动队）；强手（或强队）的克星

ext.ext_cn: 强队克星约维尔队在托基以5比2取胜，成为历史上最辉煌的非联赛俱乐部。
ext.ext_en: Giant-killers Yeovil became the most successful non-league club in history with their 5-2 win at Torquay.

defs.def_en: A giant-killer is a sportsman, sportswoman, or team that unexpectedly beats a much stronger opponent.

defs.def_cn: 有意的;精心计划的;蓄谋的

ext.ext_cn: 他们在该地区的行动是精心谋划的，意在恐吓土地所有者放弃手中的地产。
ext.ext_en: Their movements through the region were calculated to terrify landowners into abandoning their holdings...

ext.ext_en: These tracks were calculated to be controversial and attract attention to the album.

defs.def_en: If something is calculated to have a particular effect, it is specially done or arranged in order to have that effect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这样的声明不太可能吓住将来的移民。
ext.ext_en: Such a statement was hardly calculated to deter future immigrants.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not calculated to have a particular effect, you mean that it is unlikely to have that effect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 艾琳擦洗地板就是为了蓄意掩盖她的罪行。
ext.ext_en: Irene's cleaning the floor had been a calculated attempt to cover up her crime.

ext.ext_cn: 蓄谋已久、环环相扣的夺权策略
ext.ext_en: ...a calculated and coherent strategy for winning power.

defs.def_en: You can describe a clever or dishonest action as calculated when it is very carefully planned or arranged.

defs.def_cn: (风险)认为值得一试的，权衡考虑过的

ext.ext_en: The President took a calculated political risk in throwing his full support behind the rebels.

defs.def_en: If you take a calculated risk, you do something which you think might be successful, although you have fully considered the possible bad consequences of your action.

ext.ext_cn: 一些美国人在 12 月疯狂花钱，以避开新税。
ext.ext_en: Some Americans went on a spending spree in December to beat the new tax.

defs.def_en: If you spend a period of time doing something in an excessive way, you can say that you are going on a particular kind of spree .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He grew older and more rebellious.

defs.def_en: If you think someone behaves in an unacceptable way and does not do what they are told, you can say they are rebellious .

defs.def_cn: （反对现行政府体制的群体）反叛的，叛乱的

ext.ext_cn: 叛乱的军官控制了电台，广播宣布推翻君主制的消息。
ext.ext_en: The rebellious officers, having seized the radio station, broadcast the news of the overthrow of the monarchy.

defs.def_en: A rebellious group of people is a group involved in taking violent action against the rulers of their own country, usually in order to change the system of government there.
The spokes of a wheel are the bars that connect the outer ring to the centre.

defs.def_en: Epaulettes are decorations worn on the shoulders of certain uniforms, especially military ones.

ext.ext_en: A few days before, a fire had devastated large parts of Windsor Castle.

defs.def_en: If something devastates an area or a place, it damages it very badly or destroys it totally.

ext.ext_cn: 他是活跃的双性恋者。

ext.ext_cn: 他是活跃的双性恋者。
ext.ext_en: He was an active bisexual.

defs.def_en: Someone who is bisexual is sexually attracted to both men and women.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她像个小女孩一样咯咯地笑了笑。
ext.ext_en: She gave a little girlish giggle.

defs.def_en: If you describe a woman as girlish, you mean she behaves, looks, or sounds like a young girl, for example because she is shy, excited, or lively.

defs.def_cn: (机器、引擎)嗡嗡响，发出沉闷声

ext.ext_cn: 空调嗡嗡作响。
ext.ext_en: The air-conditioner thrummed.

ext.ext_cn: 制冷机低沉的嗡嗡声
ext.ext_en: ...the thrum of refrigeration motors...

defs.def_en: When something such as a machine or engine thrums, it makes a low beating sound.

defs.def_cn: (用于形容词、名词后)表示“以…为核心的”

ext.ext_en: ...lemon-centered white chocolates.

defs.def_en: See also:centre;self-centred;-centred can be added to adjectives and nouns to indicate what kind of a centre something has.

ext.ext_en: The city council has voted almost unanimously in favour.

defs.def_en: A council is a group of people who are elected to govern a local area such as a city or, in Britain, a county.

defs.def_cn: (房屋或公寓)地方政府出租的

ext.ext_en: Council tenants around the country are planning a mass lobby of Parliament.

defs.def_en: Council houses or flats are owned by the local council, and people pay rent to live in them.

ext.ext_cn: 全国公民自由委员会
ext.ext_en: ...the National Council for Civil Liberties.

ext.ext_cn: 艺术委员会
ext.ext_en: ...the Arts Council.

ext.ext_en: The permanent council of the Organization of American States meets today here in Washington.

ext.ext_cn: 德意志联邦银行的中央委员会
ext.ext_en: ...the Bundesbank's central council.

defs.def_en: In some organizations, the council is the group of people that controls or governs it.

ext.ext_en: President Najibullah said he would call a grand council of all Afghans...

ext.ext_en: The president also meets ministers at inter-ministerial councils held at the Elysée Palace.

defs.def_en: A council is a specially organized, formal meeting that is attended by a particular group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然被判终身监禁，但是他在服刑10年后可以申请假释。
ext.ext_en: Although sentenced to life, he will become eligible for parole after serving 10 years.

ext.ext_en: If released, he will continue to be on parole for eight more years.

defs.def_en: If a prisoner is given parole, he or she is released before the official end of their prison sentence and has to promise to behave well.

ext.ext_en: He faces at most 12 years in prison and could be paroled after eight years.

A deal-maker is someone in business or politics who makes deals.

ext.ext_en: You can instruct your bank to allow a third party to remove money from your account.

defs.def_en: A third party is someone who is not one of the main people involved in a business agreement or legal case, but who is involved in it in a minor role.

ext.ext_en: Premiums for third-party cover are set to rise by up to 25 per cent.

defs.def_en: Third-party insurance is a type of insurance that pays money to people who are hurt or whose property is damaged as a result of something you have done. It does not pay you any money for damage you suffer as a result of your own actions.

ext.ext_cn: 花式咖啡可在美食店和咖啡店买到。
ext.ext_en: Flavored coffee is sold at gourmet food stores and coffee shops...

ext.ext_cn: 这夫妇俩都有烹饪美食的嗜好。
ext.ext_en: The couple share a love of gourmet cooking.

defs.def_en: Gourmet food is nicer or more unusual or sophisticated than ordinary food, and is often more expensive.

defs.def_cn: 美食家；讲究饮食的人;老饕
defs.def_en: A gourmet is someone who enjoys good food, and who knows a lot about food and wine.

ext.ext_cn: 被关在卢卡斯维尔一级警戒监狱的450名囚犯
ext.ext_en: ...the 450 inmates at the maximum-security lock-up in Lucasville.

defs.def_en: A lock-up is the same as a jail .

ext.ext_en: 25lb of Semtex explosive was found in the lock-up she had rented to Mr Henderson.

ext.ext_cn: 独立车库
ext.ext_en: ...a lock-up garage.

defs.def_en: A lock-up is a garage that is used by someone, but is not next to their house.

defs.def_cn: 不自然的东西;矫揉造作之物

ext.ext_cn: 他们衣着简朴，不使用那些现代的发明物。
ext.ext_en: They wear simple clothes and shun modern contrivances...

ext.ext_cn: 矫揉造作而缺乏实质性内容的音乐
ext.ext_en: music with a tendency towards contrivance and lack of substance.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a contrivance, you disapprove of it because it is unnecessary and artificial.

ext.ext_cn: 提高价格的计谋
ext.ext_en: ...some contrivance to raise prices.

defs.def_en: A contrivance is an unfair or dishonest scheme or trick to gain an advantage for yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 英国会对运载证件不齐全的乘客进入国内的航空公司课以罚款。
ext.ext_en: Britain imposed fines on airlines which bring in passengers without proper papers...

ext.ext_en: Many companies have imposed a pay freeze...

defs.def_en: If you impose something on people, you use your authority to force them to accept it.

ext.ext_cn: 父母双方都应切记不要把自己的喜好强加给孩子。
ext.ext_en: Parents of either sex should beware of imposing their own tastes on their children.

defs.def_en: If you impose your opinions or beliefs on other people, you try and make people accept them as a rule or as a model to copy.

defs.def_cn: 使遭受，使承受(压力、痛苦等)

ext.ext_cn: 拍摄任务使她承受了格外大的压力。
ext.ext_en: The filming imposed an additional strain on her.

ext.ext_cn: 无休止的课程改革使教师承受的压力
ext.ext_en: ...the pressures imposed upon teachers by ceaseless curriculum reforms.

defs.def_en: If something imposes strain, pressure, or suffering on someone, it causes them to experience it.

ext.ext_en: I was afraid you'd simply feel we were imposing on you...

ext.ext_cn: “利奥,我妈妈觉得我不应该再在这儿麻烦你了，”格雷丝说。
ext.ext_en: 'Mum thinks I should stop imposing on your hospitality, Leo,' said Grace.

defs.def_en: If someone imposes on you, they unreasonably expect you to do something for them which you do not want to do.

ext.ext_cn: 我不想打扰自己已婚的朋友。
ext.ext_en: I didn't want to impose myself on my married friends.

defs.def_en: If someone imposes themselves on you, they force you to accept their company although you may not want to.

ext.ext_cn: 他一字一顿，听上去很生硬。
ext.ext_en: His voice was harsh as he enunciated each word carefully...

ext.ext_cn: 她缓慢、仔细而又清晰地读着。
ext.ext_en: She enunciates very slowly and carefully.

defs.def_en: When you enunciate a word or part of a word, you pronounce it clearly.

defs.def_cn: 阐明；清楚而准确地阐释

ext.ext_cn: 他总是乐意向所有愿意倾听的人阐明他的观点。
ext.ext_en: He was ever ready to enunciate his views to all who would listen.

defs.def_en: When you enunciate a thought, idea, or plan, you express it very clearly and precisely.

ext.ext_cn: 他一丝不苟地作好准备并准时地在门厅等候。
ext.ext_en: He was punctilious about being ready and waiting in the entrance hall exactly on time...

ext.ext_cn: 他是个非常拘礼的年轻人。
ext.ext_en: He was a punctilious young man.

defs.def_en: Someone who is punctilious is very careful to behave correctly.

ext.ext_cn: 极大地唤起了对那段时间的回忆
ext.ext_en: ...a perfect evocation of the period.

defs.def_en: An evocation of something involves creating an image or impression of it.

defs.def_cn: 周密地计划；详尽地安排

ext.ext_en: I have started planning out what I shall be doing next week.

defs.def_en: If you plan out the future, you decide in detail what you are going to do.

Capital-intensive industries and businesses need the investment of large sums of money.

defs.def_en: Adventuresome means the same as adventurous .

ext.ext_en: ...prepubescent boys and girls.

defs.def_en: Prepubescent means relating to the time just before someone's body becomes physically mature.

ext.ext_en: He was wearing a cream silk shirt and a tartan golfing cap.

ext.ext_cn: 在西班牙打高尔夫球度假
ext.ext_en: ...a golfing holiday in Spain.

defs.def_en: Golfing is used to describe things that involve the playing of golf or that are used while playing golf.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以打网球或高尔夫球。
ext.ext_en: You can play tennis or go golfing.

defs.def_en: Golfing is the activity of playing golf.

defs.def_cn: 起决定性作用的事实(或论点)

ext.ext_en: DNA fingerprinting has proved the clincher in this investigation...

ext.ext_en: The clincher was City's second goal, scored minutes from the end.

defs.def_en: A clincher is a fact or argument that finally proves something, settles a dispute, or helps someone achieve a victory.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Herr Schmidt is certainly the most odious man I have ever met...

ext.ext_cn: 法官称这一罪行令人发指。
ext.ext_en: The judge described the crime as odious.

defs.def_en: If you describe people or things as odious, you think that they are extremely unpleasant.

ext.ext_en: ...published by Boxtree, at £0.99 for the softback and £5.99 for the hardback...

ext.ext_cn: 这种书曾经畅销一时，现在推出了平装本。
ext.ext_en: This title was a best seller and is now available in softback.

defs.def_en: A softback is a book with a thin cardboard, paper, or plastic cover.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 妄自尊大的;高傲的;自负的

ext.ext_cn: 他傲慢自负，虚荣无知。
ext.ext_en: He was self-important, vain and ignorant.

ext.ext_cn: 妄自尊大的官员们
ext.ext_en: ...self-important officials.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is self-important, you disapprove of them because they behave as if they are more important than they really are.

ext.ext_cn: 雨水从他的棒球帽帽檐上滴落。
ext.ext_en: Rain dripped from the brim of his baseball cap.

ext.ext_cn: 宽边平顶黑礼帽
ext.ext_en: ...a flat black hat with a wide brim.

defs.def_en: The brim of a hat is the wide part that sticks outwards at the bottom.

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队在锦标赛中连赢两场后信心大增。
ext.ext_en: England are brimming with confidence after two straight wins in the tournament.

ext.ext_cn: 我注意到多拉贝拉非常兴奋。
ext.ext_en: I noticed Dorabella was brimming over with excitement...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is brimming with a particular quality, they are full of that quality.

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔满怀乞求地看着他，两眼泪汪汪的。
ext.ext_en: Michael looked at him imploringly, eyes brimming with tears.

ext.ext_cn: 她看到我时，两眼泪汪汪的，说不出话来。
ext.ext_en: When she saw me, her eyes brimmed over with tears and she could not speak.

defs.def_en: When your eyes are brimming with tears, they are full of fluid because you are upset, although you are not actually crying.

ext.ext_cn: 花坛里长满了百合和玫瑰。
ext.ext_en: The flowerbeds brim with a mixture of lilies and roses.

defs.def_en: If something brims with particular things, it is packed full of them.

ext.ext_en: Richard filled her glass right up to the brim...

ext.ext_cn: 厕所里爬满了虫子。
ext.ext_en: The toilet was full to the brim with insects.

defs.def_en: If something, especially a container, is filled to the brim or full to the brim with something, it is filled right up to the top.

ext.ext_cn: 她心跳加快，满心喜悦。
ext.ext_en: Her heart beat so fast and she was full to the brim with joy.

defs.def_en: If you are full to the brim with a particular emotion, you feel that emotion so strongly that it is stronger than all other emotions.

defs.def_cn: 从行驶的汽车里（射击）的;飞车进行的

ext.ext_en: He was killed by three shots to the head in a drive-by shooting.

defs.def_en: A drive-by shooting or a drive-by murder involves shooting someone from a moving car.

defs.def_en: If you remove something from a place, you take it away.

ext.ext_cn: 他脱下了夹克。
ext.ext_en: He removed his jacket.

defs.def_en: If you remove clothing, you take it off.

ext.ext_cn: 这种处理方式会清除最顽固的污渍。

ext.ext_cn: 试试用柠檬汁去除手指上的烟渍。
ext.ext_en: Try using lemon juice to remove tobacco stains from your fingers.

defs.def_en: If you remove a stain from something, you make the stain disappear by treating it with a chemical or by washing it.

ext.ext_cn: 学生评议会投票免除了富勒的职位。

defs.def_en: If people remove someone from power or from something such as a committee, they stop them being in power or being a member of the committee.

defs.def_en: If you remove an obstacle, a restriction, or a problem, you get rid of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她喜欢他的陪伴，也很享受离伦敦社交圈仅仅一步之遥的兴奋感觉。
ext.ext_en: She enjoyed his company and the excitement of feeling herself linked at one remove to London society...
