defs.def_en: If you do or experience something at one remove, you do not do it or experience it yourself, but someone else does it or experiences it instead of you.

ext.ext_cn: 澳大利亚的克里斯·罗伯逊在决赛中击败了自己的同胞克里斯·迪特马。
ext.ext_en: Chris  Robertson of Australia beat his compatriot Chris Dittmar in the final.

defs.def_en: Your compatriots are people from  your own country.
Rhubarb is a plant with large leaves and long red stems. You can cook the stems with sugar to make jam or puddings.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 纽曼阴险得很，明里一套，暗里一套。
ext.ext_en: Newman was devious, prepared to say one thing in print and another in private...

ext.ext_cn: 她通过不正当的手段追查到了另外那个女人。
ext.ext_en: By devious means she tracked down the other woman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as devious you do not like them because you think they are are dishonest and like to keep things secret, often in a complicated way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他走了一条迂回路线。
ext.ext_en: He followed a devious route.

defs.def_en: A devious route or path to a place involves many changes in direction, rather than being as straight and direct as possible.
Frankincense is a substance which is obtained from a tree and which smells pleasant when it is burned. It is used especially in religious ceremonies.

defs.def_cn: 怀有，抱有(希望);怀念(过去)

ext.ext_cn: 总统将铭记这次俄亥俄之行。
ext.ext_en: The president will cherish the memory of this visit to Ohio...

ext.ext_cn: 那是一个美好的时刻，我们将多年不忘。
ext.ext_en: It was a wonderful occasion which we will cherish for many years to come.

defs.def_en: If you cherish something such as a hope or a pleasant memory, you keep it in your mind for a long period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 他由衷地爱恋并珍惜她。
ext.ext_en: He genuinely loved and cherished her...

ext.ext_cn: 房子先前的主人非常爱惜这房子。
ext.ext_en: The previous owners had cherished the house.

defs.def_en: If you cherish someone or something, you take good care of them because you love them.

defs.def_cn: 珍视，维护，捍卫(权利、特权或原则)

ext.ext_cn: 这些人民珍视他们的独立和主权。
ext.ext_en: These people cherish their independence and sovereignty.

defs.def_en: If you cherish a right, a privilege, or a principle, you regard it as important and try hard to keep it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 着迷的；迷恋的；强迫性的；过分（到不正常程序）的

ext.ext_cn: 威廉斯对赛车到了痴迷的程度。
ext.ext_en: Williams is obsessive about motor racing...

ext.ext_cn: 你正处于失去工作后一段过度焦虑的抑郁期。
ext.ext_en: You were suffering from a period of obsessive depression after losing your job.

defs.def_en: If someone's behaviour is obsessive, they cannot stop doing a particular thing or behaving in a particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 无论在哪个领域，过分痴迷者都会跟他们的癖好一样令人厌烦。
ext.ext_en: Obsessives, in any area, are invariably as boring as their hobbies...

ext.ext_cn: 我不是个强迫症患者，完全不是。
ext.ext_en: I am not an obsessive. Not at all.

defs.def_en: An obsessive is someone who is obsessive about something or who behaves in an obsessive way.

ext.ext_cn: 奥布赖恩坐在一张吧凳上，胳膊肘靠在吧台上。
ext.ext_en: O'Brien sat on a bar stool and leaned his elbows on the counter.

defs.def_en: A stool is a seat with legs but no support for your arms or back.
If someone has fallen between two stools, they are unable to decide which of two courses of action to take and as a result they have not done either of them successfully.
Stools are the pieces of solid waste matter that are passed out of a person's body through their bowels.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 钠和硫磺腐蚀性很强。
ext.ext_en: Sodium and sulphur are highly corrosive.

defs.def_en: A corrosive substance is able to destroy solid materials by a chemical reaction.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 逐渐起破坏作用的;损害性的

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀的破坏作用
ext.ext_en: ...the corrosive effects of inflation.

defs.def_en: If you say that something has a corrosive effect, you mean that it gradually causes serious harm.

defs.def_cn: 小问题;（尤指）暂时的耽搁

ext.ext_cn: 用不着为最近销售上出现的一点小问题感到惊慌。
ext.ext_en: A recent sales hiccup is nothing to panic about...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管偶尔出现一些小的磕碰，美国和老挝一直保持着很友好的关系。
ext.ext_en: Despite the occasional hiccup, the US and Laos have had quite cordial relations.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a small problem or difficulty as a hiccup, especially if it does not last very long or is easily put right.

ext.ext_cn: 小婴儿进食过程中或刚刚进食后经常会打嗝。
ext.ext_en: A young baby may frequently get a bout of hiccups during or soon after a feed.

defs.def_en: When you have hiccups, you make repeated sharp sounds in your throat, often because you have been eating or drinking too quickly.
A hiccup is a sound of the kind that you make when you have hiccups.

ext.ext_cn: 刚才一口吞下整个鸡蛋，她现在还在打嗝。
ext.ext_en: She was still hiccuping from the egg she had swallowed whole.

defs.def_en: When you hiccup, you make repeated sharp sounds in your throat.

ext.ext_cn: 麦克阿瑟将军曾是太平洋战区盟军的最高统帅。
ext.ext_en: MacArthur was Supreme Commander for the allied powers in the Pacific.

ext.ext_cn: 最高法院
ext.ext_en: ...the Supreme Court.

defs.def_en: Supreme is used in the title of a person or an official group to indicate that they are at the highest level in a particular organization or system.

ext.ext_cn: 她的认可是至关重要的。
ext.ext_en: Her approval was of supreme importance...

ext.ext_cn: 该女士图谋攫取最高权力。
ext.ext_en: The lady conspired to seize supreme power.

defs.def_en: You use supreme to emphasize that a quality or thing is very great.

defs.def_cn: (通过考试)取得资格的，有资格的，合格的

ext.ext_cn: 有教学资格的教师远远供不应求。
ext.ext_en: Demand has far outstripped supply of qualified teachers...

ext.ext_cn: 读者应该向有资历的专业人士征求此类意见。
ext.ext_en: The reader should seek the services of a qualified professional for such advice.

defs.def_en: Someone who is qualified has passed the examinations that they need to pass in order to work in a particular profession.

defs.def_cn: （支持、赞同）有限度的，有保留的

ext.ext_cn: 政府已有所保留地支持这个观点。
ext.ext_en: The government has given qualified support to the idea...

ext.ext_cn: 韦德先生对两个问题给出了不完全肯定的回答。
ext.ext_en: Mr Wade answers both questions with a qualified yes.

defs.def_en: If you give someone or something qualified support or approval, your support or approval is not total because you have some doubts.

ext.ext_cn: 即便是作为一次人道主义行动，它也不过是取得了有限的成功。
ext.ext_en: Even as a humanitarian mission it has been only a qualified success.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a qualified success, you mean that it is only partly successful.

ext.ext_cn: 我16岁的时候离家出走了。
ext.ext_en: I ran away from home when I was sixteen...

ext.ext_cn: 科林被他打了一顿后就离家出走了，从此杳无音讯。
ext.ext_en: After his beating Colin ran away and hasn't been heard of since...

defs.def_en: If you run away from a place, you leave it because you are unhappy there.

ext.ext_cn: 去年，她和一个叫麦克塔维什的男人私奔了。
ext.ext_en: She ran away with a man called McTavish last year...

ext.ext_cn: 我和他一直盘算着一起私奔。
ext.ext_en: He and I were always planning to run away together.

defs.def_en: If you run away with someone, you secretly go away with them in order to live with them or marry them.

defs.def_cn: 逃避，躲避(问题、新事物等)

ext.ext_cn: 他们避开了这个问题，希望它不了了之。
ext.ext_en: They run away from the problem, hoping it will disappear of its own accord...

ext.ext_cn: 你不能永远逃避。
ext.ext_en: You can't run away for ever.

defs.def_en: If you run away from something unpleasant or new, you try to avoid dealing with it or thinking about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 莱内的声音很恐怖，既难听又刺耳。
ext.ext_en: Lainey had a terrible voice, unmusical and sharp.

defs.def_en: An unmusical sound is unpleasant to listen to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们完全不懂音乐。
ext.ext_en: They're completely unmusical.

defs.def_en: An unmusical person cannot play or appreciate music.
Compound interest is interest that is calculated both on an original sum of money and on interest which has previously been added to the sum.

defs.def_cn: (常指因生气而)跺着脚走，迈着重重的步伐

ext.ext_cn: 他转身不理他们，噔噔噔地爬上了山。
ext.ext_en: He turned his back on them and stomped off up the hill...

ext.ext_cn: 他跺着脚走出了房间。
ext.ext_en: He stomped out of the room.

defs.def_en: If you stomp somewhere, you walk there with very heavy steps, often because you are angry.
A bung is a round piece of wood, cork, or rubber which you use to close the hole in a container such as a barrel or flask.

ext.ext_cn: 往米中倒入大量凉水，然后放在炉子上。
ext.ext_en: Pour a whole lot of cold water over the rice, and bung it in the oven.

defs.def_en: If you bung something somewhere, you put it there in a quick and careless way.

ext.ext_cn: 水槽又堵上了。
ext.ext_en: The sink's bunged up again...

ext.ext_cn: 我的鼻子完全不通气了。
ext.ext_en: My nose is all bunged up.

defs.def_en: If something is bunged up, it is blocked.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不合时宜的;时机不佳的

ext.ext_cn: 他认为减税不合时宜。
ext.ext_en: He argued that the tax cut was ill-timed.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ill-timed, you mean that it happens or is done at the wrong time, so that it is damaging or rude.

ext.ext_cn: 在她的手提包里发现了一张皱巴巴的小纸片。
ext.ext_en: A crumpled scrap of paper was found in her handbag...

ext.ext_cn: 用木屑燃起的火
ext.ext_en: ...a fire fueled by scraps of wood...

defs.def_en: A scrap of something is a very small piece or amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 星期天晚餐的残羹剩饭
ext.ext_en: ...the scraps from the Sunday dinner table.

defs.def_en: Scraps are pieces of unwanted food which are thrown away or given to animals.

ext.ext_cn: 侯赛因总统号召中东所有国家放弃核武器和化学武器。
ext.ext_en: President Hussein called on all countries in the Middle East to scrap nuclear or chemical weapons...

ext.ext_cn: 人们曾认为会放开护照管制。
ext.ext_en: It had been thought that passport controls would be scrapped.

defs.def_en: If you scrap something, you get rid of it or cancel it.

ext.ext_cn: 爸爸的办公室里总有大量的废纸。
ext.ext_en: There's always tons of scrap paper in Dad's office.

defs.def_en: Scrap metal or paper is no longer wanted for its original purpose, but may have some other use.

ext.ext_cn: 成千上万的坦克、大炮和装甲车将被切割成废金属。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of tanks, artillery pieces and armored vehicles will be cut up for scrap.

defs.def_en: Scrap is metal from old or damaged machinery or cars.

ext.ext_cn: 比利·邦兹经常与球员发生拳脚冲突。
ext.ext_en: Billy Bonds has never been one to avoid a scrap.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a fight or a quarrel as a scrap, especially if it is not very serious.

ext.ext_cn: 易早泄
ext.ext_en: ... a tendency to ejaculate quickly.

defs.def_en: When a man ejaculates, sperm comes out through his penis.

ext.ext_cn: “什么？”凯瑟琳脱口说道。
ext.ext_en: 'What?' Catherine ejaculated.

defs.def_en: If you ejaculate, you suddenly say or shout something, for example because you are very surprised.

defs.def_cn: (尤指由于醉酒或吸毒而出现的)神志不清，恍惚，不省人事

ext.ext_cn: 他烂醉如泥，瘫倒在沙发上。
ext.ext_en: He fell back onto the sofa in a drunken stupor...

ext.ext_cn: 他每晚都喝得不省人事。
ext.ext_en: He was drinking himself into a stupor every night.

defs.def_en: Someone who is in a stupor is almost unconscious and is unable to act or think normally, especially as a result of drink or drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 英国近年的拳击比赛中很少有如此激动人心的。
ext.ext_en: Few contests in the recent history of British boxing have been as thrilling.

ext.ext_cn: 写作比赛
ext.ext_en: ...a writing contest.

defs.def_en: See also:beauty contest;A contest is a competition or game in which people try to win.

ext.ext_cn: 定于11月举行的州选举将是明年总统竞选前最后一次此类投票选举。
ext.ext_en: The state election due in November will be the last such ballot before next year's presidential contest...

ext.ext_cn: 教会与政府之间明显的争斗
ext.ext_en: ...a clear contest between church and state.

defs.def_en: A contest is a struggle to win power or control.

defs.def_cn: 争取赢得(选举、比赛等);角逐

ext.ext_cn: 他很快获得了本党提名,角逐大选。
ext.ext_en: He quickly won his party's nomination to contest the elections.

ext.ext_cn: 各方争奇斗艳、难分高下的地区花卉展
ext.ext_en: ...a closely contested regional flower show.

defs.def_en: If someone contests an election or competition, they take part in it and try to win it.

ext.ext_cn: 你的前任雇主若对本案存有异议，必须在14天内予以答复。
ext.ext_en: Your former employer has to reply within 14 days in order to contest the case...

ext.ext_cn: 性别歧视是一个争论激烈的话题。
ext.ext_en: Gender discrimination is a hotly contested issue.

defs.def_en: If you contest a statement or decision, you object to it formally because you think it is wrong or unreasonable.

ext.ext_cn: 持械抢劫者通过墙上的一个洞闯进了一家珠宝店。
ext.ext_en: Armed robbers broke into a jeweller's through a hole in the wall.

defs.def_en: A robber is someone who steals money or property from a bank, a shop, or a vehicle, often by using force or threats.  →see usage note at:thief

ext.ext_cn: 丹在自己的船舱里朝舱外凝视着。
ext.ext_en: Dan was in his cabin, staring out of a porthole.

defs.def_en: A porthole is a small round window in the side of a ship or aircraft.

defs.def_cn: 凉拌卷心菜丝；生菜色拉
defs.def_en: Coleslaw is a salad of chopped raw cabbage, carrots, onions, and sometimes other vegetables, usually with mayonnaise.
A financial consultant is the same as a financial adviser .

ext.ext_cn: 所有爬行动物生长过程中都要蜕皮。
ext.ext_en: All reptiles have to slough their skin to grow...

ext.ext_cn: 柠檬天竺葵枝条底部棕色的枯叶会脱落。
ext.ext_en: The lemon geranium sloughs dry brown leaves at the base of its branches.

defs.def_en: When a plant sloughs its leaves, or an animal such as a snake sloughs its skin, the leaves or skin come off naturally.

ext.ext_cn: 这项统计数据显然没有披露未登记的罪案。
ext.ext_en: The statistics don't reveal of course unrecorded crime...

ext.ext_cn: 波兰大多数私营企业都未注册在案。
ext.ext_en: Much of Poland's private industry goes unrecorded...

defs.def_en: You use unrecorded to describe something that has not been written down or recorded officially, especially when it should have been.
Humanism is the belief that people can achieve happiness and live well without religion.

defs.def_cn: 水田芥，水芥子(长于溪流或池塘中，叶子可作色拉生食)
defs.def_en: Watercress is a small plant with white flowers which grows in streams and pools. Its leaves taste hot and are eaten raw in salads.

defs.def_cn: 在澳大利亚（或新西兰）；在澳新地区

ext.ext_cn: 就澳新地区而言，夏季滑雪的最佳去处是新西兰。
ext.ext_en: For summer skiing down under, there is no better place than New Zealand.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to Australia and New Zealand as down under .

defs.def_cn: 钚（尤用于核武器及用作核电站燃料的一种放射性元素）
defs.def_en: Plutonium is a radioactive element used especially in nuclear weapons and as a fuel in nuclear power stations.
Someone's daughter-in-law is the wife of their son.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 焦躁不安的;紧张的;恼怒的
defs.def_en: If someone is wound up, they are very tense and nervous or angry.

defs.def_cn: 意思是;表示…的意思;作…解释

ext.ext_cn: 在现代威尔士语中，glas 意为“蓝色”。
ext.ext_en: In modern Welsh, 'glas' means 'blue'...

ext.ext_cn: evidence 是什么意思？
ext.ext_en: What does 'evidence' mean?...

defs.def_en: If you want to know what a word, code, signal, or gesture means, you want to know what it refers to or what its message is.

ext.ext_cn: 你指的是我吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you mean me?...

ext.ext_cn: 让我用一个古老的故事来说明我的意思吧。
ext.ext_en: Let me illustrate what I mean with an old story...

defs.def_en: If you ask someone what they mean, you are asking them to explain exactly what or who they are referring to or what they are intending to say.

defs.def_cn: (某事)对(某人)很重要，要紧,意义重大

ext.ext_cn: 虽然她目睹了这可耻的一幕，但是这对他来说无关紧要。
ext.ext_en: The idea that she witnessed this shameful incident meant nothing to him...

ext.ext_cn: 获胜对他们来说非常重要。
ext.ext_en: It would mean a lot to them to win.

defs.def_en: If something means something to you, it is important to you in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 前列腺肿大不一定就是癌症。
ext.ext_en: An enlarged prostate does not necessarily mean cancer...

ext.ext_cn: 不能因为他蓄须就说他是嬉皮士。
ext.ext_en: Just because he has a beard doesn't necessarily mean he's a hippy.

defs.def_en: If one thing means another, it shows that the second thing  exists or is true.

ext.ext_cn: 这几乎肯定会导致北大西洋公约组织的终结。
ext.ext_en: It would almost certainly mean the end of NATO...

ext.ext_cn: 商品促销与产品折扣同样意味着可能会省下一大笔钱。
ext.ext_en: Trade and product discounts can also mean big savings...

defs.def_en: If one thing means another, the first thing leads to the second thing happening.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们普遍愿意过平静安宁的生活，即便这意味着只能与单亲生活在一起。
ext.ext_en: Children universally prefer to live in peace and security, even if that means living with only one parent...

ext.ext_cn: 良好的管理需要有效的沟通。
ext.ext_en: Managing well means communicating well.

defs.def_en: If doing one thing means doing another, it involves doing the second thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他说，如果你星期五还不回去上班的话就解雇你。我想他是当真的。
ext.ext_en: He says you're fired if you're not back at work on Friday. And I think he meant it...

ext.ext_cn: 他看得出我并非只是说说而已，于是拿起他的皮衣走了。
ext.ext_en: He could see I meant what I said. So he took his fur coat and left.

defs.def_en: If you say that you mean what you are saying, you are telling someone that you are serious about it and are not joking, exaggerating, or just being polite.

ext.ext_cn: 我无意伤害你。
ext.ext_en: I didn't mean to hurt you...

ext.ext_cn: 如果这么说听起来刺耳的话，那目的就达到了。
ext.ext_en: If that sounds harsh, it is meant to...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone meant to do something, you are saying that they did it deliberately.

ext.ext_cn: 我相信他并无恶意。
ext.ext_en: I'm sure he didn't mean any harm...

ext.ext_cn: 我本无意冒犯，那不过是句脱口而出的冒失话。
ext.ext_en: I didn't mean any offence. It was a flippant, off-the-cuff remark.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone did not mean any harm, offence, or disrespect, you are saying that they did not intend to upset or offend people or to cause problems, even though they may in fact have done so.

ext.ext_cn: 夏天是把想读却没读的新书恶补一下的最佳时机。
ext.ext_en: Summer is the perfect time to catch up on the new books you meant to read...

ext.ext_cn: 你非常清楚我想说什么。
ext.ext_en: You know very well what I meant to say...

defs.def_en: If you mean to do something, you intend or plan to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰不断安慰我说，我们注定要在一起。
ext.ext_en: John was constantly reassuring me that we were meant to be together.

defs.def_en: If you say that something was meant to happen, you believe that it was made to happen by God or fate, and did not just happen  by chance.

defs.def_cn: 我的意思是，也就是说（用于使表述更加清楚）

ext.ext_cn: 这是他的主意，我是指戈登。
ext.ext_en: It was his idea. Gordon's, I mean...

ext.ext_cn: 有什么烦心事吗？我的意思是，除了这件事以外还有吗？
ext.ext_en: Is something upsetting you—I mean, apart from this business?

defs.def_en: You say 'I mean' when making clearer something that you have just said.

defs.def_cn: (用于引出主张，尤指证明自己刚才所说的话)

ext.ext_cn: 我肯定他不会在意的，因为是我问他的。
ext.ext_en: I'm sure he wouldn't mind. I mean, I was the one who asked him...

ext.ext_cn: 他们满脑子种族成见，似乎都是些20世纪30年代的老思想。
ext.ext_en: They were filled with racial stereotypes, I mean, it looked like something from the 1930s.

defs.def_en: You can use 'I mean' to introduce a statement, especially one that justifies something that you have just said.

defs.def_cn: 我的意思是(用于纠正之前所说的话)

ext.ext_cn: 是法律或者古典文学——我的意思是英语或古典文学。
ext.ext_en: It was law or classics—I mean English or classics.

defs.def_en: You say I mean when correcting something that you have just said.

defs.def_cn: 理解…的滋味;了解…的影响

ext.ext_cn: 我明白在这种悲惨的情况下失去孩子的滋味。
ext.ext_en: I know what it means to lose a child under such tragic circumstances.

defs.def_en: If you know what it means to do  something, you know everything that is involved in a particular activity or experience, especially the effect that it has on you.

ext.ext_cn: “哦，盖尔德纳，”他说道，好像他听说过这个名字。
ext.ext_en: 'Oh, Gairdner,' he said, as if that meant something to him...

ext.ext_cn: 有人对 Fareham 这个词有印象吗？
ext.ext_en: Does the word 'Fareham' mean anything to anyone?

defs.def_en: If a name, word, or phrase means something to you, you have heard it before and you know what it refers to.

ext.ext_cn: 我明白您的好意，不过我自己能行。
ext.ext_en: I know you mean well, but I can manage by myself.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone means well, you mean they are trying to be kind and helpful, even though they might be causing someone problems or upsetting them.

defs.def_cn: (疑问句中用于询问对方自己的理解是否正确)你是说

ext.ext_cn: 哪次事故？你是说克里斯蒂娜的那次？
ext.ext_en: What accident? You mean Christina's?...

ext.ext_cn: “我要是说了不呢？”“你是说公寓那件事吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'What if I had said no?' 'About the apartment, you mean?'

defs.def_en: You use 'you mean' in a question to check that you have understood what someone has said.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 别这么吝啬布料，不然做出来的窗帘会显得特寒酸。
ext.ext_en: Don't be mean with fabric, otherwise curtains will end up looking skimpy.

defs.def_en: If you  describe someone as mean, you are being critical of them because they are unwilling to spend much money or to use very much of a particular thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 从地方委员会可能获得的微乎其微的拨款
ext.ext_en: ...the meanest grant possible from the local council.

defs.def_en: If you describe an amount as mean, you are saying that it is very small.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 小姑娘们把自己锁在楼上，因为麦克对她们很刻薄。
ext.ext_en: The little girls had locked themselves in upstairs because Mack had been mean to them...

ext.ext_cn: 拒绝的话我说不出口。
ext.ext_en: I'd feel mean saying no.

defs.def_en: If someone is being mean, they are being unkind to another person, for example by not allowing them to do something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （指人或动物）脾气极坏的，残忍的

ext.ext_cn: 世界上最残忍的斗士
ext.ext_en: ...the meanest fighter in the world.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or animal as mean, you are saying that they are very bad-tempered and cruel.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他从小在巴拿马城中心闹市区的穷街陋巷里长大。
ext.ext_en: He was raised on the mean streets of the central market district of Panama City.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as mean, you think that it looks poor and dirty.

ext.ext_cn: 他烧鲑鱼的水平一流。
ext.ext_en: He cooks a mean salmon...

ext.ext_cn: 玛吉打得一手好网球。
ext.ext_en: Marge played a mean game of tennis.

defs.def_en: You can use mean in expressions such as 'He plays a mean trumpet' and 'She mixes a mean cocktail' to indicate that someone does something extremely well.

defs.def_cn: 高水平的;上乘的;优秀的

ext.ext_cn: 许多别的乐器她也演奏得相当出色。
ext.ext_en: She was no mean performer on a variety of other instruments...

ext.ext_cn: 而且拉姆齐自己也是一位出色的思想家。
ext.ext_en: Moreover, Ramsay was no mean thinker himself.

defs.def_en: You can use no mean in expressions such as 'no mean writer' and 'no mean golfer' to indicate that someone does something well.

ext.ext_cn: 歼灭121架敌机是一个了不起的纪录。
ext.ext_en: To destroy 121 enemy aircraft is no mean record...

ext.ext_cn: 雷普顿进入了决赛，鉴于有1,500所左右的学校参与了角逐，能够取得这样的成绩相当了不起。
ext.ext_en: Repton reached the final, and since around 1,500 schools entered the competition, that was no mean achievement.

defs.def_en: You can use no mean in expressions such as 'no mean achievement' and 'no mean task' to indicate that someone has done something they deserve to be proud of.

ext.ext_cn: 取120个值计算平均数。
ext.ext_en: Take a hundred and twenty values and calculate the mean.

ext.ext_cn: 26岁年龄组的平均分数
ext.ext_en: ...the mean score for 26-year-olds.

defs.def_en: See also:means;The mean is a number that is the average of a set of numbers.

defs.def_cn: (与 heavy, light 等形容词连用构成形容词)表示“行动…的”，“走路…的”

ext.ext_cn: 身材瘦削、步履轻盈的小个子男人
ext.ext_en: ...a slim, light-footed little man...

ext.ext_cn: 他是个步伐敏捷的10岁男孩。
ext.ext_en: He was a nimble-footed boy of ten.

defs.def_en: See also:foot;flat-footed;sure-footed;-footed combines with words such as 'heavy' or 'light' to form adjectives which indicate how someone moves or walks.

defs.def_cn: 剩余部分;剩余物;余下的人(或物)

ext.ext_cn: 他把剩下的咖啡一口气喝了下去。
ext.ext_en: He gulped down the remainder of his coffee...

ext.ext_cn: 我那天余下的时间里心情都很糟糕。
ext.ext_en: I spent the remainder of the day feeling terrible.

defs.def_en: The remainder of a group are the things or people that still remain after the other things or people have gone or have been dealt with.
In arithmetic, the remainder is the amount that remains when one amount cannot be exactly divided by another. For example, if you divide 22 by 7, the answer is 3 and the remainder is 1.

ext.ext_cn: 此书销量不好，很快就被廉价处理了。
ext.ext_en: It failed to sell and was soon remaindered.

defs.def_en: If a book is remaindered, it is sold at a reduced price because it has not been selling very well and will not be published again.
A remainder is a book that has been remaindered.

ext.ext_cn: 关于工业为何陷入困境正在展开一场全面的讨论。
ext.ext_en: A full-scale debate is under way on what ails the industry.

defs.def_en: If something ails a group or area of activity, it is a problem or source of trouble for that group or for people involved in that activity.

ext.ext_cn: “你哪里不舒服？”他问道。
ext.ext_en: 'What ails you?' he asked.

defs.def_en: If something ails someone, they are ill.

defs.def_cn: 英镑（英国货币单位，等于100便士）；镑（埃及等国的货币单位）

ext.ext_en: Beer cost three pounds a bottle...

ext.ext_cn: 价值1,000英镑的珠宝和银饰被盗。
ext.ext_en: A thousand pounds worth of jewellery and silver has been stolen.

defs.def_en: The pound is the unit of money which is used in Britain. It is represented by the symbol £. One British pound is divided into a hundred pence. Some other countries, for example Egypt, also have a unit of money called a pound .

ext.ext_cn: 英镑对大多数其他货币的汇率有望继续升高。
ext.ext_en: The pound is expected to continue to increase against most other currencies.

defs.def_en: The pound is used to refer to the British currency system, and sometimes to the currency systems of other countries which use pounds.

defs.def_cn: 磅（英美等一些讲英语的国家的重量单位，合0.454千克）

ext.ext_cn: 她的体重不足90磅。
ext.ext_en: Her weight was under ninety pounds.

ext.ext_cn: 一磅奶酪
ext.ext_en: ...a pound of cheese.

defs.def_en: A pound is a unit of weight used mainly in Britain, America, and other countries where English is spoken. One pound is equal to 0.454 kilograms. A pound of something is a quantity of it that weighs one pound.  →see usage note at:weight
A pound is a place where dogs and cats found wandering in the street are taken and kept until they are claimed by their owners.
A pound is a place where cars that have been parked illegally are taken by the police and kept until they have been claimed by their owners.

defs.def_cn: 用力击打；连续砰砰地猛击

ext.ext_en: Somebody began pounding on the front door...

defs.def_en: If you pound something or pound on it, you hit it with great force, usually loudly and repeatedly.

ext.ext_cn: 她捣玉米粒时停了一下。
ext.ext_en: She paused as she pounded the maize grains.

defs.def_en: If you pound something, you crush it into a paste or a powder or into very small pieces.

defs.def_cn: （常因恐惧而心脏）剧烈跳动，怦怦地跳

ext.ext_en: I'm sweating, my heart is pounding. I can't breathe.

defs.def_en: If your heart is pounding, it is beating with an unusually strong and fast rhythm, usually because you are afraid.

defs.def_cn: （不顾别人痛苦而坚决要求的）应得的东西

ext.ext_en: Banks are quick to demand their pound of flesh when overdrafts run a little over the limit.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone demands their pound of flesh, you mean that they insist on getting something they are entitled to, even though it may cause distress to the person it is demanded from.

ext.ext_cn: 当地图书馆

ext.ext_en: She issued them library cards.

defs.def_en: A public library is a building where things such as books, newspapers, videos, and music are kept for people to read, use, or borrow.

ext.ext_en: My thanks go to the British School of Osteopathy, for the use of their library.

ext.ext_en: Guests were rarely entertained in the library.

defs.def_en: In some large houses the library is the room where most of the books are kept.

ext.ext_cn: 0.5毫克的水银
ext.ext_en: ...0.5 milligrams of mercury.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 鱼做起来会很麻烦。
ext.ext_en: Fish can be fiddly to cook.

defs.def_en: Something that is fiddly is difficult to do or use because it involves small or complicated objects.

ext.ext_en: The mere mention of the words 'heart failure', can conjure up, to the layman, the prospect of imminent death...

ext.ext_en: There are basically two types called, in layman's terms, blue and white asbestos.

defs.def_en: A layman is a person who is not trained, qualified, or experienced in a particular subject or activity.

defs.def_cn: （基督教中的）平信徒，在俗教徒

ext.ext_en: In 1932, one Boston layman wrote to Archbishop William O'Connell in support of Father Coughlin.

defs.def_en: A layman is a man who is involved with the Christian church but is not a member of the clergy or a monk.

defs.def_cn: 进行中的；正在发生的；酝酿中的

defs.def_cn: 印度的;印度人的;印度文化的

ext.ext_en: ...the Indian government.

ext.ext_en: ...a study of Indians and Pakistanis living in Southall.

ext.ext_en: The South American Indians have been cooking and eating potatoes for well over two thousand years.

ext.ext_en: I'm trying to make a spreadsheet up to computerize everything that's done by hand at the moment...

ext.ext_en: Many hospitals say they simply can't afford to computerize.

ext.ext_en: The company was clearly at a crossroads...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的关系发展到了关键阶段。
ext.ext_en: They had reached a crossroads in their relationship.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is at a crossroads, you mean that it has reached a very important stage in its development where it could go one way or another.

ext.ext_en: ...Mulberry, a small town at the crossroads of agriculture in central Florida.

defs.def_en: A crossroads is an important or central place.

ext.ext_en: He has flaming red hair.

ext.ext_cn: 她刚和恋人发生了激烈的争吵。
ext.ext_en: She has had a flaming row with her lover.

ext.ext_en: Farmers don't need much prompting to tell you that 'flaming dog owners' are the scourge of their lives.

defs.def_en: Some people use flaming to emphasize what they are saying, especially when they are annoyed.

ext.ext_en: After breakfast they played while I cleared up...

ext.ext_en: I cleared up my room.

defs.def_en: When you clear up or clear a place up, you tidy things and put them away.

defs.def_cn: 解决(问题);消除(误会);揭开(谜团)

ext.ext_en: There should be someone to whom you can turn for any advice or to clear up any problems...

ext.ext_en: During dinner the confusion was cleared up: they had mistaken me for Kenny.

defs.def_en: See also:clear-up;To clear up a problem, misunderstanding, or mystery means to settle it or find a satisfactory explanation for it.

defs.def_cn: 解决(医学难题);消除，清除(感染);治愈(疾病);痊愈

ext.ext_en: Antibiotics should be used to clear up the infection...

ext.ext_en: Acne often clears up after the first three months of pregnancy.

ext.ext_en: It all depends on the weather clearing up.

defs.def_cn: 联式房屋;双拼式房屋;并联房屋

defs.def_en: A duplex or a duplex apartment is a flat or apartment which has rooms on two floors.

ext.ext_en: At first sight, Joe Pesci is not exactly cast in the leading man mould...

ext.ext_cn: 我们发现了两把准备低价出售的二手椅子。
ext.ext_en: We found two second-hand chairs that were going for a song.

defs.def_en: If you buy something for a song, you buy it for much less than its real value.

defs.def_cn: 竭尽全力，鼓足劲头，处于良好的竞技状态(新闻用语，形容运动员)

ext.ext_cn: 沃德并不是发挥最稳定的球员，可是一旦进入状态，他似乎就是天下无敌的王者。
ext.ext_en: Ward is not the most consistent of players, but when he is on song he looks a world-beater.

defs.def_en: Journalists sometimes describe sports players as being on song when they are playing really well.

defs.def_cn: 重整；重新安排；重新排列

ext.ext_cn: 她回家时，发现马尔科姆把她所有的家具都重新摆放了。
ext.ext_en: When she returned, she found Malcolm had rearranged all her furniture...

ext.ext_cn: 一个服务生正在麻利地为这一大帮人重新布置餐桌。
ext.ext_en: A waiter was rapidly rearranging tables for the big group.

defs.def_en: If you rearrange things, you change the way in which they are organized or ordered.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以取消约会或是重新安排约会时间。
ext.ext_en: You may cancel or rearrange the appointment...

ext.ext_cn: 10月31日的会议重新安排到了1月30日。
ext.ext_en: The meeting on 31 October is rearranged for 30 January.

defs.def_en: If you rearrange a meeting or an appointment, you arrange for it to take place at a different time to that originally intended.

ext.ext_cn: 一伙小混混嘲笑一位残疾人。
ext.ext_en: A gang taunted a disabled man...

ext.ext_cn: 其他年轻人笑话他的衣服。
ext.ext_en: Other youths taunted him about his clothes.

defs.def_en: If someone taunts you, they say unkind or insulting things to you, especially about your weaknesses or failures.

ext.ext_cn: 最近，安娜·福特对她认为阻碍了女性在电视业发展的男性集团进行了猛烈抨击。
ext.ext_en: Anna Ford recently hit out at the male clique which she believes holds back women in television.

defs.def_en: If you describe a group of people as a clique, you mean that they spend a lot of time together and seem unfriendly towards people who are not in the group.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他给道格拉斯写了一封非常正式的道歉信。
ext.ext_en: He wrote a very formal letter of apology to Douglas...

ext.ext_cn: 商业关系有必要更正式一些。
ext.ext_en: Business relationships are necessarily a bit more formal.

defs.def_en: Formal speech or behaviour is very correct and serious rather than relaxed and friendly, and is used especially in official situations.

defs.def_cn: (行为、声明或要求)官方的，正式的

ext.ext_cn: 联合国官员称正式请求已向美国当局转达。
ext.ext_en: UN officials said a formal request was passed to American authorities...

ext.ext_cn: 尚无任何官方声明。
ext.ext_en: No formal announcement had been made.

defs.def_en: A formal action, statement, or request is an official one.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一天晚上，电影公司在演出结束后安排了一个正式的晚宴。
ext.ext_en: One evening the film company arranged a formal dinner after the play.

ext.ext_cn: 包括学校正式舞会、演讲之夜、婚礼和大型舞会等一系列丰富多样的活动
ext.ext_en: ...a wide array of events, including school formals and speech nights, weddings, and balls.

defs.def_en: Formal occasions are special occasions at which people wear smart clothes and behave according to a set of accepted rules.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (服饰)正规的，正式的，适合正式场合的

ext.ext_cn: 他们打着普通的领带，而不是更为正式的高领领结。
ext.ext_en: They wore ordinary ties instead of the more formal high collar and cravat.

defs.def_en: Formal clothes are very smart clothes that are suitable for formal occasions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 整齐的;规矩的;井然有序的

ext.ext_cn: 这并不能鼓励孩子有条理地分析周围的环境。
ext.ext_en: This does not encourage the child to analyse the environment in a formal way...

ext.ext_cn: 古典希腊戏剧以韵文写成，通常用词讲究、结构整齐。
ext.ext_en: Classic Greek drama was written in verse, usually in an elevated and formal style.

defs.def_en: Something that is done, written, or studied in a formal way has a very ordered, organized method or style.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管小学毕业后就再没有受过正规的教育，他却十分爱读书。
ext.ext_en: Although his formal education stopped after primary school, he was an avid reader...

ext.ext_cn: 勒罗伊没受过任何正规的舞蹈训练。
ext.ext_en: Leroy didn't have any formal dance training.

defs.def_en: Formal education or training is given officially, usually in a school, college, or university.

defs.def_cn: (尤指按照某种设计规则)布局匀称的，布置整齐的

ext.ext_cn: 布局匀称的草药园
ext.ext_en: ...a formal herb garden...

ext.ext_cn: 科罗娜塔墙纸给餐厅增添了一种整齐有致的气氛。
ext.ext_en: The Coronata wallpaper lends a formal air to the dining room.

defs.def_en: See also:formality;A formal garden or room is arranged in a very regular and controlled way, especially according to certain rules of design.

ext.ext_cn: 早些时候，古巴政府曾指责西班牙外交部长的殖民主义态度。
ext.ext_en: Earlier, the Cuban government had accused the Spanish Foreign Minister of colonialist attitudes.

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲的几个殖民大国
ext.ext_en: ...the European colonialist powers.

defs.def_en: Colonialist means relating to colonialism.

ext.ext_cn: 殖民主义者强加给当地人民的统治者
ext.ext_en: ...rulers who were imposed on the people by the colonialists.

defs.def_en: A colonialist is a person who believes in colonialism or helps their country to get colonies.

defs.def_cn: （自发组成的）治安维持会会员;义务警察

ext.ext_cn: 治安员们把那些人揪了出来。
ext.ext_en: The vigilantes dragged the men out.

ext.ext_cn: 治安巡逻员
ext.ext_en: ...vigilante patrols.

defs.def_en: Vigilantes are people who organize themselves into an unofficial group to protect their community and to catch and punish criminals.

ext.ext_cn: 自黏标签
ext.ext_en: ...self-adhesive labels.

ext.ext_cn: 自黏瓷砖
ext.ext_en: ...self-adhesive tiles.

defs.def_en: Something that is self-adhesive is covered on one side with a sticky substance like glue, so that it will stick to surfaces.

ext.ext_cn: 对于美国人来说，最大的挑战在于理解东欧人的思维方式。
ext.ext_en: The greatest challenge for the Americans is understanding the mindset of Eastern Europeans...

ext.ext_cn: 当今运动员的一贯想法是：“现在只管尽自己最大努力，而不去担心日后会怎么样。”
ext.ext_en: The modern athlete's mind-set is, 'I'm going to make as much as I can now and not worry about the future.'

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's mind-set, you mean their general attitudes and the way they typically think about things.

defs.def_cn: 大型联合企业;企业集团

ext.ext_cn: 菲亚特是意大利最大的产业集团。
ext.ext_en: Fiat is Italy's largest industrial conglomerate.

defs.def_en: A conglomerate is a large business firm consisting of several different companies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 由不同成分组成的;成分混杂的

ext.ext_cn: 一组来源各异、内容丰富多样的研究
ext.ext_en: ...a rather heterogeneous collection of studies from diverse origins.

ext.ext_cn: 当今的异质性社会
ext.ext_en: ...the heterogeneous society of today.

defs.def_en: A heterogeneous group consists of many different types of things or people.

ext.ext_cn: 研讨会不收会务费，而且还提供午餐。
ext.ext_en: The seminars are free, with lunch provided.

ext.ext_cn: 内有礼券详情的免费宣传册
ext.ext_en: ...a free brochure with details of gift vouchers.

defs.def_en: If something is free, you can have it or use it without paying for it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自由的;不受约束的;没有限制的

ext.ext_cn: 政府将可不受限制地实行其经济政策。
ext.ext_en: The government will be free to pursue its economic policies...

ext.ext_cn: 选举是自由公正的。
ext.ext_en: The elections were free and fair...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is free is not restricted, controlled, or limited, for example by rules, customs, or other people.

ext.ext_cn: 它会使我们摆脱巨额债务。
ext.ext_en: It will free us of a whole lot of debt...

ext.ext_cn: 这位30 岁的明星正试图从他的唱片合约中脱身。
ext.ext_en: The 30-year-old star is trying to free himself from his recording contract.

defs.def_en: If you free someone of something that is unpleasant or restricting, you remove it from them.

defs.def_cn: (人身)自由的;不受监禁(或奴役)的

ext.ext_cn: 他以自由之身走出了法院。
ext.ext_en: He walked from the court house a free man...

ext.ext_cn: 目前已有 90 多名犯人因为一项政府特赦获得自由。
ext.ext_en: More than ninety prisoners have been set free so far under a government amnesty.

defs.def_en: Someone who is free is no longer a prisoner or a slave.

ext.ext_cn: 以色列准备释放更多的黎巴嫩犯人。
ext.ext_en: Israel is set to free more Lebanese prisoners...

ext.ext_cn: 这项法案有明确的目的，即保护被解放的奴隶免受白人暴民的伤害。
ext.ext_en: The act had a specific intent, to protect freed slaves from white mobs.

defs.def_en: To free a prisoner or a slave means to let them go or release them from prison.

ext.ext_cn: 远远摆脱恐惧的未来
ext.ext_en: ...a future far more free of fear...

ext.ext_cn: 她保持着苗条的身材，脸上也没有皱纹。
ext.ext_en: She retains her slim figure and is free of wrinkles...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is free of or free from an unpleasant thing, they do not have it or they are not affected by it.
See also:duty-free;interest-free;tax-free;A sum of money or type of goods that is free of tax or duty is one that you do not have to pay tax on.

ext.ext_cn: 工具腰带解放了双手，还减少了锤子掉落的风险。
ext.ext_en: Toolbelts free both hands and lessen the risk of dropping hammers...

ext.ext_cn: 他和迪斯尼的协议很快就要到期，这样他就可以腾出身来发展自己的项目了。
ext.ext_en: His deal with Disney will run out shortly, freeing him to pursue his own project...

defs.def_en: To free someone or something means to make them available for a task or function that they were previously not available for.

defs.def_cn: 空闲的;有空的;不上班的;不在忙的

ext.ext_cn: 她空闲的时候就去购物。
ext.ext_en: She spent her free time shopping...

ext.ext_cn: 过去我经常在课余时间写作。
ext.ext_en: I used to write during my free periods at school...

defs.def_en: If you have a free period of time or are free at a particular time, you are not working or occupied then.

defs.def_cn: 不在用的;无人使用的;未被占用的

ext.ext_cn: 列车上只剩下一个空座。
ext.ext_en: There was only one seat free on the train...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在刚进门处的唯一一张空桌子边坐下。
ext.ext_en: They took the only free table, which was just inside the door.

defs.def_en: If something such as a table or seat is free, it is not being used or occupied by anyone, or is not reserved for anyone to use.

defs.def_cn: 松开的;脱开的;未缚住的;未固定的

ext.ext_cn: 恶劣的天气情况使得把那艘船拉离钻塔的努力很难奏效。
ext.ext_en: The severe conditions hampered attempts to pull the vessel free of the rig...

ext.ext_cn: 他抽出胳膊，大步朝门走去。
ext.ext_en: He pulled his arm free, and strode for the door...

defs.def_en: If you get something free or if it gets free, it is no longer trapped by anything or attached to anything.

defs.def_cn: 松开;解开;使不再缚住(或固定)

ext.ext_cn: 消防员花了两个小时才把传动带切断，把他救了出来。
ext.ext_en: It took firemen two hours to cut through the drive belt to free him...

ext.ext_cn: 他设法挣脱出一只手来挡住了一拳。
ext.ext_en: He managed to free one hand to ward off a punch.

defs.def_en: If you free someone or something, you remove them from the place in which they have been trapped or become fixed.

ext.ext_cn: 他一只手抓起电话听筒，另一只手去摸床头灯的开关。
ext.ext_en: He snatched up the receiver and his free hand groped for the switch on the bedside lamp...

ext.ext_cn: 多亏了她还有一只手空着才没让自己倒下去。
ext.ext_en: She checked her fall with her free arm.

defs.def_en: When someone is using one hand or arm to hold or move something, their other hand or arm is referred to as their free one.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 慷慨的;大手大脚的;过分给予的

ext.ext_cn: 他们并不是一直都如此好为人师。
ext.ext_en: They weren't always so free with their advice...

ext.ext_cn: 他们经常会大肆批评，而且其中有些并无道理。
ext.ext_en: They would often be free with criticism, some of it unjustified.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is free with something such as advice or money, you mean that they give a lot of it, sometimes when it is not wanted.

ext.ext_cn: 开始吧。请便。
ext.ext_en: Go right ahead. Feel free...

ext.ext_cn: 如果有任何问题，请随意提问。
ext.ext_en: If you have any questions at all, please feel free to ask me.

defs.def_en: You say 'feel free' when you want to give someone permission to do something, in a very willing way.

ext.ext_cn: 我并没有指望你白干。
ext.ext_en: I wasn't expecting you to do it for free...

ext.ext_cn: 能够免费得到为什么还要浪费50英镑呢？
ext.ext_en: Why waste £50 when you could get it for free?

defs.def_en: If you do something or get something for free, you do it without being paid or get it without having to pay for it.

defs.def_cn: (表达批评意见时用于强调)不管怎样

ext.ext_cn: 不管怎样我都要说：我受不了他。
ext.ext_en: I'll tell you one thing for free: I can't stand him.

defs.def_en: You say that you will express a critical opinion about something for free when you want to emphasize how strongly you feel about it.

defs.def_cn: 开放，放开(市场、经济或体系)

ext.ext_cn: 开放市场、扩大竞争的政策
ext.ext_en: ...policies for freeing up markets and extending competition.

defs.def_en: To free up a market, economy, or system means to make it operate with fewer restrictions and controls.

defs.def_cn: 掉队者;落伍者;拖后腿的人

ext.ext_cn: 两名掉队者落后了 20 码。
ext.ext_en: There were two stragglers twenty yards back...

ext.ext_cn: 任何在黑暗中落伍或走失的掉队者都很容易成为敌人的攻击目标。
ext.ext_en: Any straggler that fell behind or got lost in the darkness was easy prey for the enemy.

defs.def_en: The stragglers are the people in a group who are moving more slowly or making less progress than the others.

ext.ext_cn: 大约在凌晨两点钟只剩下几个人时
ext.ext_en: ...round about two o'clock in the morning when there were only a few stragglers left.

defs.def_en: The stragglers at an event such as a party are the people who are still there after most of the other people have left.

ext.ext_cn: 幸好那个冬天还算暖和。
ext.ext_en: Fortunately, the weather that winter was reasonably mild...

ext.ext_cn: 对我来说幸运的是，我的朋友发现了非常严重的错误。
ext.ext_en: Fortunately for me, my friend saw that something was seriously wrong...

defs.def_en: Fortunately is used to introduce or indicate a statement about an event or situation that is good.

ext.ext_cn: 墙壁是白色的，地面铺了地砖，房间布置得特别简单朴素。
ext.ext_en: The room is typically simple and unadorned, with white walls and a tiled floor.

defs.def_en: Something that is unadorned is plain, rather than having decoration on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 投票者认为他是一位坚定果断的国际领导人。
ext.ext_en: Voters perceive him as a decisive and resolute international leader...

ext.ext_cn: 他将形势描述得非常危险，并号召采取果断行动。
ext.ext_en: He described the situation as very dangerous and called for resolute action.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as resolute, you approve of them because they are very determined not to change their mind or not to give up a course of action.
A topcoat is a coat that you wear over your other clothes.
A topcoat is the final layer of paint or varnish that is put on something. Topcoat is the type of paint or varnish that you use for the final layer.
Wholesaling is the activity of buying or selling goods in large amounts, especially in order to sell them in shops or supermarkets.

ext.ext_cn: 娱乐界和国际明星圈
ext.ext_en: ...the world of entertainment and international stardom...

ext.ext_cn: 有酒席宴会、戏剧演出和地方队之间的体育竞赛。
ext.ext_en: There were feasts and banquets, theatrical entertainments and sporting competitions between local groups.

defs.def_en: Entertainment consists of performances of plays and films, and activities such as reading and watching television, that give people pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 那家公司遭受了严重亏损。
ext.ext_en: The company endured heavy financial losses.

ext.ext_cn: 他们不得不独自承受的无法忍受的疼痛，因为甚至连医生都无法靠近他们
ext.ext_en: ...unbearable pain, which they had to endure in solitude because not even the doctors could get near them.

defs.def_en: If you endure a painful or difficult situation, you experience it and do not avoid it or give up, usually because you cannot.

ext.ext_cn: 那种语言以某种方式保存下来，并继续存在下去。
ext.ext_en: Somehow the language endures and continues to survive.

defs.def_en: If something endures, it continues to exist without any loss in quality or importance.

defs.def_cn: 不知道(书面英语中 don't know 的非正式写法)

ext.ext_cn: “她到底怎么得到它的？” ——“我不知道。”
ext.ext_en: 'How on earth did she get it?' — 'I dunno.'

defs.def_en: Dunno is sometimes used in written English to represent an informal way of saying 'don't know'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可怜的；令人怜悯的；悲惨的

ext.ext_cn: 可怜的卷尾巴小狗
ext.ext_en: ...a pathetic little dog with a curly tail...

ext.ext_cn: 这一小群旁观者看起来真是让人悲哀。
ext.ext_en: The small group of onlookers presented a pathetic sight...

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or animal as pathetic, you mean that they are sad and weak or helpless, and they make you feel very sorry for them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 差劲的；软弱的；令人生厌的

ext.ext_cn: 多差劲的借口啊！
ext.ext_en: What pathetic excuses...

ext.ext_cn: 一小杯葡萄酒要1英镑，真差劲。
ext.ext_en: It's a pound for a small glass of wine, which is pathetic.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as pathetic, you mean that they make you feel impatient or angry, often because they are weak or not very good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 涂着口红、戴着耳环、一身女人气的瘦骨嶙峋的男人
ext.ext_en: ...a skinny, effeminate guy in lipstick and earrings...

ext.ext_cn: 他的嗓音出奇地高，尖声尖气，有些娘娘腔。
ext.ext_en: His voice was curiously high-pitched, reedy, almost effeminate.

defs.def_en: If you describe a man or boy as effeminate, you think he behaves, looks, or sounds like a woman or girl.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰不断遭到父亲身体和心理上的双重虐待。
ext.ext_en: John received constant physical and psychological abuse from his father...

ext.ext_cn: 罗宾的失忆是心理问题，而非生理问题。
ext.ext_en: Robyn's loss of memory is a psychological problem, rather than a physical one.

defs.def_en: Psychological means concerned with a person's mind and thoughts.

ext.ext_cn: 心理测试
ext.ext_en: ...psychological testing.

defs.def_en: Psychological means relating to psychology.

ext.ext_cn: 他请求美国立即提供援助，拆除这批弹头。
ext.ext_en: He asked for immediate help from the United States to dismantle the warheads.

defs.def_en: If you dismantle a machine or structure, you carefully separate it into its different parts.

ext.ext_cn: 反对总统废除种族隔离的政策
ext.ext_en: ...opposition to the president's policy of dismantling apartheid...

ext.ext_cn: 林林总总的公共设施正被逐渐废除。
ext.ext_en: Public services of all kinds are being dismantled.

defs.def_en: To dismantle an organization or system means to cause it to stop functioning by gradually reducing its power or purpose.

defs.def_cn: 唐杜里烹饪法(印度一种用泥炉烹调的方法)
defs.def_en: Tandoori dishes are Indian meat dishes which are cooked in a clay oven.

defs.def_cn: 不喜欢;不赞成;受冷遇;失宠

ext.ext_cn: 执政党不喜欢他。
ext.ext_en: He was in disfavour with the ruling party...

ext.ext_cn: 总统大选失败后，他被打入了冷宫。
ext.ext_en: He fell into disfavor as the president fell in the polls.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is in disfavour, people dislike or disapprove of them. If someone or something falls into disfavour, people start to dislike or disapprove of them.

defs.def_cn: (表情流露出的)不喜欢,不赞成

ext.ext_cn: 她反感地盯着他那长及衣领的一头乱发。
ext.ext_en: She eyed his unruly collar-length hair with disfavour.

defs.def_en: If you look at someone or something with disfavour, the expression on your face shows that you dislike or disapprove of them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 受到严格限制的饮食的单调
ext.ext_en: ...the monotony of a heavily restricted diet...

ext.ext_cn: 植物和动物一样，生活环境常常有限。
ext.ext_en: Plants, like animals, often have restricted habitats.

defs.def_en: Something that is restricted is quite small or limited.

defs.def_cn: 仅限…使用的;仅限…所有的

ext.ext_cn: 绝不只是依靠救济金生活的家庭的孩子才有纪律问题。
ext.ext_en: Discipline problems are by no means restricted to children in families dependent on benefits...

ext.ext_cn: 这个问题并不只存在于东南部。
ext.ext_en: The problem is not restricted to the southeast.

defs.def_en: If something is restricted to a particular group, only members of that group have it. If it is restricted to a particular place, it exists only in that place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 老科丁卡机场附近的一个禁区
ext.ext_en: ...a highly restricted area close to the old Khodinka airfield.

defs.def_en: A restricted area is one that only people with special permission can enter.

defs.def_cn: (文件等)保密的，仅限于内部的

ext.ext_cn: 对他的指控是他在1975年2月将一份保密文件泄露给了一位记者。
ext.ext_en: The charge was that, in February 1975, he had leaked a restricted document to a journalist.

defs.def_en: A restricted document is one that only people with special permission can read.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 相信完美可以企及是不现实的。
ext.ext_en: It is unrealistic to believe perfection is an attainable goal.

defs.def_en: Something that is attainable can be achieved.

ext.ext_cn: 公司称与工会的谈判已陷入僵局。
ext.ext_en: The company says it has reached an impasse in negotiations with the union.

defs.def_en: If people are in a difficult position in which it is impossible to make any progress, you can refer to the situation as an impasse .
A greenhouse is a glass building in which you grow plants that need to be protected from bad weather.

defs.def_cn: 温室效应的；引起温室效应的
defs.def_en: Greenhouse means relating to or causing the greenhouse effect.

defs.def_cn: 航空（学）的；飞机制造学的

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲最大的航空研究实验室
ext.ext_en: ...the biggest aeronautical research laboratory in Europe.

defs.def_en: Aeronautical means involving or relating to the design and construction of aeroplanes.

ext.ext_cn: 这个小男孩，大约有四岁大
ext.ext_en: ...this little laddie, aged about four...

ext.ext_cn: 现在告诉我，小伙子，出了什么问题？
ext.ext_en: Now then, laddie, what's the trouble?

defs.def_en: A laddie is a young man or boy.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在紧急情况下)命令…出动,请求…出动

ext.ext_cn: 哥伦比亚出动了军队,并采取了紧急措施。
ext.ext_en: Colombia has called out the army and imposed emergency measures...

ext.ext_cn: 我叫了医生。
ext.ext_en: I called the doctor out...

defs.def_en: See also:call;If you call someone out, you order or request that they come to help, especially in an emergency.
A doberman is a type of large dog with short dark fur.

ext.ext_cn: 精神错乱的重要证据
ext.ext_en: ...serious evidence of mental derangement.

defs.def_en: Derangement is the state of being mentally ill and unable to think or act in a controlled way.

ext.ext_cn: 选举结果令他们很震惊，他们现在要对选举的可信性提出质疑。
ext.ext_en: Shocked by the results of the elections, they now want to challenge the validity of the vote...

ext.ext_cn: 当然，一些人否定了此类说法的合理性。
ext.ext_en: Some people, of course, denied the validity of any such claim.

defs.def_en: See also:valid;The validity of something such as a result or a piece of information is whether it can be trusted or believed.

defs.def_cn: 苹果酒(英国的苹果酒通常含有酒精;美国的苹果酒通常不含酒精，含有酒精的苹果酒通常叫做 hard cider)

ext.ext_cn: 他点了一杯苹果酒。
ext.ext_en: He ordered a cider.

ext.ext_cn: 他点了一杯苹果酒。
ext.ext_en: He ordered a cider.

defs.def_en: Cider is a drink made from apples which in Britain usually contains alcohol. In the United States, cider does not usually contain alcohol, and if it does contain alcohol, it is usually called hard cider .

defs.def_cn: 参考书阅览室;工具书阅览室
defs.def_en: A reference library is a library that contains books which you can look at in the library itself but which you cannot borrow.
Your birthday is the anniversary of the date on which you were born.

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎常常为双方各不相让而生气沮丧。
ext.ext_en: He often appeared angry and frustrated by the intransigence of both sides.

defs.def_en: If you talk about someone's intransigence, you mean that they refuse to behave differently or to change their attitude to something.

ext.ext_cn: 人的精神实际上是不可摧毁的。
ext.ext_en: The human spirit is virtually indestructible...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽安怀着一颗年轻、不断进取的心去寻求新的天地。
ext.ext_en: Marian retains a restless, youthful spirit, in search of new horizons.

defs.def_en: See also:kindred spirit;Your spirit is the part of you that is not physical and that consists of your character and feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 他已灵魂出窍，剩下的只是他的躯壳。
ext.ext_en: His spirit has left him and all that remains is the shell of his body.

defs.def_en: A person's spirit is the non-physical part of them that is believed to remain alive after their death.

ext.ext_cn: 避邪
ext.ext_en: ...protection against evil spirits.

defs.def_en: See also:Holy Spirit;A spirit is a ghost or supernatural being.

ext.ext_cn: 她是个非常勇敢的女孩，认识她的人都敬佩她的勇气。
ext.ext_en: She was a very brave girl and everyone who knew her admired her spirit.

defs.def_en: Spirit is the courage and determination that helps people to survive in difficult times and to keep their way of life and their beliefs.

ext.ext_cn: 他们打得生龙活虎。
ext.ext_en: They played with spirit.

defs.def_en: Spirit is the liveliness and energy that someone shows in what they do.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的问题只能通过妥协来解决。
ext.ext_en: Their problem can only be solved in a spirit of compromise...

ext.ext_cn: 他们抱一种和解的态度去参加谈判。
ext.ext_en: They approached the talks in a conciliatory spirit.

defs.def_en: The spirit in which you do something is the attitude you have when you are doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 在英国的奥运代表团中有一种强烈的团队精神。
ext.ext_en: There is a great sense of team spirit among the British Olympic squad...

ext.ext_cn: 总统已经呼吁巴西人民要有爱国情怀和集体主义精神。
ext.ext_en: The president has appealed to the Brazilian people for patriotism and community spirit.

defs.def_en: A particular kind of spirit is the feeling of loyalty to a group that is shared by the people who belong to the group.

defs.def_cn: 精神(指某一群体特有的思想、信念、目标)

ext.ext_cn: 劳工运动的精髓
ext.ext_en: ...the real spirit of the Labour movement.

defs.def_en: A particular kind of spirit is the set of ideas, beliefs, and aims that are held by a group of people.

defs.def_cn: (法律、协议等的)原意,实质，精神

ext.ext_cn: 对工作许可证的要求违反了 1950 年条约的精神。
ext.ext_en: The requirement for work permits violates the spirit of the 1950 treaty.

defs.def_en: The spirit of something such as a law or an agreement is the way that it was intended to be interpreted or applied.

ext.ext_cn: 我愿意把自己看成是个无拘无束的人。
ext.ext_en: I like to think of myself as a free spirit...

ext.ext_cn: 他是纽约莎士比亚戏剧节的创始人及领导者。
ext.ext_en: He was the founder and guiding spirit of New York's Shakespeare Festival.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a person as a particular kind of spirit if they show a certain characteristic or if they show a lot of enthusiasm in what they are doing.

ext.ext_cn: 晚餐时，每个人都兴致勃勃。
ext.ext_en: At supper, everyone was in high spirits...

ext.ext_cn: 进行一点儿体育锻炼能帮助他改善情绪。
ext.ext_en: A bit of exercise will help lift his spirits.

defs.def_en: Your spirits are your feelings at a particular time, especially feelings of happiness or unhappiness.

ext.ext_cn: 他被秘密带走，可能被杀害了。
ext.ext_en: He was spirited away and probably murdered...

ext.ext_cn: 他的父母偷偷地将他带到了该国。
ext.ext_en: His parents had spirited him away to the country...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is spirited away, or if they are spirited out of somewhere, they are taken from a place quickly and secretly without anyone noticing.
Spirits are strong alcoholic drinks such as whisky and gin.

defs.def_cn: (用作燃料、清洗等用途的)酒精
defs.def_en: See also:methylated spirits;surgical spirit;Spirit or spirits is an alcoholic liquid that is used as a fuel, for cleaning things, or for other purposes. There are many kinds of spirit.
If you enter into the spirit of something, you take part in it in an enthusiastic way.

defs.def_cn: 精神上(在某地或和某人在一起，但实际上本人并不在场)

ext.ext_cn: 我在精神上支持你。
ext.ext_en: In spirit I was with you here.

defs.def_en: If you say you are somewhere in spirit or with someone in spirit, you mean that although you are not with them, you feel as though you are with them because you are thinking about them a lot.

ext.ext_cn: 她们在本质上似乎和那些最早出去工作的具有独立思想的土耳其女性很相似。
ext.ext_en: They seemed close in spirit to those first independent-minded Turkish women who took professions...

ext.ext_cn: 它本质上是独立的。
ext.ext_en: It is independent in spirit.

defs.def_en: You use in spirit when you are talking about someone's true nature.
The spirit of the age or the spirit of the times is the set of ideas, beliefs, and aims that is typical of people in a particular period in history.

Voice mail is a system of sending messages over the telephone. Calls are answered by a machine which connects you to the person you want to leave a message for, and they can listen to their messages later.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在那里举办的音乐会座无虚席。
ext.ext_en: Their concert there was a sell-out.

ext.ext_cn: 观众爆满的演出
ext.ext_en: ...sell-out shows.

defs.def_en: If a play, sports event, or other entertainment is a sell-out, all the tickets for it are sold.

defs.def_cn: (对原则的)背弃;(向敌对势力的)屈服

ext.ext_cn: 对某些人来说，他决定以社会党候选人的身份参加星期天的选举简直是一种叛变。
ext.ext_en: For some, his decision to become a Socialist candidate at Sunday's election was simply a sell-out.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as a sell-out, you disapprove of the fact that they have done something which used to be against their principles, or given in to an opposing group.
A sand dune is a hill of sand near the sea or in a sand desert.

defs.def_cn: 女作家（很多女作家反对这样的称呼，更喜欢被称为 author)
defs.def_en: An authoress is a female author. Many female writers object to this word, and prefer to be called authors.
A teardrop is a large tear that comes from your eye when you are crying quietly.

ext.ext_cn: 它们的根十分粗壮而且扎得很深，从而避免了受侵蚀。
ext.ext_en: As their roots are strong and penetrating, they prevent erosion.

ext.ext_cn: 河谷的侵蚀
ext.ext_en: ...erosion of the river valleys.

defs.def_en: Erosion is the gradual destruction and removal of rock or soil in a particular area by rivers, the sea, or the weather.

defs.def_cn: （权威、权利、信心等的）逐渐丧失，削弱

ext.ext_cn: 对世界金融市场心灰意冷
ext.ext_en: ...the erosion of confidence in world financial markets.

ext.ext_cn: 总统权力的削弱
ext.ext_en: ...an erosion of presidential power.

defs.def_en: The erosion of a person's authority, rights, or confidence is the gradual destruction or removal of them.

defs.def_cn: （支持的）减少;（价值的）降低;（货币的）贬值

ext.ext_cn: 道德沦丧
ext.ext_en: ...the erosion of moral standards.

ext.ext_cn: 对该项目的支持大幅减少
ext.ext_en: ...a dramatic erosion of support for the program.

defs.def_en: The erosion of support, values, or money is a gradual decrease in its level or standard.

defs.def_cn: (尤指与管理人员相对而言的)全体工人，工人的生产区，工作车间

ext.ext_cn: 必须要控制成本，不仅仅是工人方面，董事会方面也要控制。
ext.ext_en: Cost must be controlled, not just on the shop floor but in the boardroom too.

ext.ext_cn: 普通工人
ext.ext_en: ...shop floor workers.

defs.def_en: The shop floor is used to refer to all the ordinary workers in a factory or the area where they work, especially in contrast to the people who are in charge.

ext.ext_cn: 看哪，彩虹！
ext.ext_en: Oh look, a rainbow!

ext.ext_cn: 彩虹般五颜六色的绸缎
ext.ext_en: ...silk brocade of every colour of the rainbow.

defs.def_en: A rainbow is an arch of different colours that you can sometimes see in the sky when it is raining.

ext.ext_cn: 五颜六色的彩垫
ext.ext_en: ...a rainbow of coloured cushions.

defs.def_en: A rainbow of colours is a wide range of bright colours.

ext.ext_cn: 找到一种治愈方法的希望——就如同永远够不到的一桶黄金——往往让理智的人们做出不理智的事情。
ext.ext_en: The promise of a cure — the pot of gold at the end of the rainbow — often makes sensible people do irrational things.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is at the end of the rainbow, you mean that people want it but it is almost impossible to obtain or achieve.

ext.ext_cn: 英格丽德飞奔过空无一人的街道。
ext.ext_en: Ingrid darted across the deserted street...

ext.ext_cn: 女孩转身穿过树林飞速跑开了。
ext.ext_en: The girl turned and darted away through the trees.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal darts somewhere, they move there suddenly and quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 她狡黠地从眼角瞥了布拉姆韦尔一眼。
ext.ext_en: She darted a sly sideways glance at Bramwell...

ext.ext_cn: 乐队指挥飞快地扫了威尔弗雷德一眼，然后视线又落回到迈克尔身上。
ext.ext_en: The conductor's eyes darted to Wilfred, then fixed on Michael again.

defs.def_en: If you dart a look at someone or something, or if your eyes dart to them, you look at them very quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 马尔科夫身中毒镖而亡。
ext.ext_en: Markov died after being struck by a poison dart.

defs.def_en: A dart is a small, narrow object with a sharp point which can be thrown or shot.
Darts is a game in which you throw darts at a round board which has numbers on it.

defs.def_cn: 附信(与包裹或另一封信一起寄出)
defs.def_en: A covering letter is a letter that you send with a parcel or with another letter in order to provide extra information.

ext.ext_cn: 这份兼职很赚钱。
ext.ext_en: It was quite a lucrative sideline...

ext.ext_cn: 米恩斯先生以卖计算机硬盘作为副业。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Means sold computer disks as a sideline.

defs.def_en: A sideline is something that you do in addition to your main job in order to earn extra money.
The sidelines are the lines marking the long sides of the playing area, for example on a football field or tennis court.

ext.ext_cn: 在作出关键决定时，法国不想再被撇在一边了。
ext.ext_en: France no longer wants to be left on the sidelines when critical decisions are taken...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直在一旁关注东欧相继取得的重大进展。
ext.ext_en: He has watched from the sidelines the great developments unrolling in Eastern Europe...

defs.def_en: If you are on the sidelines in a situation, you do not influence events at all, either because you have chosen not to be involved, or because other people have not involved you.

defs.def_cn: 把…排除在外;使靠边;不重视

ext.ext_cn: 他承受着被迫辞职的压力，很快就要被排挤出去了。
ext.ext_en: He was under pressure to resign and was about to be sidelined...

ext.ext_cn: 他们所担忧的是环境政策不能得到及时的重视。
ext.ext_en: What they fear is that environment policy will be sidelined until it is too late.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is sidelined, they are made to seem unimportant and not included in what people are doing.

defs.def_cn: 使(运动员)下场;使退出比赛

ext.ext_cn: 默瑟明天要进行下颌骨固定手术，将离开赛场 6至8 个星期。
ext.ext_en: Mercer will have his jaw wired up tomorrow and will be sidelined for six to eight weeks.

defs.def_en: In sports, if a player is sidelined, he or she is prevented from playing for a period of time, for example because of an injury.

ext.ext_cn: 对讲机发出嗡嗡声，他按下了相应的开关。
ext.ext_en: The intercom buzzed and he pressed down the appropriate switch...

ext.ext_cn: 武装直升机嗡嗡地飞过城市上空。
ext.ext_en: Attack helicopters buzzed across the city.

defs.def_en: If something buzzes or buzzes somewhere, it makes a long continuous sound, like the noise a bee makes when it is flying.

defs.def_cn: 匆忙地走动；忙得团团转

ext.ext_cn: 几个观光客在匆匆游览。
ext.ext_en: A few tourists were buzzing about...

ext.ext_cn: 拍卖行里乱哄哄谈生意的商人们令她望而生畏。
ext.ext_en: She was intimidated by the number of businessmen buzzing around the saleroom.

defs.def_en: If people are buzzing around, they are moving around quickly and busily.

ext.ext_cn: 还有很多问题在我的脑海里翻腾。
ext.ext_en: Many more questions were buzzing around in my head...

ext.ext_cn: 高级时尚顾问会使你的头脑充满新鲜想法。
ext.ext_en: Top style consultants will leave you buzzing with new ideas.

defs.def_en: If questions or ideas are buzzing around your head, or if your head is buzzing with questions or ideas, you are thinking about a lot of things, often in a confused way.

defs.def_cn: 充满嘈杂的（谈话、活动）声

ext.ext_cn: 大家在吃午饭，排练室里很是嘈杂。
ext.ext_en: The rehearsal studio is buzzing with lunchtime activity.

ext.ext_cn: 首都到处流传着可能发生游行示威的流言。
ext.ext_en: The capital is buzzing with rumours of possible demonstrations.

defs.def_en: If a place is buzzing with activity or conversation, there is a lot of activity or conversation there, especially because something important or exciting is about to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 当被告被带进来的时候，整个法庭的人都激动起来，一片嘈杂。
ext.ext_en: A buzz of excitement filled the courtroom as the defendant was led in.

ext.ext_cn: 兴奋嘈杂的说话声
ext.ext_en: ...the excited buzz of conversation.

defs.def_en: You can use buzz to refer to a long continuous sound, usually caused by lots of people talking at once.

ext.ext_cn: 表演仍然能让他兴奋不已。
ext.ext_en: Performing still gives him a buzz...

ext.ext_cn: 制造冲突让他感到幸灾乐祸。
ext.ext_en: He got a buzz from creating confrontations.

defs.def_en: If something gives you a buzz, it makes you feel very happy or excited for a short time.

defs.def_cn: 热闹有趣的气氛；时尚氛围

ext.ext_cn: 姑娘们在前几次的游览中就爱上了都柏林，她们说她们喜欢这个城市的时尚氛围。
ext.ext_en: The girls fell in love with Dublin on previous visits. They said that what they liked was the buzz about the place.

defs.def_en: If a place or event has a buzz, it has a lively, interesting and modern atmosphere.

ext.ext_cn: 园艺设计圈里的最新流行词语
ext.ext_en: ...the latest buzz phrase in garden design circles...

ext.ext_cn: 性教育在学校是个热议话题。
ext.ext_en: Sex education in schools was the buzz topic.

defs.def_en: You can use buzz to refer to a word, idea, or activity which has recently become extremely popular.

defs.def_cn: （用内线）给…打电话；（用蜂鸣器）呼叫

ext.ext_cn: 那天上午晚些时候朱丽给我打来了电话。
ext.ext_en: Later that morning Julie buzzed me.

ext.ext_cn: 我们到了梅贝里街的时候会给他打电话。
ext.ext_en: We'll give him a buzz when we get to Maybury Street.

defs.def_en: If you buzz someone, you call them, usually using an internal telephone line or a buzzer.

ext.ext_cn: 美国战斗机低飞掠过城市。
ext.ext_en: American fighter planes buzzed the city.

defs.def_en: If an aircraft buzzes a place, it flies low over it, usually in a threatening way.

defs.def_cn: (常于口语与非正式书面语中代替 until)

ext.ext_cn: 他们必须等到周一才能给银行经理打电话。
ext.ext_en: They had to wait till Monday to ring the bank manager...

ext.ext_cn: 我一直努力活到了现在，而且没有你的帮助也能继续活下去。
ext.ext_en: I've survived till now, and will go on doing so without help from you.

defs.def_en: In spoken English and informal written English, till is often used instead of until .

defs.def_cn: (商店等处的)现金出纳机，收银机

ext.ext_cn: 收银台前令顾客恼火的长队
ext.ext_en: ...long queues at tills that make customers angry.

defs.def_en: In a shop or other place of business, a till is a counter or cash register where money is kept, and where customers pay for what they have bought.
