ext.ext_cn: 乔治·弗雷泽显然是个好士兵，沉着冷静且适应力强。
ext.ext_en: George Fraser was clearly a good soldier, calm and resilient...

ext.ext_cn: 1987年10月美国股市崩盘后，日本股市是反弹最快的。
ext.ext_en: When the U.S. stock market collapsed in October 1987, the Japanese stock market was the most resilient.

defs.def_en: People and things that are resilient are able to recover easily and quickly from unpleasant or damaging events.
A daddy longlegs is a flying insect with very long legs.

ext.ext_cn: 这套房子归她们家有三四代人了。
ext.ext_en: The house had belonged to her family for three or four generations.

defs.def_en: If something belongs to you, you own it.

ext.ext_cn: 这是男性的笔迹。
ext.ext_en: The handwriting belongs to a male...

ext.ext_cn: 他们确定这是一具15岁女孩的尸体。
ext.ext_en: They established that the body belonged to a 15-year-old girl.

defs.def_en: You say that something belongs to a particular person when you are guessing, discovering, or explaining that it was produced by or is part of that person.

ext.ext_cn: 我过去是一个青年俱乐部的成员。
ext.ext_en: I used to belong to a youth club.

defs.def_en: If someone belongs to a particular group, they are a member of that group.

defs.def_cn: 属于（某个类别、类型或群体）

ext.ext_cn: 评委们无法判定它属于哪一类。
ext.ext_en: The judges could not decide which category it belonged in...

ext.ext_cn: 我意识到我和他不是一路人。
ext.ext_en: I realized that he and I belonged to different worlds.

defs.def_en: If something or someone belongs in or to a particular category, type, or group, they are of that category, type, or group.

ext.ext_cn: 这些画出自一个人人向往上流社会的时代。
ext.ext_en: The pictures belong to an era when there was a preoccupation with high society.

defs.def_en: If something belongs to a particular time, it comes from that time.

ext.ext_cn: 但是最终决定权在罗莎娜手里
ext.ext_en: ...but the last word belonged to Rosanne.

defs.def_en: If you say that something belongs to someone, you mean that person has the right to it.

ext.ext_cn: 未来属于民主。
ext.ext_en: The future belongs to democracy.

defs.def_en: If you say that a time belongs to a particular system or way of doing something, you mean that that time is or will be characterized by it.

ext.ext_cn: 他推断这俩小孩是这对夫妇的。
ext.ext_en: He deduced that the two children belonged to the couple.

defs.def_en: If a baby or child belongs to a particular adult, that adult is his or her parent or the person who is looking after him or her.

defs.def_cn: 属于彼此（恋人用来表示亲密关系）

ext.ext_cn: 我真的觉得我们属于彼此。
ext.ext_en: I really think that we belong together...

ext.ext_cn: 他是我的。
ext.ext_en: He belongs with me.

defs.def_en: When lovers say that they belong together, they are expressing their closeness or commitment to each other.

defs.def_cn: 归属于（某地或某一情形）

ext.ext_cn: 你不属于这里。
ext.ext_en: You don't belong here...

ext.ext_cn: 这曲子很适合在音乐厅演奏。
ext.ext_en: This piece really belongs in the concert hall...

defs.def_en: If a person or thing belongs in a particular place or situation, that is where they should be.

defs.def_cn: 请求(给予金钱、帮助、支援等);(意见的)征求

ext.ext_cn: 共和党领袖公开向意大利裔美国人拉选票。
ext.ext_en: Republican leaders are making open solicitation of the Italian-American vote...

ext.ext_cn: 新措施旨在减少不请自来的电话调查。
ext.ext_en: The new measures are aimed at cutting back on intrusive telephone solicitations.

defs.def_en: Solicitation is the act of asking someone for money, help, support, or an opinion.
Netsurfing is the activity of looking at different sites on the Internet, especially when you are not looking for anything in particular.
A stroller is a small chair on wheels, in which a baby or small child can sit and be wheeled around.

defs.def_cn: 指压按摩(用于治疗疾病或减轻疼痛)
defs.def_en: Shiatsu is a form of massage that is used to cure illness and reduce pain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 受尊敬的;受敬重的;受重视的

ext.ext_cn: 他的小说和剧本使他非常受人敬重。
ext.ext_en: He is highly respected for his novels and plays...

ext.ext_cn: 她在国际社会中非常受人敬重。
ext.ext_en: She is a well respected member of the international community.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is respected is admired and considered important by many people.

defs.def_cn: (尤指直播的)电视节目，电视广播
defs.def_en: A telecast is a programme that is broadcast on the television, especially a programme that is broadcast live.

defs.def_cn: 玻利维亚的；玻利维亚人的
defs.def_en: Bolivian means belonging or relating to Bolivia or its people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (女子)有曲线美的，体形优美的
defs.def_en: If someone describes a woman as curvy, they think she is attractive because of the curves of her body.

defs.def_cn: 用夹子夹住的;用别针别住的

ext.ext_cn: 易拉得领带
ext.ext_en: ...a clip-on tie.

ext.ext_cn: 夹式灯
ext.ext_en: ...a clip-on light.

defs.def_en: A clip-on object is designed to be fastened to something by means of a clip.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 处于困境的;危机四伏的;问题缠身的

ext.ext_cn: 焦头烂额的总统还否认了最近有关他被自己的士兵挟持为人质的说法。
ext.ext_en: The embattled president also denied recent claims that he was being held hostage by his own soldiers.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person, group, or organization as embattled, you mean that they are having a lot of problems or difficulties.

defs.def_cn: . 卷入战争的;（尤指）被敌军包围的

ext.ext_cn: 双方都表示想努力为处于战乱中的该岛北部和东部地区寻求政治解决方案。
ext.ext_en: Both sides say they want to try to reach a political settlement in the embattled north and east of the island.

defs.def_en: An embattled area is one that is involved in the fighting in a war, especially one that is surrounded by enemy forces

ext.ext_cn: 与被告的简短交流体现了她独特的办事方式。
ext.ext_en: An example of her modus operandi was provided during a terse exchange with the defendant.

defs.def_en: A modus operandi is a particular way of doing something.

defs.def_cn: 未能如期出现的人;爽约者

ext.ext_cn: 但伊万尼塞维奇不能参赛对温布尔登主办方将是一个重大打击。
ext.ext_en: But Ivanisevic's no-show will be a blow for Wimbledon chiefs.

ext.ext_cn: 上周在密尔沃基进行的比赛约翰·亨利·威廉斯没有出场。
ext.ext_en: John Henry Williams was a no-show at last week's game in Milwaukee.

defs.def_en: If someone who is expected to go somewhere fails to go there, you can say that they are a no-show .
A bookie is the same as a bookmaker .
A juggernaut is a very large truck.

defs.def_cn: 无法控制的强大机构；巨头集团

ext.ext_cn: 这个集团成为了商品期权交易市场的销售巨头。
ext.ext_en: The group became a sales juggernaut in the commodity options business.

defs.def_en: If you describe an organization or group as a juggernaut, you are critical of them because they are large and extremely powerful, and you think they are not being controlled properly.

ext.ext_cn: 他慢慢地睁开眼睛，并发出痛苦的呻吟。
ext.ext_en: Slowly, he opened his eyes. As he did so, he began to groan with pain...

ext.ext_cn: 他们瞥了一眼躺在地上的男人，那人现在开始呻吟起来。
ext.ext_en: They glanced at the man on the floor, who began to groan...

defs.def_en: If you groan, you make a long, low sound because you are in pain, or because you are upset or unhappy about something.

ext.ext_cn: “我的腿——我想是断了，”埃里克咕哝着说。
ext.ext_en: 'My leg — I think it's  broken,' Eric groaned.

defs.def_en: If you groan something, you say it in a low, unhappy voice.

ext.ext_cn: 他的父母开始抱怨大学的学费太贵。
ext.ext_en: His parents were beginning to groan about the price of college tuition.

ext.ext_cn: 当你的孩子因不能做某些事情而发牢骚的时候，你应该抱着一颗理解的心去倾听。
ext.ext_en: Listen sympathetically to your child's moans and groans about what she can't do.

defs.def_en: If you groan about something, you complain about it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些木头在吱吱嘎嘎作响，木地板有些摇晃。
ext.ext_en: The timbers groan and creak and the floorboards shift.

defs.def_en: If wood or something made of wood groans, it makes a loud sound when it moves.

ext.ext_cn: 吧台上摆满了大碟大碟非常新鲜的鱼。
ext.ext_en: The bar counter groans under the weight of huge plates of the freshest fish.

ext.ext_cn: 堆满了食物的桌子
ext.ext_en: ...a table groaning with food.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a table groans under the weight of food, you are emphasizing that there is a lot of food on it.

defs.def_cn: 受…重压；受…折磨；不堪重负

ext.ext_cn: 高利率令消费者不堪重负。
ext.ext_en: Consumers were groaning under the weight of high interest rates...

ext.ext_cn: 书架上摆满了有关环境威胁的书，不堪重负。
ext.ext_en: Bookshelves groan under the burden of books on threats to the environment.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is groaning under the weight of something, you think there is too much of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他摸着自己轮廓分明的下巴想了一会儿。
ext.ext_en: He thought for a moment, stroking his well-defined jaw...

ext.ext_cn: 梅格惊讶得目瞪口呆。
ext.ext_en: Meg's jaw dropped in amazement...

defs.def_en: Your jaw is the lower part of your face below your mouth. The movement of your jaw is sometimes considered to express a particular emotion. For example, if your jaw drops, you are very surprised.

ext.ext_cn: 颌骨发达的森林啮齿类动物
ext.ext_en: ...a forest rodent with powerful jaws.

defs.def_en: A person's or animal's jaws are the two bones in their head which their teeth are attached to.

defs.def_cn: 危险的局面；令人不快的情形

ext.ext_cn: 一只家养犬把一个新生男婴从鬼门关救了回来。
ext.ext_en: A family dog rescued a newborn boy from the jaws of death.

ext.ext_cn: 陷入全球性经济衰退的危机之中
ext.ext_en: ...caught in the jaws of world recession.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the jaws of something unpleasant such as death or hell, you are referring to a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

ext.ext_cn: 除了其他诱人之处，他们还公开宣称说，会把客人们带到海滨圣地拉姆斯盖特玩一天。
ext.ext_en: Among other enticements, they advertized that they would take guests to Ramsgate for the day.

defs.def_en: An enticement is something which makes people want to do a particular thing.

defs.def_cn: (网球比赛中双方各得 40 分时的)局末平分（之后一方须连得两分方可获胜）
defs.def_en: Deuce is the score in a game of tennis when both players have forty points. One player has to win two points one after the other to win the game.
Golden syrup is a sweet food in the form of a thick, sticky, yellow liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 政治动荡的一段时期
ext.ext_en: ...a period of political uncertainty.

ext.ext_cn: 西海岸生活的迷茫
ext.ext_en: ...the uncertainties of life on the West Coast.

defs.def_en: Uncertainty is a state of doubt about the future or about what is the right thing to do.

ext.ext_cn: 一块薰衣草香皂
ext.ext_en: ...a bar of lavender soap.

ext.ext_cn: 一大盒肥皂粉
ext.ext_en: ...a large packet of soap powder.

defs.def_en: Soap is a substance that you use with water for washing yourself or sometimes for washing clothes.

defs.def_cn: 用肥皂擦洗;往…上面抹肥皂

ext.ext_cn: 她把全身涂满肥皂。
ext.ext_en: She soaped herself all over.

defs.def_en: If you soap yourself, you rub soap on your body in order to wash yourself.
A soap is the same as a soap opera .

ext.ext_cn: 另一个调查发现，51%的女性在工作中曾遭遇过某种形式的性骚扰。
ext.ext_en: Another survey found that 51 per cent of women had experienced some form of sexual harassment in their working lives.

ext.ext_cn: 种族侵扰
ext.ext_en: ...racial harassment...

defs.def_en: Harassment is behaviour which is intended to trouble or annoy someone, for example repeated attacks on them or attempts to cause them problems.

defs.def_cn: 种族的；种族间的；人种的

ext.ext_cn: 对少数民族和少数人种的保护
ext.ext_en: ...the protection of national and racial minorities.

ext.ext_cn: 消除种族歧视
ext.ext_en: ...the elimination of racial discrimination.

defs.def_en: Racial describes things relating to people's race.

ext.ext_cn: 他闻到了她身上的一股香水味。
ext.ext_en: He caught a whiff of her perfume.

defs.def_en: If there is a whiff of a particular smell, you smell it only slightly or only for a brief period of time, for example as you walk past someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 他的私生活没有爆出过一丁点儿的丑闻。
ext.ext_en: Not a whiff of scandal has ever tainted his private life...

ext.ext_cn: 这个电视节目有些伪善和夸耀的嫌疑。
ext.ext_en: The TV show had the whiff of hypocrisy and pomposity.

defs.def_en: A whiff of something bad or harmful is a slight sign of it.
A prank is a childish trick.

ext.ext_cn: 他在集市上摆摊卖靴子。
ext.ext_en: He sold boots on a market stall.

defs.def_en: A market is a place where goods are bought and sold, usually outdoors.

defs.def_cn: 需求量;市场需求;顾客群;行销地区

ext.ext_cn: 国外市场越来越重要了。
ext.ext_en: The foreign market was increasingly crucial.

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯的个人电脑市场
ext.ext_en: ...the Russian market for personal computers...

defs.def_en: The market for a particular type of thing is the number of people who want to buy it, or the area of the world in which it is sold.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于谈论同行业竞争时）年销售量，市场总额

ext.ext_cn: 两大公司控制了72%的市场份额。
ext.ext_en: The two big companies control 72% of the market.

defs.def_en: The market refers to the total amount of a product that is sold each year, especially when you are talking about the competition between the companies who sell that product.

ext.ext_cn: 他们最终的目标是为匈牙利建立起市场经济体制。
ext.ext_en: Their ultimate aim was a market economy for Hungary...

ext.ext_cn: 他必须以目前的市价出售这座房子。
ext.ext_en: He must sell the house for the current market value.

defs.def_en: If you talk about a market economy, or the market price of something, you are referring to an economic system in which the prices of things depend on how many are available and how many people want to buy them, rather than prices being fixed by governments.

defs.def_cn: 营销;推销；进行市场推广

ext.ext_cn: 要是你用了推广流行音乐的方式宣传我们的音乐的方式
ext.ext_en: ...if you marketed our music the way you market pop music...

ext.ext_cn: 按键式电话从1963年起就开始在美国销售。
ext.ext_en: Touch-tone telephones have been marketed in America since 1963.

defs.def_en: To market a product means to organize its sale, by deciding on its price, where it should be sold, and how it should be advertised.

ext.ext_cn: 每年有25万人进入就业市场。
ext.ext_en: Every year, 250,000 people enter the job market.

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪80年代劳动力市场的变化
ext.ext_en: ...the changes in the labour market during the 1980s.

defs.def_en: The job market or the labour market refers to the people who are looking for work and the jobs available for them to do.

ext.ext_cn: 去年10月股市崩盘。
ext.ext_en: The market collapsed last October.

defs.def_en: The stock market is sometimes referred to as the market .

defs.def_cn: 买方市场/ 卖方市场

ext.ext_cn: 别怕还价，现在是买方市场。
ext.ext_en: Don't be afraid to haggle: for the moment, it's a buyer's market...

ext.ext_cn: 房地产成了卖方市场，房价急剧上升。
ext.ext_en: Housing became a seller's market, and prices zoomed up.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is a buyer's market, you mean that it is a good time to buy a particular thing, because there is a lot of it available, so its price is low. If you say that it is a seller's market, you mean that very little of it is available, so its price is high.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你打算买一台新收音机，你会发现最新型号的收音机变化非常大。
ext.ext_en: If you're in the market for a new radio, you'll see that the latest models are very different.

defs.def_en: If you are in the market for something, you are interested in buying it.

defs.def_cn: 在出售;待售/上市;投入市场

ext.ext_cn: 出售更多的闲置办公室
ext.ext_en: ...putting more empty offices on the market.

ext.ext_cn: 刚刚上市的新药
ext.ext_en: ...new medicines that have just come onto the market.

defs.def_en: If something is on the market, it is available for people to buy. If it comes onto the market, it becomes available for people to buy.

ext.ext_cn: 他居然一个赛季要价15万英镑，真让人不敢问津。
ext.ext_en: At £150,000 for a season, he really is pricing himself out of the market.

defs.def_en: If you price yourself out of the market, you try to sell goods or services at a higher price than other people, with the result that no one buys them from you.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦有抵抗的苗头出现时，政府总是迅速地加以消灭。
ext.ext_en: Every time a new flicker of resistance appeared, the government snuffed it out...

ext.ext_cn: 抵押贷款利率最近的回升可能会扼杀房地产的复苏。
ext.ext_en: The recent rebound in mortgage rates could snuff out the housing recovery.

defs.def_en: To snuff out something such as a disagreement means to stop it, usually in a forceful or sudden way.

ext.ext_cn: 丹津掐灭了蜡烛。
ext.ext_en: Tenzin snuffed out the candle.

defs.def_en: If you snuff out a small flame, you stop it burning, usually by using your fingers or by covering it with something for a few seconds.

ext.ext_cn: 一枚原本射向赖利的子弹意外击毙了一个路过的暴徒。
ext.ext_en: A bullet meant for Riley snuffs out a passing gangster...

ext.ext_cn: 你已经大权在握，可以为所欲为了。你可以灭了他，也可以不这么做。
ext.ext_en: You've got the power. You can do anything you want. You can snuff him out or not.

defs.def_en: If someone snuffs out someone else, they kill them.

defs.def_cn: 谋划,策划（艰难或复杂的行动）

ext.ext_cn: 财政部长将继续策划波兰的经济改革。
ext.ext_en: The finance minister will continue to mastermind Poland's economic reform...

ext.ext_cn: 爆炸是由一个臭名昭著的毒品走私分子操纵的。
ext.ext_en: The bombings were masterminded by a known drugs smuggler.

defs.def_en: If you mastermind a difficult or complicated activity, you plan it in detail and then make sure that it happens successfully.

defs.def_cn: （常指罪案）主谋，出谋划策的人，幕后操纵者

ext.ext_cn: 他就是密谋获取炸药的主谋。
ext.ext_en: He was the mastermind behind the plan to acquire the explosives.

defs.def_en: The mastermind behind a difficult or complicated plan, often a criminal one, is the person who is responsible for planning and organizing it.

ext.ext_cn: 免去洛先生的委员会主任一职
ext.ext_en: ...Mr Low's dismissal from his post at the head of the commission.

defs.def_en: When an employee is dismissed from their job, you can refer to their dismissal .

ext.ext_cn: 他们对公众意见的蛮横漠视
ext.ext_en: ...their high-handed dismissal of public opinion.

defs.def_en: Dismissal of something means deciding or saying that it is not important.

ext.ext_cn: 伊尔蒂德神父总是敞开大门欢迎来客，男孩子们会在娱乐时间聚在他的书房里打扑克或玩游戏。
ext.ext_en: Father Illtyd kept open house and the boys would congregate in his study during their recreation time, playing cards or games.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone keeps open house, you mean that they welcome friends or visitors to their house whenever they arrive and allow them to stay for as long as they want to.

defs.def_cn: （机构等的）开放日，接待日，参观日

ext.ext_cn: 本月早些时候的星期六开放日那天
ext.ext_en: ...at a Saturday open house earlier this month...

ext.ext_cn: 一周后，萨拉和我参加了特德学校的开放日活动。
ext.ext_en: A week later, Sara and I attended open house at Ted's school...

defs.def_en: An open house is a day on which members of the public are encouraged to visit a particular institution or place to see what it is like.

ext.ext_cn: 现在“提前退休”几乎就是裁员的委婉说法。
ext.ext_en: The term 'early retirement' is nearly always a euphemism for redundancy nowadays.

defs.def_en: A euphemism is a polite word or expression that is used to refer to things which people may find upsetting or embarrassing to talk about, for example sex, the human body, or death.

defs.def_cn: 半食宿（指旅馆费用包括早餐和晚餐）
defs.def_en: If you stay at a hotel and have half board, your breakfast and evening meal are included in the price of your stay at the hotel, but not your lunch.

ext.ext_cn: 你将得到酬劳，你的职员也如此。
ext.ext_en: You will be remunerated and so will your staff.

ext.ext_cn: 报酬丰厚的工作
ext.ext_en: ...an adequately remunerated job.

defs.def_en: If you are remunerated for work that you do, you are paid for it.

defs.def_cn: 午夜后的几小时;凌晨时分

ext.ext_cn: 他们在周六的凌晨时分被逮捕。
ext.ext_en: They were arrested in the small hours of Saturday morning.

defs.def_en: If something happens in the small hours, it happens soon after midnight, in the very early morning.

defs.def_cn: 难以确切表达的;难以确定的;模糊不清的

ext.ext_cn: 她的眼神里有种难以确定的东西。
ext.ext_en: There was something indefinable in her eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 他的头不知为何有点晕眩。
ext.ext_en: His head felt lighter in some indefinable way.

defs.def_en: An indefinable quality or feeling cannot easily be described.

ext.ext_cn: 大会的主题是文艺复兴时期的欧洲。
ext.ext_en: The theme of the conference is renaissance Europe...

ext.ext_cn: “瞧，那是选择写作风格时要考虑的又一个因素，”他又回到了主题上。
ext.ext_en: 'That's another element in choosing a style of writing, you see,' he says, returning to his main theme...

defs.def_en: A theme in a piece of writing, a talk, or a discussion is an important idea or subject that runs through it.

defs.def_cn: (艺术品、文学作品的)主题，中心思想

ext.ext_cn: 小说的主题是男人和女人之间永无休止的冲突。
ext.ext_en: The novel's central theme is the perennial conflict between men and women...

ext.ext_cn: 这幅画体现了蒙克作品中另一个常见的主题。
ext.ext_en: This painting points to another recurring theme in Munch's work.

defs.def_en: A theme in an artist's work or in a work of literature is an idea in it that the artist or writer develops or repeats.

ext.ext_cn: 莫扎特的《魔笛》中主旋律的变奏曲
ext.ext_en: ...variations on themes from Mozart's The Magic Flute.

defs.def_en: A theme is a short simple tune on which a piece of music is based.

defs.def_cn: (电影、电视节目、广播节目的)主题音乐，主题曲

ext.ext_cn: 电影《日瓦戈医生》的主题曲
ext.ext_en: ...the theme from Dr Zhivago...

ext.ext_cn: BBC 选用了范吉利斯的《火战车》作为其 1984 年奥运节目的主题音乐。
ext.ext_en: The BBC used Vangelis's Chariots of Fire as its Olympic theme tune in 1984.

defs.def_en: Theme music or a theme song is a piece of music that is played at the beginning and end of a film or of a television or radio programme.

ext.ext_cn: 她数出了 30 便士——大部分是零钱——递给了我。
ext.ext_en: She was counting out 30p, mostly in small change, into my hand.

defs.def_en: Small change is coins of low value.
When spoilage occurs, something, usually food, decays or is harmed, so that it is no longer fit to be used.

ext.ext_cn: 只有主人公先把那些恶龙制服，才有可能实现大团圆结局。
ext.ext_en: A happy ending is only possible because the hero has first vanquished the dragons...

ext.ext_cn: 拥有了知识和智慧就能够把恶势力从这个世界上铲除。
ext.ext_en: With knowledge and wisdom, evil could be vanquished on this earth.

defs.def_en: To vanquish someone means to defeat them completely in a battle or a competition.

ext.ext_cn: 碳化合物氧化后必然会产生二氧化碳。
ext.ext_en: Carbon dioxide is a necessary result of the oxidation of carbon compounds.

defs.def_en: Oxidation is a process in which a chemical substance changes because of the addition of oxygen.
A crinoline was a round frame which women wore under their skirts in the 19th century.
An altimeter is an instrument in an aircraft that shows the height of the aircraft above the ground.

defs.def_cn: 验尸；尸体检验；尸体解剖
defs.def_en: A  post-mortem is a medical examination of a dead person's body in order to find out how they died.

defs.def_cn: （尤指对失败或出差错的事情的）事后分析；事后检讨

ext.ext_cn: 正在对总统竞选活动进行反思。
ext.ext_en: The postmortem on the presidential campaign is under way.

defs.def_en: A post-mortem is an examination of something that has recently happened, especially something that has failed or gone wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们对这些结果并不满意。
ext.ext_en: We are not satisfied with these results.

ext.ext_cn: 心满意足的顾客
ext.ext_en: ...satisfied customers.

defs.def_en: If you are satisfied with something, you are happy because you have got what you wanted or needed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 人们必须确信这种治疗方法是安全的。
ext.ext_en: People must be satisfied that the treatment is safe.

defs.def_en: If you are satisfied that something is true or has been done properly, you are convinced about this after checking it.

defs.def_cn: 一连串;一系列;连续;接连

ext.ext_cn: 与学生和政治领袖的一系列会面
ext.ext_en: ...a series of meetings with students and political leaders.

ext.ext_cn: 一连串的爆炸事件
ext.ext_en: ...a series of explosions.

defs.def_en: A series of things or events is a number of them that come one after the other.

defs.def_cn: (广播或电视的)系列节目,系列片

ext.ext_cn: 由戴维·阿滕伯勒主持的电视系列片《生命之源》
ext.ext_en: ...the TV series 'The Trials of Life' presented by David Attenborough.

ext.ext_cn: 世界上最长的广播剧，英国的《阿彻一家》
ext.ext_en: ...the world's longest-running radio series, Britain's 'The Archers'.

defs.def_en: A radio or television series is a set of programmes of a particular kind which have the same title.

ext.ext_cn: 他很高兴能入住圣庭苑酒店。
ext.ext_en: He was happy to book into the Royal Pavilion Hotel...

ext.ext_cn: 今天，马奥尼自己到悉尼最好的一家旅馆办理了入住手续。
ext.ext_en: Today Mahoney booked himself into one of the best hotels in Sydney...

defs.def_en: When you book into a hotel or when you book in, you officially state that you have arrived to stay there, usually by signing your name in a register.

defs.def_cn: （由于羞愧或难为情而）脸红，涨红了脸

ext.ext_cn: “你好，玛丽亚，”他说，这让她脸上又泛起了红晕。
ext.ext_en: 'Hello, Maria,' he said, and she blushed again...

ext.ext_cn: 我为自己的愚蠢羞愧得满脸通红。
ext.ext_en: I blushed scarlet at my stupidity.

defs.def_en: When you blush, your face becomes redder than usual because you are ashamed or embarrassed.

defs.def_cn: 不让…尴尬；避免使…难为情

ext.ext_cn: “为了不让当事人颜面扫地，我们就不指名道姓了，”一位警方发言人说道。
ext.ext_en: 'We don't want to name the man to spare his blushes,' said a police spokesman.

defs.def_en: If you spare someone's blushes or save someone's blushes, you avoid doing or saying something that will embarrass them.

defs.def_cn: 熔炉(指不同民族或思想融合混杂的地方或状况)

ext.ext_cn: 这个共和国是多民族的大熔炉。
ext.ext_en: The republic is a melting pot of different nationalities.

ext.ext_cn: 文化熔炉
ext.ext_en: ...the cultural melting pot...

defs.def_en: A melting pot is a place or situation in which people or ideas of different kinds gradually get mixed together.

defs.def_cn: 仍在变化的;尚未定型的;难以预料的

ext.ext_cn: 他们的命运仍然难以预料。
ext.ext_en: Their fate is still in the melting pot.

defs.def_en: If something is in the melting pot, you do not know what is going to happen to it.

ext.ext_cn: 她还影射了对手过去的婚姻问题。
ext.ext_en: She also alluded to her rival's past marital troubles.

defs.def_en: If you allude to something, you mention it in an indirect way.
Christmas pudding is a special pudding that is eaten at Christmas.
Flip-flops are open shoes which are held on your feet by a strap that goes between your toes.

defs.def_cn: (尤指政客)改变决定，转持相反观点

ext.ext_cn: 他因为在几个关键问题上临场变卦而备受批评。
ext.ext_en: He has been criticized for flip-flopping on several key issues...

ext.ext_cn: 他当时好像对自己的决定非常肯定，现在怎么会突然有如此巨大的转变呢？
ext.ext_en: He seemed so sure of his decision, how could he flip-flop so dramatically now?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone, especially a politician, flip-flops on a decision, you are critical of them because they change their decision, so that they do or think the opposite.
Sugar cane is a tall tropical plant. It is grown for the sugar that can be obtained from its thick stems.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们登上铺着俗艳的紫色地毯的楼梯。
ext.ext_en: They climbed the garish purple-carpeted stairs.

ext.ext_cn: 餐馆花哨的烫金招牌
ext.ext_en: ...the restaurant's garish, illuminated signs.

defs.def_en: You describe something as garish when you dislike it because it is very bright in an unattractive, showy way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 某些人对电视有点嗤之以鼻。
ext.ext_en: Some people are a bit sniffy about television.

ext.ext_cn: 自命不凡的艺术评论家
ext.ext_en: ...sniffy art critics.

defs.def_en: Someone who is sniffy about something does not think it is of high quality, perhaps unfairly.
Siamese twins are twins who are born with their bodies joined.
Artichokes or globe artichokes are round green vegetables that have fleshy leaves arranged like the petals of a flower.

ext.ext_cn: 我的余生都会珍惜这次经历。
ext.ext_en: It was an experience I will treasure for the rest of my life...

ext.ext_cn: 我会开一个派对，然后把剩下的钱用来投资。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to throw a party, then invest the rest of the money...

defs.def_en: The rest is used to refer to all the parts of something or all the things in a group that remain or that you have not already mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 诸如此类;如此等等;不一而足

ext.ext_cn: 一个穿着体面、开着路虎如此等等的男人
ext.ext_en: ...a man with nice clothes, a Range Rover and the rest...

ext.ext_cn: 那种族主义之类的观念又怎么样呢？
ext.ext_en: And what about racism and all the rest of it?

defs.def_en: You can add and the rest or all the rest of it to the end of a statement or list when you want to refer in a vague way to other things that are associated with the ones you have already mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 他精疲力竭，被建议休息两周。
ext.ext_en: He's tired and exhausted, and has been advised to rest for two weeks...

ext.ext_cn: 尽量不要活动受伤的手臂。
ext.ext_en: Try to rest the injured limb as much as possible.

defs.def_en: If you rest or if you rest your body, you do not do anything active for a time.

ext.ext_cn: “你太累了，劳拉，”他说，“回家休息一下吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'You're worn out, Laura,' he said. 'Go home and get some rest.'...

ext.ext_cn: 我先好好歇一会儿，之后再告诉你一切。
ext.ext_en: After I've had a good rest, I'll tell you everything.

defs.def_en: If you get some rest or have a rest, you do not do anything active for a time.

ext.ext_cn: 这样的观点建立在很多不正确的假设之上。
ext.ext_en: Such a view rests on a number of incorrect assumptions...

ext.ext_cn: 国家的长远未来取决于我们如何教育孩子。
ext.ext_en: The long-term future of the country rests on how we teach our children.

defs.def_en: If something such as a theory or someone's success rests on a particular thing, it depends on that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 法官说不管伯格曼小姐愿不愿意承认，这件事的责任都在她。
ext.ext_en: The judge said that whether Miss Bergman wishes to admit it or not, the responsibility rests with her. ...

ext.ext_cn: 最后的决定权在于总统。
ext.ext_en: The final decision rested with the President.

defs.def_en: If authority, a responsibility, or a decision rests with you, you have that authority or responsibility, or you are the one who will make that decision.

ext.ext_cn: 他把手臂放在椅背上。
ext.ext_en: He rested his arms on the back of the chair...

ext.ext_cn: 他把一根拐杖靠在栏杆上。
ext.ext_en: He rested one of his crutches against the rail.

defs.def_en: If you rest something somewhere, you put it there so that its weight is supported.

ext.ext_cn: 他的头靠在她的肩上。
ext.ext_en: His head was resting on her shoulder...

ext.ext_cn: 他双手撑着头，陷入了沉思。
ext.ext_en: He had been resting his head in his hands, deep in thought.

defs.def_en: If something is resting somewhere, or if you are resting it there, it is in a position where its weight is supported.

ext.ext_cn: 他在尖嘴镐上靠了一会儿。
ext.ext_en: He rested on his pickaxe for a while.

defs.def_en: If you rest on or against someone or something, you lean on them so that they support the weight of your body.

defs.def_cn: （尤指头或四肢的）支撑物;撑架;托架

ext.ext_cn: 坐立时，把胳膊肘靠在扶手上。
ext.ext_en: When you are sitting, keep your elbow on the arm rest.

defs.def_en: A rest is an object that is used to support something, especially your head, arms, or feet.

ext.ext_cn: 她说话的时候，眼睛凝视着丈夫的脸。
ext.ext_en: As she spoke, her eyes rested on her husband's face.

defs.def_en: If your eyes rest on a particular person or object, you look directly at them, rather than somewhere else.

ext.ext_cn: 飞机猛冲过一片森林，在一片田野中停了下来。
ext.ext_en: The plane had plowed a path through a patch of forest before coming to rest in a field.

defs.def_en: When an object that has been moving comes to rest, it finally stops.

ext.ext_cn: 知道自己的乳腺癌可能被误诊，哪个女人能不担心呢？
ext.ext_en: How can any woman rest easy now, knowing her breast cancer may be misdiagnosed?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone can rest easy, you mean that they don't need to worry about a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 你安静一下，好吗？我们想睡一会儿。
ext.ext_en: Give it a rest, will you? We're trying to get some sleep...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为你应该暂时停止踢足球。
ext.ext_en: I think you ought to give football a rest for a time.

defs.def_en: If someone tells you to give something a rest, they want you to stop doing it because it annoys them or because they think it is harming you.

ext.ext_cn: 他的遗愿是把他安葬在家乡萨默塞特郡附近的教堂里。
ext.ext_en: His dying wish was to be laid to rest at the church near his Somerset home.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone who has died is laid to rest, you mean that they are buried.

ext.ext_cn: 他的演说应当会消除那些忧虑。
ext.ext_en: His speech should lay those fears to rest...

ext.ext_cn: 我决定平息那些说我们正面临财政困难的谣言。
ext.ext_en: I am determined to put to rest these rumours that we are in financial trouble.

defs.def_en: If you lay something such as fears or rumours to rest or if you put them to rest, you succeed in proving that they are not true.

defs.def_cn: (尤指长时间的谈论后）停止讨论(某个话题)

ext.ext_cn: 我不准备就此罢休。
ext.ext_en: I am not prepared to let this matter rest...

ext.ext_cn: 别说了，雷切尔。让她平静一下。
ext.ext_en: Let it rest, Rachel. Leave her in peace.

defs.def_en: If someone refuses to let a subject rest, they refuse to stop talking about it, especially after they have been talking about it for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 她很快就让他放心了。“巴雷特太太会很高兴让你的兄弟们回来的，”她说道。
ext.ext_en: She was quick to put his mind at rest. 'Mrs Barrett will be delighted to have your brothers back,' she said...

ext.ext_cn: 上周五的脑部扫描终于让他放心了。
ext.ext_en: A brain scan last Friday finally set his mind at rest.

defs.def_en: To put someone's mind at rest or set their mind at rest means to tell them something that stops them worrying.

defs.def_cn: (对性格、情感、意见的)自我表现，自我抒发

ext.ext_cn: 想要表现自我的欲望和被迫从众的压力对她来说是一个最主要的冲突。
ext.ext_en: The conflict between the urge for self-expression and the pressure to conform is a central one for her...

ext.ext_cn: 衣服是一种基本的自我表现形式。
ext.ext_en: Clothes are a fundamental form of self-expression.

defs.def_en: Self-expression is the expression of your personality, feelings, or opinions, for example through an artistic activity such as drawing or dancing.

ext.ext_cn: 他做《纽约先驱报》的当地特约记者来赚些外快。
ext.ext_en: He picked up extra money as a local stringer for the New York Herald.

defs.def_en: A stringer is a journalist who is employed part-time by a newspaper or news service in order to report on a particular area.

defs.def_cn: 复苏;复兴;恢复;再次流行

ext.ext_cn: 这种重回现实主义的趋势已经重新激起了人们对许多艺术家的兴趣。
ext.ext_en: This return to realism has produced a revival of interest in a number of artists...

ext.ext_cn: 至少到明年8月之前，新车销量回升的希望都微乎其微。
ext.ext_en: There is little chance of a revival in new car sales until at least August next year.

defs.def_en: When there is a revival of something, it becomes active or popular again.

defs.def_cn: (戏剧、歌剧或芭蕾等的)重新上演

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·克莱门特对于契诃夫的《海鸥》的重新演绎
ext.ext_en: ...John Clement's revival of Chekhov's 'The Seagull'.

defs.def_en: A revival is a new production of a play, an opera, or a ballet.

defs.def_cn: （复兴基督教信仰的）奋兴布道会

ext.ext_cn: 他游历南非，组织奋兴布道会。
ext.ext_en: He toured South Africa organizing revival meetings.

defs.def_en: A revival meeting is a public religious event that is intended to make people more interested in Christianity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 发痒的;令人感到瘙痒的

ext.ext_cn: 又痒又痛的眼睛
ext.ext_en: ...itchy, sore eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 假发让人感觉发痒,很不舒服。
ext.ext_en: Wigs are itchy and uncomfortable.

defs.def_en: If a part of your body or something you are wearing is itchy, you have an unpleasant feeling on your skin that makes you want to scratch.

defs.def_cn: 漫游的渴望;旅行的渴望

ext.ext_cn: 这次旅行让我渴望出游,想去更多的地方。
ext.ext_en: The trip gave me itchy feet and I wanted to travel more.

defs.def_en: If you have itchy feet, you have a strong desire to leave a place and to travel.

ext.ext_cn: 大批鸟儿来这块泥地觅食。
ext.ext_en: The mud is a feeding ground for large numbers of birds.

defs.def_en: The feeding ground of a group of animals or birds, is the place where they find food and eat.

ext.ext_cn: 她三天两头旷课。
ext.ext_en: Her attendance at school was sporadic.

defs.def_en: Someone's attendance at an event or an institution is the fact that they are present at the event or go regularly to the institution.

ext.ext_cn: 2月份，平均每周的观影人数为241万。
ext.ext_en: Average weekly cinema attendance in February was 2.41 million...

ext.ext_cn: 今年的出席人数比预期少28%。
ext.ext_en: This year attendances were 28% lower than forecast...

defs.def_en: The attendance at an event is the number of people who are present at it.

ext.ext_cn: 议员保罗·提斯里将在会议开始时出席，以欢迎我们。
ext.ext_en: Councillor Paul Tisley will be in attendance at the start of the meeting to welcome us...

ext.ext_cn: 防暴警察和数辆消防车都到了。
ext.ext_en: Police with riot gear and several fire engines are in attendance.

defs.def_en: If someone is in attendance at a place or an event, they are there.

ext.ext_cn: 他活得相当潇洒，通常带着厨师、用人、管家和司机到处游玩。
ext.ext_en: He lived in considerable style, travelling widely, usually with a cook, valet, butler and chauffeur in attendance.

defs.def_en: If someone is in attendance on an important person, they are accompanying that person as a servant or assistant.

defs.def_cn: （用于数字后表示速度）千米每小时
defs.def_en: kph is written after a number to indicate the speed of something such as a vehicle. kph is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'kilometres per hour'.

ext.ext_cn: 在地方上代表民主的人是市长。
ext.ext_en: The person who embodies democracy at the local level is the mayor...

ext.ext_cn: 我想给那个商人授权。
ext.ext_en: I want to empower the businessman.

defs.def_en: Em- is a form of en- that is used before b-, m-, and p-.
A hanky is the same as a handkerchief.

ext.ext_cn: 美国大大小小的街道
ext.ext_en: ...the highways and byways of America.

ext.ext_cn: 狭窄的城中小路
ext.ext_en: ...the narrow city byways.

defs.def_en: A byway is a small road which is not used by many cars or people.

ext.ext_cn: 我的研究集中于儿童文学中的一些冷门领域。
ext.ext_en: My research focuses on the byways of children's literature.

defs.def_en: The byways of a subject are the less important or less well known areas of it.

ext.ext_cn: 那家公司遭受了严重亏损。
ext.ext_en: The company endured heavy financial losses.

ext.ext_cn: 他们不得不独自承受的无法忍受的疼痛，因为甚至连医生都无法靠近他们
ext.ext_en: ...unbearable pain, which they had to endure in solitude because not even the doctors could get near them.

defs.def_en: If you endure a painful or difficult situation, you experience it and do not avoid it or give up, usually because you cannot.

ext.ext_cn: 那种语言以某种方式保存下来，并继续存在下去。
ext.ext_en: Somehow the language endures and continues to survive.

defs.def_en: If something endures, it continues to exist without any loss in quality or importance.

ext.ext_cn: 他错过了回家的末班车。
ext.ext_en: He missed his last bus home...

ext.ext_cn: 他们只得乘公共汽车出行。
ext.ext_en: They had to travel everywhere by bus.

defs.def_en: A bus is a large motor vehicle which carries passengers from one place to another. Buses drive along particular routes, and you have to pay to travel in them.

defs.def_cn: 用大客车运送；乘坐公共汽车

ext.ext_cn: 美国政府证券和债券

defs.def_en: Securities are stocks, shares, bonds, or other certificates that you buy in order to earn regular interest from them or to sell them later for a profit.

ext.ext_en: ...a canopied Elizabethan bed.

defs.def_en: A canopied building or piece of furniture is covered with a roof or a piece of material supported by poles.

ext.ext_en: The ice-cool driver has built a reputation for pulling out his best performances under pressure.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as ice-cool, you admire them because they are calm and do not show emotion in difficult situations.

ext.ext_en: ...a trompe l'oeil painting.

ext.ext_cn: 这个世上净是些蹩脚文人。我不想与他们为伍。
ext.ext_en: The world is full of scribblers. I don't intend to join their ranks.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to writers as scribblers when they think they are not very good writers.

ext.ext_en: An elderly woman, arms crossed, sang the descant.

defs.def_en: A descant is a tune which is played or sung above the main tune in a piece of music.

defs.def_cn: (尤指为获取毛皮)设陷阱捕兽者
defs.def_en: A trapper is a person who traps animals, especially for their fur.

defs.def_en: A ukulele is a small guitar with four strings.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人反胃的;令人恶心的

ext.ext_en: The stench from rotting food is stomach-churning.

ext.ext_en: ...that rush of stomach-churning fear at the sound of a mortar exploding nearby.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as stomach-churning, you mean that it is so unpleasant that it makes you feel physically sick.

defs.def_cn: 可交换的;可互换的;可交替的

ext.ext_en: His greatest innovation was the use of interchangeable parts...

ext.ext_cn: 新款上的每一个零部件与原先的都可互换。
ext.ext_en: Every part on the new models is interchangeable with those on the original.

defs.def_en: Things that are interchangeable can be exchanged with each other without it making any difference.

ext.ext_en: ...the ghost of Marie Antoinette...

ext.ext_cn: 死去的孩子们的幽灵常在该村出没。
ext.ext_en: The village is haunted by the ghosts of the dead children.

defs.def_en: A ghost is the spirit of a dead person that someone believes they can see or feel.

defs.def_cn: （尤指对可怕事物的）记忆，回忆

ext.ext_cn: 总统正借这两次访问来消除《慕尼黑协定》的阴影。
ext.ext_en: The President is using the two visits to lay the ghosts of the Munich Agreement.

ext.ext_cn: 经济管理不善的梦魇
ext.ext_en: ...the ghost of economic mismanagement.

defs.def_en: The ghost of something, especially of something bad that has happened, is the memory of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他露出一丝微笑。
ext.ext_en: He gave the ghost of a smile...

ext.ext_cn: 阳光和煦，仅有一丝西北风轻轻吹拂。
ext.ext_en: The sun was warm and there was just a ghost of a breeze from the north-west.

defs.def_en: If there is a ghost of something, that thing is so faint or weak that it hardly exists.

ext.ext_cn: 我出版了《每日邮报》的女记者为他代笔的自传，写得颇具文采。
ext.ext_en: I published his autobiography, which was very competently ghosted by a woman journalist from the Daily Mail...

ext.ext_en: I ghosted his weekly rugby column for the Telegraph.

defs.def_en: If a book or other piece of writing is ghosted, it is written by a writer for another person, for example a politician or sportsman, who then publishes it as his or her own work.

defs.def_cn: 没有一点（成功的）可能；机会渺茫

ext.ext_cn: 那房子他根本不可能卖得出去。
ext.ext_en: He doesn't stand a ghost of a chance of selling the house.

defs.def_en: If someone does not stand or does not have a ghost of a chance of doing something, they have very little chance of succeeding in it.

defs.def_cn: （人）放弃，撂挑子；（机器）报废，不再运转

ext.ext_cn: 一些公司没等找到目标便已放弃。
ext.ext_en: Some firms give up the ghost before they find what they are looking for...

ext.ext_cn: 我的汽车电池报废了。
ext.ext_en: The battery in my car gave up the ghost.

defs.def_en: If someone gives up the ghost, they stop trying to do something because they no longer believe they can do it successfully. If a machine gives up the ghost, it stops working.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He seemed aloof and detached.

defs.def_en: Someone who is aloof is not very friendly and does not like to spend time with other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The Government is keeping aloof from the controversy...

ext.ext_cn: 我会让自己远离错误和腐败。
ext.ext_en: I will hold myself aloof from wrong and corruption.

defs.def_en: If someone stays aloof from something, they do not become involved with it.
A cesspit is a hole or tank in the ground into which waste water and sewage flow.

defs.def_cn: 种族的；种族间的；人种的

ext.ext_cn: 对少数民族和少数人种的保护
ext.ext_en: ...the protection of national and racial minorities.

ext.ext_cn: 消除种族歧视
ext.ext_en: ...the elimination of racial discrimination.

defs.def_en: Racial describes things relating to people's race.

defs.def_en: A bunker is a place, usually underground, that has been built with strong walls to protect it against heavy gunfire and bombing.
A bunker is a container for coal or other fuel.
On a golf course, a bunker is a large area filled with sand, which is deliberately put there as an obstacle that golfers must try to avoid.

defs.def_cn: （高尔夫球运动中）把球击入沙坑

ext.ext_cn: 她第二次击球把球打进了沙坑。
ext.ext_en: She bunkered her second shot.

defs.def_en: In golf, if you bunker a shot, you hit your ball into the bunker.
A table lamp is a small electric lamp which stands on a table or other piece of furniture.

ext.ext_en: Staff must report for duty at their normal place of work...

ext.ext_cn: 我的责任就是照看这些动物。
ext.ext_en: My duty is to look after the animals.

defs.def_en: Duty is work that you have to do for your job.

ext.ext_cn: 我一丝不苟地履行我的职责。
ext.ext_en: I carried out my duties conscientiously...

ext.ext_en: He was relieved of his duties as presidential adviser.

defs.def_en: Your duties are tasks which you have to do because they are part of your job.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为写信向你表达谢意是我的责任。
ext.ext_en: I consider it my duty to write to you and thank you.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is your duty, you believe that you ought to do it because it is your responsibility.

ext.ext_en: ...customs duties...

defs.def_en: Duties are taxes which you pay to the government on goods that you buy.

ext.ext_cn: 我下班了。
ext.ext_en: I'm off duty...

ext.ext_cn: 四名官员已经被通知停职在家休整。
ext.ext_en: Four officers were told to go off duty and rest at home...

defs.def_en: If someone such as a policeman or a nurse is off duty, they are not working. If someone is on duty, they are working.

ext.ext_cn: 波尔登的学校不够大，容不下所有的孩子。
ext.ext_en: The school in Poldown was not big enough to accommodate all the children...

ext.ext_en: The CD-ROMs will accommodate the works of all English poets from 600 to 1900.

defs.def_en: If a building or space can accommodate someone or something, it has enough room for them.

ext.ext_cn: 一家为接待前来参加阿方索国王婚礼的来宾而建的宾馆
ext.ext_en: ...a hotel built to accommodate guests for the wedding of King Alfonso...

ext.ext_cn: 学生被安置在附近的住家中。
ext.ext_en: Students are accommodated in homes nearby.

defs.def_en: To accommodate someone means to provide them with a place to live or stay.

ext.ext_en: The roads are built to accommodate gradual temperature changes...

ext.ext_en: The way that American history is taught may change in order to accommodate some more of those cultures.

defs.def_en: If something is planned or changed to accommodate a particular situation, it is planned or changed so that it takes this situation into account.

ext.ext_en: He has never put an arm around his wife to accommodate photographers...

ext.ext_en: He's already altered several of the proposals in his economic plan to accommodate demands of special interests.

defs.def_en: If you do something to accommodate someone, you do it with the main purpose of pleasing or satisfying them.

ext.ext_cn: 某些种类的动植物不能适应迅速变化的环境。
ext.ext_en: Some animal and plant species cannot accommodate to the rapidly changing conditions...

ext.ext_cn: 她走得很慢，以便与他保持一致的步伐。
ext.ext_en: She walked slowly to accommodate herself to his pace.

defs.def_en: If you accommodate to something new, you change your behaviour or ideas so that you are able to deal with it.

ext.ext_en: The torment of having her baby kidnapped is written all over her face.

ext.ext_en: Sooner or later most writers end up making books about the torments of being a writer...

ext.ext_en: Outdoors, mosquitoes and midges were a perpetual torment.

defs.def_en: A torment is something that causes extreme suffering, usually mental suffering.

ext.ext_en: At times the memories returned to torment her...

ext.ext_en: He had lain awake all night, tormented by jealousy.

defs.def_en: If something torments you, it causes you extreme mental suffering.

ext.ext_en: He exerted considerable influence on the thinking of the scientific community on these issues...

ext.ext_en: The cyst was causing swelling and exerting pressure on her brain.

defs.def_en: If someone or something exerts influence, authority, or pressure, they use it in a strong or determined way, especially in order to produce a particular effect.

ext.ext_en: Do not exert yourself unnecessarily.

defs.def_en: If you exert yourself, you make a great physical or mental effort, or work hard to do something.

ext.ext_en: Can you assure me that my father is not suffering?

defs.def_en: If you suffer pain, you feel it in your body or in your mind.

ext.ext_en: He was eventually diagnosed as suffering from terminal cancer...

ext.ext_en: I realized he was suffering from shock.

defs.def_en: If you suffer from an illness or from some other bad condition, you are badly affected by it.

ext.ext_en: Romania suffered another setback in its efforts to obtain financial support for its reforms.

ext.ext_en: It is obvious that Syria will suffer most from this change of heart.

defs.def_en: If you suffer, you are badly affected by an event or situation.

ext.ext_en: I'm not surprised that your studies are suffering...

ext.ext_en: Without a major boost in tourism, the economy will suffer even further.

defs.def_en: If something suffers, it does not succeed because it has not been given enough attention or is in a bad situation.

ext.ext_cn: 她不愿与笨人为伍，而在她看来，大多数人都是笨人。
ext.ext_en: She doesn't suffer fools gladly and, in her view, most people are fools.

defs.def_en: If you do not suffer fools gladly, you are not patient with people who you think are stupid.

ext.ext_en: Perth was the setting for the SNP's conference this year...

defs.def_en: A particular setting is a particular place or type of surroundings where something is or takes place.

defs.def_cn: (炉具、热水器等上可供调节的)挡，级，点，刻度

ext.ext_en: You can boil the fish fillets on a high setting.

defs.def_en: A setting is one of the positions to which the controls of a device such as a cooker, stove, or heater can be adjusted.

ext.ext_cn: 为期12个月的保修单
ext.ext_en: ...a twelve month warranty...

ext.ext_cn: 这套设备仍在保修期内。
ext.ext_en: The equipment is still under warranty.

defs.def_en: A warranty is a written promise by a company that, if you find a fault in something they have sold you within a certain time, they will repair it or replace it free of charge.

defs.def_cn: 拆散(核反应堆、大型机械等);使退役

ext.ext_en: HMS Warspite was decommissioned as part of defence cuts.

ext.ext_cn: 科罗拉多州废弃的发电站
ext.ext_en: ...a decommissioned power plant in Colorado.

defs.def_en: When something such as a nuclear reactor or a large machine is decommissioned, it is taken to pieces because it is no longer going to be used.

ext.ext_cn: 托什是一个遇事喜欢又嚷又骂的人。
ext.ext_en: Tosh was known to be a man who would cuss and shout...

ext.ext_en: He rails and cusses at those pop stars.

defs.def_en: If someone cusses, they swear at someone or use bad language.
Unilateralism is the belief that one country should get rid of all its own nuclear weapons, without waiting for other countries to do the same.

ext.ext_en: ...the recent history of American aggressive unilateralism on trade.

defs.def_en: Unilateralism is used to refer to a policy in which one country or group involved in a situation takes a decision or action on its own, without the agreement of the other countries or groups involved.

ext.ext_cn: 教士袍挂在墙上。
ext.ext_en: Priestly robes hang on the walls.

ext.ext_cn: 他的教士职责
ext.ext_en: ...his priestly duties.

defs.def_en: Priestly is used to describe things that belong or relate to a priest.

Someone who practises idolatry worships idols.

ext.ext_cn: 他们对她的喜爱不久就发展到了盲目崇拜的地步。
ext.ext_en: Their affection for her soon increased almost to idolatry.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's admiration for a particular person as idolatry, you think it is too great and uncritical.

defs.def_cn: 不能修复的;不可弥补的;无可挽救的

ext.ext_cn: 这一举措会对该组织造成不可弥补的损害。
ext.ext_en: The move would cause irreparable harm to the organization.

defs.def_en: Irreparable damage or harm is so bad that it cannot be repaired or put right.

ext.ext_cn: 这套房子归她们家有三四代人了。
ext.ext_en: The house had belonged to her family for three or four generations.

defs.def_en: If something belongs to you, you own it.

ext.ext_cn: 这是男性的笔迹。
ext.ext_en: The handwriting belongs to a male...

ext.ext_cn: 他们确定这是一具15岁女孩的尸体。
ext.ext_en: They established that the body belonged to a 15-year-old girl.

defs.def_en: You say that something belongs to a particular person when you are guessing, discovering, or explaining that it was produced by or is part of that person.

ext.ext_cn: 我过去是一个青年俱乐部的成员。
ext.ext_en: I used to belong to a youth club.

defs.def_en: If someone belongs to a particular group, they are a member of that group.

defs.def_cn: 属于（某个类别、类型或群体）

ext.ext_en: The judges could not decide which category it belonged in...

ext.ext_cn: 我意识到我和他不是一路人。
ext.ext_en: I realized that he and I belonged to different worlds.

defs.def_en: If something or someone belongs in or to a particular category, type, or group, they are of that category, type, or group.

ext.ext_cn: 这些画出自一个人人向往上流社会的时代。
ext.ext_en: The pictures belong to an era when there was a preoccupation with high society.

defs.def_en: If something belongs to a particular time, it comes from that time.

ext.ext_cn: 但是最终决定权在罗莎娜手里
ext.ext_en: ...but the last word belonged to Rosanne.

defs.def_en: If you say that something belongs to someone, you mean that person has the right to it.

ext.ext_cn: 未来属于民主。
ext.ext_en: The future belongs to democracy.

defs.def_en: If you say that a time belongs to a particular system or way of doing something, you mean that that time is or will be characterized by it.

ext.ext_cn: 他推断这俩小孩是这对夫妇的。
ext.ext_en: He deduced that the two children belonged to the couple.

defs.def_en: If a baby or child belongs to a particular adult, that adult is his or her parent or the person who is looking after him or her.

defs.def_cn: 属于彼此（恋人用来表示亲密关系）

ext.ext_en: I really think that we belong together...

ext.ext_cn: 他是我的。
ext.ext_en: He belongs with me.

defs.def_en: When lovers say that they belong together, they are expressing their closeness or commitment to each other.

defs.def_cn: 归属于（某地或某一情形）

ext.ext_cn: 你不属于这里。
ext.ext_en: You don't belong here...

ext.ext_cn: 这曲子很适合在音乐厅演奏。
ext.ext_en: This piece really belongs in the concert hall...

defs.def_en: If a person or thing belongs in a particular place or situation, that is where they should be.

defs.def_cn: 只有两人(或两队等）胜算最大的;主要为两方角逐的

ext.ext_cn: 这次选举有可能并非是支持率最高的民主党与共和党候选人之间的传统两方角逐。
ext.ext_en: The election may not be the traditional two-horse race between the preferred Democrat and Republican party candidates.

defs.def_en: If you describe a contest as a two-horse race, you mean that only two of the people or things taking part have any chance of winning.

ext.ext_cn: 勃艮第大区一向被视为重要的美食中心。
ext.ext_en: Burgundy has always been considered a major centre of gastronomy.

defs.def_en: Gastronomy is the activity and knowledge involved in preparing and appreciating good food.

defs.def_cn: (河流、道路)蜿蜒而行，迂回曲折

ext.ext_cn: 田地周围蜿蜒的道路
ext.ext_en: ...roads that meandered round the edges of the fields...

ext.ext_cn: 一条乡间的单轨铁路从山谷间曲折地穿过。
ext.ext_en: A rural single railway track meanders through the valley...

defs.def_en: If a river or road meanders, it has a lot of bends, rather than going in a straight line from one place to another.
A  meander is a large bend in a river.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在群山、河流和葡萄园构成的美丽画卷中漫步。
ext.ext_en: We meandered through a landscape of mountains, rivers, and vineyards...

ext.ext_cn: 沿着爱尔兰的乡间小路漫步是多么惬意。
ext.ext_en: It's so restful to meander along Irish country roads.

defs.def_en: If you meander somewhere, you move slowly and not in a straight line.

defs.def_cn: 漫谈;闲聊;(文章)结构松散

ext.ext_cn: 他的谈话看似不着边际，最终却集中到了事态的真相上来。
ext.ext_en: His talk appears to meander but by the end focuses attention on the true state of affairs.

ext.ext_cn: 一部内容丰富的漫谈小说
ext.ext_en: ...a rich and meandering novel.

defs.def_en: If a speech, account, or piece of writing meanders, it seems to move from one topic to another without any order or purpose.

defs.def_cn: 不中用的;失灵的;出故障的

ext.ext_cn: 他换掉了坏阀门。
ext.ext_en: He replaced a dud valve.

ext.ext_cn: 矿井废弃了。
ext.ext_en: The mine was a dud.

defs.def_en: Dud means not working properly or not successful.

defs.def_cn: (用以清洁硬质表面或除去油漆的)钢丝球
defs.def_en: Steel wool is a mass of fine steel threads twisted together into a small ball and used for cleaning hard surfaces or removing paint.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 绝妙的;非凡的;不可思议的

ext.ext_cn: 他真是个很棒的演员。
ext.ext_en: He certainly is a marvellous actor...

ext.ext_cn: 她做的鱼饼味美可口。
ext.ext_en: She made marvellous fish pie...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as marvellous, you are emphasizing that they are very good.

defs.def_cn: 突破性科技;颠覆性技术

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪其他伟大的颠覆性科技，如电、电话和汽车
ext.ext_en: ...the other great disruptive technologies of the 20th century, such as electricity, the telephone and the car.

defs.def_en: A disruptive technology is a new technology, such as computers and the Internet, which has a rapid and major effect on technologies that existed before.

ext.ext_cn: 一枚手工银制胸针
ext.ext_en: ...a hand-crafted brooch made from silver.

ext.ext_cn: 镶琥珀的银耳环
ext.ext_en: ...amber earrings set in silver.

defs.def_en: Silver is a valuable pale grey metal that is used for making jewellery and ornaments.

ext.ext_cn: 埋有 150,000 英镑银币的地下室
ext.ext_en: ...the basement where £150,000 in silver was buried.

defs.def_en: Silver consists of coins that are made from silver or that look like silver.

ext.ext_cn: 他拍打去地毯上的灰尘，还擦拭了银器。
ext.ext_en: He beat the rugs and polished the silver.

defs.def_en: You can use silver to refer to all the things in a house that are made of silver, especially the cutlery and dishes.

ext.ext_cn: 他浓密的银发该理理了。
ext.ext_en: He had thick silver hair which needed cutting.

ext.ext_cn: 一辆银色跑车
ext.ext_en: ...a silver sports car...

defs.def_en: Silver is used to describe things that are shiny and pale grey in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 英国斩获了铜牌，接下来又赢得了世界杯的银牌。
ext.ext_en: Britain went on to take bronze and then followed it up by winning silver in the World Cup.

defs.def_en: A silver is the same as a silver medal .

ext.ext_cn: 保险业提出了自己的全民医疗保健方案。
ext.ext_en: The insurance industry has produced its own proposals for universal health care...

ext.ext_cn: 爱美之心，人皆有之。
ext.ext_en: The desire to look attractive is universal.

defs.def_en: Something that is universal relates to everyone in the world or everyone in a particular group or society.

ext.ext_cn: 全球性的疾病
ext.ext_en: ...universal diseases.

defs.def_en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

ext.ext_cn: 没有普遍适用的经济学原理。
ext.ext_en: There are no economic universals.

defs.def_en: A universal is a principle that applies in all cases or a characteristic that is present in all members of a particular class.

ext.ext_cn: 我今年很想出国，可能是去法国南部。
ext.ext_en: I would love to go abroad this year, perhaps to the South of France.

ext.ext_cn: 国内外公众的反对
ext.ext_en: ...public opposition here and abroad...

defs.def_en: If you go abroad, you go to a foreign country, usually one which is separated from the country where you live by an ocean or a sea.

defs.def_cn: 在四下流传;广为流传地

ext.ext_cn: 人们还会普遍觉得这项变革早晚得接受。
ext.ext_en: There'll still be a feeling abroad that this change has to be recognised.

defs.def_en: If there is a story or feeling abroad, people generally know about it or feel it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一家公司正在给自己的员工发机票，万一需要就紧急撤离。
ext.ext_en: One company is giving its employees airplane tickets in the event they need to make a hasty escape.

defs.def_en: A hasty movement, action, or statement is sudden, and often done in reaction to something that has just happened.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 仓促而就的;匆忙结束的

ext.ext_cn: 匆匆忙忙吃过饭后，大家走出来，各就各位。
ext.ext_en: After the hasty meal, the men had moved forward to take up their positions.

defs.def_en: A hasty event or action is one that is completed more quickly than normal.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 所以我们不要鲁莽行事。毕竟他是跑不掉的。
ext.ext_en: So let's not be hasty. After all, he can't run away...

ext.ext_cn: 美国的一些盟友已力劝他不要急于作决定。
ext.ext_en: A number of the United States' allies had urged him not to take a hasty decision.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as hasty, you mean that they are acting too quickly, without thinking carefully, for example because they are angry.

defs.def_cn: （某一学科、个人或群体的）全部词汇

ext.ext_cn: 管理学词汇
ext.ext_en: ...the lexicon of management...

ext.ext_cn: 巧克力在大多数人的字典里等同于罪恶。
ext.ext_en: Chocolate equals sin in most people's lexicon.

defs.def_en: The lexicon of a particular subject is all the terms associated with it. The lexicon of a person or group is all the words they commonly use.
A lexicon is an alphabetical list of the words in a language or the words associated with a particular subject.

defs.def_cn: （尤指希腊语、希伯来语等古老语言的）词典，字典
defs.def_en: A lexicon is a dictionary, especially of a very old language such as Greek or Hebrew.

ext.ext_cn: 炙热的中亚沙漠
ext.ext_en: ...the burning desert of Central Asia.

ext.ext_cn: 他摸了摸男孩的额头，烧得烫手。
ext.ext_en: He touched the boy's forehead. It was burning hot.

defs.def_en: You use burning to describe something that is extremely hot.

ext.ext_cn: 她瞪着他们俩，目光中充满怒火和责备。
ext.ext_en: She glared at both of them with burning, reproachful eyes.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has burning  eyes, you mean they look at you in an intense way or have bright eyes because of a strong feeling.

ext.ext_cn: 我热切期盼成为一名记者。
ext.ext_en: I had a burning ambition to become a journalist.

ext.ext_cn: 她复仇心切。
ext.ext_en: She had a burning desire to wreak revenge.

defs.def_en: If you have a burning interest in something or a burning desire to do something, you are extremely interested in it or want to do it very much.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 今年联邦财政预算辩论中的一个重要问题就是：哪些人的纳税额应该提高？
ext.ext_en: The burning question in this year's debate over the federal budget is: whose taxes should be raised?

defs.def_en: A burning issue or question is a very important or urgent one that people feel very strongly about.

ext.ext_cn: 在该国不同的地区发生了群体暴力事件。
ext.ext_en: Communal violence broke out in different parts of the country.

ext.ext_cn: 不同群体之间的关系
ext.ext_en: ...inter-communal relations.

defs.def_en: Communal means relating to particular groups in a country or society.

ext.ext_cn: 囚犯们在公共餐厅吃饭。
ext.ext_en: The inmates ate in a communal dining room.

ext.ext_cn: 公共所有
ext.ext_en: ...communal ownership.

defs.def_en: You use communal to describe something that is shared by a group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 这家商店的内部装修仍然保留着19世纪的风格。
ext.ext_en: The interior of the shop still retains a nineteenth-century atmosphere...

ext.ext_cn: 他对这个职业仍然深怀敬意。
ext.ext_en: He retains a deep respect for the profession...

defs.def_en: To retain something means to continue to have that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他决定聘请他为出庭律师。
ext.ext_en: He decided to retain him for the trial.

defs.def_en: If you retain a lawyer, you pay him or her a fee to make sure that he or she will represent you when your case comes before the court.
Text messaging is sending written messages using a mobile phone.

defs.def_cn: (预防不测的)保障措施,安全网

ext.ext_cn: 对于低收入工人来说，福利救济是唯一真正有效的保障措施。
ext.ext_en: Welfare is the only real safety net for low-income workers.

defs.def_en: A safety net is something that you can rely on to help you if you get into a difficult situation.
In a circus, a safety net is a large net that is placed below performers on a high wire or trapeze in order to catch them and prevent them being injured if they fall off.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一些一流老人服务机构是由慈善组织资助的。
ext.ext_en: Some of the best services for the ageing are sponsored by philanthropic organizations.

defs.def_en: A philanthropic person or organization freely gives money or other help to people who need it.

defs.def_cn: (机器、昆虫翅膀等)发出呼呼声，嗡嗡作响

ext.ext_cn: 相机发出嗡嗡声和咔嚓声。
ext.ext_en: The camera whirred and clicked.

ext.ext_cn: 电影放映机的嗡嗡声
ext.ext_en: ...the whirring sound of the film projector.

defs.def_en: When something such as a machine or an insect's wing whirrs, it makes a series of low sounds so quickly that they seem like one continuous sound.

ext.ext_cn: 该政策在美国国会屡遭强烈批评。
ext.ext_en: This policy had repeatedly come under strong criticism on Capitol Hill...

ext.ext_cn: 常有人指责英国人并不真正关心自己的子女。
ext.ext_en: The criticism that the English do not truly care about their children was often voiced.

defs.def_en: Criticism is the action of expressing disapproval of something or someone. A criticism is a statement that expresses disapproval.

ext.ext_cn: 她已出版了包括小说、诗歌和文学评论在内的20多部著作。
ext.ext_en: She has published more than 20 books including novels, poetry and literary criticism.

defs.def_en: Criticism is a serious examination and judgment of something such as a book or play.

ext.ext_cn: 为想学越野驾驶的人开办的培训班
ext.ext_en: ...training sessions for anyone who wants to go off-roading.

defs.def_en: Off-roading is the activity of driving off-road vehicles over rough ground.
Your bowels are the tubes in your body through which digested food passes from your stomach to your anus.
You can refer in a polite way to someone getting rid of the waste from their body by saying that they move, open, or empty their bowels .

ext.ext_cn: 在地心深处
ext.ext_en: ...deep in the bowels of the earth...

ext.ext_cn: 林恩进入了这座漆黑的建筑物的内部。
ext.ext_en: Lyn went off into the dark bowels of the building.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the parts deep inside something such as the earth, a building, or a machine as the bowels of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 她双眼噙满泪水。
ext.ext_en: Her eyes filled with tears...

ext.ext_cn: 我一下子禁不住喜极而泣。
ext.ext_en: I just broke down and wept with tears of joy...

defs.def_en: Tears are the drops of salty liquid that come out of your eyes when you are crying.

ext.ext_cn: 他在电话里失声痛哭。
ext.ext_en: He was in floods of tears on the phone...

ext.ext_cn: 她突然哭了，跑出了厨房。
ext.ext_en: She burst into tears and ran from the kitchen...

defs.def_en: You can use tears in expressions such as in tears ,burst into tears, and close to tears to indicate that someone is crying or is almost crying.

ext.ext_cn: 她差点把我的大衣扯破了。
ext.ext_en: She very nearly tore my overcoat...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽·安撕掉了餐巾的边儿。
ext.ext_en: Mary Ann tore the edge off her napkin...

defs.def_en: If you tear paper, cloth, or another material, or if it tears, you pull it into two pieces or you pull it so that a hole appears in it.

ext.ext_cn: 我通过篷车帘子的破洞窥视。
ext.ext_en: I peered through a tear in the van's curtains.

defs.def_en: A tear in paper, cloth, or another material is a hole that has been made in it.

ext.ext_cn: 犬齿用来咬穿、咬死猎物，还可以撕肉。
ext.ext_en: Canine teeth are for piercing and killing prey, and tearing flesh...

ext.ext_cn: 他绊倒在地，膝盖上蹭破了皮。
ext.ext_en: He had stumbled down and torn the skin from his knees.

defs.def_en: If something tears your flesh or skin, it cuts it badly.

ext.ext_cn: 他右大腿的一块肌肉拉伤了。
ext.ext_en: He tore a muscle in his right thigh...

ext.ext_cn: 这块肌肉要是再拉伸的话，甚至可能会撕裂。
ext.ext_en: If the muscle is stretched again it could even tear.

defs.def_en: If you tear one of your muscles or ligaments, or if it tears, you injure it by accidentally moving it in the wrong way.

ext.ext_cn: 她猛地扯掉他车上的雨刷。
ext.ext_en: She tore the windscreen wipers from his car...

ext.ext_cn: 他一把扯下那女孩的照片，将它揉成一团。
ext.ext_en: He tore down the girl's photograph, and crumpled it into a ball.

defs.def_en: To tear something from somewhere means to remove it roughly and violently.

ext.ext_cn: 女粉丝冲破保安的阻拦，撕扯他的衣裳。
ext.ext_en: Female fans fought their way past bodyguards and tore at his clothes.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal tears at something, they pull it violently and try to break it into pieces.

ext.ext_cn: 门猛地开了，米兰达闯进房间。
ext.ext_en: The door flew open and Miranda tore into the room...

ext.ext_cn: 他也不朝两边看，就在路上开始狂奔。
ext.ext_en: Without looking to left or to right, he tore off down the road.

defs.def_en: If you tear somewhere, you move there very quickly, often in an uncontrolled or dangerous way.

defs.def_cn: 使饱经创伤;使经受磨难

ext.ext_cn: 自独立以来就饱受内战和外敌入侵之苦的国家
ext.ext_en: ...a country that has been torn by civil war and foreign invasion since its independence.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place is torn by particular events, you mean that unpleasant events which cause suffering and division among people are happening there.

ext.ext_cn: 英国不肯同意法国的要求。
ext.ext_en: Britain would not accede to France's request.

ext.ext_cn: 我一直搞不懂他为什么不一开始就同意我们的要求。
ext.ext_en: I never understood why he didn't just accede to our demands at the outset.

defs.def_en: If you accede to someone's request, you do what they ask.

ext.ext_cn: 当亨利八世即位时
ext.ext_en: ...when Henry VIII acceded to the throne.

defs.def_en: When a member of a royal family accedes to the throne, they become king or queen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 强调个人独特性的;奉行个人主义的

ext.ext_cn: 大多数艺术家都非常强调个人独特性。
ext.ext_en: Most artists are very individualistic...

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙一直都是个非常强调个人主义的国家。
ext.ext_en: Spain remains a very individualistic country.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is individualistic, you mean that they like to think and do things in their own way, rather than imitating other people. You can also say that a society is individualistic if it encourages people to behave in this way.

ext.ext_cn: 有电话和传真机的现代化接待处
ext.ext_en: ...a modern reception desk with telephone and fax...

ext.ext_cn: 现在卡通画家用传真机发送作品。
ext.ext_en: These days, cartoonists send in their work by fax.

defs.def_en: A fax or a fax machine is a piece of equipment used to copy documents by sending information electronically along a telephone line, and to receive copies that are sent in this way.

ext.ext_cn: 我给每个投资人都传真了一份合同。
ext.ext_en: I faxed a copy of the agreement to each of the investors...

ext.ext_cn: 你发传真回复他了吗？
ext.ext_en: Did you fax him a reply?...

defs.def_en: If you fax a document to someone, you send it from one fax machine to another.

ext.ext_cn: 我给他发了一份很长的传真，说我不需要女仆。
ext.ext_en: I sent him a long fax, saying I didn't need a maid.

ext.ext_cn: 一份 2,000 词的传真
ext.ext_en: ...a 2,000 word fax message.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a copy of a document that is transmitted by a fax machine as a fax .

ext.ext_cn: “我告诉过你普雷斯克毫不知情的，”肯普颇为不耐烦地说道。
ext.ext_en: 'I told you Preskel had no idea,' remarked Kemp with some asperity.

defs.def_en: If you say something with asperity, you say it impatiently and severely.

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔在数学上可能不太灵光，但在语言方面很有天赋。
ext.ext_en: Michael may have been a dunce at mathematics, but he was gifted at languages.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a dunce, you think they are rather stupid because they find it difficult or impossible to learn what someone is trying to teach them.

ext.ext_cn: 我专心听你所讲。
ext.ext_en: You have my undivided attention...

ext.ext_cn: 其后，他将注意力转向了该省形势严峻的住房问题。
ext.ext_en: Later he turned his attention to the desperate state of housing in the province.

defs.def_en: If you give someone or something your attention, you look at it, listen to it, or think about it carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 副标题为“律师”的第二册也将获得广泛关注。
ext.ext_en: Volume Two, subtitled 'The Lawyers', will also attract considerable attention...

ext.ext_cn: 此次会议可能有助于将关注焦点放在经济上。
ext.ext_en: The conference may help to focus attention on the economy.

defs.def_en: Attention is great interest that is shown in someone or something, particularly by the general public.

ext.ext_cn: 每年有超过200万起家中受伤事件需要医疗处理。
ext.ext_en: Each year more than two million household injuries need medical attention.

ext.ext_cn: 好像一天24小时都要人照看的难缠的宝宝
ext.ext_en: ...a demanding baby who seems to want attention 24 hours a day.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is getting attention, they are being dealt with or cared for.

ext.ext_cn: 避免被当地人指指点点的唯一办法就是闭门不出。
ext.ext_en: The only way to escape the unwanted attentions of the local men was not to go out...

ext.ext_cn: 会议的举行避开了媒体的关注。
ext.ext_en: The meeting was held away from the attentions of the media...

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's efforts to help you, or the interest they show in you, as their attentions, especially if you dislike or disapprove of them.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们无法让群众一直关注此事，那将一事无成。
ext.ext_en: If we don't keep bringing this to the attention of the people, nothing will be done...

ext.ext_cn: 我们作总结时着重提到了辩论应该关注的一些问题。
ext.ext_en: We conclude by drawing attention to the issues around which the debate should focus.

defs.def_en: If you bring something to someone's attention or draw their attention to it, you tell them about it or make them notice it.

ext.ext_cn: 淡淡的咖啡香味一下子吸引了他。
ext.ext_en: A faint aroma of coffee attracted his attention...

ext.ext_cn: 他坐在其中一张圆桌旁边，想引起她的注意。
ext.ext_en: He sat at one of the round tables and tried to attract her attention.

defs.def_en: If someone or something attracts your attention or catches your attention, you suddenly notice them.

defs.def_cn: 关心/不关心；注意/不注意

ext.ext_cn: 食品工业比以往任何时候都更加关注年轻消费者。
ext.ext_en: More than ever before, the food industry is paying attention to young consumers...

ext.ext_cn: 入夜后还有人在沙滩上散步，起先我并没注意到。
ext.ext_en: Other people walk along the beach at night, so I didn't pay any attention at first...

defs.def_en: If you pay attention to someone, you watch them, listen to them, or take notice of them. If you pay no attention to someone, you behave as if you are not aware of them or as if they are not important.

ext.ext_cn: 全副武装的士兵们立正站着。
ext.ext_en: Soldiers in full combat gear stood at attention...

ext.ext_cn: 服务员笔直站立着，餐巾折叠着放在他们的手臂上。
ext.ext_en: The waiters stood to attention with napkins folded over their arms.

defs.def_en: When people stand to attention or stand at attention, they stand straight with their feet together and their arms at their sides.

ext.ext_cn: 他们围着老师的椅子站成半圆形回答问题。
ext.ext_en: They stood in a semi-circle round the teacher's chair and answered questions.

defs.def_en: A semi-circle is one half of a circle, or something having the shape of half a circle.

ext.ext_cn: 一件古董真品
ext.ext_en: ...a genuine antique.

ext.ext_cn: 古董银首饰
ext.ext_en: ...antique silver jewellery...

defs.def_en: An antique is an old object such as a piece of china or furniture which is valuable because of its beauty or rarity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 经济拮据的;穷困潦倒的

ext.ext_cn: 他 10 岁时父亲去世了，家里生活变得很拮据。
ext.ext_en: His father died when he was ten, leaving the family in straitened circumstances...

ext.ext_cn: 在如今经济不景气的情况下，有很多传言说要削减外交支出。
ext.ext_en: There is much talk of cuts in the diplomatic service in these straitened times.

defs.def_en: If someone is living in straitened circumstances, they do not have as much money as they used to, and are finding it very hard to buy or pay for everything that they need.
A portcullis is a strong gate above an entrance to a castle and used to be lowered to the ground in order to keep out enemies.

ext.ext_cn: 小杰克和养父母住在一起。
ext.ext_en: Little Jack was placed with foster parents...

ext.ext_cn: 寄养母是一个很不错的热心人。
ext.ext_en: The foster mother was a wonderful, warm person.

defs.def_en: Foster parents are people who officially take a child into their family for a period of time, without becoming the child's legal parents. The child is referred to as their foster child.

ext.ext_cn: 从那以后她代养了 100 多个孩子，并从中得到快乐。
ext.ext_en: She has since gone on to find happiness by fostering more than 100 children.

defs.def_en: If you foster a child, you take it into your family for a period of time, without becoming its legal parent.

ext.ext_cn: 他说，发达国家有责任促进全球经济增长，以帮助新兴民主国家。
ext.ext_en: He said that developed countries had a responsibility to foster global economic growth to help new democracies...

ext.ext_cn: 地产贬值引发了现金危机。
ext.ext_en: Its cash crisis has been fostered by declining property values.

defs.def_en: To foster something such as an activity or idea means to help it to develop.

ext.ext_cn: 这家工厂将会成为西方在东方投资的样板。
ext.ext_en: The factory was to be a showpiece of Western investment in the East...

ext.ext_cn: 温布利球场是该国最具代表性的体育场。
ext.ext_en: Wembley is the showpiece stadium in this country.

defs.def_en: A showpiece is something that is admired because it is the best thing of its type, especially something that is intended to be impressive.

ext.ext_cn: 军方领导层又解除了几个市镇的军事管制。
ext.ext_en: The military leadership have lifted martial law in several more towns.

defs.def_en: Martial law is control of an area by soldiers, not the police.

ext.ext_cn: 在警方讯问时保持沉默的权利
ext.ext_en: ...the right to silence in police interrogations.

ext.ext_cn: 审问期间虐待疑犯
ext.ext_en: ...ill-treatment of suspects during interrogation.

defs.def_en: An interrogation is the act of interrogating someone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们喜欢五星级的宾馆和毕恭毕敬的接待。
ext.ext_en: They like five-star hotels and deferential treatment.

ext.ext_cn: 亚洲妇女要对男人顺从和恭敬的传统要求
ext.ext_en: ...the traditional requirement for Asian women to be submissive and deferential to men.

defs.def_en: Someone who is deferential is polite and respectful towards someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 安东尼的怪笑让萨克利夫不知所措。
ext.ext_en: Antony's wry smile disconcerted Sutcliffe...

ext.ext_cn: 显然，英国的反应让这位大使很不安。
ext.ext_en: The ambassador was clearly disconcerted by the British reaction.

defs.def_en: If something disconcerts you, it makes you feel anxious, confused, or embarrassed.

defs.def_cn: 被草木覆盖的;有植被的

ext.ext_cn: 卡斯尔步行街那一地段的植被不是很厚密。
ext.ext_en: That part of Castle Walk is not thickly vegetated.

defs.def_en: If an area is vegetated, it is covered with plants and trees.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指儿童)有礼貌的，有涵养的，有教养的

ext.ext_cn: 他只是个有教养的中产阶级家庭的男孩。
ext.ext_en: He's just a well-brought-up, middle-class boy.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone, especially a child, is well-brought-up, you mean that they are very polite because they have been taught good manners.
An astrophysicist is someone who studies astrophysics.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 突如其来的;急剧的;引人注目的

ext.ext_cn: 第五年遭受旱灾预计会对加利福尼亚的经济产生巨大的影响。
ext.ext_en: A fifth year of drought is expected to have dramatic effects on the California economy...

ext.ext_cn: 这项政策已经让我们监狱的囚犯人数激增。
ext.ext_en: This policy has led to a dramatic increase in our prison populations.

defs.def_en: A dramatic change or event happens suddenly and is very noticeable and surprising.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 激动人心的;引人注目的;令人印象深刻的

ext.ext_cn: 他目睹了许多人从五层高的楼上跳下来逃生的惊险场面。
ext.ext_en: He witnessed many dramatic escapes as people jumped from as high as the fourth floor...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的到来令人激动不已，难以忘怀。
ext.ext_en: Their arrival was dramatic and exciting.

defs.def_en: A dramatic action, event, or situation is exciting and impressive.

defs.def_cn: 戏剧的;有关戏剧的;戏剧学的

ext.ext_cn: 大学里戏剧艺术专业的学生
ext.ext_en: ...a dramatic arts major in college...

ext.ext_cn: 我没想过要拍一部剧情片，我正在拍一部纪录片。
ext.ext_en: I had no thoughts of making a dramatic film. I was working in documentary.

defs.def_en: You use dramatic to describe things connected with or relating to the theatre, drama, or plays.
A review board is a group of people in authority who examine a situation or system to see if it should be improved, corrected, or changed.

defs.def_cn: 未被遏制的；未受到抑制的

ext.ext_cn: 如果不加以遏制，杂草就会疯长。
ext.ext_en: If left unchecked, weeds will flourish.

ext.ext_cn: 任由野蛮行径和不法行为横行无忌的世界
ext.ext_en: ...a world in which brutality and lawlessness are allowed to go unchecked...

defs.def_en: If something harmful or undesirable is left unchecked, nobody controls it or prevents it from growing or developing.

defs.def_cn: (火炉、锅炉或熔炉的)调节风门，风挡
defs.def_en: A damper is a small sheet of metal in a fire, boiler, or furnace that can be moved to increase or reduce the amount of air that enters.

defs.def_cn: (钢琴等乐器的)制音器，减音器
defs.def_en: A damper is a device in a piano or similar musical instrument which makes the sound less loud by restricting the movement of the strings.

ext.ext_cn: 寒冷的天气给我们的计划泼了冷水。
ext.ext_en: The cold weather put a damper on our plans...

ext.ext_cn: 那将会抑制美国钢铁出口未来的增长。
ext.ext_en: That would put a damper on the future growth of U.S. steel exports.

defs.def_en: To put a damper on something means to have an effect on it which stops it being as enjoyable or as successful as it should be.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 筹划不周的;计划欠周详的

ext.ext_cn: 一个考虑不周的关闭煤矿的计划
ext.ext_en: ...an ill-conceived plan to close the coal mine.

defs.def_en: If you describe a plan or action as ill-conceived, you mean that it is likely to fail or have bad consequences because it has not been thought about carefully enough.

defs.def_cn: 组织内部的;机构内部进行的

ext.ext_cn: 很多公司会进行内部培训。
ext.ext_en: A lot of companies do in-house training.

ext.ext_cn: 该杂志仍然是内部发行。
ext.ext_en: The magazine is still produced in-house.

defs.def_en: In-house work or activities are done by employees of an organization or company, rather than by workers outside the organization or company.
Cable television is a television system in which signals are sent along wires rather than by radio waves.
Showbiz is the same as show business .

ext.ext_cn: 他虽然经验不足，但还是获得了这份工作。
ext.ext_en: Despite his lack of experience, he got the job...

ext.ext_cn: 指控因证据不足而被撤销。
ext.ext_en: The charges were dropped for lack of  evidence...

defs.def_en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

ext.ext_cn: 它没有意大利轿车动力强劲。
ext.ext_en: It lacked the power of the Italian cars...

ext.ext_cn: 他欠缺做主席应具备的判断力和政治敏锐度。
ext.ext_en: He lacked the judgment and political acumen for the post of chairman...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something lacks a particular quality or that a particular quality is lacking in them, you mean that they do not have any or enough of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他说他们之间不缺谈资。
ext.ext_en: He said there was no lack of things for them to talk about...

ext.ext_cn: 克林顿总统开腔时颇有气势。
ext.ext_en: President Clinton displayed no lack of vigor when he began to speak.

defs.def_en: If you say there is no lack of something, you are emphasizing that there is a great deal of it.
