A costumer is the same as a costumier .

ext.ext_cn: 那是一种对战争既畏惧又期待的心理。
ext.ext_en: The mood is one of paranoia and expectation of war.

ext.ext_cn: 他看待周围世界时越来越重的疑惧心理
ext.ext_en: ...the mounting paranoia with which he viewed the world around him.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone suffers from paranoia, you think that they are too suspicious and afraid of other people.
In psychology, if someone suffers from paranoia, they wrongly believe that other people are trying to harm them, or believe themselves to be much more important than they really are.
In some societies, a family's totem is the particular animal, plant, or natural object which they regard as a special symbol and which they believe has spiritual significance.

ext.ext_cn: 这部歌剧是西方文明的文化标志物之一。
ext.ext_en: This opera is one of the cultural totems of Western civilisation.

defs.def_en: Something that is a totem of another thing is a symbol of it.

ext.ext_cn: 拴在链子上的看门狗狂躁地流着口水。
ext.ext_en: Mad guard dogs slavered at the end of their chains.

ext.ext_cn: 狼流着口水的嘴巴
ext.ext_en: ...the wolf's slavering jaws.

defs.def_en: If an animal slavers, liquid comes from its mouth, for example because it is about to attack and eat something.

ext.ext_cn: 我发现自己跳过了这些章节，尽管有许多读者无疑会为这些描写兴奋不已。
ext.ext_en: I found myself skipping these passages, though no doubt many readers will slaver over them.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is slavering, you mean that they are so excited by something that they cannot control themselves, and that you find this disgusting.

ext.ext_cn: 她觉得自己的所作所为是对帕特里克的背叛。
ext.ext_en: She felt that what she had done was a betrayal of Patrick...

ext.ext_cn: 他承认自己有被民权领袖出卖了的感觉。
ext.ext_en: He acknowledged the sense of betrayal by civil rights leaders.

defs.def_en: A betrayal is an action which betrays someone or something, or the fact of being betrayed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 把他们的车折价贴换成更小、更经济型车的计划
ext.ext_en: ...plans to trade in their car for something smaller and more economical...

ext.ext_cn: 满缸洗衣更经济。
ext.ext_en: It is more economical to wash a full load.

defs.def_en: Something that is economical does not require a lot of money to operate. For example a car that only uses a small amount of petrol is economical .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不浪费的;节俭的;节约的

ext.ext_cn: 勤俭持家的观念
ext.ext_en: ...ideas for economical housekeeping.

defs.def_en: Someone who is economical spends money sensibly and does not want to waste it on things that are unnecessary. A way of life that is economical does not need a lot of money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的肢体语言极尽简化，措词总体温和。
ext.ext_en: His gestures were economical, his words generally mild.

defs.def_en: Economical means using the minimum amount of time, effort, or language that is necessary.

ext.ext_cn: 如果及早发现，大多数皮肤癌都是完全可以治愈的。
ext.ext_en: Most skin cancers are completely curable if detected in the early stages.

defs.def_en: If a disease or illness is curable, it can be cured.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我刚来这儿的时候，住的公寓简直糟透了。
ext.ext_en: When I first came here, I had a crummy flat.

ext.ext_cn: 那座房子太破旧，都开始坍塌了。
ext.ext_en: The house is so old and crummy it's falling apart.

defs.def_en: Something that is crummy is unpleasant, of very poor quality, or not good enough.
A wallet is a small flat folded case, usually made of leather or plastic, in which you can keep banknotes and credit cards.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定句中表示某事尚未发生但有可能发生，在疑问句中用来询问某事是否已发生。英国英语中，表示此义时通常不与一般过去时连用）尚（未），还，仍

ext.ext_cn: 他们还没有完成。
ext.ext_en: They haven't finished yet...

ext.ext_cn: 尚未作出决定。
ext.ext_en: No decision has yet been made...

defs.def_en: You use yet in negative statements to indicate that something has not happened up to the present time, although it probably will happen. You can also use yet in questions to ask if something has happened up to the present time. In British English the simple past tense is not normally used with this meaning of 'yet'.

defs.def_cn: （与谈论过去的否定句连用，表示当时并非如此）还，尚（未）

ext.ext_cn: 还有很多是萨姆当时不知道的。
ext.ext_en: There was so much that Sam didn't know yet...

ext.ext_cn: 他四处询问，得知比利还没到这儿。
ext.ext_en: He had asked around and learned that Billy was not yet here.

defs.def_en: You use yet with a negative statement when you are talking about the past, to report something that was not the case then, although it became the case later.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定句，表示某事以后会做但现在不该或不能做）还，尚

ext.ext_cn: 先不要起床。
ext.ext_en: Don't get up yet...

ext.ext_cn: 人质目前还不能回家。
ext.ext_en: The hostages cannot go home just yet...

defs.def_en: If you say that something should not or cannot be done yet, you mean that it should not or cannot be done now, although it will have to be done at a later time.

defs.def_cn: （用于最高级后，表示到目前为止最差或最好）迄今为止，到目前为止

ext.ext_cn: 这是到目前为止英国广播公司的最糟糕的点子。
ext.ext_en: This is the BBC's worst idea yet...

ext.ext_cn: 她的最新小说是她迄今为止最好的一部。
ext.ext_en: Her latest novel is her best yet.

defs.def_en: You use yet after a superlative to indicate, for example, that something is the worst or the best of its kind up to the present time.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示仍有可能）还是，仍然

ext.ext_cn: 就像最精彩的故事那样，这个故事也许仍会有个美好的结局。
ext.ext_en: Like the best stories, this one  may yet have a happy end...

ext.ext_cn: 也许仍有可能通过磋商达成协议。
ext.ext_en: A negotiated settlement might yet be possible.

defs.def_en: You can use yet to say that there is still a possibility that something will happen.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示一段时间的表达后，表示时间的延续）还要，还

ext.ext_cn: 失业人数在一段时间内还将上升。
ext.ext_en: Unemployment will go on rising for some time yet...

ext.ext_cn: 几年内还不会有什么事发生。
ext.ext_en: Nothing will happen for a few years yet...

defs.def_en: You can use yet after expressions which refer to a period of time, when you want to say how much longer a situation will continue for.

defs.def_cn: （表示从未做过某事，尤指惊人的事或坏事）还未，尚未

ext.ext_cn: 她还从没和她的丈夫一起过过圣诞节。
ext.ext_en: She has yet to spend a Christmas with her husband...

ext.ext_cn: 他已经3次获奥斯卡提名，但从未获奖。
ext.ext_en: He has been nominated three times for the Oscar but has yet to win.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have yet to do something, you mean that you have never done it, especially when this is surprising or bad.

defs.def_cn: （用于引出颇令人惊讶的事实）可是却，却又

ext.ext_cn: 我吃得并不多，但是却穿16码的衣服。
ext.ext_en: I don't eat much, yet I am a size 16...

ext.ext_cn: 他们很害怕詹姆斯会死——然而，有那么几个瞬间，他们几乎是希望他会死。
ext.ext_en: They were terrified James would die — yet there were moments when they almost wished he would...

defs.def_en: You can use yet to introduce a fact which is rather surprising after the previous fact you have just mentioned.

defs.def_cn: （用于强调，尤指相对于以前同类事物更为极端等）还要，甚至，更

ext.ext_cn: 更为大型的卫星将被送入轨道。
ext.ext_en: Yet bigger satellites will be sent up into orbit...

ext.ext_cn: 我又看了一个医生。
ext.ext_en: I saw yet another doctor...

defs.def_en: You can use yet to emphasize a word, especially when you are saying that something is surprising because it is more extreme than previous things of its kind, or a further case of them.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定句）迄今为止，目前为止

ext.ext_cn: 目前尚不清楚撞车是否是由事故引起的。
ext.ext_en: As yet it is not known whether the crash was the result of an accident...

ext.ext_cn: 我们还未收到回复。
ext.ext_en: We have not as yet received a response.

defs.def_en: You use as yet with negative statements to describe a situation that has existed up until the present time.

ext.ext_cn: 飞机开始在跑道上滑行。
ext.ext_en: The plane started taxiing down the runway.

defs.def_en: At an airport, the runway is the long strip of ground with a hard surface which an aeroplane takes off from or lands on.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 慈祥的;照顾年轻人的;有长者风范的

ext.ext_cn: 他开始讲话了，态度极其和蔼而慈祥。
ext.ext_en: He began to talk in his most gentle and avuncular manner.

defs.def_en: An avuncular man or a man with avuncular behaviour is friendly and helpful towards someone younger.

ext.ext_cn: 瘾君子不切实际的自我欺骗
ext.ext_en: ...the grandiose self-delusion of the addict.

defs.def_en: Self-delusion is the state of having a false idea about yourself or the situation you are in.

defs.def_cn: 聪明机灵（但有点儿荒唐）的人

ext.ext_cn: “为什么不把网吧的一个电子邮件地址公布出去呢？”某个聪明人建议道。
ext.ext_en: 'Why not give out one of the cybercafe's e-mail addresses?' suggested one bright spark...

ext.ext_cn: 某个聪明过头的家伙昨晚把暖气关了。
ext.ext_en: Some bright spark turned the heating off last night!

defs.def_en: If you say that some bright spark had a particular idea or did something, you mean that their idea or action was clever, or that it seemed clever but was silly in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 潜水员向海岸走去时，铅坠和氧气罐使他们步履维艰。
ext.ext_en: Lead weights and air cylinders encumbered the divers as they walked to the shore...

ext.ext_cn: 它现在仍旧被20世纪80年代就深受其累的债务压得喘不过气。
ext.ext_en: It is still labouring under the debt burden that it was encumbered with in the 1980s.

defs.def_en: If you are encumbered by something, it prevents you from moving freely or doing what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 狭窄的码头被数百辆手推车堵得水泄不通。
ext.ext_en: The narrow quay was encumbered by hundreds of carts.

defs.def_en: If a place is encumbered with things, it contains so many of them that it is difficult to move freely there.
A duvet is a large cover filled with feathers or similar material which you put over yourself in bed instead of a sheet and blankets.

defs.def_cn: 芳香理疗师;香薰理疗师
defs.def_en: An aromatherapist is a person who is qualified to practise aromatherapy.

ext.ext_cn: 墙上被人用喷漆涂得乱七八糟。
ext.ext_en: The walls have been horribly vandalized with spray paint.

defs.def_en: Spray paint is paint bought in a special can which you spray on a surface by pressing a button on the top of the can.

ext.ext_cn: 教授年轻人如何给汽车喷漆和修理护栏。
ext.ext_en: The youths are taught how to spray paint cars and mend fences...

ext.ext_cn: 他把自己的名字用喷漆喷在了墙上。
ext.ext_en: He spray-painted his name on the wall.

defs.def_en: If you spray paint a surface, you paint it using spray paint. If you spray paint something on a surface, you paint it on that surface using spray paint.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的那所尽管装饰精致、但并不及达拉斯其他大亨的私宅那样奢华的房子
ext.ext_en: ...his house, which, however elaborate, is less ostentatious than the preserves of other Dallas tycoons.

ext.ext_cn: 豪华铺张的婚宴
ext.ext_en: ...an ostentatious wedding reception.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ostentatious, you disapprove of it because it is expensive and is intended to impress people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他显然很有钱，但出手大方却不炫富。
ext.ext_en: Obviously he had plenty of money and was generous in its use without being ostentatious...

ext.ext_cn: 她的语言优美，丝毫无装腔作势之感。
ext.ext_en: She's got a lovely way with language without ever sounding ostentatious.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as ostentatious, you disapprove of them because they want to impress people with their wealth or importance.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （动作或行为）招摇的，显眼的，引人注目的

ext.ext_cn: 他的妻子几乎没有怎么开口，不过她本来就不是好出风头的人。
ext.ext_en: His wife was fairly quiet but she is not an ostentatious person anyway.

defs.def_en: You can describe an action or behaviour as ostentatious when it is done in an exaggerated way to attract people's attention.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿要是渴了，就会吃得更频繁。
ext.ext_en: If a baby is thirsty, it feeds more often...

ext.ext_cn: 运动过程中渴了就喝点水。
ext.ext_en: Drink whenever you feel thirsty during exercise.

defs.def_en: If you are thirsty, you feel a need to drink something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 人们应该理解他们复仇的愿望是多么强烈。
ext.ext_en: People should understand how thirsty for revenge they are.

defs.def_en: If you are thirsty for something, you have a strong desire for it.

ext.ext_cn: 上小学三年级的八九岁的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...eight-to-nine-year-olds in their third year at primary school...

ext.ext_cn: 格林赛德小学
ext.ext_en: Greenside Primary School.

defs.def_en: A primary school is a school for children between the ages of 5 and 11.

ext.ext_cn: 我以每年450英镑的租金租了一所房子。
ext.ext_en: I went into a leasehold property at four hundred and fifty pounds rent per year.

defs.def_en: If a building or land is described as leasehold, it is allowed to be used in return for payment according to the terms of a lease.

defs.def_cn: （按租约使用房屋或土地的）租赁权
defs.def_en: If you have the leasehold of a building or piece of land, you have the legal right to use it for a period of time as arranged according to a lease.

ext.ext_cn: 丹巴尔先生对他的回答感到满意。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Dambar was gratified by his response.

defs.def_en: If you are gratified by something, it gives you pleasure or satisfaction.

ext.ext_cn: 我们满足了朋友的好奇心。
ext.ext_en: We gratified our friend's curiosity...

ext.ext_cn: 每一个突发的念头都会得到满足。
ext.ext_en: Every whim will be gratified.

defs.def_en: If you gratify your own or another person's desire, you do what is necessary to please yourself or them.

defs.def_cn: （通常指针对个人或政府的）密谋者，阴谋分子

ext.ext_cn: 政变谋划者试图夺取莫斯科的政权。
ext.ext_en: Coup plotters tried to seize power in Moscow.

defs.def_en: A plotter is a person who secretly plans with others to do something that is illegal or wrong, usually against a person or government.
A plotter is a person or instrument that marks the position of something such as a ship on a map or chart.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （社会、制度等）组织有序的，结构井然的

ext.ext_cn: 任何井然有序的社会都需要一套客观公正、为大家所接受的规则。
ext.ext_en: An objective set of rules which we all agree to accept is necessary for any ordered society.

defs.def_en: An ordered society or system is well-organized and has a clear structure.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 兴高采烈的;得意洋洋的

ext.ext_cn: 第二次心脏搭桥手术成功了，我很高兴。
ext.ext_en: I was elated that my second heart bypass had been successful...

ext.ext_cn: “那是我一生中表现最好的比赛之一，”哈基宁兴高采烈地说。
ext.ext_en: 'That was one of the best races of my life,' said an elated Hakkinen.

defs.def_en: If you are elated, you are extremely happy and excited because of something that has happened.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 超自然的;神奇的;不可思议的

ext.ext_cn: 纳卡尼是邪恶的魔鬼，长得像人类但具有超能力。
ext.ext_en: The Nakani were evil spirits who looked like humans and possessed supernatural powers.

ext.ext_cn: 超自然生物
ext.ext_en: ...supernatural beings.

defs.def_en: Supernatural creatures, forces, and events are believed by some people to exist or happen, although they are impossible according to scientific laws.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得想吐。
ext.ext_en: I was overcome with a feeling of nausea.

defs.def_en: Nausea is the condition of feeling sick and the feeling that you are going to vomit.

defs.def_cn: （政治家言论）与所属党派政策不一致的，偏离既定政策的
defs.def_en: If a politician is off-message, they say something that does not follow the official policy of their party.

ext.ext_cn: 关于这一暴动的报道暴露出监狱系统已经达到了承受极限。
ext.ext_en: The report on the riot exposed a prison system stretched to breaking point...

ext.ext_cn: 这附近的家庭已经忍无可忍了。从10月以来他们就一直只领一半的薪水。
ext.ext_en: Families round here are at breaking point. They have been on half wages since October...

defs.def_en: If something or someone has reached breaking point, they have so many problems or difficulties that they can no longer cope with them, and may soon collapse or be unable to continue.

defs.def_cn: 中号的;中型的;中等大小的

ext.ext_cn: 中号炖锅
ext.ext_en: ...a medium-sized saucepan.

ext.ext_cn: 中等规模的会计事务所
ext.ext_en: ...medium-sized accountancy firms.

defs.def_en: Medium-sized means neither large nor small, but approximately half way between the two.

ext.ext_cn: 食物一流。
ext.ext_en: The food was first-class...

ext.ext_cn: 她头脑相当灵光，是个非常棒的作家。
ext.ext_en: She has a first-class brain and is a damned good writer.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as first-class, you mean that they are extremely good and of the highest quality.

ext.ext_cn: 他昨天正式宣布退出甲级板球赛。
ext.ext_en: He officially announced his retirement from first-class cricket yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 哈丽雅特毕业时获文学一级学士学位。
ext.ext_en: Harriet graduated with a first class degree in literature...

defs.def_en: You use first-class to describe something that is in the group that is considered to be of the highest standard.

defs.def_cn: (车厢、船舱、机舱)头等的，一等的

ext.ext_cn: 头等车厢
ext.ext_en: ...a first-class carriage...

ext.ext_cn: 他为自己赢得了两张飞往都柏林的头等舱机票。
ext.ext_en: He won himself two first-class tickets to fly to Dublin.

defs.def_en: First-class accommodation on a train, aeroplane, or ship is the best and most expensive type of accommodation.

defs.def_cn: (英)优先投递的，第一类的;(美)第一类邮件的(适用于信函和明信片)

ext.ext_cn: 买两张第一类邮件邮票。
ext.ext_en: Two first class stamps, please...

ext.ext_cn: 今年一类邮件的邮费不会增加。
ext.ext_en: The price of mailing a first-class letter will not be increasing this year.

defs.def_en: In Britain, first-class postage is the quicker and more expensive type of postage. In the United States, first-class postage is the type of postage that is used for sending letters and postcards.

ext.ext_cn: 她给我画了张像。
ext.ext_en: She did a drawing of me.

defs.def_en: See also:draw;A drawing is a picture made with a pencil or pen.

defs.def_cn: 前夕;前一天；前一段时间

ext.ext_cn: 在他27岁生日前一天
ext.ext_en: ...on the eve of his 27th birthday.

defs.def_en: See also:Christmas Eve;New Year's Eve;The eve of a particular event or occasion is the day before it, or the period of time just before it.

defs.def_cn: 马上结束，赶紧做完（不愉快的事情）

ext.ext_cn: 动手越早，我们就会越早了结这事儿。
ext.ext_en: The sooner we start, the sooner we'll get it over with.

defs.def_en: If you want to get something unpleasant over with, you want to do it or finish experiencing it quickly, since you cannot avoid it.

defs.def_cn: 你们，汝等，尔辈（you的过时用法，诗歌或宗教用语）

ext.ext_cn: 汝等进入此地，须弃绝希望。
ext.ext_en: Abandon hope all ye who enter here.

defs.def_en: Ye is an old-fashioned, poetic, or religious word for you when you are talking to more than one person.

ext.ext_cn: 老茶庄
ext.ext_en: ...Ye Olde Tea Shoppe.

defs.def_en: Ye is sometimes used in imitation of an old written form of the word 'the'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 模棱两可的;含糊其词的

ext.ext_cn: 很多人对这一观点都含糊其词。
ext.ext_en: Many were equivocal about the idea...

ext.ext_cn: 他模棱两可的回应丝毫没有消除人们的猜疑。
ext.ext_en: His equivocal response has done nothing to dampen the speculation.

defs.def_en: If you are equivocal, you are deliberately vague in what you say, because you want to avoid speaking the truth or making a decision.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （常因自相矛盾而）难以理解的，难以解释的

ext.ext_cn: 这个领域的研究有点难以理解。
ext.ext_en: Research in this area is somewhat equivocal...

ext.ext_cn: 意识到自己的立场本身难以解释清楚，他备受折磨。
ext.ext_en: He was tortured by an awareness of the equivocal nature of his position.

defs.def_en: If something is equivocal, it is difficult to understand, interpret, or explain, often because it has aspects that seem to contradict each other.

defs.def_cn: 无人居住的；杳无人迹的

ext.ext_cn: 北太平洋上一个无人居住的岛
ext.ext_en: ...an uninhabited island in the North Pacific...

ext.ext_cn: 这个地区的大部分荒无人烟。
ext.ext_en: The area is largely uninhabited.

defs.def_en: An uninhabited place is one where nobody lives.

defs.def_cn: 毁谤;诋毁;侮辱性的言辞

ext.ext_cn: 这是对伦敦市警察局刚正廉明作风的又一次诽谤。
ext.ext_en: This is yet another slur on the integrity of the Metropolitan Police.

ext.ext_cn: 种族毁谤的言论
ext.ext_en: ...racial slurs.

defs.def_en: A slur is an insulting remark which could damage someone's reputation.

defs.def_cn: (由于醉酒、生病或困倦等)含糊不清地说，大着舌头说

ext.ext_cn: 他重复了一遍，说得更含糊了。
ext.ext_en: He repeated himself and slurred his words more than usual...

ext.ext_cn: 新闻广播员的话音变得含糊不清起来。
ext.ext_en: The newscaster's speech began to slur...

defs.def_en: If someone slurs their speech or if their speech slurs, they do not pronounce each word clearly, because they are drunk, ill, or sleepy.

defs.def_cn: （一种语言的）全部字母，字母表

ext.ext_cn: 现代俄语字母表有31个字母。
ext.ext_en: The modern Russian alphabet has 31 letters...

ext.ext_cn: 两岁半时他已认识全部字母。
ext.ext_en: By two and a half he knew the alphabet.

defs.def_en: An alphabet is a set of letters usually presented in a fixed order which is used for writing the words of a particular language or group of languages.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他看到了敌人冷酷的眼神。
ext.ext_en: He saw the pitiless eyes of his enemy...

ext.ext_cn: 他判决立下，毫不留情。
ext.ext_en: His judgments are immediate, pitiless.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is pitiless shows no pity or kindness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·斯坦贝克把尘土和烈日炙烤的天空用作小说的背景。
ext.ext_en: John Steinbeck used the dust and the pitiless skies as the backcloth to his novel.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as the weather or the heat as pitiless, you mean that it is very extreme.

ext.ext_cn: 一出有关一个男人试图教化一个女人，结果反而被那个女人教化的喜剧
ext.ext_en: ...a comedy about a man who tries to civilise a woman—but she ends up civilising him...

ext.ext_cn: 这产生了教化人类的影响。
ext.ext_en: It exerts a civilizing influence on mankind.

defs.def_en: To civilize a person or society means to educate them and improve their way of life.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不愿意的；不情愿的；不乐意的

ext.ext_cn: 最初政府不愿意承认失败。
ext.ext_en: Initially the government was unwilling to accept the defeat...

ext.ext_cn: 数月来，我一直不是不愿意就是没办法做这件事。
ext.ext_en: For months I had been either unwilling or unable to go through with it.

defs.def_en: If you are unwilling to do something, you do not want to do it and will not agree to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名年轻教师，他发现自己并不情愿地参与到了学校的权力争斗中。
ext.ext_en: A youthful teacher, he finds himself an unwilling participant in school politics...

ext.ext_cn: 她成为情势的牺牲品绝对不是自己愿意的。
ext.ext_en: She was certainly an unwilling victim of circumstances.

defs.def_en: You can use unwilling to describe someone who does not really want to do the thing they are doing.
A pooch is a dog.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 凹陷的腹部
ext.ext_en: ...a concave stomach.

ext.ext_cn: 空喷发胶罐凹进去的罐底
ext.ext_en: ...the concave bottom of an empty hair spray container.

defs.def_en: A surface that is concave curves inwards in the middle.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我坚信一切终究都会好起来。
ext.ext_en: I am confident that everything will come out right in time...

ext.ext_cn: 瑞安先生坚信一定会成功。
ext.ext_en: Mr Ryan is confident of success...

defs.def_en: If you are confident about something, you are certain that it will happen in the way you want it to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 过了一段时间，他变得更加自信、更为放松。
ext.ext_en: In time he became more confident and relaxed...

ext.ext_cn: 她是一位充满自信的女性，对自己的观点深信不疑。
ext.ext_en: She is a confident woman who is certain of her views.

defs.def_en: If a person or their manner is confident, they feel sure about their own abilities, qualities, or ideas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她确信所有人都站在她这边。
ext.ext_en: She is confident that everybody is on her side...

ext.ext_cn: “我肯定行。”传来一个很有把握的回答。
ext.ext_en: 'Bet you I can', comes the confident reply.

defs.def_en: If you are confident that something is true, you are sure that it is true. A confident statement is one that the speaker is sure is true.

ext.ext_cn: 7 万吨油从油轮中溢了出来。
ext.ext_en: 70,000 tonnes of oil spilled from the tanker...

ext.ext_cn: 大坝里的水随时都会溢出来
ext.ext_en: ...water behind a dam, getting ready to spill over...

defs.def_en: If a liquid spills or if you spill it, it accidentally flows over the edge of a container.

ext.ext_cn: 她把洒出来的奶昔从柜台上擦掉。
ext.ext_en: She wiped a spill of milkshake off the counter...

ext.ext_cn: 溢出的油对野生动物来说可能是毁灭性的。
ext.ext_en: An oil spill could be devastating for wildlife.

defs.def_en: A spill is an amount of liquid that has spilled from a container.

defs.def_cn: (使)(袋子、盒子等中盛放的东西)洒出，涌出

ext.ext_cn: 有几只袋子裂开了，里面的东西撒了出来。
ext.ext_en: A number of bags had split and were spilling their contents...

ext.ext_cn: 他仔细地把小背包放好，不让里面的东西掉到地板上。
ext.ext_en: He carefully balanced the satchel so that its contents would not spill out onto the floor.

defs.def_en: If the contents of a bag, box, or other container spill or are spilled, they come out of the container onto a surface.

ext.ext_cn: 男孩的眼泪开始夺眶而出。
ext.ext_en: Tears began to spill out of the boy's  eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 当铃声响起时，1,000 多名孩子从教室里涌了出来。
ext.ext_en: When the bell rings, more than 1,000 children spill from classrooms.

defs.def_en: If people or things spill out of a place, they come out of it in large numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 她注意到布莱恩门底下透出的光。
ext.ext_en: She noticed the light spilling under Brian's  door...

ext.ext_cn: 门再次打开了，光照亮了小屋。
ext.ext_en: The door swung open again, spilling light into the cell.

defs.def_en: If light spills or is spilled into a place, it shines brightly into it, usually through a gap.

ext.ext_cn: 他准备杀掉100万人。
ext.ext_en: He is prepared to spill the blood of a million people...

ext.ext_cn: 如果出现伤亡，这些国家就会进入交战状态。
ext.ext_en: If blood is spilled the countries will be at war.

defs.def_en: If you spill someone's blood, you kill them or wound them.

defs.def_cn: 用类似饰钉物装饰的;带饰钉的

ext.ext_cn: 镶有饰钉的皮夹克
ext.ext_en: ...studded leather jackets.

ext.ext_cn: 漂亮的镶钻金手镯
ext.ext_en: ...a beautiful gold bracelet studded with diamonds.

defs.def_en: Something that is studded is decorated with studs or things that look like studs.

ext.ext_cn: 他的收藏里有许多佛兰芒人的杰作。
ext.ext_en: His collection was studded with Flemish masterpieces.

ext.ext_cn: 装有很多小扩音器的金属嵌板
ext.ext_en: ...a metal panel studded with small microphones.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is studded with another thing, you mean that there are a lot of the second thing in or on the first thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我们已经聘请了马德琳·贝尔等歌手担任主唱，我认为俱乐部马上就会有起色了。
ext.ext_en: We have introduced singers like Madeline Bell as headliners and I think the club is beginning to take off.

defs.def_en: A headliner is the main performer or group of performers in a show.

defs.def_cn: 荒废的;无人看管的;被遗忘的

ext.ext_cn: 里奥格兰德河三角洲曾是一片遍布荆棘和沼泽的荒废之地。
ext.ext_en: The delta region of the Rio Grande river was a forsaken land of thickets and swamps.

ext.ext_cn: 废弃的教堂和无人居住的旅馆
ext.ext_en: ...a forsaken church and a derelict hotel.

defs.def_en: See also:godforsaken;A forsaken place is not lived in, used, or looked after.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 旅途就此结束了，这让我有点坐立不安，我想是吧。
ext.ext_en: This is the end of a tour so I'm a little antsy, I guess.

defs.def_en: If someone is antsy, they are nervous or impatient.

defs.def_cn: 联合王国国旗；英国国旗
defs.def_en: The Union Jack is the national flag of the United Kingdom. It consists of a blue background with red and white crosses on it.
Tweezers are a small tool that you use for tasks such as picking up small objects or pulling out hairs. Tweezers consist of two strips of metal or plastic joined together at one end.

defs.def_cn: 重新定义;重新界定;重新思考

ext.ext_cn: 关于知识分子作用的重新界定
ext.ext_en: ...the redefinition of the role of the intellectual.

defs.def_en: The redefinition of something is the act or process of causing people to consider it in a new way.
When there is a fire drill in a particular building, the people who work or live there practise what to do if there is a fire.
The innards of a person or animal are the organs inside their body.
A machine's innards are the parts inside it.

ext.ext_cn: 她在东京长大。
ext.ext_en: She grew up in Tokyo.

defs.def_en: See also:grown-up;When someone grows up, they gradually change from being a child into being an adult.

ext.ext_cn: 你该懂事了。
ext.ext_en: It's time you grew up.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to grow up, you are telling them to stop behaving in a silly or childish way.

ext.ext_cn: 各种重工业沿着港口逐渐发展起来。
ext.ext_en: A variety of heavy industries grew up alongside the port.

defs.def_en: If something grows up, it starts to exist and then becomes larger or more important.

ext.ext_cn: 这架飞机已经超期服役很长时间了。
ext.ext_en: The plane has been kept in service far longer than originally intended...

ext.ext_cn: 最初法国拒绝签署该条约。
ext.ext_en: France originally refused to sign the treaty...

defs.def_en: When you say what happened or was the case originally, you are saying what happened or was the case when something began or came into existence, often to contrast it with what happened later.

ext.ext_cn: 飞机驾驶员受了重伤，副驾驶员于是代替其驾驶。
ext.ext_en: The pilot was seriously injured and the co-pilot took over.

defs.def_en: The co-pilot of an aircraft is a pilot who assists the chief pilot.
An escarpment is a wide, steep slope on a hill or mountain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我想我并不嫉妒你的成功。
ext.ext_en: I don't think I'm envious of your success...

ext.ext_cn: 我听起来是嫉妒吗？实际上我是可怜他们。
ext.ext_en: Do I sound envious? I pity them, actually.

defs.def_en: If you are envious of someone, you want something that they have.

defs.def_cn: (内容轻松、以女性为目标群体的)浪漫电影

ext.ext_cn: 我老婆喜欢看轻松的爱情喜剧，我不喜欢。我可没办法坐上两个小时看这种女人的东西。
ext.ext_en: My wife likes chick flicks, I don't. I can't sit through two hours of women's stuff.

defs.def_en: A chick flick is a romantic film that is not very serious and is intended to appeal to women.

ext.ext_cn: 我讨厌被人当作伤病号对待。
ext.ext_en: I hate being treated as an invalid.

defs.def_en: An invalid is someone who needs to be cared for because they have an illness or disability.

ext.ext_cn: 审判被中止,判决结果被宣布无效。
ext.ext_en: The trial was stopped and the results declared invalid...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你因证件无效被拒入内,我们不承担责任。
ext.ext_en: We cannot accept liability if you are refused entry because of invalid documents.

defs.def_en: If an action, procedure, or document is invalid, it cannot be accepted, because it breaks the law or some official rule.

defs.def_cn: (论据、结论)站不住脚的,错误的

ext.ext_cn: 我们认为那些论点当场即被确凿的事实驳倒了。
ext.ext_en: We think that those arguments are rendered invalid by the hard facts on the ground.

defs.def_en: An invalid argument or conclusion is wrong because it is based on a mistake.

defs.def_cn: （体育比赛中）追平比分的得分
defs.def_en: In sports such as football, an equalizer is a goal or a point that makes the scores of the two teams equal.

ext.ext_cn: 一颗脉动的恒星
ext.ext_en: ...a star that pulsates.

ext.ext_cn: 搏动着的血管
ext.ext_en: ...a pulsating blood vessel.

defs.def_en: If something pulsates, it beats, moves in and out, or shakes with strong, regular movements.

defs.def_cn: 乱扒;乱摸;(尤指在看不见时)摸索着寻找

ext.ext_cn: 他抓起夹克，然后在书桌的抽屉里乱翻了一些零钱。
ext.ext_en: He grabbed his jacket and scrabbled in his desk drawer for some loose change...

ext.ext_cn: 我吊在那儿，两脚乱蹬着寻找落脚点。
ext.ext_en: I hung there, scrabbling with my feet to find a foothold.

defs.def_en: If you scrabble for something, especially something that you cannot see, you move your hands or your feet about quickly and hurriedly in order to find it.

ext.ext_cn: 那些银行正在拼命急于收回成本。
ext.ext_en: The banks are now desperately scrabbling to recover their costs...

ext.ext_cn: 机会已经失去。他苦苦思索别的方案。
ext.ext_en: The opportunity had gone. His mind scrabbled for alternatives.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is scrabbling to do something, you mean that they are having difficulty because they are in too much of a hurry, or because the task is almost impossible.

ext.ext_cn: 他们寻求缓和两国关系的政策的愿望
ext.ext_en: ...their desire to pursue a policy of detente...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经迈出缓和两国关系的第一步。
ext.ext_en: They have made the first move towards a detente.

defs.def_en: Detente is a state of friendly relations between two countries when previously there had been problems between them.

ext.ext_cn: 在过去的5天中，该港口一直受到德国俯冲轰炸机的攻击。
ext.ext_en: The port had been attacked by German dive bombers for the past five days.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a plane that flies down low over a place in order to drop bombs on it as a dive bomber .
A surrogate mother is a woman who has agreed to give birth to a baby on behalf of another woman.

defs.def_cn: 米尤扎克(商店或餐馆播放的背景音乐)
defs.def_en: Muzak is recorded music that is played as background music in shops or restaurants.

defs.def_cn: 让人提不起兴趣的音乐
defs.def_en: If you describe music as muzak, you dislike it because you think it is dull or unnecessary.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 非正义的；不公正的；不公平的

ext.ext_cn: 对查尔斯的攻击甚为不公。
ext.ext_en: The attack on Charles was deeply unjust...

ext.ext_cn: 他用了25年的时间与带有种族歧视色彩和没有公正可言的移民法作斗争。
ext.ext_en: He spent 25 years campaigning against racist and unjust immigration laws.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action, system, or law as unjust, you think that it treats a person or group badly in a way that they do not deserve.

ext.ext_cn: 这使得很多美国人断定商业道德是个自相矛盾的说法。
ext.ext_en: This has made many Americans conclude that business ethics is an oxymoron.

defs.def_en: If you describe a phrase as an oxymoron, you mean that what it refers to combines two opposite qualities or ideas and therefore seems impossible.
A butler is the most important male servant in a wealthy house.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 特里西一直不说话，因为她不愿意吐露内心的想法。
ext.ext_en: Trish was silent because she was reluctant to put her thoughts into words...

ext.ext_cn: 他不会说英语，参观过程中一言未发。
ext.ext_en: He spoke no English and was completely silent during the visit...

defs.def_en: Someone who is silent is not speaking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 寡言少语的;很少说话的;不爱说话的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个一本正经、寡言少语的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a serious, silent man.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a silent person, you mean that they do not talk to people very much, and sometimes give the impression of being unfriendly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无声的;寂静的;不出声的

ext.ext_cn: 屋子里一片寂静，只有约翰发出的咀嚼声。
ext.ext_en: The room was silent except for John's crunching...

ext.ext_cn: 重型枪炮的声音又一次安静了下来。
ext.ext_en: The heavy guns have again fallen silent.

defs.def_en: A place that is silent is completely quiet, with no sound at all. Something that is silent makes no sound at all.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 道格拉斯明显不愿提及自己对父亲的感情。
ext.ext_en: Douglas was noticeably silent about his feelings for his father...

ext.ext_cn: 最近政府对发生在海地的虐待事件绝口不提。
ext.ext_en: The administration has recently become silent about abuses in Haiti.

defs.def_en: If someone is silent about something, they do not tell people anything about it, because they think it is a private matter or because they want to keep the information secret.

defs.def_cn: (情感、行为等)无声的，不用言语表达的

ext.ext_cn: 袭击者还站在那里，用一种鄙夷的眼神一言不发地看着她。
ext.ext_en: The attacker still stood there, watching her with silent contempt...

ext.ext_cn: 她默默祈祷以表谢意。
ext.ext_en: She offered a silent prayer of thanks.

defs.def_en: A silent emotion or action is not expressed in speech.

ext.ext_cn: 查理·卓别林著名的默片之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the famous silent films of Charlie Chaplin.

ext.ext_cn: 默片时代的喜剧明星们
ext.ext_en: ...comedy stars of the silent era.

defs.def_en: A silent film has pictures usually accompanied by music but does not have the actors' voices or any other sounds.
A silent letter in a word is written but not pronounced. For example, the 'k' in the word 'know' is silent.

defs.def_cn: 攫取(精华部分);捞取（钱财）

ext.ext_cn: 他被控从经济中捞取了丰厚的油水。
ext.ext_en: He has been accused of skimming the cream off the economy...

ext.ext_cn: 像 AC 米兰这样财大气粗的意大利足球俱乐部也不可能把欧洲所有的明星球员统统招到自己门下。
ext.ext_en: Rich Italian clubs such as AC Milan cannot simply skim off all of Europe's stars...

defs.def_en: If someone skims off the best part of something, or money which belongs to other people, they take it for themselves.

defs.def_cn: 后工业化的（指很多不再以重工业为基础的西方社会）
defs.def_en: Post-industrial is used to describe many Western societies whose economies are no longer based on heavy industry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不寻常的；非常规的；非正统的

ext.ext_cn: 她非常喜欢那些稀奇古怪的老古董。
ext.ext_en: She adores old, offbeat antiques.

ext.ext_cn: 绝妙另类的想象力
ext.ext_en: ...a wickedly offbeat imagination.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as offbeat, you think that they are different from normal.

defs.def_cn: 改变（说法、决定等）；出尔反尔

ext.ext_cn: 委员会改变主意，放弃了有争议的奖金制度。
ext.ext_en: The committee backtracked by scrapping the controversial bonus system...

ext.ext_cn: 财政部长收回了他的决定。
ext.ext_en: The finance minister backtracked on his decision.

defs.def_en: If you backtrack on a statement or decision you have made, you do or say something that shows that you no longer agree with it or support it.

ext.ext_cn: 伦纳德跳进车里，开始原路折返。
ext.ext_en: Leonard jumped in his car and started backtracking...

ext.ext_cn: 我们不得不原路返回到拐角处过街。
ext.ext_en: We had to backtrack to the corner and cross the street.

defs.def_en: If you backtrack, you go back along a path or route you have just used.

ext.ext_cn: 我们能不能回过头来谈谈你的小学和中学教育？
ext.ext_en: Can we just backtrack a little bit and look at your primary and secondary education?

defs.def_en: If you backtrack in an account or explanation, you talk about things which happened before the ones you were previously talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 祭坛
ext.ext_en: ...the sacrificial altar.

ext.ext_cn: 祭祀品
ext.ext_en: ...a sacrificial victim.

defs.def_en: Sacrificial means connected with or used in a sacrifice.
A vasectomy is a surgical operation in which the tube that carries sperm to a man's penis is cut, usually as a means of contraception.

ext.ext_cn: 可以认为这实际上承认了该共和国的独立。
ext.ext_en: This might be interpreted as a de facto recognition of the republic's independence.

ext.ext_cn: 他们将在事实上处于交战状态。
ext.ext_en: They will be de facto in a state of war.

defs.def_en: De facto is used to indicate that something is a particular thing, even though it was not planned or intended to be that thing.

An armband is a band of fabric that you wear round your upper arm in order to show that you have an official position or belong to a particular group. Some people also wear a black armband to show that a friend or relation has died.

defs.def_cn: （用于学游泳的）充气臂圈，救生臂环
defs.def_en: Armbands are plastic rings filled with air that people who are learning to swim wear on their upper arms to help them float.

defs.def_cn: 闭塞的地方；与世隔绝的地方

ext.ext_cn: 僻静的乡村
ext.ext_en: ...a quiet rural backwater.

defs.def_en: A backwater is a place that is isolated.

defs.def_cn: 停滞（或落后）的地方；一潭死水

ext.ext_cn: 英国有变成在世界上没有真正影响力的政治死水之虞。
ext.ext_en: Britain could become a political backwater with no serious influence in the world...

ext.ext_cn: 这个机构将沦落为华盛顿闭塞落后之地。
ext.ext_en: This agency will be relegated to the backwaters of Washington...

defs.def_en: If you refer to a place or institution as a backwater, you think it is not developing properly because it is isolated from ideas and events in other places and institutions.
In athletics, the shot put is a competition in which people throw a heavy metal ball as far as possible.

defs.def_cn: 巴勒斯坦的；巴勒斯坦人的
defs.def_en: Palestinian means belonging or relating to the region between the River Jordan and the Mediterranean Sea which used to be called Palestine, or to the Arabs who come from this region.
A Palestinian is an Arab who comes from the region that used to be called Palestine.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 因为没人知道密码,所以任何人都不可能进得去。
ext.ext_en: It was impossible for anyone to get in because no one knew the password...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为税金没法管理。
ext.ext_en: He thinks the tax is impossible to administer...

defs.def_en: Something that is impossible cannot be done or cannot happen.

ext.ext_cn: 政府现在几乎陷入了进退维谷的境地。
ext.ext_en: The Government was now in an almost impossible position.

defs.def_en: An impossible situation or an impossible position is one that is very difficult to deal with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以忍受的;让人受不了的

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰妮想,这个女人真让人受不了。
ext.ext_en: The woman is impossible, thought Frannie.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as impossible, you are annoyed that their bad behaviour or strong views make them difficult to deal with.

ext.ext_cn: 摆在中心、缝着花鸟的装饰品
ext.ext_en: ...a centrepiece of appliqued flowers and birds.

ext.ext_cn: 华美的嵌花床罩
ext.ext_en: ...a magnificent appliqued bedspread.

defs.def_en: Appliqued shapes or fabric are formed from pieces of fabric which are stitched on to clothes or larger pieces of cloth.

ext.ext_cn: 他被诬赖成孩子的父亲而被骗结婚。
ext.ext_en: He was tricked into marriage by a false accusation of paternity.

defs.def_en: Paternity is the state or fact of being the father of a particular child.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 焦虑的；不安的；心神不定的；不自在的

ext.ext_cn: 他什么也没说，只是朝我狡黠地笑了笑，这让我感到极其不安。
ext.ext_en: He said nothing but gave me a sly grin that made me feel terribly uneasy...

ext.ext_cn: 他看上去焦虑不安，拒绝回答问题。
ext.ext_en: He looked uneasy and refused to answer questions...

defs.def_en: If you are uneasy, you feel anxious, afraid, or embarrassed, because you think that something is wrong or that there is danger.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 最好如何去跟年迈的母亲谈，理查德心里没有数。
ext.ext_en: Richard was uneasy about how best to approach his elderly mother...

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们觉得很难给出一个明确的答案。
ext.ext_en: Scientists feel uneasy about giving a positive answer.

defs.def_en: If you are uneasy about doing something, you are not sure that it is correct or wise.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （局势或关系）不稳定的，动荡的

ext.ext_cn: 洛杉矶归于一种不稳定的平静之中。
ext.ext_en: An uneasy calm has settled over Los Angeles...

ext.ext_cn: 两人之间不够稳固的联合给了人们一线希望。
ext.ext_en: The uneasy alliance between these two men offered a glimmer of hope...

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation or relationship as uneasy, you mean that the situation is not settled and may not last.

ext.ext_cn: 《弃我而去》这首歌非常伤感，听起来很晦涩。
ext.ext_en: 'Rid Of Me' is harrowing, uneasy listening...

ext.ext_cn: 这本旅游手册不是很好懂。
ext.ext_en: This is an uneasy travel book.

defs.def_en: If you describe a book or music as uneasy, you are critical of it because it is difficult to read or listen to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 人口众多的；人口稠密的

ext.ext_cn: 有2.16亿人的印度尼西亚是世界第四人口大国。
ext.ext_en: Indonesia, with 216 million people, is the fourth most populous country in the world.

defs.def_en: A populous country or area has a lot of people living in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他强烈谴责了宗教偏执。
ext.ext_en: He deplored religious bigotry.

defs.def_en: Bigotry is the possession or expression of strong, unreasonable prejudices or opinions.
A prairie dog is a type of small furry animal that lives underground in the prairies of North America.

defs.def_cn: (尤指政府官员对书刊、戏剧、电影、报道等的)审查，检查

ext.ext_cn: 政府今天宣布将取消新闻审查制度。
ext.ext_en: The government today announced that press censorship was being lifted.

defs.def_en: Censorship is the censoring of books, plays, films, or reports, especially by government officials, because they are considered immoral or secret in some way.

defs.def_cn: 基础训练；基础知识；基础

ext.ext_cn: 该学位课程将为数学和统计学打下扎实的基础。
ext.ext_en: The degree provides a thorough grounding in both mathematics and statistics.

defs.def_en: If you have a grounding in a subject, you know the basic facts or principles of that subject, especially as a result of a particular course of training or instruction.

ext.ext_cn: 普鲁士军事传统的自豪的继承者
ext.ext_en: ...the proud inheritors of the Prussian military tradition.

defs.def_en: The inheritors of something such as a tradition are the people who live or arrive after it has been established and are able to benefit from it.

ext.ext_cn: 三分之二的继承人会把他们继承得到的房产迅速变卖。
ext.ext_en: Two-thirds of inheritors promptly sold the houses they were left.

defs.def_en: An inheritor is someone who inherits money or property from someone who has died.
A savannah is a large area of flat, grassy land, usually in Africa.

ext.ext_cn: 最近几周，新兵正在接受训练。
ext.ext_en: New recruits have been undergoing training in recent weeks...

ext.ext_cn: 他苦苦等待了48个小时，化验结果才出来。
ext.ext_en: He underwent an agonising 48-hour wait for the results of tests.

defs.def_en: If you undergo something necessary or unpleasant, it happens to you.
An elector is a person who has the right to vote in an election.
An elector is a member of the electoral college. People vote for electors in each state to represent them in the presidential elections.

defs.def_cn: 道德（或宗教）上极拘谨的人；禁欲者；苦行者

ext.ext_cn: 贝科夫已经忘记了马利宁是个清教徒式的人物。
ext.ext_en: Bykov had forgotten that Malinin was something of a puritan...

ext.ext_cn: 那些使道学先生们勃然大怒的课题将继续成为她工作的重点。
ext.ext_en: As for the subjects that so enrage puritans, they will continue to form the focus of her work.

defs.def_en: You describe someone as a puritan when they live according to strict moral or religious principles, especially when they disapprove of physical pleasures.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 道德（或宗教）上极拘谨的；清教徒似的；禁欲的；苦行的

ext.ext_cn: 保罗身上无疑带有清教徒气质。
ext.ext_en: Paul was someone who certainly had a puritan streak in him.

ext.ext_cn: 苦行式的克己
ext.ext_en: ...puritan self-denial.

defs.def_en: Puritan attitudes are based on strict moral or religious principles and often involve disapproval of physical pleasures.

ext.ext_cn: 目前的大部分危机都是他自己引起的。
ext.ext_en: He has brought much of the present crisis on himself...

ext.ext_cn: 政府当前的经济难题
ext.ext_en: ...the government's present economic difficulties...

defs.def_en: You use present to describe things and people that exist now, rather than those that existed in the past or those that may exist in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 他为协调过去和现在所付出的努力。
ext.ext_en: ...his struggle to reconcile the past with the present.

ext.ext_cn: 一直持续到现在
ext.ext_en: ...continuing right up to the present...

defs.def_en: The present is the period of time that we are in now and the things that are happening now.

In grammar, the present tenses of a verb are the ones that are used to talk about things that happen regularly or situations that exist at this time. The simple present tense uses the base form or the 's' form of a verb, as in 'I play tennis twice a week' and 'He works in a bank'.

ext.ext_cn: 目前还没有办法预测谁会得这种病。
ext.ext_en: There is no way at present of predicting which individuals will develop the disease...

ext.ext_cn: 目前，14岁以下儿童不允许进酒吧。
ext.ext_en: At present children under 14 are not permitted in bars.

defs.def_en: A situation that exists at present exists now, although it may change.

ext.ext_cn: 从乔托时期直至现代的西欧艺术
ext.ext_en: ...Western  European art from the period of Giotto to the present day.

ext.ext_cn: 当代的寺庙音乐
ext.ext_en: ...monastic music of the present day.

defs.def_en: The present day is the period of history that we are in now.

ext.ext_cn: 大臣们一致认为暂时还不能取消制裁。
ext.ext_en: The ministers had expressed the unanimous view that sanctions should remain in place for the present.

defs.def_en: Something that exists or will be done for the present exists now or will continue for a while, although the situation may change later.

defs.def_cn: 机不可失，失不再来；就在当下

ext.ext_cn: 不要等到新年才下决心规划生活。要把握当下。
ext.ext_en: Don't wait until New Year to resolve to organise your life. There's no time like the present.

defs.def_en: If you say 'There's no time like the present', you are suggesting to someone that they should do something now, not later.

ext.ext_cn: 总裁没有出席这次会议。
ext.ext_en: The president was not present at the meeting...

ext.ext_cn: 将近85%的男性在他们的孩子出生时都在场。
ext.ext_en: Nearly 85 per cent of men are present at the birth of their children...

defs.def_en: If someone is present at an event, they are there.

defs.def_cn: （尤指物质、疾病）存在于…的，包含于…的

ext.ext_cn: 这种特殊形态的维生素D天然存在于母乳中。
ext.ext_en: This special form of vitamin D is naturally present in breast milk...

ext.ext_cn: 有一种理论认为，这种传染病存在于人类中已经有很长时间了。
ext.ext_en: One theory is that the infection has been present in humans for a very long time...

defs.def_en: If something, especially a substance or disease, is present in something else, it exists within that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 这张地毯是首相送的结婚礼物。
ext.ext_en: The carpet was a wedding present from the Prime Minister...

ext.ext_cn: 我给母亲买了一份生日礼物。
ext.ext_en: I bought a birthday present for my mother...

defs.def_en: A present is something that you give to someone, for example at Christmas or when you visit them.

ext.ext_cn: 市长在一次正式的市政招待会上给他颁发了一枚金质奖章。
ext.ext_en: The mayor presented him with a gold medal at an official city reception...

ext.ext_cn: 肯特亲王迈克尔颁发了奖品。
ext.ext_en: Prince Michael of Kent presented the prizes...

defs.def_en: If you present someone with something such as a prize or document, or if you present it to them, you formally give it to them.

ext.ext_cn: 这给很多金融消费者带来了一个问题。
ext.ext_en: This presents a problem for many financial consumers...

ext.ext_cn: 未来将会面临诸多挑战。
ext.ext_en: The future is going to be one that presents many challenges...

defs.def_en: If something presents a difficulty, challenge, or opportunity, it causes it or provides it.

ext.ext_cn: 一有机会，同事们就会侮辱他们。
ext.ext_en: Their colleagues insulted them whenever the opportunity presented itself...

ext.ext_cn: 然而，突然又出现了一个障碍。
ext.ext_en: A further obstacle has presented itself, however.

defs.def_en: If an opportunity or problem presents itself, it occurs, often when you do not expect it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们花费时间用各种各样的图表来比照和展示这些信息。
ext.ext_en: We spend the time collating and presenting the information in a variety of chart forms...

ext.ext_cn: 我们向工会提供了3种选择供讨论。
ext.ext_en: We presented three options to the unions for discussion...

defs.def_en: When you present information, you give it to people in a formal way.

ext.ext_cn: 政府将这些变化描述为重大的改革。
ext.ext_en: The government has presented these changes as major reforms...

ext.ext_cn: 英国人喜欢把自己说成是一个爱狗的民族。
ext.ext_en: The British like to present themselves as a nation of dog-lovers...

defs.def_en: If you present someone or something in a particular way, you describe them in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 能使他在公众面前表现得更为自信的那些窍门
ext.ext_en: ...all those tricks which would help him to present himself in a more confident way in public.

defs.def_en: The way you present yourself is the way you speak and act when meeting new people.

ext.ext_cn: 这一小群旁观者看上去让人觉得悲哀。
ext.ext_en: The small group of onlookers presented a pathetic sight...

ext.ext_cn: 为了给人一种更为职业的形象，该党可能会丧失自身特色。
ext.ext_en: In presenting a more professional image the party risks losing its individuality.

defs.def_en: If someone or something presents a particular appearance or image, that is how they appear or try to appear.

ext.ext_cn: 她被告知于11点30分在市政厅参加就职仪式。
ext.ext_en: She was told to present herself at the Town Hall at 11.30 for the induction ceremony...

ext.ext_cn: 我们立即向当局备案。
ext.ext_en: We presented ourselves to the authorities promptly.

defs.def_en: If you present yourself somewhere, you officially arrive there, for example for an appointment.

ext.ext_cn: 她在英国广播公司主持一个月刊节目。
ext.ext_en: She presents a monthly magazine programme on the BBC.

defs.def_en: If someone presents a programme on television or radio, they introduce each item in it.

ext.ext_cn: 利里克剧院正在上演新排的《桥对面》。
ext.ext_en: The Lyric Theatre is presenting a new production of 'Over the Bridge'.

defs.def_en: When someone presents something such as a production of a play or an exhibition, they organize it.

ext.ext_cn: 福克斯走向前，用马来语向他表示欢迎，并把他介绍给了杰克。
ext.ext_en: Fox stepped forward, welcomed him in Malay, and presented him to Jack...

ext.ext_cn: 请允许我介绍我妻子的表哥，扎卡里·科伦索先生。
ext.ext_en: Allow me to present my wife's cousin, Mr Zachary Colenso.

defs.def_en: If you present someone to someone else, often an important person, you formally introduce them.

ext.ext_cn: 私有化和那些哗众取宠的做法并不能改进英国铁路运输。
ext.ext_en: Privatisation and gimmickry are not the answer to improving Britain's rail service.

defs.def_en: If you describe features or actions as gimmickry, you mean they are not necessary or useful, and their only purpose is to attract attention or publicity.

defs.def_cn: 徒手画的;不用绘图仪器画的

ext.ext_cn: 徒手素描
ext.ext_en: ...freehand sketches.

ext.ext_cn: 使用样板或模版，或者干脆徒手画。
ext.ext_en: Use a template or stencil or simply do it freehand.

defs.def_en: A freehand drawing is drawn without using instruments such as a ruler or a pair of compasses.

defs.def_cn: 争执不下；针锋相对；唱对台戏

ext.ext_cn: 数月来，牙医和卫生部门为费用问题针锋相对。
ext.ext_en: For months dentists and the health department have been at loggerheads over fees...

ext.ext_cn: 法国与其他欧盟成员国要求削减国家借贷的意见相左，因而受到它们的孤立，与它们闹得不可开交。
ext.ext_en: France was left isolated and at loggerheads with other EU member countries over its refusal to fall into line with demands to cut state borrowing.

defs.def_en: If two or more people or groups are at loggerheads, they disagree very strongly with each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 灵活而方便的业务费用支付方式
ext.ext_en: ...a flexible and convenient way of paying for business expenses...

ext.ext_cn: 这家人认为在厨房吃饭更方便。
ext.ext_en: The family thought it was more convenient to eat in the kitchen.

defs.def_en: If a way of doing something is convenient, it is easy, or very useful or suitable for a particular purpose.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 附近的;方便到达的;近便的

ext.ext_cn: 这座城市地理位置优越，到伦敦和希思罗机场都很方便。
ext.ext_en: The town is well placed for easy access to London and convenient for Heathrow Airport...

ext.ext_cn: 马丁一直往前开，直到找到了一个方便的停车场。
ext.ext_en: Martin drove along until he found a convenient parking place.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as convenient, you are pleased because it is near to where you are, or because you can reach another place from there quickly and easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她会尽力安排一个双方都方便的时间和地点进行面试。
ext.ext_en: She will try to arrange a mutually convenient time and place for an interview...

ext.ext_cn: 今天晚上你方便吗？
ext.ext_en: Would this evening be convenient for you?

defs.def_en: A convenient time to do something, for example to meet someone, is a time when you are free to do it or would like to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (态度、行为等)方便的，省力的，省事的

ext.ext_cn: 我们不能拿少数这几个人作为一种方便的借口而对此置之不理。
ext.ext_en: We cannot make this minority a convenient excuse to turn our backs...

ext.ext_cn: 随手抓来的替罪羊
ext.ext_en: ...a convenient scapegoat...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's attitudes or actions as convenient, you think they are only adopting those attitudes or performing those actions in order to avoid something difficult or unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 西尔维娅去卫生间拿了一条毛巾。
ext.ext_en: Sylvia fetched a towel from the bathroom...

ext.ext_cn: 去给我拿杯水来。
ext.ext_en: Fetch me a glass of water...

defs.def_en: If you fetch something or someone, you go and get them from the place where they are.

ext.ext_cn: 预计这幅画将售得两三百万英镑。
ext.ext_en: The painting is expected to fetch between two and three million pounds.

defs.def_en: If something fetches a particular sum of money, it is sold for that amount.

ext.ext_cn: 我在帐篷里帮忙打杂。
ext.ext_en: I helped out in the tents fetching and carrying.

defs.def_en: If you fetch and carry, you perform simple, often boring tasks for someone, such as collecting and carrying things for them.

ext.ext_cn: 在核武器试验中他们暴露在放射性尘埃之下。
ext.ext_en: They were exposed to radioactive fallout during nuclear weapons tests.

defs.def_en: Fallout is the radiation that affects a particular place or area after a nuclear explosion has taken place.

ext.ext_cn: 格伦迪受该事件影响丢了工作。
ext.ext_en: Grundy lost his job in the fallout from the incident.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the fallout from something that has happened, you mean the unpleasant consequences that follow it.

ext.ext_cn: 拉金贬低文学的倾向
ext.ext_en: ...Larkin's tendency to disparage literature.

ext.ext_en: The tax cut is widely disparaged by senators from both parties as a budget gimmick.

defs.def_en: If you disparage someone or something, you speak about them in a way which shows that you do not have a good opinion of them.

ext.ext_cn: 锻炼身体能够形成一种良性循环。一旦你开始一项锻炼计划并持之以恒，你会感觉良好并坚持下去。
ext.ext_en: Exercise creates its own virtuous circle. Once you start a programme and do it regularly, you'll feel so good you'll want to continue.

ext.ext_cn: 投资和增长的良性循环
ext.ext_en: ...a virtuous circle of investment and growth.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as a virtuous circle, you mean that once one good thing starts happening, other good things happen, which cause the first thing to continue happening.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Ray was very giggly and joking all the time.

ext.ext_cn: 咯咯笑的女孩子们
ext.ext_en: ...giggly girls.

defs.def_en: Someone who is giggly keeps laughing in a childlike way, because they are amused, nervous, or drunk.
A eucalyptus is an evergreen tree, originally from Australia, that is grown to provide wood, gum, and an oil that is used in medicines.

defs.def_cn: （用于筛查乳腺癌的）乳房X光造影检查
defs.def_en: A mammogram is a test used to check whether women have breast cancer, using x-rays.

defs.def_cn: 拒绝考虑;不接受;不同意

ext.ext_en: The British government is expected to reject the idea of state subsidy for a new high speed railway...

ext.ext_cn: 17家出版社回绝了这部手稿，直到詹克斯看到了它的潜在价值。
ext.ext_en: Seventeen publishers rejected the manuscript before Jenks saw its potential.

defs.def_en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

defs.def_cn: 摈弃，抛弃，不接受(信仰或政治制度)

ext.ext_cn: 抛弃了父母一代政治和宗教信仰的东欧移民子女
ext.ext_en: ...the children of Eastern European immigrants who had rejected their parents' political and religious beliefs.

defs.def_en: If you reject a belief or a political system, you refuse to believe in it or to live by its rules.

ext.ext_en: One of my most able students was rejected by another university.

defs.def_en: If someone is rejected for a job or course of study, it is not offered to them.

ext.ext_cn: 你和别人交朋友，然后向人家提出无理要求，结果被人家拒绝。
ext.ext_en: You make friends with people and then make unreasonable demands so that they reject you.

ext.ext_cn: 被爱人拒绝的人
ext.ext_en: ...people who had been rejected by their lovers.

defs.def_en: If someone rejects another person who expects affection from them, they are cold and unfriendly towards them.

defs.def_cn: 排斥(移植器官)；对…产生排斥反应

ext.ext_en: It was feared his body was rejecting a kidney he received in a transplant four years ago.

defs.def_en: If a person's body rejects something such as a new heart that has been transplanted into it, it tries to attack and destroy it.
If a machine rejects a coin that you put in it, the coin comes out and the machine does not work.
A reject is a product that has not been accepted for use or sale, because there is something wrong with it.
An extinguisher is the same as a fire extinguisher .

defs.def_cn: 出类拔萃的；卓越的；绝佳的

ext.ext_en: He has been a meticulous manager, a manager par excellence.

ext.ext_cn: 布雷森是个非常出色的天主教电影制作人。
ext.ext_en: Bresson is par excellence the Catholic film-maker.

defs.def_en: You say that something is a particular kind of thing par excellence in order to emphasize that it is a very good example of that kind of thing.

ext.ext_cn: 由于健康问题他不得不退休。
ext.ext_en: He was forced to retire because of ill health...

ext.ext_cn: 儿时的她曾饱受病痛的折磨。
ext.ext_en: As a child she had suffered regular bouts of ill health.

defs.def_en: Someone who suffers from ill health has an illness or keeps being ill.

ext.ext_cn: 我们看着同学们悠闲地走进了大楼。
ext.ext_en: We watched our fellow students saunter into the building...

ext.ext_cn: 他沿着河边漫步走到磨坊。
ext.ext_en: He sauntered along the river to the mill.

defs.def_en: If you saunter somewhere, you walk there in a slow, casual way.

defs.def_en: SARS is a serious disease which affects your ability to breathe. SARS is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'severe acute respiratory syndrome'.

defs.def_cn: (印有信息的窄长条)纸带(在美国城市中，人们有时从高楼上抛下纸带以示庆祝或向某人表示敬意)

ext.ext_en: A half million people watched the troops march in New York's ticker tape parade.

defs.def_en: Ticker tape consists of long narrow strips of paper on which information such as stock exchange prices is printed by a machine. In American cities, people sometimes throw ticker tape from high windows as a way of celebrating and honouring someone in public.

ext.ext_cn: 政府被一群自以为是的书呆子控制着。
ext.ext_en: The Government was dominated by self-important eggheads.

defs.def_en: If you think someone is more interested in ideas and theories than in practical actions you can say they are an egghead .
Titanium is a light strong white metal.

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望他参加典礼。
ext.ext_en: They expected him to participate in the ceremony...

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家一半以上的人口参加体育锻炼。
ext.ext_en: Over half the population of this country participate in sport.

defs.def_en: If you participate in an activity, you take part in it.

defs.def_cn: 巴尔干化；分裂成若干独立小国

ext.ext_cn: 我们不能接受使国家分裂或巴尔干化的行为。
ext.ext_en: We can't accept the fragmentation or balkanization of the country.

defs.def_en: If you disapprove of the division of a country into separate independent states, you can refer to the Balkanization of the country.

ext.ext_cn: 唯一的亮光来自对面墙上高处的一扇小窗子。
ext.ext_en: The only illumination came from a small window high in the opposite wall.

defs.def_en: Illumination is the lighting that a place has.

ext.ext_cn: 著名的布莱克浦彩灯节
ext.ext_en: ...the famous Blackpool illuminations.

defs.def_en: Illuminations are coloured lights which are put up in towns, especially at Christmas, in order to make them look attractive, especially at night.

ext.ext_cn: 顿悟
ext.ext_en: ...a sense of illumination...

ext.ext_cn: 这一理论不能给人以更深刻的启迪。
ext.ext_en: No further illumination can be had from this theory.

defs.def_en: You can use illumination to describe an increased understanding of something, especially something of a religious or spiritual nature.

ext.ext_cn: 鲍威尔湖的水一滴都没有用于灌溉该地区。
ext.ext_en: None of the water from Lake Powell is used to irrigate the area.

ext.ext_cn: 由纵横交错的运河灌溉的一条条狭长耕地区域
ext.ext_en: ...strips of cultivated land irrigated by a maze of interconnected canals.

defs.def_en: To irrigate land means to supply it with water in order to help crops grow.

defs.def_cn: (附带出售香烟、报刊等的)糖果店
defs.def_en: A sweet shop is a small shop that sells sweets and cigarettes, and sometimes newspapers and magazines.

defs.def_cn: (用鼻子和嘴表示亲热地)轻擦，轻触

ext.ext_cn: 小狗跑过来，依偎在我身边。
ext.ext_en: The dog came and nuzzled up against me.

defs.def_en: If you nuzzle someone or something, you gently rub your nose and mouth against them to show affection.

ext.ext_cn: 草莓在运输过程中要冷藏，以防止变质。
ext.ext_en: The strawberries are kept in cold storage to prevent them spoiling during transportation.

defs.def_en: If something such as food is put in cold storage, it is kept in an artificially cooled place in order to preserve it.

ext.ext_cn: 几年前，一位出版商要我考虑写一部小说，但之后这事就搁置下来了。
ext.ext_en: A few years ago I was asked by a publisher to consider writing a novel, and the idea has been in cold storage ever since.

defs.def_en: If you put an idea or plan into cold storage or in cold storage, you delay it for a while rather than acting on it as you originally intended.

ext.ext_cn: 获胜党的领导人
ext.ext_en: ...the leader of the winning party...

ext.ext_cn: 希尔在哪一方，哪一方就输。
ext.ext_en: Hill has never been on the winning side...

defs.def_en: You can use winning to describe a person or thing that wins something such as a competition, game, or election.

ext.ext_cn: 她又给了他一个动人的微笑。
ext.ext_en: She gave him another of her winning smiles...

ext.ext_cn: 他魅力十足，个性迷人。
ext.ext_en: He had much charm and a winning personality.

defs.def_en: You can use winning to describe actions or qualities that please other people and make them feel friendly towards you.

ext.ext_cn: 结束了工具匠的学徒期以后，他当上了经理。
ext.ext_en: After serving his apprenticeship as a toolmaker, he became a manager.

ext.ext_cn: 学徒期
ext.ext_en: ...a period of apprenticeship.

ext.ext_cn: 英语、数学、信息与通信技术和科学是必修科目。
ext.ext_en: English, Maths, ICT and science are compulsory subjects.

defs.def_en: ICT refers to activities or studies involving computers and other electronic technology. ICT is an abbreviation for (缩略 =) 'Information and Communications Technology'.

defs.def_cn: （尤指因特网上的讨论）与主题不相干的，跑题的

ext.ext_en: In addition to the 81 positive comments, 26 students had neutral, mixed, negative or off topic views.

defs.def_en: If you describe something that someone says or writes as off topic, you mean that it is not relevant to the current discussion; used especially of discussions on the Internet.

ext.ext_cn: 她会坐在那儿用铅笔头画画。
ext.ext_en: She would sit there drawing with the pencil stub...

ext.ext_cn: 画一个公司标志的草图。
ext.ext_en: Draw a rough design for a logo...

defs.def_en: When you draw, or when you draw something, you use a pencil or pen to produce a picture, pattern, or diagram.

ext.ext_cn: 克莱尔看到出租车缓缓开走了。
ext.ext_en: Claire had seen the taxi drawing away...

ext.ext_cn: 当火车驶进巴斯尔登站时，一节车厢的门撞到他了。
ext.ext_en: A carriage door struck him as a train drew into Basildon station.

defs.def_en: When a vehicle draws somewhere, it moves there smoothly and steadily.

ext.ext_en: When we drew level, he neither slowed down nor accelerated.

ext.ext_en: After drawing the curtains, she lit a candle...

defs.def_en: When you draw a curtain or blind, you pull it across a window, either to cover or to uncover it.

ext.ext_en: ...a chariot drawn by six black mules.

defs.def_en: If an animal or vehicle draws something such as a cart, carriage, or another vehicle, it pulls it along.

ext.ext_en: He drew on an American cigarette...

ext.ext_en: Her cheeks hollowed as she drew smoke into her lungs.

defs.def_en: If you draw on a cigarette, you breathe the smoke from it into your mouth or lungs.

ext.ext_en: Villagers still have to draw their water from wells.

ext.ext_en: Any practice that draws blood could increase the risk of getting the virus.

defs.def_en: If something that hits you or presses part of your body draws blood, it cuts your skin so that it bleeds.

ext.ext_en: Companies could not draw money from bank accounts as cash.

defs.def_en: If you draw money out of a bank, building society, or savings account, you get it from the account so that you can use it.

ext.ext_en: He is moving ever closer to drawing his pension.

defs.def_en: If you draw a salary or a sum of money, you receive a sum of money regularly.

ext.ext_en: We delved through a sackful of letters to draw the winning name...

ext.ext_en: Aston Villa have drawn a Czech team in the first round of the UEFA Cup.

A draw is a competition where people pay money for numbered or named tickets, then some of those tickets are chosen, and the owners are given prizes.

ext.ext_en: I draw strength from the millions of women who have faced this challenge successfully...

ext.ext_en: The students are drawn from a cross-section of backgrounds.

defs.def_en: To draw something from a particular thing or place means to take or get it from that thing or place.

ext.ext_en: He says he cannot yet draw any conclusions about the murders.

defs.def_en: If you draw a particular conclusion, you decide that that conclusion is true.

defs.def_cn: 作(比较或对比)；加以(区别)

defs.def_en: If you draw a comparison, parallel, or distinction, you compare or contrast two different ideas, systems, or other things.

ext.ext_en: Such a policy would inevitably draw fierce resistance from farmers.

defs.def_en: If someone or something draws a particular reaction, people react to it in that way.

defs.def_en: If something such as a film or an event draws a lot of people, it is so interesting or entertaining that a lot of people go to it.

defs.def_en: When an event or period of time draws to a close or draws to an end, it finishes.

ext.ext_en: They encourage doctors to prescribe cheaper generic  drugs instead of more expensive brand names.
