ext.ext_cn: 卢森堡草拟了一项英国、法国和德国之间都可以接受的妥协方案。
ext.ext_en: Luxembourg sketched out an acceptable compromise between Britain, France and Germany.

defs.def_en: If you sketch a situation or incident, you give a short description of it, including only the most important facts.

defs.def_cn: (通常指喜剧节目中的)幽默短剧

ext.ext_cn: 刻画一位民歌手的 5 分钟幽默短剧
ext.ext_en: ...a five-minute sketch about a folk singer.

defs.def_en: A sketch is a short humorous piece of acting, usually forming part of a comedy show.

ext.ext_cn: 政府将努力控制通货膨胀。
ext.ext_en: The government would try to rein back inflation.

defs.def_en: To rein back something such as spending means to control it strictly.

ext.ext_cn: 最新医学研究证实了较为健康的生活方式的好处。
ext.ext_en: Recent medical studies confirm the efficacy of a healthier lifestyle.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the efficacy of something, you are talking about its effectiveness and its ability to do what it is supposed to.

ext.ext_cn: 帕特清清楚楚地记得那次旅行。
ext.ext_en: Pat has vivid recollections of the trip...

ext.ext_cn: 那次车祸他一点也不记得了。
ext.ext_en: He had no recollection of the crash...

defs.def_en: If you have a recollection of something, you remember it.

ext.ext_cn: 他到领事馆工作，主要因为那是仅有的几个空缺职位之一。
ext.ext_en: He joined the consular service, chiefly because this was one of the few job vacancies...

ext.ext_cn: 听到别人对自己工作的指责，他的反应主要是困惑。
ext.ext_en: His response to attacks on his work was chiefly bewilderment.

defs.def_en: You use chiefly to indicate that a particular reason, emotion, method, or feature is the main or most important one.
Sandalwood is the sweet-smelling wood of a tree that is found in South Asia and Australia. It is also the name of the tree itself.
Sandalwood is the oil extracted from the wood of the tree. It is used to make perfume.

ext.ext_cn: 职业满足感
ext.ext_en: ...professional fulfilment.

defs.def_en: Fulfilment is a feeling of satisfaction that you get from doing or achieving something, especially something useful.

ext.ext_cn: 游览吴哥实现了孩提时的一个梦想。
ext.ext_en: Visiting Angkor was the fulfilment of a childhood dream.

defs.def_en: The fulfilment of a promise, threat, request, hope, or duty is the event or act of it happening or being made to happen.
A celeb is the same as a celebrity .

ext.ext_cn: 据悉，这种药会对女性产生副作用。
ext.ext_en: The drug is known to produce side-effects in women...

ext.ext_cn: 旨在制定出一个新的世界贸易条约的谈判已经进行了6年。
ext.ext_en: Talks aimed at producing a new world trade treaty have been under way for six years.

defs.def_en: To produce something means to cause it to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司为通信系统生产电路。
ext.ext_en: The company produced circuitry for communications systems...

ext.ext_cn: 我很高兴我们确实有能力生产这么多粮食。
ext.ext_en: I'm quite pleased that we do have the capacity to produce that much food.

defs.def_en: If you produce something, you make or create it.

ext.ext_cn: 然后，这些植物就被授粉，从而成熟结籽。
ext.ext_en: These plants are then pollinated and allowed to mature and produce seed.

ext.ext_cn: 煤和油燃烧时产生的气体
ext.ext_en: ...gases produced by burning coal and oil.

defs.def_en: When things or people produce something, it comes from them or slowly forms from them, especially as the result of a biological or chemical process.

ext.ext_cn: 他们要他拿出证据证明自己的主张。
ext.ext_en: They challenged him to produce evidence to support his allegations...

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们提出了有力论据反驳他的观点。
ext.ext_en: Scientists have produced powerful arguments against his ideas.

defs.def_en: If you produce evidence or an argument, you show it or explain it to people in order to make them agree with you.

ext.ext_cn: 租车必须出示护照和有效驾驶执照。
ext.ext_en: To hire a car you must produce a passport and a current driving licence...

ext.ext_cn: 在和朋友争吵的时候，她掏出了刀。
ext.ext_en: She produced the knife during arguments with her friends.

defs.def_en: If you produce an object from somewhere, you show it or bring it out so that it can be seen.

defs.def_cn: 上演（戏剧）；制作（电影、电视节目）；灌制（唱片）

ext.ext_cn: 他推出了自己的体育杂志，叫做《是的，体育》。
ext.ext_en: He has produced his own sports magazine called Yes Sport...

ext.ext_cn: 他制作推出了《歌舞线上》这一百老汇经久不衰的剧目。
ext.ext_en: He produced 'A Chorus Line', Broadway's longest running show.

defs.def_en: If someone produces something such as a film, a magazine, or a CD, they organize it and decide how it should be done.

ext.ext_cn: 我们设法在英国搞到我们所需的大部分农产品。
ext.ext_en: We manage to get most of our produce in Britain...

ext.ext_cn: 在未来几周，冬季农产品会更贵。
ext.ext_en: Winter produce will cost more for the next few weeks.

defs.def_en: Produce is food or other things that are grown in large quantities to be sold.

ext.ext_cn: 她超出常人的活力、魅力和才智
ext.ext_en: ...her exceptional vitality, vivacity and wit.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has vivacity, you mean that they are lively, exciting, and attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可忍受的；可容忍的；忍耐得住的

ext.ext_cn: 一阵凉风吹来，让炎热的天气变得稍微舒适了一些。
ext.ext_en: A cool breeze made the heat pleasantly bearable.

defs.def_en: If something is bearable, you feel that you can accept it or deal with it.
A warm-blooded animal, for example a bird or a mammal, has a fairly high body temperature which does not change much and is not affected by the surrounding temperature.

ext.ext_cn: 是不是他让你来跟我们这么瞎说八道的?
ext.ext_en: Was it him who made you come to us with this cock-and-bull story?

defs.def_en: If you describe something that someone tells you as a cock-and-bull story, you mean that you do not believe it is true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （因生病、焦虑等）瘦削的，憔悴的

ext.ext_cn: 他看起来消瘦而疲惫，却说没什么可担心的。
ext.ext_en: Looking gaunt and tired, he denied there was anything to worry about.

defs.def_en: If someone looks gaunt, they look very thin, usually because they have been very ill or worried.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （建筑物）寒碜的，非常不起眼的，难看的

ext.ext_cn: 山坡上有幢难看的灰色大房子。
ext.ext_en: Above on the hillside was a large, gaunt, grey house.

defs.def_en: If you describe a building as gaunt, you mean it is very plain and unattractive.

ext.ext_cn: 你是个聪明的女人，想必你现在明白了我是在帮你。
ext.ext_en: You're an intelligent woman, surely you realize by now that I'm helping you...

ext.ext_cn: 你想必还没有忘记沃尔特斯医生吧？
ext.ext_en: You surely haven't forgotten Dr Walters?...

defs.def_en: You use surely to emphasize that you think something should be true, and you would be surprised if it was not true.

ext.ext_cn: 他知道他必定会死在外科医生刀下。
ext.ext_en: He knew that under the surgeon's knife he would surely die...

ext.ext_cn: 他无疑是一名画家，就如同伦勃朗或任何其他一流的肖像画家一样。
ext.ext_en: He is an artist, just as surely as Rembrandt or any other first-rate portrait painter is one.

defs.def_en: If something will surely happen or is surely the case, it will definitely happen or is definitely the case.

defs.def_cn: 缓慢但确定地;稳扎稳打地

ext.ext_cn: 虽然过程缓慢，但她无疑开始爱上他了。
ext.ext_en: Slowly but surely she started to fall in love with him...

ext.ext_cn: 他的身体恢复缓慢，但确实是在恢复。
ext.ext_en: He's recovering, slowly but surely.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is happening slowly but surely, you mean that it is happening gradually but it is definitely happening.

defs.def_cn: 滚下;摔倒;跌落;翻滚而下

ext.ext_cn: 一个小男孩从3楼防火梯上摔了下来。
ext.ext_en: A small boy tumbled off a third floor fire escape...

ext.ext_cn: 那只狗已摔下了悬崖。
ext.ext_en: The dog had tumbled down the cliff…

defs.def_en: If someone or something tumbles somewhere, they fall there with a rolling or bouncing movement.

ext.ext_cn: 房价自 1989 年中期以来实际上暴跌了近 30%。
ext.ext_en: House prices have tumbled by almost 30 per cent in real terms since mid-1989...

ext.ext_cn: 东京股市的股价今天继续暴跌。
ext.ext_en: Share prices continued to tumble today on the Tokyo stock market.

defs.def_en: If prices or levels of something are tumbling, they are decreasing rapidly.

ext.ext_cn: 瀑布飞流直溅，冲刷着岩石。
ext.ext_en: Waterfalls crash and tumble over rocks.

ext.ext_cn: 松巴高原芬芳的松树与湍急的河流
ext.ext_en: ...the aromatic pines and tumbling streams of the Zonba Plateau.

defs.def_en: If water tumbles, it flows quickly over an uneven surface.

defs.def_cn: 突然闯入（某地）;陷入，浑然不觉地进入(某种状态)

ext.ext_cn: 很多母亲和孩子在离婚后陷入贫困。
ext.ext_en: Many mothers and children tumble into poverty after divorce...

ext.ext_cn: 没有比一头冲进自己的公寓摔上房门更让我开心的事了。
ext.ext_en: There's no thought more pleasing than the prospect of tumbling into my apartment and slamming the door.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone tumbles into a situation or place, you mean that they get into it without being fully in control of themselves or knowing what they are doing.

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢大的挑战，而所有挑战中再没有比这更大的了。
ext.ext_en: I like a big challenge and they don't come much bigger than this...

ext.ext_cn: 新政府面临的第一个难题是经济问题。
ext.ext_en: The new government's first challenge is the economy.

defs.def_en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

ext.ext_cn: 一个崭新的德国必须迎接挑战，承担更多的责任。
ext.ext_en: The new Germany must rise to the challenge of its enhanced responsibilities...

ext.ext_cn: 他们一个下午成功接待了80名学童。
ext.ext_en: They rose to the challenge of entertaining 80 schoolchildren for an afternoon.

defs.def_en: If someone rises to the challenge, they act in response to a difficult situation which is new to them and are successful.

defs.def_cn: (对真实性、价值、权威等提出的)怀疑，质疑

ext.ext_cn: 示威者现在直接对政府的权威发出了质疑。
ext.ext_en: The demonstrators have now made a direct challenge to the authority of the government.

defs.def_en: A challenge to something is a questioning of its truth or value. A challenge to someone is a questioning of their authority.

defs.def_cn: 怀疑，质疑(真实性、价值、权威等)

ext.ext_cn: 民主党领袖对总统签署这项法案提出了质疑。
ext.ext_en: Democratic leaders have challenged the president to sign the bill...

ext.ext_cn: 此项动议立即遭到其中两个共和国的反对。
ext.ext_en: The move was immediately challenged by two of the republics...

defs.def_en: If you challenge ideas or people, you question their truth, value, or authority.

ext.ext_cn: 两家的女儿吵起来后，一个妈妈划破了邻居的车胎，说要和她较量较量。
ext.ext_en: A mum slashed a neighbour's car tyre and challenged her to a fight after their daughters fell out...

ext.ext_cn: 他在犯罪现场留了个条儿，向警探挑衅。
ext.ext_en: He left a note at the scene of the crime, challenging detectives to catch him...

defs.def_en: If you challenge someone, you invite them to fight or compete with you in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 显然，那些人是在受到一支巡逻队的盘问后开的火。
ext.ext_en: The men apparently opened fire after they were challenged by a patrol.

defs.def_en: If someone is challenged by a guard, they are ordered to stop and say who they are or why they are there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 吸烟的人都知道吸烟对自身健康的危害。
ext.ext_en: Smokers are well aware of the dangers to their own health...

ext.ext_cn: 他本应该清楚自己下级们的所作所为。
ext.ext_en: He should have been aware of what his junior officers were doing...

defs.def_en: If you are aware of something, you know about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 注意到的；察觉到的；意识到的

ext.ext_cn: 她对城市噪音很敏感。
ext.ext_en: She was acutely aware of the noise of the city...

ext.ext_cn: 简突然间意识到她正在用指甲抠大腿。
ext.ext_en: Jane was suddenly aware that she was digging her nails into her thigh.

defs.def_en: If you are aware of something, you realize that it is present or is happening because you hear it, see it, smell it, or feel it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们政治上非常警觉。
ext.ext_en: They are politically very aware.

defs.def_en: Someone who is aware notices what is happening around them or happening in the place where they live.

ext.ext_cn: 大主教呼吁政府为当地居民建造更多低成本的住宅。
ext.ext_en: The Archbishop called upon the government to build more low cost homes for local residents...

ext.ext_cn: 超过10％的慕尼黑居民生活在贫困线以下。
ext.ext_en: More than 10 percent of Munich residents live below the poverty line.

defs.def_en: The residents of a house or area are the people who live there.

ext.ext_cn: 他于1990年搬到比利时和儿子一起住。他儿子自1967年起就住在布鲁塞尔。
ext.ext_en: He moved to Belgium in 1990 to live with his son, who had been resident in Brussels since 1967.

defs.def_en: Someone who is resident in a country or a town lives there.

ext.ext_cn: 到达后的第二天早上，你就去见住院医生，进行私人问诊。
ext.ext_en: The morning after your arrival, you meet with the resident physician for a private consultation.

defs.def_en: A resident doctor or teacher lives in the place where he or she works.
A resident or a resident doctor is a doctor who is receiving a period of specialized training in a hospital after leaving university.

ext.ext_cn: 在格雷陶器场开始自己的职业生涯后，她在那里做了7年的特聘设计师。
ext.ext_en: Having begun her career at Gray's Pottery, she stayed there as resident designer for seven years.

defs.def_en: If an institution has a resident specialist, that specialist works for the institution.

defs.def_cn: (由于准备不充分而引起的)起步失误，失败的开端

ext.ext_cn: 他说，任何经济改革一开始都难免会经历失败,难免会出错。
ext.ext_en: Any economic reform, he said, faced false starts and mistakes.

defs.def_en: A false start is an attempt to start something, such as a speech, project, or plan, which fails because you were not properly prepared or ready to begin.
If there is a false start at the beginning of a race, one of the competitors moves before the person who starts the race has given the signal.
A plumber is a person whose job is to connect and repair things such as water and drainage pipes, baths, and toilets.

ext.ext_cn: 财政部早就预测消费者支出会出现上扬。
ext.ext_en: The Treasury has long been predicting an upturn in consumer spending.

defs.def_en: In Britain, the United States, and some other countries, the Treasury is the government department that deals with the country's finances.
The treasury in a building such as a castle or a church is a room where valuable objects are displayed or stored.

ext.ext_cn: 可乐和其他碳酸饮料
ext.ext_en: ...colas and other carbonated soft drinks.

defs.def_en: Carbonated drinks are drinks that contain small bubbles of carbon dioxide.

ext.ext_cn: 他指责部长们与外国公司串通一气损害就业权。
ext.ext_en: He accused ministers of conniving with foreign companies to tear up employment rights...

ext.ext_cn: 几位资深政治家串通起来确保他不会获释。
ext.ext_en: Senior politicians connived to ensure that he was not released.

defs.def_en: If one person connives with another to do something, they secretly try to achieve something which will benefit both of them.

ext.ext_cn: 他怀疑南非政府内有一帮人纵容这些骚乱的发生，企图削弱非国大。
ext.ext_en: He suspected elements within the South African government were conniving at the disturbances to try to weaken the ANC...

ext.ext_cn: 低价从贫穷国家采购是加重其贫穷的不义之举。
ext.ext_en: To buy things cheaply from a poor country is to connive in its poverty.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone connives at something or connives in something, you are critical of them because they allow or help it to happen even though they know that it is wrong and that they ought to prevent it.

ext.ext_cn: 1999年，网络公司在电视广告上投入了超过10亿美元。
ext.ext_en: In 1999, dot-coms spent more than $1 billion on TV spots.

ext.ext_cn: 网络公司
ext.ext_en: ...a dot-com company.

defs.def_en: A dot-com is a company that does all or most of its business on the Internet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对很多医学领域产生了深刻影响的发现
ext.ext_en: ...discoveries which had a profound effect on many areas of medicine.

ext.ext_cn: 严重的分歧
ext.ext_en: ...profound disagreement...

defs.def_en: You use profound to emphasize that something is very great or intense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 深刻的；深奥的；知识渊博的

ext.ext_cn: 这本书充满了深刻、新颖、令人深思的见解。
ext.ext_en: This is a book full of profound, original and challenging insights.

ext.ext_cn: 该国知识最渊博的人之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the country's most profound minds.

defs.def_en: A profound idea, work, or person shows great intellectual depth and understanding.

ext.ext_cn: 这件背心裙背部有一个巧妙的拉链。
ext.ext_en: The sundress has a neat back zip fastening.

defs.def_en: A fastening is something such as a clasp or zip that you use to fasten something and keep it shut.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极强烈的；势不可挡的；令人不知所措的

ext.ext_cn: 如果将这个任务细分为简单易行的若干步骤来做，便不会感到如此无所适从。
ext.ext_en: The task won't feel so overwhelming if you break it down into small, easy-to-accomplish steps...

ext.ext_cn: 她一心想再要一个孩子。
ext.ext_en: She felt an overwhelming desire to have another child.

defs.def_en: If something is overwhelming, it affects you very strongly, and you do not know how to deal with it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 绝大多数小企业在头两年内就破产了。
ext.ext_en: The overwhelming majority of small businesses go broke within the first twenty-four months...

ext.ext_cn: 去年5月，该党在缅甸大选中获得了压倒性的胜利。
ext.ext_en: The party won an overwhelming victory in Burma's general elections last May...

defs.def_en: You can use overwhelming to emphasize that an amount or quantity is much greater than other amounts or quantities.

ext.ext_cn: 雷用专门的防锈涂料涂船的吃水线以下的部位。
ext.ext_en: Ray painted below the waterline with a special anti-rust paint.

defs.def_en: The waterline is a line, either real or imaginary, on the side of a ship representing the level the water reaches when the ship is at sea.

ext.ext_cn: 卡尔·瓦诺将军，陆军总参谋长
ext.ext_en: ...General Carl Vano, the chief of staff of the Army.

defs.def_en: The Chiefs of Staff are the highest-ranking officers of each service of the armed forces.

defs.def_cn: 军乐队鼓手指挥;行进军乐队指挥（或领队）
defs.def_en: A drum major is a sergeant in the army who is in charge of the drummers in a military band, or who leads the band when they are marching.
A drum major is a man who leads a marching band by walking in front of them.
A spinnaker is a large, light, triangular sail that is attached to the front mast of a boat.

ext.ext_cn: 员工人数从 21.7万减少到了11.4万。
ext.ext_en: The number of staff has declined from 217,000 to 114,000...

ext.ext_cn: 第一季度工人每小时的产量下降了 1.3%。
ext.ext_en: Hourly output by workers declined 1.3% in the first quarter...

defs.def_en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

ext.ext_cn: 他谢绝了他们的邀请。
ext.ext_en: He declined their invitation...

ext.ext_cn: 乐队拒绝对这一报道作任何评论。
ext.ext_en: The band declined to comment on the story...

defs.def_en: If you decline something or decline to do something, you politely refuse to accept it or do it.

ext.ext_cn: 注册人数终究还是没有出现如此大幅度的下降。
ext.ext_en: There wasn't such a big decline in enrollments after all...

ext.ext_cn: 公元5世纪时罗马的衰落
ext.ext_en: ...Rome's decline in the fifth century...

defs.def_en: If there is a decline in something, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or quality.

ext.ext_cn: 令人欣慰的是，吸烟量在逐渐下降。
ext.ext_en: Thankfully the smoking of cigarettes is on the decline...

ext.ext_cn: 他仍是世界上最受欢迎的高尔夫球选手之一，但他的球技日不如前。
ext.ext_en: He is still one of the world's most popular golfers, but his game is in decline.

defs.def_en: If you shower, you wash yourself by standing under a spray of water from a shower.

ext.ext_en: There'll be bright or sunny spells and scattered showers this afternoon.

ext.ext_en: Showers of sparks flew in all directions.

ext.ext_en: ...a baby shower.

defs.def_en: A shower is a party or celebration at which the guests bring gifts.

ext.ext_en: The festival remains a valuable showcase for new talent.

defs.def_en: You use showcase to refer to a situation or setting in which something is displayed or presented to its best advantage.

ext.ext_en: Restored films are being showcased this month at a festival in Paris.

defs.def_en: If something is showcased, it is displayed or presented to its best advantage.

ext.ext_cn: 她跟某一同事有染。
ext.ext_en: She was having an affair with someone at work.

defs.def_en: See also:love affair;If two people who are not married to each other have an affair, they have a sexual relationship.

ext.ext_en: He does not want to interfere in the internal affairs of another country...

ext.ext_en: With more details, here's our foreign affairs correspondent.

defs.def_en: See also:current affairs;state of affairs;You can use affairs to refer to all the important facts or activities that are connected with a particular subject.

ext.ext_en: He was rational and consistent in the conduct of his affairs...

ext.ext_en: The unexpectedness of my father's death meant that his affairs were not entirely in order.

defs.def_en: Your affairs are all the matters connected with your life which you consider to be private and normally deal with yourself.

ext.ext_en: If you wish to make a fool of yourself, that is your affair...

ext.ext_en: Pamela knew she was a good student, and that was not just a conceit.

ext.ext_en: Critics may complain that the novel's central conceit is rather simplistic.

defs.def_en: In literature, a conceit is a clever or unusual metaphor or comparison.

defs.def_cn: 有争议的;有疑问的;未定的

ext.ext_en: It is debatable whether or not antibiotics would make any difference...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is debatable, you mean that it is not certain.

ext.ext_cn: 黑市的食品价格

ext.ext_en: ...a tiny Nepalese hat embroidered with golden threads.

ext.ext_en: The thread running through many of these proposals was the theme of individual power and opportunity...

ext.ext_en: All religions are united by the common threads of fighting evil and helping others...

defs.def_en: If you thread your way through a group of people or things, or thread through it, you move through it carefully or slowly, changing direction frequently as you move.

defs.def_cn: 使(细长的物体)穿过;使穿进

ext.ext_cn: 把鞋带穿进他的鞋眼
ext.ext_en: ...threading the laces through the eyelets of his shoes...

ext.ext_cn: 通风管和电缆在这幢结构复杂的建筑物中穿过。
ext.ext_en: Air ducts and electrical cables were threaded through the complex structure...

defs.def_en: If you thread a long thin object through something, you pass it through one or more holes or narrow spaces.

ext.ext_cn: 把这些蘑菇擦干净，然后用线穿起来。
ext.ext_en: Wipe the mushrooms clean and thread them on a string.

defs.def_en: If you thread small objects such as beads onto a string or thread, you join them together by pushing the string through them.

ext.ext_cn: 我坐下来，穿好针，剪下一枚旧纽扣。
ext.ext_en: I sit down, thread a needle, snip off an old button.

defs.def_en: When you thread a needle, you put a piece of thread through the hole in the top of the needle in order to sew with it.

ext.ext_cn: 成千上万的强硬派分子走上街头示威，脆弱的和平局势危在旦夕。
ext.ext_en: The fragile peace was hanging by a thread as thousands of hardliners took to the streets.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is hanging by a thread, you mean that it is in a very uncertain state and is unlikely to survive or succeed.

defs.def_cn: (活动中断后)继续下去/(经历失败、霉运后)恢复生机

ext.ext_cn: 许多女性得以重操旧业。
ext.ext_en: Many women have been able to pick up the threads of their former career.

defs.def_en: If you pick up the threads of an activity, you start it again after an interruption. If you pick up the threads of your life, you become more active again after a period of failure or bad luck.

defs.def_cn: （常指用某种仪器）测量，测定，算出

ext.ext_cn: 他测出风速在30节以上。
ext.ext_en: He gauged the wind at over thirty knots...

ext.ext_cn: 距离以行程时间而非英里数来计算。
ext.ext_en: Distance is gauged by journey time rather than miles.

defs.def_en: If you gauge the speed or strength of something, or if you gauge an amount, you measure or calculate it, often by using a device of some kind.

ext.ext_cn: 温度计
ext.ext_en: ...temperature gauges.

ext.ext_cn: 压力计
ext.ext_en: ...pressure gauges.

defs.def_en: A gauge is a device that measures the amount or quantity of something and shows the amount measured.

defs.def_cn: 判断，判定（人的行动、情感或意图）

ext.ext_cn: 他在盘算着敌人可能的动向和自己的对策时
ext.ext_en: ...as he gauged possible enemy moves and his own responses...

ext.ext_cn: 从他对鸡毛蒜皮的小事的反应就可以判断出他的情绪。
ext.ext_en: His mood can be gauged by his reaction to the most trivial of incidents.

defs.def_en: If you gauge people's actions, feelings, or intentions in a particular situation, you carefully consider and judge them.

defs.def_cn: （评价或判断的）事实，依据，标准

ext.ext_cn: 这一指数是政府判断未来经济活动的主要依据。
ext.ext_en: The index is the government's chief gauge of future economic activity.

defs.def_en: A gauge of someone's feelings or a situation is a fact or event that can be used to judge them.

ext.ext_cn: 窄轨铁路
ext.ext_en: ...a narrow gauge railway.

defs.def_en: A gauge is the distance between the two rails on a railway line.

defs.def_cn: （金属等的）厚度；（金属丝等的）直径
defs.def_en: A gauge is the thickness of something, especially metal or wire.

ext.ext_cn: 草莓奶昔
ext.ext_en: ...a strawberry milkshake.

defs.def_en: A milkshake is a cold drink made by mixing milk with a flavouring or fruit, and sometimes ice cream.

defs.def_cn: 最外面的；离中心最远的

ext.ext_cn: 每间屋最远的角落
ext.ext_en: ...the outermost corners of each room.

ext.ext_cn: 已知最外围的行星海王星
ext.ext_en: ...Neptune, the outermost known planet.

defs.def_en: The outermost thing in a group is the one that is furthest from the centre.

ext.ext_cn: 远期目标必须是将核武器尽数销毁。
ext.ext_en: The long-range goal must be to do away with nuclear weapons altogether.

defs.def_en: To do away with something means to remove it completely or put an end to it.

ext.ext_cn: 一个被丈夫几次三番下毒手的女人
ext.ext_en: ...a woman whose husband had made several attempts to do away with her.

defs.def_en: If one person does away with another, the first murders the second. If you do away with yourself, you kill yourself.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 堂吉诃德式的;幻想的;不切实际的;空想的

ext.ext_cn: 他生活中一直遵循一种完全不切实际的堂吉诃德式的道德准则。
ext.ext_en: He has always lived his life by a hopelessly quixotic code of honour.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's ideas or plans as quixotic, you mean that they are imaginative or hopeful but unrealistic.

ext.ext_cn: 我想喝点什么。
ext.ext_en: I want a drink...

ext.ext_cn: 伊恩很清楚他需要什么样的生活。
ext.ext_en: Ian knows exactly what he wants in life...

defs.def_en: If you want something, you feel a desire or a need for it.

ext.ext_cn: 我想说你怀孕了我有多高兴。
ext.ext_en: I want to say how really delighted I am that you're having a baby...

ext.ext_cn: 听我说，我想就今天的事向你道歉。我觉得我对你有点过于苛刻了。
ext.ext_en: Look, I wanted to apologize for today. I think I was a little hard on you.

defs.def_en: You can say that you want to say something to indicate that you are about to say it.

defs.def_cn: (用于疑问句中表示提议或邀请)想要，需要

ext.ext_cn: 你想再来一杯咖啡吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you want another cup of coffee?...

ext.ext_cn: 你想把自行车停在这里吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you want to leave your bike here?

defs.def_en: You use want in questions as a way of making an offer or inviting someone to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 杰里米，我需要你解释一下。
ext.ext_en: I want an explanation from you, Jeremy...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你有异议，我要你马上告诉我。
ext.ext_en: If you have a problem with that, I want you to tell me right now...

defs.def_en: If you say to someone that you want something, or ask them if they want to do it, you are firmly telling them what you want or what you want them to do.

ext.ext_cn: 窗户该擦了。
ext.ext_en: The windows wanted cleaning...

ext.ext_cn: 她该剪头发了。
ext.ext_en: Her hair wants cutting.

defs.def_en: If you say that something wants doing, you think that it needs to be done.

ext.ext_cn: 你应当格外小心，别与克雷弗克这样的人为敌。
ext.ext_en: You want to be very careful not to have a man like Crevecoeur for an enemy...

ext.ext_cn: 伙计，你应当看看你要去哪里。
ext.ext_en: You want to look where you're going, mate.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone that they want to do a particular thing, you are advising them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们被警方通缉。
ext.ext_en: They were wanted by the police...

ext.ext_cn: 他那个时候杀了很多人，现在至少有3个国家在通缉他。
ext.ext_en: He has killed many in his time, and is wanted in at least three countries...

defs.def_en: If someone is wanted by the police, the police are searching for them because they are thought to have committed a crime.

ext.ext_cn: 亲爱的，过来。我想要你。
ext.ext_en: Come on, darling. I want you.

defs.def_en: If you want someone, you have a great desire to have sex with them.

ext.ext_cn: 应当好好照看孩子，并为他们规划一生。
ext.ext_en: Children should be wanted and planned...

ext.ext_cn: 我很爱这个小宝贝，因为它肯定是我最后一个孩子了。
ext.ext_en: I want this baby very much, because it certainly will be the last.

defs.def_en: If a child is wanted, its mother or another person loves it and is willing to look after it.

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔比要你去他办公室。
ext.ext_en: Albie wants you in his office...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不想要她做司法部长。
ext.ext_en: They didn't want her as attorney general...

defs.def_en: If someone wants you in a particular place or role, they desire you to be in that place or role.

ext.ext_cn: 缺乏风度和魅力
ext.ext_en: ...a want of manners and charm...

ext.ext_cn: 由于缺乏休息，这些男人日渐虚弱。
ext.ext_en: The men were daily becoming weaker from want of rest.

defs.def_en: A want of something is a lack of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他说他们在为言论自由而战，为信仰自由而战，为远离贫困而战。
ext.ext_en: He said they were fighting for freedom of speech, freedom of worship, and freedom from want.

defs.def_en: Want is the state of being extremely poor.

ext.ext_cn: 要是没有仆人事先想她所想并为她准备妥当，她连汤匙也举不起来。
ext.ext_en: She couldn't lift a spoon without a servant anticipating her wants and getting it for her...

ext.ext_cn: 超市经常声称他们根据消费者的需要提供包装食品。
ext.ext_en: Supermarkets often claim that they are responding to the wants of consumers by providing packaged foods.

defs.def_en: Your wants are the things that you want.

ext.ext_cn: 因为没有更好的工作，他们当中很多人做了教师。
ext.ext_en: Many of them had gone into teaching for want of anything better to do...

ext.ext_cn: 还有一种情感，由于找不到更好的字眼来描绘，他称它为悲痛。
ext.ext_en: There was another emotion, and for want of a better word he called it grief.

defs.def_en: If you do something for want of something else, you do it because the other thing is not available or not possible.

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽说如果你愿意，可以在这儿呆一宿。
ext.ext_en: Mary says you're welcome to stay the night if you want...

ext.ext_cn: “你想把它都看完吗？”——“是的，如果你愿意的话。”
ext.ext_en: 'Do you want to go through it all?' — 'Yeah, if you want.'

defs.def_en: You say if you want when you are making or agreeing to an offer or suggestion in a casual way.

ext.ext_cn: “我并不想显得自大，”劳伯特解释说，“但我有95%的成功把握。”
ext.ext_en: 'I don't want to appear big-headed,' explains Loubet, 'but I would say there is a 95% chance of success.'...

ext.ext_cn: 我并不想显得小气，但所有这些东西都必须从预算中开支。
ext.ext_en: Without wanting to sound mean about it, these things all have to come from a budget.

defs.def_en: People sometimes say 'I don't want to be rude', for example, or 'without wanting to be rude' as a way of apologizing or warning you when they are going to say something which might upset, annoy, or worry you.

defs.def_cn: (粗暴或生气地问)你想干什么？

ext.ext_cn: “你想干什么！”她粗野地低语道，“滚开。”
ext.ext_en: 'What do you want!' she whispered savagely. 'Get out.'...

ext.ext_cn: “伯尼来过电话。”——“他想干什么？”
ext.ext_en: 'Bernie's been on the phone.' — 'What does he want?'

defs.def_en: If you say to someone 'what do you want?', you are asking them in a rather rude or angry way why they have come to the place where you are or why they want to speak to you.

defs.def_cn: （尤指电子产品）最高档的，高端的，最昂贵的

ext.ext_cn: 高端个人计算机和计算机工作站
ext.ext_en: ...high-end personal computers and computer workstations.

defs.def_en: High-end products, especially electronic products, are the most expensive of their kind.

ext.ext_cn: 你确定锁了前门吗？
ext.ext_en: Are you sure you locked the front door?...

ext.ext_cn: 沃尔夫冈走向过道尽头锁着的那扇门。
ext.ext_en: Wolfgang moved along the corridor towards the locked door at the end.

defs.def_en: When you lock something such as a door, drawer, or case, you fasten it, usually with a key, so that other people cannot open it.

ext.ext_cn: 那一刻，他听见吉尔的钥匙开启门锁的声音。
ext.ext_en: At that moment he heard Gill's key turning in the lock of the door...

ext.ext_cn: 有人强行撬开落地窗上的锁闯入屋里。
ext.ext_en: An intruder forced open a lock on French windows at the house.

defs.def_en: The lock on something such as a door or a drawer is the device which is used to keep it shut and prevent other people from opening it. Locks are opened with a key.

defs.def_cn: 把… 锁起妥藏；把…关起来

ext.ext_cn: 她的女佣把箱子锁进保险柜里。
ext.ext_en: Her maid locked the case in the safe...

ext.ext_cn: 他们殴打了他们，并把他们锁在一间囚室里。
ext.ext_en: They beat them up and locked them in a cell.

defs.def_en: If you lock something or someone in a place, room, or container, you put them there and fasten the lock.

ext.ext_cn: 他仰靠在转椅上，十指交叉枕在脑后。
ext.ext_en: He leaned back in the swivel chair and locked his fingers behind his head...

ext.ext_cn: 随着液压系统嘎吱一声响，起落架进入了锁定位置。
ext.ext_en: There was a whine of hydraulics as the undercarriage locked into position.

defs.def_en: If you lock something in a particular position or if it lock there, it is held or fitted firmly in that position.

On a canal or river, a lock is a place where walls have been built with gates at each end so that boats can move to a higher or lower section of the canal or river, by gradually changing the water level inside the gates.

ext.ext_cn: 她撩开他脑门上的一绺头发。
ext.ext_en: She brushed a lock of hair off his forehead.

defs.def_en: A lock of hair is a small bunch of hairs on your head that grow together and curl or curve in the same direction.

ext.ext_cn: 留着长长卷发的女人们
ext.ext_en: ...women with long, wavy locks.

defs.def_en: Your locks are your hair.

ext.ext_cn: 这些书一般妥善锁藏在图书馆的地窖里。
ext.ext_en: The books were normally kept under lock and key in the library vault...

ext.ext_cn: 他眼下被关押在利兹的伊斯特穆尔保安部。
ext.ext_en: He is currently under lock and key at Eastmoor secure unit in Leeds.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is kept under lock and key, they are in a container or room which has been securely locked.
In fairy stories, a sorcerer is a person who performs magic by using the power of evil spirits.

ext.ext_cn: 她的导论是客观公正的典范，是对爱尔兰历史的生动概括。
ext.ext_en: Her introduction is a model of fairness, a lively summation of Irish history.

defs.def_en: A summation is a summary of what someone has said or done.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 加了香料的;加了佐料的

ext.ext_cn: 端上来的每道菜都加了很多佐料。
ext.ext_en: Every dish was served heavily spiced.

ext.ext_cn: 加了鲜美调料的酱汁
ext.ext_en: ...delicately spiced sauces.

defs.def_en: Food that is spiced has had spices or other strong-tasting foods added to it.
A skylight is a window in a roof.

ext.ext_cn: 看到雪,许多女孩似乎一下子变得兴奋起来。
ext.ext_en: Many of the girls seemed to be infused with excitement on seeing the snow...

ext.ext_cn: 工会会把不必要的冲突带入公司员工关系当中。
ext.ext_en: A union would infuse unnecessary conflict into the company's employee relations.

defs.def_en: To infuse a quality into someone or something, or to infuse them with a quality, means to fill them with it.

ext.ext_cn: 那个地方散发着一种奇特的气质。
ext.ext_en: A strange spirit infused the place.

defs.def_en: If a quality infuses something, every part of that thing has that quality.

ext.ext_cn: 浸泡草药根沏成的茶水
ext.ext_en: ...teas made by infusing the roots of herbs...

ext.ext_cn: 草药大夫把花朵浸泡到油里。
ext.ext_en: Herbalists infuse the flowers in oil...

defs.def_en: If you infuse things such as tea leaves or herbs, or allow them to infuse, you put them in hot water for some time so that the water absorbs their flavour. You can also infuse things in other liquids.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对不起,我太不小心了。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry. How careless of me...

ext.ext_cn: 有些当妈妈的花钱有点随意。
ext.ext_en: Some mothers were a bit careless with money...

defs.def_en: If you are careless, you do not pay enough attention to what you are doing, and so you make mistakes, or cause harm or damage.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 当同事身处危险时他表现英勇，不顾个人安危。
ext.ext_en: He had shown himself careless of personal safety where the life of his colleagues might be at risk...

ext.ext_cn: 她不注意个人卫生。
ext.ext_en: She's careless about her hygiene...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is careless of something such as their health or appearance, you mean that they do not seem to be concerned about it, or do nothing to keep it in a good condition.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他手腕轻轻一抖,球就飞出去了。
ext.ext_en: With a careless flip of his wrists, he sent the ball quickly on its way.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's movements as careless, you mean that they are relaxed or confident, and do not seem to require much effort or thought.

defs.def_cn: (英国的)售旗募捐日，旗日，公益募捐日
defs.def_en: In Britain, a flag day is a day on which people collect money for a charity from people in the street. People are given a small sticker to wear to show that they have given money.

A combining form is a word that is used, or used with a particular meaning, only when joined to another word. For example, '-legged' as in 'four-legged' and '-fold' as in 'fivefold' are combining forms.

defs.def_cn: 男爵（贵族爵位中最低的一级）

ext.ext_cn: 他们的继父，迈克尔·迪斯腾普尔男爵
ext.ext_en: ...their stepfather, Baron Michael Distemple.

defs.def_en: A baron is a man who is a member of the lowest rank of the nobility.

ext.ext_cn: 打击毒枭之战
ext.ext_en: ...the battle against the drug barons.

ext.ext_cn: 英国新闻业巨子
ext.ext_en: ...the British press barons.

defs.def_en: You can use baron to refer to someone who controls a large amount of a particular industry or activity and who is therefore extremely powerful.

Soccer is a game played by two teams of eleven players using a round ball. Players kick the ball to each other and try to score goals by kicking the ball into a large net. Outside the USA, this game is also referred to as football .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 上校微弱的声音几不可闻。
ext.ext_en: The Co-lonel's voice was barely audible...

ext.ext_cn: 听得出来松了一口气。
ext.ext_en: There was an audible sigh of relief.

defs.def_en: A sound that is audible is loud enough to be heard.

ext.ext_cn: 整个食物链因农业中过度使用化学物质而受到影响。
ext.ext_en: The whole food chain is affected by the over use of chemicals in agriculture.

defs.def_en: The food chain is a series of living things which are linked to each other because each thing feeds on the one next to it in the series.
A Klansman is a man who is a member of the Ku Klux Klan .

defs.def_cn: （价格等）达到最低点，停止恶化

ext.ext_cn: 他预期经济萧条将见底。
ext.ext_en: He expects the recession to bottom out...

ext.ext_cn: 房产价格已经止跌企稳。
ext.ext_en: House prices have bottomed out.

defs.def_en: If a trend such as a fall in prices bottoms out, it stops getting worse or decreasing, and remains at a particular level or amount.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在我看来这起罪行是可以预见的，死亡也是本可避免的。
ext.ext_en: It seems to me that this crime was foreseeable and this death preventable...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的法律体系的原则之一是人们要对他们可以预见的行为后果负责。
ext.ext_en: One of the principles of our legal system is that people are accountable for the foreseeable consequences of their actions.

defs.def_en: If a future event is foreseeable, you know that it will happen or that it can happen, because it is a natural or obvious consequence of something else that you know.

ext.ext_cn: 利润和红利的增长看上去会在较长时间内维持在平均水平之上。
ext.ext_en: Profit and dividend growth looks like being above average for the foreseeable future.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen for the foreseeable future, you think that it will continue to happen for a long time.

defs.def_cn: 在可预见的未来;不久;很快

ext.ext_cn: 那么，他们最终会在不久的将来举行自由选举吗？
ext.ext_en: So, might they finally have free elections in the foreseeable future?

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen in the foreseeable future you mean that you think it will happen fairly soon.

ext.ext_cn: 这其中的原因在于视神经是大脑的一部分。
ext.ext_en: The reason for this is that the optic nerve is a part of the brain.

defs.def_en: See also:optics;Optic means relating to the eyes or to sight.
Nectar is a sweet liquid produced by flowers, which bees and other insects collect.

defs.def_cn: 甘露;(尤指酒类)琼浆玉液

ext.ext_cn: 托尼从杯中抿了一口感叹道：“哇，人间美味啊，神灵的琼浆玉液呀，天赐之物，太棒了。”
ext.ext_en: Tony sipped from his glass. 'Mmm. Ambrosia. Nectar of the gods. Divine. Wonderful.'

defs.def_en: If you refer to a drink, especially an alcoholic drink, as nectar, you think it tastes very nice.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无价的；极贵重的；极为昂贵的

ext.ext_cn: 它们是独一无二、不可替代的无价之宝。
ext.ext_en: They are priceless, unique and irreplaceable.

ext.ext_cn: 英国王室收藏的无价珍宝
ext.ext_en: ...the priceless treasures of the Royal Collection.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is priceless, you are emphasizing that it is worth a very large amount of money.

ext.ext_en: His fellow students had found him too ingratiating.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or their behaviour as ingratiating, you mean that they try to make people like them.

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰克以恳求的眼神看着吉姆。
ext.ext_en: Frank looked at Jim with imploring eyes.

defs.def_en: An imploring look, cry, or letter shows that you very much want someone to do something and are afraid they may not do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自我贬低的;过分谦虚的

ext.ext_cn: 沙伦以幽默自嘲的口吻讲述那一夜的故事。
ext.ext_en: Sharon tells the story of that night with self-deprecating humour.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as self-deprecating, you mean that they criticize themselves or represent themselves as foolish in a light-hearted way.

defs.def_cn: 欺骗；误导；吓唬；虚张声势

ext.ext_cn: 这封信不过是吓唬人罢了。
ext.ext_en: The letter was a bluff...

ext.ext_cn: 关键是要做好采取军事行动的准备，以表明这不是虚张声势。
ext.ext_en: It is essential to build up the military option and show that this is not a bluff...

defs.def_en: See also:double bluff;A bluff is an attempt to make someone believe that you will do something when you do not really intend to do it.

defs.def_cn: （因料到对方不敢行动而）要求…摊牌，接受…的挑战

ext.ext_cn: 社会党人已经决定接受对方的挑战。
ext.ext_en: The Socialists have decided to call the opposition's bluff.

defs.def_en: If you call someone's  bluff, you tell them to do what they have been threatening to do, because you are sure that they will not really do it.

defs.def_cn: 欺骗；误导；吓唬；虚张声势

ext.ext_cn: 任何一方，或者双方，都可能是在故弄玄虚。
ext.ext_en: Either side, or both, could be bluffing...

ext.ext_cn: 每一个案例中，劫机者都用了假手榴弹吓唬机组人员。
ext.ext_en: In each case the hijackers bluffed the crew using fake grenades...

defs.def_en: If you bluff, you make someone believe that you will do something when you do not really intend to do it, or that you know something when you do not really know it.

defs.def_cn: （尤指河边或海边的）悬崖，峭壁，陡岸

ext.ext_cn: 康加里河边高耸的峭壁
ext.ext_en: ...a high bluff over the Congaree River.

defs.def_en: A bluff is a steep cliff or bank, especially by a river or the sea.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他给人感觉是一个直来直去的人，但内心却让人捉摸不透。
ext.ext_en: He comes across as a man with a bluff exterior who, beyond that, is difficult to get to know...

ext.ext_cn: 他继续用一种直白而又诙谐生动的笔触描绘着约克郡的生活。
ext.ext_en: He has continued to write with a bluff, vivid humour about Yorkshire life.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone, usually a man, as bluff, you mean that they have a very direct way of speaking and behaving.

ext.ext_cn: 他视力不好，再也不能正常阅读了。
ext.ext_en: He suffered from poor eyesight and could no longer read properly.

defs.def_en: Your eyesight is your ability to see.

ext.ext_cn: 她出去了，留下雷切尔一个人除衣淋浴。
ext.ext_en: She went out, leaving Rachel to undress and have her shower...

ext.ext_cn: 她给孩子脱下衣服，然后把她放进锡铁澡盆里。
ext.ext_en: She undressed the child before putting her in the tin bath.

defs.def_en: When you undress or undress someone, you take off your clothes or someone else's clothes.  →see usage note at:wear

ext.ext_cn: 每个封面上都有一名裸体女子。
ext.ext_en: Every cover showed a woman in a state of undress.

defs.def_en: If someone is in a state of undress, they do not have all their clothes on.

ext.ext_cn: 有句格言说道，大致对总比完全错要好
ext.ext_en: ...the dictum that it is preferable to be roughly right than precisely wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 她提醒我们想想巴纳姆的名言：如果营销得力，你可以把任何东西卖给任何人。
ext.ext_en: She reminded us of Barnum's dictum: You could sell anything to anybody if you marketed it right.

defs.def_en: A dictum is a saying that describes an aspect of life in an interesting or wise way.

ext.ext_cn: 迪斯雷利的声明——政府必须把民众的健康当作第一要务
ext.ext_en: ...Disraeli's dictum that the first priority of the government must be the health of the people.

defs.def_en: A dictum is a formal statement made by someone who has authority.

ext.ext_cn: 这对夫妇花了几千元来翻新房子。
ext.ext_en: The couple spent thousands renovating the house...

ext.ext_cn: 她住在一个宽敞的翻新过的农舍里。
ext.ext_en: She lives in a large, renovated farmhouse.

defs.def_en: If someone renovates an old building, they repair and improve it and get it back into good condition.
A gene is the part of a cell in a living thing which controls its physical characteristics, growth, and development.

defs.def_cn: 有疗效的;药用的;治病的

ext.ext_cn: 药用植物
ext.ext_en: ...medicinal plants.

defs.def_en: Medicinal substances or substances with medicinal effects can be used to treat and cure illnesses.

defs.def_cn: (重要活动的)开始日，启动日，实施日

ext.ext_cn: 我定在 6 月 29 日启程。
ext.ext_en: D-day for my departure was set for 29th June.

defs.def_en: You can use D-day to refer to the day that is chosen for the beginning of an important activity.

ext.ext_cn: 她直到晚上才开始打字。
ext.ext_en: She didn't do any typing till the evening.

defs.def_en: Typing is the work or activity of typing something by means of a typewriter or word processor.

ext.ext_cn: 我的打字水平非常差。
ext.ext_en: My typing is quite dreadful...

ext.ext_cn: 金尼试图重拾生疏了的打字技术。
ext.ext_en: Ginny tried to sharpen up some rusty typing skills.

defs.def_en: Typing is the skill of using a typewriter or keyboard quickly and accurately.

ext.ext_cn: 传统卫道士们也许会叫嚣反对，但在当今世界，文化相对论确实是占据着统治地位。
ext.ext_en: Traditionalists may howl, but in today's world, cultural relativism rules...

ext.ext_cn: 贝内特发起了一场捍卫“道德价值”、反对腐朽堕落的“自由相对论”的战争。
ext.ext_en: Bennett launched a crusade for 'moral values' against decadent 'liberal relativism.'

defs.def_en: Relativism is the belief that the truth is not always the same but varies according to circumstances.

defs.def_cn: （电子仪器发出的）哔哔声，嘟嘟声，短促尖锐的声音
defs.def_en: A bleep is a short, high-pitched sound, usually one of a series, that is made by an electrical device.

defs.def_cn: 发出哔哔声；发出嘟嘟声；发出短促尖锐的声音

ext.ext_cn: 当我们把船调头的时候，信号器又不停地发出哔哔声。
ext.ext_en: When we turned the boat about, the signal began to bleep again constantly.

defs.def_en: If something electronic bleeps, it makes a short, high-pitched sound.

defs.def_cn: (家具、装备等)折叠式的，可折叠的

ext.ext_cn: 折叠床
ext.ext_en: ...a fold-up bed.

defs.def_en: A fold-up piece of furniture or equipment is one that is specially designed so that it can be folded into a smaller shape in order to be stored.

ext.ext_cn: 流动记者
ext.ext_en: ...a roving reporter...

ext.ext_cn: 这些孩子被迫流浪街头，结成了一些流窜的犯罪团伙。
ext.ext_en: Left to raise themselves on the streets, these children form roving bands of delinquents.

defs.def_en: You use roving to describe a person who travels around, rather than staying in a fixed place.
If you say that a man has a roving eye, you are criticizing him for continually paying attention to different women.

defs.pos_cn: 与形容词，可数名词构成的词
defs.def_cn: (与数词连用构成形容词和名词)表示“有…个座位的”，“可容纳…人的事物”

ext.ext_cn: 一辆双座跑车
ext.ext_en: ...a two-seater sports car.

ext.ext_cn: 能坐 3 个人的沙发
ext.ext_en: ...a three-seater sofa...

defs.def_en: See also:all-seater;-seater combines with numbers to form adjectives and nouns which indicate how many people something such as a car has seats for.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为或时刻)有重大影响的(常指负面影响)，决定性的

ext.ext_cn: 这是一项将会让政府垮台的重大决定。
ext.ext_en: It was a fateful decision, one which was to break the Government.

defs.def_en: If an action or a time when something happened is described as fateful, it is considered to have an important, and often very bad, effect on future events.

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼尔作为契约佣工来到马里兰州。
ext.ext_en: Daniel arrived in Maryland as an indentured servant.

defs.def_en: In the past, an indentured worker was one who was forced to work for someone for a period of time, because of an agreement made by people in authority.

ext.ext_cn: 他喝他的那杯茶。
ext.ext_en: He drank his cup of tea...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经不喝啤酒了,开始喝龙舌兰酒了。
ext.ext_en: They'd stopped drinking beer and started on tequila...

defs.def_en: When you drink a liquid, you take it into your mouth and swallow it.

ext.ext_cn: 他嗜烟酗酒。
ext.ext_en: He was smoking and drinking too much...

ext.ext_cn: 千万别搭喝了酒的司机开的车。
ext.ext_en: Never accept a ride with people who have been drinking.

defs.def_en: To drink means to drink alcohol.

ext.ext_cn: 我给你来杯水。
ext.ext_en: I'll get you a drink of water.

defs.def_en: A drink is an amount of a liquid which you drink.

ext.ext_cn: 辛苦了一天后她想喝上一杯。
ext.ext_en: She felt like a drink after a hard day.

defs.def_en: A drink is an alcoholic drink.

defs.def_cn: 酒(如啤酒、葡萄酒或威士忌)

ext.ext_cn: 酗酒有害健康。
ext.ext_en: Too much drink is bad for your health.

defs.def_en: Drink is alcohol, such as beer, wine, or whisky.

defs.def_cn: 醉得不省人事;烂醉如泥;酩酊大醉

ext.ext_cn: 我们喝廉价葡萄酒喝得酩酊大醉。
ext.ext_en: We drank ourselves into a stupor on cheap wine.

defs.def_en: If you drink yourself into a stupor or drink yourself into oblivion, you drink so much alcohol that you lose consciousness or fall deeply asleep.

defs.def_cn: 比…更能喝酒;酒量比…大;灌醉

ext.ext_cn: 16 岁的时候他就能把我灌醉了。
ext.ext_en: At sixteen he could drink me under the table.

defs.def_en: If someone drinks you under the table, they drink more alcohol than you are able to on a particular occasion.

ext.ext_cn: 他妻子过世后他就沉溺于酒中了。
ext.ext_en: He took to drink after his wife died.

defs.def_en: If someone takes to drink, they start to drink a lot of alcohol regularly, usually because they are depressed or worried about something.
People say 'I'll drink to that' to show that they agree with and approve of something that someone has just said.

ext.ext_cn: 她被故意排除在嘉宾名单之外。
ext.ext_en: She has been deliberately left off the guest list...

ext.ext_cn: 法官把沃尔什的名字从逮捕名单中拿掉了。
ext.ext_en: The judge left Walsh's  name off the list of those he wanted arrested.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is  left off a list, they are not included on that list.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都停下不吃了，低着头闲站着。
ext.ext_en: We all left off eating and stood about with bowed heads...

ext.ext_cn: 有些病人停止了治疗。
ext.ext_en: Some of the patients left off treatment.

defs.def_en: If someone leaves off doing something, they stop doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 卡罗琳是一名时装设计师。
ext.ext_en: Carolyne is a fashion designer.

defs.def_en: A designer is a person whose job is to design things by making drawings of them.

defs.def_cn: (服装、品牌等)由著名设计师设计的，标有设计师姓名的

ext.ext_cn: 他穿着著名设计师设计的服装，开着一部古董车。
ext.ext_en: He wears designer clothes and drives an antique car...

ext.ext_cn: 人们想买名牌是为了满足虚荣心。
ext.ext_en: People want to buy designer labels for snob value.

defs.def_en: Designer clothes or designer labels are expensive, fashionable clothes made by a famous designer, rather than being made in large quantities in a factory.

ext.ext_cn: 乱蓬蓬的头发和时兴的胡茬都很新潮。
ext.ext_en: Tousled hair and designer stubble are chic...

ext.ext_cn: 时尚的啤酒和流行的葡萄酒已经取代了老牌的英国啤酒。
ext.ext_en: Designer beers and trendy wines have replaced the good old British pint.

defs.def_en: You can use designer to describe things that are worn or bought because they are fashionable.

ext.ext_cn: 或许，他性格中不好的一面你还没有看见。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps there is a negative side to his character that you haven't seen yet...

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家的国民性是由移民形成的。
ext.ext_en: The character of this country has been formed by immigration.

defs.def_en: The  character of a person or place consists of all the qualities they have that make them distinct from other people or places.

ext.ext_cn: 他说，向英国宇航公司给予财政优惠未获证实。
ext.ext_en: The financial concessions granted to British Aerospace were, he said, of a precarious character...

ext.ext_cn: 那些国有农场从性质上讲是半军事的。
ext.ext_en: The state farms were semi-military in character.

defs.def_en: If something has a particular character, it has a particular quality.

defs.def_cn: (某地人具有的)特点，特色，特征

ext.ext_cn: 个性鲜明是英国人固有的、也是他们看重的特点。
ext.ext_en: Individuality is a valued and inherent part of the British character.

defs.def_en: You can use character to refer to the qualities that people from a particular place are believed to have.

ext.ext_cn: 就是那种勇气和决心使他成为如此了不起的人。
ext.ext_en: It's that kind of courage and determination that makes him such a remarkable character...

ext.ext_cn: 奈杰尔真是个可悲的人哪。
ext.ext_en: What a sad character that Nigel is.

defs.def_en: You use character to say what kind of person someone is. For example, if you say that someone is a strange character, you mean they are strange.

ext.ext_cn: 他开始对我进行一连串的人身攻击。
ext.ext_en: He's begun a series of personal attacks on my character...

ext.ext_cn: 巴特曼先生品德高尚。
ext.ext_en: Mr Bartman was a man of good character.

defs.def_en: Your character is your personality,  especially how reliable and honest you are. If someone is of good character, they are reliable and honest. If they are of bad character, they are unreliable and dishonest.

ext.ext_cn: 她在努力获得民众的支持时，表现出真正的人格力量。
ext.ext_en: She showed real character in her attempts to win over the crowd...

ext.ext_cn: 我当时不知道罗恩有那么坚强的个性。
ext.ext_en: I didn't know Ron had that much strength of character.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has character, you mean that they have the ability to deal effectively with difficult, unpleasant, or dangerous situations.

ext.ext_cn: 一座难看的购物中心对面，耸立着为数不多的几幢别具特色的大楼之一。
ext.ext_en: An ugly shopping centre stands across from one of the few buildings with character.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place has character, you mean that it has an interesting or unusual quality which makes you notice it and like it.

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影是自传体，其中的主角由科勒德亲自扮演。
ext.ext_en: The film is autobiographical and the central character is played by Collard himself...

ext.ext_cn: 他让个个角色都逼真可信。
ext.ext_en: He's made the characters believable.

defs.def_en: The characters in a film, book, or play are the people that it is about.

defs.def_cn: 有趣的人;怪人;滑稽的人

ext.ext_cn: 人们会非常怀念他的，他可真是个有趣的人啊。
ext.ext_en: He'll be sadly missed. He was a real character.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a character, you mean that they are interesting, unusual, or amusing.
A character is a letter, number, or other symbol that is written or printed.

defs.def_cn: 符合/不符合…的性格(或特点)

ext.ext_cn: 把自己的婴孩放在第一位，这完全符合雷切尔的性格。
ext.ext_en: It was entirely in character for Rachel to put her baby first...

ext.ext_cn: 还有什么能让他做出这种如此失常的行为来？
ext.ext_en: What else could make him behave so out of character?

defs.def_en: If someone's actions are in character, they are doing what you would expect them to do, knowing what kind of person they are. If their actions are out of character, they are not doing what you would expect them to do.

defs.def_cn: (拿薪水却很少工作或担负责任的)闲职，挂名职位

ext.ext_cn: 她给他找了一个级别很高的闲职：国会图书馆研究员。
ext.ext_en: She found him an exalted sinecure as a Fellow of the Library of Congress.

ext.ext_cn: 在一家大型法律事务所从事的悠闲自得的肥差
ext.ext_en: ...a lucrative sinecure with a big law firm.

defs.def_en: A sinecure is a job for which you receive payment but which does not involve much work or responsibility.
A generator is a machine which produces electricity.

defs.def_cn: 促使…发生的人（或事物）；产生者

ext.ext_cn: 美国经济依然在创造着数量惊人的新就业机会。
ext.ext_en: The US economy is still an impressive generator of new jobs...

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司盈利状况一直相当好。
ext.ext_en: The company has been a very good cash generator.

defs.def_en: A generator of something is a person, organization, product, or situation which produces it or causes it to happen.
A doghouse is a small building made especially for a dog to sleep in.

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫因让她独自应付把她惹毛了。
ext.ext_en: Her husband was in the doghouse for leaving her to cope on her own.

defs.def_en: If you are in the doghouse, people are annoyed or angry with you.

ext.ext_cn: 本系列丛书将包括小说和非小说类纪实文学作品。
ext.ext_en: The series will include both fiction and non-fiction...

ext.ext_cn: 刘易斯写了13本小说和10本纪实文学作品。
ext.ext_en: Lewis is the author of thirteen novels and ten non-fiction books.

defs.def_en: Non-fiction is writing that gives information or describes real events, rather than telling a story.
A goalpost is one of the two upright wooden posts that are connected by a crossbar and form the goal in games such as football and rugby.

ext.ext_cn: 好像每当我达到规定条件时，他们就改变规则。
ext.ext_en: They seem to move the goal posts every time I meet the conditions which are required.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of moving the goalposts, you mean that they have changed the rules in a situation or an activity, in order to gain an advantage for themselves and to make things difficult for other people.

ext.ext_cn: 额外聘请员工以及随之发生的食宿费用等实际估算下来为每年918万英镑。
ext.ext_en: The actual estimate for extra staff and consequential costs such as accommodation was an annual £9.18m.

defs.def_en: Consequential means the same as consequent .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这一新的转变至少和那次一样重要。
ext.ext_en: This new transformation is at least as consequential as that one was...

ext.ext_cn: 从医学的角度来看，耽误一个星期通常并无大碍。
ext.ext_en: From a medical standpoint a week is usually not a consequential delay.

defs.def_en: Something that is consequential is important or significant.

defs.def_cn: 地球，世界（用于强调其广大或某事在许多地区发生）

ext.ext_cn: 来自世界各个角落的一瓶瓶啤酒
ext.ext_en: ...bottles of beer from every corner of the globe...

ext.ext_cn: 地球表面70%的地方覆盖着水。
ext.ext_en: 70% of our globe's  surface is water.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the world as the globe when you are emphasizing how big it is or that something happens in many different parts of it.

ext.ext_cn: 世界地球仪
ext.ext_en: ...a globe of the world...

ext.ext_cn: 3个巨大的地球仪立在地板上。
ext.ext_en: Three large globes stand on the floor.

defs.def_en: A globe is a ball-shaped object with a map of the world on it. It is usually fixed on a stand.

ext.ext_cn: 现在，顶灯已装上了一个白色球状罩子。
ext.ext_en: The overhead light was covered now with a white globe.

defs.def_en: Any ball-shaped object can be referred to as a globe .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 埃米的鞋子根本不适合走路。
ext.ext_en: Amy's shoes were unsuitable for walking any distance.

ext.ext_cn: 消除车流量不宜过大的城镇和乡村的交通拥挤局面
ext.ext_en: ...taking heavy traffic out of unsuitable towns and villages.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is unsuitable for a particular purpose or situation does not have the right qualities for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他沉浸在自己的过度纵欲中。
ext.ext_en: He was indulging his own sexual proclivities.

ext.ext_cn: 好做白日梦
ext.ext_en: ...a proclivity to daydream.

defs.def_en: A proclivity is a tendency to behave in a particular way or to like a particular thing, often a bad way or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 运送食品和医疗用品的联合国车队
ext.ext_en: ...a U.N. convoy carrying food and medical supplies...

ext.ext_cn: 人道主义援助车队
ext.ext_en: ...humanitarian relief convoys...

defs.def_en: A convoy is a group of vehicles or ships travelling together.

ext.ext_cn: 他命令联合舰队将军队护送到那不勒斯。
ext.ext_en: He ordered the combined fleet to convoy troops to Naples.

defs.def_en: To convoy goods or people somewhere means to move them there in a convoy.
A duffel is the same as a duffel coat .
A duffel is the same as a duffel bag .

ext.ext_cn: 使人类彰显高尚的经久不衰的人生基本准则
ext.ext_en: ...the enduring fundamental principles of life that ennoble mankind.

defs.def_en: To ennoble someone or something means to make them more dignified and morally better.

ext.ext_cn: 被封为贵族的金融家之子
ext.ext_en: ...the son of a financier who had been ennobled.

ext.ext_cn: 新近被封为贵族的阿彻男爵
ext.ext_en: ...the newly ennobled Lord Archer.

defs.def_en: If someone is ennobled, they are made a member of the nobility.

ext.ext_cn: 暴雨和大水淹死了许多牲口。
ext.ext_en: The heavy rains and flooding killed scores of livestock.

defs.def_en: Animals such as cattle and sheep which are kept on a farm are referred to as livestock.

ext.ext_cn: 他疲惫的心继续沉溺于自哀自怜之中。
ext.ext_en: His tired mind continued to wallow in self-pity...

ext.ext_cn: 我只想沉湎于自己的悲伤中。
ext.ext_en: I wanted only to wallow in my own grief.

ext.ext_cn: 我从来没找到过如此好的理由，可以美美地泡个热水澡。
ext.ext_en: Never have I had such a good excuse for wallowing in deep warm baths...

ext.ext_cn: 狗喜欢在泥水洼里扑腾，河马则喜欢在其中打滚撒欢儿。
ext.ext_en: Dogs love splashing in mud and hippos wallow in it.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal wallows in water or mud, they lie or roll about in it slowly for pleasure.

defs.def_cn: 使震惊;使惊呆;使惊愕;使神志不清

ext.ext_cn: 他的一边脑袋上猛地挨了一掌，使他顿时觉得晕头转向，昏天黑地
ext.ext_en: ...a violent slap on the side of the head, which stunned and stupefied him.

defs.def_en: If something stupefies you, it shocks or surprises you so much that you cannot think properly for a while.

ext.ext_cn: 开始之前,他把所有要留下的东西列了详细的清单。
ext.ext_en: Before starting, he made an inventory of everything that was to stay.

ext.ext_cn: 每艘快艇 12 张帆的储备
ext.ext_en: ...one inventory of twelve sails for each yacht.

defs.def_en: An inventory is a supply or stock of something.

defs.def_cn: (通常指男性)消防队员，救火队员
defs.def_en: A fireman is a person, usually a man, whose job is to put out fires.
A regiment is a large group of soldiers that is commanded by a colonel.

ext.ext_cn: 可以满足一大批饥饿的顾客的高能量食品
ext.ext_en: ...robust food, good enough to satisfy a regiment of hungry customers.

defs.def_en: A regiment of people is a large number of them.
A companionway is a staircase or ladder that leads from one deck to another on a ship.

ext.ext_cn: 贩毒集团
ext.ext_en: ...a drug cartel...

ext.ext_cn: 自1993年以来,由沙特阿拉伯主导的石油输出国组织欧佩克就一直将石油产量控制在每天2,500万桶左右。
ext.ext_en: Since 1993 OPEC, the oil cartel dominated by Saudi Arabia, has kept its output constant at around 25m barrels a day.

defs.def_en: A cartel is an association of similar companies or businesses that have grouped together in order to prevent competition and to control prices.

defs.def_cn: 干完(任期);执行完(合同);服满(刑期)

ext.ext_cn: 州长已宣称自己是清白的，并说他打算任职到期满。
ext.ext_en: The governor has declared his innocence and says he plans to serve out his term...

ext.ext_cn: 我只能服满刑期。
ext.ext_en: I was resigned to serving out the sentence.

defs.def_en: If someone serves out their term of office, contract, or prison sentence, they do not leave before the end of the agreed period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 索菲的脸渐渐地不那么红了。
ext.ext_en: Slowly the redness left Sophie's face.

defs.def_en: Redness is the quality of being red.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第 6 个字母
defs.def_en: F is the sixth letter of the English  alphabet.

defs.def_cn: C 大调音阶中的第四个音;F 音
defs.def_en: In music, F is the fourth note in the scale of C major.

defs.def_cn: (置于表示页码或行数的数字后)见第…页(或行)及下页(或下行)(ff. 则表示见第…页(或行)及以下各页(或以下各行))
defs.def_en: f. is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'following'. It is written after a page or line number to indicate that you are referring to both the page or line mentioned and the one after it. You use ff. when you are referring to the page or line mentioned and two or more pages or lines after it.

defs.def_cn: (用于首字母为 f 的一些单词的书面缩写形式，如female, feminine, franc, false 和 Fahrenheit)

ext.ext_cn: 将炉温升至 400 华氏度。
ext.ext_en: Heat the oven to 400 degrees F.

defs.def_en: F or f is a written abbreviation for words beginning with f, such as 'female', 'feminine', 'franc', 'false', and 'Fahrenheit'.
In a piece of music, f is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) forte and indicates that the piece should be played loudly.

defs.def_cn: 使恼火;使困惑;使伤脑筋

ext.ext_cn: 一想到别人在背后说我闲话，我就很恼火。
ext.ext_en: It vexed me to think of others gossiping behind my back...

ext.ext_cn: 有关她的一切都令他困惑。
ext.ext_en: Everything about her vexed him.

defs.def_en: If someone or something vexes you, they make you feel annoyed, puzzled, and frustrated.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 发狂的;狂躁的;非常激动的

ext.ext_cn: 他真的疯了一般。
ext.ext_en: He was really manic...

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎有一股近乎疯狂的劲头。
ext.ext_en: He seemed to have an almost manic energy.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as manic, you mean that they do things extremely quickly or energetically, often because they are very excited or anxious about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （微笑、笑声或幽默）过度的，失常的

ext.ext_cn: 傻笑
ext.ext_en: ...a manic grin.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's smile, laughter, or sense of humour as manic, you mean that it seems excessive or strange, as if they were insane.
The tusks of an elephant, wild boar, or walrus are its two very long, curved, pointed teeth.

defs.def_cn: 与他人格格不入的人;行为怪异的人

ext.ext_cn: 因为不想要孩子，让我感到自己在社会和心理上与别人格格不入。
ext.ext_en: I have been made to feel a social and psychological misfit for not wanting children.

defs.def_en: A misfit is a person who is not easily accepted by other people, often because their behaviour is very different from that of everyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 他们可能打出这样的竞选口号：“我们会让您少出钱”。
ext.ext_en: They could campaign on the slogan 'We'll take less of your money'.

ext.ext_cn: 一群高呼口号的愤怒的示威者
ext.ext_en: ...a group of angry demonstrators shouting slogans.

defs.def_en: A slogan is a short phrase that is easy to remember. Slogans are used in advertisements and by political parties and other organizations who want people to remember what they are saying or selling.

ext.ext_cn: 国王患有心脏病。
ext.ext_en: The king was suffering from cardiac weakness.

defs.def_en: Cardiac means relating to the heart.

ext.ext_cn: 4名警官在爆炸中受重伤。
ext.ext_en: Four police officers sustained serious injuries in the explosion...

ext.ext_cn: 另外两名乘客逃过一劫，未受重伤。
ext.ext_en: The two other passengers escaped serious injury.

defs.def_en: An injury is damage done to a person's or an animal's body.  →see usage note at:wound

ext.ext_cn: 她判得 3,500 英镑精神损失赔偿。
ext.ext_en: She was awarded £3,500 for injury to her feelings.

defs.def_en: If someone suffers injury to their feelings, they are badly upset by something. If they suffer injury to their reputation, their reputation is seriously harmed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: They were uncertain of the total value of the transaction...

defs.def_en: If you are uncertain about something, you do not know what you should do, what is going to happen, or what the truth is about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 未知的；不明了的；不确定的

ext.ext_cn: 然而，这些共和国究竟能够提供多少切实可行的帮助还未可知。
ext.ext_en: How far the republics can give practical help, however, is uncertain...

ext.ext_en: It's uncertain whether they will accept the plan...

defs.def_en: If something is uncertain, it is not known or definite.

ext.ext_cn: 她明白无误地叫他离她远远的。
ext.ext_en: She told him in no uncertain terms to go away.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone tells a person something in no uncertain terms, you are emphasizing that they say it strongly and clearly so that there is no doubt about what they mean.

defs.def_cn: 食品加工机(用来混合、剁碎或搅拌食物)

ext.ext_cn: 非法广播电台
ext.ext_en: ...a pirate radio station.

defs.def_en: Pirate radio is the broadcasting of radio programmes illegally.

ext.ext_cn: 我的19岁生日
ext.ext_en: ...my nineteenth birthday.

ext.ext_cn: 19世纪
ext.ext_en: ...the nineteenth century.

defs.def_en: The nineteenth item in a series is the one that you count as number nineteen.
Largo written above a piece of music means that it should be played slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 爆炸后有毒化学物质可能会进入大气层。
ext.ext_en: There is a risk that toxic chemicals might be blasted into the atmosphere.

ext.ext_en: ...a terrible accident in which his  left arm was blasted off by some kind of a bomb...

defs.def_en: If something is blasted into a particular place or state, an explosion causes it to be in that place or state. If a hole is blasted in something, it is created by an explosion.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的工作是用葛里炸药炸石头，非常枯燥。
ext.ext_en: Their work was taken up with boring and blasting rock with gelignite...

ext.ext_cn: 他们用炸药炸石筑路。
ext.ext_en: They're  using dynamite to blast away rocks to put a road in.

defs.def_en: If workers are blasting rock, they are using explosives to make holes in it or destroy it, for example so that a road or tunnel can be built.

ext.ext_cn: 因从小到大一直被父亲虐待而开枪弑父的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a son who blasted his father to death after a lifetime of bullying...

ext.ext_en: The police were reported to have blasted their way into the house using explosives...

ext.ext_cn: 一个武装纵队试图从公交车和卡车组成的路障中间炸出一条通道来。
ext.ext_en: One armoured column attempted to blast a path through a barricade of buses and trucks.

ext.ext_cn: 向它喷射冷空气可以使水蒸发。
ext.ext_en: Blasting cold air over it makes the water evaporate...

ext.ext_cn: 暴风雪夹着大团的积雪吹过湖面。
ext.ext_en: A blizzard was blasting great drifts of snow across the lake.

defs.def_en: Ifsomething blasts water or air somewhere, it sends out a sudden, powerful stream of it.

ext.ext_en: The sound of western music blasted as she entered.

ext.ext_cn: 拉姆齐劲射入网。

defs.def_cn: 有趣的事；开心的事；乐趣

ext.ext_cn: 做这个专辑真是一种乐趣。
ext.ext_en: Making the album was a real blast.

defs.def_en: If you say that something was a blast, you mean that you enjoyed it very much.

ext.ext_en: In many of those homes the television is on full blast 24 hours a day...

ext.ext_en: You are unlikely to run the heater at full blast for long periods.

ext.ext_en: Scientists transmuted matter into pure energy and exploded the first atomic bomb.

defs.def_en: If something transmutes or is transmuted into a different form, it is changed into that form.

ext.ext_en: Get your body moving to boost energy, stay supple and shake off winter lethargy...

ext.ext_en: He was unaware that they had shaken off their pursuers.

ext.ext_cn: 她甩开了他的手。
ext.ext_en: She shook off his restraining hand.

defs.def_en: If you shake off someone who is touching you, you move your arm or body sharply so that they are no longer touching you.

ext.ext_cn: 我们沿着桥上狭窄的钢制格架往前爬。

ext.ext_cn: 他早期的性爱经历
ext.ext_en: ...his early romantic experiences...

ext.ext_cn: 他并没有兴趣和英格丽德发生性关系。

defs.def_en: Romantic means connected with sexual love.

ext.ext_en: ...romantic novels.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （事物）浪漫的，富有浪漫色彩的，充满浪漫气息的

In grammar, the past participle of a verb is a form that is usually the same as the past form and so ends in '-ed'. A number of verbs have irregular past participles, for example 'break' — past participle 'broken', and 'come' — past participle 'come'.
