A Frenchman is a man who comes from France.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 偏常的;反常的;离经叛道的

ext.ext_cn: 社会对偏常及犯罪行为的反应
ext.ext_en: ...the social reactions to deviant and criminal behaviour...

ext.ext_cn: 当然，并不是所有的酗酒者和吸毒者都会生育出不正常的后代。
ext.ext_en: Of course, not all alcoholics and drug abusers produce deviant offspring.

defs.def_en: Deviant behaviour or thinking is different from what people normally consider to be acceptable.

defs.def_cn: 偏常者;反常者;离经叛道者
defs.def_en: A deviant is someone whose behaviour or beliefs are different from what people normally consider to be acceptable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 肌肉绷紧或受凉时更容易损伤。
ext.ext_en: When muscles are taut or cold there is more chance of injury or strain...

ext.ext_cn: 晾衣绳被拉紧并系牢。
ext.ext_en: The clothes line is pulled taut and secured.

defs.def_en: Something that is taut is stretched very tight.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那年夏天，她减去了怀孕期间增加的体重，身材又变得修长而健美。
ext.ext_en: That summer she had shed the weight gained during pregnancy, her body was trim and taut.

defs.def_en: If a person or their body is taut, they are very lean with firm muscles.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 本一骨碌坐了起来，表情紧张而惊恐。
ext.ext_en: Ben sat up quickly, his face taut and terrified...

ext.ext_cn: 长期焦虑带来的紧张而疲惫的神色从她脸上慢慢消失了。
ext.ext_en: Little by little she lost the taut, strained air of perpetual anxiety.

defs.def_en: If someone has a taut expression, they look very worried and tense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (文章、电影等)结构严谨的，紧凑的

ext.ext_cn: 艾希·侯相导演的《在世人面前》——一部劫持校车的情节紧凑的惊悚片
ext.ext_en: ...Eric Rochant's 'Aux yeux du monde', a taut thriller about the kidnapping of a school bus.

defs.def_en: If you describe a piece of writing or a film as taut, you mean that it is good because it is exciting and has no unnecessary details.

defs.def_cn: （尤指因为生病、震惊或受到惊吓）面如土色的，没有血色的

ext.ext_cn: 生还者们面色惨白，看起来仍然惊魂未定。
ext.ext_en: The survivors were ashen-faced and visibly shaken.

defs.def_en: Someone who is ashen-faced looks very pale, especially because they are ill, shocked, or frightened.

defs.def_cn: (人或动物)悄悄地缓慢行进，蹑手蹑脚地移动

ext.ext_cn: 我回到旅馆，蹑手蹑脚地上楼回到房间。
ext.ext_en: Back I go to the hotel and creep up to my room...

ext.ext_cn: 兔子悄悄溜走，藏进洞里。
ext.ext_en: The rabbit creeps away and hides in a hole.

defs.def_en: When people or animals creep somewhere, they move quietly and slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 薄雾又从海面上弥漫过来了。
ext.ext_en: Mist had crept in again from the sea.

defs.def_en: If something creeps somewhere, it moves very slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 可能会不知不觉地产生不安全感。
ext.ext_en: Insecurity might creep in...

ext.ext_cn: 可能是由于体力不支，她在比赛中的失误越来越多。
ext.ext_en: An increasing ratio of mistakes, perhaps induced by tiredness, crept into her game.

defs.def_en: If something creeps in or creeps back, it begins to occur or becomes part of something without people realizing or without them wanting it.

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀率已攀升至9.5%。
ext.ext_en: The inflation rate has been creeping up to 9.5 per cent...

ext.ext_cn: 每个班的平均学生人数已经从3人增长到了4人。
ext.ext_en: The average number of students in each class is creeping up from three to four.

defs.def_en: If a rate or number creeps up to a higher level, it gradually reaches that level.

defs.def_cn: 讨厌鬼; (尤指)讨好卖乖的人，马屁精
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a creep, you mean that you dislike them a great deal, especially because they are insincere and flatter people.

defs.def_cn: 吓人;使惊慌;使心里发毛

ext.ext_cn: 我一直都很讨厌那座雕像。它让我心里发毛。
ext.ext_en: I always hated that statue. It gave me the creeps.

defs.def_en: If someone or something gives you the creeps, they make you feel very nervous or frightened.
The parking lights on a vehicle are the small lights at the front that help other drivers to notice the vehicle and to judge its width.

ext.ext_cn: 要不是他动了动步枪，你肯定会认为他是个硬纸板模型。
ext.ext_en: You'd swear he was a cardboard cut-out except that he'd moved his rifle...

ext.ext_cn: 你可以和戴维·贝克汉姆的纸板模型合影。
ext.ext_en: You can have your picture taken with a  cutout of David Beckham.

defs.def_en: A cardboard cut-out is a shape that has been cut from thick card.

ext.ext_cn: 使用带自动断电装置的水壶加热，这样水沸腾的时间就不会过长了。
ext.ext_en: Use a kettle with an automatic cut-out so it doesn't boil for longer than necessary...

ext.ext_cn: 发动机断电装置和方向盘锁无法保护汽车的内部。
ext.ext_en: Engine cut-out devices and steering wheel locks do not protect the car's contents.

defs.def_en: A cut-out is a device that turns off a machine automatically in particular circumstances.
Brisket is a cut of beef that comes from the breast of the cow.

ext.ext_cn: 我挺过来了，我能应付下去。
ext.ext_en: I'm a survivor. I'll get by...

ext.ext_cn: 梅尔维尔仅靠一点点钱勉强度日。
ext.ext_en: Melville managed to get by on a small amount of money.

defs.def_en: If you can get by with what you have, you can manage to live or do things in a satisfactory way.

defs.def_cn: (按年龄、体格等条件选征服役者的)选拔征兵，义务兵役
defs.def_en: In the United States, selective service is a system of selecting and ordering young men to serve in the armed forces for a limited period of time.

defs.def_cn: 工装裤;背带裤;(美国英语亦指)牛仔裤
defs.def_en: Dungarees are a one-piece garment consisting of trousers, a piece of cloth which covers your chest, and straps which go over your shoulders. In American English, dungarees can also refer to jeans.
A subaltern is any commissioned officer in the army below the rank of captain.

A valentine or a valentine card is a greetings card that you send to someone who you are in love with or are attracted to, usually without signing your name, on St Valentine's Day, the 14th of February.

defs.def_cn: 动员;鼓动;召集；（人们）动员起来

ext.ext_cn: 最好的希望是我们能争取到国际上的支持，然后采取行动。
ext.ext_en: The best hope is that we will mobilize international support and get down to action...

ext.ext_cn: 此行的目的就是动员公众对这个备受争议的问题发表意见。
ext.ext_en: The purpose of the journey is to mobilise public opinion on the controversial issue...

defs.def_en: If you mobilize support or mobilize people to do something, you succeed in encouraging people to take action, especially political action. If people mobilize, they prepare to take action.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你能够调集资源，就可以把这件事做成。
ext.ext_en: If you could mobilize the resources, you could get it done.

defs.def_en: If you mobilize resources, you start to use them or make them available for use.

defs.def_cn: (国家或军队)动员起来;动员(军队)

ext.ext_cn: 作为对最后通牒的回应，苏丹甚至威胁说要动员军队。
ext.ext_en: Sudan even threatened to mobilize in response to the ultimatums...

ext.ext_cn: 印度现在更有条件动员军队了。
ext.ext_en: India is now in a better position to mobilise its forces...

defs.def_en: If a country mobilizes, or mobilizes its armed forces, or if its armed forces mobilize, they are given orders to prepare for a conflict.
Something that is unpolluted is free from pollution.

ext.ext_cn: 一群叛乱分子迅速占领了港口地区和大部分城北郊区。
ext.ext_en: A group of rebels overran the port area and most of the northern suburbs...

ext.ext_cn: 新德里市中心被一群袭击政府大楼的武装暴徒控制了。
ext.ext_en: The centre of New Delhi was overrun by an armed mob which attacked government buildings.

defs.def_en: If an army or an armed force overruns a place, area, or country, it succeeds in occupying it very quickly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 花坛里杂草横生。
ext.ext_en: The flower beds were overrun with grasses...

ext.ext_cn: 由于老鼠泛滥成灾，该旅馆被勒令关闭。
ext.ext_en: The Hotel has been ordered to close because it is overrun by mice and rats...

defs.def_en: If you say that a place is overrun with things that you consider undesirable, you mean that there are a large number of them there.

ext.ext_cn: 星期二的午餐超时了45分钟。
ext.ext_en: Tuesday's lunch overran by three-quarters of an hour...

ext.ext_cn: 会谈超过了他们的预定时间。
ext.ext_en: The talks overran their allotted time.

defs.def_en: If an event or meeting overruns by, for example, ten minutes, it continues for ten minutes longer than it was intended to.

ext.ext_cn: 新武器研发的费用总是大大超支，却还要试图让纳税人出钱资助，我们应该制止这一荒谬至极的行为。
ext.ext_en: We should stop the nonsense of taxpayers trying to finance new weapons whose costs always overrun hugely...

ext.ext_cn: 开支超出预算将近30%。
ext.ext_en: Costs overran the budget by about 30%.

defs.def_en: If costs overrun, they are higher than was planned or expected.

defs.def_cn: 非常自负的;自命不凡的
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as vainglorious, you are critical of them because they are very proud of what they have done and boast a lot about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 数量很少的;微薄的;不足的;贫乏的

ext.ext_cn: 银行职员对只加薪3.1%已心生怒火。
ext.ext_en: The bank's staff were already angered by a meagre 3.1% pay rise...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的食品供给少得可怜。
ext.ext_en: Their food supply is meager.

defs.def_en: If you describe an amount or quantity of something as meagre, you are critical of it because it is very small or not enough.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我见到过这个身着灰色套装的英俊男士。
ext.ext_en: I saw this nice-looking man in a gray suit...

ext.ext_cn: 我们相处得很好，并且她很漂亮。
ext.ext_en: We got on very well and she was very nice-looking.

defs.def_en: Someone who is nice-looking is physically attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 负责军情通报的官员们声称今天没有飞机被击落。
ext.ext_en: Military briefers say no planes were shot down today.

defs.def_en: A briefer is an official who has the job of giving information about something, for example a war.
Your Adam's apple is the lump that sticks out of the front of your neck below your throat.
A moonless sky or night is dark because there is no moon.

ext.ext_cn: 我们生活在一个二元对立的世界：昼和夜,正和负,男和女等等。
ext.ext_en: We live in a world of duality, day and night, positive and negative, male and female, etc.

defs.def_en: A duality is a situation in which two opposite ideas or feelings exist at the same time.

defs.def_cn: 英寻(度量单位，等于 1.8 米或 6 英尺，用于指水深)

ext.ext_cn: 我们驶进海湾，将锚抛进 5 英寻深的水里。
ext.ext_en: We sailed into the bay and dropped anchor in five fathoms of water.

defs.def_en: A fathom is a measurement of 1.8 metres or 6 feet, used when referring to the depth of water.

defs.def_cn: 透彻理解;深入了解;弄清…的真相

ext.ext_cn: 我真搞不懂斯坦纳在说些什么。
ext.ext_en: I really couldn't fathom what Steiner was talking about...

ext.ext_cn: 杰里米的消极态度令人费解。
ext.ext_en: Jeremy's passive attitude was hard to fathom.

defs.def_en: If you cannot fathom something, you are unable to understand it, although you think carefully about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自信的；放松的；有把握的

ext.ext_cn: 比起最近几次在国会中的露面，他表现得自信多了。
ext.ext_en: He was infinitely more assured than in his more recent parliamentary appearances.

defs.def_en: Someone who is assured is very confident and relaxed.

ext.ext_cn: 我们必胜，我们锐不可当。
ext.ext_en: Our victory is assured; nothing can stop us...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天，她的未来似乎已经在握。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday, her future seemed assured.

defs.def_en: If something is assured, it is certain to happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 确定的;信心十足的;志在必得的

ext.ext_cn: 劳拉·戴维斯确信能在欧洲队中占据一席之地。
ext.ext_en: Laura Davies is assured of a place in Europe's team...

ext.ext_cn: 比克斯塔夫看上去对于当选总书记志在必得。
ext.ext_en: Bickerstaffe looks assured of being elected general secretary.

defs.def_en: If you are assured of something, you are certain to get it or achieve it.

ext.ext_cn: 家长尽可放心，孩子们的安全将成为重中之重。
ext.ext_en: Their parents can rest assured that their children's safety will be of paramount importance...

ext.ext_cn: 放心吧，他知道的常识很可能比你以为的要多得多。
ext.ext_en: Rest assured, he probably has rather more common sense than you realize.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone can rest assured that something is the case, you mean that it is definitely the case, so they do not need to worry about it.

ext.ext_cn: 我将去见约翰逊夫妇。等着瞧吧，我一定会把你的无礼告诉他们。
ext.ext_en: I will be seeing Mr and Mrs. Johnson. And rest assured I will tell them of your rudeness...

ext.ext_cn: 不用多想，如果你欠税，我们会去收的。
ext.ext_en: Rest assured, if you owe taxes, we will collect them.

defs.def_en: You use rest assured when you want to emphasize your determination to do something.

defs.def_cn: 四重奏乐团;四重唱组合

ext.ext_cn: 四重奏弦乐团
ext.ext_en: ...a string quartet.

ext.ext_cn: 四重唱组合
ext.ext_en: ...a quartet of singers.

defs.def_en: A quartet is a group of four people who play musical instruments or sing together.
A quartet is a piece of music for four instruments or four singers.

defs.def_cn: 四人组;四件套；四个一组

ext.ext_cn: 一套4本的书
ext.ext_en: ...a quartet of books.

ext.ext_cn: 由4名45岁左右的当地妇女组成的小组
ext.ext_en: ...a quartet of local women in their mid-forties.

defs.def_en: A quartet of people or things is a group or set of four people or things.

ext.ext_cn: 那个腿部被截肢的女人可以装假肢并学着用它来行走。
ext.ext_en: The woman whose leg had been amputated could get a prosthesis and learn to walk on it.

defs.def_en: A prosthesis is an artificial body part that is used to replace a natural part.

ext.ext_cn: 赛车是工程学上一项相当了不起的成就。
ext.ext_en: A racing car is an extraordinary feat of engineering.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an action, or the result of an action, as a feat, you admire it because it is an impressive and difficult achievement.

ext.ext_cn: 几十年来，这家公司一直是英国经济的晴雨表。
ext.ext_en: For decades the company was the bellwether of the British economy...

ext.ext_cn: 国际商用机器公司的股票行情被视为华尔街股市的风向标。
ext.ext_en: IBM is considered the bellwether stock on Wall Street.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a bellwether, you mean that it is an indication of the way a situation is changing.

ext.ext_cn: 如果看到他有具体的计划，其他银行会很愿意提供帮助。
ext.ext_en: The other banks are going to be very eager to help, provided that they see that he has a specific plan...

ext.ext_cn: 只要他们身体强健，我看不出他们有什么理由不继续再打四五年比赛。
ext.ext_en: Provided they are fit I see no reason why they shouldn't go on playing for another four or five years.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen provided or provided that something else happens, you mean that the first thing will happen only if the second thing also happens.

defs.def_cn: （与名词连用构成新的名词）表示“…观察者”，“…注视者”

ext.ext_cn: 观鸟者在灌木丛中蹑手蹑脚地走来走去。
ext.ext_en: The bird-watchers crept about in the bushes...

ext.ext_cn: 皇室观察员玛丽·海斯说：“看来女王接下来的日子不太好过。”
ext.ext_en: Royal-watcher Mary Hayes said: 'It looks like it is going to be an unhappy time for the Queen.'

defs.def_en: -watcher combines with nouns to form other nouns that refer to people who are interested in a group of animals or people, and who study them closely.

ext.ext_cn: 等一下，别挂。
ext.ext_en: Hang on a mo.

defs.def_en: A mo is a very short length of time. It is short for moment .

ext.ext_cn: 总统提议对那些给员工放假的企业实行免税优惠。
ext.ext_en: The president proposed to provide tax credits to businesses that allow workers time off.

defs.def_en: A tax credit is an amount of money on which you do not have to pay tax.

ext.ext_cn: 这个团队遭到了亚历克斯·费格森经理的严厉批评。
ext.ext_en: The team was given a roasting by manager Alex Feguson.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you a roasting, they criticize you severely about something in a way that shows that they are very annoyed with you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可触犯的;不可违背的

ext.ext_cn: 该比赛有一个规则不可违背：必须跳过而不能绕过障碍物。
ext.ext_en: The game had a single inviolable rule: obstacles were to be overcome, not circumvented.

defs.def_en: If a law or principle is inviolable, you must not break it.

defs.def_cn: 不可更改的;不可侵犯的

ext.ext_cn: 昨天的决议称现在的波兰边界是“不可侵犯的”。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday's resolution says the present Polish border is 'inviolable'.

defs.def_en: If a country says its borders are inviolable, it means they must not be changed or crossed without permission.
An allergen is a substance that causes an allergic reaction in someone.

defs.def_cn: 自始至终;从头到尾;贯穿

ext.ext_cn: 敌对派别相互残杀的国家悲剧 1990 年全年都在上演。
ext.ext_en: The national tragedy of rival groups killing each other continued throughout 1990...

ext.ext_cn: 电影音乐要想让人记住不难，因为它的主旋律贯穿影片始终。
ext.ext_en: Movie music can be made memorable because its themes are repeated throughout the film.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens throughout a particular period of time, you mean that it happens during the whole of that period.

ext.ext_cn: 创始于 1950 年的国际防盲及救盲组织如今在非洲、加勒比海地区和东南亚各地都开展项目。
ext.ext_en: 'Sight Savers', founded in 1950, now runs projects throughout Africa, the Caribbean and South East Asia...

ext.ext_cn: 正如我们一直想在本书中努力表明的那样，提供优质服务的公司靠的不是运气。
ext.ext_en: As we have tried to show throughout this book, companies that provide outstanding service don't do it by luck.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens or exists throughout a place, you mean that it happens or exists in all parts of that place.

defs.def_cn: (尤指同一工作或项目上的)同事，同僚
defs.def_en: Your co-workers are the people you work with, especially people on the same job or project as you.
A litigator is a lawyer who helps someone take legal action.

defs.def_cn: 苏丹(某些伊斯兰国家统治者的称号)

ext.ext_cn: 在苏丹阿卜杜勒·哈米德统治期间
ext.ext_en: ...during the reign of Sultan Abdul Hamid.

defs.def_en: A sultan is a ruler in some Muslim countries.

ext.ext_cn: 传来一声响亮的枪声。
ext.ext_en: A single shot rang out.

defs.def_en: If a sound rings out, it can be heard loudly and clearly.

ext.ext_cn: 一些简单的娱乐，譬如在一个阳光明媚的日子散步，就能使我们的心情更愉快。
ext.ext_en: It is simple pleasures, such as a walk on a sunny day, which have a cumulative effect on our mood...

ext.ext_cn: 吃鱼的好处要长期才能显现。
ext.ext_en: The benefits from eating fish are cumulative.

defs.def_en: If a series of events have a cumulative effect, each event makes the effect greater.

defs.def_cn: (用于制造蜡烛、肥皂的)动物油脂
defs.def_en: Tallow is hard animal fat that is used for making candles and soap.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (证据或报告)确凿的，导致定罪的

ext.ext_cn: 确凿证明他对此事的处理存在过错的报告
ext.ext_en: ...a damning report into his handling of the affair...

ext.ext_cn: 他最言之凿凿的地方在于其对军方的评论。
ext.ext_en: He was most damning in his comments about the army.

defs.def_en: If you describe evidence or a report as damning, you mean that it suggests very strongly that someone is guilty of a crime or has made a serious mistake.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我的喉咙已经好几年没有像昨晚那样疼了。
ext.ext_en: It's years since  I've had a sore throat like I did last night...

ext.ext_cn: 手术过后我的胸口还在作痛。
ext.ext_en: My chest is still sore from the surgery.

defs.def_en: If part of your body is sore, it causes you pain and discomfort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 结果就是，现在他们都对你感到十分恼火。
ext.ext_en: The result is that they are now all feeling very sore at you...

ext.ext_cn: 他们对在四分之一决赛里输给英格兰队这件事感到非常懊恼。
ext.ext_en: They are sore about losing to England in the quarter-finals.

defs.def_en: If you are sore about something, you are angry and upset about it.

defs.def_cn: 皮肤发炎疼痛处;疮肿;溃疡
defs.def_en: See also:cold sore;A sore is a painful place on the body where the skin is infected.

defs.def_cn: 痛处;惹人生气的话题;令人难堪的话题

ext.ext_cn: 美国军队继续驻扎在韩国领土上这一事实仍然让这些学生深感气愤。
ext.ext_en: The continuing presence of American troops on Korean soil remains a very sore point with these students.

defs.def_en: If something is a sore point with someone, it is likely to make them angry or embarrassed if you try to discuss it.

ext.ext_cn: 远处传来酒醉士兵的喊声和歌声
ext.ext_en: ...the distant shouts and songs of the drunken soldiery.

defs.def_en: Soldiery is a group or body of soldiers.

defs.def_cn: （铰接卡车失控时）弯成V字形，弯折

ext.ext_cn: 他的车弯成V字形，撞进了反方向车道，车身挡住了所有的3个车道。
ext.ext_en: His vehicle jack-knifed, and crashed across all three lanes of the opposite carriageway.

defs.def_en: If a truck that is in two parts jack-knifes, the back part swings around at a sharp angle to the front part in an uncontrolled way as the truck is moving.
A hothouse is a heated building, usually made of glass, in which plants and flowers can be grown.

defs.def_cn: （尤指思想或感情活动的）爆发地，温床

ext.ext_cn: 熙攘的人群有时将罗马变成一个癫狂情绪的爆发地。
ext.ext_en: The vast crowds make Rome a frantic hothouse at times.

ext.ext_cn: 该学院享有的新思想摇篮的美誉
ext.ext_en: ...the reputation of the College as a hothouse of novel ideas.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a situation or place as a hothouse when there is intense activity, especially intellectual or emotional activity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们两人都于穷困潦倒中死去。
ext.ext_en: Both of them died in abject poverty...

ext.ext_cn: 这项计划彻底失败了。
ext.ext_en: This scheme was an abject failure.

defs.def_en: You use abject to emphasize that a situation or quality is extremely bad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 卑躬屈节的；自卑的；怯懦的

ext.ext_cn: 他低声下气，急于讨好别人。
ext.ext_en: He sounded abject and eager to please...

ext.ext_cn: 他转过头看着这个噤若寒蝉的女孩，又重复了一遍他的问题。
ext.ext_en: He looked back at the abject, silent girl and repeated his question.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as abject, you think they have no courage or respect for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 乌克兰的工业和农业都很发达。
ext.ext_en: The Ukraine is strong both in industry and agriculture.

defs.def_en: Agriculture is farming and the methods that are used to raise and look after crops and animals.
High noon means the same as noon.

defs.def_cn: （新闻用语）紧要关头，关键时刻

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在正处在家庭录像大行其道的时代，这对国内的电影院来说似乎是个关乎生死存亡的关键时刻。
ext.ext_en: It looks like high noon for the nation's movie theaters, now we are in the age of the home video.

defs.def_en: Journalists sometimes use high noon to refer to a crisis or event which is likely to decide finally what is going to happen in a conflict or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我和他的生活合而为一。
ext.ext_en: My life merged with his...

ext.ext_cn: 美国银行与一家竞争银行合并了。
ext.ext_en: Bank of America merged with a rival bank...

defs.def_en: If one thing merges with another, or is merged with another, they combine or come together to make one whole thing. You can also say that two things merge, or are merged .

ext.ext_cn: 他就像一条变色龙，可以神不知鬼不觉地隐藏在背景中间。
ext.ext_en: Like a chameleon, he could merge unobtrusively into the background...

ext.ext_cn: 他的面容消失在黑暗之中。
ext.ext_en: His features merged with the darkness...

defs.def_en: If one sound, colour, or object merges into another, the first changes so gradually into the second that you do not notice the change.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不想看到像他这个年龄的人四处闲荡，危及他人生命。
ext.ext_en: We do not want people of his age mucking around risking people's lives...

ext.ext_cn: 他小时候，夏天都是在船上浑打胡闹度过的。
ext.ext_en: He'd spent his boyhood summers mucking about in boats...

defs.def_en: If you muck around or muck about, you behave in a childish or silly way, often so that you waste your time and fail to achieve anything.

ext.ext_cn: 总统夫人既没有乱干预政策，也没有列席内阁会议。
ext.ext_en: The president's wife doesn't muck around with policy or sit in on Cabinet meetings.

defs.def_en: If you muck around with or muck about with something, you alter it, often making it worse than it was.

ext.ext_cn: 他对耍弄他的人毫不客气。
ext.ext_en: He does not tolerate anyone who mucks him about.

defs.def_en: If you muck someone around or muck them about, you treat them badly, for example by not being honest with them or by continually changing plans which affect them.

ext.ext_cn: 他同时呼吁加快政治改革的步伐。
ext.ext_en: He has also called for an acceleration of political reforms.

ext.ext_cn: 失业的急速增加
ext.ext_en: ...the sharp acceleration in job losses.

defs.def_en: The acceleration of a process or change is the fact that it is getting faster and faster.

defs.def_cn: （汽车等的）加速能力，加速幅度

ext.ext_cn: 加速到时速60英里只需要5.7秒。
ext.ext_en: Acceleration to 60 mph takes a mere 5.7 seconds.

defs.def_en: Acceleration is the rate at which a car or other vehicle can increase its speed, often seen in terms of the time that it takes to reach a particular speed.
Acceleration is the rate at which the speed of an object increases.

defs.def_cn: 向后的，往后的（一些人亦使用backwards)

ext.ext_cn: 他打开2号公寓的门，回头瞥了拉里一眼，然后就进了房间。
ext.ext_en: He unlocked the door of apartment two and disappeared inside after a backward glance at Larry...

ext.ext_cn: 他做了一个后空翻。
ext.ext_en: He did a backward flip.

defs.def_en: A backward movement or look is in the direction that your back is facing. Some people use backwards for this meaning.

ext.ext_cn: 到了一定的年龄，就不可能再退回去干不需要技能的工作。
ext.ext_en: At a certain age, it's not viable for men to take a backward step into unskilled work...

ext.ext_cn: 许多牙医不再为依靠国民保健制度的病人看病，这是该国的一大倒退。
ext.ext_en: Many dentists will no longer treat National Health Service patients, which is a big backward step in this country.

defs.def_en: If someone takes a backward step, they do something that does not change or improve their situation, but causes them to go back a stage.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们应当为落后的祖国加快变革的脚步。
ext.ext_en: We need to accelerate the pace of change in our backward country.

defs.def_en: A backward country or society does not have modern industries and machines.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 关于帮助落后孩子的教学方法研究
ext.ext_en: ...research into teaching techniques to help backward children...

ext.ext_cn: 我学走路和说话都很慢，所以我父母以为我很迟钝。
ext.ext_en: I was slow to walk and talk and my parents thought I was backward.

defs.def_en: A backward child has difficulty in learning.

ext.ext_cn: 我们靠我的工资勉强度日。
ext.ext_en: We're barely scraping by on my salary.

defs.def_en: If someone scrapes by, they earn just enough money to live on with difficulty.

ext.ext_cn: 她正剧烈地抽噎着，浑身颤抖。
ext.ext_en: She was now shaking with long, racking sobs.

defs.def_en: See also:nerve-racking;A racking pain or emotion is a distressing one which you feel very strongly.
Heroin is a powerful drug which some people take for pleasure, but which they can become addicted to.

ext.ext_cn: 工厂里弥漫着锯屑和胶水的气味。
ext.ext_en: The smell of sawdust and glue pervaded the factory...

ext.ext_cn: 渗透到社会各阶层的腐败
ext.ext_en: ...the corruption that pervades every stratum of the country...

defs.def_en: If something pervades a place or thing, it is a noticeable feature throughout it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他快晕船了，已经感到恶心了。
ext.ext_en: He was very prone to seasickness and already felt queasy.

defs.def_en: If you feel queasy or if you have a queasy stomach, you feel rather ill, as if you are going to be sick.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一些人为自己的姓名和地址是如何被泄露出去的感到不安。
ext.ext_en: Some people feel queasy about how their names and addresses have been obtained.

defs.def_en: If you feel queasy about something, you are a little worried about it.
If you say that someone is the guest of honour at a dinner or other social occasion, you mean that they are the most important guest.

ext.ext_cn: 我绝望地看着妻子。
ext.ext_en: I looked at my wife in despair...

ext.ext_cn: 绝望或无能的感觉
ext.ext_en: ...feelings of despair or inadequacy.

defs.def_en: Despair is the feeling that everything is wrong and that nothing will improve.

ext.ext_cn: “啊，我有时会感到绝望，”他假装悲伤地说。
ext.ext_en: 'Oh, I despair sometimes,' he says in mock sorrow...

ext.ext_cn: 面对媒体的诸多批评他的确感到绝望。
ext.ext_en: He does despair at much of the press criticism.

defs.def_en: If you despair, you feel that everything is wrong and that nothing will improve.

defs.def_cn: 对…感到绝望;对…不抱希望

ext.ext_cn: 他想通过写作来谋生，不过他对此不抱希望。
ext.ext_en: He wished to earn a living through writing but despaired of doing so.

ext.ext_cn: 为那些对有瓦遮头不再抱有任何希望的人们找到住处的努力
ext.ext_en: ...efforts to find homes for people despairing of ever having a roof over their heads...

defs.def_en: If you despair of something, you feel that there is no hope that it will happen or improve. If you despair of someone, you feel that there is no hope that they will improve.

ext.ext_cn: 目击者称空中石块和玻璃碎片四溅。
ext.ext_en: Eyewitnesses spoke of rocks and shards of glass flying in the air.

defs.def_en: Shards are pieces of broken glass, pottery, or metal.

ext.ext_cn: 毫无疑问,兰普利完全疯了。
ext.ext_en: Lampley was obviously completely wacko.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is wacko, you are saying in an unkind way that they are strange and eccentric.

defs.def_cn: 性交(有些人认为此词具冒犯意味)

ext.ext_cn: 好莱坞可怕的婚前性罪恶
ext.ext_en: ...the fearful Hollywood sin of pre-marital nookie.

defs.def_en: You can refer to sexual intercourse as nookie. Some people consider this word offensive.

ext.ext_cn: 原因有很多而且可能互相关联。
ext.ext_en: The causes are many and may interconnect...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的生活与18世纪晚期的名人联系在一起。
ext.ext_en: Their lives interconnect with those of celebrated figures of the late eighteenth-century...

defs.def_en: Things that interconnect or are interconnected are connected to or with each other. You can also say that one thing interconnects with another.

defs.def_cn: (尤指不熟悉或想象中的)生物，动物

ext.ext_cn: 阿拉斯加的爱斯基摩人认为每一个活着的生物都有灵魂。
ext.ext_en: Alaskan Eskimos believe that every living creature possesses a spirit...

ext.ext_cn: 花园四周是树篱，许多小动物可以在那里栖身。
ext.ext_en: The garden is surrounded by a hedge in which many small creatures can live...

defs.def_en: You can refer to any living thing that is not a plant as a creature, especially when it is of an unknown or unfamiliar kind. People also refer to imaginary animals and beings as creatures .

ext.ext_cn: 她很迷人，是个可人儿。
ext.ext_en: She's charming, a sweet creature...

ext.ext_cn: 我不是个爱慕虚荣的人。
ext.ext_en: I am not a vain creature...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a particular type of creature, you are focusing on a particular quality they have.  a creature of habit→see: habit;

ext.ext_cn: 我们不是保守派政府的傀儡。
ext.ext_en: We are not creatures of the Conservative government.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as someone else's creature, you mean that they are controlled by or depend on that person.

ext.ext_cn: 很多人推测美国将会暂时搁置和平进程。
ext.ext_en: Many speculated that the US would put the peace process on the back burner...

ext.ext_cn: 十年来她一直都在照顾自己的三个孩子，基本上把事业搁在了一边。
ext.ext_en: For 10 years she has looked after her three children with her career very much on the back burner.

defs.def_en: If you put an issue on the back burner, you leave it in order to deal with it later because you now consider it to have become less urgent or important.

defs.def_cn: 大自然(尤指被看作影响人类的力量)

ext.ext_cn: 当时大自然用火山熔岩和冰川造就了冰岛
ext.ext_en: ...when Mother Nature created Iceland out of volcanic lava and glaciers.

defs.def_en: Mother Nature is sometimes used to refer to nature, especially when it is being considered as a force that affects human beings.

defs.def_cn: 托格(测定毯子、被子保暖度的官方计量单位)

ext.ext_cn: 托格值的范围已经扩大至 15 托格。
ext.ext_en: The range of tog values has been extended to 15 togs.

ext.ext_cn: 一床舒适暖和的 13.5 托格冬季羽绒被
ext.ext_en: ...a snug 13.5-tog winter duvet.

defs.def_en: A tog is an official measurement that shows how warm a blanket or quilt is.

defs.def_cn: (尤指为某一特殊目的所穿的)衣服

ext.ext_cn: 照片上他穿着足球衣。
ext.ext_en: The photograph showed him wearing football togs.

defs.def_en: Togs are clothes, especially ones for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不能允许教条主义阻碍进步。
ext.ext_en: We cannot allow dogmatism to stand in the way of progress.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an opinion as dogmatism, you are criticizing it for being strongly stated without considering all the relevant facts or other people's opinions.

ext.ext_cn: 他提醒说，他为这个国家制定的经济计划没有商量的余地。
ext.ext_en: He warned that his economic programme for the country was not negotiable...

ext.ext_cn: 该庄园现在出售，价格可议。
ext.ext_en: The Manor is for sale at a negotiable price.

defs.def_en: Something that is negotiable can be changed or agreed when people discuss it.

defs.def_cn: (契约或财产)可转让的，可兑现的

ext.ext_cn: 这些债券或许不能再行转让了。
ext.ext_en: The bonds may no longer be negotiable.

ext.ext_cn: 可转让无记名债券
ext.ext_en: ...negotiable bearer bonds.

defs.def_en: Contracts or assets that are negotiable can be transferred to another person in exchange for money.

ext.ext_cn: 部分路面已被河水冲毁，但仍可以通行。
ext.ext_en: Parts of the road had been washed away by streams, but it was negotiable.

defs.def_en: An area of land that is negotiable is easy to travel across.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 整齐的;整洁的;井然有序的

ext.ext_cn: 房子只需偶尔粉刷一次就可以保持整洁。
ext.ext_en: The house only needs an occasional coat of paint to keep it shipshape.

defs.def_en: If something is shipshape, it looks tidy, neat, and in good condition.

defs.def_cn: （视为政治整体的）全体国民，人民

ext.ext_cn: 国王是人民的领袖。
ext.ext_en: ...the king was the head of the body politic.

defs.def_en: The body politic is all the people of a nation when they are considered as a complete political group.
A sprayer is a piece of equipment used for spraying liquid somewhere.

defs.def_cn: （尤指说话内容令人不悦、具冒犯性或愚蠢可笑的）高谈阔论者，夸夸其谈者，胡吹乱侃者
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a loudmouth, you are critical of them because they talk a lot, especially in an unpleasant, offensive, or stupid way.
If a man talks about the fair sex, he is referring to women in general.
Isn't is the usual spoken form of 'is not'.
A transformer is a piece of electrical equipment which changes a voltage to a higher or lower voltage.

ext.ext_cn: 国王被迫采用了削弱其权力的新宪法。
ext.ext_en: The king was forced to adopt a new constitution which reduced his powers.

ext.ext_cn: 《美国宪法》
ext.ext_en: ...the American Constitution...

defs.def_en: The constitution of a country or organization is the system of laws which formally states people's rights and duties.

ext.ext_cn: 他的体格必定极其强壮。
ext.ext_en: He must have an extremely strong constitution...

ext.ext_cn: 我一向体壮如牛。
ext.ext_en: I've always had the constitution of an ox.

defs.def_en: Your constitution is  your health.

ext.ext_cn: 他一直用这辆车牵引他的活动工作室。
ext.ext_en: He had been using the vehicle to tow his work trailer...

ext.ext_cn: 他们威胁要拖走我的车。
ext.ext_en: They threatened to tow away my car...

defs.def_en: If one vehicle tows another, it pulls it along behind it.

ext.ext_cn: 她站在我门口，身后跟着一个孩子。
ext.ext_en: There she was on my doorstep with child in tow...

ext.ext_cn: 她有一个记者和一名摄影师追随着。
ext.ext_en: She had a reporter and a photographer in tow.

defs.def_en: If you have someone in tow, they are following you closely because you are looking after them or you are leading them somewhere.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 吸引人的;引人入胜的;令人着迷的

ext.ext_cn: 虽然我自己不打斯诺克，但是我觉得它挺令人着迷。
ext.ext_en: I find snooker riveting though I don't play myself.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as riveting, you mean that it is extremely interesting and exciting, and that it holds your attention completely.

ext.ext_cn: 灰褐色、杏黄色和乳白色相间的色彩暗淡的羊毛衫
ext.ext_en: ...a pale wool jacket in taupe, apricot, and cream.

defs.def_en: Something that is taupe is a pale brownish-grey colour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 随着宝宝的成长，其骨骼的柔韧性会降低。
ext.ext_en: As your baby grows bigger, his bones become less pliable...

ext.ext_cn: 这些编织精美的篮子是用柔韧的云杉嫩树根编成的。
ext.ext_en: The finely twined baskets are made with young, pliable spruce roots.

defs.def_en: If something is pliable, you can bend it easily without cracking or breaking it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 易受影响的；柔顺的；顺从的

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们继续期望自己的女儿只重外表、毫无主见、头脑空空的话，她们就会对未来准备不足。
ext.ext_en: If we go on expecting our daughters to be decorative and pliable and empty-headed, they'll be inadequately prepared for the future.

defs.def_en: Someone who is pliable can be easily influenced and controlled by other people.

defs.def_cn: （主要用于广告和产品名称中）巨大的，巨型的，特大的

ext.ext_cn: 特大盒纸巾
ext.ext_en: ...a jumbo box of tissues.

ext.ext_cn: 烤大虾
ext.ext_en: ...grilled jumbo prawns.

defs.def_en: Jumbo means very large; used mainly in advertising and in the names of products.

ext.ext_cn: 英国航空公司的大型喷气式客机
ext.ext_en: ...a British Airways jumbo.

defs.def_en: A jumbo or a jumbo jet is a very large jet aircraft that can carry several hundred passengers.

ext.ext_cn: 马上去邮局！
ext.ext_en: Get down to the post office pronto!

defs.def_en: If you say that something must be done pronto, you mean that it must be done quickly and at once.

ext.ext_cn: 该市将拆掉这幢大楼，在这儿建个公园。
ext.ext_en: The city will tear down the building and create a park.

ext.ext_cn: 我猜他们早晚会拆除这座楼的。
ext.ext_en: I imagine they'll be tearing the building down sooner or later.

defs.def_en: If you tear something down, you destroy it or remove it completely.

defs.def_cn: 生计；谋生之道；主要收入来源

ext.ext_cn: 移动电话业务实际上是他的主业。
ext.ext_en: The mobile phone business was actually his bread and butter.

defs.def_en: Something that is the bread and butter of a person or organization is the activity or work that provides the main part of their income.

defs.def_cn: 最基本的；影响到大多数人的

ext.ext_en: It's got four beats to a bar.

defs.def_en: See also:upbeat;downbeat;In music, a beat is a unit of measurement. The number of beats in a bar of a piece of music is indicated by two numbers at the beginning of the piece.

ext.ext_cn: 把鸡蛋和白糖混在一起搅打至开始变稠。
ext.ext_en: Beat the eggs and sugar until they start to thicken.

defs.def_en: If you beat eggs, cream, or butter, you mix them thoroughly using a fork or beater.

defs.def_cn: 拍打，拍动（翅膀）；（翅膀）拍动

ext.ext_cn: 它们拍打着翅膀飞走了。
ext.ext_en: Beating their wings they flew off...

ext.ext_cn: 它的翅膀缓慢拍动着。
ext.ext_en: Its wings beat slowly.

defs.def_en: When a bird or insect beats its wings or when its wings beat, its wings move up and down.

ext.ext_cn: 在昨天的比赛中，瑞士以2比1击败美国。
ext.ext_en: In yesterday's games, Switzerland beat the United States two-one...

ext.ext_cn: 有些男人就是不想被女人打败。
ext.ext_en: There are men who simply don't like being beaten by a woman...

defs.def_en: If you beat someone in a competition or election, you defeat them.

defs.def_cn: 打破（纪录等）；超过； 突破

ext.ext_cn: 他和队长一样渴望打破这项纪录。
ext.ext_en: He was as eager as his Captain to beat the record.

defs.def_en: If someone beats a record or achievement, they do better than it.

defs.def_cn: 战胜（某个组织、问题、疾病等）

ext.ext_cn: 情况已然明朗，工会无法和政府抗衡。
ext.ext_en: It became clear that the Union was not going to beat the government...

ext.ext_cn: 他们认识到这一严厉举措是战胜通货膨胀的唯一希望。
ext.ext_en: They recognise that tough action offers the only hope of beating inflation...

defs.def_en: If you beat something that you are fighting against, for example an organization, a problem, or a disease, you defeat it.

ext.ext_cn: 救援人员因风浪太大而被迫中断工作。
ext.ext_en: The rescuers were beaten back by strong winds and currents...

ext.ext_cn: 南非执政的国民党已经击退了右翼分子的一次挑战。
ext.ext_en: South Africa's  ruling National Party has beaten off a right-wing challenge.

defs.def_en: If an attack or an attempt is beaten off or is beaten back, it is stopped, often temporarily.

ext.ext_cn: 当软件公司的老板比卖保险强多了。
ext.ext_en: Being boss of a software firm beats selling insurance...

ext.ext_cn: 辛苦一天之后美美地泡个热水澡比什么都强。
ext.ext_en: Nothing quite beats the luxury of soaking in a long, hot bath at the end of a tiring day...

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing beats another, you mean that it is better than it.

defs.def_cn: 没有比…更好的；什么也比不上；最好的莫过于

ext.ext_cn: 做清洁没有比用肥皂和水更好的了。
ext.ext_en: You can't beat soap and water for cleansing.

defs.def_en: If you say you can't beat a particular thing you mean that it is the best thing of its kind.

ext.ext_cn: 他们要努力赶在午夜的最后期限之前完成。
ext.ext_en: They were trying to beat the midnight deadline...

ext.ext_cn: 那些为了在抢购高峰前下手而在星期天购物的人是在浪费时间。
ext.ext_en: Those who shop on Sunday to beat the rush are wasting their time.

defs.def_en: To beat a time limit or an event means to achieve something before that time or event.

defs.def_cn: （警察的）辖区，巡逻区；（记者的）负责采访的区域

ext.ext_cn: 小分队的警察比那些负责大片区域的警察更了解自己管片的群众。
ext.ext_en: The team police get to know the people in their patrol areas better than cops who must cover a larger beat.

defs.def_en: A police officer's or journalist's beat is the area for which he or she is responsible.

defs.def_cn: 把…难住；使不明白；使无法解释

ext.ext_cn: “不管怎样，我到底做错了什么？”——“这我也不知道，刘易斯。”
ext.ext_en: 'What am I doing wrong, anyway?' — 'Beats me, Lewis.'...

ext.ext_cn: 我真搞不懂你怎么会这么麻木。
ext.ext_en: How you can be so insensitive absolutely beats me.

defs.def_en: You use beat in expressions such as 'It beats me' or 'What beats me is' to indicate that you cannot understand or explain something.

ext.ext_cn: 趁早滚开。
ext.ext_en: Beat it before it's too late.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to beat it, you are telling them to go away.

defs.def_cn: （表示惊讶或恼怒）竟然有这种事？岂有此理！

ext.ext_cn: 真是岂有此理！格雷厄姆·格林在弗里敦，而我却在非洲的另一边。
ext.ext_en: Can you beat it; there was Graham Greene in Freetown and there was I on the other side of Africa.

defs.def_en: You can say Can you beat it? or Can you beat that? to show that you are surprised and perhaps annoyed about something.

defs.def_cn: 比…抢先行动；赶在…前面（做某事）

ext.ext_cn: 别拖得太久，不然就会有人捷足先登了。
ext.ext_en: Don't  be too long about it or you'll find someone has beaten you to it.

defs.def_en: If you intend to do something but someone beats you to it, they do it before you do.
If you can't beat them, join them means that, if someone is too strong for you to defeat, it is better to be on the same side as them.

ext.ext_cn: “你眼红吗？”——“除非我把持不住自己，”他毫不犹豫地说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Are you jealous?' — 'Only when I'm not in control,' he says, not missing a beat.

defs.def_en: If you say or do something without missing a beat, you continue to speak or do it, even though people might have expected you to hesitate or stop.

ext.ext_cn: 丝凯作为黄金海岸大红大紫的模特儿，自结婚以后从来就没有错失过任何机会。
ext.ext_en: Skye has scarcely missed a beat as one of the Gold Coast's spectacular models since her marriage.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone never misses a beat, you mean that they always know what is going on and how they can take advantage of it.

ext.ext_cn: 值勤警员注意观察情况，对救援呼叫及时反应，确保让百姓有一种安全感。
ext.ext_en: The officer on the beat picks up information; hears cries for help; makes people feel safe.

defs.def_en: A police officer on the beat is on duty, walking around the area for which he or she is responsible.

ext.ext_cn: 他手脚并用地打着拍子。
ext.ext_en: He beats time with hands and feet.

defs.def_en: If you beat time to a piece of music, you move your hand or foot up and down in time with the music. A conductor beats time to show the choir or orchestra how fast they should sing or play the music.
A troopship is a ship on which large numbers of soldiers are taken from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 鼓励孩子在他的愿望和你的愿望之间找到一个折中点。
ext.ext_en: Encourage your child to reach a compromise between what he wants and what you want...

ext.ext_cn: 时刻准备好并乐意在自己与伴侣的需求之间作出让步。
ext.ext_en: Be ready and willing to make compromises between your needs and those of your partner...

defs.def_en: A compromise is a situation in which people accept something slightly different from what they really want, because of circumstances or because they are considering the wishes of other people.

ext.ext_cn: 政府已经就货币政策向批评人士作出让步。
ext.ext_en: The government has compromised with its critics over monetary policies...

ext.ext_cn: “9点。”我说。“9点半。”他试着说。于是我们各让一步，定在了9点一刻。
ext.ext_en: 'Nine,' said I. 'Nine thirty,' tried he. We compromised on 9.15...

defs.def_en: If you compromise with someone, you reach an agreement with them in which you both give up something that you originally wanted. You can also say that two people or groups compromise .

defs.def_cn: 使（自己）声誉受损;违背(信念)

ext.ext_cn: 因与紧急委员会合作而使自己名誉受损的政府成员
ext.ext_en: ...members of the government who have compromised themselves by co-operating with the emergency committee...

ext.ext_cn: 他宁愿一枪打死自己也不愿违背自己的原则。
ext.ext_en: He would rather shoot himself than compromise his principles.

defs.def_en: If someone compromises themselves or compromises their beliefs, they do something which damages their reputation for honesty, loyalty, or high moral principles.
A nightie is the same as a nightdress or nightgown .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人或事物）悲惨的，忧伤的，哀伤的

ext.ext_cn: 忧伤的情歌
ext.ext_en: ...a woeful ballad.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is woeful, they are very sad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 恶劣的;糟糕的;不合意的

ext.ext_cn: 这样的态度是极度无知造成的。
ext.ext_en: Such attitudes are the product of woeful ignorance.

ext.ext_cn: 糟糕的经济状况
ext.ext_en: ...the woeful state of the economy.

defs.def_en: You can use woeful to emphasize that something is very bad or undesirable.

defs.def_cn: 陈词滥调；枯燥冗长的陈述

ext.ext_cn: 她站在门口，听他喋喋不休地抱怨她的客户。
ext.ext_en: She remained in the doorway, listening to his litany of complaints against her client.

defs.def_en: If you describe what someone says as a litany of things, you mean that you have heard it many times before, and you think it is boring or insincere.

defs.def_cn: 连祷；应答祈祷；启应祈祷
defs.def_en: A litany is part of a church service in which the priest says a set group of words and the people reply, also using a set group of words.

ext.ext_cn: 这位上校得以在军队监狱里策动了一场哗变。
ext.ext_en: The colonel was able to orchestrate a rebellion from inside an army jail.

ext.ext_cn: 精心策划的竞选活动
ext.ext_en: ...a carefully orchestrated campaign.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone orchestrates an event or situation, you mean that they carefully organize it in a way that will produce the result that they want.

ext.ext_cn: 他在为自己那部歌剧的第二幕谱写管弦乐曲。
ext.ext_en: He was orchestrating the second act of his opera.

defs.def_en: When someone orchestrates a piece of music, they write the individual parts to be played by the different instruments of an orchestra.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （气候或条件）艰苦的，恶劣的，严峻的

ext.ext_cn: 天气变得恶劣、寒冷且变化莫测。
ext.ext_en: The weather grew harsh, chilly and unpredictable.

ext.ext_cn: 恶劣的沙漠环境
ext.ext_en: ...the harsh desert environment.

defs.def_en: Harsh climates or conditions are very difficult for people, animals, and plants to live in.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫冷酷无情的残忍
ext.ext_en: ...the cold, harsh cruelty of her husband...

ext.ext_cn: 他以尖刻恶毒的语言大肆抨击自己的对手。
ext.ext_en: He said many harsh and unkind things about his opponents.

defs.def_en: Harsh actions or speech are unkind and show no understanding or sympathy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 热带色彩在我们北方暗淡的光线下可能显得有点刺目。
ext.ext_en: Tropical colours may look rather harsh in our dull northern light.

ext.ext_cn: 会让发质变脆弱的刺激性较强的洗发水
ext.ext_en: ...harsher detergents that can leave hair brittle.

defs.def_en: Something that is harsh is so hard, bright, or rough that it seems unpleasant or harmful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 可惜她的嗓门太大太难听了。
ext.ext_en: It's a pity she has such a loud harsh voice.

defs.def_en: Harsh voices and sounds are ones that are rough and unpleasant to listen to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 残酷的事实是，谁死谁活在很大程度上要靠运气。
ext.ext_en: The harsh truth is that luck plays a big part in who will live or die.

defs.def_en: If you talk about harsh realities or facts, or the harsh truth, you are emphasizing that they are true or real, although they are unpleasant and people try to avoid thinking about them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你不太想去，是吗？
ext.ext_en: You're not keen on going, are you?...

ext.ext_cn: 两家公司都很想合并。
ext.ext_en: Both companies were keen on a merger...

defs.def_en: If you are keen on doing something, you very much want to do it. If you are keen that something should happen, you very much want it to happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我对这个想法燃起了极大的热情。
ext.ext_en: I got quite keen on the idea...

ext.ext_cn: 我对物理和化学不是太感喜爱。
ext.ext_en: I wasn't too keen on physics and chemistry.

defs.def_en: If you are keen on something, you like it a lot and are very enthusiastic about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是业余摄影爱好者。
ext.ext_en: She was a keen amateur photographer.

defs.def_en: You use keen to indicate that someone has a lot of enthusiasm for a particular activity and spends a lot of time doing it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是个很好学的学生，学习非常努力。
ext.ext_en: He's a very keen student and works very hard...

ext.ext_cn: 你们都很热心。
ext.ext_en: You're all very keen.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as keen, you mean that they have an enthusiastic nature and are interested in everything that they do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他对那项工作的进展一直很关心。
ext.ext_en: He had retained a keen interest in the progress of the work.

ext.ext_cn: 他强烈的忠诚感
ext.ext_en: ...his keen sense of loyalty.

defs.def_en: A keen interest or emotion is one that is very intense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他一生都是工党的热情拥护者。
ext.ext_en: He's been a keen supporter of the Labour Party all his life...

ext.ext_cn: 他是“停车再换乘”计划的热情拥护者。
ext.ext_en: He is a keen advocate of park-and-ride schemes.

defs.def_en: If you are a keen supporter of a cause, movement, or idea, you support it enthusiastically.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 思维敏捷的；机灵的；机智的

ext.ext_cn: 他们把他描述成一个才思敏捷的人。
ext.ext_en: They described him as a man of keen intellect...

ext.ext_cn: 沃尔什先生深刻理解选民最为关注的事项。
ext.ext_en: Mr Walsh has a keen appreciation of the priorities of the electorate...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a keen mind, you mean that they are very clever and aware of what is happening around them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对细节非常敏感的业余画家
ext.ext_en: ...an amateur artist with a keen eye for detail...

ext.ext_cn: 布兰德敏锐的耳朵听出了口音。
ext.ext_en: Brand's keen ear caught the trace of an accent.

defs.def_en: If you have a keen eye or ear, you are able to notice things that are difficult to detect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 米克一直迷恋卡拉。
ext.ext_en: Mick has always been very keen on Carla.

defs.def_en: If you are keen on someone, you find them sexually attractive and want to get to know them better.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 预计地方选举的竞争会非常激烈。
ext.ext_en: There is expected to be a keen fight in the local elections.

defs.def_en: A keen fight or competition is one in which the competitors are all trying very hard to win, and it is not easy to predict who will win.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 该公司通过讨价还价从供货商那里拿到了很低的价格。
ext.ext_en: The company negotiates very keen prices with their suppliers.

defs.def_en: Keen prices are low and competitive.

ext.ext_cn: 他仰天恸哭起来。
ext.ext_en: He tossed back his head and keened...

ext.ext_cn: 有人正在低声哀泣。
ext.ext_en: Someone was making a low, keening noise.

defs.def_en: If someone keens, they cry out or make sounds to express their sorrow at someone's death.

defs.def_cn: 对…十分热衷；对…非常热情

ext.ext_cn: 那么你对科学并不是太感兴趣了？
ext.ext_en: So you're not mad keen on science then?...

ext.ext_cn: 她非常想去。
ext.ext_en: She was mad keen to go.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is mad keen on something, you are emphasizing that they are very enthusiastic about it.

ext.ext_cn: 你们不必特意盛装赴宴。
ext.ext_en: You do not need to dress up for dinner...

ext.ext_cn: 我就是喜欢穿另一个时代的衣服玩。
ext.ext_en: I just love the fun of dressing up in another era's clothing...

defs.def_en: If you dress up or dress yourself up, you put on different clothes, in order to make yourself look smarter than usual or to disguise yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 妈妈喜欢打扮我。
ext.ext_en: Mother loved to dress me up.

defs.def_en: If you dress someone up, you give them special clothes to wear, in order to make them look smarter or to disguise them.

ext.ext_cn: 政客们将他们的狼子野心美化成是谋求公共利益。
ext.ext_en: Politicians dress up their ruthless ambition as a pursuit of the public good...

ext.ext_cn: 无论你如何粉饰,银行就是为了放贷而生的。
ext.ext_en: However you dress it up, a bank only exists to lend money.

defs.def_en: If you dress something up, you try to make it seem more attractive, acceptable, or interesting than it really is.

ext.ext_cn: 颁给他的嘉奖令称他表现出非凡的勇气，堪为表率。
ext.ext_en: His citation says he showed outstanding and exemplary courage.

defs.def_en: A citation is an official document or speech which praises a person for something brave or special that they have done.
A citation from a book or other piece of writing is a passage or phrase from it.

ext.ext_cn: 法庭可能会发传票，对罗宾斯女士处以罚款。
ext.ext_en: The court could issue a citation and fine Ms. Robbins.

defs.def_en: A citation is the same as a summons .
A pickpocket is a person who steals things from people's pockets or bags in public places.

defs.def_cn: 开罐器；开瓶器；开启工具

ext.ext_cn: 开罐器
ext.ext_en: ...a tin opener.

defs.def_en: See also:eye-opener;An opener is a tool which is used to open containers such as tins or bottles.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 经过慎重思考的;经过深思熟虑的

ext.ext_cn: 安妮认为梅维斯是个厚颜无耻的骗子，这显然是经过一番深思熟虑后才得出的看法。
ext.ext_en: Obviously it was Anne's considered opinion that Mavis was a bold-faced liar...

ext.ext_cn: 对于工会的提议，我们希望能在年底之前给出一个成熟的答复。
ext.ext_en: We would hope to be able to give a considered response to the unions' proposals by the end of the year.

defs.def_en: See also:consider;A considered opinion or act is the result of careful thought.

defs.def_cn: 法国的;法国人的;法语的;法国文化的

ext.ext_cn: 法国议会
ext.ext_en: ...the French parliament...

ext.ext_cn: 所有员工都是法国人。
ext.ext_en: All the staff are French.

defs.def_en: French means belonging or relating to France, or its people, language, or culture.

ext.ext_cn: 三分之二的法国人赞成限制欧洲的进口贸易。
ext.ext_en: Two-thirds of the French are in favour of limiting foreign imports into Europe.

defs.def_en: The French are the people who come from France.

ext.ext_cn: 村民们讲法语。
ext.ext_en: The villagers spoke French.

defs.def_en: French is the language spoken by people who live in France and in parts of some other countries, including Belgium, Canada, and Switzerland.
A xylophone is a musical instrument which consists of a row of wooden bars of different lengths. You play the xylophone by hitting the bars with special hammers.

defs.def_cn: 强硬的抗议;愤怒的回应

ext.ext_cn: 英国专家对该教授的断言进行了强烈驳斥。
ext.ext_en: British experts delivered a strong counter-blast to the Professor's claims.

defs.def_en: A counterblast is a strong angry reply to something that has been said, written, or done.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (选择、陈述等)严峻的，令人不快的

ext.ext_cn: 英国公司如果想要保持竞争力就不得不面对严峻的选择。
ext.ext_en: UK companies face a stark choice if they want to stay competitive...

ext.ext_cn: 在他的庆祝演说中，他向华盛顿和其他西方国家提出了严正警告。
ext.ext_en: In his celebration speech, he issued a stark warning to Washington and other Western capitals.

defs.def_en: Stark choices or statements are harsh and unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 与官方的政策形成鲜明对比的伦敦和华盛顿之间的秘密合作
ext.ext_en: ...secret cooperation between London and Washington that was in stark contrast to official policy.

defs.def_en: If two things are in stark contrast to one another, they are very different from each other in a way that is very obvious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 客厅里简易的、毫无特色的白色壁炉
ext.ext_en: ...the stark white, characterless fireplace in the drawing room.

defs.def_en: Something that is stark is very plain in appearance.
A torch is a small electric light which is powered by batteries and which you can carry in your hand.

ext.ext_cn: 他们点着一支火把，放火烧了小教堂的茅草屋顶。
ext.ext_en: They lit a torch and set fire to the chapel's thatch.

ext.ext_cn: 要求和平的火炬示威游行
ext.ext_en: …a torch-lit march for peace.

defs.def_en: A torch is a long stick with burning material at one end, used to provide light or to set things on fire.

ext.ext_cn: 那伙匪徒为打开金库用氧乙炔炬干了长达10个小时。
ext.ext_en: The gang worked for up to ten hours with acetylene torches to open the vault.

defs.def_en: See also:blowtorch;A torch is a device that produces a hot flame and is used for tasks such as cutting or joining pieces of metal.

ext.ext_cn: 暴乱者放火烧了当地的图书馆。
ext.ext_en: The rioters torched the local library...

ext.ext_cn: 轿车、卡车被放火焚烧，瓶子与砖块乱砸乱飞。
ext.ext_en: Cars and trucks have been torched, bottles and bricks thrown.

defs.def_en: If someone torches a building or vehicle, they set fire to it deliberately.

ext.ext_cn: 他一直单恋芭芭拉。
ext.ext_en: He has always carried a torch for Barbara.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is carrying a torch for someone else, you mean that they secretly admire them or love them.

ext.ext_cn: 这个团体旨在将游行示威的数百万人与死去的数千人的信念传承下去。
ext.ext_en: This group aims to carry the torch for the millions who demonstrated and the thousands who died...

ext.ext_cn: 自从他 1985 年去世以来，他的遗孀一直致力于保存和发扬他的斯大林主义遗产。
ext.ext_en: Since his death in 1985 his widow has carried the torch of his Stalinist legacy.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is carrying the torch of a particular belief or movement, you mean that they are working hard to ensure that it is not forgotten and continues to grow stronger.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 脆干酪
ext.ext_en: ...crumbly cheese.

defs.def_en: Something that is crumbly is easily broken into a lot of little pieces.

ext.ext_cn: 我真的认为人们只要不伤害别人，自己想做什么就可以做什么。
ext.ext_en: I do believe in people being able to do what they want to do, providing they're not hurting someone else...

ext.ext_cn: 如果他们不慌乱，我相信他们生还的概率将在95%以上。
ext.ext_en: Providing they do not panic, I believe that their chances of survival will be beyond 95 per cent.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen providing or providing that something else happens, you mean that the first thing will happen only if the second thing also happens.
A comb is a flat piece of plastic or metal with narrow pointed teeth along one side, which you use to tidy your hair.

ext.ext_cn: 萨尔瓦托认真地梳了梳头。
ext.ext_en: Salvatore combed his hair carefully...

ext.ext_cn: 她淡红色的头发剪得短短的，梳得很整齐。
ext.ext_en: Her reddish hair was cut short and neatly combed.

defs.def_en: When you comb your hair, you tidy it using a comb.

ext.ext_cn: 警察在树林里四处搜寻凶器。
ext.ext_en: Officers combed the woods for the murder weapon...

ext.ext_cn: 他们呈扇形散开，在寺庙周围仔细搜寻。
ext.ext_en: They fanned out and carefully combed the temple grounds.

defs.def_en: If you comb a place, you search everywhere in it in order to find someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 之后8位警察花了两年时间搜寻证据。
ext.ext_en: Eight policemen then spent two years combing through the evidence.

defs.def_en: If you comb through information, you look at it very carefully in order to find something.
A bleeper is the same as a beeper .

ext.ext_cn: 商讨如何控制该地区军备竞赛的会议
ext.ext_en: ...a conference on ways to control the arms race in the region.

defs.def_en: An arms race is a situation in which two countries or groups of countries are continually trying to get more and better weapons than each other.

ext.ext_cn: 我抱定了独身的想法。
ext.ext_en: I'm a confirmed bachelor...

ext.ext_cn: 伦纳德这位坚定的无神论者实在是无法理解。
ext.ext_en: Leonard, a confirmed atheist, simply could not understand.

defs.def_en: You use confirmed to describe someone who has a particular habit or belief that they are very unlikely to change.

ext.ext_cn: 我们重新把水箱加满。
ext.ext_en: We topped up the water tanks...

ext.ext_cn: 他抱怨她喝得太慢，随即又把她的杯子续满。
ext.ext_en: He topped her glass up after complaining she was a slow drinker.

defs.def_en: See also:top-up;If you top something up, you make it full again when part of it has been used.
The iris is the round coloured part of a person's eye.
An iris is a tall plant with long leaves and large purple, yellow, or white flowers.

ext.ext_cn: 经济衰退使许多公司实力大损，不少难以为继。
ext.ext_en: The recession has weakened so many firms that many can no longer survive...

ext.ext_cn: 首相的反对者认为她的权威已经受到致命削弱。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister's opponents believe that her authority has been fatally weakened...

defs.def_en: If you weaken something or if it weakens, it becomes less strong or less powerful.

ext.ext_cn: 我看着名单，觉得自己的决心正在动摇。
ext.ext_en: I looked at the list and felt my resolve weakening...

ext.ext_cn: 詹妮的态度有所缓和，最终软了下来。
ext.ext_en: Jennie weakened, and finally relented...

defs.def_en: If your resolve weakens or if something weakens it, you become less determined or less certain about taking a particular course of action that you had previously decided to take.

ext.ext_cn: 营养不良明显导致病人身体虚弱。
ext.ext_en: Malnutrition obviously weakens the patient.

defs.def_en: If something weakens you, it causes you to lose some of your physical strength.

ext.ext_cn: 一颗炸弹爆炸使后墙的一片砖发生了松动。
ext.ext_en: A bomb blast had weakened an area of brick on the back wall...

ext.ext_cn: 不要直接加热烘干内衣，那样会损坏布料。
ext.ext_en: Never dry underwear over direct heat; it will weaken the fabric.

defs.def_en: If something weakens an object, it does something to it which causes it to become less firm and more likely to break.

defs.def_cn: （出国旅行者用的）外语常用语手册

ext.ext_cn: 我买了一本丹麦常用语手册。
ext.ext_en: We bought a Danish phrase book.

defs.def_en: A phrase book is a book used by people travelling to a foreign country. It has lists of useful words and expressions, together with the translation of each word or expression in the language of that country.
In a restaurant or night club, the dance floor is the area where people can dance.

ext.ext_cn: 他的身体被压得血肉模糊，根本无法辨认。
ext.ext_en: His body was crushed and mangled beyond recognition.

ext.ext_cn: 面目全非的残骸
ext.ext_en: ...the mangled wreckage.

defs.def_en: If a physical object is mangled, it is crushed or twisted very forcefully, so that it is difficult to see what its original shape was.

defs.def_cn: （因发音、书写错误或表达不清晰而）扭曲，改变（词语、信息的意思）

ext.ext_cn: 几乎再简单的话他也表达不清。
ext.ext_en: There is almost no phrase so simple that he cannot mangle it...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不知所云，把科学知识讲得错误百出。
ext.ext_en: They don't know what they're talking about and mangle scientific information.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone mangles words or information, you are criticizing them for not speaking or writing clearly or correctly.

defs.def_cn: (旧时由两个木制滚筒辗压衣服的）轧干机，脱水机
defs.def_en: A mangle is an old-fashioned machine for removing water from clothes that have been washed. The clothes are squeezed between two wooden cylinders.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 帕斯特纳克给了他一个几乎无法察觉的微笑。
ext.ext_en: Pasternak gave him a barely perceptible smile...

ext.ext_cn: 有一种微弱但可察觉的冷落意味。
ext.ext_en: There was a slight but perceptible air of neglect.

defs.def_en: Something that is perceptible can only just be seen or noticed.
A couch is a long, comfortable seat for two or three people.

defs.def_cn: (病人接受检查或治疗时的)诊察台
defs.def_en: A couch is a narrow bed which patients lie on while they are being examined or treated by a doctor.

ext.ext_cn: 新的中右翼政府经常以温和的语言表述其激进的目标。
ext.ext_en: The new centre-right government's radical objectives are often couched in moderate terms...

ext.ext_cn: 这一次该提议是以最后通牒的形式提出来的。
ext.ext_en: This time the proposal was couched as an ultimatum.

defs.def_en: If a statement is couched in a particular style of language, it is expressed in that style of language.

ext.ext_cn: 把它冻硬，但是不要硬得像石头一样。
ext.ext_en: Freeze it only until firm but not rock solid.

defs.def_en: Something that is rock-solid is extremely hard.

defs.def_cn: 十分可靠的;可信赖的;不易改变的

ext.ext_cn: 梅休是一个正直可靠的男人。
ext.ext_en: Mayhew is a man of rock-solid integrity...

ext.ext_cn: 我需要确凿的证据。
ext.ext_en: I'll need rock solid proof...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as rock-solid, you approve of them because they are extremely reliable or unlikely to change.

ext.ext_cn: 整个国家必须要有一套统一的法律。
ext.ext_en: There must be one set of laws for the whole of the country...

ext.ext_cn: 我可能需要一套备用的衣服。
ext.ext_en: I might need a spare set of clothes...

defs.def_en: A set of things is a number of things that belong together or that are thought of as a group.

ext.ext_cn: 格拉芙第一盘以 5 比 1 领先。
ext.ext_en: Graf was leading 5-1 in the first set.

defs.def_en: In tennis, a set is one of the groups of six or more games that form part of a match.
In mathematics, a set is a group of mathematical quantities that have some characteristic in common.

defs.def_cn: (一场音乐会中所演唱或演奏的)一组歌曲(或乐曲)

ext.ext_cn: 短暂的休息后，乐队继续演奏他们的曲目。
ext.ext_en: The band continued with their set after a short break...

ext.ext_cn: 他伴着原声乐器独唱了一组歌曲。
ext.ext_en: He plays a solo acoustic set.

defs.def_en: A band's or musician's set is the group of songs or tunes that they perform at a concert.

defs.def_cn: (经常碰面或趣味相同的)一伙(或一帮、一群)人

ext.ext_cn: 他属于媒体所称的“切尔西圈子”里的人。
ext.ext_en: He belonged to what the press called 'The Chelsea Set'.

defs.def_en: See also:jet set;You can refer to a group of people as a set if they meet together socially or have the same interests and lifestyle.

defs.def_cn: (话剧的)布景;(电影的)摄影棚，拍片现场

ext.ext_cn: 自从进入摄影棚的第一刻起，他就希望自己也能成为一名导演。
ext.ext_en: From the first moment he got on the set, he wanted to be a director too...

ext.ext_cn: 他为牧女游乐园剧院设计的舞台布景
ext.ext_en: ...his stage sets for the Folies Bergeres.

defs.def_en: The set for a play, film, or television show is the furniture and scenery that is on the stage when the play is being performed or in the studio where filming takes place.

ext.ext_cn: 马特看着休，从他坚挺的肩膀中看出了他的倔强。
ext.ext_en: Matt looked at Hugh and saw the stubbornness in the set of his shoulders...

ext.ext_cn: 画家理查德·斯通在她的眼神和面部表情中捕捉到了她的坚毅和决绝。
ext.ext_en: Artist Richard Stone has captured in her eyes and the set of her face her steely determination.

defs.def_en: The set of someone's face or part of their body is the way that it is fixed in a particular expression or position, especially one that shows determination.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们花在看电视上的时间太多了。
ext.ext_en: Children spend so much time in front of the television set...

ext.ext_cn: 1963 年我们买了我们的第一台电视机——黑白的。
ext.ext_en: We got our first set — black and white — in 1963.

defs.def_en: A set is an appliance. For example, a television set is a television.

ext.ext_cn: 他从她手中拿过箱子，将它小心地放在地板上。
ext.ext_en: He took the case out of her hand and set it on the floor...

ext.ext_cn: 他把杯子放下时，饮料溅出来一点。
ext.ext_en: When he set his glass down he spilled a little drink.

defs.def_en: If you set something somewhere, you put it there, especially in a careful or deliberate way.

ext.ext_cn: 这座城堡坐落于一片方圆 25 英亩、风景秀丽的土地上。
ext.ext_en: The castle is set in 25 acres of beautiful grounds...

ext.ext_cn: 基伯龙位于一个 8 英里大小的半岛上。
ext.ext_en: Quiberon is set on an eight-mile peninsula.

defs.def_en: If something is set in a particular place or position, it is in that place or position.

ext.ext_cn: 那名男子打开了高墙中一面大门上的锁让我进去。
ext.ext_en: The man unlocked a gate set in a high wall and let me through...

ext.ext_cn: 舷边甲板下面的一个凹处放了一个小小的洗脸盆。
ext.ext_en: Set into an alcove under the side deck is a tiny wash basin.

defs.def_en: If something is set into a surface, it is fixed there and does not stick out.

defs.def_cn: 使处于(某种状态或情况)

ext.ext_cn: 让厨房计时器开始计时。
ext.ext_en: Set the kitchen timer going...

ext.ext_cn: 会上发言者的一句话让我思绪飘远。
ext.ext_en: A phrase from the conference floor set my mind wandering...

defs.def_en: You can use set to say that a person or thing causes another person or thing to be in a particular condition or situation. For example, to set someone free means to cause them to be free, and to set something going means to cause it to start working.

defs.def_cn: 设置，调整好，调准(钟表等)

ext.ext_cn: 将音量尽量调大。
ext.ext_en: Set the volume as high as possible...

ext.ext_cn: 我忘了定闹钟,结果睡过了头。
ext.ext_en: I forgot to set my alarm and I overslept.

defs.def_en: When you set a clock or control, you adjust it to a particular point or level.

defs.def_cn: 决定，确定(日期、价格、目标或水准)

ext.ext_cn: 会议主席将明天中午定为截止日期。
ext.ext_en: The conference chairman has set a deadline of noon tomorrow...

ext.ext_cn: 将会确定将来会议的时间。
ext.ext_en: A date will be set for a future meeting...

defs.def_en: If you set a date, price, goal, or level, you decide what it will be.

ext.ext_cn: 她对自主权看得很重。
ext.ext_en: She sets a high value on autonomy...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你自己都认为做女人一文不值，又怎么能期望别人尊重你呢？
ext.ext_en: If you set no value on being a woman yourself, how can you expect others to?

defs.def_en: If you set a certain value on something, you think it has that value.

defs.def_cn: 树立(榜样);创造(纪录);开创(先例)

ext.ext_cn: 法律专家说她的案子不会成为判例，因为它是庭外和解的。
ext.ext_en: Legal experts said her case would not set a precedent because it was an out-of-court settlement...

ext.ext_cn: 英国的斯蒂芬·琼斯创造了新的马拉松世界纪录—— 2 小时 8 分零 5 秒。
ext.ext_en: A new world marathon record of 2 hrs, 8 min, 5 sec, was set by Stephen Jones of Great Britain...

defs.def_en: If you set something such as a record, an example, or a precedent, you do something that people will want to copy or try to achieve.

ext.ext_cn: 我必须严格地规划我的学业，同时给自己定下明确的目标。
ext.ext_en: I have to plan my academic work very rigidly and set myself clear objectives...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在给你分派任务之前会先对你进行培训。
ext.ext_en: We will train you first before we set you a task...

defs.def_en: If someone sets you a task or aim or if you set yourself a task or aim, you need to succeed in doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 他打破了用拉丁语出试卷的传统。
ext.ext_en: He broke with the tradition of setting examinations in Latin.

defs.def_en: To set an examination or a question paper means to decide what questions will be asked in it.

defs.def_cn: 安排好的;确定的;固定的

ext.ext_cn: 投资者可以申购固定价格的股票组合。
ext.ext_en: Investors can apply for a package of shares at a set price...

ext.ext_cn: 据说定期斋戒会让我们更虔诚。
ext.ext_en: A set period of fasting is supposed to bring us closer to godliness...

defs.def_en: You use set to describe something which is fixed and cannot be changed.

ext.ext_cn: 指定阅读书目之一是简·奥斯汀的《爱玛》。
ext.ext_en: One of the set books is Jane Austen's Emma.

defs.def_en: A set book must be studied by students taking a particular course.

defs.def_cn: (戏剧、电影、小说等)以(某时或某地)为背景的

ext.ext_cn: 这出戏以中西部的一个小镇为背景。
ext.ext_en: The play is set in a small Midwestern town.

ext.ext_cn: 菲利普·K.迪克 1964 年写的一部以 1994 年火星上一个人类聚居地为背景的科幻小说。
ext.ext_en: ...a 1964 science fiction novel by Philip K Dick, set in 1994 in a colony of humans on Mars...

defs.def_en: If a play, film, or story is set in a particular place or period of time, the events in it take place in that place or period.

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯特·巴乔注定会成为迄今为止最伟大的球员之一。
ext.ext_en: Roberto Baggio was set to become one of the greatest players of all time...

ext.ext_cn: 谈判可能会持续一周。
ext.ext_en: The talks are set to continue through the week.

defs.def_en: If you are set to do something, you are ready to do it or are likely to do it. If something is set to happen, it is about to happen or likely to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 她执意要去女子学校上学。
ext.ext_en: She was set on going to an all-girls school...

ext.ext_cn: 玛格丽特总是调皮捣乱，而且一意孤行。
ext.ext_en: Margaret was always mischievous and set on her own individual course...

defs.def_en: If you are set on something, you are strongly determined to do or have it. If you are set against something, you are strongly determined not to do or have it.

defs.def_cn: 使表现出，显出(坚定的表情)

ext.ext_cn: 相反，她一脸严肃，面部紧绷，一声不吭地等着。
ext.ext_en: Instead, she set her jaw grimly and waited in silence...

ext.ext_cn: 他傲慢无礼地朝元先生冲过来，面露怒容。
ext.ext_en: He came insolently towards Mr. Won, his features set in a scowl.

defs.def_en: If you set your face or jaw, you put on a fixed expression of determination.

ext.ext_cn: 这些甜点开始凝固时就可以加入辅料了。
ext.ext_en: You can add ingredients to these desserts as they begin to set...

ext.ext_cn: 关小火让煎蛋的下面凝固。
ext.ext_en: Lower the heat and allow the omelet to set on the bottom...

defs.def_en: When something such as jelly, melted plastic, or cement sets, it becomes firm or hard.

ext.ext_cn: 他们望着夕阳没入远处的山谷。
ext.ext_en: They watched the sun set behind the distant dales.

ext.ext_cn: 落日的红色余晖
ext.ext_en: ...the red glow of the setting sun.

defs.def_en: When the sun sets, it goes below the horizon.

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎认为我在给他设什么套儿。
ext.ext_en: He seemed to think I was setting some sort of trap for him...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在小路上挖深沟设饵雷。
ext.ext_en: They dug trenches in their path and set booby traps.

defs.def_en: To set a trap means to prepare it to catch someone or something.
When someone sets the table, they prepare it for a meal by putting plates and cutlery on it.

ext.ext_cn: 他因为给古老的宗教经书谱曲配乐而备受关注。
ext.ext_en: He has attracted much interest by setting ancient religious texts to music.

defs.def_en: If someone sets a poem or a piece of writing to music, they write music for the words to be sung to.

defs.def_cn: 为…做准备;为…铺平了道路

ext.ext_cn: 民主党代表大会已经为今年秋季激烈的大选作好了准备。
ext.ext_en: The Democrat convention has set the scene for a ferocious election campaign this autumn...

ext.ext_cn: 该公司最近一直在为美国的业务发展作准备。
ext.ext_en: The company has been setting the stage recently for progress in the US.

defs.def_en: If someone sets the scene or sets the stage for an event to take place, they make preparations so that it can take place.

defs.def_cn: 守旧的;一成不变的;固执的
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is set in their ways, you are being critical of the fact that they have fixed habits and ideas which they will not easily change, even though they may be old-fashioned.

ext.ext_cn: 他们走上街头，用点燃的轮胎设置路障。
ext.ext_en: They took to the streets, setting up roadblocks of burning tyres...

ext.ext_cn: 200名和平人士正计划在边界建一处和平营地。
ext.ext_en: 200 peace activists are planning to set up a peace camp at the border.

defs.def_en: If you set up a temporary structure, you place it or build it somewhere.

defs.def_cn: 安装，装配，调试(设备或机器)

ext.ext_cn: 调试相机可能会很费事。
ext.ext_en: Setting up the camera can be tricky...

ext.ext_en: Jay had always tended to keep his girlfriends at a distance.

Electrical systems or parts supply or use electricity.
