defs.def_cn: 制造电气设备的;供电的
defs.def_en: Electrical industries, engineers, or workers are involved in the production and supply of electricity or electrical goods.

ext.ext_cn: 我在伦敦看过他的独角戏，非常喜欢。
ext.ext_en: I saw him do his one-man show in London, which I loved.

defs.def_en: A one-man performance is given by only one man rather than by several people.

ext.ext_cn: 它已从一个人经营的生意发展成资产规模近千万、业务额达数百万美元的公司。
ext.ext_en: It has grown from a one-man business to a multi-million dollar business with close to $10 million in assets...

ext.ext_cn: 他7个月前在自己的国家建立了个人统治。
ext.ext_en: He established one-man rule in his country seven months ago.

defs.def_en: A one-man organization, such as a business or type of government, is controlled by one person, rather than by several people.

ext.ext_cn: 曼迪递给他一把硬币。
ext.ext_en: Mandy handed him a fistful of coins.

defs.def_en: A fistful of things is the number of them that you can hold in your fist.

ext.ext_cn: 小型企业是经济的生命力所在。
ext.ext_en: Small businesses are the lifeblood of the economy...

ext.ext_cn: 煤炭和钢铁曾是这个地区的生命线。
ext.ext_en: Coal and steel were the region's lifeblood.

defs.def_en: The lifeblood of an organization, area, or person is the most important thing that they need in order to exist, develop, or be successful.

ext.ext_cn: 北约宣称将削减现代核武器的数量并将其维持在这一水平，以保障和平。
ext.ext_en: NATO says it will keep a reduced number of modern nuclear weapons to guarantee peace.

defs.def_en: NATO is an international organization which consists of the USA, Canada, Britain, and other European countries, all of whom have agreed to support one another if they are attacked. NATO is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'North Atlantic Treaty Organization'.

defs.def_cn: (用以编筑篱笆及围墙的)枝条构架

ext.ext_cn: 当地用泥巴和枝条盖起的小屋
ext.ext_en: ...the native huts of mud and wattle.

ext.ext_cn: 篱笆围栏
ext.ext_en: ...wattle fencing.

defs.def_en: Wattle is a framework made by weaving thin sticks through thick sticks which is used for making fences and walls.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指儿童)有礼貌的，有涵养的，有教养的

ext.ext_cn: 他只是个有教养的中产阶级家庭的男孩。
ext.ext_en: He's just a well-brought-up, middle-class boy.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone, especially a child, is well-brought-up, you mean that they are very polite because they have been taught good manners.
A deposit account is a type of bank account where the money in it earns interest.

ext.ext_cn: 烤牛肉
ext.ext_en: ...roast beef.

ext.ext_cn: 炖牛肉
ext.ext_en: ...beef stew.

defs.def_en: See also:corned beef;Beef is the meat of a cow, bull, or ox.

ext.ext_cn: 批评者不要老是抱怨马丁太太没有做什么事情，不妨看看她正要做什么事情。
ext.ext_en: Instead of beefing about what Mrs Martin has not done, her critics might take a look at what she is trying to do.

ext.ext_cn: 我对韦恩真的没有什么不满的。
ext.ext_en: I really don't have a beef with Wayne.

defs.def_en: If someone beefs about something, they keep complaining about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 每一件东西都是莫莉灵巧的双手缝制出来的。
ext.ext_en: Everything had been stitched by Molly's nimble fingers...

ext.ext_cn: 脚步轻盈灵活的瓦尔学会了跳探戈舞。
ext.ext_en: Val, who was light and nimble on her feet, learnt to dance the tango.

defs.def_en: Someone who is nimble is able to move their fingers, hands, or legs quickly and easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 机敏的头脑再加上经济学学位作后盾使他对金融问题把握非常准。
ext.ext_en: A nimble mind backed by a degree in economics gave him a firm grasp of financial matters...

ext.ext_cn: 老年人被告知，要想保持头脑灵敏，就必须要多动脑。
ext.ext_en: Elderly people are told that if they want to keep their minds nimble, they must use them.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a nimble mind, you mean they are clever and can think very quickly.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于机械的）润滑剂，润滑油

ext.ext_cn: 它的喷嘴抹了某种润滑油。
ext.ext_en: Its nozzle was smeared with some kind of lubricant.

ext.ext_cn: 工业用润滑油
ext.ext_en: ...industrial lubricants.

defs.def_en: A lubricant is a substance which you put on the surfaces or parts of something, especially something mechanical, to make the parts move smoothly.

defs.def_cn: （比喻有利于事情顺利进行的）润滑剂

ext.ext_cn: 我认为幽默是人生的上好润滑剂。
ext.ext_en: I think humor is a great lubricant for life.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as a lubricant in a particular situation, you mean that it helps to make things happen without any problems.

defs.def_cn: (与过去分词连用构成形容词)表示“新近…的”，“刚刚…的”

ext.ext_cn: 一瓶刚采摘的鲜花
ext.ext_en: ...a vase of fresh-cut flowers.

ext.ext_cn: 刚割完草的一块草场
ext.ext_en: ...a meadow of fresh-mown hay.

defs.def_en: Fresh- is added to past participles in order to form adjectives which describe something as having been recently made or done.
A hexagon is a shape that has six straight sides.

defs.def_cn: （晚上分别或睡觉前的道别语）晚安
defs.def_en: You say 'Goodnight' to someone late in the evening before one of you goes home or goes to sleep.

defs.def_cn: （晚上分别或睡觉前）道晚安/吻别道晚安

ext.ext_cn: 埃莉诺上楼去跟孩子们道晚安。
ext.ext_en: Eleanor went upstairs to say goodnight to the children.

ext.ext_cn: 两人都站起来与她吻别道晚安。
ext.ext_en: Both men rose to their feet and kissed her goodnight.

defs.def_en: If you say goodnight to someone or kiss them goodnight, you say something such as 'Goodnight' to them or kiss them before one of you goes home or goes to sleep.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 容光焕发的;喜气洋洋的

ext.ext_cn: 凯茜对着女儿容光焕发的面孔微笑着。
ext.ext_en: Kathy smiled at her daughter's radiant face...

ext.ext_cn: 婚礼那天，新娘看上去真是光彩照人。
ext.ext_en: On her wedding day the bride looked truly radiant.

defs.def_en: Someone who is radiant is so happy that their happiness shows in their face.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 光辉灿烂的；光芒四射的

ext.ext_cn: 夕阳为古老的红砖墙罩上了一层暖暖的炫目光辉。
ext.ext_en: The evening sun warms the old red brick wall to a radiant glow.

ext.ext_cn: 海湾里的早晨阳光灿烂。
ext.ext_en: Out on the bay the morning is radiant.

defs.def_en: Something that is radiant glows brightly.

ext.ext_cn: 如果没有太阳辐射的热量，地球将是一个冰封的世界。
ext.ext_en: The earth would be a frozen ball if it were not for the radiant heat of the sun.

defs.def_en: Radiant heat or energy is sent out in the form of rays.

ext.ext_cn: 将向所有参展者发送时间安排。
ext.ext_en: Schedules will be sent out to all exhibitors.

defs.def_en: An exhibitor is a person whose work is being shown in an exhibition.

ext.ext_cn: 他正在用一块满是油污的破布擦手。
ext.ext_en: He was wiping his hands on an oily rag.

ext.ext_cn: 一捆破布
ext.ext_en: ...a bundle of old rags...

defs.def_en: A rag is a piece of old cloth which you can use to clean or wipe things.

ext.ext_cn: 有男人、女人和小孩，其中一些人衣衫褴褛。
ext.ext_en: There were men, women and small children, some dressed in rags.

defs.def_en: Rags are old torn clothes.

ext.ext_cn: “这个叫汤姆的人在一家地方小报社工作，”他说。
ext.ext_en: 'This man Tom works for a local rag,' he said.

defs.def_en: People refer to a newspaper as a rag when they have a poor opinion of it.

defs.def_cn: 嘲弄；拿…开玩笑；对…恶作剧

ext.ext_cn: 她大概有30岁，比那些嘲弄她的年轻人大10岁。
ext.ext_en: She was about thirty, ten years older than the youngsters ragging her.

defs.def_en: To rag someone means to make fun of them in an unkind way.

ext.ext_cn: 我只见他发过一次脾气。
ext.ext_en: I've only once seen him lose his rag.

defs.def_en: If you lose your rag, you suddenly become so angry that you are not in control of yourself.

defs.def_cn: 从赤贫到巨富;白手起家

ext.ext_cn: 他白手起家，人们对他都很钦佩。
ext.ext_en: His was a rags-to-riches story and people admire that.

defs.def_en: You use rags to riches to describe the way in which someone quickly becomes very rich after they have been quite poor.

ext.ext_cn: 烟草公司知道了这种消息一定会大怒。
ext.ext_en: This sort of information is like a red rag to a bull for the tobacco companies.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a red rag to a bull, you mean that it is certain to make a particular person or group very angry.

defs.def_cn: 大麻麻醉剂，哈希什（一种毒品）
defs.def_en: Hashish is an illegal drug made from the hemp plant which some people smoke like a cigarette to make them feel relaxed.

ext.ext_cn: 我们有很多土地被用来种植出口作物。
ext.ext_en: A lot of our land is used to grow crops for export...

ext.ext_cn: 我记得很多事情。
ext.ext_en: I remember a lot of things...

defs.def_en: A lot of something or lots of it is a large amount of it. A lot of people or things, or lots of them, is a large number of them.

ext.ext_cn: 马修经常外出做研究。
ext.ext_en: Matthew's  out quite a lot doing his research...

ext.ext_cn: 我很喜欢你。
ext.ext_en: I like you, a lot...

defs.def_en: A lot means to a great extent or degree.

ext.ext_cn: 他们常常出去玩，一般是到皇家咖啡馆或者常春藤那里。
ext.ext_en: They went out a lot, to the Cafe Royal or the The Ivy...

ext.ext_cn: 他经常谈到自己的孩子。
ext.ext_en: He talks a lot about his own children.

defs.def_en: If you do something a lot, you do it often or for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 他在8月和9月买进了两批这家公司的股票，每次1,000股。
ext.ext_en: He bought two lots of 1,000 shares in the company during August and September...

ext.ext_cn: 我们刚炒掉一批建筑工人。
ext.ext_en: We've just sacked one lot of builders.

defs.def_en: You can use lot to refer to a set or group of things or people.

ext.ext_cn: 未来几代人会觉得我们无趣乏味得很。
ext.ext_en: Future generations are going to think that we were a pretty boring lot.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a specific group of people as a particular lot.

defs.def_cn: （指刚提到的数量的）全部，整个儿

ext.ext_cn: 他没有拿钱去交房租，而是去了投注站，半小时内就把这笔钱全输光了。
ext.ext_en: Instead of using the money to pay his rent, he went to a betting shop and lost the lot in half an hour.

defs.def_en: You can use the lot to refer to the whole of an amount that you have just mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 她想认命接受这段婚姻，但却做不到。
ext.ext_en: She tried to accept her marriage as her lot in life but could not...

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人往往对自己的际遇不甚满意。
ext.ext_en: Young people are usually less contented with their lot.

defs.def_en: Your lot is the kind of life you have or the things that you have or experience.

ext.ext_cn: 如果在你这块地底下发现了石油或金子，你可以把采矿权卖掉。
ext.ext_en: If oil or gold are discovered under your lot, you can sell the mineral rights.

defs.def_en: See also:parking lot;A lot is a small area of land that belongs to a person or company.

defs.def_cn: 一件（或成组的一批）拍卖品

ext.ext_cn: 破产事务官想要将这些店铺打包整体出售。
ext.ext_en: The receivers are keen to sell the stores as one lot...

ext.ext_cn: 这两件拍卖品拍出了300多万英镑的价钱。
ext.ext_en: The two lots have made just over £3 million.

defs.def_en: A lot in an auction is one of the objects or groups of objects that are being sold.

ext.ext_cn: 抽签选出了两个名字。
ext.ext_en: Two names were selected by drawing lots...

ext.ext_cn: 这是世界杯决赛首次用抽签的方法来决定亚军和季军。
ext.ext_en: For the first time in a World Cup finals, lots had to be drawn to decide who would finish second and third.

defs.def_en: If people draw lots to decide who will do something, they each take a piece of paper from a container. One or more pieces of paper is marked, and the people who take marked pieces are chosen.

defs.def_cn: 决心与…共命运；决定与…站在一起

ext.ext_cn: 他已决定与议会中的极右团体共进退。
ext.ext_en: He has decided to throw in his lot with the far-right groups in parliament.

defs.def_en: If you throw in your lot with a particular person or group, you decide to work with them and support them from then on, whatever happens.

ext.ext_cn: 这些人造屏障将会确保提供高度的保护。
ext.ext_en: These man-made barriers will ensure a very high degree of protection...

ext.ext_cn: 政客们已经利用电视取得了不同程度的成功。
ext.ext_en: Politicians have used television with varying degrees of success.

defs.def_en: You use degree to indicate the extent to which something happens or is the case, or the amount which something is felt.

defs.def_cn: （表示相对的数量、规模或范围）程度问题/ 程度上不同

ext.ext_cn: 第一个改变只是程度上的变化，而第二个则是根本性的转变。
ext.ext_en: The first change is a matter of degree, the second is a fundamental shift...

ext.ext_cn: 总的来说，总统的方案和州长的提议似乎只是在程度和强调的重点上有所不同，根本的思想观念几乎无异。
ext.ext_en: Generally, the programs of the president and the proposals of the governor appear to differ in degree and emphasis rather than ideology.

defs.def_en: You use degree in expressions such as a matter of degree and different in degree to indicate that you are talking about the comparative quantity, scale, or extent of something, rather than other factors.

ext.ext_cn: 外面的温度超过了 80 度。
ext.ext_en: It's over 80 degrees outside...

ext.ext_cn: 纯净水有时候要降到零下40摄氏度才会结冰。
ext.ext_en: Pure water sometimes does not freeze until it reaches minus 40 degrees Celsius.

defs.def_en: A degree is a unit of measurement that is used to measure temperatures. It is often written as ˚, for example 23˚.

defs.def_cn: 度，度数(可以表示角度、经度、纬度等)

ext.ext_cn: 它向外指向 45 度角的方向。
ext.ext_en: It was pointing outward at an angle of 45 degrees.

ext.ext_cn: 位于南纬 78 度的麦克默多南极考察站
ext.ext_en: ...McMurdo Station in Antarctica, which is at 78 degrees South.

defs.def_en: A degree is a unit of measurement that is used to measure angles, and also longitude and latitude. It is often written as as '˚', for example 23˚.

ext.ext_cn: 他选择了攻读耶鲁大学的经济学硕士学位。
ext.ext_en: He took a master's degree in economics at Yale.

ext.ext_cn: 工程学学位
ext.ext_en: ...an engineering degree.

defs.def_en: A degree at a university or college is a course of study that you take there, or the qualification that you get when you have passed the course.

ext.ext_cn: 鲁宾逊咖啡屋里的人正在变少，但也只是渐少而已。
ext.ext_en: The crowd in Robinson's Coffee-House was thinning, but only by degrees.

defs.def_en: If something happens by degrees, it happens slowly and gradually.

defs.def_cn: 在一定/很大/ 某种程度上

ext.ext_cn: 这些声明从某种程度上来说全都属实。
ext.ext_en: These statements are, to some degree, all correct.

defs.def_en: You use expressions such as to some degree ,to a large degree, or to a certain degree in order to indicate that something is partly true, but not entirely true.

ext.ext_cn: 你认为发生的事情在多大程度上是在你的掌控之下？
ext.ext_en: To what degree would you say you had control over things that went on?...

ext.ext_cn: 他对自己极为自信，以至于竟然辱骂朋友。
ext.ext_en: He believes in himself to such a degree that he abuses his friends.

defs.def_en: You use expressions such as to what degree and to the degree that when you are discussing how true a statement is, or in what ways it is true.

defs.def_cn: （尤指当have为助动词时，you have的常用口语形式）

ext.ext_cn: 你现在已经拿到学位了，打算做什么？
ext.ext_en: Now you've got your degree, what will you do?...

ext.ext_cn: 你度假时吃过的许多水果都可以在超市买到。
ext.ext_en: Many of the fruits you've tasted on your holidays can be found in supermarkets.

defs.def_en: You've is the usual spoken form of 'you have', especially when 'have' is an auxiliary verb.

defs.def_cn: 大不列颠岛（由英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士组成，与北爱尔兰一起构成联合王国）
defs.def_en: Great Britain is the island consisting of England, Scotland, and Wales, which together with Northern Ireland makes up the United Kingdom.
A slicker is a long loose waterproof coat.
A stud farm is a place where horses are bred.

defs.def_cn: （机构或政府中的）任要职者，高官

ext.ext_cn: 他们在选举中似乎不愿选身居高位的人。
ext.ext_en: They appear to be in a mood to vote against office-holders in the elections.

defs.def_en: An office-holder is a person who has an important official position in an organization or government.

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆某些地方长得和他那帅气的父亲一模一样，只是年轻一些。
ext.ext_en: Tom was in some ways a younger clone of his handsome father...

ext.ext_cn: 要是设计师认为所有人都想和超模一样，那他们就错了。
ext.ext_en: Designers are mistaken if they believe we all want to be supermodel clones.

defs.def_en: If  someone or something is a clone of another person or thing, they are so similar to this person or thing that they seem to be exactly the same as them.

defs.def_cn: 克隆动物(或植物);无性繁殖动物(或植物)
defs.def_en: A clone is an animal or plant that has been produced artificially, for example in a laboratory, from the cells of another animal or plant. A clone is exactly the same as the original animal or plant.

defs.def_cn: 克隆;以无性繁殖技术复制

ext.ext_cn: 克隆已经灭绝的生物的想法仍旧只限于科幻小说中。
ext.ext_en: The idea of cloning extinct life forms still belongs to science fiction.

defs.def_en: To clone an animal or plant means to produce it as a clone.

defs.def_cn: （为了成功或存活的）依靠，依赖

ext.ext_cn: 该市传统上对旅游业的依赖
ext.ext_en: ...the city's traditional dependence on tourism...

ext.ext_cn: 你是期望变老，还是害怕自己年迈体衰、记忆减退，而且还要依赖他人？
ext.ext_en: Do you look forward to old age, or do you dread frailty, loss of memory and dependence on others?

defs.def_en: Your dependence on something or someone is your need for them in order to succeed or be able to survive.

ext.ext_cn: 法国医生倾向于把毒瘾看作是一种根深蒂固的心理障碍。
ext.ext_en: French doctors tend to regard drug dependence as a form of deep-rooted psychological disorder.

defs.def_en: If you talk about drug dependence or alcohol dependence, you are referring to a situation where someone is addicted to drugs or is an alcoholic.

defs.def_cn: （受其影响或决定的）依赖（关系）

ext.ext_cn: 流通对生产的依赖
ext.ext_en: ...the dependence of circulation on production.

defs.def_en: You talk about the dependence of one thing on another when the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

ext.ext_cn: 德肋撒嬷嬷是一位毕生致力于消除贫困事业的年迈修女。
ext.ext_en: Mother Teresa is an elderly nun who has devoted her life to fighting poverty...

ext.ext_cn: 计划设立更多单位防控森林火灾。
ext.ext_en: More units to fight forest fires are planned...

defs.def_en: If you fight something unpleasant, you try in a determined way to prevent it or stop it happening.

ext.ext_cn: 我们政府应该努力废止食物补贴。
ext.ext_en: Our Government should be fighting for an end to food subsidies...

ext.ext_cn: 李不得不为在考察队中获得一席之地而苦苦争取。
ext.ext_en: Lee had to fight hard for his place on the expedition...

defs.def_en: If you fight for something, you try in a determined way to get it or achieve it.

ext.ext_cn: 这两个男人为土地和水的使用权发生了争斗。
ext.ext_en: The two men fought a battle over land and water rights...

ext.ext_cn: 在周末发生的最近一起暴力事件中，警方与向他们投掷手榴弹的一伙匪徒展开了枪战。
ext.ext_en: In the latest incident at the weekend police fought a gun battle with a gang which used hand grenades against them...

defs.def_en: If an army or group fights a battle with another army or group, they oppose each other with weapons. You can also say that two armies or groups fight a battle.

ext.ext_cn: 他参了战，后被美国人俘虏。
ext.ext_en: He fought in the war and was taken prisoner by the Americans...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我是个年轻人，我宁愿进监狱也不愿为这个国家打仗。
ext.ext_en: If I were a young man I would sooner go to prison than fight for this country...

defs.def_en: See also:dogfight;If a person or army fights in a battle or a war, they take part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 她小时候会和妹妹打架。
ext.ext_en: As a child she fought with her younger sister...

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们觉得乔治湖村是个绝妙的游乐园。
ext.ext_en: Children find Lake George Village a wonderland of amusement parks.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a place as a wonderland when it is strange and very beautiful or exciting.

ext.ext_cn: 是内部检举和调查性报道揭露了这一腐败事实。
ext.ext_en: It took internal whistle-blowing and investigative journalism to uncover the rot.

ext.ext_cn: 一份印证了该公务员全部检举内容的长达144页的报告
ext.ext_en: ...a 144-page report which confirmed everything the whistle-blowing civil servant had alleged.

defs.def_en: Whistle-blowing is the act of telling the authorities or the public that the organization you are working for is doing something immoral or illegal.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无准备的；没有预料的；措手不及的；没防备的

ext.ext_cn: 我对第二天的通告完全没有心理准备。
ext.ext_en: I was totally unprepared for the announcement on the next day...

ext.ext_cn: 学院的老师们抱怨说他们的学生还很不适应大学的课业。
ext.ext_en: Faculty members complain that their students are unprepared to do college-level work...

defs.def_en: If you are unprepared for something, you are not ready for it, and you are therefore surprised or at a disadvantage when it happens.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们不愿意接受造成这种国内外形势的真实原因。
ext.ext_en: They are unprepared to accept the real reasons for their domestic and foreign situation...

ext.ext_cn: 他不愿意合作，甚至拒绝交流。
ext.ext_en: He was unprepared to co-operate, or indeed to communicate.

defs.def_en: If you are unprepared to do something, you are not willing to do it.

defs.def_cn: (代替某些形容词词尾的 -te，-t,和 -tic，置于形容词后构成名词)表示“状态”，“性质”

ext.ext_cn: 一家人感情上的亲密
ext.ext_en: ...the emotional intimacy of a family...

ext.ext_cn: 他们依照要求起誓保密。
ext.ext_en: They were sworn to secrecy.

defs.def_en: -cy replaces '-te', '-t', and '-tic' at the end of some adjectives to form nouns referring to the state or quality described by the adjective.

defs.def_cn: (用于名词后构成名词)表示“等级”，“职务”

ext.ext_cn: 他有望继续担任英格兰队队长。
ext.ext_en: He is likely to retain the England captaincy.

ext.ext_cn: 大学特遣牧师职位
ext.ext_en: ...the university chaplaincy.

defs.def_en: -cy is added to some nouns referring to people with a particular rank or post in order to form nouns that refer to this rank or post.

defs.def_cn: 被风吹动的;随风飘动的

ext.ext_cn: 形成了60英尺高的沙丘的风沙
ext.ext_en: ...the wind-blown sand which forms the 60 ft dunes.

defs.def_en: You can use wind-blown to indicate that something has been blown from one place to another by the wind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的一头金发被风吹得乱蓬蓬的。
ext.ext_en: His blond hair was windblown.

defs.def_en: If something such as someone's hair is wind-blown, it is untidy because it has been blown about by the wind.

defs.def_cn: 也门的;也门人的;也门文化的

ext.ext_cn: 也门首都萨那
ext.ext_en: ...the Yemeni capital, Sanaa.

ext.ext_cn: 也门大使
ext.ext_en: ...the Yemeni ambassador.

defs.def_en: Yemeni means belonging or relating to the Yemen, or to its people or culture.
A Yemeni is a Yemeni citizen, or a person of Yemeni origin.

defs.def_cn: (尤指由男子统治或组织的群体中的)妇女们，女人们

ext.ext_cn: 男人们从不留意女人们打理的家。
ext.ext_en: Men never notice anything in a house run by their womenfolk.

defs.def_en: Some people refer to the women of a particular community as its womenfolk, especially when the community is ruled or organized by men.

defs.def_cn: 吨(在英国等于2,240 磅;在美国等于 2,000 磅)

ext.ext_cn: 数百吨石油溢出流入大海。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of tons of oil spilled into the sea...

ext.ext_cn: 清除垃圾每吨要花费 100 美元。
ext.ext_en: Getting rid of rubbish can cost $100 a ton.

defs.def_en: A ton is a unit of weight that is equal to 2240 pounds in Britain and to 2000 pounds in the United States.
A ton is the same as a tonne .

ext.ext_cn: 如果你做了错事，他们全都会对你大发雷霆。
ext.ext_en: If you do something awful they all come down on you like a ton of bricks.

defs.def_en: If someone comes down on you like a ton of bricks, they are extremely angry with you and tell you off because of something wrong that you have done.
If you say that something weighs a ton, you mean that it is extremely heavy.

ext.ext_cn: 基于假口供的情报
ext.ext_en: ...information that was based on perjured testimony.

defs.def_en: In a court of law, perjured evidence or perjured testimony is a false statement of events.

defs.def_cn: 轻车熟路;驾轻就熟;习惯性地做

ext.ext_cn: 这一行程你以前已经走过多次了，早就了如指掌了。
ext.ext_en: You've made that same trip so many times before that you're on automatic pilot...

ext.ext_cn: 我机械性地跟着通过了过境检查、行李认领和海关。
ext.ext_en: My body was on autopilot as I trailed through passport control, baggage reclaim and customs.

defs.def_en: If you are on automatic pilot or on autopilot, you are acting without thinking about what you are doing, usually because you have done it many times before.
An automatic pilot or an autopilot is a device in an aircraft that automatically keeps it on a particular course.

ext.ext_cn: 违法者对受害人亲属给予了适当的补偿。
ext.ext_en: The offender made proper restitution to the victim's kindred.

defs.def_en: Your kindred are your family, and all the people who are related to you.

ext.ext_cn: 我回想起多次同她就这些问题及类似话题进行的讨论。
ext.ext_en: I recall many discussions with her on these and kindred topics.

defs.def_en: Kindred things are similar to each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 误导性的;迷惑性的；欺骗性的

ext.ext_cn: 说我们是朋友会让别人产生误解。
ext.ext_en: It would be misleading to say that we were friends...

ext.ext_cn: 这篇文章有几处误导性说法。
ext.ext_en: The article contains several misleading statements.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as misleading, you mean that it gives you a wrong idea or impression.

ext.ext_cn: 这些蘑菇将会是一道美味的佐菜。
ext.ext_en: These mushrooms would make a delicious side dish.

defs.def_en: A side dish is an amount of a particular food that is served at the same time as the main dish.

defs.def_cn: 所有来者；所有申请者；所有参赛者

ext.ext_cn: 该条件适合于有住宅的所有申请者。
ext.ext_en: This offer is open to all comers, so long as they own a home...

ext.ext_cn: 这是她给所有报名者设置的第二期住校攻读的课程。
ext.ext_en: This is her second season offering residential courses for all-comers.

defs.def_en: You use all-comers to refer to everyone who wants to take part in an activity, especially a competition.
Something that is cerise is a bright pinkish red.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 恢复健康（或体力、精神）的

ext.ext_cn: 她打开了卧室的门，想着今晚洗个热水澡该多么令人惬意。
ext.ext_en: She opened the door to her bedroom, thinking how restorative a hot bath would feel tonight.

defs.def_en: Something that is restorative makes you feel healthier, stronger, or more cheerful after you have been feeling tired, weak, or miserable.

defs.def_cn: 使人恢复健康（或体力、精神）的事物

ext.ext_cn: 休假7天肯定能让人精神焕发。
ext.ext_en: Seven days off could be a wonderful restorative.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a restorative, you mean that it makes you feel healthier, stronger, or more cheerful after you have been feeling tired, weak, or miserable.

defs.def_cn: 证实;证明…正确;证明…无辜

ext.ext_cn: 主任说专家们的报告证明了他是正确的。
ext.ext_en: The director said he had been vindicated by the experts' report...

ext.ext_cn: 部长们和官员们相信他们的决定会被证明是正确的。
ext.ext_en: Ministers and officials are confident their decision will be vindicated.

defs.def_en: If a person or their decisions, actions, or ideas are vindicated, they are proved to be correct, after people have said that they were wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 放入对虾和鱿鱼，烹炒 2 分钟。
ext.ext_en: Add the prawns and squid and cook for 2 minutes.

ext.ext_cn: 放入对虾和鱿鱼，烹炒 2 分钟。
ext.ext_en: Add the prawns and squid and cook for 2 minutes.

defs.def_en: A squid is a sea creature with a long soft body and many soft arms called tentacles.
Blotting paper is thick soft paper that you use for soaking up and drying ink on a piece of paper.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不知什么原因，本该有楼梯的地方却没有。
ext.ext_en: For some unfathomable reason, there are no stairs where there should be...

ext.ext_cn: 生活多么离奇，多么莫测，多么不公啊！
ext.ext_en: How odd life was, how unfathomable, how profoundly unjust.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unfathomable, you mean that it cannot be understood or explained, usually because it is very strange or complicated.

ext.ext_cn: 一个古怪、难以捉摸、反复无常的人
ext.ext_en: ...a strange, unfathomable and unpredictable individual.

ext.ext_cn: 此刻显得浑浊莫测的黑眼睛
ext.ext_en: ...the dark eyes that right now seemed opaque and unfathomable.

defs.def_en: If you use unfathomable to describe a person or the expression on their face, you mean that you cannot tell what they are thinking or what they intend to do.
Anorexia or anorexia nervosa is an illness in which a person has an overwhelming fear of becoming fat, and so refuses to eat enough and becomes thinner and thinner.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 固执的；执拗的；顽固不化的

ext.ext_cn: 他非常偏执，而且具有种族歧视思想。
ext.ext_en: He was bigoted and racist.

defs.def_en: Someone who is bigoted has strong, unreasonable prejudices or opinions and will not change them, even when they are proved to be wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 乍一看的话，还以为他们三人是晚上出来散步的。
ext.ext_en: A casual observer would have taken them to be three men out for an evening stroll...

ext.ext_cn: 目击者说那名女子从花束中拔出一把刀来，扎进了他的颈部。
ext.ext_en: Observers say the woman pulled a knife out of the bunch of flowers and stabbed him in the neck.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone who sees or notices something as an observer .

ext.ext_cn: 观察家说周末发生的事件似乎为反对派赢得了更多支持。
ext.ext_en: Observers say the events of the weekend seem to have increased support for the opposition...

ext.ext_cn: 政治观察家认为新内阁可能很快就会组建。
ext.ext_en: Political observers believe that a new cabinet may be formed shortly.

defs.def_en: An observer is someone who studies current events and situations, especially in order to comment on them and predict what will happen next.

defs.def_cn: （监督重大事件或局势的）观察员

ext.ext_cn: 总统建议联合国应派一名观察员参加本次会议。
ext.ext_en: The president suggested that a UN observer should attend the conference.

defs.def_en: An observer is a person who is sent to observe an important event or situation, especially in order to make sure it happens as it should, or so that they can tell other people about it.

defs.def_cn: （海、河或湖中的）游泳者，嬉水者

ext.ext_cn: 海滩上挤满了游泳嬉戏的人们。
ext.ext_en: The beach was crowded with bathers.

defs.def_en: A bather is a person who is swimming in the sea, or in a river or lake.
A necktie is a narrow piece of cloth that someone, usually a man, puts under his shirt collar and ties so that the ends hang down in front.

ext.ext_cn: 正在为实现零部件标准化和减少推出的型号数量而努力。
ext.ext_en: There is a drive both to standardise components and to reduce the number of models on offer...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为标准化教育对那些智力水平低于或超出平均水平的儿童没有好处。
ext.ext_en: He feels standardized education does not benefit those children who are either below or above average intelligence.

defs.def_en: To standardize things means to change them so that they all have the same features.
Knives is the plural of knife.
A pinhole is a tiny hole.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她风格简约而质朴。
ext.ext_en: Her style is pared-down and simple...

ext.ext_cn: 新的北大西洋公约组织将是一个精简了的军事组织。
ext.ext_en: The new NATO will be a pared-down military organization.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as pared-down, you mean that it has no unnecessary features, and has been reduced to a very simple form.
A divan or divan bed is a bed that has a thick base under the mattress.
A divan is a long soft seat that has no back or arms.

ext.ext_cn: 受暴力和镇压制约的社会
ext.ext_en: ...a society conditioned by violence and repression.

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪30年代的镇压
ext.ext_en: ...the repressions of the 1930s.

defs.def_en: Repression is the use of force to restrict and control a society or other group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 他对男人情感的压抑
ext.ext_en: ...the repression of his feelings about men.

defs.def_en: Repression of feelings, especially sexual ones, is a person's unwillingness to allow themselves to have natural feelings and desires.

ext.ext_cn: 最重要的部分，即花朵，很少成为化石。
ext.ext_en: The most important parts, the flowers, rarely fossilise...

ext.ext_cn: 蛋白质是否存留取决于骨头被石化的方式。
ext.ext_en: The survival of the proteins depends on the way in which bones are fossilised.

defs.def_en: If the remains of an animal or plant fossilize or are fossilized, they become hard and form fossils, instead of decaying completely.

ext.ext_cn: 他们似乎想要做的实际上就是让人们生活和工作的环境固定不变。
ext.ext_en: What they seem to want to do in fact is fossilize the particular environment in which people live and work...

ext.ext_cn: 需要发生改变，但是政策僵化不变。
ext.ext_en: Needs change while policies fossilize.

defs.def_en: If you say that ideas, attitudes, or ways of behaving have fossilized or have been fossilized, you are criticizing the fact that they are fixed and unlikely to change, in spite of changing situations or circumstances.

ext.ext_cn: 已使用这种乳膏来减少阴道感染。
ext.ext_en: The creams have been used to reduce vaginal infections.

defs.def_en: Vaginal means relating to or involving the vagina.

ext.ext_cn: 你会因自己的谎言而犯错误。
ext.ext_en: Your own lies will trip you up...

ext.ext_cn: 他将用尽一切手段让新右翼政府出现失误。
ext.ext_en: He will do all he can to trip up the new right-wing government...

defs.def_en: See also:trip 2;3;If someone or something trips a person up, or if they trip up, they fail or make a mistake.

defs.def_cn: （足球或橄榄球比赛中裁判出示的）红牌
defs.def_en: In football or rugby, if a player is shown the red card, the referee holds up a red card to indicate that the player must leave the pitch for breaking the rules.

defs.def_cn: （足球或橄榄球比赛中）将…红牌罚下

ext.ext_cn: 艾奇逊因两次对翁贝托犯规被红牌罚下。
ext.ext_en: Aitchison was red-carded for two fouls on Umberto.

defs.def_en: In football or rugby, if a player is red carded, the referee holds up a red card to indicate that the player must leave the pitch for breaking the rules.

ext.ext_cn: 薄纱棉布衬衫
ext.ext_en: ...cheesecloth shirts...

ext.ext_cn: 用双层平纹细布或干酪包布过滤混合料。
ext.ext_en: Strain the mixture through a double thickness of muslin or cheesecloth.

defs.def_en: Cheesecloth is cotton cloth that is very thin and light. There are tiny holes between the threads of the cloth.

ext.ext_cn: 他声称自己事先并不知道这次抗议的事。
ext.ext_en: He claimed he had no prior knowledge of the protest...

ext.ext_cn: 宪法规定总统在采取军事行动之前必须获得国会同意。
ext.ext_en: The Constitution requires the president to seek the prior approval of Congress for military action...

defs.def_en: You use prior to indicate that something has already happened, or must happen, before another event takes place.

defs.def_cn: （所有权、责任）更重要的，优先的

ext.ext_cn: 我想选用的这家公司已有约在先。
ext.ext_en: The firm I wanted to use had prior commitments.

defs.def_en: A prior claim or duty is more important than other claims or duties and needs to be dealt with first.

defs.def_cn: 小修道院院长；大修道院副院长
defs.def_en: A prior is a monk who is in charge of a priory or a monk who is the second most important person in a monastery.

ext.ext_cn: 在去日本之前，他去了纽约。
ext.ext_en: Prior to his Japan trip, he went to New York...

ext.ext_cn: 在枪杀案发生之前，有人目睹一位男子在这附近游荡，该男子可能与此案有关。
ext.ext_en: A man seen hanging around the area prior to the shooting could have been involved.

defs.def_en: If something happens prior to a particular time or event, it happens before that time or event.

defs.def_cn: 微不足道的；渺小的；低劣的

ext.ext_cn: 从丹佛来的某个无名乐队
ext.ext_en: ...some poxy band from Denver.

ext.ext_cn: 运输预算中微乎其微的1%
ext.ext_en: ...a poxy one per cent of the transport budget.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as poxy, you think that they are insignificant, too small, or bad in some other way.

defs.def_cn: 花言巧语;华丽的词藻;浮夸之词

ext.ext_cn: 需要的是立刻采取行动，而不是说些华而不实的空话。
ext.ext_en: What is required is immediate action, not rhetoric...

ext.ext_cn: 激烈的言辞让官员们关系如此恶化，双方几乎不怎么说话。
ext.ext_en: The harsh rhetoric had so soured officials that the two sides were barely speaking.

defs.def_en: If you refer to speech or writing as rhetoric, you disapprove of it because it is intended to convince and impress people but may not be sincere or honest.

ext.ext_cn: 政治生活中高尚的惯例，如政治雄辩术、公职和公共服务
ext.ext_en: ...the noble institutions of political life, such as political rhetoric, public office and public service.

defs.def_en: Rhetoric is the skill or art of using language effectively.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在狭窄的街道上和警察打起了游击战。
ext.ext_en: They fought running battles in the narrow streets with police.

defs.def_en: When two groups of people fight a running battle, they keep attacking each other in various parts of a place.

ext.ext_cn: 英语基本熟练是入学条件之一。
ext.ext_en: Evidence of basic proficiency in English is part of the admission requirement.

defs.def_en: If you show proficiency in something, you show ability or skill at it.

ext.ext_cn: 他看到她用拇指按了一个红色按钮——紧急呼叫按钮。
ext.ext_en: He saw her jab her thumb on a red button — a panic button...

ext.ext_cn: 一个针头扎进了婴儿的胳膊。
ext.ext_en: A needle was jabbed into the baby's arm...

defs.def_en: If you jab one thing into another, you push it there with a quick, sudden movement and with a lot of force.

ext.ext_cn: 对对手而言，他实在是太强大了，一顿结实的左刺拳打得对手摇摇晃晃。
ext.ext_en: He was simply too powerful for his opponent, rocking him with a steady supply of left jabs.

defs.def_en: A jab is a sudden, sharp punch.

ext.ext_cn: 很疼的疟疾预防针
ext.ext_en: ...painful anti malaria jabs.

defs.def_en: A jab is an injection of something into your blood to prevent illness.

ext.ext_cn: 他们一直在互相指责，其中民主党一方抨击总统的对外政策。
ext.ext_en: They have been sniping at each other, with the Democrats taking jabs at the president's handling of foreign policy.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a sudden and unpleasant critical remark as a jab .
A hairpin is a small piece of metal or plastic bent back on itself which someone uses to hold their hair in position.
A hairpin is the same as a hairpin bend .
The kernel of a nut is the part that is inside the shell.

ext.ext_cn: 那一信息的核心是和平绝不应该成为对任何人有利或不利的根源。
ext.ext_en: The kernel of that message was that peace must not be a source of advantage or disadvantage for anyone.

defs.def_en: The kernel of something is the central and most important part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 据我所知，他的话可能有一点儿道理。
ext.ext_en: For all I know, there may be a kernel of truth in what he says.

defs.def_en: A kernel of something is a small element of it.

defs.def_cn: （尤指特殊场合的）盛况，壮观景象

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰贵族的气派和显赫
ext.ext_en: ...the pomp and splendour of the English aristocracy.

defs.def_en: Pomp is the use of a lot of ceremony, fine clothes, and decorations, especially on a special occasion.

ext.ext_cn: 这是我很久以来听到的最好消息。
ext.ext_en: It's the best news I've heard in a long time.

defs.def_en: It's is the usual spoken form of 'it is'.

defs.def_cn: (it has 的常用口语形式,尤用于 has 用作助动词时)

ext.ext_cn: 自我上次演出以来已有很长时间了。
ext.ext_en: It's been such a long time since I played.

defs.def_en: It's is the usual spoken form of 'it has', especially when 'has' is an auxiliary verb.

defs.def_cn: 大量地涂抹;厚厚地涂抹

ext.ext_en: If your skin is dry, you have to slather on moisturiser to soften it.

ext.ext_en: The transmitters will send a signal automatically to a local base station...

defs.def_en: To send a signal means to cause it to go to a place by means of radio waves or electricity.

defs.def_en: To send someone or something into a particular state means to cause them to go into or be in that state.

ext.ext_en: The bar chart below shows the huge growth of UK car exports over the past few years.

defs.def_en: A bar chart is a graph which uses parallel rectangular shapes to represent changes in the size, value, or rate of something or to compare the amount of something relating to a number of different countries or groups.

defs.def_cn: （主题乐园或游乐场的）大转轮，摩天轮
defs.def_en: A big wheel is a very large upright wheel with carriages around the edge of it which people can ride in. Big wheels are often found at theme parks or fun fairs.

ext.ext_en: ...postural exercises.

defs.def_en: Postural means relating to the way a person stands or sits.

ext.ext_en: Today, oil and natural gas have replaced coal and wood in most areas.

defs.def_en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

ext.ext_en: The museum's P.R. man was going to be dragged over the coals for sure.

defs.def_en: If a person in authority hauls or drags someone over the coals, they speak to them severely about something foolish or wrong that they have done.

ext.ext_en: Taking a gun to the United States would be like taking coals to Newcastle.

defs.def_en: If someone is taking coals to Newcastle, they are trying to give or sell someone something that they already have a lot of.

ext.ext_en: To me the only justification for a zoo is educational...

defs.def_en: A justification for something is an acceptable reason or explanation for it.

defs.def_cn: 消除，剔除，根除(尤指不需要之物)

ext.ext_en: Academic departments are being eliminated...

ext.ext_en: If you are eliminated in the show-jumping then you are out of the complete competition.

defs.def_en: When a person or team is eliminated from a competition, they are defeated and so take no further part in the competition.

ext.ext_cn: 电牛棒

defs.def_en: If something is contaminated by dirt, chemicals, or radiation, they make it dirty or harmful.

ext.ext_en: It's being overfat that constitutes a health risk...

ext.ext_en: The restaurant has been refurbished — it was found to be a fire risk...

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is a risk, you mean they are likely to cause harm.

defs.def_en: If you are considered a good risk, a bank or shop thinks that it is safe to lend you money or let you have goods without paying for them at the time.

defs.def_cn: 冒着…的危险;担着…的风险

ext.ext_en: Those who fail to register risk severe penalties...

ext.ext_en: Why should he have risked all that to become an agent of a foreign power?

ext.ext_en: Up to 25,000 jobs are still at risk...

ext.ext_en: Americans wanted to aid Britain even at the risk of war.

defs.def_cn: 自担风险;责任自负;后果自负

defs.def_en: If you tell someone that they are doing something at their own risk, you are warning them that, if they are harmed, it will be their own responsibility.

ext.ext_en: ...Beethoven's Piano Sonata in E minor, Opus 90.

defs.def_cn: 艺术作品；乐曲；著作；画作

ext.ext_cn: 彼得·盖布瑞尔的新作
ext.ext_en: ...the new opus from Peter Gabriel.

defs.def_en: See also:magnum opus;You can refer to an artistic work such as a piece of music or writing or a painting as an opus .

ext.ext_cn: 陪审团听到了对所发生事件的两种截然不同的陈述。

ext.ext_en: The economic logic of reform is inescapable...

ext.ext_en: A sense of imminent doom was inescapable.

defs.def_en: If you describe a fact, situation, or activity as inescapable, you mean that it is difficult not to notice it or be affected by it.

defs.def_en: Thrush is a medical condition caused by a fungus. It most often occurs in a baby's mouth or in a woman's vagina.

defs.def_cn: 恣意的批评；有失偏颇的突然抨击

ext.ext_cn: 共和党对手对总统妄加批评
ext.ext_en: ...Republican rivals taking pot shots at the president.

defs.def_en: A pot shot is a criticism of someone which may be unexpected and unfair.

ext.ext_cn: 美满的婚姻中，夫妻双方会共同努力去解决出现的任何问题。

ext.ext_en: The Kurds are spread out across five nations.
