defs.def_en: Oratory is the art of making formal speeches which strongly affect people's feelings and beliefs.

defs.def_cn: （基督徒做礼拜的）祈祷室，小礼拜堂

ext.ext_cn: 婚礼将于下月在布朗普顿礼拜堂举行。
ext.ext_en: The wedding will be at the Brompton Oratory next month.

defs.def_en: An oratory is a room or building where Christians go to pray.

ext.ext_cn: 像做油酥面团那样用指尖把脂油和面粉揉搓到一起。
ext.ext_en: The fat and flour are rubbed together with the fingertips as for pastry.

defs.def_en: Your fingertips are the ends of your fingers.

ext.ext_cn: 资料就在我手边，但一直都没有用。
ext.ext_en: I had the information at my fingertips and hadn't used it.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is at your fingertips, you approve of the fact that you can reach it easily or that it is easily available to you.

ext.ext_cn: 剁肉刀
ext.ext_en: ...a meat cleaver.

defs.def_en: A cleaver is a knife with a large square blade, used for chopping meat or vegetables.

defs.def_cn: 牛奶车(指一种用于送牛奶的有蓬无围挡的电动小货车)
defs.def_en: A milk float is a small electric van with a roof and no sides which is used to deliver milk to people's houses.

ext.ext_cn: 他站起来把他的椅子拖向桌子。
ext.ext_en: He got up and dragged his chair towards the table.

defs.def_en: If you drag something, you pull it along the ground, often with difficulty.

defs.def_cn: (电脑操作中)用鼠标拖动，用鼠标改变（尺寸或形状）

ext.ext_cn: 用鼠标拖动图片,将其调整为新的尺寸。
ext.ext_en: Use your mouse to drag the pictures to their new size.

defs.def_en: To drag a computer image means to use the mouse to move the position of the image on the screen, or to change its size or shape.

ext.ext_cn: 治安人员硬把那些人拉下车。
ext.ext_en: The vigilantes dragged the men out of the vehicles...

ext.ext_cn: 没有迹象表明她是被硬拖着穿过草地的。
ext.ext_en: There were no signs she'd been dragged across the grass.

defs.def_en: If someone drags you somewhere, they pull you there, or force you to go there by physically threatening you.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你能把他硬从工作中拉回来，他也会是个尽心尽责的父亲。
ext.ext_en: When you can drag him away from his work, he can also be a devoted father...

ext.ext_cn: 没有充分的理由，我就从澳大利亚被硬叫了回来。
ext.ext_en: I've been dragged back from Australia for no sufficient reason.

defs.def_en: If someone drags you somewhere you do not want to go, they make you go there.

ext.ext_cn: 我发现要让我自己定期出门锻炼真的很难。
ext.ext_en: I find it really hard to drag myself out and exercise regularly.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你能舍弃酒店的奢侈享受
ext.ext_en: ...if you manage to drag yourself away from the luxury of the hotel.

defs.def_en: If you say that you drag yourself somewhere, you are emphasizing that you have to make a very great effort to go there.

ext.ext_cn: 他极费力地拖着那条中毒的腿走路。
ext.ext_en: He was barely able to drag his poisoned leg behind him...

ext.ext_cn: 他拖着腿，几乎举不起他的胳膊。
ext.ext_en: He drags his leg, and he can hardly lift his arm.

defs.def_en: If you drag your foot or your leg behind you, you walk with great difficulty because your foot or leg is injured in some way.

defs.def_cn: 用网(或钩子)搜索(河或湖底)

ext.ext_cn: 昨天警方的蛙人在公用草地上的一个小池塘里打捞。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday police frogmen dragged a small pond on the Common.

defs.def_en: If the police drag a river or lake, they pull nets or hooks across the bottom of it in order to look for something.

defs.def_cn: (时间)过得很慢;（活动）单调乏味地进行，拖沓地进行

ext.ext_cn: 时间一分钟一分钟地熬过去。
ext.ext_en: The minutes dragged past...

ext.ext_cn: 节奏忽快忽慢，第二幕前半场太过拖沓。
ext.ext_en: The pacing was uneven, and the early second act dragged.

defs.def_en: If a period of time or an event drags, it is very boring and seems to last a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 卫星成了航天飞机的累赘。
ext.ext_en: The satellite acts as a drag on the shuttle...

ext.ext_cn: 缩减开支会减缓增长速度。
ext.ext_en: Spending cuts will put a drag on growth.

defs.def_en: If something is a drag on the development or progress of something, it slows it down or makes it more difficult.

defs.def_cn: 令人不快的事;无聊的事

ext.ext_cn: 逛街买衣服是件挺没意思的事。
ext.ext_en: As far as shopping for clothes goes, it's a drag...

ext.ext_cn: 放干的三明治很难吃。
ext.ext_en: A dry sandwich is a drag to eat.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a drag, you mean that it is unpleasant or very dull.

ext.ext_cn: 他吸了一口烟，吐出了烟雾。
ext.ext_en: He took a drag on his cigarette, and exhaled the smoke.

defs.def_en: If you take a drag on a cigarette or pipe that you are smoking, you take in air through it.

defs.def_cn: (物体在空气或液体中移动时所受到的)阻力，抗力

ext.ext_cn: 额外的空气分子阻力使得卫星坠毁到了地球上。
ext.ext_en: The drag of those extra air molecules brought the satellite crashing to Earth.

defs.def_en: Drag is the resistance to the movement that is experienced by something that is moving through air or through a fluid.

ext.ext_cn: 还安排了娱乐活动，星期三是男扮女装演出，星期天是脱衣舞演出。
ext.ext_en: Entertainment is laid on too, in the form of drag on Wednesdays and strippers on Sundays...

ext.ext_cn: 社区变成了玩杂耍的、踩高跷的和扮装皇后的天地。
ext.ext_en: The neighborhood is given over to performers, stilt walkers and drag queens.

defs.def_en: Drag is the wearing of women's clothes by a male entertainer.

ext.ext_cn: 他声称政府在故意拖延。
ext.ext_en: The government, he claimed, was dragging its feet.

defs.def_en: If you drag your feet or drag your heels, you delay doing something or do it very slowly because you do not want to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 红宝石钻戒
ext.ext_en: ...a ruby and diamond ring.

defs.def_en: A ruby is a dark red jewel.

defs.def_cn: 红宝石色;红玉色;深红色

ext.ext_cn: 一杯深红色的赤霞珠红葡萄酒
ext.ext_en: ...a glass of ruby-red Cabernet Sauvignon.

defs.def_en: Something that is ruby is dark red in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 你曾因日晒出现过皮肤问题吗？
ext.ext_en: Have you ever had any skin problems connected with exposure to the sun?...

ext.ext_cn: 这一争端与谈判没有直接联系。
ext.ext_en: The dispute is not directly connected to the negotiations...

defs.def_en: See also:connect;well-connected;If one thing is connected with another, there is a link or relationship between them.

ext.ext_cn: 他承认自己高谈阔论不是因为他确定找到了真理，而是因为那给了他很多乐趣。
ext.ext_en: He philosophized, he admitted, not because he was certain of establishing the truth, but because it gave him pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 空谈种族和谐的倾向
ext.ext_en: ...a tendency to philosophize about racial harmony.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is philosophizing, you mean that they are talking or thinking about important subjects, sometimes instead of doing something practical.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在白天离开以避免引起怀疑。
ext.ext_en: We left in the daytime so as not to arouse suspicion.

ext.ext_cn: 你所激起的强烈公愤
ext.ext_en: ...the deep public anger you have aroused.

defs.def_en: If something arouses a particular reaction or attitude in people, it causes them to have that reaction or attitude.

ext.ext_cn: 没有什么比走很长的路更能激起食欲的了。
ext.ext_en: There is nothing like a long walk to arouse the appetite...

ext.ext_cn: 他激发了她母性的本能。
ext.ext_en: He aroused her mothering instincts.

defs.def_en: If something arouses a particular feeling or instinct that exists in someone, it causes them to experience that feeling or instinct strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 有些男人在性伴侣对他们说撩人情话时会被激起性欲。
ext.ext_en: Some men are aroused when their partner says erotic words to them.

defs.def_en: If you are aroused by something, it makes you feel sexually excited.

ext.ext_cn: 他道歉说这个话题总是会让他生气。
ext.ext_en: He apologized, saying this subject always aroused him.

defs.def_en: If something arouses you, it makes you feel angry.

ext.ext_cn: 大约两点时，我们被一通敲门声唤醒。
ext.ext_en: About two o'clock, we were aroused from our sleep by a knocking at the door.

defs.def_en: If something arouses you from sleep, it wakes you up.

ext.ext_cn: 内陆地区有一些很有意思的徒步远足路线，但多数徒步者都去爬悬崖陡壁。
ext.ext_en: There are interesting hikes inland, but most ramblers stick to the clifftops...

ext.ext_cn: 要沿着照明好的路走。
ext.ext_en: Stick to well-lit roads.

defs.def_en: If you stick to something or someone when you are travelling, you stay close to them.

ext.ext_cn: 也许他还是一心放在写作上来得保险。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps he should have stuck to writing...

ext.ext_cn: 莱昂内尔，你就把自己看到的告诉警察，实话实说。
ext.ext_en: Lionel, you just tell the cops what you saw; stick to your story.

defs.def_en: If you stick to something, you continue doing, using, saying, or talking about it, rather than changing to something else.

defs.def_cn: 遵守，坚持(诺言、协议、决定或原则等)

ext.ext_cn: 移民支持团体正等着看他是否说话算话。
ext.ext_en: Immigrant support groups are waiting to see if he sticks to his word...

ext.ext_cn: 她明确表示，尽管工会很强悍，但政府将坚持自己的政策。
ext.ext_en: She made it clear the government would stick to its policies despite union militancy...

defs.def_en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.  to stick to your guns→see: gun;

ext.ext_cn: 我们显然很失望，但委员会只能照章办事，别无他法。
ext.ext_en: Obviously we are disappointed but the committee could do nothing less than stick to the rules...

ext.ext_cn: 要想重新赢得公众的信任，警方必须紧遵最高标准。
ext.ext_en: Police must stick to the highest standards if they are to win back public confidence.

defs.def_en: If you stick to rules, you do what they say you must do.

defs.def_cn: （为说服政府或其他权力机关而组织的）压力集团

ext.ext_cn: 环保压力集团“绿色和平”组织
ext.ext_en: ...the environmental pressure group Greenpeace.

defs.def_en: A pressure group is an organized group of people who are trying to persuade a government or other authority to do something, for example to change a law.

defs.def_cn: 玩儿蛋去，见鬼去（用于表达反对、讨厌或恼火）
defs.def_en: Bollocks is used by some people to express disagreement, dislike, or annoyance.
A man's bollocks are his testicles.
A jump rope is a piece of rope, usually with handles at each end. You exercise with it by turning it round and round and jumping over it.

ext.ext_cn: 宾夕法尼亚西部的电话区号是412。
ext.ext_en: The area code for western Pennsylvania is 412.

defs.def_en: The area code for a particular city or region is the series of numbers that you have to dial before someone's personal number if you are making a telephone call to that place from a different area.
A comic book is a magazine that contains stories told in pictures.

ext.ext_cn: 把疖子切开是很痛的。
ext.ext_en: It is a painful experience having the boil lanced.

defs.def_en: If a boil on someone's body is lanced, a small cut is made in it so that the liquid inside comes out.

ext.ext_cn: 长矛撞击盔甲发出的咣咣声
ext.ext_en: ...the clang of lances striking armour.

defs.def_en: A lance is a long spear used in former times by soldiers on horseback.

defs.def_cn: 示威者;示威游行（或集会）者

ext.ext_cn: 我看见警察正试图用催泪弹驱散一群示威者。
ext.ext_en: I saw the police using tear gas to try and break up a crowd of demonstrators.

defs.def_en: Demonstrators are people who are marching or gathering somewhere to show their opposition to something or their support for something.
A demonstrator is a person who shows people how something works or how to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 萨博汽车的经销商目前正推出高档样品车无人陪同的 24 小时试驾活动。
ext.ext_en: Saab dealers are currently giving away unaccompanied 24-hour test drives in posh demonstrator models.

defs.def_en: A demonstrator is an item for sale that customers can use and test so they can decide whether they want to buy it.
A cockatiel is a bird similar to a cockatoo that is often kept as a pet.
Congestion charges refer to money motorists must pay in order to drive in some city centres. Congestion charges are intended to reduce traffic within those areas.

ext.ext_cn: 胚胎在羊膜腔中发育。
ext.ext_en: The embryo lives in the amniotic cavity.

ext.ext_cn: 早期胚胎非凡的适应力
ext.ext_en: ...the remarkable resilience of very young embryos.

defs.def_en: An embryo is an unborn animal or human being in the very early stages of development.

defs.def_cn: (想法、体系或机构)萌芽阶段的，初期的

ext.ext_cn: 他们这个政党有望组建政府，但目前还不成熟。
ext.ext_en: They are an embryo party of government...

ext.ext_cn: 这只是初步的想法，并非成形的提议。
ext.ext_en: It was an embryo idea rather than a fully worked proposal.

defs.def_en: An embryo idea, system, or organization is in the very early stages of development, but is expected to grow stronger.

ext.ext_cn: 这些发展早在十多年前的萌芽阶段就已预见到。
ext.ext_en: These developments were foreseen in embryo more than a decade ago.

defs.def_en: Something that is in embryo is at a very early stage of its development.

ext.ext_cn: 他接着给我讲我出生的事。
ext.ext_en: He proceeded to tell me of my birth...

ext.ext_cn: 他要求在威士忌里加冰，接着心满意足地喝了个酩酊大醉。
ext.ext_en: He asked for ice for his whiskey and proceeded to get contentedly drunk.

defs.def_en: If you proceed to do something, you do it, often after doing something else first.

ext.ext_cn: 这个团体继续示威游行，他们知道这将导致流血事件的发生。
ext.ext_en: The group proceeded with a march they knew would lead to bloodshed...

ext.ext_cn: 因为被告方没有做好应诉的准备，审判已经被延期至11月份。
ext.ext_en: The trial has been delayed until November because the defence is not ready to proceed.

defs.def_en: If you proceed with a course of action, you continue with it.

defs.def_cn: （活动、过程或事件）继续，持续，连续不断

ext.ext_cn: 这些并不是什么新思想，自从战争开始就一直稳定地发展演变。
ext.ext_en: The ideas were not new. Their development had proceeded steadily since the war...

ext.ext_cn: 对内政部进行改革的尝试还没有取得很大进展。
ext.ext_en: Efforts to reform the Interior Ministry  have not yet proceeded very far.

defs.def_en: If an activity, process, or event proceeds, it goes on and does not stop.

ext.ext_cn: 她爬上楼梯，顺着楼上的走廊走去。
ext.ext_en: She climbed the steps and proceeded along the upstairs hallway...

ext.ext_cn: 在确认没有违反制裁条例后，货船被放行了。
ext.ext_en: The freighter was allowed to proceed after satisfying them that it was not breaking sanctions.

defs.def_en: If you proceed in a particular direction, you go in that direction.

defs.def_cn: （某个事件或活动的）收入，收益

ext.ext_cn: 出售武器所得的收入随后用来支持了中美洲的反政府武装组织。
ext.ext_en: The proceeds of the arms sales were then funneled to Contra fighters in Central America...

ext.ext_cn: 音乐会的收入将用于救助饥荒。
ext.ext_en: The proceeds from the concert will go towards famine relief.

defs.def_en: The proceeds of an event or activity are the money that has been obtained from it.

defs.def_cn: 公司供雇员使用的汽车，公司配车(通常作为福利，或因雇员工作需要经常外出)
defs.def_en: A company car is a car which an employer gives to an employee to use as their own, usually as a benefit of having a particular job, or because their job involves a lot of travelling.
Lice is the plural of louse.

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以把一些图画贴在那边的空白墙壁上。
ext.ext_en: We could put some of the pictures over on that blank wall over there...

ext.ext_cn: 他从他的笔记本上撕下一页空白纸。
ext.ext_en: He tore a blank page from his notebook.

defs.def_en: Something that is blank has nothing on it.

ext.ext_cn: 每个空格填上一个单词，把句子补充完整。
ext.ext_en: Put a word in each blank to complete the sentence.

defs.def_en: A blank is a space which is left in a piece of writing or on a printed form for you to fill in particular information.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 茫然的；漠然的；毫无表情的

ext.ext_cn: 阿博特一脸茫然。“我没听明白，先生。”
ext.ext_en: Abbot looked blank. 'I don't quite follow, sir.'...

ext.ext_cn: 他女儿漠然地看了他一眼。
ext.ext_en: His daughter gave him a blank look.

defs.def_en: If you look blank, your face shows no feeling, understanding, or interest.

ext.ext_cn: 对不起，我脑子里一片空白。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry, but my mind is a blank...

ext.ext_cn: 我在医院里醒了过来，不知道自己身在何处。一切都是空白。
ext.ext_en: I came round in hospital and did not know where I was. Everything was a complete blank.

defs.def_en: If your mind or memory is a blank, you cannot think of anything or remember anything.

ext.ext_cn: 只发射空包弹的发令枪
ext.ext_en: ...a starter pistol which only fires blanks.

defs.def_en: Blanks are gun cartridges which contain explosive but do not contain a bullet, so that they cause no harm when the gun is fired.

ext.ext_cn: 他们四处寻找那个司机，但一无所获。
ext.ext_en: They drew a blank in their search for the driver.

defs.def_en: If you draw a blank when you are looking for someone or something, you do not succeed in finding them.

ext.ext_cn: 我的脑子突然一片空白。
ext.ext_en: My mind went totally blank.

defs.def_en: If your mind goes blank, you are suddenly unable to think of anything appropriate to say, for example in reply to a question.
Ltd is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) limited when it is used after the name of a company.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰接着打开前门，我开始跟他上楼。
ext.ext_en: John then unlocked the front door and I started to follow him up the stairs...

ext.ext_cn: 苏珊娜是从 1956 年开始修建这个花园的。
ext.ext_en: It was 1956 when Susanna started the work on the garden...

defs.def_en: If you start to do something, you do something that you were not doing before and you continue doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 火灾被认为是从楼上的一个房间里开始燃起的。
ext.ext_en: The fire is thought to have started in an upstairs room...

ext.ext_cn: 第一次世界大战于那年 8 月爆发。
ext.ext_en: The Great War started in August of that year...

defs.def_en: When something starts, or if someone starts it, it takes place from a particular time.

ext.ext_cn: 我一开始先问了问美国有多少所日托中心。
ext.ext_en: I started by asking how many day-care centers were located in the United States...

ext.ext_cn: 他先去佛罗里达的基韦斯特岛度了个愉快的假期。
ext.ext_en: He started with a good holiday in Key West, Florida.

defs.def_en: If you start by doing something, or if you start with something, you do that thing first in a series of actions.

ext.ext_cn: 贝蒂的第一份工作是在服装厂里当运务员。
ext.ext_en: Betty started as a shipping clerk at the clothes factory...

ext.ext_cn: 格雷斯·罗伯逊于 1947 年参加工作，做了《图片邮报》杂志的一名摄影师。
ext.ext_en: Grace Robertson started as a photographer with Picture Post in 1947.

defs.def_en: You use start to say what someone's first job was. For example, if their first job was that of a factory worker, you can say that they started as a factory worker.

ext.ext_cn: 乔治·格兰杰开办了一个保健中心，我知道他正在物色合格的职员。
ext.ext_en: George Granger has started a health centre and I know he's looking for qualified staff...

ext.ext_cn: 目前可能正是创业的最佳时机。
ext.ext_en: Now is probably as good a time as any to start a business.

defs.def_en: See also:start-up;When someone starts something such as a new business, they create it or cause it to begin.

defs.def_cn: 开动，发动(发动机、汽车、机器等)

ext.ext_cn: 他发动了汽车，车发出平稳的嗡嗡声。
ext.ext_en: He started the car, which hummed smoothly...

ext.ext_cn: 我们从一个停车区经过时，一辆车发动了引擎。
ext.ext_en: We were just passing one of the parking bays when a car's engine started.

defs.def_en: If you start an engine, car, or machine, or if it starts, it begins to work.

ext.ext_cn: 她砰的一声把瓶子放到了桌子上，把他吓了一跳。
ext.ext_en: She put the bottle on the table, banging it down hard. He started at the sound...

ext.ext_cn: 雷切尔从沙发上猛地往前一欠身子。——“你的意思是你已经抓到了皮特?”
ext.ext_en: Rachel started forward on the sofa. — 'You mean you've arrested Pete?'

defs.def_en: If you start, your body suddenly moves slightly as a result of surprise or fear.

ext.ext_cn: 你必须先打听到她的姓名和地址，而那可能就是第一个难题。
ext.ext_en: You must get her name and address, and that can be a problem for a start...

ext.ext_cn: 有人提醒我他 70 岁了，这很令人惊讶。首先，他看上去不像。
ext.ext_en: It comes as a surprise to be reminded that he is 70. For a start, he doesn't look it...

defs.def_en: You use for a start or to start with to introduce the first of a number of things or reasons that you want to mention or could mention.

ext.ext_cn: 新首相上任后开了个好头，但他仍得展现出自己的执政风格。
ext.ext_en: The new Prime Minister has got off to a good start, but he still has to demonstrate what manner of leader he is going to be...

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队在五国锦标赛中开局不利，以 10 比 35 输给了法国队。
ext.ext_en: England got off to a bad start in the Five Nations' Championship, losing 35-10 to France.

defs.def_en: If you get off to a good start, you are successful in the early stages of doing something. If you get off to a bad start, you are not successful in the early stages of doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 一开始，她的压力很大，但现在已经好些了。
ext.ext_en: To start with, the pressure on her was very heavy, but it's eased off a bit now...

ext.ext_cn: 成功有保证了，至少该系统一开始运行得挺顺利。
ext.ext_en: Success was assured and, at least to start with, the system operated smoothly.

defs.def_en: To start with means at the very first stage of an event or process.
A billionaire is an extremely rich person who has money or property worth at least a thousand million pounds or dollars.

ext.ext_cn: 如果他把手指按在喷嘴上，就可以产生强力的喷射。
ext.ext_en: If he put his finger over the nozzle he could produce a forceful spray.

defs.def_en: The nozzle of a hose or pipe is a narrow piece fitted to the end to control the flow of liquid or gas.
In Britain, a holiday camp is a place which provides holiday accommodation and entertainment for large numbers of people.

defs.def_cn: （社交场合）穿晚礼服的，正式的

ext.ext_cn: 老同学正式晚宴
ext.ext_en: ...a black-tie dinner for former students.

defs.def_en: A black tie event is a formal social event such as a party at which people wear formal clothes called evening dress.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数客人都会穿晚礼服。
ext.ext_en: Most of the guests will be wearing black tie.

defs.def_en: If a man is dressed in black tie, he is wearing formal evening dress, which includes a dinner jacket or tuxedo and a bow tie.

ext.ext_cn: 反对人工流产的运动
ext.ext_en: ...the pro-life movement.

defs.def_en: Someone who is pro-life thinks that women do not have a right to choose whether or not to give birth to a child they have conceived, and that abortion is wrong in most or all circumstances.
A soda fountain is a counter in a drugstore or café where snacks and non-alcoholic drinks are prepared and sold.

defs.def_cn: 使有尊严;使变得庄严;使变得高贵

ext.ext_cn: 悲剧作品使悲伤和灾难得到了升华。
ext.ext_en: Tragic literature dignifies sorrow and disaster...

ext.ext_cn: 在那块刻有哈考特·西布利医生姓名的久经风雨的黄铜牌映衬下，门柱更增添了几分庄重。
ext.ext_en: The gatepost was dignified by the weathered brass plate of Dr Harcourt Sibley.

defs.def_en: To dignify something means to make it impressive.

defs.def_cn: 使显得堂皇;抬高…的身价;美化

ext.ext_cn: 这种猜测不值得我们作任何评论。
ext.ext_en: We won't dignify this kind of speculation with a comment...

ext.ext_cn: 那种技术后来被美其名曰“资讯娱乐”。
ext.ext_en: It was a technique later dignified by the term 'info-tainment'.

defs.def_en: If you say that a particular reaction or description dignifies something you have a low opinion of, you mean that it makes it appear acceptable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可预言的；可预测的；可预料的

ext.ext_cn: 考虑到这两个国家之间激烈的敌对情绪，这种反应是可以预见的。
ext.ext_en: This was a predictable reaction, given the bitter hostility between the two countries...

ext.ext_cn: 这个结果完全在预料之中。
ext.ext_en: The result was entirely predictable.

defs.def_en: If you say that an event is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 但是当高夫指望能得到黑格的支持时，却遭到了冷遇。
ext.ext_en: But when Gough looked to Haig for support, he was given the cold shoulder.

defs.def_en: If one person gives another the cold shoulder, they behave towards them in an unfriendly way, to show them that they do not care about them or that they want them to go away.

ext.ext_cn: 就连她自己团队里的人都认为她泼妇似的，又爱唠叨，在走廊里看见她也不爱搭理她。
ext.ext_en: Even her own party considered her shrewish and nagging, and cold-shouldered her in the corridors.

defs.def_en: If one person cold-shoulders another, they give them the cold-shoulder.

Feng shui is a Chinese art which is based on the belief that the way you arrange things within a building, and within the rooms of that building, can affect aspects of your life such as how happy and successful you are.

ext.ext_cn: 这个设备可以插入到笔记本电脑的一个通用串行总线接口。
ext.ext_en: The device plugs into one of the laptop's USB ports.

defs.def_en: A USB on a computer is a place where you can attach another piece of equipment, for example a printer. USB is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'Universal Serial Bus'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 似顽童的;顽皮的;调皮的

ext.ext_cn: 吉莱斯皮以他精灵搞怪的幽默感而广为人知。
ext.ext_en: Gillespie is well known for his impish sense of humour.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or their behaviour as impish, you mean that they are rather disrespectful or naughty in a playful way.
Chiropody is the professional treatment and care of people's feet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （词语、表达方式、主意等）用得过滥的，陈词滥调的

ext.ext_cn: “生态的”这个词已经成为园艺产品生产商用得最滥的形容词之一。
ext.ext_en: 'Ecological' has become one of the most overworked adjectives among manufacturers of garden supplies.

ext.ext_cn: 程式化的微笑
ext.ext_en: ...an overworked simile.

defs.def_en: If you describe a word, expression, or idea as overworked, you mean it has been used so often that it no longer has much effect or meaning.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 银行致函尼克，称他透支了100英镑。
ext.ext_en: Nick's bank sent him a letter saying he was £100 overdrawn...

ext.ext_cn: 透支前先向银行咨询。
ext.ext_en: Talk to the bank before you go overdrawn.

defs.def_en: If you are overdrawn or if your bank account is overdrawn, you have spent more money than you have in your account, and so you are in debt to the bank.

defs.def_cn: 趾高气扬地走;昂首阔步

ext.ext_cn: 他在城里大摇大摆地晃荡，好像那是他的地盘。
ext.ext_en: He struts around town like he owns the place.

ext.ext_cn: 他起身到舞池里炫耀自己的舞技。
ext.ext_en: He got up to strut his stuff on the dance-floor.

defs.def_en: Someone who struts walks in a proud way, with their head held high and their chest out, as if they are very important.

ext.ext_cn: 吊桥的支柱
ext.ext_en: ...the struts of a suspension bridge.

defs.def_en: A strut is a piece of wood or metal which holds the weight of other pieces in a building or other structure.
Something that is mildewed has mildew growing on it.
An articulated vehicle, especially a lorry, is made in two or more sections which are joined together by metal bars, so that the vehicle can turn more easily.

ext.ext_cn: 他不断出手相助这位落难女子。
ext.ext_en: He keeps coming to the aid of this damsel in distress.

defs.def_en: A damsel is a young, unmarried woman.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指令人不快的事情)无休止的，持续不断的，不停的

ext.ext_cn: 无休止的经济不景气和金融紧缩措施的压力
ext.ext_en: ...the remorseless pressure of recession and financial constraint.

ext.ext_cn: 谢尔曼将军在佐治亚州不屈不挠的前进
ext.ext_en: ...General Sherman's remorseless progress through Georgia.

defs.def_en: If you describe something, especially something unpleasant, as remorseless, you mean that it goes on for a long time and cannot be stopped.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 迅速而冷酷地诉诸暴力的能力
ext.ext_en: ...the capacity for quick, remorseless violence.

ext.ext_cn: 毫无怜悯之心的窃贼
ext.ext_en: ...remorseless thieves.

defs.def_en: Someone who is remorseless is prepared to be cruel to other people and feels no pity for them.

ext.ext_cn: 很明显，任何长期接受用心教育的孩子都有可能取得进步。
ext.ext_en: Obviously, any child who receives dedicated teaching over an extended period is likely to improve.

defs.def_en: See also:extend;If something happens for an extended period of time, it happens for a long period of time.

defs.def_cn: （在语言或风俗习惯方面）使英语化，使英国化

ext.ext_cn: 他已将他的姓氏英语化了。
ext.ext_en: He had anglicized his surname...

ext.ext_cn: 荷兰殖民统治在19世纪结束时，文职部门已被英国化了。
ext.ext_en: When Dutch colonial rule ended in the 19th century the civil service was anglicised.

defs.def_en: If you anglicize something, you change it so that it resembles or becomes part of the English language or English culture.

ext.ext_cn: 杀虫剂用得越多，昆虫的抗药力就变得越强，于是又要用更多的杀虫剂。这是一个恶性循环。
ext.ext_en: The more pesticides are used, the more resistant the insects become so the more pesticides have to be used. It's a vicious circle.

ext.ext_cn: 贫穷的恶性循环
ext.ext_en: ...the vicious circle of poverty.

defs.def_en: A vicious circle is a problem or difficult situation that has the effect of creating new problems which then cause the original problem or situation to occur again.

ext.ext_cn: 感觉和认知过程
ext.ext_en: ...processes of perception and cognition.

defs.def_en: Cognition is the mental process involved in knowing, learning, and understanding things.

ext.ext_cn: 有机和无机纤维的屋面材料
ext.ext_en: ...roofing made from organic and inorganic fibres.

defs.def_en: Inorganic substances are substances such as stone and metal that do not come from living things.

defs.def_cn: 极力结交上流人士的人;高攀名流的人

ext.ext_cn: 劳斯十分势利，喜欢攀龙附凤——这几乎是不可否认的事实。
ext.ext_en: That Rous was a snob and a social climber could scarcely be denied.

defs.def_en: You describe someone as a social climber when they try to get accepted into a higher social class by becoming friendly with people who belong to that class.

defs.def_cn: (不能、不必、不愿指明的)东西，事物，特征，事情

ext.ext_cn: “喷泉中间的那个是什么东西？”——“估计是塑像什么的吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'What's that thing in the middle of the fountain?' — 'Some kind of statue, I guess.'...

ext.ext_cn: 她正在忙着收拾早饭后的那一摊子。
ext.ext_en: She was in the middle of clearing the breakfast things...

defs.def_en: You can use thing to refer to any object, feature, or event when you cannot, need not, or do not want to refer to it more precisely.

ext.ext_cn: 这些遗传病通常只发生在男性身上，如肌肉萎缩、血友病等。
ext.ext_en: These are genetic disorders that only affect males normally. They are things like muscular dystrophy and haemophilia...

ext.ext_cn: 地球主要由铁、硅等物质构成。
ext.ext_en: The Earth is made mainly of iron and silicon and things like that...

defs.def_en: Thing is used in lists and descriptions to give examples or to increase the range of what you are referring to.

defs.def_cn: (用于形容词后，与其一起表示该形容词的意思)

ext.ext_cn: 当然，识字和智力是两码事。
ext.ext_en: Of course, literacy isn't the same thing as intelligence...

ext.ext_cn: 为人父母真难啊。
ext.ext_en: To be a parent is a terribly difficult thing...

defs.def_en: Thing is often used after an adjective, where it would also be possible just to use the adjective. For example, you can say it's a different thing instead of it's different .

ext.ext_cn: 这什么问题也解决不了。
ext.ext_en: It isn't going to solve a single thing...

ext.ext_cn: 你什么也不必担心。
ext.ext_en: Don't you worry about a thing...

defs.def_en: Thing is often used instead of the pronouns 'anything,' or 'everything' in order to emphasize what you are saying.

defs.def_cn: (尤用于否定句中，强调恶劣或困难)这种事，这种东西

ext.ext_cn: 我不信他会告诉利奥这种事。
ext.ext_en: I don't believe he would tell Leo such a thing...

ext.ext_cn: “你在指责我是小偷吗？”——“我没有做过这种事，托尼。”
ext.ext_en: 'Are you accusing me of being a thief?' — 'I have done no such thing, Tony.'...

defs.def_en: Thing is used in expressions such as such a thing or things like that, especially in negative statements, in order to emphasize the bad or difficult situation you are referring back to.

defs.def_cn: (尤指不太重要的)情况,形势,活动,想法

ext.ext_cn: 我今晚有点心神不定，这场争斗让我不安。
ext.ext_en: I'm a bit unsettled tonight. This war thing's upsetting me...

ext.ext_cn: 这些家伙显然很拿舞厅这事当回事。
ext.ext_en: These folks clearly take this ballroom thing very seriously.

defs.def_en: You can use thing to refer in a vague way to a situation, activity, or idea, especially when you want to suggest that it is not very important.

ext.ext_cn: 她确实把它拿回了家，放在了一个罐子模样的东西里。
ext.ext_en: She'd actually taken it home and she put it in this jar thing...

ext.ext_cn: 那个潜艇艇长有个类似于潜望镜之类的东西。
ext.ext_en: The captain of the submarine has got this periscope thing.

defs.def_en: You can use thing when you are referring to something that you are uncertain or vague about, after mentioning something that it resembles or could possibly be.

defs.def_cn: (用来表示将要提及重要事情或特别想要对方知道的情况)

ext.ext_cn: 有一点我能肯定，那就是她当时被吓到了。
ext.ext_en: One thing I am sure of was that she was scared...

ext.ext_cn: 父母亲最想知道的是：孩子能活下来吗？
ext.ext_en: The first thing parents want to know is: will the baby survive?...

defs.def_en: You often use thing to indicate to the person you are addressing that you are about to mention something important, or something that you particularly want them to know.

defs.def_cn: (常用于指代刚提及的事，表示强调或提供更多信息)

ext.ext_cn: 喝醉酒这种情况小伙子都会有。
ext.ext_en: Getting drunk is a thing all young men do...

ext.ext_cn: 我从来也没有想要正常过。那不是我想做的事。
ext.ext_en: I never wanted to be normal. It was not a thing I ever thought desirable...

defs.def_en: Thing is often used to refer back to something that has just been mentioned, either to emphasize it or to give more information about it.

ext.ext_cn: 比彻姆，那不是一件东西，是一个人！
ext.ext_en: It's not a thing, Beauchamp. It's a human being!

defs.def_en: A thing is a physical object that is considered as having no life of its own.

defs.def_cn: 东西，玩意儿(表示蔑视或愤怒)

ext.ext_cn: 这玩意儿简直一点用也没有。
ext.ext_en: This thing's virtually useless...

ext.ext_cn: 他们持有轻机枪或者冲锋枪，还是什么玩意儿的。
ext.ext_en: They're armed with sub-machine-guns or machine-pistols or whatever you call those things...

defs.def_en: Thing is used to refer to something, especially a physical object, when you want to express contempt or anger towards it.

defs.def_cn: 家伙，东西（用以提及人或动物的某一特点，通常表示喜爱之情)

ext.ext_cn: 你真是个聪明的小家伙。
ext.ext_en: You really are quite a clever little thing...

ext.ext_cn: 你这个走运的家伙！
ext.ext_en: Oh you lucky thing!

defs.def_en: You can call a person or an animal a particular thing when you want to mention a particular quality that they have and express your feelings towards them, usually affectionate feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉叫他带着他的全部家当离开，再也别回来。
ext.ext_en: Sara told him to take all his things and not to return...

ext.ext_cn: 你在打开行李之前还要借什么东西吗？
ext.ext_en: Is there anything you'd  like to borrow, before your own things are unpacked?

defs.def_en: Your things are your clothes or possessions.

ext.ext_cn: 大家都认为，情况正在好转。
ext.ext_en: Everyone agrees things are getting better...

ext.ext_cn: 改变所有权也许能使情况改善。
ext.ext_en: A change of ownership might improve things...

defs.def_en: Things can refer to the situation or life in general and the way it is changing or affecting you.

ext.ext_cn: 出世超凡
ext.ext_en: ...a movement away from the things of this world to the things of the spirit...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得我现在更加注重精神生活，而且我真的相信善恶报应。
ext.ext_en: I think I'm more aware now of some spiritual things and I do believe in good and evil.

defs.def_en: Things can refer to a particular aspect of life, such as the physical or spiritual aspect.

defs.def_cn: (难以言表的)可怕的事情，怪事，恐怖的事情

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·W.坎贝尔，《外星来客》的作者
ext.ext_en: ...John W. Campbell, author of 'The Thing From Another World.'

defs.def_en: You can refer to something that is too frightening, strange, or horrible to describe clearly as a thing .

ext.ext_cn: 我感觉不得不出去喝他个一醉方休，因为流行这样。
ext.ext_en: I feel under pressure to go out and get drunk because it's the thing to do...

ext.ext_cn: 他们显然认为他的品味已不太流行。
ext.ext_en: They were obviously of the opinion that his taste was not quite the thing.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is the thing, you mean that it is fashionable or popular.

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉希望富兰克林在这件事上和所有其他事情一样，能遵循家庭传统。
ext.ext_en: Sara wished Franklin to follow family tradition, in this as in all things.

ext.ext_cn: 提倡凡事适可而止的传统养生之道
ext.ext_en: ...the old rule of health, which prescribes moderation in all things.

defs.def_en: In all things means in every situation and at all times.

ext.ext_cn: 我意识到我有个大毛病，我总想不得罪任何人。
ext.ext_en: I realised I had a big problem. I wanted to be all things to all people...

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影试图面面俱到——既是喜剧、爱情剧、梦幻剧，还想是讽刺剧。
ext.ext_en: The film tries to be all things to all men — comedy, romance, fantasy, and satire.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is trying to be all things to all men or to all people, you are criticizing them because they are trying to behave in a way that will please everyone, and this is impossible.

ext.ext_cn: 人们想要做正确的事，于是购买“绿色”产品。
ext.ext_en: People want to do the right thing and buy 'green'...

ext.ext_cn: 卡林顿作出了令人敬佩的举动，辞了职。
ext.ext_en: Carrington did the honourable thing and resigned...

defs.def_en: If, for example, you do the right thing or do the decent thing in a situation, you do something which is considered correct or socially acceptable in that situation.

ext.ext_cn: 那不符合社会习俗。在那个年代，养家的应该是男人。
ext.ext_en: It was not the done thing. In those days the man was supposed to be the provider.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is the done thing, you mean it is the most socially acceptable way to behave.

defs.def_cn: 第一件事/最后一件事;一大早/临睡前

ext.ext_cn: 我一早就去看她。
ext.ext_en: I'll go see her, first thing...

ext.ext_cn: 早上第一件事是一定要把钱拿到办公室去。
ext.ext_en: Take the money to your office without fail, first thing in the morning...

defs.def_en: If you do something first thing, you do it at the beginning of the day, before you do anything else. If you do it last thing, you do it at the end of the day, before you go to bed or go to sleep.

defs.def_cn: 对…很反感;对…有特别的感觉

ext.ext_cn: 我一直很讨厌红头发。
ext.ext_en: I had always had a thing about red hair...

ext.ext_cn: 他对领带很在意。
ext.ext_en: He's got this thing about ties.

defs.def_en: If you have a thing about someone or something, you have very strong feelings about them.

defs.def_cn: 最好…，…较好(用来提出建议或评论)

ext.ext_cn: 你能否告诉我该不该修剪苹果树？
ext.ext_en: Can you tell me whether it is a good thing to prune an apple tree?...

ext.ext_cn: 在新的民主国家，掌握妥协这门艺术不是件坏事。
ext.ext_en: In a new democracy, it is no bad thing to master the art of compromise...

defs.def_en: You say it is a good thing to do something to introduce a piece of advice or a comment on a situation or activity.

defs.def_cn: 大肆渲染;小题大做;把事情闹大

ext.ext_cn: 风言风语把他和她出去购物这件事闹得沸沸扬扬。
ext.ext_en: Gossips made a big thing about him going on shopping trips with her...

ext.ext_cn: 我拉着他的手，郑重其事地把他介绍给了我母亲。
ext.ext_en: I took his hand to make a big thing of introducing him to my mother...

defs.def_en: If you make a thing of something or make a thing about it, you talk about it or do it in an exaggerated way, so that it seems much more important than it really is.

defs.def_cn: (用于对比两种想法、行动、局势，强调第二种更困难、重要或极端)…是一回事

ext.ext_cn: 说走容易，真要抬腿跨出门可就难了。
ext.ext_en: It was one thing to talk about leaving; it was another to physically walk out the door...

ext.ext_cn: 借 10 万美元事儿小，欠 42.5 万美元这事可就大了。
ext.ext_en: Borrowing $100,000 is one thing. Owing $425,000 is another!

defs.def_en: You can say that the first of two ideas, actions, or situations is one thing when you want to contrast it with a second idea, action, or situation and emphasize that the second one is much more difficult, important, or extreme.

ext.ext_cn: 她是个恶魔。一方面，她确实以残忍为乐。
ext.ext_en: She was a monster. For one thing, she really enjoyed cruelty...

ext.ext_cn: 她卖不掉它，一来是由于尺寸用起来不方便。
ext.ext_en: She was unable to sell it, because for one thing its size was awkward...

defs.def_en: You can say for one thing when you are explaining a statement or answering a question, to suggest that you are not giving the whole explanation or answer, and that there are other points that you could add to it.

ext.ext_cn: 忙完这个又忙那个，等到我们回到什鲁斯伯里的时候，天色已经很晚了。
ext.ext_en: What with one thing and another, it was fairly late in the day when we returned to Shrewsbury...

ext.ext_cn: 每位来客都要为圣诞节订购啤酒、烈酒、波尔图葡萄酒等这样那样的酒。
ext.ext_en: Everybody came in with their Christmas order for beer and spirits and port and one thing and another.

defs.def_en: You can use the expression 'one thing and another' to suggest that there are several reasons for something or several items on a list, but you are not going to explain or mention them all.

defs.def_cn: 没办法解释的事;赶巧发生

ext.ext_cn: “我也不知道为啥，”丹巴先生耸了耸肩，“我想可能是赶巧了吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'I wonder why.' Mr. Dambar shrugged. 'It must be just one of those things, I guess.'

ext.ext_cn: 这是没办法的事，纯属巧合。
ext.ext_en: It was simply one of those things, pure coincidence.

defs.def_en: If you say it is just one of those things you mean that you cannot explain something because it seems to happen by chance.

ext.ext_cn: 他星期六过来看看她是不是感到孤独。自然而然地，他就留下来过夜了。
ext.ext_en: He came by on Saturday to see if she was lonely. One thing led to another and he stayed the night.

defs.def_en: You say one thing led to another when you are explaining how something happened, but you do not really want to give the details or you think people will be able to imagine the details.

ext.ext_cn: 我们承认所有人——无论男女——都有权以自己的方式去生活，不管其方式有多么怪异离奇。
ext.ext_en: We accept the right of all men and women to do their own thing, however bizarre...

ext.ext_cn: 只要她保持电话联系，她就可以随心所欲地生活。
ext.ext_en: She was allowed to do her own thing as long as she kept in touch by phone.

defs.def_en: If you do your own thing, you live, act, or behave in the way you want to, without paying attention to convention or depending on other people.

defs.def_cn: 不复存在的事物;过去的东西

ext.ext_cn: 自从发明了口服疫苗后，令人痛苦的伤寒疫苗注射就成为了过去。
ext.ext_en: Painful typhoid injections are a thing of the past, thanks to the introduction of an oral vaccine...

ext.ext_cn: 廉价的电脑、传真和电话通信将使每天坐车上下班成为历史。
ext.ext_en: Cheap computers, faxes and phone calls will make commuting to work a thing of the past.

defs.def_en: If something is a thing of the past, it no longer exists or happens, or is being replaced by something new.

ext.ext_cn: 佩恩大夫把拉娜领回检查室，告诉她她有幻视。
ext.ext_en: Dr Payne led Lana back into the examination room and told her she was seeing things...

ext.ext_cn: 我想昨天我出现幻听了。我以为听到了布谷鸟叫。
ext.ext_en: I thought I was hearing things yesterday. I thought I heard a cuckoo.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is seeing or hearing things, you mean that they believe they are seeing or hearing something that is not really there.

defs.def_cn: 没有这回事;不可能的事

ext.ext_cn: 完全没有风险的行业是不存在的。
ext.ext_en: There really is no such thing as a totally risk-free industry...

ext.ext_cn: “我发现了一条美人鱼。”——“别说傻话了。哪有那种东西。”
ext.ext_en: 'I found a mermaid.' — 'Don't  be daft. There's no such thing.'

defs.def_en: You can say there is no such thing as something to emphasize that it does not exist or is not possible.

ext.ext_cn: “你的市场调查有哪些内容？”“嗯，这个嘛，要视我们的目标年龄群体而定。”
ext.ext_en: 'What does your market research consist of?' — 'Well, the thing is, it depends on our target age group.'...

ext.ext_cn: 我要弄到开设言语治疗课程的经费了。但问题是，我不知道自己是否还想做下去。
ext.ext_en: I'm getting a grant for a speech therapy course. But the thing is, I don't know whether I want to do it any more.

defs.def_en: You say the thing is to introduce an explanation, comment, or opinion, that relates to something that has just been said. The thing is is often used to identify a problem relating to what has just been said.

defs.def_cn: 正是所要的;正是所需的

ext.ext_cn: 猕猴桃正是健康的小点心。
ext.ext_en: Kiwi fruit are just the thing for a healthy snack...

ext.ext_cn: 我知道什么能让你提起精神。
ext.ext_en: I know the very thing to cheer you up.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is just the thing or is the very thing, you are emphasizing that it is exactly what is wanted or needed.

ext.ext_cn: 帕特里夏·休伊特很了解如何做到有条不紊。
ext.ext_en: Patricia Hewitt knows a thing or two about how to be well-organised...

ext.ext_cn: 他们一致认为，在家庭价值方面，非洲可以教给美洲很多。
ext.ext_en: They do agree Africa could teach America a thing or two about family values...

defs.def_en: If you say that a person knows a thing or two about something or could teach someone a thing or two about it, you mean that they know a lot about it or are good at it.

defs.def_cn: (童话故事中可载人飞行的)魔毯
defs.def_en: In stories, a magic carpet is a special carpet that can carry people through the air.

ext.ext_cn: 酷爱假日的英国人正收拾小桶和锹铲前往阳光充足的地方。
ext.ext_en: Holiday mad Brits are packing their buckets and spades and heading for the sun.

defs.def_en: British people are sometimes referred to as Brits .
A traffic jam is a long line of vehicles that cannot move forward because there is too much traffic, or because the road is blocked by something.
A tortoise is a slow-moving animal with a shell into which it can pull its head and legs for protection.

ext.ext_cn: 格雷厄姆开始剧烈咳嗽。
ext.ext_en: Graham began to cough violently...

ext.ext_cn: 他咳了一声说道，“奥尔斯沃西夫人，打断您一下，我能说句话吗？”
ext.ext_en: He coughed. 'Excuse me, Mrs Allsworthy, could I have a word?'

defs.def_en: When you cough, you force air out of your throat with a sudden, harsh noise. You often cough when you are ill, or when you are nervous or want to attract someone's attention.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你持续咳嗽一个月以上
ext.ext_en: ...if you have a persistent cough for over a month.

defs.def_en: A cough is an illness in which you cough often and your chest or throat hurts.

ext.ext_cn: 我开始咯血，于是他们把我转到了医院。
ext.ext_en: I started coughing blood so they transferred me to a hospital.

ext.ext_cn: 在寒冷彻骨的海上，基茨开始发烧，不断地咯血。
ext.ext_en: On the chilly seas, Keats became feverish, continually coughing up blood.

defs.def_en: If you cough blood or mucus, it comes up out of your throat or mouth when you cough.

defs.def_cn: (发动机等)突然发出刺耳的噪声

ext.ext_cn: 接着，发动机突然咔咔地响了几声，然后就熄火了。
ext.ext_en: Then suddenly, the engine coughed, spluttered and died.

defs.def_en: If an engine or other machine coughs, it makes a sudden, harsh noise.

defs.def_cn: (由四对或四对以上舞伴组成的老式)方阵舞，夸德里尔舞
defs.def_en: A quadrille is a type of old-fashioned dance for four or more couples.

ext.ext_cn: 能用的那点儿小钱被繁文缛节拖得遥遥无期。
ext.ext_en: The little money that was available was tied up in bureaucratic red tape.

defs.def_en: You refer to official rules and procedures as red tape when they seem unnecessary and cause delay.
A garret is a small room at the top of a house.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎有些抑郁。
ext.ext_en: He seemed somewhat depressed...

ext.ext_cn: 她对整个情形感到极其沮丧和不快。
ext.ext_en: She's been very depressed and upset about this whole situation.

defs.def_en: If you are depressed, you are sad and feel that you cannot enjoy anything, because your situation is so difficult and unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 鼓励向经济困难地区投资的法律法规
ext.ext_en: ...legislation to encourage investment in depressed areas...

ext.ext_cn: 建筑业不再像以往那样萧条了。
ext.ext_en: The construction industry is no longer as depressed as it was.

defs.def_en: A depressed place or industry does not have enough business or employment to be successful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 指压按摩是用手按压人体某个轻微凹陷的穴位。
ext.ext_en: Acupressure is manual pressure applied to a specific slightly depressed point on the body.

defs.def_en: A depressed point on a surface is lower than the parts around it.

defs.def_cn: 马克杯(用来喝热饮的有柄大杯子）

ext.ext_cn: 他用勺子把速溶咖啡舀入两个杯子中。
ext.ext_en: He spooned instant coffee into two of the mugs.

ext.ext_cn: 为让自己保持清醒，他一杯接一杯地喝咖啡。
ext.ext_en: He had been drinking mugs of coffee to keep himself awake.

defs.def_en: A mug is a large deep cup with straight sides and a handle, used for hot drinks.

ext.ext_cn: 我正出门朝我的车走去，就在这时这家伙企图对我进行抢劫。
ext.ext_en: I was walking out to my car when this guy tried to mug me...

ext.ext_cn: 他已是不止一次被抢劫了。
ext.ext_en: He has been mugged more than once.

defs.def_en: If someone mugs you, they attack you in order to steal your money.

ext.ext_cn: 在女性眼里，他是个傻瓜。
ext.ext_en: He's a mug as far as women are concerned...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得签这个协议真傻。
ext.ext_en: I feel such a mug for signing the agreement.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a mug, you mean that they are stupid and easily deceived by other people.

defs.def_cn: (不值得一做的)傻瓜的游戏，傻事

ext.ext_cn: 我曾经是个赌棍，但现在再也不赌了，那是傻瓜的游戏。
ext.ext_en: I used to be a very heavy gambler, but not any more. It's a mug's game...

ext.ext_cn: 傻瓜才节食。
ext.ext_en: Dieting is a mug's game.

defs.def_en: If you say that an activity is a mug's game, you mean that it is not worth doing because it does not give the person who is doing it any benefit or satisfaction.

ext.ext_cn: 他设法让自己那张丑陋的脸上了电视。
ext.ext_en: He managed to get his ugly mug on the telly.

defs.def_en: Some-one's mug is their face.

ext.ext_cn: 诗歌选集
ext.ext_en: ...an anthology of poetry.

defs.def_en: An anthology is a collection of writings by different writers published together in one book.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你读过我早期的回忆录，就全都明白了。
ext.ext_en: If you've read my earlier memoirs you'll know all about it...

ext.ext_cn: 戴高乐在他的回忆录中写道，他怀着拯救法兰西民族的坚定信念来到了伦敦。
ext.ext_en: In his memoirs, De Gaulle wrote that he had come to London determined to save the French nation.

defs.def_en: A person's memoirs are a written account of the people who they have known and events that they remember.

defs.def_cn: (尤指不知道如何完成的)非凡的成就，杰作

ext.ext_cn: 一桩技术奇迹
ext.ext_en: ...a piece of technical wizardry.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a very clever achievement or piece of work as wizardry, especially when you do not understand how it is done.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰被逐出了英格兰。
ext.ext_en: John was banished from England...

ext.ext_cn: 我被赶到了楼上的小卧室。
ext.ext_en: I was banished to the small bedroom upstairs...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is banished from a place or area of activity, they are sent away from it and prevented from entering it.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在摆脱经济衰退的公共投资项目
ext.ext_en: ...a public investment programme intended to banish the recession.

ext.ext_cn: 已经被根除数世纪之久的疟疾之类的疾病
ext.ext_en: ...diseases like malaria that have been banished for centuries.

defs.def_en: If you banish something unpleasant, you get rid of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他现在已经完全打消了退休的念头。
ext.ext_en: He has now banished all thoughts of retirement...

ext.ext_cn: 他现在已经不再去想过去的这几天了。
ext.ext_en: The past few days had been banished from his mind.

defs.def_en: If you banish the thought of something, you stop thinking about it.

ext.ext_cn: 马裤
ext.ext_en: ...riding breeches.

defs.def_en: Breeches are trousers which reach as far as your knees.

defs.def_cn: （政府等提供的金钱上的）法律援助
defs.def_en: Legal aid is money given by the government or another organization to people who cannot afford to pay for a lawyer.
A misanthrope is a person who does not like other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 质量低劣的;蹩脚的;廉价的

ext.ext_cn: 我正在读一本写得很烂的言情小说。
ext.ext_en: I was reading some trashy romance novel.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as trashy, you think it is of very poor quality.

ext.ext_cn: 军队打算占领该城市或干脆截断其粮食补给迫使其投降。
ext.ext_en: The army intends to take the city or simply starve it into submission.

defs.def_en: Submission is a state in which people can no longer do what they want to do because they have been brought under the control of someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 为获得文凭和证书所修的课程通常不需要提交论文。
ext.ext_en: Diploma and certificate courses do not normally require the submission of a dissertation.

defs.def_en: The submission of a proposal, report, or other document is the act of formally sending it to someone, so that they can consider it or decide about it.

defs.def_cn: 提交的建议(或报告等);呈递的文件

ext.ext_cn: 必须准备一份书面报告。
ext.ext_en: A written submission has to be prepared.

defs.def_en: A submission is a proposal, report, or other document that is formally sent or presented to someone, so that they can consider or decide about it.

defs.def_cn: 骑士制度的;骑士精神的

ext.ext_cn: 骑士的理想
ext.ext_en: ...chivalric ideals.

defs.def_en: Chivalric means relating to or connected with the system of chivalry that was believed in and followed by medieval knights.

ext.ext_cn: 盛放贵重宝石的金盒子
ext.ext_en: ...a golden box containing precious jewels.

defs.def_en: See also:crown jewels;A jewel is a precious stone used to decorate valuable things that you wear, such as rings or necklaces.

defs.def_cn: 珍宝；珍贵的东西；出色的人；美貌超群的人

ext.ext_cn: 沿城堡街走下去，欣赏一下我们美妙绝伦的大教堂。
ext.ext_en: Walk down Castle Street and admire our little jewel of a cathedral...

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦，你真是出类拔萃呀。
ext.ext_en: Alan, you're a jewel.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as a jewel, you mean that they are better, more beautiful, or more special than other similar things or than other people.

defs.def_cn: 王冠上的宝石；最有成就（或最值得骄傲）之处

ext.ext_cn: 他的成就令人震惊，而这部书则是他的杰作。
ext.ext_en: His achievement is astonishing and this book is the jewel in his crown.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an achievement or thing as the jewel in someone's crown, you mean that it is considered to be their greatest achievement or the thing they can be most proud of.

ext.ext_cn: 她的嫁妆钱都投到了母亲的铺子里。
ext.ext_en: The money from her dowry was invested in her mother's store.

defs.def_en: A woman's dowry is the money and goods which, in some cultures, her family gives to the man that she marries.

defs.def_cn: 黑帮火拼;帮派争夺地盘的争斗

ext.ext_cn: 该地产正处于两伙敌对的毒品犯罪团伙激烈火拼的中心地带。
ext.ext_en: The estate is at the centre of a bitter turf war between rival drug gangs.

defs.def_en: A turf war is a struggle between criminals or gangs over who controls a particular area.

ext.ext_cn: 双方都称这不仅仅是大小银行争地盘这么简单的问题。
ext.ext_en: Both sides say this is more than just a turf war between big and small banks.

defs.def_en: A turf war is a struggle between people over who controls a particular activity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 小麦适宜在冬季寒冷而夏季温暖干燥的地方生长。
ext.ext_en: Wheat is grown in places which have cold winters and warm, dry summers...

ext.ext_cn: 因为天气暖和，戴维只穿了一件白色的棉衬衣。
ext.ext_en: Because it was warm, David wore only a white cotton shirt...

defs.def_en: Something that is warm has some heat but not enough to be hot.  →see usage note at:hot

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们被迫风餐露宿，吃不饱也穿不暖。
ext.ext_en: They have been forced to sleep in the open without food or warm clothing...

ext.ext_cn: 床上是干净的被单和暖和的毯子。
ext.ext_en: The bed had clean sheets and warm blankets.

defs.def_en: Warm clothes and blankets are made of a material such as wool which protects you from the cold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们希望这种颜色能让房子给人一种暖意融融、宾至如归的感觉。
ext.ext_en: We hope the colour gives the house a warm and inviting feel...

ext.ext_cn: 地下室的走廊漆成了暖黄色。
ext.ext_en: The basement hallway is painted a warm yellow.

defs.def_en: Warm colours have red or yellow in them rather than blue or green, and make you feel comfortable and relaxed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是一位热情慈爱的母亲。
ext.ext_en: She was a warm and loving mother...

ext.ext_cn: “太棒了！”他欢呼道，他熟悉而热情的声音让所有认识他的人都感到如沐春风。
ext.ext_en: 'Wonderful!' he exclaimed, in the familiar warm voice that made everybody who knew him feel welcome...

defs.def_en: A warm person is friendly and shows a lot of affection or enthusiasm in their behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 太阳出来了，把他后背晒得暖洋洋的。
ext.ext_en: The sun had come out to warm his back...

ext.ext_cn: 她把手伸向木火堆取暖。
ext.ext_en: She went to warm her hands by the log fire.

defs.def_en: If you warm a part of your body or if something hot warms it, it stops feeling cold and starts to feel hotter.

defs.def_cn: (对某人)产生好感;(对想法)开始感兴趣

ext.ext_cn: 那些对他日渐了解的人被他的坦率和真诚所打动。
ext.ext_en: Those who got to know him better warmed to his openness and honesty...

ext.ext_cn: 随着这封信接下来进入到伊丽莎白最喜欢抱怨的内容，她开始奔向主题。
ext.ext_en: Elizabeth warmed to her theme as the letter continued with her favourite lament.

defs.def_en: If you warm to a person or an idea, you become fonder of the person or more interested in the idea.
A trunk road is a major road that has been specially built for travelling long distances. A trunk road is not as wide or as fast as a motorway.
Genealogy is the study of the history of families, especially through studying historical documents to discover the relationships between particular people and their families.

ext.ext_cn: 他坐下又给她细数了一遍他家族的家谱，20分钟内说出了一连串的名字。
ext.ext_en: He had sat and repeated his family's genealogy to her, twenty minutes of nonstop names.

defs.def_en: A genealogy is the history of a family over several generations, for example describing who each person married and who their children were.

ext.ext_cn: “再见，”杰夫大声喊。
ext.ext_en: 'See you,' Geoff sang out.

defs.def_en: If someone sings out something, they say it in a loud, cheerful voice.

ext.ext_cn: 蒙蔽、欺骗或恫吓选民的企图
ext.ext_en: ...attempts to deceive, con, or browbeat the voters...

ext.ext_cn: 我要退出100米比赛的时候，一个年纪大些的孩子试图吓唬我就范。
ext.ext_en: When I backed out of the 100 metres, an older kid tried to browbeat me into it.

defs.def_en: If someone tries to browbeat you, they try to force you to do what they want.

defs.def_cn: 胃，腹部（在英国英语中属于非正式或文学用语）

ext.ext_cn: 她把双手放在自己隆起的肚子上。
ext.ext_en: She laid her hands on her swollen belly...

ext.ext_cn: 一匹被开膛破肚的马
ext.ext_en: ...a horse with its belly ripped open...

defs.def_en: See also:beer belly;pot belly;The belly of a person or animal is their stomach or abdomen. In British English, this is an informal or literary use.

defs.def_cn: 资不抵债；无力偿还债务

ext.ext_cn: 我绝对不能眼睁睁地看着这家公司垮掉。
ext.ext_en: I really can't  afford to see this company go belly up.

defs.def_en: If a company goes belly up, it does not have enough money to pay its debts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (话语、想法等)妥当的，合宜的，贴切的

ext.ext_cn: 她的行文风格并非总是恰到好处，往往爱重复。
ext.ext_en: Her prose style is not always felicitous; she tends to repetition.

defs.def_en: If you describe a remark or idea as felicitous, you approve of it because it seems particularly suitable in the circumstances.

defs.def_cn: 代沟；两代人之间的隔阂
defs.def_en: If you refer to the generation gap, you are referring to a difference in attitude and behaviour between older people and younger people, which may cause them to argue or may prevent them from understanding each other fully.

defs.def_cn: (通常指生气时或希望远方的人能听见时而)大叫，嚷，高呼

ext.ext_cn: 在呼啸的大风中他得大声喊叫才能让别人听见。
ext.ext_en: He had to shout to make himself heard above the near gale-force wind...

ext.ext_cn: “她还活着!”他欢欣鼓舞地大声叫道。
ext.ext_en: 'She's alive!' he shouted triumphantly...

defs.def_en: If you shout, you say something very loudly, usually because you want people a long distance away to hear you or because you are angry.

defs.def_cn: 成功在望;有成功的机会

ext.ext_cn: 他明白自己有望为日本建成克雷格·布朗之队。
ext.ext_en: He knew he was in with a shout of making Craig Brown's squad for Japan.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in with a shout of achieving or winning something, you mean that they have a chance of achieving or winning it.
If you are in a pub and someone you are with says 'It's your shout' or 'It's my shout', they mean that it is your turn or their turn to buy a round of drinks.

ext.ext_cn: 轻松赚钱总是件诱人的事。
ext.ext_en: Making easy money has always been an attractive proposition...

ext.ext_cn: 即使在经验丰富的登山者中，平纳克尔峰也被认为是很难攀登的。
ext.ext_en: Even among seasoned mountaineers Pinnacle Ridge is considered quite a tough proposition.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a task or an activity as, for example, a difficult proposition or an attractive proposition, you mean that it is difficult or pleasant to do.

ext.ext_cn: 认为民主国家互不争斗的观点是以一个极小的历史样本为根据的。
ext.ext_en: The proposition that democracies do not fight each other is based on a tiny historical sample.

defs.def_en: A proposition is a statement or an idea which people can consider or discuss to decide whether it is true.

ext.ext_cn: 对第136号修正案投赞成票，但对第129号、133号和134号修正案投反对票。
ext.ext_en: Vote Yes on Proposition 136, but No on Propositions 129, 133 and 134.

defs.def_en: In the United States, a proposition is a question or statement about an issue of public policy which appears on a voting paper so that people can vote for or against it.

ext.ext_cn: 几天前你带着一份商业提案来我的办公室见我。
ext.ext_en: You came to see me at my office the other day with a business proposition...

ext.ext_cn: 我想给你提一个建议。
ext.ext_en: I want to make you a proposition.

defs.def_en: A proposition is an offer or a suggestion that someone makes to you, usually concerning some work or business that you might be able to do together.

defs.def_cn: 向…提出下流的要求；向…提出猥亵的要求

ext.ext_cn: 据说他曾试图向一名同事求欢。
ext.ext_en: He had allegedly tried to proposition a colleague.

ext.ext_cn: 令人讨厌的求欢
ext.ext_en: ...unwanted sexual propositions.

defs.def_en: If someone who you do not know very well propositions you, they suggest that you have sex with them.

ext.ext_cn: 所有的意大利政党都已经承认现在是时候对体制进行改组了。
ext.ext_en: All Italy's political parties have accepted that it is time to revamp the system...

ext.ext_cn: 里卡多·博菲利是一名加泰罗尼亚的建筑师，这座整修过的机场就是他设计的。
ext.ext_en: Ricardo Bofill, the Catalan architect, has designed the revamped airport.

defs.def_en: If someone revamps something, they make changes to it in order to try and improve it.
The morning star is the planet Venus, which can be seen shining in the sky just after the sun rises.

ext.ext_cn: 核潜艇
ext.ext_en: ...a nuclear submarine.

defs.def_en: A submarine is a type of ship that can travel both above and below the surface of the sea. The abbreviation sub is also used.

ext.ext_cn: 海底洞穴
ext.ext_en: ...submarine caves.

ext.ext_cn: 海底植物
ext.ext_en: ...submarine plants.

defs.def_en: Submarine means existing below the surface of the sea.

defs.def_cn: 潜艇三明治，长卷三明治(亦使用缩略形式sub)
defs.def_en: A submarine sandwich is a long soft bread roll filled with a combination of things such as meat, cheese, eggs, and salad. The abbreviation sub is also used.

ext.ext_cn: 在圣诞节演出的哑剧中还能看到这些戏剧残留下来的痕迹。
ext.ext_en: Vestigial remains of these plays are now seen in the Christmas pantomime.

defs.def_en: Vestigial is used to describe the small amounts of something that still remain of a larger or more important thing.

defs.def_cn: 使不愉快;使生气;得罪;惹怒

ext.ext_cn: 为了不惹她生气，他对这个问题避而不答。
ext.ext_en: Not wishing to displease her, he avoided answering the question.

defs.def_en: If something or someone displeases you, they make you annoyed or rather angry.
Riot gear is the special clothing and equipment worn by police officers or soldiers when they have to deal with a riot.

defs.def_cn: (尤用于填塞墙壁、车身或木头缝隙或孔洞的)填料,填充物
defs.def_en: Filler is a substance used for filling cracks or holes, especially in walls, car bodies, or wood.
You can describe something as a filler when it is being used or done because there is a need for something and nothing better is available.
See also:stocking filler;If you say that something is, for example, a stadium filler or a floor filler, you mean that it is likely to attract crowds to a stadium or onto a dance floor.

defs.def_cn: (到自以为会得势的地方参加竞选的)外来政客，提包客

ext.ext_cn: 他来到华盛顿时，不是以寻常的外来政客的身份,而是作为一位名人。
ext.ext_en: He had come to Washington, not as a common carpetbagger, but a man well known.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a carpetbagger, you disapprove of them because they are trying to become a politician in an area which is not their home, simply because they think they are more likely to succeed there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 大胆的;敢于冒险的;勇于创新的

ext.ext_cn: 伯吉特可能比我更敢于冒险。
ext.ext_en: Bergit was probably more daring than I was...

ext.ext_cn: 他意识到这是一个非常大胆的问题。
ext.ext_en: He realized this to be a very daring thing to ask.

defs.def_en: People who are daring are willing to do or say things which are new or which might shock or anger other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 英勇无畏的查利·皮尔斯
ext.ext_en: ...the heroic and daring Charlie Pierce...

ext.ext_cn: 他的大胆营救保住了那些年轻人的性命。
ext.ext_en: His daring rescue saved the lives of the youngsters.

defs.def_en: A daring person is willing to do things that might be dangerous.

ext.ext_cn: 他的冒险可能让他断送了性命。
ext.ext_en: His daring may have cost him his life.

defs.def_en: Daring is the courage to do things which might be dangerous or which might shock or anger other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他那可怕而恶毒的布丽奇特姨妈
ext.ext_en: ...his terrifying and venomous Aunt Bridget...

ext.ext_cn: 他肆意辱骂韦特，并对他进行恶毒的人身攻击。
ext.ext_en: He heaped abuse on Waite and made venomous personal attacks...

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as venomous, you mean that they show great bitterness and anger towards someone.

defs.def_cn: （蛇、蜘蛛等生物）分泌毒液的，有毒的

ext.ext_cn: 蝰蛇是英国唯一的一种毒蛇。
ext.ext_en: The adder is Britain's only venomous snake.

defs.def_en: A venomous snake, spider, or other creature uses poison to attack other creatures.
A sickle is a tool that is used for cutting grass and grain crops. It has a short handle and a long curved blade.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 能抵抗干旱条件的新品种作物
ext.ext_en: ...new strains of crops that can withstand arid conditions.

ext.ext_cn: 该国的干旱区域
ext.ext_en: ...the arid zones of the country.

defs.def_en: Arid land is so dry that very few plants can grow on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 枯燥无味的；乏善可陈的

ext.ext_cn: 她为他枯燥无味的生活带来了从未有过的乐趣。
ext.ext_en: She had given him the only joy his arid life had ever known.

ext.ext_cn: 在20世纪60和70年代军事独裁期间政事荒芜的岁月
ext.ext_en: ...the politically arid years of military dictatorship in the 1960s and '70s.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a period of your life or an academic subject as arid, you mean that it has so little interest, excitement, or purpose that it makes you feel bored or unhappy.

defs.def_cn: 电话交换台;总机;电话局
defs.def_en: A telephone exchange is a building where connections are made between telephone lines.

ext.ext_cn: 专家已把这一病症与体内毒素的积累联系起来。
ext.ext_en: Experts have linked this condition to a build-up of toxins in the body…

ext.ext_cn: 检验表明水生有壳动物的毒素水平提高了。
ext.ext_en: Tests showed increased levels of toxin in shellfish.

defs.def_en: A toxin is any poisonous substance produced by bacteria, animals, or plants.

defs.def_cn: 中名(名与姓之间的名字)

ext.ext_cn: 他的中名是贾斯廷。
ext.ext_en: His middle name is Justin.

defs.def_en: Your middle name is the name that comes between your first name and your surname.

defs.def_cn: 突出的个性；明显的特征

ext.ext_cn: 与人为善是我最大的特点。我在给饭店写评语时很少用到激烈的言辞。
ext.ext_en: Geniality is my middle name. I rarely write a fierce word about any restaurant.

defs.def_en: You can use middle name in expressions such as 'discretion was her middle name' and 'his middle name is loyalty' to indicate that someone always behaves with a great deal of a particular quality.

defs.def_cn: 当然(在英语口语中常用于代替 of course)
defs.def_en: Course is often used in the expression 'of course', or instead of 'of course' in informal spoken English. See 见 of course .

defs.def_cn: (尤指船或飞机的)航向，航线，路线

ext.ext_cn: 飞机可以通过上下升降和左右移动改变航线来避免相撞。
ext.ext_en: Aircraft can avoid each other by going up and down, as well as by altering course to left or right...

ext.ext_cn: 托船驶离卡尔弗特岛海岸朝哈凯航道驶去。
ext.ext_en: The tug was seaward of the Hakai Passage on a course that diverged from the Calvert Island coastline.

defs.def_en: The course of a vehicle, especially a ship or aircraft, is the route along which it is travelling.

ext.ext_cn: 我能给吉尔的最大帮助就是对他忠诚、关爱他并且永远满怀同情之心。
ext.ext_en: My best course of action was to help Gill by being loyal, loving and endlessly sympathetic...

ext.ext_cn: 他必须面对失败，他唯有这一条路走。
ext.ext_en: He must fall on his sword. That's the only course left open to him...

defs.def_en: A course of action is an action or a series of actions that you can do in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 改变历史进程的一系列决定性的海战
ext.ext_en: ...a series of decisive naval battles which altered the course of history...

ext.ext_cn: 按照事情发展的自然规律，母牛每天应该挤奶两次以上。
ext.ext_en: In the natural course of events cows would wish to be milked more than twice a day...

defs.def_en: You can refer to the way that events develop as, for example, the course of history or the course of events .

ext.ext_cn: 企业管理课程
ext.ext_en: ...a course in business administration...

ext.ext_cn: 我不久将要选修一门现代小说课程。
ext.ext_en: I'm shortly to begin a course on the modern novel.

defs.def_en: See also:access course;correspondence course;refresher course;sandwich course;A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

ext.ext_cn: 治疗期间辅以一个疗程的抗生素注射来杀灭细菌。
ext.ext_en: Treatment is supplemented with a course of antibiotics to kill the bacterium...

ext.ext_cn: 她去看医生，医生建议她服用一个疗程的镇静剂。
ext.ext_en: She went to her doctor, who offered to put her on a course of tranquillizers.

defs.def_en: A course of medical treatment is a series of treatments that a doctor gives someone.

ext.ext_cn: 午餐很棒，尤其是第一道菜。
ext.ext_en: The lunch was excellent, especially the first course.

ext.ext_cn: 有3道菜的晚餐
ext.ext_en: ...a three-course dinner.

defs.def_en: A course is one part of a meal.

ext.ext_cn: 比科斯达夫赛场上的前3名骑手之间只差12秒。
ext.ext_en: Only 12 seconds separated the first three riders on the Bickerstaffe course...

ext.ext_cn: 7月份迎来了环法自行车赛，200名自行车选手要骑行2,000英里的赛程。
ext.ext_en: In July comes the Tour de France, when 200 cyclists cover a course of 2,000 miles.

defs.def_en: In sport, a course is an area of land where races are held or golf is played, or the land over which a race takes place.

ext.ext_cn: 富有浪漫气息的庄园和城堡俯瞰着蜿蜒的河道。
ext.ext_en: Romantic chateaux and castles overlook the river's twisting course.

defs.def_en: The course of a river is the channel along which it flows.

ext.ext_cn: 他泪如雨下。
ext.ext_en: The tears coursed down his cheeks...

ext.ext_cn: 静坐时动脉血液流动较缓。
ext.ext_en: When you're sitting still, you need less blood coursing through your arteries.

defs.def_en: If a liquid courses somewhere, it flows quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 在20世纪30年代，英国的钢铁产量几乎翻了一番。
ext.ext_en: In the course of the 1930s steel production in Britain approximately doubled...

ext.ext_cn: 我们聊了起来，在谈话过程中得知他是一名水手。
ext.ext_en: We struck up a conversation, in the course of which it emerged that he was a sailing man.

defs.def_en: If something happens in the course of a particular period of time, it happens during that period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 如果警察每天理所当然地携带武器，这难道不会促使罪犯也持械吗？
ext.ext_en: If police are carrying arms as a matter of course then doesn't it encourage criminals to carry them?

defs.def_en: If you do something as a matter of course, you do it as part of your normal work or way of life.

defs.def_cn: 在正确航道(或航线)上/偏离航道(或航线)

ext.ext_cn: 这艘倒霉的船偏离航道误入浅水区，被另外一艘船撞上了。
ext.ext_en: The ill fated ship was sent off course into shallow waters and rammed by another vessel.

defs.def_en: If a ship or aircraft is on course, it is travelling along the correct route. If it is off course, it is no longer travelling along the correct route.

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队很有可能打进世界杯决赛。
ext.ext_en: England are well on course for a place at the World Cup Finals...

ext.ext_cn: 该公司有望在下一个财年实现2,000万英镑的盈利。
ext.ext_en: The company is on course for profits of £20m in the next financial year.

defs.def_en: If you are on course for something, you are likely to achieve it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们估计在流行病结束之前会有17,000到20,000头牛死去。
ext.ext_en: They estimated that between 17,000 and 20,000 cows would die before the epidemic had run its course...

ext.ext_cn: 他坚称必须对监禁的领导人依法审判。
ext.ext_en: As for the imprisoned leaders, he asserted that justice would have to take its course.

defs.def_en: If something runs its course or takes its course, it develops naturally and comes to a natural end.

ext.ext_cn: 美国历史上的第一位总统连任两届。
ext.ext_en: The oldest president in American history had stayed the course for two terms.

defs.def_en: If you stay the course, you finish something that you have started, even though it has become very difficult.

ext.ext_cn: 最后，他们很多荒诞的说法都变得错综复杂了。
ext.ext_en: In the course of time, many of their myths become entangled.

defs.def_en: If something changes or becomes true in the course of time, it changes or becomes true over a long period of time.
A born-again Christian is a person who has become an evangelical Christian as a result of a religious experience.

defs.def_cn: （人因有了某种新的信仰或生活方式）面目一新的，重获新生的

ext.ext_cn: 作为一个刚刚迷恋上自行车赛的自行车手，我决定参加这个赛季的几场比赛。
ext.ext_en: As a 'born-again' cyclist I had decided that this season I would ride in a few races.

defs.def_en: You can use born-again to describe someone who has adopted a new set of beliefs or a new way of life and is very enthusiastic about it.

ext.ext_cn: 黑人教会社区试图将来自不同教派的基督徒联合起来。
ext.ext_en: The Black church community has sought to bring together Christians from different denominational backgrounds...

ext.ext_cn: 一群来自多个不同教派的宗教领袖
ext.ext_en: ...a multi-denominational group of religious leaders.

defs.def_en: Denominational means relating to or organized by a particular religious denomination.
A field mouse is a mouse with a long tail that lives in fields and woods.

defs.def_cn: （用于亲属关系的名词之前表示更高一辈的关系）

ext.ext_cn: 戴维斯的曾祖母
ext.ext_en: ...Davis's great-grandmother.

defs.def_en: Great- is used before some nouns that refer to relatives. Nouns formed in this way refer to a relative who is a further generation away from you. For example, your great-aunt is the aunt of one of your parents.

ext.ext_cn: 人们为逃税而做出的种种事情令人吃惊。
ext.ext_en: It's  amazing what people will do to get out of paying taxes.

defs.def_en: If you get out of doing something that you do not want to do, you succeed in avoiding doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 他刚一松开手就缓缓向后倒下。
ext.ext_en: He just released his hold and toppled slowly backwards...

ext.ext_cn: 狂风暴雨刮倒了树木，打落了电线。
ext.ext_en: Winds and rain toppled trees and electricity lines.

defs.def_en: If someone or something topples somewhere or if you topple them, they become unsteady or unstable and fall over.

ext.ext_cn: 推翻该政权的革命
ext.ext_en: ...the revolution which toppled the regime.

defs.def_en: To topple a government or leader, especially one that is not elected by the people, means to cause them to lose power.

defs.def_cn: （流行音乐唱片的）B面；次要歌曲

ext.ext_cn: 该乐队的主打歌曲和次要歌曲的汇编
ext.ext_en: ...a compilation of the band's A and B-sides.

defs.def_en: The B-side of a pop record has the less important or less popular song on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是个性情温和的孩子，很少哭闹。
ext.ext_en: She was a placid child who rarely cried...

ext.ext_cn: 马库斯面对她的发作保持平静。
ext.ext_en: Marcus remained placid in the face of her outburst.

defs.def_en: A placid person or animal is calm and does not easily become excited, angry, or upset.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 伊利湖宁静的湖水
ext.ext_en: ...the placid waters of Lake Erie...

ext.ext_cn: 他8年来一直过着平静的生活。
ext.ext_en: He had been leading a placid life for the past eight years.

defs.def_en: A placid place, area of water, or life is calm and peaceful.

ext.ext_cn: 时隔12年之后，轮渡服务又重新开通了。
ext.ext_en: The ferry service has restarted after an interval of 12 years...

ext.ext_cn: 中间有很长时间的沉默。
ext.ext_en: There was a long interval of silence.

defs.def_en: An interval between two events or dates is the period of time between them.

ext.ext_cn: 幕间休息时有葡萄酒供应。
ext.ext_en: During the interval, wine was served...

ext.ext_cn: 中场休息时英格兰队落后两球。
ext.ext_en: England were two goals behind at the interval.

defs.def_en: An interval during a film, concert, show, or game is a short break between two of the parts.

ext.ext_cn: 她夜里每隔一段时间就叫他起来服药。
ext.ext_en: She woke him for his medicines at intervals throughout the night.

defs.def_en: If something happens at intervals, it happens several times with gaps or pauses in between.

defs.def_cn: 以…的间距;每隔…远的距离

ext.ext_en: Several red and white barriers marked the road at intervals of about a mile...

ext.ext_cn: 这条道路得名于这些树木，它们沿两边的路缘间隔均匀地排列着。
ext.ext_en: The trees which gave the road its name stood at regular intervals along the kerb...

defs.def_en: If things are placed at particular intervals, there are spaces of a particular size between them.
A bullwhip is a very long, heavy whip.

ext.ext_cn: 该研究还表明了肥胖症和死亡率之间存在直接的联系。
ext.ext_en: The study also demonstrated a direct link between obesity and mortality...

ext.ext_cn: 你得证明自己是靠得住的。
ext.ext_en: You have to demonstrate that you are reliable...

defs.def_en: To demonstrate a fact means to make it clear to people.

ext.ext_cn: 例如，他们是否已表现出会致力于民主？
ext.ext_en: Have they, for example, demonstrated a commitment to democracy?...

ext.ext_cn: 该政府正不遗余力地展示其军事力量。
ext.ext_en: The government's going to great lengths to demonstrate its military might.

defs.def_en: If you demonstrate a particular skill, quality, or feeling, you show by your actions that you have it.

defs.def_cn: 示威;进行示威游行（或集会）

ext.ext_cn: 3万名愤怒的农场主示威抗议可能对农产品补贴进行的削减。
ext.ext_en: 30,000 angry farmers demonstrated against possible cuts in subsidies...

ext.ext_cn: 在城市里，大批的人群举行示威游行，要求进行变革。
ext.ext_en: In the cities vast crowds have been demonstrating for change...
