ext.ext_cn: 他道歉说这个话题总是会让他生气。
ext.ext_en: He apologized, saying this subject always aroused him.

defs.def_en: If something arouses you, it makes you feel angry.

ext.ext_cn: 大约两点时，我们被一通敲门声唤醒。
ext.ext_en: About two o'clock, we were aroused from our sleep by a knocking at the door.

defs.def_en: If something arouses you from sleep, it wakes you up.

defs.def_cn: (与名词、形容词连用构成形容词)表示“…风格的”，“有…特征的”

ext.ext_cn: 西式政治体系的建立
ext.ext_en: ...the development of a Western-style political system.

ext.ext_cn: 丰盛的乡村大餐
ext.ext_en: ...a hearty country-style dinner.

defs.def_en: -style combines with nouns and adjectives to form adjectives which describe the style or characteristics of something.

defs.def_cn: (与名词、形容词连用构成副词)表示“以…方式”

ext.ext_cn: 客人们被要求打扮成 20 世纪 20 年代的样子。
ext.ext_en: Guests have been asked to dress 1920s-style.

defs.def_en: -style combines with adjectives and nouns to form adverbs which describe how something is done.

ext.ext_cn: 今年福特公司的市场份额一直在扩大，导致通用汽车公司市场份额减少。
ext.ext_en: Ford has been gaining market share this year at the expense of GM.

defs.def_en: A company's market share in a product is the proportion of the total sales of that product that is produced by that company.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 新潮的泳衣
ext.ext_en: ...snazzy swimsuits.

ext.ext_cn: 漂亮的新款保时捷
ext.ext_en: ...a snazzy new Porsche.

defs.def_en: Something that is snazzy is stylish and attractive, often in a rather bright or noticeable way.

ext.ext_cn: 来自布里斯班的42岁家庭主妇
ext.ext_en: ...a 42-year-old housewife from Brisbane.

defs.def_en: A housewife is a married woman who does not have a paid job, but instead looks after her home and children.
A swan is a large bird with a very long neck. Swans live on rivers and lakes and are usually white.

ext.ext_cn: 她一个人自由自在地环游世界。
ext.ext_en: She spends her time swanning around the world...

ext.ext_cn: 这位母亲成了寡妇，已经悠然闲逛去了。
ext.ext_en: The mother was widowed and had swanned off.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as swanning around or swanning off, you mean that they go and have fun, rather than working or taking care of their responsibilities.
A worksheet is a specially prepared page of exercises designed to improve your knowledge or understanding of a particular subject.

defs.def_cn: （表示比较而言唯一真实、恰当或必要的情况）只，只有

ext.ext_cn: 只有总统才能授权使用原子弹。
ext.ext_en: Only the President could authorize the use of the atomic bomb...

ext.ext_cn: 只有强有力的男性才能给予的指导和训练
ext.ext_en: ...the guidance and discipline that can be provided only by a strong male...

defs.def_en: You use only to indicate the one thing that is true, appropriate, or necessary in a particular situation, in contrast to all the other things that are not true, appropriate, or necessary.

defs.def_cn: （引出发生的必要条件）只有…（才）

ext.ext_cn: 只有官司赢了才支付律师费。
ext.ext_en: The lawyer is paid only if he wins...

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰银行坚持只有条件成熟才会降息。
ext.ext_en: The Bank of England insists that it will cut interest rates only when it is ready...

defs.def_en: You use only to introduce the thing which must happen before the thing mentioned in the main part of the sentence can happen.

ext.ext_cn: 她是壳牌公司法律事务部唯一的女性。
ext.ext_en: She was the only woman in Shell's legal department...

ext.ext_cn: 我的猫古斯塔夫是我所有的一切——我唯一的伴侣。
ext.ext_en: My cat Gustaf was the only thing I had—the only company.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the only person or thing involved in a particular situation, you mean there are no others involved in it.
An only child is a child who has no brothers or sisters.

defs.def_cn: (尤用于想要纠正错误观点时)只不过，仅…而已

ext.ext_cn: 眼下这只不过是个推测而已。
ext.ext_en: At the moment it is only a theory...

ext.ext_cn: “我只是一名中士，”克莱门茨说道。
ext.ext_en: 'I'm only a sergeant,' said Clements...

defs.def_en: You use only to indicate that something is no more important, interesting, or difficult, for example, than you say it is, especially when you want to correct a wrong idea that someone may get or has already got.

defs.def_cn: （强调数量少或时间短）才，仅仅

ext.ext_cn: 儿童汽车坐椅一周的租金才10英镑。
ext.ext_en: Child car seats only cost about £10 a week to hire.

ext.ext_cn: 仅有几克重的宇宙飞船导航系统
ext.ext_en: ...spacecraft guidance systems weighing only a few grams...

defs.def_en: You use only to emphasize how small an amount is or how short a length of time is.

defs.def_cn: （强调是其中的一小部分，而非全部）只，仅仅

ext.ext_cn: 这些仅仅是其中几种可能。
ext.ext_en: These are only a few of the possibilities...

ext.ext_cn: 只有少数人支持这场革命。
ext.ext_en: Only a minority of the people supported the Revolution.

defs.def_en: You use only to emphasize that you are talking about a small part of an amount or group, not the whole of it.

defs.def_cn: （用于 can 或 could 之后，强调除此以外别无可为）只（能）

ext.ext_cn: 我有那么一会儿一句话都说不出来，只能站在那里看着。
ext.ext_en: For a moment I could say nothing. I could only stand and look...

ext.ext_cn: 警方只能猜测问题的严重性。
ext.ext_en: The police can only guess at the scale of the problem.

defs.def_en: Only is used after 'can' or 'could' to emphasize that it is impossible to do anything except the rather inadequate or limited action that is mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 现在我的境况好转了，我真希望他能在这里。
ext.ext_en: I only wish he were here now that things are getting better for me...

ext.ext_cn: 我们唯有希望这些大象能够康复。
ext.ext_en: We can only hope that the elephants can recover.

defs.def_en: You can use only in the expressions I only wish or I only hope in order to emphasize what you are hoping or wishing.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示稍加改动或限定）只是，不过

ext.ext_cn: 这就像电影一样充满戏剧性，不过这是真实发生的。
ext.ext_en: It's just as dramatic as a film, only it's real...

ext.ext_cn: 这有点像我的房子，只是更为漂亮。
ext.ext_en: It's a bit like my house, only nicer...

defs.def_en: Only can be used to add a comment which slightly changes or limits what you have just said.

defs.def_cn: （用于含有 would 的从句后，引出未做某事的原因）要不是，若非

ext.ext_cn: 要不是路太远，我一定会邀你一同前往。
ext.ext_en: I'd invite you to come with me, only it's such a long way...

ext.ext_cn: 我是很乐意去的，只是不知道孩子们会不会喜欢住在那里。
ext.ext_en: I'd be quite happy to go. Only I don't know what my kids would say about living there.

defs.def_en: Only can be used after a clause with 'would' to indicate why something is not done.

ext.ext_cn: 赖尔试着找了大使馆，却被告知休正在开会。
ext.ext_en: Ryle tried the Embassy, only to be told that Hugh was in a meeting...

ext.ext_cn: 他飞快地跑过起居室，却发现前门锁上了。
ext.ext_en: He raced through the living room, only to find the front door closed.

defs.def_en: You can use only before an infinitive to introduce an event which happens immediately after one you have just mentioned, and which is rather surprising or unfortunate.

defs.def_cn: （强调行动或行为恰当）完全，真正

ext.ext_cn: 告诉她你打算申请，这才算公平嘛。
ext.ext_en: It's only fair to let her know that you intend to apply...

ext.ext_cn: 她看起来变化很大，不过这完全是在意料之中的。
ext.ext_en: She appeared to have changed considerably, which was only to be expected.

defs.def_en: You can use only to emphasize how appropriate a certain course of action or type of behaviour is.

defs.def_cn: （用于动词前，表示结果令人遗憾或不受欢迎）愈加，只（会）

ext.ext_cn: 禁运只会殃及无辜的百姓。
ext.ext_en: The embargo would only hurt innocent civilians...

ext.ext_cn: 她说卖淫合法化只会引发问题。
ext.ext_en: She says that legalising prostitution will only cause problems.

defs.def_en: You can use only in front of a verb to indicate that the result of something is unfortunate or undesirable and is likely to make the situation worse rather than better.

ext.ext_cn: 亲爱的，你什么时候需要人帮忙照看孩子，只要开口说一声就行。
ext.ext_en: Any time you want a babysitter, dear, you only have to ask...

ext.ext_cn: 我们只要看一下标签即可知道食品的成分。
ext.ext_en: We have only to read the labels to know what ingredients are in foods.

defs.def_en: If you say you only have to or have only to do one thing in order to achieve or prove a second thing, you are emphasizing how easily the second thing can be achieved or proved.

ext.ext_cn: 我刚到。
ext.ext_en: I've only just arrived...

ext.ext_cn: 经济复苏的迹象刚刚开始显现。
ext.ext_en: The signs of an economic revival are only just beginning...

defs.def_en: You can say that something has only just happened when you want to emphasize that it happened a very short time ago.

ext.ext_cn: 几个世纪以来，那里的农民只能勉强维持生计。
ext.ext_en: For centuries farmers there have only just managed to survive...

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦空袭那阵我已开始记事，但也只是仅仅有些模糊的印象。
ext.ext_en: I am old enough to remember the Blitz, but only just...

defs.def_en: You use only just to emphasize that something is true, but by such a small degree that it is almost not true at all.

ext.ext_cn: 计划很容易出岔子，我太清楚这点了。
ext.ext_en: I know only too well that plans can easily go wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 新生儿出世后，其他孩子极容易受到冷落。
ext.ext_en: When the new baby comes along it is only too easy to shut out the others.

defs.def_en: You can use only too to emphasize that something is true or exists to a much greater extent than you would expect or like.

ext.ext_cn: 我非常乐意为他们答疑解惑。
ext.ext_en: I'll be only too pleased to help them out with any queries.

defs.def_en: You can say that you are only too happy to do something to emphasize how willing you are to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 6大按揭贷款机构
ext.ext_en: ...the six leading mortgage lenders.

defs.def_en: A lender is a person or an institution that lends money to people.

ext.ext_cn: 我为她的聪慧所倾倒。
ext.ext_en: I was captivated by her brilliant mind...

ext.ext_cn: 40年来,她那令人惊艳的美貌让全世界为之痴迷。
ext.ext_en: For 40 years she has captivated the world with her radiant looks.

defs.def_en: If you are captivated by someone or something, you find them fascinating and attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 一种辛辣、略甜、无色也几乎无臭的液体
ext.ext_en: ...a colourless, almost odourless liquid with a sharp, sweetish taste.

defs.def_en: Something that is colourless has no colour at all.

defs.def_cn: (通常指由于害怕、惊讶或生病而脸色)苍白的，无血色的

ext.ext_cn: 她脸色苍白，并且浑身发抖。
ext.ext_en: Her face was colourless, and she was shaking...

ext.ext_cn: 他面无血色，胡子也没刮。
ext.ext_en: His complexion was colorless and he hadn't  shaved.

defs.def_en: If someone's face is colourless, it is very pale, usually because they are frightened, shocked, or ill.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无趣味的;枯燥的;平淡无奇的

ext.ext_cn: 阅历丰富得多但缺乏个性的将军
ext.ext_en: ...the much more experienced but colourless General...

ext.ext_cn: 我们匆匆穿过湍急的那曲河畔这个毫无生气的小镇。
ext.ext_en: We hurried through the colourless little town set on the fast-flowing Nyakchu.

defs.def_en: Colourless people or places are dull and uninteresting.

defs.def_cn: 不能回头;破釜沉舟;无法改变

ext.ext_cn: 他已经下定决心使用武力。
ext.ext_en: He's crossed the Rubicon with regard to the use of military force as an option.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has crossed the Rubicon, you mean that they have reached a point where they cannot change a decision or course of action.
The witness box in a court of law is the place where people stand or sit when they are giving evidence.

ext.ext_cn: 绿色聚酯纤维衬衫
ext.ext_en: ...a green polyester shirt.

defs.def_en: Polyester is a type of artificial cloth used especially to make clothes.

defs.def_cn: (作户外演讲时用的)临时小讲台

ext.ext_cn: 他们中间的一个人登上了小讲台，开始跟当地人讲军队为什么应该允许招募同性恋者。
ext.ext_en: One of them climbed aboard a soapbox and began informing the locals why gays should be allowed in the military.

ext.ext_cn: 露天演讲
ext.ext_en: ...soapbox speeches.

defs.def_en: A soapbox is a small temporary platform on which a person stands when he or she is making a speech outdoors.

defs.def_cn: (针对某事自己有强烈看法的)演讲，发表意见，书写感受

ext.ext_cn: 我们对推进某些问题十分关注，很想就这些问题发表我们的意见。
ext.ext_en: We were interested in pushing forward certain issues and getting up on our soapbox about them...

ext.ext_cn: 我想谈一谈领取退休金的年龄这个问题，对此我颇有想法。
ext.ext_en: I wanted to talk about the pension age. It's rather a soapbox of mine.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is on their soapbox, you mean that they are speaking or writing about something they have strong feelings about.

ext.ext_cn: 他戴着手铐被送进了监狱。
ext.ext_en: He was led away to jail in handcuffs.

defs.def_en: Handcuffs are two metal rings which are joined together and can be locked round someone's wrists, usually by the police during an arrest.

ext.ext_cn: 他们试图把他铐起来，但尽管有伤在身，他还是奋力挣脱了。
ext.ext_en: They tried to handcuff him but, despite his injuries, he fought his way free.

defs.def_en: If you handcuff someone, you put handcuffs around their wrists.

ext.ext_cn: “不要为那个感到沮丧，”他一边说，一边抚弄着本乌黑的卷发。
ext.ext_en: 'Don't let that get you down,' he said ruffling Ben's dark curls.

defs.def_en: If you ruffle someone's hair, you move your hand backwards and forwards through it as a way of showing your affection towards them.

defs.def_cn: 吹皱;使泛起涟漪;使起伏不平

ext.ext_cn: 晚风吹皱了池水。
ext.ext_en: The evening breeze ruffled the pond...

ext.ext_cn: 一阵微风吹下山坡，使青草如波浪起伏。
ext.ext_en: A gust of breeze moved down the hillside, ruffling the grass.

defs.def_en: When the wind ruffles something such as the surface of the sea, it causes it to move gently in a wave-like motion.

defs.def_cn: 使惊慌;使失去信心;激怒;使沮丧

ext.ext_cn: 我能看出，我不吃他那一套让他很恼火。
ext.ext_en: I could tell that my refusal to allow him to ruffle me infuriated him.

ext.ext_cn: 什么都不能扰乱她随意地和员工打招呼时流露出的那种镇定自若。
ext.ext_en: Nothing could ruffle the perfect composure with which she casually greets members of staff.

defs.def_en: If something ruffles someone, it causes them to panic and lose their confidence or to become angry or upset.

ext.ext_cn: 驯养的鸟儿在有人靠近时会伸长脖子，竖起颈羽。
ext.ext_en: Tame birds, when approached, will stretch out their necks and ruffle their neck feathering...

ext.ext_cn: 它全身的羽毛突然竖了起来，胀得鼓鼓的。
ext.ext_en: Its body plumage suddenly began to ruffle and swell.

defs.def_en: If a bird ruffles its feathers or if its feathers ruffle, they stand out on its body, for example when it is cleaning itself or when it is frightened.

defs.def_cn: （衣服领口、袖口等处的）褶边，褶饰，花边

ext.ext_cn: 领口和袖口带有褶边的白色上衣
ext.ext_en: ...a white blouse with ruffles at the neck and cuffs.

defs.def_en: Ruffles are folds of cloth at the neck or the ends of the arms of a piece of clothing, or are sometimes sewn on things as a decoration.

ext.ext_cn: 他那直截了当、往往还粗鲁生硬的办事方式无疑会激怒一些人。
ext.ext_en: His direct, often abrasive approach will doubtless ruffle a few feathers...

ext.ext_cn: 政治家们通常都很小心，避免激怒了他们的选民。
ext.ext_en: Politicians are usually careful not to ruffle the feathers of their constituents.

defs.def_en: To ruffle someone's feathers means to cause them to become very angry, nervous, or upset.

ext.ext_cn: 氧气分析器
ext.ext_en: ...an oxygen analyser.

defs.def_en: An analyser is a piece of equipment which is used to analyse the substances that are present in something such as a gas.
An analyser is someone who analyses information.
A moneylender is a person who lends money which has to be paid back at a high rate of interest.
Skates are ice-skates.
Skates are roller-skates.

ext.ext_cn: 我真的滑冰了——尽管有些踉跄，但没有跌跟头。
ext.ext_en: I actually skated, and despite some teetering I did not fall on the ice...

ext.ext_cn: 丹滑着冰来到他的面前。
ext.ext_en: Dan skated up to him.

defs.def_en: If you skate, you move about wearing ice-skates or roller-skates.

ext.ext_cn: 那些船上有许多鲭鱼，还有几条鳐鱼。
ext.ext_en: Boats had plenty of mackerel and a few skate.

defs.def_en: A skate is a kind of flat sea fish.

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们往往回避释梦的难题。
ext.ext_en: Scientists have tended to skate over the difficulties of explaining dreams...

ext.ext_cn: 别人逼问他有关他 19 岁时遇到的那些女人的情况时，他就会加以搪塞。
ext.ext_en: When pressed, he skates around the subject of those women who he met as a 19-year-old.

defs.def_en: If you skate over or round a difficult subject, you avoid discussing it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 好动武的;爱动用武器的;爱开枪的;以开枪为乐的

ext.ext_cn: 他们被那些肆意开枪的国民卫队士兵枪杀了。
ext.ext_en: They were gunned down by members of the trigger-happy National Guard…

ext.ext_cn: 他们中的一些人有点以开枪为乐事——他们会向任何移动的物体射击。
ext.ext_en: Some of them are a bit trigger-happy — they'll shoot at anything that moves.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as trigger-happy, you disapprove of them because they are too ready and willing to use violence and weapons, especially guns.

ext.ext_cn: 整个国家必须要有一套统一的法律。
ext.ext_en: There must be one set of laws for the whole of the country...

ext.ext_cn: 我可能需要一套备用的衣服。
ext.ext_en: I might need a spare set of clothes...

defs.def_en: A set of things is a number of things that belong together or that are thought of as a group.

ext.ext_cn: 格拉芙第一盘以 5 比 1 领先。
ext.ext_en: Graf was leading 5-1 in the first set.

defs.def_en: In tennis, a set is one of the groups of six or more games that form part of a match.
In mathematics, a set is a group of mathematical quantities that have some characteristic in common.

defs.def_cn: (一场音乐会中所演唱或演奏的)一组歌曲(或乐曲)

ext.ext_cn: 短暂的休息后，乐队继续演奏他们的曲目。
ext.ext_en: The band continued with their set after a short break...

ext.ext_cn: 他伴着原声乐器独唱了一组歌曲。
ext.ext_en: He plays a solo acoustic set.

defs.def_en: A band's or musician's set is the group of songs or tunes that they perform at a concert.

defs.def_cn: (经常碰面或趣味相同的)一伙(或一帮、一群)人

ext.ext_cn: 他属于媒体所称的“切尔西圈子”里的人。
ext.ext_en: He belonged to what the press called 'The Chelsea Set'.

defs.def_en: See also:jet set;You can refer to a group of people as a set if they meet together socially or have the same interests and lifestyle.

defs.def_cn: (话剧的)布景;(电影的)摄影棚，拍片现场

ext.ext_cn: 自从进入摄影棚的第一刻起，他就希望自己也能成为一名导演。
ext.ext_en: From the first moment he got on the set, he wanted to be a director too...

ext.ext_cn: 他为牧女游乐园剧院设计的舞台布景
ext.ext_en: ...his stage sets for the Folies Bergeres.

defs.def_en: The set for a play, film, or television show is the furniture and scenery that is on the stage when the play is being performed or in the studio where filming takes place.

ext.ext_cn: 马特看着休，从他坚挺的肩膀中看出了他的倔强。
ext.ext_en: Matt looked at Hugh and saw the stubbornness in the set of his shoulders...

ext.ext_cn: 画家理查德·斯通在她的眼神和面部表情中捕捉到了她的坚毅和决绝。
ext.ext_en: Artist Richard Stone has captured in her eyes and the set of her face her steely determination.

defs.def_en: The set of someone's face or part of their body is the way that it is fixed in a particular expression or position, especially one that shows determination.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们花在看电视上的时间太多了。
ext.ext_en: Children spend so much time in front of the television set...

ext.ext_cn: 1963 年我们买了我们的第一台电视机——黑白的。
ext.ext_en: We got our first set — black and white — in 1963.

defs.def_en: A set is an appliance. For example, a television set is a television.

ext.ext_cn: 他从她手中拿过箱子，将它小心地放在地板上。
ext.ext_en: He took the case out of her hand and set it on the floor...

ext.ext_cn: 他把杯子放下时，饮料溅出来一点。
ext.ext_en: When he set his glass down he spilled a little drink.

defs.def_en: If you set something somewhere, you put it there, especially in a careful or deliberate way.

ext.ext_en: Happily, Lisa Martineau takes an opposite approach.

defs.def_en: See also:happy;You can add happily to a statement to indicate that you are glad that something happened or is true.

ext.ext_cn: 他们或许会感到疲惫，虽然外表看似没事，但可能很容易发火。
ext.ext_en: They may feel tired and though outwardly calm, can be irritable...

ext.ext_cn: 表面上，这似乎是开启了一个极棒的项目，但实际上却是为一场大的灾难埋下了伏笔。
ext.ext_en: Outwardly this looked like the beginning of a terrific programme but the stage was actually set for a major disaster.

defs.def_en: You use outwardly to indicate the feelings or qualities that a person or situation may appear to have, rather than the ones that they actually have.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 欣喜若狂的；万分高兴的

ext.ext_cn: 谢利见到我万分高兴。
ext.ext_en: Shelley was overjoyed to see me...

ext.ext_cn: 他看到儿子回来欣喜若狂。
ext.ext_en: He was overjoyed at his son's return.

defs.def_en: If you are overjoyed, you are extremely pleased about something.

defs.def_cn: （尤指有毒化学品造成的）污染

ext.ext_cn: 罚款是因该公司对厂房周边空气造成了污染。
ext.ext_en: The fine was for the company's pollution of the air near its plants...

ext.ext_cn: 对废弃物的回收利用能够减少对垃圾场的需求，从而也有助于控制环境污染。
ext.ext_en: Recycling also helps control environmental pollution by reducing the need for waste dumps.

defs.def_en: Pollution is the  process of polluting water, air, or land, especially with poisonous chemicals.

ext.ext_cn: 这条河中的污染物水平在下降。
ext.ext_en: The level of pollution in the river was falling.

defs.def_en: Pollution is poisonous or dirty substances that are polluting the water, air, or land somewhere.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这是一家创办伊始抱有雄心壮志的银行。
ext.ext_en: It was a bank that started out with grand ideas and lofty ideals...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管身处混乱之中，他却怀有崇高的目标。
ext.ext_en: Amid the chaos, he had lofty aims.

defs.def_en: A lofty ideal or ambition is noble, important, and admirable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （建筑物）巍峨的，高耸的；（房间）屋顶高的

ext.ext_cn: 位于萨尔茨堡市郊的一间采光好、屋顶高的公寓
ext.ext_en: ...a light, lofty apartment in the suburbs of Salzburg...

ext.ext_cn: 维多利亚式房屋屋顶高耸，房间布局凌乱，因此可能会显得较为阴冷。
ext.ext_en: Victorian houses can seem cold with their lofty ceilings and rambling rooms.

defs.def_en: A lofty building or room is very high.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他常在言语间流露出来的、对其职业不屑一顾的傲慢态度
ext.ext_en: ...the lofty disdain he often expresses for his profession.

ext.ext_cn: 倨傲不屑
ext.ext_en: ...lofty contempt.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone behaves in a lofty way, you are critical of them for behaving in a proud and rather unpleasant way, as if they think they are very important.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 爱发号施令的；好指挥人的

ext.ext_cn: 她记得自己曾是一个颇为专横的小姑娘。
ext.ext_en: She remembers being a rather bossy little girl.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as bossy, you mean that they enjoy telling people what to do.

ext.ext_cn: 诺尔曼切开自己的派，往里面挤了点番茄酱。
ext.ext_en: Norman cut open his pie and squirted tomato sauce into it...

ext.ext_cn: 水从它的喉部喷出来。
ext.ext_en: The water squirted from its throat...

defs.def_en: If you squirt a liquid somewhere or if it squirts somewhere, the liquid comes out of a narrow opening in a thin fast stream.

ext.ext_cn: 我朝他喷水。
ext.ext_en: I squirted him with water...

ext.ext_cn: 它的内衬只是简单地喷了些油。
ext.ext_en: Its linings were simply squirted with oil.

defs.def_en: If you squirt something with a liquid, you squirt the liquid at it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 表示谴责的;责怪的;责备的

ext.ext_cn: “马屁精，”她饱含嘲弄和责备地看了他一眼，说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Flatterer,' she said giving him a mock reproving look.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a reproving look or speak in a reproving voice, you show or say that you think they have behaved in a wrong or foolish way.

ext.ext_cn: 我们将给予她贵宾级礼遇，并且为她铺设红地毯。
ext.ext_en: We'll give her some VIP treatment and roll out the red carpet...

ext.ext_cn: 走红地毯的礼遇让他感到很局促。
ext.ext_en: He is embarrassed by the red carpet treatment.

defs.def_en: The red carpet is special treatment given to an important or honoured guest, for example the laying of a strip of red carpet for them to walk on.

defs.def_cn: 在（饮食中）掺入杂质;掺假

ext.ext_cn: 食物被掺了杂质以增加分量。
ext.ext_en: The food had been adulterated to increase its weight...

ext.ext_cn: 规定禁止出售假冒化妆品。
ext.ext_en: There is a regulation against adulterated cosmetics.

defs.def_en: If something such as food or drink is adulterated, someone has made its quality worse by adding water or cheaper products to it.

ext.ext_cn: 衣领上绣着非常小的红色草莓。
ext.ext_en: The collar was embroidered with very small red strawberries...

ext.ext_cn: 玛蒂尔达在一块有花鸟图案的祭坛布上刺绣。
ext.ext_en: Matilda was embroidering an altar cloth covered with flowers and birds...

defs.def_en: If something such as clothing or cloth is embroidered with a design, the design is stitched into it.

defs.def_cn: 对（故事、叙述等）添枝加叶渲染

ext.ext_cn: 他说了些谎，有时只是对事实添油加醋了一番。
ext.ext_en: He told some lies and sometimes just embroidered the truth...

ext.ext_cn: 她围绕这个主题添枝加叶地说了大约10分钟。
ext.ext_en: She embroidered on this theme for about ten minutes.

defs.def_en: If you embroider a story or account of something, or if you embroider on it, you try to make it more interesting by adding details which may be untrue.

defs.def_cn: 庄园;地产；（在乡村的）大片私有土地

ext.ext_cn: 在怀维尔勋爵位于约克郡的庄园里举行的狩猎会
ext.ext_en: ...a shooting party on Lord Wyville's estate in Yorkshire.

defs.def_en: An estate is a large area of land in the country which is owned by a person, family, or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 他过去曾住在那个住宅区。
ext.ext_en: He used to live on the estate.

defs.def_en: People sometimes use estate to refer to a housing estate or an industrial estate.

ext.ext_cn: 他的遗产被估价为15万美元。
ext.ext_en: His estate was valued at $150,000.

defs.def_en: Someone's estate is all the money and property that they leave behind them when they die.
An estate is the same as an estate car .

ext.ext_cn: 社会失衡比收入不公平更令他忧虑。
ext.ext_en: Social imbalance worries him more than inequity of income.

ext.ext_cn: 我们卫生保健制度的不公正
ext.ext_en: ...the inequities in our health care system.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the inequity of something, you are criticizing it because it is unfair or unjust.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个男人的光头上满是汗珠。
ext.ext_en: The man's bald head was beaded with sweat...

ext.ext_cn: 她开始谢顶。
ext.ext_en: She is going bald.

defs.def_en: Someone who is bald has little or no hair on the top of their head.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （轮胎表面）磨平了的，磨光了的
defs.def_en: If a tyre is bald, its surface has worn down and it is no longer safe to use.

defs.def_cn: 不加修饰的；直截了当的；赤裸裸的

ext.ext_cn: 官方通讯社发表了直截了当的声明。
ext.ext_en: The announcement came in a bald statement from the official news agency...

ext.ext_cn: 事实明摆着，他就是不开心。
ext.ext_en: The bald truth is he's just not happy.

defs.def_en: A bald statement is in plain language and contains no extra explanation or information.

defs.def_cn: (以前的状态、制度或行为的)恢复，回复

ext.ext_cn: 又恢复了旧时的体制，王室就是在这种制度下接受了近300年的俸禄。
ext.ext_en: This is a reversion to the system under which the Royals were paid for nearly 300 years.

ext.ext_cn: 她向婴儿期情感的回归
ext.ext_en: ...a reversion to the emotions of her baby years.

defs.def_en: A reversion to a previous state, system, or kind of behaviour is a change back to it.
The reversion of land or property to a person, family, or country is the return to them of the ownership or control of the land or property.
An egg timer is a device that measures the time needed to boil an egg.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 运用各种打击乐效果
ext.ext_en: ...using all manner of percussive effects.

defs.def_en: Percussive sounds are like the sound of drums.
A geisha is a Japanese woman who is specially trained in music, dancing, and the art of conversation. Her job is to entertain men.
A servant is someone who is employed to work at another person's home, for example as a cleaner or a gardener.

defs.def_cn: 提供服务的人(或事物);可以利用的人(或事物)

ext.ext_cn: 和其他所有公务员一样，警察必须服务于公众的需求。
ext.ext_en: Like any other public servants, police must respond to public demand...

ext.ext_cn: 问题是科技将为我们所用还是要驾驭我们。
ext.ext_en: The question is whether technology is going to be our servant or our master.

defs.def_en: See also:civil servant;You can use servant to refer to someone or something that provides a service for people or can be used by them.

defs.def_cn: (足球或橄榄球比赛中的)掷边线球，掷界外球
defs.def_en: When there is a throw-in in a football or rugby match, the ball is thrown back onto the field after it has been kicked off it.

A personal pronoun is a pronoun such as 'I', 'you', 'she', or 'they' which is used to refer to the speaker or the person spoken to, or to a person or thing whose identity is clear, usually because they have already been mentioned.

defs.def_cn: (在英国，各大院校师生在出席正式场合时戴的)方顶帽；(在美国，学生在中学和大学毕业典礼时戴的)学位帽
defs.def_en: A mortar board is a stiff black cap which has a flat square top with a bunch of threads attached to it. In Britain, mortar boards are sometimes worn on formal occasions by university students and teachers. In the United States, mortar boards are worn by students at graduation ceremonies at high schools, colleges, and universities.

ext.ext_cn: 他一看到夏普浸满鲜血的制服，脸色顿时变得煞白。
ext.ext_en: His face blanched as he looked at Sharpe's blood-drenched uniform...

ext.ext_cn: 一回想起那些不愉快的事情，她觉得自己的脸刷地就白了。
ext.ext_en: She felt herself blanch at the unpleasant memories.

defs.def_en: If you blanch, you suddenly become very pale.

ext.ext_cn: 他所说的一切都是错的。他回避了自己的判断错误。
ext.ext_en: Everything he had said had been a mistake. He blanched at his miscalculations...

ext.ext_cn: 有些地方你能带残疾儿童去，那里的工作人员不会一看到轮椅就退缩。
ext.ext_en: There are places you can take physically handicapped children where staff don't blanch at the sight of a wheelchair.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone blanches at something, you mean that they find it unpleasant and do not want to be involved with it.

ext.ext_cn: 把桃子焯一下去皮。
ext.ext_en: Skin the peaches by blanching them.

defs.def_en: If you blanch vegetables, fruit, or nuts, you put them into boiling water for a short time, usually in order to remove their skins, or to prepare them for freezing.
A registry office is the same as a register office .
A raincoat is a waterproof coat.

ext.ext_cn: 真相一定不能传出去。万一传出去，她会成为笑柄。
ext.ext_en: The truth must never get out. If it did she would be a laughing-stock.

ext.ext_cn: 他的政策成了金融界的笑柄
ext.ext_en: ...his policies became the laughing stock of the financial community.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or an organization has become a laughing stock, you mean that they are supposed to be important or serious but have been made to seem ridiculous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 盛气凌人的;居高临下的

ext.ext_cn: 我讨厌你的钱，也受够了你居高临下的态度。
ext.ext_en: I'm fed up with your money and your whole condescending attitude...

ext.ext_cn: 他们可能有点儿架子。
ext.ext_en: They can be a bit condescending.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is condescending, you are showing your disapproval of the fact that they talk or behave in a way which shows that they think they are superior to other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个小镇枯燥乏味，毫无特色。
ext.ext_en: The town is boring and characterless.

ext.ext_cn: 一顿索然无味的饭
ext.ext_en: ...a bland and characterless meal.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as characterless, you mean that it is dull and uninteresting.

defs.def_cn: 梦之队;最佳阵容;最佳组合

ext.ext_cn: 美国篮球梦之队
ext.ext_en: ...American basketball's dream team.

ext.ext_cn: 律师和调查人员的梦幻组合
ext.ext_en: ...a dream team of lawyers and investigators.

defs.def_en: A dream team is the best possible group of people to be in a sports team or to do a particular job.
Water polo is a game played in a swimming pool in which two teams of swimmers try to score goals with a ball.

ext.ext_cn: 乳腺癌的发病率随年龄增长而递增。
ext.ext_en: The incidence of breast cancer increases with age.

ext.ext_cn: 儿童高死亡率
ext.ext_en: ...the high incidence of child mortality.

defs.def_en: The incidence of something bad, such as a disease, is the frequency with which it occurs, or the occasions when it occurs.
A steed is a large strong horse used for riding.

ext.ext_cn: 这座塔是那些灰暗岁月的遗迹，那时大房子不得不被加固,以抵御侵略者。
ext.ext_en: The tower is a relic of grim days when big houses had to be fortified against invaders...

ext.ext_cn: 德国的收容法是欧洲历史上一个已逝去时期的遗留产物。
ext.ext_en: Germany's asylum law is a relic of an era in European history which has passed...

defs.def_en: If you refer to something or someone as a relic of an earlier period, you mean that they belonged to that period but have survived into the present.

defs.def_cn: (有历史价值的)遗物，遗迹，遗址

ext.ext_cn: 战争遗迹纪念馆
ext.ext_en: ...a museum of war relics.

ext.ext_cn: 古埃及遗迹
ext.ext_en: ...ancient Egyptian relics.

defs.def_en: A relic is something which was made or used a long time ago and which is kept for its historical significance.
A relic is the body of a saint or something else associated with a saint, which some people regard as holy.

ext.ext_cn: 对于毫不相干的事情进行大量吹毛求疵的批评。
ext.ext_en: A lot of nit-picking was going on about irrelevant things...

ext.ext_cn: 我会挑剔细节，我对某些事情相当吹毛求疵。
ext.ext_en: I can get down to nitpicking detail, I am pretty fussy about certain things.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's opinion as nitpicking, you disapprove of the fact that it concentrates on small and unimportant details, especially to try and find fault with something.

ext.ext_cn: 由于证据不足，警方已决定不起诉。
ext.ext_en: The police have decided not to prosecute because the evidence is not strong enough...

ext.ext_cn: 路边电子眼拍下的照片很快将足以起诉超速的司机。
ext.ext_en: Photographs taken by roadside cameras will soon be enough to prosecute drivers for speeding...

defs.def_en: If the authorities prosecute someone, they charge them with a crime and put them on trial.

ext.ext_cn: 将对此案提起公诉的律师说他不能透露具体的涉案金额。
ext.ext_en: The attorney who will prosecute the case says he cannot reveal how much money is involved.

ext.ext_cn: 检察官
ext.ext_en: ...the prosecuting attorney.

defs.def_en: When a lawyer prosecutes a case, he or she tries to prove that the person who is on trial is guilty.

ext.ext_cn: 圣安德鲁斯在相反方向上 10 英里处。
ext.ext_en: St Andrews was ten miles in the opposite direction...

ext.ext_cn: 他驾车朝着拉里商店的方向驶去。
ext.ext_en: He drove off in the direction of Larry's shop...

defs.def_en: A direction is the general line that someone or something is moving or pointing in.

ext.ext_cn: 他们威胁说，如果该党不改变方针，他们就将集体退席。
ext.ext_en: They threatened to walk out if the party did not change direction...

ext.ext_cn: 我以前从未尝试过持续写作，不过那可能是我下一步努力的方向之一。
ext.ext_en: I've never done any sustained writing, but that might be one of my next directions.

defs.def_en: A direction is the general way in which something develops or progresses.

ext.ext_cn: 现在我知道了不该在饭没做完之前就扔掉烹饪说明。
ext.ext_en: I should know by now not to throw away the directions until we've finished cooking...

ext.ext_cn: 他接着告诉丹去计算机房该怎么走。
ext.ext_en: He proceeded to give Dan directions to the computer room.

defs.def_en: Directions are instructions that tell you what to do, how to do something, or how to get somewhere.

defs.def_cn: (影片、戏剧或电视节目的)导演

ext.ext_cn: 他的失败说明了导演戏剧和电影是不同的。
ext.ext_en: His failures underline the difference between theatre and film direction.

defs.def_en: The direction of a film, play, or television programme is the work that the director does while it is being made.

ext.ext_cn: 教皇在墨西哥城主持了弥撒。
ext.ext_en: The Pontiff celebrated mass in Mexico City.

defs.def_en: The Pontiff is the Pope.

ext.ext_cn: 他迄今为止一直不为我说的俏皮话所动。
ext.ext_en: He had thus far succeeded in fending off my conversational sallies.

defs.def_en: Sallies are clever and amusing remarks.

defs.def_cn: 突然冲出;奋身前往;大胆迈入

ext.ext_cn: 她第一次赴异性约会时对她的担心
ext.ext_en: ...worrying about her when she sallies forth on her first date...

ext.ext_cn: 塔玛拉会不畏严寒在夜晚外出。
ext.ext_en: Tamara would sally out on bitterly cold nights.

defs.def_en: If someone sallies forth or sallies somewhere, they go out into a rather difficult, dangerous, or unpleasant situation in a brave or confident way.

ext.ext_cn: 我小时候生活在一个小乡村里。
ext.ext_en: When I was a child I lived in a country village...

ext.ext_cn: 他还只是个孩子。
ext.ext_en: He's just a child.

defs.def_en: A child is a human being who is not yet an adult.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们都好吧？
ext.ext_en: How are the children?...

ext.ext_cn: 他的子女都已离家独立生活了。
ext.ext_en: His children have left home...

defs.def_en: Someone's children are their sons and daughters of any age.
Your eyeballs are your whole eyes, rather than just the part which can be seen between your eyelids.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然他有通行证，卫兵还是直勾勾地盯着他。
ext.ext_en: The guard eyeballed him pretty hard despite his pass.

defs.def_en: If you eyeball someone or something, you stare at them.

ext.ext_cn: 与受害人对峙的那个小混混儿
ext.ext_en: ...the young thug who stands eyeball-to-eyeball with his victim.

ext.ext_cn: 两军结束剑拔弩张的对峙、各自撤军的提议
ext.ext_en: ...proposals that the two armies end their eyeball to eyeball confrontation and withdraw.

defs.def_en: If you are eyeball to eyeball with someone, you are in their presence and involved in a meeting, dispute, or contest with them. You can also talk about having an eyeball to eyeball meeting or confrontation.

ext.ext_cn: 吸食大量毒品后在洛杉矶开车闲逛
ext.ext_en: ...driving around Los Angeles drugged up to the eyeballs...

ext.ext_cn: 他失业了，而且债台高筑。
ext.ext_en: He is out of a job and up to his eyeballs in debt.

defs.def_en: You use up to the eyeballs to emphasize that someone is in an undesirable state to a very great degree.
A dogfish is a small shark. There are several kinds of dogfish.

ext.ext_cn: 蛹蛰伏在土壤中，直到冬天它们才蜕变成蛾子飞出来。
ext.ext_en: The pupae remain dormant in the soil until they emerge as adult moths in the winter.

defs.def_en: A pupa is an insect that is in the stage of development between a larva and a fully grown adult. It has a protective covering and does not move.

defs.def_cn: (车辆)缓缓行进，艰难移动，曲折开进

ext.ext_cn: 卡车沿着赞比西山谷的绝壁缓缓行进。
ext.ext_en: The truck was trundling along the escarpment of the Zambesi valley…

ext.ext_cn: 几架马车仍然在破落的矿村中曲折行进。
ext.ext_en: A few horse-drawn carts still trundle through the dilapidated mining villages…

defs.def_en: If a vehicle trundles somewhere, it moves there slowly, often with difficulty or an irregular movement.

defs.def_cn: 慢慢移动，缓慢滚动(尤指带轮的小体积重物)

ext.ext_cn: 那个老头提起手推车，慢慢推走了。

ext.ext_en: ...Victorian ephemera.

defs.def_en: Ephemera is things people collect such as old postcards, posters, and bus tickets, which were only intended to last a short time when they were produced.
You use the women's movement to refer to groups of people and organizations that believe that women should have the same rights and opportunities in society as men.

ext.ext_en: 'I'm Nancy Drew,' she said, holding out her hand...

ext.ext_en: Max held out his cup for a refill.

defs.def_en: If you hold out your hand or something you have in your hand, you move your hand away from your body, for example to shake hands with someone.

ext.ext_cn: 我应该坚持要求更优厚的条件的。
ext.ext_en: I should have held out for a better deal...

ext.ext_cn: 他只能再坚持几周了。
ext.ext_en: He can only hold out a few more weeks.

defs.def_en: If you hold out for something, you refuse to accept something which you do not think is good enough or large enough, and you continue to demand more.

ext.ext_en: He had always believed that kids could sense it when you held out on them.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is holding out on you, you think that they are refusing to give you information that you want.

ext.ext_en: The guerrillas were holding out in the Paghman valley...

ext.ext_cn: 一名犯人仍在监狱的房顶上顽抗。
ext.ext_en: One prisoner was still holding out on the roof of the jail.

defs.def_en: If you hold out, you manage to resist an enemy or opponent in difficult circumstances and refuse to give in.

ext.ext_cn: 他对他们再次成为一家人仍抱持希望。
ext.ext_en: He still holds out hope that they could be a family again.

defs.def_en: If you hold out hope of something happening, you hope that in the future something will happen as you want it to.

defs.def_cn: 与…一起存在；与…不可分离

ext.ext_en: ...the lucrative $250,000 salary that goes with the job.

defs.def_en: If one thing goes with another thing, the two things officially belong together, so that if you get one, you also get the other.

ext.ext_en: For many women, the status which goes with being a wife is important.

defs.def_en: If one thing goes with another thing, it is usually found or experienced together with the other thing.

defs.def_cn: 与（异性）交往；和…谈恋爱（或保持性关系）
defs.def_en: If someone is going with another person, they are having a sexual or romantic relationship with that person.

ext.ext_en: In our country there is an adversarial relationship between government and business.

ext.ext_cn: 两派对立的法律制度
ext.ext_en: ...an adversarial legal system.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as adversarial, you mean that it involves two or more people or organizations who are opposing each other.
The melting point of a substance is the temperature at which it melts when you heat it.

ext.ext_en: I have an interesting, well-paid job, with opportunities to travel.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or their job is well-paid, you mean that they receive a lot of money for the work that they do.

ext.ext_en: ...her unborn baby...

ext.ext_en: They will affect generations of Britons still unborn.

defs.def_en: An unborn child has not yet been born and is still inside its mother's womb.

ext.ext_en: ...a petition containing 170 signatures.

defs.def_en: Your signature is your name, written in your own characteristic way, often at the end of a document to indicate that you wrote the document or that you agree with what it says.

defs.def_cn: 为(某人)所特有的;体现个体特征的

ext.ext_en: Rabbit stew is one of chef Giancarlo Moeri's signature dishes...

ext.ext_en: The dress reflects our signature style of understated elegance with a strong feeling of individuality.

defs.def_en: A signature item is typical of or associated with a particular person.

ext.ext_cn: 双方聚首签署一份正式协议。
ext.ext_en: The two sides met to put their signatures to a formal agreement.

defs.def_en: If you put your signature to a document, you sign it as a way of officially showing that you agree with what is written.
If you say that you wouldn't give something houseroom, you are emphasizing that you do not want it or do not like it at all.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Babies of eight to twelve months are generally highly imitative.

defs.def_en: People and animals who are imitative copy others' behaviour.

ext.ext_en: The terror ended when armed police swooped on the car...

ext.ext_en: The drugs squad swooped and discovered 240 kilograms of cannabis.

defs.def_en: If police or soldiers swoop on a place, they go there suddenly and quickly, usually in order to arrest someone or to attack the place.

ext.ext_en: More than 20 helicopters began swooping in low over the ocean...

ext.ext_en: The hawk swooped and soared away carrying something.

defs.def_en: When a bird or aeroplane swoops, it suddenly moves downwards through the air in a smooth curving movement.

ext.ext_en: In one fell swoop the bank wiped away the tentative benefits of this policy.

defs.def_en: If something is done in one fell swoop or at one fell swoop, it is done on a single occasion or by a single action.

ext.ext_en: ...a village of chocolate-box timbered houses.

defs.def_en: Chocolate-box places or images are very pretty but in a boring or conventional way.

defs.def_en: A terraced slope or side of a hill has flat areas like steps cut into it, where crops or other plants can be grown.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (因害羞、紧张等)张口结舌的，说不出话的

defs.def_en: If someone is tongue-tied, they are unable to say anything because they feel shy or nervous.

defs.def_cn: (支票、票据或其他单据的)存根，票根
defs.def_en: A counterfoil is the part of a cheque, ticket, or other document that you keep when you give the other part to someone else.

ext.ext_en: The importance of health education cannot be overstated.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is overstating something, you mean they are describing it in a way that makes it seem more important or serious than it really is.

ext.ext_en: She has a reputation for getting at the guts of a subject and never pulling her punches...

ext.ext_en: She became quite a notable director in the thirties and forties.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The book includes some useful facts about animal and plant life.

ext.ext_en: That was the beginning of my life in the television business.

ext.ext_en: Most diabetics have a normal sex life.

ext.ext_en: It's the people with insecurities who make life difficult.

defs.def_en: You can use life to refer to the events and experiences that happen to people while they are alive.

ext.ext_en: I was 19 and too young to know much about life...

ext.ext_en: I needed some time off from education to experience life.

defs.def_cn: （有关特定地方、团体或活动的）生活

ext.ext_en: How did you adjust to college life?

ext.ext_en: ...the culture and life of north Africa...

defs.def_en: You can use life to refer to the things that people do and experience that are characteristic of a particular place, group, or activity.

ext.ext_en: The town itself was full of life and character...

ext.ext_en: The rejection of the Jewish theme meant the rejection of everything that gave the script passion and life...

ext.ext_en: A life of John Paul Jones had long interested him.

ext.ext_en: The repairs did not increase the value or the life of the equipment.

defs.def_en: The life of something such as a machine, organization, or project is the period of time that it lasts for.

ext.ext_cn: 学习写生

ext.ext_en: The Church is my life.

ext.ext_en: Poems which had seemed dull and boring suddenly came to life.

defs.def_en: If you bring something to life or if it comes to life, it becomes interesting or exciting.

ext.ext_en: The volcano came to life a week ago.

ext.ext_en: He was jailed for life in 1966 for the murder of three policemen...

ext.ext_cn: 她可能会留下永久的创伤。
ext.ext_en: She may have been scarred for life...

defs.def_en: For life means for the rest of a person's life.

defs.def_cn: 无论如何，再怎么（也不能）

ext.ext_cn: 我无论如何也无法理解你为什么没想到这个。
ext.ext_en: I can't for the life of me understand why you didn't think of it.

defs.def_en: If you say that you cannot for the life of you understand or remember something, you are emphasizing that you cannot understand or remember it, even if you try hard.

ext.ext_cn: 我游到救生筏前，死命地抓住它。
ext.ext_en: I made for the life raft and hung on for dear life.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something for dear life or for their life, you mean that they do it using all their strength and effort because they are in a dangerous or urgent situation.
If you say that someone lives life to the full, you mean that they try to gain a lot from life by being always busy and trying new activities.

defs.def_cn: 做点有益的事；不要成天鸡毛蒜皮
defs.def_en: If you tell someone to get a life, you are expressing frustration with them because their life seems boring or they seem to care too much about unimportant things.

ext.ext_cn: 我不能下半辈子一直活在希望这事没有发生的阴影中。生活还是要继续。
ext.ext_en: I can't spend the rest of my life wishing it hadn't happened. Life goes on.

defs.def_en: You can say 'Life goes on' after mentioning something very sad to indicate that, although people are very upset or affected by it, they have to carry on living normally.

defs.def_cn: 有业余爱好；生活丰富多彩
defs.def_en: If you say that you have a life, you mean that you have interests and activities, particularly outside your work, which make your life enjoyable and worthwhile.

defs.def_cn: （男人或女人）在（某人）生活中的，与（某人）有恋爱关系（或性关系）的

ext.ext_cn: 她有了一个新男友。
ext.ext_en: There is a new man in her life.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the man or woman in someone's life, you mean the person they are having a relationship with, especially a sexual relationship.

defs.def_cn: （强调从来没有经历过）我一生中

ext.ext_cn: 我一生中从来没有这么害怕过。
ext.ext_en: I have never been so scared in all my life...

ext.ext_cn: 我一辈子都没见过这么乱七八糟的场面。
ext.ext_en: I have never seen such a shambles in my life.

defs.def_en: You can use in all my life or in my life to emphasize that you have never previously experienced something to such a degree.

defs.def_cn: 从来没受过这样的惊吓/从来没跑这么快过

ext.ext_cn: 一名当红雷盖乐歌手对着一个年轻的歌迷唱了一首小夜曲，这让她感到了前所未有的激动与兴奋。
ext.ext_en: A top reggae singer gave a young fan the thrill of her life when he serenaded her.

defs.def_en: You can use expressions such as the fright of your life or the race of your life to emphasize, for example, that you have never been so frightened or that you never have run faster.

ext.ext_cn: 不等于说我们要求所有的优秀出版社都与众不同。
ext.ext_en: ...not that we should expect all good publishers to be larger than life...

ext.ext_cn: 在他的整个职业生涯中，他都是一个非同凡响的人物。
ext.ext_en: Throughout his career he's always been a larger than life character.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is larger than life, you mean that they appear or behave in a way that seems more exaggerated or important than usual.

ext.ext_cn: 牺牲自己的生命去救朋友，没有比这更伟大的爱了。
ext.ext_en: Man can have no greater love than to lay down his life for his friends.

defs.def_en: If someone lays down their life for another person, they die so that the other person can live.

ext.ext_cn: 观众不会忘记风度翩翩的男主角德克冒着生命危险把达芙妮从恶龙爪下救出的情形。
ext.ext_en: Viewers will remember the dashing hero, Dirk, risking life and limb to rescue Daphne from the dragons.

defs.def_en: If someone risks life and limb, they do something very dangerous that may cause them to die or be seriously injured.

ext.ext_cn: 他去了尽可能远的地方开始新的生活。
ext.ext_en: He had gone as far away as possible to build a new life.

defs.def_en: If you start a new life, you move to another place or country, or change your career, usually to try and recover from an unpleasant experience.

defs.def_cn: （表示断然拒绝）决不会，绝不可能

ext.ext_cn: “你应该让他搭一段车的。”——“在那种情况下？绝对不行。”
ext.ext_en: 'You should have given him a lift.' — 'In that condition? Not on your life!'

defs.def_en: If someone says 'Not on your life', they are totally rejecting a suggestion that has been made.

defs.def_cn: 过自己的生活；按自己的方式生活

ext.ext_cn: 大人需要过他们自己的生活，但有了孩子就很难做到了。
ext.ext_en: Adults need to live their own lives and that's difficult with children.

defs.def_en: If you live your own life, you live in the way that you want to and accept responsibility for your actions and decisions, without other people's  advice or interference.

defs.def_cn: 控制…的生活；左右…的生活

ext.ext_cn: 我决心不再让毒品和酒精控制我的生活。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to stop letting drugs and drink rule my life.

defs.def_en: If you say that something rules someone's  life, you mean that it affects everything they do, usually in a negative way.

ext.ext_cn: 温斯顿怎么也学不会看路标。
ext.ext_en: Winston could not have read the road signs to save his life.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone cannot do something to save their life, you are emphasizing that they do it very badly.

defs.def_cn: 聚会的灵魂人物，社交场合的活跃人物（美国英语中通常作the life of the party）
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as the life and soul of the party, you mean that they are very lively and entertaining on social occasions, and are good at mixing with people. In American English, you usually say that they are the life of the party .

ext.ext_cn: 赫尔的书一开始是一个电影剧本。
ext.ext_en: Herr's book started life as a dramatic screenplay.

defs.def_en: If something starts life or begins life as a particular thing, it is that thing when it first starts to exist.

ext.ext_cn: 被处决之前，他承认另外还杀死过至少35名女性。
ext.ext_en: Before execution, he admitted to taking the lives of at least 35 more women...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾帮助自己身患癌症、不久于人世的第一任妻子自杀。
ext.ext_en: He helped his first wife take her life when she was dying of cancer.

defs.def_en: If someone takes another person's  life, they kill them. If someone takes their own life, they kill themselves.

defs.def_cn: 生活就是如此；这就是人生

ext.ext_cn: “要是弗洛里特不回去取书就不会发生这样的事了。”——“这就是人生。”
ext.ext_en: 'It never would have happened if Florette had not gone back for the book.' — 'That's life.'

defs.def_en: People say 'That's life' after an unlucky, unpleasant, or surprising event to show that they realize such events happen occasionally and must be accepted.

ext.ext_cn: 发动机突然又开始转了，这让他大大松了一口气。
ext.ext_en: To his great relief the engine came to life...

ext.ext_cn: 萨伏伊酒店花园里的洒水器突然开始喷水。
ext.ext_en: In the garden of the Savoy Hotel the sprinklers suddenly burst into life.

defs.def_en: You can use expressions such as to come to life ,to spring to life, and to roar into life to indicate that a machine or vehicle suddenly starts working or moving.

ext.ext_cn: 我如今身在一家破旧的旅馆里，没有干净衣服，没有一分钱，又惊魂未定。这是什么日子啊！
ext.ext_en: Here I am at a crummy hotel with no clean clothes, no money and suffering from shock. What a life!

defs.def_en: People say 'What a life' to indicate that they are unhappy or are having great difficulties.

defs.def_cn: 生命无价值/使生命有价值

ext.ext_cn: 如果没有美食可以让人期待和享受，那人生还有什么意思！
ext.ext_en: Life is not worth living without food you can look forward to and enjoy!...

ext.ext_cn: 正是这些时刻让生活有了意义。
ext.ext_en: Those are the moments which make life worth living.

defs.def_en: If you say that life isn't worth living without something, or that something makes life worth living, you mean that you cannot enjoy life without it.
A loggia is a roofed area attached to a house.
Winter sports are sports that take place on ice or snow, for example skating and skiing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如今有了更加有效的避孕方法，女性便可以规划她们的家庭和事业。
ext.ext_en: With today's more efficient contraception women can plan their families and careers.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

ext.ext_cn: 大会越权作出变更。
ext.ext_en: The assembly arrogated to itself the right to make changes...

ext.ext_cn: 他为自己僭取特权。
ext.ext_en: He arrogated the privilege to himself alone.

defs.def_en: If someone arrogates to themselves something such as a responsibility or privilege, they claim or take it even though they have no right to do so.

ext.ext_cn: 一名官员费力地挤过人群。
ext.ext_en: An official pushed through the throng.

defs.def_en: A throng is a large crowd of people.

ext.ext_cn: 人群涌进大厅。
ext.ext_en: The crowds thronged into the mall.

ext.ext_cn: 拥在教皇周围的教众甚多
ext.ext_en: ...the multitudes that throng around the Pope.

defs.def_en: When people throng somewhere, they go there in great numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 6 月底到 8 月初，他们群聚在海滩上。
ext.ext_en: They throng the beaches between late June and early August.

defs.def_en: If people throng a place, they are present there in great numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 政府没有承认错误，只是敷衍了事地处理问题。
ext.ext_en: Instead of the Government admitting its error, it just tinkered with the problem...

ext.ext_cn: 他们修了修发动机。
ext.ext_en: They tinkered with the engine…

defs.def_en: If you tinker with something, you make some small changes to it, in an attempt to improve it or repair it.
In former times, a tinker was a person who did not have a fixed home, but travelled from place to place mending metal pots and doing other small repair jobs.

defs.def_cn: (尤指爱尔兰裔的)流浪者，吉卜赛人
defs.def_en: Some people refer to any traveller or gipsy, especially one who is Irish, as a tinker .

defs.def_cn: (偷东西或变戏法时)敏捷而熟练的手法;空空妙手

ext.ext_cn: 他指控麦格雷戈先生“使用障眼法”。
ext.ext_en: He accused Mr MacGregor of 'sleight of hand'.

ext.ext_cn: 在财务上巧做手脚
ext.ext_en: ...a financial sleight of hand.

defs.def_en: Sleight of hand is the deceiving of someone in a skilful way.
A piste is a track of firm snow for skiing on.

ext.ext_cn: 描绘丹吉尔湾的壁画
ext.ext_en: ...a mural of Tangier bay.

defs.def_en: A mural is a picture painted on a wall.

ext.ext_cn: 地方议会通过了一项法律，允许企业私有，这向中央政权发起了新的挑战。
ext.ext_en: The regional parliament threw down a new challenge to the central authorities by passing a law allowing private ownership of businesses...

ext.ext_cn: 政府部长们一直在应对从前的同事的公然挑战。
ext.ext_en: Government ministers have been responding to the challenge thrown down by their former colleague.

defs.def_en: If you throw down a challenge to someone, you do something new or unexpected in a bold or forceful manner that will probably cause them to reply or react equally strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 英国和法国对这项提案已经发表了一些反对意见。
ext.ext_en: Britain and France have expressed some disagreement with the proposal.

defs.def_en: Disagreement means objecting to something such as a proposal.

ext.ext_cn: 美国国会和总统就削减巨额预算赤字的提案仍持不同意见，双方僵持不下。
ext.ext_en: The United States Congress and the President are still locked in disagreement over proposals to reduce the massive budget deficit...

ext.ext_cn: 由于在受邀人员一事上谈不拢，和平会谈的计划化为了泡影。
ext.ext_en: Plans for a peace conference failed due to disagreement on who should be allowed to attend...

defs.def_en: When there is disagreement about something, people disagree or argue about what should be done.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人抑郁的;使人沮丧的;让人消沉的

ext.ext_cn: 昨天的失业数字令人沮丧。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday's unemployment figures were depressing...

ext.ext_cn: 我很想 2 月份去度假，因为我觉得那是一个非常阴沉惨淡、令人抑郁的月份。
ext.ext_en: I'm rather keen to go on holiday in February because I think it's a very dismal, depressing month.

defs.def_en: Something that is depressing makes you feel sad and disappointed.

ext.ext_cn: 50便士的硬币
ext.ext_en: ...50 pence coins.

ext.ext_cn: 弗雷德里克收藏的金币
ext.ext_en: ...Frederick's gold coin collection.

defs.def_en: A coin is a small piece of metal which is used as money.

ext.ext_cn: 杰伦·拉尼尔创造了“虚拟现实”这个词，并成为推动其早期发展的先驱人物。
ext.ext_en: Jaron Lanier coined the term 'virtual reality' and pioneered its early development...

ext.ext_cn: lunatic是个生造词，用来形容月圆时发疯的人。
ext.ext_en: The word 'lunatic' was coined to describe people who went mad at the full moon.

defs.def_en: If you coin a word or a phrase, you are the first person to say it.

ext.ext_cn: 很多私立大学正在大发其财。
ext.ext_en: Many private colleges are coining it...

ext.ext_cn: 一家葡萄酒商店正在靠出售威丽牌子的香槟大把大把赚钱。
ext.ext_en: One wine shop is coining money selling Wembley-label champagne.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is coining it or is coining money, you are emphasizing that they are making a lot of money very quickly, often without really earning it.

defs.def_cn: 用个双关语;套用句老话

ext.ext_cn: 50名当地的音乐家，用个双关词，“联合起来”（band亦有“乐队”之意）组成了“爵士乐大联盟”。
ext.ext_en: Fifty local musicians have, to coin a phrase, banded together to form the Jazz Umbrella.

defs.def_en: You say 'to coin a phrase' to show that you realize you are making a pun or using a cliché

ext.ext_cn: 这些研究结果提醒人们，失业率下降的另一面是低薪。
ext.ext_en: These findings are a reminder that low pay is the other side of the coin of falling unemployment.

defs.def_en: You use the other side of the coin to mention a different aspect of a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 据报道，部长强调经济改革和政治改革是一个问题的两个方面。
ext.ext_en: The minister reportedly stressed that economic and political reforms were two sides of the same coin.

defs.def_en: If you say that two things are two sides of the same coin, you mean that they are different ways of looking at or dealing with the same situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有毒的;毒性的;引起中毒的

ext.ext_cn: 清除有毒废弃物的成本
ext.ext_en: ...the cost of cleaning up toxic waste...

ext.ext_cn: 这些产品对人类没有毒性。
ext.ext_en: These products are not toxic to humans.

defs.def_en: A toxic substance is poisonous.
An incinerator is a special large container for burning rubbish at a very high temperature.

ext.ext_cn: 军事策略家们企图绕开这一条约。
ext.ext_en: Military planners tried to circumvent the treaty.

defs.def_en: If someone circumvents a rule or restriction, they avoid having to obey the rule or restriction, in a clever and perhaps dishonest way.

defs.def_cn: 躲避，回避(尤指意欲伤害自己的人)

ext.ext_cn: 罗斯福偶尔会试图避开他。
ext.ext_en: Roosevelt occasionally attempted to circumvent him.

defs.def_en: If you circumvent someone, you cleverly prevent them from achieving something, especially when they are trying to harm you.

ext.ext_cn: 原来他们院子里那棵漂亮的无花果树已不长一片树叶，不挂一个果子。
ext.ext_en: A beautiful fig tree that had stood in their yard was leafless and barren.

defs.def_en: If a tree or plant is leafless, it has no leaves.
A meridian is an imaginary line from the North Pole to the South Pole. Meridians are drawn on maps to help you describe the position of a place.

defs.def_cn: 精打细算的会计（或管理人员）

ext.ext_cn: 精打细算、一味想要控制开支的管理层
ext.ext_en: ...bean counters who tend to focus on controlling expenses.

defs.def_en: You can describe people such as accountants and business managers as bean counters if you disapprove of them because you think they are only interested in money.

defs.def_cn: （英国）上议院，贵族院;上议院大楼

ext.ext_cn: 该法规已经两次遭到上议院的否决。
ext.ext_en: The legislation has twice been rejected by the House of Lords.

defs.def_en: The House of Lords is the part of the parliament in Britain whose members have not been elected. The building where they meet is also called the House of Lords.  →see usage note at:government

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 花费不多的;价钱不贵的

ext.ext_cn: 许多价钱实惠的餐馆
ext.ext_en: ...a variety of good inexpensive restaurants.

defs.def_en: Something that is inexpensive does not cost very much.
Conjunctivitis is an eye infection which causes the thin skin that covers the eye to become red.

ext.ext_cn: 光喋喋不休没用，你应该采取行动。
ext.ext_en: It's no good bleating on about it, you ought to do something about it.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is bleating on about something, you mean that they are talking about it a great deal in a way which makes them sound weak and irritating.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 美的；艺术的；美感的；审美的

ext.ext_cn: 因其外形美观且经久耐用、质量上乘而被选定的产品
ext.ext_en: ...products chosen for their aesthetic appeal as well as their durability and quality.

ext.ext_cn: 他强烈地感受到这件作品的美学价值。
ext.ext_en: He responded very strongly to the aesthetic of this particular work.

defs.def_en: Aesthetic is used to talk about beauty or art, and people's appreciation of beautiful things.

ext.ext_cn: 这种有追溯力的法规鲜有先例。
ext.ext_en: There are few precedents for this sort of retroactive legislation.

defs.def_en: If a decision or action is retroactive, it is intended to take effect from a date in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 如果他知道了，肯定会责骂我的。
ext.ext_en: If he finds out, he'll scold me...

ext.ext_cn: 后来她训斥女儿不应该那样对父亲说话。
ext.ext_en: Later she scolded her daughter for having talked to her father like that...

defs.def_en: If you scold someone, you speak angrily to them because they have done something wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家也被准予加入世界贸易组织。
ext.ext_en: The country has also been granted membership of the World Trade Organisation...

ext.ext_cn: 他寄给我一份入会登记表。
ext.ext_en: He sent me a membership form...

defs.def_en: Membership of an organization is the state of being a member of it.

defs.def_cn: 全体会员(或成员);全体会员(或成员)人数

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲建筑商联合会拥有逾35万家建筑公司会员。
ext.ext_en: The European Builders Confederation has a membership of over 350,000 building companies.

ext.ext_cn: 会员队伍庞大的组织
ext.ext_en: ...organizations with huge memberships.

defs.def_en: The membership of an organization is the people who belong to it, or the number of people who belong to it.
In Britain, a co-operative society is a commercial organization with several shops in a particular district. Customers can join this organization and get a share of its profits.
DDT is a poisonous substance which is used for killing insects.

ext.ext_cn: 除了一小组受薪员工外，这个组织里都是不领报酬的志愿者。
ext.ext_en: Apart from a small team of paid staff, the organisation consists of unpaid volunteers.

ext.ext_cn: 禁止从事有偿工作的旅游签证
ext.ext_en: ...tourist visas, which prohibit paid work.

defs.def_en: Paid workers, or people who do paid work, receive money for the work that they do.

ext.ext_cn: 用于找房子的10天带薪假期
ext.ext_en: ...10 days' paid holiday for house hunting...

ext.ext_cn: 调查进行期间，单位给他放了带薪假。
ext.ext_en: He has been placed on a paid leave of absence while investigations are made.

defs.def_en: If you are given paid holiday, you get your wages or salary even though you are not at work.

ext.ext_cn: 高收入的会计师
ext.ext_en: ...a well-paid accountant...

ext.ext_cn: 在发达国家中，英国的旅游行业雇员报酬最低。
ext.ext_en: Travel and tourism employees in the UK are among the worst paid in the developed world...

defs.def_en: If you are well paid, you receive a lot of money for the work that you do. If you are badly paid, you do not receive much money.

ext.ext_cn: 一连串空中打击粉碎了那位将军继续战斗的希望
ext.ext_en: ...a series of airforce strikes that put paid to the General's hopes of fighting on...

ext.ext_cn: 仅仅6个月前我还经营着自己的公司，经济衰退让公司关了门。
ext.ext_en: Only six months ago I ran my own business. The recession put paid to that.

defs.def_en: If an unexpected event puts paid to someone's hopes, chances, or plans, it completely ends or destroys them.

defs.def_cn: 拥护联邦制的;联邦主义的;联邦主义者的

ext.ext_cn: 在欧洲实行联邦主义的理念
ext.ext_en: ...the federalist idea of Europe.

ext.ext_cn: 很多魁北克人是联邦制的拥护者。
ext.ext_en: Many Quebeckers are federalists.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is federalist believes in, supports, or follows a federal system of government.

defs.def_cn: （尤指为建筑物提供集中供暖的）汽锅，锅炉
defs.def_en: A boiler is a device which burns gas, oil, electricity, or coal in order to provide hot water, especially for the central heating in a building.

ext.ext_cn: 业主如果未能按时交房贷，就会面临丧失抵押品赎回权的危险。
ext.ext_en: If homeowners can't keep up the payments, they face foreclosure...

ext.ext_en: If interest rates go up, won't foreclosures rise?

defs.def_en: Some long thin objects that are used in sports are called sticks .

ext.ext_cn: 一根芹菜
ext.ext_en: ...a stick of celery.

ext.ext_cn: 肉桂条
ext.ext_en: ...cinnamon sticks.

defs.def_en: A stick of something is a long thin piece of it.

defs.def_cn: 严厉的批评;大肆的取笑

ext.ext_cn: 对你批评最严厉的并不是驾车人，而是普通民众。
ext.ext_en: It's not motorists who give you the most stick, it's the general public...

ext.ext_cn: 我由于自己的信仰遭到了伙伴们的取笑，但我不在乎。
ext.ext_en: I get some stick from the lads because of my faith but I don't mind.

defs.def_en: If you give someone some stick, you criticize them or tease them roughly.

ext.ext_cn: 他住在某个偏远的乡村。
ext.ext_en: He lived out in the sticks somewhere.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone lives in the sticks, you mean that they live a long way from any large cities.

ext.ext_cn: 不幸的是，经典的美国小说经常被用来作为批评当代英国作家的依据。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately historic American fiction is constantly being used as a stick to beat contemporary British writers with.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a stick to beat someone with, you mean that it is used, or could be used, as a basis for criticism.
If someone gets the wrong end of the stick or gets hold of the wrong end of the stick, they do not understand something correctly and get the wrong idea about it.

ext.ext_cn: 拥有很多奖章的人
ext.ext_en: ...a man with more medals than you can shake a stick at.

defs.def_en: If you say that there are more things than you could or can shake a stick at, you are emphasizing in a humorous way that there are a lot of them.

ext.ext_cn: 他将文件叠起来，塞进自己的书桌抽屉里。
ext.ext_en: He folded the papers and stuck them in his desk drawer...

ext.ext_cn: 杰克打开门，探出头来。
ext.ext_en: Jack opened his door and stuck his head out.

defs.def_en: If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

ext.ext_cn: 他们派来了很多男护士，在我的背上扎了一针。
ext.ext_en: They sent in loads of male nurses and stuck a needle in my back...

ext.ext_cn: 有个小流氓昨晚扎了她一刀。
ext.ext_en: Some punk stuck a knife in her last night...

defs.def_en: If you stick a pointed object in something, or if it sticks in something, it goes into it or through it by making a cut or hole.

ext.ext_cn: 它们还在从起重机上掉落的地方，一部分露出水面。
ext.ext_en: They lay where they had fallen from the crane, sticking out of the water...

ext.ext_cn: 小个子男人脏乎乎的短裤口袋里鼓鼓的，伸出来个什么东西。
ext.ext_en: Something was sticking from the pocket of the little man's grimy shorts...

defs.def_en: If something is sticking out from a surface or object, it extends up or away from it. If something is sticking into a surface or object, it is partly in it.

ext.ext_cn: 别忘了剪下标志，贴到你的卡上。
ext.ext_en: Don't forget to clip the token and stick it on your card...

ext.ext_cn: 我们就把它贴在窗户上了。
ext.ext_en: We just stuck it to the window...

defs.def_en: If you stick one thing to another, you attach it using glue, sticky tape, or another sticky substance.

ext.ext_cn: 土粘在犁铧上，卡住了犁。
ext.ext_en: The soil sticks to the blade and blocks the plough...

ext.ext_cn: 如果蜡纸已粘在蛋糕的底部，就把它撕掉。
ext.ext_en: Peel away the waxed paper if it has stuck to the bottom of the cake...

defs.def_en: If one thing sticks to another, it becomes attached to it and is difficult to remove.

ext.ext_cn: 这件事一直萦绕在我的脑海里，因为这是我在那个国家看到的首起种族主义实例。
ext.ext_en: The incident stuck in my mind because it was the first example I had seen of racism in that country...

ext.ext_cn: 那首歌多年来一直铭记在我心中。
ext.ext_en: That song has stuck in my head for years.

defs.def_en: If something sticks in your mind, you remember it for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 有位朋友戏谑地称它为“避难所”，然后这个名称就沿用了下来。
ext.ext_en: A friend dubbed it 'The Sanctuary' and the name stuck.

defs.def_en: If you give someone or something a name and the name sticks, it becomes the name which most people use to refer to that person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我不知道他们将如何证明这些指控属实。
ext.ext_en: I don't see how they'll make the charges stick...

ext.ext_cn: 但法律专家们不能肯定这一指控是否成立。
ext.ext_en: But legal experts are not sure if such a charge can stick.

defs.def_en: If someone manages to make a charge or accusation stick, they show that the person accused is guilty of the crime or action they are accused of.

ext.ext_cn: 仪表盘上的指针一下转到了 50 英尺处，也就是到头了，然后就停在那里不动了。
ext.ext_en: The needle on the dial went right round to fifty feet, which was as far as it could go, and there it stuck...

ext.ext_cn: 匕首牢牢地卡在银质刀鞘中。
ext.ext_en: The dagger stuck tightly in the silver scabbard.

defs.def_en: If something which can usually be moved sticks, it becomes fixed in one position.

ext.ext_cn: 我找了份在啤酒厂洗瓶子的工作。干了两星期，就再也受不了了。
ext.ext_en: Got a job bottle-washing at the brewery. I lasted a fortnight. I couldn't stick it...

ext.ext_cn: 你坚持了多久？
ext.ext_en: How long did you stick it for?

defs.def_en: If you are in an unpleasant or difficult situation and you say that you cannot stick it, you mean that you cannot bear to remain there long.

ext.ext_cn: 这部剧糟透了，他们趁早拉倒吧。
ext.ext_en: It's a rotten play, so they can stick it...

ext.ext_cn: 她接着怒气冲冲地走了出去，告诉他“去他妈的工作”。
ext.ext_en: She then stormed out in a temper telling him to 'stick his job'.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone can stick something, especially a job, or if you tell them where to stick it, you are rudely refusing it or emphasizing that you do not want it or like it.
A dehumidifier is a machine that is used to reduce the amount of moisture in the air.

ext.ext_cn: 他被行刑队枪决了。
ext.ext_en: He was executed by firing squad.

defs.def_en: A firing squad is a group of soldiers who are ordered to shoot and kill a person who has been found guilty of committing a crime.

ext.ext_en: Should the teacher present grammatical rules to students?

ext.ext_cn: 语法错误
ext.ext_en: ...grammatical errors.

defs.def_en: Grammatical is used to indicate that something relates to grammar.

defs.def_cn: 符合语法规则的；符合文法的

ext.ext_cn: 考查学生是否能用符合语法规则的英语进行写作的新型考试
ext.ext_en: ...a new test to determine whether students can write grammatical English.

defs.def_en: If someone's language is grammatical, it is considered correct because it obeys the rules of grammar.

ext.ext_cn: 我们这一系列的药草茶不含防腐剂、色素以及人工调味品。
ext.ext_en: Our range of herbal teas contain no preservatives, colourings or artificial flavourings.

ext.ext_cn: 柠檬调料
ext.ext_en: ...lemon flavoring.

defs.def_en: Flavourings are substances that are added to food or drink to give it a particular taste.

ext.ext_cn: 艾琳倾身把后座门打开。
ext.ext_en: Eileen leaned across and opened the passenger door...

ext.ext_cn: 他前倾吻了她一下。
ext.ext_en: He leaned forward to give her a kiss...

defs.def_en: When you lean in a particular direction, you bend your body in that direction.

ext.ext_en: She was feeling tired and was glad to lean against him...

ext.ext_cn: 把植物靠墙摆放，用泥煤盖住根部。
ext.ext_en: Lean the plants against a wall and cover the roots with peat...

defs.def_en: If you lean on or against someone or something, you rest against them so that they partly support your weight. If you lean an object on or against something, you place the object so that it is partly supported by that thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 跟大部分运动员一样，她身形清瘦，肌肉结实。
ext.ext_en: Like most athletes, she was lean and muscular...

ext.ext_cn: 她看着那个瘦高个儿上了车。
ext.ext_en: She watched the tall, lean figure step into the car.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as lean, you mean that they are thin but look strong and healthy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这块肉很好，又瘦又嫩。
ext.ext_en: It is a beautiful meat, very lean and tender.

ext.ext_cn: 买得到的最瘦的碎牛肉
ext.ext_en: ...the leanest ground beef you can get.

defs.def_en: If meat is lean, it does not have very much fat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 英镑目前的汇率将迫使英国公司厉行精兵简政。
ext.ext_en: The value of the pound will force British companies to be leaner and fitter.

ext.ext_cn: 削减企业赘肉，建立瘦身型公司
ext.ext_en: ...cutting corporate flab and building leaner companies.

defs.def_en: If you describe an organization as lean, you mean that it has become more efficient and less wasteful by getting rid of staff, or by dropping projects which were unprofitable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 萧条的20世纪30年代
ext.ext_en: ...the lean years of the 1930s...

ext.ext_cn: 随着城里游客的减少，出租车行业正遭受30年来最不景气的时期。
ext.ext_en: With fewer tourists in town, the taxi trade is going through its leanest patch for 30 years.

defs.def_en: If you describe periods of time as lean, you mean that people have less of something such as money or are less successful than they used to be.

ext.ext_cn: 没有受到法庭制裁的惯犯被当地人处治了。
ext.ext_en: Persistent criminals who have gone unpunished by the courts have been dealt with by local people...

ext.ext_en: I have been amazed at times that cruelty can go unpunished.

defs.def_en: If a criminal or crime goes unpunished, the criminal is not punished.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指不好或不受欢迎的状态或情况）持续存在的，继续发生的

ext.ext_en: Her position as national leader has been weakened by persistent fears of another coup attempt...

ext.ext_en: His cough grew more persistent until it never stopped...

defs.def_en: Something that is persistent continues to exist or happen for a long time; used especially about bad or undesirable states or situations.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 执著的；不屈不挠的；锲而不舍的

ext.ext_cn: 对政府交通政策一直持批评态度的人
ext.ext_en: ...a persistent critic of the government's transport policies...

ext.ext_cn: 今天早晨他又打来了电话。他非常执著。
ext.ext_en: He phoned again this morning. He's very persistent.

defs.def_en: Someone who is persistent continues trying to do something, even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

defs.def_cn: 变得僵硬;变得紧张;绷紧

defs.def_en: If you stiffen, you stop moving and stand or sit with muscles that are suddenly tense, for example because you feel afraid or angry.

ext.ext_en: The blood supply to the skin is reduced when muscles stiffen.

defs.def_en: If your muscles or joints stiffen, or if something stiffens them, they become difficult to bend or move.

ext.ext_en: Russian resistance suddenly stiffened because there was no room for retreat...

ext.ext_en: Canada has recently stiffened its immigration rules.

defs.def_en: If attitudes or behaviour stiffen, or if something stiffens them, they become stronger or more severe, and less likely to be changed.

ext.ext_cn: 这种特殊的纸实际是一种糨糊浆过的又薄又软的杉原纸。
ext.ext_en: This special paper was actually thin, soft Sugiwara paper that had been stiffened with a kind of paste...

ext.ext_en: They peeled cold stiffened gloves from their hands.

defs.def_en: If something such as cloth is stiffened, it is made firm so that it does not bend easily.

ext.ext_en: They accused him of weaving a web of lies and deceit.

defs.def_en: A web is a complicated pattern of connections or relationships, sometimes considered as an obstacle or a danger.

ext.ext_en: ...the detritus of war.

defs.def_en: Detritus is the small pieces of rubbish that remain after an event has finished or when something has been used.

ext.ext_en: The soldiers fired without provocation...

defs.def_en: If you describe a person's action as provocation or a provocation, you mean that it is a reason for someone else to react angrily, violently, or emotionally.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: This morning, looking harassed and drawn, Lewis tendered his resignation.

ext.ext_en: ...non-standard window shapes...

ext.ext_en: The shop is completely out of non-standard sizes.

defs.def_en: Non-standard things are different from the usual version or type of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 那完全是一派胡言。

defs.def_cn: (机械装置等)延迟的，延时的，定时的

ext.ext_en: ...a type of delayed action parachute.

defs.def_cn: (建屋互助会或保险公司)非互助化，非互利化，转为有限公司
