defs.def_en: If something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

ext.ext_cn: 事故的起因并非一目了然。
ext.ext_en: The cause of the accident was not immediately apparent.

defs.def_en: If something is immediately obvious, it can be seen or understood without any delay.

ext.ext_cn: 对这种不幸境况负有直接责任的人是该省的省长。
ext.ext_en: The man immediately responsible for this misery is the province's governor...

ext.ext_cn: 我们让故事情节与人们息息相关。
ext.ext_en: We had the people immediately concerned in the plot.

defs.def_en: Immediately is used to indicate that someone or something is closely and directly involved in a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望饭后马上就开始。
ext.ext_en: They wish to begin immediately after dinner...

ext.ext_cn: 她总是坐在司机驾驶位置的正后方。
ext.ext_en: She always sits immediately behind the driver...

defs.def_en: Immediately is used to emphasize that something comes next, or is next to something else.

ext.ext_cn: 我一做完那件事就对自己感到十分厌恶。
ext.ext_en: Immediately I've done it I feel completely disgusted with myself.

defs.def_en: If one thing happens immediately something else happens, it happens after that event, without any delay.

ext.ext_cn: 许多低成本独立制作的电影使新导演和新演员崭露头角。
ext.ext_en: A number of low-budget independent films brought new directors and actors to the fore.

defs.def_en: If someone or something comes to the fore in a particular situation or group, they become important or popular.

defs.def_cn: (动物、船只或飞行器)前部的，前端的

ext.ext_cn: 船的前部没有受到直接破坏。
ext.ext_en: There had been no direct damage in the fore part of the ship.

ext.ext_cn: 左前腿膝关节下出现的一个肿块
ext.ext_en: ...a swelling appeared below his near fore knee.

defs.def_en: Fore is used to refer to parts at the front of an animal, ship, or aircraft.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的游艇设施完备，首尾有两个双人舱。
ext.ext_en: Our yacht was well equipped with two double cabins fore and aft...

ext.ext_cn: 他松开紧紧抓住护栏的手，往船的两头扫了一眼。
ext.ext_en: He loosened his very strong hold on the ship's rail and glanced fore and aft.

defs.def_en: If something is fore in a boat or plane, it is at the front of it.

ext.ext_cn: 安妮回到寓所的时候早就过了午夜。
ext.ext_en: It was well after midnight by the time Anne returned to her apartment...

ext.ext_cn: 大门午夜时上锁。
ext.ext_en: The entrance gates were locked at midnight.

defs.def_en: Midnight is twelve o'clock in the middle of the night.

ext.ext_cn: 想要推迟午夜的最后期限是完全不可能的。
ext.ext_en: It is totally out of the question to postpone the midnight deadline...

ext.ext_cn: 我和姐姐的确在半夜大吃了一顿。
ext.ext_en: Well we did have a midnight feast, me and my sister.

defs.def_en: Midnight is used to describe something which happens or appears at midnight or in the middle of the night.

defs.def_cn: 开夜车;挑灯夜战;工作(或读书)至深夜

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯为了写完文章挑灯夜战，现在已经睡着了。
ext.ext_en: Chris is asleep after burning the midnight oil trying to finish his article.

defs.def_en: If someone is burning the midnight oil, they are staying up very late in order to study or do some other work.

defs.def_cn: （正式辩论中质疑议事规则遭到破坏而提出的）程序问题

ext.ext_cn: 本·莫里斯先生在议会就程序问题提出质询。
ext.ext_en: A point of order was raised in parliament by Mr Ben Morris...

ext.ext_cn: 因对程序问题的异议而提出了推迟要求并获得了通过。
ext.ext_en: The postponement was demanded and won on a point of order.

defs.def_en: In a formal debate, a point of order is an official complaint that someone makes because the rules about how the debate is meant to be organized have been broken.

ext.ext_cn: 生活成本大幅上涨。
ext.ext_en: The cost of living has increased dramatically...

ext.ext_cn: 各公司正在把工作岗位转移至生活费用较低的城镇。
ext.ext_en: Companies are moving jobs to towns with a lower cost of living.

defs.def_en: The cost of living is the average amount of money that people in a particular place need in order to be able to afford basic food, housing, and clothing.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你常常因为沮丧而暴饮暴食，首先应该设法找到悲伤的原因。
ext.ext_en: If you tend to overeat because of depression, first take steps to recognize the source of your sadness.

ext.ext_cn: 辛辣食品吃得过多的人
ext.ext_en: ...people who overeat spicy foods.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone overeats, you mean they eat more than they need to or more than is healthy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 出自匠人之手的；技艺纯熟但无创意的

ext.ext_cn: 会议的确开得有板有眼，但谈不上激动人心。
ext.ext_en: Really it's a workmanlike conference rather than a dramatic one...

ext.ext_cn: 这个剧本充其量就是匠人之作。
ext.ext_en: The script was workmanlike at best.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as workmanlike, you mean that it has been done quite well and sensibly, but not in a particularly imaginative or original way.

ext.ext_cn: 他发起的运动得到了女权主义者、反战分子和生态学家的支持。
ext.ext_en: His campaign attracted the support of feminists, peaceniks and ecologists.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a peacenik, you mean that they are strongly opposed to war.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我不记得确切的话语。
ext.ext_en: I don't remember the exact words...

ext.ext_cn: 抗议电话的确切数量并未透露。
ext.ext_en: The exact number of protest calls has not been revealed...

defs.def_en: Exact means correct in every detail. For example, an exact copy is the same in every detail as the thing it is copied from.

defs.def_cn: （用于名词前表强调）刚好的，确切的

ext.ext_cn: 直到这时我才真正开始考虑它。
ext.ext_en: I hadn't really thought about it until this exact moment...

ext.ext_cn: 你真的认为我能够得到我想要的东西么？
ext.ext_en: Do you really think I could get the exact thing I want?...

defs.def_en: You use exact before a noun to emphasize that you are referring to that particular thing and no other, especially something that has a particular significance.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 严肃、严谨、倔强的他同时又冷漠、多疑、敏感、不会变通。
ext.ext_en: Formal, exact and obstinate, he was also cold, suspicious, touchy and tactless.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as exact, you mean that they are very careful and detailed in their work, thinking, or methods.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经强行要求委员会主席作出书面道歉。
ext.ext_en: Already he has exacted a written apology from the chairman of the commission...

ext.ext_cn: 他们也可能会为提供合作而索要高价。
ext.ext_en: They, too, would be likely to exact a high price for their cooperation.

defs.def_en: When someone exacts something, they demand and obtain it from another person, especially because they are in a superior or more powerful position.

ext.ext_cn: 她利用媒体帮助自己进行可怕的复仇。
ext.ext_en: She uses the media to help her exact a terrible revenge.

defs.def_en: If someone exacts revenge on a person, they have their revenge on them.

ext.ext_cn: 纯粹的体力劳动已经产生了极其不利的影响。
ext.ext_en: The sheer physical effort had exacted a heavy price...

ext.ext_cn: 激烈的地面战役带来的紧张压力将让军队付出代价。
ext.ext_en: The strain of a violent ground campaign will exact a toll on troops.

defs.def_en: If something exacts a high price, it has a bad effect on a person or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 一小部分——确切地说是5个——已经坏了。
ext.ext_en: A small number — five, to be exact—have been bad...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为自己是个自由主义的民主党人，或者更准确地说，是倡导民主的自由主义者。
ext.ext_en: I consider myself to be a liberal democrat, or to be more exact, a democratic liberal.

defs.def_en: You say to be exact to indicate that you are slightly correcting or giving more detailed information about what you have been saying.

ext.ext_cn: 皇家马德里队获胜，与领先的巴塞罗那队仍然保持着5分的差距。
ext.ext_en: Real's victory keeps them five points behind the pacesetters, Barcelona...

ext.ext_cn: 起初领先的是哈蒙德。
ext.ext_en: Hammond was the early pace-setter.

defs.def_en: A pacesetter is someone who is in the lead during part of a race or competition and therefore decides the speed or standard of the race or competition for that time.

defs.def_cn: （某个领域或活动中的）领导者

ext.ext_cn: 蒙古国似乎不太可能领导亚洲政治变革。
ext.ext_en: Mongolia seemed an unlikely candidate as the pacesetter for political change in Asia.

defs.def_en: A pacesetter is a person or a company that is considered to be the leader in a particular field or activity.
A sandwich course is an educational course in which you have periods of study between periods of being at work.

ext.ext_cn: 最重要的部分，即花朵，很少成为化石。
ext.ext_en: The most important parts, the flowers, rarely fossilise...

ext.ext_cn: 蛋白质是否存留取决于骨头被石化的方式。
ext.ext_en: The survival of the proteins depends on the way in which bones are fossilised.

defs.def_en: If the remains of an animal or plant fossilize or are fossilized, they become hard and form fossils, instead of decaying completely.

ext.ext_cn: 他们似乎想要做的实际上就是让人们生活和工作的环境固定不变。
ext.ext_en: What they seem to want to do in fact is fossilize the particular environment in which people live and work...

ext.ext_cn: 需要发生改变，但是政策僵化不变。
ext.ext_en: Needs change while policies fossilize.

defs.def_en: If you say that ideas, attitudes, or ways of behaving have fossilized or have been fossilized, you are criticizing the fact that they are fixed and unlikely to change, in spite of changing situations or circumstances.

ext.ext_cn: 这个人受伤严重，无法完全遮掩住。
ext.ext_en: This man was too injured to dissimulate well...

ext.ext_cn: 他们都穿着田径服，似乎想掩饰他们的真实职能。
ext.ext_en: They were decked out in tracksuits, seemingly to dissimulate their true function.

defs.def_en: When people dissimulate, they hide their true feelings, intentions, or nature.

ext.ext_cn: 谷仓里堆满了成捆的稻草。
ext.ext_en: The barn was full of bales of straw...

ext.ext_cn: 我跌跌撞撞地趟过泥地来到一个堆满麦秆的场院。
ext.ext_en: I stumbled through mud to a yard strewn with straw.

defs.def_en: Straw consists of the dried, yellowish stalks from crops such as wheat or barley.

ext.ext_cn: 一瓶插着吸管的柠檬水
ext.ext_en: ...a bottle of lemonade with a straw in it.

defs.def_en: A straw is a thin tube of paper or plastic, which you use to suck a drink into your mouth.

defs.def_cn: 抓救命稻草;采取极端措施;作绝望的挣扎

ext.ext_cn: 政府情急之下采取的考虑欠周的计划
ext.ext_en: ...a badly thought-out scheme from a Government clutching at straws.

defs.def_en: If you are clutching at straws or grasping at straws, you are trying unusual or extreme ideas or methods because other ideas or methods have failed.

defs.def_cn: 压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草;最终使人不堪忍受的事

ext.ext_cn: 教会同意授给女性神职的决定使他终于忍无可忍。
ext.ext_en: For him the Church's decision to allow the ordination of women had been the last straw...

ext.ext_cn: 之后出现了经济衰退，财政收入下降，但致命的打击还是那场战争。
ext.ext_en: Then came the recession. Revenues dropped, but the straw to break the camel's back was the war.

defs.def_en: If an event is the last straw or the straw that broke the camel's back, it is the latest in a series of unpleasant or undesirable events, and makes you feel that you cannot tolerate a situation any longer.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你的一些客人不幸被抓了壮丁，同意在夏日烧烤野餐结束后开车把其他人送回家
ext.ext_en: ...if a few of your guests have drawn the short straw and agreed to drive others home after your summer barbecue.

defs.def_en: If you draw the short straw, you are chosen from a number of people to perform a job or duty that you will not enjoy.

ext.ext_cn: 最新的迹象是该国几家零售巨头的销售额有所上升。
ext.ext_en: The latest straw in the wind is a pick-up in sales among the nation's retail giants.

defs.def_en: If you say that an incident or piece of news is a straw in the wind, you mean that it gives an indication of what might happen in the future.

defs.def_cn: 重新装饰;再装修;重新粉刷

ext.ext_cn: 美国人每隔几年就会把家里和办公室重新粉刷一下。
ext.ext_en: Americans redecorate their houses and offices every few years...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的孩子们都离开了家，现在我们想要重新粉刷一下房屋。
ext.ext_en: Our children have left home, and we now want to redecorate.

defs.def_en: If you redecorate a room or a building, you put new paint or wallpaper on it.

ext.ext_cn: 夏末时节，我通常会把一小车堆肥施到土里。
ext.ext_en: I usually dig in a small barrow load of compost in late summer...

ext.ext_cn: 他告诫说，翻土掺钙并不利于植物生长。
ext.ext_en: To dig calcium into the soil, he warned, does not help the plant.

defs.def_en: If you dig a substance in, or dig it into the soil, you mix it into the soil by digging.

ext.ext_cn: 该营直接开到机场掘壕防守。
ext.ext_en: The battalion went directly to the airport to begin digging in...

ext.ext_cn: 敌人现在一定在挖掩体，准备迎接进攻。
ext.ext_en: The enemy must be digging themselves in now ready for the attack...

defs.def_en: When soldiers dig in or dig themselves in, they dig trenches and prepare themselves for an attack by the enemy.

defs.def_cn: （面临失败、困境等时）固执己见，坚定立场，坚持不懈

ext.ext_cn: 双方都坚持自己的立场，南北之间出现了一条鸿沟。
ext.ext_en: A yawning North-South gulf has opened up with both sides digging in.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is digging in, you mean that they are not changing their mind or weakening their efforts, although they may be losing a contest or facing difficult problems.

ext.ext_cn: “听着，”黛西一边大口喝着燕麦粥一边说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Listen,' said Daisy, digging into her oatmeal...

ext.ext_cn: 拉把椅子过来开吃吧！
ext.ext_en: Pull up a chair and dig in!

defs.def_en: If someone digs in, or digs into some food, they start eating eagerly. If you tell someone to dig in, you are inviting them to start eating, and encouraging them to eat as much as they want.

defs.def_cn: 使受精神创伤;使惊吓过度;使痛苦

ext.ext_cn: 那次经历给我我妻子造成了精神创伤。
ext.ext_en: My wife was traumatized by the experience...

ext.ext_cn: 他父母给他留下了心理伤害吗？
ext.ext_en: Did his parents traumatize him?...

defs.def_en: If someone is traumatized by an event or situation, it shocks or upsets them very much, and may cause them psychological damage.

defs.def_cn: 徽章，证章（美国英语通常用button指金属小圆徽章）
defs.def_en: A badge is a piece of metal or cloth which you wear to show that you belong to an organization or support a cause. American English usually uses button to refer to a small round metal badge.

ext.ext_cn: 对数千工会积极分子来说，成为共产党员是荣誉的象征。
ext.ext_en: Being a Communist was a badge of honour for thousands of trade union activists.

defs.def_en: Any feature which is regarded as a sign of a particular quality can be referred to as a badge .

defs.def_cn: 决定论(认为一切行为和事件都具有不以人类意志为转移的必然性和因果制约性)

ext.ext_cn: 我不相信历史决定论。
ext.ext_en: I don't believe in historical determinism.

defs.def_en: Determinism is the belief that all actions and events result from other actions, events, or situations, so people cannot in fact choose what to do.
Eye shadow is a substance which you can paint on your eyelids in order to make them a different colour.

ext.ext_cn: 游行者奚落路过的白人，但没有发生暴力事件，也没有人被逮捕。
ext.ext_en: Marchers jeered at white passers-by, but there was no violence, nor any arrests...

ext.ext_cn: 他的车队遭到愤怒的当地居民的嘲讽。
ext.ext_en: His motorcade was jeered by angry residents...

defs.def_en: To jeer at someone means to say or shout rude and insulting things to them to show that you do not like or respect them.

ext.ext_cn: 他面色阴郁地凝视前方，假装没听见那些冷嘲热讽。
ext.ext_en: He stared sullenly into space, pretending not to hear the jeers.

ext.ext_cn: 观众对他的起哄和嘲笑
ext.ext_en: ...the heckling and jeers of his audience.

defs.def_en: Jeers are rude and insulting things that people shout to show they do not like or respect someone.

ext.ext_cn: 萨尔茨堡是个风景非常秀丽的游览之地。
ext.ext_en: Salzburg is an outstandingly beautiful place to visit...

ext.ext_cn: 他的每一部小说都写得令人击掌。
ext.ext_en: All his novels were outstandingly well written.

defs.def_en: You use outstandingly to emphasize how good, or occasionally how bad, something is.

defs.def_cn: 萨密兹达;(苏联和东欧的)地下出版发行系统

ext.ext_cn: 专门出版和发行地下文学的出版商
ext.ext_en: ...a publisher specialising in samizdat literature.

defs.def_en: Samizdat referred to a system in the former USSR and Eastern Europe by which books and magazines forbidden by the state were illegally printed by groups who opposed the state.

ext.ext_cn: 老款的汽车难免缺少经过改进的最新安全保护装置。
ext.ext_en: Older cars inevitably lack the latest safety refinements.

ext.ext_cn: 比赛的发展和改进
ext.ext_en: ...development and refinement of the game.

defs.def_en: Refinements are small changes or additions that you make to something in order to improve it. Refinement is the process of making refinements.

ext.ext_cn: 既有尊严又有教养的女孩
ext.ext_en: ...a girl who possessed both dignity and refinement.

defs.def_en: Refinement is politeness and good manners.

defs.def_cn: (储存气体或化学品的)金属罐,金属桶

ext.ext_cn: 防暴警察向人群中投掷了催泪瓦斯罐和烟幕弹。
ext.ext_en: Riot police hurled tear gas canisters and smoke bombs into the crowd.

ext.ext_cn: 商用燃料罐
ext.ext_en: ...canisters of commercial fuel.

defs.def_en: A canister is a strong metal container. It is used to hold gases or chemical substances.

defs.def_cn: (用金属、塑料、瓷器制作的盛放糖、面粉等的)盒子,罐子,筒
defs.def_en: A canister is a metal, plastic, or china container with a lid. It is used for storing food such as sugar and flour.

ext.ext_cn: 她买了一只能装得下那些胶卷筒的旅行包。
ext.ext_en: She bought a travel-bag large enough to contain the film canisters.

defs.def_en: A canister is a flat round container. It is usually made of metal and is used to store photographic film.

ext.ext_cn: 我去了乡下休养。
ext.ext_en: I went away to the country to recuperate...

ext.ext_cn: 他背部受了重伤，目前正在康复中。
ext.ext_en: He is recuperating from a serious back injury.

defs.def_en: When you recuperate, you recover your health or strength after you have been ill or injured.

ext.ext_cn: 大量消耗臭氧层的物质
ext.ext_en: ...substances that deplete the ozone layer...

ext.ext_cn: 他们长时间开火，耗尽了弹药。
ext.ext_en: They fired in long bursts, which depleted their ammunition...

defs.def_en: To deplete a stock or amount of something means to reduce it.

defs.def_cn: 使…武器化;把…改装成武器;把…用作弹药库

ext.ext_cn: 他们快把蓖麻毒素——一种致命的植物毒素——研发为武器了。
ext.ext_en: They were close to weaponizing ricin—a lethal plant toxin.

ext.ext_cn: 太空武器化的计划
ext.ext_en: ...the plan to weaponize outer space.

defs.def_en: If a substance or material is weaponized, it is used as a weapon or made into a weapon. If an area is weaponized, it is used as a location for weapons.

ext.ext_cn: 人们可以容忍公众人物婚外的不检点行为。
ext.ext_en: People are prepared to be tolerant of extra-marital peccadilloes by public figures.

defs.def_en: Peccadilloes are small, unimportant sins or faults.

ext.ext_cn: 计划生育诊所
ext.ext_en: ...a family planning clinic.

defs.def_en: A clinic is a building where people go to receive medical advice or treatment.

defs.def_cn: 色情作品作者（或发行人、出售商）
defs.def_en: A pornographer is a person who produces or sells pornography.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 直言不讳的；直截了当的

ext.ext_cn: 看不惯炫耀和虚伪、直言不讳的一个美国人
ext.ext_en: ...a plain-spoken American full of scorn for pomp and pretense.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is plain-spoken, you mean that they say exactly what they think, even when they know that what they say may not please other people.
An abattoir is a place where animals are killed in order to provide meat.

Artificial intelligence is a type of computer technology which is concerned with making machines work in an intelligent way, similar to the way that the human mind works. The abbreviation AI is also used.
A rhododendron is a large bush with large flowers which are usually pink, red, or purple.

ext.ext_cn: 我们来到这里时，我种的第一批作物里就有黑麦。
ext.ext_en: One of the first crops that I grew when we came here was rye.

ext.ext_cn: 100克全麦或黑麦面粉
ext.ext_en: ...100g wholemeal or rye flour.

defs.def_en: Rye is a cereal grown in cold countries. Its grains can be used to make flour, bread, or other foods.

ext.ext_cn: 我正吃夹火腿和瑞士干酪的黑麦面包。
ext.ext_en: I was eating ham and Swiss cheese on rye.

defs.def_en: Rye is bread made from rye.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司犯有严重过失。
ext.ext_en: The company were guilty of gross negligence.

ext.ext_cn: 极端不公的法案
ext.ext_en: ...an act of gross injustice.

defs.def_en: You use gross to describe something unacceptable or unpleasant to a very great amount, degree, or intensity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （言语、行为）极端粗俗的，下流的

ext.ext_cn: 他用不堪入耳的话辱骂那位海军上将。
ext.ext_en: He abused the Admiral in the grossest terms...

ext.ext_cn: 我感到无地自容，不知道自己怎么会变得如此粗俗。
ext.ext_en: I feel disgusted and wonder how I could ever have been so gross.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's  speech or behaviour is gross, you think it is very rude or unacceptable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人不快的；让人恶心的；令人厌恶的

ext.ext_cn: 他们前几天晚上为“美国远离毒品”组织播的那则广告非常恶心，我觉得爸爸看了都快晕过去了。
ext.ext_en: They had a commercial on the other night for Drug Free America that was so gross I thought Daddy was going to faint...

ext.ext_cn: 他穿着十分难看的节日服装。
ext.ext_en: He wears really gross holiday outfits.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as gross, you think it is very unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我只有在觉得自己胖得很难看的时候才能拒绝巧克力这类东西的诱惑。
ext.ext_en: I only resist things like chocolate if I feel really gross.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as gross, you mean that they are extremely fat and unattractive.

ext.ext_cn: 10月份之前保证10.4%的毛利或7.8%的纯利收益的固定利率账户
ext.ext_en: ...a fixed rate account guaranteeing 10.4% gross interest or 7.8% net until October.

ext.ext_cn: 利息是按照总收入给付，未扣除税金。
ext.ext_en: Interest is paid gross, rather than having tax deducted.

defs.def_en: Gross means the total amount of something, especially money, before any has been taken away.

ext.ext_cn: 6月份国民储蓄机构的总销售额为7.09亿英镑。
ext.ext_en: National Savings gross sales in June totalled £709 million.

defs.def_en: Gross means the total amount of something, after all the relevant amounts have been added together.
Gross means the total weight of something, including its container or wrapping.

defs.def_cn: （扣除税金前）总共赚得，总收入为

ext.ext_cn: 我是个工厂工人，去年的总收入为12,900英镑。
ext.ext_en: I'm a factory worker who grossed £12,900 last year...

ext.ext_cn: 到目前为止，这些电影的票房总收入已超过了5.9亿英镑。
ext.ext_en: So far the films have grossed more than £590 million.

defs.def_en: If a person or a business grosses a particular amount of money, they earn that amount of money before tax has been taken away.

ext.ext_cn: 他订购了12罗磁盘。
ext.ext_en: He ordered twelve gross of the disks.

defs.def_en: A gross is a group of 144 things.

ext.ext_cn: 采用 6 毫米胶片是因为它的定格图像要比录像带更加清晰。
ext.ext_en: 6-millimetre film was used because it offered clearer freeze frames than video tape.

defs.def_en: A freeze-frame from a film is an individual picture from it, produced by stopping the film or video tape at that point.

ext.ext_cn: 陪审团通过慢放和定格把录像带反复看了许多遍。
ext.ext_en: The jury watched the tape dozens of times in slow motion and in freeze frame.

ext.ext_cn: 遥控器上的定格键
ext.ext_en: ...the freeze-frame button on the remote control.

defs.def_en: If you watch a film in freeze-frame, you watch it using a facility that allows you to stop the film to look at an individual picture.

defs.def_cn: (与…)关系紧密的;等同(于)…的;互为依存的

ext.ext_cn: 巴黎一直是优雅、奢华和时尚的代名词。
ext.ext_en: Paris has always been synonymous with elegance, luxury and style...

ext.ext_cn: 头发变白并不一定等于变老了。
ext.ext_en: Going grey is not necessarily synonymous with growing old...

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing is synonymous with another, you mean that the two things are very closely associated with each other so that one suggests the other or one cannot exist without the other.

ext.ext_cn: 很多人对政府组阁过程中的政治交易所感到的气愤和反感
ext.ext_en: ...the anger and distaste many people feel at the political horse-trading involved in forming a government.

defs.def_en: If you describe discussions or negotiations as horse-trading, you disapprove of them because they are unofficial and involve compromises.
When negotiation or bargaining is forceful and shows clever and careful judgment, you can describe it as horse-trading .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (地方或人)深受…影响的，充满…的

ext.ext_cn: 这座城堡历史悠久，充满了传奇。
ext.ext_en: The castle is steeped in history and legend...

ext.ext_cn: 他说他们脱离现实，总是沉浸在过去。
ext.ext_en: He said they were unrealistic and steeped in the past.

defs.def_en: If a place or person is steeped in a quality or characteristic, they are surrounded by it or deeply influenced by it.

ext.ext_cn: 我被女王的私人秘书罗伯特·费洛斯爵士召往白金汉宫。
ext.ext_en: I received a summons to the Palace from Sir Robert Fellowes, the Queen's private secretary.

defs.def_en: A summons is an order to come and see someone.

ext.ext_cn: 她已经接到法院传唤其出庭的传票。
ext.ext_en: She had received a summons to appear in court.

defs.def_en: A summons is an official order to appear in court.

ext.ext_cn: 这些人被传唤，上周有30人到霍夫地方法院接受讯问。
ext.ext_en: The men were summonsed and last week 30 appeared before Hove magistrates...

ext.ext_cn: 她已经收到传票，要求其到圣奥尔本斯地方法院出庭。
ext.ext_en: She has been summonsed to appear at St Albans magistrates' court.

defs.def_en: If someone is summonsed, they are officially ordered to appear in court.

ext.ext_cn: 许多问题影响了这件事的顺利进行。
ext.ext_en: A number of problems marred the smooth running of this event...

ext.ext_cn: 大范围的舞弊破坏了那次选举。
ext.ext_en: That election was marred by massive cheating.

defs.def_en: To mar something means to spoil or damage it.

ext.ext_cn: 我一生都对大海和小船着迷。
ext.ext_en: I've had a lifelong fascination with the sea and with small boats.

defs.def_en: Fascination is the state of being greatly interested in or delighted by something.

ext.ext_cn: 主要讲述大英博物馆魅力的系列节目
ext.ext_en: ...a series focusing on the fascinations of the British Museum.

defs.def_en: A fascination is something that fascinates people.

defs.def_cn: （节日时装饰街道和建筑物的）彩旗

ext.ext_cn: 红、白、蓝彩旗装点着该市修复一新的火车站。
ext.ext_en: Red, white and blue bunting hung in the city's renovated train station.

defs.def_en: Bunting consists of rows of small coloured flags that are used to decorate streets and buildings on special occasions.

ext.ext_cn: 最终结果非常好，非常成功。
ext.ext_en: The end result is very good and very successful...

ext.ext_cn: 此事的最终结果将是统一。
ext.ext_en: The end result of this will be unity.

defs.def_en: The end result of an activity or a process is the final result that it produces.

ext.ext_cn: 他这个人就爱在心里反复琢磨事儿。
ext.ext_en: He tends to chew things over too much in his mind...

ext.ext_cn: 戈德斯通进一步考虑了这个问题。
ext.ext_en: Goldstone chewed over the idea further.

defs.def_en: If you chew something over, you keep thinking about it.

ext.ext_cn: 第二辆车插着加纳的三角旗。
ext.ext_en: The second car was flying the Ghanaian pennant.

defs.def_en: A pennant is a long, narrow, triangular flag.

defs.def_cn: （棒球联赛冠军队获得的）锦旗，冠军地位

ext.ext_cn: 红袜队以一场之差将冠军输给了底特律队。
ext.ext_en: The Red Sox lost the pennant to Detroit by a single game.

defs.def_en: In baseball, a pennant is a flag that is given each year to the top team in a league. The championship is also called the pennant.

ext.ext_cn: 婚姻常因为配偶双方的缺点而破裂。
ext.ext_en: Marriages usually break down as a result of the shortcomings of both partners...

ext.ext_cn: 他的书有其自身的缺点。
ext.ext_en: His book has its shortcomings.

defs.def_en: Someone's or something's shortcomings are the faults or weaknesses which they have.

defs.def_cn: (形状、设计或结构的)对称，匀称

ext.ext_cn: 雪花难以置信的美丽和对称
ext.ext_en: ...the incredible beauty and symmetry of a snowflake...

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢这所房子，因为它非常对称。
ext.ext_en: I loved the house because it had perfect symmetry...

defs.def_en: Something that has symmetry is symmetrical in shape, design, or structure.

ext.ext_cn: 超级大国承诺在武器运输方面要保持数量均衡。
ext.ext_en: The superpowers pledged to maintain symmetry in their arms shipments.

defs.def_en: Symmetry in a relationship or agreement is the fact of both sides giving and receiving an equal amount.

ext.ext_cn: 他说在英国经济与其他欧洲国家的经济实现更大的趋同性之前，英国不会重新加入欧洲汇率机制。
ext.ext_en: He said that Britain would not rejoin the ERM 'until there is much greater symmetry between our economy and other European economies.'

defs.def_en: You can refer to symmetry between countries, institutions, or situations if you think that there is a close similarity between them.

ext.ext_cn: 龋齿
ext.ext_en: ...dental caries.

defs.def_en: Caries is decay in teeth.

ext.ext_cn: 随着火气越来越大，他公开对出售国有资产的一些激进观点表示强烈反对。
ext.ext_en: As tempers rose, he spoke out strongly against some of the radical ideas for selling off state-owned property...

ext.ext_cn: 维克多·什科洛夫斯基为这本书公开辩护。
ext.ext_en: Viktor Shklovsky spoke out in defence of the book...

defs.def_en: If you speak out against something or in favour of something, you say publicly that you think it is bad or good.

ext.ext_cn: 肉的配给量降到了每人每周一磅。
ext.ext_en: The meat ration was down to one pound per person per week...

ext.ext_cn: 他们开始发行用来购买大米、面粉等生活基本必需品的定量配给卡。
ext.ext_en: They have begun to issue ration cards for basic necessities such as rice and flour.

defs.def_en: When there is not enough of something, your ration of it is the amount that you are allowed to have.

defs.def_cn: （通常指由于紧缺）配给，定量供应

ext.ext_cn: 面包、大米和茶叶等日常必需品已实行配给。
ext.ext_en: Staples such as bread, rice and tea are already being rationed...

ext.ext_cn: 实行食物配给的决定
ext.ext_en: ...the decision to ration food...

defs.def_en: When something is rationed by a person or government, you are only allowed to have a limited amount of it, usually because there is not enough of it.

ext.ext_cn: 救助官员说第一批紧急援助的小麦和食用油是上月发放到这里的。
ext.ext_en: Aid officials said that the first emergency food rations of wheat and oil were handed out here last month...

ext.ext_cn: 俄军士兵尝了一下长官的配给食物，然后高高兴兴地把那些高级食物一扫而光。
ext.ext_en: The Russian soldiers sampled the officers' rations and wolfed the superior food with delight.

defs.def_en: Rations are the food which is given to people who do not have enough food or to soldiers.

ext.ext_cn: 他像往常那样吃完垃圾食品、吸了两根烟后
ext.ext_en: ...after consuming his ration of junk food and two cigarettes.

defs.def_en: Your ration of something is the amount of it that you normally have.

ext.ext_cn: 一天下午，我觉得有些无聊，还真的睡着了一小会儿。
ext.ext_en: One afternoon, I grew bored and actually fell asleep for a few minutes...

ext.ext_cn: 利息只能根据实际借款数目给付。
ext.ext_en: Interest is only payable on the amount actually borrowed.

defs.def_en: You use actually to indicate that a situation exists or happened, or to emphasize that it is true.

defs.def_cn: （用于纠正他人或表示反对）实际上，事实上

ext.ext_cn: 不，我不是学生。实际上我是医生。
ext.ext_en: No, I'm not a student. I'm a doctor, actually...

ext.ext_cn: “那么这并不是一次家庭才艺表演了？”——“嗯，事实上我觉得这恰恰就是一次家庭才艺表演。”
ext.ext_en: 'So it's not a family show then?' —'Well, actually, I think that's exactly what it is.'

defs.def_en: You use actually when you are correcting or contradicting someone.

defs.def_cn: (礼貌地表达与他人的期待所不同的观点)说实在的，说真的

ext.ext_cn: “你认为和自己的病人交朋友的想法好吗？”——“说实在的，我认为很好，这个想法很棒。”
ext.ext_en: 'Do you think it's a good idea to socialize with one's patients?' — 'Actually, I do, I think it's a great idea.'

ext.ext_cn: 如果他要离开伯明翰，说真的，我会很惊讶。
ext.ext_en: I would be surprised, actually, if he left Birmingham.

defs.def_en: You can use actually when you are politely expressing an opinion that other people might not have expected from you.

ext.ext_cn: 这么说吧，约翰，我给你打电话是想得到些建议。
ext.ext_en: Well actually, John, I rang you for some advice...

ext.ext_cn: 这样吧，我们就只读你让他们偶遇这一小段吧。
ext.ext_en: Actually, let's just read this little bit where you've made them bump into each other.

defs.def_en: You use actually to introduce a new topic into a conversation.

defs.def_cn: （证券或股票）金边的，保险的，定期定息的
defs.def_en: Gilt-edged stocks or securities are issued by the government for people to invest in for a fixed period of time at a fixed rate of interest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 批评家说他就是愚蠢和任性。
ext.ext_en: His critics say he's just being silly and petulant...

ext.ext_cn: 他生气地拿起那支钢笔。
ext.ext_en: He picked the pen up with a petulant gesture.

defs.def_en: Someone who is petulant is unreasonably angry and upset in a childish way.
A wheelhouse is a small room or shelter on a ship or boat, where the wheel used for steering the boat is situated.

ext.ext_cn: 尸骨被刨出，移到了墓地。
ext.ext_en: The bones were disinterred and moved to a burial site.

defs.def_en: When a dead body is disinterred, it is dug up from out of the ground.

defs.def_cn: 使重现;使复活;再度使用(很久未用过的东西)

ext.ext_cn: 在电视广告中再度使用60年代经典灵歌的趋势
ext.ext_en: ...the trend for disinterring sixties soul classics for TV commercials.

defs.def_en: If you disinter something, you start using it again after it has not been used for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 美国不明飞行物目击事件激增。
ext.ext_en: There has been a surge of UFO sightings in America.

defs.def_en: A UFO is an object seen in the sky or landing on earth which cannot be identified and which is often believed to be from another planet. UFO is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'unidentified flying object'.

ext.ext_cn: 他凝视着雨点溅落在玻璃上。
ext.ext_en: He stared at the rain spattering on the glass...

ext.ext_cn: 轻轻地把鱼翻过来，小心别把滚烫的黄油溅到自己身上。
ext.ext_en: Gently turn the fish, being careful not to spatter any hot butter on yourself...

defs.def_en: If a liquid spatters a surface or you spatter a liquid over a surface, drops of the liquid fall on an area of the surface.

defs.def_cn: 使思维迟钝;使厌烦;使呆滞

ext.ext_cn: 这种态度会扼杀科学的进步。
ext.ext_en: This attitude stultifies scientific progress...

ext.ext_cn: 只有一名穿制服的无聊警卫可能偷听到了他们的谈话。
ext.ext_en: Only a uniformed guard stultified with boredom might have overheard them.

defs.def_en: If something stultifies you, it makes you feel empty or dull in your mind, because it is so boring.

ext.ext_cn: “我认为错在那些遴选者，”他说。
ext.ext_en: 'I blame the selectors,' quoth he.

defs.def_en: Quoth means 'said'. Quoth comes before the subject of the verb.
A shipyard is a place where ships are built and repaired.

ext.ext_cn: 装满三明治的柳编野餐篮
ext.ext_en: ...big wicker picnic baskets filled with sandwiches.

ext.ext_cn: 洗衣筐
ext.ext_en: ...a laundry basket.

defs.def_en: A basket is a stiff container that is used for carrying or storing objects. Baskets are made from thin strips of materials such as straw, plastic, or wire woven together.

defs.def_cn: （用于比较不同货币或商品价值的）一篮子，一组（货币或商品）

ext.ext_cn: 英镑对一篮子货币的比价创下76.9的新低。
ext.ext_en: The pound's value against a basket of currencies hit a new low of 76.9.

ext.ext_cn: 通过衡量固定的一组商品和服务的价格来测算通货膨胀的方法
ext.ext_en: ...an inflation measure that gauges the price of a fixed basket of goods and services.

defs.def_en: In economics, a basket of currencies or goods is the average or total value of a number of different currencies or goods.
In basketball, the basket is a net hanging from a ring through which players try to throw the ball in order to score points.

ext.ext_cn: 她烘制了烤饼和蛋糕供客人享用。
ext.ext_en: She makes scones and cakes for the delectation of visitors.

defs.def_en: If you do something for someone's delectation, you do it to give them enjoyment or pleasure.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 梦魇般的;令人毛骨悚然的;令人不愉快的

ext.ext_cn: 她描述了尸横街头、令人毛骨悚然的一幕。
ext.ext_en: She described a nightmarish scene of dead bodies lying in the streets.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as nightmarish, you mean that it is extremely frightening and unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可疑的;靠不住的;暧昧的

ext.ext_cn: 在我们看来这种说法非常可疑。
ext.ext_en: This claim seems to us to be rather dubious...

ext.ext_cn: 索霍区仍然是个靠不住的地方。
ext.ext_en: Soho was still a highly dubious area...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as dubious, you mean that you do not consider it to be completely honest, safe, or reliable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 怀疑的;无把握的;迟疑的;拿不准的

ext.ext_cn: 我父母起初对此心存疑虑,但是我们很快就让他们信服了。
ext.ext_en: My parents were dubious about it at first but we soon convinced them.

defs.def_en: If you are dubious about something, you are not completely sure about it and have not yet made up your mind about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （荣誉、名声等）不好的,不光彩的

ext.ext_cn: 纳吉作为第一个以这种方式被禁赛的运动员而“出名”。
ext.ext_en: Nagy has the dubious honour of being the first athlete to be banned in this way...

ext.ext_cn: 萨尔瓦多因是美洲大陆土壤侵蚀最严重的地方而有了这份不光彩的名声。
ext.ext_en: El Salvador has earned the dubious distinction of having the worst soil erosion in continental America.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has the dubious honour or the dubious pleasure of doing something, you are indicating that what they are doing is not an honour or pleasure at all, but is, in fact, unpleasant or bad.

defs.def_cn: (房间或房子的)色彩设计，色彩搭配

ext.ext_cn: 橄榄绿和芥末黄的时尚搭配
ext.ext_en: ...a stylish colour scheme of olive green and mustard.

defs.def_en: In a room or house, the colour scheme is the way in which colours have been used to decorate it.

defs.def_cn: 脱瘾治疗;戒毒（或酒）治疗
defs.def_en: Detoxification is treatment given to people who are addicted to drugs or alcohol in order to stop them from being addicted.

ext.ext_cn: 每天至少饮用2升无气矿泉水以帮助身体解毒。
ext.ext_en: Drink at least 2 litres of still mineral water throughout the day to aid detoxification.

defs.def_en: Detoxification is treatment that is intended to remove poisonous or harmful substances from your body.

ext.ext_cn: 把店关了就好了。
ext.ext_en: Just close up the shop...

ext.ext_cn: 这座消夏别墅关了整整一年。
ext.ext_en: The summer house had been closed up all year.

defs.def_en: If someone closes up a building, they shut it completely and securely, often because they are going away.

ext.ext_cn: 不要用冷水，那样会刺激血管闭合。
ext.ext_en: Don't use cold water as it shocks the blood vessels into closing up.

defs.def_en: If an opening, gap, or something hollow closes up, or if you close it up, it becomes closed or covered.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 爱说话的;话多的;健谈的

ext.ext_cn: 他的话突然多了起来，脸颊微微泛红，双眼明亮许多。
ext.ext_en: He suddenly became very talkative, his face slightly flushed, his eyes much brighter.

defs.def_en: Someone who is talkative talks a lot.

ext.ext_cn: 用木料、金属和玻璃制成的一件件家具
ext.ext_en: ...pieces of furniture in wood, metal and glass...

ext.ext_cn: 他的头撞在一根金属棒上。
ext.ext_en: He hit his head against a metal bar.

defs.def_en: See also:base metal;Metal is a hard substance such as iron, steel, gold, or lead.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （结构、家具）摇摇晃晃的，摇摇欲坠的，不牢固的

ext.ext_cn: 莫娜爬上了摇摇晃晃的木楼梯。
ext.ext_en: Mona climbed the rickety wooden stairway.

defs.def_en: A rickety structure or piece of furniture is not very strong or well made, and seems likely to collapse or break.

defs.def_cn: 改变，收回（原来的说法）；改口

ext.ext_cn: 政府渐渐地不再反对他出席伦敦会议。
ext.ext_en: The administration has been steadily rowing back from its early opposition to his attendance in London...

ext.ext_cn: 政府被迫取消了一项涉及削减工资的财政紧缩计划。
ext.ext_en: The government was forced to row back on an austerity plan that would have involved wage cuts.

defs.def_en: If you row back on something you have said or written, you express a different or contrary opinion about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们围着老师的椅子站成半圆形回答问题。
ext.ext_en: They stood in a semi-circle round the teacher's chair and answered questions.

defs.def_en: A semi-circle is one half of a circle, or something having the shape of half a circle.

A peace process consists of all the meetings, agreements, and negotiations in which people such as politicians are involved when they are trying to arrange peace between countries or groups that are fighting with each other.

defs.def_cn: 没有什么;没有一件(东西);没有一点

ext.ext_cn: 咖啡时间过后，我什么都没干。
ext.ext_en: I've done nothing much since coffee time...

ext.ext_cn: 皮尔逊先生说，他对妻子白天的生活习惯一无所知。
ext.ext_en: Mr Pearson said he knew nothing of his wife's daytime habits...

defs.def_en: Nothing means not a single thing, or not a single part of something.

defs.def_cn: 无关紧要的事物(或人);微不足道的事物(或人)

ext.ext_cn: 因为他一直不缺钱，所以这对他来说不算什么。
ext.ext_en: Because he had always had money it meant nothing to him...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然凶杀案的增加令人担忧，但和这个十年里接下来的几年将要发生的事相比却是小巫见大巫了。
ext.ext_en: While the increase in homicides is alarming, it is nothing compared to what is to come in the rest of the decade...

defs.def_en: You use nothing to indicate that something or someone is not important or significant.

defs.def_cn: 极低的价格;相当于免费

ext.ext_cn: 这件家具很破旧，显然他是白捡来的了。
ext.ext_en: The furniture was threadbare; he'd obviously picked it up for nothing...

ext.ext_cn: 曼图亚市这个位置的房子曾一度卖到35万美元，现在不值几个钱了。
ext.ext_en: Homes in this corner of Mantua that once went for $350,000 are now worth nothing.

defs.def_en: If you say that something cost nothing or is worth nothing, you are indicating that it cost or is worth a surprisingly small amount of money.

defs.def_cn: (用于形容词或带 to 的不定式前表示事物或人不具备所说的性质)没有什么，不是什么

ext.ext_cn: 湖四周的乡村总的来说没有什么特别的。
ext.ext_en: Around the lake the countryside generally is nothing special...

ext.ext_cn: 他没有什么特别之处。
ext.ext_en: There was nothing remarkable about him...

defs.def_en: You use nothing before an adjective or 'to'-infinitive to say that something or someone does not have the quality indicated.

defs.def_cn: (用于 so + 形容词、副词前或比较级前表示强调)没有别的东西，没有别的事情

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人对如何钻制度的空子学得最快。
ext.ext_en: Youngsters learn nothing so fast as how to beat the system...

ext.ext_cn: 我想我的生活中没什么比写歌更重要了。
ext.ext_en: I consider nothing more important in my life than songwriting...

defs.def_en: You can use nothing before 'so' and an adjective or adverb, or before a comparative, to emphasize how strong or great a particular quality is.

defs.def_cn: 要么彻底干完，要么根本不干

ext.ext_cn: 他要么把这件事做完，要么就不做，只有这两种选择。
ext.ext_en: Either he went through with this thing or he did not; it was all or nothing.

defs.def_en: You can use all or nothing to say that either something must be done fully and completely or else it cannot be done at all.

ext.ext_cn: 毕竟，锻炼15分钟比不锻炼好。
ext.ext_en: After all, 15 minutes of exercise is better than nothing.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is better than nothing, you mean that it is not what is required, but that it is better to have that thing than to have nothing at all.

defs.def_cn: (用于名词、不带 to 的不定式或 -ing 形式前)只有，仅仅

ext.ext_cn: 钱带来的只是悲伤、痛苦和灾难。
ext.ext_en: All that money brought nothing but sadness and misery and tragedy...

ext.ext_cn: 这只是让我们显得很滑稽。
ext.ext_en: It did nothing but make us ridiculous...

defs.def_en: You use nothing but in front of a noun, an infinitive without 'to', or an '-ing' form to mean 'only'.

ext.ext_cn: 现在付钱，否则不行。
ext.ext_en: Pay now, or nothing doing...

ext.ext_cn: “我可以坐地铁，然后让戴维到车站接我。”——“不行。”
ext.ext_en: 'I could take the subway and have David pick me up at the station.' — 'Nothing doing.'

defs.def_en: You can say 'Nothing doing' when you want to say that something is not happening or cannot be done.

ext.ext_cn: 很大程度上取决于你选择哪种配料。除了亲口品尝和动手尝试外，没有别的方法。
ext.ext_en: Much depends on which individual ingredients you choose. There is nothing for it but to taste and to experiment for yourself...

ext.ext_cn: 他真希望自己的房间离卫生间不那么远，没别的办法，只能走上长长的一段穿过屋子。
ext.ext_en: He wished he was not in a room so far from the bathroom. There was nothing for it but a long trudge through the house.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is nothing for it but to take a particular action, you mean that it is the only possible course of action that you can take, even though it might be unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 菲什教授一贯表现出很高的职业水准。
ext.ext_en: Professor Fish has been nothing if not professional...

ext.ext_cn: 好莱坞是极有创造力的地方，尤其是如果有人肯埋单的话。
ext.ext_en: Hollywood is nothing if not creative, especially if someone else will pick up the bills.

defs.def_en: You use nothing if not in front of an adjective to indicate that someone or something clearly has a lot of the particular quality mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: “谢谢你招待了这么美味的晚餐。”——“这没什么，”萨拉说。
ext.ext_en: 'Thank you for the wonderful dinner.' — 'It's nothing,' Sarah said...

ext.ext_cn: “艾伦，我要走了。真不知该怎么感谢你。”——“小事情，多保重。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'll be on my way. I can't thank you enough, Alan.' — 'It was nothing, but take care.'

defs.def_en: People sometimes say 'It's nothing' as a polite response after someone has thanked them for something they have done.

ext.ext_cn: 这都是废话和迷信，不是真的。
ext.ext_en: It's all rubbish and superstition, and there's nothing in it.

defs.def_en: If you say about a story or report that there is nothing in it or nothing to it, you mean that it is untrue.

ext.ext_cn: 这个装置有一个能拧开瓶盖的电动钳子，并不复杂。
ext.ext_en: This device has a gripper that electrically twists off the jar top. Nothing to it...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你过去不敢做烤薄饼的话，现在别迟疑了，真是一点儿都不费事!
ext.ext_en: If you've shied away from making pancakes in the past, don't be put off — there's really nothing in it!

defs.def_en: If you say about an activity that there is nothing to it or nothing in it, you mean that it is extremely easy.

defs.def_cn: (比赛或竞争中)水平不相上下，势均力敌
defs.def_en: If you say about a contest or competition that there is nothing in it, you mean that two or more of the competitors are level and have an equal chance of winning.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调，表示事情让人吃惊或重要)简直，全然

ext.ext_cn: 他头脑中所想的简直就是对管理人员传统角色的彻底颠覆。
ext.ext_en: What he had in mind amounted to nothing less than a total reversal of the traditional role of the executive...

ext.ext_cn: 你简直就是凶手！
ext.ext_en: You're nothing less than a murderer!

defs.def_en: You can use nothing less than to emphasize your next words, often indicating that something seems very surprising or important.

defs.def_cn: 并非没有道理;事出有因

ext.ext_cn: 这种飞机被称作“寡妇机”是事出有因的。
ext.ext_en: Not for nothing was the plane called 'The widow-maker'...

ext.ext_cn: 全世界的室内设计师都希望从英国乡村花园汲取美妙的灵感，这并非没有道理。
ext.ext_en: It's not for nothing that interior decorators the world over look to the English country garden for glorious inspiration.

defs.def_en: If you say that it was not for nothing that something happened, you are emphasizing that there was a very good reason for it to happen.

defs.def_cn: 不付代价的收益;不劳而获

ext.ext_cn: 你的问题是你认为自己可以不劳而获。
ext.ext_en: What's wrong with you is that you think you can get something for nothing.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is getting something for nothing, you disapprove of the fact that they are getting what they want without doing or giving anything in return.

ext.ext_cn: “我们打算到我办公室把这件事谈个明白。”——“我们决不同意这么做。”
ext.ext_en: 'We're going to talk this over in my office.'—'We're going to do nothing of the sort.'...

ext.ext_cn: 亚当森夫人说她深感抱歉，但她的语气清楚地让人感到她毫无歉意。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Adamson said that she was extremely sorry, in tones that made it clear that she was nothing of the sort.

defs.def_en: Nothing of the sort is used when strongly contradicting something that has just been said.
Prozac is a drug that is used to treat people who are suffering from depression.

ext.ext_cn: 我朝母鸡扔卵石，吓得它们乱跳乱叫。
ext.ext_en: I threw pebbles at the hens, and that made them jump and squawk.

ext.ext_cn: 一只绿头鸭突然飞起，愤怒地尖鸣一声直冲天空。
ext.ext_en: A mallard suddenly took wing, rising steeply into the air with an angry squawk.

defs.def_en: When a bird squawks, it makes a loud harsh noise.

ext.ext_cn: 阿伯先生大声抱怨说这笔交易是个骗局。
ext.ext_en: Mr Arbor squawked that the deal was a double-cross...

ext.ext_cn: “等等我！”梅拉尼粗声抗议道，“我不想一个人呆在这里。”
ext.ext_en: 'Wait for me!' Melanie squawked. 'I'm not staying here alone.'

defs.def_en: If a person squawks, they complain loudly, often in a high-pitched, harsh tone.

ext.ext_cn: “非常令人难堪，”他开口道，然后停顿了一下。
ext.ext_en: 'It's rather embarrassing,' he began, and paused...

ext.ext_cn: 他不得不停顿一下清清嗓子。
ext.ext_en: He had to pause to clear his throat...

defs.def_en: If you pause while you are doing something, you stop for a short period and then continue.

ext.ext_cn: 歇了一会儿后，亚历克斯毫不客气地说：“要是让你心烦了，那我很抱歉。”
ext.ext_en: After a pause Alex said sharply: 'I'm sorry if I've upset you'...

ext.ext_cn: 酒吧女招待在我们面前摆放两个盘子时停顿了一下。
ext.ext_en: There was a pause while the barmaid set down two plates in front of us.

defs.def_en: A pause is a short period when you stop doing something before continuing.

ext.ext_cn: 反对派发言人说他希望协议能够让他们仔细想想暴力行为毫无意义。
ext.ext_en: An opposition spokesman said he hoped the agreement would give them pause for thought about the futility of violence.

defs.def_en: If something gives you pause for thought, it makes you think carefully about something, especially in a different way than you have thought about it before.

ext.ext_cn: 工作人员会很乐意为您安排游泳、航行或是滑水等活动。
ext.ext_en: The staff will be happy to help arrange for you to swim, sail, or water-ski.

defs.def_en: If you water-ski, you stand on skis in the water while being pulled along by a boat.

ext.ext_cn: 飞行员稍稍减速，以保持水平飞行。
ext.ext_en: The pilot throttles back slightly to maintain level flight...

ext.ext_cn: 他快步来到控制台跟前，减小了油门。
ext.ext_en: He stepped swiftly to the controls to throttle back the engine.

defs.def_en: If you throttle back, or you throttle back the engine, when driving a motor vehicle or flying an aircraft, you make it go slower by reducing the quantity of fuel entering the engine.

ext.ext_cn: 我说了声抱歉，跑回到电话机旁。
ext.ext_en: I excused myself and ran back to the telephone...

ext.ext_cn: 警方认为持枪的歹徒逃到树林里去了。
ext.ext_en: Police believe the gunmen ran off into the woods...

defs.def_en: When you run, you move more quickly than when you walk, for example because you are in a hurry to get somewhere, or for exercise.

ext.ext_cn: 当我参加纽约的马拉松比赛时
ext.ext_en: ...when I was running in the New York Marathon...

ext.ext_cn: 菲莉丝·史密斯控制好速度，用51.32秒跑完了比赛，获得了参赛资格。
ext.ext_en: Phyllis Smith ran a controlled race to qualify in 51.32 sec.

defs.def_en: When someone runs in a race, they run in competition with other people.

ext.ext_cn: 主人坚持要让“酷地”参加金杯赛马会。
ext.ext_en: The owner insisted on Cool Ground running in the Gold Cup...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们遇上持续下雨，塞西尔也能让“扈从”参加德比马赛。
ext.ext_en: If we have a wet spell, Cecil could also run Armiger in the Derby.

defs.def_en: When a horse runs in a race or when its owner runs it, it competes in a race.

ext.ext_cn: 穿过山毛榉林的阳光斑驳的小路
ext.ext_en: ...the sun-dappled trail which ran through the beech woods.

ext.ext_cn: 中部有一根延展的细金属丝的充满气体的玻璃管
ext.ext_en: ...a gas-filled glass tube with a thin wire running down the centre...

defs.def_en: If you say that something long, such as a road, runs in a particular direction, you are describing its course or position. You can also say that something runs the length or width of something else.

defs.def_cn: 安装(电线、管道等);布线;使（电线、管道等）通过

ext.ext_cn: 我们的主人从房里牵出一根延长电线，架起屏幕和投影仪。
ext.ext_en: Our host ran a long extension cord out from the house and set up a screen and a projector.

defs.def_en: If you run a wire or tube somewhere, you fix it or pull it from, to, or across a particular place.

ext.ext_cn: 他笑了，用手指拢了拢他的头发。
ext.ext_en: He laughed and ran his fingers through his hair...

ext.ext_cn: 我用刷子刷了一下头发，冲了出去。
ext.ext_en: I ran the brush through my hair and dashed out...

defs.def_en: If you run your hand or an object through something, you move your hand or the object through it.

defs.def_cn: 使通过(机器、过程或测试)

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经尽力搜集了数据，并将它们输入了自己的计算机。
ext.ext_en: They have gathered the best statistics they can find and run them through their own computers.

defs.def_en: If you run something through a machine, process, or series of tests, you make it go through the machine, process, or tests.

ext.ext_cn: 去年2月，他才宣布自己将参加总统竞选。
ext.ext_en: It was only last February that he announced he would run for president...

ext.ext_cn: 和俄亥俄州的民主党参议员约翰·格伦竞选绝非易事。
ext.ext_en: It is no easy job to run against John Glenn, Ohio's Democratic senator...

defs.def_en: If someone runs for office in an election, they take part as a candidate.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经开始为参选总统做准备了。
ext.ext_en: He was already preparing his run for the presidency.

defs.def_en: A run for office is an attempt to be elected to office.

ext.ext_cn: 他的继父经营着一家生意红火的涂料公司。
ext.ext_en: His stepfather ran a prosperous paint business...

ext.ext_cn: 这是治国之道吗？
ext.ext_en: Is this any way to run a country?...

defs.def_en: If you run something such as a business or an activity, you are in charge of it or you organize it.

ext.ext_cn: 负责这些营地的官员们说现在这一体系运转得非常顺利。
ext.ext_en: Officials in charge of the camps say the system is now running extremely smoothly.

ext.ext_cn: 保证银行正常运营的员工
ext.ext_en: ...the staff who have kept the bank running.

defs.def_en: If you talk about how a system, an organization, or someone's life is running, you are saying how well it is operating or progressing.

ext.ext_cn: 他进行了多项检查，最后证明我感染了支原体。
ext.ext_en: He ran a lot of tests and it turned out I had an infection called mycoplasma...

ext.ext_cn: 你可以在程序运行期间，逐条输入命令以对程序进行检查。
ext.ext_en: You can check your program one command at a time while it's running.

defs.def_en: If you run an experiment, computer program, or other process, or start it running, you start it and let it continue.

ext.ext_cn: 他又按下了播放键播放磁带。
ext.ext_en: He pushed the play button again and ran the tape...

ext.ext_cn: 磁带已经转到头了，但是什么也没录上。
ext.ext_en: The tape had run to the end but recorded nothing.

defs.def_en: When you run a cassette or video tape or when it runs, it moves through the machine as the machine operates.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有意识到录音机还在录。
ext.ext_en: He had failed to realise that the tape recorder was still running...

ext.ext_cn: 我们告诉他在外边等着，不要熄火。
ext.ext_en: We told him to wait out front with the engine running.

defs.def_en: When a machine is running or when you are running it, it is switched on and is working.

defs.def_cn: (机器或设备靠某种能源)运转，开动

ext.ext_cn: 黑色的出租车使用柴油。
ext.ext_en: Black cabs run on diesel...

ext.ext_cn: 数排摊位都让位给了使用煤气罐的饭店。
ext.ext_en: Rows of stalls are given over to restaurants running off gas cylinders.

defs.def_en: A machine or equipment that runs on or off a particular source of energy functions using that source of energy.

ext.ext_cn: 我从1977年到1983年一直开着一辆1960年产的罗孚100。
ext.ext_en: I ran a 1960 Rover 100 from 1977 until 1983.

defs.def_en: If you run a car or a piece of equipment, you have it and use it.

defs.def_cn: (火车、公交车等沿固定路线)行驶

ext.ext_cn: 一辆区间公交车频繁地往返于这家旅馆和那个乡村俱乐部。
ext.ext_en: A shuttle bus runs frequently between the Inn and the Country Club.

ext.ext_cn: 不能让火车准点运行的政府
ext.ext_en: ...a government which can't make the trains run on time.

defs.def_en: When you say that vehicles such as trains and buses run from one place to another, you mean they regularly travel along that route.

ext.ext_cn: 你能开车送我到巴尔的摩吗？
ext.ext_en: Could you run me up to Baltimore?

defs.def_en: If you run someone somewhere in a car, you drive them there.

ext.ext_cn: 我会开车去肖特山看看亚当斯夫人。
ext.ext_en: I'll run over to Short Mountain and check on Mrs Adams.

defs.def_en: If you run over or down to a place that is quite near, you drive there.

ext.ext_cn: 南安普敦之行表明这辆车还是挺能跑的。
ext.ext_en: A run to Southampton showed the car was capable of a reasonable journey.

ext.ext_cn: 早上去学校
ext.ext_en: ...doing the morning school run.

defs.def_en: A run is a journey somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 泪水滑过她的脸庞。
ext.ext_en: Tears were running down her cheeks...

ext.ext_cn: 雨水顺着城堡的墙壁流下时会流入蓄水池。
ext.ext_en: There were cisterns to catch rainwater as it ran off the castle walls...

defs.def_en: If a liquid runs in a particular direction, it flows in that direction.

ext.ext_cn: 她走到水槽边，把空玻璃杯灌上水。
ext.ext_en: She went to the sink and ran water into her empty glass...

ext.ext_cn: 他们听见他打开了厨房里的水龙头。
ext.ext_en: They heard him running the kitchen tap...

defs.def_en: If you run water, or if you run a tap or a bath, you cause water to flow from a tap.

ext.ext_cn: 你肯定忘了关浴室的龙头了。
ext.ext_en: You must have left a tap running in the bathroom...

ext.ext_cn: 他完全清醒了，听见浴缸里的水在流。
ext.ext_en: He came fully awake to hear the bath running.

defs.def_en: If a tap or a bath is running, water is coming out of a tap.

ext.ext_cn: 蒂莫西正在哭泣，主要是因为太累了，而且他还流着鼻涕。
ext.ext_en: Timothy was crying, mostly from exhaustion, and his nose was running.

defs.def_en: If your nose is running, liquid is flowing out of it, usually because you have a cold.

ext.ext_cn: 一个小时后，他发现自己已经大汗淋漓了。
ext.ext_en: After an hour he realised he was completely running with sweat...

ext.ext_cn: 凝结的水珠在窗玻璃上流动。
ext.ext_en: The window panes were running with condensation.

defs.def_en: If a surface is running with a liquid, that liquid is flowing down it.

ext.ext_cn: 墨迹在湿纸上浸开了。
ext.ext_en: The ink had run on the wet paper.

defs.def_en: If the dye in some cloth or the ink on some paper runs, it comes off or spreads when the cloth or paper gets wet.

ext.ext_cn: 她突然觉得浑身激动。
ext.ext_en: She felt a surge of excitement run through her...

ext.ext_cn: 各种各样的想法在我的脑海里闪过。
ext.ext_en: All sorts of thoughts were running through my head.

defs.def_en: If a feeling runs through your body or a thought runs through your mind, you experience it or think it quickly.

defs.def_cn: （感觉或吵闹声）扩散，弥漫，传遍

ext.ext_cn: 一时间群情激昂。
ext.ext_en: A buzz of excitement ran through the crowd.

defs.def_en: If a feeling or noise runs through a group of people, it spreads among them.

ext.ext_cn: 另一条贯穿这部连续剧的主线是医生在治疗精神病患者中起到的作用。
ext.ext_en: Another thread running through this series is the role of doctors in the treatment of the mentally ill...

ext.ext_cn: 贯穿全书始终的主题
ext.ext_en: ...the theme running through the book...

defs.def_en: If a theme or feature runs through something such as someone's actions or writing, it is present in all of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这份报纸刊登了4篇社论连载，题为《我们生活的选择》。
ext.ext_en: The newspaper ran a series of four editorials entitled 'The Choice of Our Lives.'

ext.ext_cn: 本周末刊登的题为《科莫先生退出了》的社论
ext.ext_en: ...an editorial that ran this weekend entitled 'Mr. Cuomo Backs Out.'

defs.def_en: When newspapers or magazines run a particular item or story or if it runs, it is published or printed.

ext.ext_cn: “喔，我要去巴巴多斯!”一首20世纪70年代流行歌曲这样欢快地唱道。
ext.ext_en: 'Whoa, I'm goin' to Barbay-dos!' ran the jaunty lyrics of a 1970s hit song.

defs.def_en: You can use run to indicate that you are quoting someone else's words or ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 今天的零售物价指数显示通货膨胀率为10.9％。
ext.ext_en: Today's RPI figure shows inflation running at 10.9 per cent...

ext.ext_cn: 现在，每年的赤字约达3亿美元。
ext.ext_en: The deficit is now running at about 300 million dollars a year.

defs.def_en: If an amount is running at a particular level, it is at that level.

ext.ext_cn: 它得到了评论家们的好评，但只在伦敦西区上映了3年的时间。
ext.ext_en: It pleased critics but ran for only three years in the West End...

ext.ext_cn: 这份合同在1992年至2020年间有效。
ext.ext_en: The contract was to run from 1992 to 2020...

defs.def_en: If a play, event, or legal contract runs for a particular period of time, it lasts for that period of time.

defs.def_cn: 占用(多于、等于或少于预定的时间)

ext.ext_cn: 告诉她我过会儿会给她回电话，我又要晚了。
ext.ext_en: Tell her I'll call her back later, I'm running late again...

ext.ext_cn: 组织者会告诉你活动是如期举行还是会提前。
ext.ext_en: The steward will be able to tell you whether the event is running to time or is ahead of schedule.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is running late, they have taken more time than had been planned. If they are running to time or ahead of time, they have taken the time planned or less than the time planned.

ext.ext_cn: 这个小女孩发烧了，需要帮助。
ext.ext_en: The little girl is running a fever and she needs help.

defs.def_en: If you are running a temperature or a fever, you have a high temperature because you are ill.

defs.def_cn: (演出或电视节目的)上映期，放映期

ext.ext_cn: 演出在伯明翰上映一个月后，将于10月9日转到伦敦西区。
ext.ext_en: The show will transfer to the West End on October 9, after a month's run in Birmingham...

ext.ext_cn: 同时，达斯蒂·斯普林菲尔德的电视剧新作开始在BBC1台播放。
ext.ext_en: Meanwhile, Dusty Springfield's new TV series began a run on BBC 1.

defs.def_en: A run of a play or television programme is the period of time during which performances are given or programmes are shown.

defs.def_cn: 一系列，一连串(成功或失败等)

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队的队长得了一连串的低分。
ext.ext_en: The England skipper is haunted by a run of low scores...

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰保守党人一直好运连连。
ext.ext_en: The Scottish Tories' run of luck is holding.

defs.def_en: A run of successes or failures is a series of successes or failures.

defs.def_cn: 额定产量;单次生产数额

ext.ext_cn: 韦恩打算将印量增加到1,000册。
ext.ext_en: Wayne plans to increase the print run to 1,000...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的国防市场太小，就经济可行性而言不足以维持生产。
ext.ext_en: Their defense markets are too small to sustain economically viable production runs.

defs.def_en: A run of a product is the amount that a company or factory decides to produce at one time.

defs.def_cn: (板球或棒球运动中击球后跑动得到的)一分

ext.ext_cn: 他20岁时就成为了在一个赛季中获得2,000分的最年轻的选手。
ext.ext_en: At 20 he became the youngest player to score 2,000 runs in a season.

defs.def_en: In cricket or baseball, a run is a score of one, which is made by players running between marked places on the field after hitting the ball.

defs.def_cn: 自由出入的权力;随意使用的权力

ext.ext_cn: 他可以随意使用这座房子和游泳池。
ext.ext_en: He had the run of the house and the pool.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you the run of a place, they give you permission to go where you like in it and use it as you wish.

ext.ext_cn: 当时非同寻常的专业运动员
ext.ext_en: ...a man who was outside the common run of professional athletes at the time.

ext.ext_cn: 努力做好维修工的同时还写一个专栏
ext.ext_en: ...trying to accomplish the usual run of maintenance jobs and write a column too.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is different from the average run or common run of people or things, you mean that they are different from ordinary people or things.

ext.ext_cn: 对英镑的抢购已经完全扼杀了降低汇率的希望。
ext.ext_en: A run on sterling has killed off hopes of a rate cut...

ext.ext_cn: 民众信心的丧失可能导致花旗银行出现挤兑，从而威胁到整个金融体系。
ext.ext_en: Loss of confidence could trigger a run on Citibank that would threaten the entire financial system.

defs.def_en: If there is a run on something, a lot of people want to buy it or get it at the same time.
A ski run or bobsleigh run is a course or route that has been designed for skiing or for riding in a bobsleigh.

defs.def_cn: 爆冷门;逆转局势;出乎意料

ext.ext_cn: 这个决定性的得分逆转了场上的局势。
ext.ext_en: The decisive goal arrived against the run of play...

ext.ext_cn: 工人社会党逆转乾坤，出乎意料地以较大优势获得了星期天大选的胜利。
ext.ext_en: Against the run of the polls, the Socialist Workers' Party won Sunday's general election by an unexpectedly large margin.

defs.def_en: If something happens against the run of play or against the run of events, it is different from what is generally happening in a game or situation.

defs.def_cn: （比赛或竞争中）几乎击败，和…相差无几

ext.ext_cn: 在这个赛季中，21岁以下代表队已经打败了威尔士队和苏格兰队，和英格兰队的比分也非常接近。
ext.ext_en: The Under-21 team has defeated Wales and Scotland this season, and ran England very close...

ext.ext_cn: 该党派至少在一个郡获胜，而在其他几个郡也和第一名相距甚微。
ext.ext_en: The party won at least one county, and ran a close second in several others.

defs.def_en: If you run someone close ,run them a close second, or run a close second, you almost beat them in a race or competition.

ext.ext_cn: 记忆中，小溪第一次干涸了。
ext.ext_en: Streams had run dry for the first time in memory.

defs.def_en: If a river or well runs dry, it no longer has any water in it. If an oil well runs dry, it no longer produces any oil.

defs.def_cn: (信息或金钱的来源)枯竭，用完

ext.ext_cn: 才投产3天凑集的钱就用光了。
ext.ext_en: Three days into production, the kitty had run dry.

defs.def_en: If a source of information or money runs dry, no more information or money can be obtained from it.

ext.ext_cn: 家族遗传的精神错乱困扰着他。
ext.ext_en: The insanity which ran in his family haunted him.

defs.def_en: If a characteristic runs in someone's family, it often occurs in members of that family, in different generations.

ext.ext_cn: 当其中一个匪徒逃跑的时候，一架直升机在空中盘旋。
ext.ext_en: A helicopter hovered overhead as one of the gang made a run for it...

ext.ext_cn: 科迪，快出去，快跑。
ext.ext_en: Cody, get out, run for it.

defs.def_en: If you make a run for it or if you run for it, you run away in order to escape from someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 上周的谋杀案发生后，那里的人们群情激愤。
ext.ext_en: Feelings there have been running high in the wake of last week's killing.

defs.def_en: If people's feelings are running high, they are very angry, concerned, or excited.

defs.def_cn: 从长远来看/从短期来看

ext.ext_cn: 有时昂贵的药物或其他治疗方法从长远来看可能是比较划算的。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes expensive drugs or other treatments can be economical in the long run...

ext.ext_cn: 事实上，事情在短期内可能会变得更加糟糕。
ext.ext_en: In fact, things could get worse in the short run.

defs.def_en: If you talk about what will happen in the long run, you are saying what you think will happen over a long period of time in the future. If you talk about what will happen in the short run, you are saying what you think will happen in the near future.

defs.def_cn: （因害怕而）躲得远远的，极力逃避

ext.ext_cn: 亚丝明承认如果马克约她出去的话，她会极力躲避。
ext.ext_en: Yasmin admits she would run a mile if Mark asked her out.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone would run a mile if faced with something, you mean that they are very frightened of it and would try to avoid it.

ext.ext_cn: 当下甚至能和梅丽尔·斯特里普媲美的一位年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...a youngster who even now could give Meryl Streep a run for her money.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone could give someone else a run for their money, you mean you think they are almost as good as the other person.

ext.ext_cn: 15岁的丹尼从地方当局的收容所逃跑了。
ext.ext_en: Fifteen-year-old Danny is on the run from a local authority home.

defs.def_en: If someone is on the run, they are trying to escape or hide from someone such as the police or an enemy.

defs.def_cn: (在比赛中)彻底落败，遭受挫败

ext.ext_cn: 对手认为他必败无疑。
ext.ext_en: His opponents believe he is definitely on the run...

ext.ext_cn: 我知道我彻底打败了他。
ext.ext_en: I knew I had him on the run.

defs.def_en: If someone is on the run, they are being severely defeated in a contest or competition.

ext.ext_cn: 管理部门的人吓坏了。
ext.ext_en: The administration is running scared.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or group is running scared, you mean that they are frightened of what someone might do to them or what might happen.

ext.ext_cn: 政府军队的弹药和燃料都所剩无几了。
ext.ext_en: Government forces are running short of ammunition and fuel...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的饮用水不多了。
ext.ext_en: We are running low on drinking water...

defs.def_en: If you are running short of something or running low on something, you do not have much of it left. If a supply of something is running short or running low, there is not much of it left.

defs.def_cn: 忏悔星期二(基督教大斋期首日的前一天，人们按照传统会吃薄饼)
defs.def_en: Shrove Tuesday is the Tuesday before Ash Wednesday. People traditionally eat pancakes on Shrove Tuesday.
If you tell someone to keep their pecker up, you are encouraging them to be cheerful in a difficult situation.
A man's pecker is his penis.

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲十分敬仰艾森豪威尔将军。
ext.ext_en: My father venerated General Eisenhower.

defs.def_en: If you venerate someone or something, you value them or feel great respect for them.

ext.ext_cn: 一张胶合板
ext.ext_en: ...a sheet of plywood.

defs.def_en: Plywood is wood that consists of thin layers of wood stuck together.
A garbage collector is a person whose job is to take people's garbage away.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 发达国家必须认识到世界范围内的贫富差距正在不断扩大。
ext.ext_en: The developed nations have to recognize the growing gap between rich and poor around the world...

ext.ext_cn: 这一匮乏在欠发达国家不可避免。
ext.ext_en: This scarcity is inevitable in less developed countries.

defs.def_en: If you talk about developed countries or the developed world, you mean the countries or the parts of the world that are wealthy and have many industries.

defs.def_cn: 过高估计（数量、重要性等）

ext.ext_cn: 事后看来，他高估了他们对和平的渴望。
ext.ext_en: With hindsight, he was overestimating their desire for peace.

ext.ext_cn: 东南地区的平均收入约为9,000英镑，虽然这可能是一个偏高的估计。
ext.ext_en: Average earnings in the South East were about £9,000, although that may be an overestimate.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone overestimates something, you mean that they think it is greater in amount or importance than it really is.

ext.ext_cn: 参与国家生活的重要性再怎么说都不为过。
ext.ext_en: The importance of participating in the life of the country cannot be overestimated...

ext.ext_cn: 这一工艺的潜在收益不可估量。
ext.ext_en: It is hard to overestimate the potential gains from this process.

defs.def_en: If you say that something cannot be overestimated, you are emphasizing that you think it is very important.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为你高估我了，弗雷德。
ext.ext_en: I think you overestimate me, Fred.

defs.def_en: If you overestimate someone, you think that they have more of a skill or quality than they really have.
Tarragon is a European herb with narrow leaves which are used to add flavour to food.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻信的；易受骗的；易上当的

ext.ext_cn: 承认向轻信媒体的公众提供了不实报道有何意义呢？
ext.ext_en: What point is there in admitting that the stories fed to the gullible public were false?...

ext.ext_cn: 我很容易上当，可能会相信他的话。
ext.ext_en: I'm so gullible I would have believed him.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as gullible, you mean they are easily tricked because they are too trusting.

ext.ext_cn: 警方逮捕了与其中一次袭击有关的5名青年男子。
ext.ext_en: Police arrested five young men in connection with one of the attacks...

ext.ext_cn: 警方称有7人因轻罪被捕。
ext.ext_en: The police say seven people were arrested for minor offences.

defs.def_en: If the police arrest you, they take charge of you and take you to a police station, because they believe you may have committed a crime.

ext.ext_cn: 患者可能必须对生活习惯作出重大调整以控制病情。
ext.ext_en: The sufferer may have to make major changes in his or her life to arrest the disease...

ext.ext_cn: 如果草率施行，该法律将会阻滞高质量研究的进展。
ext.ext_en: The law could arrest the development of good research if applied prematurely.

defs.def_en: If something or someone arrests a process, they stop it continuing.

ext.ext_cn: 天才建筑师的作品无论残留多少都能最大限度地吸引眼球。
ext.ext_en: The work of an architect of genius always arrests the attention no matter how little remains...

ext.ext_cn: 他跟随她到了大厅，看见了吸引她注意的东西。
ext.ext_en: As he reached the hall after her, he saw what had arrested her.

defs.def_en: If something interesting or surprising arrests your attention, you suddenly notice it and then continue to look at it or consider it carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 随着世界变得日益复杂，某些事物确实理所当然地规范化和全球化了。
ext.ext_en: As the world becomes more complex, some things do, of course, standardize and globalize...

ext.ext_cn: 由于业务全球化的成本太高，公司将进行合并。
ext.ext_en: Companies will come together because of the sheer costs involved in globalising their businesses.

defs.def_en: When industry globalizes or is globalized, companies from one country link with companies from another country in order to do business with them.

ext.ext_cn: 奥萝拉感觉自己被笼罩在鸦片烟霾中。
ext.ext_en: Aurora felt the opium haze enfold her...

ext.ext_cn: 伍德正舒服地穿着件羊毛晨衣。
ext.ext_en: Wood was now comfortably enfolded in a woolly dressing-gown.

defs.def_en: If something enfolds an object or person, they cover, surround, or are wrapped around that object or person.

ext.ext_cn: 撒克走到他身后，伸开双臂拥抱他。
ext.ext_en: Thack came up behind him, enfolding him in his arms.

defs.def_en: If you enfold someone or something, you hold them close in a very gentle, loving way.
Buggery is anal intercourse.

ext.ext_cn: 购票需提前7天，并确定往返日期。
ext.ext_en: Tickets must be bought seven days in advance, with outward and return journey dates specified.

defs.def_en: An outward journey is a journey that you make away from a place that you are intending to return to later.

ext.ext_cn: 我外表看似镇定，实则吓得不轻。
ext.ext_en: In spite of my outward calm I was very shaken...

ext.ext_cn: 军事统治者所做的只是为了恢复表面上的秩序。
ext.ext_en: What the military rulers have done is to restore the outward appearance of order.

defs.def_en: The outward feelings, qualities, or attitudes of someone or something are the ones they appear to have rather than the ones that they actually have.

ext.ext_cn: 马克躺在那儿昏迷不醒，但看不出受伤的迹象。
ext.ext_en: Mark was lying unconscious but with no outward sign of injury.

defs.def_en: The outward features of something are the ones that you can see from the outside.

ext.ext_cn: 有人扔了一个苹果核。
ext.ext_en: Someone threw an apple core...

ext.ext_cn: 将梨削皮去核。
ext.ext_en: Peel the pears and remove the cores.

defs.def_en: The core of a fruit is the central part of it. It contains seeds or pips.

defs.def_cn: 去掉…的果心;给（水果）去核

ext.ext_cn: 苹果削皮去核机
ext.ext_en: ...machines for peeling and coring apples.

defs.def_en: If you core a fruit, you remove its core.

defs.def_cn: (物体、建筑物或城市的)中心部分

ext.ext_cn: 地核
ext.ext_en: ...the earth's core...

ext.ext_cn: 市中心是一座接一座古老的广场。
ext.ext_en: The core of the city is a series of ancient squares.

defs.def_en: The core of an object, building, or city is the central part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 直击问题要害的能力
ext.ext_en: ...the ability to get straight to the core of a problem...

ext.ext_cn: 黑人总爱惹事这一观念是种族主义论断的核心。
ext.ext_en: The notion that blacks comprise a problem is at the core of racist reasoning.

defs.def_en: The core of something such as a problem or an issue is the part of it that has to be understood or accepted before the whole thing can be understood or dealt with.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的骨干团队已经就位了。
ext.ext_en: We already have our core team in place...

ext.ext_cn: 由大约6名职员组成的骨干队伍将继续该项目。
ext.ext_en: A core of about six staff would continue with the project.

defs.def_en: A core team or a core group is a group of people who do the main part of a job or piece of work. Other people may also help, but only for limited periods of time.

ext.ext_cn: 基础课是英文、数学和科学。
ext.ext_en: The core subjects are English, mathematics and science...

ext.ext_cn: 原则上我不反对设置基础课程，但我认为要求掌握一门外语是不现实的。
ext.ext_en: I'm not opposed to a core curriculum in principle, but I think requiring a foreign language is unrealistic.

defs.def_en: In a school or college, core subjects are a group of subjects that have to be studied.

ext.ext_cn: 地方政府的主要事务进行了调整。
ext.ext_en: The core activities of local authorities were reorganised...

ext.ext_cn: 该集团打算主营6种业务。
ext.ext_en: The group plans to concentrate on six core  businesses...

defs.def_en: The core businesses or the core activities of a company or organization are their most important ones.

ext.ext_cn: 那些村民是十足的保皇主义者。
ext.ext_en: The villagers are royalist to the core.

defs.def_en: You can use to the core to describe someone who is a very strong supporter of someone or something and will never change their views. For example, you can say that someone is Republican to the core .

ext.ext_cn: 伦纳德极为震惊;他从未看过或读过这样的东西。
ext.ext_en: Leonard was shaken to the core; he'd never seen or read anything like it.

defs.def_en: If someone is shaken to the core or shocked to the core, they are extremely shaken or shocked.
The master bedroom in a large house is the largest bedroom.

ext.ext_cn: 利用民众惧变心理的竞选活动
ext.ext_en: ...an election campaign which plays on the population's fear of change...

ext.ext_cn: 我说这话是利用了她的慷慨，对此我感到愧疚。
ext.ext_en: I felt guilty saying that, playing on her generosity.

defs.def_en: If you play on someone's fears, weaknesses, or faults, you deliberately use them in order to persuade that person to do something, or to achieve what you want.

defs.def_cn: 上帝般的；如神明的；神圣的

ext.ext_cn: 他因精力充沛、才华横溢而被尊为神人。
ext.ext_en: His energy and talent elevate him to godlike status...

ext.ext_cn: 一个头发卷曲、如上帝般圣洁的人
ext.ext_en: ...a godlike being with curly hair...

defs.def_en: A godlike person or a person with godlike qualities is admired or respected very much as if he or she were perfect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 于是他们把她一个人留在整洁的小房子里，只有记忆陪着她。
ext.ext_en: So they left her in the neat little house, alone with her memories...

ext.ext_cn: 她脱掉衣服，把湿衣服整齐地码成一堆放在角落里。
ext.ext_en: She undressed and put her wet clothes in a neat pile in the corner.

defs.def_en: A neat place, thing, or person is tidy and smart, and has everything in the correct place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他说道：“这不像是阿尔夫的风格，他不会把文件弄得那么乱。他一向很爱整洁。”
ext.ext_en: 'That's not like Alf,' he said, 'leaving papers muddled like that. He's always so neat.'

defs.def_en: Someone who is neat keeps their home or possessions tidy, with everything in the correct place.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is neat, you mean that it is very good.

ext.ext_en: The plan is likely only to aggravate ethnic frictions.

defs.def_en: If there is friction between people, there is disagreement and argument between them.

ext.ext_en: The pistons are graphite-coated to reduce friction.

defs.def_en: Friction is the force that makes it difficult for things to move freely when they are touching each other.

ext.ext_cn: 他和她的腿之间的擦蹭
ext.ext_en: ...the friction of his leg against hers.

defs.def_en: Friction is the rubbing of one object against another.

ext.ext_cn: 狱警继续巡视监狱。

ext.ext_en: He failed to return from a patrol.

defs.def_en: When soldiers, police, or guards patrol an area or building, they move around it in order to make sure that there is no trouble there.

ext.ext_en: The army is now on patrol in Srinagar and a curfew has been imposed...

ext.ext_en: Security forces remained on patrol until late into the night.

ext.ext_cn: 游击队用手榴弹袭击了巡逻队。
ext.ext_en: Guerrillas attacked a patrol with hand grenades.

ext.ext_cn: 在缅甸边界巡逻的边境巡逻队
ext.ext_en: ...a border patrol operating near the Burmese frontier.

defs.def_en: A patrol is a group of soldiers or vehicles that are patrolling an area.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 肌肉发达的;精壮的;强健的

ext.ext_cn: 一名个子不高、肌肉发达的年轻男子
ext.ext_en: A short, sinewy young man...

ext.ext_cn: 如果能经常正确地锻炼肌肉的话，双臂就会一直结实而强健。
ext.ext_en: When muscles are exercised often and properly, they keep the arms firm and sinewy.

defs.def_en: Someone who is sinewy has a lean body with strong muscles.

ext.ext_cn: 花粉热临床表现为流泪、流涕，眼睛、鼻子发痒。
ext.ext_en: When someone has hayfever, the eyes and nose will stream and itch...

ext.ext_cn: 我的皮肤又硬又粗糙,而且还很痒。
ext.ext_en: My skin was hard and scaly and I itched.

defs.def_en: When a part of your body itches, you have an unpleasant feeling on your skin that makes you want to scratch.

ext.ext_en: I was itching to get involved and to bring my own theories into practice...

ext.ext_cn: 将军盼着打一仗。
ext.ext_en: The general was itching for a fight.

defs.def_en: If you are itching to do something, you are very eager or impatient to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 当他在自己身上试验还处在初级阶段的疫苗时，有些人说他的行为是蛮干。
ext.ext_en: When he tested an early vaccine on himself, some described the act as foolhardy...

ext.ext_cn: 拒绝是极不明智的。
ext.ext_en: It was foolhardy to have refused.

defs.def_en: If you describe behaviour as foolhardy, you disapprove of it because it is extremely risky.

ext.ext_cn: 之所以说此观点违背了批判性社会研究的宗旨，有几点理由。
ext.ext_en: This view is contrary to the aims of critical social research for a number of reasons...

ext.ext_cn: 几个在场的人，包括温博格，所掌握的信息截然不同。
ext.ext_en: Several of those present, including Weinberger, had contrary information.

defs.def_en: Ideas, attitudes, or reactions that are contrary to each other are completely different from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 与通常的看法相反，适度的运动事实上会降低食欲。
ext.ext_en: Contrary to popular belief, moderate exercise actually decreases your appetite...

ext.ext_cn: 你也许以为那两个人生气了，但实际上正相反，两个人都没有生气。
ext.ext_en: Contrary to what you might think, neither man was offended.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is true contrary to other people's beliefs or opinions, you are emphasizing that it is true and that they are wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 这种想法并不能让欧共体团结一致。相反地，我认为它会导致我们的分裂。
ext.ext_en: It is not an idea around which the Community can unite. On the contrary, I see it as one that will divide us.

defs.def_en: You use on the contrary when you have just said or implied that something is not true and are going to say  that the opposite is true.

ext.ext_cn: “人们根本不会做那样的事情。”——“恰恰相反，他们一直在那样做。”
ext.ext_en: 'People just don't do things like that.' — 'On the contrary, they do them all the time.'

defs.def_en: You can use on the contrary when you are disagreeing strongly with something that has just been said or implied, or are making a strong negative reply.

defs.def_cn: 完全相反;完全不同;根本不是

ext.ext_cn: 我不是一个女权主义者，根本不是。
ext.ext_en: I'm not a feminist, quite the contrary...

ext.ext_cn: “有没有迹象表明他可能很快就会辞职？”——“完全没有。”
ext.ext_en: 'Are there any signs that he may quit soon?' — 'Quite the contrary.'

defs.def_en: You can use quite the contrary to emphasize a previous negative statement, or when you are making a strong negative reply.

ext.ext_cn: 然而，那并不一定意味着货币供应量受到了限制，有大量证据表明事实正好相反。
ext.ext_en: That does not automatically mean, however, that the money supply has been curbed, and there is considerable evidence to the contrary...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管巴基斯坦再三保证停止其核项目，但事实却并非如此。
ext.ext_en: Despite repeated assurances to the contrary, Pakistan has not ended its nuclear programme.

defs.def_en: When a particular idea is being considered, evidence or statements to the contrary suggest that this idea is not true or that the opposite is true.

defs.def_cn: (用于代替名词词尾的-ology以构成新的名词）表示“…学家”
defs.def_en: -ologist is used to replace '-ology' at the end of nouns in order to form other nouns that refer to people who are concerned with a particular science or subject. For example, a 'biologist' is concerned with biology.

defs.def_cn: 用后即可丢弃的;一次性的

ext.ext_cn: 适合8磅以下婴儿使用的一次性尿布

ext.ext_en: He shaved himself with a disposable razor.

defs.def_en: A disposable product is designed to be thrown away after it has been used.

defs.def_cn: (收入)可自由支配的、扣除税款后余下的

ext.ext_en: Gerald had little disposable income...

ext.ext_en: The nation's disposable earnings in 1987 amounted to £86 billion.

defs.def_en: Your disposable income is the amount of income you have left after you have paid income tax and social security charges.

ext.ext_cn: 主菜在中午12点30分到下午两点之间是半价。
ext.ext_en: Main courses are half price from 12.30pm to 2pm...

ext.ext_en: Mind you, a half-price suit still cost $400...

defs.def_en: If something is half-price, it costs only half what it usually costs.
