ext.ext_en: By yesterday she was selling off stock at half price...

ext.ext_cn: 他们通常要价300英镑，但我们按半价买到了。
ext.ext_en: They normally charge three hundred pounds but we got it for half price.

defs.def_en: If something is sold at or for half-price, it is sold for only half of what it usually costs.

ext.ext_cn: 你的身高和体重是多少？
ext.ext_en: What is your height and weight?...

ext.ext_cn: 这减轻了负荷的重量。
ext.ext_en: This reduced the weight of the load...

defs.def_en: The weight of a person or thing is how heavy they are, measured in units such as kilograms, pounds, or tons.

ext.ext_cn: 他体重过重，这有损他的健康。
ext.ext_en: His weight was harming his health...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管车子很大很重，但它一点都不难开。
ext.ext_en: Despite the vehicle's size and weight it is not difficult to drive.

defs.def_en: A person's or thing's weight is the fact that they are very heavy.

ext.ext_cn: 他把重心从一只脚转到另一只脚上。
ext.ext_en: He shifted his weight from one foot to the other...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直不让左腿受力。
ext.ext_en: He kept the weight from his left leg.

defs.def_en: If you move your weight, you change position so that most of the pressure of your body is on a particular part of your body.

ext.ext_cn: 我在健身房举哑铃。
ext.ext_en: I was in the gym lifting weights.

defs.def_en: Weights are objects which weigh a known amount and which people lift as a form of exercise.
Weights are metal objects which weigh a known amount and which are used on a set of scales to weigh other things.

ext.ext_cn: 用力提重物会导致血压升高。
ext.ext_en: Straining to lift heavy weights can lead to a rise in blood pressure.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a heavy object as a weight, especially when you have to lift it.

ext.ext_cn: 可以把它缝到窗帘的褶边里增加重量，使窗帘更有垂感。
ext.ext_en: It can be sewn into curtain hems to weight the curtain and so allow it to hang better.

defs.def_en: If you weight something, you make it heavier by adding something to it, for example in order to stop it from moving easily.

ext.ext_en: ...a computer program which weights the different transitions according to their likelihood...

ext.ext_cn: 这考虑到了允许一家公司的新药在本国上市的国家的数量，并依照每个国家的市场规模权衡其重要性。
ext.ext_en: This takes account of the number of countries in which a company wins approval for a new drug, weighted by the size of each country's market.

defs.def_en: If you weight things, you give them different values according to how important or significant they are.

ext.ext_cn: 相关科学家对不同模型的结论给予不同的权重。
ext.ext_en: The scientists involved put different weight on the conclusions of different models...

ext.ext_en: We had this understanding that courses were roughly the same weight.

defs.def_en: If something is given a particular weight, it is given a particular value according to how important or significant it is.

ext.ext_en: The weight of expectation was getting to them...

ext.ext_en: Companies found themselves collapsing under the weight of debts.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the weight of something, you mean that it is large in amount or has great power, which means that it is difficult to oppose or fight against.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经离开这一事实让人更担心他会发动一场内战。
ext.ext_en: The fact that he is gone has given more weight to fears that he may try to launch a civil war...

ext.ext_en: Do you think, perhaps, that what happened today might lend weight to that criticism?

defs.def_en: If someone or something gives weight to what a person says, thinks, or does, they emphasize its significance.

ext.ext_en: Consumers generally place more weight on negative information than on the positive when deciding what to buy.

ext.ext_cn: 弗洛伊德认为父母在我们的成长过程中所起到的举足轻重的作用
ext.ext_en: ...the overwhelming weight Freud assigned parents in our development.

defs.def_en: If you give something or someone weight, you consider them to be very important or influential in a particular situation.

ext.ext_en: The relief was indescribable. It was freedom after years of slavery. A great weight lifted from me.

defs.def_en: If you feel a weight on you, you have a problem or a responsibility that is difficult for you to manage and that you are very worried about.

ext.ext_cn: 那个论点不再具有那么大的影响力了。
ext.ext_en: That argument no longer carries as much weight...

ext.ext_cn: 参议员克里在华盛顿举足轻重。
ext.ext_en: Senator Kerry carries considerable weight in Washington.

defs.def_en: If a person or their opinion carries weight, they are respected and are able to influence people.

ext.ext_en: Any successful manager is worth his weight in gold.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is worth their weight in gold, you are emphasizing that they are so useful, helpful, or valuable that you feel you could not manage without them.

ext.ext_cn: 他指责这个团队没有尽到本分。
ext.ext_en: He accused the team of not pulling their weight.

defs.def_en: If you pull your weight, you work as hard as everyone else who is involved in the same task or activity.

defs.def_cn: （利用自己的影响等）全力相助，鼎力支持

ext.ext_en: The administration is throwing its full weight behind the UN plan.

defs.def_en: If you throw your weight behind a person, plan, or campaign, you use all your influence and do everything you can to support them.

ext.ext_en: It was amazing how my mother coped with bringing up three children on less than three pounds a week...

ext.ext_cn: 这些问题很讨厌，但是我们都设法解决了。
ext.ext_en: The problems were an annoyance, but we managed to cope.

defs.def_en: If you cope with a problem or task, you deal with it successfully.

defs.def_cn: 应付，忍受(不愉快的局面)

ext.ext_en: She has had to cope with losing all her previous status and money.

defs.def_en: If you have to cope with an unpleasant situation, you have to accept it or bear it.

ext.ext_cn: 新的桨片设计使其可以应付昆虫尸体带来的影响。
ext.ext_en: New blades have been designed to cope with the effects of dead insects...

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家的监狱里挤满了瘾君子，都容纳不下了。
ext.ext_en: The country's prisons are filled with drug-takers, and cannot cope with the numbers...

defs.def_en: If a machine or a system can cope with something, it is large enough or complex enough to deal with it satisfactorily.

defs.def_cn: (基督教牧师在特殊仪式中所穿的)长袍，法衣
defs.def_en: A cope is a long sleeveless piece of clothing worn by some Christian priests on special occasions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人兴奋的;令人激动的;刺激的

ext.ext_cn: 比赛本身非常刺激。
ext.ext_en: The race itself is very exciting...

ext.ext_cn: 这次旅行是他们人生中最刺激的冒险经历。
ext.ext_en: This voyage was the most exciting adventure of their lives...

defs.def_en: If something is exciting, it makes you feel very happy or enthusiastic.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (比赛等)势均力敌的，难分高下的

ext.ext_en: In such a close-run race as this election, the campaign becomes all important.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a race or contest as a close-run thing, you mean that it was only won by a very small amount.

defs.def_cn: 毫无根据的；无缘无故的

ext.ext_cn: 对她的指控毫无根据。
ext.ext_en: The charges against her are baseless.

ext.ext_cn: 毫无根据的吸毒指控
ext.ext_en: ...baseless allegations of drug taking.

defs.def_en: If you describe an accusation, rumour, or report as baseless, you mean that it is not true and is not based on facts.

ext.ext_cn: 涉嫌收受佣金和非法政党筹资
ext.ext_en: ...alleged kickbacks and illegal party financing.

defs.def_en: A kickback is a sum of money that is paid to someone illegally, for example money which a company pays someone to arrange for the company to be chosen to do an important job.

defs.def_cn: 光荣的一圈（指得胜者绕场一圈接受观众欢呼）
defs.def_en: If the winner of a race or game does a lap of honour, they run or drive slowly around a race track or sports field in order to receive the applause of the crowd.

defs.def_cn: 系统的;影响全面的;全身的

ext.ext_cn: 经济陷入全面危机。
ext.ext_en: The economy is locked in a systemic crisis.

defs.def_en: Systemic means affecting the whole of something.
Systemic chemicals or drugs are absorbed into the whole of an organism such as a plant or person, rather than being applied to one area.

ext.ext_cn: 他继续写他的小说。
ext.ext_en: He recommenced work on his novel...

ext.ext_cn: 他在谢菲尔德大学的课程要到明年才能继续。
ext.ext_en: His course at Sheffield University will not recommence until next year.

defs.def_en: If you recommence something or if it recommences, it begins again after having stopped.

defs.def_cn: 经营的；业务上的；营业上的

ext.ext_en: He warns that corruption is corroding Russia.

defs.def_en: To corrode something means to gradually make it worse or weaker.

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯·博德曼赢得了奥运会4,000米自行车追逐赛的冠军。
ext.ext_en: Chris Boardman won the Olympic 4,000 metres pursuit...

ext.ext_cn: 隧道宽10米，长600米。
ext.ext_en: The tunnel is 10 metres wide and 600 metres long.

defs.def_en: A metre is a metric unit of length equal to 100 centimetres.

ext.ext_cn: 他们必须每人作一首严格押头韵的诗。
ext.ext_en: They must each compose a poem in strict alliterative metre...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的诗都按传统的韵律和韵脚而作。
ext.ext_en: All of the poems are written in traditional metres and rhyme schemes.

defs.def_en: In the study of poetry, metre is the regular and rhythmic arrangement of syllables according to particular patterns.

ext.ext_cn: 上尉停住了，站着一动不动。
ext.ext_en: The lieutenant stopped and stood stock-still.

defs.def_en: If someone stands or sits stock-still, they do not move at all.

ext.ext_cn: 他给他们开了张1万英镑的支票。
ext.ext_en: He wrote them a cheque for £10,000...

ext.ext_cn: 我想用支票结账。
ext.ext_en: I'd like to pay by cheque.

defs.def_en: See also:blank cheque;traveller's cheque;A cheque is a printed form on which you write an amount of money and who it is to be paid to. Your bank then pays the money to that person from your account.

defs.def_cn: （用于构成名词）表示“恐惧”，“憎恨”

ext.ext_cn: 那个地方的人极度憎恨欧洲。
ext.ext_en: The place seethed with Europhobia...

ext.ext_cn: 随着年龄的增长，技术恐惧感愈加强烈。
ext.ext_en: Technophobia increases with age.

defs.def_en: -phobia occurs in words which refer to a very strong, irrational fear or hatred of people or things of a particular kind.

defs.def_cn: 说出，提出(尤指令人惊讶的话)

ext.ext_cn: 当他说出这句话时，听到的人都大笑起来。
ext.ext_en: Everyone who heard it just burst out laughing when he came out with it...

ext.ext_cn: 她引用的那句妙语是什么来着？
ext.ext_en: What was that marvellous quote that she came out with?

defs.def_en: If you come out with a remark, especially a surprising one, you make it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 微不足道的;可忽略不计的

ext.ext_cn: 士兵拿到的军饷少得可怜。
ext.ext_en: The pay that the soldiers received was negligible...

ext.ext_cn: 高层主管们相信罢工的影响微不足道。
ext.ext_en: Senior managers are convinced that the strike will have a negligible impact.

defs.def_en: An amount or effect that is negligible is so small that it is not worth considering or worrying about.

defs.def_cn: 分配物；分配额；（尤指）划拨款项

ext.ext_cn: 拨给巴基斯坦的援助物资仍在审核当中。
ext.ext_en: The aid allocation for Pakistan was still under review...

ext.ext_cn: 定量配给时期，糖是限量配给的。
ext.ext_en: During rationing we had a sugar allocation.

defs.def_en: An allocation is an amount of something, especially money, that is given to a particular person or used for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 他的儿子们为家产如何分配而吵得很凶。
ext.ext_en: His sons quarrelled bitterly over the allocation of family resources...

ext.ext_cn: 必须协调城市规划和土地分配之间的关系。
ext.ext_en: Town planning and land allocation had to be coordinated.

defs.def_en: The allocation of something is the decision that it should be given to a particular person or used for a particular purpose.

defs.def_cn: 出神地;想入非非地;心不在焉地

ext.ext_cn: “他们是神圣的,”她神情恍惚地叹了口气。
ext.ext_en: 'They were divine,' she sighs, dreamily...

ext.ext_cn: 她出神地看着小窗子外面的蓝色地平线。
ext.ext_en: She stared dreamily out of the small window at the blue horizon.

defs.def_en: If you say or do something dreamily, you say or do it in a way that shows your mind is occupied with pleasant, relaxing thoughts.

defs.def_cn: (食物或饮料)有助于减肥的，低热量的，低卡路里的

ext.ext_cn: 所有减肥餐的含糖量都很低。
ext.ext_en: All dietetic meals are low in sugar.

defs.def_en: Dietetic food or drink is food or drink that has been specially produced so that it does not contain many calories.

ext.ext_cn: 禁止商业性捕鲸的禁令
ext.ext_en: ...a ban on commercial whaling.

ext.ext_cn: 捕鲸业
ext.ext_en: ...the whaling industry.

defs.def_en: Whaling is the activity of hunting and killing whales.

ext.ext_cn: 离南达科他州阿伯丁的主干道只有两条街
ext.ext_en: ...just two blocks off the main drag in Aberdeen, South Dakota.

defs.def_en: The main drag in a town or city is its main street.

defs.def_cn: 喜欢饮酒的;经常饮酒的;贪杯的
defs.def_en: See also:drink;Someone's drinking friends or companions are people they regularly drink alcohol with.

ext.ext_cn: 防尘口罩根据它们的防护效果分等级。
ext.ext_en: Dust masks are graded according to the protection they offer...

ext.ext_cn: 南点学院不对学生的作业评分。
ext.ext_en: South Point College does not grade the students' work.

defs.def_en: If something is graded, its quality is judged, and it is often given a number or a name that indicates how good or bad it is.

ext.ext_cn: 列入二级文物保护的建筑
ext.ext_en: ...a grade II listed building.

ext.ext_cn: 武器级钚
ext.ext_en: ...weapons-grade plutonium.

defs.def_en: The grade of a product is its quality, especially when this has been officially judged.

defs.def_cn: （用数字或字母表示的）成绩，评分

ext.ext_cn: 你希望得到什么样的成绩？
ext.ext_en: What grade are you hoping to get?...

ext.ext_cn: 你背负了拿到高分的巨大压力。
ext.ext_en: There was a lot of pressure on you to obtain good grades.

defs.def_en: Your grade in an examination or piece of written work is the mark you get, usually in the form of a letter or number, that indicates your level of achievement.

ext.ext_cn: 基层职员的流动率特别高。
ext.ext_en: Staff turnover is particularly high among junior grades.

defs.def_en: Your grade in a company or organization is your level of importance or your rank.

ext.ext_cn: 怀特先生在佐治亚州南部教一年级。
ext.ext_en: Mr White teaches first grade in south Georgia.

defs.def_en: In the United States, a grade is a group of classes in which all the children are of a similar age. When you are six years old you go into the first grade and you leave school after the twelfth grade.

ext.ext_cn: 她驾车开上一个陡坡，然后沿着长长的下坡路驶入沙漠。
ext.ext_en: She drove up a steep grade and then began the long descent into the desert.

defs.def_en: A grade is a slope.

ext.ext_cn: 我是一名海军中尉军官。
ext.ext_en: I was a naval officer, lieutenant junior grade.

defs.def_en: Someone's grade is their military rank.

ext.ext_cn: 她非常渴望成为舞蹈演员，但却因为达不到标准而未能圆梦。
ext.ext_en: She had a strong desire to be a dancer but failed to make the grade.

defs.def_en: If someone makes the grade, they succeed, especially by reaching a particular standard.

ext.ext_cn: 我虽然有很多朋友，但心底里还是惧怕寂寞。
ext.ext_en: I have so many friends, but deep down, underneath, I have a fear of loneliness.

defs.def_en: Loneliness is the unhappiness that is felt by someone because they do not have any friends or do not have anyone to talk to.

defs.def_cn: (用于构成形容词)表示“穿着(某种颜色或款式的)衬衫的”

ext.ext_cn: 穿白衬衣的男人们
ext.ext_en: ...white-shirted men.

defs.def_en: -shirted is used to form adjectives which indicate what colour or type of shirt someone is wearing.

defs.def_cn: (争执双方试图解决争端的)冷却期，冷静期

ext.ext_cn: 在举行罢工投票表决和采取劳工行动之间应当有7天的冷静期。
ext.ext_en: There should be a seven-day cooling-off period between a strike ballot and industrial action.

ext.ext_cn: 夫妻被准许离婚之前一年的冷静期
ext.ext_en: ...a one-year cooling-off period before couples were granted a divorce.

defs.def_en: A cooling-off period is an agreed period of time during which two sides with opposing views try to resolve a dispute before taking any serious action.

ext.ext_cn: 战争期间,他们被关在狱中。
ext.ext_en: They were incarcerated for the duration of the war...

ext.ext_cn: 监禁一名囚犯一年要花费 4 万到 5 万美元。
ext.ext_en: It can cost $40,000 to $50,000 to incarcerate a prisoner for a year.

defs.def_en: If people are incarcerated, they are kept in a prison or other place.

ext.ext_cn: 你这是直接购买，而不是通过代理人。
ext.ext_en: You are buying direct, rather than through an agent.

ext.ext_cn: 一份某人授权他人为其代理人的书面申明
ext.ext_en: ...a written declaration by someone, authorizing another person to act as his agent.

defs.def_en: See also:estate agent;press agent;travel agent;An agent is a person who looks after someone else's business affairs or does business on their behalf.
An agent in the arts world is a person who gets work for an actor or musician, or who sells the work of a writer to publishers.

ext.ext_cn: 这些年来他一直是为东方国家效力的一位间谍。
ext.ext_en: All these years he's been an agent for the East.

defs.def_en: An agent is a person who works for a country's secret service.

ext.ext_cn: 在许多社会中，年轻人将自己看成是高度活跃的分子，是变革的推动者和世界的塑造者。
ext.ext_en: In many societies young men regard themselves as highly active, the agents of change, shapers of the world.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone or something as the agent of a particular effect, you mean that they cause this effect.

ext.ext_cn: 白面粉中的漂白剂
ext.ext_en: ...the bleaching agent in white flour.

ext.ext_cn: 血纤维蛋白原，一种凝血剂
ext.ext_en: ...fibrinogen, a blood clotting agent.

defs.def_en: A chemical that has a particular effect or is used for a particular purpose can be referred to as a particular kind of agent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他在学校成绩平平。
ext.ext_en: His school record was mediocre.

ext.ext_cn: 不尽如人意的音乐
ext.ext_en: ...mediocre music.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as mediocre, you mean that it is of average quality but you think it should be better.
In a vehicle, power steering is a system for steering which uses power from the engine so that it is easier for the driver to steer the vehicle.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: The Tropic of Cancer is an imaginary line around the Earth 23˚26′ north of the equator.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 遍布的；贯穿始终的；四处弥漫的

ext.ext_cn: 在国民生活中军队的影响无处不在
ext.ext_en: ...the pervasive influence of the army in national life...

ext.ext_cn: 她生活在深深的愧疚之中。
ext.ext_en: She lives with a pervasive sense of guilt.

defs.def_en: Something, especially something bad, that is pervasive is present or felt throughout a place or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 大地在摇晃，悬崖好像在颤动。
ext.ext_en: The ground shook and the cliffs seemed to vibrate...

ext.ext_cn: 噪音使桌子颤动起来。
ext.ext_en: The noise vibrated the table.

defs.def_en: If something vibrates or if you vibrate it, it shakes with repeated small, quick movements.
Ethanol is another name for alcohol .

defs.def_cn: (尤指女子说服人所用的)花言巧语，巧计

ext.ext_cn: 她声称女人“靠她们的小聪明来达到目的”。
ext.ext_en: She claimed that women 'use their feminine wiles to get on.'

defs.def_en: Wiles are clever tricks that people, especially women, use to persuade other people to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 装配线上的一名工人
ext.ext_en: ...a man who works on an assembly line.

defs.def_en: An assembly line is an arrangement of workers and machines in a factory, where each worker deals with only one part of a product. The product passes from one worker to another until it is finished.

defs.def_cn: 科学;自然科学;自然科学知识

ext.ext_cn: 最伟大的科学发现都非常简单。
ext.ext_en: The best discoveries in science are very simple.

ext.ext_cn: 科学技术
ext.ext_en: ...science and technology.

defs.def_en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

ext.ext_cn: 物理学是自然科学中发展出了强有力的抽象理论的最好例子。
ext.ext_en: Physics is the best example of a science which has developed strong, abstract theories.

ext.ext_cn: 微生物学
ext.ext_en: ...the science of microbiology.

defs.def_en: A science is a particular branch of science such as physics, chemistry, or biology.

defs.def_cn: (研究人类行为的)学科，社会科学

ext.ext_cn: 现代心理学
ext.ext_en: ...the modern science of psychology.

defs.def_en: A science is the study of some aspect of human behaviour, for example sociology or anthropology.

ext.ext_cn: 该基金大部分用于了资助联邦监狱的建造。
ext.ext_en: The fund has been used largely to finance the construction of federal prisons...

ext.ext_cn: 政府开支依靠征税款和借贷来维持。
ext.ext_en: Government expenditure is financed by taxation and by borrowing.

defs.def_en: When someone finances something such as a project or a purchase, they provide the money that is needed to pay for them.

ext.ext_cn: 高级金融界的大户
ext.ext_en: ...a major player in the world of high finance...

ext.ext_cn: 该报告建议对公共财政进行彻底改革。
ext.ext_en: The report recommends an overhaul of public finances...

defs.def_en: Finance is the commercial or government activity of managing money, debt, credit, and investment.

ext.ext_cn: 对财务上的意外状况要做到有备无患。
ext.ext_en: Be prepared for unexpected news concerning your finances...

ext.ext_cn: 通常，妇女管理日常财务，而把大多数较长期的决策交给男人。
ext.ext_en: In general, women manage the day-to-day finances but leave most longer-term decisions to men...

defs.def_en: You can refer to the amount of money that you have and how well it is organized as your finances .

defs.def_cn: 小天使(艺术作品中常表现为带翼、裸身的孩子)
defs.def_en: A cherub is a kind of angel that is represented in art as a naked child with wings.
A juvenile court is a court which deals with crimes committed by young people who are not yet old enough to be considered as adults.

ext.ext_cn: 女仆每星期换一次床单。
ext.ext_en: Once a week, a maid changes the sheets.

ext.ext_cn: 丝绸床单的奢华
ext.ext_en: ...the luxury of silk sheets.

defs.def_en: A sheet is a large rectangular piece of cotton or other cloth that you sleep on or cover yourself with in a bed.

ext.ext_cn: 一张报纸
ext.ext_en: ...a sheet of newspaper...

ext.ext_cn: 我能将全部内容都放在一页上。
ext.ext_en: I was able to fit it all on one sheet.

defs.def_en: A sheet of paper is a rectangular piece of paper.

ext.ext_cn: 有关世界各国信息的简要记录
ext.ext_en: ...information sheets on each country in the world.

defs.def_en: You can use sheet to refer to a piece of paper which gives information about something.

defs.def_cn: (玻璃、金属、木头等的)大块薄片，薄板

ext.ext_cn: 一片碎玻璃
ext.ext_en: ...a cracked sheet of glass...

ext.ext_cn: 高架起重机正吊起一块块巨大的钢板。
ext.ext_en: Overhead cranes were lifting giant sheets of steel...

defs.def_en: A sheet of glass, metal, or wood is a large, flat, thin piece of it.

defs.def_cn: (覆盖在其他物体上的)一大片，一层

ext.ext_cn: 一层冰
ext.ext_en: ...a sheet of ice.

ext.ext_cn: 一层蓝灰色的灰尘
ext.ext_en: ...a blue-grey sheet of dust.

defs.def_en: A sheet of something is a thin wide layer of it over the surface of something else.

defs.def_cn: 一团，一片，一股(迅速移动的火或水)

ext.ext_cn: 街道上现在是一片火海。
ext.ext_en: The streets were now in one fierce sheet of flame...

ext.ext_cn: 倾盆大雨斜着打落在路上。
ext.ext_en: Sheets of rain slanted across the road.

defs.def_en: A sheet of fire or water is a fast-moving mass of it that is difficult to see through.
In sailing, a sheet is a line or rope used for controlling the position of a sail on a boat.

defs.def_cn: (通过消耗体力)宣泄(愤怒)，释放(精力)，排解(压力)

ext.ext_cn: 她快步走了一会儿，以排解心中的沮丧。
ext.ext_en: She went for a brisk walk to work off her frustration...

ext.ext_cn: 我要是哪天不顺心，就去做饭排解一下。
ext.ext_en: If I've had a bad day I'll work it off by cooking.

defs.def_en: If you work off energy, stress, or anger, you get rid of it by doing something that requires a lot of physical effort.

ext.ext_cn: 这份报告建议让学生通过参加社区服务来偿还债务。
ext.ext_en: The report proposes that students be allowed to work off their debt through community service...

ext.ext_cn: 爱德华负债累累，他要工作半辈子才能偿清。
ext.ext_en: There were heavy debts. It would take half Edward's lifetime to work them off.

defs.def_en: If you work off a debt, you repay it by working.

defs.def_cn: 分不开地;解不开地;紧密地

ext.ext_cn: 宗教对她来说是与生活本身紧密联系在一起的。
ext.ext_en: Religion was for her inextricably linked with life itself.

defs.def_en: If two or more things are inextricably linked, they cannot be considered separately.

ext.ext_cn: 他恳求的目光
ext.ext_en: ...his pleading eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 她脸上恳求的表情
ext.ext_en: ...the pleading expression on her face...

defs.def_en: A pleading expression or gesture shows someone that you want something very much.

ext.ext_cn: 他完全不理会锡德的恳求。
ext.ext_en: He simply ignored Sid's pleading.

ext.ext_cn: 较贫穷国家的呼吁
ext.ext_en: ...the pleadings of the poorer countries.

defs.def_en: See also:special pleading;Pleading is asking someone for something you want very much, in an intense or emotional way.

ext.ext_cn: 病人认出其中一个女的是她曾见过的幽灵。
ext.ext_en: The patient recognized one of the women as the apparition she had seen.

ext.ext_cn: 圣母显灵
ext.ext_en: ...these apparitions of the Virgin.

defs.def_en: An apparition is someone you see or think you see but who is not really there as a physical being.

defs.def_cn: （尤指令人恐惧的人或物）庞大而笨重的，庞然大物般的

ext.ext_cn: 我醒来时，有个巨形身影正低头盯着我看。
ext.ext_en: When I woke up there was a hulking figure staring down at me...

ext.ext_cn: 他偶然发现了这座红砖砌成的森然高耸的医院。
ext.ext_en: He came upon the hulking redbrick hospital.

defs.def_en: You use hulking to describe a person or object that is extremely large, heavy, or slow-moving, especially when they seem threatening in some way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不科学的；无科学知识的

ext.ext_cn: 这支队伍中的成员没有一个具有行医资格，而且他们使用的方法也被认为根本不科学。
ext.ext_en: No member of the team was medically qualified and its methods were considered totally unscientific.

ext.ext_cn: 这样一个数目很小且不具科学性的投票者样本
ext.ext_en: ...this small, unscientific sample of voters.

defs.def_en: Research or treatment that is unscientific is not likely to be good because it is not based on facts or is not done in the proper way.

ext.ext_cn: 这支乐队准备开始为巡演排练。
ext.ext_en: The band was scheduled to begin rehearsals for a concert tour...

ext.ext_cn: 在排练《康康舞》的时候，波特感觉主题曲需要一个前奏乐曲。
ext.ext_en: When 'Can-Can' was in rehearsal, Porter felt that the title song needed a musical introduction.

defs.def_en: See also:dress rehearsal;A rehearsal of a play, dance, or piece of music is a practice of it in preparation for a performance.

ext.ext_cn: 草图应该是最终绘画的某种演练。
ext.ext_en: The sketch should be a kind of rehearsal for the eventual painting...

ext.ext_cn: 白日梦可能像是真实情景的预演。
ext.ext_en: Daydreams may seem to be rehearsals for real-life situations.

defs.def_en: You can describe an event or object which is a preparation for a more important event or object as a rehearsal for it.

ext.ext_cn: 她正哼着一支欢快的小调。
ext.ext_en: She was humming a merry little tune.

defs.def_en: A tune is a series of musical notes that is pleasant and easy to remember.

ext.ext_cn: 她还将演奏你最喜欢的流行乐曲。
ext.ext_en: She'll also be playing your favourite pop tunes.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a song or a short piece of music as a tune .

ext.ext_cn: “我们在演奏以前确实会为吉他调音，”他坚持说道。
ext.ext_en: 'We do tune our guitars before we go on,' he insisted.

ext.ext_cn: 其他人正静静地为他们的乐器调音。
ext.ext_en: Others were quietly tuning up their instruments.

defs.def_en: When someone tunes a musical instrument, they adjust it so that it produces the right notes.

defs.def_cn: 调试，调整(发动机或机器)

ext.ext_cn: 司机们被敦促要确保汽车发动机调试妥当。
ext.ext_en: Drivers are urged to make sure that car engines are properly tuned.

ext.ext_cn: 那家店调试一辆保时捷收费高达 500 美元。
ext.ext_en: The shop charges up to $500 to tune up a Porsche.

defs.def_en: When an engine or machine is tuned, it is adjusted so that it works well.

ext.ext_cn: 一台小彩色电视机频道调在了一出下午的肥皂剧上。
ext.ext_en: A small colour television was tuned to an afternoon soap opera.

defs.def_en: If your radio or television is tuned to a particular broadcasting station, you are listening to or watching the programmes being broadcast by that station.

ext.ext_cn: 那在国会谁说了算？
ext.ext_en: Who would then be calling the tune in Parliament?

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or organization is calling the tune, you mean that they are in a position of power or control in a particular situation.

defs.def_cn: 改变调子;变卦;改变态度

ext.ext_cn: 你从今天早上就变卦了，是不是？
ext.ext_en: You've changed your tune since this morning, haven't you?...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天他变卦了，说提价只是试行。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday he changed his tune, saying the fare increase was experimental.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has changed their tune, you are criticizing them because they have changed their opinion or way of doing things.

defs.def_cn: 被…牵着鼻子走;受…的控制

ext.ext_cn: 商业主义的危险就是教会最终可能会被大赞助商牵着鼻子走。
ext.ext_en: The danger of commercialism is that the churches end up dancing to the tune of their big business sponsors.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is dancing to someone else's tune, you mean that they are allowing themselves to be controlled by the other person.

defs.def_cn: 合调的/走调的;在调子上/不在调子上

ext.ext_cn: 他声音很一般，但唱得都在调子上。
ext.ext_en: It was just an ordinary voice, but he sang in tune...

ext.ext_cn: 很多音都走调了。
ext.ext_en: Many of the notes are out of tune...

defs.def_en: A person or musical instrument that is in tune produces exactly the right notes. A person or musical instrument that is out of tune does not produce exactly the right notes.

defs.def_cn: 一致/不一致;赞同/不赞同

ext.ext_cn: 今天，他方向的改变似乎更与时代合拍。
ext.ext_en: Today, his change of direction seems more in tune with the times...

ext.ext_cn: 和平倡导者可能不被大部分英国人认同。
ext.ext_en: The peace campaigners were probably out of tune with most Britons.

defs.def_en: If you are in tune with a group of people, you are in agreement or sympathy with them. If you are out of tune with them, you are not in agreement or sympathy with them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经对世界杯提供了高达 150 万英镑的赞助费。
ext.ext_en: They've been sponsoring the World Cup to the tune of a million and a half pounds.

defs.def_en: To the tune of a particular amount of money means to the extent of that amount.

defs.def_cn: (专门提供赛马内幕消息的)情报贩子
defs.def_en: A tipster is someone who tells you, usually in exchange for money, which horses they think will win particular races, so that you can bet money on the horses.

defs.def_cn: （因纽特人使用的或独木舟运动中所用的）独木舟，单人划子
defs.def_en: A kayak is a narrow boat like a canoe, used by the Inuit people and in the sport of canoeing.

ext.ext_cn: 地下河距离上面的城市街道只有几英尺。
ext.ext_en: The groundwater is only feet beneath the city streets.

defs.def_en: Groundwater is water that is found under the ground. Groundwater has usually passed down through the soil and become trapped by rocks.

ext.ext_cn: 她的母亲患有偏头痛。
ext.ext_en: Her mother suffered from migraines.

defs.def_en: A migraine is an extremely painful headache that makes you feel very ill.

defs.def_cn: (热衷于流行音乐的)时髦少年(通常指少女)
defs.def_en: A teenybopper is a teenager, usually a girl, who is very interested in pop music.
A pillbox is a small tin or box in which you can keep pills.
A pillbox is a small building made of concrete and is used to defend a place.
A pillbox or a pillbox hat is a small round hat for a woman.

ext.ext_cn: 这种枪只有一个用途——就是用来杀人。
ext.ext_en: This gun is designed for one purpose—it's basically to kill people...

ext.ext_cn: 我基本上认为他是在性格上和我互补的人。
ext.ext_en: Basically I think he would be someone who complemented me in terms of character.

defs.def_en: You use basically for emphasis when you are stating an opinion, or when you are making an important statement about something.

defs.def_cn: 大致说来；从根本上来讲

ext.ext_cn: 大致说来，你有两个选择。
ext.ext_en: Basically you've got two choices...

ext.ext_cn: 从根本上来讲，这是严格的素食主义饮食。
ext.ext_en: It's basically a vegan diet...

defs.def_en: You use basically to show that you are describing a situation in a simple, general way, and that you are not concerned with less important details.

defs.def_cn: 忘却,抹去,消除(想法或感受)

ext.ext_cn: 他们急于抹去上次在卡迪夫遭遇失败的记忆。
ext.ext_en: They are desperate to erase the memory of that last defeat in Cardiff...

ext.ext_cn: 自从苏珊离开后，他再也不提“爱情”这个词了。
ext.ext_en: Love was a word he'd erased from his vocabulary since Susan's going.

defs.def_en: If you erase a thought or feeling, you destroy it completely so that you can no longer remember something or no longer feel a particular emotion.

defs.def_cn: 抹掉（磁带录音）；删除（计算机文件）

ext.ext_cn: 他在录音棚里流着眼泪抹掉他辛苦录制的所有磁带。
ext.ext_en: He was in the studio tearfully erasing all the tapes he'd slaved over...

ext.ext_cn: 看起来那些名字被意外地从计算机磁盘上删除了。
ext.ext_en: It appears the names were accidentally erased from computer disks.

defs.def_en: If you erase sound which has been recorded on a tape or information which has been stored in a computer, you completely remove or destroy it.

ext.ext_cn: 不幸的是她已经删除了那条短信。
ext.ext_en: It was unfortunate that she had erased the message.

defs.def_en: If you erase something such as writing or a mark, you remove it, usually by rubbing it with a cloth.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (女子)有曲线美的，体形优美的

ext.ext_cn: 体形优美的金发女郎
ext.ext_en: ...a curvaceous blonde.

defs.def_en: If someone describes a woman as curvaceous, they think she is attractive because of the curves of her body.

ext.ext_cn: 你看起来身体很好。
ext.ext_en: You seem in fine fettle.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is in fine fettle, you mean that they are in very good health or condition.
You use toothless to describe a person or their smile when they have no teeth.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在他看来，委员会仍然是一个没有实权、不起作用的机构。
ext.ext_en: In his view, the Commission remains a toothless and ineffectual body.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as an official group or a law as toothless, you mean it has no real power and is not effective.

ext.ext_cn: 我看见她坐在靠窗的桌旁，沐浴在阳光中。
ext.ext_en: I saw her sitting at a window table, bathed in sunlight.

defs.def_en: Sunlight is the light that comes from the sun during the day.

ext.ext_cn: 以前不允许官员监督投票。
ext.ext_en: Officials had not been allowed to monitor the voting...

ext.ext_cn: 你需要利用反馈信息来监控进展。
ext.ext_en: You need feedback to monitor progress.

defs.def_en: If you monitor something, you regularly check its development or progress, and sometimes comment on it.

defs.def_cn: 监听(外国无线电广播等)

ext.ext_cn: 彼得·默里一直在伦敦监听来自蒙罗维亚的新闻报道。
ext.ext_en: Peter Murray is in London and has been monitoring reports out of Monrovia.

defs.def_en: If someone monitors radio broadcasts from other countries, they record them or listen carefully to them in order to obtain information.

ext.ext_cn: 心脏监测器显示患者神志不清。
ext.ext_en: The heart monitor shows low levels of consciousness.

defs.def_en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example processes or substances inside a person's body.

ext.ext_cn: 他在看电视转播的网球赛。
ext.ext_en: He was watching a game of tennis on a television monitor.

defs.def_en: A monitor is a screen which is used to display certain kinds of information, for example in airports or  television studios.

ext.ext_cn: 政府监督员将继续陪同记者。
ext.ext_en: Government monitors will continue to accompany reporters.

ext.ext_cn: 监督纳米比亚独立情况的联合国核查员
ext.ext_en: ...UN monitors overseeing Namibian independence.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a person who checks that something is done correctly, or that it is fair, as a monitor .

ext.ext_cn: 他们可能会主诉腹泻或腹痛。
ext.ext_en: They may complain of diarrhea or bellyache.

defs.def_en: Bellyache is a pain inside your abdomen, especially in your stomach.

defs.def_cn: 无病呻吟；反复大声发牢骚

ext.ext_cn: 无端就经济衰退叫苦不迭
ext.ext_en: ...bellyaching about recession.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is bellyaching, you mean they complain loudly and frequently about something and you think this is unreasonable or unjustified.
A billy goat is a male goat.

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦警察总部诈骗案调查组的警官们
ext.ext_en: ...fraud squad officers from London's police headquarters...

ext.ext_cn: 这座大楼是该家族公司的总部。
ext.ext_en: The building is the headquarters of the family firm.

defs.def_en: The headquarters of an organization are its main offices.

ext.ext_cn: 军队和领导层间持续的心理战
ext.ext_en: ...the continuing war of nerves between the army and the leadership.

defs.def_en: A war of nerves is a conflict in which the opposing sides try to make each other feel less confident.

ext.ext_cn: 我们已在实现持久和平上取得很大进展。
ext.ext_en: We are well on our way to a lasting peace...

ext.ext_cn: 她给他留下了难以磨灭的印象。
ext.ext_en: She left a lasting impression on him.

defs.def_en: See also:last;You can use lasting to describe a situation, result, or agreement that continues to exist or have an effect for a very long time.
A hen is a female chicken. People often keep hens in order to eat them or sell their eggs.

ext.ext_cn: 雌性鸵鸟
ext.ext_en: ...ostrich hens.

defs.def_en: The female of any bird can be referred to as a hen .

ext.ext_cn: 暖暖的炉火吸引着她继续向前走进那间屋子。
ext.ext_en: She went further into the room, drawn by the warmth of the fire...

ext.ext_cn: 六月带来了夏日的第一缕热气。
ext.ext_en: June had brought with it the first of the summer warmth.

defs.def_en: The warmth of something is the heat that it has or produces.

ext.ext_cn: 毛毯能让你睡得更温暖、更舒适。
ext.ext_en: The blanket will provide additional warmth and comfort in bed.

defs.def_en: The warmth of something such as a garment or blanket is the protection that it gives you against the cold.

ext.ext_cn: 他热情且友好地迎接了我们俩。
ext.ext_en: He greeted us both with warmth and affection.

defs.def_en: Someone who has warmth is friendly and enthusiastic in their behaviour towards other people.

ext.ext_cn: 把黄油切成小片。
ext.ext_en: Chop the butter into small pieces...

ext.ext_cn: 把洋葱切碎。
ext.ext_en: Chop the onions very finely...

defs.def_en: If you chop something, you cut it into pieces with strong downward movements of a knife or an axe.

ext.ext_cn: 烤羊排
ext.ext_en: ...grilled lamb chops.

defs.def_en: A chop is a small piece of meat cut from the ribs of a sheep or pig.

ext.ext_cn: 别问我为什么他们一会儿一个主意。
ext.ext_en: Don't ask me why they have chopped and changed so much.

defs.def_en: When people chop and change, they keep changing their minds about what to do or how to act.

defs.def_cn: 将被取消(或关闭);(人)将被解雇

ext.ext_cn: 他不愿说哪些项目将被毙掉。
ext.ext_en: He won't say which programmes are for the chop...

ext.ext_cn: 我被威尔士队解聘时，既失望又错愕。
ext.ext_en: I was both disappointed and amazed when I got the chop from the Wales team.

defs.def_en: If something is for the chop or is going to get the chop, it is going to be stopped or closed. If someone is for the chop, they are going to lose their job or position.
When Christians refer to the second coming, they mean the expected return to earth of Jesus Christ.

defs.def_cn: (会议中用作信息展示的)活动挂图板

ext.ext_cn: 有 3 个会议室，每个会议室都配有屏幕、活动挂图板和视听设备。
ext.ext_en: There are three conference rooms each of which is equipped with a screen, flipchart and audio visual equipment.

defs.def_en: A flip chart is a stand with large sheets of paper which is used when presenting information at a meeting.
A flautist is someone who plays the flute.

ext.ext_cn: 安达卢西亚自治区政府
ext.ext_en: ...the autonomous regional government of Andalucia.

ext.ext_cn: 对地区安全的担忧
ext.ext_en: ...concern about regional security...

defs.def_en: Regional is used to describe things which relate to a particular area of a country or of the world.
A doctoral thesis or piece of research is written or done in order to obtain a doctor's degree.
A mutineer is a person who takes part in a mutiny.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 滑坡使边远地区的许多村庄与外界隔绝。
ext.ext_en: Landslides have cut off many villages in remote areas.

ext.ext_cn: 位于约克郡山谷的一个偏僻的农场
ext.ext_en: ...a remote farm in the Yorkshire dales.

defs.def_en: Remote areas are far away from cities and places where most people live, and are therefore difficult to get to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在久远的过去，岩石板滑落到周边，从而形成了这个洞。
ext.ext_en: Slabs of rock had slipped sideways in the remote past, and formed this hole.

defs.def_en: The remote past or remote future is a time that is many years distant from the present.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 关系不紧密的;关系疏远的;相距甚远的

ext.ext_cn: 这个政府按照远离民众的少数人的意愿行事。
ext.ext_en: This government depends on the wishes of a few who are remote from the people...

ext.ext_cn: 青少年被迫学习和他们的日常生活关系不大的学科。
ext.ext_en: Teenagers are forced to study subjects that seem remote from their daily lives.

defs.def_en: If something is remote from a particular subject or area of experience, it is not relevant to it because it is very different.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (可能性或机会)渺茫的，微乎其微的

ext.ext_cn: 不论何时只要有一点可能暴露在阳光下，我就会用防晒霜。
ext.ext_en: I use a sunscreen whenever there is even a remote possibility that I will be in the sun...

ext.ext_cn: 他生还的机会非常渺茫。
ext.ext_en: The chances of his surviving are pretty remote.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is a remote possibility or chance that something will happen, you are emphasizing that there is only a very small chance that it will happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 冷漠的;冷淡的;与人疏远的;清高的

ext.ext_cn: 她相貌如此美丽，同时又如此清高不群。
ext.ext_en: She looked so beautiful, and at the same time so remote.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as remote, you mean that they behave as if they do not want to be friendly or closely involved with other people.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦出现坏疽，机体组织便已死亡。
ext.ext_en: Once gangrene has developed the tissue is dead.

defs.def_en: Gangrene is the decay that can occur in a part of a person's body if the blood stops flowing to it, for example as a result of illness or injury.

defs.def_cn: (上衣与裤子搭配的)女式长裤套装
defs.def_en: A trouser suit is women's clothing consisting of a pair of trousers and a jacket which are made from the same material.

ext.ext_cn: 他举起右拳高喊：“骗子，骗子！”
ext.ext_en: He raised his right fist and declaimed: 'Liar and cheat!'...

ext.ext_cn: 他过去常给我们朗诵法语诗歌。
ext.ext_en: He used to declaim French verse to us.

defs.def_en: If you declaim, you speak dramatically, as if you were acting in a theatre.

defs.def_cn: 情绪失控;狂野情绪的爆发

ext.ext_cn: 我受够了你的歇斯底里，知道吗？
ext.ext_en: I'm sick of your having hysterics, okay?...

ext.ext_cn: 人很容易情绪失控，你要小心。
ext.ext_en: It is quite easy to get engulfed in the hysterics and you have to be careful.

defs.def_en: If someone is in hysterics or is having hysterics, they are in a state of uncontrolled excitement, anger, or panic.

ext.ext_cn: 这太让人震惊了，我的情绪濒于崩溃。
ext.ext_en: It was such a shock I had hysterics...

ext.ext_cn: 我陷入了癫狂状态。
ext.ext_en: I went into hysterics.

defs.def_en: If someone is in hysterics or is having hysterics, they are in a state of violent and disturbed emotion that is usually a result of shock.

ext.ext_cn: 他经常让我们大家狂笑不止。
ext.ext_en: He'd often have us all in absolute hysterics.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone is in hysterics or is having hysterics when they are laughing loudly in an uncontrolled way.
A G-string is a narrow band of cloth that is worn between a person's legs to cover his or her sexual organs, and that is held up by a narrow string round the waist.

defs.def_cn: （戏剧、歌剧等的）首场演出之夜
defs.def_en: The opening night of a play or an opera is the first night on which a particular production is performed.

ext.ext_cn: 我们花了很多钱买波希米亚玻璃制品送人和自用。
ext.ext_en: We splurged on Bohemian glass for gifts, and for ourselves.

ext.ext_cn: 我相信，银行里存有足够的钱能让我破费一回买双好鞋。
ext.ext_en: I'm confident that there's enough in the bank for a splurge on a great pair of shoes.

defs.def_en: If you splurge on something, you spend a lot of money, usually on things that you do not need.

defs.def_cn: （love的非正式写法，用于称呼）亲爱的

ext.ext_cn: “别担心，亲爱的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Don't worry, luv.'

defs.def_en: Luv is a written form of the word 'love', when it is being used as an informal way of addressing someone.

ext.ext_cn: 我向来觉得永生的想法很可怕。
ext.ext_en: I have always found the thought of eternity terrifying.

ext.ext_cn: 让他永远安息
ext.ext_en: ...laying him to rest for all eternity.

defs.def_en: Eternity is time without an end or a state of existence outside time, especially the state which some people believe they will pass into after they have died.

defs.def_cn: 极长的一段时间;似乎无穷尽的一段时间

ext.ext_cn: 那场战争持续了极长的一段时间。
ext.ext_en: The war continued for an eternity...

ext.ext_cn: 电话响了似乎很长一段时间，然后有人接了电话。
ext.ext_en: The ringing went on for what seemed an eternity, and then someone answered.

defs.def_en: If you say that a situation lasted for an eternity, you mean that it seemed to last an extremely long time, usually because it was boring or unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 神秘的;谜一般的;费解的

ext.ext_cn: 黑利打量着她，脸上带着神秘的笑容。
ext.ext_en: Haley studied her, an enigmatic smile on his face...

ext.ext_cn: 她在韦尔斯最具神秘色彩的一部电影中出演主角。
ext.ext_en: She starred in one of Welles's most enigmatic films.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is enigmatic is mysterious and difficult to understand.

defs.def_cn: 想出，得到(解决方法);解(谜)

ext.ext_cn: 谈判人员定于今天晚些时候进行会谈，商定一个折中方案。
ext.ext_en: Negotiators are due to meet later today to work out a compromise...

ext.ext_cn: 我花了一些时间才弄清此事的起因。
ext.ext_en: It took me some time to work out what was causing this...

defs.def_en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you manage to find the solution by thinking or talking about it.

defs.def_cn: 计算出，解出（数学题答案）

ext.ext_cn: 清算破产公司的资产值其实很困难。
ext.ext_en: It is proving hard to work out the value of bankrupt firms' assets...

ext.ext_cn: 问到5个人吃一顿饭花了40.35英镑，每人要出多少钱时，他们算不出来。
ext.ext_en: When asked what a £40.35 meal for five people would cost each diner, they were unable to work it out.

defs.def_en: If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it.

ext.ext_cn: 每磅价格合计3.20英镑。
ext.ext_en: The price per pound works out at £3.20...

ext.ext_cn: 租一辆面包车自己搬的话，算起来可能要更省钱些。
ext.ext_en: It will probably work out cheaper to hire a van and move your own things.

defs.def_en: If something works out at a particular amount, it is calculated to be that amount after all the facts and figures have been considered.

ext.ext_cn: 事情根本没有按计划进行。
ext.ext_en: Things just didn't work out as planned...

ext.ext_cn: 我希望进展顺利。
ext.ext_en: I hope it will work out well...

defs.def_en: If a situation works out well or works out, it happens or progresses in a satisfactory way.

ext.ext_cn: 参与者都觉得这是一场噩梦，但我相信其结局会是圆满的。
ext.ext_en: People involved in it think it's a nightmare, but I'm sure it will work itself out.

defs.def_en: If a process works itself out, it reaches a conclusion or satisfactory end.

defs.def_cn: 继续(服役)至期满;干满(离职通知规定的时间)

ext.ext_cn: 在她的继任者真正到任前有一段过渡时间，因为她得干满离职通知规定的时间。
ext.ext_en: There was an interim before her successor actually came because she had to work out her notice.

defs.def_en: If you work out your service or your notice, you continue to work at your job until you have completed a specified period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 一周去健身房锻炼两次，或游两次泳。
ext.ext_en: Work out at a gym or swim twice a week.

defs.def_en: If you work out, you do physical exercises in order to make your body fit and strong.

defs.def_cn: (英国中学的)第六学年，六年级(学生年龄在16 岁至 18 岁，通常是为参加高级程度考试作准备)

ext.ext_cn: 她还在上六年级的时候就得到了第一份模特工作。
ext.ext_en: She was offered her first modelling job while she was still in the sixth-form...

ext.ext_cn: 这对夫妇在索利哈尔的一所六年级学院相遇。
ext.ext_en: The couple met at a sixth form college in Solihull.

defs.def_en: The sixth form in a British school consists of the classes that pupils go to from 16 to 18 years of age, usually in order to study for A levels.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得她会自己动笔；无需他人捉刀。
ext.ext_en: I suspect she'll be writing it herself; she doesn't need a ghost writer.

defs.def_en: A ghost writer is someone who writes a book or other published work instead of the person who is named as the author.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人惊讶的；非常惊人的

ext.ext_cn: 他花了3个小时就学会了拉丁文，真让人吃惊！
ext.ext_en: It's astonishing, he's learned Latin in three hours!

ext.ext_cn: 表现出的惊人体力
ext.ext_en: ...an astonishing display of physical strength.

defs.def_en: Something that is astonishing is very surprising.

defs.def_cn: （尤指儿童的）注意力缺乏多动症（常使用缩略形式ADHD）
defs.def_en: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder is a condition where people, especially children, are extremely active and unable to concentrate on anything for very long, with the result that they find it difficult to learn and often behave in inappropriate ways. The abbreviation ADHD is often used.

ext.ext_cn: 咱们是要写个故事，还是怎么的？
ext.ext_en: Are we going to write a story or summat?

defs.def_en: Summat is a British dialect form of the word 'something'.

ext.ext_cn: 查尔斯王子和理查德·尼克松这样的贵宾
ext.ext_en: ...such VIPs as Prince Charles and Richard Nixon...

ext.ext_cn: 她在贵宾休息室里等候着。
ext.ext_en: She waited in the VIP lounge.

defs.def_en: A VIP is someone who is given better treatment than ordinary people because they are famous, influential, or important. VIP is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'very important person'.

defs.def_cn: 唾液，唾沫(常指唾沫星子)
defs.def_en: Spit is the watery liquid produced in your mouth. You usually use spit to refer to an amount of it that has been forced out of someone's mouth.

defs.def_cn: 吐唾沫(常表示憎恨或轻蔑)

ext.ext_cn: 那伙人也想过要揍他，但最后只是啐了他一口。
ext.ext_en: The gang thought of hitting him too, but decided just to spit...

ext.ext_cn: 他们朝我吐唾沫，还嘲笑我。
ext.ext_en: They spat at me and taunted me...

defs.def_en: If someone spits, they force an amount of liquid out of their mouth, often to show hatred or contempt.

ext.ext_cn: 把那块口香糖吐出来，注意听。
ext.ext_en: Spit out that gum and pay attention...

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉就像有一条蛇朝自己的双眼里喷射了毒液。
ext.ext_en: He felt as if a serpent had spat venom into his eyes...

defs.def_en: If you spit liquid or food somewhere, you force a small amount of it out of your mouth.

defs.def_cn: (机器) 噼啪作响;(煮着的食物)毕剥作响

ext.ext_cn: 发动机发出劈啪声，接着是砰的一声响。
ext.ext_en: The engine spat and banged.

ext.ext_cn: 把猪排烤得嗞嗞啦啦响的炉火
ext.ext_en: ...the fire where pork chops were sizzling and spitting.

defs.def_en: If something such as a machine or food that is cooking spits, it sends out small amounts of something, making a series of short, sharp noises.

ext.ext_cn: “该死的，等一下”，明迪愤愤地说道，“谁也没说过要过夜。”
ext.ext_en: 'Wait a damn minute,' Mindy spat. 'Nobody said anything about staying overnight.'...

ext.ext_cn: 克拉默愤愤地骂了一句脏话。
ext.ext_en: Cramer spat an obscenity.

defs.def_en: If someone spits an insult or comment, they say it in an angry or hostile way.

ext.ext_cn: 雨很快就会停的——这只不过是毛毛雨。
ext.ext_en: It will stop in a minute — it's only spitting.

defs.def_en: If it is spitting, it is raining very lightly.

ext.ext_cn: 她用烤肉叉子烤肉。
ext.ext_en: She roasted the meat on a spit.

defs.def_en: A spit is a long rod which is pushed through a piece of meat and hung over an open fire to cook the meat.
A spit of land is a long, flat, narrow piece of land that sticks out into the sea.

ext.ext_cn: 离伦敦塔非常近的一个餐馆
ext.ext_en: ...a restaurant within spitting distance of the Tower of London.

defs.def_en: If one place is within spitting distance of another, they are very close to each other.

defs.def_cn: 极像…的人;和…一模一样的人

ext.ext_cn: 尼娜看起来像极了茜茜·斯帕赛克。
ext.ext_en: Nina looks the spitting image of Sissy Spacek.

defs.def_en: If you say that one person is the spitting image of another, you mean that they look very similar.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个聪明人，是个好小伙。
ext.ext_en: He's an intelligent man and a nice fella...

ext.ext_cn: “你是个不可理喻的家伙。”费尔贝恩气冲冲地说。
ext.ext_en: 'You're a funny feller,' Fairbairn said grumpily.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a man as a fella .

defs.def_cn: (用于 double, single 等形容词后)表示“…层的”

ext.ext_cn: 载满了游客的红色双层巴士
ext.ext_en: ...a red double-decker bus full of tourists.

ext.ext_cn: 三层的花生酱和果酱夹心三明治
ext.ext_en: ...a triple-decker peanut butter and jelly sandwich.

defs.def_en: -decker is used after adjectives like 'double' and 'single' to indicate how many levels or layers something has.

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔走下病床去招待客人。
ext.ext_en: Michael left his sickbed to entertain his house guests.

defs.def_en: Your sickbed is the bed that you are lying in while you are ill.
An advertiser is a person or company that pays for a product, event, or job to be advertised in a newspaper, on television, or on a poster.

defs.def_cn: (用于某些地方报纸的名称中)

ext.ext_cn: 《克罗伊登广告报》
ext.ext_en: ...the Croydon Advertiser.

defs.def_en: Advertiser is used in the name of some local newspapers.
A bulldozer is a large vehicle with a broad metal blade at the front, which is used for knocking down buildings or moving large amounts of earth.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 下垂的;松垂的;松弛耷拉的

ext.ext_cn: 床垫是否高低不平并且下陷？
ext.ext_en: Is the mattress lumpy and saggy?...

ext.ext_cn: 每天只锻炼 20 分钟，即使最松弛的臀部也会变挺翘。
ext.ext_en: Exercise for just 20 minutes a day to firm up even the saggiest bottom.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as saggy, you mean that it has become less firm over a period of time and become unattractive.

ext.ext_cn: 不论从哪个方面来说，他们都受到了隆重的接待。
ext.ext_en: They were royally received in every aspect...

ext.ext_cn: 他记得他们后来喝得烂醉。
ext.ext_en: They then get royally drunk in his memory.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is done royally, you are emphasizing that it is done in an impressive or grand way, or that it is very great in degree.
The aircrew on a plane are the pilot and other people who are responsible for flying it and for looking after any passengers who are on it.

defs.def_cn: 皮氏培养皿（实验室中用于微生物培养的有盖平盘）
defs.def_en: A Petri dish is a flat dish with a lid, used in laboratories for producing cultures of microorganisms.
A papergirl is a girl who delivers newspapers to people's homes.

defs.def_cn: (尤指政界的)自由市场论者,支持自由市场者
defs.def_en: A free-marketeer is someone, especially a politician, who is in favour of letting market forces control the economy.

defs.def_cn: （关系的）破裂；（计划、讨论等的）失败，结束

ext.ext_cn: 美国和欧盟官员间谈判的破裂
ext.ext_en: ...the breakdown of talks between the US and EU officials.

ext.ext_cn: 无法挽回的婚姻破裂
ext.ext_en: ...the irretrievable breakdown of a  marriage...

defs.def_en: The breakdown of something such as a relationship, plan, or discussion is its failure or ending.

ext.ext_cn: 我个人的生活一团糟。母亲去世了，几年后我又患上了神经衰弱。
ext.ext_en: My personal life was terrible. My mother had died, and a couple of years later I had a breakdown...

ext.ext_cn: 他们经常显得很沮丧，精神濒于崩溃的边缘。
ext.ext_en: They often seem depressed and close to emotional breakdown.

defs.def_en: See also:nervous breakdown;If you have a breakdown, you become very depressed, so that you are unable to cope with your life.

ext.ext_cn: 她的旧车老不听使唤，一路上总是出故障。
ext.ext_en: Her old car was unreliable, so the trip was plagued by breakdowns...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你的车坏在路肩上了，就得等警察或修理站来帮忙。
ext.ext_en: If you stop on the hard shoulder, wait for the police or breakdown service.

defs.def_en: If a car or a piece of machinery has a breakdown, it stops working.

ext.ext_cn: 向组织者提供了一份开支细目。
ext.ext_en: The organisers were given a breakdown of the costs.

defs.def_en: A breakdown of something is a list of its separate parts.

defs.def_cn: （用来构成形容词和名词，表示反对某种制度、做法或群体的人或事）反…

ext.ext_cn: 反政府的示威游行
ext.ext_en: ...anti-government demonstrations.

ext.ext_cn: 反种族主义活动家
ext.ext_en: ...anti-racist campaigners.

defs.def_en: Anti- is used to form adjectives and nouns that describe someone or something that is opposed to a particular system, practice, or group of people.

defs.def_cn: （用来构成形容词和名词）表示“防…”，“抗…”，“阻止”

ext.ext_cn: 高射炮
ext.ext_en: ...anti-aircraft guns.

ext.ext_cn: 反歧视法
ext.ext_en: ...anti-discrimination legislation.

defs.def_en: Anti- is used to form adjectives and nouns that describe things that are intended to destroy something harmful or to prevent something from happening.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 当我们到达苏珊家时，她非常热情。
ext.ext_en: When we arrived at her house Susan was very welcoming...

ext.ext_cn: 她脸上展露出热情的笑容。
ext.ext_en: Her face spread in a welcoming smile.

defs.def_en: If someone is welcoming or if they behave in a welcoming way, they are friendly to you when you arrive somewhere, so that you feel happy and accepted.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （建筑物或房间）舒适的，惬意的

ext.ext_cn: 这家餐厅小巧精致，绿意盎然，令人感到非常惬意。
ext.ext_en: The restaurant is small and green and very welcoming.

defs.def_en: A welcoming building or room looks pleasant and you feel as though you would be happy and comfortable spending time there.

ext.ext_cn: 应将旁枝剪至主串上一叶高处
ext.ext_en: Side shoots should be cut back to one leaf above the basal cluster.

ext.ext_cn: 皮肤的基底层
ext.ext_en: ...the basal layer of the skin.

defs.def_en: Basal means relating to or forming the base of something.

defs.def_cn: 基本的；处于休息状态的

ext.ext_cn: 定期运动能够提高你的基础代谢率。
ext.ext_en: Regular exercise can increase your basal metabolic rate...

ext.ext_cn: 冷水中生物的基础代谢速度要低很多。
ext.ext_en: Basal metabolism is much lower for creatures in cold water.

defs.def_en: Your basal metabolic rate is the rate at which your body uses energy when it is at rest.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正在削减教育经费。
ext.ext_en: They're cutting funds for education...

ext.ext_cn: 保罗延长了他的受教育时间，打算花6年时间深造英语。
ext.ext_en: Paul prolonged his education with six years of advanced study in English.

defs.def_en: Education involves teaching people various subjects, usually at a school or college, or being taught.

ext.ext_cn: 更好的健康教育
ext.ext_en: ...better health education.

defs.def_en: Education of a particular kind involves teaching the public about a particular issue.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 思想狭隘的;心胸狭窄的

ext.ext_cn: 偏执的盲从者
ext.ext_en: ...a narrow-minded bigot.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as narrow-minded, you are criticizing them because they are unwilling to consider new ideas or other people's opinions.

ext.ext_cn: 几家公司正推出新的入门级产品，期望吸引更多的顾客。
ext.ext_en: Several companies are offering new, entry-level models in hopes of attracting more buyers.

defs.def_en: Entry-level is used to describe basic low-cost versions of products such as cars or computers that are suitable for people who have no previous experience or knowledge of them.

ext.ext_cn: 很多初级水平工作都由中学毕业生来做。
ext.ext_en: Many entry-level jobs were filled by school leavers.

defs.def_en: Entry-level jobs are suitable for people who do not have previous experience or qualifications in a particular area of work.

defs.def_cn: (罗盘上的)方位基点,基本方位(即东、西、南、北)
defs.def_en: The cardinal points are the four main points of the compass, north, south, east, and west.
An obstetrician is a doctor who is specially trained to deal with pregnant women and with women who are giving birth.

ext.ext_cn: 女子文法学校的运动场
ext.ext_en: ...the playing fields of the girls' Grammar School.

defs.def_en: A playing field is a large area of grass where people play sports.

defs.def_cn: 公平竞争的环境；机会均等的环境

ext.ext_cn: 我们寻求一个能与外国公司公平竞争的环境。
ext.ext_en: We ask for a level playing field when we compete with foreign companies.

defs.def_en: You talk about a level playing field to mean a situation that is fair, because no competitor or opponent in it has an advantage over another.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以去划船或者打网球。
ext.ext_en: You can go boating or play tennis...

ext.ext_cn: 他们死于一起划船事故。
ext.ext_en: They were killed in a boating accident.

defs.def_en: Boating is travelling on a lake or river in a small boat for pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 我睡觉很轻，几乎就没睡着。
ext.ext_en: I'm a very light sleeper and I can hardly get any sleep at all...

ext.ext_cn: 与睡眠好的人相比，睡眠不好的人要花更长的时间才能入睡。
ext.ext_en: Poor sleepers take longer to fall asleep than good sleepers.

defs.def_en: You can use sleeper to indicate how well someone sleeps. For example, if someone is a light sleeper, they are easily woken up.

defs.def_cn: (英国英语的)卧铺车厢,卧铺铺位（在美国英语中，sleeping car 指卧铺车厢，roomette 则指一个卧铺的铺位)
defs.def_en: In British English, a sleeper is a carriage on a train containing beds for passengers to sleep in at night, or a section of such a carriage. The usual American words are sleeping car for the carriage and roomette for the section.
A sleeper is a train with beds for its passengers to sleep in at night.
Railway sleepers are large heavy beams that support the rails of a railway track.

defs.def_cn: 出乎意料的成功者;爆冷门的人(或事物)

ext.ext_cn: 凭借着《童子军》的意外走红而首尝成功的年轻荷兰作家——曼诺·梅耶斯
ext.ext_en: ...Menno Meyjes, a young Dutch writer, who had had his first success with the sleeper 'The Children's Crusade'.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as a sleeper, you mean that they unexpectedly become successful, often after a long period of being inactive or unknown.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 绝大多数人口都是城镇居民。
ext.ext_en: Most of the population is an urban population...

ext.ext_cn: 绝大多数城区附近都有公园。
ext.ext_en: Most urban areas are close to a park.

defs.def_en: Urban means belonging to, or relating to, a town or city.

ext.ext_cn: 旅游旺季在度假小屋住一周通常需花费约70英镑。
ext.ext_en: A typical high-season week in a chalet costs about £70.

defs.def_en: The high season is the time of year when a place has most tourists or visitors.

ext.ext_cn: 爬第一座小山花了半个钟头。
ext.ext_en: Climbing the first hill took half an hour...

ext.ext_cn: 他拎起手提箱，爬上了楼梯。
ext.ext_en: He picked up his suitcase and climbed the stairs...

defs.def_en: If you climb something such as a tree, mountain, or ladder, or climb up it, you move towards the top of it. If you climb down it, you move towards the bottom of it.

ext.ext_cn: 姑娘们匆忙跑了出来，爬进汽车，然后开车走了。
ext.ext_en: The girls hurried outside, climbed into the car, and drove off...

ext.ext_cn: 他肯定是从婴儿床里爬出来的。
ext.ext_en: He must have climbed out of his cot...

defs.def_en: If you climb somewhere, you move there carefully, for example because you are moving into a small space or trying to avoid falling.

defs.def_cn: (飞机等)爬升，升高;(太阳)升高，上升

ext.ext_cn: 飞机起飞前往洛杉矶，在爬升过程中一台发动机熄火，刚飞离跑道就坠毁了。
ext.ext_en: The plane took off for LA, lost an engine as it climbed, and crashed just off the runway.

defs.def_en: When something such as an aeroplane climbs, it moves upwards to a higher position. When the sun climbs, it moves higher in the sky.

ext.ext_cn: 自去年6月以来，该国的失业率一直在不断上升。
ext.ext_en: The nation's unemployment rate has been climbing steadily since last June...

ext.ext_cn: 年初以来，物价已经上涨了21%。
ext.ext_en: Prices have climbed by 21% since the beginning of the year...

defs.def_en: When something climbs, it increases in value or amount.

defs.def_cn: 有前途的人;有能耐的人
defs.def_en: A high-flyer is someone who has a lot of ability and is likely to be very successful in their career.

ext.ext_cn: 你在第9章会找到所有细节。
ext.ext_en: You will find all the particulars in Chapter 9...

ext.ext_cn: 住院接待处的护士询问了她的详细情况。
ext.ext_en: The nurses at the admission desk asked her for particulars.

defs.def_en: The particulars of something or someone are facts or details about them which are written down and kept as a record.

defs.def_cn: 隐秘的动机;不可告人的目的

ext.ext_cn: 他指责一些国家有不可告人的目的，意图损害法国的影响力。
ext.ext_en: He accused foreign nations of having a hidden agenda to harm French influence...

ext.ext_cn: 有没有不可告人的动机？
ext.ext_en: Is there a hidden agenda?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a hidden agenda, you are criticizing them because you think they are secretly trying to achieve or cause a particular thing, while they appear to be doing something else.

ext.ext_cn: 20 世纪 40 年代对科学的神化
ext.ext_en: ...the deification of science in the 1940s.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the deification of someone or something, you mean that they are regarded with very great respect and are not criticized at all.

ext.ext_cn: 这控制着液体的吸收。
ext.ext_en: This controls the absorption of liquids...

ext.ext_cn: 维生素C促进食物中铁的吸收。
ext.ext_en: Vitamin C increases the absorption of iron from food.

defs.def_en: The absorption of a liquid, gas, or other substance is the process of it being soaked up or taken in.

ext.ext_cn: 为收容难民又备好了两个新营地。
ext.ext_en: Two new camps were readied for the absorption of refugees.

defs.def_en: The absorption of a group into a larger group is the process of it becoming part of the larger group.

ext.ext_cn: 他被艺术家对创作的全身心投入所打动。
ext.ext_en: He was struck by the artists' total absorption in their work.

defs.def_en: Someone's absorption in something is the fact that they are very interested in it and that it takes up all their attention and energy.

defs.def_cn: 缠结;纠结;乱糟糟的一团

ext.ext_cn: 原来的计算机和电话系统如今只剩下乱糟糟的一团电线。
ext.ext_en: A tangle of wires is all that remains of the computer and phone systems...

ext.ext_cn: 他站在那儿，头发乱成一团，下巴上一片黑胡茬。
ext.ext_en: There he stood: hair in wild tangles, dark stubble shadowing his chin.

defs.def_en: A tangle of something is a mass of it twisted together in an untidy way.

ext.ext_cn: 动物被缠进渔网里淹死了。
ext.ext_en: Animals get tangled in fishing nets and drown...

ext.ext_cn: 她想把睡衣踢脱，可是它却和缎子床单绞到了一块。
ext.ext_en: She tried to kick the pajamas loose, but they were tangled in the satin sheet...

defs.def_en: If something is tangled or tangles, it becomes twisted together in an untidy way.

ext.ext_cn: 我在想，我们卷入了怎样的纷争之中。
ext.ext_en: I was thinking what a tangle we had got ourselves into.

ext.ext_cn: 国内政局的错综复杂
ext.ext_en: ...the tangle of domestic politics.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a confusing or complicated situation as a tangle .

ext.ext_cn: 马赫福兹先生讲述的故事过于宏大，主题有些混乱了。
ext.ext_en: The themes get tangled in Mr. Mahfouz's epic storytelling...

ext.ext_cn: 你眼下头脑不清了，对于金钱和感情的忧虑交织在了一起。
ext.ext_en: You are currently in a muddle where financial and emotional concerns are tangled together.

defs.def_en: If ideas or situations are tangled, they become confused and complicated.

defs.def_en: If one thing is a metaphor for another, it is intended or regarded as a symbol of it.

ext.ext_en: Moldavians and Romanians share a common language...

ext.ext_en: Such behaviour is common to all young people.

ext.ext_cn: 常见的家蝇

defs.def_en: When there are more animals or plants of a particular species than there are of related species, then the first species is called common .

ext.ext_en: Democracy might elevate the common man to a position of political superiority...

ext.ext_en: He didn't have the common courtesy to ask permission.
