A credit transfer is a direct payment of money from one bank account into another.
If a student has a credit transfer when they change from one school or college to another, their credits are transferred from their old school or college to their new one.

defs.def_cn: 惹恼；引起…的敌意（或反感）

ext.ext_cn: 他不想引起她的反感。
ext.ext_en: He didn't want to antagonize her.

defs.def_en: If you antagonize someone, you make them feel angry or hostile towards you.

ext.ext_cn: 这些香草会激发你去品尝各种异国风味的菜肴！
ext.ext_en: These herbs will inspire you to try out all sorts of exotic-flavoured dishes!...

ext.ext_cn: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。
ext.ext_en: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause...

defs.def_en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

defs.def_cn: 启发;使产生灵感和热情

ext.ext_cn: 吉米·亨德里克斯启发了整整一代吉他演奏者。
ext.ext_en: Jimi Hendrix inspired a generation of guitarists.

defs.def_en: If someone or something inspires you, they give you new ideas and a strong feeling of enthusiasm.

defs.def_cn: 作为…的为灵感来源;是…的原型

ext.ext_cn: 那本书的灵感源于一个真实人物,即塔玛拉·德特罗。
ext.ext_en: The book was inspired by a real person, namely Tamara de Treaux.

ext.ext_cn: 正是由正在毁掉该国的民族主义冲突激发的一起政治谋杀
ext.ext_en: ...a political murder inspired by the same nationalist conflicts now wrecking the country.

defs.def_en: If a book, work of art, or action is inspired by something, that thing is the source of the idea for it.

defs.def_cn: 激起，唤起(某种感情或反应)

ext.ext_cn: 该汽车的性能会很快唤起驾驶者的信心。
ext.ext_en: The car's performance quickly inspires confidence.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that inspires a particular emotion or reaction in people makes them feel this emotion or reaction.

defs.def_cn: (尤当 had 为助动词时，we had 的常用口语形式)

ext.ext_cn: 快点，乔治，我们最好现在就回去。
ext.ext_en: Come on, George, we'd better get back now...

ext.ext_cn: 当时我们真的没有什么能跟警方说的。
ext.ext_en: At the time we'd really nothing to tell the police.

defs.def_en: We'd is the usual spoken form of 'we had', especially when 'had' is an auxiliary verb.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们吸烟的话，会点一支让她也试试的。
ext.ext_en: If we smoked, we'd light a cigarette and let her try it out...

ext.ext_cn: 我真不知道没有她我们该怎么办！
ext.ext_en: I don't know how we'd have managed without her!

defs.def_en: We'd is the usual spoken form of 'we would'.
A llama is a South American animal with thick hair, which looks like a small camel without a hump.

ext.ext_cn: 这顿美餐是他母亲和他的姐妹们准备的。
ext.ext_en: The feast was served by his mother and sisters...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的无礼和不专业让我震惊。
ext.ext_en: I was amazed by their discourtesy and lack of professionalism...

defs.def_en: If something is done by a person or thing, that person or thing does it.

defs.def_cn: （图书、音乐、绘画等）由…（创作），出自

ext.ext_cn: 一幅凡·高的画
ext.ext_en: ...a painting by Van Gogh...

ext.ext_cn: 阿德里安·莱恩的最新电影《雅各的天梯》讲的是一个发生在越战后的恐怖故事。
ext.ext_en: 'Jacob's Ladder', the newest film by Adrian Lyne, is a post-Vietnam horror story.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a book, a piece of music, or a painting is by a particular person, you mean that this person wrote it or created it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们将开车旅行。
ext.ext_en: We'll be travelling by car.

ext.ext_cn: 烛光晚餐
ext.ext_en: ...dinners by candlelight.

defs.def_en: If you do something by a particular means, you do it using that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 把奶油和高汤一起放在平底锅里熬煮来制作调味料。
ext.ext_en: Make the sauce by boiling the cream and stock together in a pan...

ext.ext_cn: 这艘游艇的船员为清一色的女性，她们进行了首次环球航行，创造了历史。
ext.ext_en: The all-female yacht crew made history by becoming the first to sail round the world...

defs.def_en: If you achieve one thing by doing another thing, your action enables you to achieve the first thing.

defs.def_cn: （用于短语中）由于，出于（偶然或意外）

ext.ext_cn: 我昨天外出散步时碰巧遇见了他。
ext.ext_en: I met him by chance out walking yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 他不小心拆了英格丽德的信。
ext.ext_en: He opened Ingrid's letter by mistake...

defs.def_en: You use by in phrases such as 'by chance' or 'by accident' to indicate whether or not an event was planned.

defs.def_cn: 就（本性、职业或出身）而言

ext.ext_cn: 拥有一个天性仁爱的贤妻，我当然很幸运。
ext.ext_en: I am certainly lucky to have a kind wife who is loving by nature...

ext.ext_cn: 她的职业是护士，现在开办了一个妇女咨询中心。
ext.ext_en: She's a nurse by profession and now runs a counselling service for women...

defs.def_en: If someone is a particular type of person by nature, by profession, or by birth, they are that type of person because of their nature, their profession, or the family they were born into.

defs.def_cn: 根据，按照（法律或某种标准）

ext.ext_cn: 法律规定药剂师必须按照医生开的处方配药。
ext.ext_en: Pharmacists are required by law to give the medicine prescribed by the doctor.

ext.ext_cn: 以他的标准来看相当朴素的晚礼服
ext.ext_en: ...evening wear that was discreet by his standards.

defs.def_en: If something must be done by law, it happens according to the law. If something is the case by particular standards, it is the case according to the standards.

ext.ext_cn: 斯特拉知道他说“重来”是什么意思。
ext.ext_en: Stella knew what he meant by 'start again'...

ext.ext_cn: “你真是太幸运了。”——“你这话是什么意思？”
ext.ext_en: 'You're unbelievably lucky.' — 'What do you mean by that?'

defs.def_en: If you say what someone means by a particular word or expression, you are saying what they intend the word or expression to refer to.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示抓住身体某部位或握住物体某部分）

ext.ext_cn: 他抓住她的肩膀把她的身子转了过来。
ext.ext_en: He caught her by the shoulder and turned her around...

ext.ext_cn: 她被拉着胳膊带到走廊另一头的一个小房间里。
ext.ext_en: She was led by the arm to a small room at the far end of the corridor...

defs.def_en: If you hold someone or something by a particular part of them, you hold that part.

ext.ext_cn: 朱迪丝正坐在窗户边的一张摇椅里。
ext.ext_en: Judith was sitting in a rocking-chair by the window...

ext.ext_cn: 费利西蒂·马克斯韦尔站在吧台旁，要了一杯红酒。
ext.ext_en: Felicity Maxwell stood by the bar and ordered a glass of wine...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is by something else is beside it and close to it.

ext.ext_cn: 几辆车贴着我开过去。
ext.ext_en: A few cars passed close by me...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直在街对面走着，并与街这边的我交错而过。
ext.ext_en: He kept walking and passed by me on his side of the street.

defs.def_en: If a person or vehicle goes by you, they move past you without stopping.

ext.ext_cn: 我们已安排好去造访她位于帕西菲克格罗夫的家。
ext.ext_en: We had made arrangements to stop by her house in Pacific Grove...

ext.ext_cn: 爸爸打来电话让我去他办公室一趟。
ext.ext_en: Daddy called and asked me to drop by his office.

defs.def_en: If you stop by a place, you visit it for a short time.

ext.ext_cn: 到8点时，他已经到达我住的宾馆了。
ext.ext_en: By eight o'clock he had arrived at my hotel...

ext.ext_cn: 到那时，我们都知道事情实际上已经结束了。
ext.ext_en: We all knew by then that the affair was practically over.

defs.def_en: If something happens by a particular time, it happens at or before that time.

ext.ext_cn: 白天的时候，妇女可以安全地在街上行走，而到了夜晚人行道上会变得很危险。
ext.ext_en: By day a woman could safely walk the streets, but at night the pavements became dangerous...

ext.ext_cn: 她可不想独自在夜晚匆匆走过伦敦的街道。
ext.ext_en: She had no wish to hurry alone through the streets of London by night.

defs.def_en: If you do something by day, you do it during the day. If you do it by night, you do it during the night.

ext.ext_en: ...an apparent annual rate of 22.8 per cent (1.9 multiplied by 12)...

ext.ext_cn: 230厘米除以22厘米等于10.45厘米。
ext.ext_en: 230cm divided by 22cm is 10.45cm.

defs.def_en: In arithmetic, you use by before the second number in a multiplication or division sum.

defs.def_cn: 乘（表示长乘宽得出的居室等的面积）

ext.ext_cn: 3个囚犯关在一个3米长2米宽的小牢房里。
ext.ext_en: Three prisoners were sharing one small cell 3 metres by 2 metres.

defs.def_en: You use by to talk about measurements of area. For example, if a room is twenty feet by fourteen feet, it measures twenty feet in one direction and fourteen feet in the other direction.

ext.ext_cn: 暴力犯罪自去年以来增加了10%。
ext.ext_en: Violent crime has increased by 10 percent since last year...

ext.ext_cn: 他们薪水降低了1/3。
ext.ext_en: Their pay has been cut by one-third.

defs.def_en: If something increases or decreases by a particular amount, that amount is gained or lost.

ext.ext_cn: 包裹成打地从美国运来。
ext.ext_en: Parcels arrived by the dozen from America...

ext.ext_cn: 利伯蒂布按米出售，既可用作装饰又可作衣料。
ext.ext_en: Liberty fabrics, both for furnishing and for dressmaking, are sold by the metre.

defs.def_en: Things that are made or sold by the million or by the dozen are made or sold in those quantities.

ext.ext_cn: 他的父亲开始一点点地失去记忆，变得越来越健忘。
ext.ext_en: His father began to lose his memory bit by bit, becoming increasingly forgetful.

defs.def_en: You use by in expressions such as 'minute by minute' and 'drop by drop' to talk about things that happen gradually, not all at once.

ext.ext_cn: 一个独自坐在角落里的黑发男人
ext.ext_en: ...a dark-haired man sitting by himself in a corner.

defs.def_en: If you are by yourself, you are alone.

ext.ext_cn: 我不知道自己是否能够独自养大一个孩子。
ext.ext_en: I didn't know if I could raise a child by myself.

defs.def_en: If you do something by yourself, you succeed in doing it without anyone helping you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一小撮尖胡须
ext.ext_en: ...a pointy little beard.

defs.def_en: Something that is pointy has a point at one end.

ext.ext_cn: 他们脚下的流沙
ext.ext_en: ...the shifting sand beneath their feet...

ext.ext_cn: 伊洛卡的克罗地亚小镇就是人口不停流动的典型例子。
ext.ext_en: The Croatian town of Ilok is a classic case of shifting populations.

defs.def_en: See also:shift;Shifting is used to describe something which is made up of parts that are continuously moving and changing position in relation to other parts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有德行的;道德高尚的;正直的

ext.ext_cn: 路易斯在人们眼里是一个智慧、勇敢、品德高尚的顾家男人。
ext.ext_en: Louis was shown as an intelligent, courageous and virtuous family man.

defs.def_en: A virtuous person behaves in a moral and correct way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自命不凡的;自鸣得意的

ext.ext_cn: 我打扫了整个公寓，这让我觉得自己很了不起。
ext.ext_en: I cleaned the flat, which left me feeling virtuous.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as virtuous, you mean that they have done what they ought to do and feel very pleased with themselves, perhaps too pleased.

ext.ext_cn: 年轻的聋哑男子
ext.ext_en: ...a young deaf and dumb man.

defs.def_en: Someone who is dumb is completely unable to speak.

defs.def_cn: (在某种场合下因愤怒或惊讶而)说不出话的,哑口无言的

ext.ext_cn: 一时间我们惊讶得哑口无言。
ext.ext_en: We were all struck dumb for a minute.

defs.def_en: If someone is dumb on a particular occasion, they cannot speak because they are angry, shocked, or surprised.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我遇到过很多笨蛋。
ext.ext_en: I've met a lot of dumb people...

ext.ext_cn: 问题这么设计，就是为了让她出丑。
ext.ext_en: The questions were set up to make her look dumb.

defs.def_en: If you call a person dumb, you mean that they are stupid or foolish.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 愚蠢的;令人心烦的;令人恼火的

ext.ext_cn: 我想出了这个馊主意。
ext.ext_en: I came up with this dumb idea...

ext.ext_cn: 让人恼火的是媒体。
ext.ext_en: It's the media that's dumb.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is dumb, you think that it is silly and annoying.

defs.def_cn: 无声的;无言的;不用言语表达的

ext.ext_cn: 她不语，从她脸上掠过的一丝表情可知她是认得的。
ext.ext_en: An expression of dumb recognition wiggled across her features.

defs.def_en: Something that is dumb is done or expressed without words.
Horticulture is the study and practice of growing plants.
A crucible is a pot in which metals or other substances can be melted or heated up to very high temperatures.

ext.ext_cn: 各种观点得以在党派纷争的严峻考验中得到检验的体系
ext.ext_en: ...a system in which ideas are tested in the crucible of party contention...

ext.ext_cn: 该政权成为右翼思想和右翼价值观形成的熔炉。
ext.ext_en: The regime served as a crucible for the forging of right-wing ideas and values.

defs.def_en: Crucible is used to refer to a situation in which something is tested or a conflict takes place, often one which produces something new.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不打算给那些陷入困境的公司开空白支票。
ext.ext_en: We are not prepared to write a blank cheque for companies that have run into trouble.

defs.def_en: If someone is given a blank cheque, they are given the authority to spend as much money as they need or want.

ext.ext_cn: 从某种意义上来说，他已经全权负责建立新南非的协商工作。
ext.ext_en: He was, in a sense, given a blank cheque to negotiate the new South Africa.

defs.def_en: If someone is given a blank cheque, they are given the authority to do what they think is best in a particular situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 适应大城市生活的;在大城市混得开的

ext.ext_cn: 索尔特和佩帕是两个来自皇后区的精明泼辣的女孩。
ext.ext_en: Salt and Peppa are two streetwise and sassy girls from Queens.

ext.ext_cn: 骄傲、精明、自以为无所不知的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...a cocky, streetwise kid who thought he knew it all.

defs.def_en: Someone who is streetwise knows how to deal with difficult or dangerous situations in big cities.

defs.def_cn: （大批地）居住于，生活于，栖居于

ext.ext_cn: 在所有这一切发生之前，这个岛上居住的是印第安阿拉瓦克人。
ext.ext_en: Before all this the island was populated by native American Arawaks.

ext.ext_cn: 生活在周围村庄的当地信德人
ext.ext_en: ...native Sindhis, who populate the surrounding villages.

defs.def_en: If an area is populated by certain people or animals, those people or animals live there, often in large numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 各继任政权吞并了该地区，并将低地的人们迁移到了这里。
ext.ext_en: Successive regimes annexed the region and populated it with lowland people.

defs.def_en: To populate an area means to cause people to live there.

ext.ext_cn: 占据法国政权上层的勤勉、审慎的技术专家型官员
ext.ext_en: ...the diligent and discreet technocrats who populate the upper reaches of French power.

ext.ext_cn: 电影里那种来自下层社会的人物
ext.ext_en: ...the sort of low-life characters who populate the film.

defs.def_en: The people or characters who populate an area of public life or a piece of entertainment are the people or characters in it.

defs.def_cn: 逐步破坏，渐渐削弱(观点、感觉或体制)

ext.ext_cn: 叛乱分子并不打算明目张胆地发动政变，而是想要逐渐削弱她的权力。
ext.ext_en: Instead of an outright coup attempt, the rebels want to chip away at her authority.

defs.def_en: If you chip away at something such as an idea, a feeling, or a system, you gradually make it weaker or less likely to succeed by repeated efforts.

defs.def_cn: 逐渐还清(债务);慢慢减少(金额)

ext.ext_cn: 该集团本指望通过变卖固定资产逐步还清债务。
ext.ext_en: The group had hoped to chip away at its debts by selling assets.

defs.def_en: If you chip away at a debt or an amount of money, you gradually reduce it.
CFS is an abbreviation for (缩略=) chronic fatigue syndrome .

defs.def_cn: （英联邦各国互相派驻的）高级专员
defs.def_en: A High Commissioner is a senior representative who is sent by one Commonwealth country to live in another in order to work as an ambassador.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国难民事务高级专员
ext.ext_en: ...the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees.

defs.def_en: A High Commissioner is the head of an international commission.

ext.ext_cn: 令人失望的销售额预示着会有更多人被裁员。
ext.ext_en: The disappointing sales figures foreshadow more redundancies...

ext.ext_cn: 上个月提议的变动在 3 月份的预算中已经有所预兆了。
ext.ext_en: The change proposed last month was foreshadowed in the March Budget.

defs.def_en: If something foreshadows an event or situation, it suggests that it will happen.
A fort is a strong building or a place with a wall or fence around it where soldiers can stay and be safe from the enemy.

ext.ext_cn: 他不在的时候，其生意伙伴代为负责。
ext.ext_en: His business partner is holding the fort while he is away.

defs.def_en: If you hold the fort for someone, or, in American English, if you hold down the fort, you look after things for them while they are somewhere else or are busy doing something else.

ext.ext_cn: 其含意不言而喻。
ext.ext_en: The implication was plain, if left unstated...

ext.ext_cn: 他辞职的另一个没有言明的理由可能是他遭到了起诉。
ext.ext_en: An additional, unstated reason for his resignation may have been a lawsuit filed against him.

defs.def_en: You say that something is unstated when it has not been expressed in words.

defs.def_cn: （有时用于街名）大街，街道（书面缩略形式为Ave.）

ext.ext_cn: 帕克大街上最贵的商店
ext.ext_en: ...the most expensive stores on Park Avenue.

defs.def_en: Avenue is sometimes used in the names of streets. The written abbreviation Ave. is also used.
An avenue is a wide, straight road, especially one with trees on either side.

ext.ext_cn: 给塔尔博特提出了80种进行调查的可能途径。
ext.ext_en: Talbot was presented with 80 potential avenues of investigation...

ext.ext_cn: 还有一个办法可用，但需要进一步的磋商。
ext.ext_en: There is another avenue to pursue — it involves further negotiations.

defs.def_en: An avenue is a way of getting something done.

defs.def_cn: 催人泪下的戏剧(或电影、书籍)
defs.def_en: If you refer to a play, film, or book as a tear-jerker, you are indicating that it is very sad or sentimental.

Electioneering is the activities that politicians and their supporters carry out in order to persuade people to vote for them or their political party in an election, for example making speeches and visiting voters.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 热烈赞扬的；热情洋溢的

ext.ext_cn: 媒体一直盛赞两国关系。
ext.ext_en: The media has been speaking in glowing terms of the relationship between the two countries...

ext.ext_cn: 他首演的几部戏都获得了如潮好评。
ext.ext_en: The premieres of his plays brought in glowing reviews.

defs.def_en: See also:glow;A glowing description or opinion about someone or something praises them highly or supports them strongly.

defs.def_cn: （主干道上通常铺有草坪的）中央分隔带,中央分道区,中间安全区
defs.def_en: The median strip is the strip of ground, often covered with grass, that separates the two sides of a major road.

ext.ext_cn: 下面的壁炉架上陈列的是一批17世纪的郁金香花瓶。
ext.ext_en: Beneath this, on the mantelshelf, is displayed a collection of seventeenth-century tulip vases.

defs.def_en: A mantelshelf is a mantelpiece.

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得我在夸大其词。
ext.ext_en: He thinks I'm exaggerating...

ext.ext_cn: 别夸张。
ext.ext_en: Don't exaggerate...

defs.def_en: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

ext.ext_cn: 这些数字夸大了竞争力的丧失。
ext.ext_en: These figures exaggerate the loss of competitiveness...

ext.ext_cn: 那件连衣裙凸显了她的蜂腰，也让她的胸部看起来更丰满。
ext.ext_en: The dress exaggerates her wasp waist and enlarges her bosom.

defs.def_en: If something exaggerates a situation, quality, or feature, it makes the situation, quality, or feature appear greater, more obvious, or more important than it really is.

ext.ext_cn: 当袭击发生后，没有任何援助受害人的方案。
ext.ext_en: When the attack took place, there were no victim support schemes.

defs.def_en: Victim support is the giving of help and advice to people who are victims of crime.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都需要寻求降低碳排放量的方法。

defs.def_cn: 复杂混乱的情况;乱糟糟的一堆;困境

ext.ext_en: I tried to drag myself out of the morass of despair.

ext.ext_cn: 经济混乱
ext.ext_en: ...the economic morass.

defs.def_en: If you describe an unpleasant or confused situation as a morass, you mean that it seems impossible to escape from or resolve, because it has become so serious or so complicated.

defs.def_cn: 政府文职机构;行政部门；（统称）行政工作人员

ext.ext_cn: 行政机关的工作
ext.ext_en: ...a job in the Civil Service.

defs.def_en: The Civil Service of a country consists of its government departments and all the people who work in them. In many countries, the departments concerned with military and legal affairs are not part of the Civil Service.

ext.ext_cn: 低热量、高纤维的食谱
ext.ext_en: ...low-cal, high-fiber recipes.

defs.def_en: Low-cal food is food that contains only a few calories. People who are trying to lose weight eat low-cal food.

ext.ext_cn: 反对该措施的人士认为这是一场政治作秀，会对经济发展带来严重的打击。
ext.ext_en: Opponents of the measure say it's political grandstanding that could prove devastating to the economy.

defs.def_en: Grandstanding means behaving in a way that makes people pay attention to you instead of thinking about more important matters.

ext.ext_cn: 他因为冒失无礼受到惩罚。
ext.ext_en: He was punished for his impertinence.

defs.def_en: If someone talks or behaves in a rather impolite and disrespectful way, you can call this behaviour impertinence or an impertinence .

ext.ext_cn: 英国许多海滩连最起码的卫生标准都达不倒。
ext.ext_en: Many of Britain's beaches fail to meet minimum standards of cleanliness.

ext.ext_cn: 个人卫生的重要性
ext.ext_en: ...the importance of personal cleanliness.

defs.def_en: Cleanliness is the degree to which people keep themselves and their surroundings clean.

defs.def_cn: （尤指男士在正式场合戴的）蝴蝶领结
defs.def_en: A bow tie is a tie in the form of a bow. Bow ties are worn by men, especially for formal occasions.

ext.ext_cn: 战争的压力让他一时丧失了神志。
ext.ext_en: The stress of war temporarily unhinged him.

defs.def_en: If you say that an experience has unhinged someone, you mean that it has affected them so deeply that they have become mentally ill.

ext.ext_cn: 大幅减少我们固体废料问题的可能性
ext.ext_en: ...the potential of greatly reducing our solid waste problem...

ext.ext_en: He did not eat solid food for several weeks.

defs.def_en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

ext.ext_cn: 固体在一定的温度下会变为液体。
ext.ext_en: Solids turn to liquids at certain temperatures.

ext.ext_cn: 固体的分解
ext.ext_en: ...the decomposition of solids.

defs.def_en: A solid is a substance that stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 雪已经融化了，湖面却依然冻得硬邦邦的。
ext.ext_en: The snow had melted, but the lake was still frozen solid...

ext.ext_cn: 混凝土会像岩石一样坚固。
ext.ext_en: The concrete will stay as solid as a rock.

defs.def_en: A substance that is solid is very hard or firm.

defs.def_cn: 无空隙的;实心的;非中空的

ext.ext_cn: 打通了 50 英尺厚的实心岩石修建而成的隧道
ext.ext_en: ...a tunnel carved through 50ft of solid rock.

ext.ext_cn: 五彩缤纷、密密实实的林带
ext.ext_en: ...a solid wall of multicoloured trees.

defs.def_en: A solid object or mass does not have a space inside it, or holes or gaps in it.

ext.ext_cn: 水龙头似乎是用纯金制成的。
ext.ext_en: The taps appeared to be made of solid gold.

ext.ext_cn: 实木门
ext.ext_en: ...solid wood doors.

defs.def_en: If an object is made of solid gold or solid wood, for example, it is made of gold or wood all the way through, rather than just on the outside.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 银行往往建得看上去很坚固，好让顾客放心。
ext.ext_en: Banks are built to look solid to reassure their customers...

ext.ext_cn: 这部车子令人感觉十分皮实。
ext.ext_en: The car feels very solid.

defs.def_en: A structure that is solid is strong and is not likely to collapse or fall over.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你要的是一个可靠而稳重的丈夫——一个全心全意对你的人。
ext.ext_en: You want a husband who is solid and stable, someone who will devote himself to you...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的乐手都来自值得我们尊敬的工人阶级。
ext.ext_en: All the band come from good, solid, working-class backgrounds...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as solid, you mean that they are very reliable and respectable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (证据、消息等)可靠的，确凿的，有根有据的

ext.ext_cn: 我们还没有得到关于大家现在所处位置的确切消息。
ext.ext_en: We don't have good solid information on where the people are...

ext.ext_cn: 需要的是一些确凿的证据。
ext.ext_en: Some solid evidence was what was required...

defs.def_en: Solid evidence or information is reliable because it is based on facts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (工作、意见等)切实有用的，充实的，实实在在的

ext.ext_cn: 哥伦比亚国际大学为教堂在许多问题上提供了切实有用的建议。
ext.ext_en: The CIU provides churches with solid advice on a wide range of subjects...

ext.ext_cn: 我就希望能有一个上佳的表现。
ext.ext_en: All I am looking for is a good solid performance...

defs.def_en: You use solid to describe something such as advice or a piece of work which is useful and reliable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (政策的依据、对组织的支持)牢固的，坚实的，充分的

ext.ext_cn: 我决定在这个坚实的基础之上继续努力。
ext.ext_en: I am determined to build on this solid foundation.

ext.ext_cn: 拥有党内成员的强力支持、受到党外民众广泛欢迎的民主党提名人
ext.ext_en: ...a Democratic nominee with solid support within the party and broad appeal beyond.

defs.def_en: You use solid to describe something such as the basis for a policy or support for an organization when it is strong, because it has been developed carefully and slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一起共事了整整两年时间。
ext.ext_en: We had worked together for two solid years.

defs.def_en: If you do something for a solid period of time, you do it without any pause or interruption throughout that time.

ext.ext_cn: 买新电器时，电器经销商往往会拿走旧电器，有时会以旧换新。
ext.ext_en: Electrical retailers will often take away old appliances if you buy a new one, sometimes in part-exchange.

ext.ext_cn: 以旧换新
ext.ext_en: ...part-exchange deals.

defs.def_en: If you give an old item in part exchange for something you are buying, the seller accepts the old item as part of the payment, so you do not have to give them as much money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指先天性的）畸形的，变形的，残缺的

ext.ext_cn: 畸形婴儿
ext.ext_en: ...malformed babies...

ext.ext_cn: 这些管状器官先天畸形的现象更加少见。
ext.ext_en: More rarely, the tubes have been malformed from birth.

defs.def_en: If people or parts of their body are malformed, they do not have the shape or form that they are supposed to, especially when they have been like this since birth.

defs.def_cn: 梦想家;空想家;不切实际的人

ext.ext_cn: 她是个头脑冷静的务实派,绝不是一个不切实际的人。
ext.ext_en: Far from being a dreamer, she's a level-headed pragmatist.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a dreamer, you mean that they spend a lot of time thinking about and planning for things that they would like to happen but which are improbable or impractical.

defs.def_cn: 扰乱狩猎活动者;破坏猎狐运动者
defs.def_en: A hunt saboteur is someone who tries to stop a hunt from taking place or being successful because they believe it is cruel to the animal being hunted.

ext.ext_en: ...plans to modernize the refinery...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的选举制度迫切需要现代化。
ext.ext_en: There is a pressing need to modernise our electoral system.

defs.def_en: To modernize something such as a system or a factory means to change it by replacing old equipment or methods with new ones.
A teddy bear is a children's toy, made from soft or furry material, which looks like a friendly bear.

ext.ext_cn: 脾气相当暴躁的老倔头
ext.ext_en: ...such a terrible old curmudgeon.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a curmudgeon, you do not like them because they are mean or bad-tempered.
A tranquillizer is a drug that makes people feel calmer or less anxious. Tranquillizers are sometimes used to make people or animals become sleepy or unconscious.

ext.ext_en: The Daily News once had the highest circulation of any daily in the country...

ext.ext_cn: 事实证明这家报纸难以维持其发行量。
ext.ext_en: The paper has proved unable to maintain its circulation figures.

defs.def_en: The circulation of a newspaper or magazine is the number of copies that are sold each time it is produced.

ext.ext_en: Anyone with heart, lung or circulation problems should seek medical advice before flying.

ext.ext_cn: 血液循环不畅导致的手指上的冻疮
ext.ext_en: ...cold spots in the fingers caused by poor circulation.

defs.def_en: Your circulation is the movement of blood through your body.

defs.def_cn: (货币等)流通/不流通/退出流通

ext.ext_en: The supply of money in circulation was drastically reduced overnight.

ext.ext_en: ...a society like America, with perhaps 180 million guns in circulation.

defs.def_en: If something such as money is in circulation, it is being used by the public. If something is out of circulation or has been withdrawn from circulation, it is no longer available for use by the public.

defs.def_cn: (一段时间)不出现在公共场合，不参加社交活动;坐牢;服刑

ext.ext_cn: 通过对著名活动家进行政治审判使其从公众视线中消失。
ext.ext_en: Political trials were being used to keep prominent activists out of circulation...

ext.ext_en: I had been out of circulation for a month and knew that many friends would be there.

defs.def_en: If someone is out of circulation, they do not appear in public or at social gatherings for a period of time. You can also say that someone is out of circulation when they are in prison.

defs.def_cn: 玷污，毁坏，损害，败坏(地位、名誉)

ext.ext_cn: 反对派领导人说，选举中存在舞弊现象。
ext.ext_en: Opposition leaders said that the elections had been tainted by corruption.

ext.ext_en: ...a series of political scandals that has tainted the political stars of a generation.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is tainted by something bad or undesirable, their status or reputation is harmed because they are associated with it.

ext.ext_cn: 她的政府从来没有真正摆脱掉腐败的阴影。
ext.ext_en: Her government never really shook off the taint of corruption...

ext.ext_cn: 哪怕是再纯真的恋情她也能从中嗅出罪恶的味道。
ext.ext_en: She could smell the taint of sin in the most innocent of passions.

defs.def_en: A taint is an undesirable quality which spoils the status or reputation of someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 变质的油会破坏味道。
ext.ext_en: Rancid oil will taint the flavour.

ext.ext_cn: 被艾滋病毒和肝炎病毒污染的血液
ext.ext_en: ...blood tainted with the AIDS and hepatitis viruses.

defs.def_en: If an unpleasant substance taints food or medicine, the food or medicine is spoiled or damaged by it.

ext.ext_en: They admonished me for taking risks with my health...

ext.ext_cn: 她温柔地责备他：“你要多休息，少说话。”
ext.ext_en: She admonished him gently, 'You should rest, not talk so much.'

defs.def_en: If you admonish someone, you tell them very seriously that they have done something wrong.

ext.ext_en: ...a bright morning in mid-December...

ext.ext_cn: 她的孩子是 12 月 4 号出生的。
ext.ext_en: Her baby was born on 4th December...

defs.def_en: December is the twelfth and last month of the year in the Western calendar.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Most religions teach you to be truthful…

ext.ext_cn: 我们都学会了要非常坦诚地对待自己的个人生活。
ext.ext_en: We've all learnt to be fairly truthful about our personal lives...

defs.def_en: If a person or their comments are truthful, they are honest and do not tell any lies.

defs.def_cn: 伤害名誉;人身攻击;背后说坏话

ext.ext_cn: 小报上开始了对那位已故女士全方位的人身攻击。
ext.ext_en: A full-scale character assassination of the dead woman got underway in the tabloid press.

defs.def_en: A character assassination is a deliberate attempt to destroy someone's reputation, especially by criticizing them in an unfair and dishonest way when they are not present.

defs.def_cn: (用于构成名词或形容词)中间，中部，中期

ext.ext_cn: 18世纪中叶
ext.ext_en: ...the mid-eighteenth century...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维丝35岁左右。
ext.ext_en: Davis is in her mid-thirties.

defs.def_en: Mid- is used to form nouns or adjectives that refer to the middle part of a particular period of time, or the middle point of a particular place.

defs.def_cn: 专科院校;学院;(美国的)私立中学

ext.ext_cn: 皇家音乐学院
ext.ext_en: ...the Royal Academy of Music.

ext.ext_cn: 她在警校当教官的经历
ext.ext_en: ...her experience as a police academy instructor.

defs.def_en: Academy is sometimes used in the names of schools and colleges, especially those specializing in particular subjects or skills, or private high schools in the United States.

ext.ext_cn: 美国心理治疗师学会
ext.ext_en: ...the American Academy of Psychotherapists...

ext.ext_cn: 英国电影和电视艺术学院
ext.ext_en: The British Academy of Film and Television Arts.

defs.def_en: Academy appears in the names of some societies formed to improve or maintain standards in a particular field.

ext.ext_cn: 陈旧的铁床架
ext.ext_en: ...an old iron bedstead.

defs.def_en: A bedstead is the metal or wooden frame of an old-fashioned bed.

defs.def_cn: 按时间顺序的;按先后次序的

ext.ext_cn: 我把这些报道按时间顺序整理好了。
ext.ext_en: I have arranged these stories in chronological order.

defs.def_en: If things are described or shown in chronological order, they are described or shown in the order in which they happened.

defs.def_cn: (年龄)自然的，实龄的(与心理年龄或身心发展程度相对)
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's chronological age, you are referring to the number of years they have lived, in contrast to their mental age or the stage they have reached in their physical or emotional development.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他已经变成了一个愤世嫉俗、冷酷无情的成年人。
ext.ext_en: He had turned into an embittered, hardened adult...

ext.ext_cn: 当杰拉尔德感到人们没有真诚待他时，就变得乖张易怒，怨恨不平。
ext.ext_en: Gerald turned sour and embittered when he felt people were not dealing honestly with him.

defs.def_en: If someone is embittered, they feel angry and unhappy because of harsh, unpleasant, and unfair things that have happened to them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们担心一个更加强大的欧洲议会只会增强大国的力量。
ext.ext_en: A stronger European Parliament would, they fear, only reinforce the power of the larger countries...

ext.ext_cn: 这种优越感往往会被外部世界强化。
ext.ext_en: This sense of privilege tends to be reinforced by the outside world.

defs.def_en: If something reinforces a feeling, situation, or process, it makes it stronger or more intense.

defs.def_cn: 给予…更多支持;为…提供更多证据

ext.ext_cn: 让我们更加意识到自己生活的世界充满威胁和危险的电影
ext.ext_en: ...films that reinforce the idea that we live in a threatening and risky world.

defs.def_en: If something reinforces an idea or point of view, it provides more evidence or support for it.

ext.ext_cn: 最终，他们不得不通过增加外梁来对墙体进行加固。
ext.ext_en: Eventually, they had to reinforce the walls with exterior beams.

defs.def_en: To reinforce an object means to make it stronger or harder.

defs.def_cn: 为(军队或警察队伍)增加力量（或装备）；向（某地）增兵;增援

ext.ext_cn: 双方经过昨天的激战后都在向各自的阵地增派兵力。
ext.ext_en: Both sides have been reinforcing their positions after yesterday's fierce fighting...

ext.ext_cn: 巴基斯坦南部的海得拉巴市已增派了军队和警力。
ext.ext_en: Troops and police have been reinforced in the southern Pakistan city of Hyderabad.

defs.def_en: To reinforce an army or a police force means to make it stronger by increasing its size or providing it with more weapons. To reinforce a position or place means to make it stronger by sending more soldiers or weapons.

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须及时找到解决这些问题的方法。
ext.ext_en: We must find a way to resolve these problems before it's too late...

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望这场危机能够得到和平解决。
ext.ext_en: They hoped the crisis could be resolved peacefully.

defs.def_en: To resolve a problem, argument, or difficulty means to find a solution to it.

ext.ext_cn: 她决定把这件事汇报给医院的护士长。
ext.ext_en: She resolved to report the matter to the hospital's nursing manager...

ext.ext_cn: 她决定，如果米米忘记了这个承诺，她就提醒她。
ext.ext_en: She resolved that, if Mimi forgot this promise, she would remind her.

defs.def_en: If you resolve to do something, you make a firm decision to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这会坚定美国公众诉诸战争的决心。
ext.ext_en: This will strengthen the American public's resolve to go to war.

defs.def_en: Resolve is determination to do what you have decided to do.

ext.ext_cn: 就像音乐家那样将混乱嘈杂的声音变成优美和谐的旋律
ext.ext_en: ...like a musician resolving a confused mass of sound into melodic or harmonic order...

ext.ext_cn: 每一束螺旋光都分解成了光点。
ext.ext_en: Each of the spirals of light resolved into points.

defs.def_en: If you resolve something into a clearer form, or if it resolves into a clearer form, its shape or the different parts it contains become clear.
A cockroach is a large brown insect that is sometimes found in warm places or where food is kept.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼尔斯冷静、坦率时状态最佳；而好斗、爱辩时则不然。
ext.ext_en: Daniels is at his best when he's cool and direct, rather than combative and polemical.

ext.ext_cn: 克莱默尖锐的辩论小说
ext.ext_en: ...Kramer's biting polemical novel.

defs.def_en: Polemical means arguing very strongly for or against a belief or opinion.

ext.ext_cn: 加强安全的运动
ext.ext_en: ...a campaign to beef up security...

ext.ext_cn: 双方仍在增强各自的军事力量。
ext.ext_en: Both sides are still beefing up their military strength.

defs.def_en: If you beef up something, you increase, strengthen, or improve it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 仅靠现金不能使东欧的银行维持下去。
ext.ext_en: Cash alone will not make Eastern Europe's banks viable...

ext.ext_cn: 目标是要建立一个能够使家庭农场得以存续的国家，并使其维持下去。
ext.ext_en: The goal has been to establish and sustain a nation of viable family farms.

defs.def_en: Something that is viable is capable of doing what it is intended to do.

ext.ext_en: Five viable pregnancies were established.

defs.def_en: Foetuses, seeds, or eggs are described as viable if they are capable of developing into living beings without outside help.

defs.def_cn: (通常指不快的)一阵强烈情感

ext.ext_cn: 我时而会感到阵阵内疚。
ext.ext_en: I would have twinges of guilt occasionally…

defs.def_en: Food that is meaty contains a lot of meat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些简短而翔实的报告是他的最爱。
ext.ext_en: The short, meaty reports are those he likes best...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管她以扮演头脑简单的金发女郎著称，这一次她却得到了一个人物形象更丰满的角色。
ext.ext_en: Famous for playing dizzy blondes, this time she has been given a more meaty role.

defs.def_en: You can describe something such as a piece of writing or a part in a film as meaty if it contains a lot of interesting or important material.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他两只胖乎乎的手搁在大腿上，上下打量着这个走廊。
ext.ext_en: He looked up and down the corridor, meaty hands resting on his thighs.

ext.ext_cn: 一位双臂丰腴、很有亲和力的女士
ext.ext_en: ...a pleasant lady with meaty arms.

defs.def_en: You can describe a part of someone's body as meaty if it is big and strong.

defs.def_cn: （用于英国或英联邦政府的公函上）为女王（或英王）陛下效劳
defs.def_en: OHMS is used on official letters from British or Commonwealth government offices. OHMS is the abbreviation for (缩略=) 'On Her Majesty's Service' or 'On His Majesty's Service'.

ext.ext_cn: 据说在上一周的战斗中有200多人丧生。
ext.ext_en: More than two hundred people have reportedly been killed in the past week's fighting...

ext.ext_cn: 据说现在莫斯科已经同意继续销售。
ext.ext_en: Now Moscow has reportedly agreed that the sale can go ahead...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is reportedly true, you mean that someone has said that it is true, but you have no direct evidence of it.

defs.def_cn: 结账退房;结账离开(诊所);给…办理结账手续

ext.ext_cn: 他们收拾好东西，办理了退房手续。
ext.ext_en: They packed and checked out of the hotel...

ext.ext_cn: 我非常失望没有见着布赖恩，他刚退房走了。
ext.ext_en: I was disappointed to miss Bryan, who had just checked out...

defs.def_en: When you check out of a hotel or clinic where you have been staying, or if someone checks you out, you pay the bill and leave.

ext.ext_cn: 或许我们应该去趟图书馆，查个明白。
ext.ext_en: Maybe we ought to go down to the library and check it out...

ext.ext_cn: 我们理应在电脑上查清他的资料。
ext.ext_en: We ought to check him out on the computer...

defs.def_en: If you check out something or someone, you find out information about them to make sure that everything is correct or satisfactory.

defs.def_cn: 经证实是对的;符合要求

ext.ext_cn: 詹森遇害的那个周末她在圣迭戈，后经查证情况属实。
ext.ext_en: She was in San Diego the weekend Jensen got killed. It checked out...

ext.ext_cn: 查过了，一切正常。
ext.ext_en: Everything checks out.

defs.def_en: If something checks out, it is correct or satisfactory.

ext.ext_cn: 吃时将司康饼切半，抹上果酱和大量凝脂奶油。
ext.ext_en: Serve by cutting the scones in half and spreading with jam and lashings of clotted cream.

ext.ext_cn: 连场粗俗闹剧
ext.ext_en: ...lashings of slapstick comedy.

defs.def_en: Lashings of something means a large quantity or amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在那艘游艇上四处看了看，检查了它的系索和应急装置。
ext.ext_en: We made a tour of the yacht, checking lashings and emergency gear.

defs.def_en: Lashings are ropes or cables that are used to tie one thing to another.

ext.ext_cn: 他始终无法忍受评论界对他的刻薄抨击。
ext.ext_en: He never grew used to the lashings he got from the critics.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's comments as a lashing, you mean that they are very critical and angry.
A lashing is a punishment in which a person is hit with a whip.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可觉察的;可发现的;可查出的

ext.ext_cn: 医生说该疾病可能是遗传而来，但在出生时无法查出。
ext.ext_en: Doctors say the disease is probably inherited but not detectable at birth.

defs.def_en: Something that is detectable can be noticed or discovered.

ext.ext_cn: 多数人反对这种暴力的手段。
ext.ext_en: Most people disapprove of such violent tactics...

ext.ext_cn: 她母亲不赞成她在酒吧工作。
ext.ext_en: Her mother disapproved of her working in a pub...

defs.def_en: If you disapprove of something or someone, you feel or show that you do not like them or do not approve of them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不动感情的；不带偏见的

ext.ext_cn: 作为检察官，我们对经手的案件会尽力做到不偏不倚。
ext.ext_en: We, as prosecutors, try to be dispassionate about the cases we bring...

ext.ext_cn: 他以一个讲师般平板、不动感情的口吻说话。
ext.ext_en: He spoke in the flat, dispassionate tone of a lecturer.

defs.def_en: Someone who is dispassionate is calm and reasonable, and not affected by emotions.

defs.def_cn: (与形容词连用)表示“有…性格(或态度、意见等)的”

ext.ext_cn: 这是一些心理阴暗的人。
ext.ext_en: These are evil-minded people...

ext.ext_cn: 他说一不二的职业作风是出了名的。
ext.ext_en: He is famous for his tough-minded professionalism.

defs.def_en: -minded combines with adjectives to form words that describe someone's character, attitude, opinions, or intelligence.

defs.def_cn: (与副词连用构成形容词)表示“对…感兴趣的”，“有…头脑的”

ext.ext_cn: 我不是一个喜欢作研究的人。
ext.ext_en: I am not an academically-minded person...

ext.ext_cn: 他没有学机械的头脑。
ext.ext_en: He was not mechanically-minded.

defs.def_en: -minded combines with adverbs to form adjectives that indicate that someone is interested in a particular subject or is able to think in a particular way.

defs.def_cn: (与名词连用构成形容词)表示“一心想…的”，“满脑子是…的”

ext.ext_cn: 人们认为比起他的前任来，他更有实干精神。
ext.ext_en: He is seen as more business-minded than his predecessor...

ext.ext_cn: 过去我们不像今天的女孩子那么有事业心。
ext.ext_en: We weren't career-minded like girls are today.

defs.def_en: -minded combines with nouns to form adjectives that indicate that someone thinks a particular thing is important or cares a lot about it.
A death camp is a place where prisoners are kept, especially during a war, and where many of them die or are killed.

ext.ext_cn: 随着冷战即将结束，对话就只是一种形式了。
ext.ext_en: With the Cold War almost over, the talks were a mere formality.

defs.def_en: If you say that an action or procedure is just a formality, you mean that it is done only because it is normally done, and that it will not have any real effect on the situation.

ext.ext_cn: 给他们办理入境和通关手续只用了短短几分钟时间。
ext.ext_en: They are whisked through the immigration and customs formalities in a matter of minutes.

defs.def_en: See also:formal;Formalities are formal actions or procedures that are carried out as part of a particular activity or event.
If a person is paid hush money, someone gives them money not to reveal information they have which could be damaging or embarrassing.

ext.ext_cn: 12名犯人在一场监狱暴乱中被杀害。
ext.ext_en: Twelve inmates have been killed during a riot at the prison.

defs.def_en: When there is a riot, a crowd of people behave violently in a public place, for example they fight, throw stones, or damage buildings and vehicles.

ext.ext_cn: 去年，600名犯人闹事，他们纵火并设置路障。
ext.ext_en: Last year 600 inmates rioted, starting fires and building barricades...

ext.ext_cn: 他们发动暴乱，以抗议政府的行为。
ext.ext_en: They rioted in protest against the government.

defs.def_en: If people riot, they behave violently in a public place.

defs.def_cn: 五颜六色;丰富多彩;各种各样

ext.ext_cn: 所有的仙人掌都开花了，整个沙漠里五彩缤纷。
ext.ext_en: All the cacti were in flower, so that the desert was a riot of colour...

ext.ext_cn: 印度菜肴口味丰富，并添加各种香料。
ext.ext_en: With Indian cuisine, you expect a riot of tastes and spices.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is a riot of something pleasant such as colour, you mean that there is a large amount of various types of it.

defs.def_cn: 严厉警告…停止闹事;严厉警告…注意言行

ext.ext_cn: 我很高兴你警告比利不许胡闹。他还是个孩子，仍然需要有人告诉他该做什么。
ext.ext_en: I'm glad you read the riot act to Billy. He's still a kid and still needs to be told what to do.

defs.def_en: If someone in authority reads you the riot act, they tell you that you will be punished unless you start behaving properly.

defs.def_cn: 失去控制;变得狂乱;无法无天

ext.ext_cn: 斯特兰韦斯监狱里那些狂暴的囚犯们全都失去了控制。
ext.ext_en: Rampaging prisoners ran riot through Strangeways jail.

defs.def_en: If people run riot, they behave in a wild and uncontrolled manner.

defs.def_cn: (想象力等)狂野，不受拘束，任意发挥

ext.ext_cn: 音乐学院让你有充分的理由任想象力自由驰骋。
ext.ext_en: A conservatory offers the perfect excuse to let your imagination run riot.

ext.ext_cn: 我们没有证据，只要没有证据，谣言就会满天飞。
ext.ext_en: We have no proof and when there is no proof, rumour runs riot.

defs.def_en: If something such as your imagination runs riot, it is not limited or controlled, and produces ideas that are new or exciting, rather than sensible.

defs.def_cn: 买方市场（指市场上某种东西供过于求，有利于买方选择和压价）
defs.def_en: When there is a buyer's market for a particular product, there are more of the products for sale than there are people who want to buy them, so buyers have a lot of choice and can make prices come down.

ext.ext_cn: 烧毁的汽车
ext.ext_en: ...a burnt-out car.

defs.def_en: Burnt-out vehicles or buildings have been so badly damaged by fire that they can no longer be used.

defs.def_cn: 精疲力竭的；劳累过度的

ext.ext_cn: 我所认识的每个一直保持那种强度的人都劳累过度。
ext.ext_en: But everyone I know who kept it up at that intensity is burnt out.

defs.def_en: If someone is burnt-out, they exhaust themselves at an early stage in their life or career because they have achieved too much too quickly.
A mare is an adult female horse.

defs.def_cn: 把…做得过分；把…做得过火；对…过于夸张

ext.ext_cn: 美国中央银行承认将利率上调至6%可能是过度紧缩了银根
ext.ext_en: ...a recognition by the US central bank that it may have overdone its tightening when it pushed rates up to 6 per cent...

ext.ext_cn: 他想辞去工作，在家照看孩子。而她却觉得这样做有些过头。
ext.ext_en: He wants to give up working and stay home to look after the children. She feels, however, that this is overdoing it a bit.

defs.def_en: If someone overdoes something, they behave in an exaggerated or extreme way.

ext.ext_cn: 重要的是,不要过度练习新学的动作。
ext.ext_en: It is important never to overdo new exercises...

ext.ext_cn: 出租车司机协会劝告那些工作时长不受限制的会员不要疲劳驾驶。
ext.ext_en: The taxi drivers' association is urging its members, who can work as many hours as they want, not to overdo it.

defs.def_en: If you overdo an activity, you try to do more than you can physically manage.

defs.def_cn: 老同学间的互相关照；校友关系网

ext.ext_cn: 大多数人都是通过校友关系谋得其职位的。
ext.ext_en: The majority obtained their positions through the old boy network.

defs.def_en: When people talk about the old-boy network, they are referring to a situation in which people who went to the same public school or university use their positions of influence to help each other.

ext.ext_cn: 解决良策掌握在政府手中。
ext.ext_en: The remedy lies in the hands of the government.

ext.ext_cn: 解决经济问题的良方妙策
ext.ext_en: ...a remedy for economic ills.

defs.def_en: A remedy is a successful way of dealing with a problem.

ext.ext_cn: 有助于治疗冬季传染病的自然疗法
ext.ext_en: ...natural remedies to help overcome winter infections.

defs.def_en: A remedy is something that is intended to cure you when you are ill or in pain.

ext.ext_cn: 已经做了很多内部工作对这种情形进行补救。
ext.ext_en: A great deal has been done internally to remedy the situation.

defs.def_en: If you remedy something that is wrong or harmful, you correct it or improve it.

defs.def_cn: (美国由选举产生的)县治安官

ext.ext_cn: 当地的县治安官
ext.ext_en: ...the local sheriff.

ext.ext_cn: 县治安官鲍勃·卡希尔
ext.ext_en: ...Sheriff Bob Cahill.

defs.def_en: In the United States, a sheriff is a person who is elected to make sure that the law is obeyed in a particular county.

ext.ext_cn: 首席法官——郡法官约翰·莫厄特
ext.ext_en: ...the presiding judge, Sheriff John Mowatt.

defs.def_en: In Scotland, a sheriff is a legal officer whose chief duty is to act as judge in a Sheriff Court. These courts deal with all but the most serious crimes and with most civil actions.

defs.def_cn: (英格兰和威尔士境内挂名的名誉)郡长，郡督

ext.ext_cn: 牛津的郡长
ext.ext_en: ...the Sheriff of Oxford.

defs.def_en: In England and Wales, the Sheriff of a city or county is a person who is elected or appointed to carry out mainly ceremonial duties.

ext.ext_cn: 那些不堪难民潮困扰的国家希望马上建立安全区。
ext.ext_en: Countries overwhelmed by the human tide of refugees want safe havens set up at once.

defs.def_en: If part of a country is declared a safe haven, people who need to escape from a dangerous situation such as a war can go there and be protected.

ext.ext_cn: 一些民主党人支持为海地人在美国提供临时避难所。
ext.ext_en: Some Democrats support granting the Haitians temporary safe haven in the US.

defs.def_en: If a country provides safe haven for people from another country who have been in danger, it allows them to stay there under its official protection.

ext.ext_cn: 认为家庭是躲避外面残酷世界的避风港的想法
ext.ext_en: ...the idea of the family as a safe haven from the brutal outside world.

defs.def_en: A safe haven is a place, a situation, or an activity which provides people with an opportunity to escape from things that they find unpleasant or worrying.

defs.def_cn: 布尔什维克的；布尔什维克主义的

ext.ext_cn: 在布尔什维克革命爆发的74年之后，苏维埃时代终结了。
ext.ext_en: Seventy-four years after the Bolshevik Revolution, the Soviet era ended.

ext.ext_cn: 反布尔什维克的力量
ext.ext_en: ...anti-Bolshevik forces.

defs.def_en: Bolshevik is used to describe the political system and ideas that Lenin and his supporters introduced in Russia after the Russian Revolution of 1917.

defs.def_cn: 布尔什维克；布尔什维克主义者
defs.def_en: A Bolshevik was a person who supported Lenin and his political ideas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 妙极的;惹人喜爱的;了不起的

ext.ext_cn: 这场雨过后,野花会变得美不胜收。
ext.ext_en: The wildflowers will be incredible after this rain...

ext.ext_cn: 谢谢你带我去,我玩得非常开心。
ext.ext_en: Thanks for taking me, I had an incredible time...

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as incredible, you like them very much or are impressed by them, because they are extremely or unusually good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可思议的;难以置信的

ext.ext_cn: 在战时人们仍然想踢足球,这似乎不可思议。
ext.ext_en: It seemed incredible that people would still want to play football during a war...

ext.ext_cn: 我们不应把孩子们告诉我们的一些不可思议的故事当成谎话而不予理睬。
ext.ext_en: We should not dismiss as lies the incredible stories that children may tell us.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is incredible, you mean that it is very unusual or surprising, and you cannot believe it is really true, although it may be.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们从欧洲大陆进口数量惊人的奶酪。
ext.ext_en: We import an incredible amount of cheese from the Continent...

ext.ext_cn: 声音异常嘈杂。
ext.ext_en: There was an incredible din...

defs.def_en: You use incredible to emphasize the degree, amount, or intensity of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们家门口有两棵枝繁叶茂的大橡树。
ext.ext_en: There were two very large oak trees in front of our house with wide spreading branches and luxuriant foliage.

defs.def_en: Luxuriant plants,  trees, and gardens are large, healthy, and growing well.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 健康浓密的头发需要定期修剪。
ext.ext_en: Hair that's thick and luxuriant needs regular trimming.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's hair as luxuriant, you mean that it is very thick and healthy.
Ornithology is the study of birds.

defs.def_cn: （尤指拍击海岸的）大浪花，大海浪
defs.def_en: See also:ice-breaker;law-breaker;record-breaker;strike-breaker;Breakers are big sea waves, especially at the point when they just reach the shore.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 投资航空业风险很大。
ext.ext_en: Investing in airlines is a very risky business...

ext.ext_cn: 自以为我们了解投票人在一年后的想法是很危险的行为。
ext.ext_en: It's risky to assume that we know what voters will be thinking in a year's time.

defs.def_en: If an activity or action is risky, it is dangerous or likely to fail.

ext.ext_cn: 最终布尔什维克和德国签署了停战协议。
ext.ext_en: Finally, the Bolsheviks signed an armistice with Germany.

defs.def_en: An armistice is an agreement between countries who are at war with one another to stop fighting and to discuss ways of making peace.

defs.def_cn: 对(新设备等)做现场试验

ext.ext_cn: 我们自己对其进行了实地试验，很高兴没有出现问题。
ext.ext_en: We've field-tested them ourselves and are happy that they work.

ext.ext_cn: 现场测试将在布莱尔城堡和伯利庄园进行。
ext.ext_en: Field tests are to be carried out at Blair Castle and Burghley.

defs.def_en: If you field-test a new piece of equipment, you test it in a real, natural environment.

ext.ext_cn: 金属探测器
ext.ext_en: ...a metal detector.

ext.ext_cn: 火警报警器和烟雾检测器
ext.ext_en: ...fire alarms and smoke detectors.

defs.def_en: A detector is an instrument which is used to discover that something is present somewhere, or to measure how much of something there is.

ext.ext_cn: 媒体会歪曲事实，将人说得不是完美无缺就是一无是处。
ext.ext_en: The media distorts reality; categorises people as all good or all bad...

ext.ext_cn: 部长说他周末的讲话被曲解了。
ext.ext_en: The minister has said his remarks at the weekend have been distorted.

defs.def_en: If you distort a statement, fact, or idea, you report or represent it in an untrue way.

ext.ext_cn: 画家可能会对线条和形状进行夸大或扭曲。
ext.ext_en: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms...

ext.ext_cn: 漫画家们总是把他画得变形了。
ext.ext_en: His size was persistently distorted by the cartoonists...

defs.def_en: If something you can see or hear is distorted or distorts, its appearance or sound is changed so that it seems unclear.

ext.ext_cn: 坠机是导航不力的直接后果。
ext.ext_en: The crash was a direct result of inadequate navigational aids.

defs.def_en: Navigational means relating to the act of navigating a ship or an aircraft.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数仓鸮都是笼养的。
ext.ext_en: The great majority of barn owls are reared in captivity...

ext.ext_cn: 一位美国传教士在被关押两个多月后于今天获释。
ext.ext_en: An American missionary was released today after more than two months of captivity...

defs.def_en: Captivity is the state of being kept imprisoned or enclosed.

ext.ext_cn: 他们辉煌的学术成就被当作了典范。
ext.ext_en: Their great academic success was paraded as paradigmatic.

defs.def_en: You can describe something as paradigmatic if it acts as a model or example for something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （改变或区别）显著的，显而易见的

ext.ext_cn: 侵财案件明显增加了。
ext.ext_en: There has been a marked increase in crimes against property...

ext.ext_cn: 他处事严谨，与他爱张扬的妻子形成了鲜明的对比。
ext.ext_en: He was a man of austere habits, in marked contrast to his more flamboyant wife...

defs.def_en: A marked change or difference is very obvious and easily noticed.

defs.def_cn: 成为攻击对象的;处境危险的

ext.ext_cn: 他只消打一个电话，我就大难临头了。
ext.ext_en: All he needs to do is make one phone call and I'm a marked man.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a marked man or woman, you mean that they are in danger from someone who wants to harm or kill them.

defs.def_cn: (处理违章停车的)交通管理员
defs.def_en: A traffic warden is a person whose job is to make sure that cars are not parked illegally.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as uncritical, you mean that they do not judge whether someone or something is good or bad, right or wrong, before supporting or believing them.

defs.def_cn: (感觉、理解)加强;(使)加深;(技巧)提高;(使)改善

ext.ext_en: This seemed madly dangerous.

defs.def_en: You can use madly in front of an adjective in order to emphasize the quality expressed by the adjective.

defs.def_en: If you implement something such as a plan, you ensure that what has been planned is done.

ext.ext_en: ...knives and other useful implements.

ext.ext_cn: 书写用具
ext.ext_en: ...writing implements.

defs.def_en: An implement is a tool or other piece of equipment.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a stay-at-home, you mean that they stay at home rather than going out to work or travelling.

ext.ext_en: Both sisters bit their nails as children...

ext.ext_en: He bit into his sandwich...

defs.def_en: If you bite something, you use your teeth to cut into it, for example in order to eat it or break it. If an animal or person bites you, they use their teeth to hurt or injure you.

ext.ext_en: He took another bite of apple...

ext.ext_en: You cannot eat a bun in one bite.

ext.ext_en: It was time to go home for a little rest and a bite to eat.

defs.def_en: If you have a bite to eat, you have a small meal or a snack.

ext.ext_en: Any dog bite, no matter how small, needs immediate medical attention.

defs.def_en: A bite is an injury or a mark on your body where an animal, snake, or small insect has bitten you.

ext.ext_en: As the sanctions begin to bite there will be more political difficulties ahead...

ext.ext_en: The recession started biting deeply into British industry.

defs.def_en: When an action or policy begins to bite, it begins to have a serious or harmful effect.

ext.ext_en: There may even be some wire or nylon biting into the flesh...

defs.def_en: If an object bites into a surface, it presses hard against it or cuts into it.

defs.def_cn: （食物或酒的）浓郁味道，辛辣味

defs.def_en: If you say that a food or drink has bite, you like it because it has a strong or sharp taste.

ext.ext_en: There was a bite in the air, a smell perhaps of snow.

defs.def_en: If the air or the wind has a bite, it feels very cold.

ext.ext_en: The teams have that extra bite when they are playing against their neighbours...

ext.ext_en: The novel seems to lack bite and tension—even passion.

defs.def_en: If something such as a performance or a piece of writing has bite, it is exciting or effective.

ext.ext_en: If I don't get a bite in a few minutes I lift the rod and twitch the bait.

defs.def_en: If a fish bites when you are fishing, it takes the hook or bait at the end of your fishing line in its mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 谈话的片段
ext.ext_en: ...bites of conversation.

defs.def_en: A bite of something is a small part or amount of it.

defs.def_cn: 恩将仇报；以怨报德；忘恩负义

ext.ext_en: She may be cynical about the film industry, but ultimately she has no intention of biting the hand that feeds her.

ext.ext_en: Whenever possible, suggest she talks about it but be aware she may bite your head off for your trouble.

ext.ext_en: He bit his tongue as he found himself on the point of saying 'follow that car'.

ext.ext_en: Local taxes are going to be taking a bigger bite out of people's income than they ever have before.

defs.def_en: If something takes a bite out of a sum of money, part of the money is spent or taken away in order to pay for it.

ext.ext_cn: 我一直想坐游轮旅游。
ext.ext_en: I've always wanted to go on a cruise...

ext.ext_cn: 他们漫步于阳光下购物，看上去悠然惬意。
ext.ext_en: They look happy and relaxed as they stroll in the sunshine on a shopping trip...

defs.def_en: You use on to introduce an activity that someone is doing, particularly travelling.

defs.def_cn: （机器、电灯等）开着，工作着，使用中

ext.ext_cn: 灯亮着，门也敞开着。
ext.ext_en: The light was on and the door was open...

ext.ext_cn: 中央供暖系统已经关上。我又将它打开了。
ext.ext_en: The central heating's been turned off. I've turned it on again...

defs.def_en: When something such as a machine or an electric light is on, it is functioning or in use. When you switch it on, it starts functioning.

ext.ext_cn: 克莱尔和贝丽尔是组委会成员。
ext.ext_en: Claire and Beryl were on the organizing committee...

ext.ext_cn: 他任职于外交关系委员会。
ext.ext_en: He was on the Council of Foreign Relations.

defs.def_en: If you are on a committee or council, you are a member of it.

defs.def_cn: 在（某一日子或日期）（发生）

ext.ext_cn: 今年的活动将于6月19日举行，比往年提前一周。
ext.ext_en: This year's event will take place on June 19th, a week earlier than usual...

ext.ext_cn: 她周一前往韩国。
ext.ext_en: She travels to Korea on Monday...

defs.def_en: You can indicate when something happens by saying that it happens on a particular day or date.

ext.ext_cn: 她在宾馆里等候，准备第一时间迎接孩子们从伦敦过来。
ext.ext_en: She waited in her hotel to welcome her children on their arrival from London...

ext.ext_cn: 撤离人员一抵达迪拜就径直被送往迪拜国际机场。
ext.ext_en: On reaching Dubai the evacuees are taken straight to Dubai international airport.

defs.def_en: You use on when mentioning an event that was followed by another one.

ext.ext_cn: 他们继续默默无语地走了一会儿。
ext.ext_en: They walked on in silence for a while...

ext.ext_cn: 要是审查表明你们公司的运营状况基本良好，请继续往下读。
ext.ext_en: If the examination shows your company enjoys basically good health, read on...

defs.def_en: You use on to say that someone is continuing to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 她缠了我好几个星期了，要我带她去马厩看看。
ext.ext_en: She's been on at me for weeks to show her round the stables...

ext.ext_cn: 他以前总是跟我唠叨必须获胜才行。
ext.ext_en: He used to keep on at me about the need to win...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone goes on at you, you mean that they continually criticize you, complain to you, or ask you to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 也许从现在起我们最好少见面。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps it would be best not to see much of you from now on...

ext.ext_cn: 从此刻起，我们将会麻烦缠身。
ext.ext_en: We can expect trouble from this moment on...

defs.def_en: You use on in expressions such as from now on and from then on to indicate that something starts to happen at the time mentioned and continues to happen afterwards.

defs.def_cn: （常用在副词early，late，far及其比较级之后，尤置于句首、句尾或介词之前）

ext.ext_cn: 从大清早起这个市集广场就色彩缤纷，生机勃勃。
ext.ext_en: The market square is a riot of colour and animation from early on in the morning...

ext.ext_cn: 后来我学会了识谱。
ext.ext_en: Later on I learned how to read music...

defs.def_en: You often use on after the adverbs 'early', 'late', 'far', and their comparative forms, especially at the beginning or end of a sentence, or before a preposition.

ext.ext_cn: 由于眼睛感染一直不见好，她在服用抗生素。
ext.ext_en: She was on antibiotics for an eye infection that wouldn't go away...

ext.ext_cn: 许多老年人都需按时服药。
ext.ext_en: Many of the elderly are on medication.

defs.def_en: Someone who is on a drug takes it regularly.

defs.def_cn: 以…（为食）；（机器）用（某种动力或燃料运转）

ext.ext_cn: 毛虫以各类树木、灌木和植物为食。
ext.ext_en: The caterpillars feed on a wide range of trees, shrubs and plants...

ext.ext_cn: 他仅靠喝水、吃鱼罐头过活。
ext.ext_en: He lived on a diet of water and tinned fish...

defs.def_en: If you live on a particular kind of food, you eat it. If a machine runs on a particular kind of power or fuel, it uses it in order to function.

ext.ext_cn: 失业或低收入的年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...young people who are unemployed or on low wages...

ext.ext_cn: 他的周薪为300块。
ext.ext_en: He's on three hundred a week...

defs.def_en: If you are on a particular income, that is the income that you have.

ext.ext_cn: 上周抗议对食品和药品征税的大罢工
ext.ext_en: ...a general strike to protest a tax on food and medicine last week...

ext.ext_cn: 每卖出一张唱片就会有一部分利润捐给教会。
ext.ext_en: The Church was to receive a cut of the profits on every record sold...

defs.def_en: Taxes or profits that are obtained from something are referred to as taxes or profits on it.

ext.ext_cn: 我决心不在住旅馆方面浪费钱。
ext.ext_en: I resolved not to waste money on a hotel...

ext.ext_cn: 他喂狗花的钱比自己的饮食开销还多。
ext.ext_en: He spent more on feeding the dog than he spent on feeding himself...

defs.def_en: When you buy something or pay for something, you spend money on it.

ext.ext_cn: 人们常抱怨孩子花太多时间玩电脑游戏。
ext.ext_en: People complain about how children spend so much time on computer games...

ext.ext_cn: 你们都知道我来这里的目的。所以我就闲话少说了。
ext.ext_en: You all know why I am here. So I won't waste time on preliminaries.

defs.def_en: When you spend time or energy on a particular activity, you spend time or energy doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 我可不要不爱吃奶酪的孩子，那可不行。
ext.ext_en: I'm not having children who don't like cheese. It's not on...

ext.ext_cn: 我们不该那样动用警力，那根本不可接受。
ext.ext_en: We shouldn't use the police in that way. It's just not on.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not on or is just not on, you mean that it is unacceptable or impossible.

ext.ext_cn: 设计师、建筑工人、装配工——这个单子可以没完没了
ext.ext_en: ...designers, builders, fitters — the list goes on and on...

ext.ext_cn: 洛贝尔冒着纷飞的大雪不停地往前开。
ext.ext_en: Lobell drove on and on through the dense and blowing snow.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens on and on, you mean that it continues to happen for a very long time.

ext.ext_cn: 你到底在说些什么呀？
ext.ext_en: What on earth are you going on about?...

ext.ext_cn: 说真的，凯特，我不知道你在说些什么。
ext.ext_en: Honest, Kate, I don't know what you're on about.

defs.def_en: If you ask someone what they are on about or what they are going on about, you are puzzled because you cannot understand what they are talking about.

defs.def_cn: （表示有信心）知道自己在说些什么，了解情况

ext.ext_cn: 他看起来很在行。
ext.ext_en: It looks like he knows what he's on about.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone knows what they are on about, you are confident that what they are saying is true or makes sense, for example because they are an expert.

defs.def_cn: 掌握不利于（某人）的证据；抓住（某人）的把柄

ext.ext_cn: 他或许抓住了她的什么把柄。可能是给她提供了毒品，然后威胁她如果不这样做的话就告发她。
ext.ext_en: He may have something on her. He may have supplied her with drugs, and then threatened to tell if she didn't do this...

ext.ext_cn: 你手里没有对我不利的证据，这一点你很清楚。你的揣测在法庭上是绝对站不住脚的。
ext.ext_en: You've got nothing on me and you know it. Your theory would never stand up in a court of law.

defs.def_en: If someone has something on you, they have evidence that you have done something wrong or bad. If they have nothing on you, they cannot prove that you have done anything wrong or bad.
See also:floss;Dental floss is a type of thread that is used to clean the gaps between your teeth.

ext.ext_cn: 他从共和党人到民主党人的倒戈
ext.ext_en: ...his metamorphosis from a republican to a democrat...

ext.ext_cn: 就业部已经经历了数次改革。
ext.ext_en: The employment department has undergone several metamor-phoses.

defs.def_en: When a metamorphosis occurs, a person or thing develops and changes into something completely different.

ext.ext_cn: 更多的科学家现在能够接触到海洋学的最新技术。
ext.ext_en: The latest techniques in oceanography are now available to many more scientists.

defs.def_en: Oceanography is the scientific study of sea currents, the sea bed, and the fish and animals that live in the sea.

defs.def_cn: (从国家、大集团的)退出，脱离，分离

ext.ext_cn: 乌克兰之退出苏联
ext.ext_en: ...the Ukraine's secession from the Soviet Union.

defs.def_en: The secession of a region or group from the country or larger group to which it belongs is the action of formally becoming separate.

defs.def_cn: 胡子刮干净的；不蓄须的
defs.def_en: If a man is clean-shaven, he does not have a beard or a moustache.

ext.ext_cn: 有人担心警方利用该法罚没犯下轻罪的人的财产。
ext.ext_en: There is concern that police use the law to confiscate assets from people who have committed minor offences...

ext.ext_cn: 他们没收了武器、弹药和宣传材料。
ext.ext_en: They confiscated weapons, ammunition and propaganda material.

defs.def_en: If you confiscate something from someone, you take it away from them, usually as a punishment.

ext.ext_cn: 他打算重走哥伦布到达西印度群岛的航行路线。
ext.ext_en: He aims to follow Columbus's voyage to the West Indies.

ext.ext_cn: 首次完全以天文研究为目的的航天飞行
ext.ext_en: ...the first space shuttle voyage to be devoted entirely to astronomy.

defs.def_en: A voyage is a long journey on a ship or in a spacecraft.  →see usage note at:journey

ext.ext_cn: 绿色和平组织的旗舰正在穿越巴伦支海的北极寒冷地带。
ext.ext_en: The Greenpeace flagship is voyaging through the Arctic cold of the Barents Sea.

defs.def_en: To voyage to a place means to travel there, especially by sea.

ext.ext_cn: 莫霍克印第安人和魁北克省警方之间的僵持局面仍没有结束的迹象。
ext.ext_en: There is no sign of an end to the stand-off between Mohawk Indians and the Quebec provincial police...

ext.ext_cn: 国务院警告说这可能会引发新的外交僵局。
ext.ext_en: The State Department was warning that this could lead to another diplomatic stand-off.

defs.def_en: See also:Mexican stand-off;A stand-off is a situation in which neither of two opposing groups or forces will make a move until the other one does something, so nothing can happen until one of them gives way.

ext.ext_cn: 该国也出口牛肉。
ext.ext_en: The nation also exports beef...

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望向东南亚和非洲出口抗生素产品。
ext.ext_en: They expect the antibiotic products to be exported to Southeast Asia and Africa...

defs.def_en: To export products or raw materials means to sell them to another country.

ext.ext_cn: 他这么做是为了推广美国出口产品。
ext.ext_en: He did this to promote American exports...

ext.ext_cn: 加纳的主要出口商品是可可豆。
ext.ext_en: Ghana's main export is cocoa.

defs.def_en: Exports are goods which are sold to another country and sent there.

ext.ext_cn: 它有时会输出通货膨胀。
ext.ext_en: It has exported inflation at times.

ext.ext_cn: 声称这项协议会把就业机会转往墨西哥的质疑者
ext.ext_en: ...hecklers who said the deal would export jobs to Mexico.

defs.def_en: To export something means to introduce it into another country or make it happen there.

ext.ext_cn: 文件可以以ASCII或者PCX格式导出。
ext.ext_en: Files can be exported in ASCII or PCX formats.

defs.def_en: In computing, if you export files or information from one type of software into another type, you change their format so that they can be used in the new software.
Mussels are a kind of shellfish that you can eat from their shells.

ext.ext_cn: 她很爱自己的父母，为让他们高兴愿意做任何事。
ext.ext_en: She adored her parents and would do anything to please them.

defs.def_en: If you adore someone, you feel great love and admiration for them.

ext.ext_cn: 我妈妈非常喜欢吃香蕉，每天要吃两根。
ext.ext_en: My mother adores bananas and eats two a day...

ext.ext_cn: 我爱读好书，也喜欢看戏。
ext.ext_en: I adore good books and the theatre.

defs.def_en: If you adore something, you like it very much.
A  courthouse is a building in which a court of law meets.
A courthouse is a building used by the government of a county.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 政府在提高卫生和教育事业的效率上所付出的值得赞扬的努力
ext.ext_en: ...the government's praiseworthy efforts to improve efficiency in health and education.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is praiseworthy, you mean that you approve of it and it deserves to be praised.

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家长期失业严重、犯罪猖獗，经济几近瘫痪。
ext.ext_en: The country is an economic basket case with chronic unemployment and rampant crime.

defs.def_en: If someone describes a country or organization as a basket case, they mean that its economy or finances are in a seriously bad state.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我告诉了你这件事，你会认为我脑子进水了。
ext.ext_en: You're going to think I'm a basket case when I tell you this.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a basket case, you think that they are insane.

defs.def_cn: 击落(飞机、直升机、导弹等)

ext.ext_cn: 他们声称击落了一枚来犯的导弹。
ext.ext_en: They claimed to have shot down one incoming missile...

ext.ext_cn: 他的飞机于 1967 年在北越被击落。
ext.ext_en: His plane was shot down over North Vietnam in 1967.

defs.def_en: If someone shoots down an aeroplane, a helicopter, or a missile, they make it fall to the ground by hitting it with a bullet or missile.

ext.ext_cn: 他准备开枪射击抗议者以镇压叛乱。
ext.ext_en: He was prepared to suppress rebellion by shooting down protesters...

ext.ext_cn: 他们残忍地开枪将他打死了。
ext.ext_en: They shot him down in cold blood.

defs.def_en: If one person shoots down another, they shoot them with a gun.

ext.ext_cn: 她能够用充分的书面证据将传闻彻底粉碎。
ext.ext_en: She was able to shoot the rumour down in flames with ample documentary evidence.

defs.def_en: If you shoot someone down or shoot down their ideas, you say or show that they are completely wrong.
A glazier is someone whose job is fitting glass into windows and doors.

ext.ext_cn: 他们同意起草一份正式协议。
ext.ext_en: They agreed to draw up a formal agreement...

ext.ext_cn: 他希望部长们把注意力放在政策的执行上，而不是政策的制定上。
ext.ext_en: He wants his ministers to concentrate on implementing policy, not on drawing it up.

defs.def_en: If you draw up a document, list, or plan, you prepare it and write it out.

ext.ext_cn: 他拉了把椅子坐下。
ext.ext_en: He drew up a chair and sat down.

defs.def_en: If you draw up a chair, you move it nearer to a person or place, for example so that you can watch something or join in with something.

ext.ext_cn: 他把身子挺得笔直。
ext.ext_en: He drew himself up to his full height...

ext.ext_cn: “行！”客栈老板娘挺直身子愤然说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Well!', said the innkeeper, drawing herself up indignantly.

defs.def_en: If you draw yourself up, you make your back very straight.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 斯图尔特记不清他为什么要那样做了,因为他烂醉如泥。
ext.ext_en: Stewart could not remember exactly why he had done it because he was so drunk...

ext.ext_cn: 我喝醉了，只好让人把我送回家。
ext.ext_en: I got drunk and had to be carried home...

defs.def_en: Someone who is drunk has drunk so much alcohol that they cannot speak clearly or behave sensibly.

ext.ext_cn: 一个酒鬼躺在小胡同里。
ext.ext_en: A drunk lay in the alley.

defs.def_en: A drunk is someone who is drunk or frequently gets drunk.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们现在正陶醉于成功之中。
ext.ext_en: They are currently drunk with success...

ext.ext_cn: 当时我沉醉于生活中的精彩刺激。
ext.ext_en: I felt drunk with the excitement of life.

defs.def_en: If you are drunk with a strong emotion or an experience, you are in a state of great excitement because of it.

A prefix is a letter or group of letters, for example 'un-' or 'multi-', which is added to the beginning of a word in order to form a different word. For example, the prefix 'un-' is added to 'happy' to form 'unhappy'.

defs.def_cn: 前置代码（置于一组号码前的数字或字母，表示所属区域等）

ext.ext_cn: 我很快就学会了识别牌照前面的代码。
ext.ext_en: I soon learnt to read the licence plates' prefixes.

defs.def_en: A prefix is one or more numbers or letters added to the beginning of a code number to indicate, for example, what area something belongs to.

defs.def_cn: 后现代主义（20世纪后期艺术、建筑、文学领域的一种流派，通常以讽刺的手法将风格、观点、指代对象与现代社会揉为一体）
defs.def_en: Post-modernism is a late twentieth century approach in art, architecture, and literature which typically mixes styles, ideas, and references to modern society, often in an ironic way.

ext.ext_cn: 黑丝绒帽子

ext.ext_en: ...a gold Mercedes with red velour seats.

defs.def_en: Velour is a silk or cotton fabric similar to velvet.

defs.def_cn: （盘等）适于烤箱内用的，耐热的
defs.def_en: An ovenproof dish is one that has been specially made to be used in an oven without being damaged by the heat.

ext.ext_cn: 放眼望去到处都是冷却塔和工厂烟囱
ext.ext_en: ...landscapes dominated by cooling towers and factory chimneys.

defs.def_en: A cooling tower is a very large, round, high building which is used to cool water from factories or power stations.

ext.ext_cn: 成捆的干草
ext.ext_en: ...bales of hay.

defs.def_cn: 把…打成大包；把…扎成大捆

ext.ext_en: Once hay has been cut and baled it has to go through some chemical processes.

defs.def_en: If something such as hay, cloth, or paper is baled, it is tied together tightly.

defs.def_cn: 自然环境保护的;生态环境保护的；环保的

ext.ext_cn: 经济和生态环境保护法规
ext.ext_en: ...economic and environmental legislation.

ext.ext_en: ...the environmental claims being made for some products...

defs.def_en: Environmental means concerned with the protection of the natural world of land, sea, air, plants, and animals.

defs.def_cn: 与周围环境有关的;由生存环境引起的

ext.ext_en: The form the human family takes is a response to environmental pressures.

ext.ext_en: ...a soap specially designed for those with sensitive skins...

ext.ext_en: Patrick needs to use specially adapted computer equipment...

ext.ext_en: What was specially enjoyable about that job?

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人恼怒的;令人厌烦的;令人烦恼的

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you dismiss something, you decide or say that it is not important enough for you to think about or consider.

defs.def_en: If you dismiss something from your mind, you stop thinking about it.

defs.def_en: When a judge dismisses a case against someone, he or she formally states that there is no need for a trial, usually because there is not enough evidence for the case to continue.

defs.def_en: In music, wah-wah is used to describe the sound produced by covering and uncovering the open end of a brass instrument. This sound can also be produced electronically, especially when playing the electric guitar.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: She was cheery and talked to them about their problems.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as cheery, you mean that they are cheerful and happy.

ext.ext_cn: 燕麦麸
ext.ext_en: ...oat bran.

defs.def_en: Oats are a cereal crop or its grains, used for making biscuits or a food called porridge, or for feeding animals.

defs.def_cn: （尤指在性方面）放荡不羁，尽情玩乐

ext.ext_cn: 这些小伙子需要放纵一下。
ext.ext_en: The kids need to sow a few wild oats.

defs.def_en: If a young person sows their wild oats, they behave in a rather uncontrolled way, especially by having a lot of sexual relationships.

defs.def_en: You can refer to fighting between two countries or groups who are at war as hostilities .
The emergency room is the room or department in a hospital where people who have severe injuries or sudden illnesses are taken for emergency treatment. The abbreviation ER is often used.

ext.ext_en: ...policies designed to buy off the working-class vote...

ext.ext_en: In buying your children all these things, you are in a sense buying them off.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or organization buys off another person or group, you are criticizing the fact that they are giving them something such as money so that they will not complain or cause trouble.
A swain is a young man who is in love.

defs.def_cn: 思想正直的;有正义感的;明智的

ext.ext_en: Every right-thinking American would be proud of them.

defs.def_en: If you think that someone's opinions or beliefs are sensible and you agree with them, you can describe them as a right-thinking person.

defs.def_en: Nannying is the job of being a nanny.

defs.def_cn: (帮助、建议等)过多干涉，过度保护

ext.ext_cn: 政府对市场的过度保护和干涉
ext.ext_en: ...governmental nannying and interference in markets.

defs.def_en: If you refer to activities such as helping and advising people as nannying, you disapprove of these activities because you think that they are protecting people too much.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Their most potent weapon was the Exocet missile...

ext.ext_en: The drug is extremely potent, but causes unpleasant side effects.

defs.def_en: Something that is potent is very effective and powerful.

defs.def_en: Cushioning is something soft that protects an object when it hits something.
A gymnasium is the same as a gym .

ext.ext_cn: 一位数学专业的老师

defs.def_en: Someone's specialism is a particular subject or skill which they study and know a lot about.

ext.ext_en: The needs of children may not be best met by an overemphasis on subject specialism.

defs.def_en: Specialism is the act of specializing in a particular subject.

defs.def_en: A browser is someone who browses in a shop.

ext.ext_en: About 12 inches wide is the absolute minimum you should consider...

ext.ext_en: They've been scattering toys everywhere...

ext.ext_en: The cavalry scattered them and chased them off the field.

ext.ext_en: On the table was a pile of books and a scatter of papers.

ext.ext_en: There are some annoying loose ends in the plot.

ext.ext_cn: 青少年无所事事的时候最容易惹出麻烦来。
ext.ext_en: Adolescents are most likely to get into trouble when they're at a loose end.

ext.ext_en: Whereas the population of working age increased by 1 million between 1981 and 1986, today it is barely growing.

defs.def_en: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

ext.ext_en: ...the story of Sin-Sin, a little boy who has magical powers.

defs.def_en: Something that is magical seems to use magic or to be able to produce magic.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The beautiful island of Cyprus is a magical place to get married.

defs.def_en: You can say that a place or object is magical when it has a special mysterious quality that makes it seem wonderful and exciting.

defs.def_cn: 品脱（液量单位，英制中等于0.568升或1/8英国加仑，美制中等于0.473升或1/8美国加仑）

ext.ext_cn: 一品脱牛奶

ext.ext_en: The military requested 6,000 pints of blood from the American Red Cross.

ext.ext_cn: 他会坐下读报，然后出去喝杯啤酒。
ext.ext_en: He sits down and reads the paper, then goes out for a pint.

defs.def_en: If you go for a pint, you go to the pub to drink a pint of beer or more.

ext.ext_en: Thirteen people have been charged with treason — an offence which can carry the death penalty...

ext.ext_cn: 英国的《消费者保护法》规定销售不安全物品属刑事犯罪行为。
ext.ext_en: In Britain the Consumer Protection Act makes it a criminal offence to sell goods that are unsafe.

defs.def_en: An offence is a crime that breaks a particular law and requires a particular punishment.

ext.ext_cn: 出版这本书可能不会引起人们的反感。
ext.ext_en: The book might be published without creating offense...

ext.ext_en: Privilege determined by birth is an offence to any modern sense of justice.

defs.def_en: Offence or an offence is behaviour which causes people to be upset or embarrassed.

defs.def_cn: （体育运动中的）进攻队，进攻方

ext.ext_cn: 中场时，这位教练对围拢一圈的进攻队员进行战术指导。
ext.ext_en: Between plays the coach was talking to the offense in the huddle.

defs.def_en: In sports such as American football or basketball, the offense is the team which has possession of the ball and is trying to score.
