ext.ext_en: It says the photograph is likely cause distress and offence to the public...

ext.ext_cn: 我们有过一些分歧，如有得罪我很抱歉。
ext.ext_en: We have had our differences and I'm sorry if it has caused offence.

defs.def_en: If you cause offence or give offence to someone, you say or do something rude which upsets or embarrasses them.

ext.ext_cn: 爸爸，别见怪，不过你该洗澡了。
ext.ext_en: Dad, you need a bath. No offence.

defs.def_en: Some people say 'no offence' to make it clear that they do not want to upset you, although what they are saying may seem rather rude.

defs.def_cn: （常指不必要地）(对…)生气，(因…)见怪

ext.ext_cn: 什么事都不会让她生气。
ext.ext_en: She never takes offence at anything...

ext.ext_cn: 她从未见过他像最近几周这样高度紧张，动不动就生气。
ext.ext_en: Never had she seen him so tense, so quick to take offence as he had been in recent weeks.

defs.def_en: If someone takes offence at something you say or do, they feel upset, often unnecessarily, because they think you are being rude to them.

defs.def_cn: 国家主义;民族独立主义

ext.ext_cn: 不断高涨的斯洛伐克民族独立主义浪潮
ext.ext_en: ...the rising tide of Slovak nationalism.

defs.def_en: Nationalism is the desire for political independence of people who feel they are historically or culturally a separate group within a country.

ext.ext_en: This kind of fierce nationalism is a powerful and potentially volatile force.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a person's great love for their nation as nationalism. It is often associated with the belief that a particular nation is better than any other nation, and in this case is often used showing disapproval.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这种行为上的倒退现象在男孩中更加普遍。
ext.ext_en: This regressive behaviour is more common in boys.

defs.def_en: Regressive behaviour, activities, or processes involve a return to an earlier and less advanced stage of development.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 加有蜂蜜的美味姜饼
ext.ext_en: ...the toothsome honey-sweetened gingerbread.

defs.def_en: If you describe food as toothsome, you mean that it tastes very good.

defs.def_cn: 沉思;冥想;若有所思地说(或写)

ext.ext_en: Many of the papers muse on the fate of the President...

ext.ext_en: 'As a whole,' she muses, 'the 'organized church' turns me off'...

defs.def_en: If  you muse on something, you think about it, usually saying or writing what you are thinking at the same time.

defs.def_cn: (给画家、诗人或音乐家带来灵感的)女神，创作女神

ext.ext_cn: 她曾是法国画家亨利·马蒂斯的人体模特和灵感女神。
ext.ext_en: Once she was a nude model and muse to French artist Henri Matisse.

ext.ext_cn: 给他以灵感的人们
ext.ext_en: ...the muses who fuel his inspiration.

defs.def_en: A muse is a person, usually a woman, who gives someone, usually a man, a desire to create art, poetry, or music, and gives them ideas for it.
A chignon is a knot of hair worn at the back of a woman's head.

ext.ext_cn: 远古文明相信新鲜的空气和阳光有治病的功效。
ext.ext_en: Ancient civilizations believed in the curative powers of fresh air and sunlight.

ext.ext_cn: 能治病的药草
ext.ext_en: ...curative herbs.

defs.def_en: Something that has curative properties can cure people's illnesses.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 欣喜若狂的;非常开心的

ext.ext_en: I was so thrilled to get a good report from him...

ext.ext_cn: 休和约翰对于获得这个奖项感到兴奋不已。
ext.ext_en: Sue and John were especially thrilled with this award...

defs.def_en: If someone is thrilled, they are extremely pleased about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: I'm going to work two days a week teaching handicapped kids to fish...

ext.ext_en: Alex was mentally handicapped.

defs.def_en: Someone who is handicapped has a physical or mental disability that prevents them living a totally normal life. Many people who have a disability find this word offensive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 处于困境的；境况不佳的

ext.ext_en: The average working week in Japan is 42.3 hours, compared with 41.6 in the UK, so they are not too badly off.

defs.def_en: If you are badly off, you are in a bad situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那些有着高薪工作的人竟然还抱怨自己多么缺钱，真是过分。
ext.ext_en: It is outrageous that people doing well-paid jobs should moan about how badly off they are.

defs.def_en: If you are badly off, you do not have much money.

defs.def_en: A rabbi is a Jewish religious leader, usually one who is in charge of a synagogue, one who is qualified to teach Judaism, or one who is an expert on Jewish law.

defs.def_cn: 把…提交至…面前；把…向…详细陈述

ext.ext_cn: 多数党如果远远背离原先向选民立下的原则，那将是不明智的。
ext.ext_en: The majority party would be unwise to deviate far from the principles it had laid before the electors...

ext.ext_en: Now what we need is definite proof that we can lay before the prime minister.

defs.def_en: If you lay an idea or piece of information before someone, you present it to them in detail, usually in order to obtain their approval or advice.
Molecular biology is the study of the structure and function of the complex chemicals that are found in living things.

ext.ext_cn: “你喜欢它吗？”——“喜欢。”
ext.ext_en: 'Did you like it?' —'Yep.'...

ext.ext_cn: 是的，我们确实要结婚了。
ext.ext_en: Yep, we really are gonna get married.

defs.def_en: Yep means yes.
Rheumatism is an illness that makes your joints or muscles stiff and painful. Older people, especially, suffer from rheumatism.

ext.ext_en: One in four pupils leaving secondary school can't read or write properly.

defs.def_en: A secondary school is a school for pupils between the ages of 11 or 12 and 17 or 18.

ext.ext_cn: 与别人建立亲密关系的途径
ext.ext_en: ...a means of achieving intimacy with another person.

defs.def_en: Intimacy between two people is a very close personal relationship between them.

ext.ext_en: Her sunburn made intimacy too painful...

ext.ext_en: The truth was he did not feel like intimacy with any woman.

defs.def_en: You sometimes use intimacy to refer to sex or a sexual relationship.

ext.ext_cn: 恋爱场面的亲昵行为
ext.ext_en: ...the intimacies of a love scene.

defs.def_en: Intimacies are things that you say or do to someone you have a very close personal relationship with.
A stable lad is the same as a stable boy .

ext.ext_cn: 有了地质图、书籍和地图册，你便可以找到所有已探明的珍贵矿藏的位置。
ext.ext_en: With geological maps, books and atlases you can find out all the proven sites of precious minerals.

ext.ext_cn: 一次漫长的地质勘探
ext.ext_en: ...a lengthy geological survey.

defs.def_en: Geological means relating to geology.

ext.ext_cn: 阿根廷的农产品
ext.ext_en: ...Argentine agricultural products.

defs.def_en: Argentine means the same as Argentinian .

A drum majorette is a girl or young woman who wears a uniform and carries a stick which at intervals she throws into the air and catches. Drum majorettes march, often in lines, in front of a band as part of a procession.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 漫不经心的;心不在焉的;健忘的

ext.ext_cn: 他晚年变得愈加健忘了。
ext.ext_en: In his later life he became even more absent-minded.

defs.def_en: Someone who is absent-minded forgets things or does not pay attention to what they are doing, often because they are thinking about something else.

defs.def_cn: (表演者的)滑稽动作，幽默表演,噱头
defs.def_en: An entertainer's schtick is a series of funny or entertaining things that they say or do.

ext.ext_en: It would be very nice if we had a true figure of how many people in this country haven't got a job...

ext.ext_cn: 过不了多久，通货膨胀率就会开始下降。
ext.ext_en: It will not be long before the inflation figure starts to fall...

defs.def_en: A figure is a particular amount expressed as a number, especially a statistic.

defs.def_cn: (0 到 9 的)数字符号，数目字
defs.def_en: A figure is any of the ten written symbols from 0 to 9 that are used to represent a number.

ext.ext_cn: 通常保持在个位数的通货膨胀率现在已超过了 12％。
ext.ext_en: Inflation, which has usually been in single figures, is running at more than 12%...

ext.ext_en: Crawley, with 14, was the only other player to reach double figures...

You can also say, for example, that an amount or number is in three figures when it is between one hundred and nine hundred and ninety-nine.

ext.ext_cn: 阿利斯泰尔看见了坐在椅子里的罗丝的模糊身影。
ext.ext_en: Alistair saw the dim figure of Rose in the chair...

ext.ext_en: She waited, standing on the bridge, until his figure vanished against the grey backdrop of the Palace...

defs.def_en: You refer to someone that you can see as a figure when you cannot see them clearly or when you are describing them.

defs.def_cn: (绘画作品中的)人物;雕像;塑像

ext.ext_cn: 一个戴着兜帽作沉思状的真人大小青铜女子雕像
ext.ext_en: ...a life-size bronze figure of a brooding, hooded woman.

defs.def_en: In art, a figure is a person in a drawing or a painting, or a statue of a person.

ext.ext_cn: 为自己的健康和体形感到骄傲吧。
ext.ext_en: Take pride in your health and your figure...

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮特天生一头金发，身材曼妙。
ext.ext_en: Janet was a natural blonde with a good figure.

defs.def_en: Your figure is the shape of your body.

ext.ext_cn: 这个运动受到三大政党关键人物的支持。
ext.ext_en: The movement is supported by key figures in the three main political parties.

defs.def_en: Someone who is referred to as a figure of a particular kind is a person who is well-known and important in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 有时候年轻小伙子只是需要找一个母亲式的人物聊一聊，从中获得安慰。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes young lads just need to turn to a mother figure for a bit of a chat and reassurance.

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼尔·布恩——西部伟大的英雄形象
ext.ext_en: Daniel Boone, the great hero figure of the frontier...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is, for example, a mother figure or a hero figure, you mean that other people regard them as the type of person stated or suggested.

ext.ext_cn: 查一查世界地图(见图1)，就能找到主要的葡萄酒产区。
ext.ext_en: If you look at a world map (see Figure 1) you can identify the major wine-producing regions...

ext.ext_cn: 表 1.15 显示出哪些省份在 1910 至 1920 年间人口减少了。
ext.ext_en: Figure 1.15 shows which provinces lost populations between 1910 and 1920.

defs.def_en: In books and magazines, the diagrams which help to show or explain information are referred to as figures .

ext.ext_cn: 画个五边形，一个规则的五边形。
ext.ext_en: Draw a pentagon, a regular five-sided figure.

defs.def_en: In geometry, a figure is a shape, especially a regular shape.

ext.ext_cn: 她觉得自己和内德都从这一经历中学到了很多东西。
ext.ext_en: She figured that both she and Ned had learned a lot from the experience.

defs.def_en: If you figure that something is the case, you think or guess that it is the case.

defs.def_cn: 不奇怪;很正常;合乎情理

ext.ext_cn: 等我说完，他说道：“是啊，那是预料中事。”
ext.ext_en: When I finished, he said, 'Yeah. That figures'...

ext.ext_cn: 弄明白了你就会觉得这合情合理。
ext.ext_en: Work it out and you'll find it figures.

defs.def_en: If you say 'That figures' or 'It figures', you mean that the fact referred to is not surprising.

ext.ext_cn: 有关侵犯人权的部分在报告中占据了显要地位。
ext.ext_en: Human rights violations figured prominently in the report.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing figures in something, they appear in or are included in it.

ext.ext_cn: 今天她看起来十分孤独。
ext.ext_en: Today she cuts a lonely figure.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone cuts a particular figure, you mean that they appear to other people in the way described.

ext.ext_cn: 令人想象不到的是，这个男人已经成为了笑谈。
ext.ext_en: The man has become an unlikely figure of fun.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a figure of fun, you mean that people think they are ridiculous.

ext.ext_cn: 如果不多加注意，你就会失去女孩般的苗条身段。
ext.ext_en: You'll lose your girlish figure if you don't watch out.

defs.def_en: If you keep your figure, you stay thin. If you lose your figure, you become rather fat.

defs.def_cn: 说出…的确切数量(或数目)

ext.ext_en: No one will put a figure on the final cost of this reconstruction.

defs.def_en: When you put a figure on an amount, you say exactly how much it is.

ext.ext_cn: 杰克竭尽全力发展自己的公司，但有几个障碍是他始料不及的。
ext.ext_en: Jack worked as hard as he could to build his business, but he hadn't figured on a few obstacles.

defs.def_en: If you figure on something, you plan that it will happen or assume that it will happen when making your plans.

ext.ext_en: It took them about one month to figure out how to start the equipment...

ext.ext_en: They're trying to figure out the politics of this whole situation...

defs.def_en: If you figure out a solution to a problem or the reason for something, you succeed in solving it or understanding it.

ext.ext_cn: 他算出了他们活期存款账户上的余额总和。
ext.ext_en: He figured up the balance in their checking account.

defs.def_en: If you figure up a cost or amount, you add numbers together to get the total.

ext.ext_cn: 胡志明诞辰一百周年纪念
ext.ext_en: ...the one hundredth anniversary of the birth of Ho Chi Minh.

defs.def_en: An anniversary is a date which is remembered or celebrated because a special event happened on that date in a previous year.

defs.def_cn: 过剩;剩余;过剩量;剩余额

ext.ext_cn: 德国遭遇了教师过剩的问题。
ext.ext_en: Germany suffers from a surplus of teachers.

defs.def_en: If there is a surplus of something, there is more than is needed.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎没人手头很富裕。
ext.ext_en: Few people have large sums of surplus cash...

ext.ext_cn: 我把多余的鸟卖给当地的宠物商店。
ext.ext_en: I sell my surplus birds to a local pet shop...

defs.def_en: Surplus is used to describe something that is extra or that is more than is needed.

ext.ext_en: Japan's annual trade surplus is in the region of 100 billion dollars.

defs.def_en: If a country has a trade surplus, it exports more than it imports.

ext.ext_en: Norway's budget surplus has fallen from 5.9% in 1986 to an expected 0.1% this year.

defs.def_en: If a government has a budget surplus, it has spent less than it received in taxes.

ext.ext_en: She has such a kind, friendly personality...

ext.ext_cn: 休·特伦查德完全凭着个人魅力就能随心所欲。
ext.ext_en: Through sheer force of personality Hugh Trenchard had got his way...

defs.def_en: Your personality is your whole character and nature.

defs.def_cn: 强烈的（或鲜明的)个性;个性鲜明的人

ext.ext_cn: 极有个性的女人
ext.ext_en: ...a woman of great personality...

ext.ext_cn: 他很有个性魅力——非常风趣。
ext.ext_en: He is such a personality — he is so funny.

defs.def_en: If someone has personality or is a personality, they have a strong and lively character.

defs.def_cn: （娱乐界或体育界的）名流，名人，风云人物

ext.ext_cn: 广播电视界风云人物，吉米·萨维尔
ext.ext_en: ...the radio and television personality, Jimmy Saville.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a famous person, especially in entertainment, broadcasting, or sport, as a personality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 秘密的;鬼祟的;偷偷摸摸的

ext.ext_cn: 这种做生意的方式偷偷摸摸，遮遮掩掩。
ext.ext_en: It is a sneaky and underhand way of doing business...

ext.ext_cn: 一个小孩鬼鬼祟祟地在干什么事情的时候，通常另一个小孩可以判断出来。
ext.ext_en: One kid can generally tell when another kid is sneaky.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as sneaky, you disapprove of them because they do things secretly rather than openly.
A water bird is a bird that swims or walks in water, especially lakes and rivers. There are many kinds of water bird.

ext.ext_cn: 北苏丹最西边的省份
ext.ext_en: ...the westernmost province of North Sudan.

defs.def_en: The westernmost part of an area or the westernmost place is the one that is farthest towards the west.

ext.ext_cn: 仅仅约一个小时之后，我发现我的枪不见了。
ext.ext_en: It was only an hour or so later that I discovered that my gun was missing...

ext.ext_cn: 扑克牌不见了。
ext.ext_en: The playing cards had gone missing.

defs.def_en: If something is missing, it is not in its usual place, and you cannot find it.

defs.def_cn: 被去除的；缺损的；缺掉的

ext.ext_cn: 他的衬衫掉了3枚纽扣。
ext.ext_en: Three buttons were missing from his shirt.

defs.def_en: If a part of something is missing, it has been removed or has come off, and has not been replaced.

ext.ext_cn: 不过，缺乏的是一种内在的艺术凝聚力。
ext.ext_en: What is missing, however, is an internal, artistic cohesion...

ext.ext_cn: 她给我的名单并不完整，有一个名字漏掉了。
ext.ext_en: She had given me an incomplete list. One name was missing from it.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is missing, you mean that it has not been included, and you  think that it should have been.

ext.ext_cn: 爆炸中有5人死亡，1,000多人受伤，1人至今下落不明。
ext.ext_en: Five people died in the explosion and more than one thousand were injured. One person is still missing.

defs.def_en: Someone who is missing cannot be found, and it is not known whether they are alive or dead.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不受牵连的;不受约束的

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影给人一种创作者与他的素材反常地保持疏离的感觉。
ext.ext_en: The film has the feel of a man curiously disengaged from his material.

defs.def_en: If someone is disengaged from something, they are not as involved with it as you would expect.

ext.ext_cn: 这个实验本身只是简单的科学实验。
ext.ext_en: The experiment itself is garden-variety science.

defs.def_en: You can use garden-variety to describe something you think is ordinary and not special in any way.

ext.ext_cn: 我对一个名叫詹姆斯的黑头发高挑个儿男孩的热恋
ext.ext_en: ...my passion for a dark-haired, slender boy named James.

ext.ext_cn: 爱和情欲的表达
ext.ext_en: ...the expression of love and passion.

defs.def_en: Passion is strong sexual feelings towards someone.

ext.ext_cn: 他发表了热情洋溢的讲话。
ext.ext_en: He spoke with great passion.

ext.ext_cn: 共和党候选人的激情和奉献精神
ext.ext_en: ...the passion and commitment of the Republican candidate.

defs.def_en: Passion is a very strong feeling about something or a strong belief in something.

ext.ext_cn: 她酷爱园艺。
ext.ext_en: She had a passion for gardening...

ext.ext_cn: 他酷爱的另一个国家是意大利。
ext.ext_en: His other great passion was Italy.

defs.def_en: If you have a passion for something, you have a very strong interest in it and like it very much.

defs.def_cn: (酒吧或俱乐部里穿着暴露的女子在客人近旁表演的)桌前艳舞，桌上艳舞
defs.def_en: Table dancing is a type of entertainment in a bar or club in which a woman who is wearing very few clothes dances in a sexy way close to a customer or group of customers.

defs.def_cn: 临终圣礼，临终礼仪（基督教牧师为将死之人举行的宗教仪式）

ext.ext_cn: 史蒂芬·利神父为死者主持了临终圣礼。
ext.ext_en: Father Stephen Lea administered the last rites to the dead men.

defs.def_en: The last rites are a religious ceremony performed by a Christian priest for a dying person.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他并不像往常那么高兴。
ext.ext_en: He wasn't quite as perky as normal...

ext.ext_cn: 她个性开朗活泼而又独立。
ext.ext_en: She had a perky, independent spirit.

defs.def_en: If someone is perky, they are cheerful and lively.

ext.ext_cn: 他得到了一个新的免租金公寓。
ext.ext_en: He was given a new rent-free apartment.

ext.ext_cn: 他们告诉詹姆斯他不能再白住了。
ext.ext_en: They told James he could no longer live rent-free.

defs.def_en: If you have a rent-free house or office, you do not have to pay anything to use it.

defs.def_cn: 使年轻;使恢复青春;使恢复活力

ext.ext_cn: 有人建议雪莱去意大利，那里的天气会使他恢复活力。
ext.ext_en: Shelley was advised that the Italian climate would rejuvenate him...

ext.ext_cn: 当就要离开这里返回文明世界时，我们俩都觉得恢复了活力。
ext.ext_en: When it was time to leave and return to civilization we both felt rejuvenated...

defs.def_en: If something rejuvenates you, it makes you feel or look young again.

defs.def_cn: 使（组织、制度等）恢复活力;使更有效率

ext.ext_cn: 政府大力推行改造内城贫民区的计划。
ext.ext_en: The government pushed through schemes to rejuvenate the inner cities...

ext.ext_cn: 他们应该侧重于修整现有的绿化植被，比如草和灌木。
ext.ext_en: They should concentrate on rejuvenating the existing vegetation, like grass and shrubs.

defs.def_en: If you rejuvenate an organization or system, you make it more lively and more efficient, for example by introducing new ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家即将走向繁荣富强。
ext.ext_en: The country was on the verge of becoming prosperous and successful...

ext.ext_cn: 卡萝尔差点就要哭了。
ext.ext_en: Carole was on the verge of tears.

defs.def_en: If you are on the verge of something, you are going to do it very soon or it is likely to happen or begin very soon.
The verge of a road is a narrow piece of ground by the side of a road, which is usually covered with grass or flowers.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有时间也不愿意去考虑其他事情。
ext.ext_en: He had neither the time nor the inclination to think of other things...

ext.ext_cn: 她丝毫没有要走的意思。
ext.ext_en: She showed no inclination to go...

defs.def_en: An inclination is a feeling that makes you want to act in a particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 他冒充医生，骗过了所有人。
ext.ext_en: He masqueraded as a doctor and fooled everyone.

ext.ext_cn: 披着美德外衣的丑恶
ext.ext_en: ...vices masquerading as virtues.

defs.def_en: To masquerade as someone or something means to pretend to be that person or thing, particularly in order to deceive other people.

ext.ext_cn: 他在新闻发布会上说选举将是一场骗人的把戏。
ext.ext_en: He told a news conference that the elections would be a masquerade.

defs.def_en: A masquerade is an attempt to deceive people about the true nature or identity of something.

ext.ext_cn: 化装舞会
ext.ext_en: ...a masquerade ball.

defs.def_en: A masquerade is an event such as a party or dance where people dress up in disguise and wear masks.

ext.ext_cn: 书中严格规定了审讯17岁以下未成年人时应当遵守的事项。
ext.ext_en: There was a firm rubric in the book about what had to be observed when interrogating anyone under seventeen.

defs.def_en: A rubric is a set of rules or instructions, for example the rules at the beginning of an examination paper.

ext.ext_cn: 这项援助归于政府间的技术合作这一类别。
ext.ext_en: The aid comes under the rubric of technical co-operation between governments.

defs.def_en: A rubric is a title or heading under which something operates or is studied.
You can refer to someone's lower cheeks as their jowls, especially when they hang down towards their jaw.

ext.ext_cn: 她和家人不得不紧挨着这些人住着。
ext.ext_en: She and her family have to live cheek by jowl with these people.

defs.def_en: If you say that people or things are cheek by jowl with each other, you are indicating that they are very close to each other.

ext.ext_cn: 她和她丈夫一起去度假了，以期弥合他们婚姻的裂隙。
ext.ext_en: She has gone on holiday with her husband to try to patch up their marriage...

ext.ext_cn: 现在他弥合了自己和部长的分歧。
ext.ext_en: He has now patched up his differences with the Minister...

defs.def_en: If you patch up a quarrel or relationship, you try to be friendly again and not to quarrel any more.

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以修补这些破洞。
ext.ext_en: We can patch up those holes...

ext.ext_cn: 他的钱还不够补这个轮胎，更别提买个新的了。
ext.ext_en: He did not have enough money to have the tire patched up, let alone buy a new one.

defs.def_en: If you patch up something which is damaged, you mend it or patch it.

defs.def_cn: 为…处理伤口；包扎，处理（伤口）

ext.ext_cn: 事故发生后为她包扎伤口的医护人员
ext.ext_en: ...the medical staff who patched her up after the accident...

ext.ext_cn: 急诊手术对他的脸进行了处理。
ext.ext_en: Emergency surgery patched up his face.

defs.def_en: If doctors patch someone up or patch their wounds up, they treat their injuries.

ext.ext_cn: 贸易部长们艰难地达成了妥协。
ext.ext_en: Trade ministers patched up a compromise.

defs.def_en: If people or countries patch up a deal, they manage to agree on it after difficult discussions.

ext.ext_cn: 他们把他硬塞进吉普车后座。
ext.ext_en: They thrust him into the back of a jeep...

ext.ext_cn: 她抓起一沓婴儿照片塞到我手里。
ext.ext_en: She grabs a stack of baby photos and thrusts them into my hands.

defs.def_en: If you thrust something or someone somewhere, you push or move them there quickly with a lot of force.

ext.ext_cn: 她一头扎进人群。
ext.ext_en: She thrust her way into the crowd...

ext.ext_cn: 他来到花园门口，挤了进去。
ext.ext_en: He reached the garden gate and thrust his way through it.

defs.def_en: If you thrust your way somewhere, you move there, pushing between people or things which are in your way.

ext.ext_cn: 一根天线在草地边上竖立着。
ext.ext_en: An aerial thrust up from the grass verge...

ext.ext_cn: 一缕阳光透过云层照射下来。
ext.ext_en: A ray of sunlight thrust out through the clouds.

defs.def_en: If something thrusts up or out of something else, it sticks up or sticks out in a noticeable way.

defs.def_cn: (车辆等的)推力，反压力，侧向压力

ext.ext_cn: 它提供了飞机前进所需的推力。
ext.ext_en: It provides the thrust that makes the craft move forward.

defs.def_en: Thrust is the power or force that is required to make a vehicle move in a particular direction.

defs.def_cn: (活动、思想的)要点，主要内容，要旨

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影的真正要旨是它审视了纽约的哈西德教徒。
ext.ext_en: The real thrust of the film is its examination of New York's Hasidic community...

ext.ext_cn: 此项研究的核心是早期宇宙和银河系的形成。
ext.ext_en: The main thrust of the research will be the study of the early Universe and galaxy formation...

defs.def_en: The thrust of an activity or of an idea is the main or essential things it expresses.

ext.ext_cn: 量子力学和混沌理论都表明世界永远处于不断变化中。
ext.ext_en: Both quantum mechanics and chaos theory suggest a world constantly in flux.

defs.def_en: In physics, quantum theory and quantum mechanics are concerned with the behaviour of atomic particles.

defs.def_cn: 巨变;猛增;飞跃；突飞猛进

ext.ext_cn: 这种疫苗的问世是医疗保健领域的重大突破。
ext.ext_en: The vaccine represents a quantum leap in healthcare...

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪70年代初，移民的规模骤然扩大。
ext.ext_en: The scale of migration took a quantum leap in the early 1970s.

defs.def_en: A quantum leap or quantum jump in something is a very great and sudden increase in its size, amount, or quality.

defs.def_cn: 星号（即*，尤用于表示文中另外一处有更多信息）
defs.def_en: An asterisk is the sign *. It is used especially to indicate that there is further information about something in another part of the text.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在恰位于城镇边缘的一座小山上。
ext.ext_en: We were on a hill, right on the edge of town...

ext.ext_cn: 她正站在水边。
ext.ext_en: She was standing at the water's edge...

defs.def_en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

ext.ext_cn: 锋利的剑刃
ext.ext_en: ...the sharp edge of the sword.

defs.def_en: The edge of something sharp such as a knife or an axe is its sharp or narrow side.

ext.ext_cn: 他慢慢挪向电话机，准备抓起听筒。
ext.ext_en: He edged closer to the telephone, ready to grab it...

ext.ext_cn: 他在民意测验中的支持率正一点点攀升。
ext.ext_en: He is edging ahead in the opinion polls.

defs.def_en: If someone or something edges somewhere, they move very slowly in that direction.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经令犀牛濒临灭绝。
ext.ext_en: They have driven the rhino to the edge of extinction...

ext.ext_cn: 她泪水盈眶。
ext.ext_en: She was on the edge of tears.

defs.def_en: The edge of something, especially something bad, is the point at which it may start to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 法国有3天的准备时间，这可能会让他们在对阵英格兰时占上风。
ext.ext_en: The three days France have to prepare could give them the edge over England...

ext.ext_cn: 凭借先进的生产技术，他们得以占据竞争优势。
ext.ext_en: Through superior production techniques they were able to gain the competitive edge.

defs.def_en: If someone or something has an edge, they have an advantage that makes them stronger or more likely to be successful than another thing or person.

ext.ext_cn: 以新乐队为主打是这次演出的一个亮点。
ext.ext_en: Featuring new bands gives the show an edge...

ext.ext_cn: 格林的小说有强烈的现实主义色彩。
ext.ext_en: Greene's stories had an edge of realism.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has an edge, you mean that they have a powerful quality.

ext.ext_cn: 但是幽默的背后却透着怨气。
ext.ext_en: But underneath the humour is an edge of bitterness...

ext.ext_cn: 他的声音有些紧张。
ext.ext_en: There was a nervous edge to his voice.

defs.def_en: If someone's voice has an edge to it, it has a sharp, bitter, or emotional quality.

ext.ext_cn: 我的神经时刻处于紧绷状态。
ext.ext_en: My nerves were constantly on edge.

defs.def_en: If you or your nerves are on edge, you are tense, nervous, and unable to relax.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数时候，观众都屏息凝神。
ext.ext_en: Most of the time the audience is on the edge of its seat.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is on the edge of their seat or chair, you mean that they are very interested in what is happening or what is going to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然有一些瑕疵，演出还是一举获得了成功。
ext.ext_en: The show, despite some rough edges, was an instant success.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or a piece of entertainment has rough edges, you mean that they have some small faults, although generally you approve of them.

ext.ext_cn: 一度身体欠佳令她表现有失水准。
ext.ext_en: A spell of poor health took the edge off her performance.

defs.def_en: If something takes the edge off a situation, usually an unpleasant one, it weakens its effect or intensity.
A mercenary is a soldier who is paid to fight by a country or group that they do not belong to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 唯利是图的;见钱眼开的
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as mercenary, you are criticizing them because you think that they are only interested in the money that they can get from a particular person or situation.
Antipasto is the sort of food that is often served at the beginning of an Italian meal, for example cold meats and vegetables in olive oil.

defs.def_cn: 流行的观点;广为接受的看法

ext.ext_cn: 她陷入了一场没有爱情的婚姻，这是众所周知的了。
ext.ext_en: The story that she was trapped in a loveless marriage became common currency.

defs.def_en: If you say that an idea or belief has become common currency, you mean it is widely used and accepted.
A cyclist is someone who rides a bicycle, or is riding a bicycle.

defs.def_cn: (字迹等)由黑色细线条构成的

ext.ext_cn: 他在信封上看到了她那细长的笔迹。
ext.ext_en: He saw her spidery writing on the envelope.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as handwriting as spidery, you mean that it consists of thin, dark, pointed lines.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无根据的;似是而非的；谬误的

ext.ext_cn: 这个想法的出发点是好的，但是条理混乱，而且本质上是错误的。
ext.ext_en: The thinking is good-hearted, but muddled and fundamentally unsound...

ext.ext_cn: 从教育角度看，全国统考是不合理的。
ext.ext_en: The national tests were educationally unsound.

defs.def_en: If a conclusion or method is unsound, it is based on ideas that are wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 凡是有头脑的人都不会把钱存到自己明知不可靠的银行里。
ext.ext_en: No sensible person would put his money in a bank he knew to be unsound.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is unsound, they are unreliable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个项目会破坏环境。
ext.ext_en: The project is environmentally unsound...

ext.ext_cn: 卡路里含量极低的饮食结构也会造成营养不良。
ext.ext_en: A diet extremely low in calories can also be a diet that is nutritionally unsound.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is unsound in some way, you mean that it is damaging in that way or to the thing mentioned.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那个教堂的结构很不坚固。
ext.ext_en: The church was structurally unsound.

defs.def_en: If a building or other structure is unsound, it is in poor condition and is likely to collapse.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在国际新闻组有一个短期的空缺职位。
ext.ext_en: They had a short-term vacancy for a person on the foreign desk...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数空缺属于高层职位，要求具备相应的资历。
ext.ext_en: Most vacancies are at senior level, requiring appropriate qualifications.

defs.def_en: A vacancy is a job or position which has not been filled.

ext.ext_cn: 今年,那些通常爆满的旅店整个夏天都有空客房。
ext.ext_en: This year hotels that usually are jammed had vacancies all summer.

defs.def_en: If there are vacancies at a building such as a hotel, some of the rooms are available to rent.

ext.ext_cn: 柴可夫斯基的《第一钢琴协奏曲》
ext.ext_en: ...Tchaikovsky's First Piano Concerto.

ext.ext_cn: 非常适合双小提琴和弦乐队演奏的协奏曲
ext.ext_en: ...a wonderful concerto for two violins and string orchestra.

defs.def_en: A concerto is a piece of music written for one or more solo instruments and an orchestra.
A blindfold is a strip of cloth that is tied over someone's eyes so that they cannot see.

defs.def_cn: 蒙住…的眼睛；遮住…的视线

ext.ext_cn: 绑架者把他的眼睛蒙起来，并开车把他带到了贝鲁特南部的一处公寓。
ext.ext_en: His abductors blindfolded him and drove him to a flat in southern Beirut...

ext.ext_cn: 该报道称犯人常会被蒙住双眼。
ext.ext_en: The report says prisoners were often kept blindfolded.

defs.def_en: If you blindfold someone, you tie a blindfold over their eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 澳大利亚国际象棋顶级大师伊恩·罗杰斯和6位对手下盲棋，战胜了5位。
ext.ext_en: The Australian chess grandmaster Ian Rogers took on six opponents blindfold and beat five.

defs.def_en: If someone does something blindfold, they do it while wearing a blindfold.

defs.def_cn: 能轻而易举；蒙着眼睛都可以

ext.ext_cn: 尽管对信的内容已经能够倒背如流了，他还是又看了一遍。
ext.ext_en: He read the letter again although already he could have recited its contents blindfold.

defs.def_en: If you say that you can do something blindfold, you are emphasizing that you can do it easily, for example because you have done it many times before.

defs.def_cn: （医院的）急诊科，急诊室（缩略形式为A&E;）
