ext.ext_en: For added safety, bar the door to the kitchen.

defs.def_en: If you bar a door, you place something in front of it or a piece of wood or metal across it in order to prevent it from being opened.

ext.ext_cn: 哈里走过去挡住了他的路。
ext.ext_en: Harry moved to bar his way...

ext.ext_cn: 他走到她前面，挡住了她的去路。
ext.ext_en: He stepped in front of her, barring her way.

defs.def_en: If you bar someone's way, you prevent them from going somewhere or entering a place, by blocking their path.

ext.ext_cn: 从1982年起，大赦国际的工作人员就被禁止进入斯里兰卡。
ext.ext_en: Amnesty workers have been barred from Sri Lanka since 1982...

ext.ext_cn: 很多工作将他们拒之门外。
ext.ext_en: Many jobs were barred to them.

defs.def_en: If someone is barred from a place or from doing something, they are officially forbidden to go there or to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 交流的一个基本障碍就是缺少一种大家都说的通用语。
ext.ext_en: One of the fundamental bars to communication is the lack of a universally spoken, common language...

ext.ext_cn: 政府机构在一个又一个行业中设置了障碍以阻止竞争。
ext.ext_en: In industry after industry, government bodies have erected bars to competition.

defs.def_en: If something is a bar to doing a particular thing, it prevents someone from doing it.

defs.def_cn: 不受任何规则约束；不限任何方式方法；不择手段

ext.ext_cn: 这是一场没有规则的战争，我们必须作好抵抗的准备。
ext.ext_en: It is a war with no holds barred and we must prepare to resist...

ext.ext_cn: 她发起火来什么都干得出。
ext.ext_en: When she'd  get angry it was no holds barred.

defs.def_en: If you say that there are no holds barred when people are fighting or competing for something, you mean that they are no longer following any rules in their efforts to win.

ext.ext_cn: 除1989年物价稳定之外，从20世纪80年代中期开始，通货膨胀就一直在上升。
ext.ext_en: Bar a plateau in 1989, there has been a rise in inflation ever since the mid-1980's...

ext.ext_cn: 该项服务的目的就是向独立投资者提供除建议外他们想要的一切。
ext.ext_en: The aim of the service was to offer everything the independent investor wanted, bar advice.

defs.def_en: See also:barring;You can use bar when you mean 'except'. For example, all the work bar the washing means all the work except the washing.

defs.def_cn: （英格兰有资格在任何法庭作辩护的）出庭律师职业；（美国的）律师职业，律师界

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯特打算学法律。
ext.ext_en: Robert was planning to read for the Bar.

defs.def_en: The Bar is used to refer to the profession of a barrister in England, or of any kind of lawyer in the United States.
In music, a bar is one of the several short parts of the same length into which a piece of music is divided.

ext.ext_cn: 我丈夫不得不吃几片药来降压。
ext.ext_en: My husband has to take several pills to counteract high blood pressure...

ext.ext_cn: 这一事件将会削弱此类趋势。
ext.ext_en: This event will counteract such trends.

defs.def_en: To counteract something means to reduce its effect by doing something that produces an opposite effect.

ext.ext_cn: 他以在大街上乞讨为生。
ext.ext_en: He lived on the street as a vagrant.

defs.def_en: A vagrant is someone who moves a lot from place to place because they have no permanent home or job, and have to ask for or steal things in order to live.

ext.ext_cn: 3个年龄在19到20岁之间的被告被控谋杀未遂。
ext.ext_en: The three accused, aged between 19 and 20, are charged with attempted murder...

ext.ext_cn: 除非撤销对她的谋杀指控，否则她拒绝作证。
ext.ext_en: She refused to testify, unless the murder charge against her was dropped.

defs.def_en: Murder is the deliberate and illegal killing of a person.  →see usage note at:kill

ext.ext_cn: 关于两个男人为了看看是否能成功逃脱惩罚而去谋杀另一名男子的惊悚片
ext.ext_en: ...a thriller about two men who murder a third to see if they can get away with it.

ext.ext_cn: 被谋杀的宗教和政治领袖的尸体
ext.ext_en: ...the body of a murdered religious and political leader.

defs.def_en: To murder someone means to commit the crime of killing them deliberately.

defs.def_cn: (做坏事而)安然无恙，逍遥法外，为所欲为

ext.ext_cn: 他很有魅力而且讨人喜欢，这常让他能够为所欲为。
ext.ext_en: His charm and the fact that he is so likeable often allows him to get away with murder.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone gets away with murder, you are complaining that they can do whatever they like without anyone trying to control them or punish them.

defs.def_cn: (对不喜欢的东西)大惊小怪地拼命叫嚷

ext.ext_cn: 人们对着那些穿越他们城市的川流不息的车辆大呼小叫。
ext.ext_en: People are screaming blue murder about the amount of traffic going through their town.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone screams blue murder or screams bloody murder, you are emphasizing that they are making a lot of noise or fuss about something that they do not like.

defs.def_cn: （在参考书、列表等中）查检（事实或信息）

ext.ext_cn: 我在人事档案里找到了你的地址。
ext.ext_en: I looked your address up in the personnel file...

ext.ext_cn: 这个词的意思很多人都要查字典才知道。
ext.ext_en: Many people have to look up the meaning of this word in the dictionary.

defs.def_en: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it out by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

defs.def_cn: 拜访，探访，看望（久未见面的人）

ext.ext_cn: 我会设法登门拜访，问他几个问题。
ext.ext_en: I'll  try to look him up, ask him a few questions...

ext.ext_cn: 她去看望了一些过去的老朋友。
ext.ext_en: She looked up some friends of bygone years.

defs.def_en: If you look someone up, you visit them after not having seen them for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 计算机行业的情况可能会好转。
ext.ext_en: Things could be looking up in the computer industry.

defs.def_en: If a situation is looking up, it is improving.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Someone who is indigent is very poor.

ext.ext_cn: 他从大楼一个窗口跳出去跑了。
ext.ext_en: He had leapt from a window in the building and escaped...

ext.ext_cn: 新闻短片里有他跳向空中的画面。
ext.ext_en: The newsreels show him leaping into the air...

defs.def_en: If you leap, you jump high in the air or jump a long distance.

ext.ext_cn: 两名男子跳上吉普车，疾驰而去。
ext.ext_en: The two men leaped into the jeep and roared off...

ext.ext_cn: 他狂吼一声，向前猛冲，纵身跳进水中。
ext.ext_en: With a terrible howl, he leapt forward and threw himself into the water.

defs.def_en: If you leap somewhere, you move there suddenly and quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车向前飞驰。
ext.ext_en: The car leapt forward.

defs.def_en: If a vehicle leaps somewhere, it moves there in a short sudden movement.

ext.ext_cn: 其结果是生产力的大幅提高。
ext.ext_en: The result has been a giant leap in productivity.

ext.ext_cn: 由35,000猛增至75,000的失业人数
ext.ext_en: ...the leap in the unemployed from 35,000 to 75,000...

defs.def_en: A leap is a large and important change, increase, or advance.

ext.ext_cn: 沃里克队在排名中蹿升至第3名，落后领先的埃塞克斯队31分。
ext.ext_en: Warwicks leap to third in the table, 31 points behind leaders Essex.

defs.def_en: If you leap to a particular place or position, you make a large and important change, increase, or advance.

defs.def_cn: （因吃惊、害怕、高兴等心脏）猛地跳动

ext.ext_cn: 我见到她时心都要跳出来了。
ext.ext_en: My heart leaped at the sight of her.

defs.def_en: If you say that your heart leaps, you mean that you experience a sudden, very strong feeling of surprise, fear, or happiness.

ext.ext_cn: 戏剧学校校长一职出缺，他马上抓住了这个机会。
ext.ext_en: The post of principal of the theatre school became vacant and he leapt at the chance.

defs.def_en: If you leap at a chance or opportunity, you accept it quickly and eagerly.

defs.def_cn: （改善或增长）非常迅速地，飞跃地

ext.ext_cn: 他今季的表现一日千里。
ext.ext_en: He's improved in leaps and bounds this season...

ext.ext_cn: 地球上的物种数目似乎正飞速增长。
ext.ext_en: The total number of species on the planet appears to be growing by leaps and bounds.

defs.def_en: You can use in leaps and bounds or by leaps and bounds to emphasize that someone or something is improving or increasing quickly and greatly.

ext.ext_cn: 小心谨慎的人是不会轻易冒险的。
ext.ext_en: Prudent people are not going to take a leap in the dark...

ext.ext_cn: 他再次毫无计划地乱闯。
ext.ext_en: Once more he's making a leap into the unknown without a plan.

defs.def_en: If you take a leap in the dark or a leap into the unknown, you do something without having any previous experience in that activity or knowledge of it.
A homosexual relationship is a sexual relationship between people of the same sex.

ext.ext_cn: 一桩涉及两名同性恋律师的欺诈案审判被撤销了。
ext.ext_en: A fraud trial involving two homosexual lawyers was abandoned.

ext.ext_cn: 法官说对同性恋者的歧视应予以谴责。
ext.ext_en: The judge said that discrimination against homosexuals is deplorable.

defs.def_en: Someone who is homosexual is sexually attracted to people of the same sex.

defs.def_cn: 折叠式轻便婴儿车；折叠式幼儿小推车
defs.def_en: A baby buggy is a small folding seat with wheels, which a young child can sit in and which can be pushed around.
A baby buggy is another word for a baby carriage .

ext.ext_cn: 加泰罗尼亚自治区首府巴塞罗那
ext.ext_en: ...Barcelona, capital of the autonomous region of Catalonia.

ext.ext_cn: 边远山区
ext.ext_en: ...a remote mountain region.

defs.def_en: A region is  a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦和外省地区
ext.ext_en: ...London and the regions...

ext.ext_cn: 将采取税收优惠政策把公司吸引到东南部以外的各地区。
ext.ext_en: Tax incentives would be used to attract firms to the regions, away from the South-East.

defs.def_en: The regions are the parts of a country that are not the capital city and its surrounding area.

ext.ext_cn: 骨盆区
ext.ext_en: ...the pelvic region.

ext.ext_cn: 大脑的额区
ext.ext_en: ...the frontal region of the brain.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a part of your body as a region.

ext.ext_cn: 这个计划将耗资大约600万英镑。
ext.ext_en: The scheme will cost in the region of six million pounds.

defs.def_en: You say in the region of to indicate that an amount that you are stating is approximate.

defs.def_cn: (尤指俄国 1917 年前)沙皇专制的，沙皇时代的，支持沙皇政体的
defs.def_en: Tsarist means belonging to or supporting the system of government by a tsar, especially in Russia before 1917.

ext.ext_cn: 我们开过了，不得不原路返回。
ext.ext_en: We drove past it and had to double back.

defs.def_en: If you double back you go back in the direction that you came from.
A tern is a small black and white seabird with long wings and a forked tail.
A phone box is a small shelter in the street in which there is a public telephone.
A bowling alley is a building which contains several tracks for bowling.

ext.ext_cn: 那场比赛在付费电视节目中播出。
ext.ext_en: The match appeared on pay-per-view television.

defs.def_en: Pay-per-view is a cable or satellite television system in which you have to pay a fee if you want to watch a particular programme.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰和他年迈的母亲一起生活。
ext.ext_en: John lives with his ageing mother...

ext.ext_cn: 老化的飞机需要更加频繁地进行安全检查。
ext.ext_en: Ageing aircraft need more frequent safety inspections.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is ageing is becoming older and less healthy or efficient.
Ageing is the process of becoming old or becoming worn out.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 富足的；成功的；兴旺的；繁荣的

ext.ext_cn: 一个相对富裕的英国家族中最小的儿子
ext.ext_en: ...the youngest son of a relatively prosperous British family...

ext.ext_cn: 这地方显得空前繁荣。
ext.ext_en: The place looks more prosperous than ever.

defs.def_en: Prosperous people, places, and economies are rich and successful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 英国将对武器出售采取更具限制性的政策。
ext.ext_en: Britain is to adopt a more restrictive policy on arms sales.

ext.ext_cn: 限制条件越来越多的移民法
ext.ext_en: ...increasingly restrictive immigration laws...

defs.def_en: Something that is restrictive prevents people from doing what they want to do, or from moving freely.

defs.def_cn: 权力自主原则，权力下放原则(允许成员针对影响自身的问题自作主张)

ext.ext_cn: 财政大臣很清楚，必须保证权力下放原则得到贯彻执行并使之奏效。
ext.ext_en: The chancellor knows that the principle of subsidiarity must be guaranteed and shown to work.

defs.def_en: Subsidiarity is the principle of allowing the individual members of a large organization to make decisions on issues that affect them, rather than leaving those decisions to be made by the whole group.

defs.def_cn: 使感到震惊;使毛骨悚然;使产生反感

ext.ext_cn: 他的家人对这一变化感到震惊。
ext.ext_en: His family were horrified by the change.

ext.ext_cn: 会让所有父母感到毛骨悚然的犯罪趋势
ext.ext_en: ...a crime trend that will horrify all parents.

defs.def_en: If someone is horrified, they feel shocked or disgusted, usually because of something that they have seen or heard.

ext.ext_cn: 他有一双深陷的褐色眼睛。
ext.ext_en: He had deep-set brown eyes.

defs.def_en: Deep-set eyes seem to be further back in the face than most people's eyes.
If someone calls a man a dickhead, they are saying that they think he is very stupid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 恶毒的眼神
ext.ext_en: ...a baleful look.

defs.def_en: Baleful means harmful, or expressing harmful intentions.

ext.ext_cn: 带有 120 英尺高塔的 11 世纪城堡
ext.ext_en: ...an eleventh century castle with 120-foot high towers.

ext.ext_cn: 比萨斜塔
ext.ext_en: ...the Leaning Tower of Pisa.

defs.def_en: A tower is a tall, narrow building, that either stands alone or forms part of another building such as a church or castle.

defs.def_cn: (比周围的人或物)高出许多；屹立

ext.ext_cn: 他站起身来，比她高出许多。
ext.ext_en: He stood up and towered over her...

ext.ext_cn: 在学校，一个女孩可能比她同龄的大多数男孩子都要高出许多。
ext.ext_en: At school, a girl may tower over most boys her age…

defs.def_en: Someone or something that towers over surrounding people or things is a lot taller than they are.

defs.def_cn: (无线电或电视信号的)发射塔

ext.ext_cn: 军队仍然控制着电视和广播发射塔。
ext.ext_en: Troops are still in control of the television and radio tower.

defs.def_en: A tower is a tall structure that is used for sending radio or television signals.

ext.ext_cn: 他为法兰克福一栋新写字楼所作的设计
ext.ext_en: ...his design for a new office tower in Frankfurt.

defs.def_en: A tower is the same as a tower block .
A tower is a tall box that contains the main parts of a computer, such as the hard disk and the drives.

defs.def_cn: (在危难时)可依靠的人，主心骨，支柱

ext.ext_cn: 帕特是我们全家人的主心骨。
ext.ext_en: Pat was a tower of strength to our whole family.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a tower of strength, you appreciate them because they give you a lot of help, support, and encouragement when you have problems or are in a difficult situation.

ext.ext_cn: 静脉滴注器
ext.ext_en: ...an intravenous drip.

ext.ext_cn: 通过静脉注射的吸毒者
ext.ext_en: ...intravenous drug users.

defs.def_en: Intravenous foods or drugs are given to sick people through their veins, rather than their mouths.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 岳父的猝死使他十分伤心。
ext.ext_en: He had been deeply affected by the sudden death of his father-in-law...

ext.ext_cn: 那位陌生人说：“我希望突然改变地点不会给您带来不便。”
ext.ext_en: 'I hope,' the stranger said, 'that the sudden change of venue did not inconvenience you.'...

defs.def_en: Sudden means happening quickly and unexpectedly.

ext.ext_cn: 她突然看起来一点都不困了。
ext.ext_en: All of a sudden she didn't look sleepy any more.

defs.def_en: If something happens all of a sudden, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

defs.def_cn: 过早的；提早的；未到期的

ext.ext_cn: 他母亲的早逝给了他沉重的打击。
ext.ext_en: His mother's untimely death had a catastrophic effect on him...

ext.ext_cn: 她提前回来可能会破坏掉梅尔维尔小姐今晚的整个计划。
ext.ext_en: Her untimely return could spoil Miss Melville's entire programme for the evening.

defs.def_en: If you describe an event as untimely, you mean that it happened earlier than it should, or sooner than you expected.

ext.ext_cn: 送牛奶的来得不是时候
ext.ext_en: ...an untimely visit from the milkman...

ext.ext_cn: 即使往最好里说，我相信你的读者也会觉得这篇文章发表得不是时候。
ext.ext_en: I am sure your readers would have seen the article as at best untimely.

defs.def_en: You can describe something as untimely if it happens at an unsuitable time.

ext.ext_cn: 这支军队的溃败使这个地区出现了军事真空。
ext.ext_en: The collapse of the army left a vacuum in the area...

ext.ext_cn: 他的出现将填补过去这几天形成的权力真空。
ext.ext_en: His presence should fill the power vacuum which has been developing over the past few days.

defs.def_en: If someone or something creates a vacuum, they leave a place or position which then needs to be filled by another person or thing.

defs.def_cn: 在封闭状态中;与外界隔绝

ext.ext_cn: 道德价值观的教育不能脱离实际。
ext.ext_en: Moral values cannot be taught in a vacuum...

ext.ext_cn: 我们生活在与世隔绝的环境里——没有其他生物，收不到外界消息，也没有书看。
ext.ext_en: We lived in a vacuum — no life, no news, no books.

defs.def_en: If something is done in a vacuum, it is not affected by any outside influences or information.

ext.ext_cn: 今天我用吸尘器清洁了地毯。
ext.ext_en: I vacuumed the carpets today...

ext.ext_cn: 定期用吸尘器吸尘很重要。
ext.ext_en: It's important to vacuum regularly.

defs.def_en: If you vacuum something, you clean it using a vacuum cleaner.

ext.ext_cn: 风是由于热空气上升产生真空导致的一种气流运动。
ext.ext_en: Wind is a current of air caused by a vacuum caused by hot air rising...

ext.ext_cn: 旋转的涡轮形成了一块真空区域。
ext.ext_en: The spinning turbine creates a vacuum.

defs.def_en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas.
Calcium is a soft white element which is found in bones and teeth, and also in limestone, chalk, and marble.
A funnel is an object with a wide, circular top and a narrow short tube at the bottom. Funnels are used to pour liquids into containers which have a small opening, for example bottles.

ext.ext_cn: 一艘有3根桅杆和两个烟囱的商船
ext.ext_en: ...a merchantman with three masts and two funnels.

defs.def_en: A funnel is a metal chimney on a ship or railway engine powered by steam.

ext.ext_cn: 这些火焰造成了对流漏斗，把许多微粒抛向上层大气。
ext.ext_en: These fires create convection funnels, and throw a lot of particles into the upper atmosphere.

defs.def_en: You can describe as a funnel something that is narrow, or narrow at one end, through which a substance flows and is directed.

ext.ext_cn: 风从北方吹来，刮过平原，穿过山谷。
ext.ext_en: The winds came from the north, across the plains, funnelling down the valley...

ext.ext_cn: 北海高涨的潮水被一场风暴推涌进英吉利海峡。
ext.ext_en: High tides in the North Sea were funnelled down into the English Channel by a storm.

defs.def_en: If something funnels somewhere or is funnelled there, it is directed through a narrow space.

defs.def_cn: 输送，传送(金钱、货物或信息)

ext.ext_cn: 其全球艾滋病项目把捐款发放给各国政府。
ext.ext_en: Its Global Programme on AIDS funnelled money from donors to governments...

ext.ext_cn: 他偷偷地把信用卡信息传递给造假者。
ext.ext_en: He secretly funnelled credit-card information to counterfeiters.

defs.def_en: If you funnel money, goods, or information from one place or group to another, you cause it to be sent there as it becomes available.

ext.ext_cn: 一些主教练最近就英格兰职业足球运动员协会负责这些谈判提出了异议。
ext.ext_en: Some managers have recently raised objection to the PFA handling these negotiations...

ext.ext_cn: 参议院不顾白宫的反对于今天投票决定中止援助。
ext.ext_en: Despite objections by the White House, the Senate voted today to cut off aid.

defs.def_en: If you make or raise an objection to something, you say that you do not like it or agree with it.

ext.ext_cn: 我对银行营利并不抵触。
ext.ext_en: I have no objection to banks making money...

ext.ext_cn: 我不会再因为你去见她而不高兴。
ext.ext_en: I no longer have any objection to your going to see her.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have no objection to something, you mean that you are not annoyed or bothered by it.

defs.def_cn: (体育比赛中的)奖章获得者，奖牌获得者

ext.ext_cn: 奥运会金牌得主
ext.ext_en: ...the Olympic gold medallists.

defs.def_en: A medallist is a person who has won a medal in sport.

ext.ext_cn: 屏住呼吸片刻，然后呼气。
ext.ext_en: Hold your breath for a moment and exhale...

ext.ext_cn: 韦德吐出一口烟，然后咳嗽起来。
ext.ext_en: Wade exhaled a cloud of smoke and coughed.

defs.def_en: When you exhale, you breathe out the air that is in your lungs.

ext.ext_cn: 医生职业性的冷静
ext.ext_en: ...a doctor's professional detachment...

ext.ext_cn: 里德利以一种吹毛求疵的超然态度看待他的作品。
ext.ext_en: Ridley viewed his work with a cynical detachment.

defs.def_en: Detachment is the feeling that you have of not being personally involved in something or of having no emotional interest in it.

ext.ext_cn: 海军陆战队独立小分队
ext.ext_en: ...a detachment of marines.

defs.def_en: A detachment is a group of soldiers who are sent away from the main group to do a special job.

defs.def_cn: (通常指储存食物的)仓库，栈房

ext.ext_cn: 有些村舍里仍住着老人;有些已经改作粮仓和仓库。
ext.ext_en: Some of the cottages were still lived in by old folk; others had been turned into barns and storehouses.

defs.def_en: A storehouse is a building in which things, usually food, are stored.

ext.ext_cn: 这本书是名副其实的信息宝库。
ext.ext_en: This book is a veritable storehouse of information...

ext.ext_cn: 拥有一座藏满了珍贵记忆的宝库真是令人欣慰。
ext.ext_en: It is comforting to have a storehouse of treasured memories.

defs.def_en: When a lot of things can be found together in one place, you can refer to this place as a storehouse of a particular kind.
Your fingernails are the thin hard areas at the end of each of your fingers.

defs.def_cn: （苏格兰和美国的）新教圣公会的

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰新教圣公会
ext.ext_en: ...the Scottish Episcopal Church.

ext.ext_cn: 纽约新教圣公会主教
ext.ext_en: ...the Episcopal bishop of New York.

defs.def_en: Episcopal means relating to a branch of the Anglican Church in Scotland and the USA.

ext.ext_cn: 主教会议
ext.ext_en: ...episcopal conferences.

ext.ext_cn: 一套红色的主教法衣
ext.ext_en: ...a set of red episcopal vestments.

defs.def_en: Episcopal means relating to bishops.

defs.def_cn: (在英国，根据法律凡车龄3年以上的车辆必须进行的)年检，旧车性能检测

ext.ext_cn: 我的车再有两天就该年检了。
ext.ext_en: My car is due for its MOT in two days' time.

defs.def_en: In Britain, an MOT is a test which, by law, must be made each year on all road vehicles that are more than 3 years old, in order to check that they are safe to drive.
A nutcracker is a device used to crack the shell of a nut. Nutcrackers can be used to refer to one or more of these devices.

ext.ext_cn: 学校的道德和伦理标准
ext.ext_en: ...the moral and ethical standards in the school.

ext.ext_cn: 围绕患不治之症的人们的医疗、护理和伦理方面的问题
ext.ext_en: ...the medical, nursing and ethical issues surrounding terminally-ill people.

defs.def_en: Ethical means relating to beliefs about right and wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 合乎道德的;合乎伦理规范的

ext.ext_cn: 合乎道德规范的投资计划
ext.ext_en: ...ethical investment schemes...

ext.ext_cn: 该政党认为将税收政策和党内筹资挂钩是合乎道德的做法吗？
ext.ext_en: Does the party think it is ethical to link tax policy with party fund-raising?

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ethical, you mean that it is morally right or morally acceptable.

defs.def_cn: 小声发表意见;小声表达观点

ext.ext_cn: 一段时间以来，人们都在暗地里发着牢骚，表达对政府应对通货膨胀政策的不满。
ext.ext_en: For some time there have been murmurings of discontent over the government policy on inflation...

ext.ext_cn: 在这一点上专家们低声赞同。
ext.ext_en: At this point there were murmurings of approval from the experts.

defs.def_en: If there are murmurings of, for example, approval or disapproval, people are expressing their approval or disapproval of something in a quiet way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Clement weather is pleasantly mild and dry.

defs.def_cn: 有导游陪同的参观(或游览)
defs.def_en: A conducted tour is a visit to a building, town, or area during which someone goes with you and explains everything to you.

ext.ext_cn: 这所大学从1971年起开始实行男女同校。
ext.ext_en: The college has been co-educational since 1971.

defs.def_en: A co-educational school, college, or university is attended by both boys and girls.
A whip is a long thin piece of material such as leather or rope, fastened to a stiff handle. It is used for hitting people or animals.

ext.ext_cn: 目击证人称梅尔顿先生抽打了这匹马16鞭之多。
ext.ext_en: Eyewitnesses claimed Mr Melton whipped the horse up to 16 times...

ext.ext_cn: 他被用带有饰钉的皮带抽打。
ext.ext_en: He was whipped with a studded belt.

defs.def_en: If someone whips a person or animal, they beat them or hit them with a whip or something like a whip.

ext.ext_cn: 狂风抽打着我们的脸。
ext.ext_en: A terrible wind whipped our faces...

ext.ext_cn: 一根树枝抽打到了她的脸颊。
ext.ext_en: A branch whipped her across the cheek.

defs.def_en: If something, for example the wind, whips something, it strikes it sharply.

ext.ext_cn: 缕缕金发在风中飘扬。
ext.ext_en: Blond strands of hair whipped in the wind.

defs.def_en: If something flexible whips in a particular way, it moves sharply when it is affected by a force, for example by the wind.

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃迅速掏出他的笔记本。
ext.ext_en: Bob whipped out his notebook...

ext.ext_cn: 运动员们在飞快地脱衬衫。
ext.ext_en: Players were whipping their shirts off...

defs.def_en: If someone whips something out or whips it off, they take it out or take it off very quickly and suddenly.

ext.ext_cn: 在这里，大风以每小时大约30英里的速度刮着。
ext.ext_en: The wind out here is whipping along at about 30 miles an hour...

ext.ext_cn: 我迅速地驶入一个停车位。
ext.ext_en: I whipped into a parking space.

defs.def_en: If something or someone whips somewhere, they move there or go there very quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 搅打奶油直到它变黏稠。
ext.ext_en: Whip the cream until thick...

ext.ext_cn: 把鸡蛋、油和蜂蜜搅打在一起。
ext.ext_en: Whip the eggs, oils and honey together.

defs.def_en: When you whip something liquid such as cream or an egg, you stir it very fast until it is thick or stiff.

ext.ext_cn: 他能让一群人变得歇斯底里。
ext.ext_en: He could whip a crowd into hysteria...

ext.ext_cn: 政治家和商人们把他们自己弄得十分恐慌。
ext.ext_en: Politicians and businessmen have whipped themselves into a panic.

defs.def_en: If you whip people into an emotional state, you deliberately cause and encourage them to be in that state.

defs.def_cn: 组织秘书，党鞭（维持党纪并督导该党议员出席议会重要议题的讨论和表决的人）
defs.def_en: See also:three-line whip;A whip is a member of a political party in a parliament or legislature who is responsible for making sure that party members are present to vote on important issues and that they vote in the appropriate way.

ext.ext_cn: 如今购物者占主导地位，如果商店不降价，他们是不会买的。
ext.ext_en: These days the shopper has the whip hand, and will not buy if stores fail to lower their prices.

defs.def_en: If you have the whip hand, you have power over someone else in a particular situation.
An oil well is a deep hole which is made in order to get oil out of the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 我惊呆了。
ext.ext_en: I felt numb with horror...

ext.ext_cn: 我惊恐万分地看着船加足马力从我身边开走了。
ext.ext_en: As I watched in horror the boat began to power away from me.

defs.def_en: Horror is a feeling of great shock, fear, and worry caused by something extremely unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 他对死亡的惧怕
ext.ext_en: ...his horror of death.

defs.def_en: If you have a horror of something, you are afraid of it or dislike it very much.

ext.ext_cn: 这场极其血腥的内战的惨烈
ext.ext_en: ...the horror of this most bloody of civil wars.

defs.def_en: The horror of something, especially something that hurts people, is its very great unpleasantness.

defs.def_cn: 极其不愉快（或可怕）的经历

ext.ext_cn: 你能想象得出自从我上次给你写信以来我们所经历的所有可怕事情吗？
ext.ext_en: Can you possibly imagine all the horrors we have undergone since I last wrote you?

defs.def_en: You can refer to extremely unpleasant or frightening experiences as horrors .

defs.def_cn: 极讨厌（或丑陋）的人（或事物）

ext.ext_cn: 招待我们的男主人傲慢无礼。真不知道他温柔的妻子怎么能容忍这样一个讨厌的家伙。
ext.ext_en: Our host was arrogant and offensive. How his sweet wife could tolerate such a horror was baffling.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone or something as a horror, you mean that you think they are very unpleasant or ugly.

defs.def_cn: （影片或故事）情节恐怖的，惊悚的

ext.ext_cn: 心理恐怖片
ext.ext_en: ...a psychological horror film.

defs.def_en: A horror film or story is intended to be very frightening.

ext.ext_cn: 乘飞机旅行时丢失行李的糟糕经历
ext.ext_en: ...a horror story about lost luggage while flying.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an account of a very unpleasant experience or event as a horror story.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司已经凭借其袋泡茶提高了自己在英国茶叶市场的占有份额。现在它正在成功地使该国人民改喝（最可怕不过的）速溶茶。
ext.ext_en: The company has already boosted its share of the UK tea market with its round tea bags. Now it is successfully converting the nation to (horror of horrors) instant tea.

defs.def_en: Horror of horrors is used to refer to something that you consider to be the worst part of a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 经济学专业的本科生可能是大学里最聪明的学生。
ext.ext_en: Economics undergraduates are probably the brightest in the university.

ext.ext_cn: 大学本科课程
ext.ext_en: ...undergraduate degree programmes.

defs.def_en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for his or her first degree.

defs.def_cn: 方法;手段;工具(means 用于此意时单复数同形)

ext.ext_cn: 采取这项举措是为了打击犯罪。
ext.ext_en: The move is a means to fight crime...

ext.ext_cn: 军队已经深谙利用恐怖手段控制民众之道。
ext.ext_en: The army had perfected the use of terror as a means of controlling the population...

defs.def_en: A means of doing something is a method, instrument, or process which can be used to do it. Means is both the singular and the plural form for this use.

ext.ext_cn: 富人
ext.ext_en: ...a person of means...

ext.ext_cn: 他没有钱来补偿她。
ext.ext_en: He did not have the means to compensate her.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the money that someone has as their means .

defs.def_cn: 超出财力；入不敷出/在财力之内；量入为出

ext.ext_cn: 得到的礼物越多，她的胃口就越大，直到他捉襟见肘为止。
ext.ext_en: The more gifts she received, the more she craved, until he was living beyond his means...

ext.ext_cn: 量入为出地一步步偿还旧债，这个方法要好得多。
ext.ext_en: It is far better to pay off old debts steadily by living within your means.

defs.def_en: If someone is living beyond their means, they are spending more money than they can afford. If someone is living within their means, they are not spending more money than they can afford.

ext.ext_cn: 本课程为期两年，授课形式为讲座与研讨。
ext.ext_en: This is a two year course taught by means of lectures and seminars...

ext.ext_cn: 活动房屋通过一系列复杂的软管、管道和连杆与汽车相连。
ext.ext_en: The trailer was connected to the car by means of a complicated system of hoses, pipes and rods.

defs.def_en: If you do something by means of a particular method, instrument, or process, you do it using that method, instrument, or process.

ext.ext_cn: “我可以过来看看你的房子吗？”“当然可以。”
ext.ext_en: 'Can I come and have a look at your house?' — 'Yes by all means'.

defs.def_en: You can say 'by all means' to tell someone that you are very willing to allow them to do something.

defs.def_cn: 决不;丝毫不;一点儿也不

ext.ext_cn: 这丝毫不足为奇。
ext.ext_en: This is by no means out of the ordinary...

ext.ext_cn: 不过，他们并没有结束,绝对没有。
ext.ext_en: They were not finished, however, not by any means.

defs.def_en: You use expressions such as 'by no means', 'not by any means', and 'by no manner of means' to emphasize that something is not true.

ext.ext_cn: 我们似乎忽略了这样一个事实：营销只是达到目的的手段。
ext.ext_en: We seem to have lost sight of the fact that marketing is only a means to an end.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a means to an end, you mean that it helps you to achieve what you want, although it may not be enjoyable or important itself.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 刺骨的寒风于开阔处呼啸着。
ext.ext_en: An icy wind blew hard across the open spaces...

ext.ext_cn: 他的鞋和衣服都湿透了，冰冷冰冷的。
ext.ext_en: His shoes and clothing were wet through and icy cold.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as icy or icy cold, you mean that it is extremely cold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: An icy road has ice on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 冷冰冰的;不友好的;冷漠的

ext.ext_cn: 他反应冷淡。
ext.ext_en: His response was icy.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as icy, you mean that they are not affectionate or friendly, and they show their dislike or anger in a quiet, controlled way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 磁性微粒
ext.ext_en: ...magnetic particles.

defs.def_en: If something metal is magnetic, it acts like a magnet.

ext.ext_cn: 带电气体粒子会受磁力影响。
ext.ext_en: The electrically charged gas particles are affected by magnetic forces.

defs.def_en: You use magnetic to describe something that is caused by or relates to the force of magnetism.

ext.ext_cn: 她的磁条身份证
ext.ext_en: ...her magnetic strip ID card.

ext.ext_cn: 录音磁带
ext.ext_en: ...magnetic recording tape.

defs.def_en: You use magnetic to describe tapes and other objects which have a coating of a magnetic substance and contain coded information that can be read by computers or other machines.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 引人注目的;有吸引力的;有魅力的

ext.ext_cn: 繁荣的德国经济对未来移民的吸引力
ext.ext_en: ...the magnetic effect of the prosperous German economy on would-be immigrants.

ext.ext_cn: 他外表的魅力与她个性的魅力
ext.ext_en: ...the magnetic pull of his looks and her personality.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as magnetic, you mean that it is very attractive to people because it has unusual, powerful, and exciting qualities.

defs.def_cn: 提示;使人回忆起某事的事物

ext.ext_cn: 有些事将很快让英国人清楚意识到海外作战究竟意味着什么。
ext.ext_en: The British are about to be given a sharp reminder of what fighting abroad really means...

ext.ext_cn: 首都爆发了暴力事件，这给了人们一个严酷的提醒——宗教紧张局势还在持续。
ext.ext_en: Violence has broken out in the capital, a stark reminder that the religious tensions are refusing to go away.

defs.def_en: Something that serves as a reminder of another thing makes you think about the other thing.

defs.def_cn: 缴费单;催缴单;催缴通知

ext.ext_cn: 最后一次煤气催缴通知单
ext.ext_en: ...the final reminder for the gas bill.

defs.def_en: A reminder is a letter or note that is sent to tell you that you have not done something such as pay a bill or return library books.

defs.def_cn: （通常指躺在床上的）小睡，小憩

ext.ext_cn: 她去了楼上小睡一会儿。
ext.ext_en: She had departed upstairs for a lie-down.

defs.def_en: If you have a lie-down, you have a short rest, usually in bed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我有时脾气有点暴躁。
ext.ext_en: I'm a bit short-tempered sometimes.

defs.def_en: Someone who is short-tempered gets angry very quickly.

defs.def_cn: 长有羽冠的;长有鸟冠的

ext.ext_cn: 有羽冠的鹰
ext.ext_en: ...crested hawks.

defs.def_en: A crested bird is a bird that has a crest on its head.

ext.ext_cn: 有饰章的瓷器
ext.ext_en: ...crested china.

ext.ext_cn: 有饰章的信纸
ext.ext_en: ...crested writing paper.

defs.def_en: Crested objects have on them the crest of a noble family, a town, or an organization.

defs.def_cn: 发生冲突;打斗;争论;意见不合

ext.ext_cn: 400名示威者与警察发生了冲突。
ext.ext_en: A group of 400 demonstrators clashed with police...

ext.ext_cn: 在幕后，帕森斯几乎和剧组的所有人都发生过冲突。
ext.ext_en: Behind the scenes, Parsons clashed with almost everyone on the show...

defs.def_en: When people clash, they fight, argue, or disagree with each other.

defs.def_cn: (信仰、观点、特性)相互冲突，相互抵触，不相容

ext.ext_cn: 所作的任何决策都不要和公司官方理念相冲突。
ext.ext_en: Don't make any policy decisions which clash with official company thinking...

ext.ext_cn: 在这个问题上，道德和良知互不相容。
ext.ext_en: Here, morality and good sentiments clash headlong.

defs.def_en: Beliefs, ideas, or qualities that clash with each other are very different from each other and therefore are opposed.

ext.ext_cn: 由于航班提前，侦探更改了度假日期，但是这样一来就和审判冲突了。
ext.ext_en: The detective changed his holiday dates when his flight was brought forward and it now clashed with the trial.

defs.def_en: If one event clashes with another, the two events happen at the same time so that you cannot attend both of them.

ext.ext_cn: 红门和石墙柔和的自然色调不协调。
ext.ext_en: The red door clashed with the soft, natural tones of the stone walls...

ext.ext_cn: 那么，要是色彩不搭怎么办？
ext.ext_en: So what if the colours clashed?

defs.def_en: If one colour or style clashes with another, the colours or styles look ugly together. You can also say that two colours or styles clash .

defs.def_cn: (体育用语中尤用来指热情高涨的比赛双方)交锋，交手，厮杀

ext.ext_cn: 刘易斯近来恢复了状态，将在4×100米接力赛中和克里斯蒂一决雌雄。
ext.ext_en: Lewis has recently recovered his fitness and will clash with Christie in the 4x100m relay...

ext.ext_cn: 只有切尔西队在四分之一决赛的重赛中击败桑德兰队，双方才会交锋。
ext.ext_en: The two sides will clash there only if Chelsea beat Sunderland in their quarter-final replay.

defs.def_en: Sports journalists sometimes say that two individuals or teams who compete against each other clash, especially when a lot of feeling is involved.

defs.def_cn: (金属相互碰撞)发出当啷当啷声，发出撞击声

ext.ext_cn: 她手臂上的金手镯丁零当啷地响。
ext.ext_en: The golden bangles on her arms clashed and jingled.

ext.ext_cn: 类似钹打出的铿锵声
ext.ext_en: ...a noise like the clash of cymbals.

defs.def_en: When metal objects clash, they make a lot of noise by being hit together.

defs.def_cn: 禁果(因被禁止而具有诱惑力的东西)

ext.ext_cn: 偷情的禁果
ext.ext_en: ...the forbidden fruit of an illicit romance.

defs.def_en: Forbidden fruit is a source of pleasure that involves breaking a rule or doing something that you are not supposed to do.

defs.def_cn: 蠢事;失言;失礼;尴尬的错误
defs.def_en: You can refer to something stupid or embarrassing that someone does or says as a clanger .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （话语、描述或选择）合适的，恰当的，贴切的

ext.ext_cn: 这份报告的措词用在今天和用在1929年一样贴切。
ext.ext_en: The words of this report are as apt today as in 1929.

ext.ext_cn: 对这种情况恰如其分的描述
ext.ext_en: ...an apt description of the situation.

defs.def_en: An apt remark, description, or choice is especially suitable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她动不动就拔高嗓门，并挥舞双手。
ext.ext_en: She was apt to raise her voice and wave her hands about...

ext.ext_cn: 这种天气在冬季往往更为常见。
ext.ext_en: This type of weather is apt to be more common in winter.

defs.def_en: If someone is apt to do something, they often do it and so it is likely that they will do it again.

ext.ext_cn: 他承认曾与人合谋骗取财产。
ext.ext_en: He admitted conspiring to obtain property by deception...

ext.ext_cn: 你是一场相当残忍的骗局的受害者。
ext.ext_en: You've been the victim of a rather cruel deception.

defs.def_en: Deception is the act of deceiving someone or the state of being deceived by someone.

defs.def_cn: 加速，加快（常指不愉快的事）

ext.ext_cn: 但是如果他这样做，就有可能加速自己国家的崩溃。
ext.ext_en: But if he does this, he may hasten the collapse of his own country.

defs.def_en: If you hasten an event or process, often an unpleasant one, you make it happen faster or sooner.

ext.ext_cn: 她比谁都急着去签了合同。
ext.ext_en: She more than anyone had hastened to sign the contract.

defs.def_en: If you hasten to do something, you are quick to do it.

defs.def_cn: （为避免他人误会）急忙（补充说）

ext.ext_cn: 很自然，它会返回。但没有默里的便条，我急忙补充道。
ext.ext_en: Naturally, it'll go back. But without Murray's little note, I hasten to add...

ext.ext_cn: “这不会有什么危险的，弗雷迪，”阿诺德急忙补充了一句。
ext.ext_en: 'There's no threat in this, Freddie,' Arnold hastened to say...

defs.def_en: If you hasten to say something, you quickly add something to what you have just said in order to prevent it being misunderstood.

ext.ext_cn: 他们中第一个下来的人急急忙忙地快步向我走来。
ext.ext_en: One of them, the first to alight, hastened with quicksilver steps towards me.

defs.def_en: If you hasten somewhere, you hurry there.
A caseworker is someone who does casework.
A polar bear is a large white bear which is found near the North Pole.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 其他考古学家对他的发现表示怀疑。
ext.ext_en: Other archaeologists are sceptical about his findings.

ext.ext_cn: 对全球变暖和各种断言的后果持怀疑态度的科学家
ext.ext_en: ...scientists who are sceptical of global warming and its alleged consequences...

defs.def_en: If you are sceptical about something, you have doubts about it.

ext.ext_cn: 宽松的裤子配上紧身夹克
ext.ext_en: ...baggy trousers with fitted jackets.

defs.def_en: A fitted piece of clothing is designed so that it is the same size and shape as your body rather than being loose.

ext.ext_cn: 我重铺了卧室的地毯，又添置了定做的壁橱。
ext.ext_en: I've re-carpeted our bedroom and added fitted wardrobes.

defs.def_en: A fitted piece of furniture, for example a cupboard, is designed to fill a particular space and is fixed in place.

defs.def_cn: (地毯)铺满房间的，定做的，大小合适的

ext.ext_cn: 定制的地毯、中央供暖和双层玻璃窗
ext.ext_en: ...fitted carpets, central heating and double glazing.

defs.def_en: A fitted carpet is cut to the same shape as a room so that it covers the floor completely.

defs.def_cn: (床单)大小合适的，按尺寸缝边的
defs.def_en: A fitted sheet has the corners sewn so that they fit over the corners of the mattress and do not have to be folded.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 合适的;有能力的;胜任的

ext.ext_cn: 海伦与她女儿理想中的温柔母亲形象相差甚远。
ext.ext_en: Helen was ill fitted to fulfil her daughter's ideal of a gentle mother-figure.

defs.def_en: A person who is fitted to do something or fitted for something has the right qualities for it.

ext.ext_cn: 卧室中装有警报器拉绳，遇到紧急情况时可向经理报警。
ext.ext_en: Bedrooms are fitted with alarm pull cords to alert the manager in an emergency.

defs.def_en: If a room is fitted with objects, those objects are in the room and are normally fixed in place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他来自中下阶层一个根本没什么文化的家庭。
ext.ext_en: He comes from a completely uncultured, lower middle-class family.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as uncultured, you are critical of them because they do not seem to know much about art, literature, and other cultural topics.

ext.ext_cn: 我想来点咖啡，如果你只有速溶的那种也可以。
ext.ext_en: I'd like some coffee, and I don't object to the powdered stuff if it's all you've got...

ext.ext_cn: 我对于这种古玩物件一无所知。
ext.ext_en: I don't know anything about this antique stuff...

defs.def_en: You can use stuff to refer to things such as a substance, a collection of things, events, or ideas, or the contents of something in a general way without mentioning the thing itself by name.

ext.ext_cn: 我把手插进口袋里。
ext.ext_en: I stuffed my hands in my pockets...

ext.ext_cn: 他把报纸塞进了垃圾箱，然后沿街往前走了。
ext.ext_en: He stuffed the newspapers into a litter bin and headed down the street...

defs.def_en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly.

ext.ext_cn: 他抢过我的钱包，打开并塞满钱，然后还给了我。
ext.ext_en: He grabbed my purse, opened it and stuffed it full, then gave it back to me...

ext.ext_cn: 他仍站在收银机后，嘴里塞满了爆米花。
ext.ext_en: He still stood behind his cash register stuffing his mouth with popcorn.

defs.def_en: If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it with something or with a quantity of things until it is full.

ext.ext_cn: 我可以一口气吃10块巧克力，半小时后再吃一顿大餐。
ext.ext_en: I could stuff myself with ten chocolate bars and half an hour later eat a big meal.

defs.def_en: If you stuff yourself, you eat a lot of food.

defs.def_cn: 给…装馅儿;给(鸡、辣椒等食物里)加填料

ext.ext_cn: 你能帮我给火鸡填上料然后放进烤箱里吗？
ext.ext_en: Will you stuff the turkey and shove it in the oven for me?

ext.ext_cn: 酿西红柿
ext.ext_en: ...stuffed tomatoes.

defs.def_en: If you stuff a bird such as a chicken or a vegetable such as a pepper, you put a mixture of food inside it before cooking it.

ext.ext_cn: 一条 1878 年捕获的重 29 磅 8 盎司的梭子鱼被制成标本陈列在庄园管理处。
ext.ext_en: A pike weighing 29 lb 8 oz taken in 1878 was stuffed and is on display at the estate office...

ext.ext_cn: 他不是很喜欢墙上挂的那些动物头颅标本。
ext.ext_en: He didn't much care for the stuffed animal heads that hung on the walls.

defs.def_en: If a dead animal is stuffed, it is filled with a substance so that it can be preserved and displayed.

defs.def_cn: 基本特征;特质;根本;基础

ext.ext_cn: 每个人皆无所不能，这一理念已经成为电视广告的精髓。
ext.ext_en: The idea that we can be whatever we want has become the stuff of television commercials.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing is the stuff of another, you mean that the first thing is a very important feature or characteristic of the second thing, or that the second thing can be based or built on the first thing.
If you are angry with someone for something that they have said or done, you might say 'Get stuffed!' to them.

defs.def_cn: (用在名词前表示强调)不稀罕，不在乎

ext.ext_cn: 我最终的态度是：去他们的。
ext.ext_en: Ultimately my attitude was: stuff them...

ext.ext_cn: 收起你的钱，我们不需要施舍。
ext.ext_en: Stuff your money. We don't want a handout.

defs.def_en: Stuff is used in front of nouns to emphasize that you do not care about something, or do not want it.

defs.def_cn: 露一手;施展自己的本事

ext.ext_cn: 我一上场就知道是我大显身手的时候了。
ext.ext_en: Once I get on the pitch I know I can do my stuff...

ext.ext_cn: 剩下的就只是栽上玫瑰，然后等大自然施展她的神奇魔力。
ext.ext_en: All that was left was to plant the roses and wait for nature to do her stuff.

defs.def_en: If you do your stuff, you perform an activity in the way that people expect.

ext.ext_cn: 7年的战争过后，这些家伙都成了作战行家。
ext.ext_en: These chaps know their stuff after seven years of war.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone knows their stuff, you mean that they are good at doing something because they know a lot about it.

defs.def_cn: 向艉部（或机尾）；在艉部（或机尾）

ext.ext_cn: 克拉克与舵手握手后向艉部走去，打算下船。
ext.ext_en: Clark shook hands with the pilot and walked aft to find his way off the ship.

defs.def_en: If you go aft in a boat or plane, you go to the back of it. If you are aft, you are in the back.

ext.ext_cn: 去后舱需要从餐厅的位置略微往下迈一小步。
ext.ext_en: Getting into the aft cabin involves a slight step down from saloon level.

defs.def_en: The aft end on a boat or plane is towards the back of it.

defs.def_cn: （身穿16世纪风格服装的）伦敦塔卫兵
defs.def_en: Beefeaters are guards at the Tower of London. They wear a uniform made in the style of the sixteenth century.

ext.ext_cn: 她完全清楚我的想法。
ext.ext_en: She was fully aware of my thoughts...

ext.ext_cn: 对此我并不完全同意。
ext.ext_en: I don't fully agree with that.

defs.def_en: Fully means to the greatest degree or extent possible.

ext.ext_cn: 他还没有完全康复。
ext.ext_en: He had still not fully recovered.

defs.def_en: You use fully to say that a process is completely finished.

ext.ext_cn: 菲耶尔承诺所作证词将毫无保留且句句属实。
ext.ext_en: Fiers promised to testify fully and truthfully...

ext.ext_cn: 这些争论的主要内容将在本书后面的章节中更为充分地加以讨论。
ext.ext_en: Major elements of these debates are discussed more fully later in this book.

defs.def_en: If you describe, answer, or deal with something fully, you leave out nothing that should be mentioned or dealt with.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调数量)整整，足足，至少

ext.ext_cn: 足足有 30%的贫困人口甚至连非法窝棚都住不起。
ext.ext_en: Fully 30% of the poor could not even afford access to illegal shanties.

defs.def_en: Fully is used to emphasize how great an amount is.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （论点、理论或立场）经不起反驳的，不堪一击的，站不住脚的

ext.ext_cn: 从智识、道德和现实的角度来看，这一论点是站不住脚的。
ext.ext_en: This argument is untenable from an intellectual, moral and practical standpoint...

ext.ext_cn: 他声称对他的那些指控不值一驳。
ext.ext_en: He claimed the charges against him were untenable.

defs.def_en: An argument, theory, or position that is untenable cannot be defended successfully against criticism or attack.

ext.ext_cn: 她昨天走了。
ext.ext_en: She left yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天她宣布打算辞职。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday she announced that she is quitting her job.

defs.def_en: You use yesterday to refer to the day before today.

defs.def_cn: 过去；（尤指）不久前，近日，日前

ext.ext_cn: 如今的工人和以往的不同了。
ext.ext_en: The worker of today is different from the worker of yesterday.

ext.ext_cn: 没有过去和未来的世界
ext.ext_en: ...a world without yesterdays or tomorrows.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the past, especially the recent past, as yesterday .
If someone has astigmatism, the front of their eye has a slightly irregular shape, so they cannot see properly.
Telecommuting is the same as teleworking .

ext.ext_cn: 荨麻扎了他们的腿。
ext.ext_en: The nettles stung their legs.

ext.ext_cn: 数不清的一簇簇扎人的荨麻遍布整片草地。
ext.ext_en: ...numerous clumps of stinging nettles dotted across the meadow.

defs.def_en: Nettles are wild plants which have leaves covered with fine hairs that sting you when you touch them.

ext.ext_cn: 她的举止惹恼了他。
ext.ext_en: He was nettled by her manner...

ext.ext_cn: 是那条让他改变策略以赢得选举的建议惹恼了他。
ext.ext_en: It was the suggestion that he might alter course to win an election that really nettled him.

defs.def_en: If you are nettled by something, you are annoyed or offended by it.

defs.def_cn: 迎难而上;知难而进;大胆抓棘手问题

ext.ext_cn: 一些实业家认为政府应该在全民公决前果断出手解决棘手的货币贬值问题。
ext.ext_en: Some industrialists believe the government should grasp the nettle of devaluation before the referendum takes place.

defs.def_en: If you grasp the nettle, you deal with a problem, or do something that is unpleasant, quickly and in a determined way.
A tea service is the same as a tea set .

ext.ext_cn: 爱国主义是政客们的惯用伎俩。
ext.ext_en: Patriotism is every politician's stock-in-trade...

ext.ext_cn: 美味的火锅虾曾经是海港周围咖啡馆的招牌菜。
ext.ext_en: Delicious potted shrimps and prawns were once the stock-in-trade of the harbourside cafe.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is someone's stock-in-trade, you mean that it is a usual part of their behaviour or work.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 二氧化碳溶解后能使水的酸性增加。
ext.ext_en: Dissolved carbon dioxide makes the water more acidic.

defs.def_en: Acidic substances contain acid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如果甘蓝闻着或吃着有霉味或酸味，请勿食用。
ext.ext_en: If the sprouts smell, or taste, mouldy or acidic do not eat them.

defs.def_en: An acidic taste is sour and sharp.

ext.ext_cn: 恶劣的天气阻碍了救援工作的进行。
ext.ext_en: The bad weather hampered rescue operations...

ext.ext_cn: 我受到了信息不足的牵累。
ext.ext_en: I was hampered by a lack of information.

defs.def_en: If someone or something hampers you, they make it difficult for you to do what you are trying to do.

ext.ext_cn: 豪华食品礼物篮
ext.ext_en: ...a luxury food hamper.

defs.def_en: A hamper is a basket containing food of various kinds that is given to people as a present.

ext.ext_cn: 野餐篮子
ext.ext_en: ...a picnic hamper.

defs.def_en: A hamper is a large basket with a lid, used especially for carrying food in.

ext.ext_cn: 他能分辨是非吗？
ext.ext_en: Could he distinguish right from wrong?...

ext.ext_cn: 研究表明婴儿通过辨别光亮和黑暗的区域来学会看东西。
ext.ext_en: Research suggests that babies learn to see by distinguishing between areas of light and dark...

defs.def_en: If you can distinguish one thing from another or distinguish between two things, you can see or understand how they are different.

ext.ext_cn: 音乐的某种特质使其有别于所有其他艺术形式。
ext.ext_en: There is something about music that distinguishes it from all other art forms...

ext.ext_cn: 这只鸟没有明显的特征。
ext.ext_en: The bird has no distinguishing features.

defs.def_en: A feature or quality that distinguishes one thing from another causes the two things to be regarded as different, because only the first thing has the feature or quality.

ext.ext_cn: 有哭声、喊声——他能听出不同的声音。
ext.ext_en: There were cries, calls. He could distinguish voices.

defs.def_en: If you can distinguish something, you can see, hear, or taste it although it is very difficult to detect.

ext.ext_cn: 在接下来的几年里，他作为一名宪法研究领域最杰出的学者而声名远扬。
ext.ext_en: Over the next few years he distinguished himself as a leading constitutional scholar...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在阿瑟耶之战中一战成名。
ext.ext_en: They distinguished themselves at the Battle of Assaye.

defs.def_en: If you distinguish yourself, you do something that makes you famous or important.

defs.def_cn: (爵士乐中不唱歌词的)拟声唱法
defs.def_en: Scat is a type of jazz singing in which the singer sings sounds rather than complete words.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 油热了后，放入切好的洋葱。
ext.ext_en: When the oil is hot, add the sliced onion...

ext.ext_cn: 他需要洗个热水澡，好好睡一觉。
ext.ext_en: What he needed was a hot bath and a good sleep...

defs.def_en: Something that is hot has a high temperature.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 天气热的;气温高的;炎热的

ext.ext_cn: 天太热，连慢慢散步都吃不消。
ext.ext_en: It was too hot even for a gentle stroll...

ext.ext_cn: 这是个炎热潮湿的夏日。
ext.ext_en: It was a hot, humid summer day...

defs.def_en: Hot is used to describe the weather or the air in a room or building when the temperature is high.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我又热又累，只吃了几口就吃不下了。
ext.ext_en: I was too hot and tired to eat more than a few mouthfuls...

ext.ext_cn: 我的头很晕。我感觉全身滚烫。
ext.ext_en: My head was reeling. I felt hot all over.

defs.def_en: If you are hot, you feel as if your body is at an unpleasantly high temperature.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这种灯叫做白炽灯，其颜色取决于温度。
ext.ext_en: They are called incandescent lights, and their colour depends on how hot they are...

ext.ext_cn: 记住，烤炉的顶部将比底部温度更高。
ext.ext_en: Remember that the top of the oven will be hotter than the bottom.

defs.def_en: You use hot to talk or ask about how high the temperature of something is.

ext.ext_cn: 如果单身居住，你可能不会想每天都做一顿热菜热饭。
ext.ext_en: If you live alone, you might not want to cook a hot meal every day.

defs.def_en: Hot food is intended to be eaten as soon as it is cooked, as opposed to food that you eat when it has cooled or that you do not cook at all.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 辛辣的咖喱食品
ext.ext_en: ...hot curries.

ext.ext_cn: 加了香料但并不太辣的菜
ext.ext_en: ...a dish that's spicy but not too hot.

defs.def_en: You can say that food is hot when it has a strong, burning taste caused by chillies, pepper, or ginger.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （议题、话题）热门的，受到广泛关注的

ext.ext_cn: 自海湾冲突以来，妇女在战争中的作用一直是美国国内一个备受争议的热门话题。
ext.ext_en: The role of women in war has been a hot topic of debate in America since the Gulf conflict.

defs.def_en: A hot issue or topic is one that is very important at the present time and is receiving a lot of publicity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （消息）刚发布的，最新的，新近的

ext.ext_cn: 有关上档电影、发行影碟及好莱坞最新消息的8页报道
ext.ext_en: ...eight pages of the latest movies, video releases and the hot news from Tinseltown.

defs.def_en: Hot news is new, recent, and fresh.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 风行的;走红的;炙手可热的

ext.ext_cn: 全城最轰动的展览是在美术学院举办的莫奈画展。
ext.ext_en: The hottest show in town was the Monet Exhibition at the Art Institute...

ext.ext_cn: 我上次在那里时，最热闹的地方是皇家单身汉俱乐部。
ext.ext_en: When I was last there, the hot place was the Royal Bachelors' Club.

defs.def_en: You can use hot to describe something that is very exciting and that many people want to see, use, obtain, or become involved with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （常指非法获得的贵重或知名物品）烫手的，难以销赃的

ext.ext_cn: 如果重要作品遭窃一事被大肆报道，这些作品就会因为难以转手而被销毁。
ext.ext_en: If too much publicity is given to the theft of important works, the works will become too hot to handle and be destroyed.

defs.def_en: You can use hot to describe something that no one wants to deal with, often because it has been illegally obtained and is very valuable or famous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 当他们觉得在街头混不下去了时，就沿途不断偷车换开，一路往南去了。
ext.ext_en: When the streets get too hot for them, they head south in one stolen car after another.

defs.def_en: You can describe a situation that is created by a person's behaviour or attitude as hot when it is unpleasant and difficult to deal with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （比赛）激烈的，双方全力以赴的

ext.ext_cn: 然而，我们是通过来自国外的激烈竞争才认识到了苏格兰羊绒的优良品质。
ext.ext_en: It took hot competition from abroad, however, to show us just how good Scottish cashmere really is.

defs.def_en: A hot contest is one that is intense and involves a great deal of activity and determination.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 被看好的;最有望获胜的

ext.ext_cn: 在大西洋城举行这场拳击比赛是众望所归。
ext.ext_en: Atlantic City is the hot favourite to stage the fight.

ext.ext_en: They sent out questionnaires to 100 schools countrywide.

ext.ext_en: They managed to get away from the coast undetected.

defs.def_en: If you are undetected or if you do something undetected, people do not find out where you are or what you are doing.

defs.def_cn: (尤指尖锐之物所致的)红肿伤痕

ext.ext_en: ...the red weals left across his chest by the strap.

defs.def_en: A weal is a swelling made on someone's skin by a blow, especially from something sharp or thin such as a sword or whip.

ext.ext_cn: 他参与了一场酒后街头斗殴。
ext.ext_en: He had been in a drunken street brawl.

defs.def_en: A brawl is a rough or violent fight.

ext.ext_en: He was suspended for a year from University after brawling with police over a speeding ticket...

ext.ext_cn: 两伙青年在渡轮的舞池里打起来了。
ext.ext_en: Two gangs of youths brawled on the dance floor of the ferry.

defs.def_en: If someone brawls, they fight in a very rough or violent way.
Shock troops are soldiers who are specially trained to carry out a quick attack.

ext.ext_cn: 然后他用面糊把它重新粘了起来。
ext.ext_en: He then sticks it back together with flour paste...

ext.ext_cn: 往蛋奶沙司粉里加入一点儿牛奶，搅成糊糊。
ext.ext_en: Blend a little milk with the custard powder to form a paste.

defs.def_en: Paste is a soft, wet, sticky mixture of a substance and a liquid, which can be spread easily. Some types of paste are used to stick things together.

defs.def_cn: （肉、水果或蔬菜弄碎做成的）酱

ext.ext_cn: 番茄酱
ext.ext_en: ...tomato paste.

ext.ext_cn: 鱼酱三明治
ext.ext_en: ...fish paste sandwiches.

defs.def_en: Paste is a soft smooth mixture made of crushed meat, fruit, or vegetables. You can, for example, spread it onto bread or use it in cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 把商标贴在瓶子上
ext.ext_en: ...pasting labels on bottles...

ext.ext_cn: 激进分子张贴起海报批评左翼领袖。
ext.ext_en: Activists pasted up posters criticizing the leftist leaders.

defs.def_en: If you paste something on a surface, you put glue or paste on it and stick it on the surface.

ext.ext_cn: 铅玻璃翡翠
ext.ext_en: ...paste emeralds.

defs.def_en: Paste is a hard shiny glass that is used for making imitation jewellery.

ext.ext_cn: 跨河而建的一家化工厂
ext.ext_en: ...a chemical works on the banks of the river.

ext.ext_cn: 在多瑙河上划船
ext.ext_en: ...boating on the River Danube.

defs.def_en: A river is a large amount of fresh water flowing continuously in a long line across the land.

defs.def_cn: （通常指因为生病或步行不便而）出不了门的，足不出户的

ext.ext_cn: 如果您不方便出门，可以安排专业顾问登门拜访。
ext.ext_en: If you are housebound, you can arrange for a home visit from a specialist adviser.

defs.def_en: Someone who is housebound is unable to go out of their house, usually because they are ill or cannot walk far.

defs.def_cn: (政府的)部(或司、局、处)的;(企业的)部门的，科的;(大学的)系的，所的

ext.ext_cn: 部门预算
ext.ext_en: ...the departmental budget.

defs.def_en: Departmental is used to describe the activities, responsibilities, or possessions of a department in a government, company, or other organization.

ext.ext_cn: 塞浦路斯炎热潮湿的气候
ext.ext_en: ...the hot and humid climate of Cyprus.

defs.def_en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

ext.ext_cn: 经济形势依然不确定。
ext.ext_en: The economic climate remains uncertain.

ext.ext_cn: 目前暴力和恐吓的氛围
ext.ext_en: ...the existing climate of violence and intimidation...

defs.def_en: You can use climate to refer to the general atmosphere or situation somewhere.
A gangster is a member of an organized group of violent criminals.

ext.ext_cn: 人们都知道可乐能消饿、止渴和解乏。
ext.ext_en: Coca is well-known for reducing hunger, thirst and fatigue...

ext.ext_cn: 渴了喝水，别喝茶或咖啡。
ext.ext_en: Instead of tea or coffee, drink water to quench your thirst...

defs.def_en: Thirst is the feeling that you need to drink something.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在航行途中因缺水而死亡。
ext.ext_en: They died of thirst on the voyage.

defs.def_en: Thirst is the condition of not having enough to drink.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们对于学习表现出真诚的渴望。
ext.ext_en: Children show a real thirst for learning.

ext.ext_cn: 他们对于金钱越来越强烈的渴求
ext.ext_en: ...their ever-growing thirst for cash.

defs.def_en: A thirst for something is a very strong desire for that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都渴望得到同样的东西。
ext.ext_en: We all thirst for the same things.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone thirsts for something, you mean that they have a strong desire for it.

ext.ext_cn: 将军没有乱了方寸。
ext.ext_en: The General refused to be flustered...

ext.ext_cn: 她是个非常沉着的人。没什么能让她惊慌的。
ext.ext_en: She was a very calm person. Nothing could fluster her.

defs.def_en: If you fluster someone, you make them feel nervous and confused by rushing them and preventing them from concentrating on what they are doing.

defs.def_cn: 任何地方都不;没有别的地方会

ext.ext_cn: 没有哪个地方像夏威夷那样，语言成了如此重要的问题。
ext.ext_en: Nowhere is language a more serious issue than in Hawaii...

ext.ext_cn: 在世界其他地方找不到这样的森林。
ext.ext_en: This kind of forest exists nowhere else in the world...

defs.def_en: You use nowhere to emphasize that a place has more of a particular quality than any other places, or that it is the only place where something happens or exists.

ext.ext_cn: 无处可藏，也无处可逃。
ext.ext_en: There was nowhere to hide and nowhere to run...

ext.ext_cn: 我没有其他地方可去，在这个世界上没有任何地方。
ext.ext_en: I have nowhere else to go, nowhere in the world...

defs.def_en: You use nowhere when making negative statements to say that a suitable place of the specified kind does not exist.

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔焦急地顺着走廊望去，可根本看不到威尔弗雷德的影儿。
ext.ext_en: Michael glanced anxiously down the corridor, but Wilfred was nowhere to be seen...

ext.ext_cn: 越狱的囚犯已经无影无踪了。
ext.ext_en: The escaped prisoner was nowhere in sight...

defs.def_en: You use nowhere to indicate that something or someone cannot be seen or found.

defs.def_cn: 在不重要的地方;在无趣之处

ext.ext_cn: 不知通往何处的没有尽头的小路
ext.ext_en: ...endless paths that led nowhere in particular.

ext.ext_cn: 不知从哪里来也不知通向何方的乡间公路
ext.ext_en: ...country roads that go from nowhere to nowhere.

defs.def_en: You can use nowhere to refer in a general way to small, unimportant, or uninteresting places.

defs.def_cn: 突然(发生);一下子(冒出来)

ext.ext_cn: 一辆轿车不知从什么地方突然冒了出来，我只得向后跳到树篱中躲避，险些躲不及。
ext.ext_en: A car came from nowhere, and I had to jump back into the hedge just in time...

ext.ext_cn: 山丘上突然冒出一幢幢的房子。
ext.ext_en: Houses had sprung up out of nowhere on the hills.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone appears from nowhere or out of nowhere, you mean that they appear suddenly and unexpectedly.

defs.def_cn: (文字、言谈或争论中)找不到出处地

ext.ext_cn: 他没给出具体的历史背景来支撑他的论点。
ext.ext_en: He nowhere offers concrete historical background to support his arguments...

ext.ext_cn: 你说得对，但我们压根没讲过这艘游艇的特色是独一无二的。
ext.ext_en: Point taken, but nowhere did we suggest that this yacht's features were unique...

defs.def_en: You use nowhere to mean not in any part of a text, speech, or argument.

ext.ext_cn: 黄昏时，我们在茫茫荒野中扎营。
ext.ext_en: At dusk we pitched camp in the middle of nowhere.

ext.ext_cn: 遥远偏僻处的一所农舍
ext.ext_en: ...a farmhouse in the middle of nowhere.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place is in the middle of nowhere, you mean that it is a long way from other places.

ext.ext_cn: 我脑子一直在不停地围绕着同一个问题转啊转，但一无所获。
ext.ext_en: My mind won't stop going round and round on the same subject and I seem to be getting nowhere...

ext.ext_cn: 克罗斯比断言说：“我们一无所获，在做无用功。”
ext.ext_en: 'Getting nowhere fast,' pronounced Crosby, 'that's what we're doing.'...

defs.def_en: If you say that you are getting nowhere, or getting nowhere fast, or that something is getting you nowhere, you mean that you are not achieving anything or having any success.

ext.ext_cn: 他还远没有从自己的经历中走出来。
ext.ext_en: He's nowhere near recovered yet from his experiences...

ext.ext_cn: 他坐的那把椅子远不如他书桌后面那把定做的舒服。
ext.ext_en: The chair he sat in was nowhere near as comfortable as the custom-designed one behind his desk.

defs.def_en: If you use nowhere near in front of a word or expression, you are emphasizing that the real situation is very different from, or has not yet reached, the state which that word or expression suggests.
A mockingbird is a grey bird with a long tail which is found in North America. Mockingbirds are able to copy the songs of other birds.

ext.ext_cn: 至世纪之交时，匹兹堡的死亡率居全美之首。
ext.ext_en: By the turn of the century, Pittsburgh had the highest death rate in the United States.

defs.def_en: The death rate is the number of people per thousand who die in a particular area during a particular period of time.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第18个字母
defs.def_en: See also:three Rs;R is the eighteenth letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_cn: 国王，女王（书面缩略形式，为拉丁文rex或regina的简写）

ext.ext_cn: 伊丽莎白女王
ext.ext_en: ...Elizabeth R.

defs.def_en: R is a written abbreviation meaning king or queen. R is short for the Latin words 'rex' and 'regina'.

defs.def_cn: （用于首字母为r的一些单词的缩写，如在地图上代表river）
defs.def_en: R is used as an abbreviation for words beginning with r. For example, it is used on maps as a written abbreviation for 'river'.

defs.def_cn: R级电影（美国电影分级，17岁以下未成年人需由成人陪同观看）
defs.def_en: In the United States, some cinema films are marked R to show that children under 17 years old are only allowed to see them if an adult is with them.

ext.ext_cn: 三分之二的候选人在第一个难关就败下阵来，只好打包回家了。
ext.ext_en: Two-thirds of candidates fail at this first hurdle and are packed off home...

ext.ext_cn: 天气将会是最大的障碍，所以我必须要作好准备。
ext.ext_en: The weather will be the biggest hurdle so I have to be ready.

defs.def_en: A hurdle is a problem, difficulty, or part of a process that may prevent you from achieving something.

ext.ext_cn: 戴维斯以49.3秒的成绩刷新奥运会纪录，在400米跨栏赛跑中一举夺冠。
ext.ext_en: Davis won the 400m. hurdles in a new Olympic time of 49.3 sec.

defs.def_en: Hurdles is a race in which people have to jump over a number of obstacles that are also called hurdles. You can use hurdles to refer to one or more races.

ext.ext_cn: 他跑过草地，跳过低矮的栅栏。
ext.ext_en: He crossed the lawn and hurdled the short fence...

ext.ext_cn: 她通过在自家农场里跳跨干草捆学会了跨栏。
ext.ext_en: She learnt to hurdle by leaping over bales of hay on her family's farm.

defs.def_en: If you hurdle, you jump over something while you are running.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 它的建筑群半掩在长满青草的河岸后面。
ext.ext_en: Its buildings are half-hidden behind grassy banks.

defs.def_en: A grassy area of land is covered in grass.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 复杂的研究计划
ext.ext_en: ...an elaborate research project.

ext.ext_cn: 持续8天的繁琐典礼
ext.ext_en: ...an elaborate ceremony that lasts for eight days.

defs.def_en: You use elaborate to describe something that is very complex because it has a lot of different parts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （计划、系统、程序等）繁复的，详尽的，过于复杂的

ext.ext_cn: 最高层为了隐瞒问题而挖空心思
ext.ext_en: ...elaborate efforts at the highest level to conceal the problem.

ext.ext_cn: 针对毕业生的详尽的管理培训计划
ext.ext_en: ...an elaborate management training scheme for graduates.

defs.def_en: Elaborate plans, systems, and procedures are complicated because they have been planned in very great detail, sometimes too much detail.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （衣服、布料等）精致的，精巧的，制作精美的

ext.ext_cn: 他以着装精致而闻名。
ext.ext_en: He is known for his elaborate costumes.

defs.def_en: Elaborate clothing or material is made with a lot of detailed artistic designs.

defs.def_cn: 精心制作;详细计划;进一步完善

ext.ext_cn: 他的任务是制定详细政策，使得市场经济和清洁环境能够共存。
ext.ext_en: His task was to elaborate policies which would make a market economy compatible with a clean environment.

ext.ext_cn: 由联合国安全理事会5个常任理事国详细制定的方案
ext.ext_en: ...the plan elaborated by the five permanent members of the UN Security Council.

defs.def_en: If you elaborate a plan or theory, you develop it by making it more complicated and more effective.

ext.ext_cn: 发言人拒绝对昨天晚些时候发表的声明详加说明。
ext.ext_en: A spokesman declined to elaborate on a statement released late yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 你愿意详细说明一下吗？
ext.ext_en: Would you care to elaborate?

defs.def_en: If you elaborate on something that has been said, you say more about it, or give more details.

ext.ext_cn: 他的书的最新版本
ext.ext_en: ...an updated version of his book...

ext.ext_cn: 鲁多是由一种古印度竞赛游戏演变而来。
ext.ext_en: Ludo is a version of an ancient Indian racing game...

defs.def_en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

defs.def_cn: （某人对某事件区别于他人的）描述，说法

ext.ext_cn: 昨天下午，白宫对事件给出了另一种说法。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday afternoon the White House put out a new version of events...

ext.ext_cn: 她和朋友们想把他们看到的事情经过公之于众。
ext.ext_en: She and her friends wanted to go public with their version of the incident...

defs.def_en: Someone's version of an event is their own description of it, especially when it is different to other people's.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行动或情形）不公正的，不公平的

ext.ext_cn: 她获判5,000英镑，作为遭到无理解雇的补偿。
ext.ext_en: She was awarded £5,000 in compensation for unfair dismissal...

ext.ext_cn: 美国认定进口钢铁相对于国产钢铁具有不公平的优势。
ext.ext_en: America decided that imported steel had an unfair advantage over steel made at home...

defs.def_en: An unfair action or situation is not right or fair.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （制度或情形）不公平的，不平等的

ext.ext_cn: 美国飞机制造商继续指控空中客车公司不正当竞争。
ext.ext_en: The American plane makers continue to accuse Airbus of unfair competition...

ext.ext_cn: 有些人被冤判长期徒刑。
ext.ext_en: Some have been sentenced to long prison terms after unfair trials.

defs.def_en: An unfair system or situation does not give equal treatment or equal opportunities to everyone involved.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 友善的;友好的;好相处的

ext.ext_cn: 戈弗雷一度对我很友善。
ext.ext_en: Godfrey had been friendly to me.

ext.ext_cn: 面容和蔼可亲的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a man with a pleasant, friendly face...

defs.def_en: If someone is friendly, they behave in a pleasant, kind way, and like to be with other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我和他母亲很要好。
ext.ext_en: I'm friendly with his mother...

ext.ext_cn: 阿斯穆斯和许多作家成为了好友，而且还作为一名文学评论家出现在报纸上。
ext.ext_en: Asmus became friendly with a number of writers and appeared in print as a literary critic.

defs.def_en: If you are friendly with someone, you like each other and enjoy spending time together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这两个曾经友好的国家之间关系的恶化
ext.ext_en: ...a worsening in relations between the two previously friendly countries.

defs.def_en: You can describe another country or their government as friendly when they have good relations with your own country rather than being an enemy.

ext.ext_cn: 毕尔巴鄂竞技队同意在皇家社会队主场打一场友谊赛。
ext.ext_en: Athletic Bilbao agreed to play a friendly at Real Sociedad.

ext.ext_en: Austria beat Hungary 3-nil in a friendly match at Salzburg on Wednesday.

defs.def_en: In sport, a friendly is a match which is not part of a competition, and is played for entertainment or practice, often without any serious effort to win.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她开始被人们赞誉为有一颗金子般的心的无私女孩。
ext.ext_en: She started to get a reputation as an unselfish girl with a heart of gold...

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名选手，他毫无私念，真正把自己摆在团队中。
ext.ext_en: As a player he was unselfish, a true team man.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as unselfish, you approve of the fact that they regard other people's wishes and interests as more important than their own.
Tetanus is a serious painful disease caused by bacteria getting into wounds. It makes your muscles, especially your jaw muscles, go stiff.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 布满（弹孔）的;遍布（枪眼）的

defs.def_en: If something is riddled with bullets or bullet holes, it is full of bullet holes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 充满了…的;满是…的;到处是…的

ext.ext_en: They were the principal shareholders in a bank riddled with corruption...

ext.ext_en: The report was riddled with errors.

defs.def_en: If something is riddled with undesirable qualities or features, it is full of them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在这个地区的制高点能够看到洛杉矶的全景。
ext.ext_en: The terrain's high points provide a panoramic view of Los Angeles.

defs.def_en: If you have a panoramic view, you can see a long way over a wide area.

ext.ext_cn: 每100克橙子仅含35卡的热量。
ext.ext_en: Oranges contain only 35 calories per 100g.

defs.def_en: G or g is used as an abbreviation for words beginning with g, such as 'gram', 'gallon', and 'German'.

ext.ext_cn: 一艘登陆艇的发动机还在运转。
ext.ext_en: The engine of one landing craft was still running.

defs.def_en: A landing craft is a small boat designed for the landing of troops and equipment on the shore.

ext.ext_cn: 我喝了 3 罐可乐解渴。

A face flannel is a small cloth made of towelling which you use for washing yourself.
Buckled shoes have buckles on them, either to fasten them or as decoration.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone or something such as a crime as non-violent when that person or thing does not hurt or injure people.
