defs.def_en: A beautiful person is very attractive to look at.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 新英格兰很美。
ext.ext_en: New England is beautiful...

ext.ext_cn: 那是一个美妙的早晨。
ext.ext_en: It was a beautiful morning...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as beautiful, you mean that it is very attractive or pleasing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 射得漂亮！
ext.ext_en: That's a beautiful shot!

defs.def_en: You can describe something that someone does as beautiful when they do it very skilfully.
A scooter is a small light motorcycle which has a low seat.

A scooter is a type of child's bicycle which has two wheels joined by a wooden board and a handle on a long pole attached to the front wheel. The child stands on the board with one foot, and uses the other foot to move forwards.

defs.def_cn: 污言秽语;淫秽作品(或图片)

ext.ext_cn: 我发现媒体越来越沉湎于淫秽下流和耸人听闻的题材，这实在可悲。
ext.ext_en: I find the media's growing obsession with smut and sensation deplorable.

ext.ext_cn: 男生的淫秽画
ext.ext_en: ...schoolboy smut.

defs.def_en: If you refer to words or pictures that are related to sex as smut, you disapprove of them because you think they are rude and unpleasant and have been said or published just to shock or excite people.
Smut or smuts is dirt such as soot which makes a dirty mark on something.

defs.def_cn: (常指为便于保存而）使(食品等)脱水，使干燥

ext.ext_cn: 标本通常需要经过干燥处理。
ext.ext_en: Normally specimens have to be dehydrated.

defs.def_en: When something such as food is dehydrated, all the water is removed from it, often in order to preserve it.

ext.ext_cn: 人们在这样的天气下可能会脱水。
ext.ext_en: People can dehydrate in weather like this...

ext.ext_cn: 酒精会让身体迅速脱水。
ext.ext_en: Alcohol quickly dehydrates your body.

defs.def_en: If you dehydrate or if something dehydrates you, you lose too much water from your body so that you feel weak or ill.

ext.ext_cn: 人们担心宠物或野生动物可能受到杀虫剂影响。
ext.ext_en: People were concerned that pets or wildlife could be affected by the pesticides.

defs.def_en: You can use wildlife to refer to the animals and other living things that live in the wild.

ext.ext_cn: 她有一个6岁的女儿。
ext.ext_en: She has a six-year-old daughter.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在俄亥俄州的有两百年历史的农舍
ext.ext_en: ...their 200-year-old farmhouse in Ohio.

defs.def_en: -year-old combines with numbers to describe the age of people or things.

ext.ext_cn: 这些钱能让她雇一个私人侦探，帮助他寻找证据洗清罪名。
ext.ext_en: The money enabled her to hire a private detective to search for evidence that would clear him.

defs.def_en: A private detective is someone who you can pay to find missing people or do other kinds of investigation for you.

ext.ext_cn: 他身着一件条纹衬衫和一条宽松的蓝裤子。
ext.ext_en: He was wearing a stripy shirt and baggy blue trousers.

defs.def_en: Something that is stripy has stripes on it.

ext.ext_cn: 碳尘和燃油在大发动机里越积越多，造成了发动机短路。
ext.ext_en: Carbon dust and oil build up in large motors and cause them to short-circuit...

ext.ext_cn: 一旦置入，它们就会使电子安全设施短路。
ext.ext_en: Once inside they short-circuited the electronic security.

defs.def_en: If an electrical device short-circuits or if someone or something short-circuits it, a wrong connection or damaged wire causes electricity to travel along the wrong route and damage the device.

defs.def_cn: 回避，绕过（某一流程或程序)

ext.ext_cn: 这种方法旨在避开正常的投诉程序。
ext.ext_en: The approach was intended to short-circuit normal complaints procedures.

defs.def_en: If someone or something short-circuits a process or system, they avoid long or difficult parts of it and use a quicker, more direct method to achieve their aim.

ext.ext_cn: 回家睡一会儿。
ext.ext_en: Go home and get some shut-eye.

defs.def_en: Shut-eye is sleep.

ext.ext_cn: 乌黑的雨云从西南方向掠过
ext.ext_en: ...heavy, rain-laden clouds scudding across from the south-west.

defs.def_en: If clouds scud along, they move quickly and smoothly through the sky.

ext.ext_cn: 我有预感和苏珊共事会很融洽。
ext.ext_en: I had a hunch that Susan and I would work well together...

ext.ext_cn: 然后卡姆纳尔先生凭直觉在联邦选举委员会的计算机系统中进行了查询。
ext.ext_en: Then Mr. Kamenar, acting on a hunch, ran a computer check at the Federal Election Commission.

defs.def_en: If you have a hunch about something, you are sure that it is correct or true, even though you do not have any proof.

defs.def_cn: （常指因寒冷、生病或愁苦而）耸肩弓身，蜷起身子

ext.ext_cn: 他拿出约克郡地图，弓身趴在上面努力看清那些细小的字体。
ext.ext_en: He got out his map of Yorkshire and hunched over it to read the small print.

defs.def_en: If you hunch forward, you raise your shoulders, put your head down, and lean forwards, often because you are cold, ill, or unhappy.

ext.ext_cn: 韦斯耸起双肩，身体前倾靠在柜台边上。
ext.ext_en: Wes hunched his shoulders and leaned forward on the edge of the counter.

defs.def_en: If you hunch your shoulders, you raise them and lean forwards slightly.
Tiddlywinks is a game in which the players try to make small round pieces of plastic jump into a container, by pressing their edges with a larger piece of plastic.

defs.def_cn: (弹塑料片游戏所用的)塑料圆片
defs.def_en: Tiddlywinks are the small round piece of plastic used in the game of tiddlywinks.

ext.ext_cn: 文艺复兴时期的装饰
ext.ext_en: ...Renaissance embellishments.

ext.ext_cn: 没有太多装潢的公共建筑
ext.ext_en: ...public buildings with little bits of decoration and embellishment.

defs.def_en: An embellishment is a decoration added to something to make it seem more attractive or interesting.

defs.def_cn: （在重要性、益处、意义等上）重于，大于，超过

ext.ext_cn: X光在医学上的益处远甚于它带来的风险。
ext.ext_en: The medical benefits of x-rays far outweigh the risk of having them...

ext.ext_cn: 这笔交易的利远远大于弊。
ext.ext_en: The advantages of this deal largely outweigh the disadvantages.

defs.def_en: If one thing outweighs another, the first thing is of greater importance, benefit, or significance than the second thing.
A purse is a very small bag that people, especially women, keep their money in.

ext.ext_cn: 她看看我，接着伸手去包里拿香烟。
ext.ext_en: She looked at me and then reached in her purse for cigarettes.

defs.def_en: A purse is a small bag that women carry.

ext.ext_cn: 这笔钱可以直接划入公共资金，帮助降低税收。
ext.ext_en: The money could simply go into the public purse, helping to lower taxes.

defs.def_en: Purse is used to refer to the total amount of money that a country, family, or group has.

ext.ext_cn: 她撅起嘴唇，表示不赞成。
ext.ext_en: She pursed her lips in disapproval.

defs.def_en: If you purse your lips, you move them into a small, rounded shape, usually because you disapprove of something or when you are thinking.

defs.def_cn: 馅饼，派（内有肉、蔬菜或水果的西式点心）

ext.ext_cn: 猪肉馅饼
ext.ext_en: ...a pork pie.

ext.ext_cn: 苹果派和蛋奶糕
ext.ext_en: ...apple pie and custard.

defs.def_en: See also:cottage pie;shepherd's pie;A pie consists of meat, vegetables, or fruit baked in pastry.

defs.def_cn: 难以付诸实施的构想（或计划）；渺茫的希望；空口的许诺

ext.ext_cn: 遭毁坏码头区的真正重建看起来希望渺茫。
ext.ext_en: The true regeneration of devastated Docklands seemed like pie in the sky...

ext.ext_cn: 他禁不住想所有这些不过是“画饼充饥”的空话而已。
ext.ext_en: He can't help thinking it's all just 'pie in the sky' talk.

defs.def_en: If you describe an idea, plan, or promise of something good as pie in the sky, you mean that you think that it is very unlikely to happen.

defs.def_cn: (广播、电视节目中的音乐、笑声、掌声)预先录制好的
defs.def_en: See also:can;Canned music, laughter, or applause on a television or radio programme has been recorded beforehand and is added to the programme to make it sound as if there is a live audience.

defs.def_cn: (性格、行为)无可指摘的,无可挑剔的
defs.def_en: If you say that someone's character or behaviour is irreproachable, you mean that they behave so well that they cannot be criticized.

ext.ext_cn: 那个孩子像幽灵一样飞快地跑来跑去。
ext.ext_en: That child flits about like a wraith.

defs.def_en: A wraith is a ghost.

ext.ext_cn: 他们因其高水准的电影赢得了赞扬和奖项。
ext.ext_en: They won plaudits and prizes for their accomplished films.

defs.def_en: If a person or a thing receives plaudits from a group of people, those people express their admiration for or approval of that person or thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沾满泥的;多泥的;泥泞的

ext.ext_cn: 泥泞的小道
ext.ext_en: ...a muddy track...

ext.ext_cn: 地上还很泥泞。
ext.ext_en: The ground was still very muddy.

defs.def_en: Something that is muddy contains mud or is covered in mud.

ext.ext_cn: 地面还散发着雨后的气息，他们把鞋上弄得全是泥。
ext.ext_en: The ground still smelled of rain and they muddied their shoes...

ext.ext_cn: 他新买的灰色夹克被撕破了，还弄上了泥巴。
ext.ext_en: His new grey jacket was torn and muddied.

defs.def_en: If you muddy something, you cause it to be muddy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 报纸已变成土黄色了。
ext.ext_en: The paper has turned a muddy colour.

defs.def_en: Muddy is used to describe a colour which is dull and brownish.

defs.def_cn: 使更为复杂;使难以理解

ext.ext_cn: 即使不把宗教牵扯进去，这个问题也已经够棘手的了。
ext.ext_en: It's difficult enough without muddying the issue with religion.

ext.ext_cn: 使克兰先生的努力变得难以理解的复杂动机
ext.ext_en: ...the mixed motives that muddied Mr Crane's efforts.

defs.def_en: If someone or something muddies a situation or issue, they cause it to seem less clear and less easy to understand.

defs.def_cn: （为使某一党获得优势）不公正的改划选区

ext.ext_cn: 这个政党通过巧妙地改划选区而使此后的选举无往不胜。
ext.ext_en: With the help of skilful gerrymandering, the Party has never lost an election since.

defs.def_en: Gerrymandering is the act of altering political boundaries in order to give an unfair advantage to one political party or group of people.
A dressing room is a room in a theatre where performers can dress and get ready for their performance.
A dressing room is a room at a sports stadium where players can change and get ready for their game.

defs.def_cn: (尤指苏格兰或爱尔兰的)歌舞会，同乐会
defs.def_en: A ceilidh is an informal entertainment, especially in Scotland or Ireland, at which there is folk music, singing, and dancing.

ext.ext_cn: 所有的船只都将在成本加利润的基础上制造。
ext.ext_en: All vessels were to be built on a cost-plus basis.

ext.ext_cn: 成本加成合同
ext.ext_en: ...cost-plus contracts.

defs.def_en: A cost-plus basis for a contract about work to be done is one in which the buyer agrees to pay the seller or contractor all the cost plus a profit.

defs.def_cn: (尤指长期的)战略，策略，行动计划

ext.ext_cn: 下周，卫生部长们将在阿姆斯特丹聚首共商防治疟疾的策略。
ext.ext_en: Next week, health ministers gather in Amsterdam to agree a strategy for controlling malaria...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的销售策略应该取得了哪些成果呢？
ext.ext_en: What should our marketing strategy have achieved?...

defs.def_en: A strategy is a general plan or set of plans intended to achieve something, especially over a long period.

ext.ext_cn: 我刚刚一直在向各位将军解释战略学的基本原理。
ext.ext_en: I've just been explaining the basic principles of strategy to my generals.

defs.def_en: Strategy is the art of planning the best way to gain an advantage or achieve success, especially in war.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在那里举办的音乐会座无虚席。
ext.ext_en: Their concert there was a sell-out.

ext.ext_cn: 观众爆满的演出
ext.ext_en: ...sell-out shows.

defs.def_en: If a play, sports event, or other entertainment is a sell-out, all the tickets for it are sold.

defs.def_cn: (对原则的)背弃;(向敌对势力的)屈服

ext.ext_cn: 对某些人来说，他决定以社会党候选人的身份参加星期天的选举简直是一种叛变。
ext.ext_en: For some, his decision to become a Socialist candidate at Sunday's election was simply a sell-out.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as a sell-out, you disapprove of the fact that they have done something which used to be against their principles, or given in to an opposing group.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 紧密相连的;密切合作的；志同道合的

ext.ext_cn: 我们家非常团结。
ext.ext_en: We're a very close-knit family...

ext.ext_cn: 去年发生的一些事让整个社会紧密团结在一起。
ext.ext_en: Events over the last year have created a close-knit community.

defs.def_en: A close-knit group of people are closely linked, do things together, and take an interest in each other.

defs.def_cn: 伊拉克的;伊拉克人的;伊拉克文化的

ext.ext_cn: 伊拉克驻美大使
ext.ext_en: ...the Iraqi ambassador to the US.

defs.def_en: Iraqi means belonging or relating to Iraq, or to its people or culture.

defs.def_cn: 伊拉克人;伊拉克人后裔
defs.def_en: An Iraqi is an Iraqi citizen, or a person of Iraqi origin.

defs.def_cn: （有音乐、数学或体育等天赋的）天才，奇才，神童

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯的网球奇才
ext.ext_en: ...a Russian tennis prodigy.

defs.def_en: A prodigy is someone young who has a great natural ability for something such as music, mathematics, or sport.

ext.ext_cn: 看到引起如此大的反应,老太太高兴得咯咯笑了起来。
ext.ext_en: The old lady cackled, pleased to have produced so dramatic a reaction...

ext.ext_cn: 纽因顿仰头大笑。
ext.ext_en: Newington threw his head back and cackled with laughter.

defs.def_en: If someone cackles, they laugh in a loud unpleasant way, often at something bad that happens to someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 他越来越活跃，在深夜辩论中不断攻击政府。
ext.ext_en: He is increasingly active in harrying the government in late-night debates.

defs.def_en: If someone harries you, they keep bothering you or trying to get something from you.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第12个字母
defs.def_en: L is the twelfth letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_cn: （英国的）“驾驶学员”标志（白底红字的大 L 标记，贴于车上）
defs.def_en: L is the symbol for 'learner driver' in Britain. A large red 'L' on a white background is attached to cars in which people are learning to drive.

defs.def_cn: （用于首字母为l的一些单词的缩写，如litre和lire）
defs.def_en: L or l is used as an abbreviation for words beginning with l, such as 'litre' and 'lire'.

ext.ext_cn: 漂亮的柠檬黄
ext.ext_en: ...a lovely shade of lemon yellow.

ext.ext_cn: 淡黄色的裤子
ext.ext_en: ...lemon coloured trousers.

defs.def_en: Lemon yellow or lemon is used to describe things that are pale yellow in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 基因决定每个生物的特征。
ext.ext_en: Genes determine the characteristics of every living thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的身体特征
ext.ext_en: ...their physical characteristics.

defs.def_en: The characteristics of a person or thing are the qualities or features that belong to them and make them recognizable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (品质、特点)明显的，显著的，典型的

ext.ext_cn: 这些社会中典型的代际冲突的缺失
ext.ext_en: ...the absence of strife between the generations that was so characteristic of such societies...

ext.ext_cn: 风车是马略卡岛风光的一大特色。
ext.ext_en: Windmills are a characteristic feature of the Mallorcan landscape...

defs.def_en: A quality or feature that is characteristic of someone or something is one which is often seen in them and seems typical of them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 脚步不稳的；身体摇晃的

ext.ext_cn: 男孩站立不稳，并且起身后四下走动时步子踉跄。
ext.ext_en: The boy was very unsteady and had staggered around when he got up...

ext.ext_cn: 他把咖啡倒进杯里，然后一只手颤巍巍地端了一杯给戴维。
ext.ext_en: He poured coffee into the mugs, and with an unsteady hand, held one of them out to David.

defs.def_en: If you are unsteady, you have difficulty doing something, for example walking, because you cannot completely control your legs or your body.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不稳定的；不可靠的；无法捉摸的；变幻无常的

ext.ext_cn: 他的声音发颤，而且小得只刚刚能听见。
ext.ext_en: His voice was unsteady and only just audible...

ext.ext_cn: 她有亲身体验，知道情绪变化无常的家长对一个敏感的小女孩会产生什么影响。
ext.ext_en: She knew first-hand the impact an unsteady parent could have on a sensitive young girl.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unsteady, you mean that it is not regular or stable, but unreliable or unpredictable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不牢固的；不稳固的；不结实的

ext.ext_cn: 一件稍微有些不结实的家具
ext.ext_en: ...a slightly unsteady item of furniture.

defs.def_en: Unsteady objects are not held, fixed, or balanced securely.
A roan is a horse that is brown or black with some white hairs.

ext.ext_cn: 它固定在墙上。
ext.ext_en: It is fixed on the wall...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数窗帘都可直接安装在窗框上边。
ext.ext_en: Most blinds can be fixed directly to the top of the window-frame...

defs.def_en: If something is fixed somewhere, it is attached there firmly or securely.

defs.def_cn: 确定，决定，选定(日期、价格、政策等)

ext.ext_cn: 他会确定一个我和他会面的时间。
ext.ext_en: He's going to fix a time when I can see him...

ext.ext_cn: 选举日期定下来了。
ext.ext_en: The date of the election was fixed...

defs.def_en: If you fix something, for example a date, price, or policy, you decide and say exactly what it will be.

ext.ext_cn: 你去见邦尼·拉克伦的事我已经安排好了。
ext.ext_en: I've fixed it for you to see Bonnie Lachlan...

ext.ext_cn: 已经安排好了，他会在机场接我们。
ext.ext_en: It's fixed. He's going to meet us at the airport...

defs.def_en: If you fix something for someone, you arrange for it to happen or you organize it for them.

ext.ext_cn: 他不会修电路。
ext.ext_en: He cannot fix the electricity...

ext.ext_cn: 如果什么东西坏了，我们就找人来修理。
ext.ext_en: If something is broken, we get it fixed.

defs.def_en: If you fix something which is damaged or which does not work properly, you repair it.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然时间越来越紧迫，但现在处理这个问题还为时未晚。
ext.ext_en: It's not too late to fix the problem, although time is clearly getting short...

ext.ext_cn: 但是，平反一件40年的冤案并不意味着历史可以重写。
ext.ext_en: Fixing a 40-year-old wrong does not mean, however, that history can be undone.

defs.def_en: If you fix a problem or a bad situation, you deal with it and make it satisfactory.

ext.ext_cn: 那些变革中可能有很多只是权宜之计。
ext.ext_en: Many of those changes could just be a temporary fix.

defs.def_en: See also:quick fix;You can refer to a solution to a problem as a fix .

defs.def_cn: (目光)专注于，凝视;目不转睛地看

ext.ext_cn: 她那灰蓝色的眼睛紧盯着一个毫无戒心的地方官员。
ext.ext_en: She fixes her steel-blue eyes on an unsuspecting local official...

ext.ext_cn: 她那双温柔的棕色眼睛紧盯着凯利。
ext.ext_en: Her soft brown eyes fixed on Kelly...

defs.def_en: If you fix your eyes on someone or something or if your eyes fix on them, you look at them with complete attention.

ext.ext_cn: 他抓住她的手，表情极其关切地看着她。
ext.ext_en: He took her hand and fixed her with a look of deep concern...

ext.ext_cn: 他冲我歪嘴笑了笑。
ext.ext_en: He fixed me with a lopsided grin.

defs.def_en: If you fix someone with a particular kind of expression, you look at them in that way.

defs.def_cn: 将(注意力)集中在;专心考虑

ext.ext_cn: 重点考虑为你的计划融资是否可行。
ext.ext_en: Fix your attention on the practicalities of financing your schemes...

ext.ext_cn: 重点关注的是证券市场。
ext.ext_en: Attention is fixed on the stock market...

defs.def_en: If you fix your attention on someone or something, you think about them with complete attention.

defs.def_cn: 牢记，铭记，镌刻(在头脑中)

ext.ext_cn: 伦纳德现在已经令他无法忘怀。
ext.ext_en: Leonard was now fixed in his mind...

ext.ext_cn: 埃米急切地看着孩子那张神情专注的脸，想把它记在脑海里。
ext.ext_en: Amy watched the child's intent face eagerly, trying to fix it in her mind.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is fixed in your mind, you remember them well, for example because they are very important, interesting, or unusual.

defs.def_cn: 把(枪、相机、雷达)对准(或瞄准、指向)

ext.ext_cn: 美国船员将雷达对准那艘土耳其船。
ext.ext_en: The US crew fixed its radar on the Turkish ship...

ext.ext_cn: 枪口依然指着我。
ext.ext_en: The bore of the gun remained fixed on me.

defs.def_en: If someone fixes a gun, camera, or radar on something, they point it at that thing.

defs.def_cn: (通常用雷达或电子设备)找到，弄清，确定(确切位置)

ext.ext_cn: 他一直未能确定他所在的位置。
ext.ext_en: He had not been able to fix his position...

ext.ext_cn: 卫星通过对每颗恒星反复观察进行定位。
ext.ext_en: The satellite fixes positions by making repeated observations of each star.

defs.def_en: If you fix the position of something, you find out exactly where it is, usually by using radar or electronic equipment.

ext.ext_cn: 要对正在发生的事情保持持续的关注和了解并不容易。
ext.ext_en: It's been hard to get a steady fix on what's going on.

defs.def_en: If you get a fix on someone or something, you have a clear idea or understanding of them.

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉为我们准备了一些吃的。
ext.ext_en: Sarah fixed some food for us...

ext.ext_cn: 我给你弄杯饮料吧。
ext.ext_en: Let me fix you a drink...

defs.def_en: If you fix some food or a drink for someone, you make it or prepare it for them.

defs.def_cn: 整理，收拾(头发、衣服或妆容)

ext.ext_cn: “我得把头发梳理一下，”我说罢回到了卧室。
ext.ext_en: 'I've got to fix my hair,' I said and retreated to my bedroom...

ext.ext_cn: 她叫了辆出租车，补了一下妆，匆匆地给布莱恩写了张便条。
ext.ext_en: She called a cab, fixed her face, and scrawled a hasty note to Brian.

defs.def_en: If you fix your hair, clothes, or make-up, you arrange or adjust them so you look neat and tidy, showing you have taken care with your appearance.

ext.ext_cn: 公关顾问建议说，整牙也许对我有好处。
ext.ext_en: The PR man suggested that I might benefit from getting my teeth fixed...

ext.ext_cn: 我在想汤姆是不是在别的地方整过牙。
ext.ext_en: I wonder if Tom ever had his teeth fixed anywhere else.

defs.def_en: If you have your teeth fixed, you have treatment from a dentist to make your teeth even, straight, and white.

defs.def_cn: 在(比赛、竞选等活动中)作弊，做手脚，操纵

ext.ext_cn: 他们贿赂对方队员，在联赛对阵瓦朗谢讷队的一场决定性比赛中作弊。
ext.ext_en: They offered opposing players bribes to fix a decisive league match against Valenciennes...

ext.ext_cn: 我们没做任何手脚，该什么样就会什么样。
ext.ext_en: We didn't 'fix' anything. It'll be seen as it happens...

defs.def_en: If someone fixes a race, election, contest, or other event, they make unfair or illegal arrangements or use deception to affect the result.

ext.ext_cn: 涉嫌操控建筑市场钢材价格的卡特尔
ext.ext_en: ...a suspected cartel that had fixed the price of steel for the construction market...

ext.ext_cn: 该公司目前与政府在是否存在价格操控问题上存在分歧。
ext.ext_en: The company is currently in dispute with the government over price fixing.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of fixing prices, you accuse them of making unfair arrangements to charge a particular price for something, rather than allowing market forces to decide it.
An injection of an addictive drug such as heroin can be referred to as a fix .

defs.def_cn: (维持身体或心理需要所需的)一个剂量，一定数量

ext.ext_cn: 这使得该国严重依赖每年救济的那点美元，成了“嗜援成瘾”的国家。
ext.ext_en: It turned the country into an 'aid junkie', heavily dependent on its annual fix of dollars...

ext.ext_cn: 我离不开糖、甜品和巧克力。
ext.ext_en: I need my fix of sugar, sweets, and chocolate...

defs.def_en: You can use fix to refer to an amount of something which a person gets or wants and which helps them physically or psychologically to survive.

defs.def_cn: (尤指由自己引起的)困境，窘境

ext.ext_cn: 他陷入了困境。
ext.ext_en: He was in a fix...

ext.ext_cn: 政府真的让自己陷入了困境。
ext.ext_en: The government has really got itself into a fix...

defs.def_en: If you are in a fix, you are in a difficult situation, especially one that you have caused for yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 使用蛋彩画颜料(内含可以定色的蛋黄)在干石膏上绘出了特定颜色。
ext.ext_en: Certain pigment colours were painted on to dry plaster using tempera (where egg yolk is used to fix the pigment)...

ext.ext_cn: 同系交配的主要目的就是实现标准化，保持理想的遗传特性，并消除不良的特性。
ext.ext_en: The main aim of inbreeding is to standardise, to fix desirable inherited characteristics and to dispel undesirable ones.

defs.def_en: To fix something such as a dye or photographic image means to treat it with chemicals so that it does not lose its colour or disappear.

ext.ext_cn: 那样他就不会再干了。
ext.ext_en: That'll fix him.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will fix someone, you mean that you will stop their activities permanently.

ext.ext_cn: 我打算去读研究生。
ext.ext_en: I'm fixing to go to graduate school...

ext.ext_cn: 他会知道我打算什么时候走，他还会在前门等着。
ext.ext_en: He would know when I was fixing to leave. He'd wait by the front door.

defs.def_en: See also:fixed;fixings;If you say that you are fixing to do something, you mean that you are planning or intending to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 越南政府已经决定于5月19日庆祝他的诞辰。
ext.ext_en: The Vietnamese government has fixed on May 19th to celebrate his anniversary.

defs.def_en: If you fix on a particular thing, you decide that it is the one you want and will have.

ext.ext_cn: 我安排了与她见面。
ext.ext_en: I fixed up an appointment to see her...

ext.ext_cn: 住宿从未提前安排好。
ext.ext_en: Accommodation is never fixed up in advance.

defs.def_en: If you fix something up, you arrange it.

ext.ext_cn: 我已经把马修原来住的房间装饰了一番。
ext.ext_en: I've fixed up Matthew's old room...

ext.ext_cn: 整个街区都在进行装修。
ext.ext_en: The whole block is being fixed up.

defs.def_en: If you fix something up, you do work that is necessary in order to make it more suitable or attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 我们将给他准备一条领带。
ext.ext_en: We'll fix him up with a tie...

ext.ext_cn: 别人给他找了一份工作。
ext.ext_en: He was fixed up with a job.

defs.def_en: If you fix someone up with something they need, you provide it for them.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个超级体育迷。
ext.ext_en: He is a great sports enthusiast.

ext.ext_cn: 健身爱好者
ext.ext_en: ...keep-fit enthusiasts.

defs.def_en: An enthusiast is a person who is very interested in a particular activity or subject and who spends a lot of time on it.

ext.ext_cn: “你表面谦虚，骨子里目中无人。”她说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Your modesty is a cover for your overweening conceit,' she said.

defs.def_en: If you want to emphasize your disapproval of someone's great ambition or pride, you can refer to their overweening ambition or pride.

defs.def_cn: 降低…的理解难度;减少…的专业内容

ext.ext_cn: 没有人赞成降低杂志的专业水准。
ext.ext_en: No one favored dumbing down the magazine.

defs.def_en: If you dumb down something, you make it easier for people to understand, especially when this spoils it.

defs.def_cn: 接着发生的;接踵而来的;随之产生的

ext.ext_cn: 随后的争论很激烈。
ext.ext_en: The ensuing argument had been bitter.

ext.ext_cn: 随之而来的问题
ext.ext_en: ...any ensuing problems.

defs.def_en: Ensuing events happen immediately after other events.

ext.ext_cn: 在随后的10年中，两个公司的规模扩大为原来的10倍。
ext.ext_en: The two companies grew tenfold in the ensuing ten years.

defs.def_en: Ensuing months or years follow the time you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 重约4.5千克的包裹
ext.ext_en: ...a parcel weighing around 4.5 kilograms.

ext.ext_cn: 1公斤黄油
ext.ext_en: ...a kilogram of butter.

defs.def_en: A kilogram is a metric unit of weight. One kilogram is a thousand grams, or a thousandth of a metric ton, and is equal to 2.2 pounds.

defs.def_cn: （13岁时举行的）犹太男孩成人仪式
defs.def_en: A bar mitzvah is a ceremony that takes place on the thirteenth birthday of a Jewish boy, after which he is regarded as an adult.

defs.def_cn: (1920 年到 1933 年美国禁酒时期)非法经营的酒店
defs.def_en: A speakeasy was a place where people could buy alcoholic drinks illegally in the United States between 1920 and 1933, when alcohol was forbidden.

defs.def_cn: （电话号码）未列入电话号码簿的
defs.def_en: If a person or their telephone number is ex-directory, the number is not listed in the telephone directory, and the telephone company will not give it to people who ask for it.

defs.def_cn: 网络零售商；电子零售商

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司是英国最大的网络葡萄酒零售商。
ext.ext_en: This company is the biggest wine e-tailer in the UK.

defs.def_en: An etailer is a person or company that sells products on the Internet.

ext.ext_cn: 这是个和煦的早晨，阳光普照。
ext.ext_en: It is a mild morning and the sun is shining...

ext.ext_cn: 地平线上闪耀着几处星星点点的灯光。
ext.ext_en: A few scattered lights shone on the horizon.

defs.def_en: When the sun or a light shines, it gives out bright light.

ext.ext_cn: 其中一名男子用火把照着他的脸。
ext.ext_en: One of the men shone a torch in his face...

ext.ext_cn: 那个柜子只有用紫外线照射才可以看见。
ext.ext_en: The container is invisible until you shine an ultraviolet light on it...

defs.def_en: If you shine a torch or other light somewhere, you point it there, so that you can see something when it is dark.

ext.ext_cn: 她的蓝眼睛在光的照射下闪闪发亮。
ext.ext_en: Her blue eyes shone and caught the light.

ext.ext_cn: 一双如镜子般闪亮的漆皮鞋
ext.ext_en: ...a pair of patent shoes that shone like mirrors.

defs.def_en: Something that shines is very bright and clear because it is reflecting light.

ext.ext_cn: 这种发胶会使头发看上去有亮丽的光泽。
ext.ext_en: This gel gives a beautiful shine to the hair...

ext.ext_cn: 木头最近经过抛光又恢复了光泽。
ext.ext_en: The wood had been recently polished to bring back the shine.

defs.def_en: Something that has a shine is bright and clear because it is reflecting light.

ext.ext_cn: 让他给家具除尘并把它们擦亮。
ext.ext_en: Let him dust and shine the furniture...

ext.ext_cn: 他那双黑色高筒靴被擦得光鉴照人。
ext.ext_en: His high black boots had been shined to a gleaming finish.

defs.def_en: If you shine a wooden, leather, or metal object, you make it bright by rubbing or polishing it.

defs.def_cn: (技巧或活动方面)出色，出类拔萃

ext.ext_cn: 你上学时成绩优秀吗？
ext.ext_en: Did you shine at school?...

ext.ext_cn: 他的学习成绩并不出色。
ext.ext_en: He failed to shine academically.

defs.def_en: Someone who shines at a skill or activity does it extremely well.

defs.def_cn: 一见倾心;一见钟情;一眼就看上

ext.ext_cn: 在我看来你对里士满小姐完全是一见钟情。
ext.ext_en: Seems to me you've taken quite a shine to Miss Richmond.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has taken a shine to another person, you mean that he or she liked them very much at their first meeting.

ext.ext_cn: 要使该国进行政治变革，唯一的办法就是向其施压。
ext.ext_en: The only way they can bring about political change is by putting pressure on the country.

defs.def_en: To bring something about means to cause it to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 不到20分钟，犯罪现场的照片就开始传来了。
ext.ext_en: Photographs of the crime scene began to arrive within twenty minutes.

defs.def_en: A crime scene is a place that is being investigated by the police because a crime has taken place there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是个害羞、说话轻声细语的女孩。
ext.ext_en: She was a shy, quiet-spoken girl...

ext.ext_cn: 她在现实生活中是个腼腆而且不善社交的人。
ext.ext_en: She was a shy and retiring person off-stage...

defs.def_en: A shy person is nervous and uncomfortable in the company of other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 犹豫的;不情愿的;害怕的;有所顾忌的

ext.ext_cn: 在管理学校方面，你应该毫无顾忌地发表你的意见。
ext.ext_en: You should not be shy of having your say in the running of the school.

defs.def_en: If you are shy of doing something, you are unwilling to do it because you are afraid of what might happen.

ext.ext_cn: 风一吹来，火星四溅，卢埃林的种马惊跳起来。
ext.ext_en: Llewelyn's stallion shied as the wind sent sparks flying.

defs.def_en: When a horse shies, it moves away suddenly, because something has frightened it.

defs.def_cn: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井绳;一回吃亏两回学乖
defs.def_en: You say 'once bitten, twice shy' when you want to indicate that someone will not do something a second time because they had a bad experience the first time they did it.

ext.ext_cn: 一边对做宣传避之不及，一边又抱怨赞助人与我们擦身而过，这样做是没有用的。
ext.ext_en: It is no use fighting shy of publicity and then complaining when sponsors pass us by...

ext.ext_cn: 迄今为止电视台一直竭力避免报道补缺选举。
ext.ext_en: Until now television had fought shy of covering by-elections.

defs.def_en: If you fight shy of something, you try very hard to avoid it.

ext.ext_cn: 几近53％的中学辍学率
ext.ext_en: ...a high-school dropout rate just shy of 53%...

ext.ext_cn: 他在离 95 岁寿辰仅差两天时去世了。
ext.ext_en: He died two days shy of his 95th birthday.

defs.def_en: A number or amount that is just shy of another number or amount is just under it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 惊世骇俗的;我行我素的;特立独行的

ext.ext_cn: 这是特立独行的女性主义,它本来就是想惊世骇俗。
ext.ext_en: It's in-your-face feminism, and it's meant to shock.

defs.def_en: Someone who has an in-your-face attitude seems determined to behave in a way that is unusual or shocking, and does not care what people think of them.
A contestant in a competition or quiz is a person who takes part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 高级将领整齐有序地在他身后站成几排。
ext.ext_en: The senior leaders lined up behind him in orderly rows...

ext.ext_cn: 体育老师让我们靠着水泥墙排好。
ext.ext_en: The gym teachers lined us up against the cement walls...

defs.def_en: If people line up or if you line them up, they move so that they are standing in a line.

ext.ext_cn: 我会把玩具排在这个窗台上来玩。
ext.ext_en: I would line up my toys on this windowsill and play...

ext.ext_cn: 他擦完了鸡尾酒杯，把它们成排摆放在吧台后面。
ext.ext_en: He finished polishing the cocktail glasses and lined them up behind the bar.

defs.def_en: If you line things up, you move them into a straight row.

ext.ext_cn: 你得把车子和旁边的车停齐。
ext.ext_en: You have to line the car up with the ones beside you...

ext.ext_cn: 燃气灶的高度可调整，使之与厨房操作台齐平。
ext.ext_en: Gas cookers are adjustable in height to line up with your kitchen work top...

defs.def_en: If you line one thing up with another, or one thing lines up with another, the first thing is moved into its correct position in relation to the second. You can also say that two things line up, or are lined up.

ext.ext_cn: 她邀请了高管、政坛人物和教育家加入董事会。
ext.ext_en: She lined up executives, politicians and educators to serve on the board of directors...

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃·迪伦正在组织一个为期两周的英国新年巡回演唱会。
ext.ext_en: Bob Dylan is lining up a two-week UK tour for the New Year.

defs.def_en: If you line up an event or activity, you arrange for it to happen. If you line someone up for an event or activity, you arrange for them to be available for that event or activity.

ext.ext_cn: 有些出人意料的名人也在支持这个想法。
ext.ext_en: Some surprising names have lined up behind the idea...

ext.ext_cn: 我们西班牙人太爱窝里斗了。
ext.ext_en: We Spaniards have lined up against each other all too often.

defs.def_en: If you line up with, behind, or alongside a person or group, you support them. If you line up against a person or group, you oppose them.

defs.def_cn: 不容许的事物;不能接受的事物;被禁止的东西

ext.ext_cn: 我们都知道偷逃税是绝对不行的。
ext.ext_en: We all know that cheating on our taxes is a no-no.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a no-no, you think it is undesirable or unacceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 我会在格兰特到来之前就已经启程回家了。
ext.ext_en: I'd be homeward bound even before Grant arrived...

ext.ext_cn: 月台在下班赶着回家的通勤族脚下不堪重负。
ext.ext_en: The platforms groan with homeward-bound commuters.

defs.def_en: People or things that are homeward bound are on their way home.

ext.ext_cn: 收回住房的问题
ext.ext_en: ...the problem of home repossessions.

ext.ext_cn: 面临住房被收回的家庭
ext.ext_en: ...families facing repossession of their homes.

defs.def_en: The repossession of someone's house is the act of repossessing it.

ext.ext_cn: 你将在拍卖会上见到的许多车辆都是被收回物品。
ext.ext_en: Many of the cars you will see at auction are repossessions.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a house or car that has been repossessed as a repossession .
Marijuana is a drug which is made from the dried leaves and flowers of the hemp plant, and which can be smoked.

ext.ext_cn: 重拾信仰的昔日叛乱者
ext.ext_en: ...a one-time rebel who had rediscovered his faith...

ext.ext_cn: 娜奥米的一些早期作品在20世纪80年代和90年代被重新发掘出来。
ext.ext_en: Some of Naomi's earlier writings have been rediscovered in the 1980s and 1990s...

defs.def_en: If you rediscover something good or valuable that you had forgotten or lost, you become aware of it again or find it again.

ext.ext_cn: 11月的空气刺痛了我的脸颊，预示着冬天就要来临。
ext.ext_en: The November air stung my cheeks, a harbinger of winter.

defs.def_en: Something that is a harbinger of something else, especially something bad, is a sign that it is going to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 吸入与呼出的完整循环
ext.ext_en: ...a complete cycle of inhalation and exhalation...

ext.ext_cn: 他们因吸入大量烟尘被送往医院。
ext.ext_en: They were taken to hospital suffering from smoke inhalation...

defs.def_en: Inhalation is the process or act of breathing in, taking air and sometimes other substances into your lungs.

ext.ext_cn: 吸入药剂可以缓解并抑制咳嗽。
ext.ext_en: Inhalations can soothe and control the cough...

ext.ext_cn: 吸入薄荷醇或许可以起到作用。
ext.ext_en: Inhalations of menthol may do the trick.

defs.def_en: An inhalation is a treatment for colds and other illnesses in which you dissolve substances in hot water and breathe in the vapour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 狭隘的;偏执的;严格僵化的;不自由的

ext.ext_cn: 严格僵化的立法
ext.ext_en: ...illiberal legislation...

ext.ext_cn: 他的观点非常狭隘。
ext.ext_en: His views are markedly illiberal.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as illiberal, you are critical of them because they do not allow or approve of much freedom or choice of action.

ext.ext_cn: 他被迫调整了自己的日程安排。
ext.ext_en: He has been forced to adjust his schedule...

ext.ext_cn: 我们俩日程安排得都很紧。
ext.ext_en: We both have such hectic schedules.

defs.def_en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

ext.ext_cn: 喷气式飞机提前两分钟到达了约翰内斯堡。
ext.ext_en: The jet arrived in Johannesburg two minutes ahead of schedule...

ext.ext_cn: 一切都按计划进行。
ext.ext_en: Everything went according to schedule...

defs.def_en: You can use schedule to refer to the time or way something is planned to be done. For example, if something is completed on schedule, it is completed at the time planned.

ext.ext_cn: 航天飞机已经预定于凌晨 4 点 38 分发射升空。
ext.ext_en: The space shuttle had been scheduled to blast off at 04:38...

ext.ext_cn: 总统选举原计划在去年 12 月举行。
ext.ext_en: A presidential election was scheduled for last December...

defs.def_en: If something is scheduled to happen at a particular time, arrangements are made for it to happen at that time.

defs.def_cn: (价格、细节或条件等的)一览表，明细表，清单
defs.def_en: A schedule is a written list of things, for example a list of prices, details, or conditions.

defs.def_cn: (火车、客轮、公共汽车或航班的)时刻表,时间表

ext.ext_cn: 公共汽车时刻表
ext.ext_en: ...a bus schedule.

defs.def_en: A schedule is a list of all the times when trains, boats, buses, or aircraft are supposed to arrive at or leave a particular place.
In a school or college, a schedule is a diagram that shows the times in the week at which particular subjects are taught.

defs.def_cn: 划时代的;开创新纪元的

ext.ext_cn: 有意让它听起来像是一个划时代的宣言。
ext.ext_en: It was meant to sound like an epoch-making declaration.

ext.ext_cn: 当下正在东欧发生的划时代的变革
ext.ext_en: ...the epoch-making changes now taking place in Eastern Europe.

defs.def_en: An epoch-making change or declaration is considered to be the extremely important because it is likely to have a significant effect on a particular period of time.

ext.ext_cn: “它就在这里的什么地方，”他一边说，一边在桌子里乱翻。
ext.ext_en: 'It's in here somewhere,' he said, rooting about in his desk.

defs.def_en: If you root around or root about in something, you look for something there, moving things around as you search.
An autobahn is a German motorway.

defs.def_cn: 以色列的;以色列人的;以色列文化的

ext.ext_cn: 以色列政府
ext.ext_en: ...the Israeli government.

defs.def_en: Israeli means belonging or relating to Israel, or to its people or culture.
An Israeli is an Israeli citizen, or a person of Israeli origin.

ext.ext_cn: 废旧的石灰岩采石场
ext.ext_en: ...an old limestone quarry.

defs.def_en: A quarry is an area that is dug out from a piece of land or the side of a mountain in order to get stone or minerals.

defs.def_cn: 开采(石料或矿产);在…开采

ext.ext_cn: 同时还在这些大石灰岩洞里开采水泥原料。
ext.ext_en: The large limestone caves are also quarried for cement.

ext.ext_cn: 当地采掘的石头
ext.ext_en: ...locally quarried stone.

defs.def_en: When stone or minerals are quarried or when an area is quarried for them, they are removed from the area by digging, drilling, or using explosives.
A person's or animal's quarry is the person or animal that they are hunting.

ext.ext_cn: 新的生产范式
ext.ext_en: ...a new paradigm of production.

defs.def_en: A paradigm is a model for something which explains it or shows how it can be produced.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经成为成功人士的典范。
ext.ext_en: He had become the paradigm of the successful man.

defs.def_en: A paradigm is a clear and typical example of something.

defs.def_cn: 权势日隆;影响变大;日益受欢迎

ext.ext_cn: 激进派改革者再度占据了统治地位。
ext.ext_en: Radical reformers are once more in the ascendant...

ext.ext_cn: 为什么地理、戏剧、艺术和英语逐渐受宠？
ext.ext_en: Why are Geography, Drama, Art and English in the ascendant?

defs.def_en: If someone or something is in the ascendant, they have or are getting more power, influence, or popularity than other people or things.

ext.ext_cn: 四周和上方有一排排座位的礼堂
ext.ext_en: ...the auditorium with the tiers of seats around and above it.

ext.ext_cn: 3层的结婚蛋糕
ext.ext_en: ...a three-tier wedding cake.

defs.def_en: A tier is a row or layer of something that has other layers above or below it.

ext.ext_cn: 岛上居民发起一场运动，要求废除岛上三级市政管理层中的一级。
ext.ext_en: Islanders have campaigned for the abolition of one of the three tiers of municipal power on the island.

ext.ext_cn: 大学实行双重体制的可能性
ext.ext_en: ...the possibility of a two-tier system of universities.

defs.def_en: A tier is a level in an organization or system.

ext.ext_cn: 市政税在明年4月将取代人头税。
ext.ext_en: The council tax replaces the poll tax next April.

ext.ext_cn: 取代鲍勃成为公司主席的市政律师
ext.ext_en: ...the city lawyer who replaced Bob as chairman of the company...

defs.def_en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

ext.ext_cn: 我把所有的油脂清除干净，然后用油来代替，从而使它在低温条件下运转得更好。
ext.ext_en: I clean out all the grease and replace it with oil so it works better in very low temperatures...

ext.ext_cn: 英国广播公司认定那不能取代她。
ext.ext_en: The BBC decided it could not replace her.

defs.def_en: If you replace one thing or person with another, you put something or someone else in their place to do their job.

ext.ext_cn: 我们几年前安装的淋浴器坏了，但买不起新的来换。
ext.ext_en: The shower that we put in a few years back has broken and we cannot afford to replace it.

defs.def_en: If you replace something that is broken, damaged, or lost, you get a new one to use instead.

ext.ext_cn: 线路中断了，惠特洛克把听筒放回原处。
ext.ext_en: The line went dead. Whitlock replaced the receiver...

ext.ext_cn: 把瓶盖重新盖上。
ext.ext_en: Replace the caps on the bottles.

defs.def_en: If you replace something, you put it back where it was before.

ext.ext_cn: 如果预先准备自己的葬礼，就能选择自己喜欢的鲜花和音乐。
ext.ext_en: When you prearrange your funeral, you can pick your own flowers and music.

defs.def_en: If you prearrange something, you plan or arrange it before the time when it actually happens.

defs.def_cn: (常指为便于保存而）使(食品等)脱水，使干燥

ext.ext_cn: 标本通常需要经过干燥处理。
ext.ext_en: Normally specimens have to be dehydrated.

defs.def_en: When something such as food is dehydrated, all the water is removed from it, often in order to preserve it.

ext.ext_cn: 人们在这样的天气下可能会脱水。
ext.ext_en: People can dehydrate in weather like this...

ext.ext_cn: 酒精会让身体迅速脱水。
ext.ext_en: Alcohol quickly dehydrates your body.

defs.def_en: If you dehydrate or if something dehydrates you, you lose too much water from your body so that you feel weak or ill.

ext.ext_cn: 他因收受贿赂正在接受调查。
ext.ext_en: He was being investigated for receiving bribes.

defs.def_en: A bribe is a sum of money or something valuable that one person offers or gives to another in order to persuade him or her to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 他被指控贿赂一名高级银行官员。
ext.ext_en: He was accused of bribing a senior bank official...

ext.ext_cn: 政府收买工人让其保持沉默。
ext.ext_en: The government bribed the workers to be quiet.

defs.def_en: If one person bribes another, they give them a bribe.
A woodcutter is someone who cuts down trees or who chops wood as their job.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 嗜杀成性的；耽于暴力的；残忍的；血腥的

ext.ext_cn: 他们野蛮残暴。
ext.ext_en: They were savage and bloodthirsty.

ext.ext_cn: 在这场血腥的战争中一些最令人惨不忍睹的场景
ext.ext_en: ...some of the most tragic scenes witnessed even in this bloodthirsty war.

defs.def_en: Bloodthirsty people are eager to use violence or display a strong interest in violent things. You can also use bloodthirsty to refer to very violent situations.

ext.ext_cn: 实际上多数人一个问题得了满分，另一个问题却得了零分。
ext.ext_en: Most people in fact got full marks in one question and zero in the other.

defs.def_en: If you get full marks in a test or exam, you get everything right and gain the maximum number of marks.

ext.ext_cn: 也许其诚实值得称道，但在处理人际关系方面却是个失败。
ext.ext_en: Full marks for honesty, perhaps, but a fail for diplomacy.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone gets full marks for something, you are praising them for being very clever or for showing some other good quality.

defs.def_cn: (律师就某人所提供的证据进行)盘问，反诘

ext.ext_cn: 被告律师将有机会盘问他。
ext.ext_en: The accused's lawyers will get a chance to cross-examine him...

ext.ext_cn: 你要清楚他们可能会就这起人身侵犯案毫不留情地盘问你。
ext.ext_en: You know you are liable to be cross-examined mercilessly about the assault.

defs.def_en: When a lawyer cross-examines someone during a trial or hearing, he or she questions them about the evidence that they have already given.

ext.ext_cn: 像托特纳姆和佩卡姆这样的内陆地区失业人口达1/4。
ext.ext_en: One in four people are now jobless in inner areas like Tottenham and Peckham.

ext.ext_cn: 失业人数
ext.ext_en: ...the number of jobless people.

defs.def_en: Someone who is jobless does not have a job, although they would like one.

ext.ext_cn: 她是邪恶的化身。
ext.ext_en: She is evil incarnate...

ext.ext_cn: 他是愤世嫉俗的极端体现。
ext.ext_en: He is cynicism incarnate.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a quality incarnate, you mean that they represent that quality or are typical of it in an extreme form.

ext.ext_cn: 为什么上帝以男性之身显现呢？
ext.ext_en: Why should God become incarnate as a male?...

ext.ext_cn: 这位法老就是俄西里斯，丰产神的化身。
ext.ext_en: The pharaoh is Osiris, the moon bull incarnate.

defs.def_en: You use incarnate to say that something, especially a god or spirit, is represented in human form.

ext.ext_cn: 该政权的种种劣行集中体现于一人。
ext.ext_en: The iniquities of the regime are incarnated in one man.

ext.ext_cn: 体现了美洲观念变化的作家
ext.ext_en: ...a writer who incarnates the changing consciousness of the Americas.

defs.def_en: If you say that a quality is incarnated in a person, you mean that they represent that quality or are typical of it in an extreme form.

ext.ext_cn: 守护之神毗湿奴化身为下界的一位国王。
ext.ext_en: The god Vishnu was incarnated on earth as a king.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is incarnated in a particular form, you mean that they appear on earth in that form.

ext.ext_cn: 工作人员正紧张忙乱地为峰会做最后准备。
ext.ext_en: The staff is working frantically on final arrangements for the summit...

ext.ext_cn: 她给埃伦打了电话，但没有约她见面。
ext.ext_en: She telephoned Ellen, but made no arrangements to see her.

defs.def_en: Arrangements are plans and preparations which you make so that something will happen or be possible.

ext.ext_cn: 这些洞穴只接受预约参观。
ext.ext_en: The caves can be visited only by prior arrangement...

ext.ext_cn: 她班上的老师作了特别安排，每月讨论一次她在学业上的进展情况。
ext.ext_en: Her class teacher made a special arrangement to discuss her progress at school once a month.

defs.def_en: An arrangement is an agreement that you make with someone to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 这所房子总是摆放着富有创意的插花。
ext.ext_en: The house was always decorated with imaginative flower arrangements.

ext.ext_cn: 咖啡桌周围摆放了一些深蓝色扶手椅
ext.ext_en: ...an arrangement of dark-blue armchairs around a coffee table.

defs.def_en: An arrangement of things, for example flowers or furniture, is a group of them displayed in a particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 莫扎特一首名曲的改编曲
ext.ext_en: ...an arrangement of a well-known piece by Mozart...

ext.ext_cn: 格伦·布朗卡把自己的曲子改编成了管弦乐曲。
ext.ext_en: Glen Bronka wrote his own orchestral arrangements.

defs.def_en: If someone makes an arrangement of a piece of music, they change it so that it is suitable for particular voices or instruments, or for a particular performance.

defs.def_cn: (情绪突然)颓丧的，抑郁的，沮丧的

ext.ext_cn: 我开始有一种永远也摆脱不了她的沮丧情绪。
ext.ext_en: I began to have a sinking feeling that I was not going to get rid of her.

defs.def_en: See also:sink;If you have a sinking feeling, you suddenly become depressed or lose hope.
A hand grenade is the same as a grenade .

ext.ext_cn: 经过脊髓传送的感官信息
ext.ext_en: ...sensory information passing through the spinal cord.

ext.ext_cn: 我们身体的感官系统
ext.ext_en: ...our body's sensory system.

defs.def_en: Sensory means relating to the physical senses.

ext.ext_cn: 离婚和在教堂再婚的问题仍然存有很大争议。
ext.ext_en: The question of divorce and remarriage in church remains highly contentious.

defs.def_en: Remarriage is the act of remarrying.

ext.ext_cn: 突然一个闪电瞬间照亮了一切。
ext.ext_en: A sudden flash of lightning lit everything up for a second...

ext.ext_cn: 墙上插头处的电线啪地发出一道蓝光，电灯的保险丝烧断了。
ext.ext_en: The wire snapped at the wall plug with a blue flash and the light fused...

defs.def_en: A flash is a sudden burst of light or of something shiny or bright.

ext.ext_cn: 一道道电光在远处的乌云中闪现。
ext.ext_en: Lightning flashed among the distant dark clouds...

ext.ext_cn: 一个女司机在他超车时不停地闪着车前灯，这让他火冒三丈。
ext.ext_en: He lost his temper after a driver flashed her headlights as he overtook...

defs.def_en: If a light flashes or if you flash a light, it shines with a sudden bright light, especially as quick, regular flashes of light.

ext.ext_cn: “莫伊拉跟你说什么啦？”利兹突然生气地质问道。
ext.ext_en: 'What did Moira tell you?' Liz demanded with a flash of anger...

ext.ext_cn: 遭到追赶时，他突然飞速地逃脱了。
ext.ext_en: When pursued, he made his escape with a flash of speed...

defs.def_en: You talk about a flash of something when you are saying that it happens very suddenly and unexpectedly.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一条繁忙的道路，每隔几分钟就有汽车飞驰而过。
ext.ext_en: It was a busy road, cars flashed by every few minutes.

ext.ext_cn: 球从球门前飞过。
ext.ext_en: ...the ball flashed across the face of the goal.

defs.def_en: If something flashes past or by, it moves past you so fast that you cannot see it properly.

ext.ext_cn: 一个荒谬的念头突然在哈里脑中闪现。
ext.ext_en: A ludicrous thought flashed through Harry's mind...

ext.ext_cn: 弥尔顿的那几行诗忽然在我脑中闪过。
ext.ext_en: Those lines of Milton flashed into my mind.

defs.def_en: If something flashes through or into your mind, you suddenly think about it.

ext.ext_cn: 哈利姆亮了一下他的军官证，设法找来了一名士兵看着路虎车。
ext.ext_en: Halim flashed his official card, and managed to get hold of a soldier to guard the Land Rover.

defs.def_en: If you flash something such as an identity card, you show it to people quickly and then put it away again.

ext.ext_cn: 数字显示在记分牌上。
ext.ext_en: The figures flash up on the scoreboard...

ext.ext_cn: “祝您好运”几个字出现在屏幕上。
ext.ext_en: The words 'Good Luck' were flashing on the screen...

defs.def_en: If a picture or message flashes up on a screen, or if you flash it onto a screen, it is displayed there briefly or suddenly, and often repeatedly.

defs.def_cn: (通过计算机、卫星或其他系统)快速发送，迅速播出，传送

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经告诉各办公室，一有消息立即发布。
ext.ext_en: They had told their offices to flash the news as soon as it broke...

ext.ext_cn: 当然，这是国际性新闻，很快就会传到世界各地。
ext.ext_en: This is, of course, international news and soon it was being flashed around the world.

defs.def_en: If you flash news or information to a place, you send it there quickly by computer, satellite, or other system.

ext.ext_cn: 我向休瞥了一眼。
ext.ext_en: I flashed a look at Sue...

ext.ext_cn: 梅格冲茜茜感激地笑了一笑。
ext.ext_en: Meg flashed Cissie a grateful smile.

defs.def_en: If you flash a look or a smile at someone, you suddenly look at them or smile at them.

ext.ext_cn: 她飞快地说着，黑色的双眼放着光。
ext.ext_en: Her dark eyes flashed and she spoke rapidly.

defs.def_en: If someone's eyes flash, they suddenly show a strong emotion, especially anger.

ext.ext_cn: 他是最先使用高速闪光灯拍摄鸟类的人之一。
ext.ext_en: He was one of the first people to use high speed flash in bird photography.

defs.def_en: Flash is the use of special bulbs to give more light when taking a photograph.

ext.ext_cn: 皮特关掉手电筒，停下来休息。
ext.ext_en: Stopping to rest, Pete shut off the flash.

defs.def_en: A flash is the same as a flashlight .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 城郊富人区的豪华饭店
ext.ext_en: ...a flash uptown restaurant...

ext.ext_cn: 可以去弄一个“指挥台”系统，它听起来很昂贵，但其实花不了多少钱就可以组装起来。
ext.ext_en: You can go for a 'rostrum' system, which sounds flash, but can be assembled quite cheaply.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as flash, you mean that it looks expensive, fashionable, and new.

ext.ext_cn: 人们会来看看我们现在有多成功，看看我们的成功是否只是昙花一现。
ext.ext_en: People will be looking in to see how good we are now and whether our success has just been a flash in the pan.

defs.def_en: If you describe an achievement or success as a flash in the pan, you mean that it is unlikely to be repeated and is not an indication of future achievements or success.

ext.ext_cn: 他一下子就有了答案。
ext.ext_en: The answer had come to him in a flash...

ext.ext_cn: 一眨眼的工夫就完成了。
ext.ext_en: It was done in a flash.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens in a flash, you mean that it happens suddenly and lasts only a very short time.

ext.ext_cn: 那人立即说道：“我必须如此，是不是？”
ext.ext_en: Quick as a flash, the man said, 'I have to, don't I?'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone reacts to something quick as a flash, you mean that they react to it extremely quickly.

defs.def_cn: 突然记起;猛然想起;忽地记起

ext.ext_cn: 他脑中不断回想起头天晚上发生的事。
ext.ext_en: His mind kept flashing back to the previous night...

ext.ext_cn: 这难免会令人想起1914年，那年巴尔干半岛上这一地区的动荡最终引发了世界大战。
ext.ext_en: Thoughts inevitably flash back to 1914, when trouble in this part of the Balkans led all the way to world war.

defs.def_en: See also:flashback;If your mind flashes back to something in the past, you remember it or think of it briefly or suddenly.

defs.def_cn: 浪，弗隆(长度单位，等于 220 码或 201.2 米)
defs.def_en: A furlong is a unit of length that is equal to 220 yards or 201.2 metres.

ext.ext_cn: 既定的典礼时间就快到了。
ext.ext_en: The appointed hour of the ceremony was drawing nearer.

defs.def_en: If something happens at the appointed time, it happens at the time that was decided in advance.

ext.ext_cn: 他挥舞着一把小刀，出现在休息室里。
ext.ext_en: He appeared in the lounge brandishing a knife.

defs.def_en: If you brandish something, especially a weapon, you hold it in a threatening way.

ext.ext_cn: 没有消防设备。
ext.ext_en: There was no firefighting equipment.

defs.def_en: Firefighting is the work of putting out fires.

defs.def_cn: （通常指挪动很多物品）寻找，翻找

ext.ext_cn: 他翻遍了食橱的上层，想找那瓶威士忌。
ext.ext_en: He poked around the top of his cupboard for the bottle of whisky...

ext.ext_cn: 我们打开了车子的引擎盖，他开始仔细查看发动机。
ext.ext_en: We opened up the car bonnet and he started poking around in my engine.

defs.def_en: If you poke around or poke about for something, you search for it, usually by moving lots of objects around.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 使人尴尬的；难处理的；棘手的

ext.ext_cn: 我是第一个向他提出尴尬问题的人，不过还会有人问更难回答的问题。
ext.ext_en: I was the first to ask him awkward questions but there'll be harder ones to come...

ext.ext_cn: 大家在决定是否要站到自己配偶身旁时，这一刻令人尴尬。
ext.ext_en: There was an awkward moment as couples decided whether to stand next to their partners.

defs.def_en: An awkward situation is embarrassing and difficult to deal with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难使用的；难携带的；（工作）难处理的

ext.ext_cn: 它虽然小，但很重，不便携带。
ext.ext_en: It was small but heavy enough to make it awkward to carry...

ext.ext_cn: 标准尺寸的三脚架可能会不便于使用，用于拍摄低角度的物体时尤其如此。
ext.ext_en: Full-size tripods can be awkward, especially if you're shooting a low-level subject.

defs.def_en: Something that is awkward to use or carry is difficult to use or carry because of its design. A job that is awkward is difficult to do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 埃米笨拙地做了个手势。
ext.ext_en: Amy made an awkward gesture with her hands.

defs.def_en: An awkward movement or position is uncomfortable or clumsy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 害羞的；尴尬的；局促不安的

ext.ext_cn: 女人们经常说她们不好意思在性生活上采取主动。
ext.ext_en: Women frequently say that they feel awkward taking the initiative in sex...

ext.ext_cn: 在教子面前，他非常局促不安。
ext.ext_en: He was rather awkward with his godson.

defs.def_en: Someone who feels awkward behaves in a shy or embarrassed way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可理喻的；难打交道的；难相处的

ext.ext_cn: 她到了难相处的年龄。
ext.ext_en: She's got to an age where she is being awkward.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is awkward, you are critical of them because you find them unreasonable and difficult to live with or deal with.

defs.def_cn: (广播和电视上或多个电视频道的)联播节目

ext.ext_cn: 今晚威尔第创作的歌剧《阿依达》将在多个电视台联播
ext.ext_en: ...tonight's simulcast of Verdi's Aida.

defs.def_en: A simulcast is a programme which is broadcast at the same time on radio and television, or on more than one channel.

defs.def_cn: (在广播和电视上或多个电视频道)联播，同步播出

ext.ext_cn: 这场演出会在美国国家广播电台、福克斯广播电台和一些有线电视网上同步播出。
ext.ext_en: The show will be simulcast on NBC, Fox and a number of cable networks.

defs.def_en: To simulcast a programme means to broadcast it at the same time on radio and television, or on more than one channel.

defs.def_cn: 无计可施;山穷水尽;走投无路

ext.ext_cn: 她既忌妒又感到屈辱，感情上已经到了崩溃的边缘。
ext.ext_en: She was jealous, humiliated, and emotionally at the end of her tether...

ext.ext_cn: 我已经无计可施了。
ext.ext_en: I've reached the end of my tether.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are at the end of your tether, you mean that you are so worried, tired, and unhappy because of your problems that you feel you cannot cope.
A tether is a rope or chain which is used to tie an animal to a post or fence so that it can only move around within a small area.

ext.ext_cn: 军官下了马，把它拴到一棵树上。
ext.ext_en: The officer dismounted, tethering his horse to a tree.

defs.def_en: If you tether an animal or object to something, you attach it there with a rope or chain so that it cannot move very far.

ext.ext_cn: “他叫什么？”——“彼得。”
ext.ext_en: 'What's his name?'—'Peter.'...

ext.ext_cn: 我甚至不知道沙利文是否是他的真名。
ext.ext_en: I don't even know if Sullivan's his real name...

defs.def_en: The name of a person, place, or thing is the word or group of words that is used to identify them.

ext.ext_cn: 我母亲坚持给我取名叫霍勒斯。
ext.ext_en: My mother insisted on naming me Horace.

ext.ext_cn: 名叫约翰·T.本森的男人
ext.ext_en: ...a man named John T. Benson...

defs.def_en: When you name someone or something, you give them a name, usually at the beginning of their life.

ext.ext_cn: 为什么没让哪个儿子用你的名字呢？
ext.ext_en: Why have you not named any of your sons after yourself?

defs.def_en: If you name someone or something after another person or thing, you give them the same name as that person or thing.

defs.def_cn: 叫出…的名称;说出…的名字

ext.ext_cn: 一名记者因拒绝说出消息来源而入狱已经是近30年前的事了。
ext.ext_en: It's nearly thirty years since a journalist was jailed for refusing to name a source...

ext.ext_cn: 周末暴风雪中的一名罹难者已确认是20岁的约翰·巴尔。
ext.ext_en: One of the victims of the weekend's snowstorm has been named as twenty-year-old John Barr.

defs.def_en: If you name someone, you identify them by stating their name.

defs.def_cn: 提出，说出，指出(价格、时间、地点等)

ext.ext_cn: 给马蒂打电话，让他出个价儿。
ext.ext_en: Call Marty, tell him to name his price.

defs.def_en: If you name something such as a price, time, or place, you say what you want it to be.

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队主教练将任命新队长，接替受伤的大卫·贝克汉姆。
ext.ext_en: The England manager will be naming a new captain, to replace the injured David Beckham...

ext.ext_cn: 坎贝尔公司的总裁退休后，麦戈文被选定为继任者。
ext.ext_en: When the chairman of Campbell's retired, McGovern was named as his successor...

defs.def_en: If you name the person for a particular job, you say who you want to have the job.

ext.ext_cn: 他以判断准确而闻名。
ext.ext_en: He had a name for good judgement...

ext.ext_cn: 她从没有吸过毒，也没做过任何有损爵士乐名声的事。
ext.ext_en: She's never had any drug problems or done anything to give jazz a bad name.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the reputation of a person or thing as their name .

ext.ext_cn: 模特和时装界一些最知名的红人
ext.ext_en: ...some of the most famous names in modelling and show business.

ext.ext_cn: 耐克、李维斯、CK和汤米·希尔费格之类的顶级名牌
ext.ext_en: ...top names such as Nike, Levi's, Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone as, for example, a famous name or a great name when they are well-known.

ext.ext_cn: 房子是我丈夫名下的。
ext.ext_en: The house is in my husband's name...

ext.ext_cn: 已用穆勒的名字为他预订了一个双人间。
ext.ext_en: A double room had been reserved for him in the name of Muller.

defs.def_en: If something is in someone's name, it officially belongs to them or is reserved for them.

ext.ext_cn: 在美国，多数派代表民众执政。
ext.ext_en: In the United States the majority governs in the name of the people...

ext.ext_cn: 她代表“拯救儿童基金会”接受了礼物。
ext.ext_en: She accepted the gift in the name of the Save the Children Fund.

defs.def_en: If someone does something in the name of a group of people, they do it as the representative of that group.

ext.ext_cn: 历史上少有的例子之一，政治领袖为更大的公共利益，甘冒丢官弃职的风险
ext.ext_en: ...one of those rare occasions in history when a political leader risked his own power in the name of the greater public good...

ext.ext_cn: 有时人们打着做生意的幌子所做的事情让她感到恶心。
ext.ext_en: There had been times when she had felt sickened by the things people did in the name of business.

defs.def_en: If you do something in the name of an ideal or an abstract thing, you do it in order to preserve or promote that thing.

defs.def_cn: (加强提问或要求的语气)看在(上帝、人道等)的份儿上

ext.ext_cn: 看在上帝份儿上，这到底是怎么回事？
ext.ext_en: What in the name of heaven's going on?...

ext.ext_cn: 我以人道的名义请求政府重新评估这一重大问题。
ext.ext_en: In the name of humanity I ask the government to reappraise this important issue.

defs.def_en: People sometimes use expressions such as 'in the name of heaven' or 'in the name of humanity' to add emphasis to a question or request.

defs.def_cn: 有实无名的;未被认可的

ext.ext_cn: 这一团体，现在是有实无名的政党
ext.ext_en: ...the group, which is now a political party in all but name...

ext.ext_cn: 这实际上已是该学说的终结，只是未被道明罢了。
ext.ext_en: It's the end of the doctrine in all but name.

defs.def_en: If you say that a situation exists in all but name, you mean that it is not officially recognized even though it exists.

ext.ext_cn: 他跟顾客打招呼时直呼其名，并问他们身体可好。
ext.ext_en: He greets customers by name and enquires about their health.

defs.def_en: When you mention someone or something by name, or address someone by name, you use their name.

ext.ext_cn: 名叫哈里·巴斯蒂德的澳大利亚年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...a young Australian, Harry Busteed by name...

ext.ext_cn: 这个叫杰克·史密斯的家伙是不是还有个名字叫杰凯尔？
ext.ext_en: This guy, Jack Smith, does he go by the name of Jackal?

defs.def_en: You can use by name or by the name of when you are saying what someone is called.

ext.ext_cn: 在之前的学校，因为我反应慢，他们骂过我。
ext.ext_en: At my last school they called me names because I was so slow...

ext.ext_cn: 他们用粗鲁的言语谩骂她。
ext.ext_en: They had called her rude names.

defs.def_en: If someone calls you names, they insult you by saying unpleasant things to you or about you.

ext.ext_cn: 家庭价值观突然变得重要起来。
ext.ext_en: Family values are suddenly the name of the game...

ext.ext_cn: 重要的是活下去。
ext.ext_en: The name of the game is survival.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is the name of the game, you mean that it is the most important aspect of a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 他很有政治见解，对很多事业都予以支持。
ext.ext_en: He had political points of view and lent his name to a lot of causes.

defs.def_en: If you lend your name to something such as a cause or project, you support it.

ext.ext_cn: 她开始成为一个小有名气的人像摄影师。
ext.ext_en: She was beginning to make a name for herself as a portrait photographer...

ext.ext_cn: 他是以几部短篇小说集成名的。
ext.ext_en: He made his name with several collections of short stories.

defs.def_en: If you make a name for yourself or make your name as something, you become well-known for that thing.

defs.def_cn: 点出(或指出)(做错事者)的名字

ext.ext_cn: 没有人愿意冒着被起诉的风险去真正指认别人。
ext.ext_en: Nobody was prepared to risk prosecution by actually naming names.

defs.def_en: If you name names, you identify the people who have done something, often something wrong.

defs.def_cn: (指报纸或官方机构)曝光，点名，指名(业绩差或犯错的人)

ext.ext_cn: 政府还将曝光业绩最差的航空公司。
ext.ext_en: The government will also name and shame the worst performing airlines.

defs.def_en: If something such as a newspaper or an official body names and shames people who have performed badly or who have done something wrong, it identifies those people by name.

ext.ext_cn: 许多团体实际上是有名无实。
ext.ext_en: Many of the groups exist in name only...

ext.ext_cn: 他只是名义上的总司令。
ext.ext_en: He is commander-in-chief in name only.

defs.def_en: If you say that a situation exists in name only, you mean that it does not have the status or position that it claims to have.

defs.def_cn: 凡是你说得出的，凡是你能想到的(应有尽有)

ext.ext_cn: 酸黄瓜、果酱、腌浆果、西红柿，凡是你说得出的，他们都有。
ext.ext_en: Pickled cucumbers, jam, pickled berries, tomatoes; you name it, they've got it...

ext.ext_cn: 我也喜欢帆板、网球、短柄墙球、游泳等等，不一而足。
ext.ext_en: I also enjoy windsurfing, tennis, racquetball, swimming, you name it.

defs.def_en: You say you name it, usually after or before a list, to indicate that you are talking about a very wide range of things.
If someone goes bungee jumping, they jump from a high place such as a bridge or cliff with a long piece of strong elastic cord tied around their ankle connecting them to the bridge or cliff.

ext.ext_cn: 该地区计划筹建约 3,500 所新居。
ext.ext_en: Some 3,500 new dwellings are planned for the area...

ext.ext_cn: 我们去大峡谷徒步旅行,探究印第安人的崖居。
ext.ext_en: We hiked the Grand Canyon, exploring Indian cliff dwellings.

defs.def_en: A dwelling or a dwelling place is a place where someone lives.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (肤色，尤指脸色)灰黄色的，菜色的,蜡黄的

ext.ext_cn: 她头发平直，皮肤发黄。
ext.ext_en: She had lank hair and sallow skin.

ext.ext_cn: 他脸色蜡黄，汗珠津津。
ext.ext_en: His face was sallow and shiny with sweat.

defs.def_en: If a person has sallow skin, their skin, especially on their face, is a pale yellowish colour and looks unhealthy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人心碎的;使人悲痛的

ext.ext_cn: 今年我们甚至无法给自己的孙儿辈买礼物了。这真让人心碎。
ext.ext_en: This year we won't even be able to buy presents for our grandchildren. It's heartbreaking.

defs.def_en: Something that is heartbreaking makes you feel extremely sad and upset.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在这些问题上颇有经验的律师们
ext.ext_en: ...lawyers who are experienced in these matters...

ext.ext_cn: 那个小组里都是些有经验的成熟专业人士。
ext.ext_en: It's a team packed with experienced and mature professionals...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as experienced, you mean that they have been doing a particular job or activity for a long time, and therefore know a lot about it or are very skilful at it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 蛋白石般无色的；乳白色的；发乳光的

ext.ext_cn: 伊莱恩一双乳白色的眼睛转向他。
ext.ext_en: Elaine turned her opalescent eyes on him.

ext.ext_cn: 仍然泛白的天空
ext.ext_en: ...a sky which was still faintly opalescent.

defs.def_en: Opalescent means colourless or white like an opal, or changing colour like an opal.

defs.def_cn: （尤指艺术、文学等的）黄金时代，鼎盛时期

ext.ext_cn: 你成长于美国儿童文学的黄金时期。
ext.ext_en: You grew up in the golden age of American children's books.

defs.def_en: A golden age is a period of time during which a very high level of achievement is reached in a particular field of activity, especially in art or literature.
A fern is a plant that has long stems with feathery leaves and no flowers. There are many types of fern.

ext.ext_cn: 唱歌能够给人一种心旷神怡的感觉。
ext.ext_en: Singing can create a sense of wellbeing...

ext.ext_cn: 他的工作不仅重视孩子们的身体健康，同时也关注他们的情感健康。
ext.ext_en: His work emphasised the emotional as well as the physical well-being of children.

defs.def_en: Someone's well-being is their health and happiness.

defs.def_cn: （由一人代表大量选民投的）集团投票
defs.def_en: A block vote is a large number of votes that are all cast in the same way by one person on behalf of a group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 工厂雇员总数已经从 4,000 多人减少到几百人。
ext.ext_en: The factory's workforce has dwindled from over 4,000 to a few hundred...

ext.ext_cn: 出口在缩减，贸易赤字在增长。
ext.ext_en: Exports are dwindling and the trade deficit is swelling...

defs.def_en: If something dwindles, it becomes smaller, weaker, or less in number.

ext.ext_cn: 图尔金拍拍他的肩膀。“不好意思打断您一下,上校。”
ext.ext_en: Turkin tapped him on the shoulder. 'Sorry to interrupt, Colonel.'...

ext.ext_cn: 他想说话,但被她打断了。
ext.ext_en: He tried to speak, but she interrupted him.

defs.def_en: If you interrupt someone who is speaking, you say or do something that causes them to stop.

ext.ext_cn: 他马上中止了在西班牙的度假回到伦敦。
ext.ext_en: He has rightly interrupted his holiday in Spain to return to London...

ext.ext_cn: 比赛进行了将近3个小时,几次因雨而暂停。
ext.ext_en: The match took nearly three hours and was interrupted at times by rain.

defs.def_en: If someone or something interrupts a process or activity, they stop it for a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 稍高些的植物遮挡了房内的视线。
ext.ext_en: Taller plants interrupt the views from the house.

defs.def_en: If something interrupts a line, surface, or view, it stops it from being continuous or makes it look irregular.

defs.def_cn: 证实;证明…正确;证明…无辜

ext.ext_cn: 主任说专家们的报告证明了他是正确的。
ext.ext_en: The director said he had been vindicated by the experts' report...

ext.ext_cn: 部长们和官员们相信他们的决定会被证明是正确的。
ext.ext_en: Ministers and officials are confident their decision will be vindicated.

defs.def_en: If a person or their decisions, actions, or ideas are vindicated, they are proved to be correct, after people have said that they were wrong.

defs.def_cn: （用于陈述认为听者已经知道的事）显然地，无疑地

ext.ext_cn: 很显然，他们已经得到某些大公司的赞助。
ext.ext_en: Obviously, they've had sponsorship from some big companies...

ext.ext_cn: 这其中无疑存在特例。
ext.ext_en: There are obviously exceptions to this.

defs.def_en: You use obviously when you are stating something that you expect the person who is listening to know already.

ext.ext_cn: 他们显然对你十分感激。
ext.ext_en: They obviously appreciate you very much...

ext.ext_cn: 她明显要比我聪明、漂亮得多。
ext.ext_en: She's so obviously cleverer and prettier than I am.

defs.def_en: You use obviously to indicate that something is easily noticed, seen, or recognized.

ext.ext_cn: 制造轮胎的原材料是提炼汽油时产生的一种副产品。
ext.ext_en: The raw material for the tyre is a by-product of petrol refining.

defs.def_en: A by-product is something which is produced during the manufacture or processing of another product.

ext.ext_cn: 他们会见的意外成果是释放了这14个人。
ext.ext_en: A by-product of their meeting was the release of these fourteen men.

defs.def_en: Something that is a by-product of an event or situation happens as a result of it, although it is usually not expected or planned.

In grammar, a statement in the third person is a statement about another person or thing, and not directly about yourself or about the person you are talking to. The subject of a statement like this is 'he', 'she', 'it', or a name or noun.

defs.def_cn: 短程旅行(尤指去陌生地方)

ext.ext_cn: 我们计划了几次从这里出发徒步去乡间的短途旅行。
ext.ext_en: From here we plan several sorties into the countryside on foot.

ext.ext_cn: 去古董店小逛
ext.ext_en: ...little sorties into antique shops.

defs.def_en: A sortie is a brief trip away from your home base, especially a trip to an unfamiliar place.

ext.ext_cn: 他的士兵袭击了瓜扎坦，擒获了一名俘虏。
ext.ext_en: His men made a sortie to Guazatan and took a prisoner...

ext.ext_cn: 他们一天出动了 2,700 架次飞机，而且没有损失一架。
ext.ext_en: They flew 2,700 sorties in a day and didn't lose a single plane.

defs.def_en: If a military force makes a sortie, it leaves its own position and goes briefly into enemy territory to make an attack.

ext.ext_cn: 股票市场的丑闻迟迟没有消散，这主要是因为人们仍未就如何应对它达成共识。
ext.ext_en: The stock-market scandal is refusing to go away, mainly because there's still no consensus over how it should be dealt with...

ext.ext_cn: 这些鸟主要以花蜜为食。
ext.ext_en: The birds live mainly on nectar.

defs.def_en: You use mainly when mentioning the main reason or thing involved in something.

ext.ext_cn: 观众中有一半是非洲人，其中大多数来自塞内加尔或马里。
ext.ext_en: The African half of the audience was mainly from Senegal or Mali...

ext.ext_cn: 宽敞的主卧室以蓝色为主色调。
ext.ext_en: The spacious main bedroom is mainly blue.

defs.def_en: You use mainly when you are referring to a group and stating something that is true of most of it.

defs.def_cn: （欧洲历史上的）中世纪(指公元476年罗马帝国灭亡至公元1500年左右这段时期，尤指这段时期的后半部分)
defs.def_en: In European history, the Middle Ages was the period between the end of the Roman Empire in 476 AD and about 1500 AD, especially the later part of this period.
Flapjacks are thick biscuits made from oats, butter, and syrup.
Flapjacks are thin, flat, circular pieces of cooked batter made of milk, flour, and eggs. Flapjacks are usually rolled up or folded and eaten hot with a sweet or savoury filling.

ext.ext_cn: 天马行空地幻想了一番之后，等待他的是平淡无奇的现实世界。
ext.ext_en: Enough of fantasy, the workaday world awaited him.

defs.def_en: Workaday means ordinary and not especially interesting or unusual.

defs.def_cn: (新闻用语中通常作为总称)郊区

ext.ext_cn: 夏日的清晨，郊区绿茵环绕阳光明媚的景象
ext.ext_en: ...images of bright summer mornings in leafy suburbia.

defs.def_en: Journalists often use suburbia to refer to the suburbs of cities and large towns considered as a whole.

defs.def_cn: 失去权力(或影响力)的人

ext.ext_cn: 作为一位政治领袖，他已威风不再。
ext.ext_en: As a political leader he was something of a spent force.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone who used to be powerful as a spent force, you mean that they no longer have any power or influence.
Snow peas are a type of pea whose pods are eaten as well as the peas inside them.

ext.ext_cn: 普里斯特利在科学上的理性世界观延伸到了宗教思想上。
ext.ext_en: Priestley's rational outlook in science carried over to religion...

ext.ext_cn: 泉眼和水井都进行装饰,这个习俗在欧洲一直延续到基督教时代。
ext.ext_en: Springs and wells were decorated, a custom which was carried over into Christian times in Europe.

defs.def_en: If something carries over or is carried over from one situation to another, it continues to exist or apply in the new situation.

defs.def_cn: 垂直的；挺直的；直挺挺的

ext.ext_cn: 海伦笔直地坐在椅子上。
ext.ext_en: Helen sat upright in her chair...

ext.ext_cn: 那些尽力保持腰背挺直的人
ext.ext_en: ...those who had managed to remain upright...

defs.def_en: If you are sitting or standing upright, you are sitting or standing with your back straight, rather than bending or lying down.

defs.def_cn: （吸尘器、冰箱等）竖式的，立式的

ext.ext_cn: 最新款、最先进的立式吸尘器
ext.ext_en: ...the latest state-of-the-art upright vacuum cleaners.

defs.def_en: An upright vacuum cleaner or freezer is tall rather than wide.

ext.ext_cn: 他正坐在床前一张直背椅上看书。
ext.ext_en: He was sitting on an upright chair beside his bed, reading.

defs.def_en: An upright chair has a straight back and no arms.

ext.ext_cn: 四柱床的立柱
ext.ext_en: ...the uprights of a four-poster bed.

defs.def_en: You can refer to vertical posts or the vertical parts of an object as uprights .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一个非常正直可靠的人
ext.ext_en: ...a very upright, trustworthy man.

defs.def_en: You can describe people as upright when they are careful to follow acceptable rules of behaviour and behave in a moral way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 女孩眯起眼睛看照片。她好像近视。

ext.ext_en: ...the continuing support of Glasgow District Council.

ext.ext_cn: 表现派艺术展览会
ext.ext_en: ...an exhibition of expressionist art.

ext.ext_cn: 该地区自然历史的展览会
ext.ext_en: ...an exhibition on the natural history of the area.

defs.def_en: An exhibition is a public event at which pictures, sculptures, or other objects of interest are displayed, for example at a museum or art gallery.

ext.ext_cn: 他向崇拜者展示了他的力量和速度，表现得颇有冠军风范。
ext.ext_en: He responded in champion's style by treating the fans to an exhibition of power and speed.

defs.def_en: An exhibition of a particular skilful activity is a display or example of it that people notice or admire.

defs.def_cn: 降低速度;减速行驶（或动转）

ext.ext_cn: 列车正在减速的感觉
ext.ext_en: ...the sensation of the train decelerating.

defs.def_en: When a vehicle or machine decelerates or when someone in a vehicle decelerates, the speed of the vehicle or machine is reduced.

defs.def_cn: (通货膨胀、经济增长等的速度)减缓，放慢

ext.ext_cn: 过去的两年里通货膨胀已经明显放缓。
ext.ext_en: Inflation has decelerated remarkably over the past two years.

defs.def_en: When the rate of something such as inflation or economic growth decelerates, it slows down.

ext.ext_cn: 他的战友们之间的同志情谊
ext.ext_en: ...the comradeship of his fellow soldiers.

defs.def_en: Comradeship is friendship between a number of people who are doing the same work or who share the same difficulties or dangers.

ext.ext_cn: 可以预设各种程序的电脑定时器
ext.ext_en: ...a computerised timer that can be preset to a variety of programs...

ext.ext_cn: 在预先设置好的烤箱中烤蛋糕
ext.ext_en: Bake the cake in a preset oven.

defs.def_en: If a piece of equipment is preset, its controls have been set in advance of the time you want it to work.
A moggy is a cat.

defs.def_cn: 枝节问题;无关紧要的事

ext.ext_cn: 他为什么要在这些无关紧要的事上浪费她的时间呢？
ext.ext_en: Why was he wasting her time with these irrelevancies?

defs.def_en: If you describe something as an irrelevancy, you have a low opinion of it because it is not important in a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 他整晚都在放屁。
ext.ext_en: He'd been farting all night.

ext.ext_cn: 响屁
ext.ext_en: ...a loud fart.

defs.def_en: If someone farts, air is forced out of their body through their anus.
If someone describes another person as an old fart, they are showing that they think the person is boring and that they do not respect the person.

ext.ext_cn: 该国得不到任何外国贷款或经济援助。
ext.ext_en: The country has no access to foreign loans or financial aid...

ext.ext_en: The president wants to make it easier for small businesses to get bank loans.

defs.def_en: See also:bridging loan;soft loan;A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

ext.ext_cn: 我需要借辆自行车用几个星期。
ext.ext_en: I am in need of a loan of a bike for a few weeks...

ext.ext_cn: 他愿意借出在费拉角的小别墅。
ext.ext_en: He had offered the loan of his small villa at Cap Ferrat.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you a loan of something, you borrow it from them.

ext.ext_cn: 他善解人意地提出愿意把展览需要的植物通通借给我们。
ext.ext_en: He had kindly offered to loan us all the plants required for the exhibit...

ext.ext_cn: 皇家游艇协会的人找过我们，问我们能不能把船借给他们。
ext.ext_en: We were approached by the Royal Yachting Association to see if we would loan our boat to them.

defs.def_en: If you loan something to someone, you lend it to them.

ext.ext_cn: 从国家美术馆借出的印象派画作
ext.ext_en: ...impressionist paintings on loan from the National Gallery...

ext.ext_cn: 其中很多在博物馆展出，但也有一些借给了其他博物馆。
ext.ext_en: Many of these are on display in the Museum, but some have been sent out on loan to other museums.

defs.def_en: If something is on loan, it has been borrowed.

ext.ext_cn: 从南安普敦转借来的戴维·斯皮迪为伯明翰进了他的第一球。
ext.ext_en: David Speedie, on loan from Southampton, scored his first goal for Birmingham...

ext.ext_cn: 她是从中央情报局借调给我们的。
ext.ext_en: She's on loan to us from the CIA.

defs.def_en: If a person is on loan from one organization to another, they are temporarily working for the second organization while still employed by the first.
Large wild animals such as lions and elephants that are hunted for sport are often referred to as big game .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沉思的;默想的;认真思考的

ext.ext_cn: 南希沉思了一会儿，突然开口说话了。
ext.ext_en: Nancy, who had been thoughtful for some time, suddenly spoke...

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎在静静思考着什么。
ext.ext_en: He was looking very thoughtful...

defs.def_en: If you are thoughtful, you are quiet and serious because you are thinking about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 体贴入微的;考虑周到的

ext.ext_cn: 体贴入微、关心他人的男人
ext.ext_en: ...a thoughtful and caring man...

ext.ext_cn: 谢谢你，你想的真周到。
ext.ext_en: Thank you. That's very thoughtful of you...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as thoughtful, you approve of them because they remember what other people want, need, or feel, and try not to upset them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (书籍、电影、讲话等)严肃的，思想性强的

ext.ext_cn: 一本兼具思想性和学术性的书
ext.ext_en: ...a thoughtful and scholarly book.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a book, film, or speech as thoughtful, you mean that it is serious and well thought out.
A knees-up is a party or celebration.
A prayer book is a book which contains the prayers which are used in church or at home.

ext.ext_cn: 她失眠了。
ext.ext_en: Sleep eluded her...

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩在62岁时获得了多年来未能得到的名望和地位。
ext.ext_en: At 62, Brian found the celebrity and status that had eluded him for so long.

defs.def_en: If something that you want eludes you, you fail to obtain it.

ext.ext_cn: 他躲过了警方抓捕达13年。
ext.ext_en: He eluded the police for 13 years.

defs.def_en: If you elude someone or something, you avoid them or escape from them.

defs.def_cn: 不为…所明白;不为…所记得

ext.ext_cn: 他找不到合适的字眼。
ext.ext_en: The appropriate word eluded him.

defs.def_en: If a fact or idea eludes you, you do not succeed in understanding it, realizing it, or remembering it.

ext.ext_cn: 暑假
ext.ext_en: ...the summer vac.

defs.def_en: A vac is a period of the year when universities and colleges are officially closed. Vac is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'vacation'.

ext.ext_cn: 我们发现这种真空吸尘器很容易推着走。
ext.ext_en: We found the vac easy to push.

defs.def_en: A vac is an electric machine which sucks up dust and dirt from carpets. Vac is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'vacuum cleaner'.

ext.ext_cn: 所有的针线活一直都是她母亲来做。
ext.ext_en: Her mother had always done all the sewing.

defs.def_en: Sewing is the activity of making or mending clothes or other things using a needle and thread.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都把自己的针线活拿出来，坐到了火堆前。
ext.ext_en: We all got out our own sewing and sat in front of the log fire.

defs.def_en: Sewing is clothes or other things that are being sewn.

defs.def_cn: 虚有其表的人;华而不实之物
