ext.ext_en: Back then, women on TV were mostly seen as eye candy...

ext.ext_cn: 动画不再仅仅吸引小孩子和动漫迷的眼球，而成了主流娱乐方式。
ext.ext_en: Animation has stopped being eye-candy for kids and geeks and become mainstream entertainment.

defs.def_en: Eye candy is used to refer to people or things that are attractive to look at but are not interesting in other ways.

ext.ext_cn: 长着金色卷发的小女孩
ext.ext_en: ...the little girl with blonde curls...

ext.ext_cn: 他的额头上垂着一绺散开的黑色卷发。
ext.ext_en: A curl of black hair fell loosely across his forehead.

defs.def_en: If you have curls, your hair is in the form of tight curves and spirals.

ext.ext_cn: 让卷发自然变干，才能使头发卷最多，最有光泽。
ext.ext_en: Dry curly hair naturally for maximum curl and shine.

defs.def_en: If your hair has curl, it is full of curls.

ext.ext_cn: 她头发不易出卷。
ext.ext_en: She has hair that refuses to curl...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽亚为出席那次活动烫了头发。
ext.ext_en: Maria had curled her hair for the event...

defs.def_en: If your hair curls or if you curl it, it is full of curls.

ext.ext_cn: 生锈的炉子里冒出一缕青烟。
ext.ext_en: A thin curl of smoke rose from a rusty stove.

ext.ext_cn: 螺旋状的柠檬皮
ext.ext_en: ...curls of lemon peel.

defs.def_en: A curl of something is a piece or quantity of it that is curved or spiral in shape.

ext.ext_cn: 他轻轻地握住她的手腕。
ext.ext_en: His fingers curled gently round her wrist...

ext.ext_cn: 抬起一只脚，弯曲脚趾，使脚尖朝下。
ext.ext_en: Raise one foot, curl the toes and point the foot downwards...

defs.def_en: If your toes, fingers, or other parts of your body curl, or if you curl them, they form a curved or round shape.

defs.def_cn: (使)呈螺旋(或卷曲)状移动;(使)旋绕

ext.ext_cn: 烟从烟囱里袅袅升起。
ext.ext_en: Smoke was curling up the chimney...

ext.ext_cn: 他一脚弧线球射门成功。
ext.ext_en: He curled the ball into the net.

defs.def_en: If something curls somewhere, or if you curl it there, it moves there in a spiral or  curve.

ext.ext_cn: 他想蜷缩成小小的一团。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to curl into a tiny ball...

ext.ext_cn: 那只小猫在沙发垫子上蜷缩成了一团。
ext.ext_en: The kitten was curled on a cushion on the sofa.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal curls into a ball, they move into a position in which their body makes a rounded shape.

ext.ext_cn: 玫瑰的叶子因为闹虫害而卷边了。
ext.ext_en: The rose leaves have curled because of an attack by grubs.

ext.ext_cn: 油地毡卷角了。
ext.ext_en: The corners of  the lino were curling up.

defs.def_en: When a leaf, a piece of paper, or another flat object curls, its edges bend towards the centre.

ext.ext_cn: 他撇嘴表示怀疑。
ext.ext_en: He curled his upper lip in a show of scepticism...

ext.ext_cn: 每次丈夫写日记时，她都会不满地撇撇那张刻薄的小嘴。
ext.ext_en: She had a small, mean mouth that curled disapprovingly each time her husband wrote something in his diary.

defs.def_en: If you curl your lip, you raise your upper lip slightly at one side, as a way of showing anger or contempt.
A snowplough is a vehicle which is used to push snow off roads or railway lines.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不具代表性的；不典型的

ext.ext_cn: 总统谴责示威者，说他们并不能代表罗马尼亚人民。
ext.ext_en: The President denounced the demonstrators as unrepresentative of the Romanian people.

defs.def_en: If you describe a group of people as unrepresentative, you mean that their views are not typical of the community or society to which they belong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （对战斗等）起劲的，狂热的，迫切的

ext.ext_cn: 他提醒某些更为狂热的将军要考虑入侵带来的后果。
ext.ext_en: He has warned some of his more gung ho generals about the consequences of an invasion...

ext.ext_cn: 共和党的参议员对减税并不太热衷。
ext.ext_en: Senate Republicans are less gung-ho about tax cuts.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is gung ho, you mean that they are very enthusiastic or eager to do something, for example to fight in a battle.

ext.ext_cn: 有限元素集
ext.ext_en: ...a finite set of elements...

ext.ext_cn: 只有有限的几种情况可能会发生。
ext.ext_en: Only a finite number of situations can arise...

defs.def_en: Something that is finite has a definite fixed size or extent.
A finite clause is a clause based on a verb group which indicates tense, such as 'went', 'is waiting', or 'will be found', rather than on an infinitive or a participle.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 善于表达的;口齿伶俐的

ext.ext_cn: 她是一个口才很好的年轻女子。
ext.ext_en: She is an articulate young woman...

ext.ext_cn: 孩子无法对她所目睹的事情作出清楚的描述。
ext.ext_en: The child was unable to offer an articulate description of what she had witnessed.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as articulate, you mean that they are able to express their thoughts and ideas easily and well.

defs.def_cn: 清楚地表达（思想或感情）

ext.ext_cn: 总统因未能清晰表述对外交事务的整体构想而受到指责。
ext.ext_en: The president has been accused of failing to articulate an overall vision in foreign affairs.

defs.def_en: When you articulate your ideas or feelings, you express them clearly in words.

ext.ext_cn: 他小心而清晰地发出每个音节。
ext.ext_en: He articulated each syllable carefully.

defs.def_en: If you articulate something, you say it very clearly, so that each word or syllable can be heard.

ext.ext_cn: 13 世纪的堡垒
ext.ext_en: ...a 13th-century fortress.

defs.def_en: A fortress is a castle or other large strong building, or a well-protected place, which is intended to be difficult for enemies to enter.

defs.def_cn: (为得到某机会而)排队，排队等候

ext.ext_cn: 想为我效力的人可是排着长队呢！
ext.ext_en: People are queueing up to work for me!...

ext.ext_cn: 越来越多的国家争相成为其中的一员。
ext.ext_en: There are a growing number of countries queueing up for membership.

defs.def_en: If you say that people are queuing up to do or have something, you mean that a lot of them want the opportunity to do it or have it.

ext.ext_cn: 高高的白色瓷瓶上绘满了百合花。
ext.ext_en: There were lilies everywhere in tall white porcelain vases.

defs.def_en: Porcelain is a hard, shiny substance made by heating clay. It is used to make delicate cups, plates, and ornaments.

ext.ext_cn: 17和18世纪装饰用的瓷器
ext.ext_en: ...decorative 17th and 18th century porcelains.

ext.ext_cn: 一批价值连城的英国瓷器藏品
ext.ext_en: ...a priceless collection of English porcelain.

defs.def_en: A porcelain is an ornament that is made of porcelain. You can refer to a number of such ornaments as porcelain .
Carpet bombing is heavy bombing from aircraft, with the intention of hitting as many places as possible in a particular area.

ext.ext_cn: 尼基因脑震荡被火速送往医院。
ext.ext_en: Nicky was rushed to hospital with concussion...

ext.ext_cn: 她从马上摔下来，造成了脑震荡。
ext.ext_en: She fell off a horse and suffered a concussion.

defs.def_en: If you suffer concussion after a blow to your head, you lose consciousness or feel sick or confused.

defs.def_cn: 混乱的;乱七八糟的;颠三倒四的

ext.ext_cn: 在我的一生中世界已经变得一团糟。
ext.ext_en: The world has turned topsy-turvy in my lifetime.

ext.ext_cn: 长满苔藓、东倒西歪的墓碑
ext.ext_en: …the moss-covered, topsy-turvy gravestones.

defs.def_en: Something that is topsy-turvy is in a confused or disorganized state.

ext.ext_cn: 历史学家对日记选篇进行加注、核查以及阐释。
ext.ext_en: Historians annotate, check and interpret the diary selections.

ext.ext_cn: 附有注释的参考书目
ext.ext_en: ...an annotated bibliography.

defs.def_en: If you annotate written work or a diagram, you add notes to it, especially in order to explain it.

ext.ext_cn: 两艘船都还比较新。
ext.ext_en: Both ships are fairly new...

ext.ext_cn: 我们做得还过得去，但也仅仅是过得去而已。
ext.ext_en: We did fairly well but only fairly well.

defs.def_en: Fairly means to quite a large degree. For example, if you say that something is fairly old, you mean that it is old but not very old.

defs.def_cn: (用在形容词和副词前，代替very,表示强调，但比 very 语气弱)有些，有点，还算

ext.ext_cn: 你在学校一直还算聪明吧？
ext.ext_en: Were you always fairly bright at school?...

ext.ext_cn: 对这事你还得专心一点。
ext.ext_en: You've got to be fairly single-minded about it...

defs.def_en: You use fairly instead of  'very' to add emphasis to an adjective or adverb without making it sound too forceful.

defs.def_cn: (表示强调)在很大程度上，简直

ext.ext_cn: 他简直是飞过了房间。
ext.ext_en: He fairly flew across the room...

ext.ext_cn: 对他来说，这个地方充满了人情味。
ext.ext_en: For him, the place is fairly boiling with humanity...

defs.def_en: Fairly is used to emphasize that something happens to a very great degree or extent.

ext.ext_cn: 毋庸置疑，既然约翰爵士的薪水是与业绩挂钩的，他的每一分钱都是理所应得的。
ext.ext_en: It can no doubt be fairly argued that Sir John, whose pay is linked to performance, is entitled to every penny...

ext.ext_cn: 读完这本书，我差不多可以说是专家了。
ext.ext_en: After I had read the book I could fairly claim to be an expert.

defs.def_en: You use fairly to suggest that a statement is probably or possibly true, and therefore deserves to be accepted or considered.

ext.ext_cn: 地方政务委员会应当行使权力以保证人们严格遵守法律。
ext.ext_en: Local councils should use their powers to ensure strict observance of laws.

defs.def_en: The observance of something such as a law or custom is the practice of obeying or following it.

defs.def_cn: (政府或其他组织的)计划，方案，安排

ext.ext_cn: 有助于减少失业的方案
ext.ext_en: ...schemes to help combat unemployment.

ext.ext_cn: 私人养老金计划
ext.ext_en: ...a private pension scheme...

defs.def_en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement involving many people which is made by a government or other organization.

ext.ext_cn: 能够让我们撑过这夏天的快速赚钱之道
ext.ext_en: ...a quick money-making scheme to get us through the summer...

ext.ext_cn: 他们首先得想个法子把财宝取出来。
ext.ext_en: They would first have to work out some scheme for getting the treasure out...

defs.def_en: A scheme is someone's plan for achieving something.

ext.ext_cn: 人人时刻都在谋划着。
ext.ext_en: Everyone's always scheming and plotting...

ext.ext_cn: 新娘家人正密谋阻止婚礼。
ext.ext_en: The bride's family were scheming to prevent a wedding...

defs.def_en: If you say that people are scheming, you mean that they are making secret plans in order to gain something for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 他不太清楚在自己的人生安排中应把女人摆在什么位置。
ext.ext_en: He did not quite know how to place women in his scheme of things.

defs.def_en: Someone's scheme of things is the way in which they think that things in their life should be organized.

ext.ext_cn: 我们认识到在大千世界中我们极其渺小。
ext.ext_en: We realize that we are infinitely small within the scheme of things.

defs.def_en: When people talk about the scheme of things or the grand scheme of things , they are referring to the way that everything in the world seems to be organized.

defs.def_cn: （供烘烤一人份食物用的）小烤盘
defs.def_en: A ramekin or a ramekin dish is a small dish in which food for one person can be baked in the oven.

ext.ext_cn: 他们有3个儿子，1个女儿。
ext.ext_en: They had three sons and one daughter.
...one thousand years ago...

defs.def_en: One is the number 1.

ext.ext_cn: 他们弄僵了同那个唯一懂行的人之间的关系。
ext.ext_en: They had alienated the one man who knew the business...

ext.ext_cn: 他唯一的遗憾是从未学过一门外语。
ext.ext_en: His one regret is that he has never learned a language.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is the one person or thing of a particular kind, you are emphasizing that they are the only person or thing of that kind.

defs.def_cn: （用于代替a以强调之后的名词）

ext.ext_cn: 有一件事我很想知道——蒂姆到底哪一点让你对他如此倾心？
ext.ext_en: There is one thing I would like to know—What is it about Tim that you find so irresistible?...

ext.ext_cn: 让我讨厌的一个人是拉斯。
ext.ext_en: One person I hate is Russ.

defs.def_en: One can be used instead of 'a' to emphasize the following noun.

defs.def_cn: （用于代替a以强调之后的形容词或短语）

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们哪一天结婚的话，一定会有一个棒极了的婚礼。
ext.ext_en: If we ever get married we'll have one terrific wedding...

ext.ext_cn: 这就像是一场盛大的街头狂欢节。
ext.ext_en: It's like one enormous street carnival here.

defs.def_en: You can use one instead of 'a' to emphasize the following adjective or expression.

defs.def_cn: （用于人名前，表示未曾相识或听闻的）某一个

ext.ext_cn: 第五位好像是一个名叫约翰·凯恩克罗斯的人。
ext.ext_en: It seems that the fifth man is one John Cairncross.

defs.def_en: You can use one in front of someone's name to indicate that you have not met them or heard of them before.

defs.def_cn: （表示与其他的作比较）这一个

ext.ext_cn: 各家商店价格不同。
ext.ext_en: Prices vary from one shop to another...

ext.ext_cn: 这条路依傍海岸绵延数百英里，一边是南中国海，另一边则是丛林。
ext.ext_en: The road hugs the coast for hundreds of miles, the South China Sea on one side, jungle on the other.

defs.def_en: You can use one to refer to the first of two or more things that you are comparing.

defs.def_cn: （用于代替名词，指代某类明确的人或事物）

ext.ext_cn: 他们正打算卖掉房子，然后搬到一个小一点的住处。
ext.ext_en: They are selling their house to move to a smaller one...

ext.ext_cn: 我们对每架飞机都会进行测试，以确保其飞行性能良好。
ext.ext_en: We test each one to see that it flies well.

defs.def_en: You can use one or ones instead of a noun when it is clear what type of thing or person you are referring to and you are describing them or giving more information about them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们是唯一的知情者。
ext.ext_en: We are the only ones who know.

defs.def_en: You use ones to refer to people in general.

defs.def_cn: （用于代替名词词组，表示刚提到过的事物）

ext.ext_cn: 他的回答充满了愤怒和懊丧。
ext.ext_en: His response is one of anger and frustration...

ext.ext_cn: 土地改革是左右匈牙利议会选举的主要问题。
ext.ext_en: The issue of land reform was one that dominated Hungary's parliamentary elections.

defs.def_en: You can use one instead of a noun group when you have just mentioned something and you want to describe it or give more information about it.

defs.def_cn: （特指一群人或事物中的）一人，一个

ext.ext_cn: “光有一个大学学位还不够，”一位优等生说。
ext.ext_en: 'A college degree isn't enough', said one honors student.

ext.ext_cn: 他们中的一些人无法进食，其中一个甚至连水都喝不了。
ext.ext_en: Some of them couldn't eat a thing. One couldn't even drink.

defs.def_en: You can use one when you have been talking or writing about a group of people or things and you want to say something about a particular member of the group.

ext.ext_cn: 斯巴鲁是日本最小的汽车制造商之一。
ext.ext_en: Subaru is one of the smallest Japanese car makers.

defs.def_en: You use one in expressions such as 'one of the biggest airports' or 'one of the most experienced players' to indicate that something or someone is bigger or more experienced than most other things or people of the same kind.

ext.ext_cn: 哪天晚上一起吃饭怎么样？就咱俩。
ext.ext_en: How would you like to have dinner one night, just you and me?...

ext.ext_cn: 后来一天晚上哈里打电话来，叫我尽快到他们的公寓去。
ext.ext_en: Then one evening Harry phoned, asking me to come to their flat as soon as possible.

defs.def_en: You can use one when referring to a time in the past or in the future. For example, if you say that you did something one day, you mean that you did it on a day in the past.  one day→see: day;

defs.def_cn: （指代问题、笑话、评论、讨论的主题等）一个

ext.ext_cn: 这是个难以回答的问题。
ext.ext_en: This is a tricky one to answer...

ext.ext_cn: 你听过那个关于爱尔兰人、英国人和美国人的笑话吗？
ext.ext_en: Have you heard the one about the Irishman, the Englishman and the American?...

defs.def_en: You can use one to refer to a question, joke, remark, or subject of discussion.

ext.ext_cn: 委员会的其他成员陆续走了进来，想要趁关门前喝上一杯。
ext.ext_en: Other members of the committee drifted in for a quick one before closing time.

defs.def_en: You can use one to refer to an alcoholic drink.

defs.def_cn: （泛指包括自己的人，可作句子的主语或宾语）一个人，任何人

ext.ext_cn: 如果把目光放长远些，就会发现很多积极的事情正在发生。
ext.ext_en: If one looks at the longer run, a lot of positive things are happening...

ext.ext_cn: 从那里可以去什么地方？
ext.ext_en: Where does one go from there?...

defs.def_en: You use one to make statements about people in general which also apply to themselves. One can be used as the subject or object of a sentence.

ext.ext_cn: 40,000人全体起立。
ext.ext_en: The 40,000 crowd rose as one.

defs.def_en: If a group of people does something as one, all the people do the same thing at the same time or in the same way.

ext.ext_cn: 我不是个热衷于谈论政治的人。
ext.ext_en: I'm not one for political discussions...

ext.ext_cn: 她是个情场高手。
ext.ext_en: She was a real one for flirting with the boys.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is one for or is a one for something, you mean that they like or approve of it or enjoy doing it.

defs.def_cn: （强调某人与众不同的反应或行为方式）举个例说

ext.ext_cn: 就我而言，我并不希望你得到那份工作。
ext.ext_en: I, for one, hope you don't get the job.

defs.def_en: You can use for one to emphasize that a particular person is definitely reacting or behaving in a particular way, even if other people are not.

ext.ext_cn: 筹钱的办法有很多。
ext.ext_en: There are a hundred and one ways in which you can raise money.

defs.def_en: You can use expressions such as a hundred and one ,a thousand and one, and a million and one to emphasize that you are talking about a large number of things or people.

defs.def_cn: 集（若干部分或功能）为一体

ext.ext_cn: 集爱情和冒险于一体的故事
ext.ext_en: ...a love story and an adventure all in one...

ext.ext_cn: 这种护肤霜兼具滋润和修复功能。
ext.ext_en: This cream moisturises and repairs in one.

defs.def_en: You can use in one to indicate that something is a single unit, but is made up of several different parts or has several different functions.

defs.def_cn: 三三两两地；零零落落地

ext.ext_cn: 他们没了兴趣，开始三三两两地走开了。
ext.ext_en: They lose interest and start drifting away in ones and twos.

defs.def_en: You can use in ones and twos to indicate that people do things or something happens gradually and in small groups.

defs.def_cn: 一个接一个地；接连地；陆续地

ext.ext_cn: 我的3把吉他陆续都坏了。
ext.ext_en: My three guitars broke one after the other...

ext.ext_cn: 人们一个接一个地讲述获得医疗保健服务对于他们是何其困难。
ext.ext_en: One after another, people described how hard it is for them to get medical care.

defs.def_en: You use one after the other or one after another to say that actions or events happen with very little time between them.

defs.def_cn: （用于节目中介绍演员、歌手或其他名人）绝无仅有的，独一无二的

ext.ext_cn: 史上最伟大的摇滚乐手之一，举世无双的蒂娜·特纳
ext.ext_en: ...one of the greatest ever rock performers, the one and only Tina Turner.

defs.def_en: The one and only can be used in front of the name of an actor, singer, or other famous person when they are being introduced on a show.

ext.ext_cn: 我们挨个儿走进房间。
ext.ext_en: We went into the room one by one...

ext.ext_cn: 房子一幢接一幢地燃起熊熊大火。
ext.ext_en: One by one the houses burst into flames.

defs.def_en: You can use one by one to indicate that people do things or that things happen in sequence, not all at the same time.

defs.def_cn: （一组事物或人之中的）或者这个或者那个，有一个

ext.ext_cn: 这两个女人当中有一个人错了。
ext.ext_en: One or other of the two women was wrong.

defs.def_en: You use one or other to refer to one or more things or people in a group, when it does not matter which particular one or ones are thought of or chosen.

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以作一两处改动。
ext.ext_en: We may make one or two changes...

ext.ext_cn: 我还卖了几本给一位美国出版商。
ext.ext_en: I've also sold one or two to an American publisher...

defs.def_en: One or two means a few.

ext.ext_cn: 我可不是个随便浪费时间在任何人身上的人。
ext.ext_en: I'm not one to waste time on just anyone.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is not one to do something, you think that it is very unlikely that they would do it because it is not their normal behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 具有竞争意识、将此视作占据上风的契机的那种人
ext.ext_en: ...the competitive kind who will see this as the opportunity to be one up on you.

defs.def_en: If you try to get one up on someone, you try to gain an advantage over them.
A cesspool is the same as a cesspit .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那些认为节育与堕胎是不道德行为的人
ext.ext_en: ...those who think that birth control and abortion are immoral.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or their behaviour as immoral, you believe that their behaviour is morally wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 地区理事会将于今天投票决定是否开始实施这一计划。
ext.ext_en: The district board will vote today on whether to go ahead with the plan.

defs.def_en: If someone goes ahead with something, they begin to do it or make it, especially after planning, promising, or asking permission to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这项活动将按计划于明年夏天在谢菲尔德举行。
ext.ext_en: The event will go ahead as planned in Sheffield next summer.

defs.def_en: If a process or an organized event goes ahead, it takes place or is carried out.

ext.ext_cn: 沿着纸孔撕下表格，寄给销售部。
ext.ext_en: Tear off the form along the perforations and send it to Sales...

ext.ext_cn: 迎着光看时，就会发现椭圆形小叶子上有微小的孔眼。
ext.ext_en: When held to the light the small oblong leaves are seen to possess tiny perforations.

defs.def_en: Perforations are small holes that are made  in something, especially in paper.
Power of attorney is a legal document which allows you to appoint someone, for example a lawyer, to act on your behalf in specified matters.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 医生们说话简短生硬，十分忙碌。
ext.ext_en: The doctors are brusque and busy ...

ext.ext_cn: 他们从他那里得到的是一个粗鲁无礼的答复，他一贯都是那样的。
ext.ext_en: They received a characteristically brusque reply from him.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as brusque, you mean that they deal with things, or say things, quickly and shortly, so that they seem to be rude.

ext.ext_cn: 托尼·柯蒂斯在其首部电影里，扮演了一个食品杂货店店员。
ext.ext_en: In the first movie Tony Curtis ever made he played a grocery clerk.

ext.ext_cn: 恐怖电影
ext.ext_en: ...a horror movie.

defs.def_en: A movie is a film.

ext.ext_cn: 他带她去看电影。
ext.ext_en: He took her to the movies.

defs.def_en: You can talk about the movies when you are talking about seeing a movie in a movie theater.
A tremor is a small earthquake.

ext.ext_cn: 将会裁员 160 人的消息在该团体中掀起了一阵骚动。
ext.ext_en: News of 160 redundancies had sent tremors through the community...

ext.ext_cn: 葡萄酒生产过剩及由此造成的市价低迷引起了经济波动。
ext.ext_en: Overproduction and consequent low market prices for wine caused economic tremors.

defs.def_en: If an event causes a tremor in a group or organization, it threatens to make the group or organization less strong or stable.

defs.def_cn: (身体或声音不由自主的)震颤，颤抖

ext.ext_cn: 他感到胳膊不由自主地颤动。
ext.ext_en: He felt a tremor in his arms...

ext.ext_cn: 他感到一阵恐惧。
ext.ext_en: He felt a tremor of apprehension…

defs.def_en: A tremor is a shaking of your body or voice that you cannot control.

defs.def_cn: （计算机系统）硬接线的，硬连线的
defs.def_en: A hard-wired part of a computer forms part of its hardware.

defs.def_cn: （能力、方法、活动类型）基本的，固有的，无法改变的

ext.ext_cn: 其他人认为，我们的大脑对什么东西是“悦耳的”在某种程度上有其内在的标准。
ext.ext_en: Others think that the rules for what is 'musical' are hard-wired in our brains to some degree.

defs.def_en: If an ability, approach, or type of activity is hard-wired into the brain, it is a basic one and cannot be changed.

defs.def_cn: 同住一幢房子的人，室友（不包括家人或恋人）
defs.def_en: Your housemate is someone who shares a house with you. You do not use 'housemate' to refer to members of your family or your boyfriend or girlfriend.

ext.ext_cn: 在丢掉盒子前先看一下制造商的使用说明。
ext.ext_en: Read the manufacturer's guidelines before discarding the box.

ext.ext_cn: 丢弃的烟头
ext.ext_en: ...discarded cigarette butts.

defs.def_en: If you discard something, you get rid of it because you no longer want it or need it.

ext.ext_cn: 一封呼吁立法保护妇女权益的信
ext.ext_en: ...a letter calling for legislation to protect women's rights.

defs.def_en: Legislation consists of a law or laws passed by a government.

ext.ext_cn: 他的寡妻孤寂地度过了余生。
ext.ext_en: His widow became a virtual recluse for the remainder of her life.

defs.def_en: A recluse is a person who lives alone and deliberately avoids other people.

defs.def_cn: 对…实行再教育;重新教育

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在不得不尽快对公众进行再教育，因为他们一直都认为这是理所当然的。
ext.ext_en: We are having to re-educate the public very quickly about something they have always taken for granted.

defs.def_en: If an organization such as a government tries to re-educate a group of people, they try to make them adopt new attitudes, beliefs, or types of behaviour.

defs.def_cn: （会议或旅行等期间提供的）饮料，点心，茶点
defs.def_en: Refreshments are drinks and small amounts of food that are provided, for example, during a meeting or a journey.

ext.ext_cn: 我给你来点吃的怎样？
ext.ext_en: May I offer you some refreshment?

defs.def_en: You can refer to food and drink as refreshment .
Public works are buildings, roads, and other projects that are built by the government or state for the public.
Rummy is a card game in which players try to collect cards of the same value or cards in a sequence in the same suit.

ext.ext_cn: 一群电视台的摄影师和报社摄影记者
ext.ext_en: ...a group of TV cameramen and press photographers.

ext.ext_cn: 对博物学题材有特殊兴趣的业余摄影爱好者
ext.ext_en: ...a keen amateur photographer with a special interest in natural history subjects.

defs.def_en: A photographer is someone who takes photographs as a job or hobby.

ext.ext_cn: 希思罗机场，世界上最繁忙的国际机场
ext.ext_en: ...Heathrow Airport, the busiest international airport in the world.

defs.def_en: An airport is a place where aircraft land and take off, which has buildings and facilities for passengers.

ext.ext_cn: 那些房间里摆满了嗡嗡作响的复印机。
ext.ext_en: The rooms are crammed with humming Xerox machines.

defs.def_en: A Xerox is a machine that can make copies of pieces of paper which have writing or other marks on them.
A Xerox is a copy of something written or printed on a piece of paper, which has been made using a Xerox machine.

ext.ext_cn: 我应该把这张纸给你复印一下就对了。
ext.ext_en: I should have simply Xeroxed this sheet for you.

defs.def_en: If you Xerox a document, you make a copy of it using a Xerox machine.

defs.def_cn: (表示方位的)标记，路标，记号;（起提示作用的）标示物

ext.ext_cn: 他在书里夹了一个书签后便随她出去了。
ext.ext_en: He put a marker in his book and followed her out.

ext.ext_cn: 矗立在沙漠里的一排排饱经风吹日晒的石头路标
ext.ext_en: ...lines of weathered stone markers sticking up from the desert.

defs.def_en: A marker is an object which is used to show the position of something, or is used to help someone remember something.

ext.ext_cn: 维生素C的存在是冷冻食品里存在其他维生素和营养成分的很好说明。
ext.ext_en: Vitamin C is a good marker for the presence of other vitamins and nutrients in frozen food.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as a marker for a particular quality or feature, you mean that it demonstrates the existence or presence of that quality or feature.

defs.def_cn: 记号笔，毡笔(笔头较粗，由毡毛制成，用于绘画和着色)

ext.ext_cn: 用浓黑色的毡笔画出你孩子的轮廓。
ext.ext_en: Draw your child's outline with a heavy black marker.

defs.def_en: A marker or a marker pen is a pen with a thick tip made of felt, which is used for drawing and for colouring things.

ext.ext_cn: 聚苯乙烯茶杯
ext.ext_en: ...polystyrene cups.

defs.def_en: Polystyrene is a very light plastic substance used to make containers or to keep things warm, cool, or protected from damage.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （任务、计划或想法）切实可行的，行得通的

ext.ext_cn: 让她继续做原来的工作在情理上行不通。
ext.ext_en: It is not reasonably practicable to offer her the original job back...

ext.ext_cn: 教师只应该做合情合理而且切实可行的事。
ext.ext_en: Teachers can only be expected to do what is reasonable and practicable.

defs.def_en: If a task, plan, or idea is practicable, people are able to carry it out.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天加利福尼亚发生了里氏6.1级地震。
ext.ext_en: An earthquake measuring 6.1 on the Richter Scale struck California yesterday.

defs.def_en: The Richter scale is a scale which is used for measuring how severe an earthquake is.

defs.def_cn: （在紧急情况下将飞行员弹出舱外的）弹射座椅
defs.def_en: An ejector seat is a special seat which can throw the pilot out of a fast military aircraft in an emergency.

defs.def_cn: 奴役;苦役;完全受人支配

ext.ext_cn: 受奴役的一生
ext.ext_en: ...a life of servitude.

defs.def_en: See also:penal servitude;Servitude is the condition of being a slave or of being completely under the control of someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 该提议被视为一种改善劳资关系的尝试。
ext.ext_en: The offer is seen as an attempt to improve industrial relations...

ext.ext_cn: 新的劳资关系法规限制了工会的权力。
ext.ext_en: The new industrial relations legislation curbed the power of the unions.

defs.def_en: Industrial relations refers to the relationship between employers and employees in industry, and the political decisions and laws that affect it.

ext.ext_cn: 她扭了扭手指。
ext.ext_en: She wiggled her finger...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你挠他的下巴，他的耳朵就会摆动。
ext.ext_en: His ears wiggled if you scratched his chin...

defs.def_en: If you wiggle something or if it wiggles, it moves up and down or from side to side in small quick movements.

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影使用了他的形象,侵犯了他的肖像权。
ext.ext_en: The film exploited his image and infringed his copyright...

ext.ext_cn: 陪审团裁决他没有违反任何规定。
ext.ext_en: The jury ruled that he had infringed no rules.

defs.def_en: If someone infringes a law or a rule, they break it or do something which disobeys it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们劫掠我们,侵犯我们的权利,对我们实施杀戮。
ext.ext_en: They rob us, they infringe our rights, they kill us...

ext.ext_cn: 它开始侵犯我们的人身自由。
ext.ext_en: It's starting to infringe on our personal liberties.

defs.def_en: If something infringes people's rights, it interferes with these rights and does not allow people the freedom they are entitled to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 严峻的；令人不快的；让人沮丧的；令人难以接受的

ext.ext_cn: 他们描绘了犯罪率上升的严峻情形。
ext.ext_en: They painted a grim picture of growing crime...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天又传来更多令人沮丧的经济消息。
ext.ext_en: There was further grim economic news yesterday...

defs.def_en: A  situation or piece of information that is grim is unpleasant, depress ing, and difficult to accept.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （地方）无吸引力的，阴森的，凄凉的

ext.ext_cn: 这座城市最初可能并不吸引人，但是它有一种生机和活力。
ext.ext_en: The city might be grim at first, but there is a vibrancy and excitement.

ext.ext_cn: 矗立在荒凉的城市边缘的一幢幢塔楼
ext.ext_en: ...the tower blocks on the city's  grim edges.

defs.def_en: A place that is grim is unattractive and depressing in appearance.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是个沉默寡言、令人畏惧的女人。
ext.ext_en: She was a grim woman with a turned-down mouth...

ext.ext_cn: 她表情严肃，看上去很不开心。
ext.ext_en: Her expression was grim and unpleasant.

defs.def_en: If a person or their behaviour is grim, they are very serious, usually because they are worried about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 糟糕的；讨厌的；丑陋的；令人沮丧的

ext.ext_cn: 事情一度糟糕透了。
ext.ext_en: Things were pretty grim for a time.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is grim, you think that it is very bad, ugly, or depressing.
