defs.def_cn: 你的(yours 在古时、诗歌或宗教中的用语)

ext.ext_cn: 主啊，我属于您，我已经听见您的声音。
ext.ext_en: I am Thine, O Lord, I have heard Thy voice.

defs.def_en: Thine is an old-fashioned, poetic, or religious word for 'yours' when you are talking to only one person.

defs.def_cn: 自以为无所不知的人；百事通
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a know-all, you are critical of them because they think that they know a lot more than other people.

ext.ext_cn: 评论员们没完没了地拿女选手的容貌打趣。
ext.ext_en: The commentators make endless quips about the female players' appearance.

defs.def_en: A quip is a remark that is intended to be amusing or clever.

ext.ext_cn: “他得减肥啦，”巴拉德俏皮地说。
ext.ext_en: 'He'll have to go on a diet,' Ballard quipped...

ext.ext_cn: 主席风趣地说，他宁可卖掉他的航空公司，也不愿出售他的计算机系统。
ext.ext_en: The chairman quipped that he would rather sell his airline than his computer systems.

defs.def_en: To quip means to say something that is intended to be amusing or clever.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 佩奇精通多种风格的爵士乐。
ext.ext_en: Page is well versed in many styles of jazz.

defs.def_en: If someone is well versed in a particular subject, they know a lot about it.

defs.def_cn: 免除…的过失;解除…的责任

ext.ext_cn: 警方昨天的调查廓清了其在此事件中的任何责任。
ext.ext_en: A police investigation yesterday absolved the police of all blame in the incident.

ext.ext_cn: 宣告士兵们并无任何过失的调查
ext.ext_en: ...the inquiry which absolved the soldiers.

defs.def_en: If a report or investigation absolves someone from blame or responsibility, it formally states that he or she is not guilty or is not to blame.

ext.ext_cn: 学龄前儿童和初学走路的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...preschoolers and toddlers.

defs.def_en: Children who are no longer babies but are not yet old enough to go to school are sometimes referred to as preschoolers .

ext.ext_cn: 米兰队攻入第八粒进球后，观众有序地涌进球场。
ext.ext_en: There was a peaceful pitch invasion after Milan's eighth goal.

defs.def_en: If there is a pitch invasion during or after a football, rugby, or cricket match, fans run on to the pitch.

ext.ext_cn: 蒙古虽然穷，但有大量尚未开采的石油和矿产资源。
ext.ext_en: Mongolia, although poor, has considerable untapped resources of oil and minerals...

ext.ext_cn: 印度的股票市场蕴含着巨大的、公认的、尚未挖掘出来的潜力。
ext.ext_en: There is enormous, acknowledged and untapped potential in the Indian stock markets.

defs.def_en: An untapped supply or source of something has not yet been used.

ext.ext_cn: 很多贫穷国家都在放弃独裁统治。
ext.ext_en: Many poor countries are abandoning autocracy.

defs.def_en: Autocracy is government or control by one person who has complete power.

ext.ext_cn: 她把权力全部交给自己的女婿，他现在对国家实行独裁统治。
ext.ext_en: She ceded all power to her son-in-law who now runs the country as an autocracy.

defs.def_en: An autocracy is a country or organization that is ruled by one person who has complete power.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 阴冷刺骨的北风
ext.ext_en: ...a raw, biting northerly wind...

ext.ext_cn: 周四，南极气流给智利南部带来了刺骨的严寒。
ext.ext_en: Antarctic air brought biting cold to southern Chile on Thursday.

defs.def_en: Biting wind or cold is extremely cold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 作者对教会尖刻的讽刺引发的公愤
ext.ext_en: ...a furore caused by the author's  biting satire on the Church...

ext.ext_cn: 这是对她最尖锐的批评。
ext.ext_en: This was the most biting criticism made against her.

defs.def_en: Biting criticism or wit is very harsh or unkind, and is often caused by such feelings as anger or dislike.

defs.def_cn: （尤指政治议题的）民意测验，民意调查

ext.ext_cn: 将近3/4的民意调查受访者赞同政府的决定。
ext.ext_en: Nearly three-quarters of people questioned in an opinion poll agreed with the government's decision.

defs.def_en: An opinion poll involves asking people's opinions on a particular subject, especially one concerning politics.
Marjoram is a kind of herb.

defs.def_cn: （that 或 those 的过时或方言用语）那，那个，那些

ext.ext_cn: 不要让那条狗打盹。
ext.ext_en: Don't let yon dog nod off.

defs.def_en: Yon is an old-fashioned or dialect word for 'that' or 'those'.  hither and yon→see: hither;

ext.ext_cn: 他们决意回到祖先的土地上。
ext.ext_en: They were determined to go back to the land of their forefathers.

defs.def_en: Your forefathers are your ancestors, especially your male ancestors.

ext.ext_cn: 我不是要故意侮辱你。
ext.ext_en: I did not mean to insult you...

ext.ext_cn: 布坎南说法官的那番话侮辱了他。
ext.ext_en: Buchanan said he was insulted by the judge's remarks.

defs.def_en: If someone insults you, they say or do something that is rude or offensive.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的行为是对他们代表的人民的一种侮辱。
ext.ext_en: Their behaviour was an insult to the people they represent...

ext.ext_cn: 监狱长批评了一些站在屋顶上大声辱骂囚犯的狱警。
ext.ext_en: The prison Governor criticised some of his officers who shouted insults at prisoners on the roof.

defs.def_en: An insult is a rude remark, or something a person says or does which insults you.

defs.def_cn: 更为不公的是;更不可接受的是;更糟的是

ext.ext_cn: 撞死史密斯的汽车司机仅被罚款250英镑，驾照上扣了5分。更让人不可接受的是,他竟然开着自己的车从法院扬长而去。
ext.ext_en: The driver of the car that killed Smith got a £250 fine and five penalty points on his licence. To add insult to injury, he drove away from court in his own car.

defs.def_en: You say to add insult to injury when mentioning an action or fact that makes an unfair or unacceptable situation even worse.

defs.def_cn: 耶和华（《圣经·旧约》中对上帝的称呼）
defs.def_en: Jehovah is the name given to God in the Old Testament.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我对结果完全没兴趣，甚至都懒得看一眼。
ext.ext_en: I was so uninterested in the result that I didn't even bother to look at it.

ext.ext_cn: 既没用又冷漠的店员
ext.ext_en: ...unhelpful and uninterested shop staff.

defs.def_en: If you are uninterested in something or someone, you do not want to know any more about them, because you think they have no special or exciting qualities.

defs.def_cn: （为军队或其他组织的）采购，购买

ext.ext_cn: 他说，俄罗斯新武器的采购量将削减“大约80％”。
ext.ext_en: Russia was cutting procurement of new weapons 'by about 80 per cent', he said.

defs.def_en: Procurement is the act of obtaining something such as supplies for an army or other organization.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 下定决心的;决意的;坚定的

ext.ext_cn: 他的敌人决意要毁了他。
ext.ext_en: His enemies are determined to ruin him...

ext.ext_cn: 她是一位精明干练且意志坚定的政治家。
ext.ext_en: She is a remarkably adroit and determined politician...

defs.def_en: If you are determined to do something, you have made a firm decision to do it and will not let anything stop you.

defs.def_cn: 策略性投票(指为了防止某一方获胜，而将票投给自己并不支持的一方)
defs.def_en: Tactical voting is the act of voting for a particular person or political party in order to prevent someone else from winning, rather than because you support that person or party.

ext.ext_cn: 他们把一小笔钱存在了什么地方，以备不时之需。
ext.ext_en: They have a little nest egg tucked away somewhere for a rainy day.

defs.def_en: A nest egg is a sum of money that you are saving for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 打山鹑
ext.ext_en: ...to shoot a partridge.

ext.ext_cn: 山鹑肉做的主菜
ext.ext_en: ...a main course of partridge.

defs.def_en: A partridge is a wild bird with brown feathers, a round body, and a short tail.

ext.ext_cn: 使精炼厂现代化的计划
ext.ext_en: ...plans to modernize the refinery...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的选举制度迫切需要现代化。
ext.ext_en: There is a pressing need to modernise our electoral system.

defs.def_en: To modernize something such as a system or a factory means to change it by replacing old equipment or methods with new ones.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指女人眼中的男人)帅气的，迷人的
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as dishy, you mean they are very good looking and attractive; used especially by women about men.

ext.ext_cn: 你的书呢？拿出来，翻到第4页。
ext.ext_en: Where's your book? Take it out and turn to page 4.

ext.ext_cn: 《卫报》的头版
ext.ext_en: ...the front page of the Guardian.

defs.def_en: A page is one side of one of the pieces of paper in a book, magazine, or newspaper. Each page usually has a number printed at the top or bottom.

ext.ext_cn: 他翻着笔记本。
ext.ext_en: He turned the pages of his notebook...

ext.ext_cn: 在下一页上，你可以看到有关6本在售好书的全部信息。
ext.ext_en: Over the page you can read all about the six great books on offer.

defs.def_en: The pages of a book, magazine, or newspaper are the pieces of paper it consists of.

defs.def_cn: （历史的）一页（指重大事件或重要时期）

ext.ext_cn: 该国政治史上崭新的一页
ext.ext_en: ...a new page in the country's political history.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an important event or period of time as a page of history.

ext.ext_cn: 航班登机时，广播里反复呼叫他。
ext.ext_en: He was paged repeatedly as the flight was boarding...

ext.ext_cn: 我会叫人呼他们，告诉他们你在这儿。
ext.ext_en: I'll have them paged and tell them you're here.

defs.def_en: If someone who is in a public place is paged, they receive a message, often over a speaker, telling them that someone is trying to contact them.

defs.def_cn: （婚礼上新娘的）男伴童，小男傧相
defs.def_en: A page is a small boy who accompanies the bride at a wedding.

defs.def_cn: （美国国会或州立法会的）青年助理
defs.def_en: A page is a young person who takes messages or does small jobs for members of the United States Congress or state legislatures.

defs.def_cn: （旧时做骑士侍从的）实习骑士
defs.def_en: In former times, a page was a young boy who was a knight's servant and was learning to be a knight.

ext.ext_cn: 这项纪录保持了13年，无人能破。
ext.ext_en: This record figure was unequalled for 13 years...

ext.ext_cn: 最上乘的服务
ext.ext_en: ...an unequalled level of service.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unequalled, you mean that it is greater, better, or more extreme than anything else of the same kind.

ext.ext_cn: “不要亵渎神明，”我母亲说。
ext.ext_en: 'Don't  blaspheme,' my mother said...

ext.ext_cn: 宗教领袖指责该书亵渎了伊斯兰教。
ext.ext_en: The spiritual leader charged that the book blasphemed against Islam.

defs.def_en: If someone blasphemes, they say rude or disrespectful things about God or religion, or they use God's name as a swear word.
A gas station is a place where you can buy fuel for your car.

defs.def_cn: (公司、组织的)收入，收益;（政府的）财政收入，税收

ext.ext_cn: 电影院非常景气的一年，创下1980年以来广告及票房收入新高
ext.ext_en: ...a boom year at the cinema, with record advertising revenue and the highest ticket sales since 1980...

ext.ext_cn: 一项研究表明政府将在5年中获得约120亿美元的税收。
ext.ext_en: One study said the government would gain about $12 billion in tax revenues over five years.

defs.def_en: See also:Inland Revenue;Revenue is money that a company, organization, or government receives from people.

ext.ext_cn: 大牌珠宝商竞相邀约名人佩戴其名贵首饰。
ext.ext_en: Big-name jewellers are battling it out to get celebrities to wear their bling.

ext.ext_cn: 冈斯特说唱歌手对昂贵珠宝的热衷
ext.ext_en: ...gangsta rap's love of bling-bling.

defs.def_en: Some people refer to expensive or fancy jewellery as bling or bling-bling .

ext.ext_cn: 有人在谈论实施报复性封锁，阻止供应物资通过。
ext.ext_en: There's been talk of a retaliatory blockade to prevent supplies getting through.

defs.def_en: If you take retaliatory action, you try to harm or annoy someone who has harmed or annoyed you.

ext.ext_cn: 边境两边都在集结兵力。
ext.ext_en: There has been a build-up of troops on both sides of the border...

ext.ext_cn: 该疾病还会引起内耳的压力增加，从而导致剧烈的耳痛。
ext.ext_en: The disease can also cause a build up of pressure in the inner ear leading to severe earache.

defs.def_en: A build-up is a gradual increase in something.

ext.ext_cn: 我们至少要等到冬天再开始着力营造圣诞节的气氛。
ext.ext_en: We should wait at least until winter before we start the build-up to Christmas...

ext.ext_cn: 在学生们一番忙碌准备之后，随之而来的考试却出乎意料地平淡。
ext.ext_en: The exams came, almost an anticlimax after the build-up that the students had given them.

defs.def_en: The build-up to an event is the way that journalists, advertisers, or other people talk about it a lot in the period of time immediately before it, and try to make it seem important and exciting.
A skillet is a shallow iron pan which is used for frying.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 断断续续地有汽车驶过。
ext.ext_en: Cars passed at irregular intervals...

ext.ext_cn: 她因心律不齐被送往医院。
ext.ext_en: She was taken to hospital suffering from an irregular heartbeat...

defs.def_en: If events or actions occur at irregular intervals, the periods of time between them are of different lengths.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不规则的;不平整的;不直的

ext.ext_cn: 油漆一片片地慢慢变干了。
ext.ext_en: The paint was drying in irregular patches...

ext.ext_cn: 他牙齿长得不好，参差不齐而且有些发黄。
ext.ext_en: He had bad teeth, irregular and discolored.

defs.def_en: Something that is irregular is not smooth or straight, or does not form a regular pattern.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为)欺骗性的，不正当的,不合常规的

ext.ext_cn: 被控有违规商业行为的部长
ext.ext_en: ...the minister accused of irregular business practices...

ext.ext_cn: “利奥,你能为我做这件事吗？这是唯一的办法了。”——“拉尔夫,这么做是很不正当的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Will you do this for me, Leo? It's the only way.' — 'It's highly irregular, Ralph.'

defs.def_en: Irregular behaviour is dishonest or not in accordance with the normal rules.

defs.def_cn: (动词、名词或形容词)不规则的
defs.def_en: An irregular verb, noun, or adjective has different forms from most other verbs, nouns, or adjectives in the language. For example, 'break' is an irregular verb because its past form is 'broke', not 'breaked'.

ext.ext_cn: 至少有 17 个非正规军部队参战。
ext.ext_en: At least 17 different irregular units are engaged in the war.

defs.def_en: Irregular troops do not belong to an official national army.

ext.ext_cn: 店主们把窗户都封上了。
ext.ext_en: Shopkeepers have boarded up their windows.

defs.def_en: If you board up a door or window, you fix pieces of wood over it so that it is covered up.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你常常因为沮丧而暴饮暴食，首先应该设法找到悲伤的原因。
ext.ext_en: If you tend to overeat because of depression, first take steps to recognize the source of your sadness.

ext.ext_cn: 辛辣食品吃得过多的人
ext.ext_en: ...people who overeat spicy foods.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone overeats, you mean they eat more than they need to or more than is healthy.

defs.def_cn: (河流在入海处形成的)三角洲

ext.ext_cn: 密西西比河三角洲
ext.ext_en: ...the Mississippi delta.

defs.def_en: A delta is an area of low, flat land shaped like a triangle, where a river splits and spreads out into several branches before entering the sea.

defs.def_cn: (教堂等建筑物顶部的)尖塔，尖顶
defs.def_en: The spire of a building such as a church is the tall pointed structure on the top.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不稳固的;不牢靠的;不会长久的;不会成功的

ext.ext_cn: 敌对武装团伙在经过3天的交战后暂时停火。
ext.ext_en: A shaky ceasefire is holding after three days of fighting between rival groups...

ext.ext_cn: 恐怕这学年一开学就不顺。
ext.ext_en: I'm afraid that this school year is off to a shaky start...

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as shaky, you mean that it is weak or unstable, and seems unlikely to last long or be successful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 当众发言前，我们全都手脚发抖，嘴巴发干。
ext.ext_en: We have all had a shaky hand and a dry mouth before speaking in public...

ext.ext_cn: 即使是小手术也会让你有点战战兢兢。
ext.ext_en: Even small operations can leave you feeling a bit shaky...

defs.def_en: If your body or your voice is shaky, you cannot control it properly and it shakes, for example because you are ill or nervous.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有预见到任何问题。
ext.ext_en: He did not foresee any problems...

ext.ext_cn: 原本可以预见到的危险情况
ext.ext_en: ...a dangerous situation which could have been foreseen...

defs.def_en: If you foresee something, you expect and believe that it will happen.

defs.def_cn: (尤指正式服装或官员服装上的)腰带，彩带,肩带

ext.ext_cn: 她身着一件系有蓝色细腰带的白色连衣裙。
ext.ext_en: She wore a white dress with a thin blue sash...

ext.ext_cn: 她走上前去从即将离职的总统手中接过了就职腰带。
ext.ext_en: She arrived to receive the sash of office from the outgoing president.

defs.def_en: A sash is a long piece of cloth which people wear round their waist or over one shoulder, especially with formal or official clothes.
A sash is one of the sliding frames in a sash window.

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家陷进了一种民族主义和军国主义并存的危险境地。
ext.ext_en: The country slipped into a dangerous mixture of nationalism and militarism.

defs.def_en: Militarism is a country's desire to strengthen their armed forces in order to make themselves more powerful.
Ultrasonic sounds have very high frequencies, which human beings cannot hear.

ext.ext_cn: 女人们开始哀哭起来。
ext.ext_en: The women began to wail in mourning.

ext.ext_cn: 因丧子而痛哭的母亲
ext.ext_en: ...a mother wailing for her lost child.

defs.def_en: If someone wails, they make long, loud, high-pitched cries which express sorrow or pain.

ext.ext_cn: “看看你干的好事！”雪莉哭诉道。
ext.ext_en: 'Now look what you've done!' Shirley wailed...

ext.ext_cn: 普丽姆罗丝因疲惫而显得有些迟钝，开始哭着说她饿了。
ext.ext_en: Primrose, stupefied by tiredness, began to wail that she was hungry.

defs.def_en: If you wail something, you say it in a loud, high-pitched voice that shows that you are unhappy or in pain.

ext.ext_cn: 警车护送着大卡车，一路警笛长鸣。
ext.ext_en: Police cars, their sirens wailing, accompanied the lorries...

ext.ext_cn: 紧闭的窗户外狂风呼啸。
ext.ext_en: The wind wailed outside the closed windows.

defs.def_en: If something such as a siren or an alarm wails, it makes a long, loud, high-pitched sound.

defs.def_cn: （在某一活动上）超过，胜过，比…干得好

ext.ext_cn: 超过他们，感到自己比他们更优秀，这点对我来说很重要。
ext.ext_en: It was important for me to outdo them, to feel better than they were...

ext.ext_cn: 双方各不相让，都想显示自己有多么厉害。
ext.ext_en: Both sides have tried to outdo each other to show how tough they can be.

defs.def_en: If you outdo someone, you are a lot more successful than they are at a particular activity.

ext.ext_cn: 克罗地亚不甘人后，提出了他们自己的维和方案。
ext.ext_en: Not to be outdone, the Croats came up with a peacekeeping proposal of their own...

ext.ext_cn: 她戴了一顶漂亮的冕状头饰，而新郎也毫不逊色，身着一件非常讲究的刺绣西服马甲。
ext.ext_en: She wore a lovely tiara but the groom, not to be outdone, had on a very smart embroidered waistcoat.

defs.def_en: You use not to be outdone to introduce an action which someone takes in response to a previous action.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 隐伏的;潜在的;不知不觉间加剧的

ext.ext_cn: 变化是悄然发生的,15 到 20 年间不会产生明显影响。
ext.ext_en: The changes are insidious, and will not produce a noticeable effect for 15 to 20 years...

ext.ext_cn: 他们关注的是公开的歧视,而不是种族主义的一些潜在问题。
ext.ext_en: They focus on overt discrimination rather than insidious aspects of racism.

defs.def_en: Something that is insidious is unpleasant or dangerous and develops gradually without being noticed.

defs.def_cn: 结伙，拉帮结派，联合起来（对抗某人）

ext.ext_cn: 哈里森抱怨说他的同事联手对付他。
ext.ext_en: Harrison complained that his colleagues ganged up on him...

ext.ext_cn: 其他政党全部联合起来使他们无法掌权。
ext.ext_en: All the other parties ganged up to keep them out of power...

defs.def_en: If people gang up on someone, they unite against them for a particular reason, for example in a fight or argument.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他甚至令对手也不得不尊重他。
ext.ext_en: He even earned his opponents' grudging respect...

ext.ext_cn: 这一局面看来已经被勉强接受。
ext.ext_en: There seems to be a grudging acceptance of the situation.

defs.def_en: A grudging feeling or action is felt or done very unwillingly.
Your navel is the small hollow just below your waist at the front of your body.

defs.def_cn: （通常指餐后饮用的）樱桃白兰地，樱桃酒
defs.def_en: Kirsch is a strong, colourless, alcoholic drink made from cherries which is usually drunk after a meal.

defs.def_cn: 手持式的;便携式的;掌上的

ext.ext_cn: 塞冯萨克使用便携式摄像机拍摄了整部影片。
ext.ext_en: Saivonsac shot the entire film with a hand-held camera.

ext.ext_cn: 手持电动搅拌器
ext.ext_en: ...a hand-held electric mixer.

defs.def_en: A hand-held device such as a camera or a computer is small and light enough to be used while you are holding it.

defs.def_cn: 性感偶像，极富性魅力的名人(尤指演员或歌手)

ext.ext_cn: 好莱坞20世纪40年代的性感偶像
ext.ext_en: ...Hollywood sex symbols of the Forties.

defs.def_en: A sex symbol is a famous person, especially an actor or a singer, who is considered by many people to be sexually attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他认为政府对毒贩已经很宽容了。
ext.ext_en: He believes the government already is lenient with drug traffickers...

ext.ext_cn: 奥斯瓦尔德教授的观点稍微温和些。
ext.ext_en: Professor Oswald takes a sightly more lenient view.

defs.def_en: When someone in authority is lenient, they are not as strict or severe as expected.
A chat-up line is a remark that someone makes in order to start a conversation with someone they do not know but find sexually attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 他为减轻他们的辛劳做了力所能及的一切。
ext.ext_en: He did whatever he could to ease their travail.

defs.def_en: You can refer to unpleasant hard work or difficult problems as travail .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 甜得发腻的;过于感伤的;故作多情的

ext.ext_cn: 《彼得·潘》这个故事煽情造作的续集
ext.ext_en: ...a saccharine sequel to the Peter Pan story...

ext.ext_cn: 她的笑容太嗲了。
ext.ext_en: She smiled with saccharine sweetness.

defs.def_en: You describe something as saccharine when you find it unpleasantly sweet and sentimental.

defs.def_cn: 在整个夜间；在夜里的某一时刻

ext.ext_cn: 整晚都悄然无风。
ext.ext_en: The weather remained calm overnight...

ext.ext_cn: 决定是在夜里作出的。
ext.ext_en: The decision was reached overnight...

defs.def_en: If something happens overnight, it happens throughout the night or at some point during the night.

ext.ext_cn: 这些规定不会说变就变。
ext.ext_en: The rules are not going to change overnight...

ext.ext_cn: 他很现实，知道自己的成功不会一蹴而就。
ext.ext_en: He's realistic enough to know he's not going to succeed overnight...

defs.def_en: You can say that something happens overnight when it happens very quickly and unexpectedly.

ext.ext_cn: 他意识到自己把过夜包落在玛丽家了。
ext.ext_en: He realized he'd left his overnight bag at Mary's house.

defs.def_en: Overnight bags or clothes are ones that you take when you go and stay somewhere for one or two nights.

ext.ext_cn: 他们跟她说过她将在悉尼过夜。
ext.ext_en: They had told her she would be overnighting in Sydney.

ext.ext_cn: 可以安排过夜。
ext.ext_en: Overnights can be arranged.

defs.def_en: If you overnight somewhere, you spend the night there.

ext.ext_cn: 哀婉的乐曲，《爱尔兰挽歌》
ext.ext_en: ...the mournful dirge, 'Erin's Lament'.

defs.def_en: A dirge is a slow, sad song or piece of music. Dirges are sometimes performed at funerals.
The chauffeur of a rich or important person is the man or woman who is employed to look after their car and drive them around in it.

ext.ext_cn: 有她在那儿还是挺有用的，能开车带他到处跑。
ext.ext_en: It was certainly useful to have her there to chauffeur him around...

ext.ext_cn: 卡罗琳有辆配有司机的轿车，随时准备送她去伦敦。
ext.ext_en: Caroline had a chauffeured car waiting to take her to London.

defs.def_en: If you chauffeur someone somewhere, you drive them there in a car, usually as part of your job.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 当前唯一的超级大国远不是一个公正的旁观者。
ext.ext_en: The current sole superpower is far from being a disinterested observer...

ext.ext_cn: 当然，人们会认为科学家们理所当然是公正客观的。
ext.ext_en: Scientists, of course, can be expected to be impartial and disinterested...

defs.def_en: Someone who is disinterested is not involved in a particular situation or not likely to benefit from it and is therefore able to act in a fair and unselfish way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不感兴趣的;不关心的;冷漠的

ext.ext_cn: 我们俩都已经倦了，腻了，也死心了。
ext.ext_en: We had both become jaded, disinterested, and disillusioned...

ext.ext_cn: 莉莉显然已经恢复了食欲，但多兰却提不起胃口。
ext.ext_en: Lili had clearly regained her appetite but Doran was disinterested in food.

defs.def_en: If you are disinterested in something, you are not interested in it. Some users of English believe that it is not correct to use disinterested with this meaning.

ext.ext_cn: 客人们被告知要身穿化装舞会服装前来。
ext.ext_en: Guests were told to come in fancy dress...

ext.ext_cn: 他扮成足球运动员出现在化装舞会上。
ext.ext_en: He turned up at the fancy dress party as a footballer.

defs.def_en: Fancy dress is clothing that you wear for a party at which everyone tries to look like a famous person or a person from a story, from history, or from a particular profession.

defs.def_cn: （尤指在家里）自己动手，自行维修

ext.ext_cn: 他自己动手能力太差，甚至连搭个架子都不会。
ext.ext_en: He's useless at DIY. He won't even put up a shelf.

defs.def_en: DIY is the activity of making or repairing things yourself, especially in your home. DIY is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'do-it-yourself'.

defs.def_cn: （商店）出售自己动手做所需物品的

ext.ext_cn: 你可以在自己动手商店里买一套工具自己来做这个。
ext.ext_en: You can get kits to do this from DIY stores.

defs.def_en: A DIY shop is one that sells tools, paint, and other equipment needed for DIY.

ext.ext_cn: 他们出售自己动手做镶嵌画所需材料和现成的镶板。
ext.ext_en: They sell materials for DIY mosaics and ready-made panels.

defs.def_en: DIY things are things that you make or do yourself, rather than buying them ready-made or paying someone else to do them.
Scotswomen A Scotswoman is a woman of Scottish origin.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Tempi is a plural of tempo .

ext.ext_cn: 加藤完全清楚这些珍宝的来源。
ext.ext_en: Kato was fully aware of the provenance of these treasures...

ext.ext_cn: 他不知道其出处。
ext.ext_en: He had no idea of its provenance.

defs.def_en: The provenance of something is the place that it comes from or that it originally came from.
Pole dancing is a type of entertainment in a bar or club in which a woman who is wearing very few clothes dances around a pole in a sexy way.

ext.ext_cn: 他在加州的一家医院里，病情仍然十分危急。
ext.ext_en: He remains in a critical condition in a California hospital...

ext.ext_cn: 好几个人夸我的皮肤保养得好。
ext.ext_en: I received several compliments on the condition of my skin...

defs.def_en: If you talk about the condition of a person or thing, you are talking about the state that they are in, especially how good or bad their physical state is.

defs.def_cn: (某事完成或发生的)环境，条件

ext.ext_cn: 在实验室条件下测得了这一变化所需的时间。
ext.ext_en: This change has been timed under laboratory conditions...

ext.ext_cn: 暖冬为蚁群数量激增创造了理想的条件。
ext.ext_en: The mild winter has created the ideal conditions for an ant population explosion.

defs.def_en: The conditions under which something is done or happens are all the factors or circumstances which directly affect it.

ext.ext_cn: 人们的居住条件极其恶劣。
ext.ext_en: People are living in appalling conditions...

ext.ext_cn: 他再也不能在这样的条件下工作了。
ext.ext_en: He could not work in these conditions any longer...

defs.def_en: The conditions in which people live or work are the factors which affect their comfort, safety, or health.

defs.def_cn: (某一群人的)生活状况，境况;(尤指)艰难处境

ext.ext_cn: 人们的生活状况可以通过社会改革方案得到改善。
ext.ext_en: The condition of the people could be elevated by a programme of social reform...

ext.ext_cn: 政府鼓励人民改善生活状况。
ext.ext_en: The government has encouraged its people to better their condition.

defs.def_en: The condition of a group of people is their situation in life, especially with regard to the difficulties they have.

defs.def_cn: (尤指写入合同或法律的)条件，条款

ext.ext_cn: 作为贷款偿还条件所设定的经济目标
ext.ext_en: ...economic targets set as a condition for loan payments.

ext.ext_cn: 雇用条款及条件
ext.ext_en: ...terms and conditions of employment...

defs.def_en: A condition is something which must happen or be done in order for something else to be possible, especially when this is written into a contract or law.

ext.ext_cn: 医生怀疑他可能有心脏病。
ext.ext_en: Doctors suspect he may have a heart condition.

ext.ext_cn: 引起脑组织变性的罕见疾病
ext.ext_en: ...a rare condition that causes degeneration of the brain tissue.

defs.def_en: If someone has a particular condition, they have an illness or other medical problem.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都受到早年印象和经历的影响。
ext.ext_en: We are all conditioned by early impressions and experiences...

ext.ext_cn: 你习惯性地认为害怕是软弱的表现。
ext.ext_en: You have been conditioned to believe that it is weak to be scared...

defs.def_en: If someone is conditioned by their experiences or environment, they are influenced by them over a period of time so that they do certain things or think in a particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 对干燥、受损的头发有极佳护理效果的蛋白质
ext.ext_en: ...a protein which is excellent for conditioning dry and damaged hair.

defs.def_en: To condition your hair or skin means to put something on it which will keep it in good condition.

defs.def_cn: (因病重、烦乱或酒醉而)不能(做某事)

ext.ext_cn: 很显然，她谁都不能见。
ext.ext_en: She was clearly in no condition to see anyone.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in no condition to do something, you mean that they are too ill, upset, or drunk to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 在不披露身份的条件下，他接受了记者的采访。
ext.ext_en: He spoke to reporters on condition that he was not identified.

defs.def_en: When you agree to do something on condition that something else happens, you mean that you will only do it if this other thing also happens.

defs.def_cn: (由于缺乏锻炼而)身体状况不佳

ext.ext_cn: 他体质太差，爬不到山顶。
ext.ext_en: He was too out of condition to clamber over the top.

defs.def_en: If someone is out of condition, they are unhealthy and unfit, because they do not do enough exercise.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (政策)干涉主义的，主张干预的

ext.ext_cn: 威尔逊政府主张干涉的工业政策
ext.ext_en: ...the interventionist industrial policy of the Wilson government...

ext.ext_cn: 联合国应该更多地进行干涉以阻止对人权的践踏和苦难的发生。
ext.ext_en: The UN needs to become more interventionist to prevent human rights abuses and suffering.

defs.def_en: Interventionist policies are policies which show an organization's desire to become involved in a problem or a crisis which does not concern it directly.

defs.def_cn: 终于被充分理解;终于被完全领悟

ext.ext_cn: 其中的含意要花点时间才能完全领会。
ext.ext_en: The implication took a while to sink in.

defs.def_en: When a statement or fact sinks in, you finally understand or realize it fully.
A martial art is one of the methods of fighting, often without weapons, that come from the Far East, for example kung fu, karate, or judo.

defs.def_cn: （某人携带的或与特定活动有关的）大量物品，全套装备

ext.ext_cn: 堆满建筑工人所需装备的大庭院
ext.ext_en: ...a large courtyard full of builders' paraphernalia...

ext.ext_cn: 扔掉所有香烟、烟灰缸和与吸烟有关的其他物品。
ext.ext_en: Get rid of all cigarettes and ashtrays and other paraphernalia associated with smoking.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a large number of objects that someone has with them or that are connected with a particular activity as paraphernalia.

ext.ext_cn: 公众并不一定希望走全面听证的复杂程序。
ext.ext_en: The public don't necessarily want the paraphernalia of a full hearing.

defs.def_en: If you disapprove of the things and events that are involved in a particular system or activity, and you think they are unnecessary, you can refer to them as paraphernalia .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不出所料的；不出奇的；意料中的

ext.ext_cn: 他还是那么乞人憎这一事实并不令人觉得奇怪。
ext.ext_en: It is unsurprising that he remains so hated...

ext.ext_cn: 他作出这样的选择并不出人意料。
ext.ext_en: His choice was unsurprising.

defs.def_en: If something is unsurprising, you are not surprised by it because you would expect it to happen or be like it is.

defs.def_cn: （与knee，shoulder等词组合）表示“到…高度”，“高至…”

ext.ext_cn: 草有齐膝高。
ext.ext_en: The grass was knee-high.

ext.ext_cn: 人群将拿着旗子的人举过肩膀。
ext.ext_en: The crowd lifted the man with the flag shoulder-high.

defs.def_en: -high combines with words such as 'knee' or 'shoulder' to indicate that someone or something reaches as high as the point that is mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 在一些文化里，外科手术是被禁止的。
ext.ext_en: In some cultures surgery is proscribed...

ext.ext_cn: 根据联邦法律的规定，他们不准拥有枪支。
ext.ext_en: They are proscribed by federal law from owning guns.

defs.def_en: If something is proscribed by people in authority, the existence or the use of that thing is forbidden.

ext.ext_cn: 波罗的海周边耸立的悬崖峭壁
ext.ext_en: ...vertiginous cliffs that rise out of the Baltic.

defs.def_en: A vertiginous cliff or mountain is very high and steep.

defs.def_cn: (与表示颜色的名词连用)表示“穿着…颜色袍子的”

ext.ext_cn: 穿着棕色长袍的和尚
ext.ext_en: ...a brown-robed monk.

defs.def_en: -robed combines with the names of colours to indicate that someone is wearing robes of a particular colour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （系统、机构等）负担过重的，不堪重负的

ext.ext_cn: 大量伤员使该市的医院不堪重负。
ext.ext_en: The city's hospitals are overburdened by casualties.

ext.ext_cn: 超负荷运转的空中交通管制系统
ext.ext_en: ...an overburdened air traffic control system.

defs.def_en: If a system or organization is overburdened, it has too many people or things to deal with and so does not function properly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人因工作、问题等）负担过重的，不堪应付的

ext.ext_cn: 总督察讨厌在细枝末节上没完没了地纠缠。
ext.ext_en: The Chief Inspector disliked being overburdened with insignificant detail.

ext.ext_cn: 不堪应付教学任务的教师
ext.ext_en: ...overburdened teachers.

defs.def_en: If you are overburdened with something such as work or problems, you have more of it than you can cope with.

ext.ext_cn: 在国际社会强力打击下活动依然猖獗的贩毒分子
ext.ext_en: ...drug traffickers, who continue to flourish despite international attempts to suppress them...

ext.ext_cn: 在进行7周后遭到军队镇压的全国性民主示威活动
ext.ext_en: ...nationwide demonstrations for democracy, suppressed after 7 weeks by the army.

defs.def_en: If someone in authority suppresses an activity, they prevent it from continuing, by using force or making it illegal.

defs.def_cn: 制止，阻止，抑制(身体的功能或反应)

ext.ext_cn: 可以通过放疗杀死癌细胞来抑制其再生和扩散。
ext.ext_en: The reproduction and growth of the cancerous cells can be suppressed by bombarding them with radiation.

ext.ext_cn: 迄今为止可证明紫外线能抑制人体免疫反应的最有力证据
ext.ext_en: ...the strongest evidence so far that ultraviolet light can suppress human immune responses.

defs.def_en: If a natural function or reaction of your body is suppressed, it is stopped, for example by drugs or illness.

defs.def_cn: 抑制，控制，克制(感情或反应);忍住

ext.ext_cn: 莉兹想起了巴里，忍住没笑。
ext.ext_en: Liz thought of Barry and suppressed a smile...

ext.ext_cn: 教授说深度睡眠可以使压抑的焦虑情绪得以释放。
ext.ext_en: The Professor said that deep sleep allowed suppressed anxieties to surface.

defs.def_en: If you suppress your feelings or reactions, you do not express them, even though you might want to.

ext.ext_cn: 他们从没有试图劝我隐瞒这个消息。
ext.ext_en: At no time did they try to persuade me to suppress the information...

ext.ext_cn: 冤案错案的出现，要么是因为确实弄错了，要么是因为证据被隐瞒。
ext.ext_en: The wrong criminal is in the dock either because a genuine mistake has been made or because evidence has been suppressed.

defs.def_en: If someone suppresses a piece of information, they prevent other people from learning it.

defs.def_cn: 压制，抑制，阻止(进程或活动)

ext.ext_cn: 他说，“政府正在通过破坏经济来抑制通货膨胀。”
ext.ext_en: 'The Government is suppressing inflation by devastating the economy,' he said...

ext.ext_cn: 律师们称今天的裁决将会抬升价格，并抑制新产品的创新。
ext.ext_en: Lawyers said today's ruling would lead to higher prices and would suppress innovation of new products.

defs.def_en: If someone or something suppresses a process or activity, they stop it continuing or developing.

ext.ext_cn: 一切都非常丑陋。
ext.ext_en: Everything is hideously ugly...

ext.ext_cn: 整形外科手术导致他完全毁容了。
ext.ext_en: He has been left hideously disfigured by plastic surgery.

defs.def_en: You use hideously to emphasize that something is very ugly or unattractive.

defs.def_cn: 令人无法接受地;极其恶劣地

ext.ext_cn: 极其复杂的程序
ext.ext_en: ...a hideously complex program.

ext.ext_cn: 款式简单但无疑又贵得离谱的黑色套装
ext.ext_en: ...a simple but undoubtedly hideously expensive black suit.

defs.def_en: You can use hideously to emphasize that something is very unpleasant or unacceptable.

defs.def_cn: （用武器或手脚）迅猛攻击，殴打

ext.ext_cn: 防暴警察朝天开枪并挥舞警棍驱散数百名示威者。
ext.ext_en: Riot police fired in the air and lashed out with clubs to disperse hundreds of demonstrators...

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫脾气极差，一生气就殴打她。
ext.ext_en: Her husband has a terrible temper and lashes out at her when he's angry.

defs.def_en: If you lash out, you attempt to hit someone quickly and violently with a weapon or with your hands or feet.

ext.ext_cn: 作为一个政治人物，杰斐逊常常抨击新闻界。
ext.ext_en: As a politician Jefferson frequently lashed out at the press...

ext.ext_cn: 古巴领导人猛烈抨击美国总统的政策。
ext.ext_en: The Cuban leader lashed out against the policy of the US President.

defs.def_en: If you lash out at someone or something, you speak to them or about them very angrily or critically.

defs.def_cn: （常指在健康方面）帮助解除困境之物

ext.ext_cn: 宫颈涂片检查能够帮上大忙。
ext.ext_en: The cervical smear test is a lifesaver.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a lifesaver, you mean that it helps people in a very important way, often in a way that is important to their health.
A bank holiday is a public holiday.

ext.ext_cn: 有时当工作让我沮丧时，我喜欢幻想自己是一个农场主。
ext.ext_en: At times when my work gets me down, I like to fantasize about being a farmer.

defs.def_en: If something gets you down, it makes you unhappy.

ext.ext_cn: 她双手撑地跪在地上。
ext.ext_en: She got down on her hands and knees on the floor...

ext.ext_cn: “趴下！”她大声喊道，“有人开枪！”
ext.ext_en: 'Get down!' she yelled. 'Somebody's shooting!'

defs.def_en: If you get down, you lower your body until you are sitting, kneeling, or lying on the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 这个想法在我脑海里萦绕许久了，我现在就将它写在纸上。
ext.ext_en: The idea has been going around in my head for quite a while and now I am getting it down on paper.

defs.def_en: If you get something down, especially something that someone has just said, you write it down.

ext.ext_cn: 我咬了一大块面包和奶酪，强咽下去之后开始说话。
ext.ext_en: I bit into a hefty slab of bread and cheese. When I had got it down I started talking.

defs.def_en: If you get food or medicine down, you swallow it, especially with difficulty.

defs.def_cn: 悬而未决的问题；意见不一的问题

ext.ext_cn: 一位英国官员表示，对于制裁是否能够起到作用，他认为尚无定论。
ext.ext_en: A British official said he thought it was an open question whether sanctions would do any good.

defs.def_en: If something is an open question, people have different opinions about it and nobody can say which opinion is correct.
If one person, group, or country does something under the tutelage of another, they do it while they are being taught or guided by them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他眼神悲伤地久久望着我。
ext.ext_en: He gave me a long, doleful look.

defs.def_en: A doleful expression, manner, or voice is depressing and miserable.

defs.def_cn: (学校的)招生地区;(医院等的)服务地区

ext.ext_cn: 地区综合医院的服务范围
ext.ext_en: ...the catchment areas of the district general hospitals.

defs.def_en: The catchment area of a school, hospital, or other service is the area that it serves.

defs.def_cn: (地理学上河流的)集水区域，汇水面积
defs.def_en: In geography, the catchment area of a river is the area of land from which water flows into the river.

ext.ext_cn: 我发现做这件事最得力的工具是一把大剪刀。
ext.ext_en: I find the best tool for the purpose is a pair of shears.

defs.def_en: See also:machine tool;A tool is any instrument or simple piece of equipment that you hold in your hands and use to do a particular kind of work. For example, spades, hammers, and knives are all tools.

ext.ext_cn: 写作是宣泄强烈感情的好方法。
ext.ext_en: Writing is a good tool for discharging overwhelming feelings…

ext.ext_cn: 录像已经成为非常有用的教学手段。
ext.ext_en: The video has become an invaluable teaching tool...

defs.def_en: You can refer to anything that you use for a particular purpose as a particular type of tool .

defs.def_cn: 受人利用的人;工具;傀儡

ext.ext_cn: 他成了安全部门的工具。
ext.ext_en: He became the tool of the security services.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a tool of a particular person, group, or system, you mean that they are controlled and used by that person, group, or system, especially to do unpleasant or dishonest things.

defs.def_cn: (因罢工或抗议而突然)停工，放下工具
defs.def_en: If you say that workers down tools, you mean that they stop working suddenly in order to strike or to make a protest of some kind.

defs.def_cn: (技能、工具和设备等)从事某行当的工具

ext.ext_cn: 他们来这里向美国同事学习行业技术和技能。
ext.ext_en: They're here to learn the tools of their trade from their American colleagues...

ext.ext_cn: 黑皮夹克与纹身是重金属乐手的标准行头。
ext.ext_en: Black-leather jackets and tattoos are the standard tools of the trade for heavy-metal musicians.

defs.def_en: The tools of your trade or the tools of the trade are the skills, instruments, and other equipment that you need in order to do your job properly.
Ennui is a feeling of being tired, bored, and dissatisfied.

defs.def_cn: (固定在墙上或橱柜上的)架子，搁板

ext.ext_cn: 他从书架上拿了一本书。
ext.ext_en: He took a book from the shelf.

ext.ext_cn: 烤箱的中间搁板
ext.ext_en: ...the middle shelf of the oven.

defs.def_en: A shelf is a flat piece of wood, metal, or glass which is attached to a wall or to the sides of a cupboard. Shelves are used for keeping things on.

defs.def_cn: 搁板状岩石;突出的岩石;(水下的)暗礁，陆架

ext.ext_cn: 房子矗立在松树丛中一块突出的岩石上。
ext.ext_en: The house stands on a shelf of rock among pines.

defs.def_en: See also:continental shelf;A shelf is a section of rock on a cliff or mountain or underwater that sticks out like a shelf.

ext.ext_cn: 现货供应的任何一辆淡粉色汽车一定都有自己的卖点。
ext.ext_en: Any car you can buy off the shelf in a pastel pink has got to be saying something.

ext.ext_cn: 现成的软件
ext.ext_en: ...off-the-shelf software.

defs.def_en: If you buy something off the shelf, you buy something that is not specially made for you.

defs.def_cn: 搁置的;闲置的;没人要的

ext.ext_cn: 我害怕嫁不出去。
ext.ext_en: I was afraid of getting left on the shelf.

ext.ext_cn: 不被采用的最佳方案
ext.ext_en: ...first-rate plans which sit on the shelf.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is on the shelf, you mean that no one wants them.

ext.ext_cn: 对父亲完全弃她不顾的回忆
ext.ext_en: ...memories of her father's complete abandonment of her.

defs.def_en: The abandonment of a place, thing, or person is the act of leaving it permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

defs.def_cn: （工作、活动等的）中途放弃，中止

ext.ext_cn: 连绵阴雨致使翌日各项赛事被迫中止。
ext.ext_en: Constant rain forced the abandonment of the next day's competitions.

defs.def_en: The abandonment of a piece of work or activity is the act of stopping doing it before it is finished.

ext.ext_cn: 政府对这项政策的放弃
ext.ext_en: ...the government's abandonment of the policy.

defs.def_en: The abandonment of an idea or way of thinking is the act of stopping having the idea or of stopping thinking in that way.

defs.def_cn: (美国)女国会议员，(尤指)女众议员

ext.ext_cn: 会议由众议员玛克辛·沃特斯组织。
ext.ext_en: The meeting was organised by Congresswoman Maxine Waters.

defs.def_en: A Congresswoman is a female member of the US Congress, especially of the House of Representatives.  →see usage note at:government
Indirect discourse is the same as indirect speech .

ext.ext_cn: 他不愿意预测来年哪些书会有销路。
ext.ext_en: He was unwilling to make a prediction about which books would sell in the coming year...

ext.ext_cn: 关于经济衰退不会延续很长时间的预测对那些已经受到影响的人来说只是小小的安慰。
ext.ext_en: Predictions that the recession will be short are small comfort to those already affected...

defs.def_en: If you make a prediction about something, you say what you think will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 这给了我一种满足感。
ext.ext_en: It gave me a feeling of satisfaction...

ext.ext_cn: 我心中涌起强烈的自豪感。
ext.ext_en: Strong feelings of pride welled up in me...

defs.def_en: A feeling is an emotion, such as anger or happiness.

ext.ext_cn: 据称针对女警的暴力事件有所增加，她对此十分愤慨。
ext.ext_en: She has strong feelings about the alleged growth in violence against female officers...

ext.ext_cn: 我也开始重新审视自己对身为女性的感受。
ext.ext_en: I have also begun to reassess my own feelings about being a woman...

defs.def_en: Your feelings about something are the things that you think and feel about it, or your attitude towards it.

defs.def_cn: (可能造成困扰、伤害或难堪的)感情

ext.ext_cn: 他怕伤了我的心。
ext.ext_en: He was afraid of hurting my feelings...

ext.ext_cn: 他不尊重，也不顾及别人的感受。
ext.ext_en: He has no respect, no regard for anyone's feelings...

defs.def_en: When you refer to someone's feelings, you are talking about the things that might embarrass, offend, or upset them. For example, if you hurt someone's feelings, you upset them by something that you say or do.

ext.ext_cn: 他被惹得情绪非常激动，这很少见。
ext.ext_en: He was prompted to a rare outburst of feeling.

ext.ext_cn: 激动得发颤的声音
ext.ext_en: ...a voice that trembles with feeling.

defs.def_en: Feeling is a way of thinking and reacting to things which is emotional and not planned rather than logical and practical.

ext.ext_cn: 托马斯对哈丽雅特的爱从未消逝。
ext.ext_en: Thomas never lost his feeling for Harriet...

ext.ext_cn: 彼得行事如此麻木不仁，真是难以置信。
ext.ext_en: It's incredible that Peter can behave with such stupid lack of feeling.

defs.def_en: Feeling for someone is love, affection, sympathy, or concern for them.

ext.ext_cn: 我的脖子感觉也很奇怪。
ext.ext_en: I also had a strange feeling in my neck...

ext.ext_cn: 全身心体会放松的感觉。
ext.ext_en: Focus on the feeling of relaxation...

defs.def_en: If you have a feeling of hunger, tiredness, or other physical sensation, you experience it.

ext.ext_cn: 事故过后，他的腿丧失了知觉。
ext.ext_en: After the accident he had no feeling in his legs.

defs.def_en: Feeling in part of your body is the ability to experience the sense of touch in this part of the body.

ext.ext_cn: 我有种感觉，事情总有一天会变得对我们有利的。
ext.ext_en: I have a feeling that everything will come right for us one day...

ext.ext_cn: 人总会对其他人有某种感觉，我就觉得她会是个好人。
ext.ext_en: You have a feeling about people, and I just felt she was going to be good.

defs.def_en: If you have a feeling that something is the case or that something is going to happen, you think that is probably the case or that it is probably going to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 艺术界一些人仍然认为，这类艺术品的市场可能趋于低迷。
ext.ext_en: There is still some feeling in the art world that the market for such works may be declining...

ext.ext_cn: 看来反法西斯情绪并未受到鼓励。
ext.ext_en: It seemed that anti-Fascist feeling was not being encouraged.

defs.def_en: Feeling is used to refer to a general opinion that a group of people has about something.

ext.ext_cn: 我感觉糟糕透顶，我被留下抚养孩子，而他却在寻欢作乐。
ext.ext_en: I had the terrible feeling of being left behind to bring up the baby while he had fun.

defs.def_en: If you have a feeling of being in a particular situation, you feel that you are in that situation.

ext.ext_cn: 试着去理解在这片土地上生息的人们。
ext.ext_en: Try to get a feeling for the people who live here...

ext.ext_cn: 看来你有绘画的天赋。
ext.ext_en: You seem to have a feeling for drawing.

defs.def_en: If you have a feeling for something, you have an understanding of it or a natural ability to do it.

defs.def_cn: (地方或书本营造的)气氛，氛围

ext.ext_cn: 那就是我们在书中竭力描绘的——一种富丽堂皇的气派。
ext.ext_en: That's what we tried to portray in the book, this feeling of opulence and grandeur.

defs.def_en: If something such as a place or book creates a particular kind of feeling, it creates a particular kind of atmosphere.

ext.ext_cn: 两家人之前有过节。
ext.ext_en: There's been some bad feeling between the two families.

defs.def_en: Bad feeling or ill feeling is bitterness or anger which exists between people, for example after they have had an argument.

ext.ext_cn: 我不想我们两个公司间存有什么芥蒂。
ext.ext_en: I don't want any hard feelings between our companies...

ext.ext_cn: 他伸出大手：“不生气，对吧？”
ext.ext_en: He held out his large hand. 'No hard feelings, right?'

defs.def_en: Hard feelings are feelings of anger or bitterness towards someone who you have had an argument with or who has upset you. If you say 'no hard feelings', you are making an agreement with someone not to be angry or bitter about something.

defs.def_cn: 我知道那种滋味;我理解那种感受
defs.def_en: You say 'I know the feeling' to show that you understand or feel sorry about a problem or difficult experience that someone is telling you about.
If you have mixed feelings about something or someone, you feel uncertain about them because you can see both good and bad points about them.

ext.ext_cn: 在52 年的工作中他仅病过一周。
ext.ext_en: In fifty-two years of working he had one week of sickness...

ext.ext_cn: 看来北海的海豹又要爆发另一场疾病了。
ext.ext_en: There appears to be another outbreak of sickness among seals in the North Sea.

defs.def_en: Sickness is the state of being ill or unhealthy.

ext.ext_cn: 他忽然觉得非常想吐。
ext.ext_en: He felt a great rush of sickness...

ext.ext_cn: 过了一会儿，她渐渐不那么恶心了，挣扎着到了镜子前。
ext.ext_en: After a while, the sickness gradually passed and she struggled to the mirror.

defs.def_en: See also:morning sickness;travel sickness;Sickness is the uncomfortable feeling that you are going to vomit.

ext.ext_cn: 辐射病
ext.ext_en: ...radiation sickness.

defs.def_en: A sickness is a particular illness.

ext.ext_cn: 他站在窗前，忧郁地凝视着外面。
ext.ext_en: He stood at the window, moodily staring out...

ext.ext_cn: 房间里感觉很热，她纳闷怎么没人开窗子。
ext.ext_en: The room felt very hot and she wondered why someone did not open a window...

defs.def_en: A window is a space in the wall of a building or in the side of a vehicle, which has glass in it so that light can come in and you can see out.

ext.ext_cn: 我在最近的一家商店的橱窗前站了一会儿。
ext.ext_en: I stood for a few moments in front of the nearest shop window.

defs.def_en: A window is a large piece of glass along the front of a shop, behind which some of the goods that the shop sells are displayed.

defs.def_cn: (银行、邮局、火车站、博物馆等处柜台的)窗口

ext.ext_cn: 售票窗口那个女的告诉我入场费是17.50美元。
ext.ext_en: The woman at the ticket window told me that the admission fee was $17.50.

defs.def_en: A window is a glass-covered opening above a counter, for example in a bank, post office, railway station, or museum, which the person serving you sits behind.
On a computer screen, a window is one of the work areas that the screen can be divided into.

ext.ext_cn: 告诉她我这周晚些时候有空儿。
ext.ext_en: Tell her I've got a window in my diary later on this week.

defs.def_en: If you have a window in your diary for something, or if you can make a window for it, you are free at a particular time and can do it then.

defs.def_cn: 消失殆尽;烟消云散;化为乌有

ext.ext_cn: 到这时根本就不讲什么逻辑了。
ext.ext_en: By now all logic had gone out of the window...

ext.ext_cn: 他走后，我们幸福安稳的好日子便到头了。
ext.ext_en: When he went, our happiness and our security flew out of the window.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a plan or a particular way of thinking or behaving has gone out of the window or has flown out of the window, you mean that it has disappeared completely.

defs.def_cn: 转瞬即逝的机会;稍纵即逝的机会

ext.ext_cn: 国王说现在有寻求和平的短暂机会。
ext.ext_en: The king said there was now a window of opportunity for peace.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is a window of opportunity for something, you mean that there is an opportunity to do something but that this opportunity will only last for a short time and so it needs to be taken advantage of quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 无纸贸易能够省时省钱。
ext.ext_en: Paperless trading can save time and money.

ext.ext_cn: 无纸化办公
ext.ext_en: ...the paperless office.

defs.def_en: Paperless is used to describe business or office work which is done by computer or telephone, rather than by writing things down.

ext.ext_cn: 西蒙否认了他打算这个月晚些时候访问保加利亚的传闻。
ext.ext_en: Simon denied rumours that he was planning to visit Bulgaria later this month...

ext.ext_cn: 运动团体内部存在争执的传闻始终未断。
ext.ext_en: There have been persistent rumours of quarrels within the movement...

defs.def_en: A rumour is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.
A hacksaw is a small saw used for cutting metal.

ext.ext_cn: 这时候布鲁克不能再犹豫不决了。
ext.ext_en: It's time for Brooke to stop shilly-shallying.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is shilly-shallying, you disapprove of the fact that they are hesitating when they should make a decision.

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔加维， 葡萄牙最南部的省份
ext.ext_en: ...the Algarve, Portugal's southernmost province.

defs.def_en: A province is a large section of a country which has its own administration.

ext.ext_cn: 政府计划将3万个左右的政府职位从巴黎转移到外省。
ext.ext_en: The government plans to transfer some 30,000 government jobs from Paris to the provinces.

defs.def_en: The provinces are all the parts of a country except the part where the capital is situated.

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔沃不想作出承诺，“恐怕那不归我管，”他回答说。
ext.ext_en: Arvo avoided committing himself. 'I'm afraid that's not my province,' he replied...

ext.ext_cn: 工业研究属贸易和工业部的职责范围。
ext.ext_en: Industrial research is the province of the Department of Trade and Industry.

defs.def_en: If you say that a subject or activity is a particular person's province, you mean that this person has a special interest in it, a special knowledge of it, or a special responsibility  for it.

ext.ext_cn: 危地马拉军方说叛乱分子伏击打死了10名巡逻兵。
ext.ext_en: The Guatemalan army says rebels ambushed and killed 10 patrolmen.

defs.def_en: If a group of people ambush their enemies, they attack them after hiding and waiting for them.

ext.ext_cn: 一次伏击中一名警察中弹身亡。
ext.ext_en: A policeman has been shot dead in an ambush.

defs.def_en: An ambush is an attack on someone by people who have been hiding and waiting for them.

ext.ext_cn: 埋伏的枪手开枪打死了司机。
ext.ext_en: The gunmen, lying in ambush, opened fire, killing the driver.

defs.def_en: If someone is lying in ambush, they are hiding and waiting for someone, usually to attack them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 非常有趣的；引人入胜的

ext.ext_cn: 《姊妹花》的故事情节引人入胜。
ext.ext_en: 'Two Sisters' is an absorbing read...

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们会对其他展品一样感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: Children will find other exhibits equally absorbing.

defs.def_en: An absorbing task or activity interests you a great deal and takes up all your attention and energy.

ext.ext_cn: 她父亲死于脑瘤。
ext.ext_en: Her father died of a brain tumour.

defs.def_en: Your brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦停止用脑，人很快就会变得迟钝。
ext.ext_en: Once you stop using your brain you soon go stale...

ext.ext_cn: 用这个智力游戏锻炼你的思维能力。
ext.ext_en: Stretch your brain with this puzzle.

defs.def_en: Your brain is your mind and the way that you think.

ext.ext_cn: 并不是只有他们聪明、有志向。
ext.ext_en: They were not the only ones to have brains and ambition...

ext.ext_cn: 我很聪明，老师们都喜欢我。
ext.ext_en: I had a good brain and the teachers liked me.

defs.def_en: If someone has brains or a good brain, they have the ability to learn and understand things quickly, to solve problems, and to make good decisions.

ext.ext_cn: 怀特先生是该项计划的幕后策划者。
ext.ext_en: Mr White was the brains behind the scheme...

ext.ext_cn: 一些调查员认为她是该团伙的决策者。
ext.ext_en: Some investigators regarded her as the brains of the gang.

defs.def_en: If someone is the brains behind an idea or an organization, he or she had that idea or makes the important decisions about how that organization is managed.

ext.ext_cn: 他当时就威胁要打爆他的脑袋。
ext.ext_en: He had threatened to brain him then and there.

defs.def_en: To brain someone means to hit them forcefully on the head.

defs.def_cn: 把…的脑袋打伤；把…脑袋打开花

ext.ext_cn: 他们举着棍子监视着他，好像要揍扁他的脑袋。
ext.ext_en: They stood over him with clubs raised as if to beat his brains out.

defs.def_en: To beat someone's  brains out or bash their brains in means to hit their head very hard, so that they are badly injured or killed.

defs.def_cn: （用枪）把…的脑袋打开花；射中…的头部

ext.ext_cn: 把你所有的钱都给我，否则我就一枪把你的脑袋打开花。
ext.ext_en: Give me all your money or I'll blow your brains out...

ext.ext_cn: 他用一支猎枪射中了他的脑袋。
ext.ext_en: He blew his brains out with a shotgun.

defs.def_en: To blow someone's brains out means to shoot them in the head, killing them.

ext.ext_cn: 你从很小的时候就对下棋产生了浓厚兴趣。
ext.ext_en: You've had chess on the brain since you were little.

defs.def_en: If someone has something on the brain, they keep thinking about it.

ext.ext_cn: 为什么一个成功的企业就得允许别的公司来讨教呢？
ext.ext_en: Why should a successful company allow another firm to pick its brains?

defs.def_en: If you pick someone's brains, you ask them to help you with a problem because they know more about the subject than you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (女子)体形匀称的，有曲线美的

ext.ext_cn: 她那双美腿
ext.ext_en: ...her shapely legs.

defs.def_en: If you describe a woman as shapely, you mean that she has an attractive shape.

ext.ext_cn: 一个女人对那家人大骂有种族歧视的脏话。
ext.ext_en: A woman had hurled racist invective at the family...

ext.ext_cn: 克劳利连珠炮似的对韦特骂个不停。
ext.ext_en: Crowley maintained a stream of invective and abuse against Waite.

defs.def_en: Invective is rude and unpleasant things that people shout at people they hate or are angry with.
Nigger is an extremely offensive word for a black person.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你可能会觉得自己不值得别人关心和帮助。
ext.ext_en: You may feel unworthy of the attention and help people offer you...

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得自己不配娶这么迷人的女人。
ext.ext_en: He felt unworthy of being married to such an attractive woman.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is unworthy of something good, they do not deserve it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不相称的；与（某人）身份不相符的

ext.ext_cn: 梅尔维尔小姐忍不住问起来，虽然她知道自己不该问。
ext.ext_en: Miss Melville could not resist asking, although she knew it was unworthy of her...

ext.ext_cn: 他的指责与其首相身份不相称。
ext.ext_en: His accusations are unworthy of a prime minister.

defs.def_en: If you say that an action is unworthy of someone, you mean that it is not a nice thing to do and someone with their reputation or position should not do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 没有成就感的；无回报的

ext.ext_cn: 既辛苦又没有成就感的工作
ext.ext_en: ...dirty and unrewarding work...

ext.ext_cn: 把它完整地听下来后还是没多少收获。
ext.ext_en: Listening to it in its entirety is also fairly unrewarding.

defs.def_en: If you describe an activity as unrewarding, you mean that it does not give you any feelings of achievement or pleasure.
A caterpillar is a small, worm-like animal that feeds on plants and eventually develops into a butterfly or moth.
A phonecard is a plastic card that you can use instead of money to pay for telephone calls.
Brimstone is the same as sulphur .
When people talk about fire and brimstone, they are referring to hell and how they think people are punished there after death.

ext.ext_cn: 这条街上没有照明的路灯。
ext.ext_en: No streetlights illuminated the street...

ext.ext_cn: 叉状的闪电照亮了黑沉沉的天空。
ext.ext_en: The black sky was illuminated by forked lightning.

defs.def_en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

ext.ext_cn: 他们用游戏和图画来阐明他们的主题。
ext.ext_en: They use games and drawings to illuminate their subject.

defs.def_en: If you illuminate something that is unclear or difficult to understand, you make it clearer by explaining it carefully or giving information about it.
A eulogy is a speech or piece of writing that praises someone or something very much.
A eulogy is a speech, usually at a funeral, in which a person who has just died is praised.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 身穿制服、作风泼辣的红发女子
ext.ext_en: ...a pert redhead in uniform.

ext.ext_cn: 女佣唐突的回答
ext.ext_en: ...pert replies by servant girls.

defs.def_en: If someone describes a young woman as pert, they mean that they like her because she is lively and not afraid to say what she thinks. This use could cause offence.

ext.ext_cn: 查尔斯不光是有俏屁股和毛茸茸的胸脯。
ext.ext_en: But there is more to Charles than his pert bottom and hairy chest.

ext.ext_cn: 在她宽阔的额头和小巧的鼻子上闪烁的小雨滴
ext.ext_en: ...the tiny drops of rain gleaming on her wide forehead and her pert nose.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has, for example, a pert bottom or nose, you mean that it is quite small and neat, and you think it is attractive.

defs.def_cn: 茴芹（一种植物，其种子有很浓的气味和味道，常用于制作酒精饮料）
defs.def_en: Anise is a plant with seeds that have a strong smell and taste. It is often made into an alcoholic drink.

ext.ext_cn: 在英格兰，歌鸫是受保护物种，因此你在任何菜单上都找不到。
ext.ext_en: In England, thrushes are a protected species so you will not find them on any menu.

ext.ext_cn: 国家森林保护区
ext.ext_en: ...a protected zone of national forest.

defs.def_en: Protected is used to describe animals, plants, and areas of land which the law does not allow to be destroyed, harmed, or damaged.

ext.ext_cn: 高 6 英寸、直径 8 英寸的糖果罐子
ext.ext_en: ...a candy tin 6 inches high and 8 inches in diameter.

ext.ext_cn: 表面以下 18 英寸
ext.ext_en: ...18 inches below the surface.

defs.def_en: An inch is an imperial unit of length, approximately equal to 2.54 centimetres. There are twelve inches in a foot.

ext.ext_cn: 沿一面陡直石壁慢慢往上爬的人
ext.ext_en: ...a climber inching up a vertical wall of rock...

ext.ext_cn: 他一点点向前挪动着货车。
ext.ext_en: He inched the van forward...

defs.def_en: To inch somewhere or to inch something somewhere means to move there very slowly and carefully, or to make something do this.

defs.def_cn: (某个地方的)全部，每一寸地方

ext.ext_cn: 书架上全都塞满了书。
ext.ext_en: Every inch of shelf space was crammed with books...

ext.ext_cn: 我们时刻准备着为每一寸领土而战。
ext.ext_en: We are prepared to fight for every inch of territory.

defs.def_en: If you talk about every inch of an area, you are emphasizing that you mean the whole of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他完全是一副伦敦金融城商界人士的派头。
ext.ext_en: He looks every inch the City businessman...

ext.ext_cn: 格特鲁德站在那里,完全是一副明星的派头。
ext.ext_en: There stood Gertrude, looking every inch a star.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone looks every inch a certain type of person, you are emphasizing that they look exactly like that kind of person.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车一点一点地向前移动。
ext.ext_en: The car moved forward inch by inch...

ext.ext_cn: 警方在对那个地区进行仔细搜查。
ext.ext_en: The police were searching the area inch by inch.

defs.def_en: If someone or something moves inch by inch, they move very slowly and carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 他企图勒死一名边防警察并偷走他的枪。
ext.ext_en: He tried to strangle a border policeman and steal his gun...

ext.ext_cn: 他差点被自己的降落伞吊带勒死。
ext.ext_en: He was almost strangled by his parachute harness straps.

defs.def_en: To strangle someone means to kill them by squeezing their throat tightly so that they cannot breathe.

ext.ext_cn: 该国的经济困境阻碍了其科研机构的工作进展。
ext.ext_en: The country's economic plight is strangling its scientific institutions...

ext.ext_cn: 他的创造欲望已被他的政治负罪感扼杀了。
ext.ext_en: His creative drive has been strangled by his sense of political guilt.

defs.def_en: To strangle something means to prevent it from succeeding or developing.
A sweater is a warm knitted piece of clothing which covers the upper part of your body and your arms.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 快乐、关爱且和睦的家庭
ext.ext_en: ...a happy, loving and well adjusted family.

defs.def_en: A well-adjusted person has a mature personality and can control their emotions and deal with problems without becoming anxious.

ext.ext_cn: 琳迪戳了戳他的肋部。
ext.ext_en: Lindy poked him in the ribs.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰冲着他们笑了笑，开玩笑地捅了理查德一下。
ext.ext_en: John smiled at them and gave Richard a playful poke.

defs.def_en: If you poke someone or something, you quickly push them with your finger or with a sharp object.

ext.ext_cn: 他把手指插入孔中。
ext.ext_en: He poked his finger into the hole.

defs.def_en: If you poke one thing into another, you push the first thing into the second thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他看到那只狗一抽一抽的鼻子从篮子里冒出来。
ext.ext_en: He saw the dog's twitching nose poke out of the basket...

ext.ext_cn: 他的手指从手套的破指尖处露了出来。
ext.ext_en: His fingers poked through the worn tips of his gloves.

defs.def_en: If something pokes out of or through another thing, you can see part of it appearing from behind or underneath the other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 朱莉轻轻地敲了敲我的门，探进头来。
ext.ext_en: Julie tapped on my door and poked her head in...

ext.ext_cn: 我们无法伸出头去，看看发生了什么。
ext.ext_en: We hadn't been able to poke our heads out and see what was going on...

defs.def_en: If you poke your head through an opening or if it pokes through an opening, you push it through, often so that you can see something more easily.

ext.ext_cn: 航空业的周期性
ext.ext_en: ...the cyclical nature of the airline business.

defs.def_en: A cyclical process is one in which a series of events happens again and again in the same order.

ext.ext_cn: 他以睿智的政治头脑和强势的管理手腕出名。
ext.ext_en: He is known for his political savvy and strong management skills.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as having savvy, you think that they have a good understanding and practical knowledge of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有见识的;具有实际知识的;有经验的

ext.ext_cn: 她是个见过世面的漂亮女人。
ext.ext_en: She was a pretty savvy woman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as savvy, you think that they show a lot of practical knowledge.

ext.ext_cn: 多年来，这个国家一直处于该政权机构的高压统治下。
ext.ext_en: For many years, the country had been buried under the apparatus of the regime.

ext.ext_cn: 庞大的官僚机构
ext.ext_en: ...a massive bureaucratic apparatus.

defs.def_en: The apparatus of an organization or system is its structure and method of operation.

ext.ext_cn: 其中一个男孩须由带着呼吸装置的消防员才能救出。
ext.ext_en: One of the boys had to be rescued by firemen wearing breathing apparatus.

defs.def_en: Apparatus is the equipment, such as tools and machines, which is used to do a particular job or activity.

defs.def_cn: 使感伤;使带有感情色彩

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎要么怕女人要么就对她们怀有浪漫想法。
ext.ext_en: He seems either to fear women or to sentimentalize them...

ext.ext_cn: 他是那种煽起情来不遗余力的电影制作人。
ext.ext_en: He's the kind of filmmaker who doesn't hesitate to over-sentimentalize.

defs.def_en: If you sentimentalize something, you make it seem sentimental or think about it in a sentimental way.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我呆在家里，男友就会做可口的卤汁面条啦、鸡肉啦，或者牛排。
ext.ext_en: If I stay in my boyfriend cooks a wonderful lasagne or chicken or steak...

ext.ext_cn: 在有孩子前，我们认为每天晚上呆在家里的想法是很可怕的。
ext.ext_en: Before we had our child the idea of staying in every night would have been horrific.

defs.def_en: If you stay in during the evening, you remain at home and do not go out.

ext.ext_cn: 面积很小的列支敦士登公国
ext.ext_en: ...the tiny principality of Liechtenstein.

defs.def_en: A principality is a country that is ruled by a prince.

defs.def_cn: 性感女神(尤指电影明星)

ext.ext_cn: 拉克尔·韦尔奇作为一名性感女神红极一时。
ext.ext_en: Raquel Welch was at the height of her popularity as a sex goddess.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a woman, especially a film star, as a sex goddess, you mean that many people consider her to be sexually attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 他们互相朗诵诗歌。
ext.ext_en: They recited poetry to one another.

defs.def_en: When someone recites a poem or other piece of writing, they say it aloud after they have learned it.

ext.ext_cn: 他能做的只是列举政府的种种不是。
ext.ext_en: All he could do was recite a list of Government failings...

ext.ext_cn: 她突然意识到威姆正在念的是柯克的电话号码。
ext.ext_en: She suddenly realized that Wim was reciting Kirk's telephone number.

defs.def_en: If you recite something such as a list, you say it aloud.

defs.def_cn: （英国的建筑物）列入文物保护名册的

ext.ext_cn: 属于二级保护文物的一个17世纪农庄
ext.ext_en: ...a Grade II Listed 17th century farmhouse.

defs.def_en: In Britain, a listed building is protected by law against being destroyed or altered because it is historically or architecturally important.

ext.ext_cn: 他体重 11 英石 8 磅。
ext.ext_en: He weighs 11st 8lb.

defs.def_en: st is used as a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) stone when you are mentioning someone's  weight.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 心平气和的;性情温和的；平和的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个脾气非常好的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a man of the most equable temper...

ext.ext_en: He was a fine person to work with and he was very equable and a patient man.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as equable, you mean that they are calm, cheerful, and fair with other people, even in difficult circumstances.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 天气变得更加温和，粮食产量也已经提高。
ext.ext_en: The climate has grown more equable and the crop yields have risen.

defs.def_en: An equable climate stays at an even temperature and has no sudden changes.

A right-angled triangle has one angle that is a right angle.
A right-angled bend is a sharp bend that turns through approximately ninety degrees.

ext.ext_cn: 渡船拦腰撞上了我们的船。
ext.ext_en: The ferry hit us amidships.

defs.def_en: Amidships means halfway along the length of a ship.
A helicopter gunship is a helicopter with large guns attached to it.
A feeding bottle is a plastic bottle with a special rubber top through which a baby can suck milk or other liquids.

defs.def_cn: 求爱;恋爱;求爱(或恋爱)期

ext.ext_en: They were more interested in courtship and cars than in school...

ext.ext_cn: 恋爱没多长时间，她就接受了他的求婚。
ext.ext_en: After a short courtship, she accepted his marriage proposal.

defs.def_en: Courtship is the activity of courting or the time during which a man and a woman are courting.

ext.ext_cn: 雄性动物在求偶时会尽量展示自己，并发出一些声响。
ext.ext_en: Courtship is somewhat vocal with a lot of displaying by the male.

ext.ext_cn: 复杂的求偶舞
ext.ext_en: ...elaborate courtship dances.

defs.def_en: The courtship of male and female animals is their behaviour before they have sex.

ext.ext_cn: 1944年4月他在战时服役中阵亡。
ext.ext_en: In April 1944 he was killed on active service...

ext.ext_cn: 战争期间上校在婆罗洲服役并被授予一般服役奖章。
ext.ext_en: The colonel saw active service in Borneo and was awarded the General Service Medal.

defs.def_en: Someone who is on active service is taking part in a war as a member of the armed forces.
Brewers are people or companies who make beer.

ext.ext_cn: 一种以乙烯基为原料的现代地板革
ext.ext_en: ...a modern vinyl floor covering.

ext.ext_cn: 一把用闪闪发亮的蓝色乙烯基塑料做椅套的躺椅
ext.ext_en: ...a reclining chair upholstered in shiny blue vinyl.

defs.def_en: Vinyl is a strong plastic used for making things such as floor coverings and furniture.

defs.def_cn: （尤指区别于磁带和光盘的）塑料唱片，黑胶唱片

ext.ext_cn: 这张精选集在1984年首次以唱片形式发行。
ext.ext_en: This compilation was first issued on vinyl in 1984.

ext.ext_cn: 该专辑的唱片
ext.ext_en: ...the vinyl format of the album.

defs.def_en: You can use vinyl to refer to records, especially in contrast to cassettes or compact discs.

defs.def_cn: （指在通常的时间之前）早,提早,提前

ext.ext_cn: 我知道我得早起。
ext.ext_en: I knew I had to get up early...

ext.ext_cn: 为什么我们那么早就得上床睡觉？
ext.ext_en: Why do we have to go to bed so early?

defs.def_en: Early means before the usual time that a particular event or activity happens.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在20世纪70年代以及80年代早期
ext.ext_en: ...in the 1970s and the early 1980s.

ext.ext_cn: 初夏的几个星期
ext.ext_en: ...a few weeks in early summer...

defs.def_en: Early means near the beginning of a day, week, year, or other period of time.

defs.def_cn: （指在原定或预计的时间之前）早，提早,提前

ext.ext_cn: 为了能占个靠前的位置，她提早到了。
ext.ext_en: She arrived early to secure a place at the front...

ext.ext_cn: 第一场雪比往年提早了一个月。
ext.ext_en: The first snow came a month earlier than usual.

defs.def_en: Early means before the time that was arranged or expected.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （历史时期或事物存续期）早期的,初期的

ext.ext_cn: 怀孕初期
ext.ext_en: ...the early stages of pregnancy.

ext.ext_cn: 法斯宾德的早期影片
ext.ext_en: ...Fassbinder's early films...

defs.def_en: Early means near the beginning of a period in history, or in the history of something such as the world, a society, or an activity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 书的开头几章
ext.ext_en: ...the book's early chapters.

ext.ext_cn: 比赛刚开始时发生的一件事
ext.ext_en: ...an incident which occurred much earlier in the game.

defs.def_en: Early means near the beginning of something such as a piece of work or a process.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些早熟卷心菜和花椰菜
ext.ext_en: ...these early cabbages and cauliflowers.

ext.ext_cn: 早花灌木
ext.ext_en: ...early flowering shrubs.

defs.def_en: Early refers to plants which flower or crop before or at the beginning of the main season.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 开初的迹象看起来令人鼓舞。
ext.ext_en: The early indications look encouraging...

ext.ext_cn: 有关军队开火的最初传闻现在遭到了否认。
ext.ext_en: Earlier reports that troops opened fire are now being denied.

defs.def_en: Early reports or indications of something are the first reports or indications about it.

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀率最早有可能在本月就回落至个位数。
ext.ext_en: Inflation could fall back into single figures as early as this month.

ext.ext_cn: 早在1838年
ext.ext_en: ...as early as 1838.

defs.def_en: You can use as early as to emphasize that a particular time or period is surprisingly early.

ext.ext_cn: 弗朗西斯最终成为英格兰队主教练的几率可能更高。当然，现在这样说为时尚早，他还没赢过呢。
ext.ext_en: The chances of Francis eventually becoming manager of England are perhaps higher. It is early days, of course, and he has yet to win anything.

defs.def_en: If you say about something that might be true that it is early days, you mean that it is too soon for you to be completely sure about it.

ext.ext_cn: 共进午餐的邀请
ext.ext_en: ...an invitation to lunch...

ext.ext_cn: 叙利亚人还没有接到出席邀请。
ext.ext_en: The Syrians have not yet accepted an invitation to attend...

defs.def_en: An invitation is a written or spoken request to come to an event such as a party, a meal, or a meeting.

ext.ext_cn: 本周将寄出数百份请柬。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of invitations are being sent out this week.

ext.ext_cn: 烫金的请柬
ext.ext_en: ...gold embossed invitation cards.

defs.def_en: An invitation is the card or paper on which an invitation is written or printed.

ext.ext_cn: 一场大部分自由民主党人认为会招致灾难的战争
ext.ext_en: ...a war that most liberal Democrats regarded as an invitation to disaster...

ext.ext_cn: 别把买的东西放在汽车后座上——那会招来小偷的。
ext.ext_en: Don't leave your shopping on the back seat of your car —  it's an open invitation to a thief.

defs.def_en: If you believe that someone's action is likely to have a particular result, especially a bad one, you can refer to the action as an invitation to that result.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 工业化国家必须减少二氧化碳的排放。
ext.ext_en: Industrialized countries must reduce carbon dioxide emissions.

ext.ext_cn: 工业化世界
ext.ext_en: ...the industrialized world.

defs.def_en: An industrialized area or place is one which has a lot of industries.

ext.ext_cn: 诺尔玛·琼斯在当地一家化工厂当打包工。
ext.ext_en: Norma Jones worked as a packer in a local chemical factory.

defs.def_en: A packer is a worker whose job is to pack things into containers.
Cross-stitch is a type of decorative sewing where one stitch crosses another.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 活泼的；精力充沛的；生气勃勃的

ext.ext_cn: 她的性格可爱活泼。
ext.ext_en: She had a sweet, lively personality...

ext.ext_cn: 约瑟芬聪明、活泼、开朗。
ext.ext_en: Josephine was bright, lively and cheerful.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone as lively when they behave in an enthusiastic and cheerful way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （事件、讨论等）热闹的，热烈的，激烈的

ext.ext_cn: 结果这成了一场非常有意思的、气氛热烈的辩论会。
ext.ext_en: It turned out to be a very interesting session with a lively debate...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在洪都拉斯以4比1获胜的那场比赛尤其激动人心。
ext.ext_en: Their 4-1 win in Honduras was a particularly lively affair.

defs.def_en: A lively event or a lively discussion, for example, has lots of interesting and exciting things happening or being said in it.
