defs.def_en: If you describe someone as chauvinistic, you believe that they think their own country is more important and morally better than any other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 大男子主义的;男人至上的

ext.ext_cn: 我的前男友安东尼大男子主义思想很重。
ext.ext_en: My ex-boyfriend Anthony was very chauvinistic.

defs.def_en: If you describe a man or his behaviour as chauvinistic, you disapprove of him for believing that men are naturally better and more important than women.

ext.ext_cn: 此类艺术品在西方的首次展览
ext.ext_en: ...the first exhibition of such art in the West.

ext.ext_cn: 近现代美洲艺术
ext.ext_en: ...contemporary and modern American art.

defs.def_en: Art consists of paintings, sculpture, and other pictures or objects which are created for people to look at and admire or think deeply about.

defs.def_cn: （作为活动或教学科目的）美术

ext.ext_cn: 甘愿独自沉浸于绘画中的画家
ext.ext_en: ...a painter, content to be left alone with her all-absorbing art.

ext.ext_cn: 法纳姆美术设计学院
ext.ext_en: ...Farnham College of Art and Design.

defs.def_en: Art is the activity or educational subject that consists of creating paintings, sculptures, and other pictures or objects for people to look at and admire or think deeply about.

defs.def_cn: 艺术（活动）（如音乐、绘画、文学、电影、舞蹈等）

ext.ext_cn: 叶卡捷琳娜大帝赞助过各种艺术创作和科学研究。
ext.ext_en: Catherine the Great was a patron of the arts and sciences.

ext.ext_cn: 大不列颠艺术委员会
ext.ext_en: ...the Arts Council of Great Britain.

defs.def_en: The arts are activities such as music, painting, literature, cinema, and dance, which people can take part in for enjoyment, or to create works which express serious meanings or ideas of beauty.

ext.ext_cn: 人文和社会科学毕业生
ext.ext_en: ...arts and social science graduates.

ext.ext_cn: 文学院
ext.ext_en: ...the Faculty of Arts.

defs.def_en: At a university or college, arts are subjects such as history, literature, or languages in contrast to scientific subjects.

defs.def_cn: （用于剧院或电影院的名称中）上演艺术作品的，艺术的

ext.ext_cn: 剑桥艺术影院
ext.ext_en: ...the Cambridge Arts Cinema.

defs.def_en: Arts or art is used in the names of theatres or cinemas which show plays or films that are intended to make the audience think deeply about the content, and not simply to entertain them.

ext.ext_cn: 钓鱼是一门技术。
ext.ext_en: Fishing is an art.

ext.ext_cn: 勾引异性和谈情说爱的不科学的技巧
ext.ext_en: ...the unscientific arts of seduction and romance.

defs.def_en: If you describe an activity as an art, you mean that it requires skill and that people learn to do it by instinct or experience, rather than by learning facts or rules.

defs.def_cn: （be的现在式单数第二人称形式，过时用法）

ext.ext_cn: 父亲，我知道您无时无刻不在关心着我。
ext.ext_en: Father, I know thou art aware of me at all times.

defs.def_en: Art is an old-fashioned form of the second person singular of the present tense of the verb be.

defs.def_cn: 苏丹的;苏丹人的;苏丹文化的

ext.ext_cn: 苏丹政府
ext.ext_en: ...the Sudanese government.

ext.ext_cn: 苏丹南部城镇朱巴
ext.ext_en: ...the southern Sudanese town of Juba.

defs.def_en: Sudanese means belonging or relating to Sudan, or to its people or culture.

ext.ext_cn: 成千上万的苏丹人
ext.ext_en: ...tens of thousands of Sudanese.

defs.def_en: The Sudanese are the people of Sudan.

ext.ext_cn: 他的胫骨伤恢复得相当不错。
ext.ext_en: He made a remarkable recovery from a shin injury...

ext.ext_cn: 他的医生们认为他康复的几率不足1/500。
ext.ext_en: He had been given less than a one in 500 chance of recovery by his doctors.

defs.def_en: If a sick person makes a recovery, he or she becomes well again.

ext.ext_cn: 利率下调没有带来经济复苏。
ext.ext_en: Interest-rate cuts have failed to bring about economic recovery...

ext.ext_cn: 许多经济领域已经开始复苏。
ext.ext_en: In many sectors of the economy the recovery has started.

defs.def_en: When there is a recovery in a country's economy, it improves.

ext.ext_cn: 为追回特纳的一幅画，已发布了重金悬赏令。
ext.ext_en: A substantial reward is being offered for the recovery of a painting by Turner...

ext.ext_cn: 她有望从保险公司拿到赔偿。
ext.ext_en: She has a reasonable prospect of recovery from the insurer.

defs.def_en: You talk about the recovery of something when you get it back after it has been lost or stolen.

ext.ext_cn: 意识的突然丧失和恢复
ext.ext_en: ...the abrupt loss and recovery of consciousness.

defs.def_en: You talk about the recovery of someone's physical or mental state when they return to this state.

ext.ext_cn: 卡萝尔，一位正在戒断康复当中的大麻吸食者和酗酒者
ext.ext_en: ...Carole, a compulsive pot smoker and alcoholic in recovery.

defs.def_en: If someone is in recovery, they are being given a course of treatment to help them recover from something such as a drug habit or mental illness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一些教会领袖明确表示支持肯尼亚的政治改革。
ext.ext_en: Some church leaders have been outspoken in their support for political reform in Kenya...

ext.ext_cn: 他公开抨击种族隔离制度。
ext.ext_en: He was an outspoken critic of apartheid.

defs.def_en: Someone who is outspoken gives their opinions about things openly and honestly, even if they are likely to shock or offend people.

ext.ext_cn: 政变失败后，高层出现了急剧的变化。
ext.ext_en: Spectacular changes have taken place at the top since the failed putsch.

defs.def_en: A putsch is a sudden attempt to get rid of a government by force.
The change of life is the menopause .
A play on words is the same as a pun .

ext.ext_cn: 该项目的主要投资商是法国的国民信贷银行。
ext.ext_en: The main investor in the project is the French bank Credit National.

defs.def_en: An investor is a person or organization that buys stocks or shares, or pays money into a bank in order to receive a profit.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人满意的;恰当的;合适的

ext.ext_cn: 我从未得到令我满意的答复。
ext.ext_en: I never got a satisfactory answer...

ext.ext_cn: 这似乎是个非常令人满意的安排。
ext.ext_en: It seemed a very satisfactory arrangement...

defs.def_en: Something that is satisfactory is acceptable to you or fulfils a particular need or purpose.
Marshmallow is a soft, sweet food that is used in some cakes, puddings, and sweets.

ext.ext_cn: 用棉花软糖和巧克力做的小吃
ext.ext_en: ...a snack of marshmallows and chocolate.

defs.def_en: Marshmallows are sweets made from marshmallow.

ext.ext_cn: 这个小国家拥有令人惊叹的丰富的地貌类型。
ext.ext_en: This small country has an amazing variety of landforms.

ext.ext_cn: 冰川地貌
ext.ext_en: ...glacial land forms.

defs.def_en: A landform is any natural feature of the Earth's surface, such as a hill, a lake, or a beach.

defs.def_cn: 长老制的，长老会的（尤指苏格兰和美国的新教教会）

ext.ext_cn: 长老会牧师
ext.ext_en: ...a Presbyterian minister.

ext.ext_cn: 长时间的长老会布道
ext.ext_en: ...long Presbyterian sermons.

defs.def_en: Presbyterian means belonging or relating to a Protestant church, found especially in Scotland or the United States, which is governed by a body of official people all of equal rank.
A Presbyterian is a member of the Presbyterian church.
A snowball is a ball of snow. Children often throw snowballs at each other.

defs.def_cn: (项目、运动等)迅速增长，滚雪球般增长

ext.ext_cn: 这个企业从早期开始就一直在迅速地发展扩大。
ext.ext_en: From those early days the business has snowballed...

ext.ext_cn: 从那里开始，调查范围迅速扩大，有几人已经被逮捕。
ext.ext_en: The investigation snowballed from there and has since led to several arrests.

defs.def_en: If something such as a project or campaign snowballs, it rapidly increases and grows.

defs.def_cn: （一群人的）情绪失控，狂野情绪的爆发

ext.ext_cn: 所有人都不由自主地受到狂热情绪的感染。
ext.ext_en: No one could help getting carried away by the hysteria...

ext.ext_cn: 数人在恐慌中受了伤。“人们都疯了，”约翰·博德斯牧师说。
ext.ext_en: Several were hurt in the panic. 'It was mass hysteria,' said Rev John Borders.

defs.def_en: Hysteria among a group of people is a state of uncontrolled excitement, anger, or panic.

ext.ext_cn: 现在她正在尖叫，完全处于癔病发作状态。
ext.ext_en: By now, she was screaming, completely overcome with hysteria.

defs.def_en: A person who is suffering from hysteria is in a state of violent and disturbed emotion as a result of shock.

ext.ext_cn: 熏肉煎蛋
ext.ext_en: ...bacon and eggs.

ext.ext_cn: 烟熏五花肉
ext.ext_en: ...smoked streaky bacon.

defs.def_en: Bacon is salted or smoked meat which comes from the back or sides of a pig.

ext.ext_cn: 选民感兴趣的是代表能否兑现承诺。
ext.ext_en: Voters are interested in the representative's ability to bring home the bacon...

ext.ext_cn: 我就不信这本书不畅销。
ext.ext_en: I will be most upset if this book does not bring home the bacon.

defs.def_en: If you bring home the bacon ,you achieve what you needed to achieve.

ext.ext_cn: 是谁抚养孩子的，是谁赚钱养家的？
ext.ext_en: Who brings up the baby and who brings home the bacon?

defs.def_en: The person in a family who brings home the bacon provides the family with the money they need to live.

ext.ext_cn: 你母亲帮过我一次大忙，在我需要的时候借过钱给我。
ext.ext_en: Your mother once saved my bacon. She lent me money when I needed it.

defs.def_en: If someone or something saves your bacon, they get you out of a dangerous or difficult situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他受到如此对待让我气愤。
ext.ext_en: I'm  disgusted with the way that he was treated...

ext.ext_cn: 他对一位英国大臣竟有如此丢人的举止感到厌恶。
ext.ext_en: He was disgusted that a British minister could have behaved so disgracefully.

defs.def_en: If you are disgusted, you feel a strong sense of dislike and disapproval at something.

ext.ext_cn: 警察封锁了市中心的部分地区。
ext.ext_en: Police cordoned off part of the city centre...

ext.ext_cn: 警察将一切都封锁了。
ext.ext_en: The police cordoned everything off.

defs.def_en: If police or soldiers cordon off an area, they prevent people from entering or leaving it, usually by forming a line or ring.

ext.ext_cn: 人们应该小心自己的财物，不要随便乱放。
ext.ext_en: People should be careful about their possessions and not leave them lying around...

ext.ext_cn: 我爸爸有几本鲍勃·迪伦和披头士乐队的歌集不知道扔家里什么地方了。
ext.ext_en: My dad had a couple of Bob Dylan and Beatles songbooks lying around the house.

defs.def_en: If things are left lying around or lying about, they are not tidied away but left casually somewhere where they can be seen.

ext.ext_cn: 我会什么都不干，就只悠闲地晒晒太阳。
ext.ext_en: I'll just lie around in the sun...

ext.ext_cn: 科恩星期天一整天都在家无所事事。
ext.ext_en: On Sunday Cohen lay around the house all day.

defs.def_en: If you lie around or lie about, you spend your time relaxing and being lazy.

ext.ext_cn: 为树立联合国的威望所作的努力
ext.ext_en: ...efforts to build up the prestige of the United Nations...

ext.ext_en: It was his responsibility for foreign affairs that gained him international prestige.

defs.def_en: If a person, a country, or an organization has prestige, they are admired and respected because of the position they hold or the things they have achieved.

defs.def_cn: 气派的；贵重的；令人敬仰的

ext.ext_cn: 像凯迪拉克、奔驰、保时捷和捷豹这样气派的汽车
ext.ext_en: ...such prestige cars as Cadillac, Mercedes, Porsche and Jaguar.

defs.def_en: Prestige is used to describe products, places, or activities which people admire because they are associated with being rich or having a high social position.
In a car or other vehicle, the steering wheel is the wheel which the driver holds when he or she is driving.
A mother-to-be is a woman who is pregnant, especially for the first time.
A lamp-post is a tall metal or concrete pole that is fixed beside a road and has a light at the top.

ext.ext_cn: 他如此大声喧闹，我怕他打扰了邻居。
ext.ext_en: He makes such a racket I'm afraid he disturbs the neighbours...

ext.ext_cn: 我的睡梦被隔壁极为恼人的吵闹声给搅了。
ext.ext_en: My dream was interrupted by the most awful racket coming through the walls...

defs.def_en: A racket is a loud unpleasant noise.

ext.ext_cn: 走私活动每年都会导致数千只珍奇鸟类死亡。
ext.ext_en: A smuggling racket is killing thousands of exotic birds each year.

ext.ext_cn: 起了疑心的爱好者揭发了这一勾当，警察在诺丁汉逮捕了一名男子。
ext.ext_en: Suspicious fans exposed the racket and police arrested a man in Nottingham.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an illegal activity used to make money as a racket .

defs.def_cn: （网球、壁球、羽毛球等用的）球拍

ext.ext_cn: 提供网球拍及网球。
ext.ext_en: Tennis rackets and balls are provided.

defs.def_en: A racket is an oval-shaped bat with strings across it. Rackets are used in tennis, squash, and badminton.
Rackets is a game which is similar to squash but which is played with a hard ball.
A pharmacopoeia is an official book that lists all the drugs that can be used to treat people in a particular country, and describes how to use them.
A field event is an athletics contest such as the high jump or throwing the discus or javelin, rather than a race.

defs.def_cn: （印度教和佛教信仰的）羯磨，业（认为今世的行为会影响来世）
defs.def_en: In religions such as Hinduism and Buddhism, karma is the belief that your actions in this life affect all your future lives.
Needn't is the usual spoken form of 'need not'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 精明练达的;圆滑的;温文尔雅的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个世故、冷静、有教养的人。
ext.ext_en: He is a suave, cool and cultured man.

defs.def_en: Someone who is suave is charming, polite, and elegant, but may be insincere.

ext.ext_cn: 全球核试验禁令
ext.ext_en: ...a global ban on nuclear testing...

ext.ext_en: On a global scale, AIDS may well become the leading cause of infant death.

defs.def_en: You can use global to describe something that happens in all parts of the world or affects all parts of the world.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the global view, the ability to make wider decisions based on a knowledge of all the facts, not just some of them.

ext.ext_cn: 对当代社会的总体看法
ext.ext_en: ...a global vision of contemporary societies.

defs.def_en: A global view or vision of a situation is one in which all the different aspects of it are considered.

ext.ext_cn: 她又回到了画室，在一张大帆布上作画。
ext.ext_en: She was in her studio again, painting onto a large canvas.

defs.def_en: A studio is a room where a painter, photographer, or designer works.

defs.def_cn: (广播、电视的)录音室，录像室，演播室;(唱片、电影的)录音棚，制作室

ext.ext_cn: 与在录音棚里录音相比，她更喜欢现场表演。
ext.ext_en: She's much happier performing live than in a recording studio.

defs.def_en: A studio is a room where radio or television programmes are recorded, CDs are produced, or films are made.

defs.def_cn: 电影公司;电影制片厂;唱片公司

ext.ext_cn: 她写信给派拉蒙电影公司，询问他们是否同意让她去试镜。
ext.ext_en: She wrote to Paramount Studios and asked if they would audition her.

defs.def_en: You can also refer to film-making or recording companies as studios .

defs.def_cn: 单间公寓(一个房间兼作起居室和卧室，带厨房和卫生间)

ext.ext_cn: 我自己住在一个单间公寓里。
ext.ext_en: I live on my own in a studio flat.

defs.def_en: A studio is a small flat with one room for living and sleeping in, a kitchen, and a bathroom. You can also talk about a studio flat in British English or a studio apartment in American English.

ext.ext_cn: 数百只苍蝇围着我们转，工作人员不停地拍打。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of flies buzz around us, and the workman keeps swatting them.

ext.ext_cn: 母亲打了杰克胳膊一下。
ext.ext_en: Mother took a swat at Jack's arm.

defs.def_en: If you swat something such as an insect, you hit it with a quick, swinging movement, using your hand or a flat object.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 阿姆里塔成了一个勇敢无畏的叛逆者。
ext.ext_en: Amrita becomes a bold, daring rebel...

ext.ext_cn: 在1960年，这是一个大胆的举动。
ext.ext_en: In 1960 this was a bold move...

defs.def_en: Someone who is bold is not afraid to do things which involve risk or danger.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （在众人面前）大胆的，放肆的，莽撞的

ext.ext_cn: 我不觉得我有什么唐突，因为我素来心直口快，有什么烦心的都会说出来。
ext.ext_en: I don't feel I'm being bold, because it's always been natural for me to just speak out about whatever disturbs me.

defs.def_en: Someone who is bold is not shy or embarrassed in the company of other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 色彩鲜艳、浓淡不一的红、蓝、白色花朵
ext.ext_en: ...bold flowers in various shades of red, blue or white.

ext.ext_cn: 醒目生动的色彩
ext.ext_en: ...bold, dramatic colours.

defs.def_en: A bold colour or pattern is very bright and noticeable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 每幅图片的彩样都单独印在一页上，而在该页的背面会映出清晰的轮廓。
ext.ext_en: Each picture is shown in colour on one page and as a bold outline on the opposite page.

defs.def_en: Bold lines or designs are drawn in a clear, strong way.
Bold is print which is thicker and looks blacker than ordinary printed letters.

ext.ext_cn: 他这人确实有点怪。
ext.ext_en: He was definitely a bit of an odd bod.

defs.def_en: A bod is a person.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰一边以每小时90英里的速度跟踪这个司机，一边向警方监控室描述该司机的异常行为。
ext.ext_en: John gave the police control room a running commentary on the driver's antics as he followed him at 90mph.

defs.def_en: If someone provides a running commentary on an event, they give a continuous description of it while it is taking place.
A bib is a piece of cloth or plastic which is worn by very young children to protect their clothes while they are eating.

defs.def_cn: (通常指由于突出或极端而)著名地，出名地

ext.ext_cn: 作者们不了解出版界的实际情况，这是人所共知的。
ext.ext_en: Authors are famously ignorant about the realities of publishing...

ext.ext_cn: 众所周知，雷恩的墓志铭中写道，大教堂本身就是他的纪念碑。
ext.ext_en: As Wren's epitaph famously declares, the cathedral itself is his monument.

defs.def_en: You use famously to refer to a fact that is well known, usually because it is remarkable or extreme.

ext.ext_cn: 我和利里第一次见面就相处甚欢。
ext.ext_en: I got on famously with Leary from the first time we met.

defs.def_en: If you get on or get along famously with someone, you are very friendly with each other and enjoy meeting and being together.

ext.ext_cn: 通过张开的毛孔排出汗液和污垢。
ext.ext_en: Your open pores excrete sweat and dirt...

ext.ext_cn: 钙通过尿液和粪便排出体外。
ext.ext_en: Calcium is excreted in the urine and stools.

defs.def_en: When a person or animal excretes waste matter from their body, they get rid of it in faeces, urine, or sweat.
An aubergine is a vegetable with a smooth, dark purple skin.
A hiding place is a place where someone or something can be hidden, or where they are hiding.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 任性的；故意作对的；无理取闹的

ext.ext_cn: 阻止这种健康发展的趋势是没有道理的。
ext.ext_en: It would be perverse to stop this healthy trend...

ext.ext_cn: 精神治疗师们经常幸灾乐祸地批评自己的同行。
ext.ext_en: Psychotherapists often take a perverse delight in criticizing other psychotherapists...

defs.def_en: Someone who is perverse deliberately does things that are unreasonable or that result in harm for themselves.

defs.def_cn: （表示令人满意或可以接受）不错的，可以的

ext.ext_cn: 可以使用武器的射击场
ext.ext_en: ...a shooting range where it's OK to use weapons...

ext.ext_cn: 我一个人来行吗？
ext.ext_en: Is it okay if I come by myself?...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is okay, you find it satisfactory or acceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 看看孩子是否还好。
ext.ext_en: Check that the baby's okay...

ext.ext_cn: “别担心我，”我说，“我不会有事的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Don't worry about me,' I said. 'I'll be okay.'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is okay, you mean that they are safe and well.

ext.ext_cn: “就跟他说肯尼思爵士想跟他谈谈。”——“好的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Just tell him Sir Kenneth would like to talk to him.' — 'OK.'...

ext.ext_cn: “我星期五给你打电话好吗？”——“好的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Shall I give you a ring on Friday?' — 'Yeah okay.'

defs.def_en: You can say 'Okay' to show that you agree to something.

defs.def_cn: （询问对方是否领会或同意）好吗，行吗，明白吗

ext.ext_cn: 把它们相加再除以5就是平均数，明白吗？
ext.ext_en: Add them together, divide by five, and you've got the average. Okay?...

ext.ext_cn: 我们下周聚一聚，好吗？
ext.ext_en: We'll get together next week, OK?

defs.def_en: You can say 'Okay?' to check whether the person you are talking to understands what you have said and accepts it.

defs.def_cn: （表示希望转换话题或做别的事情）好了

ext.ext_cn: 好了，我们现在言归正传吧。
ext.ext_en: OK. Now, let's talk some business...

ext.ext_cn: 蒂姆一跃而起，“好了，我们走吧。”
ext.ext_en: Tim jumped to his feet. 'Okay, let's go.'

defs.def_en: You can use okay to indicate that you want to start talking about something else or doing something else.

defs.def_cn: （不情愿地表示接受对方观点以制止其争辩）得了，行了

ext.ext_cn: 行了，是略有不同。
ext.ext_en: Okay, there is a slight difference...

ext.ext_cn: 得了，我就算42岁吧。
ext.ext_en: Okay, so I'm forty-two.

defs.def_en: You can use okay to stop someone arguing with you by showing that you accept the point they are making, though you do not necessarily regard it as very important.

ext.ext_cn: 医生不会同意他去旅行。
ext.ext_en: His doctor wouldn't OK the trip...

ext.ext_cn: 我们都很疑惑为什么政府突然批准在岛上建一所新学校。
ext.ext_en: We are all wondering why the government is suddenly okaying a brand new school on the island.

defs.def_en: If someone in authority okays something, they officially agree to it or allow it to happen.
A car-jacker is someone who attacks and steals from people who are driving their own cars.
Banknotes are pieces of paper money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (自然资源)可持续的，不破坏环境的

ext.ext_cn: 森林的管理、保护和可持续发展
ext.ext_en: ...the management, conservation and sustainable development of forests...

ext.ext_cn: 尽量购买来自可持续发展林的木材。
ext.ext_en: Try to buy wood that you know has come from a sustainable source.

defs.def_en: You use sustainable to describe the use of natural resources when this use is kept at a steady level that is not likely to damage the environment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (计划、方法、体制)可持续的，持续性的

ext.ext_cn: 建立一套高效稳定的交通体系对伦敦的长远发展意义重大。
ext.ext_en: The creation of an efficient and sustainable transport system is critical to the long-term future of London.

ext.ext_cn: 消费支出的持续性复苏
ext.ext_en: ...a sustainable recovery in consumer spending.

defs.def_en: A sustainable plan, method, or system is designed to continue at the same rate or level of activity without any problems.

ext.ext_cn: 几个月来，整个国家一直处于政治动荡状态。
ext.ext_en: The whole country has been in a state of political ferment for some months.

defs.def_en: Ferment is excitement and trouble caused by change or uncertainty.

ext.ext_cn: 让干葡萄发酵，直到糖分全部脱出，酒无甜味。
ext.ext_en: The dried grapes are allowed to ferment until there is no sugar left and the wine is dry...

ext.ext_cn: 为了满足面包店主的需要，制造商让酵母发酵，以生产出浓度更高的产品。
ext.ext_en: To serve the needs of bakers, manufacturers ferment the yeast to produce a more concentrated product.

defs.def_en: If a food, drink, or other natural substance ferments, or if it is fermented, a chemical change takes place in it so that alcohol is produced. This process forms part of the production of alcoholic drinks such as wine and beer.
An antigen is a substance that helps the production of antibodies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 貌似这里往北的地方有个非常机密的项目正在进行。
ext.ext_en: Apparently there's a very hush-hush project under way up north...

ext.ext_cn: 他们拼命想要瞒住这桩婚事。
ext.ext_en: They were desperate to keep the marriage hush-hush.

defs.def_en: Something that is hush-hush is secret and not to be discussed with other people.

ext.ext_cn: 茅草屋顶的椽子上挂着几串干洋葱和蒜。
ext.ext_en: From the rafters of the thatched roofs hung strings of dried onions and garlic.

defs.def_en: Rafters are the sloping pieces of wood that support a roof.

ext.ext_cn: 叙利亚的塞尔柱王朝始建于 1094 年。
ext.ext_en: The Seljuk dynasty of Syria was founded in 1094.

defs.def_en: A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family.

ext.ext_cn: 可以追溯到明朝的雕刻
ext.ext_en: ...carvings dating back to the Ming dynasty.

defs.def_en: A dynasty is a period of time during which a country is ruled by members of the same family.

defs.def_cn: 王朝(指同一家族在某领域，如政界或商界，有两代以上的重要领袖或权威人物)

ext.ext_cn: 肯尼迪王朝
ext.ext_en: ...the Kennedy dynasty.

defs.def_en: A dynasty is a family which has members from two or more generations who are important in a particular field of activity, for example in business or politics.

defs.def_cn: 使浪漫化;使传奇化;使具有浪漫色彩

ext.ext_cn: 当他对现在不再抱任何幻想时，便把过去想得非常浪漫。
ext.ext_en: He romanticized the past as he became disillusioned with his present.

defs.def_en: If you romanticize someone or something, you think or talk about them in a way which is not at all realistic and which makes them seem better than they really are.

defs.def_cn: 方山(主要见于美国西南部)
defs.def_en: A mesa is a large hill with a flat top and steep sides; used mainly of hills in the south-western United States.
Down's syndrome is a disorder that some people are born with. People who have Down's syndrome have a flat forehead and sloping eyes and lower than average intelligence.

defs.def_cn: 使(某人)想要却得不到(某物);逗引;挑逗;撩拨

ext.ext_cn: 那个男孩会到房间里拿狗食逗弄狗。
ext.ext_en: The boy would come into the room and tantalize the dog with his feed.

ext.ext_cn: 他们可望而不可即的民主梦想
ext.ext_en: ...the dreams of democracy that have so tantalized them.

defs.def_en: If someone or something tantalizes you, they make you feel hopeful and excited about getting what you want, usually before disappointing you by not letting you have what they appeared to offer.

defs.def_cn: 使（权力、习俗、观念等）根深蒂固

ext.ext_cn: 旨在巩固民主和法制的一系列措施
ext.ext_en: ...a series of measures designed to entrench democracy and the rule of law...

ext.ext_cn: 这些独裁者在政治上已经站稳了脚跟，很难推翻他们。
ext.ext_en: These dictators have entrenched themselves politically and are difficult to move.

defs.def_en: If something such as power, a custom, or an idea is entrenched, it is firmly established, so that it would be difficult to change it.

ext.ext_cn: 苯蒸发了,形成了一大团气体。
ext.ext_en: The benzene vaporized and formed a huge cloud of gas...

ext.ext_cn: 爆炸可能使陨石气化了。
ext.ext_en: The blast may have vaporised the meteorite.

defs.def_en: If a liquid or solid vaporizes or if you vaporize it, it changes into vapour or gas.

defs.def_cn: 移居，迁徙(尤指到外地寻找工作或暂住一段时间)

ext.ext_cn: 人们为找工作而迁移到雅加达这类城市里。
ext.ext_en: People migrate to cities like Jakarta in search of work...

ext.ext_cn: 农民们已经认识到，想要生存就必须外出打工。
ext.ext_en: Farmers have learned that they have to migrate if they want to survive.

defs.def_en: If people migrate, they move from one place to another, especially in order to find work or to live somewhere for a short time.

defs.def_cn: (鸟类、鱼类、兽类等随季节变化)迁徙

ext.ext_cn: 绝大多数鸟类为了迁徙都不得不进行长距离的飞行。
ext.ext_en: Most birds have to fly long distances to migrate.

ext.ext_cn: 导致鱼类在从溪流向海洋迁徙途中死亡的水坝体系
ext.ext_en: ...a dam system that kills the fish as they migrate from streams to the ocean.

defs.def_en: When birds, fish, or animals migrate, they move at a particular season from one part of the world or from one part of a country to another, usually in order to breed or to find new feeding grounds.
Your eye sockets are the two hollow parts on either side of your face, where your eyeballs are.

ext.ext_cn: 免税的投资计划
ext.ext_en: ...a tax-free investment plan.

ext.ext_cn: 16.5% 的免税回报
ext.ext_en: ...a return of 16.5% tax free...

defs.def_en: Tax-free is used to describe income on which you do not have to pay tax.

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪最了不起的辩论家非列昂·托洛茨基莫属。
ext.ext_en: The greatest polemicist of the 20th century must be Leon Trotsky.

defs.def_en: A polemicist is someone who is skilled at arguing very strongly for or against a belief or opinion.

ext.ext_cn: 抢劫老人的胆小恶棍
ext.ext_en: ...the cowardly thugs who mug old people.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a violent person or criminal as a thug .

ext.ext_cn: 这展现了她作为设计师的真正天赋。
ext.ext_en: This is the mark of her real genius as a designer...

ext.ext_cn: 这人很有天赋，在航空界非常出名。
ext.ext_en: The man had genius and had made his mark in the aviation world...

defs.def_en: Genius is very great ability or skill in a particular subject or activity.

ext.ext_cn: 卓别林不仅仅是天才，也是电影史上最有影响力的人物之一。
ext.ext_en: Chaplin was not just a genius, he was among the most influential figures in film history.

defs.def_en: A genius is a highly talented, creative, or intelligent person.
Someone's foe is their enemy.

defs.def_cn: 议论纷纷的;嘈杂的;闹哄哄的

ext.ext_cn: 整个华盛顿都对白宫内发生的混乱议论纷纷。
ext.ext_en: Washington has been abuzz with stories about disarray inside the White House.

defs.def_en: If someone says that a place is abuzz with rumours or plans, they mean that everyone there is excited about them.

defs.def_cn: 隐姓埋名的;隐匿身份的

ext.ext_cn: 酒店检查员巡查时必须隐瞒真实身份。
ext.ext_en: Hotel inspectors have to travel incognito...

ext.ext_cn: 他更喜欢继续隐姓埋名下去。
ext.ext_en: He preferred to remain incognito.

defs.def_en: Someone who is incognito is using a false name or wearing a disguise, in order not to be recognized or identified.

defs.def_cn: (在否定句中用于 neither 之后以引出第二项或几项中的最后一项)也不，也没有

ext.ext_cn: 昨天罗斯先生和伍德黑德先生都无暇发表意见。
ext.ext_en: Neither Mr Rose nor Mr Woodhead was available for comment yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 我既不能给你意见，也不能提供任何建议。
ext.ext_en: I can give you neither an opinion nor any advice...

defs.def_en: You use nor after 'neither' in order to introduce the second alternative or the last of a number of alternatives in a negative statement.

defs.def_cn: (用于否定陈述后，表示该否定句也适用于自己、其他人或其他事物)也不，也没有

ext.ext_cn: “我们没有人知道要在这儿呆多久。”——“我也不知道。”
ext.ext_en: 'None of us has any idea how long we're going to be here.' — 'Nor do I.'...

ext.ext_cn: “如果我丈夫没有前途，”她说，“那我的孩子们也没有。”
ext.ext_en: 'If my husband has no future,' she said, 'then nor do my children.'...

defs.def_en: You use nor after a negative statement in order to indicate that the negative statement also applies to you or to someone or something else.

defs.def_cn: (用于否定句后，引出另一否定句补充前句)

ext.ext_cn: 烹饪快餐并不意味着牺牲风味，快餐也不见得就一定是垃圾食品。
ext.ext_en: Cooking up a quick dish doesn't mean you have to sacrifice flavour. Nor does fast food have to be junk food.

defs.def_en: You use nor after a negative statement in order to introduce another negative statement which adds information to the previous one.

ext.ext_cn: 他不得不把11点的会议提前，这样他就可以准时赶去参加葬礼。
ext.ext_en: He had to bring forward an 11 o'clock meeting so that he could get to the funeral on time...

ext.ext_cn: 选举日期必须提前两个月。
ext.ext_en: The election date had to be brought forward by two months.

defs.def_en: If you bring forward a meeting or event, you arrange for it to take place at an earlier date or time than had been planned.

ext.ext_cn: 政府将向立法部门提交几项议案。
ext.ext_en: The Government will bring forward several proposals for legislation.

defs.def_en: If you bring forward an argument or proposal, you state it so that people can consider it.

ext.ext_cn: 她威胁说如果他离开她，她就将他双重人格的生活方式公之于众。
ext.ext_en: She threatened to publicly expose his double life if he left her.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is living a double life, you mean that they lead two separate and very different lives, and they appear to be a different person in each.

ext.ext_cn: 在访问签证到期后，他又在美国非法居住了5年。
ext.ext_en: He had lived illegally in the United States for five years after his visitor's visa expired.

defs.def_en: When something such as a contract, deadline, or visa expires, it comes to an end or is no longer valid.

ext.ext_cn: 在最终离世前他经受了极大的痛苦。
ext.ext_en: He endured excruciating agonies before he finally expired.

defs.def_en: When someone expires, they die.

defs.def_cn: (石头或地面的)罅隙，裂隙，裂口

ext.ext_cn: 岩石之间人无法通过的一条窄缝
ext.ext_en: ...a narrow cleft in the rocks too small for humans to enter.

defs.def_en: A cleft in a rock or in the ground is a narrow opening in it.
A cleft in someone's chin is a line down the middle of it.
If someone has a cleft chin, they have a cleft in their chin.

defs.def_cn: 左右为难的；进退维谷的
defs.def_en: If you say that a person or organization is in a cleft stick, you mean that they are in a difficult situation which will bring them problems and harm whatever they decide to do.

ext.ext_cn: 办公室职员
ext.ext_en: ...office workers...

ext.ext_cn: 该协会在物色一位有能力的研究人员。
ext.ext_en: The society was looking for a capable research worker.

defs.def_en: A particular kind of worker does the kind of work mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 工资被冻结，工人下岗。
ext.ext_en: Wages have been frozen and workers laid off.

ext.ext_cn: 呼吁全世界工人团结起来的号召
ext.ext_en: ...a call for the workers of the world to unite...

defs.def_en: Workers are people who are employed in industry or business and who are not managers.

ext.ext_cn: 他工作很努力，对园艺很在行。
ext.ext_en: He is a hard worker and a skilled gardener...

ext.ext_cn: 她技艺高超，操作着复杂的提花织布机。
ext.ext_en: A first-class worker, she operated the difficult Jacquard looms.

defs.def_en: See also:care worker;caseworker;dock worker;social worker;teleworker;youth worker;You can use worker to say how well or badly someone works.

ext.ext_cn: 他穿着一件紫红色的涤纶夹克。
ext.ext_en: He was wearing a burgundy polyester jacket.

ext.ext_cn: 紫红色的扶手椅
ext.ext_en: ...burgundy-coloured armchairs.

defs.def_en: Burgundy is used to describe things that are purplish-red in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 一瓶勃艮第白葡萄酒
ext.ext_en: ...a bottle of white burgundy.

defs.def_en: Burgundy is a type of wine. It can be white or red in colour and comes from the region of France called Burgundy.

ext.ext_cn: 很显然，自然灾害也是造成该大陆经济危机的原因之一。
ext.ext_en: Natural disasters have obviously contributed to the continent's economic crisis...

ext.ext_cn: 人们认为意大利的政治体系几十年来一直存在着严重危机。
ext.ext_en: The Italian political system has been judged to be in terminal crisis for decades.

defs.def_en: A crisis is a situation in which something or someone is affected by one or more very serious problems.

defs.def_cn: 大学的;学院的;大学生的

ext.ext_cn: 密歇根大学获得了1933年全国大学生橄榄球赛的冠军。
ext.ext_en: The 1933 national collegiate football championship was won by Michigan.

ext.ext_cn: 大学生活
ext.ext_en: ...collegiate life.

defs.def_en: Collegiate means belonging or relating to a college or to college students.

defs.def_cn: 超过，超出（某数量、数字等）

ext.ext_cn: 其研究预算每年超过7亿美元。
ext.ext_en: Its research budget exceeds $700 million a year...

ext.ext_cn: 某些学校的入学申请人数超过了招生。
ext.ext_en: The demand for places at some schools exceeds the supply...

defs.def_en: If something exceeds a particular amount or number, it is greater or larger than that amount or number.

ext.ext_cn: 他承认自己超速了。
ext.ext_en: He accepts he was exceeding the speed limit...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我命令停止游行，我就越权了。
ext.ext_en: I would be exceeding my powers if I ordered the march to be halted.

defs.def_en: If you exceed a limit or rule, you go beyond it, even though you are not supposed to or it is against the law.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 莉萨突然笑容满面地出现在门口时，她吓了一跳。
ext.ext_en: She was startled when Lisa popped up at the door all smiles...

ext.ext_cn: 你解决完一个问题，另一个问题又会马上冒出来。
ext.ext_en: You solved one problem and another would immediately pop up.

defs.def_en: pop-up;If someone or something pops up, they appear in a place or situation unexpectedly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我儿子是个安静温和的人，喜欢运动和享受生活。
ext.ext_en: My son was a quiet and gentle man who liked sports and enjoyed life...

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔的嗓音轻柔而且抚慰人心。
ext.ext_en: Michael's voice was gentle and consoling.

defs.def_en: Someone who is gentle is kind, mild, and calm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不激烈的网球比赛
ext.ext_en: ...a gentle game of tennis...

ext.ext_cn: 他的动作舒缓而从容。
ext.ext_en: His movements were gentle and deliberate.

defs.def_en: Gentle actions or movements are performed in a calm and controlled manner, with little force.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （天气）温和的； （尤指风）和煦的，微弱的

ext.ext_cn: 呼啸的春风已经减弱，成了习习的微风。
ext.ext_en: The blustery winds of spring had dropped to a gentle breeze.

defs.def_en: If you describe the weather, especially the wind, as gentle, you mean it is pleasant and calm and not harsh or violent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 缓缓起伏的牧场
ext.ext_en: ...gentle, rolling meadows...

ext.ext_cn: 有两个超过13,000英尺的山口，但坡度平缓。
ext.ext_en: There were two passes over 13,000 feet but the slopes were gentle.

defs.def_en: A gentle slope or curve is not steep or severe.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 用文火煮30分钟。
ext.ext_en: Cook for 30 minutes over a gentle heat.

defs.def_en: A gentle heat is a fairly low heat.
A roll-neck sweater or a roll-necked sweater is a sweater with a high neck that can be rolled over.
A roll-neck is a roll-neck sweater.

ext.ext_cn: 在许多地方有了改进,例如,鼠标的左右键都可以使用了。
ext.ext_en: There are a number of improvements; for instance, both mouse buttons can now be used...

ext.ext_cn: 让孩子在日常生活中作一些小决定。比如,让他自己决定周末穿什么衣服。
ext.ext_en: Let your child make some of the small decisions concerning his daily routine. For instance, allow him to choose what clothes he wears at the weekend.

defs.def_en: You use for instance to introduce a particular event, situation, or person that is an example of what you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 她举了一个所受训练为解决问题帮了大忙的实例。
ext.ext_en: She cited an instance where their training had been a marvelous help in dealing with problems.

ext.ext_cn: 对一起严重的腐败事件的调查
ext.ext_en: ...an investigation into a serious instance of corruption.

defs.def_en: An instance is a particular example or occurrence of something.

ext.ext_cn: 你的孩子将首先由耳鼻喉专科医生来诊察。
ext.ext_en: In the first instance your child will be seen by an ear, nose and throat specialist...

ext.ext_cn: 该岗位初始为一年期,有可能会再续聘一年。
ext.ext_en: The post was for one year in the first instance with possible renewal to a further year.

defs.def_en: You say in the first instance to mention something that is the first step in a series of actions.

ext.ext_cn: 集会是应两位资深内阁大臣的要求组织的。
ext.ext_en: The rally was organised at the instance of two senior cabinet ministers.

defs.def_en: If you do something at someone's instance, you do it because they have ordered or requested you to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一张长脸、面色悲戚的瘦高男子
ext.ext_en: ...a tall, thin man with a long and lugubrious face...

ext.ext_cn: 有些段落他演奏得异常徐缓,听上去有些忧伤。
ext.ext_en: He plays some passages so slowly that they become lugubrious.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is lugubrious, you mean that they are sad rather than lively or cheerful.

ext.ext_cn: 我 15 岁了，还没有亲过一个女孩。
ext.ext_en: I'm 15 and I've never snogged a girl...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在一座桥下面拥抱接吻。
ext.ext_en: They were snogging under a bridge...

defs.def_en: If one person snogs another, they kiss and hold that person for a period of time. You can also say that two people are snogging .

ext.ext_cn: 充满诺曼人智慧的歌舞杂耍滑稽表演
ext.ext_en: ...the music hall buffoonery of Norman Wisdom.

defs.def_en: Buffoonery is foolish behaviour that makes you laugh.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她去世之后，我非常非常难过。
ext.ext_en: After she died I felt very, very upset...

ext.ext_cn: 玛尔塔一副沮丧的模样。
ext.ext_en: Marta looked upset...

defs.def_en: If you are upset, you are unhappy or disappointed because something unpleasant has happened to you.

defs.def_cn: 使心烦意乱；使生气；使心情不好

ext.ext_cn: 整个事件搞得我和未婚妻都心烦意乱。
ext.ext_en: The whole incident had upset me and my fiancee terribly...

ext.ext_cn: 她警告我不要说任何让他不高兴的话。
ext.ext_en: She warned me not to say anything to upset him...

defs.def_en: If something upsets you, it makes you feel worried or unhappy.

ext.ext_cn: 一桩将会打破全球黄金市场均势的交易
ext.ext_en: ...a deal that would upset the balance of power in the world's gold markets...

ext.ext_cn: 房价很容易受到与房产毫不相干的因素的干扰。
ext.ext_en: House prices are easily upset by factors which have nothing to do with property.

defs.def_en: If events upset something such as a procedure or a state of affairs, they cause it to go wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 不要把箱子下面那几叠床单弄乱了。
ext.ext_en: Don't upset the piles of sheets under the box.

ext.ext_cn: 撞上了他，差点打翻了姜味汽水
ext.ext_en: ...bumping into him, and almost upsetting the ginger ale.

defs.def_en: If you upset an object, you accidentally knock or push it over so that it scatters over a large area.

ext.ext_cn: 保罗昨晚肚子不舒服。
ext.ext_en: Paul was unwell last night with a stomach upset...

ext.ext_cn: 没什么大不了的。只是胃有点不舒服，没别的。
ext.ext_en: It wasn't anything serious. A mild stomach upset, that's all.

defs.def_en: A stomach upset is a slight illness in your stomach caused by an infection or by something that you have eaten.

defs.def_cn: 室女宫，室女座（黄道十二宫之一。出生于8月23日至9月22日之间的人属此星座）
defs.def_en: Virgo is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac. Its symbol is a young woman. People who are born approximately between the 23rd of August and the 22nd of September come under this sign.

defs.def_cn: 出生于室女宫时段的人
defs.def_en: A Virgo is a person whose sign of the zodiac is Virgo.
A chaffinch is a small European bird. Male chaffinches have reddish-brown fronts and grey heads.

ext.ext_cn: 热金属微粒
ext.ext_en: ...a particle of hot metal...

ext.ext_cn: 他的陈述中有一点点实话。
ext.ext_en: There is a particle of truth in his statement.

defs.def_en: A particle of something is a very small piece or amount of it.
In physics, a particle is a piece of matter smaller than an atom, for example an electron or a proton.
In grammar, a particle is a preposition such as 'into' or an adverb such as 'out' which can combine with a verb to form a phrasal verb.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 行业清理整顿需要严厉的措施。
ext.ext_en: Drastic measures are needed to clean up the profession...

ext.ext_cn: 他不打算对经济政策作任何重大调整。
ext.ext_en: He's not going to do anything drastic about economic policy.

defs.def_en: If you have to take drastic action in order to solve a problem, you have to do something extreme and basic to solve it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 上了年纪的人在他们这个人生阶段不会再有什么实质性的改变。
ext.ext_en: Elderly people are not in a position to make drastic changes at this stage of their life...

ext.ext_cn: 死亡人数的大幅下降
ext.ext_en: ...a drastic reduction in the numbers of people dying.

defs.def_en: A drastic change is a very great change.

ext.ext_cn: 哈雷彗星将于2061年回归。
ext.ext_en: Halley's Comet is going to come back in 2061.

defs.def_en: A comet is a bright object with a long tail that travels around the sun.

defs.def_cn: （主要指记者和报纸）发表社论，作出主观评论

ext.ext_cn: 其他报纸已经发表了社论，谴责捷克政府对这一独立的个体草率下定论。
ext.ext_en: Other papers have editorialized, criticizing the Czech government for rushing to judgment on this individual.

defs.def_en: If someone editorializes, they express their opinion about something rather than just stating facts; mainly used in contexts where you are talking about journalists and newspapers.
Dermatitis is a medical condition which makes your skin red and painful.

defs.def_cn: 佩戴很多珠宝的；珠光宝气的；用珠宝装饰的

ext.ext_cn: 珠光宝气的女子
ext.ext_en: ...bejewelled women.

ext.ext_cn: 镶着珠宝的黄金三重冕
ext.ext_en: ...a bejewelled golden tiara.

defs.def_en: A bejewelled person or object is wearing a lot of jewellery or is decorated with jewels.

defs.def_cn: 麋(出现在北欧、亚洲和北美的一种大型鹿，头上长有大而扁的鹿角。一些英国人用该词指北美亚种，用 elk 指欧洲和亚洲亚种)
defs.def_en: A moose is a large type of deer. Moose have big flat horns called antlers and are found in Northern Europe, Asia, and North America. Some British speakers use moose to refer to the North American variety of this animal, and elk to refer to the European and Asian varieties.

ext.ext_cn: 直接因工作原因患上哮喘的人会获得赔偿。
ext.ext_en: Compensation is available for people who have developed asthma as a direct result of their work...

ext.ext_cn: 专门的比萨烤箱比普通家用烤箱效果更好。
ext.ext_en: A real pizza oven gives better results than an ordinary home oven.

defs.def_en: A result is something that happens or exists because of something else that has happened.

ext.ext_cn: 50％的道路交通事故都会导致头部损伤。
ext.ext_en: Fifty per cent of road accidents result in head injuries...

ext.ext_cn: 经常返回她移居的国家让她写出了她的第一本书《万金油》。
ext.ext_en: Regular trips back to her adopted motherland have resulted in her first book, Tiger Balm.

defs.def_en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 很多头发问题都是由饮食引起的。
ext.ext_en: Many hair problems result from what you eat...

ext.ext_cn: 忽略早期征兆可能会导致疾病。
ext.ext_en: Ignore the early warnings and illness could result.

defs.def_en: If something results from a particular event or action, it is caused by that event or action.

ext.ext_cn: “比赛结果怎样？”——“利兹队以1比0获胜。”
ext.ext_en: 'What was the result?' — 'One-nil to Leeds.'...

ext.ext_cn: 选举的最终结果将在周五宣布。
ext.ext_en: The final election results will be announced on Friday.

defs.def_en: A result is the situation that exists at the end of a contest.

ext.ext_cn: 他们发现他们的计算机进行完全相同的计算会得出不同的结果。
ext.ext_en: They found their computers producing different results from exactly the same calculation.

defs.def_en: A result is the number that you get when you do a calculation.

ext.ext_cn: 凯特的考试成绩非常出色。
ext.ext_en: Kate's exam results were excellent.

defs.def_en: Your results are the marks or grades that you get for examinations you have taken.

ext.ext_cn: 她似乎喜欢幸灾乐祸。
ext.ext_en: She seemed to enjoy the misfortunes of others...

ext.ext_cn: 他吃尽了苦头。
ext.ext_en: He had his full share of misfortune.

defs.def_en: A misfortune is something unpleasant or unlucky that happens to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 加氯是为了杀死细菌。
ext.ext_en: Chlorine is added to kill bacteria.

defs.def_en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause disease.

ext.ext_cn: 滚烫的水喷了出来。
ext.ext_en: Piping-hot water gushed out...

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙海岸附近的一艘超级油轮仍在大量漏油。
ext.ext_en: A supertanker continues to gush oil off the coast of Spain.

defs.def_en: When liquid gushes out of something, or when something gushes a liquid, the liquid flows out very quickly and in large quantities.

ext.ext_cn: 我听到一股水流涌出。
ext.ext_en: I heard a gush of water.

defs.def_en: A gush of liquid is a sudden, rapid flow of liquid, or a quantity of it that suddenly flows out.

defs.def_cn: 过分称赞；吹捧；装腔作势地说

ext.ext_cn: “哦，棒极了。”他夸张地说。
ext.ext_en: 'Oh, it was brilliant,' he gushes...

ext.ext_cn: 他吹嘘自己如何爱妻子。
ext.ext_en: He gushed about his love for his wife.

defs.def_en: If someone gushes, they express their admiration or pleasure in an exaggerated way.

ext.ext_cn: 对母亲的爱突然涌上她的心头。
ext.ext_en: She felt a gush of pure affection for her mother...

ext.ext_cn: 他们最初怀有的深切同情渐渐地消失了。
ext.ext_en: Their initial gush of sympathy gradually dried up.

defs.def_en: You can use gush in expressions such as a gush of enthusiasm to refer to a sudden intense feeling or an expression of a feeling.

ext.ext_cn: 德拉姆获得的选票是凯里的3倍。
ext.ext_en: Durham had garnered three times as many votes as Carey...

ext.ext_cn: 他的提议得到了广泛的支持。
ext.ext_en: He has garnered extensive support for his proposals...

defs.def_en: If someone has garnered something useful or valuable, they have gained it or collected it.

ext.ext_cn: 音响师运用一系列技术来提高录音质量。
ext.ext_en: Sound engineers utilize a range of techniques to enhance the quality of the recordings...

ext.ext_cn: 人体可通过很多不同形式吸收和利用矿物质。
ext.ext_en: Minerals can be absorbed and utilized by the body in a variety of different forms.

defs.def_en: If you utilize something, you use it.

defs.def_cn: (炸弹、子弹等的)直接命中，直接击中

ext.ext_cn: 除非是直接被击中，否则这个地下掩体是非常安全的。
ext.ext_en: The dugouts were secure from everything but a direct hit.

defs.def_en: If a place suffers a direct hit, a bomb, bullet, or other missile that has been aimed at it lands exactly in that place, rather than some distance away.

ext.ext_cn: 冠状动脉的肌肉痉挛可能导致心脏病。
ext.ext_en: A muscular spasm in the coronary artery can cause a heart attack...

ext.ext_cn: 缺镁会导致肌肉痉挛。
ext.ext_en: A lack of magnesium causes muscles to go into spasm.

defs.def_en: A spasm is a sudden tightening of your muscles, which you cannot control.

defs.def_cn: (剧痛或不愉快情感的)阵发，迸发

ext.ext_cn: 一阵剧痛把他的思绪拉回到了现在。
ext.ext_en: A spasm of pain brought his thoughts back to the present...

ext.ext_cn: 肯普突然感到一阵恐惧。
ext.ext_en: Kemp felt a spasm of fear.

defs.def_en: A spasm is a sudden strong pain or unpleasant emotion which lasts for a short period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 研究人员和分析人员的高素质给我留下了深刻印象。
ext.ext_en: I was impressed by the high calibre of the researchers and analysts...

ext.ext_cn: 显然,我们永远无法得到我们想要的那种杰出人才。
ext.ext_en: It became apparent that we could never get the calibre of people we wanted.

defs.def_en: The calibre of a person is the quality or standard of their ability or intelligence, especially when this is high.

ext.ext_cn: 他的优秀品格和卓越成就影响深远。
ext.ext_en: The quality of his character and the caliber of his accomplishments produced a lasting influence...

ext.ext_cn: 教学质量很高。
ext.ext_en: The calibre of teaching was very high.

defs.def_en: The calibre of something is its quality, especially when it is good.

ext.ext_cn: 口径为0.22英寸的步枪
ext.ext_en: ...a .22 calibre rifle.

ext.ext_cn: 小口径手枪
ext.ext_en: ...a small-calibre pistol.

defs.def_en: The calibre of a gun is the width of the inside of its barrel.

defs.def_cn: 向警方告密的人;向警方揭发犯罪团伙的人
defs.def_en: A supergrass is a person who gives the police information about a large group of criminals.

ext.ext_cn: 去年1月份俄罗斯政府决定暂不放开对石油和天然气价格的管制。
ext.ext_en: The Russian government chose not to decontrol oil and gas prices last January.

ext.ext_cn: 进一步解除对银行机构的管制
ext.ext_en: ...continuing decontrol of banking institutions.

defs.def_en: When governments decontrol an activity, they remove controls from it so that companies or organizations have more freedom.

ext.ext_cn: 集市上的商贩摆出了一系列具有异域风味的该岛农产品以供选择。
ext.ext_en: Market traders display an exotic selection of the island's produce.

ext.ext_cn: 皮货商
ext.ext_en: …a fur trader.

defs.def_en: A trader is a person whose job is to trade in goods or stocks.
A stick insect is an insect with a long body and thin legs. It looks like a small stick.

defs.def_cn: （和副词一起构成形容词）表示“成比例的”，“协调的”，“均衡的”

ext.ext_cn: 这套公寓天花板很高，各房间比例均衡。
ext.ext_en: The flat has high ceilings and well-proportioned rooms.

ext.ext_cn: 身材非常匀称的年轻女子
ext.ext_en: ...a perfectly-proportioned young woman.

defs.def_en: -proportioned is added to adverbs to form adjectives that indicate that the size and shape of the different parts of something or someone are pleasing or useful.

ext.ext_cn: 这些团队应于明年年初向首相汇报情况。
ext.ext_en: The teams are due to report back to the Prime Minister early next year...

ext.ext_cn: 我一找到他就马上汇报。
ext.ext_en: I'll report back the moment I have located him...

defs.def_en: If you report back to someone, you tell them about something that they asked you to find out about.

ext.ext_cn: 当局已经下令让所有从前线返回的士兵回营地报到。
ext.ext_en: The authorities have ordered all soldiers who have returned from the front line to report back to barracks...

ext.ext_cn: 他们被送回家，并要求下午回来报到。
ext.ext_en: They were sent home and told to report back in the afternoon.

defs.def_en: If you report back to a place, you go back there and say that you are ready to start work or say that you are present.

ext.ext_cn: 我们把这些转述给了克拉伊切克。
ext.ext_en: We reported this back to Krajicek...

ext.ext_cn: 他们很害怕自己的看法有可能被人告发到政府。
ext.ext_en: They're scared that their sentiments might be reported back to the government.

defs.def_en: If you report back a comment or remark, often a critical one, you repeat it to the person it was made about.
A passbook is a small book recording the amount of money you pay in or take out of a savings account at a bank or building society.

ext.ext_cn: 美国军方希望避免出现类似于越南战争那样逐步升级的态势。
ext.ext_en: The US military wants to avoid the graduated escalation that marked the Vietnam War.

defs.def_en: Graduated means increasing by regular amounts or grades.

ext.ext_cn: 以毫米标注刻度的试管
ext.ext_en: ...a graduated tube marked in millimetres.

defs.def_en: Graduated jars are marked with lines and numbers which show particular measurements.
A furrow is a long, thin line in the earth which a farmer makes in order to plant seeds or to allow water to flow along.

ext.ext_cn: 越野摩托车的轮迹纵横交错地布满条条草沟。
ext.ext_en: Dirt bike trails crisscrossed the grassy furrows.

defs.def_en: A furrow is a deep, fairly wide line in the surface of something.

ext.ext_cn: 他嘴角边刻着的深深的皱纹
ext.ext_en: ...the deep furrows that marked the corners of his mouth.

defs.def_en: A furrow is a deep fold or line in the skin of someone's face.

ext.ext_cn: 我的银行经理眉头紧锁，拨弄着计算器，最后终于“啊哈!”了一声。
ext.ext_en: My bank manager furrowed his brow, fingered his calculator and finally pronounced 'Aha!'...

ext.ext_cn: 米奇看到几个人正在喝酒时皱起了眉头。
ext.ext_en: Midge's forehead furrowed as she saw that several were drinking...

defs.def_en: If someone furrows their brow or forehead or if it furrows, deep folds appear in it because the person is annoyed, unhappy, or confused.

defs.def_cn: 走自己…的道路;与众不同;独树一帜

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名录音艺人，凯尔走了一条较为冷僻的道路。
ext.ext_en: Cale has ploughed a more esoteric furrow as a recording artist...

ext.ext_cn: 政府在制定自己独树一帜的外交政策时无比娴熟。
ext.ext_en: The government is more than adept at ploughing its own diplomatic furrow.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone ploughs a particular furrow or ploughs their own furrow, you mean that their activities or interests are different or isolated from those of other people.
A blackboard is a dark-coloured board that you can write on with chalk. Blackboards are often used by teachers in the classroom.

ext.ext_cn: 云朵各种各样的形状
ext.ext_en: ...the varied shapes of the clouds...

ext.ext_cn: 天空几乎完全被云所遮蔽。
ext.ext_en: The sky was almost entirely obscured by cloud.

defs.def_en: A cloud is a mass of water vapour that floats in the sky. Clouds are usually white or grey in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 一群母鸡四处乱窜，搅起一团尘土。
ext.ext_en: The hens darted away on all sides, raising a cloud of dust.

defs.def_en: A cloud of something such as smoke or dust is a mass of it floating in the air.

defs.def_cn: 把…搞糊涂;使难以理解；使无法正确判断

ext.ext_cn: 可能是愤怒蒙蔽了他的眼睛，也可能是他判断有误。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps anger had clouded his vision, perhaps his judgment had been faulty...

ext.ext_cn: 晚年的时候，对宗教的狂热让他丧失心智。
ext.ext_en: In his latter years religious mania clouded his mind.

defs.def_en: If you say that something clouds your view of a situation, you mean that it makes you unable to understand the situation or judge it properly.

ext.ext_cn: 印度人民党怒斥媒体，已经破坏了气氛。
ext.ext_en: The atmosphere has already been clouded by the BJP's anger at the media.

defs.def_en: If you say that something clouds a situation, you mean that it makes it unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: (眼神或脸色)阴沉，忧郁；使看起来阴沉（或忧郁）

ext.ext_cn: 翠茜一脸失望。
ext.ext_en: Trish's face clouded with disappointment...

ext.ext_cn: 他看着凯瑟琳，满眼忧伤。
ext.ext_en: As he looked at Katherine, great sorrow clouded his eyes.

defs.def_en: If your eyes or face cloud or if sadness or anger clouds them, your eyes or your face suddenly show sadness or anger.

ext.ext_cn: 她面颊边的镜子变得模糊不清。
ext.ext_en: The mirror clouded beside her cheek...

ext.ext_cn: 我把水开得很热，水汽模糊了镜面。
ext.ext_en: I run the water very hot, clouding the mirror.

defs.def_en: If glass clouds or if moisture clouds it, tiny drops of water cover the glass, making it difficult to see through.
If you say that someone has their head in the clouds, you are criticizing them because they are ignoring or are unaware of the problems associated with a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔出生的时候，我都乐得找不着北了。
ext.ext_en: When Michael was born I was on cloud nine.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is on cloud nine, you are emphasizing that they are very happy.

ext.ext_cn: 军方因在平息示威活动时杀死了无辜平民而备受指责。
ext.ext_en: The military are under a cloud for killing civilians while breaking up a demonstration.

defs.def_en: If someone is under a cloud, people have a poor opinion of them because of something they have done.
A longshoreman is a person who works in the docks, loading and unloading ships.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她想方设法让自己在工作时间穿得更像样。
ext.ext_en: She managed to make herself presentable in time for work.

ext.ext_cn: 穿着他最体面的套装
ext.ext_en: ...wearing his most presentable suit.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone looks presentable, you mean that they look fairly tidy or attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 拿得出手的；像样的；令人满意的

ext.ext_cn: 他拿下29分，帮助莱斯特郡队获得了一个不错的总成绩。
ext.ext_en: His score of 29 had helped Leicestershire reach a presentable total...

ext.ext_cn: 有时，在新西兰演出的时候，我表现得很出彩。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes when I performed in New Zealand, I was doing a very presentable job.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as presentable, you mean that it is acceptable or quite good.

ext.ext_cn: 她之所以彻底搞砸了一个重大项目纯粹是因为不够上心。
ext.ext_en: She completely mishandled an important project purely through lack of attention...

ext.ext_cn: 这场演出气氛紧张，观众中有人朝着迪伦大叫“犹大”，指责他抛弃了他的民歌根基。
ext.ext_en: It was a pulsating session in which a member of the audience shouted 'Judas' at Dylan for deserting his folk roots.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of being a Judas, you are accusing them of being deceitful and betraying their friends or country.
Silica is silicon dioxide, a compound of silicon which is found in sand, quartz, and flint, and which is used to make glass.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 专横的;傲慢的;飞扬跋扈的
