ext.ext_en: From across the desk she gave him a witheringly imperious look.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as imperious, you mean that they have a proud manner and expect to be obeyed.
In Britain, a cream tea is an afternoon meal that consists of tea to drink and small cakes called scones that are eaten with jam and cream. Cream teas are served in places such as tea shops.

defs.def_cn: 文字处理;文字处理技术
defs.def_en: Word processing is the work or skill of producing printed documents using a computer.

ext.ext_cn: 渔夫费了很大的劲才把他的小船划到暗礁旁。
ext.ext_en: With great difficulty, the fisherman manoeuvred his small craft close to the reef...

ext.ext_cn: 据报道，部队自周日晚离开海军军舰登陆后已经挺进了将近4英里。
ext.ext_en: The troops are reported to have advanced nearly four miles since they were landed from naval craft on Sunday evening.

defs.def_en: See also:landing craft;You can refer to a boat, a spacecraft, or an aircraft as a craft .

ext.ext_cn: 北美印第安人的手工艺
ext.ext_en: ...the arts and crafts of the North American Indians...

ext.ext_cn: 这里保留着各种各样的传统手工业。
ext.ext_en: All kinds of traditional craft industries are preserved here.

defs.def_en: A craft is an activity such as weaving, carving, or pottery that involves making things skilfully with your hands.

ext.ext_cn: 写作技巧
ext.ext_en: ...the craft of writing...

ext.ext_cn: 作为该国最著名的古典小号演奏家，莫里斯·墨菲曾师从黑堤磨坊铜管乐团。
ext.ext_en: Maurice Murphy, one of the country's leading classical trumpeters, learnt his craft with the Black Dyke Mills band.

defs.def_en: You can use craft to refer to any activity or job that involves doing something skilfully.

ext.ext_cn: 这些窗户很可能是中世纪后期精心制作的。
ext.ext_en: The windows would probably have been crafted in the latter part of the Middle Ages...

ext.ext_cn: 很多代表都想要制订出一个周密的折中方案。
ext.ext_en: Many delegates were willing to craft a compromise...

defs.def_en: If something is crafted, it is made skilfully.

ext.ext_cn: 西北方向5英里外的阿申特岛
ext.ext_en: ...Ushant, five miles out to the north-west.

defs.def_en: The north-west is the direction which is halfway between north and west.

ext.ext_cn: 工党在西北部地区展开了其选举前的竞选活动。
ext.ext_en: Labour took its pre-election campaign to the North-West.

ext.ext_cn: 南美洲的最西北部
ext.ext_en: ...the extreme north-west of South America.

defs.def_en: The north-west of a place, country, or region is the part which is towards the north-west.

ext.ext_cn: 走和铁路线平行的那条西北向的窄巷。
ext.ext_en: Take the narrow lane going north-west parallel with the railway line.

defs.def_en: If you go north-west, you travel towards the north-west.

ext.ext_cn: 这里地处镇子的西北方，离火车站仅有一小段步行距离。
ext.ext_en: This was situated to the north-west of the town, a short walk from the railway station.

defs.def_en: Something that is north-west of a place is positioned to the north-west of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 西北地区卫生局
ext.ext_en: ...the North-West Regional Health Authority.

ext.ext_cn: 美国的西北海岸
ext.ext_en: ...the north-west coast of the United States.

defs.def_en: The north-west part of a place, country, or region is the part which is towards the north-west.

defs.def_cn: (风)从西北方吹来的;西北风的

ext.ext_cn: 寒冷干燥的西北风横扫了这个地区。
ext.ext_en: A brisk north-west wind swept across the region.

defs.def_en: A north-west wind is a wind that blows from the north-west.

defs.def_cn: （疾病等）经水传染的，由水传播的

ext.ext_cn: 美国官方发出了霍乱和其他经水传播的疾病可能会爆发的警告。
ext.ext_en: UN officials are warning of an outbreak of cholera and other water-borne diseases.

defs.def_en: A water-borne disease or infection is one that people can catch from infected water.

ext.ext_cn: 尼罗河水上观光游
ext.ext_en: ...a waterborne safari down the Nile...

ext.ext_cn: 环境的压力使人们更加认可水上运输。
ext.ext_en: Environmental pressures are strengthening the case for waterborne freight.

defs.def_en: Something that is water-borne travels or is transported on water.
An adverb is a word such as 'slowly', 'now', 'very', 'politically', or 'fortunately' which adds information about the action, event, or situation mentioned in a clause.

defs.def_cn: 附属建筑；外围建筑；外屋
defs.def_en: An outhouse is a small building attached to a house or very close to the house, used, for example, for storing things in.
An outhouse is an outside toilet.

ext.ext_cn: 如果谋杀罪名成立，这两个年轻人都可能会被判处死刑。
ext.ext_en: If convicted for murder, both youngsters could face the death penalty.

defs.def_en: The death penalty is the punishment of death used in some countries for people who have committed very serious crimes.

ext.ext_cn: 他充满了悔恨。
ext.ext_en: He was full of remorse...

ext.ext_cn: 他对自己的行为没有任何悔恨之意。
ext.ext_en: He has shown no remorse for his actions.

defs.def_en: Remorse is a strong feeling of sadness and regret about something wrong that you have done.

defs.def_cn: （尤指乡间道路）用碎石铺面的

ext.ext_cn: 走教堂和城堡之间的碎石小道。
ext.ext_en: Take the metalled path running between the church and the fort.

defs.def_en: A metalled road has a level surface made of small pieces of stone; used especially of country roads and tracks.
Paedophilia is sexual activity with children or the condition of being sexually attracted to children.

defs.def_cn: （身体某一部位发麻时的）针刺感

ext.ext_cn: 我的指尖有针刺的感觉。
ext.ext_en: I had pins and needles in the tips of my fingers.

defs.def_en: If you have pins and needles in part of your body, you feel small sharp pains there for a short period of time. It usually happens when that part of your body has been in an uncomfortable position.

ext.ext_cn: 把这些黑醋栗放在平底锅里。
ext.ext_en: Place the blackcurrants in a pan.

ext.ext_cn: 一盒黑醋栗饮料
ext.ext_en: ...a carton of blackcurrant drink.

defs.def_en: In Europe, blackcurrants are a type of very small, dark purple fruits that grow in bunches on bushes.

ext.ext_cn: 降雨量和降雪量共达 50 毫米。
ext.ext_en: The total rain and snowfall amounted to 50mm.

defs.def_en: The snowfall in an area or country is the amount of snow that falls there during a particular period.
A snowfall is a fall of snow.

defs.def_cn: (穿许多厚衣服把自己的身体和脸)裹起来的，包住的

ext.ext_cn: 裹着围巾，戴着毛线帽的孩子们
ext.ext_en: ...children muffled in scarves and woolly hats.

ext.ext_cn: 所有的女士都裹了好几层衣服。
ext.ext_en: All the women were muffled up in several layers of clothing.

defs.def_en: If you are muffled, you are wearing a lot of heavy clothes so that very little of your body or face is visible.

ext.ext_cn: 他在无人帮助的情况下自己戒除了毒瘾。
ext.ext_en: He overcame his addictions unassisted...

ext.ext_cn: 其他时候，他会强迫她在完全无人帮助的情况下自己行走。
ext.ext_en: At other times, he'd force her to walk totally unassisted.

defs.def_en: If you do something unassisted, you do it on your own and no-one helps you.

defs.def_cn: 主要的；首要的；最为重要的

ext.ext_cn: 同时，政治稳定性将放在首位。
ext.ext_en: Political stability, meanwhile, will be a prime concern...

ext.ext_cn: 这可能是游击队进攻的主要目标。
ext.ext_en: It could be a prime target for guerrilla attack...

defs.def_en: You use prime to describe something that is most important in a situation.

defs.def_cn: 优质的；一流的；上等的；最好的

ext.ext_cn: 这是伦敦最好的地段之一，离证券交易所很近。
ext.ext_en: It was one of the City's prime sites, near the Stock Exchange.

defs.def_en: You use prime to describe something that is of the best possible quality.

defs.def_cn: 最典型的；最有代表性的

ext.ext_cn: 最典型的例子是梅西百货，它曾经是加利福尼亚无可争辩的零售巨头。
ext.ext_en: The prime example is Macy's, once the undisputed king of California retailers.

defs.def_en: You use prime to describe an example of a particular kind of thing that is absolutely typical.

defs.def_cn: 全盛时期；最活跃时期；最成功时期

ext.ext_cn: 也许我现在正要步入事业辉煌期。
ext.ext_en: Maybe I'm just coming into my prime now...

ext.ext_cn: 在智力上，她正处于壮年。
ext.ext_en: She was in her intellectual prime...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is in their prime, they are at the stage in their existence when they are at their strongest, most active, or most successful.

ext.ext_cn: 克莱尔真希望她事先指点过萨拉。
ext.ext_en: Claire wished she'd primed Sarah beforehand...

ext.ext_cn: 阿诺德事先让她熟悉了自己的任务。
ext.ext_en: Arnold primed her for her duties...

defs.def_en: If you prime someone to do something, you prepare them to do it, for example by giving them information about it beforehand.

ext.ext_cn: 他正在装炸弹，设定为在一个小时之内爆炸。
ext.ext_en: He was priming the bomb to go off in an hour's time...

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆在办公室放了一支装了子弹的10英尺长的猎枪。
ext.ext_en: Tom keeps a primed 10-foot shotgun in his office.

defs.def_en: If someone primes a bomb or a gun, they prepare it so that it is ready to explode or fire.

ext.ext_cn: 人们指责他在军队内部搞分裂。
ext.ext_en: He had been accused of promoting disunity within the armed forces.

defs.def_en: Disunity is lack of agreement among people which prevents them from working together effectively.

defs.def_cn: 蛋奶沙司(与水果、布丁一同食用)

ext.ext_cn: 香蕉和蛋奶沙司
ext.ext_en: ...bananas and custard.

defs.def_en: Custard is a sweet yellow sauce made from milk and eggs or from milk and a powder. It is eaten with fruit and puddings.

ext.ext_cn: 以流式媒体为主要特色的网站
ext.ext_en: ...web sites that feature streaming media.

defs.def_en: See also:stream;Streaming is a method of transmitting data from the Internet directly to a user's computer screen without the need to download it.

defs.def_cn: （使）成对儿，（使）成双（常指成为恋人）

ext.ext_cn: 我知道她忍不住要将我和某人撮合到一块儿。
ext.ext_en: I knew she wouldn't be able to resist pairing me off with someone...

ext.ext_cn: 小组成员结对儿找地方吃饭睡觉。
ext.ext_en: The squad members paired off to find places to eat and sleep.

defs.def_en: When people pair off or are paired off, they form a pair, often in order to become girlfriend and boyfriend.

defs.def_cn: （国家、团体之间的正式）协定，协议，条约

ext.ext_cn: 庆祝和平协定的恰当的方式
ext.ext_en: ...a fitting way to celebrate the peace accord.

defs.def_en: An accord between countries or groups of people is a formal agreement, for example to end a war.

ext.ext_cn: 他的前任受到了同样热烈的欢迎。
ext.ext_en: His predecessor was accorded an equally tumultuous welcome...

ext.ext_cn: 政府授予他上校军衔。
ext.ext_en: The government accorded him the rank of Colonel...

defs.def_en: If you are accorded a particular kind of treatment, people act towards you or treat you in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 这种方法与社会主义意识形态的原则相符。
ext.ext_en: Such an approach accords with the principles of socialist ideology.

ext.ext_cn: 与警方所掌握的情况不完全一致的科学证据
ext.ext_en: ...scientific evidence that did not fully accord with the facts uncovered by the police.

defs.def_en: If one fact, idea, or condition accords with another, they are in agreement and there is no conflict between them.

ext.ext_cn: 依据联合国决议而采取的本次军事行动
ext.ext_en: ...this military action, taken in accord with United Nations resolutions...

ext.ext_cn: 即使国家利益不尽相同，他们也可以化敌为友。
ext.ext_en: Old enemies can become new friends even if all their national interests are not in complete accord.

defs.def_en: If one person, action, or fact is in accord with another, they are in agreement and there is no conflict between them. You can also say that two people or things are in accord.

ext.ext_cn: 这种病很多情况下会自愈。
ext.ext_en: In many cases the disease will clear up of its own accord.

defs.def_en: If something happens of its own accord, it seems to happen by itself, without anyone making it happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他辞去法国总理职务并非出于自愿。
ext.ext_en: He did not quit as France's prime minister of his own accord.

defs.def_en: If you do something of your own accord, you do it because you want to, without being asked or forced.

ext.ext_cn: 他们步调一致地转身走过草坪。
ext.ext_en: With one accord they turned and walked back over the grass.

defs.def_en: If a number of people do something with one accord, they do it together or at the same time, because they agree about what should be done.

ext.ext_cn: 开朗的电话修理工
ext.ext_en: ...a cheerful telephone repairman.

defs.def_en: A repairman is a man who mends broken machines such as televisions and telephones.

defs.def_cn: 鸸鹋（见于澳大利亚的大型鸟，不能飞行）
defs.def_en: An emu is a large Australian bird which cannot fly.

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽亚对两个孩子都疼爱有加，向来一视同仁。
ext.ext_en: Maria loved both the children. There was never a hint of favouritism.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of favouritism, you disapprove of them because they unfairly help or favour one person or group much more than another.

ext.ext_cn: 我们听到一连串的爆炸声，似乎就在附近。
ext.ext_en: We heard a series of explosions. They seemed quite close by...

ext.ext_cn: 除了我们，大家好像都很忙碌。
ext.ext_en: Everyone seems busy except us...

defs.def_en: You use seem to say that someone or something gives the impression of having a particular quality, or of happening in the way you describe.

defs.def_cn: (在描述自己的感觉、想法、经历时用于缓和语气)好像，似乎

ext.ext_cn: 我好像已经自信全无。
ext.ext_en: I seem to have lost all my self-confidence...

ext.ext_cn: 我好像记得给过你非常明确的指示。
ext.ext_en: I seem to remember giving you very precise instructions...

defs.def_en: You use seem when you are describing your own feelings or thoughts, or describing something that has happened to you, in order to make your statement less forceful.

ext.ext_cn: 无论怎么努力，我好像就是无法付清所有的账单。
ext.ext_en: No matter how hard I try I cannot seem to catch up on all the bills...

ext.ext_cn: 金的母亲似乎要哭个没完。
ext.ext_en: Kim's mother couldn't seem to stop crying.

defs.def_en: If you say that you cannot seem or could not seem to do something, you mean that you have tried to do it and were unable to.

ext.ext_cn: 对该项目持批评态度的人在推测如果改作他用不知可以建多少所医院。
ext.ext_en: Critics of the project speculate about how many hospitals could be built instead...

ext.ext_cn: 猜测黛比自杀的原因对她的家人来说是不公平的。
ext.ext_en: It would be unfair to Debby's family to speculate on the reasons for her suicide...

defs.def_en: If you speculate about something, you make guesses about its nature or identity, or about what might happen.

ext.ext_cn: 大农场主正在不断涌进来，不是为了耕作，而是要利用不断上涨的地价进行投机。
ext.ext_en: Big farmers are moving in, not in order to farm, but in order to speculate with rising land prices...

ext.ext_cn: 各银行贷出去太多高风险贷款，目前无法收回，他们还进行地产投机，而地产的价值目前已经下跌了。
ext.ext_en: The banks made too many risky loans which now can't be repaid, and they speculated in property whose value has now dropped.

defs.def_en: If someone speculates financially, they buy property, stocks, or shares, in the hope of being able to sell them again at a higher price and make a profit.

ext.ext_cn: 我喜爱信笺信封和所有文房用具。
ext.ext_en: I loved stationery and all the accoutrements of writing.

defs.def_en: Accoutrements are all the things you have with you when you travel or when you take part in a particular activity.

defs.def_cn: （尤当 has 为助动词时，he is 或 he has 的常用口语形式）

ext.ext_cn: 他一周工作大概25个小时。
ext.ext_en: He's working maybe twenty-five hours a week...

ext.ext_cn: 从入职第一天开始，他就是公司难得的人才。
ext.ext_en: From day one he's been a great asset to the company.

defs.def_en: He's is the usual spoken form of 'he is' or 'he has', especially when 'has' is an auxiliary verb.

defs.def_cn: （政治官员或公众人物）接受媒体拍照的时间
defs.def_en: If a politician or other public figure arranges a photo opportunity, they invite the newspapers and television to photograph them doing something which they think will interest or impress the public.

defs.def_cn: 反之亦然;反过来也一样

ext.ext_cn: 在英格兰有教书资格的老师在苏格兰得不到认可，反之亦然。
ext.ext_en: Teachers qualified to teach in England are not accepted in Scotland and vice versa.

defs.def_en: Vice versa is used to indicate that the reverse of what you have said is true. For example 'women may bring their husbands with them, and vice versa' means that men may also bring their wives with them.

defs.def_cn: （英国旧时为11岁左右儿童举行的）升中学甄别考试
defs.def_en: The eleven-plus is an exam which was taken by children in Britain at about the age of eleven, in order to decide which secondary school they should go to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 激烈的；猛烈的；充满敌意的

ext.ext_cn: 第二次世界大战期间激烈的战斗场面
ext.ext_en: ...the scene of bitter fighting during the Second World War.

ext.ext_cn: 对政府支持制造业不力的猛烈抨击
ext.ext_en: ...a bitter attack on the Government's failure to support manufacturing...

defs.def_en: In a bitter argument or conflict, people argue very angrily or fight very fiercely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 据说，她对自己被以如此方式解雇而感到愤愤不平。
ext.ext_en: She is said to be very bitter about the way she was sacked...

ext.ext_cn: 他漫长的一生充满了关于个人生活和政治生涯的苦涩记忆。
ext.ext_en: His long life was marked by bitter personal and political memories.

defs.def_en: If someone is bitter after a disappointing experience or after being treated unfairly, they continue to feel angry about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （经历或感觉）令人非常失望的，痛苦的，辛酸的

ext.ext_cn: 我想这个决定对他是个沉重的打击，从此以后他一蹶不振。
ext.ext_en: I think the decision was a bitter blow from which he never quite recovered...

ext.ext_cn: 大量惨痛的经历让他学会了如何坦然面对失败。
ext.ext_en: A great deal of bitter experience had taught him how to lose gracefully...

defs.def_en: A bitter experience makes you feel very disappointed. You can also use bitter to emphasize feelings of disappointment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 外面，刺骨的东风伴着阵阵小雪。
ext.ext_en: Outside, a bitter east wind was accompanied by flurries of snow.

ext.ext_cn: 在严寒中度过一夜之后
ext.ext_en: ...after spending a night in the bitter cold.

defs.def_en: Bitter weather, or a bitter wind, is extremely cold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些叶子味道相当苦。
ext.ext_en: The leaves taste rather bitter.

ext.ext_cn: 年深日久，酒会褪去辣味，口感变得醇和起来
ext.ext_en: ...as the wine ages, losing its bitter harshness, and becoming softer and smoother.

defs.def_en: A bitter taste is sharp, not sweet, and often slightly unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 一品脱苦啤酒
ext.ext_en: ...a pint of bitter.

defs.def_en: Bitter is a kind of beer that is light brown in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 他说，游击队员会为实现主要目标而战斗到底。
ext.ext_en: The guerrillas would fight to the bitter end, he said, in order to achieve their main goal.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will continue doing something to the bitter end, especially something difficult or unpleasant, you are emphasizing that you will continue doing it until it is completely finished.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她现在看上去瘦小而干瘪，很可怜。
ext.ext_en: She now looked small, shrunken and pathetic...

ext.ext_cn: 他干瘪的大腿几乎不足以支撑他身体的重量。
ext.ext_en: His shrunken thighs were barely strong enough to support the weight of his body.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is shrunken has become smaller than they used to be.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对不起。我知道我在电话里说得太刻薄了。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry. I know I was bitchy on the phone...

ext.ext_cn: 不只是女人会对彼此说些恶毒的话。
ext.ext_en: Women are not the only ones who say bitchy things about each other.

defs.def_en: If someone is being bitchy or is making bitchy remarks, they are saying unkind things about someone.

defs.def_cn: 贴心的谈话;坦率的谈心

ext.ext_cn: 我和他进行了一次推心置腹的谈话。
ext.ext_en: I've had a heart-to-heart with him...

ext.ext_cn: 婚礼前，我和母亲好好谈了谈心。
ext.ext_en: Before the wedding, I had a heart-to-heart talk with my mother.

defs.def_en: A heart-to-heart is a conversation between two people, especially close friends, in which they talk freely about their feelings or personal problems.

defs.def_cn: (尤指政治动乱的)爆发点，一触即发之际

ext.ext_cn: 星期三市中心的大集会成了直接的导火索。
ext.ext_en: The immediate flashpoint was Wednesday's big rally in the city centre...

ext.ext_cn: 两国关系中仍然有很多潜在的冲突爆发点。
ext.ext_en: There are still plenty of potential flashpoints in relations between the two countries.

defs.def_en: A flashpoint is the moment at which a conflict, especially a political conflict, suddenly gets worse and becomes violent.

defs.def_cn: 政治动乱地区;危险地区

ext.ext_cn: 更加危险的动乱区在首都之外。
ext.ext_en: The more serious flashpoints are outside the capital...

ext.ext_cn: 它可能成为巴尔干地区的下一个火药桶。
ext.ext_en: It could become the next Balkan flashpoint.

defs.def_en: A flashpoint is a place which people think is dangerous because political trouble may start there and then spread to other towns or countries.

ext.ext_cn: 他对任何人都无恶意。
ext.ext_en: He didn't bear anyone any ill will...

ext.ext_cn: 所有这些都让人们对武装力量产生了相当深的怨恨。
ext.ext_en: All this has created considerable ill-will towards the armed forces.

defs.def_en: Ill will is unfriendly or hostile feelings that you have towards someone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 无论幻想多么怪诞、多么离谱，都不能造成伤害。
ext.ext_en: Fantasies cannot harm you, no matter how bizarre or far out they are.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as far out, you mean that it is very strange or extreme.

defs.def_cn: 难以计算的;无法估计的

ext.ext_cn: 人的生命无价。
ext.ext_en: Human life is of inestimable value...

ext.ext_cn: 这给了专业人士一个无法估量的优势。
ext.ext_en: This gives the professional an inestimable advantage.

defs.def_en: If you describe the value, benefit, or importance of something as inestimable, you mean that it is extremely great and cannot be calculated.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坏的；令人不快的；不合意的；有害的；糟糕的

ext.ext_cn: 糟糕的天气使飞机无法降落。
ext.ext_en: The bad weather conditions prevented the plane from landing...

ext.ext_cn: 我们正经历一段困难时期。
ext.ext_en: We have been going through a bad time...

defs.def_en: Something that is bad is unpleasant, harmful, or undesirable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他两年前遇到严重的车祸，不得不放弃务农。
ext.ext_en: He had a bad accident two years ago and had to give up farming...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一起严重的危险驾驶案例。
ext.ext_en: This was a bad case of dangerous driving...

defs.def_en: You use bad to indicate that something unpleasant or undesirable is severe or great in degree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不明智的；错误的；不对的

ext.ext_cn: 经济学家杰弗里·福克斯认为减税是不明智的。
ext.ext_en: Economist Jeffrey Faux says a tax cut is a bad idea...

ext.ext_cn: 政治家当然有时也会作出错误的决定。
ext.ext_en: Of course politicians will sometimes make bad decisions...

defs.def_en: A bad idea, decision, or method is not sensible or not correct.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 项目终止对她的雇员来说是一个不幸的消息。
ext.ext_en: The closure of the project is bad news for her staff...

ext.ext_cn: 我与沃尔的关系开始得不太顺利。
ext.ext_en: It was a bad start in my relationship with Warr...

defs.def_en: If you describe a piece of news, an action, or a sign as bad, you mean that it is unlikely to result in benefit or success.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不合标准的；劣质的；蹩脚的；不足的

ext.ext_cn: 她出演了一部关于茅茅运动（20世纪50年代肯尼亚基库尤人反抗英国殖民者的民族主义运动）的烂片。
ext.ext_en: She was in rather a bad film about the Mau Mau...

ext.ext_cn: 英国有很多老人居住条件恶劣。
ext.ext_en: Many old people in Britain are living in bad housing...

defs.def_en: Something that is bad is of an unacceptably low standard, quality, or amount.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他加深了人们对英国人不擅长语言的印象。
ext.ext_en: He had increased Britain's  reputation for being bad at languages...

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个技术糟糕的司机。
ext.ext_en: He was a bad driver...

defs.def_en: Someone who is bad at doing something is not skilful or successful at it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以接受的；令人遗憾的

ext.ext_cn: 看不见比听不到更让人难以忍受。
ext.ext_en: Not being able to hear doesn't seem as bad as not being able to see...

ext.ext_cn: 现在看场电影至少要花上10英镑——真是太贵了。
ext.ext_en: You need at least ten pounds if you go to the cinema nowadays — it's really bad.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is bad that something happens, you mean it is unacceptable, unfortunate, or wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤表示惊讶）不错的，不坏的，挺好的

ext.ext_en: 'How much is he paying you?' — 'Oh, five thousand.' —'Not bad.'...

ext.ext_cn: “最近怎么样，老兄？”——“还不错，你呢？”
ext.ext_en: 'How are you, mate?' — 'Not bad, mate, how's  yourself?'...

defs.def_en: You can say that something is not bad to mean that it is quite good or acceptable, especially when you are rather surprised about this.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我贩卖毒品，但我并不觉得自己是个坏人。
ext.ext_en: I was selling drugs, but I didn't think I was a bad person...

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得自己的信仰并不让他比其他人更邪恶。
ext.ext_en: He does not think that his beliefs make him any worse than any other man.

defs.def_en: A bad person has morally unacceptable attitudes and behaviour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不听话的；调皮的；捣蛋的

ext.ext_cn: 重复我对你说的话，你真是个捣蛋鬼。
ext.ext_en: You are a bad boy for repeating what I told you...

ext.ext_cn: 很多父母觉得要孩子循规蹈矩是件很难的事情。
ext.ext_en: Many parents find it hard to discourage bad behaviour.

defs.def_en: A bad child disobeys rules and instructions or does not behave in a polite and correct way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 因为她刚刚戒烟，所以脾气有点大。
ext.ext_en: She is in a bit of a bad mood because she's just given up smoking.

defs.def_en: If you are in a bad mood, you are angry and behave unpleasantly to people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你不必为放松感到内疚。
ext.ext_en: You don't have to feel bad about relaxing...

ext.ext_cn: 大部分工作都是他在干，我觉得很过意不去。
ext.ext_en: I feel bad that he's  doing most of the work...

defs.def_en: If you feel bad about something, you feel rather sorry or guilty about it.

ext.ext_cn: 阿拉斯泰尔背部有毛病，所以我们睡硬板床。
ext.ext_en: Alastair has a bad back so we have a hard bed.

defs.def_en: If you have a bad back, heart, leg, or eye, it is injured, diseased, or weak.

ext.ext_cn: 他们买了太多牛肉，有些都变质了。
ext.ext_en: They bought so much beef that some went bad.

defs.def_en: Food that has gone bad is not suitable to eat because it has started to decay.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我不喜欢在街上听见一些污言秽语。
ext.ext_en: I don't like to hear bad language in the street...

ext.ext_cn: 我说了一句脏话。
ext.ext_en: I said a bad word.

defs.def_en: Bad language is language that contains offensive words such as swear words.

ext.ext_cn: 埃莉诺不得不这么快就离开，真是太遗憾了。
ext.ext_en: It is too bad that Eleanor had to leave so soon...

ext.ext_cn: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。
ext.ext_en: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is too bad that something is the case, you mean you are sorry or sad that it is the case.

defs.def_cn: （表示无法改变，亦不觉得抱歉或同情）算…倒霉

ext.ext_cn: 你没有赶上公交车只能算自己倒霉。
ext.ext_en: Too bad if you missed the bus.

defs.def_en: If you say 'too bad', you are indicating that nothing can be done to change the situation, and that you do not feel sorry or sympathetic about this.

ext.ext_cn: 经济陷入困境。
ext.ext_en: The economy is in a bad way...

ext.ext_cn: “你看起来糟透了，”布拉德笑着说。
ext.ext_en: 'You look in a bad way,' chuckled Brad.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is in a bad way, they are in a bad condition or situation.

defs.def_cn: 对…有不好的评价；说…的坏话

ext.ext_cn: 她美丽，富有，出名，而且我们还没有发现谁说她不好。
ext.ext_en: She's got beauty, wealth, and fame, and we still can't find anyone with a bad word to say about her.

defs.def_en: If nobody has a bad word to say about you, you are liked or admired by everyone.

ext.ext_cn: 密封的飞机内很少需要补充氧气。
ext.ext_en: Supplementary oxygen is rarely needed in pressurized aircraft...

ext.ext_cn: 某些种类的食物也可以装入密封的金属罐里。
ext.ext_en: Certain types of foods are also dispensed in pressurized canisters.

defs.def_en: In a pressurized container or area, the pressure inside is different from the pressure outside.
The operating system of a computer is its most basic program, which it needs in order to function and run other programs.
An estate agent is someone who works for a company that sells houses and land for people.

defs.def_cn: 对…甜言蜜语;给…灌迷魂汤;哄骗

ext.ext_cn: 她总能哄得帕梅拉同意她晚睡一会。
ext.ext_en: She could always sweet-talk Pamela into letting her stay up late...

ext.ext_cn: 他甚至想和逮住他的女警官套近乎。
ext.ext_en: He even tried to sweet-talk the policewoman who arrested him.

defs.def_en: If you sweet talk someone, you talk to them very nicely so that they will do what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 搬运工帮她卸下了她一直用手推车推着的3个大箱子。
ext.ext_en: A porter relieved her of the three large cases she had been pushing on a trolley.

ext.ext_cn: 超市手推车
ext.ext_en: ...supermarket trolleys.

defs.def_en: A trolley is an object with wheels that you use to transport heavy things such as shopping or luggage.

defs.def_cn: (运送食品饮料上桌的)小推车，台车

ext.ext_cn: 侍者已经推来了甜食推车。
ext.ext_en: The waiter had brought the sweet trolley.

defs.def_en: A trolley is a small table on wheels which is used for serving drinks or food.

ext.ext_cn: 她被放在一辆担架车上14个小时，连一杯水都没有喝。
ext.ext_en: She was left on a hospital trolley for 14 hours without even a glass of water.

defs.def_en: A trolley is a bed on wheels for moving patients in hospital.

ext.ext_cn: 他在州街登上了一辆北行的有轨电车。
ext.ext_en: He took a northbound trolley on State Street.

defs.def_en: A trolley or trolley car is an electric vehicle for carrying people which travels on rails in the streets of a town.

ext.ext_cn: 她是疯了还是怎么了？
ext.ext_en: Is she off her trolley or what?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is off their trolley, you mean that their ideas or behaviour are very strange.

ext.ext_cn: 我顺着走廊看了一眼9号房。
ext.ext_en: I looked down the hallway to room number nine...

ext.ext_cn: 她转头看他。
ext.ext_en: She  turned to look at him...

defs.def_en: If you look in a particular direction, you direct your eyes in that direction, especially so that you can see what is there or see what something is like.

ext.ext_cn: 你只要看一下第3幕最后那部分。
ext.ext_en: You've  just got to look at the last bit of Act Three.

ext.ext_cn: 大致浏览一下周一的英国报纸就会发现，国外新闻还真不少。
ext.ext_en: A quick look at Monday's British newspapers shows that there's plenty of interest in foreign news.

defs.def_en: If you look at a book, newspaper, or magazine, you read it fairly quickly or read part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 您能看一下我的背吗？我觉得有点儿不对劲。
ext.ext_en: Can you look at my back? I think something's  wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 这辆车最近跑起来一直不是很顺，只好请修理工来看了一下。
ext.ext_en: The car has not been running very well and a mechanic had to come over to have a look at it.

defs.def_en: If someone, especially an expert, looks at something, they examine it, and then deal with it or say how it should be dealt with.

ext.ext_cn: 她认真地看着他说：“你不介意吗？”
ext.ext_en: She looked at him earnestly. 'You don't mind?'

ext.ext_cn: 他面无表情地看了她一眼，仿佛根本不认识她一样。
ext.ext_en: He gave her a blank look, as if he had no idea who she was...

defs.def_en: If you look at someone in a particular way, you look at them with your expression showing what you are feeling or thinking.

ext.ext_cn: 我在找一个小孩。我相信你丈夫可以帮我找到她。
ext.ext_en: I'm looking for a child. I believe your husband can help me find her...

ext.ext_cn: 我去了缅因州找工作。
ext.ext_en: I had gone to Maine looking for a place to work...

defs.def_en: If you look for something, for example something that you have lost, you try to find it.

defs.def_cn: 寻找，寻求，谋求（解决方案或新的方法）

ext.ext_cn: 工作小组将寻求切实可行的方案，以解决医生们遇到的难题。
ext.ext_en: The working group will be looking for practical solutions to the problems faced by doctors...

ext.ext_cn: 他正在想办法摆脱这一纷争。
ext.ext_en: He's looking for a way out from this conflict.

defs.def_en: If you are looking for something such as the solution to a problem or a new method, you want it and are trying to obtain it or think of it.

ext.ext_cn: 下学期咱们会研究二战时期…
ext.ext_en: Next term we'll  be looking at the Second World War period...

ext.ext_cn: 安妮·霍尔克负责权衡你房屋改造的利与弊。
ext.ext_en: Anne Holker looks at the pros and cons of making changes to your property...

defs.def_en: If you look at a subject, problem, or situation, you think about it or study it, so that you know all about it and can perhaps consider what should be done in relation to it.

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩看她时变得多了一分尊重。
ext.ext_en: Brian had learned to look at her with new respect...

ext.ext_cn: 这要看你怎么看待它。
ext.ext_en: It depends how you look at it.

defs.def_en: If you look at a person, situation, or subject from a particular point of view, you judge them or consider them from that point of view.

defs.def_cn: （用于唤起他人注意）瞧，听着，听我说

ext.ext_cn: 哎，对不起。我不是故意的。
ext.ext_en: Look, I'm sorry. I didn't  mean it...

ext.ext_cn: 现在听好啦，情况眼下是这样的。
ext.ext_en: Now, look, here is how things stand.

defs.def_en: You say look when you want someone to pay attention to you because you are going to say something important.

defs.def_cn: （用于让他人注意令人惊讶、重要或使人厌烦的事）瞧，看看

ext.ext_cn: 嘿，看看都几点啦？咱们晚上再讨论，好不好？
ext.ext_en: Hey, look at the time! We'll talk about it tonight. All right?...

ext.ext_cn: 我是说，你瞧看电视的有多少人，看书的又有几个。
ext.ext_en: I mean, look at how many people watch television and how few read books...

defs.def_en: You can use look to draw attention to a particular situation, person, or thing, for example because you find it very surprising, significant, or annoying.

defs.def_cn: （建筑物、窗户等）面向，朝向对着

ext.ext_cn: 城堡俯瞰一片私家绿地。
ext.ext_en: The castle looks over private parkland...

ext.ext_cn: 家家大门对大门，中间隔着一条窄巷。
ext.ext_en: Each front door looks across a narrow alley to the front door opposite.

defs.def_en: If something such as a building or window looks somewhere, it has a view of a particular place.

ext.ext_cn: 我们没打算大赚一笔。
ext.ext_en: We're not looking to make a fortune.

ext.ext_cn: 生完孩子后打算瘦身的年轻妈妈们
ext.ext_en: ...young mums looking to get fit after having kids.

defs.def_en: If you are looking to do something, you are aiming to do it.

defs.def_cn: 从此一帆风顺；此后蒸蒸日上

ext.ext_cn: 我在儿子亚当出世后开始从事自由职业，自此一帆风顺。
ext.ext_en: I went freelance when my son Adam was born, and have never looked back.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone did something and then never looked back, you mean that they were very successful from that time on.

ext.ext_cn: 他不敢直视她的眼睛。
ext.ext_en: He could not look her in the eye.

defs.def_en: If you look someone in the eye or look them in the face, you look straight at their eyes in a bold and open way, for example in order to make them realize that you are telling the truth.

ext.ext_cn: 法官和政客对警察虐待或杀人之事常常装聋作哑。
ext.ext_en: Judges and politicians routinely looked the other way while people were tortured or killed by police.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone looks the other way, you are critical of them because they pay no attention to something unpleasant that is happening, when they should be dealing with it properly.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于对某人言行感到恼火时）喂，你听我说

ext.ext_cn: 你听我说，蒂姆，你这种反应真的没必要。
ext.ext_en: Now look here, Tim, there really is no need for that kind of reaction.

defs.def_en: You say look here when you are going to say something important to someone, especially when you are angry at what they have done or said.

ext.ext_cn: 卡车冲向大海时，有人大喊“当心！”
ext.ext_en: 'Look out!' somebody shouted, as the truck started to roll toward the sea.

defs.def_en: If you say or shout 'look out!' to someone, you are warning them that they are in danger.

ext.ext_cn: 那个女店员对我上下打量了一番后，叫我不要试穿那条裙子，因为她认为我穿不上。
ext.ext_en: The sales assistant looked me up and down and told me not to try the dress on because she didn't think I would get into it.

defs.def_en: If someone looks you up and down, they direct their eyes from your head to your feet, in a rude and superior way and often as though they disapprove of you.

ext.ext_cn: 希拉看上去愁眉苦脸的。
ext.ext_en: Sheila was looking miserable...

ext.ext_cn: 我要用这笔钱把家里搞得漂漂亮亮的。
ext.ext_en: I shall use the money to make my home look lovely...

defs.def_en: You use look when describing the appearance of a person or thing or the impression that they give.

ext.ext_cn: 她一副遭人遗弃和背叛的样子。
ext.ext_en: She had the look of someone deserted and betrayed...

ext.ext_cn: 装修厨房的时候，肯尼思选择的是一种亲切质朴的田园风格。
ext.ext_en: When he came to decorate the kitchen, Kenneth opted for a friendly rustic look...

defs.def_en: If someone or something has a particular look, they have a particular appearance or expression.

ext.ext_cn: 我从不以貌取人。
ext.ext_en: I never chose people just because of their looks.

ext.ext_cn: 健康、美丽的年轻女子
ext.ext_en: ...a young woman with wholesome good looks.

defs.def_en: When you refer to someone's looks, you are referring to how beautiful or ugly they are, especially how beautiful they are.

ext.ext_cn: 他有很多时间考虑将来，但情况似乎并不乐观。
ext.ext_en: He had lots of time to think about the future, and it didn't look good...

ext.ext_cn: 看来，英国已下决心要派遣一支配备有百余坦克和支援装备的主力部队。
ext.ext_en: Britain looks set to send a major force of over 100 tanks and supporting equipment...

defs.def_en: You use look when indicating what you think will happen in the future or how a situation seems to you.

ext.ext_en: My main worry was that Madeleine Johnson would still be there...

ext.ext_cn: 让人担心的是，使用武力可能会使联合国维和人员性命难保。
ext.ext_en: The worry is that the use of force could make life impossible for the UN peacekeepers...

defs.def_en: A worry is a problem that you keep thinking about and that makes you unhappy.

defs.def_cn: （表示自己并不烦恼或生气）别担心；没关系

ext.ext_cn: “没关系，宝贝儿。”他说道，然后温柔地吻了她一下。
ext.ext_en: 'Not to worry, Baby,' he said, and kissed her tenderly.

defs.def_en: You say not to worry to someone to indicate that you are not upset or angry when something has gone wrong.
Your tonsils are the two small soft lumps in your throat at the back of your mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 以前每次狂欢派对过后，我们都会到彼此的卧室去放松一下。
ext.ext_en: After raves, we used to chill out in each others' bedrooms.

defs.def_en: To chill out means to relax after you have done something tiring or stressful.

defs.def_cn: 以观看(火车或飞机等)为癖好的人

ext.ext_cn: 我是个酷爱看火车的人。
ext.ext_en: I was a devoted train spotter.

defs.def_en: A spotter of something such as trains or aeroplanes is someone whose hobby is watching and finding out about them.

defs.def_cn: （尤指向前）突然一蹿，突然急动

ext.ext_cn: 车子飞驶过一个坑洼时，她身子猛地向前一倾。
ext.ext_en: As the car sped over a pothole she lurched forward...

ext.ext_cn: 亨利看了一眼，顿时瞪大了眼睛，然后突然猛地一下站了起来。
ext.ext_en: Henry looked, stared, and lurched to his feet...

defs.def_en: To lurch means to make a sudden movement, especially forwards, in an uncontrolled way.

defs.def_cn: （在不同的行动、态度之间）左冲右撞，摇摆不定

ext.ext_cn: 州政府陷入一个又一个的预算危机。
ext.ext_en: The state government has lurched from one budget crisis to another...

ext.ext_cn: 首轮多边贸易谈判在希望与绝望间来回摇摆。
ext.ext_en: The first round of multilateral trade talks has lurched between hope and despair.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or organization lurches from one thing to another, you mean they move suddenly from one course of action or attitude to another in an uncontrolled way.

defs.def_cn: 弃…于危难之中；对…坐视不救

ext.ext_cn: 你总不会对老朋友见死不救吧？
ext.ext_en: You wouldn't leave an old friend in the lurch, surely?

defs.def_en: If someone leaves you in the lurch, they go away or stop helping you at a very difficult time.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天一个母亲在监护权之争中获胜，赢得了双胞胎女儿的监护权。
ext.ext_en: A mother yesterday won a tug-of-love battle for custody of her twin daughters.

defs.def_en: Journalists sometimes use tug-of-love to refer to a situation in which the parents of a child are divorced and one of the parents tries to get the child from the other, for example by taking him or her illegally.

ext.ext_cn: 科特雷尔穿过铺着鹅卵石的院子大步走出来。
ext.ext_en: Cottrell strode out across the cobbled courtyard.

defs.def_en: A cobbled street has a surface made of cobblestones.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她看上去和以往一样平静安详。
ext.ext_en: She looked as calm and serene as she always did...

ext.ext_cn: 他话不多,只是脸上露出他招牌式的淡定的微笑。
ext.ext_en: He didn't speak much, he just smiled with that serene smile of his.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is serene is calm and quiet.

defs.def_cn: (尤当 has 为助动词时，what is 或 what has 的常用口语形式)
defs.def_en: What's is the usual spoken form of 'what is' or 'what has', especially when 'has' is an auxiliary verb.

ext.ext_cn: 切成瓣的橙子
ext.ext_en: ...segmented oranges.

defs.def_en: Segmented means divided into parts that are loosely connected to each other.

ext.ext_cn: 道路上车流拥挤。
ext.ext_en: There was heavy traffic on the roads...

ext.ext_cn: 对于一天中的那个时间段而言，来往车辆少得有些不寻常。
ext.ext_en: Traffic was unusually light for that time of day.

defs.def_en: See also:traffic jam;Traffic refers to all the vehicles that are moving along the roads in a particular area.

defs.def_cn: (海上、铁路或空中的)交通，通行;(客、货)运输量

ext.ext_cn: 空中交通已恢复正常。
ext.ext_en: Air traffic had returned to normal...

ext.ext_cn: 铁路将承担比例高得多的货运量。
ext.ext_en: The railways will carry a far higher proportion of freight traffic...

defs.def_en: See also:air traffic control;Traffic refers to the movement of ships, trains, or aircraft between one place and another. Traffic also refers to the people and goods that are being transported.

defs.def_cn: (毒品、赃物等的)非法买卖，非法交易

ext.ext_cn: 如今每年非法毒品的交易值约在 5,000 亿美元。
ext.ext_en: Traffic in illicit drugs was now worth some 500 thousand million dollars a year.

defs.def_en: Traffic in something such as drugs or stolen goods is an illegal trade in them.

ext.ext_cn: 总统称毒品正在危害整个世界，任何非法贩卖毒品的人都应依法受到惩处。
ext.ext_en: The president said illegal drugs are hurting the entire world and anyone who traffics in them should be brought to justice.

defs.def_en: Someone who traffics in something such as drugs or stolen goods buys and sells them even though it is illegal to do so.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (政策或政党)温和的，中间派的

ext.ext_cn: 他退出了该运动，因为它放弃了温和政策。
ext.ext_en: He had left the movement because it had abandoned its centrist policies.

defs.def_en: Centrist policies and parties are moderate rather than extreme.
An oxcart is a cart pulled by an ox or oxen.

ext.ext_cn: 墙上挂着几幅精美的油画。
ext.ext_en: Several magnificent oil paintings adorn the walls.

defs.def_en: An oil painting is a picture which has been painted using oil paints.

ext.ext_cn: 多年来该剧本一直在修改。
ext.ext_en: The script has been gathering editorial accretions for years.

defs.def_en: An accretion is an addition to something, usually one that has been added over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 珊瑚礁是由许多相同的微生物不断堆积而成。
ext.ext_en: A coral reef is built by the accretion of tiny, identical organisms.

defs.def_en: Accretion is the process of new layers or parts being added to something so that it increases in size.

ext.ext_cn: 他曾在这里向不信教的当地人宣讲《福音书》。
ext.ext_en: He preached the Gospel to the heathen locals from this spot.

ext.ext_cn: 异教徒的庙宇
ext.ext_en: ...a heathen temple.

defs.def_en: Heathen means having no religion, or belonging to a religion that is not Christianity, Judaism, or Islam.

ext.ext_cn: 她称我们都是不信神的伪君子。
ext.ext_en: She called us all heathens and hypocrites.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to other people who have no religion as heathens, especially if they do not like the way they behave as a result of this.

ext.ext_cn: 这些军官至死都忠于波兰，坚守了军人气节。
ext.ext_en: The officers died faithful to Poland and to the honour of a soldier...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为自己再也无法问心无愧地在你的政府中任职。
ext.ext_en: I do not believe I can any longer serve with honour as a member of your government.

defs.def_en: Honour means doing what you believe to be right and being confident that you have done what is right.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数的高级荣誉通常都会授予忠于政府的资深议员。
ext.ext_en: Most of the high honours usually go to long-serving MPs loyal to the government...

ext.ext_cn: 他赢得了众多荣誉——其中包括一项奥斯卡奖。
ext.ext_en: He was showered with honours—among them an Oscar.

defs.def_en: An honour is a special award that is given to someone, usually because they have done something good or because they are greatly respected.

ext.ext_cn: 两位美国外科医生上周获得了诺贝尔医学和生理学奖。
ext.ext_en: Two American surgeons were last week honoured with the Nobel Prize for Medicine and Physiology...

ext.ext_cn: 雷迪先生被教皇授予“圣格列高利骑士”的荣誉称号。
ext.ext_en: Mr Reddy has been honoured by the Pope by being made a knight of St Gregory.

defs.def_en: If someone is honoured, they are given public praise or an award for something they have done.

ext.ext_cn: 还有其他5个城市为赢得该届运动会的主办权一直在进行角逐。
ext.ext_en: Five other cities had been competing for the honour of staging the Games...

ext.ext_cn: 柴可夫斯基得到了国葬待遇——他是首位获此殊荣的平民。
ext.ext_en: Tchaikovsky was given a state funeral—the first commoner to be granted this honour...

defs.def_en: If you describe doing or experiencing something as an honour, you mean you think it is something special and desirable.

defs.def_cn: 使感到荣幸;使引以为荣

ext.ext_cn: 彼得·艾利斯说若受邀约自己将感到非常荣幸。
ext.ext_en: Peter Alliss says he would be honoured to be asked...

ext.ext_cn: 这个提议让我受宠若惊，能得到您的信任我感到很荣幸。
ext.ext_en: It's a very flattering offer, and I'm honoured by your confidence in me.

defs.def_en: If you say that you would be honoured to do something, you are saying very politely and formally that you would be pleased to do it. If you say that you are honoured by something, you are saying that you are grateful for it and pleased about it.

ext.ext_cn: 女王陛下随后出席了午宴，以表示对校长的尊重。
ext.ext_en: Her Majesty later honoured the Headmaster with her presence at lunch...

ext.ext_cn: 那些对君主最为尊崇的右翼人士认为没有理由作出道歉。
ext.ext_en: Those right-wing people who most honour their monarch see no reason for any apology.

defs.def_en: To honour someone means to treat them or regard them with special attention and respect.

ext.ext_cn: 双方同意执行新的停火协议。
ext.ext_en: The two sides agreed to honour a new ceasefire...

ext.ext_cn: 阿什克纳齐先生已通知我们，他将无法履行和交响音乐厅签订的钢琴独奏演出合同。
ext.ext_en: Mr Ashkenazy has informed us that he will be unable to honour his contract with Symphony Hall to perform the piano recital.

defs.def_en: If you honour an arrangement or promise, you do what you said you would do.

ext.ext_cn: 商学荣誉学位
ext.ext_en: ...an honours degree in business studies.

defs.def_en: Honours is a type of university degree which is of a higher standard than a pass or ordinary degree.

defs.def_cn: （美国对法官、市长等的尊称）阁下，大人（当面称呼时用 your honour，其他场合提及时用 his honour 或 her honour）

ext.ext_cn: 法官大人，我之所以提及此事，是因为我觉得了解被告的背景十分重要。
ext.ext_en: I bring this up, your honor, because I think it is important to understand the background of the defendant.

ext.ext_cn: 布罗德里克法官大人
ext.ext_en: ...His Honour Judge Brodrick.

defs.def_en: Judges, and mayors in the United States, are sometimes called your honour or referred to as his honour or her honour .

ext.ext_cn: 一位著名的电视明星主持了该次展览的正式开幕典礼。
ext.ext_en: A well-known television personality did the honours at the official opening of the show.

defs.def_en: If someone does the honours at a social occasion or public event, they act as host or perform some official function.

ext.ext_cn: 该基金会将在美国艺术博物馆举办宴会，庆祝新展览的开幕。
ext.ext_en: The Foundation is holding a dinner at the Museum of American Art in honour of the opening of their new show.

defs.def_en: If something is arranged in honour of a particular event, it is arranged in order to celebrate that event.

ext.ext_cn: 他将出席在巴黎市中心特地为他举办的一场露天音乐会。
ext.ext_en: He will attend an outdoor concert in his honour in the centre of Paris...

ext.ext_cn: 联合国发行了一枚纪念阿尔弗雷德·德雷富斯上尉的邮票。
ext.ext_en: The United Nations has issued a stamp in honour of Captain Alfred Dreyfus.

defs.def_en: If something is arranged or happens in someone's honour, it is done specially to show appreciation of them.
In chess, endgame refers to the final stage of a game, when only a few pieces are left on the board and one of the players must win soon.

defs.def_cn: （战争、争论、竞赛等的）最后阶段

ext.ext_cn: 政治活动正在临近尾声。
ext.ext_en: The political endgame is getting closer.

defs.def_en: Journalists sometimes refer to the final stages of something such as a war, dispute, or contest, as an endgame.
A letter bomb is a small bomb which is disguised as a letter or parcel and sent to someone through the post. It is designed to explode when it is opened.

ext.ext_cn: 我整天无休止地编织缝纫。
ext.ext_en: I had endless hours to knit and sew...

ext.ext_cn: 我已经开始给宝宝织衣服了。
ext.ext_en: I have already started knitting baby clothes...

defs.def_en: If you knit something, especially an article of clothing, you make it from wool or a similar thread by using two knitting needles or a machine.

defs.def_cn: 使紧密结合；使严密；使紧凑

ext.ext_cn: 体育运动最大的益处在于它使整个家庭紧密地团结在一起。
ext.ext_en: The best thing about sport is that it knits the whole family close together...

ext.ext_cn: 普通百姓对总统号召人们邻里间亲密相处的动机心存疑虑。
ext.ext_en: Ordinary people have some reservations about their president's drive to knit them so closely to their neighbors.

defs.def_en: If someone or something knits things or people together, they make them fit or work together closely and successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 骨头愈合得不好。
ext.ext_en: The bone hasn't knitted together properly.

ext.ext_cn: 没能愈合好的断骨
ext.ext_en: ...broken bones that have failed to knit.

defs.def_en: When broken bones knit, the broken pieces grow together again.

ext.ext_cn: 他们皱着眉头抱怨起来。
ext.ext_en: They knitted their brows and started to grumble...

ext.ext_cn: 比利眉头微皱。
ext.ext_en: Billy's eyebrows knitted together in a little frown.

defs.def_en: If you knit your brows or knit your eyebrows, you frown because you are angry or worried.

defs.def_cn: 聚苯乙烯泡沫塑料(尤用于制造器皿)
defs.def_en: Styrofoam is a very light, plastic substance, used especially to make containers.

defs.def_cn: 苦苦思索而弄清楚（或解决）

ext.ext_cn: 他动身到他的避暑别墅去想清楚他下一步应该做什么。
ext.ext_en: He left for his summer cottage to puzzle out what he might try next...

ext.ext_cn: 诺先科苦苦思索终于想起了库佳的姓。
ext.ext_en: Nosenko puzzled out Kutya's surname...

defs.def_en: If you puzzle out a problem, you find the answer to it by thinking hard about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的妻子埃丽卡始终如一地关心和支持着他。
ext.ext_en: He had the unfailing care and support of Erica, his wife...

ext.ext_cn: 始终彬彬有礼、心地善良的人
ext.ext_en: ...a man of unfailing courtesy and kindness...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's good qualities or behaviour as unfailing, you mean that they never change.

ext.ext_cn: 村子坐落在大路边上，很容易成为土匪袭击的对象。
ext.ext_en: The village lies beside a main road, making it an easy target for bandits...

ext.ext_cn: 导弹没有击中目标。
ext.ext_en: The missiles missed their target...

defs.def_en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

ext.ext_cn: 他赢回自己的位置时为时已晚，无法实现本赛季进 20 粒球的目标。
ext.ext_en: He's won back his place too late to achieve his target of 20 goals this season.

ext.ext_cn: 未能达到规定分数的肄业生
ext.ext_en: ...school leavers who failed to reach their target grades.

defs.def_en: A target is a result that you are trying to achieve.

defs.def_cn: 攻击;批评;以…为攻击目标

ext.ext_cn: 共和党人将安索尔德定为攻击目标，认为她在争取今年连任的竞选中不堪一击。
ext.ext_en: Republicans targeted Unsoeld as vulnerable in her bid for reelection this year...

ext.ext_cn: 他抨击经济是治安状况不断恶化的根源。
ext.ext_en: He targets the economy as the root cause of the deteriorating law and order situation.

defs.def_en: To target a particular person or thing means to decide to attack or criticize them.

ext.ext_cn: 这场活动将以美国各保险公司为目标。
ext.ext_en: The campaign will target American insurance companies...

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司将成年人作为其主要顾客。
ext.ext_en: The company has targeted adults as its primary customers.

defs.def_en: If you target a particular group of people, you try to appeal to those people or affect them.

defs.def_cn: 进展顺利;有可能实现目标

ext.ext_cn: 我们仍然有可能赶在最后期限前达成目标。
ext.ext_en: We were still right on target for our deadline.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is on target, they are making good progress and are likely to achieve the result that is wanted.

ext.ext_cn: 纯种阿拉伯马
ext.ext_en: ...pure-bred Arab horses.

defs.def_en: A pure-bred animal is one whose parents and ancestors all belong to the same breed.

defs.def_cn: 使人们忘记（错误、失败、恶名等）

ext.ext_cn: 工党也无法让人忘记其高税党的名声。
ext.ext_en: Labour was also unable to live down its reputation as the party of high taxes...

ext.ext_cn: 我原以为大家永远都不会忘记这件事了。
ext.ext_en: I thought I'd never live it down.

defs.def_en: If you are unable to live down a mistake, failure, or bad reputation, you are unable to make people forget about it.

ext.ext_cn: 这只棕黄色的狗看上去非常像美国比特犬。
ext.ext_en: The tan-coloured dog looks suspiciously like an American pit bull terrier...

ext.ext_cn: “是”，他答道，但听起来语气中充满了疑问。
ext.ext_en: 'Yes,' he replied, though it sounded suspiciously like a question.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing looks or sounds suspiciously like another thing, you mean that it probably is that thing, or something very similar to it, although it may be intended to seem different.

ext.ext_cn: 他一个人住在诺丁山门的一套整洁干净得出奇的公寓里。
ext.ext_en: He lives alone in a suspiciously tidy flat in Notting Hill Gate...

ext.ext_cn: 果冻上面是一小团看上去有点怪异的人造奶油。
ext.ext_en: The jellies were topped with suspiciously synthetic blobs of cream.

defs.def_en: You can use suspiciously when you are describing something that you think is slightly strange or not as it should be.

defs.def_cn: 母亲节(在英国是四旬斋的第四个星期日;在美国是五月的第二个星期日。)
defs.def_en: Mother's Day is a special day on which children give cards and presents to their mothers as a sign of their love for them. In Britain, Mother's Day is the fourth Sunday in Lent. In the United States, it is the second Sunday in May.

ext.ext_cn: 安杰拉说她渴望参加业余戏剧班。
ext.ext_en: Angela says she longs to join an amateur dramatics class.

ext.ext_cn: 大学戏剧社团
ext.ext_en: ...the university dramatics society.

defs.def_en: You use dramatics to refer to activities connected with the theatre and drama, such as acting in plays or producing them.

defs.def_cn: 夸张的行为;做作的举止

ext.ext_cn: 南希又一次令人厌烦的装腔作势的举动
ext.ext_en: ...another wearisome outbreak of Nancy's dramatics.

defs.def_en: You talk about dramatics to express your disapproval of behaviour which seems to show too much emotion, and which you think is done deliberately in order to impress people.

ext.ext_cn: 他记下纬度和经度，然后在航海图上做了个标记。
ext.ext_en: He noted the latitude and longitude, then made a mark on the admiralty chart.

ext.ext_cn: 在北纬13度、经度230度到250度之间发现了类似的特征。
ext.ext_en: A similar feature is found at 13 degrees North between 230 degrees and 250 degrees longitude.

defs.def_en: The longitude of a place is its distance to the west or east of a line passing through Greenwich.

ext.ext_cn: 德博拉幼年生活的详尽细节
ext.ext_en: ...minute details of Deborah's infancy.

ext.ext_cn: 从婴儿期开始的心智发展
ext.ext_en: ...the development of the mind from infancy onwards.

defs.def_en: Infancy is the period of your life when you are a very young child.

ext.ext_cn: 计算科学仍然处于初期阶段。
ext.ext_en: Computing science was still in its infancy.

defs.def_en: If something is in its infancy, it is new and has not developed very much.

ext.ext_cn: 这些就是用来粉碎他们所谓的经济奇迹的事实。
ext.ext_en: These are the facts that explode their so-called economic miracle...

ext.ext_cn: 越来越多的公司变得“环保”起来，开始生产所谓的环境友好型产品。
ext.ext_en: More and more companies have gone 'green' and started producing so-called environmentally-friendly products.

defs.def_en: You use so-called to indicate that you think a word or expression used to describe someone or something is in fact wrong.

defs.def_cn: (指通常的称谓)所说的，所谓的

ext.ext_cn: 世界七大市场经济国家，即所谓的“七国集团”召开的一次峰会
ext.ext_en: ...a summit of the world's seven leading market economies, the so-called G-7...

ext.ext_cn: 她是所谓的“四人帮”之一。
ext.ext_en: She was one of the so-called Gang of Four.

defs.def_en: You use so-called to indicate that something is generally referred to by the name that you are about to use.

ext.ext_cn: 由世界自然基金会赞助的支持“保护世界森林”的徒步行走活动
ext.ext_en: ...a walk in support of Forests of the World, under the auspices of the World Wildlife Fund.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国主办的和平大会
ext.ext_en: ...a peace conference under United Nations auspices.

defs.def_en: If something is done under the auspices of a particular person or organization, or under someone's auspices, it is done with their support and approval.

ext.ext_cn: 火腿鳄梨非常好吃。
ext.ext_en: The ham is delicious with avocado.

defs.def_en: Avocados are pear-shaped vegetables, with hard skins and large stones, which are usually eaten raw.

ext.ext_cn: 水泵开动了，消防队员们开始用水灭火。

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: “是麦基博士吗？”那个男人用平稳而洪亮的声音喊道。
ext.ext_en: 'Doctor McKee?' the man called in an even, sonorous voice.

defs.def_en: A sonorous sound is deep and rich.

defs.def_cn: 和平红利，和平效益（指冷战结束后由于原先花在国防和武器上的开支得以用于其他目的所带来的经济利益）

ext.ext_cn: 虽然大多数国家的军事支出在降低，但和平红利并没有兑现。
ext.ext_en: The peace dividend has not materialised despite military spending going down in most countries.

defs.def_en: The peace dividend is the economic benefit that was expected in the world after the end of the Cold War, as a result of money previously spent on defence and arms becoming available for other purposes.

defs.def_cn: (英格兰和威尔士的有法官和陪审团列席的)刑事法庭

ext.ext_cn: 他因被控醉酒驾车而于周四在曼彻斯特的刑事法庭受审。
ext.ext_en: He appeared at Manchester Crown Court on Thursday on a drink-driving charge.

defs.def_en: In England and Wales, a Crown Court is a court in which criminal cases are tried by a judge and jury rather than by a magistrate.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 大声说出的;直言不讳的;激烈表达意见的

ext.ext_cn: 他直言不讳地表达了他对结果的不满。
ext.ext_en: He has been very vocal in his displeasure over the results...

ext.ext_cn: 今年早些时候进行的一次公众调查显示居民对此强烈抗议。
ext.ext_en: A public inquiry earlier this year produced vocal opposition from residents.

defs.def_en: You say that people are vocal when they speak forcefully about something that they feel strongly about.

defs.def_cn: 嗓音的;发声的;（尤指）歌唱的

ext.ext_cn: 更多样的歌唱风格
ext.ext_en: ...a wider range of vocal styles.

ext.ext_cn: 发声训练
ext.ext_en: ...vocal training.

defs.def_en: Vocal means involving the use of the human voice, especially in singing.

ext.ext_cn: 他逢迎富人和中产阶级，得罪了该党的传统支持者。
ext.ext_en: He has offended the party's traditional base by pandering to the rich and the middle classes.

ext.ext_cn: 不迎合大众口味的书
ext.ext_en: ...books which don't pander to popular taste.

defs.def_en: If you pander to someone or to their wishes, you do everything that they want, often to get some advantage for yourself.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 所有的厨房操作台都应该足够宽大，为制作食物提供足够的空间。
ext.ext_en: All worktops should be wide enough to allow plenty of space for food preparation.

ext.ext_cn: 宽檐遮阳帽
ext.ext_en: ...a wide-brimmed sunhat.

defs.def_en: Something that is wide measures a large distance from one side or edge to the other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这让他眉开眼笑。
ext.ext_en: It brought a wide smile to his face and laughter to his eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 他脸上绽放出灿烂的笑容。
ext.ext_en: His face broke into a wide grin.

defs.def_en: A wide smile is one in which your mouth is stretched because you are very pleased or amused.

defs.def_cn: 张开很大的;完全张开的

ext.ext_cn: 张大你的嘴。
ext.ext_en: Open your mouth wide...

ext.ext_cn: “它很大很大”，他边说边伸开手臂比划着。
ext.ext_en: 'It was huge,' he announced, spreading his arms wide...

defs.def_en: If you open or spread something wide, you open or spread it as far as possible or to the fullest extent.

ext.ext_cn: 10公里宽的陆地走廊
ext.ext_en: ...a corridor of land 10 kilometres wide...

ext.ext_cn: 这条路只有一个车道那么宽。
ext.ext_en: The road is only one track wide.

defs.def_en: You use wide to talk or ask about how much something measures from one side or edge to the other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 范围广的;包容的;广泛的

ext.ext_cn: 这本小册子提供了很多宾馆、公寓、度假屋供选择。
ext.ext_en: The brochure offers a wide choice of hotels, apartments and holiday homes...

ext.ext_cn: 宪法提案赋予他比前任大得多的权力。
ext.ext_en: The proposed constitution gives him much wider powers than his predecessor.

defs.def_en: You use wide to describe something that includes a large number of different things or people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 广泛的;广为流传的;广为人知的

ext.ext_cn: 这个案子吸引了广泛的关注。
ext.ext_en: The case has attracted wide publicity...

ext.ext_cn: 我猜想这本书会引起大家最广泛的兴趣。
ext.ext_en: I suspect this book will have the widest appeal of all...

defs.def_en: You use wide to say that something is found, believed, known, or supported by many people or throughout a large area.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 研究表明全国各地的口味大有不同。
ext.ext_en: Research shows a wide difference in tastes around the country...

ext.ext_cn: 不同的教学项目结构造成了巨大的差异。
ext.ext_en: There are wide variations caused by different academic programme structures.

defs.def_en: A wide difference or gap between two things, ideas, or qualities is a large difference or gap.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 更大的;更多的;更广泛的

ext.ext_cn: 他强调了超级大国合作这一更重要的议题。
ext.ext_en: He emphasised the wider issue of superpower cooperation...

ext.ext_cn: 奥克利把家务置于更广泛的经济、社会和政治结构背景中。
ext.ext_en: Oakley locates housework in the wider context of economic, social and political structures.

defs.def_en: Wider is used to describe something which relates to the most important or general parts of a situation, rather than to the smaller parts or to details.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 未击中目标的;未打中的

ext.ext_cn: 不管怎样，这枪没打中。
ext.ext_en: The shot was wide anyway...

ext.ext_cn: 有近一半的导弹落点出现偏差。
ext.ext_en: Nearly half the missiles landed wide.

defs.def_en: If something such as a shot or punch is wide, it does not hit its target but lands to the right or left of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个地区大部分地方（除日本外）的传统肉食是猪肉。
ext.ext_en: The source of meat for much of this region (excepting Japan) has traditionally been the pig.

defs.def_en: You use excepting to introduce the only thing that prevents a statement from being completely true.

ext.ext_cn: 即使平放，这个真空水杯也是滴水不漏。
ext.ext_en: The flask is completely watertight, even when laid on its side...

ext.ext_cn: 电池被安全地置于一个防水的隔间里。
ext.ext_en: The batteries are safely enclosed in a watertight compartment.

defs.def_en: Something that is watertight does not allow water to pass through it, for example because it is tightly sealed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (事实、论点或协议)严密的，无懈可击的

ext.ext_cn: 警方找到了确凿的证据。他们甚至在那个玻璃橱柜上提取到了他的指纹。
ext.ext_en: The police had a watertight case. They even got his fingerprints from that glass cabinet.

ext.ext_cn: 严密规范的协议
ext.ext_en: ...a legally watertight agreement.

defs.def_en: A watertight case, argument, or agreement is one that has been so carefully put together that nobody will be able to find a fault in it.

defs.def_cn: 支吾；搪塞；推诿；闪烁其词

ext.ext_cn: 英国的大臣们仍然闪烁其词。
ext.ext_en: British ministers continued to prevaricate.

defs.def_en: If you prevaricate, you avoid giving a direct answer or making a firm decision.
Erotica means works of art that show or describe sexual activity, and which are intended to arouse sexual feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 他的头骨是被来复枪的枪托砸伤的。
ext.ext_en: The butt of a rifle had been used to bash in his skull.

ext.ext_cn: 一只头部被砸扁了的死狐狸
ext.ext_en: ...a dead fox with its head bashed in.

defs.def_en: If someone bashes a person's or animal's head in, they hit it very hard and cause severe injuries to it.
Gynaecology is the branch of medical science which deals with women's diseases and medical conditions.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们需要无条件的爱。
ext.ext_en: Children need unconditional love...

ext.ext_cn: 今天上午早些时候，反叛的首领无条件投降。
ext.ext_en: The leader of the revolt made an unconditional surrender early this morning.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unconditional, you mean that the person doing or giving it does not require anything to be done by other people in exchange.
High-heeled shoes are wo-men's shoes that have high heels.

ext.ext_cn: 成功的乡村乐歌手
ext.ext_en: ...a successful country and western singer.

defs.def_en: Country and western is the same as country music .
Physical education is the school subject in which children do physical exercises or take part in physical games and sports.

defs.def_cn: 舞台工作人员;后台工作人员
defs.def_en: A stagehand is a person whose job is to move the scenery and equipment on the stage in a theatre.

defs.def_cn: (因种族、性别、宗教不同而)隔离的，分开的

ext.ext_cn: 实行种族隔离制度的学校
ext.ext_en: ...racially segregated schools...

ext.ext_cn: 约翰在巴尔的摩长大，当时该市还在实行种族隔离制度。
ext.ext_en: John grew up in Baltimore when that city was segregated.

defs.def_en: Segregated buildings or areas are kept for the use of one group of people who are the same race, sex, or religion, and no other group is allowed to use them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 站不住脚的;无可辩解的

ext.ext_cn: 他的行为是不可原谅的。
ext.ext_en: His action was indefensible...

ext.ext_cn: 她认为新政策“在道德上是站不住脚的”。
ext.ext_en: She described the new policy as 'morally indefensible'.

defs.def_en: If you say that a statement, action, or idea is indefensible, you mean that it cannot be justified or supported because it is completely wrong or unacceptable.

defs.def_cn: 无法防御的;无法保卫的

ext.ext_cn: 检查站因为军事上无法防御而被舍弃。
ext.ext_en: The checkpoint was abandoned as militarily indefensible.

defs.def_en: Places or buildings that are indefensible cannot be defended if they are attacked.

ext.ext_cn: 我不是要故意侮辱你。
ext.ext_en: I did not mean to insult you...

ext.ext_cn: 布坎南说法官的那番话侮辱了他。
ext.ext_en: Buchanan said he was insulted by the judge's remarks.

defs.def_en: If someone insults you, they say or do something that is rude or offensive.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的行为是对他们代表的人民的一种侮辱。
ext.ext_en: Their behaviour was an insult to the people they represent...

ext.ext_cn: 监狱长批评了一些站在屋顶上大声辱骂囚犯的狱警。
ext.ext_en: The prison Governor criticised some of his officers who shouted insults at prisoners on the roof.

defs.def_en: An insult is a rude remark, or something a person says or does which insults you.

defs.def_cn: 更为不公的是;更不可接受的是;更糟的是

ext.ext_cn: 撞死史密斯的汽车司机仅被罚款250英镑，驾照上扣了5分。更让人不可接受的是,他竟然开着自己的车从法院扬长而去。
ext.ext_en: The driver of the car that killed Smith got a £250 fine and five penalty points on his licence. To add insult to injury, he drove away from court in his own car.

defs.def_en: You say to add insult to injury when mentioning an action or fact that makes an unfair or unacceptable situation even worse.

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲十分敬仰艾森豪威尔将军。
ext.ext_en: My father venerated General Eisenhower.

defs.def_en: If you venerate someone or something, you value them or feel great respect for them.

defs.def_cn: 紧缩开支；省吃俭用；节衣缩食

ext.ext_cn: 这会导致公共事业单位进一步紧缩开支。
ext.ext_en: This will cause further belt-tightening in the public services.

defs.def_en: If you need to do some belt-tightening, you must spend less money and manage without things because you have less money than you used to have.

defs.def_cn: 收据;售货单发票;销售小票
defs.def_en: A sales slip is a piece of paper that you are given when you buy something in a shop, which shows when you bought it and how much you paid.

ext.ext_cn: 需要30万吨谷类补充库存。
ext.ext_en: Three hundred thousand tons of cereals are needed to replenish stocks...

ext.ext_cn: 保险基金将需要进行补充。
ext.ext_en: The insurance fund will need to be replenished.

defs.def_en: If you replenish something, you make it full or complete again.

ext.ext_cn: 从地壳中开采矿石
ext.ext_en: ...digging minerals out of the Earth...

ext.ext_cn: 救援人员一直在倒塌的建筑物废墟中挖掘救人。
ext.ext_en: Rescue crews have been digging people out of collapsed buildings.

defs.def_en: If you dig someone or something out of a place, you get them out by digging or by forcing them from the things surrounding them.

defs.def_cn: 找出，翻出（收存、藏起或遗忘很久之物）

ext.ext_cn: 最近，我把巴斯托的小说翻出来又读了一遍。
ext.ext_en: Recently, I dug out Barstow's novel and read it again...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你要的话，我们会设法为你找出那个号码。
ext.ext_en: We'll try and dig the number out for you if you want it.

defs.def_en: If you dig something out, you find it after it has been stored, hidden, or forgotten for a long time.

defs.def_cn: 防御（性）的;防卫（用）的;保护的

ext.ext_cn: 政府急忙布置了防卫措施抵御空袭。
ext.ext_en: The Government hastily organized defensive measures against the raids...

ext.ext_cn: 由于 11 月份共和党重新控制了国会，工会领导人被推到更加被动防守的位置。
ext.ext_en: The union leaders were pushed into a more defensive position by the return of a Republican Congress in November.

defs.def_en: You use defensive to describe things that are intended to protect someone or something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （表现在行为上）防御的，戒备的，卫护的

ext.ext_cn: 就像子女一样，父母也常常很注重保护他们的私生活。
ext.ext_en: Like their children, parents are often defensive about their private lives.

ext.ext_cn: 她听出他话音里的气势汹汹和自我卫护，知道他感到了羞愧。
ext.ext_en: She heard the blustering, defensive note in his voice and knew that he was ashamed.

defs.def_en: Someone who is defensive is behaving in a way that shows they feel unsure or threatened.

defs.def_cn: 处于防御姿态;处于守势

ext.ext_cn: 谴责很可能会引发对方自我防卫的反应。
ext.ext_en: Accusations are likely to put the other person on the defensive...

ext.ext_cn: 他笑了笑，不想让那个人产生抵触情绪。
ext.ext_en: He smiled, not wanting to put the man on the defensive.

defs.def_en: If someone is on the defensive, they are trying to protect themselves or their interests because they feel unsure or threatened.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (体育运动中的打法)防守（型）的

ext.ext_cn: 我总是采取防守型的打法，等待对手出错。
ext.ext_en: I'd always played a defensive game, waiting for my opponent to make a mistake.

defs.def_en: In sports, defensive play is play that is intended to prevent your opponent from scoring goals or points against you.

ext.ext_cn: 实际上，在争论开始一年前他就已经离开公司了。
ext.ext_en: He had actually left the company a year before the rumpus started.

defs.def_en: If someone or something causes a rumpus, they cause a lot of noise or argument.

defs.def_cn: （使用多种语言的地区里）讲英语的

ext.ext_cn: 说英语的加拿大人
ext.ext_en: ...anglophone Canadians.

ext.ext_cn: 非洲的英语社区
ext.ext_en: ...anglophone Africa.

defs.def_en: Anglophone communities are English-speaking communities in areas where more than one language is commonly spoken.

defs.def_cn: （指母语为英语或因所在国的官方语言为英语而）讲英语的人

ext.ext_cn: 让人感觉在这个省讲英语的人是没有前途的。
ext.ext_en: It's felt there's no future for Anglophones in the province.

ext.ext_cn: 撒哈拉沙漠以南讲英语的人
ext.ext_en: ...sub-Sahara Anglophones.

defs.def_en: Anglophones are people whose native language is English or who speak English because they live in a country where English is one of the official languages.

defs.def_cn: 数字可写光碟;数字多功能可写光碟
defs.def_en: A DVD-RW is a DVD which is capable of recording sound and images, for example from another DVD or from the Internet. CD-RW is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'digital video disc rewritable' or 'digital versatile disc rewritable'.

ext.ext_cn: 传统的西班牙食品美味可口，其特色菜肴值得寻访。
ext.ext_en: Traditional Spanish food is delicious and its specialities are worth searching out...

ext.ext_cn: 许多人都想有份工作。他们每天努力寻找。
ext.ext_en: Many people want jobs. They try to search them out every day.

defs.def_en: If you search something out, you keep looking for it until you find it.

defs.def_cn: 自我中心;利己主义;自私自利
defs.def_en: Egotism is the quality of being egotistic.

ext.ext_cn: 无论你在英国哪里的低地旅行
ext.ext_en: ...wherever you travel in the lowlands of the United Kingdom.

ext.ext_cn: 湖对面低地上那个备受热病困扰的老镇
ext.ext_en: ...the fever-haunted old town on the lowland across the lake.

defs.def_en: Lowlands are an area of low, flat land.

ext.ext_cn: 鸟儿使劲地拍打翅膀。
ext.ext_en: The bird flapped its wings furiously...

ext.ext_cn: 她看见蛾子的翅膀偶尔会泛光。
ext.ext_en: She saw the occasional glimmer of a moth's wings.

defs.def_en: The wings of a bird or insect are the two parts of its body that it uses for flying.
The wings of an aeroplane are the long flat parts sticking out of its side which support it while it is flying.

ext.ext_cn: 给我们在空置的大楼西翼分了一间办公室。
ext.ext_en: We were given an office in the empty west wing.

ext.ext_cn: 在伦敦皇家自由医院配楼的儿童精神病部
ext.ext_en: ...in the Child Psychiatry wing of London's Royal Free Hospital.

defs.def_en: A wing of a building is a part of it which sticks out from the main part.

ext.ext_cn: 非洲国民大会的武装派
ext.ext_en: ...the military wing of the African National Congress.

ext.ext_cn: 民主党自由派
ext.ext_en: ...the liberal wing of the Democratic Party.

defs.def_en: See also:left-wing;right-wing;A wing of an organization, especially a political organization, is a group within it which has a particular function or particular beliefs.

defs.def_cn: (舞台两侧用帘幕或布景遮住的)边厢,翼部,侧面

ext.ext_cn: 大多数晚上我都是在边厢观看戏剧的开场。
ext.ext_en: Most nights I watched the start of the play from the wings.

defs.def_en: In a theatre, the wings are the sides of the stage which are hidden from the audience by curtains or scenery.

defs.def_cn: (足球、曲棍球等的)边锋位置；边锋
defs.def_en: In a game such as football or hockey, the left wing and the right wing are the areas on the far left and the far right of the pitch. You can also refer to the players who play in these positions as the left wing and the right wing .
A wing of a car is a part of it on the outside which is over one of the wheels.

defs.def_cn: 飞机驾驶资格；飞行资格

ext.ext_cn: 他刚获得飞行资格，朝鲜战争就爆发了。
ext.ext_en: He had no sooner got his wings than the Korean conflict broke out.

defs.def_en: When pilots get their wings, they become qualified to fly aeroplanes.

ext.ext_cn: 过了一会儿，他们已然搭上飞机赶往南方了。
ext.ext_en: A few moments later they were airborne and winging their way south...

ext.ext_cn: 该方案的60万成员很快将获得一次发财的机会。
ext.ext_en: A cash bonanza will be winging its way to the 600,000 members of the scheme...

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone wings their way somewhere or wings somewhere, you mean that they go there quickly, especially by plane.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在从政治上限制总统的立法
ext.ext_en: ...legislation aimed at clipping the president's political wings.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone clips your wings, you mean that they restrict your freedom to do what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 现有20多家大公司随时准备接手其部分业务。
ext.ext_en: There are now more than 20 big companies waiting in the wings to take over some of its business.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is waiting in the wings, you mean that they are ready and waiting for an opportunity to take action.

ext.ext_cn: 我在村里生活很封闭，所以我想出去闯荡一番。
ext.ext_en: I led a very confined life in my village so I suppose that I wanted to spread my wings.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 粗陋的;简陋的;不起眼的

ext.ext_cn: 专门做这些菜的餐馆既有毫不起眼的也有价格昂贵的。

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: It is, in my humble opinion, perhaps the best steak restaurant in Great Britain.

defs.def_en: People use humble in a phrase such as in my humble opinion as a polite way of emphasizing what they think, even though they do not feel humble about it.

ext.ext_en: Anson was forced to eat humble pie and publicly apologise to her.

defs.def_en: If you eat humble pie, you speak or behave in a way which tells people that you admit you were wrong about something.

ext.ext_cn: 本田在20世纪80年代作为一家轻易挫败行业巨头的小汽车公司而声名鹊起。
ext.ext_en: Honda won fame in the 1980s as the little car company that humbled the industry giants...

ext.ext_en: Third-placed Barnet were humbled 3-0 at Crewe.

defs.def_en: If you humble someone who is more important or powerful than you, you defeat them easily.

defs.def_cn: 使谦逊;使感到卑微;羞辱

ext.ext_en: Ted's words humbled me...

Sticky tape is clear sticky tape that is sold in rolls and that you use, for example to stick paper or card together, or to stick things onto a wall.

defs.def_cn: 使困惑不解;使大为惊奇

ext.ext_en: The audience must have been totally mystified by the plot...

ext.ext_en: There was something strange in her attitude which mystified me.

defs.def_en: If you are mystified by something, you find it impossible to explain or understand.
A chessboard is a square board with 64 black and white squares that is used for playing chess.

ext.ext_en: Part of the attraction is Darwin's proximity to Asia...

ext.ext_en: He became aware of the proximity of the Afghans...

defs.def_en: Proximity to a place or person is nearness to that place or person.
A millionairess is a woman who has money or property worth at least a million pounds or dollars.

ext.ext_cn: 船笼罩在烟雾中。
ext.ext_en: The ship was wreathed in smoke...

ext.ext_cn: 雾气笼罩着寺院。
ext.ext_en: Fog wreathes the temples.

defs.def_en: If something is wreathed in smoke or mist, it is surrounded by it.

ext.ext_cn: 其巨大的立柱为月桂和木兰花所环绕。
ext.ext_en: Its huge columns were wreathed with laurel and magnolia.

defs.def_en: If something is wreathed with flowers or leaves, it has a circle or chain of flowers or leaves put round it.

ext.ext_en: She is famed for playing dizzy blondes.

ext.ext_cn: 一位迷人的大大咧咧的曾祖母
ext.ext_en: ...a charmingly dizzy great-grandmother.

defs.def_en: You can use dizzy to describe a woman who is careless and forgets things, but is easy to like.

defs.def_cn: 使眩晕;使困惑;使晕头转向

ext.ext_en: The sudden height dizzied her and she clung tightly.

defs.def_en: If something dizzies you, it causes you to feel unsteady or confused.

ext.ext_en: I escalated to the dizzy heights of director's secretary.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has reached the dizzy heights of something, you are emphasizing that they have reached a very high level by achieving it.

ext.ext_en: Two alligators rest their snouts on the water's surface.

defs.def_en: The snout of an animal such as a pig is its long nose.

ext.ext_en: The snout of the Mercedes poked through the gates...

ext.ext_en: The tank stopped with the long snout of its gun turned to the ridge.

defs.def_en: Writers sometimes refer to the front of a car or the barrel of a gun as its snout .

ext.ext_cn: 小号手马库斯·贝尔格雷夫为年轻艺术家办了一个爵士乐研习班。

ext.ext_en: The Jamaica Festival is planning a series of workshops and business seminars.

defs.def_en: A workshop is a period of discussion or practical work on a particular subject in which a group of people share their knowledge or experience.

defs.def_cn: (尤指使用到木材或金属的)车间，工场，作坊

ext.ext_en: ...a modestly equipped workshop.

ext.ext_cn: 铁路机车修理厂

defs.def_en: A workshop is a building which contains tools or machinery for making or repairing things, especially using wood or metal.

defs.def_cn: 劳改营；（前苏联的）古拉格劳改营
defs.def_en: A gulag is a prison camp where conditions are extremely bad and the prisoners are forced to work very hard. The name gulag comes from the prison camps in the former Soviet Union.

ext.ext_cn: 这种奶酪口感松脆，味道浓郁。
ext.ext_en: This cheese has a crumbly texture with a strong flavour...

ext.ext_en: I always add some paprika for extra flavour.

defs.def_en: The flavour of a food or drink is its taste.

ext.ext_cn: 咸酸口味的炸薯片
ext.ext_en: ...salt and vinegar flavour crisps.

ext.ext_cn: 现有3种新口味
ext.ext_en: ...now available in three new flavours.

defs.def_en: If something is orange flavour or beef flavour, it is made to taste of orange or beef.

ext.ext_cn: 把异国风味的芳草和香料加到你最喜爱的菜肴里调味。
ext.ext_en: Flavour your favourite dishes with exotic herbs and spices...

ext.ext_cn: 盐渍的酸橙是北非的一种特产，在烹制鸡肉时用来调味。
ext.ext_en: Lime preserved in salt is a north African speciality which is used to flavour chicken dishes.

defs.def_en: If you flavour food or drink, you add something to it to give it a particular taste.

ext.ext_cn: 带有明显意大利风格的轿车
ext.ext_en: ...a car with a flavour that is distinctly Italian.

ext.ext_cn: 带有 40 年代怀旧风格的服装
ext.ext_en: ...clothes with a nostalgic Forties flavour.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a special quality that something has as its flavour. For example, if something has an Italian flavour it reminds you of Italian things.

ext.ext_cn: 这本书让你大致了解一下什么是替代疗法。
ext.ext_en: The book gives you a flavour of what alternative therapy is about.

defs.def_en: If something gives you a flavour of a subject, situation, or event, it gives you a general idea of what it is like.

defs.def_cn: 红极一时的人物;风靡一时的事物

ext.ext_en: Hats were very much flavour of the month...

ext.ext_cn: 米德尔塞克斯郡板球选手盖廷和恩伯里很难说是当红人物。
ext.ext_en: Middlesex cricketers Gatting and Emburey are hardly flavour of the month.

defs.def_en: If you think that something or someone is very popular at a particular time, you can say that they are flavour of the month .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He wouldn't have accepted such an inglorious outcome.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as inglorious, you mean that it is something to be ashamed of.

defs.def_en: The chancel is the part of a church containing the altar, where the clergy and the choir usually sit.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的午餐只能算是凑合。
ext.ext_en: Their lunch was only so-so...

ext.ext_en: Sommers performed a flute solo a few weeks ago that got so-so reviews.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is so-so, you mean that it is average in quality, rather than being very good or very bad.

ext.ext_cn: 今年的失业人数可能会继续上升。
ext.ext_en: Unemployment is likely to go on rising this year...

ext.ext_cn: 我这里很好，你继续工作吧。
ext.ext_en: I'm all right here. Go on with your work...

defs.def_en: If you go on doing something, or go on with an activity, you continue to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这场对话进行的时候，我聚精会神地听着。
ext.ext_en: While this conversation was going on, I was listening with earnest attention...

ext.ext_cn: 我不知道发生了什么事。
ext.ext_en: I don't know what's going on.

defs.def_en: If something is going on, it is happening.

ext.ext_en: The population failed to understand the necessity for the war to go on.

defs.def_en: If a process or institution goes on, it continues to happen or exist.

ext.ext_cn: 随着时间的推移，可再生能源将变得愈发重要。
ext.ext_en: Renewable energy will become progressively more important as time goes on.

defs.def_en: If you say that a period of time goes on, you mean that it passes.

defs.def_cn: （做完某事后）进而，接着（做另一件事）

ext.ext_cn: 阿利斯于1969年从高尔夫球界退役，继而成为一名成功的节目主持人。
ext.ext_en: Alliss retired from golf in 1969 and went on to become a successful broadcaster...

ext.ext_en: She went on to say that she had discussed it with the Canadian foreign minister.

defs.def_en: If you go on to do something, you do it after you have done something else.

ext.ext_cn: 明天他接着去荷兰。
ext.ext_en: He goes on to Holland tomorrow.

defs.def_en: If you go on to a place, you go to it from the place that you have reached.

ext.ext_en: Meer cleared his throat several times before he went on...
