defs.def_en: If you go on, you continue saying something or talking about something.

ext.ext_en: Expectations have been raised with the Government going on about choice and market forces...

ext.ext_cn: 她一直唠叨着要我生个孩子。
ext.ext_en: She's  always going on at me to have a baby.

defs.def_en: If you go on about something, or in British English go on at someone, you continue talking about the same thing, often in an annoying way.

ext.ext_en: Go on, it's fun.

defs.def_en: You say 'Go on' to someone to persuade or encourage them to do something.

ext.ext_en: But you have to go on the facts...

ext.ext_en: There's not much to go on.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the information you have to go on, you mean the information you have available to base an opinion or judgment on.

ext.ext_cn: 每天晚上7点钟有盏灯会亮起。
ext.ext_en: A light went on at seven every evening.

defs.def_en: If an electrical device goes on, it begins operating.

ext.ext_en: He cajoled Mr Dobson to stand for mayor.

defs.def_en: If you cajole someone into doing something, you get them to do it after persuading them for some time.

defs.def_en: If you describe food or drink as insipid, you dislike it because it has very little taste.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: They gave an insipid opening performance in a nil-nil draw with Peru.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as insipid, you mean they are dull and boring.

ext.ext_en: ...the Easter Islanders.

ext.ext_en: Furthermore, they claim that any such interference is completely ineffective.

defs.def_en: Furthermore is used to introduce a piece of information or opinion that adds to or supports the previous one.

ext.ext_en: His objective was to tire out the climbers.

defs.def_en: If something tires you out, it makes you exhausted.

ext.ext_en: ...the glass bricks inset high along the corridor's opposite wall.

defs.def_en: Something that is inset with a decoration or piece of material has the decoration or material set inside it.

ext.ext_en: I frequently paint between 10 and 20 insets for my murals.

defs.def_en: An inset is a small picture, diagram, or map that is inside a larger one.

ext.ext_en: ...the first fully free elections for more than fifty years...

ext.ext_en: During his election campaign he promised to put the economy back on its feet...

defs.def_en: An election is a process in which people vote to choose a person or group of people to hold an official position.

ext.ext_cn: 1964年工党政府当选
ext.ext_en: ...the election of the Labour government in 1964.

ext.ext_cn: 他当选总统
ext.ext_en: ...his election as president...

defs.def_en: The election of a particular person or group of people is their success in winning an election.

defs.def_cn: 悬钩子;覆盆子;木莓;山莓

ext.ext_cn: 他对着电话呸了一声，然后挂断了。
ext.ext_en: He blows a raspberry down the telephone line and hangs up...

defs.def_en: If you blow a raspberry at someone or something, you reject them completely or criticize them severely.

ext.ext_en: He's not a slacker, he's the best worker they've got.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的产品是办公用品的领导品牌。
ext.ext_en: In office supplies, we're the brand leader.

defs.def_en: The brand leader of a particular product is the brand of it that most people choose to buy.

ext.ext_cn: 世纪头十年的经济现实
ext.ext_en: ...the economic realities of the noughties. 21

defs.def_en: The Noughties is the decade between 2000 to 2009.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 极不公正的罚款
ext.ext_en: ...an iniquitous fine.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as iniquitous, you mean that it is very unfair or morally bad.

ext.ext_cn: 现代火车装有自动门。
ext.ext_en: Modern trains have automatic doors.

defs.def_en: An automatic machine or device is one which has controls that enable it to perform a task without needing to be constantly operated by a person. Automatic methods and processes involve the use of such machines.

ext.ext_cn: 他拔出自动手枪，向声音传来的方向跑去。
ext.ext_en: He drew his automatic and began running in the direction of the sounds...

ext.ext_cn: 歹徒用自动武器开火了。
ext.ext_en: The gunmen opened fire with automatic weapons.

defs.def_en: An automatic is a gun that keeps firing shots until you stop pulling the trigger.

defs.def_cn: 自动挡汽车;自动变速汽车
defs.def_en: An automatic is a car in which the gears change automatically as the car's speed increases or decreases.

ext.ext_cn: 身体所有的无意识功能，甚至呼吸，都受到影响。
ext.ext_en: All of the automatic body functions, even breathing, are affected.

defs.def_en: An automatic action is one that you do without thinking about it.

ext.ext_cn: 那些司机必然会受到过失杀人的指控。
ext.ext_en: Those drivers should face an automatic charge of manslaughter...

ext.ext_cn: 以色列为所有希望获得公民身份的犹太人敞开大门。
ext.ext_en: Israel offers automatic citizenship to all Jews who want it.

defs.def_en: If something such as an action or a punishment is automatic, it happens without people needing to think about it because it is the result of a fixed rule or method.
A trolley bus is a bus that is driven by electric power taken from cables above the street.
Crossfire is gunfire, for example in a battle, that comes from two or more different directions and passes through the same area.

ext.ext_cn: 他们称自己被卷进了教育机构与政府之间的争端。
ext.ext_en: They say they are caught in the crossfire between the education establishment and the government.

defs.def_en: If you are caught in the crossfire, you become involved in an unpleasant situation in which people are arguing with each other, although you do not want to be involved or say which person you agree with.
A marionette is a puppet whose different parts you can move using strings or wires.

ext.ext_cn: 月光下白雪皑皑的山顶闪闪发光，有如仙境一般
ext.ext_en: ...a dreamland of snowy moonlit peaks and twinkling lights.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as a dreamland, you mean that it is so beautiful it is hard to believe that it is real.

defs.def_cn: 梦境;幻想世界;理想世界

ext.ext_cn: 在梦境中我们同他们在决赛中对阵。
ext.ext_en: In dreamland we play them in the final.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a situation as dreamland, you mean that it represents what someone would like to happen, but that it is completely unrealistic.

ext.ext_cn: 他坚称他所知道的一切都获自前任肯尼思·赛瑟姆。
ext.ext_en: He maintained that he learned everything he knew from his predecessor Kenneth Sisam.

defs.def_en: Your predecessor is the person who had your job before you.

ext.ext_cn: 这辆轿车比原先的车型短了约40毫米。
ext.ext_en: The car is some 40mm shorter than its predecessor.

defs.def_en: The predecessor of an object or machine is the object or machine that came before it in a sequence or process of development.

defs.def_cn: 角豆树（果实味似巧克力）
defs.def_en: A carob or carob tree is a Mediterranean tree that stays green all year round. It has dark brown fruit that tastes similar to chocolate.

defs.def_cn: 角豆(常制成粉以替代巧克力)

ext.ext_cn: 你要是非常想吃巧克力,那就嚼根角豆条解馋吧。
ext.ext_en: If you do yearn for chocolate, try a carob bar instead.

defs.def_en: The dark brown fruit of the carob tree can be referred to as carob. It is often made into powder and used instead of chocolate.
If you do a handstand, you balance yourself upside down on your hands with your body and legs straight up in the air.
Your birthplace is the place where you were born.

ext.ext_cn: 雅典——古代奥运会的诞生地
ext.ext_en: ...Athens, the birthplace of the ancient Olympics.

defs.def_en: The birthplace of something is the place where it began.
See also:red herring;A herring is a long silver-coloured fish. Herring live in large groups in the sea.

defs.def_cn: 未取得预期效果的事;失败;落空

ext.ext_cn: 全党大会没有取得预期效果。
ext.ext_en: The all-party meeting was a damp squib.

defs.def_en: You can describe something such as an event or a performance as a damp squib when it is expected to be interesting, exciting, or impressive, but fails to be any of these things.

ext.ext_cn: 把责任归咎于联合国极其不公。
ext.ext_en: It is grossly unfair to impute blame to the United Nations.

defs.def_en: If you impute something such as blame or a crime to someone, you say that they are responsible for it or are the cause of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 好管闲事的；爱指手画脚的

ext.ext_cn: 他们不会欢迎任何来自警方的横加干涉。
ext.ext_en: They wouldn't welcome any officious interference from the police...

ext.ext_cn: 人们穿上制服后会信心倍增，也更爱管闲事了。
ext.ext_en: When people put on uniforms, their attitude becomes more confident and their manner more officious.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as officious, you are critical of them because they are eager to tell people what to do when you think they should not.

defs.pos_cn: 可数名词；头衔名词；称呼名词

ext.ext_cn: 指挥官和一些士兵已经获释。
ext.ext_en: The commander and some of the men had been released.

ext.ext_cn: 指挥官鲍勃·马克斯
ext.ext_en: ...Commander Bob Marks.

defs.def_en: A commander is an officer in charge of a military operation or organization.

defs.pos_cn: 可数名词；头衔名词；称呼名词
defs.def_en: A commander is an officer in the Royal Navy or the U.S. Navy.
Aviation is the operation and production of aircraft.
A reefer or reefer coat is a short thick coat which is often worn by sailors.
A reefer is a cigarette containing cannabis or marijuana.

defs.def_cn: 极不合理的；极令人厌恶的

ext.ext_cn: 她抗议说那根本不是传统爵士乐，而是令人憎恶的噪音。
ext.ext_en: She protested that it wasn't traditional jazz at all, but an unholy row...

ext.ext_cn: 经济依然是一团糟。
ext.ext_en: The economy is still an unholy mess.

defs.def_en: You use unholy to emphasize how unreasonable or unpleasant you think something is.

defs.def_cn: （由通常敌对的两方或多方组成的联盟）不同寻常的，诡异的

ext.ext_cn: 如果政府真的倒台了，那一定是因为极右翼势力和左翼势力的诡异联盟。
ext.ext_en: If the government does fall it will be because of this unholy alliance between the far right and the left...

ext.ext_cn: 西部人指责说该党被北方和南方不同寻常的联盟所操控。
ext.ext_en: Westerners charged that the party was run by an unholy coalition between North and South.

defs.def_en: If you refer to two or more people or groups working together as an unholy alliance, you mean that this arrangement is unusual because the people usually oppose each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: “这一定会很有趣,”他对亚历克斯说，眼神里几乎透出一丝邪恶的光芒。
ext.ext_en: 'This ought to be fun,' he told Alex, eyes gleaming with an almost unholy relish...

ext.ext_cn: 他冲我高声咒骂。
ext.ext_en: He screamed unholy things at me.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unholy, you mean that it is wicked or bad.

ext.ext_cn: 挣了很多钱的家伙
ext.ext_en: ...a chap who'd made lots of dosh.

defs.def_en: Dosh is money.

defs.def_cn: （犹太人的）逾越节（自3月或4月开始，持续七八天）

ext.ext_cn: 明天晚上太阳下山的时候，犹太人的逾越节便开始了。
ext.ext_en: Tomorrow night at sundown, the Jewish holiday of Passover begins...

ext.ext_cn: 凯特已经邀请了艾伦和她一起过逾越节。
ext.ext_en: Kate had invited Alan to spend the Passover with her.

defs.def_en: Passover is a Jewish festival that begins in March or April and lasts for seven or eight days. Passover begins with a special meal that reminds Jewish people of how God helped their ancestors escape from Egypt.
Soya flour, butter, or other food is made from soya beans.
Corned beef is beef which has been cooked and preserved in salt water.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 狠毒的;恶毒的；存心不良的

ext.ext_cn: 她目光狠毒，唇紧抿。
ext.ext_en: Her stare was malevolent, her mouth a thin line.

defs.def_en: A malevolent person deliberately tries to cause harm or evil.
A spring roll is a Chinese food consisting of a small roll of thin pastry filled with vegetables and sometimes meat, and then fried.

ext.ext_cn: 屋檐下挂着冰凌。
ext.ext_en: There were icicles hanging from the eaves.

defs.def_en: The eaves of a house are the lower edges of its roof.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 总是有很多美味可口的饭菜可供选择。
ext.ext_en: There's always a wide selection of delicious meals to choose from...

ext.ext_cn: 美洲山核桃不论生的还是熟的都很好吃。
ext.ext_en: Pecan nuts are delicious both raw and cooked.

defs.def_en: Food that is delicious has a very pleasant taste.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这一切中包含了一种绝妙的讽刺。
ext.ext_en: There is a delicious irony in all this.

ext.ext_cn: 那种惊喜之情
ext.ext_en: ..that delicious feeling of surprise.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as delicious, you mean that it is very pleasant.

defs.def_cn: (在英国)通过单务契约(更名等)
defs.def_en: In Britain, if you change your name by deed poll, you change it officially and legally.

defs.def_cn: 高级时装的设计制作;高级时装

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯汀·拉克鲁瓦的首次巴黎高级时装展
ext.ext_en: ...Christian Lacroix's first Paris couture collection.

defs.def_en: Couture is the designing and making of expensive fashionable clothes, or the clothes themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 士兵们横冲直撞，洗劫商店并且开枪射击。
ext.ext_en: Soldiers went on a rampage, pillaging stores and shooting.

ext.ext_cn: 抢劫和强奸的胆子
ext.ext_en: ...the boldness to pillage and rape.

defs.def_en: If a group of people pillage a place, they steal property from it using violent methods.

ext.ext_cn: 他戴着玳瑁粗框大眼镜。
ext.ext_en: He wears huge spectacles with thick tortoiseshell frames.

defs.def_en: Tortoiseshell means made of tortoiseshell or made of a material which resembles tortoiseshell.

defs.def_cn: (翅膀呈棕色和橘黄色的)蛱蝶
defs.def_en: A tortoiseshell is a butterfly with brown and orange wings.

ext.ext_cn: 结果是我们有很多优秀然而却不太快乐的员工。
ext.ext_en: The upshot is that we have lots of good but not very happy employees...

ext.ext_en: So the upshot is we're going for lunch on Friday.

defs.def_en: The upshot of a series of events or discussions is the final result of them, usually a surprising result.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （通常指因不确定而）结结巴巴的，迟疑不决的

ext.ext_cn: 她结结巴巴地说自己要发表一项声明。
ext.ext_en: In a halting voice she said that she wished to make a statement...

ext.ext_cn: 这位官员用结结巴巴的德语作答。
ext.ext_en: The officer replied in halting German...

defs.def_en: If you speak or do something in a halting way, you speak or do it slowly and with a lot of hesitation, usually because you are uncertain about what to say or do next.
Matrices is the plural of matrix.

defs.def_cn: (投币操作的)自动售货机;(赌博用的)吃角子老虎机
defs.def_en: A slot machine is a machine from which you can get food or cigarettes or on which you can gamble. You make it work by putting coins into a slot.

defs.def_cn: （尤指奉行不合理规章制度的）官僚，官员，职员

ext.ext_cn: 大小官僚从一开始就是我们的阻碍。
ext.ext_en: Officialdom has been against us from the start.

defs.def_en: Officialdom is used to refer to officials who work for the government or in other organizations, especially when you think that their rules are unhelpful.

ext.ext_cn: 他在川流不息的人群中东躲西闪。
ext.ext_en: He dodged amongst the seething crowds of men...

ext.ext_cn: 我们躲到柱子后面，避开了观光者的视线。
ext.ext_en: We dodged behind a pillar out of sight of the tourists.

defs.def_en: If you dodge, you move suddenly, often to avoid being hit, caught, or seen.

ext.ext_cn: 他拼命地闪身躲开一辆试图撞倒他的疾驰的汽车。
ext.ext_en: He desperately dodged a speeding car trying to run him down.

defs.def_en: If you dodge something, you avoid it by quickly moving aside or out of reach so that it cannot hit or reach you.

defs.def_cn: (常指用欺诈的方式故意)躲避，逃避

ext.ext_cn: 他炫耀自己通过装病来逃避服兵役。
ext.ext_en: He boasts of dodging military service by feigning illness...

ext.ext_cn: 很多挣扎求生的企业不惜违法逃税。
ext.ext_en: Many struggling firms are ready to break the law by dodging tax.

defs.def_en: If you dodge something, you deliberately avoid thinking about it or dealing with it, often by being deceitful.
A wombat is a type of furry animal which has very short legs and eats plants. Wombats are found in Australia.
Coursing is a sport in which rabbits or hares are hunted with dogs.

ext.ext_cn: 任何改革都会破坏并歪曲我们的宪法。
ext.ext_en: Any reform will destroy and pervert our constitution...

ext.ext_cn: 他误导了她的思想。
ext.ext_en: He perverted her mind.

defs.def_en: If you pervert something such as a process or society, you interfere with it so that it is not as good as it used to be or as it should be.

ext.ext_cn: 他被控谋划妨碍司法公正。
ext.ext_en: He was charged with conspiring to pervert the course of justice.

defs.def_en: If someone perverts the course of  justice, they deliberately do something that will make it difficult to discover who really committed a particular crime, for example, destroying evidence or lying to the police.
If you say that someone is a pervert, you mean that you consider their behaviour, especially their sexual behaviour, to be immoral or unacceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 每天超过100架次国内航班飞往英国境内15个目的地
ext.ext_en: ...over 100 domestic flights a day to 15 UK destinations.

ext.ext_cn: 国内市场的销售量
ext.ext_en: ...sales in the domestic market.

defs.def_en: See also:gross domestic product;Domestic political activities, events, and situations happen or exist within one particular country.

ext.ext_cn: 分担家务活的计划
ext.ext_en: ...a plan for sharing domestic chores.

defs.def_en: Domestic duties and activities are concerned with the running of a home and family.

ext.ext_cn: 家用器具
ext.ext_en: ...domestic appliances.

defs.def_en: Domestic items and services are intended to be used in people's homes rather than in factories or offices.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一幅家庭如此幸福的画面。
ext.ext_en: It was a scene of such domestic bliss...

ext.ext_cn: 我被叫出去解决一场家庭纠纷。
ext.ext_en: I was called out to attend a domestic dispute.

defs.def_en: A domestic situation or atmosphere is one which involves a family and their home.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 喜爱家庭生活的;乐于操持家务的

ext.ext_cn: 她人很好也顾家，把家庭看得比兼职工作更为重要。
ext.ext_en: She was kind and domestic and put her family before her part-time job.

defs.def_en: Someone who is domestic enjoys being at home and running a family.

defs.def_cn: 非野生的;驯养的;作为宠物饲养的

ext.ext_cn: 家猫
ext.ext_en: ...a domestic cat.

defs.def_en: A domestic animal is one that is not wild and is kept either on a farm to produce food or in someone's home as a pet.
A domestic, a domestic help, or a domestic worker is a person who is paid to come to help with the work that has to be done in a house such as the cleaning, washing, and ironing.
A goat is a farm animal or a wild animal that is about the size of a sheep. Goats have horns, and hairs on their chin which resemble a beard.

ext.ext_cn: 推定的父亲
ext.ext_en: ...a putative father.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as putative, you mean that they are generally thought to be the thing mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 贾尼斯和库尔特已宣布订婚。
ext.ext_en: Janis and Kurt have announced their engagement...

ext.ext_cn: 马儿们从马厩门上探出头来。
ext.ext_en: Horses were poking their heads over their stall doors.

defs.def_en: You use their to indicate that something belongs or relates to the group of people, animals, or things that you are talking about.

defs.def_cn: (代替 his or her，而不指明是男是女;有人认为这种用法不对)

ext.ext_cn: 每个党员都将收到一本名为《欢迎加入工党》的小册子。
ext.ext_en: Every member will receive their own 'Welcome to Labour' brochure.

ext.ext_cn: 但是，那些指望靠投资获取收入的人境况更为糟糕。
ext.ext_en: But anyone looking for income from their investments is in a much worse state.

defs.def_en: You use their instead of 'his or her' to indicate that something belongs or relates to a person without saying whether that person is a man or a woman. Some people think this use is incorrect.

ext.ext_cn: 许多母亲将儿子看成是未来的保护人和赡养人。
ext.ext_en: Many mothers see their son as a potential protector and provider.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as your protector, you mean that they protect you from being harmed.

ext.ext_cn: 他是唯一在衣服外面穿护胸的全国联赛裁判。
ext.ext_en: He was the only National League umpire to wear an outside chest protector.

defs.def_en: A protector is a device that protects someone or something from physical harm.

ext.ext_cn: 他穿过公园，走过一道大门。
ext.ext_en: He walked across the park and through a gateway.

defs.def_en: A gateway is an entrance where there is a gate.

defs.def_cn: （通往更广阔地方的）通道，门户

ext.ext_cn: 里昂是从英国驱车前往阿尔卑斯山的门户。
ext.ext_en: Lyons is the gateway to the Alps for motorists driving out from Britain.

defs.def_en: A gateway to somewhere is a place which you go through because it leads you to a much larger place.

defs.def_cn: （取得进展或更大成功的）途径，手段

ext.ext_cn: 在竞争异常激烈的模特界，这一享有盛誉的头衔打开了通往成功的大门。
ext.ext_en: The prestigious title offered a gateway to success in the highly competitive world of modelling.

defs.def_en: If something is a gateway to a job, career, or other activity, it gives you the opportunity to make progress or get further success in that activity.
In computing, a gateway connects different computer networks so that information can be passed between them.

defs.def_cn: （木头、金属或塑料制成的）大环，大圈
defs.def_en: A hoop is a large ring made of wood, metal, or plastic.
In croquet, the hoops are the small metal arches which players hit the ball through.
A basketball hoop is the ring that players try to throw the ball into in order to score points for their team.

defs.def_cn: （为取悦他人或达到目的而）经受苦难，作出很大努力

ext.ext_cn: 值班的接待员几乎为他费尽了力气，但还是没用。
ext.ext_en: He had the duty receptionist almost jumping through hoops for him. But to no avail.

defs.def_en: If someone makes you jump through hoops, they make you do lots of difficult or boring things in order to please them or achieve something.

ext.ext_cn: 该吃药了，亲爱的。
ext.ext_en: It's time for your tablets, dear...

ext.ext_cn: 频繁服用安眠药绝对不是好办法。
ext.ext_en: It is never a good idea to take sleeping tablets regularly.

defs.def_en: A tablet is a small solid round mass of medicine which you swallow.

ext.ext_cn: 他还研究了在金字塔周围发现的古代石匾。
ext.ext_en: He also studied the ancient stone tablets from around the pyramids.

defs.def_en: Clay tablets or stone tablets are the flat pieces of clay or stone which people used to write on before paper was invented.  tablets of stone→see: stone;

ext.ext_cn: 大街两旁满是祝福的人群。
ext.ext_en: The main street was lined with well-wishers.

defs.def_en: Well-wishers are people who hope that a particular person or thing will be successful, and who show this by their behaviour.
Lavender is a garden plant with sweet-smelling, bluish-purple flowers.
Lavender is used to describe things that are pale bluish-purple in colour.

defs.def_cn: 方格呢；方格布；格子图案

ext.ext_cn: 埃迪穿着蓝色牛仔裤和方格布衬衫。
ext.ext_en: Eddie wore blue jeans and a plaid shirt.

defs.def_en: Plaid is material with a check design on it. Plaid is also the design itself.

defs.def_cn: （苏格兰高地传统服装中的）方格呢（或布）披肩
defs.def_en: A plaid is a long piece of tartan material that is worn over the shoulder as part of the Scottish Highland traditional dress.

ext.ext_cn: 他对可能不支持政府的议会议员发动了所谓的“魅力攻势”。
ext.ext_en: He launched what was called a charm offensive against MPs who might not support the Government.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has launched a charm offensive, you disapprove of the fact that they are being very friendly to their opponents or people who are causing problems for them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: If you're at all worried about his progress, do discuss it with one of his teachers...

A misogynist is a man who dislikes women.
Misogynist attitudes or actions are ones that involve or show a strong dislike of women.

defs.def_cn: 传统保守的私立学校学生
defs.def_en: Preppies are young people, especially in America, who have often been to an expensive private school and who are conventional and conservative in their attitudes, behaviour, and style of dress.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 像传统保守的私立学校的

ext.ext_cn: 我真不敢相信他看起来竟如此正统，一点也不像同性恋。
ext.ext_en: I couldn't believe how straight-looking he was, how preppy.

ext.ext_cn: 私立学校学生风格的衣领和领带
ext.ext_en: ...a preppy collar and tie.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or their clothes, attitudes, or behaviour as preppy, you mean that they are like a preppy.

ext.ext_cn: 总统谴责参众两院没有在100天之内通过那些法案。
ext.ext_en: The president rebuked the House and Senate for not passing those bills within 100 days.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国成员国对两国继续进行核试验项目提出强烈谴责。
ext.ext_en: UN member countries delivered a strong rebuke to both countries for persisting with nuclear testing programs...

defs.def_en: If you rebuke someone, you speak severely to them because they have said or done something that you do not approve of.
In printing, a typeface is a set of alphabetical characters, numbers, and other characters that all have the same design. There are many different typefaces.

defs.def_cn: 像猿猴的;长得像猿猴似的

ext.ext_cn: 埃达有一张布满皱纹、长得像猿猴的脸。
ext.ext_en: Ada had a wrinkled, simian face.

defs.def_en: If someone has a simian face, they look rather like a monkey.

ext.ext_cn: 一种猴病毒
ext.ext_en: ...a simian virus.

defs.def_en: Simian is used to describe things relating to monkeys or apes.

ext.ext_cn: 一只山羊后腿撑地，搭着树站立起来，试图去够叶子。
ext.ext_en: A goat was standing up against a tree on its hind legs, trying to get at the leaves.

defs.def_en: To get at something means to succeed in reaching it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们想查明真相。是谁杀了他？为什么？
ext.ext_en: We want to get at the truth. Who killed him? And why?

defs.def_en: If you get at the truth about something, you succeed in discovering it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们不喜欢我的小胡子和长发，一有机会便数落我。
ext.ext_en: They don't like my moustache and my long hair, they get at me whenever they can.

defs.def_en: If you get at someone, you keep criticizing or teasing them in an unkind way.

ext.ext_cn: “你这是什么意思？”里克问道。
ext.ext_en: 'What are you getting at now?' demanded Rick.

defs.def_en: If you ask someone what they are getting at, you are asking them to explain what they mean, usually because you think that they are being unpleasant or are suggesting something that is untrue.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 平凡的;单调乏味的;令人厌烦的

ext.ext_cn: 她整天做着单调乏味的工作但收入颇丰的律师丈夫
ext.ext_en: ...her lawyer husband, trapped in a humdrum but well-paid job...

ext.ext_cn: 新政府看起来平庸无能。
ext.ext_en: The new government seemed rather humdrum.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as humdrum, you mean that they are ordinary, dull, or boring.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他谈起其他文化时似乎比对他自己的文化还要熟悉。
ext.ext_en: He talked of other cultures as if they were more familiar to him than his own...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经是我们电视屏幕上的熟面孔了。
ext.ext_en: They are already familiar faces on our TV screens.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is familiar to you, you recognize them or know them well.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 莱辛科对中央电视台相当熟悉。他在那儿工作了25年。
ext.ext_en: Lesinko is quite familiar with Central Television. He worked there for 25 years...

ext.ext_cn: 多数人都熟悉瓦格纳歌剧中的这一人物。
ext.ext_en: Most people are familiar with this figure from Wagner's opera.

defs.def_en: If you are familiar with something, you know or understand it well.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 过分亲昵的;过于随便的;放肆的

ext.ext_cn: 那辆出租车的司机在我看来放肆到了无礼的地步。
ext.ext_en: The driver of that taxi-cab seemed to me familiar to the point of impertinence...

ext.ext_cn: 约翰的“罪行”就是对经理太随便，还叫他古尔迪。
ext.ext_en: John's 'crime' was being too familiar with the manager and calling him Gouldy.

defs.def_en: If someone you do not know well behaves in a familiar way towards you, they treat you very informally in a way that you might find offensive.

ext.ext_cn: 父亲亲子假不太可能超过两周。
ext.ext_en: Paternity leave is unlikely to be for longer than two weeks.

defs.def_en: If a man has paternity leave, his employer allows him some time off work because his child has just been born.
Arabs are people who speak Arabic and who come from the Middle East and parts of North Africa.

ext.ext_cn: 表面上，阿拉伯世界好像没什么变化。
ext.ext_en: On the surface, it appears little has changed in the Arab world.

defs.def_en: Arab means belonging or relating to Arabs or to their countries or customs.

ext.ext_cn: 中尉，做这些事情我是新手，你是行家。
ext.ext_en: I'm a novice at these things, Lieutenant. You're the professional...

ext.ext_cn: 作为初涉写作的人，我对此很感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: As a novice writer, this is something I'm  interested in.

defs.def_en: A novice is someone who has been doing a job or other activity for only a short time and so is not experienced at it.
In a monastery or convent, a novice is a person who is preparing to become a monk or nun.
A drummer is a person who plays a drum or drums in a band or group.

ext.ext_cn: 狼在英国已经灭绝250年了。
ext.ext_en: It is 250 years since the wolf became extinct in Britain.

ext.ext_cn: 灭绝动物的骨骼
ext.ext_en: ...the bones of extinct animals.

defs.def_en: A species of animal or plant that is extinct no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

defs.def_cn: （某类劳动者、生活方式或活动）不复存在的，废除了的

ext.ext_cn: 如果当前趋势继续发展下去，美国的黑人农民将在这个十年末不复存在。
ext.ext_en: If the current trend continues, black farmers in the United States may be extinct by the end of this decade...

ext.ext_cn: 草药医术在西方已经成了一门几乎绝迹的技艺。
ext.ext_en: Herbalism had become an all but extinct skill in the Western world.

defs.def_en: If a particular kind of worker, way of life, or type of activity is extinct, it no longer exists, because of changes in society.

ext.ext_cn: 它最高的火山是早已熄灭的奥林波斯山。
ext.ext_en: Its tallest volcano, long extinct, is Olympus Mons.

defs.def_en: An extinct volcano is one that does not erupt or is not expected to erupt any more.
Life force is energy that some people believe exists in all living things and keeps them alive.

An inhaler is a small device that helps you to breathe more easily if you have asthma or a bad cold. You put it in your mouth and breathe in deeply, and it sends a small amount of a drug into your lungs.

ext.ext_cn: 这种报道势必会引发忧虑。
ext.ext_en: Reports of this kind are guaranteed to cause anxiety...

ext.ext_cn: 同事们一定以为我疯了。
ext.ext_en: It's guaranteed that my colleagues think I'm deranged...

defs.def_en: See also:guarantee;If you say that something is guaranteed to happen, you mean that you are certain that it will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 美国海军力量的彻底转变始于 1940 年。
ext.ext_en: The transformation of American sea power began in 1940.

defs.def_en: Sea power is the size and strength of a country's navy.
A sea power is a country that has a large navy.

ext.ext_cn: 那就足以确保我们符合贷款协议的范围。
ext.ext_en: That would be enough to make sure we fell within the parameters of our loan agreement.

ext.ext_cn: 决定葡萄酒口味的一些因素
ext.ext_en: ...some of the parameters that determine the taste of a wine.

defs.def_en: Parameters are factors or limits which affect the way that something can be done or made.

ext.ext_en: The game is a simple sports sim.

defs.def_en: A sim is a computer game that simulates an activity such as playing a sport or flying an aircraft.
Someone's stepmother is the woman who has married their father after the death or divorce of their mother.

ext.ext_en: Funnily enough I can remember what I had for lunch on July 5th, 1906, but I've forgotten what I had for breakfast today.

defs.def_en: You use funnily enough to indicate that, although something is surprising, it is true or really happened.

defs.def_en: Tubing is plastic, rubber, or another material in the shape of a tube.

defs.def_en: In Greek mythology, the Amazons were a tribe of women who were very good at fighting.

ext.ext_en: In China Grace Thompson observed the great variety of loads that were carried by 'slim, erect but muscular Amazons'.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to a tall, strong woman as an Amazon .

ext.ext_en: I think that it comes down to the fact that people do feel very dependent on their automobile...

defs.def_en: If a problem, decision, or question comes down to a particular thing, that thing is the most important factor involved.

ext.ext_cn: 以色列多岩石的内盖夫沙漠生态系统
ext.ext_en: ...the ecology of the rocky Negev desert in Israel.

ext.ext_en: ...the extinction of the marshes' unique ecology...

defs.def_en: When you talk about the ecology of a place, you are referring to the pattern and balance of relationships between plants, animals, people, and the environment in that place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The House of Commons can merely say yea or nay to the executive judgment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Despite his fabulous wealth, he is very much a man of the people.

defs.def_en: If you talk about someone's fabulous beauty, for example, or their fabulous success, you are emphasizing that they are extremely beautiful or extremely successful.

ext.ext_en: People came out in smarter clothes to promenade along the front.

defs.def_en: If someone promenades somewhere, for example along a beach, the edge of a lake, or a main street, they go  for a walk there.

ext.ext_en: Itemise your gear and mark major items with your name and post code.

ext.ext_en: ...a fully itemised bill.

defs.def_en: If you itemize a number of things, you make a list of them.

defs.def_cn: 不相信，怀疑(某人或某人的话)

ext.ext_en: He had never been able to disbelieve it completely.

defs.def_en: If you disbelieve someone or disbelieve something that they say, you do not believe that what they say is true.

defs.def_cn: 不相信(某事存在或有用)

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰克不相信占星术。
ext.ext_en: Frank disbelieved in astrology.

defs.def_en: If you disbelieve in something, you do not believe that it exists or that it works.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...a flimsy wooden door.

ext.ext_cn: 一双做工粗劣的鞋
ext.ext_en: ...a pair of flimsy shoes.

defs.def_en: A flimsy object is weak because it is made of a weak material, or is badly made.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...a very flimsy pink chiffon nightgown.

defs.def_en: Flimsy cloth or clothing is thin and does not give much protection.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The charges were based on very flimsy evidence.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as evidence or an excuse as flimsy, you mean that it is not very good or convincing.

ext.ext_cn: 可以把军队渡运过来阻截毒品的装运。
ext.ext_en: Troops could be ferried in to interdict drug shipments.

ext.ext_cn: 通过封锁桥梁来孤立那一战区的努力
ext.ext_en: ...efforts to isolate the theater of operations by interdicting the bridges.

defs.def_en: If an armed force interdicts something or someone, they stop them and prevent them from moving. If they interdict a route, they block it or cut it off.

ext.ext_en: The National Trust has placed an interdict on jet-skis in Dorset, Devon and Cornwall.

ext.ext_en: The government is a dead duck.

ext.ext_cn: 眼睑内侧
ext.ext_en: ...the underside of the eyelid.

ext.ext_en: ...the Spanish Civil War.

defs.def_en: A civil war is a war which is fought between different groups of people who live in the same country.

ext.ext_en: The child had left the inner door wide open.

defs.def_en: If something is wide open, it is open to its full extent.

defs.def_cn: （比赛、选举等）结果不确定的，胜负难定的

ext.ext_cn: 由于世界冠军缺阵，这场比赛变得胜负难定。
ext.ext_en: The competition has been thrown wide open by the absence of the world champion.

defs.def_en: If you say that a competition, race, or election is wide open, you mean that anyone could win it, because there is no competitor who seems to be much better than the others.

defs.def_cn: (用于某些词前构成术语)表示“大的”，“全面的”，“宏观的”

ext.ext_cn: 宏观经济政策的基础
ext.ext_en: ...the cornerstone of macro-economic policy.

ext.ext_cn: 失业与坐牢之间的宏观联系
ext.ext_en: ...the macro-relationship between unemployment and imprisonment.

defs.def_en: Macro- is added to words in order to form new words that are technical and that refer to things which are large or involve the whole of something.

defs.def_cn: 草草做成（或建成）；匆匆拼凑成

ext.ext_cn: 你能尽快给我弄个炒鸡蛋吗？
ext.ext_en: Could you possibly knock me up some scrambled eggs?...

ext.ext_cn: 任何一个滑水爱好者都能在几小时内做成一副滑水橇。
ext.ext_en: Any water-skiing enthusiast can knock up a pair of skis in a few hours.

defs.def_en: If you knock something up, you make it or build it very quickly, using whatever materials are available.

ext.ext_cn: 他凌晨4:30去敲门唤醒罗布。
ext.ext_en: He went to knock Rob up at 4.30am.

defs.def_en: If you knock someone up, you knock on the door of their bedroom or of their house in the night or in the morning in order to wake them up.

ext.ext_cn: 我怀孕时，整个镇子都知道了。
ext.ext_en: When I got knocked up, the whole town knew it.

defs.def_en: If a woman is knocked up by a man, she is made pregnant by him.

In grammar, the present perfect tenses of a verb are the ones used to talk about things which happened before the time you are speaking or writing but are relevant to the present situation, or things that began in the past and are still happening. The simple present perfect tense uses 'have' or 'has' and the past participle of the verb, as in 'They have decided what to do'.

defs.def_cn: 性(交)对象;发泄性欲的对象

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢她整个人，而不仅仅是把她当作性对象。
ext.ext_en: He cared for her as a whole person rather than just a sex object.

defs.def_en: If someone is described as a sex object, he or she is considered only in terms of their physical attractiveness and not their character or abilities.
A bathroom is a room in a house that contains a bath or shower, a washbasin, and sometimes a toilet.

ext.ext_cn: 她去洗手间了。
ext.ext_en: She had gone in to use the bathroom.

defs.def_en: A bathroom is a room in a house or public building that contains a toilet.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然他已经服用了抗生素，但他还是不停地上厕所。
ext.ext_en: Although he had been treated with antibiotics, he went to the bathroom repeatedly.

defs.def_en: People say that they are going to the bathroom when they want to say that they are going to use the toilet.
A clothespin is the same as a clothes peg .

defs.def_cn: (为某物提供丰富来源的)宝库

ext.ext_cn: 那本词典是个巨大的信息宝库。
ext.ext_en: The dictionary is a vast treasure trove of information...

ext.ext_cn: 这家位于伊斯灵顿区的商店里汇聚了各种漂亮的新娘服装。
ext.ext_en: This Islington shop is a treasure trove of beautiful bridalwear.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as a treasure trove of a particular thing, you mean that they are a very good or rich source of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 温莎城堡确实是名副其实的古物宝藏。
ext.ext_en: Windsor Castle is quite literally an antique treasure trove…

ext.ext_cn: 该协会的档案对学者来说简直是宝藏。
ext.ext_en: The society's archives are a treasure trove for scholars.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a collection of valuable objects as a treasure trove .

ext.ext_cn: 你在唠叨什么？
ext.ext_en: What are you rabbiting on about?

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as rabbiting on, you do not like the way they keep talking for a long time about something that is not very interesting.

ext.ext_cn: 35毫米的幻灯机
ext.ext_en: ...a 35-millimetre slide projector.

defs.def_en: See also:overhead projector;A projector is a machine that projects films or slides onto a screen or wall.

defs.def_cn: 现代中等学校(最近不复存在的一种招收11岁至16岁儿童的英国学校，与文法学校相比更重视实际技能教学而不太重视文化课的学习)
defs.def_en: Secondary moderns were schools which existed until recently in Britain for children aged between about eleven and sixteen, where more attention was paid to practical skills and less to academic study than in a grammar school.

ext.ext_cn: 安东尼受命返回自己的军营。
ext.ext_en: Anthony was ordered to return to his battalion...

ext.ext_cn: 他加入了英国近卫步兵第一团第二营。
ext.ext_en: He joined the second battalion of the Grenadier Guards.

defs.def_en: A battalion is a large group of soldiers that consists of three or more companies.

defs.def_cn: （尤指有组织、有特定任务、高效的）一大群，一大批

ext.ext_cn: 有一大批拿高薪的公关人员可以确保这样的新闻不会见诸报端。
ext.ext_en: There were battalions of highly paid publicists to see that such news didn't make the press.

defs.def_en: A battalion of people is a large group of them, especially a well-organized, efficient group that has a particular task to do.

ext.ext_cn: 他就是缺乏那多一点的活力。
ext.ext_en: He just lacked that extra zing...

ext.ext_cn: 在番茄沙司中无论加入什么都不如加一点儿新鲜的紫苏更能提味。
ext.ext_en: There's nothing like fresh basil to put a zing into a tomato sauce.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the zing in someone or something, you mean the quality that makes them lively or interesting.

defs.def_cn: (常指令人不快的事件的)反复发生，重复出现，重演

ext.ext_cn: 今天市政府已经采取措施，防止去年的冲突重演。
ext.ext_en: Today the city government has taken measures to prevent a repetition of last year's confrontation...

ext.ext_cn: 科林斯想要避免1989年发现囊肿性纤维化致病基因后的那种混乱局面再次出现。
ext.ext_en: Collins wants to avoid repetition of the confusion that followed the discovery in 1989 of the cystic fibrosis gene.

defs.def_en: If there is a repetition of an event, usually an undesirable event, it happens again.

ext.ext_cn: 他原本也可以砍去许多重复的内容，从而缩减许多页。
ext.ext_en: He could also have cut out much of the repetition and thus saved many pages.

defs.def_en: Repetition means using the same words again.

defs.def_cn: （尤指不同寻常的）服装，制服，装束

ext.ext_cn: 一位身着平民装束、为大家所熟悉的人物
ext.ext_en: ...a familiar figure in civilian garb...

ext.ext_cn: 他身着童子军制服，而不是将军的制服。
ext.ext_en: He wore the garb of a scout, not a general.

defs.def_en: Someone's garb is the clothes they are wearing, especially when these are unusual.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 暴风雪今天袭击了西部地区，导致气温骤降。
ext.ext_en: A snowstorm hit the West today, bringing with it frigid temperatures...

ext.ext_cn: 水冰冷彻骨，他在下面呆不了太长时间。
ext.ext_en: The water was too frigid to allow him to remain submerged for long.

defs.def_en: Frigid means extremely cold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 丈夫说我性冷淡。
ext.ext_en: My husband says I am frigid.

defs.def_en: If a woman is frigid, she finds it difficult to become sexually aroused. You can often use frigid to show disapproval.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 拘谨的;冷淡的;不友好的

ext.ext_cn: 所有的内阁会议都由他主持，有时会上的气氛会很拘谨。
ext.ext_en: He presided at all councils of ministers, where the atmosphere could be frigid on occasions...

ext.ext_cn: “噢，亲爱的，”她的女主人会笑容僵硬地回答。
ext.ext_en: 'Well, dear,' her hostess would reply with a frigid smile.

defs.def_en: If you describe the atmosphere in a place or someone's behaviour as frigid, you mean that it is very formal and unfriendly.
Stone-washed jeans are jeans which have been specially washed with small pieces of stone so that when you buy them they are fairly pale and soft.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (结果、事件、局势)轰动性的，引起哗然的

ext.ext_cn: 世界冠军遭遇惨败，引起了一片哗然。
ext.ext_en: The world champions suffered a sensational defeat.

defs.def_en: A sensational result, event, or situation is so remarkable that it causes great excitement and interest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (故事、报道)耸人听闻的，哗众取宠的

ext.ext_cn: 哗众取宠的小报报道
ext.ext_en: ...sensational tabloid newspaper reports.

defs.def_en: You can describe stories or reports as sensational if you disapprove of them because they present facts in a way that is intended to cause feelings of shock, anger, or excitement.

ext.ext_cn: 她的嗓音非常动听。
ext.ext_en: Her voice is sensational...

ext.ext_cn: 专家们一致认为这的确是一场精彩绝伦的演出。
ext.ext_en: Experts agreed that this was a truly sensational performance.

defs.def_en: You can describe something as sensational when you think that it is extremely good.
A grebe is a type of water bird.

ext.ext_cn: 她患有老年痴呆症。
ext.ext_en: She is suffering from senile dementia.

defs.def_en: Senile dementia is a mental illness that affects some old people and that causes them to become confused and to forget things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有害健康的物质
ext.ext_en: ...substances that are injurious to health...

ext.ext_cn: 压力本身未必有害。
ext.ext_en: Stress in itself is not necessarily injurious.

defs.def_en: Something that is injurious to someone or to their health or reputation is harmful or damaging to them.

ext.ext_cn: 柯尔律治的思想可以在《政治家手册》中找到最全面的阐述。
ext.ext_en: The fullest exposition of Coleridge's thought can be found in the States-man's Manual.

defs.def_en: An exposition of an idea or theory is a detailed explanation or account of it.

ext.ext_cn: 艺术博览会
ext.ext_en: ...an art exposition.

defs.def_en: An exposition is an exhibition in which something such as goods or works of art are shown to the public.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 善于发明的;有创造才能的

ext.ext_cn: 斯特罗曼永远求新的舞蹈设计
ext.ext_en: ...Stroman's ceaselessly inventive choreography...

ext.ext_cn: 它激发我在自己烹饪时更富创造性。
ext.ext_en: It inspired me to be more inventive with my own cooking.

defs.def_en: An inventive person is good at inventing things or has clever and original ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 你是她最亲密的朋友和知己。
ext.ext_en: You are her closest friend and confidante.

defs.def_en: Someone's confidante is a woman who they are able to discuss their private problems with.

defs.def_cn: 含沙射影地说;旁敲侧击地指出;暗示

ext.ext_cn: 一篇文章因含沙射影声称总统撒谎而遭到诽谤索赔。
ext.ext_en: The libel claim followed an article which insinuated that the President was lying...

ext.ext_cn: 你是在旁敲侧击地说我身上有臭味吗？
ext.ext_en: Are you insinuating that I smell?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone insinuates that something bad is the case, you mean that they say it in an indirect way.

defs.def_cn: 使逐渐而巧妙地取得;使迂回潜入(或挤入)

ext.ext_cn: 他处心积虑终于一步步走进了她的生活。
ext.ext_en: He gradually insinuated himself into her life.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone insinuates themselves into a particular situation, you mean that they manage very cleverly, and perhaps dishonestly, to get into that situation.
If someone is very angry with another person, or if they want to insult them, they sometimes call them a son of a bitch .

ext.ext_cn: 我每周做一次循环训练。
ext.ext_en: I do circuit training once a week.

defs.def_en: Circuit training is a type of physical training in which you do a series of different exercises, each for a few minutes.

ext.ext_cn: 把你的贵重物品存放在旅馆的保险柜里。
ext.ext_en: Leave your valuables in the hotel safe.

defs.def_en: Valuables are things that you own that are worth a lot of money, especially small objects such as jewellery.

ext.ext_cn: 大家非常谨慎，以免把这两类项目弄混。
ext.ext_en: Great care is taken to avoid confusing the two types of projects...

ext.ext_cn: 我不明白怎么会有人把你和另外一个人搞混！
ext.ext_en: I can't see how anyone could confuse you with another!

defs.def_en: If you confuse two things, you get them mixed up, so that you think one of them is the other one.

ext.ext_cn: 德国政治既令他惊讶，又让他困惑不解。
ext.ext_en: German politics surprised and confused  him.

defs.def_en: To confuse someone means to make it difficult for them to know exactly what is happening or what to do.

ext.ext_cn: 使问题进一步复杂化的是，每个人需要的睡眠时间千差万别。
ext.ext_en: To further confuse the issue, there is an enormous variation in the amount of sleep people feel happy with.

defs.def_en: To confuse a situation means to make it complicated or difficult to understand.
A sandpit is a shallow hole or box in the ground with sand in it where small children can play.
A franchiser is an organization which sells franchises.

ext.ext_cn: 巴黎有350家电影院，大多数都人满为患。
ext.ext_en: There are 350 cinemas in Paris and most are packed out.

defs.def_en: If a place is packed out, it is very full of people.

ext.ext_cn: 这种疾病能够在不同的哺乳类物种之间传播。
ext.ext_en: The disease can spread from one mammalian species to another.

defs.def_en: In zoology, mammalian means relating to mammals.

defs.def_cn: 标以交织字母的;有花押字的

ext.ext_cn: 有花押字的手帕
ext.ext_en: ...a monogrammed handkerchief.

defs.def_en: Monogrammed means marked with a design based on the first letters of a person's names.
A fairy story is the same as a fairy tale .

defs.def_cn: 支付，花费（通常指一大笔钱）

ext.ext_cn: 付数百万英镑购买球员的足球俱乐部
ext.ext_en: ...football clubs who pay out millions of pounds for players.

defs.def_en: If you pay out money, usually a large amount, you spend it on something.

ext.ext_cn: 很多保单在几周或几个月后才得以赔付。
ext.ext_en: Many policies pay out only after a period of weeks or months.

defs.def_en: When an insurance policy pays out, the person who has the policy receives the money that they are entitled to receive.

ext.ext_cn: 学习怎样避免长途飞行时令人不舒服的副作用
ext.ext_en: ...learning how to avoid the unpleasant side-effects of long-haul flights.

defs.def_en: Long-haul is used to describe things that involve transporting passengers or goods over long distances.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 缺乏勇气的；没有胆量的；无毅力的；懦弱的

ext.ext_cn: 他攻击我，攻击我的妻子，这正证明他自己是个没出息的胆小鬼。
ext.ext_en: By attacking me, by attacking my wife, he has proved himself to be a gutless coward.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as gutless, you think they have a weak character and lack courage or determination.

ext.ext_cn: 法庭决定休庭4个月。
ext.ext_en: The court ordered a four month adjournment.

defs.def_en: An adjournment is a temporary stopping of a trial, enquiry, or other meeting.

defs.def_cn: 雪花石膏（用于雕塑及装饰）

ext.ext_cn: 四座雪花石膏雕刻的少女像
ext.ext_en: ...four carved alabaster figures of maidens.

defs.def_en: Alabaster is a white stone that is used for making statues, vases, and ornaments.

ext.ext_cn: 她细腻光滑、美丽白皙的脖子上戴着一条精致的链子。
ext.ext_en: She wore a fine chain about her alabaster neck.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has alabaster skin, you mean that their skin is very beautiful because it is so white and smooth.

ext.ext_cn: 目睹困苦、潦倒的景象，他们感到心里极不舒服。
ext.ext_en: They were sickened by the scenes of misery and degradation they found...

ext.ext_cn: 她描述了自己被迫经受的屈辱。
ext.ext_en: She described the degradations she had been forced to suffer.

defs.def_en: You use degradation to refer to a situation, condition, or experience which you consider shameful and disgusting, especially one which involves poverty or immorality.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得这标志了美国文化的没落。
ext.ext_en: I feel this signals the degradation of American culture.

defs.def_en: Degradation is the process of something becoming worse or weaker, or being made worse or weaker.

ext.ext_cn: 在一些干旱地带存在严重的土地退化问题。
ext.ext_en: There are serious problems of land degradation in some arid zones.

ext.ext_cn: 地球上自然环境的加速退化
ext.ext_en: ...the accelerating degradation of our planet's natural environment.

defs.def_en: The degradation of land or of the environment is the process of its becoming damaged and poorer, for example because of the effects of pollution, industry, and modern agricultural methods.

ext.ext_cn: 植物中水杨酸的降解
ext.ext_en: ...the degradation of salicylic acid in plants.

defs.def_en: In science, the degradation of a substance is the process of its breaking down into its separate parts or elements.

ext.ext_cn: 该决议是在上议院提出反对意见后宣布的。
ext.ext_en: The decision was announced after objections were raised in the Upper House of Parliament.

defs.def_en: In Britain, the Upper House is the House of Lords.
In the United States, the Upper House is the Senate.

defs.def_cn: （其他国家的两院制议会中资历较深而实权较小的）上议院

ext.ext_cn: 德国的上议院今天将在柏林开会。
ext.ext_en: The Upper House of the German parliament is to meet today in Berlin.

defs.def_en: In other countries where the parliament is divided into two groups of members, the Upper House is the more senior of these groups, although it may not be more powerful.

ext.ext_cn: 出售种类多得惊人的劣质品的纪念品商店
ext.ext_en: ...souvenir shops selling an astounding variety of tat.

defs.def_en: You can use tat to refer to ornaments, used goods, cheap clothes, or other items which you think are cheap and of bad quality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 十分严重的;极为恶劣的

ext.ext_cn: 有严重资金周转问题的公司
ext.ext_en: ...a business with severe cash flow problems...

ext.ext_cn: 我曾患有严重的抑郁症。
ext.ext_en: I suffered from severe bouts of depression...

defs.def_en: You use severe to indicate that something bad or undesirable is great or intense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (惩罚、批评)严厉的，严重的，苛刻的

ext.ext_cn: 这一罪行十分恶劣，必须要重判。
ext.ext_en: This was a dreadful crime and a severe sentence is necessary...

ext.ext_cn: 她还没来得及回答，我妈妈就开始严厉地训斥起她来。
ext.ext_en: Before she could reply, my mother launched into a severe reprimand.

defs.def_en: Severe punishments or criticisms are very strong or harsh.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (外貌、外观)简朴的，朴素的,不加修饰的

ext.ext_cn: 戴着她的毡帽，穿着朴素的灰色套装
ext.ext_en: ...wearing her felt hats and severe grey suits...

ext.ext_cn: 靠垫给房间添了一抹亮色，不然房间看上去可能太素净了。
ext.ext_en: The cushions add a touch of colour in a room that might otherwise look severe.

defs.def_en: If you describe the appearance of someone or something as severe, you do not like its plain appearance and lack of decoration.
Particle physics is the study of the qualities of atoms and molecules and the way they behave and react.
Toothache is pain in one of your teeth.

defs.def_cn: 同premenstrual syndrome（常使用缩略形式PMT）
defs.def_en: Premenstrual tension is the same as premenstrual syndrome. The abbreviation PMT is often used.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个正直高尚的人，总是愿意尽其所能帮助他人。
ext.ext_en: He was an upright and noble man who was always willing to help in any way he could...

ext.ext_cn: 我非常愿意相信他是纯洁高尚的。
ext.ext_en: I wanted so much to believe he was pure and noble.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a noble person, you admire and respect them because they are unselfish and morally good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (想法、目标、行动等)高尚的,崇高的

ext.ext_cn: 他对皇帝陛下高尚的动机深信不疑。
ext.ext_en: He had implicit faith in the noble intentions of the Emperor...

ext.ext_cn: 我们总会用听起来非常高尚的理论为我们的行动辩护。
ext.ext_en: We'll always justify our actions with noble sounding theories...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a noble idea, goal, or action, you admire it because it is based on high moral principles.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 壮观的;宏伟的;卓越的;优质的

ext.ext_cn: 树木参天的大公园
ext.ext_en: ...the great parks with their noble trees.

ext.ext_cn: 优质纯葡萄酒
ext.ext_en: ...a noble and pure wine.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as noble, you think that its appearance or quality is very impressive, making it superior to other things of its type.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 侯门朱户
ext.ext_en: ...rich and noble families...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然他出身贵族，却过着穷人的日子。
ext.ext_en: Although he was of noble birth he lived as a poor man.

defs.def_en: Noble means belonging to a high social class and having a title.

ext.ext_cn: 在叶卡捷琳娜大帝统治时期，越来越多的贵族移居莫斯科。
ext.ext_en: More and more nobles made Moscow their home during Catherine's reign.

defs.def_en: In former times, people who belonged to a high social class and had titles such as 'Baron' or 'Duke' were referred to as nobles .
A decanter is a glass container that you use for serving wine, sherry, or port.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 偶尔的；间或的；有时发生的

ext.ext_cn: 间或发作的轻微头疼困扰了我一辈子。
ext.ext_en: I've had occasional mild headaches all my life...

ext.ext_cn: 埃丝特过去会偶尔在周末或别的日子来探望他。
ext.ext_en: Esther used to visit him for the occasional days and weekends.

defs.def_en: Occasional means happening sometimes, but not regularly or often.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他有点儿喝醉了，半睡半醒的。
ext.ext_en: He's half asleep and a bit boozed.

defs.def_en: If someone is boozed or boozed up, they are drunk.
A Hindu is a person who believes in Hinduism and follows its teachings.

ext.ext_cn: 印度教寺庙
ext.ext_en: ...a Hindu temple.

defs.def_en: Hindu is used to describe things that belong or relate to Hinduism.

defs.def_cn: 经历，经受（尤指苦难或艰难时期）

ext.ext_cn: 他正处于非常艰难的时期。
ext.ext_en: He was going through a very difficult time...

ext.ext_cn: 南非正在经历一场不可逆转的变革。
ext.ext_en: South Africa was going through a period of irreversible change.

defs.def_en: If you go through an experience or a period of time, especially an unpleasant or difficult one, you experience it.

ext.ext_cn: 显然有人翻过我的物品。
ext.ext_en: It was evident that someone had gone through my possessions.

defs.def_en: If you go through a lot of things such as papers or clothes, you look at them, usually in order to sort them into groups or to search for a particular item.

ext.ext_cn: 查阅他的客户名单是个相当费劲的活儿。
ext.ext_en: Going through his list of customers is a massive job.

defs.def_en: If you go through a list, story, or plan, you read or check it from beginning to end.

ext.ext_cn: 他们每天晚上都要上演这么一出戏：他打开卧室的窗户，她又把它关上。
ext.ext_en: Every night, they go through the same routine: he throws open the bedroom window, she closes it.

defs.def_en: When someone goes through a routine, procedure, or series of actions, they perform it in the way they usually do.

defs.def_cn: （法律、协议等）被通过；（决定）被批准

ext.ext_cn: 要是当时经济在增长的话，该法案或许也就获得通过了。
ext.ext_en: The bill might have gone through if the economy was growing.

defs.def_en: If a law, agreement, or official decision goes through, it is approved by a parliament or committee.

defs.def_cn: 改变…的方向;改变…的目标

ext.ext_cn: 采用了管控措施来重新分配资源或改变其流向。
ext.ext_en: Controls were used to redistribute or redirect resources.

defs.def_en: If you redirect your energy, resources, or ability, you begin doing something different or trying to achieve something different.

ext.ext_cn: 她指引他们去了男装部。
ext.ext_en: She redirected them to the men's department.

defs.def_en: If you redirect someone or something, you change their course or destination.

ext.ext_cn: 几袋食糖
ext.ext_en: ...bags of sugar...

ext.ext_cn: 冰激凌富含脂肪和糖。
ext.ext_en: Ice cream is high in fat and sugar.

defs.def_en: See also:caster sugar;confectioners’ sugar;demerara sugar;granulated sugar;icing sugar;Sugar is a sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of small white or brown crystals.

ext.ext_cn: 你加几勺糖？
ext.ext_en: How many sugars do you take?

ext.ext_cn: 一杯加了两块方糖的茶
ext.ext_en: ...a mug of tea with two sugars.

defs.def_en: If someone has one sugar in their tea or coffee, they have one small spoon of sugar or one sugar lump in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他坐下来，在咖啡中加糖并搅拌。
ext.ext_en: He sat down and sugared and stirred his coffee.

defs.def_en: If you sugar food or drink, you add sugar to it.

ext.ext_cn: 植物产生糖和淀粉来为自身提供能量。
ext.ext_en: Plants produce sugars and starch to provide themselves with energy.

ext.ext_cn: 葡萄汁中所含的天然糖分
ext.ext_en: ...the natural sugars found in grape juice.

defs.def_en: Sugars are substances that occur naturally in food. When you eat them, the body converts them into energy.

ext.ext_cn: 宝贝，我知道怎么能让你感觉好些，我给你讲个故事。
ext.ext_en: I know how to make you feel better, sugar. I'll tell you a story.

defs.def_en: If one person knows another person very well and likes them a lot, they sometimes call them sugar .

A non-commissioned officer in the armed forces is someone with a rank such as corporal or sergeant who used to have a lower rank, rather than an officer of higher rank who has been given a commission.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她现在已经严重失聪了。
ext.ext_en: She is now profoundly deaf.

ext.ext_cn: 许多常规的电视节目都为耳聋者配了字幕。
ext.ext_en: Many regular TV programs are captioned for the deaf.

defs.def_en: Someone who is deaf is unable to hear anything or is unable to hear very well.

defs.def_cn: 对…充耳不闻的;不愿听…的

ext.ext_cn: 省议会对所有的经济救助请求都充耳不闻。
ext.ext_en: The provincial assembly were deaf to all pleas for financial help.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is deaf to people's requests, arguments, or criticisms, you are criticizing them because they refuse to pay attention to them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人憎恶的；使人厌恶的

ext.ext_cn: 我的顾问班子和全体工作人员都对种族歧视深恶痛绝。
ext.ext_en: Racial discrimination is abhorrent to my council and our staff...

ext.ext_cn: 仍有很多人对堕胎行为表示厌恶。
ext.ext_en: There are many people who still find the act of abortion abhorrent.

defs.def_en: If something is abhorrent to you, you hate it very much or consider it completely unacceptable.
A fly is a small insect with two wings. There are many kinds of flies, and the most common are black in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 飞机穿越云层。
ext.ext_en: The planes flew through the clouds...

ext.ext_cn: 鸟儿飞走了。
ext.ext_en: The bird flew away.

defs.def_en: When something such as a bird, insect, or aircraft flies, it moves through the air.

ext.ext_cn: 他飞往洛杉矶。
ext.ext_en: He flew to Los Angeles...

ext.ext_cn: 他飞回了伦敦。
ext.ext_en: He flew back to London...

defs.def_en: If you fly somewhere, you travel there in an aircraft.

ext.ext_cn: 两架飞机帕克均成功驾驶过。
ext.ext_en: Parker had successfully flown both aircraft...

ext.ext_cn: 他驾驶一架小型飞机飞往古巴。
ext.ext_en: He flew a small plane to Cuba...

defs.def_en: When someone flies an aircraft, they control its movement in the air.

ext.ext_cn: 周四可能会将妇女和儿童空运出去。
ext.ext_en: It may be possible to fly the women and children out on Thursday...

ext.ext_cn: 救济物资正从比萨的一个仓库空运过来。
ext.ext_en: The relief supplies are being flown from a warehouse in Pisa.

defs.def_en: To fly someone or something somewhere means to take or send them there in an aircraft.

ext.ext_cn: 他那露在外面的长发随风向后飞舞。
ext.ext_en: His long, uncovered hair flew back in the wind...

ext.ext_cn: 她从楼上跑下来，长发飘动着。
ext.ext_en: She was running down the stairs, her hair flying.

defs.def_en: If something such as your hair is flying about, it is moving about freely and loosely in the air.

ext.ext_cn: 他们升起非洲人国民大会的旗帜。
ext.ext_en: They flew the flag of the African National Congress...

ext.ext_cn: 一面旗帜在新的军事指挥部上空飘扬着。
ext.ext_en: A flag was flying on the new military HQ.

defs.def_en: If you fly a flag or if it is flying, you display it at the top of a pole.

ext.ext_cn: 在他们生病的时候她飞奔至他们身边。
ext.ext_en: She flew to their bedsides when they were ill...

ext.ext_cn: 我飞奔到楼下。
ext.ext_en: I flew downstairs...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something flies in a particular direction, you are emphasizing that they move there with a lot of speed or force.

ext.ext_cn: 我必须赶快走了否则就会误机。
ext.ext_en: I must fly or I'll miss my plane...

ext.ext_cn: 我得赶紧走了。
ext.ext_en: I'll have to fly.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone that you must fly, you are indicating that you have to leave in a great hurry.

ext.ext_cn: 整个早上流言在各工作间传来传去。
ext.ext_en: Rumours had been flying around the workrooms all morning...

ext.ext_cn: 关于可能的交易的传闻在满天飞。
ext.ext_en: Rumours were flying about possible deals.

defs.def_en: If stories or rumours are flying around a place, they are being discussed a great deal and by a lot of people within a short period of time.
The front opening on a pair of trousers is referred to as the fly, or in British English the flies. It usually consists of a zip or row of buttons behind a band of cloth.
See also:flying;tsetse fly;In fishing, a fly is a model of a small winged insect that is used as a bait.

ext.ext_cn: 雷心肠很软。
ext.ext_en: Ray wouldn't hurt a fly.

ext.ext_cn: 连一只苍蝇都不肯伤害的可爱女孩
ext.ext_en: ...a lovely girl, who would not have harmed a fly.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone wouldn't hurt a fly or wouldn't harm a fly, you are emphasizing that they are very kind and gentle.

ext.ext_cn: 激烈的争吵最后以她一连串的污言秽语而告结束。
ext.ext_en: A simmering row ended with her letting fly with a stream of obscenities.

defs.def_en: If you let fly, you attack someone, either physically by hitting them, or with words by insulting them.

ext.ext_cn: 那几乎都是匆忙之中完成的。
ext.ext_en: It was all pretty much done on the fly.

defs.def_en: If you do something on the fly, you do it quickly without thinking about it or planning it in advance, especially while something else is happening.

defs.def_cn: (把…)打翻在地;(使)重重地摔在地上

ext.ext_cn: 这一拳把那个年轻人打翻在地。
ext.ext_en: The blow sent the young man flying.

defs.def_en: If you send someone or something flying or if they go flying, they move through the air and fall down with a lot of force.

ext.ext_cn: 我多么希望能够看到戴维斯发现他珍贵的货物出事时的样子啊。
ext.ext_en: What I'd give to be a fly on the wall when Davis finds out what's happened to his precious cargo.

defs.def_en: See also:fly-on-the-wall;If you say that you would like to be a fly on the wall in a situation that does not involve you, you mean that you would like to see or hear what happens in that situation.

ext.ext_cn: 她攻击他激烈的反英言论。
ext.ext_en: She flew at him for making a very anti-British remark.

defs.def_en: If you fly at someone, you attack them, either physically by hitting them, or with words by insulting them.

defs.def_cn: 突然爆发(坏脾气);突然陷入(恐慌)

ext.ext_cn: 输掉一场比赛会让他暴跳如雷。
ext.ext_en: Losing a game would cause him to fly into a rage.

defs.def_en: If you fly into a bad temper or a panic, you suddenly become very angry or anxious and show this in your behaviour.
A bootlace is a long thin cord which is used to fasten a boot.

ext.ext_cn: 离开你们中任何一个人哪怕只是一小段时间都舍不得。
ext.ext_en: Parting from any one of you for even a short time is hard...

ext.ext_cn: 那是一次非常动情的分别。
ext.ext_en: It was a dreadfully emotional parting.

defs.def_en: Parting is the act of leaving a particular person or place. A parting is an occasion when this happens.

ext.ext_cn: 她分手时说的话让他感觉空虚孤独。
ext.ext_en: Her parting words left him feeling empty and alone.

ext.ext_cn: 他大胆的吻别
ext.ext_en: ...his bold parting kiss.

defs.def_en: Your parting words or actions are the things that you say or do as you are leaving a place or person.
The parting in someone's hair is the line running from the front to the back of their head where their hair lies in different directions.

ext.ext_cn: 这三个波罗的海共和国协议分道扬镳
ext.ext_en: ...a negotiated parting of the ways for the three Baltic republics.

defs.def_en: When there is a parting of the ways, two or more people or groups of people stop working together or travelling together.
A Negro is someone with dark skin who comes from Africa or whose ancestors came from Africa.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她仍然开她那辆皮实可靠的黑色克尔维特车。
ext.ext_en: She still drives her trusty black Corvette.

defs.def_en: Trusty things, animals, or people are reliable and have always worked well in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 我一直在致力于推翻有关意义恒定性的谬谈。
ext.ext_en: I have been working on exploding the myth of fixity of meaning...

ext.ext_cn: 她相信阶级制度恒久不变。
ext.ext_en: She believed in the fixity of the class system.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the fixity of something, you talk about the fact that it does not change or weaken.

ext.ext_cn: 心理学最初是自然哲学一个纯粹的学术分支。
ext.ext_en: Psychology began as a purely academic offshoot of natural philosophy...

ext.ext_cn: 米特兰银行的分支机构，“第一自助”电话银行，将维萨卡的年利率降至22.2%。
ext.ext_en: Firstdirect, Midland Bank's telephone banking offshoot, has cut its Visa card rate to APR 22.2%.

defs.def_en: If one thing is an offshoot of another, it has developed from that other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 贸易保护主义者引起的两国之间的贸易摩擦。
ext.ext_en: Trade frictions between the two countries had been caused by trade protectionists.

defs.def_en: A protectionist is someone who agrees with and supports protectionism.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （政策、措施、法律）贸易保护主义的

ext.ext_cn: 关贸总协定的成员国已大体上同意在全球贸易中用竞争性的自由市场体制取代代价高且效率低的保护主义政策。
ext.ext_en: GATT member countries have largely agreed to replace expensive and inefficient protectionist policies with a competitive free market system for world trade.

defs.def_en: Protectionist policies, measures, and laws are meant to stop or reduce imports.

defs.def_cn: 非科班出身的；未经正式训练的

ext.ext_cn: 这位非科班出身的数学家对数字特别痴迷。
ext.ext_en: This untutored mathematician had an obsession with numbers...

ext.ext_cn: 他们15岁就辍学了，几乎未接受过正式的写作训练。
ext.ext_en: They had left school at fifteen and were quite untutored in writing.

defs.def_en: If someone is untutored, they have not been formally trained to do something, although they may be quite skilled at it.

ext.ext_cn: 钱伯斯手一挥，喝道：“闭嘴！”
ext.ext_en: Chambers waved his hand. 'Belt up!' he snapped.

defs.def_en: If someone tells you to belt up, they are telling you in a very impolite way to stop talking.

ext.ext_cn: 他轻快地走进屋里，站在门边。
ext.ext_en: He entered the room briskly and stood near the door...

ext.ext_cn: 进浴室前，他把脏衣服全都放进洗衣筐里。
ext.ext_en: Before entering the bathroom, he emptied his dirty laundry into the hamper...

defs.def_en: When you enter a place such as a room or building, you go into it or come into it.

defs.def_cn: 加入;成为…的一员；进入…（工作）

ext.ext_cn: 他进入英国广播公司成为一名普通实习生。
ext.ext_en: He entered the BBC as a general trainee...

ext.ext_cn: 她成为了一名修女。
ext.ext_en: She entered a convent.

defs.def_en: If you enter an organization or institution, you start to work there or become a member of it.

defs.def_cn: 突然出现（在头脑中）;掠过（脑海）

ext.ext_cn: 无论何时想起他的小女儿，杰里米的脸上都会出现笑容。
ext.ext_en: Whenever thoughts of his baby daughter enter his mind a smile appears on Jeremy's face...

ext.ext_cn: 我开始产生了可怕的怀疑。
ext.ext_en: Dreadful doubts began to enter my mind.

defs.def_en: If something new enters your mind, you suddenly think about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他从没想过会有谁比他更好。
ext.ext_en: It never enters his mind that anyone is better than him...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然她喜欢和马特打情骂俏，但是却未曾想过要和他相好。
ext.ext_en: Though she enjoyed flirting with Matt, it had not entered her head to have an affair with him.

defs.def_en: If it does not enter your head to do, think or say something, you do not think of doing that thing although you should have done.

defs.def_cn: 开始进入…（状况);迈入…(时期)

ext.ext_cn: 中国明年开始进入新一个五年计划期。
ext.ext_en: China enters a new five-year plan period next year...

ext.ext_cn: 战争已经进入了第二个月。
ext.ext_en: The war has entered its second month...

defs.def_en: If someone or something enters a particular situation or period of time, they start to be in it or part of it.

defs.def_cn: 参加，报名参加（比赛或考试）

ext.ext_cn: 我跑步很不错，正在考虑参加一些比赛。
ext.ext_en: I run so well I'm planning to enter some races...

ext.ext_cn: 他参加过多次比赛，赢得了数枚金牌。
ext.ext_en: He entered for many competitions, winning several gold medals...

defs.def_en: If you enter a competition, race, or examination, you officially state that you will compete or take part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他妻子玛丽偷偷地为他报名参加锦标赛。
ext.ext_en: His wife Marie secretly entered him for the Championship.

ext.ext_cn: 150个参加奖项评比的项目中的一些
ext.ext_en: ...some of the 150 projects entered for the awards.

defs.def_en: If you enter someone for a race or competition, you officially state that they will compete or take part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 每个星期她都细心地在笔记本上记下所有收到的款项。
ext.ext_en: Each week she meticulously entered in her notebooks all sums received...

ext.ext_cn: 普吕把那一段写在她的笔记本上，然后又大声念了一遍。
ext.ext_en: Prue entered the passage in her notebook, then read it aloud again.

defs.def_en: If you enter something in a notebook, register, or financial account, you write it down.

defs.def_cn: （向计算机或数据库中）输入，写入

ext.ext_cn: 每当有婴儿降生，他们就将婴儿的名字输入电脑。
ext.ext_en: When a baby is born, they enter that baby's name into the computer...

ext.ext_cn: 邮编将被输入统计员的电脑中。
ext.ext_en: Postcodes will be entered into the statisticians' computers...

defs.def_en: To enter information into a computer or database means to record it there, for example by typing it on a keyboard.

defs.def_cn: (昆虫、老鼠等)大批出没于,侵扰

ext.ext_cn: 像蚜虫这样大肆侵害谷物的害虫
ext.ext_en: ...pests like aphids which infest cereal crops.

defs.def_en: When creatures such as insects or rats infest plants or a place, they are present in large numbers and cause damage.

ext.ext_cn: 市中心充斥着犯罪与毒品。
ext.ext_en: Crime and drugs are infesting the inner cities.

defs.def_en: If you say that people or things you disapprove of or regard as dangerous are infesting a place, you mean that there are large numbers of them in that place.

ext.ext_cn: 在最初的几轮中，弗格森和迪金森表现突出。
ext.ext_en: In the earlier rounds, Ferguson and Dickinson were the standouts...

ext.ext_cn: 《伊索贝尔》是另一首很出彩的歌。
ext.ext_en: 'Isobel' is another standout song.

defs.def_en: Journalists use standout to refer to a person or thing that is much better than the other people or things involved in something.
A semi-skilled worker has some training and skills, but not enough to do specialized work.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 高温酷热让他大汗淋漓。
ext.ext_en: He was sweating from the intense heat...

ext.ext_cn: 突然,刺眼的强光照亮了整个房间。
ext.ext_en: Suddenly the room filled with intense light...

defs.def_en: Intense is used to describe something that is very great or extreme in strength or degree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 第三名的争夺紧张激烈。
ext.ext_en: The battle for third place was intense...

ext.ext_cn: 双方的武装力量都有密集动作。
ext.ext_en: The military on both sides are involved in intense activity.

defs.def_en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (目光)有穿透力的，洞悉一切的

ext.ext_cn: 在卢克母亲审视的目光下,我感到极不自在。
