defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their actions as unwitting, you mean that the person does something or is involved in something without realizing it.

defs.def_cn: 卖弄性的技巧；精湛技艺

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影的导演过分卖弄摄影技巧，追求华丽炫目的视觉效果。
ext.ext_en: The film is directed with a technical bravura and visual splendour.

defs.def_en: If you  say that someone is doing something with bravura, you mean that they are using unnecessary extra actions that emphasize their skill or importance.

ext.ext_cn: 达勒姆队的得分手布赖恩·亨特的精彩表现
ext.ext_en: ...a bravura performance from Durham's scorer, Brian Hunt.

defs.def_en: A bravura performance or piece of work is done with bravura.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无计划的;杂乱无章的;任意的

ext.ext_cn: 调查工作确实看起来缺乏计划。
ext.ext_en: The investigation does seem haphazard...

ext.ext_cn: 他从没有见过像罗伯托那样毫无计划地拍摄电影的人。
ext.ext_en: He had never seen such a haphazard approach to filmmaking as Roberto's.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as haphazard, you are critical of it because it is not at all organized or is not arranged according to a plan.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 骨灰瓷坚固耐用。
ext.ext_en: Bone china is strong and durable.

defs.def_en: Something that is durable is strong and lasts a long time without breaking or becoming weaker.

ext.ext_cn: 我应该多锻炼一些。
ext.ext_en: I should exercise more...

ext.ext_cn: 这样的饮食应保持约一年不变。
ext.ext_en: The diet should be maintained unchanged for about a year...

defs.def_en: You use should when you are saying what would be the right thing to do or the right state for something to be in.

defs.def_cn: (表示给出指示或公布官方命令)应该，必须

ext.ext_cn: 所有游客都必须到英国大使馆登记。
ext.ext_en: All visitors should register with the British Embassy...

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲委员会裁定英国航空航天公司应该偿还数千万英镑。
ext.ext_en: The European Commission ruled that British Aerospace should pay back tens of millions of pounds.

defs.def_en: You use should to give someone an order to do something, or to report an official order.

defs.def_cn: (表示与说话者的意愿相反)本应

ext.ext_cn: 今天早晨我本应该走的，但是我觉得有点不舒服。
ext.ext_en: I should have gone this morning but I was feeling a bit ill...

ext.ext_cn: 我本应该像其他旅游者一样呆在阴凉处的，那么我就不会晒伤了。
ext.ext_en: I should have been in the shade like all the other tourists, then I wouldn't have got burned...

defs.def_en: If you say that something should have happened, you mean that it did not happen, but that you wish it had. If you say that something should not have happened, you mean that it did happen, but that you wish it had not.

defs.def_cn: (表示预期或可能性)应该会，可能

ext.ext_cn: 阅读这种语言你应该没问题。
ext.ext_en: You should have no problem with reading this language...

ext.ext_cn: 选民们现在应该确切知道各党派的主张了。
ext.ext_en: The voters should by now be in no doubt what the parties stand for...

defs.def_en: You use should when you are saying that something is probably the case or will probably happen in the way you are describing. If you say that something should have happened by a particular time, you mean that it will probably have happened by that time.

defs.def_cn: (用于疑问句中表示征求意见、同意或咨询情况)可以，应该

ext.ext_cn: 我该不该去上大学呢？
ext.ext_en: Should I or shouldn't I go to university?...

ext.ext_cn: 我应该怎么做？
ext.ext_en: What should I do?...

defs.def_en: You use should in questions when you are asking someone for advice, permission, or information.

defs.def_cn: (通过假设自己处于对方立场会怎么做来提出建议)应该，可以，会

ext.ext_cn: 如果我是你，我会小心的。
ext.ext_en: I should look out if I were you!

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯，如果我是你，我就会拒绝向夏皮罗咨询。
ext.ext_en: James, I should refuse that consultancy with Shapiro, if I were you...

defs.def_en: You say 'I should', usually with the expression 'if I were you', when you are giving someone advice by telling them what you would do if you were in their position.

defs.def_cn: (用在条件从句中表示事件发生的可能性)将要，假定要

ext.ext_cn: 如果你被解雇，你的医疗和养老保险金不会自动中断。
ext.ext_en: If you should be fired, your health and pension benefits will not be automatically cut off...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你从洛弗尔公司买房子，该公司承诺3年后以同样的价格再购回。
ext.ext_en: Should you buy a home from Lovell, the company promises to buy it back at the same price after three years...

defs.def_en: You use should in conditional clauses when you are talking about things that might happen.

defs.def_cn: (用在由 that引导的从句中，放在某些动词、名词和形容词之后，表示将来的事件或情况)应该，能够，竟然会

ext.ext_cn: 他举起了杯子并且示意我也应该这样做。
ext.ext_en: He raised his glass and indicated that I should do the same...

ext.ext_cn: 我坚持我们每辆车都应该看一下。
ext.ext_en: I insisted that we should have a look at every car...

defs.def_en: You use should in 'that' clauses after certain verbs, nouns, and adjectives when you are talking about a future event or situation.

defs.def_cn: (与第一人称连用，表示没有把握)会，可能

ext.ext_cn: 我想可能马上要下雨了。
ext.ext_en: I should think it's going to rain soon...

ext.ext_cn: “我认为那样做是对的。”——“我想是吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'I suppose that was the right thing to do.' — 'I should imagine so.'...

defs.def_en: You use should in expressions such as I should think and I should imagine to indicate that you think something is true but you are not sure.

defs.def_cn: (与第一人称连用表示客气的请求等)想要，将会

ext.ext_cn: 如果今晚你将他们带来的话，我会很高兴。
ext.ext_en: I should be happy if you would bring them this evening...

ext.ext_cn: “只要是你能告诉我的，我都会洗耳恭听，”肯德尔说。
ext.ext_en: 'I should like to know anything you can tell me,' said Kendal...

defs.def_en: You use should in expressions such as I should like and I should be happy to show politeness when you are saying what you want to do, or when you are requesting, offering, or accepting something.

defs.def_cn: (强调所经历的事有趣、令人震惊等)实在该，真该，真应当

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚你真该听听他所说的。
ext.ext_en: You should have heard him last night!

ext.ext_cn: 你真应该看看他第一次出现时的样子，真让人难过。
ext.ext_en: You should have seen him when he first came out — it was so sad...

defs.def_en: You use should in expressions such as You should have seen us and You should have heard him to emphasize how funny, shocking, or impressive something that you experienced was.

defs.def_cn: (用在由who，what等引导的疑问结构中，后接but，强调某件事令人惊讶或震惊)居然

ext.ext_cn: 我正在制订这些计划，没想到这时候居然遇上这个金发的家伙和约翰。
ext.ext_en: I'm making these plans and who should I meet but this blonde guy and John.

defs.def_en: You use should in question structures which begin with words like 'who' and 'what' and are followed by 'but' to emphasize how surprising or shocking a particular event was.
A draughtsman is someone whose job is to prepare very detailed drawings of machinery, equipment, or buildings.

ext.ext_cn: 这幅恢宏画作出自一位19世纪最杰出的画家之手。
ext.ext_en: This is a great drawing by one of the 19th century's finest draughtsmen.

defs.def_en: If someone is a good draughtsman, they are very skilled at drawing.

ext.ext_cn: 最后，我想问一下你未来的计划。
ext.ext_en: Lastly, I would like to ask about your future plans...

ext.ext_cn: 多谢詹姆·谢泼绘制的地图。最后，非常感谢托尼、威廉、德博拉和贝唐。
ext.ext_en: Thank you to Jim Sheppe for drawing the maps. And lastly, a very big thank-you to Tony, William, Deborah and Bethan.

defs.def_en: You use lastly when you want to make a final point, ask a final question, or mention a final item that is connected with the other ones you have already asked or mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 他们洗了手、胳膊和脸，最后脚也洗了。
ext.ext_en: They wash their hands, arms and faces, and lastly, they wash their feet.

defs.def_en: You use lastly when you are saying what happens after everything else in a series of actions or events.  →see usage note at:last

defs.def_cn: 坚定不移的；立场坚定的；毫不动摇的

ext.ext_cn: 他在1944年的日记里声称对君主忠贞不贰。
ext.ext_en: In his diary of 1944 he proclaims unswerving loyalty to the monarchy.

ext.ext_cn: 她坚信父亲是清白的
ext.ext_en: ...her unswerving belief in her father's innocence.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's attitude, feeling, or way of behaving as unswerving, you mean that it is strong and firm and does not weaken or change.

ext.ext_cn: 火越燃越烈，火星四溅。
ext.ext_en: The fire gradually got bigger and bigger. Sparks flew off in all directions.

defs.def_en: A spark is a tiny bright piece of burning material that flies up from something that is  burning.

ext.ext_cn: 他让一束电火花穿过了一团混合气体。
ext.ext_en: He passed an electric spark through a mixture of gases.

defs.def_en: A spark is a flash of light caused by electricity. It often makes a loud sound.

ext.ext_cn: 电线在我头顶上方冒着火花。
ext.ext_en: The wires were sparking above me...

ext.ext_cn: 火光在闪烁，我注视着熊熊燃烧的烈焰。
ext.ext_en: I stared into the flames of the fire as it sparked to life.

defs.def_en: If something sparks, sparks of fire or light come from it.

ext.ext_cn: 可能是丢弃的烟头导致了这场大火。
ext.ext_en: A dropped cigarette may have sparked the fire.

defs.def_en: If a burning object or electricity sparks a fire, it causes a fire.

ext.ext_cn: 他的音乐缺少非常关键的那一点灵感。
ext.ext_en: His music lacked that vital spark of imagination...

ext.ext_cn: 连奥利弗都感到一丝兴奋。
ext.ext_en: Even Oliver felt a tiny spark of excitement.

defs.def_en: A spark of a quality or feeling, especially a desirable one, is a small but noticeable amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 是什么让你对开车产生了兴趣？
ext.ext_en: What was it that sparked your interest in motoring?

ext.ext_cn: 这些提议估计会引起激烈的争论。
ext.ext_en: The proposals are expected to spark heated debate.

defs.def_en: If one thing sparks another, the first thing causes the second thing to start happening.

ext.ext_cn: 他们不怕应对这些问题，也不怕必要时来一番激烈的争论。
ext.ext_en: They are not afraid to tackle the issues or let the sparks fly when necessary.

defs.def_en: If sparks fly between people, they discuss something in an excited or angry way.

ext.ext_cn: 他告诉我们她的年龄在48岁上下。
ext.ext_en: He told us that her age was forty-eight or thereabouts...

ext.ext_cn: 到 1997 年前后，雅典将有一个新机场，还有欧洲最先进的地铁。
ext.ext_en: By 1997 or thereabouts Athens will have a new airport, plus the best underground railway in Europe.

defs.def_en: You add or thereabouts after a number or date to indicate that it is approximate.

ext.ext_cn: 她仍有着年纪比自己小一半多的年轻女人的精力和性感。
ext.ext_en: She still has the energy and sex appeal of a woman less than half her age.

defs.def_en: Someone's sex appeal is their sexual attractiveness.
A freight train is a train on which goods are transported.

ext.ext_cn: 很可能他是找到了自己真正的使命。
ext.ext_en: It could well be that he has a real vocation...

ext.ext_cn: 黛安娜是教会学校的一名年轻老师，她深信帮助学校的女学生是其天职。
ext.ext_en: Diana was a young mission school teacher convinced of her vocation to provide support for her schoolgirl pupils.

defs.def_en: If you have a vocation, you have a strong feeling that you are especially suited to do a particular job or to fulfil a particular role in life, especially one which involves helping other people.

defs.def_cn: （认为特别适合自己的）工作，职业

ext.ext_cn: 她的职业就是当演员。
ext.ext_en: Her vocation is her work as an actress...

ext.ext_cn: 她不是当老师的料。
ext.ext_en: She has no vocation for teaching.

defs.def_en: If you refer to your job or profession as your vocation, you feel that you are particularly suited to it.

ext.ext_cn: 在现实生活中，没有彻头彻尾的坏人，相反地，也没有完完全全的好人。
ext.ext_en: In real life, nobody was all bad, nor, conversely, all good.

defs.def_en: You say conversely to indicate that the situation you are about to describe is the opposite or reverse of the one you have just described.

defs.def_cn: 科学上的;关于某一科学的

ext.ext_cn: 科学研究被普遍认为是美国高生活水准的源泉。
ext.ext_en: Scientific research is widely claimed to be the source of the high standard of living in the US.

ext.ext_cn: 将动物用于科学实验
ext.ext_en: ...the use of animals in scientific experiments.

defs.def_en: Scientific is used to describe things that relate to science or to a particular science.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 细致严谨的;使用科学方法的

ext.ext_cn: 用这个方法来测试他们的意见不科学。
ext.ext_en: It's not a scientific way to test their opinions.

ext.ext_cn: 对资本主义发展细致严谨的研究
ext.ext_en: ...the scientific study of capitalist development.

defs.def_en: If you do something in a scientific way, you do it carefully and thoroughly, using experiments or tests.

ext.ext_cn: 我穿着紫色连衫裤和高跟鞋，脸上抹着厚厚的化妆品。
ext.ext_en: I was wearing a purple jumpsuit, high heeled shoes, and lots of makeup.

defs.def_en: A jumpsuit is a piece of clothing in the form of a top and trousers in one continuous piece.

ext.ext_cn: 计算机是公平之物，所有人物都能从中获得信息。
ext.ext_en: The computer is a leveller, making information available to everyone...

ext.ext_cn: 以暴力实现平等是危险的。
ext.ext_en: Violence is a dangerous leveller.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a leveller, you mean that it makes all people seem the same, in spite of their differences in, for example, age or social status.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他快晕船了，已经感到恶心了。
ext.ext_en: He was very prone to seasickness and already felt queasy.

defs.def_en: If you feel queasy or if you have a queasy stomach, you feel rather ill, as if you are going to be sick.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一些人为自己的姓名和地址是如何被泄露出去的感到不安。
ext.ext_en: Some people feel queasy about how their names and addresses have been obtained.

defs.def_en: If you feel queasy about something, you are a little worried about it.

defs.def_cn: 但愿，作为希望（一些用词严谨者认为这种用法不正确，但实际上已被频繁地使用）

ext.ext_cn: 他们两人都曾历经磨难，但愿现在我能帮助他们重建正常的生活。
ext.ext_en: Both of them have been through an awful lot and hopefully now I can help them rebuild their lives...

ext.ext_cn: 希望你读完这个后就不会有任何问题了。
ext.ext_en: Hopefully, you won't have any problems after reading this.

defs.def_en: You say hopefully when mentioning something that you hope will happen. Some careful speakers of English think that this use of hopefully is not correct, but it is very frequently used.

ext.ext_cn: 很多小镇只允许将车停在街道的一侧。
ext.ext_en: In many towns parking is allowed only on one side of the street...

ext.ext_cn: 我知道在广场上肯定找不到停车位。
ext.ext_en: I knew I'd never find a parking space in the Square.

defs.def_en: Parking is the action of moving a vehicle into a place in a car park or by the side of the road where it can be left.

ext.ext_cn: 车辆准许进入，但是车位有限。
ext.ext_en: Cars allowed, but parking is limited.

defs.def_en: Parking is space for parking a vehicle in.

ext.ext_cn: 这种说法是指代间谍行为的常用外交辞令。
ext.ext_en: The phrase is common diplomatic parlance for spying.

defs.def_en: You use parlance when indicating that the expression you are using is normally used by a particular group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 之后对生活产生的影响可能会是空虚感和沮丧感。
ext.ext_en: The result later in life may be feelings of emptiness and depression.

defs.def_en: A feeling of emptiness is an unhappy or frightening feeling that nothing is worthwhile, especially when you are very tired or have just experienced something upsetting.

ext.ext_cn: 沙漠的空旷
ext.ext_en: ...the emptiness of the desert.

defs.def_en: The emptiness of a place is the fact that there is nothing in it.

ext.ext_cn: 我开车开了好一阵穿过这片可怕的空旷之地。
ext.ext_en: I drove for a while across this fearsome emptiness.

defs.def_en: An emptiness is a very large area of land, sea, or space that has nothing in it.
Jell-O is a transparent, usually coloured food that is eaten as a dessert. It is made from gelatine, fruit juice, and sugar.
A closet is a piece of furniture with doors at the front and shelves inside, which is used for storing things.
A closet is a very small room for storing things, especially one without windows.

defs.def_cn: (信仰、习惯、情感)隐蔽的，不公开的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个秘密的法西斯分子。
ext.ext_en: He is a closet Fascist.

ext.ext_cn: 内心对女性的仇视
ext.ext_en: ...closet misogyny.

defs.def_en: Closet is used to describe a person who has beliefs, habits, or feelings which they keep secret, often because they are embarrassed about them. Closet is also used of their beliefs, habits, or feelings.
If someone comes out of the closet, they tell people that they are homosexual after having kept this a secret.

defs.def_cn: 公开（或谈论）以前保密的事;(问题)公开
defs.def_en: If someone comes out of the closet, they reveal or discuss something which they have previously kept secret. You can also say that an issue comes out of the closet when it starts to be publicly discussed.
A class action is a legal case brought by a group of people rather than an individual.

ext.ext_cn: 你常出汗或是脸上常发烫吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you sweat a lot or flush a lot?...

ext.ext_cn: 他难为情地扭过头去，羞红了脸。
ext.ext_en: He turned away embarrassed, his face flushing red.

defs.def_en: If you flush, your face goes red because you are hot or ill, or because you are feeling a strong emotion such as embarrassment or anger.

ext.ext_cn: 她冲完马桶回到卧室。
ext.ext_en: She flushed the toilet and went back in the bedroom.

ext.ext_cn: 冲马桶的声音
ext.ext_en: ...the sound of the toilet flushing.

defs.def_en: When someone flushes a toilet after using it, they fill the toilet bowl with water in order to clean it, usually by pressing a handle or pulling a chain. You can also say that a toilet flushes .

ext.ext_cn: 他试图把钞票从马桶里冲走时被发现。
ext.ext_en: He was found trying to flush banknotes down the toilet.

defs.def_en: If you flush something down the toilet, you get rid of it by putting it into the toilet bowl and flushing the toilet.

ext.ext_cn: 用干净冷水冲洗眼睛至少 15 分钟。
ext.ext_en: Flush the eye with clean cold water for at least 15 minutes...

ext.ext_cn: 用水清洗肾脏和尿道最理想不过。
ext.ext_en: Water is ideal to flush the kidneys and the urinary tract.

defs.def_en: If you flush a part of your body, you clean it or make it healthier by using a large amount of liquid to get rid of dirt or harmful substances.

ext.ext_cn: 那样做虽不能将污物全部冲掉，但应该能疏通一些散发恶臭的排水管。
ext.ext_en: That won't flush out all the sewage, but it should unclog some stinking drains.

defs.def_en: If you flush dirt or a harmful substance out of a place, you get rid of it by using a large amount of liquid.

defs.def_cn: 把(人或动物)驱出;把…赶出

ext.ext_cn: 他们把他们从藏身之处赶了出来。
ext.ext_en: They flushed them out of their hiding places...

ext.ext_cn: 圭亚那国防军正采取行动驱逐在本国作业的非法巴西矿工。
ext.ext_en: The Guyana Defence Force is engaged in flushing out illegal Brazilian miners operating in the country.

defs.def_en: If you flush people or animals out of a place where they are hiding, you find or capture them by forcing them to come out of that place.

ext.ext_cn: 要保证每块瓷砖都和它周围的瓷砖在同一平面上。
ext.ext_en: Make sure the tile is flush with the surrounding tiles.

defs.def_en: If one object or surface is flush with another, they are at the same height or distance from something else, so that they form a single smooth surface.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (通常指短时间内)有钱的，富足的;暴富的

ext.ext_cn: 在那时，许多发展中国家都通过出口赚到了大量美元。
ext.ext_en: At that time, many developing countries were flush with dollars earned from exports...

ext.ext_cn: 等我们有钱了就可能会给他们喝香槟。
ext.ext_en: If we're feeling flush we'll probably give them champagne.

defs.def_en: If you are flush with money, you have a lot of it, usually only for a short time.

defs.def_cn: 一阵强烈感情;一阵兴奋(或快乐)

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人初尝恋爱滋味的兴奋
ext.ext_en: ...the first flush of young love.

ext.ext_cn: 在一阵胜利的喜悦中
ext.ext_en: ...in the flush of victory.

defs.def_en: The flush of something is an intense feeling of excitement or pleasure that you have when you are experiencing it and for a short time afterwards.

ext.ext_cn: 最近接二连三的胜利
ext.ext_en: ...the flush of recent victories.

ext.ext_cn: 记忆涌现
ext.ext_en: ...a flush of memories.

defs.def_en: A flush of something is a large quantity of it that comes suddenly or quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 工业界和学术界间紧密联系的重要性
ext.ext_en: ...the importance of strong links between industry and academia.

ext.ext_en: Surprisingly, she didn't feel nervous, or regretful about her actions.

defs.def_en: If you are regretful, you show that you regret something.

defs.def_cn: (与过去分词连用构成形容词，强调状况或行动的强度)特别，尤其

ext.ext_cn: 我实在太累了，正在休息。
ext.ext_en: I'm having a much-needed rest.

ext.ext_cn: 比上一季款式有了大幅改良的新款
ext.ext_en: ...a much-improved version of last season's model.

defs.def_en: Much- combines with past participles to form adjectives which emphasize the intensity of the specified state or action.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 康诺特酒店的宁静氛围让客人完全找到了宾至如归的感觉。
ext.ext_en: The tranquil atmosphere of The Connaught allows guests to feel totally at home...

ext.ext_cn: 那个地方恬静宜人。
ext.ext_en: The place was tranquil and appealing.

defs.def_en: Something that is tranquil is calm and peaceful.

ext.ext_cn: 正确答案在第8页末尾。
ext.ext_en: The correct answers can be found at the bottom of page 8...

ext.ext_cn: 下列信息在付印时准确无误。
ext.ext_en: The following information was correct at time of going to press...

defs.def_en: If something is correct, it is in accordance with the facts and has no mistakes.

ext.ext_cn: 你说得很对，这是月桂树的叶子。
ext.ext_en: You are absolutely correct. The leaves are from a bay tree...

ext.ext_cn: 如果凯西是对的，清理的总花费将达1,100亿美元。
ext.ext_en: If Casey is correct, the total cost of the cleanup would come to $110 billion.

defs.def_en: If someone is correct, what they have said or thought is true.

ext.ext_cn: 使用恰当的材料至关重要。
ext.ext_en: The use of the correct materials was crucial...

ext.ext_cn: 怀特确信裁判作出了公正的判罚。
ext.ext_en: White was in no doubt the referee made the correct decision.

defs.def_en: The correct thing or method is the thing or method that is required or is most suitable in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 你试图让自己的母亲变得越来越独立，这样做很正确。
ext.ext_en: You are perfectly correct in trying to steer your mother towards increased independence...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为总统拒绝这一提议是正确的。
ext.ext_en: I think the president was correct to reject the offer.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is correct in doing something, you approve of their action.

defs.def_cn: 纠正(问题);改正，修正(错误)

ext.ext_cn: 要解决这个问题，他可能需要做外科手术。
ext.ext_en: He may need surgery to correct the problem...

ext.ext_cn: 他批评政府在纠正过去的错误问题上效率低下，并且拖拖拉拉。
ext.ext_en: He has criticised the government for inefficiency and delays in correcting past mistakes.

defs.def_en: If you correct a problem, mistake, or fault, you do something which puts it right.

ext.ext_cn: “实际上，并不是那样，”乔治纠正我。
ext.ext_en: 'Actually, that isn't what happened,' George corrects me...

ext.ext_cn: 我必须纠正他的一处小错误。
ext.ext_en: I must correct him on a minor point.

defs.def_en: If you correct someone, you say something which you think is more accurate or appropriate than what they have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 备课和批改学生的作业花费了他很多精力。
ext.ext_en: It took an extraordinary effort to focus on preparing his classes or correcting his students' work.

defs.def_en: When someone corrects a piece of writing, they look at it and mark the mistakes in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为)符合社会公认标准的，得体的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为英国人很有礼貌，举止非常得体。
ext.ext_en: I think English men are very polite and very correct...

ext.ext_cn: 他们富有体育精神而且举止得体，让我们感到相当惊讶。
ext.ext_en: We were rather surprised by their sporting and correct behaviour.

defs.def_en: If a person or their behaviour is correct, their behaviour is in accordance with social or other rules.

defs.def_cn: 若是我说错了就请指出

ext.ext_cn: 如果我没记错的话，那是在卡马森的一个停车场内。
ext.ext_en: As I recall, but correct me if I'm wrong, it was in a car park in Carmarthen.

defs.def_en: You say 'correct me if I'm wrong' to indicate that you are not entirely sure that what you are about to say is true.
An axle is a rod connecting a pair of wheels on a car or other vehicle.

ext.ext_cn: 别逗了，快吃吧！
ext.ext_en: Stop playing around and eat!...

ext.ext_cn: 毫无疑问他很认真，那可不是闹着玩的。
ext.ext_en: There was no doubt he was serious, it wasn't just playing around...

defs.def_en: If you play around, you behave in a silly way to amuse yourself or other people.

defs.def_cn: 反复琢磨；自由调换…的排列顺序

ext.ext_cn: 我可以尝试用不同的方式排列这些图片以使它们更加吸引眼球。
ext.ext_en: I can play around with the pictures to make them more eye-catching.

defs.def_en: If you play around with a problem or an arrangement of objects, you try different ways of organizing it in order to find the best solution or arrangement.

ext.ext_cn: 多达75%的已婚男士可能在外拈花惹草。
ext.ext_en: Up to 75 per cent of married men may be playing around...

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯特和另一个女人乱搞。
ext.ext_en: Robert was playing around with another woman.

defs.def_en: If someone plays around, they have sex with people other than the person they are married to or having a serious relationship with.

defs.def_cn: （与形容词和名词连用构成形容词）表示“亲”，“支持”，“赞成”

ext.ext_cn: 他活动在该国亲民主运动的前沿。
ext.ext_en: He was at the forefront of the pro-democracy campaign in the country...

ext.ext_cn: 年轻选民是坚定的亲欧派。
ext.ext_en: Younger voters are strongly pro-European...

defs.def_en: You can add pro- to adjectives and nouns in order to form adjectives that describe people who support or admire a particular person, system, or idea.

ext.ext_cn: 原来的锅炉开始往外喷火苗后他便换了个新的。
ext.ext_en: He replaced the boiler when the last one began to spout flames...

ext.ext_cn: 主广场有个喷泉，能将水喷射至 40 英尺高的空中。
ext.ext_en: The main square has a fountain that spouts water 40 feet into the air...

defs.def_en: If something spouts liquid or fire, or if liquid or fire spout out of something, it comes out very quickly with a lot of force.
A spout of liquid is a long stream of it which is coming out of something very forcefully.

defs.def_cn: 喋喋不休地说;夸夸其谈

ext.ext_cn: 他根本不了解苏格兰橄榄球队，却在自己的专栏上对其大加抨击。
ext.ext_en: He used his column to spout ill-informed criticism of the Scots rugby team.

ext.ext_cn: 你这种人就会去附和他们的那些废话。
ext.ext_en: You're the kind of person who affiliates himself with the kind of crap they spout.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person spouts something, you disapprove of them because they say something which you do not agree with or which you think they do not honestly feel.
A spout is a long, hollow part of a container through which liquids can be poured out easily.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你只采集了一个样本，那么所有的数据就有问题了。
ext.ext_en: If you only take a sample then all the statistics are up the spout.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is up the spout, you mean that it is wrong or it is no longer working.

ext.ext_cn: 受伤的警察被同伴带走了。
ext.ext_en: An injured policeman was led away by colleagues...

ext.ext_cn: 他从自己的车边走开了。
ext.ext_en: He walked away from his car...

defs.def_en: If someone or something moves or is moved away from a place, they move or are moved so that they are no longer there. If you are away from a place, you are not in the place where people expect you to be.

ext.ext_cn: 她马上将目光移开，低头盯着自己的手。
ext.ext_en: She quickly looked away and stared down at her hands...

ext.ext_cn: 站起身时，他将脸别过去，以免让她看到眼中的泪水。
ext.ext_en: As he stands up, he turns his face away from her so that she won't see his tears.

defs.def_en: If you look or turn away from something, you move your head so that you are no longer looking at it.

ext.ext_cn: 我把杂志收好，准备睡觉。
ext.ext_en: I put my journal away and prepared for bed...

ext.ext_cn: 她所有的信件都整齐地放在文件夹中。
ext.ext_en: All her letters were carefully filed away in folders...

defs.def_en: If you put or tidy something away, you put it where it should be. If you hide someone or something away, you put them in a place where nobody can see them or find them.

defs.def_cn: 离（某人或某地）有一定距离

ext.ext_cn: 那两个女人坐在离对方尽可能远的地方。
ext.ext_en: The two women were sitting as far away from each other as possible...

ext.ext_cn: 我急于把他带到这儿，远离家人和朋友。
ext.ext_en: I was anxious to get him here, away from family and friends.

defs.def_en: If something is away from a person or place, it is at a distance from that person or place.

ext.ext_cn: 还有两周多时间即召开的华盛顿峰会
ext.ext_en: ...the Washington summit, now only just over two weeks away...

ext.ext_cn: 看起来，几个月内也许会最终实现和平。
ext.ext_en: Peace it seemed might at last be no more than a few months away.

defs.def_en: You use away to talk about future events. For example, if an event is a week away, it will happen after a week.

ext.ext_cn: 该队在客场以4比3取得的引起轰动的胜利
ext.ext_en: ...a sensational 4-3 victory for the team playing away.

ext.ext_cn: 查尔顿队即将在客场进行一场重要比赛。
ext.ext_en: Charlton are about to play an important away match.

defs.def_en: When a sports team plays away, it plays on its opponents' ground.

defs.def_cn: （表示慢慢消失、变得不重要或慢慢改变）

ext.ext_cn: 大片雪都慢慢融化了。
ext.ext_en: So much snow has already melted away...

ext.ext_cn: 他的声音渐渐变为了小声低语。
ext.ext_en: His voice died away in a whisper...

defs.def_en: You can use away to say that something slowly disappears, becomes less significant, or changes so that it is no longer the same.

defs.def_cn: （表示从一种状态到另一种状态的变化或发展）

ext.ext_cn: 英国法院渐渐地不再将少年犯送进监狱。
ext.ext_en: British courts are increasingly moving away from sending young offenders to prison...

ext.ext_cn: 从传统职业转向商贸领域的巨大转变已然发生了。
ext.ext_en: There's been a dramatic shift away from traditional careers towards business and commerce.

defs.def_en: You use away to show that there has been a change or development from one state or situation to another.

ext.ext_cn: 他经常在文字处理机上一直工作到深夜。
ext.ext_en: He would often be working away on his word processor late into the night...

ext.ext_cn: 她叹了口气，开门时心一直在怦怦直跳。
ext.ext_en: She sighed, her heart banging away against her ribs as she opened the door.

defs.def_en: You can use away to emphasize a continuous or repeated action.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你炒我鱿鱼，我就再也高兴不起来了。
ext.ext_en: If you take my work away I can't be happy anymore...

ext.ext_cn: 服务员把盘子撤走，放下了我的账单。
ext.ext_en: The waitress whipped the plate away and put down my bill...

defs.def_en: You use away to show that something is removed.

ext.ext_cn: 他们定于10月5号接受提审。
ext.ext_en: They are scheduled for arraignment October 5th...

ext.ext_cn: 审讯时，涌入的人群和安全部队发生冲突。
ext.ext_en: Crowds appeared at the arraignments, clashing with security forces.

defs.def_en: Arraignment is when someone is brought before a court of law to answer a particular charge.

ext.ext_cn: 如果不继续学习，毕业生就会失去思想上的活力。
ext.ext_en: Without continued learning, graduates will lose their intellectual vitality...

ext.ext_cn: 李先生说中国的改革给其经济注入了活力。
ext.ext_en: Mr Li said China's reforms had brought vitality to its economy.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has vitality, you mean that they have great energy and liveliness.
A vet is someone who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals.

ext.ext_cn: 波士顿的新英格兰收容所将为200名老兵提供圣诞晚餐。
ext.ext_en: The New England Shelter in Boston will serve Christmas dinner for 200 vets...

ext.ext_cn: 这三位都是越战老兵。
ext.ext_en: All three are Vietnam vets.

defs.def_en: A vet is someone who has served in the armed forces of their country, especially during a war.

ext.ext_cn: 他找不到任何要求研究成果在发表前需经审查的规定。
ext.ext_en: He can find no trace of a rule requiring research to be vetted before publication...

ext.ext_cn: 所有物品都交由一个著名的专家小组检查鉴定。
ext.ext_en: All objects are vetted by a distinguished panel of experts...

defs.def_en: If something is vetted, it is checked carefully to make sure that it  is acceptable to people in authority.

defs.def_cn: （尤指对将要从事涉及军事或政治机密工作人员的）调查，审查，考查

ext.ext_cn: 她在为我工作以前曾受到过秘密考查。
ext.ext_en: She was secretly vetted before she ever undertook any work for me...

ext.ext_cn: 那些与皇室成员结婚的人未来将受到更细致的调查。
ext.ext_en: People who marry into the Royal Family will have to be vetted much more carefully in future.

defs.def_en: If someone is vetted, they are investigated fully before being given a particular job, role, or position, especially one which involves military or political secrets.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 喜庆的;欢乐的;充满节日气氛的

ext.ext_cn: 镇子上充盈着一种节日的喜庆气氛。
ext.ext_en: The town has a festive holiday atmosphere...

ext.ext_cn: 周六晚上的船长晚会是游轮上最喜庆的活动。
ext.ext_en: The Captain's Party on Saturday evening is the cruise's most festive event.

defs.def_en: Something that is festive is special, colourful, or exciting, especially because of a holiday or celebration.

defs.def_cn: 与节日有关的;与节庆有关的;(尤指)与圣诞节有关的

ext.ext_cn: 节日期间工厂将关门。
ext.ext_en: The factory was due to shut for the festive period...

ext.ext_cn: 由于节日休假，政府武装部队人数减半。
ext.ext_en: The government's armed forces have halved their strength for the festive break.

defs.def_en: Festive means relating to a holiday or celebration, especially Christmas.

ext.ext_cn: 这会帮助那些家庭度过干旱期，不至于遭受太多的苦。
ext.ext_en: This would help the families to survive the drought without undue suffering...

ext.ext_cn: 这可能会在即将开启的谈判问题上给委员会带来过多的影响。
ext.ext_en: It might give the Commission undue influence over the coming negotiations...

defs.def_en: If you describe something bad as undue, you mean that it is greater or more extreme than you think is reasonable or appropriate.

defs.def_cn: (船)轮渡式的，滚装滚卸的，允许车辆开上开下的

ext.ext_cn: 滚装滚卸渡船
ext.ext_en: ...roll-on roll-off ferries.

defs.def_en: A roll-on roll-off ship is designed so that cars and lorries can drive on at one end before the ship sails, and then drive off at the other end after the journey.

ext.ext_cn: 看到她如此细心地修剪她那双大手，他十分惊讶。
ext.ext_en: He was surprised to see how carefully she had manicured her broad hands.

ext.ext_cn: 我偶尔做一次美甲。
ext.ext_en: I have a manicure occasionally.

defs.def_en: If you manicure your hands or nails, you care for them by softening your skin and cutting and polishing your nails.

ext.ext_cn: 大约10分钟之后，防暴警察就到了。
ext.ext_en: After about 10 minutes the riot police arrived.

defs.def_en: The riot police is the section of the police force that is trained to deal with people who cause trouble in public places.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为它值不了150英镑。
ext.ext_en: I can't say it justifies the price tag of £150...

ext.ext_cn: 那栋有34个房间的摄政时期的白色官邸报价为1,750万英镑。
ext.ext_en: The price tag on the 34-room white Regency mansion is £17.5 million.

defs.def_en: If something has a price tag of a particular amount, that is the amount that you must pay in order to buy it.
In a shop, the price tag on an article for sale is a small piece of card or paper which is attached to the article and which has the price written on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （气味或味道）辛辣的，苦的，刺激的

ext.ext_cn: 房间里弥漫着刺鼻的烟草味。
ext.ext_en: The room filled with the acrid smell of tobacco...

ext.ext_cn: 这种植物闻着刺鼻，吃着辣口。
ext.ext_en: The plant has an unpleasant odour and an acrid taste.

defs.def_en: An acrid smell or taste is strong and sharp, and usually unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 周转资金不足的；资金短缺的

ext.ext_cn: 资金紧张的市政会不得不削减主要社区服务项目经费，我们眼看就要陷入危机。
ext.ext_en: We are heading for a crisis, with cash-starved councils forced to cut back on vital community services.

defs.def_en: A cash-starved company or organization does not have enough money to operate properly, usually because another organization, such as the government, is not giving them the money that they need.

defs.def_cn: （电视上或公共活动中使用的）电子提词机，自动提示器
defs.def_en: An Autocue is a device used by people speaking on television or at a public event, which displays words for them to read.

defs.def_cn: 精神错乱的;精神失常的;疯狂的

ext.ext_cn: 一些人完全承受不了，结果就精神失常了。
ext.ext_en: Some people simply can't take it and they just go insane...

ext.ext_cn: 阿格尼丝是个备受虐待的女人,她在一时精神错乱下出于自我防卫杀了人。
ext.ext_en: Agnes was a battered woman who had killed, in self-defense, while temporarily insane.

defs.def_en: Someone who is insane has a mind that does not work in a normal way, with the result that their behaviour is very strange.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我说：“听着,这简直荒唐之极。”
ext.ext_en: I said, 'Listen, this is completely insane.'

ext.ext_cn: 不可理喻的嫉妒心
ext.ext_en: ...insane jealousy.

defs.def_en: If you describe a decision or action as insane, you think it is very foolish or excessive.

defs.def_cn: 唷，咳（书面语中用来表示吃惊、松口气或酷热难耐等）

ext.ext_cn: 唷，真是大松一口气！
ext.ext_en: Phew, what a relief!

defs.def_en: Phew is used in writing to represent the soft whistling sound that you make when you breathe out quickly, for example when you are relieved or shocked about something or when you are very hot.

ext.ext_cn: 他的头发淋雨后紧贴在头皮上。
ext.ext_en: His hair was plastered down to his scalp by the rain.

defs.def_en: If something is plastered to a surface, it is sticking to the surface.

ext.ext_cn: 我的双手、靴子和裤子上都沾满了泥巴。
ext.ext_en: My hands, boots and trousers were plastered with mud.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is plastered with a sticky substance, they are covered with it.

defs.def_cn: 大幅（或醒目）地刊载（于头版）的

ext.ext_cn: 他的照片占据了周末报纸的头版。
ext.ext_en: His picture was plastered all over the newspapers on the weekend.

defs.def_en: If a story or photograph is plastered all over the front page of a newspaper, it is given a lot of space on the page and made very noticeable.

defs.def_cn: 烂醉如泥的；酩酊大醉的

ext.ext_cn: 一小杯杜松子酒只要9便士，灌醉自己即便宜又容易。
ext.ext_en: With gin at 9p a tot, getting plastered is cheap and easy.

defs.def_en: If someone gets plastered, they get very drunk.

defs.def_cn: 用熟石膏处理过的；打上石膏的

ext.ext_cn: 她坐在病床上，一条打了石膏的腿悬在空中。
ext.ext_en: She was sitting in a hospital bed, her plastered leg up in the air.

defs.def_en: If someone's broken arm or leg is plastered, it has a hard cover of plaster of Paris around it to protect the broken bone while it is mending.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们围在门口偷看他。
ext.ext_en: Children came to peep at him round the doorway...

ext.ext_cn: 她时不时地偷眼看他是否在注意自己。
ext.ext_en: Now and then she peeped to see if he was noticing her.

defs.def_en: If you peep, or peep at something, you have a quick look at it, often secretly and quietly.

ext.ext_cn: 岩石间隐约可见紫色和黄色的花儿。
ext.ext_en: Purple and yellow flowers peeped up between rocks...

ext.ext_cn: 商店门口从不同方向露出一张脸。
ext.ext_en: Here and there a face peeped out from the shop doorway.

defs.def_en: If something peeps out from behind or under something, a small part of it is visible or becomes visible.

ext.ext_cn: 她一睡觉，就不会发出一点儿动静。
ext.ext_en: You don't hear a peep from her once she's gone to bed.

defs.def_en: If you say that you don't hear a peep from someone, you mean that they do not say anything or make any noise.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有光泽的；闪亮的；光亮的

ext.ext_cn: 一头浓密、富有光泽的褐色鬈发
ext.ext_en: ...a head of thick, lustrous, wavy brown hair.

defs.def_en: Something that is lustrous shines brightly and gently, because it has a smooth or shiny surface.
A tuba is a large musical instrument of the brass family which produces very low notes. It consists of a long metal tube folded round several times with a wide opening at the end.

ext.ext_cn: 西撒哈拉伟大的游牧部落
ext.ext_en: ...the great nomadic tribes of the Western Sahara.

defs.def_en: Nomadic people travel from place to place rather than living in one place all the time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 作为一个铁路工程师的女儿，她最初的童年生活有些漂泊不定。
ext.ext_en: The daughter of a railway engineer, she at first had a somewhat nomadic childhood.

defs.def_en: If someone has a nomadic way of life, they travel from place to place and do not have a settled home.

defs.def_cn: 标有字母（或文字）的；饰有字母（或文字）的

ext.ext_cn: 字迹粗糙的硬纸板标志牌
ext.ext_en: ...a crudely lettered cardboard sign.

defs.def_en: Something that is lettered is covered or decorated with letters or words.

ext.ext_cn: 预计众多赌马者会在国家大马赛上下注7,000万英镑。
ext.ext_en: Punters are expected to gamble £70m on the Grand National.

defs.def_en: A punter is a person who bets money, especially on horse races.

ext.ext_cn: 如果有人侵犯脱衣舞表演者，客人们就知道表演可能要结束了。
ext.ext_en: Should anyone attack the stripper, the punters know that it is likely to be the end of the show.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to their customers or clients as punters .
In American football, a punter is someone who kicks the ball by punting it.
A hauler is the same as a haulier .

ext.ext_cn: 有天早晨我不想上学，于是决定装病。
ext.ext_en: One morning, I didn't want to go to school, and decided to feign illness...

ext.ext_cn: “贾尔斯今早来电话了，”米雷拉装作若无其事地说。
ext.ext_en: 'Giles phoned this morning,' Mirella said with feigned indifference.

defs.def_en: If someone feigns a particular feeling, attitude, or physical condition, they try to make other people think that they have it or are experiencing it, although this is not true.

ext.ext_cn: 我们这次旅行于 3月 31 号从希思罗机场出发，4 月 16 号返回。
ext.ext_en: Our tour departs from Heathrow Airport on 31 March and returns 16 April...

ext.ext_cn: 麦克唐纳先生上午启程前往悉尼。
ext.ext_en: In the morning Mr McDonald departed for Sydney...

defs.def_en: When something or someone departs from a place, they leave it and start a journey to another place.

ext.ext_cn: 为什么在这个国家我们背离了教育上明智的选择？
ext.ext_en: Why is it in this country that we have departed from good educational sense?...

ext.ext_cn: 一个厨师要彻底颠覆传统的圣诞节菜肴是需要很大勇气的。
ext.ext_en: It takes a brave cook to depart radically from the traditional Christmas menu.

defs.def_en: If you depart from a traditional, accepted, or agreed way of doing something, you do it in a different or unexpected way.

ext.ext_cn: 利普顿打算离开他创立的那家公司。
ext.ext_en: Lipton is planning to depart from the company he founded.

ext.ext_cn: 在他担任皇家艺术学院院长期间有好几名教师辞职了。
ext.ext_en: ...a number of staff departed during his reign as rector of the Royal College of Art...

defs.def_en: If someone departs from a job, they resign from it or leave it. In American English, you can say that someone departs a job.

ext.ext_cn: 他带着一种已完成使命的满足感离开了这个世界。
ext.ext_en: He departed this world with a sense of having fulfilled his destiny.

defs.def_en: When someone departs this life, or departs this earth, they die.

ext.ext_cn: 地球围绕太阳转。
ext.ext_en: The Earth rotates round the sun...

ext.ext_cn: 双手抓住自己的双脚，转动一下，以放松脚踝。
ext.ext_en: Take each foot in both your hands and rotate it to loosen and relax the ankle.

defs.def_en: When something rotates or when you rotate it, it turns with a circular movement.

ext.ext_cn: 俱乐部的成员可以轮流工作，而且一个人就能做好晚上的所有准备工作。
ext.ext_en: The members of the club can rotate and one person can do all the preparation for the evening...

ext.ext_cn: 根据轮流担任领导的新政党章程，他们在一年后会轮换职位。
ext.ext_en: They will swap posts in a year's time, according to new party rules which rotate the leadership.

defs.def_en: If people or things rotate, or if someone rotates them, they take it in turns to do a particular job or serve a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 不是所有人都赞成庆祝该节日。
ext.ext_en: Not everyone approves of the festival...

ext.ext_cn: 我赞成该提案。
ext.ext_en: I approved of the proposal.

defs.def_en: If you approve of an action, event, or suggestion, you like it or are pleased about it.

ext.ext_cn: 你从来没有喜欢过亨利，对吗？
ext.ext_en: You've never approved of Henry, have you?...

ext.ext_cn: 我不喜欢他的态度。
ext.ext_en: I didn't approve of his manner.

defs.def_en: If you approve of someone or something, you like and admire them.

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯议会已经通过一项重大经济改革方案。
ext.ext_en: The Russian Parliament has approved a program of radical economic reforms...

ext.ext_cn: 议员们以97票的多数票通过了该议案。
ext.ext_en: MPs approved the Bill by a majority of 97.

defs.def_en: If someone in a position of authority approves a plan or idea, they formally agree to it and say that it can happen.

ext.ext_cn: 我们总共有3家获有机农产品协会认可的供货商。
ext.ext_en: We have three suppliers in all who are approved by the Organic Farm Food Association.

defs.def_en: If a product or person is approved by an official organization, they are declared to be of a good enough standard to be used or employed.

defs.def_cn: 极力结交上流社会;高攀名流;攀龙附凤

ext.ext_cn: 所有那些削尖脑袋向上爬的可耻行径！
ext.ext_en: All that vulgar social-climbing!

ext.ext_cn: 勒罗伊野心勃勃、一心攀龙附凤的妻子
ext.ext_en: ...Leroy's ambitious social-climbing wife.

defs.def_en: You describe someone's behaviour as social climbing when they try to get accepted into a higher social class by becoming friendly with people who belong to that class.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人生气的；让人极为沮丧的；使人极其恼火的

ext.ext_cn: 在元月促销期间购物可能会让人大为恼火。
ext.ext_en: Shopping in the January sales can be  maddening...

ext.ext_cn: 客观来说，这部传记很是令人气愤。
ext.ext_en: It is, in its way, a maddening biography.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as maddening, you mean that it makes you feel angry, irritated, or frustrated.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这份感情对我很重要，失去它让我感到悲伤而又空虚。
ext.ext_en: The relationship had been important to me and its loss left me feeling sad and empty...

ext.ext_cn: 朱莉的婚姻濒临破裂，我为此感到难过。
ext.ext_en: I'm sad that Julie's marriage is on the verge of splitting up...

defs.def_en: If you are sad, you feel unhappy, usually because something has happened that you do not like.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (故事、消息)凄惨的,可悲的,令人难过的

ext.ext_cn: 极其幽默诙谐又令人无比感伤的小说
ext.ext_en: ...a desperately humorous, impossibly sad novel...

ext.ext_cn: 我得知了这个不幸的消息，说他在一场摩托车事故中丧生。
ext.ext_en: I received the sad news that he had been killed in a motorcycle accident.

defs.def_en: Sad stories and sad news make you feel sad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (事件、境况)不幸的,令人遗憾的

ext.ext_cn: 不幸的事实是，儿童是被动吸烟的最大受害者。
ext.ext_en: It's a sad truth that children are the biggest victims of passive smoking.

defs.def_en: A sad event or situation is unfortunate or undesirable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 把吉姆·莫里森奉作神明的一些荒唐可悲的摩托车老手和年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...sad old bikers and youngsters who think that Jim Morrison is God.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as sad, you do not have any respect for them and think their behaviour or ideas are ridiculous.

ext.ext_cn: 一个受酒瘾折磨的酗酒者怎样才能进入这样一家医院呢？很遗憾，这种医院并不多。
ext.ext_en: How does a suffering alcoholic get into one of these hospitals? Sad to say, there are not very many of them around...

ext.ext_cn: 很遗憾，他在五六年前去世了。
ext.ext_en: He died five or six years ago I'm sad to say.

defs.def_en: You can use the expression sad to say when you are describing an situation which you find unfortunate.

ext.ext_cn: 减轻爆炸威力的种种方法
ext.ext_en: ...ways of mitigating the effects of an explosion...

ext.ext_cn: 由于悉尼提供补助金，所以到那里的花费就减少了。
ext.ext_en: The cost of getting there is mitigated by Sydney's offer of a subsidy.

defs.def_en: To mitigate something means to make it less unpleasant, serious, or painful.

defs.def_cn: (建筑中)组合的，组件的，模件的

ext.ext_cn: 最后他们购买了一幢建在两英亩土地上的预制组合式房屋。
ext.ext_en: They ended up buying a prebuilt modular home on a two-acre lot.

defs.def_en: In building, modular means relating to the construction of buildings in parts called modules.

defs.def_cn: (大学课程教学)单元的，分单元的

ext.ext_cn: 该课程在结构上以单元划分。
ext.ext_en: The course is modular in structure.

defs.def_en: Modular means relating to the teaching of courses at college or university in units called modules.

defs.def_cn: 事件;（尤指）特殊事件，重大事件

ext.ext_cn: “黑色星期三”事件
ext.ext_en: ...the events of Black Wednesday...

ext.ext_cn: 紧随欧洲最近发生的大事之后
ext.ext_en: ...in the wake of recent events in Europe...

defs.def_en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important. You can use events to describe all the things that are happening in a particular situation.

defs.def_cn: （社交聚会、体育比赛等有计划、有组织的）活动

ext.ext_cn: 3日比赛中的越野项目昨天在这里举行。
ext.ext_en: The cross-country section of the three-day event was held here yesterday.

ext.ext_cn: 重大体育赛事
ext.ext_en: ...major sporting events.

defs.def_en: An event is a planned and organized occasion, for example a social gathering or a sports match.

ext.ext_cn: 上午10点，一位风笛独奏家揭开了阿伯丁高地运动会的序幕，下午1点主要比赛项目开始。
ext.ext_en: A solo piper opens Aberdeen Highland Games at 10am and the main events start at 1pm.

defs.def_en: An event is one of the races or competitions that are part of an organized occasion such as a sports meeting.

defs.def_cn: 万一发生…；如果是那样子的话；假若…

ext.ext_cn: 万一出现错误——虽然这种几率微乎其微，银行同意立即退款。
ext.ext_en: The bank has agreed to give an immediate refund in the unlikely event of an error being made...

ext.ext_cn: 万一交易的某一部分受阻，其他部分将继续进行。
ext.ext_en: In the event that any part of the deal may be blocked, the rest would go ahead.

defs.def_en: You use in the event of ,in the event that, and in that event when you are talking about a possible future situation, especially when you are planning what to do if it occurs.

ext.ext_cn: 无论如何，那个保龄球场的餐厅证明还是很不错的。
ext.ext_en: In any event, the bowling alley restaurant proved quite acceptable.

defs.def_en: You say in any event after you have been discussing a situation, in order to indicate that what you are saying is true or possible, in spite of anything that has happened or may happen.

ext.ext_cn: “别低估了我们，”诺曼·威利斯去年警告说。结果，什么事也没有。
ext.ext_en: 'Don't underestimate us', Norman Willis warned last year. There was, in the event, little danger of that.

defs.def_en: You say in the event after you have been discussing what could have happened in a particular situation, in order to indicate that you are now describing what actually did happen.

ext.ext_cn: 7%的银行基准利率太高了。
ext.ext_en: Bank base rates of 7 per cent are too high.

defs.def_en: In Britain, the base rate is the rate of interest that banks use as a basis when they are calculating the rates that they charge on loans.
If you say that someone is arsing around or arsing about, you mean that they are behaving in a silly, irritating way instead of getting something done.
A hideout is a place where someone goes secretly because they do not want anyone to find them, for example if they are running away from the police.

defs.def_cn: 块茎（某种植物隆起的地下茎）
defs.def_en: A tuber is the swollen underground stem of particular types of plants.

ext.ext_cn: 外国银行账户不在英国警方的管辖权限之内。
ext.ext_en: The British police have no jurisdiction over foreign bank accounts.

defs.def_en: Jurisdiction is the power that a court of law or an official has to carry out legal judgments or to enforce laws.
A jurisdiction is a state or other area in which a particular court and system of laws has authority.

ext.ext_cn: 我带她去看顺势疗法医师，那位医生首先花了很长时间详细记录她的病史。
ext.ext_en: I took her to a homoeopath, who started by taking a very long and detailed case history.

defs.def_en: A person's case history is the record of past events or problems that have affected them, especially their medical history.

ext.ext_cn: 这种葡萄酒卖这个价真是很便宜。
ext.ext_en: At this price the wine is a bargain...

ext.ext_cn: 这周超市的新鲜鲑鱼特价销售。
ext.ext_en: Fresh salmon is a bargain at the supermarket this week.

defs.def_en: Something that is a bargain is good value for money, usually because it has been sold at a lower price than normal.

ext.ext_cn: 我们说定了，如果你能把马修也邀请来的话我就做东。
ext.ext_en: I'll make a bargain with you. I'll play hostess if you'll include Matthew in your guest-list...

ext.ext_cn: 这个条约是以法国和德国政府之间的一个协议为基础的。
ext.ext_en: The treaty was based on a bargain between the French and German governments.

defs.def_en: A bargain is an agreement, especially a formal business agreement, in which two people or groups agree what each of them will do, pay, or receive.

defs.def_cn: 商谈；交涉；谈判；讨价还价

ext.ext_cn: 在现款方面，他们更愿意同散户打交道。
ext.ext_en: They prefer to bargain with individual clients, for cash...

ext.ext_cn: 在当地的小店购物，不要害怕砍价。
ext.ext_en: Shop in small local markets and don't be afraid to bargain.

defs.def_en: When people bargain with each other, they discuss what each of them will do, pay, or receive.

defs.def_cn: 极力讨价还价；提出苛刻的交易条件

ext.ext_cn: 在讲价方面颇有名气的律师事务所
ext.ext_en: ...a law firm with a reputation for driving a hard bargain.

defs.def_en: If people drive a hard bargain, they argue with determination in order to achieve a deal which is favourable to themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 这种机器既省力，又能保持工作台面的整洁。
ext.ext_en: This machine is designed to save you effort, and keep your work surfaces tidy into the bargain...

ext.ext_cn: 她很有钱。现在你又说她还是个美女。
ext.ext_en: She is rich. Now you say she is a beauty into the bargain.

defs.def_en: You use into the bargain when mentioning an additional quantity, feature, fact, or action, to emphasize the fact that it is also involved. You can also say in the bargain in American English.

ext.ext_cn: 别跟这个独裁者打交道，他不会信守诺言的。
ext.ext_en: Dealing with this dictator wasn't an option. He wouldn't have kept his side of the bargain.

defs.def_en: If you keep your side of the bargain, you do what you have promised or arranged to do.

ext.ext_cn: 这种威士忌是在1926年通过蒸馏提取的，尔后静置到 1987年才酿熟。
ext.ext_en: The whisky had been distilled in 1926 and sat quietly maturing until 1987...

ext.ext_cn: 沼泽地的水不能饮用，但是可以将它蒸馏净化。
ext.ext_en: You can't actually drink the water from the marshland. But you can distil it...

defs.def_en: If a liquid such as whisky or water is distilled, it is heated until it changes into steam or vapour and then cooled until it becomes liquid again. This is usually done in order to make it pure.

ext.ext_cn: 油是从这种小树的浆果中提炼出来的。
ext.ext_en: The oil is distilled from the berries of this small tree.

ext.ext_cn: 提取玫瑰花瓣精油的技巧
ext.ext_en: ...the art of distilling rose petals...

defs.def_en: If an oil or liquid is distilled from a plant, it is produced by a process which extracts the most essential part of the plant. To distil a plant means to produce an oil or liquid from it by this process.

defs.def_cn: 精炼，浓缩（想法等）;吸收…为一部分

ext.ext_cn: 述评是从先前刊登在主要专栏的文章中提炼出来的。
ext.ext_en: Reviews are distilled from articles previously published in the main column...

ext.ext_cn: 最后激情融入了美丽宜人的夜色中。
ext.ext_en: Eventually passion was distilled into the natural beauty of a balmy night...

defs.def_en: If a thought or idea is distilled from previous thoughts, ideas, or experiences, it comes from them. If it is distilled into something, it becomes part of that thing.

defs.def_cn: 乌托邦；理想国；理想的完美社会

ext.ext_cn: 我们并不是要设计一个现代乌托邦。
ext.ext_en: We weren't out to design a contemporary utopia.

ext.ext_cn: 寻找理想国的作家
ext.ext_en: ...the writer in search of utopia.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an imaginary situation as a utopia, you mean that it is one in which society is perfect and everyone is happy, but which you feel is not possible.

defs.def_cn: 魅力男子;（女人心中的）大众情人，万人迷
defs.def_en: If you describe a man as a heart-throb, you mean that he is physically very attractive, so that a lot of women fall in love with him.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 容易卖出的;适销的;有销路的

ext.ext_cn: 乐施商店靠出售一些人们定期捐赠的适销物品维持经营。
ext.ext_en: The Oxfam shops depend on regular supplies of saleable items.

defs.def_en: Something that is saleable is easy to sell to people.

defs.def_cn: （物理、化学和地质学等）自然科学

ext.ext_cn: 对自然科学和物理科学兴致大增
ext.ext_en: ...the rapid growth of interest in both the natural and physical sciences.

defs.def_en: The physical sciences are branches of science such as physics, chemistry, and geology that are concerned with natural forces and with things that do not have life.
Necromancy is magic that some people believe brings a dead person back to this world so that you can talk to them.
An angler is someone who fishes with a fishing rod as a hobby.

ext.ext_cn: 斯特拉思克莱德区委员会宣布本区为无核区。
ext.ext_en: Strathclyde council has declared itself a nuclear-free zone.

ext.ext_cn: 朝鲜半岛无核化建议
ext.ext_en: ...proposals for a nuclear-free Korean peninsular.

defs.def_en: A nuclear-free place is a place where nuclear energy or nuclear weapons are forbidden.

defs.def_cn: 头脑清醒的；理智的；脚踏实地的

ext.ext_cn: 是家人和老友帮助我始终做到脚踏实地。
ext.ext_en: Family and old friends help me stay grounded.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is grounded, you mean that they are sensible and reasonable, and that they understand the importance of ordinary things in life.

defs.def_cn: 匿名的;无名的;不知名的

ext.ext_cn: 你愿意的话可以不透露姓名。
ext.ext_en: You can remain anonymous if you wish...

ext.ext_cn: 一个匿名捐助者施以援手提供了奖金。
ext.ext_en: An anonymous benefactor stepped in to provide the prize money.

defs.def_en: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

ext.ext_cn: 当然，那必须通过不记名投票的方式。
ext.ext_en: Of course, that would have to be by anonymous vote.

defs.def_en: Something that is anonymous does not reveal who you are.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 华盛顿西北部最无特色的地区
ext.ext_en: ...the most anonymous part of north-west Washington...

ext.ext_cn: 呆在家里比呆在单调乏味的度假别墅里要惬意得多。
ext.ext_en: It's nice to stay in a home rather than in an anonymous holiday villa.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as anonymous, you dislike it because it has no unusual or interesting features and seems unwelcoming.

ext.ext_cn: 那些冷血杀手那时已经将他们的尸体拖到楼上浴室里。
ext.ext_en: Their cold-blooded killers had then dragged their lifeless bodies upstairs to the bathroom...

ext.ext_cn: 没有呼吸，也没有脉搏，他已经死了。
ext.ext_en: There was no breathing or pulse and he was lifeless.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal is lifeless, they are dead, or are so still that they appear to be dead.

ext.ext_cn: 它由石膏制成，坚硬苍白，毫无生命，与人的肌体没有任何相似之处。
ext.ext_en: It was made of plaster, hard and white and lifeless, bearing no resemblance to human flesh.

defs.def_en: If you describe an object or a machine as lifeless, you mean that they are not living things, even though they may resemble living things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 干燥的石墙看起来也许荒凉且毫无生机，但它们为动植物提供了宝贵的栖息地。
ext.ext_en: Dry stone walls may appear stark and lifeless, but they provide a valuable habitat for plants and animals.

defs.def_en: A lifeless place or area does not have anything living or growing there at all.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无生气的；沉闷的；单调的

ext.ext_cn: 他的小说都是些肤浅沉闷的玩意儿，只有一本除外。
ext.ext_en: With one exception his novels are shallow and lifeless things.

ext.ext_cn: 一位老妇人的毫无生气的画像
ext.ext_en: ...a lifeless portrait of an elderly woman.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person, or something such as an artistic performance or a town as lifeless, you mean they lack any lively or exciting qualities.

ext.ext_cn: 我从来没犯过罪。
ext.ext_en: I have never committed any crime...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个杀人犯。
ext.ext_en: This is a man who has committed murder.

defs.def_en: If someone commits a crime or a sin, they do something illegal or bad.

ext.ext_cn: 有未经证实的报道说他曾企图自杀。
ext.ext_en: There are unconfirmed reports he tried to commit suicide.

defs.def_en: If someone commits suicide, they deliberately kill themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 他们呼吁西方国家向极端贫困国家投入更多的钱。
ext.ext_en: They called on Western nations to commit more money to the poorest nations...

ext.ext_cn: 政府已经给一个旨在减少酸雨的方案拨了几十亿英镑。
ext.ext_en: The government had committed billions of pounds for a programme to reduce acid rain...

defs.def_en: If you commit money or resources to something, you decide to use them for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 我建议大家慎重考虑一下答应周日工作的问题。
ext.ext_en: I would advise people to think very carefully about committing themselves to working Sundays...

ext.ext_cn: 我希望拥有一份能进一步发展的友谊，但又不想太快作出承诺。
ext.ext_en: I'd like a friendship that might lead to something deeper, but I wouldn't want to commit myself too soon...

defs.def_en: If you commit yourself to something, you say that you will definitely do it. If you commit yourself to someone, you decide that you want to have a long-term relationship with them.

ext.ext_cn: 对这样一个微妙的问题明确表态并非他们的外交风格。
ext.ext_en: It isn't their diplomatic style to commit themselves on such a delicate issue...

ext.ext_cn: 不管怎样，她都不想明确表态。
ext.ext_en: She didn't want to commit herself one way or the other.

defs.def_en: If you do not want to commit yourself on something, you do not want to say what you really think about it or what you are going to do.

defs.def_cn: 把…正式送进(医院、监狱等)

ext.ext_cn: 阿瑟由于酗酒被送进一家精神病医院。
ext.ext_en: Arthur's drinking caused him to be committed to a psychiatric hospital.

defs.def_en: If someone is committed to a hospital, prison, or other institution, they are officially sent there for a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 预计他会被移交利物浦高等刑事法庭。
ext.ext_en: He is expected to be committed for trial at Liverpool Crown Court.

defs.def_en: In the British legal system, if someone is committed for trial, they are sent by magistrates to stand trial in a crown court.

ext.ext_cn: 关于这件事她未曾写下只言片语。
ext.ext_en: She had not committed anything to paper about it...

ext.ext_cn: 我会重复一下，好让你们记住。
ext.ext_en: I'll repeat that so you can commit it to memory.

defs.def_en: If you commit something to paper or to writing, you record it by writing it down. If you commit something to memory, you learn it so that you will remember it.

defs.def_cn: 偷偷地走近;偷偷地挨近

ext.ext_cn: 你敲门的时候，我设法悄悄靠近了他。
ext.ext_en: I managed to sneak up on him when you knocked on the door.

defs.def_en: If someone sneaks up on you, they try and approach you without being seen or heard, perhaps to surprise you or do you harm.

defs.def_cn: 突然降临;出其不意地发生

ext.ext_cn: 有些时候，我们期待的事情会不期而至。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes our expectations sneak up on us unawares.

defs.def_en: If something sneaks up on you, it happens or occurs when you are not expecting it.

defs.def_cn: (食物、饮料、空气等的)摄取量,吸入量

ext.ext_cn: 每天的饮酒量不应超过两个计量单位。
ext.ext_en: Your intake of alcohol should not exceed two units per day...

ext.ext_cn: 减少盐的摄入量。
ext.ext_en: Reduce your salt intake.

defs.def_en: Your intake of a particular kind of food, drink, or air is the amount that you eat, drink, or breathe in.

defs.def_cn: (组织或地方的)新纳入者，新招收者

ext.ext_cn: 今年新招学生中的一个
ext.ext_en: ...one of this year's intake of students...

ext.ext_cn: 在美国有提案建议把每年移民的接收数量增加3倍。
ext.ext_en: There was a proposal in the United States to quadruple its annual intake of immigrants.

defs.def_en: The people who are accepted into an organization or place at a particular time are referred to as a particular intake .

defs.def_cn: (通常因震惊而)倒吸的一口冷气

ext.ext_cn: 即便人声鼎沸,我还是听到有人猛地倒抽一口冷气。
ext.ext_en: I heard, even over the babble of the crowd, a sharp, shocked intake of breath.

defs.def_en: When someone takes an intake of breath, they breathe in quickly and noisily, usually because they are shocked at something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 年龄越大，世界对我而言就变得越陌生、越难理解。
ext.ext_en: The older I grow, the stranger and less explicable the world appears to me.

defs.def_en: If something is explicable, it can be explained and understood because it is logical or sensible.

ext.ext_cn: 她心爱的两只猫
ext.ext_en: ...her two beloved cats.

ext.ext_cn: 几个问题
ext.ext_en: ...a few problems.

defs.def_en: -s or -es is added to a noun to form a plural.

defs.def_cn: (用于动词后构成第三人称单数现在时形式)

ext.ext_cn: 他从来没想过这个问题。
ext.ext_en: He never thinks about it...

ext.ext_cn: 她喜欢自己的工作。
ext.ext_en: She likes her job...

defs.def_en: -s or -es is added to a verb to form the third person singular, present tense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他粗硬的红头发根根直立。
ext.ext_en: His bristly red hair was standing on end.

defs.def_en: Bristly hair is thick and rough.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那个巨人胡须浓密的面颊
ext.ext_en: ...the giant's bristly cheek.

defs.def_en: If a man's chin is bristly, it is covered with bristles because he has not shaved recently.

defs.def_cn: (业余时间接受军训的)英国国防义勇军
defs.def_en: The Territorial Army is a British armed force whose members are not professional soldiers but train as soldiers in their spare time.

defs.def_cn: 电影编剧;广播(或电视)节目的撰稿人
defs.def_en: A scriptwriter is a person who writes scripts for films or for radio or television programmes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的脸像老人一样布满皱纹。
ext.ext_en: His lined face was that of an old man.

defs.def_en: If someone's face or skin is lined, it has lines on it as a result of old age, tiredness, worry, or illness.
Lined paper has lines printed across it to help you write neatly.
A briefcase is a case used for carrying documents in.

defs.def_cn: 女诗人（大多数女诗人更愿意被称作poet）
defs.def_en: A poetess is a female poet. Most female poets prefer to be called poets.
A grandstand is a covered stand with rows of seats for people to sit on at sporting events.

defs.def_cn: （表示吃惊、企盼、高兴或不快）嗬

ext.ext_cn: “嗬，天哪！那评论有点种族歧视，不是吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'Ooh dear me, that's a bit of a racist comment isn't it.'...

ext.ext_cn: “红色？嗬，真不错。”
ext.ext_en: 'Red? Ooh how nice.'

defs.def_en: People say 'ooh' when they are surprised, looking forward to something, or find something pleasant or unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他长着窄长的鹰钩鼻和深陷的褐色眼睛。
ext.ext_en: He had a thin aquiline nose and deep-set brown eyes.

defs.def_en: If someone has an aquiline nose or profile, their nose is large, thin, and usually curved.

ext.ext_cn: “又下起雨来了。”——“这丝毫不影响景色的美丽。”
ext.ext_en: 'It's starting to rain again.' — 'Not enough to take away from the charm of the scene.'...

ext.ext_cn: 胜利只是表面的，可这丝毫无损于战斗部队的勇气和技术。
ext.ext_en: The victory looks rather hollow. That takes nothing away from the courage and skill of the fighting forces.

defs.def_en: If something takes away from an achievement, success, or quality, or takes something away from it, it makes it seem lower in value or worth than it should be.

ext.ext_cn: 他习惯早起，7点钟就坐在桌前吃早餐。
ext.ext_en: He was an early riser and he would be at the breakfast table at seven.

defs.def_en: An early riser is someone who likes to get up early in the morning. A late riser is someone who likes to get up late.
A riser is the flat vertical part of a step or a stair.

ext.ext_cn: 棕色马海毛套裙
ext.ext_en: ...a brown mohair dress.

defs.def_en: Mohair is a type of very soft wool.
A baguette is a type of long, thin, white bread which is traditionally made in France.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自我谦避的;不求闻达的

ext.ext_cn: 作为女性我们往往不喜夸耀，对自己获得的成功轻描淡写。
ext.ext_en: As women we tend to be self-effacing and make light of what we have achieved.

ext.ext_cn: 许多外交官所持的那种稍稍自我谦避的态度
ext.ext_en: ...the slightly self-effacing manner adopted by many diplomats.

defs.def_en: Someone who is self-effacing does not like talking about themselves or drawing attention to themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 种族不和
ext.ext_en: ...racial disharmony.

defs.def_en: When there is disharmony, people disagree about important things and this causes an unpleasant atmosphere.

defs.def_cn: 牡蛎繁殖地；牡蛎养殖场
defs.def_en: An oyster bed is a place where oysters breed and grow naturally or are kept for food or pearls.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 引人捧腹大笑的;滑稽的;极有趣的

ext.ext_cn: 我们第一次听说此事时，觉得很好笑。
ext.ext_en: We thought it was hilarious when we first heard about it...

ext.ext_cn: 关于这个话题他有说不完的趣事。
ext.ext_en: He had a fund of hilarious tales on the subject.

defs.def_en: If something is hilarious, it is extremely funny and makes you laugh a lot.

ext.ext_cn: 将豆子浸泡 2 小时。
ext.ext_en: Soak the beans for 2 hours...

ext.ext_cn: 他关上水龙头，让盘子浸泡在水中。
ext.ext_en: He turned off the water and left the dishes to soak.

defs.def_en: If you soak something or leave it to soak, you put it into a liquid and leave it there.

ext.ext_cn: 水浸湿了他的夹克和衬衫。
ext.ext_en: The water had soaked his jacket and shirt...

ext.ext_cn: 用至少 4 加仑的水浸湿每株灌木周围的土。
ext.ext_en: Soak the soil around each bush with at least 4 gallons of water.

defs.def_en: If a liquid soaks something or if you soak something with a liquid, the liquid makes the thing very wet.

ext.ext_cn: 血流得太多，渗透了我的平脚短裤。
ext.ext_en: There was so much blood it had soaked through my boxer shorts...

ext.ext_cn: 雨水渗入了沙地。
ext.ext_en: Rain had soaked into the sand.

defs.def_en: If a liquid soaks through something, it passes through it.

ext.ext_cn: 我需要在热腾腾的澡盆里好好地泡一泡。
ext.ext_en: What I need is to soak in a hot tub.

ext.ext_cn: 我在浴缸里泡了很长时间。
ext.ext_en: I was having a long soak in the bath.

defs.def_en: If someone soaks, they spend a long time in a hot bath, because they enjoy it.

ext.ext_cn: 新的剧院和艺术中心突然在全国各地涌现出来。
ext.ext_en: New theatres and arts centres sprang up all over the country.

defs.def_en: If something springs up, it suddenly appears or begins to exist.

ext.ext_cn: 他们会回到自己部族的地盘上。
ext.ext_en: They would go back to their tribal lands.

ext.ext_cn: 他们古老部落风俗的丰富遗产
ext.ext_en: …their rich heritage of ancient tribal customs.

defs.def_en: Tribal is used to describe things relating to or belonging to tribes and the way that they are organized.

defs.def_cn: 可放在衣袋中携带的；小型的；袖珍的

ext.ext_cn: 方便的袖珍参考书
ext.ext_en: ...a handy pocket-sized reference book.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as pocket-sized, you approve of it because it is small enough to fit in your pocket.

defs.def_cn: （使）变形;（使）成畸形;损毁…的外形

ext.ext_cn: 严重的类风湿性关节炎会造成四肢变形。
ext.ext_en: Bad rheumatoid arthritis deforms limbs...

ext.ext_cn: 金属重新塑形而不断裂的能力
ext.ext_en: ...the ability of a metal to deform to a new shape without cracking.

defs.def_en: If something deforms a person's body or something else, it causes it to have an unnatural shape. In technical English, you can also say that the second thing deforms.

ext.ext_cn: 我严重中暑，又饿又累。
ext.ext_en: I was suffering from acute sunstroke, starvation and exhaustion.

defs.def_en: Sunstroke is an illness caused by spending too much time in hot sunshine.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 两人在修理东西上都有一手绝活。
ext.ext_en: Both are blessed with uncommon ability to fix things.

ext.ext_cn: 非常富有的医生家的公子
ext.ext_en: ...the son of a doctor and well blessed with money.

defs.def_en: If someone is blessed with a particular good quality or skill, they have that good quality or skill.

defs.def_cn: 令人快乐的；可喜的；美好的

ext.ext_cn: 一个健康活泼的婴儿的出生真是一件可喜的事情。
ext.ext_en: The birth of a live healthy baby is a truly blessed event...

ext.ext_cn: 雨天会给枯草热患者带来欣喜，减轻他们的痛苦。
ext.ext_en: Rainy weather brings blessed relief to hay fever victims.

defs.def_en: You use blessed to describe something that you think is wonderful, and that you are grateful for or relieved about.

defs.def_cn: （强调生气）该死的，倒霉的，讨厌的

ext.ext_cn: 竟然没有一个人了解点儿情况。
ext.ext_en: No-one knows a blessed thing.

defs.def_en: Some people use blessed to emphasize that they are annoyed about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 向总统开枪的一个心理不正常的人
ext.ext_en: ...a twisted man who shot at the president...

ext.ext_cn: 那封信非常清楚地表明了一个变态者的思维方式。
ext.ext_en: The letter showed horribly clearly the workings of a twisted mind.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as twisted, you dislike them because you think they are strange in an unpleasant way.
A policewoman is a woman who is a member of the police force.

ext.ext_cn: 40 %以上的英国成年人把电视当作获取艺术文化信息的主要途径。
ext.ext_en: ...over 40 per cent of British adults use television as their major source of information about the arts...

ext.ext_cn: 必须在可行的地方使用可再生能源。
ext.ext_en: Renewable sources of energy must be used where practical...

defs.def_en: The source of something is the person, place, or thing which you get it from.

defs.def_cn: 寻找(产品或原料的)货源

ext.ext_cn: 他们一道走遍世界各地，为那家私营小公司寻觅服装货源。
ext.ext_en: Together they travel the world, sourcing clothes for the small, privately owned company...

ext.ext_cn: 一辆普通汽车上大约有60%的部件是由制造商以外的其他供应商提供的。
ext.ext_en: About 60 per cent of an average car is sourced from outside of the manufacturer.

defs.def_en: In business, if a person or firm sources a product or a raw material, they find someone who will supply it.

defs.def_cn: 消息来源;消息人士;(论文中引文的)出处，原始资料

ext.ext_cn: 军方称这艘船当时正高速向南行进。
ext.ext_en: Military sources say the boat was heading south at high speed...

ext.ext_cn: 她对二手资料和一手资料的引用毫无区别。
ext.ext_en: She quotes secondary and primary sources without distinction.

defs.def_en: A source is a person or book that provides information for a news story or for a piece of research.

ext.ext_cn: 这件事给我提供了找出问题根源的线索。
ext.ext_en: This gave me a clue as to the source of the problem.

defs.def_en: The source of a difficulty is its cause.

ext.ext_cn: 台伯河的源头
ext.ext_en: ...the source of the Tiber.

defs.def_en: The source of a river or stream is the place where it begins.

defs.def_cn: （打开匣盖玩偶即可跳出的）玩偶匣
defs.def_en: A jack-in-the-box is a child's toy that consists of a box with a doll inside it that jumps out when the lid is opened.
Diesel or diesel oil is the heavy oil used in a diesel engine.
A diesel is a vehicle which has a diesel engine.

ext.ext_cn: 在闷热的隧道里挥舞着丁字镐干活的一个肤色黝黑的年轻挖土工
ext.ext_en: ...a blackened young navvy, swinging a pickaxe in the sweating tunnel.

defs.def_en: A navvy is a person who is employed to do hard physical work, for example building roads or canals.

ext.ext_cn: 他设法与两个共和国都达成了部分协议。
ext.ext_en: He managed to reach a partial agreement with both republics.

ext.ext_cn: 市内部分地段轿车禁行令
ext.ext_en: ...a partial ban on the use of cars in the city.

defs.def_en: You use partial to refer to something that is not complete or whole.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢爱运动的蓝眼睛女子。
ext.ext_en: He's partial to sporty women with blue eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 莫莉承认她偏爱粉红色。
ext.ext_en: Mollie confesses she is rather partial to pink...

defs.def_en: If you are partial to something, you like it.

ext.ext_cn: 可能会有人骂我偏心。
ext.ext_en: I might be accused of being partial...

ext.ext_cn: 一家报纸批评总统的提议，称该提议偏袒以色列。
ext.ext_en: A newspaper criticized the president's proposal, saying that it was partial to Israel.

defs.def_en: Someone who is partial supports a particular person or thing, for example in a competition or dispute, instead of being completely fair.

defs.def_cn: 同 New Year's Day 或 New Year's Eve
defs.def_en: New Year's is another name for New Year's Day or New Year's Eve .

ext.ext_cn: 他的工作服挂在厨房里的挂钩上。
ext.ext_en: His work jacket hung on the peg in the kitchen.

defs.def_en: A peg is a small hook or knob that is attached to a wall or door and is used for hanging things on.
A peg is a small device which you use to fasten clothes to a washing line.

ext.ext_cn: 他用木楔子取代钉子制作家具。
ext.ext_en: He builds furniture using wooden pegs instead of nails.

ext.ext_cn: 锤子敲击钢栓的噪音
ext.ext_en: ...the noise of the hammer striking the steel pegs.

defs.def_en: A peg is a small piece of wood or metal that is used for fastening something to something else.

defs.def_cn: 用销钉（或楔子、木栓）固定

ext.ext_cn: 大风天试图用衣夹把双人床单固定在晾衣绳上
ext.ext_en: ...trying to peg a double sheet on a washing line on a blustery day...

ext.ext_cn: 用销钉在顶上加固防护网，防止叶子落入。
ext.ext_en: Peg down netting over the top to keep out leaves.

defs.def_en: If you peg something somewhere or peg it down, you fix it there with pegs.

defs.def_cn: 限定（价格、数量等）；把…固定在一定水平；使与…挂钩

ext.ext_cn: 其货币与美元挂钩。
ext.ext_en: Its currency is pegged to the dollar...

ext.ext_cn: 英国的贸易利润固定在4,000万英镑。
ext.ext_en: UK trading profits were pegged at £40 million...

defs.def_en: See also:level-pegging;If a price or amount of something is pegged at a particular level, it is fixed at that level.

ext.ext_cn: 我们认为是时候煞煞他们的嚣张气焰了。
ext.ext_en: We thought it was time they were brought down a peg or two...

ext.ext_cn: 我们乐意看到她杀威风，但不是用这种方法。
ext.ext_en: We'd have liked to see her taken down a peg, but not this way.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone should be brought down a peg or be taken down a peg, you mean that they should be made to realize that they are not so important or wonderful as they think they are.

ext.ext_cn: 两件套西服成衣
ext.ext_en: ...an off-the-peg two-piece suit...

ext.ext_cn: 比起穿着昂贵的套装到高档饭店吃饭，他更喜欢吃汉堡、买成衣。
ext.ext_en: Instead of dining in top restaurants and wearing expensive suits, he likes to eat hamburgers and buys clothes off the peg.

defs.def_en: Off-the-peg clothes are made in large numbers and sent to shops, not made specially for a particular person.

ext.ext_cn: 泰勒明显不适合做这项工作——简直就是方枘圆凿。
ext.ext_en: Taylor is clearly the wrong man for the job — a square peg in a round hole.
