defs.def_cn: (目视他人使其遭殃的)恶毒目光;邪眼
defs.def_en: Some people believe that the evil eye is a magical power to cast a spell on someone or something by looking at them, so that bad things happen to them.

defs.def_cn: 不悦的眼光;忌妒的眼神

ext.ext_cn: 我们出去时，女孩子们总是用忌妒的眼神看着我。
ext.ext_en: When we go out, girls are always giving me the evil eye.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you the evil eye, they look at you in an unpleasant way, usually because they dislike you or are jealous of you.

defs.def_cn: （伸展到另一地区的）狭长土地，锅柄状地区

ext.ext_cn: 得克萨斯州的锅柄状地区
ext.ext_en: ...the Texas panhandle.

defs.def_en: A panhandle is a narrow strip of land joined to a larger area of land.

ext.ext_cn: 这些无家可归者很多似乎都靠街头行乞或者干零工养活自己。
ext.ext_en: Many of these street people seemed to support themselves by panhandling and doing odd jobs...

ext.ext_cn: 还有一个沿街乞讨的家伙。
ext.ext_en: There was also a guy panhandling for quarters.

defs.def_en: If someone panhandles, they stop people in the street and ask them for food or money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 轻微罪行正对社区生活产生有害影响。
ext.ext_en: Petty crime is having a deleterious effect on community life.

defs.def_en: Something that has a deleterious effect on something has a harmful effect on it.
Penicillin is a drug that kills bacteria and is used to treat infections.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （系统、机构等）超负荷运转的，硬撑着的

ext.ext_cn: 当前的犯罪率急剧上升，警力不堪重负。
ext.ext_en: The crime rate is rising rapidly at present and the police force is overstretched...

ext.ext_cn: 分析人士担心超负荷运转的空中交通管制系统会面临崩溃。
ext.ext_en: Analysts fear the overstretched air traffic control system could reach breaking point.

defs.def_en: If a system or organization is overstretched, it is being forced to work more than it is supposed to.

defs.def_cn: 最小的;极少的;最低限度的

ext.ext_cn: 双方的合作是最低限度的。
ext.ext_en: The co-operation between the two is minimal...

ext.ext_cn: 这些改革的目的之一就是以最低成本实现有效的防御。
ext.ext_en: One aim of these reforms is effective defence with minimal expenditure.

defs.def_en: Something that is minimal is very small in quantity, value, or degree.

ext.ext_cn: 用婴儿车推着宝宝的年轻妈妈
ext.ext_en: ...young mums with infants in prams...

ext.ext_cn: 那家人被迫带着他们尚在襁褓中的儿子逃走了。
ext.ext_en: The family were forced to flee with their infant son.

defs.def_en: An infant is a baby or very young child.

ext.ext_cn: 自从我们上幼儿园起，你就是我最好的朋友。
ext.ext_en: You've been my best friend ever since we started in the infants.

ext.ext_cn: 自从我们上幼儿园起，你就是我最好的朋友。
ext.ext_en: You've been my best friend ever since we started in the infants.

defs.def_en: Infants are children between the ages of five and seven, who go to an infant school.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车后部的婴儿座椅
ext.ext_en: ...an infant carrier in the back of a car.

defs.def_en: Infant means designed especially for very young children.

ext.ext_cn: 这家新公司总部在德国。
ext.ext_en: The infant company was based in Germany.

ext.ext_cn: 处于初期阶段的公共医疗卫生服务
ext.ext_en: ...the infant health service.

defs.def_en: An infant organization or system is new and has not developed very much.

ext.ext_cn: 她私生活和公众形象间的冲突
ext.ext_en: ...the contradictions between her private life and the public persona...

ext.ext_cn: 他时常伪装自己。
ext.ext_en: From time to time he will take on a new persona.

defs.def_en: See also:persona non grata;Someone's persona is the aspect of their character or nature that they present to other people, perhaps in contrast to their real character or nature.

defs.def_cn: （不快事情中的）喘息，缓解，暂息

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经好几周没有在炮火中获得任何喘息的机会了。
ext.ext_en: It was some weeks now since they had had any respite from shellfire.

defs.def_en: A respite is a short period of rest from something unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 贬值只能让经济得到暂时的缓解。
ext.ext_en: Devaluation would only give the economy a brief respite.

defs.def_en: A respite is a short delay before a very unpleasant or difficult situation which may or may not take place.
A hormone is a chemical, usually occurring naturally in your body, that makes an organ of your body do something.

defs.def_cn: （浇花园或洗车用的）水管，软管，胶管
defs.def_en: A hosepipe is a hose that people use to water their gardens or wash their cars.
A chaplaincy is the building or office in which a chaplain works.

defs.def_cn: 特遣牧师的职位(或工作)

ext.ext_cn: 皇家医院的牧师职位
ext.ext_en: ...the chaplaincy of the Royal Hospital.

defs.def_en: A chaplaincy is the position or work of a chaplain.

ext.ext_cn: 从那颗恒星上不断吹出恒星风。
ext.ext_en: A stellar wind streams outward from the star.

defs.def_en: Stellar is used to describe anything connected with stars.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 伊顿和牛津的精英教育
ext.ext_en: ...a stellar education at Eton and Oxford...

ext.ext_cn: 法国各家公司都获利丰厚。
ext.ext_en: The French companies are registering stellar profits.

defs.def_en: A stellar person or thing is considered to be very good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 天使般的；善良的；温柔的

ext.ext_cn: 天使般的脸蛋儿
ext.ext_en: ...an angelic face...

ext.ext_cn: 他看上去善良温柔。
ext.ext_en: He looked angelic.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone as angelic if they are, or seem to be, very good, kind, and gentle.

ext.ext_cn: 天籁之音唱诗班
ext.ext_en: ...angelic choirs.

defs.def_en: Angelic means like angels or relating to angels.

defs.def_cn: 基准化分析法，标杆分析法（和业内最大竞争对手进行比较从而提高业绩的方法）
defs.def_en: In business, benchmarking is a process in which a company compares its products and methods with those of the most successful companies in its field, in order to try to improve its own performance.

ext.ext_cn: 现在河床已完全干涸了。
ext.ext_en: Now the river bed is bone dry.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is bone dry, you are emphasizing that it is very dry indeed.

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词后构成另一形容词）表示“…叶的”

ext.ext_cn: 阔叶树
ext.ext_en: ...broad-leaved trees.

ext.ext_cn: 茂密的小叶枫树
ext.ext_en: ...very dense and small-leafed maples.

defs.def_en: -leaved or -leafed combines with adjectives to form other adjectives which describe the type of leaves a tree or plant has.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 温柔的;慈爱的;体贴的;柔软的

ext.ext_cn: 她的声音很温柔，充满了怜爱。
ext.ext_en: Her voice was tender, full of pity...

ext.ext_cn: 病人们可能享受不到以前住院时那种悉心体贴的照顾。
ext.ext_en: Patients may not receive the tender, loving care once associated with a hospital stay.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is tender expresses gentle and caring feelings.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他在7岁的小小年纪就喜欢上了这项运动。
ext.ext_en: He had become attracted to the game at the tender age of seven.

ext.ext_cn: 如此幼小的年纪就失去了父亲
ext.ext_en: ...the loss of her father at such a tender age.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something at a tender age, you mean that they do it when they are still young and have not had much experience.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (肉等食品)软的，嫩的，易咀嚼的

ext.ext_cn: 至少煮两个小时，或一直煮到肉变烂为止。
ext.ext_en: Cook for a minimum of 2 hours, or until the meat is tender.

ext.ext_cn: 幼嫩的四季豆
ext.ext_en: ...tender young dwarf beans.

defs.def_en: Meat or other food that is tender is easy to cut or chew.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （身体部位）敏感的，疼痛的，一碰就疼的

ext.ext_cn: 我的肚子一碰就很疼。
ext.ext_en: My tummy felt very tender...

ext.ext_cn: 用按摩法治疗疼痛部位。
ext.ext_en: Treat any tender points by massaging.

defs.def_en: If part of your body is tender, it is sensitive and painful when it is touched.

ext.ext_cn: 建筑商们将会收到说明书，并被邀请参与该项目投标。
ext.ext_en: Builders will then be sent the specifications and asked to submit a tender for the work...

ext.ext_cn: 现在，有些服务项目必须进行招标。
ext.ext_en: Some services are now compulsorily put out to tender.

defs.def_en: A tender is a formal offer to supply goods or to do a particular job, and a statement of the price that you or your company will charge. If a contract is put out to tender, formal offers are invited. If a company wins a tender, their offer is accepted.

ext.ext_cn: 工作人员不得投标承接私营部门的工作。
ext.ext_en: The staff are forbidden to tender for private-sector work...

ext.ext_cn: 他参与竞标，并赢得了合同。
ext.ext_en: He tendered for and was awarded the contract.

defs.def_en: If a company tenders for something, it makes a formal offer to supply goods or do a job for a particular price.

ext.ext_cn: 她很快递交了辞呈。
ext.ext_en: She quickly tendered her resignation...

ext.ext_cn: 他从外套内兜里掏出钱包，出示了许可证。
ext.ext_en: He took his wallet from his inside coat pocket and tendered the permit.

defs.def_en: If you tender something such as a suggestion, your resignation, or money, you formally offer or present it.
Fossil fuel is fuel such as coal or oil that is formed from the decayed remains of plants or animals.

defs.def_cn: （体育赛事的）冠军保持者;冠军

ext.ext_cn: 卡斯帕罗夫 22 岁时成为最年轻的世界冠军。
ext.ext_en: Kasparov became the youngest world title-holder at 22.

defs.def_en: The title-holder is the person who most recently won a sports competition that is held regularly.

defs.def_cn: （摄像机或摄影机）拉近镜头，进行近景拍摄

ext.ext_cn: 可对入户窃贼在整栋楼里进行跟踪并将其面部图像放大的追踪系统
ext.ext_en: ...a tracking system which can follow a burglar round a building and zoom in on his face...

ext.ext_cn: 他把自己的照相机对准了大自然，时而拉近镜头仔细观察一片片的叶子。
ext.ext_en: He trained his camera on nature, sometimes zooming in to examine single leaves.

defs.def_en: If a camera zooms in on something that is being filmed or photographed, it gives a close-up picture of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们鼓吹能颠覆英国社会结构的政治学说。
ext.ext_en: They propagated political doctrines which promised to tear apart the fabric of British society.

defs.def_en: If people propagate an idea or piece of information, they spread it and try to make people believe it or support it.

ext.ext_cn: 栽培葡萄最简便的方法就是硬条扦插。
ext.ext_en: The easiest way to propagate a vine is to take hardwood cuttings...

ext.ext_cn: 欧白头翁可以通过种子进行繁殖。
ext.ext_en: The pasque flower can be propagated from seed.

defs.def_en: If you propagate plants, you grow more of them from the original ones.

defs.def_cn: (安装在家具底部的)脚轮，滚轮
defs.def_en: Castors are small wheels fitted to a piece of furniture so that it can be moved more easily.

ext.ext_cn: 据估计,每年有50名儿童独自来到英国。
ext.ext_en: It is estimated that every year 50 unaccompanied children arrive in Britain...

ext.ext_cn: 凯利还太小，不能自己一个人去。
ext.ext_en: Kelly's too young to go unaccompanied.

defs.def_en: If someone is unaccompanied, they are alone.

defs.def_cn: （行李、货物等）单独运送的，不随主人同行的

ext.ext_cn: 单独运送的包裹或是遭到搜查，或是被搬走。
ext.ext_en: Unaccompanied bags are either searched or removed.

defs.def_en: Unaccompanied luggage or goods are being sent or transported separately from their owner.

defs.def_cn: 无伴奏的；清唱的；独奏的

ext.ext_cn: 独奏的长笛
ext.ext_en: ...an unaccompanied flute...

ext.ext_cn: 这首歌大部分是在没有伴奏的情况下清唱的。
ext.ext_en: The piece is most often sung unaccompanied.

defs.def_en: An unaccompanied voice or instrument sings or plays alone, with no other instruments playing at the same time.

ext.ext_cn: 使这项任务实现机械化的技术只能逐步发展。
ext.ext_en: Only gradually are technologies being developed to mechanize the task...

ext.ext_cn: 也许这种治疗方法最终将实现机械化。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps, in time, this treatment will be mechanised.

defs.def_en: If someone mechanizes a process, they cause it to be done by a machine or machines, when it was previously done by people.

ext.ext_cn: 马克还在如笼中困兽般踱来踱去。
ext.ext_en: Mark was still pacing like a caged animal.

defs.def_en: A caged bird or animal is inside a cage.

ext.ext_cn: 牧师给死者作安葬准备。
ext.ext_en: The priest prepared the body for burial...

ext.ext_cn: 他会有个体面的葬礼。
ext.ext_en: He can have a decent burial.

defs.def_en: A burial is the act or ceremony of putting a dead body into a grave in the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 问题是，大批的人都失业了。
ext.ext_en: The problem is millions of people are unemployed...

ext.ext_cn: 该研习班会帮助格里姆斯比的失业青年。
ext.ext_en: This workshop helps young unemployed people in Grimsby...

defs.def_en: Someone who is unemployed does not have a job.

defs.def_cn: 折中政策;不彻底的行动

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经宣布要继续战斗，而不是半途而废。
ext.ext_en: They have already declared their intention to fight on rather than settle for half-measures.

defs.def_en: If someone refers to policies or actions as half measures, they are critical of them because they think that they are not forceful enough and are therefore of little value.

defs.def_cn: 辩论家;参加辩论者;辩手

ext.ext_cn: 他们精于辩论。
ext.ext_en: They are skilled debaters.

defs.def_en: A debater is someone who takes part in debates.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人生气的；让人极为沮丧的；使人极其恼火的

ext.ext_cn: 在元月促销期间购物可能会让人大为恼火。
ext.ext_en: Shopping in the January sales can be  maddening...

ext.ext_cn: 客观来说，这部传记很是令人气愤。
ext.ext_en: It is, in its way, a maddening biography.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as maddening, you mean that it makes you feel angry, irritated, or frustrated.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不动感情的；无动于衷的；冷漠的；平静的

ext.ext_cn: 英国男人常被认为是矜持而冷漠的。
ext.ext_en: British men are often seen as being reserved and unemotional...

ext.ext_cn: 她念了起来，语调利落而平静。
ext.ext_en: She began to read in a brisk, unemotional voice...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as unemotional, you mean that they do not show any feelings.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （指人）不关心政治的，对政治不感兴趣的

ext.ext_cn: 作为一个音乐人，你不能不关心政治。
ext.ext_en: As a musician, you cannot be apolitical.

defs.def_en: Someone who is apolitical is not interested in politics.

defs.def_cn: （组织或活动）与政党无关的，不支持任何政党的

ext.ext_cn: 通常不支持任何政党的欧盟委员会
ext.ext_en: ...the normally apolitical European Commission...

ext.ext_cn: 其他人坚称该暴力事件与任何政党无关，行凶者只是意欲反抗权威的一伙人。
ext.ext_en: Others maintain the violence is apolitical and the perpetrators are just gangs bent on defying authority.

defs.def_en: If you describe an organization or an activity as apolitical, you mean that it is not linked to a particular political party.

ext.ext_cn: 星期四上午，政府官员视察地震灾区，以协调救援工作。
ext.ext_en: Government officials visited the earthquake zone on Thursday morning to co-ordinate the relief effort.

ext.ext_cn: 建立咨询委员会以协调警务工作
ext.ext_en: ...the setting up of an advisory committee to co-ordinate police work.

defs.def_en: If you co-ordinate an activity, you organize the various people and things involved in it.

ext.ext_cn: 她会教你如何搭配款式和颜色。
ext.ext_en: She'll show you how to co-ordinate pattern and colours...

ext.ext_cn: 系上与其他装饰相配的布质蝴蝶结。
ext.ext_en: Tie it with fabric bows that co-ordinate with other furnishings...

defs.def_en: If you co-ordinate clothes or furnishings that are used together, or if they co-ordinate, they are similar in some way and look nice together.

ext.ext_cn: 新的内衣套装
ext.ext_en: ...new lingerie co-ordinates.

defs.def_en: Co-ordinates are pieces of clothing or soft furnishings which are similar and which are intended to be worn or used together.

ext.ext_cn: 他们每年都花费几周的时间接受强化治疗，以使四肢能够更好地协调。
ext.ext_en: They spend several weeks each year undergoing intensive treatment which enables them to coordinate their limbs better.

defs.def_en: If you co-ordinate the different parts of your body, you make them work together efficiently to perform particular movements.

ext.ext_cn: 您能告诉我您的坐标吗？
ext.ext_en: Can you give me your co-ordinates?

ext.ext_cn: 世界各地的经纬坐标
ext.ext_en: ...the latitude and longitude co-ordinates of any location in the world.

defs.def_en: The co-ordinates of a point on a map or graph are the two sets of numbers or letters that you need in order to find that point.

defs.def_cn: (因惊讶或疼痛等)尖叫;尖声笑

ext.ext_cn: 她尖叫一声从床上跳了起来。
ext.ext_en: She shrieked and leapt from the bed...

ext.ext_cn: 米兰达尖声大笑。
ext.ext_en: Miranda shrieked with laughter.

defs.def_en: When someone shrieks, they make a short, very loud cry, for example because they are suddenly surprised, are in pain, or are laughing.

ext.ext_cn: “停下！停下！”简尖叫道。
ext.ext_en: 'Stop it! Stop it!' shrieked Jane...

ext.ext_cn: 他一边哭一边尖声咒骂着脏话。
ext.ext_en: He was shrieking obscenities and weeping.

defs.def_en: If you shriek something, you shout it in a loud, high-pitched voice.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人不快的；令人不舒服的

ext.ext_cn: 那些症状可能令人不适，很不舒服甚至会比较严重。
ext.ext_en: The symptoms can be uncomfortable, unpleasant and serious...

ext.ext_cn: 那个真空吸尘器有股很难闻的气味。
ext.ext_en: The vacuum has an unpleasant smell...

defs.def_en: If something is unpleasant, it gives you bad feelings, for example by making you feel upset or uncomfortable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她认为他是个粗鲁的人。
ext.ext_en: She thought him an unpleasant man...

ext.ext_cn: 不要开始给我找麻烦，否则我就不客气了。
ext.ext_en: Don't start giving me problems otherwise I'll have to be very unpleasant indeed.

defs.def_en: An unpleasant person is very unfriendly and rude.

defs.def_cn: (be的第一和第三人称单数过去式）
defs.def_en: Was is the first and third person singular of the past tense of be .

defs.def_cn: (信件、要求、请求等)使应接不暇,使不胜负荷

ext.ext_cn: 她所在的售票处收到铺天盖地的购票请求。
ext.ext_en: Her office was inundated with requests for tickets...

ext.ext_cn: 他们转给我的粉丝来信让我应接不暇。
ext.ext_en: They have inundated me with fan letters.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are inundated with things such as letters, demands, or requests, you are emphasizing that you receive so many of them that you cannot deal with them all.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的街区正被科罗拉多河上涨的河水淹没。
ext.ext_en: Their neighborhood is being inundated by the rising waters of the Colorado River.

defs.def_en: If an area of land is inundated, it becomes covered with water.

defs.def_cn: （在英美两国的圣诞节时尤受欢迎的）一品红，圣诞花
defs.def_en: A poinsettia is a plant with groups of bright red or pink leaves that grows in Central and South America. Poinsettias are very popular in Britain and the United States, especially at Christmas.

ext.ext_en: Unfortunately, his idea of bold journalism was a hatchet job, portraying the staff in a negative light.

defs.def_en: To do a hatchet job on someone or something means to say or write something mentioning many bad things about them, which harms their reputation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （批评、评论等）鲜明的，犀利的，尖锐的，中肯的

ext.ext_cn: 他因这番尖锐的批评而万念俱灰，茫然不知所措。
ext.ext_en: He was shattered and bewildered by this trenchant criticism...

ext.ext_cn: 他的评论既一针见血又鞭辟入里。
ext.ext_en: His comment was trenchant and perceptive.

defs.def_en: You can use trenchant to describe something such as a criticism or comment that is very clear, effective, and forceful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 奇怪的;怪异的;意料之外的

ext.ext_cn: 然后一件奇怪的事发生了。
ext.ext_en: Then a strange thing happened...

ext.ext_cn: 闪烁的蓝光有点怪异。
ext.ext_en: There was something strange about the flickering blue light...

defs.def_en: Something that is strange is unusual or unexpected, and makes you feel slightly nervous or afraid.

ext.ext_cn: 结果，我独自一人来到了一个陌生的城市。
ext.ext_en: I ended up alone in a strange city...

ext.ext_cn: 她面对着一份全新工作，周围是陌生的环境和陌生的人。
ext.ext_en: She was faced with a new job, in unfamiliar surroundings with strange people.

defs.def_en: A strange place is one that you have never been to before. A strange person is someone that you have never met before.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 局促不安的;不自在的;不舒服的

ext.ext_cn: 我感到非常头晕、不舒服。
ext.ext_en: I felt all dizzy and strange.

defs.def_en: If you feel strange, you have an unpleasant or uncomfortable feeling, either physical or emotional.

defs.def_cn: （伸展到另一地区的）狭长土地，锅柄状地区

ext.ext_en: ...the Texas panhandle.

defs.def_en: A panhandle is a narrow strip of land joined to a larger area of land.

ext.ext_en: Many of these street people seemed to support themselves by panhandling and doing odd jobs...

ext.ext_cn: 还有一个沿街乞讨的家伙。
ext.ext_en: There was also a guy panhandling for quarters.

defs.def_en: If someone panhandles, they stop people in the street and ask them for food or money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 寄一盘新磁带过去不合算。
ext.ext_en: It would be uneconomical to send a brand new tape...

ext.ext_cn: 采用的方法很老套，没什么效益。
ext.ext_en: The methods employed are old-fashioned and uneconomical...

defs.def_en: If you say that an action, a method, or a product is uneconomical, you mean that it does not make a profit.
Terrorism is the use of violence, especially murder and bombing, in order to achieve political aims or to force a government to do something.

defs.def_cn: (战争中)严密策划的行动;(足球赛中)精心设定的攻防套路

ext.ext_en: The first three Oldham goals came from set-pieces.

defs.def_en: A set piece is an occasion such as a battle or a move in a game of football that is planned and carried out in an ordered way.

defs.def_cn: (电影、小说或音乐作品中的)固定套路

ext.ext_cn: 电影中精彩的武打套路
ext.ext_en: ...the film's martial arts set pieces.

defs.def_en: A set piece is a part of a film, novel, or piece of music which has a strong dramatic effect and which is often not an essential part of the main story.

defs.def_cn: 日光节约时间;夏令时间
defs.def_en: Daylight Saving Time is a period of time in the summer when the clocks are set one hour forward, so that people can have extra light in the evening.

ext.ext_cn: 他提出的合并理由只是空话连篇。
ext.ext_en: His justification for the merger was just hot air...

ext.ext_cn: 我那时已得出结论，他只会夸夸其谈。
ext.ext_en: I'd come to the conclusion by then that he was all hot air.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's claims or promises are just hot air, you are criticizing them because they are made mainly to impress people and have no real value or meaning.

ext.ext_cn: 小组成员必须通过角色扮演互相交流。
ext.ext_en: Group members have to communicate with each other through role-play.

defs.def_en: Role play is the act of imitating the character and behaviour of someone who is different from yourself, for example as a training exercise.

ext.ext_cn: 事先和朋友通过角色扮演排练一下面试。
ext.ext_en: Rehearse and role-play the interview with a friend beforehand.

defs.def_en: If people role play, they do a role play.
Putty is a stiff paste used to fix sheets of glass into window frames.
Input/output refers to the information that is passed into or out of a computer.

ext.ext_cn: 输入输出设备系统
ext.ext_en: ... an input/output system.

defs.def_en: Input/output refers to the hardware or software that controls the passing of information into or out of a computer.
A military policeman is a member of the military police.

ext.ext_cn: 一个经常和父母对着干的淘气男孩

ext.ext_en: He urged Russian soldiers to disobey orders if asked to fire on civilian targets...

defs.def_en: When someone disobeys a person or an order, they deliberately do not do what they have been told to do.

ext.ext_cn: 在接下来的骚乱中，3名英国人受伤。
ext.ext_en: During the disturbance which followed, three Englishmen were hurt.

ext.ext_cn: 去年9月最严重的骚乱
ext.ext_en: ...the worst of last September'sdisturbances.

defs.def_en: A disturbance is an incident in which people behave violently in public.

ext.ext_cn: 养老院对当地居民造成的干扰会比学校小。
ext.ext_en: The home would cause less disturbance to local residents than a school...

ext.ext_cn: 这些动物对外界的干扰很敏感，且从未被圈养过。
ext.ext_en: The animals are very sensitive to disturbance and have never bred in captivity.

defs.def_en: Disturbance means upsetting or disorganizing something which was previously in a calm and well-ordered state.

ext.ext_cn: 糟糕的学习成绩与情绪失常有关。
ext.ext_en: Poor educational performance is related to emotional disturbance.

ext.ext_cn: 某种心律失常的治疗方法
ext.ext_en: ...the treatment of certain heart rhythm disturbances.

defs.def_en: You can use disturbance to refer to a medical or psychological problem, when someone's body or mind is not working in the normal way.

ext.ext_cn: 退潮时，它便成为甲壳动物居住的岩石区潮水潭。
ext.ext_en: When the tide ebbs it's a rock pool inhabited by crustaceans.

defs.def_en: When the tide or the sea ebbs, its level gradually falls.

ext.ext_cn: 春季退潮
ext.ext_en: ...the spring ebb tide...

ext.ext_en: We decided to leave on the ebb at six o'clock next morning.

defs.def_en: The ebb or the ebb tide is one of the regular periods, usually two per day, when the sea gradually falls to a lower level as the tide moves away from the land.

ext.ext_cn: 随着人体力的衰退
ext.ext_en: ...as a man's physical strength ebbs...

ext.ext_en: Were there occasions when enthusiasm ebbed?

defs.def_en: If someone's life, support, or feeling ebbs, it becomes weaker and gradually disappears.

defs.def_cn: 处于低潮;处于衰退状态

ext.ext_en: ...a time when everyone is tired and at a low ebb...

ext.ext_cn: 政府的支持率跌到了最低点。
ext.ext_en: The Government's popularity is at its lowest ebb.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is at a low ebb or at their lowest ebb, they are not being very successful or profitable.

ext.ext_cn: 感觉和情绪的起伏
ext.ext_en: ...the ebb and flow of feeling and moods.

defs.def_en: You can use ebb and flow to describe the way that something repeatedly increases and decreases or rises and falls.

A robin is a brown bird found in North America. The male has a reddish-brown breast. North American robins are larger than European ones, and are a completely different species of bird.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (言辞或行为)非正式的，亲切随便的

ext.ext_en: His friend was less good-looking, but a lot more informal and relaxed.

defs.def_en: Informal speech or behaviour is relaxed and friendly rather than serious, very correct, or official.

ext.ext_en: I would like it to be an informal occasion...

ext.ext_cn: 房间里有一种轻松随意的氛围。
ext.ext_en: The house has an informal atmosphere.

defs.def_en: An informal situation is one which is relaxed and friendly and not very serious or official.

defs.def_cn: (衣服)非正式场合穿的,休闲的

ext.ext_en: Most of the time Jenny needs informal clothes...

ext.ext_cn: 吃午饭时可以穿休闲服。
ext.ext_en: For lunch, dress is informal.

defs.def_en: Informal clothes are casual and suitable for wearing when you are relaxing, but not on formal occasions.

ext.ext_cn: 两位领导人将到戴维营进行非正式讨论。
ext.ext_en: The two leaders will retire to Camp David for informal discussions.

ext.ext_cn: 欧盟部长非正式会议
ext.ext_en: ...an informal meeting of EU ministers...

defs.def_en: You use informal to describe something that is done unofficially or casually without planning.

ext.ext_en: Owing to a typographical error, the town of Longridge was spelt as Longbridge.

ext.ext_cn: 一幢木屋的建筑模型
ext.ext_en: ...an architect's model of a wooden house.

ext.ext_en: ...a working scale model of the whole Bay Area...

defs.def_en: A model of an object is a physical representation that shows what it looks like or how it works. The model is often smaller than the object it represents.

ext.ext_cn: 我们认为这可以作为管理活动的普遍范例。
ext.ext_en: We believe that this is a general model of managerial activity...

ext.ext_cn: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。
ext.ext_en: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.

defs.def_en: A model is a system that is being used and that people might want to copy in order to achieve similar results.

ext.ext_cn: 达尔文最终提出了生物进化的模型。
ext.ext_en: Darwin eventually put forward a model of biological evolution...

ext.ext_cn: 他提出了一个人体内应激反应的模型。
ext.ext_en: He proposed a model of stress reaction in the body.

defs.def_en: A model of a system or process is a theoretical description that can help you understand how the system or process works, or how it might work.

defs.def_cn: 创立(系统或过程）的（理论描述)模型

ext.ext_cn: 创立诸如大气层之类的非线性系统的模型所需的数学知识
ext.ext_en: ...the mathematics needed to model a nonlinear system like an atmosphere.

defs.def_en: If someone such as a scientist models a system or process, they make an accurate theoretical description of it in order to understand or explain how it works.

ext.ext_cn: 作为一个非常懂礼貌的人，他已经学会了克制内心的任何愤怒情绪。
ext.ext_en: A model of good manners, he has conquered any inward fury...

ext.ext_cn: 他的婚姻和家庭生活都是规规矩矩的。
ext.ext_en: His marriage and family life is a model of propriety.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is a model of a particular quality, you are showing approval of them because they have that quality to a large degree.

ext.ext_cn: 还是个小女孩的时候，她就是一个模范学生。
ext.ext_en: As a girl she had been a model pupil...

ext.ext_cn: 医务人员说他是一个模范病人。
ext.ext_en: Hospital staff say he is a model patient.

defs.def_en: You use model to express approval of someone when you think that they perform their role or duties extremely well.

defs.def_cn: 按特定模型制造;仿特定样式做出

ext.ext_cn: 该配额制度是仿照美国以及欧洲大陆国家的同类制度制定的。
ext.ext_en: The quota system was modelled on those operated in America and continental Europe...

ext.ext_cn: 这个节目将仿照英国广播公司的人气系列剧《阿彻一家》制作。
ext.ext_en: The program will be modeled after a popular BBC series called 'The Archers'...

defs.def_en: If one thing is modelled on another, the first thing is made so that it is like the second thing in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 以年纪较长的女性作为自己仿效的对象绝没有什么不对。
ext.ext_en: There's absolutely nothing wrong in modelling yourself on an older woman...

ext.ext_cn: 他们会倾向于模仿老师的行为举止。
ext.ext_en: They will tend to model their behaviour on the teacher's behaviour.

defs.def_en: If you model yourself on someone, you copy the way that they do things, because you admire them and want to be like them.

ext.ext_cn: 要想花钱少些，就选择基本的型号。
ext.ext_en: To keep the cost down, opt for a basic model...

ext.ext_cn: 该型号的编号为1870/285。
ext.ext_en: The model number is 1870/285.

defs.def_en: A particular model of a machine is a particular version of it.  →see usage note at:brand
An artist's model is a person who stays still in a particular position so that the artist can make a picture or sculpture of them.

ext.ext_cn: 图利奥已为桑德拉做了11年的模特儿。
ext.ext_en: Tullio has been modelling for Sandra for eleven years.

defs.def_en: If someone models for an artist, they stay still in a particular position so that the artist can make a picture or sculpture  of them.

ext.ext_cn: 巴黎顶尖时装摄影模特儿
ext.ext_en: ...Paris's top photographic fashion model.

defs.def_en: A fashion model is a person whose job is to display clothes by wearing them.

ext.ext_cn: 我不是到这里来当时装模特儿的。
ext.ext_en: I wasn't here to model clothes...

ext.ext_cn: 她15岁就开始在巴黎做时装模特儿。
ext.ext_en: She began modelling in Paris aged 15.

defs.def_en: If someone models clothes, they display them by wearing them.

defs.def_cn: (用黏土、木头等)做…的模型;塑造

ext.ext_cn: 在那儿她开始用黏土做模型。
ext.ext_en: There she began to model in clay...

ext.ext_cn: 她有时刻木雕，有时刻石雕，有时塑泥塑。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes she carved wood and sometimes stone; sometimes she modelled clay...

defs.def_en: If you model shapes or figures, you make them out of a substance such as clay or wood.

defs.def_cn: 胡子茬儿；（胡须剃后长出的）粗硬短须；（男子头顶处的）短发

ext.ext_cn: 两天没剃长出的胡子茬儿
ext.ext_en: ...two days' growth of bristles...

ext.ext_cn: 他用双手摸了摸他平头上柔软的短发。
ext.ext_en: He rubbed his hands over the soft bristles of his crew cut.

ext.ext_cn: 牙刷毛一开始磨损，就把它扔掉。
ext.ext_en: As soon as the bristles on your toothbrush begin to wear, throw it out.

defs.def_en: The bristles of a brush are the thick hairs or hair-like pieces of plastic which are attached to it.

ext.ext_cn: 它粗短的尾巴上鬃毛浓密。
ext.ext_en: It has a short stumpy tail covered with bristles.

defs.def_en: Bristles are thick, strong animal hairs that feel hard and rough.

defs.def_cn: （因寒冷、恐惧或愤怒）毛发直立

ext.ext_cn: 这使人毛骨悚然。
ext.ext_en: It makes the hairs at the nape of the neck bristle...

ext.ext_cn: 这些猫的哀叫引得我的狗毛发竖立。
ext.ext_en: Cats yowl. My dog's hair bristles in response.

defs.def_en: If the hair on a person's or animal's body bristles, it rises away from their skin because they are cold, frightened, or angry.

ext.ext_cn: 埃利斯对有人指责伯克利的实验考虑不够周密感到气愤。
ext.ext_en: Ellis bristles at accusations that Berkeley's experiment is ill-conceived...

ext.ext_cn: 有人暗示他是个种族主义者，他对此十分恼火。
ext.ext_en: He bristled with indignation at the suggestion that he was racist.

defs.def_en: If you bristle at something, you react to it angrily, and show this in your expression or the way you move.

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家到处都是武装团伙。
ext.ext_en: The country bristles with armed groups...

ext.ext_cn: 这个想法存有诸多争议。
ext.ext_en: The idea fairly bristles with controversy...

defs.def_en: If you say that a place or thing bristles with people or with other things, you are emphasizing that it contains a great number of them.

ext.ext_cn: 公众30多年来未曾见过的豪华舞厅
ext.ext_en: ...a spectacular ballroom, unseen by the public for over 30 years...

ext.ext_cn: 我们选了这位西班牙骑手早年一些不为人知的照片刊登出来。
ext.ext_en: We print a selection of previously unseen photos from the Spanish rider's early years.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unseen, you mean that it has not been seen for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 对我来说，表演就是在麦克风前通过无线电波面对看不见的听众进行的。
ext.ext_en: For me, a performance is in front of a microphone, over the radio, to an unseen audience...

ext.ext_en: There was barely time for the two boys to escape unseen.

defs.def_en: You can use unseen to describe things which people cannot see.

ext.ext_cn: 在当代西方社会，快速变化的时尚迎合了人们追求新奇和个性的需求。
ext.ext_en: In the contemporary western world, rapidly changing styles cater to a desire for novelty and individualism.

defs.def_en: Novelty is the quality of being different, new, and unusual.

ext.ext_cn: 看到人们排队买食品是件新鲜事。
ext.ext_en: Seeing people queuing for food was a novelty...

ext.ext_cn: 这要从轿车还是新鲜玩意儿那会儿说起。
ext.ext_en: It came from the days when a motor car was a novelty.

defs.def_en: A novelty is something that is new and therefore interesting.

ext.ext_cn: 复活节时，我们给他们分发塑料彩蛋，里面装着小玩具、新颖的小玩意儿和硬币。
ext.ext_en: At Easter, we give them plastic eggs filled with small toys, novelties and coins.

defs.def_en: Novelties are cheap toys, ornaments, or other objects that are sold as presents or souvenirs.

defs.def_cn: 配子（用以产生新生命的雄性或雌性细胞）
defs.def_en: Gamete is the name for the two types of male and female cell that join together to make a new creature.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 困惑不解的；不知所措的；晕头转向的

ext.ext_cn: 光是摆在那里的各式商品就让一些购物者晕头转向了。
ext.ext_en: Some shoppers looked bewildered by the sheer variety of goods on offer.

defs.def_en: If you are bewildered, you are very confused and cannot understand something or decide what you should do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他认为政府对毒贩已经很宽容了。
ext.ext_en: He believes the government already is lenient with drug traffickers...

ext.ext_cn: 奥斯瓦尔德教授的观点稍微温和些。
ext.ext_en: Professor Oswald takes a sightly more lenient view.

defs.def_en: When someone in authority is lenient, they are not as strict or severe as expected.

ext.ext_cn: 他的儿子、兄弟和侄子都是他的左膀右臂，都配备了武器。
ext.ext_en: His sons, brother and nephews were his armed sidekicks.

ext.ext_cn: 愚笨的助手
ext.ext_en: ...a dim-witted sidekick.

defs.def_en: Someone's sidekick is a person who accompanies them and helps them, and who you consider to be less intelligent or less important than the other person.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我非常感激他对我的帮助。
ext.ext_en: I am deeply indebted to him for his help.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are indebted to someone for something, you mean that you are very grateful to them for something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 美国财政部长指出了负债最多的那些国家。
ext.ext_en: America's treasury secretary identified the most heavily indebted countries.

defs.def_en: Indebted countries, organizations, or people are ones that owe money to other countries, organizations, or people.

ext.ext_cn: 人们应该能自由表达他们的个性。
ext.ext_en: People should be free to express their individuality...

ext.ext_cn: 这会让你的促销品显得个性十足、格调高雅。
ext.ext_en: This will give your promotional material individuality and style.

defs.def_en: The individuality of a person or thing consists of the qualities that make them different from other people or things.

defs.def_cn: 不思悔改的；不悔悟的；不知羞耻的

ext.ext_cn: 帕梅拉对自己那些脏话和伤人的言辞一点也不感到羞愧。
ext.ext_en: Pamela was unrepentant about her strong language and abrasive remarks.

ext.ext_cn: 顽固不化地赞成死刑的人
ext.ext_en: ...unrepentant defenders of the death penalty.

defs.def_en: If you are unrepentant, you are not ashamed of your beliefs or actions.

defs.def_cn: 对…进行精神分析；用精神分析法治疗

ext.ext_cn: 在电影中伯顿对弗思进行了精神分析，想要治愈他的抑郁症。
ext.ext_en: The movie sees Burton psychoanalysing Firth to cure him of his depression.

defs.def_en: When a psychotherapist or psychiatrist psychoanalyses someone who has mental problems, he or she examines or treats them using psychoanalysis.

ext.ext_cn: 我的医生实在是一位酷男。
ext.ext_en: My doctor is a real cool dude.

defs.def_en: A dude is a man.
When there is a share issue, shares in a company are made available for people to buy.
If you say that someone is a pseud, you mean that they are trying to appear very intellectual but you think that they appear silly.

ext.ext_cn: 我继续比照医生办公室里的图表来判断他病情的发展。
ext.ext_en: I continued to measure his progress against the charts in the doctor's office...

ext.ext_cn: 一所文法学校成功与否是以考上大学的学生人数为衡量依据的。
ext.ext_en: A grammar school's success was measured in terms of the number of pupils who got into university...

defs.def_en: If you measure the quality, value, or effect of something, you discover or judge how great it is.

ext.ext_cn: 测量一下这条缝隙的长与宽。
ext.ext_en: Measure the length and width of the gap...

ext.ext_cn: 他测出了超声波穿过骨头的速度。
ext.ext_en: He measured the speed at which ultrasonic waves travel along the bone.

defs.def_en: If you measure a quantity that can be expressed in numbers, such as the length of something, you discover it using a particular instrument or device, for example a ruler.

defs.def_cn: 距离(或长度、宽度、数量等)为…

ext.ext_cn: 这座房子长20多米，宽6米。
ext.ext_en: The house is more than twenty metres long and measures six metres in width...

ext.ext_cn: 这只手工绘制的盘子直径为30厘米。
ext.ext_en: This hand-decorated plate measures 30cm across...

defs.def_en: If something measures a particular length, width, or amount, that is its size or intensity, expressed in numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 除了胡安之外，每个人都获得了相当大的成功。
ext.ext_en: With the exception of Juan, each attained a measure of success...

ext.ext_cn: 殖民地正要求获得更大程度上的自治。
ext.ext_en: The colonies were claiming a larger measure of self-government.

defs.def_en: A measure of a particular quality, feeling, or activity is a fairly large amount of it.

defs.def_cn: （情形严重或发展到了一定程度的）体现，表现，标志

ext.ext_cn: 他们几乎全都无处可归，看得出他们是陷入了困境。
ext.ext_en: It is a measure of their plight that few of them have anywhere to go to...

ext.ext_cn: 那简直就是银行里糟糕局面的写照。
ext.ext_en: That is a measure of how bad things have become at the bank.

defs.def_en: If you say that one aspect of a situation is a measure of that situation, you mean that it shows that the situation is very serious or has developed to a very great  extent.

ext.ext_cn: 政府警告说，警方将采取更为强硬的措施来遏制动乱。
ext.ext_en: The government warned that police would take tougher measures to contain the trouble...

ext.ext_cn: 他说将会采取严厉措施惩罚凶手。
ext.ext_en: He said stern measures would be taken against the killers...

defs.def_en: When someone, usually a government or other authority, takes measures to do something, they carry out particular actions in order to achieve a particular result.

ext.ext_cn: 他又为自己倒了满满一大杯麦芽威士忌。
ext.ext_en: He poured himself another generous measure of malt.

ext.ext_cn: 一杯烈酒
ext.ext_en: ...a pub measure of spirits.

defs.def_en: A measure of a strong alcoholic drink such as brandy or whisky is an amount of it in a glass. In pubs and bars, a measure is an official standard amount.
In music, a measure is one of the several short parts of the same length into which a piece of music is divided.

ext.ext_cn: 人类对于宇宙的了解已经大为增加。
ext.ext_en: Mankind's knowledge of the universe has increased beyond measure...

ext.ext_cn: 她让他大为光火。
ext.ext_en: She irritated him beyond measure.

defs.def_en: If you say that something has changed or that it has affected you beyond measure, you are emphasizing that it has done this to a great extent.

ext.ext_cn: 另外，我重复了我的问题。
ext.ext_en: I repeated my question for good measure...

ext.ext_cn: 除此之外还包括对宾馆的一些详细介绍。
ext.ext_en: For good measure, a few details of hotels were included.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is done for good measure, you mean that it is done in addition to a number of other things.

defs.def_cn: 了解;熟悉;估量…的能力/掂量出…的分量;摸清…的底细

ext.ext_cn: 工业化国家的政府没能意识到这次危机的严重程度。
ext.ext_en: The governments of the industrialized world had failed to get the measure of the crisis...

ext.ext_cn: 他有没有掂掂我们的分量，知道我们并不愿冒生命危险？
ext.ext_en: Has he taken the measure of us and concluded that we're not willing to risk a life?...

defs.def_en: If you get or take the measure of someone or something, you discover what they are like, so that you are able to control them or deal with them. If you have the measure of someone or something, you have succeeded in doing this.

defs.def_cn: 在某种程度上/在很大程度上

ext.ext_cn: 权力在某种程度上是意志的表现。
ext.ext_en: Power is in some measure an act of will...

ext.ext_cn: 在英国，我们迄今为止已经远远地避开了这两类麻烦。
ext.ext_en: In Britain, we have so far escaped, in large measure, either of these afflictions.

defs.def_en: If something is true in some measure or in large measure, it is partly or mostly true.

defs.def_cn: (某个字母)是…的缩写，代表，表示

ext.ext_cn: AIDS是获得性免疫缺损综合征的缩写。
ext.ext_en: AIDS stands for Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome...

ext.ext_cn: EU代表什么？
ext.ext_en: What does EU stand for?

defs.def_en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

defs.def_cn: 支持，主张，代表(某种观点或态度)

ext.ext_cn: 该党正试图让大家觉得只有它才是民主的代表。
ext.ext_en: The party is trying to give the impression that it alone stands for democracy...

ext.ext_cn: 他仇恨我们以及我们的任何主张。
ext.ext_en: He hates us and everything we stand for.

defs.def_en: The ideas or attitudes that someone or something stands for are the ones that they support or represent.

ext.ext_cn: 这太不像话了，我们再也不能容忍下去了。
ext.ext_en: It's outrageous, and we won't stand for it any more.

defs.def_en: If you will not stand for something, you will not allow it to happen or continue.

ext.ext_cn: 白天慢慢过去，布兰德发现自己兴趣愈发浓厚。
ext.ext_en: As the day wore on Brand found himself increasingly impressed...

ext.ext_cn: 夏天的时光已经流逝，生活又恢复了昔日的无聊。
ext.ext_en: The summer days wore on and life returned to its boring routine.

defs.def_en: If you say that time wears on, you mean that it passes, especially when it seems to pass slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 也许我们可以一起去某个地方，就我和你。
ext.ext_en: Maybe if we could go someplace together, just you and I...

ext.ext_cn: 他们住在凯奥特峡谷一带。
ext.ext_en: They lived over around Coyote Canyon someplace.

defs.def_en: Someplace means the same as somewhere .

ext.ext_cn: 这位医生在产房刺目的灯光下忙碌着。
ext.ext_en: The doctor worked busily beneath the blinding lights of the delivery room.

defs.def_en: A blinding light is extremely bright.

defs.def_cn: 显而易见的；非常明显的

ext.ext_cn: 我所经历的痛苦让我突然一下子清楚地领悟到了生活的真谛。
ext.ext_en: The miseries I went through made me suddenly realise with a blinding flash what life was all about.

defs.def_en: You use blinding to emphasize that something is very obvious.

ext.ext_cn: 先是一阵疼痛，接着一股瞬间的剧痛沿着丹洛的脊柱窜了上来。
ext.ext_en: There was a pain then, a quick, blinding agony that jumped along Danlo's spine.

defs.def_en: Blinding pain is very strong pain.

ext.ext_cn: 游行路线
ext.ext_en: ...the processional route.

defs.def_en: Processional means used for or taking part in a ceremonial procession.

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影的后期制作将于来年年初完成。
ext.ext_en: The film's post-production will be completed early next year.

ext.ext_cn: 电影后期制作公司
ext.ext_en: ...a film post-production company.

defs.def_en: In film and television, post-production is the work such as editing that takes place after the film has been shot.
A blood transfusion is a process in which blood is injected into the body of a person who is badly injured or ill.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的具体任务就是将大量信息分类并努力弄清它们的意思。
ext.ext_en: Their specific task is to sort through the reams of information and try to determine what it may mean...

ext.ext_cn: 凯利花了3个小时翻阅大量文件。
ext.ext_en: Kelly spent three hours going through reams of paper.

defs.def_en: If you say that there are reams of paper or reams of writing, you mean that there are large amounts of it.

ext.ext_cn: 快节奏的叙事
ext.ext_en: ...a fast-moving narrative...

ext.ext_cn: 斯隆以发生谋杀案的那天作为故事的开端。
ext.ext_en: Sloan began his narrative with the day of the murder.

defs.def_en: A narrative is a story or an account of a series of events.

defs.def_cn: (通常指小说中一系列事件的)记叙，叙述，讲述

ext.ext_cn: 两个作者都不是很善于讲故事。
ext.ext_en: Neither author was very strong on narrative.

ext.ext_cn: 奈简约的叙事风格
ext.ext_en: ...Nye's simple narrative style.

defs.def_en: Narrative is the description of a series of events, usually in a novel.
A mineral is a substance such as tin, salt, or sulphur that is formed naturally in rocks and in the earth. Minerals are also found in small quantities in food and drink.

ext.ext_cn: 形容词短语
ext.ext_en: ...an adjectival phrase.

defs.def_en: Adjectival means relating to adjectives or like an adjective.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他工作努力，精力充沛。
ext.ext_en: He was hardworking and energetic.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as hard-working, you mean that they work very hard.

ext.ext_cn: 一名勘测员说是地面下陷导致了这些问题出现，房子需要加固地基。
ext.ext_en: A surveyor said that the problems were caused by subsidence and the house needed to be underpinned.

defs.def_en: When there is subsidence in a place, the ground there sinks to a lower level.

ext.ext_cn: 一件饰有圆形小亮片的无肩带式晚礼服
ext.ext_en: ...a strapless sequinned evening gown.

defs.def_en: A sequinned piece of clothing is decorated or covered with sequins.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家的政治体制依然残暴异常，缺少平等，四分五裂。
ext.ext_en: This country still had a deeply oppressive, unequal and divisive political system.

ext.ext_cn: 男女之间不平等的权力关系
ext.ext_en: ...the unequal power relationships between men and women.

defs.def_en: An unequal system or situation is unfair because it gives more power or privileges to one person or group of people than to others.

defs.def_cn: 不能胜任的；力不能及的

ext.ext_cn: 批评她的人说事实证明她并不具备完成这项工作的能力。
ext.ext_en: Her critics say she has proved unequal to the task...

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉难以胜任这项工作，希望有人能给点建议。
ext.ext_en: He felt unequal to the job and wished there were someone he could go to for advice.

defs.def_en: If someone is unequal to a task they have to do, they do not have the abilities needed to do it well.

defs.def_cn: （大小、力量或数量上）不均等的，不对等的

ext.ext_cn: 埃及人很有可能用不同长度的24小时来度量日子。
ext.ext_en: The Egyptians probably measured their day in twenty-four hours of unequal length.

defs.def_en: Unequal means being different in size, strength, or amount.
If you think someone has views which are more right-wing than most other members of their party, you can say they are a right-winger .

ext.ext_cn: 汽车挡风玻璃上的任何一条裂缝看起来总是正对着司机的视线。
ext.ext_en: Any crack in a car windscreen always seems to be right in the driver's line of vision.

defs.def_en: Your line of vision is the same as your line of sight .

ext.ext_cn: 矿物油被用来润滑机器。
ext.ext_en: Mineral oils are used to lubricate machinery.

ext.ext_cn: 润滑油
ext.ext_en: ...lubricating oil.

defs.def_en: If you lubricate something such as a part of a machine, you put a substance such as oil on it so that it moves smoothly.

ext.ext_cn: 富兰克林的任务是促使与法国方面的会谈顺畅进行。
ext.ext_en: Franklin's task was to lubricate the discussions with the French.

defs.def_en: If you say that something lubricates a particular situation, you mean that it helps things to happen without any problems.

defs.def_cn: 沙林，甲氟膦酸异丙酯(用作化学武器的一种毒性极强的气体)
defs.def_en: Sarin is an extremely poisonous gas that is used in chemical weapons.

defs.def_cn: 融入；与…融为一体；与…协调

ext.ext_cn: 蟾蜍已经变色，和新的环境融为一体。
ext.ext_en: The toad had changed its colour to blend in with its new environment.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎和天空融为一体的一片绵延不绝的浅灰色
ext.ext_en: ...a continuous pale neutral grey, almost blending into the sky...

defs.def_en: If something blends into the background, it is so similar to the background that it is difficult to see or hear it separately.

defs.def_cn: 与…打成一片；成为…的一员；融入

ext.ext_cn: 这势必让我更加下定决心融入周围环境。
ext.ext_en: It must have reinforced my determination to blend into my surroundings...

ext.ext_cn: 她觉得自己可以很好地融入进来。
ext.ext_en: She felt she would blend in nicely...

defs.def_en: If someone blends into a particular group or situation, they seem to belong there, because their appearance or behaviour is similar to that of the other people involved.

defs.def_cn: 笑眯眯地;微笑地;含笑地

ext.ext_cn: 他打开了大门，微笑着欢迎出行的人归来。
ext.ext_en: He opened the gate and smilingly welcomed the travellers home.

defs.def_en: If someone does something smilingly, they smile as they do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一项的确已失去了魅力的游戏。
ext.ext_en: It's a game that has really lost its allure.

ext.ext_cn: 伊莎贝拉·阿佳妮令人倾倒的魅力
ext.ext_en: ...the captivating allure of Isabelle Adjani.

defs.def_en: The allure of something or someone is the pleasing or exciting quality that they have.
A tsunami is a very large wave, often caused by an earthquake, that flows onto the land and destroys things.

defs.def_cn: （固定在门上供敲门用的）门环
defs.def_en: See also:knock;A knocker is a piece of metal on the front door of a building, which you use to hit the door in order to attract the attention of the people inside.

ext.ext_cn: 眼泪顺着她的脸颊流了下来。
ext.ext_en: Tears were running down her cheeks...

ext.ext_cn: 她轻轻地吻了他的双颊。
ext.ext_en: She kissed him lightly on both cheeks.

defs.def_en: Your cheeks are the sides of your face below your eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 我真惊讶他们当初竟然有脸问。
ext.ext_en: I'm amazed they had the cheek to ask in the first place...

ext.ext_cn: 我还是认为，他们寄来优惠购物券，而不是退款，真是有些厚颜无耻。
ext.ext_en: I still think it's a bit of a cheek sending a voucher rather than a refund...

defs.def_en: You say that someone has a cheek when you are annoyed or shocked at something unreasonable that they have done.
If you turn the other cheek when someone harms or insults you, you do not harm or insult them in return.

defs.def_cn: 做苦工的奴隶;奴隶干的活;苦役

ext.ext_cn: 在丛林地带，儿童被用作开采金矿的苦役。
ext.ext_en: The children were used as slave labour in gold mines in the jungle...

ext.ext_cn: 该报告宣称，成千上万的人被军队逼迫做苦役。
ext.ext_en: The report alleges that thousands of people have been forced into slave labour by the army.

defs.def_en: Slave labour refers to slaves or to work done by slaves.

defs.def_cn: 辛苦但报酬很低的工作;苦工

ext.ext_cn: 为了挣点钱，他被迫到卖汉堡的小店里做苦工。
ext.ext_en: He's been forced into slave labour at burger bars to earn a bit of cash.

defs.def_en: If people work very hard for long hours for very little money, you can refer to it as slave labour .
Pah is used in writing to represent the sound someone makes when showing disgust or contempt.

ext.ext_cn: 宁静的乡间小径
ext.ext_en: ...a quiet country lane...

ext.ext_cn: 沿着小路走到河边。
ext.ext_en: Follow the lane to the river.

defs.def_en: A lane is a narrow road, especially in the country.

ext.ext_cn: 公园路多切斯特酒店
ext.ext_en: ...The Dorchester Hotel, Park Lane.

defs.def_en: Lane is also used in the names of roads, either in cities or in the country.

ext.ext_cn: 卡车在慢车道上以20英里的时速行驶。
ext.ext_en: The lorry was travelling at 20mph in the slow lane...

ext.ext_cn: 我转入2号公路东向车道。
ext.ext_en: I pulled out into the eastbound lane  of Route 2.

defs.def_en: A lane is a part of a main road which is marked by the edge of the road and a painted line, or by two painted lines.

ext.ext_cn: 泳池分三部分，有为初学者而设的慢泳道。
ext.ext_en: The pool is divided into three sections with a crawler lane for beginners...

ext.ext_cn: 她抽到第三道，所有对手尽收眼底。
ext.ext_en: Drawn in lane three, she had all her rivals in sight.

defs.def_en: At a swimming pool or athletics track, a lane is a long narrow section which is marked by lines or ropes.

ext.ext_cn: 撞船事故发生在全世界最繁忙的航道上。
ext.ext_en: The collision took place in the busiest shipping lanes in the world.

defs.def_en: A lane is a route that is frequently used by aircraft or ships.

ext.ext_cn: 青少年罪犯对紧张刺激生活的贪求
ext.ext_en: ...the young criminals' lust for life in the fast lane.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 表示歉意的；认错的；愧疚的

ext.ext_cn: 医院的工作人员深表歉意，但这真的于事无补。
ext.ext_en: The hospital staff were very apologetic but that couldn't really compensate...

ext.ext_cn: 对于他们所做的改进，他们简直感到愧疚。
ext.ext_en: They were almost apologetic about the improvements they'd made...

defs.def_en: If you are apologetic, you show or say that you are sorry for causing trouble for someone, for hurting them, or for disappointing them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 危险的;可能带来危害的;不安全的

ext.ext_cn: 那段路很不安全。
ext.ext_en: It's a dangerous stretch of road.

ext.ext_cn: 危险的毒品
ext.ext_en: ...dangerous drugs...

defs.def_en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

ext.ext_cn: 船搁浅在水深本应为35英尺的地方。
ext.ext_en: The ship ran aground where there should have been a depth of 35ft.

defs.def_en: If a ship runs aground, it touches the ground in a shallow part of a river, lake, or the sea, and gets stuck.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一派天伦之乐的场景。
ext.ext_en: It was a scene of such domestic bliss.

defs.def_en: Bliss is a state of complete happiness.

ext.ext_cn: 因为担心物品可能带上病菌，他们砌墙堵死了她的屋子。
ext.ext_en: They had walled up her room because of the fear that things might be infected.

defs.def_en: If someone walls up a room, or if someone is walled up in it, walls are built blocking every door so that nobody can get in or out.

ext.ext_cn: 厨师、工作人员和经理都是中国人。
ext.ext_en: The chef, staff and managers are all Chinese.

ext.ext_cn: 琳达·埃默里——沃尔香肠公司的营销经理
ext.ext_en: ...Linda Emery, marketing manager for Wall's sausages.

defs.def_en: A manager is a person who is responsible for running part of or the whole of a business organization.

defs.def_cn: (明星、艺人等的)经纪人，业务管理人
defs.def_en: The manager of a pop star or other entertainer is the person who looks after their business interests.

defs.def_cn: (球队的)主教练(在美国英语中，该词只用于棒球球队，其他运动则用 coach 一词指主教练)
defs.def_en: The manager of a sports team is the person responsible for training the players and organizing the way they play. In American English, manager is only used for baseball; in other sports, coach is used instead.

ext.ext_cn: 它的爪子挠伤了他的大腿。
ext.ext_en: Its claws lacerated his thighs.

defs.def_en: If something lacerates your skin, it cuts it badly and deeply.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 过分花哨的;过分修饰的

ext.ext_cn: 过于华丽的词藻
ext.ext_en: ...florid language.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as florid, you disapprove of the fact that it is complicated and extravagant rather than plain and simple.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 雅各布斯身材结实，脸色红润。
ext.ext_en: Jacobs was a stout, florid man.

defs.def_en: Someone who is florid always has a red face.

ext.ext_cn: 他称其为美国军官的个性给他留下了很深的印象。
ext.ext_en: He is struck by what he calls the individualism of American officers.

defs.def_en: You use individualism to refer to the behaviour of someone who likes to think and do things in their own way, rather than imitating other people.

defs.def_cn: (国家对经济、政治的)不干涉主义，自由放任主义

ext.ext_cn: 他们的政治文化中浓厚的个人自由主义
ext.ext_en: ...the strong individualism in their political culture.

defs.def_en: Individualism is the belief that economics and politics should not be controlled by the state.

ext.ext_cn: 一瓣蒜
ext.ext_en: ...a clove of garlic.

defs.def_en: Garlic is the small, white, round bulb of a plant that is related to the onion plant. Garlic has a very strong smell and taste and is used in cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 我们坚信已经向前迈进了一步。
ext.ext_en: It is our firm conviction that a step forward has been taken...

ext.ext_cn: 由于宗教信仰的原因，他们不会拿起武器进行反抗。
ext.ext_en: Their religious convictions prevented them from taking up arms.

defs.def_en: A conviction is a strong belief or opinion.

ext.ext_cn: “我们会的，先生，”索恩坚定地说。
ext.ext_en: 'We shall, sir,' said Thorne, with conviction.

defs.def_en: If you have conviction, you have great confidence in your beliefs or opinions.

ext.ext_cn: 他的否认也没有说服力。
ext.ext_en: Nor did his denial carry conviction.

defs.def_en: If something carries conviction, it is likely to be true or likely to be believed.

ext.ext_cn: 他会对判决提起上诉。
ext.ext_en: He will appeal against his conviction...

ext.ext_cn: 因为有犯罪前科，警察们都认识这个人。
ext.ext_en: The man was known to the police because of previous convictions.

defs.def_en: If someone has a conviction, they have been found guilty of a crime in a court of law.

defs.def_cn: 改变资本结构；调整资本运行方式

ext.ext_cn: 沃诺克先生辞职了，因为公司放弃了一项资金重组计划。
ext.ext_en: Mr Warnock resigned as the company abandoned a plan to recapitalize...

ext.ext_cn: 他计划对保险基金进行重组。
ext.ext_en: He plans to recapitalize the insurance fund.

defs.def_en: If a company recapitalizes, it changes the way it manages its financial affairs, for example by borrowing money or reissuing shares.
A weather girl is a young woman who presents weather forecasts at regular times on television or radio.

ext.ext_cn: 我再次尝试联系我的表妹琼。
ext.ext_en: I tried again to get ahold of my cousin Joan.

defs.def_en: If you get ahold of someone or something, you manage to contact, find, or get them.

defs.def_cn: （受惊吓或遇到困难之后）保持镇静，保持理智

ext.ext_cn: 我一定要保持头脑冷静。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to have to get ahold of myself.

defs.def_en: If you get ahold of yourself, you force yourself to become calm and sensible after a shock or in a difficult situation.

ext.ext_cn: 它毫无用处，这让她很生气。
ext.ext_en: The sheer futility of it all exasperates her.

defs.def_en: If someone or something exasperates you, they annoy you and make you feel frustrated or upset.

ext.ext_cn: 危险因素会与日俱增已成为共识。
ext.ext_en: The consensus is that risk factors have an accumulative effect.

defs.def_en: If something is accumulative, it becomes greater in amount, number, or intensity over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 有关采用欧元的文章已经有很多。
ext.ext_en: Millions of words have been written about the introduction of the euro...

ext.ext_cn: 政府和企业将开始用欧元记账。
ext.ext_en: Governments and businesses will start keeping accounts in euros.

defs.def_en: The euro is a unit of currency that is used by the member countries of the European Union which have accepted European monetary union.
Broad beans are flat round beans that are light green in colour and are eaten as a vegetable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我在吃的方面一向很爱探究求索。
ext.ext_en: I have always had an enquiring mind where food is concerned...

ext.ext_cn: 所有这些都有助于培养孩子好学爱问的态度。
ext.ext_en: All this helps children to develop an inquiring attitude to learning.

defs.def_en: If you have an inquiring mind, you have a great interest in learning new things.

ext.ext_cn: 探询的一瞥
ext.ext_en: ...an enquiring glance.

defs.def_en: If someone has an inquiring expression on their face, they are showing that they want to know something.

ext.ext_cn: 尼尔之前在伯明翰的一所学校参加颁奖仪式。
ext.ext_en: Neil had been at a prize giving ceremony at a school in Birmingham.

ext.ext_cn: 养牛展的颁奖仪式
ext.ext_en: ...a prize-giving for cattle-breeding.

defs.def_en: also prizegiving. A prize-giving is a ceremony where prizes are awarded to people who have produced a very high standard of work.

ext.ext_cn: 李医生相信，锻炼身体能使患结肠癌的风险降低一半。
ext.ext_en: Dr Lee believes that men who exercise can halve their risk of cancer of the colon...

ext.ext_cn: 劳动力在两年里减少了一半。
ext.ext_en: The work force has been halved in two years...

defs.def_en: When you halve something or when it halves, it is reduced to half its previous size or amount.

ext.ext_cn: 将菠萝对半切开，挖出里面的果肉。
ext.ext_en: Halve the pineapple and scoop out the inside.

defs.def_en: If you halve something, you divide it into two equal parts.
Halves is the plural of half.

ext.ext_cn: 我原以为我们结婚后他会改变的。
ext.ext_en: I thought he would change after we got married...

ext.ext_cn: 他们相识一个月后就结婚了。
ext.ext_en: They married a month after they met...

defs.def_en: When two people get married or marry, they legally become husband and wife in a special ceremony. Get married is less formal and more commonly used than marry .

ext.ext_cn: 当地的牧师已经同意在庄园的小教堂里为我们主持婚礼。
ext.ext_en: The local vicar has agreed to marry us in the chapel on the estate...

ext.ext_cn: 我们于1957年7月在纽约举行了婚礼。
ext.ext_en: In July 1957, we were married in New York.

defs.def_en: When a priest or official marries two people, he or she conducts the ceremony in which the two people legally become husband and wife.

ext.ext_cn: 他把三个女儿都嫁给了王室的王子。
ext.ext_en: He married his three daughters to princes of the ruling house.

defs.def_en: If a parent marries their child to someone, the parent chooses who their child will marry and arranges it.
An adventurer is a person who enjoys going to new, unusual, and exciting places.

defs.def_cn: 投机取巧者；用不正当手段谋求钱财（或权利）者

ext.ext_cn: 不择手段的机会主义者和野心勃勃的政治投机者
ext.ext_en: ...unprincipled opportunists and ambitious political adventurers.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as an adventurer, you disapprove of them because they are using dishonest or immoral methods to gain money or power.

ext.ext_cn: 我走到街角等校车。
ext.ext_en: I walk to a street corner and wait for the school bus...

ext.ext_cn: 不要坐等事情发生。要创造条件让它们发生。
ext.ext_en: Stop waiting for things to happen. Make them happen...

defs.def_en: When you wait for something or someone, you spend some time doing very little, because you cannot act until that thing happens or that person arrives.

ext.ext_cn: 组织者宣布结果之前长达4小时的等待
ext.ext_en: ...the four-hour wait for the organizers to declare the result.

defs.def_en: A wait is a period of time in which you do very little, before something happens or before you can do something.

defs.def_cn: 准备妥当;可获得;可使用

ext.ext_cn: 会有辆汽车等你。
ext.ext_en: There'll be a car waiting for you...

ext.ext_cn: 我们到家时，有一顿美餐正等着我们享用。
ext.ext_en: When we came home we had a meal waiting for us...

defs.def_en: If something is waiting for you, it is ready for you to use, have, or do.

ext.ext_cn: 我想和你谈谈，但可以晚点再说。
ext.ext_en: I want to talk to you, but it can wait...

ext.ext_cn: 任何改变都要等找到赞助商之后再作决定。
ext.ext_en: Any changes will have to wait until sponsors can be found.

defs.def_en: If you say that something can wait, you mean that it is not important or urgent and so you will deal with it or do it later.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你觉得所有这些听起来令人兴奋，那就等着去读这本书吧。
ext.ext_en: If you think this all sounds very exciting, just wait until you read the book...

ext.ext_cn: 吃点儿东西你就会打起精神的。等着瞧吧。
ext.ext_en: As soon as you get some food inside you, you'll feel more cheerful. Just you wait.

defs.def_en: You can use wait when you are trying to make someone feel excited, or to encourage or threaten them.

ext.ext_cn: “等一下，”他插嘴说，“这没有给她一个公平的解释机会！”
ext.ext_en: 'Wait a minute!' he broke in. 'This is not giving her a fair hearing!'

defs.def_en: Wait is used in expressions such as wait a minute ,wait a second, and wait a moment to interrupt someone when they are speaking, for example because you object to what they are saying or because you want them to repeat something.

ext.ext_cn: 有很多仆人服侍她。
ext.ext_en: There were plenty of servants to wait on her...

ext.ext_cn: 每学期每个学生都要在餐厅服务一周。
ext.ext_en: Each student is expected to wait at table for one week each semester.

defs.def_en: If an employee waits on you, for example in a restaurant or hotel, they take orders from you and bring you what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 我们迫不及待地想开始。
ext.ext_en: We can't wait to get started...

ext.ext_cn: 那一定很棒。我都等不及了。
ext.ext_en: It's gonna be great. I can hardly wait...

defs.def_en: If you say that you can't wait to do something or can hardly wait to do it, you are emphasizing that you are very excited about it and eager to do it.

defs.def_cn: (让人在命令下达前勿提前做某事)等一等

ext.ext_cn: 手臂弯曲。手臂上举。保持一下。伸展。
ext.ext_en: Arms bend. Arms upward. Wait for it. Stretch.

defs.def_en: You say 'wait for it' to stop someone from doing something too soon because you have not yet given them the command to do it.

defs.def_cn: (表示接下来要说的内容非常有趣或令人惊奇)注意了，听好了

ext.ext_cn: 将花费整整50万美元获取货真价实的17世纪的空气，注意了，是从一个内有尸体的铅制棺材里获得。
ext.ext_en: A cool $500,000 is to be spent on obtaining genuine 17th-century air from the inside of, wait for it, an occupied lead coffin.

defs.def_en: You can use 'wait for it' to indicate that you are about to say something that is amusing or surprising.

ext.ext_cn: 我们只好等等看将会发生什么。
ext.ext_en: We'll have to wait and see what happens.

ext.ext_cn: 观望态度
ext.ext_en: ...a wait-and-see attitude.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to wait and see, you tell them that they must be patient or that they must not worry about what is going to happen in the future because they have no control over it.

ext.ext_cn: 那你还等什么呢？难道要我求你吻我吗？
ext.ext_en: Well, what are you waiting for? Do I have to ask you for a kiss?

defs.def_en: If you say to someone 'What are you waiting for?' you are telling them to hurry up and do something.

ext.ext_cn: 我的主人命令我务必私下里传递消息。
ext.ext_en: My master ordered me not to deliver the message except in private...

ext.ext_cn: 1777年，北方的几个州鼓励白人奴隶主解放奴隶，让他们参军。
ext.ext_en: In 1777 several northern states encouraged white masters to free their slaves for military service.

defs.def_en: A servant's master is the man that he or she works for.

ext.ext_cn: 主人打开抽屉拿出牵狗用的皮带时，狗兴奋地叫了起来。
ext.ext_en: The dog yelped excitedly when his master opened a desk drawer and produced his leash.

defs.def_en: A dog's master is the man or boy who owns it.

ext.ext_cn: 她是英文高手。
ext.ext_en: She was a master of the English language...

ext.ext_cn: 他特别擅长充当拦路虎。
ext.ext_en: He is a master at blocking progress...

defs.def_en: See also:past master;If you say that someone is a master of a particular activity, you mean that they are extremely skilled at it.

ext.ext_cn: 杰克逊镇定自若，始终克制着情绪。
ext.ext_en: Jackson remained calm and always master of his passions...

ext.ext_cn: 对于谁当家作主，他不抱任何幻想。
ext.ext_en: He was under no illusions as to who was master in his house.

defs.def_en: If you are master of a situation, you have complete  control over it.

ext.ext_cn: 达夫很快掌握了广播节目制作的技能。
ext.ext_en: Duff soon mastered the skills of radio production...

ext.ext_cn: 学生应该掌握一门第二语言。
ext.ext_en: Students are expected to master a second language.

defs.def_en: If you master something, you learn how to do it properly or you succeed in understanding it completely.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦控制住了一个局面，又得接着应付下一个。
ext.ext_en: When you have mastered one situation you have to go on to the next...

ext.ext_cn: 仅凭天分，他就控制了所有的危机。
ext.ext_en: His genius alone has mastered every crisis.

defs.def_en: If you master a difficult situation, you succeed in controlling it.

ext.ext_cn: 帕尔默先生是一名退休的数学教师。
ext.ext_en: Mr Palmer was a retired maths master.

defs.def_en: See also:headmaster;housemaster;A master is a male teacher.

ext.ext_cn: 一幅由荷兰著名画家文森特·凡·高所作的画像
ext.ext_en: ...a portrait by the Dutch master, Vincent Van Gogh.

defs.def_en: See also:old master;A famous male painter of the past is often called a master .

defs.def_cn: （电影、录音等）原始拷贝的，母盘的，母带的

ext.ext_cn: 一盘留作母带自用，其余的都分发出去。
ext.ext_en: Keep one as a master copy for your own reference and circulate the others.

defs.def_en: A master copy of something such as a film or a tape recording is an original copy that can be used to produce other copies.

ext.ext_cn: “皇家太平洋”号的船长
ext.ext_en: ...the Royal Pacific's master.

defs.def_en: The master of a ship that carries passengers or goods is its captain.

ext.ext_cn: 我获得了经济学硕士学位。
ext.ext_en: I've a master's in economics.

defs.def_en: A master's degree can be referred to as a master's .

defs.def_cn: 长老(信徒对宗教法师或领袖的称呼)

ext.ext_cn: 她认为自己是被长老选中来揭示被人们遗忘的智慧的。
ext.ext_en: She believed that she had been selected by the Master to reveal forgotten wisdom.

defs.def_en: Master is sometimes used by the followers of a male religious teacher or leader as a way of referring to him or addressing him.

defs.def_cn: (旧时的)少爷，小主人;君(现在用于信件中对男孩的称谓)

ext.ext_cn: 很高兴见到您，西蒙少爷。
ext.ext_en: Nice to see you, Master Simon.

defs.def_en: In the past, Master was used before a boy's name as a polite way of referring to him or addressing him. Nowadays, Master can be written before a boy's name when addressing a letter to him.

ext.ext_cn: 这绝非喜爱独立自主的人能呆下去的地方。
ext.ext_en: It was no place for a man who liked to be his own master.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are your own master, you mean that your decisions are not controlled by other people and you are free to do what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 毛巾布浴袍
ext.ext_en: ...a towelling bathrobe.

defs.def_en: Towelling is a kind of fairly thick soft cloth that is used especially for making towels.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 易卜生对中产阶级礼数的讽刺性抨击
ext.ext_en: ...Ibsen's satiric attack on bourgeois convention.

defs.def_en: Satiric means the same as satirical .

defs.def_cn: （连接两个或两个以上选择的可能性）或，或者，还是

ext.ext_cn: “喝茶还是喝咖啡？”约翰问道。
ext.ext_en: 'Tea or coffee?' John asked...

ext.ext_cn: 她的头发是金色还是深褐色？
ext.ext_en: Was she blonde or brunette?...

defs.def_en: You use or to link two or more alternatives.

defs.def_cn: （与 either 或 whether 连用，给出另一个选择项）或，还是，就是

ext.ext_cn: 像面包、牛奶和肉之类的东西要么是买不到，要么就是只能去黑市买。
ext.ext_en: Items like bread, milk and meat were either unavailable or could be obtained only on the black market...

ext.ext_cn: 要么你跟他谈，要么我去。
ext.ext_en: Either you can talk to him, or I will...

defs.def_en: You use or to give another alternative, when the first alternative is introduced by 'either' or 'whether'.

defs.def_cn: （用于两个数字之间表示概数）或，大约

ext.ext_cn: 每天只喝三四杯茶对身体有益。
ext.ext_en: Everyone benefited from limiting their intake of tea to just three or four cups a day...

ext.ext_cn: 我大概9岁或10岁的时候，有人跟我说人长大了就得工作。
ext.ext_en: When I was nine or ten someone explained to me that when you are grown up you have to work...

defs.def_en: You use or between two numbers to indicate that you are giving an approximate amount.

defs.def_cn: （用于对刚说过的话进行更正或补充）或者说

ext.ext_cn: 他想道，那人是个傻瓜，或者说，至少很无能。
ext.ext_en: The man was a fool, he thought, or at least incompetent...

ext.ext_cn: 他再无所求，或者说他是这么想的。
ext.ext_en: There was nothing more he wanted, or so he thought...

defs.def_en: You use or to introduce a comment which corrects or modifies what you have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 她必须动手术，要不然就没命了。
ext.ext_en: She had to have the operation, or she would die.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone should do something or something unpleasant will happen, you are warning them that if they do not do it, the unpleasant thing will happen.

defs.def_cn: （用于证明刚刚所作陈述的真实性）否则，要不然

ext.ext_cn: 我想，他一定认为简值得他这么做，否则他不会在她身上浪费时间。
ext.ext_en: He must have thought Jane was worth it or he wouldn't have wasted time on her, I suppose.

defs.def_en: You use or to introduce something which is evidence for the truth of a statement you have just made.

defs.def_cn: （表示某事物对即将发生的事没有影响）不管是不是…

ext.ext_cn: 不管我是不是主席，只要我想停止这个项目，我就能做到。
ext.ext_en: Chairman or no, if I want to stop the project, I can...

ext.ext_cn: 首要的难题是，过时也好，不过时也罢，它很不错。
ext.ext_en: The first difficulty is that, old-fashioned or not, it is very good.

defs.def_en: You use or no or or not to emphasize that a particular thing makes no difference to what is going to happen.

defs.def_cn: （用于重复的同一名词之间，表示某事物是否真实对情形没有影响）不管是否有…，无论有没有…

ext.ext_cn: 第二天是否下雨都没有差别，一切照常进行。
ext.ext_en: The next day, rain or no rain, it was business as usual...

ext.ext_cn: 不管是否有石油，塞尔维亚的困难都会存在。
ext.ext_en: Oil or no oil, Serbia has troubles.

defs.def_en: You use or no between two occurrences of the same noun in order to say that whether something is true or not makes no difference to a situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不证自明的;不言而喻的;明摆着的

ext.ext_cn: 不言而喻，我们永远都不会有足够的资源来满足需求。
ext.ext_en: It is self-evident that we will never have enough resources to meet the demand...

ext.ext_cn: 对该国的影响显而易见。
ext.ext_en: The implications for this country are self-evident.

defs.def_en: A fact or situation that is self-evident is so obvious that there is no need for proof or explanation.
A rabble-rouser is a clever speaker who can persuade a group of people to behave violently or aggressively, often for the speaker's own political advantage.
A rosehip is a bright red or orange fruit that grows on some kinds of rose bushes.
A persimmon is a soft, orange fruit that looks rather like a large tomato. Persimmons grow on trees in hot countries.

defs.def_cn: 使失去法律效力;废除;取消

ext.ext_cn: 他利用自己适用范围广泛的行政权力废止当地政府所作的决定。
ext.ext_en: He used his broad executive powers to nullify decisions by local governments...

ext.ext_en: It is worth remembering that previous wills are nullified automatically upon marriage.

defs.def_en: To nullify a legal decision or procedure means to declare that it is not legally valid.

ext.ext_cn: 他也许能通过供应更为多样化的农产品来抵消那一劣势。
ext.ext_en: He may be able to nullify that disadvantage by offering a wider variety of produce...

ext.ext_cn: 这毫无疑问会使该举措完全失效，而仅仅只是加速通货膨胀。
ext.ext_en: This, of course, would nullify the effect of the move and merely accelerate inflation.

defs.def_en: To nullify something means to make it have no effect.

ext.ext_cn: 他们最终决定通过住房合作社来重建奥米斯顿月牙街。
ext.ext_en: They decided a housing co-operative was the way to regenerate Ormiston Crescent...

ext.ext_cn: 这家饭店是合作经营的。
ext.ext_en: The restaurant is run as a co-operative.

defs.def_en: A co-operative is a business or organization run by the people who work for it, or owned by the people who use it. These people share its benefits and profits.

defs.def_cn: 齐心协力的;合作进行的

ext.ext_cn: 在埃及当局和美国当局的共同努力下他被顺利移交美国联邦调查局进行羁押。
ext.ext_en: He was transferred to FBI custody in a smooth co-operative effort between Egyptian and US authorities...

ext.ext_cn: 总统说这次访问将会促进两国之间的友好合作关系。
ext.ext_en: The President said the visit would develop friendly and co-operative relations between the two countries.

defs.def_en: A co-operative activity is done by people working together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 合作的;有协作精神的;愿意配合的

ext.ext_cn: 我尽了最大努力配合。
ext.ext_en: I made every effort to be co-operative.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is co-operative, you mean that they do what you ask them to without complaining or arguing.

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家的一些顶尖经济预测专家称经济复苏正在加速。
ext.ext_en: Some of the nation's top economic forecasters say the economic recovery is picking up speed.

defs.def_en: See also:weather forecaster;A forecaster is someone who uses detailed knowledge about a particular activity in order to work out what they think will happen in that activity in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 一小堆堆肥
ext.ext_en: ...a small compost heap.

defs.def_en: Compost is a mixture of decayed plants and vegetable waste which is added to the soil to help plants grow.
Compost is specially treated soil that you buy and use to grow seeds and plants in pots.

ext.ext_cn: 将已收获过的黄瓜、西红柿和其他作物的秧蔓割下，制成堆肥。
ext.ext_en: Cut down and compost spent cucumbers, tomatoes and other crops...

ext.ext_cn: 应该把花园里所有枯萎的花草制成堆肥，然后再用它们给花园施肥。
ext.ext_en: All garden waste should be composted and returned to the garden.

defs.def_en: To compost things such as unwanted bits of plants means to make them into compost.

ext.ext_cn: 患有这种过敏症的人也经常会患有哮喘病。
ext.ext_en: Frequently sufferers of this kind of allergy are also sufferers of asthma.

ext.ext_cn: 枯草热患者
ext.ext_en: ...hay-fever sufferers.

defs.def_en: A sufferer from an illness or some other bad condition is a person who is affected by the illness or condition.

ext.ext_cn: 我们找地方见面一起吃个午饭好不好？
ext.ext_en: Shall we meet somewhere for lunch?...

ext.ext_cn: 他不喜欢吃工作午餐。
ext.ext_en: He did not enjoy business lunches...

defs.def_en: Lunch is the meal that you have in the middle of the day.  →see usage note at:meal

ext.ext_cn: 只有非常有钱的人才能在米拉贝勒餐厅吃得起午餐。
ext.ext_en: Only the extremely rich could afford to lunch at the Mirabelle...

ext.ext_cn: 我们都没吃午饭，于是便去小吃店买了火腿三明治。
ext.ext_en: Having not yet lunched, we went to the refreshment bar for ham sandwiches.

defs.def_en: When you lunch, you have lunch, especially at a restaurant.

ext.ext_cn: 本书共包括25堂“人生课”：第一课，没有免费的午餐。别以为可以不劳而获。
ext.ext_en: The book includes 25 Lessons for Life: Lesson 1: There is no free lunch. Don't  feel entitled to anything you don't sweat and struggle for...

ext.ext_cn: 但即使是在好莱坞也没有免费的午餐。
ext.ext_en: But, even in Hollywood, there is no such thing as a free lunch.

defs.def_en: If you say there's no such thing as a free lunch, you are saying that most things that are worth having need to be paid for or worked for, and that you cannot expect to get things for nothing.

ext.ext_cn: 它是槭木做的。
ext.ext_en: It's made of maple.

ext.ext_cn: 它是槭木做的。
ext.ext_en: It's made of maple.

defs.def_en: A maple or a maple tree is a tree with five-pointed leaves which turn bright red or gold in autumn.

ext.ext_cn: 嫉妒会带来忧虑和痛苦。
ext.ext_en: Jealousy causes distress and painful emotions.

ext.ext_cn: 疼痛和悲伤让她嘴巴发僵。
ext.ext_en: Her mouth grew stiff with pain and distress.

defs.def_en: Distress is a state of extreme sorrow, suffering, or pain.

ext.ext_cn: 他担心船可能会遇险。
ext.ext_en: He expressed concern that the ship might be in distress.

ext.ext_cn: 这名警察收到了求救呼叫，看见两个年轻人正在殴打他的同事。
ext.ext_en: The constable received a distress call, and saw two youths attacking his colleague.

defs.def_en: Distress is the state of being in extreme danger and needing urgent help.

ext.ext_cn: 想到托尼正处于危险中，他心急如焚。
ext.ext_en: The idea of Toni being in danger distresses him enormously.

ext.ext_cn: 我并不想吓到马或惹怒它。
ext.ext_en: I did not want to frighten or distress the horse.

defs.def_en: If someone or something distresses you, they cause you to be upset or worried.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一些年轻人孩童时脾气随和、性格活泼，刚进入青春期却变得害羞起来。
ext.ext_en: Some young people who were easy-going and extroverted as children become self-conscious in early adolescence.

defs.def_en: Someone who is extroverted is very active, lively, and friendly.

defs.def_cn: 无法满足的;贪得无厌的

ext.ext_cn: 公众对名人有着难以满足的好奇心。
ext.ext_en: The public has an insatiable appetite for stories about the famous...

ext.ext_cn: 他们是贪得无厌的征税员。
ext.ext_en: They were insatiable collectors.

defs.def_en: If someone has an insatiable desire for something, they want as much of it as they can possibly get.

ext.ext_cn: 我再也不想和这些笨蛋打交道了。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to deal with these imbeciles any longer.

defs.def_en: If you call someone an imbecile, you are showing that you think they are stupid or have done something stupid.

ext.ext_cn: 这么做很愚蠢。
ext.ext_en: It was an imbecile thing to do.

defs.def_en: Imbecile means stupid.
In the past, people who had something wrong with their brains that made them seem less intelligent, or different from other people, were sometimes called imbeciles .

ext.ext_cn: 他在广播剧中扮演角色。
ext.ext_en: He acted in radio dramas.

defs.def_en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio.

defs.def_cn: 戏剧;戏剧艺术;戏剧事业

ext.ext_cn: 他对希腊戏剧一无所知。
ext.ext_en: He knew nothing of Greek drama...

ext.ext_cn: 她在戏剧学校上学时认识了他。
ext.ext_en: She met him when she was at drama school.

defs.def_en: You use drama to refer to plays in general or to work that is connected with plays and the theatre, such as acting or producing.

defs.def_cn: 戏剧性事件;戏剧性情节

ext.ext_cn: 丝毫没有释放人质时的那种激动和如释重负的感觉。
ext.ext_en: There was none of the drama and relief of a hostage release...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然这件事带有戏剧性，但并不意外。
ext.ext_en: For all its drama, the event was not unexpected.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a real situation which is exciting or distressing as drama .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The February air was soft, cool, and inviting...

ext.ext_cn: 有一家诱人的带露天阳台的饭馆。
ext.ext_en: There is an inviting restaurant with an outdoor terrace.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is inviting, you mean that it has good qualities that attract you or make you want to experience it.

ext.ext_cn: 生活在卡里巴湖滨的大象
ext.ext_en: ...elephants living on the shores of Lake Kariba...

defs.def_en: The shores or the shore of a sea, lake, or wide river is the land along the edge of it. Someone who is on shore is on the land rather than on a ship.

ext.ext_cn: 人们担心类似的流行病很快会传到欧洲。
ext.ext_en: It is feared that a similar epidemic will soon reach the shores of Europe...

ext.ext_cn: 这个年轻人是又一个注定要离开这个国家的人。
ext.ext_en: This youngster is another destined to leave these shores.

defs.def_en: When someone or something reaches the shores of a country or continent, they arrive in that country or continent.

ext.ext_en: Those cells divide and give many other different types of cells.

ext.ext_cn: 血细胞
ext.ext_en: ...blood cells...

defs.def_en: A cell is the smallest part of an animal or plant that is able to function independently. Every animal or plant is made up of millions of cells.

defs.def_cn: 单人牢房；(修道院的)单人小室
defs.def_en: A cell is a small room in which a prisoner is locked. A cell is also a small room in which a monk or nun lives.

ext.ext_cn: 共产党的基层组织
ext.ext_en: ...Communist Party cells.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a small group of people within a larger organization as a cell .
