Kidney beans are long, very narrow beans that are green in colour and are eaten as a vegetable. They grow on a tall climbing plant and are the cases that contain the seeds of the plant.

ext.ext_cn: 免费拨打我们的客服电话。
ext.ext_en: Call our customer-service staff toll-free.

ext.ext_cn: 免费拨打我们的客服电话。
ext.ext_en: Call our customer-service staff toll-free.

defs.def_en: A toll-free telephone number is one which you can dial without having to pay for the call.
A turboprop is a turbine engine that makes an aircraft propeller go round.
A turboprop is an aircraft with one or more turboprops.

ext.ext_cn: 有足够的人投票给工党,使之轻易战胜了保守党。
ext.ext_en: Enough people voted for the Labour Party to give the Conservatives a drubbing.

defs.def_en: If someone gets a drubbing, they are defeated easily.

ext.ext_en: His ignorance appals me...

ext.ext_en: My wife now looks like her mother, which appals me.

defs.def_en: If something appals you, it disgusts you because it seems so bad or unpleasant.

ext.ext_en: Social Security refused to pay her more than £17 per week...

ext.ext_en: Buses and trains use much less fuel per person than cars.

ext.ext_cn: 来到这里后，他们抱怨工资没有依照协议发放。
ext.ext_en: When they reach here they complain that they are not being paid as per the agreement...

ext.ext_en: I approached an Intourist official, as per instructions.

defs.def_en: If something happens as per a particular plan or suggestion, it happens in the way planned or suggested.

defs.def_cn: (场所或建筑物)舍弃不用的，无人居住的

ext.ext_cn: 东挖西掘后留下了一片废弃的矿坑。
ext.ext_en: All that digging had left a network of abandoned mines and tunnels.

ext.ext_cn: 沦为了犯罪温床的弃置楼群
ext.ext_en: ...abandoned buildings that become a breeding ground for crime.

defs.def_en: An abandoned place or building is no longer used or occupied.

A warship is a ship with guns that is used for fighting in wars.

defs.def_cn: 相反的;成反比的;相逆的

ext.ext_en: The tension grew in inverse proportion to the distance from their final destination.

defs.def_en: If there is an inverse relationship between two things, one of them becomes larger as the other becomes smaller.

ext.ext_cn: 你根本就不想把你的逻辑反过来考虑。
ext.ext_en: There is no sign that you bothered to consider the inverse of your logic.

ext.ext_cn: 全息图可以通过反转显现出逆像。
ext.ext_en: The hologram can be flipped to show the inverse image.

defs.def_en: The inverse of something is its exact opposite.

ext.ext_cn: 某种特定语言的发音体系
ext.ext_en: ...the phonic system underlying a particular language.

defs.def_en: In linguistics, phonic means relating to the sounds of speech.
Phonics is a method of teaching people to read by training them to associate written letters with their sounds.

ext.ext_cn: 他听到了钟的嘀嗒声。
ext.ext_en: He was conscious of a clock ticking...

ext.ext_cn: 他也修钟表。
ext.ext_en: He also repairs clocks and watches...

defs.def_en: A clock is an instrument, for example in a room or on the outside of a building, that shows what time of day it is.

ext.ext_cn: 公务员早、中、晚都要打卡。
ext.ext_en: Government workers were made to punch time clocks morning, noon and night.

defs.def_en: A time clock in a factory or office is a device that is used to record the hours that people work. Each worker puts a special card into the device when they arrive and leave, and the times are recorded on the card.

ext.ext_cn: 里程表显示此车已行驶了16万英里.
ext.ext_en: The car had 160,000 miles on the clock...

ext.ext_cn: 车速达到每小时240英里时,里程表上的指针显示超出了最高时速。
ext.ext_en: At 240 mph the needle went off the clock.

defs.def_en: In a car, the clock is the instrument that shows the speed of the car or the distance it has travelled.

defs.def_cn: 达到(特定的时间或速度)

ext.ext_cn: 埃利奥特跑出了今年800米的最快速度
ext.ext_en: Elliott clocked the fastest time this year for the 800 metres...

ext.ext_cn: 游艇在风速为40节的大风中摇摆前行，有时航速能达到17节。
ext.ext_en: The yacht swayed in 40-knot winds, clocking speeds of 17 knots at times.

defs.def_en: To clock  a particular time or speed in a race means to reach that time or speed.

ext.ext_cn: 他100米跑了11秒。
ext.ext_en: He has been clocked at 11 seconds for 100 metres...

ext.ext_cn: 在北卡罗来纳州一处山顶测得的风速为每小时170英里。
ext.ext_en: 170-mile-an-hour winds were clocked on a mountaintop in North Carolina.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is clocked at a particular time or speed, their time or speed is measured at that level.

ext.ext_cn: 那家公司有任何丑闻，博比肯定会知道。
ext.ext_en: If there was any scandal in that company, you can be sure that Bobby will have clocked it.

defs.def_en: If you clock something, you notice or see it.

ext.ext_cn: 开始涨潮了，紧急救援机构正在争分夺秒地工作。
ext.ext_en: The emergency services were working against the clock as the tide began to rise...

ext.ext_cn: 从现在开始要跟时间赛跑。
ext.ext_en: It's now become a race against the clock.

defs.def_en: If you are doing something against the clock, you are doing it in a great hurry, because there is very little time.
If you beat the clock, you finish doing something or succeed in doing something before the time allowed for doing it has ended.

ext.ext_cn: 救援部门一直在日夜不停地工作，解救被困司机。
ext.ext_en: Rescue services have been working round the clock to free stranded motorists...

ext.ext_cn: 我们没有能力对你提供24小时的保护。
ext.ext_en: We can't afford to give you around-the-clock protection.

defs.def_en: If something is done round the clock or around the clock, it is done all day and all night without stopping.

ext.ext_cn: 在某些方面，我们希望能回到以前。
ext.ext_en: In some ways we wish we could turn the clock back...

ext.ext_cn: 我们无法让时光倒流。
ext.ext_en: We cannot put back the clock.

defs.def_en: If you want to turn the clock back or put the clock back, you want to return to a situation that used to exist, usually because the present situation is unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: (通常指因不耐烦而)不断看时间，老是看钟表

ext.ext_cn: 课大约上了一半，我就开始不停地看时间。
ext.ext_en: I started to watch the clock about halfway through the class.

defs.def_en: If you are watching the clock, you keep looking to see what time it is, usually because you are bored by something and want it to end as soon as possible.
In physics, kinetic is used to describe something that is concerned with movement.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她推开一扇嘎吱作响的门。
ext.ext_en: She pushed open a creaky door.

defs.def_en: A creaky object creaks when it moves.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 老朽的;破旧的;不时兴的

ext.ext_cn: 它陈旧而腐朽的政治体系
ext.ext_en: ...its creaky and corrupt political system.

ext.ext_cn: 这本老掉牙的英国惊险小说
ext.ext_en: ...this creaky old British thriller.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as creaky, you think it is bad in some way because it is old or old-fashioned.

defs.def_cn: 各式各样的东西;大杂烩

ext.ext_cn: 塞满了各式各样东西的玻璃橱柜
ext.ext_en: ...glass cases filled with a miscellany of objects...

ext.ext_cn: 最上层的抽屉装着各式各样的外国硬币和钞票。
ext.ext_en: The top drawer held a miscellany of foreign coins and banknotes.

defs.def_en: A miscellany of things is a collection or group of many different kinds of things.

ext.ext_cn: 硫也可用来给器材消毒。
ext.ext_en: Sulphur is also used to sterilize equipment...

ext.ext_cn: 牛奶经过灭菌处理后被封装在瓶子里。
ext.ext_en: The milk was sterilized and sealed in bottles.

defs.def_en: If you sterilize a thing or a place, you make it completely clean and free from germs.

ext.ext_cn: 我妻子生完第4个孩子后做了绝育手术。
ext.ext_en: My wife was sterilized after the birth of her fourth child.

defs.def_en: If a person or an animal is sterilized, they have a medical operation that makes it impossible for them to have or produce babies.

defs.def_cn: 纪念死者的文字；（常指）墓志铭，碑文
defs.def_en: An epitaph is a short piece of writing about someone who is dead, often carved on their grave.

ext.ext_cn: 好像有越来越多的人支持领导层采取更为强势的立场。
ext.ext_en: There appears to be increasing support for the leadership to take a more aggressive stance...

ext.ext_cn: 飞机似乎在加德满都附近坠毁了。
ext.ext_en: The aircraft appears to have crashed near Katmandu...

defs.def_en: If you say that something appears to be the way you describe it, you are reporting what you believe or what you have been told, though you cannot be sure it is true.

ext.ext_cn: 她竭力让自己表现得比实际更自信。
ext.ext_en: She did her best to appear more self-assured than she felt...

ext.ext_cn: 他急于想表现得像个绅士。
ext.ext_en: He is anxious to appear a gentleman...

defs.def_en: If someone or something appears to have a particular quality or characteristic, they give the impression of having that quality or characteristic.

ext.ext_cn: 一个女人远远出现在街的尽头。
ext.ext_en: A woman appeared at the far end of the street...

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚，其中几个犯人出现在房顶上。
ext.ext_en: Last night some of the prisoners appeared on the roof.

defs.def_en: When someone or something appears, they move into a position where you can see them.

ext.ext_cn: 初夏时绽放的白色小花
ext.ext_en: ...small white flowers which appear in early summer...

ext.ext_cn: 标语已出现在全城周围的墙上。
ext.ext_en: Slogans have appeared on walls around the city.

defs.def_en: When something new appears, it begins to exist or reaches a stage of development where its existence can be noticed.

ext.ext_cn: 每个月我都翘首期盼着《男孩世界》的出版。
ext.ext_en: I could hardly wait for 'Boys' World' to appear each month.

ext.ext_cn: 发表在他最后一部诗集中的一首诗
ext.ext_en: ...a poem which appeared in his last collection of verse.

defs.def_en: When something such as a book appears, it is published or becomes available for people to buy.

ext.ext_cn: 吉尔·本内特成为了约翰·奥斯本的第四任妻子，并参演过他的几部戏剧。
ext.ext_en: Jill Bennett became John Osborne's fourth wife, and appeared in several of his plays...

ext.ext_cn: 学生领袖出现在电视上请求大家保持冷静。
ext.ext_en: Student leaders appeared on television to ask for calm.

defs.def_en: When someone appears in something such as a play, a show, or a television programme, they take part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 又有两个经理因偷税漏税指控被传唤到沃辛治安法庭。
ext.ext_en: Two other executives appeared at Worthing Magistrates' Court charged with tax fraud...

ext.ext_cn: 那个美国人将在波特曼广场接受纪律委员会成员的审问。
ext.ext_en: The American will appear before members of the disciplinary committee at Portman Square.

defs.def_en: When someone appears before a court of law or before an official committee, they go there in order to answer charges or to give information as a witness.

ext.ext_cn: 最近，几名警察因串谋杀人被判处死刑。
ext.ext_en: Recently a number of policemen were sentenced to death for their complicity in the murder...

ext.ext_cn: 他被控与政变首领——前上校格雷戈里奥·霍纳桑——串通一气。
ext.ext_en: He is accused of complicity with the leader of the coup, former Colonel Gregorio Honasan.

defs.def_en: Complicity is involvement with other people in an illegal activity or plan.

ext.ext_cn: 她利用了他，甚至离婚后还在欺骗他。
ext.ext_en: She took advantage of him, stringing him along even after they were divorced.

defs.def_en: If you string someone along, you deceive them by letting them believe you have the same desires, beliefs, or hopes as them.

ext.ext_cn: 汽酒还可以提高玩乐的兴致。
ext.ext_en: Sparkling wine can also put you in the party spirit.

defs.def_en: If you talk about someone being in the party spirit, you mean that they are in the mood to enjoy a party or to have fun.
Beside the sea, a lake, or a wide river, the foreshore is the part of the shore which is between the highest and lowest points reached by the water.
A footbridge is a narrow bridge for people travelling on foot.

ext.ext_cn: 两党分歧甚大，还远未能结成同盟。
ext.ext_en: The two parties were still too much apart to form an alliance.

defs.def_en: An alliance is a group of countries or political parties that are formally united and working together because they have similar aims.

ext.ext_cn: 若IBM公司和苹果公司联合将会有什么效果呢？
ext.ext_en: What will be the effect of the alliance between IBM and Apple?...

ext.ext_cn: 他们现在可以选择与自由民主党人或绿党结盟来执掌国家政权。
ext.ext_en: They are now in a position to govern the state in alliance with either the Free Democrats or the Green Party.

defs.def_en: An alliance is a relationship in which two countries, political parties, or organizations work together for some purpose.
Phosphorescence is a glow or soft light which is produced in the dark without using heat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 尽管听着像是自怜，我还是要说这对我比对乔安妮更难承受。
ext.ext_en: At the risk of sounding self-pitying, I'd say it has been harder on me than it has on Joanne.

defs.def_en: Someone who is self-pitying is full of self-pity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 紧张的;不安的;神经紧绷的

ext.ext_cn: 今晚，他躁动不安，紧张兮兮的。
ext.ext_en: Tonight he is manic, wired and uptight.

defs.def_en: If someone is wired, they are tense, nervous, and unable to relax.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦更多人能上网，网络改变主流媒体的潜力将十分巨大。
ext.ext_en: Once more people are wired, the potential to change the mainstream media will be huge.

defs.def_en: A computer, organization, or person that is wired has the equipment that is necessary to use the Internet.

defs.def_cn: (材料或衣服)内带金属丝的，夹丝的

ext.ext_cn: 一段夹丝的丝带
ext.ext_en: ...a length of wired ribbon.

defs.def_en: Wired is used to describe material or clothing that has wires sewn into it in order to keep it stiff.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as dumpy, you mean they are short and fat, and are usually implying they are unattractive.

ext.ext_cn: 一群人正站在一起痛饮啤酒。
ext.ext_en: A crowd of men were standing around swilling beer.

defs.def_en: If you swill an alcoholic drink, you drink a lot of it.

defs.def_cn: (使)(液体)晃动,摇晃;(使)来回流动

ext.ext_cn: 大量海水冲入了船舱，正在船底来回晃荡。
ext.ext_en: Gallons of sea water had rushed into the cabin and were now swilling about in the bilges...

ext.ext_cn: 她晃动着杯中的威士忌。
ext.ext_en: She swilled the whisky around in her glass.

defs.def_en: If a liquid swills around, or if you swill it around, it moves around the area that it is contained in.

ext.ext_cn: 喝完咖啡后，他涮了涮杯子然后把它放在滴水板上。
ext.ext_en: Having finished his coffee, he swilled out the mug and left it on the draining board.

defs.def_en: To swill out something means to clean it by pouring water over it.
Swill is a liquid mixture containing waste food that is given to pigs to eat.
A putter is a club used for hitting a golf ball a short distance once it is on the green.

defs.def_cn: 慢条斯理地工作；悠然自得地做

ext.ext_cn: 我开始在外面闲荡，不知道自己在做什么。
ext.ext_en: I started puttering around outside, not knowing what I was doing...

ext.ext_cn: 她喜欢在厨房里磨洋工。
ext.ext_en: She liked to putter in the kitchen.

defs.def_en: If you putter around, you do unimportant but quite enjoyable things, without hurrying.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们只不过是普通人，太容易犯错误了。
ext.ext_en: They are only human and all too fallible...

ext.ext_cn: 时间一次又一次证明,这个系统是会出错的。
ext.ext_en: The system has proved fallible time after time...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is fallible, you mean that they are not perfect and are likely to make mistakes or to fail in what they are doing.
A piece of music that is played fortissimo is played very loudly.

defs.def_cn: (房屋、工厂、道路、桥梁等的)建筑，建造

ext.ext_cn: 他已经开始建造一间狩猎用的小屋。
ext.ext_en: He'd already started construction on a hunting lodge.

ext.ext_cn: 英国唯一一家在建的核电站
ext.ext_en: ...the only nuclear power station under construction in Britain.

defs.def_en: Construction is the building of things such as houses, factories, roads, and bridges.

ext.ext_cn: 长期从事此类设备制造的公司
ext.ext_en: ...companies who have long experience in the construction of those types of equipment...

ext.ext_cn: 这是除柚木以外最好的造船木材。
ext.ext_en: With the exception of teak, this is the finest wood for boat construction.

defs.def_en: The construction of something such as a vehicle or machine is the making of it.

ext.ext_cn: 一套公正的刑事审判制度的创建
ext.ext_en: ...the construction of a just system of criminal justice.

defs.def_en: The construction of something such as a system is the creation of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这座英式亭阁是令人赞叹的钢和玻璃建筑，大小和威斯敏斯特教堂相当。
ext.ext_en: The British pavilion is an impressive steel and glass construction the size of Westminster Abbey.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an object that has been built or made as a construction .

ext.ext_cn: 震颤派教徒认为家具应当朴素、简单、有用、实用，并且结构合理。
ext.ext_en: The Shakers believed that furniture should be plain, simple, useful, practical and of sound construction...

ext.ext_cn: 这些椅子构造轻巧，但却极为结实。
ext.ext_en: The chairs were light in construction yet extremely strong.

defs.def_en: You use construction to refer to the structure of something and the way it has been built or made.

defs.def_cn: (对某人言行的)解释，理解，阐释

ext.ext_cn: 这种否认仅限于不接受对他所说话语的阐释。
ext.ext_en: The denial was limited to rejecting the construction put on his remarks...

ext.ext_cn: 他误解了所见到的事情。
ext.ext_en: He put the wrong construction on what he saw.

defs.def_en: The construction that you put on what someone says or does is your interpretation of what it means.

ext.ext_cn: 避免使用复杂的动词结构。
ext.ext_en: Avoid complex verbal constructions.

defs.def_en: A grammatical construction is a particular arrangement of words in a sentence, clause, or phrase.

defs.def_cn: （数字或数量）趋向平缓，趋于稳定

ext.ext_cn: 数据表明，该国首都谋杀案件的数量开始保持在稳定的水平。
ext.ext_en: The figures show evidence that murders in the nation's capital are beginning to level off...

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀率最终稳定在每月11%左右。
ext.ext_en: Inflation is finally levelling out at around 11% a month.

defs.def_en: If a changing number or amount levels off or levels out, it stops increasing or decreasing at such a fast speed.

defs.def_cn: （飞机在爬升或下降后）进入平飞

ext.ext_cn: 飞机在大约3万英尺的高度进入水平飞行。
ext.ext_en: The aircraft levelled out at about 30,000 feet.

defs.def_en: If an aircraft levels off or levels out, it travels horizontally after having been travelling in an upwards or downwards direction.

ext.ext_cn: 食用菌
ext.ext_en: ...edible fungi.

defs.def_en: If something is edible, it is safe to eat and not poisonous.

ext.ext_cn: 有那么一会儿,凯瑟琳很想逃跑。
ext.ext_en: For an instant, Catherine was tempted to flee...

ext.ext_cn: 疼痛立刻就消失了。
ext.ext_en: The pain disappeared in an instant.

defs.def_en: An instant is an extremely short period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 就在那时,博物馆陷入了一片漆黑。
ext.ext_en: At that instant the museum was plunged into total darkness...

ext.ext_cn: 与此同时,他猛地推开了车门。
ext.ext_en: In the same instant he flung open the car door.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens at a particular instant, you mean that it happens at exactly the time you have been referring to, and you are usually suggesting that it happens quickly or immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 我一看到蝙蝠就把门闩上了。
ext.ext_en: I had bolted the door the instant I had seen the bat.

defs.def_en: To do something the instant something else happens means to do it immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 波特先生的书一经推出便大受欢迎。
ext.ext_en: Mr Porter's book was an instant hit...

ext.ext_cn: 他一到莫特莱克就觉得不喜欢这个地方。
ext.ext_en: He had taken an instant dislike to Mortlake.

defs.def_en: You use instant to describe something that happens immediately.

defs.def_cn: (食品)已配制好的，调制快速方便的，速溶的

ext.ext_cn: 速溶咖啡
ext.ext_en: ...instant coffee.

defs.def_en: Instant food is food that you can prepare very quickly, for example by just adding water.

ext.ext_cn: 她匆匆写了个便条告诉妈妈她已外出。
ext.ext_en: She scribbled a note to tell Mum she'd gone out...

ext.ext_cn: 我正草草地写着日记，灯灭了。
ext.ext_en: As I scribbled in my diary the light went out.

defs.def_en: If you scribble something, you write it quickly and roughly.

ext.ext_cn: 卡罗琳 5 岁时在墙上乱涂乱画。
ext.ext_en: When Caroline was five she scribbled on a wall.

defs.def_en: To scribble means to make meaningless marks or rough drawings using a pencil or pen.

ext.ext_cn: 很抱歉我写得如此潦草。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry what I wrote was such a scribble.

defs.def_en: Scribble is something that has been written or drawn quickly and roughly.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得非常沮丧。
ext.ext_en: I am feeling very depressed...

ext.ext_cn: 我会永远感激那个小伙子。
ext.ext_en: I will always feel grateful to that little guy...

defs.def_en: If you feel a particular emotion or physical sensation, you experience it.

defs.def_cn: (经历或事件)给人…感觉，令人有…感觉

ext.ext_cn: 完成一项工作后感觉很好。
ext.ext_en: It feels good to have finished a piece of work...

ext.ext_cn: 一切进展如此之快让人感觉不对劲。
ext.ext_en: The speed at which everything moved felt strange...

defs.def_en: If you talk about how an experience or event feels, you talk about the emotions and sensations connected with it.

ext.ext_cn: 这种金属摸起来冰冷而光滑。
ext.ext_en: The metal felt smooth and cold...

ext.ext_cn: 10 英尺长的桨拿起来感觉很笨重。
ext.ext_en: The ten-foot oars felt heavy and awkward...

defs.def_en: If you talk about how an object feels, you talk about the physical quality that you notice when you touch or hold it. For example, if something feels soft, you notice that it is soft when you touch it.

ext.ext_cn: 那天感觉像冬天一样寒冷。
ext.ext_en: It felt wintry cold that day.

defs.def_en: If you talk about how the weather feels, you describe the weather, especially the temperature or whether or not you think it is going to rain or snow.

ext.ext_cn: 医生摸了摸他的头。
ext.ext_en: The doctor felt his head...

ext.ext_cn: 晾干之后，表面摸上去就不再光滑了。
ext.ext_en: When dry, feel the surface and it will no longer be smooth...

defs.def_en: If you feel an object, you touch it deliberately with your hand, so that you learn what it is like, for example what shape it is or whether it is rough or smooth.

ext.ext_cn: 透过好几层衣服，我能感觉到他的肌肉。
ext.ext_en: Through several layers of clothes I could feel his muscles...

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉到她的腿贴着自己的腿。
ext.ext_en: He felt her leg against his.

defs.def_en: If you can feel something, you are aware of it because it is touching you.

ext.ext_cn: 她感觉有什么东西塞到了她手里。
ext.ext_en: She felt something being pressed into her hands...

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉身边有什么东西在动。
ext.ext_en: He felt something move beside him...

defs.def_en: If you feel something happening, you become aware of it because of the effect it has on your body.

ext.ext_cn: 我不觉脸红了。
ext.ext_en: I felt myself blush...

ext.ext_cn: 如果什么时候感到紧张，就有意识地放松。
ext.ext_en: If at any point you feel yourself becoming tense, make a conscious effort to relax...

defs.def_en: If you feel yourself doing something or being in a particular state, you are aware that something is happening to you which you are unable to control.

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉到她在看着他。
ext.ext_en: He felt her eyes on him...

ext.ext_cn: 突然，我感觉身后有什么东西。
ext.ext_en: Suddenly, I felt a presence behind me...

defs.def_en: If you feel the presence of someone or something, you become aware of them, even though you cannot see or hear them.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得对当地野生动物的保护力度不够。
ext.ext_en: I feel that not enough is being done to protect the local animal life...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得最后肯定会皆大欢喜。
ext.ext_en: I feel certain that it will all turn out well...

defs.def_en: If you feel that something is the case, you have a strong idea in your mind that it is the case.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得自己应该辞职。
ext.ext_en: I feel I should resign...

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得他必须去做。
ext.ext_en: He felt that he had to do it...

defs.def_en: If you feel that you should do something, you think that you should do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们想知道你对堕胎是怎么看的。
ext.ext_en: We'd like to know what you feel about abortion...

ext.ext_cn: 对回到这个街区你有何感想？
ext.ext_en: How do you feel about going back to the neighborhood?...

defs.def_en: If you talk about how you feel about something, you talk about your opinion, attitude, or reaction to it.

ext.ext_cn: 他俩都不想回去睡觉。
ext.ext_en: Neither of them felt like going back to sleep...

ext.ext_cn: 我们去散散步好吗？我想活动一下。
ext.ext_en: Could we take a walk? I feel like a little exercise.

defs.def_en: If you feel like doing something or having something, you want to do it or have it because you are in the right mood for it and think you would enjoy it.

defs.def_cn: 感受，体会，承受(某种后果或影响)

ext.ext_cn: 这家慈善机构仍受到其前主席被检举带来的影响。
ext.ext_en: The charity is still feeling the effects of revelations about its one-time president...

ext.ext_cn: 发展中国家将会受到真正的影响。
ext.ext_en: The real impact will be felt in the developing world.

defs.def_en: If you feel the effect or result of something, you experience it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个房间有一种温暖舒适的感觉。
ext.ext_en: The room has a warm, cosy feel.

ext.ext_cn: 一本史诗般的书
ext.ext_en: ...a book that takes on the feel of an epic.

defs.def_en: The feel of something, for example a place, is the general impression that it gives you.

ext.ext_cn: 我在里兜里摸钱包和证件。
ext.ext_en: I felt for my wallet and papers in my inside pocket...

ext.ext_cn: 我一屁股坐在常坐的椅子上，摸索着找报纸。
ext.ext_en: I slumped down in my usual armchair and felt around for the newspaper.

defs.def_en: If you feel for something, for example in the dark, you try to find it by moving your hand around until you touch it.

ext.ext_cn: 她在电话里哭了，非常难过，我很同情她。
ext.ext_en: She cried on the phone and was very upset and I really felt for her.

defs.def_en: If you feel for someone, you have sympathy for them.

ext.ext_cn: 限制房屋开发的法规
ext.ext_en: ...ordinances that restrict building development.

defs.def_en: An ordinance is an official rule or order.
A cabbage is a round vegetable with white, green or purple leaves that is usually eaten cooked.

defs.def_cn: 植物人;（脑部受损或患重病的）废人
defs.def_en: If someone refers to a very sick or disabled person as a cabbage, they are saying in an offensive way that the sick person is so badly brain-damaged or ill that they cannot do anything.

defs.def_cn: 只能同甘不能共苦的;顺境中的

ext.ext_cn: 不能患难与共的朋友
ext.ext_en: ...a fair-weather friend.

defs.def_en: You use fair-weather to refer to someone who offers help to someone, or who takes part in a particular activity, only when it is easy or pleasant for them to do so.

defs.def_cn: （建筑、家具、艺术品）洛可可式（18世纪流行于欧洲的装饰风格，常包括精致繁琐的曲线形装饰）
defs.def_en: Rococo is a decorative style that was popular in Europe in the eighteenth century. Rococo buildings, furniture, and works of art often include complicated curly decoration.

ext.ext_cn: 莫斯可夫斯基百货商场，一座靠近市中心的大型多层综合建筑
ext.ext_en: ...the Moskovski Department Store, a vast multi-story complex near the city's center.

ext.ext_cn: 多层停车场
ext.ext_en: ...a multi-storey car park.

defs.def_en: A multi-storey building has several floors at different levels above the ground.

defs.def_cn: （使）（戏剧性的事件）逐渐发生；（使）展开

ext.ext_cn: 她对工会的改革是在失业率不断上升的背景下展开的。
ext.ext_en: Her union reforms were played out against a background of rising unemployment...

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影和现实生活中发生的一系列戏剧性事件有着诡异的巧合之处。
ext.ext_en: The film has eerie parallels with the drama being played out in real life.

defs.def_en: If a dramatic event is played out, it gradually takes place.

ext.ext_cn: 你是否付出艰苦努力以取得成功，而不是只在那里做白日梦？
ext.ext_en: Do you work hard for success rather than daydream about it?...

ext.ext_cn: 他幻想着自己成为著名记者。
ext.ext_en: He daydreams of being a famous journalist...

defs.def_en: If you daydream, you think about pleasant things for a period of time, usually about things that you would like to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他躲进白日梦中幻想美女。
ext.ext_en: He escaped into daydreams of beautiful women...

ext.ext_cn: 这个故事的念头是他做白日梦的时候突然想到的。
ext.ext_en: The idea for the story came to him in a daydream.

defs.def_en: A daydream is a series of pleasant thoughts, usually about things that you would like to happen.

defs.def_cn: （尤指社会底层的）蠢货，大老粗，乡巴佬

ext.ext_cn: 她不得不跟那些刺有文身、偷盗影碟的大老粗为邻。
ext.ext_en: She has to live cheek by jowl with oiks, people with tattoos and stolen videos.

ext.ext_cn: 十来个站在一起互相叫嚷的公学蠢蛋
ext.ext_en: ...a dozen public school oiks standing and screeching at each other.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as an oik, you think that they behave in a rude or unacceptable way, especially in a way that you believe to be typical of a low social class.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 傲慢自大的;自以为高人一等的

ext.ext_cn: 妄自尊大的知识分子
ext.ext_en: ...snooty intellectuals...

ext.ext_cn: 人人都认为安娜贝尔太目中无人。
ext.ext_en: Everyone thought Annabel was being snooty.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is snooty, you disapprove of them because they behave as if they are superior to other people.

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢开普敦的那片地方。
ext.ext_en: I like that part of Cape Town...

ext.ext_cn: 尊重是任何关系中都非常重要的部分。
ext.ext_en: Respect is a very important part of any relationship.

defs.def_en: A part of something is one of the pieces, sections, or elements that it consists of.

ext.ext_cn: 军事装备的备用零件
ext.ext_en: ...spare parts for military equipment...

ext.ext_cn: 这台发动机只有3个活动部件。
ext.ext_en: This engine has only got three moving parts.

defs.def_en: A part for a machine or vehicle is one of the smaller pieces that is used to make it.

ext.ext_cn: 那是一场非常严重的事故，他有一只脚残废了。
ext.ext_en: It was a very severe accident and he lost part of his foot...

ext.ext_cn: 妈妈和他能够一起走一段路。
ext.ext_en: Mum and he were able to walk part of the way together...

defs.def_en: Part of something is some of it.

ext.ext_cn: 今天的电视制片人必须既是新闻人，又是教育者。
ext.ext_en: The television producer today has to be part news person, part educator...

ext.ext_cn: 几个人查看了那栋半詹姆士一世时期风格、半乔治王朝风格的大楼。
ext.ext_en: Several people looked over the part-Jacobean, part-Georgian building.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is part one thing, part another, you mean that it is to some extent the first thing and to some extent the second thing.

ext.ext_cn: 用松节油和亚麻油，比例为3:2。
ext.ext_en: Use turpentine and linseed oil, three parts to two.

defs.def_en: You can use part when you are talking about the proportions of substances in a mixture. For example, if you are told to use five parts water to one part paint, the mixture should contain five times as much water as paint.

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔夫·肖博格让她在其导演的戏中扮演重要角色。
ext.ext_en: Alf Sjoberg offered her a large part in the play he was directing...

ext.ext_cn: 他是那个角色的不二人选。
ext.ext_en: He was just right for the part.

defs.def_en: A part in a play or film is one of the roles in it which an actor or actress can perform.

ext.ext_cn: 要是他能够隐瞒住自己在这场事故中的责任就好了。
ext.ext_en: If only he could conceal his part in the accident...

ext.ext_cn: 现在不再参与这门生意了，他如释重负。
ext.ext_en: He felt a sense of relief that his part in this business was now over.

defs.def_en: Your part in something that happens is your involvement in it.

ext.ext_cn: 决定是留在联盟内还是独立的投票
ext.ext_en: ...voting on whether to remain part of the Union or become independent...

ext.ext_cn: 我是队伍的一员，希望留在这个队伍中。
ext.ext_en: I was a part of the team and wanted to remain a part of the team.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is part of a group or organization, they belong to it or are included in it.

ext.ext_cn: 她乌黑的头发中有条笔直的白色分缝，仿佛将她的后脑勺一分为二。
ext.ext_en: The straight white part in her ebony hair seemed to divide the back of her head in half.

defs.def_en: The part in someone's hair is the line running from the front to the back of their head where their hair lies in different directions.

ext.ext_cn: 现在，工作在单身女性的生活中起着重要作用。
ext.ext_en: These days work plays an important part in a single woman's life...

ext.ext_cn: 我们认为她可能参与了藏匿现金。
ext.ext_en: We believe she may have played a part in hiding the cash.

defs.def_en: If something or someone plays a large or important part in an event or situation, they are very involved in it and have an important effect on what happens.

ext.ext_cn: 数千学生参加了游行。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of students have taken part in demonstrations.

defs.def_en: If you take part in an activity, you do it together with other people.

ext.ext_cn: 其他一些俱乐部的所作所为令人遗憾，但是我们不愿介入。
ext.ext_en: What some other clubs do is unfortunate, but we want no part of it.

defs.def_en: If you say that you want no part of something, you mean that you do not want to be involved in it at all.

defs.def_cn: 在（某人）看来；就（某人）而言

ext.ext_cn: 就我而言，我感到非常高兴，都快落泪了。
ext.ext_en: For my part, I feel elated and close to tears...

ext.ext_cn: 就士兵们而言，他们答应不去干扰竞选活动。
ext.ext_en: The soldiers, for their part, agreed not to disrupt the election campaign.

defs.def_en: When you are describing people's thoughts or actions, you can say for her part or for my part, for example, to introduce what a particular person thinks or does.

ext.ext_cn: 他们所采取的防止我们知道具体发生什么事情的手段
ext.ext_en: ...techniques on their part to keep us from knowing exactly what's going on...

ext.ext_cn: 我没有必要再作进一步的指导。
ext.ext_en: There is no need for any further instructions on my part...

defs.def_en: If you talk about a feeling or action on someone's part, you are referring to something that they feel or do.

ext.ext_cn: 德国人通常不卷入地区冲突。
ext.ext_en: For the most part the Germans kept out of local disputes...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数教授都投身于教学，而不是研究。
ext.ext_en: Professors, for the most part, are firmly committed to teaching, not research.

defs.def_en: For the most part means mostly or usually.

ext.ext_cn: 血糖水平在某种程度上取决于饮食内容和时间。
ext.ext_en: The levels of blood glucose depend in part on what you eat and when you eat...

ext.ext_cn: 在某种程度上，这一态度是由于害怕工会和雇员的反应。
ext.ext_en: In part this attitude was due to fear of trade union and employee reactions.

defs.def_en: You use in part to indicate that something exists or happens to some extent but not completely.

ext.ext_cn: 他一天24小时多数时间在以色列。
ext.ext_en: He had been in Israel for the best part of twenty-four hours...

ext.ext_cn: 我们花了近1个小时找她。
ext.ext_en: We spent the better part of an hour searching for her.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happened for the best part or the better part of a period of time, you mean that it happened for most of that time.

ext.ext_cn: 她张开嘴，好像要深呼吸。
ext.ext_en: Her lips parted as if she were about to take a deep breath...

ext.ext_cn: 他走到客厅窗户边，拉开了窗帘。
ext.ext_en: He crossed to the window of the sitting-room and parted the curtains.

defs.def_en: If things that are next to each other part or if you part them, they move in opposite directions, so that there is a space between them.

ext.ext_cn: 乔安娜拿起一把刷子，给头发分缝。
ext.ext_en: Picking up a brush, Joanna parted her hair...

ext.ext_cn: 他梳着锃亮的大背头，缝分得很整齐。
ext.ext_en: His hair was slicked back and neatly parted.

defs.def_en: If you part your hair in the middle or at one side, you make it lie in two different directions so that there is a straight line running from the front of your head to the back.

ext.ext_cn: 他给了我那个信封，我们就告别了。
ext.ext_en: He gave me the envelope and we parted...

ext.ext_cn: 他承认要与他的瑞典妻子伊娃分手。
ext.ext_en: He has confirmed he is parting from his Swedish-born wife Eva.

defs.def_en: When two people part, or if one person parts from another, they leave each other.

ext.ext_cn: 我相信洛特和我永远都不会分开。
ext.ext_en: I don't believe Lotte and I will ever be parted...

ext.ext_cn: 住院可能是孩子第一次与父母分开。
ext.ext_en: A stay in hospital may be the first time a child is ever parted from its parents.

defs.def_en: If you are parted from someone you love, you are prevented from being with them.

defs.def_cn: （士兵或登山者的）露营，临时宿营
defs.def_en: A bivouac is a temporary camp made by soldiers or mountain climbers.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在市郊露营。
ext.ext_en: We bivouacked on the outskirts of the city.

defs.def_en: If you bivouac in a particular place, you stop and stay in a bivouac there.

ext.ext_cn: 顾客常常会尽可能地拖延付款。
ext.ext_en: Customers often defer payment for as long as possible...

ext.ext_cn: 我不会因为它们没有即刻在政治上受到欢迎就推迟作出这些决定。
ext.ext_en: I'm not going to defer decisions just because they are not immediately politically popular.

defs.def_en: If you defer an event or action, you arrange for it to happen at a later date, rather than immediately or at the previously planned time.

ext.ext_cn: 鼓励医生听从专家的意见。
ext.ext_en: Doctors are encouraged to defer to experts.

defs.def_en: If you defer to someone, you accept their opinion or do what they want you to do, even when you do not agree with it yourself, because you respect them or their authority.

defs.def_cn: 对(男孩或男子)行割礼;环割…的包皮

ext.ext_cn: 根据犹太法律的规定，他在出生后8天内接受了割礼。
ext.ext_en: He had been circumcised within eight days of birth as required by Jewish law.

defs.def_en: If a boy or man is circumcised, the loose skin at the end of his penis is cut off.

defs.def_cn: 对(女孩或妇女)行割礼;为…切除部分(或全部)阴蒂

ext.ext_cn: 当今世界上，约有9,000万到1亿的女性接受过割礼。
ext.ext_en: An estimated number of 90 to 100 million women around the world living today have been circumcised.

defs.def_en: In some cultures, if a girl or woman is circumcised, her clitoris is cut or cut off.

ext.ext_cn: 这些系统变得更小，使用的电压也更低。
ext.ext_en: The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.

ext.ext_cn: 高压电线
ext.ext_en: ...high-voltage power lines.

defs.def_en: The voltage of an electrical current is its force measured in volts.
A puma is a wild animal that is a member of the cat family. Pumas have brownish-grey fur and live in mountain regions of North and South America.

ext.ext_cn: 他们得出了与我们完全相反的结论。
ext.ext_en: They came to conclusions diametrically opposed to ours...

ext.ext_cn: 对于这场经济危机有着截然不同的解释。
ext.ext_en: The economic crisis was interpreted in diametrically opposing ways.

defs.def_en: If you say that two things are diametrically opposed, you are emphasizing that they are completely different from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 该文劝告女性不要再对丈夫和牧师低三下四。
ext.ext_en: The essay exhorts women to cast off their servitude to husbands and priests...

ext.ext_cn: 有种充满希望和解脱的奇妙感觉，好似卸下了一副千斤重担。
ext.ext_en: There was an extraordinary feeling of hope and relief, as if a great burden had been cast off.

defs.def_en: See also:cast-off;If you cast off something, you get rid of it because it is no longer necessary or useful to you, or because it is harmful to you.

ext.ext_cn: 他解开缆绳，往海湾驶去。
ext.ext_en: He cast off, heading out to the bay.

defs.def_en: If you are on a boat and you cast off, you untie the rope that is keeping the boat in a fixed position.

ext.ext_cn: 腰带、和服和其他衣服都是儿童款的。
ext.ext_en: The sash, kimono, and other garments were made to fit a child...

ext.ext_cn: 她得去男装部找一条腰围合适的裤子。
ext.ext_en: She has to go to the men's department to find trousers that fit at the waist...

defs.def_en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

ext.ext_cn: 门槛和门扇算是贴合良好，他终于开心了。
ext.ext_en: Eventually he was happy that the sills and doors were a reasonably good fit.

defs.def_en: If something is a good fit, it fits well.

ext.ext_cn: 她正在试穿婚纱。
ext.ext_en: She was being fitted for her wedding dress.

defs.def_en: If you are fitted for a particular piece of clothing, you try it on so that the person who is making it can see where it needs to be altered.

defs.def_cn: 适合放置(于);为放置(于…)而设计

ext.ext_cn: 小得能够放进衣袋里的袖珍电脑
ext.ext_en: ...a pocket computer which is small enough to fit into your pocket...

ext.ext_cn: 他把两条长腿蜷起来伸进桌下。
ext.ext_en: He folded his long legs to fit under the table...

defs.def_en: If something fits somewhere, it can be put there or is designed to be put there.

ext.ext_cn: 她把钥匙插进锁孔。
ext.ext_en: She fitted her key in the lock...

ext.ext_cn: 谁能切割出这数百万块的石块，再把它们堆叠起来呢？
ext.ext_en: Who could cut the millions of stone blocks and fit them together?...

defs.def_en: If you fit something into a particular space or place, you put it there.

ext.ext_cn: 安上铰链插销，让门锁更牢靠。
ext.ext_en: Fit hinge bolts to give extra support to the door lock...

ext.ext_cn: 彼得已经搭好了攀爬横梯，第二天便把它们安在了墙上。
ext.ext_en: Peter had built the overhead ladders, and the next day he fitted them to the wall...

defs.def_en: If you fit something somewhere, you attach it there, or put it there carefully and securely.

ext.ext_cn: 她女儿并不符合当今的完美女性标准。
ext.ext_en: Her daughter doesn't fit the current feminine ideal...

ext.ext_cn: 抚养孩子是全天候的事，应该仔细考虑如何将它与事业协调起来。
ext.ext_en: Fostering is a full-time job and you should carefully consider how it will fit into your career...

defs.def_en: If something fits something else or fits into it, it goes together well with that thing or is able to be part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 必须始终坚持罪罚相当的原则。
ext.ext_en: The punishment must always fit the crime.

defs.def_en: You can say that something fits a particular person or thing when it is appropriate or suitable for them or it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的7辆自行车中，只有两辆适合走这种路。
ext.ext_en: Of the seven bicycles we had, only two were fit for the road.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在让消费者放心食用这些肉的安全措施
ext.ext_en: ...safety measures intended to reassure consumers that the meat is fit to eat...

defs.def_en: If something is fit for a particular purpose, it is suitable for that purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 你不配做母亲！
ext.ext_en: You're not fit to be a mother!...

ext.ext_cn: 简言之，这届政府无法胜任治国之责。
ext.ext_en: In a word, this government isn't fit to rule...

defs.def_en: If someone is fit to do something, they have the appropriate qualities or skills that will allow them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 一个资历丰富、适合担任教育界最高职位的人
ext.ext_en: ...a man whose past experience fits him for the top job in education...

ext.ext_cn: 一个人是否胜任教区牧师一职取决于其品德而不是其性别。
ext.ext_en: It is not a person's gender that fits them to be a vicar but what is in their hearts.

defs.def_en: If something fits someone for a particular task or role, it makes them good enough or suitable for it.

ext.ext_cn: 大概过了一个小时，一个长相非常俊美的男人在舞池里向我走过来。
ext.ext_en: About an hour later a really fit guy came up to me on the dance floor.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as fit, you mean that they are good-looking.

ext.ext_cn: 这臭味简直要把人熏倒。
ext.ext_en: The stink was fit to knock you down.

ext.ext_cn: 一小时又一小时地做着同一套动作，直到快要晕倒！
ext.ext_en: ...hour after hour, the same exercises until you're fit to drop!

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is fit to produce some extreme result, you are emphasizing the extreme nature of that thing or that person's activity.

defs.def_cn: (表示不赞成)决定，选择，认为做…合适

ext.ext_cn: 你说他不是朋友，但你却决定借钱给他。
ext.ext_en: He's not a friend, you say, yet you saw fit to lend him money.

defs.def_en: See also:fitted;fitting;If you say that someone sees fit to do something, you mean that they are entitled to do it, but that you disapprove of their decision to do it.

defs.def_cn: 找到时间(见某人);安排时间(做某事)

ext.ext_cn: 我们家里家外长时间忙活，忙完这里忙那里，想把一切都搞定。
ext.ext_en: We work long hours both outside and inside the home and we rush around trying to fit everything in...

ext.ext_cn: 我发现我真的没有时间做日常家务。
ext.ext_en: I find that I just can't fit in regular domestic work.

defs.def_en: If you manage to fit a person or task in, you manage to find time to deal with them.

ext.ext_cn: 她和孩子们打交道很有一手,相处得十分融洽。
ext.ext_en: She was great with the children and fitted in beautifully.

defs.def_en: If you fit in as part of a group, you seem to belong there because you are similar to the other people in it.

defs.def_cn: (在某种情形或体系中)发挥作用，担当职责;适合;符合

ext.ext_cn: 他知道我适合做什么，也知道他要怎么做才能让我发挥出最佳水平。
ext.ext_en: He knew where I fitted in and what he had to do to get the best out of me...

ext.ext_cn: 这与你告诉过我的相符。
ext.ext_en: This fits in with what you've told me.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something fits in, you understand how they form part of a particular situation or system.

defs.def_cn: 融入;与…相处融洽(或和谐)

ext.ext_cn: 很难看出他将如何融入这支队伍。
ext.ext_en: It's hard to see how he would fit into the team.

defs.def_en: If you fit into a particular group, you seem to belong there because you are similar to the other people in it.

defs.def_cn: 归属，适于(某种情形或体系)

ext.ext_cn: 多数电影的拍摄场地大致归为两类：私人宅院与公共场地。
ext.ext_en: Most film locations broadly fit into two categories; those on private property and those in a public place.

defs.def_en: If something fits into a particular situation or system, that seems to be the right place for it.

defs.def_cn: 为…提供装备;供给…必要的东西

ext.ext_cn: 我们帮他准备了去波罗的海的行装。
ext.ext_en: We helped to fit him out for a trip to the Baltic...

ext.ext_cn: 我建议我们给你配备一间办公套房。
ext.ext_en: I suggest we fit you up with an office suite...

defs.def_en: If you fit someone or something out, or you fit them up, you provide them with equipment and other things that they need.

ext.ext_cn: 斯通先生说那些提供证据的同狱犯人是在试图“诬陷他”。
ext.ext_en: Mr Stone said inmates who had given evidence were trying to 'fit him up'...

ext.ext_cn: 警官诬陷那些他们“知道”犯了罪的嫌疑人是根本没有任何法律依据的。
ext.ext_en: There can never be any legitimate basis for police officers to fit up suspects they 'know' to be guilty.

defs.def_en: See also:fit out;If someone fits another person up, they try to make it seem that that person is responsible for a crime.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 健康的普通人几天内就可以掌握简单的滑雪技术。
ext.ext_en: An averagely fit person can master easy ski runs within a few days.

defs.def_en: Someone who is fit is healthy and physically strong.

ext.ext_cn: 每5例癫痫病中约有两例是在睡眠过程中发作的。
ext.ext_en: About two in every five epileptic fits occur during sleep...

ext.ext_cn: 痉挛一旦发作就无法止住。
ext.ext_en: Once a fit has started there is nothing you can do to stop it.

defs.def_en: If someone has a fit they suddenly lose consciousness and their body makes uncontrollable movements.

defs.def_cn: (突然止不住的)一阵(咳嗽、大笑)

ext.ext_cn: 烟抽到一半，她突然一阵猛咳。
ext.ext_en: Halfway down the cigarette she had a fit of coughing...

ext.ext_cn: 这实在很离奇,我忍不住咯咯笑了起来。
ext.ext_en: It was so unreal that I broke into a fit of giggles.

defs.def_en: If you have a fit of coughing or laughter, you suddenly start coughing or laughing in an uncontrollable way.

ext.ext_cn: 帕蒂妒火中烧，开枪击中了汤姆。
ext.ext_en: Pattie shot Tom in a fit of jealous rage.

defs.def_en: If you do something in a fit of anger or panic, you are very angry or afraid when you do it.

defs.def_cn: 大发雷霆;大光其火;大吃一惊

ext.ext_cn: 到这么晚的时候我们再增加一个客人，温特顿太太会发火吗？
ext.ext_en: Will Mrs Winterton have a fit if we add one more to the guest list at this late stage?...

ext.ext_cn: 要是他知道我们在干什么会气疯了的。
ext.ext_en: He'd have a fit if he knew what we were up to!

defs.def_en: If you say that someone will have a fit when they hear about something, you mean that they will be very angry or shocked.

ext.ext_cn: 他以前更为风趣，常常让我们大家都捧腹大笑。
ext.ext_en: He was a much more entertaining person, who used to have us all in fits.

defs.def_en: Someone who is in fits is laughing uncontrollably.

ext.ext_cn: 我的瘦身运动总是三天打鱼两天晒网。
ext.ext_en: My slimming attempts tend to go in fits and starts...

ext.ext_cn: 军事技术总是间断性地进步着。
ext.ext_en: Military technology advances by fits and starts.

defs.def_en: Something that happens in fits and starts or by fits and starts keeps happening and then stopping again.

defs.def_cn: 岛(常用于岛名或文学语言)

ext.ext_cn: 天堂一般的巴厘岛
ext.ext_en: ...the paradise isle of Bali.

ext.ext_cn: 马恩岛
ext.ext_en: ...the Isle of Man.

defs.def_en: An isle is an island; often used as part of an island's name, or in literary English.

ext.ext_cn: 海恩斯夫人站在旁边，手持剪刀准备剪彩。
ext.ext_en: Mrs. Haines stood nearby, holding scissors to cut a ribbon...

ext.ext_cn: 把西红柿纵向切成两半。
ext.ext_en: Cut the tomatoes in half vertically...

defs.def_en: If you cut something, you use a knife or a similar tool to divide it into pieces, or to mark it or damage it. If you cut a shape or a hole in something, you make the shape or hole by using a knife or similar tool.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰逊刮胡子时刮伤了自己。
ext.ext_en: Johnson cut himself shaving...

ext.ext_cn: 我因为割破手指哭了起来。
ext.ext_en: I started to cry because I cut my finger...

defs.def_en: If you cut yourself or cut a part of your body, you accidentally injure yourself on a sharp object so that you bleed.

ext.ext_cn: 上一拨房客连草都没有修剪。
ext.ext_en: The most recent tenants hadn't even cut the grass...

ext.ext_cn: 你要知道不可以在起居室里剪脚趾甲。
ext.ext_en: You have to learn not to cut your toenails in the living room...

defs.def_en: If you cut something such as grass, your hair, or your fingernails, you shorten them using scissors or another tool.

ext.ext_cn: 剪裁得很差劲的蓝色套装
ext.ext_en: ...badly cut blue suits.

defs.def_en: The way that clothes are cut is the way they are designed and made.

ext.ext_cn: 我看见长长的独木舟破浪而行。
ext.ext_en: I could see long canoes cutting through the waves.

defs.def_en: To cut through something means to move or pass through it easily.

ext.ext_cn: 他决定抄近路走格林尼治公园穿过希思区。
ext.ext_en: He decided to cut across the Heath, through Greenwich Park.

defs.def_en: See also:short cut;If you cut across or through a place, you go through it because it is the shortest route to another place.

ext.ext_cn: 当务之急是降低成本。
ext.ext_en: The first priority is to cut costs...

ext.ext_cn: 联合国部队将裁减90%。
ext.ext_en: The UN force is to be cut by 90%.

defs.def_en: If you cut something, you reduce it.

ext.ext_cn: 布拉纳对这部剧进行了高明的删改。
ext.ext_en: Branagh has cut the play judiciously...

ext.ext_cn: 观众想要多一些音乐，少一些表演，所以我们删掉了一些场景。
ext.ext_en: The audience wants more music and less drama, so we've cut some scenes.

defs.def_en: If you cut a text, broadcast, or performance, you shorten it. If you cut a part of a text, broadcast, or performance, you do not publish, broadcast, or perform that part.

ext.ext_cn: 他们采用施加压力的策略迫使他们回来，包括切断食物和水的供应。
ext.ext_en: They used pressure tactics to force them to return, including cutting food and water supplies.

ext.ext_cn: 罢工已经导致很多地区停电、停水。
ext.ext_en: The strike had already led to cuts in electricity and water supplies in many areas.

defs.def_en: To cut a supply of something means to stop providing it or stop it being provided.

ext.ext_cn: 把纸牌正面朝下放在桌子上，然后切牌。
ext.ext_en: Place the cards face down on the table and cut them.

defs.def_en: If you cut a pack of playing cards, you divide it into two.

defs.def_cn: 停(电影导演要求停止拍摄时的用语)
defs.def_en: When the director of a film says 'cut', they want the actors and the camera crew to stop filming.

defs.def_cn: 灌制(唱片);制作(激光唱片)

ext.ext_cn: 她终于录制了自己的专辑。
ext.ext_en: She eventually cut her own album.

defs.def_en: When a singer or band cuts a CD, they make a recording of their music.

ext.ext_cn: 很多婴儿到一岁大时才开始长牙。
ext.ext_en: Many infants do not cut their first tooth until they are a year old.

defs.def_en: When a child cuts a tooth, a new tooth starts to grow through the gum.

ext.ext_cn: 3个月内旷课次数超过一次就可能有麻烦了。
ext.ext_en: Cutting school more than once in three months is a sign of trouble.

defs.def_en: If a child cuts classes or cuts school, they do not go to classes or to school when they are supposed to.

defs.def_cn: (不耐烦地让人停止做某事)别…，不要…

ext.ext_cn: “丹尼尔，别绕弯子了，”布伦达厉声说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Cut the euphemisms, Daniel,' Brenda snapped...

ext.ext_cn: 你为什么不能停止废话去把门打开。
ext.ext_en: Why don't you just cut the crap and open the door.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to cut something, you are telling them in an irritated way to stop it.

defs.def_cn: (从动物躯体上)割下的一块肉

ext.ext_cn: 用一块便宜点的肉，比如肋排肉。
ext.ext_en: Use a cheap cut such as spare rib chops.

defs.def_en: A cut of meat is a piece or type of meat which is cut in a particular way from the animal, or from a particular part of it.

defs.def_cn: (尤指通过不诚实手段获得的)份，份额

ext.ext_cn: 律师们自然从那个小家伙赢得的钱中分到了他们的一份。
ext.ext_en: The lawyers, of course, take their cut of the little guy's winnings.

defs.def_en: Someone's cut of the profits or winnings from something, especially ones that have been obtained dishonestly, is their share.

defs.def_cn: (在山中开凿的公路或铁路)通道，路堑
defs.def_en: A cut is a narrow valley which has been cut through a hill so that a road or railroad track can pass through.

ext.ext_cn: 琼·史密斯的侦探小说比其他侦探小说都要出色。
ext.ext_en: Joan Smith's detective stories are a cut above the rest.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is a cut above other people or things of the same kind, you mean they are better than them.
If you see someone you know and cut them dead, you ignore them.

defs.def_cn: 已成定局的;板上钉钉的

ext.ext_cn: 不幸的是，事情并不像很多人希望的那样确定。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately, things cannot be as cut and dried as many people would like...

ext.ext_cn: 我们想要的是指导原则，不是固定的答案。
ext.ext_en: We are aiming for guidelines, not cut-and-dried answers.

defs.def_en: If you say that a situation or solution is cut and dried, you mean that it is clear and definite.

ext.ext_cn: 可能除了詹姆斯外，公司里都没人能管得了他。
ext.ext_en: He's cut loose from this business except, possibly, where James is concerned...

ext.ext_cn: 它将脱离长期依附的国家，实现独立自主。
ext.ext_en: It's about to be cut loose from the state on which it has so long depended.

defs.def_en: If a person or an organization cuts loose or is cut loose, they become free from the influence or authority of other people.

ext.ext_cn: 他作出逃跑的懦弱决定
ext.ext_en: ...his cowardly decision to cut and run.

defs.def_en: If someone cuts and runs in a difficult situation, they try to escape from it quickly and gain an advantage for themselves, rather than deal with the situation in a responsible way.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为出生于英格兰的选手在国外不会取得好成绩。
ext.ext_en: He doesn't think English-born players can cut it abroad.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone can't cut it, you mean that they do not have the qualities needed to do a task or cope with a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 公然对立的两个对手之间的激烈辩论
ext.ext_en: ...cut-and-thrust debate between two declared adversaries.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the cut and thrust of an activity, you are talking about the aspects of it that make it exciting and challenging.

defs.def_cn: 有利有弊;两面都行得通

ext.ext_cn: 这种宣传有利也有弊。它使得人们关注我们，同样也关注了他们。
ext.ext_en: This publicity cuts both ways. It focuses on us as well as on them.

defs.def_en: If you say that something cuts both ways, you mean that it can have two opposite effects, or can have both good and bad effects.

ext.ext_cn: 叛军已经切断了来自首都的供电。
ext.ext_en: The rebels have cut off electricity from the capital...

ext.ext_cn: 假如供水被切断，他所在的公司就准备关闭。
ext.ext_en: His company is preparing to shut down in the event that their water supply is cut off...

defs.def_en: To cut off a supply of something means to stop providing it or stop it being provided.

ext.ext_cn: 电话接通后，你最好在断线之前尽快把话说完。
ext.ext_en: When you do get through, you've got to say your piece quickly before you get cut off...

ext.ext_cn: 就谈到这里好吗，因为我们还有很多打来电话的人在等着呢。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to cut you off now because we've got lots of callers waiting.

defs.def_en: If you get cut off when you are on the telephone, the line is suddenly disconnected and you can no longer speak to the other person.

ext.ext_cn: “但是，先生，我是奉命——”克拉克打断他说道：“别跟我争辩。”
ext.ext_en: 'But, sir, I'm under orders to —' Clark cut him off. 'Don't argue with me.'

defs.def_en: If you cut someone off when they are speaking, you interrupt them and stop them from speaking.

defs.def_cn: (电视或广播上的)名人访谈节目，脱口秀
defs.def_en: A talk show is a television or radio show in which famous people talk to each other in an informal way and are asked questions about different topics.
Tracing paper is transparent paper which you put over a picture so that you can draw over its lines in order to produce a copy of it.

defs.def_cn: (主干道上的)中央隔离带，中央分离带
defs.def_en: The central reservation is the strip of ground, often covered with grass, that separates the two sides of a major road.
In a vehicle, the emergency brake is a brake which the driver operates with his or her hand, and uses, for example, in emergencies or when parking.
A sharpshooter is a person who can fire a gun very accurately.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坏的；令人不快的；不合意的；有害的；糟糕的

ext.ext_cn: 糟糕的天气使飞机无法降落。
ext.ext_en: The bad weather conditions prevented the plane from landing...

ext.ext_cn: 我们正经历一段困难时期。
ext.ext_en: We have been going through a bad time...

defs.def_en: Something that is bad is unpleasant, harmful, or undesirable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他两年前遇到严重的车祸，不得不放弃务农。
ext.ext_en: He had a bad accident two years ago and had to give up farming...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一起严重的危险驾驶案例。
ext.ext_en: This was a bad case of dangerous driving...

defs.def_en: You use bad to indicate that something unpleasant or undesirable is severe or great in degree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不明智的；错误的；不对的

ext.ext_cn: 经济学家杰弗里·福克斯认为减税是不明智的。
ext.ext_en: Economist Jeffrey Faux says a tax cut is a bad idea...

ext.ext_cn: 政治家当然有时也会作出错误的决定。
ext.ext_en: Of course politicians will sometimes make bad decisions...

defs.def_en: A bad idea, decision, or method is not sensible or not correct.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 项目终止对她的雇员来说是一个不幸的消息。
ext.ext_en: The closure of the project is bad news for her staff...

ext.ext_cn: 我与沃尔的关系开始得不太顺利。
ext.ext_en: It was a bad start in my relationship with Warr...

defs.def_en: If you describe a piece of news, an action, or a sign as bad, you mean that it is unlikely to result in benefit or success.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不合标准的；劣质的；蹩脚的；不足的

ext.ext_cn: 她出演了一部关于茅茅运动（20世纪50年代肯尼亚基库尤人反抗英国殖民者的民族主义运动）的烂片。
ext.ext_en: She was in rather a bad film about the Mau Mau...

ext.ext_cn: 英国有很多老人居住条件恶劣。
ext.ext_en: Many old people in Britain are living in bad housing...

defs.def_en: Something that is bad is of an unacceptably low standard, quality, or amount.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他加深了人们对英国人不擅长语言的印象。
ext.ext_en: He had increased Britain's  reputation for being bad at languages...

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个技术糟糕的司机。
ext.ext_en: He was a bad driver...

defs.def_en: Someone who is bad at doing something is not skilful or successful at it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以接受的；令人遗憾的

ext.ext_cn: 看不见比听不到更让人难以忍受。
ext.ext_en: Not being able to hear doesn't seem as bad as not being able to see...

ext.ext_cn: 现在看场电影至少要花上10英镑——真是太贵了。
ext.ext_en: You need at least ten pounds if you go to the cinema nowadays — it's really bad.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is bad that something happens, you mean it is unacceptable, unfortunate, or wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤表示惊讶）不错的，不坏的，挺好的

ext.ext_en: 'How much is he paying you?' — 'Oh, five thousand.' —'Not bad.'...

ext.ext_cn: “最近怎么样，老兄？”——“还不错，你呢？”
ext.ext_en: 'How are you, mate?' — 'Not bad, mate, how's  yourself?'...

defs.def_en: You can say that something is not bad to mean that it is quite good or acceptable, especially when you are rather surprised about this.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我贩卖毒品，但我并不觉得自己是个坏人。
ext.ext_en: I was selling drugs, but I didn't think I was a bad person...

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得自己的信仰并不让他比其他人更邪恶。
ext.ext_en: He does not think that his beliefs make him any worse than any other man.

defs.def_en: A bad person has morally unacceptable attitudes and behaviour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不听话的；调皮的；捣蛋的

ext.ext_cn: 重复我对你说的话，你真是个捣蛋鬼。
ext.ext_en: You are a bad boy for repeating what I told you...

ext.ext_cn: 很多父母觉得要孩子循规蹈矩是件很难的事情。
ext.ext_en: Many parents find it hard to discourage bad behaviour.

defs.def_en: A bad child disobeys rules and instructions or does not behave in a polite and correct way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 因为她刚刚戒烟，所以脾气有点大。
ext.ext_en: She is in a bit of a bad mood because she's just given up smoking.

defs.def_en: If you are in a bad mood, you are angry and behave unpleasantly to people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你不必为放松感到内疚。
ext.ext_en: You don't have to feel bad about relaxing...

ext.ext_cn: 大部分工作都是他在干，我觉得很过意不去。
ext.ext_en: I feel bad that he's  doing most of the work...

defs.def_en: If you feel bad about something, you feel rather sorry or guilty about it.

ext.ext_cn: 阿拉斯泰尔背部有毛病，所以我们睡硬板床。
ext.ext_en: Alastair has a bad back so we have a hard bed.

defs.def_en: If you have a bad back, heart, leg, or eye, it is injured, diseased, or weak.

ext.ext_cn: 他们买了太多牛肉，有些都变质了。
ext.ext_en: They bought so much beef that some went bad.

defs.def_en: Food that has gone bad is not suitable to eat because it has started to decay.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我不喜欢在街上听见一些污言秽语。
ext.ext_en: I don't like to hear bad language in the street...

ext.ext_cn: 我说了一句脏话。
ext.ext_en: I said a bad word.

defs.def_en: Bad language is language that contains offensive words such as swear words.

ext.ext_cn: 埃莉诺不得不这么快就离开，真是太遗憾了。
ext.ext_en: It is too bad that Eleanor had to leave so soon...

ext.ext_cn: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。
ext.ext_en: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is too bad that something is the case, you mean you are sorry or sad that it is the case.

defs.def_cn: （表示无法改变，亦不觉得抱歉或同情）算…倒霉

ext.ext_cn: 你没有赶上公交车只能算自己倒霉。
ext.ext_en: Too bad if you missed the bus.

defs.def_en: If you say 'too bad', you are indicating that nothing can be done to change the situation, and that you do not feel sorry or sympathetic about this.

ext.ext_cn: 经济陷入困境。
ext.ext_en: The economy is in a bad way...

ext.ext_cn: “你看起来糟透了，”布拉德笑着说。
ext.ext_en: 'You look in a bad way,' chuckled Brad.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is in a bad way, they are in a bad condition or situation.

defs.def_cn: 对…有不好的评价；说…的坏话

ext.ext_cn: 她美丽，富有，出名，而且我们还没有发现谁说她不好。
ext.ext_en: She's got beauty, wealth, and fame, and we still can't find anyone with a bad word to say about her.

defs.def_en: If nobody has a bad word to say about you, you are liked or admired by everyone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 彼得斯曾经漫无目的地四处漂泊。
ext.ext_en: Peters had been adrift and aimless...

ext.ext_cn: 在几个小时漫无目的的搜寻之后，他们快没燃料了。
ext.ext_en: After several hours of aimless searching they were getting low on fuel.

defs.def_en: A person or activity that is aimless has no clear purpose or plan.

ext.ext_cn: 在赫伯里兹，剪羊毛的时间比其他任何地方都要晚。
ext.ext_en: In the Hebrides they shear their sheep later than anywhere else.

defs.def_en: To shear a sheep means to cut its wool off.

ext.ext_cn: 用大剪刀修剪灌木丛。
ext.ext_en: Trim the shrubs with shears.

defs.def_en: A pair of shears is a garden tool like a very large pair of scissors. Shears are used especially for cutting hedges.

defs.def_cn: (摇滚音乐会上，观众推搡着)狂舞，劲舞，来回跳动

ext.ext_cn: 穿着被汗水浸透了的T恤衫，拥到台前，狂舞着，这就是摇滚音乐会上的体验。
ext.ext_en: Moshing down the front, crushed against the stage in a sweat-drenched T-shirt is all part of the gig experience.

defs.def_en: If people at a rock concert mosh, they jump up and down together in front of the stage, often pushing each other.

ext.ext_cn: 我唯一一次生病是因为吃了未熟的梨。
ext.ext_en: I was only ill once and that came of eating an unripe pear.

defs.def_en: Unripe fruit or vegetables are not yet ready to eat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 描述的;描写的;叙述的;说明的

ext.ext_cn: 他的描写性写作手法
ext.ext_en: ...his descriptive way of writing.

defs.def_en: Descriptive language or writing indicates what someone or something is like.

ext.ext_cn: 卧底警官发现了用于使迷幻药浸透到纸里的毒品制造设备。
ext.ext_en: Undercover officers found drug-making equipment used to impregnate paper with LSD.

ext.ext_cn: 一块浸透吸光染料的塑料
ext.ext_en: ...a block of plastic impregnated with a light-absorbing dye.

defs.def_en: If someone or something impregnates a thing with a substance, they make the substance spread through it and stay in it.

ext.ext_cn: 诺曼想使她怀孕的努力失败了。
ext.ext_en: Norman's efforts to impregnate her failed.

defs.def_en: When a man or a male animal impregnates a female, he makes her pregnant.

defs.def_cn: 美国南方黑人的传统食物(如玉米面包、火腿、绿叶菜等)

ext.ext_cn: 黑人的食物可谓五花八门：有辣味的秋葵汤，有豇豆，还有羽衣甘蓝叶。
ext.ext_en: Soul food is a varied cuisine: it includes spicy gumbos, black-eyed peas, and collard greens.

defs.def_en: Soul food is used to refer to the kind of food, for example corn bread, ham, and greens, that was popular with black Americans in the southern United States and is considered typical of them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她那顶饰有花卉的橙紫相间的花哨帽子
ext.ext_en: ...her gaudy orange-and-purple floral hat.

defs.def_en: If something is gaudy, it is very brightly-coloured and showy.

defs.def_cn: 公设辩护人；公设辩护律师
defs.def_en: A public defender is a lawyer who is employed by a city or county to represent people who are accused of crimes but cannot afford to pay for a lawyer themselves.
An educator is a person who educates people.
An educator is someone who is specialized in the theories and methods of education.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 听到沙哑的录音，我立刻知道那是沃尔特·惠特曼。
ext.ext_en: Listening to the scratchy recording, I recognized Walt Whitman immediately.

defs.def_en: Scratchy sounds are thin and harsh.
