defs.def_cn: 热烈地跳舞；（尤指）伴随摇滚乐跳舞，跳摇摆舞

ext.ext_cn: 他们安了自动点唱机后，我在那儿学会了跳摇摆舞。
ext.ext_en: I learnt to jive there when they got the jukebox.

defs.def_en: If you jive, you dance energetically, especially to rock and roll or swing music.
Jive is rock and roll or swing music that you jive to.
Jive or jive talk is a kind of informal language used by some African Americans.
Decaf is decaffeinated coffee.

ext.ext_cn: 她穿着一身暗黄绿色的衣裤套装。
ext.ext_en: She wore a lime-green trouser suit...

ext.ext_cn: 索菲身着酸橙绿和海军蓝，显得很时尚。
ext.ext_en: Sophie looked chic in lime green and navy.

defs.def_en: Something that is lime green is light yellowish-green in colour.
Your credit rating is a judgment of how likely you are to pay money back if you borrow it or buy things on credit.

defs.def_cn: 威化饼，薄脆饼(常与冰激凌同吃)
defs.def_en: A wafer is a thin crisp biscuit which is usually eaten with ice cream.

defs.def_cn: (基督教圣餐仪式上牧师发放的)圣饼
defs.def_en: A wafer is a circular, thin piece of special bread which the priest gives people to eat in the Christian service of Holy Communion.
A gear lever or a gear stick is the lever that you use to change gear in a car or other vehicle.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 实利主义的;物质至上主义的

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪80年代期间，英国变成一个物质至上的社会。
ext.ext_en: During the 1980s Britain became a very materialistic society.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or society as materialistic, you are critical of them because they attach too much importance to money and material possessions.

defs.def_cn: （提议、原则、观点）占上风，占优势，获胜，被接受

ext.ext_cn: 我们希望情理会占上风。
ext.ext_en: We hope that common sense would prevail...

ext.ext_cn: 里克仍然相信正义会得以伸张。
ext.ext_en: Rick still believes that justice will prevail...

defs.def_en: If a proposal, principle, or opinion prevails, it gains influence or is accepted, often after a struggle or argument.

defs.def_cn: （情形、态度、风俗）盛行，流行，普遍

ext.ext_cn: 相似的情况在美国随处可见。
ext.ext_en: A similar situation prevails in America...

ext.ext_cn: 在革命期间普遍存在的混乱
ext.ext_en: ...the confusion which had prevailed at the time of the revolution...

defs.def_en: If a situation, attitude, or custom prevails in a particular place at a particular time, it is normal or most common in that place at that time.

defs.def_cn: （在战斗、竞赛、争论中）获胜，取胜

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎已经获得了取胜所需的选票。
ext.ext_en: He appears to have the votes he needs to prevail...

ext.ext_cn: 我确实希望他能战胜叛乱者。
ext.ext_en: I do hope he will prevail over the rebels.

defs.def_en: If one side in a battle, contest, or dispute prevails, it wins.

ext.ext_cn: 我们每一个人都必须说服我们各自的国会议员采取行动。
ext.ext_en: We must, each of us, prevail upon our congressman to act...

ext.ext_cn: 你觉得有可能说服她去做那些事情吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you think she could be prevailed upon to do those things?

defs.def_en: If you prevail upon someone to do something, you succeed in persuading them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 竞选将于明日郑重开始。
ext.ext_en: Campaigning will begin in earnest tomorrow...

ext.ext_cn: 两国终于可以开始就双方共同关心的问题进行更为认真的谈判。
ext.ext_en: The two countries can finally start negotiating in earnest about issues of mutual concern.

defs.def_en: If something is done or happens in earnest, it happens to a much greater extent and more seriously than before.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 埃拉是个虔诚、认真的女人。
ext.ext_en: Ella was a pious, earnest woman...

ext.ext_cn: 他不论笑的时候还是争论的时候表情都同样真诚。
ext.ext_en: His expression is as earnest when he smiles as when he is arguing...

defs.def_en: Earnest people are very serious and sincere in what they say or do, because they think that their actions and beliefs are important.

ext.ext_cn: 它用讽刺的语言呈现了天主教作家郑重其事表明的观点。
ext.ext_en: It presented in satirical terms points made in earnest by Catholic writers...

ext.ext_cn: 谁都不知道他是认真的还是在开玩笑。
ext.ext_en: No one could tell whether he was in earnest or in jest.

defs.def_en: If you are in earnest, you are sincere in what you are doing and saying.
In fairy stories and legends, a mermaid is a woman with a fish's tail instead of legs, who lives in the sea.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 使人放松的;能解郁安神的

ext.ext_cn: 八步功法瑜伽注重呼吸和放松，是一种舒缓身心的锻炼方法。
ext.ext_en: Astanga Yoga is a therapeutic physical exercise that focuses on breathing and relaxation.

defs.def_en: If something is therapeutic, it helps you to relax or to feel better about things, especially about a situation that made you unhappy.

defs.def_cn: 治疗性的;有助于治疗的

ext.ext_cn: 治疗性药物
ext.ext_en: ...therapeutic drugs.

defs.def_en: Therapeutic treatment is designed to treat an illness or to improve a person's health, rather than to prevent an illness.
A peepshow is box containing moving pictures which you can look at through a small hole. Peepshows used to be a form of entertainment at fairs.
An orgasm is the moment of greatest pleasure and excitement in sexual activity.

defs.def_cn: 两件套毛衣(女士穿的颜色相同的一件开襟衫和一件套头衫)
defs.def_en: A twinset is a set of women's clothing, consisting of a cardigan and sweater of the same colour.

defs.def_cn: 碰上大麻烦的人;处境非常危险的人
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is dead meat, you mean that they are in very serious trouble that may result in them being hurt or injured in some way.

defs.def_cn: (犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教中的)魔王，撒旦
defs.def_en: In Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, the Devil is the most powerful evil spirit.

ext.ext_cn: 天使长着翅膀、魔鬼长着角和蹄这样的观念
ext.ext_en: ...the idea of angels with wings and devils with horns and hoofs.

defs.def_en: A devil is an evil spirit.

ext.ext_cn: 我替布莱克感到难过，这个可怜的家伙。
ext.ext_en: I felt sorry for Blake, poor devil...

ext.ext_cn: 曼弗雷德，你是个可疑的老家伙。
ext.ext_en: Manfred, you're a suspicious old devil...

defs.def_en: You can use devil to emphasize the way you feel about someone. For example, if you call someone a poor devil, you are saying that you feel sorry for them. You can call someone you are fond of but who sometimes annoys or irritates you an old devil or a little devil .

ext.ext_cn: “我想他有点儿淘气，”康斯坦丝说道。
ext.ext_en: 'I think he was a bit of a devil,' Constance said.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a devil, you mean that they do not behave very well but you like them and are not angry with them.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调)极其讨厌（或糟糕、麻烦）的

ext.ext_cn: 他总是极讨人厌。
ext.ext_en: He was always a devil of a nuisance...

ext.ext_cn: 这是个非常棘手的问题，不是吗？
ext.ext_en: It's a devil of a tricky problem,isn't it?

defs.def_en: Devil can be used to emphasize what you think about someone or something. For example, if you say that someone is a devil of a nuisance, you mean that they are very annoying. If you say that something is a devil of a problem, you mean that it is a very difficult problem.

defs.def_cn: 宁可跟熟识的魔鬼打交道(也比跟未知的魔鬼打交道好)
defs.def_en: If you say better the devil you know or better the devil you know than the devil you don't know, you mean that you would prefer to have contact with or do business with a person you already know, even though you don't like them, than with a person you don't know.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调)需煞费苦心（做），要大费周折（做）

ext.ext_cn: 我们说服他参加可费了一番周折。
ext.ext_en: We had the devil's own job to persuade him to take part.

defs.def_en: If you say that you had the devil's own job to do something or that you had a devil of a job doing something, you are emphasizing that it was difficult to do it.

defs.def_cn: 拼命地;竭力地;（开车）飞快地

ext.ext_cn: 他不断敦促自己，从早上 7 点一直拼命工作到午夜。
ext.ext_en: He drives himself on, working like the devil from seven in the morning until midnight...

ext.ext_cn: 他一定是把车开得飞快。
ext.ext_en: He must have driven like the devil.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something like the devil, you are emphasizing that they put a lot of effort into it. If you say that someone drives like the devil, you are emphasizing that they drive very fast.

defs.def_cn: 落后者遭殃(形容或评论人人都只考虑自己而不顾别人)

ext.ext_cn: 人人都只考虑自己，谁落后谁倒霉。
ext.ext_en: Every one for himself and the devil take the hindmost.

defs.def_en: You can say the devil take the hindmost to describe or comment on a situation you disapprove of because people do only what is best for themselves without thinking about other people.
If you say that you are between the devil and the deep blue sea, you mean that you are in a difficult situation where you have to choose between two equally unpleasant courses of action.
If you say that someone has sold their soul to the devil, you mean that you disapprove of them because they have done something that you think is not right in order to get what they want.

ext.ext_cn: 呵，说曹操，曹操就到！
ext.ext_en: Well, talk of the devil!

defs.def_en: People say speak of the devil, or in British English talk of the devil, if someone they have just been talking about appears unexpectedly.

ext.ext_cn: “究竟出了什么事？”
ext.ext_en: 'What the devil's the matter?'

ext.ext_cn: 蒂姆想知道他们究竟是怎么做到的。
ext.ext_en: Tim wondered how the devil they had managed it...

defs.def_en: When you want to emphasize how annoyed or surprised you are, you can use an expression such as what the devil ,how the devil, or why the devil .

ext.ext_cn: 不出意外的话，我相信他们会成功的。
ext.ext_en: Barring accidents, I believe they will succeed.

defs.def_en: You use barring to indicate that the person, thing, or event that you are mentioning is an exception to your statement.

defs.def_cn: (有关)卫生的，环境卫生的，公共卫生的

ext.ext_cn: 卫生条件之差令人震惊。
ext.ext_en: Sanitary conditions are appalling...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数人生活在简陋的铁皮屋子里，没有电，没有干净的水，也没有卫生设施。
ext.ext_en: The vast majority live in tin shacks without electricity, clean water or sanitary facilities.

defs.def_en: Sanitary means concerned with keeping things clean and healthy, especially by providing a sewage system and a clean water supply.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个游泳的地方不大卫生。
ext.ext_en: It's not the most sanitary place one could swim.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place is not sanitary, you mean that it is not very clean.

defs.def_cn: 信条;主义;学说;（尤指）宗教教义

ext.ext_cn: 轮回转世说
ext.ext_en: ...the doctrine of reincarnation.

ext.ext_cn: 我不同意作者的生活和意图与他的文本没有联系的学说。
ext.ext_en: I disagree with the doctrine that the writer's life and intention have no bearing on his texts.

defs.def_en: A doctrine is a set of principles or beliefs, especially religious ones.

defs.def_cn: (尤指政府外交政策的)正式声明

ext.ext_cn: 二战后，美国对欧洲作出的第一个承诺便是在 1947 年提出杜鲁门主义。
ext.ext_en: Following World War II, the first U.S. commitment to Europe came in the form of the 1947 Truman Doctrine.

defs.def_en: A doctrine is a statement of official government policy, especially foreign policy.

ext.ext_cn: 他们全都光着脚走过潮湿的沙地来到水边。
ext.ext_en: They all walked barefoot across the damp sand to the water's edge.

ext.ext_cn: 沙粒
ext.ext_en: ...grains of sand.

defs.def_en: Sand is a substance that looks like powder, and consists of extremely small pieces of stone. Some deserts and many beaches are made up of sand.

ext.ext_cn: 绵延数英里的金色沙滩
ext.ext_en: ...miles of golden sands.

defs.def_en: Sands are a large area of sand, for example a beach.

ext.ext_cn: 用砂纸仔细而轻柔地打磨表面。
ext.ext_en: Sand the surface softly and carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 我打算用砂纸把椅子打磨光洁后重新上漆。
ext.ext_en: I was going to sand down the chairs and repaint them...

defs.def_en: If you sand a wood or metal surface, you rub sandpaper over it in order to make it smooth or clean.

ext.ext_cn: 他一直是她曲折坎坷的生活中的主心骨。
ext.ext_en: He had been a rock in the shifting sands of her existence.

ext.ext_cn: 他在阿拉伯风云变幻的政局中的高明谋略
ext.ext_en: ...his shrewd tactical skills in the shifting sands of Arab politics.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the shifting sands of a situation, you mean that it changes so often that it is difficult to deal with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是如此傲慢。
ext.ext_en: He was so arrogant...

ext.ext_cn: 那话听起来很嚣张，是不是？
ext.ext_en: That sounds arrogant, doesn't it?

defs.def_en: Someone who is arrogant behaves in a proud, unpleasant way towards other people because they believe that they are more important than others.

ext.ext_cn: 她的父亲是一位很有名的赛马驯养师。
ext.ext_en: Her father was a well-known racehorse breeder.

defs.def_en: See also:fast-breeder reactor;Breeders are people who breed animals or plants.

ext.ext_cn: 这些剃须刀都已经配好了电池。
ext.ext_en: The shavers come complete with batteries.

ext.ext_cn: 使用电池的磁带播放机
ext.ext_en: ...a battery-operated cassette player.

defs.def_en: Batteries are small devices that provide the power for electrical items such as radios and children's toys.

ext.ext_cn: 电瓶没电了的汽车
ext.ext_en: ...a car with a flat battery.

defs.def_en: A car battery is a rectangular box containing acid that is found in a car engine. It provides the electricity needed to start the car.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在一排废弃火炮旁停了下来。
ext.ext_en: They stopped beside a battery of abandoned guns.

ext.ext_cn: 装在房顶的一排排聚光灯
ext.ext_en: ...batteries of spotlights set up on rooftops.

defs.def_en: A battery of equipment such as guns, lights, or computers is a large set of it kept together in one place.

defs.def_cn: （物品的）一组，一系列；（人的）一群

ext.ext_cn: 一大群记者和众多电视摄像机
ext.ext_en: ...a battery of journalists and television cameras...

ext.ext_cn: 强效可卡因是瘾君子们吸食的众多毒品之一。
ext.ext_en: Crack is part of a battery of drugs used by addicts.

defs.def_en: A battery of people or things is a very large number of them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们给每个病人都做了一系列的检查。
ext.ext_en: We give a battery of tests to each patient.

defs.def_en: A battery of tests is a set of tests that is used to assess a number of different aspects of something, such as your health.

ext.ext_cn: 在黑暗、拥挤的层架式鸡舍里饲养的母鸡
ext.ext_en: ...battery hens being raised in dark, cramped conditions.

defs.def_en: Battery farming is a system of breeding chickens and hens in which large numbers of them are kept in small cages, and used for their meat and eggs.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 迂回曲折的;弯弯曲曲的

ext.ext_cn: 开车的话需要走一段非常蜿蜒曲折的下坡路。
ext.ext_en: The drive required going down a quite twisty road.

defs.def_en: A twisty road, track, or river has a lot of sharp bends and corners.

ext.ext_cn: 温度降到零摄氏度以下水就会结冰。
ext.ext_en: If the temperature drops below 0°C, water freezes...

ext.ext_cn: 地面冻实了。
ext.ext_en: The ground froze solid.

defs.def_en: If a liquid or a substance containing a liquid freezes, or if something freezes it, it becomes solid because of low temperatures.

ext.ext_cn: 这时可以把汤冷冻起来。
ext.ext_en: You can freeze the soup at this stage...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数新鲜的芳草都很适宜冷冻贮藏。
ext.ext_en: Most fresh herbs will freeze successfully.

defs.def_en: If you freeze something such as food, you preserve it by storing it at a temperature below freezing point. You can also talk about how well food freezes .

defs.def_cn: (管子、机器等因液体结冰)冻得堵塞，冻牢

ext.ext_cn: 水管会冻住。
ext.ext_en: The water pipes will freeze.

defs.def_en: If something such as a pipe or machine freezes, it becomes blocked or stiff with ice or frozen liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 要是那几个月一直又下雨又冰冻怎么办？
ext.ext_en: What if it rained and then froze all through those months?

ext.ext_cn: 那些树因为 12 月里的一次冰冻而遭到毁坏。
ext.ext_en: The trees were damaged by a freeze in December.

defs.def_en: When it freezes outside, the temperature falls below freezing point.

ext.ext_cn: 窗子底下关不严，所以有一段时间即使是在盛夏我们也觉得很冷。
ext.ext_en: The windows didn't fit at the bottom so for a while we froze even in the middle of summer...

ext.ext_cn: 做这个手会冻僵的。
ext.ext_en: Your hands will freeze doing this.

defs.def_en: If you freeze, you feel extremely cold.

ext.ext_cn: 当手电筒的光照到她身上时她僵住了。
ext.ext_en: She froze when the beam of the flashlight struck her.

defs.def_en: If someone who is moving freezes, they suddenly stop and become completely still and quiet.

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望政府冻结物价。
ext.ext_en: They want the government to freeze prices...

ext.ext_cn: 工资已被冻结，工人也下岗了。
ext.ext_en: Wages have been frozen and workers laid off.

defs.def_en: If the government or a company freeze things such as prices or wages, they state officially that they will not allow them to increase for a fixed period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 英国已冻结了其援助项目。
ext.ext_en: Britain has already frozen its aid programme...

ext.ext_cn: 外交关系直到今年8月才解冻。
ext.ext_en: Diplomatic relations were frozen until August this year.

defs.def_en: If a government freezes a plan or process, they state officially that they will not allow it to continue for a period of time.

defs.def_cn: 冻结，查封(银行账户、基金、财产等)

ext.ext_cn: 州长采取的行动冻结了 30 万个账户。
ext.ext_en: The governor's action freezes 300,000 accounts...

ext.ext_cn: 他说根据这些法规，赖斯先生的资产可能已经被冻结了。
ext.ext_en: Under these laws, he said, Mr. Rice's assets could have been frozen.

defs.def_en: See also:freezing;frozen;If someone in authority freezes something such as a bank account, fund, or property, they obtain a legal order which states that it cannot be used or sold for a particular period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 其他商人则想方设法地要把我们排挤出这个生意圈。
ext.ext_en: Other traders did everything they could to freeze us out of the business.

defs.def_en: If you freeze someone out of an activity or situation, you prevent them from being involved in it by creating difficulties or by being unfriendly.

ext.ext_cn: 气温远远低于零度，湖面和河面都封冻了。
ext.ext_en: The air temperature was well below freezing, and lakes and rivers froze over...

ext.ext_cn: 湖面还结着冰。
ext.ext_en: The lakes are still frozen over.

defs.def_en: If something freezes over, it becomes covered with a layer of ice or other frozen substance.

ext.ext_cn: 在冬季经常完全冻住的抽水马桶
ext.ext_en: ...lavatories that often freeze up in winter...

ext.ext_cn: 冰可能会冻死他们的鱼雷发射装置。
ext.ext_en: Ice could freeze up their torpedo release mechanisms.

defs.def_en: If something freezes up or if something freezes it up, it becomes completely covered or blocked with ice.

ext.ext_cn: 贼鸥是飞行速度很快的黑色鸟类，尾部长而分叉。
ext.ext_en: Jaegers are swift black birds with long forked tails.

defs.def_en: Something that divides into two parts and forms a 'Y' shape can be described as forked .

ext.ext_cn: 他的职业生涯是从利物浦大学开始的。
ext.ext_en: His professional career started at Liverpool University.

defs.def_en: Professional means relating to a person's work, especially work that requires special training.

ext.ext_cn: 像医生和工程师这样需要高技能的专业人员
ext.ext_en: ...highly qualified professional people like doctors and engineers.

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲想让我成为职业人士，这样能更稳定一些。
ext.ext_en: My father wanted me to become a professional and have more stability.

defs.def_en: Professional people have jobs that require advanced education or training.

ext.ext_cn: 这是我当职业足球运动员以来受伤来得最不是时候的一次。
ext.ext_en: This has been my worst time for injuries since I started as a professional footballer...

ext.ext_cn: 杰克·尼克劳斯自从1961年转为职业选手以来参加了四大赛的所有比赛。
ext.ext_en: Jack Nicklaus has played in every Major Championship since he turned professional in 1961.

defs.def_en: You use professional to describe people who do a particular thing to earn money rather than as a hobby.

ext.ext_cn: 踢过短时间职业足球的艺术系学生
ext.ext_en: ...an art student who had played professional football for a short time.

defs.def_en: Professional sports are played for money rather than as a hobby.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 专业的；内行的；高水平的

ext.ext_cn: 他们的经营既有真正的专业水准又不乏个人特色。
ext.ext_en: They run it with  a truly professional but personal touch.

ext.ext_cn: 一位非常敬业的、同所有演职人员合作融洽的专业人士
ext.ext_en: ...a dedicated professional who worked harmoniously with the cast and crew.

defs.def_en: If you say that something that someone does or produces is professional, you approve of it because you think that it is of a very high standard.
If you say that a situation is a tinderbox, you mean that it is very tense and something dangerous or unpleasant is likely to happen very soon.

ext.ext_cn: 那名被判有罪的强奸杀人犯定在下周五处决。
ext.ext_en: The convicted murderer and rapist is scheduled to be executed next Friday.

defs.def_en: A rapist is a man who has raped someone.
An abscess is a painful swelling containing pus.
An astrologer is a person who uses astrology to try to tell you things about your character and your future.

defs.def_cn: (表示曾经相信、希望或期待)将，将会

ext.ext_cn: 没有人相信他真的会自杀。
ext.ext_en: No one believed he would actually kill himself...

ext.ext_cn: 他会一直是这个样子吗？
ext.ext_en: Would he always be like this?…

defs.def_en: You use would when you are saying what someone believed, hoped, or expected to happen or be the case.

ext.ext_cn: 这项声明还称，虽然双方观点存在若干分歧，但将就这些分歧展开讨论。
ext.ext_en: The statement added that although there were a number of differing views, these would be discussed by both sides...

ext.ext_cn: 乔治认为这辆车非常稀罕，所以他只会拿它展示很少的几次。
ext.ext_en: George decided it was such a rare car that he would only use it for a few shows...

defs.def_en: You use would when saying what someone intended to do.

defs.def_cn: (表示可能出现的情况的结果或影响)会，将会

ext.ext_cn: 一般来说，跟别人去豪华餐馆吃饭会是件乐事。
ext.ext_en: Ordinarily it would be fun to be taken to fabulous restaurants...

ext.ext_cn: 要是认为警官对粗鄙行为不气不恼，那可就错了。
ext.ext_en: It would be wrong to suggest that police officers were not annoyed by acts of indecency...

defs.def_en: You use would when you are referring to the result or effect of a possible situation.

defs.def_cn: (would 或 would have 与过去分词连用，表示有充分理由认为或猜测是某种情况)肯定，一定，应该

ext.ext_cn: 你肯定不认识他。
ext.ext_en: You wouldn't know him...

ext.ext_cn: 他的崇拜者们肯定已经很熟悉卡罗琳了。
ext.ext_en: His fans would already be familiar with Caroline...

defs.def_en: You use would, or would have with a past participle, to indicate that you are assuming or guessing that something is true, because you have good reasons for thinking it.

defs.def_cn: (用于if，unless等引导的条件状语从句的主句，表示认为某事不大可能发生)就，该

ext.ext_cn: 要是我能睡会儿，我就能够应付。
ext.ext_en: If only I could get some sleep, I would be able to cope...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得如果我更多地去看一些花园,就有可能更好地规划和设计它们。
ext.ext_en: I think if I went to look at more gardens, I would be better on planning and designing them...

defs.def_en: You use would in the main clause of some 'if' and 'unless' sentences to indicate something you consider to be fairly unlikely to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他们说他们愿意与警方通力合作。
ext.ext_en: They said they would give the police their full cooperation...

ext.ext_cn: 她表示愿意帮助她丈夫。
ext.ext_en: She indicated that she would help her husband...

defs.def_en: You use would to say that someone was willing to do something. You use would not to indicate that they refused to do something.

defs.def_cn: (表示尽管付出很大努力却没有发生)就(不)，偏(不)

ext.ext_cn: 他冲着门又踢又推，还用肩膀撞，但门就是打不开。
ext.ext_en: He kicked, pushed, and hurled his shoulder at the door. It wouldn't open...

ext.ext_cn: 他反复试着发动车子，但电池的电越来越少，最后根本就打不着火了。
ext.ext_en: He kept trying to start the car and the battery got flatter and flatter, until it wouldn't turn the engine at all...

defs.def_en: You use would not to indicate that something did not happen, often in spite of a lot of effort.

defs.def_cn: (尤与like, love 和 wish 连用，表示想做某事或拥有某物，或希望某事发生)要，会

ext.ext_cn: 她问我想干什么，然后提到了一份工作。
ext.ext_en: She asked me what I would like to do and mentioned a particular job...

ext.ext_cn: 你妈妈现在想喝一杯咖啡。
ext.ext_en: Right now, your mom would like a cup of coffee...

defs.def_en: You use would, especially with 'like', 'love', and 'wish', when saying that someone wants to do or have a particular thing or wants a particular thing to happen.  would rather→see: rather;

defs.def_cn: (用于带if从句的疑问句中，表示请求许可做某事)会

ext.ext_cn: 我可以抽烟吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you think it would be all right if I smoked?...

ext.ext_cn: 卡特勒先生，我可以问您个问题吗？
ext.ext_en: Mr. Cutler, would you mind if I asked a question?

defs.def_en: You use would with 'if' clauses in questions when you are asking for permission to do something.

defs.def_cn: (通常在疑问句中与 like 连用，表示礼貌地给予或邀请)

ext.ext_cn: 想喝一杯吗?
ext.ext_en: Would you like a drink?...

ext.ext_cn: 您愿意留下来吗?
ext.ext_en: Would you like to stay?...

defs.def_en: You use would, usually in questions with 'like', when you are making a polite offer or invitation.

defs.def_cn: (通常用于疑问句中，表示礼貌地请求某人做某事)请

ext.ext_cn: 请帮个忙把我刚刚收到的这封信处理掉行吗?
ext.ext_en: Would you do me a favour and get rid of this letter I've just received?...

ext.ext_cn: 请进来一下好吗?
ext.ext_en: Would you come in here a moment, please?...

defs.def_en: You use would, usually in questions, when you are politely asking someone to do something.

defs.def_cn: (用于批评，表示对某人做某事并不感到意外，此时 would 须重读)

ext.ext_cn: 呵，你当然会这样说的，因为你是个男的。
ext.ext_en: Well, you would say that: you're a man...

ext.ext_cn: “嗯，接着弗朗西丝卡转过身说，这个问题问得真蠢。”——“她肯定会这么说，不是吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'Well, then Francesca turned round and said, That's a stupid question.' — 'She would, wouldn't she.'

defs.def_en: You say that someone would do something when it is typical of them and you are critical of it. You emphasize the word would when you use it in this way.

defs.def_cn: (would 或 would have 与过去分词连用，表示发表看法或了解他人是否赞同自己的看法，尤用于对自己的话没有把握时)

ext.ext_cn: 我想你得承认他是个备受尊敬的专栏作家。
ext.ext_en: I think you'd agree he's a very respected columnist...

ext.ext_cn: 我会认为派军队去平叛是恰当之举。
ext.ext_en: I would have thought it a proper job for the Army to fight rebellion...

defs.def_en: You use would, or sometimes would have with a past participle, when you are expressing your opinion about something or seeing if people agree with you, especially when you are uncertain about what you are saying.

defs.def_cn: (用于以随便的口气向人提出建议)我(就)会

ext.ext_cn: 如果我是你,我就会直接去按你朋友的门铃, 把自行车要回来。
ext.ext_en: If I were you I would simply ring your friend's bell and ask for your bike back...

ext.ext_cn: 我要是你，就不会跟房东太太谈私事。
ext.ext_en: I would not, if I were you, be inclined to discuss private business with the landlady...

defs.def_en: You use I would when you are giving someone advice in an informal way.

defs.def_cn: (用于否定句，与 guess, know 等动词连用，表示某事不明显，尤用于某事令人吃惊时)

ext.ext_cn: 克丽丝极富艺术气质，你根本想不到她是银行家的女儿。
ext.ext_en: Chris is so full of artistic temperament you'd never think she was the daughter of a banker...

ext.ext_cn: 他承认，内心里他可能心潮起伏，但你根本不会猜到。
ext.ext_en: Inside, he admits, his emotions may be churning, but you would never guess it.

defs.def_en: You use you would in negative sentences with verbs such as 'guess' and 'know' when you want to say that something is not obvious, especially something surprising.

defs.def_cn: (表示某事过去惯常发生, 而现在不再发生了)就，会

ext.ext_cn: 星期天早晨，妈妈会烤面包，我就站在冰箱旁帮忙。
ext.ext_en: Sunday mornings my mother would bake. I'd stand by the fridge and help...

ext.ext_cn: “美是肤浅的。”妈妈会说。
ext.ext_en: 'Beauty is only skin deep,' my mother would say.

defs.def_en: You use would to talk about something which happened regularly in the past but which no longer happens.

defs.def_cn: (would have 与过去分词连用，表示某个时间前可能发生的事情)就，会

ext.ext_cn: 在推出10周之内，可能会有3,400万人看到我们的电视广告。
ext.ext_en: Within ten weeks of the introduction, 34 million people would have been reached by our television commercials.

defs.def_en: You use would have with a past participle when you are saying what was likely to have happened by a particular time.

defs.def_cn: (would have 与过去分词连用，表示过去可能发生的事情的结果或影响)就，会

ext.ext_cn: 我女儿要是还活着的话，这周就17岁了。
ext.ext_en: My daughter would have been 17 this week if she had lived...

ext.ext_cn: 我要是知道他的想法，我是决不会让他领养那些孩子的。
ext.ext_en: If I had known how he felt, I would never have let him adopt those children...

defs.def_en: You use would have with a past participle when you are referring to the result or effect of a possible event in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 我本想从政的。
ext.ext_en: I would have liked a life in politics...

ext.ext_cn: 她本想问问题，但他又继续谈另一个话题去了。
ext.ext_en: She would have liked to ask questions, but he had moved on to another topic...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone would have liked or preferred something, you mean that they wanted to do it or have it but were unable to.

defs.def_cn: (通常用于否定句，批评某人所为，表示不满)（不）会

ext.ext_cn: 他们做的事情我是决不会做的。
ext.ext_en: I would never have done what they did.

defs.def_en: You use would, usually in negative sentences, to criticize something that someone has done and to express your disapproval of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他要是听了他父亲的话就好了。
ext.ext_en: Would that he could have listened to his father.

defs.def_en: If you say 'would that' something were the case, you are saying that you wish it were the case.

defs.def_cn: 碍眼的东西（如建筑物等）

ext.ext_cn: 贫困产生了贫民窟，那里不仅有碍观瞻，而且卫生隐患严重。
ext.ext_en: Poverty leads to slums, which are an eyesore and a health hazard.

defs.def_en: You describe a building or place as an eyesore when it is extremely ugly and you dislike it or disapprove of it.

defs.def_cn: 剪贴簿;剪报资料收贴簿
defs.def_en: A scrapbook is a book with empty pages on which you can stick things such as pictures or newspaper articles in order to keep them.

defs.def_cn: 假阳性;错误的测试结果

ext.ext_cn: 高比率的错误测试结果
ext.ext_en: ...a high rate of false positive results.

defs.def_en: A false positive is a mistaken result of a scientific test. For example, if the result of a pregnancy test is a false positive, it indicates that a woman is pregnant when she is not.

ext.ext_cn: 他们会为自己的所作所为痛悔终生。
ext.ext_en: They will bitterly regret what they have done for ever more...

ext.ext_cn: 编辑的决定是最终性的，而且应该永远不会改变。
ext.ext_en: The editor's decision is final and shall evermore remain so.

defs.def_en: Ever more means for all the time in the future.
A volt is a unit used to measure the force of an electric current.

ext.ext_cn: 富兰克林一回来，就收到了好几十封贺电和贺信。
ext.ext_en: Scores of congratulatory telegrams and letters greeted Franklin on his return...

ext.ext_cn: 总统收到用电报发来的一份简报。
ext.ext_en: The President received a briefing by telegram.

defs.def_en: A telegram is a message that is sent by telegraph and then printed and delivered to someone's home or office.

defs.def_cn: （over there的过时或方言用语）那里，那边

ext.ext_cn: 看那边，就在木头柱子的旁边。
ext.ext_en: Now look yonder, just beyond the wooden post there.

ext.ext_cn: 他的妻子，克劳迪娅，躺在那边那棵树下。
ext.ext_en: His wife, Claudia, lies under yonder tree.

defs.def_en: Yonder is an old-fashioned or dialect word for 'over there'.

ext.ext_cn: 他此后一生都活跃于协会中，后来还当上了副会长。
ext.ext_en: He was to remain active in the association, latterly as vice president, for the rest of his life...

ext.ext_cn: 首先是当地居民搬离市中心，继而是商铺，近日各个企业也开始迁出。
ext.ext_en: City centres were abandoned first by residents, then by shops, and latterly by businesses...

defs.def_en: You can use latterly to indicate that a situation or event is the most recent one.

ext.ext_cn: 圣保罗大教堂
ext.ext_en: ...St. Paul's Cathedral.

ext.ext_cn: 有主教座堂的坎特伯雷市
ext.ext_en: ...the cathedral city of Canterbury.

defs.def_en: A cathedral is a very large and important church which has a bishop in charge of it.
Mulled wine has sugar and spice added to it and is then heated.

ext.ext_cn: 他和他专横残暴的父母一样为人惧怕和憎恨。
ext.ext_en: He was just as feared and reviled as his tyrannical parents...

ext.ext_cn: 观众有什么权力因为英格兰队员们无能为力的事情而斥责他们？
ext.ext_en: What right had the crowd to revile the England players for something they could not help...?

defs.def_en: If someone or something is reviled, people hate them intensely or show their hatred of them.

defs.def_cn: 自雇的;个体经营的;自由职业的

ext.ext_cn: 如果你是个体户，就没有带薪休假或病假。
ext.ext_en: There are no paid holidays or sick leave if you are self-employed.

ext.ext_cn: 个体建筑工
ext.ext_en: ...a self-employed builder.

defs.def_en: If you are self-employed, you organize your own work and taxes and are paid by people for a service you provide, rather than being paid a regular salary by a person or a firm.
A chiropodist is a person whose job is to treat and care for people's feet.

defs.def_cn: （意外情况下）充当替代者，代替

ext.ext_cn: 宾馆客人多时，这里的职员可以互相替班。
ext.ext_en: The staff here can pinch hit for each other when the hotel is busy.

defs.def_en: If you pinch-hit for someone, you do something for them because they are unexpectedly unable to do it.

defs.def_cn: （棒球比赛中替补队员在关键时刻）替补击球

ext.ext_cn: 达瓦里洛上场替补击球。
ext.ext_en: Davalillo goes up to pinch-hit.

defs.def_en: In a game of baseball, if you pinch-hit for another player, you hit the ball instead of them.

ext.ext_cn: 构成地球上所有生命的分子
ext.ext_en: ...molecules that are the building blocks of all life on earth.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a building block of something, you mean it is one of the separate parts that combine to make that thing.
If someone whispers sweet nothings to you, they quietly say nice, loving, and flattering things to you.

defs.def_cn: (用于制作绳子、垫子的)椰子壳粗纤维
defs.def_en: Coir is a rough material made from coconut shells which is used to make ropes and mats.

ext.ext_cn: 她嗓子疼。
ext.ext_en: She had a sore throat...

ext.ext_cn: 她盯着他看的时候，感觉自己的喉咙发干。
ext.ext_en: As she stared at him she felt her throat go dry.

defs.def_en: Your throat is the back of your mouth and the top part of the tubes that go down into your stomach and your lungs.

ext.ext_cn: 他的条纹领带松松地挂在脖子上。
ext.ext_en: His striped tie was loosened at his throat.

defs.def_en: Your throat is the front part of your neck.

ext.ext_cn: 克罗斯清了清嗓子，开始有礼貌地低声说话。
ext.ext_en: Cross cleared his throat and spoke in low, polite tones.

defs.def_en: If you clear your throat, you cough once in order to make it easier to speak or to attract people's attention.

defs.def_cn: 向…反复灌输;向…不断强调;迫使…接受

ext.ext_cn: 我一直和爸爸很亲近，不过他从不强迫我继承他的事业。
ext.ext_en: I've always been close to my dad but he's never rammed his career down my throat...

ext.ext_cn: 我搞不懂我们为什么硬要他们学习莎士比亚的作品。
ext.ext_en: I can't understand why we're trying to ram Shakespeare down their throats.

defs.def_en: If you ram something down someone's throat or force it down their throat, you keep mentioning a situation or idea in order to make them accept it or believe it.

ext.ext_cn: 认为我和比利斗得你死我活的想法真是大错特错。
ext.ext_en: The idea that Billy and I are at each other's throats couldn't be further from the truth.

defs.def_en: If two people or groups are at each other's throats, they are quarrelling or fighting violently with each other.

ext.ext_cn: 令我耿耿于怀的是自己没能获奖。
ext.ext_en: What sticks in my throat is that I wasn't able to win the trophy...

ext.ext_cn: 她想问他有没有基思的消息，可是难以启齿。
ext.ext_en: She wanted to ask if he had news of Keith, but the words stuck in her throat.

defs.def_en: If something sticks in your throat, you find it unacceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 柠檬酸
ext.ext_en: ...citric acid...

ext.ext_cn: 胃酸能杀死病毒。
ext.ext_en: Acids in the stomach destroy the virus.

defs.def_en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些灌木必须生长在不含石灰的酸性土壤环境。
ext.ext_en: These shrubs must have an acid, lime-free soil.

defs.def_en: An acid substance contains acid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些酒可能喝着比较冲并且有股酸味。
ext.ext_en: These wines may taste rather hard and somewhat acid.

defs.def_en: An acid fruit or drink has a sour or sharp taste.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这部当代风尚喜剧杂糅了悲悯的情怀和尖酸的幽默。
ext.ext_en: This comedy of contemporary manners is told with compassion and acid humour.

defs.def_en: An acid remark, or acid humour, is very unkind or critical.
The drug LSD is sometimes referred to as acid .

defs.def_cn: 按特殊要求制作的;定做的

ext.ext_cn: 这台机器是请史蒂夫·罗伯茨定做的。
ext.ext_en: The machine was custom-built by Steve Roberts.

ext.ext_cn: 定制的厨房
ext.ext_en: ...a custom-built kitchen.

defs.def_en: If something is custom-built, it is built according to someone's special requirements.

defs.def_cn: 具有所需素质及才能的;是做…材料的

ext.ext_cn: 我还是放弃学医了，我真的不是那块料。
ext.ext_en: I left medicine anyway. I wasn't really cut out for it...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为自己没有做领导的才能。
ext.ext_en: He doesn't feel he is cut out to be a leader.

defs.def_en: If you are not cut out for a particular type of work, you do not have the qualities that are needed to be able to do it well.
Can't is the usual spoken form of 'cannot'.
You use hosiery to refer to tights, stockings, and socks, especially when they are on sale in shops.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她表情极为丰富。
ext.ext_en: She had the most rubbery face...

ext.ext_cn: 面膜敷上后等约15分钟，待其变成橡胶状质地。
ext.ext_en: The mask is left on for about 15 minutes while it sets to a rubbery texture.

defs.def_en: Something that is rubbery looks or feels soft or elastic like rubber.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Food such as meat that is rubbery is difficult to chew.

defs.def_cn: 单声道的;单声道放音的

ext.ext_cn: 这款汽车有单声道音响设备。
ext.ext_en: This model has a mono soundtrack.

defs.def_en: Mono is used to describe a system of playing music in which all the sound is directed through one speaker only.
Mono is the same as mononucleosis .
Onomatopoeic words sound like the noise they refer to. 'Hiss', 'buzz', and 'rat-a-tat-tat' are examples of onomatopoeic words.

ext.ext_cn: 挡风玻璃上的雨刷咔嗒咔嗒来回摆动。
ext.ext_en: The windshield wipers clacked back and forth...

ext.ext_cn: 我的一个雪橇板咔嗒一声撞在另一个上面，差点把我绊倒。
ext.ext_en: I clacked one ski against the other and almost tripped.

defs.def_en: If things clack or if you clack them, they make a short loud noise, especially when they hit each other.
Your ticker is your heart.
A switchblade is a knife with a blade that is hidden in the handle and that springs out when a button is pressed.

ext.ext_cn: 国防部发出的关于其职责的备忘录
ext.ext_en: ...a memorandum from the Ministry of Defence on its role...

ext.ext_cn: 代表团向下院呈交了有关公然侵犯基本人权的备忘录。
ext.ext_en: The delegation submitted a memorandum to the Commons on the blatant violations of basic human rights.

defs.def_en: A memorandum is a written report that is prepared for a person or committee in order to provide them with information about a particular matter.

ext.ext_cn: 为我们两国之间的合作而达成的谅解备忘录

defs.def_cn: 喜欢结交(某类人);确保身边总有(某类东西)

ext.ext_cn: 他总会亲手挑选一批聪明而年轻的军官常伴他左右。
ext.ext_en: He had made it his business to surround himself with a hand-picked group of bright young officers...

ext.ext_cn: 他们喜欢身边都是自己熟悉的物品。
ext.ext_en: They love being surrounded by familiar possessions.

defs.def_en: If you surround yourself with certain people or things, you make sure that you have a lot of them near you all the time.

ext.ext_cn: 有铸铁边饰的小壁炉
ext.ext_en: ...a small fireplace with a cast-iron surround.

defs.def_en: The surround of something such as a fireplace is the border, wall, or shelves around it.

ext.ext_cn: 全队都在新建的现代化村会所的宽敞洗浴间享受了热水淋浴。
ext.ext_en: The entire team enjoyed hot showers in the spacious surrounds of a new, modern village hall.

defs.def_en: Your surrounds are your surroundings .

defs.def_cn: 喜欢结伴逛商场的年轻人;逛街狂

ext.ext_cn: 于是，十几岁的孩子们没事就去逛大商场，在里面到处溜达却很少购物。
ext.ext_en: Thus, teenagers become mall rats, hanging out but rarely shopping in those megamalls.

defs.def_en: Mall rats are young people who spend a lot of time hanging around in shopping malls with their friends.

defs.def_cn: （桥、房顶等上的）矮护墙，女儿墙
defs.def_en: A parapet is a low wall along the edge of something high such as a bridge or roof.
If you say that someone puts their head above the parapet, you mean they take a risk. If you say they keep their head below the parapet, you mean they avoid taking a risk.

ext.ext_cn: 她的天真无邪很快就让艺术界的自命不凡显露无遗。
ext.ext_en: Her wide-eyed innocence soon exposes the pretensions of the art world.

ext.ext_cn: 迫切想要探索这个世界的天真男孩
ext.ext_en: ...a wide-eyed boy ready to explore.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as wide-eyed, you mean that they are inexperienced and innocent, and may be easily impressed.

defs.def_cn: (尤指因惊讶或恐惧而)睁大眼睛的

ext.ext_cn: 她吃惊地睁大了眼睛。
ext.ext_en: She is wide-eyed with astonishment.

ext.ext_cn: 瞠目结舌的表情
ext.ext_en: ...an expression of wide-eyed amazement.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as wide-eyed, you mean that their eyes are more open than usual, especially because they are surprised or frightened.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极痛苦的;折磨人的;剧痛的

ext.ext_cn: 我忍受着剧痛，一条腿无法动弹。
ext.ext_en: I was in excruciating pain and one leg wouldn't move...

ext.ext_cn: 她对爱情的寻觅常常给她带来极大的痛苦和孤独感。
ext.ext_en: Her search for love has often caused her excruciating misery and loneliness.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as excruciating, you are emphasizing that it is extremely painful, either physically or emotionally.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以忍受的;令人苦恼的

ext.ext_cn: 同时，又无聊得让人苦恼不已。
ext.ext_en: Meanwhile, the boredom is excruciating...

ext.ext_cn: 一时间安静得令人难以忍受。
ext.ext_en: There was a moment of excruciating silence.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as excruciating, you mean that it is very unpleasant to experience, for example because it is very boring or embarrassing.

ext.ext_cn: 政府称其正筹建一个由18架“幻影”战斗机组成的空军中队。
ext.ext_en: The government said it was preparing a squadron of eighteen Mirage fighter planes.

defs.def_en: A squadron is a section of one of the armed forces, especially the air force.
Button mushrooms are small mushrooms used in cooking.
A test-tube baby is a baby that develops from an egg which has been removed from the mother's body, fertilized, and then replaced in her womb in order that it can continue developing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极其荒谬的；愚蠢至极的

ext.ext_cn: 整个想法都荒唐透顶。
ext.ext_en: The whole idea was preposterous.

ext.ext_cn: 他们无比愚蠢地声称自己发现了一个阴谋
ext.ext_en: ...their preposterous claim that they had unearthed a plot.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as preposterous, you mean that it is extremely unreasonable and foolish.

defs.def_cn: （皮肤）显出静脉的,青筋暴露的

ext.ext_cn: 海伦的双手枯瘦，青筋凸起。
ext.ext_en: Helen's hands were thin and veined.

ext.ext_cn: 脸颊上青筋暴露的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a man who had blue-veined cheeks.

defs.def_en: Veined skin has a lot of veins showing through it.

ext.ext_cn: 外形如一片叶脉清晰的叶子的铜制烟灰缸
ext.ext_en: ...a bronze ashtray shaped like a veined leaf.

ext.ext_cn: 这种有蓝色纹理的独特奶酪
ext.ext_en: ...this distinctive blue-veined cheese.

defs.def_en: Something that is veined has a pattern or colouring like that of veins showing through skin.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不充分的;不足的;不够好的

ext.ext_cn: 食物和药品供应不足。
ext.ext_en: Supplies of food and medicines are inadequate...

ext.ext_cn: 问题远非人手不足那么简单。
ext.ext_en: The problem goes far beyond inadequate staffing.

defs.def_en: If something is inadequate, there is not enough of it or it is not good enough.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不够格的;不能胜任的;不适合的

ext.ext_cn: 我仍然感到自己能力不够,毫无用处,整个儿一团糟。
ext.ext_en: I still feel inadequate, useless and mixed up...

ext.ext_cn: 意识到自己在这场危机中无能为力，玛丽·安感到很痛苦。
ext.ext_en: Mary Ann felt painfully inadequate in the crisis.

defs.def_en: If someone feels inadequate, they feel that they do not have the qualities and abilities necessary to do something or to cope with life in general.
A tragi-comedy is a play or other written work that is both sad and amusing.

ext.ext_cn: 她看上去稍微有点儿沮丧。
ext.ext_en: There was a slight air of dejection about her.

defs.def_en: Dejection is a feeling of sadness that you get, for example, when you have just been disappointed by something.

ext.ext_cn: V形或箭头路标表示有向左或向右的急转弯。
ext.ext_en: The chevron or arrow road sign indicates a sharp bend to the left or right.

defs.def_en: A chevron is a V shape.

ext.ext_cn: 他佩戴标示级别的肩章，上面有中士的V形标志。
ext.ext_en: He wore shoulderstrap rank slides with sergeant's chevrons.

defs.def_en: A chevron is one of a number of V shapes worn on the sleeve by someone in the armed forces or in the police force to show their rank.

ext.ext_cn: 锈迹斑斑的破拖拉机
ext.ext_en: ...a decaying tractor, red with rust...

ext.ext_cn: 制造商们正研究如何用塑料制造车辆，以避免生锈。
ext.ext_en: Manufacturers are looking into building cars out of plastic to avoid the problem of rust.

defs.def_en: Rust is a brown substance that forms on iron or steel, for example when it comes into contact with water.

ext.ext_cn: 铜钉比铁钉好，因为铁会生锈。
ext.ext_en: Copper nails are better than iron nails because the iron rusts...

ext.ext_cn: 门上有一个生锈的旧门闩。
ext.ext_en: There was an old rusting bolt on the door.

defs.def_en: When a metal object rusts, it becomes covered in rust and often loses its strength.

ext.ext_cn: 主色调为深褐色和赭色的青绿色木制品
ext.ext_en: ...turquoise woodwork with accent colours of rust and ochre.

ext.ext_cn: 深褐色的上衣
ext.ext_en: ...a rust-coloured blouse.

defs.def_en: Rust is sometimes used to describe things that are reddish-brown in colour.
Rust is a disease which affects plants. It is caused by a fungus.

ext.ext_cn: 马龙·白兰度、史蒂夫·麦奎因和詹姆斯·迪恩现在成了银幕上的的传奇人物。
ext.ext_en: Marlon Brando, Steve McQueen, and James Dean are now legends of the silver screen...

ext.ext_cn: 最近我们不常见到亲爱的彼得·奥图尔活跃在银幕上了。
ext.ext_en: We don't see much of dear old Peter O'Toole on the silver screen these days.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to the films that are shown in cinemas as the silver screen .

ext.ext_cn: 巴赫博士目前正以诽谤罪起诉该公司。
ext.ext_en: Dr. Bach is now suing the company for slander...

ext.ext_cn: 朝鲜一直是西方主要大国威胁和诋毁的目标。
ext.ext_en: Korea has been a target of threats and slanders from the major western powers.

defs.def_en: Slander is an untrue spoken statement about someone which is intended to damage their reputation.

ext.ext_cn: 他由于涉嫌诽谤首相而受到了盘问。
ext.ext_en: He has been questioned on suspicion of slandering the Prime Minister.

defs.def_en: To slander someone means to say untrue things about them in order to damage their reputation.

ext.ext_cn: 他给新西兰政府去函，索取介绍新西兰生活的宣传册。
ext.ext_en: He wrote off to the New Zealand Government for these pamphlets about life in New Zealand.

defs.def_en: If you write off to a company or organization, you send them a letter, usually asking for something.

defs.def_cn: 勾销，注销(债务或已花费的款项)

ext.ext_cn: 总统说通西方免除波兰的债务。
ext.ext_en: The president persuaded the West to write off Polish debts...

ext.ext_cn: 他很早就将那笔钱勾销了。
ext.ext_en: He had long since written off the money.

defs.def_en: If someone writes off a debt or an amount of money that has been spent on a project, they accept that they are never going to get the money back.

defs.def_cn: 认定…不重要(或无用)；忽视

ext.ext_cn: 他很讨厌大家因为他的年纪而小看他。
ext.ext_en: He is fed up with people writing him off because of his age...

ext.ext_cn: 批评他的人不把他当回事，认为他太过谨慎，不能成事。
ext.ext_en: His critics write him off as too cautious to succeed...

defs.def_en: If you write someone or something off, you decide that they are unimportant or useless and that they are not worth further serious attention.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰已经报废了4辆车，现在他一直坐公交车。
ext.ext_en: John's written off four cars. Now he sticks to public transport...

ext.ext_cn: 皮特的一个朋友在那儿把他的汽车撞毁了。
ext.ext_en: One of Pete's friends wrote his car off there.

defs.def_en: If someone writes off a vehicle, they have a crash in it and it is so badly damaged that it is not worth repairing.

ext.ext_cn: 我们决定取消当天其余日程去购物。
ext.ext_en: We decided to write off the rest of the day and go shopping...

ext.ext_cn: 价格高出很多，所以我们决定将它取消。
ext.ext_en: The prices were much higher. So we decided to write that off...

defs.def_en: If you write off a plan or project, you accept that it is not going to be successful and do not continue with it.
A marmoset is a type of small monkey.

ext.ext_cn: 她坐在母亲床边。
ext.ext_en: She sat on the edge of her mother's bed...

ext.ext_cn: 她是英语教师，还是两个孩子的母亲。
ext.ext_en: She's an English teacher and a mother of two children...

defs.def_en: Your mother is the woman who gave birth to you. You can also call someone your mother if she brings you up as if she was this woman.

ext.ext_cn: 科琳曾梦想抚养一群孩子。
ext.ext_en: Colleen had dreamed of mothering a large family.

defs.def_en: If a woman mothers a child, she looks after it and brings it up, usually because she is its mother.

ext.ext_cn: 她迫切地感到要细心照料他。
ext.ext_en: She felt a great need to mother him...

ext.ext_cn: 别再宠我了。
ext.ext_en: Stop mothering me.

defs.def_en: If you mother someone, you treat them with great care and affection, as if they were a small child.

defs.def_cn: 拿铁（一种加热奶的浓咖啡）
defs.def_en: Latte is strong coffee made with hot milk.

ext.ext_cn: 他们签订了一项协议，将中东瓜分为几个势力范围。
ext.ext_en: They signed an agreement that parcelled out the Middle East into several spheres of influence.

defs.def_en: If you parcel out something, you divide it into several parts or amounts and give them to different people.

defs.def_cn: 精神变态者；变态人格者

ext.ext_cn: 有个变态搭上了她，然后把她杀了。
ext.ext_en: Some psycho picked her up, and killed her.

defs.def_en: A psycho is someone who has serious mental problems and who may act in a violent way without feeling sorry for what they have done.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你得快点了，飞机大约3小时后起飞。
ext.ext_en: You'll have to be quick. The flight leaves in about three hours...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为我是一个学东西还算快的人。
ext.ext_en: I think I'm a reasonably quick learner...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is quick moves or does things with great speed.

defs.def_cn: (quicker 有时表示“以更快的速度”，quickest表示“以最快的速度”，quick有时表示“以很快的速度”，但有些人认为这种用法并不规范)

ext.ext_cn: 先将糖稍稍加热，以使其溶解得更快些。
ext.ext_en: Warm the sugar slightly first to make it dissolve quicker...

ext.ext_cn: 普罗斯特走得最快。
ext.ext_en: Prost went quickest.

defs.def_en: Quicker is sometimes used to mean 'at a greater speed', and quickest to mean 'at the greatest speed'. Quick is sometimes used to mean 'with great speed'. Some people consider this to be non-standard.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 短暂的;持续时间很短的

ext.ext_cn: 他朝房间匆匆扫了最后一眼。
ext.ext_en: He took one last quick look about the room...

ext.ext_cn: 我只是顺路过来小酌一杯。
ext.ext_en: I just popped in for a quick drink...

defs.def_en: Something that is quick takes or lasts only a short time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 立刻发生的;很快发生的

ext.ext_cn: 官员们让迅速结束这场流血冲突的希望变得渺茫起来。
ext.ext_en: Officials played down any hope for a quick end to the bloodshed...

ext.ext_cn: 这些投资者觉得收益必须立竿见影。
ext.ext_en: These investors feel the need to make quick profits.

defs.def_en: Quick means happening without delay or with very little delay.

defs.def_cn: 迅速发生地;很快发生地

ext.ext_cn: 我尽快离开了。
ext.ext_en: I got away as quick as I could...

ext.ext_cn: 快来！约翰！卡梅拉出事了，我想她用药过量了。
ext.ext_en: Quick! John! It's Carmela. I think she's taken an overdose...

defs.def_en: Quick is sometimes used to mean 'with very little delay'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 马克说这些都是凯蒂自己的想法，并随即称赞起她的天赋来。
ext.ext_en: Mark says the ideas are Katie's own, and is quick to praise her talent...

ext.ext_cn: 而且，正如热尔韦斯毫不犹豫地指出来的那样，斯库利先生并不是一名侦探。
ext.ext_en: Furthermore, as Gervaise was quick to point out, Mr Scully was not a detective.

defs.def_en: If you are quick to do something, you do not hesitate to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 性情急躁的;容易发怒的
defs.def_en: If someone has a quick temper, they are easily made angry.

defs.def_cn: 咬到了指甲肉；咬秃指甲

ext.ext_cn: 她的手指甲都被咬秃了。
ext.ext_en: Her fingernails are bitten to the quick.

defs.def_en: If someone bites their nails to the quick, they bite off all the white part at the end of each nail.

defs.def_cn: 触及（…）痛处;极大伤害；令…伤透了心

ext.ext_cn: 有一次，我听见她在卧室里哭泣，这深深地刺痛了我的心。
ext.ext_en: I once heard her weeping in her bedroom, which cut me to the quick.

defs.def_en: If something cuts you to the quick, it makes you feel very upset.

ext.ext_cn: 他得到其他一些成员的鼎力相助。
ext.ext_en: He was ably assisted by a number of other members.

defs.def_en: Ably means skilfully and successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 交通堵塞中静止不动的汽车产生了大量污染。
ext.ext_en: Stationary cars in traffic jams cause a great deal of pollution...

ext.ext_cn: 火车停了 90 分钟。
ext.ext_en: The train was stationary for 90 minutes.

defs.def_en: Something that is stationary is not moving.
An ensign is a flag flown on a ship to show what country the ship belongs to.

ext.ext_cn: 他是派驻古巴的海军少尉。
ext.ext_en: He had been a naval ensign stationed off Cuba.

ext.ext_cn: 海军少尉史密斯
ext.ext_en: ...Ensign Smith.

defs.def_en: An ensign is a junior officer in the United States Navy.

ext.ext_cn: 村民们说这个围栏将限制公众进入山区。
ext.ext_en: Villagers say the fence would restrict public access to the hills.

defs.def_en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts.

ext.ext_cn: 第一项任务就是把树林围起来不让羊进去。
ext.ext_en: The first task was to fence the wood to exclude sheep...

ext.ext_cn: 托马斯在一小块围起来的满是沙子的地上玩耍。
ext.ext_en: Thomas was playing in a little fenced area full of sand.

defs.def_en: If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

defs.def_cn: (越野障碍赛或赛马中的)障碍物
defs.def_en: A fence in show jumping or horse racing is an obstacle or barrier that horses have to jump over.

ext.ext_cn: 他开始时为另一个犯罪团伙销赃，后来就自己干起了抢劫。
ext.ext_en: He originally acted as a fence for another gang before turning to burglary himself.

defs.def_en: A fence is a person who receives stolen property and then sells it.

defs.def_cn: 言和;重归于好;化干戈为玉帛

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚，华盛顿尽最大努力与欧洲各国修好，称理解其担忧。
ext.ext_en: Washington was last night doing its best to mend fences with the Europeans, saying it understood their concerns...

ext.ext_cn: 10年前两国曾进行过边境战争，但现在正在重修旧好。
ext.ext_en: The two countries fought a border war a decade ago, but now they are mending fences.

defs.def_en: If one country tries to mend fences with another, it tries to end a disagreement or quarrel with the other country. You can also say that two countries mend fences .

ext.ext_cn: 他们保持中立,拒绝表态。
ext.ext_en: They are sitting on the fence and refusing to commit themselves...

ext.ext_cn: 他不怕拍板，从不作骑墙派。
ext.ext_en: He's not afraid of making decisions and is a man who never sits on the fence.

defs.def_en: If you sit on the fence, you avoid supporting a particular side in a discussion or argument.

ext.ext_cn: 他计划将他镇北 5 英里处的约 100 英亩牧场圈起来。
ext.ext_en: He plans to fence in about 100 acres of his ranch five miles north of town.

defs.def_en: If you fence something in, you surround it completely with a fence.

ext.ext_cn: 军旅事务使她基本上无法脱身。
ext.ext_en: She was basically fenced in by what the military wanted to do...

ext.ext_cn: 他把手放在她身后的柱子上，这样就把她围在当中，可以低头看她了。
ext.ext_en: He put his hand on the post behind her so that he had her fenced in and could look down on her.

defs.def_en: If you are fenced in by someone or something, they are so close to you that you are unable to move or leave.

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家的一切似乎与我以前的经历完全不同。
ext.ext_en: Everything about the country seemed utterly different from what I'd experienced before...

ext.ext_cn: 新颁布的法律荒唐至极。
ext.ext_en: The new laws coming in are utterly ridiculous...

defs.def_en: You use utterly to emphasize that something is very great in extent, degree, or amount.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是要求你看到问题的两面后再作出理性的决定。
ext.ext_en: He's asking you to look at both sides of the case and come to a rational decision...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽能够保持头脑清醒理智，因而迅速做出反应。
ext.ext_en: Mary was able to short-circuit her stress response by keeping her thoughts calm and rational.

defs.def_en: Rational decisions and thoughts are based on reason rather than on emotion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他看起来是一个正常而理智的人吗？
ext.ext_en: Did he come across as a sane rational person?...

ext.ext_cn: 雷切尔现在看上去更加平静、更加理智了。
ext.ext_en: Rachel looked calmer and more rational now.

defs.def_en: A rational person is someone who is sensible and is able to make decisions based on intelligent thinking rather than on emotion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 偏离中心的；中心错位的

ext.ext_cn: 踏板似乎有点偏心，离合器也相当紧。
ext.ext_en: The pedals seem a bit off-centre and the clutch is rather stiff...
