ext.ext_en: I try to offend the least amount of people possible...

ext.ext_cn: 要是喜欢吃奶酪，就吃脂肪含量最少的。
ext.ext_en: If you like cheese, go for the ones with the least fat.

defs.def_en: You use the least to mean a smaller amount than anyone or anything else, or the smallest amount possible.

ext.ext_cn: 那天的比赛中，经验最浅的运动员抢跑无数次。
ext.ext_en: The least experienced athletes had caused a great many false-starts through the day's proceedings...

ext.ext_cn: 他是我见过的最冷漠的人之一。
ext.ext_en: He was one of the least warm human beings I had ever met.

defs.def_en: You use least to indicate that someone or something has less of a particular quality than most other things of its kind.

ext.ext_cn: 我一点儿都不知道你在说什么。
ext.ext_en: I don't have the least idea of what you're talking about...

ext.ext_cn: 别处哪怕发生一丁点儿乐事，他们便会忘记自己的职责。
ext.ext_en: They neglect their duty at the least hint of fun elsewhere...

defs.def_en: You use the least to emphasize the smallness of something, especially when it hardly exists at all.

ext.ext_cn: 他往往趁她最没有心理准备时发动魅力攻势，令她措手不及。
ext.ext_en: He had a way of throwing her off guard with his charm when she least expected it.

defs.def_en: You use least to indicate that something is true or happens to a smaller degree or extent than anything else or at any other time.

defs.def_cn: 无足轻重的；微乎其微的

ext.ext_cn: 她发愁的事多着呢，相比之下，每天早上3点就要起床根本就不算什么。
ext.ext_en: Having to get up at three o'clock every morning was the least of her worries...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然3天时间不算长，但对他来说，这已经是最不成问题的问题了。
ext.ext_en: Although three days isn't very long, shortage of time was the least of his problems...

defs.def_en: You use least in structures where you are emphasizing that a particular situation or event is much less important or serious than other possible or actual ones.

ext.ext_cn: 你自己要是不帮我，好歹也告诉我该上哪儿去呀。
ext.ext_en: Well, the least you can do, if you won't  help me yourself, is to tell me where to go instead...

ext.ext_cn: 他们本应该起码给我半天时间休息。
ext.ext_en: The least they could have given me was half a day to rest...

defs.def_en: You use the least in structures where you are stating the minimum that should be done in a situation, and suggesting that more should really be done.

ext.ext_cn: 我哪里是那种人。绝对不是。
ext.ext_en: I'm not like that at all. Not in the least...

ext.ext_cn: 我对玛丽莲·梦露那种美一点儿都不动心。
ext.ext_en: I'm not in the least bit touched by the Marilyn Monroe kind of beauty...

defs.def_en: You can use in the least and the least bit to emphasize a negative.

defs.def_cn: 最后不能不提；最后但同样重要的是

ext.ext_cn: 她的4个儿子，克里斯托弗、双胞胎丹尼尔和尼古拉斯，还有不能不提的两岁大的杰克
ext.ext_en: ...her four sons, Christopher, twins Daniel and Nicholas, and last but not least 2-year-old Jack.

defs.def_en: You use last but not least to say that the last person or thing to be mentioned is as important as all the others.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定句后）（多者之中）尤其，尤数

ext.ext_cn: 从没有人读这些文章，我就更不用说了。
ext.ext_en: No one ever reads these articles, least of all me...

ext.ext_cn: 这种话本来就不应该说，尤其是不应出自一个所谓负责任的政客之口。
ext.ext_en: Such a speech should never have been made, least of all by a so-called responsible politician.

defs.def_en: You can use least of all after a negative statement to emphasize that it applies especially to the person or thing mentioned.

defs.def_cn: （强调某一例证或原因）尤其是，特别是，相当重要地

ext.ext_cn: 节食可能不利于健康，相当重要的原因是它会引起精神压力。
ext.ext_en: Dieting can be bad for you, not least because it is a cause of stress...

ext.ext_cn: 这段时间大家都减少了出游的欲望，美国人尤其如此。
ext.ext_en: Everyone is more reluctant to travel these days, not least the Americans.

defs.def_en: You can use not least to emphasize a particularly important example or reason.

defs.def_cn: 轻则；往轻里说；客气点说

ext.ext_cn: 往轻里说是住宿条件简陋。
ext.ext_en: Accommodation was basic to say the least...

ext.ext_cn: 有些民众客气点说是嘴里不大干净。
ext.ext_en: Some members of the public can be a bit abusive to say the least.

defs.def_en: You can use to say the least to suggest that a situation is actually much more extreme or serious than you say it is.
Oilcloth is a cotton fabric with a shiny waterproof surface.
An oilcloth is a covering made from oilcloth, such as a tablecloth.

ext.ext_cn: 再加些蔬菜使煎蛋看上去量更大。
ext.ext_en: Use extra vegetables to bulk up the omelette...

ext.ext_cn: 霍利菲尔德体重增到了210磅。
ext.ext_en: Holyfield has bulked up to 210 pounds using weights.

defs.def_en: If someone or something bulks up or bulks out, they become bigger or heavier.

defs.def_cn: 柠檬榨汁器；鲜橙榨汁器
defs.def_en: A lemon squeezer is an object used for squeezing juice out of lemons and oranges.

defs.def_cn: 废除(地区、机构或服务等)的种族隔离

ext.ext_cn: 为废除体育领域的种族隔离所作的努力
ext.ext_en: ...efforts to desegregate sport...

ext.ext_cn: 教育体系本身并没有完全废除种族隔离。
ext.ext_en: The school system itself is not totally desegregated.

defs.def_en: To desegregate something such as a place, institution, or service means to officially stop keeping the people who use it in separate groups, especially groups that are defined by race.

ext.ext_cn: 11岁的女孩
ext.ext_en: ...an eleven year old girl...

ext.ext_cn: 我一定是个人见人烦的小女孩。
ext.ext_en: I must have been a horrid little girl.

defs.def_en: A girl is a female child.

ext.ext_cn: 我们有一个小女儿。
ext.ext_en: We had a little girl.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's daughter as a girl .

defs.def_cn: 年轻女子，小妞儿（可能具冒犯意味）

ext.ext_cn: 20岁的漂亮姑娘
ext.ext_en: ...a pretty twenty-year-old girl.

defs.def_en: Young women are often referred to as girls. This use could cause offence.

ext.ext_cn: 我同我女朋友交往9年了。
ext.ext_en: I've been with my girl for nine years.

defs.def_en: Some people refer to a man's girlfriend as his girl.
The spectrum is the range of different colours which is produced when light passes through a glass prism or through a drop of water. A rainbow shows the colours in the spectrum.

ext.ext_cn: 她见识过他的情绪波动会有多大。
ext.ext_en: She'd seen his moods range across the emotional spectrum...

ext.ext_cn: 各党派的政客们都对该行为表示谴责。
ext.ext_en: Politicians across the political spectrum have denounced the act...

defs.def_en: A spectrum is a range of a particular type of thing.

defs.def_cn: 波谱(如光波波谱、无线电波波谱等)

ext.ext_cn: 大量的能量，从 X 光直到无线电电波，都正被泄露到太空中去。
ext.ext_en: Vast amounts of energy, from X-rays right through the spectrum down to radio waves, are escaping into space...

ext.ext_cn: 光谱中不同的颜色被认为对健康有不同的影响。
ext.ext_en: The individual colours within the light spectrum are believed to have an effect on health.

defs.def_en: A spectrum is a range of light waves or radio waves within particular frequencies.

ext.ext_cn: 一个服务生给他送上了菜单。
ext.ext_en: A waiter offered him the menu...

ext.ext_cn: 这菜单上即便是制作最精美的菜品其热量也非常低。
ext.ext_en: Even the most elaborate dishes on the menu were quite low on calories.

defs.def_en: In a restaurant or café or at a formal meal, the menu is a list of the food and drinks that are available.

ext.ext_cn: 让几个朋友尝尝这道菜。
ext.ext_en: Try out the menu on a few friends...

ext.ext_cn: 饭菜的安排至关重要。每一顿饭的每一道菜都应该有所不同。
ext.ext_en: The menu is all-important. Every component of every meal should create contrasts.

defs.def_en: A menu is the food that you serve at a meal.

defs.def_cn: (电脑屏幕上的)菜单，功能选择单，选项单
defs.def_en: On a computer screen, a menu is a list of choices. Each choice represents something that you can do using the computer.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 逐渐消失的；逐渐忘却的

ext.ext_cn: 夏季香草逐渐消散的香味
ext.ext_en: ...the evanescent scents of summer herbs.

defs.def_en: Something that is evanescent gradually disappears from sight or memory.

defs.def_cn: 浪漫态度;浪漫精神;不切实际的理想（或感受）

ext.ext_cn: 她坚定的浪漫主义情怀让我感到担忧。
ext.ext_en: Her determined romanticism was worrying me...

ext.ext_cn: 他的诗歌带有一种梦幻般的浪漫色彩。
ext.ext_en: His poetry tended towards a dreamy romanticism.

defs.def_en: Romanticism is attitudes, ideals and feelings which are romantic rather than realistic.
Romanticism is the artistic movement of the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries which was concerned with the expression of the individual's feelings and emotions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不切实际的；不可能达成的

ext.ext_cn: 很多人都觉得这些球员的要求是完全不现实的。
ext.ext_en: There are many who feel that the players are being completely unrealistic in their demands...

ext.ext_cn: 想要完成这个步骤是不可能的。
ext.ext_en: It would be unrealistic to expect such a process ever to be completed.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is being unrealistic, you mean that they do not recognize the truth about a situation, especially about the difficulties involved in something they want to achieve.
A hopper is a large cone-shaped device into which substances such as grain, coal, or animal food can be put and from which they can be released when required.

defs.def_cn: 使（房间或建筑）通风;使空气流通

ext.ext_cn: 当油漆开始剥落时，要给房间适当通风。
ext.ext_en: Ventilate the room properly when paint stripping...

ext.ext_cn: 矿井中用钢制通风机来保持空气流通。
ext.ext_en: The pit is ventilated by a steel fan.

defs.def_en: If you ventilate a room or building, you allow fresh air to get into it.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为公开提出自己的疑问或不切实际的想法并非官员们的分内之事。
ext.ext_en: He did not think it the job of officials to ventilate their doubts or daydreams.

defs.def_en: If you ventilate your ideas or feelings, you talk about them or express them freely in front of other people.

defs.def_cn: （定期就某一特定事项进行会谈的）讨论组
defs.def_en: A discussion group is a group of people who meet regularly to discuss a particular subject.

ext.ext_cn: 我像个老妇人似的驼着背。
ext.ext_en: I was humped like an old lady.

defs.def_en: If someone is humped, their back is bent so that their shoulders are further forward than usual and their head hangs down.

ext.ext_cn: 她的声音如孩童般，带有英格兰西南部诸郡的那种抑扬顿挫。
ext.ext_en: Her voice is childlike, with a West Country lilt.

defs.def_en: If someone's voice has a lilt in it, the pitch of their voice rises and falls in a pleasant way, as if they were singing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 酒醉引起的;与酒醉有关的

ext.ext_cn: 他喝得烂醉如泥,而后一阵疼痛把他疼醒了。
ext.ext_en: The pain roused him from his drunken stupor...

ext.ext_cn: 他酒后耍酒疯用平底锅打了她。
ext.ext_en: He hit her with a frying pan during a drunken brawl.

defs.def_en: Drunken is used to describe events and situations that involve people who are drunk.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一群群醉醺醺的小流氓砸碎商店的橱窗，还投掷石块。
ext.ext_en: Groups of drunken hooligans smashed shop windows and threw stones.

defs.def_en: A drunken person is drunk or is frequently drunk.

ext.ext_cn: 他从未给她换过尿布，从未给她洗过澡。
ext.ext_en: He never changed her diapers, never bathed her.

defs.def_en: A diaper is a piece of soft towel or paper, which you fasten round a baby's bottom in order to soak up its urine and faeces.

defs.def_cn: (忍住不哭或表示不赞成时)抽鼻子

ext.ext_cn: 她抹了一把脸，很响地抽着鼻子。
ext.ext_en: She wiped her face and sniffed loudly...

ext.ext_cn: 莫伊拉环顾四周，抽了抽鼻子。“这个地方太需要有人来装修一下了。”
ext.ext_en: Moira looked around and sniffed. 'This place badly needs a decorator.'...

defs.def_en: When you sniff, you breathe in air through your nose hard enough to make a sound, for example when you are trying not to cry, or in order to show disapproval.

ext.ext_cn: 他突然停下来，闻了闻空气里的味道。
ext.ext_en: Suddenly, he stopped and sniffed the air...

ext.ext_cn: 她怀疑地闻了闻。
ext.ext_en: She sniffed at it suspiciously.

defs.def_en: If you sniff something or sniff at it, you smell it by sniffing.

defs.def_cn: 嗤之以鼻地表示;轻蔑地说

ext.ext_cn: 她轻蔑地说道：“游客!”
ext.ext_en: 'Tourists!' she sniffed.

defs.def_en: You can use sniff to indicate that someone says something in a way that shows their disapproval or contempt.

ext.ext_cn: 这份工资也不容小觑。
ext.ext_en: The salary was not to be sniffed at either...

ext.ext_cn: 外交部消息人士对有可能派出英国军队的报道不屑一顾。
ext.ext_en: Foreign Office sources sniffed at reports that British troops might be sent.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not to be sniffed at, you think it is very good or worth having. If someone sniffs at something, they do not think it is good enough, or they express their contempt for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得晕乎乎的，好像吸了胶毒一样。
ext.ext_en: He felt light-headed, as if he'd sniffed glue.

defs.def_en: If someone sniffs a substance such as glue, they deliberately breathe in the substance or the gases from it as a drug.

ext.ext_cn: 你知道如果他们嗅到马上会进行谋杀调查会怎么样。
ext.ext_en: You know what they'll be like if they get a sniff of a murder investigation...

ext.ext_cn: 新闻界嗅到了一点消息没有？
ext.ext_en: Have the Press got a sniff yet?...

defs.def_en: If you get a sniff of something, you learn or guess that it might be happening or might be near.

ext.ext_cn: 在国会的整整21年里，温特顿没有得到过任何在政府里工作的机会。
ext.ext_en: Winterton has never had a sniff of a government job in his entire twenty-one years in parliament.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has not had a sniff of something, you mean that they have not had even a small chance of getting it.

defs.def_cn: 未穿衣服的；一丝不挂的；赤身裸体的

ext.ext_cn: 他学过如何画裸体。
ext.ext_en: He learned how to draw the unclothed human frame...

ext.ext_cn: 在公共场合赤身裸体被认为是不成体统的。
ext.ext_en: It's considered improper to be unclothed in public.

defs.def_en: If someone is unclothed, they are not wearing any clothes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 尊重人的;有礼貌的;恭敬的

ext.ext_cn: 他总是彬彬有礼，尊敬他人。
ext.ext_en: He was always so polite and respectful...

ext.ext_cn: 我们家的孩子对长辈总是恭恭敬敬的。
ext.ext_en: The children in our family are always respectful to their elders...

defs.def_en: If you are respectful, you show respect for someone.
A daisy chain is a string of daisies that have been joined together by their stems to make a necklace.

defs.def_cn: (用于形容词和过去分词等前)表示“坏”,“差”,“不够…”

ext.ext_cn: 欠管教的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...ill-disciplined children.

defs.def_en: Ill- is added to words, especially adjectives and past participles, to add the meaning 'badly' or 'inadequately'. For example, 'ill-written' means badly written.

ext.ext_cn: 在田里发现了她的尸体，全身赤裸，裹在一条床单里。
ext.ext_en: Her naked body was found wrapped in a sheet in a field...

ext.ext_cn: 烫人的铺路石灼烤着我的一双赤脚。
ext.ext_en: The hot paving stones scorched my naked feet...

defs.def_en: Someone who is naked is not wearing any clothes.

defs.def_cn: (动物)没有皮毛的，没有羽毛的

ext.ext_cn: 窝里有8只还没长毛、眼睛尚未睁开的小老鼠。
ext.ext_en: The nest contained eight little mice that were naked and blind.

defs.def_en: If an animal or part of an animal is naked, it has no fur or feathers on it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果报道属实，此交易的确使当局和总统猝不及防。
ext.ext_en: If the reports are accurate, the deal leaves the authorities and the President virtually naked.

ext.ext_cn: 贝文“不要毫无准备地走进会议室”的呼吁
ext.ext_en: ...Bevan's appeal against going 'naked into the conference chamber'.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is naked or feels naked, you mean they are powerless or have no way of protecting themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 空荡荡的房间里吊着的一只没有灯罩的灯泡
ext.ext_en: ...a naked bulb dangling in a bare room...

ext.ext_cn: 水是用燃气明火加热的。
ext.ext_en: The water was heated by a naked gas flame.

defs.def_en: You can describe an object as naked when it does not have its normal covering.

ext.ext_cn: 那位女士一脸毫不掩饰的憎恨让我震惊。
ext.ext_en: The naked hatred in the woman's face shocked me...

ext.ext_cn: 她说起那封信时，声音里流露出明显的痛苦。
ext.ext_en: There had been naked misery in her voice when she'd  spoken about the letter.

defs.def_en: Naked emotions are easy to recognize, because they are very strongly felt.

ext.ext_cn: 公然的侵略和企图用武力改变边界的行径是不能置之不理的。
ext.ext_en: Naked aggression and an attempt to change frontiers by force could not go unchallenged.

ext.ext_cn: 暴力以及对权力赤裸裸的追求
ext.ext_en: ...violence and the naked pursuit of power.

defs.def_en: You can use naked to describe unpleasant or violent actions and behaviour which are not disguised or hidden in any way.

ext.ext_cn: 这些虫子用肉眼看不见。
ext.ext_en: The worms cannot be seen by the naked eye...

ext.ext_cn: 整周都可以用肉眼观察到火星。
ext.ext_en: The planet Mars will be visible to the naked eye all week...

defs.def_en: If you say that something cannot be seen by the naked eye, you mean that it cannot be seen without the help of equipment such as a telescope or microscope.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人灰心的;使人沮丧的;让人懊恼的

ext.ext_cn: 当前的情形令我们十分灰心。
ext.ext_en: The current situation is very frustrating for us...

ext.ext_cn: 对帕特来说，这是一个令人沮丧和颇为艰难的时期。
ext.ext_en: ...It is a frustrating and difficult time for Pat.

defs.def_en: Something that is frustrating annoys you or makes you angry because you cannot do anything about the problems it causes.
A baton is a short heavy stick which is sometimes used as a weapon by the police.

defs.def_cn: （乐队或合唱队指挥用的）指挥棒
defs.def_en: A baton is a light, thin stick used by a conductor to conduct an orchestra or a choir.
In athletics or track events, a baton is a short stick that is passed from one runner to another in a relay race.

defs.def_cn: （游行队伍中游行者持有的）指挥杖
defs.def_en: A baton is a long stick with a knob on one end that is sometimes carried by a person marching in a parade. The baton is spun round, thrown into the air and caught.

ext.ext_cn: 这是不是意味着要把领导权交给其他国家？
ext.ext_en: Does this mean that the baton of leadership is going to be passed to other nations?

defs.def_en: If someone passes the baton to another person, they pass responsibility for something to that person. If someone picks up the baton, they take over responsibility for something.

ext.ext_cn: 凯尔特传统文化中的重要人物
ext.ext_en: ...important figures in Celtic tradition.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as Celtic, you mean that it is connected with the people and the culture of Scotland, Wales, Ireland, and some other areas such as Brittany.

ext.ext_cn: 集尘袋起着过滤的作用，所集的灰尘太多时其吸附作用就会减小。
ext.ext_en: Dustbags act as a filter and suction will be reduced if they are too full...

ext.ext_cn: 乳头进入奶杯后，吸奶器的吸力能确保乳房吸附在上面。
ext.ext_en: If the teat enters the cup, the suction of the milking machine ensures that it becomes attached.

defs.def_en: Suction is the process by which liquids, gases, or other substances are drawn out of somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔正给护士示范如何把他的唾液吸出来。
ext.ext_en: Michael was showing the nurse how to suction his saliva...

ext.ext_cn: 我们发现了一个囊肿，我把其中的液体吸了出来。
ext.ext_en: We found a cyst and I suctioned off the liquid within.

defs.def_en: If a doctor or nurse suctions a liquid, they remove it by using a machine which sucks it away.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的气动机器人依靠空气来移动，靠吸力附着于物体表面
ext.ext_en: ...their pneumatic robot which uses air to move and sticks to surfaces by suction.

defs.def_en: Suction is the process by which two surfaces stick together when the air between them is removed.
A barrow is the same as a wheelbarrow .

defs.def_cn: （在街边贩卖水果等的）手推车
defs.def_en: A barrow is a cart from which fruit or other goods are sold in the street.
A barrow is a large structure made of earth that people used to build over graves in ancient times.

ext.ext_cn: “彗星”还跟“斯平威·哈维斯特”生下了这匹出类拔萃的小马驹。
ext.ext_en: Comet also sired the champion foal out of Spinway Harvest.

defs.def_en: When a male animal, especially a horse, sires a young animal, he makes a female pregnant so that she gives birth to it.

ext.ext_cn: 亨特娶过 3 个女人，生了 15 个孩子。
ext.ext_en: Hunt married three women and sired 15 children.

defs.def_en: If a man sires a child, he makes a woman pregnant and she gives birth to a child.
Your sire is your father.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他有一种非常滑稽的幽默感。
ext.ext_en: He had a clownish sense of humour.

ext.ext_cn: 他们滑稽愚蠢的行为
ext.ext_en: ...their clownish stupidity.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person's appearance or behaviour as clownish, you mean that they look or behave rather like a clown, and often that they appear rather foolish.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 应受斥责的;应该谴责的

ext.ext_cn: 克拉默先生说反政府示威者的暴力活动应该受到谴责。
ext.ext_en: Mr Cramer said the violence by anti-government protestors was reprehensible.

ext.ext_cn: 最应该受到谴责的行为
ext.ext_en: ...behaving in the most reprehensible manner.

defs.def_en: If you think that a type of behaviour or an idea is very bad and morally wrong, you can say that it is reprehensible .

defs.def_cn: (用来把皮肤晒成深褐色的)太阳灯，紫外线灯
defs.def_en: A sun lamp is a lamp that produces ultraviolet light. People use sun lamps to make their skin browner.

ext.ext_cn: 这是个为各种内城常见问题所困扰的社区。
ext.ext_en: It is a neighborhood beset by all the usual inner-city problems...

ext.ext_cn: 她脸上挂着她一贯的微笑。
ext.ext_en: She's smiling her usual friendly smile...

defs.def_en: Usual is used to describe what happens or what is done most often in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 照例，6月12日将会进行地方及区域选举。
ext.ext_en: As usual there will be the local and regional elections on June the twelfth...

ext.ext_cn: 像平常一样，头版上刊登着国内外新闻。
ext.ext_en: The front pages are, as usual, a mixture of domestic and foreign news.

defs.def_en: You use as usual to indicate that you are describing something that normally happens or that is normally the case.

defs.def_cn: （尤指其他事情有变化时）照常

ext.ext_cn: 就算有人死了一切也都照常进行，好像什么事都没发生过。
ext.ext_en: When somebody died everything went on as usual, as if it had never happened...

ext.ext_cn: 接受药物治疗后，家里的生活还能一切如常。
ext.ext_en: With medication, life at home goes on as usual.

defs.def_en: If something happens as usual, it happens in the way that it normally does, especially when other things have changed.

ext.ext_cn: 她是个混血（英国和牙买加）伦敦人。
ext.ext_en: She's a Londoner of mixed parentage (English and Jamaican)...

ext.ext_cn: 我们都是由各自的出身和教育造就的。
ext.ext_en: We are all the result of our parentage and upbringing.

defs.def_en: Your parentage is the identity and origins of your parents. For example, if you are of Greek parentage, your parents are Greek.

ext.ext_cn: 他从耳后拿出一小段铅笔头。
ext.ext_en: He pulled the stub of a pencil from behind his ear.

ext.ext_cn: 一烟缸的烟蒂
ext.ext_en: ...an ashtray of cigarette stubs.

defs.def_en: The stub of a cigarette or a pencil is the last short piece of it which remains when the rest has been used.

ext.ext_cn: 仍保留原始票根的球迷请于 7 月 3 号前和谢菲尔德体育馆联系。
ext.ext_en: Fans who still have their original ticket stubs should contact Sheffield Arena by July 3.

defs.def_en: A ticket stub is the part that you keep when you go in to watch a performance.
A cheque stub is the small part that you keep as a record of what you have paid.

ext.ext_cn: 我不小心踢到桌子腿上。
ext.ext_en: I stubbed my toes against a table leg.

defs.def_en: If you stub your toe, you hurt it by accidentally kicking something.

defs.def_cn: (常指富人或贵族家庭的)乡间宅第，别墅
defs.def_en: A country house is a large, often attractive, house in the country, usually one that is or was owned by a rich or noble family.
A holidaymaker is a person who is away from their home on holiday.

defs.def_cn: 父亲般的人;(像父亲一样的)长者

ext.ext_cn: 她认为女儿需要一个父亲一样的人。
ext.ext_en: She believed her daughter needed a father-figure...

ext.ext_cn: 他成了整个公司的长者。
ext.ext_en: He became a father figure to the whole company.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a father figure, you mean that you feel able to turn to that person for advice and support in the same way that you might turn to your father.

defs.def_cn: 在最大程度上;在最大范围内;最大限度地

ext.ext_cn: 价格下跌得最厉害的英格兰南部仍将是最疲软的市场。
ext.ext_en: The south of England, where prices have fallen furthest, will remain the weakest market...

ext.ext_cn: 这些机构改革在波兰进行得最为深入。
ext.ext_en: These institutional reforms have gone furthest in Poland.

defs.def_en: Furthest means to a greater extent or degree than ever before or than anything or anyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 距离海岸最远的那些地区受雷击的危险最大。
ext.ext_en: The risk of thunder is greatest in those areas furthest from the coast...

ext.ext_cn: 在那些不远万里赶来参加节日活动的人中有一群来自北爱尔兰。
ext.ext_en: Amongst those who have travelled furthest to take part in the Festival are a group from Northern Ireland.

defs.def_en: Furthest means at a greater distance from a particular point than anyone or anything else, or for a greater distance than anyone or anything else.

ext.ext_cn: 他同女朋友已经交往7个月了。
ext.ext_en: He had been going out with his girlfriend for seven months...

ext.ext_cn: 他有女朋友吗？
ext.ext_en: Has he got a girlfriend?

defs.def_en: Someone's girlfriend is a girl or woman with whom they are having a romantic or sexual relationship.

ext.ext_cn: 我同一位女友共进了午餐。
ext.ext_en: I met a girlfriend for lunch.

defs.def_en: A girlfriend is a female friend.

defs.def_cn: (美洲印第安人用动物的毛皮或树皮制作的)圆锥形帐篷
defs.def_en: A tepee is a round tent. Tepees were first made by Native American peoples from animal skins or the outer covering of trees.

defs.def_cn: （付款）作为恩惠的，非出于法律义务的

ext.ext_cn: 否则，他们不会觉得必须向那些没有受到公平待遇的顾客提供补偿款。
ext.ext_en: Otherwise, they would not feel compelled to make ex gratia payments to customers they have wronged.

defs.def_en: An ex gratia payment is one that is given as a favour or gift and not because it is legally necessary.

defs.def_cn: 互惠生，互裨青年（为学习语言而寄宿在某一家庭并帮助照看孩子的年轻外国人）
defs.def_en: An au pair is a young person from a foreign country who lives with a family in order to learn the language and who helps to look after the children.

ext.ext_cn: 现在说保险费是否会受影响还为时过早。
ext.ext_en: It is too early to say whether insurance premiums will be affected.

defs.def_en: A premium is a sum of money that you pay regularly to an insurance company for an insurance policy.

ext.ext_cn: 即使顾客想得到“解决方案”，他们大多数也不愿意为此支付额外费用。
ext.ext_en: Even if customers want 'solutions', most are not willing to pay a premium for them...

ext.ext_cn: 打电话要支付每分钟48便士的附加费。
ext.ext_en: Callers are charged a premium rate of 48p a minute.

defs.def_en: A premium is a sum of money that you have to pay for something in addition to the normal cost.

ext.ext_cn: 高端市场业务繁荣。
ext.ext_en: At the premium end of the market, business is booming.

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家最受欢迎的优质冰激凌
ext.ext_en: ...the most popular premium ice cream in this country.

defs.def_en: Premium goods are of a higher than usual quality and are often expensive.

defs.def_cn: 紧缺的；稀缺的；难以得到的

ext.ext_cn: 如果空间有限，就选择一些不会把房间占得很满的可改装家具。
ext.ext_en: If space is at a premium, choose adaptable furniture that won't fill the room.

defs.def_en: If something is at a premium, it is wanted or needed, but is difficult to get or achieve.

defs.def_cn: 超出平常价，以高价（买进或售出）

ext.ext_cn: 他最后以高价把股票回售给银行。
ext.ext_en: He eventually sold the shares back to the bank at a premium.

defs.def_en: If you buy or sell something at a premium, you buy or sell it at a higher price than usual, for example because it is in short supply.

ext.ext_cn: 我非常重视一个人的人品。
ext.ext_en: I place a high premium on what someone is like as a person...

ext.ext_cn: 他们对预防和初级护理极为重视。
ext.ext_en: They put a high premium on prevention and primary care.

defs.def_en: If you place a high premium on a quality or characteristic or put a high premium on it, you regard it as very important.

ext.ext_cn: 明天某个时刻会发生日全食。
ext.ext_en: A total solar eclipse is due to take place some time tomorrow.

defs.def_en: Solar is used to describe things relating to the sun.
Solar power is obtained from the sun's light and heat.

ext.ext_cn: 5年前一群主要由文化程度不高的激进分子构成的不满现状者夺取了政权。
ext.ext_en: Five years ago a band of malcontents, mainly half-educated radicals, seized power.

defs.def_en: You can describe people as malcontents when you disapprove of the fact that they are dissatisfied with a situation and want it to change.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车工业
ext.ext_en: ...the auto industry.

defs.def_en: An auto is a car.

defs.def_cn: 慈善商店(廉价出售二手货，利润用于慈善事业)
defs.def_en: A charity shop is a shop that sells used goods cheaply and gives its profits to a charity.

ext.ext_cn: 这些油画除了作为古董，本身没有什么内在价值。
ext.ext_en: The paintings have no intrinsic value except as curiosities...

ext.ext_cn: 速度由诸如地面坡度这样的内在因素决定。
ext.ext_en: The rate is determined by intrinsic qualities such as the land's slope.

defs.def_en: If something has intrinsic value or intrinsic interest, it is valuable or interesting because of its basic nature or character, and not because of its connection with other things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （论点、解释等）难以令人信服的，没有说服力的

ext.ext_cn: 帕特尔先生致电大学要求对方作出解释，但只得到了一些无关痛痒的惯用托词。
ext.ext_en: Mr Patel phoned the University for an explanation, and he was given the usual unconvincing excuses...

ext.ext_cn: 在很多读者看来，这很难令人信服。
ext.ext_en: To many readers it sounded unconvincing.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as an argument or explanation as unconvincing, you find it difficult to believe because it does not seem real.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （故事或人物）不可信的，不真实的

ext.ext_cn: 不太可信的爱情故事
ext.ext_en: ...an unconvincing love story.

defs.def_en: If you describe a story or a character in a story as unconvincing, you think they do not seem likely or real.

ext.ext_cn: 玫瑰图案
ext.ext_en: ...a rose motif.

defs.def_en: A motif is a design which is used as a decoration or as part of an artistic pattern.

ext.ext_cn: 这几卷的主题是“孤独是灵魂的财富，寂寞是灵魂的贫瘠”。
ext.ext_en: The motif of these volumes is that 'solitude is the richness of the soul, loneliness is its poverty.'

defs.def_en: A motif is a theme or idea that is frequently repeated throughout a piece of literature or music.

ext.ext_cn: 饭菜摆放在擦得铮亮、铺着衬垫的餐桌上。
ext.ext_en: The food is served on polished tables with mats.

defs.def_en: A mat is a small piece of something such as cloth, card, or plastic which you put on a table to protect it from plates or cups.

ext.ext_cn: 地毯上有一封信。
ext.ext_en: There was a letter on the mat...

ext.ext_cn: 带上睡袋和泡沫垫。
ext.ext_en: Bring a sleeping bag and foam mat.

defs.def_en: A mat is a small piece of carpet or other thick material which is put on the floor for protection, decoration, or comfort.

ext.ext_cn: 房屋稀稀疏疏地坐落着，每栋都有自己的一片地和粗草坪。
ext.ext_en: The houses are well spaced out, each on its own plot of ground and mat of coarse grass...

ext.ext_cn: 她摸着他那浓密的淡棕色胸毛。
ext.ext_en: She touched the thick mat of sandy hair on his chest.

defs.def_en: A mat of something such as grass or moss is a thick,  untidy layer of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我本来想抄近路，结果却迷路了。
ext.ext_en: I tried to take a short cut and got lost.

defs.def_en: A short cut is a quicker way of getting somewhere than the usual route.

ext.ext_cn: 有了名气就容易收获爱情和金钱。
ext.ext_en: Fame can be a shortcut to love and money...

ext.ext_cn: 从独裁到民主没有捷径可走。
ext.ext_en: There is no short cut from dictatorship to democracy.

defs.def_en: A short cut is a method of achieving something more quickly or more easily than if you use the usual methods.

defs.def_cn: (显示在计算机桌面上的)快捷方式(图标)

ext.ext_cn: 在视窗操作系统中移动、复制图标或创建快捷方式的方法
ext.ext_en: ...ways to move or copy icons or create shortcuts in Windows.

defs.def_en: On a computer, a shortcut is an icon on the desktop that allows you to go immediately to a program, document and so on.

ext.ext_cn: 可以实现回到屏幕顶端操作的很方便的键盘快捷键
ext.ext_en: ...a handy keyboard shortcut that takes you to the top of the screen.

defs.def_en: On a computer, a shortcut is a keystroke or a combination of keystrokes that allows you to give commands without using the mouse.

defs.def_cn: 全球变暖；地球大气层变暖

ext.ext_cn: 全球变暖的威胁将最终迫使美国减缓能源消耗。
ext.ext_en: The threat of global warming will eventually force the US to slow down its energy consumption.

defs.def_en: Global warming is the gradual rise in the earth's temperature caused by high levels of carbon dioxide and other gases in the atmosphere.

ext.ext_cn: 他摔了一跤，扭伤了脚踝。
ext.ext_en: He fell and sprained his ankle.

defs.def_en: If you sprain a joint such as your ankle or wrist, you accidentally damage it by twisting it or bending it violently.
A sprain is the injury caused by spraining a joint.
Sylvan is used to describe things that have an association with woods and trees.
Sea lanes are particular routes which ships regularly use in order to cross a sea or ocean.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 开朗的；爱开玩笑的；幽默的；诙谐的

ext.ext_cn: 他不像往常一样那么爱开玩笑。
ext.ext_en: He was in a less jocular mood than usual...

ext.ext_cn: 这首歌的风格轻松愉快、诙谐风趣。
ext.ext_en: The song was written in a light-hearted jocular way.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a jocular manner, you mean that they are cheerful and often make jokes or try to make people laugh.
A concessioner is the same as a concessionaire .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 肌肉僵硬粗大的;肌肉过分发达的

ext.ext_cn: 一幅画着一位得意洋洋、肌肉发达的女人骑跨着一个匍匐男人的卡通画
ext.ext_en: ...a cartoon of a muscle-bound woman standing victorious astride a prone male.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as muscle-bound, you mean that their muscles are well developed, usually in an unattractive way.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在抚养孩子的过程中遇到了各种各样的问题。
ext.ext_en: They face a myriad of problems bringing up children...

ext.ext_cn: 这些不同种类的鱼足以让任何一个游泳者数小时流连忘返。
ext.ext_en: These myriads of fish would be enough to keep any swimmer entranced for hours.

defs.def_en: A myriad or myriads of people or things is a very large number or great variety of them.

defs.def_cn: 无数的;大量的；各种各样的

ext.ext_cn: 以多种不同形式出现的英国流行音乐和文化
ext.ext_en: ...British pop and culture in all its myriad forms.

ext.ext_cn: 在冰里生存着的无数微小动植物
ext.ext_en: ...the myriad tiny animals and plants living in the ice.

defs.def_en: Myriad means having a large number or great variety.

defs.def_cn: (公司的)呼叫中心，电话服务中心
defs.def_en: A call centre is an office where people work answering or making telephone calls for a particular company.

ext.ext_cn: 随后几年人口的增长
ext.ext_en: ...the increase of population in subsequent years...

ext.ext_cn: 随后发生的事使之前所关注的那些问题显得无足轻重。
ext.ext_en: Those concerns were overshadowed by subsequent events.

defs.def_en: You use subsequent to describe something that happened or existed after the time or event that has just been referred to.

ext.ext_cn: 继去年在杯赛半决赛中获胜后，他们仅又赢过一场比赛。
ext.ext_en: They won only one more game subsequent to their Cup semi-final win last year.

defs.def_en: If something happened subsequent to something else, it happened after that thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不平衡的；站立不稳的；摇摇欲坠的

ext.ext_cn: 他试图用自己的身体推开袭击者，但却失去了平衡。
ext.ext_en: He tried to use his own weight to push his attacker off but he was off balance...

ext.ext_cn: 向前的这一猛扑让他站立不住，他急忙一个转身想稳住重心。
ext.ext_en: The lunge had thrown him off-balance and he spun, trying to regain his centre of gravity.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is off-balance, they can easily fall or be knocked over because they are not standing firmly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 冷不防的；大出意料的；极为慌乱的

ext.ext_cn: 马林斯突然改变话题，这让我措手不及。
ext.ext_en: Mullins knocked me off-balance with his abrupt change of subject...

ext.ext_cn: 政府对这一未遂政变猝不及防。
ext.ext_en: The government was thrown off-balance by the attempted coup.

defs.def_en: If someone is caught off-balance, they are extremely surprised or upset by a particular event or piece of news they are not expecting.

ext.ext_cn: 被保守党讥讽为“名嘴阶层”的那些人
ext.ext_en: ...those in what the Tories sneeringly call the 'chattering classes'...

ext.ext_cn: 他们态度轻蔑，不屑一顾。
ext.ext_en: They were sneeringly dismissive.

defs.def_en: To refer sneeringly to someone or something means to refer to them in a way that shows your contempt for them.

ext.ext_cn: 刚才我稍稍离题说明了迄今的情况，现在让我来概述一下。
ext.ext_en: I've digressed a little to explain the situation so far, so let me now recap...

ext.ext_cn: 她脱离了发言稿的主题，对总统给予了高度赞扬。
ext.ext_en: She digressed from her prepared speech to pay tribute to the President.

defs.def_en: If you digress, you move away from the subject you are talking or writing about and talk or write about something different for a while.

ext.ext_cn: 通过采取更好的坐姿，你的腹部马上就会看起来平坦一些。
ext.ext_en: You can make your stomach look flatter instantly by improving your posture...

ext.ext_cn: 锻炼、新鲜空气和好的坐立姿势都很有益。
ext.ext_en: Exercise, fresh air, and good posture are all helpful...

defs.def_en: Your posture is the position in which you stand or sit.

ext.ext_cn: 军方随时准备由防御立场转向备战立场。
ext.ext_en: The military machine is ready to change its defensive posture to one prepared for action...

ext.ext_cn: 没有一家银行因为这次调查而对该交易改变立场。
ext.ext_en: None of the banks changed their posture on the deal as a result of the inquiry.

defs.def_en: A posture is an attitude that you have towards something.

defs.def_cn: 故作姿态；装腔作势；装模作样

ext.ext_cn: 她说总统也许只是在做样子而已。
ext.ext_en: She says the President may just be posturing.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone is posturing when you disapprove of their behaviour because you think they are trying to give a particular impression in order to deceive people.

ext.ext_cn: 妈妈坐在厨房里的椅子上。
ext.ext_en: Mother was sitting in her chair in the kitchen...

ext.ext_cn: 他们吃惊地坐在那里，不敢相信这是真的。
ext.ext_en: They sat there in shock and disbelief...

defs.def_en: If you are sitting somewhere, for example in a chair, your bottom is resting on the chair and the upper part of your body is upright.

ext.ext_cn: 他把箱子靠墙放好，然后坐在上面。
ext.ext_en: He set the cases against a wall and sat on them...

ext.ext_cn: 伊娃拽过一把椅子，坐到丈夫的身边。
ext.ext_en: Eva pulled over a chair and sat beside her husband...

defs.def_en: When you sit somewhere, you lower your body until you are sitting on something.

ext.ext_cn: 他过去常常让我坐在他的腿上。
ext.ext_en: He used to sit me on his lap...

ext.ext_cn: 他会让你坐到电脑前，大致了解一下这个问题。
ext.ext_en: He'll sit you in front of his computer and give you a glimpse of the problem.

defs.def_en: If you sit someone somewhere, you tell them to sit there or put them in a sitting position.

defs.def_en: If you record something such as a speech or performance, you put it on tape or film so that it can be heard or seen again later.

defs.def_cn: 录制（音乐、电视或广播节目）

ext.ext_cn: 乐师们花了两天半的时间为电影录制配乐。
ext.ext_en: It took the musicians two and a half days to record their soundtrack for the film...

ext.ext_cn: 她最近录制了一档电视节目。
ext.ext_en: She has recently recorded a programme for television.

defs.def_en: If a musician or performer records a piece of music or a television or radio show, they perform it so that it can be put onto CD, tape, or film.

ext.ext_cn: 这是我最喜欢的唱片之一。
ext.ext_en: This is one of my favourite records.

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰最大、最知名的唱片公司
ext.ext_en: ...the biggest and best-known record company in England.

defs.def_en: A record is a round, flat piece of black plastic on which sound, especially music, is stored, and which can be played on a record player. You can also refer to the music stored on this piece of plastic as a record.

defs.def_cn: 记录，表明（某种测量结果或数值）

ext.ext_cn: 试验记录下了脑电活动。
ext.ext_en: The test records the electrical activity of the brain...

ext.ext_cn: 龙头股指数录得16个百分点的跌幅。
ext.ext_en: The index of the performance of leading shares recorded a 16 per cent fall.

defs.def_en: If a dial or other measuring device records a certain measurement or value, it shows that measurement or value.

defs.def_cn: （体育运动或活动的）纪录，最好成绩

ext.ext_cn: 罗杰·金德姆创造了12.92秒的世界纪录。
ext.ext_en: Roger Kingdom set the world record of 12.92 seconds...

ext.ext_cn: 这幅画卖了665,000英镑，是这个艺术家最贵的一幅了。
ext.ext_en: The painting was sold for £665,000 — a record for the artist.

defs.def_en: A record is the best result that has ever been achieved in a particular sport or activity, for example the fastest time, the furthest distance, or the greatest number of victories.

ext.ext_cn: 利润创下新高。
ext.ext_en: Profits were at record levels...

ext.ext_cn: 她以破纪录的成绩赢得了这场比赛。
ext.ext_en: She won the race in record time.

defs.def_en: You use record to say that something is higher, lower, better, or worse than has ever been achieved before.

ext.ext_cn: 他的履历显示他性格强悍。
ext.ext_en: His record reveals a tough streak...

ext.ext_cn: 作为一个牧师他成就卓著。
ext.ext_en: He had a distinguished record as a chaplain...

defs.def_en: Someone's record is the facts that are known about their achievements or character.

ext.ext_cn: 15年前留有案底的海洛因瘾君子
ext.ext_en: ...a heroin addict with a criminal record going back 15 years...

ext.ext_cn: 要是被告有暴力犯罪记录，必须予以拘留。
ext.ext_en: Where the accused has a record of violence, they should always be kept in custody.

defs.def_en: If someone has a criminal record, it is officially known that they have committed crimes in the past.

defs.def_cn: 供记录（表示将公开申明某事）

ext.ext_cn: 我们愿意郑重声明那是有极大价值的。
ext.ext_en: We're willing to state for the record that it has enormous value.

defs.def_en: If you say that what you are going to say next is for the record, you mean that you are saying it publicly and officially and you want it to be written down and remembered.

defs.def_cn: 供记录在案；作为记录（备用）

ext.ext_cn: 需要指出的是，多数莫斯科女孩18岁从学校毕业。
ext.ext_en: For the record, most Moscow girls leave school at about 18...

ext.ext_cn: 也许你不介意告诉我你周一在做些什么。只是顺便问问。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps you'd like to tell me what you were doing Monday. Just for the record.

defs.def_en: If you give some information for the record, you give it in case people might find it useful at a later time, although it is not a very important part of what you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 我可以私下说说吗，不要发表？
ext.ext_en: May I speak off the record?...

ext.ext_cn: 午餐快结束的时候，我说我有一些想私下谈的看法。
ext.ext_en: At the end of the lunch, I said I had some off-the-record comments.

defs.def_en: If something that you say is off the record, you do not intend it to be considered as official, or published with your name attached to it.

defs.def_cn: 公开宣布的；记录在案的

ext.ext_cn: 财政大臣公开宣称失业率上升是遏制通货膨胀“值得付出的代价”。
ext.ext_en: The Chancellor is on record as saying that the increase in unemployment is 'a price worth paying' to keep inflation down.

defs.def_en: If you are on record as saying something, you have said it publicly and officially and it has been written down.

ext.ext_cn: 习惯上要把所有的样品分析记录在案。
ext.ext_en: The practice is to keep on record any analysis of samples.

defs.def_en: If you keep information on record, you write it down or store it in a computer so that it can be used later.

ext.ext_cn: 这是史上为期最短的一次竞选活动。
ext.ext_en: It's the shortest election campaign on record...

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪80年代是有史以来最热的十年。
ext.ext_en: The 1980s were the hottest decade on record.

defs.def_en: If something is the best, worst, or biggest on record, it is the best, worst, or biggest thing of its kind that has been noticed and written down.

ext.ext_cn: 我来纠正一下你文章里的错误认识。
ext.ext_en: Let me set the record straight on the misconceptions contained in your article.

defs.def_en: If you set the record straight or put the record straight, you show that something which has been regarded as true is in fact not true.
A loofah is a long rough sponge-like piece of plant fibre which you use to scrub your body.

ext.ext_cn: 这些照片好像被用于敲诈勒索。
ext.ext_en: It looks like the pictures were being used for blackmail...

ext.ext_cn: 对方指控他敲诈勒索。
ext.ext_en: Opponents accused him of blackmail and extortion.

defs.def_en: Blackmail is the action of threatening to reveal a secret about someone, unless they do something you tell them to do, such as giving you money.

ext.ext_cn: 从公然威吓到微妙的情感胁迫，各种战术都用上了。
ext.ext_en: The tactics employed can range from overt bullying to subtle emotional blackmail.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action as emotional or moral blackmail, you disapprove of it because someone is using a person's emotions or moral values to persuade them to do something against their will.

ext.ext_cn: 他告诉她说他们的婚外情必须结束了，因为杰克·史密斯正在敲诈他。
ext.ext_en: He told her their affair would have to stop, because Jack Smith was blackmailing him...

ext.ext_cn: 政府坚持说它不会接受暴力讹诈。
ext.ext_en: The government insisted that it would not be blackmailed by violence...

defs.def_en: If one person blackmails another person, they use blackmail against them.

ext.ext_cn: 他停都不停地冲过交叉路口，然后错拐进了一条单行道逆向飞驰。
ext.ext_en: He zoomed through junctions without stopping and sped the wrong way down a one-way street.

defs.def_en: In one-way streets or traffic systems, vehicles can only travel along in one direction.

ext.ext_cn: 这些拖车式活动房将供单程旅行租用。
ext.ext_en: The trailers will be rented for one-way trips...

defs.def_en: One-way describes journeys which go to just one place, rather than to that place and then back again.

ext.ext_cn: 从纽约到洛杉矶的单程票
ext.ext_en: ...a one-way ticket from New York to Los Angeles.

ext.ext_cn: 弹性票价单程上浮最高可达80美元。
ext.ext_en: Unrestricted fares will be increased as much as $80 one-way.

defs.def_en: A one-way ticket or fare is for a journey from one place to another, but not back again.

ext.ext_cn: 这看起来是一举致富的良机，但到后来所有的一切都出了岔子。
ext.ext_en: It seemed like a one-way ticket to riches, but then it all went wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 吸烟注定会带来恶果，它或许是最主要的而且是唯一一个可以预防的心脏病诱因。
ext.ext_en: Smoking is a one-way ticket to doom and is probably the most important single preventable cause of heart disease.

defs.def_en: If you say that a course of action is a one-way ticket to a place or situation, or is a one-way journey there, you are sure that it will lead to the place or situation mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在观察室透过单向玻璃注视着特德和他的治疗师。
ext.ext_en: From the observation booth, we watched Ted and his therapist through the one-way glass.

defs.def_en: One-way glass or a one-way mirror is a piece of glass which acts as a mirror when looked at from one side, but acts as a window when looked through from the other side. They are used for watching people without their knowledge.

defs.def_cn: 单向付出的关系；单方受益的协议

ext.ext_cn: 过去10年的经验表明，忠诚对于欧盟怀疑论者而言是单向的，他们仅会索取不会给予。
ext.ext_en: The experience of the last 10 years has shown that, for the Eurosceptics, loyalty is a one-way street; something you demand but do not give...

ext.ext_cn: 所以在两国的双边贸易中可以说只有古巴从中受惠。
ext.ext_en: So trade between the two nations has been something of a one-way street, with Cuba deriving the benefit.

defs.def_en: If you describe an agreement or a relationship as a one-way street, you mean that only one of the sides in the agreement or relationship is offering something or is benefitting from it.

ext.ext_cn: 他一句话也不说，显得疏远而冷漠。
ext.ext_en: He was mute, distant, and indifferent...

ext.ext_cn: 我默默地向葆拉投去恳求的目光。
ext.ext_en: I threw a mute look of appeal at Paula.

defs.def_en: Someone who is mute is silent for a particular reason and does not speak.

ext.ext_cn: 公爵的女儿玛丽安娜在遭受了一次电击后失声了。
ext.ext_en: Marianna, the duke's daughter, became mute after a shock.

defs.def_en: Someone who is mute is unable to speak.

defs.def_cn: 抑制(情感);减弱，缓和(活动强度)

ext.ext_cn: 腐败似乎没有影响国家经济的持续繁荣。
ext.ext_en: The corruption does not seem to have muted the country's prolonged economic boom.

defs.def_en: If someone mutes something such as their feelings or their activities, they reduce the strength or intensity of them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们开始压低嗓门，不再那么肯定了。
ext.ext_en: They begin to mute their voices, not be as assertive...

ext.ext_cn: 最初长满树木的山坡吸收了噪音。
ext.ext_en: At first the wooded hillsides muted the sounds.

defs.def_en: If you mute a noise or sound, you lower its volume or make it less distinct.
A mute is a device which can be used to make a musical instrument produce a quieter, softer sound.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们的通讯系统效率非常差。
ext.ext_en: Their communication systems are inefficient in the extreme.

ext.ext_cn: 设备陈旧、效率低下的工厂的关闭
ext.ext_en: ...the closure of outdated and inefficient factories.

defs.def_en: Inefficient people, organizations, systems, or machines do not use time, energy, or other resources in the best way.

ext.ext_cn: 外墙看起来一刮强风就会倒塌。
ext.ext_en: The outer walls looked likely to tumble down in a stiff wind...

ext.ext_cn: 如果地基不牢，房子将会倒塌。
ext.ext_en: If the foundations are flawed the house will come tumbling down.

defs.def_en: If a building tumbles down, it collapses or parts of it fall off, usually because it is old and no-one has taken care of it.

ext.ext_cn: 各部分相互扣住。
ext.ext_en: The parts interlock...

ext.ext_cn: 把手十指交错放到背后。
ext.ext_en: Interlock your fingers behind your back...

defs.def_en: Things that interlock or are interlocked go between or through each other so that they are linked.

ext.ext_cn: 以色列、黎巴嫩与海湾的问题一环扣一环。
ext.ext_en: The problems of Israel, Lebanon, and the Gulf were tightly interlocked...

ext.ext_cn: 悲剧开始相互交叠。
ext.ext_en: The tragedies begin to interlock...

defs.def_en: If systems, situations, or plans are interlocked or interlock, they are very closely connected.
A headland is a narrow piece of land which sticks out from the coast into the sea.
A discus is a heavy circular object which athletes try to throw as far as they can as a sport.

ext.ext_cn: 他在蒙特利尔奥运会的掷铁饼比赛中夺了冠。
ext.ext_en: He won the discus at the Montreal Olympics.

defs.def_en: The discus is the sport of throwing a discus.

defs.def_cn: (组织、官方机构)超国家的，多国的

ext.ext_cn: 北大西洋公约组织和其他西方超国家机构
ext.ext_en: ...NATO and other Western supranational institutions.

defs.def_en: A supranational organization or authority involves or relates to more than one country.

ext.ext_cn: 我简直想把整个项目都扔进垃圾堆。
ext.ext_en: I'd simply like to deep-six this whole project.

defs.def_en: To deep-six something means to get rid of it or destroy it.
A guest house is a small hotel.
A guest house is a small house in the grounds of a large house, where visitors can stay.

ext.ext_cn: 我每晚都洗头。
ext.ext_en: I wash my hair every night...

ext.ext_cn: 他一头乌发。
ext.ext_en: He has black hair.

defs.def_en: Your hair is the fine threads that grow in a mass on your head.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数男子长有胸毛。
ext.ext_en: The majority of men have hair on their chest...

ext.ext_cn: 它挠得我后脖梗儿的绒毛直痒痒。
ext.ext_en: It tickled the hairs on the back of my neck.

defs.def_en: Hair is the short, fine threads that grow on different parts of your body.

ext.ext_cn: 我对猫毛过敏。
ext.ext_en: I am allergic to cat hair.

ext.ext_cn: 地毯上的狗毛
ext.ext_en: ...dog hairs on the carpet.

defs.def_en: Hair is the threads that cover the body of an animal such as a dog, or make up a horse's mane and tail.

ext.ext_cn: 荨麻长有四方茎和细小茸毛。
ext.ext_en: The stinging nettle has a square stem and little hairs.

defs.def_en: Hairs are short, very fine threads that grow on some insects and plants.

defs.def_cn: 彻底放松;玩个痛快;无拘无束

ext.ext_cn: 全球闻名的啤酒节，一个让所有身在慕尼黑的人都尽情放松的节日
ext.ext_en: ...the world-famous Oktoberfest, a time when everyone in Munich really lets their hair down.

defs.def_en: If you let your hair down, you relax completely and enjoy yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 这是那种让人不寒而栗的微笑。
ext.ext_en: This was the kind of smile that made your hair stand on end.

defs.def_en: Something that makes your hair stand on end shocks or frightens you very much.

ext.ext_cn: 她化了浓妆，精致得让人挑不出一丝瑕疵。
ext.ext_en: She had a lot of make-up on and not a hair out of place.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has not a hair out of place, you are emphasizing that they are extremely smart and neatly dressed.

defs.def_cn: 面不改色;毫不惊慌;泰然自若

ext.ext_cn: 似乎没有人对离异的公主再婚感到丝毫地吃惊。
ext.ext_en: No one seems to turn a hair at the thought of the divorced Princess marrying.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone faced with a shock or a problem does not turn a hair, you mean that they do not show any surprise or fear, and remain completely calm.

ext.ext_cn: 别钻牛角尖了。你知道我指什么。
ext.ext_en: Don't split hairs. You know what I'm getting at.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is splitting hairs, you mean that they are making unnecessary distinctions between things when the differences between them are so small they are not important.

ext.ext_cn: 这些就是用来粉碎他们所谓的经济奇迹的事实。
ext.ext_en: These are the facts that explode their so-called economic miracle...

ext.ext_cn: 越来越多的公司变得“环保”起来，开始生产所谓的环境友好型产品。
ext.ext_en: More and more companies have gone 'green' and started producing so-called environmentally-friendly products.

defs.def_en: You use so-called to indicate that you think a word or expression used to describe someone or something is in fact wrong.

defs.def_cn: (指通常的称谓)所说的，所谓的

ext.ext_cn: 世界七大市场经济国家，即所谓的“七国集团”召开的一次峰会
ext.ext_en: ...a summit of the world's seven leading market economies, the so-called G-7...

ext.ext_cn: 她是所谓的“四人帮”之一。
ext.ext_en: She was one of the so-called Gang of Four.

defs.def_en: You use so-called to indicate that something is generally referred to by the name that you are about to use.

defs.def_cn: (与 close，loose 或 tightly 等形容词或副词连用，表示某物的大小与在其上面、里面或紧贴着它的物体的关系)

ext.ext_cn: 宽松的睡衣
ext.ext_en: ...loose-fitting night clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 盖得很紧的玻璃瓶
ext.ext_en: ...glass bottles with tight-fitting caps.

defs.def_en: -fitting combines with adjectives or adverbs such as 'close', 'loose', or 'tightly' to show that something is the size indicated in relation to the thing it is on, in, or next to.
Face powder is a very fine soft powder that you can put on your face in order to make it look smoother.

ext.ext_cn: 英国200米仰泳纪录保持者
ext.ext_en: ...the British record holder for the 200m backstroke.

defs.def_en: The record holder in a particular sport or activity is the person or team that holds the record for doing it fastest or best.
In football, the penalty box is the same as the penalty area .
In ice hockey, the penalty box is an area in which players who have broken a rule have to sit for a period of time.

defs.def_cn: 禄虫（指利用职权谋求私利或报答任命的官员）

ext.ext_cn: 通过根除禄虫以净化英国议会下院的党纲
ext.ext_en: ...the party's programme to purify the Commons by the removal of placemen.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a public official as a placeman, you disapprove of the fact that they use their position for their own personal benefit or to provide political support for those who appointed them.

ext.ext_cn: 总统面临54项腐败和逃税的指控。
ext.ext_en: The President faces 54 charges of corruption and tax evasion...

ext.ext_cn: 低效和腐败行为阻碍了食品在全国的分发。
ext.ext_en: Distribution of food throughout the country is being hampered by inefficiency and corruption.

defs.def_en: Corruption is dishonesty and illegal behaviour by people in positions of authority or power.

ext.ext_cn: Morris 在英语中是 Moorish 的变体，意思是“北非的”。
ext.ext_en: 'Morris' is an English corruption of 'Moorish', meaning North African.

defs.def_en: In linguistics, a corruption is a word that is derived from an earlier word, but which has become changed in some way.

defs.def_cn: (皮面无花样设计、脚面裸露的)半高跟皮鞋
defs.def_en: Court shoes are women's shoes that do not cover the top part of the foot and are usually made of plain leather with no design.

ext.ext_cn: 别说了，我来告诉你我想要什么。
ext.ext_en: Just pipe down and I'll tell you what I want.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone who is talking a lot or talking too loudly to pipe down, you are telling them to stop talking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人愉快的；使人满意的

ext.ext_cn: 法国的这一地区在8月份气候宜人。
ext.ext_en: This area of France has a pleasing climate in August...

ext.ext_cn: 这样的景色令人心旷神怡。
ext.ext_en: Such a view is pleasing...

defs.def_en: Something that is pleasing gives you pleasure and satisfaction.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 合法的；法律允许的；法定的

ext.ext_cn: 医生们采用他们认为对她最有利的方法为她治疗是合法的。
ext.ext_en: It was lawful for the doctors to treat her in whatever way they considered was in her best interests...

ext.ext_cn: 狩猎是合法活动。
ext.ext_en: Hunting is a lawful activity.

defs.def_en: If an activity, organization, or product is lawful, it is allowed by law.

ext.ext_cn: 通常可将一年再按月细分。
ext.ext_en: Months are a conventional subdivision of the year.

defs.def_en: A subdivision is an area, part, or section of something which is itself a part of something larger.

defs.def_cn: 分割成的小块土地(供开发住房)

ext.ext_cn: 拉米克住在高耸的山脊上一片有 400 户人家的地方。
ext.ext_en: Rammick lives high on a ridge in a 400-home subdivision.

defs.def_en: A subdivision is an area of land for building houses on.

defs.def_cn: 自动柜员机;自动售货机

ext.ext_cn: 自动提款机
ext.ext_en: ...cash dispensers.

ext.ext_cn: 带有自动装饮料机的冰箱
ext.ext_en: ...a fridge with a drinks dispenser.

defs.def_en: A dispenser is a machine or container designed so that you can get an item or quantity of something from it in an easy and convenient way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那篇文章侮辱了英国公民家庭。
ext.ext_en: The article was insulting to the families of British citizens...

ext.ext_cn: 其中一名学徒对着一名路过的警官说了一句侮辱他的话。
ext.ext_en: One of the apprentices made an insulting remark to a passing officer.

defs.def_en: Something that is insulting is rude or offensive.

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词后构成复合形容词）表示“有…唇的”

ext.ext_cn: 船长的薄唇边露出一个微笑，随之在脸上漾开来。
ext.ext_en: A thin-lipped smile spread over the captain's face.

ext.ext_cn: 他双唇丰满的嘴
ext.ext_en: ...his full-lipped mouth.

defs.def_en: See also:tight-lipped;-lipped combines with adjectives to form other adjectives which describe the sort of lips that someone has.

defs.def_cn: （观点、倾向等）对立的，截然相反的

ext.ext_cn: 我有一位朋友的看法截然不同，他认为这场战争是不道德的。
ext.ext_en: I have a friend who has the opposing view and felt that the war was immoral...

ext.ext_cn: 水火不相容。
ext.ext_en: Water is the opposing force to fire.

defs.def_en: Opposing ideas or tendencies are totally different from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 这位格鲁吉亚领导人在广播讲话中称他依然赞成对立双方进行对话。
ext.ext_en: The Georgian leader said in a radio address that he still favoured dialogue between the opposing sides...

ext.ext_cn: 对方球员必须轮流击球，在球落地前将球击过网。
ext.ext_en: The opposing team must in turn try to keep the ball in the air before hitting it back over the net.

defs.def_en: Opposing groups of people disagree about something or are in competition with one another.
Aphasia is a mental condition in which people are often unable to remember simple words or communicate.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他为争取种族平等而进行的无畏斗争
ext.ext_en: ...his fearless campaigning for racial justice.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is fearless, you mean that they are not afraid at all, and you admire them for this.

ext.ext_cn: 他们是奴隶，将被作为财产买卖。
ext.ext_en: They were slaves, to be bought and sold as chattels.

defs.def_en: Chattels are things that belong to you.

defs.def_cn: （用于名词后构成形容词）表示“头脑（不好）的”

ext.ext_cn: 健忘的教授
ext.ext_en: ...a scatter-brained professor.

defs.def_en: See also:hare-brained;You can combine -brained with nouns to form adjectives which describe the quality of someone's mind when you consider that person to be rather stupid.

ext.ext_cn: 回到家后，我竭力地想把这台机器的精妙之处描述给丈夫听。
ext.ext_en: When I returned home, I tried to convey the wonder of this machine to my husband...

ext.ext_cn: 她拍的每一张照片中都传递出一种临场感，使人有如亲临现场。
ext.ext_en: In every one of her pictures she conveys a sense of immediacy...

defs.def_en: To convey information or feelings means to cause them to be known or understood by someone.

ext.ext_cn: 铁路公司修建了一条通往布赖特灵西的支线，以便直接将鱼运送到比林斯门。
ext.ext_en: The railway company extended a branch line to Brightlingsea to convey fish direct to Billingsgate.

defs.def_en: To convey someone or something to a place means to carry or transport them there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 与西北部这些森林里的树木存在共生关系的真菌
ext.ext_en: ...fungi that have a symbiotic relationship with the trees of these northwestern forests...

ext.ext_cn: 赛马总是与赌博相挂钩。
ext.ext_en: Racing has always had a symbiotic relationship with betting.

defs.def_en: A symbiotic relationship is one in which organisms, people, or things exist together in a way that benefits them all.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不起作用的;徒劳无益的

ext.ext_cn: 市长打击毒品的努力未见成效。
ext.ext_en: The mayor had become ineffectual in the struggle to clamp down on drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 过去的一些出发点很好但却无成效的就业计划
ext.ext_en: ...the well-meaning but ineffectual jobs programs of the past.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is ineffectual, they fail to do what they are expected to do or are trying to do.

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲各国政府都面临着巨大的裁军预算压力。
ext.ext_en: There are huge budgetary pressures on all governments in Europe to reduce their armed forces.

defs.def_en: A budgetary matter or policy is concerned with the amount of money that is available to a country or organization, and how it is to be spent.

ext.ext_cn: 他剪短了的头发
ext.ext_en: ...his shorn hair.

defs.def_en: If grass or hair is shorn, it has been cut very short.

ext.ext_cn: 失去了美貌和尊严，她看上去糟透了。
ext.ext_en: She looks terrible, shorn of all her beauty and dignity.

ext.ext_cn: 宗教和政治信仰逐渐丧失的时代
ext.ext_en: ...an age increasingly shorn of religious and political faith.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is shorn of something that was an important part of them, it has been removed from them.

ext.ext_cn: 一辆警车呼啸而过。
ext.ext_en: A police car roared past...

ext.ext_cn: 飞机轰鸣着沿着跑道疾驰，准备起飞。
ext.ext_en: The plane roared down the runway for takeoff...

defs.def_en: If something, usually a vehicle, roars somewhere, it goes there very fast, making a loud noise.

ext.ext_cn: 发动机轰鸣着，车子猛然冲出去。
ext.ext_en: The engine roared, and the vehicle leapt forward...

ext.ext_cn: 她的心怦怦跳着，热血在耳中澎湃。
ext.ext_en: Her heart was pounding and the blood roared in her ears.

defs.def_en: If something roars, it makes a very loud noise.

ext.ext_cn: 马克斯仰头大笑起来。
ext.ext_en: Max threw back his head and roared with laughter.

ext.ext_cn: 他站起来的时候，人们哄堂大笑。
ext.ext_en: There were roars of laughter as he stood up.

defs.def_en: If someone roars with laughter, they laugh in a very noisy way.

ext.ext_cn: “我会为此杀了你，”他大吼道。
ext.ext_en: 'I'll kill you for that,' he roared...

ext.ext_cn: 在播放国歌的时候，人们喊叫着，吹着口哨。
ext.ext_en: During the playing of the national anthem the crowd roared and whistled...

defs.def_en: If someone roars, they shout something in a very loud voice.

ext.ext_cn: 狮子大吼一声，跳了起来。
ext.ext_en: The lion roared once, and sprang.

ext.ext_cn: 远处狮子的吼声
ext.ext_en: ...the roar of lions in the distance.

defs.def_en: When a lion roars, it makes the loud sound that lions typically make.

ext.ext_cn: 英国教育学家在如何以最佳方式教授阅读的问题上存在分歧。
ext.ext_en: British educationalists are divided about how best to teach reading.

defs.def_en: An educationalist is someone who is specialized in the theories and methods of education.

defs.def_cn: 在…不知情的情况下；瞒着…

ext.ext_cn: 让我深感震惊的是，孩子们竟会背着父母欠债累累。
ext.ext_en: I am appalled that children can mount up debts unbeknown to their parents...

ext.ext_cn: 她瞒着父亲开始去上舞蹈课。
ext.ext_en: Unbeknownst to her father, she began taking dancing lessons.

defs.def_en: If something happens unbeknown to you or unbeknownst to you, you do not know about it.

ext.ext_cn: 发生了数次和警察之间的激烈冲突。
ext.ext_en: Pitched battles were fought with the police.

defs.def_en: A pitched battle is a very fierce and violent fight involving a large number of people.

ext.ext_cn: 他在起居室睡着了，我便给他盖上了羽绒被。
ext.ext_en: He fell asleep in the front room so I covered him up with a duvet.

defs.def_en: If you cover something or someone up, you put something over them in order to protect or hide them.

ext.ext_cn: 他怀疑有人密谋掩盖犯罪事实。
ext.ext_en: He suspects there's a conspiracy to cover up the crime...

ext.ext_cn: 他们知道自己犯了十分严重的错误，于是撒谎隐瞒。
ext.ext_en: They knew they had done something terribly wrong and lied to cover it up...

defs.def_en: See also:cover-up;If you cover up something that you do not want people to know about, you hide the truth about it.

ext.ext_cn: 她双手放在腿上静静等候。
ext.ext_en: She waited quietly with her hands in her lap...

ext.ext_cn: 休瞥了一眼坐在她妈妈膝上的小女孩。
ext.ext_en: Hugh glanced at the child on her mother's lap.

defs.def_en: If you have something on your lap when you are sitting down, it is on top of your legs and near to your body.

ext.ext_cn: 比赛最后一圈
ext.ext_en: ...that last lap of the race...

ext.ext_cn: 第二圈时，贝克悄然赶了上去。
ext.ext_en: On lap two, Baker edged forward.

defs.def_en: In a race, a competitor completes a lap when they have gone round a course once.

ext.ext_cn: 他在套圈超越一位落后的车手时出了错。
ext.ext_en: He was caught out while lapping a slower rider.

defs.def_en: In a race, if you lap another competitor, you go past them while they are still on the previous lap.

ext.ext_cn: 我原以为我们最远能到达橡树谷，结果只走完了第一段路程。
ext.ext_en: I had thought we might travel as far as Oak Valley, but we only managed the first lap of the journey.

defs.def_en: A lap of a long journey is one part of it, between two points where you stop.

ext.ext_cn: 轻拍着船屋支柱的海水
ext.ext_en: ...the water that lapped against the pillars of the boathouse...

ext.ext_cn: 救援人员到达时上涨的潮水已经淹到了他的下巴。
ext.ext_en: With a rising tide the water was lapping at his chin before rescuers arrived...

defs.def_en: When water laps against something such as the shore or the side of a boat, it touches it gently and makes a soft sound.

ext.ext_cn: 猫舔食盘中牛奶。
ext.ext_en: The cat lapped milk from a dish.

ext.ext_cn: 她往一个塑料碗里倒了一些水，她的大丹犬福斯特便美滋滋地舔起来。
ext.ext_en: She poured some water into a plastic bowl. Faust, her Great Dane, lapped it up with relish.

defs.def_en: When an animal laps a drink, it uses short quick movements of its tongue to take liquid up into its mouth.

defs.def_cn: （成败）难以预料，非人力所能左右

ext.ext_cn: 他们不得不停止手术，所以那时的我只能听天由命。
ext.ext_en: They had to stop the operation, so at that stage my life was in the lap of the gods.

defs.def_en: If you say that a situation is in the lap of the gods, you mean that its success or failure depends entirely on luck or on things that are outside your control.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。
ext.ext_en: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone lives in the lap of luxury, you mean that they live in conditions of great comfort and wealth.

defs.def_cn: （尤指敌军之间的）武力冲突，流血事件，杀戮

ext.ext_cn: 镇区再次发生了残忍的流血事件。
ext.ext_en: Once again there's been ferocious blood-letting in the township.

defs.def_en: Blood-letting is violence or killing between groups of people, especially between rival armies.

ext.ext_cn: 有望在不引起严重内讧的情况下达成一个满意的解决方案。
ext.ext_en: Hopefully a satisfactory solution can be reached without much blood letting.

defs.def_en: Journalists sometimes refer to a bitter quarrel between two groups of people from  within the same organization as blood-letting.

defs.def_cn: 令人目瞪口呆的；印象非常深刻的；令人震惊的

ext.ext_cn: 一位看过此报道的内部人士说这绝对是令人震惊的爆料。
ext.ext_en: One insider who has seen the report said it was pretty jaw-dropping stuff.

defs.def_en: Something that is jaw-dropping is extremely surprising, impressive, or shocking.
A tailor is a person whose job is to make men's clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以根据病人的需要调整治疗方案。
ext.ext_en: We can tailor the program to the patient's needs.

ext.ext_cn: 地方部队如何努力调整治安维护方式以增强公众信心
ext.ext_en: ...how the local forces were trying to tailor their policing style to increase public confidence.

defs.def_en: If you tailor something such as a plan or system to someone's needs, you make it suitable for a particular person or purpose by changing the details of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 心怀偏见的；有成见的；偏爱的

ext.ext_cn: 一些房东有种族偏见。
ext.ext_en: Some landlords and landladies are racially prejudiced...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得自己并没有偏见。
ext.ext_en: I like to think I'm not prejudiced.

defs.def_en: A person who is prejudiced against someone has an unreasonable dislike of them. A person who is prejudiced in favour of someone has an unreasonable preference for them.
A drug addict is someone who is addicted to illegal drugs.
A coffee table is a small low table in a living room.

ext.ext_cn: 要做这个，你需要一口带蒸笼篦子的锅,如果没有,就用别的临时凑合一下。
ext.ext_en: You need a wok with a steaming rack for this; if you don't have one, improvise...

ext.ext_cn: 兽医临时凑成了一副马具。
ext.ext_en: The vet had improvised a harness...

defs.def_en: If you improvise, you make or do something using whatever you have or without having planned it in advance.

defs.def_cn: 即兴表演;即兴演奏;即兴创作

ext.ext_cn: 我问她那一段是什么音乐,她说：“噢,我只是即兴弹的。”
ext.ext_en: I asked her what the piece was and she said, 'Oh, I'm just improvising'...

ext.ext_cn: 理查德叔叔吟诵了《圣经》中的一章,又即兴作了一段祈祷文。
ext.ext_en: Uncle Richard intoned a chapter from the Bible and improvised a prayer...

defs.def_en: When performers improvise, they invent music or words as they play, sing, or speak.

ext.ext_cn: 他坐上了驾驶员的位置发动了引擎。
ext.ext_en: He got into the driving seat and started the engine.

defs.def_en: In a vehicle such as a car or a bus, the driving seat is the seat where the person who is driving the vehicle sits.

defs.def_cn: 处于控制地位;主管;负责

ext.ext_cn: 在 69 岁时他仍一如既往地牢牢掌握着公司的控制权。
ext.ext_en: At 69 he is as firmly in the driving seat of the company as ever.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in the driving seat, you mean that they are in control in a situation.

defs.def_cn: 出手，转手，清理（不需要之物）

ext.ext_cn: 急于脱手未售出公寓的开发商降低了房价。
ext.ext_en: Prices have been cut by developers anxious to offload unsold apartments...

ext.ext_cn: 特纳已经陷入财政困难，于是将这幅画卖给了盖蒂美术馆。
ext.ext_en: Already in financial difficulties, Turner offloaded the painting on to the Getty Museum.

defs.def_en: If you offload something that you do not want, you get rid of it by giving it or selling it to someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 这些补给要卸下来装上直升机。
ext.ext_en: The supplies need to be offloaded and put on helicopters...

ext.ext_cn: 货物定于3天后在新加坡卸载。
ext.ext_en: The cargo was due to be offloaded in Singapore three days later.

defs.def_en: When goods are offloaded, they are removed from a container or vehicle and put somewhere else.
Suspended animation is a state in which an animal is unconscious, with its body functioning very slowly, for example so that the animal can survive the winter.

ext.ext_cn: 她就那样呆呆地躺着，等待着黎明到来后起床。
ext.ext_en: She lay in a state of suspended animation, waiting for dawnlight, when she would rise...

ext.ext_cn: 海牙会议处于停滞状态。
ext.ext_en: The Hague conference is in suspended animation.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as being in a state of suspended animation, you mean that they have become inactive and are doing nothing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （地方）未经开发的，有自然美的

ext.ext_cn: 这个港口宁静、天然。
ext.ext_en: The port is quiet and unspoiled.

ext.ext_cn: 不染尘嚣的科苏梅尔岛
ext.ext_en: ...the unspoiled island of Cozumel.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as unspoiled, you think it is beautiful because it has not been changed or built on for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 他星期二来电话了，就在你来之前。
ext.ext_en: He phoned on Tuesday, just before you came...

ext.ext_cn: 会谈有可能下周二开始。
ext.ext_en: Talks are likely to start next Tuesday…

defs.def_en: Tuesday is the day after Monday and before Wednesday.
Plate tectonics is the way that large pieces of the earth's surface move slowly around.

defs.def_cn: 寻找者;寻求者;追求者;谋求者

ext.ext_cn: 我追求真理。
ext.ext_en: I am a seeker after truth...

ext.ext_cn: 这些海滩吸引了欧洲各地喜欢晒太阳的人。
ext.ext_en: The beaches draw sun-seekers from all over Europe.

defs.def_en: See also:asylum seeker;job seeker;A seeker is someone who is looking for or trying to get something.

defs.def_cn: （尤指破坏公共财产的）破坏分子，捣毁者

ext.ext_cn: 安装在阿什福德车站的所有信息查询装置如今都被破坏分子毁坏了。
ext.ext_en: All information systems that have been fitted at Ashford station have now been destroyed by vandals.

defs.def_en: A vandal is someone who deliberately damages things, especially public property.

ext.ext_cn: 娱乐界令人眼花缭乱的虚幻世界
ext.ext_en: ...the glamorous make-believe world of show business...

ext.ext_cn: 她为一种虚幻的生活挥金如土。
ext.ext_en: She squandered millions on a life of make-believe.

defs.def_en: If someone is living in a make-believe world, they are pretending that things are better, different, or more exciting than they really are instead of facing up to reality.

ext.ext_cn: 她过去常跟姐姐玩扮家家的游戏。
ext.ext_en: She used to play games of make-believe with her elder sister.

ext.ext_cn: 他玩扮家家的伙伴
ext.ext_en: ...his make-believe playmate.

defs.def_en: You use make-believe to refer to the activity involved when a child plays a game in which they pretend something, for example that they are someone else.

defs.def_cn: 虚假的;虚幻的;虚构的;假装的

ext.ext_cn: 录像里，迈克尔·杰克逊沿着虚设的街道一边跳舞一边抗议说：“那孩子不是我的儿子”。
ext.ext_en: In the video, Michael Jackson danced down a make-believe street protesting that 'the kid is not my son'...

ext.ext_cn: 那些影片里的暴力场面太不真实了，都是假的。
ext.ext_en: The violence in those films was too unreal, it was make-believe...

defs.def_en: You use make-believe to describe things, for example in a play or film, that imitate or copy something real, but which are not what they appear to be.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 勤奋的;勤勉的;孜孜不倦的;细致彻底的

ext.ext_cn: 迈耶斯是个勤奋多产的工人。
ext.ext_en: Meyers is a diligent and prolific worker...

ext.ext_cn: 该项历史研究非常地认真、彻底。
ext.ext_en: The historical research was impressively diligent.

defs.def_en: Someone who is diligent works hard in a careful and thorough way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （通常指因不确定而）结结巴巴的，迟疑不决的

ext.ext_cn: 她结结巴巴地说自己要发表一项声明。
ext.ext_en: In a halting voice she said that she wished to make a statement...

ext.ext_cn: 这位官员用结结巴巴的德语作答。
ext.ext_en: The officer replied in halting German...

defs.def_en: If you speak or do something in a halting way, you speak or do it slowly and with a lot of hesitation, usually because you are uncertain about what to say or do next.

ext.ext_cn: 受到故意歧视的女性将会得到赔偿。
ext.ext_en: Women who are the victims of intentional discrimination will be able to get compensation...

ext.ext_cn: 我怎么能怪他呢？那又不是有意的。
ext.ext_en: How can I blame him? It wasn't intentional.

defs.def_en: Something that is intentional is deliberate.
In mythology, a griffin is a winged creature with the body of a lion and the head of an eagle.

ext.ext_cn: 马德拉斯咖喱粉
ext.ext_en: ...Madras curry powder.

defs.def_en: A madras curry is a rather hot spicy curry.

defs.def_cn: (汽车或其他交通工具前后轮之间的)轴距
defs.def_en: The wheelbase of a car or other vehicle is the distance between its front and back wheels.

ext.ext_cn: 我打开了一扇百叶窗已合上的窗户。
ext.ext_en: I opened a shuttered window...

ext.ext_cn: 学校和政府办公楼都关闭了，许多商店的百叶窗也一直关着。
ext.ext_en: Schools and government offices have been closed, and many shops remain shuttered.

defs.def_en: A shuttered window, room, or building has its shutters closed.

ext.ext_cn: 这栋石砌房屋的条件很不错，有新铺的瓦片屋顶，装有百叶窗的窗户还有电力供暖系统。
ext.ext_en: The stone-built property is in good condition, with a new tiled roof, shuttered windows and electric heating.

ext.ext_cn: 装有绿色百叶窗的殖民时期风格的别墅
ext.ext_en: ...green-shuttered colonial villas.

defs.def_en: A shuttered window, room, or building has shutters fitted to it.

defs.def_cn: (戏剧、电影或书籍)过分感伤，煽情
defs.def_en: If you describe a play, film, or book as schmaltz, you do not like it because it is too sentimental.

defs.def_cn: (使)(工厂、公司等)关闭,歇业，停业

ext.ext_cn: 规模较小的承包商已被迫歇业。
ext.ext_en: Smaller contractors had been forced to shut down...

ext.ext_cn: 法律规定资金长期短缺的银行必须关闭。
ext.ext_en: It is required by law to shut down banks which it regards as chronically short of capital...

defs.def_en: See also:shutdown;If a factory or business shuts down or if someone shuts it down, work there stops or it no longer trades as a business.

ext.ext_cn: 我主要喝咖啡和姜汁汽水。
ext.ext_en: I live mostly on coffee and ginger ale.

defs.def_en: Ginger ale is a fizzy non-alcoholic drink flavoured with ginger, which is often mixed with an alcoholic drink.

defs.def_cn: （尤指从行为中表现出来的）态度，看法

ext.ext_cn: 对残疾人态度的整体转变
ext.ext_en: ...the general change in attitude towards handicapped people...

ext.ext_cn: 失业会产生对工作的消极态度。
ext.ext_en: Being unemployed produces negative attitudes to work...

defs.def_en: Your attitude to something is the way that you think and feel about it, especially when this shows in the way you behave.
