ext.ext_cn: 过去这几天似乎比较平淡无聊。
ext.ext_en: The past few days have seemed comparatively flat and empty...

ext.ext_cn: 很久没有政党领导人像他昨天那样作如此枯燥无聊的演讲了。
ext.ext_en: It is a long time since a party leader delivered such a dreadfully flat speech as he did yesterday.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as flat, you mean that it is dull and not exciting or interesting.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: “不管你说什么，我都会坐在这里等。”他用一种极为平淡的声音说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Whatever you say,' he said in a deadly flat voice. 'I'll sit here and wait.'...

ext.ext_cn: 她的声音平淡，听不出疑虑也感觉不到希望。
ext.ext_en: Her voice was flat, with no question or hope in it.

defs.def_en: You use flat to describe someone's voice when they are saying something without expressing any emotion.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示音符的字母后)降半音的，降音的

ext.ext_cn: 舒伯特降 B 调钢琴三重奏(第 99 号作品)
ext.ext_en: ...Schubert's B flat Piano Trio (Opus 99).

defs.def_en: Flat is used after a letter representing a musical note to show that the note should be played or sung half a tone lower than the note which otherwise matches that letter. Flat is often represented by the symbol  after the letter.

defs.def_cn: (演唱或乐器)比标准音低的，音偏低的

ext.ext_cn: 至少可以说，她的音域不够宽，而且令人不舒服的是，她总是音高偏低。
ext.ext_en: Her vocal range was, to say the least of it, limited, and she had a distressing tendency to sing flat.

ext.ext_cn: 他因为唱歌音调偏低而被炒了。
ext.ext_en: He had been fired because his singing was flat.

defs.def_en: If someone sings flat or if a musical instrument is flat, their singing or the instrument is slightly lower in pitch than it should be.

defs.def_cn: 非常平坦的;完全平展的

ext.ext_cn: 我的故乡伊利诺伊州一马平川。
ext.ext_en: My home state of Illinois is flat as a pancake...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is as flat as a pancake, you are emphasizing that it is completely flat.

ext.ext_cn: 一个男人从街上走进来，趴倒在地，不省人事。
ext.ext_en: A man walked in off the street and fell flat on his face, unconscious.

defs.def_en: If you fall flat on your face, you fall over.

ext.ext_cn: 利兹本想开个玩笑，结果却没有达到效果。
ext.ext_en: Liz meant it as a joke but it fell flat...

ext.ext_cn: 如果不是女主角埃伦·巴尔金的话，整个情节会非常失败。
ext.ext_en: If it wasn't for the main actress, Ellen Barkin, the plot would have fallen flat on its face.

defs.def_en: If an event or attempt falls flat or falls flat on its face, it is unsuccessful.

defs.def_cn: 一文不名;身无分文;一贫如洗

ext.ext_cn: 两年后，他一贫如洗，靠失业救济金生活。
ext.ext_en: Two years later he is flat broke and on the dole.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are flat broke, you mean that you have no money at all.

defs.def_cn: 全速;全力以赴;竭尽全力

ext.ext_cn: 每个人都在全力以赴，设法捉住那些罪魁祸首。
ext.ext_en: Everyone is working flat out to try to trap those responsible...

ext.ext_cn: 他们拼命冲刺，越过终点线。
ext.ext_en: They hurtled across the line in a flat-out sprint.

defs.def_en: If you do something flat out, you do it as fast or as hard as you can.

defs.def_cn: 完完全全的;确确实实的

ext.ext_cn: 那项指控是彻头彻尾的谎言。
ext.ext_en: That allegation is a flat-out lie...

ext.ext_cn: 他们说业界所谓的放宽管制已经取得了成效的说法纯属谎言。
ext.ext_en: They say the industry is flat out lying about the effects of deregulation.

defs.def_en: You use flat out to emphasize that something is completely the case.

ext.ext_cn: 他患有心绞痛，在平地上最多能走 200 码。
ext.ext_en: He had angina and was unable to walk for more than 200 yards on the flat.

defs.def_en: On the flat means on level ground.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 喧闹的;嗓门大的;聒噪的

ext.ext_cn: 我那台噪音极大的旧打字机
ext.ext_en: ...my noisy old typewriter...

ext.ext_cn: 他的女儿一到上午就很好动，吵吵闹闹的。
ext.ext_en: His daughter was very active and noisy in the mornings.

defs.def_en: A noisy person or thing makes a lot of loud or unpleasant noise.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个咖啡馆很嘈杂，室内的一个大屏幕上不停地播放着电影片断。
ext.ext_en: It's a noisy place with film clips showing constantly on one of the cafe's giant screens...

ext.ext_cn: 行李大厅拥挤嘈杂。
ext.ext_en: The baggage hall was crowded and noisy...

defs.def_en: A noisy place is full of a lot of loud or unpleasant noise.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (为引起注意)吵吵嚷嚷的;哗众取宠的

ext.ext_cn: 它可能最终会使这个聒噪的知识分子小圈子安静下来。
ext.ext_en: It might, at last, silence the small but noisy intellectual clique.

ext.ext_cn: 企图变革社会文化的哗众取宠、不受欢迎的边缘群体
ext.ext_en: ...the noisy and unpopular fringe groups that are attempting to change the culture of their society.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as noisy, you are critical of them for trying to attract attention to their views by frequently and forcefully discussing them.
An easel is a wooden frame that supports a picture which an artist is painting or drawing.

defs.def_cn: （歌剧中的）女主角，首席女歌手

ext.ext_cn: 事业刚起步的时候，她在皇家卡尔·罗莎歌剧团担任首席女歌手。
ext.ext_en: Her career began as prima donna with the Royal Carl Rosa Opera Company.

defs.def_en: A prima donna is the main female singer in an opera.

defs.def_cn: 恃才傲物的人；自命不凡的人；妄自尊大的人

ext.ext_cn: 加入这个俱乐部的任何人都不许自以为是。
ext.ext_en: Nobody who comes to this club is allowed to behave like a prima donna.

ext.ext_cn: 自命不凡的行为
ext.ext_en: ...prima donna behaviour.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a prima donna, you disapprove of them because they think they can behave badly or get what they want because they have a particular talent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 大而笨重的;难以携带的

ext.ext_cn: 尽管这台机器看上去很笨重，操作起来却很容易。
ext.ext_en: Although the machine looks cumbersome, it is actually easy to use.

ext.ext_cn: 身上裹着厚重的衣服
ext.ext_en: ...muffled up in thick and cumbersome clothing.

defs.def_en: Something that is cumbersome is large and heavy and therefore difficult to carry, wear, or handle.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 过时而且低效的计算机系统
ext.ext_en: ...an old and cumbersome computer system...

ext.ext_cn: 提议的规章制度阐述不清、复杂低效，而且可能会带来不必要的过高花费。
ext.ext_en: The proposed regulations are ill-defined and cumbersome and could be unnecessarily costly.

defs.def_en: A cumbersome system or process is very complicated and inefficient.
See also:spare tyre;A tyre is a thick piece of rubber which is fitted onto the wheels of vehicles such as cars, buses, and bicycles.

ext.ext_cn: 中国人将谷物奉为上天的恩赐。
ext.ext_en: The Chinese revered corn as a gift from heaven...

ext.ext_cn: 现在，他仍被尊为国父。
ext.ext_en: Today he's still revered as the father of the nation.

defs.def_en: If you revere someone or something, you respect and admire them greatly.

ext.ext_cn: 他的书桌上有大堆的书籍和文件。
ext.ext_en: On his desk is a mass of books and papers.

defs.def_en: A mass of things is a large number of them grouped together.

ext.ext_cn: 她有一头浓密的棕发。
ext.ext_en: She had a mass of auburn hair.

defs.def_en: A mass  of something is a large amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她有一大堆的工作要做。
ext.ext_en: There's masses of work for her to do...

ext.ext_cn: 它每年都开许多花。
ext.ext_en: It has masses of flowers each year.

defs.def_en: Masses of something means a great deal of it.

ext.ext_cn: 对付大量失业的点子
ext.ext_en: ...ideas on combating mass unemployment...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的灯都熄灭了，大家都变得歇斯底里起来。
ext.ext_en: All the lights went off, and mass hysteria broke out.

defs.def_en: Mass is used to describe something which involves or affects a very large number of people.

ext.ext_cn: 在它冷却成为固态之前
ext.ext_en: ...before it cools and sets into a solid mass...

ext.ext_cn: 这座14世纪的大教堂变成了一堆瓦砾。
ext.ext_en: The fourteenth century cathedral was reduced to a mass of rubble.

defs.def_en: A mass of a solid substance, a liquid, or a gas is an amount of it, especially a large amount which has no definite shape.

defs.def_cn: （与领导或受过高等教育的人相对的）普通老百姓，民众，平民大众

ext.ext_cn: 他的音乐走商业化路线，针对的是一般大众。
ext.ext_en: His music is commercial. It is aimed at the masses...

ext.ext_cn: 这个问题在民众中间引起了强烈的不满。
ext.ext_en: This issue has aroused much resentment among the masses.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the masses, you mean the ordinary people in society, in contrast to the leaders or the highly educated people.

ext.ext_cn: 1939至1945年间的世界大战使大多数民众卷入其中。
ext.ext_en: The 1939-45 world war involved the mass of the population...

ext.ext_cn: 学校允许大部分考试成绩差的学生16岁时毕业离校。
ext.ext_en: Schools allowed the mass of children to leave school at 16 with poor qualifications.

defs.def_en: The mass of people are most of the people in a country, society, or group.

ext.ext_cn: 情绪激动的人群挤满了街道。
ext.ext_en: ...masses of excited people clogged the streets.

ext.ext_cn: 一张张少年的笑脸
ext.ext_en: ...a mass of grinning teenage faces.

defs.def_en: A mass of people is a large crowd of them.

ext.ext_cn: 工人们罢工后不久，警察就开始在船厂集结。
ext.ext_en: Shortly after the workers went on strike, police began to mass at the shipyard...

ext.ext_cn: 云卷云舒随风起。
ext.ext_en: The clouds massed, whipped up by the wind...

defs.def_en: When people or things mass, or when you mass them, they gather together into a large crowd or group.

ext.ext_cn: 他遍体鳞伤。
ext.ext_en: His body was a mass of sores...

ext.ext_cn: 春天，草地上开满了黄水仙。
ext.ext_en: In the spring, the meadow is a mass of daffodils.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a mass of things, you mean that it is covered with them or full of them.

ext.ext_cn: 天文学家知道冥王星与海卫一拥有几乎相同的体积、质量与密度。
ext.ext_en: Astronomers know that Pluto and Triton have nearly the same size, mass, and density.

defs.def_en: In physics, the mass of an object is the amount of physical matter that it has.

defs.def_cn: 弥撒(尤指天主教或东正教的圣餐仪式，以此纪念耶稣基督的最后的晚餐)

ext.ext_cn: 她上的是教会学校，每天都去做弥撒。
ext.ext_en: She attended a convent school and went to Mass each day.

defs.def_en: Mass is a Christian church ceremony, especially in a Roman Catholic or Orthodox church, during which people eat bread and drink wine in order to remember the last meal of Jesus Christ.
A Mass is a piece of music which uses the prayers from the Christian ceremony of Mass as the words that are sung.

ext.ext_cn: 古老的骨相学
ext.ext_en: ...the ancient science of phrenology.

defs.def_en: Phrenology is the study of the size and shape of people's heads in the belief that you can find out about their characters and abilities from this.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 症状包括皮肤发红、发痒、发炎。
ext.ext_en: Symptoms include red, itchy and inflamed skin...

ext.ext_cn: 她的眼睛红肿疼痛。
ext.ext_en: Her eyes were sore and inflamed.

defs.def_en: If part of your body is inflamed, it is red or swollen, usually as a result of an infection, injury, or illness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 感兴趣的;有兴趣的;关心的

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得她对葆拉的提议可能会感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: I thought she might be interested in Paula's proposal...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为这个年轻人开始对园艺产生兴趣了。
ext.ext_en: I think the young man is getting interested in gardening...

defs.def_en: If you are interested in something, you think it is important and want to learn more about it or spend time doing it.

defs.def_cn: 有利害关系的;利益相关的;当事的

ext.ext_cn: 所有利益相关方最终都同意了这一想法。
ext.ext_en: All the interested parties eventually agreed to the idea.

defs.def_en: An interested party or group of people is affected by or involved in a particular event or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 该中心是步行商业区，正中央有一个室外音乐演奏台。
ext.ext_en: The Centre was a pedestrian precinct with a bandstand in the middle.

defs.def_en: A shopping precinct is an area in the centre of a town in which cars are not allowed.

ext.ext_cn: 枪击事件发生在第34警区。
ext.ext_en: The shooting occurred in the 34th Precinct.

defs.def_en: A precinct is a part of a city which has its own police force and fire service.

ext.ext_cn: 携带武器者不得进入神殿的界域。
ext.ext_en: No one carrying arms is allowed within the precincts of a temple.

defs.def_en: The precincts of an institution are its buildings and land.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 传统教学方法
ext.ext_en: ...traditional teaching methods.

ext.ext_cn: 传统印度音乐
ext.ext_en: ...traditional Indian music.

defs.def_en: Traditional customs, beliefs, or methods are ones that have existed for a long time without changing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们在很多方面仍是一所旧式学校。
ext.ext_en: We're still a traditional school in a lot of ways.

ext.ext_cn: 信奉需要对子女严立规矩的老派父母
ext.ext_en: …traditional parents, who believed in laying down the law for their children.

defs.def_en: A traditional organization or person prefers older methods and ideas to modern ones.

ext.ext_cn: 这些年来，我得出的结论是她是一位非常伟大的音乐家。
ext.ext_en: Over the years I've come to the conclusion that she's a very great musician...

ext.ext_cn: 我试着说了一些我的感受，其他人无疑会有他们自己的结论。
ext.ext_en: I have tried to give some idea of how I feel — other people will no doubt draw their own conclusions.

defs.def_en: When you come to a conclusion, you decide that something is true after you have thought about it carefully and have considered all the relevant facts.

ext.ext_cn: 节目结束的时候，我问孩子们有没有问题想问我。
ext.ext_en: At the conclusion of the programme, I asked the children if they had any questions they wanted to ask me.

defs.def_en: The conclusion of something is its ending.

ext.ext_cn: 墨西哥与美国之间自由贸易协定的如期签订
ext.ext_en: ...the expected conclusion of a free-trade agreement between Mexico and the United States.

defs.def_en: The conclusion of a treaty or a business deal is the act of arranging it or agreeing it.

defs.def_cn: 必然会发生的事;事先料定的结局

ext.ext_cn: 早已注定我最终会和他干同一行。
ext.ext_en: It was a foregone conclusion that I would end up in the same business as him...

ext.ext_cn: 锦标赛的结果差不多在意料之中。
ext.ext_en: The championship result was almost a foregone conclusion.

defs.def_en: You can refer to something that seems certain to happen as a foregone conclusion .

ext.ext_cn: 总而言之，散步是一种廉价、安全、愉快的锻炼方式，而且随时随地都可以进行。
ext.ext_en: In conclusion, walking is a cheap, safe, enjoyable and readily available form of exercise.

defs.def_en: You say 'in conclusion' to indicate that what you are about to say is the last thing that you want to say.

defs.def_cn: 匆忙地下判断;草率地下结论

ext.ext_cn: 我不想让她草率地断定离婚完全是她的错。
ext.ext_en: I didn't want her to jump to the conclusion that the divorce was in any way her fault...

ext.ext_cn: 原谅我，我不该草率地下结论。
ext.ext_en: Forgive me. I shouldn't be jumping to conclusions.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone jumps to a conclusion, you are critical of them because they decide too quickly that something is true, when they do not know all the facts.

ext.ext_cn: 尝试以低通货膨胀率取代充分就业作为宏观经济政策的目标
ext.ext_en: ...the attempt to substitute low inflation for full employment as a goal of macro-economic policy.

defs.def_en: Macroeconomic means relating to the major, general features of a country's economy, such as the level of inflation, unemployment, or interest rates.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他非常顽固，而且又铁了心，是不会放弃的。
ext.ext_en: He is obstinate and determined and will not give up...

ext.ext_cn: 她是个淘气又执拗的孩子。
ext.ext_en: She was a wicked and obstinate child.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as obstinate, you are being critical of them because they are very determined to do what they want, and refuse to change their mind or be persuaded to do something else.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以移动的；难以改变的；难以消除的

ext.ext_cn: 扔在恣意蔓生的杂草丛中的锈迹斑斑的农具
ext.ext_en: ...rusted farm equipment strewn among the obstinate weeds.

defs.def_en: You can describe things as obstinate when they are difficult to move, change, or destroy.
A toilet bag is a small bag in which you keep things such as soap, a flannel, and a toothbrush when you are travelling.

ext.ext_cn: 卡文迪什夫人是我的一位亲密朋友。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Cavendish is a dear friend of mine...

ext.ext_cn: 我终于回到了我那张可爱的小桌子旁。
ext.ext_en: At last I am back at my dear little desk.

defs.def_en: You use dear to describe someone or something that you feel affection for.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 对…来说心爱的;在…（心中）宝贵的

ext.ext_cn: 他很珍视自己的家庭生活。
ext.ext_en: His family life was very dear to him...

ext.ext_cn: 这个话题举国上下的学者都非常关切。
ext.ext_en: This is a subject very dear to the hearts of academics up and down the country.

defs.def_en: If something is dear to you or dear to your heart, you care deeply about it.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示喜爱或带有屈尊俯就意味的称呼中）亲爱的;小…

ext.ext_cn: 当然，托比，我亲爱的朋友，当然。
ext.ext_en: Of course, Toby, my dear fellow, of course...

ext.ext_cn: 小伙子，随你花多长时间都行。
ext.ext_en: Take as long as you like, dear boy.

defs.def_en: You use dear in expressions such as 'my dear fellow', 'dear girl', or 'my dear Richard' when you are addressing someone whom you know and are fond of. You can also use expressions like this in a rude way to indicate that you think you are superior to the person you are addressing.

defs.def_cn: (用于信函抬头的名字或头衔前）亲爱的，尊敬的

ext.ext_cn: 亲爱的彼得，过去的这几天里我一直都在想你。
ext.ext_en: Dear Peter, I have been thinking about you so much during the past few days...

defs.def_en: Dear is written at the beginning of a letter, followed by the name or title of the person you are writing to.

defs.def_cn: 尊敬的先生/尊敬的女士(英国英语中用于正式信函的开头，美国英语中则用 Sir 或 Madam)

ext.ext_cn: “尊敬的先生，”她开头写道。
ext.ext_en: 'Dear sir,' she began.

defs.def_en: In British English, you begin formal letters with 'Dear Sir' or 'Dear Madam'. In American English, you begin them with 'Sir' or 'Madam'.

ext.ext_cn: 亲爱的，你很多地方都很像我。
ext.ext_en: You're a lot like me, dear...

ext.ext_cn: “晚安，我亲爱的孩子们，”我们关上她的房门时她对我们说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Good night, my dears,' she called to us as we closed her door behind us.

defs.def_en: You can call someone dear as a sign of affection.

defs.def_cn: (表示伤心、失望或吃惊）啊呀，哎哟，天哪

ext.ext_cn: “哎呀，哎呀！”麦金农叹息道，“你也一样。”
ext.ext_en: 'Oh dear, oh dear.' McKinnon sighed. 'You, too.'

ext.ext_cn: 出了门，布鲁斯瞥了一眼自己的手表，“天哪，快一点了。”
ext.ext_en: Outside, Bruce glanced at his watch: 'Dear me, nearly one o'clock.'

defs.def_en: You can use dear in expressions such as 'oh dear', 'dear me', and 'dear, dear' when you are sad, disappointed, or surprised about something.

ext.ext_cn: 他人真好。
ext.ext_en: He's such a dear.

defs.def_en: You can call someone a dear when you are fond of them and think that they are nice.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这儿的 CD 价格比美国那边贵多了。
ext.ext_en: CDs here are much dearer than in the States...

ext.ext_cn: 它们的价格太高了。
ext.ext_en: They're too dear.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is dear, you mean that it costs a lot of money, usually more than you can afford or more than you think it should cost.

defs.def_cn: 使…付出巨大代价;使…饱尝苦头

ext.ext_cn: 这种自满情绪正使公司付出沉重代价。
ext.ext_en: Such complacency is costing the company dear.

defs.def_en: If something that someone does costs them dear, they suffer a lot as a result of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他从一个隐蔽的有利位置望出去，看见一辆车开了过来。
ext.ext_en: From a concealed vantage point, he saw a car arrive...

ext.ext_cn: 管理员把我们带到斜坡上的一处有利位置，我们从那里看到了下面岩石上的银鸥。
ext.ext_en: The warden took us to a vantage point on the slopes where we saw herring gulls on the rocks below.

defs.def_en: A vantage point is a place from which you can see a lot of things.

ext.ext_cn: 今天看来，1987年的崩盘似乎只是股市上升进程中的一次小小挫折。
ext.ext_en: From today's vantage point, the 1987 crash seems just a blip in the upward progress of the market...

ext.ext_cn: 现在回头看看，他才意识到在他人生的头25年里他被慷慨给予了多少无条件的关爱与支持。
ext.ext_en: From the vantage point of the present he saw the unquestioning love and support that had been lavished upon him for his first twenty-five years.

defs.def_en: If you view a situation from a particular vantage point you have a clear understanding of it because of the particular period of time you are in.

ext.ext_cn: 每个托架只用了 3 颗螺钉固定在墙上。
ext.ext_en: Each bracket is fixed to the wall with just three screws.

defs.def_en: A screw is a metal object similar to a nail, with a raised spiral line around it. You turn a screw using a screwdriver so that it goes through two things, for example two pieces of wood, and fastens them together.

ext.ext_cn: 我自己用螺钉把架子固定在墙上。
ext.ext_en: I had screwed the shelf on the wall myself...

ext.ext_cn: 用螺钉固定住所有松动的地板。
ext.ext_en: Screw down any loose floorboards...

defs.def_en: If you screw something somewhere or if it screws somewhere, you fix it in place by means of a screw or screws.

ext.ext_cn: 带螺旋盖的普通果酱罐
ext.ext_en: ...an ordinary jam jar with a screw lid.

defs.def_en: A screw lid or fitting is one that has a raised spiral line on the inside or outside of it, so that it can be fixed in place by twisting.

ext.ext_cn: 凯利把消音器拧到手枪上。
ext.ext_en: Kelly screwed the silencer onto the pistol...

ext.ext_cn: 把盖子拧紧。
ext.ext_en: Screw down the lid fairly tightly...

defs.def_en: If you screw something somewhere or if it screws somewhere, you fix it in place by twisting it round and round.

defs.def_cn: 把(纸等)揉成一团，拧成一团

ext.ext_cn: 他把纸揉成一团抛进火里。
ext.ext_en: He screwed the paper into a ball and tossed it into the fire.

defs.def_en: If you screw something such as a piece of paper into a ball, you squeeze it or twist it tightly so that it is in the shape of a ball.

ext.ext_cn: 他面部扭曲，假装疼痛。
ext.ext_en: He screwed his face into an expression of mock pain.

defs.def_en: If you screw your face or your eyes into a particular expression, you tighten the muscles of your face to form that expression, for example because you are in pain or because the light is too bright.
If someone screws someone else or if two people screw, they have sex together.
Some people use screw in expressions such as screw you or screw that to show that they are not concerned about someone or something or that they feel contempt for them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们没有提供准确的消息。我们被骗了。
ext.ext_en: They haven't given us accurate information. We've been screwed...

ext.ext_cn: 这名消费者也被诈取了服务费。
ext.ext_en: The consumer is getting screwed by cover charges as well.

defs.def_en: If someone says that they have been screwed, they mean that someone else has cheated them, especially by getting money from them dishonestly.

ext.ext_cn: 富国压榨穷国长达数十载。
ext.ext_en: For decades rich nations have been screwing money out of poor nations.

defs.def_en: If someone screws something, especially money, out of you, they get it from you by putting pressure on you.
Prisoners often refer to prison officers as screws .
A screw is a propeller on a ship or an aircraft.

ext.ext_cn: 巴黎出租车司机们正威胁阻塞交通以对政府进一步施压。
ext.ext_en: Parisian taxi drivers are threatening to mount a blockade to turn the screw on the government.

defs.def_en: If you turn or tighten the screw on someone, you increase the pressure which is already on them, for example by using threats, in order to force them to do a particular thing.

defs.def_cn: 愈逼愈紧的压力(或行动)

ext.ext_cn: 每次叛乱分子发动袭击就是又往前逼进了一步，使得总统的压力越来越大。
ext.ext_en: Every rebel raid is another turn of the screw, increasing the pressure on the President.

defs.def_en: You can refer to each of a series of threats or actions which are intended to force someone to do a particular thing as another turn of the screw .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不利的经济形势阻碍着美国保险市场的复苏。
ext.ext_en: Unfavourable economic conditions were blocking a recovery of the American insurance market...

ext.ext_cn: 眼下汇率对我们不利。
ext.ext_en: We've got a fairly unfavourable exchange rate at the moment...

defs.def_en: Unfavourable conditions or circumstances cause problems for you and reduce your chances of success.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 首相今天的回应更是表示反对。
ext.ext_en: A more unfavourable response was given today by the Prime Minister...

ext.ext_cn: 穆巴拉克总统尤其不赞同这一想法。
ext.ext_en: President Mubarak was particularly unfavourable to the idea...

defs.def_en: If you have an unfavourable reaction to something, you do not like it.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为与法国菜相比，英国菜相形见绌。
ext.ext_en: He makes unfavourable comparisons between British and French cooking...

ext.ext_cn: 与一味地比较进步情况相比，年纪小一些的孩子会从姐姐的帮助中获益更多。
ext.ext_en: A younger child will benefit more from an older sister's help than from an unfavourable comparison between their progress.

defs.def_en: If you make an unfavourable comparison between two things, you say that one thing seems worse than the other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 过于自信的；盛气凌人的；自以为是的

ext.ext_cn: 在台上她显得强硬、自负且毫不妥协。
ext.ext_en: On stage she seems hard, brash and uncompromising.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or their behaviour as brash, you disapprove of them because you think that they are too confident and aggressive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: A comely woman is attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们中大多数人需要过更为平衡的生活，以保持健康和快乐。
ext.ext_en: Most of us need to lead more balanced lives to be healthy and happy...

ext.ext_cn: 她正常妊娠，生了个健康的孩子。
ext.ext_en: She had a normal pregnancy and delivered a healthy child.

defs.def_en: Someone who is healthy is well and is not suffering from any illness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 显示健康的;反映健康的

ext.ext_cn: 健康的肤色
ext.ext_en: ...the glow of healthy skin.

ext.ext_cn: 食欲旺盛的年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...young adults with healthy appetites.

defs.def_en: If a feature or quality that you have is healthy, it makes you look well or shows that you are well.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有益于健康的;促进健康的

ext.ext_cn: 对健康大有裨益的室外活动
ext.ext_en: ...a great healthy outdoor pursuit.

ext.ext_cn: 有益于健康的饮食
ext.ext_en: ...a healthy diet.

defs.def_en: Something that is healthy is good for your health.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （机构或体系）兴旺的，运作良好的

ext.ext_cn: 经济繁荣的社会主义国家
ext.ext_en: ...an economically healthy socialist state.

defs.def_en: A healthy organization or system is successful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他预计本财年能继续保持可观的利润。
ext.ext_en: He predicts a continuation of healthy profits in the current financial year.

ext.ext_cn: 巨额账户
ext.ext_en: ...a healthy bank account.

defs.def_en: A healthy amount of something is a large amount that shows success.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她对工作持一种明智态度，令人耳目一新。
ext.ext_en: She has a refreshingly healthy attitude to work...

ext.ext_cn: 不逞匹夫之勇是很明智的。
ext.ext_en: It's very healthy to be afraid when there's something to be afraid of.

defs.def_en: If you have a healthy attitude about something, you show good sense.
A flophouse is a kind of cheap hotel in a city for people who have no home and very little money.

ext.ext_cn: 照顾学龄前的孩子非常辛苦。
ext.ext_en: Looking after pre-school children is very tiring...

ext.ext_cn: 《哈尔西报告》强调了学前教育的重要性。
ext.ext_en: The Halsey Report emphasized the value of a pre-school education.

defs.def_en: Pre-school is used to describe things relating to the care and education of children before they reach the age when they have to go to school.

defs.def_cn: （美国二至五六岁孩子的）学前班

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们先上幼儿园，然后上学前班，再接着上小学。
ext.ext_en: Children graduate to the kindergarten, then pre-school, and then school.

defs.def_en: In the United States, a pre-school is a school for children between the ages of 2 and 5 or 6.
If you do the football pools, you take part in a gambling competition in which people try to win money by guessing the results of football matches.
On the Internet, a person's or organization's home page is the main page of information about them, which often contains links to other pages about them.
A diary is a book which has a separate space for each day of the year. You use a diary to write down things you plan to do, or to record what happens in your life day by day.

defs.def_cn: 没收获的；未得到回报的

ext.ext_cn: 那位职业赛马骑师周一从美国赶回诺丁汉参加比赛，但是一无所获。
ext.ext_en: The jockey rushed back from America to ride at Nottingham on Monday but went unrewarded.

ext.ext_cn: 漫长而徒劳的斗争
ext.ext_en: ...a long and unrewarded struggle.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone goes unrewarded, or that their activities go unrewarded, when they do not achieve what they are trying to achieve.

defs.def_cn: 迪吉里杜管(一种澳大利亚乐器)
defs.def_en: A didgeridoo is an Australian musical instrument that consists of a long pipe which makes a low sound when you blow into it.

ext.ext_cn: 1977年，他被判谋杀罪名成立，判处终身监禁。
ext.ext_en: In 1977 he was convicted of murder and sentenced to life imprisonment...

ext.ext_cn: 没有足够证据给他定罪。
ext.ext_en: There was insufficient evidence to convict him.

defs.def_en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a law court.
A convict is someone who is in prison.

defs.def_cn: (标明相关信息的)小布条，小标签，小纸条

ext.ext_cn: 一个蠢笨的医护人员一不留神在他的X光片上贴错了标签。
ext.ext_en: A stupid medical clerk had slipped the wrong tab on his X-ray.

ext.ext_cn: 缝在右后口袋左边的一个小红布签
ext.ext_en: ...a small red tab sewn on to the left-hand side of the back right pocket.

defs.def_en: A tab is a small piece of cloth or paper that is attached to something, usually with information about that thing written on it.

ext.ext_cn: 至少有一个估价把总数定在了 700 万美元。
ext.ext_en: At least one estimate puts the total tab at $7 million...

ext.ext_cn: “我去卧室拿钱包。”——“别费事了，戴夫人，我们就记在你的账单上好了。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'll get my purse out of the bedroom.' — 'No sweat, Mrs. Day. We can put it on your tab.'

defs.def_en: A tab is the total cost of goods or services that you have to pay, or the bill or check for those goods or services.
A tab is a metal strip that you pull off the top of a can of drink in order to open it.

ext.ext_cn: 一粒摇头丸至少卖 15 英镑。
ext.ext_en: One tab of Ecstasy costs at least £15.

defs.def_en: A tab is a drug, especially one that is sold illegally, which is in tablet form.

defs.def_cn: 密切注意，严密监视(某人的一举一动)

ext.ext_cn: 显然，希尔是来密切监视约翰逊的，以确保他不做出什么过激举动。
ext.ext_en: It was obvious Hill had come over to keep tabs on Johnson and make sure he didn't do anything drastic.

defs.def_en: If someone keeps tabs on you, they make sure that they always know where you are and what you are doing, often in order to control you.

ext.ext_cn: 那天的晚饭是波拉德掏的钱。
ext.ext_en: Pollard picked up the tab for dinner that night...

ext.ext_cn: 现如今，不论哪位雇员的背部或肩膀疼，都可以直接去找杰伊先生，费用由公司承担。
ext.ext_en: Today any employee with back or shoulder pain can go straight to Mr Jay and the company will pick up the tab.

defs.def_en: If you pick up the tab, you pay a bill on behalf of a group of people or provide the money that is needed for something.

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩把手插进口袋里，把几枚硬币拨弄得叮当作响。
ext.ext_en: Brian put his hands in his pockets and jingled some change...

ext.ext_cn: 她的手镯叮当作响，如铃声般悦耳。
ext.ext_en: Her bracelets jingled like bells.

defs.def_en: When something jingles or when you jingle it, it makes a gentle ringing noise, like small bells.

defs.def_cn: （广播或电视中宣传产品或节目的）短歌，短曲，广告歌

ext.ext_cn: 广告短歌
ext.ext_en: ...advertising jingles.

defs.def_en: A jingle is a short, simple tune, often with words, which is used to advertise a product or programme on radio or television.

defs.def_cn: （建筑、家具或艺术品）具有英王詹姆斯一世时期风格的

ext.ext_cn: 具有詹姆斯一世时期建筑风格的庄园宅邸
ext.ext_en: ...a Jacobean manor house.

defs.def_en: A Jacobean building, piece of furniture, or work of art was built or produced in Britain in the style of the period between 1603 and 1625.
Petty cash is money that is kept in the office of a company, for making small payments in cash when necessary.
A bard is a poet.

ext.ext_cn: 两名男子和一名女子正轻快地沿人行道朝他走过去。
ext.ext_en: Two men and a woman were walking briskly down the sidewalk toward him.

defs.def_en: A sidewalk is a path with a hard surface by the side of a road.
Cherries are small, round fruit with red skins.
A cherry or a cherry tree is a tree that cherries grow on.

ext.ext_cn: 辛格先生是个非常成功的推销员。
ext.ext_en: Mr Singh was a highly successful salesman...

ext.ext_cn: 她好像压根就没存在过。
ext.ext_en: It seems highly unlikely that she ever existed.

defs.def_en: Highly is used before some adjectives to mean 'very'.

ext.ext_cn: 高级政府顾问
ext.ext_en: ...a highly placed government advisor.

ext.ext_cn: 名列前茅的足球队
ext.ext_en: ...highly ranked soccer teams.

defs.def_en: You use highly to indicate that someone has an important position in an organization or set of people.

ext.ext_cn: 他是员工中薪酬最高的。
ext.ext_en: He was the most highly paid member of staff.

defs.def_en: If someone is highly paid, they receive a large salary.

ext.ext_cn: 达夫妮和迈克尔对那所学校评价很高。
ext.ext_en: Daphne and Michael thought highly of the school.

ext.ext_cn: 法国首都最受推崇的厨师之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the most highly regarded chefs in the French capital.

defs.def_en: If you think highly of something or someone, you think they are very good indeed.

defs.def_cn: 跨(或横渡、横穿)大西洋的;(通常指)英美之间的

ext.ext_cn: 许多跨大西洋的航班在那里着陆。
ext.ext_en: Many transatlantic flights land there.

ext.ext_cn: 首个跨越大西洋的无线电信号
ext.ext_en: …the first transatlantic radio signal.

defs.def_en: Transatlantic flights or signals go across the Atlantic Ocean, usually between the United States and Britain.

defs.def_cn: 在(或来自)大西洋彼岸的;在(或来自)美国的

ext.ext_cn: 大西洋彼岸的时尚
ext.ext_en: ...transatlantic fashions.

defs.def_en: Transatlantic is used to refer to something that happens, exists, or begins in the United States.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他有一张黝黑的大脸。
ext.ext_en: He had a broad swarthy face.

defs.def_en: A swarthy person has a dark face.
A lifeboat is a medium-sized boat that is sent out from a port or harbour in order to rescue people who are in danger at sea.

ext.ext_cn: 船长命令所有乘客和船员都进入救生艇。
ext.ext_en: The captain ordered all passengers and crew into lifeboats.

defs.def_en: A lifeboat is a small boat that is carried on a ship, which people on the ship use to escape when the ship is in danger of sinking.

ext.ext_cn: 他为自己发表的评论道歉并称无意冒犯该社群。
ext.ext_en: He apologizes for his comments and says he had no intention of offending the community...

ext.ext_cn: 这项调查发现几乎90％的人都会为不堪入耳的脏话所触怒。
ext.ext_en: The survey found almost 90 percent of people were offended by strong swearwords...

defs.def_en: If you offend someone, you say or do something rude which upsets or embarrasses them.

defs.def_cn: 违反，违犯，违背（法律、规定、原则等）

ext.ext_cn: 该法案有悖于理智和公正。
ext.ext_en: This bill offends against good sense and against justice...

ext.ext_cn: 道格拉斯藐视重量级拳王称号的行为违背了严格的准则。
ext.ext_en: In showing contempt for the heavyweight championship Douglas offended a stern code.

defs.def_en: To offend against a law, rule, or principle means to break it.

ext.ext_cn: 在西方国家，女孩的犯罪倾向远低于男孩。
ext.ext_en: In Western countries girls are far less likely to offend than boys.

defs.def_en: If someone offends, they commit a crime.

ext.ext_cn: 给植物喷洒杀虫剂。
ext.ext_en: Spray the plants with insecticide.

defs.def_en: Insecticide is a chemical substance that is used to kill insects.

defs.def_cn: 斑猫（毛皮上有深色条纹）
defs.def_en: A tabby or a tabby cat is a cat whose fur has dark stripes on a lighter background.

ext.ext_cn: 通过科学我们知道了应该把进步和未来联系起来。
ext.ext_en: Through science we've got the idea of associating progress with the future...

ext.ext_cn: 说唱组合被禁止参加大型的音乐活动，因为他们使人联想到肆意破坏公共财产的行为。
ext.ext_en: Rap groups have been barred from large musical events because they are associated with vandalism.

defs.def_en: If you associate someone or something with another thing, the two are connected in your mind.

defs.def_cn: 使与（某个组织、事业或观点）有关系;公开支持

ext.ext_cn: 我去年一直没有参与那个项目。
ext.ext_en: I haven't been associated with the project over the last year...

ext.ext_cn: 媒体感到有必要支持绿色运动。
ext.ext_en: The press feels the need to associate itself with the green movement.

defs.def_en: If you are associated with a particular organization, cause, or point of view, or if you associate yourself with it, you support it publicly.

ext.ext_cn: 如果他们知道自己正在与一个杀人犯为伍会怎么想?
ext.ext_en: What would they think if they knew that they were associating with a murderer?...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不同意她在迪斯科舞厅跳舞并和同性恋鬼混。
ext.ext_en: They disapproved of her dancing at discos and associating with homosexuals.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is associating with another person or group of people, you mean they are spending a lot of time in the company of people you do not approve of.

ext.ext_cn: 餐馆老板的商业伙伴
ext.ext_en: ...the restaurant owner's business associates.

defs.def_en: Your associates are the people you are closely connected with, especially at work.

defs.def_cn: （用于等级或头衔前，表示稍有不同或略低）副的，准的

ext.ext_cn: 林先生是研究所的副所长。
ext.ext_en: Mr Lin is associate director of the Institute...

ext.ext_cn: 她去年申请成为准会员。
ext.ext_en: She applied for associate membership last year.

defs.def_en: Associate is used before a rank or title to indicate a slightly different or lower rank or title.

defs.def_cn: 女飞行员；（尤指）空军女兵
defs.def_en: An airwoman is a woman who flies aircraft, especially one who serves in her country's air force.

defs.def_cn: (书、论点等的)清楚，清晰易懂，明晰

ext.ext_cn: 作者解释复杂的科技主题时的游刃有余、清晰透彻
ext.ext_en: ...the ease and clarity with which the author explains difficult technical and scientific subjects.

defs.def_en: The clarity of something such as a book or argument is its quality of being well explained and easy to understand.

ext.ext_cn: 在商界，他的天赋和远见卓识是出了名的。
ext.ext_en: In business circles he is noted for his flair and clarity of vision.

defs.def_en: Clarity is the ability to think clearly.

ext.ext_cn: 这项卓越技术的清晰度比常规的X光高得多。
ext.ext_en: This remarkable technology provides far greater clarity than conventional x-rays.

defs.def_en: Clarity is the quality of being clear in outline or sound.

defs.def_cn: (液体、玻璃或空气的)清澈度，透明度

ext.ext_cn: 首先吸引我的是水的无比清澈。
ext.ext_en: The first thing to strike me was the amazing clarity of the water.

defs.def_en: The clarity of a liquid, of glass, or of the air is the degree to which it is clear.

ext.ext_cn: 他童年时由地方政府照管，曾被送到什罗普郡的一户农民家里寄宿。
ext.ext_en: As a child in the care of a local authority he had been boarded out with a farmer in Shropshire.

defs.def_en: If someone in your care is boarded out, they are sent to stay with someone else.
The refurbishment of something is the act or process of cleaning it, decorating it, and providing it with new equipment or facilities.

ext.ext_cn: 把灌木丛上枯萎的花朵整齐地修剪掉。
ext.ext_en: Neatly trim away old flowers on shrubs…

ext.ext_cn: 把肥膘从火腿上切除。
ext.ext_en: Trim the fat off the ham…

defs.def_en: If you trim away or trim off parts of something, you cut them off, because they are not needed.

ext.ext_cn: 对不宽容政策和宗教狂热的抗议
ext.ext_en: ...a protest against intolerance and religious fanaticism.

defs.def_en: Fanaticism is fanatical behaviour or the quality of being fanatical.

ext.ext_cn: 你的文章使我想起了伤心的往事。
ext.ext_en: Your article brought back sad memories for me...

ext.ext_cn: 谈到这个让人想起了整件事。
ext.ext_en: Talking about it brought it all back.

defs.def_en: Something that brings back a memory makes you think about it.

defs.def_cn: 恢复（惯例）；使（潮流）再度流行

ext.ext_cn: 下议院将再次就是否恢复死刑展开辩论。
ext.ext_en: The House of Commons is to debate once again whether to bring back the death penalty.

defs.def_en: When people bring back a practice or fashion that existed at an earlier time, they introduce it again.

ext.ext_cn: 透过缝隙，他能看见日光。
ext.ext_en: Through the aperture he could see daylight.

defs.def_en: An aperture is a narrow hole or gap.

ext.ext_cn: 用小光圈，仔细调整相机位置。
ext.ext_en: Use a small aperture and position the camera carefully...

ext.ext_cn: 这架相机有一个32毫米的镜头，最大孔径为f/4.5，固定快门速度为1/100秒。
ext.ext_en: The camera has a 32mm lens with a maximum aperture of f/4.5 and a fixed shutter speed of 1/100sec.

defs.def_en: In photography, the aperture of a camera is the size of the hole through which light passes to reach the film.

ext.ext_cn: 他从口袋里掏出一把小钥匙,慢慢地插到锁眼里。
ext.ext_en: He took a small key from his pocket and slowly inserted it into the lock...

ext.ext_cn: 先合上嘴巴等几分钟再放进体温计。
ext.ext_en: Wait for a couple of minutes with your mouth closed before inserting the thermometer.

defs.def_en: If you insert an object into something, you put the object inside it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们与君主主义者联手添加了一个条款,呼吁对该议题进行全民投票。
ext.ext_en: They joined with the monarchists to insert a clause calling for a popular vote on the issue.

defs.def_en: If you insert a comment into a piece of writing or a speech, you include it.

defs.def_cn: 插入物;(尤指夹在书刊中的)活页广告
defs.def_en: An insert is something that is inserted somewhere, especially an advertisement on a piece of paper that is placed between the pages of a book or magazine.

ext.ext_cn: 下周，他将在佛罗里达与密特朗总统进行磋商。
ext.ext_en: Next week he'll be in Florida for consultations with President Mitterrand...

ext.ext_cn: 这些方案是在与世界卫生组织磋商之后起草的。
ext.ext_en: The plans were drawn up in consultation with the World Health Organisation...

defs.def_en: A consultation is a meeting which is held to discuss something. Consultation is discussion about something.

ext.ext_cn: 咨询营养学家后，制订了个人饮食方案。
ext.ext_en: A personal diet plan is devised after a consultation with a nutritionist.

ext.ext_cn: 就税务问题进行咨询、求得建议而支付的费用
ext.ext_en: ...fees paid for consultation and advice in tax matters.

defs.def_en: A consultation with a doctor or other expert is a meeting with them to discuss a particular problem and get their advice. Consultation is the process of getting advice from a doctor or other expert.
A consultation is a meeting where several doctors discuss a patient and his or her condition and treatment.

ext.ext_cn: 有如此优秀的研究可供参考，避开陷阱应该很容易。
ext.ext_en: With such excellent studies available for consultation, it should be easy to avoid the pitfalls.

defs.def_en: Consultation of a book or other source of information is looking at it in order to find out certain facts.

defs.def_cn: (政府或机构旨在修改法律的文件)征询意见的

ext.ext_cn: 政府在昨天公布的征求意见稿中提出，一般退休年龄为63岁。
ext.ext_en: The Government proposed a common retirement age of 63 in a consultation paper published yesterday.

defs.def_en: A consultation paper or document is a document containing ideas for changes in the law. It is published by the government or by an organization, so that people can discuss it and give their opinions on it.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们需要父母。
ext.ext_en: Children need their parents...

ext.ext_cn: 这正是很多父母犯错的地方。
ext.ext_en: This is where a lot of parents go wrong...

defs.def_en: See also:foster parent;one-parent family;single parent;Your parents are your mother and father.

defs.def_cn: 创始的；母公司的；总公司的

ext.ext_cn: 包括母公司在内，每个单位都有自己的地方管理层。
ext.ext_en: Each unit including the parent company has its own, local management.

ext.ext_cn: 该动物园的创始组织，伦敦动物学会
ext.ext_en: ...the zoo's parent body, the Zoological Society of London.

defs.def_en: An organization's parent organization is the organization that created it and usually still controls it.

defs.def_cn: （动物、植物或有机体）亲本的，亲代的

ext.ext_cn: 亲鸟开始为幼鸟寻找食物。
ext.ext_en: Parent birds began to hunt for food for their young.

defs.def_en: The parent animal, plant, or organism of a particular animal, plant or organism is the one that it comes from or is produced by.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不知道的；未注意的;未觉察的

ext.ext_cn: 她一动不动地躺在原地，已经感觉不到疼痛。
ext.ext_en: She lay motionless where she was, oblivious to pain...

ext.ext_cn: 卢埃林看起来没有注意到他周围的情况。
ext.ext_en: Llewelyn appeared oblivious of his surroundings.

defs.def_en: If you are oblivious to something or oblivious of it, you are not aware of it.

ext.ext_cn: 一个生意伙伴曾将账单交给汉普顿代为保管。
ext.ext_en: Hampton had been given the bills for safekeeping by a business partner.

defs.def_en: If something is given to you for safekeeping, it is given to you so that you will make sure that it is not harmed or stolen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (皮肤)经风吹日晒的，饱经风霜的

ext.ext_cn: 一个强壮的男人，红红的脸上饱经风霜
ext.ext_en: ...a stout man with a ruddy, weather-beaten face.

defs.def_en: If your face or skin is weather-beaten, it is rough with deep lines because you have spent a lot of time outside in bad weather.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （物体）饱经风霜的，经风吹日晒的

ext.ext_cn: 他们会透过那扇经受风吹日晒的老木门的缝隙向外张望。
ext.ext_en: They would look out through the cracks of their weather-beaten door.

defs.def_en: Something that is weather-beaten is rough and slightly damaged after being outside for a long time.

defs.def_cn: (英国17至19世纪的)济贫院，劳动救济所

ext.ext_cn: 生活在对济贫院的恐惧之中、艰苦挣扎着的什罗普郡一家人
ext.ext_en: ...a struggling Shropshire family which lived in fear of the workhouse.

defs.def_en: In Britain, in the seventeenth to nineteenth centuries, a workhouse was a place where very poor people could live and do unpleasant jobs in return for food. People use the workhouse to refer to these places in general.

defs.def_cn: （英国国教的）教区牧师；（其他教会的）圣职人员
defs.def_en: A parson is a priest in the Church of England with responsibility for a small local area, or can be used to refer to any clergyman in some other churches.
A thermometer is an instrument for measuring temperature. It usually consists of a narrow glass tube containing a thin column of a liquid which rises and falls as the temperature rises and falls.

ext.ext_cn: 账户资料被加密，以保护隐私。
ext.ext_en: Account details are encrypted to protect privacy.

ext.ext_cn: 在发送前会对信息进行加密的程序
ext.ext_en: ...a program that will encrypt the information before sending.

defs.def_en: If a document or piece of information is encrypted, it is written in a special code, so that only certain people can read it.

defs.def_cn: 尖刻的文字;刻薄的话;讽刺

ext.ext_cn: 他对媒体的尖刻抨击没完没了。
ext.ext_en: The vitriol he hurled at members of the press knew no bounds...

ext.ext_cn: 在起伏不定的政治生涯里，他对争议和讥讽早已习以为常。
ext.ext_en: He has been no stranger to controversy and vitriol during a tumultuous political career.

defs.def_en: If you refer to what someone says or writes as vitriol, you disapprove of it because it is full of bitterness and hate, and so causes a lot of distress and pain.
A telephone box is a small shelter in the street in which there is a public telephone.
In rugby, a scrummage is the same as a scrum .

ext.ext_cn: 这些人，通常为男性，似乎不懂得如何跟异性相处。
ext.ext_en: These people, usually men, seem unable to relate to the opposite sex...

ext.ext_cn: 肢体语言也可以用来吸引异性的注意。
ext.ext_en: Body language can also be used to attract members of the opposite sex.

defs.def_en: If you are talking about men and refer to the opposite sex, you mean women. If you are talking about women and refer to the opposite sex, you mean men.

defs.def_cn: 发源；来自；产生；创始；开创

ext.ext_cn: 这种病源于非洲。
ext.ext_en: The disease originated in Africa...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的碳水化合物均来自植物。
ext.ext_en: All carbohydrates originate from plants...

defs.def_en: When something originates or when someone originates it, it begins to happen or exist.
A funeral director is a person whose job is to arrange funerals.
A steamship is a ship that has an engine powered by steam.

ext.ext_cn: 表示一棵松树的图画文字
ext.ext_en: ...a pictogram of a pine tree.

defs.def_en: A pictogram is a simple drawing that represents something. Pictograms were used as the earliest form of writing.
Char-grilled meat or fish has been cooked so that it burns slightly and turns black.
A hawk is a large bird with a short, hooked beak, sharp claws, and very good eyesight. Hawks catch and eat small birds and animals.

defs.def_cn: （政治上的）鹰派人物，主战分子

ext.ext_cn: 鹰派和鸽派都充分阐明了各自的停战条件。
ext.ext_en: Both hawks and doves have expanded their conditions for ending the war.

defs.def_en: In politics, if you refer to someone as a hawk, you mean that they believe in using force and violence to achieve something, rather than using more peaceful or diplomatic methods.

ext.ext_cn: 沿街兜售小饰品的小贩
ext.ext_en: ...vendors hawking trinkets.

defs.def_en: If someone hawks goods, they sell them by walking through the streets or knocking at people's houses, and asking people to buy them.

ext.ext_cn: 开发商会竭力推销减价的公寓和房子。
ext.ext_en: Developers will be hawking cut-price flats and houses.

ext.ext_cn: 他正在四处推销一部长15分钟、价值5,000英镑的宣传录像片。
ext.ext_en: He is hawking around a 15-minute, £5,000 promotional video...

defs.def_en: You can say that someone is hawking something if you do not like the forceful way in which they are asking people to buy it.

ext.ext_cn: 他用力咳了咳，吐了口痰。
ext.ext_en: He hawked and spat.

defs.def_en: If someone hawks, they noisily clear mucus from their throat and spit it out.

defs.def_cn: 像鹰一样注视;警惕地监视
defs.def_en: If you watch someone like a hawk, you observe them very carefully, usually to make sure that they do not make a mistake or do something you do not want them to do.

defs.def_cn: (对错误或违法的事情)坐视不理，作壁上观

ext.ext_cn: 我们不能眼睁睁地看着你毁掉自己的生活。
ext.ext_en: We can't just sit by and watch you throw your life away...

ext.ext_cn: 消耗臭氧的化学物质的使用急剧增多，政府却坐视不理。
ext.ext_en: The use of ozone-depleting chemicals grew dramatically and the government sat idly by.

defs.def_en: If you sit by while something wrong or illegal is happening, you allow it to happen and do not do anything about it.
A health farm is a hotel where people go to get fitter or lose weight by exercising and eating special food.

defs.def_cn: （表示恼怒或愤怒，可能具冒犯意味）该死，真要命
defs.def_en: Some people say goddammit when they are angry or irritated. This use could cause offence.

defs.def_cn: 生气，气恼,恼怒(尤指事情无法阻止或控制时)

ext.ext_cn: 伦纳德这还是头一次对她的方法感到恼怒。
ext.ext_en: For the first time Leonard felt irritation at her methods...

ext.ext_cn: 电视镁光灯的强光让他直眨眼睛，他努力不让自己的恼怒表现出来。
ext.ext_en: He tried not to let his irritation show as he blinked in the glare of the television lights.

defs.def_en: Irritation is a feeling of annoyance, especially when something is happening that you cannot easily stop or control.

ext.ext_cn: 不要让工作中的一点烦心事打击了你的雄心抱负。
ext.ext_en: Don't allow a minor irritation in the workplace to mar your ambitions...

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得那些游客令人厌烦。
ext.ext_en: He describes the tourists as an irritation.

defs.def_en: An irritation is something that keeps annoying you.

ext.ext_cn: 这些化妆油会导致敏感皮肤发炎。
ext.ext_en: These oils may cause irritation to sensitive skins...

ext.ext_cn: 这是眼睑边缘红肿发炎的症状。
ext.ext_en: This is an irritation and inflammation of the edge of the eyelid.

defs.def_en: Irritation in a part of your body is a feeling of slight pain and discomfort there.

ext.ext_cn: 美国政府将这块土地永久性划拨给该部族。
ext.ext_en: The US Government gave the land to the tribe in perpetuity.

defs.def_en: If something is done in perpetuity, it is intended to last for ever.

defs.def_cn: （尤指谈到秘密或私人话题的）枕边风，枕边私房话
defs.def_en: Conversations that people have when they are in bed together can be referred to as pillow talk, especially when they are about secret or private subjects.

defs.def_cn: （尤指将已经冷掉的熟食）加热

ext.ext_cn: 弗蕾达为我热了一块馅饼。
ext.ext_en: Freda heated up a pie for me.

defs.def_en: When you heat something up, especially food which has already been cooked and allowed to go cold, you make it hot.

defs.def_cn: 激化;加剧;变得激烈（或热烈）

ext.ext_cn: 然后在过去几年里，民主运动开始升温。
ext.ext_en: Then in the last couple of years, the movement for democracy began to heat up.

defs.def_en: When a situation heats up, things start to happen much more quickly and with increased interest and excitement among the people involved.

ext.ext_cn: 夏天一到，她的活动住房就变得像烤炉一样热。
ext.ext_en: In the summer her mobile home heats up like an oven.

defs.def_en: When something heats up, it gradually becomes hotter.

defs.def_cn: (总称)标志，标牌(尤指路标、广告牌)

ext.ext_cn: 他们不允许在体育场周围设广告牌。
ext.ext_en: They don't allow signage around the stadium.

defs.def_en: Signage is signs, especially road signs and advertising signs, considered collectively.

ext.ext_cn: 很多人都团结起来帮助那家人。
ext.ext_en: So many people have rallied round to help the family...

ext.ext_cn: 康妮的朋友都一起支持她。
ext.ext_en: Connie's friends rallied round her.

defs.def_en: When people rally around or rally round, they work as a group in order to support someone or something at a difficult time.
A salt marsh is an area of flat, wet ground which is sometimes covered by salt water or contains areas of salt water.

ext.ext_cn: 为寻求解决方案而进行的外交谈判在中断了两周之后于今天重新开始。
ext.ext_en: Diplomatic efforts to reach a settlement resume today after a two-week hiatus...

ext.ext_cn: 他的演艺生涯曾一度中断。
ext.ext_en: There was a hiatus in his acting life.

defs.def_en: A hiatus is a pause in which nothing happens, or a gap where something is missing.

ext.ext_cn: 他们愿意在祖国需要的时候为她效力。
ext.ext_en: They were willing to serve the fatherland in its hour of need.

defs.def_en: If someone is very proud of the country where they or their ancestors were born, they sometimes refer to it as the fatherland. The word fatherland is particularly associated with Germany.

ext.ext_cn: 贝弗利山庄的绚丽浮华
ext.ext_en: ...the glitz of Beverly Hills.

ext.ext_cn: 法国庆祝革命胜利200周年的盛大场面
ext.ext_en: ...the glitz with which France celebrated the bicentenary of its revolution.

defs.def_en: You use glitz to refer to something that is exciting and attractive in a showy way.
A soldier is a person who works in an army, especially a person who is not an officer.

A kaleidoscope is a toy in the shape of a tube with a small hole at one end. If you look through the hole and turn the other end of the tube, you can see a pattern of colours which changes as you turn the tube round.

defs.def_cn: （色彩、成分等的）千变万化，瞬息万变

ext.ext_cn: 孔雀羽毛的五彩缤纷
ext.ext_en: ...the vivid kaleidoscope of colours displayed in the plumage of the peacock.

ext.ext_cn: 结盟形式、党派分立及利益关系的瞬息万变
ext.ext_en: ...a kaleidoscope of different alliances, groupings and interests.

defs.def_en: You can describe something that is made up of a lot of different and frequently changing colours or elements as a kaleidoscope.

ext.ext_cn: 简化复杂的社会保障体系的计划
ext.ext_en: ...a plan to simplify the complex social security system...

ext.ext_cn: 他过上了一种简单的生活，将自己的需求降到最低限度。
ext.ext_en: He reduced his needs to the minimum by simplifying his life.

defs.def_en: If you simplify something, you make it easier to understand or you remove the things which make it complex.

defs.def_cn: 美国化的；带上美国特点的

ext.ext_cn: 他变得过于美国化了。
ext.ext_en: He is getting much too Americanized.

defs.def_en: If someone is Americanized, they do things in a way that is typical of the United States.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这本书极其简明扼要地介绍了这项技术及其发展史。
ext.ext_en: The book gives an admirably succinct account of the technology and its history...

ext.ext_cn: 在阐述观点时一定要准确、简洁、中肯。
ext.ext_en: If you have something to say make sure that it is accurate, succinct and to the point.

defs.def_en: Something that is succinct expresses facts or ideas clearly and in few words.

ext.ext_cn: 该乐队演出时闪光灯曾 20 分钟频闪不息。
ext.ext_en: The band left their strobes on for 20 minutes.

ext.ext_cn: 类似迪斯科舞厅的频闪闪光灯
ext.ext_en: ...like strobe lighting at a disco.

defs.def_en: A strobe or a strobe light is a very bright light which flashes on and off very quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 那个举动引得学生和体育老师大笑不止。
ext.ext_en: That caused considerable mirth amongst pupils and sports masters alike...

ext.ext_cn: 他能做的只有不让快乐的泪水滑落脸庞。
ext.ext_en: It was all he could do to stop tears of mirth falling down his cheeks.

defs.def_en: Mirth is amusement which you express by laughing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 年幼的;幼小的;未成熟的

ext.ext_cn: 在苏格兰，年轻人16岁就可以结婚。
ext.ext_en: In Scotland, young people can marry at 16...

ext.ext_cn: 她去世的时候你不算太年幼，已经能记事了。
ext.ext_en: You weren't so very young when she died; you were old enough to remember.

defs.def_en: A young person, animal, or plant has not lived or existed for very long and is not yet mature.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我妈妈年轻时曾经是个成功的时装销售员。
ext.ext_en: In her younger days my mother had been a successful fashionwear saleswoman.

defs.def_en: You use young to describe  a time when a person or thing was young.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （显得）年轻的;（显得）岁数不大的

ext.ext_cn: 我当时23岁，我想，看上去比实际年龄小。
ext.ext_en: I was twenty-three, I suppose, and young for my age...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得他似乎非常年轻，非常孤独。
ext.ext_en: He seemed to me very young and very lonely.

defs.def_en: Someone who is young in appearance or behaviour looks or behaves as if they are young.

ext.ext_cn: 雌鸟可能无法给幼鸟喂食。

defs.def_cn: 胡乱应付过去;勉强蒙混过关

ext.ext_cn: 我们会应付过关的，就一天一天地演吧。
ext.ext_en: We will muddle through and just play it day by day...

ext.ext_cn: 像这样，英国广播公司也许能勉强再应付5年。
ext.ext_en: The BBC may be able to muddle through the next five years like this...

defs.def_en: If you muddle through, you manage to do something even though you do not have the proper equipment or do not really know how to do it.

ext.ext_cn: “温斯顿”是一个香烟品牌。
ext.ext_en: Winston is a brand of cigarette...

ext.ext_cn: 我买了几个畅销品牌中的一种。
ext.ext_en: I bought one of the leading brands.

defs.def_en: A brand of a product is the version of it that is made by one particular manufacturer.

ext.ext_cn: 英国式的社会主义更加注重改革，而不是革命。
ext.ext_en: The British brand of socialism was more interested in reform than revolution.

defs.def_en: A brand of something such as a way of thinking or behaving is a particular kind of it.

ext.ext_cn: 转眼间我被诬蔑为叛徒。
ext.ext_en: I was instantly branded as a rebel...

ext.ext_cn: 一些内部员工谴责这家公司具有种族主义倾向。
ext.ext_en: The company has been branded racist by some of its own staff...

defs.def_en: If someone is branded as something bad, people think they are that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 主人懒得给牛打烙印。
ext.ext_en: The owner couldn't be bothered to brand the cattle.

ext.ext_cn: 烙印是一种用烙铁烫印在牲畜毛皮上以标志其归属的印记。
ext.ext_en: A brand was a mark of ownership burned into the hide of an animal with a hot iron.

defs.def_en: When you brand an animal, you put a permanent mark on its skin in order to show who it belongs to, usually by burning a mark onto its skin.
A brand is a permanent mark on the skin of an animal, which shows who it belongs to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她身体状况非常好，我希望她身子骨能一直这么硬朗。
ext.ext_en: She is remarkable and I'd like to see her remain hale and hearty for years yet.

defs.def_en: If you describe people, especially people who are old, as hale, you mean that they are healthy.

defs.def_cn: （社会主义者、共产主义者等）左派成员，左派人士

ext.ext_cn: 这些人中，有两位是左派，有两位是中间派。
ext.ext_en: Two of the men were leftists and two were centrists.

ext.ext_cn: 智利的左派人士
ext.ext_en: ...Chilean leftists.

defs.def_en: Socialists and Communists are sometimes referred to as leftists.

defs.def_cn: 左派的；社会主义思想的；共产主义思想的

ext.ext_cn: 7个左派政党组成的联盟
ext.ext_en: ...an alliance of seven leftist parties...

ext.ext_cn: 他们毫不掩饰自己对左派的同情。
ext.ext_en: They make no secret of their leftist sympathies.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone, their ideals, or their activities as leftist, you mean that they support the ideas of socialism or communism.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他逃走时只穿着莎笼和破旧的衬衫。
ext.ext_en: He fled wearing only a sarong and a tattered shirt.

ext.ext_cn: 破旧的电话号码簿
ext.ext_en: ...a very old, tattered, phone directory.

defs.def_en: If something such as clothing or a book is tattered, it is damaged or torn, especially because it has been used a lot over a long period of time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 损坏严重的;一败涂地的

ext.ext_cn: 但是，两年半之后，事情并未如愿发展，斯坦利追求名利的梦想完全破灭了。
ext.ext_en: But, two-and-a-half years later, things haven't quite gone to plan and Stanley's dreams of fame and fortune lie tattered and torn.

ext.ext_cn: 最后的残兵败将
ext.ext_en: ...the last tattered remnants of a defeated army.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as tattered, you mean that it has been badly damaged or has failed completely.

defs.def_cn: (道路维修时暂时采取的)一侧路面双向行驶

ext.ext_cn: 5号高速公路第11号和12号出口之间的一侧路面双向行驶
ext.ext_en: ...a contraflow between Junctions Eleven and Twelve of the M5.

defs.def_en: A contraflow is a situation in which vehicles travelling on a main road in one direction have to use lanes that are normally used by traffic travelling in the opposite direction, because the road is being repaired.

ext.ext_cn: 水务委员会将实行私有化。
ext.ext_en: The water boards are about to be privatized.

ext.ext_cn: 将铁路和煤炭工业私有化的保证
ext.ext_en: ...a pledge to privatise the rail and coal industries.

defs.def_en: If a company, industry, or service that is owned by the state is privatized, the government sells it and makes it a private company.

ext.ext_cn: 润喉糖
ext.ext_en: ...throat lozenges.

defs.def_en: Lozenges are sweets which you can suck to make a cough or sore throat better.
A lozenge is a shape with four corners. The two corners that point up and down are further away than the two pointing sideways.

defs.def_cn: 使恢复活力;使更加活跃;使更加振奋;使恢复效率

ext.ext_cn: 他们为节奏布鲁斯的歌曲中加入了舞曲的节奏，使之变得更加活跃。
ext.ext_en: They've revivified rhythm and blues singing by giving it dance beats.

defs.def_en: To revivify a situation, event, or activity means to make it more active, lively, or efficient.

defs.def_cn: 一支接一支地抽烟的人
defs.def_en: A chain-smoker is a person who chain-smokes.

ext.ext_cn: 郊狼毛茸茸的尾巴
ext.ext_en: ...the coyote's furry tail.

defs.def_en: A furry animal is covered with thick, soft hair.

ext.ext_cn: 他那件带毛绒衬里的人字纹粗花呢外套
ext.ext_en: ...his herringbone tweed coat with its furry lining.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as furry, you mean that it has a soft rough texture like fur.
If you have a furry tongue, your tongue is covered with a layer of a soft greyish-white substance, usually because you are unwell.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 脸皮薄的;敏感的;易生气的

ext.ext_cn: 有人担心他脸皮太薄，经受不住总统选举的激烈竞争。
ext.ext_en: Some fear he is too thin-skinned to survive the rough-and-tumble of a presidential campaign.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is thin-skinned, you mean that they are easily upset by criticism or unpleasantness.

ext.ext_cn: 脸盆架上方用钉子挂着一面镜子。
ext.ext_en: A mirror hung on a nail above the washstand...

ext.ext_cn: 他把钉子钉到了树枝上。
ext.ext_en: He hammered the nail into the branch.

defs.def_en: A nail is a thin piece of metal with one pointed end and one flat end. You hit the flat end with a hammer in order to push the nail into something such as a wall.

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰克放下第一块厚木板，把它钉在合适的位置上。
ext.ext_en: Frank put the first plank down and nailed it in place...

ext.ext_cn: 他们把前门钉死了。
ext.ext_en: They nail shut the front door...

defs.def_en: If you nail something somewhere, you fix it there using one or more nails.

ext.ext_cn: 常剪指甲，保持双手清洁。
ext.ext_en: Keep your nails short and your hands clean.

defs.def_en: Your nails are the thin hard parts that grow at the ends of your fingers and toes.

ext.ext_cn: 检控方仍设法使其入室抢劫知名实业家们的罪名成立。
ext.ext_en: The prosecution still managed to nail him for robberies at the homes of leading industrialists.

defs.def_en: To nail someone means to catch them and prove that they have been breaking the law.

defs.def_cn: 冷酷无情的;铁石心肠的;强硬好斗的

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个既精明又铁石心肠的生意人。
ext.ext_en: He's a shrewd businessman and hard as nails...

ext.ext_cn: 他看起来既卑鄙又冷酷无情。
ext.ext_en: He simply looked mean and hard as nails.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is as hard as nails, you mean that they are extremely tough and aggressive, either physically or in their attitude towards other people or other situations.

ext.ext_cn: “我认为，如果人们有良好的环境，就会更有教养一点。”——“我想你说到点子上了。”
ext.ext_en: 'I think it would civilize people a bit more if they had decent conditions.' — 'I think you've hit the nail on the head.'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has hit the nail on the head, you think they are exactly right about something.

defs.def_cn: 正确地；准确地；令人满意地

ext.ext_cn: 你太瘦了。你的饮食不合理。
ext.ext_en: You're too thin. You're not eating properly...

ext.ext_cn: 有必要让公众在充分知情的状况下展开辩论。
ext.ext_en: There needs to be a properly informed public debate.

defs.def_en: If something is done properly, it is done in a correct and satisfactory way.

defs.def_cn: 适宜地；合适地；得体地；恰当地

ext.ext_cn: 他是个被宠坏的孩子，是该学些规矩了。
ext.ext_en: He's a spoilt brat and it's about time he learnt to behave properly...

ext.ext_cn: 他们需要注意行为是否恰当——比如说，穿着得体。
ext.ext_en: They will be concerned to do the right thing — to dress properly, for instance.

defs.def_en: If someone behaves properly, they behave in a way that is considered acceptable and not rude.

defs.def_cn: 确定…的界限;限定;划定…的边界

ext.ext_cn: 这并不是为了限制社会研究人员所能采用的方法。
ext.ext_en: This is not meant to delimit what approaches social researchers can adopt.

defs.def_en: If you delimit something, you fix or establish its limits.

defs.def_cn: 彻底破坏(计划、企图);使成泡影

ext.ext_cn: 如果施奈德看到了他，那他的所有计划都泡汤了。
ext.ext_en: If Schneider had seen him that would have scuppered all his plans...

ext.ext_cn: 如果委员会我行我素的话，整个交易将化为泡影。
ext.ext_en: If the Commission has its way, the entire deal will be scuppered.

defs.def_en: To scupper a plan or attempt means to spoil it completely.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司自成立以来已经完成了 53 种不同样式飞行器的设计。
ext.ext_en: Since its inception the company has produced 53 different aircraft designs.

defs.def_en: The inception of an institution or activity is the start of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经想不出任何办法了。
ext.ext_en: They have run out of ideas...

ext.ext_cn: 我们快没有时间了。
ext.ext_en: We're running out of time...

defs.def_en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.  to run out of steam→see: steam;

ext.ext_cn: 情况越来越糟糕，贮备物资也快用完了。
ext.ext_en: Conditions are getting worse and supplies are running out...

ext.ext_cn: 时间不多了。
ext.ext_en: Time is running out.

defs.def_en: If something runs out, it becomes used up so that there is no more left.

ext.ext_cn: 租约到期后，这家人搬到了坎皮格尼。
ext.ext_en: When the lease ran out the family moved to Campigny.

ext.ext_cn: 我的签证的到期日
ext.ext_en: ...the day my visa ran out.

defs.def_en: When a legal document runs out, it stops being valid.
Housework is the work such as cleaning, washing, and ironing that you do in your home.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 专业化的;专门的;特殊的

ext.ext_cn: 对可卡因上瘾的人从那些懂相关知识的工作人员那里得到了专业化的帮助。
ext.ext_en: Cocaine addicts get specialized support from knowledgeable staff.

ext.ext_cn: 有关美国历史的专业知识
ext.ext_en: ...a specialized knowledge of American History.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is specialized is trained or developed for a particular purpose or area of knowledge.

ext.ext_cn: 我用那只枪打死过几百只鹌鹑。
ext.ext_en: I've shot hundreds of quail with that gun.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正餐吃的是鲑鱼、鹌鹑肉和水果。
ext.ext_en: They dined off salmon, quail, and fruit.

defs.def_en: A quail is a type of small bird which is often shot and eaten.

ext.ext_cn: 这些话让我们许多人胆怯了。
ext.ext_en: The very words make many of us quail...

ext.ext_cn: 他告诉娜奥米，她正变得和马娅一样。一想到这里，娜奥米便不寒而栗。
ext.ext_en: He told Naomi she was becoming just like Maya. Naomi quailed at the thought.

defs.def_en: If someone or something makes you quail, they make you feel very afraid, often so that you hesitate.

defs.def_cn: 光芒四射的亮光;放射状的鲜艳色团

ext.ext_cn: 一团五彩烟雾
ext.ext_en: ...a starburst of multicoloured smoke.

defs.def_en: A starburst is a bright light with rays coming from it, or a patch of bright colour with points extending from it.

ext.ext_cn: 我知道自己要赢需要点运气。
ext.ext_en: I knew I needed a bit of luck to win...

ext.ext_cn: 斯里兰卡人在天气方面运气一直很差。
ext.ext_en: The Sri Lankans have been having no luck with the weather...

defs.def_en: Luck or good luck is success or good things that happen to you, that do not come from your own abilities or efforts.

ext.ext_cn: 上半赛季我一直走背运。
ext.ext_en: I had a lot of bad luck during the first half of this season...

ext.ext_cn: 兰德尔生病纯粹是时运不济。
ext.ext_en: Randall's illness was only bad luck.

defs.def_en: Bad luck is lack of success or bad things that happen to you, that have not been caused by yourself or other people.

ext.ext_cn: “成功了没？”——“没有。”
ext.ext_en: 'Any luck?' — 'No.'

defs.def_en: If you ask someone the question 'Any luck?' or 'No luck?', you want to know if they have been successful in something they were trying to do.

ext.ext_cn: 唉，真不走运，哥儿们。
ext.ext_en: Well, hard luck, mate.

defs.def_en: You can say 'Bad luck', or 'Hard luck', to someone when you want to express sympathy to them.

defs.def_cn: 带来霉运/带来好运；不吉利/ 吉利

ext.ext_cn: 琼十分迷信，她认为绿色不吉利。
ext.ext_en: Jean was extremely superstitious and believed the colour green brought bad luck.

defs.def_en: If you say that something brings bad luck or brings someone good luck, you believe that it has an influence on whether good or bad things happen to them.

defs.def_cn: （常指因缺钱而）遭遇厄运，时运不济
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as down on their luck, you mean that they have had bad experiences, often because they do not have enough money.

defs.def_cn: 碰巧的运气；运气的结果

ext.ext_cn: 完全是运气使然，这位小伙子必须面对一位美国一流选手。
ext.ext_en: The luck of the draw meant the young lad had to face one of America's best players.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is the luck of the draw, you mean that it is the result of chance and you cannot do anything about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他吻了吻她的脸颊。“祝你好运！”
ext.ext_en: He kissed her on the cheek. 'Best of luck!'

defs.def_en: If you say 'Good luck' or 'Best of luck' to someone, you are telling them that you hope they will be successful in something they are trying to do.

ext.ext_cn: 你真走运。医生还没走。
ext.ext_en: You're in luck. The doctor's still in.

defs.def_en: You can say someone is in luck when they are in a situation where they can have what they want or need.

ext.ext_cn: 他就这运气，误了最后一班船也毫不出奇。
ext.ext_en: It would be just his luck to miss the last boat.

defs.def_en: If you say it is just your luck that something unpleasant has happened to you, you mean that this is quite normal because unpleasant things are always happening to you.

defs.def_cn: 运气不好；不走运；不凑巧

ext.ext_cn: “你想要什么，罗伊？要钱的话，那你别指望了。”
ext.ext_en: 'What do you want, Roy? If it's  money, you're out of luck.'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is out of luck, you mean that they cannot have something which they can normally have.

ext.ext_cn: 他一定是一直想放松一段时间，可就是没这个命。
ext.ext_en: He must have been hoping for a relaxed time. No such luck.

defs.def_en: You can say 'No such luck' when you want to express your disappointment over something.

defs.def_cn: 得寸进尺；冒不明智的风险

ext.ext_cn: 我不敢太过贪心不足，没有要他们签署声明。
ext.ext_en: I didn't dare push my luck too far and did not ask them to sign statements.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is pushing their luck, you think they are taking a bigger risk than is sensible, and may get into trouble.

defs.def_cn: 受幸运之神眷顾；福星高照

ext.ext_cn: 在12年的演艺生涯中，里克好像总有福星高照。
ext.ext_en: Rick seems to have had luck on his side during his 12-year acting career.

defs.def_en: If you say that luck was on someone's side, you mean that they succeeded in something by chance as well as by their own efforts or ability.

ext.ext_cn: 她打算去拉斯韦加斯的赌场碰碰运气。
ext.ext_en: She was going to try her luck at the Las Vegas casinos.

defs.def_en: If someone tries their luck at something, they try to succeed at it, often when it is very difficult or there is little chance of success.

defs.def_cn: 希望；但愿；运气好的话；一切顺利的话

ext.ext_cn: 我们会一席长谈，大哭一场，但愿这样我们两个都会好过一点。
ext.ext_en: We'll have a long talk and a good cry and then with any luck  we'll both feel better.

defs.def_en: You can add with luck or with any luck to a statement to indicate that you hope that a particular thing will happen.

defs.def_cn: 反复提出，反复说（陈旧的观点或过时的信息）

ext.ext_cn: 真的有必要反复提关于爱尔兰的那套老看法吗？
ext.ext_en: Was it really necessary to trot out the same old stereotypes about Ireland?

defs.def_en: If you say that a person trots out old ideas or information, you are criticizing him or her for repeating them in a way that is not new or interesting.

defs.def_cn: 貌似，看似(但可能并非如此)

ext.ext_cn: 一眼望不到头的一长列卡车眼巴巴地等着装货。
ext.ext_en: A seemingly endless line of trucks waits in vain to load up.

ext.ext_cn: 貌似用了无数种原料制成的面包
ext.ext_en: ...bread made from a seemingly limitless variety of ingredients.

defs.def_en: If something is seemingly the case, you mean that it appears to be the case, even though it may not really be so.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经移居西班牙，似乎是想过一种更为悠闲的生活。
ext.ext_en: He has moved to Spain, seemingly to enjoy a slower style of life...

ext.ext_cn: 他这个人好像没有丁点儿的坏心眼。
ext.ext_en: He is a man with seemingly not an ounce of malice in him.

defs.def_en: You use seemingly when you want to say that something seems to be true.

ext.ext_cn: 有几位成员提出了自己的建议。
ext.ext_en: Several of the members have come up with suggestions of their own...

ext.ext_cn: 30年前，科学家们提出了质子和中子是由三种更小的粒子组成的理论。
ext.ext_en: 30 years ago, scientists came up with the theory that protons and neutrons are composed of three smaller particles.

defs.def_en: If you come up with a plan or idea, you think of it and suggest it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果沃伦能拿出那1500万美元，我们就去伦敦。
ext.ext_en: If Warren can come up with the $15 million, we'll go to London.

defs.def_en: If you come up with a sum of money, you manage to produce it when it is needed.

ext.ext_cn: 民众中国民意识的觉醒
ext.ext_en: ...the awakening of national consciousness in people.

ext.ext_cn: 少女的性萌动
ext.ext_en: ...a young woman's sexual awakening.

defs.def_en: The awakening of a feeling or realization is the start of it.

ext.ext_cn: 离家后我才猛然意识到自己不再有什么特别。
ext.ext_en: It was a rude awakening to learn after I left home that I wasn't so special anymore.

defs.def_en: If you have a rude awakening, you are suddenly made aware of an unpleasant fact.

defs.def_cn: 拒不退让者;拒不合作者;拒不参加者

ext.ext_cn: 法国在为解决争端进行的谈判中一直拒不让步。
ext.ext_en: France has been the holdout in trying to negotiate an end to the dispute.

defs.def_en: A holdout is someone who refuses to agree or act with other people in a particular situation and by doing so stops the situation from progressing or being resolved.

ext.ext_cn: 一些有献身精神的医生多年来一直努力指导业内同仁。
ext.ext_en: A few dedicated doctors have fought for years to enlighten the profession...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你知道她出什么问题了，请告诉我。
ext.ext_en: If you know what is wrong with her, please enlighten me.

defs.def_en: To enlighten someone means to give them more knowledge and greater understanding about something.

ext.ext_cn: 我就想逛逛巴黎，读读萨特的作品，听听悉尼·贝谢的音乐。
ext.ext_en: I just wanted to explore Paris, read Sartre, listen to Sidney Bechet...

ext.ext_cn: 游览完老城区之后，会由导游带队参观大教堂。
ext.ext_en: After exploring the old part of town there is a guided tour of the cathedral...

defs.def_en: If you explore a place, you travel around it to find out what it is like.

ext.ext_cn: 部长预计将会探讨这个地区战后重建的意见。
ext.ext_en: The secretary is expected to explore ideas for post-war reconstruction of the area...

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影探究了艺术家和乐器之间的关系。
ext.ext_en: The film explores the relationship between artist and instrument.

defs.def_en: If you explore an idea or suggestion, you think about it or comment on it in detail, in order to assess it carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 那次行动的重点是一口深达1英里的井，最初钻那口井是为了勘探石油。
ext.ext_en: Central to the operation is a mile-deep well, dug originally to explore for oil...
