defs.def_cn: 打开闸门;使…一发不可收拾

ext.ext_cn: 不利于烟草公司的裁决可能引发更多的官司。
ext.ext_en: A decision against the cigarette companies could open the floodgates to many more lawsuits...

ext.ext_cn: 难道它不会成为先例吗？难道它不会引发更多类似的问题吗？
ext.ext_en: Would it not set a precedent? Would it not open the floodgates?

defs.def_en: If events open the floodgates to something, they make it possible for that thing to happen much more often or much more seriously than before.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第 20 个字母。
defs.def_en: T is the twentieth letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_cn: (书写时，用于首字母为 t 的一些单词的缩写，如 ton 和 time)
defs.def_en: T or t is a written abbreviation for words beginning with 't', such as 'ton' and 'time'.

ext.ext_cn: 这样的描述再适合我们不过了。
ext.ext_en: The description fits us to a tee...

ext.ext_cn: 露西什么都追求十全十美，样样都不能出一点问题，要准备得滴水不漏。
ext.ext_en: Lucy was a stickler for perfection, and everything had to be exactly right, rehearsed down to a T.

defs.def_en: You can use to a T or to a tee to mean perfectly or exactly right. For example, if something suits you to a T, it suits you perfectly. If you have got an activity or a skill down to a T, you have succeeded in doing it exactly right.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 圣洁的;似圣徒的;善良的

ext.ext_cn: 他圣洁善良的母亲
ext.ext_en: ...his saintly mother...

ext.ext_cn: 她一直过着自我节制的圣徒式生活。
ext.ext_en: She has been saintly in her self-restraint.

defs.def_en: A saintly person behaves in a very good or very holy way.

ext.ext_cn: 朗昨晚最后的加演节目是《赤足》。
ext.ext_en: Lang's final encore last night was 'Barefoot'.

defs.def_en: An encore is a short extra performance at the end of a longer one, which an entertainer gives because the audience asks for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们加演了谁人乐队的《真是不赖的小伙子》，非常精彩。
ext.ext_en: They encore with a superlative version of The Who's 'The Kids Are Alright'.

defs.def_en: If an entertainer encores, they perform an encore.

defs.def_cn: 再来一个,再奏一曲（古典音乐会观众要求加演节目时用语）
defs.def_en: 'Encore' is the word shouted by classical concert audiences when they want a performer to perform an encore.
Czechoslovakian means the same as Czechoslovak .

defs.def_cn: 捷克斯洛伐克人;捷克斯洛伐克裔人
defs.def_en: A Czechoslovakian was a Czechoslovak citizen, or a person of Czechoslovak origin.

defs.def_cn: 本地的；本地的；地方性的

ext.ext_cn: 我们最好在本地报纸上查一下这场比赛。
ext.ext_en: We'd better check on the match in the local paper...

ext.ext_cn: 当地一些居民也加入了学生的抗议行列。
ext.ext_en: Some local residents joined the students' protest...

defs.def_en: Local means existing in or belonging to the area where you live, or to the area that you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 教育占地方市政会全部开支的三分之二。
ext.ext_en: Education comprises two-thirds of all local council spending.

ext.ext_cn: 被称为“人头税”的备受争议的地方税制
ext.ext_en: ...the controversial system of local taxation known as the poll tax.

defs.def_en: Local government is elected by people in one area of a country and controls aspects such as education, housing, and transport within that area.

defs.def_cn: (常去的)邻近小酒馆，本地酒吧

ext.ext_cn: “黑马”是我常去的附近酒吧。
ext.ext_en: The Black Horse is my local.

defs.def_en: Your local is a pub which is near where you live and where you often go for a drink.

ext.ext_cn: 通常先打局麻，以使该部位失去知觉。
ext.ext_en: An injection of local anaesthetic is usually given first to numb the area.

defs.def_en: A local anaesthetic or condition affects only a small area of your body.

ext.ext_cn: 往平底锅里加满水,小火煮沸。
ext.ext_en: Fill a saucepan with water and bring to a slow boil...

ext.ext_cn: 她做了三明治，把保温瓶灌满，又放了糖进去。
ext.ext_en: She made sandwiches, filled a flask and put sugar in...

defs.def_en: If you fill a container or area, or if it fills, an amount of something enters it that is enough to make it full.

ext.ext_cn: 他把目光投向那一排排挤占了巨大工作空间的柜子。
ext.ext_en: He cast his eyes at the rows of cabinets that filled the enormous work area...

ext.ext_cn: 正文占了 231 页。
ext.ext_en: The text fills 231 pages.

defs.def_en: If something fills a space, it is so big, or there are such large quantities of it, that there is very little room left.

ext.ext_cn: 用颜色相配的木质填料填平小孔。
ext.ext_en: Fill small holes with wood filler in a matching colour...

ext.ext_cn: 掘墓人把墓穴填上。
ext.ext_en: The gravedigger filled the grave.

defs.def_en: If you fill a crack or hole, you put a substance into it in order to make the surface smooth again.

ext.ext_cn: 警报声响彻学校停车场。
ext.ext_en: In the parking lot of the school, the siren filled the air...

ext.ext_cn: 所有灯条都打开了，满屋都是旋转的光柱。
ext.ext_en: All the light bars were turned on which filled the room with these rotating beams of light...

defs.def_en: If a sound, smell, or light fills a space, or the air, it is very strong or noticeable.

defs.def_cn: 使强烈地感到;(感情)充盈于

ext.ext_cn: 我很钦佩父亲，并对他的工作充满了敬畏和好奇。
ext.ext_en: I admired my father, and his work filled me with awe and curiosity...

ext.ext_cn: 他看着我没有说话，我第一次看出他内心充满了自豪。
ext.ext_en: He looked at me without speaking, and for the first time I could see the pride that filled him...

defs.def_en: If something fills you with an emotion, or if an emotion fills you, you experience this emotion strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 如果她想做些日常的事务来打发白天的时间，就让她去做社区工作吧。
ext.ext_en: If she wants a routine to fill her day, let her do community work.

ext.ext_cn: 星期四晚上她去上了瑜伽课，很高兴自己有事可做。
ext.ext_en: On Thursday night she went to her yoga class, glad to have something to fill up the evening.

defs.def_en: If you fill a period of time with a particular activity, you spend the time in this way.

ext.ext_cn: 组织得当、人员配备齐整的日托中心满足了人们的需求，保持了家庭结构不受破坏。
ext.ext_en: ...properly organized and staffed day-care programs fill a need which allows family structures to remain intact...

ext.ext_cn: 她带给他开心快乐，弥补了他生命中的缺憾。
ext.ext_en: She brought him a sense of fun, of gaiety that filled a gap in his life.

defs.def_en: If something fills a need or a gap, it puts an end to this need or gap by existing or being active.

ext.ext_cn: 德娜利用她多年来学到的处事技巧扮演着外交家妻子的角色。
ext.ext_en: Dena was filling the role of diplomat's wife with the skill she had learned over the years.

defs.def_en: If something fills a role, position, or function, they have that role or position, or perform that function, often successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 一个没有提及的问题是，失业人员也许缺乏填补所提供的空职的技能。
ext.ext_en: One problem not mentioned is the unemployed may not have the skills to fill the vacancies on offer...

ext.ext_cn: 有一个职位空了出来，我想要补上。
ext.ext_en: A vacancy has arisen which I intend to fill.

defs.def_en: If a company or organization fills a job vacancy, they choose someone to do the job. If someone fills a job vacancy, they accept a job that they have been offered.

ext.ext_cn: 他们开着玩笑，喝着咖啡，尽情地吃着巧克力蛋糕。
ext.ext_en: They joked and drank coffee and filled themselves with chocolate cake.

defs.def_en: If you fill yourself with food, you eat so much that you do not feel hungry.

defs.def_cn: 使爆满;使满座;使座无虚席

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们为他的故事所着迷;众所周知他在澳大利亚总是场场爆满。
ext.ext_en: Children are enthralled by his stories; he has been known to fill theatre halls in Australia.

defs.def_en: A play, film, or performer that fills a theatre, concert hall, or cinema attracts a very large audience.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎不可能找到一位愿意接受国民医疗保健来补牙的医师。
ext.ext_en: It is almost impossible to find a dentist who will fill a tooth on the National Health.

defs.def_en: When a dentist fills someone's tooth, he or she puts a filling in it.

ext.ext_cn: 只要药剂师认定处方有效就可按方配药。
ext.ext_en: A pharmacist can fill any prescription if, in his or her judgment, the prescription is valid.

defs.def_en: If you fill an order or a prescription, you provide the things that are asked for.

ext.ext_cn: 我们觉得已经受够了失望和情绪困扰。
ext.ext_en: We feel that we have had our fill of disappointments and emotional upsets.

defs.def_en: If you have had your fill of something, you have had enough of it, and do not want to experience it any more or do it any more.

ext.ext_cn: 如果想要一份免费的《病人约章》，就把这张表填一下。
ext.ext_en: If you want your free copy of the Patients' Charter fill this form in...

ext.ext_cn: 填写订单，并按一类邮件寄至注明的地址。
ext.ext_en: Fill in the coupon and send it first class to the address shown.

defs.def_en: If you fill in a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

ext.ext_cn: 两人都把图案填好色后，不妨互相交换着看一下。
ext.ext_en: When you have both filled in your patterns, you may want to share these with each other...

ext.ext_cn: 用唇线笔勾出双唇的轮廓，然后涂上唇膏。
ext.ext_en: With a lip pencil, outline lips and fill them in.

defs.def_en: If you fill in a shape, you cover the area inside the lines with colour or shapes so that none of the background is showing.

ext.ext_cn: 我还没有告诉里德所有详情——我会讲给他听的。
ext.ext_en: I didn't give Reid all the details yet — I'll fill him in...

ext.ext_cn: 他告诉她威尔伯·坎特此行的详细经过。
ext.ext_en: He filled her in on Wilbur Kantor's visit.

defs.def_en: If you fill someone in, you give them more details about something that you know about.

ext.ext_cn: 副总统夫人们将临时代替各位第一夫人。
ext.ext_en: Vice-presidents' wives would fill in for first ladies.

defs.def_en: If you fill in for someone, you do the work or task that they normally do because they are unable to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 那算不上什么事业，她只不过是在嫁人之前打发一下时间而已。
ext.ext_en: That's not a career. She's just filling in time until she gets married.

defs.def_en: See also:fill;If you are filling in time, you are using time that is available by doing something that is not very important.

ext.ext_cn: 仔细填写申请表，并且保存副本。
ext.ext_en: Fill out the application carefully, and keep copies of it.

defs.def_en: If you fill out a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

ext.ext_cn: 女孩子在长足个头之前可能会发胖。
ext.ext_en: A girl may fill out before she reaches her full height.

defs.def_en: If a fairly thin person fills out, they become fatter.

ext.ext_cn: 用碳水化合物含量高、脂肪含量低的土豆、面包和意大利面食填饱肚子。
ext.ext_en: Fill up on potatoes, bread and pasta, which are high in carbohydrate and low in fat...

ext.ext_cn: 一个人如果感觉舒心，就不必去胡吃海塞。
ext.ext_en: When you are happy about yourself you won't need to fill yourself up with food.

defs.def_en: If you fill up or fill yourself up with food, you eat so much that you do not feel hungry.

ext.ext_cn: 吃土豆容易让我们有一种饱胀感，又不会摄入过多的热量。
ext.ext_en: Potatoes fill us up without overloading us with calories.

defs.def_en: See also:fill 1;2;6;A type of food that fills you up makes you feel that you have eaten a lot, even though you have only eaten a small amount.

ext.ext_cn: 一道古老的罗马时代的高架渠
ext.ext_en: ...an old Roman aqueduct.

defs.def_en: An aqueduct is a long bridge with many arches, which carries a water supply or a canal over a valley.

ext.ext_cn: 将水输送到该国干旱地区的全国性导水系统
ext.ext_en: ...a nationwide system of aqueducts to carry water to the arid parts of this country.

defs.def_en: An aqueduct is a large pipe or canal which carries a water supply to a city or a farming area.

defs.def_cn: (人)领工资的，带薪的;（工作）支付工资的

ext.ext_cn: 妇女涌入工薪大军之中
ext.ext_en: ...the influx of women into the waged workforce...

ext.ext_cn: 他们想要稳定的、有工资的工作。
ext.ext_en: They want secure, waged employment.

defs.def_en: Waged workers receive money regularly for doing a job. Waged work is work that you are paid to do.

defs.def_cn: 悄悄地走;小心翼翼地走

ext.ext_cn: 一个年轻人悄悄走向我说道，“我可以帮你吗？”
ext.ext_en: A young man sidled up to me and said, 'May I help you?'

ext.ext_cn: 他悄悄地走进酒吧，显然不想引起注意。
ext.ext_en: He was sidling into the bar, obviously trying to be inconspicuous.

defs.def_en: If you sidle somewhere, you walk there in a quiet or cautious way, as if you do not want anyone to notice you.

ext.ext_cn: 他们给他提供了一个同他资历相当的职位。
ext.ext_en: They offered him a post befitting his seniority and experience...

ext.ext_cn: 他文笔优美，适合当诗人。
ext.ext_en: He writes beautifully, as befits a poet.

defs.def_en: If something befits a person or thing, it is suitable or appropriate for them.

defs.def_cn: (尤指家人去世或病重时批准的)私事假，丧假
defs.def_en: Compassionate leave is time away from your work that your employer allows you for personal reasons, especially when a member of your family dies or is seriously ill.
A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.
A health care worker is someone who works in a hospital or health centre.

ext.ext_cn: 我不随便跟别人上床。
ext.ext_en: I don't sleep around.

ext.ext_cn: 到处跟其他女人鬼混的酒鬼丈夫
ext.ext_en: ...a drunken husband who slept around with other women.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone sleeps around, you disapprove of them because they have sex with a lot of different people.
Pecans or pecan nuts are nuts with a thin, smooth shell that grow on trees in the southern United States and central America and that you can eat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是一个极好的伴侣，她对我慷慨大方，一心只为我着想。
ext.ext_en: She was a wonderful companion and her generosity to me was entirely selfless...

ext.ext_cn: 或许唯一持久无私的爱就是母爱。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps the only all-enduring and selfless love was that of a mother for her child.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is selfless, you approve of them because they care about other people more than themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 患健忘症的人不会忘记关于物体的一些基本知识。
ext.ext_en: People suffering from amnesia don't forget their general knowledge of objects.

defs.def_en: If someone is suffering from amnesia, they have lost their memory.

defs.def_cn: （受雇于名人的）新闻发言人，宣传员

ext.ext_cn: 这位童星的新闻发言人说：“他不会就这些事情向媒体发表观点。”
ext.ext_en: The child actor's press agent says: 'He does not talk to the press on such matters.'

defs.def_en: A press agent is a person who is employed by a famous person to give information about that person to the press.

defs.def_cn: 园林设计师；园林建筑师
defs.def_en: A landscape gardener is a person who designs gardens or parks so that they look attractive.
Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

ext.ext_cn: 这些疾病的机理极其复杂。
ext.ext_en: The biology of these diseases is terribly complicated.

ext.ext_cn: 人体生命机理
ext.ext_en: ...human biology.

defs.def_en: The biology of a living thing is the way in which its body or cells behave.

ext.ext_cn: 漫天大雪、猛烈的冻雨和大风
ext.ext_en: ...blinding snow, driving sleet and wind.

defs.def_en: Sleet is rain that is partly frozen.
A bridle is a set of straps that is put around a horse's head and mouth so that the person riding or driving the horse can control it.

ext.ext_cn: 她愤怒地昂起了头，然后就坚决地摇了摇头。
ext.ext_en: She bridled, then simply shook her head...

ext.ext_cn: 亚历克斯对帕梅拉的简慢语气很生气。
ext.ext_en: Alex bridled at the shortness of Pamela's tone.

defs.def_en: If you bridle, you show that you are angry or offended by moving your head and body upwards in a proud way.

defs.def_cn: （庆祝重大日子或事件的）游行行列

ext.ext_cn: 阅兵队列沿宾夕法尼亚大道缓慢而庄严地行进。
ext.ext_en: A military parade marched slowly and solemnly down Pennsylvania Avenue.

defs.def_en: A parade is a procession of people or vehicles moving through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event.

ext.ext_cn: 逾4,000名陆、海、空三军将士在香榭丽舍大街游行。
ext.ext_en: More than four thousand soldiers, sailors and airmen paraded down the Champs Elysee...

ext.ext_cn: 大家开始成群结队地返回村庄。
ext.ext_en: Everybody was beginning to parade back to the village.

defs.def_en: When people parade somewhere, they walk together in a formal group or a line, usually with other people watching them.

ext.ext_cn: 他让他们早晨6点列队接受检阅。
ext.ext_en: He had them on parade at six o'clock in the morning...

ext.ext_cn: 阅兵场正在进行早间检阅。
ext.ext_en: Morning parade was in progress on the parade ground.

defs.def_en: Parade is a formal occasion when soldiers stand in lines to be seen by an officer or important person, or march in a group.

ext.ext_cn: 宗教节日期间，人们打着横幅在教堂间游行。
ext.ext_en: Banners were paraded from church to church on feast days.

defs.def_en: If flags or statues are paraded, they are carried in a procession.

defs.def_cn: 将（囚犯）游街；将（囚犯）示众

ext.ext_cn: 有5名一流的战斗机飞行员被俘，并被在媒体上曝光。
ext.ext_en: Five leading fighter pilots have been captured and paraded before the media.

defs.def_en: If prisoners are paraded through the streets of a town or on television, they are shown to the public, usually in order to make the people who are holding them seem more powerful or important.

ext.ext_cn: 为了拉选票，孩子们被拉去和政党领袖们一起出现在电视上。
ext.ext_en: Children are paraded on television alongside the party leaders to win votes.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone parades a person, you mean that they show that person to others only in order to gain some advantage for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 瓦伦蒂诺喜欢看名人在重大场合展示他设计的服装。
ext.ext_en: Valentino is keen to see celebrities parading his clothes at big occasions.

defs.def_en: If people parade something, they show it in public so that it can be admired.

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢穿着泳衣在海滩上招摇而行。
ext.ext_en: I love to put on a bathing suit and parade on the beach...

ext.ext_cn: 他们跳着舞，四下招摇。
ext.ext_en: They danced and paraded around.

defs.def_en: If someone parades, they walk about somewhere in order to be seen and admired.

ext.ext_cn: 他们大秀美德并掩盖自己的罪恶。
ext.ext_en: They parade their virtuous beliefs and hide their vices...

ext.ext_cn: 女性被认为不应该赤裸裸地展示其雄心。
ext.ext_en: Women were not supposed to parade their ambition nakedly.

defs.def_en: If someone parades a real or pretended feeling or quality, they draw attention to themselves by displaying it.

ext.ext_cn: 财政大臣就能把他的减息举措当作一场小胜来夸耀了。
ext.ext_en: The Chancellor will be able to parade his cut in interest rates as a small victory...

ext.ext_cn: 她可能已经被吹嘘成一个靠努力工作改变命运的女人了。
ext.ext_en: She might have been paraded as a woman who was working hard to change her ways.

defs.def_en: If you say that something parades as or is paraded as a good or important thing, you mean that some people say that it is good or important but you think it probably is not.

defs.def_cn: （多得似乎没有尽头的）一系列

ext.ext_cn: 我问到尼克的童年生活时，他记起了一个又一个保姆。
ext.ext_en: When I ask Nick about his childhood, he remembers a parade of babysitters.

ext.ext_cn: 没完没了的广告
ext.ext_en: ...an endless parade of advertisements.

defs.def_en: If you talk about a parade of people or things, you mean that there is a series of them that seems never to end.

defs.def_cn: （常指远离大街的）一小排店铺
defs.def_en: A parade is a short row of shops, usually set back from the main street.

ext.ext_cn: 南海克拉伦斯商业街皇后酒店
ext.ext_en: ...Queens Hotel, Clarence Parade, Southsea.

defs.def_en: Parade is used as part of the name of a street.

defs.def_cn: 把…视作要人；把…奉为名人

ext.ext_cn: 到了20世纪20年代，他成为伦敦文学界的宠儿。
ext.ext_en: By the 1920's, he was lionised by literary London...

ext.ext_cn: 媒体开始狂热地吹捧他。
ext.ext_en: The press began to lionize him enthusiastically...

defs.def_en: If someone is lionized, they are treated as if they are very important or special by a particular group of people, often when they do not really deserve to be.

defs.def_cn: （表示愤怒、吃惊或激动，可能具冒犯意味）该死的，要命的
defs.def_en: Some people use goddamn when they are angry, surprised, or excited. This use could cause offence.
A coaster is a small mat that you put underneath a glass or cup to protect the surface of a table.

defs.def_cn: 沿海港口间航行的货船

ext.ext_en: He paused, absorbed by his reflections.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: You use new to describe something which has replaced another thing, for example because you no longer have the old one, or it no longer exists, or it is no longer useful.

ext.ext_en: The next election is for the government to take us into the new century.

defs.def_en: A new day or year is the beginning of the next day or year.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 造成创伤的;惊骇的;痛苦的

ext.ext_cn: 我曾经神经崩溃过。那是一次痛苦的经历。
ext.ext_en: I suffered a nervous breakdown. It was a traumatic experience...

ext.ext_cn: 对孩子来说，一只宠物的死亡可能会造成心理创伤。
ext.ext_en: For a child the death of a pet can be traumatic.

defs.def_en: A traumatic experience is very shocking and upsetting, and may cause psychological damage.

ext.ext_cn: 企业感受到了别处经济衰退带来的间接影响。
ext.ext_en: Businesses are feeling the indirect effects from the recession that's going on elsewhere...

ext.ext_cn: 作为战争的间接后果,数百万人可能会死于饥饿。
ext.ext_en: Millions could die of hunger as an indirect result of the war...

defs.def_en: An indirect result or effect is not caused immediately and obviously by a thing or person, but happens because of something else that they have done.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (路线、行程等)迂回的，非直达的

ext.ext_cn: 这些货物运输时走了一条非常迂回的路线。
ext.ext_en: The goods went by a rather indirect route.

defs.def_en: An indirect route or journey does not use the shortest or easiest way between two places.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (话语或信息)含蓄的,拐弯抹角的

ext.ext_cn: 他的话相当于拐弯抹角地请求经济援助。
ext.ext_en: His remarks amounted to an indirect appeal for economic aid...

ext.ext_cn: 隐晦提到了他的反对者。
ext.ext_en: There were indirect references to his opponent...

defs.def_en: Indirect remarks and information suggest something or refer to it, without actually mentioning it or stating it clearly.

defs.def_cn: 烦人的家伙；讨厌鬼；死鬼
defs.def_en: If you refer to another person as a git, you mean you dislike them and find them annoying.
Stewing steak is beef which is suitable for cooking slowly in a stew.

defs.def_cn: (苏格兰传统扔掷比赛的)长而重的木柱
defs.def_en: A caber is a long, heavy, wooden pole. It is thrown into the air as a test of strength in the traditional Scottish sport called 'tossing the caber'.

ext.ext_cn: 对这些人来说,土地与生活本身有着不可分割的密切关系。
ext.ext_en: For these people, land is inextricably interwoven with life itself...

ext.ext_cn: 在这本布局恢宏的新小说中,错综复杂的家庭关系与一起谋杀阴谋交织在一起。
ext.ext_en: Complex family relationships interweave with a murder plot in this ambitious new novel...

defs.def_en: If two or more things are interwoven or interweave, they are very closely connected or are combined with each other.

defs.def_cn: (主要生长杂草和石南的)高原贫瘠之地，荒野，旷野

ext.ext_cn: 科利福德位置更高，就在荒野之上。
ext.ext_en: Colliford is higher, right up on the moors...

ext.ext_cn: 埃克斯穆尔高地国家公园位于高原贫瘠之地，占地265平方英里。
ext.ext_en: Exmoor National Park stretches over 265 square miles of moor.

defs.def_en: A moor is an area of open and usually high land with poor soil that is covered mainly with grass and heather.

ext.ext_cn: 她把驳船停泊在河右岸。
ext.ext_en: She had moored her barge on the right bank of the river...

ext.ext_cn: 我决定在一些观光船附近停泊。
ext.ext_en: I decided to moor near some tourist boats.

defs.def_en: If you moor a boat somewhere, you stop and tie it to the land with a rope or chain so that it cannot move away.

defs.def_cn: 摩尔人(公元8至15世纪在北非和西班牙建立文明，信奉伊斯兰教)
defs.def_en: The Moors were a Muslim people who established a civilization in North Africa and Spain between the 8th and the 15th century A.D.

ext.ext_cn: 必须把儿童福利摆在首位。
ext.ext_en: The child's welfare must be seen as paramount...

ext.ext_cn: 氮对地球上的生命至关重要。
ext.ext_en: Nitrogen is of paramount importance to life on earth.

defs.def_en: Something that is paramount or of paramount importance  is more important than anything else.

ext.ext_cn: 我将意大利面滤干，然后平分到两个盘子里。
ext.ext_en: I drain the pasta, then I share it out between two plates...

ext.ext_cn: 公司将在 500,000 名保险单持有人中分摊 13 亿美元。
ext.ext_en: The company will share out $1.3 billion among 500,000 policyholders.

defs.def_en: See also:share-out;If you share out an amount of something, you give each person in a group an equal or fair part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 1/4的居民年龄在55岁以上。
ext.ext_en: A quarter of the residents are over 55 years old...

ext.ext_cn: 一刻钟以后我就得走了。
ext.ext_en: I've got to go in a quarter of an hour...

defs.def_en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something.

ext.ext_cn: 该集团表示第三季度的结果将于10月29日公布。
ext.ext_en: The group said results for the third quarter are due on October 29.

defs.def_en: A quarter is a fixed period of three months. Companies often divide their financial year into four quarters.

ext.ext_cn: 当时是6点差一刻。
ext.ext_en: It was a quarter to six...

ext.ext_cn: 8点45分左右再见。
ext.ext_en: See you about quarter to nine...

defs.def_en: When you are telling the time, you use quarter to talk about the fifteen minutes before or after an hour. For example, 8.15 is quarter past eight, and 8.45 is quarter to nine. In American English, you can also say that 8.15 is a quarter after eight and 8.45 is a quarter of nine.

ext.ext_cn: 把蘑菇切成丁，再把西红柿切成四瓣。
ext.ext_en: Chop the mushrooms and quarter the tomatoes.

defs.def_en: If you quarter something such as a fruit or a vegetable, you cut it into four roughly equal parts.

defs.def_cn: 把…降至原先的四分之一;把…减少四分之三

ext.ext_cn: 我之前建议成人服用的剂量可以降到1/2或者1/4。
ext.ext_en: The doses I suggested for adults could be halved or quartered.

defs.def_en: If the number or size of something is quartered, it is reduced to about a quarter of its previous number or size.

ext.ext_cn: 我向付费电话的投币孔里投了一枚25分硬币。
ext.ext_en: I dropped a quarter into the slot of the pay phone.

defs.def_en: A quarter is an American or Canadian coin that is worth 25 cents.

defs.def_cn: (城镇中某一类人群生活或工作的)区，地区

ext.ext_cn: 在法国人居住区寻找旅馆。
ext.ext_en: Look for hotels in the French Quarter.

defs.def_en: A particular quarter of a town is a part of the town where a particular group of people traditionally live or work.

defs.def_cn: (做出反应或行动的)某位人士，某个团体

ext.ext_cn: 援助来自于一个意想不到的团体。
ext.ext_en: Help came from an unexpected quarter...

ext.ext_cn: 某些人士担心共和国独立支撑下去的希望很渺茫。
ext.ext_en: There are fears in some quarters that the republic would have little chance of surviving on its own.

defs.def_en: To refer to a person or group you may not want to name, you can talk about the reactions or actions from a particular quarter .

defs.def_cn: (军人、水手、仆人的)住处，宿舍，营房

ext.ext_cn: 麦金农走下甲板，来到军官们的住处。
ext.ext_en: Mckinnon went down from deck to the officers' quarters.

defs.def_en: The rooms provided for soldiers, sailors, or servants to live in are called their quarters .

ext.ext_cn: 我们的士兵在佩列杰利基诺扎营。
ext.ext_en: Our soldiers are quartered in Peredelkino.

defs.def_en: If people are quartered somewhere, they are provided with accommodation for a short time, usually while they are working away from home.

defs.def_cn: 近距离地;近在咫尺；接近地

ext.ext_cn: 你可以近距离观察飞机的起降。
ext.ext_en: You can watch aircraft take off or land at close quarters...

defs.def_en: If you do something at close quarters, you do it very near to a particular person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 这并不是你所了解的战争。它残酷无情，对人没有半点怜悯。
ext.ext_en: This is not war as you learned it. It is brutal work, with no quarter given.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone was given no quarter, you mean that they were not treated kindly by someone who had power or control over them.

ext.ext_cn: 在法国，欠发达的农村地区说方言。
ext.ext_en: In France patois was spoken in rural, less developed regions.

defs.def_en: A patois is a form of a language, especially French, that is spoken in a particular area of a country.

ext.ext_cn: 人口中有一大部分说以法语为基础的混合语。
ext.ext_en: A substantial proportion of the population speak a French-based patois.

defs.def_en: A patois is a language that has developed from a mixture of other languages.

defs.def_cn: （尤指饲养牛、马、羊等的）大农场，大牧场

ext.ext_cn: 他在澳大利亚靠一个牧牛场为生。
ext.ext_en: He lives on a cattle ranch in Australia.

defs.def_en: See also:dude ranch;A ranch is a large farm used for raising animals, especially cattle, horses, or sheep.
A tea shop is a small restaurant where tea, coffee, cakes, sandwiches, and light meals are served.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Someone who is dissolute does not care at all about morals and lives in a way that is considered to be wicked and immoral.

ext.ext_cn: 据我们调查,八分之一的女性不能生育。
ext.ext_en: According to one survey, one woman in eight is infertile.

defs.def_en: A person or animal that is infertile is unable to produce babies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 被污染的废物经常被随意倒掉,周边土地因此而变得很贫瘠。
ext.ext_en: The polluted waste is often dumped, making the surrounding land infertile.

defs.def_en: Infertile soil is of poor quality so that plants cannot grow in it.

ext.ext_cn: 她把自己一时出轨的先后经过一五一十地告诉了他。
ext.ext_en: She gave him a factual account of the chronology of her brief liaison.

defs.def_en: The chronology of a series of past events is the times at which they happened and the order in which they happened.

ext.ext_cn: 达菲这本书中的第二部分按时间顺序对宗教改革运动进行了详细记录。
ext.ext_en: The second part of Duffy's book is a detailed chronology of the Reformation.

defs.def_en: A chronology is an account or record of the times and the order in which a series of past events took place.

defs.def_cn: （通常指女性参加的）非正式的社交聚会，咖啡聚会
defs.def_en: A coffee klatch or Kaffee Klatsch is an informal social event at which people, usually women, talk and drink coffee.

ext.ext_cn: 他左手摸索着门把手，转动一下，然后推开门。
ext.ext_en: With his left hand he groped for the knob, turned it, and pulled the door open...

ext.ext_cn: 邦伯里手伸进前胸口袋里摸索钱包。
ext.ext_en: Bunbury groped in his breast pocket for his wallet.

defs.def_en: If you grope for something that you cannot see, you try to find it by moving your hands around in order to feel it.

ext.ext_cn: 我没有开灯，而是一路摸黑走过房间。
ext.ext_en: I didn't  turn on the light, but groped my way across the room.

defs.def_en: If you grope your way to a place, you move there, holding your hands in front of you and feeling the way because you cannot see anything.

ext.ext_cn: 他在探求国家所面临问题的解决办法。
ext.ext_en: He groped for solutions to the problems facing the country...

ext.ext_cn: 她想找个简单的词来表达简单的想法。
ext.ext_en: She groped for a simple word to express a simple idea.

defs.def_en: If you grope for something, for example the solution to a problem, you try to think of it, when you have no real idea what it could be.

ext.ext_cn: 他会试图摸她的胸部，还把手从她的裙子上向上移。
ext.ext_en: He would try to grope her breasts and put his hand up her skirt.

ext.ext_cn: 她甚至吹嘘曾和一个13岁的男孩在衣橱里有过肌肤之亲。
ext.ext_en: She even boasted of having a grope in a cupboard with a 13-year-old.

defs.def_en: If one person gropes another, they touch or take hold of them in a rough, sexual way.

defs.def_cn: 加紧工作;加强管理;严格要求

ext.ext_cn: 我要求我们这次要更加理智、更加严格要求自己。
ext.ext_en: I want us to be a bit more sensible this time and tighten up.

defs.def_en: See also:tighten 4;6;If a group, team, or organization tightens up, they make an effort to control what they are doing more closely, in order to become more efficient and successful.

ext.ext_cn: 他去年不幸逝世。
ext.ext_en: He unfortunately passed away last year.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone passed away to mean that they died, if you want to avoid using the word 'die' because you think it might upset or offend people.

ext.ext_cn: 上个月销售额上升了0.4％。
ext.ext_en: Sales rose by nought point four per cent last month...

ext.ext_cn: 房屋按照能耗标准划分为0至10级。
ext.ext_en: Houses are graded from nought to ten for energy efficiency...

defs.def_en: Nought is the number 0.

ext.ext_cn: 无数次劝他写回忆录的尝试均以失败告终。
ext.ext_en: Numerous attempts to persuade him to write his memoirs came to nought.

defs.def_en: If you try to do something but your efforts are not successful, you can say that your efforts come to nought .

ext.ext_cn: 约翰不断遭到父亲身体和心理上的双重虐待。
ext.ext_en: John received constant physical and psychological abuse from his father...

ext.ext_cn: 罗宾的失忆是心理问题，而非生理问题。
ext.ext_en: Robyn's loss of memory is a psychological problem, rather than a physical one.

defs.def_en: Psychological means concerned with a person's mind and thoughts.

ext.ext_cn: 心理测试
ext.ext_en: ...psychological testing.

defs.def_en: Psychological means relating to psychology.

ext.ext_cn: 在非洲传播关于艾滋病方面的知识耗时数年。
ext.ext_en: It took years to disseminate information about Aids in Africa...

ext.ext_cn: 他们散布反对法国的宣传资料。
ext.ext_en: They disseminated anti-French propaganda.

defs.def_en: To disseminate information or knowledge means to distribute it so that it reaches many people or organizations.

ext.ext_cn: 就算仅仅是为了以防万一，难道他就不能挪到安全的地方吗？
ext.ext_en: Could he not, just as a precaution, move to a place of safety?...

ext.ext_cn: 我已在离开伦敦前进行了准备，做了些调查研究。
ext.ext_en: I had taken the precaution of doing a little research before I left London...

defs.def_en: A precaution is an action that is intended to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant from happening.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不平坦的;不平滑的;凹凸不平的;参差不齐的

ext.ext_cn: 他摇摇晃晃地行走在停车场凹凸不平的地面上。
ext.ext_en: He staggered on the uneven surface of the car park...

ext.ext_cn: 她四下打量了一番教堂凹凸不平的灰色墙壁和色彩鲜艳的彩色玻璃窗。
ext.ext_en: She gazed round the church at the grey uneven walls and the vivid stained glass windows.

defs.def_en: An uneven surface or edge is not smooth, flat, or straight.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他能听到她的呼吸不均匀。
ext.ext_en: He could hear that her breathing was uneven...

ext.ext_cn: 小孩子现在的问题是成长速度不均衡。他们被迫变得比自己的实际年龄老成。
ext.ext_en: What kids experience now is an uneven rate of development. They are forced to be older than their years.

defs.def_en: Something that is uneven is not regular or consistent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对他而言，这场演出时好时坏，很是奇怪。
ext.ext_en: This was, for him, an oddly uneven performance...

ext.ext_cn: 演技起伏极大。
ext.ext_en: The acting is wildly uneven.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as uneven, you think it is not very good because it is not consistent in quality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 其中一些灾民大声地抱怨紧急援助物资分配不公。
ext.ext_en: Some of the victims are complaining loudly about the uneven distribution of emergency aid...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一场不公平的竞赛。
ext.ext_en: It was an uneven contest.

defs.def_en: An uneven system or situation is unfairly arranged or organized.

ext.ext_cn: 气得快要发疯
ext.ext_en: ...a fury that verged on madness...

ext.ext_cn: 她讲话的声音近乎可笑。
ext.ext_en: Her speaking voice verges on the ridiculous.

defs.def_en: If someone or something verges on a particular state or quality, they are almost the same as that state or quality.

defs.def_cn: 推车儿(指狂热的观鸟爱好者)
defs.def_en: A twitcher is an enthusiastic bird-watcher.

defs.def_cn: 无与伦比的；无可匹敌的

ext.ext_cn: 像马加拉夫和阿雷纳尔这样的度假胜地，在价格方面仍具有绝对的优势。
ext.ext_en: These resorts, like Magaluf and Arenal, remain unbeatable in terms of price.

ext.ext_cn: 无与伦比的意大利汽车
ext.ext_en: ...unbeatable Italian cars.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unbeatable, you mean that it is the best thing of its kind.

ext.ext_cn: 对手实力超群。
ext.ext_en: The opposition was unbeatable...

ext.ext_cn: 还有两个比赛日，中国队的位置已经不可撼动。
ext.ext_en: With two more days of competition to go China is in an unbeatable position.

defs.def_en: In a game or competition, if you describe a person or team as unbeatable, you mean that they win so often, or perform so well that they are unlikely to be beaten by anyone.

ext.ext_cn: 设在商场内的银行业务
ext.ext_en: ...in-store banking.

ext.ext_cn: 设在超市内的面包店
ext.ext_en: ...an instore bakery.

defs.def_en: In-store facilities are facilities that are available within a department store, supermarket or other large shop.

ext.ext_cn: 瓷砖
ext.ext_en: ...ceramic tiles.

ext.ext_cn: 手绘瓷砖制品
ext.ext_en: ...items made from hand-painted ceramic.

defs.def_en: Ceramic is clay that has been heated to a very high temperature so that it becomes hard.

ext.ext_cn: 一批中国陶瓷
ext.ext_en: ...a collection of Chinese ceramics.

defs.def_en: Ceramics are ceramic ornaments or objects.
Ceramics is the art of making artistic objects out of clay.

defs.def_cn: (政府的)部，司，局，处;(企业的)部门，科;(大学的)系，所;(大型商店的)货品区

ext.ext_cn: 美国卫生、教育和福利部
ext.ext_en: ...the U.S. Department of Health, Education and Welfare...

ext.ext_cn: 他转到了销售部。
ext.ext_en: He moved to the sales department.

defs.def_en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university. A department is also one of the sections in a large shop.

defs.def_cn: 不是…的职责（或知识）范围;并非…的专长

ext.ext_cn: “恐怕这个名字对我来说毫无意义，”他说，“我对此并不熟悉。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'm afraid the name means nothing to me,' he said. 'That's not my department.'

defs.def_en: If you say that a task or area of knowledge is not your department, you mean that you are not responsible for it or do not know much about it.

ext.ext_cn: 我并没有一直在看奥运会，当时只是恰好换到这个频道。
ext.ext_en: I just happened to switch over although I haven't been watching the Olympics...

ext.ext_cn: 换到 4 频道吧。
ext.ext_en: Let's switch over to Channel 4.

defs.def_en: If you switch over when you are watching television, you change to another channel.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个湖里鱼很多。
ext.ext_en: Fish are plentiful in the lake.

ext.ext_cn: 蔬菜、色拉和水果的充分供应
ext.ext_en: ...a plentiful supply of vegetables and salads and fruits.

defs.def_en: Things that are plentiful exist in such large amounts or numbers that there is enough for people's wants or needs.
A draft dodger is someone who avoids joining the armed forces when normally they would have to join.

defs.def_cn: 未删节的；未节略的；足本的；完整的

ext.ext_cn: 《战争与和平》的全本
ext.ext_en: ...the unabridged version of 'War and Peace'.

defs.def_en: An unabridged piece of writing, for example a book or article, is complete and not shortened in any way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 傻笑
ext.ext_en: ...a goofy smile.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as goofy, you think they are rather silly or ridiculous.

ext.ext_cn: 他头几个月的行程都是边走边画，不期然间竟然到了都柏林。
ext.ext_en: He spent the first few months on a walking and sketching tour, before fetching up in Dublin.

defs.def_en: If you fetch up somewhere, you arrive there, especially when you have not planned to go there.

ext.ext_cn: 战争的残酷
ext.ext_en: ...the inhumanity of war.

ext.ext_cn: 人施加于同类的凶残
ext.ext_en: ...man's inhumanity to man.

defs.def_en: You can describe extremely cruel actions as inhumanity .

defs.def_cn: （书、戏剧、电影或故事中品行端正的）女主角，女主人公

ext.ext_cn: 女主角是一名电视台的高级主管。
ext.ext_en: The heroine is a senior TV executive.

defs.def_en: The heroine of a book, play, film, or story is the main female character, who usually has good qualities.

ext.ext_cn: 现今的民族英雄是在该运动会上获得首枚金牌的邢芬。
ext.ext_en: The national heroine of the day was Xing Fen, winner of the first Gold medal of the Games.

defs.def_en: A heroine is a woman who has done something brave, new, or good, and who is therefore greatly admired by a lot of people.

ext.ext_cn: 我心目中的偶像是伊丽莎白·泰勒。
ext.ext_en: My heroine was Elizabeth Taylor.

defs.def_en: If you describe a woman as your heroine, you mean that you admire her greatly, usually because of a particular quality or skill that she has.

ext.ext_cn: 她的房子有两间向阳的带落地窗的大屋子。
ext.ext_en: Her house has two big sunlit rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows.

defs.def_en: Sunlit places are brightly lit by the sun.

defs.def_cn: (两个或多个组织共同协作后产生的)协同增效作用,协同作用

ext.ext_cn: 当然，这两家公司间非常明显地产生了巨大的协同效应。
ext.ext_en: Of course, there's quite obviously a lot of synergy between the two companies...

ext.ext_cn: 皮雷利声称，合并带来的协同作用将在未来 4 年内节省约 1.3 亿英镑的开支。
ext.ext_en: The synergies gained from the merger, Pirelli claimed, would create savings of about £130m over four years.

defs.def_en: If there is synergy between two or more organizations or groups, they are more successful when they work together than when they work separately.

ext.ext_cn: 身穿制服的警察
ext.ext_en: ...uniformed policemen.

defs.def_en: If you use uniformed to describe someone who does a particular job, you mean that they are wearing a uniform.

defs.def_cn: (问题或想法)大量涌现，涌入脑海

ext.ext_cn: 所有事一齐涌上我的心头。
ext.ext_en: Everything is crowding in on me...

ext.ext_cn: 她想睡觉，但头脑中想法不断涌现，画面一一闪现。
ext.ext_en: She tried to sleep, but thoughts crowded in and images flashed into her mind.

defs.def_en: If problems or thoughts crowd in on you, a lot of them happen to you or affect you at the same time, so that they occupy all your attention and make you feel unable to escape.

ext.ext_cn: “谢罪的礼物，”罗伯茨说着递给科恩一盒雪茄。
ext.ext_en: 'A peace offering,' Roberts said as he handed the box of cigars to Cohen.

defs.def_en: You can use peace offering to refer to something that you give someone to show that you want to end the quarrel between you.

defs.def_cn: 预提税；预扣税；代扣所得税
defs.def_en: A withholding tax is an amount of money that is taken in advance from someone's income, in order to pay some of the tax they will owe.

ext.ext_cn: 把直线运动改成旋转运动
ext.ext_en: ...turning linear into rotary motion.

ext.ext_cn: 重型旋转桨叶
ext.ext_en: ...heavy-duty rotary blades.

defs.def_en: Rotary means turning or able to turn round a fixed point.

ext.ext_cn: 转缸式发动机
ext.ext_en: ...a rotary engine.

defs.def_en: Rotary is used in the names of some machines that have parts that turn round a fixed point.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 从下面经过的倒霉蛋儿很容易受重伤。
ext.ext_en: Some unfortunate person passing below could all too easily be seriously injured...

ext.ext_cn: 他显然不幸落入了一群歹徒之手。
ext.ext_en: Apparently he had been unfortunate enough to fall victim to a gang of thugs...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as unfortunate, you mean that something unpleasant or unlucky has happened to them. You can also describe the unpleasant things that happen to them as unfortunate .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不恰当的；尴尬的；棘手的

ext.ext_cn: 刚才竟发生这样的事儿，实在是太不合时宜了。
ext.ext_en: It really is desperately unfortunate that this should have happened just now.

ext.ext_cn: 加拿大国旗挂颠倒这种尴尬事儿
ext.ext_en: ...the unfortunate incident of the upside-down Canadian flag...

defs.def_en: If you describe something that has happened as unfortunate, you think that it is inappropriate, embarrassing, awkward, or undesirable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 穷困潦倒的；生活艰难的

ext.ext_cn: 每年我们都有慈善日来筹款帮助贫困人群。
ext.ext_en: Every year we have charity days to raise money for unfortunate people.

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦东区贫民窟穷困潦倒的居民
ext.ext_en: ...the unfortunate inhabitants of the East End slums.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone as unfortunate when they are poor or have a difficult life.
Fruit flies are very small flies which eat fruit and rotting plants.
Simple interest is interest that is calculated on an original sum of money and not also on interest which has previously been added to the sum.

ext.ext_cn: 荨麻扎了他们的腿。
ext.ext_en: The nettles stung their legs...

ext.ext_cn: 我像被蝎子蜇了似的跳了起来。
ext.ext_en: I jumped as if I had been stung by a scorpion...

defs.def_en: If a plant, animal, or insect stings you, a sharp part of it, usually covered with poison, is pushed into your skin so that you feel a sharp pain.

ext.ext_cn: 用镊子拔掉蜜蜂的螫刺。
ext.ext_en: Remove the bee sting with tweezers.

defs.def_en: The sting of an insect or animal is the part that stings you.

ext.ext_cn: 这不痛——你只会感觉到像被轻轻叮了一下。
ext.ext_en: This won't hurt — you will just feel a little sting.

defs.def_en: If you feel a sting, you feel a sharp pain in your skin or other part of your body.

ext.ext_cn: 刺骨的寒风吹得他脸颊生疼。
ext.ext_en: His cheeks were stinging from the icy wind...

ext.ext_cn: 千万不要将任何精油抹到眼睛周围。它们有很强的刺激性，可能会使眼睛产生刺痛感。
ext.ext_en: Never put any essential oils near the eyes. They are very strong and could sting...

defs.def_en: If a part of your body stings, or if a substance stings it, you feel a sharp pain there.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个敏感的小伙子，有些批评刺痛了他。
ext.ext_en: He's a sensitive lad and some of the criticism has stung him...

ext.ext_cn: 他那番严厉无情的话让她伤心得大哭起来。
ext.ext_en: She burst into tears, stung by the harshness of his words.

defs.def_en: If someone's remarks sting you, they make you feel hurt and annoyed.

defs.def_cn: (警方为抓捕罪犯精心设计的)圈套

ext.ext_cn: 警方展开诱捕行动以严打非法枪支。
ext.ext_en: The police ran a sting operation to crack down on illegal guns.

ext.ext_cn: 美国联邦调查局设下的圈套
ext.ext_en: ...a sting set by the FBI.

defs.def_en: A sting is a clever secret plan carried out by the police in order to catch criminals.

defs.def_cn: 煞风景的结局;令人不愉快的结尾
defs.def_en: If an announcement or decision has a sting in the tail or a sting in its tail, it contains a critical and unpleasant part, normally at the end.
If something takes the sting out of a situation, it makes it less unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 获取准确信息的难题
ext.ext_en: ...the difficulty of getting accurate information...

ext.ext_cn: 该国正面临巨大的经济困难。
ext.ext_en: The country is facing great economic difficulties.

defs.def_en: A difficulty is a problem.

ext.ext_cn: 你能站起来吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you have difficulty getting up?...

ext.ext_cn: 受伤的男子艰难地上了马。
ext.ext_en: The injured man mounted his horse with difficulty.

defs.def_en: If you have difficulty doing something, you are not able to do it easily.

ext.ext_cn: 你不得不承认，你事实上是陷入了困境。
ext.ext_en: You have to admit that you are, in fact, in difficulties...

ext.ext_cn: 有传闻称银行现在处境艰难。
ext.ext_en: Rumours spread about banks being in difficulty.

defs.def_en: If you are in difficulty or in difficulties, you are having a lot of problems.

defs.def_cn: 水印（常用于钞票上以防伪）
defs.def_en: See also:high-water mark;A watermark is a design which is put into paper when it is made, and which you can only see if you hold the paper up to the light. Banknotes often have a watermark, to make them harder to copy illegally.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得蹲监狱对于哈里会是件很可怕的事。
ext.ext_en: I think prison is going to be a scary thing for Harry...

ext.ext_cn: 他身上有某种东西让人不寒而栗。
ext.ext_en: There's something very scary about him...

defs.def_en: Something that is scary is rather frightening.

ext.ext_cn: 牢狱生活让他变得残忍粗暴。
ext.ext_en: He was brutalized by the experience of being in prison.

defs.def_en: If an unpleasant experience brutalizes someone, it makes them cruel or violent.

ext.ext_cn: 一个虐待奴役他人的15世纪的探险者
ext.ext_en: ... a 15th century explorer who brutalized people and enslaved them.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个残暴对待自己的人民的人。
ext.ext_en: Here's a man who has brutalized his own people...

defs.def_en: If one person brutalizes another, they treat them in a cruel or violent way.

ext.ext_cn: 二氧化碳等气体的排放应该稳定在当前水平。
ext.ext_en: The emission of gases such as carbon dioxide should be stabilised at their present level...

ext.ext_cn: 炼钢厂排放出的硫形成了酸雨。
ext.ext_en: Sulfur emissions from steel mills become acid rain.

defs.def_en: An emission of something such as gas or radiation is the release of it into the atmosphere.

defs.def_cn: 怀特霍尔(伦敦一街名，许多政府机关所在地)；白厅(指英国政府)

ext.ext_cn: 打着标语在怀特霍尔街上行进的人们
ext.ext_en: ...people with banners marching down Whitehall...

ext.ext_cn: 英国政府称将有望在6月底前彻底完成变革。
ext.ext_en: Whitehall said that it hoped to get the change through by the end of June.

defs.def_en: Whitehall is the name of a street in London in which there are many government offices. You can also use Whitehall to mean the British Government itself.
Racegoers are people who regularly go to watch horse races.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可疑的;靠不住的;暧昧的

ext.ext_cn: 在我们看来这种说法非常可疑。
ext.ext_en: This claim seems to us to be rather dubious...

ext.ext_cn: 索霍区仍然是个靠不住的地方。
ext.ext_en: Soho was still a highly dubious area...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as dubious, you mean that you do not consider it to be completely honest, safe, or reliable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 怀疑的;无把握的;迟疑的;拿不准的

ext.ext_cn: 我父母起初对此心存疑虑,但是我们很快就让他们信服了。
ext.ext_en: My parents were dubious about it at first but we soon convinced them.

defs.def_en: If you are dubious about something, you are not completely sure about it and have not yet made up your mind about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （荣誉、名声等）不好的,不光彩的

ext.ext_cn: 纳吉作为第一个以这种方式被禁赛的运动员而“出名”。
ext.ext_en: Nagy has the dubious honour of being the first athlete to be banned in this way...

ext.ext_cn: 萨尔瓦多因是美洲大陆土壤侵蚀最严重的地方而有了这份不光彩的名声。
ext.ext_en: El Salvador has earned the dubious distinction of having the worst soil erosion in continental America.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has the dubious honour or the dubious pleasure of doing something, you are indicating that what they are doing is not an honour or pleasure at all, but is, in fact, unpleasant or bad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有关他对女王不敬的指责
ext.ext_en: ...accusations that he had been disrespectful to the Queen...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不能这样无礼地对待亲生母亲。
ext.ext_en: They shouldn't treat their mother in this disrespectful way.

defs.def_en: If you are disrespectful, you show no respect in the way that you speak or behave to someone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她生活俭朴。
ext.ext_en: She lives a frugal life.

defs.def_en: People who are frugal or who live frugal lives do not eat much or spend much money on themselves.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 饮食很简单：奶酪、水、米饭、豆类。
ext.ext_en: The diet was frugal: cheese and water, rice and beans.

defs.def_en: A frugal meal is small and not expensive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 含糊不清的;不明确的;模棱两可的

ext.ext_cn: 这份协议非常含糊，可以有多种解释。
ext.ext_en: This agreement is very ambiguous and open to various interpretations...

ext.ext_cn: 外交大臣的话对本周较早时候发表的一份模棱两可的声明作出了澄清。
ext.ext_en: The Foreign Secretary's remarks clarify an ambiguous statement issued earlier this week.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ambiguous, you mean that it is unclear or confusing because it can be understood in more than one way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 暧昧不清的；不协调的；捉摸不定的

ext.ext_cn: 学生们对于自己在这个世界上的角色认识模糊不清。
ext.ext_en: Students have ambiguous feelings about their role in the world.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ambiguous, you mean that it contains several different ideas or attitudes that do not fit well together.

ext.ext_cn: 他的与众不同之处不光是他的身高。
ext.ext_en: It's more than his physical stature that makes him remarkable...

ext.ext_cn: 母亲身材矮小，只有 5 英尺高。
ext.ext_en: Mother was of very small stature, barely five feet tall...

defs.def_en: Someone's stature is their height.

ext.ext_cn: 谁能否认他是世界上最伟大的大提琴演奏家呢？
ext.ext_en: Who can deny his stature as the world's greatest cellist?...

ext.ext_cn: 这家俱乐部在过去 20 年间知名度大增。
ext.ext_en: This club has grown in stature over the last 20 years.

defs.def_en: The stature of a person is the importance and reputation that they have.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不折不扣的保守派
ext.ext_en: ...a thoroughgoing conservative.

ext.ext_cn: 对这种十足的物质主义不满的读者
ext.ext_en: ...readers who are unhappy with such thoroughgoing materialism.

defs.def_en: You use thoroughgoing to emphasize that someone or something is fully or completely the type of person or thing specified.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对监狱环境的一次彻底检查
ext.ext_en: ...a thoroughgoing review of prison conditions.

ext.ext_cn: 这本内容极其详尽的传记
ext.ext_en: ...this splendidly thoroughgoing biography.

defs.def_en: If you describe a piece of work as thoroughgoing, you approve of it because it has been carefully and thoroughly put together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （某人的行为）机会主义的，投机取巧的

ext.ext_cn: 该党很多成员只是抱着投机取巧的心理才加入其中的。
ext.ext_en: Many of the party's members joined only for opportunistic reasons.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as opportunistic, you are critical of them because they take advantage of situations in order to gain money or power, without thinking about whether their actions are right or wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 该党因私下接受捐赠而蒙羞。
ext.ext_en: The Party is being degraded by its acceptance of secret donations...

ext.ext_cn: 我寄给他们6,000多幅漫画，最后才有1幅得以采用。
ext.ext_en: I sent them more than 6,000 cartoons before I had my one and only acceptance by them...

defs.def_en: Acceptance of an offer or a proposal is the act of saying yes to it or agreeing to it.

ext.ext_cn: 逐步得到承认的理论
ext.ext_en: ...a theory that is steadily gaining acceptance...

ext.ext_cn: 人们普遍相信国防预算将会缩减。
ext.ext_en: There was a general acceptance that the defence budget would shrink.

defs.def_en: If there is acceptance of an idea, most people believe or agree that it is true.

ext.ext_cn: 国家主义者的一个早期目标是推动民众对权威的接受。
ext.ext_en: Popular acceptance of authority had been an early aim of the Nationalists.

ext.ext_cn: 他遇事泰然处之的态度
ext.ext_en: ...his calm acceptance of whatever comes his way.

defs.def_en: Your acceptance of a situation, especially an unpleasant or difficult one, is an attitude or feeling that you cannot change it and that you must get used to it.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车制造商们已经开始生产少量的电动车辆以测试顾客的接受程度。
ext.ext_en: Car manufacturers are already producing small numbers of electric vehicles to test customer acceptance...

ext.ext_cn: 先锋音乐时至今日都没有得到大众的广泛认可。
ext.ext_en: Avant-garde music to this day has not found general public acceptance.

defs.def_en: If there is acceptance of a new product, people start to like it and get used to it.

ext.ext_cn: 为确保残疾人真正得到接纳而作出的努力
ext.ext_en: ...an effort to ensure that the disabled achieve real acceptance.

defs.def_en: Acceptance of someone into a group means beginning to think of them as part of the group and to act in a friendly way towards them.

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪80年代美国出口影片把欧洲影片挤出了市场。
ext.ext_en: In the 1980s American exports crowded out European films.

defs.def_en: If one thing crowds out another, it is so successful or common that the other thing does not have the opportunity to be successful or exist.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （表面或物体）柔软的，易弯曲的，易变形的

ext.ext_cn: 松软的土地
ext.ext_en: ...the yielding ground.

ext.ext_cn: 柔软的靠垫
ext.ext_en: ...the soft yielding cushions.

defs.def_en: A yielding surface or object is quite soft and will move or bend rather than staying stiff if you put pressure on it.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为开发只是一个借口，目的其实是想开采周围农村地区的资源。
ext.ext_en: I think the development is a stalking horse for exploitation of the surrounding countryside.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or thing as a stalking horse, you mean that it is being used to obtain a temporary advantage so that someone can get what they really want.

defs.def_cn: (政治竞争中为摸清对手实力而推出的)掩护性候选人

ext.ext_cn: 今年秋季可能会再次推出一名掩护性候选人出来挑战，不排除这种可能性。
ext.ext_en: The possibility of another stalking horse challenge this autumn cannot be ruled out.

defs.def_en: In politics, a stalking horse is someone who stands against a leader in order to see how strong the opposition is. The stalking horse then withdraws in favour of a stronger challenger.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 将党派领袖的管制区分隔开的军事化区域
ext.ext_en: ...the militarized zone that separates the faction leaders' areas of control.

defs.def_en: A militarized area or region has members of the armed forces and military equipment in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 军事化的(指具有好战性、纪律性等军队特色的)

ext.ext_cn: 具有军事化和对抗主义特色的政治风格
ext.ext_en: ...a militarized and confrontationist style of politics.

defs.def_en: You can use militarized to show disapproval of something that has many military characteristics, for example the quality of being aggressive or strict.

ext.ext_cn: 他得以在一间三室公寓里免费住宿。
ext.ext_en: He was given free lodging in a three-room flat.

ext.ext_cn: 旅费包括离家在外的食宿费
ext.ext_en: ...travel expenses including meals and lodgings while traveling away from home.

defs.def_en: If you are provided with lodging or lodgings, you are provided with a place to stay for a period of time. You can use lodgings to refer to one or more of these places.

ext.ext_cn: 戴维换了一间租屋，没留下地址。
ext.ext_en: David had changed his lodgings, leaving no address behind...

ext.ext_cn: 许多单身汉在周围的村子里租房居住。
ext.ext_en: Many of the single men found lodgings in the surrounding villages.

defs.def_en: If you live in lodgings, you live in a room or rooms in someone's house and you pay them for this.

defs.def_cn: (燃料、自然资源的)消耗量，消费量

ext.ext_cn: 这些法律已经使美国燃料消费量有所减少。
ext.ext_en: The laws have led to a reduction in fuel consumption in the US.

ext.ext_cn: 非再生能源消费税
ext.ext_en: ...a tax on the consumption of non-renewable energy resources.

defs.def_en: The consumption of fuel or natural resources is the amount of them that is used or the act of using them.

ext.ext_cn: 这些酒中大部分都不适于人类饮用。
ext.ext_en: Most of the wine was unfit for human consumption...

ext.ext_cn: 每日平均果蔬摄入量约为200克。
ext.ext_en: The average daily consumption of fruit and vegetables is around 200 grams...

defs.def_en: The consumption of food or drink is the act of eating or drinking something, or the amount that is eaten or drunk.

ext.ext_cn: 对我们增加消费产生的垃圾进行回收要好过将其焚烧。
ext.ext_en: Recycling the waste from our increased consumption is better than burning it.

ext.ext_en: The production and consumption of goods and services is the ultimate aim of all economic endeavour.

defs.def_en: Consumption is the act of buying and using things.

defs.def_cn: 供(某人或某个群体)使用，享用

ext.ext_en: The hard-line speech appears to be mostly for domestic consumption...

ext.ext_en: The report was obviously designed for the consumption of members of the War Committee.

defs.def_en: If you do or say something for a particular person's or group's consumption, you do or say it especially for them, although your private thoughts or plans may be very different.
Consumption is the same as tuberculosis .

ext.ext_cn: 哈罗德·T.克兰福德先生
ext.ext_en: ...Harold T. Cranford Esq.

defs.def_en: Esq. is used after men's names as a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) esquir .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极佳的;卓越的;质量极高的

ext.ext_en: There is a superb 18-hole golf course 6 miles away...

ext.ext_en: The waters are crystal clear and offer a superb opportunity for swimming.

defs.def_en: If something is superb, its quality is very good indeed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (信心、控制力、技巧)非同一般的，超凡的

ext.ext_cn: 他凭借超凡的技术实现了完美着陆。
ext.ext_en: With superb skill he managed to make a perfect landing.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has superb confidence, control, or skill, you mean that they have very great confidence, control, or skill.

ext.ext_cn: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。
ext.ext_en: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground...

ext.ext_cn: 飞机猛烈撞击地面，致使一个引擎陷到了地下16英尺处。
ext.ext_en: The plane hit so hard that one engine was buried 16 feet underground.

defs.def_en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 独自在地铁里等车的女子
ext.ext_en: ...a woman alone in the underground waiting for a train...

ext.ext_cn: 他乘地铁穿过伦敦。
ext.ext_en: He crossed London by underground...

defs.def_en: The underground in a city is the railway system in which electric trains travel below the ground in tunnels.

defs.def_cn: （反抗敌人或暴政的）地下组织，秘密组织

ext.ext_cn: 战争期间，这些美元被偷运到该国，用以资助那里的地下组织。
ext.ext_en: These US dollars were smuggled into the country during the war, to aid the underground.

defs.def_en: In a country which is controlled by an enemy or has a harsh government, the underground is an organized group of people who are involved in illegal activities against the people in power.

ext.ext_cn: 秘密的克什米尔解放阵线
ext.ext_en: ...the underground Kashmir Liberation Front...

ext.ext_cn: 他们被指控组织并资助地下青年运动。
ext.ext_en: They are accused of organising and financing an underground youth movement.

defs.def_en: Underground groups and activities are secret because their purpose is to oppose the government and they are illegal.

ext.ext_cn: 经历了1981年的激烈冲突之后，他们或转入地下，或离开了该国。
ext.ext_en: After the violent clashes of 1981 they either went underground or left the country.

ext.ext_cn: 面临被捕危险不得不秘密开展工作的反对派领导人
ext.ext_en: ...opposition leaders, who are working underground because of the threat of arrest.

defs.def_en: If you go underground, you hide from the authorities or the police because your political ideas or activities are illegal.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无惊人（或重大）事件的；平凡的；平静的

ext.ext_cn: 回程波澜不惊，车开得很顺。
ext.ext_en: The return journey was uneventful, the car running perfectly...

ext.ext_cn: 她极少有机会谈论自己枯燥平淡的生活。
ext.ext_en: It was rare for her to have an opportunity to discuss her dull, uneventful life.

defs.def_en: If you describe a period of time as uneventful, you mean that nothing interesting, exciting, or important happened during it.

ext.ext_cn: 全球核试验禁令
ext.ext_en: ...a global ban on nuclear testing...

ext.ext_cn: 艾滋病很可能会成为造成全球婴儿死亡的首要原因。
ext.ext_en: On a global scale, AIDS may well become the leading cause of infant death.

defs.def_en: You can use global to describe something that happens in all parts of the world or affects all parts of the world.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 大局观——基于全部而非部分事实作出更加宏观的决定的能力
ext.ext_en: ...the global view, the ability to make wider decisions based on a knowledge of all the facts, not just some of them.

ext.ext_cn: 对当代社会的总体看法
ext.ext_en: ...a global vision of contemporary societies.

defs.def_en: A global view or vision of a situation is one in which all the different aspects of it are considered.

ext.ext_cn: 他们派两人在前面侦察。
ext.ext_en: They sent two men out in front as scouts.

defs.def_en: A scout is someone who is sent to an area of countryside to find out the position of an enemy army.
A scout is the same as a talent scout .

ext.ext_cn: 我没空在这个地区找没用的东西。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't have time to scout the area for junk...

ext.ext_cn: 一个4人小分队被派出寻找核试验地。
ext.ext_en: A team of four was sent to scout for a nuclear test site...

defs.def_en: If you scout somewhere for something, you go through that area searching for it.
A general strike is a situation where most or all of the workers in a country are on strike and are refusing to work.

defs.def_cn: 浮石，浮岩，轻石（一种火山石，用于去污以及柔肤等）
defs.def_en: Pumice is a kind of grey stone from a volcano and is very light in weight. It can be rubbed over surfaces, especially your skin, that you want to clean or make smoother.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在防空洞中避难。
ext.ext_en: They took refuge in a bomb shelter...

ext.ext_cn: 他的家成了信徒们的避难之处。
ext.ext_en: His home became a place of refuge for the believers.

defs.def_en: If you take refuge somewhere, you try to protect yourself from physical harm by going there.

defs.def_cn: 避难所;庇护处;安全地带

ext.ext_cn: 为受到暴力侵害的妇女建的避难所
ext.ext_en: ...a refuge for battered women...

ext.ext_cn: 我们沿着一条蜿蜒的小道爬向山上的一处避难所。
ext.ext_en: We climbed up a winding track towards a mountain refuge.

defs.def_en: A refuge is a place where you go for safety and protection, for example from violence or from bad weather.

ext.ext_cn: 太多的时候，他们觉得无聊就在酒精和毒品中寻求慰藉。
ext.ext_en: All too often, they get bored, and seek refuge in drink and drugs...

ext.ext_cn: 罗恩神父以沉默来逃避。
ext.ext_en: Father Rowan took refuge in silence.

defs.def_en: If you take refuge in a particular way of behaving or thinking, you try to protect yourself from unhappiness or unpleasantness by behaving or thinking in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 维多利亚站的一个行李寄存柜
ext.ext_en: ...a left luggage locker at Victoria Station.

defs.def_en: Left luggage is used to refer to luggage that people leave at a special place in a railway station or an airport, and which they collect later.
Your telephone number is the number that other people dial when they want to talk to you on the telephone.

ext.ext_cn: 鱼和贝类是特色菜。
ext.ext_en: Fish and shellfish are the specialities.

defs.def_en: Shellfish are small creatures that live in the sea and have a shell.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 猜疑的；警觉的；有戒心的

ext.ext_cn: 行政人员们说他们对拟建中的系统心怀顾虑。
ext.ext_en: Executives say they are leery of the proposed system...

ext.ext_cn: 把资金投向一个由一人独自操控的公司，他们不大放心。
ext.ext_en: They were leery about investing in a company controlled by a single individual.

defs.def_en: If you are leery of something, you are cautious and suspicious about it and try to avoid it.

ext.ext_cn: 淫笑
ext.ext_en: ...a leery grin.

defs.def_en: If someone looks or smiles at you in a leery way, they look or smile at you in an unpleasant way, usually because they are sexually interested in you.

defs.def_cn: (热带的)荒岛，无人居住的小岛
defs.def_en: A desert island is a small tropical island, where nobody lives.
A tandem is a bicycle designed for two riders, on which one rider sits behind the other.

ext.ext_cn: 马尔科姆的合同将与他手头的合同同时生效。
ext.ext_en: Malcolm's contract will run in tandem with his existing one.

defs.def_en: If one thing happens or is done in tandem with another thing, the two things happen at the same time.

ext.ext_cn: 他正配合欺诈重案办公室的官员工作。
ext.ext_en: He is working in tandem with officials of the Serious Fraud Office.

defs.def_en: If one person does something in tandem with another person, the two people do it by working together.

ext.ext_cn: 有人担心警方利用该法罚没犯下轻罪的人的财产。
ext.ext_en: There is concern that police use the law to confiscate assets from people who have committed minor offences...

ext.ext_cn: 他们没收了武器、弹药和宣传材料。
ext.ext_en: They confiscated weapons, ammunition and propaganda material.

defs.def_en: If you confiscate something from someone, you take it away from them, usually as a punishment.
Manx is used to describe people or things that belong to or concern the Isle of Man and the people who live there.

defs.def_cn: 新手;菜鸟;（尤指）新兵，新警员

ext.ext_cn: 我不想再训练新兵了。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to have another rookie to train.

ext.ext_cn: 新上任的警官
ext.ext_en: ...a rookie police officer.

defs.def_en: A rookie is someone who has just started doing a job and does not have much experience, especially someone who has just joined the army or police force.

defs.def_cn: (第一年参加体育比赛的)新队员
defs.def_en: A rookie is a person who has been competing in a professional sport for less than a year.
A doe is an adult female rabbit, hare, or deer.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 谨慎的；小心在意的；警惕的

ext.ext_en: The boy gave him a guarded look...

ext.ext_en: In the office, Dr. Lahey seemed less guarded, more relaxed.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as guarded, you mean that they are careful not to show their feelings or give away information.

ext.ext_en: ...a small minority of thoughtless and inconsiderate people...

ext.ext_cn: 她提起这事有些欠考虑。
ext.ext_en: It was thoughtless of her to mention it...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as thoughtless, you are critical of them because they forget or ignore other people's wants, needs, or feelings.

ext.ext_en: Impotence affects 10 million men in the US alone.

defs.def_en: Impotence is a man's sexual problem in which his penis fails to get hard or stay hard.

defs.def_cn: 针锋相对的；以牙还牙的

defs.def_en: A tit-for-tat action is one where someone takes revenge on another person for what they have done by doing something similar to them.

ext.ext_en: It would pay farmers to plough up the scrub and plant wheat.

defs.def_en: If someone ploughs up an area of land, they plough it, usually in order to turn it into land used for growing crops.

ext.ext_en: ...a 34-year-old mother of quads.

defs.def_en: Quads are the same as quadruplets .

ext.ext_en: His rooms were on the left-hand side of the quad.

defs.def_en: A quad is the same as a quadrangle .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...an old lady with bowed legs.

defs.def_en: Something that is bowed is curved.

ext.ext_en: He walked aimlessly along street after street, head down and shoulders bowed.

defs.def_en: See also:bow;If a person's body is bowed, it is bent forward.

defs.def_cn: (常指因年迈而)体弱的,虚弱的

ext.ext_en: ...her aging, infirm husband.

ext.ext_cn: 我们来这里保护、帮助年迈体弱者。
ext.ext_en: We are here to protect and assist the weak and infirm.

defs.def_en: A person who is infirm is weak or ill, and usually old.

ext.ext_cn: 一包防水易理妥
ext.ext_en: ...a packet of waterproof Elastoplast.

defs.def_cn: （解决办法）创可贴式的，暂时的

ext.ext_en: It is only an Elastoplast solution to a far greater constitutional problem.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an Elastoplast solution to a problem, you mean that you disapprove of it because you think that it will only be effective for a short period.

ext.ext_cn: 这些变更将于4月开始实行。
ext.ext_en: The changes will be introduced in April...

ext.ext_en: They were married on 7 April 1927 at Paddington Register Office.

defs.def_en: April is the fourth month of the year in the Western calendar.

ext.ext_en: I am negotiating with financiers to raise seed capital for my latest venture.

defs.def_en: Seed capital is an amount of money that a new company needs to pay for the costs of producing a business plan so that they can raise further capital to develop the company.

defs.def_cn: 目标市场;所针对的市场

ext.ext_cn: 我们认定有必要把目标市场从45岁以上人群调整为 35–45 岁之间的人群。
ext.ext_en: We decided that we needed to change our target market from the over-45s to the 35-45s.

defs.def_en: A target market is a market in which a company is trying to sell its products or services.

ext.ext_cn: 她是安全委员会的主席。
ext.ext_en: She's the chairperson of the safety committee.

defs.def_en: The chairperson of a meeting, committee, or organization is the person in charge of it.

defs.def_cn: （用电动器具）将（食物等）打成泥状；使成液态物

ext.ext_cn: 将混合物打成泥状，然后用滤网滤一下。
ext.ext_en: Liquidize the mixture and then pass it through a sieve.

defs.def_en: If you liquidize food, you process it using an electrical appliance in order to make it liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 他对跑车和骏马的偏爱
ext.ext_en: ...his predilection for fast cars and fast horses.

defs.def_en: If you have a predilection for something, you have a strong liking for it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 医疗保险费用昂贵。
ext.ext_en: Medical insurance is very pricey.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is pricey, you mean that it is expensive.

ext.ext_cn: 他提名的副总统在两轮投票后才当选。
ext.ext_en: His nominee for vice president was elected only after a second ballot...

ext.ext_cn: 我很高兴获得提名，也很荣幸接受如此声誉卓越的奖项，这是对我们公司所取得成就的认可。
ext.ext_en: I was delighted to be a nominee and to receive such a prestigious award in recognition of our company's achievements.

defs.def_en: A nominee is someone who is nominated for a job, position, or award.

defs.def_cn: （用于科研的）实验室，研究室，实验楼
defs.def_en: A laboratory is a building or a room where scientific experiments, analyses, and research are carried out.
A laboratory in a school, college, or university is a room containing scientific equipment where students are taught science subjects such as chemistry.

ext.ext_cn: 哲学家们并未怎么关注这一观点。
ext.ext_en: The idea has been given short shrift by philosophers.

defs.def_en: If someone or something gets short shrift, they are paid very little attention.

ext.ext_cn: 电子商务预料中的迅猛发展
ext.ext_en: ...the anticipated explosion of e-commerce.

defs.def_en: E-commerce is the same as e-business .

defs.def_cn: （动物或植物的）杂（交）种，混（合）种

ext.ext_cn: 花园里所有这些色彩鲜艳的杂交花真美丽。
ext.ext_en: All these brightly coloured hybrids are so lovely in the garden.

ext.ext_cn: 水生薄荷和留兰香的杂交种
ext.ext_en: ...a hybrid between watermint and spearmint.

defs.def_en: A hybrid is an animal or plant that has been bred from two different species of animal or plant.

defs.def_cn: （尤指两种不同物质的）混合物，合成物

ext.ext_cn: 固体和液体燃料的混合物
ext.ext_en: ...a hybrid of solid and liquid fuel.

ext.ext_cn: 合成系统
ext.ext_en: ...a hybrid system.

defs.def_en: You can use hybrid to refer to anything that is a mixture of other things, especially two other things.

defs.def_cn: 混合动力车；油电混合车

ext.ext_cn: 与纯电动汽车不同，混合动力车永远不需要接电源。
ext.ext_en: Hybrids, unlike pure electric cars, never need to be plugged in.

ext.ext_cn: 混合动力车加一次油可以跑几乎600英里。
ext.ext_en: Hybrid cars can go almost 600 miles between refueling.

The breech of a gun is the part of the barrel at the back into which you load the bullets.
A VDU is a machine with a screen which is used to display information from a computer. VDU is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'visual display unit'.

defs.def_cn: (向上帝或重要人物请求的)祈求者，恳求者，哀求者

defs.def_en: A supplicant is a person who prays to God or respectfully asks an important person to help them or to give them something that they want very much.

defs.def_cn: 职能(或地位)相当的人;对应的事物

ext.ext_en: The Foreign Secretary telephoned his Italian counterpart to protest.

ext.ext_cn: 芬兰的这一机构和北欧其他国家的同类机构迥然不同。
ext.ext_en: The Finnish organization was very different from that of its counterparts in the rest of the Nordic region.
