defs.def_en: A fiendish plan, action, or device is very clever or imaginative.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极其困难的;极具挑战性的

ext.ext_cn: 只要干净利落地做一个选择，你就能自己设计出难以解开的谜题。
ext.ext_en: A rather neat option allows you to design your own fiendish puzzle.

ext.ext_cn: 这些问题极度困难之处
ext.ext_en: ...the fiendish difficulty of the questions.

defs.def_en: A fiendish problem or task is very difficult and challenging.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 以残忍为乐的;恶魔般的

ext.ext_cn: 这是极其恶毒的行为。
ext.ext_en: This was a fiendish act of wickedness.

defs.def_en: A fiendish person enjoys being cruel.

defs.def_cn: （阳台或楼梯的）栏杆，扶手，护墙
defs.def_en: A balustrade is a railing or wall on a balcony or staircase.
A parlour is a room in a house for sitting in.

defs.def_cn: （提供服务而不销售货物的）店铺（用于店名中）

ext.ext_cn: 殡仪馆
ext.ext_en: ...a funeral parlour.

ext.ext_cn: 声名狼藉的按摩院
ext.ext_en: ...a notorious massage parlour.

defs.def_en: Parlour is used in the names of some types of shops which provide a service, rather than selling things.

ext.ext_cn: 我从来没犯过罪。
ext.ext_en: I have never committed any crime...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个杀人犯。
ext.ext_en: This is a man who has committed murder.

defs.def_en: If someone commits a crime or a sin, they do something illegal or bad.

ext.ext_cn: 有未经证实的报道说他曾企图自杀。
ext.ext_en: There are unconfirmed reports he tried to commit suicide.

defs.def_en: If someone commits suicide, they deliberately kill themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 他们呼吁西方国家向极端贫困国家投入更多的钱。
ext.ext_en: They called on Western nations to commit more money to the poorest nations...

ext.ext_cn: 政府已经给一个旨在减少酸雨的方案拨了几十亿英镑。
ext.ext_en: The government had committed billions of pounds for a programme to reduce acid rain...

defs.def_en: If you commit money or resources to something, you decide to use them for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 我建议大家慎重考虑一下答应周日工作的问题。
ext.ext_en: I would advise people to think very carefully about committing themselves to working Sundays...

ext.ext_cn: 我希望拥有一份能进一步发展的友谊，但又不想太快作出承诺。
ext.ext_en: I'd like a friendship that might lead to something deeper, but I wouldn't want to commit myself too soon...

defs.def_en: If you commit yourself to something, you say that you will definitely do it. If you commit yourself to someone, you decide that you want to have a long-term relationship with them.

ext.ext_cn: 对这样一个微妙的问题明确表态并非他们的外交风格。
ext.ext_en: It isn't their diplomatic style to commit themselves on such a delicate issue...

ext.ext_cn: 不管怎样，她都不想明确表态。
ext.ext_en: She didn't want to commit herself one way or the other.

defs.def_en: If you do not want to commit yourself on something, you do not want to say what you really think about it or what you are going to do.

defs.def_cn: 把…正式送进(医院、监狱等)

ext.ext_cn: 阿瑟由于酗酒被送进一家精神病医院。
ext.ext_en: Arthur's drinking caused him to be committed to a psychiatric hospital.

defs.def_en: If someone is committed to a hospital, prison, or other institution, they are officially sent there for a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 预计他会被移交利物浦高等刑事法庭。
ext.ext_en: He is expected to be committed for trial at Liverpool Crown Court.

defs.def_en: In the British legal system, if someone is committed for trial, they are sent by magistrates to stand trial in a crown court.

ext.ext_cn: 关于这件事她未曾写下只言片语。
ext.ext_en: She had not committed anything to paper about it...

ext.ext_cn: 我会重复一下，好让你们记住。
ext.ext_en: I'll repeat that so you can commit it to memory.

defs.def_en: If you commit something to paper or to writing, you record it by writing it down. If you commit something to memory, you learn it so that you will remember it.
A waistband is a narrow piece of material which is sewn on to a pair of trousers, a skirt, or other item of clothing at the waist in order to strengthen it.

defs.def_cn: （报刊文章顶部的）作者署名行
defs.def_en: A byline is a line at the top of an article in a newspaper or magazine giving the author's name.

defs.def_cn: 沉着;镇定;从容不迫;泰然自若

ext.ext_cn: 全体演职人员以一种真正的专业精神，从容不迫地开始了影片的制作。
ext.ext_en: The whole cast executed the production with truly professional aplomb.

defs.def_en: If you do something with aplomb, you do it with confidence in a relaxed way.

defs.def_cn: (常持续数天的)专题讨论会，研讨会

ext.ext_cn: 总统召集各州州长召开了一次教育研讨会。
ext.ext_en: The President summoned all the state governors to a conference on education.

ext.ext_cn: 保守党大会
ext.ext_en: ...the Conservative Party conference...

defs.def_en: A conference is a meeting, often lasting a few days, which is organized on a particular subject or to bring together people who have a common interest.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在餐桌旁坐下，和平常一样，吃饭之前要开个会。
ext.ext_en: They sat down at the dinner table, as they always did, before the meal, for a conference...

ext.ext_cn: 她的老板在和两位律师谈事情，不想有人打扰。
ext.ext_en: Her employer was in conference with two lawyers and did not want to be interrupted.

defs.def_en: A conference is a meeting at which formal discussions take place.

ext.ext_cn: 她的亲生父亲是意大利裔。
ext.ext_en: Her real father was of Italian extraction...

ext.ext_cn: 他娶了一位年轻的印度裔女子。
ext.ext_en: He married a young lady of Indian extraction.

defs.def_en: If you say, for example, that someone is of French extraction, you mean that they or their family originally came from France.

ext.ext_cn: 在公共场所所有的狗都应该用皮带牵住。
ext.ext_en: All dogs in public places should be on a leash.

defs.def_en: A dog's leash is a long thin piece of leather or a chain, which you attach to the dog's collar so that you can keep the dog under control.

ext.ext_cn: 他困惑地摇了摇头。
ext.ext_en: He shook his head in bewilderment.

defs.def_en: Bewilderment is the feeling of being bewildered.

ext.ext_cn: 成群结队的小青年阻拦消防部门灭火。
ext.ext_en: Crowds of youths prevented the fire service from dealing with the blaze.

defs.def_en: The fire service is an organization which has the job of putting out fires.

ext.ext_cn: 他用官方信纸写信推荐一个亲戚的公司。
ext.ext_en: He had written letters on official notepaper to promote a relative's company.

defs.def_en: Notepaper is paper that you use for writing letters on.
A machine tool is a machine driven by power that cuts, shapes, or finishes metal or other materials.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指自己的上级或长者）和蔼的，慈祥的，有礼貌的

ext.ext_cn: 她是位可爱又亲切的女人。
ext.ext_en: She is a lovely and gracious woman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone, especially someone you think is superior to you, as gracious, you mean that they are very well-mannered and pleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她最后彬彬有礼地致谢，结束了讲话。
ext.ext_en: She closed with a gracious speech of thanks.

defs.def_en: If you describe the behaviour of someone in a position of authority as gracious, you mean that they behave in a polite and considerate way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他驾车穿过设有游泳池和网球场的舒适城郊住宅区。
ext.ext_en: He drove through the gracious suburbs with the swimming pools and tennis courts.

defs.def_en: You use gracious to describe the comfortable way of life of wealthy people.

ext.ext_cn: 哎呀，你快来瞧瞧那个标本！
ext.ext_en: Good gracious, look at that specimen will you?

defs.def_en: Some people say good gracious or goodness gracious in order to express surprise or annoyance.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的治疗方法利用现有技术可以实现。
ext.ext_en: Their remedy lay within the range of existent technology.

defs.def_en: See also:non-existent;You can describe something as existent when it exists.
A video cassette is a cassette containing videotape, on which you can record or watch moving pictures and sounds.

defs.def_cn: 我(第一人称单数宾格代词)

ext.ext_cn: 我不得不作出将影响我后半生的重大决定。
ext.ext_en: I had to make important decisions that would affect me for the rest of my life...

ext.ext_cn: 他要我和他一起去剑桥。
ext.ext_en: He asked me to go to Cambridge with him...

defs.def_en: A speaker or writer uses me to refer to himself or herself. Me is a first person singular pronoun. Me is used as the object of a verb or a preposition.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (男子)风流倜傥的，温文尔雅的，衣着入时的

ext.ext_cn: 他是一位英俊潇洒、风流倜傥、敢于挑战死神的赛车手。
ext.ext_en: He was a handsome, debonair, death-defying racing-driver.

defs.def_en: A man who is debonair is confident, charming, and well-dressed.

defs.def_cn: (身体因受伤或患病产生的)肿胀,浮肿

ext.ext_cn: 他的眼睛半闭着，眼睑上有一个肿块。
ext.ext_en: His eye was partly closed, and there was a swelling over his lid...

ext.ext_cn: 他身上有些浮肿，被留院观察。
ext.ext_en: There is some swelling and he is being detained for observation.

defs.def_en: A swelling is a raised, curved shape on the surface of your body which appears as a result of an injury or an illness.

ext.ext_cn: 他说自己是时候离开那个恶女人了。
ext.ext_en: He commented that it was about time he left that accursed woman.

defs.def_en: Some people use accursed to describe something which they are very annoyed about.
If a person is accursed, they have been cursed.

defs.def_cn: 草草做成（或建成）；匆匆拼凑成

ext.ext_cn: 找到伯尼，让他尽快拟好一份协议。
ext.ext_en: Find Bernie and get him to knock an agreement together...

ext.ext_cn: 用木制门和门框匆匆搭起的棚子
ext.ext_en: ...a shelter knocked together using wooden doors and door frames.

defs.def_en: If you knock something together, you make it or build it very quickly, using whatever materials are available.

ext.ext_cn: 他说用占卜杖探测水源完全是胡说八道。
ext.ext_en: He said that dowsing for water is complete nonsense...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在南美洲为一些大公司探测石油和矿石。
ext.ext_en: We dowse oil and ore in South America for big companies.

defs.def_en: If someone dowses for underground water, minerals, or some other substance, they search for it using a special rod.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （天气）温暖舒适的，温和宜人的

ext.ext_cn: 宜人的夏夜
ext.ext_en: ...a balmy summer's evening.

defs.def_en: Balmy weather is fairly warm and pleasant.
If you say something sotto voce, you say it in a soft voice.

defs.def_cn: （食物）美味的，可口的；（尤指）稀奇的

ext.ext_cn: 一盘佳肴
ext.ext_en: ...an epicurean dish.

defs.def_en: Epicurean food is of very good quality, especially unusual or rare food.
If you refer to someone as a hillbilly, you are saying in a fairly rude way that you think they are uneducated and stupid because they come from the countryside.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为女性无论从事什么工作，加入工会都是有好处的。
ext.ext_en: I feel that women in all types of employment can benefit from joining a union.

ext.ext_cn: 工会官员
ext.ext_en: ...union officials.

defs.def_en: A union is a workers' organization which represents its members and which aims to improve things such as their working conditions and pay.

ext.ext_cn: 1918年，这个前沙皇统治的省份中占了多数的罗马尼亚人投票赞成与罗马尼亚合并。
ext.ext_en: In 1918 the Romanian majority in this former tsarist province voted for union with Romania.

defs.def_en: When the union of two or more things occurs, they are joined together and become one thing.

ext.ext_cn: 坦桑尼亚是坦噶尼喀和桑给巴尔两个政体组成的联合国家。
ext.ext_en: Tanzania is a union of the states of Tanganyika and Zanzibar.

ext.ext_cn: 关于哪些国家应该加入货币联盟的问题
ext.ext_en: ...the question of which countries should join the currency union.

defs.def_en: When two or more things, for example countries or organizations, have been joined together to form one thing, you can refer to them as a union .

ext.ext_cn: 就连路易斯都开始认为他们的婚姻并没有受到上帝的祝福。
ext.ext_en: Even Louis began to think their union was not blessed in the eyes of God.

defs.def_en: The marriage of two people is sometimes referred to as a union .

defs.def_cn: （用于名称中）俱乐部，协会，联合会

ext.ext_cn: 给星体命名是由国际天文学联合会决定的。
ext.ext_en: The naming of stars is at the discretion of the International Astronomical Union.

ext.ext_cn: 母亲联合会
ext.ext_en: ...the Mothers' Union.

defs.def_en: Union is used in the name of some clubs, societies, and organizations.

ext.ext_cn: 第二天，他把自己排在了新的家务值日表的第一位。
ext.ext_en: The next day he put himself first on the new roster for domestic chores...

ext.ext_cn: 他正在自己的办公室里制定下一个月的执勤表。
ext.ext_en: He was in his office, preparing his duty roster for the coming month.

defs.def_en: A roster is a list which gives details of the order in which different people have to do a particular job.

defs.def_cn: 名单;花名册;登记表;运动员名册（尤用于美国英语中）

ext.ext_cn: 业余垒球协会的裁判员名单上的人数已经减少到了57,000名。
ext.ext_en: The Amateur Softball Association's roster of umpires has declined to 57,000...

ext.ext_cn: 从该电影公司的男主角名单来看，罗伯特·沃克显然是出演这一角色的不二人选。
ext.ext_en: From the studio's roster of leading men, Robert Walker was an obvious choice to play the part.

defs.def_en: A roster is a list, especially of the people who work for a particular organization or are available to do a particular job. It can also be a list of the sports players who are available for a particular team, especially in American English.

defs.def_cn: 临床态度（医生对患者的说话方式）
defs.def_en: A doctor's bedside manner is the way in which they talk to their patients.
Coloratura is very complicated and difficult music for a solo singer, especially in opera.
A coloratura is a singer, usually a woman, who is skilled at singing coloratura.
A commissariat is a military department that is in charge of food supplies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 腐败的;贪污的;受贿的;营私舞弊的

ext.ext_cn: 从两个政党的腐败政客手中挽救这个国家
ext.ext_en: ...to save the nation from corrupt politicians of both parties...

ext.ext_cn: 腐败的警察
ext.ext_en: ...corrupt police officers...

defs.def_en: Someone who is corrupt behaves in a way that is morally wrong, especially by doing dishonest or illegal things in return for money or power.

ext.ext_cn: 看到一个人因为追逐金钱和权力而如此腐化真是悲哀。
ext.ext_en: It is sad to see a man so corrupted by the desire for money and power.

defs.def_en: If someone is corrupted by something, it causes them to become dishonest and unjust and unable to be trusted.

ext.ext_cn: 警告说电视将会使我们所有人堕落
ext.ext_en: ...warning that television will corrupt us all...

ext.ext_cn: 残暴行为会使人堕落、道德败坏。
ext.ext_en: Cruelty depraves and corrupts.

defs.def_en: To corrupt someone means to cause them to stop caring about moral standards.

ext.ext_cn: 有些比较优美的字体经过价廉、通用的电脑打印机处理后就面目全非了。
ext.ext_en: Some of the finer typefaces are corrupted by cheap, popular computer printers...

ext.ext_cn: 他们可以确保传统烹饪不会被商业运营模式完全破坏。
ext.ext_en: They can ensure that traditional cuisines are not totally corrupted by commercial practices.

defs.def_en: If something is corrupted, it becomes damaged or spoiled in some way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他有些火冒三丈的谴责是有理由的。
ext.ext_en: He was justified in some of his condemnatory outbursts.

defs.def_en: Condemnatory means expressing strong disapproval.

ext.ext_cn: 帕特里克·德夫林是一位杰出的法官和出色的法律专家。
ext.ext_en: Patrick Devlin was an outstanding judge and brilliant jurist.

defs.def_en: A jurist is a person who is an expert on law.

defs.def_cn: 华达呢，轧别丁（用于制作外套等的厚布料）

ext.ext_cn: 庄重的白色衬衣和笔挺的华达呢直筒长裙
ext.ext_en: ...a demure white blouse and long, straight gabardine skirt.

defs.def_en: Gabardine is a fairly thick cloth which is used for making coats, suits, and other clothes.

defs.def_cn: 华达呢外套；华达呢大衣
defs.def_en: A gabardine is a coat made from gabardine.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 新首相对无阶级社会的展望
ext.ext_en: ...the new Prime Minister's vision of a classless society.

defs.def_en: When politicians talk about a classless society, they mean a society in which people are not affected by social status.

defs.def_cn: (尤当had为助动词时，they had的一种口语形式)

ext.ext_cn: 他们俩在这条路上生活了一辈子。
ext.ext_en: They'd both lived in this road all their lives.

defs.def_en: They'd is a spoken form of 'they had', especially when 'had' is an auxiliary verb.

ext.ext_cn: 他答应他们在简的家里喝完咖啡后就去看她。
ext.ext_en: He agreed that they'd visit her after they stopped at Jan's for coffee.

defs.def_en: They'd is a spoken form of 'they would'.

defs.def_cn: （枪的）通条，洗杆，装药棒，推弹杆
defs.def_en: A ramrod is a long, thin rod which can be used for pushing something into a narrow tube. Ramrods were used, for example, for forcing an explosive substance down the barrel of an old-fashioned gun, or for cleaning the barrel of a gun.

defs.def_cn: （坐姿或立姿）非常僵直地，直挺挺地

ext.ext_cn: 一位铁灰色头发、高颧骨、腰板笔直的女士
ext.ext_en: ...a woman with iron grey hair, high cheekbones and a figure like a ramrod.

ext.ext_cn: 他那翘起的小胡子和笔直的背部
ext.ext_en: ...his dashing military moustache and straight-as-a-ramrod back.

defs.def_en: If someone sits or stands like a ramrod or straight as a ramrod, they have a very straight back and appear rather stiff and formal.

ext.ext_cn: 我现在没有当海军时那样笔挺的身姿了。
ext.ext_en: I don't have the ramrod posture I had when I was in the Navy.

ext.ext_cn: 她已经75岁了，腰板仍然笔直。
ext.ext_en: At 75, she's still ramrod straight.

defs.def_en: If someone has a ramrod back or way of standing, they have a very straight back and hold themselves in a rather stiff and formal way.

ext.ext_cn: 斑驳的光线透过百叶窗照射进来。
ext.ext_en: Cracks of light filtered through the shutters...

ext.ext_cn: 大使馆内的水电都被切断了。
ext.ext_en: Light and water in embassy buildings were cut off...

defs.def_en: Light is the brightness that lets you see things. Light comes from sources such as the sun, moon, lamps, and fire.

ext.ext_cn: 看门人巡视一圈，把灯熄灭。
ext.ext_en: The janitor comes round to turn the lights out...

ext.ext_cn: 你融入到音乐、灯光以及身边的人群中。
ext.ext_en: You get into the music, the lights and the people around you.

defs.def_en: A light is something such as an electric lamp which produces light.

ext.ext_cn: 在交通灯和十字路口前长久等待的拥堵的城市车流
ext.ext_en: ...the heavy city traffic with its endless delays at lights and crossings.

defs.def_en: You can use lights to refer to a set of traffic lights.

ext.ext_cn: 天黑了，一轮巨大的月亮把道路照得通明，周围的景物可以看得一清二楚。
ext.ext_en: It was dark and a giant moon lit the road so brightly you could see the landscape clearly...

ext.ext_cn: 房间里仅靠这一盏灯照明。
ext.ext_en: The room was lit by only the one light...

defs.def_en: If a place or object is lit by something, it has light shining on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们到达拉隆溪时天还没黑。
ext.ext_en: It was still light when we arrived at Lalong Creek...

ext.ext_cn: 他经常天一亮就起床去花园。
ext.ext_en: He would often rise as soon as it was light and go into the garden.

defs.def_en: If it is light, the sun is providing light at the beginning or end of the day.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这间房有高大的窗子，光线充足。
ext.ext_en: It is a light room with tall windows...

ext.ext_cn: 她的房子光线充足，空气流通，清新整洁。
ext.ext_en: Her house is light and airy, crisp and clean.

defs.def_en: If a room or building is light, it has a lot of natural light in it, for example because it has large windows.

ext.ext_cn: 斯蒂芬弓着身子点燃一支烟。
ext.ext_en: Stephen hunched down to light a cigarette...

ext.ext_cn: 要是木炭确实着不了的话，使用一种特殊的液体喷剂，再用长木片将其点燃。
ext.ext_en: If the charcoal does fail to light, use a special liquid spray and light it with a long taper.

defs.def_en: If you light something such as a cigarette or fire, or if it lights, it starts burning.

ext.ext_cn: 你们谁有火吗？
ext.ext_en: Have you got a light anybody?

defs.def_en: If someone asks you for a light, they want a match or cigarette lighter so they can start smoking.

ext.ext_cn: 最近几个月里他努力从更积极的角度来描绘纽约。
ext.ext_en: He has worked hard in recent months to portray New York in a better light.

defs.def_en: If something is presented in a particular light, it is presented so that you think about it in a particular way or so that it appears to be of a particular nature.

ext.ext_cn: 现实严酷的一面
ext.ext_en: ...the harsh light of reality.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the type of influence that something has on situations, people, or things as the light of that situation, person, or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他们可以继续按照自己的想法，依据自己的利益来管理学校系统。
ext.ext_en: They can get on with running the school system according to their own lights and in their own interests.

defs.def_en: You say that something is done or is acceptable according to someone's lights when you mean that it is done or is acceptable according to their own ideas and standards.

ext.ext_cn: 我记得他眼里那好奇而期待的目光。
ext.ext_en: I remembered the curious expectant light in his eyes.

defs.def_en: If there is a light in someone's  eyes, there is an expression in their eyes that shows you the mood they are in or what they are thinking about.

ext.ext_cn: 关于这笔钱人们一无所知。
ext.ext_en: Nothing about this sum has  come to light...

ext.ext_cn: 承诺要进行的调查不太可能揭露真相。
ext.ext_en: The truth is unlikely to be brought to light by the promised enquiry.

defs.def_en: If something comes to light or is brought to light, it becomes obvious or is made known to a lot of people.

ext.ext_cn: 终于明白过来了——他要和菲莉丝结婚了！
ext.ext_en: At last the light dawned. He was going to marry Phylis!

defs.def_en: If light dawns on you, you begin to understand something after a period of not being able to understand it.

ext.ext_cn: 黎明前3个小时富恩特斯下达了撤离营地的命令。
ext.ext_en: Three hours before first light Fuentes gave orders for the evacuation of the camp.

defs.def_en: First light is the time in the early morning when light first appears and before the sun rises.

ext.ext_cn: 食品业获准继续使用这些化学品。
ext.ext_en: The food industry was given a green light to extend the use of these chemicals...

ext.ext_cn: 其他国家正在急切等待美国同意完全撤销制裁。
ext.ext_en: Other countries are eagerly awaiting an American green light to lift the sanctions altogether.

defs.def_en: If someone in authority gives you a green light, they give you permission to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 根据这一信息，现在有可能弄清楚几个关键问题了。
ext.ext_en: In the light of this information it is now possible to identify a number of key issues.

defs.def_en: If something is possible in the light of particular information, it is only possible because you have this information.

defs.def_cn: 很快入睡；立即失去知觉

ext.ext_cn: “为什么没有人来告诉我？”——“因为你一下就睡过去了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Why didn't  somebody come and tell me?' — 'Because you were out like a light.'

defs.def_en: If someone goes out like a light, they fall asleep or become unconscious very quickly or immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 博物馆的地下室里堆满了永远不会重见天日的物件。
ext.ext_en: Museum basements are stacked full of objects which never see the light of day.

defs.def_en: If you say that an object sees the light of day or sees the light, you mean that it is taken out of the place where it is stored.

ext.ext_cn: 这份非同寻常的文件第一次公开是在1966年。
ext.ext_en: This extraordinary document first saw the light of day in 1966.

defs.def_en: If something sees the light of day at a particular time, it comes into existence or is made known to the public at that time.

ext.ext_cn: 我终于醒悟，甩掉了他。
ext.ext_en: I saw the light and ditched him.

defs.def_en: If someone sees the light, they finally realize something or change their attitude or way of behaving to a better one.

ext.ext_cn: 他们隔着公寓门往里边倒汽油，然后点着了火。
ext.ext_en: They had poured fuel through the door of the flat and had then set light to it.

defs.def_en: If you set light to something, you make it start burning.

defs.def_cn: 使（某事）显得非常清楚；使人了解（某事）

ext.ext_cn: 新的方法提供了一个答案，并且可能让人们对一个更大的问题有进一步的了解。
ext.ext_en: A new approach offers an answer, and may shed light on an even bigger question.

defs.def_en: To shed light on ,throw light on, or cast light on something means to make it easier to understand, because more information is known about it.

defs.def_cn: 隧道尽头的曙光；黑暗尽头的希望

ext.ext_cn: 我只能告诉她要坚持，让她知道总会柳暗花明的。
ext.ext_en: All I can do is tell her to hold on, that there's light at the end of the tunnel.

defs.def_en: When you talk about the light at the end of the tunnel, you are referring to the end of the difficult or unpleasant situation that you are in at the moment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 现代的网球拍据说比以前的轻20%。
ext.ext_en: Modern tennis rackets are now apparently 20 per cent lighter.

ext.ext_cn: 轻量负重训练
ext.ext_en: ...weight training with light weights...

defs.def_en: Something that is light does not weigh very much, or weighs less than you would expect it to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 少量的；程度轻的；强度低的

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个星期天，像任何一个星期天一样，城里的车辆不多。
ext.ext_en: It's  a Sunday like any other with the usual light traffic in the city...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天拍卖之前的成交量很小。
ext.ext_en: Trading was very light ahead of yesterday's auction.

defs.def_en: Something that is light is not very great in amount, degree, or intensity.

ext.ext_cn: 轻型装甲车队
ext.ext_en: ...a convoy of light armoured vehicles...

ext.ext_cn: 他们使用了轻机枪和AK—47步枪。
ext.ext_en: They used light machine guns and AK forty-sevens.

defs.def_en: Light equipment and machines are small and easily moved, especially because they are not heavy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 进入底土的化学物质会减少，这对土质松软的热带土壤而言尤为重要。
ext.ext_en: Less chemical gets into the subsoil which is particularly important with the light, tropical soils.

defs.def_en: Soil that is light is easy to dig, because it has a loose texture and is not sticky or solid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 墙的颜色素淡，贴了墙纸。
ext.ext_en: The walls are light in colour and covered in paper...

ext.ext_cn: 他浅色头发，灰色眼睛。
ext.ext_en: He is light haired with gray eyes.

defs.def_en: Something that is light is very pale in colour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她迷迷糊糊地进入了浅睡。
ext.ext_en: She had drifted into a light sleep...

ext.ext_cn: 她通常很容易惊醒。
ext.ext_en: She was usually a light sleeper.

defs.def_en: A light sleep is one that is easily disturbed and in which you are often aware of the things around you. If you are a light sleeper, you are easily woken when you are asleep.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那嗓音甜美轻柔。
ext.ext_en: The voice was sweet and light.

defs.def_en: A light sound, for example someone's voice, is pleasantly quiet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 量少而健康的午餐
ext.ext_en: ...a light, healthy lunch.

ext.ext_cn: 酒和奶酪或其他小食品
ext.ext_en: ...wine and cheese or other light refreshment.

defs.def_en: A light meal consists of a small amount of food, or of food that is easy to digest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 伯蒂做的西红柿清汤清淡可口。
ext.ext_en: Berti's  clear tomato soup is deliciously light...

ext.ext_cn: 用箔纸包烤或用清汤蒸煮三文鱼8至10分钟。
ext.ext_en: Bake salmon in foil or poach in a light stock for 8-10 minutes.

defs.def_en: Food that is light has a delicate flavour and is easy to digest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 昨天他在训练场进行了一些强度较小的训练。
ext.ext_en: He was on the training field for some light work yesterday.

defs.def_en: Light work does not involve much physical effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行为后果、处罚等）轻微的，不严重的

ext.ext_cn: 父亲来探监时，她承认对自己受到的从轻判决感到诧异。
ext.ext_en: She confessed her astonishment at her light sentence when her father visited her at the jail.

defs.def_en: If you describe the result of an action or a punishment as light, you mean that it is less serious or severe than you expected.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻捷的；轻盈的；用力小的

ext.ext_cn: 涂抹乳霜或化妆品时动作要轻。
ext.ext_en: Use a light touch when applying cream or make-up...

ext.ext_cn: 有人在轻轻地敲门。
ext.ext_en: There was a light knock at the door.

defs.def_en: Movements and actions that are light are graceful or gentle and are done with very little force or effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （书、音乐、电影等）消遣性的，娱乐性的，轻松的

ext.ext_cn: 他不喜欢我看些消遣小说。
ext.ext_en: He doesn't like me reading light novels.

ext.ext_cn: 轻古典音乐
ext.ext_en: ...light classical music.

defs.def_en: If you describe things such as books, music, and films as light, you mean that they entertain you without making you think very deeply.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 用友好随意的方式跟他谈谈这一关系吧。
ext.ext_en: Talk to him in a friendly, light way about the relationship...

ext.ext_cn: 最后，我们谈一个比较轻松的话题吧。
ext.ext_en: Let's finish on a lighter note.

defs.def_en: If you say something in a light way, you sound as if you think that something is not important or serious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （通常用于否定句）轻微的，不重要的

ext.ext_cn: 竟然有那么多的年轻囚犯试图自杀或自残，内政部决不可等闲视之。
ext.ext_en: It can be no light matter for the Home Office that so many young prisoners should have wanted to kill or injure themselves.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not a light matter, you mean that it should be treated or considered as being important and serious.

defs.def_cn: 轻视；对…不在乎；视…为微不足道

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯茨试图轻描淡写自己的不适。
ext.ext_en: Roberts attempted to make light of his discomfort.

defs.def_en: If you make light of something, you treat it as though it is not serious or important, when in fact it is.

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影有彩色版。
ext.ext_en: The film is available in a colorized version.

defs.def_en: A colorized film is an old black and white film which has had colour added to it using a special technique.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 贤妻为了丈夫而牺牲自己事业的时代已经结束了。
ext.ext_en: The days of the dutiful wife, who sacrifices her career for her husband, are over.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is dutiful, you mean that they do everything that they are expected to do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 幻觉的;虚假的;不切实际的

ext.ext_cn: 他的自由是虚幻的。
ext.ext_en: His freedom is illusory.

ext.ext_cn: 国家的虚假本质
ext.ext_en: ...the illusory nature of nationhood.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as illusory, you mean that although it seems true or possible, it is in fact false or impossible.

defs.def_cn: (公路的)之字形坡路，不断起伏的路线;陡坡

ext.ext_cn: 乘公共汽车驶过一段颠簸起伏的公路时感到头晕目眩
ext.ext_en: ...a dizzy bus ride over a switchback road.

defs.def_en: A switchback is a road which rises and falls sharply many times, or a sharp rise and fall in a road.

defs.def_cn: (有连续急转弯的)上山公路;(公路上的)急转弯

ext.ext_cn: 过了公路上第一个急转弯几百码处，他又遇到了第二个急转弯。
ext.ext_en: Several hundred yards beyond the first switchback in the road, he came to the second bend.

defs.def_en: A switchback is a road which goes up a steep hill in a series of sharp bends, or a sharp bend in a road.

ext.ext_cn: 他表现出焦躁不安和过度忧虑的症状。
ext.ext_en: He has exhibited symptoms of anxiety and overwhelming worry...

ext.ext_cn: 一所房子里有两只以上的猫时也会出现划分地盘的行为。
ext.ext_en: Two cats or more in one house will also exhibit territorial behaviour...

defs.def_en: If someone or something shows a particular quality, feeling, or type of behaviour, you can say that they exhibit it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的作品在美洲、欧洲和亚洲最好的美术馆展出。
ext.ext_en: His work was exhibited in the best galleries in America, Europe and Asia.

ext.ext_cn: 19世纪末伦敦动物园展出的一头巨型大象
ext.ext_en: ...a massive elephant exhibited by London Zoo in the late 19th Century.

defs.def_en: When a painting, sculpture, or object of interest is exhibited, it is put in a public place such as a museum or art gallery so that people can come to look at it. You can also say that animals are exhibited in a zoo.

ext.ext_cn: 到1936年她已在皇家艺术学院展出作品。
ext.ext_en: By 1936 she was exhibiting at the Royal Academy.

defs.def_en: When artists exhibit, they show their work in public.

ext.ext_cn: 肖纳带我参观了展品。
ext.ext_en: Shona showed me round the exhibits.

defs.def_en: An exhibit is a painting, sculpture, or object of interest that is displayed to the public in a museum or art gallery.

ext.ext_cn: 大都会艺术博物馆的展览
ext.ext_en: ...an exhibit at the Metropolitan Museum of Art.

defs.def_en: An exhibit is a public display of paintings, sculpture, or objects of interest, for example in a museum or art gallery.
An exhibit is an object that a lawyer shows in court as evidence in a legal case.

ext.ext_cn: 其他女人似乎很满足，甚至还骄傲地炫耀她们的肚腩。
ext.ext_en: Other women seemed content and even exhibited their bellies with pride...

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎想要让大家知道自己感到羞愧。
ext.ext_en: He seems to want to exhibit his shame.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone exhibits something, you mean that they are showing it openly or publicly in order to be admired, noticed, or believed.
A rhombus is a geometric shape which has four equal sides but is not a square.
A hacking jacket is a jacket made of a woollen cloth called tweed. Hacking jackets are often worn by people who go horse riding.

defs.def_cn: 像纸一样的；质地似纸的

ext.ext_cn: 每瓣蒜外面的薄皮都要留着。
ext.ext_en: Leave each garlic clove in its papery skin.

defs.def_en: Something that is papery is thin and dry like paper.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 被动的；顺从的；听之任之的

ext.ext_cn: 他顺从的态度让我做起事来要轻松些。
ext.ext_en: His passive attitude made things easier for me...

ext.ext_cn: 即使被动接受该政权也是一种通敌行为。
ext.ext_en: Even passive acceptance of the regime was a kind of collaboration.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as passive, you mean that they do not take action but instead let things happen to them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们想找些更为积极的方式来打发时间。
ext.ext_en: They want less passive ways of filling their time.

ext.ext_cn: 观看绘画或雕塑获得的被动享受
ext.ext_en: ...the passive enjoyment one gets from  looking at a painting or sculpture.

defs.def_en: A passive activity involves watching, looking at, or listening to things rather than doing things.

ext.ext_cn: 他们声明一旦发生军事接管，他们只会采取非暴力抵抗。
ext.ext_en: They made it clear that they would only exercise passive resistance in the event of a military takeover.

defs.def_en: Passive resistance involves showing opposition to the people in power in your country by not co-operating with them and protesting in non-violent ways.

In grammar, the passive or the passive voice is formed using 'be' and the past participle of a verb. The subject of a passive clause does not perform the action expressed by the verb but is affected by it. For example, in 'He's been murdered', the verb is in the passive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有可读性的；值得一读的

ext.ext_cn: 这本书中的研究缜密透彻，可读性很强。
ext.ext_en: This is an impeccably researched and very readable book.

defs.def_en: If you say that a book or article is readable, you mean that it is enjoyable and easy to read.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我的秘书花了很长时间把我写的几乎无法辨认的手稿用打字机打印成易读的文本。
ext.ext_en: My secretary worked long hours translating my almost illegible writing into a typewritten and readable script.

defs.def_en: A piece of writing that is readable is written or printed clearly and can be read easily.

defs.def_cn: 集体无意识(心理学术语)
defs.def_en: In psychology, the collective unconscious consists of the basic ideas and images that all people are believed to share because they have inherited them.

defs.def_cn: (专门处理某类犯罪的)警察分队

ext.ext_cn: 大楼里进行了人员疏散，并叫来了拆弹小组。
ext.ext_en: The building was evacuated and the bomb squad called...

ext.ext_cn: 反诈骗调查组正在对该俱乐部进行调查。
ext.ext_en: The club is under investigation by the fraud squad.

defs.def_en: A squad is a section of a police force that is responsible for dealing with a particular type of crime.

defs.def_cn: (将从中挑选运动员组队参赛的)运动队，大名单

ext.ext_cn: 肖恩·奥利里已入选参加阿根廷巡回赛的英格兰队大名单。
ext.ext_en: Sean O'Leary has been named in the England squad to tour Argentina.

defs.def_en: A squad is a group of players from which a sports team will be chosen.

ext.ext_cn: 突击小分队
ext.ext_en: ...a squad of commandos.

defs.def_en: See also:death squad;firing squad;Flying Squad;vice squad;A squad of soldiers is a small group of them.

ext.ext_cn: 他参加共和党总统提名角逐的候选资格
ext.ext_en: ...his candidacy for the Republican presidential nomination.

ext.ext_cn: 高级讲师提名名单
ext.ext_en: ...a list of nominations for senior lectureships.

defs.def_en: A nomination is an official suggestion of someone as a candidate in an election or for a job.

ext.ext_cn: 他们说他肯定能获得最佳男配角奖的提名。
ext.ext_en: They say he's certain to get a nomination for best supporting actor...

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦·帕克的电影《追梦者》获得了6项提名。
ext.ext_en: Alan Parker's film 'The Commitments' has six nominations.

defs.def_en: A nomination for an award is an official suggestion that someone or something should be given that award.

ext.ext_cn: 他们反对任命一名下级警官担任警务总监。
ext.ext_en: They opposed the nomination of a junior officer to the position of Inspector General of Police...

ext.ext_cn: 利奥去世后，有两个主要候选人被指定来接替他。
ext.ext_en: On the death of Leo there were two main candidates for nomination as his replacement.

defs.def_en: The nomination of someone to a particular job or position is their appointment to that job or position.

ext.ext_cn: 持枪者手持猎枪守卫着墓地附近的房子。
ext.ext_en: Gunmen guarded homes near the cemetery with shotguns...

ext.ext_cn: 戒备森严的法庭
ext.ext_en: ...the heavily guarded courtroom.

defs.def_en: If you guard a place, person, or object, you stand near them in order to watch and protect them.

ext.ext_cn: 手持步枪的海军陆战队士兵监视着他们。
ext.ext_en: Marines with rifles guarded them...

ext.ext_cn: 有一队警察看守着他。
ext.ext_en: He is being guarded by a platoon of police.

defs.def_en: If you guard someone, you watch them and keep them in a particular place to stop them from escaping.

ext.ext_cn: 囚犯们制服了监狱看守，并将他们锁进了牢房。
ext.ext_en: The prisoners overpowered their guards and locked them in a cell.

defs.def_en: A guard is someone such as a soldier, police officer, or prison officer who is guarding a particular place or person.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在该地区各处部署了保安。
ext.ext_en: We have a security guard around the whole area...

ext.ext_cn: 一队全副武装的警察已经封锁了市中心。
ext.ext_en: A heavily armed guard of police have sealed off the city centre.

defs.def_en: A guard is a specially organized group of people, such as soldiers or policemen, who protect or watch someone or something.
On a train, a guard is a person whose job is to travel on the train in order to help passengers, check tickets, and make sure that the train travels safely and on time.

ext.ext_cn: 他对她的身份守口如瓶。
ext.ext_en: He closely guarded her identity.

ext.ext_cn: 对该国珍惜维护的统一局面的威胁
ext.ext_en: ...a threat to the country's jealously guarded unity.

defs.def_en: If you guard some information or advantage that you have, you try to protect it or keep it for yourself.

defs.def_cn: 保护装置；保护罩；保护器

ext.ext_cn: 我头盔上的下巴保护罩
ext.ext_en: ...the chin guard of my helmet...

ext.ext_cn: 为保证操作人员的人身安全安装了桨叶保护罩。
ext.ext_en: A blade guard is fitted to protect the operator.

defs.def_en: A guard is a protective device which covers a part of someone's body or a dangerous part of a piece of equipment.

defs.def_cn: （英国的）近卫军，禁军，近卫军士兵

ext.ext_cn: 英国近卫步兵团
ext.ext_en: ...the Grenadier Guards.

defs.def_en: Some regiments in the British Army, or the soldiers in them, are referred to as Guards.

ext.ext_cn: 吸引观众的注意力，然后给他们来个出其不意。
ext.ext_en: Charm the audience and catch them off guard...

ext.ext_cn: 收到这份邀请让我颇感意外。
ext.ext_en: The invitation had caught me off guard.

defs.def_en: If  someone catches you off guard, they surprise you by doing something you do not expect. If something catches you off guard, it surprises you by happening when you are not expecting it.

defs.def_cn: 丧失警惕；放松警惕；不提防

ext.ext_cn: 非洲人国民大会在所有事项皆已完成前不敢有丝毫松懈。
ext.ext_en: The ANC could not afford to lower its guard until everything had been carried out...

ext.ext_cn: 你不能放松警惕。
ext.ext_en: You can't let your guard down...

defs.def_en: If you lower your guard ,let your guard down or drop your guard, you relax when you should be careful and alert, often with unpleasant consequences.

ext.ext_cn: 他们甚至派人在首都的大饭店外面站岗。
ext.ext_en: They've  even mounted guard outside the main hotel in the capital...

ext.ext_cn: 警方昨晚通宵值守财物。
ext.ext_en: Police mounted round-the-clock guards on properties last night.

defs.def_en: If you mount guard or if you mount a guard, you organize people to watch or protect a person or place.

ext.ext_cn: 警方已经对他进行了详细的盘问，因此他会保持戒备心理。
ext.ext_en: The police have questioned him thoroughly, and he'll be on his guard...

ext.ext_cn: 他时刻提防着任何有辱尊严之事。
ext.ext_en: He is constantly on guard against any threat of humiliation.

defs.def_en: If you are on your guard or on guard, you are being very careful because you think a situation might become difficult or dangerous.

ext.ext_cn: 警察在巴尼特市政厅值守。
ext.ext_en: Police were on guard at Barnet town hall.

defs.def_en: If someone is on guard, they are on duty and responsible for guarding a particular place or person.

ext.ext_cn: 一位年轻的警察在大门紧闭的使馆外站岗。
ext.ext_en: One young policeman stood guard outside the locked embassy gates.

defs.def_en: If you stand guard, you stand near a particular person or place because you are responsible for watching or protecting them.

ext.ext_cn: 有3人被逮捕，1人在警方监护下送医院治疗。
ext.ext_en: Three men were arrested and one was under guard in hospital.

defs.def_en: If someone is under guard, they are being guarded.

defs.def_cn: (含有坚果和水果的)牛轧糖，鸟结糖
defs.def_en: Nougat is a kind of firm sweet, containing nuts and sometimes fruit.

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词和名词前构成新的形容词和名词）表示“全”，“泛”

ext.ext_cn: 泛欧洲防御体系
ext.ext_en: ...a pan-European defence system.

ext.ext_cn: 泛阿拉伯主义思想
ext.ext_en: ...the ideology of pan-Arabism.

defs.def_en: pan- is added to the beginning of adjectives and nouns to form other adjectives and nouns that describe something as being connected with all places or people of a particular kind.

ext.ext_cn: 北冰洋的鱼受到过污染吗？
ext.ext_en: Have any fish been contaminated in the Arctic Ocean?

ext.ext_cn: 大片撂荒的土地，其中大部分由于经年累月的战火而受到了污染
ext.ext_en: ...vast tracts of empty land, much of it contaminated by years of army activity.

defs.def_en: If something is contaminated by dirt, chemicals, or radiation, they make it dirty or harmful.
Coitus is sexual intercourse.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 施虐受虐式的性关系
ext.ext_en: ...a sado-masochistic relationship.

defs.def_en: Something that is sado-masochistic is connected with the practice of sado-masochism.

defs.def_cn: (非警方人员所做的)调查，侦察

ext.ext_cn: 为了看能否找到什么脚印，我做了一番小小的侦察。
ext.ext_en: I did a little sleuthing to see if I could find any footprints.

defs.def_en: Sleuthing is the investigation of a crime or mystery by someone who is not a police officer.

ext.ext_cn: 恋爱告吹后，我一时间自信全无。
ext.ext_en: With the end of my love affair, I lost all the self-confidence I once had...

ext.ext_cn: 理查德变得越来越自信。
ext.ext_en: Richard's self confidence is growing steadily.

defs.def_en: If you have self-confidence, you behave confidently because you feel sure of your abilities or value.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 主卧室非常大。
ext.ext_en: The main bedroom is enormous...

ext.ext_cn: 当然有很多可看的。
ext.ext_en: There is, of course, an enormous amount to see.

defs.def_en: Something that is enormous is extremely large in size or amount.

ext.ext_cn: 真是让人万分失望。
ext.ext_en: It was an enormous disappointment.

ext.ext_cn: 他的穷凶极恶
ext.ext_en: ...his enormous capacity for brutality.

defs.def_en: You can use enormous to emphasize the great degree or extent of something.

defs.def_cn: 无家可归者;漂泊街头的人;流浪者
defs.def_en: Street people are homeless people who live outdoors in a town or city.
A coffer is a large strong chest used for storing valuable objects such as money or gold and silver.

ext.ext_cn: 彩票收入用于发展体育和娱乐产业，同时还用来充实国库。
ext.ext_en: The proceeds from the lottery go towards sports and recreation, as well as swelling the coffers of the government...

ext.ext_cn: 长期以来，大型的上市公司和私营企业一直在为保守党捐助资金。
ext.ext_en: Large public and private companies have long been contributors to Tory party coffers.

defs.def_en: The coffers of an organization consist of the money that it has to spend, imagined as being collected together in one place.
Acquired immune deficiency syndrome is the same as AIDS .

ext.ext_cn: 贝内特小姐用录像机播放老电影来消磨时间。
ext.ext_en: Miss Bennett whiled away the hours playing old films on her video-recorder.

defs.def_en: If you while away the time in a particular way, you spend time in that way, because you are waiting for something else to happen, or because you have nothing else to do.
A green salad is a salad made mainly with lettuce and other green vegetables.

defs.def_cn: （加在形容词后构成副词）表示“以…方式”，“至…程度”

ext.ext_cn: 我看见路易丝慢慢地走向公共汽车站。
ext.ext_en: I saw Louise walking slowly to the bus stop...

ext.ext_cn: 他们伤势严重。
ext.ext_en: They were badly injured...

defs.def_en: -ly is added to adjectives to form adverbs that indicate the manner or nature of something.

defs.def_cn: （加在名词后构成形容词）表示“像…一样的”，“有…特性的”

ext.ext_cn: 员工们很友善。
ext.ext_en: The staff are very friendly...

ext.ext_cn: 做这种事是懦弱的行为。
ext.ext_en: This was a cowardly thing to do.

defs.def_en: -ly is added to nouns to form adjectives that describe someone or something as being like or typical of a particular kind of person or thing.

defs.def_cn: （加在名词后构成形容词或副词）表示“每隔…时间（的）”，“在…时间（的）”

ext.ext_cn: 周报
ext.ext_en: ...a weekly newspaper.

ext.ext_cn: 每月支付的款项
ext.ext_en: ...monthly payments.

defs.def_en: -ly is added to nouns referring to periods of time to form adjectives or adverbs that say how often something happens or is done.
A seeing-eye dog is a dog that has been trained to lead a blind person.
A red light is a traffic signal which shines red to indicate that drivers must stop.
The red-light district of a city is the area where prostitutes work.

defs.def_cn: （用于名词后构成形容词，修饰衣物）表示“紧包着身体的”，“紧身的”，“修身的”

ext.ext_cn: 修身连衣裙
ext.ext_en: ...a figure-hugging dress.

ext.ext_cn: 包臀喇叭裤
ext.ext_en: ...hip-hugging flares.

defs.def_en: -hugging combines with nouns to form adjectives which describe an item of clothing that fits very tightly and clearly reveals the shape of your body.

defs.def_cn: (戏剧、电影或小说的)次要情节，从属情节，小插曲

ext.ext_cn: 重头戏中精彩的小插曲
ext.ext_en: ...a fascinating sub-plot to the main drama.

defs.def_en: The sub-plot in a play, film, or novel is a story that is separate from and less important than the main story.

ext.ext_cn: 埃及军队依然有待考验。
ext.ext_en: The Egyptian Army remained an untested force...

ext.ext_cn: 将要面对的事情是大家都没有经历过的。
ext.ext_en: All of us were untested for what lay ahead.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is untested, they have not yet been tried out or have not yet experienced a particular situation, so you do not know what they will be like.

defs.def_cn: 未经检验的；未经测试的

ext.ext_cn: 把未经检验的药物给人吃的危险
ext.ext_en: ...the dangers of giving untested drugs to people.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a drug or chemical as untested, you mean that it has not been subject to scientific tests to find out if it is safe to use.

defs.def_cn: （狗、猫等动物的）血统记录，纯种谱系

ext.ext_cn: 60%的狗和10%的猫有血统记录。
ext.ext_en: 60 per cent of dogs and ten per cent of cats have pedigrees.

defs.def_en: If a dog, cat, or other animal has a pedigree, its ancestors are known and recorded. An animal is considered to have a good pedigree when all its known ancestors are of the same type.

defs.def_cn: 有纯种谱系证明的；纯种的

ext.ext_cn: 纯种狗
ext.ext_en: ...a pedigree dog.

ext.ext_cn: 纯种马
ext.ext_en: ...pedigree horses.

defs.def_en: A pedigree animal is descended from animals which have all been of a particular type, and is therefore considered to be of good quality.

ext.ext_cn: 哈默的商业背景几乎保证了他能够结识美国总统。
ext.ext_en: Hammer's business pedigree almost guaranteed him the acquaintance of U.S. presidents...

ext.ext_cn: 她有纯正的贵族血统。
ext.ext_en: She had an impeccable aristocratic pedigree.

defs.def_en: Someone's pedigree is their background or their ancestors.

defs.def_cn: 撤销(秘密文件或档案)的密级;对…解密

ext.ext_cn: 这些报告去年才被撤销了密级。
ext.ext_en: These reports were only declassified last year.

defs.def_en: If secret documents or records are declassified, it is officially stated that they are no longer secret.

ext.ext_cn: 自从一年前被困在电梯里之后，他就再也没敢乘过电梯。
ext.ext_en: Since he was stuck in a lift a year ago he hasn't dared to get back into one...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数人都对哈里敢怒不敢言。
ext.ext_en: Most people hate Harry but they don't dare to say so...

defs.def_en: If you do not dare to do something, you do not have enough courage to do it, or you do not want to do it because you fear the consequences. If you dare to do something, you do something which requires a lot of courage.

defs.def_cn: 向…挑战;激…（做）；问…有没有胆量（做）

ext.ext_cn: 喝咖啡时，她点燃了一支烟，用挑衅的眼神看着他，谅他也不敢吭声。
ext.ext_en: Over coffee, she lit a cigarette, her eyes daring him to comment...

ext.ext_cn: 我想你绝不敢和文森特这样的人一起坐上 45 分钟！
ext.ext_en: I dare you to sit through forty-five minutes with someone like Vincent!

defs.def_en: If you dare someone to do something, you challenge them to prove that they are not frightened of doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 别人一激他，他就几乎什么事都做得出来。
ext.ext_en: He'd do pretty much anything on a dare...

ext.ext_cn: 找到这些孩子时，他们说自己是受了激将才出走的。
ext.ext_en: When found, the children said they'd run away for a dare.

defs.def_en: A dare is a challenge which one person gives to another to do something dangerous or frightening.

ext.ext_cn: 不要那样跟我讲话。我不允许！
ext.ext_en: Don't speak to me like that. Don't you dare...

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦，其他地方哪儿都不准去，听到了吗？
ext.ext_en: Allen, don't you dare go anywhere else, you hear?

defs.def_en: If you say to someone 'don't you dare' do something, you are telling them not to do it and letting them know that you are angry.

defs.def_cn: （表示震惊和愤怒) 你竟敢，你怎么敢

ext.ext_cn: 你竟敢拿起电话偷听我的谈话！
ext.ext_en: How dare you pick up the phone and listen in on my conversations!...

ext.ext_cn: 突然平静被打破了，就听见有人在喊：“滚回去！滚开！大胆！”
ext.ext_en: Suddenly the peace was destroyed by someone shouting, 'Get back! Go away! How dare you!'

defs.def_en: You say 'how dare you'' when you are very shocked and angry about something that someone has done.

ext.ext_cn: 恕我直言，由于政客的社会地位，他们通常容易吸引一些年轻的女性。
ext.ext_en: Politicians usually attract younger women, dare I say it, because of the status they have in society.

defs.def_en: You use 'dare I say it' when you know that what you are going to say will disappoint or annoy someone.

ext.ext_cn: 想必计算机能就其给出一个清楚的答案。
ext.ext_en: I dare say that the computer would provide a clear answer to that...

ext.ext_cn: 人们总认为我是个傻瓜，想必他们是对的。
ext.ext_en: People always think I'm a fool, and I dare say they're right...

defs.def_en: You can use 'I dare say' or 'I daresay' before or after a statement to indicate that you believe it is probably true.

defs.def_cn: 苹果沙司;苹果泥;苹果酱
defs.def_en: Apple sauce is a type of sauce made from puréed cooked apples.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不停的;不懈的;不间断的；未减轻的

ext.ext_cn: 压力现在没完没了。
ext.ext_en: The pressure now was relentless.

defs.def_en: Something bad that is relentless never stops or never becomes less intense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对质量孜孜不倦的追求使他的技能出类拔萃。
ext.ext_en: Relentless in his pursuit of quality, his technical ability was remarkable...

ext.ext_cn: 他是我所遇到的最不屈不挠的敌手。
ext.ext_en: He was the most relentless enemy I have ever known.

defs.def_en: Someone who is relentless is determined to do something and refuses to give up, even if what they are doing is unpleasant or cruel.

ext.ext_cn: 他的英勇行为应该获得最高的赞誉。
ext.ext_en: He deserves the highest praise for his bravery.

defs.def_en: Bravery is brave behaviour or the quality of being brave.
The wattage of a piece of electrical equipment is the amount of electrical power which it produces or uses, expressed in watts.

defs.def_cn: 有凸起花纹的;有罗纹的;有棱纹的

ext.ext_cn: 罗纹羊绒衫
ext.ext_en: ...ribbed cashmere sweaters.

ext.ext_cn: 特殊的棱纹轮胎
ext.ext_en: ...special ribbed tyres.

defs.def_en: A ribbed surface, material, or garment has a raised pattern of parallel lines on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 汗津津的手
ext.ext_en: ...sweaty hands...

ext.ext_cn: 她热得大汗淋漓。
ext.ext_en: She was hot and sweaty.

defs.def_en: If parts of your body or your clothes are sweaty, they are soaked or covered with sweat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 热得(或累得)让人出汗的

ext.ext_cn: 热得让人冒汗的夜总会
ext.ext_en: ...a sweaty nightclub.

defs.def_en: A sweaty place or activity makes you sweat because it is hot or tiring.

ext.ext_cn: 从各式各样的毛线衫到性感迷人的内衣
ext.ext_en: ...from multi-patterned sweaters to attractive underclothes.

defs.def_en: Your underclothes are the items of clothing that you wear next to your skin and under your other clothes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如果不是出于某种恶毒的目的，为什么把整村人囚禁起来？
ext.ext_en: Why make a whole village prisoner if it was not to some nefarious purpose?

defs.def_en: If you describe an activity as nefarious, you mean that it is wicked and immoral.

defs.def_cn: （尤指科学和社会科学领域的）类型学，分类法
defs.def_en: A typology is a system for dividing things into different types, especially in science and the social sciences.

defs.def_cn: (较长时称作 moustaches)髭，八字胡，八字须

ext.ext_cn: 他个头不高，秃顶，留着八字胡。
ext.ext_en: He was short and bald and had a moustache.

ext.ext_cn: 一个敦实、八字胡耷拉着的男人
ext.ext_en: ...a heavy man with drooping moustaches.

defs.def_en: A man's moustache is the hair that grows on his upper lip. If it is very long, it is sometimes referred to as his moustaches .

ext.ext_cn: 该方案提供种子基金融资，其贷款只收取 4%的利息。
ext.ext_en: The scheme offers seed corn finance with loans at only 4% interest.

defs.def_en: Seed corn is money that businesses spend at the beginning of a project in the hope that it will eventually produce profits.

ext.ext_cn: 墙壁被用喷漆喷得一塌糊涂。
ext.ext_en: The walls had been horribly vandalized with spray paint...

ext.ext_cn: 大约1,000名暴徒一路捣毁建筑，抢劫商店。
ext.ext_en: About 1,000 rioters vandalized buildings and looted stores.

defs.def_en: If something such as a building or part of a building is vandalized by someone, it is damaged on purpose.

defs.def_cn: 全球定位系统（缩略形式为GPS)
defs.def_en: A global positioning system is a system that uses signals from satellites to find out the position of an object. The abbreviation GPS is also used.

ext.ext_cn: 我今晚要出去玩。
ext.ext_en: I'm going out tonight.

ext.ext_cn: 这是个好时机，他们应该出去痛快地玩一玩。
ext.ext_en: It will be a marvellous occasion and they should go out and enjoy it.

defs.def_en: If you go out, you leave your home in order to do something enjoyable, for example to go to a party, a bar, or the cinema.

defs.def_cn: 与（异性）交往；与…谈恋爱（或有性关系）

ext.ext_cn: 我曾经同一位法国男子交往过一段时间。
ext.ext_en: I once went out with a French man...

ext.ext_cn: 他们相恋才6周时间。
ext.ext_en: They've only been going out for six weeks.

defs.def_en: If you go out with someone, the two of you spend time together socially, and have a romantic or sexual relationship.

ext.ext_cn: 你并非蓄意伤害对手。
ext.ext_en: You do not go out to injure opponents...

defs.def_en: If you go out to do something, you make a deliberate effort to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 卧室里的灯过了一会儿就灭了。
ext.ext_en: The bedroom light went out after a moment.

defs.def_en: If a light goes out, it stops shining.

ext.ext_cn: 火看起来快灭了。
ext.ext_en: The fire seemed to be going out.

defs.def_en: If something that is burning goes out, it stops burning.

ext.ext_cn: 有消息说一队坦克已经出动了。
ext.ext_en: Word went out that a column of tanks was on its way.

defs.def_en: If a message goes out, it is announced, published, or sent out to people.

ext.ext_cn: 这部连续剧每周五晚上10点30分在第4频道播出。
ext.ext_en: The series goes out at 10.30pm, Fridays, on Channel 4.

defs.def_en: When a television or radio programme goes out, it is broadcast.

ext.ext_cn: 双排扣的套装好多年前就过时了。
ext.ext_en: Double-breasted suits went out years ago...

ext.ext_cn: 这些武器已经被淘汰了。
ext.ext_en: The weapons had gone out of use.

defs.def_en: If a type of thing goes out, it stops existing or being used, usually because it is replaced by something else.

ext.ext_cn: 正在退潮。
ext.ext_en: The tide was going out.

defs.def_en: When the tide goes out, the water in the sea gradually moves back to a lower level.

ext.ext_cn: 纽卡斯尔队以1比2的总比分被淘汰出局。
ext.ext_en: Newcastle went out of the competition, losing 2-1 on aggregate.

defs.def_en: If a person or team goes out of a competition, they are defeated in a game and therefore can no longer take part in the competition.

ext.ext_cn: 我十分同情亚当斯太太和她那些失去了父亲的孩子们。
ext.ext_en: My heart goes out to Mrs Adams and her fatherless children.

defs.def_en: You can say 'My heart goes out to him' or 'My sympathy goes out to her' to express the strong sympathy you have for someone in a difficult or unpleasant situation.

ext.ext_cn: 匪徒们逃到了一个偏远的山间藏身。
ext.ext_en: The bandits fled to a remote mountain hideaway.

ext.ext_en: In the heat of Rome, the wait was agonizing.

defs.def_en: Something that is agonizing causes you to feel great physical or mental pain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他这时候面临着一个关系到他不久的将来的痛苦抉择。
ext.ext_en: He now faced an agonizing decision about his immediate future.

defs.def_en: Agonizing decisions and choices are very difficult to make.

defs.def_cn: (尤指因受热、受潮而)(使)翘曲,(使)变形

ext.ext_cn: 如果放在太阳下暴晒，磁带很容易翘曲或在磁带盒里黏结。
ext.ext_en: Left out in the heat of the sun, tapes easily warp or get stuck in their cases...

ext.ext_cn: 这原本应当能够防止雨水把门的饰边弄翘的。
ext.ext_en: It should have prevented rain water warping the door trim...

defs.def_en: If something warps or is warped, it becomes damaged by bending or curving, often because of the effect of heat or water.

ext.ext_cn: 我从来没有任何玩具，我父亲认为它们会扭曲我的价值观。
ext.ext_en: I never had any toys, my father thought that they would warp my personal values...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的生活被战争摧毁了。
ext.ext_en: Their lives have been warped by war.

defs.def_en: If something warps someone's character, it damages them or it influences them in a bad way.

defs.def_cn: （时间或空间的）扭曲，偏差，错觉

ext.ext_cn: 当一个离了婚的女人重新进入约会和浪漫的世界时，她很可能有种回到从前的错觉。
ext.ext_en: When a divorced woman re-enters the world of dating and romance, she's likely to feel as though she has entered a time warp.

defs.def_en: A warp in time or space is an imaginary break or sudden change in the normal experience of time or space.
In weaving, the warp is the threads which are held in a frame or machine called a loom while another thread is passed across through them.

defs.def_cn: 沙(旧时伊朗国王的称号)
defs.def_en: In former times, the Shah of Iran was its ruler.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的表情近乎滑稽。
ext.ext_en: Her expression is almost comical...

ext.ext_cn: 事态出现了有趣的转折。
ext.ext_en: Events took a comical turn.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as comical, you mean that it makes you want to laugh because it seems funny or silly.

ext.ext_cn: 这些问题让我沮丧。
ext.ext_en: These questions frustrated me...

ext.ext_cn: 观众在剧场里要受到如此多的限制，这难道不令人恼火吗？
ext.ext_en: Doesn't it frustrate you that audiences in the theatre are so restricted?

defs.def_en: If something frustrates you, it upsets or angers you because you are unable to do anything about the problems it creates.

ext.ext_cn: 政府故意阻挠他为自己的外籍员工申请工作许可证的努力。
ext.ext_en: The government has deliberately frustrated his efforts to gain work permits for his foreign staff.

ext.ext_cn: 她竞选州长的受挫之举
ext.ext_en: ...her frustrated attempt to become governor.

defs.def_en: If someone or something frustrates a plan or attempt to do something, they prevent it from succeeding.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 尸体保存完好，他的容貌特征清晰可辨。
ext.ext_en: The body was found to be well preserved, his features easily recognizable...

ext.ext_cn: 这种树很容易辨认，因为它有着非常漂亮的银色树皮。
ext.ext_en: This tree is always recognizable by its extremely beautiful silvery bark.

defs.def_en: If something can be easily recognized or identified, you can say that it is easily recognizable .

defs.def_cn: （后接名词，用于描述动作或事件）

ext.ext_cn: 她累得连澡都懒得冲。
ext.ext_en: She was too tired to take a shower...

ext.ext_cn: 贝蒂给我们照了张相。
ext.ext_en: Betty took a photograph of us...

defs.def_en: You can use take followed by a noun to talk about an action or event, when it would also be possible to use the verb that is related to that noun. For example, you can say 'she took a shower' instead of 'she showered'.

defs.def_cn: （与一系列名词连用，代替意义更为具体的动词）

ext.ext_cn: 经过 3 个月内战，爱国阵线夺取了政权。
ext.ext_en: The Patriotic Front took power after a three-month civil war...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得让女性参与其中，并担当领导角色对于女性而言意义重大。
ext.ext_en: I felt it was important for women to join and take a leading role...

defs.def_en: In ordinary spoken or written English, people use take with a range of nouns instead of using a more specific verb. For example people often say 'he took control' or 'she took a positive attitude' instead of 'he assumed control' or 'she adopted a positive attitude'.

ext.ext_cn: 来，我帮你拿大衣。
ext.ext_en: Here, let me take your coat...

ext.ext_cn: 科利特抓住她的双肩，摇晃着她。
ext.ext_en: Colette took her by the shoulders and shook her...

defs.def_en: If you take something, you reach out for it and hold it.

ext.ext_cn: 马克常常带着书本去贝丝家学习。
ext.ext_en: Mark often took his books to Bess's house to study...

ext.ext_cn: 我会把这些文件带回家阅读。
ext.ext_en: I'll take these papers home and read them...

defs.def_en: If you take something with you when you go somewhere, you carry it or have it with you.

ext.ext_cn: 她带我去了一家墨西哥餐厅。
ext.ext_en: She took me to a Mexican restaurant...

ext.ext_cn: 校车接送他们上下学。
ext.ext_en: The school bus takes them to school and brings them back...

defs.def_en: If a person, vehicle, or path takes someone somewhere, they transport or lead them there.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个来自马德拉斯的穷学生，凭自身的才华上了剑桥。
ext.ext_en: He was a poor student from Madras whose genius took him to Cambridge...

ext.ext_cn: 由于工作原因，我经常出国。
ext.ext_en: My work takes me abroad a lot.

defs.def_en: If something such as a job or interest takes you to a place, it is the reason for you going there.

defs.def_cn: 请教（问题等）；洽谈(生意等)

ext.ext_cn: 你需要去找训练有素的咨询顾问请教这些问题。
ext.ext_en: You need to take your problems to a trained counsellor...

ext.ext_cn: 在真正的市场中，顾客可以去别处洽谈业务。
ext.ext_en: In a true market, the customer can take business elsewhere.

defs.def_en: If you take something such as your problems or your business to someone, you go to that person when you have problems you want to discuss or things you want to buy.

defs.def_cn: 使…达到(一定水平、程度或状态)

ext.ext_cn: 兼具天赋、勤奋和美貌使她得以出人头地。
ext.ext_en: A combination of talent, hard work and good looks have taken her to the top...

ext.ext_cn: 经理给自己加了 20%的薪，使他的薪水达到了 2 万英镑。
ext.ext_en: The managing director had given himself a pay rise of 20%, taking his salary to £20,000...

defs.def_en: If one thing takes another to a particular level, condition, or state, it causes it to reach that level or condition.

ext.ext_cn: 他从口袋里掏出手帕，轻轻擦了擦嘴。
ext.ext_en: He took a handkerchief from his pocket and lightly wiped his mouth...

ext.ext_cn: 她打开抽屉，取出一封信。
ext.ext_en: Opening a drawer, she took out a letter.

defs.def_en: If you take something from a place, you remove it from there.

ext.ext_cn: 他偷了我的钱，我再也要不回来了。
ext.ext_en: He has taken my money, and I have no chance of getting it back...

ext.ext_cn: 窃贼们盗走了所有拿得动的东西。
ext.ext_en: The burglars took just about anything they could carry.

defs.def_en: If you take something from someone who owns it, you steal it or go away with it without their permission.

defs.def_cn: (军队、政党)攻占，夺取，赢得，俘虏

ext.ext_cn: 一支塞尔维亚部队攻占了那个镇。
ext.ext_en: A Serb army unit took the town...

ext.ext_cn: 海军陆战队士兵攻了进去，俘获 15 人。
ext.ext_en: Marines went in, taking 15 prisoners...

defs.def_en: If an army or political party takes something or someone, they win them from their enemy or opponent.

ext.ext_cn: 减去房价，又是 10 万。
ext.ext_en: Take off the price of the house, that's another hundred thousand.

defs.def_en: If you take one number or amount from another, you subtract it or deduct it.

ext.ext_cn: 以后别再叫我去照看那些孩子了，我简直无法忍受！
ext.ext_en: Don't ever ask me to look after those kids again. I just can't take it!...

ext.ext_cn: 哈里对谁都粗暴无礼，这渐渐叫人无法忍受。
ext.ext_en: Harry's rudeness to everyone was becoming hard to take.

defs.def_en: If you cannot take something difficult, painful, or annoying, you cannot tolerate it without becoming upset, ill, or angry.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在战争中)蒙受，遭受(损害、损失)

ext.ext_cn: 他们遭受重大伤亡。
ext.ext_en: They have taken heavy casualties.

defs.def_en: If you take something such as damage or loss, you suffer it, especially in war or in a battle.

ext.ext_cn: 由于路况很糟糕，我们路上花了很长时间。
ext.ext_en: Since the roads are very bad, the journey took us a long time...

ext.ext_cn: 我听说上诉要花好几年时间。
ext.ext_en: I had heard an appeal could take years...

defs.def_en: If something takes a certain amount of time, that amount of time is needed in order to do it.

defs.def_cn: 需要，要求(某种素质或某物)

ext.ext_cn: 曾经有段时间她得费尽全力才能从房间一头走到另一头。
ext.ext_en: At one time, walking across the room took all her strength...

ext.ext_cn: 我们想结婚，生孩子等，可是那得花钱。
ext.ext_en: We want to get married and start a family and all. But that takes money...

defs.def_en: If something takes a particular quality or thing, that quality or thing is needed in order to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我接受那份工作时，以为我能改变那种体制，可实际上很难。
ext.ext_en: When I took the job I thought I could change the system, but it's hard...

ext.ext_cn: 他的儿子们采纳了他的建议。
ext.ext_en: His sons took his advice.

defs.def_en: If you take something that is given or offered to you, you agree to accept it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们为自己的历史传统深感自豪。
ext.ext_en: They take great pride in their heritage...

ext.ext_cn: 政府会从最新的民意调查中得到安慰。
ext.ext_en: The government will take comfort from the latest opinion poll.

defs.def_en: If you take a feeling such as pleasure, pride, or delight in a particular thing or activity, the thing or activity gives you that feeling.

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司在票务预订方面的收入达到 10 万英镑。
ext.ext_en: The firm took £100,000 in bookings.

defs.def_en: If a shop, restaurant, theatre, or other business takes a certain amount of money, they get that amount from people buying goods or services.

ext.ext_cn: 这就又增加了1,180万美元的收入，总计为 4,300 万美元。
ext.ext_en: It added another $11.8 million to the take, for a grand total of $43 million.

defs.def_en: You can use take to refer to the amount of money that a business such as a store or theatre gets from selling its goods or tickets during a particular period.

ext.ext_cn: 《毒药》在 1991 年的圣丹斯电影节上获得一等奖。
ext.ext_en: 'Poison' took first prize at the 1991 Sundance Film Festival...

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯蒂在 100 米赛中夺得金牌。
ext.ext_en: Christie took the gold medal in the 100 metres.

defs.def_en: If you take a prize or medal, you win it.

defs.def_cn: 承担，承受，接受(责备、责任或功劳)

ext.ext_cn: 事情是莱昂内尔的弟弟拉乌尔干的，可是莱昂内尔却代他受过，并且对此绝口不提。
ext.ext_en: His brother Raoul did it, but Leonel took the blame and kept his mouth shut...

ext.ext_cn: 她不愿接受所有荣誉。
ext.ext_en: She's reluctant to take all the credit.

defs.def_en: If you take the blame, responsibility, or credit for something, you agree to accept it.

ext.ext_cn: 有些大学将被迫超计划招生。
ext.ext_en: Some universities would be forced to take more students than they wanted...

ext.ext_cn: 他们被告知，奥尔布赖特医生不再接收新病人了。
ext.ext_en: They were told that Dr Albright wasn't taking any new patients.

defs.def_en: If you take patients or clients, you accept them as your patients or clients.

ext.ext_cn: 道格拉斯把电话打进凯瑟琳的办公室，可是她不接。
ext.ext_en: Douglas telephoned Catherine at her office. She refused to take his calls.

defs.def_en: If you take a telephone call, you speak to someone who is telephoning you.

ext.ext_cn: 遗憾的是，没人把我提供的信息当回事。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately, no one took my messages seriously...

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫听到那个消息后伤心透了。
ext.ext_en: Her husband had taken the news badly...

defs.def_en: If you take something in a particular way, you react in the way mentioned to a situation or to someone's beliefs or behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 有人迷惘，有人憎恨，可是几乎谁也没有公开表达过。就拿这个办公室的人来说吧。
ext.ext_en: There's confusion and resentment, and it's almost never expressed out in the open. Take this office, for example...

ext.ext_cn: 这个问题可以从多个角度解决，不过，还是让我们逐个分析吧。
ext.ext_en: You can attack this problem from many angles, but let's take one thing at a time...

defs.def_en: You use take when you are discussing or explaining a particular question, in order to introduce an example or to say how the question is being considered.

ext.ext_cn: 他们变得通情达理了，如果你明白我的意思的话。
ext.ext_en: They've turned sensible, if you take my meaning...

ext.ext_cn: “我没说这样就对，我只是说实际情况如此。”——“你的意思我懂。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'm not saying it's right, I'm just saying that's what happens.' — 'I take your point.'

defs.def_en: If you take someone's meaning or point, you understand and accept what they are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 她把他错当成记者了。
ext.ext_en: She had taken him for a journalist...

ext.ext_cn: 你以为我是白痴吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you take me for an idiot?...

defs.def_en: If you take someone for something, you believe wrongly that they are that thing.

ext.ext_cn: “给我来份烤金枪鱼吧，”玛丽·安告诉侍者。
ext.ext_en: 'I'll take the grilled tuna,' Mary Ann told the waiter.

defs.def_en: If you take something from among a number of things, you choose to have or buy it.

ext.ext_cn: 从雷克瑟姆市中心出发，沿着切斯特路到达市郊。
ext.ext_en: From Wrexham centre take the Chester Road to the outskirts of town...

ext.ext_cn: 他只好从别的路回家。
ext.ext_en: He had to take a different route home...

defs.def_en: If you take a road or route, you choose to travel along it.

ext.ext_cn: 我和妻子租下这套乡间小屋已经一个月了。
ext.ext_en: My wife and I have taken the cottage for a month.

defs.def_en: If you take a house or flat, you rent it, usually for only a short time.

ext.ext_cn: 在订阅《纪事报》以前，我看的是《卫报》。
ext.ext_en: Before the Chronicle I used to take the Guardian.

defs.def_en: If you take something such as a newspaper, you buy it or have it delivered to your home on a regular basis.

ext.ext_cn: 它在大街的那头，我们乘车去，好吗？
ext.ext_en: It's the other end of the High Street. We'll take the car, shall we?...

ext.ext_cn: 她每个周末乘火车去纽约。
ext.ext_en: She took the train to New York every weekend...

defs.def_en: If you take a car, train, bus, or plane, you use it to go from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 学生可以选修欧洲史和美国史。
ext.ext_en: Students are allowed to take European history and American history.

defs.def_en: If you take a subject or course at school or university, you choose to study it.

ext.ext_cn: 她在格林福特参加了驾照考试。
ext.ext_en: She took her driving test in Greenford...

ext.ext_cn: 她参加完高等程度考试后去印度旅行了。
ext.ext_en: She travelled to India after taking her A levels.

defs.def_en: If you take a test or examination, you do it in order to obtain a qualification.

ext.ext_cn: 教我们经济学的是汉弗莱小姐。
ext.ext_en: The teacher who took us for economics was Miss Humphrey.

defs.def_en: If you take someone for a subject, you give them lessons in that subject.

ext.ext_cn: 她一直在服用安眠药。
ext.ext_en: She's been taking sleeping pills...

ext.ext_cn: 我从未使用过违禁药品。
ext.ext_en: I have never taken illegal drugs.

defs.def_en: If someone takes drugs, pills, or other medicines, they take them into their body, for example by swallowing them.

ext.ext_cn: 她养成了进来和克拉布特里奶奶一起喝茶的习惯。
ext.ext_en: She made a habit of coming in to take tea with Nanny Crabtree...

ext.ext_cn: 你要是不喝鲜奶和酸奶，也不吃乳酪，那么其他的补钙来源就很重要了。
ext.ext_en: If you don't take milk, cheese or yoghurt, other sources of calcium are important.

defs.def_en: If you take food or drink, you eat or drink it.

ext.ext_cn: 她坐在那儿面无表情，认真记着笔记。
ext.ext_en: She sat expressionless, carefully taking notes...

ext.ext_cn: 帮我写封信，辛格尔顿小姐。
ext.ext_en: Take a letter, Miss Singleton.

defs.def_en: If you take a note or a letter, you write down something you want to remember or the words that someone says.

ext.ext_cn: 通过钻探，地质学家可以在不同深度测量。
ext.ext_en: By drilling, geologists can take measurements at various depths...

ext.ext_cn: 如果他感觉比平时热，量量他的体温。
ext.ext_en: If he feels hotter than normal, take his temperature.

defs.def_en: If you take a particular measurement, you use special equipment to find out what something measures.

ext.ext_cn: 那地方只能容纳大约 2,000 人。
ext.ext_en: The place could just about take 2,000 people.

defs.def_en: If a place or container takes a particular amount or number, there is enough space for that amount or number.

defs.def_cn: 穿(特定尺码的鞋或衣物)

ext.ext_cn: 英国47%的女性穿16码或更大号的。
ext.ext_en: 47 per cent of women in the UK take a size 16 or above.

defs.def_en: If you take a particular size in shoes or clothes, that size fits you.

ext.ext_cn: 如果可的松无效，我恐怕只能动手术了。
ext.ext_en: If the cortisone doesn't take, I may have to have surgery.

defs.def_en: If something such as a drug or a dye takes, it has the effect or result that is intended.

ext.ext_cn: 她就是拍不好——她总记不住台词，我们只好拍了好几遍。
ext.ext_en: She couldn't get it right — she never knew the lines and we had to do several takes.

defs.def_en: A take is a short piece of action which is filmed in one continuous process for a cinema or television film.

ext.ext_cn: 你对新政府怎么看？你认为它能行吗？
ext.ext_en: What's your take on the new government? Do you think it can work?...

ext.ext_cn: 那种事情会让你对自己产生新的认识。
ext.ext_en: That sort of thing gives you a different take on who you are.

defs.def_en: Someone's take on a particular situation or fact is their attitude to it or their interpretation of it.

defs.def_cn: 我自认为;我以为;我猜测

ext.ext_cn: 伯尔先生，想必您是凯林家的朋友吧？
ext.ext_en: I take it you're a friend of the Kellings, Mr Burr...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得你们俩都不读《泰晤士报》。
ext.ext_en: I take it that neither of you reads 'The Times'...

defs.def_en: You can say 'I take it' to check with someone that what you believe to be the case or what you understand them to mean is in fact the case, or is in fact what they mean.

ext.ext_cn: 信我的没错——这是一级方程式赛车手有史以来所取得的最高成就。
ext.ext_en: Take it from me — this is the greatest achievement by any Formula One driver ever.

defs.def_en: You can say 'take it from me' to tell someone that you are absolutely sure that what you are saying is correct, and that they should believe you.

defs.def_cn: 接不接受随你，要就要不要拉倒(不容讨价还价)

ext.ext_cn: 一星期 6 天，一天 12 小时，总共 72 小时，愿不愿意随你的便。
ext.ext_en: A 72-hour week, 12 hours a day, six days a week, take it or leave it.

defs.def_en: If you say to someone 'take it or leave it', you are telling them that they can accept something or not accept it, but that you are not prepared to discuss any other alternatives.

defs.def_cn: 忍受，甘受，屈从于(侮辱或攻击)

ext.ext_cn: 政府决不会甘心忍受这种批评。
ext.ext_en: The government is not taking such criticism lying down.

defs.def_en: If someone takes an insult or attack lying down, they accept it without protesting.

defs.def_cn: 使费尽力气;使精疲力竭

ext.ext_cn: 他看上去累坏了，似乎这场争论已使他精疲力尽。
ext.ext_en: He looked tired, as if the argument had taken a lot out of him...

ext.ext_cn: 养一大堆孩子让人心力交瘁。
ext.ext_en: Having loads of children takes it out of you.

defs.def_en: If something takes a lot out of you or takes it out of you, it requires a lot of energy or effort and makes you feel very tired and weak afterwards.

ext.ext_cn: 抽出一些时间和精力帮助别人可以使你忘却烦恼。
ext.ext_en: Donating time and energy to others can take you out of yourself.

defs.def_en: If something takes you out of yourself, it makes you feel better and so you forget all your worries and unhappiness.

defs.def_cn: 休息 5 分钟/休息 10 分钟
defs.def_en: If someone tells you to take five or to take ten, they are telling you to have a five or ten minute break from what you are doing.
Something that is royal blue is deep blue in colour.

defs.def_cn: (机器、车辆等)停止运转，出故障，出毛病

ext.ext_cn: 发电机出了故障，所以停电了。
