defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一次充实而激动人心的旅行
ext.ext_en: ...a life-enhancing and exciting trip...

ext.ext_cn: 他的信跟他的诗一样，读来令生活更添滋味，可谓一大乐事。
ext.ext_en: His letters, like his poetry, are life-enhancing and a delight.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as life-enhancing, you mean that it makes you feel happier and more content.

ext.ext_cn: 他说如果这些条件不能得到满足，反对派的要求会变得更激进。
ext.ext_en: He says the opposition will radicalize its demands if these conditions aren't met.

ext.ext_cn: 因女权主义而变得激进的妇女
ext.ext_en: ...women radicalized by feminism...

defs.def_en: If something radicalizes a process, situation, or person, it makes them more radical.

defs.def_cn: 无望成功的计划(或想法)

ext.ext_cn: 美国肯定会以无成功希望为由拒绝这项提案。
ext.ext_en: The United States is certain to reject the proposal as a non-starter...

ext.ext_cn: 她提出的有些观点的确不可行，但有一些确实很有道理。
ext.ext_en: Some of the points that she put were indeed non-starters but some of them were really quite reasonable.

defs.def_en: If you describe a plan or idea as a non-starter, you mean that it has no chance of success.

ext.ext_cn: 含汽矿泉水
ext.ext_en: ...an effervescent mineral water.

defs.def_en: An effervescent liquid is one that contains or releases bubbles of gas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 活泼欢快的;热情洋溢的；兴高采烈的

ext.ext_cn: 热情活泼的金发女演员
ext.ext_en: ...an effervescent blonde actress...

ext.ext_cn: 美国是学术、艺术和政治氛围最活跃的国家。
ext.ext_en: America is the most intellectually, artistically and politically effervescent of nations.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as effervescent, you mean that they are lively, entertaining, enthusiastic, and exciting.

ext.ext_cn: 特罗洛普家的所有男孩都是体格强壮、身材高大。
ext.ext_en: All the Trollope boys were heavily built and quite tall.

ext.ext_cn: 一位60岁、强壮结实的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a strong, powerfully-built man of 60...

defs.def_en: See also:well-built;If you say that someone is built in a particular way, you are describing the kind of body they have.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 过分肥胖的；臃肿的；虚胖的

ext.ext_cn: 发胖至少有一部分是源于遗传。
ext.ext_en: The tendency to become obese is at least in part hereditary...

ext.ext_cn: 胖人常常比瘦人血压高。
ext.ext_en: Obese people tend to have higher blood pressure than lean people.

defs.def_en: If someone is obese, they are extremely fat.
If you say that someone is a wet blanket, you are criticizing them because they refuse to join other people in an enjoyable activity or because they want to stop other people enjoying themselves.

defs.def_cn: （针对某人或某事的）言论开放期，自由抨击期

ext.ext_cn: “现在是可以对烟民自由开炮的时期。”我说道。
ext.ext_en: “It's open season on smokers,” I say.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is open season on someone or something, you mean that a lot of people are currently criticizing or attacking them.

ext.ext_cn: 当地商店可供选择的消费品很少。
ext.ext_en: The choice of consumer goods available in local shops is small.

defs.def_en: Consumer goods are items bought by people for their own use, rather than by businesses.
A printing press is a machine used for printing, especially one that can print books, newspapers, or documents in large numbers.
People sometimes refer to Australia and New Zealand as the Antipodes .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （声音或腔调）故作上流社会人士的

ext.ext_cn: 矫揉造作、拿腔拿调的电台播音员
ext.ext_en: ...precious, plummy-voiced radio announcers.

ext.ext_cn: 故作上流社会人士的口音
ext.ext_en: ...a plummy accent.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a plummy voice or accent, you mean that they sound very upper-class. You usually use plummy to criticize the way someone speaks.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 明确的;清晰的;毫不隐讳的

ext.ext_cn: 电影和书籍中露骨的性爱片段
ext.ext_en: ...sexually explicit scenes in films and books.

ext.ext_cn: 招聘广告中对年龄的明确要求
ext.ext_en: ...explicit references to age in recruitment advertising.

defs.def_en: Something that is explicit is expressed or shown clearly and openly, without any attempt to hide anything.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他直言自己的目的是改革党内的投票制度。
ext.ext_en: He was explicit about his intention to overhaul the party's internal voting system.

defs.def_en: If you are explicit about something, you speak about it very openly and clearly.
Clams are a kind of shellfish which can be eaten.
Crocuses are small white, yellow, or purple flowers that are grown in parks and gardens in the early spring.

ext.ext_cn: 他穿着一件系腰带的雨衣，使他发福的腰身更加显眼。
ext.ext_en: He wore a belted raincoat that accentuated his portly middle...

ext.ext_cn: 她穿着一件带束腰的棕色绒面革夹克。
ext.ext_en: She wore a brown suede jacket, belted at the waist.

defs.def_en: If someone's jacket or coat, for example, is belted, it has a belt fastened round it.

ext.ext_cn: 正如 1892 年剧本的副标题所强调的，《凯瑟琳》是一部“爱尔兰戏剧”。
ext.ext_en: 'Kathleen' was, as its 1892 subtitle asserted, 'An Irish Drama'.

defs.def_en: The subtitle of a piece of writing is a second title which is often longer and explains more than the main title.

ext.ext_cn: 对话是西班牙语，配有英语字幕。
ext.ext_en: The dialogue is in Spanish, with English subtitles.

defs.def_en: Subtitles are a printed translation of the words of a foreign film that are shown at the bottom of the picture.

defs.def_cn: （尤指用棍子等进行的）殴打，痛打

ext.ext_cn: 白人警察对一名黑人驾车者的野蛮殴打。
ext.ext_en: ...the savage beating of a black motorist by white police officers...

ext.ext_cn: 这个小组搞到了一些显示囚犯有被毒打痕迹的照片。
ext.ext_en: The team secured pictures of prisoners showing signs of severe beatings.

defs.def_en: If someone is given a beating, they are hit hard many times, especially with something such as a stick.

ext.ext_cn: 我们公司近几年败得一塌糊涂。
ext.ext_en: Our firm has taken a terrible beating in recent years.

defs.def_en: If something such as a business, a political party, or a team takes a beating, it is defeated by a large amount in a competition or election.

ext.ext_cn: 单从规模和气势来说，肯特的利兹城堡独领风骚。
ext.ext_en: For sheer scale and grandeur, Leeds Castle in Kent takes some beating.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will take some beating, you mean that it is very good and it is unlikely that anything better will be done or made.

ext.ext_cn: 酗酒能造成永久性大脑损伤。
ext.ext_en: Heavy drinking can cause permanent damage to the brain...

ext.ext_cn: 该问题一劳永逸的解决办法
ext.ext_en: ...a permanent solution to the problem...

defs.def_en: Something that is permanent lasts for ever.

defs.def_cn: （尤指问题或困难）不断出现的，一直存在的

ext.ext_cn: 长久以来的紧张局势
ext.ext_en: ...a permanent state of tension...

ext.ext_cn: 他们觉得一直处于威胁之下。
ext.ext_en: They feel under permanent threat...

defs.def_en: You use permanent to describe situations or states that keep occurring or which seem to exist all the time; used especially to describe problems or difficulties.

ext.ext_cn: 试用期结束后,你将成为长期雇员。
ext.ext_en: At the end of the probationary period you will become a permanent employee.

ext.ext_cn: 固定工作
ext.ext_en: ...a permanent job.

defs.def_en: A permanent employee is one who is employed for an unlimited length of time.

ext.ext_cn: 在孩子们眼中,约克小屋最像一个安定的家。
ext.ext_en: York Cottage was as near to a permanent home as the children knew...

ext.ext_cn: 他们没有固定居所。
ext.ext_en: They had no permanent address.

defs.def_en: Your permanent home or your permanent address is the one at which you spend most of your time or the one that you return to after having stayed in other places.
A permanent is a treatment where a hair stylist curls your hair and treats it with a chemical so that it stays curly for several months.

ext.ext_cn: 河水在桥的周围荡漾。
ext.ext_en: The water sloshed around the bridge...

ext.ext_cn: 他喝了一口廉价的葡萄酒，在嘴巴里来回咂摸着。
ext.ext_en: He took a mouthful of the cheap wine and sloshed it around his mouth...

defs.def_en: If a liquid sloshes around or if you slosh it around, it moves around in different directions.

defs.def_cn: 踩着(水或泥浆等)走;扑哧扑哧地走

ext.ext_cn: 两个女孩挽着胳膊，一道趟过了泥浆。
ext.ext_en: The two girls joined arms and sloshed through the mud together.

defs.def_en: If you slosh through mud or water, you walk through it in an energetic way, so that the mud or water makes sounds as you walk.
You can refer to clothes that you wear to parties and other special occasions as your glad rags .

ext.ext_cn: 古时可能很少对狗或猫进行阉割。
ext.ext_en: In the ancient world, it was probably rare to castrate a dog or cat.

ext.ext_cn: 阉割的公马
ext.ext_en: ...a castrated male horse.

defs.def_en: To castrate a male animal or a man means to remove his testicles.
A cormorant is a type of dark-coloured bird with a long neck. Cormorants usually live near the sea and eat fish.

ext.ext_cn: 挂黄色糖衣的生日蛋糕
ext.ext_en: ...a birthday cake with yellow icing.

defs.def_en: Icing is a sweet substance made from powdered sugar that is used to cover and decorate cakes.

ext.ext_cn: 第三粒进球是锦上添花。
ext.ext_en: The third goal was the icing on the cake.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as the icing on the cake, you mean that it makes a good thing even better, but it is not essential.

ext.ext_cn: 一台新的视觉效果一流的宽屏电视
ext.ext_en: ...a new top-of-the-range widescreen TV.

defs.def_en: A widescreen television has a screen that is wide in relation to its height.

defs.def_cn: 梦想不到的；想象不到的

ext.ext_cn: 这种新设计将会给您带来意想不到的舒适、安全和快捷。
ext.ext_en: This new design will offer undreamed-of levels of comfort, safety and speed...

ext.ext_cn: 当那封信被送上门来之后，整个计划变得意想不到地复杂起来。
ext.ext_en: This project has complications undreamed of when the letter came through the door...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as undreamed of, you are emphasizing that it is much better, worse, or more unusual than you thought was possible.

ext.ext_cn: 蒸汽机车喷出一团团白烟。
ext.ext_en: Steam locomotives pumped out clouds of white smoke.

defs.def_en: A locomotive is a large vehicle that pulls a railway train.

ext.ext_cn: 他膝关节韧带拉伤了。
ext.ext_en: He suffered torn ligaments in his knee.

defs.def_en: A ligament is a band of strong tissue in a person's body which connects bones.

defs.def_cn: 先前存在的；先于…而存在的

ext.ext_cn: 两国之间已经存在的紧张局势
ext.ext_en: ...the pre-existing tensions between the two countries.

ext.ext_cn: 因已患疾病接受国民健康保障治疗但在治疗过程中被感染的人
ext.ext_en: ...people who have been infected in the course of their NHS treatment for a pre-existing illness.

defs.def_en: A pre-existing situation or thing exists already or existed before something else.

defs.def_cn: (用于形容词、名词后)表示“以…为核心的”

ext.ext_cn: 柠檬夹心白巧克力
ext.ext_en: ...lemon-centered white chocolates.

defs.def_en: See also:centre;self-centred;-centred can be added to adjectives and nouns to indicate what kind of a centre something has.
Testosterone is a hormone found in men and male animals, which can also be produced artificially. It is thought to be responsible for the male sexual instinct and other male characteristics.
A dacha is a country house in Russia.

defs.def_cn: (出了小事故或向某人道歉时的感叹语)哎呀

ext.ext_cn: 哎呀，出了个小差错。
ext.ext_en: Whoops, that was a mistake...

ext.ext_cn: 哎呀，11点多了，我最好还是回家吧。
ext.ext_en: Whoops, it's past 11, I'd better be off home.

defs.def_en: You say 'whoops' to indicate that there has been a slight accident or mistake, or to apologize to someone for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他讲演的大部分时间都在反驳对他外交政策的批评。
ext.ext_en: He spent most of his speech rebutting criticisms of his foreign policy.

defs.def_en: If you rebut a charge or criticism that is made against you, you give reasons why it is untrue or unacceptable.

defs.def_cn: （事情）进展很顺利；（人）精力充沛，热情洋溢，冲劲十足

ext.ext_cn: 经济依然保持着强劲的发展势头。
ext.ext_en: The economy was still going gangbusters...

ext.ext_cn: 该队前面打得很艰难，但就在关键时刻拼出了士气。
ext.ext_en: The team, who struggled early, came on like gangbusters at precisely the right time.

defs.def_en: If something is going gangbusters, it is going strongly and doing very well. If someone comes on like gangbusters, they behave very energetically and sometimes aggressively.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 重要的;必要的;非常有价值的

ext.ext_cn: 她生命中最重要的是她的儿子们。
ext.ext_en: Her sons are the most important thing in her life...

ext.ext_cn: 这场有计划的总罢工是政府面临的一个重大经济挑战。
ext.ext_en: The planned general strike represents an important economic challenge to the government...

defs.def_en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有声望的;有影响的;显要的

ext.ext_cn: 他是岛上最有声望的人。
ext.ext_en: He was the most important person on the island.

ext.ext_cn: 传媒界很有影响力的人物
ext.ext_en: ...an important figure in the media world.

defs.def_en: Someone who is important has influence or power within a society or a particular group.
Piety is strong religious belief, or behaviour that is religious or morally correct.

defs.def_cn: （尤指士兵的）突击训练场，障碍训练场
defs.def_en: An assault course is an area of land covered with obstacles such as walls which people, especially soldiers, use to improve their skills and strength.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这伙人过去一直是出了名的善变。
ext.ext_en: The group has been notoriously fickle in the past.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as fickle, you disapprove of them because they keep changing their mind about what they like or want.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 奥尔塔的天气变幻莫测。
ext.ext_en: Orta's weather can be fickle.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is fickle, you mean that it often changes and is unreliable.

defs.def_cn: （广告用语）或接近买方出价，可还价
defs.def_en: In advertisements, o.n.o. is used after a price to indicate that the person who is selling something is willing to accept slightly less money than the sum they have mentioned. o.n.o. is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) 'or near offer'.

defs.def_cn: （男子在正式场合穿的）燕尾服，晚礼服
defs.def_en: A tailcoat is a man's coat which is short at the front with long pieces at the back. Tailcoats were popular in the 19th century and are now worn only for very formal occasions, such as weddings.

ext.ext_cn: 将油加热，然后放入鱼片煎炸。
ext.ext_en: Heat the oil and deep-fry the fish fillets.

ext.ext_cn: 炸鸡和炸薯条
ext.ext_en: ...deep-fried chicken and chips.

defs.def_en: If you deep-fry food, you fry it in a large amount of fat or oil.

defs.def_cn: 与…相当;符合…标准;比得上

ext.ext_cn: 她的事业从来都没有预期的那样好。
ext.ext_en: Her career never quite matched up to its promise.

ext.ext_cn: 父亲无法达到儿子的期望
ext.ext_en: ...a father's inability to match up to the expectations of his son...

defs.def_en: If someone or something does not match up to what was expected, they are smaller, less impressive, or of poorer quality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他脸皮厚，不怕她嘲弄。
ext.ext_en: He was thick-skinned enough to cope with her taunts.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is thick-skinned, you mean that they are not easily upset by criticism or unpleasantness.

defs.def_cn: 临时的；暂时性的；暂定的

ext.ext_cn: 建立一个临时联合政府的可能性
ext.ext_en: ...the possibility of setting up a provisional coalition government...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你从未有过驾照，那就应该申请一个临时的。
ext.ext_en: If you have never held a driving licence before, you should apply for a provisional licence...

defs.def_en: You use provisional to describe something that has been arranged or appointed for the present,  but may be changed in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 美国禁毒署称被捕的4个人都是分量十足的大鱼。
ext.ext_en: The four men arrested were described as really big fish by the U.S. Drug Enforcement Agency.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a big fish, you believe that they are powerful or important in some way.

defs.def_cn: 小池塘里的大鱼；小地方的大人物

ext.ext_cn: 在南非，贾尼可谓塘中无鱼虾为大。
ext.ext_en: In South Africa, Jani was a big fish in a small pond.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a big fish in a small pond, you mean that they are powerful or important but only within a small group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 露西拉经常要姐姐们把这个故事反复讲给她听。
ext.ext_en: Lucilla often asks her sisters to retell the story...

ext.ext_cn: 这是西印度群岛文学中广为流传的故事。
ext.ext_en: It is a tale which has often been retold within West Indian literature.

defs.def_en: If you retell a story, you write it, tell it, or present it again, often in a different way from its original form.
A stag party is the same as a stag night .

ext.ext_cn: 潜水员向海岸走去时，铅坠和氧气罐使他们步履维艰。
ext.ext_en: Lead weights and air cylinders encumbered the divers as they walked to the shore...

ext.ext_cn: 它现在仍旧被20世纪80年代就深受其累的债务压得喘不过气。
ext.ext_en: It is still labouring under the debt burden that it was encumbered with in the 1980s.

defs.def_en: If you are encumbered by something, it prevents you from moving freely or doing what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 狭窄的码头被数百辆手推车堵得水泄不通。
ext.ext_en: The narrow quay was encumbered by hundreds of carts.

defs.def_en: If a place is encumbered with things, it contains so many of them that it is difficult to move freely there.

ext.ext_cn: 专门为拨弦设计的一段音乐
ext.ext_en: ...a piece designed to be played pizzicato.

ext.ext_cn: 延长了的拨奏部分
ext.ext_en: ...an extended pizzicato section.

defs.def_en: If a stringed instrument is played pizzicato, it is played by pulling the strings with the fingers rather than by using the bow.

defs.def_cn: 法律（上）的；司法的；法制的

ext.ext_cn: 他誓言要采取法律行动。
ext.ext_en: He vowed to take legal action.

ext.ext_cn: 英国的法律体系
ext.ext_en: ...the British legal system...

defs.def_en: Legal is used to describe things that relate to the law.

ext.ext_cn: 我所做的绝对合法。
ext.ext_en: What I did was perfectly legal.

ext.ext_cn: 血液中酒精含量超过法定限度的司机
ext.ext_en: ...drivers who have more than the legal limit of alcohol.

defs.def_en: An action or situation that is legal is allowed or required by law.

defs.def_cn: 不规则的曲线;波形曲线
defs.def_en: A squiggle is a line that bends and curls in an irregular way.

ext.ext_cn: 他极富魅力而且非常有幽默感。
ext.ext_en: He had enormous charm and a great sense of humour.

ext.ext_cn: 有着怪异幽默感的人
ext.ext_en: ...someone with a very warped sense of humour.

defs.def_en: Someone who has a sense of humour often finds things amusing, rather than being serious all the time.
A houseboy is a man or boy who cleans and does other jobs in someone else's house.

ext.ext_cn: 西欧的农产品供过于求。
ext.ext_en: There's a glut of agricultural products in Western Europe.

ext.ext_cn: 全球石油供应过剩
ext.ext_en: ...a world oil glut.

defs.def_en: If there is a glut of something, there is so much of it that it cannot all be sold or used.

ext.ext_cn: 该地区的医院数量已经饱和。
ext.ext_en: The region is glutted with hospitals...

ext.ext_cn: 从战场返乡的士兵挤爆了劳动力市场。
ext.ext_en: Soldiers returning from the war had glutted the job market.

defs.def_en: If a market is glutted with something, there is a glut of that thing.

defs.def_cn: （大批地）居住于，生活于，栖居于

ext.ext_cn: 在所有这一切发生之前，这个岛上居住的是印第安阿拉瓦克人。
ext.ext_en: Before all this the island was populated by native American Arawaks.

ext.ext_cn: 生活在周围村庄的当地信德人
ext.ext_en: ...native Sindhis, who populate the surrounding villages.

defs.def_en: If an area is populated by certain people or animals, those people or animals live there, often in large numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 各继任政权吞并了该地区，并将低地的人们迁移到了这里。
ext.ext_en: Successive regimes annexed the region and populated it with lowland people.

defs.def_en: To populate an area means to cause people to live there.

ext.ext_cn: 占据法国政权上层的勤勉、审慎的技术专家型官员
ext.ext_en: ...the diligent and discreet technocrats who populate the upper reaches of French power.

ext.ext_cn: 电影里那种来自下层社会的人物
ext.ext_en: ...the sort of low-life characters who populate the film.

defs.def_en: The people or characters who populate an area of public life or a piece of entertainment are the people or characters in it.
A dealing room is a place where shares, currencies, or commodities are bought and sold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无针对性的;随便的;任意的;漫无目的的

ext.ext_cn: 该报告谴责美国对工人的培训毫无针对性。
ext.ext_en: The report condemns America's scattershot approach to training workers.

defs.def_en: A scattershot approach or method involves doing something to a lot of things or people in disorganized way, rather than focusing on particular things or people.
A mountaineer is a person who is skilful at climbing the steep sides of mountains.
If you describe someone as a sexpot, you mean that they are sexually very attractive.
Sea water is salt water from the sea.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 具有异国情调的;外来的;奇异的

ext.ext_cn: 色彩斑斓的奇异花卉
ext.ext_en: ...brilliantly coloured, exotic flowers...

ext.ext_cn: 她辗转于异国他乡。
ext.ext_en: She flits from one exotic location to another.

defs.def_en: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting, usually because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

ext.ext_cn: 一派胡言！
ext.ext_en: What a load of balderdash!

defs.def_en: If you say that something that has been said or written is balderdash, you think it is completely untrue or very stupid.

ext.ext_cn: 我家药柜里的压箱宝要算是那不起眼的阿司匹林。
ext.ext_en: The star of my medicine cabinet is the humble aspirin...

ext.ext_cn: 他看着陈列柜,里面摆着几套晶莹剔透的玻璃杯。
ext.ext_en: He looked at the display cabinet with its gleaming sets of glasses.

defs.def_en: See also:filing cabinet;A cabinet is a cupboard used for storing things such as medicine or alcoholic drinks or for displaying decorative things in.

ext.ext_cn: 在唐宁街进行了长达3个小时的内阁会议后发布了这份公告。
ext.ext_en: The announcement came after a three-hour Cabinet meeting in Downing Street.

ext.ext_cn: 前内阁大臣
ext.ext_en: ...a former Cabinet Minister.

defs.def_en: The Cabinet is a group of the most senior ministers in a government, who meet regularly to discuss policies.  →see usage note at:government
A sanitary napkin is the same as a sanitary towel .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 鉴于该地区很受人们青睐，最好提前预订旅馆或宿营地。
ext.ext_en: Because of the popularity of the region, it is advisable to book hotels or camp sites in advance...

ext.ext_cn: 怀孕28周以后的准妈妈一般不宜乘坐飞机出行。
ext.ext_en: It is generally not advisable for expectant mothers to travel by air after the 28th week of pregnancy.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone that it is advisable to do something, you are suggesting that they should do it, because it is sensible or is likely to achieve the result they want.

ext.ext_cn: 他突然涌起一股对她的温柔怜悯之情。
ext.ext_en: He felt a sudden tender pity for her...

ext.ext_cn: 她知道自己是朋友同情的对象。
ext.ext_en: She knew that she was an object of pity among her friends.

defs.def_en: See also:self-pity;If you feel pity for someone, you feel very sorry for them.

ext.ext_cn: 我不知道该恨他，还是该同情他。
ext.ext_en: I don't know whether to hate or pity him.

defs.def_en: If you pity someone, you feel very sorry for them.

ext.ext_cn: 非常遗憾的是，在这个城市里，并非所有的学生都能获得同样的机会。
ext.ext_en: It is a great pity that all pupils in the city cannot have the same chances...

ext.ext_cn: 可惜你还没有车，不是吗？
ext.ext_en: Pity you haven't got your car, isn't it...

defs.def_en: If you say that it is a pity that something is the case, you mean that you feel disappointment or regret about it.

ext.ext_cn: 一个人应该避免显得太过仁慈。
ext.ext_en: One should avoid showing too much pity...

ext.ext_cn: 她从他们的脸上看不到慈悲。
ext.ext_en: She saw no pity in their faces.

defs.def_en: If someone shows pity, they do not harm or punish someone they have power over.

ext.ext_cn: 可惜的是，我们是两个世界的人。
ext.ext_en: But my world isn't your world, more's the pity.

defs.def_en: If you add more's the pity to a comment, you are expressing your disappointment or regret about something.

defs.def_cn: （尤在恼怒或不快时用于强调）行行好，发发慈悲吧

ext.ext_cn: “跑，凯瑟琳，快跑！”他尖叫道。
ext.ext_en: 'Run, Katherine. For pity's sake run!' he screamed.

defs.def_en: You can say for pity's sake to add emphasis to what you are saying, especially when you are annoyed or upset.

defs.def_cn: 对…表示同情；对…表示怜悯

ext.ext_cn: 以前从没有女性觉得他需要同情。
ext.ext_en: No woman had ever felt the need to take pity on him before.

defs.def_en: If you take pity on someone, you feel sorry for them and help them.

defs.def_cn: （用于强调）可惜的是，遗憾的是

ext.ext_cn: 遗憾的是这完全没有必要。
ext.ext_en: The pity is that it was all completely unnecessary...

ext.ext_cn: 可惜的是美国人不打板球。
ext.ext_en: The pity of it was that the Americans didn't play cricket.

defs.def_en: If you say the pity is that, or the pity of it is that, before a comment, you are emphasizing your disappointment or regret about something.

ext.ext_cn: 用一用你的常识吧。
ext.ext_en: Use your common sense...

ext.ext_cn: 她一直都有很强的直觉判断力。
ext.ext_en: She always had a lot of common sense.

defs.def_en: Your common sense is your natural ability to make good judgments and to behave in a practical and sensible way.

ext.ext_cn: 老百姓和军事当局之间缺乏协调
ext.ext_en: ...the lack of co-ordination between the civilian and military authorities.

ext.ext_cn: 经济政策的协调
ext.ext_en: ...the co-ordination of economic policy.

defs.def_en: Co-ordination means organizing the activities of two or more groups so that they work together efficiently and know what the others are doing.

ext.ext_cn: 身体笨拙而且缺乏协调能力
ext.ext_en: ...clumsiness and lack of co-ordination...

ext.ext_cn: 要想提高手眼协调能力，就练习投球和接球。
ext.ext_en: To improve hand-eye co-ordination, practise throwing and catching balls.

defs.def_en: Co-ordination is the ability to use the different parts of your body together efficiently.

ext.ext_cn: 托尼宣布该做午饭了。
ext.ext_en: Tony announced it was time to see about lunch...

ext.ext_cn: 我必须安排房子的销售事宜。
ext.ext_en: I must see about selling the house.

defs.def_en: When you see about something, you arrange for it to be done or provided.

ext.ext_cn: 意大利电视台绝对不会放过对黑手党的关注。
ext.ext_en: The Mafia is by no means ignored by Italian television.

defs.def_en: The Mafia is a criminal organization that makes money illegally, especially by threatening people and dealing in drugs.

defs.def_cn: 黑帮;势力集团;秘密犯罪团伙

ext.ext_cn: 他们同以南方为大本营的教育改革势力集团有着密切的联系。
ext.ext_en: They are well-connected with the south-based education-reform mafia.

defs.def_en: You can use mafia to refer to an organized group of people who you disapprove of because they use unfair or illegal means in order to get what they want.

ext.ext_cn: 晚育的女性经常会成为最优秀的母亲。
ext.ext_en: Women who put off having a baby often make the best mothers...

ext.ext_cn: 协会已把这次活动推迟至10月。
ext.ext_en: The Association has put the event off until October.

defs.def_en: If you put something off, you delay doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 老牧师搪塞他们说时间太晚了。
ext.ext_en: The old priest tried to put them off, saying that the hour was late.

defs.def_en: If you put someone off, you make them wait for something that they want.

ext.ext_cn: 离婚的人很多，但这好像并没有打消人们对结婚的热情。
ext.ext_en: The high divorce figures don't seem to be putting people off marriage...

ext.ext_cn: 他们很讨厌他的一些个人习惯。
ext.ext_en: His personal habits put them off...

defs.def_en: If something puts you off something, it makes you dislike it, or decide not to do or have it.

ext.ext_cn: 她要求我严肃一点——说如果我笑的话会使她分心。
ext.ext_en: She asked me to be serious — said it put her off if I laughed...

ext.ext_cn: 这影响了她复习备考。
ext.ext_en: It put her off revising for her exams.

defs.def_en: If someone or something puts you off, they take your attention from what you are trying to do and make it more difficult for you to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 顺利的;没问题的;没困难的

ext.ext_cn: 狂欢节开幕进行得几乎是一帆风顺，警方只报告了一例拘捕。
ext.ext_en: The carnival got off to a virtually trouble-free start with the police reporting only one arrest.

defs.def_en: Something that is trouble-free does not cause any problems or difficulties.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是个大腹便便的胖子，长着皱纹的脸很和善。
ext.ext_en: He was a heavy man, paunchy, with a lined, kind face.

defs.def_en: A man who is paunchy has a fat stomach.

ext.ext_cn: 复杂的算术方程式
ext.ext_en: ...complex arithmetical formulae.

defs.def_en: Arithmetical calculations, processes, or skills involve the addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division of numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 从年初起，已有 300 多人饿死。
ext.ext_en: Over three hundred people have died of starvation since the beginning of the year.

defs.def_en: Starvation is extreme suffering or death, caused by lack of food.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （通常指男士）大肚子的，大腹便便的
defs.def_en: Someone, usually a man, who is pot-bellied has a pot belly.

ext.ext_cn: 美国国家航空航天局在它的计算结果中发现了一个数学错误。
ext.ext_en: NASA discovered a mathematical error in its calculations...

ext.ext_cn: 议员们抨击管理的松散和判断的失误。
ext.ext_en: MPs attacked lax management and errors of judgment.

defs.def_en: An error is something you have done which is considered to be incorrect or wrong, or which should not have been done.

ext.ext_cn: 一枚北约的导弹误将那架飞机击落。
ext.ext_en: The plane was shot down in error by a NATO missile.

defs.def_en: If you do something in error or if it happens in error, you do it or it happens because you have made a mistake, especially in your judgment.

ext.ext_cn: 我想找个机会开导他一下，好让他认识到自己做错了。
ext.ext_en: I wanted an opportunity to talk some sense into him and try to make him see the error of his ways.

defs.def_en: If someone sees the error of their ways, they realize or admit that they have made a mistake or behaved badly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 个性强势的;左右他人的

ext.ext_cn: 她在政坛上无疑是一个强势人物。
ext.ext_en: She certainly was a dominating figure in politics...

ext.ext_cn: 那个男孩被他的母亲带大，母亲对他一生起着决定性的影响。
ext.ext_en: The boy was brought up by his mother, who was a dominating influence in his life.

defs.def_en: A dominating person has a very strong personality and influences the people around them.

ext.ext_cn: 施瓦茨科普夫将军否认曾经有任何掩饰行为。
ext.ext_en: General Schwarzkopf denied there'd been any cover-up.

defs.def_en: A cover-up is an attempt to hide a crime or mistake.

defs.def_cn: (谋杀政治对手、罪犯等的)死亡小队，暗杀小组
defs.def_en: Death squads are groups of people who operate illegally and carry out the killing of people such as their political opponents or criminals.

defs.def_cn: 信奉同一宗教的人;同一教派的人

ext.ext_cn: 他们支持他们的教友，这不足为奇。
ext.ext_en: Not surprisingly, they supported their co-religionists.

defs.def_en: A person's co-religionists are people who have the same religion.

ext.ext_cn: 有 34 人在排队投票时遭到残杀。
ext.ext_en: Thirty four people were slaughtered while queuing up to cast their votes...

ext.ext_cn: 仍然有人为了商业利益大肆捕杀鲸鱼和海豚。
ext.ext_en: Whales and dolphins are still being slaughtered for commercial gain.

defs.def_en: If large numbers of people or animals are slaughtered, they are killed in a way that is cruel or unnecessary.

ext.ext_cn: 鸡饲料的缺乏意味着养鸡场将不得不杀掉饲养的鸡。
ext.ext_en: Lack of chicken feed means that chicken farms are having to slaughter their stock.

ext.ext_cn: 去年有 491,000 多只羊被出口到欧洲大陆供宰杀。
ext.ext_en: More than 491,000 sheep were exported to the Continent for slaughter last year.

defs.def_en: To slaughter animals such as cows and sheep means to kill them for their meat.  →see usage note at:kill

defs.def_cn: (教堂的)唱诗班;(学校的)合唱队，合唱团

ext.ext_cn: 他打6岁起一直在教堂唱诗班里唱歌。
ext.ext_en: He has been singing in his church choir since he was six.

defs.def_en: A choir is a group of people who sing together, for example in a church or school.
In a church building, the choir is the area in front of the altar where the choir sits.

defs.def_cn: 重罪;最不可饶恕的事;严重过失

ext.ext_cn: 我犯了从医的大忌:跟病人有了感情纠葛。
ext.ext_en: I committed the physician's cardinal sin: I got involved with my patients.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action as a cardinal sin, you are indicating that some people strongly disapprove of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉昏昏欲睡，只好尽量克制睡意。
ext.ext_en: He felt pleasantly drowsy and had to fight off the urge to sleep.

defs.def_en: If you feel drowsy, you feel sleepy and cannot think clearly.
A tragi-comedy is a play or other written work that is both sad and amusing.

ext.ext_cn: 她将这一判决称为真理对谬误的胜利。
ext.ext_en: She called the verdict a victory of truth over falsehood.

defs.def_en: Falsehood is the quality or fact of being untrue or of being a lie.

ext.ext_cn: 他指责他们故意散布有关他的谎言。
ext.ext_en: He accused them of knowingly spreading falsehoods about him.

defs.def_en: A falsehood is a lie.

defs.def_cn: 大声急促地说出（命令或问题）

ext.ext_cn: 她不断大声地发号施令：“向上点，向下点，就那样做。”
ext.ext_en: She kept rapping out orders: 'Up a bit, down a bit, do it like that.'...

ext.ext_cn: “我们怎么会知道？”莱斯特突然大声说道。
ext.ext_en: 'How do we know that?' rapped out Lester.

defs.def_en: If you rap out an order or a question, you say it quickly and sharply.

ext.ext_cn: 位于布劳顿街的共济会会所
ext.ext_en: ...a Masonic lodge on Broughton Street.

defs.def_en: Masonic is used to describe things relating to the organization of Freemasons.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我感到胸口堵得难受。
ext.ext_en: I felt a tremendous pressure on my chest...

ext.ext_cn: 当地居民与难民之间关系非常紧张。
ext.ext_en: There's tremendous tension between the local population and the refugees…

defs.def_en: You use tremendous to emphasize how strong a feeling or quality is, or how large an amount is.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是个非常了不起的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a tremendous person…

ext.ext_cn: 我认为它精彩极了。
ext.ext_en: I thought it was absolutely tremendous.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone or something as tremendous when you think they are very good or very impressive.
Indices is a plural form of index .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他有些惊讶地瞥了罗宾一眼。
ext.ext_en: He gave Robin a mildly quizzical glance.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a quizzical look or smile, you look at them in a way that shows that you are surprised or amused by their behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 食物是用银质大浅盘盛着的。
ext.ext_en: The food was being served on silver platters.

ext.ext_cn: 一浅盘一浅盘的火腿和鸡肉三明治
ext.ext_en: ...platters of ham and chicken sandwiches.

defs.def_en: A platter is a large, flat plate used for serving food.

ext.ext_cn: 低热量的水果奶油冻或蛋奶酥作甜点，或者奶酪拼盘
ext.ext_en: ...a low-calorie fruit mousse or souffle for dessert, or a cheese platter.

defs.def_en: A platter is a large flat plate which has different kinds of the same food on, especially cheese and fruit.
On a ship, the purser is an officer who deals with the accounts and official papers. On a passenger ship, the purser is also responsible for the welfare of the passengers.

ext.ext_cn: 他通过网络把作品发给了出版商。
ext.ext_en: He sent his work to his publishers by modem.

defs.def_en: A modem is a device which uses a telephone line to connect computers or computer systems.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国的一名男发言人说，该代表团将携带 20 吨救济物资。
ext.ext_en: A UN spokesman said that the mission will carry 20 tons of relief supplies.

defs.def_en: A spokesman is a male spokesperson.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 典型年轻人的；年轻放浪的；年少不羁的

ext.ext_cn: 经纪人对他们年轻放浪的形象和相伴而来的恣意纵酒的行为毫不担心。
ext.ext_en: Their manager is unconcerned at the laddish image and the drinking that goes with it.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as laddish, you mean that they behave in a way that people think is typical of young men, for example by being rough and noisy, drinking a lot of alcohol, and having a bad attitude towards women.
A wood-burning stove is the same as a wood stove .

ext.ext_cn: 游行队伍长达数英里。
ext.ext_en: The procession stretched for several miles...

ext.ext_cn: 他从脖子到臀部均被烧伤。
ext.ext_en: He had burns that stretched from his neck to his hips.

defs.def_en: Something that stretches over an area or distance covers or exists in the whole of that area or distance.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一段非常危险的路。
ext.ext_en: It's a very dangerous stretch of road...

ext.ext_cn: 洛斯特里弗的这片水域又宽又深。
ext.ext_en: This stretch of Lost River was broader and deeper.

defs.def_en: A stretch of road, water, or land is a length or area of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他打了个呵欠，伸了伸懒腰。
ext.ext_en: He yawned and stretched...

ext.ext_cn: 试着双腿伸直并且向上拉伸脚趾。
ext.ext_en: Try stretching your legs and pulling your toes upwards...

defs.def_en: When you stretch, you put your arms or legs out straight and tighten your muscles.

ext.ext_cn: 他曾在法国南部呆过一段时间，法语流利。
ext.ext_en: He was fluent in French, having spent stretches of time in Southern France.

ext.ext_cn: 在部队生活了 18 个月后
ext.ext_en: ...after an 18-month stretch in the army...

defs.def_en: A stretch of time is a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 随着反堕胎抗议进入第二周
ext.ext_en: ...as anti-abortion protests stretched into their second week...

ext.ext_cn: 该谈判可能会延续至 1993 年夏天。
ext.ext_en: The talks could be stretched into the summer of 1993.

defs.def_en: If an event or activity stretches or is stretched into a further period of time, it continues into that period, which is later than expected.

defs.def_cn: (从一个时间)持续(至另一个时间)

ext.ext_cn: 从早上 7 点持续到晚上 8 点的工作日
ext.ext_en: ...a working day that stretches from seven in the morning to eight at night.

defs.def_en: If something stretches from one time to another, it begins at the first time and ends at the second, which is longer than expected.

ext.ext_cn: 从化学制品到食糖均有涉足的贸易帝国
ext.ext_en: ...a trading empire, with interests that stretched from chemicals to sugar.

defs.def_en: If a group of things stretch from one type of thing to another, the group includes a wide range of things.

ext.ext_cn: 该电缆不能拉伸。
ext.ext_en: The cables are designed not to stretch...

ext.ext_cn: 将油酥面团小心地移至烤盘的各角，注意不要把它拉长。
ext.ext_en: Ease the pastry into the corners of the tin, making sure you don't stretch it.

defs.def_en: When something soft or elastic stretches or is stretched, it becomes longer or bigger as well as thinner, usually because it is pulled.

ext.ext_cn: 莱卡等有弹性的织物
ext.ext_en: ...stretch fabrics such as Lycra.

ext.ext_cn: 弹力棉制泳衣
ext.ext_en: ...stretch cotton swimsuits.

defs.def_en: Stretch fabric is soft and elastic and stretches easily.

ext.ext_cn: 他们习惯于精打细算。
ext.ext_en: They're used to stretching their budgets...

ext.ext_cn: 他上年纪时省下的收入足够买一辆旧车了。
ext.ext_en: During his senior year his earnings stretched far enough to buy an old car.

defs.def_en: If you stretch an amount of something or if it stretches, you make it last longer than it usually would by being careful and not wasting any of it.

defs.def_cn: 刚能够节约下来(或支付)

ext.ext_cn: 她建议我可以开始定期存钱，我说我还不知道钱是不是够花呢。
ext.ext_en: She suggested to me that I might like to start regular savings and I said Well, I don't know whether I can stretch to that.

defs.def_en: If your resources can stretch to something, you can just afford to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 那里的旱灾正在耗尽美国的财力物力。
ext.ext_en: The drought there is stretching American resources...

ext.ext_cn: 因为要救济 300 万失业人口，公共支出即将被耗尽。
ext.ext_en: Public expenditure was being stretched to the limit by having to support 3 million unemployed people.

defs.def_en: If something stretches your money or resources, it uses them up so you have hardly enough for your needs.

defs.def_cn: 使竭尽所能;使全力以赴;使拿出全部本领

ext.ext_cn: 我正想换工作，想尝试点不一样的事情来挑战一下自己。
ext.ext_en: I'm trying to move on and stretch myself with something different...

ext.ext_cn: 他们批评教学质量太差，声称没有使学生们发挥出潜质。
ext.ext_en: They criticised the quality of teaching, claiming pupils were not stretched enough.

defs.def_en: If you say that a job or task stretches you, you mean that you like it because it makes you work hard and use all your energy and skills so that you do not become bored or achieve less than you should.

defs.def_cn: (通常指为够到某东西而)尽量伸长手臂

ext.ext_cn: 他伸长胳膊把打火机递了过去。
ext.ext_en: He offered his lighter at full stretch.

defs.def_en: If you are at full stretch, your arm is straight and extended as far as possible, usually because you are trying to reach something that is almost too far away.

ext.ext_cn: 每个人都将全力以赴。
ext.ext_en: Everyone would be working at full stretch.

defs.def_en: If you are at full stretch, you are using the maximum amount of effort or energy.

defs.def_cn: 任凭怎么想也(不);再怎么说也(不)

ext.ext_cn: 她老公绝对不是个拈花惹草的人。
ext.ext_en: Her husband was not a womaniser by any stretch of the imagination...

ext.ext_cn: 他的演讲再怎么说也不缺乏人情味。
ext.ext_en: By no stretch of the imagination could his speech be described as impersonal.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not true or possible by any stretch of the imagination, you are emphasizing that it is completely untrue or absolutely impossible.

defs.def_cn: (久坐之后)散散步，活动活动腿脚

ext.ext_cn: 我在广场处停下来，下车活动活动腿脚。
ext.ext_en: I stopped at the square and got out to stretch my legs.

defs.def_en: If you stretch your legs, you go for a short walk, usually after you have been sitting down for a long time.

defs.def_cn: 牵强附会;勉强说得过去

ext.ext_cn: 把这称为审查有点儿牵强。
ext.ext_en: It is stretching a point to call this censorship.

defs.def_en: If you stretch a point, you describe something in a way which is not accurate, although it may be partly true.

defs.def_cn: 克里姆林宫（位于莫斯科，为俄罗斯政府处理公务的地方）

ext.ext_cn: 在克里姆林宫召开的为时两小时的会议
ext.ext_en: ...a two hour meeting in the Kremlin.

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯中央政府依然坚持通过外交方式解决危机。
ext.ext_en: The Kremlin is still insisting on a diplomatic solution to the crisis.

defs.def_en: The Kremlin is the building in Moscow where Russian government business takes place.

ext.ext_cn: 他们想设计一种既美观又实用的机械。
ext.ext_en: They wanted to design a machine that was both attractive and practical.

ext.ext_cn: 脚踏特制皮靴的男子
ext.ext_en: ...men wearing specially designed boots.

defs.def_en: When someone designs a garment, building, machine, or other object, they plan it and make a detailed drawing of it from which it can be built or made.

defs.def_cn: 设计(调查问卷);规划;制订

ext.ext_cn: 我们或许可以专门设计一门课程以满足你的特殊需求。
ext.ext_en: We may be able to design a course to suit your particular needs...

ext.ext_cn: 计算机安全系统将由独立的技师来设计。
ext.ext_en: Computer security systems will be designed by independent technicians...

defs.def_en: When someone designs a survey, policy, or system, they plan and prepare it, and decide on all the details of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他生来就是个有设计天赋的机械师。
ext.ext_en: He was a born mechanic with a flair for design...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数移动机器人仍处在设计阶段。
ext.ext_en: Most mobile robots are still in the design stage...

defs.def_en: Design is the process and art of planning and making detailed drawings of something.

ext.ext_cn: 通过改善计算机的设计，这些机器不断得到更新。
ext.ext_en: These machines are constantly updated by improving the design of the computers.

ext.ext_cn: 新款时钟
ext.ext_en: ...a new design of clock...

defs.def_en: The design of something is the way in which it has been planned and made.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在一周内就画出了房子的图样。
ext.ext_en: They drew up the design for the house in a week.

defs.def_en: A design is a drawing which someone produces to show how they would like something to be built or made.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的整套餐具上都饰有黑莓图案。
ext.ext_en: Their range of tableware is decorated with a blackberry design...

ext.ext_cn: 许多画都是基于简单的几何图案。
ext.ext_en: Many pictures have been based on simple geometric designs.

defs.def_en: A design is a pattern of lines, flowers, or shapes which is used to decorate something.

ext.ext_cn: 让他呆在中间是不是有什么目的？
ext.ext_en: Is there some design in having him in the middle?...

ext.ext_cn: 情报机构策划了一项暗杀陆军部长的重大计划。
ext.ext_en: The intelligence service conceived a grand design to assassinate the War Minister.

defs.def_en: A design is a general plan or intention that someone has in their mind when they are doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 这一项目旨在帮助那些没有土地的人。
ext.ext_en: This project is designed to help landless people...

ext.ext_cn: 它不是为18岁以下者设计的。
ext.ext_en: It's not designed for anyone under age eighteen.

defs.def_en: If something is designed for a particular purpose, it is intended for that purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 这两个人经常见面——开始是偶然的，后来就是有意的了。
ext.ext_en: The pair met often — at first by chance but later by design.

defs.def_en: If something happens or is done by design, someone does it deliberately, rather than by accident.

ext.ext_cn: 他的上校在打他妻子的主意。
ext.ext_en: His colonel had designs on his wife...

ext.ext_cn: 希腊一直强调它对这片领土没有任何企图。
ext.ext_en: Greece has always stressed that it had no designs on the territory.

defs.def_en: If someone has designs on something, they want it and are planning to get it, often in a dishonest way.
A red-headed person is a person whose hair is between red and brown in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 破坏乡村景致的人
ext.ext_en: ...people who despoil the countryside.

ext.ext_cn: 遭到煤矿开采和重工业破坏的景观
ext.ext_en: ...a landscape despoiled by coal-mining and heavy industry.

defs.def_en: To despoil a place means to make it less attractive, valuable, or important by taking things away from it or by destroying it.

defs.def_cn: 携带武器（通常为枪支）的

ext.ext_cn: 市警方称那名男子携带了一支左轮手枪。
ext.ext_en: City police said the man was armed with a revolver.

ext.ext_cn: 有武装警卫巡逻的带刺铁丝网围栏
ext.ext_en: ...a barbed-wire fence patrolled by armed guards...

defs.def_en: Someone who is armed is carrying a weapon, usually a gun.

ext.ext_cn: 我呼吁每个人都放弃使用暴力和武装斗争。
ext.ext_en: I call on everyone to renounce the use of violence and armed struggle...

ext.ext_cn: 他们被判犯有持械抢劫罪。
ext.ext_en: They had been found guilty of armed robbery.

defs.def_en: An armed attack or conflict involves people fighting with guns or carrying weapons.

defs.def_cn: 北美印第安人（具冒犯意味）
defs.def_en: Native Americans who were living in North America when Europeans arrived there used to be called Red Indians. This use could cause offence.

defs.def_cn: （沙漠或其他干旱地区动物饮水的）水坑，水洼
defs.def_en: In a desert or other dry area, a water hole is a pool of water where animals can drink.
In football, the keeper is the same as the goalkeeper.
In American football, a keeper is a play in which the quarterback keeps the ball.
A keeper at a zoo is a person who takes care of the animals.

defs.def_cn: （博物馆或美术馆的）馆长，主任
defs.def_en: The keeper of a museum or art gallery, or of one part of it, is the person who is responsible for the things in it.

ext.ext_cn: “我不知道他在哪儿，”休斯回答说。“我又不是他的保姆。”
ext.ext_en: 'I don't know where he is,' Hughes replied. 'I'm not his keeper.'

defs.def_en: If you say that you are not someone's keeper, you mean that you are not responsible for what they do or for what happens to them.
A concierge is a person, especially in France, who looks after a block of flats and checks people entering and leaving the building.

ext.ext_cn: 我先佯作向左然后再向右。
ext.ext_en: I feinted to the left, then to the right...

ext.ext_cn: 他们虚晃一招，然后集中兵力攻打敌方最坚固的阵线。
ext.ext_en: They feinted and concentrated forces against the most fortified line of the enemy side.

defs.def_en: In sport or military conflict, if someone feints, they make a brief movement in a different direction from the one they intend to follow, as a way of confusing or deceiving their opponent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 遍布鹅卵石的湖岸
ext.ext_en: ...the lake's pebbly shore.

defs.def_en: A pebbly beach is covered in pebbles.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不友好的;脾气坏的;粗鲁的

ext.ext_cn: 他要是拒绝的话，她就会认为他不够友好。
ext.ext_en: She would think him churlish if he refused...

ext.ext_cn: 房间太漂亮了，要是再争辩的话就会显得很无礼。
ext.ext_en: The room was so lovely it seemed churlish to argue.

defs.def_en: Someone who is churlish is unfriendly, bad-tempered, or impolite.

defs.def_cn: (尤指写于20世纪中期之前，有歌舞穿插于故事中，幽默轻松的)歌舞喜剧，歌舞喜剧电影

ext.ext_cn: 在大都会歌剧院的试唱失败后，她转而投身歌舞喜剧。
ext.ext_en: After failing a singing audition at the Metropolitan Opera, she turned to musical comedy.

defs.def_en: Musical comedy is a type of play or film that has singing and dancing as part of the story and that is humorous and entertaining, especially one written before the middle of the twentieth century.

ext.ext_cn: 他嘴唇发干，眼睛圆睁，全身开始颤抖起来。
ext.ext_en: His mouth became dry, his eyes widened, and he began to tremble all over...

ext.ext_cn: 吉尔脸色发白，气得直发抖。
ext.ext_en: Gil was white and trembling with anger...

defs.def_en: If you tremble, you shake slightly because you are frightened or cold.

ext.ext_cn: 他感到大地在脚下颤动。
ext.ext_en: He felt the earth tremble under him...

ext.ext_cn: 树上的叶子瑟瑟抖动。
ext.ext_en: The leaves trembled in the trees.

defs.def_en: If something trembles, it shakes slightly.

defs.def_cn: (通常因难过或紧张而声音)发颤，颤抖

ext.ext_cn: 他声音颤抖，泪水在眼眶里打转。
ext.ext_en: His voice trembled, on the verge of tears.

ext.ext_cn: “请理解这一点，”她开始说道，声音有些发颤。
ext.ext_en: 'Please understand this,' she began, a tremble in her voice.

defs.def_en: If your voice trembles, it sounds unsteady and uncertain, usually because you are upset or nervous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人不快的；令人不舒服的

ext.ext_cn: 那些症状可能令人不适，很不舒服甚至会比较严重。
ext.ext_en: The symptoms can be uncomfortable, unpleasant and serious...

ext.ext_cn: 那个真空吸尘器有股很难闻的气味。
ext.ext_en: The vacuum has an unpleasant smell...

defs.def_en: If something is unpleasant, it gives you bad feelings, for example by making you feel upset or uncomfortable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她认为他是个粗鲁的人。
ext.ext_en: She thought him an unpleasant man...

ext.ext_cn: 不要开始给我找麻烦，否则我就不客气了。
ext.ext_en: Don't start giving me problems otherwise I'll have to be very unpleasant indeed.

defs.def_en: An unpleasant person is very unfriendly and rude.
A fryer is a type of deep pan which you can use to fry food in hot oil.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以通过电话购买保险。
ext.ext_en: You can buy insurance over the phone...

ext.ext_cn: 她盼望着能打电话和女儿交谈。
ext.ext_en: She looked forward to talking to her daughter by phone...

defs.def_en: The phone is an electrical system that you use to talk to someone else in another place, by dialling a number on a piece of equipment and speaking into it.

ext.ext_cn: 两分钟后电话响了。
ext.ext_en: Two minutes later the phone rang...

ext.ext_cn: 道格14岁的儿子杰米接了电话。
ext.ext_en: Doug's 14-year-old son Jamie answered the phone.

defs.def_en: See also:cellular phone;mobile phone;The phone is the piece of equipment that you use when you dial someone's phone number and talk to them.

ext.ext_cn: 她拿起电话听筒，开始拨打莫里斯·坎贝尔的号码。
ext.ext_en: She picked up the phone, and began to dial Maurice Campbell's number...

ext.ext_cn: 她颤抖着放下电话听筒，电话几乎立刻又响了起来。
ext.ext_en: Trembling, she put the phone down. It rang again almost immediately.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone picks up or puts down the phone, you mean that they lift or replace the receiver.

ext.ext_cn: 他打电话给劳拉看她是不是好些了。
ext.ext_en: He'd phoned Laura to see if she was better...

ext.ext_cn: 我等她电话的时候，越等越生气。
ext.ext_en: I got more and more angry as I waited for her to phone.

defs.def_en: When you phone someone, you dial their phone number and speak to them by phone.

ext.ext_cn: 她老来电话，想知道我在做什么。
ext.ext_en: She's always on the phone, wanting to know what I've been up to.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is on the phone, you mean that they are speaking to someone else by phone.

defs.def_cn: 装了电话的；可用电话联系的

ext.ext_cn: 福罗斯特家没装电话。
ext.ext_en: The Frosts were not on the phone.

defs.def_en: If you are on the phone, you have a phone in your home or place of work, so that you can be contacted by phone.
A cocked hat is a hat with three corners that used to be worn with some uniforms.

defs.def_cn: (在质量或重要性上)远远胜过

ext.ext_cn: 这一设计令其他作品相形见绌。
ext.ext_en: This design knocks everything else into a cocked hat.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing knocks another thing into a cocked hat, you mean that it is much better or much more significant than the other thing.
Anybody means the same as anyone .  →see usage note at:anyone

ext.ext_cn: 我是被迫从事这个行业的。
ext.ext_en: I was press-ganged into working in that business...

ext.ext_cn: 她是一个志愿者，不一定非是受人迫使的。
ext.ext_en: She was a volunteer, she hadn't had to be press-ganged.

defs.def_en: If you are press-ganged into doing something, you are made or persuaded to do it, even though you do not really want to.

ext.ext_cn: 为了不被抓去当兵，他们逃离了自己的村庄。
ext.ext_en: They left their villages to evade being press-ganged into the army...

ext.ext_cn: 政府否认强征妇女入伍。
ext.ext_en: The government denies that the women were press-ganged.

defs.def_en: If people are press-ganged, they are captured and forced to join the army or navy.

defs.def_cn: （旧时为海军抓壮丁的）征兵队

ext.ext_cn: 海军不得不让征兵队强制征兵。
ext.ext_en: The navy resorted to the press-gang.

defs.def_en: In former times, a press-gang was a group of men who used to capture boys and men and force them to join the navy.

ext.ext_cn: 十二门徒
ext.ext_en: ...the twelve apostles.

defs.def_en: The apostles were the followers of Jesus Christ who went from place to place telling people about him and trying to persuade them to become Christians.

defs.def_cn: （政策或思想等的）信奉者，倡导者，鼓吹者

ext.ext_cn: 她母亲是健康饮食矢志不渝的倡导者。
ext.ext_en: Her mother was a dedicated apostle of healthy eating.

defs.def_en: An apostle of a particular philosophy, policy, or cause is someone who strongly believes in it and works hard to promote it.

ext.ext_cn: 他很活跃，还和他们开玩笑。
ext.ext_en: He perks up and jokes with them.

ext.ext_cn: 让你发笑、使你开心的建议
ext.ext_en: ...suggestions to make you smile and perk you up.

defs.def_en: If something perks you up or if you perk up, you become cheerful and lively, after feeling tired, bored, or depressed.

ext.ext_cn: 为了使这淡而无味的东西更有味道，当地人开始加些土特产调味。
ext.ext_en: To make the bland taste more interesting, the locals began perking it up with local produce...

ext.ext_cn: 心理转折使原本老套的故事情节变得生动有趣。
ext.ext_en: Psychological twists perk up an otherwise predictable story line.

defs.def_en: If you perk something up, you make it more interesting.

ext.ext_cn: 秋季房价可能上涨。
ext.ext_en: House prices could perk up during the autumn...

ext.ext_cn: 所有能够为公司节省开支、增加流动资金的办法都研究过了。
ext.ext_en: Anything that could save the company money and perk up its cash flow was examined.

defs.def_en: If sales, prices, or economies perk up, or if something perks them up, they begin to increase or improve.

ext.ext_cn: 他去打扫猪圈了。
ext.ext_en: He stamped off to muck out the pigsty...

ext.ext_cn: 就这样清扫。
ext.ext_en: Here's how to muck out.

defs.def_en: If you muck out a stable or a farm animal's home, you clean out all the faeces and old hay.

defs.def_cn: 劫持（飞机或其他交通工具）

ext.ext_cn: 两名男子试图劫持一架从里加飞往摩尔曼斯克的飞机。
ext.ext_en: Two men tried to hijack a plane on a flight from Riga to Murmansk...

ext.ext_en: Governor William Livingston addressed the New Jersey Assembly.

defs.def_en: In some systems of government, a governor is a person who is in charge of the political administration of a region or state.

ext.ext_cn: 董事们运用赋予他们的更大权力罢免不称职的校长。
ext.ext_en: Governors are using the increased powers given to them to act against incompetent headteachers.

ext.ext_en: ...the chairman of the BBC board of governors.

defs.def_en: A governor is a member of a committee which controls an organization such as a school or a hospital.

ext.ext_cn: 这一事件已汇报给监狱长。
ext.ext_en: The incident was reported to the prison governor.

defs.def_en: In some British institutions, the governor is the most senior official, who is in charge of the institution.
