ext.ext_cn: 一场流感正席卷莫斯科。
ext.ext_en: A flu epidemic is sweeping through Moscow.

ext.ext_cn: 致命的黄热病的流行
ext.ext_en: ...a killer epidemic of yellow fever.

defs.def_en: If there is an epidemic of a particular disease somewhere, it affects a very large number of people there and spreads quickly to other areas.

ext.ext_cn: 连环杀人现象的猖獗
ext.ext_en: ...an epidemic of serial killings...

ext.ext_cn: 禁毒专家说它可能会结束强效可卡因吸食泛滥的局面。
ext.ext_en: Drug experts say it could spell the end of the crack epidemic.

defs.def_en: If an activity that you disapprove of is increasing or spreading rapidly, you can refer to this as an epidemic of that activity.
Roman numerals are the letters used by the ancient Romans to represent numbers, for example I, IV, VIII, and XL, which represent 1, 4, 8, and 40. Roman numerals are still sometimes used today.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第22个字母
defs.def_en: V is the twenty-second letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_cn: （用于首字母为v的一些单词的缩写，如verse, versus, very和volt)

ext.ext_cn: 纽卡斯尔联队对莱斯特城队
ext.ext_en: ...Newcastle United v Leicester City.

defs.def_en: V or v is an abbreviation for words beginning with v, such as 'verse', 'versus', 'very', and 'volt'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沉寂的;静态的;不活动的

ext.ext_cn: 政治上波澜不兴、甚至马首是瞻的社会
ext.ext_en: ...a society which was politically quiescent and above all deferential.

ext.ext_cn: 宁静的南方海滨小城
ext.ext_en: ...a quiescent Southern seaside town.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is quiescent is quiet and inactive.
In Britain, a municipality is a city or town which is governed by its own locally-appointed officials. You can also refer to a city's or town's local government as a municipality .

defs.def_cn: (美国能自行选举政府的)自治市
defs.def_en: In the United States, a municipality is a city or town that is incorporated and can elect its own government, which is also called a municipality .

ext.ext_cn: 我们的医生诊断是喉部感染，并且开了一些抗生素和小剂量阿司匹林。
ext.ext_en: Our doctor diagnosed a throat infection and prescribed antibiotic and junior aspirin...

ext.ext_cn: 她服用了双倍医嘱剂量的安眠药片。
ext.ext_en: She took twice the prescribed dose of sleeping tablets...

defs.def_en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

ext.ext_cn: 规定了总统选举方法的宪法第二条
ext.ext_en: ...article II of the constitution, which prescribes the method of electing a president...

ext.ext_cn: 阿利奥特告诉辛格尔顿他是依法判决。
ext.ext_en: Alliott told Singleton he was passing the sentence prescribed by law.

defs.def_en: If a person or set of laws or rules prescribes an action or duty, they state that it must be carried out.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一项旨在帮助长期失业者的新的培训计划有望出台。
ext.ext_en: A new training scheme to help the long-term unemployed is expected...

ext.ext_cn: 该协会相信新技术将可长远地解决信用卡诈骗问题。
ext.ext_en: The association believes new technology will provide a long-term solution to credit card fraud.

defs.def_en: Something that is long-term has continued for a long time or will continue for a long time in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 公司的长期目标是希望在莫斯科和其他大城市开门营业。
ext.ext_en: In the long term the company hopes to open in Moscow and other major cities...

ext.ext_cn: 长远来看，这些措施可能只会使潜在问题恶化。
ext.ext_en: Over the long term, such measures may only make the underlying situation worse.

defs.def_en: When you talk about what happens in the long term, you are talking about what happens over a long period of time, either in the future or after a particular event.

defs.def_cn: (尤指用于制作大衣或毛毯的)带毛的羊皮，羊毛皮革

ext.ext_cn: 羊皮袄
ext.ext_en: ...a sheepskin coat.

defs.def_en: Sheepskin is the skin of a sheep with the wool still attached to it, used especially for making coats and rugs.
Joists are long thick pieces of metal, wood, or concrete that form part of the structure of a building, usually to support a floor or ceiling.

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦像这样的地下通道有9英里长。
ext.ext_en: London has 9 miles of such subterranean passages.

defs.def_en: A subterranean river or tunnel is under the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 这座房子十分宽敞，现代化生活设施一应俱全，距离车站很近，而且还有一个花园。
ext.ext_en: The house is spacious with all mod cons, handy for the station and has a garden.

defs.def_en: Mod cons are the modern facilities in a house that make it easy and pleasant to live in.
Someone's sexual orientation is whether they are sexually attracted to people of the same sex, people of the opposite sex, or both.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯特很想谈谈陆军生活。
ext.ext_en: Robert was eager to talk about life in the Army...

ext.ext_cn: 我家儿子5岁的时候，我特别想再要一个孩子。
ext.ext_en: When my own son was five years old, I became eager for another baby...

defs.def_en: If you are eager to do or have something, you want to do or have it very much.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （看起来或听上去）急切的，期盼的

ext.ext_cn: 阿蒂对他身边那些期盼的面孔嗤之以鼻。
ext.ext_en: Arty sneered at the crowd of eager faces around him...

ext.ext_cn: 她的声音像个小姑娘似的，而且带着一股急不可耐。
ext.ext_en: Her voice was girlish and eager.

defs.def_en: If you look or sound eager, you look or sound as if you expect something interesting or enjoyable to happen.

defs.def_cn: 温室气体（主要为二氧化碳）
defs.def_en: Greenhouse gases are the gases which are responsible for causing the greenhouse effect. The main greenhouse gas is carbon dioxide.
A homing pigeon is a pigeon that is trained to return to a particular place, especially in races with other pigeons.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有识别力的;有眼力的;有洞察力的

ext.ext_cn: 为懂行的旅游者量身打造的假期
ext.ext_en: ...tailor-made holidays to suit the more discerning traveller...

ext.ext_cn: 她孩提时培养起的对收藏的痴迷丝毫未减，现在只是变得更有眼力了。
ext.ext_en: Her childhood passion for collecting has not dimmed, but now she is more discerning.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as discerning, you mean that they are able to judge which things of a particular kind are good and which are bad.

defs.def_cn: 可证明的;可论证的;可表明的;明显的

ext.ext_cn: 道路安全方案在道路使用者身上逐渐显现出明显的效果。
ext.ext_en: The road safety programme is having a demonstrable effect on road users...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然其速度和安全性都可得到证明，但这种船还是不受欢迎。
ext.ext_en: Despite its demonstrable speed and safety, the boat failed to become popular.

defs.def_en: A demonstrable fact or quality can be shown to be true or to exist.

ext.ext_cn: 90 or more to a collector... 这些书对收藏家而言可能值八九十英镑或更多。
ext.ext_en: These books might be worth £80 or £

ext.ext_cn: 他母亲继承了一处年产值为1.5万美元的农场。
ext.ext_en: His mother inherited a farm worth 15,000 dollars a year...

defs.def_en: If something is worth a particular amount of money, it can be sold for that amount or is considered to have that value.

ext.ext_cn: 我去买了大约6美元的薯条。
ext.ext_en: I went and bought about six dollars' worth of potato chips...

ext.ext_cn: 现在大批鹿群在森林里游荡，造成价值几十亿卢布的损失。
ext.ext_en: Large numbers of deer now roam the forests and are causing thousands of millions of roubles-worth of damage.

defs.def_en: Worth combines with amounts of money, so that when you talk about a particular amount of money's worth of something, you mean the quantity of it that you can buy for that amount of money.

ext.ext_cn: 你有可维持3年的研究经费去做自己想做的事。
ext.ext_en: You've got three years' worth of research money to do what you want with...

ext.ext_cn: 经过1小时15分钟的清洁、柔肤和精心护理后，我的皮肤摸上去感觉大不一样。
ext.ext_en: After an hour and a quarter's-worth of cleansing, toning and pampering, the difference to the way my skin felt was remarkable.

defs.def_en: Worth combines with time expressions, so you can use worth when you are saying how long an amount of something will last. For example, a week's worth of food is the amount of food that will last you for a week.

ext.ext_cn: 他决定去瞧瞧那座房子，看是否值得买下。
ext.ext_en: He's decided to get a look at the house and see if it might be worth buying...

ext.ext_cn: 如果这是他的工作所需，那么这份工作真的不值得去做。
ext.ext_en: If this was what his job required, then the job wasn't really worth having...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is worth having, you mean that it is pleasant or useful, and therefore a good thing to have.

defs.def_cn: 具有(某一行动)的价值;值得(做)

ext.ext_cn: 没有谁值得付出重大的牺牲。
ext.ext_en: No one is worth a great deal of sacrifice...

ext.ext_cn: 我在这艘船上花了很多金钱和时间，但都很值得。
ext.ext_en: I am spending a lot of money and time on this boat, but it is worth it...

defs.def_en: If something is worth a particular action, or if an action is worth doing, it is considered to be important enough for that action.

ext.ext_cn: 他从来没有过像她这样值得交往的女性朋友。
ext.ext_en: He had never had a woman of her worth as a friend...

ext.ext_cn: 这支队伍需要一位他这样技术水平的司机。
ext.ext_en: The team would have need of a driver of his worth.

defs.def_en: Someone's worth is the value, usefulness, or importance that they are considered to have.

defs.def_cn: 拼命地; 全力以赴地；热情高涨地

ext.ext_cn: 我们俩开始使劲地朝人群挥手。
ext.ext_en: We both began waving to the crowd for all we were worth...

ext.ext_cn: 使足劲推！
ext.ext_en: Push for all you're worth!

defs.def_en: If you do something for all you are worth, you do it with a lot of energy and enthusiasm.

defs.def_cn: 尽可能地利用;充分利用

ext.ext_cn: 你若想让法律援助多少发挥点作用，只有充分利用这一制度。
ext.ext_en: You get anywhere with legal aid only by playing the system for all it is worth.

ext.ext_cn: 选取一种观点并对其充分加以挖掘
ext.ext_en: ...taking an idea and exploiting it for all it's worth.

defs.def_en: If someone does something for all it is worth, they do it as much as possible and for as long as they can get benefit from it.

defs.def_cn: (尤为避免显得傲慢)不管好坏，不管有没有用

ext.ext_cn: 不管怎么样，我觉得威士忌放冰很好。
ext.ext_en: For what it's worth, my feeling is that ice in whisky is fine...

ext.ext_cn: 不管有没有用，我反正把我的笔记带来了。
ext.ext_en: I've brought my notes, for what it's worth.

defs.def_en: If you add for what it's worth to something that you say, you are suggesting that what you are saying or referring to may not be very valuable or helpful, especially because you do not want to appear arrogant.

defs.def_cn: (行为或活动)值得…去做，对…有好处

ext.ext_cn: 上法庭要求对协议进行改动也许对你有益。
ext.ext_en: It might be worth your while to go to court and ask for the agreement to be changed...

ext.ext_cn: 你会发现游览之前先了解一下各岛的特色非常有帮助。
ext.ext_en: You'll find it well worth your while to learn something of each island's special features before visiting them.

defs.def_en: If an action or activity is worth someone's while, it will be helpful, useful, or enjoyable for them if they do it, even though it requires some effort.

ext.ext_cn: 担心世界人口过剩的年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...young persons who are concerned about overpopulation in the world.

defs.def_en: If there is a problem of overpopulation in an area, there are more people living there than can be supported properly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 线条被蚀刻得如此精细，在远处看都看不见。
ext.ext_en: The lines were so finely etched as to be invisible from a distance...

ext.ext_cn: 这种腰带即便在最薄的衣衫下都看不出来。
ext.ext_en: The belt is invisible even under the thinnest garments.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as invisible, you mean that it cannot be seen, for example because it is transparent, hidden, or very small.

ext.ext_cn: 父母担心他们可能会逾越这些无形的界限。
ext.ext_en: Parents fear they might overstep these invisible boundaries...

ext.ext_cn: 她父亲的脸突然僵硬了,仿佛是被无形的双手扼住了脖子。
ext.ext_en: Her father's face had suddenly tightened as though he was being strangled by invisible hands.

defs.def_en: You can use invisible when you are talking about something that cannot be seen but has a definite effect. In this sense, invisible is often used before a noun which refers to something that can usually be seen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 被人忽视的;不为人注意的

ext.ext_cn: 一名办事员会感到如此受人忽视，令人觉得不可思议。
ext.ext_en: It was strange, how invisible a clerk could feel...

ext.ext_cn: 穷人的问题大多不受重视。
ext.ext_en: The problems of the poor are largely invisible.

defs.def_en: If you say that you feel invisible, you are complaining that you are being ignored by other people. If you say that a particular problem or situation is invisible, you are complaining that it is not being considered or dealt with.

defs.def_cn: (故事中的人或事物)隐身的，隐形的

ext.ext_cn: 《隐形人》
ext.ext_en: ...The Invisible Man.

defs.def_en: In stories, invisible people or things have a magic quality which makes people unable to see them.

ext.ext_cn: 旅游业是英国最大的一项无形输出。
ext.ext_en: Tourism is Britain's single biggest invisible export...

ext.ext_cn: 旅游业收入是该国无形收益当中最大的一项。
ext.ext_en: The revenue from tourism is the biggest single item in the country's invisible earnings...

defs.def_en: In economics, invisible earnings are the money that a country makes as a result of services such as banking and tourism, rather than by producing goods.

defs.def_cn: 无形服务业(如银行业、旅游业)
defs.def_en: Invisibles are services such as banking and tourism, which provide a country's invisible earnings.

defs.def_cn: 芦荟叶汁（常用于化妆品）；芦荟
defs.def_en: Aloe vera is a substance that contains vitamins and minerals and is often used in cosmetics. Aloe vera is also the name of the plant from which this substance is extracted.

defs.def_cn: 运动型多用途车(缩略形式为 SUV)
defs.def_en: A sport utility vehicle is a powerful vehicle with four-wheel drive that can be driven over rough ground. The abbreviation SUV is often used.

ext.ext_cn: 从撒克逊时代起就开始采伐塞文山谷的这些树林获取木料。
ext.ext_en: These Severn Valley woods have been exploited for timber since Saxon times.

ext.ext_cn: 木质平房
ext.ext_en: ...a single-story timber building.

defs.def_en: Timber is wood that is used for building houses and making furniture. You can also refer to trees that are grown for this purpose as timber .

ext.ext_cn: 栖息于屋顶横梁上的鸟
ext.ext_en: ...a bird nestling in the timbers of the roof.

defs.def_en: The timbers of a ship or house are the large pieces of wood that have been used to build it.

ext.ext_cn: 巴黎和华沙之间的中点位置
ext.ext_en: ...the midpoint between Paris and  Warsaw.

ext.ext_cn: 房子前院的中心位置
ext.ext_en: ...the midpoint of the front of your house.

defs.def_en: The midpoint between two things is the point that is the same distance from both things.

ext.ext_cn: 她的人生还没有走到一半。
ext.ext_en: She has not yet reached the midpoint of her life.

ext.ext_cn: 本财政年度的中期
ext.ext_en: ...the midpoint in the current fiscal year.

defs.def_en: The midpoint of an event is the time halfway between the beginning and the end of it.
Stretch marks are lines or marks on someone's skin caused by the skin stretching after the person's weight has changed rapidly. Women who have had children often have stretch marks.
An unlit fire or cigarette has not been made to start burning.
An unlit street or building is dark because there are no lights switched on in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是个很严厉的人，非常挑剔。
ext.ext_en: He is a very rigorous man, very persnickety.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as persnickety, you think that they pay too much attention to small, unimportant details.

ext.ext_cn: 他们或许是着便装的士兵。
ext.ext_en: They might have been soldiers in civvies.

defs.def_en: People in the armed forces use civvies to refer to ordinary clothes that are not part of a uniform.

ext.ext_cn: 猛男照片
ext.ext_en: ...beefcake photos.

defs.def_en: Attractive men with large muscles can be referred to as beefcake.

defs.def_cn: 各式各样的;五颜六色的;混杂的

ext.ext_cn: 那一周会过得很开心，晚上可以在西部高地上的各式旅馆里过夜。
ext.ext_en: It should be a great week, with overnight stops in assorted hotels in the West Highlands.

ext.ext_cn: 12至18号的泳衣，颜色各异
ext.ext_en: ...swimsuits, sizes 12-18, in assorted colours.

defs.def_en: A group of assorted things is a group of similar things that are of different sizes or colours or have different qualities.
A head teacher is a teacher who is in charge of a school.
A cactus is a thick fleshy plant that grows in many hot, dry parts of the world. Cacti have no leaves and many of them are covered in prickles.

ext.ext_cn: 这种家常汤的额外优点是烹制时间短。
ext.ext_en: The bonus of this homely soup is the brevity of its cooking time.

ext.ext_cn: 我担心这封信写得太短。
ext.ext_en: The brevity of the letter concerned me.

defs.def_en: The brevity of something is the fact that it is short or lasts for only a short time.
Berries are small, round fruit that grow on a bush or a tree. Some berries are edible, for example blackberries and raspberries.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他有些惊讶地瞥了罗宾一眼。
ext.ext_en: He gave Robin a mildly quizzical glance.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a quizzical look or smile, you look at them in a way that shows that you are surprised or amused by their behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 皇宫影业公司发行了两部颂扬我们文学遗产的精彩影片。
ext.ext_en: Palace has released two marvellous films that pay homage to our literary heritage...

ext.ext_cn: 在他的加冕典礼上，威尔士、诺森布里亚和苏格兰的国王向他宣誓效忠。
ext.ext_en: At his coronation he received the homage of kings from Wales, Northumbria and Scotland.

defs.def_en: Homage is respect shown towards someone or something you admire, or to a person in authority.

ext.ext_cn: 她用背顶门，直到门向内打开。
ext.ext_en: She pressed back against the door until it swung inwards...

ext.ext_cn: 脚跟不要离地,脚向内转。
ext.ext_en: Keeping your heels on the ground, turn your feet inwards.

defs.def_en: If something moves or faces inwards, it moves or faces towards the inside or centre of something.
A topographical survey or map relates to or shows the physical features of an area of land, for example its hills, valleys, and rivers.

ext.ext_cn: 为期三年旨在克服对男女同性恋者、双性恋者和跨性别者所持偏见的项目
ext.ext_en: ...a three-year-project designed to overcome prejudice towards gay, lesbian, bisexual and transgender people.

ext.ext_cn: 卡伦说她是个跨性别者——一个渴望成为女人并被女人所吸引的男人。
ext.ext_en: Karen said she is a transgender — a man who wants to be a woman and is attracted to women.

defs.def_en: Transgender people, such as transsexuals, do not have a straightforward gender identity.

ext.ext_cn: 他听见外面一阵骚动。
ext.ext_en: He heard a commotion outside...

ext.ext_cn: 现在能听见楼下人声鼎沸。
ext.ext_en: Sounds of voices and commotion could be heard downstairs now.

defs.def_en: A commotion is a lot of noise, confusion, and excitement.
Sarcoma is one of the two main forms of cancer. It affects tissues such as muscle and bone.

defs.def_cn: （通常在私家车库进行的）旧货出售
defs.def_en: If you have a garage sale, you sell things such as clothes, toys and household items that you do not want, usually in your garage.

ext.ext_cn: 米尔斯当过团长。
ext.ext_en: Mills was regimental colonel.

defs.def_en: Regimental means belonging to a particular regiment.

ext.ext_cn: 刚才我稍稍离题说明了迄今的情况，现在让我来概述一下。
ext.ext_en: I've digressed a little to explain the situation so far, so let me now recap...

ext.ext_cn: 她脱离了发言稿的主题，对总统给予了高度赞扬。
ext.ext_en: She digressed from her prepared speech to pay tribute to the President.

defs.def_en: If you digress, you move away from the subject you are talking or writing about and talk or write about something different for a while.

defs.def_cn: 二等的;无足轻重的;地位低下的

ext.ext_cn: 太多的航空公司把我们的孩子当作二等公民对待。
ext.ext_en: Too many airlines treat our children as second-class citizens.

defs.def_en: If someone treats you as a second-class citizen, they treat you as if you are less valuable and less important than other people.

ext.ext_cn: 我没有料到会发现在这个国家的一些地区孩子们只能接受二流的教育。
ext.ext_en: I am not prepared to see children in some parts of this country having to settle for a second-class education.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as second-class, you mean that it is of poor quality.

ext.ext_cn: 他坐在一节二等车厢的角落里。
ext.ext_en: He sat in the corner of a second-class carriage...

ext.ext_cn: 7 名普通舱的旅客准备下船。
ext.ext_en: Seven second-class passengers prepared to disembark.

defs.def_en: The second-class accommodation on a train or ship is the ordinary accommodation, which is cheaper and less comfortable than the first-class accommodation.

defs.def_cn: (邮件)第二类的,(英国)廉价慢递的,(美国)投递报刊的

ext.ext_cn: 第二类邮件所贴的邮票
ext.ext_en: ...a second-class stamp.

ext.ext_cn: 第二类信件
ext.ext_en: ...second class letters.

defs.def_en: In Britain, second-class postage is the slower and cheaper type of postage. In the United States, second-class postage is the type of postage that is used for sending newspapers and magazines.

defs.def_cn: (英国的大学学位)二级优等的

ext.ext_cn: 至少须获得二级优等荣誉学位。
ext.ext_en: A second-class honours degree is the minimum requirement.

defs.def_en: In Britain, a second-class degree is a good university degree, but not as good as a first-class degree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 虽然篇幅很长，而且情节复杂，但是《阿斯塔的书》仍不失为一部内容丰富、值得一读的作品。
ext.ext_en: Despite its length and convoluted plot, 'Asta's Book' is a rich and rewarding read...

ext.ext_cn: 这项政策太令人费解，甚至连大学校长们也是一头雾水。
ext.ext_en: The policy is so convoluted even college presidents are confused.

defs.def_en: If you describe a sentence, idea, or system as convoluted, you mean that it is complicated and difficult to understand.

ext.ext_cn: 他用某种黑色的黏糊糊的东西粉刷地板。
ext.ext_en: He had painted the floors with some kind of black gunge.

defs.def_en: You use gunge to refer to a soft, sticky substance, especially if it is unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 大量的车流改道经过我家前门。
ext.ext_en: The heavy traffic was re-routed past my front door...

ext.ext_cn: 他们改变了拉瓜迪亚机场飞机的航线。
ext.ext_en: They rerouted the planes at La Guardia airport.

defs.def_en: If vehicles or planes are re-routed, they are directed along a different route because the usual route cannot be used.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指地方、气候或活动）宜人的，提神的，令人心旷神怡的，令人精神焕发的

ext.ext_cn: 舒心惬意的散步
ext.ext_en: ...a bracing walk.

defs.def_en: If you describe something, especially a place, climate, or activity as bracing, you mean that it makes you feel fresh and full of energy.

defs.def_cn: 传心术;读心术;心灵感应

ext.ext_cn: 我们许多人感觉很难用语言表达自己的需求，希望别人能通过心灵感应了解我们的感受。
ext.ext_en: Many of us find it very difficult to state our needs. We expect people to know by telepathy what we are feeling.

defs.def_en: If you refer to telepathy, you mean the direct communication of thoughts and feelings between people's minds, without the need to use speech, writing, or any other normal signals.

defs.def_cn: (演员面对观众站立时)在舞台左侧

ext.ext_cn: 他从左侧上了台。
ext.ext_en: He entered stage left.

defs.def_en: Stage left is the left side of the stage for an actor who is standing facing the audience.

ext.ext_cn: 因为经济原因，车主必须把汽车处理掉。
ext.ext_en: The owner needs to get rid of the car for financial reasons...

ext.ext_cn: 存在贪污腐败现象，我们将予以清除。
ext.ext_en: There's corruption, and we're going to get rid of it...

defs.def_en: When you get rid of something that you do not want or do not like, you take action so that you no longer have it or suffer from it.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为经理是出于个人原因想开除他。
ext.ext_en: He believed that his manager wanted to get rid of him for personal reasons...

ext.ext_cn: 看起来你急于想摆脱我。
ext.ext_en: You seem in rather a hurry to get rid of me.

defs.def_en: If you get rid of someone who is causing problems for you or who you do not like, you do something to prevent them affecting you any more, for example by making them leave.

ext.ext_cn: 这些提议试图使这个国家摆脱政治腐败。
ext.ext_en: The proposals are an attempt to rid the country of political corruption...

ext.ext_cn: 这种新疫苗可能会消除世界上最可怕的一种疾病。
ext.ext_en: The new vaccine may rid the world of one of its most terrifying diseases.

defs.def_en: If you rid a place or person of something undesirable or unwanted, you succeed in removing it completely from that place or person.

ext.ext_cn: 为什么他总是无法摆脱那些想法和担忧?
ext.ext_en: Why couldn't he ever rid himself of those thoughts, those worries?

ext.ext_cn: 该国为了消除贫困和饥饿而作出的努力
ext.ext_en: ...the country's efforts to rid itself of poverty and hunger.

defs.def_en: If you rid yourself of something you do not want, you take action so that you no longer have it or are no longer affected by it.

ext.ext_cn: 这家人已经找到一个方法摆脱她以及她给他们带来的问题。
ext.ext_en: The family had sought a way to be rid of her and the problems she had caused them.

defs.def_en: If you are rid of someone or something that you did not want or that caused problems for you, they are no longer with you or causing problems for you.

ext.ext_cn: 在我看来你妻子是一个浅薄的女人，幸好你离开了她。
ext.ext_en: It seems to me your wife was a shallow woman and you're well rid of her.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is well rid of someone, you think it is good that the person has gone because you did not like them or you think they caused a lot of problems.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 带醇厚桃味的餐后甜酒
ext.ext_en: ...a rich, peachy dessert wine.

ext.ext_cn: 桃红色
ext.ext_en: ...peachy pink.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as peachy, you mean that it tastes or smells like a peach or is similar in colour to a peach.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她生活中的一切都非常棒。
ext.ext_en: Everything in her life is just peachy.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is peachy or peachy keen, you mean that it is very nice.

defs.def_cn: (非官方军事组织成员有时使用的)假名，化名

ext.ext_cn: 化名为阿坎的塞尔维亚民兵组织领袖
ext.ext_en: ...a Serb militia leader who goes by the nom de guerre Arkan.

defs.def_en: A nom de guerre is a false name which is sometimes used by people who belong to an unofficial military organization.
A beaker is a plastic cup used for drinking, usually one with no handle.
A beaker is a large cup or glass.
A beaker is a glass or plastic jar which is used in chemistry.

ext.ext_cn: 苏珊想象着婚礼日当天的情景——自己挽着父亲的手臂走在教堂的过道上。
ext.ext_en: Susan visualized her wedding day and saw herself walking down the aisle on her father's arm...

ext.ext_cn: 他想象不出她年老时的样子。
ext.ext_en: He could not visualize her as old...

defs.def_en: If you visualize something, you imagine what it is like by forming a mental picture of it.

ext.ext_cn: 本章末尾列有一份有用的精选书目。
ext.ext_en: At the end of this chapter there is a select bibliography of useful books.

defs.def_en: A bibliography is a list of books on a particular subject.

defs.def_cn: （参考或引证的）文献目录，参考书目
defs.def_en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that are referred to in a particular book.

ext.ext_cn: 他暗地里设法阻挠她在党内的晋升。
ext.ext_en: He secretly tried to block her advancement in the Party...

ext.ext_cn: 争取努力把你所有的任务一次完成一项。
ext.ext_en: Try to make the effort to work your way through all of your tasks one at a time…

defs.def_en: If you try to do something, you want to do it, and you take action which you hope will help you to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他启动了一套私有化方案，以设法赢得商界的支持。
ext.ext_en: He has started a privatisation programme to try and win support from the business community…

ext.ext_cn: 我必须设法见到他。
ext.ext_en: I must try and see him.

defs.def_en: To try and do something means to try to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我和爱人两年来一直想要个孩子。
ext.ext_en: My partner and I have been trying for a baby for two years...

ext.ext_cn: 他说他明年会争取夺得第一名。
ext.ext_en: He said he was going to try for first place next year.

defs.def_en: If you try for something, you make an effort to get it or achieve it.

ext.ext_cn: 在这么重要的场合最好不要尝试以前从未做过的新菜谱。
ext.ext_en: It's best not to try a new recipe for the first time on such an important occasion...

ext.ext_cn: 中草药香烟、口香糖之类的我统统都试过了。
ext.ext_en: I've tried everything from herbal cigarettes to chewing gum…

defs.def_en: If you try something new or different, you use it, do it, or experience it in order to discover its qualities or effects.

defs.def_cn: 到(某处)试试;找(某人)试试

ext.ext_cn: 你到当地的音像店找过了吗？
ext.ext_en: Have you tried the local music shops?

defs.def_en: If you try a particular place or person, you go to that place or person because you think that they may be able to provide you with what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃试着推了推门。令他吃惊的是，门竟然开了。
ext.ext_en: Bob tried the door. To his surprise it opened.

defs.def_en: If you try a door or window, you try to open it.

ext.ext_cn: 他建议那些责任人应该以反人类罪受到审判。
ext.ext_en: He suggested that those responsible should be tried for crimes against humanity...

ext.ext_cn: 他有罪与否，等案件在法庭受审后就会作出判决。
ext.ext_en: Whether he is innocent or guilty is a decision that will be made when the case is tried in court...

defs.def_en: When a person is tried, he or she has to appear in a law court and is found innocent or guilty after the judge and jury have heard the evidence. When a legal case is tried, it is considered in a court of law.

defs.def_cn: (橄榄球的)达阵得分(在对方球门线内带球触地得分)

ext.ext_cn: 上半场以 21:3 领先的法国队有 8 个达阵得分。
ext.ext_en: The French, who led 21-3 at half time, scored eight tries.

defs.def_en: In the game of rugby, a try is the action of scoring by putting the ball down behind the goal line of the opposing team.

defs.def_cn: 没努力尝试;没竭尽全力

ext.ext_cn: 一切并非无可挑剔，但已经竭尽全力了。
ext.ext_en: Not all is perfect, but it isn't for want of trying.

defs.def_en: If you say that something fails but not for want of trying or not for lack of trying, you mean that everything possible was done to make it succeed.

defs.def_cn: (演奏爵士乐、舞曲或流行音乐的)小型乐队

ext.ext_cn: 新浪潮摇滚小乐队
ext.ext_en: ...a new-wave rock combo.

defs.def_en: A combo is a small group of musicians who play jazz, dance, or popular music.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人愉快的；美丽动人的；引人入胜的

ext.ext_cn: 秀丽的山间景色
ext.ext_en: ...gorgeous mountain scenery...

ext.ext_cn: 这天过得很愉快。
ext.ext_en: It's a gorgeous day...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is gorgeous, you mean that it gives you a lot of pleasure or is very attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 化妆品行业常找一些性感美女来推销护肤产品。
ext.ext_en: The cosmetics industry uses gorgeous women to sell its skincare products...

ext.ext_cn: 跟我同住的女孩都对瑞安很痴迷，她们觉得他非常性感。
ext.ext_en: All the girls in my house are mad about Ryan, they think he's gorgeous.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as gorgeous, you mean that you find them very sexually attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 身着华丽的帝国元帅服的红发男子
ext.ext_en: ...a red-haired man in the gorgeous uniform of a Marshal of the Empire.

defs.def_en: If you describe things such as clothes and colours as gorgeous, you mean they are bright, rich, and impressive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （旅馆、饭店、剧院或交通工具）预订一空的，满座的，满员的

ext.ext_cn: 圣贾斯特饭店似乎已经客满了，但我们设法在乔治饭店订到了一个房间。
ext.ext_en: St Just seemed pretty booked up, but we managed to find a room at the George.

defs.def_en: If a hotel, restaurant, theatre, or transport service is booked up, it has no rooms, tables, or tickets left for a time or date.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 威尔逊先生后几个月的日程都已经排满了。
ext.ext_en: Mr Wilson's diary is booked up for months ahead...

ext.ext_cn: 我现在忙得很，不可能腾出手做这个。
ext.ext_en: I'm fully booked up, I couldn't possibly do it now.

defs.def_en: If someone is booked up, they have made so many arrangements that they have no more time to do things.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有马上走向前门。
ext.ext_en: He didn't approach the front door at once...

ext.ext_cn: 当我走近时，他们就不说话了。
ext.ext_en: When I approached, they grew silent...

defs.def_en: When you approach something, you get closer to it.

ext.ext_cn: 这条小路通往船屋。
ext.ext_en: The path serves as an approach to the boat house.

defs.def_en: An approach to a place is a road, path, or other route that leads to it.

ext.ext_cn: 当查普尔为这份工作找我商量时，我的第一反应是不相信。
ext.ext_en: When Chappel approached me about the job, my first reaction was of disbelief...

ext.ext_cn: 他请我建造并设计该饭店。
ext.ext_en: He approached me to create and design the restaurant...

defs.def_en: If you approach someone about something, you speak to them about it for the first time, often making an offer or request.

ext.ext_cn: 银行已经实际解决了这个问题。
ext.ext_en: The Bank has approached the issue in a practical way...

ext.ext_cn: 雇主们对你如何处理问题感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: Employers are interested in how you approach problems.

defs.def_en: When you approach a task, problem, or situation in a particular way, you deal with it or think about it in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 我们将探索收集信息的不同方法。
ext.ext_en: We will be exploring different approaches to gathering information.

ext.ext_cn: 英国法律制度采用的辩论式审判模式
ext.ext_en: ...the adversarial approach of the British legal system.

defs.def_en: Your approach to a task, problem, or situation is the way you deal with it or think about it.

ext.ext_cn: 秋天临近，花园中的草木和颜色也发生了变化。
ext.ext_en: As autumn approached, the plants and colours in the garden changed.

ext.ext_cn: 步步逼近的危机
ext.ext_en: ...the approaching crisis.

defs.def_en: As a future time or event approaches, it gradually gets nearer as time passes.

ext.ext_cn: 接近年末时，我们面临经济迟滞、处处萧条的局面。
ext.ext_en: We approach the end of the year with the economy slowing and little sign of cheer.

defs.def_en: As you approach a future time or event, time passes so that you get gradually nearer to it.

ext.ext_cn: 石油价格已接近近10年中的最高水平。
ext.ext_en: Oil prices have approached their highest level for almost ten years...

ext.ext_cn: 曼塞尔将以接近每小时200英里的平均车速参赛。
ext.ext_en: Mansell will race at average speeds approaching 200mph.

defs.def_en: If something approaches a particular level or state, it almost reaches that level or state.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 杰出的学者之家
ext.ext_en: ...a distinguished academic family.

ext.ext_cn: 成就卓然的事业
ext.ext_en: ...a distinguished career.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their work as distinguished, you mean that they have been very successful in their career and have a good reputation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他看上去非常高贵。
ext.ext_en: He looked very distinguished.

ext.ext_cn: 一位尊贵的绅士
ext.ext_en: ...a distinguished gentleman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as distinguished, you mean that they look very noble and respectable.

defs.def_cn: (高速公路上的)防撞护栏，防撞墙
defs.def_en: A crash barrier is a strong low fence built along the side of a road or between the two halves of a motorway in order to prevent accidents.
A prayer meeting is a religious meeting where people say prayers to God.
A tarantula is a large hairy spider which has a poisonous bite.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯在其《通论》中的精辟言辞
ext.ext_en: ...the somewhat gnomic utterances of John Maynard Keynes in his General Theory.

defs.def_en: A gnomic remark is brief and seems wise but is difficult to understand.

ext.ext_cn: 他每次训练后都做放松活动。
ext.ext_en: He always warms down after training.

defs.def_en: See also:warm-down;If you warm down after doing a physical activity, you do special exercises to help relax your muscles and joints.

defs.def_cn: 感到疑惑;纳闷儿;想弄明白

ext.ext_cn: 我纳闷儿那是什么声音。
ext.ext_en: I wondered what that noise was...

ext.ext_cn: “他自称是她父亲，”马克斯说，“我们一直都在怀疑他。”
ext.ext_en: 'He claims to be her father,' said Max. 'We've been wondering about him.'...

defs.def_en: If you wonder about something, you think about it, either because it interests you and you want to know more about it, or because you are worried or suspicious about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢坐着对发生的一切惊叹不已。
ext.ext_en: He liked to sit and wonder at all that had happened...

ext.ext_cn: 沿着城堡街走下去，欣赏我们视若珍宝的教堂，继而叹服于城堡的壮观。
ext.ext_en: Walk down Castle Street, admire our little jewel of a cathedral, then wonder at the castle...

defs.def_en: If you wonder at something, you are very surprised about it or think about it in a very surprised way.

ext.ext_cn: 这差不多用了10年的时间，真是桩奇事。
ext.ext_en: It's a wonder that it took almost ten years...

ext.ext_cn: 奥利维尔伤得不重，真是奇迹。
ext.ext_en: The wonder is that Olivier was not seriously hurt.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is a wonder that something happened, you mean that it is very surprising and unexpected.

ext.ext_cn: “对呀！”博比惊奇地叫道。“你是怎么想起那件事的？”
ext.ext_en: 'That's right!' Bobby exclaimed in wonder. 'How did you remember that?'...

ext.ext_cn: 我对她的好运既惊奇又感叹。
ext.ext_en: I was expressing some amazement and wonder at her good fortune...

defs.def_en: Wonder is a feeling of great surprise and pleasure that you have, for example when you see something that is very beautiful, or when something happens that you thought was impossible.

ext.ext_cn: 关于宇宙奇观和太空探险的讲座
ext.ext_en: ...a lecture on the wonders of space and space exploration.

ext.ext_cn: 看见他的名字出现在出版物上的诧异
ext.ext_en: ...the wonder of seeing his name in print...

defs.def_en: A wonder is something that causes people to feel great surprise or admiration.

defs.def_cn: 神奇的;奇妙的;有奇效的

ext.ext_cn: 米克尔森被誉为美国高尔夫球界的神奇小子。
ext.ext_en: Mickelson was hailed as the wonder boy of American golf...

ext.ext_cn: 威廉斯医生称其可能会成为特效药。
ext.ext_en: Dr Williams describes it as a potential wonder drug.

defs.def_en: If you refer, for example, to a young man as a wonder boy, or to a new product as a wonder drug, you mean that they are believed by many people to be very good or very effective.

defs.def_cn: 昙花一现的人(或事物);惊艳一时的人(或事物)

ext.ext_cn: 哈里对老朋友的讲话不屑一顾，称之“火不了多久”。
ext.ext_en: Harry dismissed his old friend's speech as 'a nine-day wonder'...

ext.ext_cn: 有些超新星研究者怀疑，这可能只是昙花一现。
ext.ext_en: Some supernova researchers wondered if it might be just a nine-day wonder.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is a nine-day wonder or a one-day wonder, you disapprove of the fact that they are attracting so much interest and attention, because you think that their popularity will only last for a very short time.

defs.def_cn: (用于礼貌地请人做事、征求意见或打听消息时)不知…，请问…

ext.ext_cn: 不知您是否能帮我个忙。
ext.ext_en: I was just wondering if you could help me...

ext.ext_cn: 我只是纳闷儿你是怎么看待这一切的。
ext.ext_en: I just wonder what you make of all that...

defs.def_en: You can say 'I wonder' if you want to be very polite when you are asking someone to do something, or when you are asking them for their opinion or for information.

ext.ext_cn: 难怪我兄弟感觉不舒服了。
ext.ext_en: No wonder my brother wasn't feeling well...

ext.ext_cn: 在这种情形下，他们遇到困难就不足为怪了。
ext.ext_en: Under such circumstances, it is little wonder that they experience difficulties...

defs.def_en: If you say 'no wonder', 'little wonder', or 'small wonder', you mean that something is not surprising.

defs.def_cn: （表示找出某事的原因）难怪，怪不得

ext.ext_cn: 布拉德是简的兄弟！怪不得他老是让我想起她呢！
ext.ext_en: Brad was Jane's brother! No wonder he reminded me so much of her!

defs.def_en: You can say 'No wonder' when you find out the reason for something that has been puzzling you for some time.

ext.ext_cn: 放松一会儿就可以收到奇效。
ext.ext_en: A few moments of relaxation can work wonders...

ext.ext_cn: 拉什顿创造了行业奇迹。
ext.ext_en: Rushton has done wonders for the industry.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or thing works wonders or does wonders, you mean that they have a very good effect on something.

ext.ext_cn: 人们将赌注下在扬基队上并不说明就喜欢他们。
ext.ext_en: Just because people wagered on the Yankees did not mean that they liked them...

ext.ext_cn: 高尔夫球手投下重注赌尼克·法尔多夺冠。
ext.ext_en: Golfers had wagered a good deal of money on Nick Faldo winning the championship.

defs.def_en: If you wager on the result of a horse race, football match, or other event, you give someone a sum of money which they give you back with extra money if the result is what you predicted, or which they keep if it is not.

ext.ext_cn: 她愿意打赌他居住的公寓并不属于他。
ext.ext_en: She was willing to wager that he didn't own the apartment he lived in...

ext.ext_cn: 我敢打赌，她就算到了70岁，影响力也会不减当年。
ext.ext_en: I'll wager she'll still make the same impact when she's 70.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will wager that something is the case, you mean you are confident that it is the case.

ext.ext_cn: 肯沃西以一项微不足道的指控为由将他拘捕了。
ext.ext_en: Kenworthy had run him in on a petty charge.

defs.def_en: To run someone in means to arrest them or to take them to the police.

defs.def_cn: 流着鼻涕的;满是鼻涕的

ext.ext_cn: 他又是流鼻涕，又是流眼泪，还有点咳嗽。
ext.ext_en: He suffered from a snotty nose, runny eyes and a slight cough.

defs.def_en: Something that is snotty produces or is covered in snot.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 傲慢自大的;自以为高人一等的

ext.ext_cn: 目空一切的大学生
ext.ext_en: ...snotty college kids...

ext.ext_cn: 她高傲地笑了一下。
ext.ext_en: She smiled a snotty smile.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as snotty, you disapprove of them because they have a very proud and superior attitude to other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 漠然的;漠不关心的;无动于衷的

ext.ext_cn: 连最不感兴趣的学生都开始坐直了听讲。
ext.ext_en: Even the most apathetic students are beginning to sit up and listen...

ext.ext_cn: 其他人对两党的候选人都不感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: Others feel apathetic about the candidates in both parties.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as apathetic, you are criticizing them because they do not seem to be interested in or enthusiastic about doing anything.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Someone who is unflappable is always calm and never panics or gets upset or angry.

defs.def_cn: (常表示幽默)最高地位的，最上层的，最优秀的
defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as top-drawer, you are saying, often in a humorous way, that they have a high social standing or are of very good quality.

ext.ext_cn: 中美洲加勒比海沿岸
ext.ext_en: ...Central America's Caribbean coast...

ext.ext_cn: 混乱局面已经扩散，正在影响利比里亚中部的大片地区。
ext.ext_en: The disruption has now spread and is affecting a large part of central Liberia.

defs.def_en: Something that is central is in the middle of a place or area.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 位于中央地带的;处于中心的;四通八达的

ext.ext_cn: 首都的中心地带
ext.ext_en: ...a central location in the capital.

defs.def_en: A place that is central is easy to reach because it is in the centre of a city, town, or particular area.

defs.def_cn: 中央的;有最高决策权的

ext.ext_cn: 人们对罗马的中央政府缺乏信任。
ext.ext_en: There is a lack of trust towards the central government in Rome.

ext.ext_cn: 古巴共产党中央委员会
ext.ext_en: ...the central committee of the Cuban communist party.

defs.def_en: A central group or organization makes all the important decisions that are followed throughout a larger organization or a country.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 自上世纪60年代以来，黑人舞曲一直是主流流行乐的核心。
ext.ext_en: Black dance music has been central to mainstream pop since the early '60s.

ext.ext_cn: 他们文化的核心部分
ext.ext_en: ...a central part of their culture.

defs.def_en: The central person or thing in a particular situation is the most important one.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他注意到了须后水淡淡的麝香味。
ext.ext_en: He was conscious of the faint, musky aroma of after-shave...

ext.ext_cn: 她非常清楚马克斯在仔细端详她。
ext.ext_en: She was very conscious of Max studying her...

defs.def_en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or realize that it is happening.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指由于不满或自觉重要而)注意的，关注的

ext.ext_cn: 我很在意自己的体重。
ext.ext_en: I'm very conscious of my weight...

ext.ext_cn: 他非常清楚这种转变伴随着社会动乱的危险。
ext.ext_en: He is acutely conscious that this transition will bring with it the risk of social unrest.

defs.def_en: If you are conscious of something, you think about it a lot, especially because you are unhappy about it or because you think it is important.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得我们没有刻意地决定要生很多孩子。
ext.ext_en: I don't think we ever made a conscious decision to have a big family...

ext.ext_cn: 有意识地放松肌肉。
ext.ext_en: Make a conscious effort to relax your muscles.

defs.def_en: A conscious decision or action is made or done deliberately with you giving your full attention to it.

ext.ext_cn: 她一直都很清醒，知道是怎么回事。
ext.ext_en: She was fully conscious all the time and knew what was going on.

defs.def_en: Someone who is conscious is awake rather than asleep or unconscious.

defs.def_cn: (记忆或想法)有意识的，意识到的

ext.ext_cn: 他对自己住院的4个星期没有任何有意识的记忆。
ext.ext_en: He had no conscious memory of his four-week stay in hospital...

ext.ext_cn: 在意识心理之下存在很多层次的无意识。
ext.ext_en: Beneath the conscious mind there are many levels of the unconscious.

defs.def_en: Conscious memories or thoughts are ones that you are aware of.

ext.ext_cn: 她有用不完的热情。
ext.ext_en: She has an inexhaustible supply of enthusiasm...

ext.ext_cn: 他有无穷的精力和无限的耐心。
ext.ext_en: His energy was unbounded and his patience inexhaustible.

defs.def_en: If there is an inexhaustible supply of something, there is so much of it that it cannot all be used up.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在处理任何内部政治分歧的苗头时，总统都毫不留情。
ext.ext_en: The President was ruthless in dealing with any hint of internal political dissent.

ext.ext_cn: 残忍的极权主义国家的侵略
ext.ext_en: ...an invasion by a ruthless totalitarian power...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is ruthless, you mean that you disapprove of them because they are very harsh or cruel, and will do anything that is necessary to achieve what they want.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为等)坚决的，果断的，不留情面的

ext.ext_cn: 她的律师在讨论离婚协议的过程中表现得非常坚决。
ext.ext_en: Her lawyers have been ruthless in thrashing out a divorce settlement...

ext.ext_cn: 成功合并两家银行需要坚决快速地着手解决费用问题。
ext.ext_en: Successfully merging two banks requires a fast and ruthless attack on costs.

defs.def_en: A ruthless action or activity is done forcefully and thoroughly, without much concern for its effects on other people.
A chimney sweep is a person whose job is to clean the soot out of chimneys.

ext.ext_cn: 他沿着八车道的高速公路向城市驶去。
ext.ext_en: He took off for the city on the eight-lane superhighway.

defs.def_en: A superhighway is a large, fast motorway or freeway with several lanes.

ext.ext_cn: 运用数字和光纤技术提供新的电信连接的信息高速公路
ext.ext_en: ...a superhighway using digital and fibre-optic technology to provide new telecommunications links.

defs.def_en: The information superhighway is the network of computer links that enables computer users all over the world to communicate with each other.

defs.def_cn: (形式、风格或内容)传统的，正统的，古典的

ext.ext_cn: 福金没有改变传统芭蕾舞的舞步，而是另辟蹊径对这些舞步加以运用。
ext.ext_en: Fokine did not change the steps of classical ballet; instead he found new ways of using them.

ext.ext_cn: 斯密和早期古典经济学家的科学态度
ext.ext_en: ...the scientific attitude of Smith and earlier classical economists.

defs.def_en: You use classical to  describe something that is traditional in form, style, or content.
Classical music is music that is considered to be serious and of lasting value.

defs.def_cn: 古典文化的;古希腊(或古罗马)文明的

ext.ext_cn: 古埃及和古希腊的治疗术士
ext.ext_en: ...the healers of ancient Egypt and classical Greece...

ext.ext_cn: 这是古典时期一项无可匹敌的技术成果。
ext.ext_en: It's a technological achievement that is unrivalled in the classical world.

defs.def_en: Classical is used to describe things which relate to the ancient Greek or Roman civilizations.

ext.ext_cn: 古阿拉伯语诗歌的一行诗句
ext.ext_en: ...a line of classical Arabic poetry.

defs.def_en: A classical language is a form of a language that was used in ancient times and is now no longer used, or only used in formal writing.

ext.ext_cn: 她努力让呼吸平缓下来。
ext.ext_en: She tried to quieten her breathing...

ext.ext_cn: 一个男人喊了一声，狗儿们就一下子安静下来了。
ext.ext_en: A man shouted and the dogs suddenly quietened.

defs.def_en: If you quieten someone or something, or if they quieten, you make them become less noisy, less active, or silent.

defs.def_cn: 消除，减轻(恐惧);平息(抱怨)

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯情报机构要花很长时间才能消除西方的疑虑。
ext.ext_en: Russian intelligence will take a long time to quieten the paranoia of the West.

defs.def_en: To quieten fears or complaints means to persuade people that there is no good reason for them.

defs.def_cn: (使)同步;(使)在时间上一致;(使)同速进行

ext.ext_cn: 想让我们的生活步调保持一致好一起去度假和过周末几乎是不可能的事。
ext.ext_en: It was virtually impossible to synchronise our lives so as to take holidays and weekends together...

ext.ext_cn: 将配乐和电影情节进行同步合成。
ext.ext_en: Synchronise the score with the film action.

defs.def_en: If you synchronize two activities, processes, or movements, or if you synchronize one activity, process, or movement with another, you cause them to happen at the same time and speed as each other.

ext.ext_cn: 他的饮食服务公司使他在41岁成了百万富翁。
ext.ext_en: His catering business made him a millionaire at 41...

ext.ext_cn: 他最近承办了一次总统招待会的宴席。
ext.ext_en: He recently did the catering for a presidential reception.

defs.def_en: Catering is the activity of providing food and drink for a large number of people, for example at weddings and parties.

defs.def_cn: (持共同态度或信仰的人的)大本营，据点

ext.ext_cn: 北威尔士最西部是说威尔士语人的聚居区。
ext.ext_en: The westernmost part of north Wales is a stronghold of Welsh-speakers...

ext.ext_cn: 这个选区是工党的大本营。
ext.ext_en: The seat was a stronghold of the Labour party.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place or region is a stronghold of a particular attitude or belief, you mean that most people there share this attitude or belief.

ext.ext_cn: 设得兰群岛是水獭在不列颠群岛上最后的栖息地。
ext.ext_en: Shetland is the last stronghold of otters in the British Isles.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place is a stronghold of a particular type of animal, you mean that more of that type of animal live there than in other places.

ext.ext_cn: 她祝贺他喜得贵子。
ext.ext_en: She congratulated him on the birth of his son...

ext.ext_cn: 大家对我们订婚的反应让我非常惊讶。所有人都开始祝贺我们。
ext.ext_en: I was absolutely astonished by the reaction to our engagement. Everyone started congratulating us.

defs.def_en: If you congratulate someone, you say something to show you are pleased that something nice has happened to them.

ext.ext_cn: 活动安排得有条不紊，充满乐趣，我必须要称赞一下组织者。
ext.ext_en: I really must congratulate the organisers for a well run and enjoyable event...

ext.ext_cn: 我们特别想表扬几名选手。
ext.ext_en: We specifically wanted to congratulate certain players.

defs.def_en: If you congratulate someone, you praise them for something good that they have done.

defs.def_cn: 为(自己)感到高兴(或自豪）

ext.ext_cn: 沃特斯通完全有理由为自己感到高兴。
ext.ext_en: Waterstone has every reason to congratulate himself...

ext.ext_cn: 记者们为新闻界在调查中所起的作用感到自豪。
ext.ext_en: Journalists have been congratulating themselves on the role the press has played in the investigations.

defs.def_en: If you congratulate yourself, you are pleased about something that you have done or that has happened to you.

ext.ext_cn: 城市已被猛烈的炮火夷为平地。
ext.ext_en: The city has been flattened by heavy artillery bombardments...

ext.ext_cn: 首都仍在遭受叛军的持续轰炸。
ext.ext_en: The capital is still under constant bombardment by the rebel forces.

defs.def_en: A bombardment is a strong and continuous attack of gunfire or bombing.

defs.def_cn: 一连串（想法、要求、质问或批评）

ext.ext_cn: 铺天盖地的图片，强调工作是至关重要的
ext.ext_en: ...the constant bombardment of images urging that work was important.

defs.def_en: A bombardment of ideas, demands, questions, or criticisms is an aggressive and exhausting stream of them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这种醇厚的白葡萄酒年头愈久口味愈佳。
ext.ext_en: This full-flavoured white wine ages well.

defs.def_en: Full-flavoured food or wine has a pleasant fairly strong taste.

ext.ext_cn: 在剧院的侧楼中建一个博物馆
ext.ext_en: ...setting up a museum in an annexe to the theatre.

defs.def_en: An annexe is a building which is joined to or is next to a larger main building.

ext.ext_cn: 附录列举并讨论了8本书。
ext.ext_en: The Annex lists and discusses eight titles.

defs.def_en: An annexe to a document is a section added to it at the end.

defs.def_cn: （尤用作友善或幽默的称呼）秃子，光头

ext.ext_cn: 演员帕特里克·斯图尔特早就秃头了，为此他还很得意。
ext.ext_en: The actor Patrick Stewart is a long-time baldy and proud of it...

ext.ext_cn: 别烦我，秃子。
ext.ext_en: Get lost, baldy.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to a bald person as a baldy, especially if they are talking about them or to them in a friendly or humorous way.

defs.def_cn: 女装设计师;女装裁缝;女装商人

ext.ext_cn: 上周，巴黎的时装设计师们展示了他们的冬季时装作品。
ext.ext_en: The Paris couturiers showed their collections for winter last week.

defs.def_en: A couturier is a person who designs, makes, and sells expensive, fashionable clothes for women.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 歧视老年人的;有年龄歧视的

ext.ext_cn: 雇用方的年龄偏见
ext.ext_en: ...ageist bias from employers.

defs.def_en: Ageist behaviour is unacceptable behaviour based on the belief that older people are of less value than younger people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 毫无知觉的；呆若木鸡的；患紧张症的

ext.ext_cn: 而且身受重伤的女主人公陷入了毫无知觉的昏迷状态。
ext.ext_en: ...and the traumatised heroine sinks into a catatonic trance.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as being in a catatonic state, you mean that they are not moving or responding at all, usually as a result of illness, shock, or drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 审判被无限期推迟。
ext.ext_en: The trial was adjourned for an indefinite period.

ext.ext_cn: 公务人员的无限期罢工
ext.ext_en: ...an indefinite strike by government workers.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation or period as indefinite, you mean that people have not decided when it will end.

ext.ext_cn: 在未来的某个时间
ext.ext_en: ...at some indefinite time in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 年龄不明的端庄女子
ext.ext_en: ...a handsome woman of indefinite age.

defs.def_en: Something that is indefinite is not exact or clear.
A sniper is someone who shoots at people from a hidden position.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 名声不好的;不名誉的;不光彩的

ext.ext_cn: 他被人发现喜欢与那些不三不四的女人混在一起。
ext.ext_en: He was found to have been enjoying the company of disreputable women.

ext.ext_cn: 最为喧哗、名声最差的酒吧
ext.ext_en: ...the noisiest and most disreputable bars.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is disreputable, you are critical of them because they are not respectable or cannot be trusted.
Falconry is the skill of training falcons to hunt, and the sport of using them to hunt.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Problematical means the same as problematic .

ext.ext_cn: 检察官
ext.ext_en: ...a prosecuting attorney.

defs.def_en: See also:District Attorney;In the United States, an attorney or attorney at law is a lawyer.  →see usage note at:lawyer
If you do the donkey work, you do the hard work or the less interesting part of the work that needs to be done.

defs.def_cn: 喋喋不休地讲；滔滔不绝地说

ext.ext_cn: 我听着妈妈喋喋不休地唠叨着我结婚那天应该穿什么，应该怎么做，应该请些什么人。
ext.ext_en: I heard my mother rattling on and on about the day I get married, what I must wear, how I must act, who I must invite...

ext.ext_cn: 尼科利尼喋喋不休讲个不停，一只手比划着以示强调，另一只手握着方向盘，而他则安静地听着。
ext.ext_en: He listened in silence as Niccolini rattled on, emphasizing his remarks with one hand and steering with the other.

defs.def_en: When you say that someone rattles on about something, you mean that they talk about it for a long time in a way that annoys you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有失尊严的；不像话的；令人尴尬的

ext.ext_cn: 看到整个县都不顾颜面地公开争吵，真让人感到难过。
ext.ext_en: It is sad to see a county confine its activities to undignified public bickering...

ext.ext_cn: 随后传来了很不像话的摔门声。
ext.ext_en: There followed an undignified slamming of doors...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's actions as undignified, you mean they are foolish or embarrassing.
An obelisk is a tall stone pillar that has been built in honour of a person or an important event.

ext.ext_cn: 医学界在抗癌的斗争中不断取得进步。
ext.ext_en: The medical community continues to make progress in the fight against cancer...

ext.ext_cn: 双方在达成协议方面的进展甚微。
ext.ext_en: The two sides made little if any progress towards agreement.

defs.def_en: Progress is the process of gradually improving or getting nearer to achieving or completing something.

ext.ext_cn: 据报道，总理对第一天会谈的进展表示满意。
ext.ext_en: The Chancellor is  reported to have been delighted with the progress of the first day's talks...

ext.ext_cn: 埃伦会通过电话及时向我通报进展情况。
ext.ext_en: Ellen would keep me abreast of the progress by phone.

defs.def_en: The progress of a situation or action is the way in which it develops.

ext.ext_cn: 他会每两个星期来访一次，看看他的新员工进展如何。
ext.ext_en: He will visit once a fortnight to see how his new staff are progressing...

ext.ext_cn: 他的病情发展得这么快，您是否感到意外？
ext.ext_en: Were you surprised that his disease progressed so quickly?...

defs.def_en: To progress means to move over a period of time to a stronger, more advanced, or more desirable state.

ext.ext_cn: 随着夜幕逐渐降临，悲伤变成了愤怒。
ext.ext_en: As the evening progressed, sadness turned to rage...

ext.ext_cn: 那时候生活很艰难，并且随着战争的持续愈发艰难了。
ext.ext_en: Life was hard, and it became harder as the war progressed.

defs.def_en: If events progress, they continue to happen gradually over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 在K被指控后最初的10个月左右，这个案子进展缓慢。
ext.ext_en: Very little was done to progress the case in the first 10 or so months after K was charged.

defs.def_en: If you progress something, you cause it to develop.

ext.ext_cn: 我们坐下来的时候，比赛已经开始了。
ext.ext_en: The game was already in progress when we took our seats...

ext.ext_cn: 这些日记里既有自白，也有当下工作记录，还有见闻评论。
ext.ext_en: The diaries are a mixture of confession, work in progress and observation.

defs.def_en: If something is in progress, it has started and is still continuing.

ext.ext_cn: 当情绪几近失控的人群拼命想接近他时，警察和保镖不得不保护他。
ext.ext_en: Police and bodyguards had to protect him as the almost hysterical crowds struggled to approach him...

ext.ext_cn: 他成了新闻人物，收到了疯狂的攻击性邮件。
ext.ext_en: He made headlines and received hysterical hate mail.

defs.def_en: Someone who is hysterical is in a state of uncontrolled excitement, anger, or panic.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 癔病的;（通常指因惊吓而）情绪异常激动的

ext.ext_cn: 我曾患阵发的严重癔病性抑郁症。
ext.ext_en: I suffered bouts of really hysterical depression.

defs.def_en: Someone who is hysterical is in a state of violent and disturbed emotion that is usually a result of shock.

defs.def_cn: （笑声）疯狂失控的，不可抑制的

ext.ext_cn: 我不得不冲向卫生间，以免遭到别人的疯狂嘲笑。
ext.ext_en: I had to rush to the loo to avoid an attack of hysterical giggles.

defs.def_en: Hysterical laughter is loud and uncontrolled.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 保罗·马祖尔斯基担任司仪，他简直把人笑坏了。
ext.ext_en: Paul Mazursky was Master of Ceremonies, and he was pretty hysterical.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as hysterical, you think that they are very funny and they make you laugh a lot.

ext.ext_cn: 这种煤气取暖器不需要烟囱。
ext.ext_en: This gas fire doesn't need a chimney.

defs.def_en: A chimney is a pipe through which smoke goes up into the air, usually through the roof of a building.

ext.ext_cn: 他宁愿在烟雾缭绕的酒吧里哼唱歌曲。
ext.ext_en: He would much rather have been crooning in a smoky bar...

ext.ext_cn: 那天晚上晚些时候，刘易斯开始哼唱另一首斯普林斯汀的歌曲。
ext.ext_en: Later in the evening, Lewis began to croon another Springsteen song.

defs.def_en: If you croon, you sing or hum quietly and gently.

defs.def_cn: (尤指伤感或不真诚地)轻声说

ext.ext_cn: “乖儿子，”她轻声说着，把他紧紧地抱在怀里。
ext.ext_en: 'Dear boy,' she crooned, hugging him heartily...

ext.ext_cn: 那个男人正温柔地轻声鼓励他的妻子。
ext.ext_en: The man was crooning soft words of encouragement to his wife.

defs.def_en: If one person talks to another in a soft gentle voice, you can describe them as crooning, especially if you think they are being sentimental or insincere.

ext.ext_cn: 偶尔会裸泳的那个人到这里来了。
ext.ext_en: The occasional nude bather comes here...

ext.ext_cn: 她拒绝了为《花花公子》杂志拍摄裸照的120万英镑开价。
ext.ext_en: She turned down £1.2 million to pose nude in Playboy...

defs.def_en: A nude person is not wearing any clothes.

defs.def_cn: 裸体画;裸体雕像;裸体人像

ext.ext_cn: 他是澳大利亚最为杰出的艺术家之一，以肖像画、风景画和裸体画而闻名。
ext.ext_en: He was one of Australia's most distinguished artists, renowned for his portraits, landscapes and nudes.

defs.def_en: A nude is a picture or statue of a person who is not wearing any clothes. A nude is also a person in a picture who is not wearing any clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 通过文字记载和口头传诵留存下来的古代文化传统
ext.ext_en: ...the written and oral traditions of ancient cultures.

ext.ext_cn: 口头协定
ext.ext_en: ...an oral agreement.

defs.def_en: Oral communication is spoken rather than written.

ext.ext_cn: 口试后，我私下里与那位考生谈了谈。
ext.ext_en: I spoke privately to the candidate after the oral.

defs.def_en: An oral is an examination, especially in a foreign language, that is spoken rather than written.

ext.ext_cn: 良好的口腔卫生
ext.ext_en: ...good oral hygiene.

defs.def_en: You use oral to indicate that something is done with a person's mouth or relates to a person's mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 口服避孕药
ext.ext_en: ...oral contraceptives.

defs.def_en: Oral medicines are taken by mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经有两个星期没有坐在办公桌前了。
ext.ext_en: He has been absent from his desk for two weeks...

ext.ext_cn: 那些画也不在墙上了。
ext.ext_en: The pictures, too, were absent from the walls...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is absent from a place or situation where they should be or where they usually are, they are not there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: “没什么，”罗茜心不在焉地说。
ext.ext_en: 'Nothing,' Rosie said in an absent way.

defs.def_en: If someone appears absent, they are not paying attention because they are thinking about something else.

ext.ext_cn: 那些不在子女身边、未能支付抚养费的父亲
ext.ext_en: ...absent fathers who fail to pay towards the costs of looking after their children.

defs.def_en: An absent parent does not live with his or her children.

defs.def_cn: 使不在，使离开（本应在或通常在的地方）

ext.ext_cn: 她长大了，可以自己做主不来吃午餐了。
ext.ext_en: She was old enough to absent herself from the lunch table if she chose...

ext.ext_cn: 在军事法庭上他对自己擅离职守表示服罪。
ext.ext_en: He pleaded guilty before a court martial to absenting himself without leave.

defs.def_en: If someone absents themselves from a place where they should be or where they usually are, they do not go there or they do not stay there.

ext.ext_cn: 假如得不到解决，像休·戈弗雷这样的人就会一直坚持斗争下去。
ext.ext_en: Absent a solution, people like Sue Godfrey will just keep on fighting.

defs.def_en: If you say that absent one thing, another thing will happen, you mean that if the first thing does not happen, the second thing will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 莱昂内尔做了个鸡笼，打算养些鸡，吃上新鲜鸡蛋。
ext.ext_en: Lionel built a coop so that they could raise chickens and have a supply of fresh eggs.

ext.ext_cn: 散养的鸡
ext.ext_en: ...free-range chickens.

defs.def_en: Chickens are birds which are kept on a farm for their eggs and for their meat.

ext.ext_cn: 我怕黑，是个十足的胆小鬼。
ext.ext_en: I'm scared of the dark. I'm a big chicken.

ext.ext_cn: 格雷戈里，你怎么就这么胆小呢？
ext.ext_en: Why are you so chicken, Gregory?

defs.def_en: If someone calls you a chicken, they mean that you are afraid to do something.

defs.def_cn: 高兴得太早;过早地打如意算盘

ext.ext_cn: 我不想高兴得太早。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to count my chickens before they are hatched.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is counting their chickens, you mean that they are assuming that they will be successful or get something, when this is not certain.

defs.def_cn: 鸡和蛋的问题(指很难决定孰先孰后、孰因孰果的情境)

ext.ext_cn: 这是个鸡和蛋的问题。是因为营养缺乏导致湿疹呢，还是湿疹导致了某些营养缺乏？
ext.ext_en: It's a chicken and egg situation. Does the deficiency lead to the eczema or has the eczema led to certain deficiencies?

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as a chicken and egg situation, you mean that it is impossible to decide which of two things caused the other one.

defs.def_cn: 像只没头的苍蝇到处乱窜

ext.ext_cn: 别像只没头苍蝇东一头西一头的，力气要用对地方。
ext.ext_en: Instead of running round like a headless chicken use your efforts in a more productive way.

defs.def_en: If someone is running round like a headless chicken or rushing around like a headless chicken, they are panicking when they should be thinking carefully about what needs to be done.

defs.def_cn: （尤指战争中的)英勇表现，勇气，勇猛

ext.ext_cn: 他自己因在战争中的英勇表现而获得了勋章。
ext.ext_en: He was himself decorated for valour in the war.

defs.def_en: Valour is great bravery, especially in battle.  discretion is the better part of valour→see: discretion;

defs.def_cn: 多虑的人;经常发愁的人
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a worrier, you mean that they spend a lot of time thinking about problems that they have or unpleasant things that might happen.

ext.ext_cn: 她无处可去。
ext.ext_en: She didn't have anyplace to go...

ext.ext_cn: 你可以去任何地方给汽车作检修。
ext.ext_en: You can go anyplace to get the car serviced.

defs.def_en: Anyplace means the same as anywhere .
On a ship, the crow's nest is a small platform high up on the mast, where a person can go to look in all directions.
A dragoon was a soldier in old European armies. Dragoons usually fought on horseback.

ext.ext_cn: 迫使我参加考试的历史教授
ext.ext_en: ...the history professor who had dragooned me into taking the exam...

ext.ext_cn: 她的丈夫也被拉来参加远足了。
ext.ext_en: Her husband had also been dragooned into the excursion.

defs.def_en: If someone dragoons you into doing something that you do not want to do, they persuade you to do it even though you try hard not to agree.

ext.ext_cn: 他的很多文章都痛批奢华与财富。
ext.ext_en: A lot of his writings inveigh against luxury and riches.

defs.def_en: If you inveigh against something, you criticize it strongly.
A merchant bank is a bank that deals mainly with firms, investment, and foreign trade, rather than with the public.

defs.def_cn: 刀子嘴;说话刻薄;言辞尖刻

ext.ext_cn: 尽管她说话尖刻，却得到了朋友们的忠心。
ext.ext_en: Despite her sharp tongue, she inspires loyalty from her friends.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a sharp tongue, you are critical of the fact that they say things which are unkind though often clever.
Radio astronomy is a branch of science in which radio telescopes are used to receive and analyse radio waves from space.

ext.ext_cn: 一瓶洗发液
ext.ext_en: ...a bottle of shampoo.

ext.ext_cn: 泡泡浴、肥皂和香波
ext.ext_en: ...bubble baths, soaps and shampoos.

defs.def_en: Shampoo is a soapy liquid that you use for washing your hair.

ext.ext_cn: 用洗发液洗洗头发然后擦干。
ext.ext_en: Shampoo your hair and dry it.

defs.def_en: When you shampoo your hair, you wash it using shampoo.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的布局广泛的企业网点
ext.ext_en: ...his widely dispersed businesses...

ext.ext_cn: 他们零星散居在安第斯山脉的高处。
ext.ext_en: They live high in the Andes, in small and dispersed groups.

defs.def_en: Things that are dispersed are situated in many different places, a long way apart from each other.

defs.def_cn: 煎鱼铲子(铲面有细长孔)
defs.def_en: A fish slice is a kitchen tool which consists of a flat part with narrow holes in it attached to a handle. It is used for turning or serving fish or other food that is cooked in a frying pan.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰逊现在为迈卡·帕里斯伴唱。
ext.ext_en: Johnson now sings backing vocals for Mica Paris.

defs.def_en: In a pop song, the vocals are the singing, in contrast to the playing of instruments.

ext.ext_cn: 身为父亲的快乐
ext.ext_en: ...the joys of fatherhood.

defs.def_en: Fatherhood is the state of being a father.
Albumin is a protein that is found in blood plasma, egg white, and some other substances.

defs.def_cn: 仇外情绪，惧外情绪（对外国人的强烈厌恶或惧怕）
defs.def_en: Xenophobia is strong and unreasonable dislike or fear of people from other countries.
A bachelor is a man who has never married.
Anal means relating to the anus of a person or animal.
A sleeping pill is a pill that you can take to help you sleep.

ext.ext_cn: 如果能找出你兄弟在哪儿，我们就会去找。
ext.ext_en: If it is possible to find out where your brother is, we shall...

ext.ext_cn: 只要我们有足够的信念，任何事情都是有可能的。
ext.ext_en: Everything is possible if we want it enough...

defs.def_en: If it is possible to do something, it can be done.

ext.ext_cn: 他把对几家报纸可能提起诉讼的事宜提交首席检察官来处理。
ext.ext_en: He referred the matter to the Attorney General for possible action against several newspapers...

ext.ext_cn: 她的家人在讨论移居美国的可能。
ext.ext_en: Her family is discussing a possible move to America...

defs.def_en: A possible event is one that might happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 也许，对于所有这一切，会有一种解释。
ext.ext_en: It is possible that there's an explanation for all this...

ext.ext_cn: 可能哈里本人都不清楚自己意欲何为。
ext.ext_en: It was possible that Harry himself did not know what he had intended to do.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is possible that something is true or correct, you mean that although you do not know whether it is true or correct, you accept that it might be.

ext.ext_cn: 请尽快作决定。
ext.ext_en: Please make your decision as soon as possible...

ext.ext_cn: 我想尽可能多学一些关于这个行业的知识，让自己更有备无患。
ext.ext_en: I want to learn as much as possible about the industry so that I'm better prepared...

defs.def_en: If you do something as soon as possible, you do it as soon as you can. If you get as much as possible of something, you get as much of it as you can.

defs.def_cn: （与形容词最高级连用，表示强调）最…的

ext.ext_cn: 他们在最不景气的时候进入了就业市场。
ext.ext_en: They have joined the job market at the  worst possible time...

ext.ext_cn: 我们清楚明白地表达了我们的失望、伤心和愤怒。
ext.ext_en: We expressed in the clearest possible way our disappointment, hurt and anger...

defs.def_en: You use possible with superlative adjectives to emphasize that something has more or less of a quality than anything else of its kind.

defs.def_cn: 如果可能的话；要是有可能的话

ext.ext_cn: 我要见你，如果可能，马上。
ext.ext_en: I need to see you, right away if possible.

ext.ext_cn: 只要有可能就应维护和平的道义责任
ext.ext_en: ...the moral duty to uphold peace if at all possible.

defs.def_en: You use possible in expressions such as 'if possible' and 'if at all possible' when stating a wish or intention, to show that although this is what you really want, you may have to accept something different.

ext.ext_cn: 官方消息人士在公开推测谁有可能成为接任劳伦斯博士的人选。
ext.ext_en: Government sources are now openly speculating about a possible successor for Dr Lawrence...

ext.ext_cn: 布拉德利本人就被认为是总统职位的有力竞争者。
ext.ext_en: Bradley has been considered a possible presidential contender himself.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as, for example, a possible Prime Minister, you mean that they may become Prime Minister.

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个手腕高超、富有胆识、足智多谋的民主党人，能够让不可能的事成为可能。
ext.ext_en: He is a democrat with the skill, nerve, and ingenuity to push the limits of the possible.

defs.def_en: The possible is everything that can be done in a situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人）值得尊敬的，正直的;（行为）光荣的，体面的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为他是个品行高洁的人，一心奉献于人民和工会的事业。
ext.ext_en: I believe he was an honourable man, dedicated to the people and his union...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为唯一体面的行为就只有一死。
ext.ext_en: He argued that the only honorable course of action was death...

defs.def_en: If you describe people or actions as honourable, you mean that they are good and deserve to be respected and admired.

defs.def_cn: （用于某些贵族和法官等官员名字前的尊称）尊敬的，阁下

ext.ext_cn: 尊敬的斯温顿·托马斯法官先生
ext.ext_en: ...the Honourable Mr Justice Swinton Thomas.

defs.def_en: Honourable is used as a title before the names of some members of the nobility, judges, and some other officials.

defs.def_cn: （英国议会辩论时议员彼此间的尊称）尊敬的，阁下

ext.ext_cn: 比勒里基区的议员阁下
ext.ext_en: ...the Honourable Member for Billericay.

defs.def_en: In debates in the British parliament, one member of parliament refers to another as the honourable member, the honourable gentleman, the honourable lady, or their honourable friend.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 皇室与世隔绝的生活
ext.ext_en: ...the cloistered world of royalty.

defs.def_en: If you have a cloistered way of life, you live quietly and are not involved in the normal busy life of the world around you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 草率建成的；粗制滥造的

ext.ext_cn: 偷工减料的设备
ext.ext_en: ...jerry-built equipment...

ext.ext_cn: 这地方建造得有些不牢靠。
ext.ext_en: The place is a bit jerry-built.

defs.def_en: If you describe houses or blocks of flats as jerry-built, you are critical of the fact that they have been built very quickly and cheaply, without much care for safety or quality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我很高兴自己的态度最终缓和了下来。
ext.ext_en: I'm glad I relented in the end...

ext.ext_cn: 这些人见到你好像发自内心地感到喜悦。
ext.ext_en: The people seem genuinely glad to see you...

defs.def_en: If you are glad about something, you are happy and pleased about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我将很乐意向你们展示一切。
ext.ext_en: I'll be glad to show you everything...

ext.ext_cn: 我们愿意回答任何问题。
ext.ext_en: We should be glad to answer any questions.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will be glad to do something, usually for someone else, you mean that you are willing and eager to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 报喜讯的人
ext.ext_en: ...the bringer of glad tidings.

defs.def_en: Glad tidings means good news.

ext.ext_cn: 好像他是个让人讨厌的旅客，尽向忙碌的人问些愚蠢的问题
ext.ext_en: ...as if he were a pesky tourist asking silly questions of a busy man.

defs.def_en: Pesky means irritating.

defs.def_cn: 急救医士；医务辅助人员

ext.ext_cn: 我们计划在未来3年内为每辆救护车配备一名急救医士。
ext.ext_en: We intend to have a paramedic on every ambulance within the next three years.

defs.def_en: A paramedic is a person whose training is similar to that of a nurse and who helps to do medical work.
Ketchup is a thick, cold sauce, usually made from tomatoes, that is sold in bottles.

defs.def_cn: 英国皇家海军舰艇（用于船名前）

ext.ext_cn: 英国皇家海军军舰“勇士号”下水
ext.ext_en: ...launching HMS Warrior.

defs.def_en: HMS is used before the names of ships in the British Royal Navy. HMS is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'Her Majesty's Ship' or 'His Majesty's Ship'.

ext.ext_cn: 无籽儿葡萄
ext.ext_en: ...seedless grapes.

defs.def_en: A seedless fruit has no seeds in it.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国已经制定了有关投票资格的标准细则。
ext.ext_en: The UN has established detailed criteria for who should be allowed to vote...

ext.ext_cn: 这所学院由一名意大利教授于1989年创建。
ext.ext_en: The School was established in 1989 by an Italian professor.

defs.def_en: If someone establishes something such as an organization, a type of activity, or a set of rules, they create it or introduce it in such a way that it is likely to last for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 我们已经和那家博物馆建立了联系。
ext.ext_en: We had already established contact with the museum...

ext.ext_cn: 新加坡和南非已经建立了外交关系。
ext.ext_en: Singapore and South Africa have established diplomatic relations.

defs.def_en: If you establish contact with someone, you start to have contact with them. You can also say that two people, groups, or countries establish contact.

ext.ext_cn: 医学化验证实她不是他们的亲骨肉。
ext.ext_en: Medical tests established that she was not their own child...

ext.ext_cn: 查清楚这笔钱将作何用途至关重要。
ext.ext_en: It will be essential to establish how the money is being spent...

defs.def_en: If you establish that something is true, you discover facts that show that it is definitely true.

defs.def_cn: 使立足;使被认可;确立(地位)

ext.ext_cn: 这将是大有前途的喜剧演员们让自己获得认可的节目。
ext.ext_en: This is going to be the show where up-and-coming comedians will establish themselves...

ext.ext_cn: 他已经确立了自己在美国政界的核心地位。
ext.ext_en: He has established himself as a pivotal figure in US politics...

defs.def_en: If you establish yourself, your reputation, or a good quality that you have, you succeed in doing something, and achieve respect or a secure position as a result of this.

ext.ext_cn: 他徒劳无功。
ext.ext_en: His efforts were to no avail...

ext.ext_cn: 我一再道歉，但丝毫没有奏效。
ext.ext_en: I apologized repeatedly, but to little avail.

defs.def_en: If you do something to no avail or to little avail, what you do fails to achieve what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 宾客们应该可以随意使用你们的各种设施。
ext.ext_en: Guests should feel at liberty to avail themselves of your facilities.

defs.def_en: If you avail yourself of an offer or an opportunity, you accept the offer or make use of the opportunity.
A haversack is a canvas bag that is usually worn over one shoulder.
A queen-size bed is larger than a double bed, but smaller than a king-size bed.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎不可能确认死因。
ext.ext_en: It was almost impossible to pinpoint the cause of death.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你能确切地解释愤怒从何而来
ext.ext_en: ...if you can pinpoint exactly what the anger is about...

defs.def_en: If you pinpoint something or its position, you discover or show exactly where it is.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 出言不逊的；冒犯顶撞的

Lippy is short for lipstick.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 高的（不用于形容人或动植物）

ext.ext_en: ...a house, with a high wall all around it...

ext.ext_en: Mount Marcy is the highest mountain in the Adirondacks.

ext.ext_en: ...an elegant bronze horse only nine inches high...

ext.ext_cn: 院子里的草有齐腰高。
ext.ext_en: The grass in the yard was waist high...

defs.def_en: You use high to talk or ask about how much something upright measures from the bottom to the top.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （相对地面、海平面、其他人或物）高的

ext.ext_en: I looked down from the high window...

ext.ext_cn: 桥很高，被几个大木墩托起。
ext.ext_en: The bridge was high, jacked up on wooden piers...

defs.def_en: If something is high, it is a long way above the ground, above sea level, or above a person or thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The European country with the highest birth rate is Ireland...

ext.ext_cn: 官方报告称死伤惨重。
ext.ext_en: Official reports said casualties were high...

defs.def_en: You can use high to indicate that something is great in amount, degree, or intensity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不要吃太多浓酱汁、油炸食品和甜腻的油酥点心，因为这些食品的脂肪含量很高。
ext.ext_en: Don't indulge in rich sauces, fried food and thick pastry as these are high in fat.

ext.ext_cn: 富含钙的优质堆肥
ext.ext_en: ...a superb compost, high in calcium.

defs.def_en: If a food or other substance is high in a particular ingredient, it contains a large amount of that ingredient.

ext.ext_en: Traffic from Jordan to Iraq is down to a dozen loaded lorries a day, compared with a high of 200 a day...

ext.ext_en: Sales of Russian vodka have reached an all-time high.

defs.def_en: If something reaches a high of a particular amount or degree, that is the greatest it has ever been.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The Labour Party has not made the issue a high priority...

ext.ext_cn: 经济改革已成为头等大事。
ext.ext_en: Economic reform is high on the agenda.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a high priority or is high on your list, you mean that you consider it to be one of the most important things you have to do or deal with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Was there anyone particularly high in the administration who was an advocate of a different policy?...

ext.ext_en: Every single one of the arms companies is controlled by the families of high officials.

defs.def_en: Someone who is high in a particular profession or society, or has a high position, has a very important position and has great authority and influence.

ext.ext_en: Neither Anna nor I are interested in high finance.

ext.ext_en: ...the rise of Japan's high technology industries.

defs.def_en: You can use high to describe something that is advanced or complex.

ext.ext_en: We just do not set our sights high enough.

defs.def_en: If you aim high, you try to obtain or to achieve the best that you can.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: People have such high expectations of you.

defs.def_en: If someone has a high reputation, or people have a high opinion of them, people think they are very good in some way, for example at their work.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: His team were of the highest calibre...

defs.def_en: If the quality or standard of something is high, it is very good indeed.

defs.def_en: If someone has high principles, they are morally good.

defs.def_en: A high sound or voice is close to the top of a particular range of notes.

ext.ext_en: ...the first prototype aircraft.

ext.ext_cn: 他是老一辈政治家的典型。
ext.ext_en: He was the prototype of the elder statesman.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is a prototype of a type of person or thing, you mean that they are the first or most typical one of that type.

ext.ext_cn: 和他分居的妻子
ext.ext_en: ...his estranged wife.

ext.ext_en: He was laid to rest yesterday without a final goodbye from his estranged son...
