ext.ext_cn: 世界上最伟大的摇滚乐队
ext.ext_en: ...the greatest rock 'n' roll band in the world.

defs.def_en: Rock and roll is a kind of popular music developed in the 1950s which has a strong beat and is played on electrical instruments.

defs.def_cn: (因未付清全款而)收回，重新占有

ext.ext_cn: 他的汽车因为欠款被公司收回。
ext.ext_en: His car was repossessed by the company...

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司收回房产的销售额上升了40%。
ext.ext_en: The firm's sales of repossessed properties is up by 40 per cent.

defs.def_en: If your car or house is repossessed, the people who supplied it take it back because they are still owed money for it.
Judo is a sport in which two people fight and try to throw each other to the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 镇上的警察穿着深蓝色制服，戴着鸭舌帽。
ext.ext_en: The town police wear dark blue uniforms and flat caps...

ext.ext_cn: 菲利普身着制服，腰带上别着手枪皮套。
ext.ext_en: Philippe was in uniform, wearing a pistol holster on his belt...

defs.def_en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school.

ext.ext_cn: 马克一身年轻男性旅行者的典型行头——绿军裤、T恤外加衬衫。
ext.ext_en: Mark's is the uniform of the young male traveller — green Army trousers, T-shirt and shirt.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the particular style of clothing which a group of people wear to show they belong to a group or a movement as their uniform.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （同一物）始终如一的，均匀的，划一的

ext.ext_cn: 土豆条要切得大小厚薄均匀。
ext.ext_en: Chips should be cut into uniform size and thickness...

ext.ext_cn: 所有流动的水看似一成不变，但实际上内部分成许多广延的面，或者说层，彼此逆向移动。
ext.ext_en: All flowing water, though it appears to be uniform, is actually divided into extensive inner surfaces, or layers, moving against one another...

defs.def_en: If something is uniform, it does not vary, but is even and regular throughout.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （不同物）全都相同的，一律的，清一色的

ext.ext_cn: 每面墙边都一溜摆着相同的绿色金属档案柜。
ext.ext_en: Along each wall stretched uniform green metal filing cabinets...

ext.ext_cn: 虾放养在清一色的长池子里，再送到附近的包装车间冷冻，最后用船运往北方。
ext.ext_en: Shrimp are raised in long uniform ponds, frozen in the nearby packing plant and shipped north.

defs.def_en: If you describe a number of things as uniform, you mean that they are all the same.

ext.ext_cn: 绗缝的床罩
ext.ext_en: ...a quilted bedspread.

defs.def_en: Something that is quilted consists of two layers of fabric with a layer of thick material between them, often decorated with lines of stitching which form a pattern.
If an economy is suffering from stagflation, inflation is high but there is no increase in the demand for goods or in the number of people who have jobs.

ext.ext_cn: “你能不能给董事会打电话，提醒他们我觉得自己应该辞职？”——“我会的，但我认为你这是在逃避责任。”
ext.ext_en: 'Will you call the board to alert them that I feel I should resign?' — 'I'll do it. But I think you're copping out.'

defs.def_en: See also:cop-out;If you say that someone is copping out, you mean they are avoiding doing something they should do.

defs.def_cn: （致词、书信或演出）告别的，告别性质的

ext.ext_cn: 沃克先生，在担任主席职务两年后发表了告别演说
ext.ext_en: ...Mr Walker, making his valedictory address after two years as chairman.

ext.ext_cn: 她离开情人时唱起的离别咏叹调
ext.ext_en: ...her valedictory aria, sung as she leaves her lover.

defs.def_en: A valedictory speech, letter, or performance is one that is intended as a way of saying goodbye when someone leaves another person, a place, or a job.

defs.def_cn: （优秀生在毕业典礼上作的）告别演说

ext.ext_cn: 他听了霍华德在中学毕业典礼上作的告别演讲。
ext.ext_en: He listened to Howard give the valedictory address at high school graduation.

defs.def_en: A valedictory is a speech that is given by the student with the highest marks in their class at their graduation ceremony.

defs.def_cn: 不理解的；困惑的；迷惑的

ext.ext_cn: 他困惑地盯着那个瓶子看了好一会儿。
ext.ext_en: He gave the bottle a long, uncomprehending look.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as uncomprehending, you mean that they do not understand what is happening or what someone has said.

ext.ext_cn: 长生不老药
ext.ext_en: ...the elixir of life.

defs.def_en: An elixir is a liquid that is considered to have magical powers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 应受责备的;难辞其咎的

ext.ext_cn: 他们不采取任何行动的决定使他们难辞其咎。
ext.ext_en: Their decision to do nothing makes them culpable.

ext.ext_cn: 应该受到处罚的因为疏忽导致的过失杀人罪
ext.ext_en: ...manslaughter resulting from culpable negligence.

defs.def_en: If someone or their conduct is culpable, they are responsible for something wrong or bad that has happened.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is gormless, you think that they are stupid because they do not understand things very well.

ext.ext_cn: 眉开眼笑的矮胖男人
ext.ext_en: ...a short, roly-poly man with laughing eyes.

defs.def_en: Roly-poly people are pleasantly fat and round.

defs.def_cn: (人或身体某部位)生冻疮的，冻伤的
defs.def_en: If a person or a part of their body is frostbitten, they are suffering from frostbite.

ext.ext_cn: 防弹玻璃
ext.ext_en: ...bullet-proof glass.

ext.ext_cn: 防弹背心
ext.ext_en: ...a bullet-proof vest.

defs.def_en: Something that is bullet-proof is made of a strong material that bullets cannot pass through.

ext.ext_cn: 学生可以就计算语言学的任何一个方面展开研究。
ext.ext_en: Students may pursue research in any aspect of computational linguistics.

ext.ext_cn: 50年前各种计算机方法的局限性
ext.ext_en: ...the limits of the computational methods available 50 years ago.

defs.def_en: Computational means using computers.

defs.def_cn: （同类事物中的）另一个，再一个

ext.ext_cn: 马德里加尔夫人给另一片烤面包涂上了黄油。
ext.ext_en: Mrs. Madrigal buttered another piece of toast...

ext.ext_cn: 我们又要有一个孩子。
ext.ext_en: We're going to have another baby.

defs.def_en: Another thing or person means an additional thing or person of the same type as one that already exists.

ext.ext_cn: 我想他改天就会处理这个问题。
ext.ext_en: I think he's just going to deal with this problem another day...

ext.ext_cn: 咨询指导让她去看另一位治疗专家。
ext.ext_en: The counsellor referred her to another therapist.

defs.def_en: You use another when you want to emphasize that an additional thing or person is different to one that already exists.

ext.ext_cn: 对我们男孩子来说另一个极度刺激的时刻是战争爆发。
ext.ext_en: Another time of great excitement for us boys was when war broke out...

ext.ext_cn: 休所作的另一个改变是安装中央供暖系统。
ext.ext_en: Another change that Sue made was to install central heating.

defs.def_en: You use another at the beginning of a statement to link it to a previous statement.

defs.def_cn: （用在距离、时间段或其他量词之前）又…的，再…的

ext.ext_cn: 沿同一条路再往前走两公里，直至到达圣马丽亚教堂。
ext.ext_en: Continue down the same road for another 2 kilometres until you reach the church of Santa Maria...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为物价涨幅不会再超过4个百分点。
ext.ext_en: He believes prices will not rise by more than another 4 per cent.

defs.def_en: You use another before a word referring to a distance, length of time, or other amount, to indicate an additional amount.

defs.def_cn: （用于有名的人物、地点或事件前表示与其类似的）另一个…，类似…的

ext.ext_cn: 你可能成不了第二个海明威，但你可以练就一手好文笔。
ext.ext_en: You may never be another Hemingway, but you can learn to write well.

defs.def_en: You use another in front of the name of a well-known person, place, or event to indicate that you think someone or something is just like that person, place, or event.

ext.ext_cn: 学着自助和互助的妇女们
ext.ext_en: ...women learning to help themselves and one another...

ext.ext_cn: 两国之间很少有贸易往来。
ext.ext_en: The two countries do little trade with one another.

defs.def_en: You use one another to indicate that each member of a group does something to or for the other members.

ext.ext_cn: 他们以无畏和无私奉献的精神迎接了一个又一个的困难。
ext.ext_en: They had faced one difficulty after another with bravery and dedication...

ext.ext_cn: 他们并未停手，摧毁了一家又一家商店。
ext.ext_en: They kept going, destroying one store after another.

defs.def_en: If you talk about one thing after another, you are referring to a series of repeated or continuous events.

defs.def_cn: （表示不确指）各种不同的，各种各样的

ext.ext_cn: 聚集在这个宽敞厨房里的家庭成员和来访的各类艺术家
ext.ext_en: ...family members and visiting artists of one kind or another crowding the huge kitchen...

ext.ext_cn: 所有这些产业都曾在不同时期与癌症有过联系。
ext.ext_en: All of these industries have at one time or another been linked to cancer.

defs.def_en: You use or another in expressions such as one kind or another when you do not want to be precise about which of several alternatives or possibilities you are referring to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人、动物)脚步稳的，不会摔倒的

ext.ext_cn: 我的马虽矮小，但精瘦结实，走路稳当。
ext.ext_en: My horse is small but wiry and sure-footed.

defs.def_en: A person or animal that is sure-footed can move easily over steep or uneven ground without falling.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 工党的信心日益增强。
ext.ext_en: The Labour Party was growing increasingly sure-footed.

defs.def_en: If someone is sure-footed, they are confident in what they are doing.

defs.def_cn: 未被看见的；未引起注意的；被忽视的

ext.ext_cn: 我试图趁没人注意溜上楼去。
ext.ext_en: I tried to slip up the stairs unnoticed...

ext.ext_cn: 她44岁的生日就这样过去了，除了她自己没人注意到。
ext.ext_en: Her forty-fourth birthday had just passed, unnoticed by all but herself.

defs.def_en: If something happens or passes unnoticed, it is not seen or noticed by anyone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她出众的相貌和迷人的气质
ext.ext_en: ...her striking looks and charismatic personality.

defs.def_en: A charismatic person attracts, influences, and inspires people by their personal qualities.

defs.def_cn: (基督教会中相信人可以得到神赐异能的)神恩教派的
defs.def_en: The charismatic church is the part of the Christian Church that believes that people can obtain special gifts from God, for example the power to heal sick people.
A magic wand or a wand is a long thin rod that magicians and fairies wave when they are performing tricks and magic.

ext.ext_cn: 能够保证公正的和平的灵丹妙药是不存在的。
ext.ext_en: There is no magic wand to secure a just peace...

ext.ext_cn: 人民不能指望他创造奇迹。
ext.ext_en: People can't expect him to wave a magic wand.

defs.def_en: You use magic wand, especially in the expression there is no magic wand, to indicate that someone is dealing with a difficult problem which cannot be solved quickly and easily.

ext.ext_cn: 她坚称将军已经预先知晓了这个阴谋。
ext.ext_en: She has maintained that the General had foreknowledge of the plot.

defs.def_en: If you have foreknowledge of an event or situation, you have some knowledge of it before it actually happens.

ext.ext_cn: 钻石项链和与之相配的耳环
ext.ext_en: ...a diamond necklace and matching earrings.

defs.def_en: A necklace is a piece of jewellery such as a chain or a string of beads which someone, usually a woman, wears round their neck.

defs.def_cn: 给…戴火项链(指将淋了汽油的轮胎套在某人脖子上并点燃的私刑)

ext.ext_cn: 破坏罢工的嫌疑人，其房屋遭汽油弹炸毁，人被砍死或被套上火项链烧死。
ext.ext_en: Alleged strike breakers had their houses petrol-bombed or were hacked to death or necklaced.

defs.def_en: To necklace someone means to kill them by putting a tyre soaked in petrol around their neck and then setting fire to it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以理解的；晦涩难懂的

ext.ext_cn: 他嘴里不知咕哝了几句什么。
ext.ext_en: He muttered something unintelligible...

ext.ext_cn: 我努力想插上话，可是大部分谈话内容我都听不懂。
ext.ext_en: I did my best to join in, but the conversation was largely unintelligible.

defs.def_en: Unintelligible language is impossible to understand, for example because it is not written or pronounced clearly, or because its meaning is confused or complicated.

defs.def_cn: (英国高等法院的)大法官法庭
defs.def_en: In Britain, the Chancery or Chancery Division is the Lord Chancellor's court, which is a division of the High Court of Justice.
also out-tray. An out tray is a shallow container used in offices to put letters and documents in when they have been dealt with and are ready to be sent somewhere else.

defs.def_cn: 集体治疗法（一组病人相互讨论各自问题的一种心理治疗法）
defs.def_en: Group therapy is a form of psychiatric treatment in which a group of people discuss their problems with each other.

ext.ext_cn: 山坡下面，野山羊咩咩地轻声叫着。
ext.ext_en: From the slope below, the wild goats bleated faintly.

ext.ext_cn: 一小群咩咩叫的母羊和羊羔
ext.ext_en: ...a small flock of bleating ewes and lambs.

defs.def_en: When a sheep or goat bleats, it makes the sound that sheep and goats typically make.

defs.def_cn: 微弱地尖声诉说；羊叫般地说

ext.ext_cn: “我不想要它，”埃里克微弱地尖声说。
ext.ext_en: 'I don't want it,' Eric bleated.

ext.ext_cn: 她想尖叫，但最终只是发出了这么微弱的呻吟。
ext.ext_en: She wanted to scream, but all that would come out was this faint bleat.

defs.def_en: If someone bleats, they speak in a weak, high voice.

ext.ext_cn: 他们总是抱怨“不公平的”外国竞争。
ext.ext_en: They are always bleating about 'unfair' foreign competition...

ext.ext_cn: 不要一有问题就跑来向我哭诉。
ext.ext_en: Don't come bleating to me every time something goes wrong.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone bleats about something, you mean that they complain about it in a way which makes them sound weak and irritating.

ext.ext_cn: 禁止州会计师招揽生意的法律
ext.ext_en: ...laws prohibiting the state's accountants from pitching for business...

ext.ext_cn: 他们争取的是中产阶级的选票。
ext.ext_en: It was middle-class votes they were pitching for.

defs.def_en: If someone is pitching for something, they are trying to persuade other people to give it to them.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第3个字母
defs.def_en: C is the third letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_cn: C大调音阶中的第一音;C音
defs.def_en: In music, C is the first note in the scale of C major.
If you get a C as a mark for a piece of work or in an exam, your work is average.

ext.ext_cn: 博物馆内对一家纽约餐厅(约1825-1835年)的再现
ext.ext_en: ...the museum's recreation of a New York dining-room (c. 1825-35).

defs.def_en: c. is written in front of a date or number to indicate that it is approximate. c. is an abbreviation for (缩略 =) 'circa'.

defs.def_cn: (用于首字母为C的一些单词的缩写,如 copyright, Celsius 等)

ext.ext_cn: 把炉子加热到摄氏180度。
ext.ext_en: Heat the oven to 180˚C.

defs.def_en: C or c is used as an abbreviation for words beginning with c, such as 'copyright' or 'Celsius'.

ext.ext_cn: 他开着自己的车参加赛车，也把它们出租用来拍电影、电视和广告片。
ext.ext_en: He races his cars, and hires them out for film, TV and promo videos.

defs.def_en: A promo is something such as a short video film which is used to promote a product.
A lintel is a piece of stone or wood over a door or window which supports the bricks above the door or window.

ext.ext_cn: 他探询地挑起了眉毛。
ext.ext_en: He raised a questioning eyebrow.

defs.def_en: See also:question;If someone has a questioning expression on their face, they look as if they want to know the answer to a question.

defs.def_cn: (鱼或动物的)背部的，背上的，背侧的

ext.ext_cn: 海豚的背鳍
ext.ext_en: ...a dolphin's dorsal fin.

defs.def_en: Dorsal means relating to the back of a fish or animal.

ext.ext_cn: 她一直在找一个去纽约的好借口。
ext.ext_en: She had been casting around for a good excuse to go to New York.

defs.def_en: If you cast around for something or cast about for it, you try to find it or think of it.

ext.ext_cn: 墙上挂满了老牌英雄人物发黄的旧照片。
ext.ext_en: The walls are hung with sepia photographs of old school heroes.

defs.def_en: Something that is sepia is deep brown in colour, like the colour of very old photographs.

ext.ext_cn: 总统同意修订宪法，允许多党选举。
ext.ext_en: The president agreed to amend the constitution and allow multi-party elections...

ext.ext_cn: “你必须承认这个男人有魅力，”尼科尔森说。“是诱惑力，”韦尔斯纠正说。
ext.ext_en: 'You must admit that the man has got charm,' said Nicolson. 'Glamour,' amended Wells.

defs.def_en: If you amend something that has been written such as a law, or something that is said, you change it in order to improve it or make it more accurate.

ext.ext_cn: 他导致了他们的婚姻破裂，因此想作出补偿。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to make amends for causing their marriage to fail.

defs.def_en: If you make amends when you have harmed someone, you show that you are sorry by doing something to please them.

defs.def_cn: 将…一分为二；把…分为两部分

ext.ext_cn: 这条主干道把整个小镇一分为二。
ext.ext_en: The main street bisects the town from end to end.

defs.def_en: If something long and thin bisects an area or line, it divides the area or line in half.

ext.ext_cn: 你不会记得我。我那时在另外一组。
ext.ext_en: You wouldn't remember me. I was in another group...

ext.ext_cn: 我当然完全不记得和你讲过话。
ext.ext_en: I certainly don't remember talking to you at all...

defs.def_en: If you remember people or events from the past, you still have an idea of them in your mind and you are able to think about them.

defs.def_cn: (经过一段时间后)忆起，回忆起

ext.ext_cn: 她记起来那晚她正要去社交俱乐部。
ext.ext_en: She remembered that she was going to the social club that evening...

ext.ext_cn: 然后我想起了那张支票，这让我精神大振。
ext.ext_en: Then I remembered the cheque, which cheered me up.

defs.def_en: If you remember that something is the case, you become aware of it again after a time when you did not think about it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你记不住你的号码，用代码把它记在记事本上。
ext.ext_en: If you can't remember your number, write it in code in a diary...

ext.ext_cn: 我从未有过如此安全的感觉。
ext.ext_en: I couldn't remember ever having felt so safe and secure...

defs.def_en: If you cannot remember something, you are not able to bring it back into your mind when you make an effort to do so.

ext.ext_cn: 我的确记得拿了礼物。
ext.ext_en: I did remember to take the present...

ext.ext_cn: 请记得写信时在信封里放一个贴好邮票、写明地址的信封。
ext.ext_en: Please remember to enclose a stamped addressed envelope when writing.

defs.def_en: If you remember to do something, you do it when you intend to.

ext.ext_cn: 重要的是要记住每个人的反应不同。
ext.ext_en: It is important to remember that each person reacts differently...

ext.ext_cn: 值得记住的是孩子们在这一方面往往会效仿父母。
ext.ext_en: It is worth remembering that children tend to copy their parents in this respect...

defs.def_en: You tell someone to remember that something is the case when you want to emphasize its importance. It may be something that they already know about or a new piece of information.

ext.ext_cn: 在文法学校他因不善于玩游戏为大家所熟知。
ext.ext_en: At his grammar school he is remembered for being bad at games...

ext.ext_cn: 作为最伟大的财政大臣之一他将永远被铭记。
ext.ext_en: He will always be remembered as one of the great Chancellors of the Exchequer.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone will be remembered for something that they have done, you mean that people will think of this whenever they think about the person.

ext.ext_cn: “代我问候莱尔，好吗？”我说。
ext.ext_en: 'Remember me to Lyle, won't you?' I said...

ext.ext_cn: 她要我转达对你的问候。
ext.ext_en: She asked to be remembered to you.

defs.def_en: If you ask someone to remember you to a person who you have not seen for a long time, you are asking them to pass your greetings on to that person.

ext.ext_cn: 我们将带给大家一个难忘的夜晚。
ext.ext_en: We'll give everyone a night to remember...

ext.ext_cn: 我将使这成为一个难忘的生日。
ext.ext_en: I'll make it a birthday to remember.

defs.def_en: If you make a celebration an occasion to remember, you make it very enjoyable for all the people involved.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 饥饿的;感到饿的;辘辘饥肠的

ext.ext_cn: 我的朋友饿了，于是我们开车去一家购物中心吃饭。
ext.ext_en: My friend was hungry, so we drove to a shopping mall to get some food...

ext.ext_cn: 她沦落到要靠偷窃来养活饥饿的家人。
ext.ext_en: She is reduced to stealing to feed her hungry family.

defs.def_en: When you are hungry, you want some food because you have not eaten for some time and have an uncomfortable or painful feeling in your stomach.

ext.ext_cn: 利奥尼达斯家曾经很穷，他有很多年都吃不饱肚子。
ext.ext_en: Leonidas' family had been poor, he went hungry for years.

defs.def_en: If people go hungry, they do not have enough food to eat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 苏珊无疑一心想过一种和现在不同的生活。
ext.ext_en: Susan was certainly hungry for a life different from the one she had made for herself...

ext.ext_cn: 我于1961年离开牛津，渴望成为一名评论家。
ext.ext_en: I left Oxford in 1961 hungry to be a critic.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is hungry for something, you are emphasizing that they want it very much.

defs.def_cn: (尤指关系要好的)同学，同窗，校友

ext.ext_cn: 他和一个同学创办了那份杂志。
ext.ext_en: He started the magazine with a schoolmate...

ext.ext_cn: 学校的老师们很喜欢他，但同学们对他并不待见。
ext.ext_en: He was a favorite with his schoolmasters but not his schoolmates.

defs.def_en: A schoolmate is a child who goes to the same school as you, especially one who is your friend.
A cathode-ray tube is a device in televisions and computer terminals which sends an image onto the screen.

ext.ext_cn: 将马铃薯戳一些洞，并用盐揉搓外皮。
ext.ext_en: Prick the potatoes and rub the skins with salt...

ext.ext_cn: 他用大头针在箔纸上戳一些孔。
ext.ext_en: He pricks holes in the foil with a pin.

defs.def_en: If you prick something or prick holes in it, you make small holes in it with a sharp object such as a pin.

ext.ext_cn: 她刚用针把手指扎破了。
ext.ext_en: She had just pricked her finger with the needle.

defs.def_en: If something sharp pricks you or if you prick yourself with something sharp, it sticks into you or presses your skin and causes you pain.

ext.ext_cn: 大卫德觉得眼泪就要流出来了。
ext.ext_en: Davydd felt tears prick his eyes.

defs.def_en: If tears prick your eyes, you feel as if you are about to cry.

defs.def_cn: 刺激（良心）；使突然经受；触动

ext.ext_cn: 一旦我们使他们良心发现，大多数人还是有同情心的。
ext.ext_en: Most were sympathetic once we pricked their consciences...

ext.ext_cn: 我突然感到好奇。
ext.ext_en: I was pricked by the needle of curiosity.

defs.def_en: If something pricks your conscience, you suddenly feel guilty about it. If you are pricked by an emotion, you suddenly experience that emotion.

ext.ext_cn: 同时，她觉得脖子上一阵刺痛。
ext.ext_en: At the same time she felt a prick on her neck.

defs.def_en: A prick is a small, sharp pain that you get when something pricks you.
If someone calls a man a prick, they are indicating that they do not like him and that they think he is stupid.
A man's prick is his penis.

ext.ext_cn: 他公然指责对手胆小懦弱。
ext.ext_en: He openly accused his opponents of cowardice.

defs.def_en: Cowardice is cowardly behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 她一袭天蓝色的真丝衬衫式连身裙，和她的双眸颜色一样。
ext.ext_en: Her silk shirtdress was sky-blue, the colour of her eyes.

defs.def_en: Something that is sky-blue is a very pale blue in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 霍乱流行
ext.ext_en: ...a cholera epidemic.

defs.def_en: Cholera is a serious disease that often kills people. It is caused by drinking infected water or by eating infected food.

ext.ext_cn: 马饲料
ext.ext_en: ...fodder for horses...

ext.ext_cn: 苜蓿科植物广泛用作动物饲料。
ext.ext_en: The alfalfa plant is widely used as animal fodder.

defs.def_en: Fodder is food that is given to cows, horses, and other animals.

ext.ext_cn: 记者招待会只不过是提供了更多的再次击他人格的口实。
ext.ext_en: The press conference simply provided more fodder for another attack on his character...

ext.ext_cn: 老电影是最廉价的播放素材。
ext.ext_en: Old movies were the cheapest broadcast fodder.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is fodder for a particular purpose, you mean that it is useful for that purpose and perhaps nothing else.

ext.ext_cn: 经历了一次严重的心脏病发作之后，他被绑在床上，全身都插着导管。
ext.ext_en: After a massive heart attack, he was strapped to a bed, with tubes in every orifice.

defs.def_en: An orifice is an opening or hole, especially one in your body such as your mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 政府不断努力重申其对该地区的控制权
ext.ext_en: ...the government's continuing effort to reassert its control in the region...

ext.ext_cn: 大人们重申他们旧时的权威。
ext.ext_en: The adults had reasserted their old authority.

defs.def_en: If you reassert your control or authority, you make it clear that you are still in a position of power, or you strengthen the power that you had.

defs.def_cn: （想法、习惯等）再次显现，再次出现

ext.ext_cn: 他的幽默感开始再次显现。
ext.ext_en: His sense of humour was beginning to reassert itself.

defs.def_en: If something such as an idea or habit reasserts itself, it becomes noticeable again.

defs.def_cn: (加在表示国家的形容词前构成形容词)表示“中国与…的”，“中…的”

ext.ext_cn: 中越友谊
ext.ext_en: ...Sino-Vietnamese friendship.

ext.ext_cn: 中日贸易和投资
ext.ext_en: ...Sino-Japanese trade and investment.

defs.def_en: Sino- is added to adjectives indicating nationality to form adjectives which describe relations between China and another country.

ext.ext_cn: 他作为政党领袖和国家元首的双重身份
ext.ext_en: ...his dual role as head of the party and head of state...

ext.ext_cn: 罗布或许能拥有双重国籍。
ext.ext_en: Rob may be entitled to dual nationality.

defs.def_en: Dual means having two parts, functions, or aspects.

defs.def_cn: 漫无边际地闲扯;喋喋不休地说

ext.ext_cn: 埃拉漫无边际地闲扯，她心不在焉地听着。
ext.ext_en: She only half-listened as Ella rambled on...

ext.ext_cn: 他站在我的厨房里喝着啤酒，漫无边际地讲着有关莉莲的事情。
ext.ext_en: He stood in my kitchen drinking beer, rambling on about Lillian.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is rambling on, you mean that they have been talking for a long time in a boring and rather confused way.

defs.def_cn: （尤指为查明死因而）挖出，掘出（尸体）

ext.ext_cn: 他的遗体被从纽约市皇后区的墓地里挖了出来。
ext.ext_en: His remains have been exhumed from a cemetery in Queens, New York City.

defs.def_en: If a dead person's body is exhumed, it is taken out of the ground where it is buried, especially so that it can be examined in order to find out how the person died.

defs.def_cn: 公开地；公然地；未加隐瞒地；坦率地

ext.ext_cn: 现在我们能公开谈论以前讳言不提的艾滋病问题。
ext.ext_en: We can now talk openly about AIDS which we couldn't before...

ext.ext_cn: 德国中央银行公开批评德国政府。
ext.ext_en: The Bundesbank has openly criticised the German Government...

defs.def_en: If you do something openly, you do it without hiding any facts or hiding your feelings.

defs.def_cn: 重新审视（观点、信仰或态度）

ext.ext_cn: 我们可能会重新审视我们的目标或我们实现目标的方法。
ext.ext_en: We may reexamine our goals or our methods for attaining our goals...

ext.ext_cn: 她的丈夫和孩子也都要重新审视他们的期望。
ext.ext_en: Her husband and children will also have to re-examine their expectations.

defs.def_en: If a person or group of people re-examines their ideas, beliefs, or attitudes, they think about them carefully because they are no longer sure if they are correct.

ext.ext_cn: 菲尔茨将遗赠给他妻子哈蒂和儿子克劳德共计两万美元。
ext.ext_en: Fields's will bequeathed his wife Hattie and son Claude the sum of twenty thousand dollars...

ext.ext_cn: 他把他所有的钱财都留给了孩子。
ext.ext_en: He bequeathed all his silver to his children.

defs.def_en: If you bequeath your money or property to someone, you legally state that they should have it when you die.

ext.ext_cn: 他给继任者留下了发展势头非常不错的经济。
ext.ext_en: He bequeaths his successor an economy that is doing quite well...

ext.ext_cn: 殖民主义给非洲确实没有留下多少东西。
ext.ext_en: It is true that colonialism did not bequeath much to Africa.

defs.def_en: If you bequeath an idea or system, you leave it for other people to use or develop.

ext.ext_cn: 乌黑的头发
ext.ext_en: ...jet-black hair.

defs.def_en: Something that is jet black is a very intense black.

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔伯格从墙上摘下那幅肖像画。
ext.ext_en: Alberg took the portrait down from the wall...

ext.ext_cn: 吉尔站起身，走到书架跟前，取下一本书。
ext.ext_en: Gil rose and went to his bookcase and took down a volume.

defs.def_en: If you take something down, you reach up and get it from a high place such as a shelf.

ext.ext_cn: 加拿大军队拆掉了印第安人设置的路障。
ext.ext_en: The Canadian army took down the barricades erected by the Indians...

ext.ext_cn: 他们支起鸟食台，可是人人都嫌它碍事，所以莱斯就想把它拆了。
ext.ext_en: They put up the bird table, but it got in everyone else's way so Les tried to take it down.

defs.def_en: If you take down a structure, you remove each piece of it.

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆，我们一直试着给你回电话，可是，或许我们把你的号码写错了。
ext.ext_en: We've been trying to get back to you, Tom, but we think we took your number down incorrectly...

ext.ext_cn: 我用速记法把他的评论记录了下来。
ext.ext_en: I took down his comments in shorthand.

defs.def_en: If you take down a piece of information or a statement, you write it down.

ext.ext_cn: 克莱尔坐在前排长木椅上。
ext.ext_en: Claire sat in the front pew.

defs.def_en: A pew is a long wooden seat with a back, which people sit on in church.

defs.def_cn: (输送液体或气体的)管道,管子

ext.ext_cn: 天花板上巨大的通风管道
ext.ext_en: ...a big air duct in the ceiling.

defs.def_en: A duct is a pipe, tube, or channel which carries a liquid or gas.

defs.def_cn: (人体内输送泪水、胆汁等的)导管

ext.ext_cn: 泪管
ext.ext_en: ...tear ducts.

defs.def_en: A duct is a tube in your body which carries a liquid such as tears or bile.

defs.def_cn: （举办聚会等的）女主人，女东道主

ext.ext_cn: 女主人介绍了他们。
ext.ext_en: The hostess introduced them...

ext.ext_cn: 她对我们大家来说都是个出色的女主人。
ext.ext_en: She was a superb hostess to us all.

defs.def_en: The hostess at a party is the woman who has invited the guests and provides the food, drink, or entertainment.

defs.def_cn: （夜总会或舞厅的）三陪女郎，舞女
defs.def_en: A hostess at a night club or dance hall is a woman who is paid by a man to be with him for the evening.

ext.ext_cn: 英国广播公司第一频道负责人的工作
ext.ext_en: ...the job of controller of BBC 1.

ext.ext_cn: WH史密斯公司的财政主管
ext.ext_en: ...the financial controller of W H Smith.

defs.def_en: See also:air traffic controller;A  controller is a person who has responsibility for a particular organization or for a particular part of an organization.
A controller is the same as a comptroller .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 罢工者的要求很不合理，他们在两周前已拒绝接受这份协议。
ext.ext_en: The strikers were being unreasonable in their demands, having rejected the deal two weeks ago...

ext.ext_cn: 与一个得克萨斯的花花公子的不正当关系导致她的婚姻破裂。
ext.ext_en: It was her unreasonable behaviour with a Texan playboy which broke up her marriage...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is being unreasonable, you mean that they are behaving in a way that is not fair or sensible.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 汽油价格的疯涨
ext.ext_en: ...unreasonable increases in the price of petrol...

ext.ext_cn: 1/4的消费者认为现在的水费很不合理。
ext.ext_en: One in four consumers now say water prices are very unreasonable.

defs.def_en: An unreasonable decision, action, price, or amount seems unfair and difficult to justify.

ext.ext_cn: 席卷美国东海岸的猛烈暴风雨
ext.ext_en: ...the violent storms which whipped America's East Coast.

defs.def_en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

defs.def_cn: 强烈的反应;群情激愤;激动人心

ext.ext_cn: 照片最初刊登出来时曾引起了一片公愤。
ext.ext_en: The photos caused a storm when they were first published...

ext.ext_cn: 公告一发布就引发了一场强烈的抗议。
ext.ext_en: The announcement provoked an immediate storm of protest.

defs.def_en: If something causes a storm, it causes an angry or excited reaction from a large number of people.

ext.ext_cn: 人们对他的演讲报以雷鸣般的掌声。
ext.ext_en: His speech was greeted with a storm of applause...

ext.ext_cn: 自1968 年奥运会以来，没有哪次颁奖仪式引起过如此哗然的一片嘘声。
ext.ext_en: Not since the 1968 Olympic Games has a medals ceremony caused such a storm of booing.

defs.def_en: A storm of applause or other noise is a sudden loud amount of it made by an audience or other group of people in reaction to something.

ext.ext_cn: 争吵了几句后，他气冲冲地走了出去。
ext.ext_en: After a bit of an argument, he stormed out...

ext.ext_cn: 他气冲冲地闯进一间办公室，质问部门经理在哪里。
ext.ext_en: He stormed into an office, demanding to know where the head of department was.

defs.def_en: If you storm into or out of a place, you enter or leave it quickly and noisily, because you are angry.

ext.ext_cn: “这是场彻底的失败，”他怒吼道。
ext.ext_en: 'It's a fiasco,' he stormed.

defs.def_en: If you storm, you say something in a very loud voice, because you are extremely angry.

ext.ext_cn: 政府大楼遭到了攻击和抢劫。
ext.ext_en: Government buildings have been stormed and looted...

ext.ext_cn: 难民们决定冲进大使馆。
ext.ext_en: The refugees decided to storm the embassy.

defs.def_en: If a place that is being defended is stormed, a group of people attack it, usually in order to get inside it.

ext.ext_cn: 肯尼亚的长跑运动员在田径界获得了巨大成功。
ext.ext_en: Kenya's long distance runners have taken the athletics world by storm.

defs.def_en: If someone or something takes a place by storm, they are extremely successful.

ext.ext_cn: 他坚称自己不会辞职，一定渡过难关。
ext.ext_en: He insists he will not resign and will weather the storm.

defs.def_en: If someone weathers the storm, they succeed in reaching the end of a very difficult period without much harm or damage.

ext.ext_cn: 烧焦炭的炉子
ext.ext_en: ...a coke-burning stove.

defs.def_en: Coke is a solid black substance that is produced from coal and is burned as a fuel.
Coke is the same as cocaine .

ext.ext_cn: 有圆点花纹的黄色比基尼
ext.ext_en: ...a yellow bikini with polka dots.

ext.ext_cn: 圆点花纹图案的紧身女式衬衫
ext.ext_en: ...a tight-fitting polka dot blouse.

defs.def_en: Polka dots are very small spots printed on a piece of cloth.

defs.def_cn: 囊性纤维变性;囊性纤维化
defs.def_en: Cystic fibrosis is a serious disease of the glands which usually affects children and can make breathing difficult.

ext.ext_cn: 星期四我们出去玩了一天。
ext.ext_en: On the Thursday we went out on a day trip...

ext.ext_cn: 马克被派往远东出差。
ext.ext_en: Mark was sent to the Far East on a business trip.

defs.def_en: See also:round trip;A trip is a journey that you make to a particular place.  →see usage note at:journey

ext.ext_cn: 她昨晚绊倒了，摔坏了髋骨。
ext.ext_en: She tripped and fell last night and broke her hip...

ext.ext_cn: 他想要跟着杰克在雪中留下的脚印走，却让一块石头绊倒了。
ext.ext_en: He tried to follow Jack's footsteps in the snow and tripped on a rock...

defs.def_en: If you trip when you are walking, you knock your foot against something and fall or nearly fall.

defs.def_cn: 使绊;将…绊倒; 使跌倒

ext.ext_cn: 一个家伙把脚伸出来想要绊倒我。
ext.ext_en: One guy stuck his foot out and tried to trip me.

ext.ext_cn: 他突然扑向吉姆叔叔的双腿，想要把他绊倒。
ext.ext_en: He made a sudden dive for Uncle Jim's legs to try to trip him up...

defs.def_en: If you trip someone who is walking or running, you put your foot or something else in front of them, so that they knock their own foot against it and fall or nearly fall.

defs.def_cn: (对权力等的)迷恋;(内疚、怀旧感等的)困扰

ext.ext_cn: 就好像去夏威夷就一定要开心似的，如果你不开心，你会一个劲儿地感到愧疚。
ext.ext_en: There's such pressure to be happy in Hawaii, if you're unhappy you're on a guilt trip...

ext.ext_cn: 顶级的明星待遇和无上的权力体验肯定要数私人飞机了。
ext.ext_en: The biggest star perk, and the biggest power trip, must be the private plane.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is, for example, on a power trip, a guilt trip, or a nostalgia trip, you mean that their behaviour is motivated by power, guilt, or nostalgia.

ext.ext_cn: 焦虑或抑郁的人吸毒后可能会有非常糟糕的幻觉。
ext.ext_en: An anxious or depressed person can experience a really bad trip.

defs.def_en: A trip is an experience that someone has when their mind is affected by a drug such as LSD.

ext.ext_cn: 有一天晚上我服用了迷幻药后正在幻游。
ext.ext_en: One night I was tripping on acid.

defs.def_en: If someone is tripping, they are having an experience in which their mind is affected by a drug such as LSD.

ext.ext_cn: 一个身穿红色罩衫的女孩迈着轻快的步子下山。
ext.ext_en: A girl in a red smock tripped down the hill...

ext.ext_cn: 他们轻快地走着，几乎没有世间的烦恼。
ext.ext_en: They tripped along with scarcely a care in the world.

defs.def_en: If someone trips somewhere, they walk there with light, quick steps.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 最重要的;显著的;突出的

ext.ext_cn: 他快速浏览了重要的事实。
ext.ext_en: He read the salient facts quickly...

ext.ext_cn: 慢性疲劳也是抑郁症的显著特点之一。
ext.ext_en: Chronic fatigue is also one of the salient features of depression.

defs.def_en: The salient points or facts of a situation are the most important ones.

defs.def_cn: 突出阵线，突出部(战线向敌人阵地推进的狭小范围)

ext.ext_cn: 随后的战争中，士兵们大部分时间只能呆在最危险的突出阵地里。
ext.ext_en: The soldiers had to remain in a deathtrap salient for most of the rest of the war.

defs.def_en: A salient is a narrow area where an army has pushed its front line forward into enemy territory.
If you describe someone as a drudge, you mean they have to work hard at a job which is not very important or interesting.

ext.ext_cn: 他松开了油门。
ext.ext_en: He eased his foot off the accelerator.

defs.def_en: The accelerator in a car or other vehicle is the pedal which you press with your foot in order to make the vehicle go faster.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人)精力充沛的,有干劲的,富有创新思想的

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎是一个富有干劲、精力充沛的领导。
ext.ext_en: He seemed a dynamic and energetic leader...

ext.ext_cn: 马库斯仪表堂堂,精力充沛且雄心勃勃。
ext.ext_en: Marcus was handsome, dynamic and ambitious.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as dynamic, you approve of them because they are full of energy or full of new and exciting ideas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 南亚仍然是世界上经济最活跃的地区。
ext.ext_en: South Asia continues to be the most dynamic economic region in the world.

ext.ext_cn: 90 分钟活力四射的印第安民间舞蹈
ext.ext_en: ...90 minutes of dynamic Indian folk dance.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as dynamic, you approve of it because it is very active and energetic.

ext.ext_cn: 不断发生变异、在世界范围内传播的流行病
ext.ext_en: ...a dynamic, evolving worldwide epidemic...

ext.ext_cn: 政治辩论是不断发展变化的。
ext.ext_en: Political debate is dynamic.

defs.def_en: A dynamic process is one that constantly changes and progresses.

defs.def_cn: (引起改变或进步的)动力，活力

ext.ext_cn: 市场要有活力，需要不断地改变和调整。
ext.ext_en: The dynamic of the market demands constant change and adjustment...

ext.ext_cn: 政治有其自身的驱动力。
ext.ext_en: Politics has its own dynamic.

ext.ext_en: The bank isn't performing as well as some of its competitors.

defs.def_en: A company's competitors are companies who are trying to sell similar goods or services to the same people.

ext.ext_cn: 德国的赫伯特·布洛克尔是年纪最大的选手之一，赢得了个人项目的银牌。
ext.ext_en: Herbert Blocker of Germany, one of the oldest competitors, won the individual silver medal.

defs.def_en: A competitor is a person who takes part in a competition or contest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 非典型的；不突出的；泛泛的

ext.ext_cn: 在许多方面，安妮塔·卢斯看着都不像是从事剧本创作这一行的。
ext.ext_en: Anita Loos was in many respects untypical of the screenwriting trade...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为我们的成绩算是突出的。
ext.ext_en: I believe our results are not untypical.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is untypical of a particular type of person or thing, they are not a good example of the way that type of person or thing normally is. People sometimes say something is not untypical when they mean that it is quite normal.

defs.def_cn: (机构、服务等）介绍约会的，婚介的

ext.ext_cn: 我加入了一个婚介机构。
ext.ext_en: I joined a dating agency.

ext.ext_cn: 电视相亲节目
ext.ext_en: ...a TV dating show.

defs.def_en: Dating agencies or services are for people who are trying to find a girlfriend or boyfriend.

defs.def_cn: (装饰衣服的)闪光小圆片,小亮片

ext.ext_cn: 裙子上点缀着无数亮闪闪的小圆片。
ext.ext_en: The frocks were covered in sequins, thousands of them.

defs.def_en: Sequins are small, shiny discs that are sewn on clothes to decorate them.

ext.ext_cn: 这些产品不会使头发变白。
ext.ext_en: These products don't bleach the hair.

ext.ext_cn: 市面上的面粉是经过人工漂白的。
ext.ext_en: Commercial flour is bleached artificially.

defs.def_en: If you bleach something, you use a chemical to make it white or pale in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 树根剥皮后挂起来风干晒白。
ext.ext_en: The tree's  roots are stripped and hung to season and bleach...

ext.ext_cn: 太阳会使你脸上的汗毛发白。
ext.ext_en: The sun will bleach the hairs on your face...

defs.def_en: If the sun bleaches something, or something bleaches, its colour gets paler until it is almost white.
Bleach is a chemical that is used to make cloth white, or to clean things thoroughly and kill germs.

defs.def_cn: (英国英语)男用内裤;(美国英语)(男用或女用)内裤;衬裤
defs.def_en: Underpants are a piece of underwear which have two holes to put your legs through and elastic around the top to hold them up round your waist or hips. In British English, underpants refers to only men's underwear but in American English it refers to both men's and women's.
A snowman is a large shape which is made out of snow, especially by children, and is supposed to look like a person.
Petroleum jelly is a soft, clear substance obtained from oil or petroleum. It is put on the skin to protect or soften it, or put on surfaces to make them move against each other easily.

ext.ext_cn: 中间休息时，林顿组织了一次抽奖。
ext.ext_en: During the interval, Linton superintended a prize draw.

defs.def_en: If you superintend something, you have responsibility for ensuring that it is carried out properly.

ext.ext_cn: 如有疑问，请在办公时间致电安妮·费希尔咨询。
ext.ext_en: If you have any queries, please call Anne Fisher during office hours.

defs.def_en: Office hours are the times when an office or similar place is open for business. For example, office hours in Britain are usually between 9 o'clock and 5 o'clock from Monday to Friday.

ext.ext_cn: 轮到他大声宣读通知了。
ext.ext_en: He's obliged to take his turn at reading out the announcements...

ext.ext_cn: 要我大声读出来吗？
ext.ext_en: Shall I read them out?

defs.def_en: If you read out a piece of writing, you say it aloud.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如此靠近威严的女皇，他心中充满了敬畏。
ext.ext_en: Being so near the august person of the Empress, he was overcome with awe.

ext.ext_cn: 自由党俱乐部的庄严环境
ext.ext_en: ...the august surroundings of the Liberal Club.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is august is dignified and impressive.

ext.ext_cn: 削减开支的提议引起了诸多争议。
ext.ext_en: The proposed cuts have caused considerable controversy.

ext.ext_cn: 关于侵犯人权问题的激烈的政治辩论
ext.ext_en: ...a fierce political controversy over human rights abuses.

defs.def_en: Controversy is a lot of discussion and argument about something, often involving strong feelings of anger or disapproval.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 浮华的；华丽的；光彩夺目的

ext.ext_cn: 位于科罗拉多州的全球最奢华的滑雪胜地之一阿斯彭
ext.ext_en: ...Aspen, Colorado, one of the glitziest ski resorts in the world.

defs.def_en: Something that is glitzy is exciting and attractive in a showy way.

ext.ext_cn: 飞机拥挤不堪，航空公司超额售票，起飞时间几乎从未准点过。
ext.ext_en: Planes are crowded, airlines overbook, and departures are almost never on time.

defs.def_en: If an organization such as an airline or a theatre company overbooks, they sell more tickets than they have places for.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 逃避现实的；令人解脱的

ext.ext_cn: 一丝逃避现实的幻想
ext.ext_en: ...a little escapist fantasy.

defs.def_en: Escapist ideas, activities, or types of entertainment make people think about pleasant or unlikely things instead of the uninteresting or unpleasant aspects of their life.

ext.ext_cn: 然而他们信仰的根据并非纯粹是种族主义。
ext.ext_en: The cause of their beliefs, however, was not racialism pure and simple.

defs.def_en: Racialism means the same as racism .

ext.ext_cn: 新生儿加护病房
ext.ext_en: ...the neonatal intensive care unit.

defs.def_en: Neonatal means relating to the first few days of life of a new born baby.

defs.def_cn: （使）适应；（使）服水土；（使）习惯于（新情况、新地方或新气候）

ext.ext_cn: 运动员通过留驻蒙特卡洛来适应酷热。
ext.ext_en: The athletes are acclimatising to the heat by staying in Monte Carlo...

ext.ext_cn: 今年他早早地前往圣路易斯以便适应新环境。
ext.ext_en: This year he has left for St Louis early to acclimatise himself...

defs.def_en: When you acclimatize or are acclimatized to a new situation, place, or climate, you become used to it.

ext.ext_cn: 我叫他们去那所房子看看他们是否在那里。
ext.ext_en: I asked them to go around to the house to see if they were there...

ext.ext_cn: 迈克去拜访了他们。
ext.ext_en: Mike went round to see them.

defs.def_en: If you go around to someone's house, you go to visit them at their house.

ext.ext_cn: 我已经习惯光脚。
ext.ext_en: I had got in the habit of going around with bare feet...

ext.ext_cn: 如果他们总是当众发牢骚，再找别的工作可就没那么容易了。
ext.ext_en: If they went around complaining publicly, they might not find it so easy to get another job.

defs.def_en: If you go around in a particular way, you behave or dress in that way, often as part of your normal life.

ext.ext_cn: 关于这件事正有一则恶意的谣言在流传。
ext.ext_en: There's a nasty sort of rumour going around about it.

defs.def_en: If a piece of news or a joke is going around, it is being told by many people in the same period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 最终，我们将没有足够的水供大家喝。
ext.ext_en: Eventually we will not have enough water to go around.

defs.def_en: If there is enough of something to go around, there is enough of it to be shared among a group of people, or to do all the things for which it is needed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 合法的；依法的；法律认可的

ext.ext_cn: 法国政府对海地政变表示谴责，并要求恢复合法政府的地位。
ext.ext_en: The French government has condemned the coup in Haiti and has demanded the restoration of the legitimate government...

ext.ext_cn: 政府无意干扰被告的合法经营活动。
ext.ext_en: The government will not seek to disrupt the legitimate business activities of the defendant.

defs.def_en: Something that is legitimate is acceptable according to the law.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 合情理的；有道理的；正当的

ext.ext_cn: 怀有这种恐惧完全在情理之中。
ext.ext_en: That's a perfectly legitimate fear...

ext.ext_cn: 《纽约时报》有理由称自己是一份全国性报纸。
ext.ext_en: The New York Times has a legitimate claim to be a national newspaper.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a feeling or claim is legitimate, you think that it is reasonable and justified.

ext.ext_cn: 我们结婚纯粹是为了给孩子一个合法身份。
ext.ext_en: We only married in order that the child should be legitimate.

defs.def_en: A legitimate child is one whose parents were married before he or she was born.

ext.ext_cn: 我们希望通过立法来使这一程序合法化。
ext.ext_en: We want to legitimate this process by passing a law.

defs.def_en: To legitimate something means the same as to legitimize it.

defs.def_cn: 持续不断的;重复的;一直存在的

ext.ext_cn: 她暗示说女性总是处在保持身材异常瘦削的压力之下。
ext.ext_en: She suggests that women are under constant pressure to be abnormally thin...

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀始终是个威胁。
ext.ext_en: Inflation is a constant threat...

defs.def_en: You use constant to describe something that happens all the time or is always there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 平均风速保持稳定。
ext.ext_en: The average speed of the winds remained constant.

defs.def_en: If an amount or level is constant, it stays the same over a particular period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 在时装界，有时似乎唯一永恒不变的东西就是不断的变化。
ext.ext_en: In the world of fashion it sometimes seems that the only constant is ceaseless change...

ext.ext_cn: 若干研究已经发现了两个重要常量。
ext.ext_en: Two significant constants have been found in a number of research studies.

defs.def_en: A constant is a thing or value that always stays the same.

ext.ext_cn: 在下一个路口向右拐。
ext.ext_en: Take the next turning on the right.

defs.def_en: See also:turn;If you take a particular turning, you go along a road which leads away from the side of another road.

defs.def_cn: (尤指没用或不需要的)杂乱的东西

ext.ext_cn: 卡罗琳喜欢把厨房台面收拾得整整齐齐。
ext.ext_en: Caroline prefers her worktops to be clear of clutter.

defs.def_en: Clutter is a lot of things in an untidy state, especially things that are not useful or necessary.

ext.ext_cn: 空饮料罐胡乱地堆在桌上。
ext.ext_en: Empty soft-drink cans clutter the desks...

ext.ext_cn: 路上堵满了汽车和货车。
ext.ext_en: The roads were cluttered with cars and vans.

defs.def_en: If things or people clutter a place, they fill it in an untidy way.

defs.def_cn: 精神科医生；精神病学家

ext.ext_cn: 亚历克斯今后好几个月甚至几年都可能要去看精神科医生。
ext.ext_en: Alex will probably be seeing a psychiatrist for many months or even years.

defs.def_en: A psychiatrist is a doctor who treats people suffering from mental illness.

defs.def_cn: 驾驶游艇（或快艇）的人;帆船比赛选手
defs.def_en: A yachtsman is a man who sails a yacht.

A syringe is a small tube with a thin hollow needle at the end. Syringes are used for putting liquids into things and for taking liquids out, for example for injecting drugs or for taking blood from someone's body.

defs.def_cn: 保龄球(运动);十柱保龄球戏
defs.def_en: Ten-pin bowling is a game in which you try to knock down ten objects shaped like bottles by rolling a heavy ball towards them. It is usually played in a place called a bowling alley.

ext.ext_cn: 晚期癌症
ext.ext_en: ...terminal cancer.

ext.ext_cn: 他的病没治了。
ext.ext_en: ...his illness was terminal.

defs.def_en: A terminal illness or disease causes death, often slowly, and cannot be cured.

defs.def_cn: (病人)患绝症的，晚期的,病危的

ext.ext_cn: 他们为身患绝症的病人开办了一个安养所。
ext.ext_en: They have started a hospice for terminal patients.

defs.def_en: A terminal patient is dying of a terminal illness or disease.

defs.def_cn: (车辆、乘客、货物的)集散地，起点站，终点站

ext.ext_cn: 正在制定在希思罗机场修建第 5 航站楼的计划。
ext.ext_en: Plans are underway for a fifth terminal at Heathrow airport.

defs.def_en: A terminal is a place where vehicles, passengers, or goods begin or end a journey.

ext.ext_cn: 卡尔每周在电脑终端前坐 40 个小时。
ext.ext_en: Carl sits at a computer terminal 40 hours a week.

defs.def_en: A computer terminal is a piece of equipment consisting of a keyboard and a screen that is used for putting information into a computer or getting information from it.

ext.ext_cn: 电池的阳极
ext.ext_en: ...the positive terminal of the battery.

defs.def_en: On a piece of electrical equipment, a terminal is one of the points where electricity enters or leaves it.

defs.def_cn: 布卡（伊斯兰国家妇女穿的蒙面长袍）
defs.def_en: A burqa is a long garment that covers the head and body and is traditionally worn by women in Islamic countries.

defs.def_cn: (通常因沮丧)把自己关起来，独自躲起来

ext.ext_cn: 他又沮丧又生了病，再一次躲进了自己昏暗的工作室。
ext.ext_en: Depressed and ill, he had again shut himself away in his darkened studio.

defs.def_en: If you shut yourself away, you avoid going out and seeing other people, usually because you are feeling depressed.

defs.def_cn: 除去…的臭味;脱去…的异味

ext.ext_cn: 这种机器使用极少量的臭氧为食品冷藏车消毒杀菌和去除异味。
ext.ext_en: The machine uses minute quantities of ozone to sterilise and deodorise refrigerated food vehicles.

ext.ext_cn: 脚部除臭喷剂
ext.ext_en: ...a deodorising foot spray.

defs.def_en: If you deodorize something, you remove unpleasant smells from it.

defs.def_cn: 有用意地;有目的地;意味深长地

ext.ext_cn: “你知道，我交朋友有一套的，”她故意补充说。
ext.ext_en: 'I have a knack for making friends, you know,' she added meaningfully...

ext.ext_cn: “我曾经和你一样迷惑，”她意味深长地说。
ext.ext_en: 'I was once as bewildered as you are,' she said meaningfully.

defs.def_en: See also:meaningful;You use meaningfully to indicate that someone has deliberately chosen their words in order to express something in a way which is not obvious but which is understood by the person they are talking to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 温顺的;驯良的;易控制的

ext.ext_cn: 温顺、听话的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...docile, obedient children...

ext.ext_cn: 他们想要廉价的、听话的劳动力。
ext.ext_en: They wanted a low-cost, docile workforce.

defs.def_en: A person or animal that is docile is quiet, not aggressive, and easily controlled.

defs.def_cn: 预期寿命；平均（期望）寿命

ext.ext_cn: 平均期望寿命曾是40岁。
ext.ext_en: The average life expectancy was 40...

ext.ext_cn: 他们比上一辈人的预期寿命要长。
ext.ext_en: They had longer life expectancies than their parents.

defs.def_en: The life expectancy of a person, animal, or plant is the length of time that they are normally likely to live.

defs.def_cn: 车辆的;交通工具的;交通的

ext.ext_cn: 车辆交通
ext.ext_en: ...vehicular traffic...

ext.ext_cn: 不通车。
ext.ext_en: There is no vehicular access.

defs.def_en: Vehicular is used to describe something which relates to vehicles and traffic.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子越晚需要补牙就越好。
ext.ext_en: The longer your child can go without needing a filling, the better.

defs.def_en: A filling is a small amount of metal or plastic that a dentist puts in a hole in a tooth to prevent further decay.

ext.ext_cn: 在每个薄煎饼上摊上一些馅。
ext.ext_en: Spread some of the filling over each pancake.

defs.def_en: The filling in something such as a cake, pie, or sandwich is a substance or mixture that is put inside it.

defs.def_cn: (软体家具或垫子的)芯，填充物

ext.ext_cn: 老式泡沫芯子的二手沙发
ext.ext_en: ...second-hand sofas with old-style foam fillings.

defs.def_en: The filling in a piece of soft furniture or in a cushion is the soft substance inside it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 螃蟹虽然好吃，却容易让人感到饱足。
ext.ext_en: Although it is tasty, crab is very filling.

defs.def_en: Food that is filling makes you feel full when you have eaten it.

defs.def_cn: 单色的；素色的；无花纹（或图案、字迹）的

ext.ext_cn: 一般来说，单色的地毯使房间显得更宽敞。
ext.ext_en: In general, a plain carpet makes a room look bigger...

ext.ext_cn: 他把论文装进一个空白信封里。
ext.ext_en: He placed the paper in a plain envelope...

defs.def_en: A plain object, surface, or fabric is entirely in one colour and has no pattern, design, or writing on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 布朗温的长裙虽然朴素，却很合身。
ext.ext_en: Bronwen's dress was plain but it hung well on her...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一幢简朴的灰石房子，主要以其天然简约的风格显得与众不同。
ext.ext_en: It was a plain, grey stone house, distinguished mainly by its largely unspoilt simplicity.

defs.def_en: Something that is plain is very simple in style.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他能明显地看出我快要精神崩溃了。
ext.ext_en: It was plain to him that I was having a nervous breakdown...

ext.ext_cn: 他明确表示自己热爱这项运动，并仍想参与其中。
ext.ext_en: He's made it plain that he loves the game and wants to be involved still.

defs.def_en: See also:plain-spoken;If a fact, situation, or statement is plain, it is easy to recognize or understand.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 肤色苍白、相貌平平的害羞女孩
ext.ext_en: ...a shy, rather plain girl with a pale complexion.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as plain, you think they look ordinary and not at all beautiful.

defs.def_cn: 平原；（几乎没有树木的）大片平地

ext.ext_cn: 北美大平原上曾有过7,000万头野牛。
ext.ext_en: Once there were 70 million buffalo on the plains.

defs.def_en: A plain is a large flat area of land with very few trees on it.

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词前加强语气）显然，完全地

ext.ext_cn: 这食物实在太难吃了。
ext.ext_en: The food was just plain terrible.

ext.ext_cn: 她是喜欢抛头露面，还是太过愚蠢了呢？
ext.ext_en: Is it love of publicity or plain stupidity on her part?

defs.def_en: You can use plain before an adjective in order to emphasize it.

defs.def_cn: （尤在与另一个更加不同寻常或让人印象深刻的名字比较时表示强调）普通的，平凡的

ext.ext_cn: 他们为什么不能像其他人一样，给你取个普普通通的安或艾丽斯的名字呢？
ext.ext_en: Why couldn't they call you plain Ann or Alice like the rest?

defs.def_en: You can use plain before a name to emphasize how simple and ordinary it is, especially when you are comparing it with another more unusual or impressive name.

ext.ext_cn: 3名便衣警察让我下车。
ext.ext_en: Three officers in plain clothes told me to get out of the car.

defs.def_en: If a police officer is in plain clothes, he or she is wearing ordinary clothes instead of a police uniform.

ext.ext_cn: 请寄上18.99英镑的支票，外加2英镑的邮资和包装费。
ext.ext_en: Send a cheque for £18.99 plus £2 for postage and packing...

ext.ext_cn: 他们将支付约6.73亿美元再加上利息。
ext.ext_en: They will pay about $673 million plus interest.

defs.def_en: You say plus to show that one number or quantity is being added to another.

ext.ext_cn: 这架飞机经历了零下65度和零上120度的温度变化。
ext.ext_en: The aircraft was subjected to temperatures of minus 65 degrees and plus 120 degrees.

defs.def_en: Plus before a number or quantity means that the number or quantity is greater than zero.  plus or minus→see: minus;

ext.ext_cn: 能宽宽松松容下两个大人、三个孩子，而且后备箱里还可以放只狗。
ext.ext_en: There's easily enough room for two adults and three children, plus a dog in the boot...

ext.ext_cn: 我们得找一名能真正入戏的男演员，而且他还得能让观众跟上复杂的剧情中。
ext.ext_en: We had to have an actor who could generate real empathy. Plus he had to carry the audience through a lot of plot.

defs.def_en: You can use plus when mentioning an additional item or fact.

ext.ext_cn: 只有35名员工，却要为3万多顾客服务。
ext.ext_en: There are only 35 staff to serve 30,000-plus customers...

ext.ext_cn: 客人中有16位极为成功的主管，年薪都超过了5万英镑。
ext.ext_en: Among the guests were 16 high-flying executives, all on salaries of £50,000 a year plus.

defs.def_en: You use plus after a number or quantity to indicate that the actual number or quantity is greater than the one mentioned.

ext.ext_en: The gallant soldiers lost their lives so that peace might reign again.

defs.def_en: If someone is gallant, they behave bravely and honourably in a dangerous or difficult situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他在与疾病进行了顽强的抗争后故去，享年82岁。
ext.ext_en: He died at the age of 82, after a gallant fight against illness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Douglas was a complex man, thoughtful, gallant, and generous.

defs.def_en: A Scotch egg is a hard boiled egg that is covered with sausage meat and breadcrumbs, then fried.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 任性的;不易管教的;难以捉摸的

ext.ext_cn: 出现过严重情绪问题的任性的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...wayward children with a history of severe emotional problems.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as wayward, you mean that they behave in a selfish, bad, or unpredictable way, and are difficult to control.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坚忍的;坦然的;不以为苦的

ext.ext_cn: 她一直很敬佩爱尔兰北部人民的坚忍和勇敢。
ext.ext_en: She never ceased to admire the stoical courage of those in Northern Ireland...

ext.ext_cn: 他们分手时他表现得很坦然。
ext.ext_en: He had been stoical at their parting.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone behaves in a stoical way, you approve of them because they do not complain or show they are upset in bad situations.

ext.ext_cn: 暴徒开始用棍棒猛打他的肩、头和胳膊。
ext.ext_en: Men began to belabour his shoulders, his head, his arms with sticks.

defs.def_en: If you belabour someone or something, you hit them hard and repeatedly.

ext.ext_cn: 因为这点已经是众所周知了，我就不再啰唆了。
ext.ext_en: I won't belabour the point, for this is a familiar story.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone belabours the point, you mean that they keep on talking about it, perhaps in an annoying or boring way.

ext.ext_cn: 如今很多人不再费心思举行婚礼。
ext.ext_en: Lots of people don't bother to go through a marriage ceremony these days...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数报纸甚至懒得去报道这件事。
ext.ext_en: Most of the papers didn't even bother reporting it...

defs.def_en: If you do not bother to do something or if you do not bother with it, you do not do it, consider it, or use it because you think it is unnecessary or because you are too lazy.

ext.ext_cn: 我通常都买切片面包——比较省事。
ext.ext_en: I usually buy sliced bread — it's less bother...

ext.ext_cn: 打官司耗时太久，去找警察也很麻烦。
ext.ext_en: The courts take too long and going to the police is a bother...

defs.def_en: Bother means trouble or difficulty. You can also use bother to refer to an activity which causes this, especially when you would prefer not to do it or get involved with it.

defs.def_cn: 麻烦（用于淡化问题的严重性）

ext.ext_cn: 文斯惹上了点儿官司。
ext.ext_en: Vince is having a spot of bother with the law.

defs.def_en: You use bother to refer to serious trouble, usually when you want to make it sound less serious than it really is.

ext.ext_cn: 你有什么烦心事吗？
ext.ext_en: Is something bothering you?...

ext.ext_cn: 那种嫉妒我并不在意。
ext.ext_en: That kind of jealousy doesn't bother me...

defs.def_en: If something bothers you, or if you bother about it, it worries, annoys, or upsets you.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在捉弄一个总是来烦我的人。
ext.ext_en: We are playing a trick on a man who keeps bothering me...

ext.ext_cn: 我不明白他为何用这种烂事来烦我。
ext.ext_en: I don't know why he bothers me with this kind of rubbish.

defs.def_en: If someone bothers you, they talk to you when you want to be left alone or interrupt you when you are busy.
Some people say 'bother' or 'bother it' when they are annoyed about something.

ext.ext_cn: 我就是不想费事照看这所房子。
ext.ext_en: I just can't  be bothered to look after the house...

ext.ext_cn: 医生们才懒得解释他们所做的事情。
ext.ext_en: Doctors cannot be bothered to explain what they do.

defs.def_en: If you say that you can't be bothered to do something, you mean that you are not going to do it because you think it is unnecessary or because you are too lazy.

defs.def_cn: 这不麻烦；不费事；没什么

ext.ext_cn: 我一会儿会开车把你送回宾馆，举手之劳。
ext.ext_en: I'll drive you back to your hotel later. It's no bother.

defs.def_en: If you say 'it's no bother' after offering to do something for someone, you are emphasizing that you really want to do it and that it will take very little effort.

defs.def_cn: 令人麻木的;使热情（或想象力）消退的

ext.ext_cn: 她厌倦了自己生活令人窒息的一成不变。
ext.ext_en: She was bored with the deadening routine of her life.

defs.def_en: A deadening situation destroys people's enthusiasm and imagination.

defs.def_en: A choleric person gets angry very easily. You can also use choleric to describe a person who is very angry.

ext.ext_en: There would be no logic in upsetting the agreements.

ext.ext_en: The plan was based on sound commercial logic.

defs.def_en: If you cross something such as a room, a road, or an area of land or water, you move or travel to the other side of it. If you cross to a place, you move or travel over a room, road, or area of land or water in order to reach that place.

defs.def_en: If someone or something crosses a limit or boundary, for example the limit of acceptable behaviour, they go beyond it.

ext.ext_en: Berg tilts his head and a mischievous look crosses his face...

ext.ext_en: A faint smile crossed his lips.

ext.ext_en: Round her neck was a cross on a silver chain...

ext.ext_en: He solemnly made the sign of the cross...

ext.ext_en: 'Holy Mother of God!' Marco crossed himself.

defs.def_en: If Christians cross themselves, they make the sign of a cross by moving their hand across the top half of their body.

ext.ext_en: My wife is much cleverer than me; it is a cross I have to bear.

ext.ext_en: Put a tick next to those activities you like and a cross next to those you dislike.

ext.ext_en: Jill crossed her legs and rested her chin on one fist, as if lost in deep thought...

ext.ext_en: Pop crossed his arms over his chest and watched us...

defs.def_en: If you cross your arms, legs, or fingers, you put one of them on top of the other.

ext.ext_en: If you ever cross him, forget it, you're finished.

defs.def_en: If you cross someone who is likely to get angry, you oppose them or refuse to do what they want.

ext.ext_cn: “哈！”那声音听起来既像在笑又像在叫。
ext.ext_en: 'Ha!' It was a cross between a laugh and a bark...

ext.ext_cn: 那条狗可爱极了，是柯利牧羊犬和金毛猎犬的杂交品种。
ext.ext_en: It was a lovely dog. It was a cross between a collie and a golden retriever.

defs.def_en: Something that is a cross between two things is neither one thing nor the other, but a mixture of both.

ext.ext_cn: 勒蒂西耶将球准确地横传给了格罗夫斯。
ext.ext_en: Le Tissier hit an accurate cross to Groves.

defs.def_en: In some team sports such as football and hockey, a cross is the passing of the ball from the side of the field to a player in the centre, usually in front of the goal.

ext.ext_cn: 陆军士兵用运兵车封锁了十字路口。
ext.ext_en: The Army boys had personnel carriers blockading the cross streets.

defs.def_en: A cross street is a road that crosses another more important road.

ext.ext_en: The women are cross and bored...

ext.ext_cn: 我很生他的气。
ext.ext_en: I'm terribly cross with him...

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是一个非常迷人的漂亮女孩。
ext.ext_en: She's a very charming and very pretty girl.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone, especially a girl, as pretty, you mean that they look nice and are attractive in a delicate way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （地方或事物）漂亮的，美丽的（但无特殊之处）

ext.ext_cn: 惠特斯特布尔仍然是一个非常漂亮的小镇。
ext.ext_en: Whitstable is still a very pretty little town.

ext.ext_cn: 罩着漂亮的印花布的舒适沙发
ext.ext_en: ...comfortable sofas covered in a pretty floral print.

defs.def_en: A place or a thing that is pretty is attractive and pleasant, in a charming but not particularly unusual way.

ext.ext_cn: 我很清楚她会怎么做。
ext.ext_en: I had a pretty good idea what she was going to do...

ext.ext_cn: 我到达之后，很快就找到了住处。
ext.ext_en: Pretty soon after my arrival I found lodgings.

defs.def_en: You can use pretty before an adjective or adverb to mean 'quite' or 'rather'.  →see usage note at:fairly

ext.ext_cn: 他的新政府看起来和旧政府没什么两样。
ext.ext_en: His new government looks pretty much like the old one...

ext.ext_cn: 我几乎每周都出去旅行。
ext.ext_en: I travel pretty well every week.

defs.def_en: Pretty much or pretty well means 'almost'.

defs.def_cn: 处于有利的位置；处境优越

ext.ext_cn: 战争开始的时候，他们认为自己境况不错，因为他们粮食准备充足。
ext.ext_en: When the war started, they thought they were sitting pretty, because they had all that extra grain.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is sitting pretty, you mean that they are in a good, safe, or comfortable position.

ext.ext_cn: 两年前，他正式签字将他的艺术收藏品转让给了纽约大都会艺术博物馆。
ext.ext_en: Two years ago, he signed over his art collection to the New York Metropolitan Museum of Art...

ext.ext_cn: 去年6月，他主动关闭了自己的公司并签字将资产转让给了其他人。
ext.ext_en: Last June, he closed his business voluntarily and signed his assets over to someone else.

defs.def_en: If you sign something over, you sign documents that give someone else property, possessions, or rights that were previously yours.

defs.def_cn: 无法解决的;难以克服的;不可逾越的

ext.ext_cn: 这次危机似乎并不难以克服。
ext.ext_en: The crisis doesn't seem like an insurmountable problem.

defs.def_en: A problem that is insurmountable is so great that it cannot be dealt with successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 在炉火旁度过的那些冬夜

ext.ext_cn: 围炉畅聊

defs.def_en: If you sit by the fireside in a room, you sit near the fire.

ext.ext_en: Stewart took over yesterday when Russell was debilitated by a stomach virus.

defs.def_en: If you are debilitated by something such as an illness, it causes your body or mind to become gradually weaker.

ext.ext_en: ...their efforts to debilitate the political will of the Western alliance.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as accident prone, you mean that a lot of accidents or other unpleasant things happen to them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Marina was a confident, happy child...

ext.ext_cn: 我很高兴能重新回到跑道上。

defs.def_en: Someone who is happy has feelings of pleasure, usually because something nice has happened or because they feel satisfied with their life.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
