ext.ext_cn: 除了体弱多病外，她的童年特别幸福。
ext.ext_en: Except for her illnesses, she had had a particularly happy childhood...

ext.ext_cn: 这里从前一直是个令人愉快的地方。
ext.ext_en: It had always been a happy place...

defs.def_en: A happy time, place, or relationship is full of happy feelings and pleasant experiences, or has an atmosphere in which people feel happy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （对情况或安排）满意的，放心的

ext.ext_cn: 如果你对修理效果不满意，可以再找他们投诉。
ext.ext_en: If you are not happy about a repair, go back and complain...

ext.ext_cn: 我自己把事情解决了，对此他很满意。
ext.ext_en: He's happy that I deal with it myself...

defs.def_en: If you are happy about a situation or arrangement, you are satisfied with it, for example because you think that something is being done in the right way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如果有问题，我很乐意回答。
ext.ext_en: I'll be happy to answer any questions if there are any...

ext.ext_cn: 我愿意冒这个险。
ext.ext_en: That's a risk I'm happy to take.

defs.def_en: If you say you are happy to do something, you mean that you are very willing to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 生日快乐！
ext.ext_en: Happy Birthday!...

ext.ext_cn: 复活节快乐！
ext.ext_en: Happy Easter!

defs.def_en: Happy is used in greetings and other conventional expressions to say that you hope someone will enjoy a special occasion.  many happy returns→see: return;

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 幸运的是，罗伯特碰巧遇到了理查德和朱莉娅，发现原来他们也碰到了类似的问题。
ext.ext_en: By happy coincidence, Robert met Richard and Julia and discovered they were experiencing similar problems.

defs.def_en: A happy coincidence is one that results in something pleasant or helpful happening.
A bridleway is the same as a bridle path .

ext.ext_cn: 电话簿里要是找不到，查号台能告诉你号码。
ext.ext_en: Directory enquiries will give you the number if you cannot find it in the telephone book.

defs.def_en: The telephone book is a book that contains an alphabetical list of the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of the people in a particular area.

ext.ext_cn: 这份救助呼吁已经促使德国的工商业界行动了起来。
ext.ext_en: The aid appeal has galvanised the  German business community...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在形势驱使下已经在政治、经济和军事上采取了联合行动。
ext.ext_en: They have been galvanised into collective action — militarily, politically and economically.

defs.def_en: To galvanize someone means to cause them to take action, for example by making them feel very excited, afraid, or angry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 松树很脆，容易折断。
ext.ext_en: Pine is brittle and breaks.

ext.ext_cn: 又干又脆的发梢
ext.ext_en: ...the dry, brittle ends of the hair.

defs.def_en: An object or substance that is brittle is hard but easily broken.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 脆弱的；不稳固的；易变的

ext.ext_cn: 这些事件表明北爱尔兰的和平仍然很脆弱。
ext.ext_en: These incidents suggest the peace in Northern Ireland is still brittle...

ext.ext_cn: 这也许会火上浇油，破坏当前脆弱不稳的休战局面。
ext.ext_en: This may help to undermine the brittle truce that currently exists.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation, relationship, or someone's mood as brittle, you mean that it is unstable, and may easily change.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 诺埃尔·科沃德尖锐嘲讽无礼举止的喜剧
ext.ext_en: ...Noel Coward's brittle comedy of bad manners.

defs.def_en: Someone who is brittle seems rather sharp and insensitive and says things which are likely to hurt other people's feelings.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 默特尔冷笑了一声。
ext.ext_en: Myrtle gave a brittle laugh.

defs.def_en: A brittle sound is short, loud, and sharp.

defs.def_cn: （have 的第二人称单数的过时形式，与 you 的过时形式 thou 连用）
defs.def_en: Hast is an old-fashioned second person singular form of the verb 'have'. It is used with 'thou' which is an old-fashioned form of 'you'.

defs.def_cn: (饮用水、游泳池的水等)加氯消毒的

ext.ext_cn: 在用氯消过毒的泳池游泳
ext.ext_en: ...swimming in chlorinated pools.

defs.def_en: Chlorinated water, for example drinking water or water in a swimming pool, has been cleaned by adding chlorine to it.

defs.def_cn: （通常用来展示植物或存放水果蔬菜的）挂篮，吊篮
defs.def_en: A hanging basket is a basket with small ropes or chains attached so that it can be hung from a hook. Hanging baskets are usually used for displaying plants or storing fruit and vegetables.

ext.ext_cn: 金钱是我的动力。
ext.ext_en: Money is my motivation...

ext.ext_cn: 袭击发生的时间及其动机尚不清楚。
ext.ext_en: The timing of the attack, and its motivations, are unknown.

defs.def_en: Your motivation for doing something is what causes you to want to do it.
Reformism is the belief that a system or law should be reformed.

defs.def_cn: 在外进餐;（常指）在餐馆进餐

ext.ext_cn: 她不喜欢参加派对，也不喜欢出去吃饭。
ext.ext_en: She does not enjoy parties or dining out.

defs.def_en: If you dine out, you have dinner away from your home, usually at a restaurant.

defs.def_cn: 在…的范围内;到…的程度;只要

ext.ext_cn: 审视过去的作用是能帮你从错误中吸取教训。
ext.ext_en: Looking back helps insofar as it helps you learn from your mistakes.

defs.def_en: You use insofar as to introduce a statement which explains and adds to something you have just said.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是一桩恶性谋杀案的受害者。
ext.ext_en: He was the victim of a very brutal murder.

ext.ext_cn: 对反政府抗议的残酷镇压
ext.ext_en: ...the brutal suppression of anti-government protests...

defs.def_en: A brutal act or person is cruel and violent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 直截了当的；直言不讳的；直率的

ext.ext_cn: 他们直言不讳地谈论自己和自己的感受，让人觉得耳目一新。
ext.ext_en: It was refreshing to talk about themselves and their feelings with brutal honesty...

ext.ext_cn: 他痛苦地吸了口气，不得不坦言此事。
ext.ext_en: He took an anguished breath. He had to be brutal and say it.

defs.def_en: If someone expresses something unpleasant with brutal honesty or frankness, they express it in a clear and accurate way, without attempting to disguise its unpleasantness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 残酷无情的；难以忍受的

ext.ext_cn: 今年夏天价格的大幅下跌将会很残酷。
ext.ext_en: The dip in prices this summer will be brutal...

ext.ext_cn: 下午的太阳酷热难挡。
ext.ext_en: The afternoon sun had been brutal...

defs.def_en: Brutal is used to describe things that have an unpleasant effect on people, especially when there is no attempt by anyone to reduce their effect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可触犯的;不可违背的

ext.ext_cn: 该比赛有一个规则不可违背：必须跳过而不能绕过障碍物。
ext.ext_en: The game had a single inviolable rule: obstacles were to be overcome, not circumvented.

defs.def_en: If a law or principle is inviolable, you must not break it.

defs.def_cn: 不可更改的;不可侵犯的

ext.ext_cn: 昨天的决议称现在的波兰边界是“不可侵犯的”。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday's resolution says the present Polish border is 'inviolable'.

defs.def_en: If a country says its borders are inviolable, it means they must not be changed or crossed without permission.

ext.ext_cn: 不久，家里打来了电话，把我从沉思中唤醒。
ext.ext_en: It was not long ere a call came from the house and recalled me from my reflections...

ext.ext_cn: 在12点前取水。
ext.ext_en: Take the water ere the clock strikes twelve.

defs.def_en: Ere means the same as 'before'.

defs.def_cn: (使）（知识、消息等)传播；（使）散布；（使）普及

ext.ext_cn: 久而久之，这项技术传播到了其他国家并得到利用。
ext.ext_en: Over time, the technology is diffused and adopted by other countries.

ext.ext_cn: 传播新思想的尝试
ext.ext_en: ...an attempt to diffuse new ideas...

defs.def_en: If something such as knowledge or information is diffused, or if it diffuses somewhere, it is made known over a wide area or to a lot of people.

defs.def_cn: 宣泄，舒缓(尤指不良情绪)

ext.ext_cn: 教皇的来信并没有缓解紧张的气氛。
ext.ext_en: The arrival of letters from the Pope did nothing to diffuse the tension.

defs.def_en: To diffuse a feeling, especially an undesirable one, means to cause it to weaken and lose its power to affect people.

ext.ext_cn: 使灯光漫射也会降低其强度。
ext.ext_en: Diffusing a light also reduces its power...

ext.ext_cn: 太阳躲到了树后，余晖透过冬日的树枝洒落下来。
ext.ext_en: The sun slid behind trees, its last light diffused by wintry branches.

defs.def_en: If something diffuses light, it causes the light to spread weakly in different directions.

ext.ext_cn: 它能使尼古丁平稳缓慢地渗透到血液里。
ext.ext_en: It allows nicotine to diffuse slowly and steadily into the bloodstream...

ext.ext_cn: 它形成了一个温暖的热源，热量迅速扩散至我的四肢。
ext.ext_en: It created a glowing centre of warmth that quickly diffused through my limbs...

defs.def_en: To diffuse or be diffused through something means to move and spread through it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 分散的社群
ext.ext_en: ...a diffuse community...

ext.ext_cn: 一道冰冷的光线透过天窗漫射进来。
ext.ext_en: A cold, diffuse light filtered in through the skylight.

defs.def_en: Something that is diffuse is not directed towards one place or concentrated in one place but spread out over a large area.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 含糊不清的;难以理解的

ext.ext_cn: 他的文章含混晦涩，让人看后不知所云。
ext.ext_en: His writing is so diffuse and obscure that it is difficult to make out what it is he is trying to say.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as diffuse, you mean that it is vague and difficult to understand or explain.
Table wine is fairly cheap wine that is drunk with meals.
Forty is the number 40.

defs.def_cn: 四十多，四十几(指从40至49的数字)

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个四十多岁的高大男子，穿西装打领带，看上去很精神。
ext.ext_en: He was a big man in his forties, smartly dressed in a suit and tie.

defs.def_en: When you talk about the forties, you are referring to numbers between 40 and 49. For example, if you are in your forties, you are aged between 40 and 49. If the temperature is in the forties, the temperature is between 40 and 49 degrees.

defs.def_cn: 二十世纪四十年代(指从 1940 年至 1949 年)

ext.ext_cn: 钢罐是 20 世纪 40 年代时开始使用的。
ext.ext_en: Steel cans were introduced sometime during the forties.

defs.def_en: The forties is the decade between 1940 and 1949.
A campground is the same as a campsite .

ext.ext_cn: 你的穿着应该整洁漂亮，而且必须非常合身。
ext.ext_en: What you wear should be stylish and clean, and must definitely fit well...

ext.ext_cn: 你肯定会遭到一些批评，但你必须去面对。
ext.ext_en: You are going to have to take a certain amount of criticism, but you must cope with it...

defs.def_en: You use must to indicate that you think it is very important or necessary for something to happen. You use must not or mustn't to indicate that you think it is very important or necessary for something not to happen.

defs.def_cn: (通常因为规定或法律)必须，应当

ext.ext_cn: 候选人必须满足参选的总体条件。
ext.ext_en: Candidates must satisfy the general conditions for admission...

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦先生应当支付法纳姆先生的诉讼费。
ext.ext_en: Mr Allen must pay Mr Farnham's legal costs...

defs.def_en: You use must to indicate that it is necessary for something to happen, usually because of a rule or law.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示肯定推测)一定，谅必

ext.ext_cn: 29岁的拉赛尔一定是有史以来温布利球场上的裁判员中最年轻的一个。
ext.ext_en: At 29 Russell must be one of the youngest ever Wembley referees...

ext.ext_cn: 雷盖音乐得到了一整个国家人民的支持，这个国家就是牙买加——这一点上它无疑是独一无二的。
ext.ext_en: Reggae must be the only music that's got its own country — Jamaica...

defs.def_en: You use must to indicate that you are fairly sure that something is the case.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示据已知情况推测)很可能是，想必是，肯定是

ext.ext_cn: 来客说：“你肯定是埃玛。”
ext.ext_en: 'You must be Emma,' said the visitor...

ext.ext_cn: 霍洛韦小姐心脏不好，她肯定得过心脏病。
ext.ext_en: Miss Holloway had a weak heart. She must have had a heart attack...

defs.def_en: You use must, or must have with a past participle, to indicate that you believe that something is the case, because of the available evidence.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示前者为后者的前提)应该已经(发生)

ext.ext_cn: 为得到那份工作，你肯定已辞去了另一份工作。
ext.ext_en: In order to take that job, you must have left another job...

ext.ext_cn: 开始读这本书之前，你一定已经了解到：你身体的不适症状是源于焦虑。
ext.ext_en: In order to start reading this book you must have had some idea that the physical symptoms you were experiencing were due to anxiety.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing must have happened in order for something else to happen, you mean that it is necessary for the first thing to have happened before the second thing can happen.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示意图)一定要，坚持要

ext.ext_cn: 我一定要回来。
ext.ext_en: I must be getting back...

ext.ext_cn: 我要喝杯威士忌。
ext.ext_en: I must have a whiskey...

defs.def_en: You use must to express your intention to do something.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示建议或邀请)务必，一定要

ext.ext_cn: 弗雷德里克，你一定得去看医生。
ext.ext_en: You must see a doctor, Frederick...

ext.ext_cn: 你一定要看看保罗送给我作结婚礼物的那幅画。
ext.ext_en: You must see the painting Paul has given me as a wedding present...

defs.def_en: You use must to make suggestions or invitations very forcefully.

ext.ext_cn: 对你来说，这份工作想必很难。
ext.ext_en: This must be a very difficult job for you...

ext.ext_cn: 你现在一定非常担心。
ext.ext_en: You must be very worried by now...

defs.def_en: You use must in remarks and comments where you are expressing sympathy.

ext.ext_cn: 我得说这真是个意外。
ext.ext_en: This came as a surprise, I must say...

ext.ext_cn: 我得承认我喜欢看起来淑女一些。
ext.ext_en: I must admit I like looking feminine...

defs.def_en: You use must in conversation in expressions such as 'I must say' and 'I must admit' in order to emphasize a point that you are making.

defs.def_cn: (用于引起读者或听众的注意)一定要注意/一定记住

ext.ext_cn: 然而，一定要注意不是所有的英国和美国军官都执行了命令。
ext.ext_en: It must be noted, however, that not all British and American officers carried out orders...

ext.ext_cn: 必须声明，这种疾病是人类已知的最为复杂的疾病之一。
ext.ext_en: It must be stated that this illness is one of the most complex conditions known to man.

defs.def_en: You use must in expressions such as 'it must be noted' and 'it must be remembered' in order to draw the reader's or listener's attention to what you are about to say.

defs.def_cn: (用于问句中表示生气)偏偏，非要

ext.ext_cn: 你为什么做每件事情都跟你非要赢似的？
ext.ext_en: Why must you do everything as if you have to win?...

ext.ext_cn: 她为什么非要插嘴？
ext.ext_en: Why must she inter-rupt?...

defs.def_en: You use must in questions to express your anger or irritation about something that someone has done, usually because you do not understand their behaviour.

defs.def_cn: (用于感叹句，表示惊讶或震惊)一定是，准是

ext.ext_cn: “走吧！请走吧。”——“你一定是在开玩笑吧！”
ext.ext_en: 'Go! Please go.' — 'You must be joking!'...

ext.ext_cn: 真的，我一定是气坏了！
ext.ext_en: I really must be quite mad!...

defs.def_en: You use must in exclamations to express surprise or shock.

defs.def_cn: 必不可少的事物;一定要做的事

ext.ext_cn: 新发行的第37期国家储蓄债券是任何一个纳税人的必然之选。
ext.ext_en: The new 37th issue of National Savings Certificates is a must for any taxpayer...

ext.ext_cn: 一定要去参观一下那个举世闻名且精彩有趣的汽车博物馆。
ext.ext_en: A must is a visit to the fascinating and world-renowned Motor Museum.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as a must, you mean that it is absolutely necessary.

defs.def_cn: 如果你一定要(这样做的话)

ext.ext_cn: 如果一定要呆在太阳底下的话，就擦上你能买到的防晒系数最高的防晒霜。
ext.ext_en: If you must be in the sunlight, use the strongest filter cream you can get...

ext.ext_cn: “我能说一句吗？”——“亲爱的，如果你非说不可的话，好吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'Could I have a word?' — 'Oh dear, if you must.'...

defs.def_en: You say 'if you must' when you know that you cannot stop someone doing something that you think is wrong or stupid.

defs.def_cn: 如果你一定想要知道的话

ext.ext_cn: “妈妈，为什么不穿你的慢跑短裤呢？”——“哦，如果你非要问的话，因为我的腿太瘦了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Why don't you wear your jogging shorts Mum?' — 'Well, my legs are too skinny, if you must know.'

ext.ext_cn: “你跟他说过你那天夜里去过那儿了。”——“是的，如果你非要问的话。”
ext.ext_en: 'You told him you'd been there that night.' — 'If you must know, yes.'

defs.def_en: You say 'if you must know' when you tell someone something that you did not want them to know and you want to suggest that you think they were wrong to  ask you about it.

defs.def_cn: 帮倒忙的人;好心办坏事的人
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a do-gooder, you mean that they do things which they think will help other people, although you think that they are interfering.

defs.def_cn: (电台或电视台的)节目串联主持人
defs.def_en: A continuity announcer is someone who introduces the next programme on a radio or television station.
See also:pack;Packing is the paper, plastic, or other material which is put round things that are being sent somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 由于名字搞错了，一位独自开车的女子昨天等候救援的时间长达6小时。
ext.ext_en: A lone woman motorist waited for six hours for help yesterday because of a name mix-up...

ext.ext_cn: 他被一名独行枪手射杀。
ext.ext_en: He was shot by a lone gunman.

defs.def_en: If you talk about a lone person or thing, you mean that they are alone.

ext.ext_cn: 90%的单亲家庭由母亲持家。
ext.ext_en: Ninety per cent of lone parent families are headed by mothers.

defs.def_en: A lone parent is a parent who is looking after her or his child or children and who is not married or living with a partner.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 月球的椭圆形轨道
ext.ext_en: ...the moon's elliptical orbit...

ext.ext_cn: 在设计图上，体育场呈椭圆形。
ext.ext_en: The stadium is elliptical in plan.

defs.def_en: Something that is elliptical has the shape of an ellipse.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 柯丝蒂·甘对一段童年不幸遭遇的朴实、委婉的记述
ext.ext_en: ...Kirsty Gunn's austere, elliptical account of a childhood tragedy.

ext.ext_cn: 对那些不宜当众谈及的问题的隐诲提及
ext.ext_en: ...elliptical references to problems best not aired in public.

defs.def_en: Elliptical references to something are indirect rather than clear.

ext.ext_cn: 为了节约能源，该共和国的工厂周末不开工。
ext.ext_en: The republic's factories have closed for the weekend to conserve energy.

defs.def_en: If you conserve a supply of something, you use it carefully so that it lasts for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 美国为帮助发展中国家保护森林所提供的援助的大幅增长
ext.ext_en: ...a big increase in US aid to help developing countries conserve their forests.

ext.ext_cn: 政府资助的历史建筑保护机构
ext.ext_en: ...the Government-funded body responsible for conserving historic buildings.

defs.def_en: To conserve something means to protect it from harm, loss, or change.

defs.def_cn: (含有大块或整块水果的)蜜饯，果酱
defs.def_en: Conserve is jam containing a large proportion of fruit, usually in whole pieces.

ext.ext_cn: 领导层各群体间的派系之争
ext.ext_en: ...factional disputes between the various groups that make up the leadership.

defs.def_en: Factional arguments or disputes involve two or more small groups from within a larger group.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻率的;轻浮的;不严肃的

ext.ext_cn: 该死，不要不当回事！这是很严肃的！
ext.ext_en: Don't be flippant, damn it! This is serious!...

ext.ext_cn: 他现在把那当作轻率的随口一说不再理会了。
ext.ext_en: He now dismisses that as a flippant comment.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or what they say as flippant, you are criticizing them because you think they are not taking something as seriously as they should.
A gas fire is a fire that produces heat by burning gas.

defs.def_cn: (由舞蹈、音乐等方面的名家为优秀生讲授的)高级讲习班
defs.def_en: A masterclass is a lesson where someone who is an expert at something such as dancing or music gives advice to a group of good students. Masterclasses usually take place in public or are broadcast on television.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 喝含糖的罐装饮料会滋生蛀牙。
ext.ext_en: Sugary canned drinks rot your teeth.

ext.ext_cn: 甜茶
ext.ext_en: ...sugary tea.

defs.def_en: Sugary food or drink contains a lot of sugar.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (电影或音乐)煽情的，甜腻腻的，矫情的

ext.ext_cn: 这个节目看起来矫揉造作，而其中的人物还自我感觉良好。
ext.ext_en: The programme seemed false and sugary, and the characters smug.

defs.def_en: If you describe a film or piece of music as sugary, you mean that it is sentimental and insincere.

ext.ext_cn: 纯种阿拉伯马
ext.ext_en: ...pure-bred Arab horses.

defs.def_en: A pure-bred animal is one whose parents and ancestors all belong to the same breed.
Rabies is a serious disease which causes people and animals to go mad and die. Rabies is particularly common in dogs.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If the weather is showery, there are showers of rain but it does not rain all the time.

defs.def_cn: 按时间顺序的;按先后次序的

ext.ext_cn: 我把这些报道按时间顺序整理好了。
ext.ext_en: I have arranged these stories in chronological order.

defs.def_en: If things are described or shown in chronological order, they are described or shown in the order in which they happened.

defs.def_cn: (年龄)自然的，实龄的(与心理年龄或身心发展程度相对)
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's chronological age, you are referring to the number of years they have lived, in contrast to their mental age or the stage they have reached in their physical or emotional development.

defs.def_cn: 即时通信(因特网的书写信息实时传递系统)(缩略形式为 IM)

ext.ext_cn: 雅虎、微软以及其他竞争对手的即时通信服务的用户
ext.ext_en: ... users of the instant-messaging services of Yahoo, Microsoft and other rivals.

defs.def_en: Instant messaging is a form of written communication that allows you to send messages from one computer to another. The message appears immediately on the screen of the computer you send it to, provided the computer is using the service. The abbreviation IM is also used.

defs.def_cn: （多建于古希腊、古罗马时期的）圆形露天大剧场
defs.def_en: An amphitheatre is a large open area surrounded by rows of seats sloping upwards. Amphitheatres were built mainly in Greek and Roman times for the performance of plays.

defs.def_cn: （部分或整个被包围的）露天场地，圆形凹地

ext.ext_cn: 被群山环绕的天然露天场地
ext.ext_en: ...a natural amphitheatre of mountains.

defs.def_en: You can describe land which partly or completely surrounds an open area as an amphitheatre.

defs.def_cn: 当天往返的短途旅客;（通常指）一日游游客
defs.def_en: A day-tripper is someone who goes on a day trip.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我承认我有野心，但我不认为这是个贬义词。
ext.ext_en: I agree I am ambitious, and I don't see that as a pejorative term...

ext.ext_cn: 难道没有人提出“女诗人”有点儿贬义吗？
ext.ext_en: Isn't there a suggestion that 'poetess' is slightly pejorative?

defs.def_en: A pejorative word or expression is one that expresses criticism of someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 音乐演奏成了当晚唱主角的商业活动的陪衬。
ext.ext_en: The playing of music proved to be incidental to the main business of the evening...

ext.ext_cn: 在账单底部,你会发现有传真等各项杂费。
ext.ext_en: At the bottom of the bill, you will notice various incidental expenses such as faxes.

defs.def_en: If one thing is incidental to another, it is less important than the other thing or is not a major part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这番话很快被泄露了出去。
ext.ext_en: The words spilled out in a rush...

ext.ext_cn: 他很想把自己的问题透露给菲利普。
ext.ext_en: He was tempted to spill out his problems to Philip.

defs.def_en: If you spill out information or if it spills out, you tell someone about it in a hurried way, because you cannot or do not want to keep it secret.

defs.def_cn: (厨房旁边的)餐具洗涤室，炊具存放室
defs.def_en: A scullery is a small room next to a kitchen where washing and other household tasks are done.

defs.def_cn: 超级病菌(新闻用语，指无法用抗生素杀死的细菌)
defs.def_en: Journalists refer to a type of bacteria as a superbug when it is very difficult to deal with because it cannot be killed by antibiotics.

ext.ext_cn: 在1918年再版之前，这本书一直非常罕见。
ext.ext_en: It remained an exceptionally rare book until it was reprinted in 1918.

defs.def_en: If a book is reprinted, further copies of it are printed when all the other ones have been sold.

ext.ext_cn: 由于需求量上升，去年11月，再版已是势在必行。
ext.ext_en: Demand picked up and a reprint was required last November.

defs.def_en: A reprint is a process in which new copies of a book or article are printed because all the other ones have been sold.

ext.ext_cn: 1962年小说的重印本
ext.ext_en: ...a reprint of a 1962 novel.

defs.def_en: A reprint is a new copy of a book or article, printed because all the other ones have been sold or because minor changes have been made to the original.

defs.def_cn: 拒绝(某人或其请求、提议等)

ext.ext_cn: 在这之前，我本该笑着拒绝她。
ext.ext_en: Before this I'd have smiled and turned her down...

ext.ext_cn: 我谢绝了他的提议。
ext.ext_en: I thanked him for the offer but turned it down…

defs.def_en: If you turn down a person or their request or offer, you refuse their request or offer.

ext.ext_cn: 他不断调低中央暖气的温度。
ext.ext_en: He kept turning the central heating down...

ext.ext_cn: 她受不了没完没了的音乐，就把音量调小了。
ext.ext_en: She could not bear the relentless music and turned down the volume.

defs.def_en: When you turn down a radio, heater, or other piece of equipment, you reduce the amount of sound or heat being produced, by adjusting the controls.

ext.ext_cn: 20 世纪 50 年代离婚率下降了。
ext.ext_en: The divorce rate turned down in the 1950s.

defs.def_en: If the rate or level of something turns down, it decreases.

ext.ext_cn: 她站在我的床边低头盯着我。
ext.ext_en: She was standing beside my bed staring down at me...

ext.ext_cn: 他们叫我站着不动，不要转身。
ext.ext_en: They told me to stand still and not to turn round...

defs.def_en: When you are standing, your body is upright, your legs are straight, and your weight is supported by your feet.

ext.ext_cn: 贝克尔站起来和本握手。
ext.ext_en: Becker stood and shook hands with Ben.

ext.ext_cn: 当我走进去时，他们全都起立鼓掌。
ext.ext_en: When I walked in, they all stood up and started clapping.

defs.def_en: When someone who is sitting stands, they change their position so that they are upright and on their feet.

ext.ext_cn: 我站到一边，让她从我身旁过去。
ext.ext_en: I stood aside to let her pass me...

ext.ext_cn: 警察们往后退了退。这会是个炸弹吗？
ext.ext_en: The policemen stood back. Could it be a bomb?

defs.def_en: If you stand aside or stand back, you move a short distance sideways or backwards, so that you are standing in a different place.

ext.ext_cn: 房子孤零零地坐落在一座小山顶上。
ext.ext_en: The house stands alone on top of a small hill...

ext.ext_cn: 我伸手去够位于桌子中央的灯。
ext.ext_en: I reached for the lamp, which stood in the middle of the table.

defs.def_en: If something such as a building or a piece of furniture stands somewhere, it is in that position, and is upright.

defs.def_cn: (建筑物在周围其他建筑物倒塌或被毁后)依然存在，矗立

ext.ext_cn: 二战中遭到轰炸的那座宫殿依然矗立着。
ext.ext_en: The palace, which was damaged by bombs in World War II, still stood...

ext.ext_cn: 几乎没有几个建筑物留存下来。
ext.ext_en: There are very few buildings left standing.

defs.def_en: You can say that a building is standing when it remains after other buildings around it have fallen down or been destroyed.

ext.ext_cn: 把这株植物放在一个阳光充足、上方有遮盖物的开阔处。
ext.ext_en: Stand the plant in the open in a sunny, sheltered place.

defs.def_en: If you stand something somewhere, you put it there in an upright position.

defs.def_cn: (将食物或调拌物等)搁置不动

ext.ext_cn: 色拉如果能事先做好再搁置一会儿，味道会更好。
ext.ext_en: The salad improves if made in advance and left to stand.

defs.def_en: If you leave food or a mixture of something to stand, you leave it without disturbing it for some time.

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉有必要表明自己对南非的种族主义持反对态度。
ext.ext_en: He felt the need to make a stand against racism in South Africa...

ext.ext_cn: 他们必须表明立场并投票。
ext.ext_en: They must take a stand and cast their votes...

defs.def_en: If you take or make a stand, you do something or say something in order to make it clear what your attitude to a particular thing is.

ext.ext_cn: 修订案将迫使参议员们表明自己对性骚扰问题的立场。
ext.ext_en: The amendment will force senators to show where they stand on the issue of sexual harassment...

ext.ext_cn: 迄今为止，主教还没有表明自己的态度。
ext.ext_en: So far, the bishop hasn't said where he stands.

defs.def_en: If you ask someone where or how they stand on a particular issue, you are asking them what their attitude or view is.

ext.ext_cn: 谁也不知道他怎样看待他们;他是个完全不可捉摸的人。
ext.ext_en: No-one knows where they stand with him; he is utterly unpredictable...

ext.ext_cn: 所有孩子都需要管教，让他们知道别人如何看待自己。
ext.ext_en: All children need discipline, to know where they stand.

defs.def_en: If you do not know where you stand with someone, you do not know exactly what their attitude to you is.

ext.ext_cn: 联盟已准备好采取必要行动。
ext.ext_en: The alliance stands ready to do what is necessary...

ext.ext_cn: 他被指责为实现自己当总统的野心而不惜毁灭该党。
ext.ext_en: He stands accused of destroying the party in pursuit of his presidential ambitions...

defs.def_en: You can use stand instead of 'be' when you are describing the present state or condition of something or someone.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然可能有例外，但该规定仍然有效。
ext.ext_en: Although exceptions could be made, the rule still stands...

ext.ext_cn: 最高法院说判决结果依然有效。
ext.ext_en: The Supreme Court says that the convictions can stand.

defs.def_en: If a decision, law, or offer stands, it still exists and has not been changed or cancelled.

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀率目前为 3.6%。
ext.ext_en: The inflation rate now stands at 3.6 per cent...

ext.ext_cn: 双方的支持率在 42%和 44%之间。
ext.ext_en: Support for the two sides is standing at between 42 and 44 per cent.

defs.def_en: If something that can be measured stands at a particular level, it is at that level.

ext.ext_cn: 她身高 5 英尺 5 英寸，体重 120 磅。
ext.ext_en: She stood five feet five inches tall and weighed 120 pounds...

ext.ext_cn: 大坝将高达 600 英尺。
ext.ext_en: The dam will stand 600 feet high...

defs.def_en: You can describe how tall or high someone or something is by saying that they stand a particular height.

defs.def_cn: 经得起，承受得住(困难、考验)

ext.ext_cn: 这些就是第一批能经受住不停碾碎玻璃所造成的磨损的机器。
ext.ext_en: These are the first machines that can stand the wear and tear of continuously crushing glass...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为这些书能和狄更斯的作品相媲美。
ext.ext_en: I think these books can stand comparison quite happily with works by Dickens...

defs.def_en: If something can stand a situation or a test, it is good enough or strong enough to experience it without being damaged, harmed, or shown to be inadequate.

ext.ext_cn: 我再也受不了了。我要逃走。
ext.ext_en: I can't stand any more. I'm going to run away...

ext.ext_cn: 不管有多少针对他的个人批评，斯托达特都可以忍受。
ext.ext_en: Stoddart can stand any amount of personal criticism...

defs.def_en: If you cannot stand something, you cannot bear it or tolerate it.

ext.ext_cn: 我讨厌那个男人和他的傲慢。
ext.ext_en: I can't stand that man and his arrogance...

ext.ext_cn: 他受不了我抽烟。
ext.ext_en: He can't stand me smoking.

defs.def_en: If you cannot stand someone or something, you dislike them very strongly.

defs.def_cn: 可能获得/ 可能失去

ext.ext_cn: 如果该公司被卖掉，管理层会获得几百万美元。
ext.ext_en: The management group would stand to gain millions of dollars if the company were sold...

ext.ext_cn: 在 22 个核武器制造点工作的多达 3 万名工人可能会失业。
ext.ext_en: As many as 30,000 workers at 22 nuclear weapons sites stand to lose their jobs.

defs.def_en: If you stand to gain something, you are likely to gain it. If you stand to lose something, you are likely to lose it.

ext.ext_cn: 他尚未宣布自己是否会参选。
ext.ext_en: He has not yet announced whether he will stand in the election...

ext.ext_cn: 一些热心支持者正在力劝他参选。
ext.ext_en: Some ardent supporters were urging him to stand...

defs.def_en: If you stand in an election, you are a candidate in it.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以请我喝一品脱啤酒。
ext.ext_en: You can stand me a pint.

defs.def_en: If you stand someone a meal or a drink, you buy it for them.

defs.def_cn: (设在户外或大型公共建筑物内的)小店，售货摊

ext.ext_cn: 他在美国运通公司办公大楼外经营一家报摊。
ext.ext_en: He ran a newspaper stand outside the American Express office...

ext.ext_cn: 她从街角的小摊上买了个热狗。
ext.ext_en: She bought a hot dog from a stand on a street corner.

defs.def_en: See also:newsstand;A stand is a small shop or stall, outdoors or in a large public building.

ext.ext_cn: 烛台体育场看台上的人们都站在那里拼命喊加油。
ext.ext_en: The people in the stands at Candlestick Park are standing and cheering with all their might.

ext.ext_cn: 烛台体育场看台上的人们都站在那里拼命喊加油。
ext.ext_en: The people in the stands at Candlestick Park are standing and cheering with all their might.

defs.def_en: A stand at a sports ground is a large structure where people sit or stand to watch what is happening.

ext.ext_cn: 那把茶壶配有一个可以接滴水的茶托。
ext.ext_en: The teapot came with a stand to catch the drips.

defs.def_en: A stand is an object or piece of furniture that is designed for supporting or holding a particular kind of thing.

defs.def_cn: (出租车、公共汽车的)停车候客处

ext.ext_cn: 幸好附近就有一个出租车候客处。
ext.ext_en: Luckily there was a taxi stand nearby.

defs.def_en: A stand is an area where taxis or buses can wait to pick up passengers.

ext.ext_cn: 那位父亲今天出庭作证时，驳斥了自己儿子的证词。
ext.ext_en: When the father took the stand today, he contradicted his son's testimony...

ext.ext_cn: 政府已传招了近 50 名证人出庭。
ext.ext_en: The government has called nearly 50 witnesses to the stand.

defs.def_en: In a law court, the stand is the place where a witness stands to answer questions.

defs.def_cn: 真实性取决于;成败在于

ext.ext_cn: 航空公司的成败应该取决于它们吸引乘客的能力。
ext.ext_en: Airlines should stand or fall on their ability to attract passengers.

defs.def_en: If an idea, claim, or attempt stands or falls on something, its truth or success depends on that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在那里对罗马军团进行了最后的抵抗，场面英勇而悲壮。
ext.ext_en: There they made their tragic and heroic last stand against the Roman legions.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone's final attempt to defend themselves before they are defeated as their last stand .

ext.ext_cn: 显然，如果你通情达理，对人友善，那么你肯定会获得更多回报。
ext.ext_en: It stands to reason that if you are considerate and friendly to people you will get a lot more back...

ext.ext_cn: 很显然，史密斯不是他的真名。
ext.ext_en: Smith isn't his real name, that stands to reason.

defs.def_en: If you say it stands to reason that something is true or likely to happen, you mean that it is obvious.

ext.ext_cn: 英国政府不会阻止这样一项提议。
ext.ext_en: The British government would not stand in the way of such a proposal...

ext.ext_cn: 去美国是他的决定，我凭什么要阻拦他？
ext.ext_en: It is his decision to go to America and who am I to stand in his way?

defs.def_en: If you stand in the way of something or stand in a person's way, you prevent that thing from happening or prevent that person from doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 他看到这个男人后脑勺上有道大口子，血还在往外渗。
ext.ext_en: He saw there was a big hole in the back of the man's head, blood was still oozing from it...

ext.ext_cn: 岩浆就会从火山口缓缓涌流出来。
ext.ext_en: The lava will just ooze gently out of the crater...

defs.def_en: When a thick or sticky liquid oozes from something or when something oozes it, the liquid flows slowly and in small quantities.

ext.ext_cn: 格雷厄姆表面上看起来会像过去一样满怀信心。
ext.ext_en: Outwardly, Graham will ooze all his old confidence...

ext.ext_cn: 这幢伊丽莎白时期的房子散发着迷人的魅力。
ext.ext_en: The Elizabethan house oozes charm...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something oozes a quality or characteristic, or oozes with it, you mean that they show it very strongly.

defs.def_cn: （尤指河、湖、海底的）软泥，淤泥，泥浆

ext.ext_cn: 原始软泥
ext.ext_en: ...a primeval ooze...

ext.ext_cn: 他把手伸进淤泥里捞摸，结果抓上来一只巨大的蟾蜍。
ext.ext_en: He grabbed into the ooze and came up clutching a large toad.

defs.def_en: You can refer to any thick, sticky, liquid substance as ooze, especially the mud at the bottom of a river, lake, or the sea.
A tripod is a stand with three legs that is used to support something such as a camera or a telescope.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 课文索然无味。
ext.ext_en: The text is banal...

ext.ext_cn: 隐藏的喇叭里幽幽地传出平淡乏味的音乐。
ext.ext_en: Bland, banal music tinkled discreetly from hidden loudspeakers.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as banal, you do not like it because you think that it is so ordinary that it is not at all effective or interesting.

ext.ext_cn: 参赛者不得不应付狂风肆虐的天气条件。
ext.ext_en: The competitors had to contend with squally weather conditions.

defs.def_en: In squally weather, there are sudden strong winds which often cause brief, violent storms.

ext.ext_cn: 出发远征的那个早上,我醒来就有一种灾难即将来临的感觉。
ext.ext_en: On the morning of the expedition I awoke with a feeling of impending disaster...

ext.ext_cn: 那个早上他已经对西蒙讲过他即将结婚的事了。
ext.ext_en: He'd spoken to Simon that morning of his impending marriage.

defs.def_en: An impending event is one that is going to happen very soon.
An explorer is someone who travels to places about which very little is known, in order to discover what is there.
The armour-plating on a vehicle or building is the hard metal covering which is intended to protect it from gunfire and other missiles.

ext.ext_cn: 哈拉穿着库尔德斯坦常见的漂亮束腰上衣和马裤。
ext.ext_en: Hallah wears the stylish tunic and pantaloons common in Kurdistan.

defs.def_en: Pantaloons are long trousers with very wide legs, gathered at the ankle.
Termites are small white insects which live in hot countries in homes made of earth. Termites do a lot of damage by eating wood.

ext.ext_cn: 他非常明确地表示任何不同意他政策的人都坚持不了多久。
ext.ext_en: He made it abundantly clear that anybody who disagrees with his policies will not last long.

defs.def_en: If something is abundantly clear, it is extremely obvious.

ext.ext_cn: 在美国大量生长的一种植物
ext.ext_en: ...a plant that grows abundantly in the United States...

ext.ext_cn: 每页都配有丰富的彩色照片。
ext.ext_en: All the pages are abundantly illustrated with colour photographs.

defs.def_en: Something that occurs abundantly is present in large quantities.

ext.ext_cn: 为了防范不可预见的紧急情况,人们给房子、家具和汽车上保险。
ext.ext_en: For protection against unforeseen emergencies, you insure your house, your furnishings and your car...

ext.ext_cn: 在为意外事故、疾病与失业投保之前一定要考虑清楚。
ext.ext_en: Think carefully before you insure against accident, sickness and redundancy...

defs.def_en: If you insure yourself or your property, you pay money to an insurance company so that, if you become ill or if your property is damaged or stolen, the company will pay you a sum of money.

ext.ext_cn: 他仅仅治疗有把握治愈的病人，以使自己免于失败。
ext.ext_en: He insured himself against failure by treating only people he was sure he could cure...

ext.ext_cn: 世上没有哪种电子器材能完全避免意外事故的发生。
ext.ext_en: All the electronics in the world cannot insure against accidents, though.

defs.def_en: If you insure yourself against something unpleasant that might happen in the future, you do something to protect yourself in case it happens, or to prevent it happening.

defs.def_cn: (尤指来自警方、军队等组织的)监视，监察

ext.ext_en: She alleged that Taylor had forged her signature on the form...

ext.ext_en: To forge a blade takes great skill.

defs.def_en: If someone forges an object out of metal, they heat the metal and then hammer and bend it into the required shape.

ext.ext_cn: 他再次承诺会稳步推进自己的改革计划。
ext.ext_en: He again pledged to forge ahead with his plans for reform...

ext.ext_en: The two companies forged ahead, innovating and expanding.

A meeting place is a place where people meet.
Ophthalmology is branch of medicine concerned with people's eyes and the problems that affect them.

ext.ext_en: The patient's brain activity is monitored via electrodes taped to the skull.

defs.def_en: An electrode is a small piece of metal or other substance that is used to take an electric current to or from a source of power, a piece of equipment, or a living body.
A country's secret service is a secret government department whose job is to find out enemy secrets and to prevent its own government's secrets from being discovered.

defs.def_cn: (美国负责保护总统的)特工处
defs.def_en: The secret service is the government department in the United States which protects the president.

defs.def_cn: （大型车辆的）气闸，气动刹车，空气制动器
defs.def_en: Air brakes are brakes which are used on heavy vehicles such as buses and trains and which are operated by means of compressed air.

ext.ext_en: Rabies has been described as one of the most terrifying diseases known to man.

defs.def_en: If something is terrifying, it makes you very frightened.

ext.ext_en: Australia's rugby union side enjoyed a record-breaking win over France.

defs.def_en: A record-breaking success, result, or performance is one that beats the previous best success, result, or performance.

ext.ext_en: I found a pencil and some blank paper in her desk...

ext.ext_en: He had written her a note in pencil.

defs.def_en: A pencil is an object that you write or draw with. It consists of a thin piece of wood with a rod of a black or coloured substance through the middle. If you write or draw something in pencil, you do it using a pencil.

ext.ext_cn: 他用铅笔给约瑟夫·丹尼尔斯写了个便条。
ext.ext_en: He pencilled a note to Joseph Daniels.

defs.def_en: If you pencil a letter or a note, you write it using a pencil.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 刻苦的；勤奋的；兢兢业业的

ext.ext_cn: 勤勉的学生
ext.ext_en: ...an assiduous student...

ext.ext_cn: 波多斯基一直很努力地学习外语。
ext.ext_en: Podulski had been assiduous in learning his adopted language.

defs.def_en: Someone who is assiduous works hard or does things very thoroughly.

ext.ext_cn: 一个小时的林间漫步
ext.ext_en: ...an hour's ramble through the woods.

defs.def_en: A ramble is a long walk in the countryside.

ext.ext_cn: 在荒野里漫步的自由
ext.ext_en: ...freedom to ramble across the moors.

defs.def_en: If you ramble, you go on a long walk in the countryside.

ext.ext_cn: 有时她讲话很有条理，有时则讲得漫无边际。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes she spoke sensibly; sometimes she rambled...

ext.ext_en: It would have been best written in a more concise way as it does tend to ramble.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person rambles in their speech or writing, you mean they do not make much sense because they keep going off the subject in a confused way.
A toner is a substance which you can put on your skin, for example to clean it or make it less oily.

defs.def_cn: （作家、电影导演等的）破格，不拘一格

ext.ext_cn: 有关捕捉大鱼的所有内容只是一点破格罢了。
ext.ext_en: All that stuff about catching giant fish was just a bit of poetic licence.

defs.def_en: If someone such as a writer or film director uses poetic licence, they break the usual rules of language or style, or they change the facts, in order to create a particular effect.

ext.ext_cn: “请问那是什么意思？”——“那一点回头我会说，现在先写下来就好了。”
ext.ext_en: 'What does that mean please?' — 'I'm coming back to that. Just write it down for the minute.'

defs.def_en: If you come back to a topic or point, you talk about it again later.
Your pals are your friends.

ext.ext_en: Holidays can be horrendous. All right, I'll rephrase that. The first few days are invariably hell...

ext.ext_cn: 经理又换了一种方式提问。
ext.ext_en: Again, the executive rephrased the question.

defs.def_en: If you rephrase a question or statement, you ask it or say it again in a different way.

ext.ext_en: In recent years the Austrian economy has outperformed most other industrial economies...

ext.ext_en: It was yet another case where the human eye outperformed radar.

defs.def_en: If one thing outperforms another, the first is more successful or efficient than the second.
A DVD burner is a piece of computer equipment that you use for copying data from a computer onto a DVD.

ext.ext_en: Those concerns were overshadowed by subsequent events.

defs.def_en: You use subsequent to describe something that happened or existed after the time or event that has just been referred to.

ext.ext_cn: 继去年在杯赛半决赛中获胜后，他们仅又赢过一场比赛。
ext.ext_en: They won only one more game subsequent to their Cup semi-final win last year.

defs.def_en: If something happened subsequent to something else, it happened after that thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Jon's exuberance was irrepressible.

ext.ext_en: He wanted to show his sympathy for the bereaved.

defs.def_en: When you accumulate things or when they accumulate, they collect or are gathered over a period of time.

defs.def_en: If something swamps a place or object, it fills it with water.

ext.ext_cn: 枣红色母马
ext.ext_en: ...a chestnut mare.

ext.ext_en: ...that old chestnut, the war between man and machines.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a statement, a story, or a joke as an old chestnut or a hoary chestnut, you mean that it has been repeated so often that it is no longer interesting.

ext.ext_en: He has been seen as a champion of a more cautious approach to economic reform.

ext.ext_en: Chicago has 6 graduate and professional schools of high repute.

defs.def_en: A person or thing of repute or of high repute is respected and known to be good.

ext.ext_en: Under his stewardship, the UN's repute has risen immeasurably.

defs.def_en: A person's or organization's repute is their reputation, especially when this is good.

defs.def_cn: (尤指司机使用的)民用波段，民用电台频道

ext.ext_cn: 我的工作是清洗鱼缸内壁。
ext.ext_en: It was my job to wash out the fish tank.

defs.def_en: If you wash out a container, you wash the inside of it.

ext.ext_cn: 用的是永久性的涂料，洗不掉。
ext.ext_en: With permanent tints, the result won't wash out.

defs.def_en: If dye or dirt washes out, it can be removed by washing.

ext.ext_en: Rain washed out five of the last seven games.

ext.ext_cn: 栗色的小猴崽
ext.ext_en: ...a tiny, nut-brown monkey.

ext.ext_en: She produced a bundle of notes and proceeded to count out one hundred and ninety-five pounds...

ext.ext_cn: 他把一包包的衣服夹在胳膊下面。
ext.ext_en: He gathered the bundles of clothing into his arms...

defs.def_en: A bundle of things is a number of them that are tied together or wrapped in a cloth or bag so that they can be carried or stored.

defs.def_cn: 极度，非常（用于强调某人具备的某种品质或特性）

ext.ext_cn: 我记得米基是个很有趣的人，和他在一起非常愉快。
ext.ext_en: I remember Mickey as a bundle of fun, great to have around...

ext.ext_en: Life at high school wasn't a bundle of laughs, either...

ext.ext_cn: 这份职业提供了大量福利，全面训练就是其中很重要的一项。
ext.ext_en: The profession offers a bundle of benefits, not least of which is extensive training.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a bundle of things, you are emphasizing that there is a wide range of them.

ext.ext_cn: 他被塞进一部车里，带到50英里外的警察局。
ext.ext_en: He was bundled into a car and driven 50 miles to a police station...

ext.ext_en: It's cheaper to buy software bundled with a PC than separately.

ext.ext_en: The interview went out over the airways.

defs.def_en: Airways means the same as airwaves .

ext.ext_en: He has offered seats at the conference table to the Russian leader and the president of Kazakhstan...

ext.ext_cn: 越来越多的公司向他们提供工作机会。
ext.ext_en: The number of companies offering them work increased...

defs.def_en: A graduation is a line or number on a container or measuring instrument which marks a particular measurement.

ext.ext_en: A notably short, silver-haired man, he plays basketball with his staff several times a week.

defs.def_en: You can use notably to emphasize a particular quality that someone or something has.

ext.ext_cn: 旅客必须携带有效证件。
ext.ext_en: Passengers must carry proper documentation.

defs.def_en: Documentation consists of documents which provide proof or evidence of something, or are a record of something.

ext.ext_en: ...the information technology industry.

defs.def_en: Information technology is the theory and practice of using computers to store and analyse information. The abbreviation IT is often used.

defs.def_en: Rhyming slang is a spoken informal kind of language in which you do not use the normal word for something, but say a word or phrase that rhymes with it instead. In Cockney rhyming slang, for example, people say 'apples and pears' to mean 'stairs'.

defs.def_cn: 滑稽讽刺表演（或文章）；装滑稽取笑；嘲弄

ext.ext_en: ...a trio of burlesque Moscow stereotypes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If someone is destined for a particular place, or if goods are destined for a particular place, they are travelling towards that place or will be sent to that place.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as bombastic, you are criticizing them for trying to impress other people by saying things that sound impressive but have little meaning.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...well-worn party dogma and ideology.

defs.def_en: A well-worn expression, remark, or idea has been used so often that it no longer seems to have much meaning or to be interesting.

ext.ext_en: ...well-worn brown shoes.

ext.ext_en: ...a new word in the German vocabulary.

defs.def_en: If something provokes a reaction, it causes it.
See also:turtle dove;A dove is a bird that looks like a pigeon but is smaller and lighter in colour. Doves are often used as a symbol of peace.

defs.def_en: In American English, dove is sometimes used as the past tense of dive.
A bustier is a type of close-fitting strapless top worn by women.
A witticism is a witty remark or joke.
Misogyny is a strong dislike of women.

ext.ext_cn: 他们停下了脚步，结果他差点儿撞到他们身上。
ext.ext_en: They stopped walking and he almost bumped into them...

ext.ext_en: There was a jerk as the boat bumped against something...

defs.def_en: If you bump into something or someone, you accidentally hit them while you are moving.

ext.ext_en: I felt a little bump and I knew instantly what had happened...

ext.ext_en: The child took five steps, and then sat down with a bump.

defs.def_en: A bump is the action or the dull sound of two heavy objects hitting each other.

ext.ext_en: She fell against our coffee table and got a large bump on her forehead.

defs.def_en: A bump is a minor injury or swelling that you get if you bump into something or if something hits you.

ext.ext_en: The truck hit a bump and bounced.

defs.def_en: A bump on a road is a raised, uneven part.

ext.ext_en: We left the road, and again bumped over the mountainside...

defs.def_en: If a vehicle bumps over a surface, it travels in a rough, bouncing way because the surface is very uneven.

ext.ext_en: Although the plan received unanimous approval, this does not mean that it represents the lowest common denominator.

defs.def_en: If you describe a plan or policy as the lowest common denominator, you are critical of it because it has been deliberately made too simple so that nobody will disagree.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen in the fullness of time, you mean that it will eventually happen after a long time or after a long series of events.

ext.ext_cn: 矿工们开凿了一条地道，以排出矿井里的水。

ext.ext_cn: 诈骗案通常错综复杂，会给公共资金造成巨大损失。
ext.ext_en: Fraud trials are often complex and have become an expensive drain on the public purse.

defs.def_en: See also:brain drain;If you say that something is a drain on an organization's finances or resources, you mean that it costs the organization a large amount of money, and you do not consider that it is worth it.

ext.ext_cn: 国家财力已经被战争消耗殆尽。
ext.ext_en: The state's finances have been drained by war...

ext.ext_cn: 公司已逐渐用完了其现金储备。
ext.ext_en: The company has steadily drained its cash reserves.

defs.def_en: If you say that a country's or a company's resources or finances are drained, you mean that they are used or spent completely.

ext.ext_cn: 他们意识到他们的公众形象正迅速被毁掉。
ext.ext_en: They were aware that their public image was rapidly going down the drain...

ext.ext_cn: 他痛惜他四年的生活就因大腿根部的伤被毁掉了。
ext.ext_en: He lamented that four years of his life had gone down the drain because of an injury to his groin.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is going down the drain, you mean that it is being destroyed or wasted.

ext.ext_cn: 当地的小店都倒闭了。
ext.ext_en: Small local stores are going down the drain.

defs.def_en: If you say that a business is going down the drain, you mean that it is failing financially.

ext.ext_cn: 他对人性多面性的宽容与理解
ext.ext_en: ...his tolerance and understanding of diverse human nature.

ext.ext_cn: 对其他方法的接受与宽容
ext.ext_en: …the acceptance and tolerance of other ways.

defs.def_en: Tolerance is the quality of allowing other people to say and do as they like, even if you do not agree or approve of it.

ext.ext_cn: 对疼痛的忍耐力降低了，对感染的抵抗力也减弱了。
ext.ext_en: There is lowered pain tolerance, lowered resistance to infection.

ext.ext_cn: 对错误的低容忍度
ext.ext_en: ...a low tolerance of errors.

defs.def_en: Tolerance is the ability to bear something painful or unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 和过量服用任何其他药物一样，身体会对它产生耐药性。
ext.ext_en: As with any drug taken in excess, your body can build up a tolerance to it.

defs.def_en: If someone or something has a tolerance to a substance, they are exposed to it so often that it does not have very much effect on them.

defs.def_cn: 单调乏味;无变化;一成不变

ext.ext_cn: 进城住一晚或许有助于消除一周生活的单调。
ext.ext_en: A night on the town may help to break the monotony of the week.

ext.ext_cn: 单调乏味的安稳生活
ext.ext_en: ...a life of secure monotony.

defs.def_en: The monotony of something is the fact that it never changes and is boring.
An IUD is a piece of plastic or metal which is put inside a woman's womb in order to prevent her from becoming pregnant. IUD is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'intrauterine device'.
A trimaran is a fast sailing boat similar to a catamaran, but with three hulls instead of two.
A turtle is a large reptile which has a thick shell covering its body and which lives in the sea most of the time.
A turtle is any reptile that has a thick shell around its body, for example a tortoise or terrapin.

ext.ext_cn: 拖船两次都差点翻个儿，但我设法稳住了船身。
ext.ext_en: The tug nearly turned turtle twice, but I managed to keep her upright.

defs.def_en: If a boat turns turtle, it turns upside down when it is in the water.

defs.def_cn: （与数词连用构成形容词）表示“有…个房间的”

ext.ext_cn: 他们找到了一个出租的小两居室。
ext.ext_en: They found a little two-roomed flat to rent.

defs.def_en: -roomed combines with numbers to form adjectives which tell you how many rooms a house or flat contains.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一向强调经济改革的重要性。
ext.ext_en: We have always stressed the importance of economic reform...

ext.ext_cn: 安全第一。
ext.ext_en: Safety is of paramount importance.

defs.def_en: The importance of something is its quality of being significant, valued, or necessary in a particular situation.
Importance means having influence, power, or status.

ext.ext_cn: 布克奖，英国小说界的最高荣誉
ext.ext_en: ...the Booker prize, Britain's top award for fiction...

ext.ext_cn: 她向女学生卡罗琳·塔克颁发了英勇奖状。
ext.ext_en: She presented a bravery award to schoolgirl Caroline Tucker.

defs.def_en: An award is a prize or certificate that a person is given for doing something well.

ext.ext_cn: 判给工人的赔偿金
ext.ext_en: ...workmen's compensation awards.

defs.def_en: In law, an award is a sum of money that a court decides should be given to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 今年教师平均加薪幅度将近8%
ext.ext_en: ...this year's average pay award for teachers of just under 8%.

defs.def_en: A pay award is an increase in pay for a particular group of workers.

ext.ext_cn: 她的两部电影双双获奖。
ext.ext_en: She was awarded the prize for both films...

ext.ext_cn: 为表彰他的奉献精神，市长授予他荣誉奖章。
ext.ext_en: For his dedication the Mayor awarded him a medal of merit.

defs.def_en: If someone is awarded something such as a prize or an examination mark, it is given to them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们将合同给了一家英国造船厂。
ext.ext_en: We have awarded the contract to a British shipyard...

ext.ext_cn: 高级法院法官裁定他获得600万英镑的损失赔偿金。
ext.ext_en: A High Court judge had awarded him £6 million damages.

defs.def_en: To award something to someone means to decide that it will be given to that person.

defs.def_cn: 推动的;推进的;强有力的

ext.ext_cn: 顾客消费是夏季经济增长的强大推动力。
ext.ext_en: Consumer spending was the driving force behind the economic growth in the summer...

ext.ext_cn: 布鲁斯·里奥克的勃勃雄心是他们新近成功的主要原因。
ext.ext_en: Bruce Rioch's driving ambition is the main reason behind their new-found success.

defs.def_en: See also:drive;The driving force or idea behind something that happens or is done is the main thing that has a strong effect on it and makes it happen or be done in a particular way.

defs.def_cn: （常用来清洁木质及金属物质的）钢丝球；钢丝绒
defs.def_en: Wire wool consists of very thin pieces of wire twisted together, often in the form of small pads. These are used to clean wooden and metal objects.

defs.def_cn: （建筑工人、工厂工人、骑手等戴的）防护帽，安全帽
defs.def_en: A hard hat is a hat made from a hard material, which people wear to protect their heads on building sites or in factories, or when riding a horse.
An iPod is a portable MP3 player that can play music downloaded from the Internet.
A sanitary towel is a pad of thick soft material which women wear to absorb the blood during their periods.

ext.ext_cn: 整个营地的宽度为400步。
ext.ext_en: The breadth of the whole camp was 400 paces.

defs.def_en: The breadth of something is the distance between its two sides.

ext.ext_cn: 年长者阅历相当丰富。
ext.ext_en: Older people have a tremendous breadth of experience...

ext.ext_cn: 他学识渊博，令我非常钦佩。
ext.ext_en: His breadth of knowledge filled me with admiration.

defs.def_en: The breadth of something is its quality of consisting of or involving many different things.

ext.ext_cn: 这个乐队通过到北美各地演出打响了知名度。
ext.ext_en: The group built their reputation by playing across the length and breadth of North America...

ext.ext_cn: 她游历了英国各地。
ext.ext_en: She has travelled the length and breadth of Britain.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something or something happens throughout or across the length and breadth of a place, you are emphasizing that it happens everywhere in that place.

defs.def_cn: (地方、活动)围绕特定主题的，特定历史时期的

ext.ext_cn: 主题饭店、酒吧和夜总会
ext.ext_en: ...themed restaurants, bars, and nightclubs.

ext.ext_cn: 分布着一系列小型主题区域的巨大空间
ext.ext_en: ...a huge space laid out as a series of small themed areas.

defs.def_en: A themed place or event has been created so that it shows a particular historical time or way of life, or tells a well-known story.

ext.ext_cn: 过去的农业是以家庭为单位的。
ext.ext_en: Agriculture was based in the past on the family as a unit.

defs.def_en: If you consider something as a unit, you consider it as a single, complete thing.

ext.ext_cn: 医疗卫生服务研究部门
ext.ext_en: ...the health services research unit...

ext.ext_cn: 这个团队得出的结果令人吃惊。
ext.ext_en: The results from this unit are staggering.

defs.def_en: A unit is a group of people who work together at a specific job, often in a particular place.

defs.def_cn: （武装部队或警察机关的）小队，分队

ext.ext_cn: 一个秘密军事分队企图污染难民的饮用水。
ext.ext_en: One secret military unit tried to contaminate the drinking water of the refugees...

ext.ext_cn: 两支海军小分队在过去的36个小时被困在城内。
ext.ext_en: Two small Marine units have been trapped inside the city for the last 36 hours.

defs.def_en: A unit is a group within an armed force or police force, whose members fight or work together or carry out a particular task.

defs.def_cn: （常为更大机器一部分的）装置，设备，部件

ext.ext_cn: 这个部件能插进任何电视机。
ext.ext_en: The unit plugs into any TV set.

defs.def_en: A unit is a small machine which has a particular function, often part of a larger machine.
A unit of measurement is a fixed standard quantity, length, or weight that is used for measuring things. The litre, the centimetre, and the ounce are all units.
A unit is one of the parts that a textbook is divided into.

ext.ext_cn: 农业部委托对低投入耕作进行研究。
ext.ext_en: The Ministry of Agriculture commissioned a study into low-input farming...

ext.ext_cn: 你可以委托他们专门为你画点什么。
ext.ext_en: You can commission them to paint something especially for you.

defs.def_en: If you commission something or commission someone to do something, you formally arrange for someone to do a piece of work for you.

defs.def_cn: 受托之事;(接受报酬的)任务

ext.ext_cn: 就在几天前，我完成了一项委托创作任务。
ext.ext_en: Just a few days ago, I finished a commission.

defs.def_en: A commission is a piece of work that someone is asked to do and is paid for.

ext.ext_cn: 销售人员只根据销售量提取佣金。
ext.ext_en: The salesmen work on commission only...

ext.ext_cn: 他还因为带来了很多新客户拿到一笔佣金。
ext.ext_en: He also got a commission for bringing in new clients.

defs.def_en: Commission is a sum of money paid to a salesperson for every sale that he or she makes. If a salesperson is paid on commission, the amount they receive depends on the amount they sell.

defs.def_cn: (银行或公司收取的)服务费，手续费

ext.ext_cn: 旅行社对英镑支票收取1%的服务费。
ext.ext_en: Travel agents charge 1 per cent commission on sterling cheques...

ext.ext_cn: 卖方支付固定的服务费。
ext.ext_en: Sellers pay a fixed commission fee.

defs.def_en: If a bank or other company charges commission, they charge a fee for providing a service, for example for exchanging money or issuing an insurance policy.

ext.ext_cn: 当局被敦促成立一个委员会负责调查这些谋杀案。
ext.ext_en: The authorities have been asked to set up a commission to investigate the murders.

ext.ext_cn: 媒体投诉委员会
ext.ext_en: ...the Press Complaints Commission.

defs.def_en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something.

ext.ext_cn: 如果使用枪支进行犯罪，就应该受到额外的惩罚。
ext.ext_en: If a person uses a gun in the commission of a crime, then he should be given an additional penalty.

defs.def_en: The commission of a crime is the act of committing a crime.

ext.ext_cn: 他接受任命成为一名海军军官。
ext.ext_en: He accepted a commission as a naval officer.

defs.def_en: If a member of the armed forces receives a commission, he or she becomes an officer.

ext.ext_cn: 他被任命为空军少尉。
ext.ext_en: He was commissioned as second lieutenant in the Air Force...

ext.ext_cn: 只有持委任状的军官才有资格获得十字勋章。
ext.ext_en: Only commissioned officers qualify for the Military Cross.

defs.def_en: If a member of the armed forces is commissioned, he or she is made an officer.

defs.def_cn: (船、设备等)坏了的，不能使用的

ext.ext_cn: 技工预计这艘船到9月底才能修好。
ext.ext_en: The operator expects the ship to be out of commission until the end of September.

defs.def_en: If something, for example a ship or a piece of equipment, is out of commission, it is broken and cannot be used until it is repaired.

ext.ext_cn: 他对这些运动项目的兴趣开始减退，倒是对橄榄球开始有了热情。
ext.ext_en: While his interest in these sports began to wane, a passion for rugby developed.

ext.ext_cn: 她母亲日渐不济的体力
ext.ext_en: ...her mother's waning strength.

defs.def_en: If something wanes, it becomes gradually weaker or less, often so that it eventually disappears.  wax and wane→see: wax;

ext.ext_cn: 当然，他名义上是副首相，但是显然他的影响力正在下降。
ext.ext_en: He was nominally Deputy Prime Minister, certainly, but his influence was clearly on the wane...

ext.ext_cn: 1982年，他的事业走下坡路时，以5,000英镑的价钱卖了个剧本。
ext.ext_en: In 1982, with his career prospects on the wane, he sold a script for £5,000.

defs.def_en: If something is on the wane, it is becoming weaker or less.

ext.ext_cn: 月亮渐亏，每天出现的时间也越来越晚。
ext.ext_en: The moon was waning, and each day it rose later.

ext.ext_cn: 被下弦月染成银色的天空
ext.ext_en: ...a sky silvered by a waning moon.

defs.def_en: When the moon is waning, it is showing a smaller area of brightness each day as it changes from a full moon to a new moon.

ext.ext_cn: 海军陆战队队员爬到使馆大楼顶上，升起了美国国旗。
ext.ext_en: The Marines climbed to the roof of the embassy building to raise the American flag...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经举起白旗投降。
ext.ext_en: They had raised the white flag in surrender.

defs.def_en: A flag is a piece of cloth which can be attached to a pole and which is used as a sign, signal, or symbol of something, especially of a particular country.

defs.def_cn: (在售旗募捐日出售或在某个位置上作标记用的)小旗，旗状物
defs.def_en: A flag is a small piece of paper or cloth attached to a stick or pin which is sold on a flag day or used to mark a particular spot.

defs.def_cn: 旗帜(新闻用语，代指某个国家、组织或其价值观、权力)

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·惠特克将与他的兄弟迈克尔一起代表英国参加这场自行车赛。
ext.ext_en: Joining John Whitaker will be his brother Michael also riding under the British flag...

ext.ext_cn: 机场由加拿大军队以联合国的名义开放。
ext.ext_en: The airport was opened by Canadian troops operating under the flag of the United Nations.

defs.def_en: Journalists sometimes refer to the flag of a particular country or organization as a way of referring to the country or organization itself and its values or power.

ext.ext_cn: 他的热情丝毫未减。
ext.ext_en: His enthusiasm was in no way flagging...

ext.ext_cn: 跑到4,000米时，他开始体力不支。
ext.ext_en: By 4,000m he was beginning to flag.

defs.def_en: If you flag or if your spirits flag, you begin to lose enthusiasm or energy.
See also:flagged;A flag is the same as a flagstone .

defs.def_cn: (在国外时)表示并号召拥护自己的国家;（为少数人支持的事业)摇旗呐喊

ext.ext_cn: 史蒂夫·克拉布在巴塞罗那可以旗帜鲜明地支持英国。
ext.ext_en: Steve Crabb can fly the flag with distinction for Britain in Barcelona.

defs.def_en: If you fly the flag, you show that you are proud of your country, or that you support a particular cause, especially when you are in a foreign country or when few other people do.

defs.def_cn: 挥手拦下，招手叫(尤指出租车)

ext.ext_cn: 马利特已经出门了，正挥手招呼一辆出租车。
ext.ext_en: Marlette was already out of the door, flagging down a taxi.

defs.def_en: If you flag down a vehicle, especially a taxi, you wave at it as a signal for the driver to stop.

defs.def_cn: 到处，处处（用于索引或注释，表示某一名称或问题在文章或某一章节中多次出现）

ext.ext_cn: 《论它们之间的关系》（伦敦，1873），第8页及其他各章节。
ext.ext_en: ...The Theories of their Relation (London, 1873), p. 8 and passim.

defs.def_en: In indexes and notes, passim indicates that a particular name or subject occurs frequently throughout a particular piece of writing or section of a book.
A cassette recorder is a machine that is used for recording and listening to cassettes.

ext.ext_cn: 基因只是致病的部分原因。
ext.ext_en: The gene is only part of the causation of illness.

defs.def_en: The causation of something, usually something bad, is the factors that have caused it.

ext.ext_cn: 有关社会因果律的假设
ext.ext_en: ...assumptions concerning social causation.

defs.def_en: Causation is a study of the factors involved in causing something.

ext.ext_cn: “鲁头士”，一支模仿披头士的乐队
ext.ext_en: ...a Beatles tribute band, the Prefab Four.

defs.def_en: A tribute band is a pop group that plays the music and copies the style of another, much more famous, pop group.
A lion is a large wild member of the cat family that is found in Africa. Lions have yellowish fur, and male lions have long hair on their head and neck.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为他们十分般配。
ext.ext_en: They were well matched, I thought...

ext.ext_cn: 我的父母并不十分般配。
ext.ext_en: My parents were not very well matched...

defs.def_en: If you say that two people are well matched, you mean that they have qualities that will enable them to have a good relationship.

defs.def_cn: (体育等竞赛中)不相上下的,势均力敌的

ext.ext_cn: 双方势均力敌，奉献了一场精彩的比赛。
ext.ext_en: Two well-matched sides conjured up an entertaining game...

ext.ext_cn: 两个队难分伯仲。
ext.ext_en: The teams are evenly matched.

defs.def_en: In sports and other competitions, if the two opponents or teams are well matched, they are both of the same standard in strength or ability.
A possum is the same as an opossum .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 琐碎的;不重要的;微不足道的

ext.ext_cn: 主管试图对这些问题置之不理，认为都是些细枝末节的小事，可以稍后解决。
ext.ext_en: The director tried to wave aside these issues as trivial details that could be settled later...

ext.ext_cn: 我不喜欢为一点小毛病就去看医生。
ext.ext_en: I don't like to visit the doctor just for something trivial.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as trivial, you think that it is unimportant and not serious.

defs.def_cn: (与患病者或吸毒者)共依存的，相互依赖的

ext.ext_cn: 男人也会产生共依存性。
ext.ext_en: Guys can be co-dependent, too.

ext.ext_cn: 这个节目关注共依存者面临的各种问题。
ext.ext_en: The program is geared around the problems of being a co-dependent.

defs.def_en: A co-dependent person is in an unsatisfactory relationship with someone who is ill or an addict, but does not want the relationship to end.

A concessive clause is a subordinate clause which refers to a situation that contrasts with the one described in the main clause. For example, in the sentence 'Although he was tired, he couldn't get to sleep', the first clause is a concessive clause.

defs.def_cn: (用在副词over,under等后构成形容词)表示“性行为…的”，“有…性行为的”

ext.ext_cn: 我丈夫总是有点儿性欲过盛。
ext.ext_en: My husband has always been a bit oversexed.

ext.ext_cn: 房事中占绝对主导的性欲极其旺盛的女人
ext.ext_en: ...a highly sexed woman who takes complete control in the bedroom.

defs.def_en: -sexed is used after adverbs such as 'over' and 'under' to form adjectives which indicate that someone wants to have sex too often or not often enough.
Secateurs are a gardening tool that look like a pair of strong, heavy scissors. Secateurs are used for cutting the stems of plants.
A sports writer is a journalist who writes about sport.

ext.ext_cn: 对美国资金市场的投资扶持了美元。
ext.ext_en: Investments in the U.S. money market have propped up the American dollar...

ext.ext_cn: 在证券交易所，市场在大量买单的推动下有所上扬。
ext.ext_en: On the Stock Exchange, aggressive buying propped the market up.

defs.def_en: To prop up something means to support it or help it to survive.

ext.ext_cn: 他用小手指把眼镜向上推了推。
ext.ext_en: He pushes his glasses up his nose with his pinkie.

defs.def_en: Your pinkie is the smallest finger on your hand.

ext.ext_cn: 大约花了50分钟才把火扑灭。
ext.ext_en: It took about 50 minutes to extinguish the fire...

ext.ext_cn: 新闻发布会一结束，灯光就熄灭了。
ext.ext_en: The lights are extinguished as soon as the news conference is over.

defs.def_en: If you extinguish a fire or a light, you stop it burning or shining.

ext.ext_cn: 那条消息使她对理查德归来的希望彻底破灭。
ext.ext_en: The message extinguished her hopes of Richard's return.

defs.def_en: If something extinguishes a feeling or idea, it destroys it.

defs.def_cn: 目瞪口呆地凝视；张口结舌地看

ext.ext_cn: 他的秘书停止了记录，目瞪口呆地望着我。
ext.ext_en: His secretary stopped taking notes to gape at me...

ext.ext_cn: 他不是那种像个游客似的四处闲逛、对什么都好奇张望的人。
ext.ext_en: He was not the type to wander round gaping at everything like a tourist.

defs.def_en: If you gape, you look at someone or something in surprise, usually with an open mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 前门不翼而飞，屋顶豁开了一个洞。
ext.ext_en: The front door was missing. A hole gaped in the roof.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a hole or a wound gapes, you are emphasizing that it is big or wide.

defs.def_cn: （因遭人怠慢而感到的）恼怒，愠怒

ext.ext_cn: 米米已不再为苏姗拒绝接受这份工作的事生气了。
ext.ext_en: Mimi had gotten over her pique at Susan's refusal to accept the job.

defs.def_en: Pique is the feeling of annoyance you have when you think someone has not treated you properly.

defs.def_cn: 激起，引起（兴趣或好奇心）

ext.ext_en: The area is of great botanical interest.

defs.def_en: Botanical books, research, and activities relate to the scientific study of plants.

ext.ext_cn: 这种极其有效的新型植物制剂是从可乐果和海藻中提炼出来的。
ext.ext_en: The most effective new botanicals are extracts from cola nut and marine algae.

defs.def_en: Botanicals are drugs which are made from plants.

ext.ext_cn: 把电影胶片或幻灯片转换成视频应该不费吹灰之力。
ext.ext_en: Transferring cine film or slides to video should be a doddle.

defs.def_en: A three-line whip is a situation where the MPs in a political party are ordered to attend parliament and vote in a particular way on a particular issue.

defs.def_cn: 过去已久的；很久以前的

ext.ext_en: The book recalls other memories of a bygone age.

ext.ext_cn: 过去的几代人
ext.ext_en: ...bygone generations.

defs.def_en: Bygone means happening or existing a very long time ago.

defs.def_cn: 让过去的事过去；冰释前嫌
defs.def_en: If two people let bygones be bygones, they decide to forget about unpleasant things that have happened between them in the past.

defs.def_cn: 未事先通知的；未提前说明的；未打招呼的

ext.ext_cn: 他刚刚从南美来到这里，事先没有打招呼。
ext.ext_en: He had just arrived unannounced from South America...

ext.ext_cn: 到西贡的第一个晚上，我给父亲的堂兄堂弟们来了个突然袭击。
ext.ext_en: My first night in Saigon I paid an unannounced visit to my father's cousins.

defs.def_en: If someone arrives or does something unannounced, they do it unexpectedly and without anyone having being told about it beforehand.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自主的;自立的;自力更生的

ext.ext_cn: 她聪慧自立，大胆直言，对蠢人没有耐心。
ext.ext_en: She is intelligent and self-reliant, speaking her mind and not suffering fools gladly.

defs.def_en: If you are self-reliant, you are able to do things and make decisions by yourself, without needing other people to help you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 米饭没煮好会结块，而且软黏黏的。
ext.ext_en: When the rice isn't cooked properly it goes lumpy and gooey...

ext.ext_cn: 许多妇女，尤其是年纪大了以后，腿上会现出疙疙瘩瘩的青筋。
ext.ext_en: Many women, especially as they get older, develop lumpy veins in their legs.

defs.def_en: Something that is lumpy contains lumps or is covered with lumps.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as dim-witted, you are saying in quite an unkind way that you do not think they are very clever.

ext.ext_cn: 他的辞职是对该队的沉重打击。
ext.ext_en: His resignation was a body blow to the team.

defs.def_en: A body blow is something that causes great disappointment and difficulty to someone who is trying to achieve something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （意见等）令人不快的，难以接受的

ext.ext_cn: 强奸事件成了新闻报道的好素材，真是令人难以接受。
ext.ext_en: It is an unpalatable fact that rape makes a good news story...

ext.ext_cn: 直到那时我才开始了解到有关约翰的一些令人难以接受的实情。
ext.ext_en: It was only then that I began to learn the unpalatable truth about John.

defs.def_en: If you describe an idea as unpalatable, you mean that you find it unpleasant and difficult to accept.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一块干巴巴、难以入口的奶酪
ext.ext_en: ...a lump of dry, unpalatable cheese.

defs.def_en: If you describe food as unpalatable, you mean that it is so unpleasant that you can hardly eat it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们真的并不希望成为巴勒斯坦人民的太上皇。
ext.ext_en: We really don't want to be the overlords of the Palestinian population...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天，在对威尔士橄榄球界几位巨头投了不信任票后，该运动的管理陷入一片混乱。
ext.ext_en: The running of Welsh rugby was left in chaos yesterday after a vote of no confidence in the game's overlords.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as an overlord, you mean that they have great power and are likely to use it in a bad way.

ext.ext_cn: 亨利二世是第一位被承认为爱尔兰领主的国王。
ext.ext_en: Henry II was the first king to be recognized as overlord of Ireland.

defs.def_en: In former times, an overlord was someone who had power over many people.

ext.ext_cn: 她的棕灰色母马
ext.ext_en: ...her dun mare.

defs.def_en: Something that is dun is a dull grey-brown colour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 可能你太顺从了。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps you are too acquiescent.

defs.def_en: Someone who is acquiescent is ready to agree to do what someone wants, or to accept what they do.

defs.def_cn: （可作为类似案件判决依据的）判例案件
defs.def_en: A test case is a legal case which becomes an example for deciding other similar cases.

ext.ext_cn: 不管从哪个角度来看，核能都是未来的能源。
ext.ext_en: Whichever way you look at it, nuclear power is the energy of the future...

ext.ext_cn: 犹太人只要愿意，均可自动加入以色列国籍，不管他们是什么肤色，不管他们说何种语言。
ext.ext_en: Israel offers automatic citizenship to all Jews who want it, whatever colour they are and whichever language they speak.

defs.def_en: You use whichever in order to indicate that it does not matter which of the possible alternatives happens or is chosen.

defs.def_cn: (用来指明多个可能性中正确或特指的一个)…的那个

ext.ext_cn: 学会用最适合的方式来放松自己
ext.ext_en: ...learning to relax by whichever method suits you best.

ext.ext_cn: 钓鱼时间从上午6点到黄昏或是到晚上10点半，以较早者为准。
ext.ext_en: Fishing is from 6 am to dusk or 10.30pm, whichever is sooner...

defs.def_en: You use whichever to specify which of a number of possibilities is the right one or the one you mean.
The witness stand is the same as the witness box .

ext.ext_cn: 我没有把钱款挪为己用，也没有挪用任何资金。
ext.ext_en: I took no money for personal use and have not misappropriated any funds whatsoever...

ext.ext_cn: 据称总共有5亿美元被挪用。
ext.ext_en: A total of $500 million is alleged to have been misappropriated.

defs.def_en: If someone misappropriates money which does not belong to them, they take it without permission and use it for their own purposes.

defs.def_cn: 白噪音(尤指持续而无规律的杂音)

ext.ext_cn: 他们被迫听白噪音，类似于你在调电台时听到的那种静电噪音。
ext.ext_en: They were made to listen to white noise, such as static of the sort you might pick up between radio stations.

defs.def_en: White noise is sound, especially of a loud, continuous, or unpleasant kind, that seems to have no pattern or rhythm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 谨慎的；小心在意的；警惕的

ext.ext_cn: 那个男孩充满戒心地瞧了他一眼。
ext.ext_en: The boy gave him a guarded look...

ext.ext_cn: 莱希博士在办公室里看起来没有那么谨小慎微，放松了许多。
ext.ext_en: In the office, Dr. Lahey seemed less guarded, more relaxed.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as guarded, you mean that they are careful not to show their feelings or give away information.

defs.def_cn: 安然度过，挺过(风暴或危机)

ext.ext_cn: 执政党认为他们可以安然度过这场政治风暴。
ext.ext_en: The ruling party think they can ride out the political storm...

ext.ext_en: He has to just ride this out and hope that it turns in his favor.

defs.def_en: If someone rides out a storm or a crisis, they manage to survive a difficult period without suffering serious harm.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你出不了门，可以预约专家顾问上门就诊。
ext.ext_en: If you are housebound, you can arrange for a home visit from a specialist adviser...

ext.ext_cn: 佩卡姆本人是一名癌症专家，他非常了解不同治疗方法之间的巨大差异。
ext.ext_en: Peckham, himself a cancer specialist, is well aware of the wide variations in medical practice.

defs.def_en: A specialist is a person who has a particular skill or knows a lot about a particular subject.

ext.ext_cn: 他恳求的目光
ext.ext_en: ...his pleading eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 她脸上恳求的表情
ext.ext_en: ...the pleading expression on her face...

defs.def_en: A pleading expression or gesture shows someone that you want something very much.

ext.ext_cn: 他完全不理会锡德的恳求。
ext.ext_en: He simply ignored Sid's pleading.

ext.ext_cn: 较贫穷国家的呼吁
ext.ext_en: ...the pleadings of the poorer countries.

defs.def_en: See also:special pleading;Pleading is asking someone for something you want very much, in an intense or emotional way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有说服力的;令人信服的

ext.ext_cn: 要将少校即将返回的消息告知朱利安·卡文迪什是有绝对充足的理由的。
ext.ext_en: There were perfectly cogent reasons why Julian Cavendish should be told of the Major's impending return.

defs.def_en: A cogent reason, argument, or example is strong and convincing.

defs.def_cn: 宿命感;宿命论;宿命情绪

ext.ext_cn: 现在激进分子中间无疑弥漫着一种宿命情绪。
ext.ext_en: There's a certain mood of fatalism now among the radicals.

defs.def_en: Fatalism is a feeling that you cannot control events or prevent unpleasant things from happening, especially when this feeling stops you from making decisions or making an effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...short boxy jackets.

defs.def_en: Something that is boxy is similar to a square in shape and usually plain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He was a serious, silent man.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无声的;寂静的;不出声的

ext.ext_en: The room was silent except for John's crunching...

ext.ext_cn: 重型枪炮的声音又一次安静了下来。
ext.ext_en: The heavy guns have again fallen silent.

defs.def_en: A place that is silent is completely quiet, with no sound at all. Something that is silent makes no sound at all.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Douglas was noticeably silent about his feelings for his father...

ext.ext_en: The administration has recently become silent about abuses in Haiti.

defs.def_en: If someone is silent about something, they do not tell people anything about it, because they think it is a private matter or because they want to keep the information secret.

ext.ext_en: The attacker still stood there, watching her with silent contempt...

ext.ext_en: She offered a silent prayer of thanks.

defs.def_en: A silent emotion or action is not expressed in speech.

ext.ext_en: ...one of the famous silent films of Charlie Chaplin.

ext.ext_cn: 默片时代的喜剧明星们
ext.ext_en: ...comedy stars of the silent era.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: A fifth year of drought is expected to have dramatic effects on the California economy...

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: I had no thoughts of making a dramatic film. I was working in documentary.

defs.def_en: You use dramatic to describe things connected with or relating to the theatre, drama, or plays.

ext.ext_cn: 第一批临床实验有望明年开始。
ext.ext_en: The first clinical trials were expected to begin next year.

ext.ext_cn: 临床心理学家
ext.ext_en: ...a clinical psychologist.

defs.def_en: Clinical means involving or relating to the direct medical treatment or testing of patients.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （思想、行为）非常符合逻辑的，不带感情的

ext.ext_en: All this questioning is so analytical and clinical — it kills romance.

ext.ext_en: ...the proto-fascist tendencies of some of its supporters.

ext.ext_en: ...Albion, whose own legend stretches back to the mists of proto-history.

defs.def_en: Proto- is used to form adjectives and nouns which indicate that something is in the early stages of its development.

defs.def_cn: 住自己房屋者；业主居住者

ext.ext_en: The Northern Region has a lower proportion of owner-occupiers than any other English region.

defs.def_en: An owner-occupier is a person who owns the house or flat that they live in.

ext.ext_cn: 需要很多种土生昆虫给当地植物授粉。
ext.ext_en: Many of the indigenous insects are needed to pollinate the local plants.

ext.ext_cn: 女人们在聊天。
ext.ext_en: The women were chatting...

ext.ext_en: I was chatting to him the other day...

defs.def_en: When people chat, they talk to each other in an informal and friendly way.

defs.def_cn: 酒后驾车者;醉酒驾驶者

ext.ext_cn: 酒后驾车引起的车祸
ext.ext_en: ...a car accident caused by a drunk driver.

defs.def_en: A drunk driver is someone who drives after drinking more than the amount of alcohol that is legally allowed.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调)纯粹的，完全的，十足的

ext.ext_cn: 听他的音乐完全是一种享受。
ext.ext_en: His music is sheer delight...

ext.ext_cn: 灵感的激发通常纯粹是靠运气。
ext.ext_en: Sheer chance quite often plays an important part in sparking off an idea.

defs.def_en: You can use sheer to emphasize that a state or situation is complete and does not involve or is not mixed with anything else.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
