ext.ext_en: There was a sheer drop just outside my window...

ext.ext_cn: 一名男青年从陡峭的岩壁上坠崖身亡。
ext.ext_en: A young man plunged from a sheer rock face to his death.

defs.def_en: A sheer cliff or drop is extremely steep or completely vertical.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 极薄的黑色紧身裤
ext.ext_en: ...sheer black tights.

defs.def_en: Sheer material is very thin, light, and delicate.

ext.ext_cn: 作为单身母亲，我独自抚养我的3个孩子。
ext.ext_en: I was bringing up my three children as a single parent.

ext.ext_cn: 单亲家庭
ext.ext_en: ...single-parent families.

defs.def_en: A single parent is someone who is bringing up a child on their own, because the other parent is not living with them.

defs.def_cn: 无可争辩的;不容置疑的

ext.ext_en: It is indisputable that birds in the UK are harbouring this illness...

ext.ext_en: The indisputable fact is that computers carry out logical operations.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is indisputable, you are emphasizing that it is true and cannot be shown to be untrue.
A diskette is the same as a floppy disk .

ext.ext_cn: “不要亵渎神明，”我母亲说。
ext.ext_en: 'Don't  blaspheme,' my mother said...

ext.ext_cn: 宗教领袖指责该书亵渎了伊斯兰教。
ext.ext_en: The spiritual leader charged that the book blasphemed against Islam.

defs.def_en: If someone blasphemes, they say rude or disrespectful things about God or religion, or they use God's name as a swear word.

Formica is a hard plastic that is used for covering surfaces such as kitchen tables or counters.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the remorseless pressure of recession and financial constraint.

ext.ext_en: ...General Sherman's remorseless progress through Georgia.

defs.def_en: If you describe something, especially something unpleasant, as remorseless, you mean that it goes on for a long time and cannot be stopped.

ext.ext_en: ...the capacity for quick, remorseless violence.

ext.ext_cn: 毫无怜悯之心的窃贼
ext.ext_en: ...remorseless thieves.

defs.def_en: Someone who is remorseless is prepared to be cruel to other people and feels no pity for them.

ext.ext_cn: 暴力事件和左右翼极端主义日益猖獗，这对警方提出了更高的要求。
ext.ext_en: Greater demands were being placed on the police by growing violence and left- and right-wing extremism.

defs.def_en: Extremism is the behaviour or beliefs of extremists.

ext.ext_cn: 赖尔更多的是出于好奇才同意的。

ext.ext_en: Doctors refused to treat her, claiming that her problems were all psychosomatic.

defs.def_en: If someone has a psychosomatic illness, their symptoms are caused by worry or unhappiness rather than by a physical problem.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人)适于上电视镜头的，上镜的

ext.ext_cn: 福斯特小姐头脑聪明，镜头感十足，凭其独家节目拿到约 9 万英镑的年薪。
ext.ext_en: The bright and telegenic Miss Foster is being paid around £90,000 a year for her exclusive deal.

defs.def_en: Someone who is telegenic behaves confidently and looks attractive when they are on the television.

defs.def_cn: （用于制作家具的）花梨木，黄檀木，红木

ext.ext_cn: 一张沉重的红木桌子
ext.ext_en: ...a heavy rosewood desk.

defs.def_en: Rosewood is a hard dark-coloured wood that is used for making furniture. Rosewood comes from a species of tropical tree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 骨瘦如柴的；瘦骨嶙峋的

ext.ext_cn: 一位面部瘦削、头发花白的老者
ext.ext_en: ...an old man with a bony face and white hair...

ext.ext_cn: 他用细长的手指捅了一下比利的胸口。
ext.ext_en: He poked a long bony finger in Billy's chest.

defs.def_en: Someone who has a bony face or bony hands, for example, has a very thin face or very thin hands, with very little flesh covering their bones.

ext.ext_cn: 眼窝的骨架
ext.ext_en: ...the bony ridge of the eye socket.

defs.def_en: The bony parts of a person's or animal's body are the parts made of bone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 味美但刺极多的鱼
ext.ext_en: ...a delicious but extremely bony fish.

defs.def_en: If you describe fish that you are eating as bony, you mean that it has a lot of bones.

ext.ext_cn: 把所有东西从船上卸下来，然后把船彻底清理一下。
ext.ext_en: Unload everything from the boat and clean it thoroughly...

ext.ext_cn: 有人举报说他们正在从满满当当的卡车上卸洗劫来的家具。
ext.ext_en: They were reported to be unloading trucks filled with looted furniture.

defs.def_en: If you unload goods from a vehicle, or you unload a vehicle, you remove the goods from the vehicle, usually after they have been transported from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 从3月至今，他已经卖出130万股了。
ext.ext_en: Since March, he has unloaded 1.3 million shares.

defs.def_en: If someone unloads investments, they get rid of them or sell them.
A motorist is a person who drives a car.
A grad is a graduate .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得他是我所认识的最有魅力并且最为体贴的男士。
ext.ext_en: I think he's the most charming, most considerate man I've ever known...

ext.ext_cn: 我一直认为一个人应该尽量为他人着想。
ext.ext_en: I've always understood one should try and be considerate of other people.

defs.def_en: Someone who is considerate pays attention to the needs, wishes, or feelings of other people.

defs.def_cn: (尤指对于不同态度和价值观的)文化意识

ext.ext_cn: 旨在该行业内促进多样性和提升文化意识的计划
ext.ext_en: ...programs to promote diversity and cultural awareness within the industry.

defs.def_en: Someone's cultural awareness is their understanding of the differences between themselves and people from other countries or other backgrounds, especially differences in attitudes and values.

ext.ext_cn: 一段荧光带
ext.ext_en: ...a piece of fluorescent tape.

defs.def_en: A fluorescent surface, substance, or colour has a very bright appearance when light is directed onto it, as if it is actually shining itself.

ext.ext_cn: 荧光灯管
ext.ext_en: ...fluorescent light tubes.

defs.def_en: A fluorescent light shines with a very hard, bright light and is usually in the form of a long strip.

defs.def_cn: 酞胺哌啶酮，反应停(原为孕妇用药，被发现会导致胎儿四肢畸形后停用)
defs.def_en: Thalidomide is a drug which used to be given to pregnant women, before it was discovered that it resulted in babies being born with wrongly shaped arms and legs.

defs.def_cn: (由于母亲怀孕期间服用了反应停导致的)四肢畸形的

ext.ext_cn: 四肢畸形儿童的特殊需要
ext.ext_en: ...the special needs of thalidomide children.

defs.def_en: Thalidomide is used to describe someone whose arms and legs are wrongly shaped because their mother took thalidomide when she was pregnant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 心智健全的;神志正常的

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎神志完全正常。
ext.ext_en: He seemed perfectly sane...

ext.ext_cn: 心智健全的人做不出这种事来。
ext.ext_en: It wasn't the act of a sane person.

defs.def_en: Someone who is sane is able to think and behave normally and reasonably, and is not mentally ill.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 清醒的;明智的;合情合理的

ext.ext_cn: 理智的人都不愿意看到冲突或伤亡。
ext.ext_en: No sane person wishes to see conflict or casualties.

ext.ext_cn: 安全合理的能源政策
ext.ext_en: ...a sane and safe energy policy.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a sane person, action, or system, you mean one that you think is reasonable and sensible.
On a ship or aircraft, the galley is the kitchen.

defs.def_cn: （旧时常由奴隶或囚犯划桨的）桨帆船
defs.def_en: In former times, a galley was a ship with sails and a lot of oars, which was often rowed by slaves or prisoners.

defs.def_cn: (电影、小说、戏剧中的)闪回，倒叙

ext.ext_cn: 甚至有一段关于谋杀本身的闪回。
ext.ext_en: There is even a flashback to the murder itself.

defs.def_en: In a film, novel, or play, a flashback is a scene that returns to events in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 他反复想起朋友们死去的那个夜晚的情形。
ext.ext_en: He has recurring flashbacks to the night his friends died.

defs.def_en: If you have a flashback to a past experience, you have a sudden and very clear memory of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们打喷嚏究竟是怎么回事？
ext.ext_en: What exactly happens when we sneeze?...

ext.ext_cn: 马上去看病，把花粉过敏引起的打喷嚏治好。
ext.ext_en: See your doctor now to beat summer sneezing.

defs.def_en: When you sneeze, you suddenly take in your breath and then blow it down your nose noisily without being able to stop yourself, for example because you have a cold.

ext.ext_cn: 别把这笔钱不当回事。
ext.ext_en: The money's not to be sneezed at.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not to be sneezed at, you mean that it is worth having.

ext.ext_cn: 想到小廷代尔从小在这里过着田园生活，我就觉得高兴。
ext.ext_en: It pleases me to think of young Tyndale growing up here in deep rusticity.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the simple, peaceful character of life in the countryside as rusticity .

ext.ext_cn: 缺乏的正是对我们社会制度特殊性的洞察。
ext.ext_en: What is lacking is an insight into the particularity of our societal system...

ext.ext_cn: 时间不可避免地掩盖了每种境况的特殊之处。
ext.ext_en: Time inevitably glosses over the particularities of each situation.

defs.def_en: The particularity of something is its quality of being different from other things. The particularities of something are the features that make it different.
Particularity is the giving or showing of details.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有吸引力的;有趣的;动人的

ext.ext_cn: 他举手投足间流露出一种幽默感，我觉得很有魅力。
ext.ext_en: There was a sense of humour to what he did that I found very appealing...

ext.ext_cn: 那是个十分吸引人的想法。
ext.ext_en: That's a very appealing idea.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is appealing is pleasing and attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 她恳求地看了他一眼，温柔的眼神足以融化坚冰。
ext.ext_en: She gave him a soft appealing look that would have melted solid ice.

defs.def_en: An appealing expression or tone of voice indicates to someone that you want help, advice, or approval.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正准备动私刑绞死他时，援军闯入房间把他救下了。
ext.ext_en: They were about to lynch him when reinforcements from the army burst into the room and rescued him.

defs.def_en: If an angry crowd of people lynch someone, they kill that person by hanging them, without letting them have a trial, because they believe that that person has committed a crime.
A ponce is the same as a pimp .

defs.def_cn: 娘娘腔的人；脂粉气十足的人

ext.ext_cn: 在我看来，现在年轻的一代就是一群娘娘腔。
ext.ext_en: The younger ones as far as I am concerned are a bunch of ponces.

defs.def_en: If you call a man a ponce, you are insulting him because you think the way he dresses or behaves is too feminine.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 足智多谋的;机智的;办法多的

ext.ext_cn: 他极具创造力，而且足智多谋，在我的职业生涯中起到了重要的作用。
ext.ext_en: He was amazingly inventive and resourceful, and played a major role in my career...

ext.ext_cn: 她母亲是一个足智多谋、精力充沛的女人。
ext.ext_en: Her mother was a resourceful and energetic woman.

defs.def_en: Someone who is resourceful is good at finding ways of dealing with problems.

defs.def_cn: （商业上）大量获得（利润），遭受(严重损失)，热销；（体育中）获胜，得（分）

ext.ext_cn: 更低的费率意味着各公司更有可能在未来的几个月中大幅获利。
ext.ext_en: Lower rates mean that firms are more likely to rack up profits in the coming months...

ext.ext_cn: 印度尽管没有大胜，却也以3比0击败了日本。
ext.ext_en: India while not racking up such an impressive score beat Japan 3-0.

defs.def_en: If a business racks up profits, losses, or sales, it makes a lot of them. If a sportsman, sportswoman, or team racks up wins, they win a lot of matches or races.

ext.ext_cn: 曼迪用去世的日期减去出生的日期。
ext.ext_en: Mandy subtracted the date of birth from the date of death...

ext.ext_cn: 我们已给每位成人房客减去了 25 美元，这就是基本的房费价格了。
ext.ext_en: We have subtracted $25 per adult to arrive at a basic room rate.

defs.def_en: If you subtract one number from another, you do a calculation in which you take it away from the other number. For example, if you subtract 3 from 5, you get 2.
If you say that what someone has said or written is guff, you think that it is nonsense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我开始感到异常困倦。
ext.ext_en: I was beginning to feel amazingly sleepy...

ext.ext_cn: 他叫醒她的时候，她仍然又累又困。
ext.ext_en: She was still tired and sleepy when he woke her.

defs.def_en: If you are sleepy, you are very tired and are almost asleep.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 瓦朗斯是里昂南面一座寂静的小镇。
ext.ext_en: Valence is a sleepy little town just south of Lyon.

defs.def_en: A sleepy place is quiet and does not have much activity or excitement.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正沿一条狭窄的山路向上爬。
ext.ext_en: They were climbing up a narrow mountain road...

ext.ext_cn: 我跑上楼梯，见艾莉森躺在那里。
ext.ext_en: I ran up the stairs and saw Alison lying at the top...

defs.def_en: If a person or thing goes up something such as a slope, ladder, or chimney, they move away from the ground or to a higher position.

ext.ext_cn: 他正站在梯子顶上锯他那颗苹果树的树冠。
ext.ext_en: He was up a ladder sawing off the tops of his apple trees...

ext.ext_cn: 丽东酒店位于陡峭的半山腰上。
ext.ext_en: The Newton Hotel is halfway up a steep hill.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is up something such as a ladder or a mountain, they are near the top of it.

ext.ext_cn: 保罗头也没抬地答了话。
ext.ext_en: Paul answered, without looking up...

ext.ext_cn: 要抬起头，不时看看四周。
ext.ext_en: Keep your head up, and look around you from time to time.

defs.def_en: You use up to indicate that you are looking or facing in a direction that is away from the ground or towards a higher level.

ext.ext_cn: 他起身走向窗户。
ext.ext_en: He stood up and went to the window...

ext.ext_cn: 他起身出去走进了大堂。
ext.ext_en: He got up and went out into the foyer.

defs.def_en: If someone stands up, they move so that they are standing.

ext.ext_cn: 一排坦克由市里沿路开来。
ext.ext_en: A line of tanks came up the road from the city...

ext.ext_cn: 我们靠在桥的木栏杆上，朝河望去。
ext.ext_en: We leaned on the wooden rail of the bridge and looked up the river...

defs.def_en: If you go or look up something such as a road or river, you go or look along it. If you are up a road or river, you are somewhere along it.

defs.def_cn: 向(或在)某地;(尤指)向(或在)北方，向(或在)地势更高处;

ext.ext_cn: 我明天来看你。
ext.ext_en: I'll be up to see you tomorrow...

ext.ext_cn: 他当时住在北部。
ext.ext_en: He was living up North...

defs.def_en: If you are travelling to a particular place, you can say that you are going up to that place, especially if you are going towards the north or to a higher level of land. If you are already in such a place, you can say that you are up there.

ext.ext_cn: 那个女孩开始跑起来，一路跑到街对面的汽车旁边。
ext.ext_en: The girl ran the rest of the way across the street and up to the car...

ext.ext_cn: 出去时一个十来岁的男孩踩着溜冰鞋滑了过来。
ext.ext_en: On the way out a boy of about ten came up on roller skates...

defs.def_en: If you go up to something or someone, you move to the place where they are and stop there.

ext.ext_cn: 他们最近提高了我的租金。
ext.ext_en: They recently put my rent up...

ext.ext_cn: 旅游火了，工作机会多了，个人收入涨了。
ext.ext_en: Tourism is up, jobs are up, individual income is up...

defs.def_en: If an amount of something goes up, it increases. If an amount of something is up, it has increased and is at a higher level than it was.

ext.ext_cn: 你肯定你该起床了吗？
ext.ext_en: Are you sure you should be up?...

ext.ext_cn: 这些天所有人都一大早就起来。
ext.ext_en: These days all sorts of people were up at the crack of dawn...

defs.def_en: If you are up, you are not in bed.

ext.ext_cn: 半个小时一到，布鲁克斯便起来了。
ext.ext_en: The moment the half-hour was up, Brooks rose...

ext.ext_cn: 6周过去了，大家都为她不得不离开而难过。
ext.ext_en: When the six weeks were up, everybody was sad that she had to leave.

defs.def_en: If a period of time is up, it has come to an end.

ext.ext_cn: 半条利德霍尔街都在修路，他们的出租车只好绕道走。
ext.ext_en: Half the road was up in Leadenhall Street, so their taxi was obliged to make a detour.

defs.def_en: You say that a road is up when it is being repaired and cannot be used.

defs.def_cn: （指棒球运动员）该上场击球的
defs.def_en: If a baseball player is up, it is their turn to bat.
If a computer or computer system is up, it is working.

ext.ext_cn: “去你的，”记者边说边怒气冲冲地冲到大街上。
ext.ext_en: 'Up yours,' said the reporter and stormed out into the street.

defs.def_en: People sometimes say 'Up yours!' as an insult when you have said something to annoy them or make them angry.

ext.ext_cn: 你怎么样，伦诺克斯？很高兴看到你能下床走动了。
ext.ext_en: How are you Lennox? Good to see you up and about.

defs.def_en: If someone who has been in bed for some time, for example because they have been ill, is up and about, they are now out of bed and living their normal life.

ext.ext_cn: 那是怎么回事呢？出问题了，是吗？
ext.ext_en: What is it then? Something's up, isn't it?...

ext.ext_cn: 戈登先生突然闭口不言，他的朋友们知道有哪儿不对劲了。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Gordon stopped talking, and his friends knew something was up.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is up, you mean that something is wrong or that something worrying is happening.

defs.def_cn: 出什么事啦？出什么问题啦？出什么毛病啦？

ext.ext_cn: “出什么事啦？”我对他说。——“没什么事，”他答道。
ext.ext_en: 'What's up?', I said to him. — 'Nothing much,' he answered...

ext.ext_cn: 咱们先坐下来，然后你把事情告诉我。
ext.ext_en: Let's sit down and then you can say what's up.

defs.def_en: If you say to someone 'What's up?' or if you tell them what's up, you are asking them or telling them what is wrong or what is worrying them.

ext.ext_cn: 他不停地上蹿下跳，活像个足球赛中的男孩。
ext.ext_en: He continued to jump up and down like a boy at a football match...

ext.ext_cn: 我踱来踱去仔细思量后叫了一辆出租车。
ext.ext_en: I strolled up and down thoughtfully before calling a taxi...

defs.def_en: If you move up and down somewhere, you move there repeatedly in one direction and then in the opposite direction.

ext.ext_cn: 每一段感情都有许多起伏。
ext.ext_en: Every relationship has a lot of ups and downs...

ext.ext_cn: 该机构经历过兴衰沉浮。
ext.ext_en: The organisation has had its ups and downs.

defs.def_en: If you have ups and downs, you experience a mixture of good things and bad things.

ext.ext_cn: 他们称经济正在企稳向好。
ext.ext_en: They're saying that the economy is on the up...

ext.ext_cn: 对音乐而言，那是一个大好年头，人们有钱，有机会，有希望——一派欣欣向荣的景象。
ext.ext_en: It was a great year for music, people had money, opportunities, hope—things were on the up and up.

defs.def_en: If something is on the up or on the up and up, it is becoming more successful.

ext.ext_cn: 我看人很准的。你要是诚实正派，我能看出来的。
ext.ext_en: I'm a pretty good judge of men. If you're honest and on the up and up, I'll be able to tell it.

defs.def_en: If someone is on the up and up, they are honest and sincere.

ext.ext_cn: 身体状况允许的病人可去隔壁的游泳池。
ext.ext_en: Those patients who were up to it could move to the adjacent pool...

ext.ext_cn: 他一点都拿不准萨拉能否胜任。
ext.ext_en: He wasn't at all sure Sarah was up to that...

defs.def_en: If you feel up to doing something, you are well enough to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 除非你要搞什么小动作，不然你为什么单要一间房？
ext.ext_en: Why did you need a room unless you were up to something?...

ext.ext_cn: 他们一定已经知道了父亲要搞什么。
ext.ext_en: They must have known what their father was up to...

defs.def_en: To be up to something means to be secretly doing something that you should not be doing.

ext.ext_cn: 由他负责把事情摆平，不管花多长时间。
ext.ext_en: It was up to him to make it right, no matter how long it took...

ext.ext_cn: 我相信要是换成我，我一定能找到他。
ext.ext_en: I'm sure I'd have spotted him if it had been up to me...

defs.def_en: If you say that it is up to someone to do something, you mean that it is their responsibility to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 晚上9点半之前任何时间你都可以给我打电话。
ext.ext_en: Please feel free to call me any time up until half past nine at night...

ext.ext_cn: 一直到1989年，人均收入每年平均增长1％。
ext.ext_en: Up to 1989, the growth of per capita income averaged 1 per cent per year.

defs.def_en: Up until or up to are used to indicate the latest time at which something can happen, or the end of the period of time that you are referring to.

ext.ext_en: Up to twenty thousand students paid between five and six thousand dollars...

ext.ext_cn: 这一过程可能要两年时间才能完成。
ext.ext_en: It could be up to two years before the process is complete.

defs.def_en: You use up to to say how large something can be or what level it has reached.

ext.ext_cn: 我做的蛋奶酥拿不出手。
ext.ext_en: My own souffles aren't up to much...

ext.ext_cn: 这企业不怎么样。
ext.ext_en: This business isn't up to much.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not up to much, you mean that it is of poor quality.

ext.ext_cn: 参议院三分之一的席位和众议院所有席位都面临改选。
ext.ext_en: A third of the Senate and the entire House are up for re-election.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is up for election, review, or discussion, they are about to be considered.

ext.ext_cn: 女主席正面临职位上的最大挑战。
ext.ext_en: The chairwoman is up against the greatest challenge to her position...

ext.ext_cn: 他们虽然遇到劲旅，但却表现出色。
ext.ext_en: They were up against a good team but did very well.

defs.def_en: If you are up against something, you have a very difficult situation or problem to deal with.

ext.ext_cn: 他提高了给该公司的报价。
ext.ext_en: He upped his offer for the company...

ext.ext_cn: 药店销量增加了63％。
ext.ext_en: Chemist stores upped sales by 63 percent...

defs.def_en: If you up something such as the amount of money you are offering for something, you increase it.

ext.ext_cn: 几个月来不断暗示爱意、想发展长期恋爱关系的男人却突然远走美国。
ext.ext_en: A man who for months had been dropping amorous hints about a long-term relationship upped and disappeared to America...

ext.ext_cn: 有一天他突然就离开了。
ext.ext_en: One day he just upped and left.
