ext.ext_en: The book is both inaccurate and exaggerated...

ext.ext_cn: 这些报告所依据的是不准确的信息。
ext.ext_en: The reports were based on inaccurate information.

defs.def_en: If a statement or measurement is inaccurate, it is not accurate or correct.

defs.def_cn: (善于公关、为政党出谋划策的)媒体顾问，舆论导向专家
defs.def_en: In politics, a spin doctor is someone who is skilled in public relations and who advises political parties on how to present their policies and actions.

ext.ext_cn: 冷冻不失为一种保存食物的好方法。
ext.ext_en: Freezing isn't a bad way of preserving food...

ext.ext_cn: 另一种交友的办法就是去上夜校。
ext.ext_en: Another way of making new friends is to go to an evening class...

defs.def_en: If you refer to a way of doing something, you are referring to how you can do it, for example the action you can take or the method you can use to achieve it.

ext.ext_cn: 她友好地笑了笑。
ext.ext_en: She smiled in a friendly way...

ext.ext_cn: 他说话的方式怪怪的。
ext.ext_en: He had a strange way of talking...

defs.def_en: If you talk about the way someone does something, you are talking about the qualities their action has.

ext.ext_cn: 电子订票系统通过多种方式帮助航空公司获利。
ext.ext_en: Computerized reservation systems help airline profits in several ways...

ext.ext_cn: 她感到从未有过的害怕。
ext.ext_en: She was afraid in a way that was quite new to her...

defs.def_en: If a general statement or description is true in a particular way, this is the form of it that is true in a particular case.

ext.ext_cn: 从某些方面来说，正式的开幕仪式只不过是走个形式。
ext.ext_en: In some ways, the official opening is a formality...

ext.ext_cn: 她形容她的爱人“各方面完美至极”。
ext.ext_en: She described her lover as 'perfect in every way'.

defs.def_en: You use way in expressions such as in some ways ,in many ways, and in every way to indicate the degree or extent to which a statement is true.

ext.ext_cn: 他指责那些督促他改变习惯的人。
ext.ext_en: He denounces people who urge him to alter his ways...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为你们在康沃尔呆的太久了，已经忘记了城市的生活方式。
ext.ext_en: I think you've been too long in Cornwall. You've forgotten the ways of the city...

defs.def_en: The ways of a particular person or group of people are their customs or their usual behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 如今她离了婚。一贯足智多谋的她已开始自己创业。
ext.ext_en: She is now divorced and, in her usual resourceful way, has started her own business...

ext.ext_cn: 正面冲突不是他的风格。
ext.ext_en: Direct confrontation was not his way.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's way, you are referring to their usual or preferred type of behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 我想那是其中的一种看法。
ext.ext_en: I suppose that's one way of looking at it...

ext.ext_cn: 但是，迪伦的大多数歌词都有其他的解读方式。
ext.ext_en: With most of Dylan's lyrics, however, there are other ways of interpreting the words...

defs.def_en: You use way to refer to one particular opinion or interpretation of something, when others are possible.

defs.def_cn: 可能的后果;可能作出的决定

ext.ext_cn: 没有迹象表明投票结果会怎样。
ext.ext_en: There is no indication which way the vote could go...

ext.ext_cn: 两种结果法官怎样判都有可能。
ext.ext_en: The judge could have decided either way.

defs.def_en: You use way when mentioning one of a number of possible, alternative results or decisions.

ext.ext_cn: 我非常抱歉——没有想到你是那样想的。
ext.ext_en: I'm terribly sorry — I had no idea you felt that way.

defs.def_en: The way you feel about something is your attitude to it or your opinion about it.

ext.ext_cn: 我讨厌他摆布别人。
ext.ext_en: I hate the way he manipulates people...

ext.ext_cn: 你或许还记得，每一场的结尾要么是某人作沉思状，要么是某人故作深沉。
ext.ext_en: You may remember the way each scene ended with someone looking pensive or significant.

defs.def_en: If you mention the way that something happens, you are mentioning the fact that it happens.

ext.ext_cn: 她挤进了人群。
ext.ext_en: She thrust her way into the crowd...

ext.ext_cn: 他以为我们是想通过贿赂进入他的公司。
ext.ext_en: He thought we were trying to buy our way into his company...

defs.def_en: You use way in expressions such as push your way ,work your way, or eat your way, followed by a prepositional phrase or adverb, in order to indicate movement, progress, or force as well as the action described by the verb.

ext.ext_cn: 有谁知道洗手间在哪里吗？
ext.ext_en: Does anybody know the way to the bathroom?...

ext.ext_cn: 我恐怕不记得路了。
ext.ext_en: I'm afraid I can't remember the way...

defs.def_en: The way somewhere consists of the different places that you go through or the route that you take in order to get there.

ext.ext_cn: 他大步走进厨房，与迎面而来的爸爸擦身而过。
ext.ext_en: As he strode into the kitchen, he passed Pop coming the other way...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在楼梯顶部停住了，不知道接下来该往哪边走。
ext.ext_en: They paused at the top of the stairs, doubtful as to which way to go next...

defs.def_en: If you go or look a particular way, you go or look in that direction.

ext.ext_cn: 就在他走的路上不远处。
ext.ext_en: It's not very far out of his way...

ext.ext_cn: 她会说和我同路，可以载我一程。
ext.ext_en: She would say she was going my way and offer me a lift.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the direction you are travelling in as your way .

ext.ext_cn: 那些人在沙尘暴中迷了路，不小心穿越了边境。
ext.ext_en: The men lost their way in a sandstorm and crossed the border by mistake...

ext.ext_cn: 许多老的街道名都被改了，人们再也找不到原来的路了。
ext.ext_en: They've changed a lot of the old street names, and people can't find their way anymore.

defs.def_en: If you lose your way, you take a wrong or unfamiliar route, so that you do not know how to get to the place that you want to go to. If you find your way, you manage to get to the place that you want to go to.

ext.ext_cn: 直到大家各奔东西，我才开始学着自力更生。
ext.ext_en: It wasn't until we each went our separate ways that I began to learn how to do things for myself...

ext.ext_cn: 你走你的阳关道，我过我的独木桥。
ext.ext_en: You go your way and I'll go mine.

defs.def_en: You talk about people going their different ways in order to say that their lives develop differently and they have less contact with each other.

ext.ext_cn: 把握住这几个月之内你可能获得的机会。
ext.ext_en: Take advantage of the opportunities coming your way in a couple of months...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我碰上你可能感兴趣的东西，我就给你寄过去。
ext.ext_en: If I run into anything that might interest you, I'll send it your way.

defs.def_en: If something comes your way, you get it or receive it.

ext.ext_cn: “你挡着道了，”她说，“麻烦你让一下。”
ext.ext_en: 'You're standing in the way,' she said. 'Would you mind moving aside'...

ext.ext_cn: 滚开！
ext.ext_en: Get out of my way!

defs.def_en: If someone or something is in the way, they prevent you from moving forward or seeing clearly.

ext.ext_cn: 锡尔弗敦路，是这条路么？
ext.ext_en: Silvertown Way, was that the road?

ext.ext_cn: 长250英里、人来人往的奔宁路
ext.ext_en: ...the well-trodden 250-mile Pennine Way.

defs.def_en: Way is used in the names of some roads, and also in the names of some long paths for walkers in the countryside.

defs.def_cn: （某人居住地的）周边；特定的地区

ext.ext_cn: 如果你在我们这里说标准英语，大家就会对你产生怀疑。
ext.ext_en: If you speak standard English anywhere round our way, people tend to view you with suspicion.

ext.ext_cn: 从纽卡斯尔那边来的人
ext.ext_en: ...somebody from Newcastle way.

defs.def_en: You can use way to refer to the area near where someone lives or near a specified place.

ext.ext_cn: 一些观众把旗子拿倒了。
ext.ext_en: The flag was held the wrong way up by some spectators...

ext.ext_cn: 将它安到正确位置上很重要。
ext.ext_en: It's important to fit it the right way round.

defs.def_en: You use way in expressions such as the right way up and the other way around to refer to one of two or more possible positions or arrangements that something can have.

ext.ext_cn: 从这里往西远远的山谷中是弗赖堡镇。
ext.ext_en: Way down in the valley to the west is the town of Freiburg...

ext.ext_cn: 这些考试成绩远高于平均水平。
ext.ext_en: These exam results are way above average...

defs.def_en: You can use way to emphasize, for example, that something is a great distance away or is very much below or above a particular level or amount.

ext.ext_cn: 这一地区被希腊、塞尔维亚和保加利亚分成了3部分。
ext.ext_en: The region was split three ways, between Greece, Serbia and Bulgaria...

ext.ext_cn: 即使把价钱平摊成6份，每人也还是要花一大笔钱。
ext.ext_en: Splitting the price six ways had still cost them each a bundle.

defs.def_en: If you split something a number of ways, you divide it into a number of different parts or quantities, usually fairly equal in size.

ext.ext_cn: 他们中有些人住的地方离这里很远。
ext.ext_en: Some of them live in places quite a long way from here...

ext.ext_cn: 顺着巷子再走过去一点，我们经过车道来到一幢房子前。
ext.ext_en: A little way further down the lane we passed the driveway to a house...

defs.def_en: Way is used in expressions such as a long way ,a little way, and quite a way, to say how far away something is or how far you have travelled.

ext.ext_cn: 离成功还远着呢。
ext.ext_en: Success is still a long way off...

ext.ext_cn: 离8月还早着呢。
ext.ext_en: August is still an awfully long way away.

defs.def_en: Way is used in expressions such as a long way ,a little way, and quite a way, to say how far away in time something is.

defs.def_cn: (表示动作完成的程度)全部/多半/一半

ext.ext_cn: 他已经快把螺丝帽拧下来了。
ext.ext_en: He had unscrewed the caps most of the way...

ext.ext_cn: 你上一次完整地听完一张专辑是什么时候？
ext.ext_en: When was the last time you listened to an album all the way through?

defs.def_en: You use way in expressions such as all the way ,most of the way and half the way to refer to the extent to which an action has been completed.

ext.ext_cn: 街对面那座带三角屋顶的大房子
ext.ext_en: ...the big gabled house across the way.

defs.def_en: If something is across the way, it is nearby on the opposite side of a road or area.

ext.ext_cn: 他不得不一路步行回家。
ext.ext_en: He had to walk all the way home...

ext.ext_cn: 那条裙子是大老远从纽约送来的。
ext.ext_en: That dress came all the way from New York.

defs.def_en: You use all the way to emphasize how long a distance is.

ext.ext_cn: 既然已经发动了革命，我们就一定要进行到底。
ext.ext_en: Having started a revolution we must go all the way...

ext.ext_cn: 我自始至终都会支持他。
ext.ext_en: I'll support him all the way.

defs.def_en: You can use all the way to emphasize that your remark applies to every part of a situation, activity, or period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 就像通常的这种集会一样，宣言内容在代表团到达之前就差不多拟好了。
ext.ext_en: As is the way with these gatherings, the declarations were largely drafted before the delegations arrived.

defs.def_en: You can use as is the way to say that a particular situation or example of behaviour is typical and you would not expect it to be different.

ext.ext_cn: 他病得很重，但还能说话。
ext.ext_en: He's in a bad way, but able to talk.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in a bad way, you mean that they are very ill or unhealthy.

ext.ext_cn: 几周后上台的那个人也帮助她把事业推进了一大步。
ext.ext_en: The man who took over a few weeks later has also helped further her career in a big way...

ext.ext_cn: 足球在美国从来就没获得过大发展。
ext.ext_en: Soccer in the States has never taken off in a big way.

defs.def_en: If you say that something exists, happens, or develops in a big way, you are emphasizing its great extent or importance.

ext.ext_cn: 各国不可能两全其美：环境更清洁的代价有时可能就是污染企业就业岗位的减少。
ext.ext_en: Countries cannot have it both ways: the cost of a cleaner environment may sometimes be fewer jobs in dirty industries...

ext.ext_cn: 你决定吧，反正鱼与熊掌不可兼得。
ext.ext_en: Make up your mind, you can't have it both ways.

defs.def_en: If someone says that you can't have it both ways, they are telling you that you have to choose between two things and cannot do or have them both.

ext.ext_cn: 顺便说一句，Latifah 这个名字意思是“娇嫩”。
ext.ext_en: The name Latifah, by the way, means 'delicate'...

ext.ext_cn: 对了，你的研讨会进行得怎样？
ext.ext_en: By the way, how did your seminar go?

defs.def_en: You say by the way when you add something to what you are saying, especially something that you have just thought of.

ext.ext_cn: 相比而言，曼联队的行程将略多于1,200英里。
ext.ext_en: By way of contrast, Manchester United will travel slightly more than 1,200 miles...

ext.ext_cn: “在那种事儿上我会很迷信，”她解释道。
ext.ext_en: 'I get very superstitious about things like that,' she said by way of explanation.

defs.def_en: You use by way of when you are explaining the purpose of something that you have said or are about to say. For example, if you say something by way of an introduction, you say it as an introduction.

ext.ext_cn: 我采用传统授课与实践和指导相结合的方式教授心理学。
ext.ext_en: I teach psychology by way of a range of traditional lectures, practicals and tutorials.

defs.def_en: If you do something by way of a particular method, you use that method to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这条通道经隧道从河下经过。
ext.ext_en: The path goes under the river by way of the tunnel.

defs.def_en: If you go somewhere by way of a particular place, you go through that place in order to get to where you want.

ext.ext_cn: 怎样才能激励这些罪犯洗心革面呢？
ext.ext_en: What can be done to encourage convicted offenders to change their ways?

defs.def_en: If someone changes their ways or mends their ways, they permanently improve their behaviour or their way of doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 会谈旨在为新宪法的正式商讨扫清道路。
ext.ext_en: The talks are meant to clear the way for formal negotiations on a new constitution...

ext.ext_cn: 这项判决可能会为其他孩子起诉他们的父母开辟一条通道。
ext.ext_en: The decision could open the way for other children to sue their parents.

defs.def_en: If you clear the way ,open the way, or prepare the way for something, you create an opportunity for it to happen.

defs.def_cn: (采取)最容易的办法，最省事的做法(以回避困难或尴尬处境)

ext.ext_cn: 事情刚变得有点棘手他就急忙脱身。
ext.ext_en: As soon as things got difficult he took the easy way out...

ext.ext_cn: 把我们的失败归罪到别人头上倒是省事。
ext.ext_en: It is the easy way out to blame others for our failure.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone takes the easy way out, you disapprove of them because they do what is easiest for them in a difficult situation, rather than dealing with it properly.

defs.def_cn: (两种情况中)不论发生哪一种情况

ext.ext_cn: 可能会出现海平面上升或陆地下沉:不论发生哪种情况，沙丘都会在短时间内消失。
ext.ext_en: The sea may rise or the land may fall; either way the sand dunes will be gone in a short time.

defs.def_en: You use either way in order to introduce a statement which is true in each of the two possible or alternative cases that you have just mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 真的相信无政府主义才是未来出路的人
ext.ext_en: ...people who genuinely believe that anarchy is the way forward...

ext.ext_cn: 培养年轻球员应该是所有俱乐部谋求发展之道。
ext.ext_en: Young players have got to be the way forward for every club.

defs.def_en: If you say that a particular type of action or development is the way forward, you approve of it because it is likely to lead to success.

defs.def_cn: 想怎样就怎样;随心所欲

ext.ext_cn: 她非常善于利用自己的魅力随心所欲。
ext.ext_en: She is very good at using her charm to get her way.

defs.def_en: If someone gets their way or has their way, nobody stops them doing what they want to do. You can also say that someone gets their own way or has their own way .

ext.ext_cn: 起初他只是麻木，接着转为了愤怒。
ext.ext_en: First he had been numb. Then the numbness gave way to anger...

ext.ext_cn: 最后一批房子也被拆掉用作了大豆地。
ext.ext_en: The last houses give way to soybean fields.

defs.def_en: If one thing gives way to another, the first thing is replaced by the second.

ext.ext_cn: 天花板上的钩子断了，灯落下来砸到桌子上燃起了火。
ext.ext_en: The hook in the ceiling had given way and the lamp had fallen blazing on to the table.

defs.def_en: If an object that is supporting something gives way, it breaks or collapses, so that it can no longer support that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 总统似乎已迫于强硬派的压力而妥协了。
ext.ext_en: It seems the President has given way to pressure from the hardliners...

ext.ext_cn: 他最终还是没能抑制住冲动，把她拉向了自己。
ext.ext_en: He finally gave way to an impulse and pulled her toward him.

defs.def_en: If you give way to someone or something that you have been resisting, you stop resisting and allow yourself to be persuaded or controlled by them.

defs.def_cn: 让路;让其他人(或车辆)先行

ext.ext_cn: 让从左边来的车先行。
ext.ext_en: Give way to traffic coming from the left.

defs.def_en: If a moving person, a vehicle, or its driver gives way, they slow down or stop in order to allow other people or vehicles to pass in front of them.

ext.ext_cn: 老板总喜欢把这类事情搞清楚。
ext.ext_en: Bosses have a way of always finding out about such things.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has a way of doing a particular thing, you mean that they often do it.

defs.def_cn: 善于与(某人或某事物)打交道

ext.ext_cn: 康斯坦丝没有你这么健谈。
ext.ext_en: Constance doesn't have a way with words like you do...

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎天生就善于和外国人交往。
ext.ext_en: He seems to have had a way with foreigners.

defs.def_en: If you say hat a person has a way with something or someone, you mean that that person seems to have a natural skill or instinct for dealing with them.

ext.ext_cn: 那好吧，随你的便。就那样吧。
ext.ext_en: All right then, have it your way. Be like that.

defs.def_en: If you say have it your way or have it your own way, you are telling someone in an annoyed way that you will agree with or accept their suggestion even though you do not think they are right.

ext.ext_cn: 我绝对不会采纳他的任何方法。
ext.ext_en: In no way am I going to adopt any of his methods...

ext.ext_cn: 一位发言人坚称这两起事件“绝无关联”。
ext.ext_en: A spokesman insisted the two events were 'in no way related'...

defs.def_en: You use in no way or not in any way to emphasize that a statement is not at all true.

defs.def_cn: (用于缓和语气)在某种程度上，在某些方面

ext.ext_cn: 我想我有点惧怕失败。
ext.ext_en: In a way, I suppose I'm frightened of failing...

ext.ext_cn: 这把事情弄得有点不大愉快。
ext.ext_en: It made things very unpleasant in a way.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is true in a way, you mean that although it is not completely true, it is true to a limited extent or in certain respects. You use in a way to reduce the force of a statement.

ext.ext_cn: 上周开始的小规模的反腐示威游行
ext.ext_en: ...demonstrations against corruption, which began in a small way last week...

ext.ext_cn: 这样做你就会为获胜贡献一份小小的力量。
ext.ext_en: By doing this you will, in a small way, help win the victory.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something in a small way, you mean that although they do not do very much, their actions are useful or important.

ext.ext_cn: “我们不会妨碍你的，”苏珊娜保证道，“我们就在角落里安安静静地站着。”
ext.ext_en: 'We wouldn't get in the way,' Suzanne promised. 'We'd just stand quietly in a corner.'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone gets in the way or is in the way, you are annoyed because their presence or their actions stop you doing something properly.

ext.ext_cn: 她有一份从来不会影响她的业余爱好的工作。
ext.ext_en: She had a job which never got in the way of her leisure interests.

defs.def_en: To get in the way of something means to make it difficult for it to happen, continue, or be appreciated properly.

ext.ext_cn: 他通晓错综复杂的欧洲律法。
ext.ext_en: He knows his way around the intricate maze of European law...

ext.ext_cn: 他比大多数部长都更熟悉这套体系。
ext.ext_en: He knows his way about the system better than do most ministers.

defs.def_en: If you know your way around a particular subject, system, or job, or if you know your way about it, you know all the procedures and facts about it.

defs.def_cn: 赚钱容易；轻轻松松赚大钱

ext.ext_cn: 与电视台签订的这项大合同会让富有的英格兰足球俱乐部财源滚滚。
ext.ext_en: The lucrative contract with television means that England's wealthy football clubs will now be laughing all the way to the bank.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is laughing all the way to the bank, you mean that they are making a lot of money very easily.

ext.ext_cn: 她拿过他的箱子在前面带路。
ext.ext_en: She grabbed his suitcase and led the way.

defs.def_en: If you lead the way along a particular route, you go along it in front of someone in order to show them where to go.

ext.ext_cn: 索尼公司在缩小CD播放机的体积方面也处于领先地位。
ext.ext_en: Sony has also led the way in shrinking the size of compact-disc players.

defs.def_en: If a person or group leads the way in a particular activity, they are the first person or group to do it or they make the most new developments in it.

defs.def_cn: 取得巨大进展;取得很多成就

ext.ext_cn: 那种一天只吃得起一顿饭的日子已经离他很遥远了。
ext.ext_en: He has come a long way since the days he could only afford one meal a day.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has come a long way, you mean that they have developed, progressed, or become very successful.

ext.ext_cn: 这绝对是我参加过的最差劲的会议。
ext.ext_en: It was, by a long way, the worst meeting I have ever attended...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的最爱绝对是超市的自产品牌。
ext.ext_en: Our favourite by a long way was the supermarkets' own brand.

defs.def_en: You can use by a long way to emphasize that something is, for example, much better, worse, or bigger than any other thing of that kind.

ext.ext_cn: 比起英国首富，她还差得远呢。
ext.ext_en: She is a long way from being the richest person in Britain...

ext.ext_cn: 这与事实相差甚远。
ext.ext_en: That's a long way from the truth.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a long way from being true, you are emphasizing that it is definitely not true.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然并不能根治，但它对减轻病人的痛苦大有帮助。
ext.ext_en: Although by no means a cure, it goes a long way towards making the patient's life more tolerable.

defs.def_en: If you say that something goes a long way towards doing a particular thing, you mean that it is an important factor in achieving that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 为什么白宫在税收和预算政策问题上束手无策呢？
ext.ext_en: Why has the White House lost its way on tax and budget policy?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has lost their way, you are criticizing them because they do not have any good ideas any more, or seem to have become unsure about what to do.

ext.ext_cn: 他按照指示去了市场。
ext.ext_en: He made his way to the marketplace, as he had been instructed to do...

ext.ext_cn: 他终于到家了。
ext.ext_en: He made his way home at last.

defs.def_en: When you make your way somewhere, you walk or travel there.

ext.ext_cn: 他说他已准备好让位于党内的年轻一代。
ext.ext_en: He said he was prepared to make way for younger people in the party...

ext.ext_cn: 建这幢新大楼将不得不推倒一些房子。
ext.ext_en: A number of houses would have to be demolished to make way for the new building.

defs.def_en: If one person or thing makes way for another, the first is replaced by the second.

ext.ext_cn: 我们绝对不可能把它找回来。
ext.ext_en: There was absolutely no way that we were going to be able to retrieve it.

defs.def_en: If you say there's no way that something will happen, you are emphasizing that you think it will definitely not happen.

ext.ext_cn: 迈克，我是决不会和你玩牌赌钱的。
ext.ext_en: Mike, no way am I playing cards with you for money...

ext.ext_cn: 那不是杰克·休伊特想要的生活，绝对不是！
ext.ext_en: That was not the life Jack Hewitt planned to live. No way!

defs.def_en: You can say no way as an emphatic way of saying no.

ext.ext_cn: 拉脱维亚并不是一个自然资源丰富的国家。
ext.ext_en: Latvia is a country without much in the way of natural resources...

ext.ext_cn: 今天举行的会议没有达成什么协议。
ext.ext_en: Meetings held today produced little in the way of an agreement...

defs.def_en: You use in the way of or by way of in order to specify the kind of thing you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 他已获准离境，正在去往英国的路上。
ext.ext_en: He has been allowed to leave the country and is on his way to Britain...

ext.ext_cn: 明天天亮前我们就将赶路。
ext.ext_en: By sunrise tomorrow we'll be on our way.

defs.def_en: If you are on your way, you have started your journey somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 她提起包继续赶路。
ext.ext_en: She picked up her bag, and went on her way.

defs.def_en: If you go on your way, you continue with your journey.

ext.ext_cn: 在这个过程中你可能还得新学几招。
ext.ext_en: You may have to learn a few new skills along the way.

defs.def_en: If something happens on the way or along the way, it happens during the course of a particular event or process.

ext.ext_cn: 我现在已经出院，快康复了。
ext.ext_en: I am now out of hospital and well on the way to recovery.

defs.def_en: If you are on your way or well on your way to something, you have made so much progress that you are almost certain to achieve that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 天气预报员说不久还将有降雪。
ext.ext_en: The forecasters say more snow is on the way...

ext.ext_cn: 她已经结婚，有一对双胞胎儿子，第三个宝宝也即将出世。
ext.ext_en: She is married with twin sons and a third child on the way.

defs.def_en: If something is on the way, it will arrive soon.

defs.def_cn: (表示某事一定发生)无论如何，不管怎样

ext.ext_cn: 那些在战争时期以各种方式进入德国的人
ext.ext_en: ...those who had entered Germany one way or another during the war...

ext.ext_cn: 无论如何，这里的每个人你肯定都很了解。
ext.ext_en: You know pretty well everyone here, one way or the other.

defs.def_en: You can use one way or another or one way or the other when you want to say that something definitely happens, but without giving any details about how it happens.

defs.def_cn: (指之前提到的两个可能的决定或结论)无论哪个

ext.ext_cn: 不是这样就是那样，我们无论如何都得作出决定了。
ext.ext_en: We've got to make our decision one way or the other...

ext.ext_cn: 管它怎样，我真的不在乎。
ext.ext_en: I didn't really care one way or another.

defs.def_en: You use one way or the other or one way or another to refer to two possible decisions or conclusions that have previously been mentioned, without stating which one is reached or preferred.

defs.def_cn: 不止一种意义;不单是这样

ext.ext_cn: 这些地方选举从许多方面来说都是一个转折点。
ext.ext_en: These local elections may prove a turning point in more ways than one.

defs.def_en: You say in more ways than one to indicate that what you have said is intended to have more than one meaning.

ext.ext_cn: 应该是你帮了我，而不是我帮了你。
ext.ext_en: You'd think you were the one who did me the favor, and not the other way around.

defs.def_en: You use the other way around or the other way round to refer to the opposite of what you have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 有令人欣慰的迹象表明冷战思维即将成为历史。
ext.ext_en: There are encouraging signs that cold war attitudes are on the way out...

ext.ext_cn: 周末购物的禁令可能会在圣诞节前被取消。
ext.ext_en: The ban on Sunday shopping could be on its way out before Christmas...

defs.def_en: If something or someone is on the way out or on their way out, they are likely to disappear or to be replaced very soon.

defs.def_cn: 特地;不怕麻烦;格外努力

ext.ext_cn: 他对我非常友善，似乎是特意帮我的忙。
ext.ext_en: He was very kind to me and seemed to go out of his way to help me.

defs.def_en: If you go out of your way to do something, for example to help someone, you make a special effort to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我一直尽量躲着他。
ext.ext_en: I'd kept out of his way as much as I could...

ext.ext_cn: 他警告军队不要介入救援工作。
ext.ext_en: He warned the army to stay out of the way of the relief effort.

defs.def_en: If you keep out of someone's way or stay out of their way, you avoid them or do not get involved with them.

defs.def_cn: 结束;被处理好;得到解决

ext.ext_cn: 此项计划至少在地方选举结束之前都得保密。
ext.ext_en: The plan has to remain confidential at least until the local elections are out of the way...

ext.ext_cn: 如果当时能早点结束就更好了。
ext.ext_en: It would have been better to have got it out of the way earlier.

defs.def_en: When something is out of the way, it has finished or you have dealt with it, so that it is no longer a problem or needs no more time spent on it.

ext.ext_cn: 在学校里我独来独往，我行我素。
ext.ext_en: In school I was a loner. I went my own way.

defs.def_en: If you go your own way, you do what you want rather than what everyone else does or expects.

ext.ext_cn: 杰出的飞机设计师没有理由一定也是个出色的飞行员。同样，一个优秀的飞行员或许会是个糟糕的司机。
ext.ext_en: There is no reason why a gifted aircraft designer should also be a capable pilot. In the same way, a brilliant pilot can be a menace behind the wheel of a car.

defs.def_en: You use in the same way to introduce a situation that you are comparing with one that you have just mentioned, because there is a strong similarity between them.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经积习成性，不肯作任何真正的改变。
ext.ext_en: He was too set in his ways to make any real changes.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is set in their ways, you mean that they have been behaving in the same way for many years and do not want to change.

defs.def_cn: （用于指刚才说过的话）那样，这样

ext.ext_cn: 我们中的一些人有些不为人知的习惯，我们也不想改变这一状况。
ext.ext_en: Some of us have habits few people know about and we keep it this way...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的城市很美丽，但愿它能保持下去。
ext.ext_en: We have a beautiful city and we pray it stays that way...

defs.def_en: You can use that way and this way to refer to a statement or comment that you have just made.

ext.ext_cn: 保持土壤湿润，那样幼苗就能茁壮成长。
ext.ext_en: Keep the soil moist. That way, the seedling will flourish...

ext.ext_cn: 我知道把我留下来看孩子很不公平，但这样至少我知道孩子受到了很好的看护。
ext.ext_en: I know it's unfair that I am left holding the baby; but at least this way I know that she's being well looked after.

defs.def_en: You can use that way or this way to refer to an action or situation that you have just mentioned, when you go on to mention the likely consequence or effect of it.

defs.def_cn: 从目前事情发展的情况看

ext.ext_cn: 现在看来他是不会来了。
ext.ext_en: The way things are going, perhaps he won't come at all.

defs.def_en: You can use the way things are going to indicate that you expect something to happen because of the way the present situation is developing.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得，事情好像没必要这么复杂。
ext.ext_en: To my way of thinking, it didn't seem as if it ought to be so terribly complicated.

defs.def_en: You add to my way of thinking to a statement in order to indicate that you are giving your opinion.

ext.ext_cn: 你若留在这里，必死无疑。
ext.ext_en: You stay here, you die. No two ways about it.

defs.def_en: If you say that there are no two ways about it, you are emphasizing that there is no doubt at all about a particular situation or about how it should be interpreted.

ext.ext_cn: 一项全面的安全行动正在进行中…
ext.ext_en: A full-scale security operation is now under way...

ext.ext_cn: 这个案子从去年秋天起开始审理。
ext.ext_en: The court case got under way last autumn.

defs.def_en: If an activity or plan is under way, it has begun and is now taking place.

defs.def_cn: 以各种方式；采用各种方式

ext.ext_cn: 他用尽所有可能的方法重复做这个实验。
ext.ext_en: He re-ran the experiment every which way he could...

ext.ext_cn: 只要存货能脱手，无论采取什么方式他们都愿意。
ext.ext_en: They are just happy to sell their inventory any which way they can.

defs.def_en: Every which way and any which way are used to emphasize that something happens, or might happen, in a lot of different ways, or using a lot of different methods.

defs.def_cn: (强调位置和方向的混乱)向四面八方，杂乱地

ext.ext_cn: 横七竖八停着的车辆
ext.ext_en: ...cars parked every which way.

defs.def_en: Every which way is used to emphasize that things move in a lot of different directions or are arranged in a lot of different positions.

defs.def_cn: (尤指运载乘客和货物的)大型帆船

ext.ext_cn: 美国快速帆船是顶级的大型帆船。
ext.ext_en: American clippers were the ultimate sailing ships.

defs.def_en: A sailing ship is a large ship with sails, especially of the kind that were used to carry passengers or cargo.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可感知的；易察觉的；明显的

ext.ext_cn: 埃米和吉姆之间明显关系紧张。
ext.ext_en: The tension between Amy and Jim is palpable...

ext.ext_cn: 几乎明显有种无望的感觉。
ext.ext_en: There is an almost palpable feeling of hopelessness.

defs.def_en: You describe something as palpable when it is obvious or intense and easily noticed.

ext.ext_cn: 男人们跳舞，女人们拍手。
ext.ext_en: The men danced and the women clapped...

ext.ext_cn: 米奇拍手示意他们安静下来。
ext.ext_en: Midge clapped her hands, calling them back to order...

defs.def_en: When  you clap, you hit your hands together to show appreciation or attract attention.

ext.ext_cn: 我用一只手迅速地捂住她的嘴。
ext.ext_en: I clapped a hand over her mouth.

defs.def_en: If you clap your hand or an object onto something, you put it there quickly and firmly.

ext.ext_cn: 奥纳西斯可能会拍拍朋友的后背，可尼亚尔霍斯却会公事公办地伸出手来。
ext.ext_en: While Onassis might clap a friend on the back, Niarchos would extend a businesslike hand.

defs.def_en: If you clap someone on the back or on the shoulder, you hit their back or shoulder with your hand in a friendly way.
A clap of thunder is a sudden and loud noise of thunder.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们不立刻把粮食卸下来，它们就会在筒仓里开始腐烂。
ext.ext_en: If we don't unload it soon, the grain will start rotting in the silos...

ext.ext_cn: 罐装的甜饮料会腐蚀牙齿。
ext.ext_en: Sugary canned drinks rot your teeth.

defs.def_en: When food, wood, or another substance rots, or when something rots it, it becomes softer and is gradually destroyed.

defs.def_cn: （尤指木制品的）腐烂，腐败，腐朽

ext.ext_cn: 调查发现一层地下的横梁大面积腐烂。
ext.ext_en: Investigations had revealed extensive rot in the beams under the ground floor...

ext.ext_cn: 木构架和金属底盘都没有采取防腐措施。
ext.ext_en: Neither the timber frame nor metal chassis were protected against rot.

defs.def_en: If there is rot in something, especially something that is made of wood, parts of it have decayed and fallen apart.

ext.ext_cn: 很多学校的情况正开始变得越来越糟，教学水平一路下滑。
ext.ext_en: In many schools, the rot is beginning to set in. Standards are falling all the time...

ext.ext_cn: 该国领导人不愿采取不受欢迎的措施来阻止形势恶化。
ext.ext_en: The country's leaders are unwilling to take unpopular measures to stop the rot.

defs.def_en: You can use the rot to refer to the way something gradually gets worse. For example, if you are talking about the time when the rot set in, you are talking about the time when a situation began to get steadily worse and worse.

defs.def_cn: (尤指人在狱中)身心状况越来越糟，萎靡不振，颓废下去

ext.ext_cn: 大多数政府就让那些长期失业的人领着救济金颓废度日。
ext.ext_en: Most governments simply leave the long-term jobless to rot on the dole.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is being left to rot in a particular place, especially in a prison, you mean that they are being left there and their physical and mental condition is being allowed to get worse and worse.

ext.ext_cn: 真是自命不凡的伪知识分子的一派胡言！
ext.ext_en: What a load of pompous, pseudo-intellectual rot...

ext.ext_cn: 你胡扯！
ext.ext_en: You do talk rot!

defs.def_en: If you say that what someone is saying is rot, you mean that they are saying things that are untrue or stupid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 矫揉造作的;忸怩作态的

ext.ext_cn: 麦考利·卡尔金的银幕初吻来自于忸怩作态的11岁童星安娜·克鲁姆斯基。
ext.ext_en: Macaulay Culkin receives his first screen kiss from cutesy 11-year-old Anna Chlumsky.

ext.ext_cn: 矫饰的猫头鹰画像
ext.ext_en: ...cutesy paintings of owls.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as cutesy, you dislike them because you think they are unpleasantly pretty and sentimental.

ext.ext_cn: 那天，他皈依了基督教。
ext.ext_en: He converted to Christianity that day.

defs.def_en: Christianity is a religion that is based on the teachings of Jesus Christ and the belief that he was the son of God.

ext.ext_cn: 西柏林一直有一个庞大的无政府主义群体。
ext.ext_en: West Berlin always had a large anarchist community.

ext.ext_cn: 知名的无政府主义诗人
ext.ext_en: ...a well-known anarchist poet.

defs.def_en: An anarchist is a person who believes in anarchism.

ext.ext_cn: 显然他基本上完全放弃无政府主义的观点了。
ext.ext_en: He was apparently quite converted from his anarchist views.

defs.def_en: If someone has anarchist beliefs or views, they believe in anarchism.

defs.def_cn: 无法无天的人；扰乱分子

ext.ext_cn: 他是个社会扰乱分子。
ext.ext_en: He was a social anarchist.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is an anarchist, you disapprove of them because they seem to pay no attention to the rules or laws that everyone else obeys.

ext.ext_cn: 墙壁都是米色的。
ext.ext_en: The walls are beige.

ext.ext_cn: 一条浅棕色短裤
ext.ext_en: ...a pair of beige shorts.

defs.def_en: Something that is beige is pale brown in colour.
Your backside is the part of your body that you sit on.

ext.ext_cn: 中世纪街道纵横交织的斯特拉斯堡
ext.ext_en: ...Strasbourg, with its rambling network of medieval streets...

ext.ext_cn: 密布的血管和神经网向子宫输送养料。
ext.ext_en: The uterus is supplied with a rich network of blood vessels and nerves.

defs.def_en: A network of lines, roads, veins, or other long thin things is a large number of them which cross each other or meet at many points.

ext.ext_cn: 食品正通过当地教会人士和其他志愿者形成的网络分发下去。
ext.ext_en: Distribution of the food is going ahead using a network of local church people and other volunteers...

ext.ext_cn: 他很乐意指出家庭网络可以带来的好处。
ext.ext_en: He is keen to point out the benefits which the family network can provide.

defs.def_en: See also:old-boy network;A network of people or institutions is a large number of them that have a connection with each other and work together as a system.

ext.ext_cn: 有154个终端的计算机网络
ext.ext_en: ...a computer network with 154 terminals...

ext.ext_cn: 铁路网的很多区段停运。
ext.ext_en: Huge sections of the rail network are out of action.

defs.def_en: See also:neural network;A particular network is a system of things which are connected and which operate together. For example, a computer network consists of a number of computers that are part of the same system.

ext.ext_cn: 美国一家广播网声称已经得到了那些录音材料。
ext.ext_en: An American network says it has obtained the recordings.

ext.ext_cn: 富士电视网,一家非常成功的商业电视台
ext.ext_en: ...Fuji Television Network, a highly successful commercial station.

defs.def_en: A radio or television network is a company or group of companies that broadcasts radio or television programmes throughout an area.

defs.def_cn: 对(电视或广播节目)进行联播

ext.ext_cn: 拉姆斯敦希望看到自己的节目卖出，并进行联播。
ext.ext_en: Lumsdon would like to see his programme sold and networked...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾经拥有自己的电视联播访谈节目。
ext.ext_en: He had once had his own networked chat show.

defs.def_en: When a television or radio programme is networked, it is broadcast at the same time by several different television companies.

ext.ext_cn: 在生意场上，通过与尽可能多的人面对面地打交道来建立工作关系很重要。
ext.ext_en: In business, it is important to network with as many people as possible on a face to face basis.

defs.def_en: If you network, you try to meet new people who might be useful to you in your job.

ext.ext_cn: 他们因为计算机水平差而大吃苦头。
ext.ext_en: They were victims of a computer botch-up.

defs.def_en: A botch-up is the same as a botch .

ext.ext_cn: 如果我觉得会冒犯任何人，我就不会袒露上身进行日光浴了。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't sunbathe topless if I thought I might offend anyone.

defs.def_en: If a woman goes topless, she does not wear anything to cover her breasts.

defs.def_cn: (表演中)女艺人裸露胸部的;(酒吧)雇佣袒胸女招待的
defs.def_en: A topless show or bar is one in which the female entertainers or staff do not wear anything to cover their breasts.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正准备动私刑绞死他时，援军闯入房间把他救下了。
ext.ext_en: They were about to lynch him when reinforcements from the army burst into the room and rescued him.

defs.def_en: If an angry crowd of people lynch someone, they kill that person by hanging them, without letting them have a trial, because they believe that that person has committed a crime.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 格雷斯为冒险成功而感到兴奋。
ext.ext_en: Grace was flushed with the success of the venture...

ext.ext_cn: 出版商为争取到她的小说的出版权而兴奋不已。
ext.ext_en: The publishers were flushed with triumph when they secured rights to her novel.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is flushed with success or pride you mean that they are very excited by their success or pride.

ext.ext_cn: 我们是在对经济、社会、文化诸领域进行改革的背景下从事这项工作的。
ext.ext_en: We are doing this work in the context of reforms in the economic, social and cultural spheres.

ext.ext_cn: 乔叟写作的历史背景
ext.ext_en: ...the historical context in which Chaucer wrote...

defs.def_en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

ext.ext_cn: 如果没有上下文，我会以为这是出自一名男子笔下。
ext.ext_en: Without a context, I would have assumed it was written by a man.

defs.def_en: The context of a word, sentence, or text consists of the words, sentences, or text before and after it which help to make its meaning clear.

defs.def_cn: 在上下文中;置于背景之下

ext.ext_cn: 征税基本上是不受欢迎的，在一定情境中才勉强为人接受。
ext.ext_en: Taxation is not popular in principle, merely acceptable in context...

ext.ext_cn: 我们将耶稣置于历史环境中来看是很重要的。
ext.ext_en: It is important that we put Jesus into the context of history.

defs.def_en: If something is seen in context or if it is put into context, it is considered together with all the factors that relate to it.

defs.def_cn: 脱离上下文;断章取义地

ext.ext_cn: 托马斯说，在这个问题上他的话被断章取义了。
ext.ext_en: Thomas says that he has been taken out of context on the issue...

ext.ext_cn: 引语可能会被篡改，使用时断章取义。
ext.ext_en: Quotes can be manipulated and used out of context.

defs.def_en: If a statement or remark is quoted out of context, the circumstances in which it was said are not correctly reported, so that it seems to mean something different from the meaning that was intended.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (事实、局势或经历)不悦的，沮丧的，有害的

ext.ext_cn: 来自海外的消息特别不容乐观。
ext.ext_en: The news from overseas is overwhelmingly negative...

ext.ext_cn: 这一切对刑事司法制度产生了极坏的影响。
ext.ext_en: All this had an extremely negative effect on the criminal justice system.

defs.def_en: A fact, situation, or experience that is negative is unpleasant, depressing, or harmful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 被问及你对自己目前工作的看法时，无论如何不要流露出消极情绪。
ext.ext_en: When asked for your views about your current job, on no account must you be negative about it...

ext.ext_cn: 媒体为什么对这座光彩夺目的城市持如此悲观的看法？
ext.ext_en: Why does the media present such a negative view of this splendid city?

defs.def_en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

defs.def_cn: (回答或决定)否定的，表示否认的

ext.ext_cn: 韦拉亚提医生给了一个含糊而否定的回答。
ext.ext_en: Dr Velayati gave a vague but negative response...

ext.ext_cn: 一旦得到否定裁决，申请人就失去了比利时法律的保护。
ext.ext_en: Upon a negative decision, the applicant loses the protection offered by Belgian law...

defs.def_en: A negative reply or decision indicates the answer 'no'.

defs.def_cn: 否定词;否定语;否定表示

ext.ext_cn: 说到遵循健康饮食习惯，我们过去听到的都是否定的说法。
ext.ext_en: In the past we have heard only negatives when it came to following a healthy diet.

defs.def_en: A negative is a word, expression, or gesture that means 'no' or 'not'.
In grammar, a negative clause contains a word such as 'not', 'never', or 'no-one'.

defs.def_cn: (医学检查或科学试验)呈阴性的，结果为否定的

ext.ext_cn: 到目前为止，参加测试的有57人，测试结果均呈阴性。
ext.ext_en: So far 57 have taken the test and all have been negative.

ext.ext_cn: 阴性测试结果
ext.ext_en: ...negative test results.

defs.def_en: If a medical test or scientific test is negative, it shows no evidence of the medical condition or substance that you are looking for.
In photography, a negative is an image that shows dark areas as light and light areas as dark. Negatives are made from a camera film, and are used to print photographs.

ext.ext_cn: 以微弱负电流刺激疼得最厉害的部位。
ext.ext_en: Stimulate the site of greatest pain with a small negative current.

defs.def_en: A negative charge or current has the same electrical charge as an electron.

ext.ext_cn: 最差的学生可能会以负分收场。
ext.ext_en: The weakest students can end up with a negative score.

defs.def_en: A negative number, quantity, or measurement is less than zero.

ext.ext_cn: 委员会对那些问题的答复是否定的。
ext.ext_en: The Council answered those questions in the negative...

ext.ext_cn: 79人投赞成票，没有人投反对票。
ext.ext_en: Seventy-nine voted in the affirmative, and none in the negative.

defs.def_en: If an answer is in the negative, it is 'no' or means 'no'.

ext.ext_cn: I went (我去了)的否定式是 I did not go (我没去)。
ext.ext_en: 'I went' in the negative is 'I did not go'.

defs.def_en: If a sentence is in the negative, it contains a word such as 'not', 'never', or 'no-one'.
A cathode is the negative electrode in a cell such as a battery.

ext.ext_cn: 让他把车开到前台来。
ext.ext_en: Have him bring a car round to the reception...

ext.ext_cn: 宾馆的前台
ext.ext_en: ...the hotel's reception desk.

defs.def_en: The reception in a hotel is the desk or office that books rooms for people and answers their questions.

defs.def_cn: （办公室或医院的）接待处，服务台

ext.ext_cn: 在接待处等我。
ext.ext_en: Wait at reception for me.

defs.def_en: The reception in an office or hospital is the place where people's appointments and questions are dealt with.

ext.ext_cn: 招待会的餐桌上有熏制鲑鱼。
ext.ext_en: At the reception they served smoked salmon.

ext.ext_cn: 风光的婚宴
ext.ext_en: ...a glittering wedding reception.

defs.def_en: A reception is a formal party which is given to welcome someone or to celebrate a special event.

ext.ext_cn: 曼德拉先生在华盛顿受到热情的款待。
ext.ext_en: Mr Mandela was given a tumultuous reception in Washington...

ext.ext_cn: 他的演讲受到了冷遇。
ext.ext_en: He received a cool reception to his speech.

defs.def_en: If someone or something has a particular kind of reception, that is the way that people react to them.

ext.ext_cn: 迎接殿下到来的准备工作在有序进行。
ext.ext_en: The preparations for the reception of his Royal Highness proceeded.

defs.def_en: The reception of guests is the act of formally welcoming them.

defs.def_cn: （无线电或电视节目的）接收效果

ext.ext_cn: 调整天线的位置和方向以达到最佳接收效果。
ext.ext_en: Adjust the aerial's position and direction for the best reception.

defs.def_en: If you get good reception from your radio or television, the sound or picture is clear because the signal is strong. If the reception is poor, the sound or picture is unclear because the signal is weak.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调非常糟糕、难以接受或不幸)几乎是…，简直是…，无异于…

ext.ext_cn: 布雷西的言论简直就是异端邪说。
ext.ext_en: What Bracey is saying is tantamount to heresy...

ext.ext_cn: 忽视或忘记过去无异于篡改历史，凡是读过《动物农场》的人都知道那会导致什么后果。
ext.ext_en: To neglect or forget aspects of the past is tantamount to rewriting history, and anyone who has read Animal Farm knows where that can lead.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing is tantamount to a second, more serious thing, you are emphasizing how bad, unacceptable, or unfortunate the first thing is by comparing it to the second.

ext.ext_cn: 我有种感觉——我以前曾在哪里见过他。
ext.ext_en: I've got a feeling I've seen him before somewhere...

ext.ext_cn: 我还不准备回家，我要先去别的地方。
ext.ext_en: I'm not going home yet. I have to go somewhere else first...

defs.def_en: You use somewhere to refer to a place without saying exactly where you mean.

ext.ext_cn: 据说女王的收入大约在 700 万至 1 亿英镑之间。
ext.ext_en: The Queen is believed to earn somewhere between seven million and one hundred million pounds...

ext.ext_cn: 卡瑞的年纪在 73 到 80 岁之间。
ext.ext_en: Caray is somewhere between 73 and 80 years of age...

defs.def_en: You use somewhere when giving an approximate amount, number, or time.

ext.ext_cn: 他们最终逐渐达成共识，终于取得了一些进展。
ext.ext_en: At last they were agreeing, at last they were getting somewhere...

ext.ext_cn: 这一次，我们似乎真的要取得进展了。
ext.ext_en: This time it looks as if we're really going to get somewhere.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are getting somewhere, you mean that you are making progress towards achieving something.
A career woman is a woman with a career who is interested in working and progressing in her job, rather than staying at home looking after the house and children.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 心情多变的;闷闷不乐的

ext.ext_cn: 戴维的妈妈情绪不稳定，心情也不好。
ext.ext_en: David's mother was unstable and moody...

ext.ext_cn: 雷是一个表面上嘻嘻哈哈，但内心复杂且情绪多变的人。
ext.ext_en: Ray is a complicated, moody man behind the joking front.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as moody, you mean that their feelings and behaviour change frequently, and in particular that they often become depressed or angry without any warning.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 令人伤感的黑白照片
ext.ext_en: ...moody black and white photographs.

ext.ext_cn: 伤感的歌词伴着幽幽吉他声
ext.ext_en: ...a blend of melancholy guitars and moody lyrics.

defs.def_en: If you describe a picture, film, or piece of music as moody, you mean that it suggests particular emotions, especially sad ones.

ext.ext_cn: 敌对双方尚未将其重型武器悉数上缴。
ext.ext_en: The warring factions have not yet turned in all their heavy weapons.

ext.ext_cn: 打打闹闹的夫妻
ext.ext_en: ...warring husbands and wives.

defs.def_en: Warring is used to describe groups of people who are involved in a conflict or quarrel with each other.

defs.def_cn: 形容词词组（如very nice，interested in football，也可为单个形容词）
defs.def_en: An adjective group or adjectival group is a group of words based on an adjective, such as 'very nice' or 'interested in football'. An adjective group can also consist simply of an adjective.

defs.def_cn: （用于以3结尾的数字后构成序数词，以13结尾的数字除外）

ext.ext_en: ...September 3rd 1990.

ext.ext_cn: 第33届波士顿马拉松赛
ext.ext_en: ...the 33rd Boston Marathon.

defs.def_en: -rd is added to numbers that end in 3, except those ending in 13, in order to form ordinal numbers such as 3rd or 33rd. 3rd is pronounced 'third'.

defs.def_cn: (电视、电脑的)屏幕;(电影的)银幕
defs.def_en: See also:big screen;small screen;widescreen;A screen is a flat vertical surface on which pictures or words are shown. Television sets and computers have screens, and films are shown on a screen in cinemas.

ext.ext_cn: 许多观众对银幕暴力心存反感。
ext.ext_en: Many viewers have strong opinions about violence on the screen...

ext.ext_cn: 无论是在荧幕上还是在生活中，她都是人们心目中完美的美国青少年。
ext.ext_en: She was the ideal American teenager, both on and off screen.

defs.def_en: You can refer to film or television as the screen .

defs.def_cn: 放映(电影);播放(电视节目)

ext.ext_cn: 这个系列剧可能在 1 月份播放。
ext.ext_en: The series is likely to be screened in January...

ext.ext_cn: 后来各电视台被禁止播放任何有关这次游行的画面。
ext.ext_en: TV firms were later banned from screening any pictures of the demo.

defs.def_en: When a film or a television programme is screened, it is shown in the cinema or broadcast on television.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在我面前竖了一面屏风，所以我看不到发生了什么事情。
ext.ext_en: They put a screen in front of me so I couldn't see what was going on.

defs.def_en: A screen is a vertical panel which can be moved around. It is used to keep cold air away from part of a room, or to create a smaller area within a room.

ext.ext_cn: 宾馆后面的那条路大部分被一片公寓楼遮住了。
ext.ext_en: Most of the road behind the hotel was screened by a block of flats.

defs.def_en: If something is screened by another thing, it is behind it and hidden by it.

defs.def_cn: 检查，筛查(以确定是否患病)

ext.ext_cn: 能快速核查是否长蛀牙的唾液检验
ext.ext_en: ...a quick saliva test that would screen for people at risk of tooth decay.

defs.def_en: To screen for a disease means to examine people to make sure that they do not have it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们会对所有求职者进行筛选。
ext.ext_en: They will screen all their candidates.

ext.ext_cn: 参军的筛选程序
ext.ext_en: ...screening procedures for the regiment.

defs.def_en: When an organization screens people who apply to join it, it investigates them to make sure that they are not likely to cause problems.

defs.def_cn: 对(人、行李)进行安全检查

ext.ext_cn: 该航空公司已采用X光机对行李进行安全检查。
ext.ext_en: The airline had been screening baggage on X-ray machines.

defs.def_en: To screen people or luggage means to check them using special equipment to make sure they are not carrying a weapon or a bomb.

defs.def_cn: 转接，甄别(来电以决定是否接听)

ext.ext_cn: 我雇用了一名秘书转接打给我的电话。
ext.ext_en: I employ a secretary to screen my calls.

defs.def_en: If you screen your telephone calls, calls made to you are connected to an answering machine or are answered by someone else, so that you can choose whether or not to speak to the people phoning you.

defs.def_cn: 有立柱的；靠柱子支撑的
defs.def_en: A pillared building is a building that is supported by pillars.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他看上去喝醉了,警察说。
ext.ext_en: He appeared intoxicated, police said.

defs.def_en: Someone who is intoxicated is drunk.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 陶醉的;极其兴奋的;忘乎所以的

ext.ext_cn: 他们似乎陶醉在成功的喜悦中。
ext.ext_en: They seem to have become intoxicated by their success...

ext.ext_cn: 这些领袖可能会自感无所不能而得意忘形。
ext.ext_en: These leaders can become intoxicated with a sense of their own omnipotence.

defs.def_en: If you are intoxicated by or with something such as a feeling or an event, you are so excited by it that you find it hard to think clearly and sensibly.

ext.ext_cn: 基因操作的现代生物技术方法
ext.ext_en: ...modern biotechnological methods of genetic manipulation.

defs.def_en: Biotechnological means relating to biotechnology.

ext.ext_cn: 这幅图标示了太阳系八大行星中的6颗。
ext.ext_en: The picture shows six of the eight planets in the solar system.

defs.def_en: A planet is a large, round object in space that moves around a star. The Earth is a planet.

ext.ext_cn: 我把问题抛在一边，目前它还无法解决。
ext.ext_en: I pushed the problem aside; at present it was insoluble...

ext.ext_cn: 那是个无法解决的两难局面,我无计可施。
ext.ext_en: It was an insoluble dilemma and one which I could do nothing about.

defs.def_en: An insoluble problem is so difficult that it is impossible to solve.

ext.ext_cn: 胡萝卜素不溶于水,但可溶于油类和脂肪。
ext.ext_en: Carotenes are insoluble in water and soluble in oils and fats.

defs.def_en: If a substance is insoluble, it does not dissolve in a liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 他小心地压低了声音。
ext.ext_en: He carefully modulated his voice.

defs.def_en: If you modulate your voice or a sound, you change or vary its loudness, pitch, or tone in order to create a particular effect.

ext.ext_cn: 这些化学物质可以调节钾的功效。
ext.ext_en: These chemicals modulate the effect of potassium.

defs.def_en: To modulate an activity or process means to alter it so that it is more suitable for a particular situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 戴着一副硕大黑框眼镜的娇小女子
ext.ext_en: ...a tiny little woman with huge black glasses...

ext.ext_cn: 几位画家正在一块用作舞台布景的巨大帆布上作画。
ext.ext_en: Several painters were working on a huge piece of canvas which would serve as the scenery...

defs.def_en: Something or someone that is huge is extremely large in size.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我有超多条领带，因为我从来不肯扔掉它们。
ext.ext_en: I have a huge number of ties because I never throw them away...

ext.ext_cn: 看到他们从年轻吸毒者的痛苦中榨取暴利，他怒不可遏。
ext.ext_en: He is furious they are making huge profits out of the misery of young addicts.

defs.def_en: Something that is huge is extremely large in amount or degree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 另一组人正在研究公司间严重的债务问题。
ext.ext_en: Another team is looking at the huge problem of debts between companies...

ext.ext_cn: 结果是人类遭遇深重的灾难。
ext.ext_en: The result was human suffering on a huge scale.

defs.def_en: Something that is huge exists or happens on a very large scale, and involves a lot of different people or things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 老糊涂的;老态龙钟的;年老而无力自理的
defs.def_en: If old people become senile, they become confused, can no longer remember things, and are unable to look after themselves.

defs.def_cn: 没彩排过的；没有提前准备过的

ext.ext_cn: 事实上，这些唱片收录的大部分乐曲都是没排练过的即兴之作。
ext.ext_en: In fact, the recordings were mostly unrehearsed improvisations.

defs.def_en: Unrehearsed activities or performances have not been prepared, planned, or practised beforehand.

ext.ext_cn: 奎因在战争期间领导汉奸政府。
ext.ext_en: Quinn  headed the collaborationist government throughout the war.

defs.def_en: A collaborationist government or individual is one that helps or gives support to the enemy during the war.

defs.def_cn: (足球比赛中双方入球数相等且至少踢进一球的)平局
defs.def_en: A score draw is the result of a football match in which both teams score at least one goal, and they score the same number of goals.

ext.ext_cn: 将会有一个国际问题调查工作组。
ext.ext_en: There will be a working group on international issues.

defs.def_en: A working group is the same as a working party .

defs.def_cn: (保护植物幼苗不受寒的)玻璃罩，透明塑料罩
defs.def_en: A cloche is a long, low cover made of glass or clear plastic that is put over young plants to protect them from the cold.
A cloche or a cloche hat is a woman's hat shaped like a bell that fits closely round the head. Cloche hats were popular in the 1920s.

ext.ext_cn: 可以用新鲜植物或干药草泡制的浸剂
ext.ext_en: ...an infusion which may be prepared from the fresh plant or the dried herb...

ext.ext_cn: 36 辆卡车装了大约 100 吨的奶粉和绷带。
ext.ext_en: Thirty-six trucks were loaded with some 100 tons of dried milk and bandages.

defs.def_en: See also:dry;Dried food or milk has had all the water removed from it so that it will last for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 他们一直是这次冲突中的挑衅方。
ext.ext_en: They have been the aggressors in this conflict.

defs.def_en: The aggressor in a fight or battle is the person, group, or country that starts it.

defs.def_cn: (与 rain，blood 等名词连用构成形容词)表示“被…湿透的”

ext.ext_cn: 他在被雨浇透的树林里艰难地走着。
ext.ext_en: He trudged through the rain-soaked woods.

ext.ext_cn: 浸透了血迹的衣服
ext.ext_en: ...blood-soaked clothes.

defs.def_en: -soaked combines with nouns such as 'rain' and 'blood' to form adjectives which describe someone or something that is extremely wet or extremely damp because of the thing mentioned.

defs.def_cn: (与sun之类的名词连用构成形容词)表示“充满…的”

ext.ext_cn: 阳光明媚的加勒比海小岛
ext.ext_en: ...a sun-soaked Caribbean island.

ext.ext_cn: 资金富足的八十年代
ext.ext_en: ...the cash-soaked Eighties...

defs.def_en: -soaked combines with nouns such as 'sun' to form adjectives which describe places, times, or events that have a lot of the thing mentioned.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （计划、理论）愚蠢的，不切实际的

ext.ext_cn: 这已经不是他制定的第一个愚蠢方案了。
ext.ext_en: This isn't the first hare-brained scheme he's had.

defs.def_en: You use hare-brained to describe a scheme or theory which you consider to be very foolish and which you think is unlikely to be successful or true.

defs.def_cn: 放宽(对…的)限制；（使）自由化

ext.ext_cn: 才刚刚开始实行自由化的独裁国家
ext.ext_en: ...authoritarian states that have only now begun to liberalise.

ext.ext_cn: 放宽旅游限制的决定
ext.ext_en: ...the decision to liberalize travel restrictions.

defs.def_en: When a country or government liberalizes, or liberalizes its laws or its attitudes, it becomes less strict and allows people more freedom in their actions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 女孩们只匆匆瞥了一眼司机。
ext.ext_en: The girls caught only a fleeting glimpse of the driver...

ext.ext_cn: 他会不会搂住自己，这个念头在她脑子里一闪而过。
ext.ext_en: She wondered for a fleeting moment if he would put his arm around her.

defs.def_en: Fleeting is used to describe something which lasts only for a very short time.

ext.ext_cn: 任务是找到解决难民问题的长久之计，以作为当前暂时手段的后续措施
ext.ext_en: ...the task of finding a durable solution to the refugee problem as a follow-through to the very temporary measures.

defs.def_en: A follow-through is something that completes an action or a planned series of actions.

ext.ext_cn: 集中精力完成简短而有力的随球动作。
ext.ext_en: Focus on making a short, firm follow-through.

defs.def_en: A follow-through is a movement that completes an action such as hitting a ball.

defs.def_cn: （用于询问方式、方法）怎样，怎么，如何

ext.ext_cn: 我如何向自己的账户付款？
ext.ext_en: How do I make payments into my account?...

ext.ext_cn: 你是怎样把这里保持得如此整洁的？
ext.ext_en: How do you manage to keep the place so tidy?...

defs.def_en: You use how to ask about the way in which something happens or is done.

defs.def_cn: （用于某些形容词和动词后引出陈述或事实，常指记起之事或希望他人了解之事）

ext.ext_cn: 人们竟然日积月累地收集了这么多东西，真令人惊叹。
ext.ext_en: It's amazing how people collect so much stuff over the years...

ext.ext_cn: 好笑的是，我好像从来没有在休息日里做成过一件事。
ext.ext_en: It's funny how I never seem to get a thing done on my day off...

defs.def_en: You use how after certain adjectives and verbs to introduce a statement or fact, often something that you remember or expect other people to know about.

defs.def_cn: （用于询问数量、程度）多少，多么

ext.ext_cn: 总共是多少钱？
ext.ext_en: How much money are we talking about?...

ext.ext_cn: 我们有多少名全职工？
ext.ext_en: How many full-time staff have we got?...

defs.def_en: You use how to ask questions about the quantity or degree of something.

defs.def_cn: （用于询问是否成功或愉快）怎么样，如何

ext.ext_cn: 你的奥兰多之行怎么样？
ext.ext_en: How was your trip down to Orlando?...

ext.ext_cn: 你的约会进行得怎么样？
ext.ext_en: How did your date go?...

defs.def_en: You use how when you are asking someone whether something was successful or enjoyable.

defs.def_cn: （用于询问某人的健康或打探有关某人的消息）怎么样，如何

ext.ext_cn: 嗨！你近来怎么样？
ext.ext_en: Hi! How are you doing?...

ext.ext_cn: 罗茜近来怎么样？
ext.ext_en: How's Rosie?...

defs.def_en: You use how to ask about someone's health or to find out someone's news.

defs.def_cn: 你好（用于初次见面打招呼）

ext.ext_cn: “你好，贝林厄姆夫人，”萨姆说。
ext.ext_en: 'How do you do, Mrs Bellingham,' Sam said.

defs.def_en: 'How do you do' is a polite way of greeting someone when you meet them for the first time.

ext.ext_cn: 两个历史问题——你可以随便回答。
ext.ext_en: Two historical questions — you can answer them how you like...

ext.ext_cn: 这是你的生活，你想怎样过就怎样过！
ext.ext_en: It's your life, so live it how you want!

defs.def_en: You use how when you want to say that it does not matter which way something is done.

ext.ext_cn: 我没想到买的东西会有多沉。
ext.ext_en: I didn't realize how heavy that shopping was going to be...

ext.ext_cn: 富兰克林告诉他们大家能再一次来到英国他非常开心。
ext.ext_en: Franklin told them all how happy he was to be in Britain again.

defs.def_en: You use how to emphasize the degree to which something is true.

defs.def_cn: （用于感叹句中强调形容词、副词或陈述内容）多么，何等，如此

ext.ext_cn: 诸如在沙滩散步这样的小事会突然变得如此重要，真是令人感到不可思议。
ext.ext_en: How strange that something so simple as a walk on the beach could suddenly mean so much...

ext.ext_cn: 她焦急万分地等待我的答复。
ext.ext_en: How anxiously she awaited my answer...

defs.def_en: You use how in exclamations to emphasize an adjective, adverb, or statement.

defs.def_cn: （表示不赞成或难以相信）你怎么能，你怎么会

ext.ext_cn: 你怎么能喝这么多啤酒呢，卢克？
ext.ext_en: How can you drink so much beer, Luke?...

ext.ext_cn: 怎么会把这样一位作家当回事呢？
ext.ext_en: How could such a writer be taken seriously?...

defs.def_en: You use how in expressions such as 'How can you...' and 'How could you...' to indicate that you disapprove of what someone has done or that you find it hard to believe.

defs.def_cn: （用于提出建议或邀请）怎么样好吗

ext.ext_cn: 来杯咖啡怎么样？
ext.ext_en: How about a cup of coffee?...

ext.ext_cn: 你想让珍妮帮你预约吗？下周末怎么样？
ext.ext_en: You want Jeannie to make the appointment for you? How about the end of next week?...

defs.def_en: You use how in expressions such as 'how about...' or 'how would you like...' when you are making an offer or a suggestion.

defs.def_cn: （用于询问对方的想法或要求）你呢，你觉得呢

ext.ext_cn: 嗯，我觉得那很棒。你们俩呢？
ext.ext_en: Well, I enjoyed that. How about you two?...

ext.ext_cn: “要喝点什么吗？”—“不了，谢谢，”迈克尔说。他看了一眼威尔弗雷德。“你呢？”
ext.ext_en: 'Something to drink?' — 'No, thanks,' said Michael. He glanced at Wilfred. 'How about you?'

defs.def_en: If you ask someone 'How about you?' you are asking them what they think or want.

defs.def_cn: （用于引起他人对刚说过的话或发生的事的注意）神吧，奇妙吧，你信吗？

ext.ext_cn: 双胞胎在3点时出现了。神吧？绝对准时。
ext.ext_en: The twins made their appearance at three o'clock. How about that? Spot on time.

defs.def_en: If you say 'How about that?' you are drawing attention to something that has been said or done that you think is surprising.

defs.def_cn: （用于引出相关的新话题）怎么样，如何

ext.ext_cn: 你们的产品和服务有竞争力吗？营销又怎么样呢？
ext.ext_en: Are your products and services competitive? How about marketing?

defs.def_en: You use how about to introduce a new subject which you think is relevant to the conversation you have been having.

defs.def_cn: （用于因为惊讶而询问）怎么会这样呢，为什么

ext.ext_cn: “他们相互之间一句话都不说。”——“怎么会这样呢？”
ext.ext_en: 'They don't say a single word to each other.'—'How come?'

ext.ext_cn: 为什么他今年表现不及往常呢？
ext.ext_en: How come he hasn't been able to be as good this year?...

defs.def_en: You ask 'How come?' or 'How so?' when you are surprised by something and are asking why it happened or was said.

defs.def_cn: 你是什么意思;你到底想说什么

ext.ext_cn: “燃油表坏了。”——“坏了？你说清楚点？”
ext.ext_en: 'The fuel gauge is broken.' — 'Broken? How do you mean?'

defs.def_en: If you say 'How do you mean?' to someone, you are asking them to explain or give more details of what they have just said.

defs.def_cn: （用于询问是否可接受或满意）怎么样，行吗

ext.ext_cn: 我们找个地方一起喝一杯吧？我请客。怎么样？
ext.ext_en: Suppose we meet somewhere for a drink? I'll pay. How's that?

defs.def_en: If you say 'How's that?' to someone, you are asking whether something is acceptable or satisfactory.

ext.ext_cn: 一对金袖扣
ext.ext_en: ...a pair of gold cufflinks.

defs.def_en: Cufflinks are small decorative objects used for holding together shirt cuffs around the wrist.

ext.ext_cn: 你只能乔装出行。
ext.ext_en: You'll have to travel in disguise...

ext.ext_cn: 他一副滑稽的装扮。
ext.ext_en: He was wearing that ridiculous disguise...

defs.def_en: If you are in disguise, you are not wearing your usual clothes or you have altered your appearance in other ways, so that people will not recognize you.

ext.ext_cn: 她女扮男装，这样就可以上战场了。
ext.ext_en: She disguised herself as a man so she could fight on the battlefield.

defs.def_en: If you disguise yourself, you put on clothes which make you look like someone else or alter your appearance in other ways, so that people will not recognize you.

ext.ext_cn: 他毫不掩饰自己的焦虑不安。
ext.ext_en: He made no attempt to disguise his agitation...

ext.ext_cn: 它们看上去有益健康，实则掩盖了其为精加工食品这一事实。
ext.ext_en: Their healthy image disguises the fact that they are highly processed foods...

defs.def_en: To disguise something means to hide it or make it appear different so that people will not know about it or will not recognize it.

ext.ext_cn: 由于今天的示威游行，警方封锁了旧金山一条主干道上大约12个街区。
ext.ext_en: Police closed off about 12 blocks of a major San Francisco thoroughfare for today's march...

ext.ext_cn: 领导人的老警卫们生活在用过去的意识形态筑成的高墙内，与世隔绝。
ext.ext_en: The old guard of leaders are closed off behind walls built of yesterday's ideology.

defs.def_en: To close something off means to separate it from other things or people so that they cannot go there.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一定不能小瞧了她所取得的杰出成就。
ext.ext_en: We mustn't belittle her outstanding achievement...

ext.ext_cn: 没有理由低估这场灾难的严重性。
ext.ext_en: It makes no sense to belittle the enormity of the disaster.

defs.def_en: If you belittle someone or something, you say or imply that they are unimportant or not very good.

ext.ext_cn: 1985年3月矿工们结束了持续一年之久的罢工。
ext.ext_en: The miners ended their year-long strike in March 1985.

defs.def_en: Year-long is used to describe something that lasts for a year.

ext.ext_cn: 我们想出了一个帮他的计策。
ext.ext_en: We devised a scheme to help him...

ext.ext_cn: 必须规划出新的长期目标。
ext.ext_en: New long-range objectives must be devised.

defs.def_en: If you devise a plan, system, or machine, you have the idea for it and design it.
A peroration is the last part of a speech, especially the part where the speaker sums up his or her argument.
If someone describes a speech as a peroration, they mean that they dislike it because they think it is very long and not worth listening to.

defs.def_cn: 将(原本非法的事情)合法化

ext.ext_cn: 卖淫是否应该合法化的问题
ext.ext_en: ...the question of whether prostitution should be decriminalized.

defs.def_en: When a criminal offence is decriminalized, the law changes so that it is no longer a criminal offence.
A thoroughbred is a horse that has parents that are of the same high quality breed.

ext.ext_cn: 良种牡马
ext.ext_en: ...a thoroughbred stallion.

defs.def_en: A thoroughbred is a particular breed of racing horse.

ext.ext_cn: 她的电吉他
ext.ext_en: ...her electric guitar.

defs.def_en: An electric device or machine works by means of electricity, rather than using some other source of power.
An electric current, voltage, or charge is one that is produced by electricity.
Electric plugs, sockets, or power lines are designed to carry electricity.

ext.ext_cn: 每月电费可能会平均增加两三美元。
ext.ext_en: An average electric bill might go up $2 or $3 per month...

defs.def_en: Electric is used to refer to the supply of electricity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 扣人心弦的;紧张刺激的

ext.ext_cn: 大厅里的气氛非常紧张。
ext.ext_en: The mood in the hall was electric.

defs.def_en: If you describe the atmosphere of a place or event as electric, you mean that people are in a state of great excitement.

defs.def_cn: 名义上的;理论上的;概念的

ext.ext_cn: 国有资产的名义价值
ext.ext_en: ...the notional value of state assets.

defs.def_en: Something that is notional exists only in theory or as a suggestion or idea, but not in reality.

defs.def_cn: （激动人心的事情之后）令人失望的情况，令人扫兴的事件

ext.ext_cn: 巴里紧随德克·博加德之后发表了演讲，不出所料，演讲顿时变得索然无味。
ext.ext_en: Barry's speech followed Dirk Bogarde's appearance, and was an inevitable anticlimax...

ext.ext_cn: 令人悲哀的是，他的国际职业生涯竟如此惨淡收场。
ext.ext_en: It was sad that his international career should end in such anticlimax.

defs.def_en: You can describe something as an anticlimax if it disappoints you because it happens after something that was very exciting, or because it is not as exciting as you expected.

ext.ext_cn: 歌颂挚爱的赞歌
ext.ext_en: ...a paean to deep, passionate love.

defs.def_en: A paean is a piece of music, writing, or film that expresses praise, admiration, or happiness.
An escape artist is the same as an escapologist .
Amidst means the same as amid .

ext.ext_cn: 他们想要个有责任心的人夜间照管这个地方。
ext.ext_en: They wanted someone responsible to look after the place at night-time...

ext.ext_cn: 正在执行12小时的宵禁。
ext.ext_en: A twelve hour night time curfew is in force.

defs.def_en: Night-time is the period of time between when it gets dark and when the sun rises.

defs.def_cn: 极大的;了不起的;严重的

ext.ext_cn: 右派占绝大多数。
ext.ext_en: The Right has a thumping majority...

ext.ext_cn: 英国铁路公司遭受了 4,500 万英镑的巨额损失后境况更加惨淡。
ext.ext_en: The gloom deepened after a thumping £45m loss at British Rail.

defs.def_en: Thumping is used to emphasize that something is very great or severe.

defs.def_cn: （对信仰或行为方式的）放弃，抛弃

ext.ext_cn: 会谈以放弃恐怖主义为前提。
ext.ext_en: The talks were dependent on a renunciation of terrorism.

defs.def_en: The renunciation of a belief or a way of behaving is the public declaration that you reject it and have decided to stop having that belief or behaving in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 对地中海领土的放弃
ext.ext_en: ...the renunciation of territory in the Mediterranean.

defs.def_en: The renunciation of a claim, title, or privilege is the act of officially giving it up.

defs.def_cn: (因道德或宗教原因)克己，自我克制

ext.ext_cn: 甘地体现了克己、禁欲和自我约束的美德。
ext.ext_en: Gandhi exemplified the virtues of renunciation, asceticism and restraint.

defs.def_en: Renunciation is the act of not allowing yourself certain pleasures for moral or religious reasons.

ext.ext_cn: 政府为高校教学提供资金。
ext.ext_en: The Government funds university teaching.

ext.ext_cn: 学校的英语教学
ext.ext_en: ...the teaching of English in schools.

defs.def_en: Teaching is the work that a teacher does in helping students to learn.

ext.ext_cn: 耶稣的教义
ext.ext_en: ...the teachings of Jesus.

ext.ext_cn: 他们关于性和婚姻的教义
ext.ext_en: ...their teachings on sexuality and marriage.

defs.def_en: The teachings of a particular person, group of people, or religion are all the ideas and principles that they teach.

ext.ext_cn: 甲烷分子由1个碳原子与4个氢原子构成。
ext.ext_en: A methane molecule is composed of one carbon atom attached to four hydrogens.

defs.def_en: An atom is the smallest amount of a substance that can take part in a chemical reaction.

defs.def_cn: 民主的;民主制度的;民主政体的

ext.ext_cn: 在经历了数届军人政府后，玻利维亚于 1982 年恢复了民主政权。
ext.ext_en: Bolivia returned to democratic rule in 1982, after a series of military governments.

ext.ext_cn: 该国的首次民主选举
ext.ext_en: ...the country's first democratic elections.

defs.def_en: A democratic country, government, or political system is governed by representatives who are elected by the people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 民主精神的;民主作风的

ext.ext_cn: 教育是民主社会的基础。
ext.ext_en: Education is the basis of a democratic society...

ext.ext_cn: 他呼吁进行广泛的改革，使武装部队作风更加民主，开支更加俭省。
ext.ext_en: He called for widespread changes to make the armed forces more democratic and less expensive.

defs.def_en: Something that is democratic is based on the idea that everyone should have equal rights and should be involved in making important decisions.

ext.ext_cn: 社会民主党
ext.ext_en: ...the Social Democratic Party.

ext.ext_cn: 阿富汗人民民主党
ext.ext_en: ...the People's Democratic Party of Afghanistan...

defs.def_en: Democratic is used in the titles of some political parties.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as dim-witted, you are saying in quite an unkind way that you do not think they are very clever.

defs.def_cn: 含义甚广的术语;笼统的类别

ext.ext_cn: “全球化”是个泛称，用以描述增进了的国际贸易。
ext.ext_en: Globalisation is a catch-all to describe increased international trade...

ext.ext_cn: “消化不良”是个笼统的术语，可以指各种胃部不适。
ext.ext_en: Indigestion is a catch-all term for any kind of stomach distress.

defs.def_en: A catch-all is a term or category which includes many different things.

defs.def_cn: 莎丽(尤指印度妇女用于裹身的长条布)
defs.def_en: A sari is a piece of clothing worn especially by Indian women. It consists of a long piece of thin material that is wrapped around the body.

ext.ext_cn: 在原生境中，木槿能长到25英尺高。
ext.ext_en: In its natural habitat, the hibiscus will grow up to 25ft...

ext.ext_cn: 几乎没有哪个国家像南非那样拥有如此多样化的动植物栖生地。
ext.ext_en: Few countries have as rich a diversity of habitat as South Africa.

defs.def_en: The habitat of an animal or plant is the natural environment in which it normally lives or grows.

defs.def_cn: 年龄层，年龄组（指某地或某团体中所有生于某一时期的人）

ext.ext_cn: 各年龄段人士都会喜欢的一种风格
ext.ext_en: ...a style that would appeal to all age groups.

defs.def_en: An age group is the people in a place or organization who were born during a particular period of time, for example all the people aged between 18 and 25.

ext.ext_cn: 他承认了阴谋诈骗政府的罪名。

ext.ext_en: ...allegations that he defrauded taxpayers of thousands of dollars.

defs.def_en: If someone defrauds you, they take something away from you or stop you from getting what belongs to you by means of tricks and lies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （笑话或故事）以屎尿为题的，低级粗俗的
defs.def_en: Lavatorial jokes or stories involve childish references to urine or faeces.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的顾客很会精打细算。
ext.ext_en: Our customers have very tight budgets.

ext.ext_cn: 心满意足的顾客
ext.ext_en: ...a satisfied customer.

defs.def_en: A  customer is someone who buys goods or services, especially from a shop.

ext.ext_cn: 她是个很冷静的家伙。
ext.ext_en: She's a real cool customer.

ext.ext_cn: 两个相当难缠的家伙
ext.ext_en: ...two pretty awkward customers.

defs.def_en: You can use customer in expressions such as a cool customer or a tough customer to indicate what someone's behaviour or character is like.

ext.ext_cn: 工会和管理层都担心争端会恶化。
ext.ext_en: Both unions and management fear the dispute could escalate...

ext.ext_cn: 抗议升级为为期5天的骚乱。
ext.ext_en: The protests escalated into five days of rioting...

defs.def_en: If a bad situation escalates or if someone or something escalates it, it becomes greater in size, seriousness, or intensity.

ext.ext_cn: 可用来餐前小酌的花园露台
ext.ext_en: ...a garden terrace where you can drink your aperitifs.

defs.def_en: An aperitif is an alcoholic drink that you have before a meal.

defs.def_cn: (情节、因素)可考虑从轻处置的，可减轻罪责的

ext.ext_cn: 法官认为她这个案子存在可以减轻罪责的情节。
ext.ext_en: The judge found that in her case there were mitigating circumstances...

ext.ext_en: There are various mitigating factors.

defs.def_en: Mitigating circumstances or factors make a bad action, especially a crime, easier to understand and excuse, and may result in the person responsible being punished less severely.

ext.ext_en: Susan continued to live uptown...

Hon. is an abbreviation for (缩略=) honourable and honorary when they are used as part of a person's title.

defs.def_cn: 头等的;第一流的;呱呱叫的

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人吃惊的;惊人的;不寻常的

ext.ext_cn: 有时结果可能会令人吃惊。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes the results may be rather startling.

ext.ext_cn: 惊人的新证据
ext.ext_en: ...startling new evidence...

defs.def_en: Something that is startling is so different, unexpected, or remarkable that people react to it with surprise.

ext.ext_cn: 高架电缆

ext.ext_cn: 搭在防风雨的绝缘电线上的串串彩灯
ext.ext_en: ...strings of coloured lights with weatherproof cable.

defs.def_en: A cable is a thick wire, or a group of wires inside a rubber or plastic covering, which is used to carry electricity or electronic signals.

ext.ext_en: Steel cable will be used to replace worn ropes.

ext.ext_en: They ran commercials on cable systems across the country...

ext.ext_en: Unemployment was the electorate's main concern.

defs.def_en: Someone's concern with something is their feeling that it is important.

ext.ext_en: Feminism must address issues beyond the concerns of middle-class whites.

ext.ext_cn: 若非她的关心和照顾，他根本没有机会。
ext.ext_en: Without her care and concern, he had no chance at all...

ext.ext_cn: 我不关心政治。
ext.ext_en: I didn't concern myself with politics...

ext.ext_cn: 他唯一关心的是人质的危险处境。
ext.ext_en: He would concern himself solely with the plight of the hostages.

defs.def_en: If you concern yourself with something, you give it attention because you think that it is important.

ext.ext_en: The bulk of the book concerns Sandy's two middle-aged children...

ext.ext_en: Chapter 2 concerns itself with the methodological difficulties.

defs.def_en: If something such as a book or a piece of information concerns a particular subject, it is about that subject.

defs.def_cn: (情况、事件或活动)对…有影响，与…相关

ext.ext_en: It was just a little unfinished business from my past, and it doesn't concern you at all.

defs.def_en: If a situation, event, or activity concerns you, it affects or involves you.

ext.ext_cn: 技术方面由陆军负责。
ext.ext_en: The technical aspects were the concern of the Army...

ext.ext_cn: 如果能亲自动手摆脱他们我会非常高兴，但那不是我们的分内之事。
ext.ext_en: I would be glad to get rid of them myself. But that is not our concern.

defs.def_en: If a situation or problem is your concern, it is something that you have a duty or responsibility to be involved with.

defs.def_cn: 公司，企业(通常用于描述其类型)

ext.ext_cn: 即使规模不算大，昆斯伯里托儿所至少办得很成功。
ext.ext_en: If not a large concern, Queensbury Nursery was at least a successful one.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a company or business as a concern, usually when you are describing what type of company or business it is.

ext.ext_cn: 在我看来，是官员们煽动了这场争斗。
ext.ext_en: As far as I'm concerned the officials incited the fight.

defs.def_en: You can say 'as far as I'm concerned' to indicate that you are giving your own opinion.

defs.def_cn: 就…而言，说到(用于表明所谈论的话题)

ext.ext_cn: 在要孩子方面，目前的趋势是女性要孩子要得比较晚。
ext.ext_en: As far as starting a family is concerned, the trend is for women having their children later in life.

defs.def_en: You can say as far as something is concerned to indicate the subject that you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 破产管理人总是希望在公司仍然正常运转的时候将其卖掉。
ext.ext_en: The receivers will always prefer to sell a business as a going concern.

defs.def_en: If a company is a going concern, it is actually doing business, rather than having stopped trading or not yet having started trading.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子受到任何伤害都会让我们非常担心。
ext.ext_en: Any injury to a child is a cause of great concern to us...

ext.ext_cn: 这次调查的结果备受关注。
ext.ext_en: The survey's findings are a matter of great concern.

defs.def_en: If something is of concern to someone, they find it worrying and unsatisfactory.

defs.def_cn: 对…重要的;与…有利害关系的

ext.ext_cn: 只要肯付款，付款方式对银行来说不是很重要。
ext.ext_en: How they are paid should be of little concern to the bank as long as they are paid.

defs.def_en: If something is of concern to you, it is important to you.
Someone's paramour is their lover.
A hatchback is a car with an extra door at the back which opens upwards.

ext.ext_cn: 蓝灰色的眼睛
ext.ext_en: ...bluish-grey eyes.

defs.def_en: Something that is bluish is slightly blue in colour.

defs.def_cn: (尤指北美或澳洲的)养牛人，牧牛工人，牧牛场场主
defs.def_en: A cattleman is a man who looks after or owns cattle, especially in North America or Australia.

ext.ext_cn: 这个摄影棚并不隔音。
ext.ext_en: The studio isn't soundproof.

defs.def_en: A soundproof room, door, or window is designed to prevent all sound from getting in or out.

ext.ext_cn: 我们已将家里的录音室作了隔音处理。
ext.ext_en: We've soundproofed our home studio...

ext.ext_cn: 狗被安置在一个隔音的房间里。
ext.ext_en: The dog was placed in a soundproofed room.

defs.def_en: If you soundproof a room, you line it with special materials to stop all sound from getting in or out.

ext.ext_cn: 漆面、衣柜和床头柜是浅咖啡色的。
ext.ext_en: The paintwork, the wardrobes and the bedside cupboards were coffee-cream.

defs.def_en: The paintwork of a building, room, or vehicle is the covering of paint on it, or the parts of it that are painted.
A chain saw is a big saw with teeth fixed in a chain that is driven round by a motor.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 低调的；谦逊的；不招摇的

ext.ext_cn: 他话不多，很有礼貌，为人谦和。
ext.ext_en: He's a man of few words, very polite and unassuming...

ext.ext_cn: 她很和善，不摆架子。
ext.ext_en: She has a gentle, unassuming manner.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as unassuming, you approve of them because they are quiet and do not try to appear important.
A predator is an animal that kills and eats other animals.

defs.def_cn: 掠夺者；掠夺成性的人（或组织）

ext.ext_en: The company is worried about takeovers by various predators.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to predatory people or organizations as predators .

defs.def_cn: （通常指通过专业人士作出的）外表的改观，美容，改头换面

ext.ext_en: She received a cosmetic makeover at a beauty salon as a birthday gift.

defs.def_en: If  a person or room is given a makeover, their appearance is improved, usually by an expert.

ext.ext_cn: 最大的变革发生在电视剧行业。
ext.ext_en: The biggest makeover has been in TV drama.

defs.def_en: If an organization or system is given a makeover, important changes are made in order to improve it.

ext.ext_cn: 微型潜艇
ext.ext_en: ...midget submarines.

defs.def_en: Midget is used to describe something which is very small.
A busker is a person who sings or plays music for money in streets and other public places.
