ext.ext_en: It's unconscionable for the government to do anything for a man who admits to smuggling 135 tons of cocaine into the United States.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unconscionable, you mean that the person responsible for it ought to be ashamed of it, especially because its effects are so great or severe.

ext.ext_cn: 本用速记法记笔记。
ext.ext_en: Ben took notes in shorthand.

defs.def_en: Shorthand is a quick way of writing and uses signs to represent words or syllables. Shorthand is used by secretaries and journalists to write down what someone is saying.

ext.ext_en: 'Third World' is an abstraction, a form of shorthand...

ext.ext_cn: 认为“他”是“他或她”的中性简称的这种说法，很多人已不再接受。
ext.ext_en: The fiction that 'he' is a neutral shorthand for 'he or she' is no longer acceptable to many.

defs.def_en: You can use shorthand to mean a quick or simple way of referring to something.
A wall-to-wall carpet covers the floor of a room completely.

defs.def_cn: 无处不在的;处处可见的

ext.ext_cn: 电视上铺天盖地的足球报道

defs.def_en: You can use wall-to-wall to describe something that fills or seems to fill all the available space.

ext.ext_en: Johnson stared goggle-eyed at Kravis' sumptuous quarters.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is goggle-eyed, you mean that they are very surprised or interested by something.
If you say that someone is goggle-eyed, you mean they watch television a lot.

ext.ext_cn: 他回来后注意到了他们的病状，于是配制了解毒剂。
ext.ext_en: When he returned, he noticed their sickness and prepared an antidote.

ext.ext_en: Massage is a wonderful antidote to stress.

defs.def_en: Something that is an antidote to a difficult or unpleasant situation helps you to overcome the situation.

ext.ext_cn: 同源词
ext.ext_en: ...cognate words.

ext.ext_en: They just sat there wittering about what lectures they had tomorrow.

ext.ext_en: They started wittering on about their last trip to Provence.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is wittering about something, you mean that they are talking a lot about things that you think are silly and boring.

ext.ext_en: The explosion caused little structural damage to the office towers themselves.

defs.def_en: Structural means relating to or affecting the structure of something.

ext.ext_cn: 一帮女人用手提包砸他，用鞋尖踢他。
ext.ext_en: A mob of women laid into him with handbags and pointed shoes...

ext.ext_cn: 她以前常常责备加雷思花钱如何如何厉害。
ext.ext_en: She used to lay into Gareth about how much he spent.

defs.def_en: To lay into someone or something means to start attacking or criticizing them.

ext.ext_cn: 录用标准取决于年龄和工作年限。
ext.ext_en: The cut-off point depends on age and length of employment...

ext.ext_cn: 还没有宣布登记的截止日期。
ext.ext_en: The cut-off date for registering is yet to be announced...

defs.def_en: A cut-off or a cut-off point is the level or limit at which you decide that something should stop happening.

ext.ext_cn: 供给的全面中断会使得该国经济瘫痪。
ext.ext_en: A total cut-off of supplies would cripple the country's economy...

ext.ext_cn: 美国拒绝停止武器供应。
ext.ext_en: The United States resisted an arms cutoff.

defs.def_en: The cut-off of a supply or service is the complete stopping of the supply or service.

ext.ext_cn: 房子都一模一样——方方正正、临近街道、需要粉刷。
ext.ext_en: The houses were all the same — square, close to the street, needing paint...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的电脑其实都一样。
ext.ext_en: In essence, all computers are the same...

defs.def_en: If two or more things, actions, or qualities are the same, or if one is the same as another, they are very like each other in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 我的意思是它是一种人际关系，就如同婚姻也是一种人际关系一样。
ext.ext_en: I mean, it's a relationship, the same as a marriage is a relationship...

ext.ext_cn: 你希望离开赛场的时候自己的球队取得了胜利，同样我也想赢了一场球赛再回家。
ext.ext_en: I want to go home having won a game of football the same as you leave the ground and you want to go away with your team having won...

defs.def_en: If something is happening the same as something else, the two things are happening in a way that is similar or exactly the same.

ext.ext_cn: 伯纳德和阿莱特在同一家机构工作。
ext.ext_en: Bernard works at the same institution as Arlette...

ext.ext_cn: 让所有人同时聚在一起是不可能的。
ext.ext_en: It's impossible to get everybody together at the same time...

defs.def_en: You use same to indicate that you are referring to only one place, time, or thing, and not to different ones.

defs.def_cn: 无变化的;一成不变的;千篇一律的

ext.ext_cn: 取材自同一原材料意味着啤酒的口味始终如一。
ext.ext_en: Taking ingredients from the same source means the beers stay the same...

ext.ext_en: Only 17% said the economy would improve, but 25% believed it would stay the same.

defs.def_en: Something that is still the same has not changed in any way.

ext.ext_cn: 我们作出了对于我们而言正确的决定。其他父母也必须这么做。
ext.ext_en: We made the decision which was right for us. Other parents must do the same...

ext.ext_cn: 美国的小型专业书店经营状况不错。小型出版社也是如此。
ext.ext_en: In the United States small specialised bookshops survive quite well. The same applies to small publishers...

defs.def_en: You use the same to refer to something that has previously been mentioned or suggested.

defs.def_cn: (用于商业信件、法案等文件中)上述事物，上述情况

ext.ext_cn: 腕表: 100英镑。在其上刻字: 15英镑。
ext.ext_en: Wrist watches: £100. Inscription of same: £15.

defs.def_en: You use same to refer to something that has already been mentioned in a document such as a business letter or bill.

ext.ext_cn: “很高兴见到你，”迈克尔说。“我也是，”玛丽·安说。
ext.ext_en: 'Nice to meet you,' said Michael. 'Same here,' said Mary Ann...

ext.ext_cn: “我讨厌进商店。”——“我也一样，”威廉说。
ext.ext_en: 'I hate going into stores.' — 'Same here,' said William.

defs.def_en: You say 'same here' in order to suggest that you feel the same way about something as the person who has just spoken to you, or that you have done the same thing.

defs.def_cn: 你也一样，你也是(用于致以同样的祝愿)

ext.ext_en: 'Goodbye, then, and thanks. Good luck.' — 'The same to you.'

defs.def_en: You say 'same to you' in response to someone who wishes you well with something.

ext.ext_cn: 再给罗杰来一杯，伊莫金，我也再来一份同样的。
ext.ext_en: Give Roger another pint, Imogen, and I'll have the same again.

ext.ext_cn: 我准备等他到那儿时付给他美元，纯属私人安排。不过同样也是非法的。
ext.ext_en: I arranged to pay him the dollars when he got there, a purely private arrangement. All the same, it was illegal...

ext.ext_cn: 他的心不在桌子上的那一摞试卷上，尽管如此，他还是拽过来开始评阅。
ext.ext_en: He was unable to pay attention to the papers on his desk. Just the same, he pulled over the stack of papers and started to examine them...

defs.def_en: You can say all the same or just the same to introduce a statement which indicates that a situation or your opinion has not changed, in spite of what has happened or what has just been said.

defs.def_cn: 对我完全一样;对我毫无区别;我都无所谓

ext.ext_cn: 我留不留胡子都无所谓。
ext.ext_en: Whether I've got a moustache or not it's all the same to me...

ext.ext_cn: 善意的谎言和谎言之间有什么不同？我是说，对于我而言二者完全一样。
ext.ext_en: What's the difference between a white lie and a lie? I mean, it's all the same to me.

defs.def_en: If you say 'It's all the same to me', you mean that you do not care which of several things happens or is chosen.

ext.ext_cn: 幸运的是，南希的父亲就是她的律师。
ext.ext_en: Luckily, Nancy's father and her attorney were one and the same person...

ext.ext_cn: 我愿意为该党效力，因为它的利益和我的利益完全一致。
ext.ext_en: I'm willing to work for the party because its interests and my interests are one and the same.

defs.def_en: When two or more people or things are thought to be separate and you say that they are one and the same, you mean that they are in fact one single person or thing.

defs.def_cn: 正是这个;同一个人(或事物)

ext.ext_cn: “这个叫索特里的小伙子，他是约翰·索特里吗？”——“是的，先生。正是他。”
ext.ext_en: 'This Sawtry guy, he is John Sawtry?' — 'Yes, sir. The very same.'

defs.def_en: You say 'the same' or 'the very same' in reply to someone's question when you are saying that they have identified a person or thing correctly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (机器、装置等)高级的，精密的;(方法)复杂的

ext.ext_cn: 蜜蜂之间所用的交流方式是昆虫中最为复杂的方式之一。
ext.ext_en: Honeybees use one of the most sophisticated communication systems of any insect.

ext.ext_cn: 一架崭新的大型英式精密望远镜
ext.ext_en: ...a large and sophisticated new British telescope.

defs.def_en: A sophisticated machine, device, or method is more advanced or complex than others.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 善于社交的;高雅时髦的;见过世面的

ext.ext_cn: 克劳德是一个很有魅力、见多识广的伙伴。
ext.ext_en: Claude was a charming, sophisticated companion...

ext.ext_cn: 最近她的品位越发优雅时髦起来。
ext.ext_en: Recently her tastes have become more sophisticated.

defs.def_en: Someone who is sophisticated is comfortable in social situations and knows about culture, fashion, and other matters that are considered socially important.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 精明老练的;老于世故的

ext.ext_cn: 这些人是观察外交政策领域动向的行家里手。
ext.ext_en: These people are very sophisticated observers of the foreign policy scene.

defs.def_en: A sophisticated person is intelligent and knows a lot, so that they are able to understand complicated situations.

ext.ext_cn: 400 名德国最高级别的军官
ext.ext_en: ...400 of Germany's top-ranking military officials...

ext.ext_cn: 顶尖的相扑选手可获得超级明星的地位。
ext.ext_en: Top-ranking sumo wrestlers attain superstar status.

defs.def_en: A top-ranking person is someone who has a very high rank or status in a particular organization or field of activity.

ext.ext_cn: 戈德史密斯修理了屋顶，以确保房屋能够抗风。
ext.ext_en: Goldsmith has repaired the roof to ensure the house is wind-proof...

ext.ext_cn: 弥补地震造成的损失需要超过70亿美元。
ext.ext_en: The cost of repairing earthquake damage could be more than seven-thousand-million dollars...

defs.def_en: If you repair something that has been damaged or is not working properly, you mend it.

ext.ext_cn: 政府不断努力弥补因该部长接受采访带来的不良影响。
ext.ext_en: The government continued to try to repair the damage caused by the minister's interview...

ext.ext_cn: 最首要和最重要的是挽救我和父亲的关系。
ext.ext_en: The first and most important thing was to repair my relationship with my father.

defs.def_en: If you repair a relationship or someone's reputation after it has been damaged, you do something to improve it.

ext.ext_cn: 许多妇女懂得怎样修自己的车。
ext.ext_en: Many women know how to carry out repairs on their cars...

ext.ext_cn: 许多建筑需要整修。
ext.ext_en: Many of the buildings are in need of repair...

defs.def_en: A repair is something that you do to mend a machine, building, piece of clothing, or other thing that has been damaged or is not working properly.

ext.ext_cn: 然后我们就去凉亭吃午饭了。
ext.ext_en: We then repaired to the pavilion for lunch.

defs.def_en: If someone repairs to a particular place, they go there.

defs.def_cn: (建筑等)维修良好/糟糕，状况良好/ 糟糕

ext.ext_cn: 埃塔尔的修道士把修道院维护得很好。
ext.ext_en: The monks of Ettal keep the abbey in good repair...

ext.ext_cn: 公路的部分路段路况很差。
ext.ext_en: The road was in bad repair in parts.

defs.def_en: If something such as a building is in good repair, it is in good condition. If it is in bad repair, it is in bad condition.

defs.def_cn: 尚无证据的；尚未证实的

ext.ext_cn: 这一理论尚无证据支持。
ext.ext_en: It was a theory unsupported by evidence...

ext.ext_cn: 这些信里有一些未经证实的指控。
ext.ext_en: The letters contained unsupported allegations.

defs.def_en: If a statement or theory is unsupported, there is no evidence which proves that it is true or correct.

ext.ext_cn: 无生活依靠的单身母亲是福利救济申领者中人数增长最快的群体之一。
ext.ext_en: Unsupported mothers are one of the fastest-growing groups of welfare claimants.

defs.def_en: An unsupported person does not have anyone to provide them with money and the things they need.

defs.def_cn: 无承托的;无撑扶的;无支撑的

ext.ext_cn: 里斯本阿茹达宫那面巨大的、无承托的墙
ext.ext_en: ...the vast unsupported wall of the Ajuda Palace in Lisbon.

ext.ext_cn: 小孩在无人扶持的情况下迈出的第一步
ext.ext_en: ...the child's first unsupported step.

defs.def_en: An unsupported building or person is not being physically supported or held up by anything.

ext.ext_cn: 他家在牛津郡有一座乡间宅第。
ext.ext_en: His family have a country seat in Oxfordshire.

defs.def_en: A country seat is a large house with land in the country which is owned by someone who also owns a house in a town.

ext.ext_cn: 军队在皇宫附近向示威人群开枪，造成大量伤亡。
ext.ext_en: Troops fired on demonstrators near the Royal Palace causing many casualties.

defs.def_en: A casualty is a person who is injured or killed in a war or in an accident.

ext.ext_cn: 菲亚特一直是经济萧条中损失最惨重的公司之一。
ext.ext_en: Fiat has been one of the greatest casualties of the recession.

defs.def_en: A casualty of a particular event or situation is a person or a thing that has suffered badly as a result of that event or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我被送往圣·托马斯医院的急救室。
ext.ext_en: I was taken to casualty at St Thomas's Hospital.

defs.def_en: Casualty is the part of a hospital where people who have severe injuries or sudden illnesses are taken for emergency treatment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有趣的;引人入胜的;奇怪的

ext.ext_cn: 这本引人入胜的书既有思想性又富知识性。
ext.ext_en: This intriguing book is both thoughtful and informative.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as intriguing, you mean that it is interesting or strange.

ext.ext_cn: 这项技术需要在皮肤上切一个小口。
ext.ext_en: The technique involves making a tiny incision in the skin.

defs.def_en: An incision is a sharp cut made in something, for example by a surgeon who is operating on a patient.

defs.def_cn: 时尚商店；时装店；精品店
defs.def_en: A boutique is a small shop that sells fashionable clothes, shoes, or jewellery.

ext.ext_cn: 它的地理位置引起了海外商家的兴趣。
ext.ext_en: Its geographical location stimulated overseas mercantile enterprise.

ext.ext_cn: 广袤的地理区域
ext.ext_en: ...a vast geographical area.

defs.def_en: Geographical or geographic means concerned with or relating to geography.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 意志坚强的;坚持己见的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个有决心有毅力的人。
ext.ext_en: He is a very determined and strong-willed person.

defs.def_en: Someone who is strong-willed has a lot of determination and always tries to do what they want, even though other people may advise them not to.
A phosphate is a chemical compound that contains phosphorus. Phosphates are often used in fertilizers.
Dressmaking is the activity or job of making clothes for women or girls.
A flowerpot is a container that is used for growing plants.

ext.ext_cn: 她咬着左手的拇指尖，眼睛也不看我。
ext.ext_en: She bit the tip of her left thumb, not looking at me.

defs.def_en: Your thumb is the short thick part on the side of your hand next to your four fingers.
The thumb of a glove is the part which a person's thumb fits into.

defs.def_cn: (站在路边，伸出手，拇指向上)请求搭便车，拦车

ext.ext_cn: 你或许会对这个消息感兴趣，有个和罗里描述的一模一样的小男孩搭便车到了霍斯。
ext.ext_en: It may interest you to know that a boy answering Rory's description thumbed a ride to Howth...

ext.ext_cn: 伸手搭便车曾经给人以轻松随意的形象。
ext.ext_en: Thumbing a lift had once a carefree, easy-going image.

defs.def_en: If you thumb a lift or thumb a ride, you stand by the side of the road holding out your thumb until a driver stops and gives you a lift.

ext.ext_cn: 这个新住宅区是显得有点扎眼，还是和环境融为一体？
ext.ext_en: Does the new housing stick out like a sore thumb or blend into its surroundings?...

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲人到了日本会极为惹眼。
ext.ext_en: In Japan a European stands out like a sore thumb.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something sticks out like a sore thumb or stands out like a sore thumb, you are emphasizing that they are very noticeable, usually because they are unusual or inappropriate.

ext.ext_cn: 想到将要无所事事，他就非常害怕。
ext.ext_en: The prospect of waiting around just twiddling his thumbs was appalling...

ext.ext_cn: 政府不愿意看到毕业生领着救济金却什么也不干。
ext.ext_en: The Government cannot expect graduates to twiddle their thumbs on the dole.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is twiddling their thumbs, you mean that they do not have anything to do and are waiting for something to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 看见我母亲完完全全受我父亲的控制，我心里别提有多难受。
ext.ext_en: I cannot tell you what pain I feel when I see how much my mother is under my father's thumb...

ext.ext_cn: 她把雷切尔牢牢地抓在手心里。
ext.ext_en: She has Rachel firmly under her thumb.

defs.def_en: If you are under someone's thumb, you are under their control, or very heavily influenced by them.

defs.def_cn: （授予比赛中虽未获得正式名次但成绩优秀者的）荣誉奖
defs.def_en: If something that you do in a competition is given an honourable mention, it receives special praise from the judges although it does not actually win a prize.

ext.ext_cn: 他的进球一气呵成。
ext.ext_en: He scores goals with remarkable consistency...

ext.ext_cn: 外交政策总是缺乏连贯性。
ext.ext_en: There's always a lack of consistency in matters of foreign policy.

defs.def_en: Consistency is the quality or condition of being consistent.

ext.ext_cn: 用水把涂料稀释到牛奶般的稠度。
ext.ext_en: Dilute the paint with water until it is the consistency of milk...

ext.ext_cn: 我加了一点儿牛奶，好让面团稠度适中。
ext.ext_en: I added a little milk to mix the dough to the right consistency.

defs.def_en: The consistency of a substance is how thick or smooth it is.

defs.def_cn: (主要为钢琴演奏的)夜曲，梦幻曲

ext.ext_cn: 肖邦的降 B 调钢琴梦幻曲
ext.ext_en: ...Chopin's Piano Nocturne in B flat.

defs.def_en: A nocturne is a short gentle piece of music, often one written to be played on the piano.

ext.ext_cn: 他轻声地慢慢数着数。
ext.ext_en: He was counting slowly under his breath...

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩数到20，然后举起双筒望远镜。
ext.ext_en: Brian counted to twenty and lifted his binoculars.

defs.def_en: When you count, you say all the numbers one after another up to a particular number.

ext.ext_cn: 在上一次家族婚礼上，乔治的妻子清点了家族成员的总数。
ext.ext_en: At the last family wedding, George's wife counted the total number in the family...

ext.ext_cn: 我数了数那些钱，有500多英镑。
ext.ext_en: I counted the money. It was more than five hundred pounds...

defs.def_en: If you count all the things in a group, you add them up in order to find how many there are.

ext.ext_cn: 上个月全民投票的最终计票数显示支持率为56.7%。
ext.ext_en: The final count in last month's referendum showed 56.7 per cent in favour...

ext.ext_cn: 根据最近清点的结果，里米尼警方已拘押了247人。
ext.ext_en: At the last count the police in the Rimini area had 247 people in custody.

defs.def_en: A count is the action of counting a particular set of things, or the number that you get when you have counted them.

ext.ext_cn: 喝一两杯葡萄酒不会增加多少热量。
ext.ext_en: A glass or two of wine will not significantly add to the calorie count...

ext.ext_cn: 我丈夫的精子数很低。
ext.ext_en: My husband had a very low sperm count.

defs.def_en: See also:blood count;pollen count;You use count when referring to the level or amount of something that someone or something has.

ext.ext_cn: 屏住气息数五下，然后慢慢地呼气。
ext.ext_en: Hold your breath for a count of five, then slowly breathe out...

ext.ext_cn: 门多萨朝帕拉西奥斯的下巴猛地一记右手拳将其打倒在地，在数点八下后这场拳击比赛结束了。
ext.ext_en: The fight ended when Mendoza landed a hard right to the chin of Palacios, who went down for a count of eight.

defs.def_en: You use count in expressions such as a count of three or a count of ten when you are measuring a length of time by counting slowly up to a certain number.

ext.ext_cn: 慈善机构从哪里筹得捐款的确无关紧要：关键是钱是怎么花的。
ext.ext_en: Surely it doesn't matter where charities get their money from: what counts is what they do with it...

ext.ext_cn: 就好像是你的意见、你的好恶根本不重要似的。
ext.ext_en: It's as if your opinions, your likes and dislikes just don't count...

defs.def_en: If something or someone counts for something or counts, they are important or valuable.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在特定环境中或在特定规则下)将…看作，将…视为

ext.ext_cn: 关于沙漠的界定，众说纷纭。
ext.ext_en: No one agrees on what counts as a desert...

ext.ext_cn: 任何无法辨认的词都将视为错字。
ext.ext_en: Any word that's not legible will be counted as wrong...

defs.def_en: If something counts or is counted as a particular thing, it is regarded as being that thing, especially in particular circumstances or under particular rules.

ext.ext_cn: 数字低于7%，只是因为统计数据没有把不能算作劳动力的人口包括在内。
ext.ext_en: It's under 7 percent only because statistics don't count the people who aren't qualified to be in the work force...

ext.ext_cn: 他们入狱前的那些年不算在服刑期之内。
ext.ext_en: The years before their arrival in prison are not counted as part of their sentence.

defs.def_en: If you count something when you are making a calculation, you include it in that calculation.

ext.ext_cn: “你喝苏格兰威士忌，”她说。“所有共和党人都喝苏格兰威士忌。”——“都说错了。我是民主党人，我喝波旁威士忌。”
ext.ext_en: 'You drink Scotch,' she said. 'All Republicans drink Scotch.' — 'Wrong on both counts. I'm a Democrat, and I drink bourbon.'

defs.def_en: You can use count to refer to one or more points that you are considering. For example, if someone is wrong on two counts, they are wrong in two ways.

ext.ext_cn: 他被大陪审团以两项谋杀罪名起诉。
ext.ext_en: He was indicted by a grand jury on two counts of murder.

defs.def_en: In law, a count is one of a number of charges brought against someone in court.

defs.def_cn: 记录…的数目/记不清…的数目

ext.ext_cn: 当局称直升机搜查该地区时尸体仍在陆续被发现，他们无法提供具体数目。
ext.ext_en: The authorities say they are not able to keep count of the bodies still being found as helicopters search the area...

ext.ext_cn: 她都记不清接受过多少次采访了。
ext.ext_en: She'd lost count of the interviews she'd been called for.

defs.def_en: If you keep count of a number of things, you note or keep a record of how many have occurred. If you lose count of a number of things, you cannot remember how many have occurred.
If someone is out for the count, they are unconscious or very deeply asleep.

ext.ext_cn: 丑闻中涉及的那些从中受益的人必须准备公开表明态度了。
ext.ext_en: Those involved and benefiting from the scandal must be prepared to stand up and be counted.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone should stand up and be counted, you mean that they should say publicly what they think, and not hide it or be ashamed of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 交通拥挤，车流缓慢。
ext.ext_en: The traffic is heavy and slow...

ext.ext_cn: 使用自动搅拌器时应该选用慢挡。
ext.ext_en: Electric whisks should be used on a slow speed.

defs.def_en: Something that is slow moves, happens, or is done without much speed.

defs.def_cn: (用于非正式英语中)缓慢地，慢吞吞地

ext.ext_cn: 我走得越来越慢。
ext.ext_en: I began to walk slower and slower...

ext.ext_cn: 我们开着车去了那里，一路上开得很慢。
ext.ext_en: We got there by driving slow all the way.

defs.def_en: In informal English, slower is used to mean 'at a slower speed' and slowest is used to mean 'at the slowest speed'. In non-standard English, slow is used to mean 'with little speed'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 费时间的;时间长的;迟缓的

ext.ext_cn: 颁发护照的过程非常缓慢。
ext.ext_en: The distribution of passports has been a slow process.

defs.def_en: Something that is slow takes a long time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 国际社会对这次危机反应迟缓。
ext.ext_en: The world community has been slow to respond to the crisis...

ext.ext_cn: 我下决心有些慢。
ext.ext_en: I've been a bit slow in making up my mind.

defs.def_en: If someone is slow to do something, they do it after a delay.

ext.ext_cn: 轰炸的速度明显慢了下来。
ext.ext_en: The rate of bombing has slowed considerably...

ext.ext_cn: 她放慢车速，开始驶上一条狭窄的道路。
ext.ext_en: She slowed the car and began driving up a narrow road...

defs.def_en: If something slows or if you slow it, it starts to move or happen more slowly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的脑袋受过撞击，从那以后，他的反应变得有些迟钝。
ext.ext_en: He got hit on the head and he's been a bit slow since.

defs.def_en: Someone who is slow is not very clever and takes a long time to understand things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 呆滞的;不景气的;沉闷的

ext.ext_cn: 事情变得有点沉闷无聊的时候，不要胆怯。
ext.ext_en: Don't be faint-hearted when things seem a bit slow or boring...

ext.ext_cn: 这个岛太沉闷了，不合她的胃口。
ext.ext_en: The island is too slow for her liking.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation, place, or activity as slow, you mean that it is not very exciting.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If a clock or watch is slow, it shows a time that is earlier than the correct time.

defs.def_cn: 工时(每人每小时的工作量)

ext.ext_cn: 修复工作历时4年，耗费近4,000工时。
ext.ext_en: The restoration took almost 4,000 man-hours over four years.

ext.ext_cn: 当每个工时的产量提高时
ext.ext_en: ...when output per man-hour is raised.

defs.def_en: A man-hour is the average amount of work that one person can do in an hour. Man-hours are used to estimate how long jobs take, or how many people are needed to do a job in a particular time.

defs.def_cn: （唐突地或带有威胁性地）走近跟…攀谈，上前与…搭讪

ext.ext_cn: 一个男的在街上和我搭讪。
ext.ext_en: A man had accosted me in the street.

defs.def_en: If someone accosts another person, especially a stranger, they stop them or go up to them and speak to them in a way that seems rude or threatening.

defs.def_cn: 蔬菜杂烩（由西红柿、洋葱、茄子、小胡瓜、胡椒等蔬菜烹制成的菜）

ext.ext_cn: 除了羊肉和蔬菜杂烩之外，你本应再准备点儿别的。
ext.ext_en: You should have prepared something other than lamb and ratatouille.

ext.ext_cn: 联邦领导人继续争取促成停火协议。
ext.ext_en: Federal leaders continued their efforts to secure a ceasefire...

ext.ext_cn: 出色的成绩帮助格雷厄姆拿下了这份工作。
ext.ext_en: Graham's achievements helped secure him the job.

defs.def_en: If you secure something that you want or need, you obtain it, often after a lot of effort.

defs.def_cn: 使…免遭攻击(或伤害);保卫;保护

ext.ext_cn: 工作人员从监狱的主要区域撤出，但外围仍派人守卫。
ext.ext_en: Staff withdrew from the main part of the prison but secured the perimeter...

ext.ext_cn: 棚屋由一个搭钩和U型扣件固定着。
ext.ext_en: The shed was secured by a hasp and staple fastener.

defs.def_en: If you secure a place, you make it safe from harm or attack.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们应该确保家里从今往后尽量锁紧门窗。
ext.ext_en: We shall make sure our home is as secure as possible from now on.

defs.def_en: A secure place is tightly locked or well protected, so that people cannot enter it or leave it.

ext.ext_cn: 他帮她关上箱子，然后将帆布带子尽量系紧。
ext.ext_en: He helped her close the cases up, and then he secured the canvas straps as tight as they would go...

ext.ext_cn: 框架用横杆牢牢固定在后墙上。
ext.ext_en: The frames are secured by horizontal rails to the back wall.

defs.def_en: If you secure an object, you fasten it firmly to another object.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 固定不动的;绑紧的;系牢的

ext.ext_cn: 检查一下连接处是否稳固及木料是否结实。
ext.ext_en: Check joints are secure and the wood is sound...

ext.ext_cn: 架子的牢固程度取决于固件。
ext.ext_en: Shelves are only as secure as their fixings.

defs.def_en: If an object is secure, it is fixed firmly in position.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 工会要求稳定的工资和工作。
ext.ext_en: ...trade union demands for secure wages and employment...

ext.ext_cn: 老年人渴望有一个更稳定、更可预见的未来。
ext.ext_en: Senior citizens long for a more predictable and secure future.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a job as secure, it is certain not to change or end.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他决定给家人一个牢固坚实的生活基础。
ext.ext_en: He was determined to give his family a secure and solid base.

defs.def_en: A secure base or foundation is strong and reliable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 安心的;心里踏实的;无忧无虑的

ext.ext_cn: 和他在一起的时候，她感到一种被人保护的安全感。
ext.ext_en: She felt secure and protected when she was with him...

ext.ext_cn: 政府只有有足够的把够了才会愿意为和平作出让步。
ext.ext_en: The government must feel secure before it will be willing to make the concessions needed for peace.

defs.def_en: If you feel secure, you feel safe and happy and are not worried about life.

ext.ext_cn: 这笔贷款以你的房子作为抵押。
ext.ext_en: The loan is secured against your home...

ext.ext_cn: 他的主要任务是筹集足够的资金以偿还抵押贷款。
ext.ext_en: His main task is to raise enough finance to repay secured loans.

defs.def_en: If a loan is secured, the person who lends the money may take property such as a house from the person who borrows the money if they fail to repay it.

defs.def_cn: 骨瓷（含骨灰的精细瓷器）
defs.def_en: Bone china is a kind of thin china that contains powdered bone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: “我是个邪恶的人，”他说。
ext.ext_en: 'I am a sinful man,' he said.

ext.ext_cn: 这是个邪恶的世界
ext.ext_en: ...this is a sinful world...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as sinful, you mean that they are wicked or immoral.

defs.def_cn: (尤用于恼火时加强语气)可恶的，该死的

ext.ext_cn: 这张照片真是难看得要死。
ext.ext_en: This is such a flipping horrible picture.

ext.ext_cn: 我昨天甚至把那些可恶的床单给洗了。
ext.ext_en: I even washed the flipping bed sheets yesterday.

defs.def_en: Some people use flipping to emphasize what they are saying, especially when they are annoyed.

ext.ext_cn: 睾酮没有提高男性勃起或达到性高潮的能力。
ext.ext_en: Testosterone does not increase their erectile or orgasmic ability.

defs.def_en: Orgasmic means relating to a sexual orgasm.

defs.def_cn: 令人非常愉悦的；使人极为兴奋的

ext.ext_cn: 他在一阵阵极度亢奋的狂喜中猛拨吉他的琴颈
ext.ext_en: ...jerking the neck of his guitar in orgasmic fits of ecstasy.

defs.def_en: Some people refer to things they find extremely enjoyable or exciting as orgasmic .

ext.ext_cn: 他们向警方发出了最后通牒，要求肃清整个地区的种族主义暴徒，否则他们将自行采取行动。
ext.ext_en: They issued an ultimatum to the police to rid an area of racist attackers, or they will take the law into their own hands.

ext.ext_cn: 期限为48小时的最后通牒
ext.ext_en: ...a 48-hour ultimatum.

defs.def_en: An ultimatum is a warning to someone that unless they act in a particular way, action will be taken against them.

defs.def_cn: （调味或药用的）芳草;香草;药草
defs.def_en: A herb is a plant whose leaves are used in cooking to add flavour to food, or as a medicine.

defs.def_cn: 不被人注意的；未被认出的

ext.ext_cn: 据信他在伦敦东区的夜总会当过看门人而没被认出来。
ext.ext_en: He is believed to have worked unrecognised as a doorman at East End clubs...

ext.ext_cn: 实际上我认识她，但是我身着工作服，与她擦身而过的时候却没被认出来。
ext.ext_en: I actually knew her, but in overalls I passed unrecognised.

defs.def_en: If someone does something unrecognized, nobody knows or recognizes them while they do it.

ext.ext_cn: 人们有可能察觉不到体温的过低。
ext.ext_en: There is the possibility that hypothermia can go unrecognized...

ext.ext_cn: 人们的家里一定有很多不起眼的花瓶、碗或瓶子。
ext.ext_en: There must be many vases, bowls or bottles sitting unrecognised in people's homes...

defs.def_en: If something is unrecognized, people are not aware of it.

defs.def_cn: 不被承认的；不被认可的

ext.ext_cn: 努力和天赋经常不被认可，也得不到回报。
ext.ext_en: Hard work and talent so often go unrecognised and unrewarded...

ext.ext_cn: 她病逝了，而她一生的工作却没有得到认可。
ext.ext_en: She became ill and died with her life's work unrecognised...

defs.def_en: If you or your achievements or qualities are unrecognized, you have not been properly appreciated or acknowledged by other people for what you have done.

ext.ext_cn: 未被官方承认的伊斯兰原教旨主义运动
ext.ext_en: ...the unrecognised Islamic Fundamentalist Movement...

ext.ext_cn: 当地的主管机构可能会拒绝向非官方的武术组织出租设备。
ext.ext_en: Local authorities are likely to refuse to hire facilities to unrecognised martial arts organisations.

defs.def_en: An unrecognized meeting, agreement, or political party is not formally acknowledged as legal or valid by the authorities.

defs.def_cn: 不顾他人地;见利忘义地

ext.ext_cn: 他指责一些主要政党从这一局势中牟取私利。
ext.ext_en: He accused the mainstream political parties of cynically exploiting this situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我坚信我们的策略正在被人存心恶意操纵。
ext.ext_en: I firmly believe our strategy is being deliberately, cynically manipulated.

defs.def_en: See also:cynical;If you say that someone is cynically doing something, you mean they are doing it to benefit themselves and they do not care that they are deceiving, harming, or using people.

ext.ext_cn: 救援人员已经搜遍了30平方英里的范围。
ext.ext_en: Rescue crews had scoured an area of 30 square miles...

ext.ext_cn: 我们仔细查阅电话簿以寻找线索。
ext.ext_en: We scoured the telephone directory for clues.

defs.def_en: If you scour something such as a place or a book, you make a thorough search of it to try to find what you are looking for.

ext.ext_cn: 他决定把水池擦干净。
ext.ext_en: He decided to scour the sink.

defs.def_en: If you scour something such as a sink, floor, or pan, you clean its surface by rubbing it hard with something rough.

defs.def_cn: （地点、系统、设备等之间的）连接，接通

ext.ext_cn: 水和电都可以接通，设施也很不错。
ext.ext_en: Water and electric hook-ups are available and facilities are good.

defs.def_en: A hook-up is a connection between two places, systems, or pieces of equipment.

defs.def_cn: （通常可供多人同时就座的）长条形软座
defs.def_en: A banquette is a long, low, cushioned seat. Banquettes are usually long enough for more than one person to sit on at a time.
Geography is the study of the countries of the world and of such things as the land, seas, climate, towns, and population.

ext.ext_cn: 熟悉当地地形的警察
ext.ext_en: ...policemen who knew the local geography.

ext.ext_cn: 领略加勒比地区历史、地理及文化的图片之旅
ext.ext_en: ...a pictorial journey through the history, geography and culture of the Caribbean.

defs.def_en: The geography of a place is the way that features such as rivers, mountains, towns, or streets are arranged within it.
In some religions, hell is the place where the Devil lives, and where wicked people are sent to be punished when they die. Hell is usually imagined as being under the ground and full of flames.

defs.def_cn: 令人痛苦的境况（或经历）;地狱般的地方

ext.ext_cn: 地狱般的西伯利亚劳改营
ext.ext_en: ...the hell of the Siberian labor camps...

ext.ext_cn: 恃强欺弱者能让你的日子像活地狱。
ext.ext_en: Bullies can make your life hell.

defs.def_en: If you say that a particular situation or place is hell, you are emphasizing that it is extremely unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: （用于咒骂或加强语气）见鬼，该死

ext.ext_cn: “绝对不行！”医生厉声道。
ext.ext_en: 'Hell, no!' the doctor snapped.

defs.def_en: Hell is used by some people when they are angry or excited, or when they want to emphasize what they are saying.

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词或一些副词后表示强调）非常，很

ext.ext_cn: 这些人可能携有武器，但他们很显然没有受过训练。
ext.ext_en: The men might be armed, but they sure as hell weren't trained...

ext.ext_cn: 我气坏了。
ext.ext_en: I am angry as hell.

defs.def_en: You can use as hell after adjectives or some adverbs to emphasize the adjective or adverb.

ext.ext_cn: 她觉得自己会死在遍地毒蛇的沙丘中。她说：“这简直是人间地狱。”
ext.ext_en: She believed she would die in the snake-infested sand dunes. She said: 'It was hell on earth'.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place or a situation is hell on earth or a hell on earth, you are emphasizing that it is extremely unpleasant or that it causes great suffering.

defs.def_cn: 只是为了好玩;玩玩而已

ext.ext_cn: 经理们似乎只为了寻个乐子就动辄花上几百万。
ext.ext_en: Managers seem to be spending millions just for the hell of it.

ext.ext_cn: 只是为了好玩而破坏公物是很愚蠢的行为。
ext.ext_en: It was stupid, just vandalism for the hell of it.

defs.def_en: If someone does something for the hell of it, or just for the hell of it, they do it for fun or for no particular reason.

ext.ext_cn: 他说他宁可永远坐在那里，也不会付给他们一分钱。
ext.ext_en: He says he'll sit there until hell freezes over before he'll pay them one cent.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will do something until hell freezes over, you are emphasizing that you will do it for a very long time or for ever.

defs.def_cn: （用于名词后表示强调）极糟的，坏透的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个坏透了的小孩。
ext.ext_en: He's a child from hell...

ext.ext_cn: 她是个坏得冒水的泼妇。
ext.ext_en: She is the bitch from hell.

defs.def_en: You can use from hell after a noun when you are emphasizing that something or someone is extremely unpleasant or evil.

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲在报纸上看到这个消息后把我骂了个狗血淋头。
ext.ext_en: My father saw this in the newspaper and he gave me absolute hell.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone gives you hell, you are emphasizing that they shout at you very angrily because of something you have done wrong.

defs.def_cn: 给…带来大麻烦;使…吃足苦头

ext.ext_cn: 告诉你吧，我的背可让我受够罪了！
ext.ext_en: My back's giving me hell, let me tell you!...

ext.ext_cn: 这些孩子让她吃足了苦头，特别是那些年龄大一点的男孩子。
ext.ext_en: The children give her hell, particularly the older boys.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is giving you hell, you are emphasizing that it is causing you a lot of trouble or pain.

ext.ext_cn: “嘿，你给我有多远滚多远！”他昂首阔步走出了房间。
ext.ext_en: 'Well, you can go to hell!' He swept out of the room.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to go to hell, you are angrily telling them to go away and leave you alone.

defs.def_cn: （表示不屑）见你的鬼去，去你的

ext.ext_cn: 让彼得见鬼去吧。这是我的钱，我想留给谁就留给谁。
ext.ext_en: Peter can go to hell. It's my money and I'll leave it to who I want...

ext.ext_cn: 我想怎么干就怎么干，让他们全都见鬼去吧。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to do as I please and let 'em all go to hell.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone can go to hell, you are emphasizing angrily that you do not care about them and that they will not stop you doing what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 第一匹马往往跑得很快，会碰到几根横杆，但不会碰落。
ext.ext_en: The first horse often goes hell for leather, hits a few fences but gets away with it...

ext.ext_cn: 他们动作飞快，想尽量多录一点。
ext.ext_en: They've been going hell for leather, trying to record as much as they can.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is going hell for leather, you are emphasizing that they are doing something or are moving very quickly and perhaps carelessly.

ext.ext_cn: “我会自己去。”——“绝对不可以！”
ext.ext_en: 'I'll go myself.' — 'Like hell you will!'

defs.def_en: Some people say like hell to emphasize that they strongly disagree with you or are strongly opposed to what you say.

ext.ext_cn: 疼死了。
ext.ext_en: It hurts like hell...

ext.ext_cn: 我想她想得要命。
ext.ext_en: I missed her like hell.

defs.def_en: Some people use like hell to emphasize how strong an action or quality is.

ext.ext_cn: 对于有些孩子来说，学校简直就是活地狱。
ext.ext_en: School is a living hell for some children.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place or situation as a living hell, you are emphasizing that it is extremely unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 大乱起来;喧闹起来;闹翻天

ext.ext_cn: 他有了婚外恋，我发现了，一切顿时天翻地覆。
ext.ext_en: He had an affair, I found out and then all hell broke loose.

defs.def_en: If you say that all hell breaks loose, you are emphasizing that a lot of arguing or fighting suddenly starts.

ext.ext_cn: 主教练从俱乐部拿到了很多钱。
ext.ext_en: The manager took a hell of a lot of money out of the club.

defs.def_en: If you talk about a hell of a lot of something, or one hell of a lot of something, you mean that there is a large amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 不管结果如何，这都会是场艰苦的战斗。
ext.ext_en: Whatever the outcome, it's going to be one hell of a fight.

defs.def_en: Some people use a hell of or one hell of to emphasize that something is very good, very bad, or very big.

ext.ext_cn: 滚开，别挡着我。
ext.ext_en: Get the hell out of my way...

ext.ext_cn: 我飞快地逃离了格拉斯哥，而且老实说我再也不会回去了。
ext.ext_en: I got the hell out of Glasgow and I can honestly say I will never go back.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to get the hell out of a place, you are telling them angrily or emphatically to leave that place immediately.

defs.def_cn: （用在 scare, irritate 和 beat 等动词后表示强调）大大地，猛烈地

ext.ext_cn: 我故意俯就地拍了拍她的头顶，知道这会让她非常恼火。
ext.ext_en: I patted the top of her head in the condescending way I knew irritated the hell out of her...

ext.ext_cn: 那些警察把我打得半死。
ext.ext_en: Those cops beat the hell out of me.

defs.def_en: Some people use the hell out of for emphasis after verbs such as 'scare', 'irritate', and 'beat'.

defs.def_cn: 会有严重问题;会有大麻烦

ext.ext_cn: 一旦弗格森和托尼发现此事，就会有大麻烦的。
ext.ext_en: There would be hell to pay when Ferguson and Tony found out about it.

defs.def_en: If you say there'll be hell to pay, you are emphasizing that there will be serious trouble.

defs.def_cn: 破坏，损害，搅乱，给…制造麻烦（英国英语中亦作play merry hell with）

ext.ext_cn: 直言不讳地说，比弗布鲁克勋爵将皇家空军的作战方针搞得一团糟。
ext.ext_en: Lord Beaverbrook, to put it bluntly, played hell with the war policy of the R.A.F...

ext.ext_cn: 蛞蝓会破坏长出的新芽。
ext.ext_en: Slugs play merry hell with emerging shoots.

defs.def_en: To play hell with something means to have a bad effect on it or cause great confusion. In British English, you can also say that one person or thing plays merry hell with another.

defs.def_cn: 大吵大闹;叫嚷着反对;大兴问罪之师

ext.ext_cn: 她进来大吵大闹。她儿子的运动包丢了。
ext.ext_en: She came in and raised hell. Her son's sports bag was missing...

ext.ext_cn: 维护民主的唯一办法是对其缺陷大声提出意见。
ext.ext_en: The only way to preserve democracy is to raise hell about its shortcomings.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone raises hell, you are emphasizing that they protest strongly and angrily about a situation in order to persuade other people to correct it or improve it.

defs.def_cn: （用于what、where、why等词后表示生气）到底，究竟

ext.ext_cn: 你到底去哪里了？
ext.ext_en: Where the hell have you been?...

ext.ext_cn: 凭什么我就应该了解达丁哈的情况？
ext.ext_en: Why the hell should I know about Dadinha?...

defs.def_en: People sometimes use the hell for emphasis in questions, after words such as 'what', 'where', and 'why', often in order to express anger.

ext.ext_cn: 为了灌制这张唱片你们大家似乎都经历了重重波折。
ext.ext_en: All of you seem to have gone through hell making this record...

ext.ext_cn: 我让布赖恩吃尽了苦头。
ext.ext_en: I put Brian through hell.

defs.def_en: If you go through hell, or if someone puts you through hell, you have a very difficult or unpleasant time.

ext.ext_cn: 我真心希望你是对的。
ext.ext_en: I hope to hell you're right.

defs.def_en: If you say you hope to hell or wish to hell that something is true, you are emphasizing that you strongly hope or wish it is true.

defs.def_cn: 无论有多大困难;不管发生什么;赴汤蹈火

ext.ext_cn: 不管发生什么情况，我都没有不上班过。
ext.ext_en: I've always managed to get into work come hell or high water.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will do something come hell or high water, you are emphasizing that you are determined to do it, in spite of the difficulties involved.

ext.ext_cn: 管他呢，我心想，至少这能让懒鬼老头活动一下筋骨。
ext.ext_en: What the hell, I thought, at least it will give the lazy old man some exercise.

defs.def_en: You can say 'what the hell' when you decide to do something in spite of the doubts that you have about it.

ext.ext_cn: 让这事见鬼去吧，我可要走了。
ext.ext_en: To hell with this, I'm getting out of here...

ext.ext_cn: 让分数和资格证书都见鬼去吧。
ext.ext_en: To hell with grades and qualifications.

defs.def_en: If you say 'to hell with' something, you are emphasizing that you do not care about something and that it will not stop you from doing what you want to do.

defs.def_cn: （美国城市中）说西班牙语居民的聚居区

ext.ext_cn: 圣克鲁斯市的西班牙语居民聚居区
ext.ext_en: ...the barrios of Santa Cruz.

defs.def_en: A barrio is a mainly Spanish-speaking area in an American city.

ext.ext_cn: 墨西哥城的城区
ext.ext_en: ...the barrios of Mexico City.

defs.def_en: A barrio is an urban district in a Spanish-speaking country.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然人们一直以为我做过鼻子整形术，其实我从没做过。
ext.ext_en: I've never had plastic surgery, though people always think I've had a nose job.

defs.def_en: A nose job is a surgical operation that some people have to improve the shape of their nose.
A barb is a sharp curved point near the end of an arrow or fish-hook which makes it difficult to pull out.

ext.ext_cn: 如他所愿，这句带刺的话刺痛了她。
ext.ext_en: The barb stung her exactly the way he hoped it would.

defs.def_en: A barb is an unkind remark meant as a criticism of someone or something.

defs.def_cn: （飞机、火箭或导弹的）雾化尾迹，拉烟
defs.def_en: A vapour trail is a white line of water vapour left in the sky by an aeroplane, a rocket, or a missile.

ext.ext_cn: 在几个接收国和一些非政府组织的共同努力下，这些难民得以安置。
ext.ext_en: These refugees are looked after by the combined efforts of the host countries and non-governmental organisations.

ext.ext_en: 'Did you?' she asked earnestly...

ext.ext_en: In 1990, we were all earnestly assured that property values could only go up.

defs.def_en: If you say something earnestly, you say it very seriously, often because you believe that it is important or you are trying to persuade someone else to believe it.

ext.ext_cn: 她总是很认真地听，就好像这能帮助她弄明白一样。
ext.ext_en: She always listened earnestly as if this might help her to understand.

defs.def_en: If you do something earnestly, you do it in a thorough and serious way, intending to succeed.

ext.ext_cn: 我非常希望能够在自己的新工作中学以致用。
ext.ext_en: I earnestly hope what I learned will serve me well in my new job.

defs.def_en: If you earnestly hope or wish for something, you hope or wish strongly and sincerely for it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 心理失调的;不能适应环境的;适应不良的

ext.ext_cn: 为心理失调的儿童开设的学校
ext.ext_en: ...a school for maladjusted children.

defs.def_en: If you describe a child as maladjusted, you mean that they have psychological problems and behave in a way which is not acceptable to society.

ext.ext_cn: 他们强烈呼吁实行犬类强制登记。
ext.ext_en: They have campaigned strongly for compulsory registration of dogs...

ext.ext_cn: 登记选民数量的上升意味着许多人将第一次参加投票。
ext.ext_en: With the high voter registration, many will be voting for the first time.

defs.def_en: The registration of something such as a person's name or the details of an event is the recording of it in an official list.

defs.def_cn: 低空飞行表演;编队飞行
defs.def_en: A flypast is a flight by a group of aircraft in a special formation which takes place on a ceremonial occasion or as a display.

defs.def_cn: (20世纪20年代流行的节奏欢快的)查尔斯顿舞
defs.def_en: The Charleston is a lively dance that was popular in the 1920s.

ext.ext_cn: 北部的妇女抱怨说她们的丈夫很难开口说“我爱你”。
ext.ext_en: Women in the North complain that their hubbies find it difficult to say 'I love you.'

defs.def_en: You can refer to a woman's husband as her hubby .

ext.ext_cn: 精彩的足球比赛
ext.ext_en: ...the wonderful game of football.

ext.ext_cn: 有趣的捉迷藏游戏
ext.ext_en: ...a playful game of hide-and-seek.

defs.def_en: A game is an activity or sport usually involving skill, knowledge, or chance, in which you follow fixed rules and try to win against an opponent or to solve a puzzle.

ext.ext_cn: 这是本赛季的首场比赛。
ext.ext_en: It was the first game of the season...

ext.ext_cn: 他一般在看台上观看我们的比赛。
ext.ext_en: He regularly watched our games from the stands...

defs.def_en: A game is one particular occasion on which a game is played.

defs.def_cn: （网球、桥牌等比赛中的）一局，一盘，一场

ext.ext_cn: 第二盘她以6比0获胜。
ext.ext_en: She won six games to love in the second set.

ext.ext_cn: 第二局的最后3分
ext.ext_en: ...the last three points of the second game.

defs.def_en: A game is a part of a match, for example in tennis or bridge, consisting of a fixed number of points.

ext.ext_cn: 2000年悉尼奥运会
ext.ext_en: ...the 2000 Olympic Games at Sydney.

defs.def_en: Games are an organized event in which competitions in several sports take place.

ext.ext_cn: 在文法学校里，他因拙于体育但擅长辩论而让人印象深刻。
ext.ext_en: At his grammar school he is remembered for being bad at games but good in debates.

defs.def_en: Games are organized sports activities that children do at school.

defs.def_cn: （某人比赛或游戏时的）手法，技巧，风格

ext.ext_cn: 我打完第一局之后就进入了状态。
ext.ext_en: Once I was through the first set my game picked up.

defs.def_en: Someone's game is the degree of skill or the style that they use when playing a particular game.

defs.def_cn: 玩笑；儿戏；不认真对待的事情

ext.ext_cn: 许多人视人生如同一场游戏：有输也有赢。
ext.ext_en: Many people regard life as a game: you win some, you lose some...

ext.ext_cn: 在他看来，这是个猫捉老鼠的把戏，而我就是老鼠。
ext.ext_en: It's  a cat-and-mouse game to him, and I'm the mouse.

defs.def_en: You can describe a situation that you do not treat seriously as a game .

ext.ext_cn: 情况愈发难以确定，我们最终陷入一个唬人的把戏中。
ext.ext_en: When the uncertainties become greater than the certainties, we end up in a game of bluff...

ext.ext_cn: 直到现在，美国人一直玩着精心设计的政治把戏。
ext.ext_en: Until now, the Americans have been playing a very delicate political game.

defs.def_en: You can use game to describe a way of behaving in which a person uses a particular plan, usually in order to gain an advantage for himself or herself.

ext.ext_cn: 靠捕猎获取食物的人
ext.ext_en: ...men who shot game for food.

defs.def_en: Wild animals or birds that are hunted for sport and sometimes cooked and eaten are referred to as game .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 甘愿尝试（新鲜或不平常事物）的；有冒险精神的

ext.ext_cn: 过了这么久，他依然不乏新点子并敢于去尝试。
ext.ext_en: After all this time he still had new ideas and was game to try them...

ext.ext_cn: 他说他明年还愿意接受类似的挑战。
ext.ext_en: He said he's game for a similar challenge next year.

defs.def_en: If you are game for something, you are willing to do something new, unusual, or risky.

ext.ext_cn: 这两个共谋者的表情泄漏了秘密。
ext.ext_en: The faces of the two conspirators gave the game away.

defs.def_en: If someone or something gives the game away, they reveal a secret or reveal their feelings, and this puts them at a disadvantage.

ext.ext_cn: 别忘了她缺乏这方面的经验，完成任务还需要一些时间。
ext.ext_en: Don't  forget that she's new to this game and will take a while to complete the task.

defs.def_en: If you are new to a particular game, you have not done a particular activity or been in a particular situation before.
If a man or woman is on the game, he or she is working as a prostitute.

defs.def_cn: 将计就计；以其人之道还治其人之身

ext.ext_cn: 他必须预见到其他律师的策略，并以其人之道还治其人之身，从而打败他们。
ext.ext_en: He must anticipate the maneuvers of the other lawyers and beat them at their own game...

ext.ext_cn: 警方清楚他们必须将计就计才能逮住那个杀人凶手。
ext.ext_en: The police knew that to trap the killer they had to play him at his own game.

defs.def_en: If you beat someone at their own game, you use the same methods that they have used, but more successfully,  so that you gain an advantage over them.

defs.def_cn: （某种情况下）常有的事，司空见惯的事

ext.ext_cn: 对投资者而言,风险不足为奇。
ext.ext_en: For investors, risks are part of the game.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is all part of the game, you are telling someone not to be surprised or upset by something, because it is a normal part of the situation that they are in.

defs.def_cn: 不认真对待；耍花招；玩把戏

ext.ext_cn: “别跟我耍把戏!”他怒吼道。
ext.ext_en: 'Don't  play games with me!' he thundered...

ext.ext_cn: 凭我对他的了解，他不会耍滑头的。
ext.ext_en: From what I know of him he doesn't play silly games.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is playing games or playing silly games, you mean that they are not treating a situation seriously and you are annoyed with them.

defs.def_cn: （通常在压力下）开始更好表现，干得更出色

ext.ext_cn: 这位世界排名第九的选手必须有更出色的表现才能击退戴尔强有力的挑战。
ext.ext_en: The world No. 9 had to raise his game to see off a strong challenge from Dale...

ext.ext_cn: 这家航空公司在整个大陆拓展业务所带来的竞争会迫使其他航空公司有更好的表现。
ext.ext_en: As it expands its services around the continent, the competition it offers should force the other airlines to raise their game.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has raised their game, you mean that they have begun to perform better, usually because they were under pressure to do so.

defs.def_cn: 戏该收场了，别再演戏了（指所从事的秘密计划或活动被揭穿）

ext.ext_cn: 有些人以为他们还能撑到星期天，务实的人却很清楚，这一切都已结束了。
ext.ext_en: Some thought they would hold out until Sunday. The realists knew that the game was already up.

defs.def_en: If you say the game is up, you mean that someone's  secret plans or activities have been revealed and therefore must stop because they cannot succeed.

defs.def_cn: 空档年，间隔年（中学毕业后至上大学前学业间断的一年）

ext.ext_cn: 我在上大学前空闲的一年里周游了世界。
ext.ext_en: I went around the world in my gap year.

defs.def_en: A gap year is a period of time during which a student takes a break from studying after they have finished school and before they start college or university.

ext.ext_cn: 他们按惯例前往墓地悼念死者。
ext.ext_en: They made their way to a graveyard to pay their traditional respects to the dead.

defs.def_en: A graveyard is an area of land, sometimes near a church, where dead people are buried.

ext.ext_cn: 这里一度是全球最大的港口，现在堆满了锈迹斑斑的吊车。
ext.ext_en: This had once been the greatest port in the world, now it was a graveyard of rusting cranes.

defs.def_en: If you call a place a graveyard of particular things, you mean that there are many broken or unwanted things of that kind there.

defs.def_cn: 令人屡遭失败的事;失意之地

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲最近成了美国高尔夫运动员的滑铁卢。
ext.ext_en: Europe has been the graveyard for American golfers recently.

defs.def_en: If you call an event or place the graveyard for particular people or their hopes, you mean that those people have often failed in such events or in that place.

ext.ext_cn: 凯恩向来是个擅长讽刺的演员。
ext.ext_en: Caine has always been an actor who excels in irony...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽的骑术比他们俩都要好，而且她擅长户外运动。
ext.ext_en: Mary was a better rider than either of them and she excelled at outdoor sports...

defs.def_en: If someone excels in something or excels at it, they are very good at doing it.
In a hospital, the delivery room is the room where women give birth to their babies.
A retirement home is a place where old people live and are cared for when they are too old to look after themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 玫瑰的娇丽
ext.ext_en: ...the delicacy of a rose.

ext.ext_cn: 认为理想女性的标准是娇美、苗条和优雅的国家
ext.ext_en: ...a country where the feminine ideal is delicacy, slimness and grace.

defs.def_en: Delicacy is the quality of being easy to break or harm, and refers especially to people or things that are attractive or graceful.

ext.ext_cn: 有件有点儿棘手的事我想要商量一下。
ext.ext_en: There is a matter of some delicacy which I would like to discuss...

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉到了形势的微妙。
ext.ext_en: He sensed the delicacy of the situation.

defs.def_en: If you say that a situation or problem is of some delicacy, you mean that it is difficult to handle and needs careful and sensitive treatment.

ext.ext_cn: 两个国家都表现出少有的谨慎。
ext.ext_en: Both countries are behaving with rare delicacy...

ext.ext_cn: 他在体察民情方面表现得相当周到和练达。
ext.ext_en: He's shown considerable delicacy and tact in feeling the public mood.

defs.def_en: If someone handles a difficult situation with delicacy, they handle it very carefully, making sure that nobody is offended.

ext.ext_cn: 熏鲑鱼被认为是一道昂贵的珍馐。
ext.ext_en: Smoked salmon was considered an expensive delicacy...

ext.ext_cn: 一道又一道令人垂涎的当地佳肴端到了我们的面前。
ext.ext_en: We were served course after course of mouthwatering local delicacies.

defs.def_en: A delicacy is a rare or expensive food that is considered especially nice to eat.

defs.def_cn: 合同规定的;根据合约的

ext.ext_cn: 该公司没有履行合同规定的某些义务。
ext.ext_en: The company has not fulfilled certain contractual obligations...

ext.ext_cn: 这将根据合约的安排来完成。
ext.ext_en: This will be done by contractual arrangement.

defs.def_en: A contractual arrangement or relationship involves a legal agreement between people.

ext.ext_cn: 他们同意补偿纳税人的任何损失。
ext.ext_en: They agreed to indemnify the taxpayers against any loss...

ext.ext_cn: 印刷商获得保证，一旦受到起诉将会得到赔偿。
ext.ext_en: The printers were indemnified against legal action...

defs.def_en: To indemnify someone against something bad happening means to promise to protect them, especially financially, if it happens.

defs.def_cn: （通常因为违法或毁约而）驱逐，赶出

ext.ext_cn: 他们的母亲吸毒上瘾后，他们被从公寓里赶了出来。
ext.ext_en: They were evicted from their apartment after their mother became addicted to drugs...

ext.ext_cn: 在第一周内，该市警方就驱逐了10个家庭。
ext.ext_en: In the first week, the city police evicted ten families...

defs.def_en: If someone is evicted from the place where they are living, they are forced to leave it, usually because they have broken a law or contract.
You describe someone or something as a beaut when you think they are very good.

IVF is a method of helping a woman to have a baby in which an egg is removed from one of her ovaries, fertilized outside her body, and then replaced in her womb. IVF is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'in vitro fertilization'.
Methane is a colourless gas that has no smell. Natural gas consists mostly of methane.

ext.ext_cn: 他的职业生涯深受伤病的困扰。
ext.ext_en: His career was bedevilled by injury.

ext.ext_cn: 发展受到了诸多问题的困扰。
ext.ext_en: The development has been bedevilled with problems.

defs.def_en: If you are bedevilled by something unpleasant, it causes you a lot of problems over a period of time.
Adaption means the same as adaptation .

defs.def_cn: 部分地；在某种程度上；有点儿

ext.ext_cn: 莉萨一只耳朵失聪，而且部分失明。
ext.ext_en: Lisa is deaf in one ear and partially blind.

defs.def_en: If something happens or exists partially, it happens or exists to some extent, but not completely.

ext.ext_cn: 所有颜色都会褪色——尤其是在阳光直射下。
ext.ext_en: All colour fades — especially under the impact of direct sunlight...

ext.ext_cn: 无论多么柔和的光线，也仍然会造成损害，会让所有房间的地毯和窗帘褪色。
ext.ext_en: No matter how soft the light is, it still plays havoc, fading carpets and curtains in every room.

defs.def_en: When a coloured object fades or when the light fades it, it gradually becomes paler.

defs.def_cn: (光线)逐渐暗淡;(声音)逐渐减弱

ext.ext_cn: 光线渐渐暗了下去，西顿躺在床上，凝视着天花板。
ext.ext_en: Seaton lay on his bed and gazed at the ceiling as the light faded...

ext.ext_cn: 最后一架轰炸机的引擎声渐渐消失在远方。
ext.ext_en: The sound of the last bomber's engines faded into the distance.

defs.def_en: When light fades, it slowly becomes less bright. When a sound fades, it slowly becomes less loud.

defs.def_cn: (所注视之物)逐渐暗淡，逐渐模糊直至消失

ext.ext_cn: 他们观察了这颗彗星 70 天，直至其慢慢从视线中消失。
ext.ext_en: They observed the comet for 70 days before it faded from sight...

ext.ext_cn: 他们看着熟悉的群山渐渐隐没到黑夜当中。
ext.ext_en: They watched the familiar mountains fade into the darkness.

defs.def_en: When something that you are looking at fades, it slowly becomes less bright or clear until it disappears.

defs.def_cn: 变得不为人注意;变得无关紧要

ext.ext_cn: 情况一有不妙，她总能退到幕后。
ext.ext_en: She had a way of fading into the background when things got rough...

ext.ext_cn: 维多利亚时期最显赫的诗人差不多已全部湮没无声了。
ext.ext_en: The most prominent poets of the Victorian period had all but faded from the scene.

defs.def_en: If someone or something fades, for example, into the background, they become hardly noticeable or very unimportant.

defs.def_cn: (记忆)逐渐模糊;(感情)逐渐变淡;(可能性)逐渐变小

ext.ext_cn: 政府宣称，对叛乱分子的同情开始消退。
ext.ext_en: Sympathy for the rebels, the government claims, is beginning to fade...

ext.ext_cn: 和平的前景已经开始日渐暗淡。
ext.ext_en: Prospects for peace had already started to fade.

defs.def_en: If memories, feelings, or possibilities fade, they slowly become less intense or less strong.

ext.ext_cn: 杰伊点点头，笑容慢慢隐去了。
ext.ext_en: Jay nodded, his smile fading.

defs.def_en: If someone's smile fades, they slowly stop smiling.

defs.def_cn: 淡出;变得不再引人注目(直至完全消失)

ext.ext_cn: 他认为不管怎样，她的竞选活动都可能会很快归于沉寂。
ext.ext_en: He thought her campaign would probably fade out soon in any case.

defs.def_en: When something fades out, it slowly becomes less noticeable or less important until it disappears completely.

defs.def_cn: (光线)逐渐暗淡;(画面)淡出; (声音)渐弱

ext.ext_cn: 你得能将两个图像投射到屏幕上，让新的渐渐淡入，旧的渐渐淡出。
ext.ext_en: You'll need to be able to project two images onto the screen as the new one fades in and the old image fades out.

defs.def_en: When light, an image, or a sound fades out, it disappears after gradually becoming weaker.

defs.def_cn: 技术专家统治群体;技术专家政治集团

ext.ext_cn: 布鲁塞尔技术专家政治集团的权力
ext.ext_en: ...the power of the Brussels technocracy.

defs.def_en: A technocracy is a group of scientists, engineers, and other experts who have political power as well as technical knowledge.

defs.def_cn: 技术专家政府;技术官僚政治

ext.ext_cn: 技术专家统治的中央集权政府
ext.ext_en: ...a centralised technocracy.

defs.def_en: A technocracy is a country or society that is controlled by scientists, engineers, and other experts.

ext.ext_cn: 在两国恢复全面的外交关系之前
ext.ext_en: ...before the two countries resume full diplomatic relations...

ext.ext_cn: 各方正在为避免战争、寻求外交解决途径而作出积极的努力。
ext.ext_en: Efforts are being made to avert war and find a diplomatic solution...

defs.def_en: Diplomatic means relating to diplomacy and diplomats.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有手腕的;讲究策略的;圆滑的;婉转的

ext.ext_cn: 她人很直，我觉得我更婉转一些。
ext.ext_en: She is very direct. I tend to be more diplomatic, I suppose.

defs.def_en: Someone who is diplomatic is able to be careful to say or do things without offending people.

ext.ext_cn: 从法国回来之后，他参了军。
ext.ext_en: After returning from France, he joined the army...

ext.ext_cn: 陆军部队即将发动一次大规模进攻。
ext.ext_en: The army is about to launch a major offensive.

defs.def_en: An army is a large organized group of people who are armed and trained to fight on land in a war. Most armies are organized and controlled by governments.

ext.ext_cn: 由大批志愿者收集的资料
ext.ext_en: ...data collected by an army of volunteers.

ext.ext_cn: 成群的寻找便宜货的购物者
ext.ext_en: ...armies of shoppers looking for bargains.

defs.def_en: An army of people, animals, or things is a large number of them, especially when they are regarded as a force of some kind.

defs.def_cn: (放在圣诞袜里的)圣诞节小礼物
defs.def_en: A stocking filler is a small present that is suitable for putting in a Christmas stocking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 现在不是怯懦的时候。
ext.ext_en: This is no time to be faint-hearted...

ext.ext_cn: 选民们也许已经作好准备，去惩罚那些制订了懦弱的团结协定的政客。
ext.ext_en: The voters may be ready to punish the politicians who devised a faint-hearted solidarity pact.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or their behaviour as faint-hearted, you mean that they are not very confident and do not take strong action because they are afraid of failing.

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影是讲一个连环杀手的，不适合胆小的人看。
ext.ext_en: It's a film about a serial killer and not for the faint-hearted.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not for the faint-hearted, you mean that it is an extreme or very unusual example of its kind, and is not suitable for people who like only safe and familiar things.

defs.def_cn: （加在较短形容词和某些不以-ly结尾的副词后构成最高级）表示“最…”
defs.def_en: You add -est to many short adjectives to form superlatives. For example, the superlative of 'nice' is 'nicest'; the superlative of 'happy' is 'happiest'. You also add it to some adverbs that do not end in -ly. For example, the superlative of 'soon' is 'soonest'.
See also:alfresco;A fresco is a picture that is painted on a plastered wall when the plaster is still wet.

defs.def_cn: 不符常规的行为;不合主流的思维

ext.ext_cn: 你故意有悖传统，甚至连着装都在表明自己不认同主流思想。
ext.ext_en: You're deliberately unconventional. Even your choice of clothes is a statement of your non-conformity...

ext.ext_cn: 洛夫洛克自成一套的特立独行可以追溯到他的童年时期。
ext.ext_en: Lovelock's principled nonconformity can be traced to his childhood.

defs.def_en: Nonconformity is behaviour or thinking which is different from that of most people.

defs.def_cn: （用于构成名词和形容词）表示“照片的”，“摄影的”，“感光的”

ext.ext_cn: 希腊北部8日摄影之旅
ext.ext_en: ...an eight-day photo-trip to northern Greece.

ext.ext_cn: 感光探测系统
ext.ext_en: ...a photo-sensitive detector system.

defs.def_en: Photo- is added to nouns and adjectives in order to form other nouns and adjectives which refer or relate to photography or photographic processes, or to light.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (食物)硬实的，难消化的，使人胀饱的

ext.ext_cn: 他讨厌吃伦敦卖的难以下咽的比萨饼。
ext.ext_en: He was disgusted with the stodgy pizzas on sale in London.

defs.def_en: Stodgy food is very solid and heavy. It makes you feel very full, and is difficult to digest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 古板的;令人厌烦的;枯燥乏味的

ext.ext_cn: 他们没修养，很乏味，是一群无聊古板的老家伙。
ext.ext_en: They're not cultured or interesting, they are boring stodgy old things.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as stodgy, you dislike them or are bored by them because they are very old-fashioned or serious.

ext.ext_cn: 他们吃了一大碗麦片粥。
ext.ext_en: They ate a large bowlful of cereal...

ext.ext_cn: 我吃了份什锦色拉 —— 是卖3.20英镑的一大碗。
ext.ext_en: I had a mixed salad — a huge bowlful for £3.20.

defs.def_en: The contents of a bowl can be referred to as a bowlful of something.

ext.ext_cn: 读书时我们被反复灌输找工作要有文凭的观点。
ext.ext_en: All through school we had it drummed into us that you need a degree to get a job...

ext.ext_cn: 学生脑子里被灌输了各种标准的范例。
ext.ext_en: Standard examples were drummed into students' heads...

defs.def_en: If you drum something into someone, you keep saying it to them until they understand it or remember it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的调解可能会帮上该部落的忙。
ext.ext_en: His intercession could be of help to the tribe...

ext.ext_cn: 很多人声称他们被治愈是圣母马利亚代他们祈祷的应验。
ext.ext_en: Many claimed to have been cured as a result of the Madonna's intercessions.

defs.def_en: Intercession is the act of interceding with someone.

defs.def_cn: (常包含魔法或惊险内容的)传说，故事

ext.ext_cn: 由短篇故事、诗歌和传说汇成的作品集
ext.ext_en: ...a collection of stories, poems and folk tales...

ext.ext_cn: 《城市故事》的第一、二集将于星期二两集连播。
ext.ext_en: Episodes 1 and 2 of Tales of the City will be shown together on Tuesday.

defs.def_en: A tale is a story, often involving magic or exciting events.

defs.def_cn: (对真人真事精彩的或夸张的)描述，讲述

ext.ext_cn: 媒体上尽是星期一发生的地震所带来的恐惧和损失的报道。
ext.ext_en: The media have been filled with tales of horror and loss resulting from Monday's earthquake.

ext.ext_cn: 总是兴高采烈地描述着股票价格飙升和新资本源源不断注入房地产公司的房地产分析师
ext.ext_en: ...a property analyst, full of cheery tales about soaring share prices and new capital pouring into property companies.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an interesting, exciting, or dramatic account of a real event as a tale .

defs.def_cn: 大难不死;逃过劫难;幸免于难

ext.ext_cn: 你这次算是逃过了一劫，不过谁知道你的运气还会持续多久呢？
ext.ext_en: You lived to tell the tale this time but who knows how far you can push your luck.

defs.def_en: If you survive a dangerous or frightening experience and so are able to tell people about it afterwards, you can say that you lived to tell the tale .

ext.ext_cn: 我犹豫了，不想说同事的坏话。
ext.ext_en: I hesitated, not wanting to tell tales about my colleague.

defs.def_en: See also:tell-tale;If someone tells tales about you, they tell other people things about you which are untrue or which you wanted to be kept secret.

ext.ext_cn: 当前的公爵爵位的继承人
ext.ext_en: ...the present heir to the dukedom.

defs.def_en: A dukedom is the rank or title of a duke.
A dukedom is the land owned by a duke.

ext.ext_cn: 阴茎癌
ext.ext_en: ...penile cancer.

defs.def_en: Penile means relating to a penis.
A life form is any living thing such as an animal or plant.
In a theatre, the footlights are the row of lights along the front of the stage.

ext.ext_cn: 如果开车觉得累，就乘火车吧。
ext.ext_en: If driving tires you, take the train...

ext.ext_cn: 他很容易疲倦，可夜里却睡不好觉。
ext.ext_en: He tired easily, though he was unable to sleep well at night.

defs.def_en: If something tires you or if you tire, you feel that you have used a lot of energy and you want to rest or sleep.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为自己永远不会对国际板球赛生厌。
ext.ext_en: He felt he would never tire of international cricket...

ext.ext_cn: 迟早他会厌倦总是把自己排在最后。
ext.ext_en: Sooner or later he may tire of constantly putting himself last.

defs.def_en: If you tire of something, you no longer wish to do it, because you have become bored of it or unhappy with it.
A tire is the same as a tyre .

ext.ext_cn: 她又跺了跺脚。
ext.ext_en: She stamped her foot again.

ext.ext_cn: 足伤
ext.ext_en: ...a foot injury.

defs.def_en: Your feet are the parts of your body that are at the ends of your legs, and that you stand on.

ext.ext_cn: 戴维在楼梯下面喊孩子们。
ext.ext_en: David called to the children from the foot of the stairs...

ext.ext_cn: 海格特山脚下
ext.ext_en: ...the foot of Highgate Hill...

defs.def_en: The foot of something is the part that is farthest from its top.

ext.ext_cn: 朋友们站在床脚处，神情严肃地看着她。
ext.ext_en: Friends stood at the foot of the bed, looking at her with serious faces.

defs.def_en: The foot of a bed is the end nearest to the feet of the person lying in it.

defs.def_cn: 英尺(相当于 12 英寸或 30.48 厘米)

ext.ext_cn: 这个形状奇特的美丽湖泊周长约有15,000英尺。
ext.ext_en: This beautiful and curiously shaped lake lies at around fifteen thousand feet...

ext.ext_cn: 占地100万平方英尺的购物休闲中心
ext.ext_en: ...a shopping and leisure complex of one million square feet...

defs.def_en: A foot is a unit for measuring length, height, or depth, and is equal to 12 inches or 30.48 centimetres. When you are giving measurements, the form 'foot' is often used as the plural instead of the plural form 'feet'.

defs.def_cn: (刹车或泵)用脚操作的，脚踏的

ext.ext_cn: 我试图去够脚刹，但是没能踩到。
ext.ext_en: I tried to reach the foot brakes but I couldn't.

defs.def_en: A foot brake or foot pump is operated by your foot rather than by your hand.

ext.ext_cn: 伞兵和步兵代表政府进入大楼。
ext.ext_en: Paratroopers and foot-soldiers entered the building on the government's behalf.

defs.def_en: A foot patrol or foot soldiers walk rather than travelling in vehicles or on horseback.
See also:footing;In poetry, a foot is one of the basic units of rhythm into which a line is divided.

ext.ext_cn: 政府对改革缩手缩脚。
ext.ext_en: The Government is getting cold feet about the reforms.

defs.def_en: If you get cold feet about something, you become nervous or frightened about it because you think it will fail.

defs.def_cn: 站稳脚跟;变得自信;能独立行动

ext.ext_cn: 我在英格兰不认识什么人，但是我相信自己一旦站稳脚跟就可以独当一面。
ext.ext_en: I don't know anyone in England but I am sure I will manage when I find my feet...

ext.ext_cn: 他一旦变得自信了就能够处理任何问题。
ext.ext_en: Once he had found his feet he was able to deal with any problem.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is finding their feet in a new situation, you mean that they are starting to feel confident and to deal with things successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 在那一方面他需要脚踏实地，不能飘飘然。
ext.ext_en: In that respect he needs to keep his feet on the ground and not get carried away...

ext.ext_cn: 凯文总是头脑冷静，脚踏实地。
ext.ext_en: Kevin was always level-headed with both feet on the ground.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has their feet on the ground, you approve of the fact that they have a sensible and practical attitude towards life, and do not have unrealistic ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 我们划船到了岸边，之后余下的时间步行在岛上探险。
ext.ext_en: We rowed ashore, then explored the island on foot for the rest of the day.

defs.def_en: If you go somewhere on foot, you walk, rather than using any form of transport.

ext.ext_cn: 每个人都站起身来热烈鼓掌。
ext.ext_en: Everyone was on their feet applauding wildly.

defs.def_en: If you are on your feet, you are standing up.

ext.ext_cn: 你需要有人为你分担压力，帮你恢复元气。
ext.ext_en: You need someone to take the pressure off and help you get back on your feet...

ext.ext_cn: 他说他们都需要通力协作以使国家恢复元气。
ext.ext_en: He said they all needed to work together to put the country on its feet again.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is on their feet again after an illness or difficult period, you mean that they have recovered and are back to normal.

ext.ext_cn: 他长得很帅，也有魅力，总是走好运。
ext.ext_en: He has good looks and charm, and always falls on his feet...

ext.ext_cn: 在我挣扎过活的时候，她却运气亨通。
ext.ext_en: While I struggle through life, she lands on her feet.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone always falls or lands on their feet, you mean that they are always successful or lucky, although they do not seem to achieve this by their own efforts.

defs.def_cn: 一只脚踏进了坟墓;行将就木
defs.def_en: If you say that someone has one foot in the grave, you mean that they are very old or very ill and will probably die soon.

defs.def_cn: 情况完全逆转;事实恰恰相反

ext.ext_cn: 你没有权力开除我。相反，我现在可以开除你。
ext.ext_en: You're not in a position to remove me. The boot is now on the other foot.

defs.def_en: If you say, in British English, the boot is on the other foot or, mainly in American English, the shoe is on the other foot, you mean that a situation has been reversed completely, so that the person who was in the better position before is now in the worse one.

ext.ext_cn: 要尽力而为，要相信你可能遇到的每一个问题都会有一个适当的解决方案。
ext.ext_en: Put your best foot forward and work on the assumption that there is an acceptable solution to every problem you are likely to face.

defs.def_en: If you put your best foot forward, you act in a cheerful, determined way.

defs.def_cn: 拿定主意阻止;执意反对

ext.ext_cn: 他原本打算在 3 月独自去滑雪，但是他的太太决定让他打消这个念头。
ext.ext_en: He had planned to go skiing on his own in March but his wife had decided to put her foot down.

defs.def_en: If someone puts their foot down, they use their authority in order to stop something happening.

ext.ext_cn: 我要求司机加大油门去那曲。
ext.ext_en: I asked the driver to put his foot down for Nagchukha.

defs.def_en: If someone puts their foot down when they are driving, they drive as fast as they can.

defs.def_cn: (行为或言语)使人尴尬,冒犯别人

ext.ext_cn: 我们的主席真的让人很尴尬，可怜的人，尽管他自己没意识到。
ext.ext_en: Our chairman has really put his foot in it, poor man, though he doesn't know it.

defs.def_en: If someone puts their foot in it or puts their foot in their mouth, they accidentally do or say something which embarrasses or offends people.

defs.def_cn: (尤指架起双脚)坐下(或躺下)休息，放松

ext.ext_cn: 晚饭后他会支起双腿，歇一歇，看看书。那真是件很惬意的事情。
ext.ext_en: After supper he'd put his feet up and read. It was a pleasant prospect.

defs.def_en: If you put your feet up, you relax or have a rest, especially by sitting or lying with your feet supported off the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 他在的时候，我们从来不会出错。
ext.ext_en: When he's around, we never put a foot wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 他防守的时候几乎滴水不漏，进攻也很出色。
ext.ext_en: He hardly put a foot wrong in defence and was fine in attack.

defs.def_en: If you never put a foot wrong, you never make any mistakes.

ext.ext_cn: 人类首次登上月球的那一天
ext.ext_en: ...the day the first man set foot on the moon...

ext.ext_cn: 之后没多久我离开了那个地方，从此再也没有回过得克萨斯。
ext.ext_en: A little later I left that place and never set foot in Texas again.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone sets foot in a place, you mean that they enter it or reach it, and you are emphasizing the significance of their action. If you say that someone never sets foot in a place, you are emphasizing that they never go there.

ext.ext_cn: 只要我能够自食其力，不依附于自己的丈夫，嫁给谁我父亲倒是并不介意。
ext.ext_en: My father didn't mind whom I married, so long as I could stand on my own two feet and wasn't dependent on my husband.

defs.def_en: If someone has to stand on their own two feet, they have to be independent and manage their lives without help from other people.

ext.ext_cn: 马隆站起身来，跟在他的上司后面走出了套房。
ext.ext_en: Malone got to his feet and followed his superior out of the suite...

ext.ext_cn: 代表们欢呼着站起身来。
ext.ext_en: The delegates cheered and rose to their feet...

defs.def_en: If you get or rise to your feet, you stand up.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们在周围乱跑，让所有人都很烦。
ext.ext_en: The children were running about under everybody's feet.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is under your feet, you are annoyed because they are with you or near you, and are bothering you.

defs.def_cn: 一开始就不对;出师不利

ext.ext_cn: 尽管他们召集了选举，也为此做了一段时间的准备，但是一开始就走错了。
ext.ext_en: Even though they called the election and had been preparing for it for some time, they got off on the wrong foot.

defs.def_en: If someone gets off on the wrong foot in a new situation, they make a bad start by doing something in completely the wrong way.

ext.ext_cn: 首先，必须将头痛分为几个类型。
ext.ext_en: It is necessary initially to classify the headaches into certain types...

ext.ext_cn: 可以根据岩石的成因对其进行分类。
ext.ext_en: Rocks can be classified according to their mode of origin...

defs.def_en: To classify things means to divide them into groups or types so that things with similar characteristics are in the same group.

defs.def_cn: (圣诞节装饰用的)光片，闪光线
defs.def_en: Tinsel consists of small strips of shiny paper attached to long pieces of thread. People use tinsel as a decoration at Christmas.

ext.ext_cn: 雷诺兹从没掩饰过他要成为老大的雄心。
ext.ext_en: Reynolds has never concealed his ambition to be the top dog.

defs.def_en: If a person or organization is top dog, they are the most successful or powerful one in a particular group.

defs.def_cn: 深深地（感觉到），强烈地(意识到)

ext.ext_cn: 他闻到一股浓浓的油烟味。
ext.ext_en: He was acutely aware of the odour of cooking oil...

ext.ext_cn: 最能深切感受到这种紧张氛围的是女性。
ext.ext_en: Those tensions have been felt most acutely by women.

defs.def_en: If you feel or notice something acutely, you feel or notice it very strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 那是一次极其痛苦的返回伦敦的旅行。
ext.ext_en: It was an acutely uncomfortable journey back to London.

defs.def_en: If a feeling or quality is acutely unpleasant, it is extremely unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 取消，废除，撤销（许可、法律、协议等）

ext.ext_cn: 政府撤销了她丈夫管理外来打工人群的许可证。
ext.ext_en: The government revoked her husband's license to operate migrant labor crews.

defs.def_en: When people in authority revoke something such as a licence, a law, or an agreement, they cancel it.

ext.ext_cn: 高级政要今天会晤，探讨欧洲经济一体化的未来。
ext.ext_en: Senior politicians met today to discuss the future of European economic unity.

ext.ext_cn: 德国的统一
ext.ext_en: ...German unity.

defs.def_en: Unity is the state of different areas or groups being joined together to form a single country or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 目标的重新确认一致
ext.ext_en: ...a renewed unity of purpose...

ext.ext_cn: 集会上的发言人空泛地呼吁大家要团结一致。
ext.ext_en: Speakers at the rally mouthed sentiments of unity...

defs.def_en: When there is unity, people are in agreement and act together for a particular purpose.
A suspension bridge is a type of bridge that is supported from above by cables.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 三流电影
ext.ext_en: ...a third-rate movie.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as third-rate, you mean that it is of a very poor quality or standard.

ext.ext_cn: 焰火将点亮夜空。
ext.ext_en: The night skies will be aglow with fireworks.

defs.def_en: If something is aglow, it is shining and bright with a soft, warm light.

defs.def_cn: （因兴奋而）红光满面的，面色发红的

ext.ext_cn: “简直难以置信，”库尔特突然满面红光地说。
ext.ext_en: 'It was incredible,' Kurt says, suddenly aglow.

defs.def_en: If someone is aglow or if their face is aglow, they look excited.

ext.ext_cn: 银行正重新评估其贷款标准。
ext.ext_en: The bank is reassessing its criteria for lending money...

ext.ext_cn: 我只好借给他10英镑，让他带孩子们去看电影。
ext.ext_en: I had to lend him ten pounds to take his children to the pictures.

defs.def_en: When people or organizations such as banks lend you money, they give it to you and you agree to pay it back at a future date, often with an extra amount as interest.

ext.ext_cn: 你能把上衣借给我穿一会儿吗？
ext.ext_en: Will you lend me your jacket for a little while?...

ext.ext_cn: 他把那间平房借给康拉德一家住了两三个星期。
ext.ext_en: He had lent the bungalow to the Conrads for a couple of weeks.

defs.def_en: If you lend something that you own, you allow someone to have it or use it for a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 主办方找过他，希望他能对慈善音乐会给予支持。
ext.ext_en: He was approached by the organisers to lend support to a benefit concert...

ext.ext_cn: 斯蒂普出席了昨天的新闻发布会以示支持。
ext.ext_en: Stipe attended yesterday's news conference to lend his support.

defs.def_en: If you lend your support to someone or something, you help them with what they are doing or with a problem that they have.

defs.def_cn: 使适合；使有帮助；使易遭受

ext.ext_cn: 这个房间又亮堂又通风，夏天在此用餐最合适不过。
ext.ext_en: The room lends itself well to summer eating with its light, airy atmosphere.

defs.def_en: If something lends itself to a particular activity or result, it is easy for it to be used for that activity or to achieve that result.

ext.ext_cn: 热烈的掌声给活动平添了几分隆重的色彩。
ext.ext_en: Enthusiastic applause lent a sense of occasion to the proceedings...

ext.ext_cn: 由于管理较为宽松而且经常从事劳动，这里的囚犯因此多了一份其他监狱的囚犯所没有的尊严感。
ext.ext_en: A more relaxed regime and regular work lends the inmates a dignity not seen in other prisons.

defs.def_en: If something lends a particular quality to something else, it adds that quality to it.
Poplin is a type of cotton material used to make clothes.
A banana split is a kind of dessert. It consists of a banana cut in half along its length, with ice cream, nuts, and sauce on top.

defs.def_cn: 免受惩罚；逃脱（严厉的）惩罚

ext.ext_cn: 他可能会逃脱严惩，仅仅罚一点钱了事。
ext.ext_en: He is likely to get off with a small fine.

defs.def_en: If someone who has broken a law or rule gets off, they are not punished, or are given only a very small punishment.

ext.ext_cn: 8点钟的时候，我说“我现在要出发了。”
ext.ext_en: At eight I said 'I'm getting off now.'

defs.def_en: If you get off, you leave a place because it is time to leave.

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉过你，离农场远点。
ext.ext_en: I told you. Get off the farm.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to get off a piece of land or a property, you are telling them to leave, because they have no right to be there and you do not want them there.

ext.ext_cn: 我不断地叫他把手拿开。
ext.ext_en: I kept telling him to get off...

ext.ext_cn: “别碰我！”我尖叫道。
ext.ext_en: 'Get off me!' I screamed.

defs.def_en: You can tell someone to get off when they are touching something and you do not want them to.
If you get off, or get off to sleep, you succeed in falling asleep.

ext.ext_cn: 这对做广告的意义提出了疑问。
ext.ext_en: This raises doubts about the point of advertising...

ext.ext_cn: 她刚开始做时我心存疑虑，但她真的做得很好。
ext.ext_en: I had my doubts when she started, but she's getting really good...

defs.def_en: If you have doubt or doubts about something, you feel uncertain about it and do not know whether it is true or possible. If you say you have no doubt about it, you mean that you are certain it is true.

defs.def_cn: 不能肯定;认为…未必可能

ext.ext_cn: 其他人认为那未必会发生。
ext.ext_en: Others doubted whether that would happen...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为他不太可能从玛丽那儿学到任何新东西。
ext.ext_en: He doubted if he would learn anything new from Marie...

defs.def_en: If you doubt whether something is true or possible, you believe that it is probably not true or possible.

ext.ext_cn: 没有人怀疑他的能力。
ext.ext_en: No one doubted his ability...

ext.ext_cn: 和我谈过话的人中没有一个怀疑他作为一个政治家的诚意。
ext.ext_en: Nobody that I spoke to doubted his sincerity as a politician.

defs.def_en: If you doubt something, you believe that it might not be true or genuine.

defs.def_cn: 怀疑，不相信（某人或某人的话）

ext.ext_cn: 与此案直接相关的人中没有人怀疑他。
ext.ext_en: No one directly involved with the case doubted him...

ext.ext_cn: 我还是没有理由怀疑他的话。
ext.ext_en: I still have no reason to doubt his word.

ext.ext_cn: 昆虫的生理机能
ext.ext_en: ...insect physiology.

defs.def_en: The physiology of a human or animal's body or of a plant is the way that it functions.
