ext.ext_en: His face is still ruddy and handsome.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's face as ruddy, you mean that their face is a reddish colour, usually because they are healthy or have been working hard, or because they are angry or embarrassed.

ext.ext_en: ...barges, with their sails ruddy brown from regular dressing of ochre.

defs.def_en: Something that is ruddy is reddish in colour.

ext.ext_en: He took the paraffin stove on a picnic and the ruddy thing wouldn't work.

defs.def_en: Ruddy is used by some people to emphasize what they are saying, especially when they are angry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He analysed his game and found it wanting...

ext.ext_cn: 埃莉诺也被详细审查，结论经常是不够格。
ext.ext_en: Eleanor was scrutinized, too, and often found wanting...

defs.def_en: If you find something or someone wanting, they are not of as high a standard as you think they should be.

A seamstress is a woman who sews and makes clothes as her job.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有意刁难的；故意作对的

ext.ext_cn: 他为人刻薄、难相处是出了名的。
ext.ext_en: He had a reputation for being bloody-minded and difficult.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is being bloody-minded, you are showing that you disapprove of their behaviour because you think they are being deliberately difficult instead of being helpful.

defs.def_cn: 机敏处世的本领;遇事不乱的能力;随机应变的才干

ext.ext_cn: 他幽默诙谐，处世机敏。
ext.ext_en: He was full of jocularity and savoir-faire.

defs.def_en: Savoir-faire is the confidence and ability to do the appropriate thing in a social situation.

ext.ext_cn: 摩尔达维亚议会已宣布选举违宪。
ext.ext_en: The Moldavian parliament has declared the elections unconstitutional...

ext.ext_cn: 既然出售香烟是合法的，那么禁止做香烟广告就是违宪的。
ext.ext_en: Banning cigarette advertising would be unconstitutional, since selling cigarettes is legal.

defs.def_en: If something is unconstitutional, it breaks the rules of a political system.
Altruism is unselfish concern for other people's happiness and welfare.
A teaching hospital is a hospital that is linked with a medical school, where medical students and newly qualified doctors receive practical training.

ext.ext_cn: 她瞪大眼睛望着我。
ext.ext_en: She goggled at me...

ext.ext_cn: 他困惑地瞪着眼睛。
ext.ext_en: He goggled in bewilderment.

defs.def_en: If you goggle at something, you stare at it with your eyes wide open, usually because you are surprised by it.
Goggles are large glasses that fit closely to your face around your eyes to protect them from such things as water, wind, or dust.

defs.def_cn: （数量上）微少的，少到几乎没有的（可用so，too，very修饰）

ext.ext_en: I had little money and little free time...

ext.ext_cn: 我发现最近我只需要睡很少时间。
ext.ext_en: I find that I need very little sleep these days...

defs.def_en: You use little to indicate that there is only a very small amount of something. You can use 'so', 'too', and 'very' in front of little.

defs.def_cn: （频率或程度）微小地，小到几乎没有地

ext.ext_cn: 返回马赛的路上，他们没怎么说话。
ext.ext_en: On their way back to Marseille they spoke very little...

ext.ext_cn: 目前只有非洲没怎么受到硬毒品的影响。
ext.ext_en: Only Africa is at present little affected by hard drugs.

defs.def_en: Little means not very often or to only a small extent.

defs.def_cn: （数量上）不多的（亦作a very little）

ext.ext_cn: 卡安太太需要有人帮把手将食品杂货拿回家。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Caan needs a little help getting her groceries home...

ext.ext_cn: 吃点东西，对我们大家都会有好处。
ext.ext_en: A little food would do us all some good...

defs.def_en: A little of something is a small amount of it, but not very much. You can also say a very little.

ext.ext_en: He walked a little by himself in the garden.

defs.def_en: If you do something a little, you do it for a short time.

ext.ext_cn: 他有几句提到说肩胛骨之间一直在疼。
ext.ext_en: He complained a little of a nagging pain between his shoulder blades...

ext.ext_cn: 他有点害怕父亲的反应。
ext.ext_en: He was a little bit afraid of his father's  reaction...

defs.def_en: A little or a little bit means to a small extent or degree.

ext.ext_cn: 一开始他感觉很好，但慢慢地就变虚弱了。
ext.ext_en: In the beginning he had felt well, but little by little he was becoming weaker...

ext.ext_cn: 我得慢慢学会独自生活。
ext.ext_en: I would have to learn, little by little, to exist alone.

defs.def_en: If something happens little by little, it happens very gradually.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: We sat around a little table, eating and drinking wine.

ext.ext_cn: 那一小群艺术专业的学生
ext.ext_en: ...the little group of art students.

defs.def_en: Little things are small in size. Little is slightly more informal than small .

ext.ext_cn: 她有一幢非常漂亮的小房子，就在离图书馆不远处。
ext.ext_en: She's got the nicest little house not far from the library.

ext.ext_cn: 身材娇小的老太太
ext.ext_en: ...a little old lady...

defs.def_en: You use little to indicate that someone or something is small, in a pleasant and attractive way.

ext.ext_en: I have a little boy of 8...

ext.ext_en: When I was little I was very hyperactive.

defs.def_en: A little child is young.

ext.ext_cn: 每次让丹尼尔的妹妹做什么事，她总是要淘气地回嘴。
ext.ext_en: Whenever Daniel's little sister was asked to do something she always had a naughty reply.

defs.def_en: Your little sister or brother is younger than you are.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 沿这条路走一小段，向左转，然后过桥。
ext.ext_en: Just go down the road a little way, turn left, and cross the bridge...

ext.ext_cn: 为什么不再等一下看看事态的发展。
ext.ext_en: Why don't we just wait a little while and see what happens...

defs.def_en: A little distance, period of time, or event is short in length.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: I had a little laugh to myself...

ext.ext_cn: 她迅速站了起来，惊叫了一声。
ext.ext_en: She stood up quickly, giving a little cry of astonishment...

defs.def_en: A little sound or gesture is quick.

defs.def_cn: 微不足道的；细小的；琐碎的

ext.ext_en: Harry found himself getting angry over little things that had never bothered him before.

defs.def_en: You use little to indicate that something is not serious or important.

defs.def_cn: (人、团体或国家之间的)联系，关系，往来

ext.ext_en: Greece has established full diplomatic relations with Israel...

ext.ext_cn: 很明显夫妇之间的关系没有改善。
ext.ext_en: Apparently relations between husband and wife had not improved...

defs.def_en: See also:industrial relations;public relations;race relations;Relations between people, groups, or countries are contacts between them and the way in which they behave towards each other.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个伦理学和经济学的关系问题。
ext.ext_en: It is a question of the relation of ethics to economics.

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人失业与毒品相关犯罪之间的关联
ext.ext_en: ...a relation between youthful unemployment and drug-related offences...

defs.def_en: If you talk about the relation of one thing to another, you are talking about the ways in which they are connected.

ext.ext_cn: 拜访亲友
ext.ext_en: ...visits to friends and relations...

ext.ext_cn: 在美国，他们把休·格兰特吹捧为第二个加里·格兰特(两人并无亲属关系)。
ext.ext_en: In America they are touting Hugh Grant as the next Cary Grant (no relation).

defs.def_en: See also:poor relation;Your relations are the members of your family.

ext.ext_en: ...women's position in relation to men in the context of the family...

defs.def_en: You can talk about something in relation to something else when you want to compare the size, condition, or position of the two things.

ext.ext_en: ...a question which has been asked many times in relation to Irish affairs...

ext.ext_en: ...an accredited college of Brunel University.

ext.ext_en: The President proposed that Russian diplomats could be accredited to NATO headquarters...

ext.ext_cn: 旨在控制艾滋病传播的广告

ext.ext_en: Inflation needs to be curbed in Russia.

ext.ext_en: ...a long evening spent downing tequilas.

ext.ext_en: ...pre-1971 cars.

ext.ext_en: ...the sheer visceral joy of being alive.

ext.ext_cn: 也许他是出于情感上的原因才回来的。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps he has returned for sentimental reasons.

defs.def_en: Sentimental means relating to or involving feelings such as pity or love, especially for things in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 主管学生住宿的男老师
ext.ext_en: ...the master in charge of boarding...

ext.ext_cn: 每年的寄宿费为10,350英镑。
ext.ext_en: Annual boarding fees are £10,350.

defs.def_en: Boarding is an arrangement by which children live at school during the school term.

defs.def_cn: （用来建造围墙、门、栅栏的）长条木板

ext.ext_cn: 起居室里粉刷成白色的门板
ext.ext_en: ...the white-painted boarding in the sitting room.

defs.def_en: Boarding is long, flat pieces of wood which can be used to make walls, doors, and fences.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 得体的;适当的;合乎礼仪的

ext.ext_cn: 人们认为女性不应该过于自信。
ext.ext_en: Self-assertion was not thought seemly in a woman.

defs.def_en: Seemly behaviour or dress is appropriate in the particular circumstances.

ext.ext_cn: 对莎士比亚作品缜密的文本分析
ext.ext_en: ...close textual analysis of Shakespeare.

defs.def_en: Textual means relating to written texts, especially literary texts.

defs.def_cn: 小花束；（美国英语中亦指）一枝花
defs.def_en: A posy is a small bunch of flowers. In American English, it can also consist of a single flower.

ext.ext_cn: 枪支的序列号
ext.ext_en: ...the gun's serial number.

ext.ext_cn: 你自行车的编号
ext.ext_en: ...your bike's serial number...

defs.def_en: The serial number of an object is a number on that object which identifies it.

ext.ext_cn: 除姓名、军衔、部队编号和出生年月外，他再也不肯回答俘获他的人的任何问题。
ext.ext_en: He could never ever give any responses to his captor other than name, rank, serial number and date of birth.

defs.def_en: The serial number of a member of the United States military forces is a number which identifies them.

ext.ext_cn: 通货紧缩开始全面影响服装业。
ext.ext_en: Deflation is beginning to take hold in the clothing industry.

defs.def_en: Deflation is a reduction in economic activity that leads to lower levels of industrial output, employment, investment, trade, profits, and prices.

ext.ext_cn: 天文学家们发现了一个遥远的星系。
ext.ext_en: Astronomers have discovered a distant galaxy.

defs.def_en: A galaxy is an extremely large group of stars and planets that extends over many billions of light years.

ext.ext_cn: 银河系由1,000亿颗恒星组成。
ext.ext_en: The Galaxy consists of 100 billion stars.

defs.def_en: The Galaxy is the extremely large group of stars and planets to which the Earth and the Solar System belong.

ext.ext_cn: 出现在德国电视上的荷兰明星为数不多，他是其中一位。
ext.ext_en: He is one of a small galaxy of Dutch stars on German television.

defs.def_en: If you talk about a galaxy of people from a particular profession, you mean a group of them who are all famous or important.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 部长说这次爆炸是一起卑劣的罪行。
ext.ext_en: The Minister said the bombing was a despicable crime.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or action is despicable, you are emphasizing that they are extremely nasty, cruel, or evil.

defs.def_cn: （房屋外带屋顶的）走廊，游廊,阳台

ext.ext_cn: 他们在阳台上喝咖啡和茶。
ext.ext_en: They had their coffee and tea on the veranda.

defs.def_en: A veranda is a roofed platform along the outside of a house.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定句）哪儿，到处（都没有）

ext.ext_cn: 我还没找到住的地方。
ext.ext_en: I haven't got anywhere to live...

ext.ext_cn: 世界上从未有过如此美丽的女人。
ext.ext_en: There had never been such a beautiful woman anywhere in the world.

defs.def_en: You use anywhere in statements with negative meaning to indicate that a place does not exist.

defs.def_cn: （用于疑问句和条件从句）某个地方，哪里

ext.ext_cn: 你尝试过从哪里寻求帮助吗？
ext.ext_en: Did you try to get help from anywhere?...

ext.ext_cn: 她想去任何地方都只能等父亲开车送她去。
ext.ext_en: If she wanted to go anywhere at all she had to wait for her father to drive her.

defs.def_en: You use anywhere in questions and conditional clauses to ask or talk about a place without saying exactly where you mean.

defs.def_cn: （用于描述所谈论的某个地方的词语前）…地方

ext.ext_cn: 美国大多数休闲娱乐活动比其他地方要丰富得多的多。
ext.ext_en: In America most leisure-time activities are about a million times better than anywhere else...

ext.ext_cn: 他随你在哪儿见面都行。
ext.ext_en: He'll meet you anywhere you want...

defs.def_en: You use anywhere before words that indicate the kind of place you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 甭管到哪儿，雷切尔都会认出朱莉娅·斯通。
ext.ext_en: Rachel would have known Julia Stone anywhere.

ext.ext_cn: 屡试不爽的极为有趣的笑话
ext.ext_en: ...jokes that are so funny they always work anywhere.

defs.def_en: You use anywhere to refer to a place when you are emphasizing that it could be any of a large number of places.

ext.ext_cn: 他买的鞋子总在200美元以上。
ext.ext_en: His shoes cost anywhere from $200 up...

ext.ext_cn: 我每次逗留时间从3个星期到两个月不等。
ext.ext_en: My visits lasted anywhere from three weeks to two months.

defs.def_en: When you do not want to be exact, you use anywhere to refer to a particular range of things.

defs.def_cn: （用于强调）根本，一点儿，将近，几乎

ext.ext_cn: 空箱子数量远远不够。
ext.ext_en: There weren't anywhere near enough empty boxes...

ext.ext_cn: 唯一算得上了解真相的人是我的母亲。
ext.ext_en: The only one who's anywhere close to the truth is my mother.

defs.def_en: You use anywhere in expressions such as anywhere near and anywhere close to to emphasize a statement that you are making.

ext.ext_cn: 会谈好像没有取得任何进展。
ext.ext_en: The conversation did not seem to be getting anywhere...

ext.ext_cn: 我发现我作为电影制片人的职业没有什么发展前途。
ext.ext_en: I didn't see that my career as a film-maker was going anywhere.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is not getting anywhere or is not going anywhere, you mean that they are not making progress or achieving a satisfactory result.

ext.ext_cn: 极为谦虚
ext.ext_en: ...a deep sense of humility...

ext.ext_cn: 在很长一段时间里，他仍以一个百万富翁的方式思维，但他现在变得谦恭了。
ext.ext_en: For a long time he still thought like a millionaire but he has humility now.

defs.def_en: Someone who has humility is not proud and does not believe they are better than other people.

ext.ext_cn: 比利时首都布鲁塞尔
ext.ext_en: ...the Belgian capital, Brussels.

defs.def_en: Belgian means belonging or relating to Belgium or to its people.
An e-zine is a website which contains the kind of articles, pictures, and advertisements that you would find in a magazine.
Congregants are members of a congregation.
Your fibula is the outer bone of the two bones in the lower part of your leg.
If you call someone a rumour-monger, you disapprove of the fact that they spread rumours.

defs.def_cn: (尤指稀有野生动物的)人工饲养,笼养,圈养
defs.def_en: Captive breeding is the breeding of wild animals in places such as zoos, especially animals which have become rare in the wild.

ext.ext_cn: 那些女人在上午12 点 46分第一次打911报警说有小偷。
ext.ext_en: The women made their first 911 call about a prowler at 12:46 a.m.

defs.def_en: 911 is the number that you call in the United States in order to contact the emergency services.
A Protestant is a Christian who belongs to the branch of the Christian church which separated from the Catholic church in the sixteenth century.

ext.ext_cn: 如今大多数新教教会都有女牧师。
ext.ext_en: Most Protestant churches now have women ministers.

defs.def_en: Protestant means relating to Protestants or their churches.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 古老的;陈旧的;老掉牙的

ext.ext_cn: “女人心，海底针”这种老一套的鬼话
ext.ext_en: ...the hoary old myth that women are unpredictable.

defs.def_en: If you describe a problem or subject as hoary, you mean that it is old and familiar.

ext.ext_cn: 我们沿着悬崖顶上的小路走。
ext.ext_en: We followed the path along the clifftops...

ext.ext_cn: 经年的踩踏在岩石上形成了一条小径。
ext.ext_en: Feet had worn a path in the rock...

defs.def_en: A path is a long strip of ground which people walk along to get from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 一群记者堵住了他的去路。
ext.ext_en: A group of reporters blocked his path...

ext.ext_cn: 直到那个男人拦住她的去路，她才注意到他。
ext.ext_en: She did not notice the man until he moved into her path.

defs.def_en: Your path is the space ahead of you as you move along.

ext.ext_cn: 一辆汽车正在倒车，他看都没看它倒向哪里就一脚迈了出去。
ext.ext_en: He stepped without looking into the path of a reversing car.

ext.ext_cn: 住在机场附近或者航线下方的人们
ext.ext_en: ...people who live near airports or under the flight path of airplanes...

defs.def_en: The path of something is the line which it moves along in a particular direction.

ext.ext_cn: 反对派似乎已经选择了合作而不是对抗的路线。
ext.ext_en: The opposition appear to have chosen the path of cooperation rather than confrontation...

ext.ext_cn: 他许诺在100天内让国家走上经济复兴之路。
ext.ext_en: He promised that within 100 days he would put the country on the path to economic recovery.

defs.def_en: A path that you take is a particular course of action or way of achieving something.

ext.ext_cn: 英国国教在妇女成为牧师的道路上设置了重大障碍。
ext.ext_en: The Church of England put a serious obstacle in the path of women who want to become priests.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is in your path or blocking your path to mean that it is preventing you from doing or achieving what you want.

ext.ext_cn: 他们再次偶遇的可能性非常小。
ext.ext_en: It was highly unlikely that their paths would cross again...

ext.ext_cn: 几年来，尤尔和柯克偶遇了很多次。
ext.ext_en: Over the years, Yul and Kirk had crossed paths many times.

defs.def_en: If you cross someone's path or if your paths cross, you meet them by chance.

ext.ext_cn: 他的职责是安抚那些人，而不是去激怒他们。
ext.ext_en: His duty was to conciliate the people, not to provoke them...

ext.ext_cn: 总统有进行安抚的强烈政治意愿。
ext.ext_en: The President has a strong political urge to conciliate...

defs.def_en: If you conciliate someone, you try to end a disagreement with them.

defs.def_cn: (尤指年轻人在公共场合大声播放音乐用的）大型手提式录音机
defs.def_en: A boom box is a large portable machine for playing music, especially one that is played loudly in public by young people.

ext.ext_cn: 根据《商品说明法》，去年它因在该地区空宅前摆放“待售”牌而获罪并被处以罚款。
ext.ext_en: Last year it was convicted and fined under the Trades Descriptions Act for placing For Sale boards on empty homes in the area.

defs.def_en: In Britain, the Trade Descriptions Act or the Trades Descriptions Act is a law designed to prevent companies from presenting their goods or services in a dishonest or misleading way.
Performance art is a theatrical presentation that includes various art forms such as dance, music, painting, and sculpture.

ext.ext_cn: 诸位，新年好！
ext.ext_en: Happy New Year, everyone...

ext.ext_cn: 元旦期间餐馆关门停业。
ext.ext_en: The restaurant was closed over the New Year...

defs.def_en: New Year or the New Year is the time when people celebrate the start of a year.

ext.ext_cn: 伊莎贝尔年初要生孩子。
ext.ext_en: Isabel was expecting their baby in the New Year...

ext.ext_cn: 石油短缺有可能导致政府在年前提高油价。
ext.ext_en: The oil shortages could lead the government to raise prices before the New Year.

defs.def_en: The New Year is the first few weeks of a year.

ext.ext_cn: 无疑，有经营头脑的人在一年的任何时节都应该能够卖掉好书。
ext.ext_en: Surely anyone with marketing gumption should be able to sell good books at any time of year.

defs.def_en: If someone has gumption, they are able to think what it would be sensible to do in a particular situation, and they do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为，在内心深处她十分佩服他有勇气和她唱反调。
ext.ext_en: He suspected that deep down, she admired him for having the gumption to disagree with her.

defs.def_en: If someone has the gumption to do something, they are brave enough to do it.

defs.def_cn: （尤指并不十分准确的）预计，估计，估算

ext.ext_cn: 据我估计我们离梅卡巴堡有七八公里远。
ext.ext_en: By my reckoning we were seven or eight kilometres from Borj Mechaab.

defs.def_en: Some-one's reckoning is a calculation they make about something, especially a calculation that is not very exact.

ext.ext_cn: 她早知道他们之间的休战持续不了多长时间。他们之间的账迟早要清算。还将会有一场争斗。
ext.ext_en: She knew their truce would not last. There would be a reckoning. There would be another fight.

defs.def_en: See also:day of reckoning;If you say that you will have a reckoning with someone, you mean that you will face them at some time in the future and punish them for something they have done.

ext.ext_cn: 第22届南太平洋论坛年会
ext.ext_en: ...the twenty-second annual gathering of the South Pacific Forum.

defs.def_en: A gathering is a group of people meeting together for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 灯塔的光束在渐浓的暮色中清晰可见。
ext.ext_en: The lighthouse beam was quite distinct in the gathering dusk.

defs.def_en: See also:gather;If there is gathering darkness, the light is gradually decreasing, usually because it is nearly night.

ext.ext_cn: 略微加点盐和胡椒调味。
ext.ext_en: Season lightly with salt and pepper.

ext.ext_cn: 一撮盐
ext.ext_en: ...a pinch of salt.

defs.def_en: Salt is a strong-tasting substance, in the form of white powder or crystals, which is used to improve the flavour of food or to preserve it. Salt occurs naturally in sea water.

ext.ext_cn: 根据自己的口味给原汤加点盐，然后用文火慢炖。
ext.ext_en: Salt the stock to your taste and leave it simmering very gently.

defs.def_en: When you salt food, you add salt to it.

defs.def_cn: 盐，盐类(酸和碱的化合物)

ext.ext_cn: 该岩石中富含矿盐。
ext.ext_en: The rock is rich in mineral salts.

defs.def_en: Salts are substances that are formed when an acid reacts with an alkali.

defs.def_cn: 人中豪杰;社会中坚;吃苦耐劳的人

ext.ext_cn: 那里的大多数人都是吃苦耐劳、心地善良的工人阶级。
ext.ext_en: Most of the people there are salt-of-the-earth, good, working-class people.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as the salt of the earth, you have a lot of respect for them as the type of person who deals with difficult or demanding situations without making any unnecessary fuss.

defs.def_cn: 对…半信半疑;不完全相信

ext.ext_cn: 对这篇记述中那些颇具神奇色彩的部分也不应全信。
ext.ext_en: The more miraculous parts of this account should be taken with a pinch of salt.

defs.def_en: If you take something with a pinch of salt, you do not believe that it is completely accurate or true.

ext.ext_cn: 任何称职的教练都会采取和我一模一样的行动。
ext.ext_en: Any coach worth his salt would do exactly as I did.

defs.def_en: If you say, for example, that any doctor worth his or her salt would do something, you mean that any doctor who was good at his or her job or who deserved respect would do it.

defs.def_cn: 往伤口上撒盐;雪上加霜;落井下石

ext.ext_cn: 我不想往朋友的伤口上撒盐，所以我只说我没有进行面试。
ext.ext_en: I had no intention of rubbing salt into a friend's wounds, so all I said was that I did not give interviews.

defs.def_en: If someone or something rubs salt into the wound, they make the unpleasant situation that you are in even worse, often by reminding you of your failures or faults.
Peritonitis is a disease in which the inside wall of your abdomen becomes swollen and very painful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 二月的空气柔和、凉爽而怡人。
ext.ext_en: The February air was soft, cool, and inviting...

ext.ext_cn: 有一家诱人的带露天阳台的饭馆。
ext.ext_en: There is an inviting restaurant with an outdoor terrace.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is inviting, you mean that it has good qualities that attract you or make you want to experience it.
Low water is the same as low tide .

ext.ext_cn: 有用的章节标题
ext.ext_en: ...helpful chapter headings.

defs.def_en: See also:head;A heading is the title of a piece of writing, which is written or printed at the top of the page.

ext.ext_cn: 不要再扔那些石头了！
ext.ext_en: Stop throwing those stones!...

ext.ext_cn: 他没办法不再想这件事。
ext.ext_en: He can't stop thinking about it...

defs.def_en: If you have been doing something and then you stop doing it, you no longer do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他提出了一项新的外交计划以尽力阻止这场战争。
ext.ext_en: He proposed a new diplomatic initiative to try to stop the war...

ext.ext_cn: 如果大火不被扑灭，它可能会蔓延 2.5 万英亩。
ext.ext_en: If the fire isn't stopped, it could spread to 25,000 acres...

defs.def_en: If you stop something happening, you prevent it from happening or prevent it from continuing.

ext.ext_cn: 雨停了，山顶上有一两颗星星在闪烁。
ext.ext_en: The rain had stopped and a star or two was visible over the mountains...

ext.ext_cn: 系统过热，拍摄工作只好停了下来。
ext.ext_en: The system overheated and filming had to stop...

defs.def_en: If an activity or process stops, it is no longer happening.

defs.def_cn: (机器等)停止运转;(使)停止工作

ext.ext_cn: 钟在凌晨 2 点 12 分时停了。
ext.ext_en: The clock had stopped at 2.12 a.m...

ext.ext_cn: 他的心脏曾 3 次停止跳动。
ext.ext_en: His heart stopped three times...

defs.def_en: If something such as machine stops or is stopped, it is no longer moving or working.

defs.def_cn: (使)(移动着的人或车)停下;把…拦住

ext.ext_cn: 那辆车没有在军方检查站停车。
ext.ext_en: The car failed to stop at an army checkpoint...

ext.ext_cn: 他停下来，好让她追上自己。
ext.ext_en: He stopped and let her catch up with him...

defs.def_en: When a moving person or vehicle stops or is stopped, they no longer move and they remain in the same place.

ext.ext_cn: 人们经常在火车还尚未完全停好时就违规打开车门。
ext.ext_en: People often wrongly open doors before the train has come to a stop...

ext.ext_cn: 他放慢车速，车几乎停住了。
ext.ext_en: He slowed the car almost to a stop.

defs.def_en: If something that is moving comes to a stop or is brought to a stop, it slows down and no longer moves.

ext.ext_cn: 她都没有停下来想一想自己在说些什么。
ext.ext_en: She doesn't stop to think about what she's saying...

ext.ext_cn: 如果停下来好好想想的话，就会发觉整件事情相当蹊跷。
ext.ext_en: There is something rather strange about all this if one stops to consider it...

defs.def_en: If someone does not stop to think or to explain, they continue with what they are doing without taking any time to think about or explain it.

ext.ext_cn: 咖啡馆老板已经按规定贴上了“禁止吸烟”的标志，但是他认为自己的责任就止于此。
ext.ext_en: The cafe owner has put up the required 'no smoking' signs, but thinks his responsibility stops there...

ext.ext_cn: 好消息还不止这些。
ext.ext_en: The good news did not stop there...

defs.def_en: If you say that a quality or state stops somewhere, you mean that it exists or is true up to that point, but no further.

ext.ext_cn: 其中一扇窗户上方有一张地铁线路图，我数了数到西汉普斯特德站共有几站。
ext.ext_en: There was an Underground map above one of the windows and I counted the stops to West Hampstead...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在一个公共汽车站等车。
ext.ext_en: They waited at a bus stop.

defs.def_en: A stop is a place where buses or trains regularly stop so that people can get on and off.

ext.ext_cn: 他坚持让我们在亚特兰大市外不远的一家小餐馆歇歇脚。
ext.ext_en: He insisted we stop at a small restaurant just outside of Atlanta...

ext.ext_cn: 如果不远万里去了澳大利亚，却没在悉尼稍作停留，那真是一种罪过。
ext.ext_en: It would be a crime to travel all the way to Australia and not stop in Sydney.

defs.def_en: If you stop somewhere on a journey, you stay there for a short while.

ext.ext_cn: 库克先生漫长旅程中的最后一站是巴黎。
ext.ext_en: The last stop in Mr Cook's lengthy tour was Paris...

ext.ext_cn: 麦克正开车从佛蒙特向南行驶，中途经停波士顿接上萨拉。
ext.ext_en: Mack was driving down from Vermont, with a stop in Boston to pick Sarah up.

defs.def_en: A stop is a time or place at which you stop during a journey.
In music, organ stops are the knobs at the side of the organ, which you pull or push in order to control the type of sound that comes out of the pipes.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的动机是钱，为了钱他们会不择手段。
ext.ext_en: Their motive is money, and they will stop at nothing to get it.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone will stop at nothing to get something, you are emphasizing that they are willing to do things that are extreme, wrong, or dangerous in order to get it.

ext.ext_cn: 新西兰警方昨天发誓要竭尽全力抓到杀人凶手。
ext.ext_en: New Zealand police vowed yesterday to pull out all the stops to find the killer.

defs.def_en: If you pull out all the stops, you do everything you can to make something happen or succeed.

ext.ext_cn: 他的女儿早该站出来平息所有这些谣言。

A refund is a sum of money which is returned to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.

ext.ext_cn: 我们承诺如果您对所买物品不满意可以退款。
ext.ext_en: We guarantee to refund your money if you're not delighted with your purchase...

ext.ext_cn: 把商品退还给你的零售商，他们会按原价退款的。
ext.ext_en: Take the goods back to your retailer who will refund you the purchase price.

defs.def_en: If someone refunds your money, they return it to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.
Stilettos are women's shoes that have high, very narrow heels.

defs.def_cn: 昂贵而无用的东西;华而不实的东西

ext.ext_cn: 这个耗资400万英镑、用钢与玻璃所构筑起的亭子已经成了一个华而不实的摆设。
ext.ext_en: The pavilion has become a £4 million steel and glass white elephant.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a white elephant, you mean that it is a waste of money because it is completely useless.
Someone's kinswoman is their female relative.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这本书不但不准确,而且夸大其词。
ext.ext_en: The book is both inaccurate and exaggerated...

ext.ext_cn: 这些报告所依据的是不准确的信息。
ext.ext_en: The reports were based on inaccurate information.

defs.def_en: If a statement or measurement is inaccurate, it is not accurate or correct.

ext.ext_cn: 一条面包
ext.ext_en: ...a loaf of bread...

ext.ext_cn: 抹黄油的面包
ext.ext_en: ...bread and butter...

defs.def_en: Bread is a very common food made from flour, water, and yeast.

defs.def_cn: （通过工作等挣得的）钱财，金钱

ext.ext_cn: 科罗拉多的每一个人都是靠着开采银矿养家糊口。
ext.ext_en: There's not a living soul in Colorado who doesn't depend for his bread on silver.

defs.def_en: If you earn your bread doing a particular job or activity, you earn your money doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 把食物抹上面包屑后过几分钟就炸，这一点很重要。
ext.ext_en: It is important that food be breaded just minutes before frying.

defs.def_en: If food such as fish or meat is breaded, it is covered in tiny pieces of dry bread called breadcrumbs. It can then be fried or grilled.

ext.ext_cn: 我的脸上、雨衣上处处湿淋淋的。
ext.ext_en: My face and raincoat were soaking wet.

defs.def_en: If something is soaking or soaking wet, it is very wet.

ext.ext_cn: 人们担心形势可能恶化而演变成一场全面战争。
ext.ext_en: There are fears that the situation might deteriorate into full-scale war...

ext.ext_cn: 天气变得越来越糟。
ext.ext_en: The weather conditions are deteriorating...

defs.def_en: If something deteriorates, it becomes worse in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 他很得意自己“芳心猎手”这一名声。
ext.ext_en: He is proud of his reputation as a seducer of young women.

defs.def_en: A seducer is someone, usually a man, who seduces someone else.
The disk drive on a computer is the part that contains the disk or into which a disk can be inserted. The disk drive allows you to read information from the disk and store information on the disk.

defs.def_cn: （决定、计划、事件产生的）后果，影响

ext.ext_cn: 这本书分析了艾滋病给同性恋群体所带来的社会和政治影响。
ext.ext_en: The book analyses the social and political ramifications of AIDS for the gay community.

defs.def_en: The ramifications of a decision, plan, or event are all its consequences and effects, especially ones which are not obvious at first.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 老城区的街道狭促曲折，好似迷宫一般。
ext.ext_en: The streets of the Old City are narrow and labyrinthine.

defs.def_en: If you  describe a place as labyrinthine, you mean that it is like a labyrinth.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 错综复杂的；盘根错节的；令人费解的

ext.ext_cn: 他对这一错综复杂的情况摸不着头脑
ext.ext_en: ...his failure to understand the labyrinthine complexities of the situation.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation, process, or field of knowledge as labyrinthine, you mean that it is very complicated and difficult to understand.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 阴郁的;脾气不好的;孤僻的

ext.ext_cn: 她面色苍白、忧郁孤僻，并且沉默寡言。
ext.ext_en: She was morose, pale, and reticent.

defs.def_en: Someone who is morose is miserable, bad-tempered, and not willing to talk very much to other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (说话)生气勃勃的，活泼的，明快的

ext.ext_cn: 每部影片都配有简洁明快的双行内容提要。
ext.ext_en: Each film gets a snappy two-line summary.

ext.ext_cn: 简洁明快的美国电影对白
ext.ext_en: ...snappy American film dialogue.

defs.def_en: If someone has a snappy style of speaking, they speak in a quick, clever, brief, and often funny way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她已是一个小有名气的时尚达人。
ext.ext_en: She has already made a name for herself as a snappy dresser.

ext.ext_cn: 时髦的运动夹克
ext.ext_en: ...snappy sports jackets.

defs.def_en: If someone is a snappy dresser or if they wear snappy clothes, they wear smart, stylish clothes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (说话态度)没好气的，恶声恶气的

ext.ext_cn: 他并不是爱发火或爱起急什么的，他只是有点困惑。
ext.ext_en: He wasn't irritable or snappy or anything, just slightly perplexed.

defs.def_en: If someone is snappy, they speak to people in a sharp, unfriendly manner.

ext.ext_cn: 看看手册，动作要快。
ext.ext_en: Look at the pamphlets, and make it snappy.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to make it snappy, you tell them to do something quickly.
See also:City;The Square Mile is the part of London where many important financial institutions have their main offices.
A trumpet is a musical instrument of the brass family which plays quite high notes.

defs.def_cn: 大力鼓吹;积极宣扬;大力宣传

ext.ext_cn: 政府一直积极宣扬旅游业是快速发展型产业。
ext.ext_en: The government has been trumpeting tourism as a growth industry...

ext.ext_cn: 马克·莫里斯，被吹捧为他那一代的舞蹈奇才
ext.ext_en: …Mark Morris, who is trumpeted as the dance talent of his generation…

defs.def_en: If someone trumpets something that they are proud of or that they think is important, they speak about it publicly in a very forceful way.

ext.ext_cn: 当他们靠近时，大象又吼又跺脚。
ext.ext_en: The elephants trumpeted and stamped their feet at their approach.

defs.def_en: When an elephant trumpets, it makes a loud sound.
Radii is the plural of radius .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 反常的；异常的；不规则的

ext.ext_cn: 心律不齐和高度焦虑
ext.ext_en: ...abnormal heart rhythms and high anxiety levels.

ext.ext_cn: 过于认生的小孩
ext.ext_en: ...a child with an abnormal fear of strangers.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is abnormal is unusual, especially in a way that is worrying.

ext.ext_cn: 最好的对策可能就是回避这个问题。
ext.ext_en: The most appropriate strategy may simply be to walk away from the problem...

ext.ext_cn: 没人知道这件事与你有关。你可以置身事外。
ext.ext_en: No one knows you're a part of this. You can just walk away.

defs.def_en: If you walk away from a problem or a difficult situation, you do nothing about it or do not face any bad consequences from it.
Woodwind instruments are musical instruments such as flutes, clarinets, and recorders that you play by blowing into them.

ext.ext_cn: 粉红色丝质束腰短上衣
ext.ext_en: ...a pink silk jacket with an elasticated waist.

defs.def_en: If a piece of clothing or part of a piece of clothing is elasticated, elastic has been sewn or woven into it to make it fit better and to help it keep its shape.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些毛巾很吸水。
ext.ext_en: The towels are highly absorbent.

defs.def_en: Absorbent material soaks up liquid easily.

defs.def_cn: （通常指人因为富有而）有闲的，清闲自在的

ext.ext_cn: 有闲阶级
ext.ext_en: ...the leisured classes.

defs.def_en: Leisured people are people who do not work, usually because they are rich.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 读书和写作的逍遥日子
ext.ext_en: ...this leisured life of reading and writing.

defs.def_en: Leisured activities are done in a relaxed way or do not involve work.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指以赚钱为目的）热衷投机的

ext.ext_cn: 一个喜欢投机的英国商人
ext.ext_en: ...a buccaneering British businessman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as buccaneering, you mean that they enjoy being involved in risky or even dishonest activities, especially in order to make money.

defs.def_cn: (作动词 be 的主语，表示存在与否或引起注意)

ext.ext_cn: 坎布斯福斯和卡尔顿之间的道路在施工。
ext.ext_en: There are roadworks between Camblesforth and Carlton...

ext.ext_cn: 有没有哪些国家已经能成功解决这些问题了？
ext.ext_en: Are there some countries that have been able to tackle these problems successfully?...

defs.def_en: There is used as the subject of the verb 'be' to say that something exists or does not exist, or to draw attention to it.

defs.def_cn: (用在某些动词前表示某事物存在、发展或可见，动词的单复数取决于其后的名词)

ext.ext_cn: 人们对于拟建的高速铁路何时能竣工仍存有很大疑问。
ext.ext_en: There remains considerable doubt over when the intended high-speed rail link will be complete...

ext.ext_cn: 看不出有什么迫在眉睫的危险。
ext.ext_en: There appeared no imminent danger...

defs.def_en: You use there in front of certain verbs when you are saying that something exists, develops, or can be seen. Whether the verb is singular or plural depends on the noun which follows the verb.

defs.def_cn: (用于 hello 或 hi 之后作为问候语)

ext.ext_cn: “嘿，你们好！”那个女人笑着对他们说。——“你好！”他们齐声说。
ext.ext_en: 'Hello there,' said the woman, smiling at them. — 'Hi!' they chorused...

ext.ext_cn: 喂，你好。你一定是西德尼吧。
ext.ext_en: Oh, hi there. You must be Sidney.

defs.def_en: There is used after 'hello' or 'hi' when you are greeting someone.

defs.def_cn: 存在地;现有地;可得到地

ext.ext_cn: 大路拐角处的古老建筑群如今还在。
ext.ext_en: The group of old buildings on the corner by the main road is still there today...

ext.ext_cn: 书摆在那儿，供人们阅读后再作决定。
ext.ext_en: The book is there for people to read and make up their own mind...

defs.def_en: If something is there, it exists or is available.

defs.def_cn: 那儿(指已经提及的地方)

ext.ext_cn: 第二天，我们驱车 33 英里来到锡耶纳参加赛马节(此地的阿尔希诺山庄是个好地方，值得一去)。
ext.ext_en: The next day we drove the 33 miles to Siena (the Villa Arceno is a great place to stay while you are there) for the Palio...

ext.ext_cn: “你要想来的话，就过来吧。”——“我怎么去那里？”
ext.ext_en: 'Come on over, if you want.' — 'How do I get there?'...

defs.def_en: You use there to refer to a place which has already been mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 那儿，那边(表示用手指向的或目视的地方)

ext.ext_cn: 在那儿呢，在那边那个角上。
ext.ext_en: There it is, on the corner over there...

ext.ext_cn: 她在那边，左边那儿。
ext.ext_en: There she is on the left up there...

defs.def_en: You use there to indicate a place that you are pointing to or looking at, in order to draw someone's attention to it.

defs.def_cn: (用于 there he was 或 there we were 等表达方式中，用以概括故事或为了制造特殊效果放慢故事的节奏)

ext.ext_cn: 就这样，我们和埃米到了一起，而她快把我们逼疯了。
ext.ext_en: So there we were with Amy and she was driving us crazy...

ext.ext_cn: 我看了看，发现他在那儿，骑着马，肩上扛着一把双筒猎枪。
ext.ext_en: I looked, and there he was, riding a horse, with a double barreled shotgun on his shoulder.

defs.def_en: You use there in expressions such as 'there he was' or 'there we were' to sum up part of a story or to slow a story down for dramatic effect.

ext.ext_cn: 喂，请问戈登在吗？
ext.ext_en: Hello, is Gordon there please?

defs.def_en: You use there when speaking on the telephone to ask if someone is available to speak to you.

defs.def_cn: 在那一点上(指别人谈话中的某个观点)

ext.ext_cn: 死亡很可怕。这点我同意你的观点。
ext.ext_en: Death is terrible. I agree with you there...

ext.ext_cn: 约翰，我觉得你这点说对了。
ext.ext_en: I think you're right there John...

defs.def_en: You use there to refer to a point that someone has made in a conversation.

defs.def_cn: 那里，那儿(指活动、过程已经达到的阶段)

ext.ext_cn: 我们正在进一步调查，将从那儿入手。
ext.ext_en: We are making further investigations and will take the matter from there...

ext.ext_cn: 本期《科学在行动》到这里就结束了。
ext.ext_en: And there we end this edition of Science in Action...

defs.def_en: You use there to refer to a stage that has been reached in an activity or process.

ext.ext_cn: 我们本来希望补充一些新闻把最后一版填满，可是现在差得还很远。
ext.ext_en: We had hoped to fill the back page with extra news; we're not quite there yet...

ext.ext_cn: 生活还没有恢复正常，不过就快了。
ext.ext_en: Life has not yet returned to normal but we are getting there.

defs.def_en: You use there to indicate that something has reached a point or level which is completely successful.

defs.def_cn: 别无他法;无计可施;只能这样了

ext.ext_cn: 我岁数最大，无论怎么说，都应该有所成就了，可是你看看我这个样子。
ext.ext_en: I'm the oldest and, according to all the books, should be the achiever, but there you go...

ext.ext_cn: 重要的是工钱，不要过于慷慨，但也没办法。
ext.ext_en: It's the wages that count. Not over-generous, but there you are...

defs.def_en: You can use there in expressions such as there you go or there we are when accepting that an unsatisfactory situation cannot be changed.

defs.def_cn: 我讲的没错吧;我说对了吧

ext.ext_cn: 你看，我说的没错吧？这就是为什么我早没提。我就知道你会误解。
ext.ext_en: You see? There you go. That's why I didn't mention it earlier. I knew you'd take it the wrong way...

ext.ext_cn: “你看看，我说对了吧！”她叫道，“我就知道你要那么说。”
ext.ext_en: 'There you are, you see!' she exclaimed. 'I knew you'd say that!'...

defs.def_en: You can use there in expressions such as there you go and there we are when emphasizing that something proves that you were right.

ext.ext_cn: 我现在体重18英石，不能像从前那样跑来跑去了;不过有人说我以前就跑不动。
ext.ext_en: At 18 stone, I can't run around the way I used to. There again, some people say I never did...

ext.ext_cn: 我是说小汽车肯定是解决之道，不过良好的公交系统或许也能解决问题。
ext.ext_en: I mean small cars are the answer surely. Or there again a good system of public transport might do the same thing.

defs.def_en: You use there again to introduce an extra piece of information which either contradicts what has been said or gives an alternative to it.

ext.ext_cn: “瞧，又来了不是？又惹孩子伤心！”雪莉说。
ext.ext_en: 'There you go again, upsetting the child!' said Shirley...

ext.ext_cn: “爸爸，又来了吧，又说傻话了。”——“对不起，儿子。”
ext.ext_en: 'There you go again, Dad, with your silly words.' — 'Sorry, son.'...

defs.def_en: Phrases such as there you go again are used to show annoyance at someone who is repeating something that has annoyed you in the past.

ext.ext_cn: “接招”乐队是世界上最好的组合，就是这样的。
ext.ext_en: 'Take That' are the best group in the whole world. So there...

ext.ext_cn: 我看那样很好，就这么定了。
ext.ext_en: I think that's sweet, so there.

defs.def_en: You can add 'so there' to what you are saying to show that you will not change your mind about a decision you have made, even though the person you are talking to disagrees with you.

ext.ext_cn: 许多人觉得他应该当场辞职。
ext.ext_en: Many felt that he should have resigned there and then...

ext.ext_cn: 他当时就做出了决定。
ext.ext_en: There and then he made his decision...

defs.def_en: If something happens there and then or then and there, it happens immediately.

defs.def_cn: 好了，好了(用于安慰他人，尤其是儿童)

ext.ext_cn: “好了，好了，”妈妈说，“你只是做了一个很可怕的噩梦。”
ext.ext_en: 'There, there,' said Mum. 'You've been having a really bad dream.'

defs.def_en: You say 'there there' to someone who is very upset, especially a small child, in order to comfort them.

ext.ext_cn: 诺拉抱起那个男孩，给他一块饼干，说：“伦尼，给，拿着这块好吃的饼干。”
ext.ext_en: Nora picked up the boy, and gave him a biscuit. 'There you are, Lennie, you take the nice biscuit.'

defs.def_en: You say 'there you are' or 'there you go' when you are offering something to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 无论过去发生过什么，我希望她知道，我是支持她的。
ext.ext_en: Despite what happened in the past I want her to know I am there for her.

defs.def_en: If someone is there for you, they help and support you, especially when you have problems.

defs.def_cn: （足球或曲棍球运动中的）守门

ext.ext_cn: 守门员约翰·卢基奇的精彩表现让他们感到庆幸。
ext.ext_en: They were thankful for the excellent goalkeeping of John Lukic.

defs.def_en: In games such as football and hockey, goalkeeping refers to the activity of guarding the goal.
A cougar is a wild member of the cat family. Cougars have brownish-grey fur and live in mountain regions of North and South America.

ext.ext_cn: 回英国老家再见！
ext.ext_en: See you back in Blighty!

defs.def_en: Blighty is a way of referring to England.

ext.ext_cn: 这在全日本引起了不小的骚动，他们不得不因此改变主意。
ext.ext_en: This caused such a ruckus all over Japan that they had to change their mind.

defs.def_en: If someone or something causes a ruckus, they cause a great deal of noise, argument, or confusion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 恐怖的;令人厌恶的;让人反感的

ext.ext_cn: 牢房的气味令人作呕。
ext.ext_en: The smell in the cell was revolting...

ext.ext_cn: 这是我吃过的最让人反胃的东西。
ext.ext_en: It was the most revolting thing I have ever tasted.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is revolting, you mean you think they are horrible and disgusting.

ext.ext_cn: 乔治说：“艾达，你好吗？”她皱了一会儿眉头，然后才认出他。“乔治·布莱克，噢，我一直都不好。”
ext.ext_en: George said, 'Ida, how are you?' She frowned for a moment and then recognition dawned. 'George Black. Well, I never.'...

ext.ext_cn: 他试图在她的脸上找出一丝认出他的神情，但是根本没有。
ext.ext_en: He searched for a sign of recognition on her face, but there was none.

defs.def_en: Recognition is the act of recognizing someone or identifying something when you see it.

ext.ext_cn: 英国工业联合会对财政大臣承认经济出现衰退表示欢迎，并希望能出台降低利率的政策。
ext.ext_en: The CBI welcomed the Chancellor's recognition of the recession and hoped for a reduction in interest rates.

defs.def_en: Recognition of something is an understanding and acceptance of it.

defs.def_cn: （政府对他国的）外交认可，正式承认

ext.ext_cn: 南非于9月15日正式承认了卢旺达的新政府。
ext.ext_en: South Africa gave diplomatic recognition to Rwanda's new government on September 15...

ext.ext_cn: 他的政府直到7月份才得到英国的正式承认。
ext.ext_en: His government did not receive full recognition by Britain until July.

defs.def_en: When a government gives diplomatic recognition to another country, they officially accept that its status is valid.

ext.ext_cn: 最后，她父亲的工作得到了大众的认可。
ext.ext_en: At last, her father's work has received popular recognition...

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个出色的射手，但并没有获得应有的认可。
ext.ext_en: He is an outstanding goalscorer who doesn't get the recognition he deserves.

defs.def_en: When a person receives recognition for the things that they have done, people acknowledge the value or skill of their work.

defs.def_cn: 面目全非;认不出来;无法辨认

ext.ext_cn: 尸体都残缺不全，无法辨认了。
ext.ext_en: The bodies were mutilated beyond recognition...

ext.ext_cn: 这些设备经过大幅度的改良，都让人认不出来了。
ext.ext_en: The facilities have improved beyond all recognition...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has changed beyond recognition or out of all recognition, you mean that person or thing has changed so much that you can no longer recognize them.

ext.ext_cn: 巴西恢复了与南非的外交关系，以示对其采取措施结束种族隔离的正式认可。

ext.ext_en: Other rich pickings, including season ticket sales, are expected to exceed last year's £5m.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Ed was snowed under with fan mail when he was doing his television show.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 崇拜明星的;一心想当明星的

ext.ext_en: At first I was a bit starstruck but then I realised they were just doing their job, same as me.

ext.ext_en: ...a starstruck teenager who auditions for a TV dance show.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as starstruck, you mean that they are very interested in and impressed by famous performers, or that they want to be a performer themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 有 900 颗雕花宝石、59 尊大理石半身像、2,500 多枚钱币和纪念章，以及其他许多收藏品的收藏家
ext.ext_en: ...a collector who had, inter alia, 900 engraved gems, 59 marble busts, and over 2,500 coins and medals.

defs.def_en: You use inter alia, meaning 'among other things', when you want to say that there are other things involved apart from the one you are mentioning.

ext.ext_cn: 我要告诉你一个小秘密。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to let you in on a little secret...

ext.ext_cn: 他还不知道这个不幸的消息。
ext.ext_en: He has not yet been let in on the bad news.

defs.def_en: If you let someone in on something that is a secret from most people, you allow them to know about it.
If you refer to someone as a deadbeat, you are criticizing them because you think they are lazy and do not want to be part of ordinary society.
Braille is a system of printing for blind people. The letters are printed as groups of raised dots that you can feel with your fingers.

defs.def_cn: 巧克力脆皮冰激凌;紫雪糕
defs.def_en: A choc-ice is a small block of ice cream covered in chocolate.
A workhorse is a horse which is used to do a job, for example to pull a plough.

defs.def_cn: 吃苦耐劳的人;老黄牛;重负荷机器

ext.ext_cn: 在战争中立下汗马功劳的威灵顿轰炸机
ext.ext_en: ...the Wellington bomber, the great workhorse of the war...

ext.ext_cn: 我丈夫甚至从不看我一眼。我只是个任苦任劳养育3个孩子的机器。
ext.ext_en: My husband never even looked at me. I was just a workhorse bringing up three children.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or a machine as a workhorse, you mean that they can be relied upon to do a large amount of work, especially work that is dull or routine.
A mutant is an animal or plant that is physically different from others of the same species because of a change in its genes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (吸毒后)飘飘然的，神志恍惚的
defs.def_en: If someone is stoned, their mind is greatly affected by a drug such as cannabis.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 直至几个月前，在现代音乐神秘殿堂之外很少有人听说了戈莱斯基。
ext.ext_en: Until a few months ago few people outside the arcane world of contemporary music had heard of Gorecki.

defs.def_en: Something that is arcane is secret or mysterious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 表示歉意的；认错的；愧疚的

ext.ext_cn: 医院的工作人员深表歉意，但这真的于事无补。
ext.ext_en: The hospital staff were very apologetic but that couldn't really compensate...

ext.ext_cn: 对于他们所做的改进，他们简直感到愧疚。
ext.ext_en: They were almost apologetic about the improvements they'd made...

defs.def_en: If you are apologetic, you show or say that you are sorry for causing trouble for someone, for hurting them, or for disappointing them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可信赖的;值得信赖的；可靠的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个头脑冷静、值得信赖的领导。
ext.ext_en: He is a trustworthy and level-headed leader.

defs.def_en: A trustworthy person is reliable, responsible, and can be trusted completely.

ext.ext_cn: 他们呼吁各方作出让步以打破世界贸易谈判中的僵局。
ext.ext_en: They called for a compromise on all sides to break the deadlock in the world trade talks...

ext.ext_cn: 双方上个月的和平谈判陷入了僵局。
ext.ext_en: Peace talks between the two sides ended in deadlock last month.

defs.def_en: If a dispute or series of negotiations reaches deadlock, neither side is willing to give in at all and no agreement can be made.

defs.def_cn: 接着发生;接踵而来;随之产生

ext.ext_cn: 如果欧洲人不减少补贴，便会发生贸易战。
ext.ext_en: If the Europeans did not reduce subsidies, a trade war would ensue...

ext.ext_cn: 紧接着是短暂却令人难堪的沉默。
ext.ext_en: A brief but embarrassing silence ensued.

defs.def_en: If something ensues, it happens immediately after another event, usually as a result of it.

defs.def_cn: （用于测试新药效力的）无效对照剂；（用以安慰想象自己得病的人的）安慰剂
defs.def_en: A placebo is a substance with no effects that a doctor gives to a patient instead of a drug. Placebos are used when testing new drugs or sometimes when a patient has imagined their illness.

ext.ext_cn: 抗议者们在许多主要的十字路口设置了路障。
ext.ext_en: Protesters have been putting up barricades across a number of major intersections...

ext.ext_cn: 他正在为自己家搭建新的篱笆墙。
ext.ext_en: He was putting up a new fence at his home.

defs.def_en: If people put up a wall, building, tent, or other structure, they construct it so that it is upright.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正在悬挂新的路标。
ext.ext_en: They're putting new street signs up...

ext.ext_cn: 那所教师培训学院为该学院的创立者立了一块纪念牌匾。
ext.ext_en: The teacher training college put up a plaque to the college's founder.

defs.def_en: If you put up a poster or notice, you fix it to a wall or board.

ext.ext_cn: 最后库尔德人没有作任何抵抗就投降了。
ext.ext_en: In the end the Kurds surrendered without putting up any resistance...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾努力争取让你留在那儿。
ext.ext_en: He'd put up a real fight to keep you there...

defs.def_en: To put up resistance to something means to resist it.

ext.ext_en: The state agreed to put up $69,000 to start his company...

ext.ext_cn: 商业银行为产业界募集资金。事实上他们自己并不出资。
ext.ext_en: The merchant banks raise capital for industry. They don't actually put it up themselves.

defs.def_en: If you put up money for something, you provide the money that is needed to pay for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的朋友建议提高价格。
ext.ext_en: Their friends suggested they should put up their prices...

ext.ext_cn: 他们知道他会增加对他们的征税。
ext.ext_en: They know he would put their taxes up.

defs.def_en: To put up the price of something means to cause it to increase.

ext.ext_cn: 我想知道她能否让我住几天。
ext.ext_en: I wanted to know if she could put me up for a few days...

ext.ext_cn: 数百名初级文职官员只能被安排到旅馆和临时青年招待所过夜。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of junior civil servants have to be put up in hotel rooms and temporary hostels...

defs.def_en: If a person or hotel puts you up or if you put up somewhere, you stay there for one or more nights.

defs.def_cn: 提名…为候选人；参加竞选

ext.ext_cn: 那个新的政党提名了15名候选人竞争22个席位。
ext.ext_en: The new party is putting up 15 candidates for 22 seats...

ext.ext_cn: 他作为候选人参选。
ext.ext_en: He put up as a candidate.

defs.def_en: If a political party puts up a candidate in an election or if the candidate puts up, the candidate takes part in the election.

defs.def_cn: （给飞机或其他交通工具）（再）加油;（给…）续燃料

ext.ext_en: His plane stopped in France to refuel...

ext.ext_cn: 航空公司的机务人员给飞机加了油。
ext.ext_en: The airline's crew refuelled the plane.

defs.def_en: When an aircraft or other vehicle refuels or when someone refuels it, it is filled with more fuel so that it can continue its journey.

defs.def_cn: 细木工手艺；细木工制品
defs.def_en: Joinery is the skill and work of a joiner.
Jumper cables are the same as jump leads .
A classroom is a room in a school where lessons take place.

ext.ext_cn: 我进去的时候这家商店的店主正在扫地。
ext.ext_en: The owner of the store was sweeping his floor when I walked in...

ext.ext_cn: 宠物的主人都知道它们有自己的个性。
ext.ext_en: Every pet owner knows their animal has its own personality...

defs.def_en: See also:home owner;landowner;The owner of something is the person to whom it belongs.

ext.ext_en: Compensation for lost or damaged mail will be handled by the postal service...

ext.ext_cn: 写上完整的邮政地址。
ext.ext_en: Include your full postal address.

defs.def_en: Postal is used to describe things or people connected with the public service of carrying letters and packages from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 工会将通过秘密邮寄选票的方式选举领导人。
ext.ext_en: Unions would elect their leadership by secret postal ballot.

ext.ext_en: ...a postal course in freelance photography.

defs.def_en: Postal is used to describe activities that involve sending things by post.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: the muted greens of the far pasture...

defs.def_en: Muted colours are soft and gentle, not bright and strong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If something or someone is indelicate, they are rude or embarrassing.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is poncey, you mean you do not like them because they are too feminine or artistic.

ext.ext_en: The country had witnessed scenes of tumult not far removed from civil war...

ext.ext_en: Myles is a human dynamo.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a dynamo, you mean that they are very energetic and are always busy and active.

ext.ext_cn: 圭亚那的铁路以前是归私有企业所有的。

ext.ext_en: The contract was awarded to a previously unknown company...

defs.def_en: Previously means at some time before the period that you are talking about.

ext.ext_en: He had first entered the House 12 years previously...

ext.ext_en: She had rented the flat from the council some fourteen months previously.

defs.def_en: You can use previously to say how much earlier one event was than another event.

ext.ext_en: He could be gruff and monosyllabic.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone or the way they speak as monosyllabic, you mean that they say very little, usually because they do not want to have a conversation.

defs.def_cn: 溴化物，溴化钾（用作镇静剂）

ext.ext_en: The meeting produced the usual bromides about macroeconomic policy, third-world debt and the environment.

defs.def_en: A bromide is a comment which is intended to calm someone down when they are angry, but which has been expressed so often that it has become boring and meaningless.

ext.ext_cn: 他毫不在乎文学的社会、政治或道德层面。
ext.ext_en: He cared not a whit for the social, political or moral aspects of literature...

ext.ext_en: It does not matter one whit to the customer.

defs.def_en: You say not a whit or not one whit to emphasize that something is not the case at all.

ext.ext_en: The orchestra gave its first performance on Whit Monday.

defs.def_en: Whit means the same as Whitsun .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: His unhappiness was understandable.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour or feelings as understandable, you think that they have reacted to a situation in a natural way or in the way you would expect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Roger Neuberg writes in a simple and understandable way.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a statement or theory is understandable, you mean that people can easily understand it.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管天气恶劣，却渔获颇丰。
ext.ext_en: Despite the poor weather the fishing has been pretty good.

ext.ext_cn: 渔船
ext.ext_en: ...a fishing boat.

defs.def_en: Fishing is the sport, hobby, or business of catching fish.
The European Union is an organization of European countries which have joint policies on matters such as trade, agriculture, and finance.

ext.ext_cn: 一堆砖
ext.ext_en: ...a heap of bricks...

ext.ext_cn: 一堆堆肥
ext.ext_en: ...a compost heap...

defs.def_en: A heap of things is a pile of them, especially a pile arranged in a rather untidy way.

ext.ext_cn: 马德里加尔夫人将更多的胡萝卜堆到了迈克尔的盘子里。
ext.ext_en: Mrs. Madrigal heaped more carrots onto Michael's plate.

ext.ext_cn: 在一旁，民兵团正在堆柴点篝火。
ext.ext_en: Off to one side, the militia was heaping up wood for a bonfire.

defs.def_en: If you heap things somewhere, you arrange them in a large pile.

ext.ext_cn: 海军首长对密谋分子的手法和动机都表示出极大的轻蔑。
ext.ext_en: The head of the navy heaped scorn on both the methods and motives of the conspirators.

defs.def_en: If you heap praise or criticism on someone or something, you give them a lot of praise or criticism.

ext.ext_cn: 你有的是时间。
ext.ext_en: You have heaps of time...

ext.ext_cn: 可能适合经验丰富的人的工作
ext.ext_en: ...a job that might suit someone with heaps of experience...

defs.def_en: Heaps of something or a heap of something is a large quantity of it.

ext.ext_cn: 那些身处社会高层的人们
ext.ext_en: ...those at the top of the social heap...

ext.ext_cn: 曾经养尊处优的国企普通工人，突然发现自己已跌至社会底层。
ext.ext_en: Ordinary workers in state industry, once favoured, suddenly found themselves at the bottom of the heap.

defs.def_en: Someone who is at the bottom of the heap or at the top of the heap is low down or high up in society or an organization.

ext.ext_cn: 年青的足球队员完成激烈的阻截后瘫倒在地动弹不得。
ext.ext_en: The young footballer collapsed in a heap after a heavy tackle.

defs.def_en: If someone collapses in a heap, they fall heavily and untidily and do not move.

ext.ext_cn: 信封上盖有赫尔辛基的邮戳。
ext.ext_en: The envelope was postmarked Helsinki.

defs.def_en: If a letter is postmarked, it has a printed mark on the envelope showing when and where the letter was posted.

ext.ext_en: American economists have made important contributions to the field of financial and corporate economics...

ext.ext_cn: 他由于为世界和平做出贡献而获奖。
ext.ext_en: He was awarded a prize for his contribution to world peace.

defs.def_en: If you make a contribution to something, you do something to help make it successful or to produce it.

ext.ext_cn: 这张名单列出了慈善捐款额达50万美元以上的公司。
ext.ext_en: This list ranked companies that make charitable contributions of a half million dollars or more.

defs.def_en: A contribution is a sum of money that you give in order to help pay for something.

ext.ext_cn: 他有时会对屏幕上出现的画面明显感到不自在。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes he is decidedly uncomfortable at what he sees on the screen...

defs.def_en: Decidedly means to a great extent and in a way that is very obvious.

defs.def_cn: 值得注意的;显著的;有趣的

ext.ext_en: It is noteworthy that the programme has been shifted from its original August slot to July...

ext.ext_en: I found nothing particularly noteworthy to report...

defs.def_en: A fact or event that is noteworthy is interesting, remarkable, or significant in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 全新的方法
ext.ext_en: ...an entirely new approach...

ext.ext_cn: 欺诈完全是另外一回事。
ext.ext_en: Fraud is an entirely different matter...

defs.def_en: Entirely means completely and not just partly.

ext.ext_cn: 我完全同意。
ext.ext_en: I agree entirely...

ext.ext_cn: 天啊，整件事完全是他的错。
ext.ext_en: Oh, the whole episode was entirely his fault.

ext.ext_en: The government is ready to declare a permanent ceasefire...

ext.ext_en: His lawyers are confident that the judges will declare Mr Stevens innocent...

ext.ext_en: Your income must be declared on this form...

defs.def_en: If someone does something in a trice, they do it very quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 以9至13岁儿童为目标观众的节目
ext.ext_en: ...a programme aimed at a pre-teen audience.

A snowfield is a large area which is always covered in snow.

defs.def_cn: 典型行为模式;特有生活方式

ext.ext_en: Mining activities have totally disrupted the traditional way of life of the Yanomami Indians.

defs.def_en: A way of life is the behaviour and habits that are typical of a particular person or group, or that are chosen by them.

ext.ext_en: She likes it so much it's become a way of life for her.

ext.ext_cn: 暴力随处可见的城市
ext.ext_en: ...cities where violence is a way of life.

defs.def_en: If you describe a particular activity as a way of life for someone, you mean that it has become a very important and regular thing in their life, rather than something they do or experience occasionally.

ext.ext_cn: 她答应下一个周末和他在城里共进晚餐。
ext.ext_en: She had agreed to have dinner with him in town the following weekend...

ext.ext_en: Production has dropped while prices and unemployment have skyrocketed.

ext.ext_cn: 暴涨的医疗费用
ext.ext_en: ...the skyrocketing costs of health care.

defs.def_en: If prices or amounts skyrocket, they suddenly increase by a very large amount.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: It is possible that a tax cut might have some stimulative effect.

defs.def_en: If a government policy has a stimulative effect on the economy, it encourages the economy to grow.

ext.ext_en: She applied a little lipstick, wiped it off, but it left a pink tinge.

defs.def_en: If you wipe away or wipe off dirt or liquid from something, you remove it, for example by using a cloth or your hand.

defs.def_cn: 复活节彩蛋（复活节礼物，用巧克力制成，在某些国家彩蛋会被藏起来让孩子们去找）
defs.def_en: An Easter egg is an egg made of chocolate that is given as a present at Easter. In some countries, Easter eggs are hidden and children then look for them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 毁灭性的;极具破坏力的

ext.ext_en: The city of Ormac took the full force of the winds and devastating floods...

ext.ext_cn: 婚外情确实会对婚姻造成毁灭性的影响。
ext.ext_en: Affairs do have a devastating effect on marriages.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as devastating, you are emphasizing that it is very harmful or damaging.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人极为震惊的;使人极度不安的;可怕的

ext.ext_cn: 诊断结果令人震惊：她得了癌症。
ext.ext_en: The diagnosis was devastating. She had cancer.

defs.def_en: You can use devastating to emphasize that something is very shocking, upsetting, or terrible.

defs.def_cn: 极其引人注目的;令人印象深刻的

ext.ext_en: ...a devastating display of galloping and jumping...

ext.ext_cn: 如果让我来说的话，我真是棒极了。
ext.ext_en: I was devastating, if I do say so myself.

defs.def_en: You can use devastating to emphasize that something or someone is very impressive.

ext.ext_en: They said they would not be voting for him because he was too left-wing.

defs.def_en: Left-wing people have political ideas that are based on socialism.

ext.ext_en: The left-wing of the party is confident that the motion will be carried.

defs.def_en: The left wing of a group of people, especially a political party, consists of the members of it whose beliefs are closer to socialism than are those of its other members.

defs.def_en: Drink-drive means relating to drink-driving.

defs.def_en: Sails are large pieces of material attached to the mast of a ship. The wind blows against the sails and pushes the ship along.

ext.ext_en: The Kruzenshtern is expected to sail for Boston this week.

defs.def_en: You say a ship sails when it moves over the sea.

ext.ext_en: I shall get myself a little boat and sail her around the world...

ext.ext_en: For nearly two hundred miles she sailed on, her sails hard with ice...

defs.def_en: If you sail a boat or if a boat sails, it moves across water using its sails.

ext.ext_en: ...a windmill, its sails turning in the breeze.

defs.def_en: The sails on a windmill are the long flat parts that are turned by the wind.

ext.ext_en: Christopher Columbus set sail for the New World in the Santa Maria.

ext.ext_en: ...the challenge and fun of going to sea under sail.

ext.ext_cn: 扬帆航行的大船
ext.ext_en: ...a big ship under sail.

defs.def_en: If you cross the sea under sail, you cross it in a ship that has sails rather than an engine.

ext.ext_en: I don't tan...

defs.def_en: Something that is tan is a light brown colour.

ext.ext_en: ...the process of tanning animal hides.

ext.ext_en: Each of the area managers enjoys considerable autonomy in the running of his own area.

ext.ext_cn: 她携新欢一同现身。

ext.ext_en: He was garbed in sweater, tweed jacket, and flying boots.

ext.ext_cn: 肤色黝黑、满脸皱纹、身穿蓝色衣服的小个子女人
ext.ext_en: ...the small blue-garbed woman with a brown wrinkled face.

defs.def_en: If someone is garbed in particular clothes, they are wearing those clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 她的幽默言谈和坚定决心对其他人来说是一种鼓舞。
ext.ext_en: Her humour and determination were a source of inspiration to others.

defs.def_en: See also:sense of humour;You can refer to the amusing things that people say as their humour .

ext.ext_cn: 她很同情这个男人，但这一情景又让她忍俊不禁。
ext.ext_en: She felt sorry for the man but couldn't ignore the humour of the situation.

defs.def_en: Humour is a quality in something that makes you laugh, for example in a situation, in someone's words or actions, or in a book or film.

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯蒂娜仍搞不清楚为什么他情绪这么差。

ext.ext_en: Hugo bore his illness with great courage and good humour.
