ext.ext_en: I'm a passionate believer in public art...

defs.def_en: A passionate person has very strong feelings about something or a strong belief in something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 美丽而炽烈的26岁女子
ext.ext_en: ...a beautiful, passionate woman of twenty-six.

ext.ext_cn: 热恋故事
ext.ext_en: ...the story of a passionate love affair...

defs.def_en: A passionate person has strong romantic or sexual feelings and expresses them in their behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 雌性与雄性配对时，雌性不允许其他雄性与之交配。
ext.ext_en: During the time she is paired to a male, the female allows no other males to copulate with her...

ext.ext_cn: 鲸交配需要24小时。
ext.ext_en: Whales take twenty-four hours to copulate.

defs.def_en: If one animal or person copulates with another, they have sex. You can also say that two animals or people copulate.

ext.ext_cn: 十字形的塔
ext.ext_en: ...a cruciform tower.

defs.def_en: A cruciform building or object is shaped like a cross.

ext.ext_cn: 他期待着与新首相共事。
ext.ext_en: He was looking forward to working with the new Prime Minister.

defs.def_en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车经销商预期汽车销量会进一步攀升。
ext.ext_en: Motor traders are looking forward to a further increase in vehicle sales.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is looking forward to something useful or positive, you mean they expect it to happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有政治家风范的;有政治家才干的

ext.ext_cn: 他作为一位睿智、具备政治家才干的州长而广受尊崇。
ext.ext_en: He was widely respected as a wise and statesmanlike governor...

ext.ext_cn: 他正试图在这个选举年中树立一种更加威严、更有政治家风范的形象。
ext.ext_en: He is trying to project a more dignified, statesmanlike image in this election year.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone, especially a political leader, as statesmanlike, you approve of them because they give the impression of being very able and experienced.

defs.def_cn: 入门毒品，诱导性毒品（如大麻，一些人认为此类毒品可诱人吸食更为有害的毒品）
defs.def_en: A gateway drug is a drug such as cannabis that is believed by some people to lead to the use of more harmful drugs such as heroin or cocaine.

defs.def_cn: 媒体，传播工具，传播媒介(如电视、广播、报纸和杂志等)

ext.ext_cn: 这是份苦差，并非像媒体描绘的那般令人向往。
ext.ext_en: It is hard work and not a glamorous job as portrayed by the media.

ext.ext_cn: 新闻媒体的偏见
ext.ext_en: ...bias in the news media...

defs.def_en: See also:mass media;multimedia;You can refer to television, radio, newspapers, and magazines as the media .
Media is a plural of medium .

defs.def_cn: (18世纪的家具风格)齐彭代尔式的

ext.ext_cn: 一对齐彭代尔式椅子
ext.ext_en: ...a pair of Chippendale chairs.

defs.def_en: Chippendale is a style of furniture from the eighteenth century.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 粗糙的；粗涩的；似皮革的

ext.ext_cn: 他须发蓬乱，皮肤也相当粗糙。
ext.ext_en: His hair and beard are both untidy and his skin is quite leathery.

defs.def_en: If the texture of something, for example someone's skin, is leathery, it is tough and hard, like leather.

ext.ext_cn: 他还有各个层级的管理经验。
ext.ext_en: He has also had managerial experience on every level...

ext.ext_cn: 他靠母亲帮忙照顾他的双胞胎;她在这方面很有经验。
ext.ext_en: He's counting on his mother to take care of the twins for him; she's had plenty of experience with them.

defs.def_en: See also:work experience;Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity, which you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

defs.def_cn: （组成个人生活或形成个性的）经历，阅历

ext.ext_cn: 我在这里应该不会有任何危险，但是经验告诉我要小心。
ext.ext_en: I should not be in any danger here, but experience has taught me caution...

ext.ext_cn: 经验告诉她在日常生活中要不时休息一下。
ext.ext_en: She had learned from experience to take little rests in between her daily routine...

defs.def_en: Experience is used to refer to the past events, knowledge, and feelings that make up someone's life or character.

ext.ext_cn: 搬家对我而言已经成了常事。
ext.ext_en: Moving had become a common experience for me...

ext.ext_cn: 到目前为止他唯一的一次园艺经历非常令人满意。
ext.ext_en: His only experience of gardening so far proved immensely satisfying...

defs.def_en: An experience is something that you do or that happens to you, especially something important that affects you.

ext.ext_cn: 我们以前从未有过这样的假期，不知道会怎么样。
ext.ext_en: We had never experienced this kind of holiday before and had no idea what to expect...

ext.ext_cn: 英国商业现在正经历严重的衰退。
ext.ext_en: British business is now experiencing a severe recession.

defs.def_en: If you experience a particular situation, you are in that situation or it happens to you.

ext.ext_cn: 寡妇似乎比鳏夫更痛苦。
ext.ext_en: Widows seem to experience more distress than do widowers.

ext.ext_cn: 痛苦的感受
ext.ext_en: ...the experience of pain.

defs.def_en: If you experience a feeling, you feel it or are affected by it.

defs.def_cn: 超验的;超越一般常识(或信念)的

ext.ext_cn: 上帝的超验本质
ext.ext_en: ...the transcendental nature of God.

defs.def_en: Transcendental refers to things that lie beyond the practical experience of ordinary people, and cannot be discovered or understood by ordinary reasoning.

ext.ext_cn: 要求禁猎狐狸、水貂和野兔的提案
ext.ext_en: ...a proposal for a ban on the hunting of foxes, mink and hares.

ext.ext_cn: 带貂皮衬里的羊绒外套
ext.ext_en: ...cashmere coats lined with mink.

defs.def_en: A mink is a small animal with highly valued fur.

ext.ext_cn: 有些人喜欢穿貂皮大衣，戴钻石首饰。
ext.ext_en: Some people like to dress up in minks and diamonds.

defs.def_en: A mink is a coat or other garment made from the fur of a mink.

defs.def_cn: (为某一人群提供的)营地(如难民营、战俘营、军营等)

ext.ext_cn: 难民营
ext.ext_en: ...a refugee camp...

ext.ext_cn: 包括美国兵在内的 2,500名外国战俘一直被囚禁在坦波夫附近的战俘营。
ext.ext_en: 2,500 foreign prisoners-of-war, including Americans, had been held in camps near Tambov.

defs.def_en: A camp is a collection of huts and other buildings that is provided for a particular group of people, such as refugees, prisoners, or soldiers, as a place to live or stay.
A camp is an outdoor area with buildings, tents, or caravans where people stay on holiday.

ext.ext_cn: 吉卜赛营地
ext.ext_en: ...gypsy camps...

ext.ext_cn: 我们到前面那座小山上扎营。
ext.ext_en: We'll make camp on that hill ahead.

defs.def_en: A camp is a collection of tents or caravans where people are living or staying, usually temporarily while they are travelling.

ext.ext_cn: 我们靠近海滩宿营。
ext.ext_en: We camped near the beach.

ext.ext_cn: 用睡袋在人行道上露宿的那些男人
ext.ext_en: ...the men, who are camping on the pavement in sleeping bags.

defs.def_en: If you camp somewhere, you stay or live there for a short time in a tent or caravan, or in the open air.

defs.def_cn: (拥护某人、某政策或某观念的)阵营,集团,派别

ext.ext_cn: 这份媒体发布的声明激起了戈尔阵营以及其他民主党高层人士的愤怒抗议。
ext.ext_en: The press release provoked furious protests from the Gore camp and other top Democrats.

ext.ext_cn: 一个亲密的同事,在一场办公室纠纷中站到对方一边去了
ext.ext_en: ...a close colleague, who had sided with the opposite camp in an office dispute.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a group of people who all support a particular person, policy, or idea as a particular camp .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (常指男同性恋者的举止、表演、穿着)夸张而惹人发笑的,娘娘腔的，忸怩作态的

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯·巴伦献上了一段夸张逗笑的表演。
ext.ext_en: James Barron turns in a delightfully camp performance.

ext.ext_cn: 那段录像里是7分钟极尽夸张搞笑的闹剧表演。
ext.ext_en: The video was seven minutes of high camp and melodrama.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour, performance, or style of dress as camp, you mean that it is exaggerated and amusing, often in a way that is thought to be typical of some male homosexuals.

defs.def_cn: 故作夸张地表演;装腔作势;忸怩作态

ext.ext_cn: 他耍宝逗乐，讲荤段子，没完没了地说一堆毫无头绪的八卦。
ext.ext_en: He camped it up, he told bad taste jokes and endless anecdotes with no point at all.

defs.def_en: If  a performer camps it up, they deliberately perform in an exaggerated and often amusing way.
A travel rep is the same as a holiday rep .

defs.def_cn: (公司或机构的)董事会，理事会

ext.ext_cn: 该银行将由一个职业银行家组成的董事会来管理。
ext.ext_en: The Bank would be managed by a directorate of professional bankers.

defs.def_en: A directorate is a board of directors in a company or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 欧盟的健康安全理事会
ext.ext_en: ...the Health and Safety Directorate of the EU.

defs.def_en: A directorate is a part of a government department which is responsible for one particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 采矿会污染湖水，毁掉森林。
ext.ext_en: Mining would pollute the lake and denude the forest...

ext.ext_cn: 许多山坡上都已经光秃秃的，没有任何树木了。
ext.ext_en: Many hillsides had been denuded of trees.

defs.def_en: To denude an area means to destroy the plants in it.

ext.ext_cn: 现在大使馆里所有的外国和当地工作人员都清空了。
ext.ext_en: The Embassy is now denuded of all foreign and local staff...

ext.ext_cn: 在这些地区，我们在村子里根本看不到年轻人。
ext.ext_en: In such areas we see villages denuded of young people.

defs.def_en: To denude someone or something of a particular thing means to take it away from them.

defs.def_cn: 镜像网站（与另一网站内容相同，但网址略有不同，方便更多人登录受欢迎的网站）
defs.def_en: A mirror site is a website which is the same as another website operated by the same person or organization but has a slightly different address. Mirror sites are designed to make it easier for more people to visit a popular website.

ext.ext_cn: 为他的犹豫不决寻找借口是很容易的。
ext.ext_en: It is easy to find excuses for his indecisiveness...

ext.ext_cn: 一旦有了宝宝，我就完全有理由呆在家里了。
ext.ext_en: Once I had had a baby I had the perfect excuse to stay at home...

defs.def_en: An excuse is a reason which you give in order to explain why something has been done or has not been done, or in order to avoid doing something.

defs.def_cn: （尤指别人不赞同时）为…辩解，为…寻找理由

ext.ext_cn: 他辩解说自己是“为了供养妻子和猫儿被迫去抢劫的”。
ext.ext_en: He excused himself by saying he was 'forced to rob to maintain my wife and cat'...

ext.ext_cn: 那并不能为我母亲的行为辩解。
ext.ext_en: That doesn't excuse my mother's behaviour.

defs.def_en: To excuse someone or excuse their behaviour means to provide reasons for their actions, especially when other people disapprove of these actions.

ext.ext_cn: 很多人可能已经原谅了他们逃避责任的行为。
ext.ext_en: Many people might have excused them for shirking some of their responsibilities.

defs.def_en: If you excuse someone for something wrong that they have done, you forgive them for it.

ext.ext_cn: 在学校放假期间，她通常不必担负职责。
ext.ext_en: She is usually excused from her duties during the school holidays...

ext.ext_cn: 星期六她不用工作。
ext.ext_en: She was excused duties on Saturday.

defs.def_en: If someone is excused from a duty or responsibility, they are told that they do not have to carry it out.

ext.ext_cn: 他告辞后回到他楼上的房间。
ext.ext_en: He excused himself and went up to his room.

defs.def_en: If you excuse yourself, you use a phrase such as 'Excuse me' as a polite way of saying that you are about to leave.

defs.def_cn: 对不起，劳驾，打扰一下（用于礼貌地引起注意，尤其是要提问时）

ext.ext_cn: 请问，您是霍尼格先生吗？
ext.ext_en: Excuse me, but are you Mr Honig?

defs.def_en: You say 'Excuse me' when you want to politely get someone's attention, especially when you are about to ask them a question.

defs.def_cn: 对不起，抱歉（用于因打扰或打断对方而道歉）

ext.ext_cn: 抱歉打断一下，我觉得有件事我得说。
ext.ext_en: Excuse me interrupting, but there's a thing I feel I've got to say.

defs.def_en: You use excuse me to apologize to someone when you have disturbed or interrupted them.

defs.def_cn: 对不起，抱歉（用于礼貌地表示要离开或者停止和对方交谈）

ext.ext_cn: “抱歉出去一下，”她对贾维斯说，然后离开了房间。
ext.ext_en: 'Excuse me,' she said to Jarvis, and left the room...

ext.ext_cn: 对不起，这会儿我有工作要做。
ext.ext_en: Now if you'll excuse me, I've got work to do.

defs.def_en: You use excuse me or a phrase such as if you'll excuse me as a polite way of indicating that you are about to leave or that you are about to stop talking to someone.

defs.def_cn: 对不起，抱歉（用于表示反对）

ext.ext_cn: 抱歉，我想知道所有这些和我们有什么关系。
ext.ext_en: Excuse me, but I want to know what all this has to do with us.

defs.def_en: You use excuse me, but to indicate that you are about to disagree with someone.

defs.def_cn: 对不起，抱歉，借过（用于因为撞到某人或者在人群中挤过时表示道歉）

ext.ext_cn: 西顿一边说对不起、借过，一边挤过人群进入拥挤的客厅。
ext.ext_en: Saying excuse me, pardon me, Seaton pushed his way into the crowded living room.

defs.def_en: You say excuse me to apologize when you have bumped into someone, or when you need to move past someone in a crowd.

defs.def_cn: 抱歉，对不起（用于为打嗝、打喷嚏等失礼行为道歉）
defs.def_en: You say excuse me to apologize when you have done something slightly embarrassing or impolite, such as burping, hiccupping, or sneezing.
You say 'Excuse me?' to show that you want someone to repeat what they have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 还有杜松子酒吗？
ext.ext_en: Is there any gin left?...

ext.ext_cn: 他还剩有大把的钱。
ext.ext_en: He's got plenty of money left...

defs.def_en: If there is a certain amount of something left, or if you have a certain amount of it left, it remains when the rest has gone or been used.

ext.ext_cn: 在英国，汽车靠左行驶。
ext.ext_en: In Britain cars drive on the left.

ext.ext_cn: 温室左边那面砖墙
ext.ext_en: ...the brick wall to the left of the conservatory...

defs.def_en: The left is one of two opposite directions, sides, or positions. If you are facing north and you turn to the left, you will be facing west. In the word 'to', the 't' is to the left of the 'o'.

defs.def_cn: 左边的；左面的；左侧的；用在左边的
defs.def_en: Your left arm, leg, or ear, for example, is the one which is on the left side of your body. Your left shoe or glove is the one which is intended to be worn on your left foot or hand.

ext.ext_cn: 传统的左翼政党
ext.ext_en: ...the traditional parties of the Left...

ext.ext_cn: 政府的工业政策遭到了左派的猛烈抨击。
ext.ext_en: The government's industrial policy has been fiercely attacked by the left.

defs.def_en: You can refer to people who support the political ideals of socialism as the left. They are often contrasted with the right, who support the political ideals of capitalism and conservatism.

ext.ext_cn: 1979年撒切尔夫人首次大选获胜后，工党的路线明显左转。
ext.ext_en: After Mrs Thatcher's first election victory in 1979, Labour moved sharply to the left...

ext.ext_cn: 将出现极左或极右的情况。
ext.ext_en: There will be a radical swing to the right or the left.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or political party has moved to the left, you mean that their political beliefs have become more left-wing.

defs.def_cn: 完全的;彻底的;最大限度的

ext.ext_cn: 爆发全面核战争的可能性
ext.ext_en: ...the possibility of a full-scale nuclear war.

defs.def_en: Full-scale means as complete, intense, or great in extent as possible.

defs.def_cn: 与实物一样大小的;原尺寸的

ext.ext_cn: 能够工作的原尺寸样机
ext.ext_en: ...working, full-scale prototypes.

defs.def_en: A full-scale drawing or model is the same size as the thing that it represents.

defs.def_cn: 强烈的民族情绪;沙文主义表现

ext.ext_cn: 战争的真正代价在近几个月里所表现出的强烈民族情绪中被忽略了。
ext.ext_en: The real costs of the war have been ignored in the flag-waving of recent months.

defs.def_en: You can use flag-waving to refer to the expression of feelings for a country in a loud or exaggerated way, especially when you disapprove of this.

defs.def_cn: (艺术、文学上的)超现实主义，超现实派

ext.ext_cn: 他早期的作品受到了20世纪30年代欧洲超现实主义的影响。
ext.ext_en: His early work was influenced by the European surrealism of the 1930's.

defs.def_en: Surrealism is a style in art and literature in which ideas, images, and objects are combined in a strange way, like in a dream.

defs.def_cn: （与过去分词连用构成形容词）表示“时常”，“经常”

ext.ext_cn: 外交大臣就该条约发表的观点有大量记述并被屡屡提及。
ext.ext_en: The Foreign Secretary's views on the treaty are well-documented and oft-repeated...

ext.ext_cn: 结果发现这首诗比起它常被引用的那几句来更加恼人。
ext.ext_en: It turns out to be a far more irritating poem than its oft-quoted lines suggest.

defs.def_en: Oft- combines with past participles to form adjectives that mean that something happens or is done often.

defs.def_cn: （尤指在金融方面的）神童，奇才

ext.ext_cn: 金融神童
ext.ext_en: ...a financial whizz kid.

ext.ext_cn: 物理神童
ext.ext_en: ...a whizz-kid physics student.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a young person as a whizz-kid, you mean that they have achieved success at a young age because they are very clever and very good at something, especially making money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 新的;刚出现的;新做的;新建的

ext.ext_cn: 他们刚在斯托克地区开了一家新宾馆。
ext.ext_en: They've just opened a new hotel in the Stoke area...

ext.ext_cn: 这项新发明能保证啤酒始终保持丰富的泡沫。
ext.ext_en: The new invention ensures the beer keeps a full, frothy head.

defs.def_en: Something that is new has been recently created, built, or invented or is in the process of being created, built, or invented.

ext.ext_cn: 那天下午她出门买了一件新裙子。
ext.ext_en: That afternoon she went out and bought a new dress...

ext.ext_cn: 有很多新旧不一的船待售。
ext.ext_en: There are many boats, new and used, for sale...

defs.def_en: Something that is new has not been used or owned by anyone.

ext.ext_cn: 按照新规定，一些工厂的减排量要高达90%。
ext.ext_en: Under the new rules, some factories will cut emissions by as much as 90 percent...

ext.ext_cn: 我到新的工作岗位只有几天的时间。
ext.ext_en: I had been in my new job only a few days...

defs.def_en: You use new to describe something which has replaced another thing, for example because you no longer have the old one, or it no longer exists, or it is no longer useful.

ext.ext_cn: 新发现的行星大约是地球的10倍那么大。
ext.ext_en: The new planet is about ten times the size of the earth.

defs.def_en: New is used to describe something that has only recently been discovered or noticed.

defs.def_cn: (一天或一年)新开始的，初始的

ext.ext_cn: 新年伊始是反思过去一年诸多成就的好时机。
ext.ext_en: The start of a new year is a good time to reflect on the many achievements of the past...

ext.ext_cn: 下次选举要选出带领我们进入新世纪的政府。
ext.ext_en: The next election is for the government to take us into the new century.

defs.def_en: A new day or year is the beginning of the next day or year.

ext.ext_cn: 刚做妈妈的人通常会有的疲惫感
ext.ext_en: ...the usual exhaustion of a new mother...

ext.ext_cn: 协会给新成员人手一本免费手册。
ext.ext_en: The Association gives a free handbook to all new members.

defs.def_en: New is used to describe someone or something that has recently acquired a particular status or position.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 公司对她早有耳闻。
ext.ext_en: She wasn't new to the company...

ext.ext_cn: 当时我是第一次听到他的名字，就记住了。
ext.ext_en: His name was new to me then and it stayed in my mind...

defs.def_en: If you are new to a situation or place, or if the situation or place is new to you, you have not previously seen it or had any experience of it.

defs.def_cn: (土豆、胡萝卜、豆子等)时鲜的，早的
defs.def_en: New potatoes, carrots, or peas are produced early in the season for such vegetables and are usually small with a sweet flavour.

ext.ext_cn: 纽约队不太需要他们的教练比尔·帕索斯的鼓动。
ext.ext_en: New York needed little prompting from their coach Bill Parcells.

ext.ext_cn: 潜意识的驱使
ext.ext_en: ...the promptings of your subconscious.

defs.def_en: If you respond to prompting, you do what someone encourages or reminds you to do.

defs.def_cn: 工作周;一周的工作时间

ext.ext_cn: 工会寻求增加工资，缩短每周工作时间。
ext.ext_en: The union had sought a wage increase and a shorter work week.

defs.def_en: A work week is the amount of time during a normal week which you spend doing your job.

defs.def_cn: 为…提供资金；对…进行融资；资助

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司已经资助了当地好几部电影。
ext.ext_en: The company has bankrolled a couple of local movies.

defs.def_en: To bankroll a person, organization, or project means to provide the financial resources that they need.

ext.ext_cn: 对于这5张专辑，我们有至少170万英镑的保证资金。
ext.ext_en: We have a guaranteed minimum bankroll of £1.7m over the five albums.

defs.def_en: A bankroll is the financial resources used to back a person, project, or institution.

defs.def_cn: 工业化养殖;工厂化饲养
defs.def_en: Factory farming is a system of farming which involves keeping animals indoors, often with very little space, and giving them special foods so that they grow more quickly or produce more eggs or milk.
A stanchion is a pole or bar that stands upright and is used as a support.

defs.def_cn: 为…所不理解；在…的知识范围之外

ext.ext_cn: 该主题专业性太强，一般的外行人很难理解。
ext.ext_en: The subject matter was so technical as to be beyond the ken of the average layman.

defs.def_en: If something is beyond your ken, you do not have enough knowledge to be able to understand it.

defs.def_cn: (用于名词、形容词词首)表示“三”

ext.ext_cn: 三方会议
ext.ext_en: ...a tripartite meeting...

ext.ext_cn: 它是三角形的。
ext.ext_en: It was triangular in shape.

defs.def_en: Tri- is used at the beginning of nouns and adjectives that have 'three' as part of their meaning.
In Britain, Australia, Canada, and some other countries, a White Paper is an official report which describes the policy of the Government on a particular subject.

ext.ext_cn: 就在选举拉开序幕前，君主政体的问题使政局变得复杂起来。
ext.ext_en: The issue of the monarchy is complicating politics in the run-up to the elections...

ext.ext_cn: 公司相信在圣诞节前这些产品的销路会不错。
ext.ext_en: The company believes the products will sell well in the run-up to Christmas.

defs.def_en: The run-up to an event is the period of time just before it.

defs.def_cn: (投掷、跳高、跳远等之前的)助跑

ext.ext_cn: 当我重新参赛后，我要解决助跑这一项。
ext.ext_en: When I began to compete again, I was struggling with my run-up.

defs.def_en: In sport, a run-up is the run made by a player or athlete, for example before throwing a ball or a javelin, or before jumping.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 计划不周的;不连贯的;散乱的

ext.ext_cn: 计划不周的事件
ext.ext_en: ...a scrappy affair...

ext.ext_cn: 最后一章不过是一些支离破碎的补充内容。
ext.ext_en: The final chapter is no more than a scrappy addition.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as scrappy, you disapprove of it because it seems to be badly planned or untidy.

defs.def_cn: 热狗（夹有热红肠的长形面包）
defs.def_en: A hot dog is a long bread roll with a hot sausage inside it.

defs.def_cn: 烂糊状东西;软乎乎的东西

ext.ext_cn: 冰箱里的棕色糊状东西是一些剩的蔬菜汤。
ext.ext_en: The brown mush in the fridge is some veg soup left over.

defs.def_en: Mush is a thick, soft paste.

defs.def_cn: 感伤的事物;多愁善感的作品

ext.ext_cn: 无论什么时候，只要知名女演员们聚在一起，去演绎一部“女性题材电影”，那毫无疑问里面准是一堆多愁善感的故事。
ext.ext_en: Whenever famous actresses get together to make a 'woman's film' you can bet on an overload of sentimental mush.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a film or book as mush, you mean that it is very sentimental.

ext.ext_cn: 捣成泥的土豆和花菜
ext.ext_en: ...mushed-up potato and cauliflower.

defs.def_en: If you mush something, you make it into a  mush.

ext.ext_cn: 他们两个都想轮岗。
ext.ext_en: They both want to job share.

ext.ext_cn: 她在一家银行干一份轮岗制工作。
ext.ext_en: She works in a bank job share.

defs.def_en: If two people job share, they share the same job by working part-time, for example one person working in the mornings and the other in the afternoons.

ext.ext_cn: 业主是他的一位旧相识。
ext.ext_en: The proprietor was an old acquaintance of his...

ext.ext_cn: 我在摄影界交游甚广。
ext.ext_en: I have a large circle of friends and acquaintances engaged in photography.

defs.def_en: An acquaintance is someone who you have met and know slightly, but not well.

ext.ext_cn: 因为认识一位警官而参与到一件真实谋杀悬案调查的作家
ext.ext_en: ...a writer who becomes involved in a real murder mystery through his acquaintance with a police officer...

ext.ext_cn: 初次相见时她表现冷淡并有点爱搭不理。
ext.ext_en: On first acquaintance she is cool and slightly distant.

defs.def_en: If you have an acquaintance with someone, you have met them and you know them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在哲学或是历史方面几乎一无所知。
ext.ext_en: They had little or no acquaintance with philosophy or history...

defs.def_en: Your acquaintance with a subject is your knowledge or experience of it.

defs.def_cn: 与（某人）初次相识;结识(某人)

ext.ext_cn: 我与他初次相识是在20世纪60年代早期。
ext.ext_en: I first made his acquaintance in the early 1960s...

ext.ext_cn: 很高兴认识您，特威德先生。
ext.ext_en: I am so pleased to make your acquaintance, Mr Tweed.

defs.def_en: When you make someone's acquaintance, you meet them for the first time and get to know them a little.

ext.ext_cn: 我们认识的一位很有修养的女性
ext.ext_en: ...a highly cultivated woman of our acquaintance.

defs.def_en: A person of your acquaintance is someone who you have met and know.

defs.def_cn: （尤指属于同一社会阶层的）（女）老乡，（女）同乡
defs.def_en: A homegirl is a girl or woman from the same area as you, especially one from the same social group as you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 使人蒙受耻辱的;让人出丑的;丢脸的

ext.ext_cn: 保守党人遭受到了一次颜面尽失的失败。
ext.ext_en: The Conservatives have suffered a humiliating defeat...

ext.ext_cn: 这件事如此丢脸，深深地挫伤了我的自尊心。
ext.ext_en: It was so humiliating, a terrible blow to my self-esteem.

defs.def_en: If something is humiliating, it embarrasses you and makes you feel ashamed and stupid.

ext.ext_cn: 我不希望被人控告篡改证据。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to be accused of tampering with the evidence...

ext.ext_cn: 他发现他的电脑被人动过手脚。
ext.ext_en: He found his computer had been tampered with.

defs.def_en: If someone tampers with something, they interfere with it or try to change it when they have no right to do so.

ext.ext_cn: 中国人将谷物奉为上天的恩赐。
ext.ext_en: The Chinese revered corn as a gift from heaven...

ext.ext_cn: 现在，他仍被尊为国父。
ext.ext_en: Today he's still revered as the father of the nation.

defs.def_en: If you revere someone or something, you respect and admire them greatly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 将会有充足的机会去放松、游泳和晒太阳。
ext.ext_en: There'll be ample opportunity to relax, swim and soak up some sun...

ext.ext_cn: 底层的设计为建一个大厨房提供了充足的空间。
ext.ext_en: The design of the ground floor created ample space for a good-sized kitchen.

defs.def_en: If there is an ample amount of something, there is enough of it and usually some extra.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 丰满的怀里抱着婴儿的年轻妈妈
ext.ext_en: ...a young mother with a baby resting against her ample bosom.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's figure as ample, you mean that they are large in a pleasant or attractive way.
Torrential rain pours down very rapidly and in great quantities.

defs.def_cn: （顶部有绒球的）羊毛帽，毛绒帽
defs.def_en: A bobble hat is a woollen hat with a bobble on it.

ext.ext_cn: 你不为什么不上楼去躺一会儿呢？
ext.ext_en: Why don't you go upstairs and lie down for a bit?

defs.def_en: When you lie down, you move into a horizontal position, usually in order to rest or sleep.

ext.ext_cn: 上周报纸的一篇头版文章
ext.ext_en: ...a front-page article in last week's paper.

defs.def_en: A front-page article or picture appears on the front page of a newspaper because it is very important or interesting.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 孤立的;保守的;思想狭隘的

ext.ext_cn: 孤立保守而又恐外的英国人的旧有形象
ext.ext_en: ...the old image of the insular, xenophobic Brit.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is insular, you are being critical of them because they are unwilling to meet new people or to consider new ideas.

defs.def_cn: (尤当have为助动词时，who have 的常用口语形式)
defs.def_en: Who've is the usual spoken form of 'who have,' especially when 'have' is an auxiliary verb.
Cetaceans are animals such as whales, dolphins, and porpoises.

defs.def_cn: (残疾人、病人或年幼者等的)看护人，护理者

ext.ext_cn: 从事初级保健护理工作的几乎都是女性。
ext.ext_en: It is nearly always women who are the primary care givers.

defs.def_en: A caregiver is someone who is responsible for looking after another person, for example, a person who is disabled, ill, or very young.

ext.ext_cn: 潮湿的砖块由传送带送进另一间小屋进行干燥。
ext.ext_en: The damp bricks went along a conveyor belt into another shed to dry.

defs.def_en: A conveyor belt or a conveyor is a continuously moving strip of rubber or metal which is used in factories for moving objects along so that they can be dealt with as quickly as possible.

ext.ext_cn: 在千篇一律的病房里，他们感到恐惧而又无能为力。
ext.ext_en: They feel scared and powerless in conveyor-belt hospital wards.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as a conveyor belt, you dislike it because it produces things or people which are all the same or always deals with things or people in the same way.

ext.ext_cn: 在人生的最后阶段，猫王普雷斯利的歌曲大不如前，通常近乎于自我嘲弄。
ext.ext_en: By the end of his life, Presley's vocals often descended close to self-parody.

defs.def_en: Self-parody is a way of performing or behaving in which you exaggerate and make fun of the way you normally perform or behave.

ext.ext_cn: 不受官僚繁文缛节限制的私人信托
ext.ext_en: ...a private trust which would not be fettered by bureaucracy...

ext.ext_cn: 黑色的稀泥限制了她的行动。
ext.ext_en: The black mud fettered her movements.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are fettered by something, you dislike it because it prevents you from behaving or moving in a free and natural way.

defs.def_cn: (规则、传统、责任的)束缚，约束，桎梏

ext.ext_cn: 社会习俗的约束
ext.ext_en: ...the fetters of social convention.

defs.def_en: You can use fetters to refer to things such as rules, traditions, or responsibilities that you dislike because they prevent you from behaving in the way you want.

ext.ext_cn: 他在地牢里看见一个戴着脚镣的男孩。
ext.ext_en: He saw a boy in fetters in the dungeons.

defs.def_en: Especially in former times, fetters were chains for a prisoner's feet.
A hutch is a wooden structure that rabbits or other small pet animals are kept in.
A phial is a small tube-shaped glass bottle used, for example, to hold medicine.

ext.ext_cn: 对不起，克里斯，可我对这个家伙很反感。
ext.ext_en: Sorry, Chris, but I have bad vibes about this guy...

ext.ext_cn: 在西欧其他任何城市的星期六晚上，你都无法看到像曼彻斯特这样的景象。
ext.ext_en: You don't see a vibe like you see in Manchester on a Saturday night in any other city in western Europe.

defs.def_en: Vibes are the good or bad atmosphere that you sense with a person or in a place.

ext.ext_cn: 包括电颤琴、大提琴、低音吉他、手风琴和单簧管在内的其他多种乐器
ext.ext_en: ...a variety of other instruments, including vibes, cello, bass, accordion and clarinet.

defs.def_en: Vibes are the same as a vibraphone .

defs.def_cn: 初选名单；初审名单；初赛名单

ext.ext_cn: 27位骑手进入初赛。
ext.ext_en: There  are 27 riders on the long-list.

defs.def_en: A long-list for something such as a job or a prize is a large group that has been chosen from all the people who applied for the job, or all the people or things that are competing for the prize. The successful ones from this group are chosen to go on the shortlist .

ext.ext_cn: 她去年被列入了一线队初选名单。
ext.ext_en: She was long-listed for the senior team last year.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is long-listed for a job or a prize, they are put on a long-list of those to be considered for that job or prize.

defs.def_cn: (为做成某事或正常生活)要求有，必须有，需要

ext.ext_cn: 他迫切需要钱。
ext.ext_en: He desperately needed money...

ext.ext_cn: 这些饮食提供了你身体需要的所有营养。
ext.ext_en: These diets provide everything your body needs...

defs.def_en: If you need something, or need to do something, you cannot successfully achieve what you want or live properly without it.

defs.def_cn: (表示某一做法对某事物或地方有益)应该，应当，需要

ext.ext_cn: 该建筑有好几处应该修缮。
ext.ext_en: The building needs quite a few repairs.

ext.ext_cn: 应该清整的花园
ext.ext_en: ...a garden that needs tidying...

defs.def_en: If an object or place needs something doing to it, that action should be done to improve the object or place. If a task needs doing, it should be done to improve a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 福里斯特先生认为全英国都需要有类似的学校。
ext.ext_en: Mr Forrest believes there is a need for other similar schools throughout Britain...

ext.ext_cn: “我想我们应该见见专家。”——“我认为没有任何必要。”
ext.ext_en: 'I think we should see a specialist.' — 'I don't think there's any need for that.'...

defs.def_en: If there is a need for something, that thing would improve a situation or something cannot happen without it.

defs.def_cn: 不必，没有必要(用于告知或建议)

ext.ext_cn: “我会把钥匙放在窗户里。”——“不必麻烦了，”他粗声说道。
ext.ext_en: 'I'll put the key in the window.' — 'You needn't bother,' he said gruffly...

ext.ext_cn: 嗨，你不必大喊大叫。
ext.ext_en: Look, you needn't shout...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone needn't do something, you are telling them not to do it, or advising or suggesting that they should not do it.

defs.def_cn: (与否定词连用)不必，没有必要

ext.ext_cn: 你不必担心。
ext.ext_en: You needn't worry...

ext.ext_cn: 西蒙，这花不了多长时间。
ext.ext_en: This needn't take long, Simon...

defs.def_en: If you tell someone that they needn't do something, or that something needn't happen, you are telling them that that thing is not necessary, in order to make them feel better.

defs.def_cn: (与否定词连用)准许不做，可以不做

ext.ext_cn: 如果你不想来，可以不用再来。
ext.ext_en: You needn't come again, if you don't want to...

ext.ext_cn: 好吧，如果你不想告诉我，可以什么也不说。
ext.ext_en: Well, you needn't tell me anything if you don't want to.

defs.def_en: You use needn't when you are giving someone permission not to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 对我们来说是对的东西，对别人来说未必正确。
ext.ext_en: What is right for us need not be right for others...

ext.ext_cn: 自由不一定意味着独立。
ext.ext_en: Freedom need not mean independence.

defs.def_en: If something need not be true, it is not necessarily true or not always true.

defs.def_cn: (与否定词连用)本来不必，本来不需要

ext.ext_cn: 她本来可以自己做三明治的;她妈妈原本不必费心做任何事情。
ext.ext_en: She could have made the sandwich herself; her mum needn't have bothered to do anything...

ext.ext_cn: 我宣布和格雷丝订婚时有点紧张，但我本不必担心的。
ext.ext_en: I was a little nervous when I announced my engagement to Grace, but I needn't have worried...

defs.def_en: If someone needn't have done something, it was not necessary or useful for them to do it, although they did it.

defs.def_cn: (与否定词连用)无需说，不必说

ext.ext_cn: 如果你没按我的要求做的话，后果请自负——这话我就不必再说了吧。
ext.ext_en: I needn't add that if you fail to do as I ask, you will suffer the consequences.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎不用说，我从未和他失去联系。
ext.ext_en: I hardly need to say that I have never lost contact with him.

defs.def_en: You use need in expressions such as I need hardly say and I needn't add to emphasize that the person you are talking to already knows what you are going to say.

defs.def_cn: 还需要再说吗;还要我继续说吗

ext.ext_cn: 五十四五岁，黑色短发，灰色八字胡，明显的俄国口音，还需要我继续说吗？
ext.ext_en: Mid-fifties, short black hair, grey moustache, distinctive Russian accent. Need I go on?

defs.def_en: You can use need in expressions such as 'Need I say more' and 'Need I go on' when you want to avoid stating an obvious consequence of something you have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 教育主管部门得救助贫困儿童。
ext.ext_en: The education authorities have to provide for children in need...

ext.ext_cn: 记住，在你们两个都有困难的时候，是我借钱给你们的。
ext.ext_en: Remember that when both of you were in need, I was the one who loaned you money.

defs.def_en: People in need do not have enough of essential things such as money, food, or good health.

ext.ext_cn: 我没事，就是需要休息一下。
ext.ext_en: I was all right but in need of rest...

ext.ext_cn: 他早就应该刮一下胡子了。
ext.ext_en: He was badly in need of a shave...

defs.def_en: If you are in need of something, you need it or ought to have it.

defs.def_cn: 需要的话;如有必要(英国英语中亦作 if needs be)

ext.ext_cn: 他们现在将争取获准将案件呈交上议院审理，并且，如有必要，会上诉到欧洲人权法院。
ext.ext_en: They will now seek permission to take their case to the House of Lords, and, if need be, to the European Court of Human Rights.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will do something, especially an extreme action, if need be, you mean that you will do if it is necessary. In British English, you can also say if needs be .

ext.ext_cn: 没有必要叫医生。
ext.ext_en: There's no need to call a doctor...

ext.ext_cn: 这份杂志没必要出现那种语言。
ext.ext_en: There's no need for that kind of language in this magazine...

defs.def_en: You can tell someone that there's no need for them to do something as a way of telling them not to do it or of telling them to stop doing it, for example because it is unnecessary.

ext.ext_cn: 这话对不住我亲爱的历史老师，不过有谁需要历史课呢？
ext.ext_en: With apologies to my old history teacher, who needs history lessons?...

ext.ext_cn: 香烟，谁会要呀？
ext.ext_en: Cigarettes, who needs them?

defs.def_en: You can say 'Who needs something?' as a way of emphasizing that you think that this thing is unnecessary or not useful.

defs.def_cn: (信息)传来;(报告或电话)接收到

ext.ext_cn: 另一所监狱也发生了骚乱的消息正在不断传来。
ext.ext_en: Reports are now coming in of trouble at yet another jail.

defs.def_en: If information, a report, or  a telephone call comes in, it is received.

ext.ext_cn: 她没有收入，也没有存款。
ext.ext_en: She had no money coming in and no funds.

defs.def_en: If you have some money coming in, you receive it regularly as your income.

defs.def_cn: 加入，参与(讨论、安排或任务)

ext.ext_cn: 我能否也加入进来，说说这两点呢？
ext.ext_en: Can I come in here too, on both points?...

ext.ext_cn: 他请来一名设计师重新设计制服。
ext.ext_en: He had a designer come in and redesign the uniforms.

defs.def_en: If someone comes in on a discussion, arrangement, or task, they join it.

defs.def_cn: (新的观点、时装或产品)流行起来，上市

ext.ext_cn: 那时正是地理学真正开始发生改变、许多新观念兴起的时候。
ext.ext_en: It was just when geography was really beginning to change and lots of new ideas were coming in...

ext.ext_cn: 我不会为比例代表制的出现而难过，我认为这种制度将逐渐流行起来。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't be sorry to see proportional representation and I think it's a thing which will gradually come in.

defs.def_en: When a new idea, fashion, or product comes in, it becomes popular or available.

defs.def_cn: (在某件事中)起作用，发挥作用

ext.ext_cn: 罗丝又问：“但是需要我们干什么，亨利？”
ext.ext_en: Rose asked again, 'But where do we come in, Henry?'

ext.ext_cn: 最后，他再也无能为力了，这也正是雅克发挥作用的时候。
ext.ext_en: Finally, he could do no more, which is where Jacques came in.

defs.def_en: If you ask where something or someone comes in, you are asking what their role is in a particular matter.
When the tide comes in, the water in the sea gradually moves so that it covers more of the land.

ext.ext_cn: 一罐芥子酱
ext.ext_en: ...a pot of mustard...
