defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我将很乐意向你们展示一切。
ext.ext_en: I'll be glad to show you everything...

ext.ext_cn: 我们愿意回答任何问题。
ext.ext_en: We should be glad to answer any questions.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will be glad to do something, usually for someone else, you mean that you are willing and eager to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 报喜讯的人
ext.ext_en: ...the bringer of glad tidings.

defs.def_en: Glad tidings means good news.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 丙种羟基丁酸盐，G毒（毒品，可作药用，服后令人兴奋）
defs.def_en: GHB is a drug with some medical uses, which some people take illegally to make them feel happy and energetic. GHB is an abbreviation for（缩略=）'gamma hydroxy-butyrate'.
A tornado is a violent wind storm consisting of a tall column of air which spins round very fast and causes a lot of damage.

ext.ext_cn: 遵守礼节但互相憎恨的受人尊敬的夫妇
ext.ext_en: ...respectable couples who observe the proprieties but loathe each other.

defs.def_en: The proprieties are the standards of social behaviour which most people consider socially or morally acceptable.

defs.def_cn: (尝试、努力或行动)犹疑的，彷徨的，踉跄的

ext.ext_cn: “现在我觉得我能做了。”他用结结巴巴巴的英语说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Now I feel I can do it,' he said in faltering English...

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔倚着乔恩，踉踉跄跄地走到浴室。
ext.ext_en: Leaning on Jon, Michael took faltering steps to the bathroom.

defs.def_en: A faltering attempt, effort, or movement is uncertain because the person doing it is nervous or weak, or does not really know what to do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 决定性的;关键的;明确的

ext.ext_cn: 他在总统大选中取得的压倒性胜利
ext.ext_en: ...his decisive victory in the presidential elections...

ext.ext_cn: 选举活动现在已进入了最后的决定性阶段。
ext.ext_en: The election campaign has now entered its final, decisive phase...

defs.def_en: If a fact, action, or event is decisive, it makes it certain that there will be a particular result.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他应该让位于更年轻、更有决断力的领导者。
ext.ext_en: He should give way to a younger, more decisive leader.

defs.def_en: If someone is decisive, they have or show an ability to make quick decisions in a difficult or complicated situation.

defs.def_cn: （路边禁止或限制停车的）黄线
defs.def_en: A yellow line is a narrow yellow line painted at the edge of a road to warn drivers that parking is not allowed there, or is only allowed at certain times.
A chancellery is the building where a chancellor has his offices.

ext.ext_cn: 他以前是大臣官署的头儿。
ext.ext_en: He is a former head of the chancellery.

defs.def_en: The chancellery is the officials who work in a chancellor's office.

defs.def_cn: 赛博朋克，数字朋克(以计算机或信息技术为主题的科幻小说)
defs.def_en: Cyberpunk is a type of science fiction.

ext.ext_cn: 现世界冠军
ext.ext_en: ...the reigning world champion.

defs.def_en: The reigning champion is the most recent winner of a contest or competition at the time you are talking about.

defs.def_cn: 一方的；单边的；单方面的

ext.ext_cn: 单方面核裁军
ext.ext_en: ...unilateral nuclear disarmament.

defs.def_en: A unilateral decision or action is taken by only one of the groups, organizations, or countries that are involved in a particular situation, without the agreement of the others.

defs.def_cn: （尤指作为例证）引用，援引，提及

ext.ext_cn: 她引用了自己最喜爱的一首乔治·赫伯特的诗。
ext.ext_en: She cites a favourite poem by George Herbert...

ext.ext_cn: 他只引用了一个例子。
ext.ext_en: He cites just one example...

defs.def_en: If you cite something, you quote it or mention it, especially as an example or proof of what you are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 他们引证了亚历克斯拒绝回到婚后的家中一事。
ext.ext_en: They cited Alex's refusal to return to the marital home...

ext.ext_cn: 3位海军上将和1位海军高级文员将被指名，原因是他们在接到性侵犯的举报后没有采取任何行动。
ext.ext_en: Three admirals and a top Navy civilian will be cited for failing to act on reports of sexual assaults.

defs.def_en: To cite a person means to officially name them in a legal case. To cite a reason or cause means to state it as the official reason for your case.

ext.ext_cn: 法官裁定为无效审判，并以严重渎职为名传讯了检察官。
ext.ext_en: The judge ruled a mistrial and cited the prosecutors for outrageous misconduct.

defs.def_en: If someone is cited, they are officially ordered to appear before a court.
Alluvial soils are soils which consist of earth and sand left behind on land which has been flooded or where a river once flowed.

ext.ext_cn: 曼彻斯特周围环绕着绿色乡村带、住宅区和工业区。
ext.ext_en: Manchester is hemmed in by greenbelt countryside and by housing and industrial areas...

ext.ext_cn: 通往门口的砖路两旁是高大、杂乱的黄杨树篱。
ext.ext_en: The brick path to the door was hemmed in on either side by tall, unkempt boxwood hedges.

defs.def_en: If a place is hemmed in by mountains or by other places, it is surrounded by them.

ext.ext_cn: 公司的竞争对手抱怨他们受到严格的法律合同的约束。
ext.ext_en: The company's competitors complain that they are hemmed in by rigid legal contracts.

defs.def_en: If someone is hemmed in or if someone hems them in, they are prevented from moving or changing, for example because they are surrounded by people or obstacles.

ext.ext_cn: 我们注意到墙上爬满了小虫子。
ext.ext_en: We noticed tiny bugs that were all over the walls.

ext.ext_cn: 贫民区滋生的一种吸血的虫子
ext.ext_en: ...a bloodsucking bug which infests poor housing.

defs.def_en: A bug is an insect or similar small creature.

ext.ext_cn: 我想我的胃可能出了点儿毛病。
ext.ext_en: I think I've got a bit of a stomach bug...

ext.ext_cn: 这个俱乐部流行着一种轻微的传染病。
ext.ext_en: There was a bug going around at the club.

defs.def_en: A bug is an illness which is caused by small organisms such as bacteria.

defs.def_cn: （计算机程序中的）漏洞，错误，故障

ext.ext_cn: 软件有漏洞。
ext.ext_en: There is a bug in the software.

defs.def_en: If there is a bug in a computer program, there is a mistake in it.

ext.ext_cn: 电话装有窃听器。
ext.ext_en: There was a bug on the phone.

defs.def_en: A bug is a tiny hidden microphone which transmits what people are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 他得知他们打算在他办公室安装窃听器。
ext.ext_en: He heard that they were planning to bug his office...

ext.ext_cn: 我发现我的电话被窃听了。
ext.ext_en: I found out my phone was bugged.

defs.def_en: If someone bugs a place, they hide tiny microphones in it which transmit what people are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 我被园艺彻底迷住了。
ext.ext_en: I've definitely been bitten by the gardening bug...

ext.ext_cn: 利兹市的朗德海公园是我首次对钓鱼着迷的地方。
ext.ext_en: Roundhay Park in Leeds was the place I first got the fishing bug.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone has been bitten by a particular bug when they suddenly become very enthusiastic about something.

ext.ext_cn: 我这么做只是为了让我父母心烦。
ext.ext_en: I only did it to bug my parents.

defs.def_en: If someone or something bugs you, they worry or annoy you.

defs.def_cn: 迅速的;无法控制的;失控的

ext.ext_cn: 我们6月份的大型促销一举成功。
ext.ext_en: Our Grand Sale in June was a runaway success.

ext.ext_cn: 一炮打响的畅销书
ext.ext_en: ...a runaway best-seller.

defs.def_en: You use runaway to describe a situation in which something increases or develops very quickly and cannot be controlled.

ext.ext_cn: 离家出走的十几岁的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...a teenage runaway.

ext.ext_cn: 逃跑的奴隶
ext.ext_en: ...a runaway slave.

defs.def_en: A runaway is someone, especially a child, who leaves home without telling anyone or without permission.

ext.ext_cn: 那辆失控的车猛冲到一条长椅上，撞伤了一对老夫妇。
ext.ext_en: The runaway car careered into a bench, hitting an elderly couple...

ext.ext_cn: 这个故事就像一辆失控的高速列车，读起来惊险刺激。
ext.ext_en: The narrative pulls you along like a runaway train.

defs.def_en: A runaway vehicle or animal is moving forward quickly, and its driver or rider has lost control of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他正要解释，她却笑起来了。
ext.ext_en: He was about to offer an explanation, but she was beginning to laugh...

ext.ext_cn: 人们说他长得像父亲时，他乐得大笑起来。
ext.ext_en: He laughed with pleasure when people said he looked like his dad...

defs.def_en: When you laugh, you make a sound with your throat while smiling and show that you are happy or amused. People also sometimes laugh when they feel nervous or are being unfriendly.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得他们嘲笑我是因为我长得丑。
ext.ext_en: I thought they were laughing at me because I was ugly...

ext.ext_cn: 他戏剧化的夸张架势使她忍不住想笑。
ext.ext_en: She wanted to laugh at the melodramatic way he was acting.

defs.def_en: If people laugh at someone or something, they mock them or make jokes about them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们被同伴们说服，上台一乐。
ext.ext_en: They were persuaded onstage for a laugh by their mates...

ext.ext_cn: 这个项目是她图好玩儿才做的。
ext.ext_en: It's a project she's  doing for laughs.

defs.def_en: If you do something for a  laugh or for laughs, you do it as a joke or for fun.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你戴一顶傻傻的帽子就能让人发笑，那你一定是天生的笑匠。
ext.ext_en: If you can get a laugh by wearing a silly hat, you must have been born a comic...

ext.ext_cn: 我的笑话引来哄堂大笑，这使我深受鼓舞，继续往下讲。
ext.ext_en: The joke got a big laugh, which encouraged me to continue.

defs.def_en: If a person or their comment gets a laugh or raises a laugh, they make the people listening to them laugh.

defs.def_cn: 好玩/ 开心/有点意思

ext.ext_cn: 在那儿工作挺不错。说实在的，蛮好玩儿的。
ext.ext_en: Working there's great. It's quite a good laugh actually...

ext.ext_cn: 那儿可真是好玩！
ext.ext_en: It was a good laugh there!

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as a laugh ,a good laugh, or a bit of a laugh, you think that it is fun and do not take it too seriously.

ext.ext_cn: 米基是个活宝，在更衣室里总是逗人笑个不停。
ext.ext_en: Mickey was a good laugh and great to have in the dressing room.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a laugh or a good laugh, you like them because they are amusing and fun to be with.

defs.def_cn: （尤指经历了最初的苦恼不快后）觉得…可笑，对…一笑置之

ext.ext_cn: 虽然出了意外，但我俩事后都一笑置之。
ext.ext_en: We've both had a good laugh about the accident despite what's happened.

defs.def_en: If you have a good laugh about something, you find it amusing and realize that it is funny, especially when the situation was at first upsetting.

defs.def_cn: 笑到最后；取得最后胜利

ext.ext_cn: 德斯·奥康纳预计会飙升至圣诞畅销唱片排行榜的榜首，这将让他的批评者都笑不出来。
ext.ext_en: Des  O'Connor is expecting to have the last laugh on his critics by soaring to the top of the Christmas hit parade.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have the last laugh, you mean that you become successful at something so that people who criticize or oppose you look foolish.

defs.def_cn: 别让我笑掉大牙了；别逗了

ext.ext_cn: 克莱尔投毒？别逗了。她只不过厨艺很差罢了。
ext.ext_en: Claire, a poisoner? Don't make me laugh — She was just a lousy cook.

defs.def_en: Some people reply to other people's comments or opinions by saying 'Don't make me laugh' when they disagree with them and think they are foolish or inaccurate.

defs.def_cn: （对于困境或令人失望的境况）何妨一笑，还有可笑之处

ext.ext_cn: 摩托车党藐视法律，竟对警车玩起凌空飞车来。“牛气可嘉呀，”斯塔基先生说道。
ext.ext_en: The bikers have shown enough contempt of the law to ride their machines over police cars. 'You've got to laugh at their audacity,' said Mr Starkey.

defs.def_en: If you say 'you've got to laugh' or 'you have to laugh', you are trying to see the amusing side of a difficult or disappointing situation rather than being sad or angry about it.
Hilarity is great amusement and laughter.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她已经将他从一个酒色之徒变成了一个忠诚的丈夫和慈爱的父亲。
ext.ext_en: She had transformed him from being a hard-drinking womaniser into a devoted husband and father.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a hard-drinking person, you mean that they frequently drink large quantities of alcohol.

ext.ext_cn: 小柳树林
ext.ext_en: ...coppices of willow.

ext.ext_cn: 长有各种树木的矮树林是巢居鸟的理想栖息地。
ext.ext_en: ...the mixed coppice is an ideal habitat for nesting birds.

defs.def_en: A coppice is a small group of trees growing very close to each other.

defs.def_cn: 修剪(使更美观或为获得木材)

ext.ext_cn: 最好在冬天树汁增多之前修剪这些树。
ext.ext_en: It is best to coppice the trees in the winter before the sap rises.

ext.ext_cn: 其中长有修剪过的榛树和板栗树的一大片橡树林
ext.ext_en: ...extensive oak woods with coppiced hazel and sweet chestnut.

defs.def_en: To coppice trees or bushes means to cut off parts of them, in order to make them look more attractive or to make it easier to obtain wood from them.

ext.ext_cn: 新开的美发厅
ext.ext_en: ...a new hair salon.

ext.ext_cn: 美容院
ext.ext_en: ...a beauty salon.

defs.def_en: A salon is a place where people have their hair cut or coloured, or have beauty treatments.
A salon is a shop where smart, expensive clothes are sold.

defs.def_cn: (旧时较为流行的)文艺界名流聚会，雅集，文艺沙龙

ext.ext_cn: 他的公寓是俄国最著名的文学沙龙会所。
ext.ext_en: His apartment was the most famous literary salon in Russia.

defs.def_en: A salon is an informal meeting of fashionable writers or artists, which is held at the house of someone who is well-known. Salons were more common in former times.
A salon is a sitting room in a large, grand house.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 混乱无序的;乱七八糟的

ext.ext_cn: 一次混乱无序的公关灾难
ext.ext_en: ...a shambolic public relations disaster...

ext.ext_cn: 约翰住在一个新潮而又混乱无序的艺术家的工作室里。
ext.ext_en: John lived in a stylishly shambolic artist's studio.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation, person, or place as shambolic, you mean that they are very disorganized.

defs.def_cn: (尤指前苏联等国家由共产党任命的)要职人员

ext.ext_cn: 老百姓一直都对要职人员的特权心怀怨恨。
ext.ext_en: Ordinary people have always resented the nomenklatura's privileges.

defs.def_en: In some countries, especially the former Soviet Union, the nomenklatura were the people the Communist Party approved of and appointed to positions of authority.

ext.ext_cn: 这些文章由公司的职员捉刀。
ext.ext_en: Articles were ghost-written by company employees.

defs.def_en: If a book or other piece of writing is ghost-written, it is written by a writer for another person, for example a politician or sportsman, who then publishes it as his or her own work.

ext.ext_cn: 看到乔治假慈悲，我感到恶心。
ext.ext_en: The sight of George shedding crocodile tears made me sick.

defs.def_en: If someone is crying crocodile tears, their tears and sadness are not genuine or sincere.

ext.ext_cn: 轰炸导致公路和铁路都无法通行。
ext.ext_en: Bombing had made roads and railways unusable.

defs.def_en: Something that is unusable is not in a good enough state or condition to be used.

ext.ext_cn: 下令没收了他 150 多万英镑的盈利。
ext.ext_en: He was ordered to forfeit more than £1.5m in profits...

ext.ext_cn: 他辩称杀人犯本身已经丧失了生存的权利。
ext.ext_en: He argues that murderers forfeit their own right to life.

defs.def_en: If you forfeit something, you lose it or are forced to give it up because you have broken a rule or done something wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 他主动放弃了可观的酬金，觉得自己的健康更加重要。
ext.ext_en: He has forfeited a lucrative fee but feels his well-being is more important...

ext.ext_cn: 你认为他们会为了安全而放弃利润吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you think that they would forfeit profit in the name of safety?

defs.def_en: If you forfeit something, you give it up willingly, especially so that you can achieve something else.

ext.ext_cn: 这是他必须付的罚金。
ext.ext_en: That is the forfeit he must pay.

defs.def_en: A forfeit is something that you have to give up because you have done something wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （气候或条件）艰苦的，恶劣的，严峻的

ext.ext_cn: 天气变得恶劣、寒冷且变化莫测。
ext.ext_en: The weather grew harsh, chilly and unpredictable.

ext.ext_cn: 恶劣的沙漠环境
ext.ext_en: ...the harsh desert environment.

defs.def_en: Harsh climates or conditions are very difficult for people, animals, and plants to live in.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫冷酷无情的残忍
ext.ext_en: ...the cold, harsh cruelty of her husband...

ext.ext_cn: 他以尖刻恶毒的语言大肆抨击自己的对手。
ext.ext_en: He said many harsh and unkind things about his opponents.

defs.def_en: Harsh actions or speech are unkind and show no understanding or sympathy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 热带色彩在我们北方暗淡的光线下可能显得有点刺目。
ext.ext_en: Tropical colours may look rather harsh in our dull northern light.

ext.ext_cn: 会让发质变脆弱的刺激性较强的洗发水
ext.ext_en: ...harsher detergents that can leave hair brittle.

defs.def_en: Something that is harsh is so hard, bright, or rough that it seems unpleasant or harmful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 可惜她的嗓门太大太难听了。
ext.ext_en: It's a pity she has such a loud harsh voice.

defs.def_en: Harsh voices and sounds are ones that are rough and unpleasant to listen to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 残酷的事实是，谁死谁活在很大程度上要靠运气。
ext.ext_en: The harsh truth is that luck plays a big part in who will live or die.

defs.def_en: If you talk about harsh realities or facts, or the harsh truth, you are emphasizing that they are true or real, although they are unpleasant and people try to avoid thinking about them.

ext.ext_cn: 以新鲜水果为主的露天早餐
ext.ext_en: ... an al fresco breakfast of fresh fruit.

ext.ext_cn: 他碰见那个男人正在外面刮胡子。
ext.ext_en: He came across the man shaving alfresco.

defs.def_en: An alfresco activity, especially a meal, is one that takes place in the open air.

ext.ext_cn: 任何突如其来的情况都可能造成暴力骤然升级。
ext.ext_en: Any unexpected circumstance that arises may catalyze a sudden escalation of violence.

defs.def_en: If something catalyses a thing or a situation, it makes it active.

ext.ext_cn: 人们早已知道，如果材料的表面积足够大，可引起催化反应。
ext.ext_en: It had been known for some time that chemical reactions can be catalyzed by materials with large surface areas...

ext.ext_cn: 这些导线覆盖的面积不够大，不足以引发大爆炸。
ext.ext_en: The wires do not have a large enough surface to catalyse a big explosion.

defs.def_en: In chemistry, if something catalyses a reaction or event, it causes it to happen.

defs.def_cn: 标准通用标示语言(一种计算机语言)
defs.def_en: SGML is a computer language for creating files using a system of codes. SGML is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'standard generalized mark-up language'.

ext.ext_cn: 售票员慵懒地拖着脚走向下一节车厢。
ext.ext_en: The conductor shambled to the next carriage.

ext.ext_cn: 他那高大而且步履蹒跚的背影
ext.ext_en: ...his tall, shambling figure.

defs.def_en: If you shamble somewhere, you walk clumsily, pulling your feet along the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 拥有一大片湖区的普罗斯佩克特公园吸引着所有注重健康的人。
ext.ext_en: Prospect Park, with its vast lake, is a magnet for all health freaks...

ext.ext_cn: 较低利率像磁铁一样吸引顾客又回到了商店。
ext.ext_en: Lower interest rates are acting like a magnet, dragging consumers back to the shops.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a magnet or is like a magnet, you mean that people are very attracted by it and want to go to it or look at it.

ext.ext_cn: 冰箱磁铁
ext.ext_en: ...a fridge magnet.

defs.def_en: A magnet is a piece of iron or other material which attracts iron towards it.

ext.ext_cn: 在 1918 年 10 月间，奥匈帝国开始瓦解。
ext.ext_en: During October 1918 the Austro-Hungarian Empire began to disintegrate.

defs.def_en: If something disintegrates, it becomes seriously weakened, and is divided or destroyed.

ext.ext_cn: 挡风玻璃在时速420英里时破碎。
ext.ext_en: At 420mph the windscreen disintegrated.

defs.def_en: If an object or substance disintegrates, it breaks into many small pieces or parts and is destroyed.

ext.ext_cn: 据称的哥伦比亚最大的贩毒集团的头目之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the alleged kingpins of Colombia's largest drugs ring.

ext.ext_cn: 芝加哥犯罪团伙的总头目
ext.ext_en: ...the Chicago crime kingpin.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as the kingpin of an organization, you mean that they are the most important person involved in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对子女的父爱
ext.ext_en: ...paternal love for his children...

ext.ext_cn: 他以近乎父亲的姿态用手托着她的下巴。
ext.ext_en: He put his hand under her chin in an almost paternal gesture.

defs.def_en: Paternal is used to describe feelings or actions which are typical of those of a kind father towards his child.

ext.ext_cn: 我的祖父母
ext.ext_en: ...my paternal grandparents.

defs.def_en: A paternal relative is one that is related through a person's father rather than their mother.

defs.def_cn: 烤串；（与皮塔饼一起吃的）烤肉片
defs.def_en: A kebab is pieces of meat or vegetables grilled on a long thin stick, or slices of grilled meat served in pitta bread.

defs.def_cn: 竖铰链窗;平开窗；门式窗
defs.def_en: A casement or a casement window is a window that opens by means of hinges, usually at the side.

defs.def_cn: 马耳他的;马耳他人的;马耳他语（或文化）的

ext.ext_cn: 马耳他作家弗朗西斯·埃贝杰
ext.ext_en: ...the Maltese writer Francis Ebejer.

defs.def_en: Maltese means belonging or relating to Malta, or to its people, language, or culture.
A Maltese is a Maltese citizen, or a person of Maltese origin.
Maltese is a language spoken by people who live in Malta.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 拒绝考虑…的;对…轻视的;对…鄙视的

ext.ext_cn: 琼斯先生对报告不屑一顾，称其中充斥着谬误。
ext.ext_en: Mr Jones was dismissive of the report, saying it was riddled with inaccuracies.

ext.ext_cn: 涉及心电感应、顺势疗法等问题时科学家们常抱有的鄙视态度
ext.ext_en: ...the dismissive attitude scientists often take in regard to questions such as telepathy or homeopathic medicine.

defs.def_en: If you are dismissive of someone or something, you say or show that you think they are not important or have no value.
Fruit salad is a mixture of pieces of different kinds of fruit. It is usually eaten as a dessert.

ext.ext_cn: 几个月来马尔科姆一直想参观巴黎的艺术博物馆。
ext.ext_en: For months Malcolm had wanted to visit the Parisian art museums.

ext.ext_cn: 美国自然历史博物馆
ext.ext_en: ...the American Museum of Natural History.

defs.def_en: A museum is a building where a large number of interest-ing and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

ext.ext_cn: 我们以前完全不担心吃糖果有可能会蛀牙。
ext.ext_en: We were not in the least worried about the possibility that sweets could rot the teeth...

ext.ext_cn: 极有可能征收食物税。
ext.ext_en: Tax on food has become a very real possibility.

defs.def_en: If you say there is a possibility that something is the case or that something will happen, you mean that it might be the case or it might happen.

ext.ext_cn: 政府现在占了我们的大量土地，一种可能是用其他地产来对我们作出补偿。
ext.ext_en: The government now owns a lot of our land — one possibility would be  to compensate us with other property...

ext.ext_cn: 每个制造商都可以有几种不同的选择。
ext.ext_en: There were several possibilities open to each manufacturer.

defs.def_en: A possibility is one of several different things that could be done.

ext.ext_cn: 安全部门完全有可能窃听重要公众人物的谈话。
ext.ext_en: It's not beyond the realms of possibility that the security services do bug important public figures.

defs.def_en: You can say 'It is not beyond the realms of possibility' or 'It is not beyond the bounds of possibility'  when you are stating something that you believe is possibly true, but which other people might consider unlikely or impossible.

ext.ext_cn: 这似乎是一种田园诗般的家庭组成格局。
ext.ext_en: It appears to be an idyllic domestic set-up...

ext.ext_cn: 渐渐地，我对大学的整个体制感到相当失望。
ext.ext_en: I gradually got rather disillusioned with the whole setup of the university.

defs.def_en: A particular set-up is a particular system or way of organizing something.

ext.ext_cn: 有人让他开车去接几个人来参加聚会，他并没有意识到这是个陷阱。
ext.ext_en: He was asked to pick somebody up and bring them to a party, not realizing it was a setup.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as a set-up, you mean that people have planned it in order to deceive you or to make it look as if you have done something wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 安装时最糟糕就是操作指南讲述不够清楚。
ext.ext_en: The worst part of the set-up is the poor instruction manual...

ext.ext_cn: 安装程序
ext.ext_en: ... the setup program.

defs.def_en: The set-up of computer hardware or software is the process of installing it and making it ready to use.

defs.def_cn: （数量）较小（或少）的；更小（或少）的（前面可用a little，a lot，a bit，far和much等修饰）

ext.ext_cn: 人们应该减少脂肪摄入，以降低患心脏病的危险。
ext.ext_en: People should eat less fat to reduce the risk of heart disease.

ext.ext_cn: 较旧式机器省水省电的洗碗机
ext.ext_en: ...a dishwasher that uses less water and electricity than older machines...

defs.def_en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'a little', 'a lot',  'a bit', 'far', and 'much' in front of less.

defs.def_cn: （用在数字或数量前）少于，低于，比…少

ext.ext_cn: 高速公路的实际覆盖面积还不到农村地区的0.1%。
ext.ext_en: Motorways actually cover less than 0.1 percent of the countryside...

ext.ext_cn: 不到半个小时，他又跑上楼来。
ext.ext_en: Less than a half hour later he returned upstairs.

defs.def_en: You use less than before a number or amount to say that the actual number or amount is smaller than this.

defs.def_cn: （某一特性的程度与以往或一般情况相比）较轻地，较差地

ext.ext_cn: 我经常想到那些没我这么幸运的人。
ext.ext_en: I often think about those less fortunate than me...

ext.ext_cn: 还有一些不太常有的设施，包括图书馆和健身房。
ext.ext_en: Other amenities, less commonly available, include a library and exercise room...

defs.def_en: You use less to indicate that something or someone has a smaller amount of a quality than they used to or than is average or usual.

defs.def_cn: 不像…（更像…）；与其说…（倒不如说…）

ext.ext_cn: 乍看上去，它不像是首府，更像是矿工村。
ext.ext_en: At first sight it looked less like a capital city than a mining camp...

ext.ext_cn: 那时候的工会领导与其说是一份职业，倒不如说是一种使命。
ext.ext_en: Trades union leadership in those days was less a career than a vocation.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is less one thing than another, you mean that it is like the second thing rather than the first.

ext.ext_cn: 我们吃得多了，锻炼却少了。
ext.ext_en: We are eating more and exercising less...

ext.ext_cn: 我见所有朋友都比以前少了。
ext.ext_en: I see less of any of my friends than I used to.

defs.def_en: If you do something less than before or less than someone else, you do it to a smaller extent or not as often.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定句后）遑论，更何况，更不用说

ext.ext_cn: 我从来没说起过这事，更没有提起过她。
ext.ext_en: I never talked about it, still less about her...

ext.ext_cn: 这小伙子连女朋友都没有，更不用提老婆了。
ext.ext_en: The boy didn't have a girlfriend, much less a wife.

defs.def_en: You use the expressions still less ,much less, and even less after a negative statement in order to introduce and emphasize a further statement, and to make it negative too.

defs.def_cn: （用在数字或数量前）扣除，减去

ext.ext_cn: 博伊顿金融服务费：750英镑，扣除400英镑
ext.ext_en: ...Boyton Financial Services Fees: £750, less £400...

ext.ext_cn: 公司的司机要支付10%到25%，从中扣除税款。
ext.ext_en: Company car drivers will pay between ten and twenty five percent, less tax.

defs.def_en: When you are referring to amounts, you use less in front of a number or quantity to indicate that it is to be subtracted from another number or quantity already mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 两口子在一起的时间似乎越来越少。
ext.ext_en: The couple seem to spend less and less time together...

ext.ext_cn: 听她话音，她回爱尔兰的热情似乎日渐消退。
ext.ext_en: She sounded less and less eager to return to Ireland...

defs.def_en: You use less and less to say that something is becoming smaller all the time in degree or amount.

ext.ext_cn: 她的问候一点都不热情。
ext.ext_en: Her greeting was less than enthusiastic...

ext.ext_cn: 她的建议往往毫无帮助。
ext.ext_en: Her advice has frequently been less than wholly helpful.

defs.def_en: You use less than to say that something does not have a particular quality. For example, if you describe something as less than perfect, you mean that it is not perfect at all.

defs.def_cn: （对某事物或某人的重要性表示惊讶或钦佩）竟然，居然

ext.ext_cn: 他竟然坐航空母舰回的英格兰。
ext.ext_en: He had returned to England in an aircraft carrier no less...

ext.ext_cn: 帕特里夏·海史密斯那本书是谁改编成剧本的？雷蒙德·钱德勒呀，厉害。
ext.ext_en: Who wrote the screenplay from Patricia Highsmith's book? Raymond Chandler, no less.

defs.def_en: You can use no less as a way of expressing surprise or admiration at the importance of something or someone.

defs.def_cn: （对某一数目之大表示惊奇）多达

ext.ext_cn: 该国多达35%的地区以公园和自然保护区的形式受到保护。
ext.ext_en: No less than 35 per cent of the country is protected in the form of parks and nature sanctuaries...

ext.ext_cn: 多达4家美国电视媒体排期邀请他上节目接受采访。
ext.ext_en: He is lined up for no less than four US television interviews.

defs.def_en: You use no less than before an amount to indicate that the amount is larger than you expected.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 融雪覆盖的;满是雪泥的

ext.ext_cn: 路上不时会有吹聚起的积雪，泥泞而湿滑。
ext.ext_en: Here and there a drift across the road was wet and slushy.

defs.def_en: Slushy ground is covered in dirty, wet snow.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (故事或想法)过于浪漫伤感的，无聊言情的
defs.def_en: If you describe a story or idea as slushy, you mean you dislike it because it is extremely romantic and sentimental.

ext.ext_cn: 单亲家庭的孩子们不应该受到歧视。
ext.ext_en: Children in single-parent families must not be stigmatised...

ext.ext_cn: 艾滋病的流行让人们更加瞧不起男同性恋者。
ext.ext_en: The AIDS epidemic further stigmatised gays...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is stigmatized, they are unfairly regarded by many people as being bad or having something to be ashamed of.

defs.def_cn: (用绞肉、蔬菜、辣椒粉或青椒做的)辣味什锦肉末
defs.def_en: Chilli con carne is a dish made from minced meat, vegetables, and powdered or fresh chillies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: A commodious room or house is large and has a lot of space.

defs.def_cn: (尤指乘船)穿越英吉利海峡的

ext.ext_cn: 英吉利海峡上的渡船
ext.ext_en: ...the cross-channel ferry...

ext.ext_cn: 迪耶普有很多浏览胜地，吸引游客横渡英吉利海峡前来观光。
ext.ext_en: Dieppe has plenty to attract cross-Channel visitors.

defs.def_en: Cross-Channel travel is travel across the English Channel, especially by boat.
A nursing bottle is a plastic bottle with a special rubber top through which a baby can suck milk or another liquid.

defs.def_cn: 优先事项；最重要的事；当务之急

ext.ext_cn: 做好母亲是她的头等大事。
ext.ext_en: Being a parent is her first priority...

ext.ext_cn: 政府的首要任务是建造更多的发电站。
ext.ext_en: The government's priority is to build more power plants...

defs.def_en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

ext.ext_cn: 学校将重点发展理科、数学和现代语言。
ext.ext_en: The school will give priority to science, maths and modern languages...

ext.ext_cn: 这些提议值得拥护，因为它们优先考虑了儿童的需求。
ext.ext_en: The proposals deserve support as they give priority to the needs of children.

defs.def_en: If you give priority to something or someone, you treat them as more important than anything or anyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 抵制通货膨胀比抑制日益加剧的经济衰退更为重要。
ext.ext_en: The fight against inflation took priority over measures to combat the deepening recession...

ext.ext_cn: 我不赞成经济发展应优先于环境保护这个前提。
ext.ext_en: I disagree with the premise that economic development has priority over the environment.

defs.def_en: If something takes priority or has priority over other things, it is regarded as being more important than them and is dealt with first.

ext.ext_cn: 他们从毁坏的飞机上拆零件用。
ext.ext_en: They cannibalized damaged planes for the parts.

defs.def_en: If you cannibalize something, you take it to pieces and use it to make something else.

defs.def_cn: (公司中一种产品)损害，冲击（其他产品的销量）

ext.ext_cn: 网站并不妨碍目前的销售。
ext.ext_en: A website need not cannibalise existing sales.

defs.def_en: If one of a company's products cannibalizes the company's sales, people buy it instead of any of the company's other products.

ext.ext_cn: 我们左等右等，盼着他的消息。
ext.ext_en: We waited and waited for news of him...

ext.ext_cn: 他们仍然没有何时能回家的消息。
ext.ext_en: They still haven't had any news about when they'll be able to go home...

defs.def_en: News is information about a recently changed situation or a recent event.

ext.ext_cn: 国外新闻在16版。
ext.ext_en: Foreign News is on Page 16...

ext.ext_cn: 我们也会收到最新的体育新闻。
ext.ext_en: We'll also have the latest sports news...

defs.def_en: News is information that is published in newspapers and broadcast on radio and television about recent events in the country or world or in a particular area of activity.

ext.ext_cn: 我从新闻广播里得知了关于炸弹的全部消息。
ext.ext_en: I heard all about the bombs on the news.

ext.ext_cn: 6点钟的新闻
ext.ext_en: ...the six o'clock news.

defs.def_en: The news is a television or radio broadcast which consists of information about recent events in the country or the world.

ext.ext_cn: 《纽约每日新闻》
ext.ext_en: ...the New York Daily News.

defs.def_en: News is sometimes used in the names of newspapers.

ext.ext_cn: 谋杀案是重大新闻事件。
ext.ext_en: A murder was big news...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你是名人，你就是头条新闻。
ext.ext_en: If you are a celebrity, you are headline news.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is news, you mean that they are considered to be interesting and important at the moment, and that people want to hear about them on the radio and television and in newspapers.

ext.ext_cn: 旅游热降温对航空业来说是个坏消息。
ext.ext_en: The drop in travel is bad news for the airline industry...

ext.ext_cn: 这种新态度对艾滋病活动家来说是件好事。
ext.ext_en: This new attitude is good news to AIDS activists.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is bad news, you mean that it will cause you trouble or problems. If you say that something is good news, you mean that it will be useful or helpful to you.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我真知道什么的话，我肯定会告诉你，可我不知道。你现在说的我都没听过。
ext.ext_en: I'd certainly tell you if I knew anything, but I don't. What you're saying is news to me.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is news to you, you mean that you did not previously know what you have just been told, especially when you are surprised or annoyed about it.

defs.def_cn: （通常由当地政府或慈善团体开办的）廉价招待所，临时收容所
defs.def_en: See also:youth hostel;A hostel is a large house where people can stay cheaply for a short period of time. Hostels are usually owned by local government authorities or charities.
Toxicology is the study of poisons.
A bidet is a low fixed container in a bathroom which you can use to wash your bottom.

defs.def_cn: （犯罪行为）无受害人的，无害他人的

ext.ext_cn: 所谓的无受害人的卖淫罪
ext.ext_en: ...the so-called victimless crime of prostitution.

defs.def_en: A victimless crime is a crime which is considered to be less serious than other crimes because nobody suffers directly as a result of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对人类幸福不利的虚假道德
ext.ext_en: ...a false morality that is inimical to human happiness.

ext.ext_cn: 不利于西方利益的目标
ext.ext_en: ...goals inimical to Western interests.

defs.def_en: Conditions that are inimical to something make it difficult for that thing to exist or do well.

ext.ext_cn: 朱迪·加兰电影回顾展
ext.ext_en: ...a retrospective of the films of Judy Garland...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在1987年为他举办了一次回顾展，以示敬意。
ext.ext_en: They honoured him with a retrospective exhibition in 1987.

defs.def_en: A retrospective is an exhibition or showing of work done by an artist over many years, rather than his or her most recent work.

ext.ext_cn: 后来，回想起要负的责任她几乎会吓晕过去。
ext.ext_en: Afterwards, retrospective fear of the responsibility would make her feel almost faint.

defs.def_en: Retrospective feelings or opinions concern things that happened in the past.

defs.def_cn: (法律、法律行为等)有追溯效力的

ext.ext_cn: 银行家们立即声讨有追溯效力的税收立法。
ext.ext_en: Bankers are quick to condemn retrospective tax legislation.

defs.def_en: Retrospective laws or legal actions take effect from a date before the date when they are officially approved.

defs.def_cn: （表示最近过去的）刚过去的星期五/昨晚/去年

ext.ext_cn: 我在刚过去的7月里结了婚。
ext.ext_en: I got married last July...

ext.ext_cn: 他昨晚根本没回家。
ext.ext_en: He never made it home at all last night...

defs.def_en: You use last in expressions such as last Friday ,last night, and last year to refer, for example, to the most recent Friday, night, or year.

ext.ext_cn: 从我上次去到现在，很多事情已经变了。
ext.ext_en: Much has changed since my last visit...

ext.ext_cn: 最近一次统计显示通胀率为10.9%。
ext.ext_en: At the last count inflation was 10.9 per cent...

defs.def_en: The last event, person, thing, or period of time is the most recent one.

ext.ext_cn: 你上次去是什么时候？
ext.ext_en: When were you there last?...

ext.ext_cn: 那房子比我上次见到时更破旧了些。
ext.ext_en: The house is a little more dilapidated than when I last saw it...

defs.def_en: If something last happened on a particular occasion, that is the most recent occasion on which it happened.

ext.ext_cn: 这是他作为首相的最后机会。
ext.ext_en: This is his last chance as prime minister.

ext.ext_cn: 该章最后3页
ext.ext_en: ...the last three pages of the chapter...

defs.def_en: The last thing, person, event, or period of time is the one that happens or comes after all the others of the same kind.

ext.ext_cn: 我最后一个作证。
ext.ext_en: I testified last...

ext.ext_cn: 在学校里分队踢足球时，我总是最后被挑的那一个。
ext.ext_en: I was always picked last for the football team at school...

defs.def_en: If you do something last, you do it after everyone else does, or after you do everything else.

ext.ext_cn: 她最后一个上床。
ext.ext_en: She was the last to go to bed...

ext.ext_cn: 我和里卡尔多总是最后才知道发生什么事情。
ext.ext_en: Riccardo and I are always the last to know what's going on.

defs.def_en: If you are the last to do or know something, everyone else does or knows it before you.

ext.ext_cn: 杰德点点头，把最后一块比萨饼吃完。
ext.ext_en: Jed nodded, finishing off the last piece of pizza.

ext.ext_cn: 最后一名人质的获释
ext.ext_en: ...the freeing of the last hostage.

defs.def_en: Last is used to refer to the only thing, person, or part of something that remains.

defs.def_cn: （竞赛中）最后留下的，排位在前的

ext.ext_cn: 桑普拉斯杀入了温布尔登四强。
ext.ext_en: Sampras reached the last four at Wimbledon.

ext.ext_cn: 进入最后6人名单的唯一一位女作家
ext.ext_en: ...the only woman among the authors making it through to the last six.

defs.def_en: You use last before numbers to refer to a position that someone has reached in a competition after other competitors have been knocked out.

defs.def_cn: 最不想要的；最不可能的

ext.ext_cn: 我最不想干的事情就是教书。
ext.ext_en: The last thing I wanted to do was teach...

ext.ext_cn: 他最不可能干这种事情。
ext.ext_en: He would be the last person who would do such a thing.

defs.def_en: You can use last to indicate that something is extremely undesirable or unlikely.

ext.ext_cn: 她高喊着“往河里去，往河里去！”然后就消失了。那是我们最后一次看到她的情形。
ext.ext_en: She disappeared shouting, 'To the river, to the river!' And that was the last we saw of her...

ext.ext_cn: 我有一种感觉，这将是我最后一次听到他的消息。
ext.ext_en: I had a feeling it would be the last I heard of him.

defs.def_en: The last you see of someone or the last you hear of them is the final time that you see them or talk to them.

defs.def_cn: 持续，延续，维持（一段时间）

ext.ext_cn: 这段婚姻维持了不到两年。
ext.ext_en: The marriage had lasted for less than two years...

ext.ext_cn: 比赛只持续了通常时间的一半。
ext.ext_en: The games lasted only half the normal time...

defs.def_en: If an event, situation, or problem lasts for a particular length of time, it continues to exist or happen for that length of time.

defs.def_cn: 够用，保持可用状态（一段时间）

ext.ext_cn: 每次只需一点点胶水而已，因此一管可以用很长时间。
ext.ext_en: You only need a very small blob of glue, so one tube lasts for ages...

ext.ext_cn: 修好的帆支撑了不到24小时。
ext.ext_en: The repaired sail lasted less than 24 hours...

defs.def_en: If something lasts for a particular length of time, it continues to be able to be used for that time, for example because there is some of it left or because it is in good enough condition.

ext.ext_cn: 他们本不可能撑完整场比赛的。
ext.ext_en: They wouldn't  have lasted the full game...

ext.ext_cn: 我几乎撑过了这两个星期。我只有几天时间去做。
ext.ext_en: I almost lasted the two weeks. I only had a couple of days to do.

defs.def_en: You can use last in expressions such as last the game ,last the course, and last the week, to indicate that someone manages to take part in an event or situation right to the end, especially when this is very difficult for them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们终于找到你了，我真是太高兴了！
ext.ext_en: I'm  so glad that we've found you at last!...

ext.ext_cn: 他等待已久的时刻终于到来。
ext.ext_en: Here, at long last, was the moment he had waited for...

defs.def_en: If you say that something has happened at last or at long last you mean it has happened after you have been hoping for it for a long time.

defs.def_cn: 前天晚上／ 上上次选举／上上任领导人

ext.ext_cn: 他前晚听到的是狗叫声。
ext.ext_en: It was the dog he'd heard the night before last...

ext.ext_cn: 上上次的预算案中对移动电话引入了惩罚性税收。
ext.ext_en: In the budget before last a tax penalty on the mobile phone was introduced.

defs.def_en: You use expressions such as the night before last ,the election before last and the leader before last to refer to the period of time, event, or person that came immediately before the most recent one in a series.
If someone breathes their last, they die.

defs.def_cn: 倒数第二／倒数第三／ 倒数第四

ext.ext_cn: 那是田径比赛结束的前一天。
ext.ext_en: It's the last but one day in the athletics programme...

ext.ext_cn: 英国队位列倒数第二。
ext.ext_en: The British team finished last but one.

defs.def_en: You can use phrases such as the last but one, the last but two, or the last but three, to refer to the thing or person that is, for example, one, two, or three before the final person or thing in a group or series.

ext.ext_cn: 我把钱全部花光了，一分不剩。
ext.ext_en: I'd spent all I had, every last penny...

ext.ext_cn: 无法把所有的沙砾都清除干净。
ext.ext_en: You'll never quite get rid of every last bit of grit...

defs.def_en: You use every last to emphasize that you are talking about all the people or things in a group or all the parts of something.

defs.def_cn: （需要裁员时首先解雇新员工的）“后进先出”原则

ext.ext_cn: 对工人的裁员原则是“后进先出”。
ext.ext_en: Workers will go on a 'last in, first out' basis.

defs.def_en: The expression last in, first out is used to say that the last person who started work in an organization should be the first person to leave it, if fewer people are needed.

defs.def_cn: 我/她最近一次听到有关…的消息；最新消息

ext.ext_cn: 我最近一次听说时，乔和艾琳仍然是一对快乐的夫妻。
ext.ext_en: The last I heard, Joe and Irene were still happily married.

defs.def_en: You can use expressions such as the last I heard and the last she heard to introduce a piece of information that is the most recent that you have on a particular subject.

ext.ext_cn: 我把最好的酒留到了最后。
ext.ext_en: I have left my best wine until last...

ext.ext_cn: 我先挑出了所有通常留到最后的人。
ext.ext_en: I picked first all the people who usually were left till last.

defs.def_en: If you leave something or someone until last, you delay using, choosing, or dealing with them until you have used, chosen, or dealt with all the others.

ext.ext_cn: 老实说我以为再也不用见到你了。
ext.ext_en: I honestly thought I'd seen the last of you.

defs.def_en: If you see the last of someone, you do not expect to see them or deal with them again.

defs.def_cn: 贯穿（全书、整部电影或整件事情）

ext.ext_cn: 一部可读性极强的政治惊悚小说，情节峰回路转，不到最后一刻绝对猜不中结局
ext.ext_en: ...a highly readable political thriller with plenty of twists of plot to keep you guessing to the last.

defs.def_en: If you say that something goes on happening to the last, you mean that it happens throughout the whole of a book, film, or event.

ext.ext_cn: 他始终保持绅士风度，没有拔脚就跑，只是试图移步走开。
ext.ext_en: A gentleman to the last, he did not run, but merely attempted to stroll away...

ext.ext_cn: 阿姆斯特朗从来都是这么高大、英俊。
ext.ext_en: Armstrong was tall and handsome to the last.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a particular kind of person to the last, you are emphasizing that they continue to be that kind of person.

defs.def_cn: （表示全部包括在内）任何一丝细节/ 每一个人

ext.ext_cn: 对每一个动作，无论它显得多么随意和无意识，都不能放过一丝细节。
ext.ext_en: Every movement, no matter how casual and spontaneous, needs to be worked out to the last detail...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的部队已人尽其用。
ext.ext_en: Our troops are being used up to the last man.

defs.def_en: You use expressions such as to the last detail and to the last man to indicate that a plan, situation, or activity includes every single person, thing, or part involved.

ext.ext_cn: 再过11年我就是个领取养老金的60岁老人了。
ext.ext_en: In 11 years I will be 60 and an OAP.

ext.ext_cn: 每张票6英镑，老人和孩子半价
ext.ext_en: ...tickets only £6 each and half that for OAPs and kids.

defs.def_en: An OAP is a person who is old enough to receive an old age pension from the government. OAP is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'old age pensioner'.

ext.ext_cn: 口吃的孩子可以从言语矫治中获益。
ext.ext_en: A stammering child can benefit from speech therapy.

defs.def_en: Speech therapy is the treatment of people who have speech and language problems.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他不想让自己显得太专横霸道。
ext.ext_en: He wants to be seen as less bossy and high-handed.

ext.ext_cn: 据传他在议会中处理政府事务时专横跋扈的作风
ext.ext_en: ...his allegedly high-handed organisation of government business in parliament.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is high-handed, you disapprove of them because they use their authority in an unnecessarily forceful way without considering other people's feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 临时化的员工队伍
ext.ext_en: ...a casualised workforce.

defs.def_en: If a business casualizes its employees or casualizes their labour, it replaces employees with permanent contracts and full rights with employees with temporary contracts and few rights.

ext.ext_cn: 午饭是在野外吃的便餐。
ext.ext_en: Lunch was a snack in the fields.

defs.def_en: A snack is a simple meal that is quick to cook and to eat.

ext.ext_cn: 你吃糖果、蛋糕或甜点吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you eat sweets, cakes or sugary snacks?

defs.def_en: A snack is something such as a chocolate bar that you eat between meals.

ext.ext_cn: 不要把薯片和巧克力当零食来吃，要吃些芹菜和胡萝卜。
ext.ext_en: Instead of snacking on crisps and chocolate, nibble on celery or carrot...

ext.ext_cn: 如果她少吃油炸食品和零食的话，她的饮食结构就会有所改观。
ext.ext_en: She would improve her diet if she ate less fried food and snacked less.

defs.def_en: If you snack, you eat snacks between meals.

ext.ext_cn: 他说话带上了一点轻微的美国口音。
ext.ext_en: He had developed a slight American accent.

defs.def_en: Someone who speaks with a particular accent pronounces the words of a language in a distinctive way that shows which country, region, or social class they come from.

defs.def_cn: （某些语言中标在字母上方的）变音符号
defs.def_en: An accent is a short line or other mark which is written above certain letters in some languages and which indicates the way those letters are pronounced.

ext.ext_cn: 他强调要保持备战状态。
ext.ext_en: He is putting the accent on military readiness...

ext.ext_cn: 经常大力强调物质成就。
ext.ext_en: There is often a strong accent on material success.

defs.def_en: If you put the accent on a particular feature of something, you emphasize it or give it special importance.

defs.def_cn: 竹芋粉，葛粉（取自西印度群岛的一种植物，用于烹饪，使汤汁变稠或制作饼干）
defs.def_en: Arrowroot is a substance obtained from a West Indian plant. It is used in cooking, for example for thickening sauces or in making biscuits.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在妇女没有选举权的社会中)主张妇女拥有选举权的人，主张妇女参政主义者
defs.def_en: A suffragist is a person who is in favour of women having the right to vote, especially in societies where women are not allowed to vote.

ext.ext_cn: 我非常渴望能够帮助和照顾他人。
ext.ext_en: I had a strong desire to help and care for people...

ext.ext_cn: 他们似乎已丧失了对生活的热望。
ext.ext_en: They seem to have lost their desire for life.

defs.def_en: A desire is a strong wish to do or have something.

ext.ext_cn: 她又结婚了，并且渴望和新任丈夫生个小孩。
ext.ext_en: She had remarried and desired a child with her new husband...

ext.ext_cn: 但弗雷德觉得很无聊，想要回家。
ext.ext_en: But Fred was bored and desired to go home...

defs.def_en: If you desire something, you want it.

ext.ext_cn: 例如，青少年的性行为可能并不是源于真正的情欲，而是出于一种对爱的需要。
ext.ext_en: Teenage sex, for instance, may come not out of genuine desire but from a need to get love.

defs.def_en: Desire for someone is a strong feeling of wanting to have sex with them.

ext.ext_cn: 他从没有想过她可能不想跟他上床。
ext.ext_en: It never occurred to him that she might not desire him.

defs.def_en: If you desire someone, you want to have sex with them.

defs.def_cn: （用于说明性的书面语中）如果需要的话,如果愿意的话

ext.ext_cn: 如有需要可选修额外的课程。
ext.ext_en: Additional courses may be taken if desired...

ext.ext_cn: 如果愿意的话，可以把这些调味汁倒入一只单独的长柄锅里。
ext.ext_en: Transfer this sauce to a separate saucepan, if desired.

defs.def_en: If desired is used in instructions in written English to indicate that someone can choose to take the course of action mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 心里想望之人;心中渴望之物

ext.ext_cn: 他在设法得到自己的中意之物时会不择手段。
ext.ext_en: He was extremely devious in his efforts to achieve his heart's desire.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is your heart's desire, you mean that you want that person or thing very much.

defs.def_cn: 尚有（许多）需要改进之处;有待（大幅）提高

ext.ext_cn: 可供选择的电视节目，尤其是在周末的时候，还有大幅提升的空间。
ext.ext_en: The selection of TV programmes, especially at the weekend, leaves a lot to be desired...

ext.ext_cn: 食品似乎能够买到了，虽然质量还远不尽如人意。
ext.ext_en: Food seems to have been available, even if the quality left much to be desired...

defs.def_en: If you say that something leaves a lot to be desired, you mean that it is not as good as it should be.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 被迷住的;着了迷的;神魂颠倒的

ext.ext_cn: 他们完全被对方迷住了。
ext.ext_en: They were totally smitten with each other.

defs.def_en: If you are smitten, you find someone so attractive that you are or seem to be in love with them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 西蒙·弗雷泽深深地陶醉于自己在美国西南部所发现的这片原始美景中。
ext.ext_en: Simon Fraser was smitten by the landscapes he found in the wild southwest of the United States.

defs.def_en: If you are smitten by something, you are very impressed by it and enthusiastic about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他与安德鲁·布洛尔斯合著了《国际政治视角下的核废料》一书。
ext.ext_en: He is co-author, with Andrew Blowers, of 'The International Politics of Nuclear Waste'.

defs.def_en: The co-authors of a book, play, or report are the people who have written it together.

ext.ext_cn: 他与人合著了一本有关旅游业政策的书。
ext.ext_en: He's co-authored a book on Policy for Tourism...

ext.ext_cn: 卡伦·马修斯与刘易斯·库勒斯合作完成了这个研究课题。
ext.ext_en: Karen Matthews co-authored the study with Lewis Kullers.

defs.def_en: If two or more people co-author a book, play, or report, they write it together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她看起来面色有点苍白，神情忧虑。
ext.ext_en: She looked a little pale and strained...

ext.ext_cn: 吉尔从父亲紧张的声音中感觉到出了什么事了。
ext.ext_en: Gil sensed something wrong from her father's strained voice...

defs.def_en: If someone's appearance, voice, or behaviour is strained, they seem worried and nervous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （关系）紧张的，不友好的，互相猜测的

ext.ext_cn: 总理和副总理之间关系紧张的时期
ext.ext_en: ...a period of strained relations between the prime minister and his deputy.

defs.def_en: If relations between people are strained, those people do not like or trust each other.
A medic is a doctor or medical student.

ext.ext_cn: 一名海军卫生员被狙击手射伤了。
ext.ext_en: A Navy medic was wounded by sniper fire.

defs.def_en: A medic is a doctor who works with the armed forces, as part of a medical corps.

defs.def_cn: （公司为防止被兼并而采取的）“毒丸”防御

ext.ext_cn: 有些人认为这种程度的补偿实质上是阻止任何投标对手的“毒丸”防御。
ext.ext_en: Some believe this level of compensation is essentially a poison pill to put off any rival bidders.

defs.def_en: A poison pill refers to what some companies do to reduce their value in order to prevent themselves being taken over by another company.

ext.ext_cn: 乳腺癌手术
ext.ext_en: ...breast cancer ops.

defs.def_en: An op is a medical operation.

ext.ext_cn: 空军上尉比蒙特在1941年12月完成了200小时的空战任务。
ext.ext_en: Flt Lt Beamont had completed a 200 hour tour of ops in December 1941...

ext.ext_cn: 燧发枪团士兵琼斯奔向作战指挥室寻找他的中尉长官。
ext.ext_en: Fusilier Jones ran towards the Ops Room to find his lieutenant.

defs.def_en: Ops are military operations.

ext.ext_cn: 许多电视网记者开始将拍照时间作为更深层次地审视问题的出发点。
ext.ext_en: Many network TV reporters began using photo-ops as a jumping-off point to examine issues more in depth.

defs.def_en: An op is an opportunity. For example, a photo op is an opportunity for someone to take photographs, or to have photographs taken of them.

ext.ext_cn: 为了想法子增加家庭收入，她开始制作洋娃娃。
ext.ext_en: While searching for a way to augment the family income, she began making dolls.

defs.def_en: To augment something means to make it larger, stronger, or more effective by adding something to it.
A convenor is a trade union official who organizes the union representatives at a particular factory.
A convenor is someone who convenes a meeting.

defs.def_cn: 包罗万象的；影响一切的

ext.ext_cn: 首要的问题看来在于美国撤军后事态将会如何。
ext.ext_en: The overarching question seems to be what happens when the US pulls out?...

ext.ext_cn: 拥有私宅是所有英国人心中压倒一切和根深蒂固的强烈愿望。
ext.ext_en: Home ownership has been an overarching and innate desire of the British.

defs.def_en: You use overarching to indicate that you are talking about something that includes or affects everything or everyone.
A diocese is the area over which a bishop has control.

ext.ext_cn: 上诉法院维持了对上诉人的原判。
ext.ext_en: The Court of Appeal upheld the appellants' convictions.

defs.def_en: An appellant is someone who is appealing against a court's decision after they have been judged guilty of a crime.

defs.def_cn: （美式橄榄球中的）线卫，中后卫
defs.def_en: In American football, a linebacker is a player who tries to stop members of the other team from scoring by tackling them.

defs.def_cn: 女王似的;王后似的;高贵的

ext.ext_cn: 她属于那种像女王般把一切都组织得井然有序的类型。
ext.ext_en: She was a queenly, organizing type.

defs.def_en: You use queenly to describe a woman's appearance or behaviour if she looks very dignified or behaves as if she is very important.
A copter is a helicopter.

ext.ext_cn: 一项课后托管孩子的计划
ext.ext_en: ...an after-school childcare scheme.

defs.def_en: After-school activities are those that are organized for children in the afternoon or evening after they have finished school.

ext.ext_cn: 那只黑色小猫长着白色前爪，胸口上有一块白斑。
ext.ext_en: The kitten was black with white front paws and a white splotch on her chest...

ext.ext_cn: 他从狮子脚掌上拔下一根刺。
ext.ext_en: He removes a thorn from a lion's paw.

defs.def_en: The paws of an animal such as a cat, dog, or bear are its feet, which have claws for gripping things and soft pads for walking on.

defs.def_cn: 爪子（指手，尤用于形容手非常大或非常笨拙）

ext.ext_cn: 他用他的大爪子握了握基顿的手。
ext.ext_en: He shook Keaton's hand with his big paw.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone's hand as their paw, especially if it is very large or if they are very clumsy.

ext.ext_cn: 马迪根的马用蹄子扒着地面。
ext.ext_en: Madigan's horse pawed the ground...

ext.ext_cn: 那些狗继续用爪子疯狂地抓铁丝网。
ext.ext_en: The dogs continued to paw and claw frantically at the chain mesh.

defs.def_en: If an animal paws something, it draws its foot over it or down it.

ext.ext_cn: 别碰我，贾尔斯！
ext.ext_en: Stop pawing me, Giles!...

ext.ext_cn: 他用闲着的那只手摸我的夹克。
ext.ext_en: He pawed at my jacket with his free hand.

defs.def_en: If one person paws another, they touch or stroke them in a way that the other person finds offensive.
The theory of relativity is Einstein's theory concerning space, time, and motion.

ext.ext_cn: 他用榔头和凿子铲墙。
ext.ext_en: He used a hammer and chisel to chip away at the wall.

defs.def_en: A hammer is a tool that consists of a heavy piece of metal at the end of a handle. It is used, for example, to hit nails into a piece of wood or a wall, or to break things into pieces.

ext.ext_cn: 为了不毁坏树，用锤子将一个木栓钉进洞里。
ext.ext_en: To avoid damaging the tree, hammer a wooden peg into the hole...

ext.ext_cn: 建筑工人仍在窗外敲敲打打。
ext.ext_en: Builders were still hammering outside the window.

defs.def_en: If you hammer an object such as a nail, you hit it with a hammer.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不停地拍门、叫喊，他们才开了门。
ext.ext_en: We had to hammer and shout before they would open up...

ext.ext_cn: 一群记者正在砰砰地拍打着大门。
ext.ext_en: A crowd of reporters was hammering on the door...

defs.def_en: If you hammer on a surface, you hit it several times in order to make a noise, or to emphasize something you are saying when you are angry.

ext.ext_cn: 他反复告诉我，我并没有一下子变成个差劲的守门员。
ext.ext_en: He hammered it into me that I had not suddenly become a rotten goalkeeper...

ext.ext_cn: 该行业最近的广告宣传活动一直在反复强调这些主题。
ext.ext_en: Recent advertising campaigns from the industry have hammered at these themes.

defs.def_en: If you hammer something such as an idea into people or you hammer at it, you keep repeating it forcefully so that it will have an effect on people.

defs.def_cn: 猛烈攻击;大力批评;严厉惩罚

ext.ext_cn: 该报告严词谴责了那个私家车司机。
ext.ext_en: The report hammers the private motorist...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们迟到，就会遭到大家的声讨。
ext.ext_en: If we turned up late we would be hammered by everybody.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone hammers another person, you mean that they attack, criticize, or punish the other person severely.

defs.def_cn: （因税收政策变化、经济不景气等）使（企业）受到打击

ext.ext_cn: 看看有多少小企业正在遭受无情的打击。
ext.ext_en: Look at the numbers of small businesses that are being hammered unmercifully...

ext.ext_cn: 公司因建筑和汽车行业的衰退而受到了冲击。
ext.ext_en: The company has been hammered by the downturn in the construction and motor industries.

defs.def_en: If you say that businesses are being hammered, you mean that they are being unfairly harmed, for example by a change in taxes or by bad economic conditions.

ext.ext_cn: 他直落4局轻取年轻的奥地利对手。
ext.ext_en: He hammered the young Austrian player in four straight sets.

defs.def_en: In sports, if you say that one player or team hammered another, you mean that the first player or team defeated the second completely and easily.

defs.def_cn: （通常指因恐惧而心脏）快速跳动

ext.ext_cn: 我的心怦怦直跳。脚步声已停在我的门外。
ext.ext_en: My heart was hammering. The footsteps had stopped outside my door.

defs.def_en: If someone's heart is hammering, it is beating very fast, usually because they are frightened.

defs.def_cn: （机械设备中的）锤状物;（枪上的）击铁;(钢琴的）音槌
defs.def_en: In machines and instruments, a hammer is a part that hits another part. For example, in a gun the hammer causes the explosion which makes the bullet shoot out of it, and in a piano the hammers hit the strings and cause the sounds.

ext.ext_cn: 掷链球和铁饼等在西方算不上传统的受欢迎项目。
ext.ext_en: Events like the hammer and the discus are not traditional crowd-pullers in the West.

ext.ext_cn: 掷链球和铁饼等在西方算不上传统的受欢迎项目。
ext.ext_en: Events like the hammer and the discus are not traditional crowd-pullers in the West.

defs.def_en: In athletics, a hammer is a heavy weight on a piece of wire, which the athlete throws as far as possible.

defs.def_cn: 满腔热情地;劲头十足地

ext.ext_cn: 他酷爱侍弄花草。只要下班一回到家，他就兴冲冲地忙活起来。
ext.ext_en: He loved gardening. He went at it hammer and tongs as soon as he got back from work...

ext.ext_cn: 他们又叫又喊又吵，每晚都要乐此不疲地闹腾6个小时。
ext.ext_en: They yell, shout and argue. For six hours a night they go at it, hammer and tongs.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone was going at something hammer and tongs, you mean that they were doing it with great enthusiasm or energy.

ext.ext_cn: 伊恩·弗莱明未出版的原版笔记将在伦敦的苏富比拍卖行进行拍卖。
ext.ext_en: Ian Fleming's original unpublished notes are to go under the hammer at London auctioneers Sotheby's.

defs.def_en: If you say that something goes, comes, or is under the hammer, you mean that it is going to be sold at an auction.

defs.def_cn: 灵犭是（身细、腿瘦长、善奔跑的狗）
defs.def_en: A greyhound is a dog with a thin body and long thin legs, which can run very fast. Greyhounds sometimes run in races and people bet on them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以开会来讨论那件事吗？
ext.ext_en: Can we have a meeting to discuss that?

ext.ext_cn: 商业会议
ext.ext_en: ...business meetings.

defs.def_en: A meeting is  an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

ext.ext_cn: 那是1月，在我们初次相遇37年之后，我和丹尼斯一同回到了工作室。
ext.ext_en: In January, 37 years after our first meeting, I was back in the studio with Denis...

ext.ext_cn: 她的生活因几年前同她以前的美术老师的偶遇改变了。
ext.ext_en: Her life was changed by a chance meeting with her former art master a few years ago.

defs.def_en: When you meet someone, either by chance or by arrangement, you can refer to this event as a meeting .

defs.def_cn: (以全谷物和有机蔬菜为主的食物)健康的，可延年益寿的

ext.ext_cn: 严格的益寿饮食
ext.ext_en: ...a strict macrobiotic diet.

defs.def_en: Macrobiotic food consists of whole grains and vegetables that are grown without chemicals.
In medieval times, a knight was a man of noble birth, who served his king or lord in battle.

ext.ext_cn: 他于1988年6月被封为爵士，是女王生日宴会上的受勋者之一。
ext.ext_en: He was knighted in the Queen's birthday honours list in June 1988.

defs.def_en: If someone is knighted, they are given a knighthood.
A knight is a man who has been knighted.
In chess, a knight is a piece which is shaped like a horse's head.

defs.def_cn: 救人于危难之中的勇士

ext.ext_cn: 情歌哄骗我们去相信有勇救美人的英雄。
ext.ext_en: Love songs trick us into believing in knights in shining armor.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a knight in shining armour, you mean that they are kind and brave, and likely to rescue you from a difficult situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我嗖的一声坐到其中一张深红色的沙发上。
ext.ext_en: I plopped down on one of the dark red sofas...

ext.ext_cn: 他轻快地一屁股坐在草地上。
ext.ext_en: He plopped himself down on the grass.

defs.def_en: If you plop down or plop yourself down somewhere, you sit down quickly but gently.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 路上通常石头很多，所以最好穿结实耐磨的靴子。
ext.ext_en: The paths are often very rocky so strong boots are advisable.

ext.ext_cn: 岩石嶙峋的海岬
ext.ext_en: ...a rocky headland.

defs.def_en: A rocky place is covered with rocks or consists of large areas of rock and has nothing growing on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （局势、关系）不稳定的，不稳固的，困难重重的

ext.ext_cn: 当安刚结婚时，他们已经一起度过了一些艰难时光。
ext.ext_en: They had gone through some rocky times together when Ann was first married...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的关系在磕磕绊绊中开始了。
ext.ext_en: Their relationship had gotten off to a rocky start.

defs.def_en: A rocky situation or relationship is unstable and full of difficulties.

ext.ext_cn: 这条大街从未铺过路面，冬天泥泞不堪，无法通行。
ext.ext_en: The avenue had never been paved, and deep mud made it impassable in winter.

defs.def_en: If a road or an area of ground has been paved, it has been covered with flat blocks of stone or concrete, so that it is suitable for walking or driving on.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在为签订削减化学武器协议铺平道路的一项新提议
ext.ext_en: ...a new proposal intended to pave the way for the signing of a chemical weapons reduction agreement...

ext.ext_cn: 讨论旨在为两国进行正式谈判铺平道路。
ext.ext_en: The discussions are aimed at paving the way for formal negotiations between the two countries.

defs.def_en: If one thing paves the way for another, it creates a situation in which it is possible or more likely that the other thing will happen.

defs.def_cn: (地点、时间或场合)让人心醉的，迷人的，令人愉快的

ext.ext_cn: 20年代后期牛津迷人的氛围
ext.ext_en: ...the charmed atmosphere of Oxford in the late Twenties.

defs.def_en: A charmed place, time, or situation is one that is very beautiful or pleasant, and seems slightly separate from the real world or real life.

defs.def_cn: 总能逢凶化吉;一向遇难呈祥
defs.def_en: If you say that someone leads or has a charmed life, you mean that they always seem to be lucky, as if they are protected or helped by magic.

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚世界第一届跨大西洋热气球比赛在一片混乱中收场。
ext.ext_en: The world's first transatlantic balloon race ended in chaos last night...

ext.ext_cn: 经济秩序混乱不堪，是不可能建立民主的。
ext.ext_en: It is impossible to establish democracy amid economic chaos.

defs.def_en: Chaos is a state of complete disorder and confusion.

defs.def_cn: 无电梯的公寓大楼;无电梯直通的公寓

ext.ext_cn: 她居住在纽约东村一幢公寓楼5层的一间没有电梯直达的狭小公寓里。
ext.ext_en: She lives in a tiny fifth floor walk-up in New York's East Village.

defs.def_en: A walk-up is a tall apartment block which has no lift. You can also refer to an apartment in such a block as a walk-up .

ext.ext_cn: 如果他们在欧洲获得成功，他们将会改变世界政治和经济格局。
ext.ext_en: If they succeed on Europe, then they will have reshaped the political and economic map of the world...

ext.ext_cn: 经济萧条只不过加速了原本就在改变行业状况的变化。
ext.ext_en: Recession has simply accelerated changes that have been reshaping the industry anyway.

defs.def_en: To reshape something means to change its structure or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 老城区底层人群面临的基本问题是住房紧张和就业不足。
ext.ext_en: The basic problems of the inner-city underclass are inadequate housing and lack of jobs...

ext.ext_cn: 福利已经与长期贫困的下层社会联系在了一起。
ext.ext_en: Welfare has become identified with the long-term poor, the underclass.

defs.def_en: A country's underclass consists of those members of its population who are poor, and who have little chance of improving their situation.

ext.ext_cn: 今天海面上风浪很大，那些配有专门设备的船只无法展开清除海面浮油的工作。
ext.ext_en: Rough seas today prevented specially equipped ships from skimming oil off the water's surface...

ext.ext_cn: 将油脂撇去。
ext.ext_en: Skim off the fat.

defs.def_en: If you skim something from the surface of a liquid, you remove it.

ext.ext_cn: 掠过浪尖的海鸥
ext.ext_en: ...seagulls skimming the waves...

ext.ext_cn: 一叶小舟正轻轻掠过阳光下的海湾。
ext.ext_en: The little boat was skimming across the sunlit surface of the bay.

defs.def_en: If something skims a surface, it moves quickly along just above it.

ext.ext_cn: 他先快速地浏览页面，然后再细细阅读。
ext.ext_en: He skimmed the pages quickly, then read them again more carefully...

ext.ext_cn: 在坐飞机来这儿之前，我只来得及将手稿匆匆浏览了一遍。
ext.ext_en: I only had time to skim through the script before I flew over here.

defs.def_en: If you skim a piece of writing, you read through it quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 10名警卫一起才将他制服。
ext.ext_en: It took ten guardsmen to overpower him...

ext.ext_cn: 叛乱分子已被制服并拘捕起来。
ext.ext_en: The rebels were overpowered and arrested.

defs.def_en: If you overpower someone, you manage to take hold of and keep hold of them, although they struggle a lot.

ext.ext_cn: 他突然感到一阵眩晕。
ext.ext_en: A sudden dizziness overpowered him...

ext.ext_cn: 内疚和羞愧令我无地自容，难以启齿。
ext.ext_en: I was so overpowered by my guilt and my shame that I was unable to speak.

defs.def_en: If a feeling overpowers you, it suddenly affects you very strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天，英国的头号网球选手以7比6和6比3轻取美国选手布赖恩·加罗。
ext.ext_en: Britain's tennis No 1 yesterday overpowered American Brian Garrow 7-6, 6-3.

defs.def_en: In a sports match, when one team or player overpowers the other, they play much better than them and beat them easily.

defs.def_cn: （颜色、气味等）盖过，比…强烈得多

ext.ext_cn: 浅色太阳镜色彩柔和，皮肤白皙的人戴上不会与肤色形成强烈的反差。
ext.ext_en: On fair skin, pale shades are delicate enough not to overpower your colouring.

ext.ext_cn: 像甜椒这样的蔬菜会抢了原汤的味道。
ext.ext_en: Vegetables such as peppers can overpower the flavor of the stock.

defs.def_en: If something such as a colour or flavour overpowers another colour or flavour, it is so strong that it makes the second one less noticeable.

ext.ext_cn: 男性比女性多3倍的城镇
ext.ext_en: ...a town where men outnumber women four to one...

ext.ext_cn: 在这片以石墙隔出巴掌大的农田的乡村，驴子比汽车还多。
ext.ext_en: Donkeys outnumber cars in this landscape of tiny stonewalled fields.

defs.def_en: If one group of people or things outnumbers another, the first group has more people or things in it than the second group.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 会话(式)的;谈话的;交谈的

ext.ext_cn: 让人耳目一新的是作者轻松自如的会话式写作风格。
ext.ext_en: What is refreshing is the author's easy, conversational style...

ext.ext_cn: 他父亲希望他学习德语会话。
ext.ext_en: His father wanted him to learn conversational German.

defs.def_en: Conversational means relating to, or similar to, casual and informal talk.

defs.def_cn: (用土豆泥、肉馅等裹以面包屑做成的)炸丸子，炸条块
defs.def_en: Croquettes are small amounts of mashed potato or meat rolled in breadcrumbs and fried.

defs.def_cn: (用油、醋、香料、草药等调成的)腌泡汁
defs.def_en: A marinade is a sauce of oil, vinegar, spices, and herbs, which you pour over meat or fish before you cook it, in order to add flavour, or to make the meat or fish softer.

ext.ext_cn: 把鸡胸脯肉放入唐杜里烧烤酱里腌泡。
ext.ext_en: Marinade the chicken breasts in the tandoori paste...

ext.ext_cn: 腌制24小时。
ext.ext_en: Leave to marinade for 24 hours.

defs.def_en: To marinade means the same as to marinate .

ext.ext_cn: 我原以为她会停止纠缠我，但结果她似乎是变本加厉了。
ext.ext_en: I thought she'd stop pestering me, but it only seemed to make her worse...

ext.ext_cn: 我知道他烦透了那些缠着他要钱的人。
ext.ext_en: I know he gets fed up with people pestering him for money.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is pestering you, you mean that they keep asking you to do something, or keep talking to you, and you find this annoying.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不大的;不坚固的;脆弱的

ext.ext_cn: 火星的大气层极其稀薄,几乎全部由二氧化碳构成。
ext.ext_en: Mars has an insubstantial atmosphere, consisting almost entirely of carbon dioxide...

ext.ext_en: Her limbs were insubstantial, almost transparent.

defs.def_en: Something that is insubstantial is not large, solid, or strong.

ext.ext_cn: 他希望能获得人身安全和保障，能组建家庭并且有机会在事业上大展宏图。
ext.ext_en: He wanted safety, security, a home, and a chance to get ahead.

defs.def_en: If you want to get ahead, you want to be successful in your career.

defs.def_cn: (培训)在职期间进行的，不脱产的

ext.ext_cn: 切实存在的在职培训需求
ext.ext_en: ...the undoubted need for in-service training.

ext.ext_cn: 为教师开设的在职课程
ext.ext_en: ...in-service courses for teachers.

defs.def_en: If people working in a particular profession are given in-service training, they attend special courses to improve their skills or to learn about new developments in their field.

defs.def_cn: 闹事者;捣乱分子;(尤指）煽动作乱者

ext.ext_cn: 地方长官被赋予禁止罢工、驱逐嫌疑闹事者的权力。
ext.ext_en: The regional governor has been given powers to outlaw strikes and expel suspected troublemakers.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a troublemaker, you mean that they cause unpleasantness, quarrels, or fights, especially by encouraging people to oppose authority.

ext.ext_cn: 这些奖项将要颁发给本年度英国最杰出的戏剧表演作品。
ext.ext_en: These are the prizes given for the most outstanding British theatrical performances of the year.

ext.ext_cn: 戏剧力作
ext.ext_en: ...major theatrical productions.

defs.def_en: Theatrical means relating to the theatre.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为)夸张的，做作的，戏剧性的

ext.ext_cn: 格拉斯做了一个夸张的手势，用一只手将双眼紧紧捂上了。
ext.ext_en: In a theatrical gesture Glass clamped his hand over his eyes.

defs.def_en: Theatrical behaviour is exaggerated and unnatural, and intended to create an effect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 盛大的;壮观的;有戏剧效果的

ext.ext_cn: 整个场面很宏大，深深吸引住了我。
ext.ext_en: There was a theatrical air about the whole scene which had a great appeal for me...

ext.ext_cn: 那些衣服很艳丽很华美，像戏装一样。
ext.ext_en: The clothes were very showy, very theatrical.

defs.def_en: Theatrical can be used to describe something that is grand and dramatic, as if it is part of a performance in a theatre.

defs.def_cn: (尤指业余的)戏剧表演，娱乐表演

ext.ext_cn: 我一向擅长业余表演。
ext.ext_en: I always was good at amateur theatricals.

defs.def_en: Theatricals are performances of plays and other entertainments, especially when they are done by actors who act as a hobby rather than a profession.

ext.ext_cn: 降低收入只会使这些家庭更加贫穷，而且可能诱使不法分子进一步犯罪。
ext.ext_en: Reducing the income will further impoverish these families and could tempt an offender into further crime...

ext.ext_cn: 一年当中这个时节，新鲜水果最能吸引我了。
ext.ext_en: It is the fresh fruit that tempts me at this time of year...

defs.def_en: Something that tempts you attracts you and makes you want it, even though it may be wrong or harmful.

ext.ext_cn: 耗资百万美元试图把美国游客重新吸引到英国来的营销活动
ext.ext_en: ...a million dollar marketing campaign to tempt American tourists back to Britain...

ext.ext_cn: 在流浪者队这样优秀的俱乐部呆了这么久之后，其他苏格兰球队都吸引不了他了。
ext.ext_en: Having spent so long at a great club like Rangers, no other Scottish team could tempt him away...

defs.def_en: If you tempt someone, you offer them something they want in order to encourage them to do what you want them to do.

defs.def_cn: 说晦气话，玩过火，冒险（使好运结束）

ext.ext_cn: 你刚说从来没输过，晦气就来了。
ext.ext_en: As soon as you start to talk about never having played on a losing side, it is tempting fate.

defs.def_en: If someone says that something they say or do is tempting fate or is tempting providence, they mean they are worried that it may cause the good luck they have had so far to end.

ext.ext_cn: 叛变被残酷地镇压了下去。
ext.ext_en: Rebellions were put down with appalling barbarity.

ext.ext_cn: 战事的残酷
ext.ext_en: ...the barbarity of war.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's behaviour as barbarity, you strongly disapprove of it because you think that it is extremely cruel.

ext.ext_cn: 她采访了6名身居高位，并且颇具影响力的女士。
ext.ext_en: She interviewed six women who have reached positions of great power and influence...

ext.ext_cn: 在民主政体中，权力必须分制。
ext.ext_en: In a democracy, power must be divided.

defs.def_en: If someone has power, they have a lot of control over people and activities.

ext.ext_cn: 人类社会有能力解决面临的问题。
ext.ext_en: Human societies have the power to solve the problems confronting them...

ext.ext_cn: 父辈们有能力支配孩子们和年轻人的生活。
ext.ext_en: Fathers have the power to dominate children and young people...

defs.def_en: Your power to do something is your ability to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 你的债务情况只是暂时的，你有能力解决好。
ext.ext_en: Your debt situation is only temporary, and it is within your power to resolve it...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然这超出了他的能力范围，他还是说他会重建空军基地。
ext.ext_en: Although it is not in his power to do so, he said he would rebuild the Air Base...

defs.def_en: If it is in or within your power to do something, you are able to do it or you have the resources to deal with it.

defs.def_cn: （法律赋予当权者的）权力，权限，职权

ext.ext_cn: 首相有权任免高级部长。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister has the power to dismiss and appoint senior ministers...

ext.ext_cn: 警方有权拘捕。
ext.ext_en: The police have the power of arrest...

defs.def_en: If someone in authority has the power to do something, they have the legal right to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 工党于1964年上台。
ext.ext_en: In 1964 Labour came into power...

ext.ext_cn: 他于1970年首次执政。
ext.ext_en: He first assumed power in 1970...

defs.def_en: If people take power or come to power, they take charge of a country's affairs. If a group of people are in power, they are in charge of a country's affairs.

ext.ext_cn: 在西方人眼里，伊拉克是位于具有重要战略意义的地区的一个重要强国。
ext.ext_en: In Western eyes, Iraq is a major power in an area of great strategic importance.

ext.ext_cn: 新兴重要经济强国日本的崛起
ext.ext_en: ...the emergence of the new major economic power, Japan.

defs.def_en: You can use power to refer to a country that is very rich or important, or has strong military forces.

ext.ext_cn: “路行者”汽车的性能、轮胎和刹车都更好。
ext.ext_en: The Roadrunner had better power, better tyres, and better brakes.

ext.ext_cn: 强大的计算能力
ext.ext_en: ...massive computing power.

defs.def_en: The power of something is the ability that it has to move or affect things.

ext.ext_cn: 核能比煤清洁。
ext.ext_en: Nuclear power is cleaner than coal...

ext.ext_cn: 大部分昨晚遭大风袭击的地区已恢复供电。
ext.ext_en: Power has been restored to most parts that were hit last night by high winds...

defs.def_en: Power is energy, especially electricity, that is obtained in large quantities from a fuel source and used to operate lights, heating, and machinery.

ext.ext_cn: 据说“飞轮”电池充电一次就能驱动电动汽车行驶600英里。
ext.ext_en: The 'flywheel' battery, it is said, could  power an electric car for 600 miles on a single charge...

ext.ext_cn: 这些飞机由劳斯莱斯公司制造的发动机提供动力。
ext.ext_en: The planes are powered by Rolls Royce engines.

defs.def_en: The device or fuel that powers a machine provides the energy that the machine needs in order to work.

ext.ext_cn: 大型电动工具，如链锯
ext.ext_en: ...large power tools, such as chainsaws.

defs.def_en: If an event or series of events repeats itself, it happens again.

defs.def_en: If there is a repeat of an event, usually an undesirable event, it happens again.

ext.ext_en: There's nothing except sport and repeats on TV.

defs.def_en: If there is a repeat performance of something, usually something undesirable, it happens again.

ext.ext_en: Franklin swam and sunbathed at the pool every morning.

defs.def_en: When people sunbathe, they sit or lie in a place where the sun shines on them, so that their skin becomes browner.

ext.ext_cn: 宣布中立的公开声明
ext.ext_en: ...a public statement avowing neutrality...

ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister avowed that he saw no need to change his country's policies.

defs.def_en: If you avow something, you admit it or declare it.

ext.ext_cn: 传统家庭形式的拥护者
ext.ext_en: ...upholders of the traditional family unit.

defs.def_en: An upholder of a particular tradition or system is someone who believes strongly in it and will support it when it is threatened.

defs.def_cn: (佛教和印度教中的)曼特罗，祷文，符咒
defs.def_en: A mantra is a word or phrase repeated by Buddhists and Hindus when they meditate, or to help them feel calm.

defs.def_cn: （尤指认为并不正确或只是部分正确的）准则，原则，圭臬

ext.ext_cn: 倾听顾客意见现在已成了公共事业机构每一届新管理层都会奉行的准则之一。
ext.ext_en: Listening to customers is now part of the mantra of new management in public services.

defs.def_en: You can use mantra to refer to a statement or a principle that people repeat very often because they think it is true, especially when you think that it not true or is only part of the truth.

defs.def_cn: 严重人身伤害（罪）（缩略形式为GBH）

ext.ext_cn: 他们两人都被判造成他人严重人身伤害的罪名成立。
ext.ext_en: They were both found guilty of causing grievous bodily harm.

defs.def_en: If someone is accused of grievous bodily harm, they are accused of causing very serious physical injury to someone. The abbreviation GBH is often used.

ext.ext_cn: 工会代表
ext.ext_en: ...trade union representatives...

ext.ext_en: Employees from each department elect a representative.

defs.def_en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

ext.ext_en: She had a stressful job as a sales representative.

defs.def_en: A representative is a person whose job is to sell a company's products or services, especially by travelling round and visiting other companies.

defs.def_cn: 由代表组成的;代议制的

ext.ext_en: The new head of state should be chosen by an 87 member representative council.

defs.def_en: A representative group consists of a small number of people who have been chosen to make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: Someone who is typical of the group to which they belong can be described as representative .

defs.def_en: The existence of something is the fact that it is present in the world as a real thing.

ext.ext_en: Their day-to-day existence was routine.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's way of life as an existence, especially when they live under difficult conditions.

ext.ext_en: Local councillors have reacted with dismay and indignation...

ext.ext_en: Lucy discovered to her dismay that she was pregnant...

defs.def_en: Dismay is a strong feeling of fear, worry, or sadness that is caused by something unpleasant and unexpected.

ext.ext_en: The committee was dismayed by what it had been told...

ext.ext_en: The thought that she was crying dismayed him.

defs.def_en: If you are dismayed by something, it makes you feel afraid, worried, or sad.

defs.def_cn: 怀有，抱有(希望);怀念(过去)

ext.ext_en: The president will cherish the memory of this visit to Ohio...

ext.ext_cn: 那是一个美好的时刻，我们将多年不忘。
ext.ext_en: It was a wonderful occasion which we will cherish for many years to come.

defs.def_en: If you cherish something such as a hope or a pleasant memory, you keep it in your mind for a long period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 他由衷地爱恋并珍惜她。
ext.ext_en: He genuinely loved and cherished her...

ext.ext_cn: 房子先前的主人非常爱惜这房子。
ext.ext_en: The previous owners had cherished the house.

defs.def_en: If you cherish someone or something, you take good care of them because you love them.

defs.def_cn: 珍视，维护，捍卫(权利、特权或原则)

ext.ext_cn: 这些人民珍视他们的独立和主权。
ext.ext_en: These people cherish their independence and sovereignty.

defs.def_en: If you cherish a right, a privilege, or a principle, you regard it as important and try hard to keep it.

defs.def_cn: （美国大学里的）女子联谊会，女子俱乐部

ext.ext_en: Though they still talked a lot, Harry felt that their idyll was drawing to an end.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as an idyll, you mean that it is idyllic.

defs.def_en: A steady situation continues or develops gradually without any interruptions and is not likely to change quickly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 稳定的;牢固的;不摇晃的

ext.ext_en: Get as close to the subject as you can and hold the camera steady...

ext.ext_en: It takes a very steady hand and plenty of practice to paint a perfect line.

defs.def_en: If an object is steady, it is firm and does not shake or move about.

defs.def_en: If you look at someone or speak to them in a steady way, you look or speak in a calm, controlled way.

defs.def_en: If two people are going steady, they are having a long, fairly serious romantic relationship.

defs.def_cn: 与外界隔绝的;不受外界干扰的

ext.ext_cn: “祝贺你，”他真诚地说。

ext.ext_en: ...sincerely held religious beliefs...

defs.def_en: If you say or feel something sincerely, you really mean or feel it, and are not pretending.

ext.ext_cn: 休眠期是这种植物生活史中的另一个阶段。
ext.ext_en: The dormant period is another stage in the life cycle of the plant.

defs.def_en: The life cycle of an animal or plant is the series of changes and developments that it passes through from the beginning of its life until its death.

defs.def_cn: （想法、产品、组织等的）存在周期

ext.ext_cn: 家庭及经济生活周期的各个阶段
ext.ext_en: ...the stages of the familial and economic life cycle...

ext.ext_en: Each new product would have a relatively long life cycle.

defs.def_en: The life cycle of something such as an idea, product, or organization is the series of developments that take place in it from its beginning until the end of its usefulness.

defs.def_cn: (设备、家具等的)小配件，附件，零件
