ext.ext_cn: 工业化生产的厨卫零配件
ext.ext_en: ...industrial fittings for kitchen and bathroom...

defs.def_en: A fitting is one of the smaller parts on the outside of a piece of equipment or furniture, for example a handle or a tap.

defs.def_cn: 可拆除装置(如烤箱、加热器等)
defs.def_en: Fittings are things such as ovens or heaters, that are fitted inside a building, but can be removed if necessary.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The President's address was a fitting end to a bitter campaign.

defs.def_en: Something that is fitting is right or suitable.

ext.ext_cn: 她吃完午饭后去购物,试穿了一些她并不需要的衣服。
ext.ext_en: She lunched and shopped and went for fittings for clothes she didn't need.

defs.def_en: If someone has a fitting, they try on a piece of clothing that is being made for them to see if it fits.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 吵闹的；喧闹的；难以管束的;桀骜不驯的

ext.ext_cn: 你知道我无意存心作对。
ext.ext_en: You know I have no intention of being awkward and obstreperous.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is obstreperous, you think that they are noisy and difficult to control.

defs.def_cn: （尤指为了寻找石油或水而在地上凿的）钻孔，井眼
defs.def_en: A borehole is a deep round hole made by a special tool or machine, especially one that is made in the ground when searching for oil or water.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: It grew ever more clear to everyone that the Minister was too reactionary, too blinkered...

ext.ext_en: As long as I have strength, I shall be trying to remove the reactionary forces from the party.

defs.def_en: A reactionary person or group tries to prevent changes in the political or social system of their country.
An ectopic pregnancy occurs when a fertilized egg becomes implanted outside a woman's womb, for example in one of her fallopian tubes.

defs.def_cn: （股市的）牛市，看涨行情，多头市场
defs.def_en: A bull market is a situation on the stock market when people are buying a lot of shares because they expect that the shares will increase in value and that they will be able to make a profit by selling them again after a short time.

ext.ext_cn: 雨后的柏油路面显得黑亮黑亮的。
ext.ext_en: Rain produced a black gloss on the asphalt.

defs.def_en: A gloss is a bright shine on the surface of something.

ext.ext_en: Television commercials might seem more professional but beware of mistaking the gloss for the content.

defs.def_en: Gloss is an appearance of attractiveness or good quality which sometimes hides less attractive features or poor quality.

ext.ext_cn: 他假借日记对该政权犯下的恐怖罪行巧加粉饰。
ext.ext_en: He used his diary to put a fine gloss on the horrors the regime perpetrated...

ext.ext_cn: 整个想法就是要粉饰历史。
ext.ext_en: The whole idea was to give history a happy gloss.

defs.def_en: If you put a gloss on a bad situation, you try to make it seem more attractive or acceptable by giving people a false explanation or interpretation of it.
Gloss is the same as gloss paint .

ext.ext_cn: 她在眼睑上涂了些亮彩眼影。
ext.ext_en: She brushed gloss on to her eyelids.

ext.ext_cn: 唇彩
ext.ext_en: ...lip glosses.

defs.def_en: Gloss is a type of shiny make-up.

ext.ext_cn: 老编辑将drynke注释为love-potion（春药）。
ext.ext_en: Older editors glossed 'drynke' as 'love-potion'.

defs.def_en: If you gloss a difficult word or idea, you provide an explanation of it.

defs.def_cn: （尤指古埃及的）象形字，象形符号
defs.def_en: Hieroglyphs are symbols in the form of pictures, which are used in some writing systems, especially those of ancient Egypt.

defs.def_cn: 不情愿地；不乐意地；勉强地

ext.ext_en: He agreed to her suggestion begrudgingly.

defs.def_en: If you do something begrudgingly, you do it unwillingly.

ext.ext_cn: 经济紧缩方案
ext.ext_en: ...an economic austerity programme.

ext.ext_cn: 战后的艰苦岁月
ext.ext_en: ...the years of austerity which followed the war.

defs.def_en: Austerity is a situation in which people's living standards  are reduced because of economic difficulties.

ext.ext_cn: 许多废弃建筑，其中一些布局紧凑、古朴典雅
ext.ext_en: ...many abandoned buildings, some of which have a compact classical austerity and dignity.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as showing austerity, you like its plain and simple appearance.

defs.def_cn: 罗特韦尔犬，洛威拿狗（一种黑棕色的大狗，多用来看门）
defs.def_en: A Rottweiler is a large black and brown breed of dog which is often used as a guard dog.

ext.ext_cn: 他终于升职当上了船长。
ext.ext_en: He eventually rose to the rank of captain...

ext.ext_cn: 反情报机构的前任长官被革职并剥夺了特权。
ext.ext_en: The former head of counter-intelligence had been stripped of his rank and privileges.

defs.def_en: Someone's rank is the position or grade that they have in an organization.

defs.def_cn: （尤指社会地位高的）阶级，地位

ext.ext_cn: 每个贵族阶级都有代表。
ext.ext_en: Each rank of the peerage was represented...

ext.ext_cn: 必须把他当成高级人质来对待，而不能像对待普通囚犯那样。
ext.ext_en: He must be treated as a hostage of high rank, not as a common prisoner.

defs.def_en: Someone's rank is the social class, especially the high social class, that they belong to.

ext.ext_cn: 报告中把英国排在22个先进国家中的第20位。
ext.ext_en: The report ranks the UK 20th out of 22 advanced nations...

ext.ext_cn: 他那时世界排名第10，并且是瑞典戴维斯杯队的主力队员。
ext.ext_en: He was at the time ranked 10th in the world and had a regular place in the Swedish Davis Cup team...

defs.def_en: If an official organization ranks someone or something 1st, 5th, or 50th, for example, they calculate that the person or thing has that position on a scale. You can also say that someone or something ranks 1st, 5th, or 50th, for example.

ext.ext_cn: 在当代摄影师当中，他的要价很高。
ext.ext_en: His prices rank high among those of other contemporary photographers...

ext.ext_cn: 在亚洲各国当中，投资者很看重韩国。
ext.ext_en: Investors ranked South Korea high among Asian nations...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something ranks high or low on a scale or if you rank them high or low, you are saying how good or important you think they are.

ext.ext_cn: 必被列为国际橄榄球赛中最令人难忘的一场荡气回肠的比赛
ext.ext_en: ...a performance of heroic calibre that must rank with the most memorable in international rugby...

ext.ext_cn: 作为一部小说，《一九八四》很难被列为杰作。
ext.ext_en: As a novel, Nineteen Eighty-four hardly ranks with the greats.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something ranks with a group of famous people or things, you mean that they are extremely good and should be included in that group.

defs.def_cn: （团体或组织的）全体成员;队伍

ext.ext_cn: 媒体内部也存在一些疑虑。
ext.ext_en: There were some misgivings within the ranks of the media too...

ext.ext_cn: 联合国大会对5个新成员国的加入表示了欢迎。
ext.ext_en: The General Assembly welcomed five new members to its ranks.

defs.def_en: The ranks of a group or organization are the people who belong to it.

defs.def_cn: 普通成员；（尤指军队的）普通士兵

ext.ext_cn: 最高军事指挥说有报告称士兵中出现了士气低落。
ext.ext_en: Top military leaders say there have been reports of demoralization in the ranks...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数商店经理都是由普通店员干起，一步步升上来的。
ext.ext_en: Most store managers have worked their way up through the ranks.

defs.def_en: The ranks are the ordinary members of an organization, especially of the armed forces.

ext.ext_cn: 一队队防暴警察紧张待命。
ext.ext_en: Ranks of police in riot gear stood nervously by...

ext.ext_cn: 她依旧对着门口的一排排照相机微笑着。
ext.ext_en: She continued to smile at the ranks of cameras on their doorstep.

defs.def_en: A rank of people or things is a row of them.

ext.ext_cn: 那人带路来到了出租汽车候客处。
ext.ext_en: The man led the way to the taxi rank...

ext.ext_cn: 他朝着停车处的第一辆出租车走去。
ext.ext_en: He walked towards the first taxi on the rank.

defs.def_en: A taxi rank is a place on a city street where taxis park when they are available for hire.

ext.ext_cn: 他把目前政府提倡平等权利的举措称为“彻头彻尾的伪善”。
ext.ext_en: He called it 'rank hypocrisy' that the government was now promoting equal rights.

defs.def_en: You can use rank to emphasize a bad or undesirable quality that exists in an extreme form.

defs.def_cn: 臭气难闻的；（气味）令人恶心的

ext.ext_en: The kitchen was rank with the smell of drying uniforms.

ext.ext_cn: 脏衣服所发出的臭味
ext.ext_en: ...the rank smell of unwashed clothes.

defs.def_en: You can describe something as rank when it has a strong and unpleasant smell.

defs.def_cn: （队伍、组织的成员等）违反指令，抗命

ext.ext_en: 'Even the President's staunchest supporters have some issues where they simply must break ranks,' says Senator Lott...

ext.ext_cn: 英国看起来不会与欧盟的其他成员反目。
ext.ext_en: Britain appears unlikely to break ranks with other members of the European Union.

defs.def_en: If you say that a member of a group or organization breaks ranks, you mean that they disobey the instructions of their group or organization.

defs.def_cn: （在受到批评时）捐弃嫌隙而携手合作，抱成一团

ext.ext_en: Conservative MPs intend to put aside their differences over Europe and close ranks behind the Prime Minister...

ext.ext_cn: 当其中某成员被谴责失职时，机构往往会抱成一团。
ext.ext_en: Institutions tend to close ranks when a member has been accused of misconduct.

defs.def_en: If you say that the members of a group close ranks, you mean that they are supporting each other only because their group is being criticized.

defs.def_cn: 步…后尘；经历（他人）曾经历过的（尤指坏事）

ext.ext_en: Last month, 370,000 Americans joined the ranks of the unemployed...

defs.def_en: If you experience something, usually something bad, that other people have experienced, you can say that you have joined their ranks .

defs.def_cn: 成功可能性不大的参赛者

ext.ext_cn: 本不被看好的喀麦隆队却以1比0击败了卫冕冠军阿根廷队。
ext.ext_en: The rank outsiders, Cameroon, beat the defending champions, Argentina, by one goal to nil.

defs.def_en: If one of the people in a competition is described as a rank outsider, they are considered to have very little chance of winning.

defs.def_cn: 运用职权，滥用权力（压制他人）

ext.ext_cn: 上校倚仗权势让他的中士划船划了一路。
ext.ext_en: The Captain pulled rank and made his sergeant row the entire way.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone in authority pulls rank, you mean that they unfairly force other people to do what they want because of their higher rank or position.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他说公众的反应让他欣喜。
ext.ext_en: He said that he was delighted with the public response.

defs.def_en: If you are delighted, you are extremely pleased and excited about something.

ext.ext_en: 'You must come to Tinsley's graduation party.' — 'I'd be delighted.'

defs.def_en: If someone invites or asks you to do something, you can say that you would be delighted to do it, as a way of showing that you are very willing to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 没多久，我的肺脓肿就痊愈了。

defs.def_en: When an injury heals up, it becomes completely healthy again.

ext.ext_cn: 保守党人认为这是在遏制浪费纳税人的钱。
ext.ext_en: The Conservatives saw this as stopping the waste of ratepayers' money.

defs.def_en: In Britain, a ratepayer was a person who owned or rented property and therefore had to pay local taxes called rates. The citizens of a district are sometimes still called the ratepayers when their interests and the use of local taxes are being considered.

defs.def_cn: （美国电力、自来水或电话公司的）消费者

ext.ext_cn: 这项新的法律将会让电话运营公司“稳赚不赔”，但是消费者利益可能会继续受到侵害。
ext.ext_en: The new law could create a 'no lose' situation for the phone companies that could leave ratepayers worse off.

defs.def_en: In the United States, a ratepayer is a person whose property is served by an electricity, water, or telephone company, and who pays for these services.

defs.def_cn: 方舟（《圣经》中，大洪水时挪亚为救家人和动物而建造的大船）
defs.def_en: In the Bible, the ark was a large boat which Noah built in order to save his family and two of every kind of animal from the Flood.

ext.ext_cn: 它通常赖以为食的浮游生物和其他微生物
ext.ext_en: ...its usual diet of plankton and other small organisms.

defs.def_en: Plankton is a mass of tiny animals and plants that live in the surface layer of the sea.

ext.ext_cn: 我希望这本书不会又是重复一些流行的至理名言。
ext.ext_en: I hope this book is not yet another restatement of the prevailing wisdom...

ext.ext_cn: 普雷斯科特先生专注于对工党价值观进行经典的阐释。
ext.ext_en: Mr Prescott concentrated on offering a classic restatement of Labour values.

defs.def_en: A restatement of something that has been said or written is another statement that repeats it, usually in a slightly different form.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 乔安娜曾有一两次敷衍着去帮助格雷厄姆年轻的妻子。
ext.ext_en: Joanna had made one or two half-hearted attempts to befriend Graham's young wife.

ext.ext_cn: 不诚挚的道歉
ext.ext_en: ...a half-hearted apology...

defs.def_en: If someone does something in a half-hearted way, they do it without any real effort, interest, or enthusiasm.

ext.ext_cn: 她先挥拳打他的下巴，然后又打他的脑袋。
ext.ext_en: After punching him on the chin she wound up hitting him over the head...

ext.ext_cn: 他生气地用拳捶墙，接着转过身来面对着她。
ext.ext_en: He punched the wall angrily, then spun round to face her.

defs.def_en: If you punch someone or something, you hit them hard with your fist.

ext.ext_cn: 最后，格拉夫高兴得挥动着拳头，脸上笑开了花。
ext.ext_en: At the end, Graf punched the air in delight, a huge grin on her face.

defs.def_en: If you punch the air, you put one or both of your fists forcefully above your shoulders as a gesture of delight or victory.

ext.ext_cn: 贝勒太太迈向电梯，按下按钮。
ext.ext_en: Mrs. Baylor strode to the elevator and punched the button.

defs.def_en: If you punch something such as the buttons on a keyboard, you touch them in order to store information on a machine such as a computer or to give the machine a command to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 我拿了一支圆珠笔，在纸盒上戳了一个洞。
ext.ext_en: I took a ballpoint pen and punched a hole in the carton.

defs.def_en: If you punch holes in something, you make holes in it by pushing or pressing it with something sharp.

ext.ext_cn: 用打孔器打两个孔。
ext.ext_en: Make two holes with a hole punch.

defs.def_en: A punch is a tool that you use for making holes in something.

ext.ext_cn: 我太紧张，没能有效地传达我演说的要点。

ext.ext_cn: 飓风安德鲁的风力可能会逐渐减弱，但风速仍在每小时100英里左右。
ext.ext_en: Hurricane Andrew may be slowly losing its punch, but its winds are still around 100 miles an hour.

defs.def_en: If you say that something has punch, you mean that it has force or effectiveness.

defs.def_cn: 潘趣酒，宾治酒（各种酒和糖、柠檬、调料等勾兑而成的饮料）
defs.def_en: Punch is a drink made from wine or spirits mixed with things such as sugar, lemons, and spices.

ext.ext_cn: 她论事一针见血是出了名的，从来都是直言不讳。
ext.ext_en: She has a reputation for getting at the guts of a subject and never pulling her punches.

ext.ext_cn: 鼓励她参加慈善募捐活动。

ext.ext_en: Most of the art exhibitions have a  pronounced Scottish theme.

ext.ext_cn: 明显的澳大利亚口音
ext.ext_en: ...a pronounced Australian accent...

defs.def_en: Something that is pronounced is very noticeable.

defs.def_cn: (在一定期限内)可偿还的，必须偿还的

ext.ext_en: The loan is repayable over twenty years.

ext.ext_cn: 汉普郡的一座18世纪的宅邸

ext.ext_en: The very best properties, however, the colonial mansions and villas, were reserved for the government.

defs.def_en: A mansion is a very large house.

defs.def_cn: （常用于公寓楼的专有名称中）公寓，大厦

ext.ext_cn: 特拉华公寓——一座位于英国广播公司电台对面拥有167间套房的公寓楼
ext.ext_en: ...Delaware Mansions, a block of 167 flats opposite the BBC Radio studios.

defs.def_en: Mansions is often used in the names of blocks of flats.

defs.def_cn: 表面上的；基于初步印象的

ext.ext_cn: 表面上看这是一宗藐视法庭的案件。
ext.ext_en: There was a prima facie case that a contempt of court had been committed.

defs.def_en: Prima facie is used to describe something which appears  to be true when you first consider it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个地区以其罗马式的教堂闻名。
ext.ext_en: The area is renowned for its Romanesque churches...

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯以其前瞻性的思想而负盛名。

ext.ext_en: ...a poppy-seed derivative similar to heroin...

ext.ext_cn: 这不是一款全新的车，而是雪铁龙XM系列的派生车型。
ext.ext_en: This isn't an entirely new car, but a new derivative of the Citroen XM.

defs.def_en: A derivative is something which has been developed or obtained from something else.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 模仿他人的;缺乏创意的

ext.ext_cn: 他们沉闷乏味、缺乏创意的首张专辑
ext.ext_en: ...their dull, derivative debut album...

ext.ext_cn: 如今人们看到的单人喜剧表演好多内容都是沿袭前人。
ext.ext_en: A lot of what you see in stand-up comedy today is very derivative.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is derivative, you are criticizing it because it is not new or original but has been developed from something else.

ext.ext_cn: 据说街上发生了肉搏战。
ext.ext_en: There was, reportedly, hand-to-hand combat in the streets...

ext.ext_cn: 他在激烈的肉搏战中被打断了两根肋骨。
ext.ext_en: He suffered two broken ribs in a fierce hand-to-hand battle.

defs.def_en: Hand-to-hand fighting is fighting where the people are very close together, using either their hands or weapons such as knives.

ext.ext_cn: 他自认是一位追求更高的新闻和广播标准的斗士。
ext.ext_en: He has set himself up as a crusader for higher press and broadcasting standards.

defs.def_en: A crusader for a cause is someone who does a lot in support of it.
A Crusader was a knight who fought in the Crusades.

defs.def_cn: 亲密生嫌隙；亲不敬，熟生蔑

ext.ext_cn: 对罪恶熟悉之后，生出的不是蔑视，而是习以为常。
ext.ext_en: Familiarity with evil breeds not contempt but acceptance.

defs.def_en: See also:familiar;Familiarity is used especially in the expression familiarity breeds contempt to say that if you know a person or situation very well, you can easily lose respect for that person or become careless in that situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人无法容忍的；骇人的

ext.ext_cn: 我必须为自己极端无礼的行为道歉。
ext.ext_en: I must apologise for my outrageous behaviour...

ext.ext_cn: 本地电话资费贵得出奇。
ext.ext_en: Charges for local telephone calls are particularly outrageous.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as outrageous, you are emphasizing that it is unacceptable or very shocking.

ext.ext_cn: 卫星重新进入大气层，烧成灰烬。
ext.ext_en: The satellite re-entered the atmosphere and burned up...

ext.ext_cn: 大火烧光了18万英亩的木材。
ext.ext_en: Fires have burned up 180,000 acres of timber.

defs.def_en: If something burns up or if fire burns it up, it is completely destroyed by fire or strong heat.

ext.ext_cn: 快走比慢跑能消耗更多的热量。
ext.ext_en: Brisk walking burns up more calories than slow jogging.

defs.def_en: If something burns up fuel or energy, it uses it.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司已在国内外找到60个潜在客户。
ext.ext_en: The firm has identified 60 potential customers at home and abroad...

ext.ext_cn: 有可能发展成党员的人
ext.ext_en: ...potential party members...

defs.def_en: You use potential to say that someone or something is capable of developing into the particular kind of person or thing mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 这个男孩非常有潜质。
ext.ext_en: The boy has great potential...

ext.ext_cn: 学校力求对每一个学生因材施教，帮助他们充分发挥其潜力。
ext.ext_en: The school strives to treat pupils as individuals and to help each one to achieve their full potential...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰似乎和我一样害怕他自己会使用暴力。
ext.ext_en: John seemed as horrified as I about his potential for violence...

ext.ext_cn: 这次会议有可能成为具有转折性的事件。
ext.ext_en: The meeting has the potential to be a watershed event...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has potential for doing a particular thing, you mean that it is possible they may do it. If there is the potential for something, it may happen.

defs.def_cn: 古希腊式的；古希腊风格的

ext.ext_cn: 典雅的古希腊式柱子
ext.ext_en: ...elegant Grecian columns.

ext.ext_cn: 略带古希腊风格的飘逸的蓝色礼服
ext.ext_en: ...a vaguely Grecian gown of flowing blue.

defs.def_en: Grecian is used to describe something which is in the style of things from ancient Greece.
A baptism is a Christian ceremony in which a person is baptized.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (言谈)呆板的，生硬的，不自然的

ext.ext_cn: 我们客套了一番。
ext.ext_en: We made polite, stilted conversation...

ext.ext_cn: 他的发言很生硬，有时还打结巴。
ext.ext_en: His delivery was stilted and occasionally stumbling.

defs.def_en: If someone speaks in a stilted way, they speak in a formal or unnatural way, for example because they are not relaxed.

defs.def_cn: 未使用的;未被占用的;空的

ext.ext_cn: 车厢中部有一个空座。
ext.ext_en: Half way down the coach was a vacant seat...

ext.ext_cn: 各大城市里空置的楼房都比无家可归的人多。
ext.ext_en: In every major city there are more vacant buildings than there are homeless people.

defs.def_en: If something is vacant, it is not being used by anyone.

ext.ext_cn: 几位资深人士被认为有望填补现在空缺的职位。
ext.ext_en: A number of senior people were regarded as likely to occupy the now vacant post...

ext.ext_cn: 主席之位已经空缺一段时间了。
ext.ext_en: The post of chairman has been vacant for some time.

defs.def_en: If a job or position is vacant, no one is doing it or in it at present, and people can apply for it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她脸上有种茫然的神情。
ext.ext_en: She had a kind of vacant look on her face.

defs.def_en: A vacant look or expression is one that suggests that someone does not understand something or that they are not thinking about anything in particular.

ext.ext_cn: 梅勒斯宣扬异端邪说，不得不立即免去其圣职。
ext.ext_en: Mellors was preaching heresy and had to be immediately defrocked.

ext.ext_cn: 被免除圣职的牧师
ext.ext_en: ...a defrocked priest.

defs.def_en: If a priest is defrocked, he is forced to stop being a priest because of bad behaviour.
Rye grass is a type of grass that is grown for animals such as cows to eat.

ext.ext_cn: 鱼和米是该国的主要食品。
ext.ext_en: Fish and rice were the mainstays of the country's diet...

ext.ext_cn: 这一集体谈判原则已经成为该国劳动关系的重要基础。
ext.ext_en: This principle of collective bargaining has been a mainstay in labor relations in this country.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as the mainstay of a particular thing, you mean that it is the most basic part of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这将使电子游戏的互动性更胜以往。
ext.ext_en: This will make videogames more interactive than ever.

defs.def_en: An interactive computer program or television system is one which allows direct communication between the user and the machine.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 课堂上灵活互动的教学
ext.ext_en: ...flexible, interactive teaching in the classroom.

defs.def_en: If you describe a group of people or their activities as interactive, you mean that the people communicate with each other.

ext.ext_cn: 风吹得火星、灰渣乱飞。
ext.ext_en: The wind sent sparks and cinders flying.

defs.def_en: Cinders are the black pieces that are left after something such as wood or coal has burned away.

defs.def_cn: (数码相机等的)内存卡,存储卡，记忆卡
defs.def_en: A memory card is a type of card containing computer memory that is used in digital cameras and other devices.

ext.ext_cn: 为自由事业光荣献身的烈士
ext.ext_en: ...a glorious martyr to the cause of liberty.

ext.ext_cn: 基督教的殉教者
ext.ext_en: ...a Christian martyr...

defs.def_en: A martyr is someone who is killed or made to suffer greatly because of their religious or political beliefs, and is admired and respected by people who share those beliefs.

defs.def_cn: (因宗教或政治信仰)处死，使殉难，折磨

ext.ext_cn: 圣潘克拉斯于公元304年殉道。
ext.ext_en: St Pancras was martyred in 304 AD.

ext.ext_cn: 受难的领袖是否被释放
ext.ext_en: ...whether its martyred leader is released or not.

defs.def_en: If someone is martyred, they are killed or made to suffer greatly because of their religious or political beliefs.

defs.def_cn: (为博取同情或赞赏的)假装受苦者，诉苦者，乞怜者

ext.ext_cn: 你什么时候才能不再摆出一副可怜样？
ext.ext_en: When are you going to quit acting like a martyr?

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮弗做出愤怒的反应，开始大倒苦水。
ext.ext_en: Jennifer responded with anger and played the martyr role.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a martyr, you disapprove of the fact that they pretend to suffer, or exaggerate their suffering, in order to get sympathy or praise from other people.

defs.def_cn: 深受…之苦者;受…折磨的人

ext.ext_cn: 埃尔斯沃思深为自己的荣誉感和责任感所累。
ext.ext_en: Ellsworth was a martyr to his sense of honour and responsibility...

ext.ext_cn: 他说他深受背痛的折磨。
ext.ext_en: He said that he was a martyr to his back.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a martyr to something, you mean that they suffer as a result of it.
Counter-espionage is the same as counter-intel-ligence .

ext.ext_cn: 天突然暗了下来。
ext.ext_en: The sky darkened abruptly...

ext.ext_cn: 她已化好妆，并涂黑了睫毛。
ext.ext_en: She had put on her make-up and darkened her eyelashes.

defs.def_en: If something darkens or if a person or thing darkens it, it becomes darker.

ext.ext_cn: 我的好心情突然变得阴郁起来。
ext.ext_en: My sunny mood suddenly darkened...

ext.ext_cn: 今天什么都不会影响到他的心情。
ext.ext_en: Nothing was going to darken his mood today.

defs.def_en: If someone's mood darkens or if something darkens their mood, they suddenly become rather unhappy.

ext.ext_cn: 罗利的脸色又阴沉下来。
ext.ext_en: Rawley's face darkened again.

defs.def_en: If someone's face darkens, they suddenly look angry.

defs.def_cn: 劝阻;劝(某人)不要做(或相信)

ext.ext_cn: 医生们劝病人不要吸烟。
ext.ext_en: Doctors had tried to dissuade patients from smoking...

ext.ext_cn: 她坚持认为她孙子是无辜的，什么都不能改变她这一看法。
ext.ext_en: She steadfastly maintained that her grandsons were innocent, and nothing could dissuade her from that belief...

defs.def_en: If you dissuade someone from doing or believing something, you persuade them not to do or believe it.

ext.ext_cn: 我和朗每周和同一帮人聚在一起打扑克。
ext.ext_en: Lon and I play in the same weekly poker game.

defs.def_en: Poker is a card game that people usually play in order to win money.

ext.ext_cn: 马隆夫人拿起拨火棒，拨弄了一下身旁燃烧着的小火。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Malone took up the poker and stirred at the little fire burning beside her.

defs.def_en: A poker is a metal bar which you use to move coal or wood in a fire in order to make it burn better.

defs.def_cn: 血汗工厂(工作条件恶劣、工资低的小工厂)

ext.ext_cn: 肮脏隐蔽的血汗服装工厂
ext.ext_en: ...the dingy, hidden world of garment sweatshops.

defs.def_en: If you describe a small factory as a sweatshop, you mean that many people work there in poor conditions for low pay.
A bedspread is a decorative cover which is put over a bed, on top of the sheets and blankets.

ext.ext_cn: 查清楚你可以享受哪些福利是绝对有必要的。
ext.ext_en: It is certainly worth checking up on your benefit entitlements...

ext.ext_cn: 政府雇用税务稽查员做检查工作，以确保人们足额纳税。
ext.ext_en: The Government employs tax inspectors to check up and make sure people pay all their tax.

defs.def_en: See also:check-up;If you check up on something, you find out information about it.

ext.ext_cn: 我能肯定，他当时知道我在暗中调查他。
ext.ext_en: I'm sure he knew I was checking up on him.

defs.def_en: If you check up on someone, you obtain information about them, usually secretly.

ext.ext_cn: 鸡鸭在棚子周围到处乱刨。
ext.ext_en: Chickens and ducks scratch around the outbuildings.

ext.ext_cn: 蜜汁烤鸭
ext.ext_en: ...honey roasted duck.

defs.def_en: A duck is a very common water bird with short legs, a short neck, and a large flat beak.

ext.ext_cn: 我弄来一只公鸭和三只母鸭。
ext.ext_en: I brought in one drake and three ducks.

defs.def_en: A duck is a female duck. The male is called a drake.

defs.def_cn: 急速低头（或弓身）(以免被打中或看见)

ext.ext_cn: 他及时低下头，躲过了拨火棍的击打。
ext.ext_en: He ducked in time to save his head from a blow from the poker...

ext.ext_cn: 他低下头以掩饰他的仰慕之情。
ext.ext_en: He ducked his head to hide his admiration...

defs.def_en: If you duck, you move your head or the top half of your body quickly downwards to avoid something that might hit you, or to avoid being seen.

defs.def_cn: (快速低头或弓身以)躲闪,闪避

ext.ext_cn: 汉斯灵巧地躲过他们的击打。
ext.ext_en: Hans deftly ducked their blows.

defs.def_en: If you duck something such as a blow, you avoid it by moving your head or body quickly downwards.

ext.ext_cn: 马特慌忙躲进他的办公室。
ext.ext_en: Matt ducked into his office...

ext.ext_cn: 他溜进门里，慌忙地四处张望着。
ext.ext_en: He ducked through the door and looked about frantically.

defs.def_en: If you duck into a place, you move there quickly, often in an attempt to avoid danger or to avoid being seen.

defs.def_cn: 逃避,回避,推脱,推诿(义务或责任)

ext.ext_cn: 反对党认为卫生大臣逃避了所有决策难题。
ext.ext_en: The Opposition reckons the Health Secretary has ducked all the difficult decisions...

ext.ext_cn: 去年夏天他避开了与联合国核查人员的对峙。
ext.ext_en: He had ducked the confrontation with United Nations inspectors last summer.

defs.def_en: You say that someone ducks a duty or responsibility when you disapprove of the fact that they avoid it.

defs.def_cn: 将(某人或其头部)按入水中

ext.ext_cn: 她和马克在水池中嬉戏,胡闹着要将他按入水中。
ext.ext_en: She splashed around in the pool with Mark, rowdily trying to duck him.

defs.def_en: If someone ducks someone else, they force them or their head under water for a short time.

ext.ext_cn: 噢,很高兴见到你,亲爱的。
ext.ext_en: Oh, I am glad to see you, duck.

defs.def_en: Some people call other people duck or ducks as a sign of affection.

defs.def_cn: 毫无效果的;不起作用的

ext.ext_cn: 批评对我来说左耳进右耳出，毫无影响。
ext.ext_en: All the criticism is water off a duck's back to me.

defs.def_en: You say that criticism is like water off a duck's back or water off a duck's back to emphasize that it is not having any effect on the person being criticized.

defs.def_cn: 很自然地就会;轻而易举;如鱼得水

ext.ext_cn: 她很快就对母亲这一角色驾轻就熟了。
ext.ext_en: She took to mothering like a duck to water.

defs.def_en: If you take to something like a duck to water, you discover that you are naturally good at it or that you find it very easy to do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 没有留下深刻印象的；不以为然的

ext.ext_cn: 他对他的老师也很不以为然。
ext.ext_en: He was also very unimpressed by his teachers...

ext.ext_cn: 格雷厄姆·弗莱彻对填写冗长的调查问卷这种事没什么兴趣。
ext.ext_en: Graham Fletcher was unimpressed with the idea of filling in a lengthy questionnaire.

defs.def_en: If you are unimpressed by something or someone, you do not think they are very good, clever, or useful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人反感的；令人不快的

ext.ext_cn: 身边带着一位极难管教的孩子的母亲
ext.ext_en: ...a mother accompanied by her ghastly unruly child...

ext.ext_cn: 这是我这辈子最倒霉的一周，别提有多烦了。
ext.ext_en: It was the worst week of my life. It was ghastly.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as ghastly, you mean that you find them very unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调)同一的，完全相同的

ext.ext_cn: 你发现原来在学校里痛扁你的同一群人现在成了你的崇拜者。
ext.ext_en: You find yourself worshipped by the self-same people who beat you up at school.

defs.def_en: You use self-same when you want to emphasize that the person or thing mentioned is exactly the same as the one mentioned previously.

defs.def_cn: （装涂料、除臭剂等的）小型喷雾器
defs.def_en: An aerosol is a small container in which a liquid such as paint or deodorant is kept under pressure. When you press a button, the liquid is forced out as a fine spray or foam.

ext.ext_cn: 他上的是伊顿公学，英国最昂贵的私立学校。
ext.ext_en: He attended Eton, the most exclusive private school in Britain.

defs.def_en: A private school is a school which is not supported financially by the government and which parents have to pay for their children to go to.

ext.ext_cn: 有了事后的认识，我们都会以不同的方式行事。
ext.ext_en: With hindsight, we'd all do things differently...

ext.ext_cn: 就算是事后已经一切明了，如果让我重来一次，我也不确定自己是否会作出改变。
ext.ext_en: Even with the benefit of hindsight, I doubt I would change anything if I had my time again.

defs.def_en: Hindsight is the ability to understand and realize something about an event after it has happened, although you did not understand or realize it at the time.

defs.def_cn: （与 two, three 等词连用构成名词，表示参加某项活动的人数，尤指戏剧或电影中的角色人数）表示“…人”

ext.ext_cn: 双人剧
ext.ext_en: ...a two-hander play...

ext.ext_cn: 威廉斯的这部戏剧是一部关于两个凶手和一个银行抢劫犯的扣人心弦的现代三人剧。
ext.ext_en: Williams's play is a tense contemporary three-hander about two murderers and a bank-robber.

defs.def_en: See also:left-hander;right-hander;-hander combines with words like 'two' or 'three' to form nouns which indicate how many people are involved in a particular activity, especially a play or a film.

ext.ext_cn: 现在，他们会考虑给那些在市中心创造了就业机会的企业提供减税优惠。
ext.ext_en: Today they'll consider tax breaks for businesses that create jobs in inner cities.

defs.def_en: If the government gives a tax break to a particular group of people or type of organization, it reduces the amount of tax they have to pay or changes the tax system in a way that benefits them.

defs.def_cn: 使快速重新启动;使…重新开始

ext.ext_cn: 总统选择通过大幅降低利率来重新拉动经济增长。
ext.ext_en: The President has chosen to kick-start the economy by slashing interest rates.

ext.ext_cn: 房地产市场需要刺激。
ext.ext_en: The housing market needs a kick-start.

defs.def_en: To kick-start a process that has stopped working or progressing is to take a course of action that will quickly start it going again.

ext.ext_cn: 他将摩托车撑脚架往上一提，开始蹬车启动。
ext.ext_en: He lifted the bike off its stand and kick-started it.

defs.def_en: If you kick-start a motorcycle, you press the lever that starts it with your foot.
A convent school is a school where many of the teachers are nuns.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个展览是一次不但令人愉快，而且还鼓舞人心的体验。
ext.ext_en: The exhibition is an enjoyable and, ultimately, life-affirming experience.

defs.def_en: A life-affirming activity or attitude emphasizes the positive aspects of life.

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉有两个人在使劲拽他手里的手提箱。
ext.ext_en: He felt two men wrench the suitcase from his hand...

ext.ext_cn: 他使劲儿脱下运动鞋。
ext.ext_en: He wrenched off his sneakers...

defs.def_en: If you wrench something that is fixed in a particular position, you pull or twist it violently, in order to move or remove it.

ext.ext_cn: 她从他手里挣脱开来。
ext.ext_en: She wrenched herself from his grasp...

ext.ext_cn: 他把手臂挣脱开来。
ext.ext_en: He wrenched his arm free...

defs.def_en: If you wrench yourself free from someone who is holding you, you get away from them by suddenly twisting the part of your body that is being held.

ext.ext_cn: 他因摔倒而严重扭伤了脚踝。
ext.ext_en: He had wrenched his ankle badly from the force of the fall.

defs.def_en: If you wrench one of your joints, you twist it and injure it.

ext.ext_cn: 我一直心里清楚过了这么多年后离开埃塞克斯会非常痛苦。
ext.ext_en: I always knew it would be a wrench to leave Essex after all these years...

ext.ext_cn: 其中很多东西都具有重要的情感价值，令人难以割舍。

ext.ext_cn: 这些薄薄的晶体传导了大部分的动力。
ext.ext_en: These thin crystals transmit much of the power...

ext.ext_en: There was no vibration transmitted to the handles and the machine wasn't noisy either.

defs.def_en: If an object or substance transmits something such as sound or electrical signals, the sound or signals are able to pass through it.

ext.ext_cn: 她把我们领进了一个带阳台的房间，从那里可以俯瞰海港。
ext.ext_en: She led us to a room with a balcony overlooking the harbour...

ext.ext_cn: 该船获准在波士顿港口停泊。
ext.ext_en: The ship was permitted to tie up in Boston harbour.

defs.def_en: A harbour is an area of the sea at the coast which is partly enclosed by land or strong walls, so that boats can be left there safely.

defs.def_cn: 心怀，怀藏，怀有（情感、想法或秘密）

ext.ext_cn: 他可能已经被以前的客户或某个对他怀恨在心的人谋杀了。
ext.ext_en: He might have been murdered by a former client or someone harbouring a grudge...

ext.ext_cn: 汤森心中无怨无悔。
ext.ext_en: Townsend harbours no regrets.

defs.def_en: If you harbour an emotion, thought, or secret, you have it in your mind over a long period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 匈牙利前领导层被指控窝藏嫌犯。
ext.ext_en: Accusations of harbouring suspects were raised against the former Hungarian leadership.

defs.def_en: If a person or country harbours someone who is wanted by the police, they let them stay in their house or country and offer them protection.

defs.def_cn: 无聊季节(通常在 8 月左右，因政治新闻不多，报纸上充斥着无聊内容)
defs.def_en: The silly season is the time around August when the newspapers are full of unimportant or silly news stories because there is not much political news to report.
Play-Doh is a soft coloured substance like clay which children use for making models.

defs.def_cn: 为公众所接受的；公认的

ext.ext_cn: 关于生活的定义不一而足。
ext.ext_en: There is no generally accepted definition of life...

ext.ext_cn: 人们普遍认为，科学的兴起是宗教衰落的部分原因。
ext.ext_en: It is accepted wisdom that science has been partly responsible for the decline of religion.

defs.def_en: See also:accept;Accepted ideas are agreed by most people to be correct or reasonable.

defs.def_cn: 红褐色头发的人（尤指女人）
defs.def_en: A redhead is person, especially a woman, whose hair is a colour that is between red and brown.
A hooter is a device such as a horn that makes a hooting noise.

defs.def_cn: (军队或警察对某地的)围困，包围，围攻

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须尽一切可能解除包围。
ext.ext_en: We must do everything possible to lift the siege...

ext.ext_cn: 他们希望能和平结束这次围困。
ext.ext_en: They are hopeful of bringing the siege to a peaceful conclusion...

defs.def_en: See also:state of siege;A siege is a military or police operation in which soldiers or police surround a place in order to force the people there to come out or give up control of the place.

defs.def_cn: (警察、士兵、新闻记者等)包围，围住

ext.ext_cn: 叛乱者包围了总督府。
ext.ext_en: The rebels laid siege to the governor's residence...

ext.ext_cn: 记者围住了俱乐部。
ext.ext_en: The press laid siege to the club.

defs.def_en: If police, soldiers, or journalists lay siege to a place, they surround it in order to force the people there to come out or give up control of the place.

defs.def_cn: 遭受严厉批评;承受巨大压力

ext.ext_cn: 那家伙会认为他承受了巨大压力。
ext.ext_en: The guy'll think he's under siege...

ext.ext_cn: 广播一台受到了来自各方的严厉批评。
ext.ext_en: Radio One is under siege from all sides.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is under siege, they are being severely criticized or put under a great deal of pressure.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 心胸开阔的；开明的；宽宏大量的

ext.ext_cn: 公正无私、心胸开阔的人
ext.ext_en: ...a fair and broad-minded man.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as broad-minded, you approve of them because they are willing to accept types of behaviour which other people consider immoral.

ext.ext_cn: 工业机械与设备
ext.ext_en: ...industrial machinery and equipment.

ext.ext_cn: 化工制品与癌症的联系
ext.ext_en: ...a link between industrial chemicals and cancer.

defs.def_en: You use industrial to describe things which relate to or are used in industry.

defs.def_cn: 工业高度发达的;工业化的

ext.ext_cn: 西方工业大国的部长们
ext.ext_en: ...ministers from leading western industrial countries.

defs.def_en: An industrial city or country is one in which industry is important or highly developed.

defs.def_cn: 三个月一次的;按季度的

ext.ext_cn: 日本银行对5,000家公司的最新季度调查
ext.ext_en: ...the latest Bank of Japan quarterly survey of 5,000 companies.

ext.ext_cn: 红利按季发放还是按年发放没有什么差别。
ext.ext_en: It makes no difference whether dividends are paid quarterly or annually.

defs.def_en: A quarterly event happens four times a year, at intervals of three months.

ext.ext_cn: 这本季刊曾经是进行颇有见地的学术讨论的论坛。
ext.ext_en: The quarterly had been a forum for sound academic debate.

ext.ext_cn: 《外交政策》——一本在巴黎出版的季刊
ext.ext_en: ...'Foreign Policy', a quarterly journal published in Paris.

defs.def_en: A quarterly is a magazine that is published four times a year, at intervals of three months.
Motor neurone disease is a disease which destroys the part of a person's nervous system that controls movement.
Chain mail is a kind of armour made from small metal rings joined together so that they look like cloth.

ext.ext_cn: 那个女孩的马咴儿咴儿地叫着。
ext.ext_en: The girl's horse whinnied.

ext.ext_cn: 那匹马惊了，发出一声可怕的嘶叫。
ext.ext_en: With a terrified whinny the horse shied.

defs.def_en: When a horse whinnies, it makes a series of high-pitched sounds, usually not very loudly.

ext.ext_cn: 新民主党在希腊大选中获胜。
ext.ext_en: In the Greek general election, the New Democracy party has claimed victory.

ext.ext_cn: 希腊军队
ext.ext_en: ...the Greek army.

defs.def_en: Greek means belonging or relating to Greece.

ext.ext_cn: 他搜遍了整个房子想要找到那两个希腊人。
ext.ext_en: He had looked through the house for the two Greeks.

defs.def_en: A Greek is a person who comes from Greece.

ext.ext_cn: 我不得不学习希腊语。
ext.ext_en: I had to learn Greek.

defs.def_en: Greek is the language used in Greece.

ext.ext_cn: 老师们今天发出警告说，拉丁语、古希腊语和其他古典文学将被挤出学校的课程表。
ext.ext_en: Teachers warn today that Latin, Greek and other classics will be squeezed out of school timetables.

defs.def_en: Greek or Ancient Greek was the language used in Greece in ancient times.

defs.def_cn: (尤指歌手)声音（和某位著名人士）相似的人

ext.ext_cn: 嗓音和猫王很像的人
ext.ext_en: ...an Elvis-soundalike.

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰克·西拉特拉的《轻松自在》的模仿版
ext.ext_en: ...a soundalike version of Frank Sinatra's 'Nice'N'Easy'.

defs.def_en: A soundalike is someone, especially a singer, whose voice resembles that of a famous person.
A bank's depositors are the people who have accounts with that bank.

ext.ext_cn: 我把车留在路侧停车带，徒步而行。
ext.ext_en: I left my car in a lay-by and set off on foot.

defs.def_en: A lay-by is a short strip of road by the side of a main road, where cars can stop for a while.
A laurel or a laurel tree is a small evergreen tree with shiny leaves. The leaves are sometimes used to make decorations such as wreaths.

ext.ext_cn: 委员会主席指责美国国家航空航天局成功登月之后便志得意满，不思进取。
ext.ext_en: The committee's chairman accused NASA of resting on its laurels after making it to the moon...

ext.ext_cn: 政府不能故步自封，必须继续大刀阔斧地推行政策改革。
ext.ext_en: The government can't rest on its laurels and must press ahead with major policy changes.

defs.def_en: If someone is resting on their laurels, they appear to be satisfied with the things they have achieved and have stopped putting effort into what they are doing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 幼稚的;简单容易的;小儿科的；毫无价值的

ext.ext_cn: 这可不是哪个选手都有机会上的烂场地。
ext.ext_en: This is not a Mickey Mouse course where every player has a chance...

ext.ext_cn: 1993年的版本一点儿也不简单。
ext.ext_en: There's nothing Mickey Mouse about the 1993 version...

defs.def_en: You use Mickey Mouse to show that you think something is silly, childish, easy, or worthless.

ext.ext_cn: 穿着高跟鞋的高个子女孩
ext.ext_en: ...a tall girl in high heels.

defs.def_en: You can refer to high-heeled shoes as high heels .

defs.def_cn: 中世纪的(指公元476年西罗马帝国灭亡至公元1500年左右这段时期)

ext.ext_cn: 中世纪城堡
ext.ext_en: ...a medieval castle.

ext.ext_cn: 中世纪编年史家
ext.ext_en: ...the medieval chroniclers.

defs.def_en: Something that is medieval relates to or was made in the period of European history between the end of the Roman Empire in 476 AD and about 1500 AD.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Her cheeks were puffy with crying.

ext.ext_cn: 眼圈发黑、眼泡肿起
ext.ext_en: ...dark-ringed puffy eyes.

defs.def_en: If a part of someone's body, especially their face, is puffy, it has a round, swollen appearance.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 大海一片蔚蓝，朵朵白云飘过。
ext.ext_en: The sea was blue, and white puffy clouds sailed by.

defs.def_en: If you describe a cloud as puffy, you mean that it looks like a large ball of white cotton wool. Puffy clouds appear during fine weather.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 值得赞扬的;应当认可的

ext.ext_cn: 他们上演了一场相当精彩的表演。
ext.ext_en: They turned out a quite creditable performance...

ext.ext_cn: 加扎以优异的成绩获得了三级荣誉学位。
ext.ext_en: Gazza finished a creditable third.

defs.def_en: A creditable  performance or achievement is of a reasonably high standard.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这种态度恐怕不怎么道德。
ext.ext_en: Not a very creditable attitude, I'm afraid.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's actions or aims as creditable, you mean that they are morally good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人、社交活动)令人愉快的，友好的

ext.ext_cn: 表演过后会在客厅举行气氛融洽的聚会。
ext.ext_en: Following the performances there were chummy gatherings in the drawing room.

defs.def_en: If people or social events are chummy, they are pleasant and friendly.

ext.ext_en: It's O.K. I smoothed things out.

defs.def_en: If you smooth out a problem or difficulty, you solve it, especially by talking to the people concerned.

defs.def_cn: (说话声、哭声)哽塞的，哽咽的，顿住的

ext.ext_en: In a strangled voice he said, 'This place is going to be unthinkable without you.'

ext.ext_cn: 苏震惊得哽咽起来。
ext.ext_en: Sue let out a strangled cry of shock.

defs.def_en: A strangled voice or cry sounds unclear because the throat muscles of the person speaking or crying are tight.

defs.def_cn: 令人生气的事;让人恼火的事

ext.ext_cn: 他说那个问题不是什么大问题。
ext.ext_en: He said the issue was not a major irritant.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as an irritant, you mean that it keeps annoying you.

defs.def_cn: (令身体部位发痒或疼痛的)刺激物

ext.ext_cn: 很多杀虫剂都具有刺激性。
ext.ext_en: Many pesticides are irritants.

defs.def_en: An irritant is a substance which causes a part of your body to itch or become sore.

ext.ext_cn: 在多数语言中，形容词的阳性和阴性的拼法略为不同。
ext.ext_en: In most languages adjectives have slightly different spellings for masculine and feminine...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们拼错了一个字，就会被要求去查字典。
ext.ext_en: If we got a spelling wrong we were forced to get a dictionary out.

defs.def_en: A spelling is the correct order of the letters in a word.

defs.def_cn: 正确拼写单词的能力;拼写

ext.ext_cn: 他的拼写能力很差。
ext.ext_en: His spelling is very bad...

ext.ext_cn: 阅读、写作、语法和拼写等基本技能
ext.ext_en: ...basic skills in reading, writing, grammar and spelling...

defs.def_en: Spelling is the ability to spell words in the correct way. It is also an attempt to spell a word in the correct way.
People sometimes refer to a woman as a slut when they consider her to be very immoral in her sexual behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 直接邮寄广告业在特卖品的包装方面已经变得非常熟练了。
ext.ext_en: The direct marketing industry has become adept at packaging special offers.

defs.def_en: Direct marketing is the same as direct mail .

defs.def_cn: 未付印的；未写下的；未成文

ext.ext_en: Universal have agreed to pay £2.5 million for Grisham's next, as yet unwritten, novel.

defs.def_en: Something such as a book that is unwritten has not been printed or written down.

ext.ext_cn: 他们都遵守着那条约束他们所有人的默认规则——要守口如瓶。
ext.ext_en: They obey the one unwritten rule that binds them all—no talking.

defs.def_en: An unwritten rule, law, or agreement is one that is understood and accepted by everyone, although it may not have been formally or officially established.

ext.ext_cn: 上个月，通货膨胀的压力继续减小。
ext.ext_en: Inflationary pressures continued to slacken last month...

ext.ext_cn: 保守党政府不会放慢激进改革的步伐。
ext.ext_en: The Conservative government will not slacken the pace of radical reform.

defs.def_en: If something slackens or if you slacken it, it becomes slower, less active, or less intense.

ext.ext_cn: 她紧握着阿诺德的手松开了。
ext.ext_en: Her grip slackened on Arnold's arm...

ext.ext_cn: 生孩子的时候，肌肉会拉抻、放松，然后松弛下来。
ext.ext_en: Muscles stretch, slacken and relax during childbirth.

defs.def_en: If your grip or a part of your body slackens or if you slacken your grip, it becomes looser or more relaxed.

ext.ext_cn: 有关他酗酒的报道极尽夸张。
ext.ext_en: Reports of his drinking have been wildly exaggerated...

ext.ext_cn: 岛上的宾馆千差万别。
ext.ext_en: The island's hotels vary wildly.

defs.def_en: See also:wild;You use wildly to emphasize the degree, amount, or intensity of something.

ext.ext_cn: 长满杂草的园子
ext.ext_en: ...a garden overgrown with weeds.

defs.def_en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and prevents the plants that you want from growing properly.

ext.ext_en: Large, clogging banks of weed are the only problem.

defs.def_en: Weed is a plant that grows in water and usually forms a thick floating mass. There are many different kinds of weed.

ext.ext_cn: 卡斯珀正在给花园除杂草。
ext.ext_en: Caspar was weeding the garden...

ext.ext_cn: 拔草和锄地时尽量不要踩到花坛。
ext.ext_en: Try not to walk on the flower beds when weeding or hoeing.

defs.def_en: If you weed an area, you remove the weeds from it.

ext.ext_cn: 两年半以前我改邪归正，不抽大麻了。
ext.ext_en: Two and a half years ago I gave up the evil weed.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to tobacco or marijuana as weed .

defs.def_cn: 豪华生活;骄奢淫逸的生活

ext.ext_en: ...the Hollywood high life...

ext.ext_cn: 多数大城市是做生意和吃喝玩乐的好地方，但并不适合举家去度假。
ext.ext_en: Most large cities are good for business and high life, but not for families on holiday.

defs.def_en: You use the high life to refer to an exciting and luxurious way of living that involves a great deal of entertainment, going to parties, and eating good food.

ext.ext_cn: 这些宣传报道可能会有损我们的竞选活动。
ext.ext_en: The publicity could detract from our election campaign.

defs.def_en: If one thing detracts from another, it makes it seem less good or impressive.
When there is a weigh-in on the day of a boxing match, each competitor is weighed to check their weight before the match.

ext.ext_cn: 一块光滑的巨型圆石露出水面
ext.ext_en: ...a huge round mass of smooth rock protruding from the water...

ext.ext_cn: 她的舌尖微微伸出。
ext.ext_en: The tip of her tongue was protruding slightly.

defs.def_en: If something protrudes from somewhere, it sticks out.

ext.ext_cn: 非洲丛林的动植物
ext.ext_en: ...the flora and fauna of the African jungle...

ext.ext_cn: 咸水水域通常只能存活为数不多的几种动物。
ext.ext_en: Brackish waters generally support only a small range of faunas.

defs.def_en: Animals, especially the animals in a particular area, can be referred to as fauna .

ext.ext_cn: 他们完全被洗脑了。
ext.ext_en: They have been completely indoctrinated...

ext.ext_cn: 我不认为她在竭力向我们灌输一种信仰。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't say that she was trying to indoctrinate us.

defs.def_en: If people are indoctrinated, they are taught a particular belief with the aim that they will reject other beliefs.

ext.ext_cn: 他对儿子所处困境的无情漠视
ext.ext_en: ...his callous indifference to the plight of his son.

ext.ext_cn: 对艾滋病传播的偏见与漠视
ext.ext_en: ...the prejudice and indifference which surround the Aids epidemic.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of indifference to something, you mean that they have a complete lack of interest in it.

ext.ext_cn: 东欧迅速成为放射性残渣的倾倒场。
ext.ext_en: Eastern Europe is rapidly becoming a dumping-ground for radioactive residues.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place is a dumping ground for something, usually something unwanted, you mean that people leave or send large quantities of that thing there.

defs.def_cn: （笑话结尾处的）包袱，妙语，笑点
defs.def_en: also punch line, punchline. The punchline of a joke or funny story is its last sentence or phrase, which gives it its humour.

ext.ext_cn: 结果取决于条件，还取决于事件的进展。
ext.ext_en: The outcome depends on conditions as well as how events unfold...

ext.ext_cn: 真相开始在他们面前显露出来。
ext.ext_en: The facts started to unfold before them.

defs.def_en: If a situation unfolds, it develops and becomes known or understood.

ext.ext_cn: 随着航行的开始，唐的故事也随之展开。
ext.ext_en: Don's story unfolded as the cruise got under way...

ext.ext_cn: 威尔斯先生喜形于色地讲述自己的经历。
ext.ext_en: Mr Wills unfolds his story with evident enjoyment.

defs.def_en: If a story unfolds or if someone unfolds it, it is told to someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 他迅速展开毯子，铺在床垫上。
ext.ext_en: He quickly unfolded the blankets and spread them on the mattress...

ext.ext_cn: 这种鸟起飞时，翼展可达6英尺，很惊人。
ext.ext_en: When the bird lifts off into flight, its wings unfold to an impressive six-foot span.

defs.def_en: If someone unfolds something which has been folded or if it unfolds, it is opened out and becomes flat.

A witch is a man or woman who claims to have magic powers and to be able to use them for good or bad purposes.
Wood pulp is wood that has been cut up into small pieces and crushed. Wood pulp is used to make paper.

ext.ext_cn: 极右派种族隔离主义者
ext.ext_en: ...a segregationist on the far Right...

ext.ext_cn: 亚拉巴马州可能已被法院依法强令终止其种族隔离政策。
ext.ext_en: Alabama may have been legally forced by the courts to kill off its segregationist policies.

defs.def_en: A segregationist is someone who thinks people of different races should be kept apart.
A butty is a sandwich.

ext.ext_cn: 我们对这些子虚乌有的谣言从何而来很感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: We're interested in the source of these fictitious rumours.

defs.def_en: Fictitious is used to describe something that is false or does not exist, although some people claim that it is true or exists.

ext.ext_cn: 这部作品中描述的人物和事件均属虚构。
ext.ext_en: The persons and events portrayed in this production are fictitious.

defs.def_en: A fictitious character, thing, or event occurs in a story, play, or film but never really existed or happened.
Coat-tails are the two long pieces at the back of a tailcoat .

ext.ext_cn: 他们指责他是沾了总统的光。
ext.ext_en: They accused him of riding on the coat-tails of the president.

defs.def_en: If you do something on the coat-tails of someone else, you are able to do it because of the other person's success, and not because of your own efforts.

ext.ext_cn: 皮尔西斜眼看了看她。
ext.ext_en: Piercey glanced sideways at her...

ext.ext_cn: 长筒袜的一侧抽丝了。
ext.ext_en: The ladder blew sideways...

defs.def_en: Sideways means from or towards the side of something or someone.

ext.ext_cn: 他会被平级调动而不是降级。
ext.ext_en: He would be moved sideways, rather than demoted.

ext.ext_cn: 她最近的平级调动
ext.ext_en: ...her recent sideways move.

defs.def_en: If you are moved sideways at work, you move to another job at the same level as your old job.

defs.def_cn: 使大为吃惊;使极为困惑;使大为不快

ext.ext_cn: 结果让他大为吃惊。
ext.ext_en: He was knocked sideways by the result...

ext.ext_cn: 一周前我遇到了我的前男友，这让我们俩都感到心烦意乱。
ext.ext_en: A week ago I met my ex-boyfriend and it knocked us both sideways.

defs.def_en: If you are knocked sideways by something, it makes you feel very surprised, confused, or upset.

defs.def_cn: 激动人心的;扣人心弦的

ext.ext_cn: 非常激动人心的演出
ext.ext_en: ...a high-octane performance.

defs.def_en: You can use high-octane to emphasize that something is very exciting or intense.

ext.ext_cn: 人的生命一定可以尽可能延长的假设
ext.ext_en: ...the presupposition that human life must be sustained for as long as possible.

defs.def_en: A presupposition is something that you assume to be true, especially something which you must assume is true in order to continue with what you are saying or thinking.

defs.def_cn: (用于 bullet，fire 等名词后构成形容词)表示“留下…伤痕的”,“被…损坏的”

ext.ext_cn: 弹痕累累的公共汽车
ext.ext_en: ...a bullet-scarred bus.

ext.ext_cn: 遭雷击的树
ext.ext_en: ...a lightning-scarred tree.

defs.def_en: -scarred is used after nouns such as 'bullet' and 'fire' to form adjectives which indicate that something has been damaged or marked by the thing mentioned.

defs.def_cn: (用于battle 或 drug 等名词后构成形容词)表示“留下…创伤的”

ext.ext_cn: 留下战争创伤的战士们
ext.ext_en: ...battle-scarred soldiers.

ext.ext_cn: 留下战争创伤的孤儿
ext.ext_en: ...a war-scarred orphan.

defs.def_en: -scarred is used after nouns such as 'battle' or 'drug' to form adjectives which indicate that the thing mentioned has had a permanent effect on someone's mind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (经历)给予惩戒的，使人警诫的

ext.ext_cn: 从这次惨痛的经历中他得到了一些有益的教训。
ext.ext_en: From this chastening experience he learnt some useful lessons.

defs.def_en: A chastening experience makes you regret that you have behaved badly or stupidly.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在月光下沿路散步。
ext.ext_en: They walked along the road in the moonlight...

ext.ext_cn: 我们去了亚特兰蒂斯神殿，在月光下游览了一番。
ext.ext_en: We went to the temple of Atlantis and saw it by moonlight.

defs.def_en: Moonlight is the light that comes from the moon at night.

defs.def_cn: 兼职,从事第二职业(尤指不为专职工作的老板和税收部门所知)

ext.ext_cn: 兼职开出租车的工程师
ext.ext_en: ...an engineer who was moonlighting as a taxi driver...

ext.ext_cn: 国有企业职工可以兼职。
ext.ext_en: Workers in state enterprises were permitted to moonlight.

defs.def_en: If someone moonlights, they have a second job in addition to their main job, often without informing their main employers or the tax  office.

defs.def_cn: 攀岩者;攀岩爱好者;攀岩运动员
defs.def_en: A rock climber is a person whose hobby or sport is climbing cliffs or large rocks.

defs.def_cn: 刀斧手，刽子手（指机构内执行大量裁员任务的人）

ext.ext_cn: 他们估计他是上司派来的刽子手，专门对工人大开杀戒，大肆镇压工会。
ext.ext_en: They reckoned he was a hatchet man, out to shred the workforce and crush the union.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone who makes changes in an organization by getting rid of lots of people as a hatchet man, especially if you think they do so in an unnecessarily harsh way.
A life raft is a small rubber boat carried on an aircraft or large boat which can be filled with air and used in an emergency.
An MPV is a large, tall car whose seats can be moved or removed, for example so that it can carry large loads. MPV is an abbreviation for (缩略 =) 'multi-purpose vehicle'.

ext.ext_cn: 在每年会发生几十次地震的国家建造核电站简直就是愚蠢至极。
ext.ext_en: It's sheer folly to build nuclear power stations in a country that has dozens of earthquakes every year.

ext.ext_cn: 提醒人们战争之愚蠢的东西
ext.ext_en: ...a reminder of the follies of war.

defs.def_en: If you say that a particular action or way of behaving is folly or a folly, you mean that it is foolish.

defs.def_cn: (尤指旧时英国花园等中的)装饰性建筑
defs.def_en: A folly is a small tower or other unusual building that is built as a decoration in a large garden or park, especially in Britain in former times.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 将土豆片烤15分钟，直至酥脆。
ext.ext_en: Bake the potatoes for 15 minutes, till they're nice and crisp.

ext.ext_cn: 脆熏肉
ext.ext_en: ...crisp bacon.

defs.def_en: Food that is crisp is pleasantly hard, or has a pleasantly hard surface.

ext.ext_cn: 把熏肉烹至酥脆。
ext.ext_en: Cook the bacon until it begins to crisp...

ext.ext_cn: 把面包屑撒在干燥的烤盘上，然后放在烤箱里烤脆。
ext.ext_en: Spread breadcrumbs on a dry baking sheet and crisp them in the oven.

defs.def_en: If food crisps or if you crisp it, it becomes pleasantly hard, for example because you have heated it at a high temperature.

defs.def_cn: (当零食吃的)油炸土豆片，炸薯片

ext.ext_cn: 一袋炸薯片
ext.ext_en: ...a packet of crisps.

ext.ext_cn: 奶酪和洋葱味炸薯片
ext.ext_en: ...cheese and onion potato crisps.

defs.def_en: Crisps are very thin slices of fried potato that are eaten cold as a snack.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 秋高气爽的一天
ext.ext_en: ...a crisp autumn day.

defs.def_en: Weather that is pleasantly fresh, cold, and dry can be described as crisp .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他戴着一顶巴拿马草帽，穿着一身挺括的白西装。
ext.ext_en: He wore a panama hat and a crisp white suit...

ext.ext_cn: 我钻到崭新洁净的被单底下。
ext.ext_en: I slipped between the crisp clean sheets.

defs.def_en: Crisp cloth or paper is clean and has no creases in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (树叶或雪)发出脆响的，咯吱作响的

ext.ext_cn: 踩上去发出脆响的秋叶
ext.ext_en: ...crisp autumn leaves...

ext.ext_cn: 他咯吱咯吱地踏雪行进着。
ext.ext_en: He crunched through the crisp snow.

defs.def_en: Leaves or snow that make a loud noise when you walk on them can be described as crisp .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (写作或讲话)简短干脆的(可能显得不友好)

ext.ext_cn: “很好，”我用干脆的命令性的语气说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Very well,' I said, adopting a crisp authoritative tone.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's writing or speech as crisp, you mean they write or speak very clearly, without mentioning unnecessary details. This may make them seem unfriendly.
If something is burnt to a crisp, it is completely burnt.

ext.ext_cn: 其他国家的纸币色彩不一，大小也不同。
ext.ext_en: Other countries vary the coloring of their bank notes as well as their size.

ext.ext_cn: 景色逐渐褪去鲜艳的色彩。
ext.ext_en: ...the scenery was losing its bright colouring.

defs.def_en: The colouring of something is the colour or colours that it is.

ext.ext_cn: 他们都不像父亲那样黑。
ext.ext_en: None of them had their father's dark colouring...

ext.ext_cn: 选择与你本身的肤色相衬的颜色。
ext.ext_en: Choose shades which tone in with your natural colouring.

defs.def_en: Someone's colouring is the colour of their hair, skin, and eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 加了几滴绿色的食物色素。
ext.ext_en: A few drops of green food coloring were added.

defs.def_en: Colouring is a substance that is used to give colour to food.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （会议、会面、活动等）未组织的，未作详细安排的

ext.ext_cn: 我们的目的是，这些会议不事先进行精心组织，要随意一些。
ext.ext_en: Our aim was that these meetings be unstructured and informal...

ext.ext_cn: 和多数研讨会一样，这些研讨会也比较松散随意。
ext.ext_en: As seminars go, these are loose, unstructured affairs.

defs.def_en: Something such as a meeting, interview, or activity that is unstructured is not organized in a complete or detailed way.

ext.ext_cn: 虐待动物的现象依然很普遍。
ext.ext_en: Ill-treatment of animals remains commonplace...

ext.ext_cn: 受害人或者被虐待致死,或者致残。
ext.ext_en: The victims had either died as a result of their ill-treatment or had been left crippled.

defs.def_en: Ill-treatment is harsh or cruel treatment.

ext.ext_cn: 该市最大的零售商店
ext.ext_en: ...the largest retail outlet in the city.

defs.def_en: An outlet is a shop or organization which sells the goods made by a particular manufacturer.

defs.def_cn: 廉价商品经销店；折扣店

ext.ext_cn: 位于贝尔蒙特的厂家直销型折扣店
ext.ext_en: ...the factory outlet store in Belmont.

defs.def_en: An outlet or an outlet store is a place which sells slightly damaged or outdated goods from a particular manufacturer, or goods that it made in greater quantities than needed.

defs.def_cn: （情感的）发泄途径；（思想的）表达方式

ext.ext_cn: 她父亲在工作中找到了施展抱负的机会。
ext.ext_en: Her father had found an outlet for his ambition in his work.

defs.def_en: If someone has an outlet for their feelings or ideas, they have a means of expressing and releasing them.

ext.ext_cn: 热气出口
ext.ext_en: ...a warm air outlet.

ext.ext_cn: 排污入海的水下管道
ext.ext_en: ...an underwater outlet pipe discharging waste into the sea.

defs.def_en: An outlet is a hole or pipe through which liquid or air can flow away.
An outlet is a place, usually in a wall, where you can connect electrical devices to the electricity supply.

ext.ext_cn: 我去烧壶水给大家沏茶。
ext.ext_en: I'll put the kettle on and make us some tea.

ext.ext_cn: 在洋葱上倒一壶开水。
ext.ext_en: Pour a kettle of boiling water over the onions.

defs.def_en: A kettle is a covered container that you use for boiling water. It has a handle, and a spout for the water to come out of.

ext.ext_cn: 把肉放进一个小锅里。
ext.ext_en: Put the meat into a small kettle.

defs.def_en: A kettle is a metal pot for boiling or cooking things in.

ext.ext_cn: 作为替补参加比赛完全是两码事。
ext.ext_en: Playing for the reserve team is a totally different kettle of fish.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a different kettle of fish, you mean that it is very different from another related thing that you are talking about.
A leech is a small animal which looks like a worm and lives in water. Leeches feed by attaching themselves to other animals and sucking their blood.

ext.ext_cn: 他们只不过是一帮伸手向人要这要那的寄生虫！
ext.ext_en: They're just a bunch of leeches cadging off others!

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a leech, you disapprove of them because they deliberately depend on other people, often making money out of them.
A comic strip is a series of drawings that tell a story, especially in a newspaper or magazine.

defs.def_cn: （小船的发动机）舷外的，尾挂的
defs.def_en: An outboard motor is one that you can fix to the back of a small boat.
An odometer is a device in a vehicle which shows how far the vehicle has travelled.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 未来派的;极其前卫现代的

ext.ext_cn: 这家剧院是钢筋和玻璃结构的未来派建筑。
ext.ext_en: The theatre is a futuristic steel and glass structure.

ext.ext_cn: 超前设计的汽车
ext.ext_en: ...futuristic cars.

defs.def_en: Something that is futuristic looks or seems very modern and unusual, like something from the future.

ext.ext_cn: 轰动一时的幻想片《终结者 2》
ext.ext_en: ...the futuristic hit film, 'Terminator 2'.

defs.def_en: A futuristic film or book tells a story that is set in the future, when things are different.

ext.ext_cn: 对我尊重点，你这个小混蛋!
ext.ext_en: Have some respect for me, you scamp!

ext.ext_cn: 厚脸皮的小淘气鬼
ext.ext_en: ...cheeky young scamps.

defs.def_en: If you call a boy a scamp, you mean that he is naughty or disrespectful but you like him, so you find it difficult to be angry with him.

ext.ext_cn: 哇，好烫啊！
ext.ext_en: Gee, it's hot...

ext.ext_cn: 啊，谢谢你，斯坦！
ext.ext_en: Gee thanks, Stan.

defs.def_en: People sometimes say gee to emphasize a reaction or remark.

ext.ext_cn: 他闯进了老人的房子，用铁锤猛击老人。
ext.ext_en: He broke into the old man's house and bludgeoned him with a hammer...

ext.ext_cn: 一位富商被发现死于重物连续猛击。
ext.ext_en: A wealthy businessman has been found bludgeoned to death.

defs.def_en: To bludgeon someone means to hit them several times with a heavy object.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的方法就是迫使你屈服。
ext.ext_en: Their approach simply bludgeons you into submission...

ext.ext_cn: 他咄咄逼人地强迫你了解他的看法。
ext.ext_en: His relentless aggression bludgeons you into seeing his point.

defs.def_en: If someone bludgeons you into doing something, they make you do it by behaving aggressively.

ext.ext_cn: 一些美术馆把捐赠者的姓名镌刻在墙上以示纪念。
ext.ext_en: Some galleries commemorate donors by inscribing their names on the walls...

ext.ext_cn: 她和马克读了刻在纪念碑内墙上的文字。
ext.ext_en: She and Mark read the words inscribed on the inner walls of the monument.

defs.def_en: If you inscribe words on an object, you write or carve the words on the object.

ext.ext_cn: 在背后我题写了这样的话：“愿奇思妙想不绝！约翰”。
ext.ext_en: On the back I had inscribed the words: 'Here's to Great Ideas! John'...

ext.ext_cn: 书的题赠是：献给约翰·阿洛特——劳丽·李。
ext.ext_en: The book is inscribed: To John Arlott from Laurie Lee.

defs.def_en: If you inscribe something in the front of a book or on a photograph, you write it there, often before giving it to someone.
The cornea is the transparent skin covering the outside of your eye.

defs.def_cn: 布置;为(房间或建筑物)配备家具陈设

ext.ext_cn: 许多经营者都想用古董装饰他们的酒店。
ext.ext_en: Many proprietors try to furnish their hotels with antiques.

defs.def_en: If you furnish a room or building, you put furniture and furnishings into it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们将可向你提供其余的细节。
ext.ext_en: They'll be able to furnish you with the rest of the details.

defs.def_en: If you furnish someone with something, you provide or supply it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 又高又瘦、长相一般的男人
ext.ext_en: ...a tall, lean man, with an unremarkable face.

ext.ext_cn: 北威尔士一个极其普通的小镇
ext.ext_en: ...a rather unremarkable town in North Wales.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as unremarkable, you mean that they are very ordinary, without many exciting, original, or attractive qualities.

ext.ext_cn: 大家的反应是感到困惑，这一点情有可原。
ext.ext_en: The general response was one of understandable bafflement.

defs.def_en: Bafflement is the state of being baffled.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 未被告知（或通知）的；知识（或信息）贫乏的

ext.ext_cn: 他不能抱怨说没人告诉他该政权的实质。
ext.ext_en: He could not complain that he was uninformed about the true nature of the regime...

ext.ext_cn: 虐待儿童案件常常没人举报，或者为缺乏相关知识的公民所忽略。
ext.ext_en: Cases of child abuse often go unreported or ignored by uninformed citizens.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as uninformed, you mean that they have very little knowledge or information about a particular situation or subject.

ext.ext_cn: 辛普森不择手段的勃勃野心和自抬身价的毛病使他没能成为英国广播公司最受欢迎的记者。
ext.ext_en: Simpson's ruthless ambition and weakness for self-promotion has not made him the most popular journalist in the BBC.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of self-promotion, you disapprove of them because they are trying to make themselves seem more important than they actually are.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他严肃的小脸蛋上突然绽放出笑容。
ext.ext_en: His solemn little face broke into smiles...

ext.ext_cn: 他看上去很严肃。
ext.ext_en: He looked solemn.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is solemn is very serious rather than cheerful or humorous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他永远不再结婚的郑重承诺
ext.ext_en: ...a solemn pledge that he would never remarry.

defs.def_en: A solemn promise or agreement is one that you make in a very formal, sincere way.

ext.ext_cn: 男孩的尸体从德国运回后，他的母亲一直靠服药保持镇静。
ext.ext_en: His mother was under sedation after the boy's body was brought back from Germany.

defs.def_en: If someone is under sedation, they have been given medicine or drugs in order to calm them or make them sleep.
A shepherd is a person, especially a man, whose job is to look after sheep.

ext.ext_cn: 她在警卫的护送下上了飞机尾部的舷梯。
ext.ext_en: She was shepherded by her guards up the rear ramp of the aircraft.

defs.def_en: If you are shepherded somewhere, someone takes you there to make sure that you arrive at the right place safely.

ext.ext_cn: 海洋里死亡的许多生物会很快被沉淀物掩埋。
ext.ext_en: Many organisms that die in the sea are soon buried by sediment.

ext.ext_cn: 海洋沉淀物
ext.ext_en: ...ocean sediments.

defs.def_en: Sediment is solid material that settles at the bottom of a liquid, especially earth and pieces of rock that have been carried along and then left somewhere by water, ice, or wind.

defs.def_cn: (医院的)陈尸所，停尸房，太平间
defs.def_en: A mortuary is a building or a room in a hospital where dead bodies are kept before they are buried or cremated, or before they are identified or examined.
A mortuary is the same as a funeral home .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 狡猾的;狡诈的;不老实的

ext.ext_cn: 他有点儿不老实。
ext.ext_en: He was a bit of a dodgy character.

ext.ext_cn: 从不正当的黑道交易中赚得的钱
ext.ext_en: ...cash made in dodgy underworld deals.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as dodgy, you disapprove of them because they seem rather dishonest and unreliable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 冒险的;危险的;不可靠的

ext.ext_cn: 根据对经济的预测来预言选举的走势不大可靠。
ext.ext_en: Predicting voting trends from economic forecasts is a dodgy business.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is dodgy, you mean that it seems rather risky, dangerous, or unreliable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不太健康的;不太强壮的

ext.ext_cn: 我的心脏有点儿小毛病。
ext.ext_en: My heart's a bit dodgy.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a dodgy heart or knee, for example, you mean that that part of their body is not very strong or healthy.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我告诉某人我不会辜负他的信任，我就会恪守诺言。
ext.ext_en: When I tell someone I will not betray his confidence I keep my word...

ext.ext_cn: 总统背叛了他们，违背了不加税的诺言。
ext.ext_en: The President betrayed them when he went back on his promise not to raise taxes.

defs.def_en: If you betray someone who loves or trusts you, your actions hurt and disappoint them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们提出来只要我供出同伙就给我钱。
ext.ext_en: They offered me money if I would betray my associates...

ext.ext_cn: 这帮人是告密者，他们把计划泄露给了德国人。
ext.ext_en: The group were informers, and they betrayed the plan to the Germans.

defs.def_en: If someone betrays their country or their friends, they give information to an enemy, putting their country's  security or their friends' safety at risk.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们支持死刑，那就背弃了我们立国的理念。
ext.ext_en: We betray the ideals of our country when we support capital punishment.

defs.def_en: If you betray an ideal or your principles, you say or do something which goes against those beliefs.
