defs.def_en: Exchange is used in the names of some places where people used to trade and do business with each other.
The exchange is the same as the telephone exchange .

ext.ext_cn: 公务员通过索要礼物或钱财作为为他人提供便利的交换是违法的。
ext.ext_en: It is illegal for public officials to solicit gifts or money in exchange for favors...

ext.ext_cn: 他给她支付了很高的薪水，作为交换，他确定能够得到她的选票。
ext.ext_en: He paid her a huge salary. In exchange, he was assured of her vote.

defs.def_en: If you do or give something in exchange for something else, you do it or give it in order to get that thing.

defs.def_cn: 相反的;对立的;不相容的

ext.ext_cn: 他们心中的当务之急和环保人士的想法背道而驰。
ext.ext_en: Their priorities are antithetical to those of environmentalists.

defs.def_en: Something that is antithetical to something else is the opposite of it and is unable to exist with it.
A golf club is a long, thin, metal stick with a piece of wood or metal at one end that you use to hit the ball in golf.
A golf club is a social organization which provides a golf course and a building to meet in for its members.

defs.def_cn: （介乎两种事物之间的）边缘地带，所属不清的状态

ext.ext_cn: 处于半睡半醒之间
ext.ext_en: ...on the borderland between sleep and waking.

defs.def_en: The borderland between two things is an area which contains features from both of these things so that it is not possible to say that it belongs to one or the other.

ext.ext_cn: 黎巴嫩的南部边境地区
ext.ext_en: ...Lebanon's southern borderlands.

defs.def_en: The area of land close to the border between two countries or major areas can be called the borderlands .

ext.ext_cn: 他放弃了按部就班的政治工作，不再参与公众事务。
ext.ext_en: He gave up on programmatic politics and turned his back on public life.

defs.def_en: Programmatic ideas or policies follow a particular programme.

ext.ext_cn: 算出那些比率的平均值再乘以100。
ext.ext_en: Take the average of those ratios and multiply by a hundred.

ext.ext_cn: 商品平均价格只上涨了2.2％。
ext.ext_en: The average price of goods rose by just 2.2%...

defs.def_en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

ext.ext_cn: 售出一幢房子平均需要10周的时间。
ext.ext_en: It takes an average of ten weeks for a house sale to be completed.

defs.def_en: You use average to refer to a number or size that varies but is always approximately the same.

ext.ext_cn: 普通成年男子每天消耗的热量为1,500到2,000卡路里。
ext.ext_en: The average adult man burns 1,500 to 2,000 calories per day...

ext.ext_cn: 英国垃圾桶里平均约有1/3是产品包装。
ext.ext_en: Packaging is about a third of what is found in an average British dustbin.

defs.def_en: An average person or thing is typical or normal.

ext.ext_cn: 大部分地区降雨超过通常水平，北爱尔兰地区本月的降水量则为平均值的两倍。
ext.ext_en: Most areas suffered more rain than usual, with Northern Ireland getting double the average for the month.

ext.ext_cn: 一杯啤酒价格通常为2.2英镑。
ext.ext_en: £2.20 for a beer is average.

defs.def_en: An amount or quality that is the average is the normal amount or quality for a particular group of things or people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我的学习成绩一般。
ext.ext_en: I was only average academically.

defs.def_en: Something that is average is neither very good nor very bad, usually when you had hoped it would be better.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的平均时速是每小时42英里。
ext.ext_en: We averaged 42 miles per hour.

ext.ext_cn: 9.75％的工资平均增长幅度
ext.ext_en: ...pay increases averaging 9.75%.

defs.def_en: To average a particular amount means to do, get, or produce that amount as an average over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 美国股票价格平均上涨了38％。
ext.ext_en: American shares rose, on average, by 38%...

ext.ext_cn: 平均下来，我们每天要花费300英镑。
ext.ext_en: On an average we would be spending £300 per day.

defs.def_en: You say on average or on an average to indicate that a number is the average of several numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 总体来讲，美国公司在全球范围内还是产值最高。
ext.ext_en: On average, American firms remain the most productive in the world.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is true on average, you mean that it is generally true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一个爱管闲事的公众人士
ext.ext_en: ...a meddlesome member of the public.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as meddlesome, you are criticizing them because they try to influence or change things that do not concern them.

defs.def_cn: 红色警报;红色预警;紧急状态

ext.ext_cn: 普利茅斯所有的医院都处于紧急状态之中。
ext.ext_en: All the Plymouth hospitals are on red alert...

ext.ext_cn: 警报声宣告了红色预警的结束。
ext.ext_en: Sirens sounded an end to the red alert.

defs.def_en: If a hospital, a police force, or a military force is on red alert, they have been warned that there may be an emergency, so they can be ready to deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 法官的裁决是最终裁决，再写信也不会予以审议。
ext.ext_en: The judges' decision is final and no correspondence will be entered into...

ext.ext_cn: 与一位大学密友的长期通信培养了他写作的兴趣。
ext.ext_en: His interest in writing came from a long correspondence with a close college friend.

defs.def_en: Correspondence is the act of writing letters to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 来信他总是会回。
ext.ext_en: He always replied to his correspondence...

ext.ext_cn: 她在书信和笔记中几乎从不提及他。
ext.ext_en: She virtually never mentions him in her correspondence or notebooks.

defs.def_en: Some-one's correspondence is the letters that they receive or send.

ext.ext_cn: 非洲语言中的发音与字母关系密切。
ext.ext_en: In African languages there is a close correspondence between sounds and letters.

ext.ext_cn: 东方宗教与基督教的关联
ext.ext_en: ...correspondences between Eastern religions and Christianity.

defs.def_en: If there is a correspondence between two things, there is a close similarity or connection between them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 眼尖的;目光敏锐的;观察入微的

ext.ext_cn: 一个眼尖的售货员发现了假货。
ext.ext_en: A sharp-eyed shop assistant spotted the fake.

defs.def_en: A sharp-eyed person is good at noticing and observing things.

ext.ext_cn: 护照里面有张折起的纸片。
ext.ext_en: Inside the passport was a folded slip of paper...

ext.ext_cn: 门厅内有部电话。
ext.ext_en: There is a telephone inside the entrance hall.

defs.def_en: Something or someone that is inside a place, container, or object is in it or is surrounded by it.

ext.ext_cn: 门从里面锁上了。
ext.ext_en: The doors were locked from the inside...

ext.ext_cn: 我粉刷了一遍房子内部。
ext.ext_en: I painted the inside of the house...

defs.def_en: The inside of something is the part or area that its sides surround or contain.

ext.ext_cn: 他进过三次监狱。
ext.ext_en: He's been inside three times.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone is inside when they are in prison.

defs.def_cn: (马路车道)靠近路边的，慢(道)的

ext.ext_cn: 我在高速公路的慢道上以每小时 70 英里的速度行驶。
ext.ext_en: I was driving up at seventy miles an hour on the inside lane on the motorway.

ext.ext_cn: 我从慢车道上超了查利。
ext.ext_en: I overtook Charlie on the inside.

defs.def_en: On a wide road, the inside lane is the one which is closest to the edge of the road.

ext.ext_cn: 斯隆利用外交内幕消息发了财。
ext.ext_en: Sloane used inside diplomatic information to make himself rich...

ext.ext_cn: 编辑基思·瓦斯否认他知道内部消息。
ext.ext_en: Keith Vass, editor, denies he had inside knowledge...

defs.def_en: Inside information is obtained from someone who is involved in a situation and therefore knows a lot about it.

ext.ext_cn: 75% 的行政总裁来自公司内部。
ext.ext_en: 75 percent of chief executives come from inside the company...

ext.ext_cn: 他没有认真研究执政党内部正在发生什么。
ext.ext_en: He hasn't looked very carefully into what was happening inside the ruling party.

defs.def_en: If you are inside an organization, you belong to it.
Your insides are your internal organs, especially your stomach.

ext.ext_cn: 整颗心都空了——没有语言,没有愤怒,没有眼泪。
ext.ext_en: There is nothing left inside—no words, no anger, no tears...

ext.ext_cn: 当你写下喜欢的文字时,内心会有一种特别的情感吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you get a feeling inside when you write something you like?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a feeling inside, you mean that they have it but have not expressed it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们应该会在一个小时之内使一切运转起来。
ext.ext_en: They should have everything working inside an hour...

ext.ext_cn: 新西兰队领先了不到 5 分钟。
ext.ext_en: New Zealand were ahead inside five minutes.

defs.def_en: If you do something inside a particular time, you do it before the end of that time.

ext.ext_cn: 她的伞被风吹得翻转了。
ext.ext_en: Her umbrella blew inside out.

defs.def_en: If something such as a piece of clothing is inside out, the part that is normally inside now faces outwards.

ext.ext_cn: 他对比赛非常熟悉。
ext.ext_en: He knew the game inside out...

ext.ext_cn: 我们对彼此都了如指掌。
ext.ext_en: We know each other inside out.

defs.def_en: If you say that you know something or someone inside out, you are emphasizing that you know them extremely well.

ext.ext_cn: 爱丁堡与美国城市相反：富人住在中心,穷人住在周边。
ext.ext_en: Edinburgh is an American city turned inside out: the rich in the middle, the poor around the outside...

ext.ext_cn: 战争颠倒是非：杀戮与残忍成了美德。
ext.ext_en: War turns morality inside out: killing and cruelty are virtues.

defs.def_en: If you say that something has been turned inside out, you mean that it is the opposite of what you expect or think it should be.

defs.def_cn: 该死的;可恶的;讨厌的;糟糕的

ext.ext_cn: 我们这的气候真是糟糕透顶！
ext.ext_en: What a damnable climate we have!

ext.ext_cn: 这项强奸指控完全是卑劣的谎言。
ext.ext_en: The charge of rape was a damnable lie.

defs.def_en: You use damnable to emphasize that you dislike or disapprove of something a great deal.

defs.def_cn: (尤指大型建筑物的)正面，临街的一面
defs.def_en: The facade of a building, especially a large one, is its front wall or the wall that faces the street.

ext.ext_cn: 他们将困扰婚姻的问题掩藏在家庭和睦的外表之下。
ext.ext_en: They hid the troubles plaguing their marriage behind a facade of family togetherness.

defs.def_en: A facade is an outward appearance which is deliberately false and gives you a wrong impression about someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 这3个儿子也为家族事业做出了贡献。
ext.ext_en: The three sons also contribute to the family business...

ext.ext_cn: 我相信我们每一个人都能够对世界的未来有所贡献。
ext.ext_en: I believe that each of us can contribute to the future of the world...

defs.def_en: If you contribute to something, you say or do things to help to make it successful.

ext.ext_cn: 美国将提供40亿美元的信贷和赠款。
ext.ext_en: The US is contributing $4 billion in loans, credits and grants...

ext.ext_cn: 他们说他们很想捐献更多的钱支持慈善事业，但是今年的钱非常紧张。
ext.ext_en: They say they would like to contribute more to charity, but money is tight this year...

defs.def_en: To contribute money or resources to something means to give money or resources to help pay for something or to help achieve a particular purpose.

defs.def_cn: 促成;促使；是导致…的原因之一

ext.ext_cn: 报告说两艘船存在的设计缺陷也促成了这场悲剧的发生。
ext.ext_en: The report says design faults in both the vessels contributed to the tragedy...

ext.ext_cn: 来自人的和机械方面的压力可能也是一个因素。
ext.ext_en: Stress, both human and mechanical, may also be a contributing factor.

defs.def_en: If something contributes to an event or situation, it is one of the causes of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我受邀为报纸撰写一篇文章，对新的一年进行预测。
ext.ext_en: I was asked to contribute to a newspaper article making predictions for the new year...

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。
ext.ext_en: Frank Deford is a contributing editor for Vanity Fair magazine.

defs.def_en: If you contribute to a magazine, newspaper, or book, you write things that are published in it.
Canaries are small yellow birds which sing beautifully and are often kept as pets.

ext.ext_cn: 旧金山海湾地区地铁捷运系统
ext.ext_en: ...the Bay Area Rapid Transit subway system...

ext.ext_cn: 我深夜不坐地铁。
ext.ext_en: I don't ride the subway late at night.

defs.def_en: A subway is an underground railway.

defs.def_cn: (穿越马路、铁路的)地下通道，地下人行道

ext.ext_cn: 大多数人在走地下通道时都感到害怕。
ext.ext_en: The majority of us feel worried if we walk through a subway.

defs.def_en: A subway is a passage underneath a busy road or a railway track for people to walk through.

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司的雇员期待着发放大笔奖金。
ext.ext_en: The firm's employees were expecting large bonuses.

ext.ext_cn: 供暖工程公司
ext.ext_en: ...a firm of heating engineers.

defs.def_en: A firm is an organization which sells or produces something or which provides a service which people pay for.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 水果应该硬实完好。
ext.ext_en: Fruit should be firm and in excellent condition...

ext.ext_cn: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。
ext.ext_en: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.

defs.def_en: If something is firm, it does not change much in shape when it is pressed but is not completely hard.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如果非要爬上去，就踩在一个稳固的台子上或者找把结实的梯子。
ext.ext_en: If you have to climb up, use a firm platform or a sturdy ladder.

defs.def_en: If something is firm, it does not shake or move when you put weight or pressure on it, because it is strongly made or securely fastened.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (抓握或动作)强有力的，使上劲的

ext.ext_cn: 短暂的握手有力沉稳。
ext.ext_en: The quick handshake was firm and cool...

ext.ext_cn: 他设法牢牢抓住了那个金属物，把整个身子往上提。
ext.ext_en: He managed to grasp the metal, get a firm grip of it and heave his body upwards.

defs.def_en: If someone's grip is firm or if they perform a physical action in a firm way, they do it with quite a lot of force or pressure but also in a controlled way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她不得不对他狠下心来：“我不想再见到你。”
ext.ext_en: She had to be firm with him. 'I don't want to see you again.'...

ext.ext_cn: 也许他们需要一个父亲般严格的指引者。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps they need the guiding hand of a firm father figure.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as firm, you mean they behave in a way that shows that they are not going to change their mind, or that they are the person who is in control.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (决定或意见)确定的,不会更改的

ext.ext_cn: 他打定主意乘船离开穆尔特里堡。
ext.ext_en: He made a firm decision to leave Fort Multry by boat...

ext.ext_cn: 我坚信警民之间进行有效合作是绝对必要的。
ext.ext_en: It is my firm belief that an effective partnership approach between police and the public is absolutely necessary.

defs.def_en: A firm decision or opinion is definite and unlikely to change.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (证据或信息)确切的，确实的，确凿的

ext.ext_cn: 这名男子可能还杀害过其他人，只可惜我们没有确凿的证据。
ext.ext_en: This man may have killed others but unfortunately we have no firm evidence...

ext.ext_cn: 一段时间内都不大可能会有关于车队行进情况的确切消息。
ext.ext_en: There's unlikely to be firm news about the convoy's progress for some time.

defs.def_en: Firm evidence or information is based on facts and so is likely to be true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (控制、基础、位置等)坚实的，不可动摇的

ext.ext_cn: 尽管雅库特人是少数民族，但他们却牢牢地掌控着这块版图。
ext.ext_en: Although the Yakutians are a minority, they have firm control of the territory...

ext.ext_cn: 这家美国国内家喻户晓的公司在英国市场上站稳了脚跟。
ext.ext_en: The company, a household name in the States, has a firm foothold in the British market.

defs.def_en: You use firm to describe control or a basis or position when it is strong and unlikely to be ended or removed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这对夫妇大约两年前相遇，很快就成了知交。
ext.ext_en: The couple met about two years ago and soon became firm friends.

defs.def_en: If people are firm friends, they have been close friends for a long time and their friendship is likely to continue.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (价格、价值、货币等)坚挺的，稳定的，居高不下的

ext.ext_cn: 棉花价格始终保持坚挺，需求旺盛。
ext.ext_en: Cotton prices remain firm and demand is strong...

ext.ext_cn: 股价稳稳地维持在280便士。
ext.ext_en: The shares held firm at 280p...

defs.def_en: If a price, value, or currency is firm, it is not decreasing in value or amount.

ext.ext_cn: 在根上再多培些土，用水浇透。
ext.ext_en: Firm more soil over the roots and water thoroughly.

defs.def_en: If you firm soil around a plant, you press it so that it is fairly solid rather than loose.

defs.def_cn: 坚定不移;坚持己见;拒不让步

ext.ext_cn: 委员会面对接二连三的抗议拒不让步。
ext.ext_en: The council is standing firm against the barrage of protest...

ext.ext_cn: 总统已经呼吁其欧洲伙伴在此问题上站稳立场。
ext.ext_en: The President has appealed to his European partners to stand firm on the issue.

defs.def_en: If someone stands firm, they refuse to change their mind about something.

defs.def_cn: (使)更坚固;(使)更坚硬;(使)更结实

ext.ext_cn: 该治疗有助于强身健体、紧致皮肤。
ext.ext_en: This treatment helps tone the body, firm up muscles and tighten the skin...

ext.ext_cn: 我现在每周游5次泳，这对强身健体很有益处。
ext.ext_en: I now go swimming five times a week, which helps firm me up...

defs.def_en: If you firm up something or if it firms up, it becomes firmer and more solid.

ext.ext_cn: 展望未来，政府将更加明确其计划，建设一个更清洁、更环保、更安全的英国。
ext.ext_en: Looking to the future, the Government will firm up their plans for a cleaner, greener, safer Britain...

ext.ext_cn: 基本原则已得到进一步强化。
ext.ext_en: The ground rules have been firmed up...

defs.def_en: If you firm something up or if it firms up, it becomes clearer, stronger, or more definite.

defs.def_cn: 使(价格、价值等)保持坚挺(或稳定)

ext.ext_cn: 石油输出国组织已同意对全球石油生产稍加冻结，以稳定原油价格。
ext.ext_en: OPEC has agreed to freeze its global oil production slightly in order to firm up crude prices.

defs.def_en: If a financial institution firms up the price or value of something, they take action to protect and maintain its price or value.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 已开发出许多可渗水透气的产品。
ext.ext_en: A number of products have been developed which are permeable to air and water.

defs.def_en: If a substance is permeable, something such as water or gas can pass through it or soak into it.

ext.ext_cn: 芝加哥的多语种人口
ext.ext_en: ...Chicago's polyglot population.

defs.def_en: Polyglot is used to describe something such as a book or society in which several different languages are used.

ext.ext_cn: 能说四门语言的人
ext.ext_en: ...a polyglot who speaks four languages.

defs.def_en: A polyglot is a person who speaks or understands many languages.
Tomatoes are small, soft, red fruit that you can eat raw in salads or cooked as a vegetable.

ext.ext_cn: 印度有 15 种官方语言。
ext.ext_en: In India, there are fifteen official languages.

defs.def_en: Fifteen is the number 15.
A rugby-union team can be referred to as a fifteen .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 多果肉的；多汁的；浆状的；软糊状的

ext.ext_cn: 酸辣酱应该是浓稠的软糊状。
ext.ext_en: The chutney should be a thick, pulpy consistency.

defs.def_en: Something that is pulpy is soft, smooth, and wet, often because it has been crushed or beaten.

ext.ext_cn: 与对他声誉造成的损伤相比,这一代价就变得微不足道了。
ext.ext_en: The cost pales into insignificance when compared with the damage done to his reputation...

ext.ext_cn: 该事件被认为根本无足轻重，以至于没有一家大报纸发文报道。
ext.ext_en: The event was regarded as of such insignificance that not one major newspaper carried a report.

defs.def_en: Insignificance is the quality of being insignificant.

defs.def_cn: （未经索取便寄来的）邮寄广告宣传品，垃圾邮件
defs.def_en: Junk mail is advertisements and publicity materials that you receive through the post or by e-mail which you have not asked for and which you do not want.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 勇于冒险的；敢于创新的；新奇的

ext.ext_cn: 沃伦是个敢于冒险的商人。
ext.ext_en: Warren was an adventurous businessman...

ext.ext_cn: 菜单本可以做得更有新意。
ext.ext_en: The menu could have been more adventurous.

defs.def_en: Someone who is adventurous is willing to take risks and to try new methods. Something that is adventurous involves new things or ideas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他一直想到热带地区过冒险的生活。
ext.ext_en: He had always wanted an adventurous life in the tropics.

defs.def_en: Someone who is adventurous is eager to visit new places and have new experiences.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 感情脆弱的;多愁善感的;感伤的

ext.ext_cn: 他总是卿卿我我地跟女朋友煲电话粥。
ext.ext_en: He's constantly on the phone to his girlfriend being soppy...

ext.ext_cn: 她喜欢伤感的爱情故事、老电影以及诸如此类的东西。
ext.ext_en: She loves soppy love stories, old films, that sort of thing.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as soppy, you mean that they are foolishly sentimental.

defs.def_cn: (事故、灾难或战争中的）死亡人数
defs.def_en: The death toll of an accident, disaster, or war is the number of people who die in it.

ext.ext_cn: 军方显然担心在他的领导下，其活动将受到严重制约。
ext.ext_en: The army evidently fears that, under him, its activities would be severely circumscribed...

ext.ext_cn: 有多项法律限制公民的权利，使其不得对他人进行人身伤害。
ext.ext_en: There are laws circumscribing the right of individual citizens to cause bodily harm to others.

defs.def_en: If someone's power or freedom is circumscribed, it is limited or restricted.

defs.def_cn: （在程度、速度、强度等上）缓和，减轻，减弱

ext.ext_cn: 最近，压力已经减轻。
ext.ext_en: These days, the pressure has eased off...

ext.ext_cn: 雨小了。
ext.ext_en: The rain had eased off...

defs.def_en: If something eases off, or a person or thing eases it off, it is reduced in degree, speed, or intensity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 陈旧的；过时的;老生常谈的

ext.ext_cn: 我知道这听起来像是老生常谈，但我真的不是为了钱。
ext.ext_en: I know it sounds corny, but I'm really not motivated by money.

ext.ext_cn: 老掉牙的笑话
ext.ext_en: ...corny jokes.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as corny, you mean that it is obvious or sentimental and not at all original.

ext.ext_cn: 一想到尼克，她的喉咙就发紧。
ext.ext_en: The thought of Nick made her throat tighten...

ext.ext_cn: 一想到生活太过舒适了，我内心就很痛苦。
ext.ext_en: I tormented myself with the thought that life was just too comfortable...

defs.def_en: A thought is an idea that you have in your mind.

ext.ext_cn: 我跳起来，免得走神。
ext.ext_en: I jumped to my feet so my thoughts wouldn't start to wander...

ext.ext_cn: 通常在这种时候，我们的心思全放在了圣诞节上。
ext.ext_en: Usually at this time our thoughts are on Christmas...

defs.def_en: A person's thoughts are their mind, or all the ideas in their mind when they are concentrating on one particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 你们中有许多人给我们来信，表达对冲突的看法。
ext.ext_en: Many of you have written to us to express your thoughts on the conflict...

ext.ext_cn: 古德曼先生，那个问题你怎么看？
ext.ext_en: Mr Goodman, do you have any thoughts on that?

defs.def_en: A person's thoughts are their opinions on a particular subject.

ext.ext_cn: 艾丽斯考虑问题入了神，连走过自己的车都没看见。
ext.ext_en: Alice had been so deep in thought that she had walked past her car without even seeing it...

ext.ext_cn: 他认真考虑了她对他说过的话。
ext.ext_en: He had given some thought to what she had told him...

defs.def_en: Thought is the activity of thinking, especially deeply, carefully, or logically.

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉首先想到的就是跑回去把马克斯叫来。
ext.ext_en: Sarah's first thought was to run back and get Max...

ext.ext_cn: 他们没有想过要投降。
ext.ext_en: They had no thought of surrender...

defs.def_en: A thought is an intention, hope, or reason for doing something.

defs.def_cn: 关心，善意，帮助(尤用于感谢或表达钦佩之情)

ext.ext_cn: “你想不想挪到病房里来？”——“哦，您太好心了，不用了，谢谢。”
ext.ext_en: 'Would you like to move into the ward?' — 'A kind thought, but no, thank you.'

ext.ext_cn: “她给了他们这 700 英镑。”——“太慷慨了。”
ext.ext_en: 'She has given them this seven hundred pounds.' — 'What a lovely thought.'

defs.def_en: A thought is an act of kindness or an offer of help; used especially when you are thanking someone, or expressing admiration of someone.

defs.def_cn: (宗教、哲学、科学、政党等的)思想体系，观念体系

ext.ext_cn: 亚里士多德的科学理论统治了西方思想达 1,500 年。
ext.ext_en: Aristotle's scientific theories dominated Western thought for fifteen hundred years...

ext.ext_cn: 这一学派主张抑郁症最好用药物治疗。
ext.ext_en: This school of thought argues that depression is best treated by drugs.

defs.def_en: Thought is the group of ideas and beliefs which belongs, for example, to a particular religion, philosophy, science, or political party.

defs.def_cn: (与数字连用)表示“有…名女子的”,“由…名女子组成的”

ext.ext_cn: 由7名女子组成的团队
ext.ext_en: ...a seven-woman team.

defs.def_en: -woman combines with numbers to indicate that something involves the number of women mentioned.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你靠从那些不卖房就得挨饿的可怜人手里买下房子后建立起了庞大的房产帝国。
ext.ext_en: You have built up a huge property empire by buying from wretched people who had to sell or starve.

defs.def_en: You describe someone as wretched when you feel sorry for them because they are in an unpleasant situation or have suffered unpleasant experiences.

ext.ext_cn: 他想，可恶的女人，她怎么就不能等一等呢？
ext.ext_en: Wretched woman, he thought, why the hell can't she wait?...

ext.ext_cn: 偷窃是让我深恶痛绝的事情，它让我对这整个该死的岛都充满仇视。
ext.ext_en: Theft is something that really disgusts me. It makes me feel hateful towards this whole wretched island.

defs.def_en: You use wretched to describe someone or something that you dislike or feel angry with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得十分迷惘，难过极了。
ext.ext_en: I feel really confused and wretched...

ext.ext_cn: 小女孩脸上痛苦的表情让他很难受。
ext.ext_en: The wretched look on the little girl's face made him sorry.

defs.def_en: Someone who feels wretched feels very unhappy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 多么拙劣的借口！
ext.ext_en: What a wretched excuse...

ext.ext_cn: 薪水总是少得可怜。
ext.ext_en: The pay has always been wretched.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as wretched, you are emphasizing that it is very bad or of very poor quality.

ext.ext_cn: 各地的工薪族都反对缴税。
ext.ext_en: Working people everywhere object to paying taxes...

ext.ext_cn: 我们一起去各个地方。
ext.ext_en: We went everywhere together...

defs.def_en: You use everywhere to refer to a whole area or to all the places in a particular area.

ext.ext_cn: 布拉德利仍然保持着每次出行必派头十足的习惯。
ext.ext_en: Bradley is still accustomed to travelling everywhere in style...

ext.ext_cn: 他所到之处人们都介绍他是本届美国公开赛的冠军。
ext.ext_en: Everywhere he went he was introduced as the current United States Open Champion.

defs.def_en: You use everywhere to refer to all the places that someone goes to.

ext.ext_cn: 我到处都可以看见她的照片。
ext.ext_en: I saw her picture everywhere...

ext.ext_cn: 我到处都找了，就是找不到他。
ext.ext_en: I looked everywhere. I couldn't find him.

defs.def_en: You use everywhere to emphasize that you are talking about a large number of places, or all possible places.

ext.ext_cn: 到处都是香烟盒。
ext.ext_en: There were cartons of cigarettes everywhere...

ext.ext_cn: 到处都是衣服：挂在抽屉上、扔在地上、甚至堆在废纸篓里。
ext.ext_en: Clothes were everywhere; hanging out of drawers, strewn across the floor, even spilling from the wastepaper basket.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is everywhere, you mean that they are present in a place in very large numbers.
Your pay envelope is the envelope containing your wages, which your employer gives you at the end of every week.

ext.ext_cn: 这些树叶呈斑驳的红色。
ext.ext_en: The leaves are a variegated red.

defs.def_en: A variegated leaf or plant has different colours on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 多种多样的;形形色色的

ext.ext_cn: 我们形形色色的方言
ext.ext_en: ...our variegated dialects.

defs.def_en: Something that is variegated consists of many different parts or types.
Someone's ablutions are all the activities that are involved in washing himself or herself.

ext.ext_cn: 总统撒的弥天大谎
ext.ext_en: ...the biggest whopper the president told.

defs.def_en: If you describe a lie as a whopper, you mean that it is very far from the truth.

defs.def_cn: 特别大的物体;庞然大物

ext.ext_cn: 就彗星而言，它可是个庞然大物。
ext.ext_en: As comets go, it is a whopper.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as a whopper, you mean that it is an unusually large example of the thing mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 他们出版工具书。
ext.ext_en: They publish reference books...

ext.ext_cn: 他的最新诗集将由菲贝尔出版公司于5月出版。
ext.ext_en: His latest book of poetry will be published by Faber in May.

defs.def_en: When a company publishes a book or magazine, it prints copies of it, which are sent to shops to be sold.

ext.ext_cn: 这家杂志刊登了一篇讽刺政府的文章后被停刊。
ext.ext_en: The ban was imposed after the magazine published an article satirising the government...

ext.ext_cn: 我不鼓励人们未经允许就拍摄这样的照片，但根据法律我们可以刊登。
ext.ext_en: I don't encourage people to take photographs like this without permission, but by law we can publish.

defs.def_en: When the people in charge of a newspaper or magazine publish a piece of writing or a photograph, they print it in their newspaper or magazine.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·列侬抽时间出版了两本幽默散文。
ext.ext_en: John Lennon found time to publish two books of his humorous prose.

defs.def_en: If someone publishes a book or an article that they have written, they arrange to have it published.

ext.ext_cn: 游行者呼吁政府公布注册选民的名单。
ext.ext_en: The demonstrators called on the government to publish a list of registered voters.

defs.def_en: If you publish information or an opinion, you make it known to the public by having it printed in a newspaper, magazine, or official document.

ext.ext_cn: 帕特里夏以贝弗利·布鲁克斯的艺名在几部英国电影中饰演过小角色。
ext.ext_en: Under the stage name of Beverly Brooks, Patricia had small parts in several British films.

defs.def_en: A stage name is a name that an actor or entertainer uses instead of his or her real name when they work.

ext.ext_cn: 她仍然纺纱为家人织毛线衫。
ext.ext_en: She still spins the yarn and knits sweaters for her family.

ext.ext_cn: 用植物染料染过色的纱线
ext.ext_en: ...vegetable-dyed yarns.

defs.def_en: Yarn is thread used for knitting or making cloth.

defs.def_cn: （经过添油加醋的）奇谈，奇闻轶事

ext.ext_cn: 道格要给我讲几个他到荒野地区旅行的奇遇故事。
ext.ext_en: Doug has a yarn or two to tell me about his trips into the bush.

defs.def_en: A yarn is a story that someone tells, often a true story with invented details which make it more interesting.

ext.ext_cn: 鲁克马尼非常善于讲故事，她有可能给他们编个什么王子或神的故事。
ext.ext_en: Rukmeni's a great storyteller, so she'll probably spin them a yarn about some prince or god.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone spins a yarn, you mean that they tell a story that is not true, often an interesting or imaginative one.

ext.ext_cn: 这是马克第一次承担皇室的工作，但他经受住了严峻的考验。
ext.ext_en: It was Mark's first introduction to royal duties and he came through his baptism of fire unscathed.

defs.def_en: If someone who has just begun a new job has a baptism of fire, they immediately have to cope with very many severe difficulties and obstacles.

ext.ext_cn: 他们给我打了一针帮助我入睡。
ext.ext_en: They gave me an injection to help me sleep...

ext.ext_cn: 它必须通过注射摄入,通常一天两次。
ext.ext_en: It has to be given by injection, usually twice daily.

defs.def_en: If you have an injection, a doctor or nurse puts a medicine into your body using a device with a needle called a syringe.

ext.ext_cn: 需要现金投入来资助这其中的一些项目。
ext.ext_en: An injection of cash is needed to fund some of these projects...

ext.ext_cn: 公司希望从政府那里得到5,000万英镑的现金投入。
ext.ext_en: The company is hoping to obtain a £50 million cash injection from the government.

defs.def_en: An injection of money or resources into an organization is the act of providing it with more money or resources, to help it become more efficient or profitable.

defs.def_cn: 作为插入语的；补充说明的

ext.ext_cn: 福克斯正在插入一大段题外话，讲他在该国边境游历的故事。
ext.ext_en: Fox was making a long parenthetical remark about his travels on the border of the country.

defs.def_en: A parenthetical remark or section is put into something written or spoken but is not essential to it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (局势、时期)令人紧张的，让人焦虑的

ext.ext_cn: 这一友好姿态基本上没有改善会谈的紧张气氛。
ext.ext_en: This gesture of goodwill did little to improve the tense atmosphere at the talks...

ext.ext_cn: 过了紧张不安的 3 个星期，他又一次打来电话。
ext.ext_en: After three very tense weeks he phoned again...

defs.def_en: A tense situation or period of time is one that makes people anxious, because they do not know what is going to happen next.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 紧张的;焦虑的;无法放松的

ext.ext_cn: 起初，达特非常紧张，最后终于放松了下来。
ext.ext_en: Dart, who had at first been very tense, at last relaxed.

defs.def_en: If you are tense, you are anxious and nervous and cannot relax.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她躺着，双目紧闭，全身绷直。
ext.ext_en: She lay, eyes shut, body tense...

ext.ext_cn: 洗个澡可以放松紧张的肌肉。
ext.ext_en: A bath can relax tense muscles.

defs.def_en: If your body is tense, your muscles are tight and not relaxed.

ext.ext_cn: 纽曼的腹肌绷紧了。
ext.ext_en: Newman's stomach muscles tensed...

ext.ext_cn: 那个大块头西印度群岛土著人抓住他的肩膀时，他浑身紧张起来。
ext.ext_en: He tensed as the big West Indian gripped his shoulder...

defs.def_en: If your muscles tense, if you tense, or if you tense your muscles, your muscles become tight and stiff, often because you are anxious or frightened.

ext.ext_cn: 科琳娜好像已经去世了：他们谈论她时用的是过去时。
ext.ext_en: It was as though Corinne was already dead: they were speaking of her in the past tense.

defs.def_en: The tense of a verb group is its form, which usually shows whether you are referring to past, present, or future time.

ext.ext_cn: 武装力量一致保证坚决支持并效忠政府
ext.ext_en: ...the armed forces, all of whom had pledged their unflinching support and loyalty to the government.

defs.def_en: You can use unflinching in expressions such as unflinching honesty and unflinching support to indicate that a good quality which someone has is strong and steady, and never weakens.

defs.def_cn: （尤当have为助动词时，为may have 的口语形式）
defs.def_en: May've is a spoken form of 'may have', especially when 'have' is an auxiliary verb.
A tigress is a female tiger .

R.I.P. is written on gravestones and expresses the hope that the person buried there may rest in peace. R.I.P. is an abbreviation for (缩略=) the Latin expression 'requiescat in pace' or 'requiescant in pace'.

ext.ext_cn: 或许是因为调料的使用几乎千篇一律才使得那些产品难以区分开。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps it is the almost universal use of flavourings that makes it so hard to tell the products apart.

defs.def_en: If you can tell people or things apart, you are able to recognize the differences between them and can therefore identify each of them.
A guardrail is a railing that is placed along the edge of something such as a staircase, path, or boat, so that people can hold onto it or so that they do not fall over the edge.

defs.def_cn: 重新组建，重新构建，改组（组织或国家）

ext.ext_cn: 渐渐地，犹太社区得到重建，犹太人的生活重新开始。
ext.ext_en: Slowly Jewish communities were reconstituted and Jewish life began anew.

ext.ext_cn: 共产党改组后，现称民主社会党
ext.ext_en: ...the reconstituted Communist Party, now called the Party of Democratic Socialism.

defs.def_en: If an organization or state is reconstituted, it is formed again in a different way.

ext.ext_cn: 要泡开西红柿干，需要将其放在清水中用文火炖，直到它们变软。
ext.ext_en: To reconstitute dried tomatoes, simmer in plain water until they are tender...

ext.ext_cn: 试着吃些用水泡过的西梅干、无花果干或杏干。
ext.ext_en: Try eating reconstituted dried prunes, figs or apricots.

defs.def_en: To reconstitute dried food means to add water to it so that it can be eaten.

defs.def_cn: (用来指代不知其名或不愿用确切词汇或固有名称指称的人或物)那人，那东西，某某

ext.ext_cn: 那个新电话什么的
ext.ext_en: ...the new phone thingy.

ext.ext_cn: 他叫什么来着，杰克什么爵士
ext.ext_en: ...what's his name, Sir Jack Thingy.

defs.def_en: You refer to something or someone as thingy when you do not know or cannot be bothered to use the proper word or name for them.
A picket fence is a fence made of pointed wooden sticks fixed into the ground, with pieces of wood nailed across them.

ext.ext_cn: 米什卡找到个指甲剪，开始仔细地修剪指甲。
ext.ext_en: Mishka got some nail scissors and started carefully trimming his fingernails.

ext.ext_cn: 一副旧指甲刀
ext.ext_en: ...an old pair of nail scissors.

defs.def_en: Nail scissors are small scissors that you use for cutting your nails.

defs.def_cn: （尤指爱尔兰人或苏格兰人说英语时带有的）土腔，方言口音

ext.ext_cn: 吉尔说话带有轻微的爱尔兰口音。
ext.ext_en: Gill speaks in a quiet Irish brogue.

defs.def_en: If someone has a brogue, they speak English with a strong accent, especially Irish or Scots.
Brogues are thick leather shoes which have an elaborate pattern punched into the leather.

ext.ext_cn: 革命者肃清了国内敌对势力。
ext.ext_en: The revolutionaries expunged domestic opposition...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾努力将那段经历从记忆中抹去。
ext.ext_en: The experience was something he had tried to expunge from his memory...

defs.def_en: If you expunge something, you get rid of it completely, because it causes problems or bad feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 他们勤俭节约，积极进取，得到了当之无愧的赞扬。
ext.ext_en: They were rightly praised for their thrift and enterprise.

defs.def_en: Thrift is the quality and practice of being careful with money and not wasting things.
A thrift or a thrift institution is a kind of savings bank.

defs.def_cn: 为…举行就职典礼;使正式就任

ext.ext_cn: 新总统将于 1 月 20 号举行就职典礼。
ext.ext_en: The new President will be inaugurated on January 20.

defs.def_en: When a new leader is inaugurated, they are formally given their new position at an official ceremony.

defs.def_cn: 为…举行落成仪式;为…举行成立典礼

ext.ext_cn: 新建的有毒废物研究中心今天在皇家学院举行落成典礼。
ext.ext_en: A new centre for research on toxic waste was inaugurated today at Imperial College.

defs.def_en: When a new building or institution is inaugurated, it is declared open in a formal ceremony.

ext.ext_cn: 泛美航空公司开通了第一条国际定期航班线路。
ext.ext_en: Pan Am inaugurated the first scheduled international flight.

defs.def_en: If you inaugurate a new system or service, you start it.

defs.def_cn: 包装纸;包装塑料；包装材料

ext.ext_cn: 食品包装纸

defs.def_cn: (众人自娱自乐的)合唱，歌唱会

A flood plain is a flat area on the edge of a river, where the ground consists of soil, sand, and rock left by the river when it floods.
A greenback is a banknote such as a dollar bill.

ext.ext_cn: Enviros Consulting 公司在全世界拥有逾2,000家组织机构的客户群。
ext.ext_en: Enviros Consulting has a client base of more than 2,000 organisations worldwide.

defs.def_en: A business's client base is the same as its customer base .

ext.ext_cn: 教练在第二场比赛中没有进行场上位置的调整。
ext.ext_en: The manager has made no positional changes for the second game.

defs.def_en: Positional refers to the physical position of someone, for example in a football match.

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队被南非队彻底打败。
ext.ext_en: England were comprehensively beaten by South Africa.

defs.def_en: Something that is done comprehensively is done thoroughly.

ext.ext_cn: 简都快是个大人了。
ext.ext_en: Jan was almost a grown-up...

ext.ext_cn: 告诉孩子们，如果被人欺负就告诉大人。
ext.ext_en: Tell children to tell a grown-up if they're being bullied.

defs.def_en: A grown-up is an adult; used by or to children.

ext.ext_cn: 我的几个孩子已经长大成人并且事业有成。
ext.ext_en: I have grown-up children who're  doing well.

defs.def_en: Someone who is grown-up is physically and mentally mature and no longer depends on their parents or another adult.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她表现得很像个大人。
ext.ext_en: She's very grown-up.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is grown-up, you mean that they behave in an adult way, often when they are in fact still a child.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的歌曲唱的都是成年人的事情。
ext.ext_en: Her songs tackle grown-up subjects...

ext.ext_cn: 她说起话来像个大人。
ext.ext_en: She talked in a grown-up manner.

defs.def_en: Grown-up things seem suitable for or typical of adults.

ext.ext_cn: 坐在早餐桌前读晨报
ext.ext_en: ...reading the morning papers at the breakfast table.

defs.def_en: You refer to a table as the breakfast table when it is being used for breakfast.

defs.def_cn: 教练;指导者;(美国英语亦指)教师，大学讲师

ext.ext_cn: 有正式资格的驾驶教练的指导
ext.ext_en: ...tuition from an approved driving instructor.

defs.def_en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill such as driving or skiing. In American English, instructor can also be used to refer to a schoolteacher or to a university teacher of low rank.
In Britain, a guardsman is a soldier who is a member of one of the regiments of Guards.
In the United States, a guardsman is a soldier who is a member of the National Guard.

defs.def_cn: (用于制作家具的东印度)椴木，椴木木材
defs.def_en: Satinwood is a smooth hard wood which comes from an East Indian tree and is used to make furniture.
A swimsuit is a piece of clothing that is worn for swimming, especially by women and girls.

ext.ext_cn: 有人曾称他为20世纪最伟大的艺人。
ext.ext_en: Some have called him the greatest entertainer of the twentieth century.

defs.def_en: An entertainer is a person whose job is to entertain audiences, for example by telling jokes, singing, or dancing.

ext.ext_cn: 父母们呼吁给她复职，但结果却只是徒劳。
ext.ext_en: Parents campaigned in vain for her reinstatement.

defs.def_en: Reinstatement is the act of giving someone back a job or position which has been taken away from them.

defs.def_cn: (法律、做法等的)恢复;（设施等的）修复

ext.ext_cn: 他对恢复10%的银行基准利率表示欢迎。
ext.ext_en: He welcomed the reinstatement of the 10 per cent bank base rate.

defs.def_en: The reinstatement of a law, facility, or practice is the act of causing it to exist again.

ext.ext_cn: 坐着或者走路的时候低头垂肩，这种不正确的姿势会压迫体内的器官。
ext.ext_en: Poor posture, sitting or walking slouched over, compresses the body's organs...

ext.ext_cn: 空气会压缩，但是刹车油不会。
ext.ext_en: Air will compress but the brake fluid won't.

defs.def_en: When you compress something or when it compresses, it is pressed or squeezed so that it takes up less space.

ext.ext_cn: 他从来就不懂如何对大篇的材料进行整理或精简。
ext.ext_en: He never understood how to organize or compress large masses of material...

ext.ext_cn: 那三本书的内容全都压缩进一本书了。
ext.ext_en: All those three books are compacted and compressed into one book.

defs.def_en: If you compress something such as a piece of writing or a description, you make it shorter.

ext.ext_cn: 这4场辩论将被压缩到短短8天的时间，这是前所未有的。
ext.ext_en: The four debates will be compressed into an unprecedentedly short eight-day period...

ext.ext_cn: 有些课程，比如工程学，必须减少课时。
ext.ext_en: Some courses such as engineering had to be compressed.

defs.def_en: If an event is compressed into a short space of time, it is given less time to happen than normal or previously.

ext.ext_cn: 喉咙痛用冷敷布敷一下可能会好一些。
ext.ext_en: Sore throats may be relieved by cold compresses.

defs.def_en: A compress is a pad of wet or dry cloth pressed on part of a patient's body to reduce fever.

ext.ext_cn: 我们选举出来代表我们的政界人士
ext.ext_en: ...the politicians we elect to represent us...

ext.ext_cn: 受害者的代理律师还没有接受这个提议。
ext.ext_en: The offer has yet to be accepted by the lawyers representing the victims.

defs.def_en: If someone such as a lawyer or a politician represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

ext.ext_cn: 总书记可以在一些官方仪式上代表主席。
ext.ext_en: The general secretary may represent the president at official ceremonies.

defs.def_en: If you represent a person or group at an official event, you go there on their behalf.

defs.def_cn: (在竞赛或体育赛事中)代表（国家或地区）

ext.ext_cn: 我唯一的目标是代表英国参加奥运会。
ext.ext_en: My only aim is to represent Britain at the Olympics.

defs.def_en: If you represent your country or town in a competition or sports event, you take part in it on behalf of the country or town where you live.

ext.ext_cn: 女性在电视剧领域占据了一席之地。
ext.ext_en: Women are already well represented in the area of TV drama...

ext.ext_cn: 在新墨西哥州， 有各种各样的烹饪方法。
ext.ext_en: In New Mexico all kinds of cuisines are represented.

defs.def_en: If a group of people or things is well represented in a particular activity or in a particular place, a lot of them can be found there.

defs.def_cn: 相当于，代表着（变化、成就、胜利等）

ext.ext_cn: 展出的作品并非围绕着一个主题，而是不同时期的经典之作。
ext.ext_en: The pieces on view are not grouped around any one theme, but rather represent superb examples from various periods...

ext.ext_cn: 这些发展代表了现有秩序的重大转变。
ext.ext_en: These developments represented a major change in the established order.

defs.def_en: If you say that something represents a change, achievement, or victory, you mean that it is a change, achievement, or victory.

defs.def_cn: (标志或符号)意味着，代表着，标志着

ext.ext_cn: 圆圈中心的黑点应该是表示放射源。
ext.ext_en: ...a black dot in the middle of the circle is supposed to represent the source of the radiation.

defs.def_en: If a sign or symbol represents something, it is accepted as meaning that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我们相信你代表了英国赛马所需要的一切。
ext.ext_en: We believe you represent everything British racing needs.

defs.def_en: To represent an idea or quality means to be a symbol or an expression of that idea or quality.

ext.ext_cn: 大众媒体往往把他描绘成环保领袖。
ext.ext_en: The popular press tends to represent him as an environmental guru.

defs.def_en: If you represent a person or thing as a particular thing, you describe them as being that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 她带来了一本书，这本书从女性主义视角对维多利亚时代女性小说家进行了评论。
ext.ext_en: She had brought a book, a feminist critique of Victorian lady novelists.

ext.ext_cn: 马克思主义者对资本主义的批判
ext.ext_en: ...the Marxist critique of capitalism.

defs.def_en: A critique is a written examination and judgment of a situation or of a person's work or ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 简短却深深打动人的书信
ext.ext_en: ...a brief but poignant epistle.

defs.def_en: An epistle is a letter.

defs.def_cn: 使徒书信（《圣经·新约》中使徒们早期的书信）
defs.def_en: In the Bible, the Epistles are a series of books in the New Testament which were originally written as letters to the early Christians.

ext.ext_cn: 我们小口地喝着热葡萄酒。
ext.ext_en: We supped mulled wine.

defs.def_en: If you sup something, you drink it, especially by taking small amounts.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经受邀和一位同事及其夫人共进晚餐。
ext.ext_en: He had been invited to sup with a colleague and his wife.

defs.def_en: If you sup, you eat dinner in the evening.

defs.def_cn: 色彩画家;善于运用色彩的时装设计师
defs.def_en: A colourist is someone such as an artist or a fashion designer who uses colours in an interesting and original way.
A colourist is a hairdresser who specializes in colouring people's hair.
A wash-rag is the same as a washcloth .

defs.def_cn: （通常与厨房相连的）食品储藏室，食品储藏柜
defs.def_en: A pantry is a small room or large cupboard in a house, usually near the kitchen, where food is kept.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 惹人喜爱的;讨人喜欢的;可爱的

ext.ext_cn: 她的个性非常讨人喜欢。
ext.ext_en: She has such an endearing personality...

ext.ext_cn: 亨利的咬舌音很可爱。
ext.ext_en: Henry's lisp is so endearing.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as endearing, you mean that it causes you to feel very fond of them.
A wader is a bird with long legs and a long neck, which lives near water and feeds on fish. There are several different kinds of waders.
Waders are long rubber boots which cover all of the legs and are worn by fishermen when they are standing in water.

ext.ext_cn: 灰色的床单在晾衣绳上飘来摆去的。
ext.ext_en: Grey sheets flapped on the clothes line...

ext.ext_cn: 他们聊天时会在阳台上抖搂浴巾。
ext.ext_en: They would flap bath towels from their balconies as they chatted.

defs.def_en: If something such as a piece of cloth or paper flaps or if you flap it, it moves quickly up and down or from side to side.

defs.def_cn: 振(翅);挥(翅);(翅膀)拍打，抖动

ext.ext_cn: 鸟儿使劲地扑打着翅膀。
ext.ext_en: The bird flapped its wings furiously...

ext.ext_cn: 一只鸽子从塔里钻出来，扑扑地拍打着翅膀。
ext.ext_en: A pigeon emerges, wings flapping noisily, from the tower.

defs.def_en: If a bird or insect flaps its wings or if its wings flap, the wings move quickly up and down.

ext.ext_cn: 边跑边挥舞着手臂的小孩子
ext.ext_en: ...a kid running and flapping her arms.

defs.def_en: If you flap your arms, you move them quickly up and down as if they were the wings of a bird.

defs.def_cn: (布、皮等)扁平下垂物,垂下的部分

ext.ext_cn: 他拉开帐篷的门帘，大步走进暴风雪中。
ext.ext_en: He drew back the tent flap and strode out into the blizzard.

ext.ext_cn: 耷拉着快要掉下的一块皮
ext.ext_en: ...a loose flap of skin.

defs.def_en: A flap of cloth or skin, for example, is a flat piece of it that can move freely up and down or from side to side because it is held or attached by only one edge.

ext.ext_cn: 襟翼放下时的突然减速
ext.ext_en: ...the sudden slowing as the flaps were lowered.

defs.def_en: A flap on the wing of an aircraft is an area along the edge of the wing that can be raised or lowered to control the movement of the aircraft.

defs.def_cn: (鸟翼、布条、纸片的)拍打声，拍动，拍打

ext.ext_cn: 万籁俱寂，只有一面绸制旗子轻轻飘动的响声。
ext.ext_en: Nothing to be heard but the soft flap of a silk banner.

defs.def_en: A flap is a sudden noise or movement made by a bird's wing or by a piece of paper or cloth when it flaps.

ext.ext_cn: 为什么人们对核能惶恐不安呢？
ext.ext_en: Why did people get in a flap over nuclear energy?...

ext.ext_cn: 无论他到哪里，都会引起一阵骚动。
ext.ext_en: Wherever he goes there's always a flap.

defs.def_en: Someone who is in a flap is in a state of great excitement, worry, or panic.

ext.ext_cn: 室内温水泳池
ext.ext_en: ...a heated indoor pool...

ext.ext_cn: 冬季来游泳的人很多，泳池人满为患。
ext.ext_en: During winter, many people swim and the pool is crowded.

defs.def_en: A pool is the same as a swimming pool .

ext.ext_cn: 水塘已经干涸，里面都是欧洲蕨和芦苇。
ext.ext_en: The pool had dried up and was full of bracken and reeds.

ext.ext_cn: 处处可见水池、喷泉和珍稀鸟类的美丽花园
ext.ext_en: ...beautiful gardens filled with pools, fountains and rare birds.

defs.def_en: See also:rock pool;A pool is a fairly small area of still water.

ext.ext_cn: 她被发现躺在一片血泊中。
ext.ext_en: She was found lying in a pool of blood...

ext.ext_cn: 雨一直静静地下着，沙砾车道上积起了一摊摊水。
ext.ext_en: It was raining quietly and steadily and there were little pools of water on the gravel drive...

defs.def_en: A pool of liquid or light is a small area of it on the ground or on a surface.

ext.ext_cn: 可用的健壮人力没有军官预计的那么多。
ext.ext_en: The available pool of healthy manpower was not as large as military officials had expected...

ext.ext_cn: 这项新的提议将建立一个现金储备基金。
ext.ext_en: The new proposal would create a reserve pool of cash.

defs.def_en: See also:car pool;A pool of people, money, or things is a quantity or number of them that is available for an organization or group to use.

defs.def_cn: 共用，聚拢（资金、知识、设备等）

ext.ext_cn: 我们集思广益，共享信息。
ext.ext_en: We pooled ideas and information...

ext.ext_cn: 我和菲利普把积蓄凑到一起开办了我的公司。
ext.ext_en: Philip and I pooled our savings to start up my business.

defs.def_en: If a group of people or organizations pool their money, knowledge, or equipment, they share it or put it together so that it can be used for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一起打过台球，是好哥们儿。
ext.ext_en: We played pool together and were good mates...

ext.ext_cn: “水手”是供台球玩家和酒徒消遣的酒吧。
ext.ext_en: The Seaman was a bar for pool players and hard drinkers...

defs.def_en: Pool is a game played on a large table covered with a cloth. Players use a long stick called a cue to hit a white ball across the table so that it knocks coloured balls with numbers on them into six holes around the edge of the table.

defs.def_cn: （下注猜足球比赛结果的）赌球

ext.ext_cn: 赌球获胜的几率大约是二千万分之一。
ext.ext_en: The odds of winning the pools are about one in 20 million.

defs.def_en: If you do the pools, you take part in a gambling competition in which people try to win money by guessing correctly the results of football matches.

defs.def_cn: 令人完全无法接受的事物；令人厌恶的事物

ext.ext_cn: 正在发生的事令人非常反感。
ext.ext_en: What is happening is an abomination.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is an abomination, you think that it is completely unacceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 这种威士忌是在1926年通过蒸馏提取的，尔后静置到 1987年才酿熟。
ext.ext_en: The whisky had been distilled in 1926 and sat quietly maturing until 1987...

ext.ext_cn: 沼泽地的水不能饮用，但是可以将它蒸馏净化。
ext.ext_en: You can't actually drink the water from the marshland. But you can distil it...

defs.def_en: If a liquid such as whisky or water is distilled, it is heated until it changes into steam or vapour and then cooled until it becomes liquid again. This is usually done in order to make it pure.

ext.ext_cn: 油是从这种小树的浆果中提炼出来的。
ext.ext_en: The oil is distilled from the berries of this small tree.

ext.ext_cn: 提取玫瑰花瓣精油的技巧
ext.ext_en: ...the art of distilling rose petals...

defs.def_en: If an oil or liquid is distilled from a plant, it is produced by a process which extracts the most essential part of the plant. To distil a plant means to produce an oil or liquid from it by this process.

defs.def_cn: 精炼，浓缩（想法等）;吸收…为一部分

ext.ext_cn: 述评是从先前刊登在主要专栏的文章中提炼出来的。
ext.ext_en: Reviews are distilled from articles previously published in the main column...

ext.ext_cn: 最后激情融入了美丽宜人的夜色中。
ext.ext_en: Eventually passion was distilled into the natural beauty of a balmy night...

defs.def_en: If a thought or idea is distilled from previous thoughts, ideas, or experiences, it comes from them. If it is distilled into something, it becomes part of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 所有的武装团体都将被解散。
ext.ext_en: All the armed groups will be disbanded...

ext.ext_cn: 叛乱分子会在 6 月 10日前全部解散。
ext.ext_en: The rebels were to have fully disbanded by June the tenth.

defs.def_en: If someone disbands a group of people, or if the group disbands, it stops operating as a single unit.

defs.def_cn: 近代语言，现代语言(指作为学校课程学习的法、德、俄等欧洲国家的近代语言)

ext.ext_cn: 一所伦敦文法学校里的主管现代语言教学的主任
ext.ext_en: ...head of modern languages at a London grammar school.

defs.def_en: Modern languages refers to the modern European languages, for example French, German, and Russian, which are studied at school or university.

ext.ext_cn: 那只杂种狗张嘴要伤人。
ext.ext_en: The mongrel presented his muzzle for scratching.

defs.def_en: The muzzle of an animal such as a dog is its nose and mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 像比特犬这种得戴嘴套的狗
ext.ext_en: ...dogs like pit bulls which have to wear a muzzle.

defs.def_en: A muzzle is an object that is put over a dog's nose and mouth so that it cannot bite people or make a noise.

ext.ext_cn: 他因没能给比特犬戴嘴套而被判有罪。
ext.ext_en: He was convicted of failing to muzzle a pit bull.

defs.def_en: If you muzzle a dog or other animal, you put a muzzle over its nose and mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 他抱怨主席不让他发言。
ext.ext_en: He complained of being muzzled by the chairman...

ext.ext_cn: 她反对钳制新闻界言论的新法律。
ext.ext_en: She was opposed to new laws to muzzle the press.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is muzzled, you are complaining that they are prevented from expressing their views freely.
The muzzle of a gun is the end where the bullets come out when it is fired.

ext.ext_cn: 用来支撑底部木头的板条
ext.ext_en: ...a batten to support the base timbers.

defs.def_en: A batten is a long strip of wood that is fixed to something to strengthen it or to hold it firm.

ext.ext_cn: 屋顶板条一直没钉牢。
ext.ext_en: The roof was never securely battened down.

ext.ext_cn: 钉上大块的松木窗板可以遮挡中午的太阳
ext.ext_en: ...big pine shutters that could be battened against the noonday sun.

defs.def_en: If something is battened in place, it is made secure by having battens fixed across it or being closed firmly.

ext.ext_cn: 3 万名观众观看了决赛。
ext.ext_en: Thirty thousand spectators watched the final game.

defs.def_en: A spectator is someone who watches something, especially a sporting event.

defs.def_cn: 脱离论者;分离论者;独立主义者

ext.ext_cn: 立陶宛独立主义者
ext.ext_en: ...Lithuanian secessionists...

ext.ext_cn: 政府正试图镇压一场分离运动。
ext.ext_en: The government is trying to crush a secessionist movement.

defs.def_en: Secessionists are people who want their region or group to become separate from the country or larger group to which it belongs.

defs.def_cn: 大伯子；小叔子；内兄；内弟；姐夫；妹夫；连襟
defs.def_en: Someone's brother-in-law is the brother of their husband or wife, or the man who is married to their sister.

ext.ext_cn: 出生后第一周通常要服用维生素K，以防止出血。
ext.ext_en: Vitamin K is routinely given in the first week of life to prevent bleeding.

defs.def_en: If something is routinely done, it is done as a normal part of a job or process.

ext.ext_cn: 任何来自外界的批评通常都被当作干涉而不予理睬。
ext.ext_en: Any outside criticism is routinely dismissed as interference...

ext.ext_cn: 他通常被认为是继爱因斯坦之后最伟大的科学家。
ext.ext_en: He is routinely described as the greatest scientist since Einstein.

defs.def_en: If something happens routinely, it happens repeatedly and is not surprising, unnatural, or new.

defs.def_cn: 六分仪(用于测算船只或飞机的位置)
defs.def_en: A sextant is an instrument used for measuring angles, for example between the sun and the horizon, so that the position of a ship or aeroplane can be calculated.

defs.def_cn: （使）有一定上升;（使）有一定提高

ext.ext_cn: 加大压力的企图
ext.ext_en: ...an attempt to ratchet up the pressure...

ext.ext_cn: 他害怕通货膨胀会在年终更加严重。
ext.ext_en: He fears inflation will ratchet up as the year ends...

defs.def_en: If something ratchets up or is ratcheted up, it increases by a fixed amount or degree, and seems unlikely to decrease again.

ext.ext_cn: 双方大部分时间都在围绕程序问题争论不休。
ext.ext_en: The two sides have spent most of their time wrangling over procedural problems...

ext.ext_cn: 一群下院议员仍在与政府就选举的时间安排争吵个不停。
ext.ext_en: A group of MPs is still wrangling with the government over the timing of elections.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is wrangling with someone over a question or issue, you mean that they have been arguing angrily for quite a long time about it.

A car port is a shelter for cars which is attached to a house and consists of a flat roof supported on pillars.
A pessary is a small block of a medicine or a contraceptive chemical that a woman puts in her vagina.

ext.ext_en: Sue was adamant about that job in Australia.

defs.def_en: If someone is adamant about something, they are determined not to change their mind about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他迟到了,会议一开始就不顺利。
ext.ext_en: The meeting got off to an inauspicious start when he was late.

defs.def_en: An inauspicious event is one that gives signs that success is unlikely.
A paedophile is a person, usually a man, who is sexually attracted to children.

defs.def_cn: 鲦鱼，米诺鱼(一种极小的淡水鱼)
defs.def_en: A minnow is a very small fish that lives in lakes and rivers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 上气不接下气的；呼吸困难的；气喘吁吁的

ext.ext_cn: 我有点儿喘不上气，心脏咚咚地快速跳动着。
ext.ext_en: I was a little breathless and my heartbeat was bumpy and fast...

ext.ext_en: We were breathless with anticipation.

defs.def_en: If you are breathless, you have difficulty in breathing properly, for example because you have been running  or because you are afraid or excited.

ext.ext_cn: 技术进步速度惊人，日新月异。
ext.ext_en: Technology has advanced at a breathless pace.

ext.ext_cn: 1988年年初，兴奋与狂热的情绪令人窒息，成百上千的市民每晚聚在一起参加政治集会
ext.ext_en: ...the breathless excitement of early 1988, when hundreds and thousands of citizens gathered nightly for political meetings.

defs.def_en: You use breathless for emphasis when you are describing feelings of excitement or exciting situations.

ext.ext_en: ...the new junior minister, whatshisname, Donald Sinclair.

defs.def_en: You say whatshisname instead of a man's name when you cannot remember it or are trying to remember it.

ext.ext_cn: 叛乱分子完全控制了局面。
ext.ext_en: The rebels had taken complete control...

ext.ext_cn: 这表明管理层对此完全不了解。
ext.ext_en: It shows a complete lack of understanding by management...

defs.def_en: You use complete to emphasize that something is as great in extent, degree, or amount as it possibly can be.

ext.ext_cn: 整幢公寓大楼被付之一炬。
ext.ext_en: A complete tenement block was burnt to the ground...

ext.ext_cn: 工作指导卡最终装满了整整一个册子。
ext.ext_en: The job sheets eventually filled a complete book.

defs.def_en: You can use complete to emphasize that you are referring to the whole of something and not just part of it.

ext.ext_en: The list may not be complete.

ext.ext_cn: 一整套餐具
ext.ext_en: ...a complete dinner service...

defs.def_en: If something is complete, it contains all the parts that it should contain.

ext.ext_cn: 小孩要到两三岁才会长齐20颗乳牙。
ext.ext_en: Children don't complete their set of 20 baby teeth until they are two to three years old.

ext.ext_cn: 集全一整套所需的贴纸
ext.ext_en: ...the stickers needed to complete the collection.

defs.def_en: To complete a set or group means to provide the last item that is needed to make it a full set or group.

ext.ext_cn: 《威廉·莎士比亚全集》
ext.ext_en: ...the Complete Works of William Shakespeare.

defs.def_en: The complete works of a writer are all their books or poems published together in one book or as a set of books.

ext.ext_cn: 这个日记本配有一支金色的圆珠笔。
ext.ext_en: The diary comes complete with a gold-coloured ballpoint pen.

defs.def_en: If one thing comes complete with another, it has that thing as an extra or additional part.

ext.ext_cn: 修复农舍的工作已经完成。
ext.ext_en: The work of restoring the farmhouse is complete...

ext.ext_cn: 这个过程需要两年才能完成。
ext.ext_en: It'll be two years before the process is complete.

defs.def_en: If something is complete, it has been finished.

ext.ext_cn: 彼得·梅尔刚刚完成他的第一部小说。
ext.ext_en: Peter Mayle has just completed his first novel.

ext.ext_cn: 为了让各个体育场按时完工进行的匆忙赶工
ext.ext_en: ...the rush to get the stadiums completed on time.

defs.def_en: If you complete something, you finish doing, making, or producing it.

ext.ext_cn: 她用两年的时间修完了课程，拿到了学位。
ext.ext_en: She completed her degree in two years...

ext.ext_cn: 这本书耗时多年才写完。
ext.ext_en: This book took years to complete.

defs.def_en: If you complete something, you do all of it.

ext.ext_cn: 填写下面的订货单即可。
ext.ext_en: Simply complete the coupon below...

ext.ext_cn: 我们让候选人填写一份心理测试问卷。
ext.ext_en: We ask candidates to complete a psychometric questionnaire...

defs.def_en: If you complete a form or questionnaire, you write the answers or information asked for in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他是一名全能的记者。
ext.ext_en: He was the complete all-round journalist.

defs.def_en: You can use complete to emphasize that someone is skilled at all aspects of a particular activity and is therefore the best example of that kind of person.

ext.ext_cn: 衣帽间服务员

defs.def_en: In a public building, the cloakroom is the place where people can leave their coats, umbrellas, and so on.

defs.def_en: A cloakroom is a room containing toilets in a public building or a room containing a toilet on the ground floor of someone's house.

ext.ext_cn: 上面的墙上挂着日历,日期上画着大大的方框。
ext.ext_en: There was a calendar on the wall above, with large squares around the dates.

defs.def_en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

ext.ext_cn: 公历最初是以罗马人的儒略历为基础制定的。
ext.ext_en: The Christian calendar was originally based on the Julian calendar of the Romans.

defs.def_en: A calendar is a particular system for dividing time into periods such as years, months, and weeks, often starting from a particular point in history.

defs.def_cn: (某一组织、团体或个人的)日程表，纪事表，大事一览表

ext.ext_en: It is one of the British sporting calendar's most prestigious events...

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

The airfare to a place is the amount it costs to fly there.

ext.ext_en: Mary! How lovely to see you!...

ext.ext_en: It's a lovely day...

ext.ext_en: Laura is a lovely young woman...

ext.ext_en: She's a lovely child.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as lovely, you mean that they are friendly, kind, or generous.

defs.def_en: If something happens in conformity with something such as a law or someone's wishes, it happens as the law says it should, or as the person wants it to.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a powerhouse, you mean that they are very energetic.

ill-gotten gains;Gotten is the past participle of get in American English.

defs.def_cn: 航空的；飞机的；由飞机进行的；空中的

ext.ext_en: Weeks of aerial bombardment had destroyed factories and highways...

ext.ext_en: ...the radio aerials of taxis and cars.

defs.def_en: An aerial is a device or a piece of wire that receives television or radio signals and is usually attached to a radio, television, car, or building.

ext.ext_en: How would you explain colour to a blind person?

defs.def_en: Someone who is blind is unable to see because their eyes are damaged.

ext.ext_en: The sun hit the windscreen, momentarily blinding him.

defs.def_en: If something blinds you, it makes you unable to see, either for a short time or permanently.

defs.def_cn: 暂时看不见的；双眼模糊的；目眩的

ext.ext_en: Her mother groped for the back of the chair, her eyes blind with tears.

defs.def_en: If you are blind with something such  as tears or a bright light, you are unable to see for a short time because of the tears or light.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 看不到的；视而不见的；没有意识到的

ext.ext_cn: 戴维英俊的长相和完美的举止总是让她对他的缺点视而不见。
ext.ext_en: David's good looks and impeccable manners had always made her blind to his faults...

ext.ext_en: All the time I was blind to your suffering.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is blind to a fact or a situation, you mean that they ignore it or are unaware of it, although you think that they should take notice of it or be aware of it.

defs.def_cn: 使无法意识到；使无视；使无法认清

ext.ext_cn: 他从来不会因为对澳大利亚的热爱而看不到自己同胞的缺点。
ext.ext_en: He never allowed his love of Australia to blind him to his countrymen's faults.

defs.def_en: If something blinds you to the real situation, it prevents you from realizing that it exists or from understanding it properly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: You can describe someone's  beliefs or actions as blind when you think that they seem to take no notice of important facts or behave in an unreasonable way.

defs.def_en: A blind corner is one that you cannot see round because something is blocking your view.

ext.ext_en: I remembered a huddle of stone buildings with blind walls.

defs.def_en: A blind wall or building is one which has no windows or doors.

ext.ext_en: Teachers are turning a blind eye to pupils smoking at school, a report reveals today...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is turning a blind eye to something bad or illegal that is happening, you mean that you think they are pretending not to notice that it is happening so that they will not have to do anything about it.

defs.def_en: If you probe a place, you search it in order to find someone or something that you are looking for.

ext.ext_en: We stood in the doorway until our eyes adjusted...

defs.def_en: If you adjust your vision or if your vision adjusts, the muscles of your eye or the pupils alter to cope with changes in light or distance.

ext.ext_en: The man squinted up at him...

ext.ext_en: He was vilified, hounded, and forced into exile by the FBI.

ext.ext_en: The disease was detected during a routine check-up.

ext.ext_en: ...a regular check-up at the dentist.

ext.ext_en: ...exotic plants.

ext.ext_en: He says he plans to plant fruit trees and vegetables.

ext.ext_en: ...Ford's British car assembly plants...

ext.ext_en: The plant provides forty per cent of the country's electricity.

defs.def_en: A plant is a factory or a place where power is produced.

defs.def_cn: 成套机械；成套设备；成套装置

ext.ext_en: ...with his enormous feet  planted heavily apart.
