ext.ext_en: She planted a kiss on each of his leathery cheeks.

defs.def_en: If you plant a kiss on someone, you give them a kiss.

ext.ext_cn: 他希望能把这个想法注入阿布拉莫夫的头脑，但要让他相信这是他自己的念头。
ext.ext_en: He hoped that he could plant the idea in such a way that Abramov would believe it was his own.

defs.def_en: If you plant an idea in someone's mind, they begin to accept the idea without realizing that it has originally come from you and not from them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她还是不喜欢那个指甲脏脏的女子。
ext.ext_en: She still did not like the woman who had dirty fingernails...

ext.ext_cn: 那件连衣裙原来色彩非常鲜艳，不过现在有污渍变脏了。
ext.ext_en: The dress had been brightly coloured, but it was stained and dirty now.

defs.def_en: If something is dirty, it is marked or covered with stains, spots, or mud, and needs to be cleaned.

ext.ext_cn: 他担心狗毛弄脏了座位。
ext.ext_en: He was afraid the dog's hairs might dirty the seats...

ext.ext_cn: 使用劣质磁带还有可能会污损你的录像机磁头。
ext.ext_en: With poor quality tapes you could also risk dirtying the heads on your video recorder.

defs.def_en: To dirty something means to cause it to become dirty.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 卑劣的;卑鄙的;不道德的

ext.ext_cn: 一个敌对的黑手党家族雇用了那个枪手来实施这一卑劣行动。
ext.ext_en: The gunman had been hired by a rival Mafia family to do the dirty deed.

ext.ext_cn: 吉姆·布朗是那种打起架来不择手段的家伙。
ext.ext_en: Jim Browne is the kind of fellow who can fight dirty.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action as dirty, you disapprove of it and consider it unfair, immoral, or dishonest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (笑话、书籍、话语等)淫秽的，下流的，黄色的

ext.ext_cn: 他们说着荤段子，哼着不着调的小曲儿。
ext.ext_en: They told dirty jokes and sang raucous ballads...

ext.ext_cn: 当然很多孩子在他们的房间里看黄书，而且会把它们藏在床垫子底下。
ext.ext_en: Of course lots of kids read dirty books in their rooms and hide them under the mattress.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a joke, a book, or someone's language as dirty, you mean that it refers to sex in a way that some people find offensive.

defs.def_cn: (用于批评之词前作强调)可恶的，可恨的

ext.ext_cn: 你这个可恶的骗子。
ext.ext_en: You dirty liar.

defs.def_en: Dirty is used before words of criticism to emphasize that you do not approve of someone or something.

defs.def_cn: 把丑事公开;使家丑外扬

ext.ext_cn: 前海军官员们自揭伤疤的做法显然非常令人尴尬。
ext.ext_en: The spectacle of the former naval officers washing their dirty linen in public was distinctly embarrassing...

ext.ext_cn: 家丑不宜外扬，如果我是他的话，我就什么也不说。
ext.ext_en: We shouldn't wash our dirty laundry in public and if I was in his position, I'd say nothing at all.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone washes their dirty linen in public, you disapprove of their discussing or arguing about unpleasant or private things in front of other people. There are several other forms of this expression, for example wash your dirty laundry in public, or in American English, air your dirty laundry in public .

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔狠狠地瞪了他一眼然后走开了。
ext.ext_en: Michael gave him a dirty look and walked out.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you a dirty look, they look at you in a way which shows that they are angry with you.

defs.def_cn: 老色鬼;老淫棍;老不正经

ext.ext_cn: 他以前总想乱来。但现在他已 71 岁，有些力不从心了。不过是个老色鬼罢了。
ext.ext_en: He was always trying it on. But now he's 71, it's causing problems. He's just a dirty old man.

defs.def_en: Dirty old man is an expression some people use to describe an older man who they think shows an unnatural interest in sex.

defs.def_cn: 替…干不法勾当;替…干苦差

ext.ext_cn: 作为特工小分队的一员，部队总会派我们去做他们不愿做的事。
ext.ext_en: As a member of an elite army hit squad, the army would send us out to do their dirty work for them.

defs.def_en: To do someone's dirty work means to do a task for them that is dishonest or unpleasant and which they do not want to do themselves.

defs.def_cn: (主要为性而进行的)周末幽会
defs.def_en: A dirty weekend is a weekend during which two people go away together, mainly in order to have sex.

defs.def_cn: 引起反感的词;令人讨厌的字眼

ext.ext_cn: 市场营销成了公司里一个很令人讨厌的字眼。
ext.ext_en: Marketing became a dirty word at the company.

defs.def_en: If you say that an expression is a dirty word in a particular group of people, you mean it refers to an idea that they strongly dislike or disagree with.
A conjurer is a person who entertains people by doing magic tricks.

defs.def_cn: (竞赛或比赛中的)最有可能获胜者，领先者

ext.ext_cn: 总统选举中的两位领先者都不是主流政治家。
ext.ext_en: Neither of the front-runners in the presidential election is a mainstream politician.

defs.def_en: In a competition or contest, the front-runner is the person who seems most likely to win it.

ext.ext_cn: (美国的)大峡谷
ext.ext_en: ...the Grand Canyon.

defs.def_en: A canyon is a long, narrow valley with very steep sides.

ext.ext_cn: 一直以来我都很喜欢英国的乡间。
ext.ext_en: I've always loved the English countryside...

ext.ext_cn: 我们周边是大片美丽的乡村地区。
ext.ext_en: We are surrounded by lots of beautiful countryside.

defs.def_en: The countryside is land which is away from towns and cities.
A fig is a soft sweet fruit that grows in hot countries. It is full of tiny seeds and is often eaten dried.
A fig or a fig tree is a tree on which figs grow.

defs.def_cn: (对…)丝毫(不)在乎，完全(不)放在心上

ext.ext_cn: 我一点儿也不在乎社会怎么想。
ext.ext_en: I do not give a fig what society thinks.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone doesn't care a fig or doesn't give a fig about something, you are emphasizing that they think it is unimportant or that they are not interested in it.
A mole is a natural dark spot or small dark lump on someone's skin.
A mole is a small animal with black fur that lives underground.

ext.ext_cn: 他被俄国人征募为间谍，并在莫斯科接受了训练。
ext.ext_en: He had been recruited by the Russians as a mole and trained in Moscow.

defs.def_en: A mole is a member of a government or other organization who gives secret information to the press or to a rival organization.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有关探视权的一些无关紧要的争论
ext.ext_en: ...some piffling dispute regarding visiting rights.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as piffling, you are critical of it because it is very small or unimportant.

defs.def_cn: 无日期的；未注明日期的

ext.ext_cn: 每个包裹里都有一摞摞的信件，其中大部分都没有日期。
ext.ext_en: In each packet there are batches of letters, most of which are undated.

defs.def_en: Something that is undated does not have a date written on it.

defs.def_cn: 百花香（各种不同的干花瓣和叶子的混合物，可使室内空气芬芳）
defs.def_en: Potpourri is a mixture of dried petals and leaves from different flowers. Potpourri is used to make rooms smell pleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 世界各地建筑风格的荟萃
ext.ext_en: ...a potpourri of architectural styles from all over the world.

defs.def_en: A potpourri of things is a collection of various different items which were not originally intended to form a group.

ext.ext_cn: 上光的拼花地板
ext.ext_en: ...the polished parquet floors.

defs.def_en: Parquet is  a floor covering made of small rectangular blocks of wood fitted together in a pattern.

ext.ext_cn: 他说话明显结巴。
ext.ext_en: He spoke with a pronounced stutter.

defs.def_en: If someone has a stutter, they find it difficult to say the first sound of a word, and so they often hesitate or repeat it two or three times.

ext.ext_cn: 我抖得厉害，感觉说话舌头会打结。
ext.ext_en: I was trembling so hard, I thought I would stutter when I spoke.

defs.def_en: If someone stutters, they have difficulty speaking because they find it hard to say the first sound of a word.

defs.def_cn: 缓慢地颠簸前进;曲折缓慢地进行

ext.ext_cn: 这辆旧卡车在蜿蜒的公路上缓慢地颠簸前行。
ext.ext_en: The old truck stuttered along the winding road...

ext.ext_cn: 政治辩论一波三折地艰难进行着。
ext.ext_en: The political debate stutters on.

defs.def_en: If something stutters along, it progresses slowly and unevenly.

ext.ext_cn: 16 名年轻人出发去寻求帮助，但在下山过程中有 3 人因寒冷和大雨晕倒了。
ext.ext_en: Sixteen of the youngsters set off for help, but during the descent three collapsed in the cold and rain.

ext.ext_cn: 空客 A300 在加德满都机场降落时的坠毁
ext.ext_en: ...the crash of an Airbus A300 on its descent into Kathmandu airport.

defs.def_en: A descent is a movement from a higher to a lower level or position.

ext.ext_cn: 在坡道上，自行车手飞驰着超越了一辆辆汽车，靠着惯性一路疾冲下山。
ext.ext_en: On the descents, cyclists spin past cars, freewheeling downhill at tremendous speed.

defs.def_en: A descent is a surface that slopes downwards, for example the side of a steep hill.

ext.ext_cn: 唯一的长久之计是通过政治手段解决。否则，他们势必会陷入一片混乱。
ext.ext_en: The only lasting solution lies in a political settlement. Without it, their descent into chaos will be guaranteed.

ext.ext_cn: 他从一名受人尊敬的学者到一个度日艰难的小商人的瞬间沦落
ext.ext_en: ...his swift descent from respected academic to struggling small businessman.

defs.def_en: When you want to emphasize that a situation becomes very bad, you can talk about someone's or something's descent into that situation.

ext.ext_cn: 所有的撰稿人都是非裔人士。
ext.ext_en: All the contributors were of African descent.

defs.def_en: You use descent to talk about a person's family background, for example their nationality or social status.
Someone's genitals are their external sexual organs.

ext.ext_cn: 保持外生殖器清洁。
ext.ext_en: Keep the genital area clean.

defs.def_en: Genital means relating to a person's external sexual organs.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第14个字母
defs.def_en: N is the fourteenth letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_cn: (用于首字母为 n 的一些单词的缩写，如 north, northern 和 noun)
defs.def_en: N or n is used as an abbreviation for words beginning with N or n, such as 'north', northern', or 'noun'.

defs.def_cn: =) cardiopulmonary resuscitation .心肺复苏;人工呼吸

ext.ext_cn: 麦克马伦进行人工呼吸，其他旁观者则打了911。
ext.ext_en: McMullen performed CPR while other bystanders called 911.

defs.def_en: CPR is a medical technique for reviving someone whose heart has stopped beating by pressing on their chest and breathing into their mouth. CPR is an abbreviation for (缩略
A cataclysm is an event that causes great change or harm.
Creepers are plants with long stems that wind themselves around objects.
Broccoli is a vegetable with green stalks and green or purple tops.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的燃料用完了。
ext.ext_en: They ran out of fuel.

ext.ext_cn: 对更清洁燃料的工业研究
ext.ext_en: ...industrial research into cleaner fuels.

defs.def_en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, oil, or petrol that is burned to provide heat or power.

defs.def_cn: 刺激;使变得更糟;使加剧

ext.ext_cn: 这一结果将不可避免地加剧人们对首相未来的揣测。
ext.ext_en: The result will inevitably fuel speculation about the Prime Minister's future...

ext.ext_cn: 宽松的信贷政策刺激了经济繁荣。
ext.ext_en: The economic boom was fueled by easy credit.

defs.def_en: To fuel a situation means to make it become worse or more intense.

ext.ext_cn: 他的话必将为争论推波助澜。
ext.ext_en: His comments are bound to add fuel to the debate...

ext.ext_cn: 上调进口关税的决定只会火上浇油。
ext.ext_en: The decision to raise tariffs on imports will only add fuel to the fire.

defs.def_en: If something adds fuel to a conflict or debate, or adds fuel to the fire, it makes the conflict or debate more intense.

defs.def_cn: 双语的；涉及两种语言的；使用两种语言的

ext.ext_cn: 双语教育
ext.ext_en: ...bilingual education.

ext.ext_cn: 柯林斯双语词典
ext.ext_en: ...the Collins bilingual dictionaries.

defs.def_en: Bilingual means involving or using two languages.

defs.def_cn: 双语的；能说两种语言的

ext.ext_cn: 他会说一门亚洲语言和一门英语。
ext.ext_en: He is bilingual in an Asian language and English.

defs.def_en: Someone who is bilingual can speak two languages equally well, usually because they learned both languages as a child.

ext.ext_cn: 真正富有激情的歌曲
ext.ext_en: ...songs of genuine passion and ardour.

ext.ext_cn: 我对足球的热情
ext.ext_en: ...my ardor for football.

defs.def_en: Ardour is a strong, intense feeling of love or enthusiasm for someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 也许你不应该太仓促地否定这个想法。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps you shouldn't brush the idea aside too hastily...

ext.ext_cn: 他不理会我的政治观点。
ext.ext_en: He brushed away my views on politics.

defs.def_en: If you brush aside or brush away an idea, remark, or feeling, you refuse to consider it because you think it is not important or useful, even though it may be.

ext.ext_cn: 她的问候中带着一丝傲慢。
ext.ext_en: There was a tinge of condescension in her greeting.

defs.def_en: Condescension is condescending behaviour.
A thimble is a small metal or plastic object which you use to protect your finger when you are sewing.

ext.ext_cn: 即将在北京举行的亚运会
ext.ext_en: ...the upcoming Asian Games in Beijing...

ext.ext_cn: 在即将到来的选举中，我们将面临一场恶斗。
ext.ext_en: We'll face a tough fight in the upcoming election.

defs.def_en: Upcoming events will happen in the near future.

ext.ext_cn: 在大屠杀中玛丽亚失去了62岁的母亲。
ext.ext_en: Maria lost her 62-year-old mother in the massacre.

ext.ext_cn: 关于屠杀、拷打与挨饿的报道
ext.ext_en: ...reports of massacre, torture and starvation.

defs.def_en: A massacre is the killing of a large number of people at the same time in a violent and cruel way.  →see usage note at:kill

defs.def_cn: 大规模屠杀;大规模残杀

ext.ext_cn: 据信有300位平民被叛乱分子残杀。
ext.ext_en: 300 civilians are believed to have been massacred by the rebels...

ext.ext_cn: 军队肆无忌惮地屠杀手无寸铁的民众。
ext.ext_en: Troops indiscriminately massacred the defenceless population.

defs.def_en: If people are massacred, a large number of them are attacked and killed in a violent and cruel way.

ext.ext_cn: 正式国事访问的盛况
ext.ext_en: ...all the pageantry of an official state visit.

defs.def_en: People use pageantry to refer to the colourful and formal things that are done for special official or royal occasions, for example the wearing of special clothes and the playing of special music.

defs.def_cn: 阿堵物；孔方兄；金钱收益；（尤指）不义之财

ext.ext_cn: 这样他们就可以对那大把大把的黑心钱感到不那么内疚
ext.ext_en: ...so they can feel less guilty about their piles of filthy lucre.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to money or profit as lucre, especially when they think that it has been obtained by dishonest means.

ext.ext_cn: 足球重约400克。
ext.ext_en: A football weighs about 400 grams.

defs.def_en: A gram is a unit of weight. One thousand grams are equal to one kilogram.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个冒牌医生。
ext.ext_en: He was an imposter, who masqueraded as a doctor.

defs.def_en: Someone who is an impostor is dishonestly pretending to be someone else in order to gain an advantage.

ext.ext_cn: 不包括管理开支在内，销售营业利润平均为15%到16%
ext.ext_en: ...an average operating profit of 15% to 16% of sales, not counting administrative expenses.

defs.def_en: Not counting a particular thing means not including that thing. Counting a particular thing means including that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 中国南方生长着一棵已有1,700年历史的茶树，高100多英尺，而且还在不断长高。
ext.ext_en: There is a 1,700-year-old tea tree still living in southern China which is more than 100 feet tall and counting.

defs.def_en: If you say and counting after a number or an amount of something, you mean that the number or amount is continuing to increase.

ext.ext_cn: 装有杜比降噪系统的磁带盒
ext.ext_en: ...a cassette deck equipped with Dolby noise reduction.

defs.def_en: Dolby is a system which reduces the background noise on electronic cassette players.
A storecard is a plastic card that you use to buy goods on credit from a particular store or group of stores.

ext.ext_cn: 他大腿后侧感到刺痛。
ext.ext_en: The backs of his thighs tingled.

ext.ext_cn: 先甜后苦，在舌头上留下一丝刺痛感觉的味道
ext.ext_en: …a taste which is first sweet, then bitter, leaving a tingling sensation on the tongue.

defs.def_en: When a part of your body tingles, you have a slight stinging feeling there.

ext.ext_cn: 她激动不已。
ext.ext_en: She tingled with excitement...

ext.ext_cn: 当我放眼望去见到特里时，我整个人兴奋不已。
ext.ext_en: When I look over and see Terry I tingle all over.

defs.def_en: If you tingle with a feeling such as excitement, you feel it very strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 两个领导被这个建议搞晕了。
ext.ext_en: The two leaders were flummoxed by the suggestion.

defs.def_en: If someone is flummoxed by something, they are confused by it and do not know what to do or say.

ext.ext_cn: 在工作日夜晚播出的时长半小时的节目
ext.ext_en: ...the half-hour weeknight show.

defs.def_en: A weeknight is the evening or night of a weekday.

defs.def_cn: 抬出名人显要以提高身价;说出名人名字以抬高自己

ext.ext_cn: 那位助手继续对同伴讲个不停，搬出他认识的所有知名自行车赛手。
ext.ext_en: The assistant carried on talking to his mate, name-dropping all the famous riders he knew...

ext.ext_cn: 我不能再说每位知名人士都是我的好朋友了，听起来像是我在借他们抬高自己。
ext.ext_en: I must stop saying everyone famous is a good friend. It sounds as if I'm name-dropping.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone name-drops, you disapprove of them referring to famous people they have met in order to impress people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: You use hen-pecked to describe a man when you disapprove of the fact that his wife, or another woman, is always telling him what to do or telling him that he has done something wrong.
Aren't is the usual spoken form of 'are not'.

defs.def_cn: （am not的口语形式，用于疑问句或附加问句中）
defs.def_en: Aren't is the form of 'am not' that is used in questions or tags in spoken English.

defs.def_cn: 野外运动(如打猎、钓鱼、射击等)
defs.def_en: Hunting, shooting birds, and fishing with a rod are referred to as field sports when they are done mainly for pleasure.

ext.ext_cn: 由兰斯顿·休斯作词的库尔特·韦尔的百老汇歌剧
ext.ext_en: ...Kurt Weill's Broadway opera with lyrics by Langston Hughes.

defs.def_en: The lyrics of a song are its words.

ext.ext_cn: 劳伦斯精彩的短篇小说和抒情诗
ext.ext_en: ...Lawrence's splendid short stories and lyric poetry.

defs.def_en: Lyric poetry is written in a simple and direct style, and usually expresses personal emotions such as love.

defs.def_cn: (在艺术、音乐、芭蕾舞等方面的训练)正规地，传统地

ext.ext_cn: 彼得是受过正规训练的钢琴家。
ext.ext_en: Peter is a classically trained pianist.

defs.def_en: Someone who has been classically trained in something such as art, music, or ballet has learned the traditional skills and methods of that subject.

defs.def_cn: 基于古希腊和古罗马文化地;与古典文化有关地

ext.ext_cn: 受古典文化启发建立的圣弗朗西斯科教堂
ext.ext_en: ...the classically inspired church of S. Francesco.

defs.def_en: Classically is used to indicate that something is based on or reminds people of the culture of ancient Greece and Rome.

ext.ext_cn: 5只形状古朴的花瓶
ext.ext_en: ...five classically shaped vases...

ext.ext_cn: 年纪大一点的女性穿古朴典雅的服装最好看。
ext.ext_en: Older women look best in classically elegant styles.

defs.def_en: Something that is classically designed is traditional, and beautiful in a simple way.

ext.ext_cn: 一般来说，超重的人往往低估自己摄入食物的量。
ext.ext_en: Classically, overweight people underestimate the volume of food that they consume.

defs.def_en: You use classically to indicate that you are saying what usually happens in the case of a particular type of thing.

ext.ext_cn: 该诗集虽然可能号称收录广泛，但并未涵盖所有苏格兰诗歌。
ext.ext_en: Varied though the anthology may claim to be, it does not cover the whole gamut of Scottish poetry...

ext.ext_cn: 上周随着故事情节的展开，我的心情可以说是跌宕起伏：从震惊、气愤、悲伤到憎恶与困惑。
ext.ext_en: As the story unfolded throughout the past week, I experienced the gamut of emotions: shock, anger, sadness, disgust, confusion.

defs.def_en: The gamut of something is the complete range of things of that kind, or a wide variety of things of that kind.

ext.ext_cn: 展览涵盖20世纪的各种设计。
ext.ext_en: The show runs the gamut of 20th century design...

ext.ext_cn: 围绕银行倒闭的丑闻看来会持续到第3个年头。
ext.ext_en: The scandal surrounding the collapse of the bank looked set to rumble on for a third year.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as an argument rumbles on, you mean that it continues for a long time after it should have been settled.

defs.def_cn: 在…种满草； 在…上覆盖草皮

ext.ext_cn: 原来的柏油操场已经覆上了草皮或种满了鲜花。
ext.ext_en: The asphalt playgrounds have been grassed over or sown with flowers.

defs.def_en: If an area of ground is grassed over, grass is planted all over it.
Peanut butter is a brown paste made out of crushed peanuts which you can spread on bread and eat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 奸诈的;骗人的;两面派的

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个贪婪、奸诈而又蛮不讲理的人。
ext.ext_en: He is a possessive, duplicitous and unreasonable man.

defs.def_en: Someone who is duplicitous is deceitful.

ext.ext_cn: 他的政治观点遭到左派的抨击。
ext.ext_en: His political opinions have attracted the opprobrium of the Left.

ext.ext_cn: 公众的责难
ext.ext_en: ...public opprobrium.

defs.def_en: Opprobrium is open criticism or disapproval of something that someone has done.

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词或名词后构成形容词）表示“有…底的”

ext.ext_cn: 活底饼罐
ext.ext_en: ...a loose-bottomed cake tin.

ext.ext_cn: 玻璃底的船
ext.ext_en: ...a glass-bottomed boat.

defs.def_en: -bottomed can be added to adjectives or nouns to form adjectives that indicate what kind of bottom an object or person has.

ext.ext_cn: 有相当多的人对财政大臣作出的经济会迅猛发展的预测表示怀疑。
ext.ext_en: There was considerable scepticism about the Chancellor's forecast of a booming economy...

ext.ext_cn: 那份报告不可避免地受到了质疑。
ext.ext_en: The report has inevitably been greeted with scepticism.

defs.def_en: Scepticism is great doubt about whether something is true or useful.

ext.ext_cn: 客户使用因特网不是按分钟计费的，而是交固定的费用后便可以随意使用。
ext.ext_en: Clients are not charged by the minute but given unmetered access to the Internet for a fixed fee.

defs.def_en: An unmetered service for something such as water supply or telephone access is one that allows you to use as much as you want for a basic cost, rather than paying for the amount you use.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 美国人和俄罗斯人都迫切希望避免在南亚发生冲突。
ext.ext_en: Both the Americans and the Russians are anxious to avoid conflict in South Asia...

ext.ext_cn: 他非常希望不会出现延误。
ext.ext_en: He is anxious that there should be no delay...

defs.def_en: If you are anxious to do something or anxious that something should happen, you very much want to do it or very much want it to happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 外交部长承认对于该国的局势他仍然颇感忧虑。
ext.ext_en: The foreign minister admitted he was still anxious about the situation in the country...

ext.ext_cn: 我的一个朋友是个非常容易焦虑不安的人。
ext.ext_en: A friend of mine is a very anxious person.

defs.def_en: If you are anxious, you are nervous or worried about something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （时间或局势）紧张的，令人焦虑的，让人担忧的

ext.ext_cn: 在明晚计票完成之前，首相将面临数小时的煎熬等待。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister faces anxious hours before the votes are counted tomorrow night.

defs.def_en: An anxious time or situation is one during which you feel nervous and worried.
A chamberlain is the person who is in charge of the household affairs of a king, queen, or person of high social rank.

defs.def_cn: 有自杀倾向的;想自杀的

ext.ext_cn: 我当时想自杀，一直哭个不停。
ext.ext_en: I was suicidal and just couldn't stop crying...

ext.ext_cn: 她的自杀倾向又持续了几周。
ext.ext_en: Her suicidal tendencies continued for several more weeks.

defs.def_en: People who are suicidal want to kill themselves.

defs.def_cn: 自取灭亡的;有致命危险的

ext.ext_cn: 他们意识到面对力量相差如此悬殊的军队，抵抗无异于自取灭亡。
ext.ext_en: They realized it would be suicidal to resist in the face of overwhelming military superiority.

ext.ext_cn: 新德里非常危险的人力车
ext.ext_en: ...the suicidal bicycle rickshaws of New Delhi.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action or behaviour as suicidal, you mean that it is very dangerous.

ext.ext_cn: 没过五分钟，马和骑手都大汗淋漓。
ext.ext_en: Both horse and rider were dripping with sweat within five minutes...

ext.ext_cn: 他擦了擦脸上的汗水并四处张望。
ext.ext_en: He wiped the sweat off his face and looked around...

defs.def_en: Sweat is the salty colourless liquid which comes through your skin when you are hot, ill, or afraid.

ext.ext_cn: 在阳光的强烈照射下他们已经汗流浃背。
ext.ext_en: Already they were sweating as the sun beat down upon them.

defs.def_en: When you sweat, sweat comes through your skin.

ext.ext_cn: 每天早上我都会出一身汗。
ext.ext_en: Every morning I would break out in a sweat...

ext.ext_cn: 大量出汗后要慢慢降温。
ext.ext_en: Cool down very gradually after working up a sweat...

defs.def_en: If someone is in a sweat, they are sweating a lot.
Sweats are the same as a sweatsuit or sweatpants .

defs.def_cn: 冒冷汗，出冷汗(指感到害怕或难堪)

ext.ext_cn: 一想到这我就一身冷汗。
ext.ext_en: The very thought brought me out in a cold sweat.

defs.def_en: If someone is in a cold sweat or in a sweat, they feel frightened or embarrassed.

ext.ext_cn: 岛民不知道自己是否要被迫去往他处另谋生路，但却无能为力，只好干等。
ext.ext_en: The islanders can do little but sweat it out, wondering whether they will be forced to go and seek a new life elsewhere.

defs.def_en: If someone sweats it out, they wait anxiously for a situation to improve or be resolved, because they cannot do anything about it.

ext.ext_cn: “非常感谢。”——“没什么，还需要别的吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'Many thanks.' — 'No sweat. Anything else?'...

ext.ext_cn: 没有人在意她是个女人，这完全没有关系。
ext.ext_en: No-one minds that she's a woman, that's no sweat at all.

defs.def_en: If a person says no sweat when you ask them about something or ask them to do something, they mean that it is not a problem or that it can be done quickly or easily.

ext.ext_cn: 她很想念他。
ext.ext_en: She thought of him with affection...

ext.ext_cn: 她逐渐对这个地方钟爱有加。
ext.ext_en: She had developed quite an affection for the place.

defs.def_en: If you regard someone or something with affection, you like them and are fond of them.

ext.ext_cn: 他一厢情愿地爱慕卡罗琳。
ext.ext_en: The distant object of his affections is Caroline...

ext.ext_cn: 杰克·拉塞尔在打板球的人心中有着特殊的地位。
ext.ext_en: Jack Russell has a special place in the affections of the cricketing public.

defs.def_en: Your affections are your feelings of love or fondness for someone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对新技术会带来有益成效的乐观态度
ext.ext_en: ...optimism about the beneficent effects of new technology.

defs.def_en: A beneficent person or thing helps people or results in something good.

defs.def_cn: 医治者;（尤指通过祷告和宗教信念治疗的）信仰疗法术士
defs.def_en: A healer is a person who heals people, especially a person who heals through prayer and religious faith.

ext.ext_cn: 他们为了打动客户不惜坑蒙拐骗，因而声名狼藉。
ext.ext_en: They are notorious for resorting to trickery in order to impress their clients.

defs.def_en: Trickery is the use of dishonest methods in order to achieve something.

defs.def_cn: 穿梭外交(指国家元首拒绝直接对话的国家之间解决争端的外交方式)

ext.ext_cn: 联合国调解员在双方之间进行穿梭外交。
ext.ext_en: UN mediators are conducting shuttle diplomacy between the two sides.

defs.def_en: Shuttle diplomacy is the movement of diplomats between countries whose leaders refuse to talk directly to each other, in order to try to settle the argument between them.

ext.ext_cn: 芒克顿园艺展览会
ext.ext_en: ...Monkton horticultural show.

defs.def_en: Horticultural means concerned with horticulture.

ext.ext_cn: 他可能会被禁止离开该国。
ext.ext_en: He would not be allowed to leave the country...

ext.ext_cn: 我就是受不了要离开我的小女儿。
ext.ext_en: I simply couldn't bear to leave my little girl...

defs.def_en: If you leave a place or person, you go away from that place or person.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有获得任何学历证书便离开了学校。
ext.ext_en: He left school with no qualifications...

ext.ext_cn: 我辞职是为了专心写小说。
ext.ext_en: I am leaving to concentrate on writing fiction.

defs.def_en: If you leave an institution, group, or job, you permanently stop attending that institution, being a member of that group, or doing that job.

defs.def_cn: 抛下，离弃（配偶）；离开（关系亲密的人）

ext.ext_cn: 他不会离开你的，你不用担心。
ext.ext_en: He'll never leave you. You need have no worry...

ext.ext_cn: 要是比尔为了别的女人离开我，我会醋意大发。
ext.ext_en: I would be insanely jealous if Bill left me for another woman.

defs.def_en: If you leave your husband, wife, or some other person with whom you have had a close relationship, you stop living with them or you finish the relationship.

ext.ext_cn: 我把包放在车里了。
ext.ext_en: I left my bags in the car...

ext.ext_cn: 别把货车停在那儿。
ext.ext_en: Don't  leave your truck there...

defs.def_en: If you leave something or someone in a particular place, you let them remain there when you go away. If you leave something or someone with a person, you let them remain with that person so they are safe while you are away.

ext.ext_cn: 您可以在我们的答录机上留言。
ext.ext_en: You can leave a message on our answering machine...

ext.ext_cn: 选定球放在A、B、C、D哪个方格，然后打电话来，留下您的答案。
ext.ext_en: Decide whether the ball is in square A, B, C, or D, then call and leave your answer...

defs.def_en: If you leave a message or an answer, you write it, record it, or give it to someone so that it can be found or passed on.

ext.ext_cn: 索尔特开车走了，剩下卡伦德勘查现场。
ext.ext_en: Salter drove off, leaving Callendar surveying the scene.

defs.def_en: If you leave someone doing something, they are doing that thing when you go away from them.

defs.def_cn: 听任（某人做某事）；听（某人）自便

ext.ext_cn: 那我还是让你一个人接着干吧。
ext.ext_en: I'd better leave you to get on with it, then...

ext.ext_cn: 戴安娜会意，任由他们自己去解决。
ext.ext_en: Diana took the hint and left them to it...

defs.def_en: If you leave someone to do something, you go away from them so that they do it on their own. If you leave someone to himself or herself, you go away from them and allow them to be alone.

ext.ext_cn: 他总是留下一点儿食物第二天吃。
ext.ext_en: He always left a little food for the next day...

ext.ext_cn: 以下任何一间酒店的双人房价格都不到150英镑。
ext.ext_en: Double rooms at any of the following hotels should leave you some change from £150.

defs.def_en: To leave an amount of something means to keep it available after the rest has been used or taken away.
If you take one number away from another, you can say that it leaves the number that remains. For example, five take away two leaves three.

defs.def_cn: （尤指把令人不快或困难的事）留给，扔给（某人）

ext.ext_cn: 造成他锁骨骨折的车祸
ext.ext_en: ...a crash which left him with a broken collarbone...

ext.ext_cn: 他扔下我独自拉扯一个孩子。
ext.ext_en: He left me with a child to support.

defs.def_en: To leave someone with something, especially when that thing is unpleasant or difficult to deal with, means to make them have it or make them responsible for it.

ext.ext_cn: 造成至少10人死亡的暴乱
ext.ext_en: ...violent disturbances which have left at least ten people dead...

ext.ext_cn: 那部纪录片使我大为震惊。
ext.ext_en: The documentary left me in a state of shock...

defs.def_en: If an event leaves people or things in a particular state, they are in that state when the event has finished.

defs.def_cn: （常指因不喜欢而）不碰（食物或饮料）

ext.ext_cn: 你要是不喜欢你要的鸡尾酒，就别喝了，要点别的吧。
ext.ext_en: If you don't like the cocktail you ordered, just leave it and try a different one.

defs.def_en: If you leave food or drink, you do not eat or drink it, often because you do not like it.

ext.ext_cn: 肌肉撕裂复原后会留下疤痕。
ext.ext_en: A muscle tear will leave a scar after healing...

ext.ext_cn: 她给他留下了难以忘怀的印象。
ext.ext_en: She left a lasting impression on him.

defs.def_en: If something leaves a mark, effect, or sign, it causes that mark, effect, or sign to remain as a result.

defs.def_cn: 使处于（某个状态或位置）

ext.ext_cn: 他把相册摊在桌上没收。
ext.ext_en: He left the album open on the table...

ext.ext_cn: 我没把车灯关掉。
ext.ext_en: I've  left the car lights on...

defs.def_en: If you leave something in a particular state, position, or condition, you let it remain in that state, position, or condition.

ext.ext_cn: 上下各留一个口子通风。
ext.ext_en: Leave a gap at the top and bottom so air can circulate.

defs.def_en: If you leave a space or gap in something, you deliberately make that space or gap.

defs.def_cn: 把（工作）交托；把（决定或选择权）留交

ext.ext_cn: 贴上蓝色的空邮标签，其余的事情交给我们。
ext.ext_en: Affix the blue airmail label and leave the rest to us...

ext.ext_cn: 法官本不该把案子交给陪审团来裁定。
ext.ext_en: The judge should not have left it to the jury to decide...

defs.def_en: If you leave a job, decision, or choice to someone, you give them the responsibility for dealing with it or making it.

defs.def_cn: （安排、协议等很大程度上）视乎，取决于

ext.ext_cn: 停火协议的执行很大程度取决于各方武装力量的意愿。
ext.ext_en: The ceasefire leaves a lot to the goodwill of the forces involved...

ext.ext_cn: 这只是个模糊的构想，许多方面还要由地方当局来定夺。
ext.ext_en: It's  a vague formulation that leaves much to the discretion of local authorities.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as an arrangement or an agreement leaves a lot to another thing or person, you are critical of it because it is not adequate and its success depends on the other thing or person.

defs.def_cn: 限制（某人于某一行动或机会）

ext.ext_cn: 这样我只有一条路可走。
ext.ext_en: This left me only one possible course of action...

ext.ext_cn: 他除了辞职外别无选择。
ext.ext_en: He was left with no option but to resign.

defs.def_en: To leave someone with a particular course of action or the opportunity to do something means to let it be available to them, while restricting them in other ways.

ext.ext_cn: 不要把什么都拖到最后一分钟。
ext.ext_en: Don't leave it all until the last minute.

ext.ext_cn: 但愿我没有错失良机。
ext.ext_en: I hope I haven't left it too late.

defs.def_en: If you leave something until a particular time, you delay doing it or dealing with it until then.

ext.ext_cn: 我看我们最好还是搁下民族主义这个话题吧。
ext.ext_en: I think we'd better leave the subject of Nationalism...

ext.ext_cn: 他建议我们找个时间出来喝一杯。我说好，然后我们就换了个话题。
ext.ext_en: He suggested we get together for a drink sometime. I said I'd like that, and we left it there.

defs.def_en: If you leave a particular subject, you stop talking about it and start discussing something else.

ext.ext_cn: 他于两年半后去世，把所有遗产都留给了妻子。
ext.ext_en: He died two and a half years later, leaving everything to his wife.

defs.def_en: If you leave property or money to someone, you arrange for it to be given to them after you have died.

ext.ext_cn: 他的仁爱精神，以及他的音乐，都将长留在无数友人和学生的记忆里。他身后遗下妻子和一对儿女。
ext.ext_en: It is for his humanity as much as his music that his numerous friends and pupils will remember him. He leaves a wife, son and daughter.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone leaves a wife, husband, or a particular number of children, you mean that the wife, husband, or children remain alive after that person has died.

ext.ext_cn: 你为什么不休几天假？
ext.ext_en: Why don't you take a few days' leave?

ext.ext_cn: 产假
ext.ext_en: ...maternity leave...

defs.def_en: Leave is a period of time when you are not working at your job, because you are on holiday or vacation, or for some other reason. If you are on leave, you are not working at your job.

ext.ext_cn: 不服法官指令的上诉申请
ext.ext_en: ...an application for leave to appeal against the judge's order.

defs.def_en: If you ask for leave to do something, you ask for permission to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 有人需要直面过去的创伤，有人则觉得不去想它为妙。
ext.ext_en: Some people need to confront a traumatic past; others find it better to leave it alone...

ext.ext_cn: 你就不能不管他？
ext.ext_en: Why can't you leave him be?

defs.def_en: If you leave someone or something alone, or if you leave them be, you do not  pay them any attention or bother them.

ext.ext_cn: 如果不去管隐私问题的话，实施不间断监视其实是非常便利的。
ext.ext_en: Leaving aside the question of privacy, constant surveillance can be remarkably convenient.

defs.def_en: You use leaving aside or leaving to one side when mentioning a fact or detail that you want to ignore when making a general statement.

ext.ext_cn: 他感谢他们的愉快陪伴，然后道别走了。
ext.ext_en: He thanked them for the pleasure of their company and took his leave.

defs.def_en: When you take your leave or take leave of someone, you say goodbye and go.

defs.def_cn: 不要弄巧成拙；不要没事找事

ext.ext_cn: 他知道什么时候该适可而止，什么时候该插手干预。
ext.ext_en: He knew when to leave well alone and when to interfere.

defs.def_en: If someone tells you to leave  well alone, they are telling you not to interfere in something, because it is all right as it is and you might only make it worse.

ext.ext_cn: 警察一走，暴力事件就会死灰复燃。
ext.ext_en: As soon as the police disappear the violence will take up from where it left off.

defs.def_en: If something continues from where it left off, it starts happening again at the point where it had previously stopped.
A deciduous tree or bush is one that loses its leaves in the autumn every year.

defs.def_cn: 十年，十年期（尤指一个年代)

ext.ext_cn: 19 世纪的最后 10 年
ext.ext_en: ...the last decade of the nineteenth century.

defs.def_en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

defs.def_cn: (美国供游客骑马和露营的)度假牧场,度假农场
defs.def_en: A dude ranch is an American ranch where people can have holidays during which they can do activities such as riding or camping.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 欧文不幸两次都没有进球。
ext.ext_en: Owen was unlucky not to score on two occasions...

ext.ext_cn: 其他人都是不幸为坠落的瓦砾残片所伤。
ext.ext_en: Others were unlucky victims of falling debris.

defs.def_en: If someone is unlucky, they have bad luck.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人不愉快的；令人遗憾的

ext.ext_cn: 阿根廷队惜败于爱尔兰队
ext.ext_en: ...Argentina's unlucky defeat by Ireland.

defs.def_en: You can use unlucky to describe unpleasant things which happen to someone, especially when you feel that the person does not deserve them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 带来坏运气的；不吉利的

ext.ext_cn: 有些人认为透过玻璃看新月是不吉利的。
ext.ext_en: Some people think it is unlucky to look at a new moon through glass.

defs.def_en: Unlucky is used to describe something that is thought to cause bad luck.

ext.ext_cn: “复活节快乐，”他大喊。
ext.ext_en: 'Happy Easter,' he yelled.

ext.ext_cn: 第一个复活节的早晨
ext.ext_en: ...the first Easter morning.

defs.def_en: Easter is a Christian festival when Jesus Christ's return to life is celebrated. It is celebrated on a Sunday in March or April.

ext.ext_cn: 复活节假期他们通常都会去徒步旅行。
ext.ext_en: They usually have a walking holiday at Easter...

ext.ext_cn: 她带领一群孩子去法国过复活节。
ext.ext_en: She spends her Easter holidays taking groups of children to France...

defs.def_en: Easter is the period of several days around and including Easter Sunday.
Someone who refers to a servant as a flunkey is expressing their dislike for a job that involves doing things for an employer that ordinary people do for themselves.

defs.def_cn: 奉承者;势利小人;马屁精
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a flunkey, you disapprove of the fact that they associate themselves with someone who is powerful and carry out small, unimportant jobs for them in the hope of being rewarded.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: The landscape is everything you can see when you look across an area of land, including hills, rivers, buildings, trees, and plants.  →see usage note at:countryside

ext.ext_cn: 政治形势的改变
ext.ext_en: ...a change in the political landscape.

ext.ext_cn: 愚不可及的情况
ext.ext_en: ...a landscape of unparalleled ignorance.

defs.def_en: A landscape is all the features that are important in a particular situation.

defs.def_cn: 山水风景画；乡村风景画
defs.def_en: A landscape is a painting which shows a scene in the countryside.

defs.def_cn: 对…作景观美化；给…作园林美化

ext.ext_cn: 砾石采掘坑已进行了景观美化并种上了草木，希望能吸引野禽的到来。
ext.ext_en: The gravel pits have been landscaped and planted to make them attractive to wildfowl...

ext.ext_cn: 他们用树木、灌木丛和草坪将房产装点了一番。
ext.ext_en: They had landscaped their property with trees, shrubs, and lawns.

defs.def_en: If an area of land is landscaped, it is changed to make it more attractive, for example by adding streams or ponds and planting trees and bushes.
A wasp is an insect with wings and yellow and black stripes across its body. Wasps have a painful sting like a bee but do not produce honey.

defs.def_cn: 英里(等于1,760 码或约等于1.6公里)

ext.ext_cn: 他们驱车600英里穿越沙漠。
ext.ext_en: They drove 600 miles across the desert...

ext.ext_cn: 飓风正以每小时18英里的速度向西推进。
ext.ext_en: The hurricane is moving to the west at about 18 miles per hour...

defs.def_en: A mile is a unit of distance equal to 1,760 yards or approximately 1.6 kilometres.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你加入的健身馆非常远，就不会去得那么经常了。
ext.ext_en: If you enrol at a gym that's miles away, you won't be visiting it as often as you should...

ext.ext_cn: 我离任何地方都非常远。
ext.ext_en: I was miles and miles from anywhere...

defs.def_en: Miles is used, especially in the expression miles away, to refer to a long distance.

defs.def_cn: 很大的程度（强调区别或目标与现实的差距）

ext.ext_cn: 你比当下我们见到的大多数表演者都强多了。
ext.ext_en: You're miles better than most of the  performers we see nowadays...

ext.ext_cn: 有一个工党的候选人坐镇，他们大获全胜。
ext.ext_en: With a Labour candidate in place they won by a mile...

defs.def_en: Miles or a mile is used with the meaning 'very much' in order to emphasize the difference between two things or qualities, or the difference between what you aimed to do and what you actually achieved.

defs.def_cn: 思想不集中;开小差；走神

ext.ext_cn: 你刚才在想什么呢？你开小差了。
ext.ext_en: What were you thinking about? You were miles away.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is miles away, you mean that they are unaware of what is happening around them because they are thinking about something else.

ext.ext_cn: 总统决心“为实现和平而加倍努力”。
ext.ext_en: The President is determined 'to go the extra mile for peace'.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is willing to go the extra mile, you mean that they are willing to make a special effort to do or achieve something.

ext.ext_cn: 你一眼就可以认出便衣警察。
ext.ext_en: You can spot undercover cops a mile off.

defs.def_en: If you say that you can see or recognize something a mile off, you are emphasizing that it is very obvious and easy to recognize.

defs.def_cn: (因极度害怕或不愿面对)避而远之，跑得远远的

ext.ext_cn: 若是有人在我刚结婚时跟我说我会生7个孩子，我一定会躲得远远的。
ext.ext_en: If anybody had told me when I first got married that I was going to have seven children, I would have run a mile...

ext.ext_cn: 我神经非常脆弱，见到针头就会逃之夭夭。
ext.ext_en: I'm very squeamish and when I see needles I run a mile.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone would run a mile when faced with a particular situation, you mean that they would be very frightened or unwilling to deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: “你是怎么知道他是爱尔兰人的呢？”——“明摆的事嘛。”
ext.ext_en: 'How do you know he's Irish?' —'Sticks out a mile.'...

ext.ext_cn: 上学第一天，我们就非常惹人注意。
ext.ext_en: We stood out a mile on that first day at school.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone sticks out a mile or stands out a mile, you are emphasizing that they are very obvious and easy to recognize.

ext.ext_cn: 我们设想将来会成立一个公司联盟。
ext.ext_en: In the future we envision a federation of companies...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数人确实都在这里停下，想象不到在这之外还会有些什么。
ext.ext_en: Most people do stop at this point, not envisioning that there is anything beyond.

defs.def_en: If you envision something, you envisage it.
A screen door is a door made of fine netting which is on the outside of the main door of a house. It is used to keep insects out when the main door is open.
Sweetcorn is a long rounded vegetable covered in small yellow seeds. It is part of the maize plant. The seeds themselves can also be referred to as sweetcorn .

ext.ext_cn: 祈求神的指引
ext.ext_en: ...an invocation for divine guidance.

defs.def_en: An invocation is a request for help or forgiveness made to a god.

ext.ext_cn: 请起立对旗宣誓,之后杰尔姆·泰勒博士将做祈祷。
ext.ext_en: Please stand and pledge the flag, after which Dr. Jerome Taylor will give the invocation.

defs.def_en: An invocation is a prayer at a public meeting, usually at the beginning.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在第四大街的一家意大利餐馆吃了饭。
ext.ext_en: They ate in an Italian restaurant in Forth Street...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在这家宾馆的餐厅吃了晚饭。
ext.ext_en: We had dinner in the hotel's restaurant.

defs.def_en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.  →see usage note at:café

defs.def_cn: 篝火之夜（“盖伊·福克斯之夜”的俗称）
defs.def_en: Bonfire Night is the popular name for Guy Fawkes Night .

defs.def_cn: (尤指烹饪时)测量（或称量）用的(壶、杯、匙等)
defs.def_en: A measuring jug, cup, or spoon is specially designed for measuring quantities, especially in cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 《古兰经》将天国描述成一个乐园。
ext.ext_en: The Koran describes paradise as a place containing a garden of delight...

ext.ext_cn: 如果被捕，他们希望去死，因为他们相信自己能够上天堂。
ext.ext_en: If they were captured they wished to die, believing that they would go to paradise.

defs.def_en: According to some religions, paradise is a wonderful place where people go after they die, if they have led good lives.

ext.ext_cn: 世界上最美的自然乐园之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the world's great natural paradises...

ext.ext_cn: 斯科特在一家救助无家可归者的慈善机构工作生活。与难民营相比，他称这个慈善机构为乐园。
ext.ext_en: Scott is living and working at a mission for the homeless. He calls it a paradise compared to the camp.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a place or situation that seems beautiful or perfect as paradise or a paradise .

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔加维是高尔夫球手的天堂。
ext.ext_en: The Algarve is a golfer's paradise...

ext.ext_cn: 没多少人有钱享受这个购物天堂。
ext.ext_en: Very few people have the money to take advantage of this consumer paradise.

defs.def_en: See also:fool's paradise;You can use paradise to say that a place is very attractive to a particular kind of person and has everything they need for a particular activity.

defs.def_cn: 不可剥夺的;不能让与的

ext.ext_cn: 他说共和国现在拥有不可剥夺的自决权。
ext.ext_en: He said the republic now had an inalienable right to self-determination.

ext.ext_cn: 对各民族、国家不可剥夺权利的尊重
ext.ext_en: ...respect for the inalienable rights of peoples and nations.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has an inalienable right to something, you are emphasizing that they have a right to it which cannot be changed or taken away.
A plumb line is a piece of string with a weight attached to the end that is used to check that something such as a wall is vertical or that it slopes at the correct angle.

ext.ext_cn: 黑格非常渴望得到一个肯定的回答。
ext.ext_en: Haig was desperately eager for an affirmative answer...

ext.ext_cn: 辛克莱博士虽然点头表示了同意，但还显得有点不情愿。
ext.ext_en: Dr Sinclair's affirmative nod seemed a shade reluctant.

defs.def_en: An affirmative word or gesture indicates that you agree with what someone has said or that the answer to a question is 'yes'.

ext.ext_cn: 他问我是否准备好了，我给出肯定的回答。
ext.ext_en: He asked me if I was ready. I answered in the affirmative.

defs.def_en: If you reply to a question in the affirmative, you say 'yes' or make a gesture that means 'yes'.
In grammar, an affirmative clause is positive and does not contain a negative word.

ext.ext_cn: 开阔的田野和片片树林
ext.ext_en: ...open fields and groves of trees.

ext.ext_cn: 一片橄榄林
ext.ext_en: ...an olive grove.

defs.def_en: A grove is a group of trees that are close together.

ext.ext_cn: 博格诺里吉斯镇加拿大路47号
ext.ext_en: ...47 Canada Grove, Bognor Regis.

defs.def_en: Grove is often used as part of the name of a street.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 狂喜的;极乐的;欣喜若狂的

ext.ext_cn: 妻子生下了他们的第一个孩子，他欣喜若狂。
ext.ext_en: His wife gave birth to their first child, and he was ecstatic about it...

ext.ext_cn: 狂喜的人群欢呼着迎接他们。
ext.ext_en: They were greeted by the cheers of an ecstatic crowd.

defs.def_en: If you are ecstatic, you feel very happy and full of excitement.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们兴致勃勃地聆听了演讲。
ext.ext_en: They gave an ecstatic reception to the speech...

ext.ext_cn: 那部上演的戏备受好评，让观众潸然泪下。
ext.ext_en: The production received ecstatic reviews and had audiences weeping.

defs.def_en: You can use ecstatic to describe reactions that are very enthusiastic and excited. For example, if someone receives an ecstatic reception or an ecstatic welcome, they are greeted with great enthusiasm and excitement.

ext.ext_cn: 业余时间里她看一些烹饪方面的书籍。
ext.ext_en: In her spare time she read books on cooking...

ext.ext_cn: 我把大量业余时间花在看录像上。
ext.ext_en: I spend a lot of my spare time watching videos.

defs.def_en: Your spare time is the time during which you do not have to work and you can do whatever you like.

ext.ext_cn: 诸如欧洲结盟这样超越党派忠诚的议题
ext.ext_en: ...issues like European union that transcend party loyalty.

defs.def_en: Something that transcends normal limits or boundaries goes beyond them, because it is more significant than them.

ext.ext_cn: 他一再读错单词，而且说话含含糊糊的。
ext.ext_en: He repeatedly mispronounced words and slurred his speech.

defs.def_en: If you mispronounce a word, you pronounce it wrongly.

ext.ext_cn: 他打听了一番，发现她已经去了欧陆。
ext.ext_en: He made some inquiries and discovered she had gone to the Continent...

ext.ext_cn: 简短地问了一下圣诞假期之后,他又回到了音乐的话题上。
ext.ext_en: After a brief inquiry about the Christmas holiday, he returned to the subject of music.

defs.def_en: An inquiry is a question which you ask in order to get some information.

ext.ext_cn: 这是 25 年来我所展开的最困难、最令人震惊的谋杀调查。
ext.ext_en: This is the most difficult and shocking murder inquiry I have had to open in the last 25 years...

ext.ext_cn: 民主党要求对事件展开独立调查。
ext.ext_en: The Democratic Party has called for an independent inquiry into the incident.

defs.def_en: An inquiry is an official investigation.

ext.ext_cn: 调查突然转向了一条新的线索。
ext.ext_en: The investigation has suddenly switched to a new line of inquiry.

defs.def_en: Inquiry is the process of asking about or investigating something in order to find out more about it.

ext.ext_cn: 两名男子昨天夜里在索尔兹伯里接受了警方盘问。
ext.ext_en: Two men were helping police with their inquiries at Salisbury last night.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is helping the police with their inquiries, you mean that the police are questioning them about a crime, but have not yet charged them with it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 人为的;虚假的;捏造的;矫揉造作的

ext.ext_cn: 他说的话里没有任何蓄意捏造的成分。
ext.ext_en: There was nothing contrived or calculated about what he said...

ext.ext_cn: 它听起来不能像是虚情假意的恭维。
ext.ext_en: It mustn't sound like a contrived compliment.

defs.def_en: If you say that something someone says or does is contrived, you think it is false and deliberate, rather than natural and not planned.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (戏剧、电影、小说等)虚构的，不足信的，不真实的

ext.ext_cn: 情节看起来不真实。
ext.ext_en: The plot seems contrived.

defs.def_en: If you say that the plot of a play, film, or novel is contrived, you mean that it is unlikely and unconvincing.

defs.def_cn: 支付款；（尤指）大笔付款，大额支出

ext.ext_cn: 还有时间多赢些，后面几天还有一笔1万英镑的奖金。
ext.ext_en: And there's time to win more, with a £10,000 payout still to play for over the next few days.

ext.ext_cn: 迟迟拿不到保险赔付款
ext.ext_en: ...long delays in receiving insurance payouts.

defs.def_en: A payout is a sum of money, especially a large one, that is paid to someone, for example by an insurance company or as a prize.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人愉快的；使人满意的

ext.ext_cn: 法国的这一地区在8月份气候宜人。
ext.ext_en: This area of France has a pleasing climate in August...

ext.ext_cn: 这样的景色令人心旷神怡。
ext.ext_en: Such a view is pleasing...

defs.def_en: Something that is pleasing gives you pleasure and satisfaction.

defs.def_cn: 贷款利率；借款利率；放款利率

ext.ext_cn: 该银行的贷款利率保持不变。
ext.ext_en: The bank left its lending rates unchanged.

defs.def_en: The lending rate is the rate of interest that you have to pay when you are repaying a loan.

ext.ext_cn: 那么，谁来做饭、洗衣、缝补呢？
ext.ext_en: Who will then do the cooking, the washing, the mending?

defs.def_en: See also:mend;Mending is the sewing and repairing of clothes that have got holes in them.

ext.ext_cn: 一艘驳船停在大约 100 码开外，等待着返海回航。
ext.ext_en: A barge was about a hundred yards away, waiting to return seaward...

ext.ext_cn: 它面向北，朝着海。
ext.ext_en: It faced seawards to the north.

defs.def_en: Something that moves or faces seaward or seawards moves or faces in the direction of the sea or further out to sea.

ext.ext_cn: 马路临海一侧的房子全部沦为废墟。
ext.ext_en: The houses on the seaward side of the road were all in ruins.

defs.def_en: The seaward side of something faces in the direction of the sea or further out to sea.

defs.def_cn: 抗组（织）胺药（用于抗过敏）
defs.def_en: An antihistamine is a drug that is used to treat allergies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 凶恶的;残暴的;凶猛的;野的;未驯服的

ext.ext_cn: 这是对一个毫无自卫能力的年轻女孩的野蛮袭击。
ext.ext_en: This was a savage attack on a defenceless young girl.

ext.ext_cn: 1987 年 11 月横扫全国的暴力狂潮
ext.ext_en: ...the savage wave of violence that swept the country in November 1987.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is savage is extremely cruel, violent, and uncontrolled.

ext.ext_cn: 他们深信该地区曾是严寒的沙漠并居住着未开化的野人
ext.ext_en: ...their conviction that the area was a frozen desert peopled with uncouth savages.

defs.def_en: If you refer to people as savages, you dislike them because you think that they do not have an advanced society and are violent.

ext.ext_cn: 接着野兽突然袭击了他，最后把他咬死了。
ext.ext_en: The animal then turned on him and he was savaged to death.

defs.def_en: If someone is savaged by a dog or other animal, the animal attacks them violently.

ext.ext_cn: 这场演出已受到评论家们的激烈抨击。
ext.ext_en: The show had already been savaged by critics...

ext.ext_cn: 发言人纷纷要求进一步明确方向并强烈地抨击了该财政大臣。
ext.ext_en: Speakers called for clearer direction and savaged the Chancellor.

defs.def_en: If someone or something that they have done is savaged by another person, that person criticizes them severely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人扼腕的；令人嘘唏的；使人惋惜的

ext.ext_cn: 这一令人遗憾的事态一直持续至1947年。
ext.ext_en: This lamentable state of affairs lasted until 1947...

ext.ext_cn: 他的英语水平糟得很。
ext.ext_en: His command of English was lamentable.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as lamentable, you mean that it is very unfortunate or disappointing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以入睡的;失眠的;睡眠轻的

ext.ext_cn: 通常睡眠轻的婴儿长大后仍然只需要较少的睡眠。
ext.ext_en: Wakeful babies will often continue to need little sleep as they grow older.

defs.def_en: Someone who is wakeful finds it difficult to get to sleep and wakes up very often when they should be sleeping.

ext.ext_cn: 牛奶、呕吐物和尿布的难闻气味
ext.ext_en: ...the pong of milk and sick and nappies.

defs.def_en: A pong is an unpleasant smell.

A thruway is a wide road that is specially designed so that a lot of traffic can move along it very quickly. It is usually divided along the middle, so that traffic travelling in one direction is separated from the traffic travelling in the opposite direction.

ext.ext_cn: 我进去在大厅里等着。
ext.ext_en: I went and waited in the foyer.

defs.def_en: The foyer is the large area where people meet or wait just inside the main doors of a building such as a theatre, cinema, or hotel.

defs.def_cn: 难以区别的;难以分辨的

ext.ext_cn: 仿真武器与真武器很难区分。
ext.ext_en: Replica weapons are indistinguishable from the real thing.

defs.def_en: If one thing is indistinguishable from another, the two things are so similar that it is difficult to know which is which.

ext.ext_cn: 他被撞见拼命想要解开几盘缠在一起的胶卷。
ext.ext_en: He was found desperately trying to untangle several reels of film.

ext.ext_cn: 一种能理顺头发、增加其光泽的轻柔、无黏性的摩丝
ext.ext_en: ...a light, non-sticky mousse which untangles hair and adds brilliant shine.

defs.def_en: If you untangle something that is knotted or has become twisted around something, you undo the knots in it or free it.

defs.def_cn: 排解，解决，处理（混乱或复杂的局面）

ext.ext_cn: 律师和会计师开始着手梳理这家银行复杂的事务。
ext.ext_en: Lawyers and accountants began trying to untangle the complex affairs of the bank...

ext.ext_cn: 这个问题花了3个小时才解决。
ext.ext_en: The problem took three hours to untangle.

defs.def_en: f you untangle a confused or complicated situation, you make the different things involved clear, or put the situation right.
Loci is the plural of locus .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 寒冷刺骨的夜晚
ext.ext_en: ...sharp, frosty nights.

defs.def_en: If the weather is frosty, the temperature is below freezing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 街上空无一人，只有一只猫在结霜的石砖上拾爪而行。
ext.ext_en: The street was deserted except for a cat lifting its paws off the frosty stones.

defs.def_en: You describe the ground or an object as frosty when it is covered with frost.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 总统在新罕布什尔州可能会受到冷遇。
ext.ext_en: The president may get a frosty reception in New Hampshire...

ext.ext_cn: 很明显关系已经变冷了。
ext.ext_en: The relationship has obviously become frosty.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as frosty, you think it is unfriendly.

ext.ext_cn: 她从在海滩上捡到的贝壳和石子中汲取灵感。
ext.ext_en: She takes her inspiration from shells and stones she finds on the seashore.

defs.def_en: The seashore is the part of a coast where the land slopes down into the sea.

ext.ext_cn: 近几年器官移植方面取得的巨大进步
ext.ext_en: ...the dramatic improvements in organ transplantation in recent years...

ext.ext_cn: 国家现有的用于智障病人治疗的设施还有相当大的改进余地。
ext.ext_en: There is considerable room for improvement in state facilities for treating the mentally handicapped.

defs.def_en: If there is an improvement in something, it becomes better. If you make improvements to something, you make it better.

defs.def_cn: 更优秀之物;改善的事物

ext.ext_cn: 新上任的总理比他的前任要强。
ext.ext_en: The new Prime Minister is an improvement on his predecessor...

ext.ext_cn: 我们 1980 年引进的系统有了很大改进。
ext.ext_en: The system we introduced in 1980 has been a great improvement.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is an improvement on a previous thing or situation, you mean that it is better than that thing.

defs.def_cn: 方丹戈舞(西班牙舞蹈，两人跳舞时贴得很近)
defs.def_en: A fandango is a Spanish dance in which two people dance very close together.

defs.def_cn: 出口国;出口者;出口厂商

ext.ext_cn: 法国是世界第二大农产品出口国。
ext.ext_en: France is the world's second-biggest exporter of agricultural products.

defs.def_en: An exporter is a country, firm, or person that sells and sends goods to another country.
A bathrobe is a loose piece of clothing made of the same material as towels. You wear it before or after you have a bath or a swim.

ext.ext_cn: 他起床后穿上了晨衣。
ext.ext_en: He got out of bed and pulled on his bathrobe.

defs.def_en: A bathrobe is a dressing gown .

defs.def_cn: (浅色或强光背景下衬托出的)暗色轮廓，影像,剪影

ext.ext_cn: 城堡遗迹的黑色轮廓在暮色映衬下清晰可见。
ext.ext_en: The dark silhouette of the castle ruins stood out boldly against the fading light.

defs.def_en: A silhouette is the solid dark shape that you see when someone or something has a bright light or pale background behind them.

ext.ext_cn: 他耳朵的奇特形状
ext.ext_en: ...the distinctive silhouette of his ears...

ext.ext_cn: 这件衬衫最好是松松垮垮地穿在紧身裤外面，或者是塞进裤子里以显出苗条的身材。
ext.ext_en: The shirt's ideal worn loose over leggings or tuck it in for a streamlined silhouette.

defs.def_en: The silhouette of something is the outline that it has, which often helps you to recognize it.

defs.def_cn: 呈侧面影像;呈黑色轮廓像

ext.ext_cn: 即便看到的只是背影的轮廓，比利还是认出了那个人影。
ext.ext_en: Even from behind in silhouette, Billy recognized the figure.

defs.def_en: If you see something in silhouette, you see it as a dark shape with no detail except for the outline.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 深情且忠诚的丈夫
ext.ext_en: ...a loving and devoted husband...

ext.ext_cn: 50年过去了，这对夫妇仍然深爱着彼此。
ext.ext_en: 50 years on, the couple are still devoted to one another.

defs.def_en: Someone who is devoted to a person loves that person very much.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 爱好的;热衷的;致力（于…）的

ext.ext_cn: 多年来我个人一直一心扑在这项事业上。
ext.ext_en: I have personally been devoted to this cause for many years...

ext.ext_cn: 霍勒斯对他的花园太过上心，都有10年没出过远门了。
ext.ext_en: Horace is so devoted to his garden that he hasn't been away for 10 years...

defs.def_en: If you are devoted to something, you care about it a lot and are very enthusiastic about it.

ext.ext_cn: 专门展出残疾人艺术家作品的一个重要巡回展
ext.ext_en: ...a major touring exhibition devoted to the work of disabled artists.

ext.ext_cn: 该商店专营新的一系列配件。
ext.ext_en: The shop is devoted to a new range of accessories.

defs.def_en: Something that is devoted to a particular thing deals only with that thing or contains only that thing.

defs.def_cn: (高速公路边供紧急停车用的)软质路肩
defs.def_en: On a busy road such as a freeway, the soft shoulder is the area at the side of the road where vehicles are allowed to stop in an emergency.

defs.def_cn: 苦艾酒（一种烈酒，色绿味苦）
defs.def_en: Absinthe is a very strong alcoholic drink that is green and tastes bitter.

ext.ext_cn: 在赤贫的路易斯安那州长大的一个少年
ext.ext_en: ...a young boy growing up in dirt poor Louisiana.

defs.def_en: A dirt-poor person or place is extremely poor.

ext.ext_cn: 骇人的人肉宴
ext.ext_en: ...lurid cannibalistic feasts.

defs.def_en: Cannibalistic people and practices are connected with cannibalism.

defs.def_cn: 移植(植物);(使)(植物)适应异地生长环境

ext.ext_cn: 一个朋友从墨西哥给我寄来一个根茎，我希望能在这儿把它种活。
ext.ext_en: A friend sent me a root from Mexico, and I hope to naturalize it...

ext.ext_cn: 这种植物适应了这个环境，在草中生长得很好。
ext.ext_en: The plant naturalises well in grass.

defs.def_en: To naturalize a species of plant means to start it growing in an area where it is not usually found. If a plant naturalizes in an area where it was not found before, it starts to grow there naturally.

ext.ext_cn: 没人期待波罗的海各国会让年轻的俄罗斯士兵加入其国籍，但领取抚恤金的军人可获得公民身份。
ext.ext_en: No one expects the Baltic states to naturalise young Russian soldiers, but army pensioners can be given citizenship.

defs.def_en: See also:naturalized;If the government of a country naturalizes someone, they allow a person who was not born in that country to become a citizen of it.

defs.def_cn: 动员;鼓动;召集；（人们）动员起来

ext.ext_cn: 最好的希望是我们能争取到国际上的支持，然后采取行动。
ext.ext_en: The best hope is that we will mobilize international support and get down to action...

ext.ext_cn: 此行的目的就是动员公众对这个备受争议的问题发表意见。
ext.ext_en: The purpose of the journey is to mobilise public opinion on the controversial issue...

defs.def_en: If you mobilize support or mobilize people to do something, you succeed in encouraging people to take action, especially political action. If people mobilize, they prepare to take action.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你能够调集资源，就可以把这件事做成。
ext.ext_en: If you could mobilize the resources, you could get it done.

defs.def_en: If you mobilize resources, you start to use them or make them available for use.

defs.def_cn: (国家或军队)动员起来;动员(军队)

ext.ext_cn: 作为对最后通牒的回应，苏丹甚至威胁说要动员军队。
ext.ext_en: Sudan even threatened to mobilize in response to the ultimatums...

ext.ext_cn: 印度现在更有条件动员军队了。
ext.ext_en: India is now in a better position to mobilise its forces...

defs.def_en: If a country mobilizes, or mobilizes its armed forces, or if its armed forces mobilize, they are given orders to prepare for a conflict.

defs.def_cn: (组织、系统在一定时间内的)工作量，生产量，吞吐量

ext.ext_cn: 能让我们大幅提高工作效率的技术
ext.ext_en: ...technologies which will allow us to get much higher throughput...

ext.ext_cn: 业务量仍然可以。
ext.ext_en: There's still a reasonable throughput of business.

defs.def_en: The throughput of an organization or system is the amount of things it can do or deal with in a particular period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 世界汽车工业的生产能力严重过剩。
ext.ext_en: There is huge overcapacity in the world car industry.

defs.def_en: If there is overcapacity in a particular industry or area, more goods have been produced than are needed, and the industry is therefore less profitable than it could be.

ext.ext_cn: 经济改革的蓝图
ext.ext_en: ...the master plan for the reform of the economy.

defs.def_en: A master plan is a clever plan that is intended to help someone succeed in a very difficult or important task.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 劳拉十分冷静沉着。
ext.ext_en: Laura was very calm and composed...

ext.ext_cn: 这并不是我所期待的那种祥和平静的体验。
ext.ext_en: It wasn't the peaceful, composed experience I had expected.

defs.def_en: If someone is composed, they are calm and able to control their feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 她没有从事护理工作的天资。
ext.ext_en: She had no aptitude for nursing...

ext.ext_cn: 护理人员看上去在乎吗？
ext.ext_en: Does the nursing staff seem to care?

defs.def_en: Nursing is the profession of looking after people who are ill.

ext.ext_cn: 他打电话到我妈妈家找我。
ext.ext_en: He rang me at my mother's...

ext.ext_cn: 如果想了解更多信息，请拨打热线电话414 3929。
ext.ext_en: If you'd like more information, ring the Hotline on 414 3929...

defs.def_en: When you ring someone, you telephone them.

ext.ext_cn: 他一回到家，电话就响了。
ext.ext_en: As soon as he got home, the phone rang...

ext.ext_cn: 这部电话一直响个不停。
ext.ext_en: The phone never stopped ringing.

defs.def_en: When a telephone rings, it makes a sound to let you know that someone is phoning you.

ext.ext_cn: 他听见学校的铃声响了。
ext.ext_en: He heard the school bell ring...

ext.ext_cn: 她还没来得及按门铃，门就开了。
ext.ext_en: The door was opened before she could ring the bell.

defs.def_en: When you ring a bell or when a bell rings, it makes a sound.

ext.ext_cn: 要我按铃叫一壶新沏的茶水吗？
ext.ext_en: Shall I ring for a fresh pot of tea?...

ext.ext_cn: 他按铃叫保安放他出去。
ext.ext_en: He rang for the guard to let him out.

defs.def_en: If you ring for something, you ring a bell to call someone to bring it to you. If you ring for someone, you ring a bell so that they will come to you.

ext.ext_cn: 整个地方都回荡着音乐。
ext.ext_en: The whole place was ringing with music.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place is ringing with sound, usually pleasant sound, you mean that the place is completely filled with that sound.

defs.def_cn: (说法、讨论、辩论等的)特性，特点

ext.ext_cn: 他洋洋得意地吹嘘自己领导着“一个主张低税收的政党”，这听起来很空洞。
ext.ext_en: His proud boast of leading 'the party of low taxation' has a hollow ring.

defs.def_en: You can use ring to describe a quality that something such as a statement, discussion, or argument seems to have. For example, if an argument has a familiar ring, it seems familiar.

ext.ext_cn: 加点香料、干果或橄榄以换换口味。
ext.ext_en: Ring the changes by adding spices, dried fruit or olives.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone rings the changes, you mean that they make changes or improvements to the way something is organized or done.

defs.def_cn: 记忆犹新;在耳边回响;在脑海中浮现

ext.ext_cn: 她耳边回响起那个男人的辱骂气得浑身发抖。
ext.ext_en: She shivered as the sound of that man's abuse rang in her ears.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's words ring in your ears or ring in your head, you mean that you remember them very clearly, usually when you would prefer to forget them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们一回来就会给他打电话。
ext.ext_en: We'll give him a ring as soon as we get back.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a ring, you phone them.

defs.def_cn: (说法)听起来真实/听起来空洞

ext.ext_cn: 乔安娜的否认听起来像是真的。
ext.ext_en: Joanna's denial rang true...

ext.ext_cn: 这一番吵闹使得所有关于团结和谐的乐观言论听起来都显得有几分空洞。
ext.ext_en: The rumpus has made all the optimistic statements about unity and harmony ring a little hollow.

defs.def_en: If a statement rings true, it seems to be true or genuine. If it rings hollow, it does not seem to be true or genuine.

ext.ext_cn: 她戴了好几个钻石戒指。
ext.ext_en: She wore several diamond rings.

ext.ext_cn: 黄金婚戒
ext.ext_en: ...a gold wedding ring.

defs.def_en: A ring is a small circle of metal or other substance that you wear on your finger as jewellery.

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰克从口袋里掏出一大串钥匙。
ext.ext_en: Frank took a large ring of keys from his pocket.

ext.ext_cn: 蓝色的烟圈
ext.ext_en: ...a ring of blue smoke.

defs.def_en: An object or substance that is in the shape of a circle can be described as a ring .

ext.ext_cn: 然后他们在广场周围围成了一圈。
ext.ext_en: They then formed a ring around the square.

ext.ext_cn: 边上放着一圈薄胡萝卜片的烤鱼
ext.ext_en: ...grilled fish surrounded by a ring of thinly cut carrots.

defs.def_en: A group of people or things arranged in a circle can be described as a ring .
A gas or electric ring is one of the small flat areas on top of a stove which heat up and which you use for cooking.

defs.def_cn: 圆形竞技（或表演）场地;拳击台;摔跤台;马戏台

ext.ext_cn: 他被永久禁止踏入英国拳击赛场。
ext.ext_en: He will never again be allowed inside a British boxing ring.

defs.def_en: At a boxing or wrestling match or a circus, the ring is the place where the contest or performance takes place. It consists of an enclosed space with seats round it.

ext.ext_cn: 警方正在调查这所学校的可疑贩毒团伙。
ext.ext_en: Police are investigating the suspected drug ring at the school.

ext.ext_cn: 国际间谍组织
ext.ext_en: ...an international spy ring.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an organized group of people who are involved in an illegal activity as a ring .

defs.def_cn: (建筑物或地方)用…围起来，被…环绕

ext.ext_cn: 这些地区被军队封锁包围了。
ext.ext_en: The areas are sealed off and ringed by troops.

defs.def_en: If a building or place is ringed with or by something, it is surrounded by it.

ext.ext_cn: 他展示了给鸟儿环志的技术。
ext.ext_en: He demonstrated his techniques for ringing birds.

defs.def_en: If you ring a bird, you put a small metal ring around its leg so that you can identify it and study its movements and habits.

ext.ext_cn: 他在智力上仍远远高于那些比他年轻一半的人。
ext.ext_en: Mentally, he can still run rings round men half his age!

defs.def_en: If you say that someone runs rings round you or runs rings around you, you mean that they are a lot better or a lot more successful than you at a particular activity.
Yoga is a type of exercise in which you move your body into various positions in order to become more fit or flexible, to improve your breathing, and to relax your mind.

defs.def_cn: 瑜伽派（起源于印度、崇尚身体锻炼和冥想的哲学派别）
defs.def_en: Yoga is a philosophy which first developed in India, in which physical exercises and meditation are believed to help people to become calmer and united in spirit with God.
A dahlia is a garden flower with a lot of brightly coloured petals.

ext.ext_cn: 专家组称目前会谈的基本原则应该保持不变。
ext.ext_en: The panel says the ground rules for the current talks should be maintained.

defs.def_en: The ground rules for something are the basic principles on which future action will be based.
A minefield is an area of land or water where explosive mines have been hidden.

defs.def_cn: 危机四伏的局势；充满问题的情况

ext.ext_cn: 整个话题就是一个政治上的雷区。
ext.ext_en: The whole subject is a political minefield...

ext.ext_cn: 厨房里充满了潜在的隐患。
ext.ext_en: The kitchen is a minefield of potential hazards.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as a minefield, you are emphasizing that there are a lot of hidden dangers or problems, and where people need to behave with care because things could easily go wrong.
A buoy is a floating object that is used to show ships and boats where they can go and to warn them of danger.

ext.ext_cn: 5月里，他们在大街上载歌载舞，欢庆胜利。
ext.ext_en: In May they danced in the streets, buoyed by their victory...

ext.ext_cn: 德国的国内消费刺激了德国经济。
ext.ext_en: German domestic consumption buoyed the German economy.

defs.def_en: If someone in a difficult situation is buoyed by something, it makes them feel more cheerful and optimistic.

defs.def_cn: 无花果树叶(在绘画和雕塑中有时被用作遮羞物)
defs.def_en: A fig leaf is a large leaf which comes from the fig tree. A fig leaf is sometimes used in painting and sculpture to cover the genitals of a naked body.

ext.ext_cn: 这项协议不过是块遮羞布而已，用来掩盖对自然景观的持续破坏。
ext.ext_en: This deal is little more than a fig leaf for the continued destruction of the landscape.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer disapprovingly to something which is intended to hide or prevent an embarrassing situation as a fig leaf .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆·班伯里一心寻找谢泼德家失踪的孩子，不想花时间处理这起新的谋杀案。
ext.ext_en: Tom Banbury was preoccupied with the missing Shepherd child and did not want to devote time to the new murder...

ext.ext_cn: 她看起来心事重重。
ext.ext_en: She looked very preoccupied.

defs.def_en: If you are preoccupied, you are thinking a lot about something or someone, and so you hardly notice other things.

ext.ext_cn: 他头屑很多。
ext.ext_en: He has very bad dandruff.

defs.def_en: Dandruff is small white pieces of dead skin in someone's hair, or fallen from someone's hair.
Red meat is meat such as beef or lamb, which is dark brown in colour after it has been cooked.
A clearance sale is a sale in which the goods in a shop are sold at reduced prices, because the shopkeeper wants to get rid of them quickly or because the shop is closing down.

ext.ext_cn: 那天早上，代表团里的老手对皮克斯塔芙小姐都敬而远之。
ext.ext_en: More experienced hands in the Mission had given Miss Pickerstaff a wide berth that morning...

ext.ext_cn: 她对演艺圈的聚会敬而远之。
ext.ext_en: She gives showbiz parties a wide berth.

defs.def_en: If you give someone or something a wide berth, you avoid them because you think they are unpleasant, or dangerous, or simply because you do not like them.

defs.def_cn: （船、火车、旅行拖车等的）卧铺，铺位

ext.ext_cn: 戈德林订了他能订到的最早一班船的铺位。
ext.ext_en: Goldring booked a berth on the first boat he could.

defs.def_en: A berth is a bed on a boat, train, or caravan.
A berth is a space in a harbour where a ship stays for a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 船停靠在纽约后，麦克林托克和第一批移民局官员登上了船。
ext.ext_en: As the ship berthed in New York, McClintock was with the first immigration officers aboard.

defs.def_en: When a ship berths, it sails into harbour and stops at the quay.

ext.ext_cn: 用长波广播
ext.ext_en: ...broadcasting on long wave.

ext.ext_cn: 1,500米的长波波长
ext.ext_en: ...1500m on long wave.

defs.def_en: Long wave is a range of radio waves which are used for broadcasting.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以接受的；不能容忍的

ext.ext_cn: 孩子说脏话是完全不能容忍的。
ext.ext_en: It is totally unacceptable for children to swear...

ext.ext_cn: 乔安娜因其丈夫令人难以容忍的行为而离开了他。
ext.ext_en: Joanna left her husband because of his unacceptable behaviour.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unacceptable, you strongly disapprove of it or object to it and feel that it should not be allowed to continue.

ext.ext_cn: 我每年将不得不付1万美元的学费。
ext.ext_en: I'll have to cough up $10,000 a year for tuition...

ext.ext_cn: 这能说服国会掏钱吗？
ext.ext_en: Will this be enough to persuade Congress to cough up?

defs.def_en: See also:cough;If you cough up an amount of money, you pay or spend that amount, usually when you would prefer not to.

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家日益依赖外国援助
ext.ext_en: ...the country's increasing reliance on foreign aid.

defs.def_en: A person's or thing's reliance on something is the fact that they need it and often cannot live or work without it.
A yobbo is the same as a yob .

defs.def_cn: （向敌人进攻之方式）同归于尽的，自杀性的

ext.ext_cn: 准备轰炸核设施的神风队飞行员
ext.ext_en: ...kamikaze pilots ready to bomb nuclear installations.

defs.def_en: If someone such as a soldier or terrorist performs a kamikaze act, they attack the enemy knowing that they will be killed doing it.

defs.def_cn: （行动或态度）冒死的，不要命的

ext.ext_cn: 这些是极危险的工作，差不多准保能毁了你的事业。
ext.ext_en: These are kamikaze jobs, the ones almost guaranteed to end your career...

ext.ext_cn: 别那么玩命，冒险时要谨慎些。
ext.ext_en: Tone down your kamikaze tendencies and take more prudent risks.

defs.def_en: You can use kamikaze to describe an action or attitude which involves doing something which is very dangerous and likely to harm the person who does it.

defs.def_cn: (非正式场合穿的)粗花呢男夹克
defs.def_en: A sports jacket is a man's jacket, usually made of a woollen material called tweed. It is worn on informal occasions with trousers of a different material.
If you call someone a twerp, you are insulting them and saying that they are silly or stupid.

defs.def_cn: 浮石，浮岩，轻石（用于清洁皮肤或使皮肤光滑等）
defs.def_en: A pumice stone is a piece of pumice that you rub over your skin in order to clean the skin or make it smoother.
Pumice stone is the same as pumice .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不光彩的;不名誉的;可耻的

ext.ext_cn: 他本来不会接受这种不光彩的结局。
ext.ext_en: He wouldn't have accepted such an inglorious outcome.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as inglorious, you mean that it is something to be ashamed of.

ext.ext_cn: 不朽的斯普纳牧师
ext.ext_en: ...the immortal Reverend Dr Spooner.

ext.ext_cn: 《呼啸山庄》，艾米莉·勃朗特不朽的爱情小说
ext.ext_en: ...Wuthering Heights, Emily Bronte's immortal love story...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is immortal is famous and likely to be remembered for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 法老们被视为神灵，且长生不死。
ext.ext_en: The pharaohs were considered gods and therefore immortal.

ext.ext_cn: 瓷制的中国神仙塑像
ext.ext_en: ...porcelain figurines of the Chinese immortals.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is immortal will live or last for ever and never die or be destroyed.

ext.ext_cn: 罗斯福的不朽名言——“说话温和,手持大棒”
