defs.def_en: If you describe someone as clingy, you mean that they become very attached to people and depend on them too much.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 紧身长裙
ext.ext_en: ...long clingy skirts.

defs.def_en: Clingy clothes fit tightly round your body.

defs.def_cn: （取自有图文的铜牌上的）拓印图，拓片
defs.def_en: A brass rubbing is a picture made by placing a piece of paper over a brass plate that has writing or a picture on it, and rubbing it with a wax crayon.
A hardware store is a shop where articles for the house and garden such as tools, nails, and pans are sold.

defs.def_cn: 洗礼(基督教仪式，表示正式接纳新教徒，并为之命名)

ext.ext_cn: 我孙女的洗礼
ext.ext_en: ...my grand-daughter's christening.

ext.ext_cn: 受洗礼衣
ext.ext_en: ...a christening robe.

defs.def_en: A christening is a Christian ceremony in which a baby is made a member of the Christian church and is officially given his or her name.

ext.ext_cn: 政府只会在战争期间征募船只。
ext.ext_en: The government will commandeer ships only in wartime.

ext.ext_cn: 他在法国的战时经历
ext.ext_en: ...his wartime experiences in France.

defs.def_en: Wartime is a period of time when a war is being fought.
A truant is a pupil who stays away from school without permission.

ext.ext_cn: 上四年级时，他频频旷课。
ext.ext_en: In his fourth year he was truanting regularly.

defs.def_en: If a pupil truants, he or she stays away from school without permission.

ext.ext_cn: 她因逃课而惹了麻烦。
ext.ext_en: She was getting into trouble over playing truant from school.

defs.def_en: If a pupil plays truant, he or she stays away from school without permission.

ext.ext_cn: 这个任务彻底失败了。
ext.ext_en: The mission was a washout.

defs.def_en: If an event or plan is a washout, it fails completely.

ext.ext_cn: 对于两个赛季前排名第二的俱乐部来说，竟然有降级之虞真是太落魄了。
ext.ext_en: The prospect of relegation is a comedown for a club that finished second two seasons ago.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a comedown, you think that it is not as good as something else that you have just done or had.

ext.ext_cn: 我的拼写能力极差。
ext.ext_en: I am an absolutely appalling speller.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a good or bad speller, you mean that they find it easy or difficult to spell words correctly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (皮肤)经风吹日晒的，饱经风霜的

ext.ext_cn: 一个强壮的男人，红红的脸上饱经风霜
ext.ext_en: ...a stout man with a ruddy, weather-beaten face.

defs.def_en: If your face or skin is weather-beaten, it is rough with deep lines because you have spent a lot of time outside in bad weather.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （物体）饱经风霜的，经风吹日晒的

ext.ext_cn: 他们会透过那扇经受风吹日晒的老木门的缝隙向外张望。
ext.ext_en: They would look out through the cracks of their weather-beaten door.

defs.def_en: Something that is weather-beaten is rough and slightly damaged after being outside for a long time.

defs.def_cn: （表演平衡动作用的）高空钢丝，空中绳索
defs.def_en: A high wire is a length of rope or wire stretched tight high above the ground and used for balancing acts.

defs.def_cn: （报刊用语）危险的状态，走钢丝，（行为）容易犯错误的

ext.ext_cn: 编制今年的政府预算对财政大臣来说就好像是在走钢丝。
ext.ext_en: This year's Budget looks set to be a precarious high-wire act for the Chancellor.

defs.def_en: Journalists talk about a person being on a high wire or performing a high-wire act when he or she is dealing with a situation in which it would be easy to do the wrong thing.

defs.def_cn: （通常指橡胶制成的）防水套鞋
defs.def_en: Galoshes are waterproof shoes, usually made of rubber, which you wear over your ordinary shoes to prevent them getting wet.
A gemstone is a jewel or stone used in jewellery.
A gaucho is a South American cowboy.
Pacifism is the belief that war and violence are always wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 由于多年练习空手道，他的双手粗糙不平，布满老茧。
ext.ext_en: His hands were rough and calloused, from years of karate practice...

ext.ext_cn: 格雷斯缓慢地走过高低不平的地面。
ext.ext_en: Grace made her way slowly across the rough ground.

defs.def_en: If a surface is rough, it is uneven and not smooth.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人或行为)粗暴的，粗野的，粗鲁的

ext.ext_cn: 即使是在比赛最不激烈的时候，橄榄球也是一种粗野的运动。
ext.ext_en: Rugby's a rough game at the best of times...

ext.ext_cn: 他们抗议遭受歧视，而且偶尔还会遭到粗暴的对待。
ext.ext_en: They have complained of discrimination and occasional rough treatment.

defs.def_en: You say that people or their actions are rough when they use too much force and not enough care or gentleness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (地区、城市、学校等)危险的，充斥暴力的，犯罪率高的

ext.ext_cn: 这是我们城里犯罪率很高的地区。
ext.ext_en: It was quite a rough part of our town.

defs.def_en: A rough area, city, school, or other place is unpleasant and dangerous because there is a lot of violence or crime there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (日子)艰难的，困难的，不愉快的

ext.ext_cn: 在我们的社会中，所有女性的日子都不好过。
ext.ext_en: All women have a rough time in our society...

ext.ext_cn: 他知道明天将会是艰难的一天。
ext.ext_en: Tomorrow, he knew, would be a rough day.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has had a rough time, you mean that they have had some difficult or unpleasant experiences.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 病毒无法清除，这个小伙子仍然觉得有点不舒服。
ext.ext_en: The virus won't go away and the lad is still feeling a bit rough.

defs.def_en: If you feel rough, you feel ill.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (计算、猜测)大概的，粗略的，不精确的

ext.ext_cn: 我们只能对所需燃料作一个粗略的估计。
ext.ext_en: We were only able to make a rough estimate of how much fuel would be required...

ext.ext_cn: 作为一个大致的参照，一匹马每天需要吃相当于其体重2.5％的食物。
ext.ext_en: As a rough guide, a horse needs 2.5 per cent of his body weight in food every day.

defs.def_en: A rough calculation or guess is approximately correct, but not exact.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (想法、描述)粗略的，简略的，大致的;(图画)简笔的

ext.ext_cn: 我已经大致知道他长什么样子了。
ext.ext_en: I've got a rough idea of what he looks like...

ext.ext_cn: 画一个简略的草图标示车辆当时所在的位置往往很有用。
ext.ext_en: It often helps to make a rough sketch showing where the vehicles were.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a rough idea, description, or drawing of something, you indicate only the most important features, without much detail.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 做工粗糙的;不精致的;简陋的

ext.ext_cn: 做工粗糙的木桌子
ext.ext_en: ...a rough wooden table.

ext.ext_cn: 房间中央大致围成一圈的椅子
ext.ext_en: ...chairs set in a rough circle in the middle of the room.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is rough when it is not neat and well made.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (天气)恶劣的，狂风暴雨的;(海面)波浪滔天的

ext.ext_cn: 一艘捕鱼船和一艘货船在波涛汹涌的海上相撞了。
ext.ext_en: A fishing vessel and a cargo ship collided in rough seas.

defs.def_en: If the sea or the weather at sea is rough, the weather is windy or stormy and there are very big waves.

defs.def_cn: 风餐露宿地;无家可归地;流浪地

ext.ext_cn: 我看到年轻人沿街乞讨、露宿街头，心里会非常难过。
ext.ext_en: It makes me so sad when I see young people begging or sleeping rough on the streets.

defs.def_en: When people sleep or live rough, they sleep out of doors, usually because they have no home.

defs.def_cn: 过（从前没有过的）艰苦的生活

ext.ext_cn: 你不会过得太艰苦;每个房间都配备了一部电话和一台可以接收3个频道的收音机。
ext.ext_en: You won't be roughing it; each room comes equipped with a telephone and a 3-channel radio.

defs.def_en: If you have to rough it, you have to live without the possessions and comforts that you normally have.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得很明显该乐队长久不了。
ext.ext_en: It became blatantly obvious to me that the band wasn't going to last...

ext.ext_cn: 多年来，一些明显错误的断言都没有受到质疑。
ext.ext_en: For years, blatantly false assertions have gone unchallenged...

defs.def_en: Blatantly is used to add emphasis when you are describing states or situations which you think are bad.
A bride is a woman who is getting married or who has just got married.

defs.def_cn: （体重175磅以上的）最重量级拳击手
defs.def_en: A heavyweight is a boxer weighing more than 175 pounds and therefore in the heaviest class.

defs.def_cn: 重量级人物（或组织）;有影响力的人物（或组织）

ext.ext_cn: 他是一名政界要人。
ext.ext_en: He was a political heavyweight.

ext.ext_cn: 爵士乐坛的重量级人物
ext.ext_en: ...jazz heavyweights.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a person or organization as a heavyweight, you mean that they have a lot of influence, experience, and importance in a particular field, subject, or activity.

defs.def_cn: (使)改容换貌;(使)容光焕发;美化

ext.ext_cn: 他们因艺术的治疗效力而面貌一新。
ext.ext_en: They are transfigured by the healing powers of art...

ext.ext_cn: 他回笑了一下，有那么一瞬间不动声色的脸上焕发出容光。
ext.ext_en: He smiled back, which for an instant transfigured his unrevealing features.

defs.def_en: To be transfigured means to be changed into something great or beautiful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有臭味的;味道极其难闻的

ext.ext_cn: 汗津津的臭袜子
ext.ext_en: ...sweaty, stinky socks.

defs.def_en: If something is stinky, it smells extremely unpleasant.
Potholing is the leisure activity of going into underground caves and tunnels.
Electronic publishing is the publishing of documents in a form that can be read on a computer, for example as a CD-ROM.
A bedbug is a small insect with a round body and no wings which lives in dirty houses and feeds by biting people and sucking their blood when they are in bed.

defs.def_cn: 使非国有化;使转为私营

ext.ext_cn: 政府开始对金融机构进行私有化。
ext.ext_en: The government started to denationalize financial institutions...

ext.ext_cn: 桑德兰造船厂最终转为了私营。
ext.ext_en: Eventually Sunderland Shipbuilders was denationalised.

defs.def_en: To denationalize an industry or business means to transfer it into private ownership so that it is no longer owned and controlled by the state.

ext.ext_cn: 两组都具有通常脊椎动物才具备的两个特征。
ext.ext_en: Both groups share two attributes normally associated with vertebrates.

ext.ext_cn: 脊椎动物的耳朵
ext.ext_en: ...the ears of vertebrates.

defs.def_en: A vertebrate is a creature which has a spine. Mammals, birds, reptiles, and fish are vertebrates.

ext.ext_cn: 她计划先参加高级考试，然后去读大学。
ext.ext_en: She intends to do A levels and go to university...

ext.ext_cn: 我没有打算来德国工作。
ext.ext_en: I didn't intend coming to Germany to work...

defs.def_en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

defs.def_cn: 准备,预留(作某种用途或给某人用)

ext.ext_cn: 这笔钱准备用于旅游业的开发。
ext.ext_en: This money is intended for the development of the tourist industry...

ext.ext_cn: 圆柱在建筑中通常用来增添气势和显示地位。
ext.ext_en: Columns are usually intended in architecture to add grandeur and status...

defs.def_en: If something is intended for a particular purpose, it has been planned to fulfil that purpose. If something is intended for a particular person, it has been planned to be used by that person or to affect them in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有任何讽刺的意思。
ext.ext_en: He didn't intend any sarcasm...

ext.ext_cn: 伯克的回答有点施恩与人的感觉,尽管他无疑并没有那个意思。
ext.ext_en: Burke's response seemed a little patronizing, though he undoubtedly hadn't intended it that way...

defs.def_en: If you intend a particular idea or feeling in something that you say or do, you want to express it or want it to be understood.

ext.ext_cn: 韦布驶离干道，驱车拐入停车场。
ext.ext_en: Webb turned off the main road and drove round to the car park.

defs.def_en: A main road is an important road that leads from one town or city to another.

ext.ext_cn: 司法部长很清楚他决定起诉可能引发的政治后果。
ext.ext_en: The Attorney General was aware of the political implications of his decision to prosecute...

ext.ext_cn: 当前低迷的投资水平会对未来的经济增长产生严重影响。
ext.ext_en: The low level of current investment has serious implications for future economic growth.

defs.def_en: The implications of something are the things that are likely to happen as a result.

ext.ext_cn: 弦外之音很明显：投票给我们,否则你会非常难堪。
ext.ext_en: The implication was obvious: vote for us or it will be very embarrassing for you...

ext.ext_cn: 婚姻不忠会提升领导人可信度的暗示荒谬之极。
ext.ext_en: The implication that marital infidelity enhances a leader's credibility is preposterous.

defs.def_en: The implication of a statement, event, or situation is what it implies or suggests is the case.

defs.def_cn: （学业或事业上）达到（特定程度）成就（或成绩）的人

ext.ext_cn: 业绩出众的人会获得现金奖励。
ext.ext_en: High achievers will receive cash bonuses...

ext.ext_cn: 上学时他不属于拔尖的那类。
ext.ext_en: In school, he was not one of the achievers.

defs.def_en: A high achiever is someone who is successful in their studies or their work, usually as a result of their efforts. A low achiever is someone who achieves less than those around them.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管进行了彻底的调查，还是没有发现索思韦尔博士的任何踪迹。
ext.ext_en: Despite a thorough investigation, no trace of Dr Southwell has been found...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管支出在增加，但国民医疗保健服务的质量却明显下降了。
ext.ext_en: The National Health Service has visibly deteriorated, despite increased spending...

defs.def_en: You use despite to introduce a fact which makes the other part of the sentence surprising.

ext.ext_cn: 哈里的话让我不由自主地停下来细想。
ext.ext_en: Despite myself, Harry's remarks had caused me to stop and reflect.

defs.def_en: If you do something despite yourself you do it although you did not really intend or expect to.
A mariner is a sailor.
An applicator is a device that you use to put something somewhere when you do not want to touch it or do it with your hands.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我做了几份薪酬微薄的秘书工作，这让我非常郁闷。
ext.ext_en: I took a series of badly paid secretarial jobs which made me really miserable...

ext.ext_cn: 她伤心而沮丧地上床睡觉。
ext.ext_en: She went to bed, miserable and depressed.

defs.def_en: If you are miserable, you are very unhappy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (地方、形势)令人难受的，令人抑郁的

ext.ext_cn: 这个鬼地方根本没有什么东西可以让他分心。
ext.ext_en: There was nothing at all in this miserable place to distract him.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place or situation as miserable, you mean that it makes you feel unhappy or depressed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那是阴郁灰暗、潮湿多雨的一天。
ext.ext_en: It was a grey, wet, miserable day...

ext.ext_cn: 天气非常寒冷潮湿，令人难受。
ext.ext_en: It was very cold, damp and  miserable.

defs.def_en: If you describe the weather as miserable, you mean that it makes you feel depressed, because it is raining or dull.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 脾气坏的;不友善的;乖戾的

ext.ext_cn: 他的脾气总是很糟。他从不跟我或其他任何人讲话。
ext.ext_en: He always was a miserable man. He never spoke to me nor anybody else.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as miserable, you mean that you do not like them because they are bad-tempered or unfriendly.

defs.def_cn: 远远不足的;非常差劲的;少得可怜的

ext.ext_cn: 我们在接近地面时的航速仅为2.2节。
ext.ext_en: Our speed over the ground was a miserable 2.2 knots...

ext.ext_cn: 迄今为止，从前南斯拉夫接收的难民只有区区1,100人。
ext.ext_en: It has so far accepted a miserable 1,100 refugees from the former Yugoslavia.

defs.def_en: You can describe a quantity or quality as miserable when you think that it is much smaller or worse than it ought to be.

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影在意大利和美国均遭遇票房惨败。
ext.ext_en: The film was a miserable commercial failure both in Italy and in the United States.

defs.def_en: A miserable failure is a very great one.

ext.ext_cn: 24小时保护车辆的电子装置
ext.ext_en: ...an electronic device that protects your vehicle 24 hours a day.

ext.ext_cn: 能够测量微量物质的设备
ext.ext_en: ...a device that could measure minute quantities of matter...

defs.def_en: A device is an object that has been invented for a particular purpose, for example for recording or measuring something.

ext.ext_cn: 他们声称军费开支是用来作为调控经济的手段的。
ext.ext_en: They claim that military spending is used as a device for managing the economy.

ext.ext_cn: 隐喻的文学手法
ext.ext_en: ...the literary device of the metaphor.

defs.def_en: A device is a method of achieving something.

defs.def_cn: 听任…自便;让…自行发展;不去管

ext.ext_cn: 任其自由发挥时，奥斯本是一个弹奏流畅、常常富有创意的吉他手。
ext.ext_en: Left to his own devices, Osborn is a fluent — and often original — guitarist.

defs.def_en: If you leave someone to their own devices, you leave them alone to do as they wish.
In the game of ice hockey, the puck is the small rubber disc that is used instead of a ball.

ext.ext_cn: 狩猎是意大利最受欢迎的体育运动之一。
ext.ext_en: Hunting is one of Italy's most popular sports...

ext.ext_cn: 猎鹿于1959年在苏格兰被禁止。
ext.ext_en: Deer hunting was banned in Scotland in 1959.

defs.def_en: Hunting is the chasing and killing of wild animals by people or other animals, for food or as a sport.

ext.ext_cn: 失业救助所可以为您在求职方面提供帮助。
ext.ext_en: Jobclub can help you with job hunting.

ext.ext_cn: 李平时不是在找公寓，就是在旅行。
ext.ext_en: Lee has divided his time between flat-hunting and travelling.

defs.def_en: Hunting is the activity of searching for a particular thing.

defs.def_cn: （20世纪40年代由蓝调音乐演变成的）节奏蓝调，节奏布鲁斯（缩略形式为R&B;）
defs.def_en: Rhythm and blues is a style of popular music developed in the 1940's from blues music, but using electrically amplified instruments. The abbreviation R&B; is also used.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 悄悄的;偷偷摸摸的;鬼鬼祟祟的

ext.ext_cn: 我会偷偷溜进去，轻手轻脚地查看一下二楼。
ext.ext_en: I would creep in and with stealthy footsteps explore the second-floor...

ext.ext_cn: 这是有人不想让别人听到而偷偷摸摸移动的声音。
ext.ext_en: It was a stealthy sound made by someone anxious not to be heard.

defs.def_en: Stealthy actions or movements are performed quietly and carefully, so that no one will notice what you are doing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (指书页或纸张)卷角的，翻旧了的

ext.ext_cn: 翻烂的古代历史书
ext.ext_en: ...dog-eared copies of ancient history books.

defs.def_en: A book or piece of paper that is dog-eared has been used so much that the corners of the pages are turned down or torn.

ext.ext_cn: 我再也不想参加考试了。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to take any more exams...

ext.ext_cn: 凯特的考试成绩非常优秀。
ext.ext_en: Kate's exam results were excellent.

defs.def_en: An exam is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.
If you have a medical exam, a doctor looks at your body, feels it, or does simple tests in order to check how healthy you are.

defs.def_cn: （16至18世纪欧洲的）绘画大师作品，绘画大师

ext.ext_cn: 他收藏的16至18世纪欧洲名画和当代艺术品
ext.ext_en: ...his collection of old masters and modern art.

ext.ext_cn: 庚斯博罗、鲁本斯和其他大师所绘的肖像画
ext.ext_en: ...portraits by Gainsborough, Rubens and other Old Masters.

defs.def_en: An old master is a painting by one of the famous European painters of the 16th, 17th, and 18th centuries. These painters can also be referred to as the Old Masters.
A salt shaker is the same as a salt cellar .

ext.ext_cn: 第二天早上，我们又去骑马了。
ext.ext_en: The next morning we went riding again...

ext.ext_cn: 她在德文郡开了一个骑术学校。
ext.ext_en: She runs a riding school in Devon.

defs.def_en: Riding is the activity or sport of riding horses.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 头脑冷静的;沉着的;镇定的

ext.ext_cn: 她以沉着冷静著称。
ext.ext_en: She has a reputation for being calm and cool-headed.

ext.ext_cn: 一个头脑冷静、有责任心的政治家
ext.ext_en: ...a cool-headed, responsible statesman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as cool-headed, you mean that they stay calm in difficult situations.

ext.ext_cn: 但是，他的货币理论中存在若干关键性错误。
ext.ext_en: There were, however, a number of crucial flaws in his monetary theory...

ext.ext_cn: 几乎所有这些研究中都存在严重谬误。
ext.ext_en: Almost all of these studies have serious flaws.

defs.def_en: A flaw in something such as a theory or argument is a mistake in it, which causes it to be less effective or valid.

ext.ext_cn: 他性格中的唯一缺点好像就是脾气急。
ext.ext_en: The only flaw in his character seems to be a short temper.

defs.def_en: A flaw in someone's character is an undesirable quality that they have.
A flaw in something such as a pattern or material is a fault in it that should not be there.

ext.ext_cn: 弹出菜单后，须左击其中一个选项方可运行。
ext.ext_en: When the menu has popped up you should left-click on one of the choices to make it operate.

defs.def_en: To left-click or to left-click on something means to press the left-hand button on a computer mouse.

defs.def_cn: (指1990年德统一之前的联邦德国)西德的，西德人的，西德文化的

ext.ext_cn: 西德的首都，波恩
ext.ext_en: ...the West German capital, Bonn...

ext.ext_cn: 历届西德政府给予东德大量的贷款。
ext.ext_en: Big credits were given to East Germany by successive West German governments.

defs.def_en: West German means belonging or relating to the part of Germany that was known as the Federal Republic of Germany before the two parts of Germany were united in 1990. West German also means belonging or relating to the people or culture of this part of Germany.

ext.ext_cn: 许多西德人都很担忧国家统一的潜在代价。
ext.ext_en: Many West Germans are anxious about the potential cost of unification.

defs.def_en: A West German is someone who was a citizen of the Federal Republic of Germany, or a person of West German origin.

ext.ext_cn: 她长得太快，衣服很快便穿不下了，帕齐只好经常给她买新衣服。
ext.ext_en: She outgrew her clothes so rapidly that Patsy was always having to buy new ones.

ext.ext_cn: 长大了穿不下的宝宝装
ext.ext_en: ...outgrown baby clothes.

defs.def_en: If a child outgrows a piece of clothing, they grow bigger, so that it no longer fits them.

defs.def_cn: 因长大而放弃（以前的行为或想法）

ext.ext_cn: 这个女孩对时尚的兴趣可能会随着年龄的增长而消失，也可能不会。
ext.ext_en: The girl may or may not outgrow her interest in fashion.

defs.def_en: If you outgrow a particular way of behaving or thinking, you change and become more mature, so that you no longer behave or think in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 陶醉在自由中的她在宾馆开了一间房，住了几天。
ext.ext_en: Revelling in her freedom, she took a hotel room and stayed for several days...

ext.ext_cn: 猫确实喜暖，不管是自然的还是人工创造的温暖环境。
ext.ext_en: Cats positively revel in heat, whether natural or man-made.

defs.def_en: If you revel in a situation or experience, you enjoy it very much.

ext.ext_cn: 狂欢常常持续到黎明。
ext.ext_en: The revels often last until dawn.

defs.def_en: Revels are noisy celebrations.
A flat cap is the same as a cloth cap .
A town house is a tall narrow house in a town, usually in a row of similar houses.

defs.def_cn: (富人除乡村住宅外的)城市住宅，城镇住房
defs.def_en: The town house of a wealthy person is the house that they own in a town or city, rather than another house that they own in the country.

ext.ext_cn: 今天下午巴勒斯坦方面临时召开了记者招待会。
ext.ext_en: This afternoon the Palestinians held an impromptu press conference...

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们为来访者即兴献上了一场音乐会。
ext.ext_en: The children put on an impromptu concert for the visitors.

defs.def_en: An impromptu action is one that you do without planning or organizing it in advance.

ext.ext_cn: 一位徒步者从一块80英尺高的尖锥形岩石上摔了下来。
ext.ext_en: A walker fell 80ft from a rocky pinnacle.

defs.def_en: A pinnacle is a pointed piece of stone or rock that is high above the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·梅杰已攀上了英国政界的顶峰。
ext.ext_en: John Major has reached the pinnacle of British politics...

ext.ext_cn: 她仍然是一位处于事业巅峰期的银幕女神。
ext.ext_en: She was still a screen goddess at the pinnacle of her career.

defs.def_en: If someone reaches the pinnacle of their career or the pinnacle of a particular area of life, they are at the highest point of it.

defs.def_cn: 地球（指宇宙组成部分时用Earth，指人类居住的星球时用the Earth）

ext.ext_cn: 亚特兰蒂斯”号航天飞机今天安全返回地球。
ext.ext_en: The space shuttle Atlantis returned safely to earth today. “

ext.ext_cn: 地壳断层
ext.ext_en: ...a fault in the Earth's crust.

defs.def_en: Earth or the Earth is the planet on which we live. People usually say Earth when they are referring to the planet as part of the universe, and the Earth when they are talking about the planet as the place where we live.

ext.ext_cn: 地面摇晃，周围房屋的墙体在他们身边倒塌。
ext.ext_en: The earth shook and the walls of neighbouring houses fell around them.

defs.def_en: The earth is the land surface on which we live and move about.

ext.ext_cn: 公路蜿蜒数英里，穿过炙烤的大地、灌木丛和仙人掌。
ext.ext_en: The road winds for miles through parched earth, scrub and cactus...

ext.ext_cn: 他们将回归到用老方法耕地。
ext.ext_en: They will revert to tilling the earth in an old-fashioned way.

defs.def_en: Earth is the substance on the land surface of the earth, for example clay or sand, in which plants grow.
An earth is a hole in the ground in which an animal such as a fox lives.

ext.ext_cn: 地线没有接上。
ext.ext_en: The earth wire was not connected.

defs.def_en: The earth in an electric plug or piece of electrical equipment is the wire through which electricity can pass into the ground, which makes the equipment safe if something goes wrong with it.

defs.def_cn: （用于以how, why, what 或 where 开始的问句，表示强调，通常表示问题没有答案或很难回答）究竟，到底

ext.ext_cn: 那件事到底怎么发生的？
ext.ext_en: How on earth did that happen?...

ext.ext_cn: 卢克究竟做了什么？
ext.ext_en: What on earth had Luke done?...

defs.def_en: On earth is used for emphasis in questions that begin with words such as 'how', 'why', 'what', or 'where'. It is often used to suggest that there is no obvious or easy answer to the question being asked.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定名词短语后表强调）根本，完全

ext.ext_cn: 她没能搬过来和我们同住，这根本就说不通。
ext.ext_en: There was no reason on earth why she couldn't have moved in with us...

ext.ext_cn: 初尝胜利滋味的感觉真是无可比拟。
ext.ext_en: There is no feeling on earth like winning for the first time.

defs.def_en: On earth is used for emphasis after some negative noun groups, for example 'no reason'.

defs.def_cn: (用于包含形容词最高级的名词短语后表示强调)世界上，人世间

ext.ext_cn: 他想成为世界上跑得最快的人。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to be the fastest man on earth.

ext.ext_cn: 世界上最严重的生态灾难发生地
ext.ext_en: ...the site of the worst ecological disaster on earth.

defs.def_en: On earth is used for emphasis after a noun group that contains a superlative adjective.

defs.def_cn: （激动之后）恢复正常生活，回到现实

ext.ext_cn: 从胜利的喜悦中平复后，他承认：“当时感觉棒极了。”
ext.ext_en: When he came down to earth after his win he admitted: 'It was an amazing feeling'...

ext.ext_cn: 真相的披露让我深感震惊，我被带回了现实。
ext.ext_en: I was shocked, brought down to earth by this revelation.

defs.def_en: If you come down to earth or back to earth, you have to face the reality of everyday life after a period of great excitement.

defs.def_cn: （经过长时间的寻找后）终于找到

ext.ext_cn: 1点差5分的时候，她终于在酒馆里找到了他。
ext.ext_en: She ran him to earth in the pub at five to one.

defs.def_en: If you run someone or something to earth, you find them after searching for them for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 这肯定花了很多钱。
ext.ext_en: It must have cost the earth.

defs.def_en: If you say that something cost the earth or that you paid the earth for it, you are emphasizing that it cost a very large amount of money.

ext.ext_cn: 有人会质疑把她排除在队伍之外是否明智。
ext.ext_en: Some would question the wisdom of leaving her out of the team...

ext.ext_cn: 如果喜欢清淡的口味，可少放或不放辣椒。
ext.ext_en: If you prefer mild flavours reduce or leave out the chilli...

defs.def_en: If you leave someone or something out of an activity, collection, discussion, or group, you do not include them in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们不得不将这些体形庞大、身披绒毛的白色动物剥皮，然后切碎了做食物。
ext.ext_en: They had to flay the great, white, fleecy animals and cut them up for food...

ext.ext_cn: 再要呆在一起就好像自愿被活活剥皮一样。
ext.ext_en: To remain together was like volunteering to be flayed alive.

defs.def_en: When someone flays an animal or person, they remove their skin, usually when they are dead.

ext.ext_cn: 他还鞭挞那些允许“外国君主和势力”侵犯美国主权的人。
ext.ext_en: ...and he flayed those who allowed 'foreign potentates and powers' to violate American sovereignty.

defs.def_en: If you flay someone, you criticize them severely for their beliefs, policies, or actions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他母亲很溺爱他，任由他想干什么就干什么。
ext.ext_en: His indulgent mother was willing to let him do anything he wanted.

defs.def_en: If you are indulgent, you treat a person with special kindness, often in a way that is not good for them.

ext.ext_cn: 5头奶牛在一棵大橡树旁悠闲自在地啃着青草。
ext.ext_en: Five cows graze serenely around a massive oak...

ext.ext_cn: 这几座山过于陡峭，不适于耕种，所以就用来牧羊了。
ext.ext_en: The hills have been grazed by sheep because they were too steep to be ploughed...

defs.def_en: When animals graze or are grazed, they eat the grass or other plants that are growing in a particular place. You can also say that a field is grazed by animals.

ext.ext_cn: 我的膝盖擦破了一点皮。
ext.ext_en: I had grazed my knees a little.

defs.def_en: If you graze a part of your body, you injure your skin by scraping against something.
A graze is a small wound caused by scraping against something.

ext.ext_cn: 一颗子弹擦过他的手臂。
ext.ext_en: A bullet had grazed his arm...

ext.ext_cn: 赖特勉强起脚射门，但是球擦着近门柱有惊无险地偏出了球门。
ext.ext_en: Wright managed a shot but it grazed the near post and rolled harmlessly across the goal.

defs.def_en: If something grazes another thing, it touches that thing lightly as it passes by.

ext.ext_cn: 他的秘书替他挡住胡搅蛮缠的来访者。
ext.ext_en: His secretary shielded him from importunate visitors.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as importunate, you think they are annoying because they keep trying to get something from you.

ext.ext_cn: 在共产主义和资本主义之间寻求第三条道路
ext.ext_en: ...finding a 'Third Way' between communism and capitalism.

defs.def_en: The Third Way is used to refer to a set of political beliefs and principles that is neither extremely right-wing nor extremely left-wing.

defs.def_cn: 向…致意;向…致敬;向…行军礼

ext.ext_cn: 人群中走出一人向将军敬礼。
ext.ext_en: One of the company stepped out and saluted the General...

ext.ext_cn: 我立正敬礼。
ext.ext_en: I stood to attention and saluted.

defs.def_en: If you salute someone, you greet them or show your respect with a formal sign. Soldiers usually salute officers by raising their right hand so that their fingers touch their forehead.

ext.ext_cn: 我对他发挥的领导作用表示赞扬。
ext.ext_en: I salute him for the leadership role that he is taking...

ext.ext_cn: 这一表态称赞了过去一年的变革。
ext.ext_en: The statement salutes the changes of the past year.

defs.def_en: To salute a person or their achievements means to publicly show or state your admiration for them.

ext.ext_cn: 如果有不吸烟的人在场，任何人不得在办公室吸烟。
ext.ext_en: Nobody will be allowed to smoke in an office if there are non-smokers present.

defs.def_en: A non-smoker is someone who does not smoke.

defs.def_cn: (某些国家中学院及大学的)学期,半学年
defs.def_en: In colleges and universities in some countries, a semester is one of the two main periods into which the year is divided.

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯喜欢音乐，收集了大量的唱片和磁带。
ext.ext_en: Chris likes music and has a large collection of albums and cassettes.

defs.def_en: An album is a record with about 25 minutes of music on each side. You can also refer to a collection of songs that is available on a record, cassette, or CD as an album .

defs.def_cn: （用于保存照片、邮票等的）专册，专辑簿

ext.ext_cn: 特雷莎给我看她的相册。
ext.ext_en: Theresa showed me her photo album.

defs.def_en: An album is a book in which you keep things such as photographs or stamps that you have collected.

ext.ext_cn: 他们说有人割断了她的喉咙。
ext.ext_en: They say somebody slit her throat...

ext.ext_cn: 他开始裁开每个信封。
ext.ext_en: He began to slit open each envelope...

defs.def_en: If you slit something, you make a long narrow cut in it.

ext.ext_cn: 在树干上切一道大约半英寸长的口子。
ext.ext_en: Make a slit in the stem about half an inch long.

defs.def_en: A slit is a long narrow cut.

ext.ext_cn: 她透过窗帘上的一道窄缝注视着他们。
ext.ext_en: She watched them through a slit in the curtains.

defs.def_en: A slit is a long narrow opening in something.

defs.def_cn: （常指因寒冷、生病或愁苦）耸肩弓身的，伏首前倾的

ext.ext_cn: 一个缩头弓身的孤独身影从唐宁街10号出来了。
ext.ext_en: A solitary hunched figure emerged from Number Ten...

ext.ext_cn: 他因为长时间弓身坐着而脖子僵直，背部酸痛。
ext.ext_en: He got a stiff neck and a sore back from sitting hunched up for so long.

defs.def_en: If you are hunched, or hunched up, you are leaning forwards with your shoulders raised and your head down, often because you are cold, ill, or unhappy.

ext.ext_cn: 行房时不采取避孕措施是非常危险的。
ext.ext_en: You are playing Russian roulette every time you have unprotected sex.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is playing Russian roulette, or that what they are doing is like playing Russian roulette, you mean that what they are doing is very dangerous because it involves unpredictable risks.
If someone plays Russian roulette, they fire a gun with only one bullet at their head without knowing whether it will shoot them.
Musculature is used to refer to all the muscles in your body, or to a system of muscles that you use to perform a particular type of action.
If you describe someone as a motormouth, you mean that they talk a lot, especially in a loud or aggressive way.

ext.ext_cn: 鼹鼠的前足非常有力，擅长挖洞。
ext.ext_en: Moles have powerful forefeet for digging.

defs.def_en: A four-legged animal's forefeet are its two front feet.

defs.def_cn: 镶嵌的;嵌饰的;嵌花样的

ext.ext_cn: 精巧地嵌有小三角的盒子
ext.ext_en: ...a box delicately inlaid with little triangles.

defs.def_en: An object that is inlaid has a design on it which is made by putting materials such as wood, gold, or silver into the surface of the object.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 类似麻疹这样的传染病
ext.ext_en: ...infectious diseases such as measles...

ext.ext_cn: 这些病毒会侵袭儿童，而且具有很强的传染性。
ext.ext_en: These viruses affect children and are highly infectious.

defs.def_en: A disease that is infectious can be caught by being near a person who has it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她做任何事情都充满一种极富感染力的热情。
ext.ext_en: She radiates an infectious enthusiasm for everything she does...

ext.ext_cn: 电话里传来一阵响亮的笑声,哈里也不禁受其感染。
ext.ext_en: There was a peal of laughter down the phone, which Harry found infectious.

defs.def_en: If a feeling is infectious, it spreads to other people.

ext.ext_cn: 他们铺好木地板,在上面铺上新地毯。
ext.ext_en: They put down wooden boards, and laid new carpets on top.

ext.ext_cn: 我们客厅地毯上的污迹
ext.ext_en: ...the stain on our living-room carpet.

defs.def_en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

ext.ext_cn: 房间里铺了地毯,窗户上安装了有色玻璃。
ext.ext_en: The room had been carpeted and the windows glazed with coloured glass...

ext.ext_cn: 赌场大厅铺着厚厚的地毯。
ext.ext_en: The main gaming room was thickly carpeted.

defs.def_en: If a floor or a room is carpeted, a carpet is laid on the floor.

ext.ext_cn: 我的院子里的落叶越来越厚。
ext.ext_en: The carpet of leaves in my yard became more and more noticeable.

defs.def_en: A carpet of something such as leaves or plants is a layer of them which covers the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 地上落了厚厚的一层松针。
ext.ext_en: The ground was thickly carpeted with pine needles.

defs.def_en: If the ground is carpeted with something such as leaves or plants, it is completely covered by them.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为他在时机远未成熟时就把这事说了出去是一种失策。
ext.ext_en: I think he made a tactical blunder by announcing it so far ahead of time.

defs.def_en: A blunder is a stupid or careless mistake.

ext.ext_cn: 无疑，我又犯了一个愚蠢的错误。
ext.ext_en: No doubt I had blundered again...

ext.ext_cn: 你是一个大笨蛋。
ext.ext_en: You're  a blundering fool.

defs.def_en: If you blunder, you make a stupid or careless mistake.

defs.def_cn: 不慎陷入，误打误撞地进入（危险或困难的境地）

ext.ext_cn: 人们想知道他们是怎样稀里糊涂地陷入战争的，以及日后该如何避免重蹈覆辙。
ext.ext_en: People wanted to know how they had blundered into war, and how to avoid it in future.

defs.def_en: If you blunder into a dangerous or difficult situation, you get involved in it by mistake.

ext.ext_cn: 他不小心撞到了桌子，把花打翻了。
ext.ext_en: He had blundered into the table, upsetting the flowers.

defs.def_en: If you blunder somewhere, you move there in a clumsy and careless way.
A sand castle is a pile of sand, usually shaped like a castle, which children make when they are playing on the beach.

ext.ext_cn: 这本书本周出版。
ext.ext_en: The book comes out this week...

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯汀·史莱特有一部新片下月发行，他在片中扮演一个治安维持会成员。
ext.ext_en: Christian Slater has a new movie coming out next month in which he plays a vigilante.

defs.def_en: When a new product such as a book or CD comes out, it becomes available to the public.

ext.ext_cn: 真相开始逐渐浮出水面。
ext.ext_en: The truth is beginning to come out about what happened...

ext.ext_cn: 她暗中给爱尔兰共和军提供了大笔资助的事情即将曝光。
ext.ext_en: It will come out that she has covertly donated considerable sums to the IRA.

defs.def_en: If a fact comes out, it becomes known to people.

ext.ext_cn: 那里少数几位有勇气公开宣布自己是同性恋的男子
ext.ext_en: ...the few gay men there who dare to come out...

ext.ext_cn: 我才十几岁的时候，就公开了自己的同性恋身份。
ext.ext_en: I came out as a lesbian when I was still in my teens.

defs.def_en: When a gay person comes out, they let people know that they are gay.  come out of the closet→see: closet;

ext.ext_cn: 在美国近代史上这一小段阴暗时期，很少有人能有好的结果。
ext.ext_en: In this grim little episode of recent American history, few people come out well...

ext.ext_cn: 那么，是什么造就了美满的婚姻呢？结果表明忠诚是第一位的。

ext.ext_cn: 60年代以来，植树造林已经改变了威尔士的乡村面貌。
ext.ext_en: Since the Sixties, afforestation has changed the Welsh countryside.

defs.def_en: Afforestation is the process of planting large numbers of trees on land which has few or no trees on it.

ext.ext_cn: 这家银行将于12月庆祝其成立100周年。
ext.ext_en: The bank celebrates its hundredth anniversary in December.

defs.def_en: The hundredth item in a series is the one that you count as number one hundred.

ext.ext_cn: 米切尔以0.03秒的微弱优势赢了刘易斯。
ext.ext_en: Mitchell beat Lewis by three-hundredths of a second.

defs.def_en: A hundredth of something is one of a hundred equal parts of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 作品被拒后我感到很沮丧。
ext.ext_en: I feel despondent when my work is rejected.

defs.def_en: If you are despondent, you are very unhappy because you have been experiencing difficulties that you think you will not be able to overcome.

defs.def_cn: 过于谨慎；持暧昧态度；观望

ext.ext_cn: 他们为什么不能不再闪烁其词，说出他们真正的意图呢？
ext.ext_en: Why don't they stop pussyfooting around and say what they really mean?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is pussyfooting around, you are criticizing them for behaving in a too cautious way because they are not sure what to do and are afraid to commit themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为他坚持到底非常勇敢。
ext.ext_en: I think it was very brave of him to tough it out…

ext.ext_cn: 内阁大臣们表明他们将不顾争议坚持下去。
ext.ext_en: Cabinet ministers signalled their determination to tough out the controversy.

defs.def_en: If you tough out a difficult situation, you do not give in or show any weakness in that situation.

defs.def_cn: (不同社会、种族、宗教群体间)通婚

ext.ext_cn: 他们被获许通婚。
ext.ext_en: They were allowed to intermarry...

ext.ext_cn: 一些商人定居下来，并与当地妇女通婚。
ext.ext_en: Some of the traders settled and intermarried with local women.

defs.def_en: When people from different social, racial, or religious groups intermarry, they marry each other. You can also say that one group intermarries with another group.

defs.def_cn: 茶叶箱(装运茶叶或用于搬家的大木箱)
defs.def_en: A tea chest is a large wooden box in which tea is packed when it is exported. People also use tea chests for putting things in when they move from one house to another.

ext.ext_cn: 他和皮特之间有着惊人的相似之处。
ext.ext_en: There was a remarkable resemblance between him and Pete...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的旅游报价和那些度假手册里的价格相去甚远。
ext.ext_en: Our tour prices bore little resemblance to those in the holiday brochures.

defs.def_en: If there is a resemblance between two people or things, they are similar to each other.

ext.ext_cn: 政府公债市场异常活跃
ext.ext_en: ...an extraordinary level of activity in the government bonds market.

ext.ext_cn: 脑电波的活动
ext.ext_en: ...the electrical activity of the brain.

defs.def_en: Activity is a situation in which a lot of things are happening or being done.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以参与从划独木舟到观鸟等各种活动。
ext.ext_en: You can take part in activities from canoeing to bird watching.

defs.def_en: An activity is something that you spend time doing.

defs.def_cn: （团体为达到某种目的而采取的）活动，行动

ext.ext_cn: 因参与恐怖活动而被判的刑期
ext.ext_en: ...a jail term for terrorist activities...

ext.ext_cn: 4月29日，奉英国银行之命，该公司的各项活动被暂停。
ext.ext_en: On April 29, the activities of the company were suspended on the orders of the Bank of England.

defs.def_en: The activities of a group are the things that they do in order to achieve their aims.
A song and dance act is a performance in which a person or group of people sing and dance.

ext.ext_cn: 他用自己的钱去帮助别人，却从不到处声张。
ext.ext_en: He used his money to help others—but he never made a song and dance about it.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is making a song and dance about something, you mean they are making an unnecessary fuss about it.
See also:rump steak;T-bone steak;A steak is a large flat piece of beef without much fat on it. You cook it by grilling or frying it.

defs.def_cn: (常指切成块出售、供炖焖用的)牛肉

ext.ext_cn: 牛肉腰子馅饼
ext.ext_en: ...steak and kidney pie.

defs.def_en: See also:stewing steak;Steak is beef that is used for making stews. It is often cut into cubes to be sold.

ext.ext_cn: 鲜鲑鱼鱼排
ext.ext_en: ...fresh salmon steaks.

defs.def_en: A fish steak is a large piece of fish that contains few bones.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 二流餐馆
ext.ext_en: ...second-rate restaurants.

ext.ext_cn: 另一名二流政客
ext.ext_en: ...another second-rate politician.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as second-rate, you mean that it is of poor quality.

defs.def_cn: 鼓起的部分；隆起的部分

ext.ext_cn: 下颌骨上部的隆起部分
ext.ext_en: ...a protuberance on the upper jawbone.

defs.def_en: A protuberance is a rounded part that sticks out from the surface of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无法实现的；难以得到的

ext.ext_cn: 有一些人认为真正独立的意见是不存在的。
ext.ext_en: There are those who argue that true independent advice is unattainable.

ext.ext_cn: 无法实现的梦想
ext.ext_en: ...an unattainable dream.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is unattainable, you mean that it cannot be achieved or is not available.

ext.ext_cn: 女性的社会化强调与人相处。
ext.ext_en: Female socialization emphasizes getting along with others.

defs.def_en: Socialization is the process by which people, especially children, are made to behave in a way which is acceptable in their culture or society.

defs.def_cn: 社会所有化;社会主义化
defs.def_en: Socialization is the process by which something is made to operate on socialist principles.
An editor is the person who is in charge of a newspaper or magazine and who decides what will be published in each edition of it.

defs.def_cn: （报纸或杂志专栏的）编辑，主笔

ext.ext_cn: 烹调专栏主笔莫伊拉·弗雷泽会带您了解幕后的故事。
ext.ext_en: Cookery Editor Moyra Fraser takes you behind the scenes.

ext.ext_cn: 由家庭事务专栏编辑艾伦·特拉维斯执笔
ext.ext_en: ...by Alan Travis, Home Affairs Editor.

defs.def_en: An editor is a journalist who is responsible for a particular section of a newspaper or magazine.

ext.ext_cn: 你的编辑角色很重要，因为你能够客观地审视作品。
ext.ext_en: Your role as editor is important, for you can look at a piece of writing objectively.

defs.def_en: An editor is a person who checks and corrects texts before they are published.

defs.def_cn: （报道某类广播、电视新闻的）记者，编辑

ext.ext_cn: 我台经济新闻记者多米尼克·哈罗德
ext.ext_en: ...our economics editor, Dominic Harrod.

defs.def_en: An editor is a radio or television journalist who reports on a particular type of news.

defs.def_cn: （电影、广播或电视节目的）剪辑员，剪辑师

ext.ext_cn: 她在20世纪福克斯公司担任电影剪辑师。
ext.ext_en: She worked at 20th Century Fox as a film editor.

defs.def_en: An editor is a person who prepares a film, or a radio or television programme, by selecting some of what has been filmed or recorded and putting it in a particular order.

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔·罗森是这本选集的编者。
ext.ext_en: Michael Rosen is the editor of the anthology.

defs.def_en: An editor is a person who collects pieces of writing by different authors and prepares them for publication in a book or a series of books.
An editor is a computer program that enables you to change and correct stored data.

ext.ext_cn: 我曾经见到家长试图和他们的孩子讲道理，但是从没有见过这招奏效。
ext.ext_en: I have watched parents trying to reason with their children and have never seen it work.

defs.def_en: If you try to reason with someone, you try to persuade them to do or accept something by using sensible arguments.

ext.ext_cn: 两名被手铐铐在一起的囚犯试图逃跑时分别往电灯杆两边跑，结果没逃掉。
ext.ext_en: Two prisoners bungled an escape bid after running either side of a lamp-post while handcuffed.

ext.ext_cn: 联邦调查局为结束持续51天的围困进行的糟糕尝试
ext.ext_en: ...the FBI's bungled attempt to end the 51 day siege.

defs.def_en: If you bungle something, you fail to do it properly, because you make mistakes or are clumsy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 风很大，杰克觉得很冷。
ext.ext_en: It was windy and Jake felt cold.

defs.def_en: If it is windy, the wind is blowing a lot.

ext.ext_cn: 宗教原教旨主义正在这一地区蔓延。
ext.ext_en: Religious fundamentalism was spreading in the region.

defs.def_en: Fundamentalism is the belief in the original form of a religion or theory, without accepting any later ideas.

defs.def_cn: (面临同样问题或患同一疾病的人成立的)互助组，支援团

ext.ext_cn: 她参加了当地医院的癌症互助组。
ext.ext_en: She attended a cancer support group at her local hospital.

ext.ext_cn: 谋杀受害人家属互助组
ext.ext_en: ...a support group for relatives of murder victims.

defs.def_en: A support group is an organization run by and for people who have a particular problem or medical condition.

ext.ext_cn: 堪萨斯州的邮政缩写是KS。
ext.ext_en: The postal abbreviation for Kansas is KS.

defs.def_en: An abbreviation is a short form of a word or phrase, made by leaving out some of the letters or by using only the first letter of each word.
The EU is an organization of European countries which have joint policies on matters such as trade, agriculture, and finance. EU is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'European Union'.

ext.ext_cn: 他去年秋天出版了自己的自传。
ext.ext_en: He published his autobiography last autumn.

defs.def_en: Your autobiography is an account of your life, which you write yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 公众对这种治安管理费用的不满情绪与日俱增。
ext.ext_en: There is growing public disquiet about the cost of such policing.

defs.def_en: Disquiet is a feeling of worry or anxiety.

ext.ext_cn: 这则消息让他焦虑不安。
ext.ext_en: This information disquieted him.

defs.def_en: If something disquiets you, it makes you feel anxious.

ext.ext_cn: 她养大了4个孩子。
ext.ext_en: She brought up four children...

ext.ext_cn: 是他的祖母和父亲把他养大的。
ext.ext_en: His grandmother and his father brought him up...

defs.def_en: When someone brings up a child, they look after it until it is an adult. If someone has been brought up in a certain place or with certain attitudes, they grew up in that place or were taught those attitudes when they were growing up.
Backstroke is a swimming stroke that you do lying on your back.

ext.ext_cn: 100米仰泳比赛
ext.ext_en: ...the 100 metres backstroke.

defs.def_en: The backstroke is a swimming race in which the competitors swim backstroke.

ext.ext_cn: 罗斯向来喜欢有女人伴其左右。
ext.ext_en: Ross had always enjoyed the company of women...

ext.ext_cn: 他是个尽情享受生活的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a guy who enjoyed life to the full...

defs.def_en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

ext.ext_cn: 我得说此刻我感到非常愉快。
ext.ext_en: I must say I am really enjoying myself at the moment.

defs.def_en: If you enjoy yourself, you do something that you like doing or you take pleasure in the situation that you are in.

ext.ext_cn: 今年，德国人将平均享受40天的带薪假期。
ext.ext_en: The average German will enjoy 40 days' paid holiday this year...

ext.ext_cn: 他出了名地老实。
ext.ext_en: He enjoys a reputation for honesty.

defs.def_en: If you enjoy something such as a right, benefit, or privilege, you have it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的任务只是找到能够让直升机着陆的地方。
ext.ext_en: Their mission is simply to scout out places where helicopters can land.

defs.def_en: If you scout something out, you succeed in finding it after you have been through an area searching for it.

ext.ext_cn: 对其信念的公开否认
ext.ext_en: ...a public disavowal of his beliefs.

defs.def_en: A disavowal of something is a statement that you are not connected with it or responsible for it, or that you no longer agree with or believe in it.

ext.ext_cn: 这3名男子似乎已把东西往卡车上装载完毕。
ext.ext_en: The three men seemed to have finished loading the truck...

ext.ext_cn: 丹巴尔先生盛了一大盘千层面。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Dambar had loaded his plate with lasagne...

defs.def_en: If you load a vehicle or a container, you put a large quantity of things into it.

ext.ext_cn: 他载着一大车干草驶过。
ext.ext_en: He drove by with a big load of hay...

ext.ext_cn: 他身上背着沉甸甸的东西。
ext.ext_en: He was carrying a very heavy load.

defs.def_en: A load is something, usually a large quantity or heavy object, which is being carried.

ext.ext_cn: 我把另一堆衣服放进洗衣机。
ext.ext_en: I put another load in the washing machine.

defs.def_en: A load is a quantity of clothes or sheets which need washing and which are washed together in a washing machine.

ext.ext_cn: 我有大把的钱。
ext.ext_en: I've got loads of money...

ext.ext_cn: 他的部下亮出一大堆令人尴尬的资料来。
ext.ext_en: His people came up with a load of embarrassing information...

defs.def_en: If you refer to a load of people or things or loads of them, you are emphasizing that there are a lot of them.

ext.ext_cn: 我知道怎么上子弹，也知道枪怎么用。
ext.ext_en: I knew how to load and handle a gun...

ext.ext_cn: 他带了一把子弹上膛的枪。
ext.ext_en: He carried a loaded gun...

defs.def_en: When someone loads a weapon such as a gun, they put a bullet or missile in it so that it is ready to use.

defs.def_cn: 把（胶卷、磁带等）装入；将（数据）载入

ext.ext_cn: 那家报纸的一名摄影师正往相机里装胶卷。
ext.ext_en: A photographer from the newspaper was loading his camera with film...

ext.ext_cn: 一名技师把一盒录影带装进其中一台机器。
ext.ext_en: A technician loads a video tape into one of the machines...

defs.def_en: To load a camera or other piece of equipment means to put film, tape, or data into it so that it is ready to use.

ext.ext_cn: 她在给秘书们减轻一些工作量。
ext.ext_en: She's taking some of the load off the secretaries.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the amount of work you have to do as a load .

ext.ext_cn: 一个节能灯泡也许就能减轻发电站的负荷。
ext.ext_en: An efficient bulb may lighten the load of power stations...

ext.ext_cn: 几个处理器可共同分担处理一个程序数据的负荷。
ext.ext_en: Several processors can share the load of handling data in a single program.

defs.def_en: The load of a system or piece of equipment, especially a system supplying electricity or a computer, is the extent to which it is being used at a particular time.

ext.ext_cn: 这些椅子中有的是平脚的，这样可分散地面所受的压力。
ext.ext_en: Some of these chairs have flattened feet which spread the load on the ground...

ext.ext_cn: 高血压会给心脏增加额外的负担。
ext.ext_en: High blood pressure imposes an extra load on the heart.

defs.def_en: The load on something is the amount of weight that is pressing down on it or the amount of strain that it is under.

ext.ext_cn: 爆炸冲击波使含有有毒气体的蘑菇云腾空而起。
ext.ext_en: The blast sent a huge mushroom cloud of toxic gas into the air.

defs.def_en: A mushroom cloud is an extremely large cloud caused by a nuclear explosion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有资格的;符合条件的;有能力的

ext.ext_cn: 大约有一半人有资格参加今天的选举投票。
ext.ext_en: Almost half the population are eligible to vote in today's election...

ext.ext_cn: 你也许有资格获得大学奖学金。
ext.ext_en: You could be eligible for a university scholarship.

defs.def_en: Someone who is eligible to do something is qualified or able to do it, for example because they are old enough.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （作为结婚对象）合适的，中意的

ext.ext_cn: 他是日本最为抢手的单身汉。
ext.ext_en: He's the most eligible bachelor in Japan.

defs.def_en: An eligible man or woman is not yet married and is thought by many people to be a suitable partner.

ext.ext_cn: 灵敏的味觉
ext.ext_en: ...a keen sense of taste.

defs.def_en: Taste is one of the five senses that people have. When you have food or drink in your mouth, your sense of taste makes it possible for you to recognize what it is.

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢葡萄酒的味道，喜欢品尝不同的口味。
ext.ext_en: I like the taste of wine and enjoy trying different kinds...

ext.ext_cn: 她嗓子里的血腥味让她直恶心。
ext.ext_en: The taste of blood in her throat made her want to vomit...

defs.def_en: The taste of something is the individual quality which it has when you put it in your mouth and which distinguishes it from other things. For example, something may have a sweet, bitter, sour, or salty taste.

ext.ext_cn: 我们尝了尝他带来的白葡萄酒。
ext.ext_en: We have a taste of the white wine he's brought.

defs.def_en: If you have a taste of some food or drink, you try a small amount of it in order to see what the flavour is like.

ext.ext_cn: 我喝了杯有股柴油味的茶。
ext.ext_en: I drank a cup of tea that tasted of diesel...

ext.ext_cn: 它吃起来像巧克力。
ext.ext_en: It tastes like chocolate...

defs.def_en: If food or drink tastes of something, it has that particular flavour, which you notice when you eat or drink it.

ext.ext_cn: 他喝完开胃酒，又尝了点侍者端来的葡萄酒。
ext.ext_en: He finished his aperitif and tasted the wine the waiter had produced...

ext.ext_cn: 在进行下一步之前，先切一小块肉尝尝。
ext.ext_en: Before proceeding any further, cut off a small bit of the meat and taste it.

defs.def_en: If you taste some food or drink, you eat or drink a small amount of it in order to try its flavour, for example to see if you like it or not.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以尝出菜里面有辣椒，不过味道有点甜。
ext.ext_en: You can taste the chilli in the dish but it is a little sweet.

defs.def_en: If you can taste something that you are eating or drinking, you are aware of its flavour.

ext.ext_cn: 但是，有过一举成名的经历以后，他就不会再想回去当替补了。
ext.ext_en: But having had a taste of the big time, he won't want to go back to playing in the reserves...

ext.ext_cn: 这次航行使他初次体验到了自由的滋味。
ext.ext_en: This voyage was his first taste of freedom.

defs.def_en: If you have a taste of a particular way of life or activity, you have a brief experience of it.

ext.ext_cn: 任何过过这种日子的人都希望它持续得越久越好。
ext.ext_en: Anyone who has tasted this life wants it to carry on for as long as possible.

defs.def_en: If you taste something such as a way of life or a pleasure, you experience it for a short period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 她喜欢上了到北美那些险象环生的偏远地区旅行。
ext.ext_en: She developed a taste for journeys to isolated hazardous regions in North America...

ext.ext_cn: 那使我喜欢上了读书。
ext.ext_en: That gave me a taste for reading.

defs.def_en: If you have a taste for something, you have a liking or preference for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他在穿衣方面很有品味。
ext.ext_en: His taste in clothes is extremely good...

ext.ext_cn: 牛津的社交圈过于开放，不合她的胃口。
ext.ext_en: Oxford's social circle was far too liberal for her taste.

defs.def_en: A person's taste is their choice in the things that they like or buy, for example their clothes, possessions, or music. If you say that someone has good taste, you mean that you approve of their choices. If you say that they have poor taste, you disapprove of their choices.

defs.def_cn: 格调庸俗的/格调高雅的;没品位的/高品位的;不合时宜的/得体的

ext.ext_cn: 他不接受那种认为他的电影格调不高的观点。
ext.ext_en: He rejects the idea that his film is in bad taste...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为你的行为既不妥当又不合时宜。
ext.ext_en: I do not feel your actions were either appropriate or done in good taste.

defs.def_en: If you say that something that is said or done is in bad taste or in poor taste, you mean that it is offensive, often because it concerns death or sex and is inappropriate for the situation. If you say that something is in good taste, you mean that it is not offensive and that it is appropriate for the situation.

ext.ext_cn: 酌量添加番茄酱、盐和胡椒粉。
ext.ext_en: Add tomato paste, salt and pepper to taste.

defs.def_en: When a recipe tells you to add a particular spice or other flavouring to taste, it means that you can add as much of that ingredient as you like.

defs.def_cn: 收购，购买（公司或机构）的股份

ext.ext_cn: 其他公司会收购这家公司的股份。
ext.ext_en: Other companies could buy into the firm.

defs.def_en: See also:buy;If you buy into a company or an organization, you buy part of it, often in order to gain some control of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人失望的;令人沮丧的;令人扫兴的

ext.ext_cn: 酒棒极了，但是饭菜却让人不敢恭维。
ext.ext_en: The wine was excellent, but the food was disappointing...

ext.ext_cn: 对此呼吁的反应令人失望，主要归咎于经济衰退。
ext.ext_en: The recession is largely blamed for the disappointing response to the appeal.

defs.def_en: Something that is disappointing is not as good or as large as you hoped it would be.
A gamer is someone who plays computer games.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...his passionate commitment to peace...

ext.ext_cn: 我是公共艺术的狂热信徒。
ext.ext_en: I'm a passionate believer in public art...

defs.def_en: A passionate person has very strong feelings about something or a strong belief in something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 美丽而炽烈的26岁女子
ext.ext_en: ...a beautiful, passionate woman of twenty-six.

ext.ext_cn: 热恋故事
ext.ext_en: ...the story of a passionate love affair...

defs.def_en: A passionate person has strong romantic or sexual feelings and expresses them in their behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 他不想就语义进行争辩。
ext.ext_en: He did not want to enter into a semantic debate.

defs.def_en: Semantic is used to describe things that deal with the meanings of words and sentences.

defs.def_cn: 自负地谈论；武断地说话

ext.ext_cn: 政客喜欢自以为是地谈论准则的废弛。
ext.ext_en: Politicians like to pontificate about falling standards.

defs.def_en: If someone pontificates about something, they state their opinions as if they are the only correct ones and nobody could possibly argue against them.

ext.ext_cn: 教皇福尔摩苏斯上任四年半后去世。
ext.ext_en: Pope Formosus died after a pontificate of four and a half years.

defs.def_en: The pontificate of a pope is the period of time during which he is pope.
The large round tent that a circus uses for its performances is called the big top.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 易激动的;感情冲动的;（尤指）敢爱敢恨的

ext.ext_cn: 这两名舞蹈演员都深知自己何以吸引了两位热血青年的注意力。
ext.ext_en: Both of these dancers knew full well why they attracted the attentions of two hot-blooded young men.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as hot-blooded, you mean that they are very quick to express their emotions, especially anger and love.

ext.ext_cn: 她转身对房间里的其他人说：“你们其余人给我滚出去。”
ext.ext_en: She turned to the others in the room. 'The rest of you clear out of here.'...

ext.ext_cn: “滚出去！”他高声骂道，“这是私人住宅！”
ext.ext_en: 'Clear out!' he bawled. 'Private property!'

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to clear out of a place or to clear out, you are telling them rather rudely to leave the place.

ext.ext_cn: 我临走时特地事先把办公桌清理了一下。
ext.ext_en: I took the precaution of clearing out my desk before I left.

defs.def_en: See also:clear-out;If you clear out a container, room, or house, you tidy it and throw away the things in it that you no longer want.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 未达专业水准的；不专业的；外行的

ext.ext_cn: 她的表现很不专业，在节目进行到90分钟的时候就突然离开了。
ext.ext_en: What she did was very unprofessional. She left abruptly about 90 minutes into the show...

ext.ext_cn: 他还因行为违反了职业道德而被罚150美元。
ext.ext_en: He was also fined $150 for unprofessional conduct.

defs.def_en: If you use unprofessional to describe someone's behaviour at work, you are criticizing them for not behaving according to the standards that are expected of a person in their profession.

defs.def_cn: （旧时的）满师学徒工，学徒期满的工匠
defs.def_en: In former times, a journeyman was a worker who had finished learning a trade and who was employed by someone rather than working on his or her own.

defs.def_cn: （缺乏天分或原创性的）熟练工，熟手

ext.ext_cn: 道格拉斯29岁，是个技术不错的拳击手，在以前的比赛中发挥不太稳定。
ext.ext_en: Douglas was a 29-year-old journeyman fighter, erratic in his previous fights.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a journeyman, you mean that they have the basic skill which their job requires, but are not very talented or original.

ext.ext_cn: 我可以用一张软盘来启动，但其他的就无能为力了。
ext.ext_en: I can boot up from a floppy disk, but that's all...

ext.ext_cn: 去启动你的个人电脑。
ext.ext_en: Go over to your PC and boot it up.

defs.def_en: When you boot up a computer, you make it ready to use by putting in the instructions which it needs in order to start working.

ext.ext_cn: 穿堂风有助于空气流通。
ext.ext_en: Draughts help to circulate air...

ext.ext_cn: 基思打开窗户，探出身到冷风中。
ext.ext_en: Keith opened the window and leaned out into the cold air.

defs.def_en: Air is the mixture of gases which forms the earth's atmosphere and which we breathe.

ext.ext_cn: 政府军队朝天鸣枪驱散了抗议人群。
ext.ext_en: Government troops broke up the protest by firing their guns in the air...

ext.ext_cn: 人们吸烟的烟雾似乎会长时间滞留在空气中。
ext.ext_en: People's cigarette smoke seemed to hang in the air.

defs.def_en: The air is the space around things or above the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 乘飞机旅行的人数将以每年大约6%的速度持续增加。
ext.ext_en: Air travel will continue to grow at about 6% per year...

ext.ext_cn: 伤者不得不用飞机送往医院。
ext.ext_en: Casualties had to be brought to hospital by air.

defs.def_en: Air is used to refer to travel in aircraft.
An air is a simple tune which can be easily recognized and remembered.

defs.def_cn: 神态;感觉;总体印象;氛围

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮弗觉得他很风趣。
ext.ext_en: Jennifer regarded him with an air of amusement...

ext.ext_cn: 这一餐使整个场合有了近乎节日般的喜庆氛围。
ext.ext_en: The meal gave the occasion an almost festive air.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has a particular air, you mean that they give this general impression.

defs.def_cn: 矫揉造作；装腔作势；做作

ext.ext_cn: 我们贫穷但从不装腔作势。
ext.ext_en: We're poor and we never put on airs.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is putting on airs or giving themselves airs, you are criticizing them for behaving as if they are better than other people.

defs.def_cn: （通过电视或无线电）播送，播放

ext.ext_cn: 今晚公共广播公司将播放一部名为《民主进行时》的纪录片。
ext.ext_en: Tonight PBS will air a documentary called 'Democracy In Action'.

defs.def_en: If a broadcasting company airs a television or radio programme, they show it on television or broadcast it on the radio.

ext.ext_cn: 他们一起坐了六个多小时，而且双方都认为他们已经表达了所有的不同意见。
ext.ext_en: They sat for more than six hours, and both sides agreed they had aired all their differences...

ext.ext_cn: 在会上完全公开了整个问题。
ext.ext_en: The whole issue was thoroughly aired at the meeting.

defs.def_en: If you air your opinions, you make them known to people.

ext.ext_cn: 她母亲按部就班地每周一次清扫所有的房间并开窗通风。
ext.ext_en: One day a week her mother systematically cleaned and aired each room.

defs.def_en: If you air a room or building, you let fresh air into it.

ext.ext_cn: 衬衫洗干净之后，我自己将它们熨好、烘干并放在他房间的抽屉里。
ext.ext_en: When the shirts were clean, I ironed them myself, aired them and placed them in drawers in his room.

defs.def_en: If you air clothing or bedding, you put it somewhere warm to make sure that it is completely dry.

ext.ext_cn: 一项只为消除疑团并弄清案件事实而进行的调查
ext.ext_en: ...an inquiry just to clear the air and settle the facts of the case.

defs.def_en: If you do something to clear the air, you do it in order to resolve any problems or disagreements that there might be.

defs.def_cn: 大模大样;摆架子;装腔作势

ext.ext_cn: “顾客总是对的”这种陈词滥调让他们变得趾高气扬。
ext.ext_en: The old cliché of the customer being always right is what gives them airs and graces.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's airs and graces, you mean that they behave in a way that shows that they think they are more important than other people.

ext.ext_cn: 人人都感到无比激动。
ext.ext_en: There was great excitement in the air...

ext.ext_cn: 她走开了，将疑问留在人们心里。
ext.ext_en: She walked away and left the question hanging in the air.

defs.def_en: If something is in the air it is felt to be present, but it is not talked about.

defs.def_cn: 播送（广播、电视节目）；（广播、电视节目）播放/停止播放

ext.ext_cn: 她即将上电视主持一档新节目。
ext.ext_en: She is going on the air as presenter of a new show...

ext.ext_cn: 罗克韦尔希望该节目能在一年内播出。
ext.ext_en: Rockwell hopes the program can be on the air within a year...

defs.def_en: If someone is on the air, they are broadcasting on radio or television. If a programme is on the air, it is being broadcast on radio or television. If it is off the air, it is not being broadcast.

defs.def_cn: （消失得）无影无踪/突然神秘地（出现）

ext.ext_cn: “但是他们可能去哪里呢？”他追问道，“他们不可能就神秘消失了!”
ext.ext_en: 'But where could they have gone?' he demanded. 'They can't just vanish into thin air!'...

ext.ext_cn: 他突然间神秘地出现了；我既没看见他来，也没听见他的脚步声。
ext.ext_en: He had materialized out of thin air; I had not seen or heard him coming.

defs.def_en: If someone or something disappears into thin air, they disappear completely. If someone or something appears out of thin air, they appear suddenly and mysteriously.

ext.ext_cn: 今天他告诉记者们总统是否前往莫斯科尚未确定。
ext.ext_en: He told reporters today that the president's trip to Moscow is up in the air.

defs.def_en: If you say that a decision or a situation is up in the air, you mean that it has not yet been completely settled or planned.

ext.ext_cn: 一得知我加入了这个队，我高兴得像飞上了天。
ext.ext_en: As soon as I know I'm in the team it's like I'm walking on air.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are walking on air or floating on air, you mean that you feel extremely happy about something.

ext.ext_cn: 我肩膀里的几块金属碎片
ext.ext_en: ...fragments of metal in my shoulder...

ext.ext_cn: 她什么都看，对新闻的每个片段都细细品味。
ext.ext_en: She read everything, digesting every fragment of news.

defs.def_en: A fragment of something is a small piece or part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 乌云散开，太阳出来了。
ext.ext_en: The clouds fragmented and out came the sun...

ext.ext_cn: 激烈的竞争已经如从前一样使得该地区四分五裂。
ext.ext_en: Fierce rivalries have traditionally fragmented the region...

defs.def_en: If something fragments or is fragmented, it breaks or separates into small pieces or parts.

ext.ext_cn: 道格拉斯扮演一个失意的普通美国人，他在日常生活压力下突然失控。
ext.ext_en: Douglas plays a frustrated American everyman who suddenly loses control under the pressure of daily life.

defs.def_en: Everyman is used to refer to people in general. If you say, for example, that a character in a film or book is an everyman, you mean that the character has experiences and emotions that are like those of any ordinary person.

ext.ext_cn: 我通过锁眼向里看。
ext.ext_en: I looked through the keyhole.

defs.def_en: A keyhole is the hole in a lock that you put a key in.

defs.def_cn: （情感、事件等）使不知所措，使难以承受

ext.ext_cn: 他一心渴望回到从前。
ext.ext_en: He was overwhelmed by a longing for times past...

ext.ext_cn: 她迫不及待地要找个人说说话，随便是谁都行。
ext.ext_en: The need to talk to someone, anyone, overwhelmed her.

defs.def_en: If you are overwhelmed by a feeling or event, it affects you very strongly, and you do not know how to deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 毫无疑问，盟军一次大规模的进攻就会击溃已是强弩之末的敌军。
ext.ext_en: It was clear that one massive Allied offensive would overwhelm the weakened enemy.

defs.def_en: If a group of people overwhelm a place or another group, they gain complete control or victory over them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们快活地扑向三明治。
ext.ext_en: They fell on the sandwiches with alacrity.

defs.def_en: If you fall on something when it arrives or appears, you eagerly seize it or welcome it.

ext.ext_cn: 尿道感染
ext.ext_en: ...urinary tract infections.

defs.def_en: Urinary means belonging to or related to the parts of a person's body through which urine flows.

ext.ext_cn: 他打开地图，放在了地板上。
ext.ext_en: He unfolded the map and set it on the floor...

ext.ext_cn: 你有市中心的地图吗？
ext.ext_en: Have you got a map of the city centre?

defs.def_en: A map is a drawing of a particular area such as a city, a country, or a continent, showing its main features as they would appear if you looked at them from above.

ext.ext_cn: 地质图、书籍与地图册
ext.ext_en: ...geological maps, books and atlases.

ext.ext_cn: 电视上的气象图
ext.ext_en: ...weather maps on television.

defs.def_en: A map is a drawing that gives special information about an area.

ext.ext_cn: 使用雷达绘制金星表面地图的宇宙飞船
ext.ext_en: ...a spacecraft which is using radar to map the surface of Venus.

ext.ext_cn: 对海底地形的更精确绘制
ext.ext_en: ...better mapping of the ocean  floor.

defs.def_en: To map an area means to make a map of it.

ext.ext_cn: 爱丁堡艺术节的组织者们为使C.P.泰勒名扬四海所作的努力
ext.ext_en: ...the attempts of the Edinburgh Festival's organisers to put C.P. Taylor firmly on the map...

ext.ext_en: This could put cider back on the map as one of our great national drinks.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something put a person, thing, or place on the map, you approve of the fact that they made it become well-known and important.

defs.def_cn: （塑料或金属制的）编织针，毛衣针
defs.def_en: Knitting needles are thin plastic or metal rods which you use when you are knitting.

ext.ext_cn: 我快速翻至索引部分。
ext.ext_en: I riffled through the pages until I reached the index.

defs.def_en: If you riffle through the pages of a book or riffle them, you turn them over quickly, without reading everything that is on them.

ext.ext_cn: 她看见科林原本红润的脸渐渐失去了血色。
ext.ext_en: She watched the colour drain from Colin's rubicund face.

defs.def_en: If someone has a rubicund face, they have a red face.

ext.ext_cn: 我正在等待苹果成熟。
ext.ext_en: I'm waiting for the apples to ripen...

ext.ext_cn: 把西红柿放在有阳光的窗台上可以让它们成熟。
ext.ext_en: You can ripen the tomatoes on a sunny windowsill.

defs.def_en: When crops ripen or when the sun ripens them, they become ripe.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you describe a person as companionable, you mean they are friendly and pleasant to be with.

defs.def_cn: 不可摧毁的;不可毁坏的

ext.ext_cn: 这种塑料几乎牢不可破。
ext.ext_en: This type of plastic is almost indestructible.

defs.def_en: If something is indestructible, it is very strong and cannot be destroyed.

defs.def_cn: 对人而言地;与人相关地

ext.ext_cn: 作为母亲不容许有常人的缺点，她必须十全十美。
ext.ext_en: A mother is not allowed to be humanly flawed; she has to be perfect.

defs.def_en: Humanly means relating to human beings.

defs.def_cn: 人力能及的;尽最大努力的

ext.ext_cn: 她因在著书上追求极致之美而享有盛名。
ext.ext_en: She has gained a reputation for creating books as perfect as is humanly possible...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经为儿子竭尽了全力。
ext.ext_en: They had done everything humanly possible for their son.

defs.def_en: If something is humanly possible, it is possible for people to do it.

defs.def_cn: 使复杂化的难题(或困难)
