ext.ext_en: The age difference was a complication to the relationship...

ext.ext_cn: 还有个问题就是对环境的日益关注。
ext.ext_en: An added complication is the growing concern for the environment.

defs.def_en: A complication is a problem or difficulty that makes a situation harder to deal with.

ext.ext_cn: 失明是糖尿病常见的并发症。
ext.ext_en: Blindness is a common complication of diabetes...

ext.ext_cn: 他死于心脏病发作引起的并发症。
ext.ext_en: He died of complications from a heart attack.

defs.def_en: A complication is a medical problem that occurs as a result of another illness or disease.
The forenoon is the morning.
A whetstone is a stone which is used for sharpening knives or other tools that have a blade.

ext.ext_cn: 一团黑烟吹过城市的上空。
ext.ext_en: A cloud of black smoke blew over the city...

ext.ext_cn: 空气里充斥着浓浓的烟味。
ext.ext_en: The air was thick with cigarette smoke.

defs.def_en: Smoke consists of gas and small bits of solid material that are sent into the air when something burns.

ext.ext_cn: 烟囱里浓烟滚滚。
ext.ext_en: The chimney was smoking fiercely.

ext.ext_cn: 一堆冒着烟的瓦砾
ext.ext_en: ...a pile of smoking rubble.

defs.def_en: If something is smoking, smoke is coming from it.

ext.ext_cn: 他独自坐在那儿，抽着一只大雪茄。
ext.ext_en: He was sitting alone, smoking a big cigar...

ext.ext_cn: 戒烟并非易事。
ext.ext_en: It's not easy to quit smoking cigarettes...

defs.def_en: When someone smokes a cigarette, cigar, or pipe, they suck the smoke from it into their mouth and blow it out again. If you smoke, you regularly smoke cigarettes, cigars, or a pipe.

ext.ext_cn: 熏鱼用的格栅
ext.ext_en: ...the grid where the fish were being smoked.

ext.ext_cn: 熏咸肉
ext.ext_en: ...smoked bacon.

defs.def_en: If fish or meat is smoked, it is hung over burning wood so that the smoke preserves it and gives it a special flavour.
If someone says there's no smoke without fire or where there's smoke there's fire, they mean that there are rumours or signs that something is true so it must be at least partly true.

defs.def_cn: 被焚毁;被烧掉;被付之一炬

ext.ext_cn: 900 多年的英国历史在温莎城堡的一场大火中灰飞烟灭。
ext.ext_en: More than 900 years of British history went up in smoke in the Great Fire of Windsor.

defs.def_en: If something goes up in smoke, it is destroyed by fire.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的旅行社倒闭之后，他们的梦想也随之破灭了。
ext.ext_en: Their dreams went up in smoke after the collapse of their travel agency.

defs.def_en: If something that is very important to you goes up in smoke, it fails or ends without anything being achieved.

ext.ext_cn: 该国有 3/4 的工人参加了这次罢工。
ext.ext_en: Three-quarters of the country's workers took part in the strike...

ext.ext_cn: 那花了他大概 45 分钟。
ext.ext_en: It took him about three-quarters of an hour.

defs.def_en: Three-quarters is an amount that is three out of four equal parts of something.
A gooseberry is a small green fruit that has a sharp taste and is covered with tiny hairs.
In football, if a player commits a professional foul, they deliberately do something which is against the rules in order to prevent another player from scoring a goal.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (观点、计划)受错误思想引导的；（人）被错误地引导的，被引入歧途的

ext.ext_cn: 他本想表现得风趣一点，却弄巧成拙地冒犯了别人。
ext.ext_en: In a misguided attempt to be funny, he manages only offensiveness...

ext.ext_cn: 他误以为她能够以诚相待。
ext.ext_en: He is misguided in expecting honesty from her.

defs.def_en: If you describe an opinion or plan as misguided, you are critical of it because you think it is based on an incorrect idea. You can also describe people as misguided.

ext.ext_cn: 那并没有说服他们放弃战争，但的确迫使他们重新评估了自己的战略。
ext.ext_en: It did not persuade them to abandon the war but it did force them to reappraise their strategy.

defs.def_en: If you reappraise something such as an idea or a plan, you think carefully about it and decide whether it needs to be changed.
If you handwash something, you wash it by hand rather than in a washing machine.

ext.ext_cn: 他于 7 月份下令解散国内所有的非正式武装组织。
ext.ext_en: In July he issued a decree ordering all unofficial armed groups in the country to disband...

ext.ext_cn: 他准备行使其新近获得的权力，发布总统政令以推行改革。
ext.ext_en: He is prepared to use his recently-acquired powers to introduce reform by presidential decree.

defs.def_en: A decree is an official order or decision, especially one made by the ruler of a country.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国安理会已通过决议，规定选举必须在5月前举行。
ext.ext_en: The UN Security Council has decreed that the election must be held by May...

ext.ext_cn: 国王颁布了大赦令。
ext.ext_en: The king decreed a general amnesty.

defs.def_en: If someone in authority decrees that something must happen, they decide or state this officially.

ext.ext_cn: 法庭的裁决
ext.ext_en: ...court decrees.

defs.def_en: A decree is a judgment made by a law court.

ext.ext_cn: 副国务卿雷金纳德·巴塞洛缪
ext.ext_en: ...Under-Secretary of State Reginald Bartholomew.

ext.ext_cn: 外交部副部长
ext.ext_en: ...the under-secretary for Foreign Affairs.

defs.def_en: An under-secretary is a senior official with an important post in a government department.

ext.ext_cn: 你头发的发质与健康状况都应改善。
ext.ext_en: Both the texture and condition of your hair should improve...

ext.ext_cn: 天气开始好转了。
ext.ext_en: The weather is beginning to improve...

defs.def_en: If something improves or if you improve it, it gets better.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的法语进步很大。
ext.ext_en: Their French has improved enormously...

ext.ext_cn: 他说他要提高足球技术。
ext.ext_en: He said he was going to improve his football.

defs.def_en: If a skill you have improves or you improve a skill, you get better at it.

ext.ext_cn: 他康复很快,医生已减少了用药剂量。
ext.ext_en: He had improved so much the doctor had cut his dosage.

defs.def_en: If you improve after an illness or an injury, your health gets better or you get stronger.

ext.ext_cn: 我们需要比对阵法国队时表现得更好。
ext.ext_en: We need to improve on our performance against France.

defs.def_en: If you improve on a previous achievement of your own or of someone else, you achieve a better standard or result.

ext.ext_cn: 摩托车手们风驰电掣般离去。
ext.ext_en: The bikers zoomed off.

defs.def_en: If you zoom off, you leave very quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 当时霍乱疫情已在夺去很多战俘的生命。
ext.ext_en: A cholera plague had been killing many prisoners of war at the time.

defs.def_en: A plague is a very infectious disease that spreads quickly and kills large numbers of people.

ext.ext_cn: 新一轮鼠疫的爆发
ext.ext_en: ...a fresh outbreak of plague.

ext.ext_cn: 像天花、伤寒和鼠疫这样的疾病
ext.ext_en: ...illnesses such as smallpox, typhus and the plague.

defs.def_en: Plague or the plague is a very infectious disease which usually results in death. The patient has a severe fever and swellings on his or her body.

defs.def_cn: （某一事物肆虐造成的）灾难，祸患

ext.ext_cn: 该市处于鼠患的威胁之下。
ext.ext_en: The city is under threat from a plague of rats...

ext.ext_cn: 去年抢劫和入室行窃成灾。
ext.ext_en: Last year there was a plague of robbery and housebreaking.

defs.def_en: A plague of unpleasant things is a large number of them that arrive or happen at the same time.

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀将继续成为周期性的烦扰。
ext.ext_en: Inflation will remain a recurrent plague...

ext.ext_cn: 蒂姆好像并没有染上我们这代人愤世嫉俗的通病。
ext.ext_en: Tim seems to have escaped the cynicism which is the absolute plague of our generation.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a plague, you mean that it causes a great deal of trouble or harm.

ext.ext_cn: 她感觉体虚、疲倦、头昏眼花。
ext.ext_en: She was plagued by weakness, fatigue, and dizziness...

ext.ext_cn: 几乎一半的员工担心失业。
ext.ext_en: Fears about job security plague nearly half the workforce.

defs.def_en: If you are plagued by unpleasant things, they continually cause you a lot of trouble or suffering.

ext.ext_cn: 卡尔弗小姐，我不会再问更多的问题来烦你了。
ext.ext_en: I'm not going to plague you with a lot more questions, Miss Culver...

ext.ext_cn: 汤米·库克已纠缠平纳好几个月了。
ext.ext_en: Tommy Cook had been plaguing Pinner for months.

defs.def_en: If someone plagues you, they keep bothering you or asking you for something.

ext.ext_cn: 他的妻子和我的父母在旁边时，我会极力躲着他。
ext.ext_en: I would avoid him like the plague when his wife and my parents were around...

ext.ext_cn: 我一般对廉价的葡萄酒敬而远之。
ext.ext_en: I normally avoid cheap wine like the plague.

defs.def_en: If you say that you avoid someone or something like the plague, you are emphasizing that you deliberately avoid them completely.

ext.ext_cn: 你和你该死的百分比都见鬼去吧！
ext.ext_en: A plague on you and your damned percentages!

defs.def_en: You say a plague on a particular person or thing when you are very irritated by them and do not want to bother with them any more.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （女性）娇小可爱的，小巧玲珑的
defs.def_en: If you describe a woman as petite, you are politely saying that she is small and is not fat.

ext.ext_cn: 他们或许想逃离这个国家。
ext.ext_en: They probably wanted to get out of the country...

ext.ext_cn: 我叫他滚开。
ext.ext_en: I told him to leave and get out.

defs.def_en: If you get out, you leave a place because you want to escape from it, or because you are made to leave it.

ext.ext_cn: 出去走走，好好玩玩，交些新朋友。
ext.ext_en: Get out and enjoy yourself, make new friends.

defs.def_en: If you get out, you go to places and meet people, usually in order to have a more enjoyable life.

ext.ext_cn: 我想退出这个团体，但是他们不同意。
ext.ext_en: I wanted to get out of the group, but they wouldn't let me...

ext.ext_cn: 撤销这个合同不会有任何问题。
ext.ext_en: Getting out of the contract would be no problem.

defs.def_en: If you get out of an organization or a commitment, you withdraw from it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果消息现在传出去，可能会是灾难性的丑闻。
ext.ext_en: If word got out now, a scandal could be disastrous...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为亚美尼亚局势非常严峻的消息一旦披露，全世界都将作出反应。
ext.ext_en: Once the news gets out that Armenia is in a very critical situation, I think the world will respond.

defs.def_en: If news or information gets out, it becomes known.

defs.def_cn: 拉斯塔法里教徒（把前埃塞俄比亚皇帝海尔·塞拉西奉为神来崇拜的牙买加宗教团体的成员，通常留长发）

ext.ext_cn: 他是南非仅有的几千名虔诚的拉斯塔法里教徒中的一员。
ext.ext_en: He was one of the few thousand committed Rastafarians in South Africa.

defs.def_en: A Rastafarian is a member of a Jamaican religious group which considers Haile Selassie, the former Emperor of Ethiopia, to be God. Rastafarians often have long hair which they wear in a hairstyle called dreadlocks.

defs.def_cn: 拉斯塔法里教的;拉斯塔法里教徒的

ext.ext_cn: 拉斯塔法里教诗人本杰明·西番雅
ext.ext_en: ...Rastafarian poet Benjamin Zephaniah...

ext.ext_cn: 因为信奉拉斯塔法里教，他拒绝剪去头发。
ext.ext_en: He refused to cut his hair due to his Rastafarian beliefs.

defs.def_en: Rastafarian is used to describe Rastafarians and their beliefs and lifestyle.

ext.ext_cn: 不缴水费引起的断水的比率正在上升。
ext.ext_en: The rate of disconnections following non-payment of water charges is rising.

ext.ext_cn: 他的电话被切断
ext.ext_en: ...the disconnection of his phone.

defs.def_en: The disconnection of a gas, water, or electricity supply, or of a telephone, is the act of disconnecting it so that it cannot be used.

ext.ext_cn: 他希望能从联盟中逐渐抽身而出。
ext.ext_en: He hopes for a gradual disconnection from the federation.

defs.def_en: The disconnection of two things is the act or process of separating them so that they are no longer connected or linked in any way.

defs.def_cn: 非常劣质的；蹩脚透顶的

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·兰迪斯导演的一部糟糕至极的喜剧
ext.ext_en: ...a piss-poor comedy directed by John Landis.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as piss-poor, you think it is of extremely poor quality.

ext.ext_cn: 夜总会的艺人
ext.ext_en: ...a cabaret artiste.

defs.def_en: An artiste is a professional entertainer, for example a singer or a dancer.

defs.def_cn: (做晚礼服用的尼龙或丝质)薄纱，绢网，丝网
defs.def_en: Tulle is a soft nylon or silk cloth similar to net, that is used for making evening dresses.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 悔过的； 忏悔的；愧疚的

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯特·盖茨坐在他们面前，对过去的事几乎无颜以对。
ext.ext_en: Robert Gates sat before them, almost penitent about the past...

ext.ext_cn: 她深感愧疚。
ext.ext_en: She is deeply penitent.

defs.def_en: Someone who is penitent is very sorry for something wrong that they have done, and regrets their actions.

ext.ext_cn: 我有两个助手协助经营。
ext.ext_en: I have two assistants who help with the admin.

ext.ext_cn: 监狱的管理人员
ext.ext_en: ...the prison's admin staff.

defs.def_en: Admin is the activity or process of organizing an institution or organization.
Stewardship is the responsibility of looking after property.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 全世界有1/4的人没有个像样的家。
ext.ext_en: One in four people worldwide are without adequate homes...

ext.ext_cn: 老一套方法已不足以满足当前的需要。
ext.ext_en: The old methods weren't adequate to meet current needs...

defs.def_en: If something is adequate, there is enough of it or it is good enough to be used or accepted.

defs.def_cn: (食品的)最迟销售日期，保质期

ext.ext_cn: 一块超过保质期4周的奶酪
ext.ext_en: ...a piece of cheese four weeks past its sell-by date.

defs.def_en: The sell-by date on a food container is the date by which the food should be sold or eaten before it starts to decay.

defs.def_cn: 不再有效的;不再吸引人的;无用的

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名运动员，他早已风光不再。
ext.ext_en: As a sportsman, he is long past his sell-by date.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is past their sell-by date, you mean they are no longer effective, interesting, or useful.

ext.ext_cn: 在报纸下面的一张纸上放着一个信封。
ext.ext_en: Under the newspaper, atop a sheet of paper, lay an envelope.

defs.def_en: If something is atop something else, it is on top of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 尼古拉·杰米坚科的表演激动人心且富有诗意。
ext.ext_en: Nikolai Demidenko gave an exciting yet poetic performance.

defs.def_en: Something that is poetic is very beautiful and expresses emotions in a sensitive or moving way.

ext.ext_cn: 盖尔语有非常深厚的诗歌传统。
ext.ext_en: There's a very rich poetic tradition in Gaelic.

defs.def_en: Poetic means relating to poetry.

defs.def_cn: 万金油；万能博士；杂而不精的人
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a jack-of-all-trades, you mean that they are able to do a variety of different jobs. You are also often suggesting that they are not very good at any of these jobs.

defs.def_cn: (书籍、唱片或电影)标准长度的，未经删节的

ext.ext_cn: 他十好几年以来第一张足长的唱片
ext.ext_en: ...his first full-length recording in well over a decade.

defs.def_en: A full-length book, record, or film is the normal length, rather than being shorter than normal.

defs.def_cn: (上衣或裙子)长及小腿(或脚踝)的;(衣袖)长及手腕的
defs.def_en: A full-length coat or skirt is long enough to reach the lower part of a person's leg, almost to the ankles. A full-length sleeve reaches a person's wrist.
Full-length curtains or other furnishings reach to the floor.
A full-length mirror or painting shows the whole of a person.

ext.ext_cn: 她摊平了四肢。
ext.ext_en: She stretched herself out full-length.

defs.def_en: Someone who is lying full-length, is lying down flat and stretched out.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人怜悯的；引人哀怜的；可怜的

ext.ext_cn: 他们经过时，响起了令人哀怜的恸哭。
ext.ext_en: As they pass by, a piteous wailing is heard.

defs.def_en: Something that is piteous is so sad that you feel great pity for the person involved.

defs.def_cn: 中子弹(有杀伤力但不会造成大爆炸、损毁建筑或造成辐射污染)
defs.def_en: A neutron bomb is a nuclear weapon that is designed to kill people and animals without a large explosion and without destroying buildings or causing serious radioactive pollution.

ext.ext_cn: 一个网名叫 nirvanakcf (涅）的人
ext.ext_en: ...someone with the screen name of nirvanakcf.

defs.def_en: Someone's screen name is a name that they use when communicating with other people on the Internet.

defs.def_cn: 重新评价；重新评估；再评定

ext.ext_cn: 英国最严重的监狱暴动会迫使政府对监狱政策进行彻底的重新评估。
ext.ext_en: Britain's worst jail riot will force a fundamental reappraisal of prison policy...

ext.ext_cn: 是时候进行简要分析和重新评估了。
ext.ext_en: It is a time for quiet analysis and reappraisal.

defs.def_en: If there is a reappraisal of something such as an idea or plan, people think about the idea carefully and decide whether they want to change it.
Mama means the same as mother .

ext.ext_cn: 飞机看样子在降落后滑出了跑道。
ext.ext_en: The plane apparently overshot the runway after landing...

ext.ext_cn: 他们刚才已经错过那个街角一次了。
ext.ext_en: They had already overshot the corner once.

defs.def_en: If you overshoot a place that you want to get to, you go past it by mistake.

ext.ext_cn: 政府通常会超出其最初的开支目标。
ext.ext_en: The government usually overshot its original spending target.

ext.ext_cn: 修建医院费用中超支的1亿英镑
ext.ext_en: ...the 100 million pounds overshoot in the cost of building the hospital.

defs.def_en: If a government or organization overshoots its budget, it spends more than it had planned to.

ext.ext_cn: 记得带一个围裙或者一件旧衬衫来，免得弄脏你的衣服。
ext.ext_en: Remember to bring an apron or an old shirt to protect your clothes...

ext.ext_cn: 带一个女伴来参加我的聚会吧。
ext.ext_en: Come to my party and bring a girl with you...

defs.def_en: If you bring someone or something with you when you come to a place, they come with you or you have them with you.

ext.ext_cn: 她伸手从兜里掏出来一支烟。
ext.ext_en: Reaching into her pocket, she brought out a cigarette...

ext.ext_cn: 她母亲拉起她的双手放到自己脸上。
ext.ext_en: Her mother brought her hands up to her face.

defs.def_en: If you bring something somewhere, you move it there.

ext.ext_cn: 他走过去为德娜倒了一杯白兰地，端到她跟前。
ext.ext_en: He went and poured a brandy for Dena and brought it to her...

ext.ext_cn: 女乘务员体贴地给我拿来了毯子。
ext.ext_en: The stewardess kindly brought me a blanket.

defs.def_en: If you bring something that someone wants or needs, you get it for them or carry it to them.

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉过你是什么把我带到这儿的。
ext.ext_en: I told you about what brought me here...

ext.ext_cn: 丈夫的到来惊得她站了起来。
ext.ext_en: The shock of her husband's arrival brought her to her feet...

defs.def_en: To bring something or someone to a place or position means to cause them to come to the place or move into that position.

ext.ext_cn: 一位冒着生命危险向世人报道此事的勇敢记者
ext.ext_en: ...a brave reporter who had risked death to bring the story to the world.

ext.ext_cn: 将艺术介绍给公众的事业
ext.ext_en: ...the drive to bring art to the public.

defs.def_en: If you bring something new to a place or group of people, you introduce it to that place or cause those people to hear or know about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他在广场前把车停了下来。
ext.ext_en: He brought the car to a stop in front of the square...

ext.ext_cn: 他是一位历史学家，工作的缘故使他处在了和政界的当权者对立的位置上。
ext.ext_en: His work as a historian brought him into conflict with the political establishment...

defs.def_en: To bring someone or something into a particular state or condition means to cause them to be in that state or condition.

ext.ext_cn: 他呼吁美国在实现该地区的和平方面发挥更加富有成效的作用。
ext.ext_en: He called on the United States to play a more effective role in bringing peace to the region...

ext.ext_cn: 金克尔声称这次袭击使德国蒙羞。
ext.ext_en: Kinkel said the attacks had brought disgrace on Germany...

defs.def_en: If something brings a particular feeling, situation, or quality, it makes people experience it or have it.

ext.ext_cn: 对桑德罗来说，新的一年带来的是灾难。
ext.ext_en: For Sandro, the new year brought disaster...

ext.ext_cn: 我们不知道将来会发生什么。
ext.ext_en: We don't know what the future will bring.

defs.def_en: If a period of time brings a particular thing, it happens during that time.

defs.def_cn: （对某人）提起（诉讼）；将（某人）送上（法庭）

ext.ext_cn: 为了将前政府成员以贪污腐败的罪名送上法庭，他持续不懈地奔走游说。
ext.ext_en: He campaigned relentlessly to bring charges of corruption against former members of the government...

ext.ext_cn: 这艘船的船长和船员可能会被告上法庭，甚至有可能坐牢。
ext.ext_en: The ship's  captain and crew may be brought to trial and even sent to prison.

defs.def_en: If you bring a legal action against someone or bring them to trial, you officially accuse them of doing something illegal.

defs.def_cn: 提供，制作，播出（电视或广播节目）

ext.ext_cn: 您正在收听的是《科学在行动》，由BBC全球广播频道制作播出。
ext.ext_en: You're listening to Science in Action, brought to you by the BBC World Service...

ext.ext_cn: 我们将为您带来今天各项赛事的所有详情。
ext.ext_en: We'll  be bringing you all the details of the day's  events.

defs.def_en: If a television or radio programme is brought to you by an organization, they make it, broadcast it, or pay for it to be made or broadcast.

defs.def_cn: 把（某人）带到（或引到）（某话题）

ext.ext_cn: 这就把我带到了一个我想提及的敏感问题上。
ext.ext_en: Which brings me to a delicate matter I should like to raise...

ext.ext_cn: 这篇发自德国的特别报道也到此结束。
ext.ext_en: And that brings us to the end of this special report from Germany.

defs.def_en: When you are talking, you can say that something brings you to a particular point in order to indicate that you have now reached that point and are going to talk about a new subject.

defs.def_cn: 强迫（自己）做（令人伤心、窘迫或讨厌的事）

ext.ext_cn: 这是件很不幸的事，恐怕现在我还无法开口谈论此事。
ext.ext_en: It is all very tragic and I am afraid I just cannot bring myself to talk about it at the moment.

defs.def_en: If you cannot bring yourself to do something, you cannot do it because you find it too upsetting, embarrassing, or disgusting.

ext.ext_cn: 他提出了一个在这次运动中很少被提及的话题。
ext.ext_en: He brought up a subject rarely raised during the course of this campaign...

ext.ext_cn: 你为什么现在要把这个问题提出来？
ext.ext_en: Why are you bringing it up now?

defs.def_en: If you bring up a particular subject, you introduce it into a discussion or conversation.

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿不容易打出嗝来。
ext.ext_en: It's hard for the baby to bring up wind.

defs.def_en: If someone brings up food or wind, food or air is forced up from their stomach through their mouth.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 枯燥的;乏味的;令人生厌的

ext.ext_cn: 这种表单读起来冗长乏味。
ext.ext_en: Such lists are long and tedious to read.

ext.ext_cn: 枯燥乏味的逐行编程工作
ext.ext_en: ...the tedious business of line-by-line programming.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a job, task, or situation as tedious, you mean it is boring and rather frustrating.

ext.ext_cn: 每次坐飞机前，我都吓得直发抖。
ext.ext_en: I shook with terror whenever I was about to fly in an aeroplane...

ext.ext_cn: 警察使用了催泪瓦斯攻入屋子以后，恐惧的一天结束了。
ext.ext_en: The day of terror ended after police used teargas and stormed the house.

defs.def_en: Terror is very great fear.

defs.def_cn: (尤指有政治目的的)恐怖活动，恐怖主义

ext.ext_cn: 对首都的炸弹袭击可能标志着选举前的恐怖活动开始了。
ext.ext_en: The bomb attack on the capital could signal the start of a pre-election terror campaign.

defs.def_en: Terror is violence or the threat of violence, especially when it is used for political reasons.

ext.ext_cn: 小时候，他特别害怕见人。
ext.ext_en: As a boy, he had a real terror of facing people.

ext.ext_cn: 恐怖的暴力行为
ext.ext_en: ...the terrors of violence.

defs.def_en: A terror is something that makes you very frightened.

defs.def_cn: 讨厌的小孩;淘气鬼;小捣蛋

ext.ext_cn: 他是个淘气鬼，从小就不老实。
ext.ext_en: He was a terror. He had been a difficult child for as long as his parents could remember.

defs.def_en: If someone describes a child as a terror, they think that he or she is naughty and difficult to control.

defs.def_cn: 完全吓不倒；让人丝毫不焦虑

ext.ext_cn: 她现在不像原来那样害怕分娩了。
ext.ext_en: Childbirth now held fewer terrors for her than it once had.

defs.def_en: If something holds no terrors for you, you are not at all frightened or worried by it.

ext.ext_cn: 我用最后几个月的时间复习了神经学课程。
ext.ext_en: I had spent the last few months boning up on neurology.

defs.def_en: If you bone up on a subject, you try to find out about it or remind yourself of what you have already learned about it.

ext.ext_cn: 火腿三明治
ext.ext_en: ...a ham sandwich.

defs.def_en: A sandwich usually consists of two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

ext.ext_cn: 在两半儿海绵蛋糕中间夹入奶油。
ext.ext_en: Sandwich the two halves of the sponge together with cream...

ext.ext_cn: 在写文章时，不要把坏消息夹在毫不相关、拐弯抹角或过度铺垫的开头和结尾中间。

defs.def_en: If you obliterate something such as a memory, emotion, or thought, you remove it completely from your mind.

A roofless building has no roof, usually because the building has been damaged or has not been used for a long time.

ext.ext_en: He showed courage in adversity.

Fluoride is a mixture of chemicals that is sometimes added to drinking water and toothpaste because it is considered to be good for people's teeth.

defs.def_en: The expiry of something such as a contract, deadline, or visa is the time that it comes to an end or stops being valid.

ext.ext_en: ...Rembrandt's skilful use of light and shade.

defs.def_en: Someone who is skilful at something does it very well.
A sloop is a small sailing boat with one mast.
Scarlet fever is an infectious disease which gives you a painful throat, a high temperature, and red spots on your skin.

ext.ext_en: The doctor is bewitched by Maya's beauty.

defs.def_en: If someone or something bewitches you, you are so attracted to them that you cannot think about anything else.
A twig is a very small thin branch that grows out from a main branch of a tree or bush.

defs.def_cn: 顿悟;突然醒悟;豁然开窍

ext.ext_en: Then I twigged that they were illegal immigrants...

ext.ext_en: He took out his notebook and flipped the pages...

ext.ext_en: It's hot out — very hot, very humid.

defs.def_en: You can use out to indicate that you are talking about the situation outside, rather than inside buildings.

ext.ext_en: I tried to get in touch with you yesterday evening, but I think you were out...

defs.def_en: If you are out, you are not at home or not at your usual place of work.

ext.ext_en: Rosie's husband was now out East.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is out in a particular place, you mean that they are in a different place, usually one far away.

ext.ext_en: The tide was out and they walked among the rock pools.

defs.def_en: When the sea or tide goes out, the sea moves away from the shore.

defs.def_cn: 缺少，不足，损失（某一数量的钱）

ext.ext_en: Me and my friends are out ten thousand dollars, with nothing to show for it!

defs.def_en: If you are out a particular amount of money, you have that amount less than you should or than you did.

ext.ext_en: Several of the lights went out, one after another.

defs.def_en: If a light or fire is out or goes out, it is no longer shining or burning.

ext.ext_en: Well, the daffodils are out in the gardens and they're always a beautiful show.

defs.def_en: If something such as a book or CD is out, it is available for people to buy.

defs.def_en: If you say that a particular thing is out, you mean that it is no longer fashionable at the present time.

defs.def_en: If you take something out of the container or place where it has been, you remove it so that it is no longer there.

ext.ext_en: To get the most out of your money, you have to invest.
