...fifteen sixteenths of an inch.

defs.def_en: A sixteenth is one of sixteen equal parts of something.
A subordinate clause is a clause in a sentence which adds to or completes the information given in the main clause. It cannot usually stand alone as a sentence.
Someone who is a big noise has an important position in a group or organization.

defs.def_cn: 未展现实力；未发挥水平

ext.ext_cn: 有些人可能会认为我的才华在目前的工作中没能充分施展出来。
ext.ext_en: Some people might think I've underachieved in my job.

defs.def_en: If someone underachieves in something such as school work or a job, they do not perform as well as they could.

ext.ext_cn: 有朝一日，我会成为一名飞行员。
ext.ext_en: Some day I'll be a pilot...

ext.ext_cn: 他捧起她的左手，希望这只手的中指有朝一日会戴上一枚金戒指。
ext.ext_en: He took her left hand, hoping that it would someday bear a gold ring on the third finger.

defs.def_en: Some day means at a date in the future that is unknown or that has not yet been decided.

ext.ext_cn: 违反反社会行为令是刑事犯罪。
ext.ext_en: Breach of an ASBO is a criminal offence.

defs.def_en: An ASBO is a legal order restricting the activities or movements of someone who has repeatedly behaved in a way that upsets or annoys other people. ASBO is an abbreviation for（缩略=）'anti-social behaviour order'.

defs.def_cn: 发吧唧声，发扑哧声(像走在烂泥地里似的)

ext.ext_cn: 他扑哧扑哧地走过草皮。
ext.ext_en: He squelched across the turf...

ext.ext_cn: 他湿透的裤子紧贴小腿，鞋子吧唧作响。
ext.ext_en: His sodden trousers were clinging to his shins and his shoes squelched.

defs.def_en: To squelch means to make a wet, sucking sound, like the sound you make when you are walking on wet, muddy ground.

defs.def_cn: 制止，压制，遏制(谣言、反对势力)

ext.ext_cn: 总统想要消除任何视本次会议为谈判尝试的看法。
ext.ext_en: The President wants to squelch any perception that the meeting is an attempt to negotiate.

defs.def_en: If you squelch something that is causing you trouble, for example rumours or opposition, you firmly put a stop to it.

defs.def_cn: （与形容词连用）表示“有…胳膊的”

ext.ext_cn: 胳膊圆润、身穿棉制连衣裙的妇女
ext.ext_en: ...plump-armed women in cotton dresses.

defs.def_en: -armed is used with adjectives to indicate what kind of arms someone has.

defs.def_cn: （和形容词或名词连用，构成形容词）表示“配备…武器的”，“持有…武器的”

ext.ext_cn: 装备核武器的海军舰只
ext.ext_en: ...nuclear-armed navy vessels.

defs.def_en: -armed is used with adjectives such as 'nuclear' and nouns such as 'missile' to form adjectives that indicate what kind of weapons an army or person has.

ext.ext_cn: 原子簇是由中子和质子构成的。
ext.ext_en: Each atomic cluster is made up of neutrons and protons.

defs.def_en: A neutron is an atomic particle that has no electrical charge.

ext.ext_cn: 第四点，实习教师本来的热情应该得到保持。
ext.ext_en: Fourthly, the natural enthusiasm of the student teachers should be maintained.

defs.def_en: You say fourthly when you want to make a fourth point or give a fourth reason for something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 低矮的圆形小山
ext.ext_en: ...a low rounded hill...

ext.ext_cn: 这艘驳船的两端都是圆形的。
ext.ext_en: The barge had a rounded bow and stern.

defs.def_en: Something that is rounded is curved in shape, without any points or sharp edges.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 全面发展的;多方面的;完善的

ext.ext_cn: 他的叙述结构严谨，不乏形象丰满、真实有趣的人物
ext.ext_en: ...his carefully organised narrative, full of rounded, believable and interesting characters.

ext.ext_cn: 全面发展、受过良好教育的聪明过人的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a well-rounded, well-educated and highly intelligent man...

defs.def_en: You describe something or someone as rounded or well-rounded when you are expressing approval of them because they have a personality which is fully developed in all aspects.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不稳定的;难以预测的；不规则的

ext.ext_cn: 阿根廷动荡不定的通货膨胀率可能会破坏那些计划。
ext.ext_en: Argentina's erratic inflation rate threatens to upset the plans.

ext.ext_cn: 那个家庭发生的稀奇古怪的事情
ext.ext_en: ...the family's erratic affairs.

defs.def_en: Something that is erratic does not follow a regular pattern, but happens at unexpected times or moves along in an irregular way.
Coffee beans are small dark brown beans that are roasted and ground to make coffee. They are the seeds of the coffee plant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 惩罚性空袭
ext.ext_en: ...a punitive bombing raid...

ext.ext_cn: 其他经济学家说任何针对外国公司的惩罚性措施都会损害美国的利益。
ext.ext_en: Other economists say any punitive measures against foreign companies would hurt US interests.

defs.def_en: Punitive actions are intended to punish people.
If you say that someone has been put through the wringer or has gone through the wringer, you mean that they have suffered a very difficult or unpleasant experience.

ext.ext_cn: 生物技术行业
ext.ext_en: ...the biotech industry.

defs.def_en: Biotech means the same as biotechnology .

defs.def_cn: （尤指在公共场所的）打架滋事，大吵大闹

ext.ext_cn: 有人向巴恩斯特珀尔刑事法院告发他在德文郡布朗顿的一家酒馆打架滋事。
ext.ext_en: Barnstaple crown court was told he caused an affray at a pub in Braunton, Devon...

ext.ext_cn: 他们因殴斗滋事被判决为社区义务服务。
ext.ext_en: They were convicted of affray and received community service sentences.

defs.def_en: An affray is a noisy and violent fight, especially in a public place.

ext.ext_cn: 朱莉安娜心中充满了重新找回的信心。
ext.ext_en: Juliana was brimming over with new-found confidence...

ext.ext_cn: 作为电影界的一名性格演员，亨明斯最近开始走红。
ext.ext_en: Hemmings is enjoying a newfound popularity as a character actor in the movies.

defs.def_en: A new-found quality or ability is one that you have got recently.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 言语得体的;谈吐文雅的

ext.ext_cn: 我记得她是个安静、勤奋并且谈吐优雅的女孩子。
ext.ext_en: I remember her as a quiet, hard-working and well-spoken girl.

defs.def_en: A well-spoken person speaks in a polite correct way and with an accent which is considered socially acceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 装着食品和衣物的包裹
ext.ext_en: ...parcels of food and clothing...

ext.ext_cn: 他左臂下夹着一个大牛皮纸邮包。
ext.ext_en: He had a large brown paper parcel under his left arm.

defs.def_en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

ext.ext_cn: 这些小块土地大多数是当地人买下的。
ext.ext_en: These small parcels of land were purchased for the most part by local people.

defs.def_en: A parcel of land is a piece of land.

ext.ext_cn: 女人嫁给他,得到的不仅是一个丈夫，还会有一栋破烂的房子和一大堆经济问题。
ext.ext_en: The woman who became his wife would be acquiring not just a husband but a run-down house and a parcel of financial worries.

defs.def_en: A parcel of things or people is a quantity of them.

ext.ext_cn: 赔付是在英国开展保险业务必不可少的一部分。
ext.ext_en: Payment was part and parcel of carrying on insurance business within the UK...

ext.ext_cn: 这只是一部分——才一天的工作，你要知道。
ext.ext_en: It's all part and parcel — just a day's work really you know.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is part and parcel of something else, you are emphasizing that it is involved or included in it.

ext.ext_cn: 我想开电视。
ext.ext_en: I want to turn on the television...

ext.ext_cn: 她问他们为什么不开灯。
ext.ext_en: She asked them why they hadn't turned the lights on.

defs.def_en: When you turn on a piece of equipment or a supply of something, you cause heat, sound, or water to be produced by adjusting the controls.

ext.ext_cn: 并不是非得完美无瑕的身体才能激发男人的性欲。
ext.ext_en: The body that turns men on doesn't have to be perfect.

defs.def_en: See also:turn-on;If someone or something turns you on, they attract you and make you feel sexually excited.

ext.ext_cn: 如果场合需要，他也能瞬间就表现得风度翩翩。
ext.ext_en: He could also turn on the style when the occasion demanded.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone turns on a particular way of behaving, you mean that they suddenly start behaving in that way, and you are often also suggesting that this is insincere.

defs.def_cn: 对…进行身体（或语言)攻击;斥责

ext.ext_cn: 示威者攻击警察，推翻车辆并将其纵火焚烧。
ext.ext_en: Demonstrators turned on police, overturning vehicles and setting fire to them...

ext.ext_cn: 他怒斥皮特，指责他沾染毒品。
ext.ext_en: He turned on Pete and accused him of being mixed up in drugs.

defs.def_en: If someone turns on you, they attack you or speak angrily to you.

ext.ext_cn: 故事情节取决于伊尔莎会选择情人还是丈夫。
ext.ext_en: The plot turns on whether Ilsa will choose her lover or her husband.

defs.def_en: If something turns on a particular thing, its success or truth depends on that thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻声的;安静的；静悄悄的

ext.ext_cn: 塔妮娅把孩子们哄得安安静静而又心满意足。
ext.ext_en: Tania kept the children reasonably quiet and contented...

ext.ext_cn: 一阵悄悄的低语声传遍了整个教室。
ext.ext_en: A quiet murmur passed through the classroom...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is quiet makes only a small amount of noise.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她在一个安静的小办公室里受到接待。
ext.ext_en: She was received in a small, quiet office...

ext.ext_cn: 街上安静得有些异常。
ext.ext_en: The street was unnaturally quiet.

defs.def_en: If a place is quiet, there is very little noise there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (地方、环境、时光)安宁的，清静的，平静的，宁静的

ext.ext_cn: 平静而与世隔绝的农村地区
ext.ext_en: ...a quiet rural backwater...

ext.ext_cn: 他不在的时候这里非常清静。
ext.ext_en: It is very quiet without him...

defs.def_en: If a place, situation, or time is quiet, there is no excitement, activity, or trouble.

ext.ext_cn: 他叫大家安静，然后宣布下一首歌要送给我们。
ext.ext_en: He called for quiet and announced that the next song was in our honor...

ext.ext_cn: 杰里米希望在大赛来临之前能享受到些许平静和安宁。
ext.ext_en: Jeremy wants some peace and quiet before his big match.

defs.def_en: Quiet is silence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沉默的；不出声的;一言不发的

ext.ext_cn: 我叫他们不要说话，马上睡觉。
ext.ext_en: I told them to be quiet and go to sleep...

ext.ext_cn: 我一下子收了声，红了脸，答不出话来。
ext.ext_en: I just went quiet, embarrassed, and couldn't answer...

defs.def_en: If you are quiet, you are not saying anything.

defs.def_cn: (感情)不外露的，不张扬的，内敛的，含蓄的

ext.ext_cn: 他对自己胸有成竹，但却并不张扬。
ext.ext_en: He has a quiet confidence in his ability...

ext.ext_cn: 他一生都在默默而坚定地做事。
ext.ext_en: All through his life he has shown a quiet determination to get things done.

defs.def_en: If you refer, for example, to someone's quiet confidence or quiet despair, you mean that they do not say much about the way they are feeling.

ext.ext_cn: 瑞典人通过秘密的外交手段来争取他的自由。
ext.ext_en: The Swedes had sought his freedom through quiet diplomacy...

ext.ext_cn: 然后就回到房子里悄悄地庆祝一番。
ext.ext_en: Then it was back to the house for a quiet celebration...

defs.def_en: You describe activities as quiet when they happen in secret or in such a way that people do not notice them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 温和的;文静的;不易激动(或动怒)的

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个温和友善的人。
ext.ext_en: He's a nice quiet man.

defs.def_en: A quiet person behaves in a calm way and is not easily made angry or upset.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (颜色、服饰)素净的，朴素大方的

ext.ext_cn: 为了避免别人注目，他们穿得很朴素。
ext.ext_en: They dress in quiet colors so as not to call attention to themselves.

defs.def_en: You describe colours or clothes as quiet when they are not bright or not very noticeable.

ext.ext_cn: 风势减弱了，海面平静下来。
ext.ext_en: The wind dropped and the sea quieted...

ext.ext_cn: 埃丝特拉正要说些什么，但是看到丈夫的一个手势，马上就不说话了。
ext.ext_en: Estela started to say something but a gesture from her husband quieted her at once.

defs.def_en: If someone or something quiets or if you quiet them, they become less noisy, less active, or silent.

defs.def_cn: 消除，减轻(恐惧);平息(抱怨)

ext.ext_cn: 音乐似乎能够减轻她的焦虑和孤独。
ext.ext_en: Music seemed to quiet her anxiety and loneliness.

defs.def_en: To quiet fears or complaints means to persuade people that there is no good reason for them.

ext.ext_cn: 她不会乖乖离开的。
ext.ext_en: She's not going to go quietly.

defs.def_en: If someone does not go quietly, they do not leave a particular job or a place without complaining or resisting.

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉她此事要保密。
ext.ext_en: I told her to keep quiet about it...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得，我比内尔更容易守得住我们订婚的秘密。
ext.ext_en: I think I found it easier than Nell to keep our engagement quiet.

defs.def_en: If you keep quiet about something or keep something quiet, you do not say anything about it.

ext.ext_cn: 她已经保证要在别人看不见的时候私下教他开车。
ext.ext_en: She'd promised to give him driving lessons, on the quiet, when no one could see.

defs.def_en: If something is done on the quiet, it is done secretly or in such a way that people do not notice it.

defs.def_cn: 装饰派艺术（20世纪20至30年代流行的装饰和建筑风格）

ext.ext_cn: 具有装饰派艺术风格的灯具
ext.ext_en: ...art deco lamps.

defs.def_en: Art Deco is a style of decoration and architecture that was common in the 1920s and 30s. It uses simple, bold designs on materials such as plastic and glass.

ext.ext_cn: 如果卖给开发商会有很高商业价值的公共用地
ext.ext_en: ...common land which would have a high commercial value if sold to developers.

ext.ext_cn: 一个白手起家、营私舞弊的房地产开发商
ext.ext_en: ...a corrupt, self-made property developer.

defs.def_en: A developer is a person or a company that buys land and builds houses, offices, shops, or factories on it, or buys existing buildings and makes them more modern.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·巴丁也是超导电性理论的创立者之一。
ext.ext_en: John Bardeen was also co-developer of the theory of superconductivity.

ext.ext_cn: 软件开发者
ext.ext_en: ...a software developer.

defs.def_en: A developer is someone who develops something such as an idea, a design, or a product.
Developer is a chemical used for developing photographs or films.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (系统、想法和信仰)兼容的，可以并存的

ext.ext_cn: 他认为自由企业制并不违背俄罗斯的价值观和传统。
ext.ext_en: Free enterprise, he argued, was compatible with Russian values and traditions...

ext.ext_cn: 婚姻和我的生活好像就是没法兼容。
ext.ext_en: Marriage and the life I live just don't seem compatible.

defs.def_en: If things, for example systems, ideas, and beliefs, are compatible, they work well together or can exist together successfully.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 能和谐相处的;合得来的

ext.ext_cn: 我和米尔德丽德很合得来，我感兴趣的东西她也感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: Mildred and I are very compatible. She's interested in the things that interest me...

ext.ext_cn: 在大城市，几乎肯定能找到一个和你意气相投、让你觉得舒心的心灵抚慰者。
ext.ext_en: In a large city you're almost certain to find a physician with whom you are compatible and feel comfortable.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are compatible with someone, you mean that you have a good relationship with them because you have similar opinions and interests.

defs.def_cn: (尤指与 IBM公司制造的计算机或计算机设备)兼容的
defs.def_en: If one make of computer or computer equipment is compatible with another make, especially IBM, they can be used together and can use the same software.

ext.ext_cn: 他大腿后侧感到刺痛。
ext.ext_en: The backs of his thighs tingled.

ext.ext_cn: 先甜后苦，在舌头上留下一丝刺痛感觉的味道
ext.ext_en: …a taste which is first sweet, then bitter, leaving a tingling sensation on the tongue.

defs.def_en: When a part of your body tingles, you have a slight stinging feeling there.

ext.ext_cn: 她激动不已。
ext.ext_en: She tingled with excitement...

ext.ext_cn: 当我放眼望去见到特里时，我整个人兴奋不已。
ext.ext_en: When I look over and see Terry I tingle all over.

defs.def_en: If you tingle with a feeling such as excitement, you feel it very strongly.
A house plant is a plant which is grown in a pot indoors.

defs.def_cn: 抗议性投票（对一贯支持的政党投出的反对票）
defs.def_en: In an election, a protest vote is a vote against the party you usually support in order to show disapproval of something they are doing or planning to do.

defs.def_cn: 调查者;(尤指)从事调查的人，侦察员
defs.def_en: An investigator is someone who carries out investigations, especially as part of their job.
A searchlight is a large powerful light that can be turned to shine a long way in any direction.

ext.ext_cn: 对虾三明治
ext.ext_en: ...a prawn sandwich.

defs.def_en: A prawn is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten.
In an airport, the departure lounge is the place where passengers wait before they get onto their plane.

defs.def_cn: 消防署;(尤指实际灭火的)消防队

ext.ext_cn: 把所有人疏散出去，打电话叫消防队。
ext.ext_en: Get everyone out and call the fire brigade...

ext.ext_cn: 7支消防队被派来控制火势。
ext.ext_en: Seven fire brigades were deployed to contain the blaze.

defs.def_en: The fire brigade is an organization which has the job of putting out fires; used especially to refer to the people who actually fight the fires.

ext.ext_cn: 其中的一些言论激怒了很多人。
ext.ext_en: Many people have been outraged by some of the things that have been said...

ext.ext_cn: 关于塞尔维亚拘留营里动用酷刑并大肆处决的报道令全世界的宗教领袖义愤填膺。
ext.ext_en: Reports of torture and mass executions in Serbia's detention camps have outraged the world's religious leaders.

defs.def_en: If you are outraged by something, it makes you extremely shocked and angry.

ext.ext_cn: 这一决定激起了妇女和人权组织的强烈愤慨。
ext.ext_en: The decision provoked outrage from women and human rights groups...

ext.ext_cn: 该协定并未真正激起公愤。
ext.ext_en: The Treaty has failed to arouse genuine public outrage.

defs.def_en: Outrage is an intense feeling of anger and shock.

ext.ext_cn: 最近的一起暴行是同时动用了枪支和炸弹的对车站的袭击。
ext.ext_en: The latest outrage was to have been a co-ordinated gun and bomb attack on the station...

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆，这简直太过分了！
ext.ext_en: Tom, this is an outrage!

defs.def_en: You can refer to an act or event which you find very shocking as an outrage .

defs.def_cn: (疾病)无法治愈的，不可医治的

ext.ext_cn: 他患有无法根治的皮肤病。
ext.ext_en: He is suffering from an incurable skin disease.

defs.def_en: If someone has an incurable disease, they cannot be cured of it.

defs.def_cn: 无法改变的;无可救药的

ext.ext_cn: 可怜的老威廉是个无可救药的浪漫主义者。
ext.ext_en: Poor old William is an incurable romantic...

ext.ext_cn: 你要么非常年轻,要么是个不可救药的乐天派。
ext.ext_en: You are either very young or an incurable optimist.

defs.def_en: You can use incurable to indicate that someone has a particular quality or attitude and will not change.

defs.def_cn: 管理者;管理机构;调控者;调控机构

ext.ext_cn: 人们要求国会调查政府监管机构为何花了这么长时间才关闭该工厂。
ext.ext_en: Congress is being asked to investigate why it took so long for government regulators to shut the plant down...

ext.ext_cn: 将会指定一个独立的管理机构来保证公平竞争。
ext.ext_en: An independent regulator will be appointed to ensure fair competition.

defs.def_en: A regulator is a person or organization appointed by a government to regulate an area of activity such as banking or industry.

ext.ext_cn: 一个自动电压调节器保证了发电机电流输出的稳定。
ext.ext_en: An automatic voltage regulator ensured a constant output from the generator.

defs.def_en: A regulator is a device or mechanism that automatically controls something, such as the temperature in a room or the growth of a person's body.

ext.ext_cn: 他们会同意你旁听几节课吗？
ext.ext_en: Will they permit you to sit in on a few classes?...

ext.ext_cn: 即使不在其研究专题范围之内，人们也可以列席会议。
ext.ext_en: People can sit in on meetings, even if it's not really in their subject area.

defs.def_en: If you sit in on a lesson, meeting, or discussion, you are present while it is taking place but do not take part in it.

defs.def_cn: 真实的世界；现实世界；现实生活

ext.ext_cn: 当他们最终离开学校的时候，他们没掌握什么实际技能，难以应对现实世界。
ext.ext_en: When they eventually leave the school they will be totally ill-equipped to deal with the real world...

ext.ext_cn: 我是奥运冠军，但是我不得不走进现实生活工作谋生。
ext.ext_en: I was Olympic champion but I had to go out into the real world and work for a living.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the real world, you are referring to the world and life in general, in contrast to a particular person's own life, experience, and ideas, which may seem untypical and unrealistic.

ext.ext_cn: 他们责备我不应拿自己的健康冒险。
ext.ext_en: They admonished me for taking risks with my health...

ext.ext_cn: 她温柔地责备他：“你要多休息，少说话。”
ext.ext_en: She admonished him gently, 'You should rest, not talk so much.'

defs.def_en: If you admonish someone, you tell them very seriously that they have done something wrong.
A dump truck is a truck whose carrying part can be tipped backwards so that the load falls out.

defs.def_cn: 鉴定…为合格;确认…达到标准

ext.ext_cn: 这门学位课程经电气工程师学院鉴定完全合格。
ext.ext_en: This degree programme is fully accredited by the Institution of Electrical Engineers.

ext.ext_cn: 布鲁内尔大学的一所正式学院
ext.ext_en: ...an accredited college of Brunel University.

defs.def_en: If an educational qualification or institution is accredited, it is officially declared to be of an approved standard.

ext.ext_cn: 总统提议俄罗斯外交官可被派驻北约总部。
ext.ext_en: The President proposed that Russian diplomats could be accredited to NATO headquarters...

ext.ext_cn: 一些参加的组织抗议他们所选出的代表未获委任。
ext.ext_en: Some of the organisations taking part protested that the delegates they had chosen were not being accredited.

defs.def_en: If someone such as a diplomat or journalist is accredited to a particular job or place, they are officially recognized as having that job, or the right to be in that place.

ext.ext_cn: 我抓到了她的手。
ext.ext_en: I managed to grab her hand...

ext.ext_cn: 我掐住他的脖子。
ext.ext_en: I grabbed him by the neck.

defs.def_en: If you grab something, you take it or pick it up suddenly and roughly.

ext.ext_cn: 他笨手笨脚地想抓住艾尔弗雷德的手臂。
ext.ext_en: He was clumsily trying to grab at Alfred's arms.

ext.ext_cn: 我试图抓住那把刀。
ext.ext_en: I made a grab for the knife...

defs.def_en: If you grab at something, you try to grab it.

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽·安，叫那位侍者过来。
ext.ext_en: Grab that waiter, Mary Ann.

defs.def_en: If you grab someone who is walking past, you succeed in getting their attention.

ext.ext_cn: 为了吸引那群人的注意，我纵身跃上墙头。
ext.ext_en: I jumped on the wall to grab the attention of the crowd.

defs.def_en: If you grab someone's attention, you do something in order to make them notice you.

ext.ext_cn: 拿瓶啤酒来。
ext.ext_en: Grab a beer.

defs.def_en: If you grab something such as food, drink, or sleep, you manage to get some quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 她抓住了一次求职面试的机会。
ext.ext_en: She grabbed the chance of a job interview...

ext.ext_cn: 他抓住机会买下了他的城堡。
ext.ext_en: He grabbed at the opportunity to buy his castle.

defs.def_en: If you grab something such as a chance or opportunity, or grab at it, you take advantage of it eagerly.

ext.ext_cn: 对个人权力的巧取豪夺
ext.ext_en: ...a grab for personal power.

defs.def_en: A grab for something such as power or fame is an attempt to gain it.

ext.ext_cn: 著名的里兹饭店开价1亿英镑供各方竞购。
ext.ext_en: The famous Ritz hotel is up for grabs for £100m.

defs.def_en: If something is up for grabs, it is available to anyone who is interested.

defs.def_cn: 意气相投的人;心心相印的朋友

ext.ext_cn: 我和史蒂夫成了知己，几乎时刻相伴。
ext.ext_en: Steve and I became soul mates, near-constant companions.

defs.def_en: A soul mate is someone with whom you share a close friendship and deep personal understanding.
Science fiction consists of stories in books, magazines, and films about events that take place in the future or in other parts of the universe.

ext.ext_cn: 免责声明书明确声明公司将不对任何差错负责。
ext.ext_en: The disclaimer asserts that the company won't be held responsible for any inaccuracies.

defs.def_en: A disclaimer is a statement in which a person says that they did not know about something or that they are not responsible for something.

defs.def_cn: 行为主义（某些心理学家认为研究人或动物心理的唯一有效方法就是观察其行为表现）
defs.def_en: Behaviourism is the belief held by some psychologists that the only valid method of studying the psychology of people or animals is to observe how they behave.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你得快点了，飞机大约3小时后起飞。
ext.ext_en: You'll have to be quick. The flight leaves in about three hours...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为我是一个学东西还算快的人。
ext.ext_en: I think I'm a reasonably quick learner...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is quick moves or does things with great speed.

defs.def_cn: (quicker 有时表示“以更快的速度”，quickest表示“以最快的速度”，quick有时表示“以很快的速度”，但有些人认为这种用法并不规范)

ext.ext_cn: 先将糖稍稍加热，以使其溶解得更快些。
ext.ext_en: Warm the sugar slightly first to make it dissolve quicker...

ext.ext_cn: 普罗斯特走得最快。
ext.ext_en: Prost went quickest.

defs.def_en: Quicker is sometimes used to mean 'at a greater speed', and quickest to mean 'at the greatest speed'. Quick is sometimes used to mean 'with great speed'. Some people consider this to be non-standard.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 短暂的;持续时间很短的

ext.ext_cn: 他朝房间匆匆扫了最后一眼。
ext.ext_en: He took one last quick look about the room...

ext.ext_cn: 我只是顺路过来小酌一杯。
ext.ext_en: I just popped in for a quick drink...

defs.def_en: Something that is quick takes or lasts only a short time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 立刻发生的;很快发生的

ext.ext_cn: 官员们让迅速结束这场流血冲突的希望变得渺茫起来。
ext.ext_en: Officials played down any hope for a quick end to the bloodshed...

ext.ext_cn: 这些投资者觉得收益必须立竿见影。
ext.ext_en: These investors feel the need to make quick profits.

defs.def_en: Quick means happening without delay or with very little delay.

defs.def_cn: 迅速发生地;很快发生地

ext.ext_cn: 我尽快离开了。
ext.ext_en: I got away as quick as I could...

ext.ext_cn: 快来！约翰！卡梅拉出事了，我想她用药过量了。
ext.ext_en: Quick! John! It's Carmela. I think she's taken an overdose...

defs.def_en: Quick is sometimes used to mean 'with very little delay'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 马克说这些都是凯蒂自己的想法，并随即称赞起她的天赋来。
ext.ext_en: Mark says the ideas are Katie's own, and is quick to praise her talent...

ext.ext_cn: 而且，正如热尔韦斯毫不犹豫地指出来的那样，斯库利先生并不是一名侦探。
ext.ext_en: Furthermore, as Gervaise was quick to point out, Mr Scully was not a detective.

defs.def_en: If you are quick to do something, you do not hesitate to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 性情急躁的;容易发怒的
defs.def_en: If someone has a quick temper, they are easily made angry.

defs.def_cn: 咬到了指甲肉；咬秃指甲

ext.ext_cn: 她的手指甲都被咬秃了。
ext.ext_en: Her fingernails are bitten to the quick.

defs.def_en: If someone bites their nails to the quick, they bite off all the white part at the end of each nail.

defs.def_cn: 触及（…）痛处;极大伤害；令…伤透了心

ext.ext_cn: 有一次，我听见她在卧室里哭泣，这深深地刺痛了我的心。
ext.ext_en: I once heard her weeping in her bedroom, which cut me to the quick.

defs.def_en: If something cuts you to the quick, it makes you feel very upset.

ext.ext_cn: 她想尖叫，但她的声带好像不听使唤了。
ext.ext_en: She wanted to scream, but her vocal cords seemed paralysed.

defs.def_en: Your vocal cords are the part of your throat that vibrates when you speak.

ext.ext_cn: 行业需要的技术与人们可以提供的技能并不匹配。
ext.ext_en: There is a mismatch between the skills offered by people and the skills needed by industry.

ext.ext_cn: 令人遗憾的风格搭配的不协调
ext.ext_en: ...an unfortunate mismatch of styles.

defs.def_en: If there is a mismatch between two or more things or people, they do not go together well or are not suitable for each other.

ext.ext_cn: 她故意把衣服混搭。
ext.ext_en: She was deliberately mismatching articles of clothing.

defs.def_en: To mismatch things or people means to put them together although they do not go together well or are not suitable for each other.

ext.ext_cn: 市政委员会表示关切是合情合理呢，还是反应过激？
ext.ext_en: Is the council right to be concerned, or is it overreacting?...

ext.ext_cn: 市场反应看似过激，但实际并非如此。
ext.ext_en: The market appeared to overreact, but this is not the case...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone overreacts to something, you mean that they have and show more of an emotion than is necessary or appropriate.
An outbound flight is one that is leaving or about to leave a particular place.

ext.ext_cn: 她已婚的妹妹在一起交通事故中瘫痪了。
ext.ext_en: Her married sister had been paralysed in a road accident.

ext.ext_cn: 使他双腿瘫痪的病毒
ext.ext_en: ...a virus which paralysed his legs.

defs.def_en: If someone is paralysed by an accident or an illness, they have no feeling in their body, or in part of their body, and are unable to move.

defs.def_cn: 使失去活动能力；使无法正常运转；使瘫痪

ext.ext_cn: 到现在，政府因为无力决断已经陷入瘫痪达数周。
ext.ext_en: For weeks now the government has been paralysed by indecision...

ext.ext_cn: 他突然被吓得动弹不得。
ext.ext_en: He was suddenly paralysed by fear...

defs.def_en: If a person, place, or organization is paralysed by something, they become unable to act or function properly.

ext.ext_cn: 为你的教堂组织一次募捐活动。
ext.ext_en: Organize a fundraiser for your church.

defs.def_en: A fundraiser is an event which is intended to raise money for a particular purpose, for example, for a charity.

ext.ext_cn: 安东尼爵士是自由民主党热心的资金筹集者。
ext.ext_en: Sir Anthony was a keen fundraiser for the Liberal Democrats.

defs.def_en: A fundraiser is someone who works to raise money for a particular purpose, for example, for a charity.
Wedlock is the state of being married.
If a baby is born in wedlock, it is born while its parents are married. If it is born out of wedlock, it is born at a time when its parents are not married.

ext.ext_cn: 具有环绕立体声效果的扩音器
ext.ext_en: ...loudspeakers that give all-around stereo sound.

defs.def_en: Stereo is used to describe a sound system in which the sound is played through two speakers.

defs.def_cn: 立体声磁带播放机;立体声激光唱片播放机;立体音响
defs.def_en: A stereo is a cassette or CD player with two speakers.

defs.def_cn: (救生艇或其他小船的)艇长，舵手
defs.def_en: The coxswain of a lifeboat or other small boat is the person who steers the boat.

ext.ext_cn: 我们听说了人们被赶出去流落街头的故事。
ext.ext_en: We hear stories of people being turfed out and ending up on the streets...

ext.ext_cn: 该党在 15 年后被赶下了台。
ext.ext_en: The party was turfed out of office after 15 years.

defs.def_en: If someone is turfed out of a place or position, they are forced to leave.

defs.def_cn: 违反，破坏（条约、法律或承诺）

ext.ext_cn: 该报违反了保护隐私的行为准则。
ext.ext_en: The newspaper breached the code of conduct on privacy...

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影触犯了刑事诽谤法。
ext.ext_en: The film breached the criminal libel laws.

defs.def_en: If you breach an agreement, a law, or a promise, you break it.

defs.def_cn: （对条约、法律或承诺的）违反，破坏

ext.ext_cn: 这位议员被控违反了保密规定。
ext.ext_en: The congressman was accused of a breach of secrecy rules.

ext.ext_cn: 一起违约金达10亿美元的合同违约诉讼案
ext.ext_en: ...a $1 billion breach of contract suit.

defs.def_en: A breach of an agreement, a law, or a promise is an act of breaking it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的行动使两国关系面临严重恶化的危险。
ext.ext_en: Their actions threatened a serious breach in relations between the two countries.

ext.ext_cn: 铁托和斯大林之间的不和
ext.ext_en: ...the breach between Tito and Stalin.

defs.def_en: A breach in a relationship is a serious disagreement which often results in the relationship ending.

ext.ext_cn: 石灰岩上有许多缝隙，故而树根能从岩洞顶部长出来。
ext.ext_en: The limestone is sufficiently fissured for tree roots to have breached the roof of the cave...

ext.ext_cn: 大火当时有可能把货船上的油罐烧漏了，从而引燃原油。
ext.ext_en: Fire may have breached the cargo tanks and set the oil ablaze.

defs.def_en: If someone or something breaches a barrier, they make an opening in it, usually leaving it weakened or destroyed.

ext.ext_cn: 这名爆炸手从一个俯瞰这座大楼的楼顶上投下炸药，破坏了安保系统。
ext.ext_en: The bomber had breached security by hurling his dynamite from a roof overlooking the building.

ext.ext_cn: 国防部各基地普遍存在的安全系统遭到攻破的现象
ext.ext_en: ...widespread breaches of security at Ministry of Defence bases.

defs.def_en: If you breach someone's security or  their defences, you manage to get through and attack an area that is heavily guarded and protected.

ext.ext_cn: 在他们病得很重无法坚持的情况下，我被劝服去临时顶替他们。
ext.ext_en: I was persuaded to step into the breach temporarily when they became too ill to continue.

defs.def_en: If you step into the breach, you do a job or task which someone else was supposed to do or has done in the past, because they are suddenly unable to do it.

defs.def_cn: (抖动着肩膀和臀部)跳希米舞;一扭一摆地走

ext.ext_cn: 舞者们在新奥尔良的大街上跳着希米舞。
ext.ext_en: Dancers shimmied in the streets of New Orleans...

ext.ext_cn: 蒂娜·特纳穿着极其性感的裙子一边跳着希米舞一边穿过舞台。
ext.ext_en: Tina Turner shimmied across the stage in an incredibly sexy dress.

defs.def_en: If you shimmy, you dance or move in a way that involves shaking your hips and shoulders from side to side.

ext.ext_cn: 这伙歹徒如此胆大妄为、厚颜无耻，让我很是震惊。
ext.ext_en: I was shocked at the audacity and brazenness of the gangsters.

defs.def_en: Audacity is audacious behaviour.

defs.def_cn: 对…施催眠术;使进入催眠状态

ext.ext_cn: 一位催眠治疗师将对你实施催眠，从而帮你戒烟。
ext.ext_en: A hypnotherapist will hypnotize you and will stop you from smoking...

ext.ext_cn: 出人意料的是，自我催眠术只要上一次课就可以学会。
ext.ext_en: Surprisingly, the ability to hypnotize yourself can be learnt in a single session.

defs.def_en: If someone hypnotizes you, they put you into a state in which you seem to be asleep but can still see, hear, or respond to things said to you.

ext.ext_cn: 他为那乌黑的头发和白皙的面庞所倾倒。
ext.ext_en: He's hypnotized by that black hair and that white face...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维坐在那里，好像被尼克的声音迷住了似的。
ext.ext_en: Davey sat as if hypnotized by the sound of Nick's voice.

defs.def_en: If you are hypnotized by someone or something, you are so fascinated by them that you cannot think of anything else.

defs.def_cn: 间接提到；暗指；影射；典故

ext.ext_cn: 该题目可能暗指艾滋病。
ext.ext_en: The title is perhaps an allusion to AIDS.

defs.def_en: An allusion is an indirect reference to someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 超大屏电视机
ext.ext_en: ...a giant-sized TV.

defs.def_en: An object that is giant-sized is much bigger than objects of its kind usually are.

ext.ext_cn: 女孩的父母试图扑灭大火的时候也被烧伤了。
ext.ext_en: The girl's parents were also burned as they tried to smother the flames.

defs.def_en: If you smother a fire, you cover it with something in order to put it out.

defs.def_cn: 使…透不过气来;使…窒息;闷死

ext.ext_cn: 一位父亲在医院里企图捂死自己 6 周大的儿子的情景被秘密地拍了下来。
ext.ext_en: A father was secretly filmed as he tried to smother his six-week-old son in hospital.

defs.def_en: To smother someone means to kill them by covering their face with something so that they cannot breathe.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦灌木丛开始遮住这些小苗，我们就得把它们移走。
ext.ext_en: Once the shrubs begin to smother the little plants, we have to move them.

defs.def_en: Things that smother something cover it completely.

ext.ext_cn: 她十分疼爱自己的孩子，几乎到了溺爱的程度。
ext.ext_en: She loved her own children, almost smothering them with love.

ext.ext_cn: 对孩子过分溺爱、过度保护的母亲
ext.ext_en: ...a smothering, overprotective mother.

defs.def_en: If you smother someone, you show your love for them too much and protect them too much.

ext.ext_cn: 她抑制着心中的自怜，将满腔的怜悯之情都倾注在了他的身上。
ext.ext_en: She summoned up all her pity for him, to smother her self-pity.

ext.ext_cn: 忍住的咯咯笑
ext.ext_en: ...smothered giggles.

defs.def_en: If you smother an emotion or a reaction, you control it so that people do not notice it.

defs.def_cn: 压制，钳制，扼杀，镇压 (某种活动或过程)

ext.ext_cn: 在被占领期间法国思想界受到了压制。
ext.ext_en: Intellectual life in France was smothered by the occupation...

ext.ext_cn: 波兰和匈牙利的债务正开始扼杀改革的进程。
ext.ext_en: The debts of both Poland and Hungary are beginning to smother the reform process.

defs.def_en: If an activity or process is smothered, it is prevented from continuing or developing.

ext.ext_cn: 皇家利物浦爱乐乐团
ext.ext_en: ...the Royal Liverpool Philharmonic Orchestra.

defs.def_en: See also:chamber orchestra;symphony orchestra;An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

defs.def_cn: （剧院或音乐厅的）正厅前排座位
defs.def_en: The orchestra or the orchestra seats in a theatre or concert hall are the seats on the ground floor directly in front of the stage.

defs.def_cn: 最低贷款利率；最优惠贷款利率

ext.ext_cn: 今天，至少有一家银行降低了其最低贷款利率。
ext.ext_en: At least one bank cut its prime rate today.

defs.def_en: A bank's prime rate is the lowest rate of interest which it charges at a particular time and which is offered only to certain customers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那些磁带质量较差。
ext.ext_en: The cassettes were of inferior quality...

ext.ext_cn: 这就导致了标价过高而往往质量低劣的产品的出现。
ext.ext_en: This resulted in overpriced and often inferior products...

defs.def_en: Something that is inferior is not as good as something else.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (地位、能力等)低等的,低于…的;下级的

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢与那些智力水平不如他的人共处。
ext.ext_en: He preferred the company of those who were intellectually inferior to himself.

ext.ext_cn: 革命之前俄国妇女的低微地位
ext.ext_en: ...the inferior status of women in pre-revolutionary Russia...

defs.def_en: If one person is regarded as inferior to another, they are regarded as less important because they have less status or ability.

ext.ext_cn: 要我赶紧出去一趟买些食品吗？
ext.ext_en: Should I nip out and get some groceries?...

ext.ext_cn: 韦恩总是一溜烟跑到街角商店找他。
ext.ext_en: Wayne is always nipping down to the corner shop for him...

defs.def_en: If you nip somewhere, usually somewhere nearby, you go there quickly or for a short time.

ext.ext_cn: 我知道有一些狗咬婴儿的事情。
ext.ext_en: I have known cases where dogs have nipped babies...

ext.ext_cn: 他用两个粗糙的手指捏了捏比利的脸蛋。
ext.ext_en: He nipped Billy's cheek with two rough fingers.

defs.def_en: If an animal or person nips you, they bite you lightly or squeeze a piece of your skin between their finger and thumb.

ext.ext_cn: 她有偶尔喝一小口干邑的习惯。
ext.ext_en: She had a habit of taking an occasional nip from a flask of cognac.

defs.def_en: A nip is a small amount of a strong alcoholic drink.
A tussock is a small piece of grass which is much longer and thicker than the grass around it.

ext.ext_cn: 警方围捕了一些嫌疑犯。
ext.ext_en: The police rounded up a number of suspects...

ext.ext_cn: 她说巡警在村里的学校把她们赶到一起，并用枪托殴打她们。
ext.ext_en: She says the patrolmen rounded them up at the village school and beat them with rifle butts.

defs.def_en: If the police or army round up a number of people, they arrest or capture them.

ext.ext_cn: 他找了一份放牛的差事，负责把牛赶到一起。
ext.ext_en: He had sought work as a cowboy, rounding up cattle...

ext.ext_cn: 我们已经精心挑选了一些产品。
ext.ext_en: We've rounded up a selection of products.

defs.def_en: If you round up animals or things, you gather them together.

ext.ext_cn: 导致丧失工作能力的永久性完全伤残
ext.ext_en: ...permanent total disablement resulting in inability to work.

defs.def_en: Disablement is the state of being disabled or the experience of becoming disabled.

ext.ext_cn: 日本的民主制度无疑与我们的不同。
ext.ext_en: Japanese democracy is certainly different from ours...

ext.ext_cn: 像我们这样的镇子很少有外地人。
ext.ext_en: There are few strangers in a town like ours...

defs.def_en: You use ours to refer to something that belongs or relates both to yourself and to one or more other people.

ext.ext_cn: 我以为那会是个美差，结果我成了一个打杂的。
ext.ext_en: I thought it would be glamorous but I just turned out to be a general dogsbody.

defs.def_en: A dogsbody is a person who has to do all the boring jobs that nobody else wants to do.

defs.def_cn: (不好的事情)产生，开始，到来，恶化

ext.ext_cn: 当他们发现魔力已失的时候，失望的情绪开始蔓延。
ext.ext_en: Then disappointment sets in as they see the magic is no longer there...

ext.ext_cn: 冬天即将到来，人们将面临食物和燃料的短缺。
ext.ext_en: Winter is setting in and the population is facing food and fuel shortages.

defs.def_en: If something unpleasant sets in, it begins and seems likely to continue or develop.

defs.def_cn: 咬舌（指将s和z读作th，如把sing念作thing等）

ext.ext_cn: 他说话有点咬舌。
ext.ext_en: He has a slight lisp.

defs.def_en: If someone has a lisp, they pronounce the sounds 's' and 'z' as if they were 'th'. For example, they say 'thing' instead of 'sing'.

defs.def_cn: 咬着舌说；口齿不清地说

ext.ext_cn: 那个矮个子因为非常生气，所以说话咬舌咬得很厉害。
ext.ext_en: The little man, upset, was lisping badly...

ext.ext_cn: 博克曼口齿不清地表示祝贺。
ext.ext_en: Bochmann lisped his congratulations.

defs.def_en: If someone lisps, they say something with a lisp or speak with a lisp.

ext.ext_cn: 他最喜欢的消遣是打高尔夫。
ext.ext_en: His favourite pastime is golf.

defs.def_en: A pastime is something that you do in your spare time because you enjoy it or are interested in it.
An islet is a small island.
Asparagus is a vegetable that is long and green and has small shoots at one end. It is cooked and served whole.

defs.def_cn: 自相矛盾；有矛盾特点的情况

ext.ext_cn: 矛盾之处在于这个地区最有活力的经济体却有着最落后的金融体系。
ext.ext_en: The paradox is that the region's most dynamic economies have the most primitive financial systems...

ext.ext_cn: 锻炼奇怪的地方在于它会越活动越有劲。
ext.ext_en: The paradox of exercise is that while using a lot of energy it seems to generate more...

defs.def_en: You describe a situation as a paradox when it involves two or more facts or qualities which seem to contradict each other.

defs.def_cn: 悖论；自相矛盾的说法；似矛盾而（可能）正确的说法

ext.ext_cn: 这个故事存在多重悖论。
ext.ext_en: The story contains many levels of paradox...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然我非常成功，可事实上我却是个相当失败的人。这句话自相矛盾，是吧？
ext.ext_en: Although I'm so successful I'm really rather a failure. That's a paradox, isn't it?

defs.def_en: A paradox is a statement in which it seems that if one part of it is true, the other part of it cannot be true.
Astrology is the study of the movements of the planets, sun, moon, and stars in the belief that these movements can have an influence on people's lives.

defs.def_cn: 睡前饮料;(通常指)睡前酒

ext.ext_cn: 也许你愿意睡前和我一起喝一杯？
ext.ext_en: Perhaps you would join me for a nightcap?

defs.def_en: A nightcap is a drink that you have just before you go to bed, usually an alcoholic drink.

ext.ext_cn: 需要随便3团4股羊毛线。
ext.ext_en: You need 3 balls of any 4-ply knitting wool.

defs.def_en: You use -ply after a number to indicate how many pieces are twisted together to make a type of wool, thread, or rope.
A sett is the place where a badger lives.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 没精打采的;垂头丧气的

ext.ext_cn: 他们无精打采的，甚至都没有抵抗。
ext.ext_en: They were too spiritless even to resist.

defs.def_en: If someone is spiritless, they lack energy, courage, and liveliness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她对变成一个干瘪老太太的恐惧
ext.ext_en: ...her fears of becoming a dried-up old prune.

defs.def_en: See also:dry up;If you describe someone as dried-up, you are saying rudely that they are old and dull, and not worth paying attention to.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数病人都很喜欢翻看旧相册。
ext.ext_en: Most patients derive enjoyment from leafing through old picture albums.

defs.def_en: If you leaf through something such as a book or magazine, you turn the pages without reading or looking at them very carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 澳大利亚有15年通货膨胀率维持在两位数。
ext.ext_en: Australia had 15 years of double-digit inflation.

ext.ext_cn: 两位数的利润增长
ext.ext_en: ...a double-digit increase in profits.

defs.def_en: A double-digit number is between 10 and 99.
A pen-friend is someone you write friendly letters to and receive letters from, although the two of you may never have met.
Mustard powder is a yellow powder. You add hot water to it in order to make mustard.
A pineapple is a large oval fruit that grows in hot countries. It is sweet, juicy, and yellow inside. It has a thick brownish skin.

ext.ext_cn: 生物恐怖主义威胁
ext.ext_en: ...the threat of bioterrorism.

defs.def_en: Bioterrorism is terrorism that involves the use of biological weapons.

ext.ext_cn: 他把自己的愤怒和迷惘写了下来，这渐渐成了一种理解问题的宣泄方式。
ext.ext_en: He wrote out his rage and bewilderment, which gradually became a form of catharsis leading to understanding.

defs.def_en: Catharsis is getting rid of unhappy memories or strong emotions such as anger or sadness by expressing them in some way.
Source code is the original form of a computer program as it is written by a programmer. It is then converted into code that the computer can understand.

defs.def_cn: 安息日(犹太教的安息日是星期六，基督教的安息日是星期日)

ext.ext_cn: 过安息日的教徒
ext.ext_en: ...a religious man who kept the Sabbath...

ext.ext_cn: 纪念安息日，守为圣日。
ext.ext_en: Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

defs.def_en: The Sabbath is the day of the week when members of some religious groups do not work. The Jewish Sabbath is on Saturday and the Christian Sabbath is on Sunday.

ext.ext_cn: 教师应该有2年的见习期。
ext.ext_en: Teachers should have a probationary period of two years.

defs.def_en: A probationary period is a period after someone starts a job, during which their employer can decide whether the person is suitable and should be allowed to continue.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他已经催促他们达成合理的妥协，给予休斯他所应得的报酬。
ext.ext_en: He has urged them to come to an equitable compromise that gives Hughes his proper due...

ext.ext_cn: 我们相信你能够重新分配这笔钱，以公平合理地照顾市中心的贫民。
ext.ext_en: We believe you can redistribute this money in a way that's equitable to take care of the poor of the inner city.

defs.def_en: Something that is equitable is fair and reasonable in a way that gives equal treatment to everyone.

ext.ext_cn: 交易完成后，委托人会出现并将她购买的东西交给她。
ext.ext_en: When her deal is done, the client emerges with her purchase.

defs.def_en: A task or activity that is done has been completed successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 蛋糕一烤好就从炉子里取出来。
ext.ext_en: As soon as the cake is done, remove it from the oven.

defs.def_en: When something that you are cooking is done, it has been cooked long enough and is ready.

ext.ext_cn: “你领头，我们来找。”——“行。”
ext.ext_en: 'You lead and we'll look for it.' — 'Done.'

defs.def_en: You say 'Done' when you are accepting a deal, arrangement, or bet that someone has offered to make with you.

defs.def_cn: 完全了结的;彻底完成的

ext.ext_cn: 大功告成后你就可以休息了。
ext.ext_en: Once this is all over and done with you can have a rest.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is over and done with, you mean that it is completely finished and you do not have to think about it any more.

ext.ext_cn: 他们共进烛光晚餐。
ext.ext_en: They dined by candlelight.

defs.def_en: Candlelight is the light that a candle produces.

ext.ext_cn: 把下列数字和你卡片上的数字比照一下。
ext.ext_en: Check the numbers below against the numbers on your card.

defs.def_en: A card is a piece of stiff paper or thin cardboard on which something is written or printed.

ext.ext_cn: 他们检查我的包和记者证。
ext.ext_en: They check my bag and press card.

ext.ext_cn: 她的会员证
ext.ext_en: ...her membership card...

defs.def_en: A card is a piece of cardboard or plastic, or a small document, which shows information about you and which you carry with you, for example to prove your identity.

defs.def_cn: 银行卡;借记卡;工资卡;购物卡

ext.ext_cn: 他用美国运通卡付了全部账款。
ext.ext_en: He paid the whole bill with an American Express card...

ext.ext_cn: 外出度假时,在外币取款机上使用银行卡一定要小心。
ext.ext_en: Holidaymakers should beware of using plastic cards in foreign cash dispensers.

defs.def_en: A card is a rectangular piece of plastic, issued by a bank, company, or shop, which you can use to buy things or obtain money.

ext.ext_cn: 我过生日时她寄来一张贺卡。
ext.ext_en: She sends me a card on my birthday.

ext.ext_cn: 数百万张祝愿康复的卡片
ext.ext_en: ...millions of get-well cards.

defs.def_en: A card is a folded piece of stiff paper with a picture and sometimes a message printed on it, which you send to someone on a special occasion.

ext.ext_cn: 在明信片上写明你的近况寄到下面的地址。
ext.ext_en: Send your details on a card to the following address.

defs.def_en: A card is the same as a postcard .

ext.ext_cn: 这是我的名片,你也许会用得到我。
ext.ext_en: Here's my card. You may need me.

defs.def_en: A card is a piece of thin cardboard carried by someone such as a business person in order to give to other people. A card shows the name, address, telephone number, and other details of the person who carries it.

ext.ext_cn: 一副扑克牌
ext.ext_en: ...a pack of cards...

ext.ext_cn: 库尔特拿起他那手牌,一张张成扇形铺开。
ext.ext_en: Kurt picked up his hand and fanned out the cards one by one.

defs.def_en: Cards are thin pieces of cardboard with numbers or pictures printed on them which are used to play various games.

ext.ext_cn: 他们又是喝酒抽烟,又是打牌,玩得很痛快。
ext.ext_en: They enjoy themselves drinking wine, smoking and playing cards.

defs.def_en: If you are playing cards, you are playing a game using cards.

ext.ext_cn: 在他俩的爱情关系中,他的最大优势是:她需要他超过他需要她。
ext.ext_en: It was his strongest card in their relationship — that she wanted him more than he wanted her...

ext.ext_cn: 这让西方制造商得以亮出他们的王牌:资金和技术。
ext.ext_en: This permitted Western manufacturers to play their strong cards: capital and technology.

defs.def_en: You can use card to refer to something that gives you an advantage in a particular situation. If you play a particular card, you use that advantage.

ext.ext_cn: 她把那些硬纸片放进了口袋。
ext.ext_en: She put the pieces of card in her pocket.

defs.def_en: Card is strong, stiff paper or thin cardboard.
In computing, a card is a circuit board that can be put into a computer to provide additional memory or functions.

defs.def_cn: (体育比赛的)赛事安排，比赛日程

ext.ext_cn: “天堂男孩”和“飞奔将军”这两匹赛马在开赛的前两场胜算很大。
ext.ext_en: Paradise Boy and the Galloping General have clear chances in the opening two events on the card...

ext.ext_cn: 他将在五局制比赛中迎战凯文·福特。
ext.ext_en: He will now fight Kevin Ford on the five-bout card.

defs.def_en: You can use card to refer to a series of races or matches at a particular sporting event.

defs.def_cn: 要求…出示证明文件(表明达到买酒或饮酒的年龄等)

ext.ext_cn: 这么多年来，头一回有人要我出示身份证。
ext.ext_en: For the first time in many years, I got carded.

defs.def_en: If you are carded, someone in authority asks you to show a document to prove that you are old enough to do something, for example, to buy or drink alcohol.

ext.ext_cn: 去年夏天,她就和朋友们说她有可能在元旦期间结婚。
ext.ext_en: Last summer she began telling friends that a New Year marriage was on the cards.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is on the cards in British English, or in the cards in American English, you mean that it is very likely to happen.

defs.def_cn: 处理得当;巧妙发挥优势

ext.ext_cn: 如果他处理得好,说不定都能当上英格兰队的下任教练。
ext.ext_en: He could even be the next manager of the England team if he plays his cards right.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone will achieve success if they play their cards right, you mean that they will achieve success if they act skilfully and use the advantages that they have.

defs.def_cn: 摊牌;直抒己见;和盘托出(感觉、想法、计划)

ext.ext_cn: 你有话就直说,有什么不满都说清楚。
ext.ext_en: Put your cards on the table and be very clear about your complaints.

defs.def_en: If you put or lay your cards on the table, you deal with a situation by speaking openly about your feelings, ideas, or plans.

ext.ext_cn: 她正用一台老掉牙的收银机记账。
ext.ext_en: She was ringing up her sale on an ancient cash register.

defs.def_en: If a shop assistant rings up a sale on a cash register, he or she presses the keys in order to record the amount that is being spent.

ext.ext_cn: 这家广告代理商每年销售额达14亿美元。
ext.ext_en: The advertising agency rang up 1.4 billion dollars in yearly sales.

defs.def_en: If a company rings up an amount of money, usually a large amount of money, it makes that amount of money in sales or profits.

ext.ext_cn: 自1978年以来，可用于采购图书的经费已经减少了17％。
ext.ext_en: Since 1978, the amount of money available to buy books has fallen by 17%...

ext.ext_cn: 有3艘小船可供出租。
ext.ext_en: There are three small boats available for hire...

defs.def_en: If something you want or need is available, you can find it or obtain it.

ext.ext_cn: 利奇先生休假了，不方便作出评论。
ext.ext_en: Mr Leach is on holiday and was not available for comment.

defs.def_en: Someone who is available is not busy and is therefore free to talk to you or to do a particular task.

ext.ext_cn: 有个犯人刻了一副漂亮的木头象棋。
ext.ext_en: One of the prisoners has carved a beautiful wooden chess set...

ext.ext_cn: 他用白松木雕刻出那些人偶。
ext.ext_en: He carves his figures from white pine...

defs.def_en: See also:carving;If you carve an object, you make it by cutting it out of a substance such as wood or stone. If you carve something such as wood or stone into an object, you make the object by cutting it out.

ext.ext_cn: 他把名字刻在自己的课桌上。
ext.ext_en: He carved his name on his desk...

ext.ext_cn: 那些雕饰精美的门制于17世纪。
ext.ext_en: The ornately carved doors were made in the seventeenth century.

defs.def_en: If you carve writing or a design on an object, you cut it into the surface of the object.

ext.ext_cn: 安德鲁开始切鸡肉。
ext.ext_en: Andrew began to carve the chicken...

ext.ext_cn: 把牛肉切成片。
ext.ext_en: Carve the beef into slices.

defs.def_en: If you carve a piece of cooked meat, you cut slices from it so that you can eat it.

ext.ext_cn: 她作为喜剧演员已经闯出了一片天地。
ext.ext_en: She has carved a niche for herself as a comic actor...

ext.ext_cn: 她们也许忠诚地支持着自己的丈夫，但她们也在开创自己的事业。
ext.ext_en: They may be loyally standing by their men, but they are also carving their own careers...

defs.def_en: If you carve a career or a niche for yourself, you succeed in getting the career or the position that you want by your own efforts.

ext.ext_cn: 将要修建两条三车道的公路穿过乡间。
ext.ext_en: Two three-lane roads will be carved through countryside.

defs.def_en: If a road is carved through a place, it is built so that it goes through that place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 人员过多的；人浮于事的

ext.ext_cn: 很多工厂长期人浮于事。
ext.ext_en: Many factories were chronically overmanned.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place or an industry is overmanned, you mean that you think there are more people working there or doing the work than is necessary.

defs.def_cn: 头脑容易发热的人;鲁莽的人;急性子

ext.ext_cn: 他和他爸爸一样都是个恃强凌弱的莽夫。
ext.ext_en: He is a hothead and a bully just like his dad.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a hothead, you are criticizing them for acting too quickly, without thinking of the consequences.

defs.def_cn: (尤用作对自己小的人的爱称)亲爱的，小宝贝儿
defs.def_en: You can call someone sweetie if you are fond of them, especially if they are younger than you.
If you say that someone is a sweetie, you mean that they are kind and nice.
Sweets are sometimes referred to as sweeties by children or by adults speaking to children.

ext.ext_cn: 一位生于俄罗斯、后移民到美国的教授
ext.ext_en: ...a Russian-born professor who had immigrated to the United States...

ext.ext_cn: 他 1848 年从阿尔斯特移民到这里。
ext.ext_en: He immigrated from Ulster in 1848...

defs.def_en: If someone immigrates to a particular country, they come to live or work in that country, after leaving the country where they were born.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 武断的;任意的;任性的;主观的

ext.ext_cn: 随意逮捕和拘留屡见不鲜。
ext.ext_en: Arbitrary arrests and detention without trial were common.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action, rule, or decision as arbitrary, you think that it is not based on any principle, plan, or system. It often seems unfair because of this.

ext.ext_cn: 和谈中叛乱分子的首席谈判代表
ext.ext_en: ...the rebels' chief negotiator at the peace talks...

ext.ext_cn: 两名美国谈判代表正在呼吁大量削减外部援助。
ext.ext_en: The two American negotiators are calling for substantial cuts in external subsidies.

defs.def_en: Negotiators are people who take part in political or financial negotiations.

defs.def_cn: 小心谨慎地；战战兢兢地

ext.ext_cn: 她双手小心翼翼地抚摸着伤口处的绷带。
ext.ext_en: She was touching the dressing gingerly with both hands...

ext.ext_cn: 我战战兢兢地开车经过安检站。
ext.ext_en: I drove gingerly past the security check points.

defs.def_en: If you do something gingerly, you do it in a careful manner, usually because you expect it to be dangerous, unpleasant, or painful.

ext.ext_cn: 他既是画家又是诗人。
ext.ext_en: He was a painter and poet.

defs.def_en: A poet is a person who writes poems.

ext.ext_cn: 他驱车飞驰而去。
ext.ext_en: He drove off at high speed...

ext.ext_cn: 对这类相机而言，快门的速度是固定的。
ext.ext_en: With this type of camera, the shutter speed is fixed...

defs.def_en: The speed of something is the rate at which it moves or travels.

defs.def_cn: (某事发生或进展的)速度，进度

ext.ext_cn: 19 世纪 50 年代末期，技术变革的速度加快了。
ext.ext_en: In the late 1850s the speed of technological change quickened...

ext.ext_cn: 每一位学习者都可以按自己的进度学习。
ext.ext_en: Each learner can proceed at his own speed.

defs.def_en: The speed of something is the rate at which it happens or is done.

ext.ext_cn: 速度是所有田径运动项目的关键要素。
ext.ext_en: Speed is the essential ingredient of all athletics...

ext.ext_cn: 他突然加速了。
ext.ext_en: He put on a burst of speed...

defs.def_en: Speed is very fast movement or travel.

defs.def_cn: (指某事发生或进展时的)高速，快速

ext.ext_cn: 他办事之麻利让我深感叹服。
ext.ext_en: I was amazed at his speed of working.

ext.ext_cn: 统一进程速度惊人
ext.ext_en: ...the sheer speed of the unification process.

defs.def_en: Speed is a very fast rate at which something happens or is done.

ext.ext_cn: 火车将以每小时 186 英里的速度快速穿过海峡隧道。
ext.ext_en: Trains will speed through the Channel Tunnel at 186mph...

ext.ext_cn: 我一路高速行驶时，发动机的噪音只提高了一点点。
ext.ext_en: The engine noise rises only slightly as I speed along.

defs.def_en: If you speed somewhere, you move or travel there quickly, usually in a vehicle.

ext.ext_cn: 这名男子没有驾驶资格，并且违章超速行驶。
ext.ext_en: This man was not qualified to drive and was speeding.

defs.def_en: Someone who is speeding is driving a vehicle faster than the legal speed limit.
Speed is an illegal drug such as amphetamine which some people take to increase their energy and excitement.

ext.ext_cn: 已经确定了一个日子，届时将向所有的市政委员汇报有关该建议的最新进展情况。
ext.ext_en: A day has been set aside to bring all councillors up to speed on the proposal...

ext.ext_cn: 那些负责人自以为掌握了最新情况。
ext.ext_en: Those in charge deluded themselves they were up to speed.

defs.def_en: If you are up to speed, you have all the most recent information that you need about something.

ext.ext_cn: 受害人要求全额赔偿。
ext.ext_en: The victims are demanding full restitution...

ext.ext_cn: 我们已经要求他们重新雇用那些被开除的人，并对他们进行补偿。
ext.ext_en: We have asked that they rehire the people that were fired and that they make restitution to them.

defs.def_en: Restitution is the act of giving back to a person something that was lost or stolen, or of paying them money for the loss.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 相似的；类似的；可比拟的

ext.ext_cn: 像这样的海底建造技术很复杂，与尝试在水下建桥有些相似。
ext.ext_en: Marine construction technology like this is very complex, somewhat analogous to trying to build a bridge under water.

defs.def_en: If one thing is analogous to another, the two things are similar in some way.

defs.def_cn: (通常置于户外的)垃圾桶，垃圾箱
defs.def_en: A trash can is a large round container which people put their rubbish in and which is usually kept outside their house.

ext.ext_cn: 公司正汇编一份证据材料来支持指控。
ext.ext_en: The company is compiling a dossier of evidence to back its allegations...

ext.ext_cn: 政府保存着成千上万个公民的档案。
ext.ext_en: The government kept dossiers on thousands of its citizens.

defs.def_en: A dossier is a collection of papers containing information on a particular event, or on a person such as a criminal or a spy.

ext.ext_cn: 这些修道院是12世纪大卫王用来抵御英国人而修建的堡垒。
ext.ext_en: The abbeys were founded in the 12th century by King David as a bulwark against the English...

ext.ext_cn: 在这个国家，上议院是唯一的民主堡垒。
ext.ext_en: The House of Lords is the only bulwark of democracy in this country.

defs.def_en: A bulwark against something protects you against it. A bulwark of something protects it.

ext.ext_cn: 我对着房子打球。
ext.ext_en: I bounced a ball against the house...

ext.ext_cn: 我的父亲会颠着足球冲进厨房。
ext.ext_en: My father would burst into the kitchen bouncing a football.

defs.def_en: When an object such as a ball bounces or when you bounce it, it moves upwards from a surface or away from it immediately after hitting it.
The bounce of a sports field is the condition of it, which determines how high a ball will bounce on it.

ext.ext_cn: 需要保护你的手臂和双腿免受玻璃反射光线的照射。
ext.ext_en: Your arms and legs need protection from light bouncing off glass...

ext.ext_cn: 它们的工作原理是通过固体来反射微波。
ext.ext_en: They work by bouncing microwaves off solid objects.

defs.def_en: If sound or light bounces off a surface or is bounced off it, it reaches the surface and is reflected back.

ext.ext_cn: 她走路时长长的黑发随之飘动。
ext.ext_en: Her long black hair bounced as she walked...

ext.ext_cn: 然后我注意到那辆车在上下颠簸，好像有人在车上蹦跳似的。
ext.ext_en: Then I noticed the car was bouncing up and down as if someone were jumping on it...

defs.def_en: If something bounces or if something bounces it, it swings or moves up and down.

defs.def_cn: (在柔软物体表面）跳上跳下，蹦跳，弹跳

ext.ext_cn: 她放任我们随心所欲，甚至连我们在床上蹦跳她也不管。
ext.ext_en: She lets us do anything, even bounce on our beds.

defs.def_en: If you bounce on a soft surface, you jump up and down on it repeatedly.

ext.ext_cn: 帕齐抱起婴儿放在膝上颠动着。
ext.ext_en: Patsy had picked up the baby and was bouncing him on her knee.

defs.def_en: If you bounce a child on your knee, you lift him or her up and down quickly and repeatedly for fun.

ext.ext_cn: 莫伊拉蹦蹦跳跳地进了办公室。
ext.ext_en: Moira bounced into the office.

defs.def_en: If someone bounces somewhere, they move there in an energetic way, because they are feeling happy.

defs.def_cn: 向…透露（想法）；与…探讨（想法）

ext.ext_cn: 与别人谈谈自己的想法是有益的。
ext.ext_en: It was good to bounce ideas off another mind...

ext.ext_cn: 咱们交流一下看法吧。
ext.ext_en: Let's bounce a few ideas around.

defs.def_en: If you bounce your ideas off someone, you tell them to that person, in order to find out what they think about them.

ext.ext_cn: 已经努力迫使成员国制定具有重大金融意义的决策。
ext.ext_en: Attempts have been made to bounce member states into decisions with major financial implications.

defs.def_en: If someone bounces you into doing something you do not really want to do, they make you do it, usually by starting a process which cannot easily be stopped.

ext.ext_cn: 我们唯一的不满就是，如果支票被拒付…
ext.ext_en: Our only complaint would be if the cheque bounced...

ext.ext_cn: 他的开户银行错误地拒付了票面金额为75,000英镑的支票。
ext.ext_en: His bank wrongly bounced cheques worth £75,000.

defs.def_en: If a cheque bounces or if a bank bounces it, the bank refuses to accept it and pay out the money, because the person who wrote it does not have enough money in their account.
If an e-mail or other electronic message bounces, it is returned to the person who sent it because the address was wrong or because of a problem with one of the computers involved in sending it.

defs.def_cn: 圣周，受难周（基督教指复活节前的一周）
defs.def_en: In the Christian religion, Holy Week is the week before Easter, when Christians remember the events leading up to the death of Christ.

ext.ext_cn: 她站起身来，看到丝裙上的褶痕皱起了眉头。
ext.ext_en: She stood up, frowning at the creases in her silk dress...

ext.ext_cn: 爸爸用他的一双大手捋平了地图上的折痕。
ext.ext_en: Papa flattened the creases of the map with his broad hands.

defs.def_en: Creases are lines that are made in cloth or paper when it is crushed or folded.

ext.ext_cn: 旅行时大多数服装都会略微起褶。
ext.ext_en: Most outfits crease a bit when you are travelling...

ext.ext_cn: 莉兹小心翼翼地坐在床上，生怕把裙子弄皱。
ext.ext_en: Liz sat down on the bed, lowering herself carefully so as not to crease her skirt.

defs.def_en: If cloth or paper creases or if you crease it, lines form in it when it is crushed or folded.

defs.def_cn: (皮肤因为皱眉或微笑而)起皱纹;使(皮肤)起皱纹

ext.ext_cn: 他红润的脸庞仍旧时常笑得堆起褶子。
ext.ext_en: His ruddy face still routinely creases with mirth...

ext.ext_cn: 他的脸上，第二次流露出了感情。
ext.ext_en: For just the second time a look of emotion creases his face.

defs.def_en: If your face creases or if an expression creases it, lines appear on it because you are frowning or smiling.

ext.ext_cn: 他眼角的细纹
ext.ext_en: ...the tiny creases at the corners of his eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 克雷弗克一笑，脸上的皱纹就加深了。
ext.ext_en: When Crevecoeur smiled, the creases in his face deepened.

defs.def_en: Creases in someone's skin are lines which form where their skin folds when they move.

defs.def_cn: (板球场上击球手的)位置线，击球线

ext.ext_cn: 海恩斯还在击球线上，他已经得了84分了。
ext.ext_en: Haynes was still at the crease, unbeaten on 84.

defs.def_en: In cricket, the crease is a line on the playing surface where the batsman stands.

defs.def_cn: (尤指针对私人问题提供咨询的)顾问，辅导顾问

ext.ext_cn: 经受了这种苦难的孩子应该去咨询在排遣丧亲之痛方面有着丰富经验的辅导人员。
ext.ext_en: Children who have suffered like this should see a counsellor experienced in bereavement...

ext.ext_cn: 他们寻求婚姻顾问的帮助。
ext.ext_en: They sought the help of a marriage counsellor.

defs.def_en: A counsellor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their personal problems.
A prairie is a large area of flat, grassy land in North America. Prairies have very few trees.
Bookbinding is the work of fastening books together and putting covers on them.

ext.ext_cn: 皮下脂肪
ext.ext_en: ...subcutaneous fat.

defs.def_en: Subcutaneous is used to indicate that something is situated, used, or put under your skin.

ext.ext_cn: 授予该国黑人选举权
ext.ext_en: ...the enfranchisement of the country's blacks.

defs.def_en: Enfranchisement is the condition of someone being enfranchised.

ext.ext_cn: 他被揭穿，原来是个骗子。
ext.ext_en: He was exposed as a charlatan.

defs.def_en: You describe someone as a charlatan when they pretend to have skills or knowledge that they do not really possess.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 多变的;易变的;反复无常的

ext.ext_cn: 食物中钾的含量差别很大。
ext.ext_en: The potassium content of foodstuffs is very variable...

ext.ext_cn: 有一阵风朝岸上吹来，风向变化不定，但风力很强。
ext.ext_en: There was a bit of a wind and it was blowing  onshore, variable, but quite strong.

defs.def_en: Something that is variable changes quite often, and there usually seems to be no fixed pattern to these changes.

ext.ext_cn: 购买决定可能会基于价格、送货日期、售后服务以及其他可变因素。
ext.ext_en: Decisions could be made on the basis of price, delivery dates, after-sales service or any other variable...

ext.ext_cn: 对该产业进行预测时还要考虑天气和宏观经济环境等其他不确定因素。
ext.ext_en: Other variables in making forecasts for the industry include the weather and the general economic climate.

defs.def_en: A variable is a factor that can change in quality, quantity, or size, which you have to take into account in a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 普遍做法是把自变量放在等式的右边。
ext.ext_en: It is conventional to place the independent variable on the right-hand side of an equation.

defs.def_en: A variable is a quantity that can have any one of a set of values.

defs.def_cn: 未使用的;未被占用的;空的

ext.ext_cn: 车厢中部有一个空座。
ext.ext_en: Half way down the coach was a vacant seat...

ext.ext_cn: 各大城市里空置的楼房都比无家可归的人多。
ext.ext_en: In every major city there are more vacant buildings than there are homeless people.

defs.def_en: If something is vacant, it is not being used by anyone.

ext.ext_cn: 几位资深人士被认为有望填补现在空缺的职位。
ext.ext_en: A number of senior people were regarded as likely to occupy the now vacant post...

ext.ext_cn: 主席之位已经空缺一段时间了。
ext.ext_en: The post of chairman has been vacant for some time.

defs.def_en: If a job or position is vacant, no one is doing it or in it at present, and people can apply for it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她脸上有种茫然的神情。
ext.ext_en: She had a kind of vacant look on her face.

defs.def_en: A vacant look or expression is one that suggests that someone does not understand something or that they are not thinking about anything in particular.

defs.def_cn: （想象中耳尖、头戴尖顶帽的）小精灵，小仙子
defs.def_en: A pixie is an imaginary little creature like a fairy. Pixies have pointed ears and wear pointed hats.
A stoplight is a set of coloured lights which controls the flow of traffic on a road.
The stoplights on a car or other vehicle are the two red lights at the back.

ext.ext_cn: 这使得两种文化能相互融合，却又不失其个性。
ext.ext_en: This allows the two cultures to intermingle without losing their separate identities.

ext.ext_cn: 与其他国家的公民打成一片的机会
ext.ext_en: ...an opportunity for them to intermingle with the citizens of other countries.

defs.def_en: When people or things intermingle, they mix with each other.

ext.ext_cn: 那只小狗狂吠着。
ext.ext_en: The little dog yapped frantically.

ext.ext_cn: 两只疯狂吠叫的凯恩犭更狗
ext.ext_en: ...two yapping cairn terriers.

defs.def_en: If a small dog yaps, it makes short loud sounds in an excited way.

defs.def_cn: 哇啦哇啦地说个不停;瞎扯

ext.ext_cn: 那家伙就爱胡扯，而且一说起来就没完没了。
ext.ext_en: The guy just loves to yap, and will do so at length...

ext.ext_cn: 她没完没了地和我唠叨着乔的事。
ext.ext_en: She keeps yapping at me about Joe.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone yaps, you mean that they talk continuously in an annoying way.

ext.ext_cn: 海洋的凶险
ext.ext_en: ...the perils of the sea...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然处境非常危险,我还是挺过来了。
ext.ext_en: In spite of great peril, I have survived...

defs.def_en: Perils are great dangers.

ext.ext_cn: 拍电视广告的危险
ext.ext_en: ...the perils of starring in a television commercial.

defs.def_en: The perils of a particular activity or course of action are the dangers or problems it may involve.

ext.ext_cn: 无视该问题要自担风险。
ext.ext_en: Ignore it at your peril...

ext.ext_cn: 违法者要自担后果。
ext.ext_en: Anyone who breaks the law does so at their peril.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does something at their peril, you are warning them that they will probably suffer as a result of doing it.

defs.def_cn: 使分裂;使破裂;使出现分歧

ext.ext_cn: 他说种族间的相互残杀正在让这个国家走向分裂。
ext.ext_en: He said that communal carnage was ripping the country apart...

ext.ext_cn: 在这一点上和保罗作斗争可能会使这个家庭破裂。
ext.ext_en: To have fought Paul on this would have risked ripping the family apart.

defs.def_en: If something rips people apart, it causes them to quarrel or fight so seriously that they can no longer be friends.

ext.ext_cn: 主持人和听众都公开批评她，并以取笑她为乐。
ext.ext_en: The presenters and audience ripped her apart, enjoying a laugh at her expense...

ext.ext_cn: 我们是英国唯一一家坚持批判这些浅薄的谎言和半真半假的报道的报纸。
ext.ext_en: We are the only paper in Britain that has consistently ripped apart these shallow lies and half-truths...

defs.def_en: If you rip someone apart or rip their opinion apart, you criticize them and say publicly that they are wrong, often by laughing at what they have said or done.

ext.ext_cn: 男人给她的感受是支配一切，野蛮残暴。
ext.ext_en: Her experience of men was of domination and brutality.

ext.ext_cn: 警察的残暴行为
ext.ext_en: ...police brutality.

defs.def_en: Brutality is cruel and violent treatment or behaviour. A brutality is an instance of cruel and violent treatment or behaviour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽听到了刺耳的救护车警铃声。
ext.ext_en: Mary heard the penetrating bell of an ambulance...

ext.ext_cn: 她说话带有鼻音，很刺耳。
ext.ext_en: Her voice was nasal and penetrating.

defs.def_en: A penetrating sound is loud and usually high-pitched.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （目光）锐利的，犀利的，有洞察力的

ext.ext_cn: 他的目光敏锐而犀利，看得我心里怦怦直跳。
ext.ext_en: He gazed at me with a sharp, penetrating look that made my heart pound.

ext.ext_cn: 锐利的黑眼睛
ext.ext_en: ...dark penetrating eyes.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you a penetrating look, it makes you think that they know what you are thinking.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 缜密而敏锐的头脑
ext.ext_en: ...a thoughtful, penetrating mind...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直在问一些尖锐的问题。
ext.ext_en: He never stopped asking penetrating questions.

defs.def_en: Someone who has a penetrating mind understands and recognizes things quickly and thoroughly.

defs.def_cn: 茴芹籽（用作糖果、饮料和药物的调味剂）

ext.ext_cn: 茴香有一种与众不同的茴芹籽的味道。
ext.ext_en: Fennel has a very distinctive aniseed flavour.

defs.def_en: Aniseed is a substance made from the seeds of the anise plant. It is used as a flavouring in sweets, drinks, and medicine.

defs.def_cn: （支付款项、福利等）与收入相关的，与工资挂钩的

ext.ext_cn: 政府的全国收入型养老金计划
ext.ext_en: ...the Government's State Earnings Related Pension Scheme.

defs.def_en: An earnings-related payment or benefit provides higher or lower payments according to the amount a person was earning while working.

defs.def_cn: 采取强硬手段;绝不手软

ext.ext_cn: 她在一个由比自己大20岁的男人们主宰的世界里作风强硬。
ext.ext_en: She is playing hardball in a world dominated by men 20 years her senior.

defs.def_en: If someone plays hardball, they will do anything that is necessary to achieve or get what they want, even if this involves being harsh or unfair.

defs.def_cn: (因工作量不足的)被迫休假，暂时下岗

ext.ext_cn: 这可能意味着大量的政府工作人员要暂时下岗。
ext.ext_en: This could mean a massive furlough of government workers.

defs.def_en: If workers are given furlough, they are told to stay away from work for a certain period because there is not enough for them to do.

defs.def_cn: 使被迫休假;使暂时下岗

ext.ext_cn: 我们遗憾地通知您，您将要无限期地在家待岗。
ext.ext_en: We regret to inform you that you are being furloughed indefinitely...

ext.ext_cn: 这些工厂已经开始让数百名工人暂时下岗。
ext.ext_en: The factories have begun furloughing hundreds of workers.

defs.def_en: If people who work for a particular organization are furloughed, they are given a furlough.

ext.ext_cn: 我正休假在家。
ext.ext_en: I was at home on furlough.

defs.def_en: When soldiers are given furlough, they are given official permission to leave the area where they are based or are fighting, for a certain period.

ext.ext_cn: 利物浦队的队员一度似乎怎么都不会受伤，但现在一倒就倒了一片。
ext.ext_en: There was a time when Liverpool players never seemed to get injured, but now they are going down like ninepins.

defs.def_en: If you say that people or things are going down like ninepins, you mean that large numbers of them are suddenly becoming ill, collapsing, or doing very badly.

defs.def_cn: (用于名词后，表示食品或饮料带有某种味道)表示“…味的”

ext.ext_cn: 草莓味糖果
ext.ext_en: ...strawberry-flavoured sweets.

ext.ext_cn: 果味苏打水
ext.ext_en: ...fruit-flavored sparkling water.

defs.def_en: -flavoured is used after nouns such as strawberry and chocolate to indicate that a food or drink is flavoured with strawberry or chocolate.

ext.ext_cn: 他始终深信约翰·莱亚莱神父等人已经尽了全力了。
ext.ext_en: His faith that men such as the Reverend John Leale tried to do their best is unshaken.

defs.def_en: If your beliefs are unshaken, you still have those beliefs, although they have been attacked or challenged.

defs.def_cn: (情感上)不为所动的，不受影响的

ext.ext_cn: 莫娜不为她经历的这场磨难所动，对自己表现出的勇气也态度淡然。
ext.ext_en: Mona remains unshaken by her ordeal and is matter-of-fact about her courage.

defs.def_en: If you are unshaken by something, you are not emotionally affected by it.
In fairy stories, a sorceress is a woman who performs magic by using the power of evil spirits.

defs.def_cn: 芬尼（德国原硬币，1马克等于100芬尼。）
defs.def_en: A pfennig was a German coin worth one hundredth of a mark.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 品行端正的;品德高尚的

ext.ext_cn: 也许这个人说到底品行并非那么完美。
ext.ext_en: Maybe this guy isn't so squeaky clean after all.

ext.ext_cn: 他对树立一个品德高尚的形象的渴望
ext.ext_en: ...his desire to foster a squeaky-clean image.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is squeaky clean, you mean that they live a very moral life and have never done anything wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 海湾大桥有一段垮塌了。
ext.ext_en: A section of the Bay Bridge had collapsed...

ext.ext_cn: 屋顶轰隆一声塌了下来，碎石瓦砾落了一地。
ext.ext_en: The roof collapsed in a roar of rock and rubble...

defs.def_en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

defs.def_cn: (体系或机构)崩溃，瓦解，突然失败

ext.ext_cn: 他的商业帝国无力承担沉重的债务负担而垮掉了。
ext.ext_en: His business empire collapsed under a massive burden of debt...

ext.ext_cn: 这一体系在其占统治地位的大多数国家都失败了。

defs.def_en: If something, for example a system or institution, collapses, it fails or comes to an end completely and suddenly.

defs.def_en: If you collapse, you suddenly faint or fall down because you are very ill or weak.

ext.ext_en: She arrived home exhausted and barely capable of showering before collapsing on her bed.

defs.def_en: If you collapse onto something, you sit or lie down suddenly because you are very tired.

ext.ext_en: He plunged 300ft to the ground when his parachute collapsed...

ext.ext_en: He was rushed to hospital last week after suffering a collapsed lung.

ext.ext_cn: 一段反常的暖和天气
ext.ext_en: ...a spell of unseasonably warm weather...

ext.ext_en: It was unseasonably mild for late January.

defs.def_en: Unseasonably warm, cold, or mild weather is warmer, colder, or milder than it usually is at the time of year.

ext.ext_en: I thought back to the time in 1975 when my son was desperately ill...

ext.ext_en: When you think back on it, do you think that it was the right thing to do?...

defs.def_en: If you think back, you make an effort to remember things that happened to you in the past.

defs.def_en: An urban myth is a strange or surprising story which many people believe, but which is not actually true.
An archdiocese is the area over which an archbishop has control.
Whey is the watery part of sour milk that is separated from the thick part called curds, for example when you are making cheese.
A vibraphone is an electronic musical instrument which consists of a set of metal bars in a frame. When you hit the bars they produce ringing notes that last for some time.
Wrapping paper is special paper which is used for wrapping presents.

ext.ext_en: Crime and the fear of crime preoccupy the community.

ext.ext_en: ...the particular issues, problems and theories that preoccupied him.

defs.def_en: If something is preoccupying you, you are thinking about it a lot.
Caster sugar is white sugar that has been ground into fine grains. It is used in cooking.
A sculptor is someone who creates sculptures.

defs.def_cn: （尤指在聚会上表演的）娱乐节目；聚会节目
defs.def_en: Someone's party piece is something that they often do to entertain people, especially at parties, for example singing a particular song or saying a particular poem.

ext.ext_cn: 狗象征着忠诚。

ext.ext_en: In some works, flowers take on a powerful emblematic quality.

defs.def_en: If something, such as an object in a picture, is emblematic of a particular quality or an idea, it symbolically represents the quality or idea.

ext.ext_cn: 彭萨柯拉的杀人事件是世界各地发生的大量暴力事件的典型代表。
ext.ext_en: The killing in Pensacola is emblematic of a lot of the violence that is happening around the world.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is emblematic of a state of affairs, you mean that it is characteristic of it and represents its most typical features.
A ewer is a large jug with a wide opening.

ext.ext_cn: 救援人员奋力营救大火中的受害者。
ext.ext_en: Rescue workers fought to get to victims inside the inferno.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a fire as an inferno, you mean that it is burning fiercely and causing great destruction.

ext.ext_en: ...a University professor who specializes in the history of the Russian empire.

ext.ext_en: ...a Portuguese restaurant which specializes in seafood.

defs.def_en: If you specialize in a thing, you know a lot about it and concentrate a great deal of your time and energy on it, especially in your work or when you are studying or training. You also use specialize to talk about a restaurant which concentrates on a particular type of food.
A carrier bag is a bag made of plastic or paper which has handles and which you carry shopping in.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If something is unsurprising, you are not surprised by it because you would expect it to happen or be like it is.

defs.def_en: Southbound roads or vehicles lead or are travelling towards the south.

defs.def_en: Hospitality is friendly, welcoming behaviour towards guests or people you have just met.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The power of the Green movement in Germany has made that country a leader in the drive to recycle more waste materials.

ext.ext_en: ...trying to persuade governments to adopt greener policies...

ext.ext_en: Our children are being educated to be green in everything they do.

ext.ext_en: The Greens see themselves as a radical alternative to the two major British political parties.

defs.def_en: Greens are members of green political movements.

ext.ext_en: ...the village green.

defs.def_en: A green is an area of land covered with grass, especially in a town or in the middle of a village.

defs.def_en: Green is used in the names of places that contain or used to contain an area of grass.

ext.ext_en: Eat your greens.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the cooked leaves of vegetables such as spinach or cabbage as greens .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Pick and ripen any green fruits in a warm dark place.

defs.def_en: You can describe fruit and vegetables as green when they are unripe and not ready to be eaten.

defs.def_en: To reconnoitre an area means to obtain information about its geographical features or about the size and position of an army there.
