defs.def_cn: （经济或体力上）参与过多活动的，捉襟见肘的

ext.ext_cn: 英国东印度茶业公司摊子大、开支多，已濒临破产。
ext.ext_en: The British East India Tea Company was overextended and faced bankruptcy...

ext.ext_cn: 工作压身、精力上捉襟见肘的家长可能会被视作对孩子缺乏关爱，但他们也许只是太疲惫了。
ext.ext_en: The overworked, overextended parent may be seen as unloving, but may simply be exhausted.

defs.def_en: If a person or organization is overextended, they have become involved in more activities than they can financially or physically manage.

defs.def_cn: 重新装备，更换(机器设备等)

ext.ext_cn: 每次更换产品，就得重新装备机器。
ext.ext_en: Each time the product changes, the machines have to be retooled.

defs.def_en: If the machines in a factory or the items of equipment used by a firm are retooled, they are replaced or changed so that they can do new tasks.

defs.def_cn: 使人扫兴的人；大煞风景的人

ext.ext_cn: 别那么扫兴！
ext.ext_en: Don't be such a killjoy!...

ext.ext_cn: 这是那种典型的令人不快的官僚主义态度。
ext.ext_en: This is a classic example of the killjoy attitudes of officialdom.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a killjoy, you are critical of them because they stop other people from enjoying themselves, often by reminding them of something unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: (与数字连用构成形容词)表示“有…排挡的”，“有…速的”

ext.ext_cn: 10 速自行车
ext.ext_en: ...a 10-speed bicycle.

defs.def_en: -speed is used after numbers to form adjectives that indicate that a bicycle or car has a particular number of gears.

defs.def_cn: 拆除（爆炸装置);解除（警报);使无效

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯正在拆除其一些最危险的导弹。
ext.ext_en: Russia is deactivating some of its deadliest missiles.

defs.def_en: If someone deactivates an explosive device or an alarm, they make it harmless or impossible to operate.
A commie is the same as a communist .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在新的联邦政府体制中，6 省中的 5 个将成为自治区。
ext.ext_en: Five of the six provinces are to become autonomous regions in a new federal system of government.

defs.def_en: A federal country or system of government is one in which the different states or provinces of the country have important powers to make their own laws and decisions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 中央集权式的;集权式联邦制的

ext.ext_cn: 他认为一个集权式联邦制在欧洲是不可行的。
ext.ext_en: He does not believe in a federal Europe with centralising powers.

defs.def_en: Some people use federal to describe a system of government which they disapprove of, in which the different states or provinces are controlled by a strong central government.

defs.def_cn: 归属联邦政府的;与联邦政府有关的

ext.ext_cn: 联邦政府仅掌控 6％的教育预算。
ext.ext_en: The federal government controls just 6% of the education budget.

ext.ext_cn: 联邦法官
ext.ext_en: ...a federal judge.

defs.def_en: Federal also means belonging or relating to the national government of a federal country rather than to one of the states within it.
Federals are the same as feds .

ext.ext_cn: 财富实现了在社会中更加公平地再分配。
ext.ext_en: Wealth was redistributed more equitably among society...

ext.ext_cn: 税收可以用来对收入进行再分配。
ext.ext_en: Taxes could be used to redistribute income.

defs.def_en: If something such as money or property is redistributed, it is shared among people or organizations in a different way from the way that it was previously shared.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (音乐)乡土爵士乐风格的，放克风格的

ext.ext_cn: 这种节奏有些乡土爵士乐风格。
ext.ext_en: It's a funky sort of rhythm.

defs.def_en: Funky jazz, blues, or pop music has a very strong, repeated bass part.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不从习俗(或传统)的;不寻常的;与众不同的

ext.ext_cn: 我想那个地方是有种怪怪的独特魅力，但是不适合抚养孩子。
ext.ext_en: It had a certain funky charm, I guess, but it wasn't much of a place to raise a kid.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as funky, you like them because they are unconventional or unusual.

defs.def_cn: （电视）游戏节目，有奖竞赛节目

ext.ext_cn: 要想做一个优秀的游戏节目主持人就要了解你的参赛选手。
ext.ext_en: Being a good game-show host means getting to know your contestants.

defs.def_en: Game shows are television programmes on which people play games in order to win prizes.

defs.def_cn: 促红细胞生成素（运动员禁用）
defs.def_en: EPO is a drug that can improve performance in sports and is used illegally by some sportspeople. EPO is short for 'erythropoietin'.

ext.ext_cn: 非婚生育率激增。
ext.ext_en: Illegitimacy rates are soaring.

defs.def_en: Illegitimacy is the state of being born of parents who were not married to each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 追逐私利的;只顾自己的

ext.ext_cn: 他说民主会为追逐私利的政客大开方便之门，使他们趁机以公谋私。
ext.ext_en: He said that democracy would open the way for self-seeking politicians to abuse the situation.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as self-seeking, you disapprove of them because they are interested only in doing things which give them an advantage over other people.

defs.def_cn: (班级或教学体制)学生水平不一的，不按照学生能力分班的

ext.ext_cn: 几乎在所有英国国立小学里，孩子们都在能力水平不一的混合班学习。
ext.ext_en: In nearly all British state junior schools, children learn in mixed ability classes.

ext.ext_cn: 针对能力不同的学生的教学
ext.ext_en: ...mixed ability teaching.

defs.def_en: A mixed ability class or teaching system is one in which pupils are taught together in the same class, even though their abilities are different.

ext.ext_cn: 清晨，天空呈现出斑驳的深灰色。
ext.ext_en: In the mornings the sky appeared a heavy shade of mottled gray...

ext.ext_cn: 墙壁是用深浅两种绿色油漆的。
ext.ext_en: The walls were painted in two shades of green.

defs.def_en: A shade of a particular colour is one of its different forms. For example, emerald green and olive green are shades of green.

ext.ext_cn: 一年中的这个时间,背阴处的温度可达到 48 摄氏度。
ext.ext_en: Temperatures in the shade can reach forty-eight degrees celsius at this time of year...

ext.ext_cn: 亚历克西斯顺着海岸前行，走到一处悬崖下的阴凉地又重新开始阅读。
ext.ext_en: Alexis walked up the coast, and resumed his reading in the shade of an overhanging cliff.

defs.def_en: Shade is an area of darkness under or next to an object such as a tree, where sunlight does not reach.

ext.ext_cn: 海滩上棕榈树成阴的疗养胜地
ext.ext_en: ...a health resort whose beaches are shaded by palm trees...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数植物都要尽量避免强光直射。
ext.ext_en: Most plants prefer to be lightly shaded from direct, hot sunlight...

defs.def_en: If you say that a place or person is shaded by objects such as trees, you mean that the place or person cannot be reached, harmed, or bothered by strong sunlight because those objects are in the way.

defs.def_cn: (为避免强光照射而)遮挡,遮住(眼睛)

ext.ext_cn: 你不能直视它，必须遮住眼睛或索性闭上。
ext.ext_en: You can't look directly into it; you've got to shade your eyes or close them altogether...

ext.ext_cn: 我不得不在红绿灯处停车，然后放下遮阳板来遮挡阳光。
ext.ext_en: I had to stop at the traffic lights and put down the sun visor to shade my eyes from the light.

defs.def_en: If you shade your eyes, you put your hand or an object partly in front of your face in order to prevent a bright light from shining into your eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 伦勃朗为营造一种动态效果而对光线和阴影的巧妙运用
ext.ext_en: ...Rembrandt's skilful use of light and shade to create the atmosphere of movement.

defs.def_en: Shade is darkness or shadows as they are shown in a picture.

defs.def_cn: (抽象事物的)细微差别,不同方面

ext.ext_cn: 能表达意思上的各种微妙差别的能力
ext.ext_en: ...the capacity to convey subtle shades of meaning.

ext.ext_cn: 确实很多报纸观点各异
ext.ext_en: ...literally dozens of newspapers of every shade of opinion.

defs.def_en: The shades of something abstract are its many, slightly different forms.

defs.def_cn: 逐渐变成;渐渐与…分辨不清

ext.ext_cn: 夜幕渐渐降临，我们驱车在狭窄的胡同里缓慢前行。
ext.ext_en: As the dusk shaded into night, we drove slowly through narrow alleys...

ext.ext_cn: 尾羽的根部呈深蓝色，到了尾尖就渐变成淡蓝色。
ext.ext_en: The tail feathers are dark blue at their bases, shading to pale blue at their tips.

defs.def_en: If something shades into something else, there is no clear division between the two things, so that you cannot tell where or when the first thing ends and the second thing begins.
Shades are sunglasses .
A shade is the same as a lampshade .

ext.ext_cn: 南希放下窗帘，关了灯。
ext.ext_en: Nancy left the shades down and the lights off.

defs.def_en: A shade is a piece of stiff cloth or heavy paper that you can pull down over a window as a covering.

ext.ext_cn: 他的写作得益于他感到已故的林肯一直在他身后激励着他。
ext.ext_en: His writing benefits from the shade of Lincoln hovering over his shoulder.

defs.def_en: The shade of a dead person is their spirit, which is thought to be still alive in some way and in contact with the real world.

ext.ext_cn: 头两个进球都有点碰巧。
ext.ext_en: The first two goals were a shade fortunate...

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得她很迷人，但对他来说可能又有点太过天真。
ext.ext_en: He found her charming, but perhaps just a shade too ingenuous for him...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is, for example, a shade unusual or a shade disappointing, you mean that it is slightly unusual or disappointing.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管缺乏层次变化，但听上去仍比较悦耳的有些颤抖、未作修饰的嗓音。
ext.ext_en: ...a faltering, artless voice that is pleasant enough, if rather lacking in light and shade.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is light and shade in something such as a performance, you mean you like it because different parts of it are different in tone or mood.

defs.def_cn: 使黯然失色;使相形见绌

ext.ext_cn: 一次让其他所有跨栏运动员的表现都相形见绌的赛跑
ext.ext_en: ...a run that put every other hurdler's performance in the shade.

defs.def_en: To put someone or something in the shade means to be so impressive that the person or thing seems unimportant by comparison.

ext.ext_cn: 该政府部门直接掌控着外贸的各个方面。
ext.ext_en: The ministry had direct control over every aspect of foreign trade.

ext.ext_cn: 有关新国际贸易协定的谈判
ext.ext_en: ...negotiations on a new international trade agreement...

defs.def_en: Trade is the activity of buying, selling, or exchanging goods or services between people, firms, or countries.

defs.def_cn: 做买卖;做生意;从事贸易

ext.ext_cn: 即便对方的报价很有吸引力,他们也有可能拒绝进行交易。
ext.ext_en: They may refuse to trade, even when offered attractive prices...

ext.ext_cn: 他们有多年与西方贸易往来的经验。
ext.ext_en: They had years of experience of trading with the West...

defs.def_en: When people, firms, or countries trade, they buy, sell, or exchange goods or services between themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 他们把今后几年的旅游业完全给毁了。
ext.ext_en: They've completely ruined the tourist trade for the next few years.

ext.ext_cn: 军火贸易
ext.ext_en: ...the arms trade.

defs.def_en: A trade is a particular area of business or industry.

ext.ext_cn: 他在北海学会了潜水员这一行的本事。
ext.ext_en: He learnt his trade as a diver in the North Sea...

ext.ext_cn: 阿林是珠宝匠。
ext.ext_en: Allyn was a jeweller by trade...

defs.def_en: Someone's trade is the kind of work that they do, especially when they have been trained to do it over a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 他们用土地换取了货物与金钱。
ext.ext_en: They traded land for goods and money...

ext.ext_cn: 他仍然声称军火没有被用来交换人质。
ext.ext_en: He still claims the arms weren't traded for hostages…

defs.def_en: If someone trades one thing for another or if two people trade things, they agree to exchange one thing for the other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 迈克要求乔治和他交换位置，让他和托德同坐一辆车。
ext.ext_en: Mike asked George to trade places with him so he could ride with Tod...

ext.ext_cn: 肯尼迪调皮地建议教授和看门人互换一段时间工作。
ext.ext_en: Kennedy mischievously suggested that professors ought to trade jobs for a time with janitors…

defs.def_en: If you trade places with someone or if the two of you trade places, you move into the other person's position or situation, and they move into yours.

defs.def_cn: 使(足球、棒球等职业运动员)转会

ext.ext_cn: 他从巨人队转会到扬基队。
ext.ext_en: He was traded from the Giants to the Yankees...

ext.ext_cn: 奥克兰运动家队自从他转会后还没有赢过一场比赛。
ext.ext_en: The A's have not won a game since they traded him.

defs.def_en: In professional sports, for example football or baseball, if a player is traded from one team to another, they leave one team and begin playing for another.

ext.ext_cn: 儿童会通过在操场上对打或互骂的方式解决争端。
ext.ext_en: Children would settle disputes by trading punches or insults in the schoolyard...

ext.ext_cn: 他们与城内的政府军互相开炮。
ext.ext_en: They traded artillery fire with government forces inside the city.

defs.def_en: If two people or groups trade something such as blows, insults, or jokes, they hit each other, insult each other, or tell each other jokes.

ext.ext_cn: 政府正设法阻止医院自行焚烧垃圾废物。
ext.ext_en: The government is trying to stop hospitals incinerating their own waste.

defs.def_en: When authorities incinerate rubbish or waste material, they burn it completely in a special container.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车受撞击起火,一些人被烧死。
ext.ext_en: The cars caught fire on impact and some of the victims were incinerated.

defs.def_en: If people are incinerated, for example in a bomb attack or a fire, they are burnt to death.

ext.ext_cn: 她急着去赶飞往纽约的红眼航班。
ext.ext_en: She was running to catch a red-eye to New York...

ext.ext_cn: 他决定不乘夜航航班回家，而是留下来搭第二天早上9点的飞机。
ext.ext_en: He decided not to take the red-eye flight home but to wait and take a nine o'clock flight the following morning.

defs.def_en: A red-eye or a red-eye flight is a plane journey during the night.

defs.def_cn: （由于拍摄时使用闪光灯等原因而在照片中呈现的）红眼

ext.ext_cn: 这个相机有防红眼功能。
ext.ext_en: The camera incorporates a redeye reduction facility.

defs.def_en: In photography, redeye is the unwanted effect that you sometimes get in photographs of people or animals where their eyes appear red because of the reflection of a camera flash or other light.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人震惊的；使人惊骇的；极为恶劣的

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经在恶劣不堪的条件下生活两个月了。
ext.ext_en: They have been living under the most appalling conditions for two months.

defs.def_en: Something that is appalling is so bad or unpleasant that it shocks you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我头痛欲裂。
ext.ext_en: I developed an appalling headache.

defs.def_en: You can use appalling to emphasize that something is very great or severe.

defs.def_cn: 指责,非难,质疑(他人的动机、诚信等)

ext.ext_cn: 部长的来信怀疑我的诚实,质疑我的动机。
ext.ext_en: The Secretary's letter questions my veracity and impugns my motives...

ext.ext_cn: 我所希望的,就是该银行的好名声不要在某些方面受到质疑。
ext.ext_en: All I can hope is that the good name of the Bank will not be impugned in some way.

defs.def_en: If you impugn something such as someone's motives or integrity, you imply that they are not entirely honest or honourable.

ext.ext_cn: 一项努力拯救一个鳄鱼物种、使其免于灭绝的行动已经开始。
ext.ext_en: An operation is beginning to try to save a species of crocodile from extinction...

ext.ext_cn: 很多物种已经被猎杀到灭绝的边缘。
ext.ext_en: Many species have been shot to the verge of extinction.

defs.def_en: The extinction of a species of animal or plant is the death of all its remaining living members.

ext.ext_cn: 伐木工人说由于木材销量下降，他们的工作恐不复存在。
ext.ext_en: The loggers say their jobs are faced with extinction because of declining timber sales.

defs.def_en: If someone refers to the extinction of a way of life or type of activity, they mean that the way of life or activity stops existing.
Political economy is the study of the way in which a government influences or organizes a nation's wealth.

ext.ext_cn: 其名字的由来鲜为人知。
ext.ext_en: The derivation of its name is obscure...

ext.ext_cn: 该词源于古法语。
ext.ext_en: The word is of old French derivation.

defs.def_en: The derivation of something, especially a word, is its origin or source.

ext.ext_cn: 新科技思想的兴起
ext.ext_en: ...the emergence of new scientific ideas.

defs.def_en: The emergence of something is the process or event of its coming into existence.

ext.ext_cn: 女性仍然是家庭暴力的主要受害者。
ext.ext_en: Women are still the main victims of domestic violence.

defs.def_en: Domestic violence is violence that takes place in the home, especially between a husband and wife.
A sombrero is a hat with a very wide brim which is worn especially in Mexico.

defs.def_cn: 迷幻浩室音乐（一种节奏反复有力的电子舞曲）
defs.def_en: Acid house is a type of electronic dance music with a strong, repeated rhythm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 提供有用消息(或资料)的;增长知识的;增长见闻的

ext.ext_cn: 这些广告并没有包含太多有用信息。
ext.ext_en: The adverts are not very informative...

ext.ext_cn: 《绿色环保的假期》是本生动有趣、增长见闻的读物。
ext.ext_en: 'Holidays That Don't Cost the Earth' is a lively, informative read.

defs.def_en: Something that is informative gives you useful information.

ext.ext_cn: 有些足球球员因为代言鞋类产品而得到几百万的报酬。
ext.ext_en: Some footballers get paid millions for endorsing footwear.

defs.def_en: Footwear refers to things that people wear on their feet, for example shoes and boots.

ext.ext_cn: 演出座无虚席
ext.ext_en: ...playing to a full house.

defs.def_en: If a theatre has a full house for a particular performance, it has as large an audience as it can hold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一项调查表明，人们对该吃什么才能保持健康这个问题感到困惑。
ext.ext_en: A survey showed people were confused about what they should eat to stay healthy...

ext.ext_cn: 事情发生得太快，把布赖恩给弄糊涂了。
ext.ext_en: Things were happening too quickly and Brian was confused.

defs.def_en: If you are confused, you do not know exactly what is happening or what to do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 由于双方均宣称获胜，形势依然不明朗。
ext.ext_en: The situation remains confused as both sides claim success.

ext.ext_cn: 价值观变得越来越混乱的现代社会
ext.ext_en: ...a modern society in which values have become increasingly confused.

defs.def_en: Something that is confused does not have any order or pattern and is difficult to understand.
A tape recorder is a machine used for recording and playing music, speech, or other sounds.

ext.ext_cn: 严格的训练是新任教练的秘密武器。
ext.ext_en: Discipline was the new coach's secret weapon.

defs.def_en: Someone's secret weapon is a thing or person which they believe will help them achieve something and which other people do not know about.

defs.def_cn: (尤用于讨论政治事务时)国家

ext.ext_cn: 墨西哥是个世俗国家，和梵蒂冈没有外交关系。
ext.ext_en: Mexico is a secular state and does not have diplomatic relations with the Vatican...

ext.ext_en: Some weeks ago I recommended to EU member states that we should have discussions with the Americans.

ext.ext_cn: 南部一些州的领导正在路易斯维尔开会。
ext.ext_en: Leaders of the Southern states are meeting in Louisville.

defs.def_en: Some large countries such as the USA are divided into smaller areas called states .

ext.ext_cn: 该国政府入不敷出。
ext.ext_en: The state does not collect enough revenue to cover its expenditure...

ext.ext_cn: 他们声称无法为地面军事行动提供充分的空中掩护。
ext.ext_en: They said they could not provide adequate air cover for ground operations.

defs.def_en: Cover is protection from enemy attack that is provided for troops or ships carrying out a particular operation, for example by aircraft.

ext.ext_cn: 查尔斯点燃了导火索，他们便赶紧四处躲避。
ext.ext_en: Charles lit the fuses and they ran for cover.

ext.ext_cn: 没有树木和其他遮蔽物的荒芜之地
ext.ext_en: ...barren wastes of field with no trees and no cover.

defs.def_en: Cover is trees, rocks, or other places where you shelter from the weather or from an attack, or hide from someone.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然严格来讲保险单并不包含这一项，他们的保险公司还是支付了那张900英镑的账单。
ext.ext_en: Their insurer paid the £900 bill, even though the policy did not strictly cover it...

ext.ext_cn: 这些项目不在你的医保范围之内。
ext.ext_en: These items are not covered by your medical insurance...

defs.def_en: An insurance policy that covers a person or thing guarantees that money will be paid by the insurance company in relation to that person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 确保该公司上了足够的保险。
ext.ext_en: Make sure that the firm's insurance cover is adequate.

defs.def_en: Insurance cover is a guarantee from an insurance company that money will be paid by them if it is needed.

ext.ext_cn: 该法规适用于4类试验。
ext.ext_en: The law covers four categories of experiments...

ext.ext_cn: 像其他商品一样，纯种狗的买卖同样受《货物买卖法》的约束。
ext.ext_en: Like any other commodity, pedigree dogs are covered by the Sale of Goods Act.

defs.def_en: If a law covers a particular set of people, things, or situations, it applies to them.

defs.def_cn: (在演讲、课程或书中)讨论，涉及

ext.ext_cn: 《牛津化学初级读本》丛书旨在论述有机化学中的重要问题。
ext.ext_en: The Oxford Chemistry Primers aim to cover important topics in organic chemistry...

ext.ext_cn: 所涉及的其他主题包括焦虑及如何克服。
ext.ext_en: Other subjects covered included nerves and how to overcome them.

defs.def_en: If you cover a particular topic, you discuss it in a lecture, course, or book.

ext.ext_cn: 鲁宾逊被派到意大利报道1990年的世界杯比赛。
ext.ext_en: Robinson was sent to Italy to cover the 1990 World Cup...

ext.ext_cn: 美国新闻媒体将对该审判进行追踪报道。
ext.ext_en: The US news media will cover the trial closely.

defs.def_en: If journalists, newspapers, or television companies cover an event, they report on it.

ext.ext_cn: 将它寄到指定地址，并附上1.50英镑以支付邮资和管理费。
ext.ext_en: Send it to the address given with £1.50 to cover postage and administration...

ext.ext_cn: 那笔钱甚至都不够赔偿破损费。
ext.ext_en: Those figures might not even cover the cost of breakages.

defs.def_en: If a sum of money covers something, it is enough to pay for it.

ext.ext_cn: 家具上套有可清洗外罩的家庭娱乐室
ext.ext_en: ...a family room with washable covers on the furniture.

ext.ext_cn: 羽绒被罩
ext.ext_en: ...a duvet cover.

defs.def_en: A cover is something which is put over an object, usually in order to protect it.

ext.ext_cn: 她放下杯子，钻进被子里。
ext.ext_en: She set her glass down and slid farther under the covers.

defs.def_en: The covers on your bed are the things such as sheets and blankets that you have on top of you.

ext.ext_cn: 几年前，大卫·拜恩曾登上《时代》周刊的封面。
ext.ext_en: A few years ago, David Byrne was on the cover of Time magazine.

ext.ext_cn: 有绿色封皮的螺旋装订的活页小册子
ext.ext_en: ...a small spiral-bound booklet with a green cover...

defs.def_en: The cover of a book or a magazine is the outside part of it.

defs.def_cn: (对秘密或违法之事的)掩盖，掩饰

ext.ext_cn: 他们建立起一座为淫秽活动作掩护的假寺庙。
ext.ext_en: They set up a spurious temple that was a cover for sexual debauchery...

ext.ext_cn: 为掩饰身份，他一般对外称自己是一名自由摄影师。
ext.ext_en: As a cover story he generally tells people he is a freelance photographer.

defs.def_en: Something that is a cover for secret or illegal activities seems respectable or normal, and is intended to hide the activities.

defs.def_cn: (通过提供假信息或不完全的信息来)遮掩，掩盖，包庇

ext.ext_cn: 她为什么要包庇想要杀她的人呢？
ext.ext_en: Why would she cover for someone who was trying to kill her?

defs.def_en: If you cover for someone who is doing something secret or illegal, you give false information or do not give all the information you have, in order to protect them.

ext.ext_cn: 她没有足够的护士来顶替那些生病或休假的人工作。
ext.ext_en: She did not have enough nurses to cover for those who went ill or took holiday.

defs.def_en: If you cover for someone who is ill or away, you do their work for them while they are not there.

ext.ext_cn: 其他艺术家翻唱他的歌曲，一定使他过上了收入颇为可观的生活。
ext.ext_en: He must make a decent living from other artists covering his songs.

defs.def_en: To cover a song originally performed by someone else means to record a new version of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这支单曲是滚石乐队的一首老歌的翻唱。
ext.ext_en: The single is a cover of an old Rolling Stones song.

defs.def_en: A cover is the same as a cover version .

defs.def_cn: 揭露，揭示(真实身份或工作的真实性质)

ext.ext_cn: 问那种问题会暴露我的身份。
ext.ext_en: Asking those kind of questions could blow my cover...

ext.ext_cn: 那个年轻人看起来局促不安，就好像他是一个身份暴露的间谍一样。
ext.ext_en: The young man looked embarrassed, as if he were a spy whose cover had been blown.

defs.def_en: To blow someone's cover means to cause their true identity or the true nature of their work to be revealed.

defs.def_cn: (通常为到达另一地点)离开隐蔽处，冲出躲藏处

ext.ext_cn: 他们又开始跑，离开隐蔽处朝公路冲去。
ext.ext_en: They began running again, broke cover and dashed towards the road.

defs.def_en: If you break cover, you leave a place where you have been hiding or sheltering from attack, usually in order to run to another place.

defs.def_cn: 躲避(炮火、轰炸或坏天气)

ext.ext_cn: 警方的射击手开火回击时，购物者们躲在汽车后面。
ext.ext_en: Shoppers took cover behind cars as police marksmen returned fire.

defs.def_en: If you take cover, you shelter from gunfire, bombs, or the weather.

defs.def_cn: 在…的遮掩下(躲避炮火轰炸、坏天气等)

ext.ext_cn: “躲起来！”比利喊道，我们便又一次冲向桌子。
ext.ext_en: 'Get under cover!' shouted Billy, and we darted once more for the tables.

defs.def_en: If you are under cover, you are under something that protects you from gunfire, bombs, or the weather.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在黑暗的掩护下行进。
ext.ext_en: They move under cover of darkness.

defs.def_en: If you do something under cover of a particular situation, you are able to do it without being noticed because of that situation.

defs.def_cn: 保护自己(免受批评、谴责等);辩解

ext.ext_cn: 精明狡猾的首相辩解说自己是苏格兰血统。
ext.ext_en: The canny Premier covered his back by pointing out that he was of Scottish stock.

defs.def_en: If you cover your back or cover your rear, you do something in order to protect yourself, for example against criticism or against accusations of doing something wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 要谨慎行事，保护好自己并保持低调。
ext.ext_en: Just play it safe, cover your ass, keep your head down.

defs.def_en: Cover your ass means the same as cover your back .

ext.ext_cn: 非法移民
ext.ext_en: ...illegal immigrants.

ext.ext_cn: 移民签证
ext.ext_en: ...immigrant visas.

defs.def_en: An immigrant is a person who has come to live in a country from some other country.

defs.def_cn: 精彩描写;小品文;精彩片断

ext.ext_cn: 一系列反映苏格兰历史的令人难忘的精彩片断
ext.ext_en: ...a succession of memorable cameos of Scottish history...

ext.ext_cn: 他扮演一个非常出彩的小角色:一名住院的年轻艾滋病患者。
ext.ext_en: He played a cameo role, that of a young Aids patient in hospital.

defs.def_en: A cameo is a short description or piece of acting which expresses cleverly and neatly the nature of a situation, event, or person's character.

defs.def_cn: (通常为椭圆形的)多彩浮雕首饰

ext.ext_cn: 多彩浮雕胸针
ext.ext_en: ...a cameo brooch.

defs.def_en: A cameo is a piece of jewellery, usually oval in shape, consisting of a raised stone figure or design fixed on to a flat stone of another colour.

ext.ext_cn: 我咒骂着一瘸一拐地站起来。
ext.ext_en: I cursed and hobbled to my feet.

ext.ext_cn: 他生气地看了她一眼，骂了一句。
ext.ext_en: He shot her an angry look and a curse.

defs.def_en: If you curse, you use rude or offensive language, usually because you are angry about something.

ext.ext_cn: 奶奶提出抗议，但他辱骂她并把她粗暴地推到一旁。
ext.ext_en: Grandma protested, but he cursed her and rudely pushed her aside...

ext.ext_cn: 他骂自己怎么那么不小心。
ext.ext_en: He cursed himself for having been so careless.

defs.def_en: If you curse someone, you say insulting things to them because you are angry with them.

defs.def_cn: (尤指用粗话)抱怨，发牢骚;咒骂

ext.ext_cn: 于是，我们一面抱怨延误了时间，一面又朝西出发了。
ext.ext_en: So we set off again, cursing the delay, towards the west...

ext.ext_cn: 她在心里默默地骂自己愚蠢。
ext.ext_en: She silently cursed her own stupidity.

defs.def_en: If you curse something, you complain angrily about it, especially using rude language.

ext.ext_cn: 可能我的家族受到了诅咒。
ext.ext_en: Maybe there is a curse on my family...

ext.ext_cn: 他受到伏都教的诅咒。
ext.ext_en: He's been the object of a voodoo curse.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is a curse on someone, you mean that there seems to be a supernatural power causing unpleasant things to happen to them.

ext.ext_cn: 冷漠是英国地方民主制度长期以来难以推广的祸根。
ext.ext_en: Apathy is the long-standing curse of British local democracy...

ext.ext_cn: 夏季感冒是极其糟糕的事。
ext.ext_en: Summer colds are a terrible curse.

defs.def_en: You can refer to something that causes a great deal of trouble or harm as a curse .

defs.def_cn: (旧时伺候富人和有权势之人的)高级妓女
defs.def_en: In former times, a courtesan was a woman who had sexual relationships with rich and powerful men for money.

ext.ext_cn: 他从头至尾都表现出一定的冷静沉着。
ext.ext_en: He behaves throughout with a certain sang-froid.

defs.def_en: A person's sang-froid is their ability to remain calm in a dangerous or difficult situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不能穿过的;刺不进的;透不过的

ext.ext_cn: 高加索山脉,几乎难以穿越的欧亚屏障
ext.ext_en: ...the Caucasus range, an almost impenetrable barrier between Europe and Asia.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a barrier or a forest as impenetrable, you mean that it is impossible or very difficult to get through.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的书出了名的晦涩难懂。
ext.ext_en: His books are notoriously impenetrable.

ext.ext_cn: 这些隐晦难懂的诗
ext.ext_en: ...these impenetrable poems.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a book or a theory as impenetrable, you are emphasizing that it is impossible or very difficult to understand.

ext.ext_cn: 只要她在那一带，她总会去拜访教区牧师。
ext.ext_en: She always called at the vicarage whenever she was in the area...

ext.ext_cn: 只要你愿意，随时都可以去我的乡间小屋住。
ext.ext_en: You can have my cottage whenever you like...

defs.def_en: You use whenever to refer to any time or every time that something happens or is true.

ext.ext_cn: 他好像在1963年还是什么时候娶了当时的温哥华小姐。
ext.ext_en: He married Miss Vancouver in 1963, or whenever it was.

defs.def_en: You use whenever to refer to a time that you do not know or are not sure about.

defs.def_cn: (尤指某种液体的)大块污渍,大斑块
defs.def_en: A splodge is a large uneven mark or stain, especially one that has been caused by a liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 他们身穿黑色衣服，以纪念那些亡故者。
ext.ext_en: They wore black in remembrance of those who had died.

defs.def_en: If you do something in remembrance of a dead person, you do it as a way of showing that you want to remember them and that you respect them.

ext.ext_cn: 他沉湎于过去的记忆。
ext.ext_en: He had clung to the remembrance of things past.

ext.ext_cn: 关于家庭假日的更愉快的记忆
ext.ext_en: ...happier remembrances of family holidays.

defs.def_en: A remembrance is a memory that you have of someone or something.
A coop is a cage where you keep small animals or birds such as chickens and rabbits.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们已经长大离家开始自己生活的家庭
ext.ext_en: ...a family whose children have grown up and flown the coop...

ext.ext_cn: 她晋升为高级发型师，然后又冲破种种限制，开起了自己的发廊。
ext.ext_en: She graduates to senior stylist and then flies the coop to set up in a salon of her own.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has flown the coop, you mean that they have left a place or situation that limits their freedom.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 把前花园和隔壁隔开的低矮的花园围墙
ext.ext_en: ...the low garden wall that separated the front garden from next door...

ext.ext_cn: 她把它放在了矮桌上。
ext.ext_en: She put it down on the low table...

defs.def_en: Something that is low measures only a short distance from the bottom to the top, or from the ground to the top.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （位置）低的，近地面的，近底部的

ext.ext_cn: 他的头碰到了低梁上。
ext.ext_en: He bumped his head on the low beams...

ext.ext_cn: 当时是傍晚时分，太阳低悬于空中。
ext.ext_en: It was late afternoon and the sun was low in the sky...

defs.def_en: If something is low, it is close to the ground, to sea level, or to the bottom of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 确保供水河水位较低时水深仍能处于既定水平的水泵
ext.ext_en: ...pumps that guarantee a constant depth of water even when the supplying river is low.

defs.def_en: When a river is low, it contains less water than usual.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 英国的伤亡人数始终很低。
ext.ext_en: British casualties remained remarkably low...

ext.ext_cn: 他们现在还得靠微薄的收入过日子。
ext.ext_en: They are still having to live on very low incomes...

defs.def_en: You can use low to indicate that something is small in amount or that it is at the bottom of a particular scale. You can use phrases such as in the low 80s to indicate that a number or level is less than 85 but not as little as 80.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她拒绝把科林由“法律顾问”这一低级别往上提。
ext.ext_en: She refused to promote Colin above the low rank of 'legal adviser'.

defs.def_en: Low is used to describe people who are not considered to be very important because they are near the bottom of a particular scale or system.

ext.ext_cn: 我的体重在降到5.5英石的最低点后，最终稳定在7.5英石。
ext.ext_en: Eventually my weight stabilised at seven and a half stone after dropping to a low of five and a half stone...

ext.ext_cn: 美元跌至新低。
ext.ext_en: The dollar fell to a new low.

defs.def_en: If something reaches a low of a particular amount or degree, that is the smallest it has ever been.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （汽车或自行车的排挡）低速的，低挡的

ext.ext_cn: 她选了低速挡小心翼翼地沿小径下行。
ext.ext_en: She selected a low gear and started down the track carefully.

defs.def_en: If you drive or ride a bicycle in a low gear, you use a gear, usually first or second, which gives you the most control over your car or bicycle when travelling slowly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 学校不会接受任何学生质量不合格的作业。
ext.ext_en: A school would not accept low-quality work from any student...

ext.ext_cn: 调查小组批评该精神病院的员工护理水平低劣。
ext.ext_en: The inquiry team criticises staff at the psychiatric hospital for the low standard of care.

defs.def_en: If the quality or standard of something is low, it is very poor.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们要找低卡路里的食物。
ext.ext_en: They look for foods that are low in calories.

ext.ext_cn: 低钠番茄酱
ext.ext_en: ...low-sodium tomato sauce...

defs.def_en: If a food or other substance is low in a particular ingredient, it contains only a small amount of that ingredient.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 重点将放在学校里的后进生身上。
ext.ext_en: Low achievers in schools will receive priority.

ext.ext_cn: 如果业绩落后、得不到报偿的工人罢工的话
ext.ext_en: ...if there are strikes by unrewarded low performers.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone such as a student or a worker as a low achiever, you mean that they are not very good at their work, and do not achieve or produce as much as others.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 大多数性犯罪者都瞧不起自己。
ext.ext_en: The majority of sex offenders have a low opinion of themselves...

ext.ext_cn: 我对英国小报完全没有好感。
ext.ext_en: I have an extremely low opinion of the British tabloid newspapers.

defs.def_en: If you have a low opinion of someone or something, you disapprove of them or dislike them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们大家都非常疲惫，士气低落。
ext.ext_en: We are all very tired and morale is low...

ext.ext_cn: 人们几乎不抱什么期望。
ext.ext_en: People had very low expectations.

defs.def_en: You can use low to describe negative feelings and attitudes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她突然发出一声低沉、憋闷的呻吟，身体开始剧烈地颤抖。
ext.ext_en: Then suddenly she gave a low, choking moan and began to tremble violently...

ext.ext_cn: 我的声音变得很低沉，以至于前几天在电话里被人误以为是男人。
ext.ext_en: My voice has got so low now I was mistaken for a man the other day on the phone.

defs.def_en: If a sound or noise is low, it is deep.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的声音很低，他很费力才听得到。
ext.ext_en: Her voice was so low he had to strain to catch it.

defs.def_en: If someone's voice is low, it is quiet or soft.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 光线很暗时他们视力不佳。
ext.ext_en: Their eyesight is poor in low light.

defs.def_en: A light that is low is not bright or strong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （收音机、烤炉、灯光等调节至）低挡的，低强度的

ext.ext_cn: 她把厨房用小收音机的音量调低。
ext.ext_en: She turned her little kitchen radio on low...

ext.ext_cn: 买一个调光开关，把灯光调暗，或者干脆把灯关掉。
ext.ext_en: Buy a dimmer switch and keep the light on low, or switch it off altogether...

defs.def_en: If a radio, oven, or light is on low, it has been adjusted so that only a small amount of sound, heat, or light is produced.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不足的；短缺的；剩余不多的

ext.ext_cn: 我们的被单枕套有点不够了。
ext.ext_en: We're a bit low on bed linen...

ext.ext_cn: 全球小麦储备严重不足。
ext.ext_en: World stocks of wheat were getting very low.

defs.def_en: If you are low on something or if a supply of it is low, there is not much of it left.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: “你知道，我可没主动要求要干这份工作，”他情绪低落时会这样跟朋友说。
ext.ext_en: 'I didn't  ask for this job, you know,' he tells friends when he is low.

defs.def_en: If you are low, you are depressed.

ext.ext_cn: 使他病倒了好几个月的未确诊疾病

defs.def_en: If you bang a part of your body, you accidentally knock it against something and hurt yourself.

ext.ext_en: Reichel took me out to lunch.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (协议、计划、安排)暂行的，临时的，试探性的

ext.ext_cn: 政治领导人已就下个月举行预备会议达成初步协定。
ext.ext_en: Political leaders have reached a tentative agreement to hold a preparatory conference next month...

ext.ext_cn: 这种理论仍然是探索性的。
ext.ext_en: Such theories are still very tentative.

defs.def_en: Tentative agreements, plans, or arrangements are not definite or certain, but have been made as a first step.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我刚开始投诉时很犹豫不决。
ext.ext_en: My first attempts at complaining were rather tentative...

ext.ext_cn: 她并没有对他怯生生的微笑作出回应。
ext.ext_en: She did not return his tentative smile.

defs.def_en: If someone is tentative, they are cautious and not very confident because they are uncertain or afraid.

defs.def_cn: (脚指甲)长入肉内的，向内生长的
defs.def_en: An ingrown toenail, or in British English an ingrowing toenail, is one which is growing into your toe, often causing you pain.

defs.def_cn: （因不信任或不喜欢而）不愿和…扯上关系
defs.def_en: If you say that you wouldn't touch something with a barge pole, you mean that you would not want to have anything to do with it, either because you do not trust it, or because you do not like it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 形似而实非的;虚假的;伪造的

ext.ext_cn: 他于1979年因被诬告贪污而被捕。
ext.ext_en: He was arrested in 1979 on spurious corruption charges...

ext.ext_cn: 有关不公正的指控有不少是虚假的。
ext.ext_en: Quite a lot of allegations of misjustice are spurious.

defs.def_en: Something that is spurious seems to be genuine, but is false.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (论点、推理)不正确的，站不住脚的

ext.ext_cn: 不正确的分析框架
ext.ext_en: ...a spurious framework for analysis...

ext.ext_cn: 这张图表的依据完全站不住脚。
ext.ext_en: The justification of this chart is entirely spurious.

defs.def_en: A spurious argument or way of reasoning is incorrect, and so the conclusion is probably incorrect.
A Christian church is sometimes referred to as a house of God.

ext.ext_cn: 现在，网球明星的随行人员中有些是心理培训师。
ext.ext_en: Mind trainers are now part of a tennis star's retinue.

defs.def_en: An important person's retinue is the group of servants, friends, or assistants who go with them and look after their needs.
A Transit van is a type of van that is used for carrying goods.

defs.def_cn: (定期定量缴纳给教会、慈善机构等的)什一税，捐税，捐款
defs.def_en: A tithe is a fixed amount of money or goods that is given regularly in order to support a church, a priest, or a charity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （文章或言谈）表示赞美的，颂扬性的

ext.ext_cn: 《纽约时报》发文谈及你的隐退，文中对你大加赞扬。
ext.ext_en: The New York Times has this very laudatory article about your retirement...

ext.ext_cn: 贝丝谈及哈默医生时赞不绝口。
ext.ext_en: Beth spoke of Dr. Hammer in laudatory terms.

defs.def_en: A laudatory piece of writing or speech expresses praise or admiration for someone.

ext.ext_cn: 他在这儿的工作只是临时的。
ext.ext_en: His job here is only temporary...

ext.ext_cn: 多数青少年问题是暂时性的。
ext.ext_en: Most adolescent problems are temporary.

defs.def_en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 约旦领导人似乎愿意参加会议。
ext.ext_en: The Jordanian leader seemed amenable to attending a conference...

ext.ext_cn: 因为我不够优秀，不够有趣或者不够亲切，所以恋爱关系从来都维持不长。
ext.ext_en: I never had a long-term relationship as I wasn't good enough, or interesting or amenable enough.

defs.def_en: If you are amenable to something, you are willing to do it or accept it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 它们看上去像某种猛兽的牙齿。
ext.ext_en: They look like the teeth of some fierce animal.

defs.def_en: A fierce animal or person is very aggressive or angry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 争夺斯柯达股份的竞争极为激烈。
ext.ext_en: Competition has been fierce to win a stake in Skoda...

ext.ext_cn: 该镇在周末与叛乱分子一番激战后被攻占。
ext.ext_en: The town was captured after a fierce battle with rebels at the weekend...

defs.def_en: Fierce feelings or actions are very intense or enthusiastic, or involve great activity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 登山者被一连几天的强风暴雨给困住了。
ext.ext_en: The climbers were trapped by a fierce storm which went on for days.

defs.def_en: Fierce conditions are very intense, great, or strong.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在帮助建立健康的生活方式的指导材料
ext.ext_en: ...instructional material designed to help you with your lifestyle...

ext.ext_cn: 你应该充分利用我们的教学课程。
ext.ext_en: You may wish to take advantage of our instructional session.

defs.def_en: Instructional books or films are meant to teach people something or to offer them help with a particular problem.

defs.def_cn: 详述；具体说明；举例说明

ext.ext_cn: 约翰逊先生举例说明了他想要表达的主要观点。
ext.ext_en: Mr Johnson particularizes the general points he wants to make...

ext.ext_cn: 农民能够得到某种具体的税收待遇。
ext.ext_en: A farmer is entitled to a certain particularized tax treatment.

defs.def_en: If you particularize something that you have been talking about in a general way, you give details or specific examples of it.

defs.def_cn: （产于北美的）蓝莓，越橘蓝色浆果
defs.def_en: A blueberry is a small dark blue fruit that is found in North America. Blueberries are usually cooked before they are eaten.

defs.def_cn: 文员；文书；耍笔杆子的人

ext.ext_cn: 决定人们生活轨迹的文员
ext.ext_en: ...the pencil pushers who decide the course of people's lives.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a pencil pusher, you mean that their work consists of writing or dealing with documents, and does not seem very useful or important.

defs.def_cn: (撒有糖霜的单人份)纸杯蛋糕
defs.def_en: Cupcakes are small iced cakes for one person.

ext.ext_cn: 他把手伸进口袋，掏出一张便签。
ext.ext_en: He reached into his pocket and withdrew a sheet of notepaper...

ext.ext_cn: 卡桑德拉将手从罗杰手里抽了回来。
ext.ext_en: Cassandra withdrew her hand from Roger's.

defs.def_en: If you withdraw something from a place, you remove it or take it away.

ext.ext_cn: 他声明危机一结束，所有外国军队都将撤离。
ext.ext_en: He stated that all foreign forces would withdraw as soon as the crisis ended...

ext.ext_cn: 如果希特勒那天上午11点前不从波兰撤兵，英德两国便将处于战争状态。
ext.ext_en: Unless Hitler withdrew his troops from Poland by 11 o'clock that morning, a state of war would exist between Great Britain and Germany...

defs.def_en: When groups of people such as troops withdraw or when someone withdraws them, they leave the place where they are fighting or where they are based and return nearer home.

ext.ext_cn: 开一个取款时不会乱收费的储蓄账户。
ext.ext_en: Open a savings account that does not charge ridiculous fees to withdraw money...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在旅馆结账后，从银行账户中取了100美元。
ext.ext_en: They withdrew 100 dollars from a bank account after checking out of their hotel.

defs.def_en: If you withdraw money from a bank account, you take it out of that account.

defs.def_cn: 退出，返回(至另一个房间)

ext.ext_cn: 他和其他人回到了他们租住的房间。
ext.ext_en: He and the others withdrew to their rented rooms...

ext.ext_cn: 他斟完酒，然后就又退下了。
ext.ext_en: He poured the wine and then withdrew again...

defs.def_en: If you withdraw to another room, you go there.

ext.ext_cn: 非洲国民大会威胁要退出会谈。
ext.ext_en: The African National Congress threatened to withdraw from the talks.

defs.def_en: If you withdraw from an activity or organization, you stop taking part in it.

defs.def_cn: 收回，撤回(所说的话或声明)

ext.ext_cn: 他收回所说的话，然后又解释他本来想说什么。
ext.ext_en: He withdrew his remarks and explained what he had meant to say.

defs.def_en: If you withdraw a remark or statement that you have made, you say that you want people to ignore it.
The thirteenth item in a series is the one that you count as number thirteen.

defs.def_cn: 法郎(法国和比利时使用欧元前的货币单位，也是其他一些讲法语国家的货币单位)

ext.ext_cn: 葡萄价格大幅上涨，达到每公斤 32 法郎。
ext.ext_en: The price of grapes had shot up to 32 francs a kilo.

ext.ext_cn: 瑞士法郎一直出人意料地保持着坚挺。
ext.ext_en: The Swiss franc has remained surprisingly strong.

defs.def_en: The franc was the unit of currency that was used in France and Belgium, before it was replaced by the euro. It is also the unit of currency in some other countries where French is spoken.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 活跃的;活泼的;时髦的;新潮的

ext.ext_cn: 古板乏味的 50 年代被多姿多彩的60年代所取代。
ext.ext_en: The stuffy '50s gave way to the swinging '60s.

ext.ext_cn: 20 世纪 60 年代中期“摇摆伦敦”时期的年轻学生
ext.ext_en: ...a young student in mid-1960s 'swinging London'.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as swinging, you mean that they are lively and fashionable.

ext.ext_cn: 监狱太可怕了，我不想去那里。
ext.ext_en: Prison petrifies me and I don't want to go there.

defs.def_en: If something petrifies you, it makes you feel very frightened.

ext.ext_cn: 对政治僵局可能会使经济发展停滞的担心
ext.ext_en: ...the fear that a political deadlock may petrify economic initiatives.

defs.def_en: If something such as a society or institution petrifies, or if something petrifies it, it stops changing and developing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 女王最近到访期间他的不得体行为
ext.ext_en: ...his ungracious behaviour during the Queen's recent visit...

ext.ext_cn: 我拒绝接受帮助的时候时常显得粗鲁无礼。
ext.ext_en: I was often rude and ungracious in refusing help.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as ungracious, you mean that they are not polite or friendly in their speech or behaviour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 十分有趣的;非常吸引人的

ext.ext_cn: 他是非常有趣的写作素材。
ext.ext_en: He is an engrossing subject for a book.

defs.def_en: Something that is engrossing is very interesting and holds your attention completely.

defs.def_cn: 德国的；德国人的；德语的

ext.ext_cn: 德国利率的下调
ext.ext_en: ...a cut in German interest rates.

ext.ext_cn: 德国政府
ext.ext_en: ...the German government.

defs.def_en: German means belonging or relating to Germany.

ext.ext_cn: 我听到一个怒不可遏的人说着德语。
ext.ext_en: I heard a very angry man talking in German.

defs.def_en: German is the language used in Germany, Austria, and parts of Switzerland.

ext.ext_cn: 王朝统治
ext.ext_en: ...dynastic rule.

defs.def_en: Dynastic means typical of or relating to a dynasty.

defs.def_cn: (旧时骑兵用的)军刀，马刀，弯刀
defs.def_en: A sabre is a heavy sword with a curved blade that was used in the past by soldiers on horseback.

ext.ext_cn: 总的来看，输家比赢家多。
ext.ext_en: Overall, there were more losers than gainers...

ext.ext_cn: 星期二的大赢家为索尼公司，其股票上涨至9,070日元的高点。
ext.ext_en: Tuesday's notable gainer was Sony, which reached a high of 9,070 yen.

defs.def_en: A gainer is a person or organization who gains something from a particular situation.
Net curtains are curtains made of thin cloth that people hang across their windows to stop people outside seeing into their houses in the daytime.
Flaxen hair is pale yellow in colour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指对被自己击败或欺凌过自己的人）宽宏大量的，宽厚的，慷慨大度的

ext.ext_cn: 我准备表现得宽宏大量，同情他的境遇。
ext.ext_en: I was prepared to be magnanimous, prepared to feel compassion for him...

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个很有雅量的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a man capable of magnanimous gestures.

defs.def_en: If you are magnanimous, you behave kindly and generously towards someone, especially after defeating them or being treated badly by them.
Cologne is a kind of weak perfume.
The CIA is the government organization in the United States that collects secret information about other countries. CIA is an abbreviation for (缩略 =) 'Central Intelligence Agency'.
alsonailfile. A nail file is a small strip of rough metal or card that you rub across the ends of your nails to shorten them or shape them.
A Christmas tree is a fir tree, or an artificial tree that looks like a fir tree, which people put in their houses at Christmas and decorate with coloured lights and ornaments.

ext.ext_cn: 他声称这一切都是一场针对他的阴谋。
ext.ext_en: He claimed that it was all a conspiracy against him...

ext.ext_cn: 一个自称是记者的人威胁要公开有关她的私生活的细节。
ext.ext_en: A man claiming to be a journalist threatened to reveal details about her private life...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

ext.ext_cn: 他再次声称，特立尼达和多巴哥的人民支持他的行动。
ext.ext_en: He repeated his claim that the people of Trinidad and Tobago backed his action...

ext.ext_cn: 他拒不承认他和6个女人有染的说法。
ext.ext_en: He rejected claims that he had affairs with six women.

defs.def_en: A claim is something which someone says which they cannot prove and which may be false.

defs.def_cn: 声称(负有责任或享有功劳)

ext.ext_cn: 一个地下组织已经声称对这起炸弹爆炸事件负责。
ext.ext_en: An underground organisation has claimed responsibility for the bomb explosion...

ext.ext_cn: 他太谦逊，不愿意邀功。
ext.ext_en: He was too modest to claim the credit.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone claims responsibility or credit for something, you mean they say that they are responsible for it, but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

defs.def_cn: 索取，索要(有权拥有的东西)

ext.ext_cn: 如今他们回来索取本属于他们的东西。
ext.ext_en: Now they are returning to claim what was theirs.

defs.def_en: If you claim something, you try to get it because you think you have a right to it.

ext.ext_cn: 多方主张拥有对马其顿的领土主权，结果在巴尔干地区引发了冲突。
ext.ext_en: Rival claims to Macedonian territory caused conflict in the Balkans.

defs.def_en: A claim is a demand for something that you think you have a right to.

defs.def_cn: 取得，获得，赢得(纪录、冠军或奖励)

ext.ext_cn: 庄创下了54.64秒的纪录。
ext.ext_en: Zhuang claimed the record in 54.64 seconds...

ext.ext_cn: 施特菲·格拉芙于1992年第4次赢得温布尔登桂冠。
ext.ext_en: Steffi Graf claimed a fourth Wimbledon title in 1992.

defs.def_en: If someone claims a record, title, or prize, they gain or win it.

ext.ext_cn: 现在他不欠她什么了。
ext.ext_en: She'd no claims on him now...

ext.ext_cn: 他被人们团团围住，个个都要他把注意力放在自己身上。
ext.ext_en: He was surrounded by people, all with claims on his attention.

defs.def_en: If you have a claim on someone or their attention, you have the right to demand things from them or to demand their attention.

defs.def_cn: 需要，要求(花时间或精力)

ext.ext_cn: 需要她关注的人已经很多了。
ext.ext_en: There is already a long list of people claiming her attention.

defs.def_en: If something or someone claims your attention, they need you to spend your time and effort on them.

ext.ext_cn: 有权申领政府补贴的人当中，约有25%没有提出申请。
ext.ext_en: Some 25 per cent of the people who are entitled to claim State benefits do not do so...

ext.ext_cn: 约翰办理过失业保险，可是当他去索赔时却遭拒付。
ext.ext_en: John had taken out redundancy insurance but when he tried to claim, he was refused payment...

defs.def_en: If you claim money from the government, an insurance company, or another organization, you officially apply to them for it, because you think you are entitled to it according to their rules.

defs.def_cn: (向雇主)索要，索取，讨要(钱、福利)

ext.ext_cn: 工会要求按照通货膨胀率的4倍提高工资。
ext.ext_en: The union claimed a pay rise worth four times the rate of inflation.

ext.ext_cn: 他们强烈要求改善工作环境。
ext.ext_en: They are making substantial claims for improved working conditions...

defs.def_en: If you claim money or other benefits from your employers, you demand them because you think you deserve or need them.

defs.def_cn: (战争、疾病、事故)夺去(生命)，导致(死亡)

ext.ext_cn: 昨天，内战夺去了一位联合国译员的生命。
ext.ext_en: The civil war claimed the life of a U.N. interpreter yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 心脏病是头号杀手，每年夺去18万条生命。
ext.ext_en: Heart disease is the biggest killer, claiming 180,000 lives a year.

defs.def_en: If you say that a war, disease, or accident claims someone's life, you mean that they are killed in it or by it.

ext.ext_cn: 芭芭拉·福利特最出名的事就是她教工党议员如何在电视上拥有良好形象。
ext.ext_en: Barbara Follett's greatest claim to fame is that she taught Labour MPs how to look good on television.

defs.def_en: Someone's claim to fame is  something quite important or interesting that they have done or that is connected with them.

ext.ext_cn: 5个亚洲国家声称对那些岛屿拥有主权。
ext.ext_en: Five Asian countries lay claim to the islands.

defs.def_en: If you lay claim to something you do not have, you say that it belongs to you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不方便的;打扰的;令人为难的

ext.ext_cn: 你能 10 点半来吗？我知道你不方便,但是我必须见你。
ext.ext_en: Can you come at 10.30? I know it's inconvenient for you, but I must see you...

ext.ext_cn: 等这么久很麻烦。
ext.ext_en: It's very inconvenient to have to wait so long...

defs.def_en: Something that is inconvenient causes problems or difficulties for someone.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以付费升级到商务舱。
ext.ext_en: You can pay to be upgraded to a business class seat.

ext.ext_cn: 他们乘坐的是商务舱。
ext.ext_en: They flew business class.

defs.def_en: Business class seating on an aeroplane costs less than first class but more than economy class.

ext.ext_cn: 这场音乐会将由英国广播公司进行现场直播。
ext.ext_en: The concert will be broadcast live by the BBC.

ext.ext_cn: 英国广播公司驻突尼斯记者
ext.ext_en: ...the BBC correspondent in Tunis.

defs.def_en: The BBC is a British organization which broadcasts programmes on radio and television. BBC is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'British Broadcasting Corporation'.

defs.def_cn: 英国广播公司的电视频道（或广播电台）

ext.ext_cn: 周四晚上9点英国广播公司电视二台开始播放他的新连续剧。
ext.ext_en: He begins his new series on BBC 2 at 9pm on Thursday.

ext.ext_cn: 英国广播公司苏格兰广播站
ext.ext_en: ...BBC Radio Scotland.

defs.def_en: BBC is used to refer to television channels and radio stations that are run by the BBC.

ext.ext_cn: 它以 Tattle 这一品牌名称在市场上出售。
ext.ext_en: It's marketed under the trade name 'Tattle'.

defs.def_en: A trade name is the name which manufacturers give to a product or to a range of products.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 公平的；均衡考虑的；兼顾各方的

ext.ext_cn: 一份公正、公平、全面的报告
ext.ext_en: ...a fair, balanced, comprehensive report.

defs.def_en: A balanced report, book, or other document takes into account all the different opinions on something and presents information in a fair and reasonable way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 均衡的饮食
ext.ext_en: ...a balanced diet.

defs.def_en: Something that is balanced is pleasing or useful because its different parts or elements are in the correct proportions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 冷静理智的；临危不乱的

ext.ext_cn: 我必须证明自己是个正派、稳重的人。
ext.ext_en: I have to prove myself as a respectable, balanced, person.

defs.def_en: Someone who is balanced remains calm and thinks clearly, even in a difficult situation.

defs.def_cn: 对…纠缠不休；对…说个没完

ext.ext_cn: 你总是得没完没了地和别人说那件事。
ext.ext_en: You've constantly got to keep on at people about that...

ext.ext_cn: 她不停跟他说，让他去考取一些资格证书。
ext.ext_en: She kept on at him to get some qualifications.

defs.def_en: If you keep on at someone, you repeatedly ask or tell them something in a way that annoys them.

ext.ext_cn: 我能看到岩石上的鹰巢。
ext.ext_en: I can see an eagle's nest on the rocks.

defs.def_en: A bird's  nest is the home that it makes to lay its eggs in.

ext.ext_cn: 一些鸟类会彼此紧挨着筑巢。
ext.ext_en: Some species may nest in close proximity to each other.

ext.ext_cn: 巢址
ext.ext_en: ...nesting sites.

defs.def_en: When a bird nests somewhere, it builds a nest and settles there to lay its eggs.

ext.ext_cn: 一些独居蜂会把巢筑在田间的地洞里。
ext.ext_en: Some solitary bees make their nests in burrows in the soil.

ext.ext_cn: 鼠穴
ext.ext_en: ...a rat's nest.

defs.def_en: A nest is a home that a group of insects or other creatures make in order to live in and give birth to their young in.

ext.ext_cn: 我夫人像是要把奥斯本庄园变成自己的安乐窝。
ext.ext_en: My wife seems to be building a nest of her own at Osborne House...

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿睡在粉色和白色毛毯铺成的小窝里。
ext.ext_en: The baby had been asleep in her nest of pink and white blankets.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a place as your nest when it is your home or where you feel comfortable and relaxed.

defs.def_cn: 老巢;窟;秘密窝点;(贼窟中的)一帮

ext.ext_cn: 比亚里茨，那时候出了名的间谍老巢
ext.ext_en: ...Biarritz, notorious in those days as a nest of spies...

ext.ext_cn: 你是说你在警察局有一帮通风报信的？
ext.ext_en: Are you telling me that you've got your own little nest of informers in the Police Department?

defs.def_en: You can use nest to refer to a place where something bad is being done or to the people there who are doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 相比追逐私利，玛丽更乐意帮助他人。
ext.ext_en: Mary's much more interested in doing things for other people than feathering her own nest.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is feathering their nest, you mean that they are getting a lot of money out of something, so that they can lead a comfortable life.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们独立生活后，他和妻子搬到多塞特的茅草屋去住了。
ext.ext_en: When their children had flown the nest, he and his wife moved to a thatched cottage in Dorset.

defs.def_en: When children fly the nest, they leave their parents' home to live on their own.

ext.ext_cn: 他盘腿坐在地上。
ext.ext_en: He sat cross-legged on the floor.

ext.ext_cn: 盘腿而坐的神像散发出智慧与沉静的气息。
ext.ext_en: The cross-legged deity exudes wisdom and composure.

defs.def_en: If someone is sitting cross-legged, they are sitting on the floor with their legs bent so that their knees point outwards.

ext.ext_cn: 岛上到处都是海鸟。
ext.ext_en: The island is covered with seabirds.

defs.def_en: Seabirds are birds that live near the sea and get their food from it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 恼火的;不满的;不高兴的

ext.ext_cn: 不满的雇员们最近要求他辞职。
ext.ext_en: Disgruntled employees recently called for his resignation...

ext.ext_cn: 党员们对竞选活动的运作方式很不满。
ext.ext_en: Party members are disgruntled at the way the campaign is being handled.

defs.def_en: If you are disgruntled, you are cross and dissatisfied because things have not happened the way that you wanted them to happen.

defs.def_cn: 次轻量级拳击运动员(指拳击手体重介于 53.5至57 公斤)
defs.def_en: A featherweight is a professional boxer who weighs between 53.5 and 57 kilograms, which is one of the lowest weight ranges.

ext.ext_cn: 奥秘在于易拉罐中的一个小玩意儿。
ext.ext_en: The secret is a little widget in the can.

defs.def_en: You can refer to any small device as a widget when you do not know exactly what it is or how it works.

ext.ext_cn: 用在小型便携式计算机上的最新光盘转速为每分钟 3,600 转。
ext.ext_en: The latest discs, used for small portable computers, spin 3600 times a minute...

ext.ext_cn: 地球绕着地轴自转。
ext.ext_en: The Earth spins on its own axis...

defs.def_en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

defs.def_cn: (用甩干机或洗衣机)甩干（衣服），给…脱水

ext.ext_cn: 只需要将洗好的衣物脱水，它就差不多干了。
ext.ext_en: Just spin the washing and it's nearly dry.

ext.ext_cn: 设定用凉水洗衣，最后短时脱水。
ext.ext_en: Set on a cool wash and finish with a short spin.

defs.def_en: When you spin washing, it is turned round and round quickly in a spin drier or a washing machine to get the water out.

ext.ext_cn: 我喝了葡萄酒后晕乎乎的。
ext.ext_en: My head was spinning from the wine...

ext.ext_cn: 那么多数字把我搞得头昏脑胀。
ext.ext_en: All those figures make my poor head spin.

defs.def_en: If your head is spinning, you feel unsteady or confused, for example because you are drunk, ill, or excited.

defs.def_cn: 带倾向性的解释(或说法)

ext.ext_cn: 他把这次投票解释为对宪法的支持，这也是他的支持者对今天的投票结果所作的解释。
ext.ext_en: He interpreted the vote as support for the constitution and that is the spin his supporters are putting on the results today.

ext.ext_cn: 报道中带有的根本不恰当的政治倾向，特别是《纽约时报》的报道
ext.ext_en: ...the wholly improper political spin given to the report, particularly by The New York Times.

defs.def_en: See also:spin doctor;If someone puts a certain spin on an event or situation, they interpret it and try to present it in a particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 公众厌烦了那些有倾向性的报道和种种许诺。该是用政绩说话的时候了。
ext.ext_en: The public is sick of spin and tired of promises. It's time for politicians to act.

defs.def_en: In politics, spin is the way in which political parties try to present everything they do in a positive way to the public and the media.
If you go for a spin or take a car for a spin, you make a short journey in a car just to enjoy yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 他很惊讶，也很生气，因为她编的故事太真实了，甚至不能被斥为一个简单的谎言。
ext.ext_en: He was surprised, and annoyed that she had spun a story which was too good to be condemned as a simple lie.

defs.def_en: If someone spins a story, they give you an account of something that is untrue or only partly true.

ext.ext_cn: 米歇尔也会按顾客的要求为其纺羊毛呢，每盎司收费 2.25 美元。
ext.ext_en: Michelle will also spin a customer's wool fleece to specification at a cost of $2.25 an ounce.

defs.def_en: When people spin, they make thread by twisting together pieces of a fibre such as wool or cotton using a device or machine.

defs.def_cn: (飞机的)螺旋式急遽下坠，向下旋冲
defs.def_en: If a plane goes into a spin, it falls very rapidly towards the ground in a spiral movement.

defs.def_cn: (网球或板球运动中球的）快速旋转，旋转运动
defs.def_en: In a game such as tennis or cricket, if you put spin on a ball, you deliberately make it spin rapidly when you hit it or throw it.

ext.ext_cn: 可怜的简对这次聚会真有些不知所措。
ext.ext_en: Poor Jane was in rather a spin about the party.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in a spin or in a flat spin, you mean that they are confused and unable to act sensibly because of something that has happened.

defs.def_cn: （家庭、学校及其他团体成员的）团聚，重聚，聚会

ext.ext_cn: 这个协会每年聚会一次。
ext.ext_en: The Association holds an annual reunion...

ext.ext_cn: 全家人都来参加了这次盛大的家庭聚会。
ext.ext_en: The whole family was there for this big family reunion.

defs.def_en: A reunion is a party attended by members of the same family, school, or other group who have not seen each other for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们将近一周都没能见到她。这是一次令人激动的团聚。
ext.ext_en: The children weren't allowed to see her for nearly a week. It was a very emotional reunion.

defs.def_en: A reunion is a meeting between people who have been separated for some time.
A pedestrian mall is the same as a pedestrian precinct .
An abacus is a frame used for counting. It has rods with sliding beads on them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有区别的;不同的;个别的

ext.ext_cn: 工程学和工艺学互不相同，也有别于自然学科。
ext.ext_en: Engineering and technology are disciplines distinct from one another and from science...

ext.ext_cn: 这本书分为内容不同的两部分。
ext.ext_en: This book is divided into two distinct parts.

defs.def_en: If something is distinct from something else of the same type, it is different or separate from it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 用最少量的食用油来调出一种独特的口味
ext.ext_en: ...to impart a distinct flavor with a minimum of cooking fat.

defs.def_en: If something is distinct, you can hear, see, or taste it clearly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 确定无疑的;确切的;清楚的

ext.ext_cn: 由于托尼不在场了，她的态度有了明显的转变。
ext.ext_en: Now that Tony was no longer present, there was a distinct change in her attitude...

ext.ext_cn: 我清楚地记得他最后几年的情况。
ext.ext_en: I have distinct memories of him in his last years.

defs.def_en: If an idea, thought, or intention is distinct, it is clear and definite.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 身高6英尺3英寸有些明显的不便之处！
ext.ext_en: Being 6ft 3in tall has some distinct disadvantages!

ext.ext_cn: 双方很可能再进行一场马拉松式的优胜杯比赛。
ext.ext_en: Another Cup marathon between the two sides is now a distinct possibility.

defs.def_en: You can use distinct to emphasize that something is great enough in amount or degree to be noticeable or important.

defs.def_cn: 截然不同于;完全不同于;有区别于

ext.ext_cn: 有许多证据表明油性鱼，与高脂肪肉不同，对人体有益。
ext.ext_en: There's a lot of evidence that oily fish, as distinct from fatty meat, has a beneficial effect.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are talking about one thing as distinct from another, you are indicating exactly which thing you mean.

defs.def_cn: 活期(存款)账户;往来账户

ext.ext_cn: 他的活期账户严重透支。
ext.ext_en: His current account was seriously overdrawn.

defs.def_en: A current account is a personal bank account which you can take money out of at any time using your cheque book or cash card.

defs.def_cn: 经常项目，经常账户(指一国一定时期内进出口贸易的差额)

ext.ext_cn: 葡萄牙1992年经常项目可能会出现小额顺差。
ext.ext_en: Portugal will probably have a small current-account surplus for 1992.

defs.def_en: A country's current account is the difference in value between its exports and imports over a particular period of time.

defs.def_cn: 未奏效;未获得预期效果;失败

ext.ext_cn: 他们的一些政策已经失败了。
ext.ext_en: Some of their policies had misfired.

defs.def_en: If a plan misfires, it goes wrong and does not have the results that you intend it to have.

ext.ext_cn: 他试着启动船的引擎，但没发动起来。
ext.ext_en: The boat's engine misfired after he tried to start it up.

defs.def_en: If an engine misfires, the fuel fails to start burning when it should.

ext.ext_cn: 开过一枪后，枪哑火卡住了。
ext.ext_en: The gun misfired after one shot and jammed.

defs.def_en: If a gun misfires, the bullet is not sent out as it should be when the gun is fired.

ext.ext_cn: 他把煎锅放在煤气灶上。
ext.ext_en: He put the frying pan on the gas burner.

defs.def_en: See also:back burner;front burner;A burner is a device which produces heat or a flame, especially as part of a cooker, stove, or heater.

ext.ext_cn: 14世纪，几何图形是风靡一时的墙壁装饰图案。
ext.ext_en: Geometric designs were popular wall decorations in the 14th century.

defs.def_en: Geometric or geometrical patterns or shapes consist of regular shapes or lines.

ext.ext_cn: 欧几里得试图表达他的一个几何学观点。
ext.ext_en: Euclid was trying to convey his idea of a geometrical point.

defs.def_en: Geometric or geometrical means relating to or involving the principles of geometry.

defs.def_cn: (通常指新闻节目中引自政客演讲的)简短引述，原话片段

ext.ext_cn: 国家电视台 30 秒的原声片段
ext.ext_en: ...a 30-second sound bite on national television.

defs.def_en: A soundbite is a short sentence or phrase, usually from a politician's speech, which is broadcast during a news programme.

defs.def_cn: (建筑物或火车内的)走廊，过道，通道
defs.def_en: A corridor is a long passage in a building or train, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

defs.def_cn: 走廊(通往他国或经由他国通向大海的狭长地带)

ext.ext_cn: 东普鲁士和德国的其他地区于1919年被波兰走廊分隔。
ext.ext_en: East Prussia and the rest of Germany were separated, in 1919, by the Polish corridor.

defs.def_en: A corridor is a strip of land that connects one country to another or gives it a route to the sea through another country.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 关怀体贴的;关心照顾的；有同情心的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个可爱的男孩,非常温柔体贴。
ext.ext_en: He is a lovely boy, very gentle and caring.

ext.ext_cn: 爱意绵绵、知冷知热的丈夫
ext.ext_en: ...a loving, caring husband.

defs.def_en: If someone is caring, they are affectionate, helpful, and sympathetic.

defs.def_cn: (职业)护理的，关怀的，照顾他人的

ext.ext_cn: 本门课程同样适合护理业从业人士学习。
ext.ext_en: The course is also suitable for those in the caring professions.

ext.ext_cn: 护理服务
ext.ext_en: ...the caring services.

defs.def_en: The caring professions are those such as nursing and social work that are involved with looking after people who are ill or who need help in coping with their lives.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 5位幸存者最终到达安全之地时已经衣衫褴褛、饥肠辘辘、精疲力尽。
ext.ext_en: The five survivors eventually reached safety, ragged, half-starved and exhausted.

defs.def_en: Someone who is ragged looks untidy and is wearing clothes that are old and torn.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Ragged clothes are old and torn.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 高低不平的；参差不齐的；犬牙交错的

ext.ext_cn: 她能听到他不均匀的呼吸声，似乎他是跑着过来的。
ext.ext_en: She could hear his ragged breathing, as if he had been running...

ext.ext_cn: 奥布赖恩让那些人排成了参差不齐的一列。
ext.ext_en: O'Brien formed the men into a ragged line.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is ragged when it is untidy or uneven.

ext.ext_cn: 他们让我到这儿、到那儿，哪儿都跑遍了，我累得筋疲力尽却没有任何进展。
ext.ext_en: They'd send me here, there and everywhere and I'd run myself ragged and get no place...

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙队先是猛烈进攻，使英格兰队疲于奔命，但守门员伊恩·沃克防守甚严。
ext.ext_en: Spain ran England ragged early on but goalkeeper Ian Walker proved a formidable barrier.

defs.def_en: If someone runs you ragged, they make you do so much that you become exhausted.

ext.ext_cn: 金属等导电材料中的电子
ext.ext_en: ...electrons in a conducting material such as a metal.

ext.ext_cn: 新型高吸水性材料的设计
ext.ext_en: ...the design of new absorbent materials.

defs.def_en: A material is a solid substance.

ext.ext_cn: 她的裙子的厚布料
ext.ext_en: ...the thick material of her skirt...

ext.ext_cn: 这些布料质地柔软，穿着很舒服。
ext.ext_en: The materials are soft and comfortable to wear.

defs.def_en: Material is cloth.

ext.ext_cn: 建筑商耗尽了材料。
ext.ext_en: The builders ran out of materials.

ext.ext_cn: 缝纫材料
ext.ext_en: ...sewing materials.

defs.def_en: Materials are the things that you need for a particular activity.

ext.ext_cn: 我在讲述这个故事时加入了新的素材。
ext.ext_en: In my version of the story, I added some new material.

ext.ext_cn: 影片的制片人受到了创作影片原始素材的作者的启发
ext.ext_en: ...the film producer's debt to the author of original screen material.

defs.def_en: Ideas or information that are used as a basis for a book, play, or film can be referred  to as material .

defs.def_cn: （指与抽象相对）物质的，有形的，实体的

ext.ext_cn: 每个房间肯定都塞满了东西。
ext.ext_en: Every room must have been stuffed with material things.

ext.ext_cn: 物质世界
ext.ext_en: ...the material world.

defs.def_en: Material things are related to possessions or money, rather than to more abstract things such as ideas or values.

ext.ext_cn: 她不是上大学的料。
ext.ext_en: She was not university material...

ext.ext_cn: 成为总统候选人后，他的宣言并没有多少变化。
ext.ext_en: His message has changed little since he became presidential material.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a particular kind of material, you mean that they have the qualities or abilities to do a particular job or task.

defs.def_cn: (证据或信息)直接相关的，实质性的，重要的

ext.ext_cn: 实质性证据的性质和可用性毋庸讨论。
ext.ext_en: The nature and availability of material evidence was not to be discussed...

ext.ext_cn: 他们坚持认为该公司并未透露实质性的信息。
ext.ext_en: They contend that the company failed to disclose material information.

defs.def_en: Material evidence or information is directly relevant and important in a legal or academic argument.

ext.ext_cn: 他可以再学学使用吸尘器、洗衣机和其他家用电器。
ext.ext_en: He could also learn to use the vacuum cleaner, the washing machine and other household appliances.

ext.ext_cn: 美泰克公司，美国最大的家电制造商之一
ext.ext_en: ...Maytag, one of America's biggest domestic appliance manufacturers.

defs.def_en: An appliance is a device or machine in your home that you use to do a job such as cleaning or cooking. Appliances are often electrical.

ext.ext_cn: 这些进步是巧妙应用科学的结果。
ext.ext_en: These advances were the result of the intellectual appliance of science.

defs.def_en: The appliance of a skill or of knowledge is its use for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 由演技精湛的伊迪丝·埃文斯主演的戏剧
ext.ext_en: ...a play starring the incomparable Edith Evans...

ext.ext_cn: 从房子里向外看到的景色非常优美。
ext.ext_en: The views from the house are incomparable.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as incomparable, you mean that they are extremely good or impressive.

ext.ext_cn: 那是场精彩绝伦的演出。
ext.ext_en: It was a performance of incomparable brilliance.

ext.ext_cn: 有绝世美景的地区
ext.ext_en: ...an area of incomparable beauty.

defs.def_en: You use incomparable to emphasize that someone or something has a good quality to a great degree.
A single-breasted coat, jacket, or suit fastens in the centre of the chest and has only one row of buttons.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不常做肝这道菜，因为很多人吃不惯。
ext.ext_en: We don't serve liver often because so many people dislike it...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维开始讨厌所有他曾喜欢的吸烟的电视偶像了。
ext.ext_en: David began to dislike all his television heroes who smoked.

defs.def_en: If you dislike someone or something, you consider them to be unpleasant and do not like them.

ext.ext_cn: 他毫不掩饰对我的厌恶。
ext.ext_en: He made no attempt to conceal his dislike of me...

ext.ext_cn: 多年的厌恶之情终于爆发，双方拳脚相加。
ext.ext_en: Years of dislike boiled over and blows were exchanged.

defs.def_en: Dislike is the feeling that you do not like someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 想想工作中哪些部分是自己喜欢的，哪些是不喜欢的。
ext.ext_en: Consider what your likes and dislikes are about your job...

ext.ext_cn: 对他人无端的厌恶之情别人可以轻易察觉到。
ext.ext_en: Strong irrational dislikes of other people can easily be picked up from others.

defs.def_en: Your dislikes are the things that you do not like.

ext.ext_cn: 我非常烦他。
ext.ext_en: I took a violent dislike to him...

ext.ext_cn: 对以前爱吃的食物，他兴许突然就没了胃口。
ext.ext_en: He may suddenly take a dislike to foods that he's previously enjoyed.

defs.def_en: If you take a dislike to someone or something, you decide that you do not like them.

ext.ext_cn: 一枚手榴弹掷向了陆军巡逻队。
ext.ext_en: A hand grenade was thrown at an army patrol.

defs.def_en: A grenade or a hand grenade is a small bomb that can be thrown by hand.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有价值的;有益的;有用的

defs.def_en: When an organization, group, or shape re-forms, or when someone re-forms it, it is created again after a period during which it did not exist or existed in a different form.

ext.ext_en: The military were plotting a coup...

ext.ext_en: Yesterday's meeting was intended to plot a survival strategy for the party...

ext.ext_en: For the next five years she plotted her career.

defs.def_en: When people plot a strategy or a course of action, they carefully plan each step of it.
See also:sub-plot;The plot of a film, novel, or play is the connected series of events which make up the story.

defs.def_cn: （尤指作特殊用途的）一小块（土地）

ext.ext_cn: 我想我该给自己买一小块地，在上面建一座房子。
ext.ext_en: I thought that I'd buy myself a small plot of land and build a house on it...

ext.ext_en: The bottom of the garden was given over to vegetable plots.

defs.def_en: A plot of land is a small piece of land, especially one that has been measured or marked out for a special purpose, such as building houses or growing vegetables.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在图表上绘制出大约8个点的曲线。
ext.ext_en: We plot about eight points on the graph.

defs.def_en: When someone plots something on a graph, they mark certain points on it and then join the points up.

defs.def_cn: （在地图上）标绘出（飞机、船舶的位置或航线）

defs.def_en: When someone plots the position or course of a plane or ship, they mark it on a map using instruments to obtain accurate information.

ext.ext_en: They used a computer to plot the movements of everyone in the building.

defs.def_en: If someone plots the progress or development of something, they make a diagram or a plan which shows how it has developed in order to give some indication of how it will develop in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 保守党人在治安问题上不知所措。

defs.def_en: If someone loses the plot, they become confused and do not know what they should do.

defs.def_cn: (火车或公共汽车的)当日往返票

ext.ext_en: I have patients who are HIV-positive and asymptomatic.

defs.def_en: If someone with a disease is asymptomatic, it means that they do not show any symptoms of the disease.

defs.def_en: If you hire something, you pay money to the owner so that you can use it for a period of time.

defs.def_en: If something is for hire, it is available for you to hire.

defs.def_en: If you plunge an object into something, you push it quickly or violently into it.

Cats are lions, tigers, and other wild animals in the same family.

ext.ext_en: 'All right, I've been reading it. So what?' — 'Curiosity killed the cat, that's what.'

ext.ext_cn: 那个活动房被形容为宽敞豪华，可事实上几乎连转身的地儿都没有。
ext.ext_en: It was described as a large, luxury mobile home, but there was barely room to swing a cat.

defs.def_en: If you say 'There's no room to swing a cat' or 'You can't swing a cat', you mean that the place you are talking about is very small or crowded.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Someone who is rheumatic suffers from rheumatism.

ext.ext_cn: 许多成熟的企业正面临倒闭。

defs.def_en: Bankruptcy is the state of being bankrupt.

ext.ext_cn: 8月份企业破产数字攀升。
ext.ext_en: The number of corporate bankruptcies climbed in August.

defs.def_en: A bankruptcy is an instance of an organization or person going bankrupt.

ext.ext_cn: 大屠杀使该政权的道德沦丧暴露无遗。

ext.ext_cn: 我把泡泡糖弄到了娜娜的车座上。

Biological diversity is the same as biodiversity.

ext.ext_cn: 小一些的湖深度从 5 英尺到 14 英尺不等。

ext.ext_en: The depth of the shaft is 520 yards...

defs.def_en: The depth of something such as a river or hole is the distance downwards from its top surface, or between its upper and lower surfaces.

ext.ext_cn: 我很清楚存在于伦敦德里市的那种强烈情绪。
ext.ext_en: I am well aware of the depth of feeling that exists in Londonderry...

ext.ext_en: The country's leadership had underestimated the depth of the crisis.

defs.def_en: The depth of a situation is its extent and seriousness.

ext.ext_en: It makes invaluable reading for anyone who wants to acquire a greater depth of understanding of the subject.

defs.def_en: The depth of someone's knowledge is the great amount that they know.

ext.ext_en: The blue base gives the red paint more depth.

defs.def_en: The depth of a colour is its intensity and strength.
