ext.ext_en: All the paintings are startlingly dramatic as a result of their depth of field and colour.

defs.def_en: In photography and art, you say that a picture has depth or depth of field when you mean that it appears three-dimensional rather than flat.

ext.ext_cn: 他的音乐缺乏深度。
ext.ext_en: His music lacks depth...

ext.ext_cn: 我们所有人都有值得认识的深藏部分。
ext.ext_en: There are hidden depths in all of us.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something has depth, you mean that they have serious and interesting qualities which are not immediately obvious and which you have to think about carefully before you can fully understand them.

ext.ext_cn: 船消失在了大海深处。
ext.ext_en: The ship vanished into the depths.

defs.def_en: The depths are places that are a long way below the surface of the sea or earth.

ext.ext_cn: 乡村腹地
ext.ext_en: ...the depths of the countryside...

ext.ext_cn: 从松林深处传来一声回响。
ext.ext_en: Somewhere in the depths of the pine forest an identical sound reverberated.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the depths of an area, you mean the parts of it which are very far from the edge.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子生病时我陷入了绝望的深渊之中。
ext.ext_en: I was in the depths of despair when the baby was sick.

defs.def_en: If you are in the depths of an unpleasant emotion, you feel that emotion very strongly.

defs.def_cn: …的中间部分;…最严重的时候;…最强烈的时候

ext.ext_cn: 该国正遭遇最严重的经济衰退。
ext.ext_en: The country is in the depths of a recession.

ext.ext_cn: 隆冬时节
ext.ext_en: ...the depths of winter.

defs.def_en: If something happens in the depths of a difficult or unpleasant period of time, it happens in the middle and most severe or intense part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们将深入探讨这3个领域。
ext.ext_en: We will discuss these three areas in depth...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的成就已经全面分析过了，无需再议。
ext.ext_en: Their achievements have already been analysed in depth and do not require further discussion.

defs.def_en: If you deal with a subject in depth, you deal with it very thoroughly and consider all the aspects of it.

ext.ext_cn: 吉布森先生显然才智不逮。
ext.ext_en: Mr Gibson is clearly intellectually out of his depth...

ext.ext_cn: 我上学总是很吃力。我讨厌学习，觉得太难了。
ext.ext_en: I'd always struggled at school. I hated it and felt out of my depth.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is out of their depth, you mean that they are in a situation that is much too difficult for them to be able to cope with it.
If you are out of your depth, you are in water that is deeper than you are tall, with the result that you cannot stand up with your head above water.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 哀婉的小提琴声
ext.ext_en: ...plangent violins.

defs.def_en: A plangent sound is a deep, loud sound, which may be sad.

ext.ext_cn: 她那种端庄沉着的非凡气质
ext.ext_en: ...her extraordinary dignity and composure.

defs.def_en: If someone behaves or moves with dignity, they are calm, controlled, and admirable.

ext.ext_cn: 人的高尚感
ext.ext_en: ...the sense of human dignity.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的生命以及情感的完整统一和尊贵庄严
ext.ext_en: ...the integrity and the dignity of our lives and feelings.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the dignity of people or their lives or activities, you mean that they are valuable and worthy of respect.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你错了，那就承认。你不会因此而失去尊严，反而会赢得尊重。
ext.ext_en: If you were wrong, admit it. You won't lose dignity, but will gain respect...

ext.ext_cn: 她仍然保持着自己的尊严。
ext.ext_en: She still has her dignity.

defs.def_en: Your dignity is the sense that you have of your own importance and value, and other people's respect for you.

ext.ext_cn: 到他去世的时候，他已经是一位百万富翁了。
ext.ext_en: By the time he died, he was a millionaire.

defs.def_en: A millionaire is a very rich person who has money or property worth at least a million pounds or dollars.

ext.ext_cn: 他们原来在苏格兰西北部有一间小屋。
ext.ext_en: They used to have a cottage in N.W. Scotland...

ext.ext_cn: 姐姐伊冯娜也来到奥克肯登小屋和我一起住了。
ext.ext_en: My sister Yvonne also came to live at Ockenden Cottage with me.

defs.def_en: A cottage is a small house, usually in the country.

defs.def_cn: 降低，减弱，抑制(热情、激动等)

ext.ext_cn: 似乎没有什么能让他那持久的热情消退。
ext.ext_en: Nothing seems to dampen his perpetual enthusiasm...

ext.ext_cn: 我不想扫你的兴，但你是否忽视了几个小的问题呢？
ext.ext_en: I hate to dampen your spirits but aren't you overlooking a couple of minor points.

defs.def_en: To dampen something such as someone's enthusiasm or excitement means to make it less lively or intense.

ext.ext_cn: 她花了点时间弄湿毛巾，洗了把脸。
ext.ext_en: She took the time to dampen a washcloth and do her face.

defs.def_en: If you dampen something, you make it slightly wet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 关于一位女性寻找自我的自传体色彩浓厚的小说
ext.ext_en: ...a highly autobiographical novel of a woman's search for identity.

defs.def_en: An autobiographical piece of writing relates to events in the life of the person who has written it.
A house owner is a person who owns a house.

defs.def_cn: 猴架(供孩子们攀爬玩耍的架子)
defs.def_en: Monkey bars are metal or wooden bars that are joined together to form a structure for children to climb and play on.
A projectile is an object that is fired from a gun or other weapon.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人钦佩的；值得赞赏的

ext.ext_cn: 贝顿是个令人钦佩的人物。
ext.ext_en: Beyton is an admirable character...

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影叙事简练，令人叹服。
ext.ext_en: The film tells its story with admirable economy.

defs.def_en: An admirable quality or action is one that deserves to be praised and admired.

defs.def_cn: (名人)丑闻的传播，丑闻的揭发

ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister accused opposition leaders of muck-raking.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of muck-raking, you are criticizing them for finding and spreading unpleasant or embarrassing information about someone, especially a public figure.

ext.ext_cn: 赫普沃思男装店

ext.ext_cn: 体育服装用品商店
ext.ext_en: ...a sports outfitters.

defs.def_en: also outfitters. An outfitter or an outfitters is a shop that sells clothes and equipment for a specific purpose.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第7个字母
defs.def_en: G is the seventh letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_en: In music, G is the fifth note in the scale of C major.
A G is a unit of measurement of the force resulting from acceleration. One G is equivalent to the force of the earth's gravitational pull.
A G is a thousand pounds or dollars.

defs.def_cn: （用于首字母为 g 的一些单词的缩写，如gram，gallon 和German）

ext.ext_cn: 每100克橙子仅含35卡的热量。
ext.ext_en: Oranges contain only 35 calories per 100g.

defs.def_en: G or g is used as an abbreviation for words beginning with g, such as 'gram', 'gallon', and 'German'.

ext.ext_cn: 总统正因为那件事备受指责。

ext.ext_en: In recent years they have attracted more than their fair share of flak from the press.

defs.def_en: If you get a lot of flak from someone, they criticize you severely. If you take the flak, you get the blame for something.

ext.ext_en: ...her parents' house in Warwickshire.

ext.ext_en: If he set his alarm clock for midnight, it would wake the whole house...

ext.ext_en: So I grew up with that feeling that the man is the head of the house.

defs.def_en: You can refer to all the people who live together in a house as the house .

ext.ext_cn: 年代久远的萨尔茨堡咖啡馆
ext.ext_en: ...an old Salzburg coffee house.

defs.def_en: House is used in the names of types of places where people go to eat and drink.

ext.ext_en: Many of the clothes come from the world's top fashion houses...

ext.ext_en: Eventually she was fired from her job at a publishing house.

defs.def_en: House is used in the names of types of companies, especially ones which publish books, lend money, or design clothes.

defs.def_cn: （用于办公楼、私宅或豪宅名称）大楼，大厦，大宅

ext.ext_en: I was to go to the very top floor of Bush House in Aldwych.

ext.ext_cn: 利兹附近的哈伍德宫
ext.ext_en: ...Harewood House near Leeds.

defs.def_en: House is sometimes used in the names of office buildings and large private homes or expensive houses.

defs.def_cn: （英国）上（或下）议院；（美国）众议院

ext.ext_en: Some members of the House and Senate worked all day yesterday...

ext.ext_en: The Republicans have majorities in both Houses.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the two main bodies of Britain's parliament and the United States of America's legislature as the House or a House.

ext.ext_en: The club is planning a public debate on 'This house believes that journalism has not gained from the introduction of new technology'.

defs.def_en: You can refer to all the people at a debate as the house .

defs.def_cn: （英国学校中为进行体育竞赛等所划分的）组，社

ext.ext_en: He was a prefect and house captain.

defs.def_en: In a British school, a house is a group of children of different ages who compete against other groups in sports and other activities. Each house usually has a name.

defs.def_cn: 贵族;名门望族；（尤指）王室，王族

ext.ext_cn: 沙特王族
ext.ext_en: ...the Saudi Royal House.

ext.ext_cn: 温莎王室
ext.ext_en: ...the House of Windsor.

defs.def_en: A house is a family which has been or will be important for many generations, especially the family of a king or queen.

defs.def_cn: （剧场、影院或其他娱乐场所的）观众席;全体观众

ext.ext_cn: 他们的演出座无虚席。
ext.ext_en: They played in front of a packed house.

defs.def_en: The house is the part of a theatre, cinema, or other place of entertainment where the audience sits. You can also refer to the audience at a particular performance as the house.

defs.def_cn: （餐馆里的葡萄酒）廉价佐餐的，未列入酒水单的

ext.ext_cn: 特威德点了一瓶佐餐葡萄酒。
ext.ext_en: Tweed ordered a carafe of the house wine.

ext.ext_cn: 一瓶普通红葡萄酒或白葡萄酒
ext.ext_en: ...a bottle of house red or white.

defs.def_en: A restaurant's house wine is the cheapest wine it sells, which is not listed by name on the wine list.

ext.ext_cn: 1985年《住房法案》的第三部分要求地方政府为无家可归者提供住所。
ext.ext_en: Part III of the Housing Act 1985 imposes duties on local authorities to house homeless people...

ext.ext_cn: 很遗憾，我们不得不让住户挤在这些狭小的公寓里。
ext.ext_en: Regrettably we have to house families in these inadequate flats.

defs.def_en: To house someone means to provide a house or flat for them to live in.

ext.ext_cn: 古堡本身对公众开放，并设有一个摩托车和汽车博物馆。
ext.ext_en: The château itself is open to the public and houses a museum of motorcycles and cars...

ext.ext_cn: 多年后，以她的名义建造的寺庙被改造成了罗马铸币厂。
ext.ext_en: Many years later, the temple erected in her name was used to house the Roman mint.

defs.def_en: A building or container that houses something is the place where it is located or from where it operates.

ext.ext_cn: 这座房子里会住12个男孩和8个女孩。
ext.ext_en: The building will house twelve boys and eight girls...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的别墅里现在住着军官。
ext.ext_en: Their villas housed army officers now.

defs.def_en: If you say that a building houses a number of people, you mean that is the place where they live or where they are staying.

defs.def_cn: (人、表演或演讲）博得全场喝彩，引得哄堂大笑

ext.ext_en: It's really an amazing dance. It just always brings the house down.

defs.def_en: If a person or their performance or speech brings the house down, the audience claps, laughs, or shouts loudly because the performance or speech is very impressive or amusing.

defs.def_cn: 很快就打得火热;一见如故;一拍即合
defs.def_en: If two people get on like a house on fire, they quickly become close friends, for example because they have many interests in common.

ext.ext_en: He lives with an aunt who keeps house for him.

defs.def_en: If you keep house, you do the cleaning and cooking for your household, and do not go out to work.

defs.def_en: If you are given something in a restaurant or bar on the house, you do not have to pay for it.

ext.ext_en: Some think Stempel's departure will help the company get its financial house in order...

ext.ext_en: The challenge for American leadership is this: Can we put our economic house in order?...

defs.def_en: If someone gets their house in order ,puts their house in order, or sets their house in order, they arrange their affairs and solve their problems.

ext.ext_cn: 去年他接受了一个扩张心脏动脉的手术。

defs.def_en: If you widen something or if it widens, it becomes greater in measurement from one side or edge to the other.

ext.ext_en: The search for my brother widened...

defs.def_en: If you widen something or if it widens, it becomes greater in range or it affects a larger number of people or things.

defs.def_en: If a difference or gap widens or if something widens it, it becomes greater.

defs.def_en: If the ground or a building is subsiding, it is very slowly sinking to a lower level.

ext.ext_cn: 当地官员称洪水已经退去了。

defs.def_en: If a level of water, especially flood water, subsides, it goes down.

ext.ext_en: They met little resistance from outgunned government troops.

defs.def_en: In a battle, if one army is outgunned, they are in a very weak position because the opposing army has more or better weapons.

defs.def_en: If you are outgunned in a contest, you are beaten because your rival is stronger or better than you.

defs.def_en: A deckchair is a simple chair with a folding frame, and a piece of canvas as the seat and back. Deckchairs are usually used on the beach, on a ship, or in the garden.
Doesn't is the usual spoken form of 'does not'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Biodiesel is fuel made from natural sources such as plant oils, that can be used in diesel engines.

defs.def_en: At a special ceremony or formal dinner, the toastmaster is the person who proposes toasts and introduces the speakers.

defs.def_cn: 感觉官能(即视觉、嗅觉、听觉、触觉、味觉)

ext.ext_cn: 她再度盯着他看，无法相信自己的眼睛和耳朵。
ext.ext_en: She stared at him again, unable to believe the evidence of her senses.

ext.ext_cn: 灵敏的嗅觉
ext.ext_en: ...a keen sense of smell.

defs.def_en: See also:sixth sense;Your senses are the physical abilities of sight, smell, hearing, touch, and taste.

ext.ext_cn: 她可能意识到了我并没有对她全盘托出。
ext.ext_en: She probably sensed that I wasn't telling her the whole story...

ext.ext_cn: 他四下看了看，感觉到有危险。
ext.ext_en: He looks about him, sensing danger...

defs.def_en: If you sense something, you become aware of it or you realize it, although it is not very obvious.

ext.ext_cn: 突然间你就有这样一种感觉：人们正在彼此疏远。
ext.ext_en: Suddenly you got this sense that people were drawing themselves away from each other...

ext.ext_cn: 两边都没有紧迫感。
ext.ext_en: There is no sense of urgency on either side.

defs.def_en: See also:sense of occasion;If you have a sense that something is the case, you think that it is the case, although you may not have firm, clear evidence for this belief.

ext.ext_cn: 当你的孩子在挣扎求生时，你会感到非常内疚。
ext.ext_en: When your child is struggling for life, you feel this overwhelming sense of guilt...

ext.ext_cn: 我们被一种虚假的安全感所麻痹，急切地等着他们回来。
ext.ext_en: Lulled into a false sense of security, we eagerly awaited their return.

defs.def_en: If you have a sense of guilt or relief, for example, you feel guilty or relieved.

ext.ext_cn: 我的正义感被激了起来。
ext.ext_en: My sense of justice was offended...

ext.ext_cn: 我们对所有的这些都要有轻重缓急之分。
ext.ext_en: We must keep a sense of proportion about all this...

defs.def_en: If you have a sense of something such as duty or justice, you are aware of it and believe it is important.

ext.ext_cn: 他有着无可挑剔的节奏感。
ext.ext_en: He has an impeccable sense of timing...

ext.ext_cn: 她穿衣打扮的品位实在糟透了。
ext.ext_en: Her dress sense is appalling.

defs.def_en: See also:sense of humour;Someone who has a sense of timing or style has a natural ability with regard to timing or style. You can also say that someone has a bad sense of timing or style.

defs.def_cn: 理智;头脑;良好的判断力

ext.ext_cn: 在他年纪更轻一些而且还有点头脑的时候

ext.ext_cn: 那种方法不奏效的时候，他们有时会想到要寻求帮助。

defs.def_en: See also:common sense;Sense is the ability to make good judgments and to behave sensibly.

ext.ext_en: There's no sense in pretending this doesn't happen...

ext.ext_cn: 试图比竞争对手花更多的钱建一个大得多的维修厂没有什么意义。
ext.ext_en: There's little sense in trying to outspend a competitor with a much larger service factory.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is no sense or little sense in doing something, you mean that it is not a sensible thing to do because nothing useful would be gained by doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 有两个意思的名词
ext.ext_en: ...a noun which has two senses...

ext.ext_cn: 然后她想起来他们对那个词的真正意思一无所知。
ext.ext_en: Then she remembered that they had no mind in any real sense of that word.

defs.def_cn: 从某种意义上说/总的来说。

ext.ext_en: In one sense, the fact that few new commercial buildings can be financed does not matter...

defs.def_en: Sense is used in several expressions to indicate how true your statement is. For example, if you say that something is true in a sense, you mean that it is partly true, or true in one way. If you say that something is true in a general sense, you mean that it is true in a general way.

ext.ext_cn: 他坐在那儿说：“是的，这些数字可以理解。”
ext.ext_en: He was sitting there saying, 'Yes, the figures make sense.'

ext.ext_cn: 现在就都讲得通了。
ext.ext_en: It all makes sense now.

defs.def_en: If something makes sense, you can understand it.

ext.ext_cn: 只要不非得弄懂它的意思，它听上去还是很美的。
ext.ext_en: Provided you didn't try to make sense of it, it sounded beautiful...

ext.ext_en: This is to help her to come to terms with her early upbringing and make sense of past experiences.

defs.def_en: When you make sense of something, you succeed in understanding it.

ext.ext_cn: 自己应该照顾自己。

defs.def_en: If a course of action makes sense, it seems sensible.

ext.ext_en: Eventually the world will come to its senses and get rid of them...

ext.ext_cn: 但愿她的死能让这些人醒悟。
ext.ext_en: May her death bring these people to their senses.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has come to their senses or has been brought to their senses, you mean that they have stopped being foolish and are being sensible again.

ext.ext_en: They looked at me as if I had taken leave of my senses.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone seems to have taken leave of their senses, you mean that they have done or said something very foolish.
If you say that someone talks sense, you mean that what they say is sensible.

defs.def_en: If you have a sense that something is true or get a sense that something is true, you think that it is true.

ext.ext_en: I must have driven past that place thousands of times.

defs.def_en: If you refer to thousands of things or people, you are emphasizing that there are very many of them.

ext.ext_en: The rose is the most romantic of flowers, beloved of poets, singers, and artists.

defs.def_en: Your beloved is the person that you love.

defs.def_en: In former times, a coracle was a simple round rowing boat made of woven sticks covered with animal skins.

defs.def_cn: 暂时看不见的；双眼模糊的；目眩的

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 看不到的；视而不见的；没有意识到的

ext.ext_en: David's good looks and impeccable manners had always made her blind to his faults...

ext.ext_en: Teachers are turning a blind eye to pupils smoking at school, a report reveals today...

ext.ext_cn: 那部电影有一个好莱坞式的美满结局。
