defs.def_en: You can refer to the last part of a book, story, play, or film as the ending, especially when you are considering the way that the story ends.

ext.ext_cn: 常见词尾，如walking一词中的ing
ext.ext_en: ...common word endings, like 'ing' in walking.

defs.def_en: The ending of a word is the last part of it.

defs.def_cn: 作为插入语的；补充说明的

ext.ext_cn: 福克斯正在插入一大段题外话，讲他在该国边境游历的故事。
ext.ext_en: Fox was making a long parenthetical remark about his travels on the border of the country.

defs.def_en: A parenthetical remark or section is put into something written or spoken but is not essential to it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我不能靠画画谋生，至少我可以教别人画画。
ext.ext_en: If I can't make a living at painting, at least I can teach someone else to paint...

ext.ext_cn: 在那些漫长的旅程中我们没有别的事情可做。
ext.ext_en: We had nothing else to do on those long trips...

defs.def_en: You use else after words such as 'anywhere', 'someone', and 'what', to refer in a vague way to another person, place, or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 既然我努力做到诚实，我希望其他所有人也能诚实。
ext.ext_en: As I try to be truthful, I expect everyone else to be truthful...

ext.ext_cn: 和其他所有东西一样，这里的香烟也供应不足。
ext.ext_en: Cigarettes are in short supply, like everything else here.

defs.def_en: You use else after words such as 'everyone', 'everything', and 'everywhere' to refer in a vague way to all the other people, things, or places except the one you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 他肯定是个不错的管子工，要不然他不会那么忙。
ext.ext_en: He must be a good plumber, or else he wouldn't be so busy...

ext.ext_cn: 政府显然没有吸取教训，不然不会把问题处理得那么草率。
ext.ext_en: Evidently no lessons have been learnt or else the government would not have handled the problem so sloppily.

defs.def_en: You use or else after stating a logical conclusion, to indicate that what you are about to say is evidence for that conclusion.

defs.def_cn: （引出不好的结果）否则，要不然

ext.ext_cn: 这次我们真的需要成功，否则人们会开始用异样的眼光看我们。
ext.ext_en: This time we really need to succeed or else people will start giving us funny looks...

ext.ext_cn: 一定要系好安全带，否则会摔出去。
ext.ext_en: Make sure you are strapped in very well, or else you will fall out.

defs.def_en: You use or else to introduce a statement that indicates the unpleasant results that will occur if someone does or does not do something.

defs.def_cn: （表示另外一种可能性）或者，还是，要不

ext.ext_cn: 你要么是个不折不扣的天才，要么就是完全疯了。
ext.ext_en: You are either a total genius or else you must be absolutely raving mad...

ext.ext_cn: 可能有人开车捎了她一程，要不就是她打了辆出租车。
ext.ext_en: It's likely someone gave her a lift, or else that she took a taxi.

defs.def_en: You use or else to introduce the second of two possibilities when you do not know which one is true.

ext.ext_cn: 我最讨厌寒冷。
ext.ext_en: Above all else I hate the cold.

defs.def_en: Above all else is used to emphasize that a particular thing is more important than other things.

defs.def_cn: (表示威胁)否则的话，要不然的话

ext.ext_cn: 规矩点，否则的话，哼！
ext.ext_en: Behave, or else!...

ext.ext_cn: 他让我们纠正错误，否则后果自负。
ext.ext_en: He told us to put it right, or else.

defs.def_en: You say 'or else' after a command to warn someone that if they do not obey, you will be angry and may harm or punish them.

ext.ext_cn: 琼斯开始恐吓并控制保罗。
ext.ext_en: Jones had set out to intimidate and dominate Paul...

ext.ext_cn: 胁迫人们为执政党投票的企图没有成功。
ext.ext_en: Attempts to intimidate people into voting for the governing party did not work.

defs.def_en: If you intimidate someone, you deliberately make them frightened enough to do what you want them to do.

defs.def_cn: 在海上的;发生于海上的

ext.ext_cn: 海上入侵
ext.ext_en: ...a seaborne invasion.

ext.ext_cn: 海上贸易
ext.ext_en: ...seaborne trade.

defs.def_en: Seaborne actions or events take place on the sea in ships.

ext.ext_cn: 我非常想报复。
ext.ext_en: I was sorely tempted to retaliate...

ext.ext_cn: 为了报复，克里斯蒂给他朋友寄了一封长信，细述卡尔完全不称职。
ext.ext_en: Christie retaliated by sending his friend a long letter detailing Carl's utter incompetence...

defs.def_en: If you retaliate when someone harms or annoys you, you do something which harms or annoys them in return.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （因绝望而）孤注一掷的，铤而走险的，拼命的

ext.ext_cn: 需要军队帮助将科索沃人民亟需的食品送抵那里。
ext.ext_en: Troops are needed to help get food into Kosovo where people are in desperate need...

ext.ext_cn: 焦急万分的鲍勃和汉斯把整座房子找了个遍。
ext.ext_en: Desperate with anxiety, Bob and Hans searched the whole house...

defs.def_en: If you are desperate, you are in such a bad situation that you are willing to try anything to change it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们结婚已快4年了，琼非常渴望要个孩子。
ext.ext_en: They'd been married nearly four years and June was desperate to start a family...

ext.ext_cn: 人们极希望他能做点什么。
ext.ext_en: People are desperate for him to do something.

defs.def_en: If you are desperate for something or desperate to do something, you want or need it very much indeed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极困难的;极严重的;极危险的

ext.ext_cn: 印度驻联合国大使说形势非常危急。
ext.ext_en: India's United Nations ambassador said the situation is desperate...

ext.ext_cn: 我决定不在约翰走投无路的时候抛弃他。
ext.ext_en: I decided not to abandon John when he was in such a desperate position.

defs.def_en: A desperate situation is very difficult, serious, or dangerous.

ext.ext_cn: 关于酒店的最可靠信息通常来自曾经去过那里的朋友和熟人。
ext.ext_en: The best information about hotels usually comes from friends and acquaintances who have been there...

ext.ext_cn: 像平常一样，他们是在厨房吃的饭。
ext.ext_en: They ate, as they usually did, in the kitchen...

defs.def_en: If something usually happens, it is the thing that most often happens in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 远足后，她比平时感觉更饿。
ext.ext_en: She felt more than usually hungry after her excursion...

ext.ext_cn: 工作上的问题使他异常沮丧。
ext.ext_en: He was more than usually depressed by problems at work.

defs.def_en: You use more than usually to show that something shows even more of a particular quality than it normally does.

ext.ext_cn: 我受过芭蕾舞训练。
ext.ext_en: I trained as a ballet dancer...

ext.ext_cn: 她也热衷于芭蕾舞。
ext.ext_en: She is also keen on the ballet.

defs.def_en: Ballet is a type of very skilled and artistic dancing with carefully planned movements.

ext.ext_cn: 三段新编芭蕾舞将在演出中首演。
ext.ext_en: The performance will include the premiere of three new ballets.

defs.def_en: A ballet is an artistic work that is performed by ballet dancers.
The petrol tank in a motor vehicle is the container for petrol.

defs.def_cn: （照顾病人或老人的）家务帮工
defs.def_en: A home help is a person who is employed to visit sick or old people at home and help with their cleaning or cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 大楼主体的斜墙给人造成一种视错觉。
ext.ext_en: Sloping walls on the bulk of the building create an optical illusion.

defs.def_en: An optical illusion is something that tricks your eyes so that what you think you see is different from what is really there.
A boulder is a large rounded rock.
In football, a sweeper is a player whose position is behind the main defenders but in front of the goalkeeper.
Women is the plural of woman.

defs.def_cn: （赫然）耸现，耸立；令人惊恐地隐现

ext.ext_cn: 大屋赫然耸现在他们面前。
ext.ext_en: The great house loomed up ahead of them.

defs.def_en: If something looms up, it comes into sight as a tall, unclear shape, often in a frightening way.

defs.def_cn: 数字命理学;数字占卦术

ext.ext_cn: 88是中国数字占卜学中非常幸运的数字。
ext.ext_en: The number eighty-eight is very lucky in Chinese numerology.

defs.def_en: Numerology is the study of particular numbers, such as a person's date of birth, in the belief that they may have special significance in a person's life.
The food value of a particular food is a measure of how good it is for you, based on its level of vitamins, minerals, or calories.

defs.def_cn: （结束于1947年的)英国统治印度的时期

ext.ext_cn: 在英国统治下印度人民的生活状况
ext.ext_en: ...Indian living conditions under the Raj.

defs.def_en: The British Raj was the period of British rule in India which ended in 1947.

ext.ext_cn: 硫化氢
ext.ext_en: ...hydrogen sulphide.

defs.def_en: A sulphide is a compound of sulphur with some other chemical elements.

defs.def_cn: （尤指艺术方面的）半吊子，浅薄涉猎者
defs.def_en: You can use dilettante to talk about someone who seems interested in a subject, especially in art, but who does not really know very much about it.

defs.def_cn: (生物的)自然选择，物竞天择，适者生存

ext.ext_cn: 自然选择确保只有最适应环境的物种得以存活下来，把基因传给下一代。
ext.ext_en: Natural selection ensures only the fittest survive to pass their genes on to the next generation.

defs.def_en: Natural selection is a process by which species of animals and plants that are best adapted to their environment survive and reproduce, while those that are less well adapted die out.

defs.def_cn: 非常宝贵的;极为有用的

ext.ext_cn: 在那一年里我有幸获得了非常宝贵的经验。
ext.ext_en: I was able to gain invaluable experience over that year...

ext.ext_cn: 该调查研究在语言学研究领域的重要性应该会得到证实。
ext.ext_en: The research should prove invaluable in the study of linguistics...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as invaluable, you mean that it is extremely useful.
The prostate or the prostate gland is an organ in the body of male mammals which is situated at the neck of the bladder and produces a liquid which forms part of semen.

ext.ext_cn: 他自己的那些书和回忆录都是掺杂着半真半假的叙述和彻头彻尾的编造的大杂烩。
ext.ext_en: His own books and memoirs are a farrago of half-truth and outright invention.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a farrago, you are critical of it because you think it is a confused mixture of different types of things.

ext.ext_cn: 伊比利亚半岛西北端的小港口
ext.ext_en: ...a small port on the north-western extremity of the Iberian peninsula.

ext.ext_cn: 飞机的末端
ext.ext_en: ...the extremities of the aeroplane.

defs.def_en: The extremity of something is its furthest end or edge.

ext.ext_cn: 他发现手脚变冷了。
ext.ext_en: He found that his extremities grew cold...

ext.ext_cn: 锻炼非常重要，它可以促进血液循环，保持手脚温暖。
ext.ext_en: Exercise is very important as it keeps the circulation moving and warms the extremities.

defs.def_en: Your extremities are the end parts of your body, especially your hands and feet.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管完全与世隔绝，她依然心智健全。
ext.ext_en: In spite of the extremity of her seclusion she was sane...

ext.ext_cn: 过去，这个地区令人生畏的地理条件和极端的天气状况使它受到保护。
ext.ext_en: In the past, the region had been protected by its forbidding geography and the extremities of its climate...

defs.def_en: The extremity of a situation or of someone's behaviour is the degree to which it is severe, unusual, or unacceptable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他人很怪，喜欢戴贝雷帽和墨镜。
ext.ext_en: He is an eccentric character who likes wearing a beret and dark glasses.

ext.ext_cn: 托马斯先生，一个想法怪异的商人
ext.ext_en: ...Mr Thomas, a businessman with eccentric views.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is eccentric, you mean that they behave in a strange way, and have habits or opinions that are different from those of most people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (工作、任务)吃力不讨好的，劳而无功的

ext.ext_cn: 足球裁判的工作吃力不讨好。
ext.ext_en: Soccer referees have a thankless task.

defs.def_en: If you describe a job or task as thankless, you mean that it is hard work and brings very few rewards.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 激烈的；猛烈的；充满敌意的

ext.ext_cn: 第二次世界大战期间激烈的战斗场面
ext.ext_en: ...the scene of bitter fighting during the Second World War.

ext.ext_cn: 对政府支持制造业不力的猛烈抨击
ext.ext_en: ...a bitter attack on the Government's failure to support manufacturing...

defs.def_en: In a bitter argument or conflict, people argue very angrily or fight very fiercely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 据说，她对自己被以如此方式解雇而感到愤愤不平。
ext.ext_en: She is said to be very bitter about the way she was sacked...

ext.ext_cn: 他漫长的一生充满了关于个人生活和政治生涯的苦涩记忆。
ext.ext_en: His long life was marked by bitter personal and political memories.

defs.def_en: If someone is bitter after a disappointing experience or after being treated unfairly, they continue to feel angry about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （经历或感觉）令人非常失望的，痛苦的，辛酸的

ext.ext_cn: 我想这个决定对他是个沉重的打击，从此以后他一蹶不振。
ext.ext_en: I think the decision was a bitter blow from which he never quite recovered...

ext.ext_cn: 大量惨痛的经历让他学会了如何坦然面对失败。
ext.ext_en: A great deal of bitter experience had taught him how to lose gracefully...

defs.def_en: A bitter experience makes you feel very disappointed. You can also use bitter to emphasize feelings of disappointment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 外面，刺骨的东风伴着阵阵小雪。
ext.ext_en: Outside, a bitter east wind was accompanied by flurries of snow.

ext.ext_cn: 在严寒中度过一夜之后
ext.ext_en: ...after spending a night in the bitter cold.

defs.def_en: Bitter weather, or a bitter wind, is extremely cold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些叶子味道相当苦。
ext.ext_en: The leaves taste rather bitter.

ext.ext_cn: 年深日久，酒会褪去辣味，口感变得醇和起来
ext.ext_en: ...as the wine ages, losing its bitter harshness, and becoming softer and smoother.

defs.def_en: A bitter taste is sharp, not sweet, and often slightly unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 一品脱苦啤酒
ext.ext_en: ...a pint of bitter.

defs.def_en: Bitter is a kind of beer that is light brown in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 他说，游击队员会为实现主要目标而战斗到底。
ext.ext_en: The guerrillas would fight to the bitter end, he said, in order to achieve their main goal.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will continue doing something to the bitter end, especially something difficult or unpleasant, you are emphasizing that you will continue doing it until it is completely finished.

defs.def_cn: 奸诈;欺骗;口是心非;两面派

ext.ext_cn: 马尔科姆认为他在为其私底下两面派的行为而心生愧疚。
ext.ext_en: Malcolm believed he was guilty of duplicity in his private dealings.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of duplicity, you mean that they are deceitful.
A man's lady friend is the woman with whom he is having a romantic or sexual relationship.

ext.ext_cn: 美国东北部海岸
ext.ext_en: ...the north-eastern coast of the United States.

defs.def_en: North-eastern means in or from the north-east of a region or country.

ext.ext_cn: 英国电力牵引公司的股票报收于207便士，比报出价格略涨1.5便士。
ext.ext_en: BET shares closed just above the offer price, up 1.5p at 207p.

defs.def_en: See also:asking price;bid price;The offer price for a particular stock or share is the price that the person selling it says that they want for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经在努力消灭疟疾、破伤风等疾病。
ext.ext_en: They are already battling to eradicate illnesses such as malaria and tetanus...

ext.ext_cn: 如果可以消灭那些单调乏味的工作，世界将会变得更加美好。
ext.ext_en: If tedious tasks could be eradicated, the world would be a much better place.

defs.def_en: To eradicate something means to get rid of it completely.

defs.def_cn: （因行为或成就而获得的）荣誉，赞誉，名声

ext.ext_cn: 因其待客方式受到好评的新的连锁酒店
ext.ext_en: ...a new hotel chain that has won kudos for the way it treats guests.

defs.def_en: Kudos is admiration or recognition that someone or something gets as a result of a particular action or achievement.

defs.def_cn: （艺术家、作家和音乐家等的）赞助人，资助人

ext.ext_cn: 叶卡捷琳娜大帝资助发展艺术和科学。
ext.ext_en: Catherine the Great was a patron of the arts and sciences.

defs.def_en: A patron is a person who supports and gives money to artists, writers, or musicians.

defs.def_cn: （允许慈善机构、团体和活动等使用自己的名字作宣传的）代言人，名义赞助人

ext.ext_cn: 菲奥娜和阿拉斯泰尔已经成为国家失踪人口服务热线的代言人。
ext.ext_en: Fiona and Alastair have become patrons of the National Missing Person's Helpline.

defs.def_en: The patron of a charity, group, or campaign is an important person who allows his or her name to be used for publicity.

ext.ext_cn: 他在萨沃伊酒店过了夜：和许多顾客一样，他无法抗拒精美的英式菜肴。
ext.ext_en: He spent the night at the Savoy: like so many of its patrons, he could not resist the exclusively English cooking.

defs.def_en: The patrons of a place such as a pub, bar, or hotel are its customers.

ext.ext_cn: 现任欧洲重量级拳击冠军
ext.ext_en: ...the reigning European heavyweight champ...

ext.ext_cn: 他谦逊地说，念中学时他曾经是游泳冠军。
ext.ext_en: He had been, he said modestly, swimming champ at high school.

defs.def_en: A champ is the same as a champion .

defs.def_cn: 无约束的；放肆的；放纵的

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪80年代贪得无厌的社会风气
ext.ext_en: ...the unbridled greed of the 1980s.

ext.ext_cn: 关于纵情乱性的故事
ext.ext_en: ...a tale of lust and unbridled passion.

defs.def_en: If you describe behaviour or feelings as unbridled, you mean that they are not controlled or limited in any way.
See also:multiple sclerosis;Sclerosis is a medical condition in which a part inside your body becomes hard.

defs.def_cn: （常指流向大海的）排水口，排污口，渠河口

ext.ext_cn: 冬季时大群大群的海鸥会聚集在垃圾场和排污口。
ext.ext_en: During the winter months, great flocks of gulls gather at rubbish tips and sewage outfalls.

defs.def_en: An outfall is a place where water or waste flows out of a drain, often into the sea.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是一个务实、理智的女人。
ext.ext_en: She was a practical, unsentimental woman...

ext.ext_cn: 他们理智看待自己给员工所带来的影响。
ext.ext_en: They are unsentimental about their impact on employees.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as unsentimental, you mean that they do not allow emotions like pity or affection to interfere with their work or decisions.

ext.ext_cn: 这家航空公司还未获得飞越坦桑尼亚领空的许可。
ext.ext_en: Permission has not yet been granted for the airline to overfly Tanzania.

defs.def_en: When an aircraft overflies an area, it flies over it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他穿着短裤，膝盖的伤口已经结痂。
ext.ext_en: He had short trousers and scabby knees.

defs.def_en: If a person, an animal, or a part of their body is scabby, it has scabs on it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的政治活动包括竞争团体间反复多变的打压行动。
ext.ext_en: Their politics consisted of unstable power-plays between rival groups.

defs.def_en: A power play is an attempt to gain an advantage by showing that you are more powerful than another person or organization, for example in a business relationship or negotiation.

defs.def_cn: （冰球比赛中的）以多打少局面
defs.def_en: In a game of ice hockey, power play is a period of time when one team has more players because one or more of the other team is in the penalty box.

defs.def_cn: 反向工程，逆向工程，倒序制造（指研究产品或系统结构以进行仿制）

ext.ext_cn: 施乐公司展开了一项逆向工程。他们把日本的机器拆开，调查了日本的工厂以弄清楚他们如何能生产出如此了不起的产品。
ext.ext_en: Xerox set about a process of reverse engineering. It pulled the machines apart and investigated the Japanese factories to find out how they could pull off such feats.

defs.def_en: Reverse engineering is a process in which a product or system is analysed in order to see how it works, so that a similar version of the product or system can be produced more cheaply.

ext.ext_cn: 英镑价值的大幅下跌
ext.ext_en: ...a substantial slippage in the value of sterling...

ext.ext_cn: 我们想要止住公共服务质量下滑的局面。
ext.ext_en: We want to stop the slippage of the quality of public services.

defs.def_en: Slippage is a failure to maintain a steady position or rate of progress, so that a particular target or standard is not achieved.

ext.ext_cn: 学校经常安排孩子们去海滩上博物学课。
ext.ext_en: Schools regularly bring children to the beach for natural history lessons.

defs.def_en: Natural history is the study of animals and plants and other living things.

defs.def_cn: (通常设在贫困地区，以特色资源吸引外地学生就学，以提高学校业绩的)磁力学校，特色学校
defs.def_en: A magnet school is a state-funded school, usually in a poor area, which is given extra resources in order to attract new pupils from other areas and help improve the school's performance.
A biography of someone is an account of their life, written by someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 一册传记和评论文章
ext.ext_en: ...a volume of biography and criticism.

defs.def_en: Biography is the branch of literature which deals with accounts of people's lives.

defs.def_cn: 鼓舞士气的事物;振奋精神的事情

ext.ext_cn: 这次获胜是一次巨大的精神鼓舞。
ext.ext_en: This win has been a great morale booster.

defs.def_en: You can refer to something that makes people feel more confident and cheerful as a morale booster .

defs.def_cn: （尤指17和18世纪侵掠西班牙船只的）海盗
defs.def_en: A buccaneer was a pirate, especially one who attacked and stole from Spanish ships in the 17th and 18th centuries.
If you describe someone as a buccaneer, you mean that they are clever and successful, especially in business, but you do not completely trust them.

ext.ext_cn: 几天来这里一直有一种满怀期待的气氛。
ext.ext_en: There's been an atmosphere of anticipation around here for a few days now...

ext.ext_cn: 我们殷切期盼着这本精装版下一卷的面世。
ext.ext_en: We await the next volume of this superb edition with keen anticipation.

defs.def_en: Anticipation is a feeling of excitement about something pleasant or exciting that you know is going to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 因料到在有组织的大罢工期间可能会出现骚乱，菲律宾的军队已进入全面戒备状态。
ext.ext_en: Troops in the Philippines have been put on full alert in anticipation of trouble during a planned general strike.

defs.def_en: If something is done in anticipation of an event, it is done because people believe that event is going to happen.

defs.def_cn: (通常由女性演唱的)感伤恋歌
defs.def_en: A torch song is a sentimental popular song about love, usually sung by a woman.

defs.def_cn: 火灾中受损物品的拍卖(或甩卖)
defs.def_en: A fire sale is an event in which goods are sold cheaply because the shop or storeroom they were in has been damaged by fire.

ext.ext_cn: 他们可能会举行清仓大甩卖。
ext.ext_en: They're likely to hold big fire sales to liquidate their inventory...

ext.ext_cn: 专家说以目前的贱价出售根本不划算。
ext.ext_en: Experts say it's just not worth selling out at current fire-sale prices.

defs.def_en: If you describe a sale of goods or other assets as a fire sale, you mean that everything is being sold very cheaply.
Venison is the meat of a deer.

ext.ext_cn: 他拍的照片时机掌握完美，记录下了动人的快乐瞬间。
ext.ext_en: His photo is a wonderful happy moment caught with perfect timing...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你时机把握得好，你会幸运地撞上某个乡村节日。
ext.ext_en: If your timing is right, you may be fortunate enough to stumble across a village fiesta.

defs.def_en: Timing is the skill or action of judging the right moment in a situation or activity at which to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 但是，部长访问的时间安排不当，可能会使访问的善意不能得到有效传达。
ext.ext_en: The timing of the minister's visit, however, could somewhat detract from the goodwill it's supposed to generate.

defs.def_en: Timing is used to refer to the time at which something happens or is planned to happen, or to the length of time that something takes.
An aviary is a large cage or covered area in which birds are kept.
Cough medicine is liquid medicine that you take when you have a cough.

defs.def_cn: (尤指西班牙或拉丁美洲的)宗教节日，狂欢节日
defs.def_en: A fiesta is a time of public entertainment and parties, usually on a special religious holiday, especially in Spain or Latin America.

defs.def_cn: （由对某主题感兴趣的人而非专业人员编写的）爱好者杂志
defs.def_en: A zine is a magazine about a particular subject, written by people who are interested in that subject rather than by professional journalists.
Cinnamon is a sweet spice used for flavouring food.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他拖着脚在硬木地板上走动。
ext.ext_en: He shuffled his feet on the hard wooden floor...

ext.ext_cn: 一个冰冷梆硬的东西顶在了他的脖梗儿上。
ext.ext_en: Something cold and hard pressed into the back of his neck.

defs.def_en: Something that is hard is very firm and stiff to touch and is not easily bent, cut, or broken.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 很难说最近这次行动会有什么结果。
ext.ext_en: It's hard to tell what effect this latest move will have...

ext.ext_cn: 她发现某些针对自己和自己工作的批评意见很难接受。
ext.ext_en: She found it hard to accept some of the criticisms directed towards her and her work...

defs.def_en: Something that is hard is very difficult to do or deal with.

ext.ext_cn: 我会努力工作，我不想让他失望。
ext.ext_en: I'll work hard. I don't want to let him down...

ext.ext_cn: 我是不是努力过头了？
ext.ext_en: Am I trying too hard?

defs.def_en: If you work hard doing something, you are very active or work intensely, with a lot of effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 照顾3个宝宝是非常累人的活儿。
ext.ext_en: Coping with three babies is very hard work...

ext.ext_cn: 一天的辛苦工作
ext.ext_en: ...a hard day's work...

defs.def_en: Hard work involves a lot of activity and effort.

ext.ext_cn: 他使劲盯着我看。
ext.ext_en: He looked at me hard...

ext.ext_cn: 你要仔细听才能听见老人的呼吸声。
ext.ext_en: You had to listen hard to hear the old man breathe...

defs.def_en: If you look, listen, or think hard, you do it carefully and with a great deal of attention.

ext.ext_cn: 我狠狠地踢了一脚垃圾箱，结果脚趾骨折了。
ext.ext_en: I kicked a dustbin very hard and broke my toe.

ext.ext_cn: 他用力推了她一下，她就向后跌坐在一把扶手椅里。
ext.ext_en: He gave her a hard push which toppled her backwards into an armchair.

defs.def_en: If you strike or take hold of something hard, you strike or take hold of it with a lot of force.

defs.def_cn: 强烈地;猛烈的;长时间地

ext.ext_cn: 我从未见过特里如此放声大笑。
ext.ext_en: I've never seen Terry laugh so hard...

ext.ext_cn: 当时雪下得很大。
ext.ext_en: It was snowing hard by then.

defs.def_en: You can use hard to indicate that something happens intensely and for a long time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的父亲是个冷酷无情的人。
ext.ext_en: His father was a hard man...

ext.ext_cn: 凯特意识到玛吉原先的那副冷酷表情其实是装出来的。
ext.ext_en: Kate realized that the previous hard look on Maggie's face had been a mask.

defs.def_en: If a person or their expression is hard, they show no kindness or sympathy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 苛刻的;严厉的;不友善的

ext.ext_cn: 别对他太苛刻了。
ext.ext_en: Don't be so hard on him.

ext.ext_cn: 他说安全部队会继续严厉镇压抗议者。
ext.ext_en: He said the security forces would continue to crack down hard on the protestors.

defs.def_en: If you are hard on someone, you treat them severely or unkindly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 光线暗淡对眼睛不利。
ext.ext_en: The grey light was hard on the eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 过去的这四年里他们吃了不少苦。
ext.ext_en: These last four years have been hard on them.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is hard on a person or thing, you mean it affects them in a way that is likely to cause them damage or suffering.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （生活、一段日子）艰难的，艰苦的

ext.ext_cn: 对她而言，那是一段非常艰苦的生活。
ext.ext_en: It had been a hard life for her...

ext.ext_cn: 那些岁月是非常艰难的。
ext.ext_en: Those were hard times.

defs.def_en: If you have a hard life or a hard period of time, your life or that period is difficult and unpleasant for you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 漫长的强霜冻期
ext.ext_en: ...a prolonged period of hard frost...

ext.ext_cn: 我估计冬天会漫长而寒冷。
ext.ext_en: I am expecting a long, hard winter.

defs.def_en: A hard winter or a hard frost is a very cold one.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （颜色）刺目的，晃眼的;（声音）刺耳的，难听的

ext.ext_cn: 大海呈一片耀眼的蓝色。
ext.ext_en: The sea was a hard blue.

defs.def_en: Hard colours or sounds are harsh or bright and unpleasant to see or hear.

ext.ext_cn: 他想要更多确凿的证据。
ext.ext_en: He wanted more hard evidence...

ext.ext_cn: 有关亨利·普赛尔生平的可靠资料可能比任何其他文艺复兴以来的伟大作曲家都要少。
ext.ext_en: There are probably fewer hard facts about the life of Henry Purcell than that of any other great composer since the Renaissance.

defs.def_en: Hard evidence or facts are definitely true and do not need to be questioned.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （水质）硬的（指含钙化合物较多）
defs.def_en: Hard water contains a lot of calcium compounds that stop soap making bubbles and sometimes appear as a deposit in kettles and baths.
Hard drugs are very strong illegal drugs such as heroin or cocaine.
In phonetics, a hard sound is one such as 'c' or 'g' as pronounced in the words 'cat' or 'give', and not as in the words 'cinema' or 'general'.

ext.ext_cn: 天堂街是火车站附近一条拥挤的小街道，离该工厂很近。
ext.ext_en: Paradise Street was a short, crowded street near the railway station and hard by the factory.

defs.def_en: If one thing is hard by another, it is very close to it.

defs.def_cn: 受到不公平待遇的;委屈的

ext.ext_cn: 酒店行李搬运工因为被迫延长当班时间而愤愤不平。
ext.ext_en: The hall porter was feeling hard done by at having to extend his shift.

defs.def_en: If you feel hard done by, you feel that you have not been treated fairly.

ext.ext_cn: 会谈从一开始就举步维艰。
ext.ext_en: The talks had been hard going at the start.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is hard going, you mean it is difficult and requires a lot of effort.

defs.def_cn: 受到沉重打击的;受严重影响的

ext.ext_cn: 加利福尼亚受经济衰退的影响尤为严重。
ext.ext_en: California's been particularly hard hit by the recession.

defs.def_en: To be hard hit by something means to be affected very severely by it.

defs.def_cn: 佯装不感兴趣;故意摆谱

ext.ext_cn: 我想得到她，但她却故意装出不感兴趣的样子。
ext.ext_en: I wanted her and she was playing hard to get.

defs.def_en: If someone plays hard to get, they pretend not to be interested in another person or in what someone is trying to persuade them to do.

defs.def_cn: 十分困难的;处于困境的

ext.ext_cn: 莫顿先生无疑比柯克比先生更聪明，但他将很难像柯克比先生那样受人欢迎。
ext.ext_en: Mr Morton is undoubtedly cleverer than Mr Kirkby, but he will be hard put to match his popularity.

defs.def_en: If someone is hard put to do something or, in British English if they are hard pushed to do something, they have great difficulty doing it.

defs.def_cn: 为…而非常苦恼（或难受）；因…而沮丧

ext.ext_cn: 可能我真的对此事太过耿耿于怀。
ext.ext_en: Maybe I just took it too hard.

defs.def_en: If you take something hard, you are very upset or depressed by it.
In weaving, the weft of a piece of cloth is the threads which are passed sideways across the other threads.
A foundation course is a course that you do at some colleges and universities in order to prepare yourself for a longer or more advanced course.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不是每个人都对未来如此悲观。
ext.ext_en: Not everyone is so pessimistic about the future...

ext.ext_cn: 哈代由于对生活持过度悲观的态度而常常受到批评。
ext.ext_en: Hardy has often been criticised for an excessively pessimistic view of life.

defs.def_en: Someone who is pessimistic thinks that bad things are going to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉用拳头做了一个威胁性的动作。
ext.ext_en: Sarah made a menacing gesture with her fist...

ext.ext_cn: 他摊开双手，明确表示他已如释重负。
ext.ext_en: He throws his hands open in a gesture which clearly indicates his relief.

defs.def_en: A gesture is a movement that you make with a part of your body, especially your hands, to express emotion or information.

defs.def_cn: （表明态度或意图的）姿态，表示

ext.ext_cn: 他对政府致力和平的承诺提出质疑，并呼吁政府做出友好的表示。
ext.ext_en: He questioned the government's commitment to peace and called on it to make a gesture of good will...

ext.ext_cn: 没有比将某人姓名文到身上更绝妙的示爱方式了。
ext.ext_en: There's not greater gesture of love than having someone's name tattooed on your body...

defs.def_en: A gesture is something that you say or do in order to express your attitude or intentions, often something that you know will not have much effect.

defs.def_cn: 打手势；用手势表示；用动作示意

ext.ext_cn: 我朝船库方向示意，他便往里面瞧了瞧。
ext.ext_en: I gestured towards the boathouse, and he looked inside...

ext.ext_cn: 他举手投足之间流露出舞者的优雅。
ext.ext_en: He gestures, gesticulates, and moves with the grace of a dancer.

defs.def_en: If you gesture, you use movements of your hands or head in order to tell someone something or draw their attention to something.

defs.def_cn: （尤指政治上故意将危险局势推至极限的）边缘政策，冒险政策

ext.ext_cn: 最新的进展涉及许多政治冒险政策的推行。
ext.ext_en: There is a lot of political brinkmanship involved in this latest development.

defs.def_en: Brinkmanship is a method of behaviour, especially in politics, in which you deliberately get into dangerous situations which could result in disaster but which could also bring success.

ext.ext_cn: 多数孩子从未见过海。
ext.ext_en: Most of the kids have never seen the sea...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的交通活动，无论是通过海路、铁路还是公路，都时刻受到密切监视。
ext.ext_en: All transport operations, whether by sea, rail or road, are closely monitored at all times.

defs.def_en: The sea is the salty water that covers about three-quarters of the earth's surface.

ext.ext_cn: 他在汹涌的海浪中挣扎了 30 分钟后淹死了。
ext.ext_en: He drowned after 30 minutes in the rough seas...

ext.ext_cn: 海水的温度越往南越高。
ext.ext_en: The seas are warm further south.

defs.def_en: You use seas when you are describing the sea at a particular time or in a particular area.

ext.ext_cn: 北海
ext.ext_en: ...the North Sea.

ext.ext_cn: 图尔卡纳浩瀚的内陆海
ext.ext_en: ...the huge inland sea of Turkana.

defs.def_en: A sea is a large area of salty water that is part of an ocean or is surrounded by land.

ext.ext_cn: 他们下面是无数张仰望的脸。
ext.ext_en: Down below them was the sea of upturned faces...

ext.ext_cn: 他扫了一眼满桌的瓶子和玻璃杯。
ext.ext_en: His eyes ran over the sea of bottles and glasses on the table.

defs.def_en: A sea of people or things is a very large number of them together.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你从没看过电视广告，你就搞不懂什么是大众文化。
ext.ext_en: If you had never seen a telly ad, you would be all at sea with popular culture.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone is all at sea when they are in a state of confusion or uncertainty.

ext.ext_cn: 这些船只每次在海上平均航行 10 天。
ext.ext_en: The boats remain at sea for an average of ten days at a time...

ext.ext_cn: 他的尸体在离加那利群岛不远的海上被发现。
ext.ext_en: His body was found at sea in waters off the Canary Islands.

defs.def_en: At sea means on or under the sea, far away from land.

ext.ext_cn: 每次出海两周的渔夫们
ext.ext_en: ...fishermen who go to sea for two weeks at a time...

ext.ext_cn: 他指向大海。
ext.ext_en: He pointed out to sea.

defs.def_en: If you go or look out to sea, you go or look across the sea.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不受欢迎的；不良的；有害的

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀被认为是有害的，因为它会对收入分配产生不利影响。
ext.ext_en: Inflation is considered to be undesirable because of its adverse effects on income distribution...

ext.ext_cn: 一大群不受欢迎的陌生人不请自来，搅了她的聚会。
ext.ext_en: A large group of undesirable strangers crashed her party.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as undesirable, you think they will have harmful effects.

defs.def_cn: 不受欢迎的人；不良分子；危险人物

ext.ext_cn: 内政部通常会迅速地将不受欢迎人士驱逐出境。
ext.ext_en: The Home Office is usually quick to deport undesirables.

defs.def_en: Undesirables are people who a particular government considers to be dangerous or a threat to society, and therefore wants to get rid of.

defs.def_cn: 罐装液化气;石油液化气
defs.def_en: Calor gas is gas in liquid form which is sold in special containers so that people can use it in places which are not connected to the gas supply, such as tents or caravans.

ext.ext_cn: 他把卧室房门重重地关上，然后逃跑了。
ext.ext_en: He slammed the bedroom door behind him and fled...

ext.ext_cn: 他逃到了哥斯达黎加以逃避服兵役。
ext.ext_en: He fled to Costa Rica to avoid military service.

defs.def_en: If you flee from something or someone, or flee a person or thing, you escape from them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自然的;正常的;合乎常情的

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人追求开快车的刺激是太正常不过的事情。
ext.ext_en: It is only natural for youngsters to crave the excitement of driving a fast car...

ext.ext_cn: 他怨恨你是很自然的事。
ext.ext_en: It is only natural that he should resent you...

defs.def_en: If you say that it is natural for someone to act in a particular way or for something to happen in that way, you mean that it is reasonable in the circumstances.

defs.def_cn: (行为)出于本性的，生来就有的

ext.ext_cn: 昆虫进食的本能
ext.ext_en: ...the insect's natural instinct to feed...

ext.ext_cn: 我们觉得受到威胁或遭受挫折时本能地会感到气愤。
ext.ext_en: Anger is the natural reaction we experience when we feel threatened or frustrated.

defs.def_en: Natural behaviour is shared by all people or all animals of a particular type and has not been learned.

ext.ext_cn: 她有一种洞察他人动机的天赋。
ext.ext_en: She has a natural ability to understand the motives of others...

ext.ext_cn: 他有做生意的天分。
ext.ext_en: He had a natural flair for business.

defs.def_en: Someone with a natural ability or skill was born with that ability and did not have to learn it.

ext.ext_cn: 他天生就会摆弄各种发动机。
ext.ext_en: He's a natural with any kind of engine...

ext.ext_cn: 事实证明她在镜头前很有表演天赋。
ext.ext_en: She proved to be a natural on camera.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a natural, you mean that they do something very well and very easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻松自如的;不局促的;不做作的

ext.ext_cn: 贝唐的妹妹和她家的其他人一样友好、随意。
ext.ext_en: Bethan's sister was as friendly and natural as the rest of the family...

ext.ext_cn: 汉娜轻松自然的举止消除了她的疑虑，于是她放松了下来。
ext.ext_en: Hannah's natural manner reassured her, and she relaxed.

defs.def_en: If someone's behaviour is natural, they appear to be relaxed and are not trying to hide anything.

defs.def_cn: 非人为的;自然的;天然的

ext.ext_cn: 它称这次台风为韩国多年来最严重的自然灾害。
ext.ext_en: It has called the typhoon the worst natural disaster in South Korea in many years...

ext.ext_cn: 巨型天然港普尔港是船只的避风港。
ext.ext_en: The gigantic natural harbour of Poole is a haven for boats.

defs.def_en: Natural things exist or occur in nature and are not made or caused by people.

defs.def_cn: (父母或子女)亲生的，有血缘关系的

ext.ext_cn: 她和亲生母亲团聚了。
ext.ext_en: She has been reunited with her natural mother...

ext.ext_cn: 他对继子女的关爱和投入不会减少他对亲生孩子的责任。
ext.ext_en: His commitments to the stepchildren will not reduce his obligation to his natural children.

defs.def_en: Someone's natural parent is their biological father or mother, as opposed to an adult who is looking after them or has adopted them. Someone's natural child is their biological son or daughter, as opposed to a child they are looking after or have adopted.

defs.def_cn: (音符)本位音的，标有还原号的

ext.ext_cn: 本位音
ext.ext_en: ...B natural. B

ext.ext_cn: 那个F是本位音还是升半音？
ext.ext_en: Is that F a natural or a sharp?

defs.def_en: In music, a natural note is the ordinary note, not its sharp or flat form.

ext.ext_cn: 根据内政部的调查，你哥哥属正常死亡。
ext.ext_en: According to the Home Office, your brother died of natural causes...

ext.ext_cn: 一名囚犯昨天突然倒下死了，看上去像是正常死亡。
ext.ext_en: A prisoner collapsed and died yesterday, apparently from natural causes.

defs.def_en: If someone dies of or from natural causes, they die because they are ill or old rather than because of an accident or violence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 彬彬有礼的；有教养的；上流社会的；装出绅士派头的

ext.ext_cn: 这是上流社会家庭寻求健康和静谧的场所。
ext.ext_en: It was a place to which genteel families came in search of health and quiet.

ext.ext_cn: 两位举止文雅、嗓音轻柔的少女
ext.ext_en: ...two maiden ladies with genteel manners and voices.

defs.def_en: A genteel person is respectable and well-mannered, and comes or seems to come from a high social class.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 古朴幽静的温彻斯特和奇切斯特
ext.ext_en: ...the genteel towns of Winchester and Chichester.

defs.def_en: A genteel place or area is quiet and traditional, but may also be old-fashioned and dull.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行为、情形等）丢脸的，可耻的，不名誉的

ext.ext_cn: 他们把他扣押了这么长时间，真不光彩。
ext.ext_en: It's disgraceful that they have detained him for so long...

ext.ext_cn: 我抱怨说他的行为丢人现眼。
ext.ext_en: I complained about his disgraceful behaviour...

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as behaviour or a situation is disgraceful, you disapprove of it strongly, and feel that the person or people responsible should be ashamed of it.

ext.ext_cn: 宇宙大爆炸理论中一些不明晰的概念
ext.ext_en: ...the ideas implicit in Big Bang cosmology.

defs.def_en: A cosmology is a theory about the origin and nature of the universe.
Cosmology is the study of the origin and nature of the universe.
A bullfinch is a type of small European bird. The male has a black head and a pinkish-red breast.

ext.ext_cn: 该部称希望避免强制性裁员。
ext.ext_en: The ministry has said it hopes to avoid compulsory redundancies.

defs.def_en: When there are redundancies, an organization tells some of its employees to leave because their jobs are no longer necessary or because the organization can no longer afford to pay them.

ext.ext_cn: 雇主削减成本的时候，数千名银行雇员面临被解雇的命运。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of bank employees are facing redundancy as their employers cut costs...

ext.ext_cn: 该公司不得不为裁员支付4.72亿英镑的补偿款。
ext.ext_en: The company has had to make redundancy payments of £472 million.

defs.def_en: Redundancy means being made redundant.

defs.def_cn: 身体强壮的；肌肉发达的

ext.ext_cn: 肌肉发达的小伙子
ext.ext_en: ...a brawny young man.

defs.def_en: Someone who is brawny is strong and has big muscles.

ext.ext_cn: 英国作家写的优秀小说少之又少
ext.ext_en: ...the dearth of good fiction by English authors.

defs.def_en: If there is a dearth of something, there is not enough of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她姑姑开的卖女帽的小店
ext.ext_en: ...her aunt's modest millinery shop.

defs.def_en: Millinery is used to refer to women's hats.

defs.def_cn: 特许经营权;专卖权;经销权

ext.ext_cn: 快餐特许经营权
ext.ext_en: ...fast-food franchises...

ext.ext_cn: 建造和经营隧道的特许权
ext.ext_en: ...the franchise to build and operate the tunnel...

defs.def_en: A franchise is an authority that is given by an organization to someone, allowing them to sell its goods or services or to take part in an activity which the organization controls.

ext.ext_cn: 她最近向其他公司出售了公司业务的特许经营权。
ext.ext_en: She has recently franchised her business...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管只有在加利福尼亚才有这项服务，其创立者迈克尔·凯恩表示计划在其他州出售特许经营权。
ext.ext_en: Though the service is available only in California, its founder Michael Cane says he plans to franchise it in other states...

defs.def_en: If a company franchises its business, it sells franchises to other companies, allowing them to sell its goods or services.

ext.ext_cn: 普选权的出现
ext.ext_en: ...the introduction of universal franchise...

ext.ext_cn: 《1867 年改革法》扩大了选举权的范围，使多数男性工人都拥有了该权利。
ext.ext_en: The 1867 Reform Act extended the franchise to much of the male working class.

defs.def_en: Franchise is the right to vote in an election, especially one in which people elect a parliament.

defs.def_cn: 穿着衣服的;穿着整齐的

ext.ext_cn: 他穿戴整齐,鞋都穿好了。
ext.ext_en: He was fully dressed, including shoes...

ext.ext_cn: 他进卧室穿衣服。
ext.ext_en: He went into his bedroom to get dressed.

defs.def_en: If you are dressed, you are wearing clothes rather than being naked or wearing your night clothes. If you get dressed, you put on your clothes.  →see usage note at:wear

ext.ext_cn: 一个穿着黑衣服的瘦高女子
ext.ext_en: ...a tall thin woman dressed in black.

ext.ext_cn: 一个穿着考究的高个男子
ext.ext_en: ...a tall, elegantly dressed man.

defs.def_en: See also:well-dressed;If you are dressed in a particular way, you are wearing clothes of a particular colour or kind.

defs.def_cn: 打扮得引人注目;打扮得花枝招展;衣着光鲜

ext.ext_cn: 一位漂亮孤傲、打扮时髦的金发女郎
ext.ext_en: ...a solitary blonde, beautiful, haughty and dressed to kill.

defs.def_en: If someone is dressed to kill, they are wearing very smart or fashionable clothes because they want people to notice them and think they are attractive.

defs.def_cn: (戏剧、电影)剧本;(电视节目)广播稿

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮在写一个电影剧本。
ext.ext_en: Jenny's writing a film script.

defs.def_en: The script of a play, film, or television programme is the written version of it.

defs.def_cn: 为(电影等)写剧本;为(广播、电视节目)撰稿

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯·卡梅伦，这两部电影的编剧兼导演
ext.ext_en: ...James Cameron, who scripted and directed both films.

defs.def_en: The person who scripts a film or a radio or television play writes it.

defs.def_cn: (一种语言的)书写系统，字母表

ext.ext_cn: 一篇使用阿拉伯字母书写的马来语演讲稿
ext.ext_en: ...a text in the Malay language but written in Arabic script.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a particular system of writing as a particular script .

ext.ext_cn: 没想到会输掉比赛。
ext.ext_en: Losing was not in the script...

ext.ext_cn: 比赛战术是正确的。只是我们没有照部署去打。
ext.ext_en: The game plan was right. We just didn't follow the script.

defs.def_en: If you say that something which has happened is not in the script, or that someone has not followed the script, you mean that something has happened which was not expected or intended to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 帕里什小姐最近在本埠报纸上登了一则广告。
ext.ext_en: Miss Parrish recently placed an advertisement in the local newspaper.

defs.def_en: An advertisement is an announcement in a newspaper, on television, or on a poster about something such as a product, event, or job.

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队今晚为欧洲足球做了一次糟糕的宣传。
ext.ext_en: The England team were a poor advertisement for European football tonight...

ext.ext_cn: 那并不能有效地体现匈牙利新兴的民主意识。
ext.ext_en: That would not be a good advertisement for Hungary's emerging democracy.

defs.def_en: If you say that an example of something is an advertisement for that thing in general, you mean that it shows how good that thing is.

defs.def_cn: 犹太复国运动;犹太复国主义
defs.def_en: Zionism is a movement which was originally concerned with establishing a political and religious state in Palestine for Jewish people, and is now concerned with the development of Israel.

defs.def_cn: 家庭（或家族）的;家庭(或家族)特有的

ext.ext_cn: 杰勒德还承担了更多的家庭责任。
ext.ext_en: Gerard also took on wider familial respon-sibilities.

defs.def_en: Familial means relating to families in general, or typical of a family.

ext.ext_cn: 首相称马歇尔议员为“怪人”。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister called Councillor Marshall 'a crank'...

ext.ext_cn: 他看上去像个怪人。
ext.ext_en: He looked like a crank.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a crank, you think their ideas or behaviour are strange.
A crank is a device that you turn in order to make something move.

defs.def_cn: (尤指用手摇曲柄)转动(或启动)

ext.ext_cn: 司机下车用曲柄去发动汽车。
ext.ext_en: The chauffeur got out to crank the motor.

defs.def_en: If you crank an engine or machine, you make it move or function, especially by turning a handle.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻松愉快的；无忧无虑的

ext.ext_cn: 他们无忧无虑，随时准备享受生活。
ext.ext_en: They were light-hearted and prepared to enjoy life.

defs.def_en: Someone who is light-hearted is cheerful and happy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不严肃的；随便的；为了好玩的

ext.ext_cn: 有很多人或随意或认真地尝试过，想要找到尼斯湖水怪。
ext.ext_en: There have been many attempts, both light-hearted and serious, to locate the Loch Ness Monster.

defs.def_en: Something that is light-hearted is intended to be entertaining or amusing, and not at all serious.

ext.ext_cn: 我每小时收取20美元，另加垫付的现金开支。
ext.ext_en: I charge twenty dollars an hour plus out-of-pocket expenses.

defs.def_en: See also:pocket;Out-of-pocket expenses are those which you pay out of your own money on behalf of someone else, and which are often paid back to you later.

defs.def_cn: 一阵剧痛；突然而强烈的情感

ext.ext_cn: 有一阵子，她为自己那样对他感到内疚。
ext.ext_en: For a moment she felt a pang of guilt about the way she was treating him.

ext.ext_cn: 阵阵饥饿感
ext.ext_en: ...hunger pangs.

defs.def_en: A pang is a sudden strong feeling or emotion, for example of sadness or pain.
Coconut milk is the milky juice inside coconuts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 远处，岛屿轮廓仅依稀可辨。
ext.ext_en: Far away the outline of the island is just discernible...

ext.ext_cn: 自 1975 年以来一直没有一个明朗的大趋势。
ext.ext_en: There has been no discernible overall trend since 1975.

defs.def_en: If something is discernible, you can see it or recognize that it exists.

ext.ext_cn: 他们首先会派一些训练有素的护士来评估每个病人的需求。
ext.ext_en: They will first send in trained nurses to evaluate the needs of the individual situation...

ext.ext_cn: 市场状况难以评价。
ext.ext_en: The market situation is difficult to evaluate.

defs.def_en: If you evaluate something or someone, you consider them in order to make a judgment about them, for example about how good or bad they are.

defs.def_cn: 十四行诗，商籁体诗(全诗共 14 行，每行 10 个音节，有固定的押韵格式)
defs.def_en: A sonnet is a poem that has 14 lines. Each line has 10 syllables, and the poem has a fixed pattern of rhymes.

ext.ext_cn: 这对夫妇在黑黝黝的山坡上艰难跋涉。
ext.ext_en: The couple trudged up the dark mountainside.

defs.def_en: A mountainside is one of the steep sides of a mountain.

ext.ext_cn: 她关掉了咖啡机。
ext.ext_en: She switched off the coffee-machine...

ext.ext_cn: 格拉斯停好车，熄了火。
ext.ext_en: Glass parked the car and switched the engine off.

defs.def_en: If you switch off a light or other electrical device, you stop it working by operating a switch.

defs.def_cn: 失去兴趣;不考虑;不再想着;不再担忧

ext.ext_cn: 谢天谢地，我已经学会了释然，随它去吧。
ext.ext_en: Thankfully, I've learned to switch off and let it go over my head...

ext.ext_cn: 你会发觉需要考虑的事情太多了，想不操心都难。
ext.ext_en: You may find you've got so many things to think about that it's difficult to switch off.

defs.def_en: If you switch off, you stop paying attention or stop thinking or worrying about something.

ext.ext_cn: 这个帮派的成员犯下了数十宗持械抢劫案。
ext.ext_en: The gang members committed dozens of armed robberies...

ext.ext_cn: 这个男子因暴力抢劫而正在服刑。
ext.ext_en: The man was serving a sentence for robbery with violence.

defs.def_en: Robbery is the crime of stealing money or property from a bank, shop, or vehicle, often by using force or threats.
A maiden aunt is an aunt who is not married.

defs.def_cn: 刺激的;欢闹的;令人兴奋的;热情洋溢的

ext.ext_cn: 有大量特效的精彩刺激的电影
ext.ext_en: ...a rip-roaring movie with a great array of special effects.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as rip-roaring, you mean that it is very exciting and full of energy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 商品自由交换惠泽八方。
ext.ext_en: Free exchange of goods was advantageous to all.

ext.ext_cn: 以非常优惠的价格购买一套工具的机会
ext.ext_en: ...an opportunity to purchase a set of tools at very advantageous prices.

defs.def_en: If something is advantageous to you, it is likely to benefit you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不诚恳的;不坦率的;狡猾的

ext.ext_cn: 称这是艺术瑰宝是言不由衷。
ext.ext_en: It would be disingenuous to claim that this is great art.

defs.def_en: Someone who is disingenuous is slightly dishonest and insincere in what they say.

defs.def_cn: 网络搜索器，网络爬虫(借用户上网之际收集信息的计算机程序)
defs.def_en: A crawler is a computer program that visits websites and collects information when you do an Internet search.

defs.def_cn: (通常置于台、架上的)小雕像，小雕塑
defs.def_en: A statuette is a very small sculpture of a person or an animal which is often displayed on a shelf or stand.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 背信弃义的；不可信的；不忠的

ext.ext_cn: 他们将从背信弃义的侵略者的尸体上踏过。
ext.ext_en: Their feet will trample on the dead bodies of their perfidious aggressors.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as perfidious, you mean that they have betrayed someone or cannot be trusted.

defs.def_cn: 使年轻;使恢复青春;使恢复活力

ext.ext_cn: 有人建议雪莱去意大利，那里的天气会使他恢复活力。
ext.ext_en: Shelley was advised that the Italian climate would rejuvenate him...

ext.ext_cn: 当就要离开这里返回文明世界时，我们俩都觉得恢复了活力。
ext.ext_en: When it was time to leave and return to civilization we both felt rejuvenated...

defs.def_en: If something rejuvenates you, it makes you feel or look young again.

defs.def_cn: 使（组织、制度等）恢复活力;使更有效率

ext.ext_cn: 政府大力推行改造内城贫民区的计划。
ext.ext_en: The government pushed through schemes to rejuvenate the inner cities...

ext.ext_cn: 他们应该侧重于修整现有的绿化植被，比如草和灌木。
ext.ext_en: They should concentrate on rejuvenating the existing vegetation, like grass and shrubs.

defs.def_en: If you rejuvenate an organization or system, you make it more lively and more efficient, for example by introducing new ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 参观酒窖前，游客们先观看了有声的视频介绍。
ext.ext_en: Visitors are shown an audio-visual presentation before touring the cellars.

defs.def_en: Audio-visual equipment and materials involve both recorded sound and pictures.

ext.ext_cn: 夜间，山谷那头的遥远村落里灯光闪闪。
ext.ext_en: At night, lights twinkle in distant villages across the valleys.

ext.ext_cn: 一串闪闪发光的钻石
ext.ext_en: ...a band of twinkling diamonds.

defs.def_en: If a star or a light twinkles, it shines with an unsteady light which rapidly and constantly changes from bright to faint.

defs.def_cn: (因感到有趣或高兴而眼睛)闪亮，发光

ext.ext_cn: 她看到母亲眼中闪烁着喜悦的光芒。
ext.ext_en: She saw her mother's eyes twinkle with amusement.

ext.ext_cn: 她的目光变得友善起来。
ext.ext_en: A kindly twinkle came into her eyes.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's eyes twinkle, you mean that their face expresses good humour or amusement.

defs.def_cn: （受雇于组织机构的）新闻发布官，新闻发言人

ext.ext_cn: 巴伐利亚政府的新闻发布官
ext.ext_en: ...the Press Officer of the Bavarian Government.

defs.def_en: A press officer is a person who is employed by an organization to give information about that organization to the press.
A churn is a container which is used for making butter.

defs.def_cn: 搅动，搅起，扰动(水、泥浆、灰尘)

ext.ext_cn: 渡船搅起豪湾的海水，从兰代尔驶向霍斯舒湾。
ext.ext_en: Ferries churn the waters of Howe Sound from Langdale to Horseshoe Bay.

ext.ext_cn: 如今被一年一度的雨季搅得非常泥泞的土路面
ext.ext_en: ...unsurfaced roads now churned into mud by the annual rains.

defs.def_en: If something churns water, mud, or dust, it moves it about violently.

ext.ext_cn: 我站起来时胃里直翻腾。
ext.ext_en: My stomach churned as I stood up...

ext.ext_cn: 我并不喜欢胃里翻江倒海的，但是要想赢得锦标赛，就得闯过这一关。
ext.ext_en: I don't enjoy having a churning stomach but if you are going to win tournaments, you must go through it.

defs.def_en: If you say that your stomach is churning, you mean that you feel sick. You can also say that something churns your stomach.

ext.ext_cn: 我知道她的婚姻存在一些根本性的问题，早在一年前她就向我倾诉过。
ext.ext_en: I knew she had some fundamental problems in her marriage because she had confided in me a year earlier...

ext.ext_cn: 他向我诉说他觉得自己像是在受罚。
ext.ext_en: He confided to me that he felt like he was being punished...

defs.def_en: If you confide in someone, you tell them a secret.

defs.def_cn: (根据错误信息进行的)徒劳寻找，白费力气的追逐

ext.ext_cn: 哈里疑心波茨故意让他白费力气地瞎找一通。
ext.ext_en: Harry wondered if Potts had deliberately sent him on a wild goose chase.

defs.def_en: If you are on a wild goose chase, you waste a lot of time searching for something that you have little chance of finding, because you have been given incorrect information.

ext.ext_cn: 他醉酒时有点讨厌。
ext.ext_en: He could be a bit of a nuisance when he was drunk...

ext.ext_cn: 抱歉添麻烦了。
ext.ext_en: Sorry to be a nuisance.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is a nuisance, you mean that they annoy you or cause you a lot of problems.

ext.ext_cn: 广告代理公司正逐渐丧失曾经对品牌营销的有力控制。
ext.ext_en: Advertising agencies are losing their once-powerful grip on brand marketing.

defs.def_en: An advertising agency is a company whose business is to create advertisements for other companies or organizations.

ext.ext_cn: 该运动的势头越来越猛。
ext.ext_en: This campaign is really gaining momentum...

ext.ext_cn: 他们每个人都迫切希望能一直劲头十足地去寻求解决方案。
ext.ext_en: They are each anxious to maintain the momentum of the search for a solution.

defs.def_en: If a process or movement gains momentum, it keeps developing or happening more quickly and keeps becoming less likely to stop.
In physics, momentum is the mass of a moving object multiplied by its speed in a particular direction.

defs.def_cn: (常指军队的)徽章,标志,识别符号

ext.ext_cn: 红星曾是苏联的国家标志。
ext.ext_en: The red star was the national insignia of the USSR.

defs.def_en: An insignia is a design or symbol which shows that a person or object belongs to a particular organization, often a military one.

ext.ext_cn: 每年参观这个县的人多达500万。
ext.ext_en: Up to five million people a year visit the county...

ext.ext_cn: 1999年的利润超过了1亿英镑。
ext.ext_en: Profits for 1999 topped £100 million.

defs.def_en: A million or one million is the number 1,000,000.

defs.def_cn: 数百万的；大量的；数不清的;不计其数的

ext.ext_cn: 无数家庭通过电视收看了这个节目。
ext.ext_en: The programme was viewed on television in millions of homes.

ext.ext_cn: 这场悲惨的战争为无数人带来了不幸。
ext.ext_en: This wretched war has brought misery to millions.

defs.def_en: If you talk about millions of people or things, you mean that there is a very large number of them but you do not know or do not want to say exactly how many.

defs.def_cn: 使士气低落;使失去信心;使泄气

ext.ext_cn: 很明显，目标之一就是要用一切可能的手段打击敌军的士气。
ext.ext_en: Clearly, one of the objectives is to demoralize the enemy troops in any way they can.

defs.def_en: If something demoralizes someone, it makes them lose so much confidence in what they are doing that they want to give up.

ext.ext_cn: 缺乏维生素 B 的饮食
ext.ext_en: ...a diet deficient in vitamin B.

ext.ext_cn: 素食者可能会缺铁。
ext.ext_en: Vegetarians can become iron-deficient.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is deficient in a particular thing, they do not have the full amount of it that they need in order to function normally or work properly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有缺点的;有缺陷的;不完善的

ext.ext_cn: 存在缺陷的降落系统
ext.ext_en: ...deficient landing systems.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is deficient is not good enough for a particular purpose.
A woman's ovaries are the two organs in her body that produce eggs.

ext.ext_cn: 脱毛膏
ext.ext_en: ...a depilatory cream.

defs.def_en: Depilatory substances and processes remove unwanted hair from your body.
A depilatory is a depilatory substance.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 耗时费力的；辛苦的；艰难的

ext.ext_cn: 一年到头把花园拾掇得干净整洁也不是件轻松活儿。
ext.ext_en: Keeping the garden tidy all year round can be a laborious task.

defs.def_en: If you describe a task or job as laborious, you mean that it takes a lot of time and effort.
A deerstalker is an old-fashioned hat with parts at the sides which can be folded down to cover the ears. Deerstalkers are usually worn by men.
A cattery is a place where you can leave your cat to be looked after when you go on holiday.
Desalination is the process of removing salt from sea water so that it can be used for drinking, or for watering crops.

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉蒙有关本片制作过程的书
ext.ext_en: ...Salamon's book about the making of this movie...

ext.ext_cn: 鸭蛋在做糕饼时，格外重要。
ext.ext_en: Ducks' eggs are particularly prized for cake making.

defs.def_en: The making of something is the act or process of producing or creating it.

ext.ext_cn: 朱莉的戏剧老师相信她会成为一颗冉冉升起的明星。
ext.ext_en: Her drama teacher is confident Julie is a star in the making...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为这会是一场灾难。
ext.ext_en: I think it's a disaster in the making.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or thing as something in the making, you mean that they are going to become known or recognized as that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 这次的发现也许会成为他成功的契机。
ext.ext_en: This discovery may yet be the making of him.

defs.def_en: If something is the making of a person or thing, it is the reason that they become successful or become very much better than they used to be.

defs.def_cn: 具备成为…的素质(或内在因素、必要条件、潜在能力)

ext.ext_cn: 戈弗雷具有成为一名成功记者的潜质。
ext.ext_en: Godfrey had the makings of a successful journalist.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or thing has the makings of something, you mean it seems possible or likely that they will become that thing, as they have the necessary qualities.

defs.def_cn: (问题等)自己造成的;咎由自取

ext.ext_cn: 这所大学的一些经济困难是由其自身造成的。
ext.ext_en: Some of the university's financial troubles are of its own making...

ext.ext_cn: 但是，首相现在却落入了她自己设下的圈套之中。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister, however, is now caught in a trap of her own making.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a problem you have is of your own making, you mean you have caused or created it yourself.

defs.def_cn: 陷入僵局的;僵持不下的

ext.ext_cn: 自 8 月份以来，和平谈判在人权问题上一直处于僵局。
ext.ext_en: The peace talks have been deadlocked over the issue of human rights since August...

ext.ext_cn: 但是经过近一周的审议，陪审团仍然僵持不下。
ext.ext_en: But after nearly a week of deliberations, the jury remained deadlocked.

defs.def_en: If a dispute or series of negotiations is deadlocked, no agreement can be reached because neither side will give in at all. You can also say that the people involved are deadlocked .

ext.ext_cn: 邦伯里重重地倒在了床上，让他疲惫的双脚休息一下。
ext.ext_en: Bunbury flopped down upon the bed and rested his tired feet...

ext.ext_cn: 她精疲力竭，一屁股坐在沙发上。
ext.ext_en: She flopped, exhausted, on to a sofa.

defs.def_en: If you flop into a chair, for example, you sit down suddenly and heavily because you are so tired.

ext.ext_cn: 公文包重重地落在桌上。
ext.ext_en: The briefcase flopped onto the desk...

ext.ext_cn: 他的头发凌乱地垂在左眼前。
ext.ext_en: His hair flopped over his left eye.

defs.def_en: If something flops onto something else, it falls there heavily or untidily.

ext.ext_cn: 决定一部电影会走红还是惨败的是大众。
ext.ext_en: It is the public who decide whether a film is a hit or a flop.

defs.def_en: If something is a flop, it is completely unsuccessful.

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影票房惨淡。
ext.ext_en: The film flopped badly at the box office.

defs.def_en: If something flops, it is completely unsuccessful.
A commercial bank is a bank which makes short-term loans using money from current or checking accounts.

defs.def_cn: 长时间的；长久的；长期的

ext.ext_cn: 电缆的维修没有花太长的时间。
ext.ext_en: Repairs to the cable did not take too long...

ext.ext_cn: 你认识她父母很长时间了吗？
ext.ext_en: Have you known her parents long?...

defs.def_en: Long means a great amount of time or for a great amount of time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （事件或时期）持续时间长的，花长时间的

ext.ext_cn: 我们和检察总长开了一个长会。
ext.ext_en: We had a long meeting with the attorney general...

ext.ext_cn: 她计划去埃及和美国度长假。
ext.ext_en: She is planning a long holiday in Egypt and America...

defs.def_en: A long event or period of time lasts for a great amount of time or takes a great amount of time.

ext.ext_cn: 你住在这一带有多长时间了？
ext.ext_en: How long have you lived around here?...

ext.ext_cn: 在朋友的记忆中，他一直都在节食。
ext.ext_en: He has been on a diet for as long as any of his friends can remember...

defs.def_en: You use long to ask or talk about amounts of time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的讲话颇为冗长。
ext.ext_en: He was making quite a long speech...

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影较长，有3小时7分钟。
ext.ext_en: This is a long film, three hours and seven minutes.

defs.def_en: A long speech, book, film, or list contains a lot of information or a lot of items and takes a lot of time to listen to, read, watch, or deal with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 睡觉吧。我明天还得忙呢。
ext.ext_en: Go to sleep.  I've got a long day tomorrow...

ext.ext_cn: 她是个电视台记者，总是工作到很晚。
ext.ext_en: She was a TV reporter and worked long hours...

defs.def_en: If you describe a period of time or work as long, you mean it lasts for more hours or days than is usual, or seems to last for more time than it actually does.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If someone has a long memory, they are able to remember things that happened far back in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 我们整晚都在放那张唱片。
ext.ext_en: We played that record all night long...

ext.ext_cn: 有时候山峰上整个夏天都有积雪。
ext.ext_en: Snow is sometimes found all summer long upon the highest peaks.

defs.def_en: Long is used in expressions such as all year long ,the whole day long, and your whole life long to say and emphasize that something happens for the whole of a particular period of time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 长桌
ext.ext_en: ...a long table...

ext.ext_cn: 医生的诊所外排了长长的一队人。
ext.ext_en: A long line of people formed outside the doctor's office...

defs.def_en: Something that is long measures a great distance from one end to the other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的目的地是乔伯姆公地，那里和他在科茨沃尔德的家离得很远。
ext.ext_en: His destination was Chobham Common, a long way from his Cotswold home...

ext.ext_cn: 长途旅行使他疲惫不堪。
ext.ext_en: The long journey tired him...

defs.def_en: A long distance is a great distance. A long journey or route covers a great distance.

ext.ext_cn: 她身穿一袭黑色长裙。
ext.ext_en: She is wearing a long black dress.

ext.ext_cn: 长袖女式衬衫
ext.ext_en: ...a long-sleeved blouse.

defs.def_en: A long piece of clothing covers the whole of someone's legs or more of their legs than usual. Clothes with long sleeves cover the whole of someone's arms.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 8星期大的胚胎只有一英寸长。
ext.ext_en: An eight-week-old embryo is only an inch long...

ext.ext_cn: 隧道有多长？
ext.ext_en: How long is the tunnel?...

defs.def_en: You use long to talk or ask about the distance something measures from one end to the other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 离最近的酒吧有长长的5英里的路程。
ext.ext_en: It was five long miles to the nearest pub.

defs.def_en: If you describe a distance as long, you mean it seems to be greater than it actually is.

ext.ext_cn: 内政部长说，只要他们不违规，他仍然会支持他们。
ext.ext_en: The interior minister said he would still support them, as long as they didn't break the rules...

ext.ext_cn: 只要选举在国际监督下进行，总统就不用下台。
ext.ext_en: The president need not step down so long as the elections are held under international supervision.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is the case as long as or so long as something else is the case, you mean that it is only the case if the second thing is the case.

defs.def_cn: 马上就到；很快回来；为时不远

ext.ext_cn: “她怎么回事？”——“我相信她快到了。”
ext.ext_en: 'What's happened to her?' — 'I'm sure she won't be long.'...

ext.ext_cn: 如果电台司令乐队的每首歌都像这首这么棒的话，那它很快便会家喻户晓了。
ext.ext_en: If every tune from Radiohead is as good as this one is, it can't be long before they are household names.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone won't  be long, you mean that you think they will arrive or be back soon. If you say that it won't  be long before something happens, you mean that you think it will happen soon.

ext.ext_cn: 德国的利率水平很快就会降下来。
ext.ext_en: German interest rates will come down before long...

ext.ext_cn: 他不久就接手负责杂志的编辑工作。
ext.ext_en: Before long he took over the editing of the magazine.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen or happened before long, you mean that it will happen or happened soon.

ext.ext_cn: 自由万岁！
ext.ext_en: Long live freedom!...

ext.ext_cn: 这是个自由世界，人人都有权发表自己的意见。我们愿此永恒不变。
ext.ext_en: It is a free world where we are all entitled to our opinions. Long may it remain so.

defs.def_en: You use long live and long may in expressions such as 'long live the Queen' and 'long may it continue' to express your support for someone or something and your hope that they will live or last a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 食物短缺不再是个问题。
ext.ext_en: Food shortages are no longer a problem...

ext.ext_cn: 她已无法再供他读书。
ext.ext_en: She could no longer afford to keep him at school...

defs.def_en: Something that is no longer the case used to be the case but is not the case now. You can also say that something is not the case any longer .

ext.ext_cn: 再见了，朋友，咱们回见。
ext.ext_en: Well, so long, pal, see you around.

defs.def_en: You can say so long as an informal way of saying goodbye.

ext.ext_cn: 史蒂夫渴望重度昔日的美好时光。
ext.ext_en: Steve longed for the good old days...

ext.ext_cn: 我渴望见到她。
ext.ext_en: I'm longing to meet her...

defs.def_en: See also:longing;If you long for something, you want it very much.

defs.def_cn: 有斑的；有疤的；有污点的

ext.ext_cn: 她脸上长斑，而且肿起来了。
ext.ext_en: Her face is blotched and swollen.

ext.ext_cn: 带迷彩色图案的12架货机
ext.ext_en: ...a dozen cargo planes blotched with camouflage colors.

defs.def_en: Something that is blotched has blotches on it.

ext.ext_cn: 该主张是将国家分成4个防区。
ext.ext_en: The idea is to divide up the country into four sectors...

ext.ext_cn: 该托管组织需要有新法律来将它分成若干小型机构。
ext.ext_en: The Trust needs a new law to divide it up into smaller bodies.

defs.def_en: If you divide something up, you separate it into smaller or more useful groups.

ext.ext_cn: 目的是为了平分公司股份，让每个人将来承担均等的风险。
ext.ext_en: The aim was to divide up the business, give everyone an equal stake in its future.

defs.def_en: If you divide something up, you share it out among a number of people or groups in approximately equal parts.
A choreographer is someone who invents the movements for a ballet or other dance and tells the dancers how to perform them.

ext.ext_cn: 让人愤慨的是那些数字并未公开。
ext.ext_en: It is outrageous that the figures are not in the public domain...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的婚姻状况已公开。
ext.ext_en: The state of their marriage has been put into the public domain.

defs.def_en: If information is in the public domain, it is not secret and can be used or discussed by anyone.
A cocoon is a covering of silky threads that the larvae of moths and other insects make for themselves before they grow into adults.

ext.ext_cn: 他站在那儿，一柱金光笼罩着他。
ext.ext_en: He stood there in a cocoon of golden light.

defs.def_en: If you are in a cocoon of something, you are wrapped up in it or surrounded by it.

defs.def_cn: 给人安全感的环境;保护层

ext.ext_cn: 她想要把心上人包裹在爱中的天真想法
ext.ext_en: ...her innocent desire to envelop her beloved in a cocoon of love...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管我们生活在一起，但却形同路人。
ext.ext_en: Even though we're living together we walk around in this cocoon of silence...

defs.def_en: If you are living in a cocoon, you are in an environment in which you feel protected and safe, and sometimes isolated from everyday life.

defs.def_cn: 把…保护起来;把…隔绝开来

ext.ext_cn: 如果出了问题，根本无处可躲，没有哪个机构会庇护你，让你免受指责。
ext.ext_en: There is nowhere to hide when things go wrong, no organisation to cocoon you from blame...

ext.ext_cn: 这个剧作家与世隔绝，生活在一个虚幻的世界里。
ext.ext_en: The playwright cocooned himself in a world of pretence.

defs.def_en: If something cocoons you from something, it protects you or isolates you from it.

defs.def_cn: 自作聪明的人;自以为无所不知的人
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a wise guy, you dislike the fact that they think they are very clever and always have an answer for everything.
A wise guy is a member of the Mafia.

defs.def_cn: 笨蛋;蠢货;不中用的东西

ext.ext_cn: 看到那些去皇家歌剧院的蠢家伙，我会不屑一顾。
ext.ext_en: Look at those saddos going to the Royal Opera House, I would jeer.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a saddo, you do not have any respect for them and think their behaviour or ideas are ridiculous.

defs.def_cn: 彻头彻尾的搜索;拉网式搜查

ext.ext_cn: 警察昨天继续对该地区进行拉网式搜查。
ext.ext_en: Officers continued a fingertip search of the area yesterday.

defs.def_en: When the police carry out a fingertip search of a place, they examine it for evidence in a very detailed way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 使人尴尬的；难处理的；棘手的

ext.ext_cn: 我是第一个向他提出尴尬问题的人，不过还会有人问更难回答的问题。
ext.ext_en: I was the first to ask him awkward questions but there'll be harder ones to come...

ext.ext_cn: 大家在决定是否要站到自己配偶身旁时，这一刻令人尴尬。
ext.ext_en: There was an awkward moment as couples decided whether to stand next to their partners.

defs.def_en: An awkward situation is embarrassing and difficult to deal with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难使用的；难携带的；（工作）难处理的

ext.ext_cn: 它虽然小，但很重，不便携带。
ext.ext_en: It was small but heavy enough to make it awkward to carry...

ext.ext_cn: 标准尺寸的三脚架可能会不便于使用，用于拍摄低角度的物体时尤其如此。
ext.ext_en: Full-size tripods can be awkward, especially if you're shooting a low-level subject.

defs.def_en: Something that is awkward to use or carry is difficult to use or carry because of its design. A job that is awkward is difficult to do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 埃米笨拙地做了个手势。
ext.ext_en: Amy made an awkward gesture with her hands.

defs.def_en: An awkward movement or position is uncomfortable or clumsy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 害羞的；尴尬的；局促不安的

ext.ext_cn: 女人们经常说她们不好意思在性生活上采取主动。
ext.ext_en: Women frequently say that they feel awkward taking the initiative in sex...

ext.ext_cn: 在教子面前，他非常局促不安。
ext.ext_en: He was rather awkward with his godson.

defs.def_en: Someone who feels awkward behaves in a shy or embarrassed way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可理喻的；难打交道的；难相处的

ext.ext_cn: 她到了难相处的年龄。
ext.ext_en: She's got to an age where she is being awkward.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is awkward, you are critical of them because you find them unreasonable and difficult to live with or deal with.

ext.ext_cn: “下面，闲话少说，让我来介绍一下我们的赞助人。”
ext.ext_en: 'And now, without further ado, let me introduce our benefactor.'

defs.def_en: If you do something without further ado or without more ado, you do it at once and do not discuss or delay it any longer.

ext.ext_cn: 你对大学的第一印象是什么？
ext.ext_en: What were your first impressions of college?...

ext.ext_cn: 我的感觉是它们完全失去了控制。
ext.ext_en: My impression is that they are totally out of control...

defs.def_en: Your impression of a person or thing is what you think they are like, usually after having seen or heard them. Your impression of a situation is what you think is going on.

ext.ext_cn: 我不想给人一种我在逃避指控的感觉。
ext.ext_en: I don't want to give the impression that I'm running away from the charges...

ext.ext_cn: 他巧妙地在窗子上面镶嵌了几面镜子，以营造一种空间感。
ext.ext_en: He cleverly inserted mirrors above the window to create an impression of space.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you a particular impression, they cause you to believe that something is the case, often when it is not.

ext.ext_cn: 他对肖恩·康纳利和詹姆斯·梅森进行了滑稽模仿。
ext.ext_en: He did impressions of Sean Connery and James Mason.

defs.def_en: An impression is an amusing imitation of someone's behaviour or way of talking, usually someone well-known.

ext.ext_cn: 世界上最古老的植物化石印痕
ext.ext_en: ...the world's oldest fossil impressions of plant life.

defs.def_en: An impression of an object is a mark or outline that it has left after being pressed hard onto a surface.

ext.ext_cn: 他告诉了我他的计划,给我留下了一个好印象。
ext.ext_en: He has told me his plans and he's made a good impression on me...

ext.ext_cn: 逐渐到达的救援对可怕的死亡率并没有起到什么作用。
ext.ext_en: The aid coming in has made no impression on the horrific death rates.

defs.def_en: If someone or something makes an impression, they have a strong effect on people or a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 他显然以为一场军事政变正在酝酿中。
ext.ext_en: He had apparently been under the impression that a military coup was in progress.

defs.def_en: If you are under the impression that something is the case, you believe that it is the case, usually when it is not actually the case.

defs.def_cn: （针对儿童、老人、病人等的）日托，日间护理，日间看护

ext.ext_cn: 日托服务能够让妇女有时间参与其他活动。
ext.ext_en: Day care enables women to get involved in other activities.

ext.ext_cn: 面向老年人的日托中心
ext.ext_en: ...a day-care centre for elderly people.

defs.def_en: Day care is care that is provided during the day for people who cannot look after themselves, such as small children, old people, or people who are ill. Day care is provided by paid workers.

ext.ext_cn: 这里是不当班的警察经常光顾的地方。
ext.ext_en: The place is the haunt of off-duty policemen.

defs.def_en: When someone such as a soldier or policeman is off-duty, they are not working.

ext.ext_cn: 她取代了他在他母亲心目中的地位吗？
ext.ext_en: Did she usurp his place in his mother's heart?...
