ext.ext_en: Many of Vasari's ruminations on the subject are not always to be believed.

ext.ext_cn: 对生命的深思
ext.ext_en: ...profound ruminations about life.

defs.def_en: Your ruminations are your careful thoughts about something.
A retail park is a large specially built area, usually at the edge of a town or city, where there are a lot of large shops and sometimes other facilities such as cinemas and restaurants.

defs.def_cn: 走珠除臭剂;滚珠香体露

ext.ext_cn: 我使用的是无香型走珠除臭剂。
ext.ext_en: I use unperfumed roll-on deodorant.

defs.def_en: A roll-on is a deodorant or cosmetic that you apply to your body using a container with a ball which turns round in the neck of the container.

defs.def_cn: (参战国内由中立部队维持和平的)安全区

ext.ext_cn: 联合国宣布它为安全区。
ext.ext_en: The UN declared it a safe area.

defs.def_en: If part of a country that is involved in a war is declared to be a safe area, neutral forces will try to keep peace there so that it is safe for people.

ext.ext_cn: 这些工厂已取代旅游业成为该国最大的外汇来源。
ext.ext_en: These factories have displaced tourism as the country's largest source of foreign exchange...

ext.ext_cn: 煤炭将让位于天然气和核能。
ext.ext_en: Coal is to be displaced by natural gas and nuclear power.

defs.def_en: If one thing displaces another, it forces the other thing out of its place, position, or role, and then occupies that place, position, or role itself.

defs.def_cn: 迫使…离开家园;迫使…迁徙;迫使…背井离乡

ext.ext_cn: 仅在欧洲就有3,000万人被迫背井离乡。
ext.ext_en: In Europe alone thirty million people were displaced...

ext.ext_cn: 许多因战乱而流离失所的百姓将无法重返家园。
ext.ext_en: Most of the civilians displaced by the war will be unable to return to their homes.

defs.def_en: If a person or group of people is displaced, they are forced to moved away from the area where they live.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 要是能找到足够便宜的地方，我就不在校园里住了。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to live off campus if I can find somewhere cheap enough...

ext.ext_cn: 烟雾报警器既不贵又易于安装。
ext.ext_en: Smoke detectors are cheap and easy to put up...

defs.def_en: Goods or services that are cheap cost less money than usual or than you expected.

ext.ext_cn: 别买廉价的仿冒品，攒点钱买正品吧。
ext.ext_en: Don't resort to cheap copies; save up for the real thing.

ext.ext_cn: 用廉价面料做的紧身套装
ext.ext_en: ...a tight suit made of some cheap material.

defs.def_en: If you describe goods as cheap, you mean they cost less money than similar products but their quality is poor.

ext.ext_cn: 把儿童当廉价劳动力使用的黑心雇主
ext.ext_en: ...unscrupulous employers who treat children as a cheap source of labour.

defs.def_en: If you describe the cost of someone's work as cheap, you disapprove of the way people are taking advantage of a situation to pay someone less than they should for the work that they do.

defs.def_cn: (言行)讨便宜的，刻薄的，不怀好意的

ext.ext_cn: 这些测试必然会被政客们不失时机地拿去大做政治文章。
ext.ext_en: These tests will inevitably be used by politicians to make cheap political points.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's remarks or actions as cheap, you mean that they are unkindly or insincerely using a situation to benefit themselves or to harm someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 哦，求求你，爸爸，就这一回，别抠门儿了。
ext.ext_en: Oh, please, Dad, just this once don't be cheap.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as cheap, you are criticizing them for being unwilling to spend money.

defs.def_cn: 人命不值钱;人命如草芥

ext.ext_cn: 我们最终将生活在一个视人命为儿戏的社会。
ext.ext_en: We will end up living in a society where life is cheap.

defs.def_en: You use life is cheap or life has become cheap to refer to a situation in which nobody cares that large numbers of people are dying.

ext.ext_cn: 现在的房子大多质量差劲透顶，肯定都是偷工减料盖起来的。
ext.ext_en: Most modern housing estates are terrible and inevitably done on the cheap.

defs.def_en: If someone does or buys something on the cheap, they spend less money than they should because they are more concerned with what it costs than with its quality.

ext.ext_cn: 当我们深入到具体细节时，情况有所改观。
ext.ext_en: Things improved when we got down to the specifics...

ext.ext_cn: 工会官员们不会讨论谈判的细节。
ext.ext_en: Union officials won't discuss specifics of the negotiations.

defs.def_en: The specifics of a subject are the details of it that need to be considered.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 富有洞察力的;有深刻见解的

ext.ext_cn: 她给出了一些非常有趣又富有洞察力的评论。
ext.ext_en: She offered some really interesting, insightful observations.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their remarks as insightful, you mean that they show a very good understanding of people and situations.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 只有通过控制成本，美国才能保持对其他国家的竞争优势。
ext.ext_en: Only by keeping down costs will America maintain its competitive advantage over other countries...

ext.ext_cn: 日本实行竞争激烈的市场体制。
ext.ext_en: Japan is a highly competitive market system...

defs.def_en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他一直都雄心勃勃，而且极其好胜。
ext.ext_en: He has always been ambitious and fiercely competitive...

ext.ext_cn: 我非常要强，下定决心不能输给别人。
ext.ext_en: I'm a very competitive person and I was determined not be beaten.

defs.def_en: A competitive person is eager to be more successful than other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 只有那些价格优惠的住房才会引起真想买房的人的兴趣。
ext.ext_en: Only those homes offered for sale at competitive prices will secure interest from serious purchasers.

ext.ext_cn: 专门提供极优惠航班折扣的旅游公司
ext.ext_en: ...a travel company specialising in amazingly competitive rates for flights.

defs.def_en: Goods or services that are at a competitive price or rate are likely to be bought, because they are less expensive than other goods of the same kind.
A hymnal is a book of hymns.
A bottle bank is a large container into which people can put empty bottles so that the glass can be used again.

defs.def_cn: 对（机器）更新部件;对（建筑物）进行翻新

ext.ext_cn: 这项业务主要是改造更新现有的飞机。
ext.ext_en: Much of this business involves retrofitting existing planes...

ext.ext_cn: 受损的房子已经修好，公路重铺了，大楼也翻新了。
ext.ext_en: Damaged houses have been repaired, roads repaved and buildings retrofitted.

defs.def_en: To retrofit a machine or a building means to put new parts or new equipment in it after it has been in use for some time, especially to improve its safety or make it work better.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不合群的懦弱小男生
ext.ext_en: ...a wimpy unpopular schoolboy...

ext.ext_cn: 这把她描绘得很懦弱，其实她性格十分坚强。
ext.ext_en: This portrays her as wimpy, but she has a very strong character.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as wimpy, you disapprove of them because they are weak and seem to lack confidence or determination.

ext.ext_cn: 在一次庭院拍卖会上，我偶然发现了一个忍不住想买的东西。
ext.ext_en: I came upon an irresistible item at a yard sale.

defs.def_en: If you come upon someone or something, you meet them or find them by chance.

ext.ext_cn: 我们所有人都有一种大难临头的感觉。
ext.ext_en: A sense of impending doom came upon all of us.

defs.def_en: If an attitude or feeling comes upon you, it begins to affect you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人紧张不安的;令人毛骨悚然的

ext.ext_cn: 有些地方晚上真是让人不寒而栗。
ext.ext_en: There were certain places that were really creepy at night...

ext.ext_cn: 她和那个让人毛骨悚然的家伙丹尼斯还没离婚吗？
ext.ext_en: Was she still married to that creepy guy, Dennis?

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is creepy, you mean they make you feel very nervous or frightened.

ext.ext_cn: 我挣脱了他，冲进了大厅。
ext.ext_en: I broke away from him and rushed out into the hall...

ext.ext_cn: 威利·汉密尔顿在比赛中早早甩开了其他选手。
ext.ext_en: Willie Hamilton broke away early in the race.

defs.def_en: If you break away from someone who is trying to hold you or catch you, you free yourself and run away.

ext.ext_cn: 土著艺术最终获得了承认，并摆脱了“原始”或“异域情调”的标签。
ext.ext_en: Aboriginal art has finally gained recognition and broken away from being labelled as 'primitive' or 'exotic'...

ext.ext_cn: 这个团体在1932年脱离工党。
ext.ext_en: The group broke away from the Labour Party in 1932.

defs.def_en: If you break away from something or someone that restricts you or controls you, you succeed in freeing yourself from them.

defs.def_cn: （某领域中的）杰出人物，佼佼者

ext.ext_cn: 薇薇恩·韦斯特伍德已成为时装界的翘楚。
ext.ext_en: Vivienne Westwood has scaled the heights of fashion's hall of fame.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a member of a particular hall of fame, you mean that they are one of the most famous people in that area of activity.
In the United States, a hall of fame is a type of museum where people can see things relating to famous people who are connected with a particular area of activity.

defs.def_cn: 可待因(一种尤用于减轻头痛及感冒症状的药物)
defs.def_en: Codeine is a drug which is used to relieve pain, especially headaches, and the symptoms of a cold.

ext.ext_cn: 为什么卡梅拉把他扯进这场争论中?
ext.ext_en: Why should Carmela have dragged him into the argument?...

ext.ext_cn: 我们可能会发现我们自己被扯到新的战争或新战争的威胁中去了。
ext.ext_en: We may find ourselves dragged into new wars and new threats of wars.

defs.def_en: To drag something or someone into an event or situation means to involve them in it when it is not necessary or not desirable.

defs.def_cn: （尤指爵士乐的）乐队指挥，乐队领队

ext.ext_cn: 著名的号手、作曲家和乐队指挥
ext.ext_en: ...a noted trumpeter, composer and bandleader.

defs.def_en: A bandleader is the person who conducts a band, especially a jazz band.

ext.ext_cn: 3只5周大的幼狮
ext.ext_en: ...three five-week-old lion cubs.

defs.def_en: A cub is a young wild animal such as a lion, wolf, or bear.

defs.def_cn: 幼童军(8至10岁的男孩组成的一支童子军)
defs.def_en: The Cubs or the Cub Scouts is a version of the Scouts for boys between the ages of eight and ten.
A cub or a cub scout is a boy who is a member of the Cubs.

ext.ext_cn: 他在去参加幼童军会议的路上。
ext.ext_en: He was on his way to Cubs.

defs.def_en: Cubs is a meeting of the Cubs.

ext.ext_cn: 我把手伸进口袋，掏出了那封信。
ext.ext_en: I put my hand into my pocket and pulled out the letter...

ext.ext_cn: 西尔维娅手里拿着相机问道：“我们先去哪里？”
ext.ext_en: Sylvia, camera in hand, asked, 'Where do we go first?'

defs.def_en: Your hands are the parts of your body at the end of your arms. Each hand has four fingers and a thumb.

ext.ext_cn: 整个选举过程中都能看出军方的介入。
ext.ext_en: The hand of the military authorities can be seen in the entire electoral process...

ext.ext_cn: 该研究将使那些希望更加严格执行这项已存在14年的法案的议员影响力加强。
ext.ext_en: The study will strengthen the hand of congressmen who want stricter enforcement of the 14-year-old Act.

defs.def_en: The hand of someone or something is their influence in an event or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 在我看来很可能这些狗大多数都没有人妥善照看。
ext.ext_en: I feel that possibly the majority of these dogs are in the wrong hands...

ext.ext_cn: 他把自己伦敦北部的业务交给一位同事打理。
ext.ext_en: He is leaving his north London business in the hands of a colleague...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is in a particular person's hands, you mean that they are looking after it, own it, or are responsible for it.

ext.ext_cn: 我能看出你需要有人帮着照看孩子。
ext.ext_en: I could see you'd want a hand with the children...

ext.ext_cn: 到花园里来帮我一把。
ext.ext_en: Come and give me a hand in the garden...

defs.def_en: If you ask someone for a hand with something, you are asking them to help you in what you are doing.

defs.def_cn: （工厂或农场的）工人，体力劳动者（通常指男性）

ext.ext_cn: 他现在是一名农场工人。
ext.ext_en: He now works as a farm hand...

ext.ext_cn: 他见过工厂工人、矿工和农场工人。
ext.ext_en: He met mill hands, miners and farm labourers.

defs.def_en: A hand is someone, usually a man, who does hard physical work, for example in a factory or on a farm, as part of a group of people who all do similar work.

defs.def_cn: （通常指演出前后的）鼓掌，掌声

ext.ext_cn: 让我们为他们热烈鼓掌。
ext.ext_en: Let's give 'em a big hand.

defs.def_en: If someone asks an audience to give someone a hand, they are asking the audience to clap loudly, usually before or after that person performs.

ext.ext_cn: 他来请求乌莎的父亲把女儿嫁给他。
ext.ext_en: He came to ask Usha's father for her hand in marriage.

defs.def_en: If a man asks for a woman's hand in marriage, he asks her or her parents for permission to marry her.

defs.def_cn: （纸牌游戏中的）手中的牌，一手牌

ext.ext_cn: 他仔细地审视着自己手中的牌。
ext.ext_en: He carefully inspected his hand.

defs.def_en: In a game of cards, your hand is the set of cards that you are holding in your hand at a particular time or the cards that are dealt to you at the beginning of the game.

defs.def_cn: 一手之宽（测量马匹高度的单位，等于4英寸）

ext.ext_cn: 我有一匹很棒的14.2手高的小马，名叫布朗迪。
ext.ext_en: I had a very good 14.2 hands pony, called Brandy.

defs.def_en: A hand is a measurement of four inches, which is used for measuring the height of a horse from its front feet to its shoulders.
The hands of a clock or watch are the thin pieces of metal or plastic that indicate what time it is.

ext.ext_cn: 手稿是作曲家亲笔写的。
ext.ext_en: The manuscripts were written in the composer's own hand.

defs.def_en: Your hand is the style in which you write with a pen or pencil.

defs.def_cn: （空间或时间上）接近的，不远的

ext.ext_cn: 手头上有合适的设备将会帮上大忙。
ext.ext_en: Having the right equipment at hand will be enormously helpful...

ext.ext_cn: 意识到自己快要退休了，他想要挣些外快。
ext.ext_en: Realizing that his retirement was near at hand, he looked for some additional income.

defs.def_en: If something is at hand ,near at hand, or close at hand, it is very near in place or time.

defs.def_cn: 在…手中，从…那里（尤指受到不好的待遇）

ext.ext_cn: 老百姓吃尽了安全部队的苦头。
ext.ext_en: The civilian population were suffering greatly at the hands of the security forces.

defs.def_en: If someone experiences a particular kind of treatment, especially unpleasant treatment, at the hands of a person or organization, they receive it from them.

ext.ext_cn: 每条褶裥都是手工缝制到位的。
ext.ext_en: Each pleat was stitched in place by hand.

defs.def_en: If you do something by hand, you do it using your hands rather than a machine.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司多年来已几易其主。
ext.ext_en: The firm has changed hands many times over the years.

defs.def_en: When something changes hands, its ownership changes, usually because it is sold to someone else.

defs.def_cn: 完全受（某人）支配;完全听命于（某人）

ext.ext_cn: 帕克能让顾客对自己言听计从。
ext.ext_en: Parker could have customers eating out of his hand.

defs.def_en: If you have someone eating out of your hand, they are completely under your control.

defs.def_cn: 连手带脚地，手脚一起地（捆绑）
defs.def_en: If someone is bound hand and foot, both their hands and both their feet are tied together.

defs.def_cn: 迫使（某人）提前行动（或公开其所作所为）

ext.ext_cn: 他指责新闻界迫使自己采取行动。
ext.ext_en: He blamed the press for forcing his hand.

defs.def_en: If you force someone's hand, you force them to act sooner than they want to, or to act in public when they would prefer to keep their actions secret.

defs.def_cn: （为…）忙得不可开交;（因…）应接不暇

ext.ext_cn: 她忙于应付新来的人。
ext.ext_en: She had her hands full with new arrivals.

defs.def_en: If you have your hands full with something, you are very busy because of it.

defs.def_cn: 自行决定权;自由行动权

ext.ext_cn: 他放手让斯蒂芬妮全权负责装修一事。
ext.ext_en: He gave Stephanie a free hand in the decoration.

defs.def_en: If someone gives you a free hand, they give you the freedom to use your own judgment and to do exactly as you wish.

defs.def_cn: 迅速而大量地（赚钱或花钱）
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is making or losing money hand over fist, you mean that they are getting or losing a lot of money very quickly.

defs.def_cn: （通常指经过努力后）获得，得到

ext.ext_cn: 帕蒂开始阅读她能找到的所有东西。
ext.ext_en: Patty began reading everything she could get her hands on.

defs.def_en: If you get your hands on something or lay your hands on something, you manage to find it or obtain it, usually after some difficulty.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国观察员和西方情报机构之间密切合作。
ext.ext_en: The UN inspectors work hand in glove with the Western intelligence agencies.

defs.def_en: If you work hand in glove with someone, you work very closely with them.

defs.def_cn: （常指为表示爱意而）手拉手的，携着手的

ext.ext_cn: 我看到他们手拉手沿着小路往前走去。
ext.ext_en: I saw them making their way, hand in hand, down the path.

defs.def_en: If two people are hand in hand, they are holding each other's nearest hand, usually while they are walking or sitting together. People often do this to show their affection for each other.

defs.def_cn: （两件事）密切相关地，同时并进地

ext.ext_cn: 对我们而言，研究和教学是齐头并进的。
ext.ext_en: For us, research and teaching go hand in hand...

ext.ext_cn: 在警方调查的同时，政府也宣布要展开彻查。
ext.ext_en: Hand in hand with the police inquiries the government has also announced a full investigation.

defs.def_en: If two things go hand in hand, they are closely connected and cannot be considered separately from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 他向所有帮助自己获得释放的人表示感谢。
ext.ext_en: He thanked all who had a hand in his release.

defs.def_en: If you have a hand in something such as an event or activity, you are involved in it.

ext.ext_cn: 亨利和理查都用高压手段实行统治。
ext.ext_en: Henry and Richard both ruled with a heavy hand.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone such as the ruler of a country treats people with a heavy hand, you are criticizing them because they are very strict and severe with them.

defs.def_cn: （常指为表示爱意而）手拉手，牵手

ext.ext_cn: 她走近一对手拉手坐在长椅上的年轻情侣。
ext.ext_en: She approached a young couple holding hands on a bench.

defs.def_en: If two people are holding hands, they are holding each other's nearest hand, usually while they are walking or sitting together. People often do this to show their affection for each other.

ext.ext_cn: 我不需要任何人的精神安慰。
ext.ext_en: I don't need anyone to hold my hand.

defs.def_en: If you ask someone to hold your hand at an event that you are worried about, you ask them to support you by being there with you.

ext.ext_cn: 威尔士队在小组中以3分之差落后于罗马尼亚队，但他们还有一场比赛没踢。
ext.ext_en: Wales are three points behind Romania in the group but have a game in hand.

defs.def_en: In a competition, if someone has games or matches in hand, they have more games or matches left to play than their opponent and therefore have the possibility of scoring more points.

ext.ext_cn: 休斯提前了15秒完成。
ext.ext_en: Hughes finished with 15 seconds in hand.

defs.def_en: If you have time or money in hand, you have more time or money than you need.

defs.def_cn: （工作或问题）办理中的，处理中的

ext.ext_cn: 手头的生意似乎快到紧要关头了。
ext.ext_en: The business in hand was approaching some kind of climax.

defs.def_en: The job or problem in hand is the job or problem that you are dealing with at the moment.

ext.ext_cn: 奥运会的组织方说各项事务都在掌控之中。
ext.ext_en: The Olympic organisers say that matters are well in hand.

defs.def_en: If a situation is in hand, it is under control.

ext.ext_cn: 他仍在一个本地乐队里担任键盘手，以免技艺生疏。
ext.ext_en: He still plays keyboards for a local band to keep his hand in.

defs.def_en: If you do something to keep your hand in, you practise a skill or hobby occasionally in order to remain fairly good at it.

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯手脚并用爬上了公路。
ext.ext_en: Chris crawled on his hands and knees out onto the highway.

defs.def_en: If you are on your hands and knees, your knees and feet and the palms of your hands are touching the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 我很乐意帮忙。
ext.ext_en: I'd be glad to lend a hand.

defs.def_en: If you lend someone a hand, you help them.

defs.def_cn: （不客气的警告语）别碰…，别干涉…

ext.ext_cn: 不准打我的牛奶的主意。
ext.ext_en: Keep your hands off my milk.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to keep their hands off something or to take their hands off it, you are telling them in a rather aggressive way not to touch it or interfere with it.

defs.def_cn: 马上;立即;无需询问（或查证）

ext.ext_cn: 我现在一个也想不出来。
ext.ext_en: I can't think of any off hand.

defs.def_en: If you do not know something off hand, you do not know it without having to ask someone else or look it up in a book.

ext.ext_cn: 他们现在又有个吸毒问题需要解决。
ext.ext_en: They now have yet another drug problem on their hands...

ext.ext_cn: 她希望不再为处理自己的事务而烦恼。
ext.ext_en: She would like the worry of dealing with her affairs taken off her hands.

defs.def_en: If you have a problem or responsibility on your hands, you have to deal with it. If it is off your hands, you no longer have to deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 婚礼用品部会有现成的专家为您提供所需的一切帮助和建议。
ext.ext_en: The Bridal Department will have experts on hand to give you all the help and advice you need...

ext.ext_cn: 手头实在没有现金可以购买食品。
ext.ext_en: There was simply no cash on hand to meet the cost of food.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is on hand, they are near and able to be used if they are needed.

ext.ext_cn: 一方面，如果体内没有足够的胆固醇，我们就无法存活下去。另一方面，如果体内胆固醇过高，多余的胆固醇就会附着在动脉内壁上。
ext.ext_en: On the one hand, if the body doesn't have enough cholesterol, we would not be able to survive. On the other hand, if the body has too much cholesterol, the excess begins to line the arteries.

defs.def_en: You use on the one hand to introduce the first of two contrasting points, facts, or ways of looking at something. It is always followed later by on the other hand or 'on the other'.

defs.def_cn: （从）另一方面（来说）（用于引出相对照的另一点）

ext.ext_cn: 嗯，好吧，医院是赔钱。但从另一个角度看，如果人们都健健康康的，就不能认为是在赔钱，而应该想成是在救死扶伤。
ext.ext_en: Well, all right, hospitals lose money. But, on the other hand, if people are healthy, don't think of it as losing money; think of it as saving lives.

defs.def_en: You use on the other hand to introduce the second of two contrasting points, facts, or ways of looking at something.

ext.ext_cn: 他酗酒的恶习已无法控制。
ext.ext_en: His drinking had got out of hand.

defs.def_en: If a person or a situation gets out of hand, you are no longer able to control them.

defs.def_cn: 立即，不假思索地（屏弃、拒绝等）

ext.ext_cn: 我起初不假思索地就否定了这个想法。
ext.ext_en: I initially dismissed the idea out of hand.

defs.def_en: If you dismiss or reject something out of hand, you do so immediately and do not consider believing or accepting it.

defs.def_cn: 因失算而让…占便宜;做对…有利的事

ext.ext_cn: 他这样做正中种族主义分子的下怀。
ext.ext_en: He is playing into the hands of racists.

defs.def_en: If you play into someone's hands, you do something which they want you to do and which places you in their power.

defs.def_cn: 摊牌;亮出底牌;表明自己的真实意图

ext.ext_cn: 尽管他拒绝亮出自己的底牌，他对竞选总统一事却越来越认真了。
ext.ext_en: He has grown more serious about running for president, although he refuses to show his hand.

defs.def_en: If you show your hand, you show how much power you have and the way you intend to act.

defs.def_cn: （尤指为有所改善）接手，照管，担任起对…的责任

ext.ext_cn: 我希望议会能很快接管国民医疗保健系统。
ext.ext_en: I hope that Parliament will soon take the NHS in hand...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾经认为照管她是值得的。
ext.ext_en: He had thought her worth taking in hand.

defs.def_en: If you take something or someone in hand, you take control or responsibility over them, especially in order to improve them.

defs.def_cn: （因愤怒、绝望或厌恶而）骤然举起双手

ext.ext_cn: 她绝望地举起双手表示放弃。
ext.ext_en: She threw up her hands in despair...

ext.ext_cn: 或许他们只会愤怒地挥舞着双手说你的要求太过分了？
ext.ext_en: Or are they just going to throw up their hands and say you're asking too much?

defs.def_en: If someone throws up their hands, they express their anger, frustration, or disgust when a situation becomes so bad that they can no longer accept it.

ext.ext_cn: 政客们总是说想帮助我们，但却身不由己。
ext.ext_en: Politicians are always saying that they want to help us but their hands are tied...

ext.ext_cn: 她为美国宪法的表述缚住了手脚。
ext.ext_en: Her hands were tied by the way that the US constitution is structured.

defs.def_en: If you say that your hands are tied, you mean that something is preventing you from acting in the way that you want to.

ext.ext_cn: 你应该保管好这份手册，这样随时想用都能马上在手边找到。
ext.ext_en: You may want to keep this brochure safe, so you have it to hand whenever you may need it.

defs.def_en: If you have something to hand or near to hand, you have it with you or near you, ready to use when needed.

ext.ext_cn: 离开学校后，他尝试过各种工作，如泥瓦匠、电影院引座员、运煤工。
ext.ext_en: After he left school, he tried his hand at a variety of jobs—bricklayer, cinema usher, coal man.

defs.def_en: If you try your hand at an activity, you attempt to do it, usually for the first time.

ext.ext_cn: 什么事都能学着做的人
ext.ext_en: ...a person who can turn his hand to anything.

defs.def_en: If you turn your hand to something such as a practical activity, you learn about it and do it for the first time.

defs.def_cn: 洗手不干;不再管;和…断绝关系

ext.ext_cn: 那份工作他好像已经洗手不干了。
ext.ext_en: He seems to have washed his hands of the job.

defs.def_en: If you wash your hands of someone or something, you refuse to be involved with them any more or to take responsibility for them.
If you win hands down, you win very easily.

ext.ext_cn: 他递给我一张小小的长方形白纸片。
ext.ext_en: He handed me a little rectangle of white paper...

ext.ext_cn: 他从内侧口袋里掏出一只厚信封递给我。
ext.ext_en: He took a thick envelope from an inside pocket and handed it to me.

defs.def_en: If you hand something to someone, you pass it to them.

ext.ext_cn: 你不得不佩服梅利莎，她到哪里都吃得开。
ext.ext_en: You've got to hand it to Melissa, she certainly gets around.

defs.def_en: You say things such as 'You have to hand it to her' or 'You've got to hand it to them' when you admire someone for their skills or achievements and you think they deserve a lot of praise.

defs.def_cn: 接力比赛(如赛跑或游泳)

ext.ext_cn: 英国要在接力赛中战胜美国，前景看上去并不那么乐观。
ext.ext_en: Britain's prospects of beating the United States in the relay looked poor.

defs.def_en: A relay or a relay race is a race between two or more teams, for example teams of runners or swimmers. Each member of the team runs or swims one section of the race.

defs.def_cn: 转播，传送，传输(电视或收音机信号)

ext.ext_cn: 这颗人造卫星主要用途是转播电视节目。
ext.ext_en: The satellite will be used mainly to relay television programmes...

ext.ext_cn: 这个系统不间断地监控辐射水平，并将信息传送到中央计算机。
ext.ext_en: This system continuously monitors levels of radiation and relays the information to a central computer...

defs.def_en: To relay television or radio signals means to send them or broadcast them.

defs.def_cn: (接受和发送电视或广播信号的)转播设备，中继设备

ext.ext_cn: 带有卫星传输设备的保安系统
ext.ext_en: ...a security system with satellite relays.

ext.ext_cn: 电视转播站
ext.ext_en: ...a television relay station.

defs.def_en: A relay is a piece of equipment that receives television or radio signals from one place and sends them to another place.

ext.ext_cn: 她把消息带到了，然后皱紧了眉头。
ext.ext_en: She relayed the message, then frowned...

ext.ext_cn: 这个决定将会被传达给伊拉克驻联合国大使。
ext.ext_en: The decision will be relayed to Iraq's ambassador at the UN.

defs.def_en: If you relay something that has been said to you, you repeat it to another person.

defs.def_cn: 家庭办公者;远程工作者;在家上班的人
defs.def_en: Teleworkers are people who work from home using equipment such as telephones, fax machines, and modems to contact the people they work with and their customers.
A wrestler is someone who wrestles as a sport, usually for money.

defs.def_cn: (俱乐部、团体、组织的)创始会员，元老
defs.def_en: A charter member of a club, group, or organization is one of the first members, often one who was involved in setting it up.
In Britain, road tax is a tax paid every year by the owners of every motor vehicle which is being used on the roads.

ext.ext_cn: 有着诸如“毛茸绿灯柱”这样怪异名字的各类艺术家
ext.ext_en: ...various artists with out-there names like Furry Green Lamppost.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is out-there is very extreme or unusual.

defs.def_cn: (某组织定期发送的)内部通讯，简报

ext.ext_cn: 该组织现有大约18,000名成员，他们会收到一份内部通讯季刊。
ext.ext_en: The organization now has around 18,000 members who receive a quarterly newsletter.

defs.def_en: A newsletter is one or more printed sheets of paper containing information about an organization that is sent regularly to its members.

ext.ext_cn: 我正在寻找一位支持我收购的出资人。
ext.ext_en: I was looking for a backer to assist me in the attempted buy-out.

defs.def_en: A backer is someone who helps or supports a project, organization, or person, often by giving or lending money.

ext.ext_cn: 种种迹象表明新一代亚裔美国人也愿意入乡随俗。
ext.ext_en: There is every sign that new Asian-Americans are just as willing to assimilate...

ext.ext_cn: 他一家人试图融入白人和西班牙裔社区。
ext.ext_en: His family tried to assimilate into the white and Hispanic communities...

defs.def_en: When people such as immigrants assimilate into a community or when that community assimilates them, they become an accepted part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我无话可说，一时还无法接受他对我所说之事的严重性。
ext.ext_en: I was speechless, still trying to assimilate the enormity of what he'd told me.

defs.def_en: If you assimilate new ideas, techniques, or information, you learn them or adopt them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （声音）响亮的；（声源）发出响亮声音的；吵闹的

ext.ext_cn: 忽然传来一声巨响。
ext.ext_en: Suddenly there was a loud bang...

ext.ext_cn: 他提高了嗓门，嗓音也刺耳起来。
ext.ext_en: His voice became harsh and loud...

defs.def_en: If a noise is loud, the level of sound is very high and it can be easily heard. Someone or something that is loud produces a lot of noise.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （对某事的支持或批评）强烈的，激烈的

ext.ext_cn: 亚当斯先生在昨天的演讲中痛斥媒体。
ext.ext_en: Mr Adams' speech yesterday was very loud in condemnation of the media...

ext.ext_cn: 琼斯先生获得了他所在社区民众的热烈支持。
ext.ext_en: Mr Jones received loud support from his local community.

defs.def_en: If someone is loud in their support for or criticism of something, they express their opinion very often and in a very strong way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指衣服）大红大绿的，花里胡哨的，俗艳的

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢戴金链子，穿花里胡哨的衣服来招人反感。
ext.ext_en: He liked to shock with his gold chains and loud clothes...

ext.ext_cn: 我曾经花120英镑买了件极为花哨的衬衣，但到现在也没穿过。
ext.ext_en: I once paid £120 for an extremely loud shirt which I've yet to wear.

defs.def_en: If you describe something, especially a piece of clothing, as loud, you dislike it because it has very bright colours or very large, bold patterns which look unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 丽莎的声音非常清楚。
ext.ext_en: Lisa's voice comes through loud and clear...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个很强烈的信息，我希望烟草业能明白无误地听到。
ext.ext_en: The message is a powerful one, and I hope it will be heard loud and clear by the tobacco industry.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone something loud and clear, you are very easily understood, either because your voice is very clear or because you express yourself very clearly.

ext.ext_cn: 即使是很少笑的福特，有几次也笑出声来。
ext.ext_en: Even Ford, who seldom smiled, laughed out loud a few times...

ext.ext_cn: 他开始大声读起来。
ext.ext_en: He began to read out loud.

defs.def_en: If you say or read something out loud, you say it or read it so that it can be heard, rather than just thinking it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 像教授的；有学者风范的

ext.ext_cn: 他的言行举止不太像帝王，倒更像学者一些。
ext.ext_en: His manner is not so much regal as professorial...

ext.ext_cn: 我提高了嗓音，像教授一样说话。
ext.ext_en: I raised my voice to a professorial tone.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as professorial, you mean that they look or behave like a professor.

defs.def_cn: 和教授（或大学教师）工作有关的

ext.ext_cn: 裁员导致36%的教授职位空缺
ext.ext_en: ...the cuts which have led to 36 per cent of professorial posts remaining unfilled.

defs.def_en: Professorial means relating to the work of a professor.

defs.def_cn: 碳税(对煤、天然气和石油等燃料征收的税)
defs.def_en: A carbon tax is a tax on the burning of fuels such as coal, gas, and oil. Its aim is to reduce the amount of carbon dioxide released into the atmosphere.

defs.def_cn: 不充分如实的陈述；轻描淡写的说明

ext.ext_cn: 说我失望那是说得太轻了。
ext.ext_en: To say I'm disappointed is an understatement...

ext.ext_cn: 说他很不好相处，那简直是说得太客气了。
ext.ext_en: He was getting very hard to live with, and that's the understatement of the year.

defs.def_en: If you say that a statement is an understatement, you mean that it does not fully express the extent to which something is true.

defs.def_cn: 轻描淡写；重事轻说；淡化

ext.ext_cn: 他极力轻描淡写地跟我们说他感到失望。
ext.ext_en: He informed us with massive understatement that he was feeling disappointed.

ext.ext_cn: 典型的英国式轻描淡写
ext.ext_en: ...typical British understatement.

defs.def_en: Understatement is the practice of suggesting that things have much less of a particular quality than they really have.

defs.def_cn: 脚踏式垃圾桶（通常用在厨房或浴室，用脚一踩盖子即启）
defs.def_en: A pedal bin is a container for waste, usually in a kitchen or bathroom. It has a lid which is controlled by a pedal that you press with your foot.

ext.ext_cn: 这葡萄酒已经在橡木桶里存放近一年了。
ext.ext_en: The wine is aged for almost a year in oak barrels.

ext.ext_cn: 几桶腌鱼
ext.ext_en: ...barrels of pickled fish.

defs.def_en: A barrel is a large, round container for liquids or food.

defs.def_cn: （石油工业中）一桶的量（相当于159升）

ext.ext_cn: 1989年，科威特每天出口150万桶石油。
ext.ext_en: In 1989, Kuwait was exporting 1.5 million barrels of oil a day...

ext.ext_cn: 油价收于每桶19.76美元。
ext.ext_en: Oil prices were closing at $19.76 a barrel.

defs.def_en: In the oil industry, a barrel is a unit of measurement equal to 159 litres.

ext.ext_cn: 他把枪管塞进了另一个人的嘴里。
ext.ext_en: He pushed the barrel of the gun into the other man's open mouth.

defs.def_en: The barrel of a gun is the tube through which the bullet moves when the gun is fired.

ext.ext_cn: 这辆车疯了一般沿街疾驶。
ext.ext_en: The car was barreling down the street at a crazy speed.

defs.def_en: If a vehicle or person is barreling in a particular direction, they are moving very quickly in that direction.

ext.ext_cn: 他们把在新泽西的花园刨了个遍，然后将里面的东西一样不落地搬回了家。
ext.ext_en: They dug up their New Jersey garden and moved it lock, stock, and barrel back home.

defs.def_en: If you say, for example, that someone moves or buys something lock, stock, and barrel, you are emphasizing that they move or buy every part or item of it.

defs.def_cn: 使…受制于人；使…处于不利地位；迫使…做…
defs.def_en: If someone has you over a barrel, they have put you in a difficult situation where you have little choice but to do what they want you to do.

defs.def_cn: 凑合用劣质的东西；将就行事
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is scraping the barrel, or scraping the bottom of the barrel, you disapprove of the fact that they are using or doing something of extremely poor quality.

defs.def_cn: 非常有趣的事；笑料不断的开心果

ext.ext_cn: 韦丁顿第一个承认自己其实并不爱搞笑。
ext.ext_en: Weddington is the first to admit she's not exactly a barrel of laughs...

ext.ext_cn: 晚餐总是充满欢笑。
ext.ext_en: The suppers are always a barrel of laughs.

defs.def_en: If an experience is a barrel of laughs, it is very enjoyable. If someone is a barrel of laughs, they are fun to be with.
An operating theatre is a special room in a hospital where surgeons carry out medical operations.
Period pain is the pain that some women have when they have a monthly period.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极其荒谬的；愚蠢至极的

ext.ext_cn: 整个想法都荒唐透顶。
ext.ext_en: The whole idea was preposterous.

ext.ext_cn: 他们无比愚蠢地声称自己发现了一个阴谋
ext.ext_en: ...their preposterous claim that they had unearthed a plot.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as preposterous, you mean that it is extremely unreasonable and foolish.

defs.def_cn: 运输工具;(尤指)军车,运输舰

ext.ext_cn: 街上有装甲运兵车和坦克。
ext.ext_en: There were armoured personnel carriers and tanks on the streets...

ext.ext_cn: 货物运输采用普通货车或厢式货车。
ext.ext_en: Deliveries are made by common carrier or van line.

defs.def_en: See also:aircraft carrier;A carrier is a vehicle that is used for carrying people, especially soldiers, or things.

ext.ext_cn: 瑞士的国有航空公司——瑞士航空公司，最近日子很不好过。
ext.ext_en: Switzerland's national carrier, Swissair, has been having a hard time recently.

defs.def_en: A carrier is a passenger airline.

ext.ext_cn: 艾滋病病毒携带者
ext.ext_en: ...an AIDS carrier.

ext.ext_cn: 蚊子、蠕虫之类携带病毒的昆虫
ext.ext_en: ...carriers of disease such as mosquitoes and worms.

defs.def_en: A carrier is a person or an animal that is infected with a disease and so can make other people or animals ill.

ext.ext_cn: 这种松紧带弹性很大，这是从事服装业的一个朋友告诉我的。
ext.ext_en: This elastic is a powerful variety which a friend in the clothing trade put me onto.

defs.def_en: If you put someone onto something useful, you tell them about it.

defs.def_cn: 个人收入调查(以判定其是否可领取政府补助金)
defs.def_en: A means test is a test in which your income is calculated in order to decide whether you qualify for a grant or benefit from the state.

ext.ext_cn: 这件夹克他穿着太大了，就把袖口卷了起来。
ext.ext_en: The jacket was too big for him so he rolled up the cuffs...

ext.ext_cn: 她走在海浪里，不得不把裤腿卷到膝盖处。
ext.ext_en: Walking in the surf, she had to roll her pants up to her knees.

defs.def_en: See also:rolled-up;If you roll up your sleeves or trouser legs, you fold the ends back several times, making them shorter.

ext.ext_cn: 快来呀，快来呀，来一起看“地球上最精彩的演出”。
ext.ext_en: Roll up, roll up, come and join The Greatest Show on Earth...

ext.ext_cn: 第一批记者在几分钟之内就涌到了实验室。
ext.ext_en: The first reporters rolled up to the laboratory within minutes.

defs.def_en: If people roll up somewhere, they arrive there, especially in large numbers, to see something interesting.

ext.ext_cn: 回到岛上后，他便投身于政治。
ext.ext_en: Back on the island, he dedicated himself to politics...

ext.ext_cn: 贝茜一生都致力于照顾他人。
ext.ext_en: Bessie has dedicated her life to caring for others.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has dedicated themselves to something, you approve of the fact that they have decided to give a lot of time and effort to it because they think that it is important.

defs.def_cn: 把(书、戏剧、音乐作品等)献（给）

ext.ext_cn: 她把自己的第一张专辑献给了伍迪·艾伦。
ext.ext_en: She dedicated her first album to Woody Allen...

ext.ext_cn: 谨以此书献给我已故的母亲。
ext.ext_en: This book is dedicated to the memory of my mother.

defs.def_en: If someone dedicates something such as a book, play, or piece of music to you, they mention your name, for example in the front of a book or when a piece of music is performed, as a way of showing affection or respect for you.

defs.def_cn: 为(建筑物或教堂)举行奉献（或落成）典礼

ext.ext_cn: 几天前，在布赖顿附近的一个小教堂，人们以一扇窗户来纪念迈克尔·斯科特牧师。
ext.ext_en: The other day, in a little church near Brighton, a window was dedicated to the memory of the Revd. Michael Scott...

ext.ext_cn: 该教堂供奉的是贝克的圣玛丽。
ext.ext_en: The church is dedicated to St Mary of Bec.

defs.def_en: If a building or church is dedicated to someone, a formal ceremony is held to show that the building will always be associated with them.

defs.def_cn: 白宫(位于华盛顿特区的美国总统府邸，也指美国总统及其官员);

ext.ext_cn: 他驾车前往白宫。
ext.ext_en: He drove to the White House...

ext.ext_cn: 白宫方面没有参加任何会谈。
ext.ext_en: The White House has not participated in any talks.

defs.def_en: The White House is the official home in Washington DC of the President of the United States. You can also use the White House to refer to the President of the United States and his or her officials.

ext.ext_cn: 我刚吃完饭铃声就响了，于是我赶去上第一堂课。
ext.ext_en: I had just enough time to finish eating before the bell rang and I was off to my first class...

ext.ext_cn: 我一直按门铃，但是没有人应门。
ext.ext_en: I've been ringing the door bell, there's no answer.

defs.def_en: A bell is a device that makes a ringing sound and is used to give a signal or to attract people's attention.

ext.ext_cn: 我弟弟内维尔是星期天出生的，当时所有的教堂钟声齐鸣。
ext.ext_en: My brother, Neville, was born on a Sunday, when all the church bells were ringing.

defs.def_en: A bell is a hollow metal object shaped like a cup which has a piece hanging inside it that hits the sides and makes a sound.

ext.ext_cn: 这些照片一共有80张，都非常清晰。
ext.ext_en: There are 80 of these pictures and they're all as clear as a bell.

defs.def_en: If something is as clear as a bell, it is very clear indeed.

ext.ext_cn: 我明天给你打电话。
ext.ext_en: I was going to give you a bell tomorrow.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a bell, you telephone them.

defs.def_cn: 听起来耳熟（但记不真切）

ext.ext_cn: 对其中一个小伙子的描述确实似曾熟悉。听起来挺耳熟。
ext.ext_en: The description of one of the lads is definitely familiar. It rings a bell.

defs.def_en: If you say that something rings a bell, you mean that it reminds you of something, but you cannot remember exactly what it is.

defs.def_cn: 非常健康的；完好无损的

ext.ext_cn: 这匹马安然无恙地回来了。
ext.ext_en: The horse returned sound as a bell.

defs.def_en: If something is as sound as a bell it is healthy and not damaged in any way.
An apostate is someone who has abandoned their religious faith, political loyalties, or principles.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 爱打听的;好探问的;过于好奇的

ext.ext_cn: 巴罗天生就爱打听别人隐私。
ext.ext_en: Barrow had an inquisitive nature...

ext.ext_cn: 熊非常好奇,必须不断地给予其智力上的刺激。
ext.ext_en: Bears are very inquisitive and must be kept mentally stimulated.

defs.def_en: An inquisitive person likes finding out about things, especially secret things.

defs.def_cn: 英格兰的;英国的;英格兰人的;英国人的;英语的

ext.ext_cn: 英国人的生活方式
ext.ext_en: ...the English way of life...

ext.ext_cn: 英国学生被迫在极短的时间内学习太多的东西。
ext.ext_en: English students are forced to learn too much too soon.

defs.def_en: English means belonging or relating to England, or to its people or language. It is also often used to mean belonging or relating to Great Britain, although many people object to this.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的书面英语显然更好。
ext.ext_en: Their knowledge of written English is certainly better...

ext.ext_cn: 他用这个节目的录像带教授英语。
ext.ext_en: He uses tapes of this program to teach English.

defs.def_en: English is the language spoken by people who live in Great Britain and Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, and many other countries.

ext.ext_cn: 我知道我有毅力做这事儿。
ext.ext_en: I know I've got the willpower to do it...

ext.ext_cn: 他多次想单凭意志力戒烟都没有成功。
ext.ext_en: His attempts to stop smoking by willpower alone failed.

defs.def_en: Willpower is a very strong determination to do something.
Marshland is land with a lot of wet, muddy areas.

defs.def_cn: (试验或研究)双盲的（指研究人员和被试验者均不知哪一组试验者正接受测试）

ext.ext_cn: 在双盲试验中，改善效果明显。
ext.ext_en: In a double-blind trial, there were definite improvements.

defs.def_en: A double-blind study or experiment compares two groups of people, one of which is being tested while the other is not. Neither the people doing the testing nor the members of the two groups know which group is being tested.

defs.def_cn: (内有水果或麦麸，涂上黄油后通常作为早餐食用的)小松饼

ext.ext_cn: 有煎饼、蓝莓松饼、鸡蛋和熏肉的早餐
ext.ext_en: ...breakfasts of pancakes, blueberry muffins, eggs, and bacon.

defs.def_en: Muffins are small, round, sweet cakes, usually with fruit or bran inside. They are often eaten with butter for breakfast.

defs.def_cn: (涂黄油后趁热吃的)小甜面包卷
defs.def_en: Muffins are small, flat, sweet bread rolls that you eat hot with butter.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (通常指年轻女子)羞涩的，娴静的

ext.ext_cn: 她非常娴静可爱。
ext.ext_en: She's very demure and sweet...

ext.ext_cn: 性感迷人的沃顿小姐对我羞涩地会心一笑。
ext.ext_en: The luscious Miss Wharton gave me a demure but knowing smile.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone, usually a young woman, as demure, you mean they are quiet and rather shy, usually in a way that you like and find appealing, and behave very correctly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 端庄的高领白衬衫
ext.ext_en: ...a demure high-necked white blouse.

defs.def_en: Demure clothes do not reveal your body and they give the impression that you are shy and behave correctly.

ext.ext_cn: 动脉已经发生病变，移植是唯一的希望。
ext.ext_en: The arteries are diseased and a transplant is the only hope...

ext.ext_cn: 清除掉枯死和染上病虫害的植物。
ext.ext_en: Clear away dead or diseased plants.

defs.def_en: Something that is diseased is affected by a disease.

ext.ext_cn: 加德纳称这本书为“一个病态恶魔的作品”。
ext.ext_en: Gardner describes the book as 'the product of a diseased and evil mind'.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's mind is diseased, you are emphasizing that you think it is not normal or balanced.
A radiotherapist is a person who treats diseases such as cancer by using radiation.

defs.def_cn: 已加入工会的；已组织工会的；工会化的

ext.ext_cn: 合同将给加入工会的工人今后3年12%的加薪。
ext.ext_en: The contract would give unionized workers a 12 percent pay raise over three years...

ext.ext_cn: 这个公司成立了工会。
ext.ext_en: The company is unionized.

defs.def_en: Unionized workers belong to trade unions. If a company or place is unionized, most of the workers there belong to trade unions.

defs.def_cn: (be 的第三人称单数现在时形式,常放在其他词后缩写为 -’s)
defs.def_en: Is is the third person singular of the present tense of be .Is is often added to other words and shortened to -'s .
Oral sex is sexual activity involving contact between a person's mouth and their partner's genitals.

ext.ext_cn: 好斗性绝非男性才具有的特征。
ext.ext_en: Aggression is by no means a male-only trait.

defs.def_en: Aggression is a quality of anger and determination that makes you ready to attack other people.

ext.ext_cn: 那次偷袭是一种不正当的侵略行径。
ext.ext_en: The raid was an unjustifiable act of aggression.

ext.ext_cn: 大规模军事侵略的威胁
ext.ext_en: ...the threat of massive military aggression.

defs.def_en: Aggression is violent and attacking behaviour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 空中壮观的彩虹
ext.ext_en: ...a glorious rainbow in the air...

ext.ext_cn: 她错过了地中海春季鲜花怒放的绚丽美景。
ext.ext_en: She had missed the glorious blooms of the Mediterranean spring.

defs.def_en: Something that is glorious is very beautiful and impressive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这次胜利勾起了他对往昔那些夺冠岁月的美好回忆。
ext.ext_en: The win revived glorious memories of his championship-winning days...

ext.ext_cn: 我们打开窗户，让傍晚那沁人心脾的空气流进室内。
ext.ext_en: We opened the windows and let in the glorious evening air.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as glorious, you are emphasizing that it is wonderful and it makes you feel very happy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 哈里森辉煌的职业生涯长达60多年。
ext.ext_en: Harrison had a glorious career spanning more than six decades...

ext.ext_cn: 她的未来甚至可能会比过去还要辉煌。
ext.ext_en: Her future could be more glorious even than her past.

defs.def_en: A glorious career, victory, or occasion involves great fame or success.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我穿好衣服，走进灿烂的阳光中。
ext.ext_en: I got dressed and emerged into glorious sunshine...

ext.ext_cn: 太阳又出来了，这是个艳阳天。
ext.ext_en: The sun was out again, and it was a glorious day.

defs.def_en: Glorious weather is hot and sunny.
A camping site is the same as a campsite .

ext.ext_cn: 一架警用直升机借助热成像设备找到了他。
ext.ext_en: He was found by a police helicopter using thermal imaging equipment.

defs.def_en: Thermal imaging is the use of special equipment that can detect the heat produced by people or things and use it to produce images of them.
An amusement arcade is a place where you can play games on machines which work when you put money in them.

ext.ext_cn: 每位宾客一到场都会有人送上葡萄酒或香槟鸡尾酒。
ext.ext_en: On arrival, guests are offered wine or a champagne cocktail...

ext.ext_cn: 擅长调鸡尾酒的人
ext.ext_en: ...an expert at mixing cocktails.

defs.def_en: A cocktail is an alcoholic drink which contains several ingredients.

defs.def_cn: (尤指不宜搭配在一起的材料构成的)合成物，混合物

ext.ext_cn: 有人在法庭上指称她把毒品和烈酒混在一起喝下去了。
ext.ext_en: The court was told she had taken a cocktail of drugs and alcohol...

ext.ext_cn: 让儿童接触枪支可能会有致命的危险。
ext.ext_en: Children and guns are a potentially lethal cocktail.

defs.def_en: A cocktail is a mixture of a number of different things, especially ones that do not go together well.

ext.ext_cn: 现在许多工作场所禁止吸烟。
ext.ext_en: Smoking is now banned in many places of work.

ext.ext_cn: 禁烟区
ext.ext_en: ...a no-smoking area.

defs.def_en: Smoking is the act or habit of smoking cigarettes, cigars, or a pipe.

ext.ext_cn: 取消肯特列车上的吸烟车厢的决定
ext.ext_en: ...the decision to scrap smoking compartments on Kent trains.

defs.def_en: A smoking area is intended for people who want to smoke.
In baseball, a slugger is a player who hits the ball very hard.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一根细电缆将信号传送给一台计算机。
ext.ext_en: A thin cable carries the signal to a computer...

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯面部瘦削，轮廓分明，容易过敏。
ext.ext_en: James's face was thin, finely boned, and sensitive.

defs.def_en: Something that is thin is much narrower than it is long.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是个瘦高个，头发灰白。
ext.ext_en: He was a tall, thin man with grey hair...

ext.ext_cn: 他个头瘦小，肤色苍白。
ext.ext_en: He is small and very thin and has pale-white skin.

defs.def_en: A person or animal that is thin has no extra fat on their body .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一本用纸轻薄、字体精细的蓝皮小书
ext.ext_en: ...a small, blue-bound book printed in fine type on thin paper...

ext.ext_cn: 薄薄的一层表土被冲走了。
ext.ext_en: A thin layer of topsoil was swept away.

defs.def_en: Something such as paper or cloth that is thin is flat and has only a very small distance between its two opposite surfaces.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 汤又稀又清，味道却出奇地浓。
ext.ext_en: The soup was thin and clear, yet mysteriously rich...

ext.ext_cn: 他们搅动着架在木炭火堆上的大罐米饭和蔬菜清汤。
ext.ext_en: They are stirring huge pots of rice and thin vegetable soup over a fire made of charcoal.

defs.def_en: Liquids that are thin are weak and watery.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 比赛前半段观众还稀稀拉拉的，这时明显增多了。
ext.ext_en: The crowd, which had been thin for the first half of the race, had now grown considerably.

defs.def_en: A crowd or audience that is thin does not have many people in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (微笑)冷淡的，牵强的，不幽默的

ext.ext_cn: 她极力挤出了一丝勉强的苦笑。
ext.ext_en: All she could manage was a thin, wan smile.

defs.def_en: A thin smile is one that is not friendly or humorous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的礼服很薄，浑身在发抖，一半是冻的。
ext.ext_en: Her gown was thin, and she shivered, partly from cold.

defs.def_en: Thin clothes are made from light cloth and are not warm to wear.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (论点、解释)浅薄的，不足信的，说服力差的

ext.ext_cn: 然而，这个证据难以令人信服，而且有点模棱两可。
ext.ext_en: However, the evidence is thin and, to some extent, ambiguous...

ext.ext_cn: 就算乐观主义者的理论是对的，还是不足以阻止改革的进行。
ext.ext_en: Even if the optimists' theory is true, it still seems a thin argument against reform.

defs.def_en: If you describe an argument or explanation as thin, you mean that it is weak and difficult to believe.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她抱怨时抬高了尖细的嗓音。
ext.ext_en: Her thin voice rose high in complaint.

defs.def_en: A voice or sound that is thin is high-pitched and not very loud.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她把一头稀疏的浅黄色头发向后梳，挽成了个圆髻。
ext.ext_en: She had pale thin yellow hair she pulled back into a bun.

defs.def_en: If someone's hair is described as thin, they do not have a lot of hair.

ext.ext_cn: 当初要是分几个冬天疏剪树木，会比一下子疏剪完效果好。
ext.ext_en: It would have been better to have thinned the trees over several winters rather than all at one time...

ext.ext_cn: 半夜时分，人群渐渐散去了。
ext.ext_en: By midnight the crowd had thinned.

defs.def_en: When you thin something or when it thins, it becomes less crowded because people or things have been removed from it.

defs.def_cn: 使（调味汁或液体）变稀薄;使变淡

ext.ext_cn: 可能有必要将酱汁稍稍稀释一下。
ext.ext_en: It may be necessary to thin the sauce slightly...

ext.ext_cn: 阿司匹林可以稀释血液，使其在变窄的血管里更顺畅地流动。
ext.ext_en: Aspirin thins the blood, letting it flow more easily through narrowed blood vessels.

defs.def_en: To thin a sauce or liquid means to make it weaker and more watery by adding another liquid to it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的头发开始脱落，皮肤也老化了。
ext.ext_en: His hair is thinning and his skin has lost all hint of youth.

defs.def_en: If a man's hair is thinning, it has begun to fall out.  thin on top→see: top;

ext.ext_cn: 议会还没有着手应对日益严重的经济危机，公众日渐失去了耐心。
ext.ext_en: Parliament has not yet begun to combat the deepening economic crisis, and public patience is wearing thin.

defs.def_en: If someone's patience, for example, is wearing thin, they are beginning to become impatient or angry with someone.

ext.ext_cn: 身居高位的人玩的那些小的权力游戏
ext.ext_en: ...the little power games that people in high places play.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a situation in which different people or groups are competing for power as a power game, especially if you disapprove of the methods they are using in order to try to win power.
A rowboat is a small boat that you move through the water by using oars.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个军事独裁者，在一场军事政变后成为这个国家的统治者。
ext.ext_en: He was a military strongman who ruled the country after a coup.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a male political leader as a strongman, you mean that he has great power and control over his country, although his methods may sometimes be violent or morally wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 终于要对政府官员实行问责了。
ext.ext_en: Public officials can finally be held accountable for their actions...

ext.ext_cn: 主要的服务行业应该对它们的顾客负责。
ext.ext_en: The major service industries should be accountable to their customers.

defs.def_en: If you are accountable to someone for something that you do, you are responsible for it and must be prepared to justify your actions to that person.
A damson is a small, sour, purple plum.

defs.def_cn: 随意地放下；漫不经心地放下

ext.ext_cn: 梅拉妮把化妆盒砰的一声扔到椅子上。
ext.ext_en: Melanie plunked her cosmetic case down on a chair...

ext.ext_cn: 她拾起掉在地上的一顶帽子，随意地往头上一扣。
ext.ext_en: She swept up a hat from where it had fallen on the ground, and plunked it on her hair.

defs.def_en: If you plunk something somewhere, you put it there without great care.

ext.ext_cn: 我目送他们离去，然后一屁股坐在其中一把金属小椅子上。
ext.ext_en: I watched them go and plunked down on one of the small metal chairs.

defs.def_en: If you plunk yourself somewhere, or plunk down, you sit down heavily and clumsily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 悠然自得的；放松随和的

ext.ext_cn: 他万事无忧，日子过得十分悠游自在。
ext.ext_en: Nothing worried him, he was really laid back...

ext.ext_cn: 这里的每个人都是一副优哉游哉的态度。
ext.ext_en: Everyone here has a really laid-back attitude.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as laid-back, you mean that they behave in a calm relaxed way as if nothing will ever worry them.

ext.ext_cn: 他非常欣赏她祖父的画作。
ext.ext_en: He was an admirer of her grandfather's paintings.

defs.def_en: If you are an admirer of someone, you like and respect them or their work very much.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰尼是追她的人中最痴心、最没有心机的一个。
ext.ext_en: Johnny was the most persistent and most harmless of her admirers.

defs.def_en: A woman's admirers are the men who are attracted to her.

ext.ext_cn: 新鲜出炉的面包散发出的美妙香味
ext.ext_en: ...the wonderful aroma of freshly baked bread.

defs.def_en: An aroma is a strong, pleasant smell.
A cameraman is a person who operates a camera for television or film making.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不自在的；不安的；尴尬的

ext.ext_cn: 索要金钱让他们有些不安。
ext.ext_en: The request for money made them feel uncomfortable...

ext.ext_cn: 如果面对咨询顾问或治疗师时你觉得不自在，一定要提出来。
ext.ext_en: If you are uncomfortable with your counsellor or therapist, you must discuss it...

defs.def_en: If you are uncomfortable, you are slightly worried or embarrassed, and not relaxed and confident.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 头上老是顶着假发，又热又不舒服。
ext.ext_en: Wigs are hot and uncomfortable to wear constantly...

ext.ext_cn: 乘地铁返回市中心又热又不舒服。
ext.ext_en: The Metro journey back to the centre of the town was hot and uncomfortable.

defs.def_en: Something that is uncomfortable makes you feel slight pain or physical discomfort when you experience it or use it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我晚上吃完饭有时会觉得不舒服。
ext.ext_en: I sometimes feel uncomfortable after eating in the evening...

ext.ext_cn: 与吸烟者一起生活或工作的人会发现戴隐形眼镜不舒服，因为烟具有刺激作用。
ext.ext_en: People living or working with smokers can find it uncomfortable to wear contact lenses because the smoke causes irritation.

defs.def_en: If you are uncomfortable, you are not physically content and relaxed, and feel slight pain or discomfort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （处境、事实等）令人不快的，令人担忧的，令人不安的

ext.ext_cn: 想到人终有一死会感到不舒服，但我们不得不去面对。
ext.ext_en: It is uncomfortable to think of our own death, but we need to...

ext.ext_cn: 这些问题让人很难回答。
ext.ext_en: Such questions are uncomfortable to answer...

defs.def_en: You can describe a situation or fact as uncomfortable when it is difficult to deal with and causes problems and worries.

ext.ext_cn: 年复一年滥造同样产品的工厂
ext.ext_en: ...factories that banged out the same product year after year.

defs.def_en: If a company bangs out a poor quality product, they produce large quantities of it in order to make money.

defs.def_cn: （并不出色地用乐器大声）演奏出，敲出，砸出（某一乐曲）

ext.ext_cn: 他打地球开始转的时候就一直在弹奏的这同一首《铃鼓先生》
ext.ext_en: ...the same version of 'Mr Tambourine Man' he's been banging out since the world was young.

defs.def_en: If someone bangs out a tune on a musical instrument such as a piano, they play it loudly and not very well.

defs.def_cn: (常指喝醉后的)狂欢，欢闹，作乐

ext.ext_cn: 我们接近百老汇时，听到人们饮酒狂欢的声音越来越大。
ext.ext_en: As we got close to Broadway, we heard the sounds of revelry getting louder and louder.

ext.ext_cn: 新年狂欢
ext.ext_en: ...New Year revelries.

defs.def_en: Revelry is people enjoying themselves in a noisy way, often while they are drunk.

ext.ext_cn: 他说把社会中的任何一部分人抽选出来做艾滋病检查都是不对的。
ext.ext_en: He said it was wrong to single out any section of society for Aids testing...

ext.ext_cn: 他们为这艘船铸造了一个完整的新船头。
ext.ext_en: They moulded a complete new bow section for the boat.

defs.def_en: See also:cross-section;A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

defs.def_cn: 把…切成片;把…分成段(或组等)

ext.ext_cn: 将蔬菜削皮或切片时用它来固定。
ext.ext_en: It holds vegetables in place while they are being peeled or sectioned.

defs.def_en: If something is sectioned, it is divided into sections.

ext.ext_cn: 1968 年《商品说明法》第 14 条
ext.ext_en: ...section 14 of the Trade Descriptions Act 1968.

ext.ext_cn: 规定联邦政府权力的至关重要的条款
ext.ext_en: ...the all-important section on the powers of the federal government.

defs.def_en: A section of an official document such as a report, law, or constitution is one of the parts into which it is divided.

ext.ext_cn: 有些建筑的立面图能比平面图提供更多的信息。
ext.ext_en: For some buildings a vertical section is more informative than a plan.

defs.def_en: A section is a diagram of something such as a building or a part of the body. It shows how the object would appear to you if it were cut from top to bottom and looked at from the side.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她不惧权威，幽默风趣，很受欢迎。
ext.ext_en: She's irreverent, fun and hugely popular...

ext.ext_cn: 泰勒知识渊博，而且并不把历史太当回事。
ext.ext_en: Taylor combined great knowledge with an irreverent attitude to history.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as irreverent, you mean that they do not show respect for people or things that are generally respected.

ext.ext_cn: 英国电信业
ext.ext_en: ...the UK telecommunications industry.

ext.ext_cn: 日本电信公司
ext.ext_en: ...a Japanese telecommunication company.

defs.def_en: Telecommunications is the technology of sending signals and messages over long distances using electronic equipment, for example by radio and telephone.

ext.ext_cn: 还有5兆的网络空间，你可以建立你的个人网站。
ext.ext_en: There's also 5Mb of webspace so that you can create your own personal web site.

defs.def_en: Webspace is computer memory that you can use to create web pages.

ext.ext_cn: 克罗斯没有答话，脸上的表情也毫无变化。
ext.ext_en: Cross didn't answer; his facial expression didn't change...

ext.ext_cn: 我落得个面部受伤，进了医院。
ext.ext_en: I ended up in hospital with facial injuries.

defs.def_en: Facial means appearing on or being part of your face.
A facial is a sort of beauty treatment in which someone's face is massaged, and creams and other substances are rubbed into it.

ext.ext_cn: 这里只有我一个人，我知道我会迷路的。
ext.ext_en: I'm here all by myself and I know I'm going to get lost...

ext.ext_cn: 好了，我不能一整天就站在这里闲聊。
ext.ext_en: Well, I can't stand here chatting all day.

defs.def_en: You use here when you are referring to the place where you are.

defs.def_cn: 在此处（指所指向的地方）

ext.ext_cn: 请在这里签字
ext.ext_en: ...if you will just sign here...

ext.ext_cn: 过来坐这里，劳伦。
ext.ext_en: Come and sit here, Lauren...

defs.def_en: You use here when you are pointing towards a place that is near you, in order to draw someone else's attention to it.

ext.ext_cn: 我这位朋友是个电台撰稿人。
ext.ext_en: My friend here writes for radio...

ext.ext_cn: 我身边这位是格伦·威廉斯先生。
ext.ext_en: I have here at my side Mr. Glenn Williams...

defs.def_en: You use here in order to indicate that the person or thing that you are talking about is near you or is being held by you.

ext.ext_cn: 我们从哪里来，到哪里去，或者倘若我们活在人世间有何目的的话，这个目的是什么
ext.ext_en: ...where we have come from, where we are going to, or what our purpose here is, if any...

ext.ext_cn: 我们是谁？我们在人世间做什么？
ext.ext_en: Who are we? What are we doing here?

defs.def_en: You use here to refer to people in general and their life on Earth.

ext.ext_cn: 我是来帮你的。
ext.ext_en: I'm here to help you...

ext.ext_cn: 我不是来听你抱怨的。
ext.ext_en: I'm not here to listen to your complaints.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are here to do something, that is your role or function.

ext.ext_cn: “出租车来了，”她礼貌地说。
ext.ext_en: 'Here's the taxi,' she said politely...

ext.ext_cn: “卡明斯先生来了，”她把门敞着说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Mr Cummings is here,' she said, holding the door open...

defs.def_en: You use here in order to draw attention to something or someone who has just arrived in the place where you are, or to draw attention to the place you have just arrived at.

defs.def_cn: 在这一点上;在这一阶段;在这一方面

ext.ext_cn: 双方都必须要让各自的民众接受这项协议。真正的考验就在这里。
ext.ext_en: Both sides will have to sell the agreement to their people. It's here that the real test will come...

ext.ext_cn: 我们就是在这一点上面临方法上的分歧。
ext.ext_en: It's here that we come up against the difference of approach...

defs.def_en: You use here to refer to a particular point or stage of a situation or subject that you have come to or that you are dealing with.

ext.ext_cn: 夏天到了。
ext.ext_en: Here comes the summer...

ext.ext_cn: 经济开始复苏。
ext.ext_en: Economic recovery is here...

defs.def_en: You use here to refer to a period of time, a situation, or an event that is present or happening now.

defs.def_cn: （用在句首以引起注意或引出介绍）下面，以下

ext.ext_cn: 以下是我们来自内罗毕的东非记者科林·布兰的报道。
ext.ext_en: From Nairobi here's our East Africa correspondent, Colin Blane...

ext.ext_cn: 接下来是一道几乎可以抵作一餐的夏季汤品。
ext.ext_en: Here is a summer soup that is almost a meal in itself...

defs.def_en: You use here at the beginning of a sentence in order to draw attention to something or to introduce something.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以给我打电话——给你，这是我母亲的电话号码。
ext.ext_en: You know you can phone me — here's my mother's number...

ext.ext_cn: 给你的咖啡，按你的口味冲的。
ext.ext_en: Here's your coffee, just the way you like it...

defs.def_en: You use here when you are offering or giving something to someone.

defs.def_cn: （表示接下来对某人性格或处境的描述出人意料）看看，瞧瞧

ext.ext_cn: 看看你，说这些难听的话。
ext.ext_en: Here you are, saying these terrible things...

ext.ext_cn: 瞧瞧我们，装出一副胜利者的姿态。
ext.ext_en: Here we are, pretending we're winning.

defs.def_en: You say 'here we are' or 'here you are' when the statement that you are making about someone's character or situation is unexpected.

ext.ext_cn: 我翻遍了抽屉，找出了阿曼达的文件夹。“找到了。”
ext.ext_en: I rummaged through the drawers and came up with Amanda's folder. 'Here we are.'

defs.def_en: You say 'here we are' when you have just found something that you have been looking for.

defs.def_cn: （表示即将开始做或说困难或令人不快的事）这就开始

ext.ext_cn: 卡尔弗医生紧张地嘟囔了一句“要打了啊”，然后就给小女孩打了一针。
ext.ext_en: Dr Culver nervously muttered 'Here goes,' and gave the little girl an injection.

defs.def_en: You say 'here goes' when you are about to do or say something difficult or unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: （尤指令人不快的事）又发生了，又来了

ext.ext_cn: “警察！开门！”——“哎呀。”我想，“又来了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Police! Open up!' — 'Oh well,' I thought, 'here we go.'...

ext.ext_cn: 起先，他被告知他太年轻了，我心想，“哎，又是老一套。”
ext.ext_en: At first, he was told he was too young and I thought, 'Oh, boy, here we go again.'...

defs.def_en: You use expressions such as 'here we go' and 'here we go again' in order to indicate that something is happening again in the way that you expected, especially something unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 我是一名此时此刻只想治病救人的执业医师。
ext.ext_en: I'm a practicing physician trying to help people here and now...

ext.ext_cn: 你没有紧扣眼前所发生的事，而是只提出了一些过去的类似事例。
ext.ext_en: Instead of staying in the here and now, you bring up similar instances from the past.

defs.def_en: You use here and now to emphasize that something is happening at the present time, rather than in the future or past, or that you would like it to happen at the present time.

ext.ext_cn: 我零零散散地到处教些课。
ext.ext_en: I do a bit of teaching here and there...

ext.ext_cn: 他只能零星地听懂一两个单词。
ext.ext_en: He could only understand a word here and there.

defs.def_en: If something happens here and there, it happens in several different places.

defs.def_cn: （祝酒词）为我们干杯/为你的新工作干杯

ext.ext_cn: 他举起杯子： “各位高邻，干了这杯！”
ext.ext_en: He raised his glass. 'Here's to neighbors.'...

ext.ext_cn: 托尼微笑着举起杯子。“为你干一杯，埃米。”
ext.ext_en: Tony smiled and lifted his glass. 'Here's to you, Amy.'

defs.def_en: You use expressions such as 'here's to us' and 'here's to your new job' before drinking a toast in order to wish someone success or happiness.

defs.def_cn: 薄荷酱(一种用薄荷叶、醋和糖制成的酱，常与羊肉一起食用)
defs.def_en: Mint sauce is a sauce made from mint leaves, vinegar, and sugar, which is often eaten with lamb.

defs.def_cn: 知名的；出了名的；已知的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个臭名昭著的毒贩子。
ext.ext_en: ...He was a known drug dealer...

ext.ext_cn: 他成了他那个时期最著名的演员之一。
ext.ext_en: He became one of the best known actors of his day...

defs.def_en: You use known to describe someone or something that is clearly recognized by or familiar to all people or to a particular group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 他的影视作品更为出名。
ext.ext_en: He is better known for his film and TV work.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is known for a particular achievement or feature, they are familiar to many people because of that achievement or feature.

defs.def_cn: 使人们知道（或清楚）；明确表示

ext.ext_cn: 首相对此明确表示反对。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister has let it be known that he is against it...

ext.ext_cn: 他向记者公开了他的偏好。
ext.ext_en: He let his preference be known to the press.

defs.def_en: If you let it be known that something is the case, or you let something be known, you make sure that people know it or can find out about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 工会指责威尔沙反复无常,不讲民主。
ext.ext_en: The Union accused Walesa of being capricious and undemocratic.

ext.ext_cn: 任意妄为且残忍成性的领导人
ext.ext_en: ...capricious and often brutal leaders.

defs.def_en: Someone who is capricious often changes their mind unexpectedly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 变幻莫测的;变幻无常的

ext.ext_cn: 双方一直在为风向飘忽不定而苦恼。
ext.ext_en: Both sides were troubled throughout by a capricious wind.

ext.ext_cn: 音响效果时好时坏、饱受诟病的剧院
ext.ext_en: ...a theatre with notoriously capricious acoustics.

defs.def_en: Something that is capricious often changes unexpectedly.

ext.ext_cn: 国泰航空公司每天都有从希思罗机场直飞香港的航班。
ext.ext_en: Cathay Pacific flies daily non-stop to Hong Kong from Heathrow...

ext.ext_cn: 游客中心每日上午 8:30 至下午 4:30 开放。
ext.ext_en: The Visitor Centre is open daily 8.30 a.m. – 4.30 p.m.

defs.def_en: If something happens daily, it happens every day.

ext.ext_cn: 包含了足量一天所需新鲜水果的饮食
ext.ext_en: ...a diet containing adequate daily amounts of fresh fruit...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的平均日营业额约为 300 英镑。
ext.ext_en: Our average daily turnover is about £300.

defs.def_en: Daily quantities or rates relate to a period of one day.

ext.ext_cn: 几份当地的日报散放在桌子上。
ext.ext_en: Copies of the local daily had been scattered on a table.

ext.ext_cn: 他仔细阅读这些日报。
ext.ext_en: He studied the daily papers.

defs.def_en: A daily is a newspaper that is published every day of the week except Sunday.

ext.ext_cn: 政府没能改善大多数人的日常生活
ext.ext_en: ...the failure of the government to improve most people's daily lives.

defs.def_en: Your daily life is the things that you do every day as part of your normal life.

defs.def_cn: 唯一重要的事物；全部；根本

ext.ext_cn: 对于有些人来说，赛跑的全部意义就是竞争。
ext.ext_en: For some people, competing is the be-all and end-all of their running.

defs.def_en: If something is the be-all and end-all to you, it is the only important thing in your life, or the only important feature of a particular activity.

defs.def_cn: （自行车或摩托车后轮两侧的）挂包，挂篮，挂篓
defs.def_en: A pannier is one of two bags or boxes for carrying things in, which are fixed on each side of the back wheel of a bicycle or motorbike.

defs.def_cn: （通常挂在驮兽两侧的）驮篮，驮篓，驮包
defs.def_en: A pannier is a large basket or bag, usually one of two that are put over an animal and used for carrying loads.

ext.ext_cn: 他仍然不时给她写写信，每年寄张圣诞贺卡。
ext.ext_en: He still writes to her sometimes and sends her a Christmas card every year.

defs.def_en: Christmas cards are cards with greetings, which people send to their friends and family at Christmas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行为或想法）疯癫的，神经的，古怪的（一些人认为用该词具冒犯意味）

ext.ext_cn: 她打算干什么？她跟她那兄弟一样神经！
ext.ext_en: What's she up to? She's as loony as her brother!

ext.ext_cn: 癫狂的女权主义者的无稽之谈
ext.ext_en: ...loony feminist nonsense.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour or ideas as loony, you mean that they seem mad, strange, or eccentric. Some people consider this use offensive.

defs.def_cn: 疯子，怪胎，神经病（一些人认为用该词具冒犯意味）

ext.ext_cn: 一开始他们都以为我是个疯子。
ext.ext_en: At first they all thought I was a loony.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a loony, you mean that they behave in a way that seems mad, strange, or eccentric. Some people consider this use offensive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 体恤的;体贴的;善解人意的

ext.ext_cn: 班主任必须对小学生的需求体察入微。
ext.ext_en: The classroom teacher must be sensitive to a child's needs...

ext.ext_cn: 他总是如此理解和关心别人。
ext.ext_en: He was always so sensitive and caring.

defs.def_en: If you are sensitive to other people's needs, problems, or feelings, you show understanding and awareness of them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 易生气的;易担忧的;敏感的

ext.ext_cn: 年轻人对外表很在意。
ext.ext_en: Young people are very sensitive about their appearance...

ext.ext_cn: 放松点，别这么敏感。
ext.ext_en: Take it easy. Don't be so sensitive.

defs.def_en: If you are sensitive about something, you are easily worried and offended when people talk about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (问题、话题)敏感的，棘手的，易引起纷争的，须谨慎对待的

ext.ext_cn: 就业是一个非常棘手的问题。
ext.ext_en: Employment is a very sensitive issue.

ext.ext_cn: 政治敏感事件
ext.ext_en: ...politically sensitive matters.

defs.def_en: A sensitive subject or issue needs to be dealt with carefully because it is likely to cause disagreement or make people angry or upset.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (文件、报告)机密的，须小心对待的，须妥善保管的

ext.ext_cn: 他吩咐员工将机密文件用碎纸机销毁。
ext.ext_en: He instructed staff to shred sensitive documents.

ext.ext_cn: 落入敌人手中会危及英军安全的机要情报
ext.ext_en: ...sensitive information which, in the wrong hands, could jeopardise the safety of British troops.

defs.def_en: Sensitive documents or reports contain information that needs to be kept secret and dealt with carefully.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 过敏的;易受影响的;敏感的

ext.ext_cn: 对光敏感的化学品
ext.ext_en: ...a chemical which is sensitive to light.

ext.ext_cn: 适用于敏感性皮肤的温和化妆品
ext.ext_en: ...gentle cosmetics for sensitive skin.

defs.def_en: Something that is sensitive to a physical force, substance, or treatment is easily affected by it and often harmed by it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (科学仪器)灵敏的，灵敏度高的

ext.ext_cn: 高灵敏度的显微镜
ext.ext_en: ...an extremely sensitive microscope.

defs.def_en: A sensitive piece of scientific equipment is capable of measuring or recording very small changes.

defs.def_cn: （装饰帽子、家具等的）绒球；（美国橄榄球比赛时拉拉队用的）塑料丝球

ext.ext_cn: 当地女孩戴的宽边、有红色绒球的帽子
ext.ext_en: ...wide-brimmed hats with red pom-poms worn by the local girls.

defs.def_en: A pom-pom is a ball of threads which is used to decorate things such as hats or furniture. In the United States, cheerleaders wave large pom-poms at football matches.
A cultivator is a tool or machine which is used to break up the earth or to remove weeds, for example in a garden or field.
A cultivator is someone who prepares the ground and grows crops in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 交通事故仍然是造成美国人过早死亡的头号因素。
ext.ext_en: Accidents are still the number one cause of premature death for Americans...

ext.ext_cn: 因为膝盖接二连三地受伤，他的职业生涯提前结束了。
ext.ext_en: His career was brought to a premature end by a succession of knee injuries.

defs.def_en: Something that is premature happens earlier than usual or earlier than people expect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不成熟的；过早的；草率的

ext.ext_cn: 现在看来他们高兴得太早了。
ext.ext_en: It now seems their optimism was premature...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为餐馆提出那样的建议太草率了。
ext.ext_en: I think it's premature for restaurants to come out with that advice.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is premature when it happens too early and is therefore inappropriate.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 即使是很小的早产儿也会对母亲的出现做出反应。
ext.ext_en: Even very young premature babies respond to their mother's presence...

ext.ext_cn: 我女儿埃玛出生时提前了两个半月。
ext.ext_en: When my daughter Emma was born she was two and a half months premature.

defs.def_en: A premature baby is one that was born before the date when it was expected to be born.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 因块头大而造成的笨拙
ext.ext_en: ...elephantine clumsiness...

ext.ext_cn: 他的腿很粗壮。
ext.ext_en: His legs were elephantine.
