ext.ext_cn: 椅子首先应该舒适。
ext.ext_en: Above all, chairs should be comfortable...

ext.ext_cn: 社会服务部门必须认可的，首先是父母的角色。
ext.ext_en: Social services departments must accept, above all, the role of the parents.

defs.def_en: You say above all to indicate that the thing you are mentioning is the most important point.

ext.ext_cn: 我以为你可能认识某个重要人物。毕竟你交游甚广。
ext.ext_en: I thought you might know somebody. After all, you're the man with connections.

defs.def_en: You use after all when introducing a statement which supports or helps explain something you have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 我到这儿来就想碰碰运气，没想到你居然真的在家。
ext.ext_en: I came out here on the chance of finding you at home after all...

ext.ext_cn: 社会民主党人竟然说他们准备开始谈判加入联合政府了。
ext.ext_en: The Social Democrats say they are ready after all to begin talks on joining a coalition government.

defs.def_en: You use after all when you are saying that something that you thought might not be the case is in fact the case.

ext.ext_cn: 他把香肠丢在人行道上，不知是谁家的狗将香肠甚至连带芥末都吃个了精光。
ext.ext_en: He dropped his sausage on the pavement and someone's dog ate it, mustard and all.

defs.def_en: You use and all when you want to emphasize that what you are talking about includes the thing mentioned, especially when this is surprising or unusual.

defs.def_cn: 总的说来；从各方面来说；总之

ext.ext_cn: 我们两人都认为总的说来它或许不是个坏主意。
ext.ext_en: We both thought that all in all it might not be a bad idea...

ext.ext_cn: 总之，等待琼斯的似乎是一个相当令人沮丧的夏天。
ext.ext_en: All in all, it appeared that a pretty depressing summer awaited Jones.

defs.def_en: You use all in all to introduce a summary or general statement.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定句、条件句、疑问句等的句末）全然，一点，根本，究竟

ext.ext_cn: 罗宾从未真正喜欢过他。
ext.ext_en: Robin never really liked him at all...

ext.ext_cn: 那儿根本没有公路。
ext.ext_en: There were no roads at all...

defs.def_en: You use at all at the end of a clause to give emphasis in negative statements, conditional clauses, and questions.

ext.ext_cn: 除了他那些铁杆崇拜者外，这位将军对于其他人并无吸引力。
ext.ext_en: The general was an unattractive man to all but his most ardent admirers...

ext.ext_cn: 除了最严寒的冬季，这种植物都能在户外生长。
ext.ext_en: The plant will stand all but the worst winters out of doors.

defs.def_en: All but a particular person or thing means everyone or everything except that person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 曾经将这座城市分隔开的混凝土墙现在已几乎不复存在。
ext.ext_en: The concrete wall that used to divide this city has now all but gone...

ext.ext_cn: 他几乎已被人遗忘。
ext.ext_en: He has been all but forgotten.

defs.def_en: You use all but to say that something is almost the case.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管有缺陷，这部电影还是迅速成为了一部经典作品。
ext.ext_en: For all its faults, the film instantly became a classic.

defs.def_en: You use for all to indicate that the thing mentioned does not affect or contradict the truth of what you are saying.

defs.def_cn: （用于强调）我可不知道/他才不在乎呢

ext.ext_cn: 说不定他或许都已不在这个国家了。
ext.ext_en: For all we know, he may even not be in this country...

ext.ext_cn: 你可以马上走，我才不在乎呢。
ext.ext_en: You can go right now for all I care.

defs.def_en: You use for all in phrases such as for all I know, and for all he cares, to emphasize that you do not know something or that someone does not care about something.

ext.ext_cn: 每次比赛他都全力以赴。
ext.ext_en: He puts his all into every game.

defs.def_en: If you give your all or put your all into something, you make the maximum effort possible.

ext.ext_cn: 总共有大概1,500万人住在所选定的区域内。
ext.ext_en: In all some 15 million people live in the selected areas...

ext.ext_cn: 有证据表明共计13人参与策划了这起谋杀。
ext.ext_en: There was evidence that thirteen people in all had taken part in planning the murder.

defs.def_en: In all means in total.

ext.ext_cn: “你吃饭了吗？——你看上去累坏了！”
ext.ext_en: 'Have you eaten? — You look all in!'

defs.def_en: If you say that you are all in, you mean that you are extremely tired.

ext.ext_cn: 正餐价格什么都算上大约为25英镑。
ext.ext_en: Dinner is about £25 all in.

defs.def_en: If something such as an activity is a particular price all in, that price includes everything that is offered.

defs.def_cn: （用于强调first, last或最高级形容词或副词）最，最为

ext.ext_cn: 首先，回答这些问题。
ext.ext_en: First of all, answer these questions...

ext.ext_cn: 现在她面临着最艰巨的任务。
ext.ext_en: Now she faces her toughest task of all.

defs.def_en: You use of all to emphasize the words 'first' or 'last', or a superlative adjective or adverb.

defs.def_cn: 在所有的人(或事物）中偏偏

ext.ext_cn: 那么多地方，他们偏偏就在超市里相遇并相爱了。
ext.ext_en: They met and fell in love in a supermarket, of all places.

defs.def_en: You use of all in expressions such as of all people or of all things when you want to emphasize someone or something surprising.

defs.def_cn: （用于对他人的言行表示愤怒或吃惊）真不要脸/运气真好

ext.ext_cn: 这是多么懒惰、冷漠、不敬业的态度！
ext.ext_en: Of all the lazy, indifferent, unbusinesslike attitudes to have!

defs.def_en: You use all in expressions like of all the cheek or of all the luck to emphasize how angry or surprised you are at what someone else has done or said.

ext.ext_cn: 足足过了41分钟他才进了第一个球。
ext.ext_en: It took him all of 41 minutes to score his first goal...

ext.ext_cn: 我只是要督促一下金，总共也就需要5分钟。
ext.ext_en: I'm just checking up on Kim. It'll take me all of five minutes.

defs.def_en: You use all of before a number to emphasize how small or large an amount is.

ext.ext_cn: 负责国民医疗服务制度改革并未使得所有人都喜欢他。
ext.ext_en: Being in charge of the National Health Service reforms did not endear him to one and all.

defs.def_en: One and all means everyone present or everyone in a particular group.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定句中削弱语气）那么

ext.ext_cn: 他并不真比我们老多少。
ext.ext_en: He wasn't all that older than we were...

ext.ext_cn: 他说和平解决这一冲突并不会太困难。
ext.ext_en: He said it would not be all that difficult to reach a peaceful conclusion to the conflict.

defs.def_en: You use all that in statements with negative meaning when you want to weaken the force of what you are saying.

defs.def_cn: 没别的了；就是这么回事

ext.ext_cn: “你为什么想知道那件事？”他问道。——“只是好奇，仅此而已。”
ext.ext_en: 'Why do you want to know that?' he demanded.—'Just curious, that's all.'

ext.ext_cn: “我不渴望当妈妈，我有一个孩子了，如此而已。”
ext.ext_en: 'I had no desire to be a mother — I had a child, that's all.'

defs.def_en: You can say that's all at the end of a sentence when you are explaining something and want to emphasize that nothing more happens or is the case.

ext.ext_cn: 鼓励那些自身并不富裕的人更多地投身慈善事业固然没错，但这么做真的公平吗？
ext.ext_en: It is all very well to urge people to give more to charity when they have less, but is it really fair?

defs.def_en: You use all very well to suggest that you do not really approve of something or you think that it is unreasonable.
A fireball is a ball of fire, for example one at the centre of a nuclear explosion.
Balsa or balsa wood is a very light wood from a South American tree.

ext.ext_cn: 英国最高的白垩悬崖
ext.ext_en: ...the highest chalk cliffs in Britain...

ext.ext_cn: 她的皮肤看上去苍白发干。
ext.ext_en: Her skin was chalk white and dry-looking.

defs.def_en: Chalk is a type of soft white rock. You can use small pieces of it for writing or drawing with.

ext.ext_cn: 在用粉笔写字的某人
ext.ext_en: ...somebody writing with a piece of chalk.

ext.ext_cn: 用彩色粉笔画一幅小图
ext.ext_en: ...drawing a small picture with coloured chalks.

defs.def_en: Chalk is small sticks of chalk, or a substance similar to chalk, used for writing or drawing with.

ext.ext_cn: 他用粉笔将消息写在黑板上。
ext.ext_en: He chalked the message on the blackboard...

ext.ext_cn: 黑板上用粉笔写着7个人名。
ext.ext_en: There was a blackboard with seven names chalked on it.

defs.def_en: If you chalk something, you draw or write it using a piece of chalk.

ext.ext_cn: 他坚持说那两个地方有天壤之别。
ext.ext_en: The two places, he insists, are as different as chalk and cheese...

ext.ext_cn: 我们非常清楚相互之间的差异，并且承认自己是截然不同的两类人。
ext.ext_en: We are very aware of our differences, we accept that we are chalk and cheese.

defs.def_en: If you say that two people or things are like chalk and cheese, you are emphasizing that they are completely different from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 我们其余几个人还没有喝完，还差得远呢。
ext.ext_en: The rest of us hadn't finished our drinks, not by a long chalk.

defs.def_en: You can use by a long chalk to add emphasis to something you are saying.

defs.def_cn: 杂乱无章的一堆东西;大杂烩

ext.ext_cn: 这座宫殿完全是各种建筑风格的大杂烩。
ext.ext_en: The palace is a complete hotch-potch of architectural styles.

defs.def_en: A hotch-potch is an untidy mixture of different types of things.
The  Mediterranean is the sea between southern Europe and North Africa.

defs.def_cn: 地中海地区(指欧洲南部地中海附近地区)

ext.ext_cn: 地中海地区最有活力、最为繁荣的城市之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the most dynamic and prosperous cities in the Mediterranean.

defs.def_en: The Mediterranean refers to the southern part of Europe, which is next to the Mediterranean Sea.

defs.def_cn: 地中海的;地中海地区的;地中海居民的

ext.ext_cn: 地道的地中海饮食
ext.ext_en: ...the classic Mediterranean diet.

defs.def_en: Something that is Mediterranean is characteristic of or belongs to the people or region around the Mediterranean Sea.

defs.def_cn: (作为许多动词的结尾形式)表示“使…化”，“使处于…的新状态”

ext.ext_cn: 那一争论可能会使谈判处于险境。
ext.ext_en: The dispute could jeopardize the negotiations.

ext.ext_cn: 一种试图将具体做法规范化、标准化的途径
ext.ext_en: ...a way of trying to regularize and standardize practice.

defs.def_en: Verbs that can end in either '-ize' or '-ise' are dealt with in this dictionary at the '-ize' spelling. Many verbs ending in -ize describe processes by which things or people are brought into a new state.

defs.def_cn: 操持家务的丈夫;家庭主夫
defs.def_en: A house-husband is a married man who does not have a paid job, but instead looks after his home and children.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 操纵的;控制的;善于摆布（他人）的

ext.ext_cn: 他说郎先生是个冷酷、算计，又爱摆布人的人。
ext.ext_en: He described Mr Long as cold, calculating and manipulative...

ext.ext_cn: 这个工人尽管盛气凌人，工于心计，却受到了提拔。
ext.ext_en: The worker was promoted despite aggressive and manipulative behaviour.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as manipulative, you disapprove of them because they skilfully force or persuade people to act in the way that they want.

defs.def_cn: 着火的；燃烧着的；看似着火的

ext.ext_cn: 房子着火了，但是只有7位职员受轻伤。
ext.ext_en: The houses were set afire but there were only minor injuries to seven personnel...

ext.ext_cn: 太阳已经落山，但天空中还映照着如火般橙绿相间的余晖。
ext.ext_en: The sun has already set, leaving the sky afire with orange and green light.

defs.def_en: If something is afire or is set afire, it is on fire or looks as if it is on fire.

defs.def_cn: 热情洋溢的；极其热衷的

ext.ext_cn: 丹所有的感官都燃烧着激情。
ext.ext_en: All Dan's senses were afire...

ext.ext_cn: 悉尼全城燃烧着奥林匹克的热情。
ext.ext_en: Sydney is afire with Olympic enthusiasm.

defs.def_en: If someone is afire with emotion, they are extremely enthusiastic and excited about something.

ext.ext_cn: 他忙不迭地向我保证，并没有什么悲惨的事要诉说。
ext.ext_en: He hastened to assure me that there was nothing traumatic to report...

ext.ext_cn: “你确定木筏安全吗？”她不安地问道。“再安全不过了，”马克斯信心十足地向她保证道。
ext.ext_en: 'Are you sure the raft is safe?' she asked anxiously. 'Couldn't be safer,' Max assured her confidently...

defs.def_en: See also:assured;If you assure someone that something is true or will happen, you tell them that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, often in order to make them less worried.

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚大胜伯明翰城队实际上已确保他们能够晋级。
ext.ext_en: Last night's resounding victory over Birmingham City has virtually assured them of promotion...

ext.ext_cn: 必须想办法保证我们的孩子有一个不错的人生开端。
ext.ext_en: Ways must be found to assure our children a decent start in life.

defs.def_en: To assure someone of something means to make certain that they will get it.

defs.def_cn: 我可以向你保证；相信我

ext.ext_cn: 我可以向你保证动物们得到了精心照顾。
ext.ext_en: I can assure you that the animals are well cared for...

ext.ext_cn: 这听上去也许微不足道，但是，相信我，它十分重要！
ext.ext_en: This may sound trivial, but I assure you it is quite important!...

defs.def_en: You use phrases such as I can assure you or let me assure you to emphasize the truth of what you are saying.
In computing, a kilobyte is one thousand bytes of data.

ext.ext_cn: 他们绕过合恩角时，暴风雨已经减弱。
ext.ext_en: The storms had abated by the time they rounded Cape Horn.

ext.ext_cn: 丝毫没有减弱迹象的犯罪势头
ext.ext_en: ...a crime wave that shows no sign of abating.

defs.def_en: If something bad or undesirable abates, it becomes much less strong or severe.
A killer bee is a type of bee which is very aggressive and likely to attack and sting people.

ext.ext_cn: 我提议对我们的主人表示感谢。
ext.ext_en: I would like to propose a vote of thanks to our host.

defs.def_en: A vote of thanks is an official speech in which the speaker formally thanks a person for doing something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有用的；可用的；有助益的

ext.ext_cn: 慢炖锅对于整天都不在家的人来说很有用。
ext.ext_en: The slow cooker is very useful for people who go out all day...

ext.ext_cn: 催眠疗法可能有助于你戒烟。
ext.ext_en: Hypnotherapy can be useful in helping you give up smoking...

defs.def_en: If something is useful, you can use it to do something or to help you in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 住处离会所有一段距离，所以租一辆车会很有用。
ext.ext_en: The accommodation is some distance from the clubhouse, so a hire car comes in useful.

defs.def_en: If an object or skill comes in useful, it can help you achieve something in a particular situation.
Antibodies are substances which a person's or an animal's body produces in their blood in order to destroy substances which carry disease.

defs.def_cn: （指可能会说明真相的故事）真实性可疑的，虚构的，杜撰的

ext.ext_cn: 这很可能是个杜撰的故事。
ext.ext_en: This may well be an apocryphal story...

ext.ext_cn: 故事讲述一位英国摩托车手在美国度假，但未必真实。
ext.ext_en: There is a story, probably apocryphal, about a British motorcyclist on holiday in America.

defs.def_en: An apocryphal story is one which is probably not true or did not happen, but which may give a true picture of someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 我们通常一天吃一顿大餐。
ext.ext_en: We usually had one slap-up meal a day.

defs.def_en: A slap-up meal is a large enjoyable meal.

At events such as formal dinners, award ceremonies, and variety shows, the master of ceremonies is the person who introduces the speakers or performers, and who announces what is going to happen next.

defs.def_cn: 堕落者;放荡者;行为不检的人

ext.ext_cn: 一个行为不检的醉鬼
ext.ext_en: ...a drunken reprobate.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a reprobate, you mean that they behave in a way that is not respectable or morally correct.

ext.ext_cn: 有时候他们因自己的轻率而搭上性命。
ext.ext_en: Occasionally they paid for their indiscretion with their lives.

ext.ext_cn: 因10年前做过的糊涂事惩罚我
ext.ext_en: ...punishing me for an indiscretion committed a decade ago.

defs.def_en: If you talk about someone's indiscretion, you mean that they have done or said something that is risky, careless, or likely to upset people.

defs.def_cn: (疾病)无法治愈的，不可医治的

ext.ext_cn: 他患有无法根治的皮肤病。
ext.ext_en: He is suffering from an incurable skin disease.

defs.def_en: If someone has an incurable disease, they cannot be cured of it.

defs.def_cn: 无法改变的;无可救药的

ext.ext_cn: 可怜的老威廉是个无可救药的浪漫主义者。
ext.ext_en: Poor old William is an incurable romantic...

ext.ext_cn: 你要么非常年轻,要么是个不可救药的乐天派。
ext.ext_en: You are either very young or an incurable optimist.

defs.def_en: You can use incurable to indicate that someone has a particular quality or attitude and will not change.

ext.ext_cn: 他们大多数晚上都在酒馆里呆着。
ext.ext_en: They're in the boozer most nights.

defs.def_en: A boozer is a pub.

ext.ext_cn: 我原以为他是个酒鬼。
ext.ext_en: I thought he was a bit of a boozer.

defs.def_en: A boozer is a person who drinks a lot of alcohol.
Flexitime is a system that allows employees to vary the time that they start or finish work, provided that an agreed total number of hours are spent at work.

ext.ext_cn: 与地毯协调搭配的粉色和米色相间的石板
ext.ext_en: ...slabs of pink and beige stone that harmonize with the carpet...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管芭芭拉·怀特和她的母亲音乐品味不太一致，她们还是喜欢一起听音乐。
ext.ext_en: Barbara White and her mother like to listen to music together, though their tastes don't harmonize.

defs.def_en: If two or more things harmonize with each other, they fit in well with each other.

defs.def_cn: 使（法律、制度或规则）协调;使统一

ext.ext_cn: 各成员国在使彼此经济协调一致的进程上会有多大进展？
ext.ext_en: How far will members have progressed towards harmonising their economies?

defs.def_en: When governments or organizations harmonize laws, systems, or regulations, they agree in a friendly way to make them the same or similar.

defs.def_cn: 用和声唱（或演奏）;为（主调）配和声

ext.ext_cn: 布雷默和加兰为主题曲《相逢圣路易斯》配和声。
ext.ext_en: Bremer and Garland harmonize on the title song, 'Meet Me in St. Louis'.

defs.def_en: When people harmonize, they sing or play notes which are different from the main tune but which sound nice with it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 下定决心的;决意的;坚定的

ext.ext_cn: 他的敌人决意要毁了他。
ext.ext_en: His enemies are determined to ruin him...

ext.ext_cn: 她是一位精明干练且意志坚定的政治家。
ext.ext_en: She is a remarkably adroit and determined politician...

defs.def_en: If you are determined to do something, you have made a firm decision to do it and will not let anything stop you.
A glockenspiel is a musical instrument which consists of metal bars of different lengths arranged like the keyboard of a piano. You play the glockenspiel by hitting the bars with wooden hammers.
A Master of Science degree is the same as an MSc or MS degree.
Dysentery is an infection in a person's intestines that causes them to pass a lot of waste, in which blood and mucus are mixed with the person's faeces.
A jacket potato is a large potato that has been baked with its skin on.

ext.ext_cn: 我和一些反对我们拍摄的人发生了小小的口角。
ext.ext_en: I had a slight altercation with some people who objected to our filming.

defs.def_en: An altercation is a noisy argument or disagreement.

ext.ext_cn: 我在街上没走几步就意识到自己迷路了。
ext.ext_en: Barely had I set foot in the street when I realised I was lost...

ext.ext_cn: 我拐错了弯，我们便在山里迷了路。
ext.ext_en: I took a wrong turn and we got lost in the mountains.

defs.def_en: If you are lost or if you get lost, you do not know where you are or are unable to find your way.

ext.ext_cn: 一本找不着的书
ext.ext_en: ...a lost book...

ext.ext_cn: 我的论文丢了。
ext.ext_en: My paper got lost...

defs.def_en: If something is lost, or gets lost, you cannot find it, for example because you have forgotten where you put it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 关于葬礼，他只记得那冷冷的天，那久久的等候和那种茫然若失的感觉。
ext.ext_en: Of the funeral he remembered only the cold, the waiting, and feeling very lost...

ext.ext_cn: 在陌生的城镇里只身一人，我感到不知所措、孤单寂寞。
ext.ext_en: I feel lost and lonely in a strange town alone.

defs.def_en: If you feel lost, you feel very uncomfortable because you are in an unfamiliar situation.

defs.def_cn: 迷惘的；无目标的；无方向的

ext.ext_cn: 他们属于迷惘的一代，想要找寻自我。
ext.ext_en: They are a lost generation in search of an identity.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or group of people as lost, you think that they do not have a clear idea of what they want to do or achieve.

ext.ext_cn: 他们失去的祖国
ext.ext_en: ...their lost homeland.

ext.ext_cn: 失去的工作或晋升机会
ext.ext_en: ...a lost job or promotion...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as lost, you mean that you no longer have it or it no longer exists.

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎很怀念逝去的青春。
ext.ext_en: He seemed to pine for his lost youth...

ext.ext_cn: 它们是与一个逝去的年代相联系的纽带。
ext.ext_en: They are links to a lost age.

defs.def_en: You use lost to refer to a period or state of affairs that existed in the past and no longer exists.

ext.ext_cn: 福克斯并没有对错过了参赛机会感到不忿。
ext.ext_en: Fox is not bitter about the lost opportunity to compete in the Games...

ext.ext_cn: 错失优势。
ext.ext_en: The advantage is lost.

defs.def_en: If something is lost, it is not used properly and is considered wasted.
If you tell someone to get lost, you are telling them in a very rude way to go away.

ext.ext_cn: 那意思我没听懂。
ext.ext_en: The meaning of that was lost on me...

ext.ext_cn: 显然，在这个街区你可能会因为一包香烟而遭人杀害。这个事实我不是没注意到。
ext.ext_en: This was a neighborhood where clearly you could be murdered for a pack of cigarettes, a fact that was not lost on me.

defs.def_en: If advice or a comment is lost on someone, they do not understand it or they pay no attention to it.

ext.ext_cn: 一时间她默不作声，直想得入了神，双眼直愣愣地盯着房间里扔得到处都是的书。
ext.ext_en: She was silent for a while, lost in thought, staring at the books littering the room.

defs.def_en: If you are lost in thought, you give all your attention to what you are thinking about and do not notice what is going on around you.

defs.def_cn: 没有…就不开心；没有…就不知所措

ext.ext_cn: 没有你在这里我都不知怎么办好。
ext.ext_en: I'd be lost without you here...

ext.ext_cn: 我热爱高尔夫，如果现在没有了它，我的生活就失去了乐趣。
ext.ext_en: I love the game and I'd be lost without golf now.

defs.def_en: If you say that you would be lost without someone or something, you mean that you would be unhappy or unable to work properly without them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一位涨红了脸的琼斯先生被警察带走了。
ext.ext_en: A red-faced Mr Jones was led away by police...

ext.ext_cn: 不管什么原因，他只要一生病，脸就会泛红。
ext.ext_en: Whenever he felt ill from any cause he became red-faced.

defs.def_en: A red-faced person has a face that looks red, often because they are embarrassed or angry.

defs.def_cn: （公司服务）网上开通的，网上经营的

ext.ext_cn: 第一家开通网上业务的银行
ext.ext_en: ...the first bank to go online.

ext.ext_cn: 网上购物中心
ext.ext_en: ...an online shopping centre.

defs.def_en: If a company goes online, its services become available on the Internet.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以和其他在线的人聊天。
ext.ext_en: You can chat to other people who are online.

ext.ext_cn: 可在网上找到的时髦玩意儿 on line
ext.ext_en: ...the cool stuff you find online.

defs.def_en: If you are online, your computer is connected to the Internet.  →see: line;

ext.ext_cn: 我们将门票收入都捐给了圣约翰急救队。
ext.ext_en: We gave the gate money to the St John Ambulance brigade.

defs.def_en: Gate money is the total amount of money that is paid by the people who go to a sports match or other event.
A delegate is a person who is chosen to vote or make decisions on behalf of a group of other people, especially at a conference or a meeting.

defs.def_cn: 授(权);把(职责、责任等)委托(给)

ext.ext_cn: 他打算把更多的权力交给副手。
ext.ext_en: He plans to delegate more authority to his deputies...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的活动有多少可以稳妥有效地委托给那些资质稍浅的员工来进行？
ext.ext_en: How many of their activities can be safely and effectively delegated to less trained staff?...

defs.def_en: If you delegate duties, responsibilities, or power to someone, you give them those duties, those responsibilities, or that power so that they can act on your behalf.

ext.ext_cn: 现在已经委派官员着手起草解决方案。
ext.ext_en: Officials have now been delegated to start work on a draft settlement.

defs.def_en: If you are delegated to do something, you are given the duty of acting on someone else's behalf by making decisions, voting, or doing some particular work.

defs.def_cn: 基层群众；平民百姓;草根阶层

ext.ext_cn: 你得参加基层党组织。
ext.ext_en: You have to join the party at grass-roots level.

defs.def_en: The grass roots of an organization or movement are the ordinary people who form the main part of it, rather than its leaders.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 以法国为背景的情色惊悚片
ext.ext_en: ...a steamy thriller set in France...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾和办公室里的一个同事有过一段热辣的婚外情。
ext.ext_en: He'd had a steamy affair with an office colleague.

defs.def_en: Steamy means involving exciting sex.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (地方)闷热潮湿的，充满水汽的

ext.ext_cn: 闷热潮湿的咖啡馆
ext.ext_en: ...a steamy cafe...

ext.ext_cn: 空气由于 100 个人散发的热量变得又热又闷。
ext.ext_en: The air was hot and steamy from the heat of a hundred bodies.

defs.def_en: A steamy place has hot, wet air.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 欲火中烧的;性欲旺盛的

ext.ext_cn: 但你难道不会有时觉得不满足吗？我的意思是，你难道不会感到，嗯，有点欲火中烧吗？
ext.ext_en: But don't you get frustrated sometimes? I mean, don't you get a bit, you know, horny?

ext.ext_cn: 满脑子都是性的青春期男孩
ext.ext_en: ...horny adolescent boys.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as horny, you mean that they are sexually aroused or that they easily become sexually aroused.

ext.ext_cn: 他的手指甲长得又长又硬。
ext.ext_en: His fingernails had grown long, and horny...

ext.ext_cn: 这只乌贼有一个笔状的角质内壳。
ext.ext_en: This cuttlefish has a horny internal shell like a pen.

defs.def_en: Something that is horny is hard, strong, and made of horn or of a hard substance like horn.

ext.ext_cn: 什么时候改善饮食都为时不晚。
ext.ext_en: It's never too late to improve your diet.

ext.ext_cn: 富含水果和蔬菜的健康饮食
ext.ext_en: ...a healthy diet rich in fruit and vegetables...

defs.def_en: Your diet is the type and range of food that you regularly eat.

defs.def_cn: (医生指定的)特别饮食，规定饮食

ext.ext_cn: 他按照医嘱要食用乳制品。
ext.ext_en: He was put on a diet of milky food.

ext.ext_cn: 专为胆固醇高的孩子准备的特别饮食
ext.ext_en: ...a special diet for children with high cholesterol.

defs.def_en: If a doctor puts someone on a diet, he or she makes them eat a special type or range of foods in order to improve their health.

defs.def_cn: （为减轻体重的）限制饮食，节食

ext.ext_cn: 你最近在节食吗？你瘦了好多。
ext.ext_en: Have you been on a diet? You've lost a lot of weight...

ext.ext_cn: 节食和锻炼会改变你的体形。
ext.ext_en: Diet and exercise will alter your shape...

defs.def_en: If you are on a diet, you eat special kinds of food or you eat less food than usual because you are trying to lose weight.

defs.def_cn: (为减轻体重而)限制饮食，节食

ext.ext_cn: 我生完第四个孩子后就一直在节食。
ext.ext_en: I've been dieting ever since the birth of my fourth child...

ext.ext_cn: 我们大多数人都曾在人生的某个时期为减肥而节食过。
ext.ext_en: Most of us have dieted at some time in our lives.

defs.def_en: If you are dieting, you eat special kinds of food or you eat less food than usual because you are trying to lose weight.

defs.def_cn: (饮料或食物)有助于减肥的，低热量的，低卡路里的

ext.ext_cn: 无糖低热量饮料
ext.ext_en: ...sugar-free diet drinks.

ext.ext_cn: 低卡路里的人造黄油
ext.ext_en: ...diet margarine.

defs.def_en: Diet drinks or foods have been specially produced so that they do not contain many calories.

defs.def_cn: (尤指令人不快或劣质的东西的)大量

ext.ext_cn: 他从广播里听到的都是千篇一律的流行歌曲。
ext.ext_en: The radio had fed him a diet of pop songs...

ext.ext_cn: 人们开始拒绝这种没完没了的绝望情绪。
ext.ext_en: People are rejecting this constant diet of despair.

defs.def_en: If you are fed on a diet of something, especially something unpleasant or of poor quality, you receive or experience a very large amount of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 多么愚蠢透顶的话！
ext.ext_en: What an idiotic thing to say!

defs.def_en: If you call someone or something idiotic, you mean that they are very stupid or silly.
The wing mirrors on a car are the mirrors on each side of the car on the outside.
A solar cell is a device that produces electricity from the sun's rays.

defs.def_cn: 单排滚轴溜冰鞋;直排轮滑鞋
defs.def_en: Rollerblades are a type of roller skates with a single line of wheels along the bottom.

ext.ext_cn: 她心情紧张起来，一颗心在胸膛里扑通扑通跳个不停。
ext.ext_en: Her heart had begun to pound inside her chest like a captive animal.

ext.ext_cn: 他描述了被俘4个月里挣扎求生的艰难岁月。
ext.ext_en: He described the difficulties of surviving for four months as a captive.

defs.def_en: A captive person or animal is being kept imprisoned or enclosed.

defs.def_cn: （观众）被强制的，受控制的;(市场)垄断的，没有选择权的

ext.ext_cn: 家长和赞助人被迫观看了我们表演的指令歌、滑稽小品和舞蹈。
ext.ext_en: We all performed action songs, sketches and dances before a captive audience of parents and patrons...

ext.ext_cn: 航空公司把商务旅行者视为垄断性市场。
ext.ext_en: Airlines consider business travellers a captive market.

defs.def_en: A captive audience is a group of people who are not free to leave a certain place and so have to watch or listen. A captive market is a group of people who cannot choose whether or where to buy things.

ext.ext_cn: 理查德在被扣押一年零六个星期后,终于在2月4日获释。
ext.ext_en: Richard was finally released on February 4, one year and six weeks after he'd been taken captive...

ext.ext_cn: 利比里亚的叛乱分子释放了4名被扣押了一个星期的外国人。
ext.ext_en: Rebels in Liberia have released four foreigners after holding them captive for a week.

defs.def_en: If you take someone captive or hold someone captive, you take or keep them as a prisoner.

defs.def_cn: 放弃，拒绝接受（想法、计划等）

ext.ext_cn: 政府似乎已经放弃了这个计划。
ext.ext_en: The Government seems to have jettisoned the plan.

defs.def_en: If you jettison something, for example an idea or a plan, you deliberately reject it or decide not to use it.

ext.ext_cn: 机组人员丢弃了多余燃料，紧急着陆。
ext.ext_en: The crew jettisoned excess fuel and made an emergency landing.

defs.def_en: To jettison something that is not needed or wanted means to throw it away or get rid of it.

defs.def_cn: 在(考试)中不及格;未通过(某一课程)

ext.ext_cn: 你儿子心烦意乱是因为没有通过历史考试。
ext.ext_en: Your son is upset because he flunked a history exam.

defs.def_en: If you flunk an exam or a course, you fail to reach the required standard.
A dinghy is a small open boat that you sail or row.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 能做些什么来减少那些难缠的反对者的影响呢？
ext.ext_en: What may be done to reduce the influence of intractable opponents?

defs.def_en: Intractable people are very difficult to control or influence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (问题或情况)棘手的,难处理的

ext.ext_cn: 经济仍然面临着一些棘手的问题。
ext.ext_en: The economy still faces intractable problems.

defs.def_en: Intractable problems or situations are very difficult to deal with.

ext.ext_cn: 彩色影片
ext.ext_en: ...films in Technicolor.

defs.def_en: Technicolor is a system of colour photography used in making cinema films.

defs.def_cn: （尤用作夸张）五彩缤纷，色彩斑斓

ext.ext_cn: 我所看见的一切——大山、山谷、湖泊和夏日的阳光全都绚丽多彩。
ext.ext_en: I was seeing it all in glorious technicolour: mountains, valleys, lakes, summer sunshine.

ext.ext_cn: 光怪陆离的梦境
ext.ext_en: ...Technicolor dreams.

defs.def_en: You can use technicolor to describe real or imagined scenes when you want to emphasize that they are very colourful, especially in an exaggerated way.

defs.def_cn: 正统观念；普遍接受的观念

ext.ext_cn: 这些观点迅速成为语言学中新的正统观念。
ext.ext_en: These ideas rapidly became the new orthodoxy in linguistics...

ext.ext_cn: 他抛开盛行的正统观念，问了一些难以回答的问题。
ext.ext_en: He broke from prevailing orthodoxies and asked the awkward questions...

defs.def_en: An orthodoxy is an accepted view about something.

defs.def_cn: （宗教、政党或哲学的）传统看法，正统信仰

ext.ext_cn: 肃清自由派、回归政治正统理念的最新举措
ext.ext_en: ...the latest step in a purge of liberals and a return to political orthodoxy.

ext.ext_cn: 纳特坚守宗教传统信仰与鲁布以赚钱为己任之间的冲突
ext.ext_en: ...a conflict between Nat's religious orthodoxy and Rube's belief that his mission is to make money.

defs.def_en: The old, traditional beliefs of a religion, political party, or philosophy can be referred to as orthodoxy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他说了一句很刻薄的话评论她的体重。
ext.ext_en: He made a snide comment about her weight...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不断地互相讽刺。
ext.ext_en: They kept making snide remarks about each other...

defs.def_en: A snide comment or remark is one which criticizes someone in an unkind and often indirect way.

ext.ext_cn: 他担任过改装赛车大赛的主持人。
ext.ext_en: He acted as grand marshal of a stock car race.

defs.def_en: A stock car is an old car which has had changes made to it so that it is suitable for races in which the cars often crash into each other.
Swimming trunks are the shorts that a man wears when he goes swimming.

defs.def_cn: （用于名词后构成形容词）表示“有…特性的”

ext.ext_cn: 烟雾缭绕的酒馆
ext.ext_en: ...a smoky pub.

ext.ext_cn: 新鲜多汁的红色浆果
ext.ext_en: ...juicy red berries...

defs.def_en: -y is added to nouns in order to form adjectives that describe something or someone as having the characteristics of what the noun refers to.

defs.def_cn: （用于颜色词后构成形容词）表示“大致…色的”，“略带…色的”

ext.ext_cn: 偏红色的深棕色木头
ext.ext_en: ...a rich, reddy, brown wood...

ext.ext_cn: 她的眼睛是蓝绿色的。
ext.ext_en: Her eyes were a bluey-green colour.

defs.def_en: -y is added to colours in order to form adjectives that describe something as being roughly that colour or having some of that colour in it.

defs.def_cn: （用于名称或名词后，表示喜爱或亲昵）

ext.ext_cn: “你好吗，小迈克？”
ext.ext_en: 'How are you, Mikey?'...

ext.ext_cn: 把小狗挪开点。
ext.ext_en: Move the little doggy.

defs.def_en: -y is added to a name or a noun in order to give it a more affectionate or familiar form.

defs.def_cn: （公路、铁路等的）路堤;（河、海等的）堤，堤岸

ext.ext_cn: 他们爬上了陡峭的堤岸。
ext.ext_en: They climbed a steep embankment.

ext.ext_cn: 铁路路堤
ext.ext_en: ...a railway embankment.

defs.def_en: An embankment is a thick wall of earth that is built to carry a road or railway over an area of low ground, or to prevent water from a river or the sea from flooding the area.

ext.ext_cn: 在一则广告中，观众几乎看不到汽车的外观。
ext.ext_en: In one ad the viewer scarcely sees the car's exterior...

ext.ext_cn: 这座大厦外观雅致而优美。
ext.ext_en: The exterior of the building was elegant and graceful.

defs.def_en: The exterior of something is its outside surface.

defs.def_cn: （尤指与实际性格相差甚远的）外表，外貌，外在

ext.ext_cn: 据曼迪说，帕特彪悍的外表下隐藏着一颗害羞且敏感的心。
ext.ext_en: According to Mandy, Pat's tough exterior hides a shy and sensitive soul.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's usual appearance or behaviour as their exterior, especially when it is very different from their real character.

ext.ext_cn: 外墙用的是预制混凝土。
ext.ext_en: The exterior walls were made of pre-formed concrete.

ext.ext_cn: 烤箱的外表面
ext.ext_en: ...the oven's exterior surfaces.

defs.def_en: You use exterior to refer to the outside parts of something or things that are outside something.

defs.def_cn: 不停的；持续的；连续不断的

ext.ext_cn: 不断追求更高的速度
ext.ext_en: ...the unceasing quest for more speed.

ext.ext_cn: 他夜以继日的操劳
ext.ext_en: ...his unceasing labours.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unceasing, you are emphasizing that it continues without stopping.

defs.def_cn: 有称号的;有头衔的;有爵位的

ext.ext_cn: 她母亲是个有爵位的贵夫人。
ext.ext_en: Her mother was a titled lady.

defs.def_en: Someone who is titled has a title such as 'Lord', 'Lady', 'Sir', or 'Princess' before their name, showing that they have a high rank in society.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 注意力分散的;思想不集中的;心烦意乱的

ext.ext_cn: 她看上去好像心烦意乱,真奇怪。
ext.ext_en: She had seemed curiously distracted...

ext.ext_cn: 她似乎不像个女诗人，更像一个心烦意乱的家庭主妇。
ext.ext_en: She seemed less like a poetess than a distracted housewife.

defs.def_en: If you are distracted, you are not concentrating on something because you are worried or are thinking about something else.

defs.def_cn: （在学业或工作上）过于强求成功，过于争强好胜

ext.ext_cn: 诸如愧疚、沮丧、总想取悦于人和凡事争强好胜等种种情绪
ext.ext_en: ...emotions such as guilt, compulsion to please or overachieve, or depression.

defs.def_en: If someone overachieves in something such as school work or a job, they work very hard, especially in a way that makes them tired or unhappy. They want to be successful because it is very important to them to do well and not because they enjoy what they are doing.
A candelabrum is the same as a candelabra .

defs.def_cn: 公开招股公司；上市公司
defs.def_en: A public company is a company whose shares can be bought by the general public.

ext.ext_cn: 马萨瓦市遭到政府军飞机轰炸，有50名平民丧生。
ext.ext_en: Fifty civilians in Masawa were killed when government planes attacked the town...

ext.ext_cn: 他将老妇人推到她家走廊上，并对她一顿暴打。
ext.ext_en: He bundled the old lady into her hallway and brutally attacked her...

defs.def_en: To attack a person or place means to try to hurt or damage them using physical violence.

ext.ext_cn: 他公开抨击了那些主张用不记名投票方式确定任命人选的人。
ext.ext_en: He publicly attacked the people who've been calling for secret ballot nominations...

ext.ext_cn: 一家报纸发表社论，批评他善于作秀。
ext.ext_en: A newspaper ran an editorial attacking him for being a showman.

defs.def_en: If you attack a person, belief, idea, or act, you criticize them strongly.

defs.def_cn: （疾病、化学药品、昆虫等）攻击，侵蚀，破坏

ext.ext_cn: 病毒看来已经侵蚀到他喉部了。
ext.ext_en: The virus seems to have attacked his throat...

ext.ext_cn: 一些主要农作物由于遭受虫害而歉收。
ext.ext_en: Several key crops failed when they were attacked by pests.

defs.def_en: If something such as a disease, a chemical, or an insect attacks something, it harms or spoils it.

ext.ext_cn: 要解决预算问题，在某种程度上就必须解决那些问题。
ext.ext_en: Any attempt to attack the budget problem is going to have to in some way deal with those issues.

defs.def_en: If you attack a job or a problem, you start to deal with it in an energetic way.

ext.ext_cn: 现在美国队控球，向对方球门展开了进攻。
ext.ext_en: Now the US is controlling the ball and attacking the opponent's goal...

ext.ext_cn: 在下半场，维拉队持续进攻的打法为他们赢得了这个进球。
ext.ext_en: The goal was just reward for Villa's decision to attack constantly in the second half.

defs.def_en: In games such as football, when one team attacks the opponent's goal, they try to score a goal.

ext.ext_cn: 这引发了哮喘。
ext.ext_en: It had brought on an attack of asthma.

defs.def_en: An attack of an illness is a short period in which you suffer badly from it.

ext.ext_cn: 我从宏伟的正门进去。
ext.ext_en: I went in through the royal portal.

defs.def_en: A portal is a large impressive doorway at the entrance to a building.
On the Internet, a portal is a site that consists of links to other websites.

defs.def_cn: （思想、问题等）再次变得重要，重新引人注意

ext.ext_cn: 这些观念在美国民权运动中重新抬头。
ext.ext_en: These ideas resurfaced again in the American civil rights movement...

ext.ext_cn: 据说，这种疾病在3个国家重新出现了。
ext.ext_en: The disease was said to have resurfaced in three countries.

defs.def_en: If something such as an idea or problem resurfaces, it becomes important or noticeable again.

ext.ext_cn: 他们很可能会躲藏几个星期，等风声过了以后再露面。
ext.ext_en: It is likely that they would go into hiding for a few weeks, and resurface when the publicity has died down.

defs.def_en: If someone who has not been seen for a long time resurfaces, they suddenly appear again.

ext.ext_cn: 乔治疯狂地挣扎，不断在水面上浮浮沉沉。
ext.ext_en: George struggled wildly, going under and resurfacing at regular intervals.

defs.def_en: If someone or something that has been under water resurfaces, they come back to the surface of the water again.

ext.ext_cn: 与此同时正赶着在下周三之前把路面重新铺好。
ext.ext_en: Meanwhile the race is on to resurface the road before next Wednesday.

defs.def_en: To resurface something such as a road means to put a new surface on it.

defs.def_cn: (尤指与言语或绘画、电影等其他表达形式相对的)书面语

ext.ext_cn: 甚至到了18世纪，学者们仍然将书面语放在第一位。
ext.ext_en: Even in the 18th century scholars continued to give primacy to the written word.

defs.def_en: You use the written word to refer to language expressed in writing, especially when contrasted with speech or with other forms of expression such as painting or film.

defs.def_cn: (漂在海上或冲到岸边的)漂流物，废料

ext.ext_cn: 水里漂满了垃圾和废物。
ext.ext_en: The water was full of flotsam and refuse.

defs.def_en: Flotsam is rubbish, for example bits of wood and plastic, that is floating on the sea or has been left by the sea on the shore.

defs.def_cn: 流离失所的人;背井离乡的流浪者;无业游民

ext.ext_cn: 他是这个城市里又一个流浪者。
ext.ext_en: He was another of the city's flotsam.

defs.def_en: You can use flotsam to refer to people who do not have homes or jobs and perhaps have had to leave their own country.

ext.ext_cn: 玉米片包装盒、瓶瓶罐罐和厨房里各种杂乱的物品
ext.ext_en: ...cornflake packets, bottles, and all the flotsam and jetsam of the kitchen.

ext.ext_cn: 海滩上的垃圾
ext.ext_en: ...flotsam and jetsam on the beach.

defs.def_en: You can use flotsam and jetsam to refer to small or unimportant items that are found together, especially ones that have no connection with each other.

ext.ext_cn: 西欧失业率最高的地区
ext.ext_en: ...an area that had the highest unemployment rate in western Europe...

ext.ext_cn: 失业对个人和社会都有极大的负面影响。
ext.ext_en: Unemployment is so damaging both to individuals and to communities.

defs.def_en: Unemployment is the fact that people who want jobs cannot get them.
A mental hospital is a hospital for people who are suffering from mental illness.
Classicism is a style of art practised especially in the 18th century in Europe. It has simple regular forms and the artist does not attempt to express strong emotions.

defs.def_cn: (基督教遵循约翰·卫斯理教义的)循道宗信徒,循道公会教徒
defs.def_en: Methodists are Christians who follow the teachings of John Wesley and who have their own branch of the Christian church and their own form of worship.

ext.ext_cn: 我希望建立一个没有剥削和不公的社会。
ext.ext_en: I have a vision of a society that is free of exploitation and injustice...

ext.ext_cn: 那是我对未来世界的想象。
ext.ext_en: That's my vision of how the world could be...

defs.def_en: Your vision of a future situation or society is what you imagine or hope it would be like, if things were very different from the way they are now.

ext.ext_cn: 他想象谢里尔瘫坐在候诊室的一把塑料椅子上。
ext.ext_en: He had a vision of Cheryl, slumped on a plastic chair in the waiting-room...

ext.ext_cn: 也许你曾幻想过被快乐嬉笑的孩子所包围的情景。
ext.ext_en: Maybe you had visions of being surrounded by happy, smiling children.

defs.def_en: If you have a vision of someone in a particular situation, you imagine them in that situation, for example because you are worried that it might happen, or hope that it will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 1981年6月24日那天，年轻的村民们首次报告说看到了圣母马利亚的幻象。
ext.ext_en: It was on 24th June 1981 that young villagers first reported seeing the Virgin Mary in a vision.

defs.def_en: A vision is the experience of seeing something that other people cannot see, for example in a religious experience or as a result of madness or taking drugs.

ext.ext_cn: 这能导致失明或视力严重受损。
ext.ext_en: It causes blindness or serious loss of vision...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管他视力很好，他却发现自己是个色盲。
ext.ext_en: In spite of his otherwise excellent vision, he found he was colour-blind.

defs.def_en: Your vision is your ability to see clearly with your eyes.

ext.ext_cn: 简挡住了克罗斯的视线，他什么也看不见。
ext.ext_en: Jane blocked Cross's vision and he could see nothing...

ext.ext_cn: 我看见另有一些模糊的影子晃了一下就不见了。
ext.ext_en: I saw other indistinct shapes that stayed out of vision.

defs.def_en: Your vision is everything that you can see from a particular place or position.

defs.def_cn: 四轮运货大马车;马拉板车
defs.def_en: A dray is a large flat cart with four wheels which is pulled by horses.
Soda pop is a sweet fizzy drink.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Someone who is hard of hearing is not able to hear properly.
If a political party wins an absolute majority, they obtain more seats or votes than the total number of seats or votes gained by their opponents in an election.

ext.ext_cn: 顶上的门朝外开。
ext.ext_en: The top door opened outwards...

ext.ext_cn: 其目的是将欧洲的社会民主与经济制度传播到世界各地。
ext.ext_en: The idea is to spread social democracy and economics outwards from Europe.

defs.def_en: If something moves or faces outwards, it moves or faces away from the place you are in or the place you are talking about.

ext.ext_cn: 其他贫穷国家将目光投向国外，加强与经济强国的联系。
ext.ext_en: Other poor countries looked outward, strengthening their ties to the economic superpowers...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为该共同体的未来在于对外发展。
ext.ext_en: His belief is that the future of the Community lies in looking outwards.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or a group of people, such as a government, looks outwards, you mean that they turn their attention to another group that they are interested in or would like greater involvement with.
A shop front is the outside part of a shop which faces the street, including the door and windows.

ext.ext_cn: 他们一直在尝试改造他们的零售店。
ext.ext_en: They have tried to reinvent their retail stores...

ext.ext_cn: 他下决心把自己重塑成一个诗人兼作家。
ext.ext_en: He was determined to reinvent himself as a poet and writer.

defs.def_en: To reinvent something means to change it so that it seems different and new.

ext.ext_cn: 这些观点中有些值得进一步探究，但是没有必要全盘重来。
ext.ext_en: Some of these ideas are worth pursuing, but there is no need to reinvent the wheel.

defs.def_en: If someone is trying to reinvent the wheel, they are trying to do something that has already been done successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 可能在一个问题上与某人情投意合，在另一个问题上又意见相左。
ext.ext_en: It's possible to be bedfellows with someone on one issue, and at odds with them on another...

ext.ext_cn: 性爱和死亡奇怪地纠结在一起。
ext.ext_en: Sex and death are strange bedfellows.

defs.def_en: You refer to two things or people as bedfellows when they have become associated or related in some way.

defs.def_cn: 与…断绝关系;否认对…的责任;否认…是自己的

ext.ext_cn: 杀害那女孩的人不配做我的儿子。我要与他脱离关系。
ext.ext_en: The man who murdered the girl is no son of mine. I disown him.

ext.ext_cn: 这些话随后遭到了军方一位官方发言人的否认。
ext.ext_en: Those comments were later disowned by an official army spokesman.

defs.def_en: If you disown someone or something, you say or show that you no longer want to have any connection with them or any responsibility for them.
A pen pal is someone you write friendly letters to and receive letters from, although the two of you may never have met.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 警示信号灯清晰可见。
ext.ext_en: The warning lights were clearly visible...

ext.ext_cn: 他们发现了一种肉眼可见的细菌。
ext.ext_en: They found a bacterium visible to the human eye...

defs.def_en: If something is visible, it  can be seen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 明显的;引人注目的;能认出的

ext.ext_cn: 预示危机严重程度的一个最显著的迹象就是失业情况。
ext.ext_en: The most visible sign of the intensity of the crisis is unemployment...

ext.ext_cn: 他明显是在努力控制自己的情绪。
ext.ext_en: He was making a visible effort to control himself...

defs.def_en: You use visible to describe something or someone that people notice or recognize.

ext.ext_cn: 在英国，传统上有形产品的进口一直大于出口。
ext.ext_en: In the UK visible imports have traditionally been greater than visible exports.

defs.def_en: In economics, visible earnings are the money that a country makes as a result of producing goods, rather than from services such as banking and tourism.
A flange is a projecting edge on an object. Its purpose is to strengthen the object or to connect it to another object.

ext.ext_cn: 她浏览了一下报纸的广告页。
ext.ext_en: She scanned the advertisement pages of the newspapers...

ext.ext_cn: 我还没有细细研读，只是粗略地翻看了一下。
ext.ext_en: I haven't read much into it as yet. I've only just scanned through it.

defs.def_en: When you scan written material, you look through it quickly in order to find important or interesting information.

ext.ext_cn: 那名警官仔细检查了房间。
ext.ext_en: The officer scanned the room...

ext.ext_cn: 她很紧张，眼睛不停地在人群中搜寻保罗。
ext.ext_en: She was nervous and kept scanning the crowd for Paul...

defs.def_en: When you scan a place or group of people, you look at it carefully, usually because you are looking for something or someone.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的方法是用炸弹探测器对每一个办理了登机手续的箱包进行扫描。
ext.ext_en: Their approach is to scan every checked-in bag with a bomb detector.

defs.def_en: If people scan something such as luggage, they examine it using a machine that can show or find things inside it that cannot be seen from the outside.

ext.ext_cn: 这个盘没有感染病毒——我已经扫描过了。
ext.ext_en: The disk has no viruses — I've scanned it already.

defs.def_en: If a computer disk is scanned, a program on the computer checks the disk to make sure that it does not contain a virus.

ext.ext_cn: 所有图书馆的全部纸质内容最终都会被扫描进电脑。
ext.ext_en: The entire paper contents of all libraries will eventually be scanned into computers...

ext.ext_cn: 设计图也可以从纸上扫描进电脑。
ext.ext_en: Designs can also be scanned in from paper.

defs.def_en: If a picture or document is scanned into a computer, a machine passes a beam of light over it to make a copy of it in the computer.

ext.ext_cn: 船上的雷达扫描了前方的海域。
ext.ext_en: The ship's radar scanned the sea ahead.

defs.def_en: If a radar or sonar machine scans an area, it examines or searches it by sending radar or sonar beams over it.

ext.ext_cn: 他被火速送往医院做脑部扫描。
ext.ext_en: He was rushed to hospital for a brain scan.

ext.ext_cn: 为诊察癌症所做的乳腺扫描检查
ext.ext_en: ...a breast scan to check for cancer.

defs.def_en: A scan is a medical test in which a machine sends a beam of X-rays over a part of your body in order to check that it is healthy.
If a pregnant woman has a scan, a machine using sound waves produces an image of her womb on a screen so that a doctor can see if her baby is developing normally.

ext.ext_cn: 他写了几首诗。锡德告诉他那几首诗都不押韵。
ext.ext_en: He had written a few poems. Sid told him they didn't scan.

defs.def_en: If a line of a poem does not scan, it is not the right length or does not have emphasis in the right places to match the rest of the poem.

ext.ext_cn: 由6本平装书组成的这套书
ext.ext_en: ...this set of 6 softcover books.

ext.ext_cn: 本月麦克米伦公司将为她的烹饪书推出平装本
ext.ext_en: ...her cookbook, which Macmillan is bringing out in soft cover this month.

defs.def_en: A softcover is a book with a thin cardboard, paper, or plastic cover.

defs.def_cn: （科幻小说或电影中的）机器人偶，仿真机器人
defs.def_en: In science fiction books and films, an android is a robot that looks like a human being.
A comma is the punctuation mark , which is used to separate parts of a sentence or items in a list.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有证据表明，这种残障不如看起来那么严重。
ext.ext_en: It is arguable that this was not as grave a handicap as it might appear...

ext.ext_cn: 法官们说至少有一个证据确凿的渎职案可作答辩。
ext.ext_en: The judges said there was at least a good arguable case of negligence to answer.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is arguable that something is true, you believe that it can be supported by evidence and that many people would agree with it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不确定的;无把握的;有疑问的

ext.ext_cn: 他是否掌控过真正的经济大权还有待证实。
ext.ext_en: It is arguable whether he ever had much control over the real economic power...

ext.ext_cn: 他说她的言论让每个虔诚的基督教信徒感到厌恶。这种说法存在疑问。
ext.ext_en: He said that her remarks disgusted every practising Christian. That claim is arguable.

defs.def_en: An idea, point, or comment that is arguable is not obviously true or correct and should be questioned.

defs.def_cn: 洞悉;深入了解;深刻见解

ext.ext_cn: 该项目将使科学家对地球大气层的状况有更新的深入了解。
ext.ext_en: The project would give scientists new insights into what is happening to the earth's atmosphere...

ext.ext_cn: 希望这次谈话能使你对我们正在开展的工作有一些较深入的了解。
ext.ext_en: I hope that this talk has given you some insight into the kind of the work that we've been doing.

defs.def_en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个富有洞察力的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a man with considerable insight.

defs.def_en: If someone has insight, they are able to understand complex situations.

defs.def_cn: 鳀（小型海鱼，常用盐腌制后食用）

ext.ext_cn: 一罐鳀鱼
ext.ext_en: ...a tin of anchovies.

ext.ext_cn: 去骨鳀鱼片
ext.ext_en: ...anchovy fillets.

defs.def_en: Anchovies are small fish that live in the sea. They are often eaten salted.

defs.def_cn: 有趣的是;令人关注的是;想不到的是

ext.ext_cn: 有意思的是,几个星期以后,本杰明又结婚了。
ext.ext_en: Interestingly enough, a few weeks later, Benjamin remarried...

ext.ext_cn: 耐人寻味的是,现在还不清楚首相支持哪个解决方案。
ext.ext_en: Interestingly, it is not clear which solution the prime minister favors.

defs.def_en: You use interestingly to introduce a piece of information that you think is interesting or unexpected.

ext.ext_cn: 内阁现在共有6张新面孔。
ext.ext_en: All together there are six new faces in the cabinet.

defs.def_en: Someone who is new in a particular public role can be referred to as a new face .
A blender is an electrical kitchen appliance used for mixing liquids and soft foods together or turning fruit or vegetables into liquid.

ext.ext_cn: 她以丈夫搞婚外情为由要求离婚。
ext.ext_en: She is going to divorce him on the grounds of adultery.

defs.def_en: If a married person commits adultery, they have sex with someone that they are not married to.
A turtle dove is a type of light-brown dove which makes a soft pleasant sound and which is said to behave in a very affectionate way towards its sexual partner and its young.

ext.ext_cn: 从国内相关的工会那儿或许能得到一项特许。
ext.ext_en: A special dispensation may be obtained from the domestic union concerned...

ext.ext_cn: 他们得到许诺，可以免服兵役。
ext.ext_en: They were promised dispensation from military service...

defs.def_en: A dispensation is special permission to do something that is normally not allowed.

ext.ext_cn: 我们始终如一的执法标准
ext.ext_en: ...our application of consistent standards in the dispensation of justice.

defs.def_en: Dispensation of something is the issuing of it, especially from a position of authority.

defs.def_cn: （某一特定时期内宗教或政治上的）制度

ext.ext_cn: 新的制度收到了成效，当然也包括商业界。
ext.ext_en: The new dispensation proved a success, certainly with the business community.

defs.def_en: A dispensation is a religious or political system that has authority at a particular time.

defs.def_cn: （电影）严肃的，艺术的，非娱乐性的

ext.ext_cn: 一部另类艺术片
ext.ext_en: ...a quirky art-house film...

ext.ext_cn: 他拍摄的影片成了艺术片的经典之作。
ext.ext_en: The movies he made became art-house classics.

defs.def_en: An art-house film is a film that is intended to be a serious artistic work rather than a piece of popular entertainment.

defs.def_cn: (手指在其上滑动以移动光标的)触控板

ext.ext_cn: 有一些增强功能，例如以触控板代替了跟踪球
ext.ext_en: ...with enhancements like a trackpad instead of a trackball.

defs.def_en: A trackpad is a flat pad on some computers that you slide your finger over in order to move the cursor.
Taxonomy is the process of naming and classifying things such as animals and plants into groups within a larger system, according to their similarities and differences.
High summer is the middle of summer.

ext.ext_cn: 只有极少数幸运儿才有机会从籍籍无名中脱颖而出，进入光鲜亮丽的模特圈。
ext.ext_en: For the lucky few, there's the chance of being plucked from obscurity and thrown into the glamorous world of modelling...

ext.ext_cn: 他在默默无闻中孤独地度过了后半生。
ext.ext_en: The latter half of his life was spent in obscurity and loneliness.

defs.def_en: Obscurity is the state of being known by only a few people.

ext.ext_cn: “怎么会那样呢？”亨特问道，亨利含糊费解的回答让他恼火。
ext.ext_en: 'How can that be?' asked Hunt, irritated by the obscurity of Henry's reply...

ext.ext_cn: 这首诗再怎么晦涩，至少有一点是清楚的。
ext.ext_en: Whatever its obscurities, the poem was clear on at least one count.

defs.def_en: Obscurity is the quality of being difficult to understand. An obscurity is something that is difficult to understand.
Distension is abnormal swelling in a person's or animal's body.
A dry cleaner is someone who has a shop where things can be dry-cleaned.
A dry cleaner or a dry cleaner's is a shop where things can be dry-cleaned.
A therm is a measurement of heat.

ext.ext_cn: 在该地区还发现了海鸥的其他亚种。
ext.ext_en: Several other sub-species of gull are found in the region.

defs.def_en: A sub-species of a plant or animal is one of the types that a particular species is divided into.
A pail is a bucket, usually made of metal or wood.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 法国北部发生零星战斗的一年
ext.ext_en: ...a year of sporadic fighting over northern France...

ext.ext_cn: 仍能听见零星的枪声。
ext.ext_en: The sound of sporadic shooting could still be heard.

defs.def_en: Sporadic occurrences of something happen at irregular intervals.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 一心一意的;专心致志的

ext.ext_cn: 他们都是些非常现实的政治家，一心追逐政治权力，为达目的毫不留情。
ext.ext_en: They were effective politicians, ruthless and single-minded in their pursuit of political power.

ext.ext_cn: 一心要赢
ext.ext_en: ...a single-minded determination to win.

defs.def_en: Someone who is single-minded has only one aim or purpose and is determined to achieve it.

defs.def_cn: 缟玛瑙（用于制作装饰品、首饰或家具）

defs.def_cn: (已退休或领取养老金的)老年人，长者
defs.def_en: A senior citizen is an older person who has retired or receives an old age pension.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 日本产的汽车质量非常可靠。
ext.ext_en: Japanese cars are so reliable.

defs.def_en: People or things that are reliable can be trusted to work well or to behave in the way that you want them to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: There is no reliable information about civilian casualties...

ext.ext_cn: 要给出可靠的估计非常困难。
ext.ext_en: It's very difficult to give a reliable estimate...

defs.def_en: Information that is reliable or that is from a reliable source is very likely to be correct.

ext.ext_cn: 他在胳膊下面挠了挠。
ext.ext_en: He scratched himself under his arm...

ext.ext_cn: 老人撩起开襟毛衣挠了挠身体的一侧。
ext.ext_en: The old man lifted his cardigan to scratch his side...
