ext.ext_cn: 树枝刮破了我的夹克，划伤了我的手和脸。
ext.ext_en: The branches tore at my jacket and scratched my hands and face...

ext.ext_cn: 小刀会在工作台上留下划痕。
ext.ext_en: Knives will scratch the worktop.

defs.def_en: If a sharp object scratches someone or something, it makes small shallow cuts on their skin or surface.

ext.ext_cn: 那名 7 岁男孩被发现时正在哭泣，脸部和颈部都有划伤。
ext.ext_en: The seven-year-old was found crying with scratches on his face and neck...

ext.ext_cn: 我指向地板砖上的一道道划痕。
ext.ext_en: I pointed to a number of scratches in the tile floor.

defs.def_en: Scratches on someone or something are small shallow cuts.

defs.def_cn: 从零开始;从头做起;白手起家

ext.ext_cn: 建立一个全新的家庭既让人兴奋又富于挑战。
ext.ext_en: Building a home from scratch can be both exciting and challenging...

ext.ext_cn: 战后，香港制造业的兴起并非从零开始。
ext.ext_en: Hong Kong's manufacturing industry did not start from scratch in the post-war period.

defs.def_en: If you do something from scratch, you do it without making use of anything that has been done before.

ext.ext_cn: 该协会花费大量时间苦苦思索如何提高美国的生产力。
ext.ext_en: The Institute spends a lot of time scratching its head about how to boost American productivity.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is scratching their head, you mean that they are thinking hard and trying to solve a problem or puzzle.

defs.def_cn: 触及表面;隔靴搔痒;浅尝辄止

ext.ext_cn: 官员们说他们只是触及了毒品问题的表面。
ext.ext_en: Officials say they've only scratched the surface of the drug problem...

ext.ext_cn: 我们只有两周的时间游览马来西亚，连走马观花都来不及。
ext.ext_en: We had only two weeks to tour Malaysia, which was hardly enough time to scratch the surface.

defs.def_en: If you only scratch the surface of a subject or problem, you find out or do a small amount, but not enough to understand or solve it.

defs.def_cn: 达到标准;合格;令人满意

ext.ext_cn: 母亲总是使我觉得自己不够优秀。
ext.ext_en: My mother always made me feel I wasn't coming up to scratch.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is not up to scratch, you mean that they are not good enough.
A preacher is a person, usually a member of the clergy, who preaches sermons as part of a church service.

defs.def_cn: 未引起质疑的；没有异议的

ext.ext_cn: 这些观点并非没有受到质疑。
ext.ext_en: These views have not gone unchallenged...

ext.ext_cn: 她不能让它无异议地通过。
ext.ext_en: She couldn't let that pass unchallenged.

defs.def_en: When something goes unchallenged or is unchallenged, people accept it without asking questions about whether it is right or wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 他是这个最强大的共和国的绝对领袖。
ext.ext_en: He is the unchallenged leader of the strongest republic.

ext.ext_cn: 稳固地领导其政党长达30多年的人物
ext.ext_en: ...the man who has led his party unchallenged for over thirty years.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's position of authority is unchallenged, you mean that it is strong and no one tries to replace them.

defs.def_cn: 未被盘问的；未受到质疑的

ext.ext_cn: 我四处走动了10分钟，没有受到查问，之后一位警觉的护士发现了我。
ext.ext_en: I managed to walk around unchallenged for 10 minutes before an alert nurse spotted me.

defs.def_en: If you do something unchallenged, nobody stops you and asks you questions, for example about who you are or why you are doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 不过，性受虐狂的倾向中总是有一些施虐的成分。
ext.ext_en: The tendency towards masochism is however always linked with elements of sadism.

defs.def_en: Masochism is behaviour in which someone gets sexual pleasure from their own pain or suffering.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦体验过南加州的生活，再重返寒冬腊月里的英国就有点自讨苦吃。
ext.ext_en: Once you have tasted life in southern California, it takes a peculiar kind of masochism to return to a British winter.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as masochism, you mean that they seem to be trying to get into a situation which causes them suffering or great difficulty.
A cassette player is a machine that is used for playing cassettes and sometimes also recording them.
An ashtray is a small dish in which smokers can put the ash from their cigarettes and cigars.

ext.ext_cn: 他被留在一间拘留室里醒酒。
ext.ext_en: He was left to sober up in a police cell.

ext.ext_cn: 不加奶的浓咖啡可以醒酒的想法
ext.ext_en: ...the idea that a cup of strong black coffee sobers you up.

defs.def_en: If someone sobers up, or if something sobers them up, they become sober after being drunk.
An aquarium is a building, often in a zoo, where fish and underwater animals are kept.
An aquarium is a glass tank filled with water, in which people keep fish.

defs.def_cn: 政治上不正确（指不在乎是否冒犯处于不利地位或遭歧视的社会群体的态度或原则）

ext.ext_cn: 政治上不正确的说法
ext.ext_en: ...allegations of political incorrectness.

defs.def_en: Political incorrectness is the attitude or policy shown by someone who does not care if they offend or upset any group of people in society who have a disadvantage, or who have been treated differently because of their sex, race, or disability.
A scherzo is a short, lively piece of classical music which is usually part of a longer piece of music.

ext.ext_cn: 选手们慢跑进入竞技场,为闭幕式画上了句号。
ext.ext_en: The competitors cantered into the arena to conclude the closing ceremony.

ext.ext_cn: 卡纳克小跑着出发了。
ext.ext_en: Carnac set off at a canter.

defs.def_en: When a horse canters, it moves at a speed that is slower than a gallop but faster than a trot.

defs.def_cn: (价值或价格的)直线下落，暴跌

ext.ext_cn: 英镑暴跌。
ext.ext_en: Sterling went into free fall...

ext.ext_cn: 价格一落千丈。
ext.ext_en: The price did a free fall.

defs.def_en: If the value or price of something goes into free fall, it starts to fall uncontrollably.
In parachuting, free fall is the part of the jump before the parachute opens.

defs.def_cn: 发出恶臭;散发难闻气味

ext.ext_cn: 离我远点——你有口臭。
ext.ext_en: Get away from me —your breath stinks...

ext.ext_cn: 这个地方有股煎洋葱的刺鼻气味。
ext.ext_en: The place stinks of fried onions...

defs.def_en: To stink means to smell extremely unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 令人讨厌;让人反感;让人感觉糟糕

ext.ext_cn: 我认为他们的方法糟透了。
ext.ext_en: I think their methods stink...

ext.ext_cn: 整件事情都透着政治腐败的气息。
ext.ext_en: The whole thing stinks of political corruption.

defs.def_en: If you say that something stinks, you mean that you disapprove of it because it involves ideas, feelings, or practices that you do not like.

defs.def_cn: (引人注意的)发怒，大吵大闹，泄愤

ext.ext_cn: 这家人正在大吵大闹。
ext.ext_en: The family's making a hell of a stink...

ext.ext_cn: 小报的报道引起民众对他为期 7 天的访问的强烈不满。
ext.ext_en: The tabloid press kicked up a stink about his seven-day visit.

defs.def_en: If someone makes a stink about something they are angry about, they show their anger in order to make people take notice.

ext.ext_cn: 这可以称得上是今秋令人赏心悦目的影片了。
ext.ext_en: This could be the feel-good movie of the autumn.

ext.ext_cn: 基调明快、让人乐观向上的爱情故事
ext.ext_en: ...a bright and enjoyable feelgood romance.

defs.def_en: A feel-good film is a film which presents people and life in a way which makes the people who watch it feel happy and optimistic.

defs.def_cn: 愉悦感，对未来的乐观态度（新闻用语)

ext.ext_cn: 选举结果公布后的最近一次调查显示，人们普遍对未来持乐观态度。
ext.ext_en: There were obvious signs of the feel-good factor in the last survey taken in the wake of the election result.

defs.def_en: When journalists refer to the feel-good factor, they mean that people are feeling hopeful and optimistic about the future.
Helium is a very light gas that is colourless and has no smell.

defs.def_cn: 远房堂兄弟(或姐妹);远房表兄弟(或姐妹)(指父母的堂表兄弟姐妹的子女)
defs.def_en: Your second cousins are the children of your parents' first cousins.

defs.def_cn: （生病或休假的医生或牧师的）临时代理
defs.def_en: A locum is a doctor or priest who does the work for another doctor or priest who is ill or on holiday.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我的职业与政治完全无关。
ext.ext_en: My line of work is entirely unrelated to politics...

ext.ext_cn: 他们中的两个人死因明显不同。
ext.ext_en: Two of them died from apparently unrelated causes.

defs.def_en: If one thing is unrelated to another, there is no connection between them. You can also say that two things are unrelated .

defs.def_cn: 不属于同一家族的；没有亲属关系的

ext.ext_cn: 吉米是被收养的，因此和贝丝没有血缘关系。
ext.ext_en: Jimmy is adopted and thus unrelated to Beth by blood.

defs.def_en: If one person is unrelated to another, they are not members of the same family. You can also say that two people are unrelated .

ext.ext_cn: 会议结束时所做的非正式民意测验表明大多数人赞同福思先生。
ext.ext_en: A straw poll conducted at the end of the meeting found most people agreed with Mr Forth...

ext.ext_cn: 就我对朋友和熟人所做的调查显示，很多父母无论如何都不会为他们的女儿购买这种东西。
ext.ext_en: Many parents wouldn't dream of buying the stuff for their daughters anyway, as a straw poll among my friends and acquaintances demonstrated.

defs.def_en: A straw poll is the unofficial questioning of a group of people to find out their opinion about something.

defs.def_cn: （某种口音或语气中的God，尤用于表示厌烦、恼怒、震惊等）上帝，天哪

ext.ext_cn: 我想，哦，我的天哪！
ext.ext_en: I thought, oh my gawd!

defs.def_en: Gawd is used to represent the word 'God' pronounced in a particular accent or tone of voice, especially to show that someone is bored, irritated, or shocked.
The Rh factor is the same as the rhesus factor .

ext.ext_cn: 我像往常一样铺开我的睡袋。
ext.ext_en: I unrolled my sleeping bag as usual...

ext.ext_cn: 客人带来了录影带，并在从天花板上放下来的幕布上放映。
ext.ext_en: Guests bring movies on tape, and show them on the screen that unrolls from the ceiling.

defs.def_en: If you unroll something such as a sheet of paper or cloth, or if it unrolls, it opens up and becomes flat when it was previously rolled in a cylindrical shape.
Someone who has self-assurance shows confidence in the things that they say and do because they are sure of their abilities.

ext.ext_cn: 那些字赫然写在纸上。
ext.ext_en: The words stood out clearly on the page...

ext.ext_cn: ginseng 这个词来自汉语的“人参”。
ext.ext_en: The word 'ginseng' comes from the Chinese word 'ren-shen'.

defs.def_en: A word is a single unit of language that can be represented in writing or speech. In English, a word has a space on either side of it when it is written.

ext.ext_cn: 她的话应验了，我伤心欲绝。
ext.ext_en: I was devastated when her words came true...

ext.ext_cn: 那位年轻女医生的话在他耳畔回响。
ext.ext_en: The words of the young woman doctor echoed in his ears...

defs.def_en: Someone's words are what they say or write.

ext.ext_cn: 你听得清这张专辑中的歌词吗？
ext.ext_en: Can you hear the words on the album?

defs.def_en: The words of a song consist of the text that is sung, in contrast to the music that is played.

defs.def_cn: 短时间的谈话;短暂的聊天

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得你该跟他谈谈了。
ext.ext_en: I think it's time you had a word with him...

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯，我能和你私下说几句吗？
ext.ext_en: James, could I have a quiet word?...

defs.def_en: If you have a word with someone, you have a short conversation with them.

ext.ext_cn: 提醒一句：不要过于迷信书上的话。
ext.ext_en: A word of warning. Don't stick too precisely to what it says in the book...

ext.ext_cn: 请允许我也向所有来信的人表示感谢。
ext.ext_en: May I also say a word of thanks to all the people who sent letters.

defs.def_en: If you offer someone a word of something such as warning, advice, or praise, you warn, advise, or praise them.

defs.def_cn: 一句话，一个字(也没有听到、明白或说)

ext.ext_cn: 她说的我一点儿也不懂。
ext.ext_en: I can't understand a word she says...

ext.ext_cn: 我敢说他一个字都不记得。
ext.ext_en: I bet he doesn't remember a single word...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does not hear, understand, or say a word, you are emphasizing that they hear, understand, or say nothing at all.

ext.ext_cn: 所报道的袭击事件没有得到当局的证实。
ext.ext_en: There is no word from the authorities on the reported attack...

ext.ext_cn: 有关街头骚乱的消息迅速传播开来。
ext.ext_en: Word has been spreading fast of the incidents on the streets...

defs.def_en: If there is word of something, people receive news or information about it.

ext.ext_cn: 一位承诺监护这个男孩的成年男子
ext.ext_en: ...an adult who gave his word the boy would be supervised...

ext.ext_cn: 根本不能相信他会信守诺言。
ext.ext_en: He simply cannot be trusted to keep his word.

defs.def_en: If you give your word, you make a sincere promise to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 没有我的命令，不准议论这件事。
ext.ext_en: I want nothing said about this until I give the word.

defs.def_en: If someone gives the word to do something, they give an order to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果换作我写这封信，我或许会用不同的措辞。
ext.ext_en: If I had written the letter, I might have worded it differently.

defs.def_en: To word something in a particular way means to choose or use particular words to express it.

ext.ext_cn: 这么多人都认为女权主义是个龌龊的字眼。
ext.ext_en: So many people think feminism is a dirty word.

defs.def_en: If you say that people consider something to be a dirty word, you mean that they disapprove of it.

defs.def_cn: 收回前言，承认说错了话(尤指此举令说话人显得愚蠢时)

ext.ext_cn: 他不得不收回他说过的公司能免受经济衰退影响的话。
ext.ext_en: He has had to eat his words about the company being recession-proof.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has to eat their words, you mean that they have to admit that they were wrong about something they said in the past, especially when this makes them look foolish.

defs.def_cn: 沉默寡言的，少言寡语的，话不多的(尤指不谈及自己的意见和感情)

ext.ext_cn: 他是个沉默寡言的人，彬彬有礼，待人谦和。
ext.ext_en: He's a man of few words, very polite and unassuming.

defs.def_en: A person of few words says very little, especially about their opinions or feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 关键是从一开始就作出正确的决定。
ext.ext_en: It's essential you make the right decisions from the word go.

defs.def_en: If you do something from the word go, you do it from the very beginning of a period of time or situation.

defs.def_cn: (因为仰慕或尊敬而)仔细倾听，一字不落地认真听

ext.ext_cn: 梅利娜凝神细听着他的每句话，被深深吸引住了。
ext.ext_en: Melina was hanging on his every word, fascinated.

defs.def_en: If you hang on someone's every word, you listen very carefully to what they are saying, because you admire or respect them.

defs.def_cn: 从来没一句好话／从来没一句坏话

ext.ext_cn: 新闻界从来没说过他们的好话。
ext.ext_en: The press never has a good word to say about them...

ext.ext_cn: 她对谁都是冷言冷语。
ext.ext_en: She doesn't have a kind word for anyone.

defs.def_en: You can use expressions such as never have a good word to say or never have a bad word to say to emphasize that a person always criticizes someone or something, or that they never criticize them.

defs.def_cn: (尤指因为一方抱怨了另一方的行为)与…争论,与…严肃讨论

ext.ext_cn: 我们争执了起来，她夺门而出。
ext.ext_en: We had words and she stormed out...

ext.ext_cn: 我真应该跟我这些愚蠢的朋友理论理论！
ext.ext_en: I shall have words with these stupid friends of mine!

defs.def_en: If one person has words with another, or if two or more people have words, they have a serious discussion or argument, especially because one has complained about the other's behaviour.

defs.def_cn: 用…的话说;引用…的原话说

ext.ext_cn: 就连助理国务卿也不得不承认之前的政策并没有，用他的话说，收到成效。
ext.ext_en: Even the Assistant Secretary of State had to admit that previous policy did not, in his words, produce results.

defs.def_en: You can use in their words or in their own words to indicate that you are reporting what someone said using the exact words that they used.

defs.def_cn: 总而言之;简言之;一句话

ext.ext_cn: 总而言之，维克多越来越厌倦了。
ext.ext_en: Victor, in a word, got increasingly fed up...

ext.ext_cn: “难道不该让他当主角吗？”——“一句话——不行。”
ext.ext_en: 'Shouldn't he be given the leading role?' — 'In a word — No.'

defs.def_en: You use in a word to indicate that you are giving a summary of what you have just been saying, or are giving a reply, in as brief a way as possible.

defs.def_cn: (讨论、争论、分歧中的)最终决定权

ext.ext_cn: 她确实喜欢商量什么事都最终自己说了算。
ext.ext_en: She does like to have the last word in any discussion...

ext.ext_cn: 最后仍然要由国务卿来定夺。
ext.ext_en: The final word will still come from the Secretary of State.

defs.def_en: If someone has the last word or the final word in a discussion, argument, or disagreement, they are the one who wins it or who makes the final decision.

ext.ext_cn: 这家矿泉疗养浴场极尽奢华，功效极高。
ext.ext_en: The spa is the last word in luxury and efficiency.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is the last word in luxury, comfort, or some other quality, you are emphasizing that it has a great deal of this quality.

defs.def_cn: (尤指因非常吃惊而)说不出话来，无以言表

ext.ext_cn: 我无以言表——太精彩了。
ext.ext_en: I'm lost for words — it's fantastic...

ext.ext_cn: 她目瞪口呆地看着这场面，一时语塞。
ext.ext_en: She was gaping at it, lost for words.

defs.def_en: If someone is lost for words, they cannot think of anything to say, especially because they are very surprised by something.

defs.def_cn: 没有直接说;拐弯抹角地说

ext.ext_cn: “她同意跟你一起去了吗？”——“没有直接说，但我知道她是怎么想的。”
ext.ext_en: 'And has she agreed to go with you?' — 'Not in so many words. But I read her thoughts'.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has said something, but not in so many words, you mean that they said it or expressed it, but in a very indirect way.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调刚刚警告对方的话很可能成真，尤其是认为对方应改变态度或行为予以避免时)你听着，记住我的话

ext.ext_cn: 那就是将来你的下场，记住我的话。
ext.ext_en: That's what you'll end up with, you mark my words.

defs.def_en: If you say 'mark my words' to someone, you are emphasizing that something you have just warned them about is very likely to happen, especially when you think they should change their attitude or behaviour to prevent it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个故事是口头流传下来的。
ext.ext_en: The story has been passed down by word of mouth.

defs.def_en: If news or information passes by word of mouth, people tell it to each other rather than it being printed in written form.
If you say that someone is putting words into your mouth or is putting words in your mouth, you mean that they are suggesting that you mean one thing when you really mean something different.

defs.def_cn: 说话算数的人;一诺千金的人
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a man of his word or a woman of her word, you mean that they always keep their promises and can be relied on.

defs.def_cn: 换言之;换句话说;也就是说

ext.ext_cn: 流动图书馆服务重新作了安排——换句话说，他们去的地方减少了。
ext.ext_en: The mobile library services have been reorganised — in other words, they visit fewer places.

defs.def_en: You say in other words in order to introduce a different, and usually simpler, explanation or interpretation of something that has just been said.

ext.ext_cn: 现在你来给我们讲讲星期六的活动吧。
ext.ext_en: Now tell us in your own words about the events of Saturday.

defs.def_en: If you say something in your own words, you express it in your own way, without copying or repeating someone else's description.

ext.ext_cn: 朋友们传话说矿工们想见他。
ext.ext_en: Friends passed the word that the miners wanted to see him.

defs.def_en: If you pass the word, you tell someone something that another person has told you.

defs.def_cn: 发话，下令(示意某事应该开始)

ext.ext_cn: 我一发话，就跟着我下来。
ext.ext_en: When I say the word, follow me down.

defs.def_en: If someone says the word, they give their approval as a sign that something should start to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 社区迅速作出反应，宣传安全性行为。
ext.ext_en: The community reacted quickly and spread the word about safe sex.

defs.def_en: If you spread the word, you tell people about something.

ext.ext_cn: 只要他说“哦，我错了，现在我要改过自新”，他们就愿意当真。
ext.ext_en: They're willing to take him at his word when he says, 'Oh, I made mistakes and now I'll change.'

defs.def_en: If you take someone at their word, you believe what they say, when they did not really mean it or when they meant something slightly different.

ext.ext_cn: 你要是买那栋房子只会买来麻烦，我说的都是真的。
ext.ext_en: You'll buy nothing but trouble if you buy that house, take my word for it.

defs.def_en: If you say to someone 'take my word for it', you mean that they should believe you because you are telling the truth.

defs.def_cn: 极其愚蠢/荒唐得让人无语

ext.ext_cn: 最需要这些机器时却不打开，真是愚蠢至极。
ext.ext_en: It's too stupid for words not having the machines switched on when they're most needed...

ext.ext_cn: 我惊愕万分，不知说什么好。
ext.ext_en: I feel simply too devastated for words.

defs.def_en: You can use expressions such as too silly for words and too ridiculous for words to emphasize that someone or something is extremely silly or ridiculous.

defs.def_cn: 信守诺言;说话算话;说到做到

ext.ext_cn: 我怎么知道他会信守诺言呢？
ext.ext_en: How do I know that he will be true to his word?...

ext.ext_cn: 他们信守诺言，离得远远的。
ext.ext_en: They were as good as their word and stayed away.

defs.def_en: If you are true to your word or as good as your word, you do what you say you will do.

ext.ext_cn: 我不会试图一字不落地记住讲话要说的内容。
ext.ext_en: I don't try to memorize speeches word for word.

defs.def_en: If you repeat something word for word, you repeat it exactly as it was originally said or written.

defs.def_cn: (分开字母、单词或数字的)正斜杠，正斜线
defs.def_en: A forward slash is the sloping line '/' that separates letters, words, or numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 华盛顿的企业对这项计划非常不满。
ext.ext_en: Washington businesses are in high dudgeon over the plan.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in high dudgeon, you are emphasizing that they are very angry or unhappy about something.

defs.def_cn: （尤指体育赛事的）主办者，承办者

ext.ext_cn: 英国最顶尖的拳击比赛主办者之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the top boxing promoters in Britain.

defs.def_en: A promoter is a person who helps organize and finance an event, especially a sports event.

ext.ext_cn: 阿伦·科普兰从来都是美国音乐的积极倡导者。
ext.ext_en: Aaron Copland was an energetic promoter of American music.

defs.def_en: The promoter of a cause or idea tries to make it become popular.
A seascape is a painting or photograph of a scene at sea.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们听见酒瓶摔碎的声音，然后是一阵更喧闹的笑声。
ext.ext_en: They heard a bottle being smashed, then more raucous laughter.

ext.ext_cn: 海鸟喧闹的叫声
ext.ext_en: ...the raucous cries of the seabirds.

defs.def_en: A raucous sound is loud, harsh, and rather unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 锡西不仅驼背，而且又矮又胖。
ext.ext_en: Cissie was round-shouldered and dumpy.

defs.def_en: If someone is round-shouldered, they bend forward when they sit or stand, and their shoulders are curved rather than straight.

defs.def_cn: (为争取社会、政治变革而四处奔走的)活动家，运动参加者

ext.ext_cn: 反狩猎的活动家们
ext.ext_en: ...anti-hunting campaigners.

ext.ext_cn: 主张实行多党制的活动家们
ext.ext_en: ...campaigners for multi-party democracy.

defs.def_en: A campaigner is a person who campaigns for social or political change.
An acupuncturist is a person who performs acupuncture.
In the United States, the Secretary of State is the head of the government department which deals with foreign affairs.

ext.ext_cn: 教育大臣
ext.ext_en: ...the Secretary of State for Education.

defs.def_en: In Britain, the Secretary of State for a particular government department is the head of that department.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦同大多数欧洲国家的首都都有所不同。
ext.ext_en: London was different from most European capitals...

ext.ext_cn: 如果他上过音乐学校，事情会有怎样的不同呢？
ext.ext_en: If he'd attended music school, how might things have been different?...

defs.def_en: If two people or things are different, they are not like each other in one or more ways.

ext.ext_cn: 不同国家专门生产不同的产品。
ext.ext_en: Different countries specialised in different products...

ext.ext_cn: 不同牌子的饮料所含的卡路里数大不相同。
ext.ext_en: The number of calories in different brands of drinks varies enormously.

defs.def_en: You use different to indicate that you are talking about two or more separate and distinct things of the same kind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不同寻常的;与众不同的

ext.ext_cn: 这种烹饪法的确很有意思而且与众不同。
ext.ext_en: This recipe is certainly interesting and different.

defs.def_en: You can describe something as different when it is unusual and not like others of the same kind.

ext.ext_cn: 保守党领导人的朋友及追随者
ext.ext_en: ...the Tory leader's friends and camp followers.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a camp follower, you mean that they do not officially belong to a particular group or movement but support it for their own advantage.

defs.def_cn: (尤指随军的)士兵家属,提供随军服务的人;跟随者
defs.def_en: Camp followers are people who travel with an army or other group, especially members of soldiers' families, or people who supply goods and services to the army.

defs.def_cn: 出生星座(指出生日期在黄道十二宫所占的星座)

ext.ext_cn: “你是什么星座的?”——“双子座。”
ext.ext_en: 'What star sign are you?'—'Gemini.'

defs.def_en: Your star sign is the sign of the zodiac under which you were born.

defs.def_cn: （常指不外出工作的）家庭妇女，家庭主妇
defs.def_en: A homemaker is a woman who spends a lot of time looking after her home and family. If you describe a woman as a homemaker, you usually mean that she does not have another job.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 忙得不可开交的;不得闲的;正在使用的

ext.ext_cn: 他正忙他那本新书。他在辛勤工作，您是知道的。
ext.ext_en: He's tied up with his new book. He's working hard, you know...

ext.ext_cn: 越来越多老年人的资金全让房子给套牢了。
ext.ext_en: More and more old people have capital tied up in a house.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is tied up, they are busy or being used, with the result that they are not available for anything else.

ext.ext_cn: 你有没有轻信过有关肯尼迪总统遇刺的阴谋论？
ext.ext_en: Did you ever swallow the conspiracy theory about Kennedy?

defs.def_en: A conspiracy theory is a belief that a group of people are secretly trying to harm someone or achieve something. You usually use this term to suggest that you think this is unlikely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 占有欲强的；有控制欲的

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼很爱吃醋，对我的占有欲很强。
ext.ext_en: Danny could be very jealous and possessive about me...

ext.ext_cn: 他母亲控制欲很强，过去他常常一天给她打好几次电话。
ext.ext_en: He used to ring his possessive mother several times a day.

defs.def_en: Someone who is possessive about another person wants all that person's love and attention.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不愿与人分享的；自私的

ext.ext_cn: 人们很想独占礼券。
ext.ext_en: People were very possessive about their coupons.

defs.def_en: Someone who is possessive about things that they own does not like other people to use them.

In grammar, a possessive determiner or possessive adjective is a word such as 'my' or 'his' which shows who or what something belongs to or is connected with. The possessive form of a name or noun has 's added to it, as in 'Jenny's' or 'cat's'.
A possessive is a possessive determiner or the possessive form of a name or noun.

ext.ext_cn: 在热闹广场的另一边，摊贩叫卖着热狗和羊角三明治。
ext.ext_en: Across the busy plaza, vendors sell hot dogs and croissant sandwiches.

defs.def_en: A plaza is an open square in a city.

defs.def_cn: 购物中心，商业区（彼此相连或拥有公共区域的一组店铺或建筑）
defs.def_en: A plaza is a group of stores or buildings that are joined together or share common areas.

ext.ext_cn: 西北方向5英里外的阿申特岛
ext.ext_en: ...Ushant, five miles out to the north-west.

defs.def_en: The north-west is the direction which is halfway between north and west.

ext.ext_cn: 工党在西北部地区展开了其选举前的竞选活动。
ext.ext_en: Labour took its pre-election campaign to the North-West.

ext.ext_cn: 南美洲的最西北部
ext.ext_en: ...the extreme north-west of South America.

defs.def_en: The north-west of a place, country, or region is the part which is towards the north-west.

ext.ext_cn: 走和铁路线平行的那条西北向的窄巷。
ext.ext_en: Take the narrow lane going north-west parallel with the railway line.

defs.def_en: If you go north-west, you travel towards the north-west.

ext.ext_cn: 这里地处镇子的西北方，离火车站仅有一小段步行距离。
ext.ext_en: This was situated to the north-west of the town, a short walk from the railway station.

defs.def_en: Something that is north-west of a place is positioned to the north-west of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 西北地区卫生局
ext.ext_en: ...the North-West Regional Health Authority.

ext.ext_cn: 美国的西北海岸
ext.ext_en: ...the north-west coast of the United States.

defs.def_en: The north-west part of a place, country, or region is the part which is towards the north-west.

defs.def_cn: (风)从西北方吹来的;西北风的

ext.ext_cn: 寒冷干燥的西北风横扫了这个地区。
ext.ext_en: A brisk north-west wind swept across the region.

defs.def_en: A north-west wind is a wind that blows from the north-west.

defs.def_cn: （尤指养牛、马、羊等的）农场主，农场管理人

ext.ext_cn: 牧牛场场主
ext.ext_en: ...a cattle rancher.

defs.def_en: A rancher is someone who owns or manages a large farm, especially one used for raising cattle, horses, or sheep.
Champagne is an expensive French white wine with bubbles in. It is often drunk to celebrate something.
If you say that champagne corks are popping, you mean that people are celebrating something.

defs.def_cn: 静力锻炼法;等长收缩肌肉锻炼法
defs.def_en: Isometrics or isometric exercises are exercises in which you make your muscles work against each other or against something else, for example by pressing your hands together.

defs.def_cn: (在比赛、竞赛中)轻松击败，以大比分战胜

ext.ext_cn: 排名第二的流浪者队以 5: 0 大胜圣约翰斯通队。
ext.ext_en: Second-placed Rangers thrashed St Johnstone 5-nil.

defs.def_en: If one player or team thrashes another in a game or contest, they defeat them easily or by a large score.

defs.def_cn: (作为惩罚)连续击打，接连殴打，痛打

ext.ext_cn: “叫你撒谎！”萨拉一边揍着孩子，一边尖叫道，“就是你偷的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Liar!' Sarah screamed, as she thrashed the child. 'You stole it.'

defs.def_en: If you thrash someone, you hit them several times as a punishment.

defs.def_cn: 猛烈摆动;翻来覆去;剧烈扭动(四肢)

ext.ext_cn: 很多船员在鲨鱼成群的水域中拼命挣扎，死状惨不忍睹。
ext.ext_en: Many of the crew died a terrible death as they thrashed about in shark-infested waters...

ext.ext_cn: 梦境太逼真了，我在睡袋里翻来滚去，喊出了声
ext.ext_en: ...dreams so vivid that I thrash inside my sleeping bag and cry out...

defs.def_en: If someone thrashes about, or thrashes their arms or legs about, they move in a wild or violent way, often hitting against something. You can also say that someone's arms or legs thrash about .

ext.ext_cn: 广阔的密西西比河上行驶着一艘豪华庞大的明轮船，她巨大的轮子拍打着浑浊的河水
ext.ext_en: ...a magnificent paddle-steamer on the mighty Mississippi, her huge wheel thrashing the muddy water...

ext.ext_cn: 3 个头发蓬乱的男人没腔没调地乱弹着吉他。
ext.ext_en: Three shaggy-haired men thrash tunelessly at their guitars.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing thrashes something, or thrashes at something, they hit it continually in a violent or noisy way.

ext.ext_cn: 哈里在办公室开派对时总不忘叫上查利。
ext.ext_en: Harry always invited Charlie when he threw a thrash in his office.

defs.def_en: A thrash is a party.

defs.def_cn: (政治)保守主义;保守党的政治主张

ext.ext_cn: 现代保守主义哲学
ext.ext_en: ...the philosophy of modern Conservatism.

defs.def_en: Conservatism is a political philosophy which believes that if changes need to be made to society, they should be made gradually. You can also refer to the political beliefs of a conservative party in a particular country as Conservatism .

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家文学界的因循守旧令人震惊。
ext.ext_en: The conservatism of the literary establishment in this country is astounding...

ext.ext_cn: 他开始了会计师的职业生涯，一份典型的体面而保守的工作。
ext.ext_en: He began his professional life as an accountant, the very model of respectability and conservatism.

defs.def_en: Conservatism is unwillingness to accept changes and new ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙最大的石油产品分销商
ext.ext_en: ...Spain's largest distributor of petroleum products...

ext.ext_cn: 布尔默公司是巴黎水和牙买加红带拉格啤酒的英国分销商。
ext.ext_en: Bulmer is the UK distributor for Perrier and the Jamaican lager Red Stripe...

defs.def_en: A distributor is a company that supplies goods to shops or other businesses.
The distributor in a car or other motor vehicle is a device that sends electric current to the spark plugs in the engine.

defs.def_cn: 连续不断的;持续的;不中断的

ext.ext_cn: 居民们报告说他们听到了连续不断的枪声。
ext.ext_en: Residents report that they heard continuous gunfire.

ext.ext_cn: 所有在公司连续任职达5年的员工
ext.ext_en: ...all employees who had a record of five years' continuous employment with the firm...

defs.def_en: A continuous process or event continues for a period of time without stopping.

defs.def_cn: (线、表面等)连续的，没有间隔的

ext.ext_cn: 一排船只
ext.ext_en: ...a continuous line of boats.

ext.ext_cn: 一条人物雕像构成的檐壁
ext.ext_en: ...the continuous frieze of sculpted figures.

defs.def_en: A continuous line or surface has no gaps or holes in it.

In English grammar, continuous verb groups are formed using the auxiliary 'be' and the present participle of a verb, as in 'I'm feeling a bit tired' and 'She had been watching them for some time'. Continuous verb groups are used especially when you are focusing on a particular moment.  →see usage note at:continual

defs.def_cn: 双胞胎之一;孪生儿之一

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉当时正在照管那对双胞胎。
ext.ext_en: Sarah was looking after the twins...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为身为双胞胎中的一个有很多积极方面。
ext.ext_en: I think there are many positive aspects to being a twin…

defs.def_en: If two people are twins, they have the same mother and were born on the same day.

ext.ext_cn: 大教堂的那对尖塔
ext.ext_en: ...the twin spires of the cathedral.

ext.ext_cn: 世界上最大的双引擎飞机
ext.ext_en: ...the world's largest twin-engined aircraft.

defs.def_en: Twin is used to describe a pair of things that look the same and are close together.

ext.ext_cn: 自由与平等这两个密切相关的概念
ext.ext_en: ...the twin concepts of liberty and equality...

ext.ext_cn: 没有采取任何措施把这些妇女从乞讨或济贫院这两大相似的灾难中拯救出来。
ext.ext_en: Nothing was done to save these women from the twin evils of begging or the workhouse.

defs.def_en: Twin is used to describe two things or ideas that are similar or connected in some way.

defs.def_cn: 使结成友好地区;使结为特殊关系

ext.ext_cn: 5 家波兰银行将和 5 家西欧银行结为姐妹银行。
ext.ext_en: Five Polish banks are to be twinned with counterparts in Western Europe...

ext.ext_cn: 该自治市与德国的卡瑟尔市结成了友好城市。
ext.ext_en: The borough is twinned with Kasel in Germany.

defs.def_en: When a place or organization in one country is twinned with a place or organization in another country, a special relationship is formally established between them.

ext.ext_cn: 这使得萨格勒布的友好城市美因茨捐赠了价值 7 万英镑的高品质装备。
ext.ext_en: This led Zagreb's twin town, Mainz, to donate £70,000-worth of high-quality equipment.

defs.def_en: Twin towns or cities are twinned with each other.

ext.ext_cn: 随着我们年龄的增长，眼睛的晶状体变厚，因此对光线的折射也会发生变化。
ext.ext_en: As we age the lenses of the eyes thicken, and thus refract light differently.

ext.ext_cn: 导致光线发生反射和折射的表面
ext.ext_en: ...surfaces that cause the light to reflect and refract.

defs.def_en: When a ray of light or a sound wave refracts or is refracted, the path it follows bends at a particular point, for example when it enters water or glass.

defs.def_cn: （食物或饮料）低热量的，低糖的，低脂的；低酒精的

ext.ext_cn: 淡啤酒
ext.ext_en: ...lite beer.

ext.ext_cn: 低脂酸奶
ext.ext_en: ...lite yogurt.

defs.def_en: Lite is used to describe foods or drinks that contain few calories or low amounts of sugar, fat, or alcohol.

ext.ext_cn: 一场为时过长、自我陶醉的注水版爵士轻音乐演奏
ext.ext_en: ... an extended, self congratulatory session of easy-listening jazz-lite.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as lite, you dislike it because it is a weaker and less demanding version of something else.

defs.def_cn: 退款；（税金、租金等的）退还部分

ext.ext_cn: 退税
ext.ext_en: ...a tax rebate...

ext.ext_cn: 顾客将从他们的电费退费中得到实惠。
ext.ext_en: Customers are to benefit from a rebate on their electricity bills.

defs.def_en: A rebate is an amount of money which is paid to you when you have paid more tax, rent, or rates than you needed to.
A three-wheeler is a bicycle or car with three wheels.
An expletive is a rude word or expression such as 'Damn!' which you say when you are annoyed, excited, or in pain.

ext.ext_cn: 一些意大利顶尖级电视明星的图片合集
ext.ext_en: ...a photo montage of some of Italy's top television stars.

defs.def_en: A montage is a picture, film, or piece of music which consists of several different items that are put together, often in an unusual combination or sequence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人垂涎的;色香俱佳的

ext.ext_cn: 形状、口感和味道各异让人垂涎的数百种奶酪
ext.ext_en: ...hundreds of cheeses, in a mouth-watering variety of shapes, textures and tastes.

ext.ext_cn: 150多种诱人的食谱
ext.ext_en: ...more than 150 mouthwatering recipes.

defs.def_en: Mouth-watering food looks or smells extremely nice.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 价值960万英镑的诱人奖品无人认领。
ext.ext_en: Prizes worth a mouth-watering £9.6 million are unclaimed.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as mouth-watering, you are emphasizing that it is very attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那次事故使这个男孩脑部严重受损，生活几乎完全依赖别人。
ext.ext_en: The accident left the boy severely brain-damaged and almost totally reliant on others.

defs.def_en: Someone who is brain-damaged has suffered brain damage.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的主要目标是将孩子安然无恙地找回来。
ext.ext_en: Our main objective was the recovery of the child safe and well...

ext.ext_cn: 他的目标是参加高尔夫球比赛并赢得胜利。
ext.ext_en: His objective was to play golf and win.

defs.def_en: Your objective is what you are trying to achieve.

ext.ext_cn: 他没有客观证据表明正在发生什么不同寻常之事。
ext.ext_en: He had no objective evidence that anything extraordinary was happening.

defs.def_en: Objective information is based on facts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （观点）客观的，不带个人感情的，没有个人偏见的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为新闻记者不应当有丝毫偏见。
ext.ext_en: I believe that a journalist should be completely objective...

ext.ext_cn: 我很想听听你对此事的客观见解。
ext.ext_en: I would really like to have your objective opinion on this.

defs.def_en: If someone is objective, they base their opinions on facts rather than on their personal feelings.
A woman's boobs are her breasts.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的时间掐得准吗？是不是他们又弄错了？
ext.ext_en: Is their timing right, or have they boobed again?

ext.ext_cn: 政府又一次犯了大错。
ext.ext_en: The government once again has made a big boob.

defs.def_en: If you boob, you make a mistake.
A cash desk is a place in a large shop where you pay for the things you want to buy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 友善的；真诚的；亲切的；和蔼可亲的

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃总是那么友善热情。
ext.ext_en: Bob was always genial and welcoming...

ext.ext_cn: 他是个热心的朋友，也是友善待客的主人。
ext.ext_en: He was a warm-hearted friend and genial host.

defs.def_en: Someone who is genial is kind and friendly.

defs.def_cn: (过程)断断续续的，一松一弛的

ext.ext_cn: 停滞与发展交替的经济循环
ext.ext_en: ...stop-go economic cycles.

ext.ext_cn: 要保持缓慢而平稳的流动，而不是时断时续
ext.ext_en: ...to allow for slow and steady flow, not stop and go.

defs.def_en: Stop-go is used to describe processes in which there are periods of inactivity between periods of activity.
Black holes are areas in space, where gravity is so strong that nothing, not even light, can escape from them. Black holes are thought to be formed by collapsed stars.
If you say that something, especially money, has gone into a black hole, you mean that it has disappeared and cannot be recovered.

ext.ext_cn: 我能够查阅证实这一说法的大量文件。
ext.ext_en: I had access to a wide range of documents which corroborated the story...

ext.ext_cn: 艾丽斯证实了布莱尔所说的。
ext.ext_en: Alice corroborated what Blair had said.

defs.def_en: To corroborate something that has been said or reported means to provide evidence or information that supports it.

ext.ext_cn: 找到一块颜色、尺寸和价格都符合你要求的毛毯几乎是不可能的。
ext.ext_en: Finding a rug that's just the colour, size and price you want can be well-nigh impossible.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎不可撼动的等级制度
ext.ext_en: ...a hierarchical structure that was well-nigh unassailable.

defs.def_en: Well-nigh means almost, but not completely or exactly.

ext.ext_cn: 她抿了口咖啡，然后把墙上的一幅画扶正。
ext.ext_en: She sipped her coffee and straightened a picture on the wall.

ext.ext_cn: 收拾、摆放靠垫和整理杂志
ext.ext_en: ...tidying, straightening cushions and organising magazines.

defs.def_en: If you straighten something, you make it tidy or put it in its proper position.

ext.ext_cn: 3 个男人挺直身体，站着等候。
ext.ext_en: The three men straightened and stood waiting.

ext.ext_cn: 他挺直身子，把手插进口袋里。
ext.ext_en: He straightened up and slipped his hands in his pockets.

defs.def_en: If you are standing in a relaxed or slightly bent position and then you straighten, you make your back or body straight and upright.

ext.ext_cn: 挺直双腿直至完全伸展开。
ext.ext_en: Straighten both legs until they are fully extended...

ext.ext_cn: 路变直了，我们驶上了高原。
ext.ext_en: The road straightened and we were on a plateau.

defs.def_en: If you straighten something, or it straightens, it becomes straight.

ext.ext_cn: 他绝对有权批准那样的一次警方突袭行动。
ext.ext_en: It would certainly be within his power to authorize a police raid like that...

ext.ext_cn: 我们愿意授权总统在必要的时候使用武力。
ext.ext_en: We are willing to authorize the president to use force if necessary.

defs.def_en: If someone in a position of authority authorizes something, they give their official permission for it to happen.

defs.def_cn: (通常指布料、衣服等洗后)缩水，收缩，缩小，皱缩

ext.ext_cn: 我所有的套头毛衣都缩水了。
ext.ext_en: All my jumpers have shrunk.

defs.def_en: If cloth or clothing shrinks, it becomes smaller in size, usually as a result of being washed.

ext.ext_cn: 西非的大片森林面积已缩小了。
ext.ext_en: The vast forests of West Africa have shrunk...

ext.ext_cn: 匈牙利可能不得不降低其缩小国家军事管制区的期望。
ext.ext_en: Hungary may have to lower its hopes of shrinking its state sector.

defs.def_en: If something shrinks or something else shrinks it, it becomes smaller.

defs.def_cn: (因害怕、震惊或厌恶)退缩，畏缩，避开

ext.ext_cn: 当我试图和一个孩子说话时，他避开了我。
ext.ext_en: One child shrinks away from me when I try to talk to him...

ext.ext_cn: 西格弗里德畏缩了，退避到墙根。
ext.ext_en: Siegfried cringed and shrank against the wall...

defs.def_en: If you shrink away from someone or something, you move away from them because you are frightened, shocked, or disgusted by them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们要想保持诚信可靠，就绝不能避忌武力的合法使用。
ext.ext_en: We must not shrink from the legitimate use of force if we are to remain credible...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在危险面前没有退缩。
ext.ext_en: They didn't shrink from danger.

defs.def_en: If you do not shrink from a task or duty, you do it even though it is unpleasant or dangerous.

ext.ext_cn: 我已经看过心理专家了。
ext.ext_en: I've seen a shrink already.

defs.def_en: A shrink is a psychiatrist.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她看上去比同龄人个头小。
ext.ext_en: She is small for her age...

ext.ext_cn: 窗户对他来说实在太小，他钻不过去。
ext.ext_en: The window was far too small for him to get through...

defs.def_en: A small person, thing, or amount of something is not large in physical size.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一小组学生定期聚在一起学习日语。
ext.ext_en: A small group of students meets regularly to learn Japanese...

ext.ext_cn: 枪支继续被小批量地制造出来。
ext.ext_en: Guns continued to be produced in small numbers.

defs.def_en: A small group or quantity consists of only a few people or things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我有一个妻子和两个年幼的孩子。
ext.ext_en: I have a wife and two small children...

ext.ext_cn: 你小的时候是什么样子？
ext.ext_en: What were you like when you were small?

defs.def_en: A small child is a very young child.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不重要的;无足轻重的;程度小的

ext.ext_cn: 对工作方式作一些小的改变会比较容易。
ext.ext_en: It's quite easy to make quite small changes to the way that you work...

ext.ext_cn: 再小的细节都逃不过她的眼睛。
ext.ext_en: No detail was too small to escape her attention...

defs.def_en: You use small to describe something that is not significant or great in degree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (企业或公司)小规模的，小型的

ext.ext_cn: 商店、饭馆以及其他小企业
ext.ext_en: ...shops, restaurants and other small businesses...

ext.ext_cn: 这里制造工具的公司普遍规模不大。
ext.ext_en: Tool companies here are generally small.

defs.def_en: Small businesses or companies employ a small number of people and do business with a small number of clients.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她非常小声地说：“我很害怕。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'm scared,' she said in a very small voice.

defs.def_en: If someone speaks in a small voice, they speak in a quiet, high voice because they are frightened or ashamed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这也许是她处心积虑要让我自惭形秽的另一步棋。
ext.ext_en: This may just be another of her schemes to make me look small...

ext.ext_cn: 孩子表现不佳时要让他们知道，但不能让他们自惭形秽。
ext.ext_en: When your children misbehave tell them without making them feel small.

defs.def_en: If someone makes you look or feel small, they make you look or feel stupid or ashamed.

ext.ext_cn: 双手置于腰部，吸气。
ext.ext_en: Place your hands on the small of your back and breathe in.

defs.def_en: The small of your back is the bottom part of your back that curves in slightly.

defs.def_cn: (国有企业等的)出售;(公司股票的)抛售

ext.ext_cn: 电力行业的私有化——其中最大的一笔出售
ext.ext_en: The privatisation of the electricity industry — the biggest sell-off of them all...

ext.ext_cn: 任何俄罗斯的土地或资产都不可出售。
ext.ext_en: There is no question of any 'sell-off' of Russian land or assets.

defs.def_en: The sell-off of something, for example an industry owned by the state or a company's shares, is the selling of it.
A sketchpad is the same as a sketchbook .

ext.ext_cn: 北半球
ext.ext_en: ...the northern hemisphere.

defs.def_en: A hemisphere is one half of the earth.

ext.ext_cn: 多数人的左脑比右脑大。
ext.ext_en: In most people, the left hemisphere is bigger than the right.

defs.def_en: A hemisphere is one half of the brain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 口语表达
ext.ext_en: ...a colloquial expression...

ext.ext_cn: 他结结巴巴地学说俄语，把她逗乐了。
ext.ext_en: His stumbling attempts at colloquial Russian amused her.

defs.def_en: Colloquial words and phrases are informal and are used mainly in conversation.

defs.def_cn: 灰姑娘;被忽视的人(或组织)

ext.ext_cn: 这个慈善机构得到的关注太少了，需要更多的帮助。
ext.ext_en: It is a Cinderella of charities, and needs more help.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or organization as a Cinderella, you mean that they receive very little attention and that they deserve to receive more.

defs.def_cn: 经前综合征，经前紧张征（常使用缩略形式PMS）

ext.ext_cn: 大约70％的女性有经前综合征。
ext.ext_en: About 70% of women suffer from premenstrual syndrome.

defs.def_en: Premenstrual syndrome is used to refer to the problems, including strain and tiredness, that many women experience before menstruation. The abbreviation PMS is often used.

ext.ext_cn: 传统石板瓦屋顶的石屋
ext.ext_en: ... a stone-built cottage, with a traditional slate roof.

defs.def_en: Slate is a dark grey rock that can be easily split into thin layers. Slate is often used for covering roofs.
A slate is one of the small flat pieces of slate that are used for covering roofs.

ext.ext_cn: 领导层打算只提交一份供公开投票表决通过的候选人名单。
ext.ext_en: The leadership want to present a single slate of candidates to be approved in an open vote.

defs.def_en: A slate is a list of candidates for an election, usually from the same party.

ext.ext_cn: 布罗姆菲尔德被确定为美国农业部长。
ext.ext_en: Bromfield was slated to become U.S. Secretary of Agriculture...

ext.ext_cn: 几项颇受争议的能源措施定于几天后提交参议院讨论。
ext.ext_en: Controversial energy measures are slated for Senate debate within days.

defs.def_en: If something is slated to happen, it is planned to happen at a particular time or on a particular occasion.

ext.ext_cn: 阿诺德·施瓦辛格的新餐馆受到了一位顶级食评家的恶评。
ext.ext_en: Arnold Schwarzenegger's new restaurant has been slated by a top food critic...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管在当时备受评论家的非议，这部影片后来却成了一部有关异端邪教的经典之作。
ext.ext_en: Slated by critics at the time, the film has since become a cult classic.

defs.def_en: If something is slated, it is criticized very severely.

ext.ext_cn: 建议你还清所有的债务，这样你就能够重新开始了。
ext.ext_en: The proposal is to pay everything you owe, so that you can start with a clean slate.

defs.def_en: If you start with a clean slate, you do not take account of previous mistakes or failures and make a fresh start.

ext.ext_cn: 为什么不洗心革面、从头来过呢？
ext.ext_en: Why not wipe the slate clean and start all over again?

defs.def_en: If you wipe the slate clean, you decide to forget previous mistakes, failures, or debts and to start again.

ext.ext_cn: 他被从爱尔兰共和国引渡到英国，面临爆炸罪的指控。
ext.ext_en: He was extradited to Britain from the Irish Republic to face explosives charges...

ext.ext_cn: 当局拒绝引渡他。
ext.ext_en: The authorities refused to extradite him.

defs.def_en: If someone is extradited, they are officially sent back to their own or another country to be tried for a crime that they have been accused of.

ext.ext_cn: 他烦了就去集市上逛逛。
ext.ext_en: When he got bored he wandered around the fair...

ext.ext_cn: 他们信步朝最近的商店走去。
ext.ext_en: They wandered off in the direction of the nearest store...

defs.def_en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction.

ext.ext_cn: 妈妈生怕我们迷路，不准我们走远。
ext.ext_en: Because Mother is afraid we'll get lost, we aren't allowed to wander far...

ext.ext_cn: 为了防止蜜蜂迷路 ，养蜂人给它们喝糖水。
ext.ext_en: To keep their bees from wandering, beekeepers feed them sugar solutions.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal wanders from a place where they are supposed to stay, they move away from the place without going in a particular direction.

ext.ext_cn: 他会走神，忘了自己正在干什么。
ext.ext_en: His mind would wander, and he would lose track of what he was doing...

ext.ext_cn: 贾维斯发现自己走神了。
ext.ext_en: Jarvis found his attention wandering...

defs.def_en: If your mind wanders or your thoughts wander, you stop concentrating on something and start thinking about other things.

ext.ext_cn: 他的眼睛不安地转来转去，打量着房间。
ext.ext_en: His eyes wandered restlessly around the room...

ext.ext_cn: 他的眼神不停地瞄到这幅画上。
ext.ext_en: His eyes kept wandering to the picture...

defs.def_en: If your eyes wander, you stop looking at one thing and start looking around at other things.

defs.def_cn: 无人照顾的；无人关心的；被忽视的

ext.ext_cn: 感到自己纯属多余、无人疼爱、少人关心的人
ext.ext_en: ...people who feel unwanted, unloved, and uncared for.

defs.def_en: If you describe people or animals as uncared for, you mean that they have not been looked after properly and as a result are hungry, dirty, or ill.

ext.ext_cn: 有些人会主动地向你讲述他们的生活经历。
ext.ext_en: Some people give you their life history without much prompting.

defs.def_en: The life history of a person is all the things that happen to them during their life.
Sedge is a plant that looks like grass and grows in wet ground.

ext.ext_cn: 他们像两个幽灵似的消失在了楼下。
ext.ext_en: They vanished down the stairs like two phantoms...

ext.ext_cn: 那个幽灵过去常常出人意料地出现，但是大多在冬季。
ext.ext_en: The phantom used to appear unexpectedly, but mostly during the winter.

defs.def_en: A phantom is a ghost.

ext.ext_cn: 她老请病假，同事们认为她所说的病纯属无中生有。
ext.ext_en: She was always taking days off for what her colleagues considered phantom illnesses.

ext.ext_cn: 假妊娠
ext.ext_en: ...a phantom pregnancy.

defs.def_en: You use phantom to describe something which you think you experience but which is not real.

ext.ext_cn: 据称被人从商业大街的取款机上冒取现金的受害者
ext.ext_en: ...victims of alleged 'phantom' withdrawals from high-street cash machines.

defs.def_en: Phantom can refer to something that is done by an unknown person, especially something criminal.

defs.def_cn: 有名无实的；虚假骗人的

ext.ext_cn: 华尔街一家投资银行的虚假交易计划
ext.ext_en: ...a phantom trading scheme at a Wall Street investment bank.

defs.def_en: Phantom is used to describe business organizations, agreements, or goods which do not really exist, but which someone pretends do exist in order to cheat people.

defs.def_cn: 运气饼干，签饼(内有预测运势的小纸条，经常见于中餐馆)
defs.def_en: A fortune cookie is a sweet, crisp cake which contains a piece of paper which is supposed to say what will happen to you in the future. Fortune cookies are often served in Chinese restaurants.

ext.ext_cn: 大脑变性疾病，如阿尔茨海默病
ext.ext_en: ...degenerative diseases of the brain, like Alzheimer's.

defs.def_en: A degenerative disease or condition is one that gets worse as time progresses.

defs.def_cn: 参加三项全能比赛的运动员
defs.def_en: A triathlete is someone who takes part in a triathlon .

defs.def_cn: 只雇用工会会员的工厂(或商店等)

ext.ext_cn: 根据只雇用工会会员的协议他们所要加入的工会
ext.ext_en: ...the trade union which they are required to join under the closed shop agreement.

defs.def_en: If a factory, shop, or other business is a closed shop, the employees must be members of a particular trade union.

defs.def_cn: （与名词连用构成名词）表示“暴力对待…的人”，“对…有强烈不满的人”

ext.ext_cn: 到处寻找并殴打同性恋者的人
ext.ext_en: ...gay-bashers who go around looking for homosexuals to beat up...

ext.ext_cn: 这些压力并非来自于那些对律师心怀不满的轻率之人，而是来自于那些头脑冷静的司法改革家。
ext.ext_en: These pressures come not from unthinking lawyer-bashers, but from sober legal reformers.

defs.def_en: -basher combines with nouns to form nouns referring to someone who is physically violent towards a particular type of person, or who is unfairly critical of a particular type of person.

ext.ext_cn: 油经过提炼去除天然存在的杂质。
ext.ext_en: Oil is refined to remove naturally occurring impurities.

defs.def_en: When a substance is refined, it is made pure by having all other substances removed from it.

defs.def_cn: 改进，改善，改良（过程、理论或机器）

ext.ext_cn: 外科手术的技术不断得到完善。
ext.ext_en: Surgical techniques are constantly being refined.

defs.def_en: If something such as a process, theory, or machine is refined, it is improved by having small changes made to it.

ext.ext_cn: 保罗·赖克曼出价到200万美金。
ext.ext_en: Paul Reichmann offered to ante up $2 million.

defs.def_en: If you ante up an amount of money, you pay your share, sometimes unwillingly.

ext.ext_cn: 他好几个小时都对着一堵墙掷网球。
ext.ext_en: He spent hours throwing a tennis ball against a wall...

ext.ext_cn: 他父亲曾有一次拎起收音机砸向他的母亲。
ext.ext_en: On one occasion, his father threw a radio at his mother...

defs.def_en: When you throw an object that you are holding, you move your hand or arm quickly and let go of the object, so that it moves through the air.

defs.def_cn: 急伸，猛动(身体或某部位)

ext.ext_cn: 她一把搂住他的肩膀。
ext.ext_en: She threw her arms around his shoulders...

ext.ext_cn: 她威胁要卧轨。
ext.ext_en: She threatened to throw herself in front of a train...

defs.def_en: If you throw your body or part of your body into a particular position or place, you move it there suddenly and with a lot of force.

ext.ext_cn: 他费劲脱下他那件笨重的夹克，随手把它扔在后座上。
ext.ext_en: He struggled out of his bulky jacket and threw it on to the back seat...

ext.ext_cn: 为什么不把它全扔进罐子，看看会发生什么变化？
ext.ext_en: Why not throw it all in the pot and see what happens?

defs.def_en: If you throw something into a particular place or position, you put it there in a quick and careless way.

ext.ext_cn: 他把我摔倒在地，开始用脚踢。
ext.ext_en: He threw me to the ground and started to kick...

ext.ext_cn: 那个装置爆炸了，把泰勒先生从车里抛了出去。
ext.ext_en: The device exploded, throwing Mr Taylor from his car.

defs.def_en: To throw someone into a particular place or position means to force them roughly into that place or position.

ext.ext_cn: 那两个人早就应该抓去坐牢。
ext.ext_en: Those two should have been thrown in jail...

ext.ext_cn: 警察应该有权对妨碍救援的人处以罚款。其实要是换了我，非关他们一宿不可。
ext.ext_en: Police should have the power to fine people who hamper rescue efforts. In fact I'd throw them into prison for a night.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is thrown into prison, you mean that they are put there by the authorities, especially if this seems unfair or cruel.

ext.ext_cn: 那匹马尥了个蹶子，把骑手掀下马，还撞倒了旁边站着的一个小伙子。
ext.ext_en: The horse reared, throwing its rider and knocking down a youth standing beside it.

defs.def_en: If a horse throws its rider, it makes him or her fall off, by suddenly jumping or moving violently.

defs.def_cn: 使处境不利;使进展不顺

ext.ext_cn: 出租车司机的抗议使得阿比让陷入了混乱。
ext.ext_en: Abidjan was thrown into turmoil because of a protest by taxi drivers...

ext.ext_cn: 经济衰退导致数百万人失业。
ext.ext_en: Economic recession had thrown millions out of work...

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is thrown into an unpleasant situation or state, something causes them to be in that situation or state.

defs.def_cn: 投下，洒下，抛下(光线或影子)

ext.ext_cn: 阳光明亮刺眼，在地上投下轮廓分明的影子。
ext.ext_en: The sunlight is white and blinding, throwing hard-edged shadows on the ground.

defs.def_en: If something throws light or a shadow on a surface, it causes that surface to have light or a shadow on it.

ext.ext_cn: 这个新信息确实使人们对他们的选择产生了怀疑。
ext.ext_en: This new information does throw doubt on their choice...

ext.ext_cn: 她无意让大家怀疑你。
ext.ext_en: She did not attempt to throw any suspicion upon you.

defs.def_en: If something throws doubt on a person or thing, it causes people to doubt or suspect them.

defs.def_cn: 飞快(看)一眼;迅速(笑)一下

ext.ext_cn: 埃米莉转过头，冲她意味深长地一笑。
ext.ext_en: Emily turned and threw her a suggestive grin.

defs.def_en: If you throw a look or smile at someone or something, you look or smile at them quickly and suddenly.

ext.ext_cn: 她投身于模特事业。
ext.ext_en: She threw herself into a modelling career...

ext.ext_cn: 他们将全部军事资源都投入了那场战斗。
ext.ext_en: They threw all their military resources into the battle.

defs.def_en: If you throw yourself, your energy, or your money into a particular job or activity, you become involved in it very actively or enthusiastically.

ext.ext_cn: 以前，我动不动就发脾气，大喊大叫，还骂人。
ext.ext_en: I used to get very upset and scream and swear, throwing tantrums all over the place.

defs.def_en: If you throw a fit or a tantrum, you suddenly start to behave in an uncontrolled way.

ext.ext_cn: 教授问我是否爱好武术，这个问题让我吃了一惊。
ext.ext_en: The professor rather threw me by asking if I went in for martial arts...

defs.def_en: You can ask how something came to happen when you want to know what caused it to happen or made it possible.

ext.ext_cn: 内政部会议结束后，声明随即发表。
ext.ext_en: The announcement came after a meeting at the Home Office...

ext.ext_cn: 我们是时候继续前行了。
ext.ext_en: The time has come for us to move on...

defs.def_en: When a particular event or time comes, it arrives or happens.

defs.def_cn: (用于日期、时间或事件之前)当…到来时

ext.ext_cn: 到5月20日选举的那一天，我们必须作出决定。
ext.ext_en: Come the election on the 20th of May, we will have to decide...

ext.ext_cn: 到星期天他又会上那儿去。
ext.ext_en: He's going to be up there again come Sunday.

defs.def_en: You can use come before a date, time, or event to mean when that date, time, or event arrives. For example, you can say come the spring to mean 'when the spring arrives'.

defs.def_cn: 突然被…意识到;突然被…想起

ext.ext_cn: 他正准备关门，突然想到一个主意。
ext.ext_en: He was about to shut the door when an idea came to him...

ext.ext_cn: 然后，我突然意识到他可能的确是明白了。
ext.ext_en: Then it came to me that perhaps he did understand.

defs.def_en: If a thought, idea, or memory comes to you, you suddenly think of it or remember it.

ext.ext_cn: 这一大笔钱将归你所有。
ext.ext_en: The fortune will come to you...

ext.ext_cn: 工厂倒闭的时候，他的确拿到了养老金。
ext.ext_en: He did have pension money coming to him when the factory shut down.

defs.def_en: If money or property is going to come to you, you are going to inherit or receive it.

defs.def_cn: (案件)提交…审理，送交…进行处理

ext.ext_cn: 会员申请书于9月提交部长会议审议。
ext.ext_en: The membership application came before the Council of Ministers in September...

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯蒂亚尼总统要求案件在90天内送交法院审理。
ext.ext_en: President Cristiani expected the case to come to court within ninety days.

defs.def_en: If a case comes before a court or tribunal or comes to court, it is presented there so that the court or tribunal can examine it.

ext.ext_cn: 午餐总共80美元。
ext.ext_en: Lunch came to $80.

defs.def_en: If something comes to a particular number or amount, it adds up to it.

ext.ext_cn: 将近一半的学生来自国外。
ext.ext_en: Nearly half the students come from abroad...

ext.ext_cn: 巧克力出自可可树。
ext.ext_en: Chocolate comes from the cacao tree...

defs.def_en: If someone or something comes from a particular place or thing, that place or thing is their origin, source, or starting point.

ext.ext_cn: 开快车会让人觉得自己有一种主宰之力。
ext.ext_en: There is a feeling of power that comes from driving fast...

ext.ext_cn: 生意不景气也未必全是坏事。
ext.ext_en: Some good might come of all this gloomy business...

defs.def_en: Something that comes from something else or comes of it is the result of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她的家庭出身非常好。
ext.ext_en: She comes of a very good family.

defs.def_en: If someone comes of a particular family or type of family, they are descended from them.

ext.ext_cn: 接下来该走哪一步，这两个国家还未能就此达成一致意见。
ext.ext_en: The two countries have been unable to agree which step should come next...

ext.ext_cn: 如果把所有的元音列在前面，字母表可能会更为合理一些。
ext.ext_en: The alphabet might be more rational if all the vowels came first...

defs.def_en: If someone or something comes first, next, or last, they are first, next, or last in a series, list, or competition.

defs.def_cn: 有，可提供(某种颜色、形状、款式或尺寸)

ext.ext_cn: 各种外形和尺寸的自行车都有。
ext.ext_en: Bikes come in all shapes and sizes...

ext.ext_cn: 这种墙纸只有黑白的。
ext.ext_en: The wallpaper comes in black and white only.

defs.def_en: If a type of thing comes in a particular range of colours, forms, styles, or sizes, it can have any of those colours, forms, styles, or sizes.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示对某事的反应)让人…

ext.ext_cn: 梅杰的回答让众议院大吃一惊。
ext.ext_en: Major's reply came as a complete surprise to the House of Commons...

ext.ext_cn: 这次逮捕让人极为震惊。
ext.ext_en: The arrest has come as a terrible shock.

defs.def_en: You use come in expressions such as it came as a surprise when indicating a person's reaction to something that happens.

ext.ext_cn: 节目的最后，我们来看一则新闻，美国作曲家兼指挥家伦纳德·伯恩斯坦去世。
ext.ext_en: Finally in the programme, we come to the news that the American composer and conductor, Leonard Bernstein, has died...

ext.ext_cn: 那完全是另一回事，接下来我们会谈到。
ext.ext_en: That is another matter altogether. And we shall come to that next.

defs.def_en: The next subject in a discussion that you come to is the one that you talk about next.

ext.ext_cn: “好了，吃吧！”老太太催促道。
ext.ext_en: 'Come, eat!' the old woman urged.

defs.def_en: People say 'Come' to encourage or comfort someone.
To come means to have an orgasm.

defs.def_cn: 再说一遍？你说什么来着？
defs.def_en: Some people say 'Come again?' when they want you to repeat what you have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 新财政部长曾就读于牛津大学，是个极为传统的人。
ext.ext_en: The new finance minister was educated at Oxford and is as traditional as they come.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is, for example, as good as they come, or as stupid as they come, you are emphasizing that they are extremely good or extremely stupid.

defs.def_cn: (表示不赞成或不同意)哦，不，别这样

ext.ext_cn: “你希望朱克曼太太在遗嘱里给你留点什么？”“哦，不，特里索恩先生。当然不是。”
ext.ext_en: 'You hope for something in Mrs Zuckerman's will?' — 'Come, come, Mr Trethowan. Of course not.'

defs.def_en: People say 'Come, come' to indicate that they disapprove of or disagree with what someone has just said or done.

ext.ext_cn: 然而，归根结底，生活中一些基本的问题还是没有变。
ext.ext_en: When you come down to it, however, the basic problems of life have not changed...

ext.ext_cn: 说到底，很少有人能这样无私。
ext.ext_en: Few people, when it comes down to it, are so selfless.

defs.def_en: You can use the expression when it comes down to it or when you come down to it for emphasis, when you are giving a general statement or conclusion.

ext.ext_cn: 他很高兴布雷迪死了，因为他可能纯粹是自找的。
ext.ext_en: He was pleased that Brady was dead because he probably had it coming to him.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has it coming to them, you mean that they deserve everything bad that is going to happen to them, because they have done something wrong or are a bad person. If you say that someone got what was coming to them, you mean that they deserved the punishment or bad experience that they have had.

defs.def_cn: 突然想起来;突然明白过来

ext.ext_cn: 哦，对了，他是他的远亲，岛上的其他人也是。
ext.ext_en: He was his distant relative, as was everyone else on the island, come to think of it...

ext.ext_cn: 其实你要想一想的话，这还是挺怪的。
ext.ext_en: You know, when you come to think of it, this is very odd.

defs.def_en: You use the expression come to think of it to indicate that you have suddenly realized something, often something obvious.

defs.def_cn: (时间或事件)未来的，接下来的

ext.ext_cn: 这场战争在未来的一段时间内仍将是人们热议的话题。
ext.ext_en: The War will remain a heated topic of debate for some time to come...

ext.ext_cn: 我希望未来的几年里他会反省自己的决定。
ext.ext_en: I hope in years to come he will reflect on his decision...

defs.def_en: When you refer to a time or an event to come or one that is still to come, you are referring to a future time or event.

ext.ext_cn: 我们大多数人都知道应该减少脂肪的摄入量。但是在购物和吃东西的时候，这些常识就丢到一边去了。
ext.ext_en: Most of us know we should cut down on fat. But knowing such things isn't much help when it comes to shopping and eating...

ext.ext_cn: 然而，涉及他们认识的人，他们的感觉就不同了。
ext.ext_en: However, when it comes down to somebody that they know, they have a different feeling.

defs.def_en: You can use the expression when it comes to or when it comes down to in order to introduce a new topic or a new aspect of a topic that you are talking about.

defs.def_cn: 我明白你的意思/你可以看出她的态度

ext.ext_cn: 要弄清楚他们这样做的原因，必须要了解他们的意图。
ext.ext_en: To understand why they are doing it, it is necessary to know where they are coming from...

ext.ext_cn: 你明白我的意思了吗？
ext.ext_en: You see where I'm coming from?

defs.def_en: You can use expressions like I know where you're coming from or you can see where she's coming from to say that you understand  someone's attitude or point of view.
A bobbin is a small round object on which thread or wool is wound to hold it, for example on a sewing machine.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 遵守纪律的;受过训练的

ext.ext_cn: 对我来说这意味着在生活上要作息有常。
ext.ext_en: For me it meant being very disciplined about how I run my life...

ext.ext_cn: 士兵们是训练有素的人。
ext.ext_en: Soldiers are disciplined people.

defs.def_en: Someone who is disciplined behaves or works in a controlled way.

defs.def_cn: 重复;雷同;翻版;老调重弹

ext.ext_cn: 《观察家报》认为这部剧“是大家熟悉的米勒式主题的拙劣翻版”。
ext.ext_en: The Observer found the play 'a feeble rehash of familiar Miller themes'...

ext.ext_cn: 这些美国汽车制造商承诺推出的“新款”多半都像是现有车型的翻版。
ext.ext_en: Most of the 'new' models promised by American car makers look set to be little more than rehashes of existing products.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a rehash, you are criticizing it because it repeats old ideas, facts, or themes, though some things have been changed to make it appear new.

defs.def_cn: 对…改头换面;只作轻微改动地重复

ext.ext_cn: 他们从最好的东西中提取一些精华的部分，然后新瓶装旧酒。
ext.ext_en: They've taken some of the best bits out of the best things and rehashed them...

ext.ext_cn: 他们只不过是在老调重弹，提出的声明中没有对未来的展望或设想。
ext.ext_en: They are just bringing up all their old rehashed claims with no prospect or vision for the future.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone rehashes old ideas, facts, or accusations, you disapprove of the fact that they present them in a slightly different way so that they seem new or original.

ext.ext_cn: 她可以看到他T恤衫下的肩部肌肉。
ext.ext_en: She could see the muscles of his shoulders beneath his T-shirt...

ext.ext_cn: 她喜欢坐在树下。
ext.ext_en: She found pleasure in sitting beneath the trees...

defs.def_en: Something that is  beneath another thing is under the other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 表面之下的情感纠结
ext.ext_en: ...emotional strains beneath the surface...

ext.ext_cn: 在内心深处的某个角落里埋藏着一颗爱心。
ext.ext_en: Somewhere deep beneath the surface lay a caring character...

defs.def_en: If you talk about what is beneath the surface of something, you are talking about the aspects of it which are hidden or not obvious.

ext.ext_cn: 他们认定她要嫁给一个配不上她的人。
ext.ext_en: They decided she was marrying beneath her...

ext.ext_cn: 很多人觉得自己在工作上被迫大材小用。
ext.ext_en: Many find themselves having to take jobs far beneath them.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is beneath you, you feel that they are not good enough for you or not suitable for you.

ext.ext_cn: 有些家庭无力维持生活。
ext.ext_en: Some families don't have the resources to feed themselves properly...

ext.ext_cn: 很多学校物资都十分短缺。
ext.ext_en: There's a great shortage of resource materials in many schools.

defs.def_en: The resources of an organization or person are the materials, money, and other things that they have and can use in order to function properly.

ext.ext_cn: 煤、钨、石油和铜之类的资源
ext.ext_en: ...resources like coal, tungsten, oil and copper...

ext.ext_cn: 现在我们人口过多，致使地球资源使用过度。
ext.ext_en: Today we are overpopulated, straining the earth's resources.

defs.def_en: A coun-try's resources are the things that it has and can use to increase its wealth, such as coal, oil, or land.

defs.def_cn: （为演出或音乐会写的）节目说明
defs.def_en: A programme note is an article written in a programme for a play or concert, which gives information about the performance or production.
Taxidermy is the craft of preparing the skins of dead animals and birds and filling them with a special material to make them look as if they are alive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我妈妈教我生活要节俭。
ext.ext_en: My mother taught me to be thrifty.

ext.ext_cn: 花钱精打细算的购物者
ext.ext_en: ...thrifty shoppers.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is thrifty, you are praising them for saving money, not buying unnecessary things, and not wasting things.

ext.ext_cn: 把剩下的配料调和好，放到一个盘子里。
ext.ext_en: Combine the remaining ingredients and put them into a dish...

ext.ext_cn: 直到 20 世纪 80 年代,几乎所有的橄榄都是手工装罐的。
ext.ext_en: Until the 1980s almost all olives were packed into jars by hand.

defs.def_en: If you put one thing into another, you put the first thing inside the second.

ext.ext_cn: 我不知道他是怎样进入伊拉克的。
ext.ext_en: I have no idea how he got into Iraq...

ext.ext_cn: 她站起来走进里间的办公室。
ext.ext_en: She got up and went into an inner office...

defs.def_en: If you go into a place or vehicle, you move from being outside it to being inside it.

defs.def_cn: (打破或损坏表面而)进入,插入

ext.ext_cn: 弗拉维尔不小心扳动了一把手枪的扳机，子弹射入了天花板。
ext.ext_en: Flavell had accidentally discharged a pistol, firing it into the ceiling...

ext.ext_cn: 骑车人从自行车上摔了下来,车把插进了他的脖子里。
ext.ext_en: The rider came off and the handlebar went into his neck.

defs.def_en: If one thing goes into another, the first thing moves from the outside to the inside of the second thing, by breaking or damaging the surface of it.

ext.ext_cn: 毒烟已经进入供水系统。
ext.ext_en: Poisonous smoke had got into the water supply...

ext.ext_cn: 这笔钱被放到了一个普通基金里。
ext.ext_en: The money went into a common fund.

defs.def_en: If one thing gets into another, the first thing enters the second and becomes part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 火车撞上了月台尽头的栅栏。
ext.ext_en: A train plowed into the barrier at the end of the platform...

ext.ext_cn: 乔安娜听见他撞到了桌子上，又骂骂咧咧的。
ext.ext_en: Joanna heard him bump into the table and curse again.

defs.def_en: If you are walking or driving a vehicle and you bump into something or crash into something, you hit it accidentally.

ext.ext_cn: 她能在两分钟内换上一套不同的行头。
ext.ext_en: She could change into a different outfit in two minutes...

ext.ext_cn: 他穿好内衣,然后穿上西装。
ext.ext_en: He put on his underwear and got into his suit.

defs.def_en: When you get into a piece of clothing, you put it on.

ext.ext_cn: 他手头时间太富裕了,反倒为他惹来了麻烦。
ext.ext_en: He had too much time on his hands and that caused him to get into trouble...

ext.ext_cn: 我逐渐消沉了。
ext.ext_en: I slid into a depression.

defs.def_en: If someone or something gets into a particular state, they start being in that state.

ext.ext_cn: 杰罗姆试图说服她在巴黎买一套公寓。
ext.ext_en: Gerome tried to talk her into taking an apartment in Paris.

defs.def_en: If you talk someone into doing something, you persuade them to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他想把一段很不愉快的插曲变成一则笑话的尝试
ext.ext_en: ...his attempt to turn a nasty episode into a joke.

ext.ext_cn: 学习那些要想成为真正意义上的成年人她必须知道的东西
ext.ext_en: ...learning what she needs to know to grow into a competent adult.

defs.def_en: If something changes into something else, it then has a new form, shape, or nature.

ext.ext_cn: 有16个队参加,分为4组。
ext.ext_en: Sixteen teams are taking part, divided into four groups...

ext.ext_cn: 把油酥面团擀薄然后切成长条。
ext.ext_en: Roll out the pastry and cut into narrow strips...

defs.def_en: If something is cut or split into a number of pieces or sections, it is divided so that it becomes several smaller pieces or sections.

ext.ext_cn: 这场音乐会将为艾滋病研究筹集资金。
ext.ext_en: The concert will raise funds for research into Aids...

ext.ext_cn: 我们开始对药物治疗有了一些深入了解。
ext.ext_en: We are beginning to have some insight into drug therapy.

defs.def_en: An investigation into a subject or event is concerned with that subject or event.

defs.def_cn: 进入,转向(某一职业、行业)

ext.ext_cn: 20 世纪 90 年代早期,进入租赁行业很容易。
ext.ext_en: In the early 1990s, it was easy to get into the rental business...

ext.ext_cn: 他关闭公司投身政治。
ext.ext_en: He closed down the business and went into politics.

defs.def_en: If you move or go into a particular career or business, you start working in it.

ext.ext_cn: 他有3个孩子,已经60多岁了。
ext.ext_en: He had three children, and lived on into his sixties...

ext.ext_cn: 再过几个小时,高尔夫公开锦标赛将进入第二天的比赛。
ext.ext_en: The Open Golf Championship will be getting into its second day in a few hours.

defs.def_en: If something continues into a period of time, it continues until after that period of time has begun.

ext.ext_cn: 我本身对电子很感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: I'm into electronics myself.

defs.def_en: If you are very interested in something and like it very much, you can say that you are into it.

ext.ext_cn: 我妹妹总让我捉摸不透，弄得我焦虑不安。
ext.ext_en: My sister puzzles me and causes me anxiety.

defs.def_en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

defs.def_cn: 对…苦苦思索；因…大伤脑筋

ext.ext_cn: 在排演莎士比亚的戏剧时，其中诗句和散文的复杂让我大伤脑筋。
ext.ext_en: In rehearsing Shakespeare, I puzzle over the complexities of his verse and prose.

defs.def_en: If you puzzle over something, you try hard to think of the answer to it or the explanation for it.

defs.def_cn: 难题；智力问题（或游戏、玩具）；谜

ext.ext_cn: 字谜
ext.ext_en: ...a word puzzle.

defs.def_en: See also:crossword;A puzzle is a question, game, or toy which you have to think about carefully in order to answer it correctly or put it together properly.

defs.def_cn: 令人费解的人；令人困惑的事物

ext.ext_cn: “旅行者二号”发回的数据给天文学家们提出了一个难题：离我们最远的那颗行星为什么会存在。
ext.ext_en: Data from Voyager II has presented astronomers with a puzzle about why our outermost planet exists...

ext.ext_cn: 她是个谜。
ext.ext_en: She was a puzzle.

defs.def_en: You can describe a person or thing that is hard to understand as a puzzle .

defs.def_cn: (粉刷墙壁或装饰天花板用的)粉饰灰泥
defs.def_en: Stucco is a type of plaster used for covering walls and decorating ceilings.

defs.def_cn: (英国等国家某一地区的)警察部队

ext.ext_cn: 诺丁汉郡警察局局长
ext.ext_en: ...the Chief Constable of the Nottinghamshire Constabulary.

defs.def_en: In Britain and some other countries, a constabulary is the police force of a particular area.

defs.def_en: In the United States, a constabulary is the constables in a particular area, or the area that they are responsible for.

ext.ext_cn: 她办事去了。

ext.ext_cn: 她有一个更加紧急的差事要办。
ext.ext_en: She had a more urgent errand.

ext.ext_en: Frank drifted into running dodgy errands for a seedy local villain.

defs.def_en: If you run an errand for someone, you do or get something for them, usually by making a short trip somewhere.
Someone who has perfect pitch is able to identify or sing musical notes correctly.
An A-bomb is an atomic bomb.
Sweet potatoes are vegetables that look like large ordinary potatoes but taste sweet. They have pinkish-brown skins and yellow flesh.

defs.def_cn: 福音传教士;巡回布道者
defs.def_en: An evangelist is a person who travels from place to place in order to try to convert people to Christianity.

ext.ext_cn: 那些决定冒着遭受社会孤立之险、继续呆在贫民区的人
ext.ext_en: ...those who have decided to risk social ostracism and stay on the wrong side of town.

ext.ext_cn: 来自文明世界的谴责、更加严厉的制裁和排斥
ext.ext_en: ...denunciation, tougher sanctions and ostracism from the civilised world.

defs.def_en: Ostracism is the state of being ostracized or the act of ostracizing someone.

ext.ext_cn: 有没有我可以用来制作自己的剪贴图片的免费软件程序？
ext.ext_en: Is there a freeware program that I can use to produce my own clip art?

defs.def_en: Freeware is computer software that you can use without payment.

ext.ext_cn: 男性、女性、种族等人口的细分

defs.def_cn: （动植物）自然生长的，野生的，野的

ext.ext_en: Elmley is one of the few wild areas remaining in the South East.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The children are wild with joy...

ext.ext_cn: 乔治本人走上台时，他们都变得十分狂热。

defs.def_en: Wild behaviour is uncontrolled, excited, or energetic.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难以约束的;不受控制的;放荡的;无节制的

ext.ext_cn: 但愤怒或激动的时候，他也会发狂、会骂人、令人生畏。
ext.ext_en: When angry or excited, however, he could be wild, profane, and terrifying...

ext.ext_cn: 她过去的生活极其放纵。
ext.ext_en: She lived a wild and incredible life...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or their behaviour as wild, you mean that they behave in a very uncontrolled way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 很长时间我都不敢告诉他我知道了，但当我告诉他时，他简直气疯了。
ext.ext_en: For a long time I daren't tell him I knew, and when I did he went wild.

defs.def_en: If someone is wild, they are very angry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: She could see his face now, his eyes wild and his skin glistening with perspiration...

ext.ext_cn: 我忘不了他圆睁的双眼。
ext.ext_en: I could not forget the wild look in his eyes.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has wild eyes or a wild look, you mean that their eyes are wide open and staring because they are frightened, angry, or insane.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （想法）非同寻常的，极端的;(猜测)未经思索的，胡乱的

ext.ext_cn: 我不过是个孩子，充满各种奇异的想法。

ext.ext_en: Browning's prediction is no better than a wild guess.

defs.def_en: A wild idea is unusual or extreme. A wild guess is one that you make without much thought.

ext.ext_cn: 我为彼得疯狂，他对我也一样。
ext.ext_en: I'm just wild about Peter, and he's just wild about me...

ext.ext_cn: 艾琳非常喜欢这出戏。
ext.ext_en: Irene was wild about the play.

defs.def_en: If you are wild about someone or something, you like them very much.

defs.def_cn: 在自然环境中；处于野生状态

ext.ext_en: Fewer than a thousand giant pandas still live in the wild.

defs.def_en: Animals that live in the wild live in a free and natural state and are not looked after by people.

defs.def_cn: （事物）疯狂发展；（尤指小孩）恣意妄为，失去控制

ext.ext_en: Everything that could grow was running wild for lack of attention...

ext.ext_cn: 莫莉放任那个女孩恣意妄为。
ext.ext_en: Molly has let that girl run wild.

defs.def_en: If something or someone, especially a child, runs wild, they behave in a natural, free, or uncontrolled way.

ext.ext_cn: 他酷爱旅游，无法在一个地方久留。
ext.ext_en: His wanderlust would not allow him to stay long in one spot.

defs.def_en: Someone who has wanderlust has a strong desire to travel.

defs.def_cn: 孟加拉的；孟加拉人的；孟加拉话的
