ext.ext_en: She married a Bengali doctor.

defs.def_en: Bengali means belonging or relating to Bengal, or to its people or language.
Bengali is the language that is spoken by people who live in Bangladesh and by many people in West Bengal.
Net is a kind of cloth that you can see through. It is made of very fine threads woven together so that there are small equal spaces between them.

ext.ext_cn: 我把蚊帐甩到一边，跳下床来。
ext.ext_en: I threw aside my mosquito net and jumped out of bed.

defs.def_en: A net is a piece of netting which is used as a protective covering for something, for example to protect vegetables from birds.

defs.def_cn: (用以捕鱼、昆虫或动物的)渔网，罗网

ext.ext_cn: 几个渔夫坐在木桶上修补渔网。
ext.ext_en: Several fishermen sat on wooden barrels, tending their nets.

defs.def_en: A net is a piece of netting which is used for catching fish, insects, or animals.
The Net is the same as the Internet .

ext.ext_cn: 我特别喜欢用网捕到鱼后再把它放了。
ext.ext_en: I'm quite happy to net a fish and then let it go...

ext.ext_cn: 盗猎者一直在捕捞大麻哈鱼到黑市上去卖。
ext.ext_en: Poachers have been netting salmon to supply the black market.

defs.def_en: If you net a fish or other animal, you catch it in a net.
In games such as tennis, the net is the piece of netting across the centre of the court which the ball has to go over.

defs.def_cn: (足球或曲棍球场的)有网球门

ext.ext_cn: 球从他的掌中滑出，钻进了球门。
ext.ext_en: He let the ball slip through his grasp and into the net.

defs.def_en: The net on a football or hockey field is the framework with netting over it which is attached to the back of the goal.
In basketball, the net is the netting which hangs from the metal hoop. You score goals by throwing the ball through the hoop and netting.

ext.ext_cn: 中前卫泰勒为俱乐部射进了他的第一粒进球。
ext.ext_en: Centre half Tiler netted his first goal for the club.

defs.def_en: In basketball or football, when you net a goal, you score a goal.

ext.ext_cn: 他们前往那片水域，打算找到怪物存在的确凿证据，以获得为此设立的25万英镑奖金。
ext.ext_en: They took to the water intent on netting the £250,000 reward offered for conclusive proof of the monster's existence.

defs.def_en: If you net something, you manage to get it, especially by using skill.

ext.ext_cn: 秘密调查已抓获90名涉嫌欺诈盗窃的职员。
ext.ext_en: Secret investigations have netted ninety staff suspected of fraud and theft...

ext.ext_cn: 扫毒行动已缴获了近900千克的可卡因。
ext.ext_en: The anti-drug sweep had netted nearly 900 kilogrammes of cocaine.

defs.def_en: When a police operation nets a number of people or things, they catch those people or find those things.

ext.ext_cn: 去年他通过出售自己持有的股份获得了整整300万英镑的净收入。
ext.ext_en: Last year he netted a cool 3 million pounds by selling his holdings...

defs.def_en: See also:netting;safety net;If you net a particular amount of money, you gain it as profit after all expenses have been paid.

defs.def_cn: 从更大范围考虑;做更大范围的尝试

ext.ext_cn: 安全部队正在更广泛地布网。
ext.ext_en: The security forces are casting their net wider.

defs.def_en: If you cast your net wider, you look for or consider a greater variety of things.

ext.ext_cn: 官员们担心英国警方指认的一些罪犯可能已成为漏网之鱼。
ext.ext_en: Officials fear some of the thugs identified by British police may have slipped through the net.

defs.def_en: If criminals slip through the net, they avoid being caught by the system or trap that was meant to catch them.

ext.ext_cn: 并且一些非洲国家也被漏掉了。
ext.ext_en: And a number of African countries, too, are slipping through the net...

ext.ext_cn: 多个部门都可干预的事实可能会导致一些孩子被遗漏。
ext.ext_en: The existence of more than one agency with power to intervene can lead to children falling through the net.

defs.def_en: You use slip through the net or fall through the net to describe a situation where people are not properly cared for by the system that is intended to help them.

ext.ext_cn: 销售和纯利润的增长
ext.ext_en: ...a rise in sales and net profit...

ext.ext_cn: 到年底，净资产达1,800万英镑。
ext.ext_en: At the year end, net assets were £18 million...

defs.def_en: A net amount is one which remains when everything that should be subtracted from it has been subtracted.

ext.ext_cn: 净重350毫克
ext.ext_en: ...350 mg net weight.

defs.def_en: The net weight of something is its weight without its container or the material that has been used to wrap it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们最终获得了近50个席位，是苏格兰政党里赢得席位最多的。
ext.ext_en: We have a net gain of nearly 50 seats, the biggest for any party in Scotland...

ext.ext_cn: 我们将在仅仅几年时间里成为汽车净出口国。
ext.ext_en: We will be a net exporter of motor cars in just a few years' time.

defs.def_en: A net result is a final result after all the details have been considered or included.

defs.def_cn: （政府对工商业的）自由放任政策

ext.ext_cn: 自由放任政策
ext.ext_en: ...a policy of laissez faire.

ext.ext_cn: 不干预原则和放任不羁的自由主义
ext.ext_en: ...the doctrine of laissez-faire and unbridled individualism.

defs.def_en: Laissez-faire is the policy which is based on the idea that governments and the law should not interfere with business, finance, or the conditions of people's working lives.

defs.def_cn: 咆哮;发狂地说;胡言乱语

ext.ext_en: She cried and raved for weeks, and people did not know what to do...

defs.def_en: If someone raves, they talk in an excited and uncontrolled way.

ext.ext_en: 'Such lovely clothes. I'd no idea Milan was so wonderful,' she raved.

defs.def_en: If you rave about something, you speak or write about it with great enthusiasm.

ext.ext_cn: 新老面孔在这场狂欢中都大放异彩。
ext.ext_en: Old faces and new talents are making it big on the rave scene.

ext.ext_en: The resulting show, 'Only the Truth is Funny', has drawn raves from the critics.

defs.def_en: A rave is the same as a rave review .

ext.ext_cn: 天赐的灵感
ext.ext_en: ...divine inspiration.

defs.def_en: You use divine to describe something that is provided by or relates to a god or goddess.

ext.ext_en: 'Isn't it divine?' she said. 'I wish I had the right sort of brooch to lend you for it.'...

defs.def_en: If you divine something, you discover or learn it by guessing.

ext.ext_en: The only reason I was divining for water was because of the drought.

ext.ext_cn: 探测杆
ext.ext_en: ...a divining rod.

ext.ext_en: The centre will act as a clearing house for research projects for former nuclear scientists.

defs.def_en: If an organization acts as a clearing house, it collects, sorts, and distributes specialized information.

defs.def_cn: (银行)票据交换所，结算所，清算中心

ext.ext_cn: 帕萨迪纳坐落于圣加布里埃尔山麓的丘陵地带。
ext.ext_en: Pasadena lies in the foothills of the San Gabriel mountains.

defs.def_en: The foothills of a mountain or a range of mountains are the lower hills or mountains around its base.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 公然的；露骨的；明目张胆的

ext.ext_en: Outsiders will continue to suffer the most blatant discrimination.

ext.ext_cn: 公然企图推卸这次惨败的责任
ext.ext_en: ...a blatant attempt to spread the blame for the fiasco...

defs.def_en: You use blatant to describe something bad that is done in an open or very obvious way.

defs.def_cn: （机器、设备等）正常运转的，可使用的

ext.ext_en: The whole system will be fully operational by December 1995.

defs.def_en: A machine or piece of equipment that is operational is in use or is ready for use.

defs.def_cn: 操作上的；实施时的；运行中的

ext.ext_en: The nuclear industry was required to prove that every operational and safety aspect had been fully researched.

defs.def_en: Operational factors or problems relate to the working of a system, device, or plan.

defs.def_cn: 毅力；韧性；不屈不挠的精神
defs.def_en: Perseverance is the quality of continuing with something even though it is difficult.

ext.ext_cn: 他不冒险：这就是为什么他得以幸存,而他的大部分仿效者却没有。
ext.ext_en: He doesn't take chances; that's why he's survived and most of his imitators haven't.

ext.ext_cn: 一群猫王埃尔维斯的模仿者
ext.ext_en: ...a group of Elvis imitators.

defs.def_en: An imitator is someone who copies what someone else does, or copies the way they speak or behave.

ext.ext_cn: 邮局承诺于星期五恢复对这个地区第一类邮件的递送。
ext.ext_en: The post office has promised to resume first class mail delivery to the area on Friday...

ext.ext_cn: 他已经保证富人和特权阶层不会再得到优惠待遇。
ext.ext_en: He had promised that the rich and privileged would no longer get preferential treatment...

defs.def_en: If you promise that you will do something, you say to someone that you will definitely do it.

defs.def_cn: 答应给予；承诺给予；保证让…得到

ext.ext_cn: 1920年，列强承诺让他们成为一个独立的国家。
ext.ext_en: In 1920 the great powers promised them an independent state...

ext.ext_cn: 这些官员承诺恢复多党统治。
ext.ext_en: The officers promise a return to multiparty rule.

defs.def_en: If you promise someone something, you tell them that you will definitely give it to them or make sure that they have it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果做出了承诺，就应该遵守。
ext.ext_en: If you make a promise, you should keep it...

ext.ext_cn: 这个项目恪守了其改善家庭福利的承诺。
ext.ext_en: The program has lived up to its promise to promote family welfare.

defs.def_en: A promise is a statement which you make to a person in which you say that you will definitely do something or give them something.

ext.ext_cn: 这次的研讨会不仅会有趣，而且有可能会颇具启发意义。
ext.ext_en: While it will be fun, the seminar also promises to be most instructive.

defs.def_en: If a situation or event promises to have a particular quality or to be a particular thing, it shows signs that it will have that quality or be that thing.

defs.def_cn: （非常好的或成功的）希望，迹象，指望

ext.ext_cn: 这个男孩在上小学的时候就初次显示出成为运动员的潜力。
ext.ext_en: The boy first showed promise as an athlete in grade school.

defs.def_en: If someone or something shows promise, they seem likely to be very good or successful.

ext.ext_cn: 放声歌唱
ext.ext_en: ...full-throated singing.

defs.def_en: A full-throated sound coming from someone's mouth, such as a shout or a laugh, is very loud.

defs.def_cn: 仙客来(一种植物，开白色、粉色或红色花朵)
defs.def_en: A cyclamen is a plant with white, pink, or red flowers.
A petunia is a type of garden plant with pink, white, or purple flowers shaped like short, wide cones.

ext.ext_cn: 她眯起了眼睛，好像是觉得阳光太刺眼。
ext.ext_en: She had screwed up her eyes, as if she found the sunshine too bright...

ext.ext_cn: 合上眼睛，闭紧。
ext.ext_en: Close your eyes and screw them up tight...

defs.def_en: If you screw up your eyes or your face, you tighten your eye or face muscles, for example because you are in pain or because the light is too bright.

ext.ext_cn: 他会提笔给家人写信，却常常懊恼沮丧地又把信纸揉成一团。
ext.ext_en: He would start writing to his family and would screw the letter up in frustration...

ext.ext_cn: 前 3 次他只写了一两行就把纸揉成了一团。
ext.ext_en: He screwed up his first three efforts after only a line or two.

defs.def_en: If you screw up a piece of paper, you squeeze it tightly so that it becomes very creased and no longer flat, usually when you are throwing it away.

ext.ext_cn: 你不能打开窗户，那样空调就不起作用了。
ext.ext_en: You can't open the window because it screws up the air conditioning...

ext.ext_cn: 滚出去。事情给你搞得还不够糟啊！
ext.ext_en: Get out. Haven't you screwed things up enough already!...

defs.def_en: To screw something up, or to screw up, means to cause something to fail or be spoiled.

defs.def_cn: （与名词连用构成名词或形容词）表示“抨击”，“非难”

ext.ext_cn: 抨击保守党或工党并不足以改变那些心生厌倦、心存怀疑的选民的态度。
ext.ext_en: Tory-bashing or Labour-bashing will not be enough to shift bored, suspicious voters.

defs.def_en: -bashing combines with nouns to form nouns or adjectives that refer to strong, public, and often unfair criticism of the people or group mentioned.

defs.def_cn: （与名词连用构成名词或形容词）表示“暴力对待”，“攻击”

ext.ext_cn: 在纽约和其他一些城市爆发的攻击同性恋者的行为

defs.def_en: Deep in an area means a long way inside it

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (足球、网球等运动中球)纵深的，靠近对方端线的

ext.ext_cn: 史蒂夫·斯汤顿的纵深横传
ext.ext_en: ...Steve Staunton's deep cross.

ext.ext_cn: 凌空远射
ext.ext_en: ...a deep volley.

defs.def_en: In sports such as football and tennis, a deep shot or pass is one that sends the ball a long way towards the end of the pitch or court.

ext.ext_cn: 里里外外三层的人群看到显示屏上的画面似乎全都惊呆了。
ext.ext_en: A crowd three deep seemed paralysed by the images on these monitors...

ext.ext_cn: 其余的空间都被纸板盒子占据了，一直摞到天花板，足有 10 层高。
ext.ext_en: The rest of the space was taken up by cardboard boxes piled right to the ceiling, ten deep.

defs.def_en: If you say that things or people are two ,three, or four deep, you mean that there are two, three, or four rows or layers of them there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 严重的;深切的;深厚的;深深的

ext.ext_cn: 我对萨特怀有深深的敬意。
ext.ext_en: I had a deep admiration for Sartre...

ext.ext_cn: 经历严重个人危机的一段时期
ext.ext_en: ...a period of deep personal crisis...

defs.def_en: You use deep to emphasize the seriousness, strength, importance, or degree of something.

ext.ext_cn: 我一再安慰他们，但在内心深处我知道我们没有任何希望。
ext.ext_en: I kept reassuring them but deep in my heart I knew we had no hope...

ext.ext_cn: 在心底里，她支持丈夫参加这个组织。
ext.ext_en: Deep down, she supported her husband's involvement in the organization.

defs.def_en: If you experience or feel something deep inside you or deep down, you feel it very strongly even though you do not necessarily show it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 尤娜很快便沉沉睡去。
ext.ext_en: Una soon fell into a deep sleep.

defs.def_en: If you are in a deep sleep, you are sleeping peacefully and it is difficult to wake you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沉浸在…中的;专注于…的;埋头于…的

ext.ext_cn: 阿比沉浸在自己的思绪中，以至于从她姨妈的车边经过时都没有注意到。
ext.ext_en: Abby had been so deep in thought that she had walked past her aunt's car without even seeing it...

ext.ext_cn: 没过多久，我们便聊得很起劲了。
ext.ext_en: Before long, we were deep in conversation.

defs.def_en: If you are deep in thought or deep in conversation, you are concentrating very hard on what you are thinking or saying and are not aware of the things that are happening around you.

ext.ext_cn: 彼得深邃的目光长久地注视着他。
ext.ext_en: Peter gave him a long deep look.

ext.ext_cn: 他停了停，深深地注视着玛丽的眼睛。
ext.ext_en: He paused, staring deep into Mary's eyes.

defs.def_en: A deep look seems to see right into your mind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 卡尔深长地吸了一口气，努力控制自己的情绪。
ext.ext_en: Cal took a long, deep breath, struggling to control his own emotions...

ext.ext_cn: 最后他一声长叹。
ext.ext_en: At last he gave a deep sigh.

defs.def_en: A deep breath or sigh uses or fills the whole of your lungs.

ext.ext_cn: 天空一片深蓝色，其间星光闪烁。
ext.ext_en: The sky was deep blue and starry...

ext.ext_cn: 这棵树的树枝扭曲多瘤且呈红色，树叶则是深绿色。
ext.ext_en: The tree has gnarled red branches and deep green leaves.

defs.def_en: You use deep to describe colours that are strong and fairly dark.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的声音深沉而柔和。
ext.ext_en: His voice was deep and mellow...

ext.ext_cn: 他们听到远处传来一声低沉的怒吼。
ext.ext_en: They heard a deep, distant roar.

defs.def_en: A deep sound is low in pitch.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯是一个非常内敛的人。
ext.ext_en: James is a very deep individual...

ext.ext_cn: 那张毫无表情的脸看上去深沉而又神秘。
ext.ext_en: That expressionless face had seemed deep and mysterious.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as deep, you mean that they are quiet and reserved in a way that makes you think that they have good qualities such as intelligence or determination.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (问题、文章等)重要的，严肃的，深刻的

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个非常严肃的问题。
ext.ext_en: This is a very deep question...

ext.ext_cn: 它们是作为历险故事来写的，并没打算追求深刻。
ext.ext_en: They're written as adventure stories. They're not intended to be deep.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a problem or a piece of writing as deep, you mean that it is important, serious, or complicated.

ext.ext_cn: 他负债累累，急需要钱，很显然什么话都说得出来。
ext.ext_en: He is so deep in debt and desperate for money that he's apparently willing to say anything...

ext.ext_cn: 公司的亏损状况进一步恶化。
ext.ext_en: The company is sliding even deeper into the red.

defs.def_en: If you are deep in debt, you have a lot of debts.

ext.ext_cn: 一个面积巨大、人迹罕至的水池，鲸和其他海洋动物穿游其间
ext.ext_en: ...a vast unfrequented pool, traversed by whales and creatures of the deep.

defs.def_en: The deep means the sea.

defs.def_cn: 在内心深处，在心底（知道）

ext.ext_cn: 在内心深处，我们知道自己能够做到。
ext.ext_en: We knew deep down that we could do it...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在心底里一直都讨厌彼此。
ext.ext_en: Deep down, we had always detested each other.

defs.def_en: If you know something deep down or deep down inside, you know that it is true, but you are not always conscious of it or willing to admit it to yourself.

defs.def_cn: 深吸一口气(以使自己坚强自信)

ext.ext_cn: 我深吸一口气，然后走了进去。
ext.ext_en: I took a deep breath and went in.

defs.def_en: If you say that you took a deep breath before doing something dangerous or frightening, you mean that you tried to make yourself feel strong and confident.

defs.def_cn: 非常严重;极为强烈;根深蒂固

ext.ext_cn: 他的愤怒和痛苦显然是深切而强烈的。
ext.ext_en: His anger and anguish clearly went deep...

ext.ext_cn: 问题不仅仅是起始阶段的小麻烦那么简单。
ext.ext_en: The problems went deeper than mere teething difficulties.

defs.def_en: If you say that something goes deep or runs deep, you mean that it is very serious or strong and is hard to change.

ext.ext_cn: AC米兰队输掉了意大利杯决赛。
ext.ext_en: A C Milan lost the Italian Cup Final...

ext.ext_cn: 政府在有关改革步调快慢的争论中是输家。
ext.ext_en: The government lost the argument over the pace of reform...

defs.def_en: If you lose a contest, a fight, or an argument, you do not succeed because someone does better than you and defeats you.

ext.ext_cn: 我把钥匙丢了。
ext.ext_en: I lost my keys...

ext.ext_cn: 我得回去再做一次体检。他们把我的X光片弄丢了。
ext.ext_en: I had to go back for my checkup; they'd lost my X-rays.

defs.def_en: If you lose something, you do not know where it is, for example because you have forgotten where you put it.

defs.def_cn: （因被夺走或遭损坏而）丧失，失去

ext.ext_cn: 公司搬到了另一个州，我便失业了。
ext.ext_en: I lost my job when the company moved to another state...

ext.ext_cn: 他被吊销执照半年。
ext.ext_en: He lost his licence for six months...

defs.def_en: You say that you lose something when you no longer have it because it has been taken away from you or destroyed.

defs.def_cn: 丧失，失去（某一特性、特点、态度或信念）

ext.ext_cn: 他完全丧失了理智。
ext.ext_en: He lost all sense of reason...

ext.ext_cn: 政府的诚信丧失殆尽。
ext.ext_en: The government had lost all credibility...

defs.def_en: If someone loses a quality, characteristic, attitude, or belief, they no longer have it.

defs.def_cn: （因意外等）丧失，失去（某种能力）

ext.ext_cn: 他们失去了听觉。
ext.ext_en: They lost their ability to hear...

ext.ext_cn: 他双腿的功能已经丧失。
ext.ext_en: He had lost the use of his legs.

defs.def_en: If you lose an ability, you stop having that ability because of something such as an accident.

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿散失热量较成人快很多。
ext.ext_en: Babies lose heat much faster than adults...

ext.ext_cn: 大量体热通过头皮散失。
ext.ext_en: A lot of body heat is lost through the scalp.

defs.def_en: If someone or something loses heat, their temperature becomes lower.

ext.ext_cn: 受害者受了重伤，大量失血。
ext.ext_en: The victim suffered a dreadful injury and lost a lot of blood...

ext.ext_cn: 发烧时，大量水分会通过排汗而丧失。
ext.ext_en: During fever a large quantity of fluid is lost in perspiration.

defs.def_en: If you lose blood or fluid from your body, it leaves your body so that you have less of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我体重减了不少。
ext.ext_en: I have lost a lot of weight...

ext.ext_cn: 玛莎减掉了25磅。
ext.ext_en: Martha was able to lose 25 pounds.

defs.def_en: If you lose weight, you become less heavy, and usually look thinner.

defs.def_cn: （因手术或意外）丧失，失去（身体部位）

ext.ext_cn: 他给火车撞伤，失去了一只脚。
ext.ext_en: He lost a foot when he was struck by a train.

defs.def_en: If you lose a part of your body, it is cut off in an operation or in an accident.

ext.ext_cn: 1987年那场致使192人丧命的渡轮灾难
ext.ext_en: ...the ferry disaster in 1987, in which 192 people lost their lives...

ext.ext_cn: 数以百计的人在战斗中丧生。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of lives were lost in fighting.

defs.def_en: If someone loses their life, they die.

ext.ext_cn: 我祖母在那场战争中失去了兄弟。
ext.ext_en: My Grandma lost her brother in the war.

defs.def_en: If you lose a close relative or friend, they die.

ext.ext_cn: 在中国沿海的一场海难中损毁的著名白底青花瓷
ext.ext_en: ...the famous Nankin pottery that was lost in a shipwreck off the coast of China.

defs.def_en: If things are lost, they are destroyed in a disaster.

ext.ext_cn: 他们声称警方在调查之初错过了宝贵的时间。
ext.ext_en: They claim that police lost valuable time in the early part of the investigation...

ext.ext_cn: 一共浪费了6个小时。
ext.ext_en: Six hours were lost in all.

defs.def_en: If you lose time, something slows you down so that you do not make as much progress as you hoped.

ext.ext_cn: 不赶紧行动就没机会了。
ext.ext_en: If you don't do it soon you're going to lose the opportunity...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不失时机地表达了自己对事件的看法。
ext.ext_en: They did not lose the opportunity to say what they thought of events.

defs.def_en: If you lose an opportunity, you do not take advantage of it.

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔抓着她的手臂，沉醉于音乐中。
ext.ext_en: Michael held on to her arm, losing himself in the music...

ext.ext_cn: 他对着眼前的景色沉思起来。
ext.ext_en: He was lost in the contemplation of the landscape.

defs.def_en: If you lose yourself in something or if you are lost in it, you give a lot of attention to it and do not think about anything else.

ext.ext_cn: 他的店铺很可能会损失数百万英镑。
ext.ext_en: His shops stand to lose millions of pounds...

ext.ext_cn: 每年可能损失10亿美元。
ext.ext_en: $1 billion a year may be lost.

defs.def_en: If a business loses money, it earns less money than it spends, and is therefore in debt.

ext.ext_cn: 是我自己的愚蠢使我输掉了那场比赛。
ext.ext_en: My own stupidity lost me the match...

ext.ext_cn: 他对经济的管理不善使他失去了广大民众的支持。
ext.ext_en: His economic mismanagement has lost him the support of the general public.

defs.def_en: If something loses you a contest or loses you something that you had, it causes you to fail or to no longer have what you had.

defs.def_cn: （表示在不成功的情况下）不会损失什么/将会损失惨重

ext.ext_cn: 他们说自己是死猪不怕开水烫，将会继续抗议直到政府否决该协议为止。
ext.ext_en: They say they have nothing to lose and will continue protesting until the government vetos the agreement...

ext.ext_cn: 若战事一起，两国均会损失惨重。
ext.ext_en: Both countries have much to lose if there is a war.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have nothing to lose, you mean that you will not suffer if your action is unsuccessful. If you say that you have much to lose, you mean that you may suffer if your action is unsuccessful.

defs.def_cn: 大发雷霆；未能控制怒火（或情绪）

ext.ext_cn: 我火冒三丈，发了疯似的。
ext.ext_en: I completely lost it. I went mad, berserk.

defs.def_en: If someone loses it, they become extremely angry or upset.

ext.ext_cn: 我想他是真的发疯了。
ext.ext_en: I'm afraid he's really lost it.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is losing it, you mean that they are becoming crazy.

ext.ext_cn: 总统抓住一切机会，大肆利用自己的新职位。
ext.ext_en: The President has lost no opportunity to capitalise on his new position...

ext.ext_cn: 他说新闻界有部分人不放过任何机会，力图制造她有罪的印象。
ext.ext_en: He said some sections of the press had lost no opportunity to create the impression that she was guilty.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone loses no opportunity to do or say a particular thing, you are emphasizing that they do it or say it whenever it is possible.

ext.ext_cn: 众官员第一时间表达了他们对这一事件的关切和悲伤。
ext.ext_en: Officials have lost no time in expressing their concern and grief over this incident...

ext.ext_cn: 弗朗辛立即为自己辩护。
ext.ext_en: Francine lost no time in defending herself.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone loses no time in doing something, you are emphasizing that they act quickly in order to benefit from a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 这些士兵在沙暴中迷了路。
ext.ext_en: The men lost their way in a sandstorm.

defs.def_en: If you lose your way, you become lost when you are trying to go somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 有一阵子这位艺术家完全迷失了方向，其出了名的幽默风趣被伤感而煽情的不知所云取而代之。
ext.ext_en: For a while the artist completely lost his way. The famous humour gave way to sentimental nonsense...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们看不到这里的原则问题的话，那么我们已经迷失方向了。
ext.ext_en: If we cannot understand that there's an issue of principle here, then we have lost our way.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone loses their way, you think they no longer have a clear idea of what they want to do or achieve.

defs.def_cn: 未被…搅醒;在…中沉睡不醒

ext.ext_cn: 有些孩子再怎么吵都照睡不误。
ext.ext_en: Some children can sleep through any kind of noise.

defs.def_en: If you sleep through something, it does not wake you up.

ext.ext_cn: 两周的时间
ext.ext_en: ...a two-week period of time...

ext.ext_cn: 时间一点点过去，马先生仍然没有出现。
ext.ext_en: Time passed, and still Ma did not appear...

defs.def_en: Time is what we measure in minutes, hours, days, and years.

ext.ext_cn: “几点钟了？”——“8点钟。”
ext.ext_en: 'What time is it?' — 'Eight o'clock.'...

ext.ext_cn: 他问我几点了。
ext.ext_en: He asked me the time...

defs.def_en: You use time to ask or talk about a specific point in the day, which can be stated in hours and minutes and is shown on clocks.

ext.ext_cn: 从圣奎伊的出发时间是 8 点 15 分，从圣赫利尔的出发时间是 18 点 15 分。
ext.ext_en: Departure times are 08:15 from St Quay, and 18:15 from St Helier.

defs.def_en: See also:opening time;The time when something happens is the point in the day when it happens or is supposed to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 潮汐预报用的是格林尼治标准时间。英国夏令时要在标准时基础上加一小时。
ext.ext_en: The tidal predictions are expressed in Greenwich Mean Time. Add one hour for British Summer Time...

ext.ext_cn: 事件发生在当地时间 10 点刚过。
ext.ext_en: The incident happened just after ten o'clock local time.

defs.def_en: You use time to refer to the system of expressing time and counting hours that is used in a particular part of the world.

defs.def_cn: (用来做某事或某事发生的)时间

ext.ext_cn: 亚当经常呆在他祖父的办公室里。
ext.ext_en: Adam spent a lot of time in his grandfather's office...

ext.ext_cn: 他既不会有时间也不会有钱来照顾我。
ext.ext_en: He wouldn't have the time or money to take care of me...

defs.def_en: You use time to refer to the period that you spend doing something or when something has been happening.

ext.ext_cn: 有相当长的一段时间他为《苏格兰人》报撰写艺术评论。
ext.ext_en: He was also for a time the art critic of 'The Scotsman'...

ext.ext_cn: 他呆了相当长的一段时间。
ext.ext_en: He stayed for quite a time...

defs.def_en: If you say that something has been happening for a time, you mean that it has been happening for a fairly long period of time.

defs.def_cn: (某事发生的)一段(或特定)时间

ext.ext_cn: 我们那时在同一所学院，当时只招男生。
ext.ext_en: We were in the same college, which was male-only at that time...

ext.ext_cn: 到那时他 30 岁了。
ext.ext_en: By this time he was thirty...

defs.def_en: You use time to refer to a period of time or a point in time, when you are describing what is happening then. For example, if something happened at a particular time, that is when it happened. If it happens at all times, it always happens.

ext.ext_cn: 那是段艰苦时期，他父母一直艰辛地养家糊口。
ext.ext_en: They were hard times and his parents had been struggling to raise their family...

ext.ext_cn: 我们会单独在一起，就像过去那样。
ext.ext_en: We'll be alone together, quite like old times...

defs.def_en: You use time or times to talk about a particular period in history or in your life.

ext.ext_cn: 他敢于与时俱进。
ext.ext_en: He is unafraid to move with the times...

ext.ext_cn: 这种方法如今与时代潮流严重脱节。
ext.ext_en: This approach is now seriously out of step with the times...

defs.def_en: You can use the times to refer to the present time and to modern fashions, tastes, and developments. For example, if you say that someone keeps up with the times, you mean they are fashionable or aware of modern developments. If you say they are behind the times, you mean they are unfashionable or not aware of them.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们不在的时候，我和萨拉度过了一段美好时光。
ext.ext_en: Sarah and I had a great time while the kids were away...

ext.ext_cn: 这一年半以来，她度过了一段非常艰难的时期。
ext.ext_en: She's had a really tough time the last year and a half...

defs.def_en: When you describe the time that you had on a particular occasion or during a particular part of your life, you are describing the sort of experience that you had then.

ext.ext_cn: 现在马丁开始遭受艾滋病的折磨，他说他的生命就要走到尽头。
ext.ext_en: Now Martin has begun to suffer the effects of AIDS, and he says his time is running out...

ext.ext_cn: 每届政府都有其执政期限，任期届满时就得下台。
ext.ext_en: Every administration has its time. And when your time is over, you leave...

defs.def_en: Your time is the amount of time that you have to live, or to do a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 民意测验表明，公众认为到了改革的时候了。
ext.ext_en: Opinion polls indicated a feeling among the public that it was time for a change...

ext.ext_cn: 他该去上班了。
ext.ext_en: It was time for him to go to work...

defs.def_en: If you say it is time for something, time to do something, or time you did something, you mean that this thing ought to happen or be done now.

ext.ext_cn: 每次她乘公车出行都至少耽搁3个小时。
ext.ext_en: Every time she travels on the bus it's delayed by at least three hours...

ext.ext_cn: 我上次见她大约是 16 年前了。
ext.ext_en: The last time I saw her was about sixteen years ago...

defs.def_en: When you talk about a time when something happens, you are referring to a specific occasion when it happens.

ext.ext_cn: 她的差事就是每天沏3次茶。
ext.ext_en: It was her job to make tea three times a day...

ext.ext_cn: 你母亲告诉你多少次了，绝不能和陌生人谈话？
ext.ext_en: How many times has your mother told you never to talk to strangers?...

defs.def_en: You use time after numbers to say how often something happens.

ext.ext_cn: 它的利润增长速度比一般公司快4倍。
ext.ext_en: Its profits are rising four times faster than the average company...

ext.ext_cn: 劳动人口中，年轻人失业的可能性是年长者的好几倍。
ext.ext_en: Young people were several times more likely to be out of work than older members of the workforce...

defs.def_en: You use times after numbers when comparing one thing to another and saying, for example, how much bigger, smaller, better, or worse it is.

ext.ext_cn: 4 乘以 6 等于 24。
ext.ext_en: Four times six is 24.

defs.def_en: You use times in arithmetic to link numbers or amounts that are multiplied together to reach a total.

ext.ext_cn: 他比自己以前的最好成绩快了 1 秒多。
ext.ext_en: He was over a second faster than his previous best time...

ext.ext_cn: 她以两分 8 秒 74 的成绩创了纪录。
ext.ext_en: She recorded a time of two minutes 8.74 seconds.

defs.def_en: Someone's time in a race is the amount of time it takes them to finish the race.

ext.ext_cn: 里尔舞曲是四四拍，吉格舞曲是六八拍。
ext.ext_en: A reel is in four-four time, and a jig is in six-eight time.

defs.def_en: The time of a piece of music is the number of beats that the piece has in each bar.

defs.def_cn: 给…确定时间;为…安排时间

ext.ext_cn: 他把选举安排在振兴经济的新政策出台时。
ext.ext_en: He timed the election to coincide with new measures to boost the economy...

ext.ext_cn: 我们把访问时间确定在3月7日。
ext.ext_en: We had timed our visit for March 7...

defs.def_en: If you time something for a particular time, you plan or decide to do it or cause it to happen at this time.

ext.ext_cn: 他用秒表测定每组动作所花的时间。
ext.ext_en: He timed each performance with a stop-watch.

defs.def_en: If you time an action or activity, you measure how long someone takes to do it or how long it lasts.

ext.ext_cn: 该给为数不多的几个有创见的电影制作者一个机会了。
ext.ext_en: It's about time a few movie makers with original ideas were given a chance...

ext.ext_cn: “她来了。”——“也早该来了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Here she is.' — 'About time too.'

defs.def_en: If you say it is about time that something was done, you are saying in an emphatic way that it should happen or be done now, and really should have happened or been done sooner.

ext.ext_cn: 提前搞清楚什么规章适用于你的情况。
ext.ext_en: Find out ahead of time what regulations apply to your situation.

defs.def_en: If you do something ahead of time, you do it before a particular event or before you need to, in order to be well prepared.

ext.ext_cn: 我母亲思想前卫，给予了我文化和艺术的熏陶。
ext.ext_en: My mother was ahead of her time. She surrounded me with culture and art.

ext.ext_cn: 他坚持认为，他仅有的根本性错误是他比时代超前了20年。
ext.ext_en: His only fundamental mistake, he insists, is that he was 20 years before his time.

defs.def_en: If someone is ahead of their time or before their time, they have new ideas a long time before other people start to think in the same way.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不能始终在一起。
ext.ext_en: We can't be together all the time...

ext.ext_cn: 我一直把他们俩弄混，他俩太像了。
ext.ext_en: I get the two of them mixed up all the time, they're so similar.

defs.def_en: If something happens or is done all the time, it happens or is done continually.

ext.ext_cn: 打入鸡蛋，一次一个。
ext.ext_en: Beat in the eggs, one at a time...

ext.ext_cn: 她跑向楼梯，一步两级地奔下台阶。
ext.ext_en: She ran for the staircase and down the steps, taking them two at a time...

defs.def_en: You say at a time after an amount to say how many things or how much of something is involved in one action, place, or group.

ext.ext_cn: 局势仍然非常紧张，战斗随时可能升级。
ext.ext_en: Conditions are still very tense and the fighting could escalate at any time.

defs.def_en: If something could happen at any time, it is possible that it will happen very soon, though nobody can predict exactly when.

ext.ext_cn: 即使在情况最好的时候贸易战都是有害无利的，而在当前这种经济形势下只会是一场灾难。
ext.ext_en: A trade war would be bad at the best of times, but in the current economic climate, it would be a disaster.

defs.def_en: You say at the best of times when you are making a negative or critical comment to emphasize that it is true even when the circumstances are as favourable as possible.

ext.ext_cn: 曾经有 400 个男人、女人和孩子居住在村子里。
ext.ext_en: At one time 400 men, women and children lived in the village.

ext.ext_cn: 一度覆盖了北半球辽阔区域的巨大冰川
ext.ext_en: ...enormous glaciers, which at one time covered vast areas of the northern hemisphere.

defs.def_en: If you say that something was the case at one time, you mean that it was the case during a particular period in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 我害怕她，但同时也确实喜欢她。
ext.ext_en: I was afraid of her, but at the same time I really liked her...

ext.ext_cn: 她能够做出又悲又喜的神情。
ext.ext_en: She was somehow able to look sad and cheerful at the same time.

defs.def_en: If two or more things exist, happen, or are true at the same time, they exist, happen, or are true together although they seem to contradict each other.

ext.ext_cn: 我不觉得我一开始就特意为每张专辑设定了不同的曲风。然而，我确实知道当时想要的是什么感觉。
ext.ext_en: I don't think I set out to come up with a different sound for each album. At the same time, I do have a sense of what is right for the moment.

defs.def_en: At the same time is used to introduce a statement that slightly changes or contradicts the previous statement.

ext.ext_cn: 辩论有时变得异常情绪化。
ext.ext_en: The debate was highly emotional at times...

ext.ext_cn: 她有时会特别想见他。
ext.ext_en: At times she had an overwhelming desire to see him...

defs.def_en: You use at times to say that something happens or is true on some occasions or at some moments.

defs.def_cn: 在…出生以前；在…有记忆前

ext.ext_cn: “你从来没看过玛丽莲·梦露演的电影？”——“是的，她拍电影时我还不记事呢。”
ext.ext_en: 'You've never seen the Marilyn Monroe film?' — 'No, I think it was a bit before my time.'

defs.def_en: If you say that something was before your time, you mean that it happened or existed before you were born or before you were able to know about it or remember it.

ext.ext_cn: 印刷文字过小迫使我早早就要买眼镜戴。
ext.ext_en: The small print has forced me, years before my time, to buy spectacles...

ext.ext_cn: 没有哪个地方能像大学城那样让你感到未老先衰。
ext.ext_en: There is nothing like a college town to make you feel old before your time.

defs.def_en: If someone has reached a particular stage in life before their time, they have reached it at a younger age than is normal.

ext.ext_cn: 这种病毒正受到越来越多的关注，其实早该如此。
ext.ext_en: The virus is getting more and more attention, and not before time...

ext.ext_cn: 那一切总算要变了。
ext.ext_en: Not before time, that is about to change.

defs.def_en: If you say not before time after a statement has been made about something that has been done, you are saying in an emphatic way that you think it should have been done sooner.

ext.ext_cn: 斯科特·黑斯廷斯中止合同，结束了他的国际比赛生涯。
ext.ext_en: Scott Hastings has called time on his international career by cutting short his contract.

defs.def_en: If you call time on something, you end it.

ext.ext_cn: 他因犯抢劫罪正在服11年的刑期，此前他也曾因类似罪行蹲过监狱。
ext.ext_en: He is serving 11 years for robbery, and did time for a similar offence before that.

defs.def_en: Someone who is doing time is in prison.

ext.ext_cn: 这个世界令人绝望的是，疯狂之事一直存在，而且将永远存在下去。
ext.ext_en: The desperate condition of the world is that madness has always been here, and that it will remain so for all time.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will be the case for all time, you mean that it will always be the case.

ext.ext_cn: 但免疫疗法目前仍处于实验阶段。
ext.ext_en: For the time being, however, immunotherapy is still in its experimental stages...

ext.ext_cn: 局势暂时稳定。
ext.ext_en: The situation is calm for the time being.

defs.def_en: If something is the case or will happen for the time being, it is the case or will happen now, but only until something else becomes possible or happens.

ext.ext_cn: 他生病的时候她的女儿们时常去探望他。
ext.ext_en: Her daughters visited him from time to time when he was ill.

defs.def_en: If you do something from time to time, you do it occasionally but not regularly.

ext.ext_cn: 我经常一点儿都听不懂他在说什么。
ext.ext_en: Half the time, I don't have the slightest idea what he's talking about.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is the case half the time you mean that it often is the case.

defs.def_cn: 不喜欢/喜欢;不赞成/赞成

ext.ext_cn: 想到他对母亲和我所做的一切，我就很讨厌他。
ext.ext_en: When I think of what he's done to my mother and me, I've just got no time for him...

ext.ext_cn: 我很钦佩那些不计个人名利，以政党的利益为重的人。
ext.ext_en: I have got a lot of time for people who are prepared to put the welfare of their party above their own vanity.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have no time for a person or thing, you mean you do not like them or approve of them, and if you say that you have a lot of time for a person or thing, you mean you like them or approve of them very much.

ext.ext_cn: 政府早该对受到经济衰退影响的人们采取更加人性化的救助措施。
ext.ext_en: It is high time the Government displayed a more humanitarian approach towards victims of the recession...

ext.ext_cn: 早该从全球视角考虑问题了。
ext.ext_en: It is high time to consider the problem on a global scale.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is high time that something happened or was done, you are saying in an emphatic way that it should happen or be done now, and really should have happened or been done sooner.

ext.ext_cn: 我及时赶上了飞往伦敦的航班。
ext.ext_en: I arrived just in time for my flight to London...

ext.ext_cn: 她定了闹钟，以便及时醒来给两个儿子服药。
ext.ext_en: She set the alarm so she'd wake up in time to give her two sons their medication.

defs.def_en: If you are in time for a particular event, you are not too late for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他早晚会解决自己的问题。
ext.ext_en: He would sort out his own problems, in time...

ext.ext_cn: 蒂娜相信假以时日，她的生意一定会盈利。
ext.ext_en: Tina believed that, given time, her business would become profitable.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen in time or given time, you mean that it will happen eventually, when a lot of time has passed.

ext.ext_cn: 她的身体随着音乐节拍摆动。
ext.ext_en: Her body swayed in time with the music...

ext.ext_cn: 我们站在舞台上，演奏得完全不合节拍。
ext.ext_en: We were standing onstage playing completely out of time.

defs.def_en: If you are playing, singing, or dancing in time with a piece of music, you are following the rhythm and speed of the music correctly. If you are out of time with it, you are not following the rhythm and speed of the music correctly.

ext.ext_cn: 总统竞选将在10天后如期举行。
ext.ext_en: Presidential elections are due to be held in ten days' time...

ext.ext_cn: 一年以后我们都会对此一笑置之。
ext.ext_en: In a year's time we will all be laughing about it.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen, for example, in a week's time or in two years' time, you mean that it will happen a week from now or two years from now.

ext.ext_cn: 如果外出，我们总是确保在节目开始之前赶回家。
ext.ext_en: If we're out, we always make sure we're home in good time for the programme.

defs.def_en: If you arrive somewhere in good time, you arrive early so that there is time to spare before a particular event.

ext.ext_cn: 有许多难度较大的动作你起初不会做，但慢慢就会了。
ext.ext_en: There will be many advanced exercises that you won't be able to do at first. You will get to them in good time...

ext.ext_cn: “我等不及要长大了。”——“别急，你总会长大的。”
ext.ext_en: 'I can't wait to be grown up.' — 'All in good time.'

defs.def_en: If you tell someone that something will happen in good time or all in good time, you are telling them to be patient because it will happen eventually.

ext.ext_cn: 他会好起来的。以他的年纪，他很快就会痊愈。
ext.ext_en: He's going to be just fine. At his age he'll heal in no time...

ext.ext_cn: 他期盼着立即出狱。
ext.ext_en: He expects to be out of prison in next to no time.

defs.def_en: If something happens in no time or in next to no time, it happens almost immediately or very quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 现在慢慢告诉我发生了什么事。
ext.ext_en: Now, in your own time, tell me what happened.

defs.def_en: If you do something in your own time, you do it at the speed that you choose, rather than allowing anyone to hurry you.

defs.def_cn: 在业余时间;在空闲时间

ext.ext_cn: 如果我选择在业余时间做其他项目，我认为那是我自己的事情。
ext.ext_en: If I choose to work on other projects in my own time, then I say that is my business.

defs.def_en: If you do something such as work in your own time in British English, or on your own time in American English, you do it in your free time rather than, for example, at work or school.

ext.ext_cn: 他边唱边和着节拍敲一个小鼓。
ext.ext_en: As he sang he kept time on a small drum.

defs.def_en: If you keep time when playing or singing music, you follow or play the beat, without going too fast or too slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 某些脉冲星发送脉冲比地球上最精确的时钟都准时。
ext.ext_en: Some pulsars keep time better than the earth's most accurate clocks.

defs.def_en: When you talk about how well a watch or clock keeps time, you are talking about how accurately it measures time.

ext.ext_cn: 离开城市之前，一定要留出时间去买些东西。
ext.ext_en: Before leaving the city, be sure to make time for a shopping trip...

ext.ext_cn: 她在百忙中为我腾出了时间。
ext.ext_en: She had made time for me in the midst of her busy schedule...

defs.def_en: If you make time for a particular activity or person, you arrange to have some free time so that you can do the activity or spend time with the person.

ext.ext_cn: 他们一大早出发，一路上人车稀少，走得比预期快多了。
ext.ext_en: They had left early in the morning, on quiet roads, and made good time.

defs.def_en: If you say that you made good time on a journey, you mean it did not take you very long compared to the length of time you expected it to take.

ext.ext_cn: 他比同一级别的大多数军官年长 5 岁，因此他决心积极努力来弥补过去损失的时间。
ext.ext_en: Five years older than the majority of officers of his same rank, he was determined to make up for lost time.

defs.def_en: If someone is making up for lost time, they are doing something actively and with enthusiasm because they have not had the opportunity to do it before or when they were younger.

ext.ext_cn: 他其实只是在消磨时光，等年龄一到就退休。
ext.ext_en: He's really just marking time until he's old enough to leave.

defs.def_en: If you are marking time, you are doing something that is not particularly useful or interesting while you wait for something more important or interesting to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他们想要什么，十之八九都会得到。
ext.ext_en: When they want something, nine times out of ten they get it...

ext.ext_cn: 当父母对孩子们说“我知道你的感受”时，他们十有八九在撒谎。
ext.ext_en: Ninety-nine times out of a hundred when parents say to their children 'I know how you feel', they are lying.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens or is the case nine times out of ten or ninety-nine times out of a hundred, you mean that it happens on nearly every occasion or is almost always the case.

defs.def_cn: 有史以来最…的;前所未有的;空前的

ext.ext_cn: “大富翁”是有史以来最畅销的游戏之一。
ext.ext_en: 'Monopoly' is one of the best-selling games of all time...

ext.ext_cn: 这是我有史以来最喜爱的一首歌。
ext.ext_en: This is my favourite song of all time.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is, for example, the best writer of all time, or the most successful film of all time, you mean that they are the best or most successful that there has ever been.

ext.ext_cn: 别急，她会准时到的。
ext.ext_en: Don't worry, she'll be on time...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的飞机通常都会准时抵达。
ext.ext_en: Their planes usually arrive on time.

defs.def_en: If you are on time, you are not late.

defs.def_cn: 迟早的事;只是时间问题

ext.ext_cn: 现在看来，他们辞职是早晚的事。
ext.ext_en: It now seems only a matter of time before they resign...

ext.ext_cn: 医生们确信他会完全康复。这只是个时间问题。
ext.ext_en: The doctors are confident he'll make a full recovery. It's just a question of time.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is only a matter of time or only a question of time before something happens, you mean that it cannot be avoided and will definitely happen at some future date.

ext.ext_cn: 要说教会问题不是当代社会道德争论的一大议题，那就错了。
ext.ext_en: It would be wrong to say that the Church doesn't enter the great moral debates of our time.

defs.def_en: When you refer to our time or our times you are referring to the present period in the history of the world.

ext.ext_cn: 我读了一篇故事，并非有什么特别的兴趣，仅仅为了消遣。
ext.ext_en: Without particular interest and just to pass the time, I read a story...

ext.ext_cn: 午饭休息时间，他与顾客谈天闲聊以消磨时间。
ext.ext_en: During a lunch break, he and the buyer passed the time with some chitchat.

defs.def_en: If you do something to pass the time you do it because you have some time available and not because you really want to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 一两个人走过去和她打了招呼。
ext.ext_en: One or two people went up and passed the time of day with her...

ext.ext_cn: 他们甚至不会说“早上好”或打声招呼。
ext.ext_en: They can't even say 'good morning' or pass the time of day.

defs.def_en: If you pass the time of day with someone, you have a short friendly conversation with them.

ext.ext_cn: 总统的决定被视为试图争取时间而故意拖延。
ext.ext_en: The president's decision is being seen as an attempt to play for time.

defs.def_en: If you play for time, you try to make something happen more slowly, because you do not want it to happen or because you need time to think about what to do if it happens.

ext.ext_cn: 会有变化的，但这需要时间。
ext.ext_en: Change will come, but it will take time...

ext.ext_cn: 建立亲密关系是需要时间的。
ext.ext_en: It takes time to build up intimacy.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will take time, you mean that it will take a long time.

ext.ext_cn: “慢慢来，”克罗斯对他说，“我一点都不急。”
ext.ext_en: 'Take your time,' Cross told him. 'I'm in no hurry.'

ext.ext_cn: 他意识到自己必须言辞谨慎，于是不慌不忙地回答着问题。
ext.ext_en: He took his time answering, knowing that he must select his words with great care.

defs.def_en: If you take your time doing something, you do it quite slowly and do not hurry.

ext.ext_cn: 我4岁大的女儿还不大会看表。
ext.ext_en: My four-year-old daughter cannot quite tell the time.

defs.def_en: If a child can tell the time, they are able to find out what the time is by looking at a clock or watch.

ext.ext_cn: 伯恩斯屡次越狱。
ext.ext_en: Burns had escaped from jail time after time...

ext.ext_cn: 我不断从新闻节目中听到这些关于孩子失踪的报道。
ext.ext_en: Time after time, I hear these stories of missing children on the news.

defs.def_en: If something happens time after time, it happens in a similar way on many occasions.

ext.ext_cn: 开心的时光总是飞逝而去。
ext.ext_en: Time flies when you're having fun.

defs.def_en: If you say that time flies, you mean that it seems to pass very quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 我们会把小孙子带走。我们一定会让他过得开心。
ext.ext_en: We're taking our little grandchild away with us. We'll make sure he has the time of his life...

ext.ext_cn: 对某些人来说，那糟透了;而对其他人，特别是年轻人来说，那是他们无比开心的日子。
ext.ext_en: For some it was awful, for others, particularly the young, it was the time of their lives.

defs.def_en: If you have the time of your life, you enjoy yourself very much indeed.

ext.ext_cn: 他意识到时间紧迫，于是急速赶回家。
ext.ext_en: He rushed home, realising there was no time to lose.

defs.def_en: If you say there is no time to lose or no time to be lost, you mean you must hurry as fast as you can to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 只有时间会验证布劳顿的乐观是否合理。
ext.ext_en: Only time will tell whether Broughton's optimism is justified...

ext.ext_cn: 我发现不了任何问题，但时间会验证一切。
ext.ext_en: I can't see any problems, but time will tell.

defs.def_en: If you say that time will tell whether something is true or correct, you mean that it will not be known until some time in the future whether it is true or correct.

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆马上告诉了我他来的原因。
ext.ext_en: Tom wasted no time in telling me why he had come.

defs.def_en: If you waste no time in doing something, you take the opportunity to do it immediately or quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 天哪，不知道他是否晓得。
ext.ext_en: Goodness, I wonder if he knows...

ext.ext_cn: 我的天哪，他干那一行已挣了好几百万了。
ext.ext_en: My goodness, he's earned millions in his career.

defs.def_en: People sometimes say 'goodness' or 'my goodness' to express surprise.  for goodness sake→see: sake; thank goodness→see: thank;

ext.ext_cn: 他依然相信人是善良的。
ext.ext_en: He retains a faith in human goodness.

defs.def_en: Goodness is the quality of being kind, helpful, and honest.

ext.ext_cn: 照相机镜头
ext.ext_en: ...a camera lens...

ext.ext_cn: 我把你那副绿色镜片的太阳镜装好了。
ext.ext_en: I packed your sunglasses with the green lenses.

defs.def_en: A lens is a thin curved piece of glass or plastic used in things such as cameras, telescopes, and pairs of glasses. You look through a lens in order to make things look larger, smaller, or clearer.
In your eye, the lens is the part behind the pupil that focuses light and helps you to see clearly.

ext.ext_cn: 亨利·库克已 85 岁，不再年轻了，但他比以往更加忙碌。
ext.ext_en: At 85, he is no spring chicken, but Henry Cook is busier than ever.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is no spring chicken, you are saying that they are not young.

defs.def_cn: 不能和谐相处的;不协调的;不一致的

ext.ext_cn: 他们强烈感受到他们的宗教信仰与政治体制不相称。
ext.ext_en: They feel strongly that their religion is incompatible with the political system...

ext.ext_cn: 他的行为与他的国家领袖身份不相称。
ext.ext_en: His behavior has been incompatible with his role as head of state...

defs.def_en: If one thing or person is incompatible with another, they are very different in important ways, and do not suit each other or agree with each other.

defs.def_cn: 不兼容的;不相容的;互斥的

ext.ext_cn: 这就使得它的微型计算机与它的大型主机不兼容。
ext.ext_en: This made its mini-computers incompatible with its mainframes...

ext.ext_cn: 由于计算机系统不兼容，许多机构通过人工方式进行信息交换。
ext.ext_en: Many institutions exchange information by hand because of incompatible computer systems.

defs.def_en: If one type of computer or computer system is incompatible with another, they cannot use the same programs or be linked up together.

ext.ext_cn: 他跑到后台向她索要签名。
ext.ext_en: He went backstage and asked for her autograph...

ext.ext_cn: 他在利兹音乐会的后台见到了杰克逊。
ext.ext_en: He met Jackson backstage at his concert in Leeds.

defs.def_en: In a theatre, backstage refers to the areas behind the stage.

defs.def_cn: 顺从;屈服;投降;被迫接受

ext.ext_cn: 绝望之际，琼斯夫人只好同意在其右膝上做手术以减轻疼痛。
ext.ext_en: In desperation, Mrs. Jones submitted to an operation on her right knee to relieve the pain...

ext.ext_en: If I submitted to their demands, they would not press the allegations.

defs.def_en: If you submit to something, you unwillingly allow something to be done to you, or you do what someone wants, for example because you are not powerful enough to resist.

defs.def_cn: 提交，递呈(建议、报告或请求)

ext.ext_cn: 他们昨天向财政大臣递交了报告。
ext.ext_en: They submitted their reports to the Chancellor yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 校长们昨天提交了一份要求加薪 9%的声明。
ext.ext_en: Head teachers yesterday submitted a claim for a 9 per cent pay rise.

defs.def_en: If you submit a proposal, report, or request to someone, you formally send it to them so that they can consider it or decide about it.

defs.def_cn: 故意拖延;有意放缓;拖拉

ext.ext_cn: 他们在同美国交涉时的地位因他们在海湾问题上的迟疑不决而降低。
ext.ext_en: Their bargaining position with America was weakened by their foot-dragging over the Gulf...

ext.ext_cn: 他批评这家公司“极其拖沓”。
ext.ext_en: He accused the company of 'shameful foot-dragging'.

defs.def_en: Foot-dragging is the action of deliberately slowing down a plan or process.

ext.ext_cn: 两位高级公务员
ext.ext_en: ...two senior civil servants.

defs.def_en: A civil servant is a person who works in the Civil Service in Britain and some other countries, or for the local, state, or federal government in the United States.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他因伤心而声音沙哑。
ext.ext_en: His voice was husky with grief.

ext.ext_cn: 迪特里希低沉沙哑的噪音
ext.ext_en: ...Dietrich's deep, husky voice.

defs.def_en: If someone's voice is husky, it is low and rather rough, often in an attractive way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （男人）魁梧健美的，高大英俊的

ext.ext_cn: 非常魁梧的帅气小伙，身材像橄榄球运动员
ext.ext_en: ...a very husky young man, built like a football player.

defs.def_en: If you describe a man as husky, you think that he is tall, strong, and attractive.
A husky is a strong, furry dog, which is used to pull sledges across snow.

defs.def_cn: 运气不佳的;注定失败的

ext.ext_cn: 在北爱尔兰创造就业机会的很不走运的尝试
ext.ext_en: ...an ill-starred attempt to create jobs in Northern Ireland.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as ill-starred, you mean that they were unlucky or unsuccessful.

defs.def_cn: (躲避恶劣天气或危险的)遮蔽物，庇护处，掩体

ext.ext_cn: 为防御可能发生的空袭，该城市正在建防空洞。
ext.ext_en: The city's bomb shelters were being prepared for possible air raids.

ext.ext_cn: 公共汽车候车亭
ext.ext_en: ...a bus shelter.

defs.def_en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

defs.def_cn: (尤指躲避恶劣天气或危险的)遮蔽，庇护，掩蔽

ext.ext_cn: 寻求避难的家庭户增加了 17％。
ext.ext_en: The number of families seeking shelter rose by 17 percent...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管马一般不怕冷，但是一定要有个能遮风挡雨的马棚。
ext.ext_en: Although horses do not generally mind the cold, shelter from rain and wind is important.

defs.def_en: If a place provides shelter, it provides you with a place to stay or live, especially when you need protection from bad weather or danger.

ext.ext_cn: 收留无家可归的妇女的收容所
ext.ext_en: ...a shelter for homeless women.

defs.def_en: A shelter is a building where homeless people can sleep and get food.

ext.ext_cn: 藏在门口的一名男子
ext.ext_en: ...a man sheltering in a doorway...

ext.ext_cn: 12 名古巴人在大使馆藏身了几天后离开了。
ext.ext_en: Twelve Cubans left the embassy after sheltering there for several days.

defs.def_en: If you shelter in a place, you stay there and are protected from bad weather or danger.

ext.ext_cn: 一所有着低矮的尖顶遮风挡雨的木房子
ext.ext_en: ...a wooden house, sheltered by a low pointed roof.

defs.def_en: If a place or thing is sheltered by something, it is protected by that thing from wind and rain.

defs.def_cn: 为(受到警察或其他人追捕的人)提供避难所;窝藏;庇护

ext.ext_cn: 一个邻居收留了这个男孩在他家藏了 7 天。
ext.ext_en: A neighbor sheltered the boy for seven days.

ext.ext_cn: 为非法移民提供庇护的人们
ext.ext_en: ...people sheltering illegal immigrants.

defs.def_en: If you shelter someone, usually someone who is being hunted by police or other people, you provide them with a place to stay or live.

ext.ext_cn: 有时候我们也会出错。
ext.ext_en: There were occasions when we slipped up...

ext.ext_cn: 你会确切地知道自己哪里出了错。
ext.ext_en: You will see exactly where you are slipping up.

defs.def_en: See also:slip-up;If you slip up, you make a small or unimportant mistake.

defs.def_cn: 薄烤饼；薄煎饼 flat as a pancake
defs.def_en: A pancake is a thin, flat, circular piece of cooked batter made from milk, flour, and eggs. Pancakes are often rolled up or folded and eaten hot with a sweet or savoury filling inside. In America, pancakes are usually eaten for breakfast, with butter and maple syrup.  →see: flat;
In Britain, a PGCE is a teaching qualification that qualifies someone with a degree to teach in a state school. PGCE is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'Postgraduate Certificate of Education'.

ext.ext_cn: 她今天因被控人身侵犯和绑架而受到提审。
ext.ext_en: She was arraigned today on charges of assault and kidnapping...

ext.ext_cn: 他因怂恿他人叛国而受到传讯。
ext.ext_en: He was arraigned for criminally abetting a traitor.

defs.def_en: If someone is arraigned on a particular charge, they are brought before a court of law to answer that charge.

ext.ext_cn: 1月9日
ext.ext_en: ...January the ninth.

ext.ext_cn: 9年级学生
ext.ext_en: ...students in the ninth grade.

defs.def_en: The ninth item in a series is the one that you count as number nine.

ext.ext_cn: 在布鲁塞尔美元升值了1/9美分。
ext.ext_en: In Brussels the dollar rose by a ninth of a cent...

ext.ext_cn: 你看到的只是一角，8/9的部分在海里。
ext.ext_en: What you see is only the tip. Eight ninths of it is under the sea.

defs.def_en: A ninth is one of nine equal parts of something.
A shorthand typist is a person who types and writes shorthand, usually in an office.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一部名至实归、抒发真挚诗情的作品
ext.ext_en: ...a work of real merit and genuine poetical feeling.

defs.def_en: Poetical means the same as poetic .

ext.ext_cn: 订货时需要交50英镑的订金，货到后余款结清。
ext.ext_en: A £50 deposit is required when ordering, and the balance is due upon delivery.

defs.def_en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it.

ext.ext_cn: 要求交一个月的房租作押金是很常见的。
ext.ext_en: It is common to ask for the equivalent of a month's rent as a deposit.

defs.def_en: A deposit is a sum of money which you pay when you start renting something. The money is returned to you if you do not damage what you have rented.
A deposit is a sum of money which is in a bank account or savings account, especially a sum which will be left there for some time.

defs.def_cn: 竞选保证金(参加议会或欧洲选举时提交，如获一定比例选票便可返还)

ext.ext_cn: 这名托利党候选人连竞选保证金都搭进去了。
ext.ext_en: The Tory candidate lost his deposit.

defs.def_en: A deposit is a sum of money which you have to pay if you want to be a candidate in a parliamentary or European election. The money is returned to you if you receive more than a certain percentage of the votes.

ext.ext_cn: 10分钟后剩余的物质被冲洗掉，任何残留的沉淀物则会用紫外线进行检测。
ext.ext_en: After 10 minutes the surplus material is washed away and any remaining deposit examined with ultra violet light.

ext.ext_cn: 地下金矿和金刚石矿
ext.ext_en: ...underground deposits of gold and diamonds.

defs.def_en: A deposit is an amount of a substance that has been left somewhere as a result of a chemical or geological process.

ext.ext_cn: 有人看见一个人放下了件小包裹。
ext.ext_en: Someone was seen depositing a packet...

ext.ext_cn: 弗里茨把一个玻璃杯和两瓶啤酒放在沃尔夫面前。
ext.ext_en: Fritz deposited a glass and two bottles of beer in front of Wolfe...

defs.def_en: To deposit someone or something somewhere means to put them or leave them there.

ext.ext_cn: 建议把贵重物品存放在宾馆的保险箱里。
ext.ext_en: You are advised to deposit valuables in the hotel safe.

defs.def_en: If you deposit something somewhere, you put it where it will be safe until it is needed again.

defs.def_cn: 将（钱）存入银行（或储蓄）账户

ext.ext_cn: 顾客必须每月至少存 100 英镑。
ext.ext_en: The customer has to deposit a minimum of £100 monthly.

defs.def_en: If you deposit a sum of money, you pay it into a bank account or savings account.

ext.ext_cn: 海洋微生物腐烂后沉积形成磷酸盐。
ext.ext_en: The phosphate was deposited by the decay of marine microorganisms.

defs.def_en: If a substance is deposited somewhere, it is left there as a result of a chemical or geological process.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you say that you are feeling peckish, you mean that you are slightly hungry.

ext.ext_en: Lauren practises the piano every day...

ext.ext_en: When she wanted to get something right, she would practise and practise and practise.

defs.def_en: See also:practised;If you practise something, you keep doing it regularly in order to be able to do it better.

defs.def_cn: 奉行（风俗、宗教等活动）；实践（手艺）

ext.ext_en: ...countries which practise multi-party politics...

ext.ext_en: Acupuncture was practised in China as long ago as the third millennium BC...

defs.def_en: When people practise something such as a custom, craft, or religion, they take part in the activities associated with it.

ext.ext_cn: 一直有报道称犯人被施以电刑。
ext.ext_en: There are consistent reports of electrical torture being practised on inmates.

defs.def_en: If something cruel is regularly done to people, you can say that it is practised on them.

defs.def_cn: 从（医）；从事（律师工作）；执业

ext.ext_en: In Belgium only qualified doctors may practise alternative medicine...

ext.ext_en: He was born in Hong Kong where he subsequently practised as a lawyer until his retirement...

defs.def_en: Someone who practises medicine or law works as a doctor or a lawyer.

ext.ext_en: A nationwide campaign against pornography began in the summer.

defs.def_en: Pornography refers to books, magazines, and films that are designed to cause sexual excitement by showing naked people or referring to sexual acts.
A drawing room is a room, especially a large room in a large house, where people sit and relax, or entertain guests.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 久经使用的;陈旧的;古旧的

ext.ext_en: Even in the dim light the equipment looked old and time-worn...

ext.ext_cn: 这些古老的疗法在治疗当今的疾病时往往非常有效。
ext.ext_en: These time-worn techniques are often very effective approaches to the illnesses of the present day.

defs.def_en: Something that is time-worn is old or has been used a lot over a long period of time.
Anthropology is the scientific study of people, society, and culture.
A blacksmith is a person whose job is making things by hand out of metal that has been heated to a high temperature.

ext.ext_en: Already some people are asking whether scientists have any right to meddle in such matters...

ext.ext_en: If only you hadn't felt compelled to meddle.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone meddles in something, you are criticizing the fact that they try to influence or change it without being asked.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...flat-footed writing...

ext.ext_cn: 政府可能会猝不及防。
ext.ext_en: The government could be caught flat-footed.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or action as flat-footed, you think they are clumsy, awkward, or foolish.

ext.ext_cn: 他答复说联合国已经通过了两项号召全面撤军的重要决议。
ext.ext_en: He replied that the UN had passed two major resolutions calling for a complete withdrawal.

ext.ext_cn: 针对被占领领土的决议草案
ext.ext_en: ...a draft resolution on the occupied territories.

defs.def_en: Aresolution is a formal decision taken at a meeting by means of a vote.

ext.ext_en: They made a resolution to lose all the weight gained during the Christmas period.

defs.def_en: See also:New Year's resolution;If you make a resolution, you decide to try very hard to do something.

ext.ext_en: 'I think I'll try a hypnotist,' I said with sudden resolution.

defs.def_en: Resolution is determination to do something or not do something.

ext.ext_en: ...the successful resolution of a dispute involving UN inspectors in Baghdad.

ext.ext_en: ...in order to find a peaceful resolution to the crisis.

defs.def_en: The resolution of a problem or difficulty is the final solving of it.

ext.ext_en: Now this machine gives us such high resolution that we can see very small specks of calcium.

defs.def_en: The resolution of an image is how clear the image is.

ext.ext_en: Every eventuality is covered, from running out of petrol to needing water.

defs.def_en: An eventuality is a possible future event or result, especially one that is unpleasant or surprising.

A street map is a map of a town or city, showing the positions and names of all the streets.
A public servant is a person who is appointed or elected to a public office, for example working for a local or state government.

A hippopotamus is a very large African animal with short legs and thick, hairless skin. Hippopotamuses live in and near rivers.

ext.ext_cn: 动物学家尤金·莫顿提出了一个有关动物发声的概括性理论。
ext.ext_en: Zoologist Eugene Morton has propounded a general theory of the vocal sounds that animals make.

defs.def_en: If someone propounds an idea or point of view they have, they suggest it for people to consider.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: She did not seem at all afraid...

ext.ext_cn: 我害怕其他的男孩们。
ext.ext_en: I was afraid of the other boys...

defs.def_en: If you are afraid of someone or afraid to do something, you are frightened because you think that something very unpleasant is going to happen to you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她为身在索马里的家人担心。
ext.ext_en: She's afraid for her family in Somalia.

defs.def_en: If you are afraid for someone else, you are worried that something horrible is going to happen to them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: I was afraid that nobody would believe me...

ext.ext_cn: 现届政府担心会在选举中落败。
ext.ext_en: The Government is afraid of losing the election...

defs.def_en: If you are afraid that something unpleasant will happen, you are worried that it may happen and you want to avoid it.

defs.def_cn: （用以道歉或婉转地提出异议）很抱歉，很遗憾，恐怕

ext.ext_cn: 恐怕我帮不了你。
ext.ext_en: I'm afraid I can't help you...

defs.def_en: If you want to apologize to someone or to disagree with them in a polite way, you can say I'm afraid.

ext.ext_en: The driver was probably having a pee.

defs.def_en: When someone pees, they urinate.

ext.ext_en: He had murdered Perceval at point blank range with a single shot...

ext.ext_en: A man fired a volley of shots at them.

defs.def_en: A shot is an act of firing a gun.

ext.ext_cn: 他视力不好，算不上是一个出色的射手。
ext.ext_en: He was not a particularly good shot because of his eyesight.

defs.def_en: Someone who is a good shot can shoot well. Someone who is a bad shot cannot shoot well.

ext.ext_cn: 他只有一次射门得分。
ext.ext_en: He had only one shot at goal.

defs.def_en: In sports such as football, golf, or tennis, a shot is an act of kicking, hitting, or throwing the ball, especially in an attempt to score a point.

defs.def_cn: 一张照片;(电影的)一组镜头

ext.ext_cn: 一只狐狸从灌木丛中窥视的照片
ext.ext_en: ...a shot of a fox peering from the bushes...

ext.ext_cn: 他在大卫·林奇的电影《象人》中所拍摄的那些渲染气氛的黑白镜头受到了好评。
ext.ext_en: He received praise for the atmospheric monochrome shots in David Lynch's The Elephant Man.

defs.def_en: A shot is a photograph or a particular sequence of pictures in a film.

ext.ext_cn: 这名重量级拳击冠军将尝试挑战霍利菲尔德的世界冠军头衔。
ext.ext_en: The heavyweight champion will be given a shot at Holyfield's world title.

defs.def_en: If you have a shot at something, you attempt to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他注射了一针宁比泰。
ext.ext_en: He administered a shot of Nembutal.

defs.def_en: A shot of a drug is an injection of it.

ext.ext_cn: 一小杯伏特加
ext.ext_en: ...a shot of vodka.

ext.ext_cn: 小杯的烈性酒和利口酒
ext.ext_en: ...spirits and liqueurs, served in a shot glass.

defs.def_en: A shot of a strong alcoholic drink is a small glass of it.

defs.def_en: If you give something your best shot, you do it as well as you possibly can.
