ext.ext_en: As a warning shot across the bows of rivals, it is already setting aggressive prices.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's actions as a shot across the bows of another person, you mean that it is a warning to that person to stop or change what they are doing.

ext.ext_cn: 董事们掌握大权，没有他们的允许什么都不能做。
ext.ext_en: The directors call the shots and nothing happens without their say-so.

defs.def_en: The person who calls the shots is in a position to tell others what to do.

defs.def_cn: 立刻;飞快地;毫不迟疑地

ext.ext_cn: 听到钥匙在开前门的声音，我立即从床上起来了。
ext.ext_en: I heard the key turn in the front door and I was out of bed like a shot...

ext.ext_cn: 如果他认为逮捕我是他的职责，他会毫不迟疑地去做。
ext.ext_en: If he thought it his duty to arrest me, he'd do it like a shot.

defs.def_en: If you do something like a shot, you do it without any delay or hesitation.

defs.def_cn: 没把握的尝试;不大可能成功的尝试

ext.ext_cn: 这桩交易有些冒险，不过巴格利也没什么可损失的。
ext.ext_en: The deal was a long shot, but Bagley had little to lose...

ext.ext_cn: 我想象着能遇到一个英俊的陌生人，不过这似乎希望不大。
ext.ext_en: I thought about meeting a handsome stranger but it seemed a bit of a long shot.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a long shot, you mean that it is unlikely to succeed, but is worth trying.

ext.ext_cn: 导弹削减条约大幅度减少了导弹数量，然而军备竞赛还远没有停止。
ext.ext_en: The missile-reduction treaty makes sweeping cuts, but the arms race isn't over by a long shot.

defs.def_en: People sometimes use the expression by a long shot to emphasize the opinion they are giving.

defs.def_cn: 布满，充满，富有(某种因素或特征)

ext.ext_cn: 他的作品令人耳目一新，充满幽默元素。
ext.ext_en: His work was deeply refreshing, and all of it shot through with humour...

ext.ext_cn: 这个论点前后矛盾，漏洞百出。
ext.ext_en: This is an argument shot through with inconsistency.

defs.def_en: If something is shot through with an element or feature, it contains a lot of that element or feature.

ext.ext_cn: 有志之士将会共同为实现这些目标而努力。
ext.ext_en: There are many who will work hard to achieve these goals...

ext.ext_cn: 我们已经达成了原初的目标。
ext.ext_en: We have achieved what we set out to do.

defs.def_en: If you achieve a particular aim or effect, you succeed in doing it or causing it to happen, usually after a lot of effort.
A dining car is a carriage on a train where passengers can have a meal.

defs.def_cn: 离开；走开，滚开（无礼的话）

ext.ext_cn: 他下楼去了。
ext.ext_en: He buzzed off downstairs...

ext.ext_cn: 现在请闭嘴并滚开。
ext.ext_en: Now be quiet and buzz off.

defs.def_en: If someone buzzes off, they go away. People sometimes say buzz off as a rude way of telling someone to go away.
Capers are the small green buds of caper plants. They are usually sold preserved in vinegar.

ext.ext_cn: 他们欢呼雀跃，放声大笑。
ext.ext_en: They were capering about, shouting and laughing...

ext.ext_cn: 涂脂抹粉的音乐家们在绚丽的横幅后面欢跳雀跃。
ext.ext_en: Painted musicians capered behind gorgeous banners.

defs.def_en: If you caper about, you run and jump around because you are happy or excited.

ext.ext_cn: 她因为直升机一案坐了6个月牢。
ext.ext_en: She served six months in prison for the helicopter caper.

defs.def_en: A dishonest or illegal activity can be referred to as a caper .

ext.ext_cn: 杰克不愿扯上这种荒唐的事。
ext.ext_en: Jack would have nothing to do with such capers...

ext.ext_cn: 胡闹了一通后,我们浑身脏得一塌糊涂——头发、眼睛、脸颊、脖子上,全是糖浆。
ext.ext_en: What a mess we were in at the end of this caper — hair, eyes, cheeks and neck covered in treacle.

defs.def_en: Activities or behaviour that are not at all serious can be referred to as capers .

ext.ext_cn: 我得马上去看医生。
ext.ext_en: I should go and see a doctor straight away...

ext.ext_cn: 我给他写了封信，并马上寄了出去。
ext.ext_en: I wrote him a letter and posted it straightaway.

defs.def_en: If you do something straight away, you do it immediately and without delay.
A mosque is a building where Muslims go to worship.

defs.def_cn: 任何…的事物;凡是…的东西

ext.ext_cn: 富兰克林几乎可以做自己喜欢做的任何事情。
ext.ext_en: Franklin was free to do pretty much whatever he pleased...

ext.ext_cn: 你年龄再大一些后，我想你就会有更强的心理承受能力来面对所发生的任何事。
ext.ext_en: When you're older I think you're better equipped mentally to cope with whatever happens...

defs.def_en: You use whatever to refer to anything or everything of a particular type.

ext.ext_cn: 戴安娜，不管发生什么，我们都爱你。
ext.ext_en: We shall love you whatever happens, Diana...

ext.ext_cn: 不论你做什么，人们都会品头论足。
ext.ext_en: People will judge you whatever you do...

defs.def_en: You use whatever to say that something is the case in all circumstances.

defs.def_cn: (用于名词词组后，强调否定陈述)任何，丝毫

ext.ext_cn: 没有任何证据表明，广播业的竞争使成本有所降低。
ext.ext_en: There is no evidence whatever that competition in broadcasting has ever reduced costs...

ext.ext_cn: 我无话可说。
ext.ext_en: I have nothing whatever to say.

defs.def_en: You use whatever after a noun group in order to emphasize a negative statement.

ext.ext_cn: 你到底是什么意思？
ext.ext_en: Whatever can you mean?...

ext.ext_cn: 你们俩究竟怎么回事？
ext.ext_en: Whatever is the matter with you both?

defs.def_en: You use whatever to ask in an emphatic way about something which you are very surprised about.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示不清楚刚才所提到事物的准确特征、含义、价值等)不管什么，随便怎样

ext.ext_cn: 我认为我的成长过程甭管怎么说还算“正常”。
ext.ext_en: I thought that my upbringing was 'normal', whatever that is...

ext.ext_cn: 他说：“我爱你。”—— 她说：“你懂什么是爱吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'I love you,' he said. — 'Whatever that means,' she said.

defs.def_en: You use whatever when you are indicating that you do not know the precise identity, meaning, or value of the thing just mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 你可能想来一杯麦芽威士忌，炭香味重些的、烟熏味重些的或者更甘甜些的，或者什么别的口味的。
ext.ext_en: You may like a Malt whisky that is peatier, or smokier, or sweeter, or whatever.

defs.def_en: You say or whatever to refer generally to something else of the same kind as the thing or things that you have just mentioned.

defs.def_cn: (表示勉强接受)随便你怎么说

ext.ext_cn: “比利，我们要坐你的车。”——“随便。”
ext.ext_en: 'We'll go in your car, Billy.'—'Whatever you say.'

defs.def_en: You say 'whatever you say' to indicate that you accept what someone has said, even though you do not really believe them or do not think it is a good idea.

defs.def_cn: (用于提出建议或警告)不管做什么，无论怎样

ext.ext_cn: 不管怎样，在知道公司遭遇困境时不要指望加薪。
ext.ext_en: Whatever you do, don't look for a pay increase when you know the company is going through some difficulty...

ext.ext_cn: 不管你做什么，不要让女士们感到不安。
ext.ext_en: Whatever you do, don't upset the women.

defs.def_en: You say whatever you do when giving advice or warning someone about something.

ext.ext_cn: 安妮出生在圣诞节前几周。
ext.ext_en: Annie was born a few weeks before Christmas...

ext.ext_cn: 在第二次世界大战之前，女性不能当情报人员。
ext.ext_en: Before World War II, women were not recruited as intelligence officers...

defs.def_en: If something happens before a particular date, time, or event, it happens earlier than that date, time, or event.  →see usage note at:ago

ext.ext_cn: 在移居英格兰之前，他早年是在斯里兰卡度过的。
ext.ext_en: He spent his early life in Sri Lanka before moving to England...

ext.ext_cn: 离开前，他到自己的办公室填写了日常考勤表。
ext.ext_en: Before leaving, he went into his office to fill in the daily time sheet.

defs.def_en: If you do one thing before doing something else, you do it earlier than the other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 战争大约一个月前才刚刚结束。
ext.ext_en: The war had ended only a month or so before.

ext.ext_cn: 有趣的是，他在我的书到期前20天把那本书送给了我。
ext.ext_en: It's  interesting that he sent me the book twenty days before the deadline for my book.

defs.def_en: You use before when you are talking about time. For example, if something happened the day before a particular date or event, it happened during the previous day.

ext.ext_cn: 加拉赫还没来得及追上球，纳德洛武就已经抢先一步触到球了。
ext.ext_en: Before Gallacher could catch up with the ball, Nadlovu had beaten him to it.

defs.def_en: If you do something before someone else can do something, you do it when they have not yet done it.

ext.ext_cn: 我以前来过这儿。
ext.ext_en: I've been here before...

ext.ext_cn: 我以前见过劳恩教授。
ext.ext_en: I had met Professor Lown before...

defs.def_en: If someone has done something before, they have done it on a previous occasion. If someone has not done something before, they have never done it.

ext.ext_cn: 他按完门铃后过了一会儿门才打开。
ext.ext_en: It was some time before the door opened in response to his ring.

defs.def_en: If there is a period of time or if several things are done before something happens, it takes that amount of time or effort for this thing to happen.

defs.def_cn: （必须先具备某一条件）才能；在…之前（必须具备某一条件）

ext.ext_cn: 在全军准备就绪之前，还有一些杂事必须处理。
ext.ext_en: There was additional work to be done before all the troops would be ready.

defs.def_en: If a particular situation has to happen before something else happens, this situation must happen or exist in order for the other thing to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他们开车穿过一个大铁门，在一栋白色的大别墅前面停了下来。
ext.ext_en: They drove through a tall iron gate and stopped before a large white villa.

defs.def_en: If someone is before something, they are in front of it.

ext.ext_cn: 拐弯就在环岛前面约2公里处。
ext.ext_en: The turn is about two kilometres before the roundabout.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone that one place is a certain distance before another, you mean that they will come to the first place first.

ext.ext_cn: 下周二，州长将接受委员会的质询。
ext.ext_en: The Governor will appear before the committee next Tuesday.

defs.def_en: If you appear or come before an official person or group, you go there and answer questions.

ext.ext_cn: 绚丽多彩的开幕式过后，这场比赛在74,000名观众的瞩目之下开始了。
ext.ext_en: The game followed a colourful opening ceremony before a crowd of seventy-four thousand.

defs.def_en: If something happens before a particular person or group, it is seen by or happens while this person or this group is present.

defs.def_cn: 摆在…面前；使面对；使面临

ext.ext_cn: 房间里所有人都清楚，摆在他们面前的是最为艰巨的任务。
ext.ext_en: Everyone in the room knew it was the single hardest task before them...

ext.ext_cn: 展现在我眼前的是充满诗情画意的生活。
ext.ext_en: I saw before me an idyllic life.

defs.def_en: If you have something such as a journey, a task, or a stage of your life before you, you must do it or live through it in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 丈夫、孩子和教会都比她本人的需求重要。
ext.ext_en: Her husband, her children, and the Church came before her needs.

defs.def_en: When you want to say that one person or thing is more important than another, you can say that they come before the other person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他们没有意识到仪表板上的指示信号表明左引擎出现了严重问题。
ext.ext_en: They had failed to recognise signs on their instrument panel indicating a serious problem in the left engine.

defs.def_en: The instrument panel of a plane, car, or machine is the panel where the dials and switches are located.
A check mark is a written mark like a V with the right side extended. It is used to show that something is correct or has been selected or dealt with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 单调乏味的;毫无变化的

ext.ext_cn: 与工厂大部分工作一样，这份工作也很单调乏味。
ext.ext_en: It's monotonous work, like most factory jobs...

ext.ext_cn: 饭菜可能会有些单一，但管够。
ext.ext_en: The food may get a bit monotonous, but there'll be enough of it.

defs.def_en: Something that is monotonous is very boring because it has a regular, repeated pattern which never changes.
A platoon is a small group of soldiers, usually one which is commanded by a lieutenant.

defs.def_cn: 钾碱，草碱（一种从木炭灰中提取的白色粉状物质，有时用作肥料）
defs.def_en: Potash is a white powder obtained from the ashes of burnt wood and is sometimes used as a fertilizer.

defs.def_cn: 具有一应特征的;完全成熟的;彻头彻尾的

ext.ext_cn: 在成为一名完全成熟的导演之前，他曾经是电影《公民凯恩》的剪辑师。
ext.ext_en: Before becoming a full-blown director, he worked as the film editor on Citizen Kane.

defs.def_en: Full-blown means having all the characteristics of a particular type of thing or person.
A slide rule is an instrument that you use for calculating numbers. It looks like a ruler and has a middle part that slides backwards and forwards.

defs.def_cn: (玻璃)用烟处理过的，烟灰色的

ext.ext_cn: 装有烟灰色玻璃窗的白色货车
ext.ext_en: ...a white van with smoked glass windows.

defs.def_en: See also:smoke;Smoked glass has been made darker by being treated with smoke.

ext.ext_cn: 花粉热临床表现为流泪、流涕，眼睛、鼻子发痒。
ext.ext_en: When someone has hayfever, the eyes and nose will stream and itch...

ext.ext_cn: 我的皮肤又硬又粗糙,而且还很痒。
ext.ext_en: My skin was hard and scaly and I itched.

defs.def_en: When a part of your body itches, you have an unpleasant feeling on your skin that makes you want to scratch.

ext.ext_cn: 我渴望参与其中，把我的理论付诸实践。
ext.ext_en: I was itching to get involved and to bring my own theories into practice...

ext.ext_cn: 将军盼着打一仗。
ext.ext_en: The general was itching for a fight.

defs.def_en: If you are itching to do something, you are very eager or impatient to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们被她的故事迷住了。
ext.ext_en: They are intrigued by her story...

ext.ext_cn: 我很想听听别人的意见。
ext.ext_en: I would be intrigued to hear others' views.

defs.def_en: If you are intrigued by something, especially something strange, it interests you and you want to know more about it.

defs.def_cn: 大公（旧时西班牙的最高爵位）
defs.def_en: In the past, a grandee was a Spanish prince of the highest rank.

ext.ext_cn: 他是美国前国防部长，也是民主党的显要人物。
ext.ext_en: He is a former defence secretary of the United States and a grandee of the Democratic Party.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone, especially a politician, who is upper class and has a lot of influence as a grandee .

ext.ext_cn: 圣潘克拉斯图书馆，伦敦西北一区，尤斯顿路100号
ext.ext_en: St Pancras Library, 100 Euston Rd, London, NW1.

defs.def_en: Rd is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) road. It is used especially in addresses and on maps or signs.

ext.ext_cn: 克罗斯决定用上点乞求和哄骗。
ext.ext_en: Cross decided to beg and wheedle a bit...

ext.ext_cn: 他连哄带骗地设法进了办公楼。
ext.ext_en: He managed to wheedle his way into the offices.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone wheedles, you mean that they try to persuade someone to do or give them what they want, for example by saying nice things that they do not mean.

ext.ext_cn: 结婚的观念无疑被过分渲染了。人们面临来自各方的结婚压力，不结婚对他们来说就是一种失败。
ext.ext_en: The couple idea is certainly oversold. There's so much pressure to become a couple that people feel failure if they don't conform...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为改革者有时过分吹嘘了改革的好处。
ext.ext_en: I think the reformers have at times oversold the reforms.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is oversold, you mean that people say they are better or more useful than they really are.

defs.def_cn: 金合欢（生长在温暖地区，通常开黄色或白色小花)
defs.def_en: An acacia or an acacia tree is a tree which grows in warm countries and which usually has small yellow or white flowers.

defs.def_cn: 靠自己努力取得成功；自力更生
defs.def_en: If you have pulled yourself up by your bootstraps, you have achieved success by your own efforts, starting from very difficult circumstances and without help from anyone.

defs.def_cn: 步枪打靶场;步枪射击场
defs.def_en: A rifle range is a place where you can practise shooting with a rifle.
A jape is a silly trick that you play on someone which is quite funny and which does not really involve upsetting them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 僵化过时的文化
ext.ext_en: ...a stagnant, backward-looking culture...

ext.ext_cn: 历史也许会证明这一雄心勃勃的计划过于保守了。
ext.ext_en: History may judge the enterprise to have been rather backward-looking.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as backward-looking, you disapprove of their attitudes, ideas, or actions because they are based on old-fashioned opinions or methods.
A half-day is a day when you work only in the morning or in the afternoon, but not all day.

ext.ext_cn: 有人在湖上游泳和扬帆。
ext.ext_en: There was swimming and sailing down on the lake.

defs.def_en: Sailing is the activity or sport of sailing boats.

ext.ext_cn: 渡船公司加开了从加来出发的航班。
ext.ext_en: Ferry companies are providing extra sailings from Calais...

ext.ext_cn: 我们将坐下一班船。
ext.ext_en: We'll get the next sailing.

defs.def_en: Sailings are trips made by a ship carrying passengers.

defs.def_cn: 轻而易举的;一帆风顺的

ext.ext_cn: 孕期并非一帆风顺，这不，又出现问题了。
ext.ext_en: Pregnancy wasn't all plain sailing and once again there were problems...

ext.ext_cn: 我们知道在温布利不会顺风顺水，因为在这一级别就没有轻松的比赛。
ext.ext_en: We know it won't be plain sailing at Wembley because there are no easy games at this level.

defs.def_en: If you say that a task was not all plain sailing, you mean that it was not very easy.

defs.def_cn: 为(芭蕾舞等)设计舞蹈动作;为…编舞

ext.ext_cn: 阿希姆自己设计了第2幕的舞蹈动作。
ext.ext_en: Achim had choreographed the dance in Act II himself...

ext.ext_cn: 她在世界各地跳过舞、编过舞、讲过学、也教过书。
ext.ext_en: She has danced, choreographed, lectured and taught all over the world.

defs.def_en: When someone choreographs a ballet or other dance, they invent the steps and movements and tell the dancers how to perform them.

ext.ext_cn: 他常无所事事地溜达到城里。
ext.ext_en: He usually moseys into town for no special reason.

defs.def_en: If you mosey somewhere, you go there slowly, often without any particular purpose.

defs.def_cn: 要价过高的物品;质量次的东西;低劣货

ext.ext_cn: 如果他觉得在卢顿机场停车一天收费5.40英镑太高的话，他应该在希思罗机场停车试试。
ext.ext_en: If he thinks £5.40 a day for parking at Luton Airport is a rip-off, he should try Heathrow.

defs.def_en: If you say that something that you bought was a rip-off, you mean that you were charged too much money or that it was of very poor quality.

ext.ext_cn: 在照搬自热门电影《绿卡》的情节中，比利为了留在这个国家和他的学生结了婚。
ext.ext_en: In a rip-off of the hit movie Green Card, Billy marries one of his students so he can stay in the country.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a rip-off of something else, you mean that it is a copy of that thing and has no original features of its own.

ext.ext_cn: 按照包装袋上的说明煮饭。
ext.ext_en: Cook the rice according to instructions on the packet.

ext.ext_cn: 香烟盒
ext.ext_en: ...a cigarette packet.

defs.def_en: A packet is a small container in which a quantity of something is sold. Packets are either small boxes made of thin cardboard, or bags or envelopes made of paper or plastic.

ext.ext_cn: 将信和包裹寄往国外
ext.ext_en: ...to send letters and packets abroad.

ext.ext_cn: 一包照片
ext.ext_en: ...a packet of photographs.

defs.def_en: A packet is a small flat parcel.

ext.ext_cn: 那会花你一大笔钱。
ext.ext_en: It'll cost you a packet...

ext.ext_cn: 你能为自己省一大笔钱。
ext.ext_en: You could save yourself a packet...

defs.def_en: You can refer to a lot of money as a packet .
A communicant is a person in the Christian church who receives communion.

ext.ext_cn: 那艘船已找到，其名字和位置已报告给海岸警卫队。
ext.ext_en: The ship was identified, and its name and position were reported to the coastguard...

ext.ext_cn: 这个温室位置绝佳，放眼望去，草木繁茂，郁郁葱葱。
ext.ext_en: This conservatory enjoys an enviable position overlooking a leafy expanse.

defs.def_en: The position of someone or something is the place where they are in  relation to other things.

ext.ext_cn: 挺直上背部和脖子来支撑头部
ext.ext_en: Hold the upper back and neck in an erect position to give support for the head...

ext.ext_cn: 确保使患者处于复苏体位。
ext.ext_en: Ensure the patient is turned into the recovery position...

defs.def_en: When someone or something is in a particular position, they are sitting, lying, or arranged in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 把蔓生植株靠边放，使其从篮子的四面垂下。
ext.ext_en: Position trailing plants near the edges and in the sides of the basket to hang down...

defs.def_en: The morrow means the next day or tomorrow.

ext.ext_cn: 早上好，主人。
ext.ext_en: Good morrow to you, my lord.

defs.def_en: Good morrow means the same as 'good morning'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 拒绝考虑…的;对…轻视的;对…鄙视的

ext.ext_cn: 琼斯先生对报告不屑一顾，称其中充斥着谬误。
ext.ext_en: Mr Jones was dismissive of the report, saying it was riddled with inaccuracies.

ext.ext_cn: 涉及心电感应、顺势疗法等问题时科学家们常抱有的鄙视态度
ext.ext_en: ...the dismissive attitude scientists often take in regard to questions such as telepathy or homeopathic medicine.

defs.def_en: If you are dismissive of someone or something, you say or show that you think they are not important or have no value.
Fairyland is the imaginary place where fairies live.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你跟我到我的一个玩具店，你会以为踏进了仙境。
ext.ext_en: If you came with me to one of my toy shops, you'd think you were stepping into a fairyland.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as a fairyland, you mean that it has a delicate beauty.

ext.ext_cn: 他们忽略了政党的官方路线。
ext.ext_en: They ignored the official party line.

defs.def_en: The party line on a particular issue is the official view taken by a political party, which its members are expected to support.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 时下潮品的简明一览表
ext.ext_en: ...a short checklist of much that is modish at the moment.

ext.ext_cn: 来自伦敦上流社会的时髦女郎
ext.ext_en: ...modish young women from London society.

defs.def_en: Something that is modish is fashionable.

ext.ext_cn: 他在正式场合代表国家。
ext.ext_en: He represented the nation on ceremonial occasions...

ext.ext_cn: 美洲印第安人在举行仪式时用到各种羽毛。
ext.ext_en: Feathers of various kinds are used by Native Americans for ceremonial purposes.

defs.def_en: Something that is ceremonial relates to a ceremony or is used in a ceremony.

defs.def_cn: (职位、功能或事件)礼仪性的，象征性的

ext.ext_cn: 到目前为止，总统一职在很大程度上只是礼仪性的。
ext.ext_en: Up to now the post of president has been largely ceremonial.

defs.def_en: A position, function, or event that is ceremonial is considered to be representative of an institution, but has very little authority or influence.

ext.ext_cn: 教皇加冕仪式
ext.ext_en: ...papal ceremonial.

ext.ext_cn: 年轻皇帝大婚前的典礼
ext.ext_en: ...the ceremonials leading up to the young Emperor's wedding.

defs.def_en: Ceremonial consists of all the impressive things that are done, said, and worn on very formal occasions.

ext.ext_cn: 宗教仪式
ext.ext_en: ...a religious ceremonial.

defs.def_en: A ceremonial is a ceremony.
Higher education is education at universities and colleges.

ext.ext_cn: 贝丽尔今天上午来登门道歉了。
ext.ext_en: Beryl came round this morning to apologize...

ext.ext_cn: 宾客盈门。
ext.ext_en: Quite a lot of people came round to the house.

defs.def_en: If someone comes around or comes round to your house, they call there to see you.

defs.def_cn: 改变观点;改变看法(以接受)

ext.ext_cn: 看来他们会改变看法，同意我们的思路。
ext.ext_en: It looks like they're coming around to our way of thinking...

ext.ext_cn: 最终她会回心转意的。
ext.ext_en: She will eventually come round.

defs.def_en: If you come around or come round to an idea, you eventually change your mind and accept it or agree with it.

ext.ext_cn: 我希望明年世界杯举行的时候我仍然效力于该队。
ext.ext_en: I hope still to be in the side when the World Cup comes around next year.

defs.def_en: When something comes around or comes round, it happens as a regular or predictable event.

ext.ext_cn: 醒来时，我躺在厨房地板上。
ext.ext_en: When I came round I was on the kitchen floor.

defs.def_en: When someone who is unconscious comes around or comes round, they recover consciousness.

ext.ext_cn: 她伸出双臂搂住他的脖子，热情地拥抱他。
ext.ext_en: She threw her arms round his neck and hugged him warmly...

ext.ext_cn: 他矮壮结实，脖子很粗。
ext.ext_en: He was short and stocky, and had a thick neck.

defs.def_en: Your neck is the part of your body which joins your head to the rest of your body.

ext.ext_cn: 她的打褶低胸的衬衫领口
ext.ext_en: ...the low, ruffled neck of her blouse...

ext.ext_cn: 他穿了件蓝衬衫，领口敞开着。
ext.ext_en: He wore a blue shirt open at the neck.

defs.def_en: The neck of an article of clothing such as a shirt, dress, or sweater is the part which surrounds your neck.

defs.def_cn: (瓶子、吉他等的)颈状部位，细长部分，颈部

ext.ext_cn: 凯瑟琳紧握着破裂的瓶颈。
ext.ext_en: Catherine gripped the broken neck of the bottle.

ext.ext_cn: 宫颈癌
ext.ext_en: ...cancer of the neck of the womb.

defs.def_en: The neck of something such as a bottle or a guitar is the long narrow part at one end of it.

defs.def_cn: 搂着脖子亲吻;相拥而吻

ext.ext_cn: 他们在车里又坐了10分钟，边说边搂着亲热。
ext.ext_en: They sat talking and necking in the car for another ten minutes...

ext.ext_cn: 我意识到自己在帘子后面吻着至友的妻子。
ext.ext_en: I found myself behind a curtain, necking with my best friend's wife.

defs.def_en: If two people are necking, they are kissing each other in a sexual way.

ext.ext_cn: 西恩西再次以微弱优势战胜莉·克罗夫特。
ext.ext_en: Cee En Cee went on to win by a neck from Leigh Crofter.

defs.def_en: If a horse wins a race by a neck, it wins by a very small distance.

ext.ext_cn: 大部分农场主的一举一动都受到银行经理们的密切关注。
ext.ext_en: Most farmers have bank managers breathing down their necks.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is breathing down your neck, you mean that they are watching you very closely and checking everything you do.

defs.def_cn: (尤指选举中)并驾齐驱，难分高低

ext.ext_cn: 最近的一次民意测验显示两个主要政党难分高下。
ext.ext_en: The latest polls indicate that the two main parties are neck and neck...

ext.ext_cn: 该党和工党目前是旗鼓相当。
ext.ext_en: The party is running neck-and-neck with Labour.

defs.def_en: In a competition, especially an election, if two or more competitors are neck and neck, they are level with each other and have an equal chance of winning.

ext.ext_cn: 我不会让他冒险骑那辆摩托车。
ext.ext_en: I won't have him risking his neck on that motorcycle.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is risking their neck, you mean they are doing something very dangerous, often in order to achieve something.

defs.def_cn: 保全(某人的工作或声誉)

ext.ext_cn: 他有很多朋友能保全他，帮他打掩护。
ext.ext_en: He had enough friends in the right places to save his neck and cover up for him...

ext.ext_cn: 他说总统正在作最后的努力，希望保住自己的声誉。
ext.ext_en: He said the President was making a last ditch attempt to save his own neck.

defs.def_en: To save someone's neck means to prevent them from losing their job or harming their reputation.

ext.ext_cn: 我在政治生涯中敢冒风险、有点叛逆是小有名气的。
ext.ext_en: During my political life I've earned myself a reputation as someone who'll stick his neck out, a bit of a rebel.

defs.def_en: If you stick your neck out, you bravely say or do something that might be criticized or might turn out to be wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 任何人都不该身背债务开始工作生涯。
ext.ext_en: No-one should start working life with a debt round their neck...

ext.ext_cn: 这项遗留问题在未来的一段时间内仍将困扰这个国家。
ext.ext_en: It's a legacy which will hang around the country's neck for some time to come.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have something round your neck or around your neck, you mean that it is your responsibility and it causes you a lot of worry.

defs.def_cn: 深深陷入，被卷入(麻烦、罪行等)

ext.ext_cn: 黑市繁荣，每个人都已堕落，深陷其中。
ext.ext_en: The black market was flourishing, everybody was corrupt, in it up to their necks...

ext.ext_cn: 他很有可能债务缠身。
ext.ext_en: He is probably up to his neck in debt.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in some sort of trouble or criminal activity up to their neck, you mean that they are deeply involved in it.

ext.ext_cn: 见到你真高兴，哪阵风把你吹来了？
ext.ext_en: It's so good to see you. What brings you to this neck of the woods?

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is from your neck of the woods is from the same part of the country as you are.

defs.def_cn: 知识分子;知识阶层;知识界

ext.ext_cn: 我在知识界的资历还没有高到能受邀参加这种盛会。
ext.ext_en: I was not high up enough in the intelligentsia to be invited to such exalted meetings.

defs.def_en: The intelligentsia in a country or community are the most educated people there, especially those interested in the arts, philosophy, and politics.

ext.ext_cn: 政府已经发布了新闻稿，宣布这些人的任命。
ext.ext_en: The government had put out a press release naming the men.

defs.def_en: A press release is a written statement about a matter of public interest which is given to the press by an organization concerned with the matter.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沾沾自喜的;自鸣得意的;洋洋自得的

ext.ext_cn: 托马斯和夫人得意地互相望了一眼。
ext.ext_en: Thomas and his wife looked at each other in smug satisfaction.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is smug, you are criticizing the fact they seem very pleased with how good, clever, or lucky they are.

defs.def_cn: （以有壳水生动物为食的）蛎鹬
defs.def_en: An oystercatcher is a black and white bird with a long red beak. It lives near the sea and eats small shellfish.

ext.ext_cn: 电视上播放了驱邪仪式。
ext.ext_en: The exorcism was broadcast on television.

defs.def_en: Exorcism is the removing of evil spirits from a person or place by the use of prayer.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 温顺的;驯良的;易控制的

ext.ext_cn: 温顺、听话的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...docile, obedient children...

ext.ext_cn: 他们想要廉价的、听话的劳动力。
ext.ext_en: They wanted a low-cost, docile workforce.

defs.def_en: A person or animal that is docile is quiet, not aggressive, and easily controlled.

defs.def_cn: 分(美元、欧元等的货币单位)

ext.ext_cn: 几个星期前卖30美分一杯的米饭，如今卖到1美元。
ext.ext_en: A cup of rice which cost thirty cents a few weeks ago is now being sold for up to one dollar...

ext.ext_cn: 我们身无分文。
ext.ext_en: We haven't got a cent.

defs.def_en: See also:per cent;A cent is a small unit of money worth one hundredth of some currencies, for example the dollar and the euro.
Parapsychology is the study of strange mental abilities that seem to exist but cannot be explained by accepted scientific theories.

ext.ext_cn: 它的地理位置引起了海外商家的兴趣。
ext.ext_en: Its geographical location stimulated overseas mercantile enterprise.

ext.ext_cn: 广袤的地理区域
ext.ext_en: ...a vast geographical area.

defs.def_en: Geographical or geographic means concerned with or relating to geography.

defs.def_cn: 卫戍部队；守备部队；警卫部队

ext.ext_cn: 一支500人的法国陆军卫戍部队
ext.ext_en: ...a five-hundred man French army garrison.

defs.def_en: A garrison is a group of soldiers whose task is to guard the town or building where they live.

ext.ext_cn: 通往驻防地的道路上地雷密布。
ext.ext_en: The approaches to the garrison have been heavily mined.

defs.def_en: A garrison is the buildings which the soldiers live in.

ext.ext_cn: 英军依然驻守在该国。
ext.ext_en: British troops still garrisoned the country...

ext.ext_cn: 那里没有其他驻防士兵。
ext.ext_en: No other soldiers were garrisoned there.

defs.def_en: To garrison a place means to put soldiers there in order to protect it. You can also say that soldiers are garrisoned in a place.

ext.ext_cn: 我预感他会给我带来危险。
ext.ext_en: I had a presentiment that he represented a danger to me...

ext.ext_cn: 他预感会有灾难降临。
ext.ext_en: He had a presentiment of disaster.

defs.def_en: A presentiment is a feeling that a particular event, for example someone's death, will soon take place.

defs.def_cn: 未意识到的；没察觉的；不知的

ext.ext_cn: 一些政府成为了银行活动的受害者，而且可能在不知不觉中做了其帮凶。
ext.ext_en: Some governments have been victims and perhaps unknowing accomplices in the bank's activities.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as unknowing, you mean that they are not aware of what is happening or of what they are doing.

ext.ext_cn: 我常犒劳自己一番,然后找个说辞让自已良心稍安。
ext.ext_en: I give myself treats and justify them to salve my conscience.

defs.def_en: If you do something to salve your conscience, you do it in order to feel less guilty.

ext.ext_cn: 缓解嘴唇干裂疼痛的软膏
ext.ext_en: ...a soothing salve for sore, dry lips.

defs.def_en: Salve is an oily substance that is put on sore skin or a wound to help it heal.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 人的身体有很多性敏感带，对这些敏感带进行抚摸会引发性欲。
ext.ext_en: Your body contains many erogenous zones, areas that lead to a feeling of sexual excitement when they are caressed.

defs.def_en: An erogenous part of your body is one where sexual pleasure can be felt or caused.

defs.def_cn: （指初次提及或非特指的人或物）一（个）

ext.ext_cn: 侍者端着托盘进来了。
ext.ext_en: A waiter entered with a tray...

ext.ext_cn: 他开始吃苹果。
ext.ext_en: He started eating an apple...

defs.def_en: You use a or an when you are referring to someone or something for the first time or when people may not know which particular person or thing you are talking about.

defs.def_cn: （一类人或事物中非特指的）任何一（个）

ext.ext_cn: 我们所见的由一位漂亮模特代言的昂贵化妆品
ext.ext_en: ...expensive make-up that we saw being advertised by a beautiful model...

ext.ext_cn: 我建议你把它留给专家来解决。
ext.ext_en: I suggest you leave it to an expert...

defs.def_en: You use a or an when you are referring to any person or thing of a particular type and do not want to be specific.

defs.def_cn: （用于前加形容词或后加修饰语的不可数名词之前）一（种）

ext.ext_cn: 她眼神中流露出深深的悲伤。
ext.ext_en: There was a terrible sadness in her eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 他对该国的确知之甚多。
ext.ext_en: He did have a real knowledge of the country...

defs.def_en: You use a or an in front of an uncount noun when that noun follows an adjective, or when the noun is followed by words that describe it more fully.

ext.ext_cn: 博林格RD香槟是一种名贵的备受推崇的葡萄酒。
ext.ext_en: Bollinger 'RD' is a rare, highly prized wine.

defs.def_en: You use a or an in front of a mass noun when you want to refer to a single type or make of something.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示数量的词组中）许多/少许/一点

ext.ext_cn: 我花很多钱购买昂贵的首饰和衣服。
ext.ext_en: I spend a lot on expensive jewelry and clothing...

ext.ext_cn: 我特来讨教。
ext.ext_en: I've come looking for a bit of advice.

defs.def_en: You use a in quantifiers such as a lot ,a little, and a bit.

defs.def_cn: （一类人或事物中典型的）一（个）

ext.ext_cn: 有些父母认为男孩子必须学会像男子汉一样顶天立地，勇于抗争。
ext.ext_en: Some parents believe a boy must learn to stand up and fight like a man.

ext.ext_cn: 病人做过的手术
ext.ext_en: ...the operation a patient has had.

defs.def_en: You use a or an to refer to someone or something as a typical member of a group, class, or type.

defs.def_cn: （用于日子、月份或节日的名称之前以表示特例）一个

ext.ext_cn: 采访是在一个星期五的下午进行的。
ext.ext_en: The interview took place on a Friday afternoon...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个购物者不理会昂贵的丝绸衣服而热衷于更实用礼物的圣诞节。
ext.ext_en: It was a Christmas when shoppers passed by expensive silks in favor of more practical gifts.

defs.def_en: You use a or an in front of the names of days, months, or festivals when you are referring to one particular instance of that day, month, or festival.

ext.ext_cn: 我解释说自己是个艺术家。
ext.ext_en: I explained that I was an artist...

ext.ext_cn: 他现在是一位教师，并且是社区内受人尊敬的一员。
ext.ext_en: He was now a teacher and a respectable member of the community.

defs.def_en: You use a or an when you are saying what someone is or what job they have.

defs.def_cn: （用于不为说话人所知的首次提到的人名前）某一（个）

ext.ext_cn: 不干胶标签上的完整地址写的是彼得伯勒的一位P. R. 斯莱特太太。
ext.ext_en: The full address on a stick-on label was that of a Mrs P. R. Slater of Peterborough...

ext.ext_cn: 据报道，一位叫马修·欧文斯的博士在前往土耳其东北部考察的途中失踪了。
ext.ext_en: A Dr Matthew Owens was reported missing while on an expedition to north-eastern Turkey.

defs.def_en: You use a or an in front of the names of people as a way of indicating that you do not know them or anything about them and you are saying their name for the first time.

defs.def_cn: （用于人名前，表示与该人有相同特性或品质）类似…的一个（或一位）

ext.ext_cn: 从她的演奏中我听出了新一代的奈杰尔·肯尼迪。
ext.ext_en: When I listen to her play I can hear a new Nigel Kennedy.

defs.def_en: You use a or an in front of the names of people when you want to refer to someone else who has the same qualities or character as the person named.

defs.def_cn: （用于姓氏前，表示某人属于某姓氏家族）一位姓…的人

ext.ext_cn: 我记得帕蒂是姓史密斯的。
ext.ext_en: As far as I can recall, Patti was a Smith.

defs.def_en: You use a or an in front of a surname when you want to refer to someone who belongs to the family with that surname.

defs.def_cn: （用于艺术家名字前）一幅…的画，一件…的雕塑作品

ext.ext_cn: 多数人不难理解为什么凡·高的作品是天才之作。
ext.ext_en: Most people have very little difficulty in seeing why a Van Gogh is a work of genius.

defs.def_en: You use a or an in front of the names of artists to refer to one individual painting or sculpture created by them.

defs.def_cn: （代替数字one使用，尤用于hundred，hour和metre等表示度量的单词之前以及half, quarter和third等分数之前）

ext.ext_cn: 1,000多英亩地
ext.ext_en: ...more than a thousand acres of land.

ext.ext_cn: 一刻钟
ext.ext_en: ...a quarter of an hour...

defs.def_en: You use a or an instead of the number 'one', especially with words of measurement such as 'hundred', 'hour', and 'metre', and with fractions such as 'half', 'quarter', and 'third'.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示比率的短语中）每一

ext.ext_cn: 印花棉布以每米13.95英镑的价格起售。
ext.ext_en: Prices start at £13.95 a metre for printed cotton...

ext.ext_cn: 该直升机能以每小时150公里左右的速度疾进。
ext.ext_en: The helicopter can zip along at about 150 kilometres an hour.

defs.def_en: You use a or an in expressions such as eight hours a day to express a rate or ratio.

defs.def_cn: (第一人称单数代词，用作动词的主语)我

ext.ext_cn: 我和吉姆就要结婚了。
ext.ext_en: Jim and I are getting married...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得，她曾喜欢过我。
ext.ext_en: She liked me, I think.

defs.def_en: A speaker or writer uses I to refer to himself or herself. I is a first person singular pronoun. I is used as the subject of a verb.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 愉悦感官的;给人以美感的

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影画面迷人，配乐悦耳动听。
ext.ext_en: The film is ravishing to look at and boasts a sensuous musical score...

ext.ext_cn: 这车坐上去很舒服，但需要高超的驾驶技术。
ext.ext_en: It is a sensuous but demanding car to drive.

defs.def_en: Something that is sensuous gives pleasure to the mind or body through the senses.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他年轻性感的情妇玛丽－特蕾泽
ext.ext_en: ...his sensuous young mistress, Marie-Therese.

ext.ext_cn: 丰阔而性感的嘴唇
ext.ext_en: ...wide sensuous lips...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is sensuous shows or suggests a great liking for sexual pleasure.
Paediatrics is the area of medicine that is concerned with the treatment of children's illnesses.

ext.ext_cn: 真正的危险是该国东部地区的民众动乱。
ext.ext_en: The real danger is civil unrest in the east of the country...

ext.ext_cn: 在多个大城市里，学生骚乱正愈演愈烈。
ext.ext_en: There is growing unrest among students in several major cities.

defs.def_en: If there is unrest in a particular place or society, people are expressing anger and dissatisfaction about something, often by demonstrating or rioting.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 持种族偏见的;种族主义的

ext.ext_en: Despite the violence that preceded the elections, reports say that polling was orderly and peaceful.

defs.def_en: If something is done in an orderly fashion or manner, it is done in a well-organized and controlled way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这是一座美丽清洁、秩序井然的城市。
ext.ext_en: It's a beautiful, clean and orderly city...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的车一排排井然有序地停放着。
ext.ext_en: Their vehicles were parked in orderly rows.

defs.def_en: Something that is orderly is neat or arranged in a neat way.
An orderly is a person who works in a hospital and does jobs that do not require special medical training.

defs.def_cn: 违反，违背，违犯（协议、法律或承诺）

ext.ext_cn: 他们触犯了法律，因此坐了牢。
ext.ext_en: They went to prison because they violated the law...

ext.ext_cn: 他们违反了停火协议。
ext.ext_en: They violated the ceasefire agreement.

defs.def_en: If someone violates an agreement, law, or promise, they break it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些人侵犯了她的家庭隐私。
ext.ext_en: These men were violating her family's privacy.

defs.def_en: If you violate someone's privacy or peace, you disturb it.

ext.ext_cn: 侦探们仍在搜捕那些亵渎了墓园的家伙。
ext.ext_en: Detectives are still searching for those who violated the graveyard.

defs.def_en: If someone violates a special place, for example a grave, they damage it or treat it with disrespect.

defs.def_cn: （故事、传统或问题）古老的，已存在很久的

ext.ext_cn: 这场由来已久的对控制权的争夺已经引发了无数流血的战争。
ext.ext_en: This age-old struggle for control had led to untold bloody wars.

defs.def_en: An age-old story, tradition, or problem has existed for many generations or centuries.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她很有政治头脑。
ext.ext_en: She was politically astute...

ext.ext_cn: 他作出了一系列精明的商业决策。
ext.ext_en: He made a series of astute business decisions.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as astute, you think they show an understanding of behaviour and situations, and are skilful at using this knowledge to their own advantage.

ext.ext_cn: 假设有人给了你一枚鸡蛋并要你准确描述鸡蛋里面有什么。
ext.ext_en: Suppose someone gave you an egg and asked you to describe exactly what was inside...

ext.ext_cn: 假设他是对的，我确实明天就会死，那该怎么办？也许我应该再买一份保险。
ext.ext_en: Supposing he's right and I do die tomorrow? Maybe I should take out an extra insurance policy.

defs.def_en: You can use suppose or supposing before mentioning a possible situation or action. You usually then go on to consider the effects that this situation or action might have.

ext.ext_cn: 这项政策非常清楚明了，我没有理由认为它不会奏效。
ext.ext_en: The policy is perfectly clear and I see no reason to suppose that it isn't working...

ext.ext_cn: 我很清楚那个问题比他料想的要更复杂。
ext.ext_en: I knew very well that the problem was more complex than he supposed...

defs.def_en: If you suppose that something is true, you believe that it is probably true, because of other things that you know.

ext.ext_cn: 这些天我有点焦躁。我看是荷尔蒙在作怪。
ext.ext_en: I get a bit uptight these days. Hormones, I suppose...

ext.ext_cn: 我看我最好做做功课。
ext.ext_en: I suppose I'd better do some homework...

defs.def_en: You can say 'I suppose' when you want to express slight uncertainty.

defs.def_cn: (表示不耐烦或有些生气)我想，我看

ext.ext_cn: 我想你认为自己很好笑。
ext.ext_en: I suppose you think you're funny...

ext.ext_cn: 我看你没想过要去通知警察。
ext.ext_en: I don't suppose it occurred to you to notify the police.

defs.def_en: You can say 'I suppose' or 'I don't suppose' before describing someone's probable thoughts or attitude, when you are impatient or slightly angry with them.

ext.ext_cn: 你能否告诉我詹姆斯街在哪儿？
ext.ext_en: I don't suppose you could tell me where James Street is could you?

defs.def_en: You can say 'I don't suppose' as a way of introducing a polite request.

defs.def_cn: (用于询问意见)你认为，你觉得

ext.ext_cn: 你认为他说的是实话吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you suppose he was telling the truth?...

ext.ext_cn: 你认为他们想从她那里得到什么？
ext.ext_en: What do you suppose they want with her?...

defs.def_en: You can use 'do you suppose' to introduce a question when you want someone to give their opinion about something, although you know that they are unlikely to have any more knowledge or information about it than you.

ext.ext_cn: 我们最近能抽空聚在一起聊上几句吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you suppose we could get together for a little chat sometime soon?

defs.def_en: You can use 'do you suppose' as a polite way of suggesting or requesting that someone does something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无固定形状（或结构）的；不规则的；无组织的

ext.ext_cn: 一团形状怪异的黑影笼罩了整个房间。
ext.ext_en: A dark, strangely amorphous shadow filled the room.

ext.ext_cn: 散漫的失业人群
ext.ext_en: ...the amorphous mass of the unemployed.

defs.def_en: Something that is amorphous has no clear shape or structure.

ext.ext_cn: 我们若现在就走，你同意吗？
ext.ext_en: Is it all right with you if we go now?...

ext.ext_cn: “在学校还好吗？”——“还可以。”
ext.ext_en: 'How was school?' — 'It was all right.'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is all right, you mean that you find them satisfactory or acceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 谢天谢地，事情终于圆满解决了。
ext.ext_en: Things have thankfully worked out all right...

ext.ext_cn: “你走路有困难吗？”护士问他。
ext.ext_en: 'Can you walk all right?' the nurse asked him.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens or goes all right, you mean that it happens in a satisfactory or acceptable manner.

defs.def_cn: 安全健康（的）；平安无恙（的）

ext.ext_cn: 她所担心的只是他是否安然无恙。
ext.ext_en: All she's worried about is whether he is all right...

ext.ext_cn: 现在你感觉还好吗？
ext.ext_en: Are you feeling all right now?

defs.def_en: If someone or something is all right, they are well or safe.

ext.ext_cn: 它确实是个偏僻的地方。
ext.ext_en: It's an isolated spot all right...

ext.ext_cn: 看起来水的确流到那儿了。
ext.ext_en: It looks like water down there all right...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is true all right or something will happen all right, you are emphasizing that there is no doubt that it is true or that it will happen.

ext.ext_cn: “我想你应该走了。”——“好的。”
ext.ext_en: 'I think you should go now.' — 'All right.'...

ext.ext_cn: “我以后会作解释的。”——“那好吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'll explain later.' — 'All right then.'

defs.def_en: You say 'all right' when you are agreeing to something.

ext.ext_cn: 彼得，你拿一半报酬。明白吗？
ext.ext_en: Peter, you get half the fees. All right?...

ext.ext_cn: 我明天见你，好吗？
ext.ext_en: I'll see you tomorrow, all right?...

defs.def_en: You say 'all right?' after you have given an instruction or explanation to someone when you are checking that they have understood what you have just said, or checking that they agree with or accept what you have just said.

defs.def_cn: 就这样吧，那么（表示想结束一项活动，开始另一活动）

ext.ext_cn: 就这样吧，鲍勃，你现在可以走了。
ext.ext_en: All right, Bob. You can go now...

ext.ext_cn: 就这样吧，孩子们，我们下星期再见。
ext.ext_en: All right, boys and girls, let's meet again next week.

defs.def_en: If someone in a position of authority says 'all right', and suggests talking about or doing something else, they are indicating that they want you to end one activity and start another.

defs.def_cn: 好吧（在讨论中用以表示理解对方的话并引入相关的话）

ext.ext_cn: “我现在有点忙。”——“好吧，我何不以后再来呢？”
ext.ext_en: 'I'm a bit busy now.' — 'All right, why don't I come back later?'

defs.def_en: You say 'all right' during a discussion to show that you understand something that someone has just said, and to introduce a statement that relates to it.

defs.def_cn: 唉，喂（表示责难或威胁某人）

ext.ext_cn: 喂，你是谁，在我的办公室做什么？
ext.ext_en: All right, who are you and what are you doing in my office?...

ext.ext_cn: 唉，别耍花招了。马上将货物交过来。
ext.ext_en: All right, let's stop playing games. Hand over the goods right now.

defs.def_en: You say all right before a statement or question to indicate that you are challenging or threatening someone.

ext.ext_cn: 政界领袖昨日联合起来对最近激增的暴力事件予以谴责。
ext.ext_en: Political leaders united yesterday to condemn the latest wave of violence...

ext.ext_cn: 格雷厄姆指责队员们技艺不佳、态度不端正而且不够努力，他说得没错。
ext.ext_en: Graham was right to condemn his players for lack of ability, attitude and application.

defs.def_en: If you condemn something, you say that it is very bad and unacceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 他被判终身监禁。
ext.ext_en: He was condemned to life imprisonment.

ext.ext_cn: 被判死刑的囚犯们提出的上诉
ext.ext_en: ...appeals by prisoners condemned to death.

defs.def_en: If someone is condemned to a punishment, they are given this punishment.

ext.ext_cn: 没有学历使他们一辈子都得从事枯燥乏味而且通常报酬很低的工作。
ext.ext_en: Their lack of qualifications condemned them to a lifetime of boring, usually poorly-paid work...

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得自己注定要孤独终老。
ext.ext_en: He felt condemned to being alone...

defs.def_en: If circumstances condemn you to an unpleasant situation, they make it certain that you will suffer in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 州政府官员称法庭判决为宣布该地区楼房为危房的行动扫清了道路。
ext.ext_en: State officials said the court's ruling clears the way for proceedings to condemn buildings in the area.

defs.def_en: If authorities condemn a building, they officially decide that it is not safe and must be pulled down or repaired.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 贪婪的；贪得无厌的；自私的

ext.ext_cn: 他吃燕窝汤吃个没够。
ext.ext_en: He had a rapacious appetite for bird's nest soup.

ext.ext_cn: 贪婪的剥削政策
ext.ext_en: ...a rapacious exploitation policy.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as rapacious, you disapprove of their greedy or selfish behaviour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的眼睛机警而又狡诈。
ext.ext_en: He had wary, foxy eyes.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as foxy, you mean that they are deceitful in a clever, secretive way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一位娇媚的身穿高领羊毛衫的金发美女
ext.ext_en: ...a foxy blonde in a turtleneck sweater.

defs.def_en: If a man calls a woman foxy, he means that she is physically attractive.
The Caribbean is the sea which is between the West Indies, Central America and the north coast of South America.

defs.def_cn: 加勒比海的;加勒比海诸岛的;加勒比人的

ext.ext_cn: 加勒比海的圣托马斯岛
ext.ext_en: ...the Caribbean island of St Thomas.

ext.ext_cn: 加勒比人50年代初在谢菲尔德定居。
ext.ext_en: Caribbeans settled in Sheffield in the early '50s.

defs.def_en: See also:Afro-Caribbean;Caribbean means belonging or relating to the Caribbean Sea and its islands, or to its people.

defs.def_cn: (寄宿学校等的)大寝室，集体寝室

ext.ext_cn: 男生寝室
ext.ext_en: ...the boys' dormitory...

ext.ext_cn: 新来的难民被安置在临时的集体寝室里。
ext.ext_en: The latest refugees were housed in makeshift dormitories.

defs.def_en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where several people sleep, for example in a boarding school.

ext.ext_cn: 她住在大学宿舍里。
ext.ext_en: She lived in a college dormitory.

defs.def_en: A dormitory is a building in a college or university where students live.

defs.def_cn: (在大城市工作者居住的)邻镇住宅区的，郊外住宅区的

ext.ext_cn: 它几乎成为了城市的一个市郊住宅区。
ext.ext_en: It had become almost a dormitory suburb of the city.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a place as a dormitory suburb or town, you mean that most of the people who live there travel to work in another, larger town a short distance away.

defs.def_cn: 使离开久住之处；使迁移他处居住

ext.ext_cn: 背井离乡给他们造成的心灵创伤
ext.ext_en: ...the trauma of uprooting themselves from their homes...

ext.ext_cn: 他没想过让德娜离开现在的家去别处居住。
ext.ext_en: He had no wish to uproot Dena from her present home.

defs.def_en: If you uproot yourself or if you are uprooted, you leave, or are made to leave, a place where you have lived for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已被迫将葡萄藤连根拔除，改种小麦。
ext.ext_en: They had been forced to uproot their vines and plant wheat.

ext.ext_cn: 被暴风雨连根拔起、倒伏在地上的树木
ext.ext_en: ...fallen trees which have been uprooted by the storm.

defs.def_en: If someone uproots a tree or plant, or if the wind uproots it, it is pulled out of the ground.
A dandelion is a wild plant which has yellow flowers with lots of thin petals. When the petals of each flower drop off, a fluffy white ball of seeds grows.
Weightlifting is a sport in which the competitor who can lift the heaviest weight wins.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 像乡下的;乡土气息的;土里土气的

ext.ext_cn: 这座房子很漂亮，带一个田园风情的美丽花园。
ext.ext_en: The house was so handsome, with a lovely countrified garden.

defs.def_en: You use countrified to describe something that seems or looks like something in the country, rather than in a town.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (流行音乐)乡村风味的，有乡土乐特征的

ext.ext_cn: 音乐在爵士乐和乡村布鲁斯乐之间来回转换。
ext.ext_en: The sound veers between jazz and countrified blues.

defs.def_en: Countrified is used to describe pop music that sounds similar to country music.

ext.ext_cn: 船员们赢了拔河比赛。
ext.ext_en: The sailors won at tug-of-war.

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲拔河锦标赛
ext.ext_en: …the European Tug of War Championships.

defs.def_en: A tug-of-war is a sports event in which two teams test their strength by pulling against each other on opposite ends of a rope.

ext.ext_cn: 切尔西队与阿斯顿维拉队昨夜上演了一场夺人大战，争购利物浦的雷·霍顿。
ext.ext_en: Chelsea and Aston Villa were involved in a tug of war for Liverpool's Ray Houghton last night.

ext.ext_cn: 政府各部门间势均力敌的争夺
ext.ext_en: …the tug of war between government departments.

defs.def_en: You can use tug-of-war to refer to a situation in which two people or groups both want the same thing and are fairly equally matched in their struggle to get it.

ext.ext_cn: 他所继承的文化传统中强烈的个人荣誉感
ext.ext_en: ...a deep sense of personal honor which was part of his cultural heritage.

ext.ext_cn: 促进英国和印度两国文化和教育交流的拉吉夫·甘地基金会
ext.ext_en: ...the Rajiv Gandhi Foundation which promotes cultural and educational exchanges between Britain and India.

defs.def_en: Cultural means relating to a particular society and its ideas, customs, and art.

ext.ext_cn: 烟草公司对体育赛事和文化活动的赞助
ext.ext_en: ...the sponsorship of sports and cultural events by tobacco companies.

defs.def_en: Cultural means involving or concerning the arts.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司和一家美国公司合并了。
ext.ext_en: The firm has amalgamated with an American company...

ext.ext_cn: 那些化学品公司已经合并成一个庞大的企业集团。
ext.ext_en: The chemical companies had amalgamated into a vast conglomerate...

defs.def_en: When two or more things, especially organizations, amalgamate or are amalgamated, they become one large thing.

ext.ext_cn: 黄昏时令人心生沮丧的密布云团
ext.ext_en: ...dispiriting clouds that enshrouded us in twilight.

ext.ext_cn: 笼罩我们政治的保密文化
ext.ext_en: ...the culture of secrecy which enshrouds our politics.

defs.def_en: To enshroud something means to cover it completely so that it can no longer be seen.

ext.ext_cn: 他们驾车南行。
ext.ext_en: They drove southward...

ext.ext_cn: 由于一次访问的缘故，他来到了摩加迪沙，又向南来到基斯马尤。
ext.ext_en: It was a visit that took him to Mogadishu and southwards to Kismayo.

defs.def_en: Southward or southwards means towards the south.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 对（令人不快的事物）司空见惯的;习惯于…的

ext.ext_cn: 医生们已经能坦然面对死亡。
ext.ext_en: Doctors become inured to death.

defs.def_en: If you are inured to something unpleasant, you have become used to it so that it no longer affects you.
A tavern is a bar or pub.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (数量或尺寸)不成比例的，不相称的

ext.ext_cn: 纠缠在同一个话题上的时间太长了。
ext.ext_en: A disproportionate amount of time was devoted to one topic...

ext.ext_cn: 从所犯罪行来看，这一量刑完全不合理。
ext.ext_en: This sentence is totally disproportionate to the alleged offence.

defs.def_en: Something that is disproportionate is surprising or unreasonable in amount or size, compared with something else.
Malted milk is a drink made from hot or cold milk flavoured with a powder containing malt.

ext.ext_cn: 他被董事们告之晋升无望了。
ext.ext_en: He was told by the governors that he could expect no further preferment.

defs.def_en: Preferment is the act of being given a better and more important job in an organization.
Pilgrims are people who make a journey to a holy place for a religious reason.
A bus boy is someone whose job is to set or clear tables in a restaurant.
Two is the number 2.

defs.def_cn: 一个巴掌拍不响;双方都有责任

ext.ext_cn: 离婚从来都不是一方的错误：双方都有责任。
ext.ext_en: Divorce is never the fault of one partner; it takes two...

ext.ext_cn: 双方都应该努力，可迄今为止我们的关系只是一厢情愿。
ext.ext_en: It takes two to tango and so far our relationship has been one-sided.

defs.def_en: If you say it takes two or it takes two to tango, you mean that a situation or argument involves two people and they are both therefore responsible for it.

ext.ext_cn: 根据我的了解，我猜想这是他曾开过的车子。
ext.ext_en: Putting two and two together, I assume that this was the car he used.

defs.def_en: If you put two and two together, you work out the truth about something for yourself, by using the information that is available to you.

ext.ext_cn: 一群漂泊的音乐人
ext.ext_en: ...a band of wandering musicians.

defs.def_en: Wandering is used to describe people who travel around rather than staying in one place for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 这个卖得非常好，部分原因是包装非常吸引人。
ext.ext_en: It is selling very well, in part because the packaging is so attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 一层层又昂贵又浪费的包装
ext.ext_en: ...layers of expensive, wasteful packaging.

defs.def_en: Packaging is the container or covering that something is sold in.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的动作优美自如，看起来毫不费劲。
ext.ext_en: His movements were so graceful they seemed effortless.

ext.ext_cn: 优雅的芭蕾舞女演员
ext.ext_en: ...graceful ballerinas.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is graceful moves in a smooth and controlled way which is attractive to watch.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 典雅的中世纪大教堂
ext.ext_en: A graceful medieval cathedral...

ext.ext_cn: 他的字从小就写得流畅优美。
ext.ext_en: His handwriting, from earliest young manhood, was flowing and graceful.

defs.def_en: Something that is graceful is attractive because it has a pleasing shape or style.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 优雅的；得体的；有风度的

ext.ext_cn: 奥布里想不出有什么得体的办法能摆脱科比特。
ext.ext_en: Aubrey could think of no graceful way to escape Corbet's company...

ext.ext_cn: 他在重压之下依然开朗迷人，风度优雅。
ext.ext_en: He was charming, cheerful, and graceful under pressure.

defs.def_en: If a person's behaviour is graceful, it is polite, kind, and pleasant, especially in a difficult situation.
A slag heap is a hill made from waste material, such as rock and mud, left over from mining.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 必要的;至关重要的;必不可少的

ext.ext_cn: 这个港口对向数百万旱灾灾民提供救援物资是至关重要的。
ext.ext_en: The port is vital to supply relief to millions of drought victims...

ext.ext_cn: 尼克·威尔曼是学校的管理员，因此与年轻人搞好关系很重要。
ext.ext_en: Nick Wileman is a school caretaker so it is vital that he gets on well with young people...
