defs.def_en: If someone is a part-time worker or has a part-time job, they work for only part of each day or week.

ext.ext_cn: 印度和巴基斯坦边境上常常发生小规模战斗。
ext.ext_en: Border skirmishes between India and Pakistan were common.

defs.def_en: A skirmish is a minor battle.

defs.def_cn: 发生小冲突;进行小规模战斗;打斗

ext.ext_cn: 他们当时正在雷区附近交火。
ext.ext_en: They were skirmishing close to the minefield now...

ext.ext_cn: 上周五警方与一些青年在住宅区发生了冲突。
ext.ext_en: Police skirmished with youths on the estate last Friday.

defs.def_en: If people skirmish, they fight.

ext.ext_cn: 这种方式上的差异已经导致了几场政治冲突。
ext.ext_en: This difference in approach has led to several political skirmishes.

defs.def_en: A skirmish is a short, sharp argument.

ext.ext_cn: 在那个死囚最后的日子里看管过他的狱警
ext.ext_en: ...prison officers who had sat with the condemned man during his last days.

defs.def_en: A condemned man or woman is going to be executed.

ext.ext_cn: 去年,他们曾控制过一幢20世纪60年代的破旧塔楼一个晚上。
ext.ext_en: They took over a condemned 1960s tower block last year for one night.

defs.def_en: A condemned building is in such a bad condition that it is not safe to live in, and so its owners are officially ordered to pull it down or repair it.

ext.ext_cn: 人体骨骼
ext.ext_en: ...a human skeleton.

defs.def_en: Your skeleton is the framework of bones in your body.

ext.ext_cn: 只有一小部分必需的工作人员留在那里，带有兴趣的人参观遗址。
ext.ext_en: Only a skeleton staff remains to show anyone interested around the site.

defs.def_en: A skeleton staff is the smallest number of staff necessary in order to run an organization or service.

ext.ext_cn: 只剩下了建筑物的框架。
ext.ext_en: Only skeletons of buildings remained.

ext.ext_cn: 政策纲领的概要
ext.ext_en: ...a skeleton of policy guidelines.

defs.def_en: The skeleton of something such as a building or a plan is its basic framework.

ext.ext_cn: 沃辛先生是此次选举中的正派先生，本身没有任何见不得人的丑事。
ext.ext_en: Mr Worthing is this election's Mr Nice Guy, without any skeletons in his cupboard.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a skeleton in the closet, or in British English a skeleton in the cupboard, you mean that they are keeping secret a bad or embarrassing fact about themselves.

defs.def_cn: （政治和商业中的）撤离策略，退出策略

ext.ext_cn: 令人担忧的是，我们没有从这场冲突中脱身的策略。
ext.ext_en: The fear is that we have no exit strategy from this conflict.

defs.def_en: In politics and business, an exit strategy is a way of ending your involvement in a situation such as a military operation or a business arrangement.

defs.def_cn: （宝石）半珍贵的，次贵重的，半宝石的
defs.def_en: Semi-precious stones are stones such as turquoises and amethysts that are used in jewellery but are less valuable than precious stones such as diamonds and rubies.

defs.def_cn: (常裹以巧克力的长条形)糖棒
defs.def_en: A candy bar is a long, thin, sweet food, usually covered in chocolate.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 女性喝酒渐渐被人们接受。
ext.ext_en: It is becoming more acceptable for women to drink alcohol...

ext.ext_cn: 大气污染程度超出了普遍认可的标准10倍或更多。
ext.ext_en: The air pollution exceeds most acceptable levels by 10 times or more.

defs.def_en: Acceptable activities and situations are those that most people approve of or consider to be normal.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们经过讨论达成了一项莫斯科可以接受的折中方案。
ext.ext_en: They have thrashed out a compromise formula acceptable to Moscow...

ext.ext_cn: 他们最近未能谈成一个双方都满意的新合同。
ext.ext_en: They recently failed to negotiate a mutually acceptable new contract.

defs.def_en: If something is acceptable to someone, they agree to consider it, use it, or allow it to happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 远处街边有一家饭店看起来还可以。
ext.ext_en: On the far side of the street was a restaurant that looked acceptable...

ext.ext_cn: 我们起了一个好头，但本可以更好一些的。
ext.ext_en: We've made an acceptable start, but it could've been better.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as acceptable, you mean that it is good enough or fairly good.

ext.ext_cn: 每门课程都包括10至12次每周一次的非正式讨论会。
ext.ext_en: Each course comprises 10-12 informal weekly meetings...

ext.ext_cn: 我们每周四去采购一次。
ext.ext_en: We go and do the weekly shopping every Thursday.

defs.def_en: A weekly event or publication happens or appears once a week or every week.

ext.ext_cn: 除了每周的薪水外，我还能得到不少小费。
ext.ext_en: In addition to my weekly wage, I got a lot of tips.

defs.def_en: Weekly quantities or rates relate to a period of one week.

ext.ext_cn: 4份全国性日报中有两份将改为周报。
ext.ext_en: Two of the four national daily papers are to become weeklies.

defs.def_en: A weekly is a newspaper or magazine that is published once a week.
A desperado is someone who does illegal, violent things without worrying about the danger.

ext.ext_cn: 包括蛙人和警犬训练员在内的50名警官正展开对她的搜寻。
ext.ext_en: Fifty officers, including frogmen and dog handlers, are searching for her.

defs.def_en: A handler is someone whose job is to be in charge of and control an animal.

ext.ext_cn: 盖特威克机场的行李搬运工
ext.ext_en: ...baggage handlers at Gatwick airport.

defs.def_en: A handler is someone whose job is to deal with a particular type of object.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 必不可少的;不可或缺的

ext.ext_cn: 他已变得越来越离不开她了。
ext.ext_en: She was becoming indispensable to him.

ext.ext_cn: 在法国对任何游客来说都不可缺少的向导
ext.ext_en: ...the indispensable guide for any traveller in France.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is indispensable, you mean that they are absolutely essential and other people or things cannot function without them.

ext.ext_cn: 极地涡旋是冬季风形成的一个风系。
ext.ext_en: The polar vortex is a system of wintertime winds.

ext.ext_cn: 使飞机减速的螺旋形气流涡旋
ext.ext_en: ...the spiralling vortex airflow that slows the plane.

defs.def_en: A vortex is a mass of wind or water that spins round so fast that it pulls objects down into its empty centre.

defs.def_cn: （局势的）漩涡;无法控制的处境

ext.ext_cn: 当婚姻破裂时，孩子们也被卷进父母感情日益恶化的漩涡中。
ext.ext_en: When marriages break down children are swept into the vortex of their parents' embittered emotions.

ext.ext_cn: 纵酒狂欢和醒来时什么都不记得的自毁漩涡
ext.ext_en: ...a self-destructive vortex of alcoholic binges and blackouts.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a situation as a vortex, you feel that you are being forced into it without being able to prevent it.

ext.ext_cn: 等边三角形
ext.ext_en: ...an equilateral triangle.

defs.def_en: A shape or figure that is equilateral has sides that are all the same length.
In language teaching, a cloze test is a test in which words are removed from a text and replaced with spaces. The task of the learner is to fill each space with the missing word or a suitable word.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 切分的，切分音乐的(节拍强弱倒置)

ext.ext_cn: 有一些圣歌以切分节奏为主旋律。
ext.ext_en: Some spirituals are based on syncopated rhythms.

defs.def_en: In syncopated music, the weak beats in the bar are stressed instead of the strong beats.

ext.ext_cn: 莱恩借着手电筒的光亮把它仔细研究了一会儿。
ext.ext_en: Len studied it a moment in the beam of his flashlight...

ext.ext_cn: 州警们正拿着手电筒在附近地区搜查。
ext.ext_en: The troopers, by flashlight, were searching the immediate area.

defs.def_en: A flashlight is a small electric light which gets its power from batteries and which you can carry in your hand.

ext.ext_cn: 为配合调查一宗谋杀案，他下令向伦敦警察厅披露一份医疗报告。
ext.ext_en: He ordered disclosure of a medical report to the Metropolitan Police in pursuance of an investigation of murder.

defs.def_en: If you do something in pursuance of a particular activity, you do it as part of carrying out that activity.

defs.def_cn: 房间;屋子;室;房间里的所有人

ext.ext_cn: 一分钟之后，他说了声抱歉就离开了房间。
ext.ext_en: A minute later he excused himself and left the room...

ext.ext_cn: 楼下是两个小房间：一个厨房和一个起居室。
ext.ext_en: Downstairs are two small rooms: a kitchen and a sitting room...

defs.def_en: A room is one of the separate sections or parts of the inside of a building. Rooms have their own walls, ceilings, floors, and doors, and are usually used for particular activities. You can refer to all the people who are in a room as the room .

defs.def_cn: 私人房间（尤指卧室或办公室）

ext.ext_cn: 如果你上楼，麻烦到我的房间把我的毛衣拿下来。
ext.ext_en: If you're running upstairs, go to my room and bring down my sweater, please.

defs.def_en: If you talk about your room, you are referring to the room that you alone use, especially your bedroom at home or your office at work.

ext.ext_cn: 托妮在离阿茨费尔德不远的一家宾馆订了一个房间。
ext.ext_en: Toni booked a room in an hotel not far from Arzfeld.

defs.def_en: A room is a bedroom in a hotel.

ext.ext_cn: 我和他都在耶鲁法学院读书的时候，在纽黑文合租了一个房间。
ext.ext_en: I had roomed with him in New Haven when we were both at Yale Law School.

defs.def_en: If you room with someone, you share a rented room, apartment, or house with them, for example when you are a student.

ext.ext_cn: 那里通常可以住得下80位来客。
ext.ext_en: There is usually room to accommodate up to 80 visitors...

ext.ext_cn: 行李舱没有足够的空间放下所有的工具。
ext.ext_en: There wasn't enough room in the baggage compartment for all the gear...

defs.def_en: See also:leg room;standing room;If there is room somewhere, there is enough empty space there for people or things to be fitted in, or for people to move freely or do what they want to.

ext.ext_cn: 高强度的工作使人几乎没空去悲伤或者忧虑。
ext.ext_en: The intensity of the work left little room for personal grief or anxiety...

ext.ext_cn: 一旦灰泥一干，就没有机会修改了。
ext.ext_en: Once the plaster was dry there was no room for correction...

defs.def_en: If there is room for a particular kind of behaviour or action, people are able to behave in that way or to take that action.

defs.def_cn: 作出改变的机会;回旋的余地

ext.ext_cn: 随着大选临近，他几乎没有什么回旋的余地了。
ext.ext_en: With an election looming, he has little room for manoeuvre.

defs.def_en: If you have room for manoeuvre, you have the opportunity to change your plans if it becomes necessary or desirable.

ext.ext_cn: 由于人体生物钟不能迅速对时差作出调整，因而产生了飞机时差反应。
ext.ext_en: Jet lag is caused because the body clock does not readjust immediately to the time change.

defs.def_en: Your body clock is the internal biological mechanism which causes your body to automatically behave in particular ways at particular times of the day.

ext.ext_cn: 把熔化的金属倒入铸模。
ext.ext_en: The molten metal is poured into the mould.

defs.def_en: Molten rock, metal, or glass has been heated to a very high temperature and has become a hot thick liquid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人不快的;令人厌恶的;恶劣的

ext.ext_cn: 令人发指的谋杀
ext.ext_en: ...an extremely nasty murder...

ext.ext_cn: 这场离婚可能会撕破脸。
ext.ext_en: This divorce could turn nasty.

defs.def_en: Something that is nasty is very unpleasant to see, experience, or feel.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你们全都是些可恶的势利小人。
ext.ext_en: What nasty little snobs you all are...

ext.ext_cn: 卫兵们看起来真凶。
ext.ext_en: The guards looked really nasty...

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as nasty, you mean that they behave in an unkind and unpleasant way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 邋遢的;低劣的;下流的;污秽的

ext.ext_cn: 埃米莉在巴勒姆的脏乱小屋
ext.ext_en: ...Emily's nasty little house in Balham...

ext.ext_cn: 那个该死的法雷尔开了些关于莱恩先生的下流玩笑。
ext.ext_en: That damned Farrel made some nasty jokes here about Mr. Lane.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as nasty, you mean it is unattractive, undesirable, or in bad taste.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一位发言人称这一坚决的行动缓和了极为棘手的局面。
ext.ext_en: A spokesman said this firm action had defused a very nasty situation.

defs.def_en: A nasty problem or situation is very worrying and difficult to deal with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我小孙女的脚跟夹到自行车的轮辐里了，伤得很严重。
ext.ext_en: My little granddaughter caught her heel in the spokes of her bicycle — it was a very nasty wound...

ext.ext_cn: 莉莉胸部感染很严重。
ext.ext_en: Lili had a nasty chest infection.

defs.def_en: If you describe an injury or a disease as nasty, you mean that it is serious or looks unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 令人不快的人(或事);危害别人的人(或事)

ext.ext_cn: 充斥着恶棍的邪恶组织
ext.ext_en: ...evil organisations, peopled with nasties...

ext.ext_cn: 脱咖啡因的咖啡仍含一些刺激物和其他可能致癌的有害物质。
ext.ext_en: Decaffeinated coffee still contains some stimulants and other nasties linked with cancer.

defs.def_en: Nasties are unpleasant or harmful people or things.

ext.ext_cn: 那些狗老是往墙上蹭，留下了斑斑污迹。
ext.ext_en: The dogs are always rubbing against the wall and making dirty marks...

ext.ext_cn: 合适的胸罩不会留下红色勒痕。
ext.ext_en: A properly fitting bra should never leave red marks.

defs.def_en: A  mark is a small area of something such as dirt that has accidentally got onto a surface or piece of clothing.

ext.ext_cn: 马蹄上套了皮套子，以免弄脏赛马场。
ext.ext_en: Leather overshoes were put on the horses' hooves to stop them marking the turf...

ext.ext_cn: 我必须格外小心使用操作台，因为木头容易留下污迹。
ext.ext_en: I have to be more careful with the work tops, as wood marks easily.

defs.def_en: If something marks a surface, or if the surface marks, the surface is damaged by marks or a mark.

ext.ext_cn: 他用铅笔做了记号。
ext.ext_en: He made marks with a pencil.

defs.def_en: A mark is a written or printed symbol, for example a letter of the alphabet.

defs.def_cn: 标示;为…作记号;为…作标记

ext.ext_cn: 银行在支票上标有“保付”的字样。
ext.ext_en: The bank marks the check 'certified'...

ext.ext_cn: 在这一格里写上你的邮政编码。
ext.ext_en: Mark the frame with your postcode...

defs.def_en: If you mark something with a particular word or symbol, you write that word or symbol on it.

ext.ext_cn: 简单的十分评分制，其中“1”即“极差”
ext.ext_en: ...a simple scoring device of marks out of 10, where '1' equates to 'Very poor performance'...

ext.ext_cn: 回答b的选手表明对这个过程有所了解，因此可以得到一半的分数。
ext.ext_en: Candidates who answered 'b' could be awarded half marks for demonstrating some understanding of the process...

defs.def_en: A mark is a point that is given for a correct answer or for doing something well in an exam or competition. A mark can also be a written symbol such as a letter that indicates how good a student's or competitor's work or performance is.

ext.ext_cn: 你不得不对她维护正义的勇气竖起大拇指。
ext.ext_en: You have to give her top marks for moral guts...

ext.ext_cn: 他的班子在经济政策上所获评价很低。
ext.ext_en: His administration has earned low marks for its economic policies.

defs.def_en: If someone gets good or high marks for doing something, they have done it well. If they get poor or low marks, they have done it badly.

ext.ext_cn: 他正在他那间小书房里批阅文章。
ext.ext_en: He was marking essays in his small study.

defs.def_en: When a teacher marks a student's work, the teacher decides how good it is and writes a number or letter on it to indicate this opinion.

ext.ext_cn: 失业人数正迅速逼近百万大关。
ext.ext_en: Unemployment is rapidly approaching the one million mark.

defs.def_en: A particular mark is a particular number, point, or stage which has been reached or might be reached, especially a significant one.

ext.ext_cn: 文明社会的特征是照顾最弱势群体。
ext.ext_en: The mark of a civilized society is that it looks after its weakest members.

defs.def_en: The mark of something is the characteristic feature that enables you to recognize it.

defs.def_cn: （品质、情感、情景的）标志，表现，迹象

ext.ext_cn: 他居然不知道经纪人的报酬得从其客户的收入中出，这说明他对好莱坞太不了解了。
ext.ext_en: It was a mark of his unfamiliarity with Hollywood that he didn't understand that an agent was paid out of his client's share...

ext.ext_cn: 店主们暂时停业以示敬意。
ext.ext_en: Shopkeepers closed their shutters as a mark of respect.

defs.def_en: If you say that a type of behaviour or an event is a mark of a particular quality, feeling, or situation, you mean it shows that that quality, feeling, or situation exists.

ext.ext_cn: 巨大的弹坑标明了爆炸发生的地点。
ext.ext_en: A huge crater marks the spot where the explosion happened.

ext.ext_cn: 标明了与泰国分界线的河
ext.ext_en: ...the river which marks the border with Thailand.

defs.def_en: If something marks a place or position, it shows where something else is or where it used to be.

ext.ext_cn: 声明标志着欧洲历史上一个伟大时代的终结。
ext.ext_en: The announcement marks the end of an extraordinary period in European history...

ext.ext_cn: 那个项目赢得了评论界的好评，成为索尼塔事业的转折点。
ext.ext_en: That programme received critical acclaim and marked a turning point in Sonita's career.

defs.def_en: An event that marks a particular stage or point is a sign that something different is about to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 这四枚新邮票是为了纪念英国天文协会成立100周年而发行的。
ext.ext_en: The four new stamps mark the 100th anniversary of the British Astronomical Association...

ext.ext_cn: 数十万人走上街头庆祝这一时刻。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of thousands of people took to the streets to mark the occasion.

defs.def_en: If you do something to mark an event or occasion, you do it to show that you are aware of the importance of the event or occasion.

defs.def_cn: 是…的特色;是…的典型特征

ext.ext_cn: 悲剧笼罩着薇尔梅特的一生。
ext.ext_en: Tragedy has marked Wilmette's life...

ext.ext_cn: 这种风格的特点是简洁、清楚、直截了当。
ext.ext_en: The style is marked by simplicity, clarity, and candor.

defs.def_en: If a particular quality or feature marks something, it is a quality or feature which that thing typically has.

defs.def_cn: 将…归为;把…列为;给…确定性质

ext.ext_cn: 她对堕胎和女权主义的反对态度表明她是个不折不扣的传统主义者。
ext.ext_en: Her opposition to abortion and feminism mark her as a convinced traditionalist.

defs.def_en: Something that marks someone as a particular type of person indicates that they are that type of person.

ext.ext_cn: 成功盯住了迈克尔·欧文的曼联后卫里奥·费迪南德
ext.ext_en: ...Manchester United defender Rio Ferdinand, who so effectively marked Michael Owen.

defs.def_en: In a team game, when a defender is marking an attacker, they are trying to stay close to the attacker and prevent them from getting the ball.

defs.def_cn: 马克(德国使用欧元之前的货币单位)

ext.ext_cn: 政府拨款3000万马克用于购置学校的新教材。
ext.ext_en: The government gave 30 million marks for new school books.

ext.ext_cn: 德国马克对美元升值了12%。
ext.ext_en: The mark appreciated 12 per cent against the dollar.

defs.def_en: The mark was the unit of money used in Germany before it was replaced by the euro.

defs.def_cn: (煤气炉上表示温度的)刻度，挡

ext.ext_cn: 将煤气炉开至4挡。
ext.ext_en: Set the oven  at gas mark 4.

defs.def_en: Mark is used before a number to indicate a particular temperature level in a gas oven.

ext.ext_cn: 他的福特葛天娜二代车
ext.ext_en: ...his Mark II Ford Cortina.

defs.def_en: Mark is used before a number to indicate a particular version or model of a vehicle, machine, or device.

defs.def_cn: 留下深刻的印记;留下深远的影响

ext.ext_cn: 多年的熏陶对她影响很深，她从不愿意跟陌生人说话。
ext.ext_en: Years of conditioning had left their mark on her, and she never felt inclined to talk to strange men.

defs.def_en: If someone or something leaves their mark or leaves a mark, they have a lasting effect on another person or thing.

defs.def_cn: 成就不凡;获得名望;成名

ext.ext_cn: 她在20世纪60年代的电影界占有一席之地。
ext.ext_en: She made her mark in the film industry in the 1960s.

defs.def_en: If you make your mark or make a mark, you become noticed or famous by doing something impressive or unusual.

defs.def_cn: （理解力或反应）敏捷的/迟钝的，灵敏的/缓慢的
defs.def_en: If you are quick off the mark, you are quick to understand or respond to something. If you are slow off the mark, you are slow to understand or respond to something.

ext.ext_cn: 各就各位！预备！跑！
ext.ext_en: On your marks—get set—go!

defs.def_en: On your marks in British English, or on your mark in American English, is a command given to runners at the beginning of a race in order to get them into the correct position to start.

defs.def_cn: 不正确;不得要领;不够贴切/完全正确;切中要害;十分贴切

ext.ext_cn: 鲁宾逊认为这个报道根本算不上离谱。
ext.ext_en: Robinson didn't think the story was so far off the mark...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为电影正在偏离美国文化的看法完全正确。
ext.ext_en: He's right on the mark about movies being out of step with American culture.

defs.def_en: If something is off the mark, it is inaccurate or incorrect. If it is on the mark, it is accurate or correct.

ext.ext_cn: 工人们赶走了工作不符合要求的人。
ext.ext_en: The workers get rid of those whose work is not up to the mark.

defs.def_en: If something is up to the mark, it is good enough.

ext.ext_cn: 那种比较并非像看起来那么离谱。
ext.ext_en: That comparison isn't as wide of the mark as it seems.

defs.def_en: If something such as a claim or estimate is wide of the mark, it is incorrect or inaccurate.

ext.ext_cn: 你听好了，我们不是极端分子。
ext.ext_en: We're not extremists, mark you.

defs.def_en: You can say mark you to emphasize and draw attention to something you have just said.

defs.def_cn: 女权主义;女权运动;男女平等主义

ext.ext_cn: 女性运动也许解放了女权主义者，但尚未改变大多数女性的生活。
ext.ext_en: Feminism may have liberated the feminists, but it has still to change the lives of the majority of women.

ext.ext_cn: 芭芭拉·约翰逊——激进女权主义的捍卫者
ext.ext_en: ...Barbara Johnson, that champion of radical feminism.

defs.def_en: Feminism is the belief and aim that women should have the same rights, power, and opportunities as men.

ext.ext_cn: 柯里用脚侧踢进了他本赛季的第一个进球。
ext.ext_en: Currie sidefooted his first goal of the season.

ext.ext_cn: 安东尼用脚侧踢了下球，球便进了。
ext.ext_en: Anthony scored with a simple side-foot.

defs.def_en: In football, if a player side-foots the ball, they kick it with the side of their foot.

defs.def_cn: 沉闷乏味的;无聊的;平淡无奇的

ext.ext_cn: 我对这条消息的总体反应可以用“哼儿哈儿”来概括。
ext.ext_en: My general reaction to this news might be summed up as 'ho-hum'...

ext.ext_cn: 音乐总体来说很棒，但编剧和表演就有点平淡无奇。
ext.ext_en: The music is generally terrific but the scripting and acting are a bit ho-hum.

defs.def_en: You can use ho hum when you want to show that you think something is not interesting, remarkable, or surprising in any way.

ext.ext_cn: ，又一份好工作泡汤了。
ext.ext_en: Ho hum, another nice job down the drain.

defs.def_en: You can say ho hum to show that you accept an unpleasant situation because it is not very serious.
An interior designer is a person who is employed to design the decoration for the inside of people's houses.

defs.def_cn: (与形容词连用)表示“有…声音的”，“听上去…的”

ext.ext_cn: 许多文人只是机械地模仿一套听上去令人印象深刻的说法。
ext.ext_en: Many literary academics simply parrot a set of impressive-sounding phrases.

ext.ext_cn: 地名听上去比较奇特的遥远地区
ext.ext_en: ...faraway places with strange-sounding names.

defs.def_en: See also:high-sounding;-sounding combines with adjectives to indicate a quality that a word, phrase, or name seems to have.

ext.ext_cn: 让我们假设这样一种情景，卡萝尔，一位正在康复的可卡因成瘾者，应邀去参加一个聚会。
ext.ext_en: Let's look at a hypothetical situation in which Carol, a recovering cocaine addict, gets invited to a party.

ext.ext_cn: 纯属假设的问题
ext.ext_en: ...a purely hypothetical question.

defs.def_en: If something is hypothetical, it is based on possible ideas or situations rather than actual ones.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 生气勃勃的；活泼的；热烈的

ext.ext_cn: 有人看见她与歌手尤里·马鲁辛交谈甚欢。
ext.ext_en: She was seen in animated conversation with the singer Yuri Marusin...

ext.ext_cn: 每个人都变得更加活泼热情。
ext.ext_en: Everyone became more animated.

defs.def_en: Someone who is animated or who is having an animated conversation is lively and is showing their feelings.

ext.ext_cn: 迪斯尼又回到了它最擅长的领域：制作动画长片。
ext.ext_en: Disney has returned to what it does best: making full-length animated feature films.

defs.def_en: An animated film is one in which puppets or drawings appear to move.

ext.ext_cn: 如果政客行为失检，那可不是媒体的责任。
ext.ext_en: If a politician transgresses, that is not the fault of the media.

ext.ext_cn: 触犯禁欲戒律的僧侣
ext.ext_en: ...a monk who had transgressed against the law of celibacy...

defs.def_en: If someone transgresses, they break a moral law or a rule of behaviour.

defs.def_cn: (客户指示银行定期支付一定款项给某人的)长期委托书;定期支付委托书
defs.def_en: A standing order is an instruction to your bank to pay a fixed amount of money to someone at regular times.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （言辞、文字等）表达生动的，有说服力的

ext.ext_cn: 在那次晚宴上，我听到他作了一番非常有说服力的陈词。
ext.ext_en: I heard him make a very eloquent speech at that dinner.

defs.def_en: Speech or writing that is eloquent is well expressed and effective in persuading people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 雄辩的;口才流利的;能言善辩的

ext.ext_cn: 他说起自己对书的喜爱来就会停不住嘴。
ext.ext_en: He was eloquent about his love of books.

ext.ext_cn: 非常能言善辩的德国评论家
ext.ext_en: ...one particularly eloquent German critic.

defs.def_en: A person who is eloquent is good at speaking and able to persuade people.

ext.ext_cn: 我感谢父母为我做出的所有自我牺牲。
ext.ext_en: I thanked my parents for all their self-sacrifice on my behalf.

defs.def_en: Self-sacrifice is the giving up of what you want so that other people can have what they need or want.

ext.ext_cn: 我们要是去看场戏，那可是件大事。
ext.ext_en: If we went to the theatre it was a very big event...

ext.ext_cn: 我在大剧院上班。
ext.ext_en: I worked at the Grand Theatre.

defs.def_en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

defs.def_cn: 戏剧工作;舞台表演;戏剧创作

ext.ext_cn: 你可以转行从事影视戏剧业。
ext.ext_en: You can move up to work in films and the theatre...

ext.ext_cn: 不久他便开始涉足戏剧。
ext.ext_en: Very soon he took the first steps towards a career in the theatre.

defs.def_en: You can refer to work in the theatre such as acting or writing plays as the theatre .

ext.ext_cn: 全国有多家公司都开始对儿童戏剧表现出极大的兴趣。
ext.ext_en: Companies across the country are beginning to show a healthy interest in theatre for children.

defs.def_en: Theatre is entertainment that involves the performance of plays.
A theater or a movie theater is a place where people go to watch films for entertainment.

ext.ext_cn: 她从手术室出来了，身体状况良好。
ext.ext_en: She is back from theatre and her condition is comfortable.

defs.def_en: In a hospital, a theatre is a special room where surgeons carry out medical operations.

ext.ext_cn: 中东这一地区一直战乱频仍。
ext.ext_en: The Middle East has often been a theatre of war.

defs.def_en: A theatre of war or other conflict is the area or region in which the war or conflict is happening.

ext.ext_cn: 我刚刚遇到了我想与之共度余生的男人。
ext.ext_en: I have just met the man I want to spend the rest of my life with...

ext.ext_cn: 他是我所见过的最友善、最真诚的人。
ext.ext_en: He's the kindest and sincerest person I've ever met...

defs.def_en: If you meet someone, you happen to be in the same place as them and start talking to them. You may know the other person, but be surprised to see them, or you may not know them at all.

ext.ext_cn: 下班后我们可以见面喝上一杯。
ext.ext_en: We could meet for a drink after work...

ext.ext_cn: 明天早上6点整在海滩上跟我见面。
ext.ext_en: Meet me down at the beach tomorrow, at 6am sharp.

defs.def_en: If two or more people meet, they go to the same place, which they have earlier arranged to do, so that they can talk or do something together.

ext.ext_cn: 嗨，特里，过来认识一下我爸爸。
ext.ext_en: Hey, Terry, come and meet my Dad.

defs.def_en: If you meet someone, you are introduced to them and begin talking to them and getting to know them.

ext.ext_cn: “珍妮弗，”马洛里小姐说，“这位是利·范沃林。”——“见到您很高兴，”珍妮弗说。
ext.ext_en: 'Jennifer,' Miss Mallory said, 'this is Leigh Van-Voreen.' — 'Pleased to meet you,' Jennifer said...

ext.ext_cn: 我得走了。认识您很高兴。
ext.ext_en: I have to leave. Nice to have met you.

defs.def_en: You use meet in expressions such as 'Pleased to meet you' and 'Nice to have met you' when you want to politely say hello or goodbye to someone you have just met for the first time.

defs.def_cn: (到火车站、飞机场或公共汽车站)迎接

ext.ext_cn: 妈妈在车站接我。
ext.ext_en: Mama met me at the station...

ext.ext_cn: 莉莉和我父亲在码头迎接我。
ext.ext_en: Lili and my father met me off the boat...

defs.def_en: If you meet someone off their train, plane, or bus, you go to the station, airport, or bus stop in order to be there when they arrive.

ext.ext_cn: 两国官员不久将再度会晤以重启谈判。
ext.ext_en: Officials from the two countries will meet again soon to resume negotiations...

ext.ext_cn: 1988至1991年间，该委员会举行了14次会议。
ext.ext_en: The commission met 14 times between 1988 and 1991.

defs.def_en: When a group of people such as a committee meet, they gather together for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数昨天与总统会晤的立法者说他们支持这个行动。
ext.ext_en: Most of the lawmakers who met with the president yesterday said they backed the mission.

defs.def_en: If you meet with someone, you have a meeting with them.

ext.ext_cn: 这个想法遭到了各方人士的冷遇。
ext.ext_en: The idea met with a cool response from various quarters...

ext.ext_cn: 我们希望今天的提议也能够得到您的首肯。
ext.ext_en: We hope today's offer will meet with your approval too...

defs.def_en: If something such as a suggestion, proposal, or new book meets with or is met with a particular reaction, it gets that reaction from people.

ext.ext_cn: 目前对严重精神病患者的护理安排不足以满足他们的需要。
ext.ext_en: The current arrangements for the care of severely mentally ill people are inadequate to meet their needs...

ext.ext_cn: 最初的2.3万份申请中有1.6万份满足入选的要求。
ext.ext_en: Out of the original 23,000 applications, 16,000 candidates meet the entry requirements.

defs.def_en: If something meets a need, requirement, or condition, it is good enough to do what is required.

ext.ext_cn: 英国制造业未能经受住20世纪70年代危机的考验。
ext.ext_en: British manufacturing failed to meet the crisis of the 1970s...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个巨大的挑战，但是我们希望在1年或18个月之内能够战胜它。
ext.ext_en: It is an enormous challenge but we hope to meet it within a year or 18 months...

defs.def_en: If you meet something such as a problem or challenge, you deal with it satisfactorily or do what is required.

ext.ext_cn: 政府说将帮助支付损害造成的部分费用。
ext.ext_en: The government said it will help meet some of the cost of the damage...

ext.ext_cn: 随着收入的增加，你会发现筹钱支付每月的还款没那么难了。
ext.ext_en: As your income increases you will find less difficulty in finding the money to meet your monthly repayments.

defs.def_en: If you meet the cost of something, you provide the money that is needed for it.

defs.def_cn: 碰上，遇到，遭遇(情况、态度、问题等)

ext.ext_cn: 我真不知道下次再碰上有潜在危险的情况时会作何反应。
ext.ext_en: I honestly don't know how I will react the next time I meet a potentially dangerous situation...

ext.ext_cn: 她从未遭遇过如此恶毒和狭隘的事情。
ext.ext_en: Never had she met such spite and pettiness.

defs.def_en: If you meet a situation, attitude, or problem, you experience it or become aware of it.

ext.ext_cn: 寻找平民志愿者的种种尝试都遭遇了令人难堪的失败。
ext.ext_en: Attempts to find civilian volunteers have met with embarrassing failure...

ext.ext_cn: 为使俄罗斯太空项目走向商业化而作出的种种努力几乎没有取得什么成功。
ext.ext_en: Efforts to commercialise the Russian space programme have met with little success.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone meets with success or failure when they are successful or unsuccessful.

ext.ext_cn: 每次龙骨触地的时候你都能感受到船体所受的压力。
ext.ext_en: You sense the stresses in the hull each time the keel meets the ground...

ext.ext_cn: 尼克慢慢向她低下头去，直到他们的嘴唇碰在了一起。
ext.ext_en: Nick's head bent slowly over hers until their mouths met.

defs.def_en: When a moving object meets another object, it hits or touches it.

ext.ext_cn: 尼娜与桌子对面的姐妹们目光相遇。
ext.ext_en: Nina's eyes met her sisters' across the table...

ext.ext_cn: 我发现当我们的目光相遇时，我本能地还以微笑。
ext.ext_en: I found myself smiling back instinctively when our eyes met.

defs.def_en: If your eyes meet someone else's, you both look at each other at the same time.

defs.def_cn: (两片区域,尤指两片陆地或海洋)相接，汇合,相邻

ext.ext_cn: 世界上沙漠与大海相接的地方非常少见，这里就是一处。
ext.ext_en: It is one of the rare places in the world where the desert meets the sea.

ext.ext_cn: 南美洲最南端、太平洋与大西洋的汇合处
ext.ext_en: ...the southernmost point of South America where the Pacific and Atlantic oceans meet.

defs.def_en: If two areas meet, especially two areas of land or sea, they are next to one another.

ext.ext_cn: 无论延伸多长，平行线永不相交。
ext.ext_en: Parallel lines will never meet no matter how far extended...

ext.ext_cn: 小路在和公路相交的地方变宽了。
ext.ext_en: The track widened as it met the road.

defs.def_en: The place where two lines meet is the place where they join together.

defs.def_cn: (两个运动员、球队或军队)比赛,较量,交锋

ext.ext_cn: 这两位女选手将在明天的决赛里决一胜负。
ext.ext_en: The two women will meet tomorrow in the final...

ext.ext_cn: 1781年3月15日，力量悬殊的两支队伍在吉尔福德狭路相逢。
ext.ext_en: The unevenly matched armies met at Guilford on 15 March 1781...

defs.def_en: If two sportsmen, teams, or armies meet, they compete or fight against one another.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·佩内尔在佛罗里达迈阿密的一次运动会上成为撑竿越过17英尺的第一人。
ext.ext_en: John Pennel became the first person to pole-vault 17 ft., at a meet in Miami, Florida.

defs.def_en: A meet is an event in which athletes come to a particular place in order to take part in a race or races.
A meet is when riders and dogs gather somewhere before they set off on a fox hunt.

defs.def_cn: 迎着(或直视)(某人的)目光

ext.ext_cn: 他犹豫起来，然后摇摇头，避开了她的目光。
ext.ext_en: He hesitated, then shook his head, refusing to meet her eyes.

defs.def_en: If you do not meet someone's eyes or meet someone's gaze, you do not look at them although they are looking at you, for example because you are ashamed.

ext.ext_cn: 雅各布·辛克莱在一名士兵的手里送了命。
ext.ext_en: Jacob Sinclair met his death at the hands of a soldier...

ext.ext_cn: 没有人知道他究竟是如何或在何处丢掉性命的。
ext.ext_en: No one knows exactly how or where he met his end.

defs.def_en: If someone meets their death or meets their end, they die, especially in a violent or suspicious way.

defs.def_cn: 失败的原因；毁灭的原因

ext.ext_cn: 他缺乏经验可能会最终导致他的失败。
ext.ext_en: His lack of experience may prove to be his undoing...

ext.ext_cn: 国防问题导致了民主党候选人的失利。
ext.ext_en: Issues of national defense have been the undoing of Democratic candidates.

defs.def_en: If something is someone's undoing, it is the cause of their failure.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 灾难性的;引起重大灾难的

ext.ext_cn: 地震引起的海啸袭击了沿海地区，导致灾难性的破坏。
ext.ext_en: A tidal wave caused by the earthquake hit the coast causing catastrophic damage...

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家的水资源匮乏可能会带来灾难性的后果。
ext.ext_en: The water shortage in this country is potentially catastrophic...

defs.def_en: Something that is catastrophic involves or causes a sudden terrible disaster.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 为从敌对的基督教民兵组织手中夺得控制权而遭遇的再次惨败
ext.ext_en: ...another catastrophic attempt to arrest control from a rival Christian militia...

ext.ext_cn: 他妈妈的过早离世对他具有灾难性的影响。
ext.ext_en: His mother's untimely death had a catastrophic effect on him.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as catastrophic, you mean that it is very bad or unsuccessful.

ext.ext_cn: 失业、低工资以及其他社会问题造成的最糟糕的影响
ext.ext_en: ...the worst effects of unemployment, low pay and other social problems.

ext.ext_cn: 长期的社会变革
ext.ext_en: ...long-term social change.

defs.def_en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

defs.def_cn: 同社会地位(或阶层)有关的

ext.ext_cn: 社会各个阶层享受高等教育的权利是不平等的。
ext.ext_en: Higher education is unequally distributed across social classes...

ext.ext_cn: 客人们来自各个社会阶层。
ext.ext_en: The guests came from all social backgrounds...

defs.def_en: Social means relating to the status or rank that someone has in society.

ext.ext_cn: 我们应当组织更多的社交活动。
ext.ext_en: We ought to organize more social events...

ext.ext_cn: 社交活动可以包括沙滩上的烧烤和老城区的步行游览。
ext.ext_en: Social activities might include barbecues on the beach and walking tours of the Old Town.

defs.def_en: Social means relating to leisure activities that involve meeting other people.

defs.def_cn: (为俱乐部或团体的会员组织的)晚会，舞会，非正式聚会，联欢会

ext.ext_cn: 教堂里举办的聚会
ext.ext_en: ...church socials.

defs.def_en: A social is a party, dance, or informal gathering that is organized for the members of a club or institution.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些濒临灭绝的、性情温顺的大型动物属于高度群居的动物。
ext.ext_en: These endangered gentle giants are highly social animals.

ext.ext_cn: 像蜜蜂和蚂蚁这样的群居昆虫
ext.ext_en: ...social insects like bees and ants.

defs.def_en: Social animals live in groups and do things together.

defs.def_cn: 弥赛亚(上帝派去拯救犹太人民的国王)
defs.def_en: For Jews, the Messiah is the King of the Jews, who will be sent to them by God.
For Christians, the Messiah is Jesus Christ.

ext.ext_cn: 人民把曼德拉看作他们的大救星。
ext.ext_en: People saw Mandela as their messiah...

ext.ext_cn: 冥冥之中，他注定会成为摇滚乐的救世主。
ext.ext_en: He was somehow destined to become a rock messiah.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a messiah, you mean that they are expected to do wonderful things, especially to rescue people from a very difficult or dangerous situation, or that they are thought to have done these things.

defs.def_cn: 不能忍受的；难以容忍的

ext.ext_cn: 艾萨克觉得这份工作实在令人难以忍受，就辞职走人了。
ext.ext_en: Isaac had found the work unendurable and walked out of the job...

ext.ext_cn: 他没料到会如此疼痛难忍。
ext.ext_en: He had not expected the pain to be unendurable...

defs.def_en: If you describe a bad situation as unendurable, you mean that it is so extremely unpleasant that you have to end it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们参与了一系列的欺骗活动。
ext.ext_en: They have been involved in a campaign of deceit.

defs.def_en: Deceit is behaviour that is deliberately intended to make people believe something which is not true.

ext.ext_cn: 桌子上有两个空啤酒瓶。
ext.ext_en: There were two empty beer bottles on the table...

ext.ext_cn: 他正在启一瓶葡萄酒的瓶塞。
ext.ext_en: He was pulling the cork from a bottle of wine.

defs.def_en: A bottle is a glass or plastic container in which drinks and other liquids are kept. Bottles are usually round with straight sides and a narrow top.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一辆大型卡车，拥有自动将葡萄酒装瓶的设备。
ext.ext_en: This is a large truck which has equipment to automatically bottle the wine.

ext.ext_cn: 瓶装水
ext.ext_en: ...bottled water.

defs.def_en: To bottle a drink or other liquid means to put it into bottles after it has been made.

ext.ext_cn: 加里正拿着一个奶瓶给婴儿喂奶。
ext.ext_en: Gary was holding a bottle to the baby's lips.

defs.def_en: A bottle is a drinking container used by babies. It has a special rubber part at the top through which they can suck their drink.

ext.ext_cn: 她干过将水果装瓶或做果酱之类的活计吗？
ext.ext_en: Did she do things like bottling fruit or making jam?

ext.ext_cn: 装罐贮藏的李子
ext.ext_en: ...bottled plums.

defs.def_en: To bottle fruit means to put it into special jars, in order to preserve it.

ext.ext_cn: 但是谁会有胆量经受这件事？
ext.ext_en: But will anyone have the bottle to go through with it?

defs.def_en: Bottle is used to refer to courage or boldness.

ext.ext_cn: 我母亲死后父亲开始酗酒。
ext.ext_en: After my mother died my father started hitting the bottle.

defs.def_en: If someone hits the bottle, they drink a lot of alcohol.

defs.def_cn: （在最后时刻）因胆怯而放弃，打退堂鼓

ext.ext_cn: 他原定参加拉塞尔·哈蒂主持的节目，但在最后时刻打了退堂鼓。
ext.ext_en: He was scheduled to appear on the Russell Harty Show, but bottled it at the last minute.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has bottled it, you mean that they have lost their courage at the last moment and have not done something they intended to do.
A bottle of smelling salts contains a chemical with a strong smell which is used to help someone recover after they have fainted.

defs.def_cn: 零分(通常用于表示橄榄球、足球等比赛中的得分)

ext.ext_cn: 他们在决赛中以 1 比 0 击败了阿根廷队。
ext.ext_en: They beat Argentina one-nil in the final.

defs.def_en: Nil means the same as zero. It is usually used to say what the score is in sports such as rugby or football.  →see usage note at:nought

ext.ext_cn: 他们实际上毫无法律权利。
ext.ext_en: Their legal rights are virtually nil...

ext.ext_cn: 冬季供暖设施几乎毫无用处。
ext.ext_en: The heating in winter was almost nil.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is nil, you mean that it does not exist at all.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 社团主义政治体系
ext.ext_en: ... a corporatist political system...

ext.ext_cn: 他们确实表现出明显的社团主义倾向。
ext.ext_en: They did show decidedly corporatist tendencies.

defs.def_en: You use corporatist to describe organizations, ideas, or systems which follow the principles of corporatism.

ext.ext_cn: 社团主义者的落败不难理解。
ext.ext_en: The defeat of the corporatists is easy to understand.

defs.def_en: A corporatist is someone who believes in the principles of corporatism.

ext.ext_cn: 有关声、光和运动的定律
ext.ext_en: ...the laws governing light, sound, and motion...

ext.ext_cn: 一组肌肉带动下一组肌肉运动。
ext.ext_en: One group of muscles sets the next group in motion...

defs.def_en: Motion is the activity or process of continually changing position or moving from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 对全身每个部位画长弧线轻抚或做圆圈状按摩。
ext.ext_en: Cover each part of the body with long sweeping strokes or circular motions...

ext.ext_cn: 他挥手做了一个干净利落的劈砍的动作。
ext.ext_en: He made a neat chopping motion with his hand.

defs.def_en: A motion is an action, gesture, or movement.

defs.def_cn: (会议、辩论或审判时提出的)动议，提议，议案

ext.ext_cn: 大会正在就提议进行辩论，稍后将就此表决。
ext.ext_en: The conference is now debating the motion and will vote on it shortly...

ext.ext_cn: 反对党很可能提出对政府的不信任案。
ext.ext_en: Opposition parties are likely to bring a no-confidence motion against the government...

defs.def_en: A motion is a formal proposal or statement in a meeting, debate, or trial, which is discussed and then voted on or decided on.

ext.ext_cn: 她示意把锁着的前门打开。
ext.ext_en: She motioned for the locked front doors to be opened...

ext.ext_cn: 他站到一边并示意唐到门口去。
ext.ext_en: He stood aside and motioned Don to the door...

defs.def_en: If you motion to someone, you move your hand or head as a way of telling them to do something or telling them where to go.

defs.def_cn: (尤为医生、护士用语)排便，大便

ext.ext_cn: 尽量保证大便规律，避免便秘。
ext.ext_en: Try to make sure your bowel motions are regular and that you avoid any constipation.

defs.def_en: Some people, especially doctors or nurses, use motion as a polite way of referring to a person's act of defecation or the faeces produced.

ext.ext_cn: “你其实不在意，对不对？”她悄声说，“你就是装装样子而已。”
ext.ext_en: 'You really don't care, do you?' she said quietly. 'You're just going through the motions.'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is going through the motions, you think they are only saying or doing something because it is expected of them without being interested, enthusiastic, or sympathetic.

ext.ext_cn: 这个水手机灵地走了走过场。
ext.ext_en: The sailor went through all the motions smartly...

ext.ext_cn: 演员们假装从事不同的劳动。
ext.ext_en: Actors go through the motions of different types of labor.

defs.def_en: If you go through the motions, you pretend to do something by making the movements associated with a particular action.

defs.def_cn: 正在发生;在进行中;即将发生

ext.ext_cn: 现在世界杯足球赛的征战工作已经展开，而他作为英格兰队主教练的工作也真正开始了。
ext.ext_en: His job as England manager begins in earnest now his World Cup campaign is in motion...

ext.ext_cn: 她那咄咄逼人的尖锐语调拉开了导致她垮台的事件的序幕。
ext.ext_en: Her sharp, aggressive tone set in motion the events that led to her downfall.

defs.def_en: If a process or event is in motion, it is happening. If it is set in motion, it is happening or beginning to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 我已着手出售恩德斯勒公馆。
ext.ext_en: I have set the wheels in motion to sell Endsleigh Court.

defs.def_en: If someone sets the wheels in motion, they take the necessary action to make something start happening.

defs.def_cn: (大小两层圆面团叠在一起制成的)农家面包
defs.def_en: A cottage loaf is a loaf of bread which has a smaller round part on top of a larger round part.

ext.ext_cn: 工作人员会很乐意为您安排游泳、航行或是滑水等活动。
ext.ext_en: The staff will be happy to help arrange for you to swim, sail, or water-ski.

defs.def_en: If you water-ski, you stand on skis in the water while being pulled along by a boat.

ext.ext_cn: 我们每天早上都得站在雪地里等着点名。
ext.ext_en: We had to stand in the snow every morning for roll call.

defs.def_en: If you take a roll call, you check which of the members of a group are present by reading their names out.

ext.ext_cn: 她的学生名单看起来像一本大人物名册。
ext.ext_en: Her list of pupils read like a roll-call of the great and good.

defs.def_en: A roll call of a particular type of people or things is a list of them.
The dining room is the room in a house where people have their meals, or a room in a hotel where meals are served.

ext.ext_cn: 苏珊心目中的自由就是拥有丰富多彩的生活。
ext.ext_en: Susan's idea of freedom was to have variety in her life style...

ext.ext_cn: 我不知道世界上还有哪个商店的经营品种如此繁多，陈列如此美观。
ext.ext_en: I know no store anywhere in the world that has such variety and display...

defs.def_en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 西汉普斯特德有各种各样不错的店铺和超级市场。
ext.ext_en: West Hampstead has a variety of good shops and supermarkets...

ext.ext_cn: 这个岛屿拥有丰富多样的景致及种类繁多的野生动植物。
ext.ext_en: The island offers such a wide variety of scenery and wildlife...

defs.def_en: A variety of things is a number of different kinds or examples of the same thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我一直乐于尝试新产品。
ext.ext_en: I'm always pleased to try out a new variety...

ext.ext_cn: 她有12种双花玫瑰。
ext.ext_en: She has 12 varieties of old-fashioned roses.

defs.def_en: A variety of something is a type of it.

ext.ext_cn: 汇集了音乐、喜剧及魔术表演的一档综艺节目
ext.ext_en: ...a variety show of music, comedy, and magic.

defs.def_en: Variety is a type of entertainment which includes many different kinds of acts in the same show.

ext.ext_cn: 编辑们和撰稿者们在试图预测未来。
ext.ext_en: Editors and contributors are trying to second-guess the future.

defs.def_en: If you try to second-guess something, you try to guess in advance what someone will do or what will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 布朗夫人在 11 月的选举中仍然没有十足的胜算。
ext.ext_en: Ms Brown is still no shoo-in for the November election.

defs.def_en: A shoo-in is a person or thing that seems sure to succeed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有效的;能产生预期效果的

ext.ext_cn: 该项目着眼于我们如何能够更加有效地鼓励学生参与教师培训。
ext.ext_en: The project looks at how we could be more effective in encouraging students to enter teacher training...

ext.ext_cn: 一般的抗生素能够有效对抗这种微生物。
ext.ext_en: Simple antibiotics are effective against this organism...

defs.def_en: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

ext.ext_cn: 自从安全部队撤离后，他们实际上控制了该地区。
ext.ext_en: They have had effective control of the area since the security forces left.

ext.ext_cn: 原本会使他们最热门的一条短途旅游线路的费用出现实质性上涨的调整
ext.ext_en: ...a restructuring that would have resulted in an effective increase on one of their most popular excursion fares.

defs.def_en: Effective means having a particular role or result in practice, though not officially or in theory.

defs.def_cn: （法律、协议等）生效的，起作用的

ext.ext_cn: 新规定将在几天后生效。
ext.ext_en: The new rules will become effective in the next few days.

defs.def_en: When something such as a law or an agreement becomes effective, it begins officially to apply or be valid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （对某人或其行为表示赞赏）充满活力的，有胆量的

ext.ext_cn: 我认识的最敢作敢为的女子
ext.ext_en: ...the most ballsy woman I know.

ext.ext_cn: 狂野热烈的现场说唱乐
ext.ext_en: ...ballsy, gutsy live rap music.

defs.def_en: You can describe a person or their behaviour as ballsy if you admire them because you think they are energetic and brave.

defs.def_cn: （国家、集体或个人的）重归于好，和解

ext.ext_cn: 同越南恢复友好关系的迹象越来越明显了。
ext.ext_en: There have been growing signs of a rapprochement with Vietnam.

ext.ext_cn: 两个宿敌之间的政治和解进程
ext.ext_en: ...the process of political rapprochement between the two former foes.

defs.def_en: A rapprochement is an increase in friendliness between two countries, groups, or people, especially after a period of unfriendliness.

ext.ext_cn: 科技发生迅猛变革的时代
ext.ext_en: ...an era of very rapid technological change.

defs.def_en: Technological means relating to or associated with technology.

defs.def_cn: 马赫(速度单位，1马赫等于1倍音速)

ext.ext_cn: 热空气可使之在超过临界马赫数之前达到更快的速度。
ext.ext_en: The hot air permitted higher speeds before the critical Mach number was exceeded...

ext.ext_cn: 目标是以大约2马赫的速度飞行，也就是音速的两倍。
ext.ext_en: The aim is to fly at about Mach 2, twice the speed of sound.

defs.def_en: Mach is used as a unit of measurement in stating the speed of a moving object in relation to the speed of sound. For example, if an aircraft is travelling at Mach 1, it is travelling at exactly the speed of sound.

ext.ext_cn: 进行体育活动是保持身体健康的一个重要因素。
ext.ext_en: Physical activity is an important factor in maintaining fitness.

defs.def_en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 黄油价格涨了 4 倍，面包价格涨了 5 倍。
ext.ext_en: The cost of butter quadrupled and bread prices increased by a factor of five.

defs.def_en: If an amount increases by a factor of two, for example, or by a factor of eight, then it becomes two times bigger or eight times bigger.

ext.ext_cn: 防晒系数为 8 的防晒霜
ext.ext_en: ...suncream with a protection factor of 8.

defs.def_en: You can use factor to refer to a particular level on a scale of measurement.
A factor of a whole number is a smaller whole number which can be multiplied with another whole number to produce the first whole number.

ext.ext_cn: X光片证实他没有骨折。
ext.ext_en: X-rays have confirmed that he has not broken any bones...

ext.ext_cn: 这些新的统计数据证实经济衰退已经严重到我们最为担忧的境地。
ext.ext_en: These new statistics confirm our worst fears about the depth of the recession...

defs.def_en: If something confirms what you believe, suspect, or fear, it shows that it is definitely true.

ext.ext_cn: 这位发言人证实该地区现已落入叛乱分子手中。
ext.ext_en: The spokesman confirmed that the area was now in rebel hands...

ext.ext_cn: 他证实了人们长期以来的担心。
ext.ext_en: He confirmed what had long been feared...

defs.def_en: If you confirm something that has been stated or suggested, you say that it is true because you know about it.

defs.def_cn: (通常指通过信件或电话)确定，确认(安排或预约)

ext.ext_cn: 你来预订，我会去函确认。
ext.ext_en: You make the reservation, and I'll confirm it in writing.

defs.def_en: If you confirm an arrangement or appointment, you say that it is definite, usually in a letter or on the telephone.

defs.def_cn: 为…施坚振礼（或坚信礼）(从而正式成为基督教会的成员)

ext.ext_cn: 他领受了坚振礼，成为英国国教会的一员。
ext.ext_en: He was confirmed as a member of the Church of England.

defs.def_en: If someone is confirmed, they are formally accepted as a member of a Christian church during a ceremony in which they say they believe what the church teaches.

defs.def_cn: 使坚定，使确信(自己的决定、信仰或观点)

ext.ext_cn: 这使我更加坚定了不做修女的决心。
ext.ext_en: It has confirmed me in my decision not to become a nun.

defs.def_en: If something confirms you in your decision, belief, or opinion, it makes you think that you are definitely right.

defs.def_cn: 加强，巩固(地位、角色或权力)

ext.ext_cn: 威廉姆斯巩固了自己世界头号斯诺克选手的地位。
ext.ext_en: Williams has confirmed his position as the world's number one snooker player.

defs.def_en: If someone confirms their position, role, or power, they do something to make their power, position, or role stronger or more definite.

defs.def_cn: 巩固，确保(某人的名声、角色或地位)

ext.ext_cn: 他的新角色会确保他跻身我们的一流演员之列。
ext.ext_en: His new role could confirm him as one of our leading actors.

defs.def_en: If something confirms you as something, it shows that you definitely deserve a name, role, or position.

ext.ext_cn: 我昏了过去，他使我恢复了知觉。
ext.ext_en: I'd passed out and he'd brought me round.

defs.def_en: If you bring someone around when they are unconscious, you make them become conscious again.

ext.ext_cn: 我们将尽己所能说服议会支持我们的观点。
ext.ext_en: We will do everything we can to bring parliament round to our point of view.

defs.def_en: If you bring someone around, you cause them to change their opinion about something so that they agree with you.

defs.def_cn: （足球、橄榄球、篮球比赛等的）中场休息
defs.def_en: Half-time is the short period of time between the two parts of a sporting event such as a football, rugby, or basketball game, when the players have a short rest.
A depth charge is a type of bomb which explodes under water and which is used especially to destroy enemy submarines.

ext.ext_cn: 双方同意组建一个委员会来调查那些索赔要求。
ext.ext_en: The two sides agreed to set up a commission to investigate claims...

ext.ext_cn: 召开会议讨论妇女关心的问题的组织
ext.ext_en: ...an organization which sets up meetings about issues of interest to women...

defs.def_en: If you set something up, you create or arrange it.

ext.ext_cn: 贝弗里奇宣布他打算竞选议员。
ext.ext_en: Beveridge announced his intention of standing for parliament...

ext.ext_cn: 我的打算是继续呆在岗位上,直到选出继任者。
ext.ext_en: It is my intention to remain in my position until a successor is elected...

defs.def_en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

defs.def_cn: 不想/很想;不打算/一心打算

ext.ext_cn: 我们无意购买美国喷气式飞机。
ext.ext_en: We have no intention of buying American jets...

ext.ext_cn: 他身边的人都确信他打算继续留任，直到 7 年任期期满。
ext.ext_en: Those close to him are convinced that he has every intention of staying on until the end of his seven-year term.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have no intention of doing something, you are emphasizing that you are not going to do it. If you say that you have every intention of doing something, you are emphasizing that you intend to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 虚实结合
ext.ext_en: ...an admixture of fact and fantasy.

defs.def_en: Admixture means the same as mixture .
Someone's stepfather is the man who has married their mother after the death or divorce of their father.

ext.ext_cn: 历史意识也显示了一种连贯性。
ext.ext_en: A historical awareness also imparts a sense of continuity.

ext.ext_cn: 为保证特技飞行过程中燃油的持续供应而专门设计的油箱
ext.ext_en: ...a tank designed to ensure continuity of fuel supply during aerobatics.

defs.def_en: Continuity is the fact that something continues to happen or exist, with no great changes or interruptions.

ext.ext_cn: 我和沃尔特参照着一盘原始电影胶片录像带来检查镜头的剪辑和灯光。
ext.ext_en: Walt and I referred to a video cassette of the original footage to check continuity and lighting.

defs.def_en: In film making, continuity is the way that things filmed at different times are made to look as if they were filmed at the same time or in the right sequence.
A streaker is someone who runs quickly through a public place wearing no clothes, as a joke.

ext.ext_cn: 反对党领袖本周恳求总统打破僵局。
ext.ext_en: Opposition leaders this week implored the president to break the deadlock...

ext.ext_cn: 她哀求他说：“求你告诉我该怎么办！”
ext.ext_en: 'Tell me what to do!' she implored him.

defs.def_en: If you implore someone to do something, you ask them to do it in a forceful, emotional way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (声音或动作)震颤的，颤抖的，打战的；（笑容）怯生生的，不自然的

ext.ext_cn: 她在椅子上坐立不安，轻颤着深吸了一口气。
ext.ext_en: She fidgeted in her chair as she took a deep, tremulous breath.

defs.def_en: If someone's voice, smile, or actions are tremulous, they are unsteady because the person is uncertain, afraid, or upset.

defs.def_cn: 同public company（缩略形式为plc，用于公司名称后）
defs.def_en: A public limited company is the same as a public company. The abbreviation plc is used after such companies' names.
A coach station is an area or a building which coaches leave from or arrive at on regular journeys.

ext.ext_cn: 你很快就会体会到身体更健康带来的好处。
ext.ext_en: You'll soon begin to reap the benefits of being fitter...

ext.ext_cn: 我们从事这一行不是为了获得巨大的经济回报。
ext.ext_en: We are not in this to reap immense financial rewards.

defs.def_en: If you reap the benefits or the rewards of something, you enjoy the good things that happen as a result of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这幅画描绘了一群农民收获水果和蔬菜的情景。
ext.ext_en: The painting depicted a group of peasants reaping a harvest of fruits and vegetables.

defs.def_en: To reap crops means to cut them down and gather them.

defs.def_cn: （信仰的）拥护者;重视(某种观念）的人

ext.ext_cn: 福特非常重视礼仪，喜欢把事情办得妥帖得体。
ext.ext_en: Ford was a respecter of proprieties and liked to see things done properly.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a respecter of something such as a belief or idea, you mean that they behave in a way which shows that they have a high opinion of it.

ext.ext_cn: 为了杜绝舞弊行为，英国体育委员会丝毫不会顾及个人的隐私或职业。
ext.ext_en: The British Sports Council is no respecter of privacy or careers as it tries to stamp out the cheats...

ext.ext_cn: 不管什么年龄都有可能遭遇意外事故和突发疾病。
ext.ext_en: Accidents and sudden illnesses are no respecters of age.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is no respecter of a rule or tradition, you mean that the rule or tradition is not important to them.

ext.ext_cn: 细铜丝
ext.ext_en: ...fine copper wire.

ext.ext_cn: 探测墙内电线、管道和木材的小装置
ext.ext_en: ...gadgets which detect electrical wires, pipes and timbers in walls.

defs.def_en: A wire is a long thin piece of metal that is used to fasten things or to carry electric current.

ext.ext_cn: 我把通到他办公室的电话线拔掉了。
ext.ext_en: I ripped out the telephone wire that ran through to his office.

ext.ext_cn: 头顶上方电线的电压
ext.ext_en: ...the voltage of the overhead wires.

defs.def_en: A wire is a cable which carries power or signals from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 她学着自己给房子布线走管
ext.ext_en: ...learning to wire and plumb the house herself...

ext.ext_cn: 电灯布线要安全稳妥。
ext.ext_en: Lamps should be safely wired...

ext.ext_en: They arranged to wire the money from the United States...

ext.ext_en: Negotiators again worked right down to the wire to reach an agreement.

ext.ext_en: It's a long way to go for two people in their seventies.

A job seeker is an unemployed person who is trying to get a job.

A blackbird is a common North American bird. The male has black feathers and often a red patch on its wings.

ext.ext_cn: 只要他一走进房间，她仍旧会起鸡皮疙瘩。
ext.ext_en: She still got goose bumps whenever he walked into the room.

defs.def_en: If you get goose bumps, the hairs on your skin stand up so that it is covered with tiny bumps. You get goose bumps when you are cold, frightened, or excited.

ext.ext_cn: 他的运动衫已破烂不堪。

defs.def_en: Clothes that are in tatters are badly torn in several places, so that pieces can easily come off.

defs.def_cn: (计划、心情等)千疮百孔，历经挫折，不堪一击

ext.ext_cn: 经济已千疮百孔。
ext.ext_en: The economy is in tatters.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a plan or a person's state of mind is in tatters, you are emphasizing that it is weak, has suffered a lot of damage, and is likely to fail completely.

ext.ext_cn: 氯气被广泛用于杀菌。
ext.ext_en: Chlorine is widely used to kill germs.

ext.ext_cn: 夺去了无数生命的细菌
ext.ext_en: ...a germ that destroyed hundreds of millions of lives.

defs.def_en: A germ is a very small organism that causes disease.

ext.ext_cn: 罗斯玛丽心里萌生了一个念头。
ext.ext_en: The germ of an idea took root in Rosemary's mind...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一本书的源起。
ext.ext_en: This was the germ of a book.

defs.def_en: The germ of something such as an idea is something which developed or might develop into that thing.

defs.def_cn: （在性问题上的）大惊小怪，过分正经；谈性色变
defs.def_en: Prudery is prudish behaviour or attitudes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的房间里堆满了水果、鲜花及礼品等。
ext.ext_en: His room was jam-packed with fruit, flowers, gifts etc.

defs.def_en: If somewhere is jam-packed, it is so full of people or things that there is no room for any more.

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆承认玩电子游戏有时会使他无心做作业。
ext.ext_en: Tom admits that playing video games sometimes distracts him from his homework...

ext.ext_cn: 不要让自己被流行的理论分散了注意力。
ext.ext_en: Don't let yourself be distracted by fashionable theories...

defs.def_en: If something distracts you or your attention from something, it takes your attention away from it.
Mayonnaise is a thick pale sauce made from egg yolks and oil. It is put on salad.

ext.ext_cn: 下着暴雨，刮着时速高达70英里的强风的恶劣天气
ext.ext_en: ...bad weather with heavy rain and gale-force winds of up to seventy miles per hour.

defs.def_en: A gale-force wind is a very strong wind.
Someone who has a pot belly has a round, fat stomach which sticks out, either because they eat or drink too much, or because they have had very little to eat for some time.
A plum is a small, sweet fruit with a smooth red or yellow skin and a stone in the middle.

ext.ext_cn: 紫红色的丝绸
ext.ext_en: ...plum-coloured silk.

defs.def_en: Something that is plum or plum-coloured is a dark reddish-purple colour.

defs.def_cn: （工作、合同、角色等）令人垂涎的，吸引人的

ext.ext_cn: 劳拉在一家时尚画廊找到了份美差。
ext.ext_en: Laura landed a plum job with a smart art gallery.

defs.def_en: A plum job, contract, or role is a very good one that a lot of people would like.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 反应敏捷的;易流露感情的;易受影响的

ext.ext_cn: 哈丽雅特是一个随和机灵的小女孩。
ext.ext_en: Harriet was an easy, responsive little girl...

ext.ext_cn: 这个班上课反应积极，想法层出不穷。
ext.ext_en: This is a responsive class with plenty of ideas...

defs.def_en: A responsive person is quick to react to people or events and to show emotions such as pleasure and affection.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 反应迅速的;积极响应的

ext.ext_cn: 选举在即，你的下院议员应当对你的要求作出积极的回应。
ext.ext_en: With an election coming soon, your MP should be very responsive to your request.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is responsive, they react quickly and favourably.

ext.ext_cn: 听到有人喊它的名字，这条狗摆了摆尾巴。
ext.ext_en: At hearing his name spoken, the dog gave a responsive wag of his tail.

defs.def_en: A responsive action is made as a reaction to something that has just been said or done.

defs.def_cn: （政府官员或商务人士的）公款旅游

ext.ext_cn: 他经常和朋友们到一些具有异国情调的地方公款游玩。
ext.ext_en: He took frequent junkets with friends to exotic locales.

defs.def_en: If you describe a trip or visit by an official or businessman as a junket, you disapprove of it because it is expensive, unnecessary, and often has been paid for with public money.

defs.def_cn: 具有一应特征的;完全的;彻底的;绝对的

ext.ext_cn: 他们真正擅长的是纯粹的摇滚乐。
ext.ext_en: What they were really good at was full-on rock'n'roll...

ext.ext_cn: 该联盟将面临政府毫无保留的抨击。
ext.ext_en: The coalition will face a full-on attack from the Government.

defs.def_en: Full-on is used to describe things or activities that have all the characteristics of their type, or are done in the strongest or most extreme way possible.

ext.ext_cn: 回头一想，我惊异地发现这一切的安排竟是如此简单。
ext.ext_en: Looking back, I am staggered how easily it was all arranged.

defs.def_en: If you look back, you think about things that happened in the past.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们有3个可爱的孩子。
ext.ext_en: We have three adorable children.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is adorable, you are emphasizing that they are very attractive and you feel great affection for them.

ext.ext_cn: 据估计，每逢周日开门营业的店铺有6万家，通过钻法律漏洞躲避检控。
ext.ext_en: It is estimated that 60,000 shops open every Sunday and trade by exploiting some loophole in the law to avoid prosecution.

defs.def_en: A loophole in the law is a small mistake which allows people to do something that would otherwise be illegal.

defs.def_cn: 送葬者，哀悼者(尤指逝者的亲戚、朋友)
defs.def_en: A mourner is a person who attends a funeral, especially as a relative or friend of the dead person.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 肯定的;有把握的;毫无疑问的

ext.ext_cn: 她坚信自己会出人头地。
ext.ext_en: She's absolutely certain she's going to make it in the world...

ext.ext_cn: 我们不敢肯定阑尾是否已经破裂。
ext.ext_en: We are not certain whether the appendix had already burst or not...

defs.def_en: If you are certain about something, you firmly believe it is true and have no doubt about it. If you are not certain about something, you do not have definite knowledge about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 然而，这项计划一定会遭到渔民领袖的反对。
ext.ext_en: However, the scheme is certain to meet opposition from fishermen's leaders...

ext.ext_cn: 即便来自阵线的候选人获胜，他们能否接受他还说不准。
ext.ext_en: It's not certain they'll accept the Front's candidate if he wins...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is certain to happen, you mean that it will definitely happen.

ext.ext_cn: 有一点可以肯定，那就是双方都非常尊重对方。
ext.ext_en: One thing is certain, both have the utmost respect for each other...

ext.ext_cn: 罗德尼肯定是头天到的。
ext.ext_en: It is certain that Rodney arrived the previous day.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is certain, you firmly believe that it is true, or have definite knowledge about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我确定他去过那儿4次。
ext.ext_en: He had been there four times to my certain knowledge.

defs.def_en: If you have certain knowledge, you know that a particular thing is true.

ext.ext_cn: 她不知道他何时走，就连他到底走不走都说不准。
ext.ext_en: She couldn't know what time he'd go, or even for certain that he'd go at all...

ext.ext_cn: 希尔得弄个清楚。
ext.ext_en: Hill had to find out for certain.

defs.def_en: If you know something for certain, you have no doubt at all about it.

ext.ext_cn: 首先，他们得确保他们能获得足够的养老金。
ext.ext_en: Firstly, they must make certain that their pension needs are adequately catered for...

ext.ext_cn: 为确保万无一失，一架警用直升机一直在空中警戒。
ext.ext_en: To make extra certain, a police helicopter kept watch from the skies.

defs.def_en: If you make certain that something is the way you want or expect it to be, you take action to ensure that it is.

ext.ext_cn: 一定有人会说：“我怎么跟你说来着！”
ext.ext_en: There will be certain people who'll say 'I told you so!'...

ext.ext_cn: 你欠某人一笔钱。
ext.ext_en: You owe a certain person a sum of money...

defs.def_en: You use certain to indicate that you are referring to one particular thing, person, or group, although you are not saying exactly which it is.

ext.ext_cn: 他们将不得不彻底放弃某些研究。
ext.ext_en: They'll have to give up completely on certain of their studies.

defs.def_en: When you refer to certain of a group of people or things, you are referring to some particular members of that group.

defs.def_cn: (用于人名前，表示不认识或了解很少)某个

ext.ext_cn: 她设法安排他们藏在一个叫博迪恩的神父家里。
ext.ext_en: She managed to arrange for them to be hidden in the house of a certain Father Boduen.

defs.def_en: You can use a certain before the name of a person in order to indicate that you do not know the person or anything else about them.

defs.def_cn: (品质、特点等)一定程度上的，有点儿

ext.ext_cn: 那就是为什么他感到有些痛苦。
ext.ext_en: That was the very reason why he felt a certain bitterness...

ext.ext_cn: 有些士兵有点儿不耐烦。
ext.ext_en: There is a certain impatience among some of the soldiers...

defs.def_en: You use a certain to indicate that something such as a quality or condition exists, and often to suggest that it is not great in amount or degree.

ext.ext_cn: 后女权主义时代
ext.ext_en: ...the post-feminist age.

defs.def_en: Post-feminist people and attitudes accept some of the ideas of feminism, but reject others.

ext.ext_cn: 舞蹈演员们觉得自己的作品赋予人力量，后女权主义者则认为那完全是荒诞不经。
ext.ext_en: The dancers say they find their work empowering, and post-feminists think that's just fantastic.

defs.def_en: A post-feminist is someone who accepts some of the ideas of feminism, but rejects others.

defs.def_cn: 来家小住的客人;暂住客人
defs.def_en: A house guest is a person who is staying at someone's house for a period of time.
A walrus is a large, fat animal which lives in the sea. It has two long teeth called tusks that point downwards.

ext.ext_cn: 一棵灌木树
ext.ext_en: ...a shrubby tree.

defs.def_en: A shrubby plant is like a shrub.

ext.ext_cn: 柠檬酸
ext.ext_en: ...citric acid...

ext.ext_en: Acids in the stomach destroy the virus.
