defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些灌木必须生长在不含石灰的酸性土壤环境。
ext.ext_en: These shrubs must have an acid, lime-free soil.

defs.def_en: An acid substance contains acid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些酒可能喝着比较冲并且有股酸味。
ext.ext_en: These wines may taste rather hard and somewhat acid.

defs.def_en: An acid fruit or drink has a sour or sharp taste.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这部当代风尚喜剧杂糅了悲悯的情怀和尖酸的幽默。
ext.ext_en: This comedy of contemporary manners is told with compassion and acid humour.

defs.def_en: An acid remark, or acid humour, is very unkind or critical.
The drug LSD is sometimes referred to as acid .

ext.ext_cn: “我完全信任你，”他说。
ext.ext_en: 'I trust you completely,' he said...

ext.ext_cn: 他确实泛泛提过总统不可信赖。
ext.ext_en: He did argue in a general way that the president can't be trusted.

defs.def_en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

ext.ext_cn: 他毁了我，也摧毁了我对男人的信任。
ext.ext_en: He destroyed me and my trust in men...

ext.ext_cn: 你已经背叛了他们的信任。
ext.ext_en: You've betrayed their trust...

defs.def_en: Your trust in someone is your belief that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

ext.ext_cn: 那就是为什么我必须得相信你会保守这个秘密的原因。
ext.ext_en: That's why I must trust you to keep this secret...

ext.ext_cn: 他们争辩说不能相信执政党会监督解除自身的权力。
ext.ext_en: They argued that the ruling party could not be trusted to oversee its own removal from power.

defs.def_en: If you trust someone to do something, you believe that they will do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这样会使上级不敢对你委以重任。
ext.ext_en: This could make your superiors hesitate to trust you with major responsibilities...

ext.ext_cn: 我愿把终身托付给他。
ext.ext_en: I'd trust him with my life.

defs.def_en: If you trust someone with something important or valuable, you allow them to look after it or deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 她只点点头，没有说话。
ext.ext_en: She nodded, not trusting her own voice...

ext.ext_cn: 首先，他不相信自己能站起来。
ext.ext_en: For one thing, he didn't trust his legs to hold him up...

defs.def_en: If you do not trust something, you feel that it is not safe or reliable.

ext.ext_cn: 杰克养大了两个了不起的孩子，我相信他的判断。
ext.ext_en: Jake has raised two smashing kids and I trust his judgement…

ext.ext_cn: 我自责，而且今后再也不能相信自己的直觉了。
ext.ext_en: I blame myself and will never be able to trust my instinct again.

defs.def_en: If you trust someone's judgment or advice, you believe that it is good or right.

defs.def_cn: 希望…是对的;估计…是对的

ext.ext_cn: 我想你会一抓住机会就诚恳道歉的。
ext.ext_en: I trust you will take the earliest opportunity to make a full apology...

ext.ext_cn: 我们估计他和他的部门正在考虑我们的建议。
ext.ext_en: We trust that he and his department are considering our suggestion.

defs.def_en: If you say you trust that something is true, you mean you hope and expect that it is true.

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名牧师，他相信上帝是用一生去传教的。
ext.ext_en: He was a pastor who trusted in the Lord who lived to preach.

ext.ext_cn: 不要盲目信任任何政府官员的诚意。
ext.ext_en: Don't blindly trust in the good faith of any government official.

defs.def_en: If you trust in someone or something, you believe strongly in them, and do not doubt their powers or their good intentions.

ext.ext_cn: 你也可以设立财产信托，这样孩子们只有达到一定年龄才能动用遗产。
ext.ext_en: You could also set up a trust so the children can't spend any inheritance until they are a certain age…

ext.ext_cn: 钱会交付他人托管，直到她年满 18 岁。
ext.ext_en: The money will be put in trust until she is 18.

defs.def_en: A trust is a financial arrangement in which a group of people or an organization keeps and invests money for someone.

defs.def_cn: 信托基金机构;财产托管机构

ext.ext_cn: 他已设立了两个慈善信托机构。
ext.ext_en: He had set up two charitable trusts...

ext.ext_cn: 国家生育信托基金会最近对 1,271 位新妈妈做了一个调查。
ext.ext_en: The National Childbirth Trust has recently conducted a survey of 1,271 new mothers.

defs.def_en: A trust is a group of people or an organization that has control of an amount of money or property and invests it on behalf of other people or as a charity.

defs.def_cn: 公立医院(由政府资助、独立经营)

ext.ext_cn: 帕丁顿的圣玛丽医院这周成为政府资助的独立经营医院。
ext.ext_en: St Mary's Hospital in Paddington became a self-governing trust this week.

defs.def_en: In Britain, a trust or a trust hospital is a public hospital that receives its funding directly from the national government. It has its own board of governors and is not controlled by the local health authority.

ext.ext_cn: 大不列颠图书馆为国家保存被托管藏书。
ext.ext_en: The British Library holds its collection in trust for the nation...

ext.ext_cn: 艺术品交由我们托管一生。
ext.ext_en: Works of art are in trust to us during our lifetime.

defs.def_en: If something valuable is kept in trust, it is held and protected by a group of people or an organization on behalf of other people.

ext.ext_cn: 他坚持认为那些指控不属实，因此我也完全相信他。
ext.ext_en: He was adamant that the allegations were untrue, so I took him on trust.

defs.def_en: If you take something on trust after having heard or read it, you believe it completely without checking it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的话音低得几乎听不见。
ext.ext_en: His voice was almost inaudible...

ext.ext_cn: 动物可以听到人类所听不到的高频声音。
ext.ext_en: Animals are able to hear high-pitched sounds that are inaudible to humans.

defs.def_en: If a sound is inaudible, you are unable to hear it.

defs.def_cn: 你,您,你们（可用于名词前指定谈话对象）

ext.ext_cn: 看到你穿过房间时，我就知道我以前曾经见过你。
ext.ext_en: When I saw you across the room I knew I'd met you before...

ext.ext_cn: 你们两个似乎与我大不一样。
ext.ext_en: You two seem very different to me...

defs.def_en: A speaker or writer uses you to refer to the person or people that they are talking or writing to. It is possible to use you before a noun to make it clear which group of people you are talking to.

defs.def_cn: （用于口语和非正式书面语中表示泛指）你，任何人

ext.ext_cn: 取得好的结果会给人以信心。
ext.ext_en: Getting good results gives you confidence...

ext.ext_cn: 那时候，你只能听命于人。
ext.ext_en: In those days you did what you were told.

defs.def_en: In spoken English and informal written English, you is sometimes used to refer to people in general.

defs.def_cn: （某些方言中指两个或多个人时有时用yous代替you）你们

ext.ext_cn: “你们两个别指望拿到工钱，”他说。“你们太懒了！”
ext.ext_en: 'Yous two are no 'gettin' paid,' he said. 'Ye're too lazy!'

defs.def_en: In some dialects of English, yous is sometimes used instead of 'you' when talking to two or more people.

ext.ext_cn: 对一些主要病虫害有抵御能力的作物
ext.ext_en: ...crops which are resistant to some of the major insect pests and diseases...

ext.ext_cn: 一种叫玉米根虫的害虫每年会让粮食减产10%。
ext.ext_en: Each year ten percent of the crop is lost to a pest called corn rootworm.

defs.def_en: Pests are insects or small animals which damage crops or food supplies.

ext.ext_cn: 他爬桌子，拽我的头发，总之是个讨厌鬼。
ext.ext_en: He climbed on the table, pulled my hair, and was generally a pest.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone, especially a child, as a pest if they keep bothering you.

defs.def_cn: （英国或爱尔兰官方地图绘制机构绘制的）地形测绘详图
defs.def_en: An Ordnance Survey map is a detailed map produced by the British or Irish government map-making organization.

ext.ext_cn: 他因犯严重伤害罪而被判入狱。
ext.ext_en: He was jailed for aggravated assault.

defs.def_en: Aggravated is used to describe a serious crime which involves violence.
Slaw is a salad of chopped raw carrot, onions, cabbage and other vegetables in mayonnaise.

defs.def_cn: 先生（尤用于称呼男性客人）

ext.ext_cn: 嘿，谢谢，先生。
ext.ext_en: Hey, thanks, guv.

defs.def_en: Guv is sometimes used to address a man, especially a customer or someone you are doing a service for.
A bathmat is a mat which you stand on while you dry yourself after getting out of the bath.

ext.ext_cn: 她直奔西蒙的房间，敲了敲门。
ext.ext_en: She went directly to Simon's apartment and knocked on the door...

ext.ext_cn: 8点钟敲我的窗，我会准备好的。
ext.ext_en: Knock at my window at eight o'clock and I'll be ready...

defs.def_en: If you knock on something such as a door or window, you hit it, usually several times, to attract someone's attention.

defs.def_cn: 碰，撞；（尤指）碰倒，撞倒，敲动

ext.ext_cn: 她不小心把架子上的茶叶罐碰了下来。
ext.ext_en: She accidentally knocked the tea tin off the shelf...

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿被从他父亲的怀中撞落。
ext.ext_en: The baby was knocked from his father's arms...

defs.def_en: If you knock something, you touch or hit it roughly, especially so that it falls or moves.

ext.ext_cn: 他们决定把两间屋子打通连成一间。
ext.ext_en: They decided to knock the two rooms into one...

ext.ext_cn: 这个宽敞的厨房是由3个小屋子打通连成的。
ext.ext_en: The spacious kitchen was achieved by knocking together three small rooms.

defs.def_en: If someone knocks two rooms or buildings into one, or knocks them together, they make them form one room or building by removing a wall.

defs.def_cn: 把…撞击到（某个位置）；把…打成（某种状态）

ext.ext_cn: 第3波浪太大了，把我打了回去。
ext.ext_en: The third wave was so strong it knocked me backwards...

ext.ext_cn: 他们被打倒在地并被抢走了钱包。
ext.ext_en: They were knocked to the ground and robbed of their wallets...

defs.def_en: To knock someone into a particular position or condition means to hit them very hard so that they fall over or become unconscious.

defs.def_cn: 使失去（某种品质或特征）

ext.ext_cn: 有关他与那位女演员有关系的传闻使他很不开心。
ext.ext_en: The stories of his links with the actress had knocked the fun out of him...

ext.ext_cn: 在他们参加培训之初，很多人还只是对环球航行抱有天真的想法。我们很快便使他们消除了那种想法。
ext.ext_en: When they first joined for training many were starry eyed about just sailing around the world. We soon knocked that out of them...

defs.def_en: To knock a particular quality or characteristic out of someone means to make them lose it.

ext.ext_cn: 他那辆旧卡车一边冒着烟一边哐里哐啷地沿路向前驶去，直到驶出了视线。
ext.ext_en: His old truck, knocking and smoking, pulled down the road and out of sight.

defs.def_en: If something knocks, it makes a repeated sharp banging noise.

ext.ext_cn: 我不是批评他们：想不想做那件事取决于他们。
ext.ext_en: I'm not knocking them: if they want to do it, it's up to them...

ext.ext_cn: 绝不要挑剔包机航班；他们使精打细算的乘客能够去往世界各地。
ext.ext_en: Never knock charter flights; they are opening up the world for budget-conscious travellers.

defs.def_en: If you knock something or someone, you criticize them and say unpleasant things about them.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的话是对我自信心的一次重大打击。
ext.ext_en: What they said was a real knock to my self-confidence...

ext.ext_cn: 在过去的两年间，艺术品市场遭受了严重的打击。
ext.ext_en: The art market has suffered some severe knocks during the past two years.

defs.def_en: If someone receives a knock, they have an unpleasant experience which prevents them from achieving something or which causes them to change their attitudes or plans.

defs.def_cn: （尤指以相貌）给…留下深刻印象，使…倾倒

ext.ext_cn: 魅惑彩妆最好留到你竭力想把所有人都迷倒的时候。
ext.ext_en: Glamorous make-up is best reserved for days when you want to go all out to knock  'em dead.

defs.def_en: To knock them dead means to impress people a great deal, especially with your appearance.

ext.ext_cn: 别闹了！
ext.ext_en: Will you just knock it off!

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to knock it off, you are telling them to stop doing something that is annoying you.

ext.ext_cn: 那个年轻人，同样地，让预言说中了。
ext.ext_en: The youth, too, fulfilled the prophecy.

ext.ext_cn: 《圣经》中的预言
ext.ext_en: ...Biblical prophecy.

defs.def_en: A prophecy is a statement in which someone says they strongly believe that a particular thing will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 你认为他们有可能击败澳大利亚吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you think they have a chance of beating Australia?...

ext.ext_cn: 这个组合获胜的希望很大。
ext.ext_en: This partnership has a good chance of success...

defs.def_en: If there is a chance of something happening, it is possible that it will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 选举委员会宣布，所有有资格者都将获得投票的机会。
ext.ext_en: The electoral council announced that all eligible people would get a chance to vote...

ext.ext_cn: 多数去避难的医生永远没有机会在英国医院行医。
ext.ext_en: Most refugee doctors never get the chance to practice medicine in British hospitals...

defs.def_en: If you have a chance to do something, you have the opportunity to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 偶遇
ext.ext_en: ...a chance meeting.

ext.ext_cn: 时运不济的倒霉蛋
ext.ext_en: ...a victim of chance and circumstance.

defs.def_en: A chance meeting or event is one that is not planned or expected.

ext.ext_cn: 我邂逅了一个人，后来发现他是个极为与众不同的家伙。
ext.ext_en: A man I chanced to meet proved to be a most unusual character...

ext.ext_cn: 就在那时，我恰好环顾了下四周。
ext.ext_en: It was just then that I chanced to look round.

defs.def_en: If you chance to do something or chance on something, you do it or find it although you had not planned or tried to.

ext.ext_cn: 安迪知道有风险，我不敢相信他竟然甘冒其险。
ext.ext_en: Andy knew the risks. I cannot believe he would have chanced it...

ext.ext_cn: 他认定，没有刺客会冒险混在人群里开枪。
ext.ext_en: He decided no assassin would chance a shot from amongst that crowd.

defs.def_en: If you chance something, you do it even though there is a risk that you may not succeed or that something bad may happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他曾邂逅过莫德先生。
ext.ext_en: He had met Mr Maude by chance.

defs.def_en: Something that happens by chance was not planned by anyone.

defs.def_cn: (用以询问某事是否属实)会不会，可能

ext.ext_cn: 他们有可能是亲戚吗？
ext.ext_en: Are they by any chance related?

defs.def_en: You can use by any chance when you are asking questions in order to find out whether something that you think might be true is actually true.

ext.ext_cn: 我理科很棒，所以很有机会拿高分。
ext.ext_en: Being very good at science subjects, I stood a good chance of gaining high grades...

ext.ext_cn: 两人都不被认为有任何可能从他手中夺得领导权。
ext.ext_en: Neither is seen as standing any chance of snatching the leadership from him.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone stands a chance of achieving something, you mean that they are likely to achieve it. If you say that someone doesn't stand a chance of achieving something, you mean that they cannot possibly achieve it.

ext.ext_cn: 在英国度假，只有赌天气了。
ext.ext_en: You take a chance on the weather if you holiday in the UK...

ext.ext_cn: 从那时起，他们就不再冒险了。
ext.ext_en: From then on, they were taking no chances...

defs.def_en: When you take a chance, you try to do something although there is a large risk of danger or failure.

ext.ext_cn: 一个小组中聪明伶俐的中产阶级家庭的孩子占大多数
ext.ext_en: ...a preponderance of bright, middle-class children in one group.

ext.ext_cn: 以小企业为主的巴斯地区
ext.ext_en: ...Bath, with its preponderance of small businesses.

defs.def_en: If there is a preponderance of one type of person or thing in a group, there is more of that type than of any other.

ext.ext_cn: 浅铜色的叶子
ext.ext_en: ...pale coppery leaves.

defs.def_en: A coppery colour is reddish-brown like copper.

defs.def_cn: 加尔文教派的;加尔文主义的

ext.ext_cn: 加尔文教派的教义
ext.ext_en: ...Calvinist doctrine.

ext.ext_cn: 加尔文式的职业道德
ext.ext_en: ...the Calvinist work ethic.

defs.def_en: Calvinist means belonging or relating to a strict Protestant church started by John Calvin.
A Calvinist is a member of the Calvinist church.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 善于发明的;有创造才能的

ext.ext_cn: 斯特罗曼永远求新的舞蹈设计
ext.ext_en: ...Stroman's ceaselessly inventive choreography...

ext.ext_cn: 它激发我在自己烹饪时更富创造性。
ext.ext_en: It inspired me to be more inventive with my own cooking.

defs.def_en: An inventive person is good at inventing things or has clever and original ideas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 报酬过高的；工资过高的

ext.ext_cn: 报酬高得离谱的公司律师
ext.ext_en: ...grossly overpaid corporate lawyers.

defs.def_en: See also:overpay;If you say that someone is overpaid, you mean that you think they are paid more than they deserve for the work they do.

defs.def_cn: 她自己（指女性或雌性动物）

ext.ext_cn: 她走出了房间。
ext.ext_en: She let herself out of the room...

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮弗相信，当自己有钱养活自己时，就会搬出去单住。
ext.ext_en: Jennifer believes she will move out on her own when she is financially able to support herself...

defs.def_en: You use herself to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal.

defs.def_cn: （书面英语中泛指人）他自己，她自己（有些人不喜欢这种用法，更倾向于使用 himself or herself 或 themselves）

ext.ext_cn: 她认为自己对这些行动不负有责任，别人怎么还能因此而责备她呢？
ext.ext_en: How can anyone blame her for actions for which she feels herself to be in no way responsible?

defs.def_en: In written English, herself is sometimes used to refer to a person without saying whether that person is a man or a woman. Some people dislike this use and prefer to use 'himself or herself' or 'themselves'.

defs.def_cn: （指国家或民族）她自己，它自己

ext.ext_cn: 不列颠民族的梦想开始渐渐幻灭。
ext.ext_en: Britain's dream of herself began to fade.

defs.def_en: Herself is sometimes used to refer to a country or nation.

defs.def_cn: （指汽车、机器或船）她自己，它自己

ext.ext_cn: 船随着海水的起伏节奏时起时落。
ext.ext_en: The ship adjusted herself to the roll and rhythm of the sea.

defs.def_en: People sometimes use herself to refer to a car, machine, or ship.

defs.def_cn: （用于加强语气，有时代替 her 作动词或介词的宾语）她本人，它本身

ext.ext_cn: 她本人是如此美丽。
ext.ext_en: She's so beautiful herself...

ext.ext_cn: 有人想过咨询一下贝唐本人的意见吗？
ext.ext_en: Has anyone thought of consulting Bethan herself?...

defs.def_en: You use herself to emphasize the person or thing that you are referring to. Herself is sometimes used instead of 'her' as the object of a verb or preposition.

ext.ext_cn: 很抱歉我没有赶上乔迁聚会。
ext.ext_en: I'm so sorry I missed the housewarming.

ext.ext_cn: 庆祝乔迁聚会
ext.ext_en: ...a housewarming party.

defs.def_en: A housewarming is a party that you give for friends when you have just moved to a new house.

ext.ext_cn: 铺位下方有成排的储物柜可以存放东西。
ext.ext_en: Stowage is provided in lined lockers beneath the berths.

defs.def_en: Stowage is the space that is available for stowing things on a ship or aeroplane.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 想到可能为英格兰首屈一指的球队效力，我非常兴奋。
ext.ext_en: I'm very excited about the possibility of playing for England's first team...

ext.ext_cn: 去签文件时我非常兴奋，几乎无法写字。
ext.ext_en: I was so excited when I went to sign the paperwork I could hardly write.

defs.def_en: If you are excited, you are so happy that you cannot relax, especially because you are thinking about something pleasant that is going to happen to you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我认为大可不必为通货膨胀而心烦。
ext.ext_en: I don't think there's any reason to get excited about inflation...

ext.ext_cn: 有人气愤地喊道马路被士兵封锁了。
ext.ext_en: Excited voices were shouting that the road was blocked by soldiers.

defs.def_en: If you are excited, you are very worried or angry about something, and so you are very alert and cannot relax.
A gladiolus is a type of plant with long thin leaves and several large brightly coloured flowers.

defs.def_cn: （be的过去时复数和第二人称单数形式）
defs.def_en: Were is the plural and the second person singular of the past tense of be.

defs.def_cn: （有时代替 was，用于条件从句、动词 wish 之后等）

ext.ext_cn: 他告诉一名外交官，如果允许他保留一个有争议油田的一部分，他可能就会撤兵。
ext.ext_en: He told a diplomat that he might withdraw if he were allowed to keep part of a disputed oil field...

ext.ext_cn: 他信奉无神论就像信仰一种新的宗教。
ext.ext_en: He believes in atheism as though it were a new religion.

defs.def_en: Were is sometimes used instead of 'was' in certain structures, for example in conditional clauses or after the verb 'wish'.
A soliloquy is a speech in a play in which an actor or actress speaks to himself or herself and to the audience, rather than to another actor.
A bassoon is a large musical instrument that is shaped like a tube and played by blowing into a curved metal pipe.

defs.def_cn: 把(织物或面团)压出褶皱

ext.ext_cn: 把边缘折起来以便封紧。
ext.ext_en: Crimp the edges to seal them tightly.

defs.def_en: If you crimp something such as a piece of fabric or pastry, you make small folds in it.

ext.ext_cn: 美元最近的坚挺影响了国外的销量和利润。
ext.ext_en: The dollar's recent strength is crimping overseas sales and profits.

defs.def_en: To crimp something means to restrict or reduce it.
A roof garden is a garden on the flat roof of a building.

defs.def_cn: 带风帽的夹克;短风雨衣
defs.def_en: An anorak is a warm waterproof jacket, usually with a hood.

defs.def_cn: （对某种爱好过于痴迷以至于乏味的）…痴，…呆，狂热爱好者

ext.ext_cn: 他真是个闷蛋。
ext.ext_en: He's such an anorak...

ext.ext_cn: 电脑游戏是电脑迷的大爱。
ext.ext_en: Computer games are the ultimate anorak pursuit.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as an anorak, you mean that they are boring because they devote too much time to a particular hobby or interest.

ext.ext_cn: 通过与我们本地的赤鹿杂交，梅花鹿的基因库已经发生了改变。
ext.ext_en: By cross-breeding with our native red deer, the sika deer have affected the gene pool...

ext.ext_cn: 不幸的是，将它与其他土豆品种杂交的尝试均告失败。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately attempts to crossbreed it with other potatoes have been unsuccessful...

defs.def_en: If one species of animal or plant cross-breeds with another, they reproduce, and new or different animals or plants are produced. You can also say that someone cross-breeds something such as an animal or plant.
A cross-breed is an animal that is the result of cross-breeding.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (声音或动作)震颤的，颤抖的，打战的；（笑容）怯生生的，不自然的

ext.ext_cn: 她在椅子上坐立不安，轻颤着深吸了一口气。
ext.ext_en: She fidgeted in her chair as she took a deep, tremulous breath.

defs.def_en: If someone's voice, smile, or actions are tremulous, they are unsteady because the person is uncertain, afraid, or upset.

ext.ext_cn: 我还在空军部队服役，不过几个月之后我就要复员了。
ext.ext_en: I'm still in the air force, though I'll be demobbed in a couple of months.

ext.ext_cn: 为退伍士兵安排住房并对他们进行再培训
ext.ext_en: ...housing and retraining demobbed soldiers.

defs.def_en: When soldiers are demobbed, they are released from the armed forces.

ext.ext_cn: 我已发誓效忠皇室。
ext.ext_en: I have sworn an oath of loyalty to the monarchy...

ext.ext_cn: 此举被视为是对在本月初一场军营叛变中表现忠心不贰的军队的奖赏。
ext.ext_en: This is seen as a reward for the army's loyalty during a barracks revolt earlier this month.

defs.def_en: Loyalty is the quality of staying firm in your friendship or support for someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 她对马内家族忠心耿耿。
ext.ext_en: She had developed strong loyalties to the Manet family.

defs.def_en: Loyalties are feelings of friendship, support, or duty towards someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 前几天我们接待了几位来自瑞士的参观者。
ext.ext_en: The other day we had some visitors from Switzerland...

ext.ext_cn: 求学时我住在牛津，但常常去贝尔法斯特。
ext.ext_en: As a student I lived in Oxford but was a frequent visitor to Belfast.

defs.def_en: A visitor is someone who is visiting a person or place.

ext.ext_cn: 今天国内所有机场都运转正常。
ext.ext_en: All airports in the country are working normally today...

ext.ext_cn: 社会进步通常是斗争和冲突的结果。
ext.ext_en: Social progress is normally a matter of struggles and conflicts...

defs.def_en: If you say that something normally happens or that you normally do a particular thing, you mean that it is what usually happens or what you usually do.

ext.ext_cn: 她显然还会照吃不误，然后把自己吃到恶心。
ext.ext_en: She would apparently eat normally and then make herself sick.

ext.ext_cn: 血液未能正常凝结
ext.ext_en: ...failure of the blood to clot normally.

defs.def_en: If you do something normally, you do it in the usual or conventional way.
A card table is a small light table which can be folded up and which is sometimes used for playing games of cards on.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (地方或天气)沉闷的，令人不快的

ext.ext_cn: 厨房既潮湿又阴暗。
ext.ext_en: The kitchen was dank and cheerless.

ext.ext_cn: 阴冷、惨淡的一天
ext.ext_en: ...a bleak, cheerless day.

defs.def_en: Cheerless places or weather are dull and depressing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我很喜欢迈克尔。
ext.ext_en: I am very fond of Michael...

ext.ext_cn: 她尤其偏爱一个名叫贝齐的小女孩。
ext.ext_en: She was especially fond of a little girl named Betsy.

defs.def_en: If you are fond of someone, you feel affection for them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 慈父
ext.ext_en: ...a fond father...

ext.ext_cn: 他给了他一个深情的微笑。
ext.ext_en: He gave him a fond smile.

defs.def_en: You use fond to describe people or their behaviour when they show affection.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他爱吃橘子酱。
ext.ext_en: He was fond of marmalade...

ext.ext_cn: 她喜欢收集稀罕少见的地毯。
ext.ext_en: She is fond of collecting rare carpets.

defs.def_en: If you are fond of something, you like it or you like doing it very much.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我对乡村生活有着十分美好的回忆。
ext.ext_en: I have very fond memories of living in our village.

defs.def_en: If you have fond memories of someone or something, you remember them with pleasure.

defs.def_cn: (期望、愿望、信仰等)愚蠢的，不切实际的

ext.ext_cn: 我痴想着希望我们可以在圣诞假期前准备就绪。
ext.ext_en: My fond hope is that we will be ready by Christmastime.

defs.def_en: You use fond to describe hopes, wishes, or beliefs which you think are foolish because they seem unlikely to be fulfilled.

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰克目前定居柏林。
ext.ext_en: Frank is currently domiciled in Berlin.

defs.def_en: If you are domiciled in a particular place, you live there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (个人或国家)持中立态度的，中立的，无倾向性的

ext.ext_cn: 我们在中立地区会面吧。
ext.ext_en: Let's meet on neutral territory...

ext.ext_cn: 那些先前决定在争斗中保持中立的人现在发现他们需要表明立场了。
ext.ext_en: Those who had decided to remain neutral in the struggle now found themselves required to take sides.

defs.def_en: If a person or country adopts a neutral position or remains neutral, they do not support anyone in a disagreement, war, or contest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (声音或表情)不露声色的，平淡的

ext.ext_cn: 伊莎贝尔放下杂志，平静地说道：“亲爱的，你来得太晚了。”
ext.ext_en: Isabel put her magazine down and said in a neutral voice, 'You're very late, darling.'...

ext.ext_cn: 他告诉了她这次死亡事故的情况，描述经过时尽可能不掺杂个人感情。
ext.ext_en: He told her about the death, describing the events in as neutral a manner as he could.

defs.def_en: If someone speaks in a neutral voice or if the expression on their face is neutral, they do not show what they are thinking or feeling.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 五分之三的受访者觉得该预算案不好不坏，他们的境况不会好到哪里去。
ext.ext_en: Three in every five interviewed felt that the Budget was neutral and they would be no better off...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is neutral, you mean that it does not have any effect on other things because it lacks any significant qualities of its own, or it is an equal balance of two or more different qualities, amounts, or ideas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (话语)模糊的，中立的，不含褒贬义的

ext.ext_cn: 双方已达成协议，在提及对方时使用中性的词语，避免有争议的字眼。
ext.ext_en: Both sides had agreed to use neutral terms in their references to each other, avoiding controversial ones...

ext.ext_cn: 他抛开了自己准备好的、被认为是中立的证词。
ext.ext_en: He had departed from his prepared testimony, which was considered to be neutral.

defs.def_en: If someone uses neutral language, they choose words which do not indicate that they approve or disapprove of something.

ext.ext_cn: 格雷厄姆把货车挂到空挡，自己跳到马路上。
ext.ext_en: Graham put the van in neutral and jumped out into the road.

defs.def_en: Neutral is the position between the gears of a vehicle such as a car, in which the gears are not connected to the engine.

In an electrical device or system, the neutral wire is one of the three wires needed to complete the circuit so that the current can flow. The other two wires are called the earth wire and the live or positive wire.

ext.ext_cn: 陆地在地平线处变成了一片浅灰。
ext.ext_en: At the horizon the land mass becomes a continuous pale neutral grey...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽建议用浅色唇线笔。
ext.ext_en: Mary suggests using a neutral lip pencil.

defs.def_en: Neutral is used to describe things that have a pale colour such as cream or grey, or that have no colour at all.

ext.ext_cn: 中子就是原子核里不带电的粒子。
ext.ext_en: A neutron is simply a neutral particle in the nucleus of an atom.

defs.def_en: In physics, neutral is used to describe things such as atomic particles that have neither a positive nor a negative charge.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 纯水是中性的，酸碱度为7。
ext.ext_en: Pure water is neutral with a pH of 7.

defs.def_en: In chemistry, neutral is used to describe things that are neither acid nor alkaline.

defs.def_cn: 当天往返的短途旅客;（通常指）一日游游客
defs.def_en: A day-tripper is someone who goes on a day trip.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 细雨蒙蒙的;下毛毛雨的

ext.ext_cn: 一个阴沉的下着细雨的午后
ext.ext_en: ...a dull, drizzly afternoon...

ext.ext_cn: 我们离开时天阴沉沉地飘着小雨。
ext.ext_en: It was dull and slightly drizzly as we left.

defs.def_en: When the weather is drizzly, the sky is dull and grey and it rains steadily but not very hard.

ext.ext_cn: 他要么是闷死的，要么是冻死的。
ext.ext_en: He either suffocated, or froze to death...

ext.ext_cn: 他们睡觉时窒息而死。
ext.ext_en: They were suffocated as they slept.

defs.def_en: If someone suffocates or is suffocated, they die because there is no air for them to breathe.

ext.ext_cn: 这样好些了，我刚才在那个小房间里快闷死了。
ext.ext_en: That's better. I was suffocating in that cell of a room...

ext.ext_cn: 房间里密不透风，憋得她喘不上气来。
ext.ext_en: The airlessness of the room suffocated her.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are suffocating or that something is suffocating you, you mean that you feel very uncomfortable because there is not enough fresh air and it is difficult to breathe.

ext.ext_cn: 和父母呆了几个星期后，她感到自己毫无自由。
ext.ext_en: After a few weeks with her parents, she felt she was suffocating...

ext.ext_cn: 总督的计划可能会造成上百万人失业，并束缚经济发展。
ext.ext_en: The governor's proposals would actually cost millions of jobs and suffocate the economy.

defs.def_en: You say that a person or thing is suffocating, or that something is suffocating them, when the situation that they are in does not allow them to act freely or to develop.

ext.ext_cn: 一直由我支付账单，维持家庭生计。
ext.ext_en: I've always paid the bills and been the breadwinner.

defs.def_en: The breadwinner in a family is the person in it who earns the money that the family needs for essential things.

ext.ext_cn: 霍奇金森理学士
ext.ext_en: ... J. Hodgkison BSc.

defs.def_en: BSc is written after someone's name to indicate that they have a BSc.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 地球上最不适合居住的地区
ext.ext_en: ...the earth's most inhospitable regions.

ext.ext_cn: 岛上不适合居住的气候
ext.ext_en: ...the island's inhospitable climate.

defs.def_en: An inhospitable place is unpleasant to live in.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If someone is inhospitable, they do not make people welcome when they visit.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 长满茧子的粗手指
ext.ext_en: ...blunt, calloused fingers.

defs.def_en: A foot or hand that is calloused is covered in calluses.
Viols are a family of musical instruments that are made of wood and have six strings. You play the viol with a bow while sitting down.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不方便的;打扰的;令人为难的

ext.ext_cn: 你能 10 点半来吗？我知道你不方便,但是我必须见你。
ext.ext_en: Can you come at 10.30? I know it's inconvenient for you, but I must see you...

ext.ext_cn: 等这么久很麻烦。
ext.ext_en: It's very inconvenient to have to wait so long...

defs.def_en: Something that is inconvenient causes problems or difficulties for someone.

ext.ext_cn: 大使呼吁美国在政策上作出改变。
ext.ext_en: The ambassador appealed for a change in US policy...

ext.ext_cn: 现在需要的是建筑师态度的转变。
ext.ext_en: What is needed is a change of attitude on the part of architects...

defs.def_en: See also:sea change;If there is a change in something, it becomes different.

ext.ext_cn: 这是个复杂的体系，不过确实有所改变。
ext.ext_en: It is a complex system, but it certainly makes a change...

ext.ext_cn: 你想不想改变一下？
ext.ext_en: Do you feel like you could do with a change?

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a change or makes a change, you mean that it is enjoyable because it is different from what you are used to.

ext.ext_cn: 他的医生加大了剂量，不过没有换药。
ext.ext_en: His doctor increased the dosage but did not change to a different medication...

ext.ext_cn: 他原打算投反对票，后来改为弃权了。
ext.ext_en: He changed from voting against to abstaining.

defs.def_en: If you change from one thing to another, you stop using or doing the first one and start using or doing the second.

ext.ext_cn: 我们正努力探寻并理解气候是如何变化的。
ext.ext_en: We are trying to detect and understand how the climates change...

ext.ext_cn: 在工会办公室，情绪慢慢从顺从转变成愤怒。
ext.ext_en: In the union office, the mood gradually changed from resignation to rage...

defs.def_en: When something changes or when you change it, it becomes different.

ext.ext_cn: 我花80英镑让人把我车上的收音机修了修，可我敢肯定，他们只是换了根保险丝。
ext.ext_en: I paid £80 to have my car radio fixed and I bet all they did was change a fuse...

ext.ext_cn: 你要是想换个医生，办法有两个。
ext.ext_en: If you want to change your doctor there are two ways of doing it.

defs.def_en: To change something means to replace it with something new or different.

ext.ext_cn: 本仅仅换了件衬衫。
ext.ext_en: Ben had merely changed his shirt...

ext.ext_cn: 他们准许她冲个澡，换套衣裳。
ext.ext_en: They had allowed her to shower and change...

defs.def_en: When you change your clothes or change, you take some or all of your clothes off and put on different ones.  →see usage note at:wear

ext.ext_cn: 他往包里塞了几套换洗衣服。
ext.ext_en: He stuffed a bag with a few changes of clothing.

defs.def_en: A change of clothes is an extra set of clothes that you take with you when you go to stay somewhere or to take part in an activity.

ext.ext_cn: 换了床单，我很快就能睡着。
ext.ext_en: After changing the bed, I would fall asleep quickly...

ext.ext_cn: 我今天把你的床单换了。
ext.ext_en: I changed the sheets on your bed today.

defs.def_en: When you change a bed or change the sheets, you take off the dirty sheets and put on clean ones.

ext.ext_cn: 她批评我不会给他喂奶、不会换尿布。
ext.ext_en: She criticizes me for the way I feed or change him...

ext.ext_cn: 他的尿布该换了。
ext.ext_en: He needs his nappy changed.

defs.def_en: When you change a baby or change its nappy or diaper, you take off the dirty one and put on a clean one.

defs.def_cn: 转乘，换乘(交通工具);转车;转机

ext.ext_cn: 我在格拉斯哥改乘去格里诺克的火车。
ext.ext_en: At Glasgow I changed trains for Greenock...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在汉诺威站被赶下火车，只好在那儿转车。
ext.ext_en: We were turned off the train at Hanover, where we had to change.

defs.def_en: When you change buses, trains, or planes or change, you get off one bus, train, or plane and get on to another in order to continue your journey.

ext.ext_cn: 司机试图换挡，接着突然转向。
ext.ext_en: The driver tried to change gear, then swerved...

ext.ext_cn: 他一边换挡，一边抬眼看后视镜。
ext.ext_en: He looked up into the mirror as he changed through his gears.

defs.def_en: When you change gear or change into another gear, you move the gear lever on a car, bicycle, or other vehicle in order to use a different gear.

ext.ext_cn: “您的找头。”——“多谢。”
ext.ext_en: 'There's your change.' — 'Thanks very much.'...

ext.ext_cn: 他们告诉店主不用找钱了。
ext.ext_en: They told the shopkeeper to keep the change.

defs.def_en: Your change is the money that you receive when you pay for something with more money than it costs because you do not have exactly the right amount of money.

ext.ext_cn: 窃贼洗劫了办公室，拿走了一口袋散币。
ext.ext_en: Thieves ransacked the office, taking a sack of loose change...

ext.ext_cn: 店里的人不肯给他换硬币打电话，除非他买点什么。
ext.ext_en: The man in the store won't give him change for the phone unless he buys something.

defs.def_en: See also:small change;Change is coins, rather than paper money.

ext.ext_cn: 快递员能破开10英镑的纸币。
ext.ext_en: The courier had change for a £10 note.

defs.def_en: If you have change for larger notes, bills, or coins, you have the same value in smaller notes, bills, or coins, which you can give to someone in exchange.

ext.ext_cn: 每次到银行换币都会要求付1%到2%的手续费。
ext.ext_en: You can expect to pay the bank a fee of around 1% to 2% every time you change money...

ext.ext_cn: 如果经常旅行，找一家能直接兑换外币的旅行社。
ext.ext_en: If you travel frequently, find an agency that will change one foreign currency directly into another.

defs.def_en: When you change money, you exchange it for the same amount of money in a different currency, or in smaller notes, bills, or coins.

ext.ext_cn: 现在换我来问你一个问题吧。
ext.ext_en: Now let me ask you a question, for a change...

ext.ext_cn: 莉兹舒服放松地倚在座位上，享受着换别人开车的惬意。
ext.ext_en: Liz settled back in her seat, comfortably relaxed, enjoying being driven for a change.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are doing something or something is happening for a change, you mean that you do not usually do it or it does not usually happen, and you are happy to be doing it or that it is happening.

defs.def_cn: （英国为成绩优异的11至18岁学生设立的）文法学校

ext.ext_cn: 他在利兹文法学校念3年级。
ext.ext_en: He is in the third year at Leeds Grammar School.

defs.def_en: A grammar school is a school in Britain for children aged between eleven and eighteen who have a high academic ability.

ext.ext_cn: 雷电交加，大雨倾盆。
ext.ext_en: There was frequent thunder and lightning, and torrential rain.

ext.ext_cn: 远处一声炸雷
ext.ext_en: ...a distant clap of thunder.

defs.def_en: Thunder is the loud noise that you hear from the sky after a flash of lightning, especially during a storm.

ext.ext_cn: 天色阴沉，一丝风也没有。或许马上就要打雷。
ext.ext_en: The day was heavy and still. It would probably thunder later.

defs.def_en: When it thunders, a loud noise comes from the sky after a flash of lightning.

ext.ext_cn: 海水拍打礁石的咆哮声似乎要淹没一切思绪。
ext.ext_en: The thunder of the sea on the rocks seemed to blank out other thoughts...

ext.ext_cn: 哈利勒听到了雪崩传来的轰隆声。
ext.ext_en: Khalil heard the thunder of an avalanche.

defs.def_en: The thunder of something that is moving or making a sound is the loud deep noise it makes.

ext.ext_cn: 马群轰隆隆地从谷底奔跑而过。
ext.ext_en: The horses thundered across the valley floor...

ext.ext_cn: 尼科利尼一步两个台阶地噔噔跑上楼。
ext.ext_en: Niccolini was thundering up the stairs, taking them two at a time...

defs.def_en: If something or someone thunders somewhere, they move there quickly and with a lot of noise.

ext.ext_cn: 她听到雾中传来隆隆的枪炮声。
ext.ext_en: She heard the sound of the guns thundering in the fog.

ext.ext_cn: 雷鸣般的掌声
ext.ext_en: ...thundering applause.

defs.def_en: If something thunders, it makes a very loud noise, usually continuously.

ext.ext_cn: “那是你的钱。快去要！”她生气地大喊。
ext.ext_en: 'It's your money. Ask for it!' she thundered...

ext.ext_cn: 检察官朝拿破仑望去，等他大声抗议。
ext.ext_en: The Prosecutor looked toward Napoleon, waiting for him to thunder an objection.

defs.def_en: If you thunder something, you say it loudly and forcefully, especially because you are angry.

ext.ext_cn: 他无意让外交大臣抢他的风头。
ext.ext_en: He had no intention of letting the Foreign Secretary steal any of his thunder.

defs.def_en: If you steal someone's thunder, you get the attention or praise that they thought they would get, usually by saying or doing what they had intended to say or do.

defs.def_cn: (疾病等)严重损害健康(或身体)的

ext.ext_cn: 关节炎和风湿病是会严重损害身体健康的主要疾病。
ext.ext_en: Arthritis and rheumatism are prominent crippling diseases...

ext.ext_cn: 他们俩都感到髋部疼痛难忍。
ext.ext_en: They both suffered from crippling pains in their hips.

defs.def_en: A crippling illness or  disability is one that severely damages your health or your body.

ext.ext_cn: 高昂的资金成本严重影响了美国的很多小型高科技公司。
ext.ext_en: The high cost of capital has a crippling effect on many small American high-tech firms...

ext.ext_cn: 该群岛上的美国部队受到了严重打击。
ext.ext_en: The American military presence on the islands had suffered a crippling blow.

defs.def_en: If you say that an action, policy, or situation has a crippling effect on something, you mean it has a very serious, harmful effect.

ext.ext_cn: 电话铃声吓了他一跳。
ext.ext_en: The telephone startled him...

ext.ext_cn: 对不起，我不是故意想吓你一跳的。
ext.ext_en: Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you...

defs.def_en: If something sudden and unexpected startles you, it surprises and frightens you slightly.
A red-headed person is a person whose hair is between red and brown in colour.
The decathlon is a competition in which athletes compete in 10 different sporting events.

defs.def_cn: 夸夸其谈;哗众取宠的空谈；蠢话

ext.ext_cn: 这是政客们宣扬过无数次的废话。
ext.ext_en: This is the claptrap that politicians have peddled many times before.

defs.def_en: If you describe something that someone says as claptrap, you mean that it is stupid or foolish although it may sound important.
A spelunker is someone who goes into underground caves and tunnels as a leisure activity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 断断续续地有汽车驶过。
ext.ext_en: Cars passed at irregular intervals...

ext.ext_cn: 她因心律不齐被送往医院。
ext.ext_en: She was taken to hospital suffering from an irregular heartbeat...

defs.def_en: If events or actions occur at irregular intervals, the periods of time between them are of different lengths.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不规则的;不平整的;不直的

ext.ext_cn: 油漆一片片地慢慢变干了。
ext.ext_en: The paint was drying in irregular patches...

ext.ext_cn: 他牙齿长得不好，参差不齐而且有些发黄。
ext.ext_en: He had bad teeth, irregular and discolored.

defs.def_en: Something that is irregular is not smooth or straight, or does not form a regular pattern.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为)欺骗性的，不正当的,不合常规的

ext.ext_cn: 被控有违规商业行为的部长
ext.ext_en: ...the minister accused of irregular business practices...

ext.ext_cn: “利奥,你能为我做这件事吗？这是唯一的办法了。”——“拉尔夫,这么做是很不正当的。”
ext.ext_en: 'Will you do this for me, Leo? It's the only way.' — 'It's highly irregular, Ralph.'

defs.def_en: Irregular behaviour is dishonest or not in accordance with the normal rules.

defs.def_cn: (动词、名词或形容词)不规则的
defs.def_en: An irregular verb, noun, or adjective has different forms from most other verbs, nouns, or adjectives in the language. For example, 'break' is an irregular verb because its past form is 'broke', not 'breaked'.

ext.ext_cn: 至少有 17 个非正规军部队参战。
ext.ext_en: At least 17 different irregular units are engaged in the war.

defs.def_en: Irregular troops do not belong to an official national army.
A hiker is a person who is going for a long walk in the countryside for pleasure.

defs.def_cn: (遏制身体正常功能的)遏抑剂

ext.ext_cn: 她服用德克塞根来抑制食欲的短暂时期
ext.ext_en: ...the brief period in her life when she took Dexedrine as an appetite suppressant.

defs.def_en: A suppressant is a drug which is used to stop one of the natural functions of the body.
A waveband is a group of radio waves of similar length which are used for particular types of radio communication.

ext.ext_cn: 私有化使许多公司大赚了一笔。
ext.ext_en: The privatisation allowed companies to rake in huge profits.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is raking in money, you mean that they are making a lot of money very easily, more easily than you think they should.

ext.ext_cn: 这一争论可能会危及提议进行的和平谈判。
ext.ext_en: The debate could endanger the proposed peace talks.

ext.ext_cn: 猞猁、狼等濒危物种
ext.ext_en: ...endangered species such as lynx and wolf.

defs.def_en: To endanger something or someone means to put them in a situation where they might be harmed or destroyed completely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 能让皮肤永葆柔嫩光滑的营养霜
ext.ext_en: ...a rich cream that keeps skin soft and smooth.

ext.ext_cn: 如玻璃般光滑的表面
ext.ext_en: ...a smooth surface such as glass...

defs.def_en: A smooth surface has no roughness, lumps, or holes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 稠度均匀的;细腻匀和的;不结块的

ext.ext_cn: 一直搅拌，直至混合物变得均匀细腻。
ext.ext_en: Continue whisking until the mixture looks smooth and creamy...

ext.ext_cn: 加入少量的凉水，将玉米粉搅拌成均匀的糊状。
ext.ext_en: Blend the cornflour to a smooth paste with a little cold water.

defs.def_en: A smooth liquid or mixture has been mixed well so that it has no lumps.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (葡萄酒、威士忌或咖啡等)醇和的，不烈的，不苦的

ext.ext_cn: 这样一来，威士忌就醇和多了。
ext.ext_en: This makes the whiskeys much smoother.

defs.def_en: If you describe a drink such as wine, whisky, or coffee as smooth, you mean that it is not bitter and is pleasant to drink.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个练习一气呵成。
ext.ext_en: This exercise is done in one smooth motion.

ext.ext_cn: 树干流畅的曲线
ext.ext_en: ...the smooth curve of the trunk.

defs.def_en: A smooth line or movement has no sudden breaks or changes in direction or speed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (骑马、航行等)平稳的，顺顺当当的

ext.ext_cn: 这个主动悬架系统使汽车行驶起来非常平稳。
ext.ext_en: The active suspension system gives the car a very smooth ride.

defs.def_en: A smooth ride, flight, or sea crossing is very comfortable because there are no unpleasant movements.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 迅速而顺利地过渡到民主体制的政治希望破灭了。
ext.ext_en: Political hopes for a swift and smooth transition to democracy have been dashed...

ext.ext_cn: 一些问题搅乱了这一事件的顺利进展。
ext.ext_en: A number of problems marred the smooth running of this event.

defs.def_en: You use smooth to describe something that is going well and is free of problems or trouble.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 故作殷勤有礼的;精明圆滑的;圆通的

ext.ext_cn: 12 名特别漂亮精明的青年男子被选为参加决赛的选手。
ext.ext_en: Twelve extremely good-looking, smooth young men have been picked as finalists...

ext.ext_cn: 在人们关于政治人物的记忆里，他是最精明、可能也是最有权势的参谋长。
ext.ext_en: He was the smoothest and probably the most powerful chief of staff in political memory.

defs.def_en: If you describe a man as smooth, you mean that he is extremely smart, confident, and polite, often in a way that you find rather unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 她站起身，抹平了裙子。
ext.ext_en: She stood up and smoothed down her frock...

ext.ext_cn: 巴多抚了抚胡子。
ext.ext_en: Bardo smoothed his moustache.

defs.def_en: If you smooth something, you move your hands over its surface to make it smooth and flat.

ext.ext_cn: 她在他的肩胛骨上抹了乳液。
ext.ext_en: She smoothed the lotion across his shoulder blades...

ext.ext_cn: 他用手把她脸上的头发捋到脑后。
ext.ext_en: His fingers smoothed the hair back from her face.

defs.def_en: If you smooth something somewhere, you use your hands to spread it there.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的会谈旨在为缔结限制远程武器条约铺平道路。
ext.ext_en: Their talks were aimed at smoothing the path towards a treaty to limit long-range weapons.

defs.def_en: If you smooth the path or smooth the way towards something, you make it easier or more likely to happen.

defs.def_cn: 既能享乐也能吃苦;是好是歹一起承受
defs.def_en: If you say that someone has to take the rough with the smooth, you mean that they have to accept the unpleasant or difficult things that happen as well as the pleasant things.

defs.def_cn: 古钢琴，击弦古钢琴(尤用于18世纪)
defs.def_en: A clavichord is a musical instrument rather like a small piano. When you press the keys, small pieces of metal come up and hit the strings. Clavichords were especially popular during the eighteenth century.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我常在外交聚会上听到的那种虚与委蛇的腔调
ext.ext_en: ...the kind of unctuous tone that I've heard often at diplomatic parties.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as unctuous, you are critical of them because they seem to be full of praise, kindness, or interest, but are obviously insincere.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （食品、饮料）含乳脂的，油的，油腻的

ext.ext_cn: 鹅油最肥美，不过你也可以用鸡油。
ext.ext_en: Goose fat gives the most unctuous flavour but you can use chicken fat.

defs.def_en: If you describe food or drink as unctuous, you mean that it is creamy or oily.

ext.ext_cn: 这个异教团体的领袖把自己看作救世主一般的人物。
ext.ext_en: The cult leader saw himself as a Messianic figure.

defs.def_en: Messianic means relating to the belief that a divine being has been born, or will be born, who will change the world.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 1794年法国大革命中失败的激进分子最先预见到了社会会发生根本改变。
ext.ext_en: The defeated radicals of the French Revolution were the first to have this messianic vision in 1794.

defs.def_en: Messianic means relating to the belief that there will be a complete change in the social order in a country or in the world.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有精神病的;心理不正常的;精神紊乱的

ext.ext_cn: 致力于帮助情绪严重失常的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...working with severely emotionally disturbed children...

ext.ext_cn: 该杀人犯显然精神失常。
ext.ext_en: The murderer was apparently mentally disturbed.

defs.def_en: A disturbed person is very upset emotionally, and often needs special care or treatment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 心神不安的;心烦意乱的;烦恼的

ext.ext_cn: 医生们焦虑不安，因为患者中有不到30%为女性。
ext.ext_en: Doctors were disturbed that less than 30 percent of the patients were women...

ext.ext_cn: 当我听说选拔委员会原本决定不派英国队去参加今年的锦标赛时，我觉得很不安。
ext.ext_en: I was disturbed to hear that the selection committee originally decided not to send a British team to this year's Championships.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone is disturbed when they are very worried or anxious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不幸的;多灾多难的;动荡不安的

ext.ext_cn: 这些动荡不安的岁月
ext.ext_en: ...these disturbed times.

ext.ext_cn: 有不幸经历的女性
ext.ext_en: ...women from disturbed backgrounds.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation or period of time as disturbed, you mean that it is unhappy and full of problems.

defs.def_cn: （与数字连用构成表示概数的形容词，尤其用于指人的年龄）表示“…几”，“…多”
defs.def_en: -something is combined with numbers such as twenty and thirty to form adjectives which indicate an approximate amount, especially someone's age. For example, if you say that someone is thirty-something, you mean they are between thirty and forty years old.

defs.def_cn: （二十）几岁的人；（三十）多岁的人

ext.ext_cn: 绝大多数二十多岁的美国人不读政治方面的东西。
ext.ext_en: Most American twenty-somethings do not read about politics.

defs.def_en: People of a similar age range are sometimes referred to as, for example, twenty-somethings or thirty-somethings .

defs.def_cn: 一味赶时髦而不顾衣着是否得体者;时尚牺牲品

ext.ext_cn: 我不是一味赶时髦的人，我只穿适合自己的服装。
ext.ext_en: I'm not a fashion victim; I stick to what suits me.

defs.def_en: A fashion victim is someone who thinks that being fashionable is more important than looking nice, and as a result often wears very fashionable clothes that do not suit them or that make them look silly.

ext.ext_cn: 开场的一幕是他们在庆祝自己突然从战争中解脱了出来。
ext.ext_en: The opening scene shows them celebrating their sudden deliverance from war...

ext.ext_cn: 她向上帝祈祷以求得拯救。
ext.ext_en: She prayed to God for deliverance.

defs.def_en: Deliverance is rescue from imprisonment, danger, or evil.

ext.ext_cn: 她故意用那样的语气说话，就是想彻底结束这个话题。
ext.ext_en: The tone of her voice  was designed to stamp on this topic of conversation once and for all...

ext.ext_cn: 阿莫里夫人的故事不得不被打断，否则她会讲个没完。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Amaury's story had to be stamped on before it got any further...

defs.def_en: If someone stamps on a dishonest or undesirable activity, they act immediately to stop it happening or spreading.

defs.def_cn: 无意的;并非故意的;因疏忽造成的

ext.ext_cn: 政府声称那是因疏忽造成的过失。
ext.ext_en: The government has said it was an inadvertent error.

defs.def_en: An inadvertent action is one that you do without realizing what you are doing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个胸有成竹、充满信心的谈判者。
ext.ext_en: He's a self-assured, confident negotiator.

defs.def_en: Someone who is self-assured shows confidence in what they say and do because they are sure of their own abilities.

defs.def_cn: 剥去，褪下（紧身的衣服，尤指把里面外翻）

ext.ext_cn: 她褪下手套。
ext.ext_en: She peeled off her gloves.

defs.def_en: If you peel off a tight piece of clothing, you take it off, especially by turning it inside out.
A local authority is an organization that is officially responsible for all the public services and facilities in a particular area.

ext.ext_cn: 谢谢你的来信，并允许我阐明目前的立场。
ext.ext_en: Thank you for writing and allowing me to clarify the present position...

ext.ext_cn: 一位银行发言人未能把情况解释清楚。
ext.ext_en: A bank spokesman was unable to clarify the situation.

defs.def_en: To clarify something means to make it easier to understand, usually by explaining it in more detail.

defs.def_cn: (隔音或防寒的)空心墙，夹层墙

ext.ext_cn: 空心墙隔音材料
ext.ext_en: ...cavity wall insulation.

defs.def_en: A cavity wall is a wall that consists of two separate walls with a space between them. Cavity walls help to keep out noise and cold.

ext.ext_cn: 那个工地的白垩底土
ext.ext_en: ...the chalk subsoil on the site.

defs.def_en: The subsoil is a layer of earth that is just below the surface soil but above hard rock.

defs.def_cn: 保加利亚的；保加利亚人的；保加利亚语的
defs.def_en: Bulgarian means belonging or relating to Bulgaria, or to its people, language, or culture.

defs.def_cn: 保加利亚人；保加利亚裔人
defs.def_en: A Bulgarian is a Bulgarian citizen, or a person of Bulgarian origin.
Bulgarian is the main language spoken by people who live in Bulgaria.

defs.def_cn: (英国政府每年批给王室的)王室年俸

ext.ext_cn: 她的王室年俸有13万英镑。
ext.ext_en: She gets £130,000 from the Civil List.

defs.def_en: The Civil List is money paid by the state every year to members of the British Royal Family to cover their living expenses.

ext.ext_cn: 主要反对党都抵制此次选举。
ext.ext_en: The main opposition parties are boycotting the elections.

ext.ext_cn: 反对党领袖已号召人们拒绝投票。
ext.ext_en: Opposition leaders had called for a boycott of the vote.

defs.def_en: If a country, group, or person boycotts a country, organization, or activity, they refuse to be involved with it in any way because they disapprove of it.

ext.ext_cn: 它的订阅人数上升到了15,000多人。
ext.ext_en: Its readership has grown to over 15,000 subscribers...

ext.ext_cn: 新的版式会疏远上了年纪的读者群，并且也不会吸引年轻读者。
ext.ext_en: A new format would alienate its ageing readership without attracting young readers.

defs.def_en: The readership of a book, newspaper, or magazine is the number or type of people who read it.
In Britain, a readership is the post of a reader at a university.

ext.ext_cn: 她对 20 世纪 60 年代的理想主义一直心怀崇敬。
ext.ext_en: She never lost her respect for the idealism of the 1960s...

ext.ext_cn: 这次经历锻炼了他们的理想主义。
ext.ext_en: This experience has tempered their idealism.

defs.def_en: Idealism is the beliefs and behaviour of someone who has ideals and who tries to base their behaviour on these ideals.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如果你没有钱，就寸步难行。
ext.ext_en: If you don't have money, you're powerless.

ext.ext_cn: 致使女性一直贫穷且没有权力的政治经济体系
ext.ext_en: ...political and economic systems that keep women poor and powerless.

defs.def_en: Someone who is powerless is unable to control or influence events.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 每天都有人被杀，而我却无力阻止。
ext.ext_en: People are being murdered every day and I am powerless to stop it...

ext.ext_cn: 他表示同情，但爱莫能助。
ext.ext_en: He was sympathetic, but powerless to help.

defs.def_en: If you are powerless to do something, you are completely unable to do it.

defs.def_cn: (电话或电气设备)无电源线的，无塞绳的

ext.ext_cn: 女服务员拿着无绳电话向皮科内走来。
ext.ext_en: The waitress approached Picone with a cordless phone.

ext.ext_cn: 无塞绳式电钻
ext.ext_en: ...the cordless drill.

defs.def_en: A cordless telephone or piece of electric equipment is operated by a battery fitted inside it and is not connected to the electricity mains.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 因为两颗子弹都击中了心脏,所以死亡是瞬间发生的。
ext.ext_en: Death was instantaneous because both bullets hit the heart.

defs.def_en: Something that is instantaneous happens immediately and very quickly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (I had 的常用口语形式，尤用于 had 作助动词时 ）

ext.ext_cn: 我完全确信自己以前曾见过她。
ext.ext_en: I felt absolutely certain that I'd seen her before.

defs.def_en: I'd is the usual spoken form of 'I had', especially when 'had' is an auxiliary verb.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有些问题我想问一下。
ext.ext_en: There are some questions I'd like to ask...

ext.ext_cn: 他知道无论他做过什么我都爱他。
ext.ext_en: He knows I'd love him whatever he did.

defs.def_en: I'd is the usual spoken form of 'I would'.
Incest is the crime of two members of the same family having sexual intercourse, for example a father and daughter, or a brother and sister.

ext.ext_cn: 他拿出了一份手写的名单，上面列有 9 个他应该要杀死的人。
ext.ext_en: He produced a handwritten list of nine men he was supposed to kill...

ext.ext_cn: 在接下来的几年里，政府开支应该会下降，而不是上升。
ext.ext_en: Public spending is supposed to fall, not rise, in the next few years.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is supposed to happen, you mean that it is planned or expected. Sometimes this use suggests that the thing does not really happen in this way.

defs.def_cn: 本应该(发生而没有发生)

ext.ext_cn: 他本来要乘最后一班汽车回卑尔根，但当然，这起事故使他没能回去。
ext.ext_en: He was supposed to go back to Bergen on the last bus, but of course the accident prevented him...

ext.ext_cn: 第一场辩论本该在星期二就举行了。
ext.ext_en: The first debate was supposed to have been held on Tuesday.

defs.def_en: If something was supposed to happen, it was planned or intended to happen, but did not in fact happen.

ext.ext_cn: 《鞭笞刑具》还从未发表过，但大家认为它是一首真正的好诗。
ext.ext_en: 'The Whipping Block' has never been published, but it's supposed to be a really good poem...

ext.ext_cn: “校长不能见客，”他的儿子应该已经这样告知了一位一大清早就来了的拜访者。
ext.ext_en: 'The President cannot be disturbed,' his son is supposed to have told an early morning caller.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is supposed to be true, you mean that people say it is true but you do not know for certain that it is true.

ext.ext_cn: 你还是我朋友呢！
ext.ext_en: You're supposed to be my friend!...

ext.ext_cn: 别跟我说我到底该作何感想。
ext.ext_en: Don't try to tell me what I'm supposed to be feeling...

defs.def_en: You can use 'be supposed to' to express annoyance at someone's ideas, or because something is not happening in the proper way.

defs.def_cn: 误以为的;误信的;所谓的

ext.ext_cn: 并非所有当地的政权都愿意接受与英国贸易的所谓好处。
ext.ext_en: Not all indigenous regimes were willing to accept the supposed benefits of British trade.

ext.ext_cn: 当法治被其所谓的捍卫者破坏时
ext.ext_en: ...when the rule of law is broken by its supposed guardians.

defs.def_en: You can use supposed to suggest that something that people talk about or believe in may not in fact exist, happen, or be as it is described.

defs.def_cn: （用作捆绑或装饰的）缎带，丝带

ext.ext_cn: 她用一根桃色缎带把头发扎在脑后。
ext.ext_en: She had tied back her hair with a peach satin ribbon.

ext.ext_cn: 一根丝带
ext.ext_en: ...a piece of ribbon.

defs.def_en: A ribbon is a long, narrow piece of cloth that you use for tying things together or as a decoration.
A typewriter or printer ribbon is a long, narrow piece of cloth containing ink and is used in a typewriter or printer.

defs.def_cn: （用以表示奖励或与某组织有关系的）绶带，勋带
defs.def_en: A ribbon is a small decorative strip of cloth which is given to someone to wear on their clothes as an award or to show that they are linked with a particular organization.

defs.def_cn: 蓄意破坏者;从事破坏活动者;(英国)阻挠捕猎活动者

ext.ext_cn: 闹事者原本计划用炸弹袭击公共汽车和办公楼。
ext.ext_en: The saboteurs had planned to bomb buses and offices.

ext.ext_cn: 狩猎者和反捕猎活动人士的对峙
ext.ext_en: ...a confrontation between huntsmen and saboteurs.

defs.def_en: A saboteur is a person who deliberately damages or destroys things such as machines, railway lines, and bridges in order to weaken an enemy or to make a protest. In Britain, people who try to stop blood sports such as fox hunting are also referred to as saboteurs .
A corkscrew is a device for pulling corks out of bottles.

defs.def_cn: 没精打采地走;闷闷不乐地闲荡

ext.ext_cn: 他在办公室闲荡了一会儿，感到百无聊赖。
ext.ext_en: He moped around the office for a while, feeling bored...

ext.ext_cn: 他整天游手好闲。
ext.ext_en: He mopes about all day.

defs.def_en: If you mope around or mope about a place, you wander around there not doing anything, looking and feeling unhappy.
Pantheism is the religious belief that God is in everything in nature and the universe.
Pantheism is a willingness to worship and believe in all gods.

ext.ext_cn: 他目前在《新闻之夜》节目中的讲话搞得政客们惶恐不安。
ext.ext_en: He currently terrorises politicians and their ilk on 'Newsnight'...

ext.ext_cn: 加布里埃尔的同辈都在与毒品作斗争,而他的问题却集中在他的婚姻上。
ext.ext_en: Where others of his ilk have battled against drugs, Gabriel's problems have centred on his marriage.

defs.def_en: If you talk about people or things of the same ilk, you mean people or things of the same type as a person or thing that has been mentioned.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们完全是凭借顽强的毅力赢得了尊敬。
ext.ext_en: They have gained respect through sheer dogged determination.

ext.ext_cn: 他对他们权利的坚决主张
ext.ext_en: ...his dogged insistence on their rights.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's actions as dogged, you mean that they are determined to continue with something even if it becomes difficult or dangerous.

defs.def_cn: （预先声明病危时希望采取何种措施的）生前预嘱
defs.def_en: A living will is a document in which you say what medical or legal decisions you want people to make for you if you become too ill to make these decisions yourself.
See also:white elephant;An elephant is a very large animal with a long, flexible nose called a trunk, which it uses to pick up things. Elephants live in India and Africa.

defs.def_cn: 润肤剂;护肤霜;镇痛药膏
defs.def_en: An emollient is a liquid or cream which you put on your skin to make it softer or to reduce pain.

defs.def_cn: (乳霜或膏剂)护肤的,润肤的,镇痛的
defs.def_en: An emollient cream or other substance makes your skin softer or reduces pain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 核心人物是保守党政府内一个貌似仁和的高层人物。
ext.ext_en: The central character is a deceptively emollient senior figure in a Conservative Government.

defs.def_en: An emollient person or emollient speech tries to make things calm and reduce conflict.
Necrophilia is the act of having sexual intercourse with a dead body, or the desire to do this.

defs.def_cn: 风险投资者;投机资本家
defs.def_en: A venture capitalist is someone who makes money by investing in high risk projects.

defs.def_cn: 羽翼丰满的;完全成熟的

ext.ext_cn: 匈牙利从今天起将拥有一个完全成熟的证券交易所。
ext.ext_en: Hungary is to have a fully-fledged Stock Exchange from today.

defs.def_en: Fully fledged means complete or fully developed.
A photocopy is a copy of a document made using a photocopier.

ext.ext_cn: 员工在兑现前复印了支票。
ext.ext_en: Staff photocopied the cheque before cashing it.

defs.def_en: If you photocopy a document, you make a copy of it using a photocopier.

ext.ext_cn: 刀叉
ext.ext_en: ...knives and forks.

defs.def_en: A fork is a tool used for eating food which has a row of three or four long metal points at the end.

ext.ext_cn: 安用叉子叉了点儿鱼肉放进嘴里。
ext.ext_en: Ann forked some fish into her mouth...

ext.ext_cn: 他用叉子叉了个鸡蛋放在面包上，然后把面包片折起做成了三明治。
ext.ext_en: He forked an egg onto a piece of bread and folded it into a sandwich.

defs.def_en: If you fork food into your mouth or onto a plate, you put it there using a fork.
A garden fork is a tool used for breaking up soil which has a row of three or four long metal points at the end.

ext.ext_cn: 他们让我先在园子里干些杂活，挖土、叉粪肥之类的。
ext.ext_en: They started me off in the gardens as a handyman. Digging, forking manure, that kind of thing...

ext.ext_cn: 农夫们割下干草，用叉子把草叉到车上，然后拉到谷仓贮存。
ext.ext_en: Farmers cut the hay, fork it on to a cart and then store it in barns.

defs.def_en: If you fork something such as manure or hay, you move it from one place to another using a large garden fork.

defs.def_cn: (道路、河流等的)分岔处，分流处;分岔;岔路

ext.ext_cn: 我们到达了一个岔路口。
ext.ext_en: We arrived at a fork in the road...

ext.ext_en: The road divides; you should take the right fork.

defs.def_en: A fork in a road, path, or river is a point at which it divides into two parts and forms a 'Y' shape.

ext.ext_cn: 过了村子之后路分了岔。
ext.ext_en: Beyond the village the road forked...

ext.ext_cn: 这条路向下延伸到了一个山坳，然后在那里分了岔。

defs.def_en: If a road, path, or river forks, it forms a fork.

ext.ext_cn: 快到城镇边界时要走岔路的左边一条小路。
ext.ext_en: Just before the town boundary fork left onto a minor road.

defs.def_en: See also:tuning fork;If you fork in a particular direction when you are travelling along a road or path, you choose one of the forks in it and travel down it.

ext.ext_cn: 他得为尼娜付一大笔私立学校的学费。
ext.ext_en: He will have to fork out for private school fees for Nina...

ext.ext_en: You don't ask people to fork out every time they drive up the motorways...

defs.def_en: If you fork out for something, you spend a lot of money on it.
A swing bridge is a low bridge that can be opened either in the middle or on one side in order to let ships pass through.

ext.ext_cn: 桌面由玻璃制成。
ext.ext_en: The top of the table is made of glass...

ext.ext_cn: 这个塑像是用什么做的？
ext.ext_en: What is the statue made out of?

defs.def_en: If something is made of or made out of a particular substance, that substance was used to build it.

defs.def_cn: 有成功的把握;具备所需的一切条件

ext.ext_cn: 上学的时候，我觉得自己一定会出人头地。
ext.ext_en: When I was at school, I thought I had it made.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has it made or has got it made, you mean that they are certain to be rich or successful.

defs.def_cn: 受压迫的;遭蹂躏的;被践踏的

ext.ext_en: The owner is making huge profits at the expense of downtrodden peasants...

ext.ext_en: His mother was old, badly dressed and obviously downtrodden.

defs.def_en: People who are downtrodden are treated very badly by people with power, and do not have the ability or the energy to do anything about it.

ext.ext_cn: 卧室里只点了一支蜡烛。
ext.ext_en: The bedroom was lit by a single candle.

defs.def_en: A candle is a stick of hard wax with a piece of string called a wick through the middle. You light the wick in order to give a steady flame that provides light.

defs.def_cn: 一根蜡烛两头烧;起早摸黑地干;过度耗费精力
defs.def_en: If you burn the candle at both ends, you try to do too many things in too short a period of time so that you have to stay up very late at night and get up very early in the morning to get them done.

ext.ext_cn: 如今的姑娘根本不能和50年代的美女相提并论。
ext.ext_en: Girls today can't hold a candle to the beauties of the Fifties.

defs.def_en: If you say that one person or thing can't hold a candle to another, you meant that the first person or thing is not nearly as good as the second.
If you say that the game is not worth the candle, you mean that something is not worth the trouble or effort needed to achieve or obtain it.
An internee is a person who has been put in prison for political reasons.

ext.ext_cn: MSN和Freeserve之类的内容提供商
ext.ext_en: ...content providers such as MSN and Freeserve.

defs.def_en: A content provider is a company that supplies material such as text, music, or images for use on websites.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 缺乏声调的;平板的;单调的

ext.ext_cn: “我们该怎么办？”米尔顿又用平板而单调的声音问道。
ext.ext_en: 'What shall we do?' Milton said again in a toneless voice.

defs.def_en: A toneless voice is dull and does not express any feeling.

defs.def_cn: 取悦观众的人(或行动、事件)

ext.ext_cn: 他有很多精彩进球，是一名真正能给观众带来欢乐的运动员。
ext.ext_en: He gets spectacular goals and is a real crowd pleaser.

defs.def_en: If you describe a performer, politician, or sports player as a crowd-pleaser, you mean they always please their audience. You can also describe an action or event as a crowd-pleaser .
Almshouses are houses in Britain which were built and run by charities to provide accommodation for poor or old people who could not afford to pay rent.
A buffalo is a wild animal like a large cow with horns that curve upwards. Buffalo are usually found in southern and eastern Africa.
A buffalo is the same as a water buffalo .
A buffalo is the same as a bison .
The lobe of your ear  is the soft, fleshy part at the bottom.

ext.ext_cn: 对大脑颞叶的损伤
ext.ext_en: ...damage to the temporal lobe of the brain.

defs.def_en: A lobe is a rounded part of something, for example one of the sections of your brain or lungs, or one of the rounded sections along the edges of some leaves.

defs.def_en: An SASE is an envelope on which you have stuck a stamp and written your own name and address. You send it to a person or organization so that they can reply to you in it. SASE is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'self-addressed stamped envelope'.

defs.def_cn: 显赫人物；积极分子；中流砥柱
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a leading light in an organization, campaign, or community, you mean that they are one of the most important, active, enthusiastic, and successful people in it.

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙国王和王后
ext.ext_en: ...the king and queen of Spain...

ext.ext_en: In 1154, Henry II became King of England.

defs.def_en: A king is a man who is the most important member of the royal family of his country, and who is considered to be the Head of State of that country.

defs.def_cn: 最重要者；首屈一指者；…之王

ext.ext_en: He's the king of unlicensed boxing...

ext.ext_en: He was the king of the big love song.

defs.def_en: If you describe a man as the king of something, you mean that he is the most important person doing that thing or he is the best at doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 方片K
ext.ext_en: ...the king of diamonds.

defs.def_en: A king is a playing card with a picture of a king on it.
In chess, the king is the most important piece. When you are in a position to capture your opponent's king, you win the game.

defs.def_cn: 过阔绰的生活；活得像个国王

ext.ext_en: Executives lived like kings. The top thirty-one executives were paid a total of $14.2 million.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone lives like a king, you mean that they are able to live in a very comfortable or luxurious way.
In a garden, a pergola is an arch or a structure with a roof over which climbing plants can be grown.

defs.def_cn: 按时间顺序记述(或播放)

ext.ext_en: The series chronicles the everyday adventures of two eternal bachelors.

defs.def_en: To chronicle a series of events means to write about them or show them in broadcasts in the order in which they happened.

ext.ext_cn: 这套大部头的拿破仑时代编年史
ext.ext_en: ...this vast chronicle of Napoleonic times.

defs.def_en: A chronicle is an account or record of a series of events.

ext.ext_cn: 《旧金山纪事报》
ext.ext_en: ...the San Francisco Chronicle.

defs.def_en: Chronicle is sometimes used as part of the name of a newspaper.

ext.ext_en: ...an engineering company in the Midlands.

defs.def_en: The Midlands is the region or area in the central part of a country, in particular the central part of England.

defs.def_cn: （经过一段时期在某一活动上）远远超过，大大超越

ext.ext_en: It didn't matter that Ingrid had outdistanced them as a movie star.

defs.def_en: If you outdistance someone, you are a lot better and more successful than they are at a particular activity over a period of time.

defs.def_cn: （在竞赛中）轻松击败，遥遥领先

ext.ext_en: ...a millionaire businessman who easily outdistanced his major rivals for the nomination.

defs.def_en: If you outdistance your opponents in a contest of some kind, you beat them easily.

ext.ext_cn: 有机水果和蔬菜
ext.ext_en: ...organic fruit and vegetables.

defs.def_en: Organic methods of farming and gardening use only natural animal and plant products to help the plants or animals grow and be healthy, rather than using chemicals.

ext.ext_en: Incorporating organic material into chalky soils will reduce the alkalinity.

defs.def_en: Organic substances are of the sort produced by or found in living things.

ext.ext_en: ...to manage the company and supervise its organic growth.

defs.def_en: Organic change or development happens gradually and naturally rather than suddenly.

defs.def_cn: （社群或结构）有机的，统一的，不可分割的

ext.ext_en: City planning treats the city as a unit, as an organic whole.

defs.def_en: If a community or structure is an organic whole, each part of it is necessary and fits well with the other parts.

ext.ext_cn: 经历了这场战争的惨败之后，世界再也不是原来的那个样子了。
ext.ext_en: After the debacle of the war the world was never the same again...

ext.ext_en: The convention was a debacle.

defs.def_en: A debacle is an event or attempt that is a complete failure.

ext.ext_en: Some banks also have a hit list of people whom they threaten to sue for damages.

defs.def_en: If someone has a hit list of people or things, they are intending to take action concerning those people or things.

Dance, drama, music, and other forms of entertainment that are usually performed live in front of an audience are referred to as the performing arts .
If you bring someone to when they are unconscious, you make them become conscious again.

ext.ext_cn: 铁轨跨过这条河直达矿井口。
ext.ext_en: Across the river the railway track ran up to the pithead.

defs.def_en: The pithead at a coal mine is all the buildings and machinery which are above ground.

ext.ext_en: Israel accepted billions of dollars in war reparations.

defs.def_en: Reparations are sums of money that are paid after a war by the defeated country for the damage and injuries it caused in other countries.

ext.ext_en: There is a clear demand amongst victims for some sort of reparation from offenders.

defs.def_en: Reparation is help or payment that someone gives you for damage, loss, or suffering that they have caused you.

ext.ext_cn: 书中有 20 张有关男性时尚的彩色插页。
ext.ext_en: There are 20 full-colour pages of fashion for men...

ext.ext_cn: 时尚界并不在意现实世界的想法。
ext.ext_en: The fashion world does not mind what the real world thinks.

defs.def_en: Fashion is the area of activity that involves styles of clothing and appearance.

ext.ext_cn: 70 年代初我戴假睫毛，这在当时是时尚。
ext.ext_en: In the early seventies I wore false eyelashes, as was the fashion...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽女王开启了青花瓷在英格兰的流行风尚。
ext.ext_en: Queen Mary started the fashion for blue and white china in England...

defs.def_en: A fashion is a style of clothing or a way of behaving that is popular at a particular time.

ext.ext_cn: 另外还有一种叫 DHE 的药物，药效也差不多。
ext.ext_en: There is another drug called DHE that works in a similar fashion...

ext.ext_cn: 事情会如此发展是因为一个女人的固执己见。
ext.ext_en: It is happening in this fashion because of the obstinacy of one woman.

defs.def_en: See also:parrot-fashion;If you do something in a particular fashion or after a particular fashion, you do it in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 石器时代的移居者用羊的牙做成项链。
ext.ext_en: Stone Age settlers fashioned necklaces from sheep's teeth.

defs.def_en: If you fashion an object or a work of art, you make it.

ext.ext_cn: 她算得上是受过教育——家庭教育。
ext.ext_en: She was educated — after a fashion — at home...

ext.ext_cn: 他勉强认路。
ext.ext_en: He knew the way, after a fashion.

defs.def_en: If you say that something was done after a fashion, you mean that it was done, but not very well.

ext.ext_cn: 那种房子又时兴起来了。
ext.ext_en: That sort of house is back in fashion...

ext.ext_cn: 婚姻似乎快要过时了。
ext.ext_en: Marriage seems to be going out of fashion.

defs.def_en: If something is in fashion, it is popular and approved of at a particular time. If it is out of fashion, it is not popular or approved of.

defs.def_en: Social housing is housing which is provided for rent or sale at a fairly low cost by organizations such as housing associations and local councils.

ext.ext_cn: 在耶稣死后的几个世纪里，基督徒们真的相信世界将要灭亡。
ext.ext_en: In the centuries following Christ's death, Christians genuinely believed the world was about to end...

ext.ext_en: Following a day of medical research, the conference focused on educational practices.

defs.def_en: Following a particular event means after that event.

ext.ext_cn: 第二天照片出现在全世界所有报纸的头版。
ext.ext_en: The following day the picture appeared on the front pages of every newspaper in the world...

ext.ext_cn: 接下来那个周一的晚上，我们一起去吃了晚餐。
ext.ext_en: We went to dinner the following Monday evening...

defs.def_en: The following day, week, or year is the day, week, or year after the one you have just mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 请写明如下信息：产品名称、类型、购买日期和价格。
ext.ext_en: Write down the following information: name of product, type, date purchased and price...

ext.ext_cn: 关于如何帮助这种病人，下面章节中将会作出解释。
ext.ext_en: The method of helping such patients is explained in the following chapters.

defs.def_en: You use following to refer to something that you are about to mention.

ext.ext_en: Australian rugby league enjoys a huge following in New Zealand.

defs.def_en: A person or organization that has a following has a group of people who support or admire their beliefs or actions.

ext.ext_cn: 顺风和向东的潮水使我们的航行很惬意、很省力。
ext.ext_en: The following wind and eastward running tide had given us a very pleasant, lazy sail.

defs.def_en: If a boat or vehicle has a following wind, the wind is moving in the same direction as the boat or vehicle.

ext.ext_cn: 你看过这本书吗？
ext.ext_en: Have you read this book?...

ext.ext_cn: 我在报纸上看到了这件事。
ext.ext_en: I read about it in the paper...

defs.def_en: When you read something such as a book or article, you look at and understand the words that are written there.

ext.ext_cn: 杰伊朗读诗歌很动听。
ext.ext_en: Jay reads poetry so beautifully...

ext.ext_cn: 我很喜欢她读书给我们听。
ext.ext_en: I like it when she reads to us...

defs.def_en: When you read a piece of writing to someone, you say the words aloud.

ext.ext_cn: 他不会读写。
ext.ext_en: He couldn't read or write...

ext.ext_cn: 他18个月大的时候就认字了。
ext.ext_en: He could read words at 18 months.

defs.def_en: People who can read have the ability to look at and understand written words.

ext.ext_cn: 后来我学会了怎么识乐谱。
ext.ext_en: Later on I learned how to read music.

defs.def_en: If you can read music, you have the ability to look at and understand the symbols that are used in written music to represent musical sounds.

ext.ext_en: How can I read a Microsoft Excel file on a computer that only has Works installed?

defs.def_en: When a computer reads a file or a document, it takes information from a disk or tape.

ext.ext_cn: 巴士的标牌上写着“私家车：不对外出租”。
ext.ext_en: The sign on the bus read 'Private: Not In Service'.

defs.def_en: You can use read when saying what is written on something or in something. For example, if a notice reads 'Entrance', the word 'Entrance' is written on it.

ext.ext_cn: 这本书读起来像歌谣。
ext.ext_en: The book reads like a ballad...

ext.ext_cn: 它读起来很拗口。
ext.ext_en: It reads very awkwardly.

defs.def_en: If you refer to how a piece of writing reads, you are referring to its style.

ext.ext_cn: 本·奥克里的最新小说很精彩。
ext.ext_en: Ben Okri's latest novel is a good read.

defs.def_en: If you say that a book or magazine is a good read, you mean that it is very enjoyable to read.

ext.ext_en: The play is being widely read as an allegory of imperialist conquest...

ext.ext_en: South Africans were praying last night that he has read the situation correctly...

defs.def_en: If something is read in a particular way, it is understood or interpreted in that way.

defs.def_cn: 看得出，读懂，看透（想法或心思）

ext.ext_en: As if he could read her thoughts, Benny said, 'You're free to go any time you like.'

defs.def_en: If you read someone's mind or thoughts, you know exactly what they are thinking without them telling you.

ext.ext_cn: 如果要在一个团队中工作你必须学会了解他人。
ext.ext_en: If you have to work in a team you must learn to read people...

ext.ext_en: Under the shaded light her expression was difficult to read.

defs.def_en: If you can read someone or you can read their gestures, you can understand what they are thinking or feeling by the way they behave or the things they say.

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔法－布拉沃－祖鲁643呼叫萨德扎，能听到我的声音吗？完毕。

ext.ext_cn: 燃油表显示油量在零以下。
ext.ext_en: The fuel gauge reads below zero.

defs.def_en: If a measuring device reads a particular amount, it shows that amount.

ext.ext_cn: 她在剑桥大学学习法语和德语。

ext.ext_en: He is now reading for a maths degree at Surrey University.

defs.def_en: If you read a subject at university, you study it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们完全相信他曾经是一名克格勃特工。

defs.def_en: If you take something as read, you accept it as true or right and therefore feel that it does not need to be discussed or proved.

defs.def_cn: 筋疲力尽的；累得要命的

ext.ext_en: ...a huge, forbidding building.

ext.ext_en: Take notes during the consultation as the final written report is very concise.

ext.ext_en: ...'Exiles' by James Joyce, edited with an Introduction and notes by J C C Mays.

defs.def_en: In a book or article, a note is a short piece of additional information.

ext.ext_en: Since Mr Bennett was going to need some time off work, he asked for a sick note...

defs.def_en: A note is a short document that has to be signed by someone and that gives official information about something.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a banknote as a note .

ext.ext_en: If the note of D is sounded on a harp, all the corresponding D strings of other octaves will likewise resonate.

defs.def_en: In music, a note is the sound of a particular pitch, or a written symbol representing this sound.

ext.ext_cn: 他回忆早些年的家族生意时，无疑是带着一种怀旧的语气的。
ext.ext_en: There is an unmistakable note of nostalgia in his voice when he looks back on the early years of the family business...

ext.ext_cn: 他不难听出我话语中的愤愤不平。
ext.ext_en: It was not difficult for him to catch the note of bitterness in my voice.

defs.def_en: You can use note to refer to a particular quality in someone's voice that shows how they are feeling.

ext.ext_en: Yesterday's testimony began on a note of passionate but civilized disagreement...

ext.ext_cn: 不知为什么他讲这些故事时一点都不害怕。
ext.ext_en: Somehow he tells these stories without a note of horror...

defs.def_en: You can use note to refer to a particular feeling, impression, or atmosphere.

ext.ext_cn: 白宫已经注意到他承诺支持所有旨在贯彻联合国决议的打击。
ext.ext_en: The White House has noted his promise to support any attack that was designed to enforce the UN resolutions...

ext.ext_cn: 突然，我意识到雨已经停了。
ext.ext_en: Suddenly, I noted that the rain had stopped...

defs.def_en: If you note a fact, you become aware of it.

ext.ext_cn: 请看这座萨卢斯蒂奥·班迪尼的雕像，他是一位杰出的锡耶纳人。
ext.ext_en: Note the statue to Sallustio Bandini, a prominent Sienese...

ext.ext_cn: 请注意，票的数量有限。
ext.ext_en: Please note that there are a limited number of tickets.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to note something, you are drawing their attention to it.
