ext.ext_en: The report notes that export and import volumes picked up in leading economies...

ext.ext_cn: 年鉴同时指出，性传播疾病报告病例数显著下降。
ext.ext_en: The yearbook also noted a sharp drop in reported cases of sexually transmitted disease.

defs.def_en: If you note something, you mention it in order to draw people's attention to it.

ext.ext_cn: “他切除了扁桃体，一直病着，”她在日记里写道。
ext.ext_en: 'He has had his tonsils out and has been ill, too,' she noted in her diary...

ext.ext_cn: 能清楚地看到一名警察记下了经过车辆的车牌号。
ext.ext_en: One policeman was clearly visible noting the number plates of passing cars...

defs.def_en: When you note something, you write it down as a record of what has happened.

ext.ext_cn: 女人们忙着交换对女王衣着的看法。
ext.ext_en: The women were busily comparing notes on the queen's outfit...

ext.ext_cn: 他们互致问候，聊了聊家常，然后才言归正传。
ext.ext_en: They exchanged greetings, compared notes on their wives and families, and finally got down to business.

defs.def_en: If you compare notes with someone on a particular subject, you talk to them and find out whether their opinion, information, or experience is the same as yours.

ext.ext_cn: 政要
ext.ext_en: ...politicians of note...

ext.ext_en: He has published nothing of note in the last ten years.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is of note is important, worth mentioning, or well-known.

defs.def_cn: 表达…的情感;带有…的印象;营造…的氛围

ext.ext_cn: 第一轮讨论前，贝克先生听上去还比较乐观。
ext.ext_en: Before his first round of discussions, Mr Baker sounded an optimistic note...

ext.ext_en: Plants growing out of cracks in paving strike the right note up a cottage-garden path.

defs.def_en: If someone or something strikes a particular note or sounds a particular note, they create a particular feeling, impression, or atmosphere.

ext.ext_cn: 留心一下天气状况。
ext.ext_en: Take note of the weather conditions...

ext.ext_cn: 他们注意到她对谋杀的消息一点都不感到惊讶。

defs.def_en: If you take note of something, you pay attention to it because you think that it is important or significant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指事业上）失败的，不成功的

ext.ext_en: The difference between successful and unsuccessful people is that successful people put into practice the things they learn...

ext.ext_en: He and his friend Boris were unsuccessful in getting a job.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司犯有严重过失。
ext.ext_en: The company were guilty of gross negligence.

ext.ext_cn: 极端不公的法案
ext.ext_en: ...an act of gross injustice.

defs.def_en: You use gross to describe something unacceptable or unpleasant to a very great amount, degree, or intensity.

ext.ext_en: I feel disgusted and wonder how I could ever have been so gross.

ext.ext_en: He wears really gross holiday outfits.

ext.ext_en: I only resist things like chocolate if I feel really gross.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as gross, you mean that they are extremely fat and unattractive.

ext.ext_cn: 他订购了12罗磁盘。

defs.def_en: A gross is a group of 144 things.

ext.ext_en: ...the process of selecting candidates for ordination.

ext.ext_cn: 他敦促美国继续进行和平斡旋。
ext.ext_en: He urged the United States to persist with its efforts to bring about peace...

defs.def_en: If you persist in doing something, you continue to do it, even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有资格的;符合条件的;有能力的

ext.ext_cn: 大约有一半人有资格参加今天的选举投票。
ext.ext_en: Almost half the population are eligible to vote in today's election...

ext.ext_cn: 你也许有资格获得大学奖学金。
ext.ext_en: You could be eligible for a university scholarship.

defs.def_en: Someone who is eligible to do something is qualified or able to do it, for example because they are old enough.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （作为结婚对象）合适的，中意的

ext.ext_cn: 他是日本最为抢手的单身汉。
ext.ext_en: He's the most eligible bachelor in Japan.

defs.def_en: An eligible man or woman is not yet married and is thought by many people to be a suitable partner.
The mayor of a town or city is the person who has been elected to represent it for a fixed period of time or, in some places, to run its government.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 浴室给人以明亮通风之感。
ext.ext_en: The bathroom has a light and airy feel.

defs.def_en: If a building or room is airy, it has a lot of fresh air inside, usually because it is large.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻率的；轻浮的；非真诚的

ext.ext_cn: 这位海军中校随意地朝他们挥挥手便扬帆而过。
ext.ext_en: Giving them an airy wave of his hand, the Commander sailed past.

defs.def_en: You can use airy to describe someone's behaviour when they are light-hearted and casual about things which some people take seriously.

ext.ext_cn: 这场比赛以零比零的平局收场。
ext.ext_en: The fixture ended in a goalless draw...

ext.ext_cn: 加时赛结束后，这场半决赛的比分还是零比零。
ext.ext_en: The semi-final finished goalless after extra time.

defs.def_en: In football, a goalless draw is a game which ends without any goals having been scored.

ext.ext_cn: 右翼极端分子给社会秩序带来的威胁
ext.ext_en: ...the threat to social order posed by right-wing extremists.

defs.def_en: The social order in a place is the way that society is organized there.
A river basin is the area of land from which all the water flows into a particular river.

ext.ext_cn: 风钻
ext.ext_en: ...pneumatic drills.

ext.ext_cn: 牙钻
ext.ext_en: ...a dentist's drill.

defs.def_en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes.

ext.ext_cn: 他在莉莉卧室的墙上钻了个孔。
ext.ext_en: He drilled into the wall of Lili's bedroom...

ext.ext_cn: 我钻了 5 个等间距的孔。
ext.ext_en: I drilled five holes at equal distance.

defs.def_en: When you drill into something or drill a hole in something, you make a hole in it using a drill.

ext.ext_cn: 有人提议钻探更多的石油。
ext.ext_en: There have been proposals to drill for more oil...

ext.ext_cn: 钻探队还在钻探。
ext.ext_en: The team is still drilling.

defs.def_en: When people drill for oil or water, they search for it by drilling deep holes in the ground or in the bottom of the sea.

ext.ext_cn: 老师带他们做了反复练习：一周中每一天的叫法、天气和数数。
ext.ext_en: The teacher runs them through a drill — the days of the week, the weather and some counting.

defs.def_en: A drill is a way that teachers teach their students something by making them repeat it many times.

ext.ext_cn: 他将合唱团训练到了一个高水平。
ext.ext_en: He drills the choir to a high standard.

defs.def_en: If you drill people, you teach them to do something by making them repeat it many times.

defs.def_cn: (尤指士兵进行的)练习,训练,操练

ext.ext_cn: 海军陆战队进行了有 18 艘军舰和 90 架飞机参与的训练。
ext.ext_en: The Marines carried out a drill that included 18 ships and 90 aircraft...

ext.ext_cn: 他双手背在身后，像一个教官。
ext.ext_en: His hands were clasped behind him like a drill sergeant.

defs.def_en: A drill is repeated training for a group of people, especially soldiers, so that they can do something quickly and efficiently.

defs.def_cn: (为在危急情况下逃生而进行的)常规训练,演习

ext.ext_cn: 消防演习
ext.ext_en: ...a fire drill.

ext.ext_cn: 防空演习
ext.ext_en: ...air-raid drills.

defs.def_en: A drill is a routine exercise or activity, in which people practise what they should do in dangerous situations.

ext.ext_cn: 厚斜纹棉布
ext.ext_en: ...cotton drill.

defs.def_en: Drill is thick cotton material which is used for making uniforms and trousers.

ext.ext_cn: 在深约 0.5 英寸,间隔 12 英寸的条播沟里播种。
ext.ext_en: Sow the seeds in drills about 1/2in. deep and 12in. apart.

defs.def_en: A drill is a long line in the earth, a few centimetres deep, which a farmer or gardener makes to plant seeds in.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 本质上的;重大的;实质性的

ext.ext_cn: 他们计划不久在罗马再次会晤以开始实质性的谈判。
ext.ext_en: They plan to meet again in Rome very soon to begin substantive negotiations.

defs.def_en: Substantive negotiations or issues deal with the most important and central aspects of a subject.

defs.def_cn: (女性阴道的)冲洗法，灌洗法;冲洗器;灌洗器
defs.def_en: A douche is a method of washing the vagina using a stream of water. You also refer to the object which you use to wash the vagina in this way as a douche .

ext.ext_cn: 怀孕时千万不要冲洗阴道。
ext.ext_en: Never douche if you are pregnant.

defs.def_en: To douche means to wash the vagina using a stream of water.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我做了几份薪酬微薄的秘书工作，这让我非常郁闷。
ext.ext_en: I took a series of badly paid secretarial jobs which made me really miserable...

ext.ext_cn: 她伤心而沮丧地上床睡觉。
ext.ext_en: She went to bed, miserable and depressed.

defs.def_en: If you are miserable, you are very unhappy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (地方、形势)令人难受的，令人抑郁的

ext.ext_cn: 这个鬼地方根本没有什么东西可以让他分心。
ext.ext_en: There was nothing at all in this miserable place to distract him.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place or situation as miserable, you mean that it makes you feel unhappy or depressed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那是阴郁灰暗、潮湿多雨的一天。
ext.ext_en: It was a grey, wet, miserable day...

ext.ext_cn: 天气非常寒冷潮湿，令人难受。
ext.ext_en: It was very cold, damp and  miserable.

defs.def_en: If you describe the weather as miserable, you mean that it makes you feel depressed, because it is raining or dull.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 脾气坏的;不友善的;乖戾的

ext.ext_cn: 他的脾气总是很糟。他从不跟我或其他任何人讲话。
ext.ext_en: He always was a miserable man. He never spoke to me nor anybody else.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as miserable, you mean that you do not like them because they are bad-tempered or unfriendly.

defs.def_cn: 远远不足的;非常差劲的;少得可怜的

ext.ext_cn: 我们在接近地面时的航速仅为2.2节。
ext.ext_en: Our speed over the ground was a miserable 2.2 knots...

ext.ext_cn: 迄今为止，从前南斯拉夫接收的难民只有区区1,100人。
ext.ext_en: It has so far accepted a miserable 1,100 refugees from the former Yugoslavia.

defs.def_en: You can describe a quantity or quality as miserable when you think that it is much smaller or worse than it ought to be.

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影在意大利和美国均遭遇票房惨败。
ext.ext_en: The film was a miserable commercial failure both in Italy and in the United States.

defs.def_en: A miserable failure is a very great one.

ext.ext_cn: 他说：“我们想在谈判桌上解决所有问题。”
ext.ext_en: 'We want to settle all matters at the negotiating table,' he said...

ext.ext_cn: 回到谈判桌旁的决定标志着工会的初步胜利。
ext.ext_en: The decision to return to the negotiating table marks an early victory for trade unions.

defs.def_en: If you say that people are at the negotiating table, you mean that they are having discussions in order to settle a dispute or reach an agreement.

ext.ext_cn: 该书曾几次受到作者过多的制约。
ext.ext_en: There are times when the book suffers from excessive authorial control.

defs.def_en: Authorial means relating to the author of something such as a book or play.

defs.def_cn: 小号手;号兵;小号吹奏者
defs.def_en: A trumpeter is someone who plays a trumpet.

defs.def_cn: 龙(故事和传说中有翼有爪且会喷火的动物)
defs.def_en: In stories and legends, a dragon is an animal like a big lizard. It has wings and claws, and breathes out fire.
If someone calls a woman, especially an older woman, a dragon, they mean that she is fierce and unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: (贴足邮票、写明姓名地址的)回邮信封

ext.ext_cn: 寄上一个回邮信封索取免费资料包。
ext.ext_en: Send an s.a.e. for a free information pack.

defs.def_en: An s.a.e. is an envelope on which you have stuck a stamp and written your own name and address. You send it to an organization so that they can reply to you in it. s.a.e. is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'stamped addressed envelope' or 'self addressed envelope'.

defs.def_cn: (作公寓或办公用的)高层建筑，摩天大楼

ext.ext_cn: 23 层高的大厦
ext.ext_en: ...a 23-storey tower block.

defs.def_en: A tower block is a tall building divided into flats or offices.

ext.ext_cn: 一月份房租增加两倍时，他们将被迫多付不少钱。
ext.ext_en: They will have to pay much more when rents treble in January...

ext.ext_cn: 该市的囚犯人数增长了两倍，达到 21,000 人。
ext.ext_en: The city has trebled the number of its prisoners to 21,000.

defs.def_en: If something trebles or if you treble it, it becomes three times greater in number or amount than it was.

ext.ext_cn: 有 700 多万股换手，是通常日平均成交量的 3 倍。
ext.ext_en: More than 7 million shares changed hands, treble the normal daily average.

defs.def_en: If one thing is treble the size or amount of another thing, it is three times greater in size or amount.

defs.def_cn: 男童高音；唱高音的男童声歌手
defs.def_en: A treble is a boy with a very high singing voice.

ext.ext_cn: 此役获胜成就了他们的三冠王——此前他们已经拿下了今年的联赛和杯赛双料冠军。
ext.ext_en: The win completed a treble for them – they already claimed a league and cup double this year.

defs.def_en: In sport, a treble is three successes one after the other, for example winning three horse races on the same day, or winning three competitions in the same season.

ext.ext_cn: 该队还因其良好的体育精神及公平竞争精神而受到了表扬。
ext.ext_en: The team also won praise for sportsmanship and fair play.

defs.def_en: Sportsmanship is behaviour and attitudes that show respect for the rules of a game and for the other players.
A minicam is a very small television camera.

ext.ext_cn: 1978年，他效力于获得世界杯冠军的阿根廷队。
ext.ext_en: In 1978 he played for the victorious Argentinian side in the World Cup.

ext.ext_cn: 3个获胜的盟国——法国、英国和美国
ext.ext_en: ...the three victorious allied powers: France, Britain, and the United States.

defs.def_en: You use victorious to describe someone who has won a victory in a struggle, war, or competition.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 疲惫不堪的;累病的;衰弱的

ext.ext_cn: 你感觉疲惫不堪的时候
ext.ext_en: ...times when you are feeling tired and run-down.

defs.def_en: If someone is run-down, they are tired or slightly ill.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (建筑物、地区等)破旧不堪的，破败的，失修的

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰最破败的地区之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the most run-down areas in Scotland.

ext.ext_cn: 破败的公寓楼
ext.ext_en: ...a run-down block of flats.

defs.def_en: A run-down building or area is in very poor condition.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 萧条的板岩采石场
ext.ext_en: ...a run-down slate quarry...

ext.ext_cn: 他买下了一个不景气的电视台。
ext.ext_en: He bought a run-down television station.

defs.def_en: A run-down place of business is not as active as it used to be or does not have many customers.

defs.def_cn: （行业、组织等规模的）缩减，紧缩

ext.ext_cn: 促使煤炭行业紧缩的原因
ext.ext_en: ...the impetus behind the rundown of the coal industry.

defs.def_en: When the run-down of an industry or organization takes place, its size or the amount of work that it does is reduced.

ext.ext_cn: 以下是能有的各项选择。
ext.ext_en: Here's a rundown of the options...

ext.ext_cn: 这份全彩附录包含了完整的比赛信息和对所有可能获胜的英国运动员的详细介绍。
ext.ext_en: This full-colour supplement includes full race details, plus a comprehensive run-down on all the British hopefuls.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a run-down of a group of things or a run-down on something, you give them details about it.

defs.def_cn: 桂冠诗人（在英国可终身享受政府薪俸，在美国则有一定时限）
defs.def_en: The poet laureate is the official poet of a country. In Britain the poet laureate is paid by the government for the rest of their life. In the United States they are paid for a fixed period.

defs.def_cn: 木炭;(用于绘画的)炭笔，木炭条
defs.def_en: Charcoal is a black substance obtained by burning wood without much air. It can be burned as a fuel, and small sticks of it are used for drawing with.

ext.ext_cn: 他不再是一个消沉的人。
ext.ext_en: He's no longer a depressive character.

ext.ext_cn: 重度抑郁症
ext.ext_en: ...a severe depressive disorder.

defs.def_en: Depressive means relating to depression or to being depressed.
See also:manic-depressive;A depressive is someone who suffers from depression.

defs.def_cn: （人）准备就绪的;（物品）准备好的

ext.ext_cn: 她花了很长时间才做好去教堂的准备。
ext.ext_en: It took her a long time to get ready for church...

ext.ext_cn: 那些可卡因已经准备好进行分销了。
ext.ext_en: The cocaine was ready for distribution...

defs.def_en: If someone is ready, they are properly prepared for something. If something is ready, it has been properly prepared and is now able to be used.

ext.ext_cn: 她说自己还没有准备好结婚。
ext.ext_en: She says she's not ready for marriage...

ext.ext_cn: 当你觉得他可以应付的时候再把他弄进一所普通学校是不会有问题的。
ext.ext_en: You'll have no trouble getting him into a normal school when you feel he's ready to go.

defs.def_en: If you are ready for something or ready to do something, you have enough experience to do it or you are old enough and sensible enough to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 愿意的；乐意的；情愿的；甘愿的

ext.ext_cn: 他们甘愿为信仰而死。
ext.ext_en: They were ready to die for their beliefs...

ext.ext_cn: 她一向乐意接受采访。
ext.ext_en: She was always ready to give interviews.

defs.def_en: If you are ready to do something, you are willing to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我不知道你怎样，但是我要睡觉了。
ext.ext_en: I don't know about you, but I'm ready for bed...

ext.ext_cn: 在曼谷的炎热天气中呆了5天之后，我们想要去海边。
ext.ext_en: After five days in the heat of Bangkok, we were ready for the beach.

defs.def_en: If you are ready for something, you need it or want it.

ext.ext_cn: 她看起来要哭了。
ext.ext_en: She looked ready to cry...

ext.ext_cn: 正当我们要吃晚餐的时候，一个小男孩跑着进来了。
ext.ext_en: Just as we were ready to sit down to dinner, a little boy came running in...

defs.def_en: To be ready to do something means to be about to do it or likely to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 现成的;就绪的;易于得到的

ext.ext_cn: 我没有想出解决这个困境的现成答案。
ext.ext_en: I didn't have a ready answer for this dilemma...

ext.ext_cn: “但还不至于如此，”他脱口而出，脸上保持着他那一贯的微笑。
ext.ext_en: 'But not quite yet,' he says quickly, with that ready smile of his...

defs.def_en: You use ready to describe things that are able to be used very quickly and easily.

ext.ext_cn: 恐怕我身上没有足够的现金。
ext.ext_en: I'm afraid I don't have enough ready cash.

ext.ext_cn: 她手头现金有点儿紧张。
ext.ext_en: She was a bit short of the readies.

defs.def_en: Ready money is in the form of notes and coins rather than cheques or credit cards, and so it can be used immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰的手下正在为最后的进攻做准备。
ext.ext_en: John's soldiers were readying themselves for the final assault...

ext.ext_cn: 在埃及，两个新的营地已经准备好收留难民了。
ext.ext_en: In Egypt, two new camps were readied for the absorption of refugees...

defs.def_en: When you ready something, you prepare it for a particular purpose.

defs.def_cn: （与过去分词连用）表示“已经…好的”，“事先…的”

ext.ext_cn: 你可以在文具店买到已印好的遗嘱单。
ext.ext_en: You can buy ready-printed forms for wills at stationery shops...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你要买已经片好的鱼片，一定要买鱼肉紧实有弹性的。
ext.ext_en: If you buy the fish ready filleted, make sure the flesh is firm and springy.

defs.def_en: Ready combines with past participles to indicate that something has already been done, and that therefore you do not have to do it yourself.

defs.def_cn: 现成的；可以立即使用的；在手边的

ext.ext_cn: 荷枪实弹的士兵穿过林区冲了上来。
ext.ext_en: Soldiers came charging through the forest, guns at the ready.

defs.def_en: If you have something at the ready, you have it in a position where it can be quickly and easily used.

ext.ext_cn: 她想在伯纳德下班回家的时候把一切准备就绪。
ext.ext_en: She liked to be ready and waiting at home when Bernard returned from work...

ext.ext_cn: 小屋已收拾好随时迎接他们的到来。
ext.ext_en: The chalet was kept ready and waiting for them at all times.

defs.def_en: If you want to emphasize that a person is properly prepared for something, or that something can now be used, you can say that they are ready and waiting .

defs.def_cn: 已经准备就绪；就等你先开始

ext.ext_cn: “准备好出发了吗?”——“就等你了，船长。”
ext.ext_en: 'Are you ready to pull out?' — 'I'm ready when you are, Captain.'

defs.def_en: If you say to someone 'Ready when you are', you are telling them that you are now ready to do something and that as soon as they are ready, you will do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们都对新课表表示强烈不满。
ext.ext_en: They all fulminated against the new curriculum.

defs.def_en: If you fulminate against someone or something, you criticize them angrily.

ext.ext_cn: 在一次离奇的比赛中，裁判给11名队员记名警告，把一名队员罚下场，成了全场关注的焦点。
ext.ext_en: The referee took centre stage as 11 players were booked and one sent off in a bizarre game...

ext.ext_cn: 核扩散重新成为国际事务的关注焦点。
ext.ext_en: Nuclear proliferation has returned to centre stage in international affairs.

defs.def_en: If something or someone takes centre stage, they become very important or noticeable.

ext.ext_cn: 他们声称实施了大屠杀和酷刑。
ext.ext_en: They have alleged that acts of genocide and torture were carried out.

defs.def_en: Genocide is the deliberate murder of a whole community or race.
Slag is used by some people to refer to a woman who they disapprove of because they think she is sexually immoral.
See also:side-saddle;A saddle is a leather seat that you put on the back of an animal so that you can ride the animal.

defs.def_cn: 给(马等)备鞍;给…装上马鞍

ext.ext_cn: 我们何不找几匹马套上马鞍出去遛遛？
ext.ext_en: Why don't we saddle a couple of horses and go for a ride?

ext.ext_cn: 我想我们一上好马鞍就离开这里。
ext.ext_en: I want to be gone from here as soon as we can saddle up...

defs.def_en: If you saddle a horse, you put a saddle on it so that you can ride it.
A saddle is a seat on a bicycle or motorcycle.
A saddle of lamb, rabbit, or venison is a piece of meat taken from the middle of the animal's back.

ext.ext_cn: 战争拖垮了经济，使该国欠下了巨额外债。
ext.ext_en: The war devastated the economy and saddled the country with a huge foreign debt.

defs.def_en: If you saddle someone with a problem or with a responsibility, you put them in a position where they have to deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 看到电视上的赛马节目时，我真希望自己能再度跨马奔驰。
ext.ext_en: When I watch horse racing on television, I wish I was back in the saddle.

defs.def_en: If you are in the saddle, you are riding a horse.

ext.ext_cn: 武装部队和奉行强硬路线的人即将掌权。
ext.ext_en: The armed forces and the hardliners are now going to be in the saddle.

defs.def_en: If you are in the saddle, you are in power or in control of a situation.

ext.ext_cn: 人们弄坏了篱笆，推倒了墙。
ext.ext_en: People have damaged hedges and pushed over walls...

ext.ext_en: Anna is always attacking other children, pushing them over.

defs.def_en: See also:pushover;If you push someone or something over, you push them so that they fall onto the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 7点钟我来接你。
ext.ext_en: I shall be calling for you at seven o'clock.

defs.def_en: If you call for someone, you go to the building where they are, so that you can both go somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 他们愤怒地要求鲁宾逊辞职。
ext.ext_en: They angrily called for Robinson's resignation...

ext.ext_cn: 停火决议要求释放所有战俘。
ext.ext_en: The ceasefire resolution calls for the release of all prisoners of war.

defs.def_en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

ext.ext_cn: 应付这种局面需要刚柔并济。
ext.ext_en: It's a situation that calls for a blend of delicacy and force.

defs.def_en: If something calls for a particular action or quality, it needs it or makes it necessary.

ext.ext_cn: 前苏联集团
ext.ext_en: ...the former Soviet bloc.

ext.ext_cn: 世界上最大的贸易共同体
ext.ext_en: ...the world's largest trading bloc.

defs.def_en: See also:en bloc;A bloc is a group of countries which have similar political aims and interests and that act together over some issues.
Cassava is a South American plant with thick roots. It is grown for food.
Cassava is a substance that comes from the root of the cassava plant and is used to make flour.
A chorister is a singer in a church choir.

ext.ext_cn: 我们谁都不应该低估女性在事业发展过程中所面临的困难程度。
ext.ext_en: None of us should ever underestimate the degree of difficulty women face in career advancement...

ext.ext_cn: 千万不要低估你从一群志趣相投的人那里所能学到的东西。
ext.ext_en: Never underestimate what you can learn from a group of like-minded people.

defs.def_en: If you underestimate something, you do not realize how large or great it is or will be.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得很多人仍然低估了他。
ext.ext_en: I think a lot of people still underestimate him...

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名士兵，我学到的第一课就是决不要低估敌人。
ext.ext_en: The first lesson I learnt as a soldier was never to underestimate the enemy.

defs.def_en: If you underestimate someone, you do not realize what they are capable of doing.
A punchbag is a heavy leather bag, filled with a firm material, that hangs on a rope. Punchbags are used by boxers and other sportsmen for exercise and training.
Bookkeeping is the job or activity of keeping an accurate record of the money that is spent and received by a business or other organization.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 博学的；有见识的；知识渊博的

ext.ext_cn: 我们雇佣友善的、在行的员工。
ext.ext_en: We employ friendly and knowledgeable staff.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你不太了解汽车，带一个懂行的朋友一起去。
ext.ext_en: If you don't know much about cars, take a knowledgeable friend along.

defs.def_en: Someone who is knowledgeable has or shows a clear understanding of many different facts about the world or about a particular subject.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有心计的;诡计多端的;能算计的

ext.ext_cn: 诺思布里奇是个头脑冷静、诡计多端、阴险狡诈的罪犯,他可能还会犯案。
ext.ext_en: Northbridge is a cool, calculating and clever criminal who could strike again.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as calculating, you disapprove of the fact that they deliberately plan to get what they want, often by hurting or harming other people.

ext.ext_cn: 我查看了那根音量指针是否在摆动。
ext.ext_en: I checked to see if the needle indicating volume was oscillating.

defs.def_en: If an object oscillates, it moves repeatedly from one position to another and back again, or keeps getting bigger and smaller.

ext.ext_cn: 股价一直在1997年创下的5年间最高点157.25便士和今年的最低点91.5便士之间浮动。
ext.ext_en: The share price has oscillated between a five-year high of 157.25p in 1997 and this year's low of 91.5p...

ext.ext_cn: 石油市场因当天来自日内瓦的报道出现了起伏。
ext.ext_en: Oil markets oscillated on the day's reports from Geneva.

defs.def_en: If the level or value of something oscillates between one amount and another, it keeps going up and down between the two amounts.

ext.ext_cn: 该共和国总统施政风格时而大胆冒进，时而谨慎务实。
ext.ext_en: The president of the Republic oscillated between a certain audacity and a prudent realism.

defs.def_en: If you oscillate between two moods, attitudes, or types of behaviour, you keep changing from one to the other and back again.
Brussels sprouts are vegetables that look like tiny cabbages.

ext.ext_cn: 金融丑闻
ext.ext_en: ...a financial scandal.

defs.def_en: A scandal is a situation or event that is thought to be shocking and immoral and that everyone knows about.

defs.def_cn: 流言蜚语;关于丑闻的传言;谣言

ext.ext_cn: 他喜欢说三道四，散布谣言。
ext.ext_en: He loved gossip and scandal...

ext.ext_cn: 这些母亲经常会因为害怕流言蜚语而抛弃自己的孩子。
ext.ext_en: These mothers often abandoned their children because of fear of scandal.

defs.def_en: Scandal is talk about the shocking and immoral aspects of someone's behaviour or something that has happened.

defs.def_cn: 令人气愤的事;不像话的事;可耻的行为

ext.ext_cn: 警察能无缘无故拦人，这真是令人愤慨的行径。
ext.ext_en: It is a scandal that a person can be stopped for no reason by the police.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a scandal, you are angry about it and think that the people responsible for it should be ashamed.

defs.def_cn: (英美)陆军上士;(美国)海军陆战队上士，空军中士

ext.ext_cn: 他父亲是一名陆军上士。
ext.ext_en: His father is a staff sergeant in the army.

ext.ext_cn: 陆军上士罗伯特·戴利
ext.ext_en: ...Staff Sergeant Robert Daily.

defs.def_en: A staff sergeant is someone who ranks just above sergeant in the British army or the United States army, marines, or air force.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 垂死的;奄奄一息的;停滞不前的

ext.ext_cn: 毫无生机的经济
ext.ext_en: ...the moribund economy.

ext.ext_cn: 死气沉沉的房地产市场
ext.ext_en: ...the moribund housing market...

defs.def_en: If you des- cribe something as moribund, you mean that it is in a very bad condition.

ext.ext_cn: 他 24 岁，是一名实习记者。
ext.ext_en: He is a 24-year-old trainee reporter...

ext.ext_cn: 我的第一份工作是在一家银行做大学毕业实习生。
ext.ext_en: My first job was as a graduate trainee with a bank.

defs.def_en: A trainee is someone who is employed at a low level in a particular job in order to learn the skills needed for that job.

ext.ext_cn: 他从小一贫如洗，没有受过教育。
ext.ext_en: He was brought up in penury, without education.

defs.def_en: Penury is the state of being extremely poor.

defs.def_cn: (在艺术或政治方面打破传统观念的)新浪潮(运动)，新潮流，新潮派

ext.ext_cn: 讽刺喜剧的新潮流
ext.ext_en: ...the new wave of satirical comedy...

ext.ext_cn: 新潮流音乐
ext.ext_en: ...New Wave music.

defs.def_en: In the arts or in politics, a new wave is a group or movement that deliberately introduces new or unconventional ideas instead of using traditional ones.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...a colloquial expression...

ext.ext_cn: 他结结巴巴地学说俄语，把她逗乐了。
ext.ext_en: His stumbling attempts at colloquial Russian amused her.

defs.def_en: Colloquial words and phrases are informal and are used mainly in conversation.
You say 'Goodbye' to someone when you or they are leaving, or at the end of a telephone conversation.

ext.ext_cn: 他道了别，知道要过很久才能再见到他的孩子。
ext.ext_en: He said his goodbyes knowing that a long time would pass before he would see his child again...

ext.ext_cn: 我匆忙地说了声再会便冒着严寒走回了家。
ext.ext_en: I said a hurried goodbye and walked home in the cold...

defs.def_en: When you say your goodbyes, you say something such as 'Goodbye' when you leave.

ext.ext_cn: 他不辞而别。
ext.ext_en: He left without saying goodbye...

ext.ext_cn: 他想跟你说声再见。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to say goodbye to you...

defs.def_en: When you say goodbye to someone, you say something such as 'Goodbye', 'Bye', or 'See you', when you or they are leaving. You can also wave goodbye to someone.

defs.def_cn: 向…说再见；承认不会（或不再）拥有

ext.ext_cn: 他可能已经失去了夺取奥运会金牌的最后机会。
ext.ext_en: He has probably said goodbye to his last chance of Olympic gold...

ext.ext_en: We can wave goodbye to the sort of protection that people at work need and deserve.

defs.def_en: If you say goodbye or wave goodbye to something that you want or usually have, you accept that you are not going to have it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: A speed limit of 30 mph was introduced in built-up areas.

defs.def_en: A built-up area is an area such as a town or city which has a lot of buildings in it.

defs.def_cn: 叛逆的人;故意与众不同的人

ext.ext_en: He is by nature a contrarian.

ext.ext_cn: 叛逆的青年知识分子
ext.ext_en: ...the young contrarian intellectual.

defs.def_en: A contrarian is a person who deliberately behaves in a way that is different from the people around them.

defs.def_en: The inmates of a prison or mental hospital are the prisoners or patients who are living there.

ext.ext_en: He attacked greedy bosses for awarding themselves big rises...

ext.ext_cn: 她既贪婪又自私。
ext.ext_en: She is greedy and selfish.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as greedy, you mean that they want to have more of something such as food or money than is necessary or fair.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...the devilish destructiveness of modern weapons.

defs.def_en: A devilish idea or action is cruel or unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...a devilish puzzle.

defs.def_cn: （恶劣环境中的）宜人之地，乐土；（不愉快情形下的）开心之时，乐事

ext.ext_en: The immaculately tended gardens are an oasis in the midst of Cairo's urban sprawl.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a pleasant place or situation as an oasis when it is surrounded by unpleasant ones.

ext.ext_en: I've just got a parking ticket — my first in years.

defs.def_en: A parking ticket is a piece of paper with instructions to pay a fine, and is put on your car when you have parked it somewhere illegally.

ext.ext_en: She was so ill that she was put on a respirator.

defs.def_en: A respirator is a device that allows people to breathe when they cannot breathe naturally, for example because they are ill or have been injured.
A respirator is a device you wear over your mouth and nose in order to breathe when you are surrounded by smoke or poisonous gas.

defs.def_cn: （天主教庭协助牧师做弥撒的）辅祭

ext.ext_cn: 他们不得不去寻找衣服和燃料。
ext.ext_en: They were forced to forage for clothing and fuel.

defs.def_en: If someone forages for something, they search for it in a busy way.

ext.ext_en: We disturbed a wild boar that had been foraging by the roadside...

ext.ext_cn: 猫在寻找食物。
ext.ext_en: The cat forages for food.

ext.ext_en: ...the amount of forage needed to feed one cow and its calf.

defs.def_en: Forage is crops that are grown as food for cattle and horses.

ext.ext_en: Forensic experts carried out a painstaking search of the debris.

defs.def_en: A painstaking search, examination, or investigation is done extremely carefully and thoroughly.

ext.ext_en: ...an Ayurvedic practitioner.

ext.ext_cn: 麦克拉伦琢磨着要拍一部电影已经有段时间了。
ext.ext_en: McLaren had been mulling over an idea to make a movie...

ext.ext_cn: 我不打扰你了，你在这儿可以仔细考虑考虑这事儿。
ext.ext_en: I'll leave you alone here so you can mull it over.

defs.def_en: If you mull something over, you think about it for a long time before deciding what to do.

ext.ext_cn: 上个星期，其他叛军领导人和政府代表之间的和谈没能达成协议，宣告破裂，但是和谈不久会重开。
ext.ext_en: Peace talks involving other rebel leaders and government representatives broke up without agreement last week, but are due to resume shortly...

ext.ext_cn: 上周，一些敌对派系领导人签订了和平协议。
ext.ext_en: Leaders of some rival factions signed a peace agreement last week...

defs.def_en: If countries or groups involved in a war or violent conflict are discussing peace, they are talking to each other in order to try to end the conflict.

ext.ext_cn: 总统提到了共同致力于世界和平和经济发展。
ext.ext_en: The President spoke of a shared commitment to world peace and economic development.

ext.ext_cn: 诺贝尔和平奖
ext.ext_en: ...the Nobel Peace Prize.

defs.def_en: If there is peace in a country or in the world, there  are no wars or violent conflicts going on.

defs.def_cn: 和平运动；裁军运动（尤指核裁军运动）

ext.ext_cn: 被控破坏一架F1-11核轰炸机的两名和平运动者
ext.ext_en: ...two peace campaigners accused of causing damage to an F1-11 nuclear bomber...

ext.ext_cn: 他为裁军运动和反对核武器扩散而奔走。
ext.ext_en: He campaigned for peace and against the spread of nuclear weapons.

defs.def_en: If you disapprove of weapons, especially nuclear weapons, you can use peace to refer to campaigns and other activities intended to reduce their numbers or stop their use.

ext.ext_cn: 我就想清静一下，和孙子孙女们一起好好呆几天。
ext.ext_en: All I want is to have some peace and quiet and spend a couple of nice days with my grandchildren...

ext.ext_cn: 再问一个问题，我就不打扰你了。
ext.ext_en: One more question and I'll leave you in peace.

defs.def_en: If you have peace, you are not being disturbed, and you are in calm, quiet surroundings.

ext.ext_cn: 看到我丈夫时，我有一种异常平静安详的奇妙感觉。
ext.ext_en: I had a wonderful feeling of peace and serenity when I saw my husband...

ext.ext_cn: 愿主的平和与你永在。
ext.ext_en: The peace of the Lord be always with you...

defs.def_en: If you have a feeling of peace, you feel contented and calm and not at all worried. You can also say that you are at peace.

ext.ext_cn: 该国劳资关系相对和睦的一段时期
ext.ext_en: ...a period of relative peace in the country's industrial relations...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你没法和你弟弟和睦相处，就滚出这座房子。
ext.ext_en: If you can't live in peace with your little brother then get out of the house.

defs.def_en: If there is peace among a group of people, they live or work together in a friendly way and do not quarrel. You can also say that people live or work in peace with each other.

ext.ext_cn: 《里斯维克和约》签订于1697年9月。
ext.ext_en: The Peace of Ryswick was signed in September 1697.

defs.def_en: The Peace of a particular place is a treaty or an agreement that was signed there, bringing an end to a war.

ext.ext_cn: 了解这个恶棍却默不作声的人们
ext.ext_en: ...people who knew about this evil man but held their peace...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得保持沉默、做一名专心的听众比较明智。
ext.ext_en: I felt it politic to keep my peace and play the part of the attentive listener.

defs.def_en: If you hold or keep your peace, you do not speak, even though there is something you want or ought to say.

ext.ext_cn: 派往柬埔寨协助维持治安的第一批联合国分遣队
ext.ext_en: ...the first UN contingent assigned to help keep the peace in Cambodia...

ext.ext_cn: 你母亲是如何做到让这两个性格迥异的男人相安无事的？
ext.ext_en: How did your mother succeed in keeping the peace between these two very different men?

defs.def_en: If someone in authority, such as the army or the police, keeps the peace, they make sure that people behave and do not fight or quarrel with each other.

ext.ext_cn: 示威者一定要遵纪守法。
ext.ext_en: The demonstrators were bound over to keep the peace.

defs.def_en: If the law requires you to keep the peace, you must behave well and not cause any trouble in public.

ext.ext_cn: 总统应该抓住这个机会与各政党握手言好，协商尽快恢复民主。
ext.ext_en: The President ought to seize this opportunity to make his peace with political parties and negotiate a speedy return to democracy...

ext.ext_cn: 突然她似乎想要和好，结束我们之间的争吵。
ext.ext_en: All of a sudden she seemed to want to make peace and patch up our quarrel.

defs.def_en: If you make peace with someone or make your peace with them, you put an end to your quarrel with them, often by apologizing.

ext.ext_cn: 这些债券对个人投资者的主要吸引力在于其安全性，令人放心。
ext.ext_en: The main appeal these bonds hold for individual investors is the safety and peace of mind they offer...

ext.ext_cn: 他开始坚持要防弹豪华轿车，仅仅是为了安心而已。
ext.ext_en: He began to insist upon a bullet-proof limousine, just for peace of mind.

defs.def_en: If something gives you peace of mind, it stops you from worrying about a particular problem or difficulty.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦我知道自己得到了宽恕，便可以心平气和了。
ext.ext_en: Once I knew I was forgiven I could be at peace with myself at last...

ext.ext_cn: 他们令你放松，让你觉得与世无争。
ext.ext_en: They make you relax. They make you feel at peace with the world.

defs.def_en: If you are at peace with yourself or at peace with the world, you feel calm and contented, and you have no emotional conflicts within yourself or with other people.

ext.ext_cn: 我在接受护理培训的时候开始对伊斯兰教产生了兴趣。
ext.ext_en: I first became interested in Islam while I was doing my nursing training...

ext.ext_cn: 由于越来越难以收回成本，可可产业日渐衰落。
ext.ext_en: The cocoa industry dwindled because it became increasingly difficult to cover costs...

defs.def_en: If someone or something becomes a particular thing, they start to change and develop into that thing, or start to develop the characteristics mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 卡其布适合你吗？
ext.ext_en: Does khaki become you?...

ext.ext_cn: 今晚别说荤话，伯纳德，说荤话可不好。
ext.ext_en: Don't be crude tonight, Bernard, it doesn't  become you.

defs.def_en: If something becomes someone, it makes them look attractive or it seems right for them.

ext.ext_cn: 她一直挂念着家人；她也许再也听不到他们的消息了。
ext.ext_en: She thought constantly about her family; she might never know what had become of them...

ext.ext_cn: 现在他被伊顿公学开除了，他去哪儿上学呢？他将来又会怎样呢？
ext.ext_en: Where will he go to school now he's been thrown out of Eton? What will become of him?

defs.def_en: If you wonder what has become of someone or something, you wonder where they are and what has happened to them.

ext.ext_cn: 一串香蕉
ext.ext_en: ...a bunch of bananas.

defs.def_en: Bananas are long curved fruit with yellow skins.

ext.ext_cn: 人们闷得发狂。
ext.ext_en: People went bananas with boredom...

ext.ext_cn: 亚当森会被这个气疯的。
ext.ext_en: Adamson's going to go bananas on this one.

defs.def_en: If someone is behaving in a silly or crazy way, or if they become extremely angry, you can say that they are going bananas .

defs.def_cn: (尤指讨论重大公共问题的)论坛，会议场所，讨论会

ext.ext_cn: 理事会成员一致认为它仍然发挥着论坛的重要作用。
ext.ext_en: Members of the council agreed that it still had an important role as a forum for discussion...

ext.ext_cn: 这个组织将提供一个可以讨论问题的平台。
ext.ext_en: The organisation would provide a forum where problems could be discussed.

defs.def_en: A forum is a place, situation, or group in which people exchange ideas and discuss issues, especially important public issues.

defs.def_cn: (古罗马城镇中讨论商业和政治问题的)广场
defs.def_en: In ancient Roman towns, the forum was a square where people met to discuss business and political matters.

defs.def_cn: 将(书或故事)改编成剧本;将…搬上舞台(或银幕);用戏剧形式表现

ext.ext_cn: 后来被改编成电影《太空先锋》的事件
ext.ext_en: ...an incident later dramatized in the movie 'The Right Stuff'.

ext.ext_cn: 小说的改编剧版本
ext.ext_en: ...a dramatised version of the novel.

defs.def_en: If a book or story is dramatized, it is written or presented as a play, film, or television drama.

defs.def_cn: 使戏剧化;戏剧性地表现;夸张

ext.ext_cn: 他们爱炫耀，几乎对每种情况都添油加醋。
ext.ext_en: They have a tendency to show off, to dramatize almost every situation.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone dramatizes a situation or event, you mean that they try to make it seem more serious, more important, or more exciting than it really is.

defs.def_cn: 使引人注目;使扣人心弦

ext.ext_cn: 400 多名流亡者举行从早到晚的绝食抗议来让人们关注他们的苦难。
ext.ext_en: More than 400 exiles were on a dawn-to-dusk hunger strike to dramatize their plight...

ext.ext_cn: 改革的必要性由于银行利润的暴跌而凸显。
ext.ext_en: The need for change has been dramatized by plummeting bank profits.

defs.def_en: If something that happens or is done dramatizes a situation, it focuses people's attention on the situation in a dramatic way.

defs.def_cn: 它(指物体、动物或上文已提及的其他事物)

ext.ext_cn: 他看见那辆灰色的路虎越野车停在不远处的边道上,离他一百码开外。
ext.ext_en: He saw the grey Land-Rover down the bypass. It was more than a hundred yards from him...

ext.ext_cn: 这真是一座很棒的城市,如果你愿意的话我领你看看。
ext.ext_en: It's a wonderful city, really. I'll show it to you if you want...

defs.def_en: You use it to refer to an object, animal, or other thing that has already been mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 如果她愿意,她可以通过法庭强制他在孩子出生以后抚养孩子。
ext.ext_en: She could, if she wanted, compel him, through a court of law, to support the child after it was born...

ext.ext_cn: 他把孩子向空中高高抛起,孩子就停止了哭闹。
ext.ext_en: He threw the baby high in the air and it stopped crying.

defs.def_en: You use it to refer to a child or baby whose sex you do not know or whose sex is not relevant to what you are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 他放弃了体育运动,不是因为被迫而是出于自愿。
ext.ext_en: He was through with sports, not because he had to be but because he wanted it that way...

ext.ext_cn: 安东尼娅不会嫉妒,即便嫉妒,她也不会表现出来。
ext.ext_en: Antonia will not be jealous, or if she is, she will not show it.

defs.def_en: You use it to refer in a general way to a situation that you have just described.

defs.def_cn: (用于某些名词、形容词、动词前说明对某情况的感受、观点)

ext.ext_cn: 再次见到史蒂夫真是太好了。
ext.ext_en: It was nice to see Steve again...

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉,你没结过婚真是遗憾啊。
ext.ext_en: It's a pity you never got married, Sarah...

defs.def_en: You use it before certain nouns, adjectives, and verbs to introduce your feelings or point of view about a situation.

defs.def_cn: (用于被动句中引出一个情况或事件)

ext.ext_cn: 据说压力会引发癌症。
ext.ext_en: It has been said that stress causes cancer...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天据报道有很多人在首都被捕。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday it was reported that a number of people had been arrested in the capital...

defs.def_en: You use it in passive clauses which report a situation or event.

defs.def_cn: (与动词连用,作形式主语或宾语)

ext.ext_cn: 当然,结果是那群人中 3/4 是精神病学家。
ext.ext_en: Of course, as it turned out, three-fourths of the people in the group were psychiatrists...

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢这里。
ext.ext_en: I like it here...

defs.def_en: You use it with some verbs that need a subject or object, although there is no noun that it refers to.

defs.def_cn: (用作 be动词的主语,指钟点、星期、日期)

ext.ext_cn: 现在是凌晨 3 点整。
ext.ext_en: It's three o'clock in the morning...

ext.ext_cn: 那天是星期一,因此她在家里。
ext.ext_en: It was a Monday, so she was at home...

defs.def_en: You use it as the subject of 'be', to say what the time, day, or date is.

defs.def_cn: (用作系动词的主语，描述天气、光线或温度)

ext.ext_cn: 那天风雨交加,我开车翻过小山去米兰德。
ext.ext_en: It was very wet and windy the day I drove over the hill to Milland...

ext.ext_cn: 天色暗下来了,我们进去吧。
ext.ext_en: It's getting dark. Let's go inside...

defs.def_en: You use it as the subject of a link verb to describe the weather, the light, or the temperature.

defs.def_cn: (尤用于刚接通电话时询问、告知身份)

ext.ext_cn: “是谁啊?”他问道。——“是你的邻居。”
ext.ext_en: 'Who is it?' he called. — 'It's your neighbor.'...

ext.ext_cn: 你好,弗蕾迪！是我,玛克辛。
ext.ext_en: Hello Freddy, it's only me, Maxine.

defs.def_en: You use it when you are telling someone who you are, or asking them who they are, especially at the beginning of a phone call. You also use it in statements and questions about the identity of other people.

defs.def_cn: (与动词 be 连用，强调突出某物)

ext.ext_cn: 确实是那些没有经济基础的穷国的环境记录最差。
ext.ext_en: It's really the poor countries that don't have an economic base that have the worst environmental records...

ext.ext_cn: 是该国的执政者创造了这一体制。
ext.ext_en: It was the country's rulers who devised this system...

defs.def_en: When you are emphasizing or drawing attention to something, you can put that thing immediately after it and a form of the verb 'be'.

defs.def_cn: 并不是因为/不仅仅因为

ext.ext_cn: 并不是我不想和家人在一起。
ext.ext_en: It's not that I didn't want to be with my family...

ext.ext_cn: 不仅仅是生活水平上存在巨大差异，心理上也有鸿沟。
ext.ext_en: It's not just that a gulf exists in living standards — there's a psychological ravine.

defs.def_en: You use it in expressions such as it's not that or it's not simply that when you are giving a reason for something and are suggesting that there are several other reasons.
If you say that someone thinks they're it, you mean that they think they are better or more important than they really are.

defs.def_cn: （犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教中的）大天使，天使长
defs.def_en: In the Jewish, Christian, and Muslim religions, an archangel is an angel of the highest rank.

ext.ext_cn: 我十几岁时增加的体重一直没有减下去。
ext.ext_en: I have never lost the weight I put on in my teens...

ext.ext_cn: 他从未如此无忧无虑过。
ext.ext_en: Never had he been so free of worry...

defs.def_en: Never means at no time in the past or at no time in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 我决不会做任何伤害他的事情。
ext.ext_en: I would never do anything to hurt him...

ext.ext_cn: 即使你想结婚想得发狂，也决不要表现出来。
ext.ext_en: Even if you are desperate to get married, never let it show...

defs.def_en: Never means 'not in any circumstances at all'.

defs.def_cn: 永不，永无，从未(never的强调说法)

ext.ext_cn: 我从不闲坐着琢磨：“我接下来做什么呢？”
ext.ext_en: I never, ever sit around thinking, 'What shall I do next?'...

ext.ext_cn: 他已发誓再也不当众谈论任何个人的事情，永远不。
ext.ext_en: He's vowed never ever to talk about anything personal in public, ever again.

defs.def_en: Never ever is an emphatic way of saying 'never'.

ext.ext_cn: 他从没有取得任何成就。
ext.ext_en: He never achieved anything...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直等到所有的行李都拿走了，但始终没看见葆拉的。
ext.ext_en: He waited until all the luggage was cleared, but Paula's never appeared...

defs.def_en: Never is used to refer to the past and means 'not'.
You say 'never!' to indicate how surprised or shocked you are by something that someone has just said.

defs.def_cn: (表示惊讶)我真没看到(或发现、想到)过

ext.ext_cn: “你在那儿干什么？”——“我是信息部的负责人。”——“啊，真没想到!”
ext.ext_en: 'What were you up to there?' — 'I was head of the information department.' — 'Well I never!'

defs.def_en: You say 'Well, I never' to indicate that you are very surprised about something that you have just seen or found out.

defs.def_cn: (经常为幽默地表示)不好，不行，不合适

ext.ext_cn: 亨利呆在她的公寓里怎么也不合适。
ext.ext_en: It would never do to have Henry there in her apartment...

ext.ext_cn: 我本人不认为这是篇糟糕的文章，否则我就和利维斯看法一样了，那可不行。
ext.ext_en: I don't think it is an example of bad writing myself, otherwise I'd be agreeing with Leavis, and that would never do.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will never do or would never do, you are saying, often humorously, that you think it is not appropriate or not suitable in some way.

defs.def_cn: （尤指流行音乐的）键盘乐器演奏者
defs.def_en: A keyboardist is someone who plays keyboard instruments, especially in popular music.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不偏不倚的;公正的;无偏见的

ext.ext_cn: 作为中立的观察员,我的分析应该客观。
ext.ext_en: As an impartial observer my analysis is supposed to be objective...

ext.ext_cn: 就业指导员向所有学生提供公正无私的建议。
ext.ext_en: Careers officers offer impartial advice to all pupils.

defs.def_en: Someone who is impartial is not directly involved in a particular situation, and is therefore able to give a fair opinion or decision about it.

ext.ext_cn: 米基喜欢长度及膝的紧身短裙。
ext.ext_en: Mickey favoured tight skirts with a hemline at the knee.

defs.def_en: The hemline of a dress or skirt is its lower edge. People sometimes use hemline to talk about how long a dress or skirt is.

ext.ext_cn: 这项政策注定会失败。
ext.ext_en: This policy is doomed to failure...

ext.ext_cn: 对英国 200 米纪录发起的3 次冲击也均以失败而告终。
ext.ext_en: Three attempts on the British 200-metre record also ended in failure.

defs.def_en: Failure is a lack of success in doing or achieving something, especially in relation to a particular activity.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的婚姻很失败，两人都想摆脱它。
ext.ext_en: The marriage was a failure and they both wanted to be free of it...

ext.ext_cn: 他的六年转型计划绝没有彻底失败。
ext.ext_en: His six-year transition programme has by no means been a complete failure.

defs.def_en: If something is a failure, it is not a success.

ext.ext_cn: 人们对埃尔加赞誉有加，但他却常觉得自己是个失败者。
ext.ext_en: Elgar received many honors and much acclaim and yet he often considered himself a failure...

ext.ext_cn: 我就是觉得我的个人生活很失败。
ext.ext_en: I just felt I had been a failure in my personal life.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a failure, you mean that they have not succeeded in a particular activity, or that they are unsuccessful at everything they do.

ext.ext_cn: 她指责说，外交部未能给在海外被捕的英国公民提供支持是可耻的。
ext.ext_en: She accused the Foreign Office of disgraceful failure to support British citizens arrested overseas.

ext.ext_cn: 他们没有把产品组合弄对
ext.ext_en: ...their failure to get the product mix right.

defs.def_en: Your failure to do a particular thing is the fact that you do not do it, even though you were expected to do it.

defs.def_cn: (机器的)故障，失灵;(身体机能的)衰竭

ext.ext_cn: 还有几次事故主要是起飞时引擎出现故障造成的。
ext.ext_en: There were also several accidents mainly caused by engine failures on take-off...

ext.ext_cn: 他因肾衰竭正在接受治疗。
ext.ext_en: He was being treated for kidney failure...

defs.def_en: If there is a failure of something, for example a machine or part of the body, it goes wrong and stops working or developing properly.

ext.ext_cn: 上个月倒闭公司的数量上升了 16％。
ext.ext_en: Business failures rose 16% last month.

defs.def_en: If there is a failure of a business or bank, it is no longer able to continue operating.

ext.ext_cn: 还有，就是纯粹缺乏想象力。
ext.ext_en: There is, too, a simple failure of imagination...

ext.ext_cn: 他后来在地上跪了很久，为自己缺乏胆量而感到羞耻。
ext.ext_en: He remained on his knees for a long time afterwards, ashamed by his failure of nerve.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a failure of a particular quality or ability, you mean that they do not have enough of it.

ext.ext_cn: 靠养老金苦苦支撑
ext.ext_en: ...struggling by on a pension.

ext.ext_cn: 公司养老金计划
ext.ext_en: ...a company pension scheme.

defs.def_en: Someone who has a pension receives a regular sum of money from the state or from a former employer because they have retired or because they are widowed or disabled.

defs.def_cn: 在西南方的;西南的;向西南部的

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰最西南部
ext.ext_en: ...the most south-westerly tip of Scotland.

defs.def_en: A south-westerly point, area, or direction is to the south-west or towards the south-west.
A south-westerly wind is a wind that blows from the south-west.

ext.ext_cn: 其中一条私人车道上，一位穿着橡胶靴的专职司机正用水管冲洗一辆豪华轿车。
ext.ext_en: In one driveway a chauffeur wearing rubber boots was hosing down a limousine...

ext.ext_cn: 当孩子全身沾满沙子进门时，你可以直接用水龙带将他们冲洗干净。
ext.ext_en: When the children come in covered in sand you can just hose them down.

defs.def_en: When you hose something or someone down, you clean them using a hose.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的观点很诚恳。
ext.ext_en: He's sincere in his views...

ext.ext_cn: 他接受了她真诚的道歉。
ext.ext_en: He accepted her apologies as sincere...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is sincere, you approve of them because they really mean the things they say. You can also describe someone's behaviour and beliefs as sincere .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 辉煌的;灿烂的;艳丽的;动人的

ext.ext_cn: 他冲着阿尔伯格粲然一笑。
ext.ext_en: He gave Alberg a dazzling smile.

defs.def_en: Something that is dazzling is very impressive or beautiful.

ext.ext_cn: 他用手遮挡眼前落日耀眼的余晖。
ext.ext_en: He shielded his eyes against the dazzling declining sun.

defs.def_en: A dazzling light is very bright and makes you unable to see properly for a short time.

ext.ext_cn: 手头无法获得应急支持。
ext.ext_en: There is no emergency back-up immediately available...

ext.ext_cn: 替代疗法能为传统的治疗提供有效的辅助。
ext.ext_en: Alternative treatments can provide a useful back-up to conventional treatment.

defs.def_en: Backup consists of extra equipment, resources, or people that you can get help or support from if necessary.

ext.ext_cn: 系统的每个部分都有备用元件。
ext.ext_en: Every part of the system has a backup...

ext.ext_cn: 计算机使用者应该定期对自己的工作进行备份。
ext.ext_en: Computer users should make regular back-up copies of their work.

defs.def_en: If you have something such as a  second piece of equipment or set of plans as backup, you have arranged for them to be available for use in case the first one does not work.

ext.ext_cn: 医生们尝试用通便药物催泻以使他退烧。
ext.ext_en: The doctors attempted to reduce his high fever by inducing diarrhea with a purgative.

defs.def_en: A purgative is a medicine that causes you to get rid of unwanted waste from your body.

ext.ext_cn: 通便油
ext.ext_en: ...purgative oils.

ext.ext_cn: 通便茶
ext.ext_en: ...a purgative tea.

defs.def_en: A purgative substance acts as a purgative.

ext.ext_cn: 只好用了起重机，才将轿车从河里拖出来。
ext.ext_en: A crane had to be used to haul the car out of the stream...

ext.ext_cn: 他吃力地站了起来。
ext.ext_en: He hauled himself to his feet...

defs.def_en: If you haul something which is heavy or difficult to move, you move it using a lot of effort.

defs.def_cn: 使出庭受审;使去见掌权者

ext.ext_cn: 她因拒绝告诉警察自己的年龄而被地方法院传讯。
ext.ext_en: She was hauled before magistrates for refusing to reveal her age to a policeman...

ext.ext_cn: 他被叫去见总裁，然后就被解雇了。
ext.ext_en: He was hauled before the managing director and fired.

defs.def_en: If someone is hauled before a court or someone in authority, they are made to appear before them because they are accused of having done something wrong.

defs.def_cn: （警方或海关查获的）一批赃物，一批违禁品

ext.ext_cn: 本次查获的毒品量表明，海洛因在国际上的交易仍很猖獗。
ext.ext_en: The size of the drugs haul shows that the international trade in heroin is still flourishing...

ext.ext_cn: 另一次入室盗窃偷得了价值4,000英镑的首饰。
ext.ext_en: Another break-in yielded a £4,000 haul of jewellery.

defs.def_en: A haul is a quantity of things that are stolen, or a quantity of stolen or illegal goods found by police or customs.

defs.def_cn: 费时费力的事;耗时累人的行程

ext.ext_cn: 罗马尼亚经济的复兴将是一项长期而艰巨的工作。
ext.ext_en: Revitalising the Romanian economy will be a long haul.

defs.def_en: See also:long-haul;If you say that a task or a journey is a long haul, you mean that it takes a long time and a lot of effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指孩子）没教养的，难控制的，难管束的

ext.ext_cn: 对难管教的孩子只是责备是不够的。
ext.ext_en: It's not good enough just to blame the unruly children.

ext.ext_cn: 没教养的行为
ext.ext_en: ...unruly behaviour.

defs.def_en: If you describe people, especially children, as unruly, you mean that they behave badly and are difficult to control.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那个人有一头乱蓬蓬的黑发。
ext.ext_en: The man had a huge head of remarkably black, unruly hair.

defs.def_en: Unruly hair is difficult to keep tidy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 喝了容易上头的烈酒
ext.ext_en: ...intoxicating liquor.

defs.def_en: Intoxicating drink contains alcohol and can make you drunk.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人陶醉的;令人极其兴奋的

ext.ext_cn: 百合花的沁人芳香
ext.ext_en: ...the intoxicating fragrance of lilies...

ext.ext_cn: 音乐在有节奏地响着,气氛令人陶醉。
ext.ext_en: The music is pulsating and the atmosphere is intoxicating.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as intoxicating, you mean that it makes you feel a strong sense of excitement or happiness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他决定和爱人一起过一种更加安定的生活。
ext.ext_en: He decided to lead a more settled life with his partner...

ext.ext_cn: 他的房子是我儿时唯一固定的家。
ext.ext_en: His house was the only settled home I had as a child.

defs.def_en: If you have a settled way of life, you stay in one place, in one job, or with one person, rather than moving around or changing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (情况、制度等)固定不变的，无变化的

ext.ext_cn: 猫是一种有固定习性的动物，它们似乎喜欢过一种有规律的生活。
ext.ext_en: Cats are creatures of habit — they seem to appreciate a settled routine...

ext.ext_cn: 天气最近一段时间一直没有变化。
ext.ext_en: There has been a period of settled weather.

defs.def_en: A settled situation or system stays the same all the time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (因长期在某地生活或工作)舒适自在的，适应的,习惯的

ext.ext_cn: 做了几年外交官后，她还是没有适应。
ext.ext_en: After a few years of being a diplomat, she still didn't feel settled.

defs.def_en: If you feel settled, you have been living or working in a place long enough to feel comfortable there.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone sports something such as a distinctive item of clothing, you mean that they wear it without any shyness.

defs.def_cn: 辐射能;放射能;（尤指）热能

ext.ext_en: The satellite will study energy radiation from stars.

ext.ext_en: Some executive members have called for his resignation.

defs.def_en: The executive committee or board of an organization is a committee within that organization which has the authority to make decisions and ensures that these decisions are carried out.

ext.ext_en: The government, the executive and the judiciary are supposed to be separate...

ext.ext_en: The matter should be resolved by the executive branch of government.

defs.def_en: The executive is the part of the government of a country that is concerned with carrying out decisions or orders, as opposed to the part that makes laws or the part that deals with criminals.

ext.ext_en: ...the development of a more adaptable, multi-skilled workforce, capable of moving with the times...

defs.def_en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

ext.ext_en: Solids turn to liquids at certain temperatures.

defs.def_en: A solid is a substance that stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

ext.ext_en: The concrete will stay as solid as a rock.

defs.def_en: If an object is made of solid gold or solid wood, for example, it is made of gold or wood all the way through, rather than just on the outside.

ext.ext_en: Banks are built to look solid to reassure their customers...

ext.ext_cn: 这部车子令人感觉十分皮实。
