ext.ext_en: A crew was sent down the shaft to close it off and bail out all the water...

defs.def_en: If you bail, you use a container to remove water from a boat or from a place which is flooded.

defs.def_cn: （囚犯）在保释期间逃跑，弃保潜逃

ext.ext_cn: 去年他在因涉毒被控告期间弃保潜逃。
ext.ext_en: He had jumped bail last year while being tried on drug charges.

defs.def_en: If a prisoner jumps bail, he or she does not come back for his or her trial after being released on bail.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 易变的;动荡不定的;反复无常的

ext.ext_cn: 以前曾发生过暴乱，现在局势不太稳定。
ext.ext_en: There have been riots before and the situation is volatile...

ext.ext_cn: 从20世纪70年代初开始，国际石油市场就一直很不稳定。
ext.ext_en: The international oil markets have been highly volatile since the early 1970s...

defs.def_en: A situation that is volatile is likely to change suddenly and unexpectedly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 第二年他陪着这位情绪无常的女演员去了好莱坞。
ext.ext_en: He accompanied the volatile actress to Hollywood the following year...

ext.ext_cn: 他脾气反复无常。
ext.ext_en: He has a volatile temper.

defs.def_en: If someone is volatile, their mood often changes quickly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （液体等物质）易挥发的，易发散的

ext.ext_cn: 人们认为，易挥发的化学物质爆炸时产生了冲击波。
ext.ext_en: It's thought that the blast occurred when volatile chemicals exploded.

defs.def_en: A volatile liquid or substance is one that will quickly change into a gas.

ext.ext_cn: 这些机器将来会需要备件和维修保养。
ext.ext_en: In the future the machines will need spare parts and maintenance.

defs.def_en: Spare parts are parts that you can buy separately to replace old or broken parts in a piece of equipment. They are usually parts that are designed to be easily removed or fitted.

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经出海去捕鲭鱼。
ext.ext_en: They'd gone out to fish for mackerel.

ext.ext_cn: 干月桂叶是烹制鲭鱼肉极佳的调味料。
ext.ext_en: Bay leaf is an excellent herb for mackerel.

defs.def_en: A mackerel is a sea fish with a dark, patterned back.

defs.def_cn: 装腔作势的人；装模作样的人

ext.ext_cn: 有时有人说我惯于装模作样。
ext.ext_en: I am sometimes accused of being an inveterate poseur.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone as a poseur when you think that they behave in an insincere or exaggerated way because they want to make a particular impression on other people.

ext.ext_cn: 整个调查过程中他们都有礼有节，对我很尊重。
ext.ext_en: I was treated with decorum and respect throughout the investigation.

defs.def_en: Decorum is behaviour that people consider to be correct, polite, and respectable.

ext.ext_cn: 当我们往下走去地窖时，四周愈见阴冷潮湿。
ext.ext_en: Things are cooler and more damp as we descend to the cellar...

ext.ext_cn: 她走下了一段楼梯。
ext.ext_en: She descended one flight of stairs.

defs.def_en: If you descend or if you descend a staircase, you move downwards from a higher to a lower level.

ext.ext_cn: 一种令人不安的平静笼罩了该地区。
ext.ext_en: An uneasy calm descended on the area...

ext.ext_cn: 人群虔敬地噤了声。
ext.ext_en: A reverent hush descended on the multitude.

defs.def_en: When a mood or atmosphere descends on a place or on the people there, it affects them by spreading among them.

ext.ext_cn: 3,000名市政官员齐聚国会山，为筹集更多的款项进行游说。
ext.ext_en: 3,000 city officials descended on Capitol Hill to lobby for more money...

ext.ext_cn: 好奇的游客和记者从世界各地一齐涌向这些平静的村落。
ext.ext_en: Curious tourists and reporters from around the globe are descending upon the peaceful villages.

defs.def_en: If a large group of people arrive to see you, especially if their visit is unexpected or causes you a lot of work, you can say that they have descended on you.

ext.ext_cn: 夜幕现在已经降临，晴朗的天空里月影婆娑，星光朦胧。
ext.ext_en: Darkness has now descended and the moon and stars shine hazily in the clear sky.

defs.def_en: When night, dusk, or darkness descends, it starts to get dark.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不会沦落到使用这种手段。
ext.ext_en: We're not going to descend to such methods...

ext.ext_cn: 她是个自尊心很强的人，绝不会自贬身份去写匿名信。
ext.ext_en: She's got too much dignity to descend to writing anonymous letters.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone descends to behaviour which you consider unacceptable, you are expressing your disapproval of the fact that they do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他最终被推翻，整个国家则陷入了混乱。
ext.ext_en: He was ultimately overthrown and the country descended into chaos.

defs.def_en: When you want to emphasize that the situation that someone is entering is very bad, you can say that they are descending into that situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不赞成的;表示反对的;不以为然的

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮特不满地看了他一眼。
ext.ext_en: Janet gave him a disapproving look.

defs.def_en: A disapproving action or expression shows that you do not approve of something or someone.

ext.ext_cn: 镇上的警察穿着深蓝色制服，戴着鸭舌帽。
ext.ext_en: The town police wear dark blue uniforms and flat caps...

ext.ext_cn: 菲利普身着制服，腰带上别着手枪皮套。
ext.ext_en: Philippe was in uniform, wearing a pistol holster on his belt...

defs.def_en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school.

ext.ext_cn: 马克一身年轻男性旅行者的典型行头——绿军裤、T恤外加衬衫。
ext.ext_en: Mark's is the uniform of the young male traveller — green Army trousers, T-shirt and shirt.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the particular style of clothing which a group of people wear to show they belong to a group or a movement as their uniform.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （同一物）始终如一的，均匀的，划一的

ext.ext_cn: 土豆条要切得大小厚薄均匀。
ext.ext_en: Chips should be cut into uniform size and thickness...

ext.ext_cn: 所有流动的水看似一成不变，但实际上内部分成许多广延的面，或者说层，彼此逆向移动。
ext.ext_en: All flowing water, though it appears to be uniform, is actually divided into extensive inner surfaces, or layers, moving against one another...

defs.def_en: If something is uniform, it does not vary, but is even and regular throughout.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （不同物）全都相同的，一律的，清一色的

ext.ext_cn: 每面墙边都一溜摆着相同的绿色金属档案柜。
ext.ext_en: Along each wall stretched uniform green metal filing cabinets...

ext.ext_cn: 虾放养在清一色的长池子里，再送到附近的包装车间冷冻，最后用船运往北方。
ext.ext_en: Shrimp are raised in long uniform ponds, frozen in the nearby packing plant and shipped north.

defs.def_en: If you describe a number of things as uniform, you mean that they are all the same.
A piggy bank is a small container shaped like a pig, with a narrow hole in the top through which to put coins. Children often use piggy banks to save money.

defs.def_cn: 基层群众；平民百姓;草根阶层

ext.ext_cn: 你得参加基层党组织。
ext.ext_en: You have to join the party at grass-roots level.

defs.def_en: The grass roots of an organization or movement are the ordinary people who form the main part of it, rather than its leaders.

ext.ext_cn: “这里热死了，”米里亚姆抱怨道。
ext.ext_en: 'It's boiling in here,' complained Miriam...

ext.ext_cn: 食物常常是表面滚烫，而里面可能还是凉的。
ext.ext_en: Often the food may be bubbling and boiling hot on the top, but the inside may still be cold.

defs.def_en: Something that is boiling or boiling hot is very hot.

defs.def_cn: 感觉极热的；热得难受的

ext.ext_cn: 当其他所有人都酷热难耐时，我却冻得够呛！
ext.ext_en: When everybody else is boiling hot, I'm freezing!

defs.def_en: If you say that you are boiling or boiling hot, you mean that you feel very hot, usually unpleasantly hot.  →see usage note at:hot

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 经济学在经济预测方面的分支
ext.ext_en: ...the predictive branch of economics.

defs.def_en: You use predictive to describe something such as a test, science, or theory that is concerned with determining what will happen in the future.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 试验性的空调系统
ext.ext_en: ...an experimental air conditioning system...

ext.ext_cn: 他倾向于创作高度试验性而且风格奇异的音乐作品。
ext.ext_en: He tends to write bizarre and highly experimental pieces of music...

defs.def_en: Something that is experimental is new or uses new ideas or methods, and might be modified later if it is unsuccessful.

defs.def_cn: 实验的;用于实验的;根据实验的

ext.ext_cn: 实验科学的主要技术
ext.ext_en: ...the main techniques of experimental science.

ext.ext_cn: 实验动物的使用
ext.ext_en: ...the use of experimental animals...

defs.def_en: Experimental means using, used in, or resulting from scientific experiments.

ext.ext_cn: 据报道，英国体育大臣准备争取试行取消那条禁令。
ext.ext_en: The British Sports Minister is reported to be ready to argue for an experimental lifting of the ban.

defs.def_en: An experimental action is done in order to see what it is like, or what effects it has.

ext.ext_cn: 上诉法院在英格兰司法体系中起着中心作用。
ext.ext_en: The Court of Appeal has a pivotal role in the English legal system...

ext.ext_cn: 这一选举可能成为哥伦比亚政治史上关键的一次。
ext.ext_en: The elections may prove to be pivotal in Colombia's political history.

defs.def_en: A pivotal role, point or figure in something is one that is very important and affects the success of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在需要大力改革中学，以便与我们在小学里所取得的成果同步。
ext.ext_en: We now need a step change in our secondary schools to match that achieved in our primaries.

defs.def_en: A step change is a sudden or major change in the way that something happens or the way that someone behaves.

ext.ext_cn: 对他们死因的讯问昨天在恩尼斯基林进行。
ext.ext_en: The inquest into their deaths opened yesterday in Enniskillen.

defs.def_en: When an inquest is held, a public official hears evidence about someone's death in order to find out the cause.

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚政党领袖就选举惨败原因进行调查时,他提出了申辩。
ext.ext_en: His plea came last night as party chiefs held an inquest into the election disaster.

defs.def_en: You can refer to an investigation by the people involved into the causes of a defeat or failure as an inquest .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无同情心的;铁石心肠的

ext.ext_cn: 铁石心肠的杀手
ext.ext_en: ...a cold-hearted killer.

defs.def_en: A cold-hearted person does not feel any affection or sympathy towards other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: A tautological statement involves tautology.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 戴眼镜的瘦弱青年
ext.ext_en: ...a puny, bespectacled youth...

ext.ext_cn: 中央银行掌握的资金实在太少了。
ext.ext_en: The resources at the central banks' disposal are simply too puny.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is puny is very small or weak.

ext.ext_cn: 修改宪法是议会独有的权力。
ext.ext_en: Constitutional changes are exclusively the prerogative of the parliament...

ext.ext_cn: 你有权决定不再去看那个治疗师而另找一个。
ext.ext_en: It is your prerogative to stop seeing that particular therapist and find another one.

defs.def_en: If something is the prerogative of a particular person or group, it is a privilege or a power that only they have.

ext.ext_cn: X射线能够穿透很多物体。
ext.ext_en: X-rays can penetrate many objects...

ext.ext_cn: 他的部下已经接到命令，见到试图穿越该地区的人就开枪。
ext.ext_en: His men had been ordered to shoot on sight anyone trying to penetrate the area.

defs.def_en: If something or someone penetrates a physical object or an area, they succeed in getting into it or passing through it.

ext.ext_cn: 女性一直未能跻身工程领域的更高层
ext.ext_en: ...the continuing failure of women to penetrate the higher levels of engineering...

ext.ext_cn: 医药行业非常复杂，很难进入。
ext.ext_en: The drugs industry is complex and hard to penetrate.

defs.def_en: If someone penetrates an organization, a group, or a profession, they succeed in entering it although it is difficult to do so.

defs.def_cn: 打入，渗透（敌人或竞争对手内部）

ext.ext_cn: 美国中央情报局已请求我们协助其打入在慕尼黑市外活动的贩毒集团。
ext.ext_en: The CIA had requested our help to penetrate a drugs ring operating out of Munich...

ext.ext_cn: 军队是不鼓励秘密警察渗入的少数机构之一。
ext.ext_en: The army was one of the few institutions the secret police were not encouraged to penetrate.

defs.def_en: If someone penetrates an enemy group or a rival organization, they succeed in joining it in order to get information or cause trouble.

ext.ext_cn: 大约已经有15家外国公司试图进入法国市场。
ext.ext_en: There have been around 15 attempts from outside France to penetrate the market.

defs.def_en: If a company or country penetrates a market or area, they succeed in selling their products there.

ext.ext_cn: 往往难以理解的冗长回答
ext.ext_en: ...long answers that were often difficult to penetrate.

defs.def_en: If you penetrate something that is difficult to understand, you succeed in understanding it.

ext.ext_cn: 他主诉肩胛骨之间有个地方总是疼。
ext.ext_en: He complained of a nagging pain between his shoulder blades.

ext.ext_cn: 顽固的头痛
ext.ext_en: ...nagging headaches.

defs.def_en: See also:nag;A nagging pain is not very severe but is difficult to cure.

ext.ext_cn: 游行示威的组织者承认他们并未申请批准这次活动。
ext.ext_en: The organisers of the demonstration concede that they hadn't sought permission for it...

ext.ext_cn: 为他作最后一刻游说以获取支持的竞选组织者
ext.ext_en: ...his campaign organisers who are canvassing for last minute support...

defs.def_en: See also:personal organizer;The organizer of an event or activity is the person who makes sure that the necessary arrangements are made.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为不值得为此花费那么多金钱和精力。
ext.ext_en: I don't think it's worth the money or the hassle...

ext.ext_cn: 婚礼真是件折腾人的事，办完后得好好休息才行。
ext.ext_en: Weddings are so much hassle that you need a good break afterwards.

defs.def_en: A hassle is a situation that is difficult and involves problems, effort, or arguments with people.

ext.ext_cn: 然后我丈夫开始不停地烦我。
ext.ext_en: Then my husband started hassling me...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你厌烦了不通情理的父母的喋喋不休，那就离开家自食其力吧。
ext.ext_en: If you are tired of being hassled by unreasonable parents, leave home and pay your own way.

defs.def_en: If someone hassles you, they cause problems for you, often by repeatedly telling you or asking you to do something, in an annoying way.
A concourse is a wide hall in a public building, for example a hotel, airport, or station.

ext.ext_cn: 这一大群人似乎也留下了同样深刻的印象。
ext.ext_en: The great concourse of people seemed to have been similarly impressed.

defs.def_en: A concourse is a large group of people gathered together.

ext.ext_cn: 使用类固醇的男人纯粹是受虚荣心的驱使。
ext.ext_en: Men who use steroids are motivated by sheer vanity...

ext.ext_cn: 由于我一贯的虚荣心作祟，我以为他可能爱上了我。
ext.ext_en: With my usual vanity, I thought he might be falling in love with me.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's vanity, you are critical of them because they take great pride in their appearance or abilities.

ext.ext_cn: 德雷克那一帮人对我的任命很不满。
ext.ext_en: Drake and his cohorts were not pleased with my appointment.

defs.def_en: A person's cohorts are their friends, supporters, or associates.

defs.def_cn: (尤指为了进行统计而被看作一个整体的)一群人

ext.ext_cn: 测试是由老师在小学三年级所有八岁到九岁的学生中进行的。
ext.ext_en: Tests were carried out by teachers on the entire cohort of eight to nine year-olds in their third year at primary school...

ext.ext_cn: 她是所有日本年轻作家的代言人。
ext.ext_en: She speaks for a whole cohort of young Japanese writers.

defs.def_en: A cohort of people is a group who have something in common. Cohort is used especially when a group is being looked at as a whole for statistical purposes.

defs.def_cn: 献（身）；奉献，投入(时间、精力等)

ext.ext_cn: 他决定将自己的余生献给科学研究事业。
ext.ext_en: He decided to devote the rest of his life to scientific investigation...

ext.ext_cn: 为了证明他是个骗子已投入了相当多的人力和财力。
ext.ext_en: Considerable resources have been devoted to proving him a liar...

defs.def_en: If you devote yourself, your time, or your energy to something, you spend all or most of your time or energy on it.

defs.def_cn: 将(文章或讲话的某一部分)专用（于）

ext.ext_cn: 在他的长篇报告中，他用了很大的篇幅来分析美国飞机的设计。
ext.ext_en: He devoted a major section of his massive report to an analysis of US aircraft design...

ext.ext_cn: 一页又一页的篇幅都用来描述导致首相辞职的一连串事件。
ext.ext_en: Page upon page is devoted to the chain of events leading to the Prime Minister's resignation.

defs.def_en: If you devote a particular proportion of a piece of writing or a speech to a particular subject, you deal with the subject in that amount of space or time.
A soft-boiled egg is one that has been boiled for only a few minutes, so that the yellow part is still liquid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 背信弃义的;不忠实的;不诚实的

ext.ext_cn: 她决定与越来越花心、越来越靠不住的丈夫离婚。
ext.ext_en: She decided to divorce her increasingly faithless and unreliable husband.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is faithless, you mean that they are disloyal or dishonest.

defs.def_cn: （尤指不快之事的）开始，开端，肇始

ext.ext_cn: 冬天来临，大部分关口均已关闭。
ext.ext_en: Most of the passes have been closed with the onset of winter...

ext.ext_cn: 战争一爆发，油价就攀过了每桶30美元。
ext.ext_en: With the onset of war, oil prices climbed past $30 a barrel.

defs.def_en: The onset of something is the beginning of it, used especially to refer to something unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 和平常一样，爸爸在和所有的女士调情，或者说所有的女士都在和他调情。
ext.ext_en: Dad's flirting with all the ladies, or they're all flirting with him, as usual...

ext.ext_cn: 他肆无忌惮地调情。
ext.ext_en: He flirts outrageously.

defs.def_en: If you flirt with someone, you behave as if you are sexually attracted to them, in a playful or not very serious way.
Someone who is a flirt likes to flirt a lot.

defs.def_cn: 不认真地考虑;有…的念头(或想法)

ext.ext_cn: 迪彼得罗，45 岁，一直有从政的念头。
ext.ext_en: Di Pietro, 45, has been flirting with the idea of a political career.

ext.ext_cn: 他们想过要在20世纪80年代不停地出唱片。
ext.ext_en: They flirted with the idea of making records throughout the 1980s.

defs.def_en: If you flirt with the idea of something, you consider it but do not do anything about it.

defs.def_cn: （英国的）就业服务中心，职业介绍所
defs.def_en: In Britain, a job centre is a place where people who are looking for work can go to get advice on finding a job, and to look at advertisements placed by people who are looking for new employees.
A torpedo is bomb that is shaped like a tube and that travels under water.

defs.def_cn: 用鱼雷袭击(或击中、击沉)

ext.ext_cn: 卢西塔尼亚号被鱼雷击沉，导致 1,000 多人死亡。
ext.ext_en: More than a thousand people died when the Lusitania was torpedoed.

defs.def_en: If a ship is torpedoed, it is hit, and usually sunk, by a torpedo or torpedoes.

ext.ext_cn: 人们认为这些袭击是为了故意破坏会谈。
ext.ext_en: These attacks are seen as an effort to torpedo the talks.

defs.def_en: If someone torpedoes negotiations or plans, they deliberately prevent them from being completed or from being successful.

ext.ext_cn: 有几个人过来迎接我。
ext.ext_en: Several people came by to welcome me...

ext.ext_cn: 她在那儿迎接他从战场归来。
ext.ext_en: She was there to welcome him home from war...

defs.def_en: If you welcome someone, you greet them in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 欢迎来到华盛顿。
ext.ext_en: Welcome to Washington...

ext.ext_cn: 欢迎回来，德博拉，有你在这儿真好。
ext.ext_en: Welcome back, Deborah—It's good to have you here.

defs.def_en: You use welcome in expressions such as welcome home ,welcome to London, and welcome back when you are greeting someone who has just arrived somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 她欣然接受了这一举措，但是说总体上改变还不彻底。
ext.ext_en: She welcomed this move but said that overall the changes didn't go far enough...

ext.ext_cn: 在德国，联邦银行行长欣然接受了这项措施。
ext.ext_en: In Germany, the move was welcomed by the Bundesbank president.

defs.def_en: If you welcome an action, decision, or situation, you approve of it and are pleased that it has occurred.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这确实是命运中一个令人欣喜的转变。
ext.ext_en: This was certainly a welcome change of fortune...

ext.ext_cn: 为更高水平的游泳爱好者新建的25米长的游泳池受到了大家的欢迎。
ext.ext_en: The new 25 metre pool for more serious swimmers is a welcome addition...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as welcome, you mean that people wanted it and are happy that it has occurred.

ext.ext_cn: 我们欢迎你加入探索这处独特的澳大利亚景观的特别之旅。
ext.ext_en: We welcome you to join us on a special tour which explores this unique Australian attraction...

ext.ext_cn: 我们欢迎你就这项调查发表意见。
ext.ext_en: We would welcome your views about the survey.

defs.def_en: If you say that you welcome certain people or actions, you are inviting and encouraging people to do something, for example to come to a particular place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 随时欢迎新成员加入。
ext.ext_en: New members are always welcome...

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉他我家不欢迎他。
ext.ext_en: I told him he wasn't welcome in my home.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is welcome in a particular place, you are encouraging them to go there by telling them that they will be liked and accepted.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你可以随时来医院。
ext.ext_en: You are welcome to visit the hospital at any time.

ext.ext_cn: 客人们可随意使用的温室
ext.ext_en: ...a conservatory which guests are welcome to use.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone that they are welcome to do something, you are encouraging them to do it by telling them that they are allowed to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (表示十分乐意让别人拥有自己不想要的东西)尽管…好了

ext.ext_cn: 就我而言，如果女人们想进军商界的话，就让她们去好了。
ext.ext_en: If women want to take on the business world they are welcome to it as far as I'm concerned.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is welcome to something, you mean that you do not want it yourself because you do not like it and you are very willing for them to have it.

defs.def_cn: 使受欢迎;使感觉受欢迎
defs.def_en: If you make someone welcome or make them feel welcome, you make them feel happy and accepted in a new place.

ext.ext_cn: 在受到热情款待后，他决定离开以免过多打搅主人。
ext.ext_en: After the kindness that had been shown to him, he didn't want to outstay his welcome.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone outstays their welcome or overstays their welcome, you mean that they stay somewhere longer than they are wanted or expected to.

ext.ext_cn: “谢谢你提供的信息。”——“ 不客气。”
ext.ext_en: 'Thank you for the information.' — 'You're welcome.'

defs.def_en: You say 'You're welcome' to someone who has thanked you for something in order to acknowledge their thanks in a polite way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 盛气凌人的;高傲的;不可一世的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为你自己就有些过于盛气凌人。
ext.ext_en: I think you're a bit too high and mighty yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 这位报界大亨和英国的显贵达人们交情甚好。
ext.ext_en: The press mogul befriended the high and mighty in Britain.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as high and mighty, you disapprove of them because they consider themselves to be very important and are confident that they are always right.

ext.ext_cn: 他们没有资格领病假工资。
ext.ext_en: They are not eligible for sick pay.

defs.def_en: When you are ill and unable to work, sick pay is the money that you get from your employer instead of your normal wages.
Stew meat is the same as stewing steak .

defs.def_cn: （尤指在第二次世界大战后）生育高峰期出生的人
defs.def_en: A baby boomer is someone who was born during a baby boom, especially during the years after the end of the Second World War.

ext.ext_cn: 最受欢迎的美国电视连续剧
ext.ext_en: ...the top-rated American television series.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司最顶级的宾馆
ext.ext_en: …the company's top-rated hotel.

defs.def_en: A top-rated show or service is the most successful or highly regarded of its kind.

defs.def_cn: (连衣裙、女衬衫等的)领口，开领

ext.ext_cn: 棕色深开领短裙
ext.ext_en: ...a short brown dress with a plunging neckline.

ext.ext_cn: 领口周围饰有淡粉色玫瑰花的裙装
ext.ext_en: ...a dress with pale pink roses around the neckline.

defs.def_en: The neckline of a dress, blouse, or other piece of clothing is the edge that goes around your neck, especially the front part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 不过，学生们聪明反被聪明误，格拉纳达最终还是决定要转播这个节目。
ext.ext_en: The students were hoist by their own petards, however, as Granada decided to transmit the programme anyway.

defs.def_en: If someone who has planned to harm someone else is hoist with their own petard or hoist by their own petard, their plan in fact results in harm to themselves.

defs.def_cn: 托洛茨基分子;托派分子
defs.def_en: A Trotskyist is someone who supports the revolutionary left-wing ideas of Leon Trotsky.

defs.def_cn: (国王或女王在重要的正式场合佩戴的)王冠，权杖，珠宝
defs.def_en: The Crown Jewels are the crown, sceptre, and other precious objects which are used on important official occasions by the King or Queen.

defs.def_cn: 最重要(或最有价值)的东西

ext.ext_cn: 该公司还愿意出让其20%的核心业务，即信用卡业务。
ext.ext_en: The company is also willing to sell 20% of its crown jewel, its credit-card business.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as someone's crown jewel, you mean it is the most important or valuable thing they have.

defs.def_cn: (英国等圣诞节吃的)圣诞蛋糕
defs.def_en: A Christmas cake is a special cake that is eaten at Christmas in Britain and some other countries.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不引人注意的；不起眼的

ext.ext_cn: 和弟弟相比，他在学校里的进步很不起眼。
ext.ext_en: His progress at school had been unspectacular compared to his brother.

ext.ext_cn: 不甚起眼但令人愉悦的田园风光
ext.ext_en: ...pleasant, if largely unspectacular, countryside.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unspectacular, you mean that it is rather dull and not remarkable in any way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不幸福的；不快乐的；愁苦的

ext.ext_cn: 她的婚姻陷入困境，她为此非常郁闷。
ext.ext_en: Her marriage is in trouble and she is desperately unhappy...

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个腼腆的人，有时候还很忧郁。
ext.ext_en: He was a shy, sometimes unhappy man...

defs.def_en: If you are unhappy, you are sad and depressed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他一向不满意儿子的政治倾向。
ext.ext_en: He has been unhappy with his son's political leanings...

ext.ext_cn: 我猜想他对我的缺席并没有感到很不高兴。
ext.ext_en: I suspect he isn't altogether unhappy about my absence...

defs.def_en: If you are unhappy about something, you are not pleased about it or not satisfied with it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们两国关系史上不愉快的这一篇章
ext.ext_en: ...this unhappy chapter in the history of relations between our two countries...

ext.ext_cn: 这项立法本身就是勉强妥协的产物。
ext.ext_en: The legislation represents in itself an unhappy compromise.

defs.def_en: An unhappy situation or choice is not satisfactory or desirable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 故弄玄虚的；蒙昧主义的；蒙骗的

ext.ext_cn: 我认为当今出版的很多诗歌都是故弄玄虚的无病呻吟。
ext.ext_en: I think that a lot of poetry published today is obscurantist nonsense.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as obscurantist, you mean that it is deliberately vague and difficult to understand, so that it prevents people from finding out the truth about it.
An orthodontist is a dentist who corrects the position of people's teeth.

ext.ext_cn: 烤肉掺杂着香料、椰子油和熟透的热带水果的味道
ext.ext_en: ...the smell of roasted meats mingled with spices, coconut oil and ripe tropical fruits.

defs.def_en: A coconut is a very large nut with a hairy shell, which has white flesh and milky juice inside it.

ext.ext_cn: 椰子干
ext.ext_en: ...desiccated coconut.

defs.def_en: Coconut is the white flesh of a coconut.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 民主参与式管理风格
ext.ext_en: ...a participative management style.

defs.def_en: Participative management or decision-making involves the participation of all the people engaged in an activity or affected by certain decisions.

defs.def_cn: 进行训诫，进行说教，教化

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名剧作家，我憎恨说教。
ext.ext_en: As a dramatist I hate to moralize...

ext.ext_cn: 社会通常会对那些“浪荡女子”指指点点。
ext.ext_en: Society in general moralized about 'loose women'.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is moralizing, you are critical of them for telling people what they think is right or wrong, especially when they have not been asked their opinion.

ext.ext_cn: 将大黄和甘菊一起煮沸再用文火炖,熬成汤药。
ext.ext_en: Make an infusion by boiling and simmering the rhubarb and camomile together...

ext.ext_cn: 将炉火调小，用文火炖调味汁。
ext.ext_en: Turn the heat down so the sauce simmers gently.

defs.def_en: When you simmer food or when it simmers, you cook it by keeping it at boiling point or just below boiling point.

ext.ext_cn: 酝酿了半个多世纪的严重分歧
ext.ext_en: ...bitter divisions that have simmered for more than half a century...

ext.ext_cn: 花匠憋了一个早上的愤怒终于爆发了。
ext.ext_en: The gardener exploded with the rage that had simmered all morning...

defs.def_en: If a conflict or a quarrel simmers, it does not actually happen for a period of time, but eventually builds up to the point where it does.

ext.ext_cn: 达尔文的自然选择理论
ext.ext_en: ...Darwin's principles of natural selection...

ext.ext_cn: 人们对沙利文博士当选卫生部部长表示满意。
ext.ext_en: Dr. Sullivan's selection to head the Department of Health was greeted with satisfaction...

defs.def_en: Selection is the act of selecting one or more people or things from a group.

defs.def_cn: 挑选出来的一批人(或事物)

ext.ext_cn: 这张流行歌曲选集
ext.ext_en: ...this selection of popular songs.

ext.ext_cn: 以戏剧形式演绎的狄更斯《圣诞颂歌》节选片段
ext.ext_en: ...a dramatic rendition of selections from Dickens' A Christmas Carol.

defs.def_en: A selection of people or things is a set of them that have been selected from a larger group.

defs.def_cn: (商店内)可供挑选的某类商品

ext.ext_cn: 它在为期一天的集市上出售应有尽有的各种古董。
ext.ext_en: It offers the widest selection of antiques of every description in a one day market.

defs.def_en: The selection of goods in a shop is the particular range of goods that it has available and from which you can choose what you want.

defs.def_cn: （借助商品目录、电视频道或计算机等渠道的）家居购物

ext.ext_cn: 美国最为成功的电视购物频道
ext.ext_en: ...America's most successful home-shopping channel.

defs.def_en: Home shopping is shopping that people do by ordering goods from their homes, using catalogues, television channels, or computers.

ext.ext_cn: 和她在一起的是她的儿子和儿媳。
ext.ext_en: With her were her son and daughter-in-law...

ext.ext_cn: 她现在陪父亲呆在家里。
ext.ext_en: She is currently staying with her father at his home.

defs.def_en: If one person is with another, they are together in one place.

ext.ext_cn: 趁热和意大利面或米饭以及四季豆一起端上桌。
ext.ext_en: Serve hot, with pasta or rice and French beans...

ext.ext_cn: 曲奇就应该搭配高脚杯的天然柠檬汁一起享用。
ext.ext_en: Cookies are just the thing to serve with tall glasses of real lemonade.

defs.def_en: If something is put with or is with something else, they are used at the same time.

ext.ext_cn: 家长将可以和老师交流谈论子女的进步情况。
ext.ext_en: Parents will be able to discuss their child's progress with their teacher...

ext.ext_cn: 他陪她走到前门。
ext.ext_en: He walked with her to the front door.

defs.def_en: If you do something with someone else, you both do it together or are both involved in it.

defs.def_cn: 和，与，同(…打斗、争论或竞争)

ext.ext_cn: 大约1,000名学生在首都与防暴警察发生了冲突。
ext.ext_en: About a thousand students fought with riot police in the capital...

ext.ext_cn: 他与楼下的房东发生了争执。
ext.ext_en: He was in an argument with his landlord downstairs.

defs.def_en: If you fight, argue, or compete with someone, you oppose them.

defs.def_cn: 用，使用(某种工具、物品或材料)

ext.ext_cn: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。
ext.ext_en: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates...

ext.ext_cn: 把水果和坚果放进罐子里，用白兰地酒浸泡。
ext.ext_en: Pack the fruits and nuts into the jars and cover with brandy...

defs.def_en: If you do something with a particular tool, object, or substance, you do it using that tool, object, or substance.

ext.ext_cn: 一名男子端着一托盘巧克力走过来。
ext.ext_en: A man came round with a tray of chocolates...

ext.ext_cn: 一名年轻女子端着一杯咖啡走进来。
ext.ext_en: A young woman came in with a cup of coffee.

defs.def_en: If someone stands or goes somewhere with something, they are carrying it.

defs.def_cn: 有，拥有(某种特征或所有物)

ext.ext_cn: 他40出头儿，高高的个子，金黄头发，一双天蓝色眼睛。
ext.ext_en: He was in his early forties, tall and blond with bright blue eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 一个收入为34,895美元的人能负担得起这笔贷款。
ext.ext_en: Someone with an income of $34,895 can afford this loan.

defs.def_en: Someone or something with a particular feature or possession has that feature or possession.

ext.ext_cn: 我得了流感，一星期都卧病在床。
ext.ext_en: I spent a week in bed with flu.

defs.def_en: Someone with an illness has that illness.

ext.ext_cn: 他腿上结着干泥巴。
ext.ext_en: His legs were caked with dried mud...

ext.ext_cn: 他们坐在铺有福米加塑料贴面的餐桌前，桌上凌乱地堆着用过的茶杯。
ext.ext_en: They sat at a Formica table cluttered with dirty tea cups.

defs.def_en: If something is filled or covered with a substance or with things, it has that substance or those things in it or on it.

ext.ext_cn: 他还有点儿生她的气。
ext.ext_en: He was still a little angry with her...

ext.ext_cn: 结婚16年后，他们已经渐渐彼此厌倦了。
ext.ext_en: After sixteen years of marriage they have grown bored with each other...

defs.def_en: If you are, for example, pleased or annoyed with someone or something, you have that feeling towards them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的目标就是让实习教师熟悉课堂。
ext.ext_en: Our aim is to allow student teachers to become familiar with the classroom...

ext.ext_cn: 他手头儿还是很紧。
ext.ext_en: He still has a serious problem with money...

defs.def_en: You use with to indicate what a state, quality, or action relates to, involves, or affects.

defs.def_cn: 用(某种方式)；带着(某种感情)

ext.ext_cn: 教她熟练而敏锐地识乐谱
ext.ext_en: ...teaching her to read music with skill and sensitivity...

ext.ext_cn: 他同意了，但很勉强。
ext.ext_en: He agreed, but with reluctance.

defs.def_en: You use with when indicating the way that something is done or the feeling that a person has when they do something.

defs.def_cn: 伴着(声音或手势);带着(表情)

ext.ext_cn: 她叹了口气，身体向后倚靠，闭上了眼睛。
ext.ext_en: With a sigh, she leant back and closed her eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 前门在他身后砰的一声关上了。
ext.ext_en: The front door closed with a crash behind him...

defs.def_en: You use with when indicating a sound or gesture that is made when something is done, or an expression that a person has on their face when they do something.

defs.def_cn: 由于，因为(某种感情而使某人有某种表现或行为)

ext.ext_cn: 吉尔气得脸色煞白，浑身发抖。
ext.ext_en: Gil was white and trembling with anger...

ext.ext_cn: 我为他们感到十分痛心。
ext.ext_en: I felt sick to my stomach with sadness for them...

defs.def_en: You use with to indicate the feeling that makes someone have a particular appearance or type of behaviour.

defs.def_cn: （表示以某姿势、外表或伴随某事件做某事）与…同时，随着

ext.ext_cn: 乔安妮站着，两手放在水槽上，眼睛定定地望着窗外。
ext.ext_en: Joanne stood with her hands on the sink, staring out the window...

ext.ext_cn: 米歇尔睡着了，头靠在他的肩上。
ext.ext_en: Michelle had fallen asleep with her head against his shoulder...

defs.def_en: You use with when mentioning the position or appearance of a person or thing at the time that they do something, or what someone else is doing at that time.

ext.ext_cn: 夜校课程一应俱全，没理由不去接受一些培训。
ext.ext_en: With all the night school courses available, there is no excuse for not getting some sort of training...

ext.ext_cn: 这次胜利使美国队自1985年后第一次重获此杯。
ext.ext_en: With the win, the US reclaimed the cup for the first time since 1985.

defs.def_en: You use with to introduce a current situation that is a factor affecting another situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我们和他们不一样,我们不那么做。
ext.ext_en: We're not like them. It's different with us...

ext.ext_cn: 我时忙时闲，大多数工作都是如此。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes I'm busy and sometimes I'm not. It's the same with most jobs.

defs.def_en: You use with when making a comparison or contrast between the situations of different people or things.

defs.def_cn: 随着，跟着(…的变化而变化)

ext.ext_cn: 吸食香烟的数量越多，患心脏病的风险就越大。
ext.ext_en: The risk of developing heart disease increases with the number of cigarettes smoked...

ext.ext_cn: 血压随着锻炼而降低。
ext.ext_en: Blood pressure decreases with exercise.

defs.def_en: If something increases or decreases with a particular factor, it changes as that factor changes.

defs.def_cn: 与(风、水流等)方向一致；顺着…

ext.ext_cn: 顺流而下的一块浮木
ext.ext_en: ...a piece of driftwood carried down with the current...

ext.ext_cn: 我们把他放在那里，让他随波漂流，并且告诉他要沿着海岸线走。
ext.ext_en: We left him there to float off with the tide, and told him to follow the coast.

defs.def_en: If something moves with a wind or current, it moves in the same direction as the wind or current.

ext.ext_cn: 是的，我知道你说的是谁。是的，我现在明白你的意思了。
ext.ext_en: Yes, I know who you mean. Yes, now I'm with you...

ext.ext_cn: 我不明白你说的话，告诉我你是什么意思。
ext.ext_en: I'm not with you. Tell me what you mean.

defs.def_en: If someone says that they are with you, they mean that they understand what you are saying.

ext.ext_cn: “我会一直支持你。”——“谢谢！”
ext.ext_en: 'I'm with you all the way.'  — 'Thank you.'

defs.def_en: If someone says that they are with you, they mean that they support or approve of what you are doing.

ext.ext_cn: 我爷爷85岁了。
ext.ext_en: My grandad is 85.

defs.def_en: Your grandad is your grandfather.

ext.ext_cn: 帮助贫困儿童读书识字
ext.ext_en: ...helping underprivileged children to learn to read.

ext.ext_cn: 政府削减支出给贫困家庭带来的巨大影响
ext.ext_en: ...the hideous effects of government cuts on underprivileged families.

defs.def_en: Underprivileged people have less money and fewer possessions and opportunities than other people in their society.

ext.ext_cn: 节目以瓦格纳的歌剧《漂泊的荷兰人》的序曲开场。
ext.ext_en: The programme opened with the overture to Wagner's Flying Dutchman.

defs.def_en: An overture is a piece of music, often one that is the introduction to an opera or play.

defs.def_cn: （友好或求爱的）主动表示，姿态，提议

ext.ext_cn: 最近他开始主动表示友好，样子笨拙却又招人喜爱。
ext.ext_en: He had lately begun to make clumsy yet endearing overtures of friendship...

ext.ext_cn: 要是西方在50年代能更积极地响应他的和平姿态就好了。
ext.ext_en: If only the West had been more responsive to his peace overtures in the fifties.

defs.def_en: If you make overtures to someone, you behave in a friendly or romantic way towards them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 控制不住的；未受控制的；不加约束的

ext.ext_cn: 他放肆的举动扰乱了全班的秩序。
ext.ext_en: His uncontrolled behavior disturbed the entire class...

defs.def_cn: 数值的;用数字表示的;数字的

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: They wanted a low-cost, docile workforce.

ext.ext_en: ...the first Director of such a novel enterprise...

ext.ext_cn: 养马确实是个有风险的营生。
ext.ext_en: Horse breeding is indeed a risky enterprise.

defs.def_cn: 进取心;事业心;创业精神

ext.ext_cn: 自由勤劳的民族具有的进取精神
ext.ext_en: ...the spirit of enterprise worthy of a free and industrious people.

ext.ext_cn: 那个团队事业心的缺乏
ext.ext_en: ...the group's lack of enterprise.

defs.def_en: Enterprise is the ability to think of new and effective things to do, together with an eagerness to do them.

defs.def_cn: 描述出；解释清楚；使被人理解

ext.ext_cn: 他拿出他们当地报纸上的半页广告来说明他的观点。
ext.ext_en: He has taken out a half-page advertisement in his local paper to put his point across...

ext.ext_cn: 这实际上是一本非常有趣的书，讲述了大量的健康知识。
ext.ext_en: This is actually a very entertaining book putting over serious health messages...

ext.ext_cn: 他移民到比利时。
ext.ext_en: He emigrated to Belgium...

ext.ext_cn: 他们打算移民。
ext.ext_en: They planned to emigrate.

defs.def_en: If you emigrate, you leave your own country to live in another country.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人体某部分)松弛的，松垂的，绵软的

ext.ext_cn: 我抓起她绵软无力的手腕。
ext.ext_en: I picked up her wrist. It was limp and flaccid.

defs.def_en: You use flaccid to describe a part of someone's body when it is unpleasantly soft and not hard or firm.
A medical examiner is a medical expert who is responsible for investigating the deaths of people who have died in a sudden, violent, or unusual way.

defs.def_cn: (申请健康保险或求职时负责体检的)特约体检医生
defs.def_en: A medical examiner is a doctor whose job is to examine people, for example when they apply for a job or for health insurance.
A micro-organism is a very small living thing which you can only see if you use a microscope.
Dishwater is water that dishes, pans, and cutlery have been washed in.

ext.ext_cn: 蓄意破坏公共财产的人
ext.ext_en: ...vandals who wrecked public property...

ext.ext_cn: 西北部的一半林地是公共财产。
ext.ext_en: Half of the north-west's timber land is public property.

defs.def_en: Public property is land and other assets that belong to the general public and not to a private owner.

ext.ext_cn: 当一个公众人物，他无法应付。
ext.ext_en: He couldn't handle being public property...

ext.ext_cn: 她抱怨说自己私生活中的隐私都成了家喻户晓的事。
ext.ext_en: She complained that intimate aspects of her personal life had been made public property.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or thing as public property, you mean that information about them is known and discussed by everyone.

ext.ext_cn: 我停车有困难。
ext.ext_en: I had trouble parking...

ext.ext_cn: 你给我们造成了很多麻烦。
ext.ext_en: You've caused us a lot of trouble...

defs.def_en: You can refer to problems or difficulties as trouble .

defs.def_cn: 麻烦;问题;引起麻烦的事

ext.ext_cn: 问题是其他事情都变了，而这些条条框框还在。
ext.ext_en: The trouble is that these restrictions have remained while other things have changed...

ext.ext_cn: 你的问题是不能接受拒绝。
ext.ext_en: Your trouble is that you can't take rejection.

defs.def_en: If you say that one aspect of a situation is the trouble, you mean that it is the aspect which is causing problems or making the situation unsatisfactory.

ext.ext_cn: 我和她互相倾诉烦恼。
ext.ext_en: She tells me her troubles. I tell her mine…

ext.ext_cn: 她把烦心事都放在心里。
ext.ext_en: She kept her troubles to herself.

defs.def_en: Your troubles are the things that you are worried about.

ext.ext_cn: 不合适的床最有可能引起背部疼痛。
ext.ext_en: An unsuitable bed is the most likely cause of back trouble…

ext.ext_cn: 她丈夫以前从来没得过任何心脏疾病。
ext.ext_en: Her husband had never before had any heart trouble...

defs.def_en: If you have kidney trouble or back trouble, for example, there is something wrong with your kidneys or your back.

ext.ext_cn: 正在全城部署防暴警察以防止发生骚乱。
ext.ext_en: Riot police are being deployed throughout the city to prevent any trouble...

ext.ext_cn: 在世界杯期间闹事的球迷将受到严惩。
ext.ext_en: Fans who make trouble during the World Cup will be severely dealt with.

defs.def_en: If there is trouble somewhere, especially in a public place, there is fighting or rioting there.

ext.ext_cn: 根本不费事，恰恰相反，非常荣幸能帮到你。
ext.ext_en: It's no trouble at all; on the contrary, it will be a great pleasure to help you...

ext.ext_cn: 那么快来这里会不会有什么不便？
ext.ext_en: Will it be any trouble to get over here that quickly?

defs.def_en: If you tell someone that it is no trouble to do something for them, you are saying politely that you can or will do it, because it is easy or convenient for you.

defs.def_cn: 需劳神费力的人(或动物)

ext.ext_cn: 我的小孙子一点都不让人操心，但是他6岁大的姐姐却野蛮而又自私。
ext.ext_en: My little grandson is no trouble at all, but his 6-year-old elder sister is rude and selfish.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or animal is no trouble, you mean that they are very easy to look after.

ext.ext_cn: 有什么事情让你烦恼吗？
ext.ext_en: Is anything troubling you?...

ext.ext_cn: 他对儿子的生活方式感到很担心。
ext.ext_en: He was troubled by the lifestyle of his son.

defs.def_en: If something troubles you, it makes you feel rather worried.

ext.ext_cn: 溃疡已经折磨她好几年了。
ext.ext_en: The ulcer had been troubling her for several years.

defs.def_en: If a part of your body troubles you, it causes you physical pain or discomfort.

ext.ext_cn: 他打了个哈欠，都懒得抬抬手遮一下嘴巴。
ext.ext_en: He yawns, not troubling to cover his mouth...

ext.ext_cn: 他都没想要看看后视镜。
ext.ext_en: He hadn't troubled himself to check his mirrors...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does not trouble to do something, you are critical of them because they do not behave in the way that they should do, and you think that this would require very little effort.

ext.ext_cn: 对不起打扰了，但我想打听一下您是否知道他在哪里。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry to trouble you, but I wondered if by any chance you know where he is...

ext.ext_cn: 我真不愿打扰您，但莉娜阿姨的生日就要到了，我想给她买点好东西。
ext.ext_en: I hate to trouble you, but Aunt Lina's birthday is coming up and I would like to buy something nice for her.

defs.def_en: You use trouble in expressions such as I'm sorry to trouble you when you are apologizing to someone for disturbing them in order to ask them something.

defs.def_cn: 处于困境;惹麻烦;将受惩罚

ext.ext_cn: 老师们都想好好教训他。
ext.ext_en: He was in trouble with his teachers...

ext.ext_cn: 把那笔钱借给我的那个人因此倒霉了。
ext.ext_en: The person who loaned them to me got into terrible trouble for it.

defs.def_en: If someone is in trouble, they are in a situation in which a person in authority is angry with them or is likely to punish them because they have done something wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 值得费点劲用手挑挑果子。
ext.ext_en: It is worth taking the trouble to sieve the fruit by hand…

ext.ext_cn: 他在批评那部电影之前都懒得费神欣赏。
ext.ext_en: He did not take the trouble to see the film before he attacked it.

defs.def_en: If you take the trouble to do something, you do something which requires a small amount of additional effort.

ext.ext_cn: 有人抱怨说根本不值得为约翰逊浪费精力。
ext.ext_en: Some grumbled that Johnson was more trouble than he was worth...

ext.ext_cn: 似乎总是觉得没必要为进一步了解它而大费工夫。
ext.ext_en: Learning more about it always seemed more trouble than it was worth.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is more trouble than they are worth, you mean that they cause you a lot of problems or take a lot of time and effort and you do not achieve or gain very much in return.

ext.ext_cn: 他从头至尾都表现出一定的冷静沉着。
ext.ext_en: He behaves throughout with a certain sang-froid.

defs.def_en: A person's sang-froid is their ability to remain calm in a dangerous or difficult situation.

ext.ext_cn: 我看几部影片，一整天差不多就混过去了。
ext.ext_en: I saw a few films and generally kind of goofed off all day.

defs.def_en: If someone goofs off, they spend their time doing nothing, often when they should be working.

ext.ext_cn: 不可否认，这是一场平民百姓反抗领导人的起义。
ext.ext_en: It was undeniably a revolt by ordinary people against their leaders...

ext.ext_cn: 意大利新占领的殖民地利比亚于1914年发生叛乱。
ext.ext_en: The newly-occupied Italian colony of Libya rose in revolt in 1914.

defs.def_en: A revolt is an illegal and often violent attempt by a group of people to change their country's political system.

ext.ext_cn: 1375年，市民奋起反抗。
ext.ext_en: In 1375 the townspeople revolted...

ext.ext_cn: 桑给巴尔岛的居民于1964年反抗苏丹统治，随后时局便不断恶化。
ext.ext_en: Zanzibar's fortunes declined after the islanders revolted against the sultanate in 1964.

defs.def_en: When people revolt, they make an illegal and often violent attempt to change their country's political system.

ext.ext_cn: 因为拒绝进行公民投票，首相正面临着党内激进分子的反抗。
ext.ext_en: The prime minister is facing a revolt by party activists over his refusal to hold a referendum...

ext.ext_cn: 很快，整个武装部队开始公然抗命。
ext.ext_en: Soon the entire armed forces were in open revolt.

defs.def_en: A revolt by a person or group against someone or something is a refusal to accept the authority of that person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 直到周五晚上首相的3位高级内阁同僚倒戈并辞职以示抗议时，首相才有所反应。
ext.ext_en: The prime minister only reacted when three of his senior cabinet colleagues revolted and resigned in protest on Friday night...

ext.ext_cn: 卡罗琳16岁时拒绝接受芭蕾舞训练。
ext.ext_en: Caroline revolted against her ballet training at sixteen.

defs.def_en: When people revolt against someone or something, they reject the authority of that person or reject that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 紧肤水

ext.ext_cn: 紧肤水
ext.ext_en: ...an astringent lotion.

ext.ext_en: Sunset Boulevard was originally conceived by Wilder as an astringent satire on Hollywood.

defs.def_en: If something has an astringent taste, it is sharp or bitter.

ext.ext_en: ...the Basque separatist movement...

ext.ext_cn: 近 2,500 人在今年的分裂主义暴乱中丧生。
ext.ext_en: Nearly 2,500 have died in separatist violence this year.

defs.def_en: Separatist organizations and activities within a country involve members of a group of people who want to establish their own separate government or are trying to do so.

defs.def_cn: 分裂主义者;独立主义者

ext.ext_cn: 军队一直遭到分裂主义者的袭击。
ext.ext_en: The army has come under attack by separatists.

defs.def_en: Separatists are people who want their own separate government or are involved in separatist activities.

defs.def_cn: 声称的；被断言的；涉嫌的

ext.ext_en: They have begun a hunger strike in protest at the alleged beating.

ext.ext_en: ...a list of alleged war criminals.

defs.def_en: An alleged fact has been stated but has not been proved to be true.

defs.def_cn: （房间或车辆）有空调设备的，安有空调的

ext.ext_cn: 我们的新空调列车
ext.ext_en: ...our new air conditioned trains.

defs.def_en: If a room or vehicle is air conditioned, the air in it is kept cool and dry by means of a special machine.

ext.ext_en: They go to the polls on Friday to choose the people they want to govern their country...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的公民十分庆幸没有受独裁者的统治。
ext.ext_en: Their citizens are very thankful they are not governed by a dictator.

defs.def_en: To govern a place such as a country, or its people, means to be officially in charge of the place, and to have responsibility for making laws, managing the economy, and controlling public services.

ext.ext_cn: 关于海险有一系列严格的规章制度对其作了规定。
ext.ext_en: Marine insurance is governed by a strict series of rules and regulations...

ext.ext_cn: 政府已经修改了有关领取失业救济金资格的规章制度。
ext.ext_en: The government has altered the rules governing eligibility for unemployment benefit.

defs.def_en: If a situation or activity is governed by a particular factor, rule, or force, it is controlled by that factor, rule, or force.

ext.ext_en: See chapter 6, pp. 137-41.

ext.ext_cn: 研究人员很清楚，他们的很多时间和精力全都是白费。
ext.ext_en: Research workers are well aware that much of their time and effort is unproductive.

ext.ext_cn: 越来越贫瘠的土地
ext.ext_en: ...increasingly unproductive land.

defs.def_en: Something that is unproductive does not produce any good results.

ext.ext_cn: 我通常在除夕举行派对，总是很闹。

ext.ext_en: People expect a horse to perform like a car, with no thought for its feelings as a living being.

ext.ext_cn: 来自外太空的生物
ext.ext_en: ...beings from outer space.

defs.def_en: See also:human being;You can refer to any real or imaginary creature as a being .

defs.def_cn: （用于解释所说内容的原因）因为，由于

ext.ext_en: I used to go everywhere with my mother being as I was the youngest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那些摄像机的存在并不令人反感。

defs.def_cn: 西方的；西方国家的；欧美的

ext.ext_cn: 在某些方面，非洲人的思维方式与西方人相差甚远。

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们日常生活中的琐事
ext.ext_en: ...the minutiae of their quotidian existence.

defs.def_en: Quotidian activities or experiences are basic, everyday activities or experiences.

ext.ext_cn: 接入远程数据库来获取信息是可以办到的。
ext.ext_en: It is possible to plug into remote databases to pick up information.

defs.def_en: If you plug into a computer system, you are able to use it or see the information stored on it.

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲政策研究中心在了解重要人士的想法。
ext.ext_en: The Centre for European Policy Studies is plugged into the thinking of the people who matter.

defs.def_en: If you plug into a group of people or their ideas, you find out about them and try to understand them.

ext.ext_cn: 他拥有一家干洗店。
ext.ext_en: He owns a dry-cleaning business.

defs.def_en: Dry-cleaning is the action or work of dry-cleaning things such as clothes.
Dry-cleaning is things that have been dry-cleaned, or that are going to be dry-cleaned.

defs.def_cn: 分叉；分岔；（在某处）改变方向

ext.ext_cn: 过了几英里，右侧出现一条小岔路。
ext.ext_en: After a few miles, a small road branched off to the right...

ext.ext_cn: 她改变路线，沿着土路走了下去。
ext.ext_en: She branched off down the earth track.

defs.def_en: A road or path that branches off from another one starts from it and goes in a slightly different direction. If you branch off somewhere, you change the direction in which you are going.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这场比赛也因球队主教练怪异的举动而尽人皆知。
ext.ext_en: The game was also notable for the bizarre behaviour of the team's manager...

ext.ext_cn: 你知道吗，你借给我的那本书真的很怪诞。
ext.ext_en: You know, that book you lent me is really bizarre.

defs.def_en: Something that is bizarre is very odd and strange.

ext.ext_cn: 这就意味着驾车的听众在全国各地行驶时都不需要重新调谐。
ext.ext_en: ...this means that listeners in cars should not have to retune as they drive across the country.

ext.ext_cn: 重新调整录像机以使观众能够接受信号的计划
ext.ext_en: ...plans to retune VCRs to allow viewers to receive the signal.

defs.def_en: To retune a piece of equipment such as a radio, television, or video means to adjust it so that it receives a different channel, or so that it receives the same channel on a different frequency.

defs.def_cn: 使(一图像)叠映在(另一图像)上;使(图像)叠加

ext.ext_cn: 他的照片被移花接木，放在了一个肌肉发达的身体上。
ext.ext_en: His picture was superimposed on a muscular body...

ext.ext_cn: 你可以把这些文字直接叠印在你的一张照片上。
ext.ext_en: You can superimpose the lettering directly onto one of your pictures.

defs.def_en: If one image is superimposed on another, it is put on top of it so that you can see the second image through it.

defs.def_cn: 使同样适用于;将…强加于

ext.ext_cn: 公共管理和执政模式移用于传统社会。
ext.ext_en: Patterns of public administration and government are superimposed on traditional societies.

defs.def_en: If features or characteristics from one situation are superimposed onto or on another, they are transferred onto or used in the second situation, though they may not fit.

defs.def_cn: (尤指缓慢、悠闲或小心地)走，行，去，往

ext.ext_cn: 睡眼惺忪的通勤族拖着沉重的步子上班去。
ext.ext_en: Sleepy-eyed commuters were wending their way to work.

defs.def_en: If you wend your way in a particular direction, you walk, especially slowly, casually, or carefully, in that direction.
A gofer is a person whose job is to do simple and rather boring tasks for someone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他脾气火暴，容易激动，就像一瓶喷溅的汽水。
ext.ext_en: He is so hot-tempered and excitable, like a bottle of soda water exploding.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as hot-tempered, you think they get angry very quickly and easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 全世界有1/4的人没有个像样的家。
ext.ext_en: One in four people worldwide are without adequate homes...

ext.ext_cn: 老一套方法已不足以满足当前的需要。
ext.ext_en: The old methods weren't adequate to meet current needs...

defs.def_en: If something is adequate, there is enough of it or it is good enough to be used or accepted.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 说话刻薄的;话语尖刻的;话中带刺的

ext.ext_cn: 朱莉娅是一个非常粗野、说话刻薄的女子。
ext.ext_en: Julia was a very tough, sharp-tongued woman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as sharp-tongued, you being critical of them for speaking in a way which is unkind though often clever.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (画作、文章、喜剧)讽刺的，讥讽的

ext.ext_cn: 讽刺 80 年代末伦敦生活的一部小说
ext.ext_en: ...a satirical novel about London life in the late 80s.

defs.def_en: A satirical drawing, piece of writing, or comedy show is one in which humour or exaggeration is used to criticize something.

ext.ext_cn: 地方当局说宵禁是一种预防措施。
ext.ext_en: The local administration says the curfew is a precautionary measure.

defs.def_en: Precautionary actions are taken in order to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant from happening.

ext.ext_cn: 他的好色放浪使他成为全县所有自尊自重的丈夫和父亲的公敌。
ext.ext_en: His lechery made him the enemy of every self-respecting husband and father in the county.

defs.def_en: Lechery is the behaviour of men who are only interested in women sexually.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 邋遢的;脏乱的;声名狼藉的

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰克为当地一个臭名远扬的恶棍跑腿，干些骗人勾当。
ext.ext_en: Frank ran dodgy errands for a seedy local villain...

ext.ext_cn: 我们当时住在紧挨着红灯区的一家脏乱不堪的旅馆里。
ext.ext_en: We were staying in a seedy hotel close to the red light district...

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or place as seedy, you disapprove of them because they look dirty and untidy, or they have a bad reputation.
Swinging doors are doors that can open both towards you and away from you.

defs.def_cn: 盖式发型(脑后和两侧均剪得很短而头顶部头发较长的男式发型)
defs.def_en: If a man has a short back and sides, his hair is cut very short at the back and sides with slightly thicker, longer hair on the top of the head.

ext.ext_cn: 人口继续增长。
ext.ext_en: The population continues to increase...

ext.ext_cn: 日本工业产量增长了2%。
ext.ext_en: Japan's industrial output increased by 2%...

defs.def_en: If something increases or you increase it, it becomes greater in number, level, or amount.

ext.ext_cn: 生产率的大幅提高
ext.ext_en: ...a sharp increase in productivity...

ext.ext_cn: 他呼吁所得税提高 1 便士。
ext.ext_en: He called for an increase of 1p on income tax.

defs.def_en: If there is an increase in the number, level, or amount of something, it becomes greater.

ext.ext_cn: 犯罪活动在不断增多。
ext.ext_en: Crime is on the increase.

defs.def_en: If something is on the increase, it is happening more often or becoming greater in number or intensity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 可预言的；可预测的；可预料的

ext.ext_cn: 考虑到这两个国家之间激烈的敌对情绪，这种反应是可以预见的。
ext.ext_en: This was a predictable reaction, given the bitter hostility between the two countries...

ext.ext_cn: 这个结果完全在预料之中。
ext.ext_en: The result was entirely predictable.

defs.def_en: If you say that an event is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen.

defs.def_cn: （足球、曲棍球等比赛中）越位的

ext.ext_cn: 由于沃克越位在先，这个进球被判无效。
ext.ext_en: The goal was disallowed because Wark was offside.

ext.ext_cn: 怀斯所站的位置至少越位10码。
ext.ext_en: Wise was standing at least ten yards offside.

defs.def_en: In games such as football or hockey, when an attacking player is offside, they have broken the rules by being nearer to the goal than a defending player when the ball is passed to them.
In American football, a player is offside if they cross the line of scrimmage before a play begins.

defs.def_cn: （车辆在靠左交通中的）右侧，外侧，远离路边的一侧

ext.ext_cn: 司机摇下前排右侧的玻璃窗。
ext.ext_en: The driver of the car lowered his offside front window.

defs.def_en: The offside of a vehicle is the side that is farthest from the edge of the road when the vehicle is being driven normally.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (用于男性姓名中，表示同名父子中的父亲)

ext.ext_cn: 老唐纳德·卡宁厄姆
ext.ext_en: ...Donald Cunningham, Sr.

defs.def_en: Sr is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) Senior, and is written after a man's name. It is used in order to distinguish a man from his son when they both have the same name.

ext.ext_cn: 黄色报刊公然奚落皇室成员。
ext.ext_en: The gutter press has held the royals up to ridicule.

defs.def_en: You can refer to newspapers and magazines which print mainly stories about sex and crime as the gutter press .
A cultured pearl is a pearl that is created by putting sand or grit into an oyster.

ext.ext_cn: 在这一群体里，这种疾病在不同的动物身上有着不同的表现。
ext.ext_en: Different animals in the colony had different manifestations of the disease...

ext.ext_cn: 纽约是美国价值观的终极体现。
ext.ext_en: New York is the ultimate manifestation of American values.

defs.def_en: A manifestation of something is one of the different ways in which it can appear.
A valuer is someone whose job is to estimate the cost or value of something, for example a house, or objects that are going to be sold in an auction.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子们需要无条件的爱。
ext.ext_en: Children need unconditional love...

ext.ext_cn: 今天上午早些时候，反叛的首领无条件投降。
ext.ext_en: The leader of the revolt made an unconditional surrender early this morning.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unconditional, you mean that the person doing or giving it does not require anything to be done by other people in exchange.
Reafforestation is the same as reforestation .

ext.ext_cn: 她和她妈妈就像是一个模子里刻出来的。
ext.ext_en: She's a carbon copy of her mother...

ext.ext_cn: 特雷莎的第一次婚姻简直就是她父母婚姻的翻版。
ext.ext_en: Theresa's first marriage was almost a carbon copy of her parents'.

defs.def_en: If you say that one person or thing is a carbon copy of another, you mean that they look or behave exactly like them.
A carbon copy is a copy of a piece of writing that is made using carbon paper.

defs.def_cn: (大学)毕业文凭，学位证书;(美国中学的)毕业文凭

ext.ext_cn: 一门为期两年、毕业后可以获得社会福利工作方面文凭的新课程
ext.ext_en: ...a new two-year course leading to a diploma in social work.

defs.def_en: A diploma is a qualification which may be awarded to a student by a university or college, or by a high school in the United States.

ext.ext_cn: 在闪电式的恋爱后，两人在7月宣布订婚。
ext.ext_en: After a whirlwind romance the couple announced their engagement in July.

ext.ext_cn: 假日罗曼史
ext.ext_en: ...a holiday romance.

defs.def_en: A romance is a relationship between two people who are in love with each other but who are not married to each other.

ext.ext_cn: 他仍然会找时间为女友准备烛光晚餐，制造浪漫。
ext.ext_en: He still finds time for romance by cooking candlelit dinners for his girlfriend...

ext.ext_cn: 他对爱情和浪漫持非常怀疑的态度。
ext.ext_en: He takes a rather sceptical view of love and romance.

defs.def_en: Romance refers to the actions and feelings of people who are in love, especially behaviour which is very caring or affectionate.

ext.ext_cn: 我们想再度营造以前坐火车旅行的浪漫和兴奋。
ext.ext_en: We want to recreate the romance and excitement that used to be part of rail journeys.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the pleasure and excitement of doing something new or exciting as romance .

defs.def_cn: 爱情故事;爱情小说;爱情电影

ext.ext_cn: 她所喜欢的小说是大部头的历史爱情小说。
ext.ext_en: Her taste in fiction was for chunky historical romances.

defs.def_en: A romance is a novel or film about a love affair.

ext.ext_cn: 自1967年开始写爱情小说起，她已经出了50多本书了。
ext.ext_en: Since taking up writing romance in 1967 she has brought out over fifty books.

defs.def_en: Romance is used to refer to novels about love affairs.

defs.def_cn: (中世纪的)冒险故事，传奇文学

ext.ext_cn: 亚瑟王的传奇故事
ext.ext_en: ...Arthurian Romances.

defs.def_en: A medieval romance is a story about adventures such as battles and long journeys.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经和一些非常适合结婚的女人谈过恋爱了。
ext.ext_en: He has romanced some of the world's most eligible women.

defs.def_en: When a man romances a woman, he has a love affair with her.

defs.def_cn: 罗曼语系的（由拉丁语演变而成的语言，如法语、西班牙语、意大利语等）
defs.def_en: Romance languages are languages such as French, Spanish, and Italian, which come from Latin.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的抱怨是合乎情理的。
ext.ext_en: They had a legitimate grievance...

ext.ext_cn: 让驾驶员深感不满的是驾驶执照收费的提高。
ext.ext_en: The main grievance of the drivers is the imposition of higher fees for driving licences.

defs.def_en: If you have a grievance about something that has happened or been done, you believe that it was unfair.

ext.ext_cn: 他再一次吻了她。
ext.ext_en: He kissed her again...

ext.ext_cn: 接着又是一阵短暂的沉寂。
ext.ext_en: Again there was a short silence...

defs.def_en: You use again to indicate that something happens a second time, or after it has already happened before.

ext.ext_cn: 他打开公文包，拿出一个文件夹后又把它合上了。
ext.ext_en: He opened his attaché-case, removed a folder, then closed it again...

ext.ext_cn: 我又开始感觉良好了。
ext.ext_en: I started to feel good about myself again.

defs.def_en: You use again to indicate that something is now in a particular state or place that it used to be in.

ext.ext_cn: 同样，这次怀孕和我前两次的情形非常相似。
ext.ext_en: Again the pregnancy was very similar to my previous two...

ext.ext_cn: 有了这些新艺术家，你看到的舞台剧会比你以前看的更富有活力。同样，那也可能是科技进步的一部分。
ext.ext_en: With the new artists, you see a more dynamic stage show than you used to see. And again, that's probably part of the progress of technology.

defs.def_en: You can use again when you want to point out that there is a similarity between the subject that you are talking about now and a previous subject.

defs.def_cn: （用于对比或语气的削弱）不过，然而

ext.ext_cn: 打出租车要容易些，但也并不总是能打到的。
ext.ext_en: It's easier to take a taxi. But then again you can't always get one...

ext.ext_cn: 他们可能会，但也可能不会。
ext.ext_en: They may, but there again they may not.

defs.def_en: You can use again in expressions such as but again ,then again, and there again when you want to introduce a remark which contrasts with or weakens something that you have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 对不起，再问一次，你叫什么名字?
ext.ext_en: Sorry, what's your name again?

defs.def_en: You can add again to the end of your question when you are asking someone to tell you something that you have forgotten or that they have already told you.

ext.ext_cn: 法国类似的一种葡萄酒的价格比这高一半。
ext.ext_en: A similar wine from France would cost you half as much again.

ext.ext_cn: 雪利酒比佐餐酒酒劲强一半。
ext.ext_en: Sherry is half as strong again as table wine.

defs.def_en: You use again in expressions such as half as much again when you are indicating how much greater one amount is than another amount that you have just mentioned or are about to mention.

ext.ext_cn: 他会反复检查自己的工作直到他认为正确为止。
ext.ext_en: He would go over his work again and again until he felt he had it right...

ext.ext_cn: 各个政党处理这个问题时都屡屡失败。
ext.ext_en: Time and again political parties have failed to tackle this issue.

defs.def_en: You can use again and again or time and again to emphasize that something happens many times.

ext.ext_cn: 当局已经敦促人们储备燃料。
ext.ext_en: The authorities have urged people to stock up on fuel...

ext.ext_cn: 纽约人一直在贮备瓶装水。
ext.ext_en: New Yorkers have been stocking up with bottled water.

defs.def_en: If you stock up on something, you buy a lot of it, in case you cannot get it later.

ext.ext_cn: 我停住脚步，等她追上来。
ext.ext_en: I stopped and waited for her to catch up...

ext.ext_cn: 我们赶上了修女们。
ext.ext_en: We caught up with the nuns.

defs.def_en: If you catch up with someone who is in front of you, you reach them by walking faster than they are walking.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数身材发育迟缓者都会赶上他们的朋友。
ext.ext_en: Most late developers will catch up with their friends...

ext.ext_cn: 赛季伊始，约翰的表现比我好，不过我经过努力追了上来。
ext.ext_en: John began the season better than me but I have fought to catch up...

defs.def_en: To catch up with someone means to reach the same standard, stage, or level that they have reached.

ext.ext_cn: 当时我在忙着读些东西。
ext.ext_en: I was catching up on a bit of reading.

defs.def_en: If you catch up on an activity that you have not had much time to do recently, you spend time doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 女士们花了点时间叙旧，聊了聊彼此的健康和家庭状况。
ext.ext_en: The ladies spent some time catching up on each other's health and families...

ext.ext_cn: 她打算回都柏林，去看望一下结婚后就再没见过面的亲戚。
ext.ext_en: She plans to return to Dublin to catch up with the relatives she has not seen since she married.

defs.def_en: If you catch up on friends who you have not seen for some time or on their lives, you talk to them and find out what has happened in their lives since you last talked together.

ext.ext_cn: 那些人本来和这场冲突不相干，他们只是被牵涉进去的。
ext.ext_en: The people themselves weren't part of the conflict; they were just caught up in it...

ext.ext_cn: 许多非洲妇女为贫穷所迫堕入贩毒行业。
ext.ext_en: Many African women, for reasons of poverty, get caught up in the drug trade.

defs.def_en: If you are caught up in something, you are involved in it, usually unwillingly.

ext.ext_cn: 洪水导致伦敦西部和希斯罗机场间形成了长达6英里的塞车长龙。
ext.ext_en: The flooding led to six-mile tailbacks between west London and Heathrow Airport.

defs.def_en: A tailback is a long line of traffic stretching back along a road, which moves very slowly or not at all, for example because of road works or an accident.

ext.ext_cn: 保险诈骗者
ext.ext_en: ...an insurance hustler.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a hustler, you mean that they try to earn money or gain an advantage from situations they are in by using dishonest or illegal methods.
A hustler is a prostitute, especially a male prostitute.
A repeat offender is someone who commits the same sort of crime more than once.

ext.ext_cn: 他们得到一笔用以鼓励科研的特别经费。
ext.ext_en: They'd got a special grant to encourage research...

ext.ext_cn: 很遗憾，我的助学金申请被拒绝了。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately, my application for a grant was rejected.

defs.def_en: A grant is an amount of money that a government or other institution gives to an individual or to an organization for a particular purpose such as education or home improvements.

ext.ext_cn: 法国已经同意给予他政治避难。
ext.ext_en: France has agreed to grant him political asylum...

ext.ext_cn: 是工党政府同意了印度和巴基斯坦的独立。
ext.ext_en: It was a Labour government which granted independence to India and Pakistan...

defs.def_en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it.

ext.ext_cn: 地方法官承认该慈善机构有理由提起诉讼。
ext.ext_en: The magistrates granted that the charity was justified in bringing the action.

ext.ext_cn: 我承认他有些冒险，但是回过来想一想，其实风险并不大。
ext.ext_en: He took a risk, I'll grant you. But when you think about it, the risk was pretty small...

defs.def_en: If you grant that something is true, you accept that it is true, even though your opinion about it does not change.

defs.def_cn: （因视作理所当然而）不把…当回事，对…不予重视（或不知感激）

ext.ext_cn: 这家人有什么资格瞧不起我，马丁？
ext.ext_en: What right has the family to take me for granted, Martin?...

ext.ext_cn: 这些官员感到受了怠慢，于是大声抱怨起来。
ext.ext_en: The officials felt taken for granted and grumbled loudly.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone takes you for granted, you are complaining that they benefit from your help, efforts, or presence without showing that they are grateful.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎所有我认为在北方是理所当然的事情在伦敦都没有发生，这让我惊诧不已。
ext.ext_en: I was amazed that virtually all the things I took for granted up north just didn't happen in London.

defs.def_en: If you take something for granted, you believe that it is true or accept it as normal without thinking about it.

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎想当然地认为他应该以代表的身份发言。
ext.ext_en: He seemed to take it for granted that he should speak as a representative.

defs.def_en: If you take it for granted that something is the case, you believe that it is true or you accept it as normal without thinking about it.

defs.def_cn: (厨房里的)洗涤池，洗碗槽，水槽

ext.ext_cn: 水槽里堆满了脏碟子。
ext.ext_en: The sink was full of dirty dishes.
