ext.ext_en: That makes her the first TV presenter to work the full term of her pregnancy...

ext.ext_cn: 年过 40 的女性好像和年轻女性一样能够怀孕到足月。
ext.ext_en: Women over 40 seem to be just as capable of carrying a baby to term as younger women.

defs.def_en: The term of a woman's pregnancy is the nine month period that it lasts. Term is also used to refer to the end of the nine month period.

ext.ext_cn: 《赫尔辛基协议》的条款
ext.ext_en: ...the terms of the Helsinki agreement...

ext.ext_cn: 伦德尔市长强加了新的合同条款。
ext.ext_en: Mayor Rendell imposed the new contract terms.

defs.def_en: The terms of an agreement, treaty, or other arrangement are the conditions that must be accepted by the people involved in it.

defs.def_cn: 勉强接受;向…让步;对…妥协

ext.ext_cn: 她只好接受了丈夫将终生残疾这个现实。
ext.ext_en: She had come to terms with the fact that her husband would always be crippled.

defs.def_en: If you come to terms with something difficult or unpleasant, you learn to accept and deal with it.

defs.def_cn: 在平等的条件下;在相同的基础上

ext.ext_cn: 我终于发现了一个可以和体格健全的人平等竞争的体育项目。
ext.ext_en: I had at last found a sport where I could compete on equal terms with able-bodied people...

ext.ext_cn: 核心问题在于女性应与男性享有平等的就业机会。
ext.ext_en: The focus was on women gaining access to work on the same terms as men.

defs.def_en: If two people or groups compete on equal terms or on the same terms, neither of them has an advantage over the other.

ext.ext_cn: 马德琳和萨拉相处很好。
ext.ext_en: Madeleine is on good terms with Sarah...

ext.ext_cn: 我们握了握手，友好地告别。
ext.ext_en: We shook hands and parted on good terms.

defs.def_en: If two people are on good terms or on friendly terms, they are friendly with each other.

defs.def_cn: 从长远来看/从短期来看/从中期来看

ext.ext_cn: 从长远来看，这个协议将会产生非常积极的影响。
ext.ext_en: The agreement should have very positive results in the long term...

ext.ext_cn: 从短期来看，喷洒化学药品显然能有效控制虫害。
ext.ext_en: In the short term, chemical sprays are clearly an effective way to control pests...

defs.def_en: See also:long-term;medium-term;short-term;You use the expressions in the long term ,in the short term, and in the medium term to talk about what will happen over a long period of time, over a short period of time, and over a medium period of time.

defs.def_cn: 按照…的条件;根据…的意见

ext.ext_cn: 只有同意他们的条件，他们才会在联盟条约上签字。
ext.ext_en: They will sign the union treaty only on their terms.

defs.def_en: If you do something on your terms, you do it under conditions that you decide because you are in a position of power.

defs.def_cn: 正在考虑，正在打算(做某事)

ext.ext_cn: 联队应该在考虑要赢得欧洲杯。
ext.ext_en: United should be thinking in terms of winning the European Cup...

ext.ext_cn: 她在考虑干一番事业。
ext.ext_en: She was thinking in terms of a career.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are thinking in terms of doing a particular thing, you mean that you are considering it.

Pagan beliefs and activities do not belong to any of the main religions of the world and take nature and a belief in many gods as a basis. They are older, or are believed to be older, than other religions.

defs.def_cn: 异教徒（旧时指不信奉基督教的人）

ext.ext_cn: 那种新宗教急于使异教徒皈依本教。
ext.ext_en: The new religion was eager to convert the pagan world.

ext.ext_cn: 立誓独身也不愿屈服与异教徒结婚的女圣人
ext.ext_en: ...female saints who took vows of virginity rather than submit to an undesired marriage with a pagan.

defs.def_en: In former times, pagans were people who did not believe in Christianity and who many Christians considered to be inferior people.

ext.ext_cn: 他因在水门事件中担任尼克松总统的首席法律顾问而声名狼藉。
ext.ext_en: He achieved notoriety as chief counsel to President Nixon in the Watergate break-in.

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪80年代作为巴黎最大胆出位、夸张惹眼的服装设计师之一而人尽皆知的克里斯蒂安·拉克鲁瓦
ext.ext_en: ...Christian Lacroix, who gained notoriety as one of Paris's most flamboyant dress designers in the 1980s.

defs.def_en: To achieve notoriety means to become well-known for something bad.

ext.ext_cn: 我一定会腾出时间去钓鱼，因为这是我减压放松的方法。
ext.ext_en: I make sure I make time for fishing because it's how I de-stress.

ext.ext_cn: 所有这些都能帮助放松身心，缓解日常生活的辛苦带来的压力。
ext.ext_en: All of these help relax and de-stress you from the rigors of daily life.

defs.def_en: If you de-stress or if something de-stresses you, you do something that helps you to relax.

ext.ext_cn: 她记下了那些名字，并且简单地给我讲了这件事的真实情况。
ext.ext_en: She had noted down the names and she told me the story simply and factually...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你发现有我给你的那张单子上的名字，就记下来。
ext.ext_en: If you find a name that's on the list I've given you, note it down...

defs.def_en: If you note down something, you write it down quickly, so that you have a record of it.

defs.def_cn: (电视、电脑的)屏幕;(电影的)银幕
defs.def_en: See also:big screen;small screen;widescreen;A screen is a flat vertical surface on which pictures or words are shown. Television sets and computers have screens, and films are shown on a screen in cinemas.

ext.ext_cn: 许多观众对银幕暴力心存反感。
ext.ext_en: Many viewers have strong opinions about violence on the screen...

ext.ext_cn: 无论是在荧幕上还是在生活中，她都是人们心目中完美的美国青少年。
ext.ext_en: She was the ideal American teenager, both on and off screen.

defs.def_en: You can refer to film or television as the screen .

defs.def_cn: 放映(电影);播放(电视节目)

ext.ext_cn: 这个系列剧可能在 1 月份播放。
ext.ext_en: The series is likely to be screened in January...

ext.ext_cn: 后来各电视台被禁止播放任何有关这次游行的画面。
ext.ext_en: TV firms were later banned from screening any pictures of the demo.

defs.def_en: When a film or a television programme is screened, it is shown in the cinema or broadcast on television.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在我面前竖了一面屏风，所以我看不到发生了什么事情。
ext.ext_en: They put a screen in front of me so I couldn't see what was going on.

defs.def_en: A screen is a vertical panel which can be moved around. It is used to keep cold air away from part of a room, or to create a smaller area within a room.

ext.ext_cn: 宾馆后面的那条路大部分被一片公寓楼遮住了。
ext.ext_en: Most of the road behind the hotel was screened by a block of flats.

defs.def_en: If something is screened by another thing, it is behind it and hidden by it.

defs.def_cn: 检查，筛查(以确定是否患病)

ext.ext_cn: 能快速核查是否长蛀牙的唾液检验
ext.ext_en: ...a quick saliva test that would screen for people at risk of tooth decay.

defs.def_en: To screen for a disease means to examine people to make sure that they do not have it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们会对所有求职者进行筛选。
ext.ext_en: They will screen all their candidates.

ext.ext_cn: 参军的筛选程序
ext.ext_en: ...screening procedures for the regiment.

defs.def_en: When an organization screens people who apply to join it, it investigates them to make sure that they are not likely to cause problems.

defs.def_cn: 对(人、行李)进行安全检查

ext.ext_cn: 该航空公司已采用X光机对行李进行安全检查。
ext.ext_en: The airline had been screening baggage on X-ray machines.

defs.def_en: To screen people or luggage means to check them using special equipment to make sure they are not carrying a weapon or a bomb.

defs.def_cn: 转接，甄别(来电以决定是否接听)

ext.ext_cn: 我雇用了一名秘书转接打给我的电话。
ext.ext_en: I employ a secretary to screen my calls.

defs.def_en: If you screen your telephone calls, calls made to you are connected to an answering machine or are answered by someone else, so that you can choose whether or not to speak to the people phoning you.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司被视为能够承担该飞机制造任务的潜在分包商之一。
ext.ext_en: The company was considered as a possible subcontractor to build the aeroplane.

defs.def_en: A subcontractor is a person or firm that has a contract to do part of a job which another firm is responsible for.

ext.ext_cn: 如果给婴儿喝果汁，要用凉开水充分稀释。
ext.ext_en: If you give your baby juice, dilute it well with cooled, boiled water...

ext.ext_cn: 然后液体被稀释。
ext.ext_en: The liquid is then diluted...

defs.def_en: If a liquid is diluted or dilutes, it is added to or mixes with water or another liquid, and becomes weaker.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 经稀释的漂白剂
ext.ext_en: ...a dilute solution of bleach.

defs.def_en: A dilute liquid is very thin and weak, usually because it has had water added to it.

ext.ext_cn: 明显有意图要削弱黑人的选举力量。
ext.ext_en: There was a clear intention to dilute black voting power...

ext.ext_cn: 人们正密切关注降低个人收入免税额度一事。
ext.ext_en: Serious attention is being given to diluting the value of personal tax allowances.

defs.def_en: If someone or something dilutes a belief, quality, or value, they make it weaker and less effective.

ext.ext_cn: 广告的意图是以公开的信息传达隐含之意。
ext.ext_en: Advertisements attempt to project a latent meaning behind an overt message.

defs.def_en: Latent is used to describe something which is hidden and not obvious at the moment, but which may develop further in the future.

ext.ext_cn: 他们冲他起哄，以激愤的问题打断他的发言。
ext.ext_en: They heckled him and interrupted his address with angry questions...

ext.ext_cn: 他遭到无情的羞辱和诘问。
ext.ext_en: He was insulted and heckled mercilessly...

defs.def_en: If people in an audience heckle public speakers or performers, they interrupt them, for example by making rude remarks.

ext.ext_cn: 他们呼吁对恐怖分子重新实施不经审讯即行拘留政策。
ext.ext_en: They called for the return of internment without trial for terrorists.

ext.ext_cn: 持不同政见者的拘留营
ext.ext_en: ...internment camps for dissidents.

defs.def_en: Internment is the practice of putting people in prison for political reasons.

defs.def_cn: (常因害羞或避免说漏嘴)不再开口，闭口不言

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉她我的名字后，她就什么也不说了。
ext.ext_en: As soon as I told her my name, she clammed up.

defs.def_en: If someone clams up, they stop talking, often because they are shy or to avoid giving away secrets.

ext.ext_cn: 针对统一条约的序文出现了争论。
ext.ext_en: The controversy has arisen over the text of the preamble to the unification treaty...

ext.ext_cn: 她开门见山地说：“我想让你尽快回到别墅。”
ext.ext_en: 'I would like you to return to the villa as soon as possible,' she said without preamble.

defs.def_en: A preamble is an introduction that comes before something you say or write.

ext.ext_cn: 该市机场的能见度降为零，空中交通陷入了停顿。
ext.ext_en: Visibility at the city's airport came down to zero, bringing air traffic to a standstill.

ext.ext_cn: 从0到7的范围
ext.ext_en: ...a scale ranging from zero to seven.

defs.def_en: Zero is the number 0.

ext.ext_cn: 那是晚冬阳光明媚的一天，温度只有零上几度。
ext.ext_en: It's a sunny late winter day, just a few degrees above zero...

ext.ext_cn: 那天晚上温度计显示气温降到了零下30度。
ext.ext_en: That night the mercury fell to thirty degrees below zero.

defs.def_en: Zero is a temperature of 0˚. It is freezing point on the Centigrade and Celsius scales, and 32˚  below freezing point on the Fahrenheit scale.

ext.ext_cn: 这个新部委正在筹建，既无资产也无负债。
ext.ext_en: This new ministry was being created with zero assets and zero liabilities.

ext.ext_cn: 零通货膨胀率
ext.ext_en: ...zero inflation...

defs.def_en: You can use zero to say that there is none at all of the thing mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 双引擎高速轰炸机
ext.ext_en: ...a high speed bomber with twin engines.

defs.def_en: A bomber is a military aircraft which drops bombs.

ext.ext_cn: 追查伦敦爆炸案凶犯的侦探们急于对他进行讯问。
ext.ext_en: Detectives hunting the London bombers will be keen to interview him.

defs.def_en: Bombers are people who cause bombs to explode in public places.

ext.ext_cn: 走到停车场中间时，他看到她在闭着眼走路。
ext.ext_en: Half-way across the car-park, he noticed she was walking with her eyes closed...

ext.ext_cn: 他正爬到梯子一半。
ext.ext_en: He was halfway up the ladder...

defs.def_en: Halfway means in the middle of a place or between two points, at an equal distance from each of them.

defs.def_cn: （时间）到一半;（事情）进行到中途

ext.ext_cn: 那时已是10月，我们已经完成了行程的一大半了。
ext.ext_en: By then, it was October and we were more than halfway through our tour.

ext.ext_cn: 到半程时，威尔士的世界级选手马修·波斯特尔位居第三。
ext.ext_en: Welsh international Matthew Postle was third fastest at the halfway point.

defs.def_en: Halfway means in the middle of a period of time or of an event.

ext.ext_cn: 民主党人愿意向总统作部分让步。
ext.ext_en: The Democrats are willing to meet the president halfway.

defs.def_en: If you meet someone halfway, you accept some of the points they are making so that you can come to an agreement with them.

ext.ext_cn: 你得有硬通货才能买到还算不错的东西。
ext.ext_en: You need hard currency to get anything halfway decent...

ext.ext_cn: 我要做的只是保持适度的冷静。
ext.ext_en: All I had to do was be halfway cool.

defs.def_en: Halfway means reasonably.

defs.def_cn: （美国英语用法，用于first, second等词后构成名词）表示“…年级学生”

ext.ext_cn: 拉塔学校的六年级学生
ext.ext_en: ...a sixth-grader at the Latta School.

defs.def_en: -grader combines with words such as 'first' and 'second' to form nouns which refer to a child or young person who is in a particular grade in the American education system.

defs.def_cn: （组织、国家等的）方向，目标，定位

ext.ext_cn: 营销定位
ext.ext_en: ...a marketing orientation...

ext.ext_cn: 对于一个迷失了方向的社会，他能做的有很多。
ext.ext_en: To a society which has lost its orientation he has much to offer...

defs.def_en: If you talk about the orientation of an organization or country, you are talking about the kinds of aims and interests it has.

defs.def_cn: （某人在信仰或偏好上基本的）态度，取向

ext.ext_cn: 本来会将性取向歧视定为非法的法规
ext.ext_en: ...legislation that would have made discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation illegal.

defs.def_en: Someone's orientation is their basic beliefs or preferences.

defs.def_cn: （岗前、学前、课前等的）情况介绍，培训，训练

ext.ext_cn: 他们对新员工进行了一两天例行公事的培训。
ext.ext_en: They give their new employees a day or two of perfunctory orientation.

ext.ext_cn: 为期一天的迎新会
ext.ext_en: ...a one-day orientation session.

defs.def_en: Orientation is basic information or training that is given to people starting a new job, school, or course.

ext.ext_cn: 法尔内塞改变了教堂的朝向，这样它的正面就可以对着广场。
ext.ext_en: Farnese had the orientation of the church changed so that the front would face a square.

defs.def_en: The orientation of a structure or object is the direction it faces.
A post-graduate or a postgraduate student is a student with a first degree from a university who is studying or doing research at a more advanced level.

ext.ext_cn: 研究生课程
ext.ext_en: ...postgraduate courses...

ext.ext_cn: 霍夫曼博士是在莱斯特大学读的研究生。
ext.ext_en: Dr Hoffman did his postgraduate work at Leicester University.

defs.def_en: Postgraduate study or research is done by a student who has a first degree and is studying or doing research at a more advanced level.

ext.ext_cn: 亚洲发展银行
ext.ext_en: ...the Asian development bank.

defs.def_en: A development bank is a bank that provides money for projects in poor countries or areas.

defs.def_cn: (因大笑、剧痛等)（使）弯腰，（使）弓身

ext.ext_cn: 对他下身凶狠的一击疼得他直不起腰
ext.ext_en: ...a savage blow in the crutch which doubled him up...

ext.ext_cn: 他们捧腹大笑，直不起身来。
ext.ext_en: They laugh so hard they double up with laughter.

defs.def_en: If something doubles you up, or if you double up, you bend your body quickly or violently, for example because you are laughing a lot or because you are feeling a lot of pain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她正揉着一大块面团。
ext.ext_en: She was kneading a lumpen mass of dough...

ext.ext_cn: 阴影里闪出几个大大的黑影。
ext.ext_en: Lumpen shapes began to appear out of the shadows.

defs.def_en: A lumpen object is large, heavy, and lumpy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 呆头呆脑的；蠢笨乏味的

ext.ext_cn: 这些人看起来蠢笨无趣得紧。
ext.ext_en: The people seemed lumpen and boring.

defs.def_en: If you describe people as lumpen, you think they are dull and clumsy.

defs.def_cn: 近陆地的；朝陆地的；向岸的

ext.ext_cn: 叛军包围了该市的近陆地区。
ext.ext_en: Rebels surrounded the city's landward sides.

defs.def_en: The landward side of something is the side nearest to the land or facing the land, rather than the sea.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我的头发是自来卷儿。
ext.ext_en: I've got naturally curly hair...

ext.ext_cn: 她的头发乌黑卷曲。
ext.ext_en: Her hair was dark and curly.

defs.def_en: Curly hair is full of curls.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 叶子极长而卷曲的花椰菜
ext.ext_en: ...cauliflowers with extra long curly leaves.

ext.ext_cn: 卷尾龙
ext.ext_en: ...dragons with curly tails.

defs.def_en: Curly is sometimes used to describe things that are curved or spiral in shape.

ext.ext_cn: 浓密的白胡子
ext.ext_en: ...a bristling white moustache.

defs.def_en: Bristling means thick, hairy, and rough. It is used to describe things such as moustaches, beards, or eyebrows.

defs.def_cn: 生气勃勃的；精神焕发的

ext.ext_cn: 他精力旺盛，坚毅顽强，已经成为英格兰文艺复兴的一个象征。
ext.ext_en: His bristling determination has become a symbol of England's renaissance.

ext.ext_cn: 动感十足、活力四射的摇滚乐
ext.ext_en: ...bristling, exuberant, rock'n'roll.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's attitude as bristling, you are emphasizing that it is full of energy and enthusiasm.
Potato crisps are the same as crisps .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不可抵抗的;不可抗拒的;不能压制的

ext.ext_cn: 事实证明回去对霍尔是个不可抗拒的诱惑。
ext.ext_en: It proved an irresistible temptation to Hall to go back.

ext.ext_cn: 来自金融市场的不可抗拒的压力
ext.ext_en: ...irresistible pressure from the financial markets...

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a desire or force as irresistible, you mean that it is so powerful that it makes you act in a certain way, and there is nothing you can do to prevent this.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 吸引人的;富有诱惑力的

ext.ext_cn: 音乐非常好听，令人难以抗拒。
ext.ext_en: The music is irresistible.

ext.ext_cn: 诱人的全麦面包
ext.ext_en: ...irresistible granary bread.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as irresistible, you mean that they are so good or attractive that you cannot stop yourself from liking them or wanting them.

ext.ext_cn: 卧室内的壁纸
ext.ext_en: ...the wallpaper in the bedroom.

defs.def_en: Wallpaper is thick coloured or patterned paper that is used for covering and decorating the walls of rooms.

ext.ext_cn: 反正我们本来就打算在那间屋里贴墙纸的。
ext.ext_en: We were going to wallpaper that room anyway.

ext.ext_cn: 糊了壁纸的卧室
ext.ext_en: ...a wallpapered bedroom.

defs.def_en: If someone wallpapers a room, they cover the walls with wallpaper.

defs.def_cn: 墙纸式作品(乏味浅薄、虽令人愉悦却不能引人关注的音乐、电视或艺术)

ext.ext_cn: 乏味的墙纸式音乐
ext.ext_en: ...bland, wallpaper music.

defs.def_en: If you describe music, television, or art as wallpaper, you are critical of it because there is nothing interesting or difficult to understand about it, so people find it pleasant but do not pay much attention to it.

ext.ext_cn: 预设的壁纸图案
ext.ext_en: ... pre-installed wallpaper images.

defs.def_en: Wallpaper is the background on a computer screen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个性格坚定的人，非常有见解，外交手段高明。
ext.ext_en: He was a man of forceful character, with considerable insight and diplomatic skills.

ext.ext_en: For most people a heart attack is a forceful reminder that they are mortal.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you describe something bad, such as a crime or disease, as rampant, you mean that it is very common and is increasing in an uncontrolled way.

ext.ext_en: The engine delivers instant acceleration whatever the revs.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the revs of an engine, you are referring to its speed, which is measured in revolutions per minute.

defs.def_en: If something happens unbidden, it happens without you expecting or wanting it to happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻声的;安静的；静悄悄的

ext.ext_cn: 塔妮娅把孩子们哄得安安静静而又心满意足。
ext.ext_en: Tania kept the children reasonably quiet and contented...

ext.ext_en: A quiet murmur passed through the classroom...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is quiet makes only a small amount of noise.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: She was received in a small, quiet office...

ext.ext_en: The street was unnaturally quiet.

defs.def_en: If a place is quiet, there is very little noise there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (地方、环境、时光)安宁的，清静的，平静的，宁静的

ext.ext_en: ...a quiet rural backwater...

ext.ext_cn: 他不在的时候这里非常清静。
ext.ext_en: It is very quiet without him...

defs.def_en: If a place, situation, or time is quiet, there is no excitement, activity, or trouble.

ext.ext_cn: 他叫大家安静，然后宣布下一首歌要送给我们。
ext.ext_en: He called for quiet and announced that the next song was in our honor...

ext.ext_cn: 杰里米希望在大赛来临之前能享受到些许平静和安宁。
ext.ext_en: Jeremy wants some peace and quiet before his big match.

defs.def_en: Quiet is silence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沉默的；不出声的;一言不发的

ext.ext_en: I told them to be quiet and go to sleep...

ext.ext_en: I just went quiet, embarrassed, and couldn't answer...

defs.def_en: If you are quiet, you are not saying anything.

defs.def_cn: (感情)不外露的，不张扬的，内敛的，含蓄的

ext.ext_en: He has a quiet confidence in his ability...

ext.ext_cn: 他一生都在默默而坚定地做事。
ext.ext_en: All through his life he has shown a quiet determination to get things done.

defs.def_en: If you refer, for example, to someone's quiet confidence or quiet despair, you mean that they do not say much about the way they are feeling.

ext.ext_cn: 瑞典人通过秘密的外交手段来争取他的自由。
ext.ext_en: The Swedes had sought his freedom through quiet diplomacy...

ext.ext_cn: 然后就回到房子里悄悄地庆祝一番。
ext.ext_en: Then it was back to the house for a quiet celebration...

defs.def_en: You describe activities as quiet when they happen in secret or in such a way that people do not notice them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 温和的;文静的;不易激动(或动怒)的

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个温和友善的人。
ext.ext_en: He's a nice quiet man.

defs.def_en: A quiet person behaves in a calm way and is not easily made angry or upset.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (颜色、服饰)素净的，朴素大方的

ext.ext_cn: 为了避免别人注目，他们穿得很朴素。
ext.ext_en: They dress in quiet colors so as not to call attention to themselves.

defs.def_en: You describe colours or clothes as quiet when they are not bright or not very noticeable.

ext.ext_cn: 风势减弱了，海面平静下来。
ext.ext_en: The wind dropped and the sea quieted...

ext.ext_cn: 埃丝特拉正要说些什么，但是看到丈夫的一个手势，马上就不说话了。
ext.ext_en: Estela started to say something but a gesture from her husband quieted her at once.

defs.def_en: If someone or something quiets or if you quiet them, they become less noisy, less active, or silent.

defs.def_cn: 消除，减轻(恐惧);平息(抱怨)

ext.ext_cn: 音乐似乎能够减轻她的焦虑和孤独。
ext.ext_en: Music seemed to quiet her anxiety and loneliness.

defs.def_en: To quiet fears or complaints means to persuade people that there is no good reason for them.

ext.ext_cn: 她不会乖乖离开的。
ext.ext_en: She's not going to go quietly.

defs.def_en: If someone does not go quietly, they do not leave a particular job or a place without complaining or resisting.

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉她此事要保密。
ext.ext_en: I told her to keep quiet about it...

ext.ext_en: I think I found it easier than Nell to keep our engagement quiet.

defs.def_en: If you keep quiet about something or keep something quiet, you do not say anything about it.

ext.ext_cn: 她已经保证要在别人看不见的时候私下教他开车。
ext.ext_en: She'd promised to give him driving lessons, on the quiet, when no one could see.

defs.def_en: If something is done on the quiet, it is done secretly or in such a way that people do not notice it.

ext.ext_cn: 意大利浓咖啡

ext.ext_cn: 他还从计算机系统里删除了文件。
ext.ext_en: He also deleted files from the computer system...

ext.ext_en: The word 'exploded' had been deleted.

defs.def_en: If you delete something that has been written down or stored in a computer, you cross it out or remove it.

defs.def_cn: 营私舞弊;玩忽职守;渎职

ext.ext_en: ...alleged financial malpractices.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of malpractice, you are accusing them of breaking the law or the rules of their profession in order to gain some advantage for themselves.

ext.ext_en: ...an entertainment star who appeals to all ages and both sexes.

ext.ext_en: ...differences between the sexes.

ext.ext_en: She continually failed to gain promotion because of her sex...

ext.ext_en: The new technique has been used to identify the sex of foetuses.

defs.def_en: The sex of a person or animal is their characteristic of being either male or female.

ext.ext_en: He was very open in his attitudes about sex...

ext.ext_en: The entire film revolves around drugs, sex and violence...

defs.def_en: Sex is the physical activity by which people can produce young.

ext.ext_en: The birds must be weighed, sexed and tagged.

defs.def_en: If an animal is sexed, someone finds out whether it is male or female.

ext.ext_en: I had no intention of having sex with him on a first date.

defs.def_en: If two people have sex, they perform the act of sex.

ext.ext_en: He chivvies the troops along with a few well-directed words.

ext.ext_cn: 最适于演绎莫扎特乐曲的银铃般美妙的嗓音
ext.ext_en: …a beautiful silver-toned voice ideal for Mozart.

ext.ext_cn: 色调柔和淡雅的图画
ext.ext_en: ...soft, pastel-toned drawings.

defs.def_en: -toned combines with adjectives to indicate that something has a particular kind of tone.

ext.ext_en: He was the media's blue-eyed boy.

ext.ext_en: Cathy thought that she had the answer to everything...

defs.def_en: You use everything to refer to all possible or likely actions, activities, or situations.

ext.ext_en: She says everything is going smoothly...

ext.ext_en: Is everything all right?...

ext.ext_en: I love him. He is everything to me...

ext.ext_en: Crime cases were something that agents solved, and to him the case was everything...

ext.ext_en: She has everything: beauty, talent, children...

ext.ext_en: It was a garden that had everything. It was rich and wild and beautiful, and exciting.

ext.ext_en: He had a bed and a fireplace and everything...

ext.ext_en: We become friends and everything, and we call each other on the phone all the time.

ext.ext_cn: 母子情深。
ext.ext_en: Mother and child form a close attachment.

defs.def_en: If you have an attachment to someone or something, you are fond of them or loyal to them.

ext.ext_en: Some models come with attachments for dusting.

ext.ext_en: During her course she worked on attachment for six months at Kew Gardens...

ext.ext_cn: 在被临时派往伦敦的一家律师事务所工作前，我在斯特拉斯堡大学学习了一年。
ext.ext_en: Before coming on my attachment to a City law firm, I spent a year at Strasbourg University.

defs.def_en: If someone is on attachment to another company, department, or place, they are working there temporarily.

ext.ext_en: Justice Fitzgerald included a 120-page discussion paper as an attachment to the annual report.

defs.def_en: An attachment is an extra document that is added to another document.

ext.ext_en: When you send an e-mail you can also send a sound or graphic file as an attachment.

ext.ext_cn: 这个问题引发了一个道德上的两难抉择。
ext.ext_en: The issue raises a moral dilemma.

See also:bottle;Bottled gas is kept under pressure in special metal cylinders which can be moved from one place to another.
A hailstorm is a storm during which it hails.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在那之前,许多孩子被安置在一个缺乏人情味的大孤儿院里。
ext.ext_en: Before then many children were cared for in large impersonal orphanages...

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: I gave Coe an impersonal stare.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as impersonal, you mean that they do not show any emotion about the person they are dealing with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 非个人的;不带个人色彩的

ext.ext_cn: 房间的其余部分整洁干净,不带任何的个人色彩。
ext.ext_en: The rest of the room was neat and impersonal...

ext.ext_en: History reduces the carnage to impersonal numbers.

ext.ext_cn: 他开始啃饼干了。

ext.ext_en: John found he was kissing and nibbling her ear...

ext.ext_en: Daniel Winter nibbled on his pen.

ext.ext_en: A herd of goats was nibbling the turf around the base of the tower...

ext.ext_en: The birds cling to the wall and nibble at the brickwork.

ext.ext_en: ...how best to compete with the overseas nations nibbling at our traditional markets...

ext.ext_en: ...crisps, nuts, and other nibbles.

ext.ext_en: I mouthed a goodbye and hurried in behind Momma...

ext.ext_cn: 她使劲冲他使眼色，不出声地对他说了些什么。
ext.ext_en: She winked broadly at him and silently mouthed something...

defs.def_en: If you mouth something, you form words with your lips without making any sound.

defs.def_cn: 言不由衷地说；信口说；不知所云地说

ext.ext_cn: 我言不由衷地说了一些表示同情的客套话。
ext.ext_en: I mouthed some sympathetic platitudes...

ext.ext_cn: 他们大谈家庭、宗教和慈善的价值，但他们在个人生活中的表现却恰恰相反。
ext.ext_en: They mouthed the values of family, religion and charity, but demonstrated the opposite in their private lives.

defs.def_en: If you mouth something, you say it, especially without believing it or without understanding it.

defs.def_cn: 需要赡养的人;要养活的人

ext.ext_cn: 他要用相当于400英镑的月收入来维持五口之家的生计，感觉很艰难。
ext.ext_en: He had to feed his family on the equivalent of four hundred pounds a month and, with five mouths to feed, he found this very hard.

defs.def_en: If you have a number of mouths to feed, you have the responsibility of earning enough money to feed and look after that number of people.

ext.ext_cn: 有时我几乎不敢开口说话。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes I hardly dare open my mouth...

ext.ext_cn: 他从到那儿后一直没有开口。
ext.ext_en: He hasn't opened his mouth since he's been there.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does not open their mouth, you are emphasizing that they never say anything at all.

ext.ext_cn: 如果她守口如瓶的话，你现在就不会在这儿啦。
ext.ext_en: You wouldn't be here now if she'd kept her mouth shut.

defs.def_en: If you keep your mouth shut about something, you do not talk about it, especially because it is a secret.

defs.def_cn: 使减至最低程度;使保持最低程度

ext.ext_cn: 相关人员希望尽可能降低罹癌风险。
ext.ext_en: Concerned people want to minimize the risk of developing cancer...

ext.ext_cn: 这些问题很多可以通过合理安排尽可能避免。
ext.ext_en: Many of these problems can be minimised by sensible planning.

defs.def_en: If you minimize a risk, problem, or unpleasant situation, you reduce it to the lowest possible level, or prevent it increasing beyond that level.

defs.def_cn: 对…轻描淡写；使显得不重要

ext.ext_cn: 有些人淡化了意识形态因素的重要性。
ext.ext_en: Some have minimized the importance of ideological factors...

ext.ext_cn: 接受审判的时候，他企图对自己的行为轻描淡写。
ext.ext_en: At his trial, he tried to minimize his behavior.

defs.def_en: If you minimize something, you make it seem smaller or less significant than it really is.

defs.def_cn: 把(计算机屏幕上的窗口)最小化

ext.ext_cn: 再次点击正方形图标，把窗口最小化。
ext.ext_en: Click the square icon again to minimize the window.

defs.def_en: If you minimize a window on a computer screen, you make it very small, because you do not want to use it.

ext.ext_cn: 尼克讲完后，从讲台上跳了下来。
ext.ext_en: Nick finished what he was saying and jumped down from the platform.

defs.def_en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give a performance.

defs.def_cn: （通常作为架放或着陆用的）平台

ext.ext_cn: 其中一些防洪棚搭建在高台上，高台可供政府的直升机在持续的洪水中降落。
ext.ext_en: Some of these flood shelters are on raised platforms, which have allowed government helicopters to land amid the continuing floods...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在一块岩石平台上找到了一个可以搭帐篷的地方。
ext.ext_en: They found a spot on a rocky platform where they could pitch their tents.

defs.def_en: A platform is a flat raised structure or area, usually one which something can stand on or land on.
A platform is a structure built for people to work and live on when drilling for oil or gas at sea, or when extracting it.

ext.ext_cn: 火车就快开了，可我还没到站台。
ext.ext_en: The train was about to leave and I was not even on the platform.

defs.def_en: A platform in a railway station is the area beside the rails where you wait for or get off a train.

ext.ext_cn: 政治和经济改革纲领
ext.ext_en: ...a platform of political and economic reforms...

ext.ext_cn: 社会党凭借民族主义政纲赢得了压倒性胜利。
ext.ext_en: The Socialist Party won a landslide victory on a nationalist platform.

defs.def_en: The platform of a political party is what they say they will do if they are elected.

defs.def_cn: （公开发表意见或表达愿望的）机会，论坛

ext.ext_cn: 示威集会为具有广泛代表性的人士提供了发表意见的机会。
ext.ext_en: The demonstration provided a platform for a broad cross section of speakers.

defs.def_en: If someone has a platform, they have an opportunity to tell people what they think or want.

defs.def_cn: （公共汽车上供乘客上下车的）踏脚台

ext.ext_cn: 我站在早晨7点那班公共汽车拥挤的后门处，随着它沿潮湿的街道蹒跚行进。
ext.ext_en: I stood on the crowded back platform of the seven o'clock bus as it lurched along the wet damp street.

defs.def_en: In a bus, the platform is the area of floor at the front or back where you get on and off.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 坚忍的;坦然的;不以为苦的

ext.ext_cn: 她一直很敬佩爱尔兰北部人民的坚忍和勇敢。
ext.ext_en: She never ceased to admire the stoical courage of those in Northern Ireland...

ext.ext_cn: 他们分手时他表现得很坦然。
ext.ext_en: He had been stoical at their parting.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone behaves in a stoical way, you approve of them because they do not complain or show they are upset in bad situations.
A beekeeper is a person who owns and takes care of bees.
Keep-fit is the activity of keeping your body in good condition by doing special exercises.

ext.ext_cn: 会按月给韦德开工资，而不是按小时，无论他是否工作了40个小时。
ext.ext_en: Wade was going to be paid a salary, instead of by the hour, whether he put in forty hours or not...

ext.ext_cn: 他们花费了很多时间和精力以使罢工持续下去。
ext.ext_en: They've put in time and effort to keep the strike going...

defs.def_en: If you put in an amount of time or effort doing something, you spend that time or effort doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些东西该部订购了113个，后来又追加了21个。
ext.ext_en: The ministry ordered 113 of these and later put in a request for 21 more...

ext.ext_cn: 我决定申请副书记一职。
ext.ext_en: I decided to put in for a job as deputy secretary.

defs.def_en: If you put in a request or put in for something, you formally request or apply for that thing.

ext.ext_cn: “在那之前他是个律师，”玛丽·安补充道。
ext.ext_en: 'He was a lawyer before that,' Mary Ann put in...

ext.ext_cn: “海伦走之前吃了点儿东西，”塞西尔急忙插了一句。
ext.ext_en: 'Helen had something to eat before she left,' put in Cecil anxiously.

defs.def_en: If you put in a remark, you interrupt someone or add to what they have said with the remark.

ext.ext_cn: 按计划在到达巴士拉之前它会停靠在亚丁或其他港口。
ext.ext_en: It's due to put in at Aden and some other ports before arriving in Basra...

ext.ext_cn: 他们请求香港允许他们在那里入港停留。
ext.ext_en: They had asked Hong Kong for permission to put into port there.

defs.def_en: When a ship puts in or puts into a port, it goes into the port for a short stop.

defs.def_cn: 慎重的考虑;仔细的思考

ext.ext_cn: 经过深思熟虑后终于作出了一个决定。
ext.ext_en: After much deliberation, a decision was reached...

ext.ext_cn: 经过 5 分钟的仔细斟酌之后，他被判谋杀总统罪名成立。
ext.ext_en: After five minutes of deliberation, he was found guilty of murdering the president.

defs.def_en: Deliberation is the long and careful consideration of a subject.

ext.ext_cn: 评议的结果
ext.ext_en: ...the outcome of the deliberations...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的审议几乎没有得出什么结论。
ext.ext_en: Their deliberations were rather inconclusive.

defs.def_en: Deliberations are formal discussions where an issue is considered carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 弗雷德字斟句酌。
ext.ext_en: Fred spoke with deliberation...

ext.ext_cn: 母亲小心翼翼地把大衣搭在椅背上。
ext.ext_en: My mother folded her coat across the back of the chair with careful deliberation.

defs.def_en: If you say or do something with deliberation, you do it slowly and carefully.
A Cornish pasty is a small pie with meat and vegetables inside.

ext.ext_cn: 17世纪的漆柜
ext.ext_en: ...17th-century lacquered cabinets.

ext.ext_cn: 喷好发胶的头发和扑面粉
ext.ext_en: ...perfectly lacquered hair and face powder.

defs.def_en: Lacquered is used to describe things that have been coated or sprayed with lacquer.

defs.def_cn: 俗丽的装饰;无用的玩意儿;华而不实之物

ext.ext_cn: 这个爱德华七世时期的女人披挂上身的所有那些俗丽的饰品
ext.ext_en: ...all the fripperies with which the Edwardian woman indulged herself.

ext.ext_cn: 没有多余或虚华的装饰的朴实的展示
ext.ext_en: ...a sombre display, with no frills or frippery.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as frippery, you mean that it is silly or unnecessary, and only done or worn for pleasure
A bullfighter is the person who tries to injure or kill the bull in a bullfight.

defs.def_cn: (常指因见到或闻到食物而)分泌唾液，流口水，垂涎

ext.ext_cn: 所有狗看到食物都会流口水。
ext.ext_en: Any dog will salivate when presented with food.

defs.def_en: When people or animals salivate, they produce a lot of saliva in their mouth, often as a result of seeing or smelling food.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰逊对快要到手的几百万垂涎欲滴。
ext.ext_en: Johnson was salivating over the millions he stood to make...

ext.ext_cn: 重建科威特的合同利润丰厚，对于他们有望分得的那一杯羹，美国各公司都垂涎欲滴。
ext.ext_en: American companies were salivating at the juicy contracts for rebuilding Kuwait that were likely to come their way.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is salivating over something such as the chance to make a lot of money, you are emphasizing that you disapprove of their pleasure or eagerness.

defs.def_cn: 必要条件;先决条件;必不可少的事物

ext.ext_cn: 成功的农业改革也是墨西哥实现现代化的必要条件。
ext.ext_en: Successful agricultural reform is also a sine qua non of Mexico's modernisation.

defs.def_en: A sine qua non is something that is essential if you want to achieve a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他在与国际社会打交道的过程中几乎什么都没学到。
ext.ext_en: He has learnt little in his dealings with the international community.

ext.ext_cn: 她家族的生意来往
ext.ext_en: ...her family's business dealings.

defs.def_en: Someone's dealings with a person or organization are the relations that they have with them or the business that they do with them.

ext.ext_cn: 部长明显地暗示政府正在考虑对母亲们实行税收减免。
ext.ext_en: The Minister gave a strong hint that the government were thinking of introducing tax concessions for mothers...

ext.ext_cn: 我已经暗示要在这里举办一次他的作品展。
ext.ext_en: I'd dropped a hint about having an exhibition of his work up here...

defs.def_en: A hint is a suggestion about something that is made in an indirect way.

ext.ext_cn: 她建议去逛逛商店，并暗示可能要请客。
ext.ext_en: She suggested a trip to the shops and hinted at the possibility of a treat of some sort...

ext.ext_cn: 批评总是含沙射影，但从未明说。
ext.ext_en: Criticism is hinted at, but never made explicit...

defs.def_en: If you hint at something, you suggest it in an indirect way.

defs.def_cn: 有益的建议;不错的主意;好点子

ext.ext_cn: 几条有用的建议可以让你的旅途更轻松。
ext.ext_en: Here are some helpful hints to make your journey easier...

ext.ext_cn: 我希望能得到一些有关时尚的建议。
ext.ext_en: I'm hoping to get some fashion hints.

defs.def_en: A hint is a helpful piece of advice, usually about how to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 她只在杜松子酒里加了少许苦艾酒。
ext.ext_en: She added only a hint of vermouth to the gin...

ext.ext_cn: 我瞥了她一眼，没有在她的脸上看到一丝嘲弄。
ext.ext_en: I glanced at her and saw no hint of irony on her face.

defs.def_en: A hint of something is a very small amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他非常怀疑死记硬背是否有用。
ext.ext_en: He is very sceptical about the value of rote learning...

ext.ext_cn: 你只是在背诵自己死记硬背下来的东西。
ext.ext_en: You are merely reciting facts that you have learned by rote.

defs.def_en: Rote learning or learning by rote is learning things by repeating them without thinking about them or trying to understand them.

ext.ext_cn: 1,000名支持者挤进体育馆里为他们加油。
ext.ext_en: A thousand supporters packed into the stadium to cheer them on...

ext.ext_cn: 多数人大概都会为自己喜欢的球员加油。
ext.ext_en: Most will probably be cheering on their favourite players.

defs.def_en: When you cheer someone on, you shout loudly in order to encourage them, for example when they are taking part in a game.

ext.ext_cn: 这一价格包括两张从布里斯班到洛杉矶的经济舱机票。
ext.ext_en: The price includes two economy class airfares from Brisbane to Los Angeles.

ext.ext_cn: 他宁愿乘坐经济舱。
ext.ext_en: He prefers to fly economy class.

defs.def_en: On an aeroplane, an economy class ticket or seat is the cheapest available.

defs.def_cn: （板球等运动中一方球队所有队员）被投杀出局

ext.ext_en: India were bowled out for 209...

ext.ext_en: Middlesex defeated Derbyshire by bowling out the opposition.

defs.def_en: See also:bowl;In a sport such as cricket, if a team is bowled out, each player in that team has had to stop batting and leave the pitch and there is nobody left to bat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人或身体部位)瘦弱的，衰老的，枯槁的

ext.ext_cn: 她干瘪的双手
ext.ext_en: ...her withered hands.

ext.ext_cn: 酒保憔悴的面容
ext.ext_en: ...the bartender's withered face.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or a part of their body as withered, you mean that they are thin and their skin looks old.

defs.def_cn: (四肢因疾病或受伤)瘦弱的，萎缩的

ext.ext_cn: 她有一条腿有点儿萎缩，看上去明显比另一条腿瘦。
ext.ext_en: She has one slightly withered leg, noticeably thinner than the other.

defs.def_en: Withered is used to describe someone's leg or arm when it is thin and weak because of disease or injury.

defs.def_cn: （男孩或男子）粗野的，吵闹的，暴力的

ext.ext_cn: 粗野狂暴的足球迷
ext.ext_en: ...yobbish football supporters.

defs.def_en: If you describe a boy or a man as yobbish, you disapprove of him because he behaves in a noisy, rude, and perhaps violent way in public.

ext.ext_cn: 雅各布夫人那块价值3,000英镑的名牌手表在西伦敦的家中被人抢走了。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Yacoub was robbed of her £3,000 designer watch at her West London home...

ext.ext_cn: 警察说斯泰凡诺夫斯基就在几个小时前抢劫了一名男子。
ext.ext_en: Police said Stefanovski had robbed a man just hours earlier.

defs.def_en: If someone is robbed, they have money or property stolen from them.

ext.ext_cn: 随着迈尔斯·戴维斯的去世，爵士乐界失去了其最与众不同的声音。
ext.ext_en: When Miles Davis died, jazz was robbed of its most distinctive voice...

ext.ext_cn: 我不能原谅刘易斯夺走了我一块奥运会金牌。
ext.ext_en: I can't forgive Lewis for robbing me of an Olympic gold.

defs.def_en: If someone is robbed of something that they deserve, have, or need, it is taken away from them.

ext.ext_cn: 巴西及加勒比地区奴隶制的废除
ext.ext_en: ...the abolition of slavery in Brazil and the Caribbean.

defs.def_en: The abolition of something such as a system or practice is its formal ending.

defs.def_en: Runes are letters from an alphabet that was used by people in Northern Europe in former times. They were carved on wood or stone and were believed to have magical powers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们的通讯系统效率非常差。
ext.ext_en: Their communication systems are inefficient in the extreme.

ext.ext_cn: 设备陈旧、效率低下的工厂的关闭
ext.ext_en: ...the closure of outdated and inefficient factories.

defs.def_en: Inefficient people, organizations, systems, or machines do not use time, energy, or other resources in the best way.

ext.ext_cn: 我们对我们调查的真实性有十足的把握。
ext.ext_en: We have total confidence in the veracity of our research...

ext.ext_cn: 发现自己的诚信受到了质疑，他很震惊。
ext.ext_en: He was shocked to find his veracity questioned.

defs.def_en: Veracity is the quality of being true or the habit of telling the truth.

ext.ext_cn: 料理好厨房需要把一切都安排得规规矩矩，且要讲求速度。
ext.ext_en: Running a kitchen involves a great deal of discipline and speed...

ext.ext_cn: 尼基作为公共关系主管，需要花很多时间与别人打交道。
ext.ext_en: Nicky's job as a public relations director involves spending quite a lot of time with other people.

defs.def_en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果有人想要隐瞒实情,那其中就涉及政府部门最高层的人物。
ext.ext_en: If there was a cover-up, it involved people at the very highest levels of government.

ext.ext_cn: 有 100 名囚犯参与的暴动
ext.ext_en: ...a riot involving a hundred inmates...

defs.def_en: If a situation or activity involves someone, they are taking part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 我似乎卷入了一件我并不知情的事情当中。
ext.ext_en: I seem to have involved myself in something I don't understand.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone involves themselves in something, you mean that they take part in it, often in a way that is unnecessary or unwanted.

ext.ext_cn: 我和诺埃尔什么事情都一起做,他让我参与所有的事。
ext.ext_en: Noel and I do everything together, he involves me in everything...

ext.ext_cn: 不久,他便开始让我介入工作中更机密的方面。
ext.ext_en: Before too long he started involving me in the more confidential aspects of the job.

defs.def_en: If you involve someone else in something, you get them to take part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 预订晚了的话你可能要额外多花钱。
ext.ext_en: A late booking may involve you in extra cost...

ext.ext_en: This involved me in a round trip of over 400 miles.

defs.def_en: If one thing involves you in another thing, especially something unpleasant or inconvenient, the first thing causes you to do or deal with the second.

defs.def_cn: 偷偷摸摸地走;悄悄走;溜走

defs.def_en: If you slink somewhere, you move there quietly because you do not want to be seen.

defs.def_cn: (占了便宜或知道了别人不知道的事情时)洋洋得意地笑，自鸣得意地笑

ext.ext_cn: 两个男人一面看着我，一面用胳膊肘顶顶对方，笑容里夹杂着一丝得意。
ext.ext_en: Two men looked at me, nudged each other and smirked...

defs.def_en: If you smirk, you smile in an unpleasant way, often because you believe that you have gained an advantage over someone else or know something that they do not know.

defs.def_cn: (由警察、士兵或车辆组成的)警戒线，封锁线;封锁圈

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 完美的;无瑕的;无可挑剔的

ext.ext_cn: 她将自己无瑕的肌肤归功于所使用的保湿霜。
ext.ext_en: She attributed her flawless complexion to the moisturiser she used...

defs.def_en: An outpost is a small group of buildings used for trading or military purposes, either in a distant part of your own country or in a foreign country.

ext.ext_en: Leftover food and unwashed dishes cover the dirty counters.

ext.ext_en: A scowling man briskly led the Queen's husband away from the great unwashed.

defs.def_en: The unwashed or the great unwashed is a way of referring to poor or ordinary people.

defs.def_cn: (儿童填色用的)填色本，涂色本
defs.def_en: A colouring book is a book of simple drawings which children can colour in.

ext.ext_en: Main Street in Great Barrington is lined with small storefronts and restaurants.

ext.ext_en: ...a tiny storefront office on the main street.

defs.def_en: A storefront is a small shop or office that opens onto the street and is part of a row of shops or offices.

defs.def_cn: (免征关税的)自由港，自由口岸
defs.def_en: A free port is a port or airport where goods can be brought in from foreign countries without payment of duty if they are going to be exported again.

ext.ext_cn: 似乎每天都有投诉。
ext.ext_en: Complaints seemed to be an everyday occurrence...

ext.ext_en: The food queues have become a daily occurrence across the country.

defs.def_en: An occurrence is something that happens.

ext.ext_cn: 65岁以上者是冠心病的最高发人群。
ext.ext_en: The greatest occurrence of coronary heart disease is in those over 65.

defs.def_en: The occurrence of something is the fact that it happens or is present.

ext.ext_cn: 一大盒糖
ext.ext_en: ...a large box of candies...

ext.ext_en: The airline's biggest headache is the increase in the price of aviation fuel...

ext.ext_cn: 这对我们来说真是个难题。
ext.ext_en: This is a real headache for us.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a headache, you mean that it causes you difficulty or worry.

defs.def_cn: (高速公路旁的)休息区，服务区

ext.ext_en: His fast-paced novels are full of bizarre situations and madcap antics.

ext.ext_en: Nobody will be allowed to smoke in an office if there are non-smokers present.

ext.ext_en: High Point prison had the highest number of breakouts of any jail in Britain.

ext.ext_cn: 他被指称使用过侮辱性语言。
ext.ext_en: He was alleged to have used abusive language.

defs.def_en: Abusive language is extremely rude and insulting.

ext.ext_cn: 在昨日星辰客栈，我总有种宾至如归的感觉。
ext.ext_en: I always feel at home at Ye Olde Starre Inn.

defs.def_en: Olde is used in names of places and in advertising to make people think that something is very old and interesting.

defs.def_cn: （尤指向组织、出版物或专家提出的）问题，疑问，询问

ext.ext_en: If you have any queries about this insurance, please contact Travel Insurance Services Limited.

defs.def_en: A query is a question, especially one that you ask an organization, publication, or expert.

defs.def_cn: 对…提出疑问;对…表示怀疑

ext.ext_cn: 这上面有一个号码，您可以打电话查询您的账单。
ext.ext_en: It's got a number you can ring to query your bill...

ext.ext_cn: 没人对我的决定提出质疑。
ext.ext_en: No one queried my decision.

defs.def_en: If you query something, you check it by asking about it because you are not sure if it is correct.

ext.ext_cn: 海伦的话音刚落，赖尔便问道：“还有其他事吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'Is there something else?' Ryle queried as Helen stopped speaking...

ext.ext_cn: 其中一位新闻记者询问是否有人为破坏的可能性。
ext.ext_en: One of the journalists queried whether sabotage could have been involved.

defs.def_en: To query means to ask a question.
A falcon is a bird of prey that can be trained to hunt other birds and animals.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 托尼除了一根手指严重淤青外没有受到其他伤害。
ext.ext_en: Tony emerged unscathed apart from a severely bruised finger...

ext.ext_cn: 相对来说，洛杉矶东部基本没有受到暴乱的影响。
ext.ext_en: East Los Angeles was left relatively unscathed by the riots...

defs.def_en: If you are unscathed after a dangerous experience, you have not been injured or harmed by it.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第16个字母
defs.def_en: P is the sixteenth letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_en: P or p is used as an abbreviation for words beginning with p, such as 'per' or 'parking'.

defs.def_cn: （音乐中表示乐曲应该轻声演奏）
defs.def_en: In a piece of music, p is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) piano and indicates that the piece should be played quietly.

ext.ext_cn: 他的行动几乎遭到了一致的反对。
ext.ext_en: His action had been greeted with almost universal disapproval.

ext.ext_cn: 通过禁酒来反对饮酒
ext.ext_en: ...a society that registered its disapproval of alcohol by banning it.

defs.def_en: If you feel or show disapproval of something or someone, you feel or show that you do not approve of them.

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢起居室那深色的木构件、东方地毯和厚重的家具。
ext.ext_en: I love the living room, with its dark woodwork, oriental rugs, and chunky furniture...

ext.ext_cn: 他可以看到木构件上新刷的油漆泛着光。
ext.ext_en: He could see the glimmer of fresh paint on the woodwork.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the doors and other wooden parts of a house as the woodwork .

ext.ext_cn: 我做木工好多年了。
ext.ext_en: I have done woodwork for many years...

ext.ext_cn: 约瑟夫教一个班木工课。
ext.ext_en: Joseph instructs a class in woodwork.

defs.def_en: Woodwork is the activity or skill of making things out of wood.

defs.def_cn: 突然跳出来;突然冒出来

ext.ext_cn: 当一首歌非常流行的时候，有人就会跳出来，说是自己写的。
ext.ext_en: When a song gets to the top, someone will come out of the woodwork and claim to have written it.

defs.def_en: If you say that people are coming out of the woodwork, you are criticizing them for suddenly appearing in public or revealing their opinions when previously they did not make themselves known.

ext.ext_cn: 他制订了几条原则，希望可以引导继任者。
ext.ext_en: He set out several principles that he hopes will guide his successors...

ext.ext_cn: 紧接着，一些评论家称赞他为当今苏格兰最伟大的诗人，是他的老朋友休·麦克迪尔米德理所当然的接班人。
ext.ext_en: ...several critics hailed him then as the greatest living Scottish poet, the natural successor to his old friend Hugh MacDiarmid.

defs.def_en: Someone's successor is the person who takes their job after they have left.

ext.ext_cn: 他的动作带着一种训练有素的拳击手的风采。
ext.ext_en: He moved with the grace of a trained boxer...

ext.ext_cn: 芭蕾课可以很好地使人保持优雅的仪态。
ext.ext_en: Ballet classes are important for poise and grace.

defs.def_en: If someone moves with grace, they move in a smooth, controlled, and attractive way.

ext.ext_cn: 新国王在履行职责时看起来举止得体、端庄稳重。
ext.ext_en: The new King seemed to be carrying out his duties with grace and due decorum...

ext.ext_cn: 这个年轻女子有着超越年龄的涵养。
ext.ext_en: The young woman had grace beyond her years.

defs.def_en: If someone behaves with grace, they behave in a pleasant, polite, and dignified way, even when they are upset or being treated unfairly.

ext.ext_cn: 她不适合这种场合，对社交礼仪所知甚少。
ext.ext_en: She didn't fit in and she had few social graces.

defs.def_en: The graces are the ways of behaving and doing things which are considered polite and well-mannered.

ext.ext_cn: 她想延缓几天，等到把这套复式公寓清理干净后再搬进去。
ext.ext_en: She wanted a couple of days' grace to get the maisonette cleaned before she moved in...

ext.ext_cn: 士兵到来之前我们只剩下几个小时了。
ext.ext_en: We have only a few hours' grace before the soldiers come.

defs.def_en: Grace is used in expressions such as a day's  grace and a month's grace to say that you are allowed that amount of extra time before you have to finish something.

ext.ext_cn: 他走到为这间舒适的房间增色不少的漂亮的旧威尔士碗橱前。
ext.ext_en: He went to the beautiful old Welsh dresser that graced this homely room...

ext.ext_cn: 肩上披着的貂皮衬托得她更加优雅，手上的钻戒则光彩夺目。
ext.ext_en: Her shoulders were graced with mink and her fingers sparkled with diamonds.

defs.def_en: If you say that something graces a place or a person, you mean that it makes them more attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 他应邀为这所夜校的活动捧场。
ext.ext_en: He had been invited to grace a function at the evening college.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone important will grace an event or an organization, you mean that they have agreed to be present at the event or to be part of the organization.

ext.ext_cn: 承蒙上帝保佑才无人死亡。
ext.ext_en: It was only by the grace of God that no one died.

defs.def_en: In Christianity and some other religions, grace is the kindness that God shows to people because he loves them.

ext.ext_en: Leo, will you say grace?

ext.ext_cn: 拉丁文的谢恩祷告
ext.ext_en: ...a Latin grace.

defs.def_en: When someone says grace before or after a meal, they say a prayer in which they thank God for the food and ask Him to bless it.

defs.def_cn: （对公爵、公爵夫人或大主教的尊称）大人，阁下，夫人

ext.ext_en: Your Grace, I have a great favour to ask of you.

defs.def_en: You use expressions such as Your Grace and His Grace when you are addressing or referring to a duke, duchess, or archbishop.

ext.ext_cn: 我最初一帆风顺，备受器重，但现在却失宠了。
ext.ext_en: All went well at first, and I was in high favour; but presently I fell from grace...

defs.def_en: If someone falls from grace, they suddenly stop being successful or popular.

defs.def_cn: 通情达理地做;知趣地做

ext.ext_en: He did not even have the grace to apologise...

ext.ext_cn: 我们很多人在年轻的时候都会干些糊涂事，但是，我们应该懂得承认错误。
ext.ext_en: Many of us do stupid things in our youth, but we should have the good grace to admit them.

defs.def_en: If someone has the good grace to do something, they are polite enough or honest enough to do it.

defs.def_cn: 若非上帝保佑，要不是我福大命大（我也会遭此不幸）
defs.def_en: If you are talking about someone who is in a bad situation and you say 'There but for the grace of God go I', you mean that you are lucky not to be in the same situation as them and you feel sympathy for them.

defs.def_cn: 情愿地/ 不情愿地；欣然地/不乐意地

ext.ext_cn: 他欣然接受这一决定并祝我好运。
ext.ext_en: He accepted the decision with good grace, and wished me the very best of luck...

ext.ext_en: With appallingly bad grace I packed up and we drove north.

defs.def_en: If you do something unpleasant with good grace or with a good grace, you do it cheerfully and without complaining. If you do something with bad grace or with a bad grace, you do it unwillingly and without enthusiasm.

ext.ext_cn: 你如此急于博得国王的欢心，以致其他事情都不管不顾了。
ext.ext_en: You're so eager to stay in the good graces of the King that nothing else matters to you.

defs.def_en: If you are in someone's good graces, they are pleased with you.

ext.ext_en: He inspires affection and respect as a man of unquestionable integrity...

ext.ext_en: There is an unquestionable link between job losses and deteriorating services.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unquestionable, you are emphasizing that it is so obviously true or real that nobody can doubt it.

ext.ext_en: He caught an eastbound train to Tottenham Court Road.

defs.def_en: Eastbound roads or vehicles lead to or are travelling towards the east.

ext.ext_en: In the guard's van lay my tin trunk.

defs.def_en: A van is a railway carriage, often without windows, which is used to carry luggage, goods, or mail.

ext.ext_en: ...the Community's enlargement.

defs.def_en: An enlargement is a photograph that has been made bigger.

ext.ext_en: At present many schools' sports grounds are grossly underused.

ext.ext_cn: 肌肉未得到充分利用而发育不良的地方
ext.ext_en: ...areas where muscles are underused and underdeveloped.

defs.def_en: Something useful that is underused is not used as much for people's benefit as it could be.

ext.ext_en: The company backed away from plans to cut their pay by 15%...

ext.ext_cn: 他正脱离其前任的政策和风格。
ext.ext_en: He's backing away from the policies and style of his predecessor...

defs.def_en: If you back away from a commitment that you made or something that you were involved with in the past, you try to show that you are no longer committed to it or involved with it.

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯起身走过来，但是女孩子们却连忙后退。
ext.ext_en: James got to his feet and started to come over, but the girls hastily backed away.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 值得想望（或拥有）的;合意的;可取的;受欢迎的

ext.ext_en: ...the young women whom his classmates thought most desirable.

defs.def_en: Someone who is desirable is considered to be sexually attractive.

ext.ext_en: Revisionist history must be challenged by historical research.

ext.ext_en: ...the revisionist interpretation of the French Revolution.

ext.ext_en: This revisionist thesis departs even further from Marxist assertions.

ext.ext_en: Valence is a sleepy little town just south of Lyon.

defs.def_en: A sleepy place is quiet and does not have much activity or excitement.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 该地居民紧密抱团，狭隘排外。

ext.ext_cn: 医院是非常狭隘排外的地方。
ext.ext_en: Hospitals are very incestuous places.

ext.ext_en: Don't overuse heated appliances on you hair.

defs.def_en: If someone overuses something, they use more of it than necessary, or use it more often than necessary.

ext.ext_cn: 你最为常用的词或词组有哪些？
ext.ext_en: Which words or phrases do you most overuse?

defs.def_en: If you say that people overuse a word or idea, you mean that they use it so often that it no longer has any real meaning or effect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 冷冰冰、不苟言笑的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a dour, taciturn man...

ext.ext_cn: 难怪他看上去如此严厉。
ext.ext_en: No wonder he looked so dour.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as dour, you mean that they are very serious and unfriendly.

defs.def_cn: 使(信仰、价值观等)内在化;吸收

ext.ext_cn: 随着时间的流逝她认同了父母的看法并将之融为自我意识的一部分。
ext.ext_en: Over time she internalized her parents' attitudes.

ext.ext_cn: 依赖内化的是非观来维持的社会秩序
ext.ext_en: ...a social order which depends on internalized feelings of what is right and wrong.

defs.def_en: If you internalize something such as a belief or a set of values, you make it become part of your attitude or way of thinking.

ext.ext_cn: 我想要一个苹果。
ext.ext_en: I want an apple.

ext.ext_cn: 两公斤烹调用的苹果
ext.ext_en: ...2kg cooking apples.

defs.def_en: See also:Adam's apple;Big Apple;crab apple;An apple is a round fruit with smooth green, yellow, or red skin and firm white flesh.

ext.ext_cn: 彭妮的独子是她的心肝宝贝。
ext.ext_en: Penny's only son was the apple of her eye.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is the apple of your eye, you mean that they are very important to you and you are extremely fond of them.

ext.ext_cn: 煤气系统的官员正在调查一起瓦斯爆炸的起因,这起事故严重毁坏了汉普郡的一所房屋。
ext.ext_en: Gas officials are investigating the cause of an explosion which badly damaged a house in Hampshire...

ext.ext_cn: 两名警官正在接受检察官的审查。
ext.ext_en: The two officers were being investigated by the director of public prosecutions...

defs.def_en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

ext.ext_cn: 诺埃尔先生为伦敦的6个销售职位选出了10人进行面试。
ext.ext_en: Mr Nowell had picked ten people to interview for six sales jobs in London...

ext.ext_cn: 我特意选了一个热带气候的城市。
ext.ext_en: I had deliberately picked a city with a tropical climate.

defs.def_en: If you pick a particular person or thing, you choose that one.

ext.ext_cn: 这儿的男孩是全国15岁以下板球手中的佼佼者。
ext.ext_en: The boys here are the pick of the under-15 cricketers in the country...

ext.ext_cn: 我们买了店里最好的套装。
ext.ext_en: We had the pick of suits from the shop.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the best things or people in a particular group as the pick of that group.

ext.ext_cn: 她过去常到克伦威尔路采花。
ext.ext_en: She used to pick flowers in the Cromwell Road...

ext.ext_cn: 他帮母亲摘果子。
ext.ext_en: He helps his mother pick fruit.

defs.def_en: When you pick flowers, fruit, or leaves, you break them off the plant or tree and collect them.

ext.ext_cn: 他拿起腿上的餐巾，放在盘子旁边。
ext.ext_en: He picked the napkin from his lap and placed it alongside his plate...

ext.ext_cn: 他从墙上的固定托架上摘下电话。
ext.ext_en: He picked the telephone off the wall bracket.

defs.def_en: If you pick something from a place, you remove it from there with your fingers or your hand.

ext.ext_cn: 埃德加，不要抠鼻子，宝贝儿。
ext.ext_en: Edgar, don't pick your nose, dear...

ext.ext_cn: 他刚吃完饭，正在剔牙。
ext.ext_en: He had just had a meal and was picking his teeth after it.

defs.def_en: If you pick your nose or teeth, you remove substances from inside your nose or between your teeth.

defs.def_cn: 寻找…的口实；寻（衅）；找（碴儿）

ext.ext_cn: 他找碴儿跟服务生打了一架，最后进了监狱。
ext.ext_en: He picked a fight with a waiter and landed in jail...

ext.ext_cn: 他现在的心情明显是逮谁就想跟谁吵。
ext.ext_en: He was clearly in a mood to pick a quarrel with anybody.

defs.def_en: If you pick a fight or quarrel with someone, you deliberately cause one.

ext.ext_cn: 他熟练地撬开每一把锁，把每个抽屉里的文件都偷走了。
ext.ext_en: He picked each lock deftly, and rifled the papers within each drawer.

defs.def_en: If someone such as a thief picks a lock, they open it without a key, for example by using a piece of wire.
A pick is the same as a pickaxe .

defs.def_cn: 挑挑拣拣；挑三拣四；挑剔

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名职业教师，我几乎可以随意挑拣自己的工作。
ext.ext_en: As a vocational teacher I could pretty much pick and choose my work...

ext.ext_cn: 我们患者不能对医生挑挑拣拣。
ext.ext_en: We, the patients, cannot pick and choose our doctors.

defs.def_en: If you pick and choose, you carefully choose only things that you really want and reject the others.

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个角色任她挑选的女演员。
ext.ext_en: Here is an actress who could have her pick of any part...

ext.ext_cn: 克莱恩本可以从世界顶尖模特中想选谁就选谁。
ext.ext_en: Klein could have had his pick of the world's top models.

defs.def_en: If you have your pick of a group of things, you are able to choose any of them that you want.

ext.ext_cn: 会计师可以任选配备的公车。
ext.ext_en: Accountants can take their pick of company cars...

ext.ext_cn: 10家豪华宾馆任你选择。
ext.ext_en: Take your pick from ten luxury hotels...

defs.def_en: If you are told to take your pick, you can choose any one that you like from a group of things.

ext.ext_cn: 女孩们害怕蛇，于是谨小慎微地择路而行。
ext.ext_en: The girls were afraid of snakes and picked their way along with extreme caution...

ext.ext_cn: 我离开木屋，小心地走在瓦砾间。
ext.ext_en: I moved away from the shack and picked my way among the rubble.

defs.def_en: If you pick your way across an area, you walk across it very carefully in order to avoid obstacles or dangerous things.

defs.def_cn: 收拾残局；努力恢复正常

ext.ext_cn: 我们是想要防患未然呢，还是想要事后收拾残局？
ext.ext_en: Do we try and prevent problems or do we try and pick up the pieces afterwards?...

ext.ext_cn: 她死后我竟一蹶不振，无法重新来过。
ext.ext_en: She died, and somehow I never picked up the pieces and started again.

defs.def_en: When you pick up the pieces after a disaster, you do what you can to get the situation back to normal again.

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩慢慢开动汽车，但很快就加速了。
ext.ext_en: Brian pulled away slowly, but picked up speed.

defs.def_en: When a vehicle picks up speed, it begins to move more quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 肉和鱼相对来说比较贵。
ext.ext_en: Meat and fish are relatively expensive.

ext.ext_cn: 进口肉制品
ext.ext_en: ...imported meat products.

defs.def_en: Meat is flesh taken from a dead animal that people cook and eat.

defs.def_cn: 喜欢做的事;感兴趣的事

ext.ext_cn: 一般人认为有压力的事情在他看来却是快乐无比的事。
ext.ext_en: What normal people considered pressure was meat and drink to him.

defs.def_en: If you say something is meat and drink to someone, you mean that they enjoy it very much.

defs.def_cn: 最基本的部分;根本部分;关键

ext.ext_cn: 他们想知道的是我们如何改善国家、让其恢复活力的基本方法。
ext.ext_en: What they want is the meat and potatoes of how we're going to improve this country and get our country moving again.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the meat and potatoes of something, you mean its most basic, simple, and essential parts.

ext.ext_cn: 他合衣躺在床上。
ext.ext_en: He lay down on the bed fully clothed...

ext.ext_cn: 她穿着一条花裙子。
ext.ext_en: She was clothed in a flowered dress.

defs.def_en: If you are clothed in a certain way, you are dressed in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 现在峡谷的南边已长满树木。
ext.ext_en: The south side of the gorge is now clothed in trees.

defs.def_en: If a place or thing is clothed in something, it is covered in that thing.
A toilet roll is a long narrow strip of toilet paper that is wound around a small cardboard tube.

ext.ext_cn: 绑匪成功地勒索了7.5万英镑才将她释放。
ext.ext_en: Her kidnapper successfully extorted a £75,000 ransom for her release...

ext.ext_cn: 总统称美国永远不会为这些人质支付赎金。
ext.ext_en: The president has said the United States will never pay ransom for the hostages...

defs.def_en: A ransom is the money that has to be paid to someone so that they will set free a person they have kidnapped.

ext.ext_cn: 相同的制度还应用于赎回或交换俘虏。
ext.ext_en: The same system was used for ransoming or exchanging captives.

defs.def_en: If you ransom someone who has been kidnapped, you pay the money to set them free.

defs.def_cn: 劫持（某人）勒索金钱;绑票;绑架

ext.ext_cn: 他被控于去年绑架了一名商人并勒索钱财。
ext.ext_en: He is charged with kidnapping a businessman last year and holding him for ransom...

ext.ext_cn: 在里约热内卢，仅今年一年就有近40人被绑票。
ext.ext_en: In Rio, nearly forty people have been held to ransom this year alone...

defs.def_en: If a kidnapper is holding someone to ransom or holding them ransom in British English, or is holding a person for ransom in American English, they keep that person prisoner until they are given what they want.

ext.ext_cn: 公务员工会和其他工会有能力胁迫政府。
ext.ext_en: Unison and the other unions have the power to hold the Government to ransom.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is holding you to ransom in British English, or holding you for ransom in American English, you mean that they are using their power to try to force you to do something which you do not want to do.

ext.ext_cn: 乐意为理发出高价的顾客
ext.ext_en: ...clients happy to pay a king's ransom for a haircut.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a sum of money as a king's ransom, you are emphasizing that it is very large.

defs.def_cn: 罕见的人（或物）；奇物;珍品

ext.ext_cn: 电动轮椅在这里很罕见。
ext.ext_en: Motorized wheelchairs are a rarity here...

ext.ext_cn: 他在华尔街的律师当中是个奇人。
ext.ext_en: He was a rarity among Wall Street lawyers...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is a rarity, they are interesting or valuable because they are so unusual.

ext.ext_cn: 这显示出这种疾病发作的罕见性。
ext.ext_en: This indicates the rarity of such attacks...

ext.ext_cn: 因为稀有并且品相完好，它价值连城。
ext.ext_en: It was a real prize due to its rarity and good condition...

defs.def_en: The rarity of something is the fact that it is very uncommon.

ext.ext_cn: 耳垢堵塞耳道可能会影响听力。
ext.ext_en: Hearing can be affected by ear wax blocking the ear canal.

defs.def_en: Your ear canal is the tube that opens in your outer ear and leads inside your ear.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不需要的；没必要的；多余的

ext.ext_cn: 屠杀鲸鱼是没有必要的也是不人道的。
ext.ext_en: The slaughter of whales is unnecessary and inhuman...

ext.ext_cn: 他责备黛安娜没必要那么大惊小怪。
ext.ext_en: He accused Diana of making an unnecessary fuss.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unnecessary, you mean that it is not needed or does not have to be done, and is undesirable.

defs.def_cn: 晚宴舞会;(筵席结束后有舞会的)正式宴会
defs.def_en: A dinner dance is a social event where a large number of people come to have dinner and to dance. Dinner dances are held in the evening at hotels, restaurants, and social clubs.
A parka is a jacket or coat which has a thick lining and a hood with fur round the edge.

ext.ext_cn: 他说抗议者正对国家造成危害。
ext.ext_en: He said the protesters were doing a disservice to the nation...

ext.ext_cn: 将一切都透露给潜在的竞争对手只会给自己帮倒忙。
ext.ext_en: You could do yourself a grave disservice by revealing all to a potential rival.

defs.def_en: If you do someone or something a disservice, you harm them in some way.
An auk is a seabird with a heavy body and short tail.

ext.ext_cn: 有人摔碎了一个瓶子。
ext.ext_en: Someone smashed a bottle...

ext.ext_cn: 一群年轻人开始砸玻璃。
ext.ext_en: A crowd of youths started smashing windows...

defs.def_en: If you smash something or if it smashes, it breaks into many pieces, for example when it is hit or dropped.

ext.ext_cn: 示威者用卡车撞开了使馆大门。
ext.ext_en: The demonstrators used trucks to smash through embassy gates...

ext.ext_cn: 士兵冲进了他的办公室。
ext.ext_en: Soldiers smashed their way into his office.

defs.def_en: If you smash through a wall, gate, or door, you get through it by hitting and breaking it.

ext.ext_cn: 瓶子撞到了墙上。
ext.ext_en: The bottle smashed against a wall...

ext.ext_cn: 他一拳打在了安东尼脸上。
ext.ext_en: He smashed his fist into Anthony's face.

defs.def_en: If something smashes or is smashed against something solid, it moves very fast and with great force against it.

defs.def_cn: (有意识地)摧毁，粉碎，消灭(政治组织、制度等)

ext.ext_cn: 他们力图重整政坛、摧毁现有的政党机器，却以失败收场。
ext.ext_en: Their attempts to clean up politics and smash the power of party machines failed.

defs.def_en: To smash a political group or system means to deliberately destroy it.

ext.ext_cn: 影片成败与否取决于公众。
ext.ext_en: It is the public who decide if a film is a smash or a flop.

defs.def_en: A smash is the same as a smash hit .

ext.ext_cn: 他差点在一场撞车事故中丧命。
ext.ext_en: He was near to death after a car smash.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a car crash as a smash .

defs.def_cn: 往楼下;顺楼梯而下;至楼下

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼丝下楼泡了茶。
ext.ext_en: Denise went downstairs and made some tea.

defs.def_en: If you go downstairs in a building, you go down a staircase towards the ground floor.

ext.ext_cn: 电话在楼下的门厅里。
ext.ext_en: The telephone was downstairs in the entrance hall...

ext.ext_cn: 大家都在楼下看电影。
ext.ext_en: Everybody was downstairs watching a movie.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is downstairs in a building, they are on the ground floor or on a lower floor than you.

ext.ext_cn: 她重新粉刷了楼下的房间，并把二楼封上了。
ext.ext_en: She repainted the downstairs rooms and closed off the second floor.

defs.def_en: Downstairs means situated on the ground floor of a building or on a lower floor than you are.

ext.ext_cn: 两栋小楼的底层已经彻底翻修过。
ext.ext_en: The downstairs of the two little houses had been entirely refashioned.

defs.def_en: The downstairs of a building is its lower floor or floors.
Your molars are the large, flat teeth towards the back of your mouth that you use for chewing food.

ext.ext_cn: 我将课本还给他了。
ext.ext_en: I gave the textbook back to him...

ext.ext_cn: 你将幻灯机还给我了。
ext.ext_en: You gave me back the projector...

defs.def_en: If you give something back, you return it to the person who gave it to you.

ext.ext_cn: 所有的煤矿都在开工的那个时候，这个社区的情况要更好一些。
ext.ext_en: It was a better community then when all the pits were working.

defs.def_en: A pit is a coal mine.

ext.ext_cn: 埃里克一脚踩空，开始往坑里滑。
ext.ext_en: Eric lost his footing and began to slide into the pit.

defs.def_en: A pit is a large hole that is dug in the ground.

defs.def_cn: （挖出沙砾或黏土后留下的）坑，窑

ext.ext_cn: 这块过去曾是农田的地1964年前一直被用作沙砾坑。
ext.ext_en: This area of former farmland was worked as a gravel pit until 1964.

defs.def_en: A gravel pit or clay pit is a very large hole that is left where gravel or clay has been dug from the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 你将和与你势均力敌的对手展开竞争。
ext.ext_en: You will be pitted against people who are every bit as good as you are...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个人挑战整个宇宙。
ext.ext_en: This was one man pitted against the universe.

defs.def_en: If two opposing things or people are pitted against one another, they are in conflict.

ext.ext_cn: 他迅速进入检修加油站，飞快地爬出赛车。
ext.ext_en: He moved quickly into the pits and climbed rapidly out of the car.

defs.def_en: See also:pit stop;In motor racing, the pits are the areas at the side of the track where drivers stop to get more fuel and to repair their cars during races.

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽·安问他晚餐怎么样，他回答说：“糟透了。”
ext.ext_en: Mary Ann asked him how dinner had been. 'The pits,' he replied.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as the pits, you mean that it is extremely bad.
A pit is the stone of a fruit or vegetable.

ext.ext_cn: 我希望同最优秀的对手斗智。
ext.ext_en: I'd like to pit my wits against the best.

defs.def_en: If you pit your wits against someone, you compete with them in a test of knowledge or intelligence.

ext.ext_cn: 我心头有种怪怪的感觉。
ext.ext_en: I had a funny feeling in the pit of my stomach.

defs.def_en: If you have a feeling in the pit of your stomach, you have a tight or sick feeling in your stomach, usually because you are afraid or anxious.

defs.def_cn: 法定强奸罪(在美国指与未成年人发生性关系)
defs.def_en: In the United States, statutory rape is the crime committed by an adult when they have sex with someone who is under the age when they can legally agree to have sex.

defs.def_cn: 搁置;悬而未决;暂停使用

ext.ext_cn: 这一威胁很可能会一直存在下去，直至明年的雷克雅未克会议。
ext.ext_en: The threat is likely to remain in abeyance until next year's meeting in Reykjavik.

ext.ext_cn: 事情被搁置了起来，直到黑格见到法国人。
ext.ext_en: The matter was left in abeyance until Haig saw French.

defs.def_en: If something is in abeyance, it is not operating or being used at the present time.

defs.def_cn: 货比三家再买;逐店比较后选购

ext.ext_cn: 价格可能会有高有低，所以在买之前很有必要货比三家。
ext.ext_en: Prices may vary so it's well worth shopping around before you buy...

ext.ext_cn: 他到处寻觅一家可灵活变通的公司。
ext.ext_en: He shopped around for a firm that would be flexible.

defs.def_en: If you shop around, you go to different shops or companies in order to compare the prices and quality of goods or services before you decide to buy them.
Rhinestones are shiny, glass jewels that are used in cheap jewellery and to decorate clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 我不是宗教狂热分子，但我是基督徒。
ext.ext_en: I am not a religious fanatic but I am a Christian.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a fanatic, you disapprove of them because you consider their behaviour or opinions to be very extreme, for example in the way they support particular religious or political ideas.

defs.def_cn: (对某一活动、运动、生活方式)入迷者，痴狂者

ext.ext_cn: 罗德和菲尔两人都是足球迷。
ext.ext_en: Both Rod and Phil are football fanatics.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a fanatic, you mean that they are very enthusiastic about a particular activity, sport, or way of life.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Fanatic means the same as fanatical .

ext.ext_cn: 人们看见他就反复不停地喊：“犹大！犹大！”
ext.ext_en: He was greeted by the chant of 'Judas! Judas!'.

defs.def_en: A chant is a word or group of words that is repeated over and over again.

ext.ext_cn: 格列高利圣歌
ext.ext_en: ...a Gregorian chant.

ext.ext_cn: 佛经诵念
ext.ext_en: ...a Buddhist chant.

defs.def_en: A chant is a religious song or prayer that is sung on only a few notes.

ext.ext_cn: 示威者们反复喊着口号。
ext.ext_en: Demonstrators chanted slogans...

ext.ext_cn: 人群一再呼喊：“我们支持你。”
ext.ext_en: The crowd chanted 'We are with you.'...

defs.def_en: If you chant something or if you chant, you repeat the same words over and over again.

ext.ext_cn: 穆斯林们诵经、祈祷。
ext.ext_en: Muslims chanted and prayed...

ext.ext_cn: 夏尔马先生点上香，念起梵文咒语。
ext.ext_en: Mr Sharma lit incense and chanted Sanskrit mantras.

defs.def_en: If you chant or if you chant something, you sing a religious song or prayer.

defs.def_cn: （应到而未到的）不在者，缺席者
defs.def_en: An absentee is a person who is expected to be in a particular place but who is not there.

ext.ext_cn: 缺席的父亲将会被强制要求支付孩子的抚养费。
ext.ext_en: Absentee fathers will be forced to pay child maintenance.

ext.ext_cn: 在外业主
ext.ext_en: ...an absentee landlord.

defs.def_en: Absentee is used to describe someone who is not there to do a particular job in person.

defs.def_cn: 缺席的（指美国因故预先投票的选票或选民）

ext.ext_cn: 他已进行了缺席投票。
ext.ext_en: He has already voted by absentee ballot...

ext.ext_cn: 缺席投票的最后期限是星期六。
ext.ext_en: The deadline for absentee voting in was Saturday.

defs.def_en: In elections in the United States, if you vote by absentee ballot or if you are an absentee voter, you vote in advance because you will be away.
Brushed cotton, nylon, or other fabric feels soft and furry.

ext.ext_cn: 现在来自外部的结婚压力少了。
ext.ext_en: Nowadays there are fewer extrinsic pressures to get married.

defs.def_en: Extrinsic reasons, forces, or factors exist outside the person or situation they affect.

ext.ext_cn: 在火车站附近大约有100家旅馆。
ext.ext_en: There were a hundred or so hotels in the vicinity of the railway station...

ext.ext_cn: 警察设置的路障还在，房子四周仍然用警戒线隔离着。
