ext.ext_en: Every single relationship I've had with a man, outside of my husband, has ended in disaster.

defs.def_en: Outside of is used to introduce the only thing or person that prevents your main statement from being completely true.

ext.ext_cn: 最多给自己留40分钟。
ext.ext_en: Give yourself forty minutes at the outside.

defs.def_en: You use at the outside to say that you think that a particular amount is the largest possible in a particular situation, or that a particular time is the latest possible time for something to happen.
A parent-teacher association is the same as a PTA .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这种淋浴器安装起来很简单。
ext.ext_en: The shower is easy to install...

ext.ext_cn: 很容易搞到城里顶级演出的票。
ext.ext_en: It's easy to get a seat at the best shows in town...

defs.def_en: If a job or action is easy, you can do it without difficulty or effort, because it is not complicated and causes no problems.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻而易举的;自如的;不拘束的

ext.ext_cn: 她谈笑风生，和那些素未谋面的人毫不拘束地聊着。
ext.ext_en: She is laughing and joking and making easy conversation with people she has never met before...

ext.ext_cn: 和他谈话很轻松。
ext.ext_en: He was an easy person to talk to.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action or activity as easy, you mean that it is done in a confident, relaxed way. If someone is easy  about something, they feel relaxed and confident about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 舒适的；安逸的;无忧无虑的

ext.ext_cn: 她一直没有过上过安逸的生活。
ext.ext_en: She has not had an easy life.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has an easy life, you mean that they live comfortably without any problems or worries.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （用于批评）不费力的，轻而易举的

ext.ext_cn: 你说起来轻松。
ext.ext_en: That's easy for you to say...

ext.ext_cn: 这太容易令人相信了。
ext.ext_en: It was all too easy to believe it.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is easy or too easy, you are criticizing someone because they have done the most obvious or least difficult thing, and have not considered the situation carefully enough.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 好听的;悦耳的/好看的;悦目的

ext.ext_cn: 这音乐听起来像是广告——悦耳但是毫无特点，听过就忘。
ext.ext_en: The music sounds like an advert—easy on the ear but bland and forgettable...

ext.ext_cn: 版式应该清晰悦目。
ext.ext_en: The layout should be clear and easy on the eye.

defs.def_en: You use easy in expressions such as easy on the ear or easy on the eye when you are describing things that are pleasant and that do not need much effort to be enjoyed or done.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 易受攻击的;易遭批评的

ext.ext_cn: 游客成了易遭袭击的目标。
ext.ext_en: Tourists have become easy prey...

ext.ext_cn: 世界银行由于在环境保护方面表现不佳而常常遭受诟病。
ext.ext_en: The World Bank, with its poor environmental record, is an easy target for blame.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as easy prey or as an easy target, you mean that they can easily be attacked or criticized.

ext.ext_cn: 我对金钱并不太在乎。
ext.ext_en: My attitude to money is slightly easy come, easy go.

defs.def_en: You use easy come, easy go to indicate that the person you are talking about does not care much about money and possessions.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于他人搬动重物时）悠着点，小心点
defs.def_en: If you say 'Easy does it', you are telling someone to be careful and not to use too much effort, especially when they are moving something large and awkward.

ext.ext_cn: 少喝点酒。
ext.ext_en: Go easy on the alcohol.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to go easy on something, you are telling them to use only a small amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: “对他宽容点，”萨姆开门的时候重复道。
ext.ext_en: 'Go easy on him,' Sam repeated, opening the door...

ext.ext_cn: 对自己别太苛刻，让自己更快乐些。
ext.ext_en: Be a little easier on yourself and enjoy yourself more...

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to go easy on, or be easy on, a particular person, you are telling them not to punish or treat that person very severely.

ext.ext_cn: 防蚊叮咬好说难做。
ext.ext_en: Avoiding mosquito bites is easier said than done.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is easier said than done, you are emphasizing that although it sounds like a good idea in theory, you think it would be difficult to actually do it.

ext.ext_cn: 最好放松一两周。
ext.ext_en: It is best to take things easy for a week or two.

defs.def_en: If someone tells you to take it easy or take things easy, they mean that you should relax and not do very much at all.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 失去皮尔斯将是一个巨大的打击。
ext.ext_en: To be without Pearce would be a considerable blow...

ext.ext_cn: 把这事做好要耗费我们相当多的时间。
ext.ext_en: Doing it properly makes considerable demands on our time...

defs.def_en: Considerable means great in amount or degree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (解决方案、方法)简单的，马马虎虎的，临时对付的

ext.ext_cn: 这里有一次简单的测量。
ext.ext_en: Here is a rough and ready measurement.

defs.def_en: A rough and ready solution or method is one that is rather simple and not very exact because it has been thought of or done in a hurry.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 粗鲁的士兵
ext.ext_en: ...rough and ready soldiers.

defs.def_en: A rough and ready person is not very polite or gentle.

ext.ext_cn: 两名救护人员迅速地将普洛弗放到担架上抬进救护车里。
ext.ext_en: The two ambulance attendants quickly put Plover on a stretcher and got him into the ambulance.

defs.def_en: A stretcher is a long piece of canvas with a pole along each side, which is used to carry an injured or sick person.

ext.ext_cn: 莱斯特被用担架抬进救护车时我就在旁边。
ext.ext_en: I was close by as Lester was stretchered into the ambulance...

ext.ext_cn: 就在中场休息前，该守门员由于肋骨受伤被用担架抬下场。
ext.ext_en: The goalkeeper was stretchered off just before half-time with a rib injury.

defs.def_en: If someone is stretchered somewhere, they are carried there on a stretcher.

ext.ext_cn: 在山上,他必须挂低速挡。
ext.ext_en: On hills, he must use low gears...

ext.ext_cn: 车挂的是四挡。
ext.ext_en: The car was in fourth gear...

defs.def_en: The gears on a machine or vehicle are a device for changing the rate at which energy is changed into motion.

ext.ext_cn: 大约需要100名穿防暴服的警察前来制止这场斗殴。
ext.ext_en: About 100 officers in riot gear were needed to break up the fight.

ext.ext_cn: 钓具
ext.ext_en: ...fishing gear...

defs.def_en: The gear involved in a particular activity is the equipment or special clothing that you use.

ext.ext_cn: 我以前常穿新潮的衣服，但看上去却滑稽可笑。
ext.ext_en: I used to wear trendy gear but it just looked ridiculous.

defs.def_en: Gear means clothing.

ext.ext_cn: 这些人同时服用海洛因和安非他明吗？
ext.ext_en: Are these people using gear and amphetamines at the same time?

defs.def_en: Some people refer to illegal drugs, especially heroin, as gear .

defs.def_cn: 使为…而准备；使为了达到…而作好准备

ext.ext_cn: 大学有时满足不了成人学生的需求。
ext.ext_en: Colleges are not always geared to the needs of mature students...

ext.ext_cn: 我为了在慕尼黑夺取金牌而进行训练。
ext.ext_en: My training was geared towards winning gold in Munich.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is geared to or towards a particular purpose, they are organized or designed in order to achieve that purpose.

defs.def_cn: 三人领导小组;三头政治;三国集团

ext.ext_cn: 前总统、现任总统与继任总统组成的三驾马车
ext.ext_en: ...leader of the troika of past, present and future presidents...

ext.ext_cn: 新闻界仅把她视为执政三巨头之一。
ext.ext_en: The press regard her as merely one of a ruling troika.

defs.def_en: Journalists sometimes refer to a group of three powerful politicians or states as a troika .

ext.ext_cn: 尽管真凶尚未查出，所有参与斗殴的男子均被驱逐出境。
ext.ext_en: All the men were being deported even though the real culprits in the fight have not been identified.

defs.def_en: When you are talking about a crime or something wrong that has been done, you can refer to the person who did it as the culprit .

defs.def_cn: 引起问题(或不利情势)的事物

ext.ext_cn: 大约10%的日本青少年超重。营养学家指出主要原因是对西式快餐越来越依赖。
ext.ext_en: About 10% of Japanese teenagers are overweight. Nutritionists say the main culprit is increasing reliance on Western fast food.

defs.def_en: When you are talking about a problem or bad situation, you can refer to its cause as the culprit .

ext.ext_cn: 他从冰箱里拿了点橘子汁，然后手拿杯子溜达到厨房的窗口。
ext.ext_en: He collected some orange juice from the refrigerator and, glass in hand, strolled to the kitchen window...

ext.ext_cn: 然后，我们溜达回来，烧上水，又坐下看报纸。
ext.ext_en: Afterwards, we strolled back, put the kettle on and settled down with the newspapers.

defs.def_en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.
A skyscraper is a very tall building in a city.

ext.ext_cn: 那里的一些典型人物让我感到惊讶。
ext.ext_en: I was surprised at the cross-section of people there...

ext.ext_cn: 电视体育节目丰富多彩，令人满意。
ext.ext_en: It is good that there is a wide cross-section of sport on television.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a cross-section of particular things or people, you mean a group of them that you think is typical or representative of all of them.

ext.ext_cn: 飞机剖面图
ext.ext_en: ...a cross-section of an airplane...

ext.ext_cn: 大厅的横截面是正方形的。
ext.ext_en: The hall is square in cross-section.

defs.def_en: A cross-section of an object is what you would see if you could cut straight through the middle of it.

ext.ext_cn: 星期二是我孙子的生日。
ext.ext_en: My grandson's birthday was on Tuesday.

defs.def_en: Someone's  grandson is the son of their son or daughter.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 要是能找到足够便宜的地方，我就不在校园里住了。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to live off campus if I can find somewhere cheap enough...

ext.ext_cn: 烟雾报警器既不贵又易于安装。
ext.ext_en: Smoke detectors are cheap and easy to put up...

defs.def_en: Goods or services that are cheap cost less money than usual or than you expected.

ext.ext_cn: 别买廉价的仿冒品，攒点钱买正品吧。
ext.ext_en: Don't resort to cheap copies; save up for the real thing.

ext.ext_cn: 用廉价面料做的紧身套装
ext.ext_en: ...a tight suit made of some cheap material.

defs.def_en: If you describe goods as cheap, you mean they cost less money than similar products but their quality is poor.

ext.ext_cn: 把儿童当廉价劳动力使用的黑心雇主
ext.ext_en: ...unscrupulous employers who treat children as a cheap source of labour.

defs.def_en: If you describe the cost of someone's work as cheap, you disapprove of the way people are taking advantage of a situation to pay someone less than they should for the work that they do.

defs.def_cn: (言行)讨便宜的，刻薄的，不怀好意的

ext.ext_cn: 这些测试必然会被政客们不失时机地拿去大做政治文章。
ext.ext_en: These tests will inevitably be used by politicians to make cheap political points.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's remarks or actions as cheap, you mean that they are unkindly or insincerely using a situation to benefit themselves or to harm someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 哦，求求你，爸爸，就这一回，别抠门儿了。
ext.ext_en: Oh, please, Dad, just this once don't be cheap.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as cheap, you are criticizing them for being unwilling to spend money.

defs.def_cn: 人命不值钱;人命如草芥

ext.ext_cn: 我们最终将生活在一个视人命为儿戏的社会。
ext.ext_en: We will end up living in a society where life is cheap.

defs.def_en: You use life is cheap or life has become cheap to refer to a situation in which nobody cares that large numbers of people are dying.

ext.ext_cn: 现在的房子大多质量差劲透顶，肯定都是偷工减料盖起来的。
ext.ext_en: Most modern housing estates are terrible and inevitably done on the cheap.

defs.def_en: If someone does or buys something on the cheap, they spend less money than they should because they are more concerned with what it costs than with its quality.
A crewman is a member of a crew.

defs.def_cn: (通常按字母顺序排列的)通讯录，姓名住址录，工商行名录

ext.ext_cn: 电话号码簿
ext.ext_en: ...a telephone directory.

defs.def_en: A directory is a book which gives lists of facts, for example people's names, addresses, and telephone numbers, or the names and addresses of business companies, usually arranged in alphabetical order.

defs.def_cn: (计算机磁盘中文件等的)目录

ext.ext_cn: 用这个选项你可以创建新的文件或目录。
ext.ext_en: This option lets you create new files or directories.

defs.def_en: A directory is an area of a computer disk which contains one or more files or other directories.

defs.def_cn: (国际互联网网站上的)专题目录

ext.ext_cn: 雅虎是最早且最知名的因特网目录服务网站。
ext.ext_en: Yahoo is the oldest and best-known Web directory service.

defs.def_en: On the World Wide Web, a directory is a list of the subjects that you can find information on.

ext.ext_cn: 电视舆论对外交政策有影响吗？
ext.ext_en: Does television set the agenda on foreign policy?...

ext.ext_cn: 许多联盟成员可能会有他们自己的政治议题。
ext.ext_en: Many of the coalition members could have their own political agendas...

defs.def_en: See also:hidden agenda;You can refer to the political issues which are important at a particular time as an agenda.

ext.ext_cn: 这一定会成为下星期议事日程上的一项议题。
ext.ext_en: This is sure to be an item on the agenda next week...

ext.ext_cn: 日本发生的骚乱将是明天会议的首要议题。
ext.ext_en: High on the agenda of tomorrow's meeting will be the turmoil in Japan.

defs.def_en: An agenda is a list of the items that have to be discussed at a meeting.
A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods are stored until they are exported to other countries or distributed to shops to be sold.

ext.ext_cn: 遗嘱认证案可能要持续两年或者更长时间。
ext.ext_en: Probate cases can go on for two years or more.

defs.def_en: Probate is the act or process of officially proving a will to be valid.

ext.ext_cn: 甲壳虫乐队——我是百听不厌。
ext.ext_en: The Beatles — I never get tired of listening to them...

ext.ext_cn: 如今的孩子没人告诉他们什么是对什么是错。
ext.ext_en: Kids these days have no one to tell them what's right and wrong...

defs.def_en: You use them to refer to a group of people, animals, or things.

defs.def_cn: (代替 him or her，而不指明是男是女;有人认为这种用法不对)

ext.ext_cn: 面对自己的孩子，告诉他们真相是需要很大勇气的。
ext.ext_en: It takes great courage to face your child and tell them the truth.

defs.def_en: You use them instead of 'him or her' to refer to a person without saying whether that person is a man or a woman. Some people think this use is incorrect.

defs.def_cn: 那些(不规范口语中代替those)

ext.ext_cn: “咱家比利不吃那些东西，”海伦说。
ext.ext_en: 'Our Billy doesn't eat them ones,' Helen said.

defs.def_en: In non-standard spoken English, them is sometimes used instead of 'those'.

defs.def_cn: (尤指竞赛中的)难题，棘手的问题
defs.def_en: A teaser is a difficult question, especially one in a competition.
A teaser is someone who makes fun of people in a slightly cruel way.

ext.ext_cn: 病了一小段时间之后，他于12月10日安详辞世。
ext.ext_en: He died peacefully on 10th December after a short illness.

defs.def_en: See also:peaceful;If you say that someone died peacefully, you mean that they suffered no pain or violence when they died.

ext.ext_cn: 任何解决爱尔兰问题的可行方案只能通过对话产生。
ext.ext_en: Any possible solution to the Irish question can only come about through dialogue...

ext.ext_cn: 那是我们去年去格拉斯顿伯里的时候发生的事。
ext.ext_en: That came about when we went to Glastonbury last year...

defs.def_en: When you say how or when something came about, you say how or when it happened.

defs.def_cn: （尤指帆布做的士兵或水手的）行囊，背包
defs.def_en: A kitbag is a long narrow bag, usually made of canvas, in which soldiers or sailors keep their clothing and personal possessions.
A rectangle is a four-sided shape whose corners are all ninety degree angles. Each side of a rectangle is the same length as the one opposite to it.
A crib is a bed for a small baby.

ext.ext_cn: 你一直在抄袭贝内特。
ext.ext_en: You have been cribbing from Bennett...

ext.ext_cn: 他在考试中作弊被抓。
ext.ext_en: He had been caught cribbing in an exam.

defs.def_en: If you crib, you copy something that someone else has written and pretend that it is your own work.

defs.def_cn: （尤指战争期间或陆上交通中断时的）空运

ext.ext_cn: 加西亚总统已经下令空运食品、药物和毛毯。
ext.ext_en: President Garcia has ordered an airlift of food, medicines and blankets.

defs.def_en: An airlift is an operation to move people, troops, or goods by air, especially in a war or when land routes are closed.

ext.ext_cn: 伤者被空运送往普雷斯特维克的医院。
ext.ext_en: The injured were airlifted to hospital in Prestwick...

ext.ext_cn: 其他国家的人，例如巴基斯坦人，正由本国政府空运出境。
ext.ext_en: Other nationalities, such as Pakistanis, were being airlifted out by their governments...

defs.def_en: If people, troops, or goods are airlifted somewhere, they are carried by air, especially in a war or when land routes are closed.

defs.def_cn: 薄幸郎；负心汉；爱情骗子

ext.ext_cn: 情场老千詹姆斯·休伊特的花心行径
ext.ext_en: ...the womanising of royal love rat James Hewitt.

defs.def_en: Journalists sometimes use love rat to refer to a man who treats his wife or girlfriend in a cruel way, especially by having sexual relationships with other women.

defs.def_cn: （可盛放烈性酒的随身携带的）金属小酒壶
defs.def_en: A hip flask is a small metal container in which brandy, whisky, or other spirits can be carried.

defs.def_cn: （对女性、少数种族和残疾人等的）积极区别对待，积极差别待遇

ext.ext_cn: 辛格先生想在国家公共部门为下层印度人保留职位，这是一种积极的区别对待。
ext.ext_en: Mr Singh wanted to reserve places for low-caste Indians within the country's public sector, as a form of positive discrimination.

defs.def_en: Positive discrimination means making sure that people such as women, members of smaller racial groups, and disabled people get a fair share of the opportunities available.

ext.ext_cn: 选民正在为美国参议院议席和 52 个众议院议席挑选候选人。
ext.ext_en: Voters are selecting candidates for both US Senate seats and for 52 congressional seats...

ext.ext_cn: 开球难度较大时，选一根好使的高尔夫球杆。
ext.ext_en: With a difficult tee shot, select a club which will keep you short of the trouble...

defs.def_en: If you select something, you choose it from a number of things of the same kind.

defs.def_cn: (在屏幕上)选定(某文件或某段文本以作特别处理)

ext.ext_cn: 我选定了一个文件，按下了删除键。
ext.ext_en: I selected a file and pressed the Delete key.

defs.def_en: If you select a file or a piece of text on a computer screen, you click on it so that it is marked in a different colour, usually in order for you to give the computer an instruction relating to that file or piece of text.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 精选的;作为…精华的;优等的

ext.ext_cn: 他是彭尼在烈性炸药研究中心召集的精英小组的一员。
ext.ext_en: He was one of the small select group assembled by Penney, at the High Explosive Research centre.

ext.ext_cn: 一组精选的法国奶酪
ext.ext_en: ...a select group of French cheeses...

defs.def_en: A select group is a small group of some of the best people or things of their kind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 第一流的;只为富人(或上层人士)而设的;高级的

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯汀·拉克鲁瓦正在举办一个非常豪华的上流聚会。
ext.ext_en: Christian Lacroix is throwing a very lavish and very select party.

ext.ext_cn: 富人俱乐部的聚会
ext.ext_en: ...a meeting of a very select club.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as select, you mean it has many desirable features, but is available only to people who have a lot of money or who belong to a high social class.

defs.def_cn: 暴力殴打（罪）；人身攻击（罪）
defs.def_en: Assault and battery is the crime of attacking someone and causing them physical harm.

defs.def_cn: （英国）国家普通职业资格证书

ext.ext_cn: 我们的国家普通职业资格考试的通过率为90%。
ext.ext_en: We have a 90 cent pass rate for GNVQs.

defs.def_en: In Britain, GNVQs are qualifications in practical subjects such as business, design, and information technology. GNVQ is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'general national vocational qualification'.

defs.def_en: Calm is used to refer to a quiet, still, or peaceful atmosphere in a place.

defs.def_en: If the sea or a lake is calm, the water is not moving very much and there are no big waves.

ext.ext_cn: 要是有什么事情我不让她参加,她会非常难过。
ext.ext_en: She gets very upset if I exclude her from anything...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你设法找到解决自己麻烦的办法,你自我感觉会好得多。
ext.ext_en: You'll feel a lot better about yourself if you work on solutions to your upsetting situations...

defs.def_en: You use if in conditional sentences to introduce the circumstances in which an event or situation might happen, might be happening, or might have happened.

ext.ext_cn: 他问我是否和你一块儿离开的,我说不是。
ext.ext_en: He asked if I had left with you, and I said no...

ext.ext_cn: 请问我能否和阿博特先生说几句话？
ext.ext_en: I wonder if I might have a word with Mr Abbot?

defs.def_en: You use if in indirect questions where the answer is either 'yes' or 'no'.

defs.def_cn: (表示与句子主要部分的陈述稍有不同)即便，纵然，虽然

ext.ext_cn: 有时即便有可能达到那个标准，那也是非常困难。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes, that standard is quite difficult, if not impossible, to achieve...

ext.ext_cn: 我正在调养身体,最多两三周以后就可以了。
ext.ext_en: I'm working on my fitness and I will be ready in a couple of weeks, if not sooner...

defs.def_en: You use if to suggest that something might be slightly different from what you are stating in the main part of the sentence, for example that there might be slightly more or less of a particular quality.

defs.def_cn: 如果…可以的话(通常与can，could, may 或 might 连用,在谈话中礼貌地提出自己的观点、转换话题或打断对方)

ext.ext_cn: 请允许我就有关奥运会举重运动员的问题再补充一点。
ext.ext_en: If I could just make another small point about the weightlifters in the Olympics...

ext.ext_cn: 因此,如果我们可以再花几分钟重新回到田径运动话题上来的话……
ext.ext_en: So, if we may return strictly to athletics again for a few minutes...

defs.def_en: You use if, usually with 'can', 'could', 'may', or 'might', at a point in a conversation when you are politely trying to make a point, change the subject, or interrupt another speaker.

defs.def_cn: (用于句首，表示礼貌地请求某人做某事)

ext.ext_cn: 请问您能不能给我们提供一些信息？
ext.ext_en: I wonder if you'd be kind enough to give us some information, please?

ext.ext_cn: 麻烦您在这里签一下字,我们将联系您的银行自动扣除您的付款。
ext.ext_en: If you will just sign here, we will arrange for your bank to deduct your payments automatically.

defs.def_en: You use if at or near the beginning of a clause when politely asking someone to do something.

defs.def_cn: (用于引导从句中较次要的事实)即便

ext.ext_cn: 即便有点儿失望,也肯定是暂时的。
ext.ext_en: If there was any disappointment it was probably temporary...

ext.ext_cn: 即便我夸大了营养的重要性,但至少它会让这个女人知道关注自己的症状。
ext.ext_en: Even if I'm overstating the case for nutrition, at least it will result in the woman being in charge of her own symptoms...

defs.def_en: You use if to introduce a subordinate clause in which you admit a fact which you regard as less important than the statement in the main clause.

ext.ext_cn: 近来的一些进展即使不能提供治愈的希望,也至少有望研制出来某种药物来阻止病毒的传播。
ext.ext_en: A number of recent advances hold out if not the hope of a cure, then at least the possibility of some drug which could stop the spread of the virus...

ext.ext_cn: 她即便没听懂他的话,也明白了他的意思,并且接受了他的建议。
ext.ext_en: She understood his meaning, if not his words, and took his advice.

defs.def_en: You use if not in front of a word or phrase to indicate that your statement does not apply to that word or phrase, but to something closely related to it that you also mention.

defs.def_cn: (用于过去时,加强语气)如果真的…

ext.ext_cn: 我变成了一个忧心如焚的母亲,一个全无用处的角色。
ext.ext_en: I became a distraught, worried mother, a useless role if ever there was one...

ext.ext_cn: 要是真的有才尽其用的人,那就是她。
ext.ext_en: If ever there was the right person in the right job it was she...

defs.def_en: You use if ever with past tenses when you are introducing a description of a person or thing, to emphasize how appropriate it is.

defs.def_cn: (与过去时连用，引出一个相对合理的理由)即使仅仅为了(或因为)…

ext.ext_cn: 她常来信,即使仅仅为了责怪我还没回信给她。
ext.ext_en: She writes me often, if only to scold me because I haven't written to her...

ext.ext_cn: 与美国总统一对一的会谈是必要的,即便仅仅是为了双方观点更深入的交流。
ext.ext_en: A one-to-one meeting with the US President was necessary, if only for a deeper exchange of views.

defs.def_en: You use if only with past tenses to introduce what you think is a fairly good reason for doing something, although you realize it may not be a very good one.

ext.ext_cn: 要是你早些时候告诉我该多好啊！
ext.ext_en: If only you had told me that some time ago...

ext.ext_cn: 要是那么简单就好了！
ext.ext_en: If only it were that simple!...

defs.def_en: You use if only to express a wish or desire, especially one that cannot be fulfilled.

ext.ext_cn: 整个房间看起来好像是经过了多年的精心布置。
ext.ext_en: The whole room looks as if it has been lovingly put together over the years...

ext.ext_cn: 他的心怦怦跳,似乎被吓坏了。
ext.ext_en: His heart was pounding, as if he were frightened.

defs.def_en: You use as if when you are making a judgment about something that you see or notice. Your belief or impression might be correct, or it might be wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 他把两根手指指向他的头,仿佛他正举着一支枪。
ext.ext_en: He points two fingers at his head, as if he were holding a gun...

ext.ext_cn: 两个堂姊妹看起来像由冰块雕刻而成。
ext.ext_en: The two cousins looked as if they'd been carved from blocks of ice.

defs.def_en: You use as if to describe something or someone by comparing them with another thing or person.

defs.def_cn: (强调某物不是真的)好像…一样,仿佛,似乎

ext.ext_cn: 我丈夫,莫名其妙地,暗示我爱鸟甚于爱他：仿佛我真如此似的。
ext.ext_en: My husband, for some unknown reason, suggested that I loved my birds more than him: as if I would...

ext.ext_cn: 把我的工作做完！老天！好像它真的很重要似的。
ext.ext_en: Getting my work done! My God! As if it mattered.

defs.def_en: You use as if to emphasize that something is not true.

defs.def_cn: 要说真有什么的话;甚至正相反

ext.ext_cn: 在一起住并没有损害我们的友谊。要说真有什么的话,它反而巩固了我们的友谊。
ext.ext_en: Living together didn't harm our friendship. If anything it strengthened it...

ext.ext_cn: 哮喘药物不会造成药物依赖,你不用持续增大剂量。甚至正相反,减小剂量才对。
ext.ext_en: Asthma drugs are not addictive and you don't need to keep increasing the dose. If anything, the reverse is true.

defs.def_en: You use 'if anything' to introduce something which strengthens or changes the meaning of the statement you have just made, but only in a small or unimportant way.

ext.ext_cn: 她的大惊小怪令我很吃惊。显然不是我的个性改变了。
ext.ext_en: I am surprised by the fuss she's making. It's not as if my personality has changed.

defs.def_en: You use 'It's not as if' to introduce a statement which, if it were true, might explain something puzzling, although in fact it is not true.

defs.def_cn: (用于给人建议)如果我是你的话

ext.ext_cn: 要是我是你,格蕾琴夫人,我一点都不会担心。
ext.ext_en: If I were you, Mrs Gretchen, I just wouldn't worry about it...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我是你,我要做的就是对他好。
ext.ext_en: What I'd do if I were you is be nice to him...

defs.def_en: You say 'if I were you' to someone when you are giving them advice.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 狠毒的;恶毒的；存心不良的

ext.ext_cn: 她目光狠毒，唇紧抿。
ext.ext_en: Her stare was malevolent, her mouth a thin line.

defs.def_en: A malevolent person deliberately tries to cause harm or evil.

defs.def_cn: 世界贸易组织（缩略形式为WTO）

ext.ext_cn: 像世界银行和世界贸易组织之类的机构
ext.ext_en: ... institutions such as the World Bank and the World Trade Organization.

defs.def_en: The World Trade Organization is an international organization that encourages and regulates trade between its member states. The abbreviation WTO is also used.

defs.def_cn: 是…的典范；集中体现；象征

ext.ext_cn: 她宛如善良和高贵的化身。
ext.ext_en: She seemed to personify goodness and nobility...

ext.ext_cn: 在斯坦利·鲍德温身上所体现的两次大战间体面正派的人生
ext.ext_en: ...the world of inter-war decency as personified by Stanley Baldwin...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone personifies a particular thing or quality, you mean that they seem to be a perfect example of that thing, or to have that quality to a very large degree.

ext.ext_cn: 有钱不见得能提高你的幸福指数。
ext.ext_en: Being rich doesn't actually increase your happiness quotient...

ext.ext_cn: 牧师占了小岛人口的很大一部分。
ext.ext_en: The island has a high quotient of clergymen.

defs.def_en: Quotient is used when indicating the presence or degree of a characteristic in someone or something.  intelligence quotient→see: IQ;
Your thighs are the top parts of your legs, between your knees and your hips.
A trestle is a wooden or metal structure that is used, for example, as one of the supports for a table. It has two pairs of sloping legs which are joined by a flat piece across the top.

defs.def_cn: （由大量人员参与、具有高度组织性的）活动，行动，工作

ext.ext_cn: 救援行动于星期五下午开始。
ext.ext_en: The rescue operation began on Friday afternoon...

ext.ext_cn: 这些士兵参加了乌干达边境附近的一次军事行动。
ext.ext_en: The soldiers were engaged in a military operation close to the Ugandan border.

defs.def_en: An operation is a highly organized activity that involves many people doing different things.

ext.ext_cn: 索恩的电子公司雇用了约5,000名员工。
ext.ext_en: Thorn's electronics operation employs around 5,000 people...

ext.ext_cn: 这两个母公司现在合并为一家企业经营业务。
ext.ext_en: The two parent groups now run their business as a single combined operation.

defs.def_en: A business or company can be referred to as an operation .

ext.ext_cn: 查尔斯的胳膊动了手术，正在这家诊所进行康复治疗。
ext.ext_en: Charles was at the clinic recovering from an operation on his arm.

defs.def_en: When a patient has an operation, a surgeon cuts open their body in order to remove, replace, or repair a diseased or damaged part.

ext.ext_cn: 在铁路连线开通之前，乘客只能乘坐长途客车穿越隧道。
ext.ext_en: Until the rail links are in operation, passengers can only travel through the tunnel by coach.

ext.ext_cn: 从80年代初就开始实行的自由银行制度
ext.ext_en: ...the free banking system that has been in operation since the early eighties.

defs.def_en: If a system is in operation, it is being used.

ext.ext_cn: 有3台滑雪缆车在运行。
ext.ext_en: There are three ski lifts in operation.

defs.def_en: If a machine or device is in operation, it is working.

ext.ext_cn: 《金融服务法》于4年前开始实施。
ext.ext_en: The Financial Services Act came into operation four years ago...

ext.ext_cn: 更经济的节能技术在发达国家已经投入使用。
ext.ext_en: Cheaper energy conservation techniques have been put into operation in the developed world.

defs.def_en: When a rule, system, or plan comes into operation or you put it into operation, you begin to use it.
In football, a wing back is a defender who also takes part in attacking play.

ext.ext_cn: 她想把克里斯的尸体火化。
ext.ext_en: She wants Chris to be cremated.

defs.def_en: When someone is cremated, their dead body is burned, usually as part of a funeral service.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （因为成功而）欢欣鼓舞的，欣喜若狂的

ext.ext_cn: 费迪南德受伤休养了一个月，重新归队后表现非常出色，他简直高兴极了。
ext.ext_en: Ferdinand was jubilant after making an impressive comeback from a month on the injured list.

ext.ext_cn: 巴黎欢腾的人群
ext.ext_en: ...the jubilant crowds of Paris.

defs.def_en: If you are jubilant, you feel extremely happy because of a success.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 耻辱的;不光彩的;不名誉的;丢脸的

ext.ext_cn: 他们耻辱的战败
ext.ext_en: ...their ignominious defeat...

ext.ext_cn: 许多人认为他注定会极不光彩地失败。
ext.ext_en: Many thought that he was doomed to ignominious failure.

defs.def_en: If you describe an experience or action as ignominious, you mean it is embarrassing because it shows a great lack of success.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 脆皮法式烤面包
ext.ext_en: ...crusty French loaves.

defs.def_en: Crusty bread has a hard, crisp outside.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指老头儿)脾气急躁的，易发怒的

ext.ext_cn: 脾气暴躁的老上校
ext.ext_en: ...a crusty old colonel.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone, especially an old man, as crusty, you mean they are impatient and easily irritated.

ext.ext_cn: 他暗示说内战是上天的惩罚。
ext.ext_en: He suggested that the civil war had been a divine punishment.

ext.ext_cn: 天赐的灵感
ext.ext_en: ...divine inspiration.

defs.def_en: You use divine to describe something that is provided by or relates to a god or goddess.
A divine is a priest who specializes in the study of God and religion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: “它是不是美极了？”她说道，“真希望我有合适的胸针可以借给你来搭配它。”
ext.ext_en: 'Isn't it divine?' she said. 'I wish I had the right sort of brooch to lend you for it.'...

ext.ext_cn: 亲爱的，见到你太让人高兴了，你看上去简直美极了。
ext.ext_en: Darling how lovely to see you, you look simply divine.

defs.def_en: People use divine to express their pleasure or enjoyment of something.

ext.ext_cn: 孩子猜测父母的需要并作出回应的能力
ext.ext_en: ...the child's ability to divine the needs of its parents and respond to them...

ext.ext_cn: 他依此猜到她不太喜欢他。
ext.ext_en: From this he divined that she did not like him much.

defs.def_en: If you divine something, you discover or learn it by guessing.

defs.def_cn: (用探测棒)探测（地下水或矿藏）

ext.ext_cn: 我之所以探寻水源是因为发生了旱灾。
ext.ext_en: The only reason I was divining for water was because of the drought.

ext.ext_cn: 探测杆
ext.ext_en: ...a divining rod.

defs.def_en: If you divine, you try to find underground supplies of water or minerals, using a special rod or pair of rods.

ext.ext_cn: 如果再度当选，总统将推行减税政策。
ext.ext_en: The president will pursue lower taxes if he is re-elected...

ext.ext_cn: 拉蒙·门多萨再度当选为皇马主席，这是他连续第3次当选这个任期为4年的职位。
ext.ext_en: ...Ramon Mendoza was re-elected president of Real for a third successive four-year term...

defs.def_en: When someone such as a politician or an official who has been elected is re-elected, they win another election and are therefore able to continue in their position as, for example, president or an official in an organization.

ext.ext_cn: 如果突然停服这些药，则可能出现一些戒断症状。
ext.ext_en: If these drugs are stopped abruptly then some withdrawal symptoms may occur.

defs.def_en: When someone has withdrawal symptoms, they feel ill after they have stopped taking a drug which they were addicted to.

defs.def_cn: 离经叛道者;摈弃社会习俗者
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a drop-out, you disapprove of the fact that they have rejected the accepted ways of society, for example by not having a regular job.

ext.ext_cn: 中学退学者
ext.ext_en: ...high-school drop-outs.

defs.def_en: A drop-out is someone who has left school or college before they have finished their studies.

defs.def_cn: 退学的;辍学的;中途放弃的

ext.ext_cn: 现在学生的辍学率是三分之一。
ext.ext_en: The drop-out rate among students is currently one in three.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the drop-out rate, you are referring to the number of people who leave a school or college early, or leave a course or other activity before they have finished it.

ext.ext_cn: 变化的速度还不够快，不能让所有人都满意。
ext.ext_en: The pace of change has not been quick enough to satisfy everyone...

ext.ext_cn: 我们实在找不到足够多的性能良好的二手车，满足不了需求。
ext.ext_en: We just can't find enough good second-hand cars to satisfy demand...

defs.def_en: If someone or something satisfies you, they give you enough of what you want or need to make you pleased or contented.

defs.def_cn: 使确信;使弄清楚;使信服

ext.ext_cn: 他必须令环境游说团体相信在减排方面将取得实质性进展。
ext.ext_en: He has to satisfy the environmental lobby that real progress will be made to cut emissions...

ext.ext_cn: 他想说服自己他已经发挥到极致了。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to satisfy himself that he had given his best performance.

defs.def_en: To satisfy someone that something is true or has been done properly means to convince them by giving them more information or by showing them what has been done.

ext.ext_cn: 这些程序应该符合某些基本要求。
ext.ext_en: The procedures should satisfy certain basic requirements.

defs.def_en: If you satisfy the requirements for something, you are good enough or have the right qualities to fulfil these requirements.
A fisherman is a person who catches fish as a job or for sport.

defs.def_cn: （英国的）“实习”标志（贴于车上以提醒其他驾驶者）
defs.def_en: In Britain, L-plates are signs with a red 'L' on them which you attach to a car to warn other drivers that you are a learner.

defs.def_cn: (由爵士乐和布鲁斯发展而来的)乡土爵士乐，放克音乐

ext.ext_cn: 实验性爵士乐、灵乐和放克音乐的融合
ext.ext_en: ...a mixture of experimental jazz, soul and funk.

defs.def_en: Funk is a style of dance music based on jazz and blues, with a strong, repeated bass part.

defs.def_cn: (尤因处于自己无法控制的情形中而出现的)恐慌，惊恐

ext.ext_cn: 他神经极为紧张！比我还糟！
ext.ext_en: He was in a blue funk! Worse than me!...

ext.ext_cn: 我的脸变得通红(我极度恐慌时就会如此)。
ext.ext_en: My face went crimson (which it does out of sheer funk).

defs.def_en: If someone is in a funk, they are frightened, especially because they are in a situation they cannot control.

ext.ext_cn: 如果他对此畏缩，那就会证实他在最近一封信里表现出来的怯懦。
ext.ext_en: If he funks it, he will confirm the impression of cowardice given by his recent letter.

defs.def_en: If you funk something, you avoid doing it because you are afraid.
A millstone is a large, flat, round stone which is one of a pair of stones used to grind grain into flour.

ext.ext_cn: 对于今天的政客而言，这个条约正在变成一个包袱。
ext.ext_en: For today's politicians, the treaty is becoming a millstone...

ext.ext_cn: 那个合同结果成了他的一个负担。
ext.ext_en: That contract proved to be a millstone around his neck.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a millstone or a millstone around your neck, you mean that it is a very unpleasant problem or responsibility that you cannot escape from.
Boxing Day is the 26th of December, the day after Christmas Day.

ext.ext_cn: 经济依然被官僚们所掌控。
ext.ext_en: The economy is still controlled by bureaucrats.

defs.def_en: Bureaucrats are officials who work in a large administrative system. You can refer to officials as bureaucrats especially if you disapprove of them because they seem to follow rules and procedures too strictly.

defs.def_cn: （通常因寒冷或恐惧而）蜷缩，缩成一团

ext.ext_cn: 她按门铃时身子在门廊里缩成一团。
ext.ext_en: She huddled inside the porch as she rang the bell...

ext.ext_cn: 默特尔缩着身子坐在床边哭泣。
ext.ext_en: Myrtle sat huddled on the side of the bed, weeping.

defs.def_en: If you huddle somewhere, you sit, stand, or lie there holding your arms and legs close to your body, usually because you are cold or frightened.

defs.def_cn: （通常因寒冷或恐惧而）聚在一起，挤成一团

ext.ext_cn: 我们疲惫不堪，又迷了路，于是大家都挤在一起。
ext.ext_en: Tired and lost, we huddled together...

ext.ext_cn: 挤作一团取暖的陌生人
ext.ext_en: ...strangers huddling together for warmth...

defs.def_en: If people huddle together or huddle round something, they stand, sit, or lie close to each other, usually because they all feel cold or frightened.

ext.ext_cn: 施蒂希特、麦康伯、乔丹和克雷普斯走到一旁私下商量着什么。
ext.ext_en: Off to one side, Sticht, Macomber, Jordan, and Kreps huddled to discuss something...

ext.ext_cn: 总统一直在和最高层助理开私下碰头会。
ext.ext_en: The president has been huddling with his most senior aides...

defs.def_en: If people huddle in a group, they gather together to discuss something quietly or secretly.

defs.def_cn: 拥挤的一群;杂乱的一堆

ext.ext_cn: 我们横七竖八地挤作一团躺在那里，大口喘着气。
ext.ext_en: We lay there: a huddle of bodies, gasping for air...

ext.ext_cn: 莱斯总是看到埃里克和塔姆凑在一起，他知道他们是在谈论自己。
ext.ext_en: Les kept seeing Eric and Tam in a huddle and he knew they were talking about him.

ext.ext_en: ...his dogged insistence on their rights.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's actions as dogged, you mean that they are determined to continue with something even if it becomes difficult or dangerous.

ext.ext_cn: 那位女士否认疏于照管自己的孩子。

defs.def_en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to look after them properly.

ext.ext_en: If you are not careful, children tend to neglect their homework.

defs.def_en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to give them the amount of attention that they deserve.

ext.ext_en: We often neglect to make proper use of our bodies...

ext.ext_en: They never neglect their duties.

defs.def_en: If you neglect to do something that you ought to do or neglect your duty, you fail to do it.

defs.def_cn: 早晨;上午(从人们通常醒来到中午或午餐前的一段时间)

ext.ext_cn: 导游上午会带你们游览全城。
ext.ext_en: During the morning your guide will take you around the city...

ext.ext_en: On Sunday morning Bill was woken by the telephone...

defs.def_en: The morning is the part of each day between the time that people usually wake up and 12 o'clock noon or lunchtime.

defs.def_cn: 凌晨，早晨，上午(从子夜到中午的这段时间)

ext.ext_cn: 我经常凌晨两三点才睡。
ext.ext_en: I often stayed up until two or three in the morning...

ext.ext_cn: 在凌晨发起了进攻。
ext.ext_en: The attack happened in the early hours of the morning.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a particular time in the morning, you mean a time between 12 o'clock midnight and 12 o'clock noon.

ext.ext_cn: 我明天上午会把它用航空快件寄到伦敦。
ext.ext_en: I'll fly it to London in the morning...

ext.ext_cn: 梅拉妮许诺第二天上午给他们打电话。
ext.ext_en: Melanie promised that she would call them in the morning.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will happen in the morning, you mean that it will happen during the morning of the following day.

defs.def_cn: 日日夜夜;夜以继日；一直

ext.ext_cn: 从早到晚都坚持做这项运动，日复一日，你就能强壮起来。
ext.ext_en: You get fit by playing the game, day in, day out, morning, noon and night.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens morning, noon and night, you mean that it happens all the time.

ext.ext_cn: 许多人都是从干电话销售做起的。
ext.ext_en: Many people start their careers in telesales...

ext.ext_en: There are a wealth of telesales jobs advertised.

defs.def_en: Telesales is the selling of a company's products or services by telephone, either by phoning possible customers or by answering calls from customers.

defs.def_cn: （在集市或体育场馆内用于播报的）天朗扩音系统
defs.def_en: A Tannoy is a system of loudspeakers used to make public announcements, for example at a fair or at a sports stadium.

defs.def_cn: （依以前用过的处方重新取药的）重复处方
defs.def_en: A repeat prescription is a prescription for a medicine that you have taken before or that you use regularly.

ext.ext_cn: 警察动用催泪瓦斯驱散示威人群。
ext.ext_en: Police used tear gas to disperse the demonstrators.

defs.def_en: Tear gas is a gas that causes your eyes to sting and fill with tears so that you cannot see. It is sometimes used by the police or army to control crowds.

defs.def_cn: （冷不防打来的）推销电话;上门推销；冷访

ext.ext_cn: 她曾经在话务中心当过话务员，负责打电话推销分时度假。
ext.ext_en: She had worked as a call centre operator making cold calls for time-share holidays.

defs.def_en: If someone makes a cold call, they telephone or visit someone they have never contacted, without making an appointment, in order to try and sell something.

defs.def_cn: (未事先联系或约定而)进行电话推销，上门推销

ext.ext_cn: 你应该拒绝和那些贸然打电话提供理财建议的陌生人见面。
ext.ext_en: You should refuse to meet anyone who cold calls with an offer of financial advice.

defs.def_en: To cold call means to make a cold call.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 思想开明的；愿意接受他人观点（或建议）的；无偏见的

ext.ext_cn: 他对别人的工作不存先入之见。
ext.ext_en: He was very open-minded about other people's work.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as open-minded, you approve of them because they are willing to listen to and consider other people's ideas and suggestions.

ext.ext_cn: 漂亮的日本盆栽树
ext.ext_en: ...a beautiful Japanese bonsai tree.

defs.def_en: A bonsai is a tree or shrub that has been kept very small by growing it in a little pot and cutting it in a special way.
Bonsai is the art of growing very small shrubs and trees.

ext.ext_cn: 他与家人断绝关系的痛楚
ext.ext_en: ...his bitter sense of severance from his family.

ext.ext_cn: 外交关系的彻底中断
ext.ext_en: ...the complete severance of diplomatic relations.

defs.def_en: Severance from a person or group, or the severance of a connection, involves the ending of a relationship or connection.

ext.ext_cn: 我们拿到了 13 个星期的薪水作为遣散费。
ext.ext_en: We were offered 13 weeks' severance pay.

defs.def_en: Severance pay is a sum of money that a company gives to its employees when it has to stop employing them.

ext.ext_cn: 市政当局批准了这次游行。
ext.ext_en: The municipal authorities gave the go-ahead for the march.

ext.ext_cn: 下个月的市政选举
ext.ext_en: ...next month's municipal elections.

defs.def_en: Municipal means associated with or belonging to a city or town that has its own local government.

ext.ext_cn: 英国公众对歌剧不大轻易接受的态度在欧洲来说很反常。
ext.ext_en: The British public's wariness of opera is an anomaly in Europe.

defs.def_en: If something is an anomaly, it is different from what is usual or expected.

ext.ext_cn: 退休时一次总付、不用缴税的5万英镑
ext.ext_en: ...a tax-free lump sum of £50,000 at retirement age.

defs.def_en: A lump sum is an amount of money that is paid as a large amount on a single occasion rather than as smaller amounts on several separate occasions.

defs.def_cn: （两个孩子相互投球、第三个孩子站在中间设法抢球的）抢球游戏
defs.def_en: Piggy-in-the-middle or pig-in-the-middle is a game in which two children throw a ball to each other and a child standing between them tries to catch it.

defs.def_cn: （两方争吵时）夹在中间的窘境，受夹板气
defs.def_en: If someone is piggy-in-the-middle or pig-in-the-middle, they are unwillingly involved in a dispute between two people or groups.

defs.def_cn: 地位低下的;无足轻重的

ext.ext_cn: 无足轻重的独裁者
ext.ext_en: ...a tinpot dictator.

defs.def_en: You can use tinpot to describe a leader, country, or government that you consider to be unimportant and inferior to most others.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 过分突出的；（难看得）显眼的，扎眼的

ext.ext_en: 'You are rude and obtrusive, Mr Galbraith,' said Tommy...

ext.ext_en: These heaters are less obtrusive and are easy to store away in the summer.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is obtrusive, you think they are noticeable in an unpleasant way.

ext.ext_en: Your partner can feel the loss as acutely as you, but may feel that it is unmanly to cry.

defs.def_en: If you describe a boy's or man's behaviour as unmanly, you are critical of the fact that they are behaving in a way that you think is inappropriate for a man.
If someone is in a persistent vegetative state, they are unable to think, speak, or move because they have severe brain damage, and their condition is not likely to improve.

defs.def_cn: 贪财的;腐败的;贪赃枉法的;唯利是图的

ext.ext_en: ...venal politicians.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as venal, you disapprove of them because they are prepared to do almost anything in return for money, even things which are dishonest or immoral.
A lawnmower is a machine for cutting grass on lawns.
A substitute teacher is a teacher whose job is to take the place of other teachers at different schools when they are unable to be there.

defs.def_cn: 经常抱怨的人;爱发牢骚的人

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a moaner, you are critical of them because they often complain about things.

defs.def_cn: 私会；（尤指与情人的）幽会，约会

ext.ext_en: She had an assignation with her boyfriend.

defs.def_en: An assignation is a secret meeting with someone, especially with a lover.

ext.ext_cn: 天气很暖和，整个下午都可以呆在户外。
ext.ext_en: It was warm enough to be outdoors all afternoon...

ext.ext_cn: 该仪式正在户外举行。
ext.ext_en: The ceremony was being held outdoors.

defs.def_en: If something happens outdoors, it happens outside in the fresh air rather than in a building.

ext.ext_en: I'm a lover of the outdoors...

ext.ext_en: Life in the great outdoors isn't supposed to be luxurious.

defs.def_en: You refer to the outdoors when talking about work or leisure activities which take place outside away from buildings.

ext.ext_en: ...a high-beaked nose and large protuberant eyes.

defs.def_en: Protuberant eyes, lips, noses, or teeth stick out more than usual from the face.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极度伤心的;心碎的;悲痛欲绝的

ext.ext_en: Was your daddy heartbroken when they got a divorce?

defs.def_en: Someone who is heartbroken is very sad and emotionally upset.

ext.ext_en: ...a sackful of presents...

ext.ext_en: Letters and cards of support have been pouring in by the sackful.

defs.def_en: A sackful is the amount of something that a sack contains or could contain.
A star-gazer is someone who studies the stars as an astronomer or astrologer.

ext.ext_en: He felt the students had been victimized because they'd  voiced opposition to the government.

ext.ext_en: ...the ever-increasing traffic on our roads.

ext.ext_cn: 医疗信息的不断变化
ext.ext_en: ...an ever-changing world of medical information...

defs.def_en: You use ever in adjectives such as ever-increasing and ever-present, to show that something exists or continues all the time.

ext.ext_en: There are various types of the disease...

ext.ext_en: Rates of interest for this type of borrowing can be high...

defs.def_en: If you refer to a particular thing or person as a type of something more general, you are considering that thing or person as an example of that more general group.

ext.ext_en: It's the first time I, a fair-skinned, freckly type, have sailed in the sun without burning...

ext.ext_cn: 我是那种特别喜欢户外运动的人。
ext.ext_en: I was rather an outdoor type…

defs.def_en: If you refer to a person as a particular type, you mean that they have that particular appearance, character, or way of behaving.

defs.def_cn: …不感兴趣的类型;并非…喜欢的类型

ext.ext_en: At first I thought he was rather ordinary looking, a little chubby, not my type...

ext.ext_en: I'm not his type. I am probably too strong a character.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is not your type, you mean that they are not the sort of person who you usually find attractive.

defs.def_cn: 用打字机(或文字处理器)打(字)

ext.ext_en: I had never really learnt to type properly...

ext.ext_en: The correction had already been set in type.

defs.def_en: Type is printed text as it appears in a book or newspaper, or the small pieces of metal that are used to create this.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: More women than men go to the doctor. Perhaps men are more robust or worry less?...

ext.ext_en: We've always specialised in making very robust, simply designed machinery.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is robust is very strong or healthy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (观点等)强烈的，坚定的，坚决的

ext.ext_en: A British Foreign Office minister has made a robust defence of the agreement...

ext.ext_en: He has the keen eye and robust approach needed.

ext.ext_cn: 如计算机、电信等高科技产业
ext.ext_en: ...such high-tech industries as computers or telecommunications.

ext.ext_en: ...the latest high-tech medical gadgetry.

defs.def_en: High-tech activities or equipment involve or result from the use of high technology.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个极其复杂的人。
ext.ext_en: He was an unusually complex man.

ext.ext_cn: 今年异常寒冷的冬天
ext.ext_en: ...this year's unusually harsh winter.

defs.def_en: You use unusually to emphasize that someone or something has more of a particular quality than is usual.

ext.ext_en: Unusually among British prime ministers, he was not a man of natural authority.

defs.def_en: You can use unusually to suggest that something is not what normally happens.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的支持是以他的提案得到他们的批准为条件的。
ext.ext_en: Their support is conditional on his proposals meeting their approval.

ext.ext_cn: 有条件要约
ext.ext_en: ...a conditional offer.

defs.def_en: If a situation or agreement is conditional on something, it will only happen or continue if this thing happens.

Most conditional clauses begin with 'if' or 'unless', for example 'If that happens, we'll be in big trouble' and 'You don't have to come unless you want to'.

ext.ext_cn: 英国工会运动的年会
ext.ext_en: ...the annual conference of Britain's trade union movement...

ext.ext_en: In its annual report, UNICEF says at least 40,000 children die every day.

defs.def_en: Annual events happen once every year.

ext.ext_cn: 每年的花销、学费和各项杂费6,600英镑。
ext.ext_en: Annual costs, tuition and fees, £6,600...

ext.ext_en: The electronic and printing unit has annual sales of about $80 million.

defs.def_en: Annual quantities or rates relate to a period of one year.

ext.ext_en: The simplest way to deal with these hardy annuals is to sow them where they are to flower.

defs.def_cn: 面对面的；一对一的；仅限两人之间的

ext.ext_en: ...the business end of a vacuum cleaner.

ext.ext_en: ...the growth of home ownership in Britain...
