ext.ext_en: Blonde and slender, she was too striking to escape their attention.

defs.def_en: If something escapes you or escapes your attention, you do not know about it, do not remember it, or do not notice it.

defs.def_cn: （气体、液体、热量等）泄露，逸出，露出

ext.ext_cn: 打开一个通风口，让潮气逸出一些。
ext.ext_en: Leave a vent open to let some moist air escape.

defs.def_en: When gas, liquid, or heat escapes, it comes out from a pipe, container, or place.
A jailhouse is a small prison.

defs.def_cn: 无人照料的；无人看管的

ext.ext_cn: 千万不能放任小孩呆在水池或水槽附近不管。
ext.ext_en: Never leave young children unattended near any pool or water tank...

ext.ext_cn: 在盖特威克机场站的站台附近发现了一个无主袋子。
ext.ext_en: An unattended bag was spotted near the platform at Gatwick...

defs.def_en: When people or things are left unattended, they are not being watched or looked after.

ext.ext_cn: 困在我那位于48层高空的家中
ext.ext_en: ...marooned in my 48th floor eyrie in the sky.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a place such as a house or a castle as an eyrie, you mean it is built high up and is difficult to reach.

defs.def_cn: （通常筑在高山上的）鹰巢，猛禽巢
defs.def_en: An eyrie is the nest of a bird of prey such as an eagle, and is usually built high up in the mountains.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他给自己定下了男子汉的任务，并希望别人效之。
ext.ext_en: He set himself manly tasks and expected others to follow his example...

ext.ext_cn: 他是理想中的有阳刚美的男人。
ext.ext_en: He was the ideal of manly beauty.

defs.def_en: If you describe a man's behaviour or appearance as manly, you approve of it because it shows qualities that are considered typical of a man, such as strength or courage.

defs.def_cn: （尤指从事研究工作的）科学家，科技工作者

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦帝国理工学院的科研人员认为他们可能已经找到了解决办法。
ext.ext_en: The boffins of Imperial College in London think they may have found a solution.

defs.def_en: A boffin is a scientist, especially one who is doing research.

ext.ext_cn: 一个计算机天才准备靠他开发的革命性影像技术赚取500万英镑。
ext.ext_en: A computer boffin is set to make £5million from his revolutionary photo technology.

defs.def_en: Very clever people are sometimes called boffins .
A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 过于煽情的;过分伤感的

ext.ext_cn: 他们甚至在床头桌上摆了一张他们自己的煽情照片。
ext.ext_en: They've even got one of those icky photos of themselves on the bedside table.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as icky, you mean that it is too emotional or sentimental.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她感到指尖有什么黏糊糊的恶心东西。
ext.ext_en: She could feel something icky on her fingers.

defs.def_en: If you describe a substance as icky, you mean that it is disgustingly sticky.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 典型的;带有成见的;已成定型的

ext.ext_cn: 达拉对我们老一套的性别和女性特质观念提出了异议。
ext.ext_en: Dara challenges our stereotypical ideas about gender and femininity.

defs.def_en: A stereotypical idea of a type of person or thing is a fixed general idea that a lot of people have about it, that may be false in many cases.

ext.ext_cn: 有鸡肉、米饭和蔬菜的一顿饭
ext.ext_en: ...a meal consisting of chicken, rice and vegetables...

ext.ext_cn: 泰国将精米出口到世界各地。
ext.ext_en: Thailand exports its fine rices around the world.

defs.def_en: Rice consists of white or brown grains taken from a cereal plant. You cook rice and usually eat it with meat or vegetables.

defs.def_cn: (令人不快却又无法改变的)生活现实

ext.ext_cn: 对我们所有人来说，精神压力常常是无从逃避的生活现实。
ext.ext_en: Stress is a fact of life from time to time for all of us.

defs.def_en: You say that something which is not pleasant is a fact of life when there is nothing you can do to change it so you must accept it.

ext.ext_cn: 是时候孩子们了解更多性知识了。
ext.ext_en: There comes a time when children need to know more than the basic facts of life.

defs.def_en: If you tell a child about the facts of life, you tell him or her about sexual intercourse and how babies are born.

ext.ext_cn: 那些文件目前在《卫报》手里。
ext.ext_en: Those documents are now in the possession of the Guardian...

ext.ext_cn: 我们应该北上占领那片土地。
ext.ext_en: We should go up and take possession of the land...

defs.def_en: If you are in possession of something, you have it, because you have obtained it or because it belongs to you.

ext.ext_cn: 人们失去了自己的家园和所有的财物。
ext.ext_en: People had lost their homes and all their possessions...

ext.ext_cn: 她已收拾好个人物品。
ext.ext_en: She had tidied away her possessions.

defs.def_en: Your possessions are the things that you own or have with you at a particular time.

ext.ext_cn: 它们都曾是法国的领地。
ext.ext_en: All of them were French possessions at one time or another.

ext.ext_cn: 大英帝国的属地
ext.ext_en: ...Britain's imperial possessions.

defs.def_en: A country's possessions are countries or territories that it controls.

ext.ext_cn: 他们相信了这些女孩之所以有如此举动是因为鬼魂附体。
ext.ext_en: They were convinced the girls' behaviour was due to possession by the devil.

defs.def_en: Possession by an evil spirit is the situation when a person's mind and body is controlled by an evil spirit.

ext.ext_cn: 他仔细研究了键盘，一个手指随时准备敲击。
ext.ext_en: He studied the keyboard carefully, one finger poised.

defs.def_en: If a part of your body is poised, it is completely still but ready to move at any moment.

defs.def_cn: 作好一切准备的；随时准备行动的

ext.ext_cn: 英国随时准备把医护人员空运到该国。
ext.ext_en: Britain was poised to fly medical staff to the country at short notice...

ext.ext_cn: 美国军队作好了发动大规模海、陆、空攻击的准备。
ext.ext_en: US forces are poised for a massive air, land and sea assault.

defs.def_en: If someone is poised to do something, they are ready to take action at any moment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 镇定的；沉着的；泰然自若的

ext.ext_cn: 她自信、沉着，几乎有些洋洋自得。
ext.ext_en: She was self-assured, poised, almost self-satisfied...

ext.ext_cn: 蕾切尔看上去沉着冷静。
ext.ext_en: Rachel appeared poised and calm.

defs.def_en: If you are poised, you are calm, dignified, and self-controlled.
Suspenders are the fastenings which hold up a woman's stockings.
Suspenders are a pair of straps that go over someone's shoulders and are fastened to their trousers at the front and back to prevent the trousers from falling down.

ext.ext_cn: 所有人都已集中到了董事会会议室，准备参加上午9点钟的会议。
ext.ext_en: Everyone had already assembled in the boardroom for the 9:00 a.m. session.

defs.def_en: The boardroom is a room where the board of a company meets.

ext.ext_cn: 有一系列治疗湿疹的油膏和乳膏可以买到。
ext.ext_en: A range of ointments and creams is available for the treatment of eczema...

ext.ext_cn: 医生给他开了治疗脱皮的软膏。
ext.ext_en: He received ointment for his flaking skin.

defs.def_en: An ointment is a smooth thick substance that is put on sore skin or a wound to help it heal.

defs.def_cn: 美中不足之处；败兴的人（或事物）；煞风景的人（或事物）

ext.ext_cn: 蕾切尔似乎是卡罗琳一帆风顺的生活中唯一的麻烦。
ext.ext_en: Rachel seems to be the one fly in the ointment of Caroline's smooth life.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as a fly in the ointment, you think they spoil a situation and prevent it being as successful as you had hoped.

defs.def_cn: 一架飞机的载客量（或装货量）

ext.ext_cn: 英国红十字会已向灾区发送了4架飞机的救济物资。
ext.ext_en: The British Red Cross has sent four planeloads of relief supplies to the stricken areas.

defs.def_en: A planeload of people or goods is as many people or goods as a plane can carry.
An orphanage is a place where orphans live and are looked after.

ext.ext_cn: 他拒绝了管理顾问们的建议。
ext.ext_en: He spurned the advice of management consultants...

ext.ext_cn: 这些表示都遭到了拒绝。
ext.ext_en: These gestures have been spurned.

defs.def_en: If you spurn someone or something, you reject them.
A gas mask is a device that you wear over your face in order to protect yourself from poisonous gases.

ext.ext_cn: 不管过去经历了什么坎坷，吉尔现在似乎都已经挺过来了。
ext.ext_en: Whatever the vicissitudes of her past life, Jill now seems to have come through.

defs.def_en: You use vicissitudes to refer to changes, especially unpleasant ones, that happen to someone or something at different times in their life or development.
If you describe someone as an ignoramus, you are being critical of them because they do not have the knowledge you think they ought to have.

ext.ext_cn: 你一到达目的地，就走出飞机并重新设置手表时间。
ext.ext_en: As soon as you arrive at your destination, step out of the aircraft and reset your wristwatch.

defs.def_en: If you reset a machine or device, you adjust or set it, so that it is ready to work again or ready to perform a particular function.

ext.ext_cn: 他做了一个手臂复位手术，正在恢复。
ext.ext_en: He is recovering from an operation to reset his arm.

defs.def_en: If a doctor resets a broken bone, they put it back into its correct position.
A murderess is a woman who has murdered someone.

defs.def_cn: 德国牧羊犬，阿尔萨斯狼狗（一种凶猛的大狼狗，常用作看家狗或警犬）
defs.def_en: An Alsatian is a large, usually fierce dog that is often used to guard buildings or by the police to help them find criminals.

defs.def_cn: 自告奋勇;主动提供(信息)

ext.ext_cn: 一位非常重要的证人站出来说她看见坦纳穿着那双靴子。
ext.ext_en: A vital witness came forward to say that she saw Tanner wearing the boots.

defs.def_en: If someone comes forward, they offer to do something or to give some information in response to a request for help.
A beetle is an insect with a hard covering to its body.

defs.def_cn: 目不转睛地;凝视良久地

ext.ext_cn: 我目不转睛地看着那尊雕像。
ext.ext_en: I stared fixedly at the statue...

ext.ext_cn: 她知道他正在盯着她看。
ext.ext_en: She was aware that he was watching her fixedly.

defs.def_en: If you stare fixedly at someone or something, you look at them steadily and continuously for a period of time.

defs.def_cn: 打扮得（干净利落或邋遢）的

ext.ext_cn: 衣着整洁得体的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a very well groomed man...

ext.ext_cn: 她看起来总是打扮得干净利落。
ext.ext_en: She always appeared perfectly groomed.

defs.def_en: You use groomed in expressions such as well groomed and badly groomed to say how neat, clean, and smart a person is.
Lawn tennis is the same as tennis .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 当时媒体的报道糟透了。
ext.ext_en: The media coverage was shocking...

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚我的情况一定很糟糕。
ext.ext_en: I must have been in a shocking state last night.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is shocking if you think that it is very bad.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人震惊的;令人愤慨的;不道德的

ext.ext_cn: 当时竟然什么都没说,真让人愤慨。
ext.ext_en: It is shocking that nothing was said...

ext.ext_cn: 这是对隐私的公然侵犯。
ext.ext_en: This was a shocking invasion of privacy.

defs.def_en: You can say that something is shocking if you think that it is morally wrong.

defs.def_cn: 权力早餐会，巨头工作早餐（指商人们在饭店里一边吃早餐一边开会）
defs.def_en: If business people have a power breakfast, they go to a restaurant early in the morning so that they can have a meeting while they eat breakfast.

ext.ext_cn: 杰茜卡小口地喝着饮料，若有所思。
ext.ext_en: Jessica sipped her drink thoughtfully...

ext.ext_cn: 他抿了一口杯中的酒，然后放了下来。
ext.ext_en: He sipped at the glass and then put it down...

defs.def_en: If you sip a drink or sip at it, you drink by taking just a small amount at a time.

ext.ext_cn: 哈里抿了一口波旁威士忌。
ext.ext_en: Harry took a sip of bourbon...

ext.ext_cn: 凯瑟琳又抿了一口杯中的酒，竭力使自己镇静下来。
ext.ext_en: Katherine took another sip from her glass to calm herself.

defs.def_en: A sip is a small amount of drink that you take into your mouth.
A totem pole is a long wooden pole with symbols and pictures carved and painted on it. Totem poles are made by some Native American peoples and placed outside their homes.

defs.def_cn: 角逐;参加…的选拔（或试演）

ext.ext_cn: 他本该参加奥运会百米赛跑的选拔。
ext.ext_en: He should have tried out for the Olympic 100 metres squad.

defs.def_en: If you try out for a sports team or an acting role, you compete or you perform a test in an attempt to be chosen.
A wanderer is a person who travels around rather than settling in one place.

ext.ext_cn: 就在他右眼的上方有一条一英寸长的伤口。
ext.ext_en: There was an inch-long gash just above his right eye.

defs.def_en: A gash is a long, deep cut in your skin or in the surface of something.

ext.ext_cn: 他砍树的时候砍伤了腿。
ext.ext_en: He gashed his leg while felling trees.

defs.def_en: If you gash something, you accidentally make a long and deep cut in it.

defs.def_cn: （用于否定句）任何事物，什么事情

ext.ext_cn: 我们什么都做不了。
ext.ext_en: We can't do anything...

ext.ext_cn: 爸爸坐着，一声不吭。
ext.ext_en: Dad sat, not saying anything...

defs.def_en: You use anything in statements with negative meaning to indicate in a general way that nothing is present or that an action or event does not or cannot happen.

defs.def_cn: （用于疑问句或条件从句）任何事物，任何事情

ext.ext_cn: 怎么了，出什么事了吗？
ext.ext_en: What happened, is anything wrong?...

ext.ext_cn: 你找到什么了吗？
ext.ext_en: Did you find anything?...

defs.def_en: You use anything in questions and conditional clauses to ask or talk about whether something is present or happening.

defs.def_cn: （用于描述所谈论事物的词语前）…的东西，…的事情

ext.ext_cn: 他最想成为一名教师。
ext.ext_en: More than anything else, he wanted to become a teacher...

ext.ext_cn: 今年的便宜货明年会更便宜。
ext.ext_en: Anything that's cheap this year will be even cheaper next year...

defs.def_en: You can use anything before words which indicate the kind of thing you are talking about.

defs.def_cn: （用于加强语气）无论什么东西，随便什么事情

ext.ext_cn: 他年轻又富有朝气，什么事都愿意做。
ext.ext_en: He is young, fresh, and ready for anything...

ext.ext_cn: 那一刻，什么事都可能发生。
ext.ext_en: At that point, anything could happen...

defs.def_en: You use anything to emphasize a possible thing, event, or situation, when you are saying that it could be any one of a very large number of things.

ext.ext_cn: 医生的结论是只有做手术，他才有可能过上基本正常的生活。
ext.ext_en: Doctors have decided the only way he can live anything near a normal life is to give him an operation...

ext.ext_cn: 只有考恩斯算是发挥出了正常水平。
ext.ext_en: Only Cowans played anything close to his true form...

defs.def_en: You use anything in expressions such as anything near ,anything close to and anything like to emphasize a statement that you are making.

ext.ext_cn: 集约饲养把奶牛变成了生产牛奶的机器，每天差不多要挤出25升到40升的牛奶。
ext.ext_en: Factory farming has turned the cow into a milk machine, producing anything from 25 to 40 litres of milk per day...

ext.ext_cn: 和他父亲争吵了大约15分钟到一个小时。
ext.ext_en: Fights with his father lasted anything between fifteen minutes and an hour.

defs.def_en: When you do not want to be exact, you use anything to talk about a particular range of things or quantities.

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词后表示强调）非常，十分

ext.ext_cn: 他过去聪明绝顶。
ext.ext_en: He used to be as smart as anything...

ext.ext_cn: 她打开门，飞快地跳了出来。
ext.ext_en: She opened the door and jumped out, quick as anything.

defs.def_en: You use as anything after an adjective to emphasize a quality that someone has.

defs.def_cn: 单单除…之外;根本不;远非

ext.ext_cn: 星期六的晚上我根本静不下心来！
ext.ext_en: I will be anything but quiet on Saturday night!...

ext.ext_cn: 并无证据表明他让什么人隐瞒真相。
ext.ext_en: There's no evidence that he told anyone to say anything but the truth...

defs.def_en: You use anything but in expressions such as anything but quiet and anything but attractive to emphasize that something is not the case.

ext.ext_cn: 就是天塌了我也不搬走。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't want to move for anything in the world...

ext.ext_cn: 我本来说什么也不会错过在英格兰的这个夏季的。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't have missed this summer in England for anything...

defs.def_en: You can say that you would not do something for anything to emphasize that you definitely would not want to do or be a particular thing.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于否定句后，对所说之事进行补充说明）甚至正相反，甚至还不如说

ext.ext_cn: 我从来不用跟在他后面打扫卫生。恰恰相反，他包揽了大部分的清洁工作。
ext.ext_en: I never had to clean up after him. If anything, he did most of the cleaning.

defs.def_en: You use if anything, especially after a negative statement, to introduce a statement that adds to what you have just said.

defs.def_cn: 或其他什么的；诸如此类

ext.ext_cn: 听着，如果你和他说话或什么的，一定要让我们知道，好吗？
ext.ext_en: Listen, if you talk to him or anything make sure you let us know, will you...

ext.ext_cn: 他没哭也没喊，什么事也没有。
ext.ext_en: He didn't cry or scream or anything.

defs.def_en: You can add or anything to the end of a clause or sentence in order to refer vaguely to other things that are or may be similar to what has just been mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 叶酸(B 族维生素的一种)
defs.def_en: Folic acid is one of the B group of vitamins. It is found in green vegetables and fruit.

ext.ext_cn: 大型水坝对西伯利亚脆弱的生态平衡造成了破坏。
ext.ext_en: Large dams have harmed Siberia's delicate ecological balance.

ext.ext_cn: 雨林破坏等生态灾难
ext.ext_en: ...ecological disasters, such as the destruction of rainforest.

defs.def_en: Ecological means involved with or concerning ecology.

defs.def_cn: 主张生态保护的;从事生态保护工作的

ext.ext_cn: 环境保护组织称目前并未采取任何行动处理这个问题。
ext.ext_en: Ecological groups say that nothing is being done to tackle the problem.

defs.def_en: Ecological groups, movements, and people are concerned with preserving the environment and natural resources, so that they can be used in a sensible way, rather than being wasted.

ext.ext_cn: 他会模仿各种口音，还会讲笑话——他可以当个独角喜剧演员。
ext.ext_en: He does all kinds of accents, he can do jokes—he could be a stand-up comic...

ext.ext_cn: 女性靠演单人喜剧通常无法成名。
ext.ext_en: Women do not normally break into the big time by doing stand-up comedy.

defs.def_en: A stand-up comic or comedian stands alone in front of an audience and tells jokes.

defs.def_cn: 单人滑稽表演;单口相声

ext.ext_cn: 凭借个人魅力、精湛的技艺和进行单人喜剧表演所需要的勇气过活
ext.ext_en: ...getting by on likeability, professionalism and the kind of nerve you need to do stand-up.

defs.def_en: Stand-up is stand-up comedy.
If people have a stand-up argument or fight, they stand up and shout at each other or hit each other violently.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指男士服装)整洁漂亮的，整洁时髦的

ext.ext_cn: 笔挺时尚的细条纹西装
ext.ext_en: ...a natty pin stripe suit...

ext.ext_cn: 克利夫是讲究衣着整洁美观的人。
ext.ext_en: Cliff was a natty dresser.

defs.def_en: If you describe clothes, especially men's clothes, as natty, you mean that they are smart and neat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 设计精巧的小屋
ext.ext_en: ...natty little houses.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as natty, you think it is smart and cleverly designed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他母亲很溺爱他，任由他想干什么就干什么。
ext.ext_en: His indulgent mother was willing to let him do anything he wanted.

defs.def_en: If you are indulgent, you treat a person with special kindness, often in a way that is not good for them.

ext.ext_cn: 该培训包括产科学和妇科学的增加课时。
ext.ext_en: The training covers extended periods in obstetrics and gynaecology.

defs.def_en: Obstetrics is the branch of medicine that is concerned with pregnancy and giving birth.

defs.def_cn: 产科（学）的；分娩的；生产的

ext.ext_cn: 孩子出生时就带有这样的残疾，这表明产科护理有问题。
ext.ext_en: For a child to be born with this disability indicates a defect in obstetric care.

defs.def_en: Obstetric medicine and care is concerned with pregnancy and giving birth.

ext.ext_cn: 当怒火转化为激情，她停止了思考。
ext.ext_en: She ceased to think, as anger transmuted into passion...

ext.ext_cn: 科学家将物质转化为纯粹的能量，引爆了第一颗原子弹。
ext.ext_en: Scientists transmuted matter into pure energy and exploded the first atomic bomb.

defs.def_en: If something transmutes or is transmuted into a different form, it is changed into that form.
A boxer is someone who takes part in the sport of boxing.
A boxer is a dog with short hair and a rather flat face.

defs.def_cn: 先驱的;创始的;开创性的

ext.ext_cn: 一份可能通向核武器全球禁令的开创性协议
ext.ext_en: ...a trail-blazing agreement that could lead to a global ban on nuclear weapons...

ext.ext_cn: 该艺术节志在不虚负其先锋性活动的声名。
ext.ext_en: The Festival aims to live up to its reputation as a trail-blazing event.

defs.def_en: A trail-blazing idea, event, or organization is new, exciting, and original.

defs.def_cn: (常指以愚蠢或不必要的方式)争论，争执

ext.ext_cn: 劳资双方在薪水、福利和工作条件的问题上争执不下。
ext.ext_en: Management and labor are dickering over pay, benefits and working conditions...

ext.ext_cn: 他可能认为我们会争执起来。我们偏不。
ext.ext_en: He may be expecting us to dicker. Don't.

defs.def_en: If you say that people are dickering about something, you mean that they are arguing or disagreeing about it, often in a way that you think is foolish or unnecessary.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 线条被蚀刻得如此精细，在远处看都看不见。
ext.ext_en: The lines were so finely etched as to be invisible from a distance...

ext.ext_cn: 这种腰带即便在最薄的衣衫下都看不出来。
ext.ext_en: The belt is invisible even under the thinnest garments.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as invisible, you mean that it cannot be seen, for example because it is transparent, hidden, or very small.

ext.ext_cn: 父母担心他们可能会逾越这些无形的界限。
ext.ext_en: Parents fear they might overstep these invisible boundaries...

ext.ext_cn: 她父亲的脸突然僵硬了,仿佛是被无形的双手扼住了脖子。
ext.ext_en: Her father's face had suddenly tightened as though he was being strangled by invisible hands.

defs.def_en: You can use invisible when you are talking about something that cannot be seen but has a definite effect. In this sense, invisible is often used before a noun which refers to something that can usually be seen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 被人忽视的;不为人注意的

ext.ext_cn: 一名办事员会感到如此受人忽视，令人觉得不可思议。
ext.ext_en: It was strange, how invisible a clerk could feel...

ext.ext_cn: 穷人的问题大多不受重视。
ext.ext_en: The problems of the poor are largely invisible.

defs.def_en: If you say that you feel invisible, you are complaining that you are being ignored by other people. If you say that a particular problem or situation is invisible, you are complaining that it is not being considered or dealt with.

defs.def_cn: (故事中的人或事物)隐身的，隐形的

ext.ext_cn: 《隐形人》
ext.ext_en: ...The Invisible Man.

defs.def_en: In stories, invisible people or things have a magic quality which makes people unable to see them.

ext.ext_cn: 旅游业是英国最大的一项无形输出。
ext.ext_en: Tourism is Britain's single biggest invisible export...

ext.ext_cn: 旅游业收入是该国无形收益当中最大的一项。
ext.ext_en: The revenue from tourism is the biggest single item in the country's invisible earnings...

defs.def_en: In economics, invisible earnings are the money that a country makes as a result of services such as banking and tourism, rather than by producing goods.

defs.def_cn: 无形服务业(如银行业、旅游业)
defs.def_en: Invisibles are services such as banking and tourism, which provide a country's invisible earnings.

defs.def_cn: （经常指价值观或生活方式有别于当今的）旧时，往昔，过去

ext.ext_cn: 现代的性感偶像现在已取代了往昔过时的英雄形象。
ext.ext_en: The modern-day sex symbol has now taken the place of the old-fashioned hero of yesteryear.

defs.def_en: You use yesteryear to refer to the past, often a period in the past with a set of values or a way of life that no longer exists.

ext.ext_cn: M4 号高速公路西向车道车流行驶缓慢。
ext.ext_en: Traffic is slow on the westbound carriageway of the M4.

ext.ext_cn: 离开芝加哥的最后一趟西行火车
ext.ext_en: ...the last westbound train to leave Chicago.

defs.def_en: Westbound roads or vehicles lead to the west or are travelling towards the west.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 顾影自怜的单相思男孩
ext.ext_en: ...a lovesick boy consumed with self-pity.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as lovesick, you mean that they are so in love with someone who does not love them, that they are behaving in a strange and foolish way.

defs.def_cn: 左右舆论者；舆论导向人
defs.def_en: Opinion formers are people who have a lot of influence over what the public thinks about things.

ext.ext_cn: 初期的反应非常好。
ext.ext_en: The initial reaction has been excellent...

ext.ext_cn: 本次初步会议的目标是澄清这些问题。
ext.ext_en: The aim of this initial meeting is to clarify the issues.

defs.def_en: You use initial to describe something that happens at the beginning of a process.

defs.def_cn: (姓名的)首字母(例如 Michael Dennis Stocks 的首字母缩写为 M.D.S.)

ext.ext_cn: 车身有她姓名缩写JB的银色保时捷跑车
ext.ext_en: ...a silver Porsche car with her initials JB on the side.

defs.def_en: Initials are the capital letters which begin each word of a name. For example, if your full name is Michael Dennis Stocks, your initials will be M.D.S.

defs.def_cn: 用姓名的首字母签名于

ext.ext_cn: 请在凭单上用首字母签名。
ext.ext_en: Would you mind initialing this voucher?...

ext.ext_cn: 这份协议是6月份草签的。
ext.ext_en: The agreement was initialled in June.

defs.def_en: If someone initials an official document, they write their initials on it, for example to show that they have seen it or that they accept or agree with it.

defs.def_cn: 骷髅标志，骷髅画(旧时为海盗旗的标记，现有时会出现在盛放有毒物质的容器上)

ext.ext_cn: 这些桶上贴着的骷髅标志引起了海关官员的怀疑。
ext.ext_en: Skull and crossbones stickers on the drums aroused the suspicion of the customs officers.

defs.def_en: A skull and crossbones is a picture of a human skull above a pair of crossed bones which warns of death or danger. It used to appear on the flags of pirate ships and is now sometimes found on containers holding poisonous substances.

ext.ext_cn: 我们被女房东弄得无家可归。
ext.ext_en: We had been made homeless by our landlady.

defs.def_en: Someone's  landlady is the woman who allows them to live or work in a building which she owns, in return for rent.

ext.ext_cn: “浪子归乡”酒吧老板娘贝特
ext.ext_en: ...Bet, the landlady of the Rovers Return.

defs.def_en: The landlady of a pub is the woman who owns or runs it, or the wife of the man who owns or runs it.
A landlady is the woman who owns or runs a boarding house or inn.

ext.ext_cn: 要想搞到这本书，你最好在分类广告栏刊登个广告。
ext.ext_en: Your best hope of obtaining a copy is to place an advert in the classifieds.

defs.def_en: The classifieds are the same as classified ads .

defs.def_cn: (与形容词连用构成新的形容词)表示“有…茎的”，“有…柄的”

ext.ext_cn: 一大束长茎玫瑰
ext.ext_en: ...an enormous bouquet of long-stemmed roses.

defs.def_en: -stemmed is added to adjectives to form adjectives which indicate what the stem of something is like.

defs.def_cn: （老人或病人用的）齐默助行架
defs.def_en: A Zimmer frame or a Zimmer is a frame that old or ill people sometimes use to help them walk.

ext.ext_cn: 露出稀疏牙齿的咧嘴大笑
ext.ext_en: ...a broad, gap-toothed grin.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their smile as gap-toothed, you mean that some of that person's teeth are missing.
If you describe a man as a lecher, you disapprove of him because you think he behaves towards women in a way which shows he is only interested in them sexually.

defs.def_cn: (牛或羊)咀嚼反刍的食物，倒嚼
defs.def_en: When animals such as cows or sheep chew the cud, they slowly chew their partly digested food over and over again in their mouth before finally swallowing it.
An indirect question is the same as a reported question .

defs.def_cn: (用考勤卡)记录上班的时间;打卡上班

ext.ext_cn: 8点钟前我得打卡上班。
ext.ext_en: I have to clock in by eight.

defs.def_en: When you clock in at work, you arrive there or put a special card into a device to show what time you arrived.
An alley cat is a cat that lives in the streets of a town, is rather fierce, and is usually not owned by anyone.

ext.ext_cn: 医生告诉她，她这是在装病。
ext.ext_en: She was told by her doctor that she was malingering.

defs.def_en: If someone is malingering, they pretend to be ill in order to avoid working.

ext.ext_cn: 给员工的薪水与老师拿的薪水相当。
ext.ext_en: Employees are paid salaries commensurate with those of teachers...

ext.ext_cn: 经理们发现自己的收入相应地减少了。
ext.ext_en: Managers saw a commensurate fall in their revenues.

defs.def_en: If the level of one thing is commensurate with another, the first level is in proportion to the second.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 人的物质存在
ext.ext_en: ...man's corporeal existence.

defs.def_en: Corporeal means involving or relating to the physical world rather than the spiritual world.

ext.ext_cn: 他抱着一摞小册子匆匆出去了。
ext.ext_en: He hurried out with an armful of brochures.

defs.def_en: An armful of something is the amount of it that you can carry fairly easily.
A proscenium or a proscenium arch is an arch in a theatre which separates the stage from the audience.

defs.def_cn: 不必要地拖延;拖得过久

ext.ext_cn: 与詹姆斯的冲突拖了两年。
ext.ext_en: The conflict with James has dragged on for two years.

defs.def_en: You say that an event or process drags on when you disapprove of the fact that it lasts for longer than necessary.

ext.ext_cn: 受债务困扰的第三世界国家日益加深的苦境
ext.ext_en: ...the worsening plight of Third World countries plagued by debts.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone's plight, you mean that they are in a difficult or distressing situation that is full of problems.

ext.ext_cn: 闭嘴，你这个只知道发牢骚的家伙。
ext.ext_en: Shut up, you moaning whinger.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a whinger, you are critical of them because they complain about unimportant things all the time.

defs.def_cn: 时髦男子;注重打扮的男人

ext.ext_cn: 他英俊潇洒，还是个衣着讲究的时髦绅士。
ext.ext_en: He was handsome and a dandy.

defs.def_en: A dandy is a man who thinks a great deal about his appearance and always dresses in smart clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 这附近有个动物园？我的孩子们一定会很高兴的。
ext.ext_en: There's a zoo round here? That's dandy for my kids.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is dandy, you mean it is good or just right.
Reeds are tall plants that grow in large groups in shallow water or on ground that is always wet and soft. They have strong, hollow stems that can be used for making things such as mats or baskets.
A reed is a small piece of cane or metal inserted into the mouthpiece of a woodwind instrument. The reed vibrates when you blow through it and makes a sound.

ext.ext_cn: 我拿起一粒药丸，把它嚼碎。
ext.ext_en: I took one of the pills and chewed it up.

defs.def_en: If you chew food up, you chew it until it is completely crushed or soft.

ext.ext_cn: 每年春天，臭氧遭到破坏，空洞就出现了。
ext.ext_en: Every spring the ozone is chewed up, and the hole appears.

ext.ext_cn: 正在逐渐蚕食政府控制的领地的叛乱分子
ext.ext_en: ...rebels who are now chewing up Government-held territory...

defs.def_en: If something is chewed up, it has been destroyed or damaged in some way.
A box number is a number used as an address, for example one given by a newspaper for replies to a private advertisement, or one used by an organization for the letters sent to it.

ext.ext_cn: 完全干枯的花和叶
ext.ext_en: ...desiccated flowers and leaves.

defs.def_en: Desiccated things have lost all the moisture that was in them.

defs.def_cn: 用干燥法保存的;脱水的;风干的

ext.ext_cn: 椰子干
ext.ext_en: ...desiccated coconut.

defs.def_en: Desiccated food has been dried in order to preserve it.

ext.ext_cn: 黑格不愿向下属请教。
ext.ext_en: Haig tended not to seek guidance from subordinates...

ext.ext_cn: 几乎所有的下属都崇拜她。
ext.ext_en: Nearly all her subordinates adored her.

defs.def_en: If someone is your subordinate, they have a less important position than you in the organization that you both work for.

ext.ext_cn: 他的60个下级官员都以他为榜样。
ext.ext_en: Sixty of his subordinate officers followed his example...

ext.ext_cn: 过去女人被认为是从属于自由民的。
ext.ext_en: Women were regarded as subordinate to free men.

defs.def_en: Someone who is subordinate to you has a less important position than you and has to obey you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这是一种形象胜于语言的艺术。
ext.ext_en: It was an art in which words were subordinate to images.

defs.def_en: Something that is subordinate to something else is less important than the other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 为了这个目标他愿意并能够把其他一切都放在次要的位置。
ext.ext_en: He was both willing and able to subordinate all else to this aim.

defs.def_en: If you subordinate something to another thing, you regard it or treat it as less important than the other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他设法把飘起的衬衫塞到裤子里。
ext.ext_en: He tried to tuck his flapping shirt inside his trousers...

ext.ext_cn: 一天清晨，她发现自己汽车的挡风玻璃雨刷下插着一支玫瑰。
ext.ext_en: She found a rose tucked under the windscreen wiper of her car one morning.

defs.def_en: If you tuck something somewhere, you put it there so that it is safe, comfortable, or neat.

ext.ext_cn: 他从学校小吃店偷了一条玛氏巧克力棒。
ext.ext_en: He stole a Mars bar from the school tuck shop.

defs.def_en: Tuck is food that children eat as a snack at school.

ext.ext_cn: 她已经做了 13 次手术，包括一次腹部瘦身整形手术。
ext.ext_en: She'd undergone 13 operations, including a tummy tuck.

defs.def_en: You can use tuck to refer to a form of plastic surgery which involves reducing the size of a part of someone's body.

ext.ext_cn: 学生们不愿真正去努力。他们希望依赖别人。
ext.ext_en: Students are unwilling to really work. They want to be spoon-fed...

ext.ext_cn: 他们一直娇生惯养，房子、仆人、银行存款一应俱全。
ext.ext_en: They've been spoon-fed, provided with a house, servants, bank balance.

defs.def_en: If you think that someone is being given too much help with something and is not making enough effort themselves, you can say they are being spoon-fed .

ext.ext_cn: 他们不太愿意被填鸭式地灌输来自日本的学说。
ext.ext_en: They were less willing to be spoon-fed doctrines from Japan...

ext.ext_cn: 曾被填鸭式地灌输了消费主义思想的孩子们发现无节制的时代已经结束了。
ext.ext_en: The children who were spoon-fed consumerism have discovered that the years of excess are over.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is spoon-fed ideas or information, you mean that they are told about them and are expected to accept them without questioning them.

ext.ext_cn: 我过了两年时间才好起来，其间他喂我进食，并承担全部的家务。
ext.ext_en: It took two years for me to get better, during which time he spoon-fed me and did absolutely everything around the house.

defs.def_en: If you spoon-feed a small child or a sick person, you feed them using a spoon.
An inquisition is an official investigation, especially one which is very thorough and uses harsh methods of questioning.
An arsonist is a person who deliberately sets fire to a building or vehicle.

ext.ext_cn: 一份新报告指出，口香糖可能对健康有害。
ext.ext_en: A new report suggests that chewing-gum may be a health hazard...

ext.ext_cn: 密西西比河上驳船漏油事件危及新奥尔良市的饮用水。
ext.ext_en: Oil leaking from a barge in the Mississippi River poses a hazard to the drinking water of New Orleans.

defs.def_en: A hazard is something which could be dangerous to you, your health or safety, or your plans or reputation.

defs.def_cn: 使冒风险;使处于危险中

ext.ext_cn: 他无法相信，如果当时那个英国人知道他冒的风险有多大，他还会让自己的孙子去冒这个险。
ext.ext_en: He could not believe that, had the Englishman known how much he was at risk, he would have hazarded his grandson.

defs.def_en: If you hazard someone or something, you put them into a situation which might be dangerous for them.

defs.def_cn: 斗胆提出;作无把握猜测

ext.ext_cn: 我斗胆猜测，他们在下一轮竞选中会有不错的表现。
ext.ext_en: I would hazard a guess that they'll do fairly well in the next election...

ext.ext_cn: “15或16？”迪尔登夫人试着猜道。
ext.ext_en: 'Fifteen or sixteen?' Mrs Dearden hazarded.

defs.def_en: If you hazard or if you hazard a guess, you make a suggestion about something which is only a guess and which you know might be wrong.
A steelmaker is a company that makes steel.

defs.def_cn: 高级顾问医师;会诊医师

ext.ext_cn: 雪利的兄弟现在在瑞典做心脏外科高级顾问医师。
ext.ext_en: Shirley's brother is now a consultant heart surgeon in Sweden.

defs.def_en: A consultant is an experienced doctor with a high position, who specializes in one area of medicine.

ext.ext_cn: 他是瑞典政府顾问。
ext.ext_en: He was a consultant to the Swedish government.

ext.ext_cn: 派来对部门进行重组的管理顾问工作组
ext.ext_en: ...a team of management consultants sent in to reorganise the department.

defs.def_en: A consultant is a person who gives expert advice to a person or organization on a particular subject.

defs.def_cn: 被吹嘘的;被过分夸耀的

ext.ext_cn: 它那套被大肆吹嘘的安保程序并没有发挥作用。
ext.ext_en: Its vaunted security procedures hadn't worked...

ext.ext_cn: 辛普森的那些被大肆称赞的发现在现代社会学中实际上都不足为奇。
ext.ext_en: Simpson's much vaunted discoveries are in fact commonplace in modern sociology.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as vaunted or much vaunted, you mean that people praise it more than it deserves.
A rockery is a raised part of a garden which is built of rocks and soil, with small plants growing between the rocks.

defs.def_cn: （使人不能说话的）封口布，塞口物

ext.ext_cn: 劫持者用一块厚厚的皮革堵住了他的嘴。
ext.ext_en: His captors had put a gag of thick leather in his mouth.

defs.def_en: A gag is something such as a piece of cloth that is tied around or put inside someone's mouth in order to stop them from speaking.

ext.ext_cn: 我用一条毛巾堵住他的嘴。
ext.ext_en: I gagged him with a towel.

defs.def_en: If someone gags you, they tie a piece of cloth around your mouth in order to stop you from speaking or shouting.

defs.def_cn: 压制…的言论自由；迫使…缄默

ext.ext_cn: 法官的言论自由不能受到压制。
ext.ext_en: Judges must not be gagged.

defs.def_en: If a person is gagged by someone in authority, they are prevented from expressing their opinion or from publishing certain information.

ext.ext_cn: 我跪在马桶边，一阵恶心。
ext.ext_en: I knelt by the toilet and gagged.

defs.def_en: If you gag, you cannot swallow and nearly vomit.

ext.ext_cn: 关于警察在法庭作证的一则笑话
ext.ext_en: ...a gag about policemen giving evidence in court.

defs.def_en: A gag is a joke.

ext.ext_cn: 天底下的女孩儿都对这种车梦寐以求。
ext.ext_en: Girls everywhere are gagging for a car like this...

ext.ext_cn: 肯定有成千上万的学生都渴望到这所大学念书。
ext.ext_en: There are thousands of students absolutely gagging to come to this university.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is gagging for something or is gagging to do something, you are emphasizing that they want to have it or do it very much.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 罗布在做医生还是当运动员之间痛苦抉择，左右为难。
ext.ext_en: Robb is torn between becoming a doctor and a career in athletics...

ext.ext_cn: 我知道政府在这个问题上犹豫不决，不知该何去何从。
ext.ext_en: I know the administration was very torn on this subject.

defs.def_en: If you are torn between two or more things, you cannot decide which to choose, and so you feel anxious or troubled.
A community college is a local college where students from the surrounding area can take courses in practical or academic subjects.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那些鹿一直没有被驯服：你一靠近，它们就跑开。
ext.ext_en: The deer never became tame; they would run away if you approached them.

defs.def_en: A tame animal or bird is one that is not afraid of humans.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如今有些政治游行显得毫无激情。
ext.ext_en: Some of today's political demonstrations look rather tame...

ext.ext_cn: 这份报告平淡无奇。
ext.ext_en: The report was pretty tame stuff.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is tame, you are criticizing them for being weak and uninteresting, rather than forceful or shocking.

defs.def_cn: 驯化，驯服(野生动物或鸟)

ext.ext_cn: 据说亚马孙人最先驯化了马。
ext.ext_en: The Amazons were believed to have been the first to tame horses.

defs.def_en: If someone tames a wild animal or bird, they train it not to be afraid of humans and to do what they say.

ext.ext_cn: 调集了两个装甲兵团去威慑、控制人群。
ext.ext_en: Two regiments of cavalry were called out to tame the crowds.

defs.def_en: If you tame someone or something that is dangerous, uncontrolled, or likely to cause trouble, you bring them under control.

ext.ext_cn: 她吸了块冰块到嘴里，嘎嘣嘎嘣地大声嚼着。
ext.ext_en: She sucked an ice cube into her mouth, and crunched it loudly...

ext.ext_cn: 理查德咬了一口苹果。
ext.ext_en: Richard crunched into the apple.

defs.def_en: If you crunch something hard, such as a sweet, you crush it noisily between your teeth.

ext.ext_cn: 我踩碎了一块瓷片。
ext.ext_en: A piece of china crunched under my foot...

ext.ext_cn: 他把那沓纸揉得嚓嚓响。
ext.ext_en: He crunched the sheets of paper in his hands.

defs.def_en: If something crunches or if you crunch it, it makes a breaking or crushing noise, for example when you step on it.

defs.def_cn: (在小石子铺成的路上)嘎吱嘎吱地行进

ext.ext_cn: 我嘎吱嘎吱地走过石子路。
ext.ext_en: I crunched across the gravel.

ext.ext_cn: 嘎吱嘎吱地驶过石头路面的车轮
ext.ext_en: ...wheels crunching over a stony surface.

defs.def_en: If you crunch across a surface made of very small stones, you move across it causing it to make a crunching noise.

ext.ext_cn: 明天可就是紧要关头了。
ext.ext_en: Tomorrow, though, is the crunch...

ext.ext_cn: 关键时刻，他可以依靠我的支持。
ext.ext_en: He can rely on my support when the crunch comes...

defs.def_en: You can refer to an important time or event, for example when an important decision has to be made, as the crunch .

defs.def_cn: (用计算器或计算机大量地)处理(数字)

ext.ext_cn: 我兴致勃勃地研究这些账簿，经常计算到凌晨1点。
ext.ext_en: I pored over the books with great enthusiasm, often crunching the numbers until 1:00 a.m.

defs.def_en: To crunch numbers means to do a lot of calculations using a calculator or computer.

defs.def_cn: 缺少资金;经济收缩;财政困难

ext.ext_cn: 联合国面临着现金短缺问题。
ext.ext_en: The UN is facing a cash crunch.

ext.ext_cn: 可能会威胁到该公司前途的财政危机
ext.ext_en: ...a financial crunch that could threaten the company's future.

defs.def_en: A situation in which a business or economy has very little money can be referred to as a crunch .

defs.def_cn: 使…合理化;对…进行理性解释

ext.ext_cn: 他坚信自己实际上是在促进和平，以此进一步将自己的行为合理化。
ext.ext_en: He further rationalized his activity by convincing himself that he was actually promoting peace...

ext.ext_cn: 我把自己的想法一股脑地写在纸上，以试图给自己的感受找个说辞。
ext.ext_en: I poured my thoughts out on paper in an attempt to rationalize my feelings.

defs.def_en: If you try to rationalize attitudes or actions that are difficult to accept, you think of reasons to justify or explain them.

defs.def_cn: 精简;（通常指通过削减员工和设备）使更有效率

ext.ext_cn: 该公司曾经拥有的366个地方办事处正被精简为150到200个规模较大的分支机构。
ext.ext_en: The network of 366 local offices is being rationalised to leave the company with 150 to 200 larger branch offices.

defs.def_en: When a company, system, or industry is rationalized, it is made more efficient, usually by getting rid of staff and equipment that are not essential.
Nightclothes are clothes that you wear in bed.

ext.ext_cn: 他在一条结了冰的人行道上滑了一跤。
ext.ext_en: He had slipped on an icy pavement...

ext.ext_cn: 小心，别滑倒了。
ext.ext_en: Be careful not to slip.

defs.def_en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

ext.ext_cn: 他的眼镜滑掉了。
ext.ext_en: His glasses had slipped...

ext.ext_cn: 锤子从她的手中滑落。
ext.ext_en: The hammer slipped out of her grasp.

defs.def_en: If something slips, it slides out of place or out of your hand.

defs.def_cn: 迅速而悄无声息地走(到某处);溜(到某处)

ext.ext_cn: 埃米偷偷下楼溜出了房子。
ext.ext_en: Amy slipped downstairs and out of the house...

ext.ext_cn: 她溜进了驾驶座，关上了门。
ext.ext_en: She slipped into the driving seat and closed the door.

defs.def_en: If you slip somewhere, you go there quickly and quietly.

defs.def_cn: 迅速而不被注意地放置;偷偷塞进

ext.ext_cn: 我偷偷在路易斯的房门下面塞了一张便条。
ext.ext_en: I slipped a note under Louise's door...

ext.ext_cn: 他摸到口袋里有一枚硬币，便匆匆丢进她的讨钱罐。
ext.ext_en: He found a coin in his pocket and slipped it into her collecting tin...

defs.def_en: If you slip something somewhere, you put it there quickly in a way that does not attract attention.

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯特在学校里偷偷地塞给她一张纸条。
ext.ext_en: Robert had slipped her a note in school...

ext.ext_cn: 她四下里看了看，然后拿出一个包裹，偷偷地塞给了这个男人。
ext.ext_en: She looked round before pulling out a package and slipping it to the man.

defs.def_en: If you slip something to someone, you give it to them secretly.

defs.def_cn: 不知不觉地转入(某种状态);逐渐陷入(某种情况)

ext.ext_cn: 他惊异地发现人很容易在不知不觉中因循守旧起来。
ext.ext_en: It amazed him how easily one could slip into a routine...

ext.ext_cn: 经济再次陷入衰退的可能性是 50%。
ext.ext_en: There was a 50-50 chance that the economy could slip back into recession.

defs.def_en: To slip into a particular state or situation means to pass gradually into it, in a way that is hardly noticed.

ext.ext_cn: 股价跌至 117 便士。
ext.ext_en: Shares slipped to 117p...

ext.ext_cn: 该俱乐部已经跌为丁级组的最后一名。
ext.ext_en: The club had slipped to the bottom of Division Four...

defs.def_en: If something slips to a lower level or standard, it falls to that level or standard.

ext.ext_cn: 她麻利地脱下夹克，扔在了沙发上。
ext.ext_en: She slipped out of the jacket and tossed it on the couch...

ext.ext_cn: 我迅速地脱下了毛绒手套。
ext.ext_en: I slipped off my woollen gloves.

defs.def_en: If you slip into or out of clothes or shoes, you put them on or take them off quickly and easily.

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须好好准备，不能出任何差错。
ext.ext_en: We must be well prepared, there must be no slips.

defs.def_en: A slip is a small or unimportant mistake.

ext.ext_cn: 他从笔记本上撕下来的一张张小纸片
ext.ext_en: ...little slips of paper he had torn from a notebook...

ext.ext_cn: 我在纸条上记下了她的名字。
ext.ext_en: I put her name on the slip.

defs.def_en: A slip of paper is a small piece of paper.
A slip is a thin piece of clothing that a woman wears under her dress or skirt.

ext.ext_cn: 跟他哥哥一比，他不过是个小毛孩。
ext.ext_en: He's a mere slip of a lad compared to his brother...

ext.ext_cn: 她才是个小丫头。
ext.ext_en: She was just a slip of a thing.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a slip of a girl or a slip of a boy, you mean they are small, thin, and young.

ext.ext_cn: 他在午夜时分离开，避开了记者的追踪。
ext.ext_en: He gave reporters the slip by leaving at midnight.

defs.def_en: If you give someone the slip, you escape from them when they are following you or watching you.

ext.ext_cn: 我可以打赌，是他走漏了我去了美国的消息。
ext.ext_en: I bet he let slip that I'd gone to America.

defs.def_en: If you let slip information, you accidentally tell it to someone, when you wanted to keep it secret.

ext.ext_cn: 他显然已经忘掉了我的来意。
ext.ext_en: The reason for my visit had obviously slipped his mind.

defs.def_en: If something slips your mind, you forget about it.

defs.def_cn: （用以探测或测量放射性的）盖革计数器
defs.def_en: A Geiger counter is a device which finds and measures radioactivity.
The guard's van of a train is a small carriage or part of a carriage in which the guard travels.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他坚决支持控制政府开支。
ext.ext_en: He's a staunch supporter of controls on government spending.

defs.def_en: A staunch supporter or believer is very loyal to a person, organization, or set of beliefs, and supports them strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 政府称这是阻止每年数十万难民涌入德国的唯一办法。
ext.ext_en: The government claims this is the only way to staunch the annual flow to Germany of hundreds of thousands of refugees...

ext.ext_cn: 为阻止苏格兰北部沿海一艘油轮的原油泄漏所进行的堵漏工作因风暴天气而告中断。
ext.ext_en: Efforts to staunch the spill of crude oil from a tanker off the north coast of Scotland are being held up by gale force winds.

defs.def_en: To staunch the flow of something means to stop it.

ext.ext_cn: 汤姆试图用手帕来止血。
ext.ext_en: Tom tried to staunch the blood with his handkerchief.

defs.def_en: To staunch a wound, or to staunch the blood from a wound, means to stop the wound from bleeding.

defs.def_cn: （通常指伸向大海的）凸式码头，突码头，突堤

ext.ext_cn: 布赖顿码头
ext.ext_en: ...Brighton Pier.

defs.def_en: A pier is a platform sticking out into water, usually the sea, which people walk along or use when getting onto or off boats.

defs.def_cn: （人、活动、思想等的）主流，主要倾向，主要趋势

ext.ext_cn: 经济主流之外的人
ext.ext_en: ...people outside  the economic mainstream...

ext.ext_cn: 这是该公司向主流科学与商业计算领域迈出的第一步。
ext.ext_en: This was the company's first step into the mainstream of scientific and commercial computing...

defs.def_en: People, activities, or ideas that are part of the mainstream are regarded as the most typical, normal, and conventional because they belong to the same group or system as most others of their kind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 宏伟的;壮丽的;令人印象深刻的

ext.ext_cn: 绿树掩映中的一幢乡间豪宅
ext.ext_en: ...a magnificent country house in wooded grounds.

ext.ext_cn: 圣费尔南多河谷的壮丽美景
ext.ext_en: ...magnificent views over the San Fernando Valley...

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is magnificent, you mean that you think they are extremely good, beautiful, or impressive.

ext.ext_cn: 他们见利忘义地试图以减少屠杀海豚数量作为交换条件，重启商业捕鲸。
ext.ext_en: They cynically tried to trade off a reduction in the slaughter of dolphins against a resumption of commercial whaling...

ext.ext_cn: 有可能以情报换取减刑。
ext.ext_en: There is a possibility of being able to trade off information for a reduced sentence.

defs.def_en: See also:trade-off;If you trade off one thing against another, you exchange all or part of one thing for another, as part of a negotiation or compromise.

ext.ext_cn: 他们将能利用自己的外表，并且单靠这一点就可以。
ext.ext_en: They would be able to trade off their looks and manage on that alone.

defs.def_en: If someone trades off something, they make use of it for their own advantage, often in an unfair way.
On an aircraft carrier, the flight deck is the flat open surface on the deck where aircraft take off and land.
On a large aeroplane, the flight deck is the area at the front where the pilot works and where all the controls are.
A headmaster is a man who is the head teacher of a school.
A big dipper is a fairground ride that carries people up and down steep slopes on a narrow railway at high speed.
A mucous membrane is skin that produces mucus to prevent itself from becoming dry. It covers delicate parts of the body such as the inside of your nose.

ext.ext_cn: 淡黄色连衣裙
ext.ext_en: ...a canary yellow dress.

defs.def_en: Something that is canary yellow is a light yellow in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 一大片广阔的土地可待开发。
ext.ext_en: A vast tract of land is ready for development...

ext.ext_cn: 他们清除了大片的森林以经营农耕、采伐与畜牧。
ext.ext_en: They cleared large tracts of forest for farming, logging and ranching.

defs.def_en: A tract of land is a very large area of land.

ext.ext_cn: 她 1930 年写了篇女性主义的短文《论节育》。
ext.ext_en: She produced a feminist tract, 'Comments on Birth-Control', in 1930.

defs.def_en: A tract is a short article expressing a strong opinion on a religious, moral, or political subject in order to try to influence people's attitudes.

ext.ext_cn: 食物在消化道里分解。
ext.ext_en: Foods are broken down in the digestive tract...

ext.ext_cn: 感冒是上呼吸道的感染。
ext.ext_en: A cold is an infection of the upper respiratory tract.

defs.def_en: A tract is a system of organs and tubes in an animal's or person's body that has a particular function, especially the function of processing a substance in the body.
A Dumpster is a large metal container for holding rubbish.

ext.ext_cn: 那时候，只有非常富有的家庭才有自己的浴缸。
ext.ext_en: In those days, only quite wealthy families had baths of their own.

defs.def_en: A bath is a container, usually a long rectangular one, which you fill with water and sit in while you wash your body.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你每天早上泡澡
ext.ext_en: ...if you have a bath every morning...

ext.ext_cn: 洗淋浴吧，别用浴缸了。
ext.ext_en: Take a shower instead of a bath.

defs.def_en: When you have or take a bath, or when you are in the bath, you sit or lie in a bath filled with water in order to wash your body.

ext.ext_cn: 不用每天给孩子洗澡。
ext.ext_en: Don't feel you have to bath your child every day.

ext.ext_cn: 助产士给他洗了个热水澡。
ext.ext_en: The midwife gave him a warm bath.

defs.def_en: If you bath someone, especially a child, you wash them in a bath.

ext.ext_cn: 这三个小孩用同一盆水洗澡。
ext.ext_en: The three children all bath in the same bath water.

defs.def_en: When you bath, you have a bath.

defs.def_cn: 澡堂；（附带泳池的）公共浴室

ext.ext_cn: 在这座被毁坏的城市里，最重要的建筑物之一就是公共澡堂。
ext.ext_en: One of the most important buildings in this ruined city is a public bath...

ext.ext_cn: 除了罗马式圆形剧场和公共浴池，这个镇上还有两座非常好的博物馆。
ext.ext_en: As well as a Roman amphitheatre and baths, the town has two superb museums.

defs.def_en: A bath or a baths is a public building containing a swimming pool, and sometimes other facilities that people can use to have a wash or a bath.

ext.ext_cn: 放在定影液中冲洗的照片
ext.ext_en: ...a developing photograph placed in a bath of fixer.

defs.def_en: A bath is a container filled with a particular liquid, such as a dye or an acid, in which particular objects are placed, usually as part of a manufacturing or chemical process.

ext.ext_cn: 锻炼不仅会降低血压，而且可能对心脏病有预防效果。
ext.ext_en: Exercise will not only lower blood pressure but possibly protect against heart attacks...

ext.ext_cn: 他们衣着时尚，但很休闲，也许是学生。
ext.ext_en: They were smartly but casually dressed; possibly students...

defs.def_en: You use possibly to indicate that you are not sure whether something is true or might happen.

defs.def_cn: （表示对所见或所闻感到惊讶、困惑或震惊）

ext.ext_cn: 这条新闻最出人意料了，真是让人想象不到。
ext.ext_en: It was the most unexpected piece of news one could possibly imagine...

ext.ext_cn: 我的意思是，他们怎么可能吃那东西呢？
ext.ext_en: I mean, how could they possibly eat that stuff?...

defs.def_en: You use possibly to emphasize that you are surprised, puzzled, or shocked by something that you have seen or heard.

ext.ext_cn: 凡是能想到的，他们都去做了。
ext.ext_en: They've done everything they can possibly think of...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一种极其美妙的感觉。
ext.ext_en: It's one of the nicest feelings you can possibly have.

defs.def_en: You use possibly to emphasize that someone has tried their hardest to do something, or has done it as well as they can.

ext.ext_cn: 不，我无论如何也回答不了那个问题。
ext.ext_en: No I really can't possibly answer that!

ext.ext_cn: 他们除此之外啥也做不了。
ext.ext_en: There's nothing more they can possibly do right...

defs.def_en: You use possibly to emphasize that something definitely cannot happen or definitely cannot be done.

ext.ext_cn: 他封住信封并贴上一张邮票。
ext.ext_en: He sealed the envelope and put on a stamp...

ext.ext_cn: 信写好后把它装进空白信封里封好。
ext.ext_en: Write your letter and seal it in a blank envelope...

defs.def_en: When you seal an envelope, you close it by folding part of it over and sticking it down, so that it cannot be opened without being torn.

defs.def_cn: 封住(容器、开口);把…密封(进容器)

ext.ext_cn: 她只是装满容器，用软木塞封住，然后贴上标签。
ext.ext_en: She merely filled the containers, sealed them with a cork, and pasted on labels...

ext.ext_cn: 一个女人把它们捡起来放入几只密封的塑料袋中。
ext.ext_en: A woman picks them up and seals them in plastic bags.

defs.def_en: If you seal a container or an opening, you cover it with something in order to prevent air, liquid, or other material getting in or out. If you seal something in a container, you put it inside and then close the container tightly.

ext.ext_cn: 在包馅饼时，先把两片馅饼皮边沿接头部分弄湿，再将其捏合。
ext.ext_en: When assembling the pie, wet the edges where the two crusts join, to form a seal.

defs.def_en: The seal on a container or opening is the part where it has been sealed.

ext.ext_cn: 定期检查冰箱和冷冻柜的密封装置。
ext.ext_en: Check seals on fridges and freezers regularly.

defs.def_en: A seal is a device or a piece of material, for example in a machine, which closes an opening tightly so that air, liquid, or other substances cannot get in or out.

ext.ext_cn: 盒子从隐藏处掉落时，封口裂开了。
ext.ext_en: The seal on the box broke when it fell from its hiding-place...

ext.ext_cn: 抗议者们猛砸卡车的侧面，并且撕掉了车门上的海关封条。
ext.ext_en: Protestors banged on the sides of the lorry and broke customs seals on the doors.

defs.def_en: A seal is something such as a piece of sticky paper or wax that is fixed to a container or door and must be broken before the container or door can be opened.

ext.ext_cn: 一批盖有总统印章的便条纸
ext.ext_en: ...a supply of note paper bearing the Presidential seal...

ext.ext_cn: 上等葡萄酒可以盖上带编号的优质产品印章。
ext.ext_en: The best wines are entitled to a numbered seal of quality.

defs.def_en: A seal is a special mark or design, for example on a document, representing someone or something. It may be used to show that something is genuine or officially approved.

ext.ext_cn: 部署士兵协助准军事警察封锁边境。
ext.ext_en: The soldiers were deployed to help paramilitary police seal the border...

ext.ext_cn: 那个两层建筑周围的大片区域被封锁，只有提供应急服务的车辆可以通行。
ext.ext_en: A wide area round the two-storey building is sealed to all traffic except the emergency services.

defs.def_en: If someone in authority seals an area, they stop people entering or passing through it, for example by placing barriers in the way.

ext.ext_cn: 麦克拉伦即将与雷诺达成一笔交易。
ext.ext_en: McLaren are close to sealing a deal with Renault...

ext.ext_cn: 一场决定他命运的大选即将举行。
ext.ext_en: A General Election will be held which will seal his destiny one way or the other...

defs.def_en: To seal something means to make it definite or confirm how it is going to be.

ext.ext_cn: 这样的一次访问可能会使两国政府间确立新关系。
ext.ext_en: Such a visit may set the seal on a new relationship between the two governments...

ext.ext_cn: 他们把这次选举看作是彻底击败共产主义的一次机会。
ext.ext_en: They see this election as a chance to put the final seal on the defeat of communism.

defs.def_en: If something sets or puts the seal on something, it makes it definite or confirms how it is going to be.

defs.def_cn: 盖上印信的;不能拆开看的;保密的

ext.ext_cn: 副本仍未公开，按照法律规定我不能讨论这项证据。
ext.ext_en: Because the transcript is still under seal, I am precluded by law from discussing the evidence.

defs.def_en: If a document is under seal, it is in a sealed envelope and cannot be looked at, for example because it is private.
A seal is a large animal with a rounded body and flat legs called flippers. Seals eat fish and live in and near the sea, usually in cold parts of the world.

defs.def_cn: 才开始的;刚起步的;未发展的

ext.ext_cn: 他的梦想根本行不通,很不成熟。
ext.ext_en: His dreams were senseless and inchoate.

ext.ext_cn: 对所有政客都心存不满的幼稚心态
ext.ext_en: ...the inchoate mood of dissatisfaction with all politicians.

defs.def_en: If something is inchoate, it is recent or new, and vague or not yet properly developed.

defs.def_cn: （与过去分词连用）表示“手工的”

ext.ext_cn: 手工制作的首饰
ext.ext_en: ...handcrafted jewelry.

ext.ext_cn: 手工制造的轿车
ext.ext_en: ...handbuilt cars.

defs.def_en: Hand- combines with past participles to indicate that something has been made by someone using their hands or using tools rather than by machines.

ext.ext_cn: 很多答案都不准确,为此他感到很烦恼。
ext.ext_en: He was disturbed by the inaccuracy of the answers...

ext.ext_cn: 记者试图通过多方求证来避免不实报道。

defs.def_en: A weedy place is full of weeds.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as weedy, you are criticizing them because they are thin and physically weak.

defs.def_cn: 上流社会人士；绅士阶层；贵族阶层

An escapologist is someone who entertains audiences by being tied up and placed in a dangerous situation, then escaping from it.

ext.ext_en: 'Loop' is one of those computer words that has gained currency in society.

defs.def_en: If a custom, idea, or word has currency, it is used and accepted by a lot of people at a particular time.

defs.def_cn: 生物的；与生命过程有关的

ext.ext_en: The living organisms somehow concentrated the minerals by biological processes...

ext.ext_en: This is a natural biological response.

defs.def_en: Biological is used to describe processes and states that occur in the bodies and cells of living things.

ext.ext_cn: 与麻风病相关的生物学研究的各个方面
ext.ext_en: ...all aspects of biological research associated with leprosy.

ext.ext_cn: 这所大学的生命科学学院
ext.ext_en: ...the university's school of biological sciences.

defs.def_en: Biological is used to describe activities concerned with the study of living things.

defs.def_cn: （武器、战争）生物性的，使用细菌的

ext.ext_cn: 这样的战争可能导致使用生化武器。
ext.ext_en: Such a war could result in the use of chemical and biological weapons.

defs.def_en: Biological weapons and biological warfare involve the use of bacteria or other living organisms in order to attack human beings, animals, or plants.

ext.ext_cn: 农业虫害生物防治顾问吉姆·利钦格
ext.ext_en: ...Jim Litsinger, a consultant on biological control of agricultural pests.

defs.def_en: A child's biological parents are the man and woman who caused him or her to be born, rather than other adults who look after him or her.
A biological washing powder contains substances called enzymes which dissolve dirt.

defs.def_cn: 存托养老金计划(英国的一种低管理费用的养老金)

ext.ext_en: New stakeholder pensions will aim to give all workers a retirement pension they can live on.

defs.def_en: In Britain, a stakeholder pension is a flexible pension scheme with low charges. Both employees and the state contribute to the scheme, which is optional, and is in addition to the basic state pension.

ext.ext_cn: 她年龄与我相仿，头发较长。
ext.ext_en: She's about my age, with longish hair.

ext.ext_en: There has been a retrogression in the field of human rights since 1975.

defs.def_en: Retrogression means moving back to an earlier and less efficient stage of development.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为应该实施种族隔离。
ext.ext_en: He believes in the separation of the races.

ext.ext_cn: 政教彻底分离的“基督教共和国”
ext.ext_en: ...a 'Christian republic' in which there was a clear separation between church and state.

defs.def_en: The separation of two or more things or groups is the fact that they are separate or become separate, and are not linked.

ext.ext_en: She wondered if Harry had been unfaithful to her during this long separation...

ext.ext_en: All children will tend to suffer from separation from their parents and siblings.

ext.ext_en: ...loss of a loved one through death, separation or divorce.

ext.ext_en: They are saying, with varying degrees of absolutism, that animals should not be exploited at all.

ext.ext_en: ...a radical Afrikaans newspaper.

defs.def_en: A rain check is a free ticket that is given to people when an outdoor game or event is stopped because of rain or bad weather, so that they can go to it when it is held again.

ext.ext_en: By his own statement, there have been imperfections in his judgment.

ext.ext_en: ...imperfections in the cloth.

defs.def_en: An imperfection in something is a small mark or damaged area which may spoil its appearance.

ext.ext_en: ...the problems of further miniaturizing the available technologies.

ext.ext_en: ...miniaturized amplifiers and receivers.

defs.def_en: If you miniaturize something such as a machine, you produce a very small version of it.

ext.ext_en: He was a vociferous opponent of Conservatism...

ext.ext_cn: 他越来越大声地表达对她行为的厌恶。
ext.ext_en: His resentment of her behaviour was becoming more vociferous.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as vociferous, you mean that they speak with great energy and determination, because they want their views to be heard.

ext.ext_en: Here the army has its ranges where Rapier missiles and other weaponry are tested...

defs.def_en: When you test something, you try it, for example by touching it or using it for a short time, in order to find out what it is, what condition it is in, or how well it works.

ext.ext_cn: 禁止核试验
ext.ext_en: ...the banning of nuclear tests.

defs.def_en: A test is a deliberate action or experiment to find out how well something works.

ext.ext_cn: 曾经，每个老师每周都有一天花上一小时对学生的每门功课进行测试。
ext.ext_en: There was a time when each teacher spent an hour, one day a week, testing pupils in every subject...

ext.ext_cn: 所有 2,602 名学生中，只有 922 名通过了测试。
ext.ext_en: Out of a total of 2,602 pupils only 922 passed the test...

ext.ext_cn: 她卖了自行车，考了驾照，并买了辆汽车。
ext.ext_en: She had sold her bike, taken a driving test and bought a car.

defs.def_en: A test is a series of questions that you must answer or actions that you must perform in order to show how much you know about a subject or how well you are able to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 她可能在试探她妈妈，看她能忍耐到什么程度才会把她撵出家门。
ext.ext_en: She may be testing her mother to see how much she can take before she throws her out.

ext.ext_en: It is a commonplace fact that holidays are a major test of any relationship...

ext.ext_en: The test of any civilised society is how it treats its minorities.

ext.ext_en: If necessary X-rays and blood tests will also be used to aid diagnosis...

ext.ext_cn: 到了火车站，为了检验自己对当地的了解程度，我请教了一个出租车司机。
ext.ext_en: Arriving at the railway station, I put local knowledge to the test and ask a taxi driver.

defs.def_en: If you put something to the test, you find out how useful or effective it is by using it.

ext.ext_en: Sooner or later, life will put the relationship to the test.

defs.def_en: If new circumstances or events put something to the test, they put a strain on it and indicate how strong or stable it really is.

ext.ext_cn: 她的许多食谱经受住了时间的考验，这充分证明了她的厨艺。
ext.ext_en: It says a lot for her culinary skills that so many of her recipes have stood the test of time.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will stand the test of time, you mean that it is strong or effective enough to last for a very long time.

defs.def_cn: 进屋撞见（别人在做私密的事）

ext.ext_cn: 他妻子进屋撞见他与别人上床。
ext.ext_en: His wife walked in on him making love.

defs.def_en: If you walk in on someone, you enter the room that they are in while they are doing something private, and this creates an embarrassing situation.

defs.def_cn: （尤指通过抓住或绑住双臂）使动弹不得

ext.ext_cn: 次日上午9点，本特里被捆住双臂、戴上头罩，然后绞死了。
ext.ext_en: At nine the next morning Bentley was pinioned, hooded and hanged.

defs.def_en: If you are pinioned, someone prevents you from moving or escaping, especially by holding or tying your arms.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 费时的;费力的;劳神的;要求很高的

ext.ext_en: He found he could no longer cope with his demanding job...

ext.ext_cn: 那是一个要求很高的角色，她必须要加倍努力。
ext.ext_en: It is a demanding role and she needs to work hard at it.

defs.def_en: A demanding job or task requires a lot of your time, energy, or attention.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难伺候的;难取悦的;挑剔的;苛刻的

ext.ext_cn: 里基是个非常难伺候的孩子。
ext.ext_en: Ricky was a very demanding child...

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯蒂娜的老板非常苛刻，但同时也很欣赏她的才华。
ext.ext_en: Her boss was very demanding but appreciative of Christina's talents.

defs.def_en: People who are demanding are not easily satisfied or pleased.

defs.def_cn: 非凡的成功;杰出的成就

ext.ext_cn: 事实证明，在这次锦标赛中教练戴夫·多诺万取得了非凡的个人成就。
ext.ext_en: The championships proved to be a personal triumph for the coach, Dave Donovan...

ext.ext_cn: 成功率达到 90% 以上的白内障手术是现代外科学的杰出成果。
ext.ext_en: Cataract operations are a triumph of modern surgery, with a success rate of more than 90 percent...

defs.def_en: A triumph is a great success or achievement, often one that has been gained with a lot of skill or effort.

defs.def_cn: (成功或获胜时的)极大的满足，狂喜，骄傲

ext.ext_cn: 她只感受了片刻成功的喜悦。
ext.ext_en: Her sense of triumph was short-lived...

ext.ext_cn: 他发出胜利的大笑。
ext.ext_en: He was laughing with triumph.

defs.def_en: Triumph is a feeling of great satisfaction and pride resulting from a success or victory.

ext.ext_cn: 凯莉一生经历了各种艰巨的任务与挑战，她都一一成功应对了。
ext.ext_en: All her life, Kelly had stuck with difficult tasks and challenges, and triumphed...

ext.ext_cn: 全世界都把她视为正义战胜邪恶的象征。
ext.ext_en: The whole world looked to her as a symbol of good triumphing over evil.

defs.def_en: If someone or something triumphs, they gain complete success, control, or victory, often after a long or difficult struggle.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 骚乱爆发时，我们周围充斥着尖厉的哭喊声和难以入耳的咒骂声。
ext.ext_en: Shrill cries and startled oaths flew up around us as pandemonium broke out...

ext.ext_cn: 引擎刺耳的呼啸声
ext.ext_en: ...the shrill whistle of the engine...

defs.def_en: A shrill sound is high-pitched and unpleasant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (要求、抗议、声明等)尖刻的，强硬的，不依不饶的

ext.ext_cn: 大西洋两岸都在大肆鼓吹贸易保护主义。
ext.ext_en: Shrill voices on both sides of the Atlantic are advocating protectionism.

defs.def_en: If you describe a demand, protest, or statement as shrill, you disapprove of it and do not like the strong, forceful way it is said.

defs.def_cn: (铃、哨)发出尖锐的声音，发出刺耳的声音

ext.ext_cn: 电话铃声刺耳地响起，惊得她跳了起来。
ext.ext_en: The phone shrilled, making her jump.

defs.def_en: If a bell or whistle shrills, it makes a loud, high-pitched sound.

ext.ext_cn: “不，不，不，”她尖叫道。
ext.ext_en: 'No, no, no,' she shrilled.

defs.def_en: If someone with a high-pitched voice shrills something, they say it loudly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 社会地位低下的;生活条件差的;贫困的

ext.ext_cn: 贫困儿童的教育问题
ext.ext_en: ...the educational problems of disadvantaged  children...

ext.ext_cn: 该中心旨在帮助欧洲的贫困地区，方法主要是通过扶持新型商业。
ext.ext_en: The centre aims to help disadvantaged  areas of Europe, mainly by fostering new businesses.

defs.def_en: People who are disadvantaged  or live in disadvantaged areas live in bad conditions and tend not to get a good education or have a reasonable standard of living.

ext.ext_cn: 凝滞的空气中隐隐有股家具上光剂的味道。
ext.ext_en: The still air smelt faintly of furniture polish.

ext.ext_cn: 肥皂粉、洗涤剂和擦亮剂
ext.ext_en: ...soap powders, detergents, and polishes.

defs.def_en: Polish is a substance that you put on the surface of an object in order to clean it, protect it, and make it shine.

ext.ext_cn: 他每天早晨都刮脸、擦鞋。
ext.ext_en: Each morning he shaved and polished his shoes...

ext.ext_cn: 他摘下眼镜，开始用手帕擦拭。
ext.ext_en: He removed his glasses and began polishing them with his handkerchief.

defs.def_en: If you polish something, you put polish on it or rub it with a cloth to make it shine.
If you say that someone has polish, you mean that they show confidence and know how to behave socially.

ext.ext_cn: 这部歌剧不及他晚期作品娴熟。
ext.ext_en: The opera lacks the polish of his later work.

defs.def_en: If you say that a performance or piece of work has polish, you mean that it is of a very high standard.

ext.ext_cn: 他们只是需要改进一下技巧。
ext.ext_en: They just need to polish their technique.

ext.ext_cn: 上为期一周的专业课，提高你的写作技能。
ext.ext_en: Polish up your writing skills on a one-week professional course.

defs.def_en: If you polish your technique, performance, or skill at doing something, you work on improving it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不会以民用设施为打击目标。
ext.ext_en: We're not going after civilian targets.

defs.def_en: If you go after something, you try to get it, catch it, or hit it.

ext.ext_cn: 探警费力地辨认出这些文字。
ext.ext_en: The detective-constable picked out the words with difficulty...

ext.ext_cn: 史蒂文形容自己是“一个普通人——放在人群中就找不出来的普通人”。
ext.ext_en: Steven describes himself as 'a regular guy — you couldn't pick me out of a crowd'.

defs.def_en: If you pick out someone or something, you recognize them when it is difficult to see them, for example because they are among a large group.

ext.ext_cn: 我将特别选出3部新剧。
ext.ext_en: I will pick out three new plays particularly...

ext.ext_cn: 我被选出来代表全队。
ext.ext_en: I have been picked out to represent the whole team...

defs.def_en: If you pick out someone or something, you choose them from a group of people or things.

ext.ext_cn: 店面上方的招牌醒目地刷成了金色大字。
ext.ext_en: The name is picked out in gold letters over the shop-front.

defs.def_en: If part of something is picked out in a particular colour, it is painted in that colour so that it can be seen clearly beside the other parts.

defs.def_cn: (尤指婴儿的)腹绞痛，急性腹痛

ext.ext_cn: 医生说她患的是腹绞痛，长大了就没事了。
ext.ext_en: The doctor said it was colic and that she would grow out of it.

defs.def_en: Colic is an illness in which you get severe pains in your stomach and bowels. Babies especially suffer from colic.

ext.ext_cn: 任何乳制品都会让他呕吐。
ext.ext_en: Any product made from cow's  milk made him vomit...

ext.ext_cn: 她临死前几天开始吐血。
ext.ext_en: She began to vomit blood a few days before she died...

defs.def_en: If you vomit, food and drink comes back up from your stomach and out through your mouth.
Vomit is partly digested food and drink that has come back up from someone's stomach and out through their mouth.
Your diaphragm is a muscle between your lungs and your stomach. It is used when you breathe.
A diaphragm is a circular rubber contraceptive device that a woman places inside her vagina.

ext.ext_cn: 佩带弓箭和长矛的武士闯入了他们的村庄。
ext.ext_en: Warriors armed with bows and arrows and spears have invaded their villages.

defs.def_en: An arrow is a long thin weapon which is sharp and pointed at one end and which often has feathers at the other end. An arrow is shot from a bow.

defs.def_cn: 箭头（用来指示方向，符号为→）

ext.ext_cn: 一连串的箭头指示着通往安德烈·萨哈罗夫的朴素的墓地的路。
ext.ext_en: A series of arrows points the way to the modest grave of Andrei Sakharov.

defs.def_en: An arrow is a written or printed sign that consists of a straight line with another line bent at a sharp angle at one end. This is a printed arrow: →. The arrow points in a particular direction to indicate where something is.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 为了加强幸福家庭的观念而举行的例行家庭聚会
ext.ext_en: ...ritualized family gatherings intended to promote the myth of the happy family.

ext.ext_cn: 高度程式化的求偶炫耀行为
ext.ext_en: ...highly ritualised courtship displays.

defs.def_en: Ritualized acts are carried out in a fixed, structured way rather than being natural.

ext.ext_cn: 在发电厂里，热能将水转化成高压蒸汽。
ext.ext_en: In an electric power plant the heat converts water into high-pressure steam.

ext.ext_cn: 蒸汽发动机的发明
ext.ext_en: ...the invention of the steam engine.

defs.def_en: Steam is the hot mist that forms when water boils. Steam vehicles and machines are operated using steam as a means of power.

ext.ext_cn: 咖啡壶在炉子上冒着热气的餐馆
ext.ext_en: ...restaurants where coffee pots steamed on their burners.

ext.ext_cn: 一篮子热腾腾的面包卷
ext.ext_en: ...a basket of steaming bread rolls.

defs.def_en: If something steams, it gives off steam.

ext.ext_en: Steam the carrots until they are just beginning to be tender...

ext.ext_en: Leave the vegetables to steam over the rice for the 20 minutes cooking time.

defs.def_en: If you steam food or if it steams, you cook it in steam rather than in water.  →see usage note at:cook

ext.ext_cn: 政府下决心要全力实施私有化计划。
ext.ext_en: The Government was determined to go full steam ahead with its privatisation programme...

ext.ext_en: Plans are rolling full steam ahead for the Jamaica Festival.

defs.def_en: If something such as a plan or a project goes full steam ahead, it progresses quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 经常运动有助于摆脱多余的压力，也是放松或宣泄情感的好办法。
ext.ext_en: Regular exercise helps to combat unwanted stress and is a good way of relaxing or letting off steam.

defs.def_en: If you let off steam, you get rid of your energy, anger, or strong emotions with physical activity or by behaving in a noisy or violent way.

defs.def_cn: (信念、计划、项目等)变得越来越重要，开始发展壮大

ext.ext_en: Just as the presidential campaign was picking up steam, riots exploded in Los Angeles.

defs.def_en: If a belief, a plan, or a project picks up steam, it starts to develop and become more important.

ext.ext_en: Patients who are well enough to turn up under their own steam are well enough to wait to be seen by a doctor.

defs.def_en: If you do something under your own steam, you do it without any help from anyone else.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第2个字母

defs.def_en: In music, B is the seventh note in the scale of C major.
If you get a B as a mark for a piece of work or in an exam, your work is good.

defs.def_cn: （用于首字母为b的一些单词的缩写，如born）
defs.def_en: B or b is used as an abbreviation for words beginning with b, for example 'born'.

defs.def_cn: 父母的；父的；母的；家长的

ext.ext_en: The water is very deep and mysterious-looking...

ext.ext_en: Den had dug a deep hole in the centre of the garden...

defs.def_en: If something is deep, it extends a long way down from the ground or from the top surface of something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个衣柜很深。
ext.ext_en: The wardrobe was very deep.

defs.def_en: A deep container, such as a cupboard, extends or measures a long distance from front to back.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我发现脚下的水只有 3 英尺深。
ext.ext_en: I found myself in water only three feet deep...

ext.ext_cn: 舒什广场周围的泥水深及脚踝。
ext.ext_en: The mud is ankle deep around Shush Square...

defs.def_en: You use deep to talk or ask about how much something measures from the surface to the bottom, or from front to back.

ext.ext_cn: 他们现在已深入叛军占领区。
ext.ext_en: They were now deep inside rebel territory.

ext.ext_cn: 深入该国的腹地
ext.ext_en: ...deep inside the country...

defs.def_en: Deep in an area means a long way inside it

ext.ext_cn: 史蒂夫·斯汤顿的纵深横传
ext.ext_en: ...Steve Staunton's deep cross.

ext.ext_cn: 凌空远射
ext.ext_en: ...a deep volley.

defs.def_en: In sports such as football and tennis, a deep shot or pass is one that sends the ball a long way towards the end of the pitch or court.

ext.ext_cn: 里里外外三层的人群看到显示屏上的画面似乎全都惊呆了。
ext.ext_en: A crowd three deep seemed paralysed by the images on these monitors...

ext.ext_cn: 其余的空间都被纸板盒子占据了，一直摞到天花板，足有 10 层高。
ext.ext_en: The rest of the space was taken up by cardboard boxes piled right to the ceiling, ten deep.

defs.def_en: If you say that things or people are two ,three, or four deep, you mean that there are two, three, or four rows or layers of them there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 严重的;深切的;深厚的;深深的

ext.ext_cn: 我对萨特怀有深深的敬意。
ext.ext_en: I had a deep admiration for Sartre...

ext.ext_cn: 经历严重个人危机的一段时期
ext.ext_en: ...a period of deep personal crisis...

defs.def_en: You use deep to emphasize the seriousness, strength, importance, or degree of something.

ext.ext_en: I kept reassuring them but deep in my heart I knew we had no hope...

ext.ext_cn: 在心底里，她支持丈夫参加这个组织。
ext.ext_en: Deep down, she supported her husband's involvement in the organization.

defs.def_en: If you experience or feel something deep inside you or deep down, you feel it very strongly even though you do not necessarily show it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Una soon fell into a deep sleep.

defs.def_en: If you are in a deep sleep, you are sleeping peacefully and it is difficult to wake you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Abby had been so deep in thought that she had walked past her aunt's car without even seeing it...

ext.ext_en: Before long, we were deep in conversation.

defs.def_en: If you are deep in thought or deep in conversation, you are concentrating very hard on what you are thinking or saying and are not aware of the things that are happening around you.

ext.ext_cn: 彼得深邃的目光长久地注视着他。
ext.ext_en: Peter gave him a long deep look.

ext.ext_cn: 他停了停，深深地注视着玛丽的眼睛。
ext.ext_en: He paused, staring deep into Mary's eyes.

defs.def_en: A deep look seems to see right into your mind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: A deep sound is low in pitch.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: James is a very deep individual...

ext.ext_en: That expressionless face had seemed deep and mysterious.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as deep, you mean that they are quiet and reserved in a way that makes you think that they have good qualities such as intelligence or determination.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (问题、文章等)重要的，严肃的，深刻的

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个非常严肃的问题。
ext.ext_en: This is a very deep question...

ext.ext_en: He is so deep in debt and desperate for money that he's apparently willing to say anything...
