defs.def_en: If you are deep in debt, you have a lot of debts.

ext.ext_cn: 一个面积巨大、人迹罕至的水池，鲸和其他海洋动物穿游其间
ext.ext_en: ...a vast unfrequented pool, traversed by whales and creatures of the deep.

defs.def_en: The deep means the sea.

defs.def_cn: 在内心深处，在心底（知道）

ext.ext_cn: 在内心深处，我们知道自己能够做到。
ext.ext_en: We knew deep down that we could do it...

ext.ext_cn: 我们在心底里一直都讨厌彼此。
ext.ext_en: Deep down, we had always detested each other.

defs.def_en: If you know something deep down or deep down inside, you know that it is true, but you are not always conscious of it or willing to admit it to yourself.

defs.def_cn: 深吸一口气(以使自己坚强自信)

ext.ext_cn: 我深吸一口气，然后走了进去。
ext.ext_en: I took a deep breath and went in.

defs.def_en: If you say that you took a deep breath before doing something dangerous or frightening, you mean that you tried to make yourself feel strong and confident.

defs.def_cn: 非常严重;极为强烈;根深蒂固

ext.ext_cn: 他的愤怒和痛苦显然是深切而强烈的。
ext.ext_en: His anger and anguish clearly went deep...

ext.ext_cn: 问题不仅仅是起始阶段的小麻烦那么简单。
ext.ext_en: The problems went deeper than mere teething difficulties.

defs.def_en: If you say that something goes deep or runs deep, you mean that it is very serious or strong and is hard to change.

ext.ext_cn: 他们听见门外的大厅里有脚步声。
ext.ext_en: They heard footsteps in the main room, beyond a door...

ext.ext_cn: 他右边是一个生机勃勃的菜园，菜园的另一边是一个小小的苹果园。
ext.ext_en: On his right was a thriving vegetable garden and beyond it a small orchard of apple trees.

defs.def_en: If something is beyond a place or barrier, it is on the other side of it.

defs.def_cn: 超过，迟于（某个时间）；逾（期）

ext.ext_cn: 很少有职业赛马骑师超过40岁仍继续参加赛马的。
ext.ext_en: Few jockeys continue race-riding beyond the age of 40...

ext.ext_cn: 如果小孩接受全日制教育的时间超过了您已告知我们的那个期限，您就有权申请儿童补助金。
ext.ext_en: You may be entitled to Child Benefit if a child continues getting full-time education beyond the date already notified by you.

defs.def_en: If something happens beyond a particular time or date, it continues after that time or date has passed.

ext.ext_cn: 他兴趣广泛，涵盖了从美术到国际政治乃至哲学的各个领域。
ext.ext_en: His interests extended beyond the fine arts to international politics and philosophy.

defs.def_en: If something extends beyond a particular thing, it affects or includes other things.

ext.ext_cn: 除了一个不会冲咖啡的秘书之外，他好像几乎没有什么随身的工作人员。
ext.ext_en: He appears to have almost no personal staff, beyond a secretary who can't make coffee...

ext.ext_cn: 除了一些零星的情况外，我什么也不知道。
ext.ext_en: I knew nothing beyond a few random facts.

defs.def_en: You use beyond to introduce an exception to what you are saying.

defs.def_cn: 超出，超过（某个点或阶段）

ext.ext_cn: 他们五年的关系已经紧张到无法维系。
ext.ext_en: Their five-year relationship was strained beyond breaking point...

ext.ext_cn: 在我看来，他不关心别人做什么。
ext.ext_en: It seems to me he's  beyond caring about what anybody does.

defs.def_en: If something goes beyond a particular point or stage, it progresses or increases so that it passes that point or stage.

ext.ext_cn: 我无法理解乔克的所作所为。
ext.ext_en: What Jock had done was beyond my comprehension...

ext.ext_cn: 瑞典的夏天非常宜人——冬天却冷得让人难以置信。
ext.ext_en: Sweden is lovely in summer — cold beyond belief in winter...

defs.def_en: If something is, for example, beyond understanding or beyond belief, it is so extreme in some way that it cannot be understood or believed.

defs.def_cn: 非…能力所及；超出…的能力

ext.ext_cn: 虽然他可以对她表示同情，但是他几乎根本无法提供任何实际的帮助。
ext.ext_en: Although he could give her sympathy, any practical help would almost certainly be beyond him...

ext.ext_cn: 局势并非她能控制。
ext.ext_en: The situation was beyond her control.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is beyond someone, you mean that they cannot deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 初夏时节，它开出了一簇簇淡紫色的花。
ext.ext_en: It bears clusters of mauve flowers in early summer.

defs.def_en: Something that is mauve is of a pale purple colour.

ext.ext_cn: 天哪，快看，安妮。
ext.ext_en: Cor, look, Annie.

defs.def_en: You can say cor when you are surprised or impressed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 夸张的卡巴莱时俗讽刺喜剧
ext.ext_en: ...an OTT comedy cabaret revue...

ext.ext_cn: 有些设计含蓄精妙，有些夸张绚丽。
ext.ext_en: Some of the designs are subtle, some gloriously OTT.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as OTT, you mean that it is exaggerated and extreme. OTT is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'over the top'.

defs.def_cn: 可供选择的；可供替代的

ext.ext_cn: 关节炎的新疗法可能是止痛药之外的另一种选择。
ext.ext_en: New ways to treat arthritis may provide an alternative to painkillers.

defs.def_en: If one thing is an alternative to another, the first can be found, used, or done instead of the second.

ext.ext_cn: 还有其他可选的旅行方式。
ext.ext_en: There were alternative methods of travel available...

ext.ext_cn: 他们有权另谋高就。
ext.ext_en: They had a right to seek alternative employment.

defs.def_en: An alternative plan or offer is different from the one that you already have, and can be done or used instead.

ext.ext_cn: 欣然接受60年代另类生活模式而不因循守旧的父母
ext.ext_en: ...unconventional parents who embraced the alternative lifestyle of the Sixties...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你喜欢另类喜剧的话，你就会喜欢这本书。
ext.ext_en: If you like alternative comedy you'll love this book.

defs.def_en: Alternative is used to describe something that is different from the usual things of its kind, or the usual ways of doing something, in modern Western society. For example, an alternative lifestyle does not follow conventional ways of living and working.

defs.def_cn: （医疗）传统的，替代的（如提取植物成分制成药物、按摩和针灸）

ext.ext_cn: 传统的医疗保健
ext.ext_en: ...alternative health care.

defs.def_en: Alternative medicine uses traditional ways of curing people, such as medicines made from plants, massage, and acupuncture.
Alternative energy uses natural sources of energy such as the sun, wind, or water for power and fuel, rather than oil, coal, or nuclear power.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 刚开始一项锻炼计划时循序渐进总是明智的。
ext.ext_en: It is always prudent to start any exercise programme gradually at first...

ext.ext_cn: 慎重小心的人都会意识到这个问题非解决不可。
ext.ext_en: Being a prudent and cautious person, you realise that the problem must be resolved.

defs.def_en: Someone who is prudent is sensible and careful.

defs.def_cn: (have 和 has 与过去分词连用构成动词的现在完成时)

ext.ext_cn: 亚历克斯已经走了。
ext.ext_en: Alex has already gone...

ext.ext_cn: 我刚看了一场话剧，我强烈推荐。
ext.ext_en: I've just seen a play that I can highly recommend...

defs.def_en: You use the forms have and has with a past participle to form the present perfect tense of verbs.

defs.def_cn: (had 与过去分词连用构成动词的过去完成时)

ext.ext_cn: 我遇见她时，她刚参加完一场求职面试回来。
ext.ext_en: When I met her, she had just returned from a job interview...

ext.ext_cn: 直到周五下午5点半，我仍未收到伦德的消息。
ext.ext_en: By Friday at 5:30 p.m., I still hadn't heard from Lund...

defs.def_en: You use the form had with a past participle to form the past perfect tense of verbs.

ext.ext_cn: 你还没有把她送走，是吗？
ext.ext_en: You haven't sent her away, have you?...

ext.ext_cn: 这事儿已经发生了，是吗？
ext.ext_en: It's happened, hasn't it?...

defs.def_en: Have is used in question tags.

defs.def_cn: (用于对带有 have,has 或 had 的句子作肯定或否定回答)

ext.ext_cn: “你从未看过玛丽莲·梦露的电影？”“对，没有。”
ext.ext_en: 'You'd never seen the Marilyn Monroe film?' — 'No I hadn't.'...

ext.ext_cn: “你们以前去过约克吗？”“是的，去过。”
ext.ext_en: 'Have you been to York before?' — 'Yes we have.'

defs.def_en: You use have when you are confirming or contradicting a statement containing 'have', 'has', or 'had', or answering a question.

defs.def_cn: （having 和过去分词连用，所引导的分句中提到的动作发生在另一个动作开始之前）

ext.ext_cn: 1月19日离开新泽西后，他到了旧金山。
ext.ext_en: He arrived in San Francisco, having left New Jersey on January 19th...

ext.ext_cn: 被医生告知超重后，他一直拼命地吃高纤维食物和水果。
ext.ext_en: Having been told by his doctor that he was overweight, he's eating all the fibre and fruit he can.

defs.def_en: The form having with a past participle can be used to introduce a clause in which you mention an action which had already happened before another action began.

defs.def_cn: （have 后接名词代替该名词作动词的用法，描述某一动作或事件）

ext.ext_cn: 我出去在周围散了一会儿步。
ext.ext_en: I went out and had a walk around...

ext.ext_cn: 她休息了一会儿，然后洗了洗，换了身衣服。
ext.ext_en: She rested for a while, then had a wash and changed her clothes...

defs.def_en: You can use have followed by a noun to talk about an action or event, when it would be possible to use the same word as a verb. For example, you can say 'I had a look at the photos' instead of 'I looked at the photos.'

defs.def_cn: （在英语口语或书面语中，have可以和很多名词连用以代替某个具体的动词，描述某一动作或事件）

ext.ext_cn: 今晚来和我们一起吃饭吧。
ext.ext_en: Come and have a meal with us tonight...

ext.ext_cn: 我们准备开个会来决定怎么办。
ext.ext_en: We will be having a meeting to decide what to do...

defs.def_en: In normal spoken or written English, people use have with a wide range of nouns to talk about actions and events, often instead of a more specific verb. For example people are more likely to say 'we had ice cream' or 'he's had a shock' than 'we ate ice cream', or 'he's suffered a shock'.

ext.ext_cn: 奥斯卡有一辆新自行车。
ext.ext_en: Oscar had a new bicycle...

ext.ext_cn: 我想自己创业。
ext.ext_en: I want to have my own business...

defs.def_en: You use have to say that someone or something owns a particular thing, or when you are mentioning one of their qualities or characteristics.

ext.ext_cn: 他有很多工作要做。
ext.ext_en: He had plenty of work to do...

ext.ext_cn: 我要打几个重要的电话。
ext.ext_en: I have some important calls to make.

defs.def_en: If you have something to do, you are responsible for doing it or must do it.

defs.def_cn: （用于代替 there is, 表示某事物存在或发生了某事）

ext.ext_cn: 有两位房客和他同住。
ext.ext_en: He had two tenants living with him...

ext.ext_cn: 我们岛上什么店铺都没有。
ext.ext_en: We haven't any shops on the island...

defs.def_en: You can use have instead of 'there is' to say that something exists or happens. For example, you can say 'you have no alternative' instead of 'there is no alternative', or 'he had a good view from his window' instead of 'there was a good view from his window'.

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽双目紧闭。
ext.ext_en: Mary had her eyes closed...

ext.ext_cn: 他们开着窗帘。
ext.ext_en: They had the curtains open...

defs.def_en: If you have something such as a part of your body in a particular position or state, it is in that position or state.

ext.ext_cn: 我请人打扫了你的房间并通了风。
ext.ext_en: I had your rooms cleaned and aired...

ext.ext_cn: 他们派人干掉了他。
ext.ext_en: They had him killed...

defs.def_en: If you have something done, someone does it for you or you arrange for it to be done.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的钱被偷了。
ext.ext_en: We had our money stolen...

ext.ext_cn: 这个舞厅的屋顶甚至在第二次世界大战中被炸飞过。
ext.ext_en: The dance hall once even had its roof blown off in World War II.

defs.def_en: If someone has something unpleasant happen to them, it happens to them.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你碰巧能和他说话，让他给我打个电话。
ext.ext_en: If you happen to talk to him, have him call me...

ext.ext_cn: 这座大桥并不像有些导游说的那么雄伟。
ext.ext_en: The bridge is not as impressive as some guides would have you believe...

defs.def_en: If you have someone do something, you persuade, cause, or order them to do it.

defs.def_cn: 抓住（某人身体的某部位）

ext.ext_cn: 警方赶到时，拉里正揪着他的耳朵，把他的头往人行道上撞。
ext.ext_en: When the police came, Larry had him by the ear and was beating his head against the pavement.

defs.def_en: If someone has you by a part of your body, they are holding you there and they are trying to hurt you or force you to go somewhere.

ext.ext_cn: 我可以把我的票给你。
ext.ext_en: You can have my ticket...

ext.ext_cn: 请告诉我你的名字好吗？
ext.ext_en: Can I have your name please?...

defs.def_en: If you have something from someone, they give it to you.

ext.ext_cn: 我头疼。
ext.ext_en: I had a headache...

ext.ext_cn: 他可能是心脏病发作。
ext.ext_en: He might be having a heart attack...

defs.def_en: If you have an illness or disability, you suffer from it.

ext.ext_cn: 我妻子刚生了个男孩。
ext.ext_en: My wife has just had a baby boy...

ext.ext_cn: 她又怀上孩子了。
ext.ext_en: She's having another baby.

defs.def_en: If a woman has a baby, she gives birth to it. If she is having a baby, she is pregnant.

ext.ext_cn: 她想一个人呆着。他们不允许。
ext.ext_en: She wanted to be alone. They wouldn't have it...

ext.ext_cn: 我不想听那些废话。
ext.ext_en: I'm not having any of that nonsense...

defs.def_en: You can use have in expressions such as 'I won't have it' or 'I'm not having that', to mean that you will not allow or put up with something.

ext.ext_cn: 据谣传，票卖到了300英镑。
ext.ext_en: Rumour has it that tickets were being sold for £300...

ext.ext_cn: 他不可能像民间传说的那样被下了毒。
ext.ext_en: He could not possibly have been poisoned as popular legend has it.

defs.def_en: You can use has it in expressions such as 'rumour has it that' or 'as legend has it' when you are quoting something that you have heard, but you do not necessarily think it is true.

defs.def_cn: 跟…过不去;总想找…的茬儿

ext.ext_cn: 他老是跟道金斯一家过不去。
ext.ext_en: He's always had it in for the Dawkins family.

defs.def_en: If someone has it in for you, they do not like you and they want to make life difficult for you.

ext.ext_cn: “你真厉害！”他说，“我不知道你还有这两下子。”
ext.ext_en: 'You were brilliant!' he said. 'I didn't know you had it in you.'

ext.ext_cn: 他具备成功的潜质。
ext.ext_en: He has it in him to succeed.

defs.def_en: If you have it in you, you have abilities and skills which you do not usually use and which only show themselves in a difficult situation.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为她和园丁有一腿。
ext.ext_en: He reckons she's having it off with the gardener.

defs.def_en: To have it off with someone or have it away with someone means to have sex with them.

ext.ext_cn: 马隆瞪大了双眼。“你在戏弄我吧，利亚姆。”
ext.ext_en: Malone's eyes widened. 'You're having me on, Liam.'

defs.def_en: If you are having someone on, you are pretending that something is true when it is not true, for example as a joke or in order to tease them.

defs.def_cn: 和…讲个明白;和…争论出个结果

ext.ext_cn: 为什么不和批评你的人讲个明白，面对面地把整件事情谈一谈呢？
ext.ext_en: Why not have it out with your critic, discuss the whole thing face to face?

defs.def_en: If you have it out or have things out with someone, you discuss a problem or disagreement very openly with them, even if it means having an argument, because you think this is the best way to solve the problem.

ext.ext_cn: 他不得不去德国。
ext.ext_en: He had to go to Germany...

ext.ext_cn: 我们需要找辆出租车。
ext.ext_en: We'll have to find a taxi...

defs.def_en: You use have to when you are saying that something is necessary or required, or must happen. If you do not have to do something, it is not necessary or required.

ext.ext_cn: 一定会有某种解决办法的。
ext.ext_en: There has to be some kind of way out...

ext.ext_cn: 那肯定是有史以来最大的谎言。
ext.ext_en: That has to be the biggest lie ever told.

defs.def_en: You can use have to in order to say that you feel certain that something is true or will happen.
A harp is a large musical instrument consisting of a row of strings stretched from the top to the bottom of a frame. You play the harp by plucking the strings with your fingers.

defs.def_cn: (在别人的地方)探看，四下搜寻，打探

ext.ext_cn: 会计师们目前正在英国广播公司四处探看，进行一项效率研究。
ext.ext_en: Accountants are nosing around the BBC at the moment, conducting an efficiency study...

ext.ext_cn: 保安人员正在四下搜寻，科尔特斯也加入到他们当中。
ext.ext_en: Security people were nosing around, and Cortez joined them.

defs.def_en: If you nose around or nose about, you look around a place that belongs to someone else, to see if you can find something interesting.

defs.def_cn: 完全地，十足地（尤用于所说的话可能会受质疑时）

ext.ext_cn: 你没有理由不能拥有一个完全正常的孩子。
ext.ext_en: There's no reason why you can't have a perfectly normal child...

ext.ext_cn: 他们非常明确地表示继续下去毫无意义。
ext.ext_en: They made it perfectly clear that it was pointless to go on...

defs.def_en: You can use perfectly to emphasize an adjective or adverb, especially when you think the person you are talking to might doubt what you are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 这次改编非常好地抓住了库尔特·冯内古特小说的精髓。
ext.ext_en: This adaptation perfectly captures the spirit of Kurt Vonnegut's novel...

ext.ext_cn: 该系统运行完美。
ext.ext_en: The system worked perfectly.

defs.def_en: If something is done perfectly, it is done so well that it could not possibly be done better.

ext.ext_cn: 你可以少花一大笔钱买到顶好的仪器。
ext.ext_en: You can buy perfectly good instruments for a lot less.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as perfectly good or acceptable, you are emphasizing that there is no reason to use or get something else, although other people may disagree.

ext.ext_cn: 他在最后时刻推迟了行程。
ext.ext_en: He postponed his trip at the eleventh hour.

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚最后一刻达成的协议
ext.ext_en: ...last night's eleventh hour agreement.

defs.def_en: If someone does something at the eleventh hour, they do it at the last possible moment.

ext.ext_cn: “我想你可以把我算进去。”她耸耸肩说道。
ext.ext_en: She shrugged. 'You can count me in, I guess.'

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to count you in, you mean that you want to be included in an activity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他表演了很长时间，那是他最精彩的闹剧之一。
ext.ext_en: He gave one of his best knockabout performances in a long time.

defs.def_en: Knockabout comedy is lively and often involves people doing funny things, rather than saying them.

ext.ext_cn: 人们彻底疯了。乱成了一团。
ext.ext_en: The crowd went absolutely mad. It was bedlam...

ext.ext_cn: 他正搅得旅馆鸡犬不宁。
ext.ext_en: He is causing bedlam at the hotel.

defs.def_en: Bedlam means a great deal of noise and disorder. People often say 'It was bedlam' to mean 'There was bedlam'.

defs.def_cn: 放慢生活节奏（调换强度较低工作以减轻压力)

ext.ext_cn: 琳达现在发现她的很多客户都在调换工作减轻压力，寻求一种新的生活方式。
ext.ext_en: Lynda now sees many of her clients downshifting in search of a new way of living.

defs.def_en: If someone downshifts, they leave a job that is well-paid but stressful for a less demanding job and a more enjoyable way of life.

ext.ext_cn: 他调到低速挡，转动方向盘。
ext.ext_en: He downshifted and turned the steering wheel.

defs.def_en: If you downshift while driving, you change to a lower gear.

defs.def_cn: （食用后会产生幻觉的）神奇蘑菇，致幻蘑菇
defs.def_en: Magic mushrooms are a type of mushroom which contain a drug and may make the person who eats them believe they are seeing things which are not real.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数当代文学作品的平庸
ext.ext_en: ...the mediocrity of most contemporary literature...

ext.ext_cn: 如今的时尚品位低下，平庸无奇。
ext.ext_en: Fashion today is sloppy mediocrity.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the mediocrity of  something, you mean that it is of average quality but you think it should be better.

ext.ext_cn: 在周围一群泛泛之辈的衬托之下，他就像一个鹤立鸡群的智者。
ext.ext_en: Surrounded by mediocrities, he can seem a towering intellectual.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a mediocrity, you think that they are not very good at what they do.

defs.def_cn: 社会地位的象征;身份的象征
defs.def_en: A status symbol is something that a person has or owns that shows they have money or importance in society.

ext.ext_cn: 弗兰克不想让警察知道去哪里可以找到他。
ext.ext_en: Frank didn't like having the cops know where to find him.

defs.def_en: A cop is a policeman or policewoman.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车旅馆老板和饭店经理因为冷落顾客而受到责骂。
ext.ext_en: Motel owners and restaurant managers copped it for neglecting their clients.

defs.def_en: If you cop it, someone punishes you or speaks to you angrily because you have done something wrong.

defs.def_cn: 没有什么价值;不怎么样

ext.ext_cn: 简在1986年推出了《XXX》专辑，但事实上并不怎么样。
ext.ext_en: The Jane's 'Triple X Album' came out in 1986, and wasn't much cop actually.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not much cop, you mean that it is not very good, and is disappointing.

ext.ext_cn: 把洋葱切成极薄的薄片。
ext.ext_en: Cut the onion into paper-thin slices...

ext.ext_cn: 这几堵墙非常薄，你能够听到发生的一切。
ext.ext_en: The walls are paper thin; you can hear everything that goes on.

defs.def_en: If something is paper-thin, it is very thin.

ext.ext_cn: 我有时会头脑发热，挥霍无度。
ext.ext_en: I can have a brainstorm and be very extravagant.

defs.def_en: If you have a brainstorm, you suddenly become unable to think clearly.

defs.def_cn: 突然想到的好主意；灵感

ext.ext_cn: “对了，”她灵机一动说道，“你干吗不请他们到这儿来？”
ext.ext_en: 'Look,' she said, getting a brainstorm, 'Why don't you invite them here?'

defs.def_en: If you have a brainstorm, you suddenly have a clever idea.

ext.ext_cn: 她们每个月聚会两次，在一起出谋献策，为各自制定生意目标。
ext.ext_en: The women meet twice a month to brainstorm and set business goals for each other...

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以集体讨论，列出该公司中最有影响的人员的名单。
ext.ext_en: We can brainstorm a list of the most influential individuals in the company.

defs.def_en: If a group of people brainstorm, they have a meeting in which they all put forward as many ideas and suggestions as they can think of.

defs.def_cn: （表示稍感恼怒、吃惊等）见鬼，糟糕

ext.ext_cn: 如果你不喜欢，不要投他的票不就得了。
ext.ext_en: Heck, if you don't like it, don't vote for him...

ext.ext_cn: 真见鬼。我能写些什么呢？
ext.ext_en: Oh, heck. What can I write about?

defs.def_en: People sometimes say 'heck!' when they are slightly irritated or surprised.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正大把大把地花钱。
ext.ext_en: They're spending a heck of a lot of money...

ext.ext_cn: 事实上我麻烦大了。
ext.ext_en: The truth is, I'm in one heck of a mess.

defs.def_en: People use a heck of to emphasize how big something is or how much of it there is.

defs.def_cn: （尤在迷惑或恼怒时用于疑问句中表示强调）到底，究竟

ext.ext_cn: 那到底是什么鬼东西？
ext.ext_en: What the heck's that?...

ext.ext_cn: 问题是，他究竟人在哪里？
ext.ext_en: The question was, where the heck was he?

defs.def_en: You use the heck in expressions such as 'what the heck' and 'how the heck' in order to emphasize a question, especially when you are puzzled or annoyed.

ext.ext_cn: 管它呢，我想，我就试试吧。
ext.ext_en: What the heck, I thought, I'll give it a whirl.

defs.def_en: You say 'what the heck' to indicate that you do not care about a bad aspect of an action or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 一群小姑娘
ext.ext_en: ...a bevy of little girls.

ext.ext_cn: 一群充满朝气的年轻军官
ext.ext_en: ...a bevy of bright young officers.

defs.def_en: A bevy of people is a group of people all together in one place.

ext.ext_cn: 限制房屋密集程度的法规
ext.ext_en: ...a law which restricts the density of housing...

ext.ext_cn: 该地区的人口密度很高。
ext.ext_en: The region has a very high population density.

defs.def_en: Density is the extent to which something is filled or covered with people or things.

ext.ext_cn: 密度为每立方厘米 3.5 克的木星卫星木卫一上遍布岩石。
ext.ext_en: Jupiter's moon Io, whose density is 3.5 grams per cubic centimetre, is all rock.

defs.def_en: In science, the density of a substance or object is the relation of its mass or weight to its volume.

defs.def_cn: 全知全能的；无所不知的；博闻广识的

ext.ext_cn: 仁慈、全知的神
ext.ext_en: ...a benevolent and omniscient deity.

ext.ext_cn: 《金融时报》无所不知的数据搜集网络
ext.ext_en: ...the Financial Times's omniscient data-gathering network.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as omniscient, you mean they know or seem to know everything.
An illusionist is a performer who makes it seem that strange or impossible things are happening, for example that a person has disappeared or been cut in half.

defs.def_cn: 相对而言;比较起来;某种程度上

ext.ext_cn: 需要的金额相对较小。
ext.ext_en: The sums needed are relatively small...

ext.ext_cn: 我愿意认为自己相对比较容易相处。
ext.ext_en: I like to think I'm relatively easy to get along with.

defs.def_en: Relatively means to a certain degree, especially when compared with other things of the same kind.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 开明的；开通的；（个人）自由主义的

ext.ext_cn: 众所周知，她在离婚与避孕方面思想很开明。
ext.ext_en: She is known to have liberal views on divorce and contraception.

ext.ext_cn: 思想开放的自由主义者的国度
ext.ext_en: ...a nation of free-thinking liberals.

defs.def_en: Someone who has liberal views believes people should have a lot of freedom in deciding how to behave and think.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （制度等）开放的；（政治或经济上）自由主义的

ext.ext_cn: 多党政制的自由民主国家
ext.ext_en: ...a liberal democracy with a multiparty political system...

ext.ext_cn: 他们支持开放的自由市场政策。
ext.ext_en: They favour liberal free-market policies.

defs.def_en: A liberal system allows people or organizations a lot of political or economic freedom.

defs.def_cn: 自由党的;支持自由党的

ext.ext_cn: 自由党领袖已宣布该党退出执政联盟。
ext.ext_en: The Liberal leader has announced his party's withdrawal from the ruling coalition.

ext.ext_cn: 自由党党员在议会中占23席。
ext.ext_en: The Liberals hold twenty-three seats in parliament.

defs.def_en: A Liberal politician or voter is a member of a Liberal Party or votes for a Liberal Party.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 慷慨的；肆意的；大量的；丰富的

ext.ext_cn: 像平时一样，他出口就是笑话。
ext.ext_en: As always he is liberal with his jokes...

ext.ext_cn: 她随便把姐姐的化妆品和衣服拿来用。
ext.ext_en: She made liberal use of her elder sister's make-up and clothes.

defs.def_en: Liberal means giving, using, or taking a lot of something, or existing in large quantities.

ext.ext_cn: 一瓶朗姆酒
ext.ext_en: ...a bottle of rum.

ext.ext_cn: 朗姆宾治酒
ext.ext_en: ...a rum punch.

defs.def_en: Rum is an alcoholic drink made from sugar.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这当然是个玩笑，但是这个玩笑也太奇怪了吧？
ext.ext_en: It was a joke, of course, but surely a rum sort of joke?

defs.def_en: If you describe people or things as rum, you mean that they are rather strange.

ext.ext_cn: 他们将请求他退出冲突。
ext.ext_en: They will plead with him to pull back from confrontation...

ext.ext_cn: 英国政府威胁要将其担忧公之于众，但后来没有这么做。
ext.ext_en: The British government threatened to make public its disquiet but then pulled back.

defs.def_en: If someone pulls back from an action, they decide not to do it or continue with it, because it could have bad consequences.

ext.ext_cn: 他们被要求从城市周围的炮兵阵地上撤出。
ext.ext_en: They were asked to pull back from their artillery positions around the city...

ext.ext_cn: 他从蒙古撤军，并且撤离阿富汗。
ext.ext_en: He pulled back forces from Mongolia, and he withdrew from Afghanistan.

defs.def_en: If troops pull back or if their leader pulls them back, they go some or all of the way back to their own territory.
A capacitor is a device for accumulating electric charge.

ext.ext_cn: 出生时间相同
ext.ext_en: ...coincident birth times...

ext.ext_cn: 会谈的同时，该银行已获准在纽约开设分行。
ext.ext_en: Coincident with the talks, the bank was permitted to open a New York branch.

defs.def_en: Coincident events happen at the same time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们的目标与我们的一致。
ext.ext_en: Their aims are coincident with ours...

ext.ext_cn: 有人指出这合乎的是公司富豪和政治官员的利益。
ext.ext_en: Coincident interests with the corporate rich and political directorate are pointed out.

defs.def_en: Coincident opinions, ideas, or policies are the same or are very similar to each other.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的计划好像注定要失败。
ext.ext_en: Their plans seemed doomed to failure...

ext.ext_cn: 他知道如果他活下来，他将注定以战俘的身份度过战争。
ext.ext_en: He knew that if he lived, he would be doomed to spend the war as a prisoner.

defs.def_en: If something is doomed to happen, or if you are doomed to a particular state, something unpleasant is certain to happen, and you can do nothing to prevent it.

ext.ext_cn: 消防队员奋力穿过烟雾企图去救孩子们，而这注定是要失败的。
ext.ext_en: Fireman battled through the smoke in a doomed attempt to rescue the children...

ext.ext_cn: 我过去常常将大量时间和精力投入到从开始就注定要失败的计划中。
ext.ext_en: I used to pour time and energy into projects that were doomed from the start.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is doomed is certain to fail or be destroyed.

ext.ext_cn: 阿留申群岛是北太平洋上一长串呈弧形排列的小岛。
ext.ext_en: The Aleutian chain is a long arc of islands in the North Pacific.

defs.def_en: An arc is a smoothly curving line or movement.
In geometry, an arc is a part of the line that forms the outside of a circle.

ext.ext_cn: 彩虹在小城上空画出了一道优美的弧线。
ext.ext_en: A rainbow arced gracefully over the town.

defs.def_en: If something arcs in a particular direction, it makes a smoothly curving line or movement.

ext.ext_cn: 他们自来到这里以后,有了很大改进。
ext.ext_en: They have improved immeasurably since their arrival...

ext.ext_cn: 今天的形势远比 25 年前严峻。
ext.ext_en: The situation today is immeasurably more acute than it was 25 years ago.

defs.def_en: You use immeasurably to emphasize the degree or extent of a process or quality.
A cowpat is a pile of faeces from a cow.

defs.def_cn: (音乐、数学等的)标记系统，成套符号

ext.ext_cn: 五线谱以C大音阶构成，每一个线和间代表这个音阶的音符。
ext.ext_en: Musical notation was conceived for the C major scale and each line and space represents a note in this scale.

ext.ext_cn: 其他的抽象符号系统，如计算机语言
ext.ext_en: ...some other abstract notation system like a computer language.

defs.def_en: A system of notation is a set of written symbols that are used to represent something such as music or mathematics.

defs.def_cn: 销售代表，销售专员（全写为 representative）

ext.ext_cn: 我一直在一家摄影公司做销售代表。
ext.ext_en: I'd  been working as a sales rep for a photographic company.

defs.def_en: See also:holiday rep;A rep is a person whose job is to sell a company's products or services, especially by travelling round and visiting other companies. Rep is short for representative .

ext.ext_cn: 与你所在工会的健康安全代表联系。
ext.ext_en: Contact the health and safety rep at your union.

defs.def_en: A rep is a person who acts as a representative for a group of people, usually a group of people who work together.

ext.ext_cn: 一部戏在登陆伦敦西区舞台前会以常备剧目试演。
ext.ext_en: A play is tested in rep before ever hitting a West End stage.

defs.def_en: In the theatre, rep is the same as repertory .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人厌恶的；让人不悦的;低劣的

ext.ext_cn: 卡姆登一所条件恶劣的小公寓
ext.ext_en: ...a grotty little flat in Camden.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as grotty, you mean that it is unpleasant or of poor quality and you dislike it strongly.

ext.ext_cn: 这是非常粗略简单的图式病毒形态。
ext.ext_en: This is the virus in very crude simple diagrammatic form.

defs.def_en: Something that is in diagrammatic form is arranged or drawn as a diagram.

defs.def_cn: 将(病人、精神病患者、老人等)送往社会收容机构

ext.ext_cn: 她病得很重，必须在医院住很长一段时间。
ext.ext_en: She became seriously ill and had to be institutionalized for a lengthy period.

ext.ext_cn: 她认为自己是个失败者,曾有一次因患抑郁症被送往精神病院治疗。
ext.ext_en: She saw herself as a failure and had been institutionalized once for depression.

defs.def_en: If someone such as a sick, mentally ill, or old person is institutionalized, they are sent to stay in a special hospital or home, usually for a long period.

defs.def_cn: 使制度化;使为文化(或社会)所认可;使约定俗成

ext.ext_cn: 目标是将计划生育纳入社区生活中。
ext.ext_en: The goal is to institutionalize family planning into community life...

ext.ext_cn: 公元1世纪时还没有任何制度化的宗教存在。
ext.ext_en: In the first century there was no such thing as institutionalized religion.

defs.def_en: To institutionalize something means to establish it as part of a culture, social system, or organization.

defs.def_cn: 唐宁街(英国首相及财政大臣居住的街道名);英国首相;英国官员

ext.ext_cn: 今天早晨首相从巴黎回到了唐宁街。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister arrived back at Downing Street from Paris this morning...

ext.ext_cn: 英国政府确实十分重视法国的民意测验。
ext.ext_en: Downing Street is taking the French opinion polls very seriously indeed.

defs.def_en: Downing Street is the street in London in which the Prime Minister and the Chancellor of the Exchequer live. You can also use Downing Street to refer to the Prime Minister and his or her officials.

ext.ext_cn: 他嘴里叼着一个精致的烟嘴，一口接一口地喷云吐雾。
ext.ext_en: He puffed constantly through an elegant cigarette holder.

defs.def_en: A cigarette holder is a narrow tube that you can put a cigarette into in order to hold it while you smoke it.
A gibbet is a gallows .
The bilge or the bilges are the flat bottom part of a ship or boat.

ext.ext_cn: 我胡乱给女性杂志写点东西，维持我们的生计。
ext.ext_en: I supported us by writing bilge for women's magazines.

defs.def_en: If you say that something written or spoken is bilge, you mean that you think it is untrue or silly.

defs.def_cn: 鹦鹉学舌般地；亦步亦趋地

ext.ext_cn: 在旧体制下，学生常常得立正站好，机械地重复课文。
ext.ext_en: Under the old system pupils often had to stand to attention and repeat lessons parrot fashion.

defs.def_en: If you learn or repeat something parrot-fashion, you do it accurately but without really understanding what it means.

defs.def_cn: (在某一活动上)远远超过，远胜于

ext.ext_cn: 梅森在他悲剧性的最后一场拳击比赛中于文布利惨败给了伦诺克斯·刘易斯。
ext.ext_en: Mason was outclassed by Lennox Lewis in his tragic last fight at Wembley...

ext.ext_cn: 没有几家城市酒店能与克里雍大饭店媲美。
ext.ext_en: Few city hotels can outclass the Hotel de Crillon.

defs.def_en: If you are outclassed by someone, they are a lot better than you are at a particular activity.

ext.ext_cn: 苏联的最新产品要远比这些飞机性能优越。
ext.ext_en: These planes are outclassed by the most recent designs from the former Soviet Union...

ext.ext_cn: 这本小说比弗雷德里克·福赛思的所有作品都更为精彩。
ext.ext_en: The story outclasses anything written by Frederick Forsyth.

defs.def_en: If one thing outclasses another thing, the first thing is of a much higher quality than the second thing.

ext.ext_cn: 高尔夫球
ext.ext_en: ...a golf ball.

ext.ext_cn: 网球
ext.ext_en: ...a tennis ball.

defs.def_en: A ball is a round object that is used in games such as tennis, baseball, football, basketball, and cricket.

ext.ext_cn: 托马斯把信揉成一团。
ext.ext_en: Thomas screwed the letter up into a ball...

ext.ext_cn: 他们听见一声爆炸的巨响，看见一个火球腾空而起。
ext.ext_en: They heard a loud explosion and saw a ball of fire go up.

defs.def_en: A ball is something or an amount of something that has a round shape.

ext.ext_cn: 他抓起那几张纸，在手里紧紧攥成团。
ext.ext_en: He picked up the sheets of paper, and balled them tightly in his fists...

ext.ext_cn: 他攥起了拳头。
ext.ext_en: His hands balled into fists...

defs.def_en: When you ball something or when it balls, it becomes round.

defs.def_cn: （脚趾和脚相连或拇指和手相连的）球状部位；脚趾球；拇指球
defs.def_en: The ball of your foot or the ball of your thumb is the rounded part where your toes join your foot or where your thumb joins your hand.
A ball is a large formal social event at which people dance.
A man's balls are his testicles.

defs.def_cn: 轮到…采取行动（或作出决断）

ext.ext_cn: 轮到你了——你必须决定自己要做什么。
ext.ext_en: The ball's now in your court — you have to decide what you're going to do.

defs.def_en: If you say that the ball is in someone's court, you mean that it is his or her responsibility to take the next action or decision in a situation.

defs.def_cn: 使某事发生；开始某种活动

ext.ext_cn: 他下周将前往中东，开始重启和谈。
ext.ext_en: He will go to the Middle East next week to get the ball rolling again on peace talks...

ext.ext_cn: 我只是想有足够的启动资金。
ext.ext_en: I just want enough cash to start the ball rolling.

defs.def_en: If you get the ball rolling ,set the ball rolling, or start the ball rolling, you start something happening.

ext.ext_cn: 男孩们在户外席地而坐，从阵阵笑声来看，他们玩得很开心。
ext.ext_en: Outside the boys were sitting on the ground and, going by the gales of laughter, they were having a ball.

defs.def_en: If you are having a ball, you are having a very enjoyable time.

ext.ext_cn: 那名侦探必须查明动机、手段和时机，而且对这三项的调查必须同步展开。
ext.ext_en: The detective has to discover the motive, the means and the opportunity and has to keep these three balls in the air.

ext.ext_cn: 同时要做无数件事情的可怜的母亲
ext.ext_en: ...unhappy mothers trying to juggle ten balls in the air.

defs.def_en: If you keep several balls in the air, you try to do several different things at once.

ext.ext_cn: 她很精明干练；她通过拍卖购过房，所以知道自己在做什么。
ext.ext_en: She really is on the ball; she's bought houses at auctions so she knows what she's doing.

defs.def_en: If someone is on the ball, they are very alert and aware of what is happening.

ext.ext_cn: 该协会威胁说如果银行和建屋互助会不配合的话，它将不再提供支持。
ext.ext_en: The association has threatened to withdraw its support if the banks and building societies refuse to play ball.

defs.def_en: If someone refuses to play ball, they are unwilling to do what someone wants them to do.

ext.ext_cn: 他遭到废黜并流亡国外。
ext.ext_en: He was dethroned and went into exile.

defs.def_en: If a king, queen, or other powerful person is dethroned, they are removed from their position of power.
A billfold is a small flat folded case, usually made of leather or plastic, where you can keep banknotes and credit cards.
A gander is a male goose.

defs.def_cn: 屈从于，屈服于，抵挡不住(诱惑或压力)

ext.ext_cn: 不要经不住诱惑，只抽一支烟也不行。
ext.ext_en: Don't succumb to the temptation to have just one cigarette...

ext.ext_cn: 首相说他的国家永远都不会屈服于压迫。
ext.ext_en: The Minister said his country would never succumb to pressure.

defs.def_en: If you succumb to temptation or pressure, you do something that you want to do, or that other people want you to do, although you feel it might be wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 几年后，卡佳因患癌症在伦敦病逝。
ext.ext_en: A few years later, Katya succumbed to cancer in London...

ext.ext_cn: 我坚决不向病毒屈服。
ext.ext_en: I was determined not to succumb to the virus.

defs.def_en: If you succumb to an illness, you become affected by it or die from it.

defs.def_cn: 持续不断的;重复的;一直存在的

ext.ext_cn: 她暗示说女性总是处在保持身材异常瘦削的压力之下。
ext.ext_en: She suggests that women are under constant pressure to be abnormally thin...

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀始终是个威胁。
ext.ext_en: Inflation is a constant threat...

defs.def_en: You use constant to describe something that happens all the time or is always there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 平均风速保持稳定。
ext.ext_en: The average speed of the winds remained constant.

defs.def_en: If an amount or level is constant, it stays the same over a particular period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 在时装界，有时似乎唯一永恒不变的东西就是不断的变化。
ext.ext_en: In the world of fashion it sometimes seems that the only constant is ceaseless change...

ext.ext_cn: 若干研究已经发现了两个重要常量。
ext.ext_en: Two significant constants have been found in a number of research studies.

defs.def_en: A constant is a thing or value that always stays the same.

ext.ext_cn: 官员们用警犬驱散抗议人群。
ext.ext_en: Officials used guard dogs to eject the protesters...

ext.ext_cn: 他被逐出餐厅。
ext.ext_en: He was ejected from a restaurant.

defs.def_en: If you eject someone from a place, you force them to leave.

ext.ext_cn: 他用步枪瞄准，射出一枚子弹，然后退出空弹壳。
ext.ext_en: He aimed his rifle, fired a single shot, then ejected the spent cartridge.

defs.def_en: To eject something means to remove it or push it out forcefully.

defs.def_cn: （通常指飞行员从即将坠毁的飞机中）弹射出来

ext.ext_cn: 飞行员从飞机中弹出，安然无恙。
ext.ext_en: The pilot ejected from the plane and escaped injury.

defs.def_en: When a pilot ejects from an aircraft, he or she leaves the aircraft quickly using an ejector seat, usually because the plane is about to crash.

defs.def_cn: (拳击中为练习或试探对手反应快慢而)轻拳出击

ext.ext_cn: 戴上护具后可以和对手练习轻拳出击。
ext.ext_en: With protective gear on you can spar with a partner...

ext.ext_cn: 他们互相推搡了一会儿，眼看就要大打出手了。
ext.ext_en: They sparred for a moment, on the brink of a full fight.

defs.def_en: If you spar with someone, you box using fairly gentle blows instead of hitting your opponent hard, either when you are training or when you want to test how quickly your opponent reacts.

defs.def_cn: 争论，争辩，拌嘴(但不动真格的)

ext.ext_cn: 这些年以来，他一直跟他的朋友杰西·杰克逊为政治手腕的问题争论不休。
ext.ext_en: Over the years he sparred with his friend Jesse Jackson over political tactics...

ext.ext_cn: 他们一直很合得来，甚至拌嘴的时候也是如此。
ext.ext_en: They had always gotten along, even when they sparred.

defs.def_en: If you spar with someone, you argue with them but not in an aggressive or serious way.

ext.ext_cn: 坚固的云杉木做成的桅杆已经弯得像一把弓，那一刻我觉得它马上就要断了。
ext.ext_en: The mast, which was a solid spruce spar, bent like a bow, and for a moment I thought we were going to lose it.

defs.def_en: A spar is a strong pole, especially one that a sail is attached to on a sailing ship.

ext.ext_cn: 游乐场是一帮精力过剩的年轻人寻求各种惊险刺激的绝佳场所。
ext.ext_en: An amusement park is the perfect locale for a bunch of irrepressible youngsters to have all sorts of adventures.

defs.def_en: A locale is a small area, for example the place where something happens or where the action of a book or film is set.

ext.ext_cn: 几乎没有什么激励政策来促使人们采取这些措施。
ext.ext_en: There is little or no incentive to adopt such measures...

ext.ext_cn: 英国许多公司都很欢迎以税收优惠的方式来鼓励研发的想法。
ext.ext_en: Many companies in Britain are keen on the idea of tax incentives for R&D.;

defs.def_en: If something is an incentive to do something, it encourages you to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 专家们在明确对欧盟各国政府所应追究的责任时十分公正。
ext.ext_en: The experts are even-handed in apportioning blame among EU governments...

ext.ext_cn: 减免的税额在地产和受益人之间分摊。
ext.ext_en: The allowable deduction is apportioned between the estate and the beneficiaries.

defs.def_en: When you apportion something such as blame, you decide how much of it different people deserve or should be given.

ext.ext_cn: 在有四分之一的人口是外来移民的法兰克福
ext.ext_en: ...in Frankfurt, where a quarter of the population is foreign...

ext.ext_cn: 她第一次在没有父母陪伴的情况下自己去国外度假。
ext.ext_en: She was on her first foreign holiday without her parents.

defs.def_en: Something or someone that is foreign comes from or relates to a country that is not your own.

ext.ext_cn: 德国外交部长
ext.ext_en: ...the German foreign minister...

ext.ext_cn: 我是洪都拉斯《论坛报》驻华盛顿的记者。
ext.ext_en: I am the foreign correspondent in Washington of La Tribuna newspaper of Honduras.

defs.def_en: In politics and journalism, foreign is used to describe people, jobs, and activities relating to countries that are not the country of the person or government concerned.

ext.ext_cn: 病人的免疫系统会对移植器官产生异质排斥反应。
ext.ext_en: The patient's immune system would reject the transplanted organ as a foreign object.

defs.def_en: A foreign object is something that has got into something else, usually by accident, and should not be there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 陌生的;不熟悉的;非典型的

ext.ext_cn: 价格竞争这个概念对于许多学校都很陌生。
ext.ext_en: The very notion of price competition is foreign to many schools...

ext.ext_cn: 我们对整件事不了解。
ext.ext_en: The whole thing is foreign to us.

defs.def_en: Something that is foreign to a particular person or thing is not typical of them or is unknown to them.

ext.ext_cn: 内务大臣尴尬地作出让步，解除了将其驱逐出境的威胁。
ext.ext_en: In an embarrassing climb-down, the Home Secretary lifted the deportation threat.

defs.def_en: A climb-down in an argument or dispute is the act of admitting that you are wrong or of changing your intentions or demands.
A beltway is a road that goes around a city or town, to keep traffic away from the centre.

defs.def_cn: 派系冲突;派系间的争端

ext.ext_cn: 运动中有大量的宗派之争。
ext.ext_en: There has been a substantial amount of factionalism within the movement.

defs.def_en: Factionalism refers to arguments or disputes between two or more small groups from within a larger group.

defs.def_cn: 阿富汗的；阿富汗人的；阿富汗语的

ext.ext_cn: 阿富汗首都喀布尔
ext.ext_en: ...the Afghan capital, Kabul.

defs.def_en: Afghan means belonging or relating to Afghanistan, or to its people or language.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 吃某些种类的鱼开始流行起来。
ext.ext_en: It became fashionable to eat certain kinds of fish...

ext.ext_cn: 切尔西港以高档餐馆闻名。
ext.ext_en: Chelsea Harbour is renowned for its fashionable restaurants.

defs.def_en: Something or someone that is fashionable is popular or approved of at a particular time.

defs.def_cn: 非凡的，卓越的，出色的（略显幽默的说法）

ext.ext_cn: 非凡的电影制作人，乔治·库哈尔
ext.ext_en: ...George Kuchar, film-maker extraordinaire.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as being, for example, a musician extraordinaire, you are saying in a slightly humorous way that you think they are an extremely good musician.

ext.ext_cn: 1减1等于0。
ext.ext_en: One minus  one is zero...

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经得到承诺，7月份的工资除去辛劳补助外将全额发放。
ext.ext_en: They've been promised their full July salary minus the hardship payment.

defs.def_en: You use minus to show that one number or quantity is being subtracted from another.

ext.ext_cn: 这架飞机曾经在零下65度和零上120度的温度下飞行。
ext.ext_en: The aircraft was subjected to temperatures of minus 65 degrees and plus 120 degrees.

defs.def_en: Minus before a number or quantity means that the number or quantity is less than zero.

defs.def_cn: 减(指学校评分中某一等级中的“略差”，但又好于下一个等级)

ext.ext_cn: 我准备给他一个B—。
ext.ext_en: I'm giving him a B minus.

defs.def_en: Teachers use minus in grading work in schools and colleges. 'B minus' is not as good as 'B', but is a better grade than 'C'.

ext.ext_cn: 电影公司垮了，克里斯没了工作，也失去了他一生的积蓄。
ext.ext_en: The film company collapsed, leaving Chris jobless and minus his life savings.

defs.def_en: To be minus something means not to have that  thing.

ext.ext_cn: 弊端远远大于那可能获得的收益。
ext.ext_en: The minuses far outweigh that possible gain...

ext.ext_cn: 利弊大致均衡。
ext.ext_en: The plusses and minuses were about equal...

defs.def_en: A minus is a disadvantage.

ext.ext_cn: 民意测验有上下5%的误差率。
ext.ext_en: The poll has a margin of error of plus or minus 5 per cent.

defs.def_en: You use plus or minus to give the amount by which a particular number may vary.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 身材微胖、不怒自威的中年女人
ext.ext_en: ...a matronly woman with an air of authority.

defs.def_en: You can use matronly to describe a woman who is fairly fat and looks middle-aged, especially if you think the clothes she is wearing are not fashionable or attractive.

defs.def_cn: 第一世界(指世界上最繁荣的工业化地区)

ext.ext_cn: 虽然南非有着很多第一世界的特征——一批良好的基础设施，不计其数的富人，但它还并不属于那个世界。
ext.ext_en: Although South Africa has many of the attributes of the first world — some good infrastructure, millions of rich people — it is still not part of that world.

ext.ext_cn: 富有的第一世界国家
ext.ext_en: ...wealthy First World countries.

defs.def_en: The most prosperous and industrialized parts of the world are sometimes referred to as the First World .

ext.ext_cn: 我就向他屈服了，从那以后我一直后悔。
ext.ext_en: I simply gave in to him, and I've regretted it ever since...

ext.ext_cn: 埃利斯好像后悔问了这个问题。
ext.ext_en: Ellis seemed to be regretting that he had asked the question...

defs.def_en: If you regret something that you have done, you wish that you had not done it.

ext.ext_cn: 我这辈子最大的遗憾就是没有把美洲杯捧回家。
ext.ext_en: My great regret in life is that I didn't bring home the America's Cup...

ext.ext_cn: 利里说他没后悔退休。
ext.ext_en: Lillee said he had no regrets about retiring.

defs.def_en: Regret is a feeling of sadness or disappointment, which is caused by something that has happened or something that you have done or not done.

defs.def_cn: 为…抱歉;很遗憾地说/通知你

ext.ext_cn: “我对他的受伤感到很遗憾，”他说。
ext.ext_en: 'I very much regret the injuries he sustained,' he said...

ext.ext_cn: 我很遗憾美国也加入了这一抗议的行列。
ext.ext_en: I regret that the United States has added its voice to such protests...

defs.def_en: You can say that you regret something as a polite way of saying that you are sorry about it. You use expressions such as I regret to say or I regret to inform you to show that you are sorry about something.

ext.ext_cn: 他深表歉意，说外科医生会努力消除手术造成的损伤。
ext.ext_en: He expressed great regret and said that surgeons would attempt to reverse the operation...

ext.ext_cn: 她遗憾地接受了他的辞职。
ext.ext_en: She has accepted his resignation with regret.

defs.def_en: If someone expresses regret about something, they say that they are sorry about it.

defs.def_cn: 一触即发的;转瞬即变的

ext.ext_cn: 他嗜酒贪杯、狂妄自大且脾气暴躁，这常常使他在夜总会和人发生恶性斗殴。
ext.ext_en: His boozing, arrogance, and hair-trigger temper have often led him into ugly nightclub brawls...

ext.ext_cn: 局势风云突变，战争一触即发。
ext.ext_en: A hair-trigger situation has been created which could lead to an outbreak of war at any time.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as hair-trigger, you mean that it is likely to change very violently and suddenly.

defs.def_cn: 把…的车堵住；使…的车无法开出

ext.ext_cn: 我们的车被堵在里面，要等很久才能走。
ext.ext_en: Our cars get blocked in and we can't leave for ages...

ext.ext_cn: 哦，外面是您的车吗？我可能把您给堵住了。
ext.ext_en: Oh, is that your car outside? I may have blocked you in.

defs.def_en: If you are blocked in, someone has parked their car in such a way that you cannot drive yours away.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 以自我为中心的;个人主义的;自私自利的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个以自我为中心、易冲动的人，希望身边的人都为他服务。
ext.ext_en: He was egocentric, a man of impulse who expected those around him to serve him.

defs.def_en: Someone who is egocentric thinks only of themselves and their own wants, and does not consider other people.
A glow-worm is a type of beetle which produces light from its body.
A dace is a type of fish that lives in rivers and lakes.

defs.def_cn: 起初的；最初的；原先的；原来的

ext.ext_cn: 最初的计划是无限期停工。
ext.ext_en: The original plan was to hold an indefinite stoppage...

ext.ext_cn: 居民以压倒多数票同意恢复该市原来的名字“开姆尼茨”。
ext.ext_en: The inhabitants have voted overwhelmingly to restore the city's original name of Chemnitz.

defs.def_en: You use original when referring to something that existed at the beginning of a process or activity, or the characteristics that something had when it began or was made.

defs.def_cn: 原物；原件；原作；原著；原文

ext.ext_cn: 填好这份问卷后，复印一份并将原卷交给雇主。
ext.ext_en: When you have filled in the questionnaire, copy it and send the original to your employer...

ext.ext_cn: 续集破天荒地与第一部一样精彩。
ext.ext_en: For once the sequel is as good as the original.

defs.def_en: If something such as a document, a work of art, or a piece of writing is an original, it is not a copy or a later version.

defs.def_cn: 原物的；原件的；原作的；非复制的

ext.ext_cn: 原版电影海报
ext.ext_en: ...an original movie poster.

defs.def_en: An original document or work of art is not a copy.

defs.def_cn: 新创作的；未发表的；未发行的；未曾演出的

ext.ext_cn: 其委托创作新作品的政策
ext.ext_en: ...its policy of commissioning original work.

ext.ext_cn: 以及理查德·沃纳最新创作的朗朗上口的歌曲
ext.ext_en: ...with catchy original songs by Richard Warner.

defs.def_en: An original piece of writing or music was written recently and has not been published or performed before.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这是用该语言写成的最具独创性和想象力的作品之一。
ext.ext_en: It is one of the most original works of imagination in the language.

ext.ext_cn: 独树一帜的作家
ext.ext_en: ...an original writer.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or their work as original, you mean that they are very imaginative and have new ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 这方面的每一本书和每一位作家他都读过，而且通常均为原著。
ext.ext_en: He read every book or author it deals with, often in the original...

ext.ext_cn: 这些歌词是用原来的意大利语演唱的。
ext.ext_en: The texts were sung in the original Italian.

defs.def_en: If you read or sing something in the original or, for example, in the original French, you read or sing it in the language it was written in, rather than a translation.

ext.ext_cn: 古巴属于热带气候，终年阳光明媚。
ext.ext_en: Cuba has a tropical climate with year-round sunshine.

ext.ext_cn: 他们一年到头每周工作7天。
ext.ext_en: They work 7 days a week year-round.

defs.def_en: Year-round is used to describe something that happens, exists, or is done throughout the year.

defs.def_cn: (旧的黑白影片的)着色法，染色法

ext.ext_cn: 经典老片的着色
ext.ext_en: ...the colorization of old film classics.

defs.def_en: Colorization is a technique used to add colour to old black and white films.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他已经是英国最高级俱乐部的成员了。
ext.ext_en: He is already a member of Britain's most exclusive club...

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦城被指责过于奢华和缺乏竞争力。
ext.ext_en: The City was criticised for being too exclusive and uncompetitive.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as exclusive, you mean that it is limited to people who have a lot of money or who belong to a high social class, and is therefore not available to everyone.

ext.ext_cn: 我们小组将独用一条60英尺长的船。
ext.ext_en: Our group will have exclusive use of a 60-foot boat...

ext.ext_cn: 在英国，他们生产的奶酪很多只在我们商店出售。
ext.ext_en: Many of their cheeses are exclusive to our stores in Britain.

defs.def_en: Something that is exclusive is used or owned by only one person or group, and not shared with anyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 他在接受一家杂志社的独家采访时说：“我所有的问题都是饮酒造成的。”
ext.ext_en: He told the magazine in an exclusive interview: 'All my problems stem from drink'.

ext.ext_cn: 一些报纸认为自己是独家报道。
ext.ext_en: Some papers thought they had an exclusive.

defs.def_en: If a newspaper, magazine, or broadcasting organization describes one of its reports as exclusive, they mean that it is a special report which does not appear in any other publication or on any other channel.

ext.ext_cn: 所有服务费都不包括增值税。
ext.ext_en: All charges for service are exclusive of value added tax...

ext.ext_cn: 周末滑雪价格为58英镑（不含交通和住宿费）。
ext.ext_en: Skiing weekends cost £58 (exclusive of travel and accommodation).

defs.def_en: If a company states that its prices, goods, or services are exclusive of something, that thing is not included in the stated price, although it usually still has to be paid for.

defs.def_cn: 相互排斥的;互不相容的

ext.ext_cn: 他们两个人都认识到了追求理想和做个好父亲不能两者兼顾。
ext.ext_en: They both have learnt that ambition and successful fatherhood can be mutually exclusive.

defs.def_en: If two things are mutually exclusive, they are separate and very different from each other, so that it is impossible for them to exist or happen together.

ext.ext_cn: 她在一张小桌上摆好盘子和餐具。
ext.ext_en: She arranged plates and cutlery on a small table.

defs.def_en: Cutlery consists of the knives, forks, and spoons that you eat your food with.
You can refer to knives and tools used for cutting as cutlery .

defs.def_cn: (欧盟的)退耕补贴方案(以防止作物产量过多或维持农产品价格)

ext.ext_cn: 退耕地
ext.ext_en: ...set-aside land...

ext.ext_cn: 一个布罗克汉普顿农场共有 1,700 英亩土地退耕闲置，得到了每英亩 87 英镑的补贴。
ext.ext_en: A Brockhampton farm is paid £87 per acre for the 1,700 acres it has in set-aside.

defs.def_en: In the European Union, set-aside is a scheme in which some areas of farmland are not used for a period of time, either because too much is being produced already, or so that a crop does not become too cheap.

ext.ext_cn: 球队主教练说：“托尼挨了一顿狠批，现在已经后悔自己的所作所为了。”
ext.ext_en: The team manager said: 'Tony has had a good talking-to and regrets his action'.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a talking-to, you speak to them severely, usually about something unacceptable that they have done, in order to show them they were wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 让人惊叹的；令人敬畏的；使人畏怯的

ext.ext_cn: 爱尔兰的教堂一直掌握着令人敬畏的权力。
ext.ext_en: The church in Ireland has always exercised an awesome power.

ext.ext_cn: 将士兵送上战场的神圣责任
ext.ext_en: ...the awesome responsibility of sending men into combat.

defs.def_en: An awesome person or thing is very impressive and often frightening.
Detergent is a chemical substance, usually in the form of a powder or liquid, which is used for washing things such as clothes or dishes.

ext.ext_cn: 他摔了一跤，扭伤了脚踝。
ext.ext_en: He fell and sprained his ankle.

defs.def_en: If you sprain a joint such as your ankle or wrist, you accidentally damage it by twisting it or bending it violently.
A sprain is the injury caused by spraining a joint.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是要求你看到问题的两面后再作出理性的决定。
ext.ext_en: He's asking you to look at both sides of the case and come to a rational decision...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽能够保持头脑清醒理智，因而迅速做出反应。
ext.ext_en: Mary was able to short-circuit her stress response by keeping her thoughts calm and rational.

defs.def_en: Rational decisions and thoughts are based on reason rather than on emotion.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他看起来是一个正常而理智的人吗？
ext.ext_en: Did he come across as a sane rational person?...

ext.ext_cn: 雷切尔现在看上去更加平静、更加理智了。
ext.ext_en: Rachel looked calmer and more rational now.

defs.def_en: A rational person is someone who is sensible and is able to make decisions based on intelligent thinking rather than on emotion.
Someone's kinsman is their male relative.

defs.def_cn: 同…谈恋爱；与…发生性关系

ext.ext_cn: 我与诺丁汉的一位帅小伙儿交往过。
ext.ext_en: I got off with a cute boy from Nottingham.

defs.def_en: If you get off with someone, you start a romantic or sexual relationship with them.

ext.ext_cn: 上布丁，把酸奶碗传一下，用酸奶拌着布丁吃。
ext.ext_en: Serve the pudding, and pass around a bowl of yogurt to go with it...

ext.ext_cn: 我讲的时候大家把这个传一下，稍微看一眼。
ext.ext_en: Just pass this round as I'm talking and take a little look at it...

defs.def_en: If a group of people pass something around or pass it round, they each take it and then give it to the next person.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 卡桑德拉注意到他因为他长得帅气。
ext.ext_en: Cassandra noticed him because he was good-looking.

ext.ext_cn: 漂亮女人
ext.ext_en: ...a good-looking woman.

defs.def_en: Someone who is good-looking has an attractive face.  →see usage note at:pretty

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她种了很多我不熟悉的奇妙植物。
ext.ext_en: She grew many wonderful plants that were unfamiliar to me...

ext.ext_cn: 我在一个陌生的城市里形单影只。
ext.ext_en: I was alone in an unfamiliar city.

defs.def_en: If something is unfamiliar to you, you know nothing or very little about it, because you have not seen or experienced it before.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她不会说日语，也不了解日本文化。
ext.ext_en: She speaks no Japanese and is unfamiliar with Japanese culture.

defs.def_en: If you are unfamiliar with something, it is unfamiliar to you.

defs.def_cn: 大量投寄；成批邮寄；群发

ext.ext_cn: 本周该公司群发了其年度报告。
ext.ext_en: This week, the company mailed out its annual report.

defs.def_en: If someone mails out things such as letters, leaflets, or bills, they send them to a large number of people at the same time.

ext.ext_cn: 她在人行横道上被撞死了。
ext.ext_en: She was mown down on a pedestrian crossing...

ext.ext_cn: 持枪歹徒在一次袭击中射杀了10个人。
ext.ext_en: Gunmen mowed down 10 people in one attack.

defs.def_en: If someone is mown down, they are killed violently by a vehicle or gunfire.

ext.ext_cn: 布劳顿星期一称病请了一天假来粉刷栅栏。
ext.ext_en: Broughton took a sickie on Monday to paint his fence.

defs.def_en: If someone takes a sickie, they take a day off work saying that they are ill, especially when they are not actually ill.

defs.def_cn: 顺利地通过;轻易地做成

ext.ext_cn: 她顺利地通过数学考试，而他却异常地吃力。
ext.ext_en: While she sailed through her maths exams, he struggled...

ext.ext_cn: 该协议以 495 票对 61 票在法国国民议会顺利通过。
ext.ext_en: The agreement sailed through the French national assembly by 495 votes to 61.

defs.def_en: If someone or something sails through a difficult situation or experience, they deal with it easily and successfully.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他偶尔要注射药物保持身体健康，但除此之外他生活一切正常。
ext.ext_en: He has occasional injections to maintain his good health but otherwise he lives a normal life...

ext.ext_cn: 两国恢复了正常的外交关系。
ext.ext_en: The two countries resumed normal diplomatic relations...

defs.def_en: Something that is normal is usual and ordinary, and is what people expect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 身体健康的;精神正常的

ext.ext_cn: 统计显示抑郁症患者比正常人更容易生病。
ext.ext_en: Statistics indicate that depressed patients are more likely to become ill than are normal people...

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿会一切正常吗？
ext.ext_en: Will the baby be normal?

defs.def_en: A normal person has no serious physical or mental health problems.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人怜悯的；使人同情的；可怜的

ext.ext_cn: 他听起来既可怜兮兮的，又对想要的东西充满渴望。
ext.ext_en: He sounded both pitiful and eager to get what he wanted...

ext.ext_cn: 这是我看到过的最令人同情的一幕。
ext.ext_en: It was the most pitiful sight I had ever seen.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is pitiful is so sad, weak, or small that you feel pity for them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 选择余地极小，而且其中一些产品的质量很差。
ext.ext_en: The choice is pitiful and the quality of some of the products is very low...

ext.ext_cn: 农场主支付的报酬少得可怜，还经常是以食物和衣服的形式。
ext.ext_en: The farmers pay pitiful wages, often in the form of food and clothes.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as pitiful, you mean that it is completely inadequate.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这一论点似乎表现出对我们陪审团能力的极度不信任，而这种不信任是可悲的。
ext.ext_en: This argument seems to show a pitiful lack of confidence in the capabilities of our juries.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as pitiful, you mean that it does not deserve respect or consideration.

ext.ext_cn: 服务沿海地区的地方广播电台经常为驾驶游艇出海的人播报天气预报。
ext.ext_en: Local radio stations serving coastal areas often broadcast forecasts for yachtsmen...

ext.ext_cn: 出售的鱼来自我们自己的近海水域。
ext.ext_en: The fish are on sale from our own coastal waters.

defs.def_en: Coastal is used to refer to things that are in the sea or on the land near a coast.

ext.ext_cn: 涂着热蛋奶沙司的樱桃松糕布丁
ext.ext_en: ...a cherry sponge pudding with warm custard.

defs.def_en: A pudding is a cooked sweet food made with flour, fat, and eggs, and usually served hot.

ext.ext_cn: 一份包含开胃面包、头道菜、主菜和甜点的菜单
ext.ext_en: ...a menu featuring canapes, a starter, a main course and a pudding...

ext.ext_cn: 我一直坚持用新鲜水果做甜点。
ext.ext_en: I tend to stick to fresh fruit for pudding.

defs.def_en: Some people refer to the sweet course of a meal as the pudding.

defs.def_cn: 布丁好坏，不尝不知；试过才知好坏
defs.def_en: If you say the proof of the pudding or the proof of the pudding is in the eating, you mean that something new can only be judged to be good or bad after it has been tried or used.

defs.def_cn: 过关斩将进入到;打拼到;闯到

ext.ext_cn: 击败世界头号选手后闯入决赛的萨巴蒂尼
ext.ext_en: ...Sabatini, who won through to the final after defeating the world number one.

defs.def_en: If you win through to a particular position or stage of a competition, you achieve it after a great effort or by defeating opponents.

ext.ext_cn: 卡罗琳唱了她歌曲中的两段和副歌部分。
ext.ext_en: Caroline sang two verses and the chorus of her song...

ext.ext_cn: 唱到副歌时，大家都跟着一起唱起来。
ext.ext_en: Everyone joined in the chorus.

defs.def_en: A chorus is a part of a song which is repeated after each verse.

ext.ext_cn: 合唱团在唱《欢乐颂》。
ext.ext_en: The chorus was singing 'The Ode to Joy'.

defs.def_en: A chorus is a large group of people who sing together.

ext.ext_cn: 《哈利路亚合唱曲》
ext.ext_en: ...the Hallelujah Chorus.

defs.def_en: A chorus is a piece of music written to be sung by a large group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 学生扮演一些次要角色，并且参与合唱。
ext.ext_en: Students played the lesser parts and sang in the chorus.

defs.def_en: A chorus is a group of singers or dancers who perform together in a show, in contrast to the soloists.

defs.def_cn: 齐声，异口同声(表示批评、反对或赞扬)

ext.ext_cn: 面对日渐高涨的齐声指责，政府不断为其经济政策辩护。
ext.ext_en: The government is defending its economic policies against a growing chorus of criticism.

defs.def_en: When there is a chorus of criticism, disapproval, or praise, that attitude is expressed by a lot of people at the same time.

ext.ext_cn: “嗨，”他们齐声招呼道。
ext.ext_en: 'Hi,' they chorused.

ext.ext_cn: 迎接他的是大家齐唱《祝你生日快乐》，令他非常感动。
ext.ext_en: He was greeted with a rousing chorus of Happy Birthday...

defs.def_en: When people chorus something, they say it or sing it together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 大部分宗教都教导人要诚实。
ext.ext_en: Most religions teach you to be truthful…

ext.ext_cn: 我们都学会了要非常坦诚地对待自己的个人生活。
ext.ext_en: We've all learnt to be fairly truthful about our personal lives...

defs.def_en: If a person or their comments are truthful, they are honest and do not tell any lies.

defs.def_cn: 杂用间，用具存放室（通常与厨房相邻，内有洗衣机、水池、清洗设备等）
defs.def_en: A utility room is a room in a house which is usually connected to the kitchen and which contains things such as a washing machine, sink, and cleaning equipment.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管现在流行所谓的健康茶饮，但没有证据证明这些茶更有益健康。
ext.ext_en: Despite the vogue for so-called health teas, there is no evidence that they are any healthier...

ext.ext_cn: 在英国，这些书还算流行。
ext.ext_en: In Britain there's been something of a vogue for these books.

defs.def_en: If there is a vogue for something, it is very popular and fashionable.

ext.ext_cn: 浅色比黄褐色和红棕色这些秋季色彩更流行。
ext.ext_en: Pale colours are much more in vogue than autumnal bronzes and coppers.

ext.ext_cn: 60年代末流行的嬉皮士形象
ext.ext_en: ...the hippie-ethnic look which came into vogue in the late 60s.

defs.def_en: If something is in vogue, is very popular and fashionable. If it comes into vogue, it becomes very popular and fashionable.
A fag is a cigarette.
A fag is a homosexual.
Evaporated milk is thick sweet milk that is sold in cans.

defs.def_cn: 白俄罗斯的;白俄罗斯人的；白俄罗斯文化的
defs.def_en: Byelorussian means belonging or relating to Byelorussia or to its people or culture.

defs.def_cn: 白俄罗斯人;白俄罗斯裔人
defs.def_en: A Byelorussian is a Byelorussian citizen, or a person of Byelorussian origin.

defs.def_cn: (某事物发展的)尖端，最前沿，领先阶段

ext.ext_cn: 该造船厂的造船技术处于世界最前沿。
ext.ext_en: This shipyard is at the cutting edge of world shipbuilding technology.

defs.def_en: If you are at the cutting edge of a particular field of activity, you are involved in its most important or most exciting developments.

ext.ext_cn: 要是皮尔斯没生病，我们就赢了。我们失去了他这个优势。
ext.ext_en: If Pearce had been fit, we would have won. We missed the cutting edge he would have given us.

defs.def_en: If someone or something gives you a cutting edge, they give you an advantage over your competitors.

defs.def_cn: 最前沿的;最先进的;尖端的

ext.ext_cn: 我们正在开发的是一种在澳大利亚从未有过的尖端技术。
ext.ext_en: What we are planning is cutting-edge technology never seen in Australia before...

ext.ext_cn: 正在帕卡德那里进行的某些研究属于前沿医学范畴。
ext.ext_en: Some of what is happening at Packard is cutting-edge medicine.

defs.def_en: Cutting-edge techniques or equipment are the most advanced that there are in a particular field.

ext.ext_cn: 直到后来很久我才对他的真实目的略知一二。
ext.ext_en: I had no inkling of his real purpose until much later...

ext.ext_cn: 我们隐约感觉可能正有什么事情发生。
ext.ext_en: We had an inkling that something might be happening.

defs.def_en: If you have an inkling of something, you have a vague idea about it.

defs.def_cn: （尝试或行动）失败的，夭折的，无结果的

ext.ext_cn: 企图阻止现任总统连任的失败尝试
ext.ext_en: ...an abortive attempt to prevent the current President from taking office.

defs.def_en: An abortive attempt or action is unsuccessful.
A marine is a  member of an armed force, for example the US Marine Corps or the Royal Marines, who is specially trained for military duties at sea as well as on land.

ext.ext_cn: 海洋生物的繁殖地
ext.ext_en: ...breeding grounds for marine life.

ext.ext_cn: 海洋生物学研究
ext.ext_en: ...research in marine biology.

defs.def_en: Marine is used to describe things relating to the sea or to the animals and plants that live in the sea.

ext.ext_cn: 专攻海事法的律师
ext.ext_en: ...a solicitor specialising in marine law.

ext.ext_cn: 海事保险索赔
ext.ext_en: ...marine insurance claims.

defs.def_en: Marine is used to describe things relating to ships and their movement at sea.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不成形的;无定形的;样子不好看的

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽姨妈总是穿一些没款没形的黑色裙子。
ext.ext_en: Aunt Mary wore shapeless black dresses.

defs.def_en: Something that is shapeless does not have a distinct or attractive shape.
A shuttlecock is the small object that you hit over the net in a game of badminton. It is rounded at one end and has real or artificial feathers fixed in the other end.
A dictator is a ruler who has complete power in a country, especially power which was obtained by force and is used unfairly or cruelly.
A doughnut is a bread-like cake made from sweet dough that has been cooked in hot fat.

ext.ext_cn: 第二天早晨我早早地起床了。
ext.ext_en: I got up early the next morning.

ext.ext_cn: 下一趟可搭乘的航班
ext.ext_en: ...the next available flight...

defs.def_en: The next period of time, event, person, or thing is the one that comes immediately after the present one or after the previous one.

ext.ext_cn: 我们下周组织一次盛大的晚会吧。
ext.ext_en: Let's plan a big night next week...

ext.ext_cn: 他明年一月退休。
ext.ext_en: He retires next January...

defs.def_en: You use next in expressions such as next Friday ,next day and next year to refer, for example, to the first Friday, day, or year that comes after the present or previous one.

ext.ext_cn: 格雷斯重重的叹息声连隔壁房间的特里斯都能听见。
ext.ext_en: Grace sighed so heavily that Trish could hear it in the next room...

ext.ext_cn: 邻座的男士睡着了。
ext.ext_en: The man in the next chair was asleep...

defs.def_en: The next place or person is the one that is nearest to you or that is the first one that you come to.

ext.ext_cn: 接着，合上双眼，然后再用力闭紧。
ext.ext_en: Next, close your eyes then screw them up tight...

ext.ext_cn: 我不知道接着该干什么了。
ext.ext_en: I don't know what to do next...

defs.def_en: The thing that happens next is the thing that happens immediately after something else.

ext.ext_cn: 我在伯克郡他的家中再次见到了他。
ext.ext_en: I next saw him at his house in Berkshire...

ext.ext_cn: 我们再次见面时，他愉快多了。
ext.ext_en: When we next met, he was much more jovial.

defs.def_en: When you next do something, you do it for the first time since you last did it.

ext.ext_cn: 他唯一缺的就是个儿子，我想他觉得有个外孙也不错。
ext.ext_en: The one thing he didn't have was a son. I think he's felt that a grandson is the next best thing...

ext.ext_cn: 水仙花的栽培量至少是第二种植大国荷兰的3倍。
ext.ext_en: At least three times more daffodils are grown than in Holland, the next largest grower.

defs.def_en: You use next to say that something has more of a particular quality than all other things except one. For example, the thing that is next best is the one that is the best except for one other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 下下周在伯恩茅斯举行的该党年会
ext.ext_en: ...the party's annual conference, to be held in Bournemouth the week after next.

defs.def_en: You use after next in expressions such as the week after next to refer to a period of time after the next one. For example, when it is May, the month after next is July.

ext.ext_cn: 我和别人一样愉快。
ext.ext_en: I enjoy pleasure as much as the next person...

ext.ext_cn: 我和别人一样雄心勃勃，想进入最高管理层。
ext.ext_en: I'm as ambitious as the next man. I'd like to manage at the very highest level.

defs.def_en: If you say that you do something or experience something as much as the next person, you mean that you are no different from anyone else in the respect mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 接下来(我)所知道的;出乎意料的是

ext.ext_cn: 我俯身去拿那些零钱，接下来就突然感到脚踝剧痛。
ext.ext_en: I had leaned over to pick up some change, and the next thing I knew I felt this terrible pain in my ankle.

defs.def_en: You can say the next thing I knew to suggest that a new situation which you are describing was surprising because it happened very suddenly.

ext.ext_cn: 她紧挨着他在沙发上坐下了。
ext.ext_en: She sat down next to him on the sofa.

ext.ext_cn: 在紧靠埃及边境的加沙地带南端
ext.ext_en: ...at the southern end of the Gaza Strip next to the Egyptian border...

defs.def_en: If one thing is next to another thing, it is at the other side of it.

ext.ext_cn: 对她而言，孩子们的重要性仅次于她的事业。
ext.ext_en: Her children were the number two priority in her life next to her career...

ext.ext_cn: 对食品杂货零售商来说，给货物贴价签也是劳动力成本中最为昂贵的一个部分，仅次于雇佣收银员的费用。
ext.ext_en: Next to the expense of cashiers, pricing items is one of the costliest labor costs of grocery retailers.

defs.def_en: You use next to in order to give the most important aspect of something when comparing it with another aspect.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰逊仍然对烟草几乎一无所知。
ext.ext_en: Johnson still knew next to nothing about tobacco...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数预制减肥产品几乎都没有什么功效。
ext.ext_en: Most pre-prepared weight loss products are next to useless.

defs.def_en: You use next to before a negative, or a word that suggests something negative, to mean almost, but not completely.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有知识的;了解情况的;见多识广的

ext.ext_cn: 了解情况的人知道该公司状况不佳。
ext.ext_en: Informed people know the company is shaky.

ext.ext_cn: 使公众适当知情的重要性
ext.ext_en: ...the importance of keeping the public properly informed.

defs.def_en: See also:well-informed;Someone who is informed knows about a subject or what is happening in the world.

ext.ext_cn: 据可靠消息,那些被拘捕者当中至少有一位少将。
ext.ext_en: According to informed sources, those taken into custody include at least one major-general.

defs.def_en: When journalists talk about informed sources, they mean people who are likely to give correct information because of their private or special knowledge.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (猜测或决策)明智的,有见识的

ext.ext_cn: 据合理猜测，他的个人财产有 12.5 亿美元。
ext.ext_en: An informed guess at his personal wealth was $1.25 billion...

ext.ext_cn: 我们能够更加明智地选择如何使用药物。
ext.ext_en: We are able to make more informed choices about how we use drugs.

defs.def_en: An informed guess or decision is one that likely to be good, because it is based on definite knowledge or information.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有益的；有利的；有帮助的

ext.ext_cn: 对我们健康有益的维生素
ext.ext_en: ...vitamins which are beneficial to our health...

ext.ext_cn: 使用计算机对孩子们的学习有益。
ext.ext_en: Using computers has a beneficial effect on children's learning.

defs.def_en: Something that is beneficial helps people or improves their lives.

defs.def_cn: 观察自然;(儿童的)自然课

ext.ext_cn: 他们周末开车进山去观察自然。
ext.ext_en: They drove into the mountains for a weekend of nature study.

defs.def_en: Nature study is the study of animals and plants by looking at them directly, for example when it is taught to young children.
Aphids are very small insects which live on plants and suck their juices.

ext.ext_cn: 让建筑师大为懊恼的是，我们搬进去最先做的事情之一就是换掉了花饰铅条窗。
ext.ext_en: One of the first things we did when we moved in, to the chagrin of the architect, was to replace the leaded windows.

defs.def_en: Chagrin is a feeling of disappointment, upset, or annoyance, perhaps because of your own failure.
A car that is fitted with automatic transmission has a gear system in which the gears change automatically.
A bus lane is a part of the road which is intended to be used only by buses.

ext.ext_cn: 我年轻时的抱负是成为一个发明家。
ext.ext_en: In my youth my ambition had been to be an inventor.

ext.ext_cn: 我少年时代看的漫画书
ext.ext_en: ...the comic books of my youth.

defs.def_en: Someone's youth is the period of their life during which they are a child, before they are a fully mature adult.

ext.ext_cn: 格雷戈里仍为香农的朝气、快乐和美丽着迷。
ext.ext_en: Gregory was still enchanted with Shannon's youth and joy and beauty...

ext.ext_cn: 这个队如今既经验丰富又充满朝气。
ext.ext_en: The team is now a good mixture of experience and youth.

defs.def_en: Youth is the quality or state of being young.

defs.def_cn: （新闻用语，尤指惹麻烦的）青年，小伙子

ext.ext_cn: 打碎玻璃橱窗抢劫商店的成群的年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...gangs of youths who broke windows and looted shops...

ext.ext_cn: 一名17岁的年轻人昨天被还押候审。
ext.ext_en: A 17-year-old youth was remanded in custody yesterday.

defs.def_en: Journalists often refer to young men as youths, especially when they are reporting that the young men have caused trouble.

ext.ext_cn: 他代表着当今年轻人的看法。
ext.ext_en: He represents the opinions of the youth of today...

ext.ext_cn: 她对这个国家的青年一代没什么好影响。
ext.ext_en: She's not a very good influence on the youth of this country.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as unnerving, you mean that it makes you feel worried or uncomfortable.

defs.def_en: If you bend something that is flat or straight, you use force to make it curved or to put an angle in it.

ext.ext_en: The road bent slightly to the right...

ext.ext_en: Glass bends light of different colours by different amounts.

defs.def_en: When a road, beam of light, or other long thin thing bends, or when something bends it, it changes direction to form a curve or angle.

defs.def_en: A bend in a road, pipe, or other long thin object is a curve or angle in it.

defs.def_en: If someone bends to your wishes, they believe or do something different, usually when they do not want to.

defs.def_cn: 曲解，通融，篡改（规则、法律等）

ext.ext_en: A minority of officers were prepared to bend the rules.

defs.def_en: If you bend rules or laws, you interpret them in a way that allows you to do something they would not normally allow you to do.

ext.ext_en: Sometimes we bend the truth a little in order to spare them the pain of the real facts.

defs.def_en: If you bend the truth or bend the facts, you say something that is not exactly true.

ext.ext_en: People are bending over backwards to please customers.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is bending over backwards to be helpful or kind, you are emphasizing that they are trying very hard to be helpful or kind.

ext.ext_en: And can you make that tea before your fidgeting drives me completely round the bend.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something drives you round the bend, you mean that you dislike them and they annoy or upset you very much.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is round the bend, you mean that they do foolish or silly things.

defs.def_en: If a child has a tantrum, they lose their temper in a noisy and uncontrolled way. If you say that an adult is throwing a tantrum, you are criticizing them for losing their temper and acting in a childish way.

defs.def_en: Someone who is litigious often makes formal complaints about people to a civil court of law.

defs.def_en: See also:hormone replacement therapy;If you refer to the replacement of one thing by another, you mean that the second thing takes the place of the first.

defs.def_cn: 替补(成员或队员)；接替者

ext.ext_en: Taylor has nominated Adams as his replacement...

ext.ext_en: The 18-year-old made his debut last week as a replacement for the injured Gordon Durie.

ext.ext_en: They shut down the nuclear reactor for safety reasons.

ext.ext_cn: 近两周来选举受到了热烈关注。

ext.ext_en: His parents tried to discourage his interest in music, but he persisted...

defs.def_en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

ext.ext_cn: 要鼓励孩子的兴趣爱好，即使你对它们所知甚少。
ext.ext_en: Encourage your child in her interests and hobbies even if they're things that you know little about...

ext.ext_cn: 他在米尔菲尔德私立学校上学的时候培养了广泛的运动爱好。

ext.ext_en: That passage interested me because it seems to parallel very closely what you're doing in the novel...

ext.ext_en: It may interest you to know that Miss Woods, the housekeeper, witnessed the attack.

ext.ext_en: In the meantime I can't interest you in a new car, I suppose?...

ext.ext_cn: 这个团体没能说服他们再版专门面向女性的文学作品。
ext.ext_en: The group wasn't able to interest them in reproducing literature specifically for women.

defs.def_en: If you are trying to persuade someone to buy or do something, you can say that you are trying to interest them in it.

ext.ext_cn: 那些董事行事时是以他们俱乐部的最大利益为出发点吗？
ext.ext_en: Did those directors act in the best interests of their club?...

ext.ext_cn: 这位社会工作者会设法让她明白她这么做对这个男孩没有好处。
ext.ext_en: The social worker would try to get her to see she was acting against the boy's interests.

defs.def_en: If something is in the interests of a particular person or group, it will benefit them in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 政府不指名地谴责“外国利益集团”煽动骚乱。
ext.ext_en: The government accused unnamed 'foreign interests' of inciting the trouble...

ext.ext_cn: 他在大选到来仅几周前辞去了财政部长职务,并抵制大公司利益集团。
ext.ext_en: He resigned as finance minister only weeks before the election and stood against big-business interests.

defs.def_en: You can use interests to refer to groups of people who you think use their power or money to benefit themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 她其他的公司股权包括斯堪的纳维亚的一个主题游乐园和英格兰西南部的几家酒店。
ext.ext_en: Her other business interests include a theme park in Scandinavia and hotels in the West Country.

ext.ext_cn: 掌控大量奶业股权的哈奇家族
ext.ext_en: ...the Hatch family, who controlled large dairy interests...

defs.def_en: A person or organization that has interests in a company or in a particular type of business owns shares in this company or this type of business.

ext.ext_cn: 东欧民主力量的发展与西方国家利害攸关。
ext.ext_en: The West has an interest in promoting democratic forces in Eastern Europe...

ext.ext_cn: 石油产品的国内消费者希望其来源能够获得保障。
ext.ext_en: Domestic consumers of petroleum products have an interest in a secure source of petroleum products.

defs.def_en: If a person, country, or organization has an interest in a possible event or situation, they want that event or situation to happen because they are likely to benefit from it.

ext.ext_cn: 你的活期账户有利息吗？
ext.ext_en: Does your current account pay interest?...

ext.ext_cn: 这是向较低利率迈出的重要一步。
ext.ext_en: This is an important step toward lower interest rates.

defs.def_en: Interest is extra money that you receive if you have invested a sum of money. Interest is also the extra money that you pay if you have borrowed money or are buying something on credit.

defs.def_cn: 为了（或符合)…的利益;有助于

ext.ext_cn: 呼吁所有商人为了国家稳定而团结协作
ext.ext_en: ...a call for all businessmen to work together in the interests of national stability.

defs.def_en: If you do something in the interests of a particular result or situation, you do it in order to achieve that result or maintain that situation.  to have someone's interests at heart→see: See  heart;

defs.def_cn: (通常指由于剧痛或不适而)扭动，翻滚

ext.ext_cn: 他痛苦地翻滚着。
ext.ext_en: He was writhing in agony...

ext.ext_cn: 这个话题让她难堪得坐立不安。
ext.ext_en: The subject makes her writhe with embarrassment...

defs.def_en: If you writhe, your body twists and turns violently backwards and forwards, usually because you are in great pain or discomfort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他无精打采，脸色苍白，食欲不振。
ext.ext_en: He was listless and pale and wouldn't  eat much.

defs.def_en: Someone who is listless has no energy or enthusiasm.

ext.ext_cn: 乌克兰矿工们已投票决定下个月罢工一天。
ext.ext_en: Mineworkers in the Ukraine have voted for a one-day stoppage next month.

defs.def_en: When there is a stoppage, people stop working because of a disagreement with their employers.

defs.def_cn: (足球等体育运动中的)中断比赛，暂停
defs.def_en: In football and some other sports, when there is a stoppage, the game stops for a short time, for example because a player is injured. The referee may add some extra time at the end of the game because of this.

ext.ext_cn: 他有将近1,000公顷的草场和耕地。
ext.ext_en: He had nearly a thousand acres of grazing and arable land.
