defs.def_en: Grazing or grazing land is land on which animals graze.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （饮料）易使人醉的;（气氛、经历等）令人兴奋的

ext.ext_cn: 在他们新婚燕尔的那些令人陶醉的日子里
ext.ext_en: ...in the heady days just after their marriage...

ext.ext_cn: 我开始兴奋，有些飘飘然了。
ext.ext_en: I felt heady and euphoric.

defs.def_en: A heady drink, atmosphere, or experience strongly affects your senses, for example by making you feel drunk or excited.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 灾难性的;引起重大灾难的

ext.ext_cn: 地震引起的海啸袭击了沿海地区，导致灾难性的破坏。
ext.ext_en: A tidal wave caused by the earthquake hit the coast causing catastrophic damage...

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家的水资源匮乏可能会带来灾难性的后果。
ext.ext_en: The water shortage in this country is potentially catastrophic...

defs.def_en: Something that is catastrophic involves or causes a sudden terrible disaster.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 为从敌对的基督教民兵组织手中夺得控制权而遭遇的再次惨败
ext.ext_en: ...another catastrophic attempt to arrest control from a rival Christian militia...

ext.ext_cn: 他妈妈的过早离世对他具有灾难性的影响。
ext.ext_en: His mother's untimely death had a catastrophic effect on him.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as catastrophic, you mean that it is very bad or unsuccessful.
A ridge is a long, narrow piece of raised land.

ext.ext_cn: 眼窝处突出的骨骼
ext.ext_en: ...the bony ridge of the eye socket.

defs.def_en: A ridge is a raised line on a flat surface.

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔现在仅仅是个不错的朋友而已。
ext.ext_en: Michael is now merely a good friend...

ext.ext_cn: 弗朗西斯·沃森远远不止是个家具行家。
ext.ext_en: Francis Watson was far from being merely a furniture expert...

defs.def_en: You use merely to emphasize that something is only what you say and not better, more important, or more exciting.

defs.def_cn: 只不过，仅仅(用于强调数量之小)

ext.ext_cn: 大脑仅占体重的3%。
ext.ext_en: The brain accounts for merely three per cent of body weight.

defs.def_en: You use merely to emphasize that a particular amount or quantity is very small.

ext.ext_cn: 球队需要的是想为英格兰而战的板球选手，而不是愿为任何国家打球的选手。
ext.ext_en: The team needs players who want to play cricket for England, not merely any country that will have them...

ext.ext_cn: 他所犯的不止是偷窃罪，而是针对老年人的暴力犯罪。
ext.ext_en: His were not merely crimes of theft but of violence against elderly people.

defs.def_en: You use not merely before the less important of two contrasting statements, as a way of emphasizing the more important statement.

defs.def_cn: (某一产品或服务的)市场领先者，市场领导者，行业龙头

ext.ext_cn: 我们正在成为时装业的领军者之一。
ext.ext_en: We are becoming one of the market leaders in the fashion industry.

defs.def_en: A market leader is a company that sells more of a particular product or service than most of its competitors do.

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影打破了先前的票房纪录。
ext.ext_en: The movie became a box-office record breaker.

defs.def_en: A record-breaker is someone or something that beats the previous best result in a sport or other activity.

ext.ext_cn: 门诊部
ext.ext_en: ...the outpatient clinic...

ext.ext_cn: 她作为门诊病人接受了精神科护理。
ext.ext_en: She received psychiatric care as an outpatient.

defs.def_en: An outpatient is someone who receives treatment at a hospital but does not spend the night there.

ext.ext_cn: 呈交立法机关的提案内容包括成立两个专门审理暴力犯罪的特别法庭。
ext.ext_en: The proposals before the legislature include the creation of two special courts to deal exclusively with violent crimes.

defs.def_en: The legislature of a particular state or country is the group of people in it who have the power to make and pass laws.

ext.ext_cn: 我努力匆匆地写下那些名字。
ext.ext_en: I attempted to scribble down the names...

ext.ext_cn: 他要了我的姓名和地址，匆匆写在他的笔记本上。
ext.ext_en: He took my name and address, scribbling it down in his notebook.

defs.def_en: If you scribble down something, you write it quickly or roughly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （言辞、文字等）表达生动的，有说服力的

ext.ext_cn: 在那次晚宴上，我听到他作了一番非常有说服力的陈词。
ext.ext_en: I heard him make a very eloquent speech at that dinner.

defs.def_en: Speech or writing that is eloquent is well expressed and effective in persuading people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 雄辩的;口才流利的;能言善辩的

ext.ext_cn: 他说起自己对书的喜爱来就会停不住嘴。
ext.ext_en: He was eloquent about his love of books.

ext.ext_cn: 非常能言善辩的德国评论家
ext.ext_en: ...one particularly eloquent German critic.

defs.def_en: A person who is eloquent is good at speaking and able to persuade people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （关系、协定、讨论）融洽的，和睦的，友好的

ext.ext_cn: 他们关系融洽的部分原因是他们有着相似的目标。
ext.ext_en: Their harmonious relationship resulted in part from their similar goals...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个和睦的集体，学生们开心玩耍，用功读书。
ext.ext_en: It is a harmonious community where pupils are happy and industrious.

defs.def_en: A harmonious relationship, agreement, or discussion is friendly and peaceful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这里的建筑风格和谐统一，没有哪座楼房高于五六层。
ext.ext_en: The architecture is harmonious and no building is over five or six floors high.

ext.ext_cn: 头脑、身体和心灵的协调
ext.ext_en: ...a harmonious balance of mind, body, and spirit.

defs.def_en: Something that is harmonious has parts which go well together and which are in proportion to each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 发出悦耳声音的神秘技巧
ext.ext_en: ...the mysterious skill involved in producing harmonious sounds.

defs.def_en: Musical notes that are harmonious produce a pleasant sound when played together.

ext.ext_cn: 找到能让你大力击球的准确握拍方法。
ext.ext_en: Find the exact grip that allows you to hit the ball hard...

ext.ext_cn: 她狠狠地打在他的左臂上。
ext.ext_en: She hit him hard across his left arm...

defs.def_en: If you hit someone or something, you deliberately touch them with a lot of force, with your hand or an object held in your hand.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车显然是撞上了一个交通标志牌后打滑失控的。
ext.ext_en: The car had apparently hit a traffic sign before skidding out of control...

ext.ext_cn: 她撞上了最后一个跨栏，整个人趴在了跑道上。
ext.ext_en: She hit the last barrier and sprawled across the track.

defs.def_en: When one thing hits another, it touches it with a lot of force.

ext.ext_cn: 可一次击中多个目标的多弹头导弹
ext.ext_en: ...multiple-warhead missiles that could hit many targets at a time...

ext.ext_cn: 医院被重炮击中。
ext.ext_en: The hospital had been hit with heavy artillery fire.

defs.def_en: If a bomb or missile hits its target, it reaches it.

ext.ext_cn: 向汽车驾驶员每年收取75英镑高速公路使用费的计划将对我大为不利。
ext.ext_en: The plan to charge motorists £75 a year to use the motorway is going to hit me hard...

ext.ext_cn: 约200人在秘鲁北部发生的地震中丧生。
ext.ext_en: About two-hundred people died in the earthquake which hit northern Peru...

defs.def_en: If something hits a person, place, or thing, it affects them very badly.

ext.ext_cn: 我突然意识到我有选择的余地。
ext.ext_en: It hit me that I had a choice...

ext.ext_cn: 然后我突然想到了答案，原来它一直就明摆在我的面前。
ext.ext_en: Then the answer hit me. It had been staring me in the face.

defs.def_en: When a feeling or an idea hits you, it suddenly affects you or comes into your mind.

ext.ext_cn: 他承认自己跌到了一生中的最低谷。
ext.ext_en: He admits to having hit the lowest point in his life ...

ext.ext_cn: 油价昨天达到了创纪录的水平。
ext.ext_en: Oil prices hit record levels yesterday.

defs.def_en: If you hit a particular high or low point on a scale of something such as success or health, you reach it.

defs.def_cn: 成功而轰动（或风行）一时的事物（如唱片、电影或戏剧）

ext.ext_cn: 这首歌在1945年风靡大江南北。
ext.ext_en: The song became a massive hit in 1945.

ext.ext_cn: 本年度出乎意料的热门视频
ext.ext_en: ...the surprise hit video of the year.

defs.def_en: If a CD, film, or play is a hit, it is very popular and successful.

ext.ext_cn: 我们这个小公司的因特网网页已经有了78,000次的点击量。
ext.ext_en: Our small company has had 78,000 hits on its Internet pages.

defs.def_en: A hit is a single visit to a website.

defs.def_cn: （在因特网上的）查询结果，检索结果
defs.def_en: If someone who is searching for information on the Internet gets a hit, they find a website where there is that information.

ext.ext_cn: 爸爸和沃尔特很快就一见如故。
ext.ext_en: They hit it off straight away, Daddy and Walter...

ext.ext_cn: 你们俩人合得来吗？
ext.ext_en: How well did you hit it off with one another?

defs.def_en: If two people hit it off, they like each other and become friendly as soon as they meet.

defs.def_cn: 大受欢迎;深受…的喜爱;令…印象深刻

ext.ext_cn: 他深受索普威思太太的喜爱。
ext.ext_en: He made a hit with Lady Sopwith...

ext.ext_cn: 她向你问好——看得出来你在那里大受欢迎。
ext.ext_en: She sends her best wishes — you've obviously made a hit there.

defs.def_en: If you make a hit with someone, they like you or are impressed by you when they meet you.
A tomb is a large grave that is above ground and that usually has a sculpture or other decoration on it.
A housing development is the same as a housing estate .
The head boy of a school is the boy who is the leader of the prefects and who often represents the school on public occasions.
An upright piano is a piano in which the strings are arranged vertically, rather than horizontally as they are in a grand piano.

defs.def_cn: 宣讲会，座谈会(学生、教师就某一话题举行的讨论会)
defs.def_en: A teach-in is a meeting, usually between students and teachers, with discussions on important and interesting topics. Teach-ins are not usually part of a formal academic course.

defs.def_cn: 也许(会发生或出现);可能(会如此)

ext.ext_cn: 今天可能会下点雨。
ext.ext_en: We may have some rain today...

ext.ext_cn: 费率也许会提高，但幅度不会太大，时间也不会太长。
ext.ext_en: Rates may rise, but it won't be by much and it won't be for long...

defs.def_en: You use may to indicate that something will possibly happen or be true in the future, but you cannot be certain.

defs.def_cn: 有可能，也许(用于表示某事可能属实，但不确定)

ext.ext_cn: 负责民权事务的官员说可能还有数百宗种族暴力事件。
ext.ext_en: Civil rights officials say there may be hundreds of other cases of racial violence...

ext.ext_cn: 他们说用钱砸不见得是个好主意。
ext.ext_en: Throwing good money after bad may not be a good idea, they say.

defs.def_en: You use may to indicate that there is a possibility that something is true, but you cannot be certain.

defs.def_cn: 也许，可能(用于表示某事有时或在某些情况下属实)

ext.ext_cn: 素食也许不足以提供一个孩子正常成长所需的热量。
ext.ext_en: A vegetarian diet may not provide enough calories for a child's normal growth...

ext.ext_cn: 山上的积雪可能厚达5英寸。
ext.ext_en: Up to five inches of snow may cover the mountains.

defs.def_en: You use may to indicate that something is sometimes true or is true in some circumstances.

defs.def_cn: (与过去分词连用，用于表示有可能已经发生、属实或给出一个可能的解释)

ext.ext_cn: 那些地方他也许去过一些。
ext.ext_en: He may have been to some of those places...

ext.ext_cn: 混乱可能导致多达20 人丧生。
ext.ext_en: The chaos may have contributed to the deaths of up to 20 people...

defs.def_en: You use may have with a past participle when suggesting that it is possible that something happened or was true, or when giving a possible explanation for something.

defs.def_cn: 尽管，或许(用于承认情况属实，但同时与更重要的事情作比较)

ext.ext_cn: 尽管我已经快到了知天命的岁数，但记忆却不那么糟糕。
ext.ext_en: I may be almost 50, but there's not a lot of things I've forgotten...

ext.ext_cn: 这位老人也许并没有代表性，但他所说的话却代表着相当一部分人的观点。
ext.ext_en: The elderly man may not be typical, but he speaks for a significant body of opinion...

defs.def_en: You use may in statements where you are accepting the truth of a situation, but contrasting it with something that is more important.

defs.def_cn: 可以(用于举出在需要时可以加以利用的某些特性、事实等)

ext.ext_cn: 这个包配有细带子，可以肩挎，也可以手拎。
ext.ext_en: The bag has narrow straps, so it may be worn over the shoulder or carried in the hand...

ext.ext_cn: 中年时期的一些疾病可以通过改善营养的方式来预防。
ext.ext_en: Some of the diseases of middle age may be prevented by improving nutrition.

defs.def_en: You use may when you are mentioning a quality or fact about something that people can make use of if they want to.

defs.def_cn: (通常根据规则或法律)可以/不可以

ext.ext_cn: 在苏格兰，如果双方均年满16岁就可以结婚。
ext.ext_en: Any two persons may marry in Scotland provided that both persons are at least 16 years of age on the day of their marriage...

ext.ext_cn: 未满18岁者不得从事需要开车的工作。
ext.ext_en: Adolescents under the age of 18 may not work in jobs that require them to drive.

defs.def_en: You use may to indicate that someone is allowed to do something, usually because of a rule or law. You use may not to indicate that someone is not allowed to do something.

defs.def_cn: 可以(表示准许或请求许可)

ext.ext_cn: 霍布斯先生？我们可以进来吗？
ext.ext_en: Mr Hobbs? May we come in?...

ext.ext_cn: 你想喝的话，现在可以喝一杯牛奶。
ext.ext_en: If you wish, you may now have a glass of milk...

defs.def_en: You use may when you are giving permission to someone to do something, or when asking for permission.

ext.ext_cn: 可以的话，我想用一下你的起居室。
ext.ext_en: I'd like the use of your living room, if I may...

ext.ext_cn: 我可否与您共赴南安普顿？
ext.ext_en: May I come with you to Southampton?...

defs.def_en: You use may when you are making polite requests.

defs.def_cn: 可以,能否（通常用于问句中，表示提出礼貌的建议、请求等)

ext.ext_cn: 可否请您体验一下我们的客房？
ext.ext_en: May we suggest you try one of our guest houses...

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以提议在斯德哥尔摩度周末吗？
ext.ext_en: May we recommend a weekend in Stockholm?...

defs.def_en: You use may, usually in questions, when you are politely making suggestions or offering to do something.

defs.def_cn: 可以(用于有礼貌地插话、提问或引入话题等)

ext.ext_cn: “能打搅一下吗，”肯尼思说。
ext.ext_en: 'If I may interrupt for a moment,' Kenneth said...

ext.ext_cn: 不管怎样，我可以再问您一个问题吗？
ext.ext_en: Anyway, may I just ask you one other thing?...

defs.def_en: You use may as a polite way of interrupting someone, asking a question, or introducing what you are going to say next.

defs.def_cn: 也许会，可能会(用于提及别人对自己所说的话可能会有的反应或态度)

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩，你知道，不论你怎么看，我都是在为生计而拼命工作。
ext.ext_en: You know, Brian, whatever you may think, I work hard for a living...

ext.ext_cn: 您也许会认为这样毫无用处，可是对于我们的客户而言，它却是优质服务的重要体现。
ext.ext_en: You may consider it useless, but for our customers it's an all-important sign of good service.

defs.def_en: You use may when you are mentioning the reaction or attitude that you think someone is likely to have to something you are about to say.

defs.def_cn: 不妨说,可以说(用于强调)

ext.ext_cn: 他们下午都在洛蒙德湖边打高尔夫——顺便提一句，球技糟透了。
ext.ext_en: They spent their afternoons playing golf—extremely badly, I may add—around Loch Lomond...

ext.ext_cn: 可以说，他俩都是绝对可靠的人。
ext.ext_en: Both of them, I may say, are thoroughly reliable  men.

defs.def_en: You use may in expressions such as I may add and I may say in order to emphasize a statement that you are making.

ext.ext_cn: 需要增加外科医生的人数，以便患者能够及早得到救治
ext.ext_en: ...the need for an increase in the numbers of surgeons so that patients may be treated as soon as possible...

ext.ext_cn: 门关着，这样没人能听见说话的内容。
ext.ext_en: The door is shut so that no one may overhear what is said.

defs.def_en: If you do something so that a particular thing may happen, you do it so that there is an opportunity for that thing to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他现在似乎失去了勇气，但愿他能很快重新振作起来。
ext.ext_en: Courage seems now to have deserted him. May it quickly reappear.

defs.def_en: People sometimes use may to express hopes and wishes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她是个妩媚动人的女子。
ext.ext_en: She's a very attractive woman...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得他魅力非凡，才智过人。
ext.ext_en: I thought he was very attractive and obviously very intelligent...

defs.def_en: A person who is attractive is pleasant to look at.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 虽然有些老旧，这仍不失为一个漂亮的小公寓。
ext.ext_en: The flat was small but attractive, if rather shabby...

ext.ext_cn: 在春天，这种乳白色的花朵分外迷人。
ext.ext_en: The creamy white flowers are attractive in the spring.

defs.def_en: Something that is attractive has a pleasant appearance or sound.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 吸引人的;值得拥有（或做）的

ext.ext_cn: 合作不仅仅是诱人的选择，它也是一种责任。
ext.ext_en: Co-operation was more than just an attractive option, it was an obligation...

ext.ext_cn: 吸烟对很多年轻人还是很有诱惑力，他们觉得这让自己显得魅力十足。
ext.ext_en: Smoking is still attractive to many young people who see it as glamorous.

defs.def_en: You can describe something as attractive when it seems worth having or doing.

ext.ext_cn: 政府在恐慌下开始强制实施某种文化统一政策。
ext.ext_en: The government panicked into imposing a kind of cultural homogeneity.

defs.def_en: Homogeneity is the quality of being homogeneous.
Self-sufficiency is the state of being self-sufficient.
A silver birch is a tree with a greyish-white trunk and branches.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 雾蒙蒙的寒冷空气使他脸上感觉很舒爽。
ext.ext_en: The cold, misty air felt wonderful on his face...

ext.ext_cn: 见到你真好。
ext.ext_en: It's wonderful to see you...

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as wonderful, you think they are extremely good.

defs.def_cn: 不重要的小角色;小人物;无关紧要的东西

ext.ext_cn: 与 120 万英镑的总债务相比，他们所欠国内税收署的那点钱实在不算什么。
ext.ext_en: What they owe to the Inland Revenue is small fry compared to the overall £1.2 million debt...

ext.ext_cn: 小人物往往是最后才拿到酬金。
ext.ext_en: It's the small fry who are usually the last to get paid.

defs.def_en: Small fry is used to refer to someone or something that is considered to be unimportant.

ext.ext_cn: 对他们来说，君主政体是国家地位的特殊象征。
ext.ext_en: To them, the monarchy is the special symbol of nationhood...

ext.ext_cn: 虽然两年前就已遭软禁，她在去年的选举中仍然是势力强大的代表人物。
ext.ext_en: She was put under house arrest two years ago but remained a powerful symbol in last year's election.

defs.def_en: Something that is a symbol of a society or an aspect of life seems to represent it because it is very typical of it.

ext.ext_cn: 随后在同一篇诗歌里，叶芝再次将玫瑰作为爱尔兰的标志。
ext.ext_en: Later in this same passage Yeats resumes his argument for the Rose as an Irish symbol...

ext.ext_cn: 我经常用向日葵来作为力量的象征。
ext.ext_en: I frequently use sunflowers as symbols of strength.

defs.def_en: A symbol of something such as an idea is a shape or design that is used to represent it.

ext.ext_cn: 汞的化学元素符号是什么？
ext.ext_en: What's the chemical symbol for mercury?

defs.def_en: A symbol for an item in a calculation or scientific formula is a number, letter, or shape that represents that item.

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲的交流电输出频率通常为50赫兹。
ext.ext_en: In Europe, AC is usually generated at 50 Hz.

ext.ext_cn: 便携式交流发电机
ext.ext_en: ...a portable AC generator.

defs.def_en: AC is used to refer to an electric current that continually changes direction as it flows. AC is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'alternating current'.

ext.ext_cn: 传来一声响亮的枪声。
ext.ext_en: A single shot rang out...

ext.ext_cn: 仅一天中就有 600 多人受伤。
ext.ext_en: Over six hundred people were wounded in a single day...

defs.def_en: You use single to emphasize that you are referring to one thing, and no more than one thing.

ext.ext_cn: 镇上每栋房子都遭到了破坏。
ext.ext_en: Every single house in town had been damaged...

ext.ext_cn: 中东是世界上最为重要的一个产油地。
ext.ext_en: The Middle East is the world's single most important source of oil.

defs.def_en: You use single to indicate that you are considering something on its own and separately from other things like it.

ext.ext_cn: 做单身妈妈难吗？
ext.ext_en: Is it difficult being a single mother?...

ext.ext_cn: 我现在不得不孤单一人度过余生。
ext.ext_en: I now have to face the rest of my life as a single person...

defs.def_en: Someone who is single is not married. You can also use single to describe someone who does not have a girlfriend or boyfriend.

ext.ext_cn: 阿斯蒂尔酒店的单人间价格是 56 英镑一晚。
ext.ext_en: A single room at the Astir Hotel costs £56 a night.

ext.ext_cn: 单人间 65 英镑，双人间 98 英镑，套房 120 英镑。
ext.ext_en: It's £65 for a single, £98 for a double and £120 for an entire suite.

defs.def_en: A single room is a room intended for one person to stay or live in.
A single bed is wide enough for one person to sleep in.

ext.ext_cn: 单程票的价格是 39 英镑。
ext.ext_en: The price of a single ticket is thirty-nine pounds.

ext.ext_cn: 一张去洛杉矶的商务舱单程票
ext.ext_en: ...a Club Class single to Los Angeles.

defs.def_en: A single ticket is a ticket for a journey from one place to another but not back again.

defs.def_cn: (只录几首短歌的)单曲唱片;(激光唱片上的)主打歌曲，单曲

ext.ext_cn: 现在的孩子都不买单曲唱片了。
ext.ext_en: Kids today don't buy singles...

ext.ext_cn: 获胜者将有机会发行自己的单曲唱片。
ext.ext_en: The winners will get a chance to release their own single.

defs.def_en: A single or a CD single is a CD which has a few short songs on it. You can also refer to the main song on a CD as a single .

ext.ext_cn: 德国的鲍里斯·贝克尔赢得男单冠军。
ext.ext_en: Boris Becker of Germany won the men's singles...

ext.ext_cn: 她单打和双打都能得心应手。
ext.ext_en: She is equally at home on the singles or doubles court.

defs.def_en: Singles is a game of tennis or badminton in which one player plays another. The plural singles can be used to refer to one or more of these matches.

defs.def_cn: (板球中的)一分打;(棒球中的)一垒打
defs.def_en: In cricket, a single is a hit from which one run is scored. In baseball, a single is a hit by which a batter reaches first base.
A beanfeast is a party or other social event.

ext.ext_cn: 将军们得把叛国者全部铲除。
ext.ext_en: The generals have to root out traitors...

ext.ext_cn: 把他铲除掉应该不需要太长的时间。
ext.ext_en: It shouldn't take too long to root him out.

defs.def_en: If you root out a person, you find them and force them from the place they are in, usually in order to punish them.

ext.ext_cn: 将会有一场根除腐败的大规模运动。
ext.ext_en: There would be a major drive to root out corruption...

ext.ext_cn: 必须杜绝任何不道德的事发生。
ext.ext_en: Any sort of wrongdoing had to be rooted out.

defs.def_en: If you root out a problem or an unpleasant situation, you find out who or what is the cause of it and put an end to it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 友善的；真诚的；亲切的；和蔼可亲的

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃总是那么友善热情。
ext.ext_en: Bob was always genial and welcoming...

ext.ext_cn: 他是个热心的朋友，也是友善待客的主人。
ext.ext_en: He was a warm-hearted friend and genial host.

defs.def_en: Someone who is genial is kind and friendly.

ext.ext_cn: 布鲁克先生离开巴黎，继续前往贝尔格莱德。
ext.ext_en: Mr Brooke moved on from Paris to Belgrade...

ext.ext_cn: 他想卖掉土地离开这里，这有什么错呢？
ext.ext_en: What's wrong with his wanting to sell his land and move on?

defs.def_en: When you move on somewhere, you leave the place where you have been staying or waiting and go there.

ext.ext_cn: 终于有人叫来警察驱散他们。
ext.ext_en: Eventually the police were called to move them on.

defs.def_en: If someone such as a policeman moves you on, they order you to stop standing in a particular place and to go somewhere else.

defs.def_cn: (结束某活动后) 改做别事

ext.ext_cn: 在决定涉足新的领域时，她经营这家商店已有10年。
ext.ext_en: She ran this shop for ten years before deciding to move on to fresh challenges...

ext.ext_cn: 他妈妈朱莉娅很快又开始了一段新恋情。
ext.ext_en: His mother, Julia, soon moved on to a new relationship...

defs.def_en: If you move on, you finish or stop one activity and start doing something different.

defs.def_cn: 主要地；首要地；最重要地

ext.ext_cn: 这主要是因为主要出口市场发展缓慢。
ext.ext_en: This is principally because the major export markets are slowing...

ext.ext_cn: 胚胎发育似乎主要受制于少数主导基因。
ext.ext_en: Embryonic development seems to be controlled principally by a very small number of master genes.

defs.def_en: Principally means more than anything else.

defs.def_cn: （人、动物或植物）有两性特征的，雌雄同体的，雌雄同序的
defs.def_en: In biology, an androgynous person, animal, or plant has both male and female sexual characteristics.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 兼具两性的；双性并存的；男女不分的

ext.ext_cn: 贝琳达常能以自己的中性特质令男人倾心。
ext.ext_en: Belinda was always attracted to men with an androgynous quality to them...

ext.ext_cn: 这种风格较为中性。
ext.ext_en: The style was quite androgynous.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as androgynous, you mean that they are not distinctly masculine or feminine in appearance or in behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 俄国人必须俯冲轰炸那些城市才能重新获得控制权。
ext.ext_en: The Russians had to dive-bomb the cities to regain control.

defs.def_en: If a plane dive-bombs an area, it suddenly flies down low over it to drop bombs onto it.
The armrests on a chair are the two pieces on either side that support your arms when you are sitting down.

ext.ext_cn: 迟来者就在门外和窗户外站着。
ext.ext_en: The latecomers stood just outside at door and window.

defs.def_en: A latecomer is someone who arrives after the time that they should have done, or later than others.

ext.ext_cn: 把茴香切成薄薄的小片。
ext.ext_en: Cut the fennel into wafer-thin slices.

ext.ext_cn: 如何把萝卜切成薄片
ext.ext_en: ...how to slice radishes wafer thin.

defs.def_en: Wafer-thin means extremely thin and flat.

ext.ext_cn: 来自一个分裂的政党、仅以微弱多数票当选的首相
ext.ext_en: ...a prime minister with a divided party and a wafer-thin majority.

defs.def_en: If you succeed by a wafer-thin margin, you succeed by a very small amount.

ext.ext_cn: 它重近27千克(约65磅)。
ext.ext_en: It weighs nearly 27 kilos (about 65 pounds)...

ext.ext_cn: 这个小金球重0.25盎司。
ext.ext_en: This little ball of gold weighs a quarter of an ounce...

defs.def_en: If someone or something weighs a particular amount, this amount is how heavy they are.

ext.ext_cn: 这台秤可以用来称包裹等其他物品。
ext.ext_en: The scales can be used to weigh other items such as parcels.

defs.def_en: If you weigh something or someone, you measure how heavy they are.

ext.ext_cn: 她在各种选择间权衡斟酌。
ext.ext_en: She weighed her options...

ext.ext_cn: 他正在仔细考虑对那个医生提起刑事诉讼的可能性。
ext.ext_en: He is weighing the possibility of filing criminal charges against the doctor...

defs.def_en: If you weigh the facts about a situation, you consider them very carefully before you make a decision, especially by comparing the various facts involved.

ext.ext_cn: 他说话非常慢，好像每个字都要仔细斟酌。
ext.ext_en: He said the words very slowly, as if weighing each one of them.

defs.def_en: If you weigh your words, you think very carefully before you say something.

ext.ext_cn: 分离使他们两人都十分苦恼。
ext.ext_en: The separation weighed on both of them...

ext.ext_cn: 她知道你哥哥的失踪让你有多忧虑。
ext.ext_en: She knows how your brother's disappearance weighs upon you.

defs.def_en: If a problem weighs on you, it makes you worried or unhappy.

ext.ext_cn: 目前的经济困难大大影响着年轻妇女在寻找有薪水的工作时的决定。
ext.ext_en: Current economic hardships weigh heavily in young women's decisions to find salaried work...

ext.ext_cn: 人类生命对他而言比政策的纯洁性更重要。
ext.ext_en: Human life weighed more with him than purity of policy...

defs.def_en: Something that weighs heavily in a situation has a strong influence or important effect on it.

defs.def_cn: (说话)机关枪似的，连珠炮似的；（行动）一刻不停的，风风火火的

ext.ext_cn: 快速作出反应的天分
ext.ext_en: ...that talent for quickfire response.

defs.def_en: Quickfire speech or action is very fast with no pauses in it.

defs.def_cn: 弗罗林(英国旧时所用的价值 2 先令的硬币)
defs.def_en: A florin was a British coin that was worth two shillings.
In a race, an obstacle course is a series of obstacles that people have to go over or round in order to complete the race.

ext.ext_cn: 看来政府已为胸怀抱负的学生设下了要求之高前所未有的重重难关。
ext.ext_en: The Government seems to have created a more demanding obstacle course for aspiring students than ever before.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a situation as an obstacle course, you mean that it is full of difficulties which have to be overcome before you can get or achieve what you want.

defs.def_cn: 没有防备的；无人看管的

ext.ext_cn: 我不该把我的公文包和相机包留在那儿无人看管。
ext.ext_en: I should not leave my briefcase and camera bag unguarded.

defs.def_en: If something is unguarded, nobody is protecting it or looking after it.

ext.ext_cn: 摄影师抓拍到了简不经意的瞬间。
ext.ext_en: The photographers managed to capture Jane in an unguarded moment...

ext.ext_cn: 他一不小心被记者套出话来。
ext.ext_en: He was ambushed by a reporter into an unguarded comment.

defs.def_en: If you do or say something in an unguarded moment, you do or say it carelessly and without thinking, especially when it is something that you did not want anyone to see or know.

ext.ext_cn: 这条大街从未铺过路面，冬天泥泞不堪，无法通行。
ext.ext_en: The avenue had never been paved, and deep mud made it impassable in winter.

defs.def_en: If a road or an area of ground has been paved, it has been covered with flat blocks of stone or concrete, so that it is suitable for walking or driving on.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在为签订削减化学武器协议铺平道路的一项新提议
ext.ext_en: ...a new proposal intended to pave the way for the signing of a chemical weapons reduction agreement...

ext.ext_cn: 讨论旨在为两国进行正式谈判铺平道路。
ext.ext_en: The discussions are aimed at paving the way for formal negotiations between the two countries.

defs.def_en: If one thing paves the way for another, it creates a situation in which it is possible or more likely that the other thing will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 日本经济的不景气使得消费者在购买车辆上减少了开支。
ext.ext_en: Japan's recession has prompted consumers to cut back on buying cars...

ext.ext_cn: 村民们想要掌握自己的命运，这促成了一项新的计划。
ext.ext_en: The need for villagers to control their own destinies has prompted a new plan.

defs.def_en: To prompt someone to do something means to make them decide to do it.

defs.def_cn: 鼓励，提示（说话者）；给（演员）提词

ext.ext_cn: “接着说，”医生鼓励他道。
ext.ext_en: 'Go on,' the therapist prompted him...

ext.ext_cn: 确切地说，他是怎样提示她的，马卡姆先生？
ext.ext_en: How exactly did he prompt her, Mr Markham?

defs.def_en: If you prompt someone when they stop speaking, you encourage or help them to continue. If you prompt an actor, you tell them what their next line is when they have forgotten what comes next.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 迅速的；即刻的；立即的；及时的

ext.ext_cn: 现在还不算晚，但是需要立即采取行动。
ext.ext_en: It is not too late, but prompt action is needed.

ext.ext_cn: 需要立即治疗的眼球炎症
ext.ext_en: ...an inflammation of the eyeball which needs prompt treatment.

defs.def_en: A prompt action is done without any delay.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你执行所有这些命令可真够迅速的。
ext.ext_en: You have been so prompt in carrying out all these commissions...

ext.ext_cn: 我们不担心，因为他们交租金总是非常及时。
ext.ext_en: We didn't worry because they were always so prompt with their rental payment.

defs.def_en: If you are prompt to do something, you do it without delay or you are not late.

defs.def_cn: （尤指因宗教、政治信仰或种族而受到的）迫害

ext.ext_cn: 对少数派的迫害
ext.ext_en: ...the persecution of minorities.

ext.ext_cn: 政治迫害的受害者
ext.ext_en: ...victims of political persecution...

defs.def_en: Persecution is cruel and unfair treatment of a person or group, especially because of their religious or political beliefs, or their race.

defs.def_cn: (在选举、体育比赛等中的)反击，反攻

ext.ext_cn: 西印度群岛队在第五场板球对抗赛的第一个比赛日发起了一次戏剧性的反攻。
ext.ext_en: The West Indies have staged a dramatic fightback on the first day of the fifth test.

defs.def_en: A fightback is an effort made by a person or group of people to get back into a strong position when they seem likely to lose something such as an election or an important sports match.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有强烈倾向性的;有偏见的;有争议的

ext.ext_cn: 他的分析源于对法国历史带有一定偏见的解读。
ext.ext_en: His analysis was rooted in a somewhat tendentious reading of French history.

defs.def_en: Something that is tendentious expresses a particular opinion or point of view very strongly, especially one that many people disagree with.

defs.def_cn: 温度自动调节器;恒温器
defs.def_en: A thermostat is a device that switches a system or motor on or off according to the temperature. Thermostats are used, for example, in central heating systems and fridges.

defs.def_cn: (看电视时)频繁更换电视频道
defs.def_en: Channel-hopping means switching quickly between different television channels because you are looking for something interesting to watch.

ext.ext_cn: 30秒后她又出现了，示意他们往前来。
ext.ext_en: Thirty seconds later she reappeared and beckoned them forward.

defs.def_en: When people or things reappear, they return again after they have been away or out of sight for some time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他为孩子们大伤脑筋。
ext.ext_en: He was rather bemused by children...

ext.ext_cn: 塞巴斯蒂安先生一脸茫然地看着男孩儿们。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Sebastian was looking at the boys with a bemused expression.

defs.def_en: If you are bemused, you are puzzled or confused.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: A warm-hearted person is friendly and affectionate.
A soda cracker is a thin, square, salty biscuit.
Ball games are games that are played with a ball such as tennis, baseball, and football.

ext.ext_cn: 我还是想去看一场棒球赛。
ext.ext_en: I'd still like to go to a ball game.

defs.def_en: A ball game is a baseball match.

defs.def_cn: 局面；情况；活动；（尤指）竞赛

ext.ext_cn: 他的两大劲敌出局了。
ext.ext_en: Two of his biggest competitors are out of the ball game.

ext.ext_cn: 他发现自己面对着一个截然不同的情况。
ext.ext_en: He finds himself faced with a whole new ball game.

defs.def_en: You can use ball game to describe any situation or activity, especially one that involves competition.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 漠不关心的;漫不经心的

ext.ext_cn: 编程者似乎对大批量制造含暴力因素的产品处之漠然，毫无责任心。
ext.ext_en: Programme-makers seem irresponsibly insouciant about churning out violence.

defs.def_en: An insouciant action or quality shows someone's lack of concern about something which they might be expected to take more seriously.

ext.ext_cn: 他要求转接到伦敦大学的电话总机。
ext.ext_en: He asked to be connected to the central switchboard at London University...

ext.ext_cn: 电话总台的接线员是旅馆老板的妻子。
ext.ext_en: The switchboard operator was the hotel owner's wife.

defs.def_en: A switchboard is a place in a large office or business where all the telephone calls are connected.

defs.def_cn: (尤指伤亡惨重的)灾难，灾祸(如地震、坠机等)

ext.ext_cn: 这已经是该地区不到两个月内的第二次空难了。
ext.ext_en: It was the second air disaster in the region in less than two months...

ext.ext_cn: 很多人被灾难夺去了一切，变得一无所有。
ext.ext_en: Many had lost all in the disaster and were destitute.

defs.def_en: A disaster is a very bad accident such as an earthquake or a plane crash, especially one in which a lot of people are killed.

defs.def_cn: 非常糟糕的事;彻底的失败;不幸

ext.ext_cn: 整个产品简直就是一个败笔！
ext.ext_en: The whole production was just a disaster!

ext.ext_cn: 如果不能挺进半决赛，对他们来说就是完败。
ext.ext_en: It would be a disaster for them not to reach the semi-finals...

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as a disaster, you are emphasizing that you think it is extremely bad or unacceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 政府把自己推向了财政危机的边缘。
ext.ext_en: The government brought itself to the brink of fiscal disaster...

ext.ext_cn: “这将会祸患无穷，”他说道。
ext.ext_en: 'The potential for disaster is enormous,' he says.

defs.def_en: Disaster is something which has very bad consequences for you.

defs.def_cn: 没有什么好结果；后患无穷
defs.def_en: If you say that something is a recipe for disaster, you mean that it is very likely to have unpleasant consequences.

ext.ext_cn: 我们行程的下一站是锡利斯特拉。
ext.ext_en: The next place on our itinerary was Silistra.

defs.def_en: An itinerary is a plan of a journey, including the route and the places that you will visit.

defs.def_cn: 不容忽视的;不可避免的;必然发生的

ext.ext_cn: 改革有其必然的经济学逻辑。
ext.ext_en: The economic logic of reform is inescapable...

ext.ext_cn: 一种即将来临的毁灭感无可逃避。
ext.ext_en: A sense of imminent doom was inescapable.

defs.def_en: If you describe a fact, situation, or activity as inescapable, you mean that it is difficult not to notice it or be affected by it.
A health centre is a building in which a group of doctors have offices or surgeries where their patients can visit them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她由于激动变得很健谈。
ext.ext_en: She was voluble with excitement...

ext.ext_cn: 伯特是个能说会道、善于交际的人。
ext.ext_en: Bert is a voluble, gregarious man.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is voluble, you mean that they talk a lot with great energy and enthusiasm.

defs.def_cn: 不同行业的;某一经济部门的

ext.ext_cn: 社会阶层之间的行业差异
ext.ext_en: ...sectoral differences within social classes.

defs.def_en: Sectoral means relating to the various economic sectors of a society or to a particular economic sector.

ext.ext_cn: 上啊，伙计们，狠狠揍他们一顿！
ext.ext_en: Go on lads, beat the living daylights out of them!

defs.def_en: If you knock the living daylights out of someone, or beat the living daylights out of them, you hit them very hard many times.
If someone or something scares the living daylights out of you, they make you feel extremely scared.

ext.ext_cn: 1981 年的预算促成了一场经济奇迹的出现。
ext.ext_en: The 1981 budget was the springboard for an economic miracle...

ext.ext_cn: 这可能是迈向成功的跳板。
ext.ext_en: It could provide a springboard to success.

defs.def_en: If something is a springboard for something else, it makes it possible for that thing to happen or start.
A springboard is a flexible board from which you jump into a swimming pool or onto a piece of gymnastic equipment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她对成年学生的问题深表同情。
ext.ext_en: She was very sympathetic to the problems of adult students...

ext.ext_cn: 也许他只是把你当作一个可以倾诉的朋友。
ext.ext_en: It may be that he sees you only as a sympathetic friend.

defs.def_en: If you are sympathetic to someone who is in a bad situation, you are kind to them and show that you understand their feelings.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她在伦敦结识了一些支持印度独立运动的人。
ext.ext_en: She met people in London who were sympathetic to the Indian freedom struggle...

ext.ext_cn: 他关于反腐反贪的讲话可能会赢得一些特立尼达岛居民的支持。
ext.ext_en: His speeches against corruption may find a sympathetic hearing among some Trinidadians.

defs.def_en: If you are sympathetic to a proposal or action, you approve of it and are willing to support it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她听起来是个很招人喜欢的人物。
ext.ext_en: She sounds a most sympathetic character.

defs.def_en: You describe someone as sympathetic when you like them and approve of the way that they behave.

defs.def_cn: 厚皮动物（如大象、犀牛等）
defs.def_en: A pachyderm is a large thick-skinned animal such as an elephant or rhinoceros.

ext.ext_cn: 他还是个小男孩的时候我就认识他了。
ext.ext_en: I knew him when he was a little boy...

ext.ext_cn: 他还只是个孩子。
ext.ext_en: He was still just a boy.

defs.def_en: A boy is a child who will grow up to be a man.

defs.def_cn: 男青年，小伙子（尤用于指青年男女恋爱关系时）

ext.ext_cn: 姑娘开始对小伙子感兴趣的年龄
ext.ext_en: ...the age when girls get interested in boys.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a young man as a boy, especially when talking about relationships between boys and girls.

ext.ext_cn: 埃里克是我表兄爱德华的儿子。
ext.ext_en: Eric was my cousin Edward's boy...

ext.ext_cn: 我有两个儿子。
ext.ext_en: I have two boys.

defs.def_en: Someone's  boy is their son.

defs.def_cn: 家伙，伙计（尤用于亲切谈论某人时）

ext.ext_cn: 当上总统的本地小伙子
ext.ext_en: ...the local boy who made President...

ext.ext_cn: “加把劲儿，伙计们”，他向船员们喊道。
ext.ext_en: 'Come on boys', he shouted to the sailors.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a man as a boy, especially when you are talking about him in an affectionate way.

defs.def_cn: 家伙，伙计（用于吆喝马或狗时）

ext.ext_cn: 趴下，小家伙，趴下！
ext.ext_en: Down, boy, down!

defs.def_en: You can use boy when giving instructions to a horse or dog.
The police are sometimes referred to as the boys in blue .

defs.def_cn: 好家伙(表示激动、羡慕等情感）

ext.ext_cn: 哇，好家伙！想想看我会告诉他什么。
ext.ext_en: Oh Boy! Just think what I could tell him.

defs.def_en: Some people say 'boy' or 'oh boy' in order to express feelings of excitement or admiration.

defs.def_cn: 男人总归是男人（用以表示男人的典型行为不会改变）
defs.def_en: If you say boys will be boys, for example when a group of men are behaving noisily or aggressively, you are suggesting in a light-hearted way that this is typical male behaviour and will never change.

ext.ext_cn: 他想被人看作一个男子汉。
ext.ext_en: He wants to be accepted as one of the boys.

defs.def_en: If a man is described as one of the boys, he is accepted by a group of male friends who do things that are thought of as typically masculine.

defs.def_cn: (昆虫、老鼠等)大批出没于,侵扰

ext.ext_cn: 像蚜虫这样大肆侵害谷物的害虫
ext.ext_en: ...pests like aphids which infest cereal crops.

defs.def_en: When creatures such as insects or rats infest plants or a place, they are present in large numbers and cause damage.

ext.ext_cn: 市中心充斥着犯罪与毒品。
ext.ext_en: Crime and drugs are infesting the inner cities.

defs.def_en: If you say that people or things you disapprove of or regard as dangerous are infesting a place, you mean that there are large numbers of them in that place.
A catapult is a device for shooting small stones. It is made of a Y-shaped stick with a piece of elastic tied between the two top parts.

defs.def_cn: (航空母舰上弹射飞机升空的)弹射装置，弹射器
defs.def_en: A catapult is a device that is used to send aircraft into the air from an aircraft carrier.

ext.ext_cn: 在电视里，假人穿过挡风玻璃飞出去的警示镜头我们见得多了，知道不系安全带的危险。
ext.ext_en: We've all seen enough dummies catapulting through windscreens in TV warnings to know the dangers of not wearing seat belts...

ext.ext_cn: 他被弹飞出去，撞在货车的侧面。
ext.ext_en: He was catapulted into the side of the van.

defs.def_en: If someone or something catapults or is catapulted through the air, they are thrown very suddenly, quickly, and violently through it.

defs.def_cn: （使）突然处于…境地;（使）忽然身处…情况下

ext.ext_cn: 《本能》使她跃至一线，成功跻身好莱坞耀眼的女明星之列。
ext.ext_en: 'Basic Instinct' catapulted her to top status among Hollywood's glamour goddesses...

ext.ext_cn: 突然间，她过上了他那种阔佬生活。
ext.ext_en: Suddenly she was catapulted into his jet-set lifestyle...

defs.def_en: If something catapults you into a particular state or situation, or if you catapult there, you are suddenly and unexpectedly caused to be in that state or situation.

ext.ext_cn: 他勃然大怒，脸涨得通红。
ext.ext_en: He was working himself up to a fury, his face reddening...

ext.ext_cn: 她的脸立刻红了。
ext.ext_en: She reddened instantly...

defs.def_en: If someone reddens or their face reddens, their face turns pink or red, often because they are embarrassed or angry.
A pen and ink drawing is done using a pen rather than a pencil.

ext.ext_cn: 随着东欧政治犯的释放，人权状况大为改善。
ext.ext_en: The boost to human rights came with the release of prisoners of conscience in Eastern Europe.

defs.def_en: Prisoners of conscience are people who have been put into prison for their political or social beliefs or for breaking the law while protesting against a political or social system.

defs.def_cn: 真正的，十足的，不折不扣的（用于强调大小、数量或性质等）

ext.ext_cn: 尽情的赛前娱乐享受
ext.ext_en: ...a veritable feast of pre-match entertainment.

ext.ext_cn: 一支真正的警卫部队
ext.ext_en: ...a veritable army of security guards.

defs.def_en: You can use veritable to emphasize the size, amount, or nature of something.

ext.ext_cn: 她开始用一块布清洗伤口。
ext.ext_en: She began cleaning the wound with a piece of cloth.

defs.def_en: Cloth is fabric which is made by weaving or knitting a substance such as cotton, wool, silk, or nylon. Cloth is used especially for making clothes.  →see usage note at:clothes

ext.ext_cn: 用湿布清洁表面。
ext.ext_en: Clean the surface with a damp cloth.

ext.ext_cn: 盖着布的托盘
ext.ext_en: ...a tray covered with a cloth.

defs.def_en: A cloth is a piece of cloth which you use for a particular purpose, such as cleaning something or covering something.

ext.ext_cn: 我和任何人一样都对神父充满敬意。
ext.ext_en: I've got as much respect for the cloth as the next man.

ext.ext_cn: 一名教士
ext.ext_en: ...a man of the cloth.

defs.def_en: The cloth is sometimes used to refer to Christian priests and ministers.

ext.ext_cn: 乳腺癌的早期发觉
ext.ext_en: ...the early detection of breast cancer.

defs.def_en: Detection is the act of noticing or sensing something.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在作弊，但因为手法老练没有被发现。
ext.ext_en: They are cheating but are sophisticated enough to avoid detection.

defs.def_en: Detection is the discovery of something which is supposed to be hidden.

ext.ext_cn: 那一年机动车盗窃案的侦破率仅为11.7%。
ext.ext_en: The detection rate for motor vehicle theft that year was just 11.7 per cent...

ext.ext_cn: 对大多数罪犯来说，最大的威慑力量是警方可能会破案并将他们逮捕。
ext.ext_en: The most important deterrent for most criminals is the likelihood of detection and arrest.

defs.def_en: Detection is the work of investigating a crime in order to find out what has happened and who committed it.

defs.def_cn: （和形容词连用）有…的肚子的，有…的腹部的

ext.ext_cn: 大腹便便的官员站在门边。
ext.ext_en: The fat-bellied officer stood near the door.

ext.ext_cn: 黄腹海蛇
ext.ext_en: ...the yellow-bellied sea-snake.

defs.def_en: See also:pot-bellied;-bellied can be added to an adjective to describe someone or something that has a stomach of a particular kind.

defs.def_cn: 当红新人，成名的年轻人（尤指演员或作家）

ext.ext_cn: 好莱坞红极一时的年轻影星
ext.ext_en: ...the Hollywood Brat Pack.

defs.def_en: A brat pack is a group of young people, especially actors or writers, who are popular or successful at the moment.

defs.def_cn: (基督教正式追封的)圣徒，圣人

ext.ext_cn: 每个教区都以某位圣徒的名字命名。
ext.ext_en: Every parish was named after a saint.

ext.ext_cn: 圣约翰
ext.ext_en: ...Saint John.

defs.def_en: A saint is someone who has died and been officially recognized and honoured by the Christian church because his or her life was a perfect example of the way Christians should live.

defs.def_cn: 至善的人;极有耐心的人;道德高尚的人;圣人般的人

ext.ext_cn: 能够忍受我，我的女朋友真的很有耐心。
ext.ext_en: My girlfriend is a saint to put up with me.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a living person as a saint, you mean that they are extremely kind, patient, and unselfish.

ext.ext_cn: 行李员想要小费。
ext.ext_en: The porter expects a gratuity.

defs.def_en: A gratuity is a gift of money to someone who has done something for you.

defs.def_cn: 退休金；遣散费；（尤指军人的）退役金

ext.ext_cn: 他将领到海军补助的退役金。
ext.ext_en: He is taking a gratuity from the Navy.

defs.def_en: A gratuity is a large gift of money that is given to someone when they leave their job, especially when they leave the armed forces.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 几天几夜紧锣密鼓的谈判
ext.ext_en: ...several days and nights of intensive negotiations...

ext.ext_cn: 每个辅导员在上岗前都要接受密集培训。
ext.ext_en: Each counsellor undergoes an intensive training programme before beginning work.

defs.def_en: Intensive activity involves concentrating a lot of effort or people on one particular task in order to try to achieve a great deal in a short time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 集约(经营)的;精耕细作的

ext.ext_cn: 在别处,大片区域被抽干了水或铲平了地，以作为工业或集约化农业用地。
ext.ext_en: Elsewhere large areas have been drained and levelled for industry or intensive farming.

ext.ext_cn: 饲养家禽的集约化方法
ext.ext_en: ...intensive methods of rearing poultry.

defs.def_en: Intensive farming involves producing as many crops or animals as possible from your land, usually with the aid of chemicals.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个粗鲁无礼、态度恶劣的人自以为他拥有法律的支持
ext.ext_en: ...this rude, ill-mannered individual who assumes he has the force of the law behind him...

ext.ext_cn: 钱特尔会认为表现出吃惊是失态的。
ext.ext_en: Chantal would have considered it ill-mannered to show surprise.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as ill-mannered, you are critical of them because they are impolite or rude.

ext.ext_cn: 这个团体与叙利亚的关系可以追溯到《圣经》时代。
ext.ext_en: The community's links with Syria date back to biblical times.

ext.ext_cn: 《圣经》中挪亚的故事
ext.ext_en: ...the biblical story of Noah.

defs.def_en: Biblical means contained in or relating to the Bible.

ext.ext_cn: 我想你听到了我的话，也明白我的意思。
ext.ext_en: I think you heard and also understand me...

ext.ext_cn: 拉斯蒂点点头，好像听懂了那位老妇人的话似的。
ext.ext_en: Rusty nodded as though she understood the old woman...

defs.def_en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

ext.ext_cn: 我根本不懂意第绪语，所以请他来翻译。
ext.ext_en: I couldn't read or understand a word of Yiddish, so I asked him to translate.

defs.def_en: If you understand a language, you know what someone is saying when they are speaking that language.

ext.ext_cn: 要是有个真正理解我的人、有个朋友就好了。
ext.ext_en: It would be nice to have someone who really understood me, a friend...

ext.ext_cn: 特里希并没有完全理解他的感受。
ext.ext_en: Trish had not exactly understood his feelings...

defs.def_en: To understand someone means to know how they feel and why they behave in the way that they do.

defs.def_cn: 知道，明白，了解（所发生的事及其原因）

ext.ext_cn: 他们还太小，不明白发生了什么事。
ext.ext_en: They are too young to understand what is going on...

ext.ext_cn: 她不明白为什么病人不能看电视。
ext.ext_en: She didn't understand why the TV was kept out of reach of the patients...

defs.def_en: You say that you understand something when you know why or how it happens.

ext.ext_cn: 我们听说她正在录音棚录制她的第二张专辑。
ext.ext_en: We understand that she's in the studio recording her second album...

ext.ext_cn: 我知道你们已经听说了戴维的事了。
ext.ext_en: I understand you've heard about David...

defs.def_en: If you understand that something is the case, you think it is true because you have heard or read that it is. You can say that something is understood to be the case to mean that people generally think it is true.

ext.ext_cn: 我得知整场比赛中他一直冲着我方球迷骂个不停。
ext.ext_en: I am given to understand that he was swearing throughout the game at our fans.

defs.def_en: If someone is given to understand that something is the case, it is communicated to them that it is the case, usually without them being told directly.

ext.ext_cn: 你不准打我的孙子孙女，明白吗？
ext.ext_en: You do not hit my grandchildren, do you understand?...

ext.ext_cn: 我不需要，懂吗？
ext.ext_en: I don't need it, understand?...

defs.def_en: You can use understand in expressions like do you understand? or is that understood? after you have told someone what you want, to make sure that they have understood you and will obey you.

defs.def_cn: （用于形容词后构成名词，通常是代替-ent）表示“状态”，“性质”，“态度”，“行为”
defs.def_en: -ence and -ency are added to adjectives, usually in place of -ent, to form nouns referring to states, qualities, attitudes, or behaviour. For example, 'affluence' is the state of being affluent.

defs.def_cn: 吃惊，震惊（以至于无法立刻作出反应）

ext.ext_cn: 我们反应如此强烈，令罗兰大吃一惊。
ext.ext_en: Roland was taken aback by our strength of feeling...

ext.ext_cn: 德里克吓了一跳，居然是一个男的接的电话。
ext.ext_en: Derek was taken aback when a man answered the phone.

defs.def_en: If you are taken aback by something, you are surprised or shocked by it and you cannot respond at once.
The penal code of a country consists of all the laws that are related to crime and punishment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不重要的；无意义的；微不足道的

ext.ext_cn: 这份工作无足轻重，而且薪水还很低。
ext.ext_en: It was an unimportant job, and paid very little...

ext.ext_cn: 他们6年前结婚时，年龄的差距似乎并不重要。
ext.ext_en: When they had married, six years before, the difference in their ages had seemed unimportant.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as unimportant, you mean that they do not have much influence, effect, or value, and are therefore not worth serious consideration.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的表演非常出色，但他却很谦虚。
ext.ext_en: He gave a great performance, but he was very humble...

ext.ext_cn: 安迪是个谦逊而且彬彬有礼的绅士。
ext.ext_en: Andy was a humble, courteous and gentle man.

defs.def_en: A humble person is not proud and does not believe that they are better than other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 斯皮罗斯·拉齐斯的第一份职业是爱琴海上一名地位卑贱的渔夫。
ext.ext_en: Spyros Latsis started his career as a humble fisherman in the Aegean...

ext.ext_cn: 他出生在一个地位相当低下的贫穷家庭。
ext.ext_en: He came from a fairly humble, poor background.

defs.def_en: People with low social status are sometimes described as humble.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 粗陋的;简陋的;不起眼的

ext.ext_cn: 专门做这些菜的餐馆既有毫不起眼的也有价格昂贵的。
ext.ext_en: There are restaurants, both humble and expensive, that specialize in them...

ext.ext_cn: 瓦恩德尔用一狭条普通的厨房用箔纸自制了反光板来拍摄这些照片。
ext.ext_en: Varndell made his own reflector for these shots from a strip of humble kitchen foil.

defs.def_en: A humble place or thing is ordinary and not special in any way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 依拙见，这可能是英国最好的牛排馆。
ext.ext_en: It is, in my humble opinion, perhaps the best steak restaurant in Great Britain.

defs.def_en: People use humble in a phrase such as in my humble opinion as a polite way of emphasizing what they think, even though they do not feel humble about it.

ext.ext_cn: 安森被迫认错并公开向她道歉。
ext.ext_en: Anson was forced to eat humble pie and publicly apologise to her.

defs.def_en: If you eat humble pie, you speak or behave in a way which tells people that you admit you were wrong about something.

ext.ext_cn: 本田在20世纪80年代作为一家轻易挫败行业巨头的小汽车公司而声名鹊起。
ext.ext_en: Honda won fame in the 1980s as the little car company that humbled the industry giants...

ext.ext_cn: 排名第三的巴尼特队以0–3的比分在克鲁遭遇惨败。
ext.ext_en: Third-placed Barnet were humbled 3-0 at Crewe.

defs.def_en: If you humble someone who is more important or powerful than you, you defeat them easily.

defs.def_cn: 使谦逊;使感到卑微;羞辱

ext.ext_cn: 特德的话让我感到自惭。
ext.ext_en: Ted's words humbled me...

ext.ext_cn: 我相信数百万观众看了这个故事后都会感到自己的渺小。
ext.ext_en: I am sure millions of viewers were humbled by this story.

defs.def_en: If something or someone humbles you, they make you realize that you are not as important or good as you thought you were.

ext.ext_cn: 警方还发现了一把手枪。
ext.ext_en: The police also found a pistol...

ext.ext_cn: 他们对着地图细看了许久也没能找到那个叫达罗比的地方的影踪。
ext.ext_en: They have spent ages looking at the map and can't find a trace of anywhere called Darrowby...

defs.def_en: If you find someone or something, you see them or learn where they are.

ext.ext_cn: 这里很多人都找不到工作。
ext.ext_en: Many people here cannot find work...

ext.ext_cn: 迄今为止，他们还没有找到一种对抗该病毒的方法。
ext.ext_en: So far they have not found a way to fight the virus...

defs.def_en: If you find something that you need or want, you succeed in achieving or obtaining it.

ext.ext_cn: 法国的 4,200 种开花植物中有 2,000种可见于这个公园。
ext.ext_en: Two thousand of France's 4,200 species of flowering plants are found in the park...

ext.ext_cn: 谷类食品、豆类、水果和蔬菜中含有纤维素。
ext.ext_en: Fibre is found in cereal foods, beans, fruit and vegetables.

defs.def_en: If something is found in a particular place or thing, it exists in that place.

defs.def_cn: 发现…处于某种状态;遇见;碰见

ext.ext_cn: 他们碰见她独自一人神色忧郁地走在海滩上。
ext.ext_en: They found her walking alone and depressed on the beach...

ext.ext_cn: 她回到在伦敦东区的住所时发现后门被撬开了。
ext.ext_en: She returned to her east London home to find her back door forced open...

defs.def_en: If you find someone or something in a particular situation, they are in that situation when you see them or come into contact with them.

defs.def_cn: (不知不觉中)发现(自己在做某事)

ext.ext_cn: 你陷入这种状况已经不是第一次了。
ext.ext_en: It's not the first time that you've found yourself in this situation...

ext.ext_cn: 我发现自己这些年来从未像现在这样开心过。
ext.ext_en: I found myself having more fun than I had had in years...

defs.def_en: If you find yourself doing something, you are doing it without deciding or intending to do it.

defs.def_cn: (某一时刻或事件)把…置于某种情形中

ext.ext_cn: 天亮时我们发现自己呆在一条冰冷黏湿的船上。
ext.ext_en: Daybreak found us on a cold, clammy ship...

ext.ext_cn: 不久午餐就送来了，当时他正埋头于一本满是潦草字迹的记事簿。
ext.ext_en: His lunch did not take long to arrive and found him poring over a notepad covered with scrawls.

defs.def_en: If a time or event finds you in a particular situation, you are in that situation at the time mentioned or when the event occurs.

ext.ext_cn: 这两位生物学家惊奇地发现，两组鸟都很好地存活了下来。
ext.ext_en: The two biologists found, to their surprise, that both groups of birds survived equally well...

ext.ext_cn: 到了我这个年纪自己就会发觉很难再找到一份工作了。
ext.ext_en: At my age I would find it hard to get another job...

defs.def_en: If you find that something is the case, you become aware of it or realize that it is the case.

ext.ext_cn: 她被裁定过失杀人罪名成立，缓刑两年。
ext.ext_en: She was found guilty of manslaughter and put on probation for two years...

ext.ext_cn: 当他们判定我们有罪时，我的脑子顿时一片空白。
ext.ext_en: When they found us guilty, I just went blank.

defs.def_en: When a court or jury decides that a person on trial is guilty or innocent, you say that the person has been found guilty or not guilty.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得和我同龄的年轻人大多都很无聊。
ext.ext_en: I find most of the young men of my own age so boring...

ext.ext_cn: 我们保证你一定会认为这很刺激的！
ext.ext_en: We're sure you'll find it exciting!...

defs.def_en: You can use find to express your reaction to someone or something.

defs.def_cn: 感受到(愉快、安慰等情感)

ext.ext_cn: 怎么会有人以猎杀这种美丽的动物为乐呢？
ext.ext_en: How could anyone find pleasure in hunting and killing this beautiful creature?...

ext.ext_cn: 我既疲惫又恐惧，就连那熟悉的承诺都无法让我感到安慰。
ext.ext_en: I was too tired and frightened to find comfort in that familiar promise.

defs.def_en: If you find a feeling such as pleasure or comfort in a particular thing or activity, you experience the feeling mentioned as a result of this thing or activity.

ext.ext_cn: 我刚刚找到了更多时间来作曲。
ext.ext_en: I was just finding more time to write music...

ext.ext_cn: 姐姐帮我筹集资金开办了一家私人企业。
ext.ext_en: My sister helped me find the money for a private operation.

defs.def_en: If you find the time or money to do something, you succeed in making or obtaining enough time or money to do it.

defs.def_cn: (有价值的)发现;(有用的)发现物

ext.ext_cn: 他的另一个幸运发现是一对烛台。
ext.ext_en: Another of his lucky finds was a pair of candle-holders...

ext.ext_cn: 他的发现被誉为本世纪植物学的最重大发现。
ext.ext_en: His discovery was hailed as the botanical find of the century.

defs.def_en: See also:finding;found;If you describe someone or something that has been discovered as a find, you mean that they are valuable, interesting, good, or useful.

defs.def_cn: 找到正确的路(去某处);成功地到达

ext.ext_cn: 他是认路的行家，即使在陌生的环境中也是如此。
ext.ext_en: He was an expert at finding his way, even in strange surroundings...

ext.ext_cn: 过了一会儿我费力地站起身来，找到了那条大街。
ext.ext_en: After a while I pulled myself to my feet and found my way to the street.

defs.def_en: If you find your way somewhere, you successfully get there by choosing the right way to go.

ext.ext_cn: 这是少数几件流传到意大利境外的米开朗琪罗作品之一。
ext.ext_en: It is one of the very few Michelangelos that have found their way out of Italy...

ext.ext_cn: 那些最不可能的东西出现于他的设计中，并且在他的安排下显得恰得其所。
ext.ext_en: The most unlikely objects found their way into his design and look absolutely right where he placed them.

defs.def_en: If something finds its way somewhere, it comes to that place, especially by chance.

defs.def_cn: (尤指特意通过努力)发现，找出，查明

ext.ext_cn: 这让人想要看下一集，弄清紧接着会发生什么事。
ext.ext_en: It makes you want to watch the next episode to find out what's going to happen...

ext.ext_cn: 得知我的问题确实是由于病症引起的，我松了口气。
ext.ext_en: I was relieved to find out that my problems were due to a genuine disorder...

defs.def_en: If you find something out, you learn something that you did not already know, especially by making a deliberate effort to do so.

defs.def_cn: 查出…的不轨行为;揭发出

ext.ext_cn: 她的表情如此严肃，我一时怀疑她是不是已经知道了我干的事。
ext.ext_en: Her face was so grave, I wondered for a moment if she'd found me out.

defs.def_en: If you find someone out, you discover that they have been doing something dishonest.

defs.def_cn: 校定，校准，调节(计量器具)

ext.ext_cn: 如何标定温度计的说明
ext.ext_en: ...instructions on how to calibrate a thermometer.

ext.ext_cn: 标定精确刻度的皮下注射器
ext.ext_en: ...a calibrated hypodermic syringe.

defs.def_en: If you calibrate an instrument or tool, you mark or adjust it so that you can use it to measure something accurately.

ext.ext_cn: 准确衡量工党内部观点转变的方法
ext.ext_en: ...a way of calibrating the shift of opinion within the Labour Party...

ext.ext_cn: 食品中杀虫剂的含量很难精确测定。
ext.ext_en: Pesticide levels in food are simply too difficult to calibrate.

defs.def_en: If you calibrate something, you measure it accurately.

ext.ext_cn: 他把纸小心地折起来。
ext.ext_en: He folded the paper carefully...

ext.ext_cn: 把煎蛋对折。
ext.ext_en: Fold the omelette in half...

defs.def_en: If you fold something such as a piece of paper or cloth, you bend it so that one part covers another part, often pressing the edge so that it stays in place.

ext.ext_cn: 再折一下，把末端对齐。
ext.ext_en: Make another fold and turn the ends together.

defs.def_en: A fold in a piece of paper or cloth is a bend that you make in it when you put one part of it over another part and press the edge.

ext.ext_cn: 牧师胡乱整了整长袍上的褶皱。
ext.ext_en: The priest fumbled in the folds of his gown.

defs.def_en: The folds in a piece of cloth are the curved shapes which are formed when it is not hanging or lying flat.

ext.ext_cn: 长凳的靠背可以向前翻折成一张桌子。
ext.ext_en: The back of the bench folds forward to make a table...

ext.ext_cn: 这张便携椅可以折叠，便于收纳。
ext.ext_en: This portable seat folds flat for easy storage...

defs.def_en: If a piece of furniture or equipment folds or if you can fold it, you can make it smaller by bending or closing parts of it.

ext.ext_cn: 米尔双臂交叉在胸前，把头转到一边。
ext.ext_en: Meer folded his arms over his chest and turned his head away...

ext.ext_cn: 林罗斯夫人坐下来，双手叠放在腿上。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Ringrose sat down and folded her hands in her lap.

defs.def_en: If you fold your arms or hands, you bring them together and cross or link them, for example over your chest.

ext.ext_cn: 但在其他商店纷纷关门倒闭之时，大型超市的强劲扩张势头却依旧不减。
ext.ext_en: But as other shops fold, the march of the superstores continues...

ext.ext_cn: 每周有2,500家小企业关张。
ext.ext_en: 2,500 small businesses were folding each week.

defs.def_en: If a business or organization folds, it is unsuccessful and has to close.

ext.ext_cn: 欧盟想要让美国重新回到他们的阵营之中。
ext.ext_en: The EU wanted to bring the US back into the fold...

ext.ext_cn: 他可能会发现等他意识到自己的错误时再想重返家族已经非常难了。
ext.ext_en: He might find it difficult to return to the family fold when he realizes his mistake.

defs.def_en: When someone joins an organization or group, you can say that they have come into the fold. When they leave the organization or group, you can say that they leave the fold .

ext.ext_cn: 拌入面粉。
ext.ext_en: Fold in the flour...

ext.ext_cn: 把奶油调入蛋黄液中。
ext.ext_en: Fold the cream into the egg yolk mixture.

defs.def_en: In cooking, if you fold in an ingredient or fold it into the other ingredients, you mix it very gently into the other ingredients.

ext.ext_cn: 她将其折叠起来，塞进了钱包里。
ext.ext_en: She folded it up, and tucked it into her purse...

ext.ext_cn: 他把文件折了几折，然后收了起来。
ext.ext_en: He folded up his paper and put it away.

defs.def_en: See also:fold 4;fold-up;If you fold something up, you make it into a smaller, neater shape by folding it, usually several times.

defs.def_cn: 车辆;交通工具;运输工具

ext.ext_cn: 这辆车单靠一箱燃料无法跑完整趟旅程。
ext.ext_en: The vehicle would not have the capacity to make the journey on one tank of fuel.

ext.ext_cn: 一种介于拖拉机和卡车之间的机动车
ext.ext_en: ...a vehicle which was somewhere between a tractor and a truck.

defs.def_en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people from place to place.

ext.ext_cn: 艺术成了她表达政治信仰的工具。
ext.ext_en: Her art became a vehicle for her political beliefs...

ext.ext_cn: 既能实现交流又能被广为接受的手段就是社会革命。
ext.ext_en: The vehicle that permitted both communication and acceptability was social revolution.

defs.def_en: You can use vehicle to refer to something that you use in order to achieve a particular purpose.
A violet is a small plant that has purple or white flowers in the spring.

ext.ext_cn: 光线开始从紫罗兰色的天空渐渐消退。
ext.ext_en: The light was beginning to drain from a violet sky.

defs.def_en: Something that is violet is a bluish-purple colour.

ext.ext_cn: 他在表达自己的想法时毫不羞怯。
ext.ext_en: When it comes to expressing himself he is no shrinking violet...

ext.ext_cn: 然而，他画过的所有女人中没有一个是羞涩腼腆的。
ext.ext_en: None of the women he paints, however, could be described as shrinking violets.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is no shrinking violet, you mean that they are not at all shy.

defs.def_cn: (通常指对女性的)性别歧视，性别偏见

ext.ext_cn: 一些像我们这样的团体致力于消除对同性恋的憎恶、种族歧视和性别歧视。
ext.ext_en: Groups like ours are committed to eradicating homophobia, racism and sexism.

defs.def_en: Sexism is the belief that the members of one sex, usually women, are less intelligent or less capable than those of the other sex and need not be treated equally. It is also the behaviour which is the result of this belief.

defs.def_cn: 多香果粉（一种烹调用香料）
defs.def_en: Allspice is a powder used as a spice in cooking, which is made from the berries of a tropical American tree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 每个人都有沮丧失意或情绪低落的时候。
ext.ext_en: Everyone has days when they feel dejected or down.

defs.def_en: If you are dejected, you feel miserable or unhappy, especially because you have just been disappointed by something.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于生气时表示强调）太，很，真是

ext.ext_cn: 它真让人讨厌，快把我的狗吓死了。
ext.ext_en: It's a blooming nuisance because it frightens my dog to death.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然我们分手了，但她确实很了不起。
ext.ext_en: Even though we split up she was blooming marvellous.

defs.def_en: Blooming is used by some people to emphasize what they are saying, especially when they are annoyed.

defs.def_cn: 容光焕发的；神采奕奕的；精力旺盛的

ext.ext_cn: 他们要是信心百倍的话，也就不会叫我了。
ext.ext_en: If they were blooming with confidence they wouldn't need me...

ext.ext_cn: 她身强体健。
ext.ext_en: She's in blooming health.

defs.def_en: Someone who is blooming looks attractively healthy and full of energy.

defs.def_cn: 过单调无聊的生活;无所事事地生活

ext.ext_cn: 他一有空闲时间就窝在家里看电视。
ext.ext_en: He spends all his free time at home vegetating in front of the TV.

defs.def_en: If someone vegetates, they spend their time doing boring or worthless things.

ext.ext_cn: 被问及国籍时，他说是英国。
ext.ext_en: Asked his nationality, he said British...

ext.ext_cn: 船员来自不同国家，语言不通。
ext.ext_en: The crew are of different nationalities and have no common language.

defs.def_en: If you have the nationality of a particular country, you were born there or have the legal right to be a citizen.

defs.def_cn: (尤指未建立独立国家的)民族

ext.ext_cn: 组成埃塞俄比亚的众多民族
ext.ext_en: ...the many nationalities that comprise Ethiopia.

defs.def_en: You can refer to people who have the same racial origins as a nationality, especially when they do not have their own independent country.

ext.ext_cn: 弗雷德优哉游哉地躺在安乐椅上。
ext.ext_en: Fred lazed in an easy chair...

ext.ext_cn: 他们去游泳池游泳，去骑马，一天之中最热之时在橡树的浓阴下消磨时间。
ext.ext_en: They used the swimming-pool, rode, lazed in the deep shade of the oaks in the heat of the day.

defs.def_en: If you laze somewhere for a period of time, you relax and enjoy yourself, not doing any work or anything else that requires effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 板球是典型的英格兰运动。
ext.ext_en: Cricket is the archetypal English game.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is archetypal has all the most important characteristics of a particular kind of person or thing and is a perfect example of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他过于谦虚，甚至到了自我轻视的程度。
ext.ext_en: He was modest to the point of self-effacement.

defs.def_en: Someone's self-effacement is their unwillingness to talk about themselves or draw attention to themselves.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 凶恶的看门狗
ext.ext_en: ...a ferocious guard-dog...

ext.ext_cn: 警方不得不去处理伦敦街头发生的一些极其严重的暴力事件。
ext.ext_en: The police had had to deal with some of the most ferocious violence ever seen on the streets of London.

defs.def_en: A ferocious animal, person, or action is very fierce and violent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (战争、争论等冲突)激烈的，猛烈的，酷烈的

ext.ext_cn: 战斗十分激烈。
ext.ext_en: Fighting has been ferocious...

ext.ext_cn: 推选一位新的议会候选人的激战正酣。
ext.ext_en: A ferocious battle to select a new parliamentary candidate is in progress.

defs.def_en: A ferocious war, argument, or other form of conflict involves a great deal of anger, bitterness, and determination.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 反英情绪之深之烈令林德伯格大为震惊。
ext.ext_en: Lindbergh was startled at the ferocious depth of anti-British feeling.

defs.def_en: If you describe actions or feelings as ferocious, you mean that they are intense and determined.

ext.ext_cn: 他们没有对参观宫殿的人数进行统计，不过这地方很受欢迎。
ext.ext_en: They do not keep a tally of visitors to the palace, but it is very popular...

ext.ext_cn: 最后得出的票数是她 817 票，李先生 731 票。
ext.ext_en: The final tally was 817 votes for her and 731 for Mr Lee.

defs.def_en: A tally is a record of amounts or numbers which you keep changing and adding to as the activity which affects it progresses.

ext.ext_cn: 其估计数目 300 与另一项调查的结果相吻合。
ext.ext_en: Its own estimate of three hundred tallies with that of another survey...

ext.ext_cn: 这一描述似乎与我们目睹的情况不符。
ext.ext_en: This description didn't seem to tally with what we saw...

defs.def_en: If one number or statement tallies with another, they agree with each other or are exactly the same. You can also say that two numbers or statements tally .

ext.ext_cn: 我们统计今年下岗工人数量的时候
ext.ext_en: ...as we tally the number of workers who have been laid off this year...

ext.ext_cn: 等到最终的数字统计出来后，几乎可以肯定销售额下降了。
ext.ext_en: When the final numbers are tallied, sales will almost certainly have fallen.

defs.def_en: If you tally numbers, items, or totals, you count them.

defs.def_cn: 禅宗（注重冥想的佛教派别之一）
defs.def_en: Zen or Zen Buddhism is a form of the Buddhist religion that concentrates on meditation rather than on studying religious writings.

ext.ext_cn: 你这大笨蛋！
ext.ext_en: You great nitwit!

ext.ext_cn: 好莱坞到处都是“蠢人”。
ext.ext_en: Hollywood was full of 'nitwits'.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a nitwit, you think they are stupid or silly.
A bicentenary is a year in which you celebrate something important that happened exactly two hundred years earlier.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家的政治体制依然残暴异常，缺少平等，四分五裂。
ext.ext_en: This country still had a deeply oppressive, unequal and divisive political system.

ext.ext_cn: 男女之间不平等的权力关系
ext.ext_en: ...the unequal power relationships between men and women.

defs.def_en: An unequal system or situation is unfair because it gives more power or privileges to one person or group of people than to others.

defs.def_cn: 不能胜任的；力不能及的

ext.ext_cn: 批评她的人说事实证明她并不具备完成这项工作的能力。
ext.ext_en: Her critics say she has proved unequal to the task...

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉难以胜任这项工作，希望有人能给点建议。
ext.ext_en: He felt unequal to the job and wished there were someone he could go to for advice.

defs.def_en: If someone is unequal to a task they have to do, they do not have the abilities needed to do it well.

defs.def_cn: （大小、力量或数量上）不均等的，不对等的

ext.ext_cn: 埃及人很有可能用不同长度的24小时来度量日子。
ext.ext_en: The Egyptians probably measured their day in twenty-four hours of unequal length.

defs.def_en: Unequal means being different in size, strength, or amount.

ext.ext_cn: 他在竞选时许诺将重振经济。
ext.ext_en: During his election campaign he promised to put the economy back on its feet...

ext.ext_cn: 雅拍体育用品公司开展了加强员工培训的活动。
ext.ext_en: Apacs has launched a campaign to improve the training of staff.

defs.def_en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

ext.ext_cn: 我们正在宣传呼吁进行法律改革。
ext.ext_en: We are campaigning for law reform...

ext.ext_cn: 伯恩斯先生积极活动,反对在这儿建青年旅舍。
ext.ext_en: Mr Burns has actively campaigned against a hostel being set up here...

defs.def_en: If someone campaigns for something, they carry out a planned set of activities over a period of time in order to achieve their aim.

ext.ext_cn: 联军部队正加大他们的空战强度。
ext.ext_en: The allies are intensifying their air campaign.

ext.ext_cn: 轮番轰炸
ext.ext_en: ...a bombing campaign.

defs.def_en: In a war, a campaign is a series of planned movements carried out by armed forces.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 标准的血压测量是评估患心脏病或中风几率的一个重要但不精确的方法。
ext.ext_en: Standard measurements of blood pressure are an important but crude way of assessing the risk of heart disease or strokes...

ext.ext_cn: 出生地信息只能非常粗略地显示实际移民过程。
ext.ext_en: Birthplace data are only the crudest indicator of actual migration paths.

defs.def_en: A crude method or measurement is not exact or detailed, but may be useful or correct in a rough, general way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 简陋的木盒子
ext.ext_en: ...crude wooden boxes.

defs.def_en: If you describe an object that someone has made as crude, you mean that it has been made in a very simple way or from very simple parts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 冒犯的;粗鲁的;不精明的

ext.ext_cn: 尼夫！你非得那么粗俗吗？
ext.ext_en: Nev! Must you be quite so crude?

ext.ext_cn: 粗俗的语言
ext.ext_en: ...crude language.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as crude, you disapprove of them because they speak or behave in a rude, offensive, or unsophisticated way.

ext.ext_cn: 850万吨粗钢
ext.ext_en: ...8.5 million tonnes of crude steel.

defs.def_en: Crude substances are in a natural or unrefined state, and have not yet been used in manufacturing processes.
Crude is the same as crude oil .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 充满激情的;激昂的;激烈的

ext.ext_cn: 他慷慨陈词，呼吁和平。
ext.ext_en: He made an impassioned appeal for peace.

defs.def_en: An impassioned speech or piece of writing is one in which someone expresses their strong feelings about an issue in a forceful way.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在一个小角落找了个位子，吃了点午饭。
ext.ext_en: We found a seat in a little nook, and had some lunch.

ext.ext_cn: 盒子叠放在工厂的各个角落。
ext.ext_en: Boxes are stacked in every nook and cranny at the factory.

defs.def_en: A nook is a small and sheltered place.

ext.ext_cn: 我背负着掌管财务的重担。
ext.ext_en: I was lumbered with the job of taking charge of all the money...

ext.ext_cn: 她必须得偿付一张90英镑左右的账单。
ext.ext_en: She was lumbered with a bill for about ninety pounds.

defs.def_en: If you are lumbered with someone or something, you have to deal with them or take care of them even though you do not want to and this annoys you.

defs.def_cn: 伊朗的;伊朗人的;伊朗文化的

ext.ext_cn: 四十五六岁的伊朗女作家
ext.ext_en: ...an Iranian writer in her mid-forties.

defs.def_en: Iranian means belonging or relating to Iran, or to its people or culture.
An Iranian is an Iranian citizen, or a person of Iranian origin.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 3 个小时断断续续的降雨之后,比赛取消了。
ext.ext_en: After three hours of intermittent rain, the game was abandoned.

defs.def_en: Something that is intermittent happens occasionally rather than continuously.

defs.def_cn: 自己动手做的;家里做的

ext.ext_cn: 面包、油酥点心和蛋黄酱都是家里做的。
ext.ext_en: The bread, pastry and mayonnaise are home-made...

ext.ext_cn: 一枚自制炸弹在骚乱中爆炸了。
ext.ext_en: A home-made bomb exploded during the disturbances.

defs.def_en: Something that is home-made has been made in someone's home, rather than in a shop or factory.

ext.ext_cn: 如果只是在晚上头疼，那常常是由于缺乏新鲜空气和氧气的缘故。
ext.ext_en: If headaches only occur at night, lack of fresh air and oxygen is often the cause...

ext.ext_cn: 机务人员关错了引擎，随即飞机坠毁。
ext.ext_en: The crash occurred when the crew shut down the wrong engine...

defs.def_en: When something occurs, it happens.

ext.ext_cn: 在非洲凡是有这种蝇虫的地方，几乎都会出现这一牛病。
ext.ext_en: The cattle disease occurs more or less anywhere in Africa where the fly occurs...

ext.ext_cn: 在地势低平的珊瑚岛或环礁上没有这种螺。
ext.ext_en: These snails do not occur on low-lying coral islands or atolls.

defs.def_en: When something occurs in a particular place, it exists or is present there.

defs.def_cn: （想法或主意）被想到，被想起，浮现于脑海中

ext.ext_cn: 我没有想到要核实我的保险单条款。
ext.ext_en: It did not occur to me to check my insurance policy...

ext.ext_cn: 我想到可以让人把书寄给我。
ext.ext_en: It occurred to me that I could have the book sent to me...

defs.def_en: If a thought or idea occurs to you, you suddenly think of it or realize it.

ext.ext_cn: 公众对这种治安管理费用的不满情绪与日俱增。
ext.ext_en: There is growing public disquiet about the cost of such policing.

defs.def_en: Disquiet is a feeling of worry or anxiety.

ext.ext_cn: 这则消息让他焦虑不安。
ext.ext_en: This information disquieted him.

defs.def_en: If something disquiets you, it makes you feel anxious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 以抨击有组织犯罪而知名的电视节目
ext.ext_en: ...a television programme noted for its attacks on organised crime...

ext.ext_cn: 律师并非以仓促求变著称。
ext.ext_en: Lawyers are not noted for rushing into change.

defs.def_en: To be noted for something you do or have means to be well-known and admired for it.

defs.def_cn: 背信弃义；背叛；不忠；不仁不义
defs.def_en: Perfidy is the action of betraying someone or behaving very badly towards someone.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 卖弄风骚的一瞥
ext.ext_en: ...a coquettish glance.

defs.def_en: If you describe a woman as coquettish, you mean she acts in a playful way that is intended to make men find her attractive.

defs.def_cn: 使（尤指不好的情况、制度、信仰等）继续，延长

ext.ext_cn: 我们绝对不能让过去的宗教分裂继续下去。
ext.ext_en: We must not perpetuate the religious divisions of the past...

ext.ext_cn: 这种形象是媒体宣传造成的错觉。
ext.ext_en: This image is a myth perpetuated by the media.

defs.def_en: If someone or something perpetuates a situation, system, or belief, especially a bad one, they cause it to continue.

ext.ext_cn: 他走到当地的投票中心投了票。
ext.ext_en: He walked to the local polling centre to cast his vote...

ext.ext_cn: 政府获得了远远超过400票赞成的绝大多数票。
ext.ext_en: The government got a massive majority — well over 400 votes...

defs.def_en: A vote is a choice made by a particular person or group in a meeting or an election.

ext.ext_cn: 为什么你认为我们应该对那件事进行表决？
ext.ext_en: Why do you think we should have a vote on that?...

ext.ext_cn: 他们进行了表决，决定放弃。
ext.ext_en: They took a vote and decided not to do it.

defs.def_en: A vote is an occasion when a group of people make a decision by each person indicating his or her choice. The choice that most people support is accepted by the group.

ext.ext_cn: 反对党大约赢得了55％的选票。
ext.ext_en: Opposition parties won about fifty-five per cent of the vote...

ext.ext_cn: 压倒多数的选票投给了民主党。
ext.ext_en: The vote was overwhelmingly in favour of the Democratic Party.

defs.def_en: The vote is the total number of votes or voters in an election, or the number of votes received or cast by a particular group.

ext.ext_cn: 当然了，我们连投票权都没有，不是吗？
ext.ext_en: And of course we didn't even have the vote, did we?...

ext.ext_cn: 在那之前，妇女连选举权都没有。
ext.ext_en: Before that, women did not have a vote at all...

defs.def_en: If you have the vote in an election, or have a vote in a meeting, you have the legal right to indicate your choice.

ext.ext_cn: 全国选民的2/3有机会在这些选举中投票。
ext.ext_en: Two-thirds of the national electorate had the chance to vote in these elections...

ext.ext_cn: 如果有一个新领导人的话，大选时似乎许多人都会投票支持政府。
ext.ext_en: It seems many people would vote for the government, at a general election, if there was a new leader...

defs.def_en: When you vote, you indicate your choice officially at a meeting or in an election, for example by raising your hand or writing on a piece of paper.

defs.def_cn: 投…的票；投（赞成或反对）票

ext.ext_cn: 52.5％的受访者表示他们会投工党的票。
ext.ext_en: 52.5% of those questioned said they'd vote Labour...

ext.ext_cn: 无论如何我可能都会那样投票。
ext.ext_en: I probably would have voted that way anyway...

defs.def_en: If you vote a particular political party or leader, or vote yes or no, you make that choice with the vote that you have.

defs.def_cn: （通过投票）决定给予（资助），同意提供（款项）

ext.ext_cn: 州议会投票决定拨款2,500美元为他建一座纪念碑。
ext.ext_en: The General Court had voted $2,500 for a monument to be erected to his memory...

ext.ext_cn: 国会投票同意拨出更多资金来维持美国军队的开支。
ext.ext_en: The Parliament voted more funds to help maintain American forces.

defs.def_en: If a government or other organization votes money for something or to do something, they decide to spend the money in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 他被班里评选为“为耶鲁作出最大贡献”的人。
ext.ext_en: His class voted him the man 'who had done the most for Yale.'...

ext.ext_cn: 迈克尔被评为“年度最佳球员”。
ext.ext_en: Michael has been voted Player of the Year.

defs.def_en: If people vote someone a particular title, they choose that person to have that title.

defs.def_cn: 以退席（或退出组织）表示反对

ext.ext_cn: 成千上万的公民正准备离开这个国家，以这一举动表示反对。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of citizens are already voting with their feet, and leaving the country...

ext.ext_cn: 作者依然可以通过退出并加盟规模小些的公司来表明他们的反对立场。
ext.ext_en: Authors still have power to vote with their feet by leaving to join smaller companies.

defs.def_en: If you vote with your feet, you show that you do not support something by leaving the place where it is happening or leaving the organization that is supporting it.

ext.ext_cn: 我建议我们全都立刻前往荷兰。
ext.ext_en: I vote that we all go to Holland immediately...

ext.ext_cn: 我提议由你来选我们该走哪条小路。
ext.ext_en: I vote that you try to pick out the trail for us.

defs.def_en: If you say 'vote that' a particular thing should happen, you are suggesting that this is what should happen.

ext.ext_cn: 古尔德先生号召采取“一人一票制”。
ext.ext_en: Mr Gould called for a move towards 'one man one vote'...

ext.ext_cn: 非洲国民大会坚持实行一人一票的制度。
ext.ext_en: The African National Congress insists on a one-man, one-vote system.

defs.def_en: One man one vote or one person one vote is a system of voting in which every person in a group or country has the right to cast their vote, and in which each individual's  vote is counted and has equal value.

defs.def_cn: 迅速地;毫不耽搁地;马上

ext.ext_cn: 她被要求立即离开。
ext.ext_en: She was asked to leave, sharpish.

defs.def_en: If you do something sharpish, you do it quickly, without any delay.

ext.ext_cn: 脑部扫描已经证实疾病得到了控制。
ext.ext_en: Brain scans have confirmed that the disease is in remission...

ext.ext_cn: 病情缓解6年后，癌症又复发了。
ext.ext_en: After six years of remission, cancer reappeared.

defs.def_en: If someone who has had a serious disease such as cancer is in remission or if the disease is in remission, the disease has been controlled so that they are not as ill as they were.

ext.ext_cn: 她因为表现良好获得减刑，可能会在一年内重获自由。
ext.ext_en: With remission for good behaviour, she could be freed in a year.

defs.def_en: If someone in prison gets remission, their prison sentence is reduced, usually because they have behaved well.

defs.def_cn: (发动机)发出噼啪声;(火焰)发出毕剥声

ext.ext_cn: 卡车噼啪响了几声停下了。
ext.ext_en: The truck sputtered and stopped...

ext.ext_cn: 发动机噼啪噼啪地重新开动了。
ext.ext_en: Engines sputtered to life again...
