defs.def_en: If something such as an engine or a flame sputters, it works or burns in an uneven way and makes a series of soft popping sounds.

defs.def_cn: (过程、行动或事态)缓慢不稳地进行，慢慢结束

ext.ext_cn: 经济发展速度已经放慢，增长率很低，或者根本没有增长。
ext.ext_en: The economy is already sputtering, with low or no growth...

ext.ext_cn: 战斗于 10 月中旬渐渐停了下来。
ext.ext_en: The battle sputtered to a halt in mid-October...

defs.def_en: If a process, action, or state of affairs sputters, it progresses slowly and unevenly or starts to end.

defs.def_cn: (尤指因生气、震惊或激动)结结巴巴地说话，语无伦次地说话

ext.ext_cn: 我大吃一惊，结结巴巴地问道：“你是什么意思？”
ext.ext_en: Stunned, I sputtered, 'What do you mean?'...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的父亲气得涨红了脸，说话开始语无伦次。
ext.ext_en: Our father's face had reddened with rage and he began to sputter...

defs.def_en: If you sputter, you speak with difficulty and make short sounds, especially because you are angry, shocked, or excited.
Your babyhood is the period of your life when you were a baby.

defs.def_cn: (调查和问题的)回答者;答卷人

ext.ext_cn: 60％的调查对象表示不认可总统的表现。
ext.ext_en: 60 percent of the respondents said they disapproved of the president's performance.

defs.def_en: A respondent is a person who replies to something such as a survey or set of questions.

ext.ext_cn: 另外，被告还向其中一位病人透露了行业机密。
ext.ext_en: In addition, the respondent disclosed professional confidences to one of the patients.

defs.def_en: A respondent is someone who has to defend a case in a law court.
The Lord's Prayer is a Christian prayer that was originally taught by Jesus Christ to his followers.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 行业清理整顿需要严厉的措施。
ext.ext_en: Drastic measures are needed to clean up the profession...

ext.ext_cn: 他不打算对经济政策作任何重大调整。
ext.ext_en: He's not going to do anything drastic about economic policy.

defs.def_en: If you have to take drastic action in order to solve a problem, you have to do something extreme and basic to solve it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 上了年纪的人在他们这个人生阶段不会再有什么实质性的改变。
ext.ext_en: Elderly people are not in a position to make drastic changes at this stage of their life...

ext.ext_cn: 死亡人数的大幅下降
ext.ext_en: ...a drastic reduction in the numbers of people dying.

defs.def_en: A drastic change is a very great change.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我们大家团结在一起，就不会有事。
ext.ext_en: If we all stick together, we ought to be okay.

defs.def_en: If people stick together, they stay with each other and support each other.

defs.def_cn: （观点、情感等的）主要原因，主要动机

ext.ext_cn: 我以音乐为生，对音乐的不懈探索已经成为我生活的动力。
ext.ext_en: My life has been music, and a constant search for it has been the mainspring of my life...

ext.ext_cn: 你开始体会到是什么样的行动在推动这个故事的发展。
ext.ext_en: You begin to understand what actions were the mainspring of the story.

defs.def_en: If you say that an idea, emotion, or other factor is the mainspring of something, you mean that it is the most important reason or motive for that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 不少企业集团一直在向联邦储备委员会施压，要求其放松利率管制。
ext.ext_en: Many business groups have been pressing the Federal Reserve to loosen interest rates...

ext.ext_cn: 钻探条例亦已放宽，以加速油田的开发。
ext.ext_en: Drilling regulations, too, have been loosened to speed the development of the fields.

defs.def_en: If someone loosens restrictions or laws, for example, they make them less strict or severe.

ext.ext_cn: 联邦共和国必须疏远其与美国的关系。
ext.ext_en: The Federal Republic must loosen its ties with the United States...

ext.ext_cn: 该政党的二把手对疏远与工会之间关系一事态度谨慎。
ext.ext_en: The deputy leader is cautious about loosening the links with the unions...

defs.def_en: If someone or something loosens the ties between people or groups of people, or  if the ties loosen, they become weaker.

ext.ext_cn: 他伸手松了松脖子上的围巾。
ext.ext_en: He reached up to loosen the scarf around his neck...

ext.ext_cn: 松一松插销，好转动门闩。
ext.ext_en: Loosen the bolt so the bars can be turned...

defs.def_en: If you loosen your clothing or something that is tied or fastened or if it loosens, you undo it slightly so that it is less tight or less firmly held in place.

ext.ext_cn: 在鸡胸上方插进一把小刀，以使鸡皮不要绷得太紧。
ext.ext_en: Insert a small knife into the top of the chicken breast to loosen the skin.

defs.def_en: If you loosen something that is stretched across something else, you make it less stretched or tight.

ext.ext_cn: 哈里的手稍一放松，安娜便挣脱出来。
ext.ext_en: Harry loosened his grip momentarily and Anna wriggled free...

ext.ext_cn: 他紧抓她的手松了一下，她便抽身而出。
ext.ext_en: When his grip loosened she eased herself away.

defs.def_en: If you loosen your grip on something, or if your grip loosens, you hold it less tightly.

ext.ext_cn: 没有迹象显示该党会放松对国家的严密控制。
ext.ext_en: There is no sign that the Party will loosen its tight grip on the country...

ext.ext_cn: 苏联对东欧的控制已经放松。
ext.ext_en: The Soviet Union's grip on Eastern Europe loosened.

defs.def_en: If a government or organization loosens its grip on a group of people or an activity, or if its grip loosens, it begins to have less control over it.

ext.ext_cn: 酒一下肚，他便打开了话匣。
ext.ext_en: The wine had loosened his tongue.

defs.def_en: If you say that something has loosened someone's tongue, you mean that it has made them talk about something, often when they should have remained silent.

ext.ext_cn: 庆典上的欢歌笑语
ext.ext_en: ...the singing and jollity of the celebration.

defs.def_en: Jollity is cheerful behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 党内右翼人士与温和派的内讧
ext.ext_en: ...in-fighting between right-wingers and moderates in the party.

defs.def_en: Infighting is quarrelling and competition between members of the same group or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 后勤人员
ext.ext_en: ...ancillary staff.

ext.ext_cn: 清洁等后勤工作
ext.ext_en: ...ancillary services like cleaning.

defs.def_en: The ancillary workers in an institution are the people such as cleaners and cooks whose work supports the main work of the institution.

ext.ext_cn: 附加收费每天至少30美元。
ext.ext_en: Ancillary charges are at least $30 per day...

ext.ext_cn: 科技发展意味着许多医学衍生职业的增长。
ext.ext_en: Scientific development meant the growth of numerous professions ancillary to medicine.

defs.def_en: Ancillary means additional to something else.

defs.def_cn: 拘泥于细节（或传统）的人；（尤指）学究，书呆子，老夫子

ext.ext_cn: 我不是书呆子，不想在英语语法和表达方式上过于教条主义。
ext.ext_en: I am no pedant and avoid being dogmatic concerning English grammar and expression.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a pedant, you mean that they are too concerned with unimportant details or traditional rules, especially in connection with academic subjects.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 奇怪的;不寻常的;奇异的

ext.ext_cn: 第一天有些怪异。
ext.ext_en: That first day was weird...

ext.ext_cn: 他与众不同，有点怪。
ext.ext_en: He's different. He's weird...

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as weird, you mean that they are strange.

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼回到神父的房子时显得极为焦虑不安。
ext.ext_en: Danny returned to Father's house in a state of intense agitation...

ext.ext_cn: 黛安娜点燃一根香烟，试图掩饰她的焦躁不安。
ext.ext_en: Diane lit a cigarette, trying to mask her agitation.

defs.def_en: See also:agitate;If someone is in a state of agitation, they are very worried or upset, and show this in their behaviour, movements, or voice.

ext.ext_cn: 这种情节确实让人难以置信。
ext.ext_en: The plot does stretch credulity.

defs.def_en: Credulity is a willingness to believe that something is real or true.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正围坐在餐桌旁。
ext.ext_en: They were sitting round the kitchen table...

ext.ext_cn: 这件女式睡衣的袖孔和领口都镶着一圈手织花边。
ext.ext_en: The nightdress has handmade lace round the armholes and neckline...

defs.def_en: To be positioned round a place or object means to surround it or be on all sides of it. To move round a place means to go along its edge, back to the point where you started.

ext.ext_cn: 突然，对面的街角处拐过一辆汽车。
ext.ext_en: Suddenly a car came round a corner on the opposite side...

ext.ext_cn: 继续顺着左边的人行道拐一个弯，然后沿路下山。
ext.ext_en: Stay on the left-hand pavement to follow a road downhill round a curve...

defs.def_en: If you move round a corner or obstacle, you move to the other side of it. If you look round a corner or obstacle, you look to see what is on the other side.

ext.ext_cn: 他恰好拥有这里一半的土地。
ext.ext_en: He happens to own half the land round here...

ext.ext_cn: 我想他已经赢得了世界各国领导人的尊重。
ext.ext_en: I think he has earned the respect of leaders all round the world...

defs.def_en: You use round to say that something happens in or relates to different parts of a place, or is near a place.

ext.ext_cn: 以每小时60英里的速度前进的车轮很快就会磨出洞来。
ext.ext_en: Holes can be worn remarkably quickly by a wheel going round at 60mph...

ext.ext_cn: 满眼金星乱转，而且越转越快。
ext.ext_en: Stars appeared everywhere, spinning round and round, faster and faster.

defs.def_en: If a wheel or object spins round, it turns on its axis.

ext.ext_cn: 她停了一下，但是并没有转身。
ext.ext_en: She paused, but did not turn round...

ext.ext_cn: 最后的结果是这艘船不得不掉转方向，驶回吉布提。
ext.ext_en: The end result was that the ship had to turn round, and go back to Djibouti...

defs.def_en: If you turn round, you turn so that you are facing or going in the opposite direction.

ext.ext_cn: 他会很乐意尽可能添置些家具，把东西挪一挪，然后重新装饰。
ext.ext_en: He will be glad to refurnish where possible, change things round and redecorate...

ext.ext_cn: 我已经把东西挪了挪，好让他更方便。
ext.ext_en: I've already moved things round a bit to make it easier for him.

defs.def_en: If you move things round, you move them so they are in different places.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰把那盘三明治传给大家。
ext.ext_en: John handed round the plate of sandwiches.

ext.ext_cn: 当大家传递威士忌酒瓶的时候
ext.ext_en: ...as the whiskey bottle is passed round.

defs.def_en: If you hand or pass something round, it is passed from person to person in a group.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得我们应该去凯文家让他把音乐的声音调小一些。
ext.ext_en: I think we should go round and tell Kevin to turn his music down...

ext.ext_cn: 他带着一瓶香槟过来了。
ext.ext_en: He came round with a bottle of champagne.

defs.def_en: If you go round to someone's house, you visit them.

ext.ext_cn: 当我们坐在那里聊天时，我开始认为自己犯了一个错误。
ext.ext_en: As we sat round chatting, I began to think I'd made a mistake...

ext.ext_cn: 我兴奋地跑来跑去。
ext.ext_en: I was running round all hyped up.

defs.def_en: You use round in informal expressions such as sit round or hang round when you are saying that someone is spending time in a place and is not doing anything very important.

ext.ext_cn: 那是用在以现有的一种美国发动机为基础的设计之上的。
ext.ext_en: That was for a design built round an existing American engine...

ext.ext_cn: 这个音乐节最重要的节目以演奏20世纪的作品和新作为主。
ext.ext_en: The core of the Festival's programme centres round performances of new and 20th century work.

defs.def_en: If something is built or based round a particular idea, that idea is the basis for it.

ext.ext_cn: 不要马上放弃，应该想想解决问题的办法。
ext.ext_en: Don't just immediately give up but think about ways round a problem...

ext.ext_cn: 有几种可以解决大多数问题的方法。
ext.ext_en: There are ways of getting round most things!

defs.def_en: If you get round a problem or difficulty, you find a way of dealing with it.

ext.ext_cn: 他竭力想要说服我改变主意，但是我不愿意跟他讲话。
ext.ext_en: He did his best to talk me round, but I wouldn't speak to him...

ext.ext_cn: 钱德勒家的这对双胞胎也最终统一了意见。
ext.ext_en: The Chandler twins were coming round to the same opinion.

defs.def_en: If you win someone round, or if they come round, they change their mind about something and start agreeing with you.

defs.def_cn: （用于描述以前发生过或定期发生的事情）

ext.ext_cn: 在过去，这些选举中总是会发生数百起谋杀案，但这一次暴力事件已经非常少了。
ext.ext_en: In the past, the elections have been marked by hundreds of murders, but this time round the violence has been much more limited...

ext.ext_cn: 当然，这不同于第一次了。
ext.ext_en: Of course, it isn't the same first time round...

defs.def_en: You use round in expressions such as this time round or to come round when you are describing something that has happened before or things that happen regularly.

ext.ext_cn: 我的腰围大概粗了两英寸。
ext.ext_en: I'm about two inches larger round the waist.

ext.ext_cn: 臀围48英寸
ext.ext_en: ...forty-eight inches round the hips.

defs.def_en: You can use round to give the measurement of the outside of something that is shaped like a circle or a cylinder.

ext.ext_cn: 我大约晚上11点上床睡觉。
ext.ext_en: I go to bed round 11:00 at night.

defs.def_en: You use round in front of times or amounts to indicate that they are approximate.

ext.ext_cn: 大概有150万人死亡。
ext.ext_en: Round about one and a half million people died.

ext.ext_cn: 大约在1902年被废除的制度
ext.ext_en: ...a system that was abolished round about 1902.

defs.def_en: In spoken English, round about means approximately.

ext.ext_cn: 它应该会让生活的方方面面都变得更加方便。
ext.ext_en: It ought to make life much easier all round...

ext.ext_cn: 每一根神经都绷紧了。
ext.ext_en: Nerves are frayed all round.

defs.def_en: You say all round to emphasize that something affects all parts of a situation or all members of a group.

ext.ext_cn: 这一直在我脑海里萦绕，直到我不知身在何处。
ext.ext_en: It all keeps going round and round in my head till I don't know where I am.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is going round and round in your head, you mean that you can't stop thinking about it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些植物中有很多都是四季常青的，所以一年到头都可以观赏。
ext.ext_en: Many of these plants are evergreen, so you can enjoy them all year round...

ext.ext_cn: 这是全年都能享受到的款待。
ext.ext_en: It's a treat to be enjoyed all the year round.

defs.def_en: If something happens all year round, it happens throughout the year.

defs.def_cn: 一连串，一系列，一轮(相关的事件，尤指相继发生的事件)

ext.ext_cn: 经协商，新一轮的预备会谈将在北京举行。
ext.ext_en: It was agreed that another round of preliminary talks would be held in Peking...

ext.ext_cn: 这是旨在增强公司竞争力的新一轮裁员。
ext.ext_en: This is the latest round of job cuts aimed at making the company more competitive...

defs.def_en: A round of events is a series of related events, especially one which comes after or before a similar series of events.

ext.ext_cn: 在皮尔金顿杯的第3轮比赛中
ext.ext_en: ...in the third round of the Pilkington Cup...

ext.ext_cn: 第3轮比赛结束后，两名美国选手领先。
ext.ext_en: After round three, two Americans share the lead.

defs.def_en: In sport, a round is a series of games in a competition. The winners of these games go on to play in the next round, and so on, until only one player or team is left.

ext.ext_cn: 在第11回合中，他被宣布获胜。
ext.ext_en: He was declared the victor in the 11th round...

ext.ext_cn: 在第一回合结束前，吉布森的左眼完全闭上了。
ext.ext_en: Gibson's left eye is completely closed before the end of round one.

defs.def_en: In a boxing or wrestling match, a round is one of the periods during which the boxers or wrestlers fight.

ext.ext_cn: 两场高尔夫球赛
ext.ext_en: ...two rounds of golf...

ext.ext_cn: 罗南·拉弗蒂在成绩为67杆的一场比赛中打出了6次小鸟球。
ext.ext_en: Ronan Rafferty shot six birdies in a round of 67.

defs.def_en: A round of golf is one game, usually including 18 holes.

ext.ext_cn: 新鲜的小块圆形山羊奶酪
ext.ext_en: ...small fresh rounds of goats' cheese...

ext.ext_cn: 黄瓜被切成了圆片。
ext.ext_en: A cucumber was sliced into rounds.

defs.def_en: A round is a circular shape.

ext.ext_cn: 4片吐司
ext.ext_en: ...four rounds of toast.

defs.def_en: A round of bread is a slice of bread. A round of sandwiches is a sandwich made from two slices of bread.

ext.ext_cn: 这些顾问们上午仍然四处走访。
ext.ext_en: The consultants still did their morning rounds...

ext.ext_cn: 他下了汽车，继续带着文件四处拜访。
ext.ext_en: He got out of the car, and carried on with his paper round.

defs.def_en: If you do your rounds or your round, you make a series of visits to different places or people, for example as part of your job.

ext.ext_cn: 他们坐在俱乐部会所的露台上，大口喝着别人请的饮料。
ext.ext_en: They sat on the clubhouse terrace, downing a round of drinks...

ext.ext_cn: 我想这轮该我请了。
ext.ext_en: I think it's my round.

defs.def_en: If you buy a round of drinks, you buy a drink for each member of the group of people that you are with.

ext.ext_cn: 在10分钟之内打出了1,650发子弹
ext.ext_en: ...firing 1650 rounds of ammunition during a period of ten minutes.

ext.ext_cn: 使用未引爆的弹药
ext.ext_en: ...the use of live rounds of ammunition.

defs.def_en: A round of ammunition is the bullet or bullets released when a gun is fired.

ext.ext_cn: 休得到了一片赞成的掌声。
ext.ext_en: Sue got a sympathetic round of applause.

defs.def_en: If there is a round of applause, everyone claps their hands to welcome someone or to show that they have enjoyed something.
In music, a round is a simple song sung by several people in which each person sings a different part of the song at the same time.

defs.def_cn: (故事、想法或玩笑)传播，流传，传开

ext.ext_cn: 20年前，这个故事广为流传。
ext.ext_en: This story was going the rounds 20 years ago.

defs.def_en: If a story, idea, or joke is going the rounds or doing the rounds, a lot of people have heard it and are telling it to other people.

ext.ext_cn: 放学以后，我接了尼克和特德，然后又去了干洗店和杂货店。
ext.ext_en: After school, I had picked up Nick and Ted and made the rounds of the dry cleaner and the grocery store...

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以逐一参观各个画廊。
ext.ext_en: We could do the rounds of the galleries.

defs.def_en: If you make the rounds or do the rounds, you visit a series of different places.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的手脚都很小，脸又扁又圆。
ext.ext_en: She had small feet and hands and a flat, round face.

ext.ext_cn: 被称为“新教堂”的球形教堂
ext.ext_en: ...the round church known as The New Temple.

defs.def_en: Something that is round is shaped like a circle or ball.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 男孩吮吸着拇指，瞪圆了大眼睛盯着赫本。
ext.ext_en: The boy sucked his thumb and stared at Hebburn with huge, round eyes.

defs.def_en: If someone has round eyes, their eyes are open wide, for example because they are surprised, excited, or afraid.

defs.def_cn: 整数的，不计尾数的(以10的倍数表示)

ext.ext_cn: 100万英镑看起来是一个比较合适的整数。
ext.ext_en: A million pounds seemed a suitably round number.

ext.ext_cn: 钱都存入小组的集体基金，到今年夏天基金的整数已经达到了18,000英镑。
ext.ext_en: The money goes into the team pool, which this summer, in round figures, has now reached £18,000.

defs.def_en: A round number is a multiple of 10, 100, 1000, and so on. Round numbers are used instead of precise ones to give the general idea of a quantity or proportion.

ext.ext_cn: 我们绕过街角就看不到那座房子了。
ext.ext_en: The house disappeared from sight as we rounded a corner...

ext.ext_cn: 绕过菲尼斯特雷角之后，这些船开始在东北信风的吹送下破浪前行。
ext.ext_en: After rounding Cape Finisterre the boats ride the north-easterly trades.

defs.def_en: If you round a place or obstacle, you move in a curve past the edge or corner of it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们得把小数四舍五入成整数。
ext.ext_en: We needed to do decimals to round up and round down numbers...

ext.ext_cn: 然后，分数被乘以100，取整为最接近的半数或整数。
ext.ext_en: The fraction was then multiplied by 100 and rounded to the nearest half or whole number...

defs.def_en: If you round an amount up or down, or if you round it off, you change it to the nearest whole number or nearest multiple of 10, 100, 1000 and so on.

defs.def_cn: （利用色相勾引男人的）荡妇，妖妇，女骗子
defs.def_en: If you describe a woman as a vamp, you mean that she uses her sexual attractiveness to get what she wants from men.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们只不过是普通人，太容易犯错误了。
ext.ext_en: They are only human and all too fallible...

ext.ext_cn: 时间一次又一次证明,这个系统是会出错的。
ext.ext_en: The system has proved fallible time after time...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is fallible, you mean that they are not perfect and are likely to make mistakes or to fail in what they are doing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我从没见过更笨拙、动作更不协调的拳击手。
ext.ext_en: I'd never seen a clumsier, less coordinated boxer...

ext.ext_cn: 令人遗憾的是我开起吉普来还是笨手笨脚。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately, I was still very clumsy behind the wheel of the jeep.

defs.def_en: A  clumsy person moves or handles things in a careless, awkward way, often so that things are knocked over or broken.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为或措词)不得体的，拙劣的

ext.ext_cn: 这一试图推翻人民党政府的行动似乎缺乏策略。
ext.ext_en: The action seemed a clumsy attempt to topple the Janata Dal government...

ext.ext_cn: 他否认声明不得体、不近人情。
ext.ext_en: He denied the announcement was clumsy and insensitive.

defs.def_en: A clumsy action or statement is not skilful or is likely to upset people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (设计或外表)粗糙的，难用的;设计欠佳的

ext.ext_cn: 就手提电脑而言，键盘就显得大而笨重了。
ext.ext_en: The keyboard is a large and clumsy instrument as far as portable computers are concerned...

ext.ext_cn: 那架飞机样子很难看。
ext.ext_en: It was a clumsy looking aeroplane.

defs.def_en: An object that is clumsy is not neat in design or appearance, and is often awkward to use.

ext.ext_cn: 尼尔之前在伯明翰的一所学校参加颁奖仪式。
ext.ext_en: Neil had been at a prize giving ceremony at a school in Birmingham.

ext.ext_cn: 养牛展的颁奖仪式
ext.ext_en: ...a prize-giving for cattle-breeding.

defs.def_en: also prizegiving. A prize-giving is a ceremony where prizes are awarded to people who have produced a very high standard of work.

ext.ext_cn: 在他们受审的过程中没有表现出一丝悔意。
ext.ext_en: They showed no repentance during their trial.

defs.def_en: If you show repentance for something wrong that you have done, you make it clear that you are sorry for doing it.
A portraitist is an artist who paints or draws people's portraits.
HRT is given to women and involves taking the hormone oestrogen, usually in order to control the symptoms of the menopause. HRT is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'hormone replacement therapy'.

defs.def_cn: (指某一职业或要职的)责任，职责

ext.ext_cn: 自从1990年荣获“欧洲文化之都”的光荣称号以来，格拉斯哥的魅力大增。
ext.ext_en: Glasgow has broadened its appeal since taking on the mantle of European City of Culture in 1990...

ext.ext_cn: 她具备担当领导职责的聪明才智。
ext.ext_en: She has the intellectual form to take up the mantle of leadership.

defs.def_en: If you take on the mantle of something such as a profession or an important job, you take on the responsibilities and duties which must be fulfilled by anyone who has this profession or job.

ext.ext_cn: 在一层烟尘的笼罩之下，公园和广场显得阴沉沉的。
ext.ext_en: The parks and squares looked grim under a mantle of soot and ash.

defs.def_en: A mantle of something is a layer of it covering a surface, for example a layer of snow on the ground.
A mantle is a piece of clothing without sleeves that people used to wear over their other clothes in former times.

defs.def_cn: 汽车的;开汽车的;汽车驾驶的

ext.ext_cn: 因违法驾车而被判3个月徒刑
ext.ext_en: ...a three-month sentence for motoring offences...

ext.ext_cn: 警方和一些汽车组织表示，这些公路比平常稍繁忙一些。
ext.ext_en: Police and motoring organizations said the roads were slightly busier than normal.

defs.def_en: Motoring means relating to cars and driving.

ext.ext_cn: 我再也无可奉告了，这本是重大的秘密。
ext.ext_en: I can't say any more, it's meant to be a big secret...

ext.ext_cn: 这样的装饰布局原本是想让人们把注意力集中在如何赚钱上。
ext.ext_en: The decor was meant to keep the mind concentrated on the making of money...

defs.def_en: You use meant to to say that something or someone was intended to be or do a particular thing, especially when they have failed to be or do it.

ext.ext_cn: 童话故事不仅仅是写给孩子们的。
ext.ext_en: Fairy tales weren't just meant for children...

ext.ext_cn: 这些种子并不是给人吃的。
ext.ext_en: The seeds were not meant for human consumption...

defs.def_en: If something is meant for particular people or for a particular situation, it is intended for those people or for that situation.

ext.ext_cn: 订婚的特别之处在于，你就应该让人人知道你订婚了。
ext.ext_en: The peculiar thing about getting engaged is that you're meant to announce it to everyone...

ext.ext_cn: 派对就是为了乐和一下。
ext.ext_en: Parties are meant to be fun.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is meant to happen, you mean that it is expected to happen or that it ought to happen.

defs.def_cn: 公认(具有某种特性或特点);具有…的名声

ext.ext_cn: 博若莱葡萄酒是公认的佳酿。
ext.ext_en: Beaujolais is meant to be a really good wine.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is meant to have a particular quality or characteristic, you mean that it has a reputation for being like that.

ext.ext_cn: 当然啦，市区正中心的租金是很高的。
ext.ext_en: Of course, slap-bang in the middle of town the rents are high.

defs.def_en: Slap bang is used in expressions such as slap bang in the middle of somewhere to mean exactly in that place.
Flagstones are large, flat, square pieces of stone which are used for covering a path or area of ground.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这东西一定要小心,稍不注意的话就会有危险。
ext.ext_en: Be very careful with this stuff, it can be dangerous if it isn't handled properly...

ext.ext_cn: 走那几段楼梯要当心!
ext.ext_en: Careful on those stairs!...

defs.def_en: If you are careful, you give serious attention to what you are doing, in order to avoid harm, damage, or mistakes. If you are careful to do something, you make sure that you do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在认真考虑了所有相关事实后,他决定起诉她。
ext.ext_en: He has decided to prosecute her after careful consideration of all the relevant facts...

ext.ext_cn: 我们目前对该疾病的认识是通过对病变器官的仔细研究得来的。
ext.ext_en: What we now know about the disease was learned by careful study of diseased organs.

defs.def_en: Careful work, thought, or examination is thorough and shows a concern for details.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得你说话应该小心,不能把反叛分子当英雄。
ext.ext_en: I think you should be careful about talking of the rebels as heroes...

ext.ext_cn: 我想,每个人宣布胜利时都应该慎重。
ext.ext_en: It is important, I think, for everyone to be careful about claiming victory.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to be careful about doing something, you think that what they intend to do is probably wrong, and that they should think seriously before they do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你得格外注意培养孩子的节俭意识，零花钱要省着花。
ext.ext_en: You will have to make a special effort to train your child to be careful with her pocket-money...

ext.ext_cn: 这将迫使企业更加节约资源。
ext.ext_en: It would force industries to be more careful with natural resources.

defs.def_en: If you are careful with something such as money or resources, you use or spend only what is necessary.

defs.def_cn: 越谨慎越好;再小心也不为过

ext.ext_cn: 孩子在水边时,还是越小心越好。
ext.ext_en: You can't be too careful when a young child is near water.

defs.def_en: You can say 'You can't be too careful' as a way of advising someone to be careful, even when this seems unnecessary.
A showgirl is a young woman who sings and dances as part of a group in a musical show.

ext.ext_cn: 一看到他们的偶像,人群爆发出热烈的欢呼声。
ext.ext_en: A great cheer went up from the crowd as they caught sight of their idol...

ext.ext_cn: 他看起来不像是青少年偶像，而更像个股票经纪人。
ext.ext_en: He looks more like a stockbroker than a teen idol.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone such as a film, pop, or sports star as an idol, you mean that they are greatly admired or loved by their fans.
An idol is a statue or other object that is worshipped by people who believe that it is a god.

ext.ext_cn: 他曾像神一样受崇拜,如今却成了堕落的偶像。
ext.ext_en: He was once worshipped like a god but is now a fallen idol.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a fallen idol, you mean that they have lost people's respect and admiration because of something bad that they have done.

ext.ext_cn: 这两个社区之间现在有可能会发生冲突。
ext.ext_en: The two communities are now on a collision course...

ext.ext_cn: 英国的大学势必将与政府发生冲突。
ext.ext_en: Britain's universities are set on a collision course with the government.

defs.def_en: If two or more people or things are on a collision course, there is likely to be a sudden and violent disagreement between them.

ext.ext_cn: 有一颗小行星可能会与地球发生碰撞。
ext.ext_en: There is an asteroid on a collision course with the Earth.

defs.def_en: If two or more people or things are on a collision course, they are likely to meet and crash into each other violently.

ext.ext_cn: 她只好踢开前门。
ext.ext_en: She was forced to kick down the front door...

ext.ext_cn: 我邻居的门被踢开了。
ext.ext_en: My neighbour's door had been kicked in.

defs.def_en: If someone kicks something down or if they kick it in, they hit it violently with their foot so that it breaks or falls over.

ext.ext_cn: 政府对破坏环境的活动继续提供补助的愚蠢行为
ext.ext_en: ...the idiocy of continuing government subsidies for environmentally damaging activities.

ext.ext_cn: 他对前政权的愚蠢政策既温和又语带讽刺的分析
ext.ext_en: ...his gentle, ironic analysis of the idiocies of the previous regime.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as idiocy, you mean that you think it is very stupid.

ext.ext_cn: 她已婚的妹妹在一起交通事故中瘫痪了。
ext.ext_en: Her married sister had been paralysed in a road accident.

ext.ext_cn: 使他双腿瘫痪的病毒
ext.ext_en: ...a virus which paralysed his legs.

defs.def_en: If someone is paralysed by an accident or an illness, they have no feeling in their body, or in part of their body, and are unable to move.

defs.def_cn: 使失去活动能力；使无法正常运转；使瘫痪

ext.ext_cn: 到现在，政府因为无力决断已经陷入瘫痪达数周。
ext.ext_en: For weeks now the government has been paralysed by indecision...

ext.ext_cn: 他突然被吓得动弹不得。
ext.ext_en: He was suddenly paralysed by fear...

defs.def_en: If a person, place, or organization is paralysed by something, they become unable to act or function properly.

defs.def_cn: 抑制，平息（强烈的感情、争吵或危机)

ext.ext_cn: 他用手捂住嘴巴，力图平息内心的恐慌。
ext.ext_en: His hand moved to his mouth as he tried to damp down the panic...

ext.ext_cn: 除非降低预期，否则整个支出增长计划可能会导致加薪要求。
ext.ext_en: The entire spending boost could go on wage demands unless expectations are damped down.

defs.def_en: To damp down something such as a strong emotion, an argument, or a crisis means to make it calmer or less intense.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们应等待从现在到下次选举之间的最有利时机。
ext.ext_en: They should wait for the most propitious moment between now and the next election...

ext.ext_cn: 这场比赛仍不被看好。
ext.ext_en: The omens for the game are still not propitious.

defs.def_en: If something is propitious, it is likely to lead to success.

defs.def_cn: 通俗艺术，波普艺术（一种始于20世纪60年代、使用明快色彩、取材自日常生活的现代艺术潮流）

ext.ext_cn: 巨幅的巴迪·霍利波普艺术丝网印刷画
ext.ext_en: ...a massive pop-art silk-screen of Buddy Holly.

defs.def_en: Pop art is a style of modern art which began in the 1960s. It uses bright colours and takes a lot of its techniques and subject matter from everyday, modern life.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人士气低落的;使人泄气的

ext.ext_cn: 面临裁员可能会令士气低落。
ext.ext_en: Redundancy can be a demoralising prospect...

ext.ext_cn: 一再的否定和批评可能会对信心造成严重打击。
ext.ext_en: Persistent disapproval or criticism can be highly demoralizing.

defs.def_en: If something is demoralizing, it makes you lose so much confidence in what you are doing that you want to give up.

defs.def_cn: 英语字母表的第 6 个字母
defs.def_en: F is the sixth letter of the English  alphabet.

defs.def_cn: C 大调音阶中的第四个音;F 音
defs.def_en: In music, F is the fourth note in the scale of C major.

defs.def_cn: (置于表示页码或行数的数字后)见第…页(或行)及下页(或下行)(ff. 则表示见第…页(或行)及以下各页(或以下各行))
defs.def_en: f. is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'following'. It is written after a page or line number to indicate that you are referring to both the page or line mentioned and the one after it. You use ff. when you are referring to the page or line mentioned and two or more pages or lines after it.

defs.def_cn: (用于首字母为 f 的一些单词的书面缩写形式，如female, feminine, franc, false 和 Fahrenheit)

ext.ext_cn: 将炉温升至 400 华氏度。
ext.ext_en: Heat the oven to 400 degrees F.

defs.def_en: F or f is a written abbreviation for words beginning with f, such as 'female', 'feminine', 'franc', 'false', and 'Fahrenheit'.
In a piece of music, f is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) forte and indicates that the piece should be played loudly.

ext.ext_cn: 乘客们为景致所吸引。
ext.ext_en: The passengers were enthralled by the scenery...

ext.ext_cn: 他让布拉格、维也纳和巴黎的观众们着迷。
ext.ext_en: He enthralled audiences in Prague, Vienna, and Paris...

defs.def_en: If you are enthralled by something, you enjoy it and give it your complete attention and interest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （动物）肮脏的，患病的，无人看管的，邋遢的

ext.ext_cn: 老癞皮狗
ext.ext_en: ...mangy old dogs.

defs.def_en: A mangy animal looks dirty, uncared for or ill.

ext.ext_cn: 该国超负荷的空中交通管制系统
ext.ext_en: ...the nation's overburdened air-traffic-control system.

defs.def_en: Air traffic control is the activity of organizing the routes that aircraft should follow, and telling pilots by radio which routes they should take.

ext.ext_cn: 他们需要等空中交通管制人员的放行。
ext.ext_en: They have to wait for clearance from air traffic control.

defs.def_en: Air traffic control is the group of people who organize the routes aircraft take.

ext.ext_cn: 争来争去无非是空调温度。
ext.ext_en: The main bone of contention is the temperature level of the air-conditioners.

defs.def_en: If a particular matter or issue is a bone of contention, it is the subject of a disagreement or argument.

ext.ext_cn: 他的母牛每年产犊时,他都给自家留上一两头。
ext.ext_en: When his cows calve each year he keeps one or two calves for his family.

defs.def_en: When a cow calves, it gives birth to a calf.

ext.ext_cn: 鲸会迁移6,000海里左右,到温暖的环礁湖生殖繁衍。
ext.ext_en: The whales migrate some 6,000 miles to breed and calve in the warm lagoons.

defs.def_en: Some other female animals, including elephants and whales, are said to calve when they give birth to their young.
Calves is the plural of calf.

ext.ext_cn: 那个图书馆吸引了成千上万的学者和研究人员。
ext.ext_en: The library attracts thousands of scholars and researchers.

ext.ext_cn: 一位有影响力的伊斯兰学者
ext.ext_en: ...an influential Islamic scholar.

defs.def_en: A scholar is a person who studies an academic subject and knows a lot about it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果她没有如此心不在焉，可能会成为一名好学生。
ext.ext_en: She could be a good scholar if she didn't let her mind wander so much.

defs.def_en: You can use the word scholar to refer to someone who learns things at school in a particular way. For example, if someone is a good scholar, they are good at learning things.

ext.ext_cn: 他作为罗兹奖学金的获得者来到牛津学习法律。
ext.ext_en: He came to Oxford as a Rhodes scholar and studied law.

defs.def_en: A scholar is a student who has obtained a scholarship.

ext.ext_cn: 我总是要求精确。
ext.ext_en: I'm a bit of a stickler for accuracy...

ext.ext_cn: 露西是个追求完美的人，凡事都得完全符合要求。
ext.ext_en: Lucy was a stickler for perfection, and everything had to be exactly right.

defs.def_en: If you are a stickler for something, you always demand or require it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 认为此次访问能够保密是可笑的。
ext.ext_en: It was ludicrous to suggest that the visit could be kept secret...

ext.ext_cn: 这主意真是荒唐透顶。
ext.ext_en: It's a completely ludicrous idea.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ludicrous, you are emphasizing that you think it is foolish, unreasonable, or unsuitable.
A reactor is the same as a nuclear reactor .

defs.def_cn: 潦草地写;马马虎虎地写

ext.ext_cn: 他给妻子草草写了个便条。
ext.ext_en: He scrawled a hasty note to his wife...

ext.ext_cn: 有人在他的车上涂写了“人渣”的字样。
ext.ext_en: Someone had scrawled 'Scum' on his car.

defs.def_en: If you scrawl something, you write it in a careless and untidy way.

defs.def_cn: 潦草的笔迹;不工整的字迹

ext.ext_cn: 这封信是仓促手写而成，潦草得几乎无法辨认。
ext.ext_en: The letter was handwritten, in a hasty, barely decipherable scrawl.

defs.def_en: You can refer to writing that looks careless and untidy as a scrawl .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指伤害他人的行为）不能证明为正当的，无可辩解的，没有道理的

ext.ext_cn: 用这些导弹击落民用飞机是极不道德也是完全没道理的。
ext.ext_en: Using these missiles to down civilian aircraft is simply immoral and totally unjustifiable.

defs.def_en: If you describe an action, especially one that harms someone, as unjustifiable, you mean there is no good reason for it.

defs.def_cn: (加在某些词前构成反义词)表示“不”，“无”，“非”

ext.ext_cn: 不完整的答案
ext.ext_en: ...incomplete answers.

ext.ext_cn: 缺乏安全感的女人
ext.ext_en: ...women who are insecure about themselves.

defs.def_en: In- is added to some words to form words with the opposite meaning. For example, something that is incorrect is not correct.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 过去人们不会教育孩子提防陌生人。
ext.ext_en: People did not teach their children to be wary of strangers...

ext.ext_cn: 他们跟他签合同时非常谨慎。
ext.ext_en: They were very wary about giving him a contract.

defs.def_en: If you are wary of something or someone, you are cautious because you do not know much about them and you believe they may be dangerous or cause problems.

ext.ext_cn: 银行家们对结果保持高度警惕。
ext.ext_en: Bankers are keeping a wary eye on the outcome.

defs.def_en: If you keep a wary eye on something or someone, you are cautious about them and watch them to see what they will do or what will happen to them.
A count noun is a noun such as 'bird', 'chair', or 'year' which has a singular and a plural form and is always used after a determiner in the singular.

defs.def_cn: 重整;重组;重塑;重新制定

ext.ext_cn: 她几乎是单枪匹马一个人重整了英国政坛。
ext.ext_en: She has, almost single-handedly, realigned British politics.

defs.def_en: If you realign your ideas, policies, or plans, you organize them in a different way in order to take account of new circumstances.

ext.ext_cn: 我转过身去把架子上孩子们的照片重新摆了摆。
ext.ext_en: I turned aside to realign the photographs of my children on the shelf.

defs.def_en: If you realign objects, you move some or all of them in order to make them into a particular pattern.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 现在许多婚姻都以离婚收场。
ext.ext_en: Numerous marriages now end in divorce...

ext.ext_cn: 他们离婚一事在这周末尘埃落定。
ext.ext_en: Their divorce became final this weekend...

defs.def_en: A divorce is the formal ending of a marriage by law.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我很小的时候父母就离婚了。
ext.ext_en: My parents divorced when I was very young...

ext.ext_cn: 他和莉莲已离婚了。
ext.ext_en: He and Lillian had got divorced...

defs.def_en: If a man and woman divorce or if one of them divorces the other, their marriage is legally ended.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 基督教文化和信仰根基的脱离
ext.ext_en: ...this divorce of Christian culture from the roots of faith...

ext.ext_cn: 这个进程绝不是工党和工会运动相脱离。
ext.ext_en: This process is, in no sense, a divorce between the Labour Party and the trade union movement.

defs.def_en: A divorce of one thing from another, or a divorce between two things is a separation between them which is permanent or is likely to be permanent.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对警察队伍的良好管理和应负的责任是分不开的。
ext.ext_en: Good management in the police cannot be divorced from accountability...

ext.ext_cn: 我们已经能够将性和生育完全分开了。
ext.ext_en: We have been able to divorce sex from reproduction.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing cannot be divorced from another, you mean that the two things cannot be considered as different and separate things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们的蜜月是在拉斯维加斯一家名为“海市蜃楼”的豪华酒店住了两天。
ext.ext_en: Our honeymoon was two days in Las Vegas at a luxurious hotel called Le Mirage...

ext.ext_cn: 她渐渐地喜欢上了罗伯托奢侈的生活方式。
ext.ext_en: She had come to enjoy Roberto's luxurious lifestyle.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as luxurious, you mean that it is very comfortable and expensive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 心满意足的；惬意的；舒适的

ext.ext_cn: 埃米微倾酒杯晃了晃酒，惬意地舒了一口气。
ext.ext_en: Amy tilted her wine in her glass with a luxurious sigh.

defs.def_en: Luxurious means feeling or expressing great pleasure and comfort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影充斥着平铺直叙的陈腐观点。
ext.ext_en: The movie is teeming with obvious and trite ideas...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾经被教导的简单观念如今听起来陈腐而幼稚。
ext.ext_en: The simple concepts he had been taught now sounded trite and naive.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as an idea, remark, or story is trite, you mean that it is dull and boring because it has been said or told too many times.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 通告是不久前才宣布的。
ext.ext_en: The announcement was made a short time ago...

ext.ext_cn: 你是怎么在如此短的时间里做到的？
ext.ext_en: How could you do it in such a short period of time?...

defs.def_en: If something is short or lasts for a short time, it does not last very long.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 似乎过得很快的;短暂的

ext.ext_cn: 有过短短几周的和平。
ext.ext_en: For a few short weeks there was peace...

ext.ext_cn: 仅短短 5 年时间后，你的钱就会增多 94,000 美元。
ext.ext_en: Only five short years later, your money will have grown by $94,000.

defs.def_en: If you talk about a short hour, day, or year, you mean that it seems to have passed very quickly or will seem to pass very quickly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们正表演莎士比亚剧作《维洛那二绅士》中的一个片段。
ext.ext_en: They were performing a short extract from Shakespeare's Two Gentlemen of Verona...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一封简短的致谢信。
ext.ext_en: This is a short note to say thank you.

defs.def_en: A short speech, letter, or book does not have many words or pages in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我又高又瘦，他又矮又胖。
ext.ext_en: I'm tall and thin and he's short and fat.

ext.ext_cn: 头发灰白的矮个子老妇人
ext.ext_en: ...a short, elderly woman with grey hair...

defs.def_en: Someone who is short is not as tall as most people are.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (距离、长度等)短的，不长的，不远的

ext.ext_cn: 市中心和商店离得很近。
ext.ext_en: The city centre and shops are only a short distance away...

ext.ext_cn: 一段短短的台阶通向一个气派的大门口。
ext.ext_en: A short flight of steps led to a grand doorway...

defs.def_en: Something that is short measures only a small amount from one end to the other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她父亲的病造成家里经济拮据。
ext.ext_en: Her father's illness left the family short of money...

ext.ext_cn: 政府军的弹药和燃料都快用完了。
ext.ext_en: Government forces are running short of ammunition and fuel...

defs.def_en: If you are short of something or if it is short, you do not have enough of it. If you are running short of something or if it is running short, you do not have much of it left.

ext.ext_cn: 他在离大楼 100 码处停下了。
ext.ext_en: He stopped a hundred yards short of the building...

ext.ext_cn: 那么如果社会党人得票领先却又未达到绝对多数，那会怎么样呢？
ext.ext_en: So what happens if the Socialists top the poll but fall short of an absolute majority?...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is or stops short of a place, they have not quite reached it. If they are or fall short of an amount, they have not quite achieved it.

ext.ext_cn: 除非爬过 4 米高的栏杆，否则从这条路没办法进到园子里。
ext.ext_en: Short of climbing railings four metres high, there was no way into the garden from this road...

ext.ext_cn: 他们只有通过内战才能将意志强加给少数派。
ext.ext_en: They have no means, short of civil war, to enforce their will upon the minorities.

defs.def_en: Short of a particular thing means except for that thing or without actually doing that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他辉煌的事业因心脏病发作而被迫终止。
ext.ext_en: His glittering career was cut short by a heart attack...

ext.ext_cn: 杰克逊提前结束了他的非洲之行。
ext.ext_en: Jackson cut short his trip to Africa...

defs.def_en: If something is cut short or stops short, it is stopped before people expect it to or before it has finished.

ext.ext_cn: 她的朋友凯斯(凯茜娃的简称)眼泪汪汪。
ext.ext_en: Her friend Kes (short for Kesewa) was in tears...

ext.ext_cn: O.O.B.E. 是 Out Of Body Experience (身外体验)的缩略形式。
ext.ext_en: 'O.O.B.E.' is short for 'Out Of Body Experience'.

defs.def_en: If a name or abbreviation is short for another name, it is the short version of that name.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 脾气暴躁、笨拙又忸怩的女人
ext.ext_en: ...an awkward, self-conscious woman with a short temper.

defs.def_en: See also:short-tempered;If you have a short temper, you get angry very easily.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 说话简短粗暴的;简慢无礼的

ext.ext_cn: 她似乎很焦虑，抑或是很紧张，对我明显很不客气。
ext.ext_en: She seemed nervous or tense, and she was definitely short with me.

defs.def_en: If you are short with someone, you speak briefly and rather rudely to them, because you are impatient or angry.

defs.def_cn: (尤指在一时找不到厕所的情况下)内急，突然感觉要上厕所
defs.def_en: If you are caught short or are taken short, you feel a sudden strong need to urinate, especially when you cannot easily find a toilet.

ext.ext_cn: 我对面是一位名叫贾丝明德(简称杰丝)的女子。
ext.ext_en: Opposite me was a woman called Jasminder (Jazzy for short)...

ext.ext_cn: 这种病情叫做季节性情感失调症，或简称 SAD。
ext.ext_en: This condition is called seasonal affective disorder, or SAD for short.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is called something for short, that is the short version of their name.

ext.ext_cn: 有些人可能极不善于理财，因而不得不缺衣少食地将就过活。
ext.ext_en: Some people may manage their finances badly and therefore have to go short of essentials.

defs.def_en: If you go short of something, especially food, you do not have as much of it as you want or need.

ext.ext_cn: 试试网球、羽毛球或帆板运动吧。总之，只要是有挑战性的。
ext.ext_en: Try tennis, badminton or windsurfing. In short, anything challenging...

ext.ext_cn: 她被医生、律师、家庭主妇——总之是一群像她一样的人——所包围着。
ext.ext_en: She was surrounded by doctors, lawyers, housewives — people, in short, like herself.

defs.def_en: You use in short when you have been giving a lot of details and you want to give a conclusion or summary.

ext.ext_cn: 结果非常不错。
ext.ext_en: The results are nothing short of magnificent...

ext.ext_cn: 他最近对华盛顿的访问几乎是一场惨败。
ext.ext_en: His last visit to Washington was little short of a fiasco.

defs.def_en: You use nothing short of or little short of to emphasize how great or extreme something is. For example, if you say that something is nothing short of a miracle or nothing short of disastrous, you are emphasizing that it is a miracle or it is disastrous.

defs.def_cn: 冒傻气的;不聪明的;愚蠢的;不理智的
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is, for example, several cards short of a full deck or one sandwich short of a picnic, you think they are stupid, foolish, or crazy.

defs.def_cn: 缺乏，缺少(某种优良品质)

ext.ext_cn: 他太缺乏热情。
ext.ext_en: He was very short on enthusiasm...

ext.ext_cn: 这些提议缺少细节。
ext.ext_en: The proposals were short on detail.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is short on a particular good quality, they do not have as much of it as you think they should have.

ext.ext_cn: 他几乎要直言批评政府了。
ext.ext_en: He stopped short of explicitly criticizing the government...

ext.ext_cn: 这项决议几乎成为公开的独立宣言。
ext.ext_en: The resolution stopped short of an outright declaration of independence.

defs.def_en: If someone stops short of doing something, they come close to doing it but do not actually do it.

defs.def_cn: (因雇主付不起全工时工钱而出现的)短工时，开工不足

ext.ext_cn: 因需求量大幅下降，全国的工人都开工不足。
ext.ext_en: Workers across the country have been put on short time because of the slump in demand...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数制造商不得不推行短工时工作制。
ext.ext_en: Most manufacturers have had to introduce short-time working.

defs.def_en: If workers are put on short time, they are asked to work fewer hours than the normal working week, because their employer can not afford to pay them a full time wage.

defs.def_cn: 使突然终止;使突然中断

ext.ext_cn: 大门上的名字让我突然停了下来。
ext.ext_en: The name on the gate pulled me up short.

defs.def_en: If something pulls you up short or brings you up short, it makes you suddenly stop what you are doing.

defs.def_cn: 干净利落地处理(或打败);迅速解决

ext.ext_cn: 阿加西干净利落地击败了对手。
ext.ext_en: Agassi made short work of his opponent.

defs.def_en: If you make short work of someone or something, you deal with them or defeat them very quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 两名身着色彩艳丽的棉质短裤和T恤衫的女子
ext.ext_en: ...two women in bright cotton shorts and tee shirts.

defs.def_en: Shorts are trousers with very short legs, that people wear in hot weather or for taking part in sports.
Shorts are men's underpants with short legs.

defs.def_cn: 少量烈酒(如威士忌、杜松子酒、伏特加等)
defs.def_en: A short is a small amount of a strong alcoholic drink such as whisky, gin, or vodka, rather than a weaker alcoholic drink that you can drink in larger quantities.

defs.def_cn: (尤指正片放映前的)电影短片
defs.def_en: A short is a short film, especially one that is shown before the main film at the cinema.

ext.ext_cn: 我答应给普伦基特夫人临时照看孩子。
ext.ext_en: I promised to babysit for Mrs Plunkett...

ext.ext_cn: 我朋友请我临时看顾她6个月大的儿子。
ext.ext_en: My friend asked me to babysit for her six-month-old son...

defs.def_en: If you babysit for someone or babysit their children, you look after their children while they are out.
The USAF is an abbreviation for (缩略=) the United States Air Force .

defs.def_cn: 折中办法;妥协方案;介乎两者之间的事物

ext.ext_cn: 想找一种介乎戏剧和电影之间的艺术形式是可能的。奥利弗在1945年创作的富于想象力的《亨利五世》即是这样一部作品。
ext.ext_en: A halfway house between the theatre and cinema is possible. Olivier created one in his imaginative 'Henry V' in 1945.

defs.def_en: A half-way house is an arrangement or thing that has some of the qualities of two different things.

defs.def_cn: （为出狱者、离院精神病人或已戒毒者设立的）过渡教习所，重返社会训练所
defs.def_en: A halfway house is a home for people such as former prisoners, mental patients, or drug addicts who can stay there for a limited period of time to get used to life outside prison or hospital.

defs.def_cn: 折价贴换交易；以旧换新交易

ext.ext_cn: 这辆车的折价贴换交易价值
ext.ext_en: ...the trade-in value of the car.

defs.def_en: A trade-in is an arrangement in which someone buys something such as a new car or washing machine at a reduced price by giving their old one, as well as money, in payment.

ext.ext_cn: 我帮着做些秘书工作。
ext.ext_en: I help out with the secretarial work...

ext.ext_cn: 我的钱不够买所有这些礼物，我母亲只好借了我一些钱。
ext.ext_en: All these presents came to more money than I had, and my mother had to help me out...

defs.def_en: If you help someone out, you help them by doing some work for them or by lending them some money.

defs.def_cn: （尤指衣服）旧的，过时的，淘汰的

ext.ext_cn: 亚历山德拉穿着那身过时的衣裳，显得臃肿笨拙。
ext.ext_en: Alexandra looked plump and awkward in her cast-off clothing.

ext.ext_cn: 我小时候从没穿过新衣服，总是拾表姐的旧衣服。
ext.ext_en: I never had anything new to wear as a child, only a cousin's cast-offs.

defs.def_en: Cast-off things, especially clothes, are ones which someone no longer uses because they are old or unfashionable, and which they give to someone else or throw away.

defs.def_cn: 宣布放弃，抛弃(信仰或行为方式)

ext.ext_cn: 在被囚禁一段时间之后，她宣布放弃恐怖主义。
ext.ext_en: After a period of imprisonment she renounced terrorism...

defs.def_en: If you renounce a belief or a way of behaving, you decide and declare publicly that you no longer have that belief or will no longer behave in that way.

defs.def_cn: 正式放弃(要求、官阶或头衔)

ext.ext_cn: 他正式放弃对法国王位的继承权。
ext.ext_en: He renounced his claim to the French throne.

defs.def_en: If you renounce a claim, rank, or title, you officially give it up.

ext.ext_cn: 他的皮肤光洁平滑。
ext.ext_en: His skin is clear and smooth...

ext.ext_cn: 主要有 3 种皮肤癌。
ext.ext_en: There are three major types of skin cancer...

defs.def_en: Your skin is the natural covering of your body.

ext.ext_cn: 那是真正的鳄鱼皮。
ext.ext_en: That was real crocodile skin.

ext.ext_cn: 豹皮大衣
ext.ext_en: ...a leopard skin coat.

defs.def_en: An animal skin is skin which has been removed from a dead animal. Skins are used to make things such as coats and rugs.

ext.ext_cn: 橙子皮称为 zest。
ext.ext_en: The outer skin of the orange is called the 'zest'.

ext.ext_cn: 香蕉皮
ext.ext_en: ...banana skins.

defs.def_en: The skin of a fruit or vegetable is its outer layer or covering.

ext.ext_cn: 要不时地搅拌牛奶蛋糊，防止其表面结皮。
ext.ext_en: Stir the custard occasionally to prevent a skin forming.

defs.def_en: If a skin forms on the surface of a liquid, a thin, fairly solid layer forms on it.

defs.def_cn: 剥去(死动物)的皮;将…去皮

ext.ext_cn: 具有大厨剥兔子皮的娴熟技艺
ext.ext_en: ...with the expertise of a chef skinning a rabbit.

defs.def_en: If you skin a dead animal, you remove its skin.

defs.def_cn: 吓得魂飞魄散;大吃一惊

ext.ext_cn: 他看到两只老鼠，几乎给吓丢了魂。
ext.ext_en: He nearly jumped out of his skin when he saw two rats.

defs.def_en: If something makes you jump out of your skin, it surprises or shocks you very much.

defs.def_cn: 保命;保全自己;设法摆脱困境

ext.ext_cn: 为了活命，他可以不顾任何人，不择手段。
ext.ext_en: He'd have done anything to anybody to save his own skin.

defs.def_en: If you try to save your own skin or save your skin, you try to save yourself from something dangerous or unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 侥幸;好不容易才;险些儿没有

ext.ext_cn: 他赢了，但是赢得十分勉强。
ext.ext_en: He won, but only by the skin of his teeth.

defs.def_en: If you do something by the skin of your teeth, you just manage to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 要当校长，你就得脸皮厚一些。
ext.ext_en: You need a thick skin to be a headmaster.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a thick skin, you mean that they are able to listen to criticism about themselves without becoming offended.
A twosome is a group of two people.

ext.ext_cn: 他站在冠军领奖台上，唱起了国歌。
ext.ext_en: As he stood on the winner's rostrum, he sang the words of the national anthem.

defs.def_en: A rostrum is a raised platform on which someone stands when they are speaking to an audience, receiving a prize, or conducting an orchestra.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在 8 月一个闷热的夜晚，高潮到来了。
ext.ext_en: The climax came one sultry August evening.

defs.def_en: Sultry weather is hot and damp.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 迷人的;撩人的;风情万种的

ext.ext_cn: 性感迷人的黑发女郎
ext.ext_en: ...a dark-haired sultry woman.

defs.def_en: Someone who is sultry is attractive in a way that suggests hidden passion.

ext.ext_cn: 恶棍和杀人犯
ext.ext_en: ...bully-boys and murderers.

defs.def_en: If you describe a man as a bully-boy, you disapprove of him because he is rough and aggressive.

ext.ext_cn: 有些人指控税务稽查员使用了流氓手段。
ext.ext_en: Some people accuse the tax inspectors of bully-boy tactics.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone uses bully-boy tactics, you disapprove of them because they use rough and aggressive methods.

ext.ext_cn: 回顾此事，我会无比地开心。
ext.ext_en: I will look back at this one with undiluted pleasure...

ext.ext_cn: 这份报告并未收到热烈的反响。
ext.ext_en: The report had not been received with undiluted enthusiasm...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's feelings or characteristics as undiluted, you are emphasizing that they are very strong and not mixed with any other feeling or quality.
A liquid that is undiluted has not been made weak by mixing it with water.

ext.ext_cn: 用耙刨地使土壤透气。
ext.ext_en: Aerate the soil by spiking with a fork.

ext.ext_cn: 新鲜的螃蟹和龙虾被装在灌满充气盐水的罐车里运往南方
ext.ext_en: ...fresh crab and lobster, transported south in tanker loads of aerated salted water.

defs.def_en: To aerate a substance means to cause air or gas to pass through it.
If someone suffers from dyslexia, they have difficulty with reading because of a slight disorder of their brain.

ext.ext_cn: 我们等了 3 个月才回去见那位专家。
ext.ext_en: We waited three months before going back to see the specialist.

defs.def_en: Three is the number 3.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 安静的;庄重的;不苟言笑的;平淡无奇的

ext.ext_cn: 她带他们去拜访她那些不苟言笑的表兄表姐们。
ext.ext_en: She took them to visit her sedate, elderly cousins...

ext.ext_cn: 她在伦敦的生活平淡无奇，几乎有些枯燥。
ext.ext_en: Her London life was sedate, almost mundane...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as sedate, you mean that they are quiet and rather dignified, though perhaps a bit dull.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不慌不忙的;慢悠悠的;从容的

ext.ext_cn: 我们重新上路了，步调更加从容。
ext.ext_en: We set off again at a more sedate pace.

ext.ext_cn: 一辆性能稳定但行驶缓慢的重型汽车
ext.ext_en: ...a heavy car with solid but sedate performance.

defs.def_en: If you move along at a sedate pace, you move slowly, in a controlled way.

ext.ext_cn: 静脉注射了镇静剂后病人安然入睡。
ext.ext_en: The patient is sedated with intravenous use of sedative drugs...

ext.ext_cn: 医生们已被告知不要给儿童使用麻醉剂，因为它可能与5起死亡病例有关。
ext.ext_en: Doctors have been told not to sedate children with an anaesthetic that may be linked to five deaths.

defs.def_en: If someone is sedated, they are given a drug to calm them or to make them sleep.

ext.ext_cn: 杰基已经在夜校学习了3年的弗拉门戈舞。
ext.ext_en: Jackie has been learning flamenco dancing at an evening class for three years.

defs.def_en: An evening class is a course for adults that is taught in the evening rather than during the day.

ext.ext_cn: 肯戈理博士视土耳其为自己的祖国。
ext.ext_en: Dr Kengerli looks to Turkey as his mother country.

defs.def_en: Someone's mother country is the country in which they or their ancestors were born and to which they still feel emotionally linked, even if they live somewhere else.

ext.ext_cn: 澳大利亚、新西兰和加拿大跟它们的宗主国不曾有殖民冲突。
ext.ext_en: Australia, New Zealand, and Canada, had no colonial conflict with the mother country.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the mother country of a particular state or country, you are referring to the very powerful country that used to control its affairs.

defs.def_cn: 目瞪口呆地凝视；张口结舌地看

ext.ext_cn: 他的秘书停止了记录，目瞪口呆地望着我。
ext.ext_en: His secretary stopped taking notes to gape at me...

ext.ext_cn: 他不是那种像个游客似的四处闲逛、对什么都好奇张望的人。
ext.ext_en: He was not the type to wander round gaping at everything like a tourist.

defs.def_en: If you gape, you look at someone or something in surprise, usually with an open mouth.

ext.ext_cn: 前门不翼而飞，屋顶豁开了一个洞。
ext.ext_en: The front door was missing. A hole gaped in the roof.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a hole or a wound gapes, you are emphasizing that it is big or wide.

ext.ext_cn: 对前首相的刑事诉讼
ext.ext_en: ...criminal proceedings against the former prime minister...

ext.ext_cn: 该委员会已经提起诉讼，禁止这家商店在周日营业。
ext.ext_en: The Council had brought proceedings to stop the store from trading on Sundays.

defs.def_en: Legal proceedings are legal action taken against someone.

defs.def_cn: （有组织的一系列）活动，事件，行动

ext.ext_cn: 问讯将会秘密进行。
ext.ext_en: The proceedings of the enquiry will take place in private...

ext.ext_cn: 他带着怀疑和警觉的眼光看待这些事件。
ext.ext_en: He viewed the proceedings with doubt and alarm.

defs.def_en: The proceedings are an organized series of events that take place in a particular place.

ext.ext_cn: 交通部将公布这次会议的记录。
ext.ext_en: The Department of Transport is to publish the conference proceedings.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a written record of the discussions at a meeting or conference as the proceedings.
A sponge cake is a very light cake made from flour, eggs, and sometimes fat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人）温顺的，易受影响的，顺从的

ext.ext_cn: 这位听话的纽约市市长听命于他。
ext.ext_en: The malleable mayor of New York was under his control...

ext.ext_cn: 她还年轻，还很乖。
ext.ext_en: She was young enough to be malleable.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is malleable, you mean that they are easily influenced or controlled by other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （材料）柔软的，可锻的，可塑的，有延展性的

ext.ext_cn: 银是延展性最好的金属。
ext.ext_en: Silver is the most malleable of all metals.

ext.ext_cn: 用黏土、橡皮泥或其他延展性强的材料
ext.ext_en: ...using clay, plasticine or another malleable material.

defs.def_en: A substance that is malleable is soft and can easily be made into different shapes.
Half-timbered is used to describe old buildings that have wooden beams showing in the brick and plaster walls, both on the inside and the outside of the building.

defs.def_cn: (钱币、投资票据或票的)面值，面额

ext.ext_cn: 这些票以其面值两倍的价钱售出。
ext.ext_en: Tickets were selling at twice their face value.

defs.def_en: The face value of things such as coins, paper money, investment documents, or tickets is the amount of money that they are worth, and that is written on them.

defs.def_cn: 按照表面意思;(对…)信以为真

ext.ext_cn: 对各相关团体的公开言论不必太过当真。
ext.ext_en: Public statements from the various groups involved should not necessarily be taken at face value.

defs.def_en: If you take something at face value, you accept it and believe it without thinking about it very much, even though it might be untrue.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 怎么这么臭！
ext.ext_en: What a horrid smell!

ext.ext_cn: 冬天天气极糟。
ext.ext_en: The winter was horrid.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as horrid, you mean that it is very unpleasant indeed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （人）招人讨厌的，使人极不愉快的

ext.ext_cn: 我以前一定是个招人讨厌的小女孩。
ext.ext_en: I must have been a horrid little girl...

ext.ext_cn: 我爱我的父母，但他们彼此之间极为不和。
ext.ext_en: I love both my parents, but they're horrid to each other.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as horrid, you mean that they behave in a very unpleasant way towards other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 挤满游客的;被旅游商品充斥的

ext.ext_cn: 游览一些商业味没那么重的岛屿吧。
ext.ext_en: Visit some of the less touristy islands.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as touristy, you do not like it because it is full of tourists or full of things for tourists to buy and do.

ext.ext_cn: 蓝蓝的天空
ext.ext_en: ...an azure sky.

ext.ext_cn: 蔚蓝和煦的大海和棕榈环绕的沙滩
ext.ext_en: ...warm azure seas and palm fringed beaches.

defs.def_en: Azure is used to describe things that are bright blue.

defs.def_cn: (附加在商品或服务价格上的）增值税（缩略形式为VAT）
defs.def_en: Value-added tax is a tax that is added to the price of goods or services. The abbreviation VAT is also used.

ext.ext_cn: 一部 20 世纪 50 年代经典怪诞喜剧的翻拍
ext.ext_en: ...a remake of a '50s classic screwball comedy.

defs.def_en: Screwball comedy is silly and eccentric in an amusing and harmless way.
If you say that someone is a screwball, you mean that they do strange or crazy things.
See also:CD-ROM;ROM is the permanent part of a computer's memory. The information stored there can be read but not changed. ROM is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'read-only memory'.
A naturalized citizen of a particular country is someone who has legally become a citizen of that country, although they were not born there.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 法国北部发生零星战斗的一年
ext.ext_en: ...a year of sporadic fighting over northern France...

ext.ext_cn: 仍能听见零星的枪声。
ext.ext_en: The sound of sporadic shooting could still be heard.

defs.def_en: Sporadic occurrences of something happen at irregular intervals.

ext.ext_cn: 收支相抵。
ext.ext_en: Outgoings and revenues balanced out...

ext.ext_cn: 所进行的剧烈运动可以消耗掉增加的热量。
ext.ext_en: The strenuous exercise undergone could balance out the increased calories.

defs.def_en: If two or more opposite things balance out or if you balance them out, they become equal in amount, value, or effect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 道德败坏的;放荡的;淫逸的

ext.ext_cn: 负债累累、放荡无度的生活方式
ext.ext_en: ...a debt-ridden and debauched lifestyle.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as debauched, you mean they behave in a way that you think is socially unacceptable, for example because they drink a lot of alcohol or have sex with a lot of people.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你的宝宝不爱爬也不爱走，不要担心。
ext.ext_en: Don't worry if your baby seems a little reluctant to crawl or walk...

ext.ext_cn: 我开始手脚并用朝门口爬去。
ext.ext_en: I began to crawl on my hands and knees towards the door...

defs.def_en: When you crawl, you move forward on your hands and knees.

ext.ext_cn: 我看着飞蛾爬到灯罩外面。
ext.ext_en: I watched the moth crawl up the outside of the lampshade.

defs.def_en: When an insect crawls somewhere, it moves there quite slowly.

ext.ext_cn: 我9点半才勉强从床上爬起来。
ext.ext_en: I crawled out of bed at nine-thirty...

ext.ext_en: They had not foreseen the higher inflation in France when most of Western Europe was crawling out of recession...

defs.def_en: If someone or something crawls somewhere, they move or progress slowly or with great difficulty.

ext.ext_cn: 这个地方全是警察。
ext.ext_en: This place is crawling with police.

ext.ext_en: ...rock-hard earth littered with rubbish and crawling with vermin.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place is crawling with people or animals, you are emphasizing that it is full of them.

ext.ext_cn: 我讨厌这个男人，他碰我一下我都觉得恶心。
ext.ext_en: I hated this man, his very touch made my skin crawl.

defs.def_en: If something makes your skin crawl or makes your flesh crawl, it makes you feel shocked or disgusted.

ext.ext_cn: 一束红玫瑰
ext.ext_en: ...a bunch of red roses...

ext.ext_cn: 她的手很小，指甲涂成了鲜红色。
ext.ext_en: She had small hands with nails painted bright red.

defs.def_en: Something that is red is the colour of blood or fire.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （因为尴尬、生气或气短）脸红的

ext.ext_cn: 我的脸涨得通红，被迫承认自己实际上没什么想法。
ext.ext_en: With a bright red face I was forced to admit that I had no real idea...

ext.ext_en: She was red with shame.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's face is red, you mean that it is redder than its normal colour, because they are embarrassed, angry, or out of breath.

ext.ext_cn: 红褐色头发的女孩
ext.ext_en: ...a girl with red hair...

ext.ext_cn: 他还是很虚荣，把头发染成了红褐色。
ext.ext_en: He is still vain enough to dye his hair red.

defs.def_en: You describe someone's hair as red when it is between red and brown in colour.
Your red blood cells or red corpuscles are the cells in your blood which carry oxygen around your body.

ext.ext_cn: 这些菜的味道辛辣，应该配红酒而不是白葡萄酒。
ext.ext_en: The spicy flavours in these dishes call for reds rather than whites.

defs.def_en: You can refer to red wine as red .

defs.def_cn: 共产党员;社会主义者;左翼思想者

ext.ext_cn: 他们所有人都非常害怕红色人士。
ext.ext_en: They're all so terrified of Reds.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a red or a Red, you mean that they are a communist, a socialist, or have left-wing ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 这座电影院亏空50万英镑。
ext.ext_en: The theatre is £500,000 in the red...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你真的出现透支，那你每笔交易要支付30便士的费用。
ext.ext_en: If you do go into the red you get charged 30p for each transaction.

defs.def_en: If a person or company is in the red or if their bank account is in the red, they have spent more money than they have in their account and therefore they owe money to the bank.

ext.ext_cn: 我不是故意要打断他的鼻梁。我只是一时气急。
ext.ext_en: I didn't mean to break his nose. I just saw red.

defs.def_en: If you see red, you suddenly become very angry.

ext.ext_cn: 该协议是战后欧洲削减非核武器的第一个条约。
ext.ext_en: The agreement is the first postwar treaty to reduce non-nuclear weapons in Europe.

defs.def_en: Non-nuclear means not using or involving nuclear weapons or nuclear power.

ext.ext_cn: 阻燃的泡沫橡胶
ext.ext_en: ...fire-retardant foam.

defs.def_en: Fire-retardant substances make the thing that they are applied to burn more slowly.

defs.def_cn: （表示征求对方认同）啊，是吧;（表示希望他人重复所说的话）什么;（表示惊讶或不以为然）嘿，哼

ext.ext_cn: 我们能继续干下去吗，啊？
ext.ext_en: Can we just get on with it, huh?...

ext.ext_cn: 挺聪明的，是吧？
ext.ext_en: Clever, huh?...

defs.def_en: Huh is used in writing to represent a noise that people make at the end of a question if they want someone to agree with them or if they want someone to repeat what they have just said. Huh is also used to show that someone is surprised or not impressed.

ext.ext_cn: 日摄取400至1200卡路里的热量
ext.ext_en: ...a daily caloric intake of from 400 to 1200 calories.

defs.def_en: Caloric means relating to calories.
A rowan or a rowan tree is a tree with a silvery trunk that has red berries in autumn.

ext.ext_cn: 明年物价一定会上涨。
ext.ext_en: There are bound to be price increases next year...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你在公共场所裸露上身，这种事情一定会发生。
ext.ext_en: If you are topless in a public place, this sort of thing is bound to happen.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is bound to happen, you mean that you are sure it will happen, because it is a natural consequence of something that is already known or exists.

defs.def_cn: （对某事并不确定或无确凿证据时，认为其）肯定会，确定是

ext.ext_cn: 我会把它给本杰明看，他肯定会知道。
ext.ext_en: I'll show it to Benjamin. He's bound to know...

ext.ext_cn: 我们会有不止一个孩子，而且其中一定有个男孩。
ext.ext_en: We'll have more than one child, and one of them's bound to be a boy.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is bound to happen or be true, you feel confident and certain of it, although you have no definite knowledge or evidence.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （与…）紧密相连的；（与…）密切相关的；（同…）难以分开的

ext.ext_cn: 不管是我们讨厌的人还是喜爱的人都一样和我们密切相关。
ext.ext_en: We are as tightly bound to the people we dislike as to the people we love...

ext.ext_cn: 经济增长仍然与贫困、社会公正和资源保护等问题紧密相连。
ext.ext_en: Economic growth is still bound to the issues of poverty, social justice and conservation.

defs.def_en: If one person, thing, or situation is bound to another, they are closely associated with each other, and it is difficult for them to be separated or to escape from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 这艘船驶向意大利。
ext.ext_en: The ship was bound for Italy.

ext.ext_cn: 飞往柏林的俄罗斯飞机
ext.ext_en: ...a Russian plane bound for Berlin.

defs.def_en: If a vehicle or person is bound for a particular place, they are travelling towards it.

defs.def_cn: 我不得不说（令人不快或出乎意料的事）

ext.ext_cn: 我不得不说，在我看来这肯定会引发暴力事件。
ext.ext_en: I'm bound to say that it seems to me this is certain to lead to violence.

defs.def_en: You can say 'I am bound to say' to introduce a statement expressing something that you find undesirable or unexpected.

ext.ext_cn: 一家公司经理不愿意让大笔财富套在股票里。
ext.ext_en: The manager of a company does not like having a large chunk of his wealth bound up in its shares...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的牢房里有大量的硫化氢气体。
ext.ext_en: They'd have a lot of hydrogen sulfide gas bound up in their cells.

defs.def_en: If something is bound up in a particular form or place, it is fixed in that form or contained in that place.

defs.def_cn: 与…密切相关的；同…难以分开的

ext.ext_cn: 我和她的命运紧密相连。
ext.ext_en: My fate was bound up with hers...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的勘探经历与这些洞穴本身的特征有着不可分割的紧密联系。
ext.ext_en: The story of their exploration is inextricably bound up with the character of the caves themselves...

defs.def_en: If one thing is bound up with or in another, they are closely connected with each other, and it is difficult to consider the two things separately.

ext.ext_cn: 温度变化缓慢，而且局限在相对较小的范围内。
ext.ext_en: Changes in temperature occur slowly and are constrained within relatively tight bounds.

ext.ext_cn: 做事不拘常规的强硬个性
ext.ext_en: ...a forceful personality willing to go beyond the bounds of convention.

defs.def_en: Bounds are limits which normally restrict what can happen or what people can do.

ext.ext_cn: 吉尔吉斯与乌兹别克斯坦、哈萨克斯坦和塔吉克斯坦接壤。
ext.ext_en: Kirgizia is bounded by Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan and Tajikistan.

ext.ext_cn: 环绕在停车场周围的树木
ext.ext_en: ...the trees that bounded the car park.

defs.def_en: If an area of land is bounded by something, that thing is situated around its edge.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的生活囿于工作、家庭和电视中。
ext.ext_en: Our lives are bounded by work,  family and television.

defs.def_en: If someone's  life or situation is bounded by certain things, those are its most important aspects  and it is limited or restricted by them.

ext.ext_cn: 他跳着上了台阶，按下了门铃。
ext.ext_en: He bounded up the steps and pushed the bell of the door...

ext.ext_cn: 那只狗蹦跳着叼回了木棍，交给理查德让他再扔出去。
ext.ext_en: The dog came bounding back with the stick for Richard to throw again.

defs.def_en: If a person or animal bounds in a particular direction, they move quickly with large steps or jumps.

ext.ext_cn: 她纵身一跃骑上了马背，绕着场地策马慢跑。
ext.ext_en: She leaps in one bound onto her pony's  back for a speedy canter around the ring...

ext.ext_cn: 杰克纵身一跃就脱身了。
ext.ext_en: With one bound Jack was free.

defs.def_en: A bound is a long or high jump.

defs.def_cn: （数量）飞快增长；（表现）迅速改进

ext.ext_cn: 股票价格又急涨了11便士，攀至311便士。
ext.ext_en: The shares bounded ahead a further 11p to 311p...

ext.ext_cn: 经济并未像人们期望的那样迅速复苏。
ext.ext_en: The economy isn't  bounding back as fast as people expected.

defs.def_en: If the quantity or performance of something bounds ahead, it increases or improves quickly and suddenly.

ext.ext_cn: 阿根廷足球迷极为热情。
ext.ext_en: The passion of Argentinian football fans knows no bounds.

defs.def_en: If you say that a feeling or quality knows no bounds, you are emphasizing that it is very strong or intense.

ext.ext_cn: 最近几天该地区禁止外国记者进入。
ext.ext_en: For the last few days the area has been out of bounds to foreign journalists.

defs.def_en: If a place is out of bounds, people are not allowed to go there.

ext.ext_cn: 美国的家长可能很快就会迫使含有暴力内容的电视节目遭禁播。
ext.ext_en: American parents may soon be able to rule violent TV programmes out of bounds.

defs.def_en: If something is out of bounds, people are not allowed to do it, use it, see it, or know about it.

A gyroscope is a device that contains a disc turning on an axis that can turn freely in any direction, so that the disc maintains the same position whatever the position or movement of the surrounding structure.

ext.ext_cn: 课时长为1小时的课程开设在布洛克斯威奇康乐中心。
ext.ext_en: The hour-long sessions take place at Bloxwich Leisure Centre.

defs.def_en: A leisure centre is a large public building containing different facilities for leisure activities, such as a sports hall, a swimming pool, and rooms for meetings.

defs.def_cn: 意识到;觉察到;开始对…采取适当行动

ext.ext_cn: 一些保险公司已经意识到其客户所得到的保险金非常少。
ext.ext_en: Some insurers have wised up to the fact that their clients were getting very cheap insurance...

ext.ext_cn: 现在该觉醒了，告诉你周围的人要适可而止。
ext.ext_en: It's time to wise up and tell those around you that enough is enough.

defs.def_en: If someone wises up to a situation or state of affairs, they become aware of it and take appropriate action.

defs.def_cn: (对逃亡者或失踪者的)追捕，追踪
defs.def_en: A manhunt is a major search for someone who has escaped or disappeared.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 尖屋顶
ext.ext_en: ...a pointed roof.

ext.ext_cn: 尖头鞋
ext.ext_en: ...pointed shoes.

defs.def_en: Something that is pointed has a point at one end.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 尖锐的；直截了当的；批评性的

ext.ext_cn: 我不能不注意到针对我的尖锐言辞。
ext.ext_en: I couldn't help but notice the pointed remarks slung in my direction...

ext.ext_cn: 她的新书对狭小社区的生活和其中女性的地位进行了犀利的剖析。
ext.ext_en: Her new book is a pointed look at life in a small community, and the position of women within it.

defs.def_en: Pointed comments or behaviour express criticism in a clear and direct way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 业余水准的；不熟练的；（像）外行的

ext.ext_en: We have to develop a less amateurish approach to our organisations...

ext.ext_en: The paintings looked amateurish.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as amateurish, you think that it is not skilfully made or done.

Bigamy is the crime of marrying a person when you are already legally married to someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 世界各国科学家一致认为在未来几十年里地球有可能变暖。
ext.ext_en: The consensus amongst the world's scientists is that the world is likely to warm up over the next few decades...

ext.ext_cn: 部队应该何时撤离的问题将由大家共同决定。
ext.ext_en: The question of when the troops should leave would be decided by consensus.

defs.def_en: A consensus is general agreement among a group of people.
A conscript is a person who has been made to join the armed forces of a country.

ext.ext_cn: 他应征加入德国军队。
ext.ext_en: He was conscripted into  the German army...

ext.ext_cn: 和所有其他年轻人一样，彼得应征入伍。
ext.ext_en: Peter was conscripted like every other young man.

defs.def_en: If someone is conscripted, they are officially made to join the armed forces of a country.
A plaintiff is a person who brings a legal case against someone in a court of law.

defs.def_cn: （用于名词或形容词前构成形容词）表示“全…”，“纯…”

ext.ext_en: ...an all-star cast...

ext.ext_cn: 纯男性工作和纯女性工作之间常常很难作比较。
ext.ext_en: It is often very hard to compare all-male and all-female jobs.

defs.def_en: All- is added to nouns or adjectives in order to form adjectives which describe something as consisting only of the thing mentioned or as having only the quality indicated.

defs.def_cn: （用于现在分词或形容词前构成形容词）表示“全面的”

ext.ext_cn: 照顾一个精神病人是时刻都要劳神费力的苦差事。
ext.ext_en: Nursing a demented person is an all-consuming task...

ext.ext_en: There are no all-embracing EC directives on race equality.

defs.def_en: All- is added to present participles or adjectives in order to form adjectives which describe something as including or affecting everything or everyone.

defs.def_cn: （用于名词前构成形容词）表示“适合各种…的”，“包含各种…的”

ext.ext_cn: 他想成立一个维护国家团结的多党执政政府。
ext.ext_en: He wanted to form an all-party government of national unity...

ext.ext_cn: 牛仔裤，这种适合各种用途的斜纹粗棉布裤子，已经有一百多年历史了。
ext.ext_en: Jeans, the all-purpose denim trousers, have been around for over a hundred years.

defs.def_en: All- is added to nouns in order to form adjectives which describe something as being suitable for or including all types of a particular thing.

defs.def_cn: 轻松诙谐的话；寒暄；客套

ext.ext_cn: 他就宾馆和天气寒暄了几句。
ext.ext_en: He exchanged pleasantries about his hotel and the weather.

defs.def_en: Pleasantries are casual, friendly remarks which you make in order to be polite.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 使人惊恐的；令人忧虑的；让人担心的

ext.ext_cn: 这种病以惊人的速度传播开来。
ext.ext_en: The disease has spread at an alarming rate.

ext.ext_cn: 令人忧虑的犯罪攀升现象
ext.ext_en: ...the alarming increase in crime.

defs.def_en: Something that is alarming makes you feel afraid or anxious that something unpleasant or dangerous might happen.

ext.ext_cn: 他担心受到惩罚，不想再牵涉其中。
ext.ext_en: He didn't want any further involvement for fear of retribution.

defs.def_en: Retribution is punishment for a crime, especially punishment which is carried out by someone other than the official authorities.

ext.ext_cn: 迈克晃了一下头，想把头发从汗涔涔的前额上甩开。
ext.ext_en: Mike shook his head, to unstick his hair from his sweating forehead...

ext.ext_cn: 为乘务员制作了徽章，这样它们就不会从车厢上脱落下来，也不会被传来传去。
ext.ext_en: The stewards' badges are made so they do not unstick from a car and therefore cannot be passed around.

defs.def_en: See also:unstuck;If you unstick something or if it unsticks, it becomes separated from the thing that it was stuck to.
A rose window is a large round stained glass window in a church.

defs.def_cn: 无趣的人;愚钝的人;无想象力的人
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a dullard, you mean that they are rather boring, unintelligent, and unimaginative.

defs.def_cn: (新想法或新设备)太复杂的，不必要的，时髦复杂的

ext.ext_cn: 戈斯先生一点儿都不相信有关瘦肉的这种“奇谈怪论”。
ext.ext_en: Mr Goss does not believe in any of this 'new-fangled nonsense' about lean meat.

ext.ext_cn: 过于复杂的税收结构
ext.ext_en: ...a newfangled tax structure.

defs.def_en: If someone describes a new idea or a new piece of equipment as new-fangled, they mean that it is too complicated or is unnecessary.

defs.def_cn: 丹宁酸，鞣酸(用于制革、染色)
defs.def_en: Tannin is a yellow or brown chemical that is found in plants such as tea. It is used in the process of making leather and in dyeing.

defs.def_cn: (英国的)地方政府出租住房，地方政府廉租房
defs.def_en: In Britain, a council house is a house that is owned by a local council and that people can rent at a low cost.

ext.ext_cn: 他看见杂志的一角从毯子下露了出来。
ext.ext_en: He saw the corner of a magazine sticking out from under the blanket...

ext.ext_cn: 在左上角写上“航空邮递”。
ext.ext_en: Write 'By Airmail' in the top left hand corner.

defs.def_en: A corner is a point or an area where two or more edges, sides, or surfaces of something join.

ext.ext_cn: 起居室角落里的牌桌
ext.ext_en: ...a card table in the corner of the living room...

ext.ext_cn: 球飞进了球网的远角。
ext.ext_en: The ball hurtled into the far corner of the net...

defs.def_en: The corner of a room, box, or similar space is the area inside it where its edges or walls meet.

ext.ext_cn: 她擦掉嘴角的面包屑。
ext.ext_en: She flicked a crumb off the corner of her mouth...

ext.ext_cn: 她用眼角的余光瞥见一辆车停了下来。
ext.ext_en: Out of the corner of her eye she saw that a car had stopped.

defs.def_en: The corner of your mouth or eye is the side of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她会整天在街角附近游荡。
ext.ext_en: She would spend the day hanging round street corners...

ext.ext_cn: 不可能每个街角都派驻警察。
ext.ext_en: We can't have police officers on every corner...

defs.def_en: The corner of a street is the place where one of its sides ends as it joins another street.

ext.ext_cn: 急转弯
ext.ext_en: ...a sharp corner...

ext.ext_cn: 这条路上急转弯、坡道和死拐角一个接一个。
ext.ext_en: The road is a succession of hairpin bends, hills, and blind corners.

defs.def_en: A corner is a bend in a road.

defs.def_cn: (遥远或难以到达的)角落，偏远处

ext.ext_cn: 买主来自世界各地。
ext.ext_en: Buyers came from all corners of the world...

ext.ext_cn: 该部落一直居住在柬埔寨的丛林深处。
ext.ext_en: The group has been living in a remote corner of the Cambodian jungle.

defs.def_en: If you talk about the corners of the world, a country, or some other place, you are referring to places that are far away or difficult to get to.
In football, hockey, and some other sports, a corner is a free shot or kick taken from the corner of the pitch.

defs.def_cn: 将…逼入死角；使走投无路

ext.ext_cn: 一辆摩托警车跟在他的车后追了12英里，最后在快到罗马时将他截住。
ext.ext_en: A police motorcycle chased his car twelve miles, and cornered him near Rome...

ext.ext_cn: 他还像一头困兽一样蜷缩着坐在那儿。
ext.ext_en: He was still sitting huddled like a cornered animal.

defs.def_en: If you corner a person or animal, you force them into a place they cannot escape from.

ext.ext_cn: 戈兰设法截住了那位兼任制片人的年轻导演，对其进行了采访。
ext.ext_en: Golan managed to corner the young producer-director for an interview.

defs.def_en: If you corner someone, you force them to speak to you when they have been trying to avoid you.
