defs.def_cn: (感情、事物或人出现的)高潮期

ext.ext_cn: 这场波及全国的爱国热潮还对那场工会运动起到了推波助澜的作用。
ext.ext_en: The trade union movement was swept along by the same tidal wave of patriotism which affected the country as a whole...

ext.ext_cn: 经济衰退的情况在加剧，各个行业相继出现失业高峰。
ext.ext_en: The recession is deepening and we are now seeing a tidal wave of job losses in all sections of the economy.

defs.def_en: If you describe a very large number of emotions, things, or people as a tidal wave, you mean that they all occur at the same time.
A bell pepper is a hollow green, red, or yellow vegetable with seeds.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 大名鼎鼎的爵士乐歌手阿德莱德·霍尔
ext.ext_en: ...the legendary Jazz singer Adelaide Hall...

ext.ext_cn: 他的政治手腕高超是出了名的。
ext.ext_en: His political skill is legendary.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as legendary, you mean that they are very famous and that many stories are told about them.

defs.def_cn: 传说中的；古老传奇中的

ext.ext_cn: 这座山据称是传说中的卢德王的长眠之处。
ext.ext_en: The hill is supposed to be the resting place of the legendary King Lud.

defs.def_en: A legendary person, place, or event is mentioned or described in an old legend.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不能安抚的;无法平息的;毫不妥协的

ext.ext_cn: 残暴无情的敌人发出的侵略威胁
ext.ext_en: ...the threat of invasion by a ruthless and implacable enemy...

ext.ext_cn: 该提案遭到了许多经济学家的坚决反对。
ext.ext_en: The move has won the implacable opposition of many economists.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is implacable, you mean that they have very strong feelings of hostility or disapproval which nobody can change.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 对人类历史的清楚记述
ext.ext_en: ...a lucid account of the history of mankind...

ext.ext_cn: 他的散文素来简洁、有力。
ext.ext_en: His prose is always lucid and compelling.

defs.def_en: Lucid writing or speech is clear and easy to understand.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （病后或糊涂过后）清醒的，头脑清楚的，思路清晰的

ext.ext_cn: 他神志不是很清醒，不太知道自己在哪里。
ext.ext_en: He wasn't  very lucid, he didn't quite know where he was.

defs.def_en: If someone is lucid, they are thinking clearly again after a period of illness or confusion.

defs.def_cn: 真菌引起的;真菌的;真菌构成的

ext.ext_cn: 足癣是一种真菌感染。
ext.ext_en: Athlete's foot is a fungal infection.

defs.def_en: Fungal means caused by, consisting of, or relating to fungus.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 震惊的;惊恐的;感到厌恶的

ext.ext_cn: 她说美国人对会上所作的陈述感到震惊。
ext.ext_en: She said that the Americans are appalled at the statements made at the conference...

ext.ext_cn: 我们当然对这些物品竟然还在商店里出售表示震惊。
ext.ext_en: We are all, of course, appalled that such items are still on sale in the shops.

defs.def_en: If you are appalled by something, you are shocked or disgusted because it is so bad or unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 我不会告诉任何人我在这儿见过你。
ext.ext_en: I won't tell anyone I saw you here...

ext.ext_cn: 不想说话的时候，你可以不说。
ext.ext_en: You needn't talk to anyone if you don't want to...

defs.def_en: You use anyone or anybody in statements with negative meaning to indicate in a general way that nobody is present or involved in an action.

defs.def_cn: （用于疑问句或条件从句）任何人

ext.ext_cn: 为什么会有人想要那份工作呢？
ext.ext_en: Why would anyone want that job?...

ext.ext_cn: 在这样的场合怎么会有人显得忧伤呢？
ext.ext_en: How can anyone look sad at an occasion like this?...

defs.def_en: You use anyone or anybody in questions and conditional clauses to ask or talk about whether someone is present or doing something.

defs.def_cn: （用于描述所谈论的人的词语前）…人

ext.ext_cn: 我过去总是比同龄人要捷足先登。
ext.ext_en: I always had been the person who achieved things before anyone else at my age...

ext.ext_cn: 这份工作不适合不擅长算术的人。
ext.ext_en: It's not a job for anyone who is slow with numbers...

defs.def_en: You use anyone or anybody before words which indicate the kind of person you are talking about.

defs.def_cn: （用于强调）任何人，随便哪个人

ext.ext_en: Anyone could be doing what I'mdoing...

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔·史密斯能把所有人逗乐。
ext.ext_en: Al Smith could make anybody laugh.

defs.def_en: You use anyone or anybody to refer to a person when you are emphasizing that it could be any person out of a very large number of people.

defs.def_cn: 重要人物;有影响的人物

ext.ext_cn: 似乎商界所有重要人物都将参加那个会议。
ext.ext_en: It seems anyone who's anyone in business is going to the conference.

defs.def_en: You use anyone who is anyone and anybody who is anybody to refer to people who are important or influential.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 卑鄙的想法

ext.ext_cn: 他们国家历史中一段不光彩的插曲
ext.ext_en: ...an ignoble episode from their country's past.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as ignoble, you mean that it is bad and something to be ashamed of.

ext.ext_en: Several bands have namechecked Lee Hazelwood in interviews.

defs.def_en: If someone gets a namecheck in something such as an article or interview, their name is mentioned in it.
Your voice box is the top part of the tube that leads from your throat to your lungs, which contains your vocal cords.

ext.ext_en: Is the problem one that's industry-wide?

defs.def_en: -wide combines with nouns to form adjectives which indicate that something exists or happens throughout the place or area that the noun refers to.

ext.ext_en: In Petersburg, 30 patrolmen have died violently in the past five years.

defs.def_en: A patrolman is a policeman who patrols a particular area.

defs.def_cn: （车友会帮助会员解决车辆故障的）巡回修理工，巡视员

ext.ext_cn: 马尔的车在路上抛了锚，AA巡视员1个小时后才到达。
ext.ext_en: Mal's car had broken down en route and the AA patrolman had taken an hour to arrive.

defs.def_en: A patrolman is a person employed by a motoring organization to help members of the organization when their cars break down.

ext.ext_cn: 事实上，这个党派的残余分子确实仍然拥有可观的资产。
ext.ext_en: The rump of the party does in fact still have considerable assets...

ext.ext_cn: 他发现自己领导的这个残存的党派和自己的观点大多不符。
ext.ext_en: He finds himself heading a rump party largely out of tune with his own views.

defs.def_en: The rump of a group, organization, or country consists of the members who remain in it after the rest have left.

ext.ext_cn: 奶牛的臀部标着一个数字。
ext.ext_en: The cows' rumps were marked with a number.

defs.def_en: An animal's rump is its rear end.
Rump or rump steak is meat cut from the rear end of a cow.

ext.ext_cn: 紧裹她臀部的仔裤
ext.ext_en: ...jeans stretching across her rump.

defs.def_en: A person's rump is his or her bottom.

ext.ext_cn: 他们开始工作，用砂纸把木制品打磨平滑。
ext.ext_en: They were settling to their work, rubbing down the woodwork with sandpaper.

defs.def_en: If you rub down a rough surface, you make it smooth by rubbing it with something such as sandpaper.

ext.ext_en: He set him on the bed and rubbed him down with a coarse towel...

ext.ext_cn: 在洗澡或淋浴后，用丝瓜络按摩身体。
ext.ext_en: After a bath or shower rub down the whole body with a loofah.

defs.def_en: If you rub someone down, you dry them or massage them with something such as a towel or cloth.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 丝绸一样的;柔软光洁的

ext.ext_cn: 迷人的丝绸长裙
ext.ext_en: ...dresses in seductively silky fabrics...

ext.ext_cn: 克莱尔捋了捋凯蒂如丝般的秀发。
ext.ext_en: Claire smoothed Katy's silky hair.

defs.def_en: If something has a silky texture, it is smooth, soft, and shiny, like silk.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 说话温和而且彬彬有礼的男子
ext.ext_en: ...a well-spoken man with a silky voice.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's voice as silky, you mean that it sounds confident but gentle and you find it attractive.

ext.ext_en: Some people moved in silky, liquid movements, others were jerky, probably drunk...

ext.ext_cn: 我的车买了两年了，我非常喜欢它卓越的操控性，安静舒适的驾车环境和平稳流畅的换挡操作。
ext.ext_en: I had the car for two years and much enjoyed its excellent handling, quietness and silky gearchange.

defs.def_en: If you describe the way someone or something moves as silky, you mean that they move very smoothly.

ext.ext_en: ...trans-Pacific flights between Asia and America.

ext.ext_en: ...the Trans-Siberian railway.

ext.ext_cn: 跨种族的收养
ext.ext_en: ...trans-racial adoption.

defs.def_en: trans- is used to form words which indicate that someone or something moves from one group, thing, state, or place to another.

defs.def_en: If someone has grit, they have the determination and courage to continue doing something even though it is very difficult.

ext.ext_en: 'It is clear that my client has been less than frank with me,' said his lawyer, through gritted teeth.

defs.def_en: If you grit your teeth, you press your upper and lower teeth tightly together, usually because you are angry about something.

ext.ext_cn: 未来会很艰难，但是我们必须咬牙坚持下去。
ext.ext_en: There is going to be hardship, but we have to grit our teeth and get on with it.

defs.def_en: If you grit your teeth, you make up your mind to carry on even if the situation is very difficult.

defs.def_cn: 首要的；最主要的；最重要的

ext.ext_en: The principal reason for my change of mind is this.

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家最主要的外汇收入来源
ext.ext_en: ...the country's principal source of foreign exchange earnings...

defs.def_en: Principal means first in order of importance.

defs.def_cn: （中小学）校长；（英国）大学校长，学院院长

ext.ext_en: Donald King is the principal of Dartmouth High School.

defs.def_en: The principal of a school, or in Britain the principal of a college, is the person in charge of the school or college.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 吸引人的；时髦的；刺激的

ext.ext_en: ...the grooviest club in London.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as groovy, you mean that it is attractive, fashionable, or exciting.

defs.def_cn: （计算机游戏的）控制杆，游戏杆
defs.def_en: In some computer games, the joystick is the lever which the player uses in order to control the direction of the things on the screen.
In an aircraft, the joystick is the lever which the pilot uses to control the direction and height of the aeroplane.
In the Christian religion, the Holy Spirit is one of the three aspects of God, together with God the Father and God the Son.
Doggie is a child's word for a dog.

ext.ext_cn: 他穿着衬衫和黑裤子，脚蹬皮靴，看上去很帅气。
ext.ext_en: He was smartly dressed in a shirt, dark trousers and boots...

ext.ext_cn: 亚历山大把裤腿卷起来。
ext.ext_en: Alexander rolled up his trouser legs.

defs.def_en: Trousers are a piece of clothing that you wear over your body from the waist downwards, and that cover each leg separately.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He is impatient as the first hour passes and then another...

ext.ext_en: The big clubs are becoming increasingly impatient at the rate of progress.

defs.def_en: If you are impatient, you are annoyed because you have to wait too long for something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 注意不要对人不耐烦。
ext.ext_en: Beware of being too impatient with others...

ext.ext_en: He threw it aside with an impatient gesture and another oath and walked off.

defs.def_en: If you are impatient, you are easily irritated by things.

defs.def_cn: 迫不及待的;切望的;急不可耐的

ext.ext_cn: 他迫不及待想要回家。
ext.ext_en: He was impatient to get home...

ext.ext_cn: 他们渴望得到工作，获取安全感。
ext.ext_en: They are impatient for jobs and security.

ext.ext_cn: 存在主义理论
ext.ext_en: ...existentialist theories.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their philosophy as existentialist, you mean that their beliefs are based on existentialism.

ext.ext_cn: 自由是每一个人与生俱来的权利。
ext.ext_en: Freedom is the natural birthright of every human.

defs.def_en: Something that is your birthright is something that you feel you have a basic right to have, simply because you are a human being.

defs.def_cn: 折中主义;兼收并蓄的原则（或做法）

ext.ext_cn: 这些设计中的兼收并蓄意味着难以界定一个总体的风格。
ext.ext_en: The eclecticism of the designs means it is difficult to define one overall look.

ext.ext_cn: 她的文化折中主义
ext.ext_en: ...her cultural eclecticism.

defs.def_en: Eclecticism is the principle or practice of choosing or involving objects, ideas, and beliefs from many different sources.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 具有非凡才能的孩子们
ext.ext_en: ...children with exceptional ability...

ext.ext_cn: 他的译作非常有诗意。
ext.ext_en: His translation is exceptional in its poetic quality.

defs.def_en: You use exceptional to describe someone or something that has a particular quality, usually a good quality, to an unusually high degree.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...if the courts hold that this case is exceptional...

ext.ext_en: School governors have the discretion to allow parents to withdraw pupils in exceptional circumstances.

ext.ext_en: Lynda now sees many of her clients downshifting in search of a new way of living.

ext.ext_cn: 他调到低速挡，转动方向盘。
ext.ext_en: He downshifted and turned the steering wheel.

defs.def_en: If you downshift while driving, you change to a lower gear.

defs.def_cn: 投票反对（某人）加入俱乐部

ext.ext_cn: 成员可以通过无记名投票反对候选人加入。
ext.ext_en: Members can blackball candidates in secret ballots.

defs.def_en: If the members of a club blackball someone, they vote against that person being allowed to join their club.

ext.ext_cn: “之前你见过那辆车吗？”——“哦，见过，它总是停在车道上。”
ext.ext_en: 'Had you seen the car before?' — 'Oh yes, it was always in the drive.'...

ext.ext_cn: “你需要我打电话解释一下情况吗？”——“哦，可以吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'Would you like me to phone and explain the situation?' — 'Oh, would you?'...

defs.def_en: You use oh to introduce a response or a comment on something that has just been said.

defs.def_cn: （表示惊讶、痛苦、恼怒或喜悦等）唉，啊，呀，哈

ext.ext_cn: “啊！”肯尼眨了眨眼睛，“人都走了吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'Oh!' Kenny blinked. 'Has everyone gone?'...

ext.ext_cn: “哎呀，我的天啊，”科龙齐斯呻吟道。
ext.ext_en: 'Oh, my God,' Korontzis moaned...

defs.def_en: See also:O;You use oh to express a feeling such as surprise, pain, annoyance, or happiness.

ext.ext_cn: 我是，呃，6月底来到这里的。
ext.ext_en: I've been here, oh, since the end of June...

ext.ext_cn: 入侵者破坏了，嗯，我不知道用什么字眼好——气氛，氛围。
ext.ext_en: The invaders have destroyed the, oh, I don't know what the right word is—the atmosphere, the ambience.

defs.def_en: You use oh when you are hesitating while speaking, for example because you are trying to estimate something, or because you are searching for the right word.

ext.ext_cn: 尸检最终认定孩子死于婴儿猝死综合征。
ext.ext_en: An autopsy eventually ascribed the baby's death to sudden infant death syndrome.

defs.def_en: If you ascribe an event or condition to a particular cause, you say or consider that it was caused by that thing.

defs.def_cn: 认为是…的特点;认为…具有

ext.ext_en: We do not ascribe a superior wisdom to government or the state.

defs.def_en: If you ascribe a quality to someone, you consider that they possess it.

ext.ext_cn: 他错误地认为“适者生存”是查尔斯·达尔文说的。
ext.ext_en: He mistakenly ascribes the expression 'survival of the fittest' to Charles Darwin.

defs.def_en: If you ascribe something such as a quotation or a work of art to someone, you say that they said it or created it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她想做好一件事的时候，就会练习、练习、再练习。
ext.ext_en: When she wanted to get something right, she would practise and practise and practise.

defs.def_en: See also:practised;If you practise something, you keep doing it regularly in order to be able to do it better.

defs.def_cn: 奉行（风俗、宗教等活动）；实践（手艺）

ext.ext_cn: 实行多党政体的国家
ext.ext_en: ...countries which practise multi-party politics...

ext.ext_cn: 中国早在公元前3,000年就已开始采用针灸疗法。
ext.ext_en: Acupuncture was practised in China as long ago as the third millennium BC...

defs.def_en: When people practise something such as a custom, craft, or religion, they take part in the activities associated with it.

ext.ext_cn: 一直有报道称犯人被施以电刑。
ext.ext_en: There are consistent reports of electrical torture being practised on inmates.

defs.def_en: If something cruel is regularly done to people, you can say that it is practised on them.

defs.def_cn: 从（医）；从事（律师工作）；执业

ext.ext_cn: 在比利时只有资质合格的医生才能从事非传统医学工作。
ext.ext_en: In Belgium only qualified doctors may practise alternative medicine...

ext.ext_cn: 他出生在香港，后来在那里从事律师工作，直到退休。
ext.ext_en: He was born in Hong Kong where he subsequently practised as a lawyer until his retirement...

defs.def_en: Someone who practises medicine or law works as a doctor or a lawyer.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 耻辱的;不光彩的;不名誉的;丢脸的

ext.ext_cn: 他们耻辱的战败
ext.ext_en: ...their ignominious defeat...

ext.ext_cn: 许多人认为他注定会极不光彩地失败。
ext.ext_en: Many thought that he was doomed to ignominious failure.

defs.def_en: If you describe an experience or action as ignominious, you mean it is embarrassing because it shows a great lack of success.
The gas pedal is another name for the accelerator .
An ox is a bull that has been castrated. Oxen are used in some countries for pulling vehicles or carrying things.
Rainwater is water that has fallen as rain.

defs.def_cn: (检阅队伍经过主席台前时的)分列式
defs.def_en: When soldiers take part in a march-past, they march past an important person as part of a ceremonial occasion.

ext.ext_cn: 政府昨天宣布为皇家海军订购3艘23型护卫舰。
ext.ext_en: The government announced an order for three Type 23 frigates for the Royal Navy yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 她自己的儿子那时也在海军。
ext.ext_en: Her own son was also in the Navy.

defs.def_en: A country's navy consists of the people it employs to fight at sea, and the ships they use.

ext.ext_cn: 我大部分时间穿黑色或深蓝色裤子。
ext.ext_en: I mostly wore black or navy trousers.

ext.ext_cn: 海军蓝的便上装
ext.ext_en: ...a navy-blue blazer.

defs.def_en: Something that is navy or navy-blue is very dark blue.

ext.ext_cn: 日本有4,000多位百岁老人。
ext.ext_en: Japan has more than 4,000 centenarians.

defs.def_en: A centenarian is someone who is a hundred years old or older.

ext.ext_cn: 我时常愉快地回想起几年前在科文特花园的一个时刻。
ext.ext_en: I often think fondly of an occasion some years ago at Covent Garden...

ext.ext_cn: 戴维斯先生曾多次被问及。
ext.ext_en: Mr Davis has been asked on a number of occasions.

defs.def_en: An occasion is a time when something happens, or a case of it happening.

ext.ext_cn: 带着她出席正式场合对我来说一直是个挑战。
ext.ext_en: Taking her with me on official occasions has been a challenge...

ext.ext_cn: 这将是一次特别的家庭聚会。
ext.ext_en: It will be a unique family occasion.

defs.def_en: An occasion is an important event, ceremony, or celebration.

ext.ext_cn: 这是个值得举家庆祝的时刻。
ext.ext_en: It is an occasion for all the family to celebrate...

ext.ext_cn: 这历来都是阐明政府政策的重要时机。
ext.ext_en: It is always an important occasion for setting out government policy.

defs.def_en: An occasion for doing something is an opportunity for doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 他认为释放人质不应造成政策的改变。
ext.ext_en: He argued that the release of hostages should not occasion a change in policy.

defs.def_en: To occasion something means to cause it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们有必要以多项罪名起诉该组织的成员。
ext.ext_en: We have had occasion to deal with members of the group on a variety of charges.

defs.def_en: If you have occasion to do something, it is necessary for you to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他对待他们严肃认真，偶尔又逗得他们捧腹不已。
ext.ext_en: He treated them seriously and, on occasion, entertained them hilariously...

ext.ext_cn: 他不仅做法文翻译，有时也做些波兰语翻译。
ext.ext_en: He translated not only from the French but also, on occasion, from the Polish.

defs.def_en: If something happens on occasion, it happens sometimes, but not very often.

defs.def_cn: 成功应付困难局面；关键时刻发挥作用

ext.ext_cn: 然而，因弗内斯队在下半场经受住了考验，踢出了很长一段时间以来的最佳水平。
ext.ext_en: Inverness, however, rose to the occasion in the second half, producing some of the best football they have played for some time.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone rose to the occasion, you mean that they did what was necessary to successfully overcome a difficult situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 信心十足的；精力充沛的

ext.ext_cn: 得意洋洋的小个子男人
ext.ext_en: ...a jaunty little man...

ext.ext_cn: 与这些引文给人的印象相比，特里曼的小说总的来说更加充满自信、富于变化，也更有活力。
ext.ext_en: Tremain's  novel is altogether jauntier, more various and energetic than these quotations imply.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as jaunty, you mean that they are full of confidence and energy.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰把三明治盘子递给每一个人。
ext.ext_en: John handed round the plate of sandwiches...

ext.ext_cn: 总是在正式场合递送的免费牙买加雪茄
ext.ext_en: ...the free Jamaican cigars that were always handed around at official functions...

defs.def_en: If you hand around or hand round something such as food, you pass it from one person to another in a group.

defs.def_cn: 莽撞的司机;横冲直撞的驾驶员
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a roadhog, you mean that they drive too fast or in a way which is dangerous to other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 忠诚的；忠心的；忠贞不渝的

ext.ext_cn: 他们始终对总统忠心耿耿。
ext.ext_en: They had remained loyal to the president...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直是我们大家忠实的朋友。
ext.ext_en: He'd always been such a loyal friend to us all.

defs.def_en: Someone who is loyal remains firm in their friendship or support for a person or thing.

defs.def_cn: 使思维迟钝;使厌烦;使呆滞

ext.ext_cn: 这种态度会扼杀科学的进步。
ext.ext_en: This attitude stultifies scientific progress...

ext.ext_cn: 只有一名穿制服的无聊警卫可能偷听到了他们的谈话。
ext.ext_en: Only a uniformed guard stultified with boredom might have overheard them.

defs.def_en: If something stultifies you, it makes you feel empty or dull in your mind, because it is so boring.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 筋疲力尽的;酩酊大醉的;（因吸毒而）恍惚的
defs.def_en: If someone is zonked or zonked out, they are not capable of doing anything because they are very tired, drunk, or drugged.

defs.def_cn: （表示同意或希望转换话题或做别的事情）好的，好吧，好了

ext.ext_cn: 好的。我会给你打电话。
ext.ext_en: Okey doke. I'll give you a ring.

defs.def_en: Okey doke is used in the same way as 'OK' to show that you agree to something, or that you want to start talking about something else or doing something else.

defs.def_cn: （表示惊讶，或强调赞同或反对）啊，哦，呀，哟

ext.ext_cn: “哎呀，安静一下吧，”肖恩说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Och be quiet then,' Shawn said...

ext.ext_cn: 口欧耶，我一直都很喜欢他。
ext.ext_en: Och aye. I always liked him.

defs.def_en: Och is used to express surprise at something, or to emphasize agreement or disagreement with what has just been said.
If you refer to someone as a hipster, you mean that they are very fashionable, often in a way that you think is rather silly.
Hipsters are trousers which are designed so that the highest part of them is around your hips, rather than around your waist.

ext.ext_cn: 儿童的智力发展
ext.ext_en: ...the mental development of children.

ext.ext_cn: 高强度的脑力劳动
ext.ext_en: ...intensive mental effort.

defs.def_en: Mental means relating to the process of thinking.

ext.ext_cn: 导致她精神失常的那种心理状态已经消失了。
ext.ext_en: The mental state that had created her psychosis was no longer present.

ext.ext_cn: 心理健康问题
ext.ext_en: ...mental health problems.

defs.def_en: Mental means relating to the state or the health of a person's mind.

defs.def_cn: 内心的;在头脑中进行的

ext.ext_cn: 外出购物的时候练习一下心算。
ext.ext_en: Practise mental arithmetic when you go out shopping...

ext.ext_cn: 格雷厄姆很快就心算出来了。
ext.ext_en: Graham made a quick mental calculation.

defs.def_en: A mental act is one that involves only thinking and not physical action.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我刚才对他说：“你一定是疯了。”
ext.ext_en: I just said to him 'you must be mental'.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is mental, you mean that you think they are mad.

defs.def_cn: 记在脑子里;把…牢记在心

ext.ext_cn: 她记着要拿他的处方再配一回药。
ext.ext_en: She made a mental note to have his prescription refilled.

ext.ext_cn: 她心里牢牢记着不坐在他的附近。
ext.ext_en: She made a mental note not to sit anywhere near him.

defs.def_en: If you make a mental note of something, you make an effort to store it in your memory so that you will not forget it.

ext.ext_cn: 战争期间,他们被关在狱中。
ext.ext_en: They were incarcerated for the duration of the war...

ext.ext_cn: 监禁一名囚犯一年要花费 4 万到 5 万美元。
ext.ext_en: It can cost $40,000 to $50,000 to incarcerate a prisoner for a year.

defs.def_en: If people are incarcerated, they are kept in a prison or other place.
If a woman gives birth by natural childbirth, she is not given any drugs to relieve her pain or to send her to sleep.
The front door of a house or other building is the main door, which is usually in the wall that faces a street.
A north-easterly point, area, or direction is to the north-east or towards the north-east.
A north-easterly wind is a wind that blows from the north-east.

ext.ext_cn: 盖尔语多年来一直濒于消亡，尽管如今孩子们还在学校学习这门语言。
ext.ext_en: Gaelic has been a dying language for many years, though children are nowadays taught it in school...

ext.ext_cn: 福特听到这一场新官司的消息后再次精神崩溃，尽管他说自己是因为工作才这样的。
ext.ext_en: After news of this new court case Ford broke down again, though he blamed the breakdown on his work...

defs.def_en: You use though to introduce a statement in a subordinate clause which contrasts with the statement in the main clause. You often use though to introduce a fact which you regard as less important than the fact in the main clause.

ext.ext_cn: 我现在回想起来，觉得那是战时最血腥的(但并非字面意义上的)一个冬天。
ext.ext_en: I look back on it as the bloodiest (though not literally) winter of the war...

ext.ext_cn: 问题终于被认定为是神经受到严重挤压，尽管这还不是最终结论。
ext.ext_en: The problem was finally, though not conclusively, identified as a severely pinched nerve...

defs.def_en: You use though to introduce a subordinate clause which gives some information that is relevant to the main clause and weakens the force of what it is saying.

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢他，不过他有时惹我生气。
ext.ext_en: I like him. Though he makes me angry sometimes...

ext.ext_cn: 我想进入政坛，或者重操律师旧业。不过我不想进学校去专门学习。
ext.ext_en: I want to try my hand at politics, or go back to the law. I don't want to go to school for it, though...

defs.def_en: You use though to indicate that the information in a clause contrasts with or modifies information given in a previous sentence or sentences.

ext.ext_cn: 我并非自夸，我的厨艺的确高超。
ext.ext_en: I'm a good cook, though I say it myself...

ext.ext_cn: 不是我吹牛，我们的小饭店可能是全城最好的。
ext.ext_en: Even though I do say it myself we've probably got the best little restaurant in town.

defs.def_en: You can say though I say so myself or even though I say it myself when you are praising yourself or something you have done, but do not want to sound too proud.

defs.def_cn: (常指建筑物奠基典礼时放置的)基石,奠基石

ext.ext_cn: 威尔士王妃为大教堂的扩建奠基。
ext.ext_en: The Princess of Wales laid the foundation stone for the extension to the Cathedral.

defs.def_en: A foundation stone is a large block of stone built into a large public building near the bottom. It is often involved in a ceremony for the opening of the building, and has writing on it recording this.

ext.ext_cn: 决定未来的一些根基：教育、培训、研究和发展
ext.ext_en: ...these foundation stones of the future: education, training, research, development.

defs.def_en: The foundation stone of something is the basic, important thing which its existence or success depends on.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (对人说话的方式)恶狠狠的，疾言厉色的，发急的

ext.ext_cn: “真美呀，托尼，”妈妈说道，话音里的恶声恶气不见了。
ext.ext_en: 'That is beautiful, Tony,' Momma said, no longer sounding at all snappish.

defs.def_en: If someone is snappish, they speak to people in a sharp, unfriendly manner.

defs.def_cn: 应激反应的;本能反应的;条件反射的

ext.ext_cn: 想要躲藏起来的本能冲动
ext.ext_en: ...that reflexive urge for concealment.

defs.def_en: A reflexive reaction or movement occurs immediately in response to something that happens.

ext.ext_cn: 他指责我妈妈与另一个男人有染。
ext.ext_en: He was accusing my mum of having an affair with another man...

ext.ext_cn: 把事情按部就班地讲清楚。不要责难或归罪于人。
ext.ext_en: Talk things through in stages. Do not accuse or apportion blame.

defs.def_en: If you accuse someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you say or tell them that you believe that they did it.

ext.ext_cn: 她的助手被警方指控犯有盗窃和欺诈罪。
ext.ext_en: Her assistant was accused of theft and fraud by the police...

ext.ext_cn: 七项罪名都指控他作伪证。
ext.ext_en: All seven charges accused him of lying in his testimony...

defs.def_en: If you are accused of a crime, a witness or someone in authority states or claims that you did it, and you may be formally charged with it and put on trial.

ext.ext_cn: 该候选人还未上任就遭指责违背诺言。
ext.ext_en: The candidate stands accused of breaking promises even before he's in office...

ext.ext_cn: 今天罗斯托夫被控勒索和诈骗。
ext.ext_en: Today, Rostov stands accused of extortion and racketeering.

defs.def_en: If someone stands accused of something, they have been accused of it.

ext.ext_cn: 骑在弓背腾跃的野马上的两个牛仔
ext.ext_en: ...two cowboys riding bucking broncos.

defs.def_en: In the western United States, especially in the 19th century, a wild horse was sometimes referred to as a bronco.

ext.ext_cn: 我差不多已经决定如约和托尼见面了。
ext.ext_en: I had almost decided to keep my rendezvous with Tony.

defs.def_en: A rendezvous is a meeting, often a secret one, that you have arranged with someone for a particular time and place.

ext.ext_cn: 他们将在希思罗机场的五角饭店碰面。
ext.ext_en: Their rendezvous would be the Penta Hotel at Heathrow Airport.

defs.def_en: A rendezvous is the place where you have arranged to meet someone, often secretly.

ext.ext_cn: 计划在周日下午和他会面。
ext.ext_en: The plan was to rendezvous with him on Sunday afternoon...

ext.ext_cn: 她想知道之后他们要去哪里约会。
ext.ext_en: She wondered where they were going to rendezvous afterwards.

defs.def_en: If you rendezvous with someone or if the two of you rendezvous, you meet them at a time and place that you have arranged.
The Home Secretary is the member of the British government who is in charge of the Home Office.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在阿特尔伯勒的一家餐厅里吃的饭。
ext.ext_en: We had dinner at a restaurant in Attleborough...

ext.ext_cn: 他将去机场接她。
ext.ext_en: He will be at the airport to meet her...

defs.def_en: You use at to indicate the place or event where something happens or is situated.

ext.ext_cn: 他小时候既害羞又胆怯，在学校过得并不快乐。
ext.ext_en: He was shy and nervous as a boy, and unhappy at school...

ext.ext_cn: 他第一次遇见霍普金斯是在上大学的时候。
ext.ext_en: It was at university that he first encountered Hopkins...

defs.def_en: If someone is at school or college, or at a particular school or college, they go there regularly to study.

ext.ext_cn: 助手坐在他身旁的一张桌子上埋头打字。
ext.ext_en: An assistant sat typing away at a table beside him...

ext.ext_cn: 格雷厄姆已经在门口了。
ext.ext_en: Graham was already at the door...

defs.def_en: If you are at something such as a table, a door, or someone's side, you are next to it or them.

defs.def_cn: 从相隔（一段距离）的地方;呈…角度

ext.ext_cn: 那两个记者谨慎地保持距离跟在后面。
ext.ext_en: The two journalists followed at a discreet distance...

ext.ext_cn: 那棵树倾斜得非常厉害。
ext.ext_en: The tree was leaning at a low angle from the ground.

defs.def_en: When you are describing where someone or something is, you can say that they are at a certain distance. You can also say that one thing is at an angle in relation to another thing.

ext.ext_cn: 葬礼将在今天下午3点举行。
ext.ext_en: The funeral will be carried out this afternoon at 3.00...

ext.ext_cn: 他只有在圣诞节和复活节时才能见到她。
ext.ext_en: He only sees her at Christmas and Easter.

defs.def_en: If something happens at a particular time, that is the time when it happens or begins to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 布莱克在13岁时随家人移民到了澳大利亚。
ext.ext_en: Blake emigrated to Australia with his family at 13...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽·马丁76岁时卒于加利福尼亚家中。
ext.ext_en: Mary Martin has died at her home in California at the age of seventy-six.

defs.def_en: If you do something at a particular age, you do it when you are that age.

defs.def_cn: 以，达（某一速度、频率、水平或价格）

ext.ext_cn: 我以正常车速沿公路返回。
ext.ext_en: I drove back down the highway at normal speed...

ext.ext_cn: 定期检查汽油，并对车辆进行定期维护。
ext.ext_en: Check the oil at regular intervals, and have the car serviced regularly...

defs.def_en: You use at to express a rate, frequency, level, or price.

ext.ext_cn: B-19重达80吨，无疑是世界上最大、最先进的军用飞机。
ext.ext_en: Weighing in at eighty tons, the B-19 was easily the largest and most sophisticated warplane in the world.

ext.ext_cn: 当失业人数维持在300万
ext.ext_en: ...as unemployment stays pegged at three million.

defs.def_en: You use at before a number or amount to indicate a measurement.

defs.def_cn: 朝（某人或某物看）；向（某人掷物）；冲（某人说话）

ext.ext_cn: 他看着迈克尔笑了。
ext.ext_en: He looked at Michael and laughed...

ext.ext_cn: 人群变得狂暴起来，并向警察投掷汽油弹。
ext.ext_en: The crowds became violent and threw petrol bombs at the police...

defs.def_en: If you look at someone or something, you look towards them. If you direct an object or a comment at someone, you direct it towards them.

ext.ext_cn: 她打开门站在那里，朝我皱着眉头。
ext.ext_en: She opened the door and stood there, frowning at me...

ext.ext_cn: 我们向工作人员招了招手，想要买单。
ext.ext_en: We waved at the staff to try to get the bill.

defs.def_en: You can use at after verbs such as 'smile' or 'wave' and before nouns referring to people to indicate that you have put on an expression or made a gesture which someone is meant to see or understand.

ext.ext_cn: 他指了指空瓶子，女服务员立即重新拿了一瓶。
ext.ext_en: He pointed at the empty bottle and the waitress quickly replaced it...

ext.ext_cn: 他指着书架说，“我已经从他那里买了不少书了”。
ext.ext_en: He gestured at the shelves. 'I've bought many books from him.'

defs.def_en: If you point or gesture at something, you move your arm or head in its direction so that it will be noticed by someone you are with.

defs.def_cn: 致力于;定位于;期望达到

ext.ext_cn: 她努力维系着她的婚姻。
ext.ext_en: She has worked hard at her marriage.

ext.ext_cn: 旨在提高学生编班考试成绩的104万美元拨款
ext.ext_en: ...a $1.04m grant aimed at improving student performance on placement examinations.

defs.def_en: If you are working at something, you are dealing with it. If you are aiming at something, you are trying to achieve it.

ext.ext_cn: 她按照他的要求将浴室里的灯开着。
ext.ext_en: She left the light on in the bathroom at his request...

ext.ext_cn: 应日本外相的邀请，我于1987年访问了日本。
ext.ext_en: I visited Japan in 1987 at the invitation of the Foreign Minister.

defs.def_en: If something is done at someone's invitation or request, it is done as a result of it.

ext.ext_cn: 恐怕我们无权透露这一信息。
ext.ext_en: I am afraid we are not at liberty to disclose that information...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的国家陷入战争状态已将近6个星期了。
ext.ext_en: Their countries had been at war for nearly six weeks.

defs.def_en: You use at to say that someone or something is in a particular state or condition.

defs.def_cn: （用于所有格代词和形容词最高级前，表示某人或某物在此时的某一特征最鲜明）

ext.ext_cn: 玩板球时他最开心了。
ext.ext_en: He was at his happiest whilst playing cricket...

ext.ext_cn: 《霍华德庄园》是一部经典的老派电影。
ext.ext_en: Howards End is old fashioned film-making at its best.

defs.def_en: You use at before a possessive pronoun and a superlative adjective to say that someone or something has more of a particular quality than at any other time.

ext.ext_cn: 3个人被从一辆面包车中发射的乱弹打死了。
ext.ext_en: Three people were killed by shots fired at random from a minibus...

ext.ext_cn: 马丁先生被人用枪指着从车里带了出来。
ext.ext_en: Mr Martin was taken out of his car at gunpoint.

defs.def_en: You use at to say how something is being done.

ext.ext_cn: 她放下了那块一直用来擦眼睛的手帕。
ext.ext_en: She lowered the handkerchief which she had kept dabbing at her eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 梅尔维尔小姐拿起一块饼干小口吃起来。
ext.ext_en: Miss Melville took a cookie and nibbled at it.

defs.def_en: You use at to show that someone is doing something repeatedly.

ext.ext_cn: 我对自己的工作得心应手。
ext.ext_en: I'm good at my work...

ext.ext_cn: 罗宾是奶酪制作专家。
ext.ext_en: Robin is an expert at cheesemaking...

defs.def_en: You use at to indicate an activity or task when saying how well someone does it.

ext.ext_cn: 埃莉诺为不得不等他这么长时间而感到很恼火。
ext.ext_en: Eleanor was annoyed at having had to wait so long for him...

ext.ext_cn: 英国队毫不掩饰他们获胜的喜悦。
ext.ext_en: The British team did not disguise their delight at their success...

defs.def_en: You use at to indicate what someone is reacting to.

ext.ext_cn: 深夜穿着内衣去游泳的一对夫妇
ext.ext_en: ...a couple who went for a late-night swim in their underwear.

ext.ext_cn: 更换内衣
ext.ext_en: ...a change of underwear.

defs.def_en: Underwear is clothing such as vests and pants which you wear next to your skin under your other clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 这一冲突实际上很有可能演变成国际化问题。
ext.ext_en: A very real danger exists of the conflict becoming internationalised...

ext.ext_cn: 他们一直想使克什米尔问题国际化。
ext.ext_en: They have been trying to internationalise the Kashmir problem.

defs.def_en: If an issue or a crisis is internationalized, it becomes the concern of many nations throughout the world.

ext.ext_cn: 五颜六色的伞的海洋
ext.ext_en: ...a sea of multicoloured umbrellas.

defs.def_en: A multicoloured object has many different colours.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 女高音歌手是个来自加利福尼亚的壮硕姑娘。
ext.ext_en: The soprano was a chunky girl from California.

defs.def_en: A chunky person is broad and heavy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她喜欢的小说是大部头的历史言情故事。
ext.ext_en: Her taste in fiction was for chunky historical romances.

ext.ext_cn: 厚实的套头毛衣
ext.ext_en: ...a chunky sweater.

defs.def_en: A chunky object is large and thick.

ext.ext_cn: 可怜的埃米莉，她的亲人应该到她这来。
ext.ext_en: Poor Emily. Her kinsfolk should come to her...

ext.ext_cn: 我把另一个儿子送到乡下和亲戚住在一起。
ext.ext_en: I sent my other son to the country to stay with kinfolk.

defs.def_en: Your kinsfolk or kinfolk are the people who are related to you.
A parrot is a tropical bird with a curved beak and brightly-coloured or grey feathers. Parrots can be kept as pets. Some parrots are able to copy what people say.

defs.def_cn: 机械地模仿；鹦鹉学舌般地重复

ext.ext_cn: 一代又一代学生学会了机械地重复这些标准解释。
ext.ext_en: Generations of students have learnt to parrot the standard explanations.

defs.def_en: If you disapprove of the fact that someone is just repeating what someone else has said, often without really understanding it, you can say that they are parroting it.
If you say that you feel as sick as a parrot, you feel very disappointed about something.

ext.ext_cn: 额外的收入意味着菲莉帕可以把房租的钱存起来。
ext.ext_en: The extra income has meant Phillippa can tuck away the rent...

ext.ext_cn: 我把盒子藏在放棉织品的抽屉里。
ext.ext_en: I tucked the box away in the linen drawer.

defs.def_en: If you tuck away something such as money, you store it in a safe place.

ext.ext_cn: 我们安全地藏在房间一个隐蔽的角落里。
ext.ext_en: We were tucked away in a secluded corner of the room...

ext.ext_cn: 他在贝克斯利的住宅坐落在一片小森林中。
ext.ext_en: His home in Bexley is tucked away in a miniature forest.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is tucked away, they are well hidden in a quiet place where very few people go.

ext.ext_cn: 医生和急救人员
ext.ext_en: ...doctors and paramedical staff.

defs.def_en: Paramedical workers and services help doctors and nurses in medical work.

ext.ext_cn: 我们全都溜到酒馆里去了。
ext.ext_en: We all decamped to the pub.

defs.def_en: If you decamp, you go away from somewhere secretly or suddenly.
A checkpoint is a place where traffic is stopped so that it can be checked.

ext.ext_cn: 吃一堑长一智，他这个教训来之不易——是从他自己的亲身经历中得来的。
ext.ext_en: He learned this lesson the hard way — from his own personal experience...

ext.ext_cn: 那是我的个人观点。
ext.ext_en: That's my personal opinion.

defs.def_en: A personal opinion, quality, or thing belongs or relates to one particular person rather than to other people.

ext.ext_cn: 经常需要本人亲自联系、打理的生意
ext.ext_en: ...a business that requires a great deal of personal contact.

ext.ext_cn: 总统秘书亲自寄出的信
ext.ext_en: ...a personal letter from the President's secretary...

defs.def_en: If you give something your personal care or attention, you deal with it yourself rather than letting someone else deal with it.

defs.def_cn: （感情、关系、健康方面）个人的，人际的，自己的

ext.ext_cn: 教导年轻人有关婚姻和人际关系方面的事情
ext.ext_en: ...teaching young people about marriage and personal relationships...

ext.ext_cn: 绝不要让个人问题影响你的表现。
ext.ext_en: You never allow personal problems to affect your performance...

defs.def_en: Personal matters relate to your feelings, relationships, and health.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 针对个人的；人身攻击的

ext.ext_cn: 报纸采取了人身攻击的手段。
ext.ext_en: Newspapers resorted to personal abuse...

ext.ext_cn: 迈拉批评我写的东西，她的批评多少有些人身攻击的味道。
ext.ext_en: Myra was attacking something I'd written, and her attack got a little personal.

defs.def_en: Personal comments refer to someone's appearance or character in an offensive way.

ext.ext_cn: 像女人一样不嫌麻烦打理个人卫生的男人
ext.ext_en: ...men who take as much trouble over personal hygiene as women.

defs.def_en: Personal care involves looking after your body and appearance.

ext.ext_cn: 他是一位我认识多年的私人朋友。
ext.ext_en: He was a personal friend whom I've known for many many years...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管我们各自背景不同，但我们还是很快从工作关系发展成了私下的好朋友。
ext.ext_en: What began as a professional relationship became a personal one pretty quickly, despite us coming from very different backgrounds.

defs.def_en: A personal relationship is one that is not connected with your job or public life.
Holly is an evergreen tree or shrub which has hard, shiny leaves with sharp points, and red berries in winter.

ext.ext_cn: 以前一直有人指责我们夸大事实，但遗憾的是，我们所有的报道都证明是真实的。
ext.ext_en: We have been accused of exaggerating before, but unfortunately all our reports proved to be true...

ext.ext_cn: 过去这一过渡过程常常很艰难。
ext.ext_en: In the past this process of transition has often proven difficult.

defs.def_en: If something proves to be true or to have a particular quality, it becomes clear after a period of time that it is true or has that quality.

ext.ext_cn: 你提出了这项控告。你拿出证据来！
ext.ext_en: You brought this charge. You prove it!...

ext.ext_cn: 结果证明对鲑鱼饲养行业的管理不够完善。
ext.ext_en: The results prove that regulation of the salmon farming industry is inadequate.

defs.def_en: If you prove that something is true, you show by means of argument or evidence that it is definitely true.

ext.ext_cn: 玛格丽特证明了自己是个好妈妈。
ext.ext_en: Margaret proved herself to be a good mother...

ext.ext_cn: 身为作曲家的他证明了自己在创作大型戏剧方面驾轻就熟。
ext.ext_en: As a composer he proved himself adept at large dramatic forms...

defs.def_en: If you prove yourself to have a certain good quality, you show by your actions that you have it.

defs.def_cn: 证明自己的能力（或知识）

ext.ext_cn: 他们绕行3,000英里只是为了证明自己能够做到。
ext.ext_en: They made a 3,000 mile detour simply to prove a point.

defs.def_en: If you prove a point, you show other people that you know something or can do something, although your action may have no other purpose.
A woman's fallopian tubes are the two tubes in her body along which eggs pass from her ovaries to her womb.

ext.ext_cn: 种甜玉米和甜菜的田地
ext.ext_en: ...fields of sweet corn and beet.

defs.def_en: See also:sugar beet;Beet is a crop with a thick round root. It is often used to feed animals, especially cows.
Beets are dark red roots that are eaten as a vegetable. They are often preserved in vinegar.
In North America, a singles bar is a bar where single people can go in order to drink and meet other single people.

defs.def_cn: 开玩笑地；闹着玩地；戏谑地

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉戏称她为“我的怪兽”。
ext.ext_en: Sarah jokingly called her 'my monster'...

ext.ext_cn: 她半开玩笑地冲他皱了皱眉。
ext.ext_en: She frowned at him, only half-jokingly.

defs.def_en: If you say or do something jokingly, you say or do it with the intention of amusing someone, rather than with any serious meaning or intention.

defs.def_cn: 保龄球(运动);十柱保龄球戏
defs.def_en: Ten-pin bowling is a game in which you try to knock down ten objects shaped like bottles by rolling a heavy ball towards them. It is usually played in a place called a bowling alley.

ext.ext_cn: 继续征求对你的工作的反馈意见。
ext.ext_en: Continue to ask for feedback on your work...

ext.ext_cn: 老板对我的评价很高。
ext.ext_en: I was getting great feedback from my boss.

defs.def_en: If you get feedback on your work or progress, someone tells you how well or badly you are doing, and how you could improve. If you get good feedback you have worked or performed well.
Feedback is the unpleasant high-pitched sound produced by a piece of electrical equipment when part of the signal that comes out goes back into it.

ext.ext_cn: 自制果酱
ext.ext_en: ...home-made jam.

defs.def_en: Jam is a thick sweet food that is made by cooking fruit with a large amount of sugar, and that is usually spread on bread.

ext.ext_cn: 他从地上捡起帽子，猛地扣到头上。
ext.ext_en: He picked his cap up off the ground and jammed it on his head...

ext.ext_cn: 皮特使劲把手插进口袋里。
ext.ext_en: Pete jammed his hands into his pockets.

defs.def_en: If you jam something somewhere, you push or put it there roughly.

defs.def_cn: （机器）卡住；使卡住；（使）不能运转

ext.ext_cn: 他开第二枪时枪卡壳了。
ext.ext_en: The second time he fired his gun jammed...

ext.ext_cn: 一根绳子卡住了船的螺旋桨。
ext.ext_en: A rope jammed the boat's propeller...

defs.def_en: If something such as a part of a machine jams, or if something jams it, the part becomes fixed in position and is unable to move freely or work properly.

ext.ext_cn: 数百名打算驾车离开的司机堵住了道路。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of departing motorists jammed the roads.

defs.def_en: If vehicles jam a road, there are so many of them that they cannot move.

ext.ext_cn: 数百人挤在木板人行道上观看。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of people jammed the boardwalk to watch...

ext.ext_cn: 他们挤上红十字会派来的巴士前往安全的地方。
ext.ext_en: They jammed into buses provided by the Red Cross and headed for safety.

defs.def_en: If a lot of people jam a place, or jam into a place, they are pressed tightly together so that they can hardly move.

defs.def_cn: 干扰（无线电或电子信号）

ext.ext_cn: 他们会试图用电子信号对发射进行干扰。
ext.ext_en: They will try to jam the transmissions electronically.

defs.def_en: To jam a radio or electronic signal means to interfere with it and prevent it from being received or heard clearly.

defs.def_cn: 使（电话总机）应接不暇；使（电话线）过于繁忙

ext.ext_cn: 在一个多小时内，成百上千的来电使得英国广播公司的总机应接不暇。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of callers jammed the BBC switchboard for more than an hour...

ext.ext_cn: 很多人想买季票，电话总机一天到晚忙个不停。
ext.ext_en: The telephone exchange has been jammed all day with people wanting to buy season tickets.

defs.def_en: If callers are jamming telephone lines, there are so many callers that the people answering the telephones find it difficult to deal with them all.

ext.ext_cn: 他们确实遇上麻烦了，鲍勃闷闷不乐地想。
ext.ext_en: They were in a real jam, Bob thought glumly.

defs.def_en: If someone is in a jam, they are in a very difficult situation.

defs.def_cn: （爵士乐手或摇滚乐手）即兴演奏

ext.ext_cn: 他在即兴吹奏萨克斯管。
ext.ext_en: He was jamming with his saxophone.

defs.def_en: When jazz or rock musicians are jamming, they are informally playing music that has not been written down or planned in advance.

defs.def_cn: 管理者;管理机构;调控者;调控机构

ext.ext_cn: 人们要求国会调查政府监管机构为何花了这么长时间才关闭该工厂。
ext.ext_en: Congress is being asked to investigate why it took so long for government regulators to shut the plant down...

ext.ext_cn: 将会指定一个独立的管理机构来保证公平竞争。
ext.ext_en: An independent regulator will be appointed to ensure fair competition.

defs.def_en: A regulator is a person or organization appointed by a government to regulate an area of activity such as banking or industry.

ext.ext_cn: 一个自动电压调节器保证了发电机电流输出的稳定。
ext.ext_en: An automatic voltage regulator ensured a constant output from the generator.

defs.def_en: A regulator is a device or mechanism that automatically controls something, such as the temperature in a room or the growth of a person's body.

defs.def_cn: 妨害公共利益的人（或行为）；社会公害；为公众厌恶的人

ext.ext_cn: 他在参与游行之后因妨害公共利益被判入狱45天
ext.ext_en: ...the 45-day jail sentence he received for causing a public nuisance after taking part in a demonstration...

ext.ext_cn: 在20世纪80年代，吸毒者在苏黎世是被众人所唾弃的。
ext.ext_en: Back in the 1980s drug users were a public nuisance in Zurich.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is, or causes, a public nuisance, they break the law by harming or annoying members of the public.

defs.def_cn: （绘画中圣人、天使头上的）光环，光轮
defs.def_en: A halo is a circle of light that is shown in pictures round the head of a holy figure such as a saint or angel.

ext.ext_cn: 环绕太阳有圈淡淡的光晕。
ext.ext_en: The sun had a faint halo round it...

ext.ext_cn: 她气鼓鼓地把头巾裹在头上，发髻都被压扁了。
ext.ext_en: She angrily slung a scarf around her head, flattening her halo of hair.

defs.def_en: A halo is a circle of light round a person or thing, or something that looks like a circle of light.

defs.def_cn: 震惊;惊愕;令人震惊的事

ext.ext_cn: 暴力程度令人震惊。
ext.ext_en: The extent of the violence came as a shock...

ext.ext_cn: 他从未从你哥哥去世的打击中恢复过来。
ext.ext_en: He has never recovered from the shock of your brother's death...

defs.def_en: If you have a shock, something suddenly happens which is unpleasant, upsetting, or very surprising.

ext.ext_cn: 那小男孩惊得说不出话来。
ext.ext_en: The little boy was speechless with shock...

ext.ext_cn: 她仍惊魂未定。
ext.ext_en: She's still in a state of shock.

defs.def_en: Shock is a person's emotional and physical condition when something very frightening or upsetting has happened to them.

ext.ext_cn: 发现他被打得休克了。
ext.ext_en: He was found beaten and in shock...

ext.ext_cn: 他们逃离了火海,却因休克而被迅速送往医院。
ext.ext_en: They escaped the blaze but were rushed to hospital suffering from shock.

defs.def_en: If someone is in shock, they are suffering from a serious physical condition in which their blood is not flowing round their body properly, for example because they have had a bad injury.

ext.ext_cn: 在警队呆了 40 年后，我对什么都见怪不怪了。
ext.ext_en: After forty years in the police force nothing much shocks me...

ext.ext_cn: 救援人员被眼前的景象惊呆了。
ext.ext_en: Relief workers were shocked by what they saw.

defs.def_en: If something shocks you, it makes you feel very upset, because it involves death or suffering and because you had not expected it.

defs.def_cn: (因行为粗鲁或不道德而)使不快，使气愤，使厌恶，使反感

ext.ext_cn: 我不会被你激怒的。
ext.ext_en: You can't shock me...

ext.ext_cn: 在那个年代，他们动不动就对一些事情看不顺眼。
ext.ext_en: They were easily shocked in those days...

defs.def_en: If someone or something shocks you, it upsets or offends you because you think it is rude or morally wrong.

defs.def_cn: (通告、事件等)令人惊愕的，令人震惊的

ext.ext_cn: 她将要辞职的惊人声明
ext.ext_en: ...the shock announcement that she is to resign.

ext.ext_cn: 令人震惊的落败
ext.ext_en: ...a shock defeat.

defs.def_en: A shock announcement or event is one which shocks people because it is unexpected.

defs.def_cn: (对经济、传统、生活方式的)冲击，撞击

ext.ext_cn: 这是一系列对斯堪的纳维亚银行系统的冲击中最近的一次。
ext.ext_en: This is the latest in a series of shocks to the Scandinavian banking system.

ext.ext_cn: 两次原油冲击下的经济萧条
ext.ext_en: ...the economic pain of two oil shocks.

defs.def_en: A shock is something sudden and unexpected that threatens the economy, traditions, or way of life of a group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 钢制栅栏可以弯曲并能吸收冲击力。
ext.ext_en: Steel barriers can bend and absorb the shock.

defs.def_en: A shock is the force of something suddenly hitting or pulling something else.
A shock is the same as an electric shock .

ext.ext_cn: 你认为我需要换新的减震器吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you think I need new shocks?

defs.def_en: A shock is a shock absorber .

ext.ext_cn: 满头白发、年事已高的神父
ext.ext_en: ...a very old priest with a shock of white hair.

defs.def_en: A shock of hair is a very thick mass of hair on a person's head.
A short, sharp shock is a punishment that is fairly harsh and severe but only lasts for a short time.

defs.def_cn: （用以酿制威士忌、啤酒和其他酒类的）麦芽

ext.ext_cn: 德国啤酒传统上只用4种原料——啤酒花、麦芽、酵母和水。
ext.ext_en: German beer has traditionally been made from just four ingredients — hops, malt, yeast and water.

defs.def_en: Malt is a substance made from grain that has been soaked in water and then dried in a hot oven. Malt is used in the production of whisky, beer, and other alcoholic drinks.
Malt is the same as malt whisky .

defs.def_cn: (用麦乳精与其他调味品制成的)麦乳精饮料
defs.def_en: A malt is a drink made from malted milk and sometimes other flavourings.

ext.ext_cn: 不要盲目听信银行家的话。
ext.ext_en: Don't just blindly follow what the banker says...

ext.ext_cn: 因为缺少足够的信息，许多学生都是近乎盲目地选择大学。
ext.ext_en: Without adequate information, many students choose a college almost blindly.

defs.def_en: See also:blind;If you say that someone does something blindly, you mean that they do it without having enough information, or without thinking about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 陡峭的石头地面排水性能很好。
ext.ext_en: The steep, stony ground is well drained.

ext.ext_cn: 碎石小路
ext.ext_en: ...a stony track.

defs.def_en: Stony ground is rough and contains a lot of stones.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (表情或态度)冷酷的，无情的，冰冷的

ext.ext_cn: 她看我的眼神冷酷无比。
ext.ext_en: She gave me the stoniest look I ever got...

ext.ext_cn: 他开车送我们回家，一路冷冰冰地一言不发。
ext.ext_en: He drove us home in stony silence.

defs.def_en: A stony expression or attitude does not show any sympathy or friendliness.

ext.ext_cn: 实行共和政体的国家
ext.ext_en: ...the nations that had adopted the republican form of government.

defs.def_en: Republican means relating to a republic. In republican systems of government, power is held by the people or the representatives that they elect.

defs.def_cn: (美国)共和党的，支持共和党的

ext.ext_cn: 支持共和党的选民们
ext.ext_en: ...Republican voters...

ext.ext_cn: 有些家庭世代都支持共和党。
ext.ext_en: Some families have been republican for generations.

defs.def_en: In the United States, if someone is Republican, they belong to or support the Republican Party.

defs.def_cn: (支持北爱尔兰脱离英国加入爱尔兰共和国的)共和主义者，共和派

ext.ext_cn: 共和派的准军事组织
ext.ext_en: ...a Republican paramilitary group.

ext.ext_en: ...a Northern Ireland republican.

defs.def_en: In Northern Ireland, if someone is Republican, they believe that Northern Ireland should not be ruled by Britain but should become part of the Republic of Ireland.

defs.def_cn: 高架桥下通道；地下通道；下穿交叉道

ext.ext_en: The Hanger Lane underpass was closed through flooding.

defs.def_en: An underpass is a road or path that goes underneath a railway or another road.

defs.def_cn: （分居或离婚后根据法院指令定期付给对方的）赡养费

ext.ext_cn: 杰夫的很大一部分钱都用在了向他的前三任妻子支付赡养费。
ext.ext_en: A great deal of Jeff's money went in alimony to his three former wives.

defs.def_en: Alimony is money that a court of law orders someone to pay regularly to their former wife or husband after they have got divorced.
Your pancreas is an organ in your body that is situated behind your stomach. It produces insulin and substances that help your body digest food.

ext.ext_cn: 听装沙丁鱼
ext.ext_en: ...tinned pilchards.

defs.def_en: Pilchards are small fish that live in the sea. Pilchards can be eaten as food.

ext.ext_cn: 他那些脍炙人口的爱情歌曲
ext.ext_en: ...his incomparably brilliant love songs...

ext.ext_cn: 与 20 世纪 80 年代初相比,英国工业如今处于相当好的状态。
ext.ext_en: British industry is in incomparably better shape than at the beginning of the 1980s.

defs.def_en: You can use incomparably to mean 'very much' when you are comparing two things and emphasizing the difference between them.
Common land is land which everyone is allowed to use.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 收入最低者过着只能勉强糊口的日子，没有医疗补助或其他福利。
ext.ext_en: The worst-paid live a hand-to-mouth existence without medical or other benefits.

ext.ext_en: ...penniless students living hand-to-mouth.

defs.def_en: A hand-to-mouth existence is a way of life in which you have hardly enough food or money to live on.
In boxing, a knockout is a situation in which a boxer wins the fight by making his opponent fall to the ground and be unable to stand up before the referee has counted to ten.

ext.ext_cn: 他给所有对手以致命一击。
ext.ext_en: He delivered a knockout blow to all of his rivals.

defs.def_en: A knockout blow is an action or event that completely defeats an opponent.

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲杯足球赛，一场欧洲顶级强队间的淘汰赛
ext.ext_en: ...the European Cup, a knockout competition between the top teams in Europe.

defs.def_en: A knockout competition is one in which the players or teams that win continue playing until there is only one winner left.

defs.def_cn: 迷人（或给人深刻印象）的人（或物）

ext.ext_cn: 她身着藏青色和鲜红色相间的衣服，十分迷人。
ext.ext_en: She was a knockout in navy and scarlet...

ext.ext_cn: 第一个故事让人印象深刻。
ext.ext_en: The first story is a knockout.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as a knockout, you think that they are extremely attractive or impressive.
A water cooler is a machine that dispenses drinking water, especially in an office.

defs.def_cn: 办公室，工作场所(用于表述在办公地点的闲聊)

ext.ext_cn: 每4名美国人中就有3人收看了电视剧《根》，转天他们会在办公室闲谈关于种族关系的话题。
ext.ext_en: Three out of four Americans watched Roots, and then the next day could talk about race relations at the water cooler.

defs.def_en: Water cooler is used in expressions that refer to the informal conversations that people have in their office or workplace.

defs.def_cn: 帕尔马干酪（意大利烹调中常用的浓味硬干酪）
defs.def_en: Parmesan or Parmesan cheese is a hard cheese with a strong flavour which is often used in Italian cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 我敲了敲前门，没有人应。
ext.ext_en: I knocked at the front door, but there was no answer...

ext.ext_cn: 警察打开门朝里面看。
ext.ext_en: The policeman opened the door and looked in...

defs.def_en: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

ext.ext_cn: 她从厨房门口朝里看，发现女儿站在炉子旁。
ext.ext_en: She looked through the door of the kitchen. Her daughter was at the stove.

defs.def_en: A door is the space in a wall when a door is open.

defs.def_cn: (商店、宾馆、戏院等的)进口，入口

ext.ext_cn: 他从正门进入了哈罗德商场。
ext.ext_en: He entered Harrods by the main door...

ext.ext_cn: 门口的队伍绕了大楼一圈。
ext.ext_en: The queues at the door wound around the building.

defs.def_en: The door is the entrance to a large building such as a shop, hotel, or theatre.

ext.ext_cn: 凯德夫人的房子和她女儿的公寓就隔了几户人家。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Cade's house was only a few doors down from her daughter's apartment.

defs.def_en: Doors is used in expressions such as a few doors down or three doors up to refer to a place that is a particular number of buildings away from where you are.

ext.ext_cn: 我一敲门，卡萝尔就来开了。
ext.ext_en: Carol answered the door as soon as I knocked.

defs.def_en: When you answer the door, you go and open the door because a visitor has knocked on it or rung the bell.

defs.def_cn: 偷偷摸摸地;背地里地;不正当地

ext.ext_cn: 政府不会允许任何人偷偷混进来并用暴力攫取政权。
ext.ext_en: The government would not allow anyone to sneak in by the back door and seize power by force...

ext.ext_cn: 他们声称政府正通过不正当的手段将牙医业私有化。
ext.ext_en: They claim the Government is privatising dentistry through the back door.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone gets or does something by the back door or through the back door, you are criticizing them for doing it secretly and unofficially.

defs.def_cn: 不再想;不再做;拒…于门外

ext.ext_cn: 我们从不把成功的系列节目拒之门外。
ext.ext_en: We never close the door on a successful series.

defs.def_en: If someone closes the door on something, they stop thinking about it or dealing with it.

ext.ext_cn: 背地里秘密作出的决定
ext.ext_en: ...decisions taken in secret behind closed doors.

defs.def_en: If people have talks and discussions behind closed doors, they have them in private because they want them to be kept secret.

ext.ext_cn: 他们挨家挨户地向百姓收钱。
ext.ext_en: They are going from door to door collecting money from civilians.

ext.ext_cn: 上门推销员
ext.ext_en: ...a door-to-door salesman...

defs.def_en: If someone goes from door to door or goes door to door, they go along a street calling at each house in turn, for example selling something.

ext.ext_cn: 全程票
ext.ext_en: ...tickets covering the whole journey from door to door...

ext.ext_cn: 星期五从盖特威克起飞全程需要 7 个小时。
ext.ext_en: Flying out on Friday from Gatwick it took seven hours door-to-door.

defs.def_en: If you talk about a distance or journey from door to door or door to door, you are talking about the distance from the place where the journey starts to the place where it finishes.

defs.def_cn: （通常指难以成功的领域中）迈向目标的第一步，成功的开端

ext.ext_cn: 债券的持有可能是有助于该公司赢得业务的第一步。
ext.ext_en: The bondholding may help the firm get its foot in the door to win the business...

ext.ext_cn: 与飞利浦公司的交易也使斯巴克得以进入一个新市场——消费类电子产品。
ext.ext_en: The Philips deal also gives Sparc a foot in the door of a new market — consumer electronics.

defs.def_en: If you say that something helps someone to get their foot in the door or their toe in the door, you mean that it gives them an opportunity to start doing something new, usually in an area that is difficult to succeed in.

defs.def_cn: 拒绝同…谈话;拒绝向…透露信息

ext.ext_cn: 你跟他说什么了吗，还是直接给了他个闭门羹？
ext.ext_en: Did you say anything to him or just shut the door in his face?

defs.def_en: If someone shuts the door in your face or slams the door in your face, they refuse to talk to you or give you any information.

ext.ext_cn: 我不确信他的死亡单单是药物所致。
ext.ext_en: I'm notsure his death can be laid at medicine's door alone...

ext.ext_cn: 通常谴责的矛头都会指向政府。
ext.ext_en: The blame is generally laid at the door of the government.

defs.def_en: If you lay something at someone'sdoor, you blame them for an unpleasant event or situation.

defs.def_cn: 介绍(新思想或新情况);使…成为可能

ext.ext_cn: 这本书介绍了固态物理中一些最激动人心的发现。
ext.ext_en: This book opens the door to some of the most exciting findings in solid-state physics...

ext.ext_cn: 研究者们拓展了其研究领域，介绍并揭示了事物发生的原因和机理。
ext.ext_en: Researchers are pushing back the frontiers and opening doors to reveal why things happen and how things work.

defs.def_en: If someone or something opens the door to a good new idea or situation, they introduce it or make it possible.

ext.ext_cn: 天气太好了，适合户外工作。
ext.ext_en: The weather was fine enough for working out of doors.

defs.def_en: When you are out of doors, you are not inside a building, but in the open air.
If you see someone to the door, you go to the door with a visitor when they leave.

ext.ext_cn: 他们会既往不咎吗——还是会对他下逐客令呢？
ext.ext_en: Would they forgive and forget — or show him the door?

defs.def_en: If someone shows you the door, they ask you to leave because they are angry with you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我坚决反对任何形式的恐怖主义。
ext.ext_en: I am utterly opposed to any form of terrorism...

ext.ext_cn: 我们强烈反对美国在该地区的存在。
ext.ext_en: We are strongly opposed to the presence of America in this region.

defs.def_en: If you are opposed to something, you disagree with it or disapprove of it.

defs.def_cn: 对立的；对抗的；相对的；相反的

ext.ext_cn: 提出与他几乎截然相反的政策的人
ext.ext_en: ...people with policies almost diametrically opposed to his own...

ext.ext_cn: 这是完全对立的目标之间的正面冲突。
ext.ext_en: This was a straight conflict of directly opposed aims.

defs.def_en: You say that two ideas or systems are opposed when they are opposite to each other or very different from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 我们是在餐厅吃的饭，而不是在小饭馆。
ext.ext_en: We ate in the restaurant, as opposed to the bistro.

defs.def_en: You use as opposed to when you want to make it clear that you are talking about one particular thing and not something else.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有根据的;正当的;合理的

ext.ext_cn: 他们提出了很多不出口的正当理由。
ext.ext_en: They put forward many valid reasons for not exporting...

ext.ext_cn: 我们有理由认为记忆是最原始的心智技能，所有其他技能都在此基础上衍生出来。
ext.ext_en: It is valid to consider memory the oldest mental skill, from which all others derive...

defs.def_en: A valid argument, comment, or idea is based on sensible reasoning.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 大多数设计者都认同这样一种不言而明的理念，即时尚是视觉艺术的一种重要形式。
ext.ext_en: Most designers share the unspoken belief that fashion is a valid form of visual art.

defs.def_en: Something that is valid is important or serious enough to make it worth saying or doing.

ext.ext_cn: 出国度假需持有效护照。
ext.ext_en: For foreign holidays you will need a valid passport...

ext.ext_cn: 所有的票在两个月内有效。
ext.ext_en: All tickets are valid for two months.

defs.def_en: If a ticket or other document is valid, it can be used and will be accepted by people in authority.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Wives is the plural of wife .

defs.def_cn: 对…起平衡作用;抗衡;抵消

ext.ext_cn: 加点蜂蜜来调和酸味。
ext.ext_en: Add honey to counterbalance the acidity...

ext.ext_cn: 他有着族长式的慷慨大方，同时却又冷漠无情。
ext.ext_en: His patriarchal generosity is counterbalanced by his ruthlessness.

defs.def_en: To counterbalance something means to balance or correct it with something that has an equal but opposite effect.

defs.def_cn: 起平衡作用的事物;抗衡力；抵消因素

ext.ext_cn: 为抗衡非国大联盟而成立的一些组织
ext.ext_en: ...organisations set up as a counterbalance to groups allied to the ANC.

defs.def_en: Something that is a counterbalance to something else counter-balances that thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 精明的；狡黠的;头脑灵活的

ext.ext_cn: 他非常精明,不会冒险暴露自己。
ext.ext_en: He was far too canny to risk giving himself away...

ext.ext_cn: 精明的投资者需要预计到美元何时会再次大跌。
ext.ext_en: A canny investor would need to predict when the dollar will once more start tumbling...

defs.def_en: A canny person is clever and able to think quickly. You can also describe a person's behaviour as canny .
Palm oil is a yellow oil which comes from the fruit of certain palm trees and is used in making soap and sometimes as a fat in cooking.

defs.def_cn: （常放在比萨饼中的）意大利辣肠
defs.def_en: Pepperoni is a kind of spicy sausage which is often sliced and put on pizzas.
A beaver is a furry animal with a big flat tail and large teeth. Beavers use their teeth to cut wood and build dams in rivers.

ext.ext_cn: 大河狸领外套
ext.ext_en: ...a coat with a huge beaver collar.

defs.def_en: Beaver is the fur of a beaver.

ext.ext_cn: 这就是为什么英国航空公司主席科林·马歇尔爵士一直如此热衷于购买美国航空公司的股票。
ext.ext_en: This is why Sir Colin Marshall, British Airways' chairman, has been so keen to buy shares in US-AIR...

ext.ext_cn: 有那么几个月，股票价格一直非常地稳定。
ext.ext_en: For some months the share price remained fairly static.

defs.def_en: A company's shares are the many equal parts into which its ownership is divided. Shares can be bought by people as an investment.

ext.ext_cn: 他兄弟二人从父亲那里继承的一小笔遗产
ext.ext_en: ...the small income he had shared with his brother from his father's estate...

ext.ext_cn: 两名美国人将共同摘得今年的诺贝尔医学奖。
ext.ext_en: Two Americans will share this year's Nobel Prize for Medicine...

defs.def_en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or occupy it. You can also say that two people share something.

defs.def_cn: 共同承担，分担，分摊(任务、责任等)

ext.ext_cn: 你可以弄清楚他们是否愿意和你一起分担买花的费用。
ext.ext_en: You can find out whether they are prepared to share the cost of the flowers with you...

ext.ext_cn: 一些共和国已经制订出共同控制核武器的计划。
ext.ext_en: The republics have worked out a plan for sharing control of nuclear weapons.

defs.def_en: If you share a task, duty, or responsibility with someone, you each carry out or accept part of it. You can also say that two people share something.

defs.def_cn: 分享，共同拥有(同样的经历)

ext.ext_cn: 是的，我想和你共度一生。
ext.ext_en: Yes, I want to share my life with you...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得我们两个有着共同的失落感，经受着同样的痛苦。
ext.ext_en: I felt we both shared the same sense of loss, felt the same pain.

defs.def_en: If you share an experience with someone, you have the same experience, often because you are with them at the time. You can also say that two people share something.

ext.ext_cn: 我们同意他的观点，认为商业可以是促进变革的一种积极力量。
ext.ext_en: We share his view that business can be a positive force for change...

ext.ext_cn: 经济繁荣昌盛一直是各国普遍追求的共同目标。
ext.ext_en: Prosperity and economic success remain popular and broadly shared goals.

defs.def_en: If you share someone's opinion, you agree with them.

defs.def_cn: 共同具有(某种品质和特点);和…有共同之处

ext.ext_cn: 和英国的某些报纸风格相似的一些报纸
ext.ext_en: ...newspapers which share similar characteristics with certain British newspapers.

ext.ext_cn: 说同一种语言的两个人群
ext.ext_en: ...two groups who share a common language.

defs.def_en: If one person or thing shares a quality or characteristic with another, they have the same quality or characteristic. You can also say that two people or things share something.

ext.ext_cn: 村里的部落很友善，他们会和你一起分享水源。
ext.ext_en: The village tribe is friendly and they share their water supply with you...

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们现在为了资金不得不相互竞争，互相之间也不会共享信息。
ext.ext_en: Scientists now have to compete for funding, and do not share information among themselves...

defs.def_en: If you share something that you have with someone, you give some of it to them or let them use it.

defs.def_cn: 向…诉说,与…分享(想法、消息等)

ext.ext_cn: 向自己信任的人倾诉感情是很有益处的。
ext.ext_en: It can be beneficial to share your feelings with someone you trust...

ext.ext_cn: 影评家鲍勃·蒙德洛和大家分享他对电影《希望之城》的看法。
ext.ext_en: Film critic Bob Mondello shares his thoughts on the movie 'City of Hope'.

defs.def_en: If you share something personal such as a thought or a piece of news with someone, you tell them about it.

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉也分摊燃气费、电费和电话费。
ext.ext_en: Sara also pays a share of the gas, electricity and phone bills...

ext.ext_cn: 他正期望着能赢得一些席位，或许还能成为马其顿新政府的一员。
ext.ext_en: He is counting on winning seats and perhaps a share in the new government of Macedonia.

defs.def_en: If something is divided or distributed among a number of different people or things, each of them has, or is responsible for, a share of it.

defs.def_cn: 应得的一份;应做的一份

ext.ext_cn: 女性必须获得她们理应得到的高薪工作培训。
ext.ext_en: Women must receive their fair share of training for good-paying jobs...

ext.ext_cn: 我已经有了太多丰富多彩的历险。
ext.ext_en: I have had more than my full share of adventures.

defs.def_en: If you have or do your share of something, you have or do an amount that seems reasonable to you, or to other people.

ext.ext_cn: 从今以后，选票数量未达到总数5%的党派将不能在议会里占有席位。
ext.ext_en: Henceforth, parties which fail to get 5% of the vote will not be represented in parliament...

ext.ext_cn: 我们被正式警告从此不得进入基地后终于获得了释放。
ext.ext_en: We were finally released with a formal warning that we were henceforth barred from the base.

defs.def_en: Henceforth means from this time onwards.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天一颗威力巨大的炸弹在贝尔法斯特市中心爆炸，引起一片混乱并造成严重破坏。
ext.ext_en: A huge bomb blast brought chaos and devastation to the centre of Belfast yesterday.

defs.def_en: Devastation is severe and widespread destruction or damage.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 未受影响的；未被改变的

ext.ext_cn: 她所喝的似乎对她没有丝毫影响。
ext.ext_en: She seemed totally unaffected by what she'd drunk...

ext.ext_cn: 罢工迫使50个机场关闭，但大部分国际航班并未受到影响。
ext.ext_en: The strike shut down 50 airports, but most international flights were unaffected.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is unaffected by an event or occurrence, they are not changed by it in any way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不矫揉造作的；自然的；率真的

ext.ext_cn: 这对率真迷人的夫妇
ext.ext_en: ...this unaffected, charming couple.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as unaffected, you mean that they are natural and genuine in their behaviour, and do not act as though they are more important than other people.

ext.ext_cn: 佩内洛普走上前拥抱了她妹妹。
ext.ext_en: Penelope came forward and embraced her sister...

ext.ext_cn: 起初人们几乎是喜极而泣，并互相拥抱。
ext.ext_en: At first people were sort of crying for joy and embracing each other...

defs.def_en: If you embrace someone, you put your arms around them and hold them tightly, usually in order to show your love or affection for them. You can also say that two people embrace .

defs.def_cn: 欣然接受，支持（变革、政治体制、观点等）

ext.ext_cn: 他迎接新的信息时代的到来。
ext.ext_en: He embraces the new information age...

ext.ext_cn: 政府监察机构已经欣然接受了这些新规则。
ext.ext_en: The new rules have been embraced by government watchdog organizations.

defs.def_en: If you embrace a change, political system, or idea, you accept it and start supporting it or believing in it.

ext.ext_cn: 将囊括人类活动的各个领域的理论
ext.ext_en: ...a theory that would embrace the whole field of human endeavour.

ext.ext_cn: 这两个曾经友好的国家之间关系的恶化
ext.ext_en: ...a worsening in relations between the two previously friendly countries.

defs.def_en: You can describe another country or their government as friendly when they have good relations with your own country rather than being an enemy.

ext.ext_cn: 进化过程
ext.ext_en: ...an evolutionary process.

ext.ext_cn: 演变时期
ext.ext_en: ...a period of evolutionary change.

defs.def_en: Evolutionary means relating to a process of gradual change and development.

ext.ext_cn: 很多野生动物园都时常遭到偷猎之徒的侵入。
ext.ext_en: Many wildlife parks are regularly invaded by people poaching game.

defs.def_en: If someone poaches fish, animals, or birds, they illegally catch them on someone else's property.

defs.def_cn: 挖（其他机构的成员或顾客）

ext.ext_en: ...allegations that it had poached members from other unions.

defs.def_en: If an organization poaches members or customers from another organization, they secretly or dishonestly persuade them to join them or become their customers.

ext.ext_en: The opposition parties complained that the government had poached their ideas.

defs.def_en: If someone poaches an idea, they dishonestly or illegally use the idea.

ext.ext_en: Poach the eggs for 4 minutes...

ext.ext_en: He had a light breakfast of poached eggs and tea.

defs.def_en: When you poach an egg, you cook it gently in boiling water without its shell.

defs.def_cn: （在煮沸的水、牛奶或其他液体中）用文火煮，煨（鱼等食品）

ext.ext_cn: 用文火把鸡肉煮到刚刚熟。
ext.ext_en: Poach the chicken until just cooked.

ext.ext_cn: 红酒煨的梨
ext.ext_en: ...a pear poached in red wine...

defs.def_en: If you poach food such as fish, you cook it gently in boiling water, milk, or other liquid.

defs.def_cn: 无可辩驳的;不容置疑的;无可否认的

ext.ext_en: We have incontrovertible evidence of what took place.

defs.def_en: Incontrovertible evidence or facts are absolutely certain and cannot be shown to be wrong.
A woman who is corseted is wearing a corset.

ext.ext_en: Ricardo Bofill, the Catalan architect, has designed the revamped airport.

defs.def_en: If someone revamps something, they make changes to it in order to try and improve it.

defs.def_cn: (通过考试获得的)资格，学历;资格考试

ext.ext_cn: 将鼓励他们在取得优秀学习成绩的同时也要获得一定的职业资质。
ext.ext_en: They will be encouraged to mix academic A-levels with vocational qualifications...

ext.ext_en: Lucy wants to study medicine but needs more qualifications.

defs.def_en: Your qualifications are the examinations that you have passed.

defs.def_cn: (通过考试后)取得资格，合格，达到标准

ext.ext_cn: 通过资格考试认证之后，他做了一名社会工作者。
ext.ext_en: Following qualification, he worked as a social worker.

defs.def_en: Qualification is the act of passing the examinations you need to work in a particular profession.

defs.def_cn: （完成某项活动或任务所需的）素质，技能，资历

ext.ext_cn: 有责任感、值得信赖是必备的素质。
ext.ext_en: Responsibility and reliability are necessary qualifications...

ext.ext_cn: 我和他曾经相处过一段时间，所以才能写出这本书。
ext.ext_en: That time with him is my qualification to write this book.

defs.def_en: The qualifications you need for an activity or task are the qualities and skills that you need to be able to do it.

ext.ext_en: The empirical evidence considered here is subject to many qualifications...

ext.ext_cn: 这份陈述需要进行限定和澄清。
ext.ext_en: This statement requires qualification and clarification.

defs.def_en: A qualification is a detail or explanation that you add to a statement to make it less strong or less general.
A turbo-charged engine or vehicle is fitted with a turbo.
A magnifying glass is a piece of glass which makes objects appear bigger than they actually are.

ext.ext_cn: 我们是自己命运的主宰者。
ext.ext_en: We are masters of our own destiny...

ext.ext_en: It is my destiny one day to be king.

defs.def_en: A person's destiny is everything that happens to them during their life, including what will happen in the future, especially when it is considered to be controlled by someone or something else.

ext.ext_cn: 人们的相遇是天意还是偶然？
ext.ext_en: Is it destiny that brings people together, or is it accident?

defs.def_en: Destiny is the force which some people believe controls the things that happen to you in your life.
A protractor is a flat, semi-circular piece of plastic or metal which is used for measuring angles.

ext.ext_cn: 带天鹅绒领子的炭灰色外套
ext.ext_en: ...a charcoal-gray overcoat with a velvet collar...

ext.ext_en: She looked pretty and rather fragile, dressed in black velvet.

defs.def_en: Velvet is soft material made from cotton, silk, or nylon, which has a thick layer of short cut threads on one side.

ext.ext_en: He gained a first class Honours degree in economics.

defs.def_en: See also:home economics;Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

ext.ext_en: He is regarded as a committed supporter of a radical free-market economics policy.

ext.ext_cn: 第三世界的经济体制
ext.ext_en: ...the economics of the third world.

defs.def_en: The economics of a society or industry is the system of organizing money and trade in it.

ext.ext_cn: 本届会议严格说来达到了法定人数。
ext.ext_en: The session was technically quorate.

defs.def_en: When a committee is quorate, there are enough people present for it to conduct official business and make decisions.

ext.ext_cn: 英国政府对细节讳莫如深。
ext.ext_en: The British government has thrown a blanket of secrecy over the details...

ext.ext_cn: 他秘密进行交易。
ext.ext_en: He shrouds his business dealings in secrecy.

defs.def_en: Secrecy is the act of keeping something secret, or the state of being kept secret.

ext.ext_cn: 晚上，年轻人喜欢聚集在放映美国电影的电影院外面。
ext.ext_en: Youngsters love to congregate here in the evenings outside cinemas showing American films...

ext.ext_cn: 每周日下午，游客成群结队地来看公开展览。
ext.ext_en: Visitors congregated on Sunday afternoons to view public exhibitions.

defs.def_en: When people congregate, they gather together and form a group.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_cn: （讲演或写作）含轶事的，多轶闻的

ext.ext_en: Gray's book is anecdotal and entertaining.

defs.def_en: Anecdotal speech or writing is full of anecdotes or is based on anecdotes.

ext.ext_en: If it had hit the Earth, it would have made a crater 100 miles across and thrown up an immense cloud of dust.

defs.def_en: If you say that a building or structure is thrown up, you mean that it is built or made very quickly, usually so that it is not of very good quality.

ext.ext_en: The political struggle threw up a strong leader...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as bland, you mean that they are rather dull and unexciting.

ext.ext_en: Shopkeepers were taping up their windows.

ext.ext_en: His company has the best pension scheme in the industry.

ext.ext_cn: 他们之间的分歧依然未能解决，他对此并不感到沮丧。
ext.ext_en: He is not disappointed at the failure to make headway towards resolving their differences...

ext.ext_cn: 警方在调查中未能取得什么进展，对此市民有些担心。
ext.ext_en: There was concern in the city that police were making little headway in the investigation.

defs.def_en: If you make headway, you progress towards achieving something.

ext.ext_cn: 他说话口齿不清。
ext.ext_en: He speaks with a lisp...

ext.ext_en: When speaking to the seminar Mr Franklin spoke of his experience, gained on a recent visit to Trinidad...

ext.ext_en: He's determined to speak at the Democratic Convention...

ext.ext_en: He said it was the job of the Church to speak for the underprivileged...

ext.ext_en: I speak for all 7,000 members of our organization...

defs.def_en: If you speak for a group of people, you make their views and demands known, or represent them.

ext.ext_en: Many of them can speak two or three or more languages.

defs.def_en: If you speak a foreign language, you know the language and are able to have a conversation in it.

ext.ext_en: In the book she speaks of his  “social ineptitude” and says he verbally abused her...

ext.ext_en: St Paul speaks of the body as the 'temple of the Holy Spirit'.

defs.def_en: People sometimes mention something that has been written by saying what the author speaks of .

ext.ext_cn: 因为母亲和前妻仍旧保持着友好的关系，他便不再和母亲说话。
ext.ext_en: He is not speaking to his mother because of her friendship with his ex-wife...

ext.ext_cn: 两位联袂主演的明星仍然互不理睬。
ext.ext_en: The co-stars are still not speaking.

defs.def_en: If two people are not speaking, they no longer talk to each other because they have quarrelled.

ext.ext_cn: 他的举止流露出早熟的痕迹。
ext.ext_en: His behaviour spoke of an early maturity...

ext.ext_cn: 长车身和高档配置无不象征着财富。
ext.ext_en: The length of the car and the high polish of its fittings both spoke of money...

defs.def_en: If you say that something speaks to you of a quality, experience, or feeling, you mean that it is evidence of it or expresses it.

ext.ext_cn: 这些数字本身就说明了问题——订单订购量低，国内销售前景惨淡，出口形势日趋恶化。

ext.ext_cn: 结局不言自明。
ext.ext_en: The results speak for themselves.

defs.def_en: If you say that something speaks for itself, you mean that its meaning or quality is so obvious that it does not need explaining or pointing out.

defs.def_cn: 你说的只是你的看法;这只是你的高见

ext.ext_en: 'We're not blaming you,' Kate said. 'Speak for yourself,' Boris muttered.

defs.def_en: If you say 'Speak for yourself' when someone has said something, you mean that what they have said is only their opinion or applies only to them.

defs.def_cn: 已被预订;早已订购;已经许给别人

ext.ext_cn: 她可能会在谈话的时候不着痕迹地对她的“未婚夫”作些评论，这样他便会认为她已经名花有主了。

ext.ext_en: 'Any fresh developments?' — 'Nothing to speak of.'

defs.def_en: Nothing to speak of means 'hardly anything' or 'only unimportant things'.

ext.ext_en: I ought not to tell you but I will, since you're in the family, so to speak...

ext.ext_en: The five countries have now all passed, so to speak, their entry test.

ext.ext_cn: 很久以来，她的母亲和外婆两人之间几乎不怎么说话。
ext.ext_en: For a long time her mother and her grandmother had hardly been on speaking terms.

defs.def_en: If you are on speaking terms with someone, you are quite friendly with them and often talk to them.

defs.def_cn: 潜水钟(内储空气，人可在其中进行水下工作)
