defs.def_cn: （红毛）猩猩（产于婆罗洲和苏门答腊）
defs.def_en: An orang-utan is an ape with long reddish hair that comes from Borneo and Sumatra.

defs.def_cn: 匆促忙乱的;杂乱无章的

ext.ext_cn: 他乱糟糟的生活中现在又面临着另一个危机。

ext.ext_cn: 它提倡将所有商贷机构排除在高校贷款计划之外。
ext.ext_en: It calls for the exclusion of all commercial lending institutions from the college loan program...

ext.ext_cn: 一些排除因素和限制条件比较适用。
ext.ext_en: Certain exclusions and limitations apply.

defs.def_en: The exclusion of something is the act of deliberately not using, allowing, or considering it.

ext.ext_cn: 在政治权力上对女性的排斥
ext.ext_en: ...women's exclusion from political power...

ext.ext_cn: 普雷斯科特先生的发言人昨天表明他对于自己被拒绝十分不满。
ext.ext_en: A spokeswoman for Mr Prescott yesterday made it clear that he had been unhappy at his exclusion.

defs.def_en: Exclusion is the act of preventing someone from entering a place or taking part in an activity.

ext.ext_cn: 黛安娜一生都在照顾他，对其他一切都无暇顾及。
ext.ext_en: Diane had dedicated her life to caring for him to the exclusion of all else.

defs.def_en: If you do one thing to the exclusion of something else, you only do the first thing and do not do the second thing at all.

defs.def_cn: 夸大…的重要性；过分强调

ext.ext_cn: 夸大经济危机的严重性
ext.ext_en: ...overplaying the depth of the economic crisis...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为历史因素被过分强调了，它实际上并不太重要。
ext.ext_en: I think the historical factor is overplayed, that it really doesn't mean much.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is overplaying something such as a problem, you mean that they are making it seem more important than it really is.

ext.ext_cn: 美国必须谨防高估自身实力。
ext.ext_en: The United States has to be careful it doesn't overplay its hand.

defs.def_en: If someone overplays their hand, they act more confidently than they should because they believe that they are in a stronger position than they actually are.
A pick-up or a pick-up truck is a small truck with low sides that can be easily loaded and unloaded.

ext.ext_cn: 房地产市场的回暖
ext.ext_en: ...a pick-up in the housing market...

ext.ext_cn: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。
ext.ext_en: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.

defs.def_en: A pick-up in trade or in a country's economy is an improvement in it.

ext.ext_cn: 这家公司在大部分城市都有提货点。
ext.ext_en: The company had pick-up points in most cities...

ext.ext_cn: 火车从滑铁卢站出发，途中会在阿什福德站停靠上人。
ext.ext_en: Trains will operate from Waterloo with a pick-up stop at Ashford.

defs.def_en: A pick-up takes place when someone picks up a person or thing that is waiting to be collected.

defs.def_cn: （以发生性关系为目的的）搭识，搭讪

ext.ext_cn: 他们已来到了世界上最著名的调情场所。
ext.ext_en: They had come to the world's most famous pick-up joint.

defs.def_en: When a pick-up takes place, someone talks to a person in a friendly way in the hope of having a casual sexual relationship with them.

ext.ext_cn: 在竞选运动中当选总统的最好提议之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the president-elect's best proposals during the campaign.

defs.def_en: The president-elect is the person who has been elected as the president of an organization or country, but who has not yet taken office.

ext.ext_cn: 这一运动新近自封的领导者们
ext.ext_en: ...the new self-appointed leaders of the movement.

defs.def_en: A self-appointed leader or ruler has taken the position of leader or ruler without anyone else asking them or choosing them to have it.

defs.def_cn: (使)发出拨弦声;(使)发出嘣的一声

ext.ext_cn: 坐在教室后面弹橡皮筋的这些人
ext.ext_en: ...people who sat at the back of class and twanged an elastic band...

ext.ext_cn: 他的吉他发出一声仿佛木尺弹在课桌上的噪音。
ext.ext_en: His guitar makes a noise like a wooden ruler being twanged upon a desk…

defs.def_en: If you twang something such as a tight string or elastic band, or if it twangs, it makes a fairly loud, ringing sound because it has been pulled and then released.

ext.ext_cn: 他说话时的鼻音
ext.ext_en: …the nasal twang of his voice.

ext.ext_cn: 她浓重的澳大利亚鼻音
ext.ext_en: ...her broad Australian twang.

defs.def_en: A twang is a quality in someone's way of speaking in which sound seems to be coming through the nose.

ext.ext_cn: 我们将定期在那里会面。
ext.ext_en: We're going to be meeting there on a regular basis...

ext.ext_cn: 女性成员轮流准备茶水。
ext.ext_en: The tea is prepared on a rota basis by the lady members...

defs.def_en: If something is done on a particular basis, it is done according to that method, system, or principle.

ext.ext_cn: 根据我们收到的病历报告，麦格雷戈的行动仍然必须受到限制。
ext.ext_en: McGregor must remain confined, on the basis of the medical reports we have received...

ext.ext_cn: 鉴于认识到问题的存在就相当于把它解决了一半，马尔卡希昨天的那番话应该会受到欢迎。
ext.ext_en: On the basis that recognising the problem is halfway to a solution, Mulcahy's comments yesterday should be well received.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are acting on the basis of something, you are giving that as the reason for your action.

ext.ext_cn: 双方大致同意联合国的计划可能成为谈判的基础。
ext.ext_en: Both factions have broadly agreed that the UN plan is a possible basis for negotiation.

ext.ext_cn: 构成地球上几乎所有物质的基础的亚原子粒子
ext.ext_en: ...the subatomic particles that form the basis of nearly all matter on earth.

defs.def_en: The basis of something is its starting point or an important part of it from which it can be further developed.

ext.ext_cn: 日本试图找到向海外派兵的法律依据
ext.ext_en: ...Japan's attempt to secure the legal basis to send troops overseas...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个没有事实依据的常见谬误。
ext.ext_en: This is a common fallacy which has no basis in fact.

defs.def_en: The basis for something is a fact or argument that you can use to prove or justify it.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然她病得很重，但病情正开始趋于稳定。
ext.ext_en: Although her illness is serious, her condition is beginning to stabilize...

ext.ext_cn: 官员们希望此举能使汇率稳定下来。
ext.ext_en: Officials hope the move will stabilize exchange rates...

defs.def_en: If something stabilizes, or is stabilized, it becomes stable.

ext.ext_cn: 专门招待英国侨民的乡间俱乐部
ext.ext_en: ...exclusive country clubs for British expats.

defs.def_en: An expat is the same as an expatriate .

ext.ext_cn: 为了看看首都，再多个一两天也是值的。
ext.ext_en: It is also worth tagging on an extra day or two to see the capital...

ext.ext_cn: 约翰逊为其添加了个圆满的结尾，并将标题改作《生活从 8:30 开始》。
ext.ext_en: Johnson tagged on a happy ending and changed the title to 'Life Begins at 8:30'.

defs.def_en: If you tag something on, you add it.

ext.ext_cn: 阿蒂对大多数女人都漠不关心。
ext.ext_en: Artie treated most women with indifference...

ext.ext_cn: 警方称他们正把它当作一起谋杀未遂案件来处理。
ext.ext_en: Police say they're treating it as a case of attempted murder...

defs.def_en: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 医生用阿司匹林为她治疗。
ext.ext_en: Doctors treated her with aspirin...

ext.ext_cn: 那个男孩因头部轻伤接受了治疗。
ext.ext_en: The boy was treated for a minor head wound...

defs.def_en: When a doctor or nurse treats a patient or an illness, he or she tries to make the patient well again.

ext.ext_cn: 大约 70% 的可可树林地喷过杀虫剂。
ext.ext_en: About 70% of the cocoa acreage is treated with insecticide...

ext.ext_cn: 很多年以后这个城市才开始处理污水。
ext.ext_en: It was many years before the city began to treat its sewage.

defs.def_en: If something is treated with a particular substance, the substance is put onto or into it in order to clean it, to protect it, or to give it special properties.

ext.ext_cn: 她总是请他吃冰激凌。
ext.ext_en: She was always treating him to ice cream...

ext.ext_cn: 明天我将犒劳一下自己——享受一天的园艺乐趣。
ext.ext_en: Tomorrow I'll treat myself to a day's gardening...

defs.def_en: If you treat someone to something special which they will enjoy, you buy it or arrange it for them.

ext.ext_cn: 莱蒂每次从城里回来都必定会给他带点特别的礼物。
ext.ext_en: Lettie had never yet failed to return from town without some special treat for him.

defs.def_en: If you give someone a treat, you buy or arrange something special for them which they will enjoy.
If you say that something is your treat, you mean that you are paying for it as a treat for someone else.

ext.ext_cn: 计划的第一部分天衣无缝。
ext.ext_en: The first part of the plan works a treat...

ext.ext_cn: 杏会非常好吃。
ext.ext_en: The apricots would go down a treat.

defs.def_en: If you say, for example, that something looks or works a treat, you mean that it looks very good or works very well.

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个让人讨厌的小东西。
ext.ext_en: He was a nasty little blighter.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone you do not like as a blighter .

ext.ext_cn: 幸运的家伙，金想。
ext.ext_en: Lucky blighter, thought King.

defs.def_en: You can use blighter as an informal way of referring to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 他瞄准那名男子的脑门正中开了一枪。
ext.ext_en: He aimed for the center of the man's head and squeezed off a single round.

defs.def_en: If you squeeze off a shot, you fire a bullet from a gun.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不乐意的；不情愿的；勉强的

ext.ext_cn: 她不愿放弃好不容易得来的自由。
ext.ext_en: She is loath to give up her hard-earned liberty...

ext.ext_cn: 新任财政部长似乎不愿削减所得税。
ext.ext_en: The new finance minister seems loth to cut income tax.

defs.def_en: If you are loath to do something, you do not want to do it.

defs.def_cn: 炫耀胜利(或成功)；耀武扬威

ext.ext_cn: 这一活动有一点炫耀胜利的意味。
ext.ext_en: There was a touch of triumphalism about the occasion.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to behaviour which celebrates a great victory or success as triumphalism, especially when this behaviour is intended to upset the people they have defeated.

ext.ext_cn: 一堆堆卖不出去的书
ext.ext_en: ...piles of unsold books...

ext.ext_cn: 佳士得13%的硬币和纸币拍卖流拍。
ext.ext_en: Thirteen per cent of Christie's coin and banknote auction went unsold.

defs.def_en: Unsold goods have been available for people to buy but nobody has bought them.

ext.ext_cn: 整本选集有着惊人的连贯性。
ext.ext_en: The anthology has a surprising sense of coherence.

defs.def_en: Coherence is a state or situation in which all the parts or ideas fit together well so that they form a united whole.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 有关他对女王不敬的指责
ext.ext_en: ...accusations that he had been disrespectful to the Queen...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不能这样无礼地对待亲生母亲。
ext.ext_en: They shouldn't treat their mother in this disrespectful way.

defs.def_en: If you are disrespectful, you show no respect in the way that you speak or behave to someone.

ext.ext_cn: 这是外国，与圣何塞很不一样。
ext.ext_en: This was a foreign country, so unlike San Jose...

ext.ext_cn: 她除了那双乌黑的眼睛外，跟他没有一点儿相像。
ext.ext_en: She was unlike him in every way except for her coal black eyes.

defs.def_en: If one thing is unlike another thing, the two things have different qualities or characteristics from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 散步不像有氧健身操那样需要交纳昂贵的费用来参加健身班或俱乐部。
ext.ext_en: Unlike aerobics, walking entails no expensive fees for classes or clubs.

defs.def_en: You can use unlike to contrast two people, things, or situations, and show how they are different.

defs.def_cn: 与…平时不同；不像…平常那样

ext.ext_cn: 他一反常态用如此强烈的语气说出那番话，着实让我吃惊。
ext.ext_en: It was so unlike him to say something like that, with such intensity, that I was astonished...

ext.ext_cn: “我们都会被抓的！” 托马斯大声嚷道，跟平时的他判若两人。
ext.ext_en: 'We'll all be arrested!'  Thomas yelled, which was most unlike him.

defs.def_en: If you describe something that a particular person has done as being unlike them, you mean that you are surprised by it because it is not typical of their character or normal behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 绝大多数建筑中可能会全面禁止吸烟。
ext.ext_en: Smoking might be banned totally in most buildings...

ext.ext_cn: 两国有可能交战。
ext.ext_en: The two countries might go to war...

defs.def_en: You use might to indicate that something will possibly happen or be true in the future, but you cannot be certain.

ext.ext_cn: 她和西蒙的父亲还没有放弃他或许还活着的希望。
ext.ext_en: She and Simon's father had not given up hope that he might be alive...

ext.ext_cn: 你或许是对的。
ext.ext_en: You might be right...

defs.def_en: You use might to indicate that there is a possibility that something is true, but you cannot be certain.

ext.ext_cn: 如果制造的汽车方向盘是装在右边的，美国可能会在这些岛屿卖出更多的汽车。
ext.ext_en: America might sell more cars to the islands if they were made with the steering wheel on the right.

ext.ext_cn: 那种可能会登上时装杂志的人
ext.ext_en: ...the type of person who might appear in a fashion  magazine.

defs.def_en: You use might to indicate that something could happen or be true in particular circumstances.

defs.def_cn: 可能(表示已经发生或过去某件事可能属实，但不确定；有时用于对某事提供一种可能的解释)

ext.ext_cn: 我听见了一声巨响，可能是爆炸声。
ext.ext_en: I heard what might have been an explosion...

ext.ext_cn: 她想这次枪击可能是一次意外。
ext.ext_en: She thought the shooting might have been an accident...

defs.def_en: You use might have with a past participle to indicate that it is possible that something hap-pened or was true, or when giving a possible explanation for something.

ext.ext_cn: 如果她当时不得不放弃骑自行车的话，她或许就从事她很有优势的帆船运动了。
ext.ext_en: If she had had to give up riding she might have taken up sailing competitively...

ext.ext_cn: 如果炸弹投在了该市人口密集的地区，那损失就大了。
ext.ext_en: Had the bomb dropped over a populated area of the city, there might have been a great deal of damage...

defs.def_en: You use might have with a past participle to indicate that something was a possibility in the past, although it did not actually happen.

defs.def_cn: 可能，也许(表示虽然接受某一事实，但将其与更为重要的方面对比)

ext.ext_cn: 他也许是个很无聊的人，可是却像黄鼠狼一样机灵。
ext.ext_en: He might be a bore, but he was as quick-witted as a weasel...

ext.ext_cn: 他们也许穷得叮当响，但他们至少拥有一种不同的生活方式。
ext.ext_en: They might not have two cents to rub together, but at least they have a kind of lifestyle that is different.

defs.def_en: You use might in statements where you are accepting the truth of a situation, but contrasting it with something that is more important.

defs.def_cn: 应该(强调某人应该做某事，尤指对某人未做某事感到气愤)

ext.ext_cn: 我不在的时候，你打扫一下厨房总该可以吧。
ext.ext_en: And while I'm out you might clean up the kitchen...

ext.ext_cn: 你之前应该告诉我那件事情！
ext.ext_en: You might have told me that before!

defs.def_en: You use might when you are saying emphatically that someone ought to do the thing mentioned, especially when you are annoyed because they have not done it.

defs.def_cn: 可以，不妨(用于委婉提出建议或忠告)

ext.ext_cn: 他们不妨停止在电视上做广告，这样做可能是明智之举。
ext.ext_en: They might be wise to stop advertising on television...

ext.ext_cn: 你可以到街那头的加油站试试。
ext.ext_en: You might try the gas station down the street...

defs.def_en: You use might to make a suggestion or to give advice in a very polite way.

defs.def_cn: 可不可以，能否(用于礼貌地打断别人、提出问题、做出请求或引出接下来要说的话)

ext.ext_cn: 我能否提个建议？
ext.ext_en: Might I make a suggestion?...

ext.ext_cn: 我可不可以问一下，您在这里干什么？
ext.ext_en: Might I ask what you're doing here?...

defs.def_en: You use might as a polite way of interrupting someone, asking a question, making a request, or introducing what you are going to say next.

defs.def_cn: （表示接下来的陈述并不令人惊讶）可以，能够(预料)

ext.ext_cn: “简怎么样？”她问道。——“如你所料，情况不好。”
ext.ext_en: 'How's Jan?' she asked. — 'Bad. As you might expect.'...

ext.ext_cn: 和想象中的一样，这些司机对此并不太在意。
ext.ext_en: The drivers, as you might imagine, didn't care much for that.

defs.def_en: You use might in expressions such as as you might expect and as you might imagine in order to indicate that the statement you are making is not surprising.

defs.def_cn: 我可以这么说(表示强调接下来的陈述)

ext.ext_cn: 亲戚们不断打电话过来，不客气地说，他们并非全都出于最好的动机。
ext.ext_en: Relatives ring up constantly, not always for the best motives, I might add...

ext.ext_cn: 可以这么说，这并没有令我大吃一惊。
ext.ext_en: It didn't come as a great surprise to me, I might say.

defs.def_en: You use might in expressions such as I might add and I might say in order to emphasize a statement that you are making.

defs.def_cn: 我早该知道/我早该猜到(表示对某件令人失望的事情或情况并不吃惊)

ext.ext_cn: 我早该知道你会跟哪个小娼妇在一起。
ext.ext_en: I might have known I'd find you with some little slut...

ext.ext_cn: “我特别厌恶杂乱无章，你是知道的。”——“我可不知道，不过我早该猜到了。”
ext.ext_en: 'I detest clutter, you know.' — 'I didn't know, but I might have guessed.'

defs.def_en: You use might in expressions such as I might have known and I might have guessed to indicate that you are not surprised at a disappointing event or fact.

ext.ext_cn: 军事力量可能会成为决定性的因素。
ext.ext_en: The might of the army could prove a decisive factor.

defs.def_en: Might is power or strength.

ext.ext_cn: 她使出全身力气抡起榔头砸向他的脑袋。
ext.ext_en: She swung the hammer at his head with all her might.

defs.def_en: If you do something with all your might, you do it using all your strength and energy.

ext.ext_cn: 她父亲在一次严重的心脏病发作后坠入海中。
ext.ext_en: Her father fell into the sea after a massive heart attack...

ext.ext_cn: 查尔斯王子又一次从马上摔了下来。
ext.ext_en: Prince Charles has again fallen from his horse...

defs.def_en: If someone or something falls, they move quickly downwards onto or towards the ground, by accident or because of a natural force.

ext.ext_cn: 这个女人抓住丈夫的肩膀，以免摔倒。
ext.ext_en: The woman gripped the shoulders of her man to stop herself from falling...

ext.ext_cn: 我们看到一幢幢大楼倒塌，砸在人和宠物身上。
ext.ext_en: We watched buildings fall on top of people and pets...

defs.def_en: If a person or structure that is standing somewhere falls, they move from their upright position, so that they are then lying on the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 风力在一些地方达到了每小时 100 英里，15 分钟内降雨量达一英寸。
ext.ext_en: Winds reached up to 100mph in some places with an inch of rain falling within 15 minutes.

ext.ext_cn: 有一天晚上下了一场大雪。
ext.ext_en: One night there was a heavy fall of snow.

defs.def_en: See also:rainfall;snowfall;When rain or snow falls, it comes down from the sky.

defs.def_cn: (常因疲乏)一头倒下，一下躺倒

ext.ext_cn: 他疲惫至极，扯下衣服，一头倒在床上。
ext.ext_en: Totally exhausted, he tore his clothes off and fell into bed...

ext.ext_cn: 早晨，我只走到沙发那儿，就一下子倒在上面。
ext.ext_en: In the morning I got as far as the sofa and fell on to it.

defs.def_en: If you fall somewhere, you allow yourself to drop there in a hurried or disorganized way, often because you are very tired.

defs.def_cn: (数量)减少;(价值)下降;(力量)减弱

ext.ext_cn: 产量将减少 6％。
ext.ext_en: Output will fall by 6%...

ext.ext_cn: 她的体重减到了 7 英石以下。
ext.ext_en: Her weight fell to under seven stones...

defs.def_en: If something falls, it decreases in amount, value, or strength.

ext.ext_cn: 政府将因失去其占多数的优势而有倒台的危险。
ext.ext_en: There's a danger of the government falling because it will lose its majority...

ext.ext_cn: 撒切尔夫人倒台的那一刻在世人的记忆中留下了永久的印痕。
ext.ext_en: The moment Mrs Thatcher fell from power has left a lasting imprint on the world's memory.

defs.def_en: If a powerful or successful person falls, they suddenly lose their power or position.

ext.ext_cn: 克罗地亚军队从波斯尼亚北部撤军后，该地区落入塞尔维亚人手里。
ext.ext_en: Croatian army troops retreated from northern Bosnia and the area fell to the Serbs...

ext.ext_cn: 随着一声宣告：“帕福斯陷落啦！”，聚集在一起的士兵爆发出一阵欢呼声。
ext.ext_en: With the announcement 'Paphos has fallen!' a cheer went up from the assembled soldiers.

defs.def_en: If a place falls in a war or election, an enemy army or a different political party takes control of it.

ext.ext_cn: 又一批士兵跟着第一批士兵从阵亡者身边跑过。
ext.ext_en: Another wave of troops followed the first, running past those who had fallen.

defs.def_en: If someone falls in battle, they are killed.

ext.ext_cn: 去佛罗里达观光而不爱上这个州几乎不可能。
ext.ext_en: It is almost impossible to visit Florida without falling in love with the state...

ext.ext_cn: 《致富》债务缠身，被另一家公司收购。
ext.ext_en: 'Business to Business' was taken over by another company after it fell into debt...

defs.def_en: You can use fall to show that someone or something passes into another state. For example, if someone falls ill, they become ill, and if something falls into disrepair, it is then in a state of disrepair.

ext.ext_cn: 问题大致分成两类。
ext.ext_en: The problems generally fall into two categories...

ext.ext_cn: 两个女人都属于高危人群。
ext.ext_en: Both women fall into the highest-risk group.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone falls into a particular group or category, you mean that they belong in that group or category.

ext.ext_cn: 那由联合国高级难民署的地方分部负责。
ext.ext_en: That responsibility falls on the local office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees...

ext.ext_cn: 照料孩子的重担落在了女性身上。
ext.ext_en: A vastly disproportionate burden falls on women for child care...

defs.def_en: If the responsibility or blame for something falls on someone, they have to take the responsibility or the blame for it.

ext.ext_cn: 公交车被拦住了，警察检查身份证时，乘客们鸦雀无声。
ext.ext_en: The bus was stopped and silence fell on the passengers as the police checked identity cards.

defs.def_en: If silence or a feeling of sadness or tiredness falls on a group of people, they become silent, sad, or tired.

defs.def_cn: (庆典或特别事件)在，适逢(某日)

ext.ext_cn: 适逢复活节后第一个星期天的名字古怪的“卸白衣主日”
ext.ext_en: ...the oddly named Quasimodo Sunday which falls on the first Sunday after Easter.

defs.def_en: If a celebration or other special event falls on a particular day or date, it happens to be on that day or date.

ext.ext_cn: 南希从眼角的余光里看见突然有个影子落在门道上。
ext.ext_en: Nancy, out of the corner of her eye, saw the shadow that suddenly fell across the doorway.

defs.def_en: When light or shadow falls on something, it covers it.

ext.ext_cn: 一个身材颀长的男孩儿，黑发垂在额上
ext.ext_en: ...a slender boy with black hair falling across his forehead.

defs.def_en: If someone's hair or a garment falls in a certain way, it hangs downwards in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 他把花放在桌上时，目光落在一张写有格雷斯笔迹的字条上。
ext.ext_en: As he laid the flowers on the table, his eye fell upon a note in Grace's handwriting.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's eyes fell on something, you mean they suddenly noticed it.

ext.ext_cn: 屋外夜幕降临，他们坐到长桌旁开始吃饭。
ext.ext_en: As darkness fell outside, they sat down to eat at long tables.

defs.def_en: When night or darkness falls, night begins and it becomes dark.

ext.ext_cn: 瀑布的全景
ext.ext_en: ...panoramic views of the falls.

ext.ext_cn: 尼亚加拉瀑布
ext.ext_en: ...Niagara Falls.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a waterfall as the falls .

ext.ext_cn: 1991 年秋他当选为法官。
ext.ext_en: He was elected judge in the fall of 1991...

ext.ext_cn: 最高法院将于明年秋开始审理此案。
ext.ext_en: The Supreme Court will not hear the case until next fall.

defs.def_en: Fall is the season between summer and winter when the weather becomes cooler.

defs.def_cn: 人类堕落(基督教中指亚当、夏娃违反戒律，被上帝逐出伊甸园)
defs.def_en: In the Christian religion, the Fall was the occasion when Adam and Eve sinned and God made them leave the Garden of Eden.

defs.def_cn: (摔跤中)双肩着地;(柔道中)体落
defs.def_en: In some sports such as judo and wrestling, a fall is the act of throwing or forcing your opponent to the floor.

defs.def_cn: (板球中，三柱门)失陷(指击球员出局)

ext.ext_cn: 最后 7 次三柱门失陷得了10分。
ext.ext_en: The last seven wickets fell for ten runs.

defs.def_en: In cricket, when a wicket falls, the team who are fielding get one of the batsmen out.

ext.ext_cn: 他身旁的书偶然翻开到写着圣保罗对罗马人的告诫那页。
ext.ext_en: By chance the book beside him fell open to St. Paul's warning to the Romans...

ext.ext_cn: 她提着的篮子忽然打开了。
ext.ext_en: The basket that she was carrying fell open.

defs.def_en: If something falls open, it opens accidentally.

defs.def_cn: 卖力;煞费苦心;不遗余力

ext.ext_cn: 他尸骨未寒，还是那些人又大肆谴责起他来。
ext.ext_en: Within days of his death those same people were falling over themselves to denounce him.

defs.def_en: If you say that people are falling over themselves to do something, you mean that they are very enthusiastic about doing it, and often that you disapprove of this.

defs.def_cn: fall to pieces (英国英语中作 fall to bits) 同 fall apart

ext.ext_cn: 就在那一刻，无线电遥控器摔得粉碎。
ext.ext_en: At that point the radio handset fell to pieces.

defs.def_en: To fall to pieces, or in British English to fall to bits, means the same as to fall apart .

ext.ext_cn: 工程一直没有完工，于是楼一点点地坍塌了。
ext.ext_en: The work was never finished and bit by bit the building fell apart.

defs.def_en: If something falls apart, it breaks into pieces because it is old or badly made.

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲货币体系正在走向瓦解。
ext.ext_en: Europe's monetary system is falling apart...

ext.ext_cn: 我已竭尽所能去维系我们的婚姻。
ext.ext_en: I've tried everything to stop our marriage falling apart.

defs.def_en: If an organization or system falls apart, it becomes disorganized or unable to work effectively, or breaks up into its different parts.

ext.ext_cn: 我要崩溃了，我一直都没合眼。
ext.ext_en: I was falling apart. I wasn't getting any sleep.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is falling apart, you mean that they are becoming emotionally disturbed and are unable to think calmly or to deal with the difficult or unpleasant situation that they are in.

ext.ext_cn: 官员们说飞机起飞后不久就有一两台引擎脱落了。
ext.ext_en: Officials say that one or two engines fell away from the plane shortly after takeoff.

defs.def_en: If something falls away from the thing it is attached to, it breaks off.

ext.ext_cn: 跑道两侧都是很陡的斜坡。
ext.ext_en: On either side of the tracks the ground fell away sharply.

defs.def_en: If you say that land falls away, you mean it slopes downwards from a particular point.

defs.def_cn: (程度)降低，减弱;(数量、规模)减少，减小

ext.ext_cn: 他的联盟也许会占绝对多数，但这种优势可能会很快丧失。
ext.ext_en: His coalition may hold a clear majority but this could quickly fall away...

ext.ext_cn: 需求开始减少。
ext.ext_en: Demand began to fall away.

defs.def_en: If the degree, amount, or size of something falls away, it decreases.

ext.ext_cn: 看见罗斯的光头，他尴尬地后退了几步。
ext.ext_en: He fell back in embarrassment when he saw that Ross had no hair at all...

ext.ext_cn: 教堂会众在他们进来时稍稍往后退了退。
ext.ext_en: The congregation fell back from them slightly as they entered.

defs.def_en: If you fall back, you move backwards a short distance away from someone or something.

ext.ext_cn: 普鲁士驻沙勒罗瓦的部队正在撤退。
ext.ext_en: The Prussian garrison at Charleroi was falling back.

defs.def_en: If an army falls back during a battle or war, it withdraws.

ext.ext_cn: 伊万斯得了风湿热，没去上课，功课也落下了。
ext.ext_en: Evans had rheumatic fever, missed school and fell behind...

ext.ext_cn: 鲍里斯落后于所有顶级选手。
ext.ext_en: Boris is falling behind all the top players.

defs.def_en: If you fall behind, you do not make progress or move forward as fast as other people.

ext.ext_cn: 他没能按时付款，面临着失去房子的危险。
ext.ext_en: He faces losing his home after falling behind with the payments...

ext.ext_cn: 因救援工作远远没有跟上，数千人可能面临死亡。
ext.ext_en: Thousands of people could die because the relief effort has fallen so far behind...

defs.def_en: If you fall behind with something or let it fall behind, you do not do it or produce it when you should, according to an agreement or schedule.

ext.ext_cn: 服务态度极佳，效率也蛮高，仅在一个小地方不尽人意。
ext.ext_en: Service was outstandingly friendly and efficient, falling down on only one detail...

ext.ext_cn: 这是他论点的薄弱之处。
ext.ext_en: That is where his argument falls down.

defs.def_en: If an argument, organization, or person falls down on a particular point, they are weak or unsatisfactory on that point.

ext.ext_cn: 他帅极了——我一下子就爱上了他。
ext.ext_en: He was fantastically handsome — I just fell for him right away.

defs.def_en: If you fall for someone, you are strongly attracted to them and start loving them.

defs.def_cn: 上…的当;受…的骗;对…信以为真

ext.ext_cn: 那不过是为了骗你到这儿来的一句谎言，你居然信了！
ext.ext_en: It was just a line to get you out here, and you fell for it!

ext.ext_cn: 我告诉他我会考虑，然后跟他要电话号码。他并没有上当。
ext.ext_en: I told him I would think about it and asked for his telephone number. He didn't fall for that one.

defs.def_en: If you fall for a lie or trick, you believe it or are deceived by it.

ext.ext_cn: 我卧室的天花板有些地方塌下来了。
ext.ext_en: Part of my bedroom ceiling has fallen in.

defs.def_en: If a roof or ceiling falls in, it collapses and falls to the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 普伦蒂斯看见戈斯走在密探身后。
ext.ext_en: Prentice saw Goss fall in behind the informer.

defs.def_en: If you fall in behind or beside someone who is walking along, you start walking behind them or beside them.

defs.def_cn: 赞成，接受(思想、计划、体系)

ext.ext_cn: 卡门不愿接受德赖弗的计划，由此引来了麻烦。
ext.ext_en: Carmen's reluctance to fall in with Driver's plans led to trouble.

defs.def_en: If you fall in with an idea, plan, or system, you accept it and do not try to change it.

ext.ext_cn: 在大学里，泰勒曾经频繁参与一个文学小团体的活动。
ext.ext_en: At university, Taylor had fallen in with a small clique of literature students.

defs.def_en: If you fall in with someone, you become friends with them and start seeing them a lot.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你的排气管脱落，应将其更换。
ext.ext_en: When your exhaust falls off, you have to replace it.

defs.def_en: If something falls off, it separates from the thing to which it was attached and moves towards the ground.

defs.def_cn: (程度)降低，减弱;(数量、规模)减少

ext.ext_cn: 失业率再次上升，零售品购买量下降。
ext.ext_en: Unemployment is rising again and retail buying has fallen off.

defs.def_en: See also:falling-off;If the degree, amount, or size of something falls off, it decreases.

ext.ext_cn: 由于放疗，她开始掉头发。
ext.ext_en: Her hair started falling out as a result of radiation treatment.

defs.def_en: If something such as a person's hair or a tooth falls out, it comes out.

ext.ext_cn: 她与丈夫闹翻了。
ext.ext_en: She fell out with her husband...

ext.ext_cn: 我和妈妈过去经常争吵。
ext.ext_en: Mum and I used to fall out a lot.

defs.def_en: If you fall out with someone, you have an argument and stop being friendly with them. You can also say that two people fall out .

defs.def_cn: (责任、职责、机会)落到…的头上;应由…做

ext.ext_cn: 他很不走运，机会一次也没有落到他头上。
ext.ext_en: He's been very unlucky that no chances have fallen to him.

ext.ext_cn: 由我来负责摆脱他们。
ext.ext_en: It fell to me to get rid of them.

defs.def_en: If a responsibility, duty, or opportunity falls to someone, it becomes their responsibility, duty, or opportunity.

ext.ext_cn: 她走后，他们便互相打了起来。
ext.ext_en: When she had departed, they fell to fighting among themselves.

defs.def_en: If someone falls to doing something, they start doing it.

ext.ext_cn: 镀铬消防配件
ext.ext_en: ...chromium-plated fire accessories.

defs.def_en: Chromium is a hard, shiny metallic element, used to make steel alloys and to coat other metals.
A cucumber is a long thin vegetable with a hard green skin and wet transparent flesh. It is eaten raw in salads.

defs.def_cn: (尤指意料之外地)非常冷静，泰然自若

ext.ext_cn: 达罗不慌不忙、大摇大摆地走进来，索要几千英镑，这跟你一点关系都没有。
ext.ext_en: You can hardly be held responsible for Darrow waltzing in, cool as a cucumber, and demanding thousands of pounds.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is as cool as a cucumber, you are emphasizing that they are very calm and relaxed, especially when you would not expect them to be.

ext.ext_en: ...tough monetarist policies.

defs.def_en: Monetarist policies or views are based on the theory that the amount of money that is available and in use in a country at any one time should be controlled.
A clergyman is a male member of the clergy.

A reflector is a type of telescope which uses a mirror that is shaped like a ball.

ext.ext_cn: 缀满各色小饰物的圣诞树
ext.ext_en: ...Christmas trees decorated with coloured baubles.

defs.def_en: A bauble is a small, cheap ornament or piece of jewellery.

ext.ext_cn: 短期资金净流出额大约为5,000万英镑。
ext.ext_en: There was a net outflow of about £50m in short-term capital.

ext.ext_cn: 越来越多出逃的难民
ext.ext_en: ...an increasing outflow of refugees.

defs.def_en: When there is an outflow of money or people, a large amount of money or people move from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你常读《家和花园》杂志的话，就会知道它是一个多么宝贵的灵感源泉。
ext.ext_en: If you are a regular reader of Homes & Gardens you will know what an invaluable source of inspiration it is...

ext.ext_cn: 这些文章使读者对中国人的思维有了深层次的认识。
ext.ext_en: These texts give the reader an insight into the Chinese mind.

defs.def_en: The readers of a newspaper, magazine, or book are the people who read it.

defs.def_cn: 爱读书的人；有读书习惯的人

ext.ext_cn: 多亏了那份工作我才成了一个喜欢阅读的人。
ext.ext_en: Thanks to that job I became an avid reader...

ext.ext_en: Their books are loved by young readers the world over.

defs.def_en: A reader is a person who reads, especially one who reads for pleasure.
A reader is a person who reads books for a publisher in order to give an opinion on whether they should be published or not.

defs.def_cn: （英国大学中仅次于教授的）高级讲师

ext.ext_cn: 约翰·史蒂文森是谢菲尔德大学的历史学高级讲师。
ext.ext_en: John Stevenson is Reader in History at the University of Sheffield.

defs.def_en: In British universities, a reader is a senior lecturer, with a rank just below that of a professor.
In American universities and colleges, a reader is an assistant to a teacher. Readers' duties include reading and marking examination papers and other work.

defs.def_cn: （帮助阅读或学习外语的）读本，读物
defs.def_en: A reader is a book to help children to learn to read, or to help people to learn a foreign language. It contains passages of text, and often exercises to give practice in reading and writing.
Momma means the same as mommy .

ext.ext_cn: 卡达雷的书仅有一小部分译成了英文。
ext.ext_en: Only a small number of Kadare's books have been translated into English...

ext.ext_cn: 马丁·路德把《圣经》译成了德语。
ext.ext_en: Martin Luther translated the Bible into German...

defs.def_en: If something that someone has said or written is translated from one language into another, it is said or written again in the second language.

ext.ext_cn: 家人为他起的广东话绰号意思是Never Sits Still(从来坐不住)。
ext.ext_en: His family's Cantonese nickname for him translates as Never Sits Still.

defs.def_en: If a name, a word, or an expression translates as something in a different language, that is what it means in that language.

ext.ext_cn: 重整华沙停滞的经济需要强硬措施，这会造成工作岗位的裁减。
ext.ext_en: Reforming Warsaw's stagnant economy requires harsh measures that would translate into job losses...

ext.ext_cn: 你的决定必须转化为具体明确的行动。
ext.ext_en: Your decision must be translated into specific, concrete actions.

defs.def_en: If one thing translates or is translated into another, the second happens or is done as a result of the first.

ext.ext_cn: “我爱他”经常解释为“有他总比没有强”。
ext.ext_en: 'I love him' often translates as 'He's better than nothing'...

ext.ext_cn: 我把这点理解为想把每个艾滋病病毒携带者都关起来的疯狂欲望。
ext.ext_en: I translated this as a mad desire to lock up every single person with HIV.

defs.def_en: If you say that a remark, a gesture, or an action translates as something, or that you translate it as something, you decide that this is what its significance is.

defs.def_cn: 将…制成表格;以表格形式排列

ext.ext_cn: 搜集信息、列表和分析数据的各种方法
ext.ext_en: ...methods of collecting, tabulating and analysing numerical data...

ext.ext_en: Results for the test program haven't been tabulated.

defs.def_en: To tabulate information means to arrange it in columns on a page so that it can be analysed.

ext.ext_cn: 他正在组建一个4人小队，包括和自己同名的儿子小托尼·奥赖利。
ext.ext_en: He is putting together a four-man team, including his son and namesake Tony o'Reilly Jnr...

ext.ext_cn: 桑利斯的圣母院不如在巴黎与其同名的圣母院有名。
ext.ext_en: Notre-Dame Cathedral in Senlis is less famous than its namesake in Paris.

defs.def_en: Someone's or something's namesake has the same name as they do.

ext.ext_en: Oxford United have transfer-listed two midfield players.

defs.def_en: If a football club transfer-lists a player, it puts their name on the transfer list.

ext.ext_cn: 拉森有时会和大家一起玩乐，但是显得更加矜持。
ext.ext_en: Larsson sometimes joined in the fun, but with more discretion...

ext.ext_cn: 他欣赏他的谨慎和忠诚。
ext.ext_en: He appreciated his discretion and his fidelity.

defs.def_en: Discretion is the quality of behaving in a quiet and controlled way without drawing attention to yourself or giving away personal or private information.

defs.def_cn: 自行决定的自由;酌情决定权

ext.ext_cn: 这个委员会可能想行使其自行决定权来调查那些指控。
ext.ext_en: This committee may want to exercise its discretion to look into those charges...

ext.ext_cn: 学校管理者有权允许家长们在特殊情况下让学生退学。
ext.ext_en: School governors have the discretion to allow parents to withdraw pupils in exceptional circumstances.

defs.def_en: If someone in a position of authority uses their discretion or has the discretion to do something in a particular situation, they have the freedom and authority to decide what to do.

ext.ext_en: We may vary the limit at our discretion and will notify you of any change...

ext.ext_cn: 凡账单上没收服务费的，是否付小费由你自己决定。
ext.ext_en: Where there are no service charges added to the bill, tip at your discretion...

defs.def_en: If something happens at someone's discretion, it can happen only if they decide to do it or give their permission.

defs.def_cn: 谨慎即大勇;勇敢贵在审慎
defs.def_en: If you say discretion is the better part of valour, you mean that avoiding a dangerous or unpleasant situation is sometimes the most sensible thing to do.

defs.def_cn: 使胆怯;使惊呆;使惊慌失措

ext.ext_en: Big concert halls do not faze Melanie...

ext.ext_cn: 知道我是同性恋者后，他没有丝毫惊慌失措。
ext.ext_en: He wasn't a bit fazed by the fact that I was gay.

defs.def_en: If something fazes you, it surprises, shocks, or frightens you, so that you do not know what to do.

ext.ext_en: They are both nice people but can be rather dull...

ext.ext_en: I felt she found me boring and dull...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.

ext.ext_en: The body's natural rhythms mean we all feel dull and sleepy between 1 and 3pm.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is dull is not very lively or energetic.

ext.ext_en: The stamp was a dull blue colour.

ext.ext_en: The soil drains freely and slugs aren't a problem.

ext.ext_en: Wash the leeks thoroughly and allow them to drain.

ext.ext_en: Tony built his own house and laid his own drains.

ext.ext_en: As his energy drained away, his despair and worry grew...

defs.def_en: If energy drains or is drained from you, you lose all energy and become very tired.

defs.def_en: If you say that a country's or a company's resources or finances are drained, you mean that they are used or spent completely.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is going down the drain, you mean that it is being destroyed or wasted.

defs.def_cn: (人)混合的，混杂的，形形色色的

ext.ext_cn: 我发现这群人各不相同，有些人还合得来，我能够理解，其他那些则和我几乎没有共同之处。
ext.ext_en: I found a very mixed group of individuals some of whom I could relate to and others with whom I had very little in common...

ext.ext_cn: 这个社区的成员非常复杂，尤其是因为这里有许多小型的工业企业。
ext.ext_en: The community is very mixed, not least because there are plenty of small industrial enterprises.

defs.def_en: A mixed group of people consists of people of many different types.

ext.ext_cn: 混血女子
ext.ext_en: ...a woman of mixed race...

ext.ext_cn: 她曾在一所由多种族学生组成的学校读书。
ext.ext_en: She had attended a racially mixed school.

defs.def_en: Mixed is used to describe something that involves people from two or more different races.

defs.def_cn: 男女同校的;男女合住的

ext.ext_cn: 一直上男女混合学校的女孩知道如何去维护自己的利益。
ext.ext_en: Girls who have always been at a mixed school know how to stand up for themselves...

ext.ext_cn: 这个温泉有6个室内池子，其中2个仅供女士，2个仅供男士，其余2个可以男女共用。
ext.ext_en: The spa has 6 indoor pools, 2 for women only, 2 for men only, and 2 for mixed bathing.

defs.def_en: Mixed education or accommodation is intended for both males and females.

ext.ext_cn: 一小份什锦色拉
ext.ext_en: ...a small mixed salad...

ext.ext_cn: 这片混合林用于商业砍伐，但与此同时也进行妥善维护以保持景观。
ext.ext_en: The mixed forest is cut commercially but is also carefully conserved to look good.

defs.def_en: Mixed is used to describe something which includes or consists of different things of the same general kind.

ext.ext_cn: 英国社会接受的习俗
ext.ext_en: ...the accepted mores of British society.

ext.ext_cn: 社会风俗和性习俗的深刻变化
ext.ext_en: ...profound changes in social and sexual mores.

defs.def_en: The mores of a particular place or group of people are the customs and behaviour that are typically found in that place or group.

ext.ext_cn: 真正民主的制度
ext.ext_en: ...a truly democratic system...

ext.ext_cn: 并非所有的医生都真正了解生殖周期。
ext.ext_en: Not all doctors truly understand the reproductive cycle...

defs.def_en: You use truly to emphasize that something has all the features or qualities of a particular thing, or is the case to the fullest possible extent.

ext.ext_cn: 非常优秀的人
ext.ext_en: ...a truly splendid man...

ext.ext_cn: 他们非常令人震惊。
ext.ext_en: They were truly appalling.

defs.def_en: You can use truly in order to emphasize your description of something.

ext.ext_cn: 相信我，苏珊，我实在感到抱歉。
ext.ext_en: Believe me, Susan, I am truly sorry...

ext.ext_cn: 他由衷地爱他的孩子们。
ext.ext_en: He truly loved his children.

defs.def_en: You use truly to emphasize that feelings are genuine and sincere.

ext.ext_cn: 我真的从不介意照顾拉斯蒂。
ext.ext_en: I truly never minded caring for Rusty…

ext.ext_cn: 我不希望你我两国之间爆发战争。真的不希望。
ext.ext_en: I do not expect a war between my country and yours. Truly I do not.

defs.def_en: You can use truly in order to emphasize that what you are saying is true.

defs.def_cn: (用于正式信件末尾)你忠实的

ext.ext_cn: 菲尔·特纳谨启
ext.ext_en: Yours truly, Phil Turner.

defs.def_en: You write Yours truly at the end of a formal letter to someone you do not know very well. You write your signature after the words 'Yours truly'.

ext.ext_cn: 鄙人被一声大喊惊醒：“喂！”
ext.ext_en: Yours truly was awoken by a shout: 'Ahoy there!'

defs.def_en: You can say yours truly as a way of referring to yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 一人份的微波炉餐
ext.ext_en: ...microwaveable meals for one.

defs.def_en: Microwaveable food can be cooked in a microwave.

ext.ext_cn: 车挨着车的交通堵塞
ext.ext_en: ...bumper to bumper traffic jams.

defs.def_en: Bumpers are bars at the front and back of a vehicle which protect it if it bumps into something.

ext.ext_cn: 稻米丰收
ext.ext_en: ...a bumper crop of rice...

ext.ext_cn: 艾奥瓦州今年玉米大丰收。
ext.ext_en: In the state of Iowa, it's  been a bumper year for corn.

defs.def_en: A bumper crop or harvest is one that is larger than usual.

ext.ext_cn: 巨额利润
ext.ext_en: ...bumper profits.

ext.ext_cn: 一大盒火柴
ext.ext_en: ...a bumper pack of matches.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is bumper size, you mean that it is very large.

TEFL is the teaching of English to people whose first language is not English, especially people from a country where English is not spoken. TEFL is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'teaching English as a foreign language'.
Easter Sunday is the Sunday in March or April when Easter is celebrated.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 详尽无遗的;彻底全面的

ext.ext_cn: 这绝称不上是详尽无遗的清单，但是列出了很多正在进行的项目。
ext.ext_en: This is by no means an exhaustive list but it gives an indication of the many projects taking place...

ext.ext_cn: 该作者对这个问题的分析很透彻。
ext.ext_en: The author's treatment of the subject is exhaustive.

defs.def_en: If you describe a study, search, or list as exhaustive, you mean that it is very thorough and complete.

ext.ext_cn: 本杰明·富兰克林初级中学
ext.ext_en: ...Benjamin Franklin Junior High.

ext.ext_cn: 他初中时辍学了。
ext.ext_en: ...He dropped out of Junior High School.

defs.def_en: In the United States, junior high is the school that young people attend between the ages of 11 or 12 and 14 or 15.

defs.def_cn: 精于讨好卖乖的人；马屁精
defs.def_en: If you call someone a goody-goody, you mean they behave extremely well in order to please people in authority.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尽管可能乏味但)无害的，不冒犯人的，不让人讨厌的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个温文随和的人。
ext.ext_en: He's a mild inoffensive man...

ext.ext_cn: 这是首挺不错的歌，朗朗上口又不难听。
ext.ext_en: It's a very nice song. Catchy, and inoffensive.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as inoffensive, you mean that they are not unpleasant or unacceptable in any way, but are perhaps rather dull.

ext.ext_cn: 他试图顺风回到飞机场。
ext.ext_en: He attempted to return downwind to the airfield.

ext.ext_cn: 住在内华达核试验基地下风处的居民
ext.ext_en: ...people who are living downwind of Nevada nuclear test sites.

defs.def_en: If something moves downwind, it moves in the same direction as the wind. If something is downwind, the wind is blowing towards it.
A security camera is a video camera that records people's activities in order to detect and prevent crime.
Carbon dioxide is a gas. It is produced by animals and people breathing out, and by chemical reactions.

defs.def_cn: （指持续的令人不快的过程）停止，缓和，减弱

ext.ext_cn: 这个城市道路上的车辆从来就没少过，甚至晚上也不例外。
ext.ext_en: The traffic in this city never lets up, even at night...

ext.ext_cn: 雨势已经减弱。
ext.ext_en: The rain had let up.

defs.def_en: See also:let-up;If an unpleasant, continuous process lets up, it stops or becomes less intense.

defs.def_cn: 收买，贿赂，恐吓(委员会等)

ext.ext_cn: 企图收买陪审团的指控传出后，审判在圣诞节前中止了。
ext.ext_en: The trial was stopped before Christmas after allegations of attempts to nobble the jury...

ext.ext_cn: 杰拉尔德爵士已经被收买了。
ext.ext_en: Sir Gerald had been nobbled.

defs.def_en: If someone nobbles an important group of people such as a committee, they offer them money or threaten them in order to make them do something.

defs.def_cn: (赛马前用药物等)害(马)使其不能取胜

ext.ext_cn: 在唐克斯特用来阻止两匹马取胜的药物
ext.ext_en: ...the drug used to nobble two horses at Doncaster.

defs.def_en: If someone nobbles a racehorse, they deliberately harm it, often using drugs, in order to prevent it from winning a race.

ext.ext_cn: 他重新树立自己地位的机会因教练的战术而流产了。
ext.ext_en: His opportunity to re-establish himself had been nobbled by the manager's tactics.

defs.def_en: If someone nobbles your plans or chances of succeeding, they prevent you from achieving what you want.

defs.def_cn: （用于某些表示计量单位的名词前）表示“千”

ext.ext_cn: 10万焦耳能量
ext.ext_en: ...100 kilojoules of energy.

ext.ext_cn: 相当于约2万吨当量的爆炸
ext.ext_en: ...an explosion of around 20 kilotons.

defs.def_en: Kilo- is added to some nouns that refer to units of measurement in order to form other nouns referring to units a thousand times bigger.

ext.ext_cn: 现在才将近11点10分。
ext.ext_en: It's just coming up to ten minutes past eleven now.

defs.def_en: To be coming up to a time or state means to be getting near to it.

ext.ext_cn: 这位19岁的佐治亚州人并不是比赛中的优秀击球手之一。
ext.ext_en: The Georgian, aged 19, is not one of the game's big hitters.

defs.def_en: In sports, you can use hitter to say how good someone is at hitting the ball.

defs.def_cn: 有影响力的政客（或商界人士）;政界（或商界）大人物

ext.ext_cn: 和欧洲实业家卡洛·德·贝内代蒂等大人物的友谊
ext.ext_en: ...friendships with heavy hitters like European industrialist Carlo De Benedetti.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone such as a politician or a businessman as a heavy hitter or a big hitter, you mean that they are powerful and influential.

ext.ext_cn: X光片证实他没有骨折。
ext.ext_en: X-rays have confirmed that he has not broken any bones...

ext.ext_cn: 这些新的统计数据证实经济衰退已经严重到我们最为担忧的境地。
ext.ext_en: These new statistics confirm our worst fears about the depth of the recession...

defs.def_en: If something confirms what you believe, suspect, or fear, it shows that it is definitely true.

ext.ext_cn: 这位发言人证实该地区现已落入叛乱分子手中。
ext.ext_en: The spokesman confirmed that the area was now in rebel hands...

ext.ext_cn: 他证实了人们长期以来的担心。
ext.ext_en: He confirmed what had long been feared...

defs.def_en: If you confirm something that has been stated or suggested, you say that it is true because you know about it.

defs.def_cn: (通常指通过信件或电话)确定，确认(安排或预约)

ext.ext_cn: 你来预订，我会去函确认。
ext.ext_en: You make the reservation, and I'll confirm it in writing.

defs.def_en: If you confirm an arrangement or appointment, you say that it is definite, usually in a letter or on the telephone.

defs.def_cn: 为…施坚振礼（或坚信礼）(从而正式成为基督教会的成员)

ext.ext_cn: 他领受了坚振礼，成为英国国教会的一员。
ext.ext_en: He was confirmed as a member of the Church of England.

defs.def_en: If someone is confirmed, they are formally accepted as a member of a Christian church during a ceremony in which they say they believe what the church teaches.

defs.def_cn: 使坚定，使确信(自己的决定、信仰或观点)

ext.ext_cn: 这使我更加坚定了不做修女的决心。
ext.ext_en: It has confirmed me in my decision not to become a nun.

defs.def_en: If something confirms you in your decision, belief, or opinion, it makes you think that you are definitely right.

defs.def_cn: 加强，巩固(地位、角色或权力)

ext.ext_cn: 威廉姆斯巩固了自己世界头号斯诺克选手的地位。
ext.ext_en: Williams has confirmed his position as the world's number one snooker player.

defs.def_en: If someone confirms their position, role, or power, they do something to make their power, position, or role stronger or more definite.

defs.def_cn: 巩固，确保(某人的名声、角色或地位)

ext.ext_cn: 他的新角色会确保他跻身我们的一流演员之列。
ext.ext_en: His new role could confirm him as one of our leading actors.

defs.def_en: If something confirms you as something, it shows that you definitely deserve a name, role, or position.

ext.ext_cn: 由于原料短缺，员工们已将近一个月无事可做。
ext.ext_en: Employees have been idle almost a month because of shortages.

defs.def_en: If people who were working are idle, they have no jobs or work.

ext.ext_cn: 如今机器闲置着。
ext.ext_en: Now the machine is lying idle.

ext.ext_cn: 已经闲置多年的工厂
ext.ext_en: ...factories that had been idle for years.

defs.def_en: If machines or factories are idle, they are not working or being used.

defs.def_cn: 懒散的;懒惰的;无所事事的

ext.ext_cn: 无所事事、整天看报纸的官僚们
ext.ext_en: ...idle bureaucrats who spent the day reading newspapers...

ext.ext_cn: 我一辈子都没碰到过像他们这样吃白饭的工人！
ext.ext_en: I never met such an idle bunch of workers in all my life!

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is idle, you disapprove of them because they are not doing anything and you think they should be.

defs.def_cn: 琐碎无聊的;毫无意义的

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩又絮絮地唠叨了5分钟。
ext.ext_en: Brian kept up the idle chatter for another five minutes.

ext.ext_cn: 无聊的好奇心
ext.ext_en: ...idle curiosity.

defs.def_en: Idle is used to describe something that you do for no particular reason, often because you have nothing better to do.

ext.ext_cn: 假装系统完美无疵是徒劳的。
ext.ext_en: It would be idle to pretend the system is perfect.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is idle to do something, you mean that it is not worth doing it, because it will not achieve anything.

ext.ext_cn: 那其实是唬人的话。
ext.ext_en: It was more of an idle threat than anything...

ext.ext_cn: 他的话不仅仅是虚张声势的自夸。
ext.ext_en: His statement isn't merely an idle boast.

defs.def_en: You refer to an idle threat or boast when you do not think the person making it will or can do what they say.

ext.ext_cn: 他们到他家后，斯科比闲逛了一会儿，抽完了他的香烟。
ext.ext_en: When they reached his house, Scobie idled a bit, finishing his cigarette...

ext.ext_cn: 露天小市场的三面都有小餐馆，我们在其中一家餐馆闲呆了很长时间。
ext.ext_en: We spent many hours idling in one of the cafes that line three sides of the tiny piazza...

defs.def_en: If you idle, you spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

ext.ext_cn: 停业的装配厂
ext.ext_en: ...idled assembly plants.

defs.def_en: To idle a factory or other place of work means to close it down because there is no work to do or because the workers are on strike.

ext.ext_cn: 罢工使约 55,000 名机械师无事可做。
ext.ext_en: The strike has idled about 55,000 machinists.

defs.def_en: To idle workers means to stop them working.

ext.ext_cn: 在树林的那一边,一架小飞机停在那里,发动机在空转。
ext.ext_en: Beyond a stand of trees a small plane idled...

ext.ext_cn: 她的戴姆勒豪华轿车原地待命,发动机在空转。
ext.ext_en: Her Daimler limo waits with its engine idling.

defs.def_en: If an engine or vehicle is idling, the engine is running slowly and quietly because it is not in gear, and the vehicle is not moving.

defs.def_cn: 不正确的;错误的;不真实的

ext.ext_cn: 他否认自己关于电话的证词是虚假的。
ext.ext_en: He denied that his evidence about the telephone call was incorrect...

ext.ext_cn: 人们对食物经常会有不正确的认识。
ext.ext_en: People often have incorrect information about food.

defs.def_en: Something that is incorrect is wrong and untrue.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 由不当姿势造成的损伤
ext.ext_en: ...injuries caused by incorrect posture.

ext.ext_cn: 不当的饮食
ext.ext_en: ...incorrect diet.

defs.def_en: Something that is incorrect is not the thing that is required or is most suitable in a particular situation.

defs.def_cn: 唐璜;滥交的男子;风流浪荡子
defs.def_en: If you describe a man as a Don Juan, you mean he has had sex with many women.

ext.ext_cn: 除了主人外，那里的人我一个也不认识。
ext.ext_en: Apart from my host, I didn't know a single person there...

ext.ext_cn: 汤米·索普威斯对人一向热情款待。
ext.ext_en: Tommy Sopwith was always the perfect host.

defs.def_en: The host at a party is the person who has invited the guests and provides the food, drink, or entertainment.

defs.def_cn: 作为主人组织，做东举办（聚会等）

ext.ext_cn: 今晚她做东举办一场有300名客人参加的舞会。
ext.ext_en: Tonight she hosts a ball for 300 guests.

ext.ext_cn: 哈萨克斯坦总统举行的宴会
ext.ext_en: ...a banquet hosted by the president of Kazakhstan.

defs.def_en: If someone hosts a party, dinner, or other function, they have invited the guests and provide the food, drink, or entertainment.

defs.def_cn: （某项活动的）主办国（或城市、机构）

ext.ext_cn: 巴塞罗那获选为1992年奥运会的主办城市。
ext.ext_en: Barcelona was chosen to be host of the 1992 Olympic games.

ext.ext_cn: 在安道尔举行的有东道国参加的预选资格赛
ext.ext_en: ...a preliminary qualifying tournament in Andorra involving the host country.

defs.def_en: A country, city, or organization that is the host of an event provides the facilities for that event to take place.

ext.ext_cn: 戛纳每年主办电影节。
ext.ext_en: Cannes hosts the annual film festival.

defs.def_en: If a country, city, or organization hosts an event, they provide the facilities for the event to take place.

ext.ext_cn: 1987年加拿大主办了英联邦大会。
ext.ext_en: In 1987 Canada played host to the Commonwealth Conference...

ext.ext_cn: 首相接待了法国总理雅克·希拉克。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister played host to French Premier Jacques Chirac.

defs.def_en: If a person or country plays host to an event or an important visitor, they host the event or the visit.

ext.ext_cn: 我是一个电台直播节目的主持人。
ext.ext_en: I am host of a live radio programme.

defs.def_en: The host of a radio or television show is the person who introduces it and talks to the people who appear in it.

ext.ext_cn: 她还在圣彼得堡电台主持一个节目。
ext.ext_en: She also hosts a show on St Petersburg Radio.

defs.def_en: The person who hosts a radio or television show introduces it and talks to the people who appear in it.

ext.ext_cn: 可能推迟英吉利海峡隧道开通的问题一大筐。
ext.ext_en: A host of problems may delay the opening of the Channel Tunnel...

ext.ext_cn: 今天我们有收音机、电视机和一大堆小型电器。
ext.ext_en: Today we have radios, TVs, and a whole host of gadgets powered by electricity.

defs.def_en: A host of things is a lot of them.

ext.ext_cn: 乌干达美丽的高地是众多野生动物的栖息地。
ext.ext_en: Uganda's beautiful highlands are host to a wide range of wildlife.

defs.def_en: If an area is host to living things, those creatures live and feed in that area.
A host or a host computer is the main computer in a network of computers, which controls the most important files and programs.

ext.ext_cn: 当卵孵化后，幼虫取食寄主的鲜肉。
ext.ext_en: When the eggs hatch the larvae eat the living flesh of the host animal.

defs.def_en: The host of a parasite is the plant or animal which it lives on or inside and from which it gets its food.

defs.def_cn: 圣体（基督教圣餐礼等宗教仪式中代表耶稣躯体的面饼）
defs.def_en: The Host is the bread which is used to represent the body of Christ in Christian church services such as Holy Communion.

ext.ext_cn: 声称录下了两个官员辱骂自己的过程的工厂工人
ext.ext_en: ...a factory worker who allegedly tape-recorded two officers verbally abusing him...

ext.ext_cn: 谈话被录了下来，并在法庭上播放。
ext.ext_en: The conversation was tape-recorded and played in court.

defs.def_en: If you tape-record speech, music, or another kind of sound, you record it on tape, using a tape recorder or a tape deck.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （话语、描述或选择）合适的，恰当的，贴切的

ext.ext_cn: 这份报告的措词用在今天和用在1929年一样贴切。
ext.ext_en: The words of this report are as apt today as in 1929.

ext.ext_cn: 对这种情况恰如其分的描述
ext.ext_en: ...an apt description of the situation.

defs.def_en: An apt remark, description, or choice is especially suitable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她动不动就拔高嗓门，并挥舞双手。
ext.ext_en: She was apt to raise her voice and wave her hands about...

ext.ext_cn: 这种天气在冬季往往更为常见。
ext.ext_en: This type of weather is apt to be more common in winter.

defs.def_en: If someone is apt to do something, they often do it and so it is likely that they will do it again.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经长大了，实在不再适合玩儿童玩具了。
ext.ext_en: He was really too old for children's toys.

ext.ext_cn: 玩具电话
ext.ext_en: ...a toy telephone.

defs.def_en: See also:soft toy;A toy is an object that children play with, for example a doll or a model car.

ext.ext_cn: 计算机已成了家庭的消遣玩意儿。
ext.ext_en: Computers have become household toys.

defs.def_en: You can refer to objects that adults use for fun rather than for a serious purpose as toys .

ext.ext_cn: 故作悲伤地尖叫
ext.ext_en: ...shrieking and caterwauling in mock distress.

ext.ext_en: The total of debits must balance the total of credits.

defs.def_en: A debit is a record of the money taken from your bank account, for example when you write a cheque.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 把这些事都留给你去做，我真感到过意不去。
ext.ext_en: I feel so guilty, leaving all this to you...

ext.ext_cn: 她见到我时一脸歉疚。
ext.ext_en: When she saw me she looked guilty.

defs.def_en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you think that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

ext.ext_cn: 许多人或许保守着这个罪恶的秘密。
ext.ext_en: Many may be keeping it a guilty secret...

ext.ext_cn: 我带着一种罪恶的解脱感离开。
ext.ext_en: I leave with a guilty sense of relief.

defs.def_en: Guilty is used of an action or fact that you feel guilty about.  guilty conscience→see: conscience;

ext.ext_cn: 他们被判谋杀罪成立。
ext.ext_en: They were found guilty of murder...

ext.ext_cn: 他承认确实犯有人身伤害罪。
ext.ext_en: He pleaded guilty to causing actual bodily harm.

defs.def_en: If someone is guilty of a crime or offence, they have committed that crime or offence.

ext.ext_cn: 他宣称布鲁克先生犯有“判断失误的重大过错”。
ext.ext_en: He claimed Mr Brooke had been guilty of a 'gross error of judgment'...

ext.ext_cn: 他们将考虑他是否犯有玩忽职守的重大过失。
ext.ext_en: They will consider whether or not he has been guilty of serious professional misconduct.

defs.def_en: If someone is guilty of doing something wrong, they have done that thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 穿毛皮衣物已经相当过时了。
ext.ext_en: Wearing fur has become deeply unfashionable...

ext.ext_cn: 夫妇俩对婚姻的看法很传统，认为婚姻是神圣的结合。
ext.ext_en: The couple hold the unfashionable view that marriage is a sacred union.

defs.def_en: If something is unfashionable, it is not approved of or done by most people.

ext.ext_cn: 我擦破皮了，一碰就疼。
ext.ext_en: My skin was abraded and very tender.

defs.def_en: To abrade something means to scrape or wear down its surface by rubbing it.

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉和丈夫还有孩子们住在伦敦中心城区的一间公寓里。
ext.ext_en: Sara lives with her husband and children in a flat in central London...

ext.ext_cn: 大火是从一幢公寓大楼烧起的。
ext.ext_en: It started a fire in a block of flats...

defs.def_en: A flat is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor and part of a larger building. A flat usually includes a kitchen and bathroom.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 只要表面平整、坚固而且干燥，瓷砖就可以贴住。
ext.ext_en: Tiles can be fixed to any surface as long as it's flat, firm and dry...

ext.ext_cn: 过了一会儿，他用右手把布抹平。
ext.ext_en: After a moment his right hand moved across the cloth, smoothing it flat...

defs.def_en: Something that is flat is level, smooth, or even, rather than sloping, curved, or uneven.

ext.ext_cn: 他身旁的两个男人直挺挺趴倒在地上。
ext.ext_en: Two men near him threw themselves flat...

ext.ext_cn: 通常躺着的时候胃灼热会更加厉害，所以应当避免平卧。
ext.ext_en: As heartburn is usually worse when you're lying down in bed, you should avoid lying flat.

defs.def_en: Flat means horizontal and not upright.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 埃伦正一手托着一个方形的扁盒子沿私人车道走着。
ext.ext_en: Ellen is walking down the drive with a square flat box balanced on one hand.

defs.def_en: A flat object is not very tall or deep in relation to its length and width.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 北边是索尔韦平原平坦而肥沃的农田。
ext.ext_en: To the north lie the flat and fertile farmlands of the Solway plain...

ext.ext_cn: 地势变得更开阔、更平整，风景十分优美。
ext.ext_en: The landscape became wider, flatter and very scenic...

defs.def_en: Flat land is level, with no high hills or other raised parts.

ext.ext_cn: 盐碱地和泥滩吸引了大量水鸟。
ext.ext_en: The salt marshes and mud flats attract large numbers of waterfowl.

defs.def_en: A low flat area of uncultivated land, especially an area where the ground is soft and wet, can be referred to as flats or a flat .

ext.ext_cn: 他用手掌使劲拍打着柜台。
ext.ext_en: He slammed the counter with the flat of his hand.

ext.ext_cn: 用刀面拍碎的 8 粒蒜瓣
ext.ext_en: ...eight cloves of garlic crushed with the flat of a knife.

defs.def_en: You can refer to one of the broad flat surfaces of an object as the flat of that object.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 人们穿着宽松的长裤、运动衫、平底鞋和各式适合旅行的休闲服装。
ext.ext_en: People wear slacks, sweaters, flat shoes, and all manner of casual attire for travel.

ext.ext_cn: 他妈妈穿上牛仔裤和平跟鞋，看上去年轻了 10 岁。
ext.ext_en: His mother looked ten years younger in jeans and flats.

defs.def_en: Flat shoes have no heels or very low heels.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: A flat tyre, ball, or balloon does not have enough air in it.

ext.ext_cn: 后来，我终于回到公路上后，车胎又瘪了。
ext.ext_en: Then, after I finally got back on the highway, I developed a flat.

defs.def_en: A flat is a tyre that does not have enough air in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这真的能让香槟不走气吗？
ext.ext_en: Could this really stop the champagne from going flat?

defs.def_en: A drink that is flat is no longer fizzy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (电池)没电的，电耗光的，电不足的

ext.ext_cn: 他的汽车报警器连着响了两天，结果电池耗没电了。
ext.ext_en: His car alarm had been going off for two days and, as a result, the battery was flat.

defs.def_en: A flat battery has lost some or all of its electrical charge.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 平足会在家族中遗传。
ext.ext_en: The condition of flat feet runs in families.

defs.def_en: If you have flat feet, the arches of your feet are too low.

ext.ext_cn: 外交部已经坚决否认参与过此事。
ext.ext_en: The Foreign Ministry has issued a flat denial of any involvement...

ext.ext_cn: 她很可能会断然拒绝你。
ext.ext_en: She is likely to give you a flat refusal.

defs.def_en: A flat denial or refusal is definite and firm, and is unlikely to be changed.

ext.ext_cn: 您面前的引擎，可以在短短 6 秒钟内速度从 0 提升至每小时 60 英里。
ext.ext_en: You're sitting behind an engine that'll move you from 0 to 60mph in six seconds flat...

ext.ext_cn: 短短两分钟内，我让人把一切都给我解释了一下。
ext.ext_en: I had it all explained to me in two minutes flat.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happened, for example, in ten seconds flat or ten minutes flat, you are emphasizing that it happened surprisingly quickly and only took ten seconds or ten minutes.

defs.def_cn: (比率、价格或百分比)固定的，统一的

ext.ext_cn: 费用按固定价格收取，而不是基于百分比收取。
ext.ext_en: Fees are charged at a flat rate, rather than on a percentage basis...

ext.ext_cn: 有时执行某项特定的任务有固定的价码。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes there's a flat fee for carrying out a particular task...

defs.def_en: A flat rate, price, or percentage is one that is fixed and which applies in every situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (贸易或商业)停滞的，不景气的

ext.ext_cn: 今年前 8 个月，大型货车的销售量增加了 14％，而小轿车的销售仍然不景气。
ext.ext_en: During the first eight months of this year, sales of big pickups were up 14% while car sales stayed flat...

ext.ext_cn: 从全国来说，房屋价格没有多大变化。
ext.ext_en: For the country overall, house prices have remained flat.

defs.def_en: If trade or business is flat, it is slow and inactive, rather than busy and improving or increasing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 过去这几天似乎比较平淡无聊。
ext.ext_en: The past few days have seemed comparatively flat and empty...

ext.ext_cn: 很久没有政党领导人像他昨天那样作如此枯燥无聊的演讲了。
ext.ext_en: It is a long time since a party leader delivered such a dreadfully flat speech as he did yesterday.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as flat, you mean that it is dull and not exciting or interesting.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: “不管你说什么，我都会坐在这里等。”他用一种极为平淡的声音说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Whatever you say,' he said in a deadly flat voice. 'I'll sit here and wait.'...

ext.ext_cn: 她的声音平淡，听不出疑虑也感觉不到希望。
ext.ext_en: Her voice was flat, with no question or hope in it.

defs.def_en: You use flat to describe someone's voice when they are saying something without expressing any emotion.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示音符的字母后)降半音的，降音的

ext.ext_cn: 舒伯特降 B 调钢琴三重奏(第 99 号作品)
ext.ext_en: ...Schubert's B flat Piano Trio (Opus 99).

defs.def_en: Flat is used after a letter representing a musical note to show that the note should be played or sung half a tone lower than the note which otherwise matches that letter. Flat is often represented by the symbol  after the letter.

defs.def_cn: (演唱或乐器)比标准音低的，音偏低的

ext.ext_cn: 至少可以说，她的音域不够宽，而且令人不舒服的是，她总是音高偏低。
ext.ext_en: Her vocal range was, to say the least of it, limited, and she had a distressing tendency to sing flat.

ext.ext_cn: 他因为唱歌音调偏低而被炒了。
ext.ext_en: He had been fired because his singing was flat.

defs.def_en: If someone sings flat or if a musical instrument is flat, their singing or the instrument is slightly lower in pitch than it should be.

defs.def_cn: 非常平坦的;完全平展的

ext.ext_cn: 我的故乡伊利诺伊州一马平川。
ext.ext_en: My home state of Illinois is flat as a pancake...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is as flat as a pancake, you are emphasizing that it is completely flat.

ext.ext_cn: 一个男人从街上走进来，趴倒在地，不省人事。
ext.ext_en: A man walked in off the street and fell flat on his face, unconscious.

defs.def_en: If you fall flat on your face, you fall over.

ext.ext_cn: 利兹本想开个玩笑，结果却没有达到效果。
ext.ext_en: Liz meant it as a joke but it fell flat...

ext.ext_cn: 如果不是女主角埃伦·巴尔金的话，整个情节会非常失败。
ext.ext_en: If it wasn't for the main actress, Ellen Barkin, the plot would have fallen flat on its face.

defs.def_en: If an event or attempt falls flat or falls flat on its face, it is unsuccessful.

defs.def_cn: 一文不名;身无分文;一贫如洗

ext.ext_cn: 两年后，他一贫如洗，靠失业救济金生活。
ext.ext_en: Two years later he is flat broke and on the dole.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are flat broke, you mean that you have no money at all.

defs.def_cn: 全速;全力以赴;竭尽全力

ext.ext_cn: 每个人都在全力以赴，设法捉住那些罪魁祸首。
ext.ext_en: Everyone is working flat out to try to trap those responsible...

ext.ext_cn: 他们拼命冲刺，越过终点线。
ext.ext_en: They hurtled across the line in a flat-out sprint.

defs.def_en: If you do something flat out, you do it as fast or as hard as you can.

defs.def_cn: 完完全全的;确确实实的

ext.ext_cn: 那项指控是彻头彻尾的谎言。
ext.ext_en: That allegation is a flat-out lie...

ext.ext_cn: 他们说业界所谓的放宽管制已经取得了成效的说法纯属谎言。
ext.ext_en: They say the industry is flat out lying about the effects of deregulation.

defs.def_en: You use flat out to emphasize that something is completely the case.

ext.ext_cn: 他患有心绞痛，在平地上最多能走 200 码。
ext.ext_en: He had angina and was unable to walk for more than 200 yards on the flat.

defs.def_en: On the flat means on level ground.
An electromagnet is a magnet that consists of a piece of iron or steel surrounded by a coil. The metal becomes magnetic when an electric current is passed through the coil.
A seminarian is a student at a seminary.

ext.ext_cn: 小块方形红棉布
ext.ext_en: ...small squares of red cotton fabric...

ext.ext_cn: 无论什么样的色彩图案，都有与之相配的织物。
ext.ext_en: Whatever your colour scheme, there's a fabric to match.

defs.def_en: Fabric is cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. Fabrics are used for making things such as clothes, curtains, and sheets.

ext.ext_cn: 社会结构已遭到上届政府极大的破坏。
ext.ext_en: The fabric of society has been deeply damaged by the previous regime...

ext.ext_cn: 经年内战已破坏了国家的基础设施，摧毁了其社会结构。
ext.ext_en: Years of civil war have wrecked the country's infrastructure and destroyed its social fabric.

defs.def_en: The fabric of a society or system is its basic structure, with all the customs and beliefs that make it work successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 冷凝作用将最终使建筑结构腐朽掉。
ext.ext_en: Condensation will eventually cause the fabric of the building to rot away.

defs.def_en: The fabric of a building is its walls, roof, and the materials with which it is built.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得她不但长得非常漂亮，而且还有很多优秀品质。
ext.ext_en: I think she has many good qualities besides being very beautiful...

ext.ext_cn: 除了福特以外，只有一个人认识朱莉娅·詹姆森。
ext.ext_en: There was only one person besides Ford who knew Julia Jameson.

defs.def_en: Besides something or beside something means in addition to it.

defs.def_cn: 而且，再说（强调所补充的内容）

ext.ext_cn: 这座房子太贵太大了。再说，我已经喜欢上我们租的小房子了。
ext.ext_en: The house was too expensive and too big. Besides, I'd grown fond of our little rented house.

defs.def_en: Besides is used to emphasize an additional point that you are making, especially one that you consider to be important.

ext.ext_cn: 简老是惹她生气，她有时就拿我出气。
ext.ext_en: Jane's always annoying her and she takes it out on me sometimes.

defs.def_en: If you take something out on someone, you behave in an unpleasant way towards them because you feel angry or upset, even though this is not their fault.

ext.ext_cn: 我们把包扔在附近的格兰德酒店后就匆匆赶往集市。
ext.ext_en: We dumped our bags at the nearby Grand Hotel and hurried towards the market...

ext.ext_cn: 他把我的背包从出租车上取来丢到我脚下。
ext.ext_en: He got my haversack from the cab and dumped it at my feet.

defs.def_en: If you dump something somewhere, you put it or unload it there quickly and carelessly.

ext.ext_cn: 逃亡用的车被丢弃在高速公路隧道附近。
ext.ext_en: The getaway car was dumped near a motorway tunnel...

ext.ext_cn: 一百万吨未经处理的污水被倾倒进了海里。
ext.ext_en: A million tonnes of untreated sewage is dumped into the sea...

defs.def_en: If something is dumped somewhere, it is put or left there because it is no longer wanted or needed.

ext.ext_cn: 将其废弃物直接运送至垃圾场的公司
ext.ext_en: ...companies that bring their rubbish straight to the dump...

ext.ext_cn: 带围墙的花园被用作了垃圾场。
ext.ext_en: The walled garden was used as a dump.

defs.def_en: A dump is a place where rubbish is left, for example on open ground outside a town.

defs.def_cn: 肮脏的地方;乱七八糟的地方

ext.ext_cn: “真够脏乱的！”克丽丝特布尔站在青年旅社的门口说道。
ext.ext_en: 'What a dump!' Christabel said, standing in the doorway of the youth hostel.

defs.def_en: If you say that a place is a dump, you think it is ugly and unpleasant to live in or visit.

defs.def_cn: (军队中粮食、武器等的)临时堆积处,临时仓库
defs.def_en: A dump is a place where an army stores food and weapons temporarily while it is stationed in a particular place.

defs.def_cn: 不再支持,摒弃(政策、想法等)

ext.ext_cn: 大臣们认为在大选前停止征收人头税至关重要。
ext.ext_en: Ministers believed it was vital to dump the poll tax before the election.

defs.def_en: To dump something such as an idea, policy, or practice means to stop supporting or using it.

defs.def_cn: (通常指为占领海外市场)倾销,抛售

ext.ext_cn: 当产量超过需求时,过剩的产品便倾销到世界市场。
ext.ext_en: It produces more than it needs, then dumps its surplus onto the world market.

defs.def_en: If a firm or company dumps goods, it sells large quantities of them at prices far below their real value, usually in another country, in order to gain a bigger market share or to keep prices high in the home market.

defs.def_cn: 与…断绝关系;与…结束关系

ext.ext_cn: 我以为他要为了另一个女孩而和我分手。
ext.ext_en: I thought he was going to dump me for another girl...

ext.ext_cn: 5 年后她被相恋多年的恋人抛弃了。
ext.ext_en: She was dumped by her long-term lover after five years...

defs.def_en: If you dump someone, you end your relationship with them.

ext.ext_cn: 有时我被扔给奶奶照看，或者被交给毫无经验的临时保姆。
ext.ext_en: I was sometimes dumped with my grandmother or left with highly unsuitable au pairs...

ext.ext_cn: 他应付不过来，只能将他那两个十来岁的儿子交给他们代为照看。
ext.ext_en: He can't cope and dumps his two teenage boys on them to be looked after.

defs.def_en: If you say that a parent dumps a child with someone, you are criticizing the parent for leaving the child to be looked after by that person.

ext.ext_cn: 将 1,000 个电话号码转存到一个128k的EPROM芯片要花好几个小时。
ext.ext_en: It can take a couple of hours to dump a thousand telephone numbers into a 128k EPROM pack...

ext.ext_cn: 所有数据随后被转存至主计算机。
ext.ext_en: All the data is then dumped into the main computer.

defs.def_en: To dump computer data or memory means to copy it from one storage system onto another, such as from disk to magnetic tape.

defs.def_cn: 转存信息库;转储数据库

ext.ext_cn: 屏幕转储
ext.ext_en: ...a screen dump.

defs.def_en: A dump is a list of the data that is stored in a computer's memory at a particular time. Dumps are often used by computer programmers to find out what is causing a problem with a program.

ext.ext_cn: 莫娜,他是个不错的家伙,没有亏待我。
ext.ext_en: He was a nice guy, Mona. He didn't dump on me.

defs.def_en: If someone dumps on you, they treat you very badly and unfairly.

defs.def_cn: 郁闷的;沮丧的;闷闷不乐的

ext.ext_cn: 她情绪有点低落，需要振奋起来。
ext.ext_en: She's feeling a bit down in the dumps and needs cheering up.

defs.def_en: If you are down in the dumps, you are feeling very depressed and miserable.

defs.def_cn: 把（液体）倒出（至其他容器中)

ext.ext_cn: 她过去总是把牛奶倒入一个壶中。
ext.ext_en: She always used to decant the milk into a jug...

ext.ext_cn: 上等的波尔图葡萄酒必须倒入其他容器中以滤除自然沉淀物。
ext.ext_en: Vintage ports must be decanted to remove natural sediments.

defs.def_en: If you decant a liquid into another container, you put it into another container.

ext.ext_cn: 他抓起一把把叶子扔向她，她大笑着鼓动他。
ext.ext_en: He was lifting up handfuls of leaves and throwing them at her. She was laughing and egging him on...

ext.ext_cn: 他们互相拱火，大打大闹。
ext.ext_en: They egged each other on to argue and to fight.

defs.def_en: If you egg a person on, you encourage them to do something, especially something dangerous or foolish.

defs.def_cn: （通常指公开地）猛烈批评，痛斥，炮轰

ext.ext_cn: 格雷不放过任何一个炮轰汤普森及其组织的机会。
ext.ext_en: Grey took every opportunity to lambast Thompson and his organization.

defs.def_en: If you lambast someone, you criticize them severely, usually in public.

defs.def_cn: 哦，呃，嗯（表示说话时的犹豫）

ext.ext_cn: 我不太同意，呃，我们位居第三的说法。
ext.ext_en: I would challenge the, er, suggestion that we're in third place...

ext.ext_cn: 那些吸毒上瘾的人，呃，以某种方式获得政府帮助。
ext.ext_en: People that are addicted to drugs get er help from the government one way or another.

defs.def_en: Er is used in writing to represent the sound that people make when they hesitate, especially while they decide what to say next.

ext.ext_cn: 国家间意识形态的截然对立
ext.ext_en: ...the ideological polarity between nations.

ext.ext_cn: 善与恶的针锋相对

defs.def_en: The south-west of a place, country, or region is the part which is towards the south-west.

ext.ext_cn: 在我家花园的西南角

defs.def_en: The south-west part of a place, country, or region is the part which is towards the south-west.

Ethnographic refers to things that are connected with or relate to ethnography.

ext.ext_cn: 政客们把事情搞砸的时候，埋单的是老百姓。

ext.ext_en: He had messed up one career...

ext.ext_en: I hope they haven't messed up your video tapes.

defs.def_en: If you mess up a place or a thing, you make it untidy or dirty.

ext.ext_en: That really messed them up, especially the boys.

defs.def_en: If something messes someone up, it causes them to be very confused or worried, or to have psychological problems.
The cervix is the entrance to the womb.

ext.ext_en: ...a constitutional amendment...

An amendment is a change that is made to a piece of writing.
A panhandler is a person who stops people in the street and asks them for food or money.
A bazooka is a long, tube-shaped gun that is held on the shoulder and fires rockets.
A character actor is an actor who specializes in playing unusual or eccentric people.

defs.def_en: A day off is a day when you do not go to work, even though it is usually a working day.

ext.ext_en: A policeman and then a paramedic tried to resuscitate her.

defs.def_en: If you resuscitate someone who has stopped breathing, you cause them to start breathing again.

ext.ext_en: He has submitted a bid to resuscitate the struggling magazine.

defs.def_en: If you resuscitate something, you cause it to become active or successful again.

ext.ext_cn: 生意红火起来，不出6 个月他们就可以每天赚 18,000 卢布了。
ext.ext_en: Business flourished and within six months they were earning 18,000 roubles a day...

ext.ext_en: Racism and crime still flourish in the ghetto.

defs.def_cn: (植物或动物)长势好，茁壮成长

ext.ext_en: The plant flourishes particularly well in slightly harsher climes.

defs.def_en: If a plant or animal flourishes, it grows well or is healthy because the conditions are right for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他挥动手中的杯子来强调这一点。
ext.ext_en: He flourished the glass to emphasize the point.

ext.ext_en: He took his peaked cap from under his arm with a flourish and pulled it low over his eyes.

defs.def_en: If you flourish an object, you wave it about in a way that makes people notice it.

ext.ext_cn: 她往往以夸张的姿势结束舞蹈。
ext.ext_en: She tended to finish dancing with a flourish.

defs.def_en: If you do something with a flourish, you do in a showy way so that people notice it.

ext.ext_en: He scrawled his name across the bill, underlining it with a showy flourish.

ext.ext_en: Virtue is not confined to the Christian world...

ext.ext_cn: 她本可以轻易地证实自己纯真善良的品性。
ext.ext_en: She could have established her own innocence and virtue easily enough.

defs.def_en: Virtue is thinking and doing what is right and avoiding what is wrong.

ext.ext_en: His virtue is patience...

ext.ext_cn: 她的缺点和优点一样多。
ext.ext_en: Her flaws were as large as her virtues...

defs.def_en: A virtue is a good quality or way of behaving.

ext.ext_en: Its other great virtue, of course, is its hard-wearing quality.

defs.def_en: The virtue of something is an advantage or benefit that it has, especially in comparison with something else.

ext.ext_en: The article stuck in my mind by virtue of one detail...

defs.def_en: If someone with a high-pitched voice shrills something, they say it loudly.

ext.ext_en: I just stood there feeling foolish and watching him...

defs.def_cn: （君主、帝王的）登基，即位；（国家统治者的）就职，就任

ext.ext_en: Wherever did you get that idea?...

ext.ext_en: Wherever have you been?

ext.ext_en: The next day she was gone to Lusaka, Kampala, or wherever.

ext.ext_en: ...language which will allow the students in class or wherever to express their opinions.

ext.ext_en: She shouldn't have desecrated the picture of a religious leader...

defs.def_en: If someone spends their time globe-trotting, they spend a lot of time travelling to different parts of the world.

ext.ext_cn: 通告受到了人们的质疑。

ext.ext_en: There are significant parallels with the 1980s...

ext.ext_en: Often there are emotional reasons paralleling the financial ones...

ext.ext_en: The change in smoking is paralleled by a change in the incidence of lung cancer...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的本能并不总是和我们的相同。
ext.ext_en: Their instincts do not always run parallel with ours...

defs.def_en: Parallel events or situations happen at the same time as one another, or are similar to one another.

defs.def_en: If two lines, two objects, or two lines of movement are parallel, they are the same distance apart along their whole length.

defs.def_en: A parallel is an imaginary line round the earth that is parallel to the equator. Parallels are shown on maps.

ext.ext_en: Davies has managed to pursue his diverse interests in parallel with his fast-moving career...
