defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 上过润滑油的；用润滑油处理过的

ext.ext_cn: 上过油的木头防水而且不会剥落。
ext.ext_en: Oiled wood is water-resistant and won't flake.

defs.def_en: See also:well-oiled;Something that is oiled has had oil put into or onto it, for example to make it work smoothly or to protect it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 粗野的；未开化的；野蛮的

ext.ext_cn: 他认为惠特曼的诗歌太粗俗。
ext.ext_en: He thought the poetry of Whitman barbarous.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as barbarous, you strongly disapprove of it because you think that it is rough and uncivilized.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 残暴的；极其残忍的；凶残的

ext.ext_cn: 凶残的进攻
ext.ext_en: ...a barbarous attack.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as barbarous, you strongly disapprove of it because you think that it is extremely cruel.

ext.ext_cn: 妈妈特别相信草药。
ext.ext_en: Mum was a great believer in herbal medicines.

defs.def_en: If you are a great believer in something, you think that it is good, right, or useful.

ext.ext_cn: 我毫不掩饰我不信教。
ext.ext_en: I made no secret of the fact that I was not a believer.

defs.def_en: A believer is someone who is sure that God exists or that their religion is true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (论点、观点或立场)有道理的，站得住脚的

ext.ext_cn: 这个论点根本站不住脚。
ext.ext_en: This argument is simply not tenable...

ext.ext_cn: 弄清他扮演的角色并再次证明他的合理立场的唯一办法是展开公开调查。
ext.ext_en: The only way his role can be clarified and his position made tenable again is if there's a public inquiry.

defs.def_en: If you say that an argument, point of view, or situation is tenable, you believe that it is reasonable and could be successfully defended against criticism.

defs.def_cn: 数字影碟;数字多功能光碟

ext.ext_cn: DVD 播放机
ext.ext_en: ...a DVD player.

defs.def_en: A DVD is a disc on which a film or music is recorded. DVD discs are similar to compact discs but hold a lot more information. DVD is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'digital video disc' or 'digital versatile disc'.
Seismology is the scientific study of earthquakes.
A coronet is a small crown.

ext.ext_cn: 他声称，一名警官威胁要陷害他并把他关进监狱。
ext.ext_en: He claimed that a police officer had threatened to stitch him up and send him to prison.

defs.def_en: To stitch someone up means to trick them so that they are put in a difficult or unpleasant situation, especially one where they are blamed for something they have not done.

ext.ext_cn: 希拉兹已经在全球促成了几笔大宗协议的签订，以此来提高销量。
ext.ext_en: Shiraz has stitched up major deals all over the world to boost sales.

defs.def_en: To stitch up an agreement, especially a complicated agreement between several people, means to arrange it.

ext.ext_cn: 我能够查阅证实这一说法的大量文件。
ext.ext_en: I had access to a wide range of documents which corroborated the story...

ext.ext_cn: 艾丽斯证实了布莱尔所说的。
ext.ext_en: Alice corroborated what Blair had said.

defs.def_en: To corroborate something that has been said or reported means to provide evidence or information that supports it.

defs.def_cn: 该死的;可恶的;讨厌的;糟糕的

ext.ext_cn: 我们这的气候真是糟糕透顶！
ext.ext_en: What a damnable climate we have!

ext.ext_cn: 这项强奸指控完全是卑劣的谎言。
ext.ext_en: The charge of rape was a damnable lie.

defs.def_en: You use damnable to emphasize that you dislike or disapprove of something a great deal.

ext.ext_cn: 都3年了，他仍在偿还债务。
ext.ext_en: Three years later, he is still paying off his debts...

ext.ext_cn: 经济收缩意味着税收的减少和政府债务的增加。
ext.ext_en: Shrinking economies mean falling tax revenues and more government debt.

defs.def_en: See also:bad debt;A debt is a sum of money that you owe someone.

ext.ext_cn: 重压是负债的一个主要原因。
ext.ext_en: Stress is a main reason for debt.

ext.ext_cn: 他原就已经因为赌博输钱负债累累了。
ext.ext_en: He was already deeply in debt through gambling losses...

defs.def_en: Debt is the state of owing money.

defs.def_cn: (表示感激）我欠你个人情/我受你的恩惠

ext.ext_cn: 他对我太好了，我永远也还不清这份人情。
ext.ext_en: He was so good to me that I can never repay the debt I owe him...

ext.ext_cn: 我要衷心地感谢乔伊斯·汤普森先生，他严谨而卓著的研究给予了我极大的帮助。
ext.ext_en: I owe a debt of thanks to Joyce Thompson, whose careful and able research was of great help...

defs.def_en: You use debt in expressions such as I owe you a debt or I am in your debt when you are expressing gratitude for something that someone has done for you.

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦退缩了，说他无意冒犯他们。
ext.ext_en: Allen back-pedalled, saying that he had had no intention of offending them...

ext.ext_cn: 他看起来想要收回声明中说过的话。
ext.ext_en: He appeared to back-pedal on that statement.

defs.def_en: If you back-pedal, you express a different or less forceful opinion about something from the one you have previously expressed.

defs.def_cn: 变卦；出尔反尔；背弃诺言

ext.ext_cn: 她已经两次变卦了。
ext.ext_en: She's backpedaled twice already...

ext.ext_cn: 内阁可能背弃这些承诺。
ext.ext_en: The cabinet may backpedal on these commitments.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone back-pedals, you disapprove of their behaviour because they are not doing what they promised.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 乳白色亚麻套装和简朴的黑色衬衫
ext.ext_en: ...a cream linen suit and austere black blouse...

ext.ext_cn: 教堂的布置很简朴。
ext.ext_en: The church was austere and simple.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as austere, you approve of its plain and simple appearance.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我发现她相当严厉，拒人于千里之外，近乎冷漠。
ext.ext_en: I found her a rather austere, distant, somewhat cold person.

ext.ext_cn: 有着非常严厉的清规戒律的组织
ext.ext_en: ...an extraordinarily austere and puritanical organization.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as austere, you disapprove of them because they are strict and serious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （生活）简朴的，不奢华的，苦行的

ext.ext_cn: 军队的生活还是相对清苦的。
ext.ext_en: The life of the troops was still comparatively austere.

defs.def_en: An austere way of life is one that is simple and without luxuries.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一套大力控制通货膨胀的紧缩性经济措施
ext.ext_en: ...a set of very austere economic measures to control inflation.

defs.def_en: An austere economic policy is one which reduces people's living standards sharply.

ext.ext_cn: 我走街串巷找到了他的新住所。
ext.ext_en: I went round the streets and found his new abode.

defs.def_en: Your abode is the place where you live.

ext.ext_cn: 精神病院30%的床位是被无家可归者占据的。
ext.ext_en: 30 per cent of psychiatric hospital beds are occupied by people of no fixed abode.

defs.def_en: If someone has no fixed abode, they are homeless.

ext.ext_cn: 岛外的人和岛民结婚之初只能获得三年的居住权。
ext.ext_en: Outsiders who wed islanders are given only three years' right of abode at first.

defs.def_en: If someone is given the right of abode in a particular country, they are legally allowed to live there.

ext.ext_cn: 如与真人、真实地点或真实事件有雷同之处，纯属巧合。
ext.ext_en: Any resemblance to actual persons, places or events is purely coincidental...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为我们现在拥有了可以说是世界上最好的书店，这并非巧合。
ext.ext_en: I think that it is not coincidental that we now have arguably the best bookshops in the world.

defs.def_en: Something that is coincidental is the result of a coincidence and has not been deliberately arranged.

ext.ext_cn: 地球轨道呈椭圆形。
ext.ext_en: The Earth orbits in an ellipse.

defs.def_en: An ellipse is an oval shape similar to a circle but longer and flatter.

ext.ext_cn: 我身上没带身份证件，也就无法证实我就是车主。
ext.ext_en: I had no ID on me so I couldn't prove I was the owner of the car...

ext.ext_cn: 彼得掏出钱包向那人出示他的身份证件。
ext.ext_en: Peter took out his wallet and showed his ID to the man...

defs.def_en: If you have ID or an ID, you are carrying a document such as an identity card or driver's licence which proves that you are a particular person.

ext.ext_cn: 警方已经被进一步授权诱捕毒贩。
ext.ext_en: The police have been given extra powers to entrap drug traffickers...

ext.ext_cn: 他声称被告是被诱骗的，从而推翻了有罪的判决。
ext.ext_en: He overturned the conviction, saying the defendant was entrapped...

defs.def_en: If you entrap someone, you trick or deceive them and make them believe or do something wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 带镀金水龙头的大理石浴室
ext.ext_en: ...marble bathrooms with gold-plated taps.

defs.def_en: Something that is gold-plated is covered with a very thin layer of gold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他患有癫痫，但是拒绝服药治疗。
ext.ext_en: He was epileptic and refused to take medication for his condition.

ext.ext_cn: 他妻子是个癫痫患者。
ext.ext_en: His wife is an epileptic.

defs.def_en: Someone who is epileptic suffers from epilepsy.

ext.ext_cn: 他癫痫发作了。
ext.ext_en: He suffered an epileptic fit...

ext.ext_cn: 葆拉从没见过有人癫痫发作。
ext.ext_en: Paula had never seen an epileptic seizure.

defs.def_en: An epileptic fit is caused by epilepsy.

ext.ext_cn: 二战后该党党员人数已从5万人的峰值下降了。
ext.ext_en: The party's membership has fallen from a peak of fifty-thousand after the Second World War...

ext.ext_cn: 在最繁忙的交通早高峰期，那枚炸弹在一个混凝土垃圾箱里爆炸了。
ext.ext_en: The bomb went off in a concrete dustbin at the peak of the morning rush hour.

defs.def_en: The peak of a process or an activity is the point at which it is at its strongest, most successful, or most fully developed.

defs.def_cn: 达到顶点；达到顶峰；达到最高值

ext.ext_cn: 温度最高达30摄氏度以上。
ext.ext_en: Temperatures have peaked at over thirty degrees Celsius...

ext.ext_cn: 那场危机在1974年7月达到巅峰。
ext.ext_en: The crisis peaked in July 1974...

defs.def_en: When something peaks, it reaches its highest value or its highest level.

ext.ext_cn: 电话每分钟36便士（优惠费率）和48便士（高峰费率）。
ext.ext_en: Calls cost 36p (cheap rate) and 48p (peak rate) per minute...

ext.ext_cn: 我们买的时机不合适，买了个最高价。
ext.ext_en: We bought it at the wrong time and paid the peak price.

defs.def_en: The peak level or value of something is its highest level or value.

ext.ext_cn: 高峰期总是非常拥挤。
ext.ext_en: It's always crowded at peak times...

ext.ext_cn: 在高峰时期，有些酒店很难预订到房间。
ext.ext_en: During peak periods, reservations are difficult to make at some of the hotels.

defs.def_en: See also:peak time;Peak times are the times when there is most demand for something or most use of something.

ext.ext_cn: 积雪覆盖的山顶
ext.ext_en: ...the snow-covered peaks.

defs.def_en: A peak is a mountain or the top of a mountain.

ext.ext_cn: 那名男子摸了摸他的帽舌。
ext.ext_en: The man touched the peak of his cap.

defs.def_en: The peak of a cap is the part at the front that sticks out above your eyes.

defs.def_cn: 剥夺;使丧失;使不能享有

ext.ext_cn: 苏联解体使西方情报机构丧失了主敌。
ext.ext_en: The disintegration of the Soviet Union deprived western intelligence agencies of their main enemies...

ext.ext_cn: 他们没法得到家里取暖所必需的燃料。
ext.ext_en: They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.

defs.def_en: If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it.

defs.def_cn: （给飞机或其他交通工具）（再）加油;（给…）续燃料

ext.ext_cn: 他的飞机经停法国续加燃油。
ext.ext_en: His plane stopped in France to refuel...

ext.ext_cn: 航空公司的机务人员给飞机加了油。
ext.ext_en: The airline's crew refuelled the plane.

defs.def_en: When an aircraft or other vehicle refuels or when someone refuels it, it is filled with more fuel so that it can continue its journey.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （情感等）强烈得令人难以承受的，不可抗拒的

ext.ext_cn: 冷酷无情、难以遏制的愤怒
ext.ext_en: ...hard, cold, overpowering anger...

ext.ext_cn: 报复的欲望有时会压倒一切。
ext.ext_en: The desire for revenge can be overpowering.

defs.def_en: An overpowering feeling is so strong that you cannot resist it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （气味、声音等）盖过一切的，过于强烈的

ext.ext_cn: 有一股刺鼻的酒味。
ext.ext_en: There was an overpowering smell of alcohol...

ext.ext_cn: 噪音吵得人什么都听不清。
ext.ext_en: The noise was overpowering.

defs.def_en: An overpowering smell or sound is so strong that you cannot smell or hear anything else.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 温特夫人块头很大，个性也较强悍。
ext.ext_en: Mrs Winter was large and somewhat overpowering.

ext.ext_cn: 态度专横
ext.ext_en: ...an overpowering manner.

defs.def_en: An overpowering person makes other people feel uncomfortable because they have such a strong personality.

defs.def_cn: 把…放在一时记不起的地方;(因记不起放在何处而)暂时丢失

ext.ext_cn: 他老是记不起把自己阅读时用的放大镜放在什么地方，所以助手们会随身携带备用的。
ext.ext_en: He misplaces his reading glasses with such regularity that aides carry extras...

ext.ext_cn: 不知怎的，我忘了把装衣服的箱子放到哪里去了。
ext.ext_en: Somehow the suitcase with my clothes was misplaced.

defs.def_en: If you misplace something, you lose it, usually only temporarily.

ext.ext_cn: 警方正在搜捕杀害他的凶手。
ext.ext_en: The police are searching for his killers...

ext.ext_cn: 他是个精神变态杀人者。
ext.ext_en: He's a psychopath, a killer.

defs.def_en: A killer is a person who has killed someone, or who intends to kill someone.

ext.ext_cn: 在多数发达国家，心脏病是导致人们死亡的头号杀手。
ext.ext_en: Heart disease is the biggest killer of men in most developed countries.

defs.def_en: You can refer to something that causes death or is likely to cause death as a killer .

defs.def_cn: 特氟龙，聚四氟乙烯(一种防粘锅的涂料)
defs.def_en: Teflon is a type of plastic which is often used to coat pans. Teflon provides a very smooth surface which food does not stick to, so the pan can be cleaned easily.
The endocrine system is the system of glands that produce hormones which go directly into the bloodstream, such as the pituitary or thyroid glands.
A lightship is a small ship that stays in one place and has a powerful flashing lamp. Lightships are used to guide ships or to warn them of danger.
A drainboard is the same as a draining board .

ext.ext_cn: 麦加和麦地那圣地的神殿看守人
ext.ext_en: ...the custodian of the holy shrines in Mecca and Medina.

defs.def_en: The custodian of an official building, a companies' assets, or something else valuable is the person who is officially in charge of it.
Vertebrae are the small circular bones that form the spine of a human being or animal.
The high-water mark is the level reached in a particular place by the sea at high tide or by a river in flood.

ext.ext_cn: 这几乎肯定是她事业的巅峰。
ext.ext_en: This was almost certainly the high-water mark of her career...

ext.ext_cn: 这一时期代表了自由主义教派的全盛时期。
ext.ext_en: This period represented a high water mark for liberal denominations.

defs.def_en: The high-water mark of a process is its highest or most successful stage of achievement.

defs.def_cn: 下颌的轮廓；下巴的外形

ext.ext_cn: 高颧骨和轮廓分明的下巴
ext.ext_en: ...high cheekbones and strong jawline.

defs.def_en: Your jawline is the part of your lower jaw which forms the outline of the bottom of your face.

ext.ext_cn: 弗朗西丝卡修女走进小教堂，坐下来，很快就睡着了。
ext.ext_en: Sister Francesca entered the chapel, took her seat, and promptly fell asleep.

defs.def_en: If you do something promptly, you do it immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 我们于7点一刻准时离开了宾馆。
ext.ext_en: Promptly at a quarter past seven, we left the hotel.

defs.def_en: If you do something promptly at a particular time, you do it at exactly that time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （姿态或人）嬉戏的，闹着玩的，不当真的

ext.ext_cn: 在他鼻尖上的戏吻
ext.ext_en: ...a playful kiss on the tip of his nose.

ext.ext_cn: 嬉戏的打闹
ext.ext_en: ...a playful fight...

defs.def_en: A playful gesture or person is friendly or humorous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 顽皮的小狗
ext.ext_en: ...a playful puppy.

defs.def_en: A playful animal is lively and cheerful.

ext.ext_cn: 觉得现代生活中错综复杂的问题最难处理的那些人
ext.ext_en: ...those who find it hardest to cope with the complexities of modern life...

ext.ext_cn: 这个问题被错综复杂的法律体系所困扰。
ext.ext_en: The issue is surrounded by legal complexities.

defs.def_en: The complexities of something are the many complicated factors involved in it.
A warplane is an aircraft that is designed to be used for fighting, for example to attack other aircraft or to drop bombs.

defs.def_cn: 假装同情者；滥发善心的人

ext.ext_cn: 我可不是只说不做的自由主义者。
ext.ext_en: I'm not a bleeding heart liberal.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a bleeding heart, you are criticizing them for being sympathetic towards people who are poor and suffering, without doing anything practical to help.

defs.def_cn: （通常由于工业或商业的发展而迅速形成的）新兴城市，发达城市

ext.ext_cn: 布里斯班由于澳大利亚电影和电视业的发展而迅速变成了一个繁荣的都市。
ext.ext_en: Brisbane has become the boom town for Australian film and television.

defs.def_en: A boom town is a town which has rapidly become very rich and full of people, usually because industry or business has developed there.

defs.def_cn: 松弛的肌肉，赘肉(尤用于挑剔某人时)

ext.ext_cn: 唐的腰间沉甸甸地坠着一圈赘肉。
ext.ext_en: Don had a hefty roll of flab overhanging his waistband.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has flab, you mean they have loose flesh on their body because they are rather fat, especially when you are being critical of them.
Field hockey is an outdoor game played on a grass field between two teams of 11 players who use long curved sticks to hit a small ball and try to score goals.

defs.def_cn: （海岸或大江、大河的）后方地区，腹地，内地

ext.ext_cn: 法国地中海沿岸及其腹地
ext.ext_en: ...the French Mediterranean coast and its hinterland.

defs.def_en: The hinterland of a stretch of coast or a large river is the area of land behind it or around it.

ext.ext_cn: 飞行员抱怨说在高湿度条件下，“幻影”战斗机上的雷达出现了故障。
ext.ext_en: Pilots complained that the radars in the Mirages malfunctioned during conditions of high humidity...

ext.ext_cn: 飞机是在从米兰出发的飞行途中从雷达屏上消失的。
ext.ext_en: The aircraft was on a flight from Milan when it disappeared from radar screens.

defs.def_en: Radar is a way of discovering the position or speed of objects such as aircraft or ships when they cannot be seen, by using radio signals.

ext.ext_cn: 责任之大让我惊慌失措。
ext.ext_en: I was numbed by the enormity of the responsibility...

ext.ext_cn: 他为眼前任务的艰巨性而担忧。
ext.ext_en: He was anxious about the enormity of the task ahead.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the enormity of something that you consider to be a problem or difficulty, you are referring to its very great size, extent, or seriousness.

ext.ext_cn: 对于已经发生的灾难，其严重性不该小视。
ext.ext_en: It makes no sense to belittle the enormity of the disaster which has occurred.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the enormity of an event, you are emphasizing that it is terrible and frightening.

ext.ext_cn: 他们犯下的滔天大罪
ext.ext_en: ...the enormities they committed.

ext.ext_cn: 奴隶制代表的罪恶
ext.ext_en: ...the enormity of what slavery meant.

defs.def_en: An enormity is an action that is considered totally unacceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 他一直用麻袋布包着棍子。
ext.ext_en: He kept the club wrapped in sackcloth.

defs.def_en: Sackcloth is rough woven material that is used to make sacks.

ext.ext_cn: 他接着又说到了自己不负责任的行为以及可能对孩子们造成的恶劣影响等等。一时间捶胸顿足，懊悔不已。
ext.ext_en: He went on about his irresponsible behaviour, the dreadful effect it would have on his children and so on. It was all sackcloth and ashes.

defs.def_en: If you talk about sackcloth or sackcloth and ashes you are referring to an exaggerated attempt by someone to show that they are sorry for doing something wrong.
A fault line is a long crack in the surface of the earth. Earthquakes usually occur along fault lines.

defs.def_cn: 薄弱之处;薄弱环节;软肋

ext.ext_cn: 这些问题显然已成为了和平进程中的薄弱环节。
ext.ext_en: These issues have created a stark fault line within the Peace Process.

defs.def_en: A fault line in a system or process is an area of it that seems weak and likely to cause problems or failure.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 刺骨的寒风于开阔处呼啸着。
ext.ext_en: An icy wind blew hard across the open spaces...

ext.ext_cn: 他的鞋和衣服都湿透了，冰冷冰冷的。
ext.ext_en: His shoes and clothing were wet through and icy cold.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as icy or icy cold, you mean that it is extremely cold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: An icy road has ice on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 冷冰冰的;不友好的;冷漠的

ext.ext_cn: 他反应冷淡。
ext.ext_en: His response was icy.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as icy, you mean that they are not affectionate or friendly, and they show their dislike or anger in a quiet, controlled way.

defs.def_cn: （尤指代表更多人提出投诉的）代表团

ext.ext_cn: 村里的长者代表团在村长的带领下到达了。
ext.ext_en: A deputation of elders from the village arrived headed by its chief.

defs.def_en: A deputation is a small group of people who have been asked to speak to someone on behalf of a larger group of people, especially in order to make a complaint.

ext.ext_cn: 西澳大利亚工党政府明年春天要举行选举。
ext.ext_en: The Labor government of Western Australia has an election due next spring...

ext.ext_cn: 我们于 1977 年春季再次见面。
ext.ext_en: We met again in the spring of 1977.

defs.def_en: Spring is the season between winter and summer when the weather becomes warmer and plants start to grow again.

ext.ext_cn: 遗憾的是，当一张标准床垫用旧后，弹簧就会变软而无法支撑你的脊椎。
ext.ext_en: Unfortunately, as a standard mattress wears, the springs soften and so do not support your spine...

ext.ext_cn: 燃料泵里的两个弹簧都断了。
ext.ext_en: Both springs in the fuel pump were broken.

defs.def_en: A spring is a spiral of wire which returns to its original shape after it is pressed or pulled.

ext.ext_cn: 北边是班亚斯德桑隆温泉。
ext.ext_en: To the north are the hot springs of Banyas de Sant Loan.

defs.def_en: A spring is a place where water comes up through the ground. It is also the water that comes from that place.

ext.ext_cn: 他一跃而起，从茶几上一把抓起自己的钥匙。
ext.ext_en: He sprang to his feet, grabbing his keys off the coffee table...

ext.ext_cn: 当他们走近时，每扇门外都有一名卫兵肃身立正。
ext.ext_en: Outside each door a guard sprang to attention as they approached...

defs.def_en: When a person or animal springs, they jump upwards or forwards suddenly or quickly.

defs.def_cn: (突然朝某个方向)迅速移动，弹开

ext.ext_cn: 不幸的是，当后备箱的盖子弹开时，里面却是空的。
ext.ext_en: Sadly when the lid of the boot sprang open, it was empty.

defs.def_en: If something springs in a particular direction, it moves suddenly and quickly.

defs.def_cn: 突然活跃起来;突然出现

ext.ext_cn: 她 8 月初和我联系请求帮助时，我和沙伦便立即行动起来了。
ext.ext_en: When she contacted me at the beginning of August to enlist support, Sharon and I sprang into action.

ext.ext_cn: 在 20 世纪 20 年代突然出现的新型工业
ext.ext_en: ...new industries which had sprung into life during the 1920s.

defs.def_en: If things or people spring into action or spring to life, they suddenly start being active or suddenly come into existence.

ext.ext_cn: 埃塞俄比亚的艺术起源于其早期的基督教和伊斯兰教文化遗产。
ext.ext_en: Ethiopia's art springs from her early Christian as well as her Muslim heritage...

ext.ext_cn: 失去一生中的至爱让他悲痛不已，愤怒涌上他的心头。
ext.ext_en: His anger sprang from his suffering at the loss of the most important love he had ever known in his life.

defs.def_en: If one thing springs from another thing, it is the result of it.

ext.ext_cn: 帆船的船体上出现了一条裂缝。
ext.ext_en: The yacht has sprung a leak in the hull.

defs.def_en: If a boat or container springs a leak, water or some other liquid starts coming in or out through a crack.

defs.def_cn: 冷不防地说;突然告诉(或宣布)

ext.ext_cn: 两个超级大国的领导人昨天在白宫的一个仪式上突然签署了一项贸易协定，令人倍感意外。
ext.ext_en: The two superpower leaders sprang a surprise at a ceremony in the White House yesterday by signing a trade deal...

ext.ext_cn: 麦克拉伦突然告诉他一个新想法。
ext.ext_en: Mclaren sprang a new idea on him.

defs.def_en: If you spring some news or a surprise on someone, you tell them something that they did not expect to hear, without warning them.

ext.ext_cn: 把申请表的白色部分撕下存底。
ext.ext_en: Detach the white part of the application form and keep it...

ext.ext_cn: 很容易就能把醋栗从梗上摘下来。
ext.ext_en: It is easy to detach the currants from the stems...

defs.def_en: If you detach one thing from another that it is fixed to, you remove it. If one thing detaches from another, it becomes separated from it.

ext.ext_cn: 这有助于他们从所面临的问题中跳出来，变得更客观一些。
ext.ext_en: It helps them detach themselves from their problems and become more objective.

defs.def_en: If you detach yourself from something, you become less involved in it or less concerned about it than you used to be.

ext.ext_cn: 亚历克西斯看到父亲离开那一群人，独自走下山去了。
ext.ext_en: Alexis saw his father detach himself from the group and walk away down the hill by himself.

defs.def_en: If you detach yourself from a person or place, you leave them.
A boarding card is a card which a passenger must have when boarding a plane or a boat.

defs.def_cn: 该死的;他妈的;十足的;完全的

ext.ext_cn: 这个该死的会议似乎永远也开不完。
ext.ext_en: The damned meeting seemed endless...

ext.ext_cn: 他们真是十足的讨厌鬼。
ext.ext_en: They're a damned nuisance.

defs.def_en: Damned is used by some people to emphasize what they are saying, especially when they are angry or frustrated.
According to some religions, the damned are people whose punishment is to stay in hell for ever after they have died.

If someone says 'I'm damned if I'm going to do it' or 'I'll be damned if I'll do it', they are emphasizing that they do not intend to do something and think it is unreasonable for anyone to expect them to do it.
Some people say 'I'll be damned!' when they are expressing surprise at something.

defs.def_cn: 勾引男人的女子;妖妇;狐狸精

ext.ext_cn: 超级名模简·布拉克内尔扮演一个性感女郎来勾引他。
ext.ext_en: Supermodel Jane Bracknel plays a nubile temptress out to seduce him.

defs.def_en: If you describe a woman as a temptress, you mean that she uses her female charm to encourage men to have sexual relations with her.

defs.def_cn: 磨碎；碾碎； 将…磨成粉

ext.ext_cn: 将胡椒粒储存在密封容器中，在需要的时候磨成粉。
ext.ext_en: Store the peppercorns in an airtight container and grind the pepper as you need it.

ext.ext_cn: 现磨咖啡的香气
ext.ext_en: ...the odor of fresh ground coffee.

defs.def_en: If you grind a substance such as corn, you crush it between two hard surfaces or with a machine until it becomes a fine powder.

ext.ext_cn: “好吧，”我边说边紧张不安地把香烟在花岗岩台阶上捻灭。
ext.ext_en: 'Well,' I said, grinding my cigarette nervously into the granite step.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你知道自己在磨牙，尤其是在夜间，你应该去看看牙医。
ext.ext_en: If you know you're grinding your teeth, particularly at night, see your dentist.

defs.def_en: If you grind something into a surface, you press and rub it hard into the surface using small circular or sideways movements.

defs.def_cn: 把…磨锋利；把…磨快；把…磨光

ext.ext_cn: 磨刀铺
ext.ext_en: ...a shop where they grind knives...

ext.ext_cn: 可以把尖端磨得更锋利些，这样切割起来更顺更快。
ext.ext_en: The tip can be ground to a much sharper edge to cut smoother and faster.

defs.def_en: If you grind something, you make it smooth or sharp by rubbing it against a hard surface.

ext.ext_cn: 坦克队于5点15分越过边境，正轰隆隆地缓慢向南开进。
ext.ext_en: Tanks had crossed the border at five fifteen and were grinding south.

defs.def_en: If a vehicle grinds somewhere, it moves there very slowly and noisily.

ext.ext_cn: 重型机器发出的刺耳的摩擦声会让他们心烦意乱。
ext.ext_en: The grind of heavy machines could get on their nerves.

defs.def_en: The grind of a machine is the harsh, scraping noise that it makes, usually because it is old or is working too hard.

ext.ext_cn: 枯燥的日常政务都由女王陛下的政府行政部门来处理。
ext.ext_en: The daily grind of government is done by Her Majesty's Civil Service...

ext.ext_cn: 生活对于平头百姓而言依然是理不清的琐事。
ext.ext_en: Life continues to be a terrible grind for the ordinary person.

defs.def_en: If you refer to routine tasks or activities as the grind, you mean they are boring and take up a lot of time and effort.

ext.ext_cn: 当以色列竭力组建新政府的时候，和平进程已经陷于停顿。
ext.ext_en: The peace process has ground to a halt while Israel struggles to form a new government.

defs.def_en: If a country's economy or something such as a process grinds to a halt, it gradually becomes slower or less active until it stops.

ext.ext_cn: 由于燃油被人抽走，这些坦克行驶了100码后又轰隆隆地缓缓停了下来。
ext.ext_en: The tanks ground to a halt after a hundred yards because the fuel had been siphoned out.

defs.def_en: If a vehicle grinds to a halt, it stops slowly and noisily.
A gardener is a person who is paid to work in someone else's garden.

ext.ext_cn: 热衷园艺的业余爱好者
ext.ext_en: ...enthusiastic amateur gardeners.

defs.def_en: A gardener is someone who enjoys working in their own garden growing flowers or vegetables.
A seedling is a young plant that has been grown from a seed.

ext.ext_cn: 我曾在几家书店停留，翻看里面的书。
ext.ext_en: I stopped in several bookstores to browse...

ext.ext_cn: 她逛了一家高级古董店。
ext.ext_en: She browsed in an up-market antiques shop...

defs.def_en: If you browse in a shop, you look at things in a fairly casual way, in the hope that you might find something you like.

ext.ext_cn: 坐在沙发上翻阅报纸上的电视节目版面
ext.ext_en: ...sitting on the sofa browsing through the TV pages of the paper...

ext.ext_cn: 有大量传记供他浏览。
ext.ext_en: There are plenty of biographies for him to browse over.

defs.def_en: If you browse through a book or magazine, you look through it in a fairly casual way.

defs.def_cn: （尤指使用电脑在万维网上）浏览信息

ext.ext_cn: 试着在网络论坛上浏览信息。
ext.ext_en: Try browsing around in the network bulletin boards.

defs.def_en: If you browse on a computer, you search for information in computer files or on the Internet, especially on the World Wide Web.

ext.ext_cn: 在距我的小屋50码远的森林边缘吃草的3只牡赤鹿
ext.ext_en: ...the three red deer stags browsing 50 yards from my lodge on the fringes of the forest.

defs.def_en: When animals browse, they feed on plants.

ext.ext_cn: 一连串的不幸事件
ext.ext_en: ...a series of misadventures...

ext.ext_cn: 判定为意外死亡。
ext.ext_en: A verdict of death by misadventure was recorded.

defs.def_en: A misadventure is an unfortunate incident.

ext.ext_cn: “厨房里还有没有老鼠洞？”——“我已经把它们堵死了。”
ext.ext_en: 'Any holes in the kitchen where the mice are getting through?' – 'I've blocked them up.'...

ext.ext_cn: 往出汗的鼻子上扑粉只会堵塞毛孔，使皮肤更加不舒服。
ext.ext_en: Powdering a sweaty nose will only block up the pores and make the skin more uncomfortable...

defs.def_en: If you block something up or if it blocks up, it is blocked completely so that nothing can get through it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 全异的;完全不同的;异类的

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们正试图将天文学中的各派观点整合在一起。
ext.ext_en: Scientists are trying to pull together disparate ideas in astronomy...

ext.ext_cn: 这9个共和国在面积、文化和财富上迥然不同。
ext.ext_en: The nine republics are immensely disparate in size, culture and wealth.

defs.def_en: Disparate things are clearly different from each other in quality or type.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一个区域性差异巨大的多元化国度
ext.ext_en: ...a very disparate nation, with enormous regional differences.

ext.ext_cn: 他们由南方保守党和自由党结成的多党派联盟
ext.ext_en: ...their disparate coalition of Southern conservatives and liberals.

defs.def_en: A disparate thing is made up of very different elements.

defs.def_cn: 毕格尔猎犬（短腿短毛长耳的猎兔犬）
defs.def_en: A beagle is a short-haired black and brown dog with long ears and short legs. It is kept as a pet or sometimes used for hunting.

defs.def_cn: 加入（讨论）;订立（协议）;开始（关系）

ext.ext_cn: 我还没有和他们订立任何财务协定。
ext.ext_en: I have not entered into any financial agreements with them...

ext.ext_cn: 几周前，我们和他们进行了意义深远的讨论。
ext.ext_en: We entered into meaningful discussions with them weeks ago...

defs.def_en: If you enter into something such as an agreement, discussion, or relationship, you become involved in it. You can also say that two people enter into something.

defs.def_cn: 成为…的一部分；成为…的一个因素；构成

ext.ext_cn: 管弦乐编曲还要考虑其他因素。
ext.ext_en: There were also other factors that entered into the orchestration.

defs.def_en: If one thing enters into another, it is a factor in it.

ext.ext_cn: 长满刺的山楂树
ext.ext_en: ...thorny hawthorn trees.

defs.def_en: A thorny plant or tree is covered with thorns.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (问题)棘手的，复杂难解的，令人头疼的

ext.ext_cn: 移民政策这个棘手问题
ext.ext_en: ...the thorny issue of immigration policy...

ext.ext_cn: 我们很有必要处理这个棘手问题。
ext.ext_en: It is essential that we tackle this thorny problem.

defs.def_en: If you describe a problem as thorny, you mean that it is very complicated and difficult to solve, and that people are often unwilling to discuss it.

ext.ext_cn: 你不应该为此事沾沾自喜。
ext.ext_en: This is not a matter for self-congratulation.

defs.def_en: If someone keeps emphasizing how well they have done or how good they are, you can refer to their behaviour as self-congratulation .

ext.ext_cn: 我找到手可以抓的地方往上爬。
ext.ext_en: I found handholds and hoisted myself along.

defs.def_en: A handhold is a small hole or hollow in something such as rock or a wall that you can put your hand in if you are trying to climb it.
A ring binder is a file with hard covers, which you can insert pages into. The pages are held in by metal rings on a bar attached to the inside of the file.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她不惧权威，幽默风趣，很受欢迎。
ext.ext_en: She's irreverent, fun and hugely popular...

ext.ext_cn: 泰勒知识渊博，而且并不把历史太当回事。
ext.ext_en: Taylor combined great knowledge with an irreverent attitude to history.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as irreverent, you mean that they do not show respect for people or things that are generally respected.

defs.def_cn: 不间断的；不变的；持续的；长久的

ext.ext_cn: 永久联盟的创立
ext.ext_en: ...the creation of a perpetual union.

defs.def_en: A perpetual feeling, state, or quality is one that never ends or changes.

defs.def_cn: 连续不断的；无尽无休的；没完没了的

ext.ext_cn: 我想我再也受不了她无休无止的抱怨了。 per|pet|ual|ly
ext.ext_en: I thought her perpetual complaints were going to prove too much for me.

ext.ext_cn: 不断再现的奇迹
ext.ext_en: ...a perpetually renewed miracle...

defs.def_en: A perpetual act, situation, or state is one that happens again and again and so seems never to end.

ext.ext_cn: 夫妻两人对他们婚姻出现问题的谣言一笑置之。
ext.ext_en: The couple laughed off rumours that their marriage was in trouble...

ext.ext_cn: 这种事情我从前会付之一笑，但现在开始觉得挺烦的。
ext.ext_en: Whilst I used to laugh it off, I'm now getting irritated by it.

defs.def_en: If you laugh off a difficult or serious situation, you try to suggest that it is amusing and unimportant, for example by making a joke about it.

ext.ext_cn: 这座城市建在岩石上，四周筑有城墙。
ext.ext_en: The city was walled and built upon a rock.

ext.ext_cn: 带围墙的玫瑰花园
ext.ext_en: ...a walled rose garden.

defs.def_en: If an area of land or a city is walled, it is surrounded or enclosed by a wall.
A polecat is a small, thin, fierce wild animal. Polecats have a very unpleasant smell.

ext.ext_cn: 她站在那儿，凝视着镜中的自己。
ext.ext_en: She stood gazing at herself in the mirror...

ext.ext_cn: 他坐在藤椅上，若有所思地凝视着炉火。
ext.ext_en: Sitting in his wicker chair, he gazed reflectively at the fire...

defs.def_en: If you gaze at someone or something, you look steadily at them for a long time, for example because you find them attractive or interesting, or because you are thinking about something else.

ext.ext_cn: 这位大人凝视的目光离开火苗，与上校的目光相遇。
ext.ext_en: The Monsignor turned his gaze from the flames to meet the Colonel's...

ext.ext_cn: 那个女人一直盯着她看，让她觉得愈发不自在了。
ext.ext_en: She felt increasingly uncomfortable under the woman's  steady gaze...

defs.def_en: You can talk about someone's gaze as a way of describing how they are looking at something, especially when they are looking steadily at it.

ext.ext_cn: 没有比迈克尔和莉齐更受人瞩目的夫妇了。
ext.ext_en: You won't find a couple more in the public gaze than Michael and Lizzie.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is in the public gaze, they are receiving a lot of attention from the general public.

ext.ext_cn: 她和其他3个女孩合租一套房子。
ext.ext_en: She rents a house with three other girls...

ext.ext_cn: 他开着一辆租来的车离开了酒店。
ext.ext_en: He left his hotel in a rented car.

defs.def_en: If you rent something, you regularly pay its owner a sum of money in order to be able to have it and use it yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 她把房间租给了大学生。
ext.ext_en: She rented rooms to university students.

ext.ext_cn: 他在国外工作期间把自己的房子租了出去。
ext.ext_en: He rented out his house while he worked abroad...

defs.def_en: If you rent something to someone, you let them have it and use it in exchange for a sum of money which they pay you regularly.

ext.ext_cn: 在我读大学期间，她打工挣钱来付租金。
ext.ext_en: She worked to pay the rent while I went to college...

ext.ext_cn: 大理石拱门的经销商们面临租金的大幅上涨。
ext.ext_en: Traders in Marble Arch are facing huge rent increases.

defs.def_en: Rent is the amount of money that you pay regularly to use a house, flat, or piece of land.
A cake tin is a metal container that you bake a cake in.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 清晰可见的;摸得着的;感觉得到的;明显的

ext.ext_cn: 应该有明显迹象表明经济开始复苏了。
ext.ext_en: There should be some tangible evidence that the economy is starting to recover...

ext.ext_cn: 这种解脱几乎可以感觉得到。
ext.ext_en: The relief was almost tangible.

defs.def_en: If something is tangible, it is clear enough or definite enough to be easily seen, felt, or noticed.

defs.def_cn: (常指男人的脸)轮廓分明的，有棱有角的

ext.ext_cn: 女人抵挡不住他那轮廓分明的脸庞的诱惑。
ext.ext_en: Women find his chiselled features irresistible.

ext.ext_cn: 棱角分明的下巴
ext.ext_en: ...a chiselled jaw.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone, usually a man, has chiselled features, you mean that their face has a strong, clear bone structure.
A harbourmaster is the official in charge of a harbour.

defs.def_cn: 避开，躲开，防止(危险、疾病等)

ext.ext_cn: 她可能进行了顽强的反抗，试图击退袭击者。

defs.def_en: To wipe out something such as a place or a group of people or animals means to destroy them completely.

defs.def_cn: (打高尔夫球等时不小心)削起的小块草皮和泥土
defs.def_en: A divot is a small piece of grass and earth which is dug out accidentally, for example by a golf club.

ext.ext_cn: 学习能力低下的儿童
ext.ext_en: ...educationally subnormal children.

ext.ext_cn: 她在一所智障学校上学。
ext.ext_en: She attended a school for the educationally subnormal.

defs.def_en: If someone is subnormal, they have less ability or intelligence than a normal person of their age.

ext.ext_cn: 在我11岁的时候，妈妈让我去上演说技巧课。
ext.ext_en: When I was 11 my mother sent me to elocution lessons.

defs.def_en: Elocution lessons are lessons in which someone is taught to speak clearly and in an accent that is considered to be standard and acceptable.
A catheter is a tube which is used to introduce liquids into a human body or to withdraw liquids from it.

defs.def_cn: 含糊不清；不明确；模棱两可

ext.ext_cn: 协议这一部分的真正含义很不明确。
ext.ext_en: There is considerable ambiguity about what this part of the agreement actually means.

ext.ext_cn: 语言的模棱两可
ext.ext_en: ...the ambiguities of language.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is ambiguity in something, you mean that it is unclear or confusing, or it can be understood in more than one way.

ext.ext_cn: 该作家的风格表明其道德观有点暧昧不明。
ext.ext_en: The author's style suggests a certain ambiguity in his moral view.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is an ambiguity in a situation or in someone's character, you mean that it contains several different qualities or attitudes which do not fit well together.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 观点明确的；坚决主张的

ext.ext_cn: 女性在过去十年中已变得更加自信。
ext.ext_en: Women have become more assertive in the past decade.

ext.ext_cn: 果断的管理作风
ext.ext_en: ...an assertive style of management.

defs.def_en: Someone who is assertive states their needs and opinions clearly, so that people take notice.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 确信的;确知的;肯定的;有把握的

ext.ext_cn: 他以前从未教过课，甚至不确定自己该不该教课。
ext.ext_en: He'd never been in a class before and he was not even sure that he should have been teaching...

ext.ext_cn: 总统一直都不确定自己想从哪个方面来着手处理该问题。
ext.ext_en: The president has never been sure which direction he wanted to go in on this issue...

defs.def_en: If you are sure that something is true, you are certain that it is true. If you are not sure about something, you do not know for certain what the true situation is.

defs.def_cn: 一定的;必定的;无疑的;确保的

ext.ext_cn: 许多人认为最好是接受付费教育，这样能确保教学质量。
ext.ext_en: A lot of people think that it's better to pay for their education so that they can be sure of getting quality...

ext.ext_cn: 年轻一代的自信让他们对成功志在必得。
ext.ext_en: It is the self-assurance of the new generation which makes them sure of their success.

defs.def_en: If someone is sure of getting something, they will definitely get it or they think they will definitely get it.

ext.ext_cn: 有 80 多个海滩可供选择，你一定能找到一处满意的。
ext.ext_en: With over 80 beaches to choose from, you are sure to find a place to lay your towel...

ext.ext_cn: 任何人如果采购食物时没列清单的话，肯定会忘了真正需要的东西。
ext.ext_en: Anyone who goes food shopping without a list is sure to forget the things they really need.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is sure to happen, you are emphasizing your belief that it will happen.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不容置疑的;确切的;可靠的;保险的

ext.ext_cn: 夏普的腿和肩膀开始疼痛，这预示着肯定要下雨了。
ext.ext_en: Sharpe's leg and shoulder began to ache, a sure sign of rain...

ext.ext_cn: 她对扫盲、贫穷和儿童保育等社会问题都有深切的认识。
ext.ext_en: She has a sure grasp of social issues such as literacy, poverty and child care.

defs.def_en: Sure is used to emphasize that something such as a sign or ability is reliable or accurate.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 务必看看莫泽雷勒干酪是怎么制成的，在第 65 页。
ext.ext_en: Be sure to read about how mozzarella is made, on page 65...

ext.ext_cn: 要确保每天的钙摄入量。
ext.ext_en: Be sure you get your daily quota of calcium.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to be sure to do something, you mean that they must not forget to do it.

ext.ext_cn: “他给你打电话了？”——“没错。昨天晚上打的。”
ext.ext_en: 'He rang you?' — 'Sure. Last night.'...

ext.ext_cn: “我想一个人呆会儿，好吗？”——“好的，没问题。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'd like to be alone, O.K?' — 'Sure. O.K.'...

defs.def_en: Sure is an informal way of saying 'yes' or 'all right'.

ext.ext_cn: “整个世界难道都疯了吗？”——“看上去的确如此，不是吗。”
ext.ext_en: 'Has the whole world just gone crazy?' — 'Sure looks that way, doesn't it.'

ext.ext_cn: 天的确太热了，他想。
ext.ext_en: It sure is hot, he thought.

defs.def_en: You can use sure in order to emphasize what you are saying.

defs.def_cn: 果真，果然(尤用在讲故事时)

ext.ext_cn: 我们觉得英国糖蜜布丁太好吃了，令人无法抗拒。的确非常美味。
ext.ext_en: We found the English treacle pudding too good to resist. Sure enough, it was delicious...

ext.ext_cn: 我正在逛商店，突然看到一位女士在仔细地打量我。她认出了我，果不其然，她走了过来。
ext.ext_en: I was in a shop when I saw a lady looking carefully at me. She'd recognised me, and sure enough, she came across.

defs.def_en: You say sure enough, especially when telling a story, to confirm that something was really true or was actually happening.

ext.ext_cn: 有一点可以肯定，阿斯特伯里的演唱风格多年来没怎么改变。
ext.ext_en: One thing's for sure, Astbury's vocal style hasn't changed much over the years...

ext.ext_cn: 即使到现在我们也不确定究竟发生了什么。
ext.ext_en: Even to this day we don't know what happened for sure.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is for sure or that you know it for sure, you mean that it is definitely true.

ext.ext_cn: 一定要认真按照操作指南来做。
ext.ext_en: Make sure that you follow the instructions carefully...

ext.ext_cn: 他想确保学校尽力提供新型教育。
ext.ext_en: He wants to make sure that schools are committed to providing alternative education.

defs.def_en: If you make sure that something is done, you take action so that it is done.

ext.ext_cn: 他往浴室里看了看，确定就他一个人。
ext.ext_en: He looked in the bathroom to make sure that he was alone...

ext.ext_cn: 在裁剪布料前要确保两个边缘的图案对称。
ext.ext_en: Before you cut the cloth, make sure that the pattern matches up on both edges.

defs.def_en: If you make sure that something is the way that you want or expect it to be, you check that it is that way.

ext.ext_cn: 这个提议绝不会理所当然地获得通过。
ext.ext_en: This proposal is by no means a sure thing.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a sure thing, you mean that you are certain that it will happen or be successful.

ext.ext_cn: “要多加小心!”——“一定会的，爸爸。再见。”
ext.ext_en: 'Be careful!' — 'Sure thing, Dad. So long.'

defs.def_en: You say 'sure thing' to show that you agree with someone or will do as they say.

defs.def_cn: (承认属实)诚然，固然，无可否认

ext.ext_cn: 规矩由父母立下。诚然，其中有许多放在今天已不再合适了。
ext.ext_en: Parents make the rules. To be sure, many of the rules are no longer appropriate today.

defs.def_en: You use to be sure when you are admitting that something is true, although it seems to contradict a more general statement that you are making.

ext.ext_cn: 我从来没见他如此自信满满、指挥自若。
ext.ext_en: I'd never seen him like this, so sure of himself, so in command.

defs.def_en: If you are sure of yourself, you are very confident about your own abilities or opinions.

ext.ext_cn: 在离开药房之前，一定要弄明白自己的药该怎么吃。
ext.ext_en: Make sure you understand exactly how to take your medicines before you leave the pharmacy.

ext.ext_cn: 杂货店的药房
ext.ext_en: ...the pharmacy section of the drugstore.

defs.def_en: A pharmacy is a shop or a department in a shop where medicines are sold or given out.

ext.ext_cn: 他花了4年时间学习药剂学。
ext.ext_en: He spent four years studying pharmacy.

defs.def_en: Pharmacy is the job or the science of preparing medicines.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 夜晚和他的心情一样阴郁。
ext.ext_en: The night was as melancholic as his mood.

ext.ext_cn: 他温柔而伤感的歌曲
ext.ext_en: ...his gentle, melancholic songs.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as melancholic, you mean that they are very sad.

ext.ext_cn: 6,550 万公吨煤
ext.ext_en: ...65.5 million tonnes of coal...

ext.ext_cn: 极品泰国香米卖得了 1 公吨 340 美元。
ext.ext_en: Top quality Thai rice fetched $340 a tonne.

defs.def_en: A tonne is a metric unit of weight that is equal to 1000 kilograms.
TESOL is the teaching of English to people whose first language is not English. TESOL is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'teaching English to speakers of other languages'.

defs.def_cn: (不载人)航天探测器，太空探测器
defs.def_en: A space probe is a spacecraft with no people in it which is sent into space in order to study the planets and send information about them back to earth.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不相信的;不轻信的;怀疑的

ext.ext_cn: “他强迫你做的？”她的语气里带着怀疑。
ext.ext_en: 'He made you do it?' Her voice was incredulous...

ext.ext_cn: 有一段短暂的充满怀疑的沉默。
ext.ext_en: There was a brief, incredulous silence.

defs.def_en: If someone is incredulous, they are unable to believe something because it is very surprising or shocking.

defs.def_cn: (使)复苏;(使)复兴;(使)恢复;(使)再次流行

ext.ext_cn: 试图复兴英国经济的努力
ext.ext_en: ...an attempt to revive the British economy...

ext.ext_cn: 他的受审重新勾起了在战争中受苦受难的法国人民的回忆。
ext.ext_en: His trial revived memories of French suffering during the war...

defs.def_en: When something such as the economy, a business, a trend, or a feeling is revived or when it revives, it becomes active, popular, or successful again.

defs.def_cn: 重新上演(戏剧、歌剧或芭蕾等)

ext.ext_cn: 盖伊提剧院正在重新上演约翰·B. 基恩的喜剧《来自克莱尔的人》。
ext.ext_en: The Gaiety is reviving John B. Kean's comedy 'The Man from Clare'.

defs.def_en: When someone revives a play, opera, or ballet, they present a new production of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她和邻居想尽一切办法都没能让他苏醒过来。
ext.ext_en: She and a neighbour tried in vain to revive him...

ext.ext_cn: 她最后清醒了一会儿，眼神呆滞。
ext.ext_en: With a glazed stare she revived for one last instant.

defs.def_en: If you manage to revive someone who has fainted or if they revive, they become conscious again.

defs.def_cn: 削弱;使势力减弱;使无效

ext.ext_cn: 左派持不同政见者已经遭到削弱和排挤。
ext.ext_en: Left-wing dissidents have been emasculated and marginalised...

ext.ext_cn: 公司试图削弱工会的力量。
ext.ext_en: The company tried to emasculate the unions...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is emasculated, they have been made weak and ineffective.

ext.ext_cn: 托什是出了名的天不怕地不怕，但是他明显被他的女朋友驯服帖了。
ext.ext_en: Tosh was known to be a man who feared no-one, yet he was clearly emasculated by his girlfriend.

defs.def_en: If a man is emasculated, he loses his male role, identity, or qualities.

defs.def_cn: (采用模仿手法的)滑稽短剧，幽默讽刺小品

ext.ext_cn: 巧妙地讽刺了流行歌曲的滑稽短剧
ext.ext_en: ...clever skits on popular songs.

defs.def_en: A skit is a short performance in which the actors make fun of people, events, and types of literature by imitating them.

defs.def_cn: (I have 的常用口语形式，尤其当 have 用作助动词时)

ext.ext_cn: 我受邀会见美国大使。
ext.ext_en: I've been invited to meet with the American Ambassador...

ext.ext_cn: 我没有其他安排。
ext.ext_en: I've no other appointments.

defs.def_en: I've is the usual spoken form of 'I have', especially when 'have' is an auxiliary verb.

defs.def_cn: (钱等)分作小量点滴给予，细水长流

ext.ext_cn: 采取明智策略分批买入股票的投资者
ext.ext_en: ...investors who adopt the sensible policy of drip feeding money into shares.

defs.def_en: If you drip-feed money into something, you pay the money a little at a time rather than paying it all at once.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的被捕标志着一场另有120人被拘留的行动的结束。
ext.ext_en: Their arrest was the culmination of an operation in which 120 other people were detained.

defs.def_en: Something, especially something important, that is the culmination of an activity, process, or series of events happens at the end of it.
A common noun is a noun such as 'tree', 'water', or 'beauty' that is not the name of one particular person or thing.

defs.def_cn: (伤口或身体部位)受感染的，感染病菌的

ext.ext_cn: 天花板上的一小片熟石膏掉到他眼里，致使他的眼睛感染了。
ext.ext_en: A flake of plaster from the ceiling fell into his eye, which became septic.

ext.ext_cn: 受感染的脚趾
ext.ext_en: ...a septic toe.

defs.def_en: If a wound or a part of your body becomes septic, it becomes infected.

ext.ext_cn: 那名枪手瞄准了德比利，伺机而动。
ext.ext_en: The gunman had singled Debilly out and waited for him...

ext.ext_cn: 他的顶头上司特别提到了他。
ext.ext_en: His immediate superior has singled him out for a special mention...

defs.def_en: If you single someone out from a group, you choose them and give them special attention or treatment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自我吹嘘的；自吹自擂的

ext.ext_cn: 我不是在吹牛。
ext.ext_en: I'm not being boastful.

ext.ext_cn: 夸海口
ext.ext_en: ...boastful predictions.

defs.def_en: If someone is boastful, they talk too proudly about something that they have done or that they own.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无宗教信仰的;反对宗教的

ext.ext_cn: 无宗教信仰的共产主义者
ext.ext_en: ...irreligious communists.

defs.def_en: An irreligious person does not accept the beliefs of any religion or opposes all religions.

defs.def_cn: 欢喜；兴奋；（常指）幸灾乐祸

ext.ext_cn: 他的美国高尔夫球队友们为他的胜利感到欢欣鼓舞。
ext.ext_en: His victory was greeted with glee by his fellow American golfers...

ext.ext_cn: 那封被泄密的信让记者们很是兴奋。
ext.ext_en: There was much glee among journalists over the leaked letter.

defs.def_en: Glee is a feeling of happiness and excitement, often caused by someone else's misfortune.

ext.ext_cn: 另一个在约克郡盛行的民间传统是做泡菜和酸辣酱。
ext.ext_en: Another strong Yorkshire country tradition is making pickles and chutneys.

defs.def_en: Pickles are vegetables or fruit, sometimes cut into pieces, which have been kept in vinegar or salt water for a long time so that they have a strong, sharp taste.

ext.ext_cn: 一罐罐菜酱
ext.ext_en: ...jars of pickle.

defs.def_en: Pickle is a cold spicy sauce with pieces of vegetables and fruit in it.

ext.ext_cn: 挑选最喜欢的水果或蔬菜，趁着新鲜把它们腌起来。
ext.ext_en: Select your favourite fruit or veg and pickle them while they are still fresh...

ext.ext_cn: 鲱鱼可以盐腌、熏制和泡制。
ext.ext_en: Herrings can be salted, smoked and pickled.

defs.def_en: When you pickle food, you keep it in vinegar or salt water so that it does not go bad and it develops a strong, sharp taste.

ext.ext_cn: 公司在市场发生变化时会发现自己身陷困境。
ext.ext_en: Companies find themselves in a pickle when their markets change...

ext.ext_cn: 卡罗琳这次真是惹了大麻烦。
ext.ext_en: Caroline had sure as hell got herself into a pickle this time.

defs.def_en: If you are in a pickle, you are in a difficult and awkward situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他注意到了须后水淡淡的麝香味。
ext.ext_en: He was conscious of the faint, musky aroma of after-shave...

ext.ext_cn: 她非常清楚马克斯在仔细端详她。
ext.ext_en: She was very conscious of Max studying her...

defs.def_en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or realize that it is happening.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (尤指由于不满或自觉重要而)注意的，关注的

ext.ext_cn: 我很在意自己的体重。
ext.ext_en: I'm very conscious of my weight...

ext.ext_cn: 他非常清楚这种转变伴随着社会动乱的危险。
ext.ext_en: He is acutely conscious that this transition will bring with it the risk of social unrest.

defs.def_en: If you are conscious of something, you think about it a lot, especially because you are unhappy about it or because you think it is important.

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得我们没有刻意地决定要生很多孩子。
ext.ext_en: I don't think we ever made a conscious decision to have a big family...

ext.ext_cn: 有意识地放松肌肉。
ext.ext_en: Make a conscious effort to relax your muscles.

defs.def_en: A conscious decision or action is made or done deliberately with you giving your full attention to it.

ext.ext_cn: 她一直都很清醒，知道是怎么回事。
ext.ext_en: She was fully conscious all the time and knew what was going on.

defs.def_en: Someone who is conscious is awake rather than asleep or unconscious.

defs.def_cn: (记忆或想法)有意识的，意识到的

ext.ext_cn: 他对自己住院的4个星期没有任何有意识的记忆。
ext.ext_en: He had no conscious memory of his four-week stay in hospital...

ext.ext_cn: 在意识心理之下存在很多层次的无意识。
ext.ext_en: Beneath the conscious mind there are many levels of the unconscious.

defs.def_en: Conscious memories or thoughts are ones that you are aware of.

ext.ext_cn: 这是对早先讨论过的很多事情的否定。
ext.ext_en: This is a rejection of most of what has gone before.

defs.def_en: Something that has gone before has happened or been discussed at an earlier time.

ext.ext_cn: 该案件于12月23日被提交给高等法院法官亨利先生审理，后被延期。
ext.ext_en: The case went before Mr Justice Henry on December 23 and was adjourned.

defs.def_en: To go before a judge, tribunal, or court of law means to be present there as part of an official or legal process.
Fresher is the comparative form of fresh .
Freshers are students who have just started their first year at university or college.

defs.def_cn: (保险折扣或赠金)因上一年无索赔而获得的

ext.ext_cn: 即便驾驶员在事故中没有过错，他们也可能失去无索赔折扣。
ext.ext_en: Motorists could lose their no-claims discount, even if they are not at fault in an accident.

defs.def_en: A no claims discount or bonus is a reduction in the money that you have to pay for an insurance policy, which you get when you have not made any claims in the previous year.

defs.def_cn: 把（某地的水）排干;使流出;使流向别处

ext.ext_cn: 把剩下的水排干。
ext.ext_en: Drain off any remaining water...

ext.ext_cn: 平底锅的凸纹设计使多余的油能够控出。
ext.ext_en: The ridged design of the pan allows excess fat to drain off.

defs.def_en: If you drain off a liquid from a place or object, you remove the liquid by causing it to flow somewhere. If a liquid drains off somewhere, it flows there.

ext.ext_cn: 长期不活动会导致关节僵硬，骨骼也可能开始退化。
ext.ext_en: Inactivity can make your joints stiff, and the bones may begin to degenerate...

ext.ext_cn: 从那时起，整个活动的基调开始变质。
ext.ext_en: From then on the whole tone of the campaign began to degenerate.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something degenerates, you mean that they become worse in some way, for example weaker, lower in quality, or more dangerous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一群堕落的计算机黑客
ext.ext_en: ...a group of degenerate computer hackers.

ext.ext_cn: 他在一些警队同僚身上发现的腐化态度
ext.ext_en: ...the degenerate attitudes he found among some of his fellow officers.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as degenerate, you disapprove of them because you think they have low standards of behaviour or morality.
