ext.ext_en: He cuddled the newborn girl...

ext.ext_cn: 他们过去经常在人前搂抱亲吻。
ext.ext_en: They used to kiss and cuddle in front of everyone.

defs.def_en: If you cuddle someone, you put your arms round them and hold them close as a way of showing your affection.

defs.def_cn: 激愤的长篇演说;长篇的批评性发言

ext.ext_cn: 她就造成自己企业破产的政策发表了激愤的长篇演说。
ext.ext_en: She launched into a tirade against the policies that ruined her business...

ext.ext_cn: 他也遭到了长篇累牍的谩骂攻击。
ext.ext_en: He too has met a tirade of abuse.

defs.def_en: A tirade is a long angry speech in which someone criticizes a person or thing.

defs.def_cn: 使更有趣；使更绚丽多彩；使更令人兴奋

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽·安曾经试图改变冷冰冰的现代室内装饰，使之更活泼多彩。
ext.ext_en: Mary Ann had made an effort at jazzing up the chilly modern interiors...

ext.ext_cn: 我并不认为他们仅仅是为了吸引媒体的目光才把它搞得有声有色的。
ext.ext_en: I don't think they're  just jazzing it up for the media.

defs.def_en: If you jazz something up, you make it look more interesting, colourful, or exciting.

defs.def_cn: 使更具流行音乐（或爵士乐）风格

ext.ext_cn: 她并没有按照传统风格演奏，而是糅合了爵士乐风格。
ext.ext_en: Instead of playing it in the traditional style, she jazzed it up...

ext.ext_cn: 斯蒂芬和我打算给那些爱情歌曲注入流行元素。
ext.ext_en: Stephen and I are going to jazz up the love songs...

defs.def_en: If someone jazzes up a piece of music, they change it in order to make it sound more like popular music or jazz.
At the coast, high tide is the time when the sea is at its highest level because the tide is in.

ext.ext_cn: 各共和国将拥有与其经济规模成比例的选举权。
ext.ext_en: Republics will have voting rights proportionate to the size of their economies...

ext.ext_cn: 额外开发土地意味着工作量相应增加。
ext.ext_en: The extra field cultivated meant a proportionate increase in work.

defs.def_en: Proportionate means the same as proportional .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (法律、规则、条件)严格的，严厉的，受严格约束的

ext.ext_cn: 他宣布将对武器的持有实行更严格的控制。
ext.ext_en: He announced that there would be more stringent controls on the possession of weapons...

ext.ext_cn: 其药物检测程序是世界上最严格的。
ext.ext_en: Its  drugtesting procedures are the most stringent in the world.

defs.def_en: Stringent laws, rules, or conditions are very severe or are strictly controlled.

defs.def_cn: 地方色彩；乡土特色；时代特色

ext.ext_cn: 该渔港通常都是一派热闹繁忙的景象，很有地方色彩。
ext.ext_en: The fishing boat harbour was usually bustling with lots of local colour.

defs.def_en: Local colour is used to refer to customs, traditions, dress, and other things which give a place or period of history its own particular character.
Traveller's cheques are cheques that you buy at a bank and take with you when you travel, for example so that you can exchange them for the currency of the country that you are in.
A gun dog is a dog that has been trained to work with a hunter or gamekeeper, especially to find and carry back birds or animals that have been shot.

ext.ext_cn: 她打了个哈欠，伸了个懒腰。
ext.ext_en: She yawned, and stretched lazily...

ext.ext_cn: 他们看起来已经厌倦了这些演讲，直打哈欠。
ext.ext_en: They looked bored and yawned at the speeches.

defs.def_en: If you yawn, you open your mouth very wide and breathe in more air than usual, often when you are tired or when you are not interested in something.

defs.def_cn: 乏味的事物;枯燥的事物

ext.ext_cn: 这场辩论实在可笑。简直是无聊透顶。
ext.ext_en: The debate was a mockery. A big yawn...

ext.ext_cn: 果不其然，那场音乐会很乏味。
ext.ext_en: The concert was a predictable yawn.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a book or a film as a yawn, you think it is very boring

ext.ext_cn: 他们之间的隔阂比以往任何时候都要深。
ext.ext_en: The gulf between them yawned wider than ever...

ext.ext_cn: 走廊尽头利迪的门黑洞洞地敞开着。
ext.ext_en: Liddie's doorway yawned blackly open at the end of the hall.

defs.def_en: A gap or an opening that yawns is large and wide, and often frightening.
Electrolysis is the process of passing an electric current through a substance in order to produce chemial changes in the substance.

ext.ext_cn: 那两名女售货员正忙着接待顾客。
ext.ext_en: The two saleswomen were busily trying to keep up with the demand.

defs.def_en: If you do something busily, you do it in a very active way.
See also:night owl;An owl is a bird with a flat face, large eyes, and a small sharp beak. Most owls obtain their food by hunting small animals at night.

defs.def_cn: (与大量名词连用，表示做动作、说某事等)做出，作出

ext.ext_cn: 我只想稍加评论。
ext.ext_en: I'd just like to make a comment...

ext.ext_cn: 我打了几个电话。
ext.ext_en: I made a few phone calls...

defs.def_en: You can use make with a wide range of nouns to indicate that someone performs an action or says something. For example, if you make a suggestion, you suggest something.

defs.def_cn: (与某些名词连用)把…做(好)，把…搞(糟)

ext.ext_cn: 看样子他把试镜搞砸了。
ext.ext_en: Apparently he made a mess of his  audition...

ext.ext_cn: 这一次你真的能做得更好吗？
ext.ext_en: Are you really going to make a better job of it this time?

defs.def_en: You can use make with certain nouns to indicate that someone does something well or badly. For example, if you make a success of something, you do it successfully, and if you make a mess of something, you do it very badly.

defs.def_cn: 摆出…的姿态;做出…的样子

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽好像要抗议，却又犹豫了。
ext.ext_en: Mary made as if to protest, then hesitated...

ext.ext_cn: 他假装要去追赶一边往回跑一边大笑的戴维。
ext.ext_en: He made to chase Davey, who ran back laughing.

defs.def_en: If you make as if to do something or make to do something, you behave in a way that makes it seem that you are just about to do it.

defs.def_cn: (在板球、棒球、橄榄球比赛中)得(分)

ext.ext_cn: 他为本郡赢得了1,972分。
ext.ext_en: He made 1,972 runs for the county.

defs.def_en: In cricket, if a player makes a particular number of runs, they score that number of runs. In baseball or American football, if a player makes a particular score, they achieve that score.

ext.ext_cn: 要是买得起真品，为什么还要拿复制品来凑合呢？
ext.ext_en: Why make do with a copy if you can afford the genuine article?...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的床单有些次，您将就着用吧。
ext.ext_en: We're a bit low on bed linen. You'll have to make do.

defs.def_en: If you make do with something, you use or have it instead of something else that you do not have, although it is not as good.

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃装成一条吐泡泡的鱼。
ext.ext_en: Bob makes like he's a fish blowing bubbles.

defs.def_en: If you make like you are doing something, you act as if you are doing it, and if you make like someone, you act as if you are that person.

ext.ext_cn: 公路上扬起的沙子呛得他咳嗽起来。
ext.ext_en: Grit from the highway made him cough...

ext.ext_cn: 衬衫的白色尖领使他看上去像个唱诗班的男童。
ext.ext_en: The white tips of his shirt collar made him look like a choirboy...

defs.def_en: If something makes you do something, it causes you to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 妈妈要他把盘子洗干净。
ext.ext_en: Mama made him clean up the plate...

ext.ext_cn: 你不能强迫我做任何事情。
ext.ext_en: You can't make me do anything...

defs.def_en: If you make someone do something, you force them to do it.

defs.def_cn: 使成为(某种人或物);使具有(某种特性)

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯·邦德——这个使他一举成名的角色
ext.ext_en: ...James Bond, the role that made him a star...

ext.ext_cn: 他回到了芝加哥，在那里度过了余生。
ext.ext_en: He  returned to Chicago, and made it his base for the rest of his life...

defs.def_en: You use make to talk about causing someone or something to be a particular thing or to have a particular quality. For example, to make someone a star means to cause them to become a star, and to make someone angry means to cause them to become angry.

ext.ext_cn: 他们生活在幻想的世界里，相形之下连欧洲迪士尼乐园都显得毫无创意。
ext.ext_en: They live in fantasy worlds which make Euro Disney seem uninventive...

ext.ext_cn: 自从他来与我同住，我们之间便摩擦不断;相比之下，萨拉夫人倒显得一副菩萨心肠。
ext.ext_en: Since he came to live with me, we have been subject to a campaign of spite and revenge which makes Lady Sarah appear angelic by comparison.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing or person makes another seem, for example, small, stupid, or good, you mean that they cause them to seem small, stupid, or good in comparison, even though they are not.

defs.def_cn: 使自己(被理解、听见、知晓等)

ext.ext_cn: 阿伦不会说波兰语，我为了让他明白我的话很是费了一番力气。
ext.ext_en: Aron couldn't speak Polish. I made myself understood with difficulty...

ext.ext_cn: 为了压过音乐声，他几乎得大声喊才能让人听见。
ext.ext_en: He almost had to shout to make himself heard above the music.

defs.def_en: If you make yourself understood, heard, or known, you succeed in getting people to understand you, hear you, or know that you are there.

ext.ext_cn: 布莱尔先生任命他为交通部长。
ext.ext_en: Mr Blair made him transport minister...

ext.ext_cn: 如果我当主席，我希望西蒙作为我信赖的副官，继续留在我的身边。
ext.ext_en: If I am made chairman, I hope Simon will stay on as my trusted lieutenant.

defs.def_en: If you make someone something, you appoint them to a particular job, role, or position.

ext.ext_cn: 我们把这里变成了美丽的家园。
ext.ext_en: We made it into a beautiful home...

ext.ext_cn: 她的畅销小说《桃树路》不久将被拍成一部电视系列短剧。
ext.ext_en: Her bestseller 'Peachtree Road' is soon to be made into a television mini-series.

defs.def_en: If you make something into something else, you change it in some way so that it becomes that other thing.

defs.def_cn: 使(总数)升为;使(分数)达到

ext.ext_cn: 这使灯泡与电费合计为27英镑。
ext.ext_en: This makes the total cost of the bulb and energy £27...

ext.ext_cn: 卢佩斯库在20码处射门得分，接着巴林特将比分扩大为4比0。
ext.ext_en: Lupescu scored from 20 yards and then Balint made it 4-0.

defs.def_en: To make a total or score a particular amount means to increase it to that amount.

ext.ext_cn: 洛伦佐是天生的领袖，善于交友。
ext.ext_en: Lorenzo was a natural leader who made friends easily...

ext.ext_cn: 他因上课调皮捣蛋而成为大多数老师的眼中钉。
ext.ext_en: He was unruly in class and made an enemy of most of his teachers.

defs.def_en: When someone makes a friend or an enemy, someone becomes their friend or their enemy, often because of a particular thing they have done.

ext.ext_cn: 父亲在有生之年见证了我出人头地的那一天。
ext.ext_en: My father lived long enough to see that I'd made something of myself...

ext.ext_cn: 教他念书的修女激励他努力上进，他最终取得了成功。
ext.ext_en: The nuns who taught him urged him to make something of his life and he did.

defs.def_en: If someone makes something of themselves or makes something of their life, they become successful.

ext.ext_cn: 她自己做面包。
ext.ext_en: She made her own bread...

ext.ext_cn: 目前日产公司在欧洲有两家工厂生产汽车。
ext.ext_en: Nissan now makes cars at two plants in Europe...

defs.def_en: To make something means to produce, construct, or create it.

defs.def_cn: 拍摄(电影);制作(电视节目)

ext.ext_cn: 我们正在拍摄一部关于野生动物的影片。
ext.ext_en: We are making a film about wildlife.

ext.ext_cn: 1934年出品的影片《克里斯蒂娜女王》
ext.ext_en: ...the film 'Queen Christina', made in 1934.

defs.def_en: If someone makes a film or television programme, they are involved in creating or producing it.

ext.ext_cn: 你洗一下，我去做午饭。
ext.ext_en: You wash while I make some lunch...

ext.ext_cn: 我给大家冲杯咖啡好吗？
ext.ext_en: Would you like me to make us all a coffee?

defs.def_en: If you make a meal or a drink, you prepare it.

ext.ext_cn: 佩里先生在他的书上作了一个注解。
ext.ext_en: Mr Perry made a note in his book...

ext.ext_cn: 事先列出你的问题。
ext.ext_en: Make a list of your questions beforehand.

defs.def_en: If you make a note or list, you write something down in that form.

ext.ext_cn: 警察并不制定法律，只是负责执行。
ext.ext_en: The police don't make the laws, they merely enforce them...

ext.ext_cn: 这座房子里就我说了算。
ext.ext_en: The only person who makes rules in this house is me.

defs.def_en: If you make rules or laws, you decide what these should be.

ext.ext_cn: 我认为各家公司的目的都是赚钱。
ext.ext_en: I think every business's goal is to make money...

ext.ext_cn: 我们挣了多少？
ext.ext_en: How much did we make?...

defs.def_en: If you make money, you get it by working for it, by selling something, or by winning it.

defs.def_cn: (某事物)使(其他事物)变得成功

ext.ext_cn: 真正让这本书大获成功的是它精美的设计。
ext.ext_en: What really makes the book are the beautiful designs.

defs.def_en: If something makes something else, it is responsible for the success of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 停在外面的只有一辆黑色的萨博——不是一个牌子的车。
ext.ext_en: The only car parked outside is a black Saab — a different make.

ext.ext_cn: 某种品牌的手表
ext.ext_en: ...a certain make of wristwatch.

defs.def_en: The make of something such as a car or radio is the name of the company that made it.  →see usage note at:brand

defs.def_cn: （可能以非法或不道德手段）拼命追求金钱(或权力）
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is on the make, you disapprove of them because they are trying to get a lot of money or power, possibly by illegal or immoral methods.

ext.ext_cn: 如果训练得当，她会成为一名出色的演员。
ext.ext_en: She'll make a good actress, if she gets the right training...

ext.ext_cn: 你构思很好，可用来写一本佳作。
ext.ext_en: You've a very good idea there. It will make a good book...

defs.def_en: You can use make to say that someone or something has the right qualities for a particular task or role. For example, if you say that someone will make a good politician, you mean that they have the right qualities to be a good politician.

ext.ext_cn: 一群人在五角大楼四周围成一圈。
ext.ext_en: A group of people made a circle around the Pentagon.

defs.def_en: If people make a particular pattern such as a line or a circle, they arrange themselves in this way.

ext.ext_cn: 4乘以2等于8。
ext.ext_en: Four twos make eight...

ext.ext_cn: 他准备增加3艘航空母舰，这样一来总共就有6艘。
ext.ext_en: He is adding three aircraft carriers—that makes six in all.

defs.def_en: You can use make to say what two numbers add up to.

defs.def_cn: 成为…的一员;加入;谋得（高级职务）

ext.ext_cn: 运动员们很乐意加入英国国家队。
ext.ext_en: The athletes are just happy to make the British team...

ext.ext_cn: 他明白自己永远也当不了导演。
ext.ext_en: He knew he was never going to make director.

defs.def_en: If someone makes a particular team or makes a particular high position, they do so well that they are put in that team or get that position.

ext.ext_cn: 他们力图在黄昏前赶到新奥尔良。
ext.ext_en: They were trying to make New Orleans by nightfall.

defs.def_en: If you make a place in or by a particular time, you get there in or by that time, often with some difficulty.

defs.def_cn: (及时)到达（尤指来得及做某事）

ext.ext_cn: 那么，你终究还是成功地来到了美国。
ext.ext_en: So you did make it to America, after all.

ext.ext_cn: 再也没能重返家园的人质
ext.ext_en: ...the hostages who never made it home...

defs.def_en: If you make it somewhere, you succeed in getting there, especially in time to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 我相信自己有成功的天分。
ext.ext_en: I believe I have the talent to make it...

ext.ext_cn: 你勇敢无畏，一定会获得成功。
ext.ext_en: You're brave and courageous. You can make it.

defs.def_en: If you make it, you are successful in achieving something difficult, or in surviving through a very difficult period.

ext.ext_cn: “我无法赴约了，”她说，“那天是母亲节。”
ext.ext_en: 'I can't make it,' she said. 'That's Mother's Day.'...

ext.ext_cn: 他没能出席我们的晚宴。
ext.ext_en: He hadn't been able to make it to our dinner.

defs.def_en: If you cannot make it, you are unable to attend an event that you have been invited  to.

ext.ext_cn: 我就想知道吉姆·马丁一共有多少件T恤衫。我猜他有3件。
ext.ext_en: All I want to know is how many T-shirts Jim Martin has got. I make it three...

ext.ext_cn: 我算出当年的总额为9,599英镑。
ext.ext_en: I make the total for the year £9,599.

defs.def_en: You use make it when saying what you calculate or guess an amount to be.

ext.ext_cn: 我的手表显示快9点半了。
ext.ext_en: I make it nearly 9.30...

ext.ext_cn: “你的表几点？”——“整点过13分钟。”
ext.ext_en: 'What time d'you make it?' — 'Thirteen past.'

defs.def_en: You use make it when saying what time your watch says it is.
A flamingo is a bird with pink feathers, long thin legs, a long neck, and a curved beak. Flamingos live near water in warm countries.

ext.ext_cn: 他的经验和威望足以做成这件事。
ext.ext_en: He's got the experience and the authority to carry it off.

defs.def_en: If you carry something off, you do it successfully.

ext.ext_cn: 它获得伦敦晚间标准戏剧奖的最佳戏剧奖。
ext.ext_en: It carried off the Evening Standard drama award for best play.

defs.def_en: If you carry off a prize or a trophy, you win it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在那之前,许多孩子被安置在一个缺乏人情味的大孤儿院里。
ext.ext_en: Before then many children were cared for in large impersonal orphanages...

ext.ext_cn: 公共医疗卫生服务一向被指责缺乏人情味。
ext.ext_en: The health service has been criticized for being too impersonal.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place, organization, or activity as impersonal, you mean that it is not very friendly and makes you feel unimportant because it involves or is used by a large number of people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 客观的;不受个人感情(或偏见)影响的

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须像外科医生拿手术刀时一样冷静客观,不受任何感情影响。
ext.ext_en: We must be as impersonal as a surgeon with his knife...

ext.ext_cn: 我不带任何感情地盯着科。
ext.ext_en: I gave Coe an impersonal stare.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as impersonal, you mean that they do not show any emotion about the person they are dealing with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 非个人的;不带个人色彩的

ext.ext_cn: 房间的其余部分整洁干净,不带任何的个人色彩。
ext.ext_en: The rest of the room was neat and impersonal...

ext.ext_cn: 历史叙述把大屠杀简缩成了冷冰冰的数字。
ext.ext_en: History reduces the carnage to impersonal numbers.

defs.def_en: An impersonal room or statistic does not give any information about the character of the person to whom it belongs or relates.
The turn-ups on a pair of trousers are the parts which are folded over at the ends of the legs.

ext.ext_cn: 教堂大钟在午夜敲响。
ext.ext_en: Church bells pealed at the stroke of midnight.

ext.ext_cn: 威斯敏斯特大教堂洪亮的钟鸣
ext.ext_en: ...the great peal of the Abbey bells.

defs.def_en: When bells peal, they ring one after another, making a musical sound.

defs.def_cn: 持久响亮的声音；轰轰的响声

ext.ext_cn: 我听到一阵响亮的欢笑声。
ext.ext_en: I heard a peal of merry laughter.

ext.ext_cn: 轰隆作响的雷声
ext.ext_en: ...great peals of thunder.

defs.def_en: A peal of laughter or thunder consists of a long, loud series of sounds.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 发展中国家的可避免死亡中超过1/4是由肺结核引起的。
ext.ext_en: More than a quarter of the avoidable deaths in the developing world are caused by TB...

ext.ext_cn: 那场悲剧是完全可以避免的。
ext.ext_en: The tragedy was entirely avoidable.

defs.def_en: Something that is avoidable can be prevented from happening.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不完美的;有缺点的;有瑕疵的

ext.ext_cn: 我们生活在一个并不完美的世界上。
ext.ext_en: We live in an imperfect world...

ext.ext_cn: 他们有大量完好的、略有瑕疵的以及已停产的炊具、冰箱和其他货品可供选择。
ext.ext_en: They have a huge selection of perfect, slightly imperfect and discontinued cookers, fridges and so on.

defs.def_en: Something that is imperfect has faults and is not exactly as you would like it to be.

defs.def_cn: (动词的)未完成过去式，未完成过去时
defs.def_en: In grammar, the imperfect or the imperfect tense of a verb is used to describe continuous situations or repeated actions in the past. Examples are 'I was reading' and 'they were eating'.

defs.def_cn: （用于构成形容词）表示“在…之外”，“超出”

ext.ext_cn: 此举超出了宪法的规定范围。
ext.ext_en: The move was extra-constitutional...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在议会内外同时下手争夺权力。
ext.ext_en: They competed for power through a combination of parliamentary and extra-parliamentary methods...

defs.def_en: extra- is used to form adjectives indicating that something is outside something or is not part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 一层锯木屑
ext.ext_en: ...a layer of sawdust.

defs.def_en: Sawdust is dust and very small pieces of wood which are produced when you saw wood.

ext.ext_cn: 侍者用一把银钳从篮子里夹起面包卷。
ext.ext_en: The waiter lifted rolls from a basket with a pair of silver tongs.

defs.def_en: Tongs are a tool that you use to grip and pick up objects that you do not want to touch. They consist of two long narrow pieces of metal joined together at one end.  hammer and tongs→see: hammer;

defs.def_cn: 无人驾驶的；无人操纵的

ext.ext_cn: 一架特别的无人驾驶飞行器
ext.ext_en: ...a special unmanned spacecraft.

ext.ext_cn: 自控火箭
ext.ext_en: ...unmanned rockets.

defs.def_en: Unmanned vehicles such as spacecraft do not have any people in them and operate automatically or are controlled from a distance.

ext.ext_cn: 从上一个无人站过来的费用可能还不到1镑。
ext.ext_en: The fare from the last unmanned station is probably less than a pound...

ext.ext_cn: 邮局无人工作意味着许多信件无人分拣。
ext.ext_en: Unmanned post offices meant millions of letters went unsorted.

defs.def_en: If a place is unmanned, there is nobody working there.
Tulips are brightly coloured flowers that grow in the spring, and have oval or pointed petals packed closely together.
An ice-breaker is a large ship which sails through frozen waters, breaking the ice as it goes, in order to create a passage for other ships.

defs.def_cn: 打破僵局的事物;活跃气氛的话

ext.ext_cn: 这个活动可以有效地活跃新群体内的气氛。
ext.ext_en: This exercise can be quite a useful ice-breaker for new groups.

defs.def_en: An ice-breaker is something that someone says or does in order to make it easier for people who have never met before to talk to each other.

defs.def_cn: (在街头等公共场所供水的)竖管
defs.def_en: A standpipe is a vertical pipe that is connected to a water supply and stands in a street or other public place.

ext.ext_cn: 3名囚犯越狱了。
ext.ext_en: Three prisoners escaped from a jail.

defs.def_en: A jail is a place where criminals are kept in order to punish them, or where people waiting to be tried are kept.

ext.ext_cn: 他被判了20年监禁。
ext.ext_en: He was jailed for twenty years.

defs.def_en: If someone is jailed, they are put into jail.

defs.def_cn: 无人护送的；没人陪同的

ext.ext_cn: 小孩无人陪同不允许走出这个地方。
ext.ext_en: Unescorted children are not allowed beyond this point...

ext.ext_cn: 他的工作是在曼哈顿的夜总会陪没有舞伴的女士跳舞。
ext.ext_en: He worked as a dancing partner for unescorted ladies at Manhattan cabarets...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is unescorted, they are not protected or supervised.

defs.def_cn: 再使用;重复使用;重新利用

ext.ext_cn: 尽可能重复使用纸张。
ext.ext_en: Try where possible to reuse paper.

ext.ext_cn: 铜、黄铜和铝被分门别类重新熔化以进行再利用。
ext.ext_en: Copper, brass and aluminium are separated and remelted for reuse.

defs.def_en: When you reuse something, you use it again instead of throwing it away.
A hernia is a medical condition which is often caused by strain or injury. It results in one of your internal organs sticking through a weak point in the surrounding tissue.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 居无定所的;无固定工作的;无归属的;漂泊的

ext.ext_cn: 这些漂泊不定的年轻人没有其他地方可去。
ext.ext_en: These rootless young people have nowhere else to go.

ext.ext_cn: 那些不愿意融入社会而过着漂泊不定、没有工作的生活的人
ext.ext_en: ...people who refused to integrate within society and instead lived rootless, jobless lives.

defs.def_en: If someone has no permanent home or job and is not settled in any community, you can describe them as rootless .

ext.ext_cn: 1816年,阿根廷宣布脱离西班牙正式独立。
ext.ext_en: In 1816, Argentina declared its independence from Spain.

ext.ext_cn: 该国自 1962 年独立以来的首次选举
ext.ext_en: ...the country's first elections since independence in 1962.

defs.def_en: If a country has or gains independence, it has its own government and is not ruled by any other country.

ext.ext_cn: 他害怕失去自己的独立性。
ext.ext_en: He was afraid of losing his independence.

ext.ext_cn: 一个女人的独立、能力与权力
ext.ext_en: ...a woman's independence, capability, and power.

defs.def_en: Someone's independence is the fact that they do not rely on other people.

ext.ext_cn: 我一直跑到哥伦比亚县，然后向东转，沿着哈勒姆山谷，从那里回到家。
ext.ext_en: I ran straight up to Columbia County, then turned East, came down the Harlem Valley and thence home...

ext.ext_cn: 那些马赛克被送到慕尼黑，从那里又送到日内瓦。
ext.ext_en: The mosaics were sent to Munich, and thence to Geneva.

defs.def_en: Thence means from a particular place, especially when you are giving directions about how to get somewhere.

defs.def_cn: 然后，接着（指状态的变化）

ext.ext_cn: 将太阳能转化成热能，然后再转化成电能
ext.ext_en: ...the conversion of sunlight into heat and thence into electricity.

defs.def_en: Thence is used to say that something changes from one state or condition to another.

defs.def_cn: 亚音速的;亚音速飞行的

ext.ext_cn: 这比大多数亚音速飞机的飞行高度高 20,000 英尺。
ext.ext_en: This is 20,000 feet higher than most subsonic airliners.

defs.def_en: Subsonic speeds or aeroplanes are very fast but slower than the speed of sound.

ext.ext_cn: 朱迪丝已经结婚了，有四个孩子。
ext.ext_en: Judith is married with four children.

defs.def_en: Four is the number 4.

ext.ext_cn: 泰勒打了 13 个 4 分球，击球时间为 140 分钟。
ext.ext_en: Taylor hit 13 fours and batted for 140 minutes.

defs.def_en: In cricket, if a player hits a four, they score four runs by hitting the ball along the ground so that it crosses the boundary at the edge of the playing area.
A four is a narrow racing boat that is rowed by a team of four people.

ext.ext_cn: 她爬到窗边。
ext.ext_en: She crawled on all fours over to the window.

defs.def_en: If you are on all fours, your knees, feet, and hands are on the ground.

ext.ext_cn: 酒和烟
ext.ext_en: ...booze and cigarettes.

ext.ext_cn: 空酒瓶
ext.ext_en: ...empty bottles of booze.

defs.def_en: Booze is alcoholic drink.

ext.ext_cn: 一群整个下午都在饮酒的醉醺醺的生意人
ext.ext_en: ...a load of drunken businessmen who had been boozing all afternoon.

defs.def_en: If people booze, they drink alcohol.

defs.def_cn: (直接)转到，接入(另一首曲子、另一段对话)

ext.ext_cn: 曲终后紧接着就是他的弦乐独奏。
ext.ext_en: The piece segues into his solo with the strings.

ext.ext_cn: 他的电影在后面的部分试图向喜剧方向发展的尝试
ext.ext_en: ...his film's attempt, in its latter sections, to segue into comedy.

defs.def_en: If something such as a piece of music or conversation segues into another piece of music or conversation, it changes into it or is followed by it without a break.
A bellboy is a man or boy who works in a hotel, carrying bags or bringing things to the guests' rooms.

defs.def_cn: 吸引观众的体育运动；观赏性强的竞技运动

ext.ext_cn: 观赏性强、最受欢迎的体育运动是足球。
ext.ext_en: The most popular spectator sport is football.

defs.def_en: A spectator sport is a sport that is interesting and entertaining to watch.

ext.ext_cn: 我孙女阿梅莉亚的一张素描
ext.ext_en: ...a drawing of my granddaughter Amelia.

defs.def_en: Someone's granddaughter is the daughter of their son or daughter.
A Laundromat is the same as a Launderette .

ext.ext_cn: 有时如果没有顶替你的合适人选，他们会继续雇用你一段时间。
ext.ext_en: Sometimes they keep you on a bit longer if there's no one quite ready to step into your shoes...

ext.ext_cn: 留下了20名骨干人员。
ext.ext_en: A skeleton staff of 20 is being kept on.

defs.def_en: If you keep someone on, you continue to employ them, for example after they are old enough to retire or after other employees have lost their jobs.

ext.ext_cn: 我一直将枪径直瞄准他的双眼。
ext.ext_en: I kept the gun aimed squarely at his eyes.

defs.def_en: Squarely means directly or in the middle, rather than indirectly or at an angle.

ext.ext_cn: 总统将责任完全归咎于对手。
ext.ext_en: The president put the blame squarely on his opponent...

ext.ext_cn: 成败完全取决于尼日利亚人。
ext.ext_en: Responsibility for success or failure lies squarely with the Nigerians.

defs.def_en: If something such as blame or responsibility lies squarely with someone, they are definitely the person responsible.

ext.ext_cn: 管理委员会直面当前形势。
ext.ext_en: The management committee have faced the situation squarely...

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须抛开一切伪装，正视学校教育的真实情况。
ext.ext_en: We have to drop our pretences and look squarely at schooling as it really is.

defs.def_en: If you face something squarely, you face it directly, without trying to avoid it.

defs.def_cn: （建筑物或车辆的）后部，后面，背面

ext.ext_cn: 他靠坐在出租车的后排座上。
ext.ext_en: He settled back in the rear of the taxi.

ext.ext_cn: 大楼后面的楼梯
ext.ext_en: ...a stairway in the rear of the building.

defs.def_en: The rear of something such as a building or vehicle is the back part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 乐师们在队前和队尾表演。
ext.ext_en: Musicians played at the front and rear of the procession...

ext.ext_cn: 市长大人坐在他阔气的马车里在后面跟着。
ext.ext_en: The Lord Mayor follows at the rear in his gilded coach.

defs.def_en: If you are at the rear of a moving line of people, you are the last person in it.

ext.ext_cn: 我打完电话后转过头，看见刘易斯拍了拍一个女招待的屁股。
ext.ext_en: I turned away from the phone to see Lewis pat a waitress on her rear.

defs.def_en: Your rear is the part of your body that you sit on.

ext.ext_cn: 她养大了16个孩子，其中6个是她亲生的，10个是她丈夫带来的。
ext.ext_en: She reared sixteen children, six her own and ten her husband's...

ext.ext_cn: 我在得克萨斯州东部长大。
ext.ext_en: I was reared in east Texas.

defs.def_en: If you rear children, you look after them until they are old enough to look after themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 她花费大量时间饲养动物。
ext.ext_en: She spends a lot of time rearing animals.

defs.def_en: If you rear a young animal, you keep and look after it until it is old enough to be used for work or food, or until it can look after itself.

ext.ext_cn: 那匹马前蹄腾空向后仰，把骑手摔了下去。
ext.ext_en: The horse reared and threw off its rider.

ext.ext_cn: 听到枪声不会仰站立起的军用小型马
ext.ext_en: ...an army pony that didn't rear up at the sound of gunfire.

defs.def_en: When a horse rears, it moves the front part of its body upwards, so that its front legs are high in the air and it is standing on its back legs.

ext.ext_cn: 高高的围墙后面，展览大厅耸立在我面前。
ext.ext_en: The exhibition hall reared above me behind a high fence...

ext.ext_cn: 两边的山峦高耸入云，山势陡峭，覆盖着积雪。
ext.ext_en: The mountains reared up on each side, steep and white.

defs.def_en: If you say that something such as a building or mountain rears above you, you mean that is very tall and close to you.

ext.ext_cn: 摩托骑警行进在队伍最后
ext.ext_en: ...police motorcyclists bringing up the rear of the procession.

defs.def_en: If a person or vehicle is bringing up the rear, they are the last person or vehicle in a moving line of them.

defs.def_cn: （令人不快之物）显现，露头，显露

ext.ext_cn: 今年夏天又显现出了罢工的势头。
ext.ext_en: The threat of strikes reared its head again this summer...

ext.ext_cn: 极右势力在20世纪80年代有所抬头。
ext.ext_en: The extreme right reared its ugly head in the 1980s.

defs.def_en: If something unpleasant rears its head or rears its ugly head, it becomes visible or noticeable.

ext.ext_cn: 加拿大人寻求加入美国海军陆战队，因为他们认为在加拿大军队里机会没那么多。
ext.ext_en: Canadians seek enlistment in the US Marines because they don't see as much opportunity in the Canadian armed forces.

defs.def_en: Enlistment is the act of joining the army, navy, marines, or air force.

ext.ext_cn: 在我退役的时候，我决定复员过平民生活。
ext.ext_en: At the end of my term of enlistment I decided to return to civilian life.

defs.def_en: Enlistment is the period of time for which someone is a member of one of the armed forces.

defs.def_cn: (有盖、长柄、较深的)炖锅;深平底锅

ext.ext_cn: 用大炖锅煮土豆和芜菁。
ext.ext_en: Cook the potatoes and turnips in a large saucepan.

defs.def_en: A saucepan is a deep metal cooking pot, usually with a long handle and a lid.

defs.def_cn: 打开潘多拉的盒子；开启邪恶之源
defs.def_en: If someone or something opens Pandora's box or opens a Pandora's box, they do something that causes a lot of problems to appear that did not exist or were not known about before.

ext.ext_cn: 教皇约翰·保罗二世身着白色长袍在简朴的圣坛前面跪下来。
ext.ext_en: Pope John Paul II knelt in his white robes before the simple altar.

ext.ext_cn: 毛皮衬里的绿色丝绸长袍
ext.ext_en: ...a fur-lined robe of green silk.

defs.def_en: A robe is a loose piece of clothing which covers all of your body and reaches the ground. You can describe someone as wearing a robe or as wearing robes .

ext.ext_cn: 赖尔穿上睡袍，下楼去了厨房。
ext.ext_en: Ryle put on a robe and went down to the kitchen.

defs.def_en: A robe is a piece of clothing, usually made of towelling, which people wear in the house, especially when they have just got up or had a bath.

defs.def_cn: （篷车或建筑物上的）遮阳篷，雨篷
defs.def_en: An awning is a piece of material attached to a caravan or building which provides shelter from the rain or sun.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我不戴面纱就会有辱门楣。
ext.ext_en: It would dishonour my family if I didn't wear the veil.

defs.def_en: If you dishonour someone, you behave in a way that damages their good reputation.

ext.ext_cn: 在死亡和耻辱之间作选择
ext.ext_en: ...a choice between death and dishonour...

ext.ext_cn: 她不愿看到她深爱的男友就这样不名誉地死去。
ext.ext_en: She refuses to see her beloved boy die in such dishonor.

defs.def_en: Dishonour is a state in which people disapprove of you and lose their respect for you.

ext.ext_cn: 我们发现银行拒绝兑现我们的部分支票。
ext.ext_en: We found that the bank had dishonoured some of our cheques.

ext.ext_cn: 对英国制造业背弃承诺
ext.ext_en: ...the dishonoured pledges to British manufacturing.

defs.def_en: If someone dishonours an agreement, they refuse to act according to its conditions.

defs.def_cn: (英国的)支票保付卡，银行支票证
defs.def_en: In Britain, a cheque card or a cheque guarantee card is a small plastic card given to you by your bank and which you have to show when you are paying for something by cheque or when you are cashing a cheque at another bank.

ext.ext_cn: 应999紧急呼叫出动的救火车
ext.ext_en: ...a fire engine answering a 999 call...

ext.ext_cn: 她用手机拨打了999。
ext.ext_en: She dialled 999 on her mobile.

defs.def_en: 999 is the number that you call in Britain in order to contact the emergency services.

defs.def_cn: 挑起争端者;头目;首恶;魁首

ext.ext_cn: 士兵们对这次抗议活动的带头者已经了如指掌。
ext.ext_en: The soldiers were well informed about the ringleaders of the protest.

defs.def_en: The ringleaders in a quarrel, disturbance, or illegal activity are the people who started it and who cause most of the trouble.

defs.def_cn: (儿童必须掌握的) 三R 技能，读写算技能

ext.ext_cn: 希望老师集中精力培养学生读写算技能的部长们
ext.ext_en: ...ministers who want teachers to concentrate on the three Rs.

defs.def_en: When talking about children's education, the three Rs are the basic skills of reading, writing, and arithmetic.

ext.ext_cn: 规则要求样本必须装在两个水密容器中。
ext.ext_en: The rules state that samples must be enclosed in two watertight containers...

ext.ext_cn: 将罐子装在透明的塑胶袋中。
ext.ext_en: Enclose the pot in a clear polythene bag...

defs.def_en: If a place or object is enclosed by something, the place or object is inside that thing or completely surrounded by it.

ext.ext_cn: 我已随信附上10英镑的支票。
ext.ext_en: I have enclosed a cheque for £10...

ext.ext_cn: 他撕开了随信寄来的奶油色信封。
ext.ext_en: He tore open the creamy envelope that had been enclosed in the letter...

defs.def_en: If you enclose something with a letter, you put it in the same envelope as the letter.

ext.ext_cn: 除杰里米外，那些男人看起来都风度翩翩。
ext.ext_en: Jeremy excepted, the men seemed personable...

ext.ext_cn: 通常每天接受4次治疗，星期日除外。
ext.ext_en: You normally receive 4 treatments each day, Sundays excepted.

defs.def_en: You use excepted after you have mentioned a person or thing to show that you do not include them in the statement you are making.

ext.ext_cn: 爱尔兰没有介入这次冲突。
ext.ext_en: Ireland stood aside from this conflict...

ext.ext_cn: 关键问题是他们会袖手旁观还是会扰乱选举。
ext.ext_en: The key question was whether they would stand aside or would disrupt the elections.

defs.def_en: If you stand aside from something, you allow it to happen without interfering in it or doing anything to prevent it.

defs.def_cn: (从重要职位上)退下，下台(常为了让位给别人)

ext.ext_cn: 总统说，如果他下台能让杀戮停止的话，他愿意这样做。
ext.ext_en: The President said he was willing to stand aside if that would stop the killing.

defs.def_en: If someone stands aside, they resign from an important job or position, often in order to let someone else take their place.

defs.def_cn: (设备、家具等的)小配件，附件，零件

ext.ext_cn: 黄铜灯具配件
ext.ext_en: ...brass light fittings.

ext.ext_cn: 工业化生产的厨卫零配件
ext.ext_en: ...industrial fittings for kitchen and bathroom...

defs.def_en: A fitting is one of the smaller parts on the outside of a piece of equipment or furniture, for example a handle or a tap.

defs.def_cn: 可拆除装置(如烤箱、加热器等)
defs.def_en: Fittings are things such as ovens or heaters, that are fitted inside a building, but can be removed if necessary.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是个离群索居的人，孤独地死去也许正得其所。
ext.ext_en: A solitary man, it was perhaps fitting that he should have died alone...

ext.ext_cn: 总统的讲话为一场激烈的竞选运动适时画上了句号。
ext.ext_en: The President's address was a fitting end to a bitter campaign.

defs.def_en: Something that is fitting is right or suitable.

ext.ext_cn: 她吃完午饭后去购物,试穿了一些她并不需要的衣服。
ext.ext_en: She lunched and shopped and went for fittings for clothes she didn't need.

defs.def_en: If someone has a fitting, they try on a piece of clothing that is being made for them to see if it fits.

ext.ext_cn: 她得到一份在旅行社当记账员的工作。
ext.ext_en: She was offered a job as an accounts clerk with a travel firm.

defs.def_en: A clerk is a person who works in an office, bank, or law court and whose job is to look after the records or accounts.

ext.ext_cn: 宾馆接待员
ext.ext_en: ...a hotel clerk.

defs.def_en: In a hotel, office, or hospital, a clerk is the person whose job is to answer the telephone and deal with people when they arrive.
A clerk is someone who works in a store.

defs.def_cn: 做文书工作;当接待员(或店员等)

ext.ext_cn: 吉恩在拍卖会上作文书工作。
ext.ext_en: Gene clerked at the auction...

ext.ext_cn: 他为最高法院的大法官做书记员。
ext.ext_en: He clerked for the chief justice of the Supreme Court.

defs.def_en: To clerk means to work as a clerk.
A vat is a large barrel or tank in which liquids can be stored.

defs.def_cn: (想法或艺术风格)成熟，风行，盛行

ext.ext_cn: 他也许会对新思想的盛行感到高兴，但他本人并没有为此作出多大贡献。
ext.ext_en: He may be happy with the flowering of new thinking, but he has yet to contribute much to it himself.

ext.ext_cn: 创造型天才的涌现
ext.ext_en: ...the flowering of creative genius.

defs.def_en: The flowering of something such as an idea or artistic style is the development of its popularity and success.
Flowering shrubs, trees, or plants are those which produce noticeable flowers.

defs.def_en: In some computer systems, a pipe is a method of passing information from one program to another.

defs.def_cn: 表现，体现，代表（思想或品质）

ext.ext_en: The proposal has been embodied in a draft resolution...

defs.def_en: If something is embodied in a particular thing, the second thing contains or consists of the first.

ext.ext_en: Steam or microwave the vegetables until tender.

ext.ext_en: ...microwaved food.

defs.def_en: To microwave food or drink means to cook or heat it in a microwave oven.

defs.def_cn: 持自由论的；自由论者的

ext.ext_en: ...the libertarian argument that people should be allowed to choose...

ext.ext_cn: 该镇的自由主义政治气氛浓厚。
ext.ext_en: The town's political climate was libertarian.

defs.def_en: If someone is libertarian or has libertarian attitudes, they believe in or support the idea that people should be free to think and behave in the way that they want.

defs.def_cn: 使精疲力竭;使疲惫不堪

ext.ext_en: Don't exhaust him...

ext.ext_en: He took to walking long distances in an attempt to physically exhaust himself.

defs.def_en: If something exhausts you, it makes you so tired, either physically or mentally, that you have no energy left.

ext.ext_cn: 我们已经耗尽了所有的物资。
ext.ext_en: We have exhausted all our material resources...

ext.ext_cn: 他们说供应的食物几乎快要吃完了。
ext.ext_en: They said that food supplies were almost exhausted.

defs.def_en: If you exhaust something such as money or food, you use or finish it all.

defs.def_cn: 详尽地讨论;详尽无遗地论述

ext.ext_cn: 她和尚塔尔肯定已经充分讨论过宝宝和衣服的问题。
ext.ext_en: She and Chantal must have exhausted the subject of babies and clothes.

defs.def_en: If you have exhausted a subject or topic, you have talked about it so much that there is nothing more to say about it.
The exhaust or the exhaust pipe is the pipe which carries the gas out of the engine of a vehicle.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车发动机排放的尾气
ext.ext_en: ...the exhaust from a car engine...

ext.ext_cn: 那座城市的街道肮脏不堪，弥漫着令人窒息的废气。
ext.ext_en: The city's streets are filthy and choked with exhaust fumes.

defs.def_en: Exhaust is the gas or steam that is produced when the engine of a vehicle is running.
Sliding doors are doors which slide together rather than swinging on hinges.

ext.ext_cn: 总统到目前为止仍然拒绝在首相那条孤注一掷的政令上连署签字。
ext.ext_en: The President has so far refused to countersign the Prime Minister's desperate decree...

ext.ext_cn: 多洛雷斯，请进来连署支票。
ext.ext_en: Dolores, please come in and countersign a cheque.

defs.def_en: If you countersign a document, you sign it after someone else has signed it.

defs.def_cn: 资产流动性；资产折现力

ext.ext_en: The company maintains a high degree of liquidity.

ext.ext_cn: 严重的资产流动问题
ext.ext_en: ...serious liquidity problems.

defs.def_en: In finance, a company's liquidity is the amount of cash or liquid assets it has easily available.

defs.def_cn: （银行授权另一家银行付款的）信用证，信用状
defs.def_en: A letter of credit is a letter written by a bank authorizing another bank to pay someone a sum of money. Letters of credit are often used by importers and exporters.

defs.def_cn: （银行为债券担保的）信用证，信用状

ext.ext_cn: 这个项目有拉萨尔银行的信用状支持。
ext.ext_en: The project is being backed by a letter of credit from Lasalle Bank.

defs.def_en: A letter of credit is a written promise from a bank stating that they will repay bonds to lenders if the borrowers are unable to pay them.

ext.ext_cn: 公司配车、提供私人医疗保险以及其他额外待遇
ext.ext_en: ...a company car, private medical insurance and other perks...

ext.ext_cn: 当学生的好处之一是旅行购票可以优惠。
ext.ext_en: One of the perks of being a student is cheap travel.

defs.def_en: Perks are special benefits that are given to people who have a particular job or belong to a particular group.
A curriculum vitae is the same as a CV .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 磁性微粒
ext.ext_en: ...magnetic particles.

defs.def_en: If something metal is magnetic, it acts like a magnet.

ext.ext_cn: 带电气体粒子会受磁力影响。
ext.ext_en: The electrically charged gas particles are affected by magnetic forces.

defs.def_en: You use magnetic to describe something that is caused by or relates to the force of magnetism.

ext.ext_cn: 她的磁条身份证
ext.ext_en: ...her magnetic strip ID card.

ext.ext_cn: 录音磁带
ext.ext_en: ...magnetic recording tape.

defs.def_en: You use magnetic to describe tapes and other objects which have a coating of a magnetic substance and contain coded information that can be read by computers or other machines.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 引人注目的;有吸引力的;有魅力的

ext.ext_en: ...the magnetic effect of the prosperous German economy on would-be immigrants.

ext.ext_cn: 他外表的魅力与她个性的魅力
ext.ext_en: ...the magnetic pull of his looks and her personality.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as magnetic, you mean that it is very attractive to people because it has unusual, powerful, and exciting qualities.

defs.def_cn: 不合法的;非法的;违反规则的

ext.ext_en: It is illegal to intercept radio messages...

ext.ext_en: Birth control was illegal there until 1978...

defs.def_en: If something is illegal, the law says that it is not allowed.

ext.ext_en: ...a clothing factory where many illegals worked.

ext.ext_cn: 雇用很多非法移民的服装厂
ext.ext_en: ...a clothing factory where many illegals worked.

defs.def_en: Illegal immigrants or workers have travelled into a country or are working without official permission.

ext.ext_cn: 悲喜交加的奇怪情感
ext.ext_en: ...an emotion oddly compounded of pleasure and bitterness.

defs.def_en: If something is compounded of different things, it is a mixture of those things.

ext.ext_en: His father would accuse him of neglecting his filial duties...

ext.ext_cn: 此刻我需要的是一份孝心。
ext.ext_en: Right now I'm in need of a little filial affection.

defs.def_en: You can use filial to describe the duties, feelings, or relationships which exist between a son or daughter and his or her parents.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister described transferring education to central government funding as 'a retrograde step'.

defs.def_en: A retrograde action is one that you think makes a situation worse rather than better.

defs.def_cn: 慢性疲劳综合征(常使用缩略形式 CFS)
defs.def_en: Chronic fatigue syndrome is an illness that is thought to be caused by a virus, and which affects people for a long period of time. Its symptoms include tiredness and aching muscles. The abbreviation CFS is often used.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 曼哈顿的豪华舞厅
ext.ext_en: ...a tony dance club in Manhattan.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as tony, you mean it is stylish and sophisticated.

defs.def_en: Desktop publishing is the production of printed materials such as newspapers and magazines using a desktop computer and a laser printer, rather than using conventional printing methods. The abbreviation DTP is also used.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Critics of the scheme take a less benign view.

defs.def_en: You use benign to describe someone who is kind, gentle, and harmless.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: We're taking relatively benign medicines and we're turning them into poisons.

defs.def_en: A benign substance or process does not have any harmful effects.

ext.ext_en: It wasn't cancer, only a benign tumour.

defs.def_en: A benign tumour will not cause death or serious harm.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: This plunge came in a time of relatively benign economic conditions.

defs.def_en: Benign conditions are pleasant or make it easy for something to happen.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's  approach to a problem as one of benign neglect, you disapprove of the fact that they are doing nothing and hoping that the problem will solve itself.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as misshapen, you think that it does not have a normal or natural shape.

defs.def_en: You use profound to emphasize that something is very great or intense.

ext.ext_en: ...one of the country's most profound minds.

ext.ext_en: He shielded his head from the sun with an old sack...

ext.ext_en: The poll canvassed the views of almost eighty economists.

defs.def_en: If you canvass public opinion, you find out how people feel about a particular subject.

ext.ext_en: The increase in pay costs was more than offset by higher productivity...

ext.ext_en: You could never eliminate risk, but preparation and training could attenuate it...

ext.ext_en: Theirs had been an increasingly attenuated relationship.

A conservationist is someone who cares greatly about the conservation of the environment and who works to protect it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行动)坚决有力的，激烈的，猛烈的

ext.ext_en: This television program provoked a spirited debate in the United Kingdom.

defs.def_en: A spirited action shows great energy and courage.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He was by nature a spirited little boy.

defs.def_en: A spirited person is very active, lively, and confident.

defs.def_en: A hot flush is a sudden hot feeling in the skin which women often experience at the time of their menopause.

ext.ext_cn: 一套车载娱乐系统
ext.ext_en: ...a range of in-car entertainment systems.

defs.def_en: In-car devices are ones that are designed to be used in a car.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我总是害怕孤单一人。
ext.ext_en: I've always been petrified of being alone...

ext.ext_cn: 好像很多人都怕蛇。
ext.ext_en: Most people seem to be petrified of snakes.

defs.def_en: If you are petrified, you are extremely frightened, perhaps so frightened that you cannot think or move.

ext.ext_cn: 一块木化石
ext.ext_en: ...a block of petrified wood.

defs.def_en: A petrified plant or animal has died and has gradually turned into stone.

ext.ext_cn: 月球表面有这样一些黑色的条痕。
ext.ext_en: There are these dark streaks on the surface of the moon...

ext.ext_cn: 火焰燃起时，犹如几条红色条纹映衬在淡褐色的墙上。
ext.ext_en: The flames begin as a few streaks of red against the pale brown of the walls.

defs.def_en: A streak is a long stripe or mark on a surface which contrasts with the surface because it is a different colour.

defs.def_cn: 在…上留下条纹(或条痕);使布满条纹(或条痕)

ext.ext_cn: 雨水已经开始在窗玻璃上冲出道道条痕。
ext.ext_en: Rain had begun to streak the windowpanes...

ext.ext_cn: 他的黑发间有几丝白发。
ext.ext_en: Fine shades of grey streaked his dark hair...

defs.def_en: If something streaks a surface, it makes long stripes or marks on the surface.

ext.ext_cn: 我们俩很像——都有点疯。
ext.ext_en: We're both alike—there is a streak of madness in us both...

ext.ext_cn: 他这人还是有点损。
ext.ext_en: He's still got a mean streak.

defs.def_en: If someone has a streak of a particular type of behaviour, they sometimes behave in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 一颗流星划过天空。
ext.ext_en: A meteorite streaked across the sky...

ext.ext_cn: 他的起跑近乎完美，迅速从那群人中蹿了出去。
ext.ext_en: He got a near perfect start, streaking away from the pack.

defs.def_en: If something or someone streaks somewhere, they move there very quickly.

defs.def_cn: (赌博或体育比赛等中的)运气，手气

ext.ext_cn: 很明显我现在手气正旺，赌场最好当心了！
ext.ext_en: The casinos had better watch out since I'm obviously on a lucky streak!

ext.ext_cn: 从 6 月 1 日开始就频频失利
ext.ext_en: ...a losing streak that had extended back to June 1.

defs.def_en: A winning streak or a lucky streak is a continuous series of successes, for example in gambling or sport. A losing streak or an unlucky streak is a series of failures or losses.

ext.ext_cn: 我很愿意提供它的一个副本。
ext.ext_en: I'll be glad to provide a copy of this...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不愿提供任何细节。
ext.ext_en: They would not provide any details...

defs.def_en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

ext.ext_cn: 条约规定，到本世纪末，美国必须撤除其基地。
ext.ext_en: The treaty provides that, by the end of the century, the United States must have removed its bases...

ext.ext_cn: 法令规定只有孩子的父母才有责任为孩子提供经济支持。
ext.ext_en: The Act provides that only the parents of a child have a responsibility for that child's financial support.

defs.def_en: If a law or agreement provides that something will happen, it states that it will happen.

defs.def_cn: (某些教派神职人员所穿、通常为黑色的)长袍，法衣
defs.def_en: A cassock is a long piece of clothing, often black, that is worn by members of the clergy in some churches.

ext.ext_cn: 租车自驾绝对会使在美国和加拿大的度假更加愉快。
ext.ext_en: Any holiday in the USA and Canada is enhanced by renting a self-drive car.

defs.def_en: A self-drive car is one which you hire and drive yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 自驾车野营度假的日益盛行
ext.ext_en: ...the growth in popularity of self-drive camping holidays.

defs.def_en: A self-drive holiday is one where you drive yourself to the place where you are staying, rather than being taken there by plane or coach.

defs.def_cn: （尤指因舒适和豪华而）尽情享受，沉湎于，陶醉于

ext.ext_cn: 躺下来尽情享受精油的滋润。
ext.ext_en: Lie back and luxuriate in the scented oil...

ext.ext_cn: 拉尔夫正沉浸于假期之中，这是他这么多年来第一个真正的假期。
ext.ext_en: Ralph was luxuriating in the first real holiday he'd had in years.

defs.def_en: If you luxuriate in something, you relax in it and enjoy it very much, especially because you find it comfortable and luxurious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指问题或困难）永恒的，持续的，亘古不变的

ext.ext_cn: 毒品和无家可归这两个一直困扰城市的问题
ext.ext_en: ...the perennial urban problems of drugs and homelessness...

ext.ext_cn: 有理科教学资格的老师一直都很短缺。
ext.ext_en: There's a perennial shortage of teachers with science qualifications.

defs.def_en: You use perennial to describe situations or states that keep occurring or which seem to exist all the time; used especially to describe problems or difficulties.

ext.ext_cn: 开绿黄色花的多年生香草
ext.ext_en: ...a perennial herb with greenish-yellow flowers.

ext.ext_cn: 多年生矮小植物
ext.ext_en: ...a low-growing perennial.

defs.def_en: A perennial plant lives for several years and has flowers each year.

ext.ext_cn: 照他看,他们和警察都是一伙的。
ext.ext_en: In his view they were all in cahoots with the police...

ext.ext_cn: 我不会让你和他勾结起来害我的。
ext.ext_en: I am not having you and him in cahoots against me.

defs.def_en: If you say that one person is in cahoots with another, you do not trust the first person because you think that they are planning something secretly with the other.

ext.ext_cn: 一片吐司
ext.ext_en: ...a piece of toast.

defs.def_en: Toast is bread which has been cut into slices and made brown and crisp by cooking at a high temperature.

ext.ext_cn: 稍稍烘烤面包两面。
ext.ext_en: Toast the bread lightly on both sides.

ext.ext_cn: 烤三明治
ext.ext_en: ...a toasted sandwich.

defs.def_en: When you toast something such as bread, you cook it at a high temperature so that it becomes brown and crisp.  →see usage note at:cook

ext.ext_cn: 我和埃莉诺向雅各布斯小姐敬酒。
ext.ext_en: Eleanor and I drank a toast to Miss Jacobs...

ext.ext_cn: 用餐终了，伯戈因被邀请致祝酒词。
ext.ext_en: At the end of the meal Burgoyne was asked to propose a toast.

defs.def_en: When you drink a toast to someone or something, you drink some wine or another alcoholic drink as a symbolic gesture, in order to show your appreciation of them or to wish them success.

ext.ext_cn: 政党官员与军队将领为他的健康举杯祝酒。
ext.ext_en: Party officials and generals toasted his health...

ext.ext_cn: 他们以香槟为她干杯。
ext.ext_en: They toasted her in champagne.

defs.def_en: When you toast someone or something, you drink a toast to them.

defs.def_cn: 深受敬慕的人;最受推崇的人

ext.ext_cn: 她是巴黎最受推崇的人。
ext.ext_en: She was the toast of Paris.

defs.def_en: If someone is the toast of a place, they are very popular and greatly admired there, because they have done something very successfully or well.

ext.ext_cn: 他们知道怎样控制、限制信息获取途径，而且如果需要，还会将其完全阻断，而这些途径对报纸来说很重要，对广播、电视更是极其关键。如果你不遵守游戏规则，你就完蛋了。
ext.ext_en: They know how to control, restrict and, if need be, throttle access, important to newspapers and absolutely vital to radio and television. And if you don't play the game, you're toast.

defs.def_en: If someone is toast, you mean that they are certain to be defeated or destroyed.

defs.def_cn: (经快速搅打后会发硬的)搅打奶油
defs.def_en: Whipping cream is cream that becomes stiff when it is stirred very fast.
A historian is a person who specializes in the study of history, and who writes books and articles about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不动感情的；无动于衷的；冷漠的；平静的

ext.ext_cn: 英国男人常被认为是矜持而冷漠的。
ext.ext_en: British men are often seen as being reserved and unemotional...

ext.ext_cn: 她念了起来，语调利落而平静。
ext.ext_en: She began to read in a brisk, unemotional voice...

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as unemotional, you mean that they do not show any feelings.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 坚果味牛油曲奇
ext.ext_en: ...nutty butter cookies...

ext.ext_cn: 鹰嘴豆有独特可口的坚果风味。
ext.ext_en: Chick peas have a distinctive, delicious and nutty flavour.

defs.def_en: If you describe food as nutty, you mean that it tastes of nuts, has the texture of nuts, or is made with nuts.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 发疯的;疯疯癫癫的;痴呆的

ext.ext_cn: 他看上去像个疯疯癫癫的教授。
ext.ext_en: He looked like a nutty professor...

ext.ext_cn: 这是个疯狂的想法。
ext.ext_en: That's a nutty idea.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as nutty, you mean that their behaviour is very strange or foolish.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不必向任何人示弱。
ext.ext_en: We should not have to bow down to anyone.

defs.def_en: If you refuse to bow down to another person, you refuse to show them respect or to behave in a way which you think would make you seem weaker or less important than them.
A tin opener is a tool that is used for opening tins of food.

ext.ext_cn: 我在家里的 11 个孩子中排行老七。
ext.ext_en: I was the seventh child in a family of 11.

defs.def_en: The seventh item in a series is the one that you count as number seven.

ext.ext_cn: 共有 100 万人丧生，占总人口的七分之一。
ext.ext_en: A million people died, a seventh of the population.

defs.def_en: A seventh is one of seven equal parts of something.

ext.ext_cn: 里德弹吉他的娴熟指法
ext.ext_en: ...Reid's dexterity on the guitar.

ext.ext_cn: 剧本的风趣幽默和机敏的语言
ext.ext_en: ...the wit and verbal dexterity of the script.

defs.def_en: Dexterity is skill in using your hands, or sometimes your mind.

defs.def_cn: （天主教、东正教和英国国教的）大主教，主教长

ext.ext_cn: 坎特伯雷大主教
ext.ext_en: ...the Archbishop of Canterbury.

ext.ext_cn: 德斯蒙德·图图大主教
ext.ext_en: ...Archbishop Desmond Tutu.

defs.def_en: In the Roman Catholic, Orthodox, and Anglican Churches, an archbishop is a bishop of the highest rank, who is in charge of all the bishops and priests in a particular country or region.

ext.ext_cn: 胃溃疡
ext.ext_en: ...stomach ulcers.

defs.def_en: An ulcer is a sore area on the outside or inside of your body which is very painful and may bleed or produce an unpleasant poisonous substance.
A swear word is a word which is considered to be rude or offensive. Swear words are usually used when people are angry.
Body odour is an unpleasant smell caused by sweat on a person's body.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 臭氧是一种非常活跃的氧气形态。
ext.ext_en: Ozone is a highly reactive form of oxygen gas.

defs.def_en: Something that is reactive is able to react chemically with a lot of different substances.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我希望我们的组织少一些被动反应，多一些积极主动。
ext.ext_en: I want our organization to be less reactive and more proactive.

defs.def_en: If someone is reactive, they behave in response to what happens to them, rather than deciding in advance how they want to behave.

ext.ext_cn: 在善良的上帝创造的世界里存在着邪恶和苦难这一神学之谜
ext.ext_en: ...this theological conundrum of the existence of evil and suffering in a world created by a good God.

defs.def_en: A conundrum is a problem or puzzle which is difficult or impossible to solve.

defs.def_cn: 按次序的;顺序的;序列的

ext.ext_cn: 宇宙的变迁史
ext.ext_en: ...the sequential story of the universe...

ext.ext_cn: 这样孩子们就会循序渐进地学习。
ext.ext_en: In this way the children are introduced to sequential learning.

defs.def_en: Something that is sequential follows a fixed order.

defs.def_cn: 失业状态；失业人群；失业队伍

ext.ext_cn: 许多白领，像股票经纪人和投资银行家，发现自己也失业了。
ext.ext_en: Many white-collar workers, like stock brokers and investment bankers, find themselves in the unemployment lines.

defs.def_en: When people talk about the unemployment line, they are talking about the state of being unemployed, especially when saying how many people are unemployed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人不快的；令人不舒服的

ext.ext_cn: 那些症状可能令人不适，很不舒服甚至会比较严重。
ext.ext_en: The symptoms can be uncomfortable, unpleasant and serious...

ext.ext_cn: 那个真空吸尘器有股很难闻的气味。
ext.ext_en: The vacuum has an unpleasant smell...

defs.def_en: If something is unpleasant, it gives you bad feelings, for example by making you feel upset or uncomfortable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她认为他是个粗鲁的人。
ext.ext_en: She thought him an unpleasant man...

ext.ext_cn: 不要开始给我找麻烦，否则我就不客气了。
ext.ext_en: Don't start giving me problems otherwise I'll have to be very unpleasant indeed.

defs.def_en: An unpleasant person is very unfriendly and rude.

defs.def_cn: 警察部门；警察机关；警方

ext.ext_cn: 警方也在寻找另一辆车。
ext.ext_en: The police are also looking for a second car...

ext.ext_cn: 警方说骚乱发生后他们已逮捕了20人。
ext.ext_en: Police say they have arrested twenty people following the disturbances...

defs.def_en: The police are the official organization that is responsible for making sure that people obey the law.

ext.ext_cn: 这一地区已被上百名警察包围。
ext.ext_en: More than one hundred police have ringed the area.

defs.def_en: Police are men and women who are members of the official organization that is responsible for making sure that people obey the law.

ext.ext_cn: 承担守卫边界职责的一小支联合国观察员部队
ext.ext_en: ...the tiny UN observer force whose job it is to police the border...

ext.ext_cn: 出动了大批警察维持游行示威的秩序。
ext.ext_en: The march was heavily policed.

defs.def_en: See also:secret police;If the police or military forces police an area or event, they make sure that law and order is preserved in that area or at that event.

ext.ext_cn: 投资管理监管组织，监督投资管理业务的自律机构
ext.ext_en: ...IMRO, the self-regulatory body that polices the investment management business.

defs.def_en: If a person or group in authority polices a law or an area of public life, they make sure that what is done is fair and legal.

ext.ext_cn: 内置有断路器，防止设备过载。
ext.ext_en: There is an internal circuit breaker to protect the instrument from overload.

defs.def_en: A circuit breaker is a device which can stop the flow of electricity around a circuit by switching itself off if anything goes wrong.

defs.def_cn: 吹捧;抬高（地位）；使…更辉煌

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲在餐桌上总是滔滔不绝地炫耀并吹嘘自己。
ext.ext_en: At the dinner table, my father would go on and on, showing off, aggrandising himself...

ext.ext_cn: 扩充该大楼的计划
ext.ext_en: ...plans to aggrandise the building.

defs.def_en: To aggrandize someone means to make them seem richer, more powerful, and more important than they really are. To aggrandize a building means to make it more impressive.

defs.def_cn: 开创性的；创新的；革新的

ext.ext_cn: 他关于同性恋题材的开创性小说
ext.ext_en: ...his groundbreaking novel on homosexuality.

ext.ext_cn: 创新研究
ext.ext_en: ...groundbreaking research.

defs.def_en: You use groundbreaking to describe things which you think are significant because they provide new and positive ideas, and influence the way people think about things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 难办的;难对付的;棘手的

ext.ext_cn: 在市中心泊车可能很困难。
ext.ext_en: Parking can be tricky in the town centre...

ext.ext_cn: 那是个非常棘手的问题，但我想有几样事你是可以做到的。
ext.ext_en: It's a very tricky problem, but I think there are a number of things you can do.

defs.def_en: If you describe a task or problem as tricky, you mean that it is difficult to do or deal with.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 诡计多端的;奸诈的;狡猾的
defs.def_en: If you describe a person as tricky, you mean that they are likely to deceive you or cheat you.
A colloquialism is a colloquial word or phrase.
An aesthete is someone who loves and appreciates works of art and beautiful things.

defs.def_cn: (道路、屋顶)铺了柏油的，涂了沥青的

ext.ext_cn: 柏油路面两边的辅道上布满车辙，凹凸不平。
ext.ext_en: The side tracks off the tarred road were rutted and uneven...

ext.ext_cn: 路虽窄，可铺了柏油。
ext.ext_en: The road was narrow but tarred.

defs.def_en: A tarred road or roof has a surface of tar.

defs.def_cn: (表示某情况自过去某时间点或某个事件以来一直持续到现在)自…以后，从…以来

ext.ext_cn: 雅克·阿诺德自 1987 年以来一直是议会议员。
ext.ext_en: Jacques Arnold has been a member of parliament since 1987...

ext.ext_cn: 几年前她得了神经衰弱，自那以后就变得十分腼腆。
ext.ext_en: She had a sort of breakdown some years ago, and since then she has been very shy...

defs.def_en: You use since when you are mentioning a time or event in the past and indicating that a situation has continued from then until now.

defs.def_cn: (表示某事件或情况从过去某时间或某个事件之后一直发生)自…以来,在…之后

ext.ext_cn: 今年英格兰和威尔士报道的犯罪增长率是战后以来最高的。
ext.ext_en: The percentage increase in reported crime in England and Wales this year is the highest since the war...

ext.ext_cn: 结果他是自安德鲁·约翰逊以来和国会斗争最多的一任总统。
ext.ext_en: He turned out to have more battles with the Congress than any president since Andrew Johnson.

defs.def_en: You use since to mention a time or event in the past when you are describing an event or situation that has happened after that time.

defs.def_cn: (表示过去某事或某情况发生后不久又发生了另一件事)此后，后来

ext.ext_cn: 约 6,000 人被捕，后来其中的几百人又被释放了。
ext.ext_en: About six thousand people were arrested, several hundred of whom have since been released...

ext.ext_cn: 他的领导风格已经在他的拥趸中引起了越来越多的批评，很多人后来离开了总局。
ext.ext_en: His style of leadership has attracted increasing criticism among his supporters, many of whom have since left Central Office.

defs.def_en: When you are talking about an event or situation in the past, you use since to indicate that another event happened at some point later in time.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管双亲早已离世，她谈论起他们时好像他们至今健在。
ext.ext_en: Even though her parents have long since died, she still talks about them in the present tense.

defs.def_en: If you say that something has long since happened, you mean that it happened a long time ago.

ext.ext_cn: 我永远都在减肥，因为我很容易长胖。
ext.ext_en: I'm forever on a diet, since I put on weight easily...

ext.ext_cn: 她挣的钱不够自己一个人住，于是搬回去和她妈妈一起住了。
ext.ext_en: Since she did not make enough money to live in her own house, she went back to live with her mother.

defs.def_en: You use since to introduce reasons or explanations.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 其他人都快喝醉了。
ext.ext_en: Everyone else was getting sloshed.

defs.def_en: If someone is sloshed, they have drunk too much alcohol.

defs.def_cn: 交际能力；人际交往能力

ext.ext_cn: 她很擅长处理人际关系，能够胜任管理一个团队。
ext.ext_en: She has very good people skills and is able to manage a team.

defs.def_en: People skills are the ability to deal with, influence, and communicate effectively with other people.

ext.ext_cn: 这个瘾君子经常把别人对他的反应当作反感他的意思，即使别人并没有那个意思。
ext.ext_en: The addict often reads disapproval into people's reactions to him even where it does not exist...

ext.ext_cn: 如果硬把太多含义强加给这部轻松的作品就不对了。
ext.ext_en: It would be wrong to try to read too much into such a light-hearted production.

defs.def_en: If you read a meaning into something, you think it is there although it may not actually be there.

defs.def_cn: 欢呼雀跃;欢腾;蹦蹦跳跳

ext.ext_cn: 趁孩子们在沙滩上嬉戏，你可以吃点小吃。
ext.ext_en: You can enjoy a quick snack while your children cavort in the sand...

defs.def_en: When people cavort, they leap about in a noisy and excited way.

ext.ext_cn: 据称，她和一个巡佐在极可意浴缸里玩鸳鸯浴，但是她并不承认。
ext.ext_en: It was claimed she cavorted with a police sergeant in a Jacuzzi but she denies this.
