ext.ext_cn: 周六走在商街上，口袋里有几个钱忍不住想要花掉。
ext.ext_en: It's Saturday, you're down the high street and you've got a few quid burning a hole in your pocket.

defs.def_en: If you say that some money is burning a hole in someone's pocket, you mean that they want to spend it as soon as possible.

defs.def_cn: 在（某人）掌握之中；受制于（某人）

ext.ext_cn: 董事会肯定已被约翰斯通掌控了。
ext.ext_en: The board of directors must surely have been in Johnstone's pocket.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in someone else's pocket, you disapprove of the fact that the first person is willing to do whatever the second person tells them, for example out of weakness or in return for money.

defs.def_cn: 为（自己或某人）牟利；使（自己或某人）中饱私囊

ext.ext_cn: 据估计可能会有5,000名银行职员利用客户账户中饱私囊。
ext.ext_en: It is estimated that 5,000 bank staff could be lining their own pockets from customer accounts.

ext.ext_cn: 无视大多数人的需要以为少数特权者牟利的政府
ext.ext_en: ...a government that ignores the needs of the majority in order to line the pockets of the favoured few.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is lining their own or someone else's pockets, you disapprove of them because they are making money dishonestly or unfairly.

ext.ext_cn: 他们非常缺钱——他们在好莱坞的花费已经远远超出了他的收入。
ext.ext_en: They were well out of pocket — they had spent far more in Hollywood than he had earned...

ext.ext_cn: 存在错误的结算单仍有可能发送出去，但告知我们的客户将不会遭受损失。
ext.ext_en: Statements with errors could still be going out, but customers who notify us will not be left out of pocket.

defs.def_en: See also:out-of-pocket;If you are out of pocket, you have less money than you should have or than you intended, for example because you have spent too much or because of a mistake.

ext.ext_cn: 比起遭到枪击，他们被人扒窃的危险更大。
ext.ext_en: They were more in danger of having their pockets picked than being shot at.

defs.def_en: If someone picks your pocket, they steal something from your pocket, usually without you noticing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (为重要或激动人心的活动)做好准备的

ext.ext_cn: 我的手下都来工作了，而且我让他们都做好了准备。
ext.ext_en: My people come to work and I get them all revved up.

defs.def_en: If someone is revved up, they are prepared for an important or exciting activity.

ext.ext_cn: 东欧剧变主要的发起者之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the major initiators of the tumultuous changes in Eastern Europe.

defs.def_en: The initiator of a plan or process is the person who was responsible for thinking of it or starting it.
A craft fair is an event at which people sell goods they have made.

defs.def_cn: 专制君主；有绝对权力的统治者
defs.def_en: A potentate is a ruler who has complete power over his people.

ext.ext_cn: 在开始动工之前至少要做一年的准备工作。
ext.ext_en: At least a year's preparatory work will be necessary before building can start.

ext.ext_cn: 为本周在马尔代夫群岛召开的峰会举行的预备会谈
ext.ext_en: ...preparatory talks for this week's summit in the Maldive Islands.

defs.def_en: Preparatory actions are done before doing something else as a form of preparation or as an introduction.

ext.ext_cn: 斯隆清了清嗓子，准备讲话。
ext.ext_en: Sloan cleared his throat preparatory to speaking...

ext.ext_cn: 她把烤箱加热，准备把馅饼放进去。
ext.ext_en: She lit the oven, preparatory to putting the pie into it.

defs.def_en: If one action is done preparatory  to another, it is done before the other action, usually as preparation for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们同意通过谈判来努力解决纠纷。
ext.ext_en: They agreed to try to settle their dispute by negotiation...

ext.ext_cn: 双方都在寻求消除分歧的方法。
ext.ext_en: Both sides are looking for ways to settle their differences...

defs.def_en: If people settle an argument or problem, or if something settles it, they solve it, for example by making a decision about who is right or about what to do.

ext.ext_cn: 为了争取庭外和解，莫尔肯同意赔款。
ext.ext_en: In an attempt to settle the case, Molken has agreed to pay restitution...

ext.ext_cn: 如果她同意庭外和解的话，得到的肯定会更多。
ext.ext_en: She got much less than she would have done if she had settled out of court...

defs.def_en: If people settle a legal dispute or if they settle, they agree to end the dispute without going to a court of law, for example by paying some money or by apologizing.

defs.def_cn: 付清(欠款);结算(账单);结(账)

ext.ext_cn: 我为我的咖啡和他的两杯葡萄酒付了账。
ext.ext_en: I settled the bill for my coffee and his two glasses of wine...

ext.ext_cn: 晚上聚会结束的时候他们和科林结清了账。
ext.ext_en: They settled with Colin at the end of the evening.

defs.def_en: If you settle a bill or debt, you pay the amount that you owe.

ext.ext_cn: 我们这边已经安排妥当了。
ext.ext_en: As far as we're concerned, the matter is settled...

ext.ext_cn: 那就定下来了，我们今晚交换联系地址。
ext.ext_en: That's settled then. We'll exchange addresses tonight.

defs.def_en: If something is settled, it has all been decided and arranged.

defs.def_cn: (以遗嘱等正式方式)赠予,授予

ext.ext_cn: 她提出要把一笔遗产留给凯瑟琳。
ext.ext_en: She offered to settle a legacy on Katharine.

defs.def_en: To settle money on someone means to formally give it to them, for example in a will.

defs.def_cn: 在…定居;使定居;把…安置在

ext.ext_cn: 在英国定居的难民面临很多问题。
ext.ext_en: Refugees settling in Britain suffer from a number of problems...

ext.ext_cn: 他造访了巴黎，并最终在那儿定居下来。
ext.ext_en: He visited Paris and eventually settled there...

defs.def_en: When people settle a place or in a place, or when a government settles them there, they start living there permanently.

ext.ext_cn: 艾伯特舒舒服服地坐在沙发上。
ext.ext_en: Albert settled himself on the sofa...

ext.ext_cn: 杰茜卡微微松了口气，坐到了椅子上。
ext.ext_en: Jessica settled into her chair with a small sigh of relief.

defs.def_en: If you settle yourself somewhere or settle somewhere, you sit down or make yourself comfortable.

ext.ext_cn: 墙上落了一层黑色的粉尘。
ext.ext_en: A black dust settled on the walls...

ext.ext_cn: 一旦杂质沉淀下去，油就可以分级了。
ext.ext_en: Once its impurities had settled, the oil could be graded...

defs.def_en: If something settles or if you settle it, it sinks slowly down and becomes still.

ext.ext_cn: 那名男子的目光落在了克罗斯的脸上。
ext.ext_en: The man let his eyes settle upon Cross's face.

defs.def_en: If your eyes settle on or upon something, you stop looking around and look at that thing for some time.

ext.ext_cn: 几只蛾子在它前面飞，最终落在了那块粗糙的喷漆金属上。
ext.ext_en: Moths flew in front of it, eventually settling on the rough painted metal.

defs.def_en: When birds or insects settle on something, they land on it from above.
A smallholder is someone who has a smallholding.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不整洁的;邋遢的;破烂的

ext.ext_cn: 有许多小旅馆都又脏又乱。
ext.ext_en: There were a lot of guest houses which were very tatty.

ext.ext_cn: 破旧的浴衣
ext.ext_en: ...a very tatty old bathrobe.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as tatty, you think it is untidy, rather dirty, and looks as if it has not been cared for.

defs.def_cn: 足医术，足病学（比chiropody一词更现代的用语）
defs.def_en: Podiatry is the professional care and treatment of people's feet. Podiatry is a more modern term for chiropody and also deals with correcting foot problems relating to the way people stand and walk.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是个热情、大方、善良的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a warm, generous and kind-hearted man.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as kind-hearted, you mean that they are kind, caring, and generous.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他沿着海岸慢慢向东前行。
ext.ext_en: He progressed slowly along the coast in an easterly direction.

defs.def_en: An easterly point, area, or direction is to the east or towards the east.

ext.ext_cn: 来自斯堪的纳维亚的寒冷东风
ext.ext_en: ...the cold easterly winds from Scandinavia.

defs.def_en: An easterly wind is a wind that blows from the east.

ext.ext_cn: 大型水坝对西伯利亚脆弱的生态平衡造成了破坏。
ext.ext_en: Large dams have harmed Siberia's delicate ecological balance.

ext.ext_cn: 雨林破坏等生态灾难
ext.ext_en: ...ecological disasters, such as the destruction of rainforest.

defs.def_en: Ecological means involved with or concerning ecology.

defs.def_cn: 主张生态保护的;从事生态保护工作的

ext.ext_cn: 环境保护组织称目前并未采取任何行动处理这个问题。
ext.ext_en: Ecological groups say that nothing is being done to tackle the problem.

defs.def_en: Ecological groups, movements, and people are concerned with preserving the environment and natural resources, so that they can be used in a sensible way, rather than being wasted.

ext.ext_cn: 威廉对自己有绝对的信心。
ext.ext_en: William has acquired an unshakeable belief in himself...

ext.ext_cn: 她坚信人的本性是善良诚实的。
ext.ext_en: She had an unshakeable faith in human goodness and natural honesty.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's beliefs as unshakeable, you are emphasizing that they are so strong that they cannot be destroyed or altered.

defs.def_cn: （游戏机室里常有的)电子游戏
defs.def_en: An arcade game is a computer game of the type that is often played in amusement arcades.

ext.ext_cn: 不久之后，国防开支的削减迫使航空航天业紧缩开支。
ext.ext_en: Shortly afterwards, cuts in defence spending forced the aerospace industry to retrench.

defs.def_en: If a person or organization retrenches, they spend less money.
Citric acid is a weak acid found in many kinds of fruit, especially citrus fruit such as oranges and lemons.
A death certificate is an official certificate signed by a doctor which states the cause of a person's death.

ext.ext_cn: 无所不能的工会
ext.ext_en: ...the all-powerful labour unions.

defs.def_en: An all-powerful person or organization has the power to do anything they want.

ext.ext_cn: 基因组学的变革
ext.ext_en: ...the genomics revolution.

defs.def_en: Genomics is the study of genomes.

ext.ext_cn: 面罩掉落的持枪歹徒逃之夭夭了。
ext.ext_en: The gunman, whose mask had slipped, fled.

ext.ext_cn: 戴面具的演员们
ext.ext_en: ...actors wearing masks.

defs.def_en: A mask is a piece of cloth or other material, which you wear over your face so that people cannot see who you are, or so that you look like someone or something else.

defs.def_cn: （防细菌或有害物质的）防护面罩,面具，口罩

ext.ext_cn: 为了免受烟雾危害，你必须戴上护目镜和面罩。
ext.ext_en: You must wear goggles and a mask that will protect you against the fumes...

ext.ext_cn: 她处理样品的时候戴着手术口罩和橡胶手套。
ext.ext_en: She wore a surgical mask and rubber gloves while she worked with the samples.

defs.def_en: A mask is a piece of cloth or other material that you wear over all or part of your face to protect you from germs or harmful substances.

defs.def_cn: (掩盖真实感情或性格的)伪装，掩饰

ext.ext_cn: 他冷静超然的伪装破碎了，一瞬间她的面前出现了一个愤怒而又狂暴的男人。
ext.ext_en: His mask of detachment cracked, and she saw for an instant an angry and violent man.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as a mask, you mean that they do not show their real feelings or character.

ext.ext_cn: 这种面膜能使你的皮肤变得柔软细嫩。
ext.ext_en: This mask leaves your complexion feeling soft and supple.

defs.def_en: A mask is a thick cream or paste made of various substances, which you spread over your face and leave for some time in order to improve your skin.

ext.ext_cn: 德娜点燃了一根烟，试图掩饰不安。
ext.ext_en: Dena lit a cigarette, trying to mask her agitation.

defs.def_en: If you mask your feelings, you deliberately do not show them in your behaviour, so that people cannot know what you really feel.

ext.ext_cn: 一片厚厚的乌云遮住了太阳。
ext.ext_en: A thick grey cloud masked the sun...

ext.ext_cn: 太多的盐会盖住食物本来的味道。
ext.ext_en: Too much salt masks the true flavour of the food...

defs.def_en: If one thing masks another, it prevents people from noticing or recognizing  the other thing.

defs.def_cn: 小偷小摸；偷窃（不太贵重的东西）

ext.ext_cn: 店员在柜台后有些小偷小摸的行为。
ext.ext_en: Staff were pilfering behind the bar...

ext.ext_cn: 食品店关门后，他们就行动起来，偷食品拿到黑市上出售。
ext.ext_en: When food stores close, they go to work, pilfering food for resale on the black market.

defs.def_en: If someone pilfers, they steal things, usually small cheap things.

defs.def_cn: （表示某事属实，然后再对其作出评论）不错，的确

ext.ext_cn: 的确，这家公司没有违法，但这样的法律是否合理呢？
ext.ext_en: Granted that the firm has not broken the law, is the law what it should be?

ext.ext_cn: 以他的年龄来说他看起来确实还算不错，不过我并不喜欢他。
ext.ext_en: Granted, he doesn't look too bad for his age, but I don't  fancy him.

defs.def_en: You use granted or granted that at the beginning of a clause to say that something is true, before you make a comment on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 影响深远的;意义重大的

ext.ext_cn: 如果不实施影响深远的改革，经济就面临崩溃的危险。
ext.ext_en: The economy is in danger of collapse unless far-reaching reforms are implemented.

defs.def_en: If you describe actions, events, or changes as far-reaching, you mean that they have a very great influence and affect a great number of things.

ext.ext_cn: 我行医是为了治病救人，而不是浪费时间为预算问题争论不休。
ext.ext_en: I went into medicine to care for patients, not to waste time bickering over budgets...

ext.ext_cn: 这两个女人经常发生口角。
ext.ext_en: The two women bickered constantly.

defs.def_en: When people bicker, they argue or quarrel about unimportant things.

defs.def_cn: (用于指先前已提到的女性或雌性动物)她，它

ext.ext_cn: 那晚安回到家时，看见布赖恩正在屋子里看电视。
ext.ext_en: When Ann arrived home that night, she found Brian in the house watching TV...

ext.ext_cn: 她17 岁，未受过教育，也没有工作。
ext.ext_en: She was seventeen and she had no education or employment...

defs.def_en: You use she to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal who has already been mentioned or whose identity is clear.

defs.def_cn: (用于泛指未指明性别的人，以避免总是用 he。有些人更倾向于使用 he or she 或 they 来表示泛指)

ext.ext_cn: 学生可能会表现出对责任感到有压力，然后可能会放弃。
ext.ext_en: The student may show signs of feeling the strain of responsibility and she may give up...

ext.ext_cn: 当新生儿感到饥饿时，就学会了喊叫。
ext.ext_en: Very early in life when the baby feels the pangs of hunger, she learns to scream.

defs.def_en: Some writers may use she to refer to a person who is not identified as either male or female. They do this because they wish to avoid using the pronoun 'he' all the time. Some people dislike this use and prefer to use 'he or she' or 'they'.

ext.ext_cn: 如果英国想要对欧洲未来的发展产生重要影响的话，就需要新的领导层。
ext.ext_en: Britain needs new leadership if she is to help shape Europe's future.

defs.def_en: She is sometimes used to refer to a country or nation.

ext.ext_cn: 当大帆船驶进南安普顿码头时，几百只小船聚集在其周围。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of small boats clustered round the yacht as she sailed into Southampton docks.

defs.def_en: Some people use she to refer to a car or a machine. People who sail often use she to refer to a ship or boat.
A hot flash is the same as a hot flush .

defs.def_cn: (信件、包裹等的)递送，投递，运送

ext.ext_cn: 递送将需要 28 天的时间。
ext.ext_en: Please allow 28 days for delivery...

ext.ext_cn: 其价格为 108 英镑，包括增值税和送货费在内。
ext.ext_en: It is available at £108, including VAT and delivery.

defs.def_en: Delivery or a delivery is the bringing of letters, parcels, or other goods to someone's house or to another place where they want them.

defs.def_cn: 递送之物;投递之物;运送之物

ext.ext_cn: 我今天早上收到了送来的新鲜鸡蛋。
ext.ext_en: I got a delivery of fresh eggs this morning.

defs.def_en: A delivery of something is the goods that are delivered.

ext.ext_cn: 比萨饼递送员
ext.ext_en: ...a pizza delivery man.

ext.ext_cn: 国际花商联盟，鲜花速递服务机构
ext.ext_en: ...Interflora, the flower delivery service.

defs.def_en: A delivery person or service delivers things to a place.

ext.ext_cn: 他的发言稿写得非常精彩，但他的演讲风格真是无可救药。
ext.ext_en: His speeches were magnificently written but his delivery was hopeless.

defs.def_en: You talk about someone's delivery when you are referring to the way in which they give a speech or lecture.

ext.ext_cn: 分娩过程最终非常顺利，生了个健康的男婴。
ext.ext_en: In the end, it was an easy delivery: a fine baby boy...

ext.ext_cn: 双胞胎的早产率要比一般的高出两倍，在36到38周之间分娩很正常。
ext.ext_en: Premature birth is three times more likely for twins, and delivery at 36 to 38 weeks is normal.

defs.def_en: Delivery is the process of giving birth to a baby.

defs.def_cn: (未出生婴儿的)生命权，出生权

ext.ext_cn: 胎儿确实有生命权吗？
ext.ext_en: Surely the fetus has a right to life?

ext.ext_cn: 反堕胎运动
ext.ext_en: ...the Right to Life Campaign.

defs.def_en: When people talk about an unborn baby's right to life, they mean that a baby has the right to be born, even if it is severely disabled or if its mother does not want it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 性感的金发女郎
ext.ext_en: ...a luscious young blonde...

ext.ext_cn: 我最喜欢的是盖比那性感饱满的双唇！
ext.ext_en: What I like most about Gabby is her luscious lips!

defs.def_en: If you describe a woman or something about her as luscious, you mean that you find her or this thing sexually attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一棵结的果子甘甜多汁的小杏树
ext.ext_en: ...a small apricot tree which bore luscious fruit.

defs.def_en: Luscious food is juicy and very good to eat.
Rheumatology is the area of medicine that is concerned with rheumatism, arthritis, and related diseases.
A mess hall is a large room where a particular group of people, especially members of the armed forces, eat meals together.

defs.def_cn: 比索（阿根廷、哥伦比亚、古巴、多米尼加共和国、墨西哥、菲律宾及乌拉圭的货币单位）
defs.def_en: The peso is the unit of money that is used in Argentina, Colombia, Cuba, the Dominican Republic, Mexico, the Philippines, and Uruguay.

defs.def_cn: （电影、文学、图像等）带有同性恋性爱（或情色）内容的
defs.def_en: Homoerotic is used to describe things such as films, literature, and images intended to be sexually appealing to homosexual men.

ext.ext_cn: 英国社会文化的多元性
ext.ext_en: ...the cultural diversity of British society.

ext.ext_cn: 在教育体系中引入更多的选择和多样性
ext.ext_en: ...to introduce more choice and diversity into the education system.

defs.def_en: The diversity of something is the fact that it contains many very different elements.

ext.ext_cn: 他的目标就是尽可能多地搜集各种材料。
ext.ext_en: His object is to gather as great a diversity of material as possible.

defs.def_en: A diversity of things is a range of things which are very different from each other.

defs.def_cn: （中世纪欧洲宫廷的）逗乐小丑，弄臣
defs.def_en: In the courts of kings and queens in medieval Europe, the jester was the person whose job was to do silly things in order to make people laugh.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他开朗活泼的个性
ext.ext_en: ...his bright and breezy personality...

ext.ext_cn: 莫娜竭力使自己的声音听上去轻松随意。
ext.ext_en: Mona tried to sound breezy.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as breezy, you mean that they behave in a casual, cheerful, and confident manner.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这张专辑音乐轻松明快，趣味十足。
ext.ext_en: This album is bright, breezy and playful.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as breezy, especially music or clothing, you mean that it is bright, lively, and cheerful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这一天微风习习，暖洋洋的。
ext.ext_en: The day was breezy and warm.

defs.def_en: When the weather is breezy, there is a fairly strong but pleasant wind blowing.

defs.def_cn: (印度教和佛教的)涅，灵魂超脱

ext.ext_cn: 心无杂念，方可入灭。
ext.ext_en: Entering the realm of Nirvana is only possible for those who have become pure.

defs.def_en: In the Hindu and Buddhist religions, Nirvana is the highest spiritual state that can possibly be achieved.

ext.ext_cn: 很多商人认为，一个相对价格从不变化的地方会是极乐世界。
ext.ext_en: Many businessmen think that a world where relative prices never varied would be nirvana.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to a state of complete happiness and peace as nirvana .

ext.ext_cn: 哈丽雅特摆弄着桌上的钢笔。
ext.ext_en: Harriet fiddled with a pen on the desk.

defs.def_en: If you fiddle with an object, you keep moving it or touching it with your fingers.

defs.def_cn: 作小改动;略微变动;稍稍修改

ext.ext_cn: 她告诉惠斯勒他给她画的肖像已经完成，不要再改了。
ext.ext_en: She told Whistler that his portrait of her was finished and to stop fiddling with it.

defs.def_en: If you fiddle with something, you change it in minor ways.

ext.ext_cn: 他打开收音机，拨动旋钮，直至调到一个脱口秀节目。
ext.ext_en: He turned on the radio and fiddled with the knob until he got a talk show.

defs.def_en: If you fiddle with a machine, you adjust it.

ext.ext_cn: 他一直在伪造账目。
ext.ext_en: He's been fiddling the books...

ext.ext_cn: 不要再在开支账户上动手脚了。
ext.ext_en: Stop fiddling your expenses account.

defs.def_en: If someone fiddles financial documents, they alter them dishonestly so that they get money for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 调查涉及 1,000 万英镑的汽车保险诈骗案的警察昨天逮捕了 16 人。
ext.ext_en: Police investigating a £10 million car insurance fiddle arrested 16 people yesterday.

ext.ext_cn: 为骗税打掩护的合法企业
ext.ext_en: ...legitimate businesses that act as covers for tax fiddles.

defs.def_en: A fiddle is a dishonest action or scheme in which someone gets money for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 我知道该怎么把这盘子固定住了——有点麻烦。
ext.ext_en: I found out how to fix the tray on — a bit of a fiddle.

defs.def_en: If something is a fiddle, it is quite difficult to do because it involves small or complicated objects.

defs.def_cn: (尤指用于演奏民间音乐的)小提琴

ext.ext_cn: 哈迪年轻时在当地舞会上演奏小提琴。
ext.ext_en: Hardy as a young man played the fiddle at local dances.

defs.def_en: Some people call violins fiddles, especially when they are used to play folk music.

ext.ext_cn: 我非常健康——精力充沛。
ext.ext_en: I'm as fit as a fiddle — with energy to spare.

defs.def_en: Someone who is as fit as a fiddle is very healthy and full of energy.
If someone is on the fiddle, they get money by doing illegal or dishonest things.

defs.def_cn: 大难临头仍歌舞升平;见危难而若无其事
defs.def_en: If you say that someone is fiddling while Rome burns, you mean that they are not dealing with a difficult or dangerous situation but instead are doing useless things or pretending that nothing is wrong.

defs.def_cn: 处于次要地位;当副手;唱配角

ext.ext_cn: 想到要身居罗斯之下她就很郁闷。
ext.ext_en: She hated the thought of playing second fiddle to Rose.

defs.def_en: If you play second fiddle to someone, your position is less important than theirs in something that you are doing together.

ext.ext_cn: 其中两人下车鼓捣引擎。
ext.ext_en: Two of them got out to fiddle around with the engine.

defs.def_en: If you fiddle around or fiddle about with a machine, you do things to it to try and make it work.

defs.def_cn: 虚度光阴;无所事事;瞎混

ext.ext_cn: 国家在日益走向分裂，他希望立法者们再不要无所事事了。
ext.ext_en: He wants lawmakers to basically stop fiddling around as the country moves closer to breaking up...

ext.ext_cn: 他把时间都浪费在鸡毛蒜皮的小事上。
ext.ext_en: He wastes time fiddling about with minor matters.

defs.def_en: If someone fiddles around or fiddles about, they waste time doing unimportant things instead of dealing with important problems.

ext.ext_cn: 此时在国会，他们正就预算案等等瞎折腾。
ext.ext_en: Right now in Congress, they're fiddling around with the budget and so on...

ext.ext_cn: 一个人开始把遗嘱改来改去时总让人感到诧异。
ext.ext_en: One always wonders when a man starts fiddling about with his Will.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is fiddling around with or fiddling about with something, you mean that they are changing it in a way that you disapprove of.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 热情洋溢的;兴高采烈的;喜气洋洋的

ext.ext_cn: 决定成为一名电影演员的热情洋溢的年轻女孩
ext.ext_en: ...an exuberant young girl who decided to become a screen actress.

defs.def_en: If you are exuberant, you are full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 生机勃勃的;焕发活力的

ext.ext_cn: 这是大胆而又精彩的烹饪。
ext.ext_en: This is bold and exuberant cooking.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as exuberant, you like it because it is lively, exciting, and full of energy and life.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 明确的;清晰的;毫不隐讳的

ext.ext_cn: 电影和书籍中露骨的性爱片段
ext.ext_en: ...sexually explicit scenes in films and books.

ext.ext_cn: 招聘广告中对年龄的明确要求
ext.ext_en: ...explicit references to age in recruitment advertising.

defs.def_en: Something that is explicit is expressed or shown clearly and openly, without any attempt to hide anything.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他直言自己的目的是改革党内的投票制度。
ext.ext_en: He was explicit about his intention to overhaul the party's internal voting system.

defs.def_en: If you are explicit about something, you speak about it very openly and clearly.

ext.ext_cn: 他们喜欢享用我们准备的丰盛大餐，但是不喜欢和我们呆在一起。
ext.ext_en: They were happy to partake of our feast, but not to share our company.

defs.def_en: If you partake of food or drink, you eat or drink some of it.

ext.ext_cn: 你可能会被问到是否参加非常剧烈的体育运动。
ext.ext_en: You will probably be asked about whether you partake in very vigorous sports.

defs.def_en: If you partake in an activity, you take part in it.

defs.def_cn: 在某种程度上具有（某种特性）

ext.ext_cn: 奇迹一般不会被认为是魔法使然，不过二者在本质上有点相似。
ext.ext_en: Miracles are not generally regarded as magical. Nevertheless, they do partake of the same nature.

defs.def_en: If something partakes of a particular quality, it has that quality to some extent.
A swab is a small piece of cotton wool used by a doctor or nurse for cleaning a wound or putting a substance on it.

ext.ext_cn: 我路过时注意到一个男子独自在自助餐厅里拖地。
ext.ext_en: I noticed a lone man in the cafeteria swabbing the floor as I passed.

defs.def_en: If you swab something, you clean it using a wet cloth or a tool called a mop.
Jeans are casual trousers that are usually made of strong blue cotton cloth called denim.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不能忍受的;无法容忍的

ext.ext_cn: 他们觉得这会给他们带来无法承受的压力。
ext.ext_en: They felt this would put intolerable pressure on them...

ext.ext_cn: 任何党派践踏人权的行为都不能容忍。
ext.ext_en: Human rights abuses by any party are intolerable.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as intolerable, you mean that it is so bad or extreme that no one can bear it or tolerate it.

ext.ext_cn: 很快村民们就买不起口粮了。
ext.ext_en: Soon the villagers couldn't afford to buy food for themselves.

defs.def_en: You refer to the people who live in a village, especially the people who have lived there for most or all of their lives, as the villagers .

ext.ext_cn: 他们在吉利根路上翻滚，模拟一场暴力厮杀。
ext.ext_en: They rolled about on the Gilligan Road, simulating a bloodthirsty fight...

ext.ext_cn: 他模仿了一段脱衣舞表演。
ext.ext_en: He performed a simulated striptease.

defs.def_en: If you simulate an action or a feeling, you pretend that you are doing it or feeling it.

ext.ext_cn: 木头上刷了漆以看起来像块石头。
ext.ext_en: The wood had been painted to simulate stone...

ext.ext_cn: 用烟来模拟从撞碎的散热器中冒出的蒸气。
ext.ext_en: Smoke was used to simulate steam coming from a smashed radiator...

defs.def_en: If you simulate an object, a substance, or a noise, you produce something that looks or sounds like it.

ext.ext_cn: 这名科学家研制了一个模型来模拟地球全年的气候。
ext.ext_en: The scientist developed one model to simulate a full year of the globe's climate...

ext.ext_cn: 已经对车辆进行了测试以确定其在模拟撞车试验中会遭受多大的损坏。
ext.ext_en: Cars are tested to see how much damage they suffer in simulated crashes.

defs.def_en: If you simulate a set of conditions, you create them artificially, for example in order to conduct an experiment.

defs.def_cn: 把…一口吞下（或咽下）；吞服

ext.ext_cn: 她喝了一大口咖啡。
ext.ext_en: She gulped down a mouthful of coffee...

ext.ext_cn: 他一口就把它吞了下去。
ext.ext_en: He'd  gulped it down in one bite.

defs.def_en: If you gulp down food or drink, you quickly eat or drink it all by swallowing large quantities of it at once.

ext.ext_cn: 他得到指挥官的许可来与我会合。
ext.ext_en: He got permission from his commanding officer to join me.

defs.def_en: A commanding officer is an officer who is in charge of a military unit.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (建屋互助会或保险公司)非互助化，非互利化，转为有限公司

ext.ext_cn: 该团体 97% 的成员支持其转为有限公司的计划。
ext.ext_en: 97 per cent of the group's members support its plans to demutualise.

defs.def_en: If a building society or insurance company demutualises, it abandons its mutual status and becomes a limited company.

defs.def_cn: （赛跑或比赛中的）第二名，亚军

ext.ext_cn: 10位亚军会得到一箱葡萄酒。
ext.ext_en: The ten runners-up will receive a case of wine.

ext.ext_cn: 1987年在缪尔费尔德败给福尔多获得亚军的美国选手保罗·阿齐格
ext.ext_en: ...Paul Azinger, the American who was runner-up to Faldo at Muirfield in 1987.

defs.def_en: A runner-up is someone who has finished in second place in a race or competition.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤用于表示反对或嘲弄）有自由主义思想的，有左翼思想的

ext.ext_cn: 来看演出的都是那些有自由主义思想的左翼分子。
ext.ext_en: The people that come to watch the play are all those right-on left-wing sort of people.

ext.ext_cn: 一群年轻的左翼学生
ext.ext_en: ...the young, right-on student crowd.

defs.def_en: You can describe someone as right-on if they have liberal or left-wing ideas, especially if you disagree with them or want to make fun of them.  →see: right on; →see: right;

ext.ext_cn: 他驾驶双翼飞机到达，在一棵树上紧急降落。
ext.ext_en: He arrives in his biplane and crash lands it in a tree...

ext.ext_cn: 一架轻型飞机昨天在一个高尔夫球场的球洞区紧急降落了。
ext.ext_en: A light aircraft crash-landed on a putting green yesterday.

defs.def_en: If a pilot crash-lands an aircraft, or if it crash-lands, it lands more quickly and less safely than usual, for example when there is something wrong with the aircraft, and it cannot land normally.

defs.def_cn: 埃塞俄比亚的;埃塞俄比亚人的;埃塞俄比亚语的
defs.def_en: Ethiopian means belonging or relating to Ethiopia, or to its people, language, or culture.
A rubber plant is a type of plant with shiny leaves. It grows naturally in Asia but is also grown as a house plant in other parts of the world.

defs.def_cn: 大胆冒险之举;恶作剧；惊险刺激的事

ext.ext_cn: 罗宾汉大胆冒险的那一幕
ext.ext_en: ...the scene of Robin Hood's escapades.

defs.def_en: An escapade is an exciting and rather dangerous adventure.

ext.ext_cn: 他心里琢磨是否该开个有关打兔子的玩笑，但决定还是算了。
ext.ext_en: He debated whether to make a joke about shooting rabbits, but decided against it...

ext.ext_cn: 克劳斯讲的笑话糟糕透了。
ext.ext_en: No one told worse jokes than Claus.

defs.def_en: A joke is something that is said or done to make you laugh, for example a funny story.

ext.ext_cn: 她会拿自己的长相开玩笑。
ext.ext_en: She would joke about her appearance...

ext.ext_cn: 洛娜边笑边和特雷弗打趣。
ext.ext_en: Lorna was laughing and joking with Trevor...

defs.def_en: If you joke, you tell funny stories or say amusing things.

ext.ext_cn: 对他们而言，那可能仅仅是个恶作剧，但对我来说，它一点也不好笑。
ext.ext_en: It was probably just a joke to them, but it wasn't funny to me.

defs.def_en: A joke is something untrue that you tell another person in order to amuse yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 别这么大戒心，查理。我只不过是开开玩笑。
ext.ext_en: Don't get defensive, Charlie. I was only joking...

ext.ext_cn: “我倒真希望你也能这么好好地关心我一下，”薇拉打趣道。
ext.ext_en: 'I wish you made as much fuss of me,' Vera joked.

defs.def_en: If you joke, you tell someone something that is not true in order to amuse yourself.

defs.def_cn: 荒唐可笑的事（或人）；笑料；笑柄

ext.ext_cn: 这真荒谬，简直是可悲、可笑。
ext.ext_en: It's ridiculous, it's pathetic, it's a joke...

ext.ext_cn: 警方的调查简直荒唐可笑，完全是在掩盖真相。
ext.ext_en: The police investigation was a joke. A total cover-up.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is a joke, you think they are ridiculous and do not deserve respect.

defs.def_cn: （恼人或令人担心的事）不可理喻，使人无法接受

ext.ext_cn: 把打火机交给纵火犯简直是不可理喻。
ext.ext_en: Giving an arsonist a lighter is beyond a joke...

ext.ext_cn: “我不怕公平地打上一架，但是这玩笑有点儿开过头了。”
ext.ext_en: I'm not afraid of a fair fight but this is beginning to get beyond a joke.

defs.def_en: If you say that an annoying or worrying situation is beyond a joke, you are emphasizing that it is worse than you think is fair or reasonable.

defs.def_cn: 拿（严肃或悲惨的事情）开玩笑；对…一笑置之

ext.ext_cn: 我真希望能有你那样的勇气，迈克尔，能把事情那么一笑置之。
ext.ext_en: I wish I had your courage, Michael, to make a joke of it like that.

defs.def_en: If you make a joke of something, you laugh at it even though it is in fact rather serious or sad.

defs.def_cn: 不是轻而易举的事；不是闹着玩的

ext.ext_cn: 在公交车上坐上两个小时可不轻松，对吧？
ext.ext_en: Two hours on a bus is no joke, is it?

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as no joke, you are emphasizing that it is very difficult or unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: “他说：“这一次玩笑反而开到自己身上来了。这一点儿也不好玩。”
ext.ext_en: 'For once,' he said, 'the joke's on me. And it's not very funny.'

defs.def_en: If you say that the joke is on a particular person, you mean that they have been made to look very foolish by something.

defs.def_cn: 开不起玩笑；经不起玩笑话

ext.ext_cn: “西蒙，你怎么回事？”柯利说。“你难道开不起玩笑么？”
ext.ext_en: 'What's the matter with you, Simon?' Curly said. 'Can't  you take a joke?'

defs.def_en: If you say that someone cannot take a joke, you are criticizing them for getting upset or angry at something you think is funny.

defs.def_cn: （用于表示吃惊或认为不可理喻）你一定是在开玩笑吧

ext.ext_cn: 你准是在开玩笑。你是认真的吗？
ext.ext_en: You're joking. Are you serious?...

ext.ext_cn: 一副耳机140英镑，你不是在开玩笑吧！
ext.ext_en: One hundred and forty quid for a pair of headphones, you've got to be joking!

defs.def_en: You say you're  joking or you must be joking to someone when they have just told you something that is so surprising or unreasonable that you find it difficult to believe.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她生活俭朴。
ext.ext_en: She lives a frugal life.

defs.def_en: People who are frugal or who live frugal lives do not eat much or spend much money on themselves.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 饮食很简单：奶酪、水、米饭、豆类。
ext.ext_en: The diet was frugal: cheese and water, rice and beans.

defs.def_en: A frugal meal is small and not expensive.

ext.ext_cn: 科普特教会是最古老的基督教会之一。
ext.ext_en: The Coptic Church is among the oldest churches of Christianity.

defs.def_en: Coptic means belonging or relating to a part of the Christian Church which was started in Egypt.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 讲究实际的;直截了当的;不容胡闹的

ext.ext_cn: 她认为自己是个直截了当、不拖泥带水的现代女性。
ext.ext_en: She saw herself as a direct, no-nonsense modern woman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as a no-nonsense person, you approve of the fact that they are efficient, direct, and quite tough.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你需要一双实用的靴子穿越丛林。
ext.ext_en: You'll need no-nonsense boots for the jungle.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as a no-nonsense thing, you approve of the fact that it is plain and does not have unnecessary parts.

ext.ext_cn: 由于缺乏睡眠，他们非常疲惫。
ext.ext_en: They were exhausted from lack of sleep...

ext.ext_cn: 试着睡一会儿。
ext.ext_en: Try and get some sleep...

defs.def_en: Sleep is the natural state of rest in which your eyes are closed, your body is inactive, and your mind does not think.

ext.ext_cn: 坐车来的路上，宝宝睡着了。
ext.ext_en: During the car journey, the baby slept...

ext.ext_cn: 前几个晚上，我一直都无法入睡。
ext.ext_en: I've not been able to sleep for the last few nights.

defs.def_en: When you sleep, you rest with your eyes closed and your mind and body inactive.

ext.ext_cn: 我想他也许很快就要睡一觉了。
ext.ext_en: I think he may be ready for a sleep soon.

defs.def_en: A sleep is a period of sleeping.

defs.def_cn: (大楼、房间等)可供(若干人)住宿，睡得下(若干人)

ext.ext_cn: 这座别墅可以住下 10 人，每人两周的费用是 530 英镑。
ext.ext_en: The villa sleeps 10 and costs £530 per person for two weeks.

defs.def_en: If a building or room sleeps a particular number of people, it has beds for that number of people.

ext.ext_cn: 那些歌声搅得我无法入睡。
ext.ext_en: I can't get to sleep with all that singing.

defs.def_en: If you cannot get to sleep, you are unable to sleep.

defs.def_cn: 对…十分担心;为…而睡不着觉

ext.ext_cn: 我并不太担心那个调查。
ext.ext_en: I didn't lose too much sleep over that investigation.

defs.def_en: If you say that you didn't lose any sleep over something, you mean that you did not worry about it at all.

defs.def_cn: 好好考虑一夜;把…留待第二天再作决定
defs.def_en: If you are trying to make a decision and you say that you will sleep on it, you mean that you will delay making a decision on it until the following day, so you have time to think about it.

defs.def_cn: 使(尤指有病或有伤的动物)无痛苦地死去;使长眠

ext.ext_cn: 我要把小狗带到兽医那里，让她安乐死。
ext.ext_en: I'm going take the dog down to the vet's and have her put to sleep.

defs.def_en: If a sick or injured animal is put to sleep, it is killed by a vet in a way that does not cause it pain.

ext.ext_cn: 她努力做一个无可挑剔的贤妻。
ext.ext_en: She strove to perform all her wifely functions perfectly.

ext.ext_cn: 为妻之道
ext.ext_en: ...the ideology of wifely duty.

defs.def_en: Wifely is used to describe things that are supposed to be typical of a good wife.

ext.ext_cn: 他在比萨店里找到一份洗盘子的工作。
ext.ext_en: He got a job washing dishes in a pizza parlour...

ext.ext_cn: 衬衣每洗一次都会褪点色。
ext.ext_en: The colours gently fade each time you wash the shirt...

defs.def_en: If you wash something, you clean it using water and usually a substance such as soap or detergent.

ext.ext_cn: 他们看起来好像已经有好些天没洗澡了。
ext.ext_en: They looked as if they hadn't washed in days...

ext.ext_cn: 她用凉水洗了把脸。
ext.ext_en: She washed her face with cold water...

defs.def_en: If you wash or if you wash part of your body, especially your hands and face, you clean part of your body using soap and water.

ext.ext_cn: 海水冲刷着海岸。
ext.ext_en: The sea washed against the shore...

ext.ext_cn: 他还在闲逛，拿着一罐可乐大口大口地喝着。
ext.ext_en: He was still hanging around, swigging the Coke out of the can.

defs.def_en: If you swig a drink, you drink it from a bottle or cup quickly and in large amounts.

ext.ext_cn: 那两个人也许不承认，可他们非常相像。
ext.ext_en: The two men were far more alike than they would ever admit...

ext.ext_cn: 人之所以重要，不在于他们拥有什么，而在于他们是什么样的人。
ext.ext_en: People matter because of what they are, not what they have...

defs.def_en: You use they to refer to a group of people, animals, or things.

defs.def_cn: (用以代替he or she，而不指明是男是女;有人认为这种用法不对)

ext.ext_cn: 教师对学生的成败并不负有责任，其职责只是帮助学生学习。
ext.ext_en: The teacher is not responsible for the student's success or failure. They are only there to help the student learn...

ext.ext_cn: 我从未见过有人进去买东西。到底有没有人进去过，我不知道。
ext.ext_en: I never saw anyone go in to buy. Whether they ever did I don't know.

defs.def_en: You use they instead of 'he or she' to refer to a person without saying whether that person is a man or a woman. Some people think this use is incorrect.

defs.def_cn: (用于 they say，they call it 等表达中表示泛指)他们

ext.ext_cn: 他们说，那里机会多的是，你只要仔细找就能发现。
ext.ext_en: They say there's plenty of opportunities out there, you just have to look carefully and you'll find them...

ext.ext_cn: 我相信，在澳大利亚，他们称之为动物磁性。
ext.ext_en: In Australia I believe that they call it animal magnetism.

defs.def_en: You use they in expressions such as 'they say' or 'they call it' to refer to people in general when you are making general statements about what people say, think, or do.

ext.ext_cn: 传销计划
ext.ext_en: ...multi-level marketing schemes.

defs.def_en: Multi-level marketing is a marketing technique which involves people buying a product, then earning a commission by selling it to their friends. The abbreviation MLM is also used.

defs.def_cn: 通过花言巧语获得；巧妙地免费得到

ext.ext_cn: 她听说他是个音乐家，就花言巧语从他朋友那里要了一盘带子。
ext.ext_en: She'd heard he was a musician and blagged a tape off a friend of his.

defs.def_en: To blag something such as a concert ticket means to persuade someone to give it to you free.
Appearance money is money paid to a famous person such as a sports star or film star for taking part in a public event.

defs.def_cn: （动作、状态或行为方式）习惯性的，惯常的，典型的

ext.ext_cn: 他不久就恢复了自己一贯的和蔼可亲的态度。
ext.ext_en: He soon recovered his habitual geniality...

ext.ext_cn: 不良姿势一旦定型，日后可就有你受的了。
ext.ext_en: If bad posture becomes habitual, you risk long-term effects.

defs.def_en: A habitual action, state, or way of behaving is one that someone usually does or has, especially one that is considered to be typical or characteristic of them.

ext.ext_cn: 她总是耽于幻想。
ext.ext_en: She was a habitual daydreamer.

ext.ext_cn: 内政大臣关于设置惯犯起刑点的打算
ext.ext_en: ...the home secretary's plans for minimum sentences for habitual criminals.

defs.def_en: You use habitual to describe someone who usually or often does a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 仓库的税前利润为310万。
ext.ext_en: Storehouse made pre-tax profits of 3.1m.

ext.ext_cn: 去年其税前收入为250万。
ext.ext_en: Last year it made 2.5m pre-tax.

defs.def_en: Pre-tax profits or losses are the total profits or losses made by a company before tax has been taken away.

defs.def_cn: (通常作为宗教惩罚的)鞭笞，鞭打

ext.ext_cn: 舞蹈开始前会举行祈祷和鞭笞的仪式。
ext.ext_en: There is a ceremony of prayer and flagellation before the dancing begins.

defs.def_en: Flagellation is the act of beating yourself or someone else, usually as a religious punishment.
A sub-machine gun is a light portable type of machine gun.

ext.ext_cn: 雇员和工会关系大有改观。
ext.ext_en: There is a substantial payback in terms of employee and union relations...

ext.ext_cn: 他们愿意等待更加长期的投资收益，并不特别在乎短期利润。
ext.ext_en: They are prepared to wait longer for a pay-back from investment rather than concentrate on short-term profits.

defs.def_en: You can use payback to refer to the profit or benefit that you obtain from something that you have spent money, time, or effort on.
The payback period of a loan is the time in which you are required or allowed to pay it back.

ext.ext_cn: 这是回报的时刻。我已经完全证明了我能成为冠军。
ext.ext_en: This was payback time. I've proved once and for all I can become champion...

ext.ext_cn: 他们根本就没有努力培养年轻球员，今年夏天他们将自食其果。
ext.ext_en: They have done absolutely nothing to develop young players and this summer will be the payback time.

defs.def_en: Payback time is when someone has to take the consequences of what they have done in the past. You can use this expression to talk about good or bad consequences.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无所不在的；随处可见的

ext.ext_cn: 糖在这种饮食里随处可见。
ext.ext_en: Sugar is ubiquitous in the diet...

ext.ext_cn: 便携式摄录机在美国随处可见。
ext.ext_en: In the US, the camcorder has become ubiquitous...

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as ubiquitous, you mean that they seem to be everywhere.

ext.ext_cn: 我们会尽全力维持和平。
ext.ext_en: We will do everything to preserve peace.

ext.ext_cn: 在保持原有教学水平的同时招收更多学生的努力
ext.ext_en: ...an effort to fit in more students while preserving standards.

defs.def_en: If you preserve a situation or condition, you make sure that it remains as it is, and does not change or end.

ext.ext_cn: 我们需要保护森林。
ext.ext_en: We need to preserve the forest...

ext.ext_cn: 资源保护是目前备受关注的问题——不管它指的是对古建筑的保护，还是对环境的保护。
ext.ext_en: Conservation is an issue which gets a lot of attention these days — whether it means preserving old buildings, or protecting the environment.

defs.def_en: If you preserve something, you take action to save it or protect it from damage or decay.

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢做果泥，只需要用一点糖把李子腌一下。
ext.ext_en: I like to make puree, using only enough sugar to preserve the plums.

ext.ext_cn: 用糖浆腌制的姜
ext.ext_en: ...preserved ginger in syrup.

defs.def_en: If you preserve food, you treat it in order to prevent it from decaying so that you can store it for a long time.
Preserves are foods such as jam that are made by cooking fruit with a large amount of sugar so that they can be stored for a long time.

defs.def_cn: 专属工作；独占的活动领域

ext.ext_cn: 外交政策事宜主要由总统专门负责。
ext.ext_en: The conduct of foreign policy is largely the preserve of the president...

ext.ext_cn: 由于男人们都去了战场，女人们第一次在男性专属的职业和运动中一展身手。
ext.ext_en: With the menfolk away at war, women got their first crack at the male preserves of employment and sport.

defs.def_en: If you say that a job or activity is the preserve of a particular person or group of people, you mean that they are the only ones who take part in it.

ext.ext_cn: 潘塔纳尔，世界上最大的野生动物保护区之一
ext.ext_en: ...Pantanal, one of the world's great wildlife preserves.

defs.def_en: A nature preserve is an area of land or water where animals are protected from hunters.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 情操高尚的;品德崇高的

ext.ext_cn: 总统对国家的期望是很高尚的，但却过于模糊。
ext.ext_en: The President's hopes for the country were high-minded, but too vague...

ext.ext_cn: 她属于那群道德高尚的女性，她们会聚在一起讨论文学作品。
ext.ext_en: She belonged to a high-minded group of ladies who met and discussed Works of Literature.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is high-minded, you think they have strong moral principles.
A fountain pen is a pen which uses ink that you have drawn up inside it from a bottle.

ext.ext_cn: 王国的势力衰弱了。
ext.ext_en: The kingdom's power declined.

ext.ext_cn: 联合王国
ext.ext_en: ...the United Kingdom.

defs.def_en: A kingdom is a country or region that is ruled by a king or queen.

ext.ext_cn: 该地区因土匪、无赖和奴隶贩子猖獗而声名狼藉。
ext.ext_en: It was infamous as a kingdom of brigands, scoundrels, and slave-traders.

defs.def_en: A kingdom is a place or area that is thought to be under the control of a person or organization.
All the animals, birds, and insects in the world can be referred to together as the animal kingdom. All the plants can be referred to as the plant kingdom.

ext.ext_cn: 村子东边零零散散的几间房舍
ext.ext_en: ...the scattering of houses east of the village...

ext.ext_cn: 詹姆斯先生已经结交了两三个豪门朋友。
ext.ext_en: Mr. James had had a scattering of very wealthy friends.

defs.def_en: A scattering of things or people is a small number of them spread over an area.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 排他性的商业行为
ext.ext_en: ...exclusionary business practices.

defs.def_en: Something that is exclusionary excludes a particular person or group of people.

defs.def_cn: 清楚地;明显地;肯定地;当然

ext.ext_cn: 我肯定会跟这些人取得联系。
ext.ext_en: I'm definitely going to get in touch with these people...

ext.ext_cn: 对此一定要采取一些措施。
ext.ext_en: Something should definitely be done about that...

defs.def_en: You use definitely to emphasize that something is the case, or to emphasize the strength of your intention or opinion.

ext.ext_cn: 他告诉他们还没有确定下场地。
ext.ext_en: He told them that no venue had yet been definitely decided.

defs.def_en: If something has been definitely decided, the decision will not be changed.

ext.ext_cn: 指控其搞政治阴谋
ext.ext_en: ...accusations of political skulduggery.

defs.def_en: Skulduggery is behaviour in which someone acts in a dishonest way in order to achieve their aim.
A wheelchair is a chair with wheels that you use in order to move about in if you cannot walk properly, for example because you are disabled or sick.

defs.def_cn: 以下义项中未列的表达方式请参见第13项。
defs.def_en: ⇒ Please look at category 13 to see if the expression you are looking for is shown under another headword.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示想要开口说话)嗯，唔

ext.ext_cn: 西尔维娅摆了摆手说：“嗯，你们自己去吃些早餐吧。”
ext.ext_en: Sylvia shook hands. 'Well, you go get yourselves some breakfast.'...

ext.ext_cn: 唔，我不喜欢事情看起来的样子。
ext.ext_en: Well, I don't like the look of that.

defs.def_en: You say well to indicate that you are about to say something.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示想要继续话题)这个，不过

ext.ext_cn: 你会失去自己的判断力。知道吗，就是变得疑神疑鬼？这正是我努力想避免的。
ext.ext_en: You can lose your perspective. You know, get paranoid? Well, that's something I really try and avoid...

ext.ext_cn: 曼城队的难题在于他们缺乏优秀球员。不过，这种情况很容易改变。
ext.ext_en: The trouble with City is that they do not have enough quality players. Well, that can easily be rectified.

defs.def_en: You say well to indicate that you intend or want to carry on speaking.

ext.ext_cn: 谢谢你的歌声，莱昂内尔。好了，我们来看看从9点到午夜都播出什么节目。
ext.ext_en: Thank you Lionel, for singing that for us. Well, we'd better tell you what's on the show between nine and midnight...

ext.ext_cn: 好了，让我们继续努力。
ext.ext_en: Well, let's press on.

defs.def_en: You say well to indicate that you are changing the topic, and are either going back to something that was being discussed earlier or are going on to something new.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示谈话结束)好吧，好了

ext.ext_cn: “我相信你会是一个有用的人才，”她最后加上一句，“好了，我看该吃午饭了。”
ext.ext_en: 'I'm sure you will be an asset,' she finally added. 'Well, I see it's just about time for lunch.'...

ext.ext_cn: 好吧，谢谢你和我们谈话。
ext.ext_en: Well, thank you for speaking with us.

defs.def_en: You say well to indicate that you have reached the end of a conversation.

defs.def_cn: (用于委婉地提出建议、批评、更正等)那么，嗯

ext.ext_cn: 那么，也许从小问题入手会更容易些。
ext.ext_en: Well, maybe it would be easier to start with a smaller problem...

ext.ext_cn: 那么，让我们等着看吧。
ext.ext_en: Well, let's wait and see...

defs.def_en: You say well to make a suggestion, criticism, or correction seem less definite or rude.

defs.def_cn: (用于停顿之前或之后，尤为给自己留出思考的时间)嗯，唔

ext.ext_cn: 听我说，我真抱歉吵醒你，嗯，我只是想告诉你我一切都好。
ext.ext_en: Look, I'm really sorry I woke you, and, well, I just wanted to tell you I was all right.

defs.def_en: You say well just before or after you pause, especially to give yourself time to think about what you are going to say.

ext.ext_cn: 彗星将在2061年返回，到时我们都看得到。噢，反正我们的子孙看得到。
ext.ext_en: The comet is going to come back in 2061 and we are all going to be able to see it. Well, our offspring are, anyway...

ext.ext_cn: 那儿有张便条，噢，其实不算是便条。
ext.ext_en: There was a note. Well, not really a note.

defs.def_en: You say well when you are correcting something that you have just said.

defs.def_cn: (用于对他人所说的话表示怀疑)哦

ext.ext_cn: “但是财政更加困难了。”——“是吗，我真不知道。”
ext.ext_en: 'But finance is far more serious.' — 'Well I don't know really.'

ext.ext_cn: “继续啊，丹尼斯。”——“哦，如果你确定的话。”
ext.ext_en: 'Go on, Dennis.' — 'Well, if you're sure.'

defs.def_en: You say well to express your doubt about something that someone has said.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示惊讶或气愤)啊，哟，好啦

ext.ext_cn: “伊梅尔达，”肯纳利夫人说道，“这是我的名字，汤姆。”——“哦，”汤姆说道，“伊梅尔达，我以前从来不知道。”
ext.ext_en: 'Imelda,' said Mrs Kennerly. 'That's my name, Tom.' — 'Well,' said Tom. 'Imelda. I never knew.'...

ext.ext_cn: 哦，天哪！他们有时看起来真像一对老夫老妻。
ext.ext_en: Well, honestly! They're like an old married couple at times.

defs.def_en: You say well to express your surprise or anger at something that someone has just said or done.

defs.def_cn: (用于等待他人回应，常表示不耐烦)嗯，那么，接着呢

ext.ext_cn: “嗯？”巴里问道，“它到底告诉我们什么？”
ext.ext_en: 'Well?' asked Barry, 'what does it tell us?'...

ext.ext_cn: “嗯，那你为什么不问我呢？”他最后问道。
ext.ext_en: 'Well, why don't you ask me?' he said finally.

defs.def_en: You say well to indicate that you are waiting for someone to say something and often to express your irritation with them.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示被听到或见到的所逗乐并常引出评论)哟，好啦

ext.ext_cn: 哟，哟，看看你啊，埃塞尔，看看这个小胖姑娘啊。
ext.ext_en: Well, well, well, look at you. Ethel, look at this little fat girl...

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃仔细瞧了一眼，说道：“哇，哇！自从战后我就再也没见过午餐肉了！”然后笑了起来。
ext.ext_en: Bob peered at it. 'Well, well!' he said, 'I haven't seen Spam since the war!' and laughed.

defs.def_en: You use well to indicate that you are amused by something you have heard or seen, and often to introduce a comment on it.

ext.ext_cn: 哎，算了，可能会更糟糕的。
ext.ext_en: Oh well, it could be worse...

ext.ext_cn: “我打电话给她了，但她拒绝了。”——“唉，那就这样吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'I called her and she said no.' — 'Oh well.'

defs.def_en: You say oh well to indicate that you accept a situation or that someone else should accept it, even though you or they are not very happy about it, because it is not too bad and cannot be changed.

defs.def_cn: (以标准或程度来说)好，出色地

ext.ext_cn: 所有印度击球手都打得不错。
ext.ext_en: All the Indian batsmen played well...

ext.ext_cn: 他的英语说得比我好。
ext.ext_en: He speaks English better than I do...

defs.def_en: If you do something well, you do it to a high standard or to a great extent.

ext.ext_cn: 把所有原料搅拌均匀。
ext.ext_en: Mix all the ingredients well...

ext.ext_cn: 用肥皂把手好好洗洗。
ext.ext_en: Wash your hands well with soap.

defs.def_en: If you do something well, you do it thoroughly and completely.

ext.ext_cn: “他对你评价很高。”——“真高兴听到这个。”
ext.ext_en: 'He speaks well of you.' — 'I'm glad to hear that.'...

ext.ext_cn: 这可能会让人们对他的印象好点。
ext.ext_en: It might help people think better of him.

defs.def_en: If you speak or think well of someone, you say or think favourable things about them.

defs.def_cn: (用于过去分词前表示达到很高标准或极大程度)

ext.ext_cn: 海伦是澳大利亚非常著名的小说家。
ext.ext_en: Helen is a very well-known novelist in Australia...

ext.ext_cn: 当今，人们越来越长寿，受教育程度也提高了。
ext.ext_en: People live longer nowadays, and they are better educated...

defs.def_en: Well is used in front of past participles to indicate that something is done to a high standard or to a great extent.

ext.ext_cn: 关于你妈妈你还记得多少，弗兰齐？
ext.ext_en: How well do you remember your mother, Franzi?...

ext.ext_cn: 这份新工作的薪水还不如原来那份多。
ext.ext_en: This new career doesn't pay nearly as well as the old one...

defs.def_en: You use well to ask or talk about the extent or standard of something.

defs.def_cn: (用于介词短语前表示强调)大大地，远远地

ext.ext_cn: 富兰克林直到午夜过后很久才出现。
ext.ext_en: Franklin did not turn up until well after midnight...

ext.ext_cn: 我们经常很早就计划好要吃什么。
ext.ext_en: We often plan our meals well in advance...

defs.def_en: You use well in front of a prepositional phrase to emphasize it. For example, if you say that one thing happened well before another, you mean that it happened a long time before it.

defs.def_cn: (用于某些形容词前表示强调)很，相当

ext.ext_cn: 她有一群十分了解其遭遇的密友。
ext.ext_en: She has a close group of friends who are very well aware of what she has suffered...

ext.ext_cn: 男人通常能更好地表达愤怒。
ext.ext_en: Men are generally better able to express anger...

defs.def_en: You use well before certain adjectives to emphasize them.

defs.def_cn: (置于描述情感的形容词前表示强调)非常

ext.ext_cn: 这是我在整场比赛中唯一一次上场，所以我对自己的进球非常开心。
ext.ext_en: It was about the only time I got up the field in the whole game so I was well happy with my goal...

ext.ext_cn: 当时我对这件事特别生气。
ext.ext_en: I was well pissed off about it at the time.

defs.def_en: Some people use well before adjectives referring to feelings to emphasize that the feeling is very strong.

defs.def_cn: (用于 perfectly，jolly，damn 等副词后，强调观点或真相)

ext.ext_cn: 你很清楚那次任务的失败不该怪我。
ext.ext_en: You know perfectly well I can't be blamed for the failure of that mission...

ext.ext_cn: 是我让自己陷入到这场婚姻中，我也一定要让自己从其中脱身。
ext.ext_en: I'd got myself into this marriage and I jolly well had to get myself out of it.

defs.def_en: You use well after adverbs such as 'perfectly', 'jolly', or 'damn' in order to emphasize an opinion or the truth of what you are saying.

defs.def_cn: (用于may，could等动词后，表示可能发生)有理由地，很可能地

ext.ext_cn: 凶手很可能来自那个庄园。
ext.ext_en: The murderer may well come from the estate...

ext.ext_cn: 我们这一代很可能是认为到电影院观影具有一种魔力的最后一代人了。
ext.ext_en: Ours could well be the last generation for which moviegoing has a sense of magic.

defs.def_en: You use well after verbs such as 'may' and 'could' when you are saying what you think is likely to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 这种病一般多发于三四十岁的女性，但我也见过许多更年轻的女性患这种病。
ext.ext_en: It is most often diagnosed in women in their thirties and forties, although I've seen it in many younger women, as well...

ext.ext_cn: “那么你喜欢这儿的什么？”——“嗯，它的历史啦，商店啦，还有这儿的人也都很友好。”
ext.ext_en: 'What do you like about it then?' — 'Erm, the history, the shops—people are quite friendly as well.'

defs.def_en: You use as well when mentioning something which happens in the same way as something else already mentioned, or which should be considered at the same time as that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 她出版了许多历史小说和一部有关英帝国女性的纪实性研究著作。
ext.ext_en: She published historical novels, as well as a non-fiction study of women in the British Empire...

ext.ext_cn: 这符合他的最大利益，同时也符合你的利益。
ext.ext_en: It is in his best interests as well as yours...

defs.def_en: You use as well as when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

defs.def_cn: 情理之中地;毫不奇怪地

ext.ext_cn: 这毫不奇怪地引得一些人倒吸凉气。
ext.ext_en: This caused a few gasps, as well it might...

ext.ext_cn: 你能看出他被吓着了，考虑到我们经历过的事情，这种反应很正常。
ext.ext_en: You can see he's terrified, as well he might be after what we've been through.

defs.def_en: If you say, after stating that something has happened or is the case, as well it might or as well it may, you mean that this is not at all surprising or is quite appropriate.

ext.ext_cn: 蓝石棉在建筑中很不常见，这倒是一件幸事，因为它比白石棉危险得多。
ext.ext_en: Blue asbestos is far less common in buildings, which is just as well because it's more dangerous than white asbestos...

ext.ext_cn: 从你所说的这一切来看，幸好她不在那儿。
ext.ext_en: Judging from everything you've said, it was just as well she wasn't there.

defs.def_en: If you say that something that has happened is just as well, you mean that it is fortunate that it happened in the way it did.

defs.def_cn: (用于建议某一特定思路或行动)最好（做…）

ext.ext_cn: 你最好记住大笑是消除紧张情绪的良方。
ext.ext_en: It is as well to bear in mind that laughter is a great releaser of tension.

defs.def_en: You say it is as well to think or do something when you are advising someone to think in a particular way or to take a particular action.

ext.ext_cn: 他可别忘了任何人的运气早晚都会用完的。
ext.ext_en: He would do well to remember that, sooner or later, everyone's luck runs out...

ext.ext_cn: 投资者应该关注一下瑞士的经济。
ext.ext_en: Investors would do well to take a look at the Swiss economy.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone would do well to do something, you mean that you advise or recommend that they do it.

ext.ext_cn: 这对夫妇形同陌路。
ext.ext_en: The couple might as well have been strangers...

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在的生活状况跟蹲监狱差不了多少。
ext.ext_en: We might just as well be in prison for all the quality our lives have at present.

defs.def_en: If you say that something, usually something bad, might as well be true or may as well be true, you mean that the situation is the same or almost the same as if it were true.

ext.ext_cn: 如果要去什么地方，那就去伯明翰吧。
ext.ext_en: If I've got to go somewhere I may as well go to Birmingham...

ext.ext_cn: 反正你已经在这儿了，那就留下来吧。
ext.ext_en: Anyway, you're here; you might as well stay...

defs.def_en: If you say that you might as well do something, or that you may as well do it, you mean that you will do it although you do not have a strong desire to do it and may even feel slightly unwilling to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他尽可为甩了你这事向你道歉。可他有没有告诉你为什么这样做啊？
ext.ext_en: It's all well and good for him to say he's sorry for dropping you, but has he told you why he did it?

defs.def_en: If you say that something is all well and good, you are suggesting that it has faults or disadvantages, although it may appear to be correct or reasonable.

ext.ext_cn: 如果他们在我离开之前到达，那自然很好。但如果不是的话，那责任就是我的了。
ext.ext_en: If they arrive before I leave, well and good. If not, the responsibility will be mine...

ext.ext_cn: 这样固然很好，但我们必须从长远的角度来看待这一情形。
ext.ext_en: This is all well and good, but we have to look at the situation in the long term.

defs.def_en: You say well and good or all well and good to indicate that you would be pleased if something happens but you are aware that it has some disadvantages.

defs.def_cn: 幸而摆脱了；幸而不受牵连

ext.ext_cn: 我痛恨冷战。幸亏我们没有卷进去。
ext.ext_en: I hated the Cold War. I think we're very well out of it.

defs.def_en: If you say to someone who is no longer involved in a situation that they are well out of it, you mean that it is a good thing they are no longer involved and they should be pleased about this.

ext.ext_cn: 战争已经彻底结束了。
ext.ext_en: The war is well and truly over.

ext.ext_cn: 知道问题已经彻底解决了的如释重负
ext.ext_en: ...the relief of knowing that a problem was well and truly solved...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is well and truly finished, gone, or done, you are emphasizing that it is completely finished or gone, or thoroughly done.

ext.ext_cn: 南希还蛮喜欢它，只是有点不满意它的颜色。
ext.ext_en: Nancy liked it well enough, but complained about the color...

ext.ext_cn: 克鲁格还比较喜欢她，只是对她的女性魅力却始终无动于衷。
ext.ext_en: Crook liked her well enough, but remained indifferent to her feminine charms.

defs.def_en: If you say that you like something or someone well enough, you mean that you quite like them or find them reasonably acceptable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我今天身体不适，所以不能参加了。
ext.ext_en: I'm not very well today, I can't come in...

ext.ext_cn: 我祝你身体健康。
ext.ext_en: I hope you're well.

defs.def_en: If you are well, you are healthy and not ill.

ext.ext_cn: 我得从井里打水。
ext.ext_en: I had to fetch water from the well.

defs.def_en: A well is a hole in the ground from which a supply of water is extracted.

ext.ext_cn: 大约650个油井起火。
ext.ext_en: About 650 wells are on fire.

defs.def_en: A well is an oil well.

ext.ext_cn: 她泪如泉涌。
ext.ext_en: Tears welled in her eyes...

ext.ext_cn: 他向后倒去，鲜血从他大腿上的一个口子里涌了出来。
ext.ext_en: He fell back, blood welling from a gash in his thigh.

defs.def_en: If liquids, for example tears, well, they come to the surface and form a pool.

ext.ext_cn: 克里萨满怀感激。
ext.ext_en: Gratitude welled in Chryssa...

ext.ext_cn: 她对他的爱比以前更强烈了。
ext.ext_en: Her love for him welled stronger than ever.

defs.def_en: If an emotion wells in you, it suddenly becomes stronger, to the point where you have to express it.

ext.ext_cn: 我讨厌告诉别人坏消息。
ext.ext_en: I hate to be the bearer of bad news.

defs.def_en: The bearer of something such as a message is the person who brings it to you.

ext.ext_cn: 奥运会开幕式上的英国旗手
ext.ext_en: ...Britain's flag bearer at the Olympic Games opening ceremony...

ext.ext_cn: 当议长走进议事厅的时候，前面由执议长权标的人开路。
ext.ext_en: The Speaker is preceded by the mace-bearer upon his entry to the chamber.

defs.def_en: A bearer of a particular thing is a person who carries it, especially in a ceremony.

defs.def_cn: 拥有（某文件、权利或职位）的人；持有…的人；持有者

ext.ext_cn: 认为公民是权利拥有者的传统中产阶级观念
ext.ext_en: ...the traditional bourgeois notion of the citizen as a bearer of rights...

ext.ext_cn: 后来他召集了他所属党派的核心领导人开会。
ext.ext_en: Later he called a meeting of his party's  central office bearers...

defs.def_en: The bearer of something such as a document, a right, or an official position is the person who possesses it or holds it.

defs.def_cn: （传统、想法或特征等的）保持者，拥有者

ext.ext_cn: 总的来说，下层民众被认为是传统的保持者。
ext.ext_en: Generally, the lower classes are considered to be the bearers of tradition.

defs.def_en: The bearer of a tradition, idea, or characteristic is someone or something that is particularly associated with it and passes it on to other people or situations.

defs.def_cn: （在旧时的印度指欧洲人的）当地用人，土著仆人
defs.def_en: In former times, especially in India, a bearer was a native servant of a European.

ext.ext_cn: gratification和gratitude的词源相同。
ext.ext_en: 'Gratification' and 'gratitude' have the same etymological root.

defs.def_en: Etymological means concerned with or relating to etymology.

ext.ext_cn: 大多数工会认为私有化会不可避免地导致失业。
ext.ext_en: Most unions see privatisation as an inevitable prelude to job losses...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天结束的会议拉开了共产党中央委员会会议的序幕。
ext.ext_en: The conference, which closed yesterday, was a prelude to a Communist Party Central Committee meeting.

defs.def_en: You can describe an event as a prelude to a more important event when it happens before it and acts as an introduction to it.

ext.ext_cn: 肖邦著名的E小调前奏曲
ext.ext_en: ...the famous E minor prelude of Chopin.

defs.def_en: A prelude is a short piece of music for the piano or organ.

ext.ext_cn: 一些当地人为难民们提供食品和衣服。
ext.ext_en: Some locals offered food and clothing to the refugees...

ext.ext_cn: 你最喜欢的衣服是哪一件？
ext.ext_en: What is your favourite item of clothing?...

defs.def_en: Clothing is the things that people wear.  →see usage note at:clothes
A stocking stuffer is the same as a stocking filler .

ext.ext_cn: 威胁从未加剧，因此我们没有必要真采取什么对策。
ext.ext_en: Because the threat never developed, we didn't need to take any real countermeasures.

defs.def_en: A counter-measure is an action that you take in order to weaken the effect of another action or a situation, or to make it harmless.
A melody is a tune.

ext.ext_cn: 她的声音非常悦耳。
ext.ext_en: Her voice was full of melody.

defs.def_en: Melody is the quality of having a pleasant tune.
Something that is bottle-green is dark green in colour.

defs.def_cn: 按键式的；用按钮操作的

ext.ext_cn: 按键式电话
ext.ext_en: ...push-button phones.

defs.def_en: A push-button machine or process is controlled by means of buttons or switches.

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯联邦
ext.ext_en: ...the Russian Federation.

defs.def_en: A federation is a federal country.

defs.def_cn: (社团或组织的)同盟，联盟，联合会

ext.ext_cn: 英国田径总会
ext.ext_en: ...the British Athletic Federation...

ext.ext_cn: 该组织由 6 个全国性机构联合而成。
ext.ext_en: The organization emerged from a federation of six national agencies.

defs.def_en: A federation is a group of societies or other organizations which have joined together, usually because they share a common interest.
A haystack is a large, solid pile of hay, often covered with a straw roof to protect it, which is left in the field until it is needed.

defs.def_cn: 落进干草垛里的一根针（比喻如大海捞针般难找的东西）
defs.def_en: If you are trying to find something and say that it is like looking for a needle in a haystack, you mean that you are very unlikely indeed to find it.

ext.ext_cn: 万有引力控制着天体的运动。
ext.ext_en: Gravity governs the motions of celestial bodies.

ext.ext_cn: 古代中国人在仔细观察、认真记录天体运动的过程里，为后代留下了宝贵而又有趣的资料。
ext.ext_en: In the process of their careful watching and recording the celestial movements the Chinese provided valuable and interesting information for succeeding generations.

defs.def_en: Celestial is used to describe things relating to heaven or to the sky.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 了不起的;美妙的;奇妙的

ext.ext_cn: 味道妙不可言的杏仁夹层巧克力蛋糕
ext.ext_en: ...a chocolate cake with an apricot filling and celestial effect on the taste buds.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as celestial, you mean that it is wonderful.

ext.ext_cn: 《联合国宪章》第50款
ext.ext_en: ...Article 50 of the United Nations Charter.

ext.ext_cn: 保障劳工权利的《社会宪章》
ext.ext_en: ...the Social Charter of workers' rights.

defs.def_en: A charter is a formal document describing the rights, aims, or principles of an organization or group of people.

ext.ext_cn: 运送外国侨民出境的最后一架包机
ext.ext_en: ...the last charter plane carrying out foreign nationals.

ext.ext_cn: 到西班牙的定期包机航班
ext.ext_en: ...frequent charter flights to Spain.

defs.def_en: A charter plane or boat is one which is hired for use by a particular person or group and which is not part of a regular service.

defs.def_cn: (个人、团体)包租，租用(飞机、船只等)

ext.ext_cn: 他包了架喷气式飞机把她从加利福尼亚送回瑞士家里。
ext.ext_en: He chartered a jet to fly her home from California to Switzerland...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天，一艘联合国租用的货船到达首都，船上载有1,550吨大米。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday, a cargo ship chartered by the UN arrived in the capital carrying 1,550 tons of rice.

defs.def_en: If a person or organization charters a plane, boat, or other vehicle, they hire it for their own use.

ext.ext_cn: 他们称内政部的方案是“对诈骗的纵容”。
ext.ext_en: They described the Home Office scheme as a 'charter for cheats'...

ext.ext_cn: 他们谴责白皮书是在怂恿中央集权和精英教育。
ext.ext_en: They condemned the white paper as a charter for centralisation and selective education.

defs.def_en: If you describe a decision or policy as a charter for someone or something you disapprove of, you mean that it is likely to help or encourage them.

ext.ext_cn: 阿布不是他的真名，是他用于伪装身份的名字。
ext.ext_en: Abu is not his real name, but it's one he uses to disguise his identity...

ext.ext_cn: 警方不久就查出了他的真实身份，并很快找到了他。
ext.ext_en: The police soon established his true identity and he was quickly found.

defs.def_en: Your identity is who you are.

ext.ext_cn: 我想要确立自己的个性意识。
ext.ext_en: I wanted a sense of my own identity.

ext.ext_cn: 许多意大利人独有的文化、宗教、民族特性
ext.ext_en: ...the distinct cultural, religious and national identity of many Italians.

defs.def_en: The identity of a person or place is the characteristics they have that distinguish them from others.

defs.def_cn: 总是；每次都是；无例外地

ext.ext_cn: 我每次谈恋爱都深陷其中，无法自拔。
ext.ext_en: Whenever I get into a relationship, I always fall madly in love...

ext.ext_cn: 她事事都迟到。
ext.ext_en: She's always late for everything...

defs.def_en: If you always do something, you do it whenever a particular situation occurs. If you always did something, you did it whenever a particular situation occurred.

ext.ext_cn: 我们将永远记得他的慷慨好客。
ext.ext_en: We will always remember his generous hospitality...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直做家庭事务律师。
ext.ext_en: He has always been the family solicitor...

defs.def_en: If something is always the case, was always the case, or will always be the case, it is, was, or will be the case all the time, continuously.

ext.ext_cn: 她老是将东西搬来搬去。
ext.ext_en: She was always moving things around.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is always happening, especially something which annoys you, you mean that it happens repeatedly.

defs.def_cn: （用于提出建议或提示其他解决方法）总还，总还是

ext.ext_cn: 如果你找不到像样的苹果，你总还可以试着自己种。
ext.ext_en: If you can't find any decent apples, you can always try growing them yourself...

ext.ext_cn: “你打算做什么？”——“不知道，我总还是能回到海军或者什么的。”
ext.ext_en: 'What are you going to do?' — 'I don't know. I could always go back in the Navy or something.'

defs.def_en: You use always in expressions such as can always or could always when you are making suggestions or suggesting an alternative approach or method.

ext.ext_cn: 她会好的。她一直都很强壮。
ext.ext_en: She's going to be fine. She always was pretty strong...

ext.ext_cn: 你从来都是我的好朋友。
ext.ext_en: You always were a good friend.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone always was, for example, awkward or lucky to indicate that you are not surprised about what they are doing or have just done.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 调皮的;淘气的;恶作剧的

ext.ext_en: She rocks back and forth on her chair like a mischievous child...

ext.ext_cn: 他有一点淘气。
ext.ext_en: He's a little mischievous.

defs.def_en: A mischievous person likes to have fun by playing harmless tricks on people or doing things they are not supposed to do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 恶意的;不友善的;捣乱的

ext.ext_cn: 媒体恶意分裂非洲国民大会的运动
ext.ext_en: ...a mischievous campaign by the press to divide the ANC...

defs.def_en: A mischievous act or suggestion is intended to cause  trouble.

ext.ext_cn: 舒伯特驾轻就熟的谱曲天分
ext.ext_en: ...Schubert's effortless gift for melodic invention.

defs.def_en: Melodic means relating to melody.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Wonderfully melodic and tuneful, his songs have made me weep.

defs.def_en: Music that is melodic has beautiful tunes in it.

ext.ext_cn: 这层镀金极为奢华。
ext.ext_en: The gilding is extremely lavish.

defs.def_en: Gilding is a layer of gold or gold paint that is put on something.

defs.def_cn: (通过性接触传播的)衣原体疾病
defs.def_en: Chlamydia is a sexually transmitted disease.

ext.ext_cn: 对总统进行不信任投票的请求被否决。

ext.ext_en: The students passed a motion of no-confidence in the college principal.

defs.def_en: If members of an organization pass a vote or motion of no-confidence in someone, they take a vote which shows that they no longer support that person or their ideas.

ext.ext_cn: 很多警官把这种举动看作是对他们服务的不信任。
ext.ext_en: Many police officers view this action as a vote of no-confidence in their service.

defs.def_en: You can refer to something people say or do as a vote of no-confidence when it shows that they no longer support a particular person or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 洗礼仪式
ext.ext_en: ...the baptismal ceremony.

defs.def_en: Baptismal means relating to or connected with baptism.

ext.ext_cn: 可替换丁烷气贮气瓶

defs.def_en: If something is replaceable, you can throw it away when it is finished and put a new one in its place.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他会看到我不是那么容易被替代的。
ext.ext_en: He would see I was not so easily replaceable.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is replaceable, you mean that they are not so important that someone else could not take their place.

ext.ext_cn: 非裔古巴人丰富的音乐、舞蹈传统
ext.ext_en: ...the rich traditions of Afro-Cuban music, and dance...

ext.ext_cn: 玛丽承袭了向别人赠送植物的家族传统。
ext.ext_en: Mary has carried on the family tradition of giving away plants...

defs.def_en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time.

defs.def_cn: 承袭…风格的;具有…特点的

ext.ext_en: They're marvellous pictures in the tradition of Gainsborough.

ext.ext_cn: 与格雷厄姆·格林一脉相承的天主教小说家
ext.ext_en: …a Catholic novelist in the tradition of Graham Greene.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is in the tradition of a person or thing from the past, you mean that they have many features that remind you of that person or thing.

ext.ext_cn: 我母亲在厨房忙得团团转。
ext.ext_en: My mother bustled around the kitchen...
