ext.ext_cn: 五分之四的老挝人是农民。
ext.ext_en: Four-fifths of Laotians are farmers.

defs.def_en: A Laotian is a Laotian citizen, or a person of Laotian origin.
Laotian is the language spoken by people who live in Laos.

ext.ext_cn: 劫持犯似乎焦虑不安，不想伤害任何人。
ext.ext_en: The hijackers seemed anxious not to harm anyone.

defs.def_en: To harm a person or animal means to cause them physical injury, usually on purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 只要是狗就可能会咬人。
ext.ext_en: All dogs are capable of doing harm to human beings.

defs.def_en: Harm is physical injury to a person or an animal which is usually caused on purpose.

defs.def_cn: 破坏;损害;对…产生不利影响

ext.ext_cn: 该产品可能会危害环境的警告
ext.ext_en: ...a warning that the product may harm the environment...

ext.ext_cn: 低价进口品将会对该行业造成危害。
ext.ext_en: Low-priced imports will harm the industry.

defs.def_en: To harm a thing, or sometimes a person, means to damage them or make them less effective or successful than they were.

ext.ext_cn: 滥用权力会对其他所有恪守职责的官员们造成伤害。
ext.ext_en: The abuse of your powers does harm to all other officers who do their job properly...

ext.ext_cn: 减税对经济而言可能弊大于利。
ext.ext_en: To cut taxes would probably do the economy more harm than good.

defs.def_en: Harm is the damage to something which is caused by a particular course of action.

defs.def_cn: 不会受损害;不会受到伤害;会安然无恙

ext.ext_cn: 总是有一个救生员在场以确保无人受到伤害。
ext.ext_en: There is always a lifeguard to ensure that no one comes to any harm...

ext.ext_cn: “快回去吧，要保证他安然无恙，”他平静地说。
ext.ext_en: 'Go back and make sure that no harm comes to him,' he said quietly.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something will come to no harm or that no harm will come to them, you mean that they will not be hurt or damaged in any way.

defs.def_cn: 也许值得（做某事）;不妨（做某事）

ext.ext_cn: 他们并不总是乐意雇用未经培训的工人，但问问也无妨。
ext.ext_en: They are not always willing to take on untrained workers, but there's no harm in asking.

defs.def_en: If you say it does no harm to do something or there is no harm in doing something, you mean that it might be worth doing, and you will not be blamed for doing it.

defs.def_cn: （做某事）没有坏处，有益;不妨（做某事）

ext.ext_cn: 她不妨把这些都试试，直到我们找到最适合她的为止。
ext.ext_en: It would do her no harm to try them until we found the one which suited her best.

defs.def_en: If you say that something would do no harm, or do someone no harm, you are recommending a course of action which you think is worthwhile, helpful, or useful.

defs.def_cn: 没有产生危害;没有人受到伤害

ext.ext_cn: 好了，你现在没事了，没人受伤。
ext.ext_en: There, now, you're all right. No harm done.

defs.def_en: If you say that there is no harm done, you are telling someone not to worry about something that has happened because it has not caused any serious injury or damage.

ext.ext_cn: 从来没人告诉这些人他们是如何被置于险境的。
ext.ext_en: These men were never told how they'd been put in harm's way...

ext.ext_cn: 如果非采取军事行动不可的话，他们的处境会非常危险。
ext.ext_en: They could be in harm's way if military action becomes necessary.

defs.def_en: If someone is put in harm's way, they are caused to be in a dangerous situation.

defs.def_cn: 在安全的地方;没有危险

ext.ext_cn: 对父母来说，这是一个能让孩子们开心或者说是让他们远离危险的简单方法。
ext.ext_en: For parents, it is an easy way of keeping their children entertained, or simply out of harm's way...

ext.ext_cn: 工人们争先恐后地将价值连城的物品运到安全的地方。
ext.ext_en: Workers scrambled to carry priceless objects out of harm's way.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is out of harm's way, they are in a safe place away from danger or from the possibility of being damaged.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 荒谬的；荒唐的；不合理的

ext.ext_cn: 讨论针对教师的强制裁员政策真是滑稽可笑。
ext.ext_en: It is absurd to be discussing compulsory redundancy policies for teachers...

ext.ext_cn: 我知道我的一些客户就为了少付我几英镑，可谓无所不用其极。
ext.ext_en: I've known clients of mine go to absurd lengths, just to avoid paying me a few pounds...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is absurd, you are criticizing it because you think that it is ridiculous or that it does not make sense.

defs.def_cn: (团体、组织中的）中坚力量，骨干分子，核心分子

ext.ext_cn: 我们拥有一批一直支持我们的忠实顾客。
ext.ext_en: We've got a hard core of customers that have stood by us...

ext.ext_cn: 一群骨干右翼参议员曾企图左右自己的同僚。
ext.ext_en: A hard-core group of right-wing senators had hoped to sway their colleagues.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the members of a group who are the most committed to its activities or who are the most involved in them as a hard core of members or as the hard-core members.

defs.def_cn: （色情作品）赤裸裸的，暴力的，露骨的
defs.def_en: Hard-core pornography shows sex in a very detailed way, or shows very violent or unpleasant sex.

defs.def_cn: （现代音乐）极端的，硬核的，纯正的

ext.ext_cn: 硬核朋克摇滚乐队
ext.ext_en: ...a hardcore punk band.

defs.def_en: Hard-core music is an extreme form of a particular type of modern music.

ext.ext_cn: 我从小就爱马，曾是一名青少年马术障碍赛选手。
ext.ext_en: I loved horses as a child and was a junior show jumper.

defs.def_en: A show jumper is a person who takes part in the sport of show jumping.

defs.def_cn: 适宜的；合适的；适当的；恰当的

ext.ext_cn: 每五人中有两人没有正当的工作。
ext.ext_en: Two out of five people lack a proper job...

ext.ext_cn: 我总是把晚餐做得很丰盛。
ext.ext_en: I always cook a proper evening meal.

defs.def_en: You use proper to describe things that you consider to be real and satisfactory rather than inadequate in some way.

defs.def_cn: 正确的；准确的；最合适的

ext.ext_cn: 最高法院将确保程序的履行合乎规范
ext.ext_en: The Supreme Court will ensure that the proper procedures have been followed...

ext.ext_cn: 他帮忙把东西放置妥当。
ext.ext_en: He helped to put things in their proper place.

defs.def_en: The proper thing is the one that is correct or most suitable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 得体的；合乎体统的；正派的

ext.ext_cn: 那个时候，女性登台表演被认为不太得体。
ext.ext_en: In those days it was not thought entirely proper for a woman to be on the stage...

ext.ext_cn: 这么做很得体。
ext.ext_en: It is right and proper to do this.

defs.def_en: If you say that a way of behaving is proper, you mean that it is considered socially acceptable and right.

defs.def_cn: 严格意义上的；真正的；本身的

ext.ext_cn: 必须区分考古学本身和以科学为基础的考古学。
ext.ext_en: A distinction must be made between archaeology proper and science-based archaeology.

defs.def_en: You can add proper after a word to indicate that you are referring to the central and most important part of a place, event, or object and want to distinguish it from other things which are not regarded as being important or central to it.

ext.ext_cn: 药草茶
ext.ext_en: ...herbal teas.

ext.ext_cn: 治疗感冒的草药方子
ext.ext_en: ...herbal remedies for colds.

defs.def_en: Herbal means made from or using herbs.
A herbal is a book which describes herbs or other plants, and their uses as medicines or in cooking.
See also:black marketeer;free-marketeer;A marketeer is the same as a marketer .
A time switch is a device that causes a machine to start or stop working at specific times.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指对与自身相关的事物）反对的，不以为然的，表示不赞同的

ext.ext_cn: 埃丽卡有点不以为然地耸耸肩。
ext.ext_en: Erica made a little deprecating shrug.

defs.def_en: A deprecating attitude, gesture, or remark shows that you think that something is not very good, especially something associated with yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 她愤愤地冲出我的房间。
ext.ext_en: She flounced out of my room in a huff...

ext.ext_cn: 要是让她离开房间，她会暴跳如雷，吵闹不休。
ext.ext_en: She will flounce and argue when asked to leave the room.

defs.def_en: If you flounce somewhere, you walk there quickly with exaggerated movements, in a way that shows you are annoyed or upset.

ext.ext_cn: 镶有荷叶边的睡衣
ext.ext_en: ...a gown with a flounce round the hem.

defs.def_en: A flounce is a piece of cloth that has been sewn into folds and put around the edge of something, for example a skirt, dress, tablecloth, or curtain.

ext.ext_cn: 她拧开水壶的盖子给他喝水。
ext.ext_en: She unscrewed the cap of her water bottle and gave him a drink...

ext.ext_cn: 台灯的底座可以拧开来进行布线和安装。
ext.ext_en: The base of the lamp unscrews for wiring and mounting.

defs.def_en: If you unscrew something such as a lid, or if it unscrews, you keep turning it until you can remove it.

ext.ext_cn: 他旋出螺丝打开电话机后盖，开始动手把话机跟电话线接上。
ext.ext_en: He unscrewed the back of the telephone and started connecting it to the cable.

defs.def_en: If you unscrew something such as a sign or mirror which is fastened to something by screws, you remove it by taking out the screws.

defs.def_cn: （苏格兰的）除夕及除夕欢庆活动
defs.def_en: Hogmanay is New Year's Eve in Scotland and the celebrations that take place there at that time.

ext.ext_cn: 芦荟用于润肤霜中，使之具有美妙的丝般润滑感。
ext.ext_en: Aloe Vera is used in moisturisers to give them a wonderfully silky texture...

ext.ext_cn: 她肤色苍白，肤质细腻如蜡。
ext.ext_en: Her skin is pale, the texture of fine wax.

defs.def_en: The texture of something is the way that it feels when you touch it, for example how smooth or rough it is.

ext.ext_cn: 这种奶酪多孔松脆，风味浓郁。
ext.ext_en: This cheese has an open, crumbly texture with a strong flavour...

ext.ext_cn: 蚯蚓吃下大量土壤，排出肥力丰富、物理结构理想的腐殖质。
ext.ext_en: Earthworms consume large amounts of soil, and produce a rich humus, perfect in texture.

defs.def_en: The texture of something, especially food or soil, is its structure, for example whether it is light with lots of holes, or very heavy and solid.

defs.def_cn: (音乐、文学作品的)神韵，谐和统一（感）

ext.ext_cn: 他独特的散文风韵显示出他常常在毒品的影响下进行创作的痕迹。
ext.ext_en: The very texture of his prose bears the influence of his familiarity with drugs.

defs.def_en: The texture of a piece of music or a work of literature is the impression that it makes on you as a result of the way that its different elements are combined.

ext.ext_cn: 巴黎伯爵，觊觎法国王位之人
ext.ext_en: ...the Comte de Paris, pretender to the French throne.

defs.def_en: A pretender to a position is someone who claims the right to that position, and whose claim is disputed by others.

ext.ext_cn: 尽力估算一下达到一个近距离目标需要多少步。
ext.ext_en: Try to estimate how many steps it will take to get to a close object...

ext.ext_cn: 我估计治疗费用总共会有12,500美元。
ext.ext_en: I estimate that the total cost for treatment will be $12,500...

defs.def_en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

ext.ext_cn: 竞选结果的官方预测
ext.ext_en: ...the official estimate of the election result...

ext.ext_cn: 这个数据是最初估算的5倍。
ext.ext_en: This figure is five times the original estimate...

defs.def_en: An estimate is an approximate calculation of a quantity or value.

ext.ext_cn: 我对他孙子的能力的判断还不算太离谱。
ext.ext_en: I hadn't been far wrong in my estimate of his grandson's capabilities.

defs.def_en: An estimate is a judgment about a person or situation which you make based on the available evidence.

ext.ext_cn: 那家商店还提供窗帘制作和安装服务，而且可以用计算机现场制作报价单和预算书。
ext.ext_en: The shop also offers a curtain-making and fitting service. Quotes and estimates can be prepared by computer on the spot.

defs.def_en: An estimate from someone who you employ to do a job for you, such as a builder or a plumber, is a written statement of how much the job is likely to cost.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 泥泞的;黏糊糊的;黏滑的

ext.ext_cn: 他的脚在泥泞中不住地打滑。
ext.ext_en: His feet slipped in the slimy mud...

ext.ext_cn: 她的手碰到了一个黏糊糊冷冰冰的东西。
ext.ext_en: Her hand touched something cold and slimy.

defs.def_en: Slimy substances are thick, wet, and unpleasant. Slimy objects are covered in a slimy substance.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 假意奉承的;口蜜腹剑的;滑头的;卑鄙的

ext.ext_cn: 我辛辛苦苦才挣到了这一切，我不希望它们被某个卑鄙的生意伙伴夺走。
ext.ext_en: I've worked hard for what I have and I don't want it taken away by some slimy business partner.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as slimy, you dislike them because they are friendly and pleasant in an insincere way.

ext.ext_cn: 飞行员不得不采取紧急措施避免灾难的发生。
ext.ext_en: The pilots had to take emergency action to avoid a disaster...

ext.ext_cn: 女士穿着应当庄重，以免受到当地人的骚扰。
ext.ext_en: Women have to dress modestly, to avoid being harassed by the locals.

defs.def_en: If you avoid something unpleasant that might happen, you take action in order to prevent it from happening.

ext.ext_cn: 他向许多银行借款，使得任何一家都搞不清楚他到底要做什么。
ext.ext_en: By borrowing from dozens of banks, he managed to avoid giving any of them an overall picture of what he was up to...

ext.ext_cn: 他总是小心谨慎地避免尴尬。
ext.ext_en: He was always careful to avoid embarrassment.

defs.def_en: If you avoid doing something, you choose not to do it, or you put yourself in a situation where you do not have to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 她最后只好把自己锁在厕所里来躲开他。
ext.ext_en: She eventually had to lock herself in the toilets to avoid him...

ext.ext_cn: 整个午饭期间，他一直在小心翼翼地回避房子的话题。
ext.ext_en: All through lunch he had carefully avoided the subject of the house.

defs.def_en: If you avoid a person or thing, you keep away from them. When talking to someone, if you avoid the subject, you keep the conversation away from a particular topic.

ext.ext_cn: 司机有足够的时间刹车或急转弯，来避开那个女人。
ext.ext_en: The driver had ample time to brake or swerve and avoid the woman.

defs.def_en: If a person or vehicle avoids someone or something, they change the direction they are moving in, so that they do not hit them.
Your solar plexus is the part of your stomach, below your ribs, where it is painful if you are hit hard.
A larder is a room or large cupboard in a house, usually near the kitchen, in which food is kept.

defs.def_cn: (尤指建筑的)隔热层,隔热材料

ext.ext_cn: 高额电费开支说明供暖系统不足或建筑隔热材料不良。
ext.ext_en: High electricity bills point to a poor heating system or bad insulation...

ext.ext_cn: 湿式潜水服有极佳的隔热性能。
ext.ext_en: A wet suit provides excellent insulation.

defs.def_en: See also:insulate;Insulation is a thick layer of a substance that keeps something warm, especially a building.

defs.def_cn: 以闪电战空袭；以闪电战攻击

ext.ext_cn: 1940年秋，伦敦平均每晚遭到200架飞机的空袭。
ext.ext_en: In the autumn of 1940 London was blitzed by an average of two hundred aircraft a night...

ext.ext_cn: 他们动用坦克、大炮、防空武器和机关枪奇袭了首都。
ext.ext_en: They blitzed the capital with tanks, artillery, anti-aircraft weapons and machine guns.

defs.def_en: If a city or building is blitzed during a war, it is attacked by bombs dropped by enemy aircraft.

defs.def_cn: 德军对英国城市的空袭，伦敦大轰炸（1940年至1941年间）
defs.def_en: The heavy bombing of British cities by German aircraft in 1940 and 1941 is referred to as the Blitz.

ext.ext_cn: 地方口音还可以接受，但要下大力气纠正语法错误。
ext.ext_en: Regional accents are still acceptable but there is to be a blitz on incorrect grammar.

defs.def_en: If you have a blitz on something, you make a big effort to deal with it or to improve it.

defs.def_cn: （为吸引注意力的）大规模活动

ext.ext_cn: 12月8日，一场大规模媒体宣传活动轰轰烈烈地展开了。
ext.ext_en: On December 8 the media blitz began in earnest.

defs.def_en: An advertising or publicity blitz is a major effort to make the public aware of something.
A crucifix is a cross with a figure of Christ on it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他感到头晕目眩。
ext.ext_en: He felt giddy and light-headed.

defs.def_en: If you feel giddy, you feel unsteady and think that you are about to fall over, usually because you are not well.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （高兴或激动得）发狂的，举止反常的

ext.ext_cn: 安东尼自鸣得意，忘乎所以。
ext.ext_en: Anthony was giddy with self-satisfaction...

ext.ext_cn: 身处那个地方让我激动得难以自持。
ext.ext_en: Being there gave me a giddy pleasure.

defs.def_en: If you feel giddy with delight or excitement, you feel so happy or excited that you find it hard to think or act normally.

ext.ext_cn: 沏茶，柯利，我们每人都要喝一杯。
ext.ext_en: Brew up, Curly. We could all do with a cup of tea.

defs.def_en: If someone brews up or if they brew up some tea, they make tea by pouring hot water over tea leaves.

ext.ext_cn: 我意识到了玛丽·莫尔斯正在制造的麻烦有多大。
ext.ext_en: I realized the extent of the trouble that Mary Morse was brewing up...

ext.ext_cn: 另一桩安全丑闻已渐露端倪。
ext.ext_en: There's another security scandal brewing up.

defs.def_en: If someone is brewing up an unpleasant situation or if an unpleasant situation is brewing up, it is starting to develop.

ext.ext_cn: 被解雇的管理人员包括前销售经理、主管和会计。
ext.ext_en: The unemployed executives include former sales managers, directors and accountants.

ext.ext_cn: 前总统理查德·尼克松
ext.ext_en: ...former President Richard Nixon...

defs.def_en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

ext.ext_cn: 前苏联
ext.ext_en: ...the former Soviet Union.

ext.ext_cn: 前南斯拉夫
ext.ext_en: ...the former Yugoslavia.

defs.def_en: Former is used to refer to countries which no longer exist or whose boundaries have changed.

ext.ext_cn: 克里斯托弗·雷恩爵士的旧居
ext.ext_en: ...the former home of Sir Christopher Wren.

ext.ext_cn: 昔日的修道院
ext.ext_en: ...a former monastery.

defs.def_en: Former is used to describe something which used to belong to someone or which used to be a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他可能会希望你记住他早年的样子。
ext.ext_en: He would want you to remember him as he was in former years.

defs.def_en: Former is used to describe a situation or period of time which came before the present one.

ext.ext_cn: 如果要在一件纯白的 T 恤和一件更贵的脏兮兮的米色 T 恤之间选择的话，多数人都会选前者，这是无可厚非的。
ext.ext_en: Given the choice between a pure white T-shirt and a more expensive, dirty cream one, most people can be forgiven for choosing the former...

ext.ext_cn: 如果家庭住房和共同养老金具有同样的价值，妻子可能会选前者，而丈夫会选后者。
ext.ext_en: If the family home and joint pension rights are of equal value, the wife may choose the former and the husband the latter.

defs.def_en: When two people, things, or groups have just been mentioned, you can refer to the first of them as the former .  →see usage note at:latter

ext.ext_cn: 政治让富兰克林的父亲着迷。
ext.ext_en: Politics fascinated Franklin's father...

ext.ext_cn: 不管是台上还是台下的她，都让他着迷。
ext.ext_en: She fascinated him, both on and off stage.

defs.def_en: If something fascinates you, it interests and delights you so much that your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

ext.ext_cn: 你脸上的淤伤是怎么搞的？
ext.ext_en: How did you get that bruise on your cheek?...

ext.ext_cn: 对她身上的伤口和淤伤进行了处理和治疗。
ext.ext_en: She was treated for cuts and bruises.

defs.def_en: A bruise is an injury which appears as a purple mark on your body, although the skin is not broken.

ext.ext_cn: 我只是把膝盖给碰伤了。
ext.ext_en: I had only bruised my knee...

ext.ext_cn: 有些人比其他人更容易被碰伤。
ext.ext_en: Some people bruise more easily than others.

defs.def_en: If you bruise a part of your body, a bruise appears on it, for example because something hits you. If you bruise easily, bruises appear when something hits you only slightly.

ext.ext_cn: 选一个干燥暖和的日子把它们从植株上割下来，注意不要碰伤它们。
ext.ext_en: Choose a warm, dry day to cut them off the plants, being careful not to bruise them.

ext.ext_cn: 被碰伤的西红柿和黄瓜
ext.ext_en: ...bruised tomatoes and cucumbers...

defs.def_en: If a fruit, vegetable, or plant bruises or is bruised, it is damaged by being handled roughly, making a mark on the skin.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天的事件将会让政府严重受挫。
ext.ext_en: The government will be severely bruised by yesterday's events.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的自尊心很容易受到伤害。
ext.ext_en: Their egos are so easily bruised.

defs.def_en: If you are bruised by an unpleasant experience, it makes you feel unhappy or upset.

ext.ext_cn: 我星期天都会睡懒觉。
ext.ext_en: I have a lie-in on Sundays.

defs.def_en: If you have a lie-in, you rest by staying in bed later than usual in the morning.

defs.def_cn: 反诉;相互指责;反唇相讥

ext.ext_cn: 激烈的争吵和相互指责最终为他们的感情画上了句号。
ext.ext_en: The bitter rows and recriminations have finally ended the relationship...

ext.ext_cn: 战争让大家充满仇恨并相互指责。
ext.ext_en: The war sweeps up everyone in hatred and recrimination.

defs.def_en: Recriminations are accusations that two people or groups make about each other.

ext.ext_cn: 我首先进行概述，然后会分析几个实例。
ext.ext_en: I'll start with some generalities and then examine a few specific examples...

ext.ext_cn: 他回避了这个非常微妙的问题，只做了个笼统的表述。
ext.ext_en: He avoided this tricky question and talked in generalities.

defs.def_en: A generality is a general statement that covers a range of things, rather than being concerned with specific instances.

ext.ext_cn: 由于其笼统性，不难料想这种定义会存在问题。
ext.ext_en: That there are problems with this kind of definition is hardly surprising, given its level of generality.

defs.def_en: The generality of a statement or description is the fact that it is a general one, rather than a specific, detailed one.

ext.ext_cn: 当多数选民都不予以支持时，情绪就会变得悲观起来。
ext.ext_en: When the generality of the electorate is doing badly, the mood will grow pessimistic.

defs.def_en: If someone refers to the generality of a group of people, they mean the majority of that group.

ext.ext_cn: 执政党在全国和地区选举中均败北。
ext.ext_en: Ruling parties have lost ground in national and local elections.

ext.ext_cn: 国内和国际重大问题
ext.ext_en: ...major national and international issues.

defs.def_en: National means relating to the whole of a country or nation rather than to part of it or to other nations.

ext.ext_cn: 这个国家的民族特征和历史
ext.ext_en: ...the national characteristics and history of the country...

ext.ext_cn: 棒球是全民性的休闲运动。
ext.ext_en: Baseball is the national pastime.

defs.def_en: National means typical of the people or customs of a particular country or nation.

ext.ext_cn: 出生于斯里兰卡的英国国民
ext.ext_en: ...a Sri-Lankan-born British national.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone who is legally a citizen of a country as a national of that country.

ext.ext_cn: 埃拉教她如何和旧家具经销商砍价。
ext.ext_en: Ella taught her how to haggle with used furniture dealers...

ext.ext_cn: 在政客们大打嘴仗的同时，暴力事件愈演愈烈。
ext.ext_en: Meanwhile, as the politicians haggle, the violence worsens...

defs.def_en: If you haggle, you argue about something before reaching an agreement, especially about the cost of something that you are buying.

ext.ext_cn: 我赶到时睡眼惺忪，头发蓬乱。
ext.ext_en: I arrived bleary-eyed and rumpled...

ext.ext_cn: 他用一双模糊的大眼睛盯着利奥。
ext.ext_en: He stared at Leo with great bleary eyes.

defs.def_en: If your eyes are bleary, they look dull or tired, as if you have not had enough sleep or have drunk too much alcohol.

In football, a penalty shoot-out is a way of deciding the result of a game that has ended in a draw. Players from each team try to score a goal in turn until one player fails to score and their team loses the game.

ext.ext_cn: 我们最不应该做的一件事就是拿凶手和被害人来比较。
ext.ext_en: The last thing we should do is make any parallelism between the murderers and their victims.

defs.def_en: When there is parallelism between two things, there are similarities between them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 挑衅的；煽动的；激怒的；刺激的

ext.ext_cn: 他近些年发表了一连串直言不讳、有时带煽动性的演说。
ext.ext_en: He has made a string of outspoken and sometimes provocative speeches in recent years...

ext.ext_cn: 他的行为被认为是煽动性的和反社会的。
ext.ext_en: His behavior was called provocative and antisocial.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as provocative, you mean that it is intended to make people react angrily or argue against it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 一些青少年可能相比同龄人在性方面更成熟、更具挑逗性。
ext.ext_en: Some adolescents might be more sexually mature and provocative than others.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's clothing or behaviour as provocative, you mean that it is intended to make someone feel sexual desire.

ext.ext_cn: 巴尔比厄开博时并没抱多大的期望； 他只是希望和一些人聊聊天。
ext.ext_en: When Barbieux started his blog, his aspirations were small; he simply hoped to communicate with a few people.

defs.def_en: A blog is a website containing a diary or journal on a particular subject.
Machine code is a way of expressing instructions and information in the form of numbers which can be understood by a computer or microchip.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那位操劳过度的家长看起来好像并不疼爱孩子，但实际上可能是太累的缘故。
ext.ext_en: The overworked, overextended parent may be seen as unloving, but may simply be exhausted.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as unloving, you believe that they do not love, or show love to, the people they ought to love.

ext.ext_cn: 人耳听觉范围的限度
ext.ext_en: ...the limits of the human auditory range.

defs.def_en: Auditory means related to hearing.

defs.def_cn: 气喘病患者；哮喘病患者

ext.ext_cn: 我从小就患有气喘病，参加不了任何体育活动。
ext.ext_en: I have been an asthmatic from childhood and was never able to play any sports.

ext.ext_cn: 每十个孩子里就有一人患有气喘病。
ext.ext_en: One child in ten is asthmatic.

defs.def_en: People who suffer from asthma are sometimes referred to as asthmatics .

ext.ext_cn: 气喘
ext.ext_en: ...asthmatic breathing.

defs.def_en: Asthmatic means relating to asthma.
Something that is tragi-comic is both sad and amusing at the same time.

ext.ext_cn: 知名的达拉斯律师同时也是得克萨斯州的前任州长候选人
ext.ext_en: ...a well-known Dallas lawyer and former Texas gubernatorial candidate.

defs.def_en: Gubernatorial means relating to or connected with the post of governor.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (房间或建筑)有穿堂风的，漏风的
defs.def_en: A draughty room or building has currents of cold air blowing through it, usually because the windows and doors do not fit very well.
Astrology is the study of the movements of the planets, sun, moon, and stars in the belief that these movements can have an influence on people's lives.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 戏剧化的;做作的;夸张的

ext.ext_cn: 多罗西娅装腔作势地呻吟了一声。
ext.ext_en: Dorothea let out a histrionic groan.

defs.def_en: If you refer to some-one's behaviour as histrionic, you are critical of it because it is very dramatic, exaggerated, and insincere.

defs.def_cn: （国王或法官等在正式场合穿的）盛装，礼服

ext.ext_cn: 全副盛装的官员
ext.ext_en: ...officials in full regalia.

defs.def_en: Regalia consists of all the traditional clothes and items which someone such as a king or a judge wears and carries on official occasions.

ext.ext_cn: 我可以全力支持他们的意见。
ext.ext_en: I can endorse their opinion wholeheartedly.

ext.ext_cn: 得到工党赞同并受选民支持的政策
ext.ext_en: ...policies agreed by the Labour Party and endorsed by the electorate.

defs.def_en: If you endorse someone or something, you say publicly that you support or approve of them.

defs.def_cn: 在（驾驶执照）上注明违章

ext.ext_cn: 由于发生事故未能报告，他的驾驶执照被注明违章。
ext.ext_en: For failing to report the accident, his licence was endorsed...

ext.ext_cn: 他的驾驶执照也被扣了8分。
ext.ext_en: He also had his licence endorsed with eight penalty points.

defs.def_en: If someone's driving licence is endorsed, an official record is made on it that they have been found guilty of a driving offence.

ext.ext_cn: 领款人必须在支票上背书。
ext.ext_en: The payee of the cheque must endorse the cheque.

defs.def_en: When you endorse a cheque, you write your name on the back of it so that it can be paid into someone's bank account.

ext.ext_cn: 那对双胞胎为一系列家用清洁产品做广告。
ext.ext_en: The twins endorsed a line of household cleaning products.

defs.def_en: If you endorse a product or company, you appear in advertisements for it.

defs.def_cn: 硬皮书;精装本(Compare 比较 softcover.）
defs.def_en: A hardcover is a book which has a stiff hard cover.

ext.ext_cn: 一只蚊子就可以感染很多人。
ext.ext_en: A single mosquito can infect a large number of people.

ext.ext_cn: 被感染者使用过的物品
ext.ext_en: ...objects used by an infected person.

defs.def_en: To infect people, animals, or plants means to cause them to have a disease or illness.

ext.ext_cn: 鸟污染了牛奶。
ext.ext_en: The birds infect the milk.

ext.ext_cn: 主要通过被污染的血液传播的病毒
ext.ext_en: ...a virus which is spread mainly by infected blood.

defs.def_en: To infect a substance or area means to cause it to contain harmful germs or bacteria.

ext.ext_cn: 有那么一会儿她的恐惧也传染给了我。
ext.ext_en: For an instant I was infected by her fear...

ext.ext_cn: 他认为他们可以用他们的资产阶级思想去影响别人。
ext.ext_en: He thought they might infect others with their bourgeois ideas...

defs.def_en: When people, places, or things are infected by a feeling or influence, it spreads to them.

ext.ext_cn: 这种病毒在短短几天内感染了数千台计算机。
ext.ext_en: This virus infected thousands of computers within days.

defs.def_en: If a virus infects a computer, it affects the computer by damaging or destroying programs.

ext.ext_cn: 这些千篇一律的演讲让他心生厌烦。
ext.ext_en: He grew bored by the sameness of the speeches.

defs.def_en: The sameness of something is its lack of variety.

ext.ext_cn: 我领他去办公室。
ext.ext_en: I ushered him into the office...

ext.ext_cn: 他们被迅速领开。
ext.ext_en: They were quickly ushered away.

defs.def_en: If you usher someone somewhere, you show them where they should go, often by going with them.

defs.def_cn: （婚礼、音乐会等的）引座员，招待员，迎宾员

ext.ext_cn: 他在一家戏院兼职当引座员。
ext.ext_en: He did part-time work as an usher in a theatre.

defs.def_en: An usher is a person who shows people where to sit, for example at a wedding or at a concert.
An usher is a person who organizes people who are attending a law court in Britain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 韦布是一个多才多艺的表演者。
ext.ext_en: Webb is a multi-faceted performer...

ext.ext_cn: 她的工作涉及多方面。
ext.ext_en: Her job is multi-faceted.

defs.def_en: Multi-faceted means having a variety of different and important features or elements.

defs.def_cn: 古文物收藏家;古文物研究者;古文物经营者
defs.def_en: An antiquary is a person who studies the past, or who collects or buys and sells old and valuable objects.

ext.ext_cn: 青少年犯罪的激增让该国陷入困境。
ext.ext_en: The country is in the grip of a teenage crime wave.

defs.def_en: When more crimes than usual are committed in a particular place, you can refer to this as a crime wave .

ext.ext_cn: 大量刚裂开的玻璃碎片叮叮当当地落到地板上。
ext.ext_en: A fresh cascade of splintered glass tinkled to the floor...

ext.ext_cn: 我们漫步经过泉水叮咚的喷泉和芬芳四溢的花园。
ext.ext_en: We strolled past tinkling fountains and perfumed gardens.

defs.def_en: If something tinkles, it makes a clear, high-pitched, ringing noise, especially as small parts of it strike a surface.

ext.ext_cn: 当他推开门时，一口旧式的钟丁零零地响了起来。
ext.ext_en: An old-fashioned bell tinkled as he pushed open the door...

ext.ext_cn: 皮尔小姐摇了摇她桌子上的铃铛，他们全都又坐下了。
ext.ext_en: Miss Peel tinkled her desk bell and they all sat down again.

defs.def_en: If a bell tinkles or if you tinkle it, it makes a quiet ringing noise as you shake it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 冷血的谋杀犯
ext.ext_en: ...a cold-blooded murderer...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一场残忍无情的杀戮。
ext.ext_en: This was a brutal and cold-blooded killing.

defs.def_en: Someone who is cold-blooded does not show any pity or emotion.
Cold-blooded animals have a body temperature that changes according to the surrounding temperature. Reptiles, for example, are cold-blooded.

ext.ext_cn: 这十年中的前五年是进步联盟迈向顶峰的时期。
ext.ext_en: The Alliance for Progress reached its apogee during the first half of the decade.

defs.def_en: The apogee of something such as a culture or a business is its highest or its greatest point.
A fishmonger is a shopkeeper who sells fish.
The fishmonger or the fishmonger's is a shop where fish is sold.

ext.ext_cn: 种植小麦，玉米或其他农作物的农民。
ext.ext_en: ...farmers growing wheat, corn, or other crops.

ext.ext_cn: 白面
ext.ext_en: ...wheat flour.

defs.def_en: Wheat is a cereal crop grown for food. Wheat is also used to refer to the grain of this crop, which is usually ground into flour and used to make bread.  to separate the wheat from the chaff→see: chaff;

defs.def_cn: (人群的)蜂拥，狂奔;(动物的)惊逃，乱窜

ext.ext_cn: 大家都争先恐后地朝出口涌去。
ext.ext_en: There was a stampede for the exit.

defs.def_en: If there is a stampede, a group of people or animals run in a wild, uncontrolled way.

ext.ext_cn: 人群争先恐后地奔逃，很多人被压伤或踩踏。
ext.ext_en: The crowd stampeded and many were crushed or trampled underfoot...

ext.ext_cn: 乡间强盗正在学习早期西部人的做法，先让牛群受惊四处乱窜以转移农民的注意力，然后再洗劫他们的房屋。
ext.ext_en: Countryside robbers are learning the ways of the wild west by stampeding cattle to distract farmers before raiding their homes.

defs.def_en: If a group of animals or people stampede or if something stampedes them, they run in a wild, uncontrolled way.

defs.def_cn: 热潮;风尚;争先恐后的现象

ext.ext_cn: 优厚的裁员条件引发了职员争先恐后地要求辞职的现象。
ext.ext_en: Generous redundancy terms had triggered a stampede of staff wanting to leave.

ext.ext_cn: 南非农场主在莫桑比克争购廉价土地的热潮
ext.ext_en: ...a stampede by South African farmers to buy up cheap land in Mozambique.

defs.def_en: If a lot of people all do the same thing at the same time, you can describe it as a stampede .

ext.ext_cn: 我们真的愿意被这样逼迫吗？
ext.ext_en: Do we really want to be stampeded in such a way?...

ext.ext_cn: 大家普遍认为鲍威尔已经逼迫政府采取行动。
ext.ext_en: It was widely believed that Powell had stampeded the Government into taking action.

defs.def_en: If people are stampeded into doing something, they are forced into doing it by pressure from other people, even though they do not think it is the right thing to do.

ext.ext_cn: 格兰特先生
ext.ext_en: ...Mr Grant.

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃·普赖斯先生
ext.ext_en: ...Mr Bob Price.

defs.def_en: Mr is used before a man's name when you are speaking or referring to him.

defs.def_cn: 先生(有时加于“总统”、“主席”等职衔前，作为称谓)

ext.ext_cn: 总统先生，你是清楚这种体制的。
ext.ext_en: Mr. President, you're aware of the system.

defs.def_en: Mr is sometimes used in front of words such as 'President' and 'Chairman' to address the man who holds the position mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 破旧不堪的;磨损的；用坏的

ext.ext_cn: 车子破损的轮胎
ext.ext_en: ...the car's worn out tyres.

ext.ext_cn: 褪色的破旧衣服碎片
ext.ext_en: ...faded bits of worn-out clothing.

defs.def_en: Something that is worn out is so old, damaged, or thin from use that it cannot be used any more.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 疲惫不堪的;精疲力竭的

ext.ext_cn: 赛前他状态很好，赛后就筋疲力尽了。
ext.ext_en: Before the race, he is fine. But afterwards he is worn out.

defs.def_en: Someone who is worn out is extremely tired after hard work or a difficult or unpleasant experience.

ext.ext_cn: “通往更加光明的未来的通行证”，这话听起来像句老掉牙的广告词，但这次这句套话却言之有物。
ext.ext_en: 'A passport to a brighter future': it sounds like a worn-out advertising slogan, but for once the cliche has substance.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as an idea as worn out, you mean that it is no longer relevant or interesting because it is old and has been repeated many times.
A mosquito net is a curtain made of very fine cloth which is hung round a bed in order to keep mosquitoes and other insects away from a person while they are sleeping.

ext.ext_cn: 我得承认我对地图十分着迷。
ext.ext_en: I must admit that maps obsess me...

ext.ext_cn: 美国正被一系列丑闻所困扰。
ext.ext_en: A string of scandals is obsessing America...

defs.def_en: If something obsesses you or if you obsess about something, you keep thinking about it and find it difficult to think about anything else.

ext.ext_cn: 城北部的军营
ext.ext_en: ...an army barracks in the north of the city.

ext.ext_cn: 威灵顿兵营的阅兵场
ext.ext_en: ...the parade grounds of Wellington Barracks.

defs.def_en: A barracks is a building or group of buildings where soldiers or other members of the armed forces live and work. 'Barracks' is the singular and plural form.

ext.ext_cn: 球迷一个劲儿地嘘他，兴头远胜于为球队加油。
ext.ext_en: Fans gained more enjoyment barracking him than cheering on the team...

ext.ext_cn: 阿兰·加西亚总统遭右翼反对派喝倒彩。
ext.ext_en: President Alan Garcia was barracked by the right wing opposition.

defs.def_en: If people in an audience barrack public speakers or performers, they interrupt them, for example by making rude remarks.

ext.ext_cn: 今年秋天，将有6000名居民参加该项目的第一阶段。
ext.ext_en: This autumn, 6000 residents will participate in the first phase of the project...

ext.ext_cn: 目前危机正进入决定性的关键阶段。
ext.ext_en: The crisis is entering a crucial, critical phase...

defs.def_en: A phase is a particular stage in a process or in the gradual development of something.

ext.ext_cn: 裁员将在两年内分阶段进行。
ext.ext_en: The redundancies will be phased over two years.

ext.ext_cn: 美国从菲律宾的分阶段撤军
ext.ext_en: ...a phased withdrawal of American forces from the Philippines.

defs.def_en: If an action or change is phased over a period of time, it is done in stages.

defs.def_cn: 不同步的（地）/同步的（地）；不协调的（地）/协调的（地）

ext.ext_cn: 技能课程与其他课程不协调。
ext.ext_en: The Skills Programme is out of phase with the rest of the curriculum.

ext.ext_cn: 消化不良、睡眠时间混乱等不舒服的飞行时差症状
ext.ext_en: ...uncomfortable jet-lag symptoms of indigestion and out-of-phase sleeping and waking.

defs.def_en: If two things are out of phase with each other, they are not working or happening together as they should. If two things are in phase, they are working or occurring together as they should.

ext.ext_cn: 他无资格申领任何社会保险福利的裁定
ext.ext_en: ...a ruling that he would be ineligible for any social security benefits...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不符合条件，不能继续留在美国。
ext.ext_en: They were ineligible to remain in the USA.

defs.def_en: If you are ineligible for something, you are not qualified for it or entitled to it.

defs.def_cn: (尤指因战争而)被迫背井离乡的人,颠沛流离的人,失去家园者
defs.def_en: A displaced person is someone who has been forced to leave the place where they live, especially because of a war.
Portraiture is the art of painting or drawing portraits.

ext.ext_cn: 该项目是两年前开始的。
ext.ext_en: The project had its genesis two years earlier...

ext.ext_cn: 他的演讲阐述了冲突的起源。
ext.ext_en: His speech was an exposition of the genesis of the conflict.

defs.def_en: The genesis of something is its beginning, birth, or creation.

ext.ext_cn: 国内骚乱
ext.ext_en: ...civil unrest.

defs.def_en: You use civil to describe events that happen within a country and that involve the different groups of people in it.

defs.def_cn: 民用的;平民的;非军事的

ext.ext_cn: 美国民用航空业
ext.ext_en: ...the US civil aviation industry.

defs.def_en: You use civil to describe people or things in a country that are not connected with its armed forces.

defs.def_cn: 政府的；国家的;世俗的;非宗教的

ext.ext_cn: 他们于8月9号在威尼斯举行了世俗婚礼。
ext.ext_en: They were married on August 9 in a civil ceremony in Venice.

ext.ext_cn: 犹太民法和宗教法
ext.ext_en: ...Jewish civil and religious law.

defs.def_en: You use civil to describe things that are connected with the state rather than with a religion.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国公民和政治权利公约
ext.ext_en: ...a United Nations covenant on civil and political rights.

defs.def_en: You use civil to describe the rights that people have within a society.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 彬彬有礼的;斯文的;客气的

ext.ext_cn: 作为来访者，我们最起码能做到的就是对当地人要彬彬有礼。
ext.ext_en: As visitors, the least we can do is be civil to the people in their own land.

defs.def_en: Someone who is civil is polite in a formal way, but not particularly friendly.

ext.ext_cn: 她再没有听到别的声音了。
ext.ext_en: She heard no further sounds...

ext.ext_cn: 喇叭声整栋房子都能听见。
ext.ext_en: The trumpet can be heard all over their house...

defs.def_en: When you hear a sound, you become aware of it through your ears.

ext.ext_cn: 大约半小时后就能听到这场比赛的解说了。
ext.ext_en: You can hear commentary on the match in about half an hour's time...

ext.ext_cn: 我想你以前从未听过多丽丝谈自己的感情生活。
ext.ext_en: I don't think you've ever heard Doris talking about her emotional life before...

defs.def_en: If you hear something such as a lecture or a piece of music, you listen to it.

ext.ext_cn: 你脑海里现在没有响起约翰·莫特森的声音吗？
ext.ext_en: Can't you just hear John Motson now?...

ext.ext_cn: “我很热，”夏洛特那带有甜美法国口音的话语仍在我的脑际盘旋。
ext.ext_en: 'I was hot,' I could still hear Charlotte say with her delicious French accent.

defs.def_en: If you say that you can hear someone saying something, you mean that you are able to imagine hearing it.

defs.def_cn: （法官或法庭）审理（案件），听取（证词）

ext.ext_cn: 陪审团已经听取了辩方证人的证词。
ext.ext_en: The jury have heard evidence from defence witnesses...

ext.ext_cn: 等了数月后，他的案子才得到审理。
ext.ext_en: He had to wait months before his case was heard.

defs.def_en: When a judge or a court of law hears a case, or evidence in a case, they listen to it officially in order to make a decision about it.

ext.ext_cn: 给我们写封短信，能收到你的信总是让人很高兴。
ext.ext_en: Drop us a line, it's always great to hear from you...

ext.ext_cn: 警方急切地希望任何可能认识她的人打电话来。
ext.ext_en: The police are anxious to hear from anyone who may know her.

defs.def_en: If you hear from someone, you receive a letter or telephone call from them.

defs.def_cn: （辩论或讨论中）倾听（意见或情况）

ext.ext_cn: 你在那里都听到人们说了些什么？
ext.ext_en: What are you hearing from people there?

defs.def_en: In a debate or discussion, if you hear from someone, you listen to them giving their opinion or information.

ext.ext_cn: 我母亲是从莱斯利那里知道这所学校的。
ext.ext_en: My mother heard of this school through Leslie...

ext.ext_cn: 多年来我一直听说的一些谣言
ext.ext_en: ...the rumours I've been hearing about for years...

defs.def_en: If you hear some news or information about something, you find out about it by someone telling you, or from the radio or television.

ext.ext_cn: 很多人没听说过反射学。
ext.ext_en: Many people haven't heard of reflexology.

ext.ext_cn: 那些可能直到一两年前才听说这个词的人们
ext.ext_en: ...people who, maybe, had hardly heard the word till a year or two ago.

defs.def_en: If you have heard of something or someone, you know about them, but not in great detail.

ext.ext_cn: 弗内斯疲倦地耸了耸肩。这事他早就全知道了。
ext.ext_en: Furness shrugs wearily. He has heard it all before...

ext.ext_cn: “我听过有多少次了？”麦钱特生气地抱怨道。
ext.ext_en: 'How many times have I heard that before?' Merchant complained angrily.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have heard something before, you mean that you are not interested in it, or do not believe it, or are not surprised about it, because you already know about it or have experienced it.

defs.def_cn: “听见没有？”“你听到我的话了吗？”（要求对方注意听自己的话）

ext.ext_cn: 如果你不出去，我就要报警了。听见没有？
ext.ext_en: If you don't get out I'll call the police. Do you hear?...

ext.ext_cn: 别惹她！听见了吗？
ext.ext_en: Leave her alone! Do you hear me?

defs.def_en: If you say 'Do you hear?' or 'Did you hear me?' to someone, you are telling them in an angry or forceful way to pay attention to what you are saying.

defs.def_cn: 说得对！说得好！（政治辩论或公众大会上对讲话人表示赞同的喝彩声）
defs.def_en: During political debates and public meetings, people sometimes say 'Hear hear!' to express their agreement with what the speaker is saying.

ext.ext_cn: 看在老天爷的份上，闭嘴吧。吵死我了！
ext.ext_en: For God's sake shut up. I can't hear myself think!...

ext.ext_cn: 如果你坐在前院，就会被吵死，因为外面交通太混乱了。
ext.ext_en: If you're sitting in the front yard, you can't hear yourself think because the traffic is getting very, very bad.

defs.def_en: If you say that you can't hear yourself think, you are complaining and emphasizing that there is a lot of noise, and that it is disturbing you or preventing you from doing something.

ext.ext_cn: 我一直想当个演员，但爸爸不同意。
ext.ext_en: I've always wanted to be an actor but Dad wouldn't hear of it...

ext.ext_cn: 他甚至考虑要从村子里搬出去。但他的朋友们不答应。
ext.ext_en: He even thought about moving from the village. But his friends wouldn't hear of it.

defs.def_en: If you say that you won't hear of someone doing something, you mean that you refuse to let them do it.
Cartography is the art or activity of drawing maps and geographical charts.

ext.ext_cn: 唱圣诞颂歌的风俗源自异教徒早期的舞蹈仪式。
ext.ext_en: The singing of Christmas carols is a custom derived from early dance routines of pagan origin...

ext.ext_cn: 在门口唱圣诞颂歌的人
ext.ext_en: ...carol singers at the door.

defs.def_en: Carols are Christian religious songs that are sung at Christmas.

defs.def_cn: （人员因过剩）被解雇的，被裁减的

ext.ext_cn: 我丈夫去年年底被裁了。
ext.ext_en: My husband was made redundant late last year.

ext.ext_cn: 失业的矿工
ext.ext_en: ...a redundant miner.

defs.def_en: If you are made redundant, your employer tells you to leave because your job is no longer necessary or because your employer cannot afford to keep paying you.

defs.def_cn: 多余的；不再需要的；过剩的

ext.ext_cn: 技术上的革新可能意味着曾经被重视的技术现在已变得多余。
ext.ext_en: Changes in technology may mean that once-valued skills are now redundant.

ext.ext_cn: 将空置大楼改造为住宅
ext.ext_en: ...the conversion of redundant buildings to residential use.

defs.def_en: Something that is redundant is no longer needed because its job is being done by something else or because its job is no longer necessary or useful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们坚决要求你立即离开。
ext.ext_en: The men are very insistent that you leave right away.

ext.ext_cn: 他在这点上很坚持。
ext.ext_en: He is most insistent on this point...

defs.def_en: Someone who is insistent keeps insisting that a particular thing should be done or is the case.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (噪音、节奏等)持续的,经久不息的

ext.ext_cn: 加勒比海与拉丁美洲经久不息的韵律节拍
ext.ext_en: ...the insistent rhythms of the Caribbean and Latin America.

defs.def_en: An insistent noise or rhythm keeps going on for a long time and holds your attention.

ext.ext_cn: 今天的听证会只是展开立法程序的第一步。
ext.ext_en: Today's hearing was just the first step in the legislative process.

ext.ext_cn: 国家的最高立法机关
ext.ext_en: ...the country's  highest legislative body.

defs.def_en: Legis- lative means involving or relating to the process of making and passing laws.

ext.ext_cn: 他把狱中的时间都用于祈祷和学习。
ext.ext_en: He spent his time in prison praying and studying...

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在所要做的就是自助并向上帝祈祷。
ext.ext_en: Now all we have to do is help ourselves and to pray to God.

defs.def_en: When people pray, they speak to God in order to give thanks or to ask for his help.

ext.ext_cn: 我只是在祈求国会中会有人在还来得及的时候做点什么。
ext.ext_en: I'm just praying that somebody in Congress will do something before it's too late...

ext.ext_cn: 大家也只能希冀球队教练从中汲取教训。
ext.ext_en: One can only pray that the team's manager learns something from it...

defs.def_en: When someone is hoping very much that something will happen, you can say  that they are praying that it will happen.

defs.def_cn: （用于不太友善或气愤但镇定地提问时）请问

ext.ext_cn: 梅杰，请问，你都买卖些什么？
ext.ext_en: And what, pray, do you buy and sell, Major?

defs.def_en: Pray is used when asking a question in a rather unfriendly way or in an angry but calm way.

ext.ext_cn: 抱歉，请继续。
ext.ext_en: I beg your pardon, pray continue.

defs.def_en: Pray was used to add politeness to a command.

ext.ext_cn: 电视记者
ext.ext_en: ...a TV reporter.

ext.ext_cn: 见习体育记者
ext.ext_en: ...a trainee sports reporter...

defs.def_en: A reporter is someone who writes news articles or who broadcasts news reports.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 委员会咄咄逼人的宣传方式使其不得人心。
ext.ext_en: The committee's confrontational style of campaigning has made it unpopular...

ext.ext_cn: 防暴警察随时待命，但还没有出现冲突场面。
ext.ext_en: Riot police are on hand but have not been confrontational.

defs.def_en: If you describe the way that someone behaves as confrontational, you are showing your disapproval of the fact that they are aggressive and likely to cause an argument or dispute.

defs.def_cn: (指代已经提及的人或物)那些

ext.ext_cn: 从理论上说，他掌管着美国账户里的 4 亿美元。然而，事实上，是美国财政部和国务院在掌控那些账户。
ext.ext_en: Theoretically he had control over more than $400 million in US accounts. But, in fact, it was the US Treasury and State Department who controlled those accounts...

ext.ext_cn: 他们拥有具有强大杀伤力的飞机，因为那些飞机多数都能发射反舰导弹。
ext.ext_en: They have the aircraft capable of doing significant damage, because most of those aircraft are capable of launching anti-ship missiles.

defs.def_en: You use those to refer to people or things which have already been mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 那些(尤用于指示或指向在时间、空间上离自己稍远的人或物)

ext.ext_cn: 那些是什么建筑？
ext.ext_en: What are those buildings?...

ext.ext_cn: 哦，那些书！我本来要在下午之前收起来的。
ext.ext_en: Oh, those books! I meant to put them away before this afternoon.

defs.def_en: You use those when you are referring to people or things that are a distance away from you in position or time, especially when you indicate or point to them.

ext.ext_cn: 那些拿起武器自卫的人是些政治犯。
ext.ext_en: Those people who took up weapons to defend themselves are political prisoners...

ext.ext_cn: 自制面包就是为了避免吃到许多面包店使用的添加剂。
ext.ext_en: The point of home bread-making is to avoid those additives used in much commercial baking.

defs.def_en: You use those to refer to someone or something when you are going to give details or information about them.

defs.def_cn: (用来对已经提及的事物作补充说明)

ext.ext_cn: 他最有可能感兴趣的就是那些能让他表现自己或炫耀才华的事情。
ext.ext_en: The interests he is most likely to enjoy will be those which enable him to show off himself or his talents...

ext.ext_cn: 如果血液不循环，肌体细胞，尤其是脑细胞，只能存活几分钟。
ext.ext_en: The cells of the body, especially those of the brain, can live only minutes without circulating blood.

defs.def_en: You use those to introduce more information about something already mentioned, instead of repeating the noun which refers to it.

ext.ext_cn: 稍许自私的行为不会对我们身边的人造成实质性伤害。
ext.ext_en: A little selfish behaviour is unlikely to cause real damage to those around us...

ext.ext_cn: 据说，许多反对派的重要人物也在被捕者之列。
ext.ext_en: A number of leading opposition figures were said to be among those arrested.

defs.def_en: You use those to mean 'people'.

defs.def_cn: (用于认为谈话对象知道所谈事物或确认双方所想为相同的人或事物时)

ext.ext_cn: 他确实在大约一个星期前给我买了那些水仙花。
ext.ext_en: He did buy me those daffodils a week or so ago...

ext.ext_cn: 我一直在给保洁部门施加压力，要求他们更换那些垃圾箱的盖子。
ext.ext_en: I have been putting pressure onto the Cleansing Services to replace those dustbin lids...

defs.def_en: You use those when you refer to things that you expect the person you are talking to to know about or when you are checking that you are both thinking of the same people or things.
Freest is the superlative of free .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人憎恶的;让人厌恶的;使人反感的

ext.ext_cn: 让人恶心的白白胖胖的鼻涕虫
ext.ext_en: ...repulsive fat white slugs.

ext.ext_cn: 美国历史上最令人憎恶的杀人恶魔
ext.ext_en: ...the most repulsive mass murderer America has known.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as repulsive, you mean that they are horrible and disgusting and you want to avoid them.

ext.ext_cn: 核子内部的斥力是巨大的。
ext.ext_en: The repulsive force within the nucleus is enormous.

defs.def_en: A repulsive force is a force which pushes away what is around it.
Pharmacology is the branch of science relating to drugs and medicines.

ext.ext_cn: 汉堡包和薯条
ext.ext_en: ... beefburgers and chips.

defs.def_en: A beefburger is the same as a hamburger .
Jelly roll is a cylindrical cake made from a thin, flat cake which is covered with jam or cream on one side, then rolled up.
A freighter is a large ship or aeroplane that is designed for carrying freight.

ext.ext_cn: 他呼吁进行资本收益税改革。
ext.ext_en: He called for the reform of capital gains tax.

defs.def_en: Capital gains are the profits that you make when you buy something and then sell it again at a higher price.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 老年人是社会中尤为明显的弱势群体。
ext.ext_en: Old people are particularly vulnerable members of our society.

defs.def_en: Someone who is vulnerable is weak and without protection, with the result that they are easily hurt physically or emotionally.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 易感染（某种疾病）的；易患病的

ext.ext_cn: 有高血压的人尤其易患糖尿病。
ext.ext_en: People with high blood pressure are especially vulnerable to diabetes...

ext.ext_cn: 生命力强的植物不容易得病。
ext.ext_en: Plants that are growing vigorously are less likely to be vulnerable to disease.

defs.def_en: If a person, animal, or plant is vulnerable to a disease, they are more likely to get it than other people, animals, or plants.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 易受伤害的;易受影响的

ext.ext_cn: 他们的坦克易受到空袭。
ext.ext_en: Their tanks would be vulnerable to attack from the air...

ext.ext_cn: 易被盗车辆一览表
ext.ext_en: ...a table showing which cars are most  vulnerable to theft...

defs.def_en: Something that is vulnerable can be easily harmed or affected by something bad.

ext.ext_cn: 他感觉到了我对即将到来的下午忐忑不安，便对我说：“这些人说话都比较随和。”
ext.ext_en: Sensing my unease about the afternoon ahead, he told me,'These men are pretty easy to talk to.'...

ext.ext_cn: 我们离开时心里感到很不安，因为我们知道有什么事瞒着我们。
ext.ext_en: We left with a deep sense of unease, because we knew something was being hidden from us...

defs.def_en: If you have a feeling of unease, you feel rather anxious or afraid, because you think that something is wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 他面临民主党内对可能出现的战事不断滋长的不满情绪。
ext.ext_en: He faces growing unease among the Democrats about the likelihood of war.

ext.ext_cn: 公众对经济现状深感不满
ext.ext_en: ...the depth of public unease about the economy...

defs.def_en: If you say that there is unease in a situation, you mean that people are dissatisfied or angry, but have not yet started to take any action.

ext.ext_cn: 将军不喜欢非战斗部队人员靠近战场。
ext.ext_en: The General does not like non-combatant personnel near a scene of action.

defs.def_en: Non-combatant troops are members of the armed forces whose duties do not include fighting.

ext.ext_cn: 红十字会已经安排了两次地区停火，以使平民能够接受医疗救助。
ext.ext_en: The Red Cross has arranged two local ceasefires, allowing non-combatants to receive medical help.

defs.def_en: In a war, non-combatants are people who are not members of the armed forces.

defs.def_cn: 无休止的;没完没了的;冗长不堪的

ext.ext_cn: 冗长乏味的会议
ext.ext_en: ...an interminable meeting.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as interminable, you are emphasizing that it continues for a very long time and indicating that you wish it was shorter or would stop.

defs.def_cn: (常与 best，worst 等形容词最高级连用)可想象的,想得到的

ext.ext_cn: 他们被关押在可以想象出的最恐怖的环境中
ext.ext_en: ...their imprisonment under some of the most horrible circumstances imaginable...

ext.ext_cn: 他刚刚经历了对于任何部长而言都是最糟糕的一天，这对他来说无法掩饰。
ext.ext_en: He could not disguise that he had had the worst imaginable day for any minister.

defs.def_en: You use imaginable after a superlative such as 'best' or 'worst' to emphasize that something is extreme in some way.

defs.def_cn: (用于 every，all 之后，表示强调)(一切)可能存在的,(一切)可能发生的;(用于 no 以后)根本

ext.ext_cn: 这项技术可能产生的其他一切后果
ext.ext_en: ...all of the other imaginable ramifications of this technology...

ext.ext_cn: 父母鼓励孩子参与一切可能的活动。
ext.ext_en: Parents encourage every activity imaginable.

defs.def_en: You use imaginable after a word like 'every' or 'all' to emphasize that you are talking about all the possible examples of something. You use imaginable after 'no' to emphasize that something does not have the quality mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 萨梯(古典神话中半人半羊的神)
defs.def_en: In classical mythology a satyr is a creature that is half man and half goat.

defs.def_cn: 神创说，特创论(相信《圣经》中上帝创世的记述，反对进化论)
defs.def_en: Creationism is the belief that the account of the creation of the universe in the Bible is true, and that the theory of evolution is incorrect.

ext.ext_cn: 不必要的资源重复
ext.ext_en: ...unnecessary duplication of resources.

defs.def_en: If you say that there has been duplication of something, you mean that someone has done a task unnecessarily because it has already been done before.
A micro-organism is a very small living thing which you can only see if you use a microscope.

ext.ext_cn: 超过退休年龄的人口比例
ext.ext_en: ...the proportion of the population who are over retirement age...

ext.ext_cn: 这个监狱的监狱长和另外一个官员将会提前退休。
ext.ext_en: The Governor of the prison and another official are to take early retirement.

defs.def_en: Retirement is the time when a worker retires.

ext.ext_cn: 为退休期间的老年人提供的经济支持
ext.ext_en: ...financial support for the elderly during retirement.

defs.def_en: A person's retirement is the period in their life after they have retired.

ext.ext_cn: 这个女人拿着一束干枯的紫罗兰。
ext.ext_en: The woman carried a bouquet of dried violets.

defs.def_en: A bouquet is a bunch of flowers which is attractively arranged.

defs.def_cn: （尤指葡萄酒散发的）香味，芬芳

ext.ext_cn: 颜色淡红、散发着丁香香味的西西里葡萄酒
ext.ext_en: ...a Sicilian wine with a light red colour and a bouquet of cloves.

defs.def_en: The bouquet of something, especially wine, is the pleasant smell that it has.
A looking glass is a mirror.

ext.ext_cn: 煤实际上比煤气便宜。
ext.ext_en: Coal is actually cheaper than gas...

ext.ext_cn: 壳牌石油公司签订了一份开采阿尔汉格尔附近的石油和天然气资源的合同。
ext.ext_en: Shell signed a contract to develop oil and gas reserves near Archangel.

defs.def_en: Gas is a substance like air that is neither liquid nor solid and burns easily. It is used as a fuel for cooking and heating.

ext.ext_cn: 氦是一种非常轻的气体。
ext.ext_en: Helium is a very light gas.

ext.ext_cn: 火山喷发形成的混杂着气体和尘埃的巨大云团
ext.ext_en: ...a huge cloud of gas and dust from the volcanic eruption.

defs.def_en: A gas is any substance that is neither liquid nor solid, for example oxygen or hydrogen.

ext.ext_cn: 芥子气
ext.ext_en: ...mustard gas...

ext.ext_cn: 问题在于废气中含有很多毒素。
ext.ext_en: The problem was that the exhaust gases contain many toxins.

ext.ext_cn: 为许多牙医使用的一种麻醉气
ext.ext_en: ...an anaesthetic gas used by many dentists.

defs.def_en: Gas is a gas used for medical purposes, for example to make patients feel less pain or go to sleep during an operation.

ext.ext_cn: 一桶汽油
ext.ext_en: ...a tank of gas.

ext.ext_cn: 加油站
ext.ext_en: ...gas stations.

defs.def_en: Gas is the fuel which is used to drive motor vehicles.

ext.ext_cn: 她的丈夫将一根与她的汽车排气管相通的管子导入卧室，企图用毒气将她杀死。
ext.ext_en: Her husband ran a pipe from her car exhaust to the bedroom in an attempt to gas her.

defs.def_en: To gas a person or animal means to kill them by making them breathe poisonous gas.

defs.def_cn: 活泼有趣的事；令人愉快的场面

ext.ext_en: It was really a gas to find someone I could talk with.

defs.def_en: You can describe a situation or event as a gas when it is very lively, amusing, and enjoyable.
If you step on the gas when you are driving a vehicle, you go faster.
A punctuation mark is a symbol such as a full stop or period, comma, or question mark that you use to divide written words into sentences and clauses.

ext.ext_cn: 她将为你设计一个超级棒的新厨房，而且绝不会超出你的预算。
ext.ext_en: She will design a fantastic new kitchen for you — and all within your budget...

ext.ext_cn: 有人没花多少钱简单地把这个地方布置了一下。
ext.ext_en: Someone had furnished the place on a tight budget...

defs.def_en: Your budget is the amount of money that you have available to spend. The budget for something is the amount of money that a person, organization, or country has available to spend on it.

ext.ext_cn: 很明显，医院每年都要平衡其收支预算。
ext.ext_en: The hospital obviously needs to balance the budget each year.

ext.ext_cn: 他已准备把增加税收作为削减预算赤字的措施之一
ext.ext_en: ...his readiness to raise taxes as part of an effort to cut the budget deficit.

defs.def_en: The budget of an organization or country is its financial situation, considered as the difference between the money it receives and the money it spends.

defs.def_cn: （英国的）政府年度预算案，政府年度预算演讲

ext.ext_cn: 财政大臣可以利用政府年度预算演讲的机会提出税收改革事宜。
ext.ext_en: The Chancellor could use the Budget to bring in taxation reforms.

ext.ext_cn: 在政府预算中公布的其他间接税收变动
ext.ext_en: ...other indirect tax changes announced in the Budget.

defs.def_en: In Britain, the Budget is the financial plan in which the government states how much money it intends to raise through taxes and how it intends to spend it. The Budget is also the speech in which this plan is announced.

ext.ext_cn: 公司已经做了1,000万美元的广告预算。
ext.ext_en: The company has budgeted $10 million for advertising...

ext.ext_cn: 该电影的预算只有1,000万美元。
ext.ext_en: The movie is only budgeted at $10 million...

defs.def_en: If you budget certain amounts of money for particular things, you decide that you can afford to spend those amounts on those things.

ext.ext_cn: 收费低廉的旅行社可以提供240英镑起的低价机票。
ext.ext_en: Cheap flights are available from budget travel agent from £240.

defs.def_en: Budget is used in advertising to suggest that something is being sold cheaply.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 恐慌的；惶惶然的；惊慌失措的

ext.ext_cn: 埃米感到一阵真切、惶惶然的孤独。
ext.ext_en: Amy felt a moment of pure, panicky loneliness...

ext.ext_cn: 很多女性晚上一个人回家时都提心吊胆。
ext.ext_en: Many women feel panicky travelling home at night alone.

defs.def_en: A panicky feeling or panicky behaviour is characterized by panic.

defs.def_cn: 赢得…的支持;说服;把…争取过来

ext.ext_cn: 他争取到了相当数量的左翼代表的支持。
ext.ext_en: He has won over a significant number of the left-wing deputies...

ext.ext_cn: 他们仍然希望把他争取过来。
ext.ext_en: They still hope to win him round.

defs.def_en: If you win someone over or win them round, you persuade them to support you or agree with you.

ext.ext_cn: 运用多种写作风格的作家
ext.ext_en: ...a writer who uses a multiplicity of styles.

ext.ext_cn: 这台机器能完成的多项任务
ext.ext_en: ...the multiplicity of tasks this machine can perform.

defs.def_en: A multiplicity of things is a large number or a large variety of them.

defs.def_cn: 直率的；公开的；直截了当的

ext.ext_cn: 川口最后干脆睁着眼睛说瞎话。
ext.ext_en: Kawaguchi finally resorted to an outright lie.

ext.ext_cn: 公开谴责
ext.ext_en: ...outright condemnation.

defs.def_en: You use outright to describe behaviour and actions that are open and direct, rather than indirect.

ext.ext_cn: 她没能大获全胜。
ext.ext_en: She had failed to win an outright victory...

ext.ext_cn: 观众反应不一，有人完全不能接受，也有人击掌叫好。
ext.ext_en: The response of the audience varied from outright rejection to warm hospitality.

defs.def_en: Outright means complete and total.

ext.ext_cn: 大约20毫米长的透明小药片
ext.ext_en: ...a tiny little transparent pill, about 20 millimetres long.

defs.def_en: A millimetre is a metric unit of length that is equal to a tenth of a centimetre or a thousandth of a metre.

ext.ext_cn: 一群大象缓慢而笨拙地穿过平原，朝水潭走去。
ext.ext_en: A herd of elephants lolloped across the plains towards a watering hole.

defs.def_en: When an animal or a person lollops along, they run along awkwardly and not very fast.

defs.def_cn: 使边缘化；使显得不重要;排斥

ext.ext_cn: 这件事的影响是使地方当局越来越受到排斥。
ext.ext_en: The effect of this has been to increasingly marginalize the local authority sector...

ext.ext_cn: 我们总是遭到排挤、剥削和不断的恐吓。
ext.ext_en: We've always been marginalized, exploited, and constantly threatened.

defs.def_en: To marginalize a group of people means to make them feel isolated and unimportant.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 唤起回忆的;引起感情共鸣的

ext.ext_cn: 她的故事让人清晰地回忆起意大利的乡村生活。
ext.ext_en: Her story is sharply evocative of Italian provincial life.

ext.ext_cn: 电影引起共鸣的力量
ext.ext_en: ...the evocative power of cinema.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as evocative, you mean that it is good or interesting because it produces pleasant memories, ideas, emotions, and responses in people.

ext.ext_cn: 有迹象表明，在她被连刺数刀前，曾与袭击者进行过搏斗。
ext.ext_en: There were signs that she struggled with her attacker before she was repeatedly stabbed.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a person who attacks someone as their attacker .
An astronomer is a scientist who studies the stars, planets, and other natural objects in space.

ext.ext_cn: 一直有人暗示这些是黑帮之间的杀戮。
ext.ext_en: It's been suggested they were gangland killings...

ext.ext_cn: 一个意大利黑社会大佬
ext.ext_en: ...one of Italy's  top gangland bosses.

defs.def_en: Gangland is used to describe activities or people that are involved in organized crime.

ext.ext_cn: 父亲从不谈他的谋生之道。
ext.ext_en: Father never talked about what he did for a living...

ext.ext_cn: 他做各种各样的活计来谋生。
ext.ext_en: He earns his living doing all kinds of things.

defs.def_en: The work that you do for a living is the work that you do in order to earn the money that you need.

defs.def_cn: 生活质量；生活素质；生活（方式）

ext.ext_cn: 奥利维娅一向是健康生活的楷模。
ext.ext_en: Olivia has always been a model of healthy living.

ext.ext_cn: 城市生活的压力
ext.ext_en: ...the stresses of urban living.

defs.def_en: You use living when you are talking about the quality of people's  daily lives.

ext.ext_cn: 宽敞的生活区位于3楼。
ext.ext_en: The spacious living quarters were on the second floor...

ext.ext_cn: 书房把主要的生活区与厨房连在一起。
ext.ext_en: The study links the main living area to the kitchen.

defs.def_en: You use living to talk about the places where people relax when they are not working.

ext.ext_cn: 这位年轻人已经死了。我们只能考虑在生之人。
ext.ext_en: The young man is dead. We have only to consider the living.

defs.def_en: The living are people who are alive, rather than people who have died.

defs.def_cn: 艰难度日，勉强糊口（美国英语中作scrape out a living或scratch out a living）

ext.ext_cn: 他靠当艺术家来勉强混口饭吃。
ext.ext_en: He almost manages to scrape a living as an artist.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone scrapes a living or scratches a living, you mean that they manage to earn enough to live on, but it is very difficult. In American English, you say they scrape out a living or scratch out a living .

ext.ext_cn: 阿瑟·C. 克拉克喜欢引用他的朋友兼同事——科幻作家雷·布拉德伯里的话。
ext.ext_en: Arthur C Clarke likes to quote his friend and fellow SF writer Ray Bradbury.

defs.def_en: SF is the same as science fiction .

defs.def_cn: （常加入肉或鱼及调味品煮成的）肉饭
defs.def_en: Pilau or pilau rice is rice flavoured with spices, often mixed with pieces of meat or fish.

ext.ext_cn: 在更大的欢呼声中骑手们冲过来了，只听呼的一声，就全部飞奔而过！
ext.ext_en: Then came the riders amid even louder cheers and whoosh! It was all over.

defs.def_en: People sometimes say 'whoosh' when they are emphasizing the fact that something happens very suddenly or very fast.

ext.ext_cn: 冷空气吹得大街上的格栅呜呜作响。
ext.ext_en: Cool air whooshes up through the grates on the street...

ext.ext_cn: 风筝在沙滩上空时隐时现。
ext.ext_en: Kites whooshed above the beach at intervals.

defs.def_en: If something whooshes somewhere, it moves there quickly or suddenly.

ext.ext_cn: 风吹过树林的呼啸呜咽
ext.ext_en: ...the whoosh and murmur of the wind through the trees...

ext.ext_cn: 他们驱车回家，一路上挡风玻璃上的雨刮器不停地呼呼刮着。
ext.ext_en: They drove home with their windshield wipers going whoosh whoosh.

defs.def_en: A whoosh of air or water is a sudden rush of it.
Teaching practice is a period that a student teacher spends teaching at a school as part of his or her training.

ext.ext_cn: 政府没有承认错误，只是敷衍了事地处理问题。

ext.ext_cn: 他们修了修发动机。
ext.ext_en: They tinkered with the engine…

defs.def_en: If you tinker with something, you make some small changes to it, in an attempt to improve it or repair it.
In former times, a tinker was a person who did not have a fixed home, but travelled from place to place mending metal pots and doing other small repair jobs.

defs.def_cn: (尤指爱尔兰裔的)流浪者，吉卜赛人
defs.def_en: Some people refer to any traveller or gipsy, especially one who is Irish, as a tinker .

ext.ext_cn: 展览追溯了美国从19世纪至今的平面设计历史。
ext.ext_en: The exhibition traces the history of graphic design in America from the 19th century to the present...

ext.ext_en: I first went there to trace my roots, visiting my mum's home island of Jamaica…

defs.def_en: If you trace the origin or development of something, you find out or describe how it started or developed.

ext.ext_cn: 早上将近8点时有人看到两名男子离开那所房子，警方急于找到他们。
ext.ext_en: Police are anxious to trace two men seen leaving the house just before 8am...

ext.ext_en: We are currently trying to trace the whereabouts of certain sums of money…

defs.def_en: If you trace someone or something, you find them after looking for them.

ext.ext_cn: 我在地图上勾勒出这条河的流向。
ext.ext_en: I traced the course of the river on the map.

defs.def_en: If you trace something such as a pattern or a shape, for example with your finger or toe, you mark its outline on a surface.

ext.ext_en: She learned to draw by tracing pictures out of old storybooks.

defs.def_en: If you trace a picture, you copy it by covering it with a piece of transparent paper and drawing over the lines underneath.

ext.ext_cn: 用冷水冲洗它们以清除所有的沙子。
ext.ext_en: Wash them in cold water to remove all traces of sand...

ext.ext_cn: 他尽力不带一丝哗众取宠的色彩来写作他的题材。
ext.ext_en: He took great pains to write on his subject without a trace of sensationalism.

defs.def_en: A trace of something is a very small amount of it.

ext.ext_cn: 当地教堂仍留有 15 世纪壁画的遗迹。
ext.ext_en: The local church has traces of fifteenth-century frescoes…

ext.ext_cn: 没有我姑姑、姑夫的踪迹。
ext.ext_en: There's been no trace of my aunt and uncle...

defs.def_en: A trace is a sign which shows you that someone or something has been in a place.

ext.ext_en: The Social Democratic Party has sunk without trace at these elections...

ext.ext_cn: 流行乐队就像奥林匹克游泳选手——拿到一次金牌后就无声无息了。
ext.ext_en: Pop groups are like Olympic swimmers — they hit gold once, then they sink without trace.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something sinks without trace or sinks without a trace, you mean that they stop existing or stop being successful very suddenly and completely.

defs.def_cn: 炮弹休克，弹震症(一种因曾置身战火而引起的精神紧张或错乱)

ext.ext_cn: 这些男人患了炮弹休克症。
ext.ext_en: The men were suffering from shell shock.

defs.def_en: Shell shock is the confused or nervous mental condition of people who have been under fire in a war.

ext.ext_cn: 很多情况下，那里的人们是真刀真枪地在为家园而抗争。
ext.ext_en: In many cases, the people there are fighting, in a literal sense, for their homes.

defs.def_en: The literal sense of a word or phrase is its most basic sense.

ext.ext_en: A literal translation of the name Tapies is 'walls.'

defs.def_en: A literal translation is one in which you translate each word of the original work rather than giving the meaning of each expression or sentence using words that sound natural.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 言辞刻板的；听话不听音的

ext.ext_en: Dennis is a very literal person.

defs.def_en: You use literal to describe someone who uses or understands words in a plain and simple way.

defs.def_cn: 确确实实的；完完全全的

ext.ext_en: He was saying no more than the literal truth.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as the literal truth or a literal fact, you are emphasizing that it is true.

defs.def_cn: (尤指出于战争原因的)禁飞区
defs.def_en: A no-fly zone is an area of sky where military and other aircraft are not allowed to fly, especially because of a war.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （尤指在钱财上）慷慨的，大方的

ext.ext_en: German banks are more generous in their lending...

ext.ext_cn: 无论以哪个标准来衡量，这都是一份厚礼。
ext.ext_en: The gift is generous by any standards.

defs.def_en: A generous person gives more of something, especially money, than is usual or expected.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 宽厚的；仁慈的；宽宏大量的

ext.ext_cn: 他从不吝啬与人分享自己渊博的知识。
ext.ext_en: He was always generous in sharing his enormous knowledge...

ext.ext_en: He was generous enough to congratulate his successor on his decision.

defs.def_en: A generous person is friendly, helpful, and willing to see the good qualities in someone or something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...a generous six weeks of annual holiday...

ext.ext_cn: 有那么宽绰的储物空间，他应该可以保持房间的整齐。
ext.ext_en: He should be able to keep his room tidy with the generous amount of storage space.

defs.def_en: A generous amount of something is much larger than is usual or necessary.
A sound stage is a stage or set which is suitable for recording sound, especially for a film.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 易碎成小薄片的;易剥落的

ext.ext_cn: 一小块发红而且快要脱落的皮肤
ext.ext_en: ...a small patch of red, flaky skin.

defs.def_en: Something that is flaky breaks easily into small thin pieces or tends to come off in small thin pieces.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他怀疑这个想法不仅仅是有点太古怪、太离奇而已。
ext.ext_en: He wondered if the idea wasn't just a little too flaky, a little too outlandish.

defs.def_en: If you describe an idea, argument, or person as flaky, you mean that they are rather eccentric and unreliable.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不整洁的；未被照顾妥当的；未被收拾整齐的

ext.ext_cn: 他的头发蓬乱污秽。
ext.ext_en: His hair was unkempt and filthy.

ext.ext_cn: 荒芜的草坪
ext.ext_en: ...the unkempt grass.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as unkempt, you mean that they are untidy, and not looked after carefully or kept neat.

ext.ext_cn: 你最好把他赶走。
ext.ext_en: You'd better shoo him away...

ext.ext_cn: 我把他赶出了房间。
ext.ext_en: I shooed him out of the room.

defs.def_en: If you shoo an animal or a person away, you make them go away by waving your hands or arms at them.

ext.ext_cn: 嘘！小鸟，嘘！
ext.ext_en: Shoo, bird, shoo.

defs.def_en: You say 'shoo!' to an animal when you want it to go away.

ext.ext_cn: 诸如塞尔焦·莱昂内之类的意大利电影制作人
ext.ext_en: ...Italian film-makers like Sergio Leone.

defs.def_en: A film-maker is someone involved in making films, in particular a director or producer.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (化学物质)腐蚀性强的，苛性的

ext.ext_cn: 强腐蚀性的洗涤剂
ext.ext_en: ...caustic cleaning agents...

ext.ext_en: Remember that this is caustic; use gloves or a spoon.

defs.def_en: Caustic chemical substances are very powerful and can dissolve other substances.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他睿智刁钻，评论尖刻，对任何采访他的人而言都是梦魇。
ext.ext_en: His abrasive wit and caustic comments were an interviewer's nightmare...

ext.ext_cn: 他常常讽刺或挖苦人，有时又会大发雷霆。
ext.ext_en: He was often caustic and mocking, or flew into rages.

defs.def_en: A caustic remark is extremely critical, cruel, or bitter.

defs.def_cn: 炒面(用炒面条、熟肉、蔬菜制作的中式食物)

ext.ext_cn: 鸡肉炒面
ext.ext_en: ...chicken chow mein.

defs.def_en: Chow mein is a Chinese-style dish that consists of fried noodles, cooked meat, and vegetables.

ext.ext_cn: 他滑稽地耸了耸肩，眼镜片后面的双眼眯了起来。
ext.ext_en: He shrugged whimsically, his eyes crinkling behind his glasses...

ext.ext_cn: 她一笑，俊俏的鼻子就会皱起来。
ext.ext_en: When she laughs, she crinkles her perfectly-formed nose...

defs.def_en: If something crinkles or if you crinkle it, it becomes slightly creased or folded.

defs.def_cn: (用于构词)表示“逆”，“相反”，“相应”，“对应”

ext.ext_cn: 军队现在似乎已经发起了反攻。
ext.ext_en: The army now appears to have launched a counter-offensive.

ext.ext_en: ...the chief of counterterrorist operations.

defs.def_en: Counter- is used to form words which refer to actions or activities that are intended to prevent other actions or activities or that respond to them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不够标准的;不合格的;差劲的;劣质的

ext.ext_cn: 居民们普遍都很贫穷，受教育程度低，居住条件较差。
