ext.ext_cn: 疼痛难忍，我就快大哭起来了。
ext.ext_en: The pain was so bad that I would be in floods of tears...

ext.ext_cn: 他们痛哭流涕地道别。
ext.ext_en: They said goodbye in a flood of tears.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone was in floods of tears or in a flood of tears, you are emphasizing that they were crying with great intensity because they were very upset.

ext.ext_cn: 铁路线被洪水冲毁。
ext.ext_en: Train lines were flooded out...

ext.ext_cn: 每隔几年他们就会因这条河的泛滥而被迫离开家园。
ext.ext_en: The river flooded them out every few years.

defs.def_en: If people, places, or things are flooded out, the water from a flood makes it impossible for people to stay in that place or to use that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他使他们看起来像傻瓜一样。
ext.ext_en: He makes 'em look like bozos.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a bozo, you mean that you think they are stupid.

defs.def_cn: （用作系带或座位支持物的）带状织物
defs.def_en: Webbing is strong material which is woven in strips and used to make belts or straps, or used in seats to support the springs.

ext.ext_cn: 大门口的一侧有块红色的匾额。
ext.ext_en: On one side of the main entrance there's a red plaque.

ext.ext_cn: 我居中、乔和肯分别在我两侧的一张照片
ext.ext_en: ...a photograph with me in the centre and Joe and Ken on each side of me.

defs.def_en: The side of something is a position to the left or right of it, rather than in front of it, behind it, or on it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在箱子的一侧贴了警示标。
ext.ext_en: We put a notice on the side of the box.

ext.ext_cn: 一辆侧面印有公司名称的小货车
ext.ext_en: ...a van bearing on its side the name of a company...

defs.def_en: The side of an object, building, or vehicle is any of its flat surfaces which is not considered to be its front, its back, its top, or its bottom.

defs.def_cn: (洞或容器垂直的)内侧面，内壁

ext.ext_cn: 凸凹不平的石墙就像一条很深的运河的河岸。
ext.ext_en: The rough rock walls were like the sides of a deep canal...

ext.ext_cn: 在餐盘底部垫一层防油纸，再在里侧涂少许的油。
ext.ext_en: Line the base of the dish with greaseproof paper and lightly grease the sides.

defs.def_en: The sides of a hollow or a container are its inside vertical surfaces.

ext.ext_cn: 靠路边停车。
ext.ext_en: Park on the side of the road.

ext.ext_cn: 半岛北侧的一个小海滩
ext.ext_en: ...a small beach on the north side of the peninsula...

defs.def_en: The sides of an area or surface are its edges.

defs.def_cn: (某地区、表面或物体一分为二的)一边，一侧

ext.ext_cn: 她翻了个身趴在了床的另一边。
ext.ext_en: She turned over on her stomach on the other side of the bed...

ext.ext_cn: 语言中枢位于左半脑。
ext.ext_en: The major centre for language is in the left side of the brain.

defs.def_en: The two sides of an area, surface, or object are its two halves.

defs.def_cn: (有车流来往的道路的)方向，侧

ext.ext_cn: 它驶上了逆行车道，撞上了对面驶来的一辆汽车。
ext.ext_en: It had gone on to the wrong side of the road and hit a car coming in the other direction.

defs.def_en: The two sides of a road are its two halves on which traffic travels in opposite directions.

defs.def_cn: (城镇或世界的)另一端，遥远的地方

ext.ext_cn: 他住在伦敦的另一端。
ext.ext_en: He lives the other side of London...

ext.ext_cn: 他见到了那艘要将他们运往世界另一端的轮船。
ext.ext_en: He saw the ship that was to transport them to the other side of the world...

defs.def_en: If you talk about the other side of a town or of the world, you mean a part of the town or of the world that is very far from where you are.

defs.def_cn: (人体自腋下至臀部的)体侧,肋部

ext.ext_cn: 他的双臂无力地垂在身体两侧。
ext.ext_en: His arms were limp at his sides...

ext.ext_cn: 他们让他侧身躺下。
ext.ext_en: They had laid him on his side.

defs.def_en: Your sides are the parts of your body between your front and your back, from under your arms to your hips.

defs.def_cn: (在…)身边，(在…)旁边(给予支持或安慰)

ext.ext_cn: 他对他的妻子始终不离不弃。
ext.ext_en: He was constantly at his wife's side...

ext.ext_cn: 他一天给我打了 20 次电话，晚上还要我陪在他身边。
ext.ext_en: He calls me 20 times a day and needs me by his side in the evening...

defs.def_en: If someone is by your side or at your side, they stay near you and give you comfort or support.

ext.ext_cn: 新复印机只能单面复印。
ext.ext_en: The new copiers only copy onto one side of the paper...

ext.ext_cn: 将排骨煎至两面呈棕黄色。
ext.ext_en: Fry the chops until brown on both sides...

defs.def_en: The two sides of something flat, for example a piece of paper, are its two flat surfaces. You can also refer to one side of a piece of paper filled with writing as one side of writing.

ext.ext_cn: 我们想听 A 面。
ext.ext_en: We want to hear side A...

ext.ext_cn: 那时候交响乐都是灌录在4 张 12 英寸唱片的双面上。
ext.ext_en: In those days symphonies were recorded on both sides of four twelve-inch records.

defs.def_en: One side of a tape or record is what you can hear or record if you play the tape or record from beginning to end without turning it over.

defs.def_cn: (牛肉、猪肉等沿脊骨劈开的)一边，半只，一扇
defs.def_en: A side of beef, bacon, or other meat consists of the meat from half the animal cut along its backbone.

ext.ext_cn: 她从剧院的侧门溜进溜出。
ext.ext_en: She slipped in and out of the theatre by a side door.

ext.ext_cn: 有扁豆做配菜的咖喱虾
ext.ext_en: ...a prawn curry with a lentil side dish.

defs.def_en: Side is used to describe things that are not the main or most important ones of their kind.

ext.ext_cn: 双方都呼吁达成新的停火协议。
ext.ext_en: Both sides appealed for a new ceasefire...

ext.ext_cn: 任何解决办法都必须能为各方所接受。
ext.ext_en: Any solution must be acceptable to all sides.

defs.def_en: The different sides in a war, argument, or negotiation are the groups of people who are opposing each other.

defs.def_cn: (争论或交易中)一方的观点(或立场)

ext.ext_cn: 他的话引起了争论双方的强烈反响。
ext.ext_en: His words drew sharp reactions from people on both sides of the issue.

ext.ext_cn: 能看到问题方方面面的人
ext.ext_en: ...those with the ability to see all sides of a question...

defs.def_en: The different sides of an argument or deal are the different points of view or positions involved in it.

ext.ext_cn: 有很多猜测认为美国会支持叛乱者。
ext.ext_en: There has been much speculation that America might be siding with the rebels...

ext.ext_cn: 你要直面那些联合反对你的人。
ext.ext_en: You need to confront those who have sided against you.

defs.def_en: If one person or country sides with another, they support them in an argument or a war. If people or countries side against another person or country, they support each other against them.

ext.ext_cn: 意大利队明显比德国队要强。
ext.ext_en: Italy were definitely a better side than Germany...

ext.ext_cn: 队长决定将 4 名 40 多岁的男子招入队中。
ext.ext_en: The captain made the decision to include four men in their 40s in his side.

defs.def_en: In sport, a side is a team.

ext.ext_cn: 他在联合国使团中负责平民方面的事务。
ext.ext_en: He is in charge of the civilian side of the UN mission...

ext.ext_cn: 这表明你的孩子现在可以领会事情有趣的一面了。
ext.ext_en: It shows that your child can now see the funny side of things...

defs.def_en: A particular side of something such as a situation or someone's character is one aspect of it.

ext.ext_cn: 那么你父亲那边更富有一些了？
ext.ext_en: So was your father's side more well off?

ext.ext_cn: 他母亲那边的一位亲戚
ext.ext_en: ...a relative on the maternal side of his family.

defs.def_en: The mother's side and the father's side of your family are your mother's relatives and your father's relatives.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在两把柳条椅上肩并肩坐着。
ext.ext_en: We sat side by side on two wicker seats...

ext.ext_cn: 将茄子码齐放在上菜用的盘子里。
ext.ext_en: Put the eggplants side by side in a serving dish.

defs.def_en: If two people or things are side by side, they are next to each other.

ext.ext_cn: 不同民族和睦相处了几个世纪的地区
ext.ext_en: ...areas where different nationalities have lived side by side for centuries...

ext.ext_cn: 通常我们和男性一起并肩工作。
ext.ext_en: We're usually working side by side with the men.

defs.def_en: If people work or live side by side, they work or live closely together in a friendly way.

defs.def_cn: 令(家人或朋友)失望(或难堪)

ext.ext_cn: 布朗不断让家人失望。
ext.ext_en: Brown was constantly letting the side down.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has let the side down, you mean that they have embarrassed their family or friends by behaving badly or not doing well at something.

ext.ext_cn: 她摇头晃脑。
ext.ext_en: She was shaking her head from side to side.

defs.def_en: If something moves from side to side, it moves repeatedly to the left and to the right.

ext.ext_cn: 他有民主党人的支持。
ext.ext_en: He has the Democrats on his side...

ext.ext_cn: 设法让那名雇员站到你这边，然后你们共同找出解决方法。
ext.ext_en: Get that employee on your side and then work together towards a solution...

defs.def_en: If you are on someone's side, you are supporting them in an argument or a war.

ext.ext_cn: 天气对我们非常有利。
ext.ext_en: The weather is rather on our side...

ext.ext_cn: 法律并不站在他们那边。
ext.ext_en: The law is not on their side.

defs.def_en: If something is on your side or if you have it on your side, it helps you when you are trying to achieve something.

ext.ext_cn: 我不想激怒他。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't like to get on the wrong side of him...

ext.ext_cn: 你得讨卡梅拉的欢心。
ext.ext_en: You'll need to get on the right side of Carmela.

defs.def_en: If you get on the wrong side of someone, you do something to annoy them and make them dislike you. If you stay on the right side of someone, you try to please them and avoid annoying them.

ext.ext_cn: 他很安静，略有点害羞。
ext.ext_en: He's quiet and a bit on the shy side.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is on the small side, you are saying politely that you think it is slightly too small. If you say that someone is on the young side, you are saying politely that you think they are slightly too young.

defs.def_cn: 兼职;在正事之外;作为副业

ext.ext_cn: 兼职挣点钱的方法
ext.ext_en: ...ways of making a little bit of money on the side.

defs.def_en: If someone does something on the side, they do it in addition to their main work.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你喜欢，可以上一碗热番茄调味汁来蘸着吃。
ext.ext_en: Serve a bowl of warm tomato sauce on the side for dipping, if desired.

defs.def_en: If you have one type of food with another food on the side, you have an amount of the second food served with the first.

defs.def_cn: 暂且不管;把…暂搁置一边

ext.ext_cn: 为了保持利润率，常置卫生和安全规章于不顾。
ext.ext_en: In order to maintain profit margins health and safety regulations are often put to one side.

defs.def_en: If you put something to one side or put it on one side, you temporarily ignore it in order to concentrate on something else.

defs.def_cn: 把…拉到一边去(私下交谈)

ext.ext_cn: 他将萨布丽娜拉到一旁，悄悄告诉她关于保险箱的事。
ext.ext_en: He took Sabrina to one side and told her about the safe.

defs.def_en: If you take someone to one side or draw them to one side, you speak to them privately, usually in order to give them advice or a warning.

defs.def_cn: (在争论或战争中)支持一方，站在…一边

ext.ext_cn: 内战中我们不能支持任何一方。
ext.ext_en: We cannot take sides in a civil war...

ext.ext_cn: 看到了吧？你又在帮他了。
ext.ext_en: See? You're taking his side again.

defs.def_en: If you take sides or take someone's side in an argument or war, you support one of the sides against the other.

defs.def_cn: 在（某一日期或事件）之前

ext.ext_cn: 现在看来，本届世界锦标赛之前两人之间不太可能展开较量了。
ext.ext_en: A race between the two is now unlikely to take place this side of the world championships.

defs.def_en: If you say that something will not happen this side of a date or event, you mean that it will not happen before that date or event.

defs.def_cn: 把（建筑或城镇）夷为平地；彻底摧毁

ext.ext_cn: 几十个村庄被夷为平地。
ext.ext_en: Dozens of villages have been razed...

ext.ext_cn: 如米特维尔和本维尔这样的城镇基本上被夷为平地。
ext.ext_en: Towns such as Mittelwihr and Bennwihr were virtually razed to the ground.

defs.def_en: If buildings, villages or towns are razed or razed to the ground, they are completely destroyed.

defs.def_cn: 民主;民主制度;民主政体

ext.ext_cn: 民主制度在东欧的传播
ext.ext_en: ...the spread of democracy in Eastern Europe.

ext.ext_cn: 亲民主运动
ext.ext_en: ...the pro-democracy movement.

defs.def_en: Democracy is a system of government in which people choose their rulers by voting for them in elections.

ext.ext_cn: 这些新兴的民主国家面临着严峻挑战。
ext.ext_en: The new democracies face tough challenges.

defs.def_en: A democracy is a country in which the people choose their government by voting for it.

defs.def_cn: 民主管理制度;民主作风

ext.ext_cn: 该工会对工业民主的强调
ext.ext_en: ...the union's emphasis on industrial democracy.

defs.def_en: Democracy is a system of running organizations, businesses, and groups in which each member is entitled to vote and take part in decisions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他风格多变，从布鲁斯、乡村音乐到雄壮的交响乐都能驾驭。
ext.ext_en: He is a protean stylist who can move from blues to ballads and grand symphony.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as protean, you mean that they have the ability to continually change their nature, appearance, or behaviour.

ext.ext_cn: 印度上层种姓多数崇拜女神时母。
ext.ext_en: Most of the upper castes worship the Goddess Kali.

defs.def_en: A caste is one of the traditional social classes into which people are divided in a Hindu society.

defs.def_cn: 种姓制度;社会等级制度

ext.ext_cn: 社会等级制度主要是通过个人生活方式赢得的社会荣誉来确定。
ext.ext_en: Caste is defined primarily by social honour attained through personal lifestyle...

ext.ext_cn: 种姓制度几乎影响着印度生活的方方面面。
ext.ext_en: The caste system shapes nearly every facet of Indian life.

defs.def_en: Caste is the system of dividing people in a society into different social classes.

ext.ext_cn: 我一无所成，所以他们瞧不起我。
ext.ext_en: I wasn't successful, so they looked down on me.

defs.def_en: To look down on someone means to consider that person to be inferior or unimportant, usually when this is not true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （暴力、性爱等）耸人听闻的，触目惊心的，骇人的

ext.ext_cn: 有关克莱尔的性生活史露骨的描述
ext.ext_en: ...lurid accounts of Claire's  sexual exploits...

ext.ext_cn: 一些报道含有对死状和肢解的令人毛骨悚然的描述。
ext.ext_en: Some reports have contained lurid accounts of deaths and mutilations.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is lurid, you are critical of it because it involves a lot of violence, sex, or shocking detail.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她精心地把脚指甲涂成妖艳的红色或橙色。
ext.ext_en: She took care to paint her toe nails a lurid red or orange.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as lurid, you do not like it because it is very brightly coloured.

defs.def_cn: 骑师;骑手;骑马(或自行车、摩托车)的人

ext.ext_cn: 她是一位经验丰富的优秀骑师。
ext.ext_en: She is a very good and experienced rider...

ext.ext_cn: 当我们走出马厩的时候，一个人骑着马向我们走了过来。
ext.ext_en: As we came out of the stables, a rider came towards us.

defs.def_en: A rider is someone who rides a horse, a bicycle, or a motorcycle as a hobby or job. You can also refer to someone who is riding a horse, a bicycle, or a motorcycle as a rider.

ext.ext_cn: 凯西先生说他觉得没有必要增加任何有关警察使用枪支的附加条款。
ext.ext_en: Mr Casey said he could see no necessity to add any rider on the use of firearms by police...

ext.ext_cn: 美国按照惯例在对以色列的援助中提出了附加条款，大意是该援助不能用于被占领地区。
ext.ext_en: America conventionally attaches a rider to Israeli aid, to the effect that it must not be used in the occupied territories.

defs.def_en: A rider is a statement that is added to another statement, especially one which contains a change, an explanation, or further information.

ext.ext_cn: 用一把非常锋利的刀将褐色的皮从肉上剥去。
ext.ext_en: Pare the brown skin from the meat with a very sharp knife...

ext.ext_cn: 他拿出一大块奶酪，切下一片，匆忙吃了。
ext.ext_en: He took out a slab of cheese, pared off a slice and ate it hastily.

defs.def_en: See also:paring;When you pare something, or pare part of it off or away, you cut off its skin or its outer layer.

ext.ext_cn: 部委的数量已经减少了1/3。
ext.ext_en: The number of Ministries has been pared down by a third...

ext.ext_cn: 奢侈品税其实对削减预算赤字并不会有多少帮助。
ext.ext_en: The luxury tax won't really do much to pare down the budget deficit...

defs.def_en: If you pare something down or back, or if you pare it, you reduce it.

defs.pos_cn: 可数名词；头衔名词；称呼名词
defs.def_cn: (英国)陆军少将;(美国)陆军(或空军、海军陆战队)少将
defs.def_en: In Britain, a major general is a senior officer in the army, one rank above a brigadier. In the United States, a major general is a senior officer in the army, air force, or marines, one rank above brigadier general.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: You use hen-pecked to describe a man when you disapprove of the fact that his wife, or another woman, is always telling him what to do or telling him that he has done something wrong.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 乔安娜曾有一两次敷衍着去帮助格雷厄姆年轻的妻子。
ext.ext_en: Joanna had made one or two half-hearted attempts to befriend Graham's young wife.

ext.ext_cn: 不诚挚的道歉
ext.ext_en: ...a half-hearted apology...

defs.def_en: If someone does something in a half-hearted way, they do it without any real effort, interest, or enthusiasm.
A dressmaker is a person who makes women's or children's clothes.

defs.def_cn: 令人不快的事；讨厌的事

ext.ext_cn: 我一天都很烦。
ext.ext_en: I had a bummer of a day...

ext.ext_cn: 真烦人！
ext.ext_en: What a bummer!

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a bummer, you mean that it is unpleasant or annoying.

defs.def_cn: 全能的；有无限权力的；无所不能的

ext.ext_cn: 道格生活在他那看似权威至高无上的父亲的阴影里。
ext.ext_en: Doug lived in the shadow of his seemingly omnipotent father.

ext.ext_cn: 作家的全能力量
ext.ext_en: ...the omnipotent power of an author.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is omnipotent has complete power over things or people.

ext.ext_cn: 在与政府的消耗战中，反叛者宣布停火。
ext.ext_en: The rebels have declared a ceasefire in their war of attrition against the government.

defs.def_en: Attrition is a process in which you steadily reduce the strength of an enemy by continually attacking them.

ext.ext_cn: 公司计划在6年内通过人员自然流失和减少雇用使员工总数减少1/4。
ext.ext_en: The company plans to cut a quarter of its workforce over six years through natural attrition and fewer hirings.

defs.def_en: At a university or place of work, attrition is the decrease in the number of students or employees caused by people leaving and not being replaced.

X-rays are a type of radiation that can pass through most solid materials. X-rays are used by doctors to examine the bones or organs inside your body and are also used at airports to see inside people's luggage.

ext.ext_cn: 她被建议拍一张腹部的X光片。
ext.ext_en: She was advised to have an abdominal X-ray.

defs.def_en: An X-ray is a picture made by sending X-rays through something, usually someone's body.

defs.def_cn: 给…拍摄X光片；对…进行X光检查

ext.ext_cn: 所有的手提行李都要接受X光检查。
ext.ext_en: All hand baggage would be x-rayed...

ext.ext_cn: 他们给我量了脉搏、血压，还给我的下颌拍了X光片。
ext.ext_en: They took my pulse, took my blood pressure, and X-rayed my jaw.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is X-rayed, an X-ray picture is taken of them.

ext.ext_cn: 一粒小麦
ext.ext_en: ...a grain of wheat.

ext.ext_cn: 米粒
ext.ext_en: ...rice grains.

defs.def_en: A grain of wheat, rice, or other cereal crop is a seed from it.

ext.ext_cn: 一袋谷物
ext.ext_en: ...a bag of grain.

ext.ext_cn: 优质谷物
ext.ext_en: ...the best grains.

defs.def_en: Grain is a cereal crop, especially wheat or corn, that has been harvested and is used for food or in trade.

ext.ext_cn: 一粒沙子
ext.ext_en: ...a grain of sand.

defs.def_en: A grain of something such as sand or salt is a tiny hard piece of it.

ext.ext_cn: 如果她真的爱你的话，希望她会理解并原谅你。
ext.ext_en: Hopefully she'll understand and forgive you, if she really loves you...

ext.ext_cn: 她会让自己原谅他偷钱的行为的。
ext.ext_en: She'd find a way to forgive him for the theft of the money...

defs.def_en: If you forgive someone who has done something bad or wrong, you stop being angry with them and no longer want to punish them.

ext.ext_cn: 看看这些数字，难怪你会觉得经济衰退已经结束了。
ext.ext_en: Looking at the figures, you could be forgiven for thinking the recession is already over...

ext.ext_cn: 如果吸引他们来到英国的研究项目被取消了，他们感觉遭到了背叛也是情有可原的。
ext.ext_en: If the research which enticed them to Britain is removed, they can be forgiven for feeling betrayed.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone could be forgiven for doing something, you mean that they were wrong or mistaken, but not seriously, because many people would have done the same thing in those circumstances.

defs.def_cn: (用于礼貌用语或道歉语中)请原谅/恕我无知

ext.ext_cn: 请原谅，我并非有意侮辱你。
ext.ext_en: Forgive me, I don't mean to insult you...

ext.ext_cn: 我真的非常抱歉，我得走了。
ext.ext_en: I do hope you'll forgive me but I've got to leave...

defs.def_en: Forgive is used in polite expressions and apologies like 'forgive me' and 'forgive my ignorance' when you are saying or doing something that might seem rude, silly, or complicated.

ext.ext_cn: 美国国会同意免除埃及的军事债务。
ext.ext_en: The American Congress has agreed to forgive Egypt's military debt.

defs.def_en: If an organization such as a bank forgives someone's debt, they agree not to ask for that money to be repaid.

ext.ext_cn: 最常用的方法是放射性碳定年法。
ext.ext_en: The most frequently used method is radiocarbon dating.

defs.def_en: Radiocarbon is a type of carbon which is radioactive, and which therefore breaks up slowly at a regular rate. Its presence in an object can be measured in order to find out how old the object is.

ext.ext_cn: 夺冠之争一直都相当激烈。
ext.ext_en: There's been some fierce competition for the title...

ext.ext_cn: 就是在这些画室里，年轻的画家们得到了同龄人的支持，也感受到了激励大家向前的竞争。
ext.ext_en: It was in these studios that young painters found the support and stimulating competition of peers.

defs.def_en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

ext.ext_cn: 我得改变方法，现在的竞争对手太强。
ext.ext_en: I have to change my approach, the competition is too good now.

defs.def_en: The competition is the person or people you are competing with.

ext.ext_cn: 这项协议原本会减少通勤航班市场的竞争。
ext.ext_en: The deal would have reduced competition in the commuter-aircraft market...

ext.ext_cn: 农场主们一直在寻找更高的价格，以更好地保护自己不受国外竞争对手的影响。
ext.ext_en: The farmers have been seeking higher prices as better protection from foreign competition...

defs.def_en: Competition is an activity involving two or more firms, in which each firm tries to get people to buy its own goods in preference to the other firms' goods.

ext.ext_cn: 美国航空和航天工业已经受到某种强劲的竞争产品的挑战。
ext.ext_en: The American aerospace industry has been challenged by some stiff competition.

defs.def_en: The competition is the goods that a rival organization is selling.

ext.ext_cn: 冲浪比赛
ext.ext_en: ...a surfing competition...

ext.ext_cn: 委员会为本地区的中小学生组织了一系列的活动和比赛。
ext.ext_en: The council has organised a series of events and competitions for school children in the area...

defs.def_en: A competition is an event in which many people take part in order to find out who is best at a particular activity.

ext.ext_cn: 我不怎么骑我的摩托车了。
ext.ext_en: I don't ride my motorbike much anymore...

ext.ext_cn: 我无法再相信他。
ext.ext_en: I couldn't trust him anymore...

defs.def_en: If something does not happen or is not true anymore, it has stopped happening or is no longer true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有污点的；有瑕疵的；有疤痕的

ext.ext_cn: 适用于油性受损肤质的爽肤水
ext.ext_en: ...a skin tonic for oily, blemished complexions.

defs.def_en: You use blemished to describe something such as someone's skin or a piece of fruit when its appearance is spoiled by small marks.

ext.ext_cn: 他们正计划转移仍滞留在该国的70名美国官员。
ext.ext_en: They were planning to evacuate the seventy American officials still in the country...

ext.ext_cn: 自1951年以来，已有18, 000人撤离了该地区。
ext.ext_en: Since 1951, 18,000 people have been evacuated from the area.

defs.def_en: To evacuate someone means to send them to a place of safety, away from a dangerous building, town, or area.

defs.def_cn: （尤指因为危险而）撤离，撤出，搬出

ext.ext_cn: 大火正威胁着大约60户人家，居民已经从该地区撤离。
ext.ext_en: The fire is threatening about sixty homes, and residents have evacuated the area...

ext.ext_cn: 官员命令居民撤离。
ext.ext_en: Officials ordered the residents to evacuate.

defs.def_en: If people evacuate a place, they move out of it for a period of time, especially because it is dangerous.

defs.def_cn: 黄体荷尔蒙；黄体酮；孕酮

ext.ext_cn: 如果卵细胞没有受精，雌激素和黄体荷尔蒙就会下降。
ext.ext_en: If the egg is not fertilised oestrogen and progesterone decrease.

defs.def_en: Progesterone is a hormone that is produced in the ovaries of women and female animals and helps prepare the body for pregnancy.
Gout is a disease which causes people's joints to swell painfully, especially in their toes.
On a computer screen, a scroll bar is a long thin box along one edge of a window, which you click on with the mouse to move the text up, down, or across the window.

ext.ext_cn: 南安普敦大学的一位法学讲师
ext.ext_en: ...a lecturer in law at Southampton University.

defs.def_en: A lecturer is a teacher at a university or college.

ext.ext_cn: 很多大楼都被装扮一新。
ext.ext_en: Many buildings have been spruced up...

ext.ext_cn: 到了晚上，我们稍微收拾打扮了一番，然后出去吃晚餐。
ext.ext_en: In the evening we spruced ourselves up a bit and went out for dinner.

defs.def_en: If something is spruced up, its appearance is improved. If someone is spruced up, they have made themselves look very smart.

ext.ext_cn: 该联合会成了美国业余击剑运动的管理机构。
ext.ext_en: The league became the governing body for amateur fencing in the U.S.

defs.def_en: A governing body or organization is one which controls a particular activity.

defs.def_cn: 口才,辩才（美国英语中亦作the gift of gab）

ext.ext_cn: 他们天生就是能说会道的推销能手。
ext.ext_en: They are naturally good salesmen with the gift of the gab.

defs.def_en: If someone has the gift of the gab, they are able to speak easily and confidently, and to persuade people. Also the gift of gab, mainly in American English.
The space age is the present period in the history of the world, when travel in space has become possible.

defs.def_cn: 太空时代的;非常现代的

ext.ext_cn: 用钢筋和玻璃建造的非常现代化的塔楼
ext.ext_en: ...a space-age tower of steel and glass.

defs.def_en: You use space-age to describe something that is very modern and makes you think of the technology of the space age.

defs.def_cn: （通常指在酒馆吃的，包括面包、乳酪、色拉和泡菜的）农夫午餐
defs.def_en: A ploughman's lunch or a ploughman's is a meal consisting of bread, cheese, salad, and pickle, usually eaten in a pub.

ext.ext_cn: 他们倚仗坦克和重型火炮占领了这个镇。
ext.ext_en: Using tanks and heavy artillery, they seized the town.

ext.ext_cn: 炮火声
ext.ext_en: ...the sound of artillery fire.

defs.def_en: Artillery consists of large, powerful guns which are transported on wheels and used by an army.

ext.ext_cn: 有段时间他离开了炮兵部队去指挥一支雷达小分队。
ext.ext_en: At some stage he left the Artillery to command a radar unit.

defs.def_en: The artillery is the section of an army which is trained to use large, powerful guns.

ext.ext_cn: 警察把两个敌对阵营的抗议人群隔离开来。
ext.ext_en: Police segregated the two rival camps of protesters...

ext.ext_cn: 他们把你与社团的其他成员隔离开。
ext.ext_en: They segregate you from the rest of the community.

defs.def_en: To segregate two groups of people or things means to keep them physically apart from each other.

ext.ext_cn: 每个村庄都有一片绿地、一座教堂、一间酒馆和一座庄园宅第。
ext.ext_en: Every village has a green, a church, a pub and a manor house...

ext.ext_cn: 记下你的每一笔花销。
ext.ext_en: Record every expenditure you make.

defs.def_en: You use every to indicate that you are referring to all the members of a group or all the parts of something and not only some of them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们每天都得参加会议。
ext.ext_en: We were made to attend meetings every day...

ext.ext_cn: 伦敦每3分钟就会发生一起入室抢劫案。
ext.ext_en: A burglary occurs every three minutes in London...

defs.def_en: You use every in order to say how often something happens or to indicate that something happens at regular intervals.

ext.ext_cn: 每3个英国人中就有两个已经有了录像机。
ext.ext_en: Two out of every three Britons already own a video recorder...

ext.ext_cn: 大约每20个人中有1个患有临床抑郁症。
ext.ext_en: About one in every 20 people have clinical depression...

defs.def_en: You use every in front of a number when you are saying what proportion of people or things something happens to or applies to.

defs.def_cn: （用于名词前表示强调）充足的，完全的

ext.ext_cn: 国会预算办公室说有种种的迹象表明联邦赤字正在增加。
ext.ext_en: The Congressional Budget Office says the federal deficit shows every sign of getting larger...

ext.ext_cn: 我想你取得成功的机会很大。
ext.ext_en: I think that there is every chance that you will succeed...

defs.def_en: You can use every before some nouns, for example 'sign', 'effort', 'reason', and 'intention' in order to emphasize what you are saying.

defs.def_cn: （幻想、愿望、欲望等）所有的，全部的

ext.ext_cn: 几十个仆人迎合他所有稀奇古怪的念头。
ext.ext_en: Dozens of servants had catered to his every whim.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's every whim, wish, or desire will be satisfied, you are emphasizing that everything they want will happen or be provided.

ext.ext_cn: 不时搅动面糊，防止其成分散开。
ext.ext_en: Stir the batter every now and then to keep it from separating...

ext.ext_cn: 不时检查那匹马的心脏和肺。
ext.ext_en: Every so often the horse's heart and lungs are checked.

defs.def_en: You use every in the expressions every now and then ,every now and again ,every once in a while, and every so often in order to indicate that something happens occasionally.

ext.ext_cn: 我隔周回一趟家。
ext.ext_en: I went home every other week...

ext.ext_cn: 自从我得了流感以来，这段时间一直在下雪，大约每三天一场。
ext.ext_en: It has been snowing, roughly every third day, for as long as I've had the flu.

defs.def_en: If something happens every other day or every second day, for example, it happens one day, then does not happen the next day, then happens the day after that, and so on. You can also say that something happens every third week ,every fourth year, and so on.
A circular saw is a round metal disk with a sharp edge which is used for cutting wood and other materials.

defs.def_cn: (用于除12之外的、以2结尾的数字后构成序数词)

ext.ext_cn: 二月22号
ext.ext_en: ...22nd February.

ext.ext_cn: 第二版
ext.ext_en: ...2nd edition.

defs.def_en: -nd is added to written numbers ending in 2, except for numbers ending in 12, in order to form ordinal numbers.
A cleaning lady is a woman who is employed to clean the rooms and furniture inside a building.

ext.ext_cn: 这些事件是两国一系列争端中最近发生的几起。
ext.ext_en: These incidents were the latest in a series of disputes between the two nations...

ext.ext_cn: 已有 26 人在一起恶性枪击事件中被打死。
ext.ext_en: 26 people have been killed in a dramatic shooting incident...

defs.def_en: An incident is something that happens, often something that is unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 《哈姆雷特》明星荟萃的演员阵容
ext.ext_en: ...a star-studded production of Hamlet...

ext.ext_cn: 该影片昨晚举办了明星云集的首映式。
ext.ext_en: The film opened with a star-studded premiere last night.

defs.def_en: A star-studded show, event, or cast is one that includes a large number of famous performers.

ext.ext_cn: 灯芯绒夹克
ext.ext_en: ...a corduroy jacket.

defs.def_en: Corduroy is thick cotton cloth with parallel raised lines on the outside.
Corduroys are trousers made out of corduroy.

ext.ext_cn: 鸟儿回到巢里继续孵卵。
ext.ext_en: The birds returned to their nests and continued to incubate the eggs.

defs.def_en: When birds incubate their eggs, they keep the eggs warm until the baby birds come out.

ext.ext_cn: 病毒在初次感染以后可以潜伏长达 10 天。
ext.ext_en: The virus can incubate for up to ten days after the initial infection.

defs.def_en: When a germ in your body incubates or is incubated, it develops for a period of time before it starts making you feel ill.

ext.ext_cn: 无疑已在他头脑中酝酿了多年的重大决定
ext.ext_en: ...the fateful decision which had doubtless been incubating in his mind for years.

defs.def_en: If you say that plans or ideas incubate, you mean that they develop slowly after a lot of thought or discussion.

defs.def_cn: (通常因做错事而)使无资格，取消…的资格

ext.ext_cn: 他被判犯有贪污罪，以后7年里将无资格担任公职。
ext.ext_en: He was convicted of corruption, and will be disqualified from office for seven years...

ext.ext_cn: 负责人商议之后，最终决定取消我们的资格。
ext.ext_en: The stewards conferred and eventually decided to disqualify us.

defs.def_en: When someone is disqualified, they are officially stopped from taking part in a particular event, activity, or competition, usually because they have done something wrong.

defs.def_cn: (通常带朗姆酒味的)圆形巧克力软糖
defs.def_en: A truffle is a soft round sweet made with chocolate and usually flavoured with rum.
A truffle is a round type of fungus which is expensive and considered very good to eat.
A requiem or a requiem mass is a Catholic church service in memory of someone who has recently died.

ext.ext_cn: 威尔第的《安魂曲》演奏
ext.ext_en: ...a performance of Verdi's Requiem.

defs.def_en: A requiem is a piece of music for singers and musicians that can be performed either as part of a requiem mass or as part of a concert.

defs.def_cn: 麻腮风三联疫苗(指儿童注射的预防麻疹、腮腺炎、风疹的疫苗)

ext.ext_cn: 麻腮风三联疫苗
ext.ext_en: ...the MMR vaccine.

defs.def_en: MMR is a vaccine that is given to young children to protect them against certain diseases. MMR is an abbreviation for (缩略 =) measles, mumps, and rubella .
A jailer is a person who is in charge of a jail and the prisoners in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 精英管理的;贤能统治的

ext.ext_cn: 更加重视人才的社会
ext.ext_en: ...a more meritocratic society.

defs.def_en: A meritocratic society or social system gives people status or rewards because of what they achieve, rather than because of their wealth or social position.

ext.ext_en: He trained in neurology at the National Hospital for Nervous Diseases.

defs.def_en: Neurology is the study of the structure, function, and diseases of the nervous system.

ext.ext_en: ...expensive Italian knitwear.

defs.def_en: Knitwear is clothing that has been knitted.

ext.ext_en: He was bareheaded in the rain...

ext.ext_cn: 我没戴帽子骑车。
ext.ext_en: I rode bareheaded...

defs.def_en: Someone who is bareheaded is not wearing a hat or any other covering on their head.
The Near East is the same as the Middle East .

ext.ext_cn: 宇航员皮埃尔·索特想要把这个长15英尺的机械手安到人造卫星上。
ext.ext_en: Astronaut Pierre Thuot tried to latch the 15-foot robotic arm onto the satellite.

defs.def_en: Robotic equipment can perform certain tasks automatically.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 像机器人的;机械呆板的

ext.ext_cn: 他有点呆板。
ext.ext_en: There is something a little robotic about him.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as robotic, you mean that they speak or move in a stiff and mechanical way like a robot.

ext.ext_cn: 他是个不惜利用他人成就作踏脚石的人。
ext.ext_en: He was a man who traded on the achievements of others.

defs.def_en: If someone trades on something, they make use of it for their own advantage, often in an unfair way.

defs.def_cn: 转寄，转发,转达(尤指文件)

ext.ext_cn: 我们整理了海外各部门的报告然后再将其转发给雅典的总部。
ext.ext_en: We coordinate the reports from the overseas divisions, and send them on to headquarters in Athens.

defs.def_en: If you send on something you have received, especially a document, you send it to another place or person.

ext.ext_en: ...a room newly done out in country-house style.

defs.def_en: If a room or building is done out in a particular way, it is decorated and furnished in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 动物每次进食后都会排粪。
ext.ext_en: Animals defecate after every meal.

defs.def_en: When people and animals defecate, they get rid of waste matter from their body through their anus.

defs.def_en: A swiss roll is a cylindrical cake made from a thin flat sponge which is covered with jam or cream on one side, then rolled up.

ext.ext_cn: 他们计划让它作为一个独立公司重新上市。
ext.ext_en: They plan to relaunch it as a stand-alone company.

defs.def_en: A stand-alone business or organization is independent and does not receive financial support from another organization.

ext.ext_cn: 能在网络和单机上运行的操作系统
ext.ext_en: ...an operating system that can work on networks and stand-alone machines.

defs.def_en: A stand-alone computer is one that can operate on its own and does not have to be part of a network.
Colitis is an illness in which your colon becomes inflamed.

ext.ext_cn: 管理才能
ext.ext_en: ...managerial competency.

defs.def_en: Competency means the same as competence .

ext.ext_cn: 他几乎买不起火车票。
ext.ext_en: He could barely afford the railway fare.

ext.ext_cn: 打车费
ext.ext_en: ...taxi fares.

defs.def_en: A fare is the money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi.

defs.def_cn: (饭店或咖啡店的)餐点，饮食，饭菜

ext.ext_cn: 自从休主厨以来，伙食大为改进。
ext.ext_en: The fare has much improved since Hugh has taken charge of the kitchen.

ext.ext_cn: 盛放在传统餐具中的葡萄牙传统馔食
ext.ext_en: ...traditional Portuguese fare in a traditional setting.

defs.def_en: The fare at a restaurant or caff is the type of food that is served there.

ext.ext_en: Some later expeditions fared better, though they were no better equipped.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something fares well or badly, you are referring to the degree of success they achieve in a particular situation or activity.

ext.ext_cn: 矿工们被迫在如此恶劣的条件下工作,她感到异常愤怒。
ext.ext_en: She was filled with indignation at the conditions under which miners were forced to work...

ext.ext_cn: 难怪他几乎抑制不住自己的愤怒。
ext.ext_en: No wonder he could hardly contain his indignation.

defs.def_en: Indignation is the feeling of shock and anger which you have when you think that something is unjust or unfair.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 粗陋难看的建筑
ext.ext_en: ...a clunky piece of architecture.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as clunky, you mean that it is solid, heavy, and rather awkward.

ext.ext_cn: 死亡人数和失业人数之间的关系
ext.ext_en: ...the relationships between mortality and unemployment...

ext.ext_cn: 该国的婴儿死亡率已降至历史最低水平。
ext.ext_en: The nation's infant mortality rate has reached a record low.

defs.def_en: The mortality in a particular place or situation is the number of people who die.

ext.ext_cn: 留意特价。
ext.ext_en: Look out for special deals...

ext.ext_cn: 有哪些症状需要注意？
ext.ext_en: What are the symptoms to look out for?

defs.def_en: If you look out for something, you pay attention to things so that you notice it if or when it occurs.

ext.ext_cn: 我只是想要为你着想。
ext.ext_en: I'm just trying to look out for you...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得必须为自己考虑一下了，因为我看不出还有谁会替我考虑。
ext.ext_en: I felt that I had to look out for myself, because I didn't see that anyone else was going to.

defs.def_en: If you look out for someone, you make sure that they have all the advantages that they can.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 腐败的;贪污的;受贿的;营私舞弊的

ext.ext_cn: 从两个政党的腐败政客手中挽救这个国家
ext.ext_en: ...to save the nation from corrupt politicians of both parties...

ext.ext_cn: 腐败的警察
ext.ext_en: ...corrupt police officers...

defs.def_en: Someone who is corrupt behaves in a way that is morally wrong, especially by doing dishonest or illegal things in return for money or power.

ext.ext_cn: 看到一个人因为追逐金钱和权力而如此腐化真是悲哀。
ext.ext_en: It is sad to see a man so corrupted by the desire for money and power.

defs.def_en: If someone is corrupted by something, it causes them to become dishonest and unjust and unable to be trusted.

ext.ext_cn: 警告说电视将会使我们所有人堕落
ext.ext_en: ...warning that television will corrupt us all...

ext.ext_cn: 残暴行为会使人堕落、道德败坏。
ext.ext_en: Cruelty depraves and corrupts.

defs.def_en: To corrupt someone means to cause them to stop caring about moral standards.

ext.ext_cn: 有些比较优美的字体经过价廉、通用的电脑打印机处理后就面目全非了。
ext.ext_en: Some of the finer typefaces are corrupted by cheap, popular computer printers...

ext.ext_cn: 他们可以确保传统烹饪不会被商业运营模式完全破坏。
ext.ext_en: They can ensure that traditional cuisines are not totally corrupted by commercial practices.

defs.def_en: If something is corrupted, it becomes damaged or spoiled in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 哦，对不起，我不是故意踩你脚的。
ext.ext_en: Oh, sorry, I didn't mean to tread on your foot...

ext.ext_cn: 我在地板上铺了白色小地毯，但大家都不敢往上踩，以免在上面留下脚印。
ext.ext_en: I had white rugs on the floor, but people were scared to tread on them in case they marked.

defs.def_en: If you tread on something, you put your foot on it when you are walking or standing.

ext.ext_cn: 她信步而行，享受着湿漉漉的草地触及双脚的感觉。
ext.ext_en: She trod casually, enjoying the touch of the damp grass on her feet.

defs.def_en: If you tread in a particular way, you walk that way.

ext.ext_cn: 我们现在可以非常清楚地听到他们沉重的脚步声。
ext.ext_en: We could now very plainly hear their heavy tread.

defs.def_en: A person's tread is the sound that they make with their feet as they walk.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你希望建立新的关系，首先要慎重行事，不要着急。
ext.ext_en: If you are hoping to form a new relationship tread carefully and slowly to begin with...

ext.ext_cn: 这种事情需要谨慎行事有 3 个原因。
ext.ext_en: There are three reasons for treading warily in such matters.

defs.def_en: If you tread carefully, you behave in a careful or cautious way.

ext.ext_cn: 他走上楼梯。梯面上铺了一种橡胶，因此没有什么声响。
ext.ext_en: He walked up the stairs. The treads were covered with a kind of rubber and very quiet.

defs.def_en: The tread of a step or stair is its flat upper surface.

ext.ext_cn: 这种宽大的轮胎有很深的胎面花纹。
ext.ext_en: The fat, broad tyres had a good depth of tread.

defs.def_en: The tread of a tyre or shoe is the pattern of thin lines cut into its surface that stops it slipping.

defs.def_cn: 走钢丝般行事;小心地把握分寸

ext.ext_cn: 他们既要让孩子们了解情况，又不能让他们产生厌烦情绪，不得不小心把握分寸。
ext.ext_en: They have to tread the delicate path between informing children and boring them...

ext.ext_cn: 因此，总统在向议会演讲时将不得不仔细拿捏分寸。
ext.ext_en: The President will therefore have to tread a very fine line when he addresses the parliament.

defs.def_en: If someone is treading a fine line or path, they are acting carefully because they have to avoid making a serious mistake, especially in a situation where they have to deal with two opposing demands.

ext.ext_cn: 他还是不按传统方式行事。
ext.ext_en: He continues to tread an unconventional path...

ext.ext_cn: 在风格上，韦勒与伦尼·克拉维茨走着相似的路子。
ext.ext_en: Stylistically, Weller is treading a similar path to that of Lenny Kravitz.

defs.def_en: If you tread a particular path, you take a particular course of action or do something in a particular way.
If someone who is in deep water treads water, they float in an upright position by moving their legs slightly.

ext.ext_cn: 我要么原地踏步直到获得晋升(这看来得是几年以后的事了)，要么改变现在正做的事情。
ext.ext_en: I could either tread water until I was promoted, which looked to be a few years away, or I could change what I was doing.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is treading water, you mean that they are in an unsatisfactory situation where they are not progressing, but are just continuing doing the same things.

ext.ext_cn: 她和丹尼一会儿要来坐坐。
ext.ext_en: She and Danny will drop by later...

ext.ext_cn: 今天早晨他到我办公室串门来了。
ext.ext_en: He dropped by my office this morning.

defs.def_en: If you drop by, you visit someone informally.

defs.def_cn: 经验主义的;以经验为依据的

ext.ext_en: There is no empirical evidence to support his thesis.

defs.def_en: Empirical evidence or study relies on practical experience rather than theories.

ext.ext_cn: 他们向人们强行灌输放弃所有钱财的思想。
ext.ext_en: They brainwash people into giving up all their money...

ext.ext_cn: 我被洗了脑，认为自己一文不值。
ext.ext_en: I'd been brainwashed into believing I was worthless...

defs.def_en: If you brainwash someone, you force them to believe something by continually telling them that it is true, and preventing them from thinking about it properly.

defs.def_cn: 刺激(某人)对…的欲望;激发（某人）对…的兴趣

ext.ext_cn: 一份真正好的商品目录也可以激起顾客购买的欲望。
ext.ext_en: A really good catalogue can also whet customers' appetites for merchandise.

ext.ext_cn: 他希望能激发学生们的兴趣，保持他们的热情的讲座
ext.ext_en: ...lectures he hopes might whet the appetite and keep students' enthusiasm.

defs.def_en: If someone or something whets your appetite for a particular thing, they increase your desire to have it or know about it, especially by giving you an idea of what it is like.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 怪异的;反复无常的;不切实际的

ext.ext_en: McGrath remembers his offbeat sense of humor, his whimsical side...

ext.ext_en: His graphic art became slighter and more whimsical.

defs.def_en: A whimsical person or idea is unusual, playful, and unpredictable, rather than serious and practical.

ext.ext_cn: 这个监狱的犯人被关在他们的囚室里。
ext.ext_en: The prison's inmates are being kept in their cells...

ext.ext_cn: 他被判处终身监禁。
ext.ext_en: He was sentenced to life in prison...

defs.def_en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

ext.ext_cn: 吸烟与疾病的联系
ext.ext_en: ...the correlation between smoking and disease.

defs.def_en: A correlation between things is a connection or link between them.

ext.ext_cn: 建筑工人已经盖好了房顶。
ext.ext_en: The builders have finished the roof.

defs.def_en: A builder is a person whose job is to build or repair houses and other buildings.

defs.def_cn: 按时去教堂做礼拜的人
defs.def_en: A churchgoer is a person who goes to church regularly.

ext.ext_en: The commission remains so weak that it will continue to avoid confrontation with governments.

defs.def_en: A confrontation is a dispute, fight, or battle between two groups of people.

ext.ext_cn: 联合国一直都在与美国国务院合作推进一项计划，寻找愿意接纳难民的国家。
ext.ext_en: The UN had been co-operating with the State Department on a plan to find countries willing to take the refugees...

ext.ext_en: The couple spoke about how they would co-operate in the raising of their child...

defs.def_en: If you co-operate with someone, you work with them or help them for a particular purpose. You can also say that two people co-operate .

ext.ext_cn: 他同意配合警方的调查。
ext.ext_en: He agreed to co-operate with the police investigation...

ext.ext_cn: 因为士兵们不肯合作，这项计划宣告失败。
ext.ext_en: The plan failed because the soldiers refused to co-operate.

defs.def_en: If you co-operate, you do what someone has asked or told you to do.

ext.ext_cn: 这颗彗星的轨道与地球的轨道交叉。

ext.ext_en: The circles will intersect in two places...

ext.ext_en: ...the ways in which historical events intersect with individual lives...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的历史相互交叉。
ext.ext_en: Their histories intersect.

defs.def_en: If one thing intersects with another or if two things intersect, the two things have a connection at a particular point.

ext.ext_cn: 该城市由 3 条主要水路贯穿。

defs.def_en: If a place, area, or surface is intersected by things such as roads or lines, they cross it.

ext.ext_en: As they guffawed loudly, the ticket collector arrived...

ext.ext_en: 'Ha, ha,' everyone guffawed. 'It's one of Viv's shock tactics.'

defs.def_en: To guffaw means to laugh loudly.

defs.def_cn: （国家或地区）不发达的，欠发达的，经济落后的

ext.ext_en: ...public-health problems in the underdeveloped world.

defs.def_en: An underdeveloped country or region does not have modern industries and usually has a low standard of living. Some people dislike this term and prefer to use developing.

defs.def_cn: 使极为兴奋;使激动不已;使震惊

ext.ext_cn: 世人为他的勇气和反抗精神震惊不已。
ext.ext_en: The world was electrified by his courage and resistance.

defs.def_en: If people are electrified by an event or experience, it makes them feel very excited and surprised.

ext.ext_en: The west-coast line was electrified as long ago as 1974.

ext.ext_en: ...the electrified section of the Lancashire and Yorkshire Railway.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is presumably the case, you mean that you think it is very likely to be the case, although you are not certain.

ext.ext_en: ...tree-planting and other conservation projects.

defs.def_en: Conservation is saving and protecting the environment.

ext.ext_en: Then he began his most famous work, the conservation and rebinding of the Book of Kells...

defs.def_en: Conservation is saving and protecting historical objects or works of art such as paintings, sculptures, or buildings.

ext.ext_en: ...projects aimed at promoting energy conservation.

ext.ext_cn: 有关保护渔业资源的规定
ext.ext_en: ...rules concerning the conservation of fishery resources.

defs.def_en: The conservation of a supply of something is the careful use of it so that it lasts for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 石柱柱廊
ext.ext_en: ...a colonnade with stone pillars.

defs.def_en: A colonnade is a row of evenly spaced columns.

defs.def_cn: （不愉快的事）萦绕在心头，缠绕

ext.ext_en: The decision to leave her children now haunts her...

ext.ext_en: The stigma of being a bankrupt is likely to haunt him for the rest of his life.

defs.def_en: A place that is the haunt of a particular person is one which they often visit because they enjoy going there.

ext.ext_en: His ghost is said to haunt some of the rooms, banging a toy drum.

defs.def_en: A ghost or spirit that haunts a place or a person regularly appears in the place, or is seen by the person and frightens them.

ext.ext_en: Train doors have handles on the inside. They are stiff so that they cannot be opened accidentally.

defs.def_en: Something such as a door or drawer that is stiff does not move as easily as it should.

ext.ext_en: ...a stiff whisky.
