ext.ext_en: A national poll shows the presidential race in a dead heat.

defs.def_en: If a race or contest is a dead heat, two or more competitors are joint winners, or are both winning at a particular moment in the race or contest. In American English, you can say that a race or contest is in a dead heat .

ext.ext_cn: 美国对外援助的最大受惠者
ext.ext_en: ...the largest recipient of American foreign aid...

ext.ext_cn: 接受器官移植的病人免疫系统受到抑制后很可能会感染其他疾病。
ext.ext_en: A suppressed immune system puts a transplant recipient at risk of other infections.

defs.def_en: The recipient of something is the person who receives it.

defs.def_cn: 婉转曲折的表达法;迂回表达

ext.ext_cn: 总是在你最想得到一个直截了当的回答时，格林菲尔德却要绕上十八个弯。
ext.ext_en: It was always when you most wanted a direct answer that Greenfield came up with a circumlocution.

defs.def_en: A circumlocution is a way of saying or writing something using more words than are necessary instead of being clear and direct.

ext.ext_cn: 他出了本短篇小说集。
ext.ext_en: He published a collection of short stories.

defs.def_en: A short story is a written story about imaginary events that is only a few pages long.

ext.ext_cn: 显然，他完全没有想到人们的情绪会是如此。
ext.ext_en: It's clear that he has badly miscalculated the mood of the people...

ext.ext_cn: 政府好像计算失误，结果导致支出有所增加。
ext.ext_en: The government appears to have miscalculated and bills are higher as a result.

defs.def_en: If you miscalculate, you make a mistake in judging a situation or in making a calculation.
An octave is a series of eight notes in a musical scale. It is also used to talk about the difference in pitch between the first and last notes in a musical scale.
Eurocrats are the civil servants and other people who work in the administration of the European Union.

defs.def_cn: 软贷款(指利率极低的贷款，通常借贷给发展中国家或其企业)
defs.def_en: A soft loan is a loan with a very low interest rate. Soft loans are usually made to developing countries or to businesses in developing countries.

defs.def_cn: 坚持;坚决认为(或主张、要求)

ext.ext_cn: 家里人坚持认为我不应让步,而应该留下来继续抗争。
ext.ext_en: My family insisted that I should not give in, but stay and fight...

ext.ext_cn: 她坚持所有采访自己都要在场。
ext.ext_en: She insisted on being present at all the interviews...

defs.def_en: If you insist that something should be done, you say so very firmly and refuse to give in about it. If you insist on something, you say firmly that it must be done or provided.

ext.ext_cn: 总统坚持说他如此做是出于同情而不是为了投机。
ext.ext_en: The president insisted that he was acting out of compassion, not opportunism...

ext.ext_cn: “并没有那么困难,”她坚持说。
ext.ext_en: 'It's not that difficult,' she insists...

defs.def_en: If you insist that something is the case, you say so very firmly and refuse to say otherwise, even though other people do not believe you.
A synod is a special council of members of a Church, which meets regularly to discuss religious issues.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 香烟很容易使人上瘾。
ext.ext_en: Cigarettes are highly addictive...

ext.ext_cn: 强效纯可卡因是市面上最容易让人上瘾的毒品。
ext.ext_en: Crack is the most addictive drug on the market.

defs.def_en: If a drug is addictive, people who take it cannot stop taking it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 制作视频电影能很快让人入迷。
ext.ext_en: Video movie-making can quickly become addictive.

defs.def_en: Something that is addictive is so enjoyable that it makes you want to do it or have it a lot.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我饮食没有规律，而且性格上容易沉迷某事。
ext.ext_en: I have an eating disorder and an addictive personality.

defs.def_en: If someone has an addictive personality, they easily become addicted to something.

ext.ext_cn: 他声称毒品是别人为了陷害他而故意放在那里的。
ext.ext_en: He claimed that the drugs had been planted to incriminate him...

ext.ext_cn: 他们害怕受牵连,一句话也不肯多说。
ext.ext_en: They are afraid of incriminating themselves and say no more than is necessary.

defs.def_en: If something incriminates you, it suggests that you are responsible for something bad, especially a crime.

ext.ext_cn: 一个成天乐呵呵、不停抽烟酗酒的人
ext.ext_en: ...a cheerful, boozy chain-smoker.

defs.def_en: A boozy person is someone who drinks a lot of alcohol.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (语言或动作）令人放心的，令人欣慰的

ext.ext_cn: 听到约翰熟悉的声音让人放心。
ext.ext_en: It was reassuring to hear John's familiar voice...

ext.ext_cn: 她告诉了我一些令我欣慰的消息。
ext.ext_en: She gave me some reassuring news.

defs.def_en: If you find some-one's words or actions reassuring, they make you feel less worried about something.

ext.ext_cn: 人造丝黑色印花连衣裙
ext.ext_en: ...a black viscose floral dress.

defs.def_en: Viscose is a smooth artificial fabric.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这种残忍地对待动物的行为是任何一个文明社会都不能容忍的。
ext.ext_en: This barbaric treatment of animals has no place in any decent society.

ext.ext_cn: 极为野蛮的暴行
ext.ext_en: ...a particularly barbaric act of violence.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour as barbaric, you strongly disapprove of it because you think that it is extremely cruel or uncivilized.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 外交官们认为繁文缛节造成的延迟是在所难免的。
ext.ext_en: Diplomats believe that bureaucratic delays are inevitable...

ext.ext_cn: 该部门的官僚作风非常严重。
ext.ext_en: The department has become a bureaucratic nightmare.

defs.def_en: Bureaucratic means involving complicated rules and procedures which can cause long delays.

ext.ext_cn: 建屋互助会处理投诉的方式
ext.ext_en: ...the way that building societies deal with complaints...

ext.ext_cn: 在对待有自杀倾向的青少年时，我们的目标应当很明确。
ext.ext_en: In dealing with suicidal youngsters, our aims should be clear...

defs.def_en: When you deal with something or someone that needs attention, you give your attention to them, and often solve a problem or make a decision concerning them.

defs.def_cn: 克制(不快情感);冷静面对(感情上困难的局面)

ext.ext_cn: 她去看了一位用催眠术帮她克服恐惧感的精神科医生。
ext.ext_en: She saw a psychiatrist who used hypnotism to help her deal with her fear...

ext.ext_cn: 他对自己不公正的被俘极为怨愤，正是这股怨愤使他得以熬过囚禁生涯。
ext.ext_en: He was able to deal with his captivity by maintaining a high degree of anger about the unfairness of his capture.

defs.def_en: If you deal with an unpleasant emotion or an emotionally difficult situation, you recognize it, and remain calm and in control of yourself in spite of it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的书中涉及当代巴黎的那些部分
ext.ext_en: ...the parts of his book which deal with contemporary Paris.

defs.def_en: If a book, speech, or film deals with a particular thing, it has that thing as its subject or is concerned with it.

defs.def_cn: 与…做买卖;和…有生意往来

ext.ext_cn: 在佛罗里达工作时，我总与英国人有生意往来。
ext.ext_en: When I worked in Florida I dealt with British people all the time...

ext.ext_cn: 要跟他这个人做生意很难。
ext.ext_en: He's a hard man to deal with.

defs.def_en: If you deal with a particular person or organization, you have business relations with them.

ext.ext_cn: 湛蓝的天空
ext.ext_en: ...an ultramarine sky.

defs.def_en: Ultramarine is used to describe things that are very bright blue in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 小偷晚上闯进了庄园。
ext.ext_en: Thieves broke into the manor at night.

ext.ext_cn: 萨福克郡海岸边的鲍德西庄园
ext.ext_en: ...Bawdsey Manor on the Suffolk coast.

defs.def_en: A manor is a large private house in the country, usually built in the Middle Ages, and also includes the land and smaller buildings around it.

ext.ext_cn: 警察局局长对侵入其辖区的行为深恶痛绝。
ext.ext_en: The Chief Constable deeply resented any intrusions into his manor...

ext.ext_cn: 谢天谢地，他们再也不在我的辖区里了。
ext.ext_en: Thank God they're not on my manor any more.

defs.def_en: Some people, especially police officers, refer to the area where they work as their manor .

defs.def_cn: 秒(a second 或 seconds 往往用以表示很短的时间)

ext.ext_cn: 有几秒钟大家都沉默无语。
ext.ext_en: For a few seconds nobody said anything...

ext.ext_cn: 只需40秒。
ext.ext_en: It only takes forty seconds...

defs.def_en: A second is one of the sixty parts that a minute is divided into. People often say 'a second' or 'seconds' when they simply mean a very short time.

ext.ext_cn: 他到访德里的第二天
ext.ext_en: ...the second day of his visit to Delhi.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的第二个孩子
ext.ext_en: ...their second child...

defs.def_en: The second item in a series is the one that you count as number two.

defs.def_cn: (用于形容词最高级前)第二…的

ext.ext_cn: 该党仍是意大利的第二大党。
ext.ext_en: The party is still the second strongest in Italy.

ext.ext_cn: 美国第二大城市
ext.ext_en: ...the second-largest city in the United States.

defs.def_en: Second is used before superlative adjectives to indicate that there is only one thing better or larger than the thing you are referring to.

ext.ext_cn: 土壤首先是被种植其中的作物消耗掉，其次受自然风化和细菌活动的侵蚀。
ext.ext_en: The soil is depleted first by having crops grown in it and second by natural weathering and bacterial action.

defs.def_en: You say second when you want to make a second point or give a second reason for something.

defs.def_cn: 二级甲等/乙等优秀学位

ext.ext_cn: 后来，我考上了兰开斯特大学，获得了二级甲等学位。
ext.ext_en: I then went up to Lancaster University and got an upper second.

defs.def_en: In Britain, an upper second is a good honours degree and a lower second is an average honours degree.

ext.ext_cn: 如果需要的话可以添菜。
ext.ext_en: There's seconds if you want them.

defs.def_en: If you have seconds, you have a second helping of food.

defs.def_cn: 二级品;二等货;次货;等外品

ext.ext_cn: 这是家新开的商店，出售打折商品和等外品。
ext.ext_en: It's a new shop selling discounted lines and seconds.

defs.def_en: Seconds are goods that are sold cheaply in shops because they have slight faults.

defs.def_cn: (拳击或国际象棋锦标赛的)副手，助手

ext.ext_cn: 他对助手们喊道：“我赢了！我赢了!”
ext.ext_en: He shouted to his seconds, 'I did it! I did it!'

defs.def_en: The seconds of someone who is taking part in a boxing match or chess tournament are the people who assist and encourage them.

ext.ext_cn: 赞同反对猎狐动议的布赖恩·萨顿
ext.ext_en: ...Bryan Sutton, who seconded the motion against fox hunting...

ext.ext_cn: 你的申请必须由现任成员推荐并得到他们的支持。
ext.ext_en: Your application must be proposed and seconded by current members.

defs.def_en: If you second a proposal in a meeting or debate, you formally express your agreement with it so that it can then be discussed or voted on.

ext.ext_cn: 上周首相在一次演讲中对严肃纪律的号召表示支持。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister seconded the call for discipline in a speech last week.

defs.def_en: If you second what someone has said, you say that you agree with them or say the same thing yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 他们中的大多数人只是听说了那次大屠杀。
ext.ext_en: Most of them had only heard of the massacre at second hand.

defs.def_en: See also:second-hand;If you experience something at second hand, you are told about it by other people rather than experiencing it yourself.

defs.def_cn: 不比任何事物差;首屈一指

ext.ext_cn: 我们的科学研究是顶尖的。
ext.ext_en: Our scientific research is second to none.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is second to none, you are emphasizing that it is very good indeed or the best that there is.

ext.ext_cn: 肝炎是仅次于吸烟的主要健康隐患。
ext.ext_en: As a major health risk hepatitis is second only to tobacco.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is second only to something else, you mean that only that thing is better or greater than it.

ext.ext_cn: 1937 年他被临时调往渥太华的加拿大皇家空军担任军备顾问。
ext.ext_en: In 1937 he was seconded to the Royal Canadian Air Force in Ottawa as air armament adviser...

ext.ext_cn: 数百名士兵被临时派去帮助农民。
ext.ext_en: Several hundred soldiers have been seconded to help farmers.

defs.def_en: If you are seconded somewhere, you are sent there temporarily by your employer in order to do special duties.
A lasso is a long rope with a loop at one end, used especially by cowboys for catching cattle.

ext.ext_cn: 牛仔们有的赶着大篷车，有的骑着马，抛套索捕牛。
ext.ext_en: Cowboys drove covered wagons and rode horses, lassoing cattle.

defs.def_en: If you lasso an animal, you catch it by throwing a lasso round its neck and pulling it tight.

ext.ext_cn: 我们正在下山。
ext.ext_en: We're going down a mountain...

ext.ext_cn: 一名男子下楼来迎接他们。
ext.ext_en: A man came down the stairs to meet them...

defs.def_en: To go down something such as a slope or a pipe means to go towards the ground or to a lower level.

ext.ext_cn: 他设法紧紧地攀在了距岩壁顶端 40 英尺的岩礁上。
ext.ext_en: He managed to cling on to a ledge 40ft down the rock face...

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚工会领袖在 400 码深的矿井下举行了彻夜的抗议活动。
ext.ext_en: The union leader was last night staging a protest vigil 400 yards down a mineshaft.

defs.def_en: If you are a particular distance down something, you are that distance below the top or surface of it.

ext.ext_cn: 她仍低头看着文件。
ext.ext_en: She was still looking down at her papers...

ext.ext_cn: 她低下头，双手掩面。
ext.ext_en: She put her head down, her hands over her face...

defs.def_en: You use down to say that you are looking or facing in a direction that is towards the ground or towards a lower level.

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼放下了玻璃杯。
ext.ext_en: Danny put down his glass...

ext.ext_cn: 响了两声后，我放下了电话。
ext.ext_en: After two rings I put down the phone...

defs.def_en: If you put something down, you put it onto a surface.

ext.ext_cn: 他们开始沿着一条又一条的街道慢跑。
ext.ext_en: They set off at a jog up one street and down another...

ext.ext_cn: 卡尔朝街尾看了看。
ext.ext_en: Karl looked down the street...

defs.def_en: If you go or look down something such as a road or river, you go or look along it. If you are down a road or river, you are somewhere along it.

defs.def_cn: (尤指往南方或往地势低的地方)往，朝

ext.ext_cn: 我从西雅图一路南下到洛杉矶。
ext.ext_en: I went down to L.A. all the way from Seattle...

ext.ext_cn: 我看见他朝大约一英里以外的商店走去了。
ext.ext_en: I have seen him walking down to the shops a mile or so away...

defs.def_en: If you are travelling to a particular place, you can say that you are going down to that place, especially if you are going towards the south or to a lower level of land.

ext.ext_cn: 人们在酒吧，喝得烂醉。
ext.ext_en: People are down the pub, getting drunk...

ext.ext_cn: 我们上车前往超市，然后开始购买食物。
ext.ext_en: We got in the car and went down the supermarket and started buying food.

defs.def_en: If you are down a place, you are at that place. If you go down a place, you go to that place. Some people consider this to be non-standard.

ext.ext_cn: 今天利率下调了。
ext.ext_en: Interest rates came down today...

ext.ext_cn: 通货膨胀率将降到 3%。
ext.ext_en: Inflation will be down to three percent...

defs.def_en: If an amount of something goes down, it decreases. If an amount of something is down, it has decreased and is at a lower level than it was.

defs.def_cn: 已处理的及尚未完成的

ext.ext_cn: 过去了 13 个月，还有 24 年。
ext.ext_en: Thirteen months down, twenty-four years to go.

defs.def_en: If you say that there are a number of things down and a number to go, you are saying how many of the things have already been dealt with and how many remain to be dealt with.

ext.ext_cn: 我是名不折不扣的军人。
ext.ext_en: I was a soldier down to my shoelaces.

ext.ext_cn: 上至主席下至上茶女侍
ext.ext_en: ...from the chairman right down to the tea ladies.

defs.def_en: Down to a particular detail means including everything, even that detail. Down to a particular person means including everyone, even that person.

ext.ext_cn: 那个可怜的人身上只剩 3 英镑了。
ext.ext_en: The poor man's down to his last £3.

defs.def_en: If you are down to a certain amount of something, you have only that amount left.

ext.ext_cn: 任何过错全是我们造成的。
ext.ext_en: Any mistakes are entirely down to us...

ext.ext_cn: 那些全是凭辛苦的劳动得来的。
ext.ext_en: That's down to pure hard work.

defs.def_en: If a situation is down to a particular person or thing, it has been caused by that person or thing.

defs.def_cn: 已安排…的;要做…的;将发生…的

ext.ext_cn: 马克已告诉我他要参加一场面试。
ext.ext_en: Mark had told me that he was down for an interview.

ext.ext_cn: 将要拆除的废弃房屋
ext.ext_en: ...derelict houses that were down for demolition.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is down for a particular thing, it has been arranged that they will do that thing, or that thing will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 一位女职员得了流感。
ext.ext_en: One of the office girls was down with the flu.

ext.ext_cn: 在麻疹肆虐时染病的小女孩
ext.ext_en: ...a little girl down with that nasty bout of measles.

defs.def_en: See also:come down with;If you are down with an illness, you have that illness.

ext.ext_cn: 他付了 20% 的钱款。
ext.ext_en: He paid 20 percent down.

defs.def_en: See also:put down;If you pay money down on something, you pay part of the money you owe for it.

ext.ext_cn: 示威者高呼“打倒叛徒”。
ext.ext_en: Demonstrators chanted 'down with the rebels'.

defs.def_en: If people shout 'down with' something or someone, they are saying that they dislike them and want to get rid of them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沮丧的;闷闷不乐的;情绪低落的

ext.ext_cn: 自从受了伤以来我一直很沮丧。
ext.ext_en: I have been down since the injury happened...

ext.ext_cn: 当有人觉得情绪低落时，要努力相互打气。
ext.ext_en: Try to support each other when one of you is feeling down...

defs.def_en: If you are feeling down, you are feeling unhappy or depressed.

ext.ext_cn: 那个日期没有刊在我们的通讯简报上。
ext.ext_en: That date wasn't down on our news sheet.

defs.def_en: If something is down on paper, it has been written on the paper.

defs.def_cn: (尤指电脑)死机的，发生故障的

ext.ext_cn: 电脑又死机了。
ext.ext_en: The computer's down again.

defs.def_en: If a piece of equipment, especially a computer system, is down, it is temporarily not working because of a fault.

ext.ext_cn: 我们喝了好几瓶本地产的葡萄酒。
ext.ext_en: We downed bottles of local wine.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone downs food or a drink, you mean that they eat or drink it.

ext.ext_cn: 两架喷气式战斗机被击落。
ext.ext_en: Two jet fighters were downed...

ext.ext_cn: 一名银行警卫开枪击中了他的大腿，使他受伤倒地。
ext.ext_en: A bank guard shot him in the leg and downed him.

defs.def_en: If something or someone is downed, they fall to the ground because they have been hurt or damaged in some way.
to down tools see

ext.ext_cn: 鹅绒
ext.ext_en: ...goose down.

defs.def_en: Down consists of the small, soft feathers on young birds. Down is used to make bed-covers and pillows.

ext.ext_cn: 整株植物都覆盖着细茸毛。
ext.ext_en: The whole plant is covered with fine down.

defs.def_en: See also:downs;Down is very fine hair.

defs.def_cn: 违法活动；犯法活动；不法活动

ext.ext_cn: 公民抗命，不管是暴力还是非暴力的，都是故意犯法。
ext.ext_en: Civil disobedience, violent or non-violent, is intentional law breaking.

defs.def_en: Law-breaking is any kind of illegal activity.

ext.ext_cn: 一有机会就把春季卷心菜移种到地里。
ext.ext_en: Plant out the spring cabbage whenever opportunities arise.

defs.def_en: When you plant out young plants, you plant them in the ground in the place where they are to be left to grow.

ext.ext_cn: 这部小说是从这个女孩的视角来叙述的。
ext.ext_en: The novel is shown from the girl's viewpoint...

ext.ext_cn: 为了能包括尽可能多的观点，编辑保留对信件进行删节的权力。
ext.ext_en: To include as many viewpoints as possible, the editor reserves the right to shorten letters.

defs.def_en: Someone's viewpoint is the way that they think about things in general, or the way they think about a particular thing.

ext.ext_cn: 你得知道站在哪里观察角度比较理想。
ext.ext_en: You have to know where to stand for a good viewpoint.

defs.def_en: A viewpoint is a place from which you can get a good view of something.

defs.def_cn: （与副词组合，构成形容词）表示“有…装潢的”，“有…摆设的”

ext.ext_cn: 斯隆环顾了一下这间设备齐全的厨房。
ext.ext_en: Sloan looked round the well-appointed kitchen...

ext.ext_cn: 我们最后到了一间装潢雅致的起居室里。
ext.ext_en: We ended up in a tastefully-appointed sitting room.

defs.def_en: See also:self-appointed;-appointed combines with adverbs to form adjectives such as well-appointed that describe a building or room that is equipped or furnished in the way that is mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 他们鼓吹能颠覆英国社会结构的政治学说。
ext.ext_en: They propagated political doctrines which promised to tear apart the fabric of British society.

defs.def_en: If people propagate an idea or piece of information, they spread it and try to make people believe it or support it.

ext.ext_cn: 栽培葡萄最简便的方法就是硬条扦插。
ext.ext_en: The easiest way to propagate a vine is to take hardwood cuttings...

ext.ext_cn: 欧白头翁可以通过种子进行繁殖。
ext.ext_en: The pasque flower can be propagated from seed.

defs.def_en: If you propagate plants, you grow more of them from the original ones.

defs.def_cn: 将…收走；把…拿开；（尤指）收拾餐具

ext.ext_cn: 女服务生收拾走盘子，端来了咖啡。
ext.ext_en: The waitress had cleared away the plates and brought coffee...

ext.ext_cn: 塔妮娅做饭，上菜，还收拾了餐具。
ext.ext_en: Tania cooked, served, and cleared away.

defs.def_en: When you clear things away or clear away, you put away the things that you have been using, especially for eating or cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 我不能总是把她硬塞给朋友们。
ext.ext_en: I couldn't keep palming her off on friends...

ext.ext_cn: 约瑟夫确保自己从不会被骗买一些次等原料。
ext.ext_en: Joseph made sure that he was never palmed off with inferior stuff.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has palmed something off on you, you feel annoyed because they have made you accept it although it is not valuable or is not your responsibility.

defs.def_cn: 罪犯指证;列队辨认嫌犯
defs.def_en: At an identity parade, a witness to a crime tries to identify the criminal from among a line of people.

defs.def_cn: 阿嚏（尤用于书面语，表示打喷嚏的声音）
defs.def_en: Atishoo is used, especially in writing, to represent the sound that you make when you sneeze.
Genetics is the study of heredity and how qualities and characteristics are passed on from one generation to another by means of genes.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他的父亲不爱与人交往，却又是个成功的商人。
ext.ext_en: His father was a misanthropic but successful businessman.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their feelings as misanthropic, you mean that they do not like other people.

defs.def_cn: (穷人居住的)简陋的小屋，棚屋
defs.def_en: A shanty is a small rough hut which poor people live in, built from tin, cardboard, or other materials that are not very strong.

defs.def_cn: (过去水手劳动时唱的)船夫曲，水手号子,船歌

ext.ext_cn: 我父亲最喜爱的船夫曲之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of my father's favourite sea-shanties.

defs.def_en: A shanty is a song which sailors used to sing while they were doing work on a ship.

ext.ext_cn: 我很愿意提供它的一个副本。
ext.ext_en: I'll be glad to provide a copy of this...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不愿提供任何细节。
ext.ext_en: They would not provide any details...

defs.def_en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

ext.ext_cn: 条约规定，到本世纪末，美国必须撤除其基地。
ext.ext_en: The treaty provides that, by the end of the century, the United States must have removed its bases...

ext.ext_cn: 法令规定只有孩子的父母才有责任为孩子提供经济支持。
ext.ext_en: The Act provides that only the parents of a child have a responsibility for that child's financial support.

defs.def_en: If a law or agreement provides that something will happen, it states that it will happen.

defs.def_cn: (尤指专唱20世纪三四十年代感伤情歌的)男歌手
defs.def_en: A crooner is a male singer who sings sentimental songs, especially the love songs of the 1930s and 1940s.

defs.def_cn: （意大利）千层面（材料包括多层面条、酱汁和肉或乳酪做的馅，在烤炉里烤制而成）
defs.def_en: Lasagne is a food dish that consists of layers of pasta, sauce, and a filling such as meat or cheese, baked in an oven.

ext.ext_cn: 士兵们横冲直撞，洗劫商店并且开枪射击。
ext.ext_en: Soldiers went on a rampage, pillaging stores and shooting.

ext.ext_cn: 抢劫和强奸的胆子
ext.ext_en: ...the boldness to pillage and rape.

defs.def_en: If a group of people pillage a place, they steal property from it using violent methods.

defs.def_cn: (土地)犁过而未耕种的;(尤指)休耕的

ext.ext_cn: 在空荡荡的休耕田地上的巨大红色谷仓
ext.ext_en: ...great red barns in empty fallow fields...

ext.ext_cn: 田地待耕。
ext.ext_en: The fields lay fallow.

defs.def_en: Fallow land has been dug or ploughed but nothing has been planted in it, especially so that its quality or strength has a chance to improve.

defs.def_cn: (某段时期)无甚成就的，无作为的

ext.ext_cn: 接着在事业上无甚起色，直到夏季有了一份工作。
ext.ext_en: There followed something of a fallow period professionally, until a job came up in the summer.

defs.def_en: A fallow period is a time when very little is being achieved.

ext.ext_cn: 《迷情之夜》的快节奏版
ext.ext_en: ...an up-tempo arrangement of 'Some Enchanted Evening'.

defs.def_en: An up-tempo piece of music has a fast beat.

defs.def_cn: 儿童保育(设施);儿童看护(设施)

ext.ext_cn: 这对伴侣分担照看孩子的责任。
ext.ext_en: Both partners shared childcare...

ext.ext_cn: 在西欧，英国的公办学前儿童照管一向是最差的。
ext.ext_en: Britain has one of the worst records for state-run pre-school childcare in Western Europe.

defs.def_en: Childcare refers to looking after children, and to the facilities which help parents to do so.
A headhunter is a person who tries to persuade someone to leave their job and take another job which has better pay and more status.

ext.ext_cn: 我们怎么会知道他是个呆瓜呢？
ext.ext_en: How were we to know that he was a numbskull?

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a numbskull, you mean that they are very stupid.

ext.ext_cn: 一袋袋的肥料
ext.ext_en: ...bags of manure.

ext.ext_cn: 有机肥
ext.ext_en: ...organic manures.

defs.def_en: Manure is animal faeces, sometimes mixed with chemicals, that is spread on the ground in order to make plants grow healthy and strong.
In literary criticism, bathos is a sudden change in speech or writing from a serious or important subject to a ridiculous or very ordinary one.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于染发或涂饰皮肤的棕红色）散沫花染剂
defs.def_en: Henna is a reddish-brown dye that is made from the leaves of a shrub. It is used especially for colouring hair or skin.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 无法预言的；不可预测的；难以预料的

ext.ext_cn: 他是个高深莫测的人。
ext.ext_en: He is utterly unpredictable.

ext.ext_cn: 众所周知，英国的天气一向变幻莫测
ext.ext_en: ...Britain's notoriously unpredictable weather.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as unpredictable, you mean that you cannot tell what they are going to do or how they are going to behave.

defs.def_cn: 两性体;阴阳人;雌雄同体;雌雄同株
defs.def_en: A hermaphrodite is a person, animal, or flower that has both male and female reproductive organs.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不会受伤害的;刀枪不入的;攻不破的

ext.ext_cn: 很多女儿都认为她们的母亲无比坚强。
ext.ext_en: Many daughters assume that their mothers are invulnerable.

ext.ext_cn: 会使美国免受核袭击的系统
ext.ext_en: ...a system that would make the U.S. invulnerable to nuclear attack.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is invulnerable, they cannot be harmed or damaged.

ext.ext_cn: 她需要一种归属感让她安心。
ext.ext_en: She needed reassurance that she belonged somewhere...

ext.ext_cn: “你真的不说吗？”她问道，乞求得到安慰。
ext.ext_en: 'You really won't tell?' she asked, begging for reassurance.

defs.def_en: If someone needs reassurance, they are very worried and need someone to help them stop worrying by saying kind or helpful things.

ext.ext_cn: 杀虫剂没有危害的保证
ext.ext_en: ...reassurances that pesticides are not harmful.

defs.def_en: Reassurances are things that you say to help people stop worrying about something.
A gatepost is a post in the ground which a gate is hung from, or which it is fastened to when it is closed.

ext.ext_cn: 歇斯底里的笑声渐渐地变成了剧烈的抽泣
ext.ext_en: ...hysterical laughter which gradually metamorphoses into convulsive sobs...

ext.ext_cn: 该集团将不得不由一个松散的企业联合组织转变成一个全面整合的跨国集团。
ext.ext_en: The group is having to metamorphose from a loose collection of businesses into a fully integrated multinational...

defs.def_en: See also:metamorphosis;To metamorphose or be metamorphosed means to develop and change into something completely different.

ext.ext_cn: 这是该作曲家逝世 40 周年纪念日。
ext.ext_en: It was the fortieth anniversary of the death of the composer.

defs.def_en: The fortieth item in a series is the one that you count as number forty.
A charwoman is a woman who is employed to clean houses or offices.

ext.ext_cn: 上前说出口令。
ext.ext_en: Advance and give the password...

ext.ext_cn: 除非知道密码，否则谁也用不了那台计算机。
ext.ext_en: No-one could use the computer unless they had a password.

defs.def_en: A password is a secret word or phrase that you must know in order to be allowed to enter a place such as a military base, or to be allowed to use a computer system.

ext.ext_cn: 他一夜没合眼。
ext.ext_en: He didn't sleep a wink all night...

ext.ext_cn: 战斗在傍晚时分打响，持续了一夜。
ext.ext_en: The fighting began in the late afternoon and continued all night...

defs.def_en: The night is the part of each day when the sun has set and it is dark outside, especially the time when people are sleeping.

defs.def_cn: 晚间，晚上(尤指睡觉前放松的时间)

ext.ext_cn: 那么，昨晚的聚会是谁办的？
ext.ext_en: So whose party was it last night?...

ext.ext_cn: 第二天晚上，德米里斯请凯瑟琳共进晚餐。
ext.ext_en: Demiris took Catherine to dinner the following night.

defs.def_en: The night is the period of time between the end of the afternoon and the time that you go to bed, especially the time when you relax before going to bed.

defs.def_cn: (演出等的)夜场，夜间活动，…之夜

ext.ext_cn: 第一个夜场演出爆满。
ext.ext_en: The first night crowd packed the building.

ext.ext_cn: 选举之夜
ext.ext_en: ...election night.

defs.def_en: A particular night is a particular evening when a special event takes place, such as a show or a play.

ext.ext_cn: 现在是莫斯科晚间11点。
ext.ext_en: It's eleven o'clock at night in Moscow...

ext.ext_cn: 他工作极为投入，会从早上七点一刻一直干到晚上九十点。
ext.ext_en: He works obsessively from 7.15 am to 9 or 10 at night.

defs.def_en: If it is a particular time at night, it is during the time when it is dark and is before midnight.

ext.ext_cn: 为了成为会计师，他上夜校学习。
ext.ext_en: He was going to college at night, in order to become an accountant...

ext.ext_cn: 阳台装有厚重的木制防雨门，夜里是关着的。
ext.ext_en: The veranda was equipped with heavy wooden rain doors that were kept closed at night.

defs.def_en: If something happens at night, it happens regularly during the evening or night.

ext.ext_cn: 很多医生和护士已经夜以继日地工作数周了。
ext.ext_en: Dozens of doctors and nurses have been working day and night for weeks...

ext.ext_cn: 他日日夜夜呆在我门口，想引起我的注意。
ext.ext_en: He was at my door night and day, demanding my attention.

defs.def_en: If something happens day and night or night and day, it happens all the time without stopping.

ext.ext_cn: 这一天糟透了，我就想早点上床睡觉。
ext.ext_en: I've had a hell of a day, and all I want is an early night...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管旅途劳顿，而且睡得很晚，她并没觉得累。
ext.ext_en: In spite of the travelling and the late night, she did not feel tired.

defs.def_en: If you have an early night, you go to bed early. If you have a late night, you go to bed late.
An anti-depressant is a drug which is used to treat people who are suffering from depression.

defs.def_cn: 使人放松（或快乐）的事物;解忧良药

ext.ext_cn: 锻炼能够使人一扫阴霾。
ext.ext_en: Exercise is a powerful antidepressant.

defs.def_en: You can use anti-depressant to talk about something that makes people feel happier and more relaxed.

ext.ext_cn: 这么做会带来极坏的负面影响。
ext.ext_en: It was an effort which was to have painful repercussions...

ext.ext_cn: 国会议员被警告如果他们的投票通过可能会带来不良影响。
ext.ext_en: Members of congress were warned of possible repercussions if their vote went through.

defs.def_en: If an action or event has repercussions, it causes unpleasant things to happen some time after the original action or event.

defs.def_cn: （构成合成词）表示“有…个引擎的”、“有…型发动机的”

ext.ext_cn: 世界最大的双引擎客机
ext.ext_en: ...the world's biggest twin-engined airliner.

ext.ext_cn: 汽油驱动的福特全顺汽车
ext.ext_en: ...a petrol-engined Ford Transit.

defs.def_en: -engined combines with other words to show the number or type of engines that something has.

ext.ext_cn: 总统还呼吁各国就签订国际贸易协定加倍努力进行磋商。
ext.ext_en: The president also called on nations to redouble their efforts to negotiate an international trade agreement...

ext.ext_cn: 掌声加倍热烈。
ext.ext_en: The applause redoubled.

defs.def_en: If you redouble your efforts, you try much harder to achieve something. If something redoubles, it increases in volume or intensity.

ext.ext_cn: 有雉堞的塔楼
ext.ext_en: ...crenellated turrets.

defs.def_en: In a castle, a crenellated wall has gaps in the top or openings through which to fire at attackers.

defs.def_cn: (通常为误导他人的)数字游戏

ext.ext_cn: 遗憾的是，他又玩起了老一套的数字游戏，吹嘘说目前属于公有部门的国营企业已不到300家。
ext.ext_en: Regrettably, he resorts to the familiar numbers game when he boasts that fewer than 300 state enterprises currently remain in the public sector.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is playing the numbers game, you think that they are concentrating on the aspects of something which can be expressed in statistics, usually in order to mislead people.

ext.ext_cn: 我的消息会让你感到十分惊讶的。
ext.ext_en: My news will astonish you...

ext.ext_cn: 她的奉献精神总是让我震惊。
ext.ext_en: Her dedication constantly astonishes me.

defs.def_en: If something or someone astonishes you, they surprise you very much.

ext.ext_cn: 那家公司慷慨捐款100万英镑，使牛津辩论学会的财务状况得以好转。
ext.ext_en: The company revived the finances of the Oxford Union with a generous £1m endowment.

ext.ext_cn: 国家艺术基金
ext.ext_en: ...the National Endowment for the Arts.

defs.def_en: An endowment is a gift of money that is made to an institution or community in order to provide it with an annual income.
If someone has an endowment of a particular quality or ability, they possess it naturally.

defs.def_cn: 定期人寿保险；定期人寿保险按揭
defs.def_en: In finance, an endowment policy or mortgage is an insurance policy or mortgage which you pay towards each month and which should then provide you with enough money to pay for your house at the end of a fixed period.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在这座建筑物的楼上。
ext.ext_en: They were on the upper floor of the building...

ext.ext_cn: 人群聚集在议会大厦的周围。
ext.ext_en: Crowds gathered around the Parliament building.

defs.def_en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls, for example a house or a factory.

ext.ext_cn: 在煎锅里把肉末煎至棕色。
ext.ext_en: Brown the mince in a frying pan.

defs.def_en: Mince is meat which has been cut into very small pieces using a machine.

ext.ext_cn: 也许我会买点瘦肉自己绞。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps I'll buy lean meat and mince it myself.

ext.ext_cn: 绞碎的牛肉
ext.ext_en: ...minced beef.

defs.def_en: If you mince food such as meat, you put it into a machine which cuts it into very small pieces.

defs.def_cn: (尤指同性恋男子)迈着小碎步快走

ext.ext_cn: 他们穿着沙滩服，化了妆，一扭一摆地进来了。
ext.ext_en: They minced in, in beach costumes and make-up.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone, especially a homosexual man, minces somewhere, you mean that they walk there with quick small steps.

defs.def_cn: 说话转弯抹角；言语婉转

ext.ext_cn: 医生直言相告，并做了最坏的预测。
ext.ext_en: The doctors didn't mince their words, and predicted the worst...

ext.ext_cn: 卡莉一向心直口快，告诉女儿说她的容颜正在衰老。
ext.ext_en: Never one to mince words, Carlie told her daughter that her looks were fading.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does not mince their words, you mean that they speak in a forceful and direct way, especially when saying something unpleasant to someone.

defs.def_cn: (剧本、诗歌或音乐作品的)演出，表演，演绎

ext.ext_cn: 这些音乐家激情演绎了《帕迪·凯西的里尔舞曲》。
ext.ext_en: The musicians burst into a rousing rendition of 'Paddy Casey's Reel'.

defs.def_en: A rendition of a play, poem, or piece of music is a performance of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在处理任何内部政治分歧的苗头时，总统都毫不留情。
ext.ext_en: The President was ruthless in dealing with any hint of internal political dissent.

ext.ext_cn: 残忍的极权主义国家的侵略
ext.ext_en: ...an invasion by a ruthless totalitarian power...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is ruthless, you mean that you disapprove of them because they are very harsh or cruel, and will do anything that is necessary to achieve what they want.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为等)坚决的，果断的，不留情面的

ext.ext_cn: 她的律师在讨论离婚协议的过程中表现得非常坚决。
ext.ext_en: Her lawyers have been ruthless in thrashing out a divorce settlement...

ext.ext_cn: 成功合并两家银行需要坚决快速地着手解决费用问题。
ext.ext_en: Successfully merging two banks requires a fast and ruthless attack on costs.

defs.def_en: A ruthless action or activity is done forcefully and thoroughly, without much concern for its effects on other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他出身于一个非常正派的中产阶级家庭。
ext.ext_en: He came from a perfectly respectable middle-class family...

ext.ext_cn: 这是一家非常体面的“老式”旅馆，坐落在离皮卡迪利广场不远的地方。
ext.ext_en: It was a highly respectable and what was called an 'old-fashioned' hotel situated not far from Piccadilly.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is respectable is approved of by society and considered to be morally correct.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 好的;可观的;令人满意的

ext.ext_cn: 回报率可观的投资
ext.ext_en: ...investments that offer respectable rates of return...

ext.ext_cn: 我终于可以穿上体面的衣服了！
ext.ext_en: At last I have something respectable to wear!

defs.def_en: You can say that something is respectable when you mean that it is good enough or acceptable.

ext.ext_cn: 父母可以表达对自己孩子所上学校的偏好。
ext.ext_en: Parents can express a preference for the school their child attends...

ext.ext_cn: 这些产品中有很多是因为认为自己的产品不佳才购进的。
ext.ext_en: Many of these products were bought in preference to their own.

defs.def_en: If you have a preference for something, you would like to have or do that thing rather than something else.

ext.ext_cn: 美国国防部将会优先考虑那些能够进行电子商务的公司。
ext.ext_en: The Pentagon will give preference to companies which do business electronically.

defs.def_en: If you give preference to someone with a particular qualification or feature, you choose them rather than someone else.
A trucker is someone who drives a truck as their job.
A face pack is a thick substance which you spread on your face, allow to dry for a short time, and then remove, in order to clean your skin thoroughly.

defs.def_cn: (用于构成形容词，表示某种能力上的障碍)听力/视力受损的,有听力/视力障碍的

ext.ext_cn: 人口总数的 1/20 强在某种程度上存在听力障碍。
ext.ext_en: More than 1 in 20 of the population is hearing-impaired to some extent...

ext.ext_cn: 英国有 170 万失明和视力受损人口。
ext.ext_en: There are 1.7 million blind and visually impaired people in Britain.

defs.def_en: You use -impaired in adjectives where you are describing someone with a particular disability. For example, someone who is hearing-impaired has a disability affecting their hearing, and someone who is visually-impaired has a disability affecting their sight.

ext.ext_cn: 天气极其恶劣。寒风凛冽，天色晦暗，能见度极低。
ext.ext_en: The weather was at its worst; bitterly cold, with leaden skies that gave minimum visibility.

defs.def_en: A leaden sky or sea is dark grey and has no movement of clouds or waves.

ext.ext_cn: 一篇从拉丁文翻译过来的沉闷的英译文章
ext.ext_en: ...a leaden English translation from the Latin.

defs.def_en: A leaden conversation or piece of writing is not very interesting.

defs.def_cn: （通常指因疲劳而行动）蹇缓的，迟缓的，沉重的

ext.ext_cn: 他听见父亲蹇步下楼。
ext.ext_en: He heard the father's leaden footsteps move down the stairs.

defs.def_en: If your movements are leaden, you move slowly and heavily, usually because you are tired.

defs.def_cn: 电脑枪战游戏;超级火力游戏
defs.def_en: A shoot-em-up is a computer game that involves shooting and killing characters.
A doorstep is a step in front of a door on the outside of a building.

ext.ext_cn: 报纸联系了他祖母，查到了他现在的住址后便前往登门采访。
ext.ext_en: The newspaper contacted his grandmother to trace his present address, and later doorstepped him at his home.

defs.def_en: When journalists doorstep someone, they go to their home and try to get an interview or photographs, even when the person does not want to talk to them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们很容易无视身边之事。
ext.ext_en: It is all too easy to lose sight of what is happening on our own doorstep...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不得不忍受就在家门口的巨型炼油厂。
ext.ext_en: They have to put up with a giant oil refinery right on their doorstep.

defs.def_en: If a place is on your doorstep, it is very near to where you live. If something happens on your doorstep, it happens very close to where you live.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 麻利的；务实的；效率高的

ext.ext_cn: 佩恩先生听起来是个非常务实的人。
ext.ext_en: Mr. Penn sounds quite businesslike...

ext.ext_cn: 这个活动开展的效率很高。
ext.ext_en: This activity was carried on in a businesslike manner.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as businesslike, you mean that they deal with things in an efficient way without wasting time.

ext.ext_cn: 工厂用带刺的铁丝网围着。
ext.ext_en: The factory was surrounded by barbed wire.

ext.ext_cn: 带刺铁丝围栏
ext.ext_en: ...a barbed-wire fence.

defs.def_en: Barbed wire is strong wire with sharp points sticking out of it, and is used to make fences.

ext.ext_cn: 入口处在马伯里路，有清晰的路标。
ext.ext_en: The entrance is well signposted and is in Marbury Road.

defs.def_en: A place or route that is signposted has signposts beside the road to show the way.

defs.def_cn: (医生的)病例记录;(社会工作者的)个案记录;(警察的)案卷
defs.def_en: A casebook is a written record of the cases dealt with by someone such as a doctor, social worker, or police officer.
A guardian angel is a spirit who is believed to protect and guide a particular person.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的精神领袖兼世俗领导人
ext.ext_en: ...their spiritual and temporal leader.

ext.ext_cn: 坚信神职人员必须不为世俗之事所牵绊
ext.ext_en: ...firmly believing in the need for the clergy not to become preoccupied with temporal matters.

defs.def_en: Temporal powers or matters relate to ordinary institutions and activities rather than to religious or spiritual ones.

ext.ext_cn: 大脑颞叶上虽小但很重要的一个区域
ext.ext_en: ...a small but important area of the temporal lobe of the brain.

defs.def_en: The temporal parts of your brain are the parts near the sides of your head.

ext.ext_cn: 人们也能看出具体行为是如何与时空相关联的。
ext.ext_en: One is also able to see how specific acts are related to a temporal and spatial context...

ext.ext_cn: 原则上说来，目前的世界危机应该从不同的时间角度加以分析。
ext.ext_en: The present world crisis should in principle be analysed from different temporal perspectives.

defs.def_en: Temporal means relating to time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 双方充满火药味的声明引发了人们对战争的担心
ext.ext_en: ...the belligerent statements from both sides which have led to fears of war...

ext.ext_cn: 他故态复萌，几乎又像一年前那样咄咄逼人了。
ext.ext_en: He was almost back to his belligerent mood of twelve months ago.

defs.def_en: A belligerent person is hostile and aggressive.

ext.ext_cn: 预计交战双方要再一次试图解决彼此的分歧了。
ext.ext_en: The belligerents were due, once again, to try to settle their differences.

defs.def_en: The belligerents in a war are the countries or groups that are fighting each other.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有特权的；享受特殊待遇的

ext.ext_cn: 他们基本上是一些非常有钱有势的精英。
ext.ext_en: They were, by and large, a very wealthy, privileged elite.

ext.ext_cn: 在这所大学工作，我感到非常荣幸。
ext.ext_en: ...I felt very privileged to work at the university.

defs.def_en: Someone who is privileged has an advantage or opportunity that most other people do not have, often because of their wealth or high social class.

defs.def_cn: （信息）保密的，只有少数人知道的

ext.ext_cn: 这些数据是保密的，并不向大众公开。
ext.ext_en: The data is privileged information, not to be shared with the general public...

ext.ext_cn: 尼克松先生认为这些录音带是保密的。
ext.ext_en: Mr Nixon argued the tapes were privileged.

defs.def_en: Privileged information is known by only a small group of people, who are not legally required to give it to anyone else.

defs.def_cn: （人、工作、角色等）重要的，地位高的

ext.ext_cn: 他的事业蓬勃发展，这在一定程度上提升了他的地位。
ext.ext_en: His career has blossomed and that has given him a certain elevated status.

defs.def_en: A person, job, or role that is elevated is very important or of very high rank.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （想法、思想等）高尚的，崇高的,睿智的

ext.ext_cn: 杂志中高贵的英伦情调
ext.ext_en: ...the magazine's elevated British tone.

defs.def_en: If thoughts or ideas are elevated, they are on a high moral or intellectual level.

defs.def_cn: （土地、建筑等）高出周围的，高架的

ext.ext_cn: 在排练过程中舞台上垫高的一个平台塌了。
ext.ext_en: An elevated platform on the stage collapsed during rehearsals.

defs.def_en: If land or buildings are elevated, they are raised up higher than the surrounding area.

defs.def_cn: 石油美元（用于计算一国通过出口石油或天然气所得的收入）
defs.def_en: Petrodollars are a unit of money used to calculate how much a country has earned by exporting petroleum or natural gas.

defs.def_cn: （用途、功能、尺寸、价值等）相等，对等，相同

ext.ext_cn: 科学和理性的对等
ext.ext_en: ...the equivalence of science and rationality.

defs.def_en: If there is equivalence between two things, they have the same use, function, size, or value.

ext.ext_cn: 他知道她没有听他的话，这让他大为光火。
ext.ext_en: He knew that what he was saying did not reach her. And the knowledge of it maddened him...

ext.ext_cn: 他在催眠曲的安抚下平静下来，但任何突发的巨响又会让他大发脾气。
ext.ext_en: He is calmed by a lullaby, but maddened by any sudden loud noise.

defs.def_en: To madden a person or animal means to make them very angry.

defs.def_cn: 平头百姓；市井小民；粗俗的人
defs.def_en: If someone refers to people as plebs, they mean they are of a low social class or do not appreciate culture.

ext.ext_cn: 我们本季运气不太好。
ext.ext_en: We had a bit of hard luck this season...

ext.ext_cn: 他可真倒霉，不是吗？
ext.ext_en: It was jolly hard luck on him, wasn't it?

defs.def_en: If you say that someone had some hard luck, or that a situation was hard luck on them, you mean that something bad happened to them and you are implying that it was not their fault.

ext.ext_cn: 店员根本不想谈论此事，说这完全是我运气太差。
ext.ext_en: The shop assistants didn't really want to discuss the matter, saying it was just my hard luck.

defs.def_en: If someone says that a bad situation affecting you is just your hard luck, they do not care about it or think you should be helped, often because they think it is your fault.

ext.ext_cn: 真不走运，伙计们，不过别太灰心。
ext.ext_en: Hard luck, chaps, but don't despair too much.

defs.def_en: You can say 'hard luck' to someone to show that you are sorry they have not got or done something that they had wanted to get or do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 认为老师们总那么宽容是幼稚的。
ext.ext_en: It's naive to think that teachers are always tolerant...

ext.ext_cn: 我一定太天真了，竟认为我们会得到我父母的祝福。
ext.ext_en: I must have been naive to think we would get my parents' blessing.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as naive, you think they lack experience and so expect things to be easy or people to be honest or kind.

ext.ext_cn: 如今，重新粉刷一下房间就像彻底打扫一次房间一样简单。
ext.ext_en: It's almost as easy these days to give your rooms a new coat of paint as it is to spring-clean them.

ext.ext_cn: 它需要一次彻底的大扫除。
ext.ext_en: It needs a thorough spring clean.

defs.def_en: When you spring-clean a house, you thoroughly clean everything in it.
A crone is an ugly old woman.

ext.ext_cn: 她哭笑不得。
ext.ext_en: She wanted to laugh and weep all at once...

ext.ext_cn: 哭泣着的一家人相互拥抱并彼此安慰。
ext.ext_en: The weeping family hugged and comforted each other...

defs.def_en: If someone weeps, they cry.

ext.ext_cn: 在恶劣的条件下，皮肤可能会开裂并流脓。
ext.ext_en: In severe cases, the skin can crack and weep.

ext.ext_cn: 会成为脓疮的小水泡
ext.ext_en: ...little blisters which develop into weeping sores.

defs.def_en: If a wound weeps, liquid or blood comes from it because it is not healing properly.

defs.def_cn: 生物；有机体；（尤指）微生物

ext.ext_cn: 并不是所有常见于生物体中的化学物质都无害。
ext.ext_en: Not all chemicals normally present in living organisms are harmless.

ext.ext_cn: 通过昆虫传播、导致昏睡病的微生物
ext.ext_en: ...the insect-borne organisms that cause sleeping sickness.

defs.def_en: An organism is an animal or plant, especially one that is so small that you cannot see it without using a microscope.

defs.def_cn: 难以解释的事情;无法估计的事物

ext.ext_cn: 他们猜测着未来难以预见的事情。
ext.ext_en: They are speculating on the imponderables of the future.

defs.def_en: An imponderable is something unknown which it is difficult or impossible to estimate or make correct guesses about.
A cable car is a vehicle for taking people up mountains or steep hills. It is pulled by a moving cable.

ext.ext_cn: 婴儿断奶后，她会把婴儿带回家。
ext.ext_en: The baby would be weaned and she would bring it home...

ext.ext_cn: 什么时候开始给我的孩子断奶最好？
ext.ext_en: When would be the best time to start weaning my baby?...

defs.def_en: When a baby or baby animal is weaned, its mother stops feeding it milk and starts giving it other food, especially solid food.

defs.def_cn: 使放弃，使戒掉，使不再依赖(尤指恶习)

ext.ext_cn: 他妻子帮他戒除了动粗和嗜酒的恶习，使他变得成熟了。
ext.ext_en: He was mellowed by a wife who weaned him off violence and drink...

ext.ext_cn: 会给你一些含少量尼古丁的药片帮你戒除烟瘾。
ext.ext_en: You are given pills with small quantities of nicotine to wean you from cigarettes...

defs.def_en: If you wean someone off a habit or something they like, you gradually make them stop doing it or liking it, especially when you think is bad for them.

defs.def_cn: 咨询;请教;请示(以获得许可)

ext.ext_cn: 咨询一下医生你需要多大的运动量。
ext.ext_en: Consult your doctor about how much exercise you should attempt...

ext.ext_cn: 他需要找个律师咨询一下。
ext.ext_en: He needed to consult with an attorney...

defs.def_en: If you consult an expert or someone senior to you or consult with them, you ask them for their opinion and advice about what you should do or their permission to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 与女儿兼经纪人商量之后，她决定出演这一角色，不过要按照她开出的条件。
ext.ext_en: After consulting with her daughter and manager she decided to take on the part, on her terms...

ext.ext_cn: 两国不得不与盟国商议。
ext.ext_en: The two countries will have to consult their allies...

defs.def_en: If a person or group of people consults with other people or consults them, they talk and exchange ideas and opinions about what they might decide to do.

ext.ext_cn: 翻到44页的图表，查一下正确的烹饪时间。
ext.ext_en: Consult the chart on page 44 for the correct cooking times...

ext.ext_cn: 他只好去查袖珍字典。
ext.ext_en: He had to consult a pocket dictionary.

defs.def_en: If you consult a book or a map, you look in it or look at it in order to find some information.

ext.ext_cn: 他有一种强烈的预感，觉得自己会死。
ext.ext_en: He had an unshakable premonition that he would die.

ext.ext_cn: 对坏消息真切的预感
ext.ext_en: ...a real, genuine premonition of bad news.

defs.def_en: If you have a premonition, you have a feeling that something is going to happen, often something unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: （旧时代表国王、女王或政府统治殖民地的）总督
defs.def_en: In former times, a viceroy was the person who ruled a colony on behalf of his king, queen, or government.

ext.ext_cn: 去年那座火山喷发致使约600人遇难。
ext.ext_en: The volcano erupted last year killing about 600 people...

ext.ext_cn: 埃特纳山是欧洲最活跃的火山。
ext.ext_en: Etna is Europe's most active volcano.

defs.def_en: A volcano is a mountain from which hot melted rock, gas, steam, and ash from inside the earth sometimes burst.

defs.def_cn: (与某人或某组织相关的)收藏品,纪念品
defs.def_en: Memorabilia are things that you collect because they are connected with a person or organization in which you are interested.

defs.def_cn: 代基里酒（用朗姆酒、酸橙汁或柠檬汁、糖和冰调制而成）
defs.def_en: A daiquiri is a drink made with rum, lime or lemon juice, sugar, and ice.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名记者，他太老实了。
ext.ext_en: He seemed too ingenuous for a reporter...

ext.ext_cn: 他以自己的率真迷住了观众。
ext.ext_en: With ingenuous sincerity, he captivated his audience.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as ingenuous, you mean that they are innocent, trusting, and honest.

defs.def_cn: 行为准则;规则;法典;法规

ext.ext_cn: 《土耳其刑法法典》第159条
ext.ext_en: ...Article 159 of the Turkish Penal Code.

ext.ext_cn: 地方建筑法规
ext.ext_en: ...local building codes.

defs.def_en: A code is a set of rules about how people should behave or about how something must be done.

ext.ext_cn: 他们使用了复杂的暗号，比如用树的名称代表字母。
ext.ext_en: They used elaborate secret codes, as when the names of trees stood for letters...

ext.ext_cn: 如果记不住自己的号码，可以用代码记在日记簿里。
ext.ext_en: If you can't remember your number, write it in code in a diary.

defs.def_en: A code is a system of replacing the words in a message with other words or symbols, so that nobody can understand it unless they know the system.

ext.ext_cn: 打电话的人如果拨错区号，就无法接通。
ext.ext_en: Callers dialing the wrong area code will not get through.

defs.def_en: A code is a group of numbers or letters which is used to identify something, such as a postal address or part of a telephone system.

ext.ext_cn: 把数字信号重新转换回通常的电视信号需要另外的微芯片。
ext.ext_en: It will need different microchips to reconvert the digital code back into normal TV signals.

defs.def_en: A code is any system of signs or symbols that has a meaning.

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们找到了破解决定各种身体特征的遗传密码的密钥。
ext.ext_en: Scientists provided the key to understanding the genetic code that determines every bodily feature.

defs.def_en: The genetic code of a person, animal or plant is the information contained in DNA which determines the structure and function of cells, and the inherited characteristics of all living things.

ext.ext_cn: 他设计了一种把每句话进行独特编码的方法。
ext.ext_en: He devised a way of coding every statement uniquely...

ext.ext_cn: 机器都编了号，便于我们区分。
ext.ext_en: The machines were coded so we could tell them apart.

defs.def_en: To code something means to give it a code or to mark it with its code.
Computer code is a system or language for expressing information and instructions in a form which can be understood by a computer.

ext.ext_cn: 他往椅背上一靠，把脚搭在桌子上。
ext.ext_en: He rocked back in the chair and propped his feet on the desk...

ext.ext_cn: 他把自行车靠在公共汽车上。
ext.ext_en: He propped his bike against the bus.

defs.def_en: If you prop an object on or against something, you support it by putting something underneath it or by resting it somewhere.
A prop is a stick or other object that you use to support something.

ext.ext_cn: 军队是政府的主要后盾之一。
ext.ext_en: The army is one of the main props of the government...

ext.ext_cn: 我生命中有两大支柱：一个是酒，另一个是工作。
ext.ext_en: I had two props in my life; one was alcohol, the other work.

defs.def_en: To be a prop for a system, institution, or person means to be the main thing that keeps them strong or helps them survive.

ext.ext_cn: 一场舞台剧的背景幕和道具
ext.ext_en: ...the backdrop and props for a stage show.

ext.ext_cn: 舞台道具
ext.ext_en: ...stage props.

defs.def_en: The props in a play or film are all the objects or pieces of furniture that are used in it.

defs.def_cn: （橄榄球争球时的）第一排边锋
defs.def_en: In rugby, a prop or prop forward is one of the two players who position themselves in the front row when a group called a scrum is formed.
A prop is the same as a propeller .

defs.def_cn: 任…处理;供…任意使用;由…自由支配

ext.ext_cn: 你对这个情况有所了解吗？
ext.ext_en: Do you have this information at your disposal?...

ext.ext_cn: 他放出话说他将使出十八般武艺。
ext.ext_en: He has said he will use all the weapons at his disposal...

defs.def_en: If you have something at your disposal, you are able to use it whenever you want, and for whatever purpose you want. If you say that you are at someone's disposal, you mean that you are willing to help them in any way you can.

defs.def_cn: (废物等的)丢掉，清理，销毁，处理

ext.ext_cn: 处理放射性废料的一劳永逸的办法
ext.ext_en: ...methods for the permanent disposal of radioactive wastes.

ext.ext_cn: 废物处理场
ext.ext_en: ...waste disposal sites.

defs.def_en: Disposal is the act of getting rid of something that is no longer wanted or needed.

ext.ext_cn: 我们注意到墙上爬满了小虫子。
ext.ext_en: We noticed tiny bugs that were all over the walls.

ext.ext_cn: 贫民区滋生的一种吸血的虫子
ext.ext_en: ...a bloodsucking bug which infests poor housing.

defs.def_en: A bug is an insect or similar small creature.

ext.ext_cn: 我想我的胃可能出了点儿毛病。
ext.ext_en: I think I've got a bit of a stomach bug...

ext.ext_cn: 这个俱乐部流行着一种轻微的传染病。
ext.ext_en: There was a bug going around at the club.

defs.def_en: A bug is an illness which is caused by small organisms such as bacteria.

defs.def_cn: （计算机程序中的）漏洞，错误，故障

ext.ext_cn: 软件有漏洞。
ext.ext_en: There is a bug in the software.

defs.def_en: If there is a bug in a computer program, there is a mistake in it.

ext.ext_cn: 电话装有窃听器。
ext.ext_en: There was a bug on the phone.

defs.def_en: A bug is a tiny hidden microphone which transmits what people are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 他得知他们打算在他办公室安装窃听器。
ext.ext_en: He heard that they were planning to bug his office...

ext.ext_cn: 我发现我的电话被窃听了。
ext.ext_en: I found out my phone was bugged.

defs.def_en: If someone bugs a place, they hide tiny microphones in it which transmit what people are saying.

ext.ext_cn: 我被园艺彻底迷住了。
ext.ext_en: I've definitely been bitten by the gardening bug...

ext.ext_cn: 利兹市的朗德海公园是我首次对钓鱼着迷的地方。
ext.ext_en: Roundhay Park in Leeds was the place I first got the fishing bug.

defs.def_en: You can say that someone has been bitten by a particular bug when they suddenly become very enthusiastic about something.

ext.ext_cn: 我这么做只是为了让我父母心烦。
ext.ext_en: I only did it to bug my parents.

defs.def_en: If someone or something bugs you, they worry or annoy you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那个年轻的女子身材苗条修长。
ext.ext_en: The young woman was tall and slim...

ext.ext_cn: 珍妮非常漂亮，身材苗条，有一双蓝色的眼睛。
ext.ext_en: Jean is pretty, of slim build, with blue eyes.

defs.def_en: A slim person has an attractively thin and well-shaped body.

ext.ext_cn: 有些人无论多么努力地减肥，都会长肉。
ext.ext_en: Some people will gain weight, no matter how hard they try to slim...

ext.ext_cn: 在减肥过程中保持饮食的营养相对均衡是明智的。
ext.ext_en: It makes sense to eat a reasonably balanced diet when slimming.

defs.def_en: If you are slimming, you are trying to make yourself thinner and lighter by eating less food.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_cn: （与某国名称连用，指包括该国和曾属该国或者人们认为应属该国的地区在内的更广阔的区域）大的

ext.ext_cn: 大叙利亚
ext.ext_en: ...greater Syria.

defs.def_en: Greater is used with the name of a country to refer to a larger area which includes that country and other land which used to belong to it, or which some people believe should belong to it.

defs.def_cn: （禁止运动员服用的）违禁药物
defs.def_en: In sport, banned substances are drugs that competitors are not allowed to take because they could artificially improve their performance.
A crossbow is a weapon consisting of a small, powerful bow that is fixed across a piece of wood, and aimed like a gun.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他远没有他的兄弟那么招摇。
ext.ext_en: He was much less flashy than his brother.

ext.ext_cn: 扎眼的跑车
ext.ext_en: ...a flashy sports car.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or thing as flashy, you mean they are smart and noticeable, but in a rather vulgar way.

defs.def_cn: (船舶主甲板上方的)上层构造，上层结构

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以设法清理出主甲板之上的一些船舱。
ext.ext_en: We might try to clear up some of the cabins in the superstructure.

defs.def_en: The superstructure of a ship is the part of it that is above its main deck.

ext.ext_cn: 我答应给普伦基特夫人临时照看孩子。
ext.ext_en: I promised to babysit for Mrs Plunkett...

ext.ext_cn: 我朋友请我临时看顾她6个月大的儿子。
ext.ext_en: My friend asked me to babysit for her six-month-old son...

defs.def_en: If you babysit for someone or babysit their children, you look after their children while they are out.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我们向南出发了。
ext.ext_en: We set off in a southerly direction.

ext.ext_cn: 津巴布韦和莫桑比克最南边的地区
ext.ext_en: ...the most southerly areas of Zimbabwe and Mozambique.

defs.def_en: A southerly point, area, or direction is to the south or towards the south.
A southerly wind is a wind that blows from the south.
A hat is a head covering, often with a brim round it, which is usually worn out of doors to give protection from the weather.

ext.ext_cn: 扮演我的民族主义角色
ext.ext_en: ...putting on my nationalistic hat.

ext.ext_cn: 各种问题，包括有太多的人身兼多职
ext.ext_en: ...various problems, including too many people wearing too many hats.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is wearing a particular hat, you mean that they are performing a particular role at that time. If you say that they wear several hats, you mean that they have several roles or jobs.

defs.def_cn: 毫不犹豫地;非常乐意地

ext.ext_cn: 印度是世界上我迫不及待想要去的一个地方。
ext.ext_en: India is one part of the world I would go to at the drop of a hat.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are ready to do something at the drop of a hat, you mean that you are willing to do it immediately, without hesitating.

ext.ext_cn: 喂，如果我告诉你一件事，你能答应保守秘密吗？
ext.ext_en: Look, if I tell you something, will you promise to keep it under your hat?...

ext.ext_cn: 在这件事儿上他嘴很紧。
ext.ext_en: He kept it all very much under his hat.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to keep a piece of information under their hat, you are asking them not to tell anyone else about it.

ext.ext_cn: 年轻的一代告诉我，宗教已经过时了，科学已证明了这一点。
ext.ext_en: The younger generation tell me that religion is 'old hat' and science has proved this.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is old hat, you mean that they have existed or been known for a long time, and they have become uninteresting and boring.

defs.def_cn: 募捐，凑份子（美国英语用 pass the hat）

ext.ext_cn: 教授们正在凑钱帮助系里的同事。
ext.ext_en: Professors are passing the hat to help staff in their department.

defs.def_en: In British English, if you pass the hat around, you collect money from a group of people, for example in order to give someone a present. In American English, you just say pass the hat .

ext.ext_cn: 我很钦佩克拉克先生的这一举动。
ext.ext_en: I take my hat off to Mr Clarke for taking this action...

ext.ext_cn: 我对此印象深刻，你不得不钦佩那个家伙。
ext.ext_en: I was impressed by that, you have to take your hat off to the guy.

defs.def_en: If you say that you take your hat off to someone, you mean that you admire them for something that they have done.

ext.ext_cn: 向他们帮扶无家可归者的善举致敬！
ext.ext_en: Hats off to them for supporting the homeless.

defs.def_en: If you say 'Hats off to someone', you are expressing admiration for them.

defs.def_cn: （常指没落时）出乎意料地获取（胜利、成功）

ext.ext_cn: 南安普敦队最终还是出乎意料地又一次获得了足总杯赛的胜利。
ext.ext_en: Southampton had somehow managed to pull another Cup victory out of the hat.

defs.def_en: To pull something out of the hat means to do something unexpected which helps you to succeed, often when you are failing.

defs.def_cn: （比赛中挑选胜出者时）随机地，任意地

ext.ext_cn: 随机抽出的前10位答对问题者将获得两张票，每张价值20英镑。
ext.ext_en: The first 10 correct entries drawn out of the hat will win a pair of tickets, worth £20 each.

defs.def_en: In competitions, if you say that the winners will be drawn or picked out of the hat, you mean that they will be chosen randomly, so everyone has an equal chance of winning.

defs.def_cn: 作为第二语言的英语(教学)
defs.def_en: ESL is taught to people whose native language is not English but who live in a society in which English is the main language or one of the main languages. ESL is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'English as a second language'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你得快点了，飞机大约3小时后起飞。
ext.ext_en: You'll have to be quick. The flight leaves in about three hours...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为我是一个学东西还算快的人。
ext.ext_en: I think I'm a reasonably quick learner...

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is quick moves or does things with great speed.

defs.def_cn: (quicker 有时表示“以更快的速度”，quickest表示“以最快的速度”，quick有时表示“以很快的速度”，但有些人认为这种用法并不规范)

ext.ext_cn: 先将糖稍稍加热，以使其溶解得更快些。
ext.ext_en: Warm the sugar slightly first to make it dissolve quicker...

ext.ext_cn: 普罗斯特走得最快。
ext.ext_en: Prost went quickest.

defs.def_en: Quicker is sometimes used to mean 'at a greater speed', and quickest to mean 'at the greatest speed'. Quick is sometimes used to mean 'with great speed'. Some people consider this to be non-standard.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 短暂的;持续时间很短的

ext.ext_cn: 他朝房间匆匆扫了最后一眼。
ext.ext_en: He took one last quick look about the room...

ext.ext_cn: 我只是顺路过来小酌一杯。
ext.ext_en: I just popped in for a quick drink...

defs.def_en: Something that is quick takes or lasts only a short time.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 立刻发生的;很快发生的

ext.ext_cn: 官员们让迅速结束这场流血冲突的希望变得渺茫起来。
ext.ext_en: Officials played down any hope for a quick end to the bloodshed...

ext.ext_cn: 这些投资者觉得收益必须立竿见影。
ext.ext_en: These investors feel the need to make quick profits.

defs.def_en: Quick means happening without delay or with very little delay.

defs.def_cn: 迅速发生地;很快发生地

ext.ext_cn: 我尽快离开了。
ext.ext_en: I got away as quick as I could...

ext.ext_cn: 快来！约翰！卡梅拉出事了，我想她用药过量了。
ext.ext_en: Quick! John! It's Carmela. I think she's taken an overdose...

defs.def_en: Quick is sometimes used to mean 'with very little delay'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 马克说这些都是凯蒂自己的想法，并随即称赞起她的天赋来。
ext.ext_en: Mark says the ideas are Katie's own, and is quick to praise her talent...

ext.ext_cn: 而且，正如热尔韦斯毫不犹豫地指出来的那样，斯库利先生并不是一名侦探。
ext.ext_en: Furthermore, as Gervaise was quick to point out, Mr Scully was not a detective.

defs.def_en: If you are quick to do something, you do not hesitate to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 性情急躁的;容易发怒的
defs.def_en: If someone has a quick temper, they are easily made angry.

defs.def_cn: 咬到了指甲肉；咬秃指甲

ext.ext_cn: 她的手指甲都被咬秃了。
ext.ext_en: Her fingernails are bitten to the quick.

defs.def_en: If someone bites their nails to the quick, they bite off all the white part at the end of each nail.

defs.def_cn: 触及（…）痛处;极大伤害；令…伤透了心

ext.ext_cn: 有一次，我听见她在卧室里哭泣，这深深地刺痛了我的心。
ext.ext_en: I once heard her weeping in her bedroom, which cut me to the quick.

defs.def_en: If something cuts you to the quick, it makes you feel very upset.

defs.def_cn: 公路货运商;公路货运承运人
defs.def_en: A haulier is a company or a person that transports goods by road.

defs.def_cn: 到达青春期的；到达发育期的

ext.ext_cn: 拽扯他的麦克风的一群少男少女
ext.ext_en: ...a horde of pubescent boys and girls who tug at his microphone.

defs.def_en: A pubescent girl or boy has reached the stage in their life when their body is becoming physically like an adult's.

ext.ext_cn: 在这个国家，叛国仍然是可判死罪的。
ext.ext_en: Treason in this country is still punishable by death...

ext.ext_cn: 他们呼吁当局将蓄奴定为一种应该受到惩罚的罪行。
ext.ext_en: They called on the authorities to make slavery a punishable offence.

defs.def_en: If a crime is punishable in a particular way, anyone who commits it is punished in that way.

defs.def_cn: 穿着（或举止）像异性的人；假小子；娘娘腔
defs.def_en: People sometimes use gender-bender to refer to a man who dresses or behaves like a woman, or a woman who dresses or behaves like a man.
Catfish are a type of fish that have long thin spines around their mouths.

ext.ext_cn: 我们三个出发了，车轮在大雨中疯狂地打滑。
ext.ext_en: The three of us set off, our wheels skidding crazily under that drenching rain...

ext.ext_cn: 球不可思议地弹过他的肩膀，钻进了球网。
ext.ext_en: The ball bounced crazily over his shoulder into the net.

defs.def_en: See also:crazy;If something moves crazily, it moves in a way or in a direction that you do not expect.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 以前他的头发是浅橙色的。
ext.ext_en: He used to have orangey coloured hair.

ext.ext_cn: 整个大厅用鲜艳的橘红色装饰，木建部分漆成黑色和金色。
ext.ext_en: The hall is decorated in bright orangey-red with black and gold woodwork.

defs.def_en: Orangey means slightly orange in colour.

ext.ext_cn: 袭击者也许一直都在等待着动手的机会。
ext.ext_en: The attacker may have been waiting around for an opportunity to strike...

ext.ext_cn: 我干等着跟医生说话。
ext.ext_en: I waited around to speak to the doctor.

defs.def_en: If you wait around or wait about, you stay in the same place, usually doing very little, because you cannot act before something happens or before someone arrives.

ext.ext_cn: 我就站在入口通道的旁边，希望他会注意到我。
ext.ext_en: I stood just beyond the entryway hoping he would notice me.

defs.def_en: An entryway is a passage that is used as an entrance to a building.

ext.ext_cn: 一个车胎爆了，司机失去了控制。
ext.ext_en: The driver lost control when a tyre burst...

ext.ext_cn: 把水泡挑破不是个好主意。
ext.ext_en: It is not a good idea to burst a blister.

defs.def_en: If something bursts or if you burst it, it suddenly breaks open or splits open and the air or other substance inside it comes out.

ext.ext_cn: 堤坝决口，淹没了他们的村庄。
ext.ext_en: A dam burst and flooded their villages.

defs.def_en: If a dam bursts, or if something bursts it, it breaks apart because the force of the river is too great.

ext.ext_cn: 季风雨使河堤决口。
ext.ext_en: Monsoons caused the river to burst its banks.

defs.def_en: If a river bursts its banks, the water rises and goes on to the land.

ext.ext_cn: 门突然被推开，一名怒气冲冲的年轻护士出现在门口。
ext.ext_en: The door burst open and an angry young nurse appeared.

defs.def_en: When a door or lid bursts open, it opens very suddenly and violently because someone pushes it or there is great pressure behind it.

ext.ext_cn: 持枪歹徒突然闯进他家里开枪射击。
ext.ext_en: Gunmen burst into his home and opened fire...

ext.ext_cn: 当门被再次猛地推开时，雷切尔冲了出去。
ext.ext_en: Rachel burst out as the door was flung open again.

defs.def_en: To burst into or out of a place means to enter or leave it suddenly with a lot of energy or force.

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪80年代初他突然在时尚界活跃起来。
ext.ext_en: He burst onto the fashion scene in the early 1980s.

defs.def_en: If you say that something bursts onto the scene, you mean that it suddenly starts or becomes active, usually after developing quietly for some time.

ext.ext_cn: 当儿子约翰在足球方面表现优秀时，他心中充满了自豪。
ext.ext_en: He almost burst with pride when his son John began to excel at football...

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得自己悲痛欲绝。
ext.ext_en: He thought his heart would burst with grief.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is about to burst with pride, anger, or another emotion, you are emphasizing the intensity of the emotion they are feeling.

ext.ext_cn: 成百上千朵烟花在半空中同时绽放。
ext.ext_en: Hundreds of fireworks burst simultaneously in midair...

ext.ext_cn: 你会时不时地听到一些爆炸声。
ext.ext_en: Every now and then you hear some bombs bursting.

defs.def_en: When a firework or bomb bursts in the air, it explodes.

ext.ext_cn: 一阵炮火
ext.ext_en: ...a burst of machine-gun fire...

ext.ext_cn: 和长时间的锻炼相比，短期内加强活动更容易应付。
ext.ext_en: It is easier to cope with short bursts of activity than with prolonged exercise...

defs.def_en: A burst of something is a sudden short period of it.

defs.def_cn: 逆转，彻底改变（决定、政策、趋势等）

ext.ext_cn: 他们已经明确表示不会更改提价的决定。
ext.ext_en: They have made it clear they will not reverse the decision to increase prices...

ext.ext_cn: 10个月来失业率的首次上升逆转了比利时失业率持续下降的趋势。
ext.ext_en: The rise, the first in 10 months, reversed the downward trend in Belgium's jobless rate.

defs.def_en: When someone or something reverses a decision, policy, or trend, they change it to the opposite decision, policy, or trend.

ext.ext_cn: 在这些方块中按顺序放置1分、5分、10分和25分的硬币各一枚。目标是颠倒这些硬币的顺序。
ext.ext_en: In the squares place a penny, nickel, dime and quarter in that order. The object is to reverse the order of these coins...

ext.ext_cn: 正常词序在被动句中是颠倒的。
ext.ext_en: The normal word order is reversed in passive sentences.

defs.def_en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

ext.ext_cn: 他将两枚邮票的位置调换了一下。
ext.ext_en: He reversed the position of the two stamps.

defs.def_en: If you reverse the positions or functions of two things, you change them so that each thing has the position or function that the other one had.

ext.ext_cn: 另一辆车倒出了车道。
ext.ext_en: Another car reversed out of the drive...

ext.ext_cn: 他把车倒出来，开走了。
ext.ext_en: He reversed and drove away...

defs.def_en: When a car reverses or when you reverse it, the car is driven backwards.

ext.ext_cn: 他顺着车辙摇摇晃晃地将车倒到了支路上。
ext.ext_en: He lurched the car in reverse along the ruts to the access road.

defs.def_en: If your car is in reverse, you have changed gear so that you can drive it backwards.

ext.ext_cn: 错误的态度会产生完全相反的效果。
ext.ext_en: The wrong attitude will have exactly the reverse effect.

defs.def_en: Reverse means opposite to what you expect or to what has just been described.

ext.ext_cn: 完全没有证据表明观众想看时间更长的板球比赛。情况恰恰相反。
ext.ext_en: There is absolutely no evidence at all that spectators want longer cricket matches. Quite the reverse...

ext.ext_cn: 这会让人以为是一本内容晦涩而详尽的大部头自传。但正好相反，这本书简短明了。
ext.ext_en: This would lead one to expect a fat, dense and detailed autobiography. The reverse is true. The book is short and spare.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing is the reverse of another, you are emphasizing that the first thing is the complete opposite of the second thing.

ext.ext_cn: 显然，前首相所在党派遭受了重大的挫折。
ext.ext_en: It's clear that the party of the former Prime Minister has suffered a major reverse.

defs.def_en: A reverse is a serious failure or defeat.

ext.ext_cn: 支票抬头必须写“《乡村生活》杂志”，你的地址应写在背面。
ext.ext_en: Cheques should be made payable to Country Living and your address written on the reverse.

defs.def_en: The reverse or the reverse side of a flat object which has two sides is the less important or the other side.

ext.ext_cn: 埃米斯以倒叙的方式讲述了这个故事，从这个男人死去的时候开始讲起。
ext.ext_en: Amis tells the story in reverse, from the moment the man dies...

ext.ext_cn: 比分下降的趋势发生逆转，分数又开始逐渐上升了。
ext.ext_en: The downward trend went into reverse and the scores started to creep up again.

defs.def_en: If something happens in reverse or goes into reverse, things happen in the opposite way to what usually happens or to what has been happening.
If you reverse the charges when you make a telephone call, the person who you are phoning pays the cost of the call and not you.
If you call someone as a twit, you are insulting them and saying that they are silly or stupid.

ext.ext_cn: 照片背面只有简单的几个字——“梦露女士”。
ext.ext_en: On the back of the photo is written the simple caption, 'Mrs. Monroe'.

defs.def_en: A caption is the words printed underneath a picture or cartoon which explain what it is about.

defs.def_cn: 为(照片或漫画)添加说明文字

ext.ext_cn: 《太阳报》在黛安娜王妃的一张照片下写了一段说明文字——“披着面纱的王妃”。
ext.ext_en: The Sun had captioned a picture of Princess Diana 'Princess of Veils'...

ext.ext_cn: 配图文字为“人民的力量”。
ext.ext_en: The photograph is captioned 'People Power'...

defs.def_en: When someone captions a picture or cartoon, they put a caption under it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们这样做并未打算进一步获利，而是出于一种义不容辞的贵族责任感。
ext.ext_en: They did so without hope of further profit and out of a sense of noblesse oblige.

defs.def_en: Noblesse oblige is the idea that people with advantages, for example those of a high social class, should help and do things for other people.
Wheatgerm is the middle part of a grain of wheat which is rich in vitamins and is often added to other food.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （道路或区域）交通阻塞的，拥堵的

ext.ext_cn: 他在两周前首次承诺解决英国道路拥堵的问题。
ext.ext_en: He first promised two weeks ago to clear Britain's congested roads...

ext.ext_cn: 有些地方挤满了车和人。
ext.ext_en: Some areas are congested with both cars and people.

defs.def_en: A congested road or area is extremely crowded and blocked with traffic or people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (身体部位)堵塞的，充血的，淤血的

ext.ext_cn: 他颈动脉栓塞，危在旦夕。
ext.ext_en: The arteries in his neck had become fatally congested.

defs.def_en: If a part of the body is congested, it is blocked.

ext.ext_cn: 我个人从来都不同意性别有优劣之分的观点。
ext.ext_en: I've personally never subscribed to the view that either sex is superior to the other.

defs.def_en: If you subscribe to an opinion or belief, you are one of a number of people who have this opinion or belief.

ext.ext_cn: 我订阅《新科学家》主要是为了了解科学的最新进展。
ext.ext_en: My main reason for subscribing to New Scientist is to keep abreast of advances in science.

defs.def_en: If you subscribe to a magazine or a newspaper, you pay to receive copies of it regularly.

ext.ext_cn: 全球新闻网络是由多个被称为新闻组的讨论组组成，任何人都可以注册加入。
ext.ext_en: Usenet is a collection of discussion groups, known as newsgroups, to which anybody can subscribe.

defs.def_en: If you subscribe to an online newsgroup or service, you send a message saying that you wish to receive it or belong to it.

defs.def_cn: 定期资助;定期捐款;定期捐助

ext.ext_cn: 我定期向几个中意的慈善机构捐款。
ext.ext_en: I subscribe to a few favourite charities.

defs.def_en: If you subscribe to a charity or a campaign, you send money to it regularly.

ext.ext_cn: 员工申请认购的股份远远超出实际可认购的额度。
ext.ext_en: Employees subscribed for far more shares than were available.

defs.def_en: If you subscribe for shares in a company, you apply to buy shares in that company.

ext.ext_en: Her center is typical of many across the country — a non-profit organization that cares for about 50 children.

ext.ext_en: This only goes to show how this racist leopard has in no way changed his spots.

defs.def_en: If you say that a leopard cannot change its spots, you mean that people or things are not able to change their basic characteristics, especially when you are critical of those characteristics.
The interment of a dead person is their burial.
A mountain lion is a wild animal that is a member of the cat family. Mountain lions have brownish-grey fur and live in mountain regions of North and South America.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这么多设备几乎一生产出来就要被淘汰。
ext.ext_en: So much equipment becomes obsolete almost as soon as it's made.

defs.def_en: Something that is obsolete is no longer needed because something better has been invented.
A clod of earth is a large lump of earth.

ext.ext_en: The whole country has been in a state of political ferment for some months.

ext.ext_en: To serve the needs of bakers, manufacturers ferment the yeast to produce a more concentrated product.

defs.def_en: If a food, drink, or other natural substance ferments, or if it is fermented, a chemical change takes place in it so that alcohol is produced. This process forms part of the production of alcoholic drinks such as wine and beer.

ext.ext_cn: “整本书你都读完了吗？”她目光敏锐地问道。
ext.ext_en: 'Have you read the whole book?' she asks, gimlet-eyed.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has gimlet eyes, you mean that they look at people or things very carefully, and seem to notice every detail.
A spliff is a cigarette which contains cannabis or marijuana.

ext.ext_en: Jones's wise words are a timely reality check for many at the club who believe the great days are just around the corner.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a reality check for someone, you mean that it makes them recognize the truth about a situation, especially about the difficulties involved in something they want to achieve.

ext.ext_cn: 描绘纳尔逊指挥的那些最著名战役的一组画作
ext.ext_en: ...a gallery of pictures depicting Nelson's most famous battles.

defs.def_en: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

ext.ext_cn: 玛格丽特·阿特伍德的小说描述了一个黑暗无望的未来美国。
ext.ext_en: Margaret Atwood's novel depicts a gloomy, futuristic America...

ext.ext_en: Children's books often depict farmyard animals as gentle, lovable creatures.

defs.def_en: To depict someone or something means to describe them or give an impression of them in writing.

ext.ext_cn: 拼凑起新政府以避免选举
ext.ext_en: ...to avoid an election by patching together a new government...

ext.ext_cn: 一份协议被仓促拼凑了出来。
ext.ext_en: A hasty deal was patched together.

defs.def_en: If you patch something together, you form it from a number of parts in a quick, hurried way.

ext.ext_en: There is high demand for city centre offices.

defs.def_en: The city centre is the busiest part of a city, where most of the shops and businesses are.

defs.def_cn: （警察等）执法者；（律师等）法律工作者

ext.ext_en: ...the 61-year-old lawman who headed the enquiry.

defs.def_en: Lawmen are men such as policemen or lawyers, whose work involves the law.
In former times in western North America, a lawman was a sheriff or deputy sheriff.
A rutabaga is a round yellow root vegetable with a brown or purple skin.

ext.ext_cn: 把面包屑炸成金褐色为止。

defs.def_en: When you fry food, you cook it in a pan that contains hot fat or oil.  →see usage note at:cook

ext.ext_en: It is not an unsympathetic biography, but Sir Edward has taken against it.

ext.ext_en: ...the system whereby Britons choose their family doctors and the government pays those doctors...

ext.ext_en: He answered our questions in English but with a thick accent...

ext.ext_en: How could she have been so thick?

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as thick, you think they are stupid.

defs.def_cn: 大量而迅速地;接二连三地

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢全身心投入到事情当中。
ext.ext_en: I enjoy being in the thick of things...

ext.ext_cn: 彼得森突然发现自己身陷一场殊死搏斗中。
ext.ext_en: Peterson suddenly found himself in the thick of desperate fighting.

ext.ext_en: The butler always laid the table.

ext.ext_en: Public utilities dig up roads to lay pipes.

ext.ext_en: They were laying a trap for the kidnapper.

ext.ext_cn: 我的金丝雀生了一个蛋。

ext.ext_cn: 春天严寒的天气降低了母鸡的产蛋能力。

ext.ext_en: Diplomats meeting in Chile have laid the groundwork for far-reaching environmental regulations...

ext.ext_cn: 为自己晚景凄凉承担这么多责任，他接受不了。
