ext.ext_cn: 我看他的这个经理当不到春天之后了。
ext.ext_en: I wouldn't  lay bets on his still remaining manager after the spring...

ext.ext_cn: 我敢打赌迪安现在就在你办公室。
ext.ext_en: I'll lay odds that Dean is at your office  right now.

defs.def_en: If you say that you would lay bets, odds, or money on something happening, you mean that you are very confident that it will happen.
To lay someone means to have sex with them.

defs.def_cn: 床上功夫高者/轻易就上床者
defs.def_en: Lay is used in expressions such a good lay or an easy lay to describe what someone is like as a sexual partner.

ext.ext_cn: 不要吹捧得太露骨，不过一定要恭维得他们很惬意。
ext.ext_en: Don't lay it on too thick, but make sure they are flattered...

ext.ext_cn: 我可能有些自由发挥，有些极端，甚至有些言过其实了。
ext.ext_en: I may have spoken a bit too freely, been a bit extreme, even laid it on a little.

defs.def_en: If someone is laying it on thick or is laying it on, they are exaggerating a statement, experience, or emotion in order to try to impress people.

ext.ext_cn: 该党因此难免被人指责有利益冲突。
ext.ext_en: The party thereby lays itself open to charges of conflict of interest...

ext.ext_cn: 这种言论会让人家笑话她。
ext.ext_en: Such a statement could lay her open to ridicule.

defs.def_en: If you lay yourself open to criticism or attack, or if something lays you open to it, something you do makes it possible or likely that other people will criticize or attack you.

defs.def_cn: （基督教中）平信徒的，世俗的，非神职的

ext.ext_cn: 爱德华是一位循道宗在俗传教士兼社会工作者。
ext.ext_en: Edwards is a Methodist lay preacher and social worker.

defs.def_en: You use lay to describe people who are involved with a Christian church but are not members of the clergy or are not monks or nuns.

defs.def_cn: 业余的；外行的；门外汉的

ext.ext_cn: 非业内人士难以进入医学图书馆。
ext.ext_en: It is difficult for a lay person to gain access to medical libraries...

ext.ext_cn: 它不仅仅是职业外交家的教科书，里面的轶事趣闻外行的读者也会喜欢。
ext.ext_en: It is not just a textbook for professional diplomats. The lay reader will enjoy the anecdotes.

defs.def_en: You use lay to describe people who are not experts or professionals in a particular subject or activity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 1941 年 11 月,佩恩得了严重的肺炎。
ext.ext_en: In November 1941 Payne was seriously ill with pneumonia...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得自己生病了。
ext.ext_en: I was feeling ill...

defs.def_en: Someone who is ill is suffering from a disease or a health problem.

ext.ext_cn: 他的批评者们坚持认为他应该为阿尔及利亚所面临的许多难题负责任。
ext.ext_en: His critics maintain that he's responsible for many of Algeria's ills.

ext.ext_cn: 解决所有问题的多种方案
ext.ext_en: ...various potions that would cure all ills.

defs.def_en: Difficulties and problems are sometimes referred to as ills .

ext.ext_cn: 他们说他们对你并无恶意。
ext.ext_en: They say they mean you no ill.

defs.def_en: Ill is evil or harm.

ext.ext_cn: 该公司保守的本性不利于竞争。
ext.ext_en: The company's conservative instincts sit ill with competition.

defs.def_en: Ill means the same as 'badly'.

ext.ext_cn: 她给家庭带来了厄运。
ext.ext_en: She had brought ill luck into her family...

ext.ext_cn: 他说他对约翰逊并无恶感。
ext.ext_en: He says that he bears no ill feelings towards Johnson.

defs.def_en: You can use ill in front of some nouns to indicate that you are referring to something harmful or unpleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 有可能他不会上场,但是我几乎承受不起失去他的损失。
ext.ext_en: It's possible he won't play but I can ill afford to lose him...

ext.ext_cn: 我们经不起再有丑闻出现了。
ext.ext_en: We can ill afford another scandal...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone can ill afford to do something, or can ill afford something, you mean that they must prevent it from happening because it would be harmful or embarrassing to them.

ext.ext_cn: 进展很不顺利,对俄罗斯议会来说这可能是个坏兆头。
ext.ext_en: It's an ominous development that may bode ill for the Russian parliament.

defs.def_en: If something bodes ill or augurs ill, it gives you a reason to fear that something harmful might happen soon.

ext.ext_cn: 圣诞节前不久,他突然不明原因地病倒了。
ext.ext_en: Shortly before Christmas, he was mysteriously taken ill...

ext.ext_cn: 她患麻疹病倒了。
ext.ext_en: She fell ill with measles.

defs.def_en: If you fall ill or are taken ill, you suddenly become ill.

ext.ext_cn: 最近的事件应该会让每个人在预测某处不可能发生什么事时变得谨慎起来,不论是好事还是坏事。
ext.ext_en: Recent events should make everyone modest about saying what cannot happen there, for good or ill.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is happening or will happen for good or ill, you mean that it is out of anyone's control whether it happens and what its effects will be.

defs.def_cn: （尤指经过千辛万苦）赢回，夺回

ext.ext_cn: 政府必须勤奋工作以重新赢得人民的信任。
ext.ext_en: The Government will have to work hard to win back the confidence of the people...

ext.ext_cn: 于是，他去打官司赢回了他的工作。
ext.ext_en: So he went and filed a suit and won his job back.

defs.def_en: If you win back something that you have lost, you get it again, especially as a result of a great effort.
A cello is a musical instrument with four strings that looks like a large violin. You play the cello with a bow while sitting down and holding it upright between your legs.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 使人悲痛的;令人心碎的

ext.ext_cn: 令人心碎的难民照片
ext.ext_en: ...heart-rending pictures of refugees...

ext.ext_cn: 我听到了最让人揪心的尖叫和呻吟。
ext.ext_en: I heard the most heartrending screams and moans.

defs.def_en: You use heart-rending to describe something that causes you to feel great sadness and pity.

defs.def_cn: 中产阶级，中产阶层(通常指商人、经理、医生、律师和教师)

ext.ext_cn: 19世纪晚期中产阶级的壮大
ext.ext_en: ...the expansion of the middle class in the late 19th century...

ext.ext_cn: 总统可能已经得到了一些中产阶级的支持。
ext.ext_en: The President may have secured some support from the middle classes.

defs.def_en: The middle class or middle classes are the people in a society who are not working class or upper class. Business people, managers, doctors, lawyers, and teachers are usually regarded as middle class.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (态度等)中产阶级的，中产阶级特有的

ext.ext_cn: 典型的中产阶级家庭教育
ext.ext_en: ...a very middle-class upbringing.

defs.def_en: People sometimes describe attitudes as middle class when they think that they are typical of middle class people, for example because they are very conventional or attach too much importance to possessions.

defs.def_cn: (经常中断其他电视或广播节目而播出的)重要新闻，简明新闻

ext.ext_cn: 我们中断节目，插播一条重要新闻。
ext.ext_en: We interrupt our programmes for a newsflash.

defs.def_en: A newsflash is an important item of news that television or radio companies broadcast as soon as they receive it, often interrupting other programmes to do so.

ext.ext_cn: 据我们调查,八分之一的女性不能生育。
ext.ext_en: According to one survey, one woman in eight is infertile.

defs.def_en: A person or animal that is infertile is unable to produce babies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 被污染的废物经常被随意倒掉,周边土地因此而变得很贫瘠。
ext.ext_en: The polluted waste is often dumped, making the surrounding land infertile.

defs.def_en: Infertile soil is of poor quality so that plants cannot grow in it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这一古板的老旧机构拒绝承认人们对流行音乐的需求。
ext.ext_en: The fusty old establishment refused to recognise the demand for popular music.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as fusty, you disapprove of them because they are old-fashioned in attitudes or ideas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 发霉味的旧地毯
ext.ext_en: ...fusty old carpets.

defs.def_en: A fusty place or thing has a smell that is not fresh or pleasant.
Absolute zero is a theoretical temperature that is thought to be the lowest possible temperature.

defs.def_cn: 未被阅读的；无人翻阅的

ext.ext_cn: 他所有未发表的作品必须在被人看到之前销毁。
ext.ext_en: All his unpublished writing should be destroyed unread...

ext.ext_cn: 他读完了数月之内出的没读的期刊。
ext.ext_en: He caught up on months of unread periodicals.

defs.def_en: If a book or other piece of writing is unread, you or other people have not read it, for example because it is boring or because you have no time.

ext.ext_en: Postmodernists say there is no objective truth. Why should anyone believe them?

ext.ext_cn: 后现代主义者对宏大的意识形态叙事的怀疑
ext.ext_en: ...the post-modernist suspicion of grand ideological narratives.

defs.def_en: A post-modernist is a writer, artist, or architect who is influenced by post-modernism.
Lemon curd is a thick yellow food made from lemons. You spread it on bread or use it to fill cakes or pastries.

ext.ext_cn: 人们认为伊迪丝是一个诡计多端的贪婪女人。
ext.ext_en: Edith was seen as a conniving, greedy woman.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as conniving, you mean you dislike them because they make secret plans in order to get things for themselves or harm other people.

defs.def_cn: (用于制作糖衣、甜点的)精细白糖粉
defs.def_en: Icing sugar is very fine white sugar that is used for making icing and sweets.

ext.ext_cn: 我可以立即逮捕你！
ext.ext_en: I could have you arrested forthwith!

defs.def_en: Forthwith means immediately.

defs.def_cn: (身心机能的)失调，不适，紊乱，疾病

ext.ext_en: ...a rare nerve disorder that can cause paralysis of the arms.

ext.ext_cn: 一位长于治疗饮食失调的精神病专家
ext.ext_en: ...a psychiatrist who specialises in eating disorders...

defs.def_en: A disorder is a problem or illness which affects someone's mind or body.

ext.ext_en: The emergency room was in disorder...

ext.ext_en: Inside all was disorder: drawers fallen out, shoes and boots scattered.

defs.def_en: Disorder is a state of being untidy, badly prepared, or badly organized.

defs.def_en: Disorder is violence or rioting in public.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: She is expected to be subservient to her uncle.

defs.def_en: If you are subservient, you do whatever someone wants you to do.

ext.ext_en: The woman's needs are seen as subservient to the group interest.

defs.def_en: If you treat one thing as subservient to another, you treat it as less important than the other thing.

ext.ext_en: Those two processes are very closely interlinked...

ext.ext_en: The question to be addressed is interlinked with the question of human rights.

ext.ext_en: Food shortages forced many townspeople into the country to grow their own food.

defs.def_en: The townspeople of a town or city are the people who live there.

ext.ext_cn: 奶牛群
ext.ext_en: ...dairy herds.

defs.def_en: A herd is a large group of animals of one kind that live together.

defs.def_cn: （缺乏独立思想的）一般民众，芸芸众生

ext.ext_cn: 他们是独立的个体，不愿随大溜。
ext.ext_en: They are individuals; they will not follow the herd.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has joined the herd or follows the herd, you are criticizing them because you think that they behave just like everyone else and do not think for themselves.

ext.ext_cn: 他开始将犯人集中在一起赶出来。
ext.ext_en: He began to herd the prisoners out...

ext.ext_cn: 这群人被赶上了一辆公共汽车。
ext.ext_en: The group was herded into a bus.

defs.def_en: If you herd people somewhere, you make them move there in a group.

ext.ext_en: Stefano used a motor cycle to herd the sheep...

ext.ext_en: A boy herded half a dozen camels down towards the water trough.

defs.def_en: If you herd animals, you make them move along as a group.

defs.def_cn: 不合法的;非法的;违反规则的

ext.ext_en: Birth control was illegal there until 1978...

defs.def_cn: (移民)非法入境的;(劳工)非法务工的

ext.ext_cn: 雇用很多非法移民的服装厂
ext.ext_en: ...a clothing factory where many illegals worked.

ext.ext_cn: 雇用很多非法移民的服装厂
ext.ext_en: ...a clothing factory where many illegals worked.

defs.def_en: Illegal immigrants or workers have travelled into a country or are working without official permission.

defs.def_cn: （视力、听力、思维的）敏锐，敏锐度

ext.ext_cn: 我们致力于提高视觉的敏锐度。
ext.ext_en: We work on improving visual acuity.

defs.def_en: Acuity is sharpness of vision or hearing, or quickness of thought.

ext.ext_cn: 列车驶入了一个车站。
ext.ext_en: The train pulled into a station...

ext.ext_cn: 我们能赶上凌晨的火车。
ext.ext_en: We can catch the early morning train...

defs.def_en: A train is a number of carriages, cars, or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Trains carry people and goods from one place to another.

ext.ext_cn: 在过去，这往往由一队驮载行李的骆驼完成。
ext.ext_en: In the old days this used to be done with a baggage train of camels.

ext.ext_cn: 一长队油轮
ext.ext_en: ...a long train of oil tankers.

defs.def_en: A train of vehicles, people, or animals is a long line of them travelling slowly in the same direction.

defs.def_cn: (想法、事件等的)(一)连串，(一)系列

ext.ext_en: He lost his train of thought for a moment, then recovered it...

ext.ext_cn: 贾尔斯触发了随后的一系列事件，这些事件最终将以悲剧收场。
ext.ext_en: Giles set in motion a train of events which would culminate in tragedy.

defs.def_en: A train of thought or a train of events is a connected sequence, in which each thought or event seems to occur naturally or logically as a result of the previous one.
The train of a woman's formal dress or wedding dress is the long part at the back of it which flows along the floor behind her.

ext.ext_cn: 仪式马上就要开始了。
ext.ext_en: In a moment the ceremony was in train…

ext.ext_cn: 他称赞政府启动的经济改革。
ext.ext_en: He praised the economic reforms set in train by the government.

defs.def_en: If a process or event is in train or has been set in train, it is happening or starting to happen.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车随之带来其他一大堆问题。
ext.ext_en: The cars have brought in their train a host of other problems.

defs.def_en: If something brings problems or difficulties in its train, the problems or difficulties occur as a natural or logical result of it.

ext.ext_cn: 美国准备训练军队参加。
ext.ext_en: The US was ready to train its troops to participate...

ext.ext_cn: 斯塔夫罗斯正受训成为一名牧师。
ext.ext_en: Stavros was training to be a priest...

defs.def_en: If someone trains you to do something, they teach you the skills that you need in order to do it. If you train to do something, you learn the skills that you need in order to do it.

defs.def_cn: 锻炼，培养(某一素质或能力)

ext.ext_en: I see my degree as something which will train my mind and improve my chances of getting a job...

ext.ext_cn: 一些孩子在入学时比其他孩子受过更好的感知技能培养。
ext.ext_en: Some children come to school with more finely trained perceptual skills than others.

defs.def_en: To train a natural quality or talent that someone has, for example their voice or musical ability, means to help them to develop it.

defs.def_cn: (为体育活动)(使)进行训练(或锻炼)

ext.ext_en: Strachan is training for the new season...

ext.ext_en: He has spent a year training crews for next month's round the world race.

defs.def_en: If you train for a physical activity such as a race or if someone trains you for it, you prepare for it by doing particular physical exercises.

ext.ext_cn: 可以训练嗅探犬追捕他们。
ext.ext_en: Sniffer dogs could be trained to track them down.

ext.ext_cn: 训练过数百只狗的人
ext.ext_en: ...a man who trained hundreds of dogs...

defs.def_en: If an animal or bird is trained to do particular things, it is taught to do them, for example in order to be able to work for someone or to be a good pet.

ext.ext_cn: 她将双筒望远镜对准地平线。
ext.ext_en: She trained her binoculars on the horizon...

ext.ext_cn: 警方摄像头已特别对准那一区域。
ext.ext_en: Police cameras had been specifically trained on that area.

defs.def_en: If you train something such as a gun, a camera, or a light on a person or thing, you aim it at them and keep it towards them.

defs.def_cn: (经整枝)使(植物)朝特定方向生长

ext.ext_cn: 不要让嫩枝爬上篱笆，要令其沿着篱笆伏地向两边长。

defs.def_en: If you train a tree, bush, or plant in a particular direction, you tie it and cut it so that it grows in that direction.

ext.ext_cn: 铜制壁炉围栏
ext.ext_en: ...a brass fender.

The fenders of a boat are objects which hang against the outside and protect it from damage when it comes next to a harbour wall or another boat.

defs.def_cn: （尤指私人飞机或军机专用的）简易着陆场，简易跑道
defs.def_en: A landing strip is a long flat piece of land from which aircraft can take off and land, especially one used only by private or military aircraft.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 给予帮助的;热心援助的;支持的

ext.ext_en: Her boss was very supportive and gave her time off work to see her mum.

defs.def_en: If you are supportive, you are kind and helpful to someone at a difficult or unhappy time in their life.

defs.def_cn: （尤用于相对小群体而言的）大众，公众，普通百姓

ext.ext_cn: 这些慈善团体依赖于公众的怜悯之心和慷慨解囊。
ext.ext_en: These charities depend on the compassionate feelings and generosity of the general public...

ext.ext_en: Unemployment is 10 percent among the general public and about 40 percent among North African immigrants.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the people in a society as the general public, especially when you are contrasting people in general with a small group.

defs.def_cn: 突然想到的好主意；灵感

ext.ext_cn: 1980年，她的一次突发奇想改变了她的生活。
ext.ext_en: In 1980 she had a brainwave that changed her life.

defs.def_en: If you have a brainwave, you suddenly have a clever idea.

ext.ext_cn: 对他的脑电波进行了连续监测。
ext.ext_en: His brainwaves were constantly monitored.

defs.def_en: Brainwaves are electrical signals produced by the brain which can be recorded and measured.

ext.ext_cn: 我的小说《教区长的妻子》正被改编成电视剧，由林赛·邓肯饰片名主角。
ext.ext_en: My novel 'The Rector's Wife' is being adapted for TV, with Lindsay Duncan in the title role.

defs.def_en: The title role in a play or film is the role referred to in the name of the play or film.

defs.def_cn: (种在一起、拌色拉用的)芥菜和水芹
defs.def_en: Mustard and cress is very young mustard plants and cress plants grown together and eaten in salad.

ext.ext_cn: 《通往天堂的阶梯》的开篇和弦
ext.ext_en: ...the opening chords of 'Stairway to Heaven'.

defs.def_en: See also:vocal cords;A chord is a number of musical notes played or sung at the same time with a pleasing effect.

ext.ext_cn: 詹金斯先生关于稳定的论点引起了欧洲两位最有影响的政治家的共鸣。
ext.ext_en: Mr Jenkins' arguments for stability struck a chord with Europe's two most powerful politicians...

ext.ext_cn: 伯克的观点无疑引起了议会的积极回应。
ext.ext_en: Burke's sentiments undoubtedly struck a responsive chord in Parliament.

defs.def_en: If something strikes a chord with you, it makes you feel sympathy or enthusiasm.

ext.ext_cn: 他的政纲靠的是铁杆追随者的支持。
ext.ext_en: His politics were based on loyal partisanship.

defs.def_en: Partisanship is support for a person or group without fair consideration of the facts and circumstances.

defs.def_cn: (说话时的)首音误置(如将long road 说成 wrong load)
defs.def_en: A spoonerism is a mistake made by a speaker in which the first sounds of two words are changed over, often with a humorous result, for example when someone says 'wrong load' instead of 'long road'.

ext.ext_cn: 他的舌头迅速舔了一下嘴唇。
ext.ext_en: His tongue flicked across his lips...

ext.ext_cn: 那个男人迅速从大腿一侧抽出枪来。
ext.ext_en: The man's gun flicked up from beside his thigh...

defs.def_en: If something flicks in a particular direction, or if someone flicks it, it moves with a short, sudden movement.

ext.ext_cn: 雪莉弹掉了黑色套装袖子上的一点小绒毛。
ext.ext_en: Shirley flicked a speck of fluff from the sleeve of her black suit...

ext.ext_cn: 艾伦伸手把信拂开了。
ext.ext_en: Alan stretched out his hand and flicked the letter away.

defs.def_en: If you flick something away, or off something else, you remove it with a quick movement of your hand or finger.

ext.ext_cn: 他帮她上马，之后挥动了缰绳。
ext.ext_en: He helped her up before flicking the reins...

ext.ext_cn: 她叹了一口气，然后用洗碗布轻掸着柜台。
ext.ext_en: She sighed and flicked a dishcloth at the counter...

defs.def_en: If you flick something such as a whip or a towel, or flick something with it, you hold one end of it and move your hand quickly up and then forward, so that the other end moves.

ext.ext_cn: 他啪的一声打开了门边墙上的电灯开关。
ext.ext_en: He flicked a light-switch on the wall beside the door...

ext.ext_cn: 萨姆啪啪不停地把手电筒开了又关。
ext.ext_en: Sam was flicking a flashlight on and off...

defs.def_en: If you flick a switch, or flick an electrical appliance on or off, you press the switch sharply so that it moves into a different position and works the equipment.

defs.def_cn: 快速翻阅;浏览;不停地转换(电视频道)

ext.ext_cn: 她正翻看着桌上的几本杂志。
ext.ext_en: She was flicking through some magazines on a table...

ext.ext_cn: 我会快速地翻页，直到找到要找的那一部分。
ext.ext_en: I'll just flick through the pages until I find the right section...

defs.def_en: If you flick through a book or magazine, you turn its pages quickly, for example to get a general idea of its contents or to look for a particular item. If you flick through television channels, you continually change channels very quickly, for example using a remote control.

ext.ext_cn: 好了，约翰，回见，再会。
ext.ext_en: Okay John. See you again. Ta-ta...

ext.ext_cn: 回头见。
ext.ext_en: Ta-ta for now.

defs.def_en: Ta-ta is used to say goodbye.
Chaff is the outer part of grain such as wheat. It is removed before the grain is used as food.

ext.ext_cn: 分清良莠并不总是很容易。
ext.ext_en: It isn't always easy to separate the wheat from the chaff.

defs.def_en: If you separate the wheat from the chaff or sort the wheat from the chaff, you decide which people or things in a group are good or important and which are not.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Any comparison that is not strictly factual runs the risk of being interpreted as subjective.

defs.def_en: Something that is factual is concerned with facts or contains facts, rather than giving theories or personal interpretations.

ext.ext_cn: 文盲人口占有相当高的比例。
ext.ext_en: A large percentage of the population is illiterate.

ext.ext_cn: 扫盲中心
ext.ext_en: ...an educational centre for illiterates.

defs.def_en: Someone who is illiterate does not know how to read or write.

defs.def_cn: (音乐、科技、经济上)知之甚少的,接近无知的

ext.ext_cn: 许多高级经理都对技术知之甚少。
ext.ext_en: Many senior managers are technologically illiterate.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as musically, technologically, or economically illiterate, you mean that they do not know much about music, technology, or economics.

ext.ext_cn: 我回到旅馆的时候，劳拉和彼得正互相叫嚷着。
ext.ext_en: When I came back to the hotel Laura and Peter were shouting and bawling at each other...

ext.ext_en: Then a voice bawled: 'Lay off! I'll kill you, you little rascal!'...

defs.def_en: If you bawl, you shout in a very loud voice, for example because you are angry or you want people to hear you.

ext.ext_en: One of the toddlers was bawling, and the other had a runny nose.

ext.ext_cn: 大声啼哭的婴儿
ext.ext_en: ...a bawling baby.

defs.def_en: If you say that a child is bawling, you are annoyed because it is crying loudly.

defs.def_cn: 性爱的;性欲的;性行为的

ext.ext_en: This was the first sexual relationship I had had...

ext.ext_en: Men's sexual fantasies often have little to do with their sexual desire.

defs.def_en: Sexual feelings or activities are connected with the act of sex or with people's desire for sex.

defs.def_cn: 性别的;性别差异的;两性间的

ext.ext_en: Women's groups denounced sexual discrimination.

ext.ext_en: ...sexual and racial equal opportunities.

defs.def_en: Sexual means relating to the differences between male and female people.

defs.def_cn: 性取向的;不同性观念的

defs.def_en: Sexual means relating to the differences between heterosexuals and homosexuals.

ext.ext_en: Girls generally reach sexual maturity two years earlier than boys.

ext.ext_cn: 有性繁殖
ext.ext_en: ...sexual reproduction.

defs.def_en: Sexual means relating to the biological process by which people and animals produce young.

defs.def_cn: (抨击等)尖锐的,猛烈的;(削减)大幅度的，严重的

ext.ext_en: ...the book mounted a swingeing attack on the materialist, growth-oriented economics of the day...

ext.ext_en: There have been swingeing cuts on government subsidies, on housing, food and fuel.

defs.def_en: A swingeing action, such as an attack or cut, is very great or severe.

ext.ext_en: They were clearing up when the second bomb exploded...

ext.ext_en: A school bus was hit by gunfire which exploded the fuel tank.

defs.def_en: If an object such as a bomb explodes or if someone or something explodes it, it bursts loudly and with great force, often causing damage or injury.

ext.ext_en: Do you fear that you'll burst into tears or explode with anger in front of her?...

ext.ext_en: 'What happened!' I exploded...

defs.def_en: If someone explodes, they express strong feelings suddenly and violently.

ext.ext_en: The population explodes to 40,000 during the tourist season...

ext.ext_cn: 日本公司的投资已经开始激增。
ext.ext_en: Investment by Japanese firms has exploded.

defs.def_en: If something explodes, it increases suddenly and rapidly in number or intensity.

ext.ext_en: Electricity privatisation has exploded the myth of cheap nuclear power...

ext.ext_en: Such rumours have only recently been exploded.

defs.def_en: If someone explodes a theory or myth, they prove that it is wrong or impossible.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: An experience or action that is rewarding gives you satisfaction or brings you benefits.

ext.ext_en: ...a storeroom filled with massive old furniture covered with dust.

defs.def_en: A storeroom is a room in which you keep things until they are needed.

ext.ext_en: He asked to be put through to Charley Lunn.

defs.def_en: When someone puts through someone who is making a telephone call, they make the connection that allows the telephone call to take place.

defs.def_en: If someone puts you through an unpleasant experience, they make you experience it.

ext.ext_en: ...the stylistic conventions of Egyptian art.

ext.ext_en: ...the UN convention on climate change.

ext.ext_cn: 日内瓦公约
ext.ext_en: ...the Geneva convention.

defs.def_en: A convention is an official agreement between countries or groups of people.

defs.def_cn: (组织、政治团体的)大会，大型会议

ext.ext_en: ...the annual convention of the Society of Professional Journalists.

ext.ext_cn: 共和党代表大会
ext.ext_en: ...the Republican convention.

defs.def_en: A convention is a large meeting of an organization or political group.

ext.ext_en: ...the iconography of revolutionary posters.

ext.ext_cn: 宗教图腾
ext.ext_en: ...religious iconography.

ext.ext_en: 'Robinson Crusoe' is one of the most famous books in the world.

ext.ext_en: Can I have a book of first class stamps please?

defs.def_en: A book of something such as stamps, matches, or tickets is a small number of them fastened together between thin cardboard covers.

ext.ext_en: Laurie revealed she had booked herself a flight home last night.

defs.def_en: When you book something such as a hotel room or a ticket, you arrange to have it or use it at a particular time.

defs.def_cn: （公司或组织机构的）账册，账簿，名册

ext.ext_en: For the most part he left the books to his managers and accountants...

ext.ext_en: Around 12 per cent of the people on our books are in the computing industry.

ext.ext_en: League referee Keith Cooper booked him in the first half for a tussle with the goalie.

defs.def_en: When a referee books a football player who has seriously broken the rules of the game, he or she officially writes down the player's name.

ext.ext_en: They took him to the station and booked him for assault with a deadly weapon.

ext.ext_en: Sir John was definitely in the Treasury's bad books for incorrect thinking on economic prospects...

ext.ext_en: Right from my very first day I seemed to be in everyone's good books.

defs.def_en: If you are in someone's bad books, they are annoyed with you. If you are in their good books, they are pleased with you.

ext.ext_cn: 应该要求警方介入调查，以将罪犯早日绳之以法。
ext.ext_en: Police should be asked to investigate so that the guilty can be brought to book soon.

defs.def_en: If you bring someone to book, you punish them for an offence or make them explain their behaviour officially.

defs.def_cn: 完全不了解的人；一无所知的事物；谜

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is a closed book, you mean that you do not know anything about them.

defs.def_cn: （旅馆、餐馆、剧院或交通工具）被预订一空，满座，客满

ext.ext_en: The car ferries from the mainland are often fully booked by February.

defs.def_en: If a hotel, restaurant, theatre, or transport service is fully booked, or booked solid, it is booked up.

ext.ext_cn: 这位迄今为止最杰出的，在我看来，也是后人无法超越的经理，就要退休了。
ext.ext_en: The greatest manager there has ever been, or ever will be in my book, is retiring.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...neglectful parents.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as neglectful, you think they fail to do everything they should do to look after someone or something properly.

ext.ext_en: Have I been neglectful of my friend, taking him for granted?

defs.def_en: If someone is neglectful of something, they do not give it the attention or consideration that it should be given.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的儿子，本和乔纳森，分别是3岁和6岁。

ext.ext_en: They finished first and second respectively.

defs.def_en: Respectively means in the same order as the items that you have just mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 一阵狂风刮过山谷。

ext.ext_cn: 短暂的一阵欢喜

defs.def_en: If you feel a gust of emotion, you feel the emotion suddenly and intensely.

defs.def_en: If a bad situation or change is irremediable, the situation cannot be improved.

defs.def_en: You use wholly to emphasize the extent or degree to which something is the case.

defs.def_en: If you say that a situation is a strain, you mean that it makes you worried and tense.

defs.def_en: When you sniff, you breathe in air through your nose hard enough to make a sound, for example when you are trying not to cry, or in order to show disapproval.

ext.ext_cn: 他突然停下来，闻了闻空气里的味道。
ext.ext_en: Suddenly, he stopped and sniffed the air...

ext.ext_cn: 她怀疑地闻了闻。
ext.ext_en: She sniffed at it suspiciously.

defs.def_en: If you sniff something or sniff at it, you smell it by sniffing.

defs.def_cn: 嗤之以鼻地表示;轻蔑地说

ext.ext_cn: 她轻蔑地说道：“游客!”
ext.ext_en: 'Tourists!' she sniffed.

defs.def_en: You can use sniff to indicate that someone says something in a way that shows their disapproval or contempt.

ext.ext_cn: 这份工资也不容小觑。
ext.ext_en: The salary was not to be sniffed at either...

ext.ext_cn: 外交部消息人士对有可能派出英国军队的报道不屑一顾。
ext.ext_en: Foreign Office sources sniffed at reports that British troops might be sent.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not to be sniffed at, you think it is very good or worth having. If someone sniffs at something, they do not think it is good enough, or they express their contempt for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他觉得晕乎乎的，好像吸了胶毒一样。
ext.ext_en: He felt light-headed, as if he'd sniffed glue.

defs.def_en: If someone sniffs a substance such as glue, they deliberately breathe in the substance or the gases from it as a drug.

ext.ext_cn: 你知道如果他们嗅到马上会进行谋杀调查会怎么样。
ext.ext_en: You know what they'll be like if they get a sniff of a murder investigation...

ext.ext_cn: 新闻界嗅到了一点消息没有？
ext.ext_en: Have the Press got a sniff yet?...

defs.def_en: If you get a sniff of something, you learn or guess that it might be happening or might be near.

ext.ext_cn: 在国会的整整21年里，温特顿没有得到过任何在政府里工作的机会。
ext.ext_en: Winterton has never had a sniff of a government job in his entire twenty-one years in parliament.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has not had a sniff of something, you mean that they have not had even a small chance of getting it.

ext.ext_cn: 中央委员会是该党的决策机构。
ext.ext_en: The Central Committee is the party's policymaking body...

ext.ext_cn: 他将在政府的政策制定上起至关重要的幕后作用。
ext.ext_en: He will play a key background role in government policy-making.

defs.def_en: Policy-making is the making of policies.

defs.def_cn: 最高点；顶点；顶峰时刻；顶峰阶段

ext.ext_cn: 他的作品被认为是电影艺术的巅峰之作。
ext.ext_en: His work is considered the acme of cinematic art.

defs.def_en: The acme of something is its highest point of achievement or excellence.

defs.def_cn: 动词词组（由动词或主要动词与情态动词或助动词连用构成）
defs.def_en: A verb group or verbal group consists of a verb, or of a main verb following a modal or one or more auxiliaries. Examples are 'walked', 'can see', and 'had been waiting'.

ext.ext_cn: 小组成员必须通过角色扮演互相交流。
ext.ext_en: Group members have to communicate with each other through role-play.

defs.def_en: Role play is the act of imitating the character and behaviour of someone who is different from yourself, for example as a training exercise.

ext.ext_cn: 事先和朋友通过角色扮演排练一下面试。
ext.ext_en: Rehearse and role-play the interview with a friend beforehand.

defs.def_en: If people role play, they do a role play.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 恐怕我有点糊涂了，我不确定该从何处着手。
ext.ext_en: I'm afraid I'm a little muddled. I'm not exactly sure where to begin.

ext.ext_cn: 近几年政府交通政策的混乱
ext.ext_en: ...the muddled thinking of the Government's transport policy in recent years.

defs.def_en: If someone is muddled, they are confused about something.

ext.ext_cn: 小火箭捆绑在宇宙飞船上，用于推动飞船飞向火星。
ext.ext_en: The tiny rocket is attached to the spacecraft and is designed to propel it toward Mars.

ext.ext_cn: 火箭推动的榴弹
ext.ext_en: ...rocket-propelled grenades.

defs.def_en: To propel something in a particular direction means to cause it to move in that direction.

ext.ext_cn: 最初是一颗流星促使我从事天文学。
ext.ext_en: It was a shooting star that propelled me into astronomy in the first place...

ext.ext_cn: 他受到内疚感和为父报仇之心的双重驱使。
ext.ext_en: He is propelled by both guilt and the need to avenge his father.

defs.def_en: If something propels you into a particular activity, it causes you to do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为或决定)明智的，理智的，合理的

ext.ext_cn: 也许应该请一个诉状律师。
ext.ext_en: It might be sensible to get a solicitor...

ext.ext_cn: 别去管他们才是明智的。
ext.ext_en: The sensible thing is to leave them alone.

defs.def_en: Sensible actions or decisions are good because they are based on reasons rather than emotions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (人)明智的，理智的，通情达理的

ext.ext_cn: 她是一个理智的女孩，没有惊慌失措。
ext.ext_en: She was a sensible girl and did not panic...

ext.ext_cn: 噢，得了吧，我们还是理智地对待此事吧。
ext.ext_en: Oh come on, let's be sensible about this...

defs.def_en: Sensible people behave in a sensible way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (衣服、鞋子)耐用的，朴素而实用的

ext.ext_cn: 穿上宽松的衣服和舒服的鞋子。
ext.ext_en: Wear loose clothing and sensible footwear.

defs.def_en: Sensible shoes or clothes are practical and strong rather than fashionable and attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 一小片杉树林
ext.ext_en: ...a little copse of fir trees.

defs.def_en: A copse is a small group of trees growing very close to each other.

ext.ext_cn: 她现年87岁，曾经是齐格菲尔时事讽刺剧团的成员之一。
ext.ext_en: She's 87 years old, and a one-time member of the Ziegfeld Follies...

ext.ext_cn: 立法机构通过投票将该国的前度领导人赶下了台。
ext.ext_en: The legislative body had voted to oust the country's onetime rulers.

defs.def_en: One-time is used to describe something such as a job, position, or role which someone used to have, or something which happened in the past.

ext.ext_cn: 我们跟着他上楼来到一个很大的大厅。
ext.ext_en: We followed him up the steps into a large hall...

ext.ext_cn: 请跟我来，夫人。
ext.ext_en: Please follow me, madam...

defs.def_en: If you follow someone who is going somewhere, you move along behind them because you want to go to the same place.

ext.ext_cn: 她意识到那辆奔驰在跟踪她。
ext.ext_en: She realized that the Mercedes was following her...

ext.ext_cn: 我想我们被跟踪了。
ext.ext_en: I think we're being followed.

defs.def_en: If you follow someone who is going somewhere, you move along behind them without their knowledge, in order to catch them or find out where they are going.

ext.ext_cn: 他追随贾尼丝到了纽约，她正在那里准备一个展览。
ext.ext_en: He followed Janice to New York, where she was preparing an exhibition.

defs.def_en: If you follow someone to a place where they have recently gone and where they are now, you go to join them there.

ext.ext_cn: 判决宣布之后发生的暴乱和抢劫
ext.ext_en: ...the rioting and looting that followed the verdict...

ext.ext_cn: 父亲去世之后那几天我不记得有什么其他事了。
ext.ext_en: I remember nothing else about the days following Daddy's death...

defs.def_en: An event, activity, or period of time that follows a particular thing happens or comes after that thing, at a later time.

ext.ext_cn: 她主演的第一部影片是马丁·斯科塞斯的《好家伙》，之后接拍了斯派克·李的《丛林热》。
ext.ext_en: Her first major role was in Martin Scorsese's 'Goodfellas' and she followed this with a part in Spike Lee's 'Jungle Fever'.

ext.ext_cn: 这本书取得了巨大的成功，作者于是又推出一部《弥赛亚的遗产》。
ext.ext_en: The book proved such a success that the authors followed it up with 'The Messianic Legacy'.

defs.def_en: If you follow one thing with another, you do or say the second thing after you have done or said the first thing.

ext.ext_cn: 不能因为一只鸟某一年没有繁殖就断定它第二年也不会繁殖。
ext.ext_en: Just because a bird does not breed one year, it does not follow that it will fail the next...

ext.ext_cn: 如果解释是正确的，可以推断出两件事。
ext.ext_en: If the explanation is right, two things follow...

defs.def_en: If it follows that a particular thing is the case, that thing is a logical result of something else being true or being the case.

defs.def_cn: (文章或讲演)接下来是,后面的是，下面是

ext.ext_cn: 接下来的是目击者的陈述。
ext.ext_en: What follows is an eyewitness account...

ext.ext_cn: 下面列出的是汉斯打算游览的地点。
ext.ext_en: There followed a list of places where Hans intended to visit...

defs.def_en: If you refer to the words that follow or followed, you are referring to the words that come next or came next in a piece of writing or speech.

ext.ext_cn: 如果他们沿着这条路走，就一定会到达一个村庄。
ext.ext_en: If they followed the road, they would be certain to reach a village...

ext.ext_cn: 我们所要做的就是按照地图走。
ext.ext_en: All we had to do was follow the map...

defs.def_en: If you follow a path, route, or set of signs, you go somewhere using the path, route, or signs to direct you.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的路线沿着太平洋海岸，途经人口稠密的街区。
ext.ext_en: Our route follows the Pacific coast through densely populated neighbourhoods...

ext.ext_cn: 洛特河的河道蜿蜒曲折。
ext.ext_en: The Lot river follows a winding and tortuous course.

defs.def_en: If something such as a path or river follows a particular route or line, it goes along that route or line.

defs.def_cn: 注视(运动物体);(眼睛)跟随着

ext.ext_cn: 安注视着一辆缓缓驶过的警车。
ext.ext_en: Ann's eyes followed a police car as it drove slowly past.

defs.def_en: If you follow something with your eyes, or if your eyes follow it, you watch it as it moves or you look along its route or course.

defs.def_cn: 按照…方式发展;以…方式发生

ext.ext_cn: 最终他的获释方式也和其他 6名人质的获释如出一辙。
ext.ext_en: His release turned out to follow the pattern set by that of the other six hostages.

defs.def_en: Something that follows a particular course of development happens or develops in that way.

defs.def_cn: 接受，遵循(建议、指示等);按(菜谱)进行

ext.ext_cn: 注意严格按照说明进行。
ext.ext_en: Take care to follow the instructions carefully...

ext.ext_cn: 每个厨师都有不同的烹饪方式。
ext.ext_en: No two chefs follow the same recipe.

defs.def_en: If you follow advice, an instruction, or a recipe, you act or do something in the way that it indicates.

ext.ext_cn: 他对于这个运动员的崇拜还没有达到要学他吸毒的程度。
ext.ext_en: His admiration for the athlete did not extend to the point where he would follow his example in taking drugs...

ext.ext_cn: 东德怎样做，其他地方一定会效仿。
ext.ext_en: Where eastern Germany goes the rest will surely follow.

defs.def_en: If you follow what someone else has done, you do it too because you think it is a good thing or because you want to copy them.

ext.ext_cn: 他子承父业，成为了一名外科医生。
ext.ext_en: He followed his father and became a surgeon...

ext.ext_cn: 安妮-弗瑞德的儿子子承母业，也进入了音乐圈。
ext.ext_en: Anni-Frid's son has followed her into the music business.

defs.def_en: If you follow someone in what you do, you do the same thing or job as they did previously.

defs.def_cn: 理解，跟得上(解释或故事情节)

ext.ext_cn: 目前为止剧情你能看得懂吗？
ext.ext_en: Can you follow the plot so far?...

ext.ext_cn: 恐怕我没明白。
ext.ext_en: I'm afraid I don't follow.

defs.def_en: If you are able to follow something such as an explanation or the story of a film, you understand it as it continues and develops.

ext.ext_cn: 数以百万计的人关注足球，因为他们发自内心地热爱足球
ext.ext_en: ...the millions of people who follow football because they genuinely love it...

ext.ext_cn: 她密切关注着劳拉的进展。
ext.ext_en: She was following Laura's progress closely.

defs.def_en: If you follow something, you take an interest in it and keep informed about what happens.

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影讲述了两个女人的命运。
ext.ext_en: The film follows the fortunes of two women.

defs.def_en: A story, film, or television programme that follows someone or something is about their experiences over a particular period of time.

defs.def_cn: (欣赏节目的同时)对照看(脚本或乐谱)

ext.ext_cn: 使听者能够一边欣赏一边对照着看的莫扎特歌剧的注释乐谱
ext.ext_en: ...an annotated version of Mozart's opera that allows the listener to follow the score.

defs.def_en: If you follow a score or written copy of a play, you read it while you listen to it being performed.

ext.ext_cn: “你们有自己的宗教信仰吗？”——“是的，我们都是印度教徒。”
ext.ext_en: 'Do you follow any particular religion?' — 'Yes, we're all Hindus.'

defs.def_en: See also:following;If you follow a particular religion or political belief, you have that religion or belief.

ext.ext_cn: 优胜者分别是：E.沃克、R.福斯特、R.盖茨和A.麦金托什。
ext.ext_en: The winners are as follows: E. Walker; R. Foster; R. Gates; A. Mackintosh...

ext.ext_cn: 按照如下操作即可完成。
ext.ext_en: This can be done if you proceed as follows.

defs.def_en: You use as follows in writing or speech to introduce something such as a list, description, or explanation.

ext.ext_cn: 马铃薯仍然是最受欢迎的食物，其次是白面包。
ext.ext_en: Potatoes are still the most popular food, followed by white bread.

defs.def_en: You use followed by to say what comes after something else in a list or ordered set of things.

ext.ext_cn: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。
ext.ext_en: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.

defs.def_en: After mentioning one course of a meal, you can mention the next course by saying what you will have to follow or what there will be to follow .

ext.ext_cn: 领导层不愿意对这些想法的含意进行深入探究。
ext.ext_en: The leadership has been unwilling to follow through the implications of these ideas...

ext.ext_cn: 我接受过演员培训，但是我没有坚持下去。
ext.ext_en: I was trained to be an actress but I didn't follow it through...

defs.def_en: If you follow through an action, plan, or idea or follow through with it, you continue doing or thinking about it until you have done everything possible.

defs.def_cn: 追查;将…深入下去;对…采取进一步行动

ext.ext_cn: 国家安全警察正在追查几条线索。
ext.ext_en: State security police are following up several leads...

ext.ext_cn: 一位警官收集了我的供述，但却没有人愿意追查下去。
ext.ext_en: An officer took a statement from me, but no one's bothered to follow it up.

defs.def_en: See also:follow 5;follow-up;If you follow up something that has been said, suggested, or discovered, you try to find out more about it or take action about it.

ext.ext_cn: 英语
ext.ext_en: ...the English language...

ext.ext_cn: 学生们要掌握一门外语。
ext.ext_en: Students are expected to master a second language...

defs.def_en: A language is a system of communication which consists of a set of sounds and written symbols which are used by the people of a particular country or region for talking or writing.

ext.ext_cn: 学生们仔细研究儿童如何习得语言。
ext.ext_en: Students examined how children acquire language...

ext.ext_cn: 言语不是艺术，但两者都是人类的行为方式。
ext.ext_en: Language is not art but both are forms of human behavior.

defs.def_en: Language is the use of a system of communication which consists of a set of sounds or written symbols.

ext.ext_cn: 商业用语
ext.ext_en: ...the language of business.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the words used in connection with a particular subject as the language of that subject.

ext.ext_cn: 电视公司往往会在审查故事片时删去其中的粗话。
ext.ext_en: Television companies tend to censor bad language in feature films...

ext.ext_cn: 俱乐部里会有一位女孩，你们男的说话注意点。
ext.ext_en: There's a girl gonna be in the club, so you guys watch your language.

defs.def_en: You can refer to someone's use of rude words or swearing as bad language when you find it offensive.

ext.ext_cn: 以平实语言对其作出概述的小册子
ext.ext_en: ...a booklet summarising it in plain language...

ext.ext_cn: 他说话圆通得体、彬彬有礼。
ext.ext_en: The tone of his language was diplomatic and polite...

defs.def_en: The language of a piece of writing or speech is the style in which it is written or spoken.

defs.def_cn: 交流方式，交际方式（包括可识别符号、非语言声音、动作等）

ext.ext_cn: 有些手语可以表达非常复杂的内容。
ext.ext_en: Some sign languages are very sophisticated means of communication.

ext.ext_cn: 计算机的数字语言
ext.ext_en: ...the digital language of computers.

defs.def_en: You can use language to refer to various means of communication involving recognizable symbols, non-verbal sounds, or actions.

ext.ext_cn: 我们被新闻界诋毁为仇外的偏狭之徒。
ext.ext_en: We have been traduced in the press as xenophobic bigots.

defs.def_en: If someone has been traduced, unpleasant and untrue things have deliberately been said about them.
Someone's biographer is a person who writes an account of their life.
A weasel is a small wild animal with a long thin body, a tail, short legs, and reddish-brown fur.

ext.ext_cn: 她在鸭塘边找了条长椅坐下。
ext.ext_en: She chose a bench beside the duck pond and sat down.

ext.ext_cn: 花园里的水池
ext.ext_en: ...a garden pond.

defs.def_en: A pond is a small area of water that is smaller than a lake. Ponds are often made artificially.

ext.ext_cn: 通常，这样的展示是在大西洋另一边进行的。
ext.ext_en: Usually, the presentation is made on the other side of the pond...

ext.ext_cn: 来自大西洋彼岸的游客数量已急剧减少。
ext.ext_en: Tourist numbers from across the pond have dropped dramatically.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to the Atlantic Ocean as the pond .

ext.ext_cn: 由于原料短缺，员工们已将近一个月无事可做。
ext.ext_en: Employees have been idle almost a month because of shortages.

defs.def_en: If people who were working are idle, they have no jobs or work.

ext.ext_cn: 如今机器闲置着。
ext.ext_en: Now the machine is lying idle.

ext.ext_cn: 已经闲置多年的工厂
ext.ext_en: ...factories that had been idle for years.

defs.def_en: If machines or factories are idle, they are not working or being used.

defs.def_cn: 懒散的;懒惰的;无所事事的

ext.ext_cn: 无所事事、整天看报纸的官僚们
ext.ext_en: ...idle bureaucrats who spent the day reading newspapers...

ext.ext_cn: 我一辈子都没碰到过像他们这样吃白饭的工人！
ext.ext_en: I never met such an idle bunch of workers in all my life!

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is idle, you disapprove of them because they are not doing anything and you think they should be.

defs.def_cn: 琐碎无聊的;毫无意义的

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩又絮絮地唠叨了5分钟。
ext.ext_en: Brian kept up the idle chatter for another five minutes.

ext.ext_cn: 无聊的好奇心
ext.ext_en: ...idle curiosity.

defs.def_en: Idle is used to describe something that you do for no particular reason, often because you have nothing better to do.

ext.ext_cn: 假装系统完美无疵是徒劳的。
ext.ext_en: It would be idle to pretend the system is perfect.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is idle to do something, you mean that it is not worth doing it, because it will not achieve anything.

ext.ext_cn: 那其实是唬人的话。
ext.ext_en: It was more of an idle threat than anything...

ext.ext_cn: 他的话不仅仅是虚张声势的自夸。
ext.ext_en: His statement isn't merely an idle boast.

defs.def_en: You refer to an idle threat or boast when you do not think the person making it will or can do what they say.

ext.ext_cn: 他们到他家后，斯科比闲逛了一会儿，抽完了他的香烟。
ext.ext_en: When they reached his house, Scobie idled a bit, finishing his cigarette...

ext.ext_cn: 露天小市场的三面都有小餐馆，我们在其中一家餐馆闲呆了很长时间。
ext.ext_en: We spent many hours idling in one of the cafes that line three sides of the tiny piazza...

defs.def_en: If you idle, you spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

ext.ext_cn: 停业的装配厂
ext.ext_en: ...idled assembly plants.

defs.def_en: To idle a factory or other place of work means to close it down because there is no work to do or because the workers are on strike.

ext.ext_cn: 罢工使约 55,000 名机械师无事可做。
ext.ext_en: The strike has idled about 55,000 machinists.

defs.def_en: To idle workers means to stop them working.

ext.ext_cn: 在树林的那一边,一架小飞机停在那里,发动机在空转。
ext.ext_en: Beyond a stand of trees a small plane idled...

ext.ext_cn: 她的戴姆勒豪华轿车原地待命,发动机在空转。
ext.ext_en: Her Daimler limo waits with its engine idling.

defs.def_en: If an engine or vehicle is idling, the engine is running slowly and quietly because it is not in gear, and the vehicle is not moving.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天该公司总裁被指控将数千万美元非法存入外国账户。
ext.ext_en: Yesterday its president was accused of salting away tens of millions of dollars in foreign accounts.

defs.def_en: If someone salts away sums of money, they save the money for the future, often illegally.
