ext.ext_cn: 他们正在继续进行法律斗争以向政府寻求一些赔偿。
ext.ext_en: They are continuing their legal battle to seek some redress from the government.

defs.def_en: Redress is money that someone pays you because they have caused you harm or loss.
A backhander is an amount of money that is illegally paid to someone in a position of authority in order to encourage them to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 卡尔·普利布拉姆，知名的神经系统科学家
ext.ext_en: ...Karl Pribram, the well-known neuro-scientist.

ext.ext_cn: 神经肌肉系统紊乱
ext.ext_en: ...disorders of the neuromuscular system.

defs.def_en: Neuro- is used to form words that refer or relate to a nerve or the nervous system.

defs.def_cn: 咆哮;大喊大叫;夸夸其谈

ext.ext_cn: 老板开始咆哮的时候，我起身走了出去。
ext.ext_en: As the boss began to rant, I stood up and went out...

ext.ext_cn: 我们听到正在大叫着魔鬼的精神病人
ext.ext_en: ...the mentally ill patient we heard ranting about demons...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone rants, you mean that they talk loudly or angrily, and exaggerate or say foolish things.

ext.ext_cn: 我不会大喊大叫或摔茶杯。
ext.ext_en: I don't rant and rave or throw tea cups.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone rants and raves, you mean that they talk loudly and angrily in an uncontrolled way.
A foundry is a place where metal or glass is melted and formed into particular shapes.

ext.ext_cn: 去年，柯林斯写了一首动人的抒情歌曲，突出描绘了无家可归者的苦境。
ext.ext_en: Last year Collins wrote a moving ballad which highlighted the plight of the homeless...

ext.ext_cn: “自由新闻”组织再次故意不去突出强调这些事实。
ext.ext_en: Once again, the 'Free Press' prefers not to highlight these facts...

defs.def_en: If someone or something highlights a point or problem, they emphasize it or make you think about it.

defs.def_cn: （用荧光笔）标出;（在计算机屏幕上）突出显示

ext.ext_cn: 点击并摁住鼠标左键将所选区域高亮显示。
ext.ext_en: Highlight the chosen area by clicking and holding down the left mouse button.

ext.ext_cn: 用黄色荧光笔标出路线的相关地图
ext.ext_en: ...the relevant maps with the route highlighted in yellow.

defs.def_en: To highlight a piece of text means to mark it in a different colour, either with a special type of pen or on a computer screen.

defs.def_cn: 最有趣（或最精彩、最重要）的部分

ext.ext_cn: 可能是本次联赛中最精彩的比赛之一
ext.ext_en: ...a match that is likely to prove one of the highlights of the tournament...

ext.ext_cn: 过去，我一天中最有意思的事就是在梅格下班回到家时为她做顿饭。
ext.ext_en: The highlight of my day used to be cooking Meg a meal when she came in from work...

defs.def_en: The highlights of an event, activity, or period of time are the most interesting or exciting parts of it.

defs.def_cn: 挑染的头发;（头发经阳光照射后产生强光效果的）浅色部分
defs.def_en: Highlights in a person's hair are narrow lighter areas made by dyeing or sunlight.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (结果、事件、局势)轰动性的，引起哗然的

ext.ext_cn: 世界冠军遭遇惨败，引起了一片哗然。
ext.ext_en: The world champions suffered a sensational defeat.

defs.def_en: A sensational result, event, or situation is so remarkable that it causes great excitement and interest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (故事、报道)耸人听闻的，哗众取宠的

ext.ext_cn: 哗众取宠的小报报道
ext.ext_en: ...sensational tabloid newspaper reports.

defs.def_en: You can describe stories or reports as sensational if you disapprove of them because they present facts in a way that is intended to cause feelings of shock, anger, or excitement.

ext.ext_cn: 她的嗓音非常动听。
ext.ext_en: Her voice is sensational...

ext.ext_cn: 专家们一致认为这的确是一场精彩绝伦的演出。
ext.ext_en: Experts agreed that this was a truly sensational performance.

defs.def_en: You can describe something as sensational when you think that it is extremely good.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极感兴趣的；专心的；全神贯注的

ext.ext_cn: 两人彼此倾心。
ext.ext_en: They were completely absorbed in each other...

ext.ext_cn: 他接触到了政治并且迅速地对它着了迷。
ext.ext_en: He had discovered politics and was rapidly becoming absorbed by it...

defs.def_en: If you are absorbed in something or someone, you are very interested in them and they take up all your attention and energy.

ext.ext_cn: 他的微观经济学授课单元有250名学生。
ext.ext_en: He has 250 students in his microeconomics module.

defs.def_en: Microeconomics is the branch of economics that is concerned with individual areas of economic activity, such as those within a particular company or relating to a particular market.
Nightclubbing is the activity of going to nightclubs.

ext.ext_cn: 1918年，奥地利成为共和国。
ext.ext_en: In 1918, Austria became a republic.

ext.ext_cn: 波罗的海沿岸诸共和国
ext.ext_en: ...the Baltic republics.

defs.def_en: See also:banana republic;A republic is a country where power is held by the people or the representatives that they elect. Republics have presidents who are elected, rather than kings or queens.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 乐于做家务事的;爱操持家务的

ext.ext_cn: 妈妈不是很喜欢干家务活。
ext.ext_en: Mum wasn't very domesticated.

defs.def_en: Someone who is domesticated willingly does household tasks such as cleaning.

ext.ext_cn: 他曾坑蒙拐骗。
ext.ext_en: He was a liar and a cheat...

ext.ext_cn: “她有时像个撒谎高手，”他说。
ext.ext_en: 'She seems at times an accomplished liar,' he said.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is a liar, you mean that they tell lies.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （东西）杂乱的；（想法）混乱的，纷乱的

ext.ext_cn: 这些乱七八糟的需优先考虑的事项没有什么可惊讶的。
ext.ext_en: These jumbled priorities should be no cause for surprise...

ext.ext_cn: 犹太-基督教传统呈现多样化，混乱复杂，相互矛盾，在各个方面都会引发质疑和争论。
ext.ext_en: The Judaeo-Christian tradition is diverse, jumbled, contradictory, at every point inviting inquiry and debate.

defs.def_en: If you describe things or ideas as jumbled, you mean that they are mixed up and not in order.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 易变的;动荡不定的;反复无常的

ext.ext_cn: 以前曾发生过暴乱，现在局势不太稳定。
ext.ext_en: There have been riots before and the situation is volatile...

ext.ext_cn: 从20世纪70年代初开始，国际石油市场就一直很不稳定。
ext.ext_en: The international oil markets have been highly volatile since the early 1970s...

defs.def_en: A situation that is volatile is likely to change suddenly and unexpectedly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 第二年他陪着这位情绪无常的女演员去了好莱坞。
ext.ext_en: He accompanied the volatile actress to Hollywood the following year...

ext.ext_cn: 他脾气反复无常。
ext.ext_en: He has a volatile temper.

defs.def_en: If someone is volatile, their mood often changes quickly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （液体等物质）易挥发的，易发散的

ext.ext_cn: 人们认为，易挥发的化学物质爆炸时产生了冲击波。
ext.ext_en: It's thought that the blast occurred when volatile chemicals exploded.

defs.def_en: A volatile liquid or substance is one that will quickly change into a gas.

ext.ext_cn: 在同一个概念体系内以新法代替旧法
ext.ext_en: ...replacing old laws with new within the same conceptual framework.

defs.def_en: Conceptual means related to ideas and concepts formed in the mind.

ext.ext_cn: 舒适的中档住处
ext.ext_en: ...comfortable mid-range accommodation.

ext.ext_cn: 中档家用汽车的价格
ext.ext_en: ...the price of a mid-range family car.

defs.def_en: You can use mid-range to describe products or services which are neither the most expensive nor the cheapest of their type.

ext.ext_cn: 他预言5年内他的敌人要么会死去，要么会进监狱。
ext.ext_en: He prophesied that within five years his opponent would either be dead or in prison...

ext.ext_cn: 她预言这次探险结局不会好。
ext.ext_en: She prophesied a bad ending for the expedition.

defs.def_en: If you prophesy that something will happen, you say that you strongly believe that it will happen.

ext.ext_cn: 这些人经常受到所在国政府的压迫。
ext.ext_en: These people often are oppressed by the governments of the countries they find themselves in...

ext.ext_cn: 我们跟其他正常人不一样。否则，他们就不会压迫我们了。
ext.ext_en: We are not normal like everybody else. If we were they wouldn't be oppressing us.

defs.def_en: To oppress people means to treat them cruelly, or to prevent them from having the same opportunities, freedom, and benefits as others.

defs.def_cn: 使心情沉重；使压抑；使苦恼

ext.ext_cn: 奥布里的眼睛还没有适应黑暗之前，这地方便已经让他觉得很压抑了。
ext.ext_en: The place oppressed Aubrey even before his eyes adjusted to the dark...

ext.ext_cn: 让她心烦的不只是天气。
ext.ext_en: It was not just the weather which oppressed her.

defs.def_en: If something oppresses you, it makes you feel depressed, anxious, and uncomfortable.

ext.ext_cn: 店铺、房子和车辆全都陷于火海。
ext.ext_en: Shops, houses, and vehicles were set ablaze.

defs.def_en: Something that is ablaze is burning very fiercely.

ext.ext_cn: 会议厅里灯火辉煌。
ext.ext_en: The chamber was ablaze with light...

ext.ext_cn: 春天，山谷里春色绚烂。
ext.ext_en: In spring, the valleys are ablaze with colour.

defs.def_en: If a place is ablaze with lights or colours, it is very bright because of them.

defs.def_cn: （目光、神色等）激动的，兴奋的，愤怒的

ext.ext_cn: 他热情洋溢。
ext.ext_en: He was ablaze with enthusiasm...

ext.ext_cn: 她声音激昂，目光如火。
ext.ext_en: Her voice is passionate. Her eyes are ablaze.

defs.def_en: If someone is ablaze, or if their eyes are ablaze, their expression shows that they are feeling a strong emotion, such as great excitement or anger.

ext.ext_cn: 叛乱分子似乎想要利用公众对政府的不满情绪。
ext.ext_en: The rebels seem to be trying to capitalize on the public's discontent with the government.

defs.def_en: If you capitalize on a situation, you use it to gain some advantage for yourself.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的意图是想方设法出售这个公司以获取奖金。
ext.ext_en: Our intention is to capitalize the company by any means we can...

ext.ext_cn: 该公司将以200万英镑的价格出售。
ext.ext_en: The company will be capitalized at £2 million.

defs.def_en: In business, if you capitalize something that belongs to you, you sell it in order to make money.
Precipitation is rain, snow, or hail.
Precipitation is a process in a chemical reaction which causes solid particles to become separated from a liquid.

defs.def_cn: 汽车停靠点;（尤指）卡车服务站
defs.def_en: A truck stop is a place where drivers, especially truck or lorry drivers, can stop, for example to rest or to get something to eat.
A north-easterly point, area, or direction is to the north-east or towards the north-east.
A north-easterly wind is a wind that blows from the north-east.

ext.ext_cn: 装甲部队在索尔兹伯里平原进行演习。
ext.ext_en: The Cavalry were exercising on Salisbury Plain.

ext.ext_cn: 美国陆军第一装甲师
ext.ext_en: ...the US Army's 1st Cavalry Division.

defs.def_en: The cavalry is the part of an army that uses armoured vehicles for fighting.

ext.ext_cn: 年轻的骑兵军官
ext.ext_en: ...a young cavalry officer.

defs.def_en: The cavalry is the group of soldiers in an army who ride horses.

defs.def_cn: 奸诈之徒，卑鄙小人，不择手段之人 (尤指律师或政客)
defs.def_en: If you refer to someone, especially a lawyer or politician, as a shyster, you mean that they are dishonest and immoral.

defs.def_cn: 令人尴尬的小争吵;口角

ext.ext_cn: 他曾因和意大利警方发生争执而在罗马被短暂拘留。
ext.ext_en: He was briefly arrested in Rome after a contretemps with Italian police.

defs.def_en: A contretemps is a small disagreement that is rather embarrassing.

defs.def_cn: 依据职权的;出于职权的;（由于职位而）理所当然的

ext.ext_cn: 顾问委员会理所当然的委员
ext.ext_en: ...ex officio members of the Advisory Council.

ext.ext_cn: 依据职权而拥有的学位
ext.ext_en: ...an ex-officio degree.

defs.def_en: Ex officio is used to describe something such as a rank or privilege that someone is entitled to because of the job or position they have.

defs.def_cn: 外出度周末的人；周末旅行者

ext.ext_cn: 他把他的谷仓改造成了供周末旅行者居住的小屋。
ext.ext_en: He converted his barns into cottages for weekenders.

defs.def_en: A weekender is someone who goes to a place or lives at a place only at weekends.

defs.def_cn: 巴哈马的；巴哈马人（或文化）的

ext.ext_cn: 巴哈马总理休伯特·英格拉哈姆
ext.ext_en: ...Bahamian Prime Minister Hubert Ingraham.

defs.def_en: Bahamian means belonging or relating to the Bahamas or to its people or culture.
Bahamians are people who come from the Bahamas.

ext.ext_cn: 他和家人在最新的这部电影中有跑龙套的角色。
ext.ext_en: He and his family have walk-on parts in the latest film.

defs.def_en: A walk-on part in a play or film is a very small part which usually does not involve any speaking.

defs.def_cn: (房屋)半独立式的，与他屋共用一墙的

ext.ext_cn: 位于海格特的一幢半独立式房子
ext.ext_en: ...a semi-detached house in Highgate.

ext.ext_cn: 这是战后建的一座普通的半独立式房屋。
ext.ext_en: It was an ordinary, post-war semi-detached.

defs.def_en: A semi-detached house is a house that is joined to another house on one side by a shared wall.

defs.def_cn: 非定居的;暂居的;非常住的

ext.ext_cn: 报纸上说10万名暂住工人将不得不被遣送回乡。
ext.ext_en: The paper said that 100,000 non-resident workers would have to be sent back to their home villages.

ext.ext_cn: 非定居选民
ext.ext_en: ...non-resident voters.

defs.def_en: A non-resident person is someone who is visiting a particular place but who does not live or stay there permanently.

ext.ext_cn: 这个文本仍有两份14世纪手抄本存世。
ext.ext_en: Two fourteenth-century manuscripts of this text are still extant...

ext.ext_cn: 现存最古老的文献出自1492年。
ext.ext_en: The oldest extant document is dated 1492.

defs.def_en: If something is extant, it is still in existence, in spite of being very old.

ext.ext_cn: 他做了心脏移植手术，正在康复。
ext.ext_en: He was recovering from a heart transplant operation.

ext.ext_cn: 出售移植用人体器官引起的争议
ext.ext_en: ...the controversy over the sale of human organs for transplant.

defs.def_en: A transplant is a medical operation in which a part of a person's body is replaced because it is diseased.

ext.ext_cn: 肾脏移植手术如今已相当常见。
ext.ext_en: The operation to transplant a kidney is now fairly routine.

ext.ext_cn: 类似心脏、肾脏这样的移植器官
ext.ext_en: ...transplanted organs such as hearts and kidneys.

defs.def_en: If doctors transplant an organ such as a heart or a kidney, they use it to replace a patient's diseased organ.

ext.ext_cn: 因为结婚，丽贝卡从伦敦移居到了曼彻斯特。
ext.ext_en: Marriage had transplanted Rebecca from London to Manchester...

ext.ext_cn: 19 世纪，圣诞老人的习俗似乎又传回了欧洲。
ext.ext_en: In the 19th century, the Santa Claus tradition seems to have been transplanted back to Europe…

defs.def_en: To transplant someone or something means to move them to a different place.

defs.def_cn: 质量上的;质的;品质的；性质的

ext.ext_cn: 孩子和成年人的思维方式有质的不同。
ext.ext_en: There are qualitative differences in the way children and adults think...

ext.ext_cn: 那就是定量研究和定性研究之间的重大差别。
ext.ext_en: That's the whole difference between quantitative and qualitative research.

defs.def_en: Qualitative means relating to the nature or stardand of something, rather than to its quantity.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 索米尔周围的白垩质土壤出产著名的安茹葡萄酒。
ext.ext_en: The chalky soil around Saumur produces the famous Anjou wines.

defs.def_en: Something that is chalky contains chalk or is covered with chalk.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的脸变得煞白。
ext.ext_en: Her face became a chalky white.

defs.def_en: Something that is chalky is a pale dull colour or has a powdery texture.

ext.ext_cn: 他在剑桥大学学习哲学和心理学。
ext.ext_en: He studied philosophy and psychology at Cambridge.

ext.ext_cn: 中国传统哲学
ext.ext_en: ...traditional Chinese philosophy.

defs.def_en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

defs.def_cn: 哲学思想；哲学体系；哲学理论

ext.ext_cn: 苏格拉底、柏拉图和亚里士多德的哲学思想
ext.ext_en: ...the philosophies of Socrates, Plato, and Aristotle.

ext.ext_cn: 完整的政治哲学体系
ext.ext_en: ...a whole spectrum of political philosophies.

defs.def_en: A philosophy is a particular set of ideas that a philosopher has.

ext.ext_cn: 最好的生活方式是改变饮食习惯，食用低糖、高纤维食品。
ext.ext_en: The best philosophy is to change your food habits to a low-sugar, high-fibre diet...

ext.ext_cn: 采访莎基拉时，我觉得自己和她的人生哲学很合拍。
ext.ext_en: When I interviewed Shakira I felt in tune with her philosophy of life...

defs.def_en: A philosophy is a particular theory that someone has about how to live or how to deal with a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 政府吝啬被指责是食品标准下降的原因。
ext.ext_en: Government penny-pinching is blamed for the decline in food standards.

defs.def_en: Penny-pinching is the practice of trying to spend as little money as possible.

ext.ext_cn: 心胸狭隘、一毛不拔的管理者
ext.ext_en: ...small-minded penny-pinching administrators.

defs.def_en: Penny-pinching people spend as little money as possible.
Aesthetics is a branch of philosophy concerned with the study of the idea of beauty.

ext.ext_cn: 所有需要注意的事他都注意到了。
ext.ext_en: He left nothing undone that needed attention.

defs.def_en: Work that is undone has not yet been done.
A genus is a class of similar things, especially a group of animals or plants that includes several closely related species.

ext.ext_cn: 看到路上被轧死的动物，我觉得不舒服。
ext.ext_en: I don't feel good about seeing roadkill.

defs.def_en: Roadkill is the remains of an animal or animals that have been killed on the road by cars or other vehicles.

ext.ext_cn: 其他选民说，如果总统不能使情况有所好转，他们也会投票把他赶下台去。
ext.ext_en: And if the President doesn't make things better, other voters say, we'll vote him out, too...

ext.ext_cn: 他们不能联合起来通过投票表决让她下台。
ext.ext_en: They cannot join forces to vote her out of office...

defs.def_en: If people vote out a particular person or political party, they give that person or party so few votes in an official election that they no longer hold a position of power.
A probation officer is a person whose job is to supervise and help people who have committed crimes and been put on probation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 分布不均衡的；散落的；斑驳的

ext.ext_cn: 局部浓雾和驾驶员不负责任是罪魁祸首。
ext.ext_en: Thick patchy fog and irresponsible driving were to blame...

ext.ext_cn: 瓶装美黑剂可能会让你的腿、手臂和脸呈现出深一块、浅一块的橙色。
ext.ext_en: Bottle tans can make your legs, arms and face look a patchy orange colour.

defs.def_en: A patchy substance or colour exists in some places but not in others, or is thick in some places and thin in others.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 时好时坏的；不稳定的；差强人意的

ext.ext_cn: 证据不充分。
ext.ext_en: The evidence is patchy...

ext.ext_cn: 交通困难，通信时断时续。
ext.ext_en: Transport is difficult, communications are patchy...

defs.def_en: If something is patchy, it is not completely reliable or satisfactory because it is not always good.

defs.def_cn: 有花形图案的;绘有花的

ext.ext_cn: 有明黄色花卉图案的织物
ext.ext_en: ...a bright yellow floral fabric.

defs.def_en: A floral fabric or design has flowers on it.

defs.def_cn: 由花组成的;有鲜花装饰的

ext.ext_cn: 引人注目的插花
ext.ext_en: ...eye-catching floral arrangements.

defs.def_en: You can use floral to describe something that contains flowers or is made of flowers.

ext.ext_cn: 门是由纯柚木制成，做工精美。
ext.ext_en: The door is beautifully made in solid teak.

defs.def_en: Teak is the wood of a tall tree with very hard, light-coloured wood which grows in South-East Asia.

ext.ext_cn: 我再次斟满了我们的酒杯。
ext.ext_en: I refilled our wine glasses.

ext.ext_cn: 马克斯伸过杯子要再续满。
ext.ext_en: Max held out his cup for a refill.

defs.def_en: If you refill something, you fill it again after it has been emptied.

ext.ext_cn: 补充包更便宜，也更轻。
ext.ext_en: Refill packs are cheaper and lighter.

defs.def_en: A refill of a particular product, such as soap powder, is a quantity of that product sold in a cheaper container than the one it is usually sold in. You use a refill to fill the more permanent container when it is empty.

ext.ext_cn: 他涨工资了。
ext.ext_en: His wages have gone up...

ext.ext_cn: 这可能会使将最低工资定得远高于贫困线的努力告吹。
ext.ext_en: This may end efforts to set a minimum wage well above the poverty line.

defs.def_en: Someone's wages are the amount of money that is regularly paid to them for the work that they do.

ext.ext_cn: 发动内战的三个派别
ext.ext_en: ...the three factions that had been waging a civil war...

ext.ext_cn: 他们打起了价格战。
ext.ext_en: They waged a price war.

defs.def_en: If a person, group, or country wages a campaign or a war, they start it and continue it over a period of time.
Date rape is when a man rapes a woman after having spent the evening socially with her.
In Britain, the TUC is an organization which represents trade unions, and to which most trade unions belong. TUC is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'Trades Union Congress'.

ext.ext_cn: 巴布亚新几内亚的山脉和丛林
ext.ext_en: ...the mountains and jungles of Papua New Guinea...

ext.ext_cn: 山区完全掩映在茂密的丛林中。
ext.ext_en: The mountain area is covered entirely in dense jungle.

defs.def_en: A jungle is a forest in a tropical country where large numbers of tall trees and plants grow very close together.

defs.def_cn: 堆满东西的地方；杂乱无章的地方

ext.ext_cn: 堆满了鸟类标本、小摆设和盆栽植物的乱七八糟的地方
ext.ext_en: ...a jungle of stuffed birds, knick-knacks, potted plants.

defs.def_en: If you describe a place as a jungle, you are emphasizing that it is full of lots of things and very untidy.

defs.def_cn: 复杂困难的境况；尔虞我诈的环境

ext.ext_cn: 有关社会保障的法律和程序仍旧是个充满错综复杂的规则的危险领域。
ext.ext_en: Social security law and procedure remain a jungle of complex rules.

ext.ext_cn: 竞争激烈的考试
ext.ext_en: ...the examination jungle.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as a jungle, you dislike it because it is complicated and difficult to get what you want from it.

defs.def_cn: 丛林法则；弱肉强食的原则

ext.ext_cn: 如果你通过侵略谋取利益，这就成了弱肉强食。
ext.ext_en: If you make aggression pay, this becomes the law of the jungle...

ext.ext_cn: 丛林法则要求的是：杀戮或者被杀。
ext.ext_en: The law of the jungle demands: kill or be killed.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the law of the jungle, you are referring to a situation in which there are no laws or rules to govern the way that people behave and people use force to get what they want.

defs.def_cn: 丛林音乐（一种有着快节奏鼓点的舞曲）
defs.def_en: Jungle is a style of dance music with a fast drum beat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他发表的那些出人意料而且经常自相矛盾的评论令他臭名昭著。
ext.ext_en: He is notorious for making unexpected, often self-contradictory, comments.

defs.def_en: If you say or write something that is self-contradictory, you make two statements which cannot both be true.

ext.ext_cn: 研究投入不足让英国工业深受其害。
ext.ext_en: British industry suffers through insufficient investment in research.

ext.ext_cn: 在工业迅速发展的国家
ext.ext_en: ...in countries where industry is developing rapidly.

defs.def_en: Industry is the work and processes involved in collecting raw materials, and making them into products in factories.

ext.ext_cn: 汽车业与纺织业
ext.ext_en: ...the motor vehicle and textile industries.

ext.ext_cn: 苏格兰旅游业
ext.ext_en: ...the Scottish tourist industry.

defs.def_en: A particular industry consists of all the people and activities involved in making a particular product or providing a particular service.

ext.ext_cn: 一些加勒比黑人在抵制整个种族关系运动。
ext.ext_en: Some Afro-Caribbeans are rejecting the whole race relations industry...

ext.ext_cn: 数十亿美元的健身产业利用我们的爱美之心赚取巨额利润。
ext.ext_en: The multibillion-dollar fitness industry rakes in fat profits from our hunger to look good.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a social or political activity as an industry, you are criticizing it because you think it involves a lot of people in unnecessary or useless work.

ext.ext_cn: 没人怀疑他的能力、勤奋和正直。
ext.ext_en: No one doubted his ability, his industry or his integrity.

defs.def_en: Industry is the fact of working very hard.

defs.def_cn: （汽车前部挡风玻璃下的）储物箱，杂物箱
defs.def_en: The glove compartment in a car is a small cupboard or shelf below the front windscreen.

defs.def_cn: （尤指为再就业）接受再培训，对…再培训

ext.ext_cn: 为什么不接受新的培训，找一份让你更快乐的工作？
ext.ext_en: Why not retrain for a job which will make you happier?...

ext.ext_cn: 工会领导人已经呼吁政府帮助对工人进行再培训。
ext.ext_en: Union leaders have called upon the government to help retrain workers.

defs.def_en: If you retrain, or if someone retrains you, you learn new skills, especially in order to get a new job.

defs.def_cn: (尤指别具匠心、与众不同的)摄影技巧，摄影手法

ext.ext_cn: 导演在镜头运用上既富有美感又渲染了气氛,戏剧手法的运用也娴熟自如。
ext.ext_en: The director employs sensuous, atmospheric camerawork and deft dramatic touches.

defs.def_en: The camerawork in a film is the way it has been filmed, especially if the style is interesting or unusual in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 古老的骨相学
ext.ext_en: ...the ancient science of phrenology.

defs.def_en: Phrenology is the study of the size and shape of people's heads in the belief that you can find out about their characters and abilities from this.

defs.def_cn: 咆哮;大喊大叫;夸夸其谈

ext.ext_cn: 老板开始咆哮的时候，我起身走了出去。
ext.ext_en: As the boss began to rant, I stood up and went out...

ext.ext_cn: 我们听到正在大叫着魔鬼的精神病人
ext.ext_en: ...the mentally ill patient we heard ranting about demons...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone rants, you mean that they talk loudly or angrily, and exaggerate or say foolish things.

ext.ext_cn: 我不会大喊大叫或摔茶杯。
ext.ext_en: I don't rant and rave or throw tea cups.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone rants and raves, you mean that they talk loudly and angrily in an uncontrolled way.

defs.def_cn: 察觉不出的;感觉不到的;难以察觉的

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩的犹豫几乎难以察觉。
ext.ext_en: Brian's hesitation was almost imperceptible.

defs.def_en: Something that is imperceptible is so small that it is not noticed or cannot be seen.
A naturalist is a person who studies plants, animals, insects, and other living things.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他是个酷爱阅读的人，总觉得书不够读。
ext.ext_en: He misses not having enough books because he's an avid reader.

ext.ext_cn: 一个热衷收集艺术品和历史文物的收藏家
ext.ext_en: ...an avid collector of art and history.

defs.def_en: You use avid to describe someone who is very enthusiastic about something that they do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他嗜财如命。
ext.ext_en: He was intensely eager, indeed avid, for wealth.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is avid for something, you mean that they are very eager to get it.

ext.ext_cn: 他从总司令部带到第八路军的急件
ext.ext_en: ...the dispatches he was carrying from GHQ to the Eighth Army.

defs.def_en: GHQ is used to refer to the place where the people who organize military forces or a military operation work. GHQ is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'General Headquarters'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 马虎的;草率的;鲁莽的;粗心大意的

ext.ext_cn: 粗心大意的学生
ext.ext_en: ...a slapdash student...

ext.ext_cn: 马尔科姆的工作方法显得极其粗枝大叶。
ext.ext_en: Malcolm's work methods appear amazingly slapdash.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as slapdash, you mean that they do things carelessly without much thinking or planning.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她的大手提包
ext.ext_en: ...her capacious handbag.

defs.def_en: Something that is capacious has a lot of space to put things in.

ext.ext_cn: 他的前任司机声称自己因为种族歧视而遭到了不公平解雇。
ext.ext_en: His former chauffeur is claiming unfair dismissal on the grounds of racial discrimination.

defs.def_en: If an employee claims unfair dismissal, they begin a legal action against their employer in which they claim that they were dismissed from their job unfairly.

ext.ext_cn: 一个曾被西方不屑地视为醉鬼的人
ext.ext_en: ...the man once dismissed by the West as a drunken buffoon.

defs.def_en: If you call someone a buffoon, you mean that they often do foolish things.

defs.def_cn: 战后的；战后不久的；（尤指）第二次世界大战后的

ext.ext_cn: 她的文章在战后那几年经常出现在《新日报》上。
ext.ext_en: In the post-war years her writing regularly appeared in The New Journal...

ext.ext_cn: 他确实是战后英国最优秀的拳击手之一。
ext.ext_en: He really was one of the finest boxers in post-war Britain.

defs.def_en: Post-war is used to describe things that happened, existed, or were made in the period immediately after a war, especially the Second World War, 1939-45.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这条裙子会使我的腿看上去又短又粗吗?
ext.ext_en: Does this dress make my legs look too stumpy?

defs.def_en: Stumpy things are short and thick.
A liquid crystal display is a display of information on a screen, which uses liquid crystals that become visible when electricity is passed through them.

defs.def_cn: （种植酿酒葡萄的）葡萄园;葡萄酒厂
defs.def_en: A vineyard is an area of land where grape vines are grown in order to produce wine. You can also use vineyard to refer to the set of buildings in which the wine is produced.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沼泽般的;湿软的;泥泞的

ext.ext_cn: 斯佩河流域宽阔的沼泽平原
ext.ext_en: ...the broad, marshy plain of the River Spey.

defs.def_en: Marshy land is always wet and muddy.

ext.ext_cn: 我已经十分肯定地告诉他们，政策不会变。
ext.ext_en: I have told them with absolute certainty there'll be no change of policy...

ext.ext_cn: 德国当前的经济非常不稳定。
ext.ext_en: There is too little certainty about the present state of the German economy.

defs.def_en: Certainty is the state of being definite or of having no doubts at all about something.

ext.ext_cn: 3个星期前举行普选已确定无疑。
ext.ext_en: A general election became a certainty three weeks ago.

ext.ext_cn: 发生更多暴力和流血事件的必然性
ext.ext_en: ...the certainty of more violence and bloodshed...

defs.def_en: Certainty is the fact that something is certain to happen.

defs.def_cn: 确定无疑的事情;必然的事

ext.ext_cn: 当代欧洲没有什么是确定无疑的。
ext.ext_en: There are no certainties in modern Europe...

ext.ext_cn: 陈规旧矩的崩塌正在重塑各个政党。
ext.ext_en: The collapse of old certainties is reshaping the political parties.

defs.def_en: Certainties are things that nobody has any doubts about.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 但他的死太没有必要了。
ext.ext_en: But his death was so needless...

ext.ext_cn: 他说：“我从未故意将任何病人置于不必要的风险境地。”
ext.ext_en: 'I have never knowingly exposed any patient to needless risks,' he said.

defs.def_en: Something that is needless is completely unnecessary.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的虎皮鹦鹉飞出鸟笼的时候，猫正好在室内。不用说，猫比我快，抓住了它。
ext.ext_en: Our budgie got out of its cage while our cat was in the room. Needless to say, the cat moved quicker than me and caught it.

defs.def_en: You use needless to say when you want to emphasize that what you are about to say is obvious and to be expected in the circumstances.

ext.ext_cn: 他翻窗从下水道管子爬下，从而躲过了警察。
ext.ext_en: He evaded police by climbing through a window and shinning down a drainpipe.

defs.def_en: A drainpipe is a pipe attached to the side of a building, through which rainwater flows from the roof into a drain.

ext.ext_cn: 这些发表在旧金山报纸上的文章都出自一个化名为多萝西·道奇的人之手。
ext.ext_en: The articles were published in San Francisco newspapers under the assumed name of Dorothy Dodge...

ext.ext_cn: 在阿纳姆，她和母亲隐姓埋名，而且刻意说着一口佛兰芒语而不是她们更常用的法语和英语。
ext.ext_en: In Arnham, she and her mother lived under assumed names and took care to speak Flemish rather than their more usual French and English.

defs.def_en: If you do something under an assumed name, you do it using a name that is not your real name.

defs.def_cn: （描写现代青年女性生活和爱情的）年轻女性文学
defs.def_en: Chick lit is modern fiction about the lives and romantic problems of young women, usually written by young women.

ext.ext_cn: 第二天他被从拘留所里放了出来。
ext.ext_en: He was released from custody the next day...

ext.ext_cn: 他有望今天出院。
ext.ext_en: He is expected to be released from hospital today...

defs.def_en: If a person or animal is released from somewhere where they have been locked up or looked after, they are set free or allowed to go.

ext.ext_cn: 他要求立即释放所有政治犯。
ext.ext_en: He called for the immediate release of all political prisoners.

ext.ext_cn: 为确保人质释放而要进行的秘密谈判
ext.ext_en: ...the secret negotiations necessary to secure hostage releases...

defs.def_en: When someone is released, you refer to their release .

ext.ext_cn: 离婚解除了夫妻双方相互之间所有的婚姻义务。
ext.ext_en: Divorce releases both the husband and wife from all marital obligations to each other...

ext.ext_cn: 这使得教师可以专门辅导学习特别吃力的学生。
ext.ext_en: This releases the teacher to work with individuals who are having extreme difficulty.

defs.def_en: If someone or something releases you from a duty, task, or feeling, they free you from it.

defs.def_cn: 发泄，释放(情感);展示(能力)

ext.ext_cn: 保持自己的本色才有助于发挥自身创造力。
ext.ext_en: Becoming your own person releases your creativity...

ext.ext_cn: 我个人并不想把自己的愤怒发泄在别人身上。
ext.ext_en: I personally don't want to release my anger on anyone else...

defs.def_en: To release feelings or abilities means to allow them to be expressed.

ext.ext_cn: 他们还未公布更多细节。
ext.ext_en: They're not releasing any more details yet...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天公布的数据显示零售额在3月份有所下滑。
ext.ext_en: Figures released yesterday show retail sales were down in March.

defs.def_en: If someone in authority releases something such as a document or information, they make it available.

ext.ext_cn: 他停下来面对着她，放开了她的手腕。
ext.ext_en: He stopped and faced her, releasing her wrist.

ext.ext_cn: 投球手掷球前的屈身动作
ext.ext_en: ...the twisting action before a bowler releases the ball.

defs.def_en: If you release someone or something, you stop holding them.

defs.def_cn: 打开，放开，松开(制动装置)

ext.ext_cn: 韦德松开手刹驶离路边。
ext.ext_en: Wade released the hand brake and pulled away from the curb.

defs.def_en: If you release a device, you move it so that it stops holding something.

defs.def_cn: 释放，放出，排放(气体、热量或某种物质)

ext.ext_cn: 释放神经毒气的武器
ext.ext_en: ...a weapon which releases toxic nerve gas...

ext.ext_cn: 肌肉的收缩消耗能量并且释放热量。
ext.ext_en: The contraction of muscles uses energy and releases heat...

defs.def_en: If something releases gas, heat, or a substance, it causes it to leave its container or the substance that it was part of and enter the surrounding atmosphere or area.

defs.def_cn: 发行，推出(唱片、碟片或电影)

ext.ext_cn: 他即将推出一张情歌专辑。
ext.ext_en: He is releasing an album of love songs.

defs.def_en: When an entertainer or company releases a new CD, video, or film, it becomes available so that people can buy it or see it.

defs.def_cn: 新发行的影片;新片;新碟;发行物

ext.ext_cn: 在这些新片中你觉得哪些真的不错？
ext.ext_en: Which of the new releases do you think are really good?

defs.def_en: A new release is a new CD, video, or film that has just become available for people to buy or see.

defs.def_cn: (影片的)上映，公映；（录像带的）发行

ext.ext_cn: 影碟推出的前3周就卖出了300万张。
ext.ext_en: The video has sold three million copies in its first three weeks on release.

defs.def_en: If a film or video is on release or on general release, it is available for people to see in public cinemas or for people to buy.
Your smalls are your underwear.
An oil platform is a structure that is used when getting oil from the ground under the sea.

defs.def_cn: (难以避免或摆脱的)复杂局势，困境

ext.ext_cn: 他的人民在混乱不安的泥潭里越陷越深。
ext.ext_en: His people had fallen further and further into a quagmire of confusion...

ext.ext_cn: 我们无意卷入一场政治困境。
ext.ext_en: We have no intention of being drawn into a political quagmire.

defs.def_en: A quagmire is a difficult, complicated, or unpleasant situation which is not easy to avoid or escape from.

ext.ext_cn: 大雨使草地变得一片泥泞。
ext.ext_en: Rain had turned the grass into a quagmire.

defs.def_en: A quagmire is a soft, wet area of land which your feet sink into if you try to walk across it.

ext.ext_cn: 绿色和黑色的去核橄榄
ext.ext_en: ...green and black pitted olives.

defs.def_en: Pitted fruits have had their stones removed.

ext.ext_cn: 任一处的建筑物正面都布满了弹洞。
ext.ext_en: Everywhere building facades are pitted with shell and bullet holes.

ext.ext_cn: 坑洼不平的月球表面
ext.ext_en: ...the pitted surface of the moon.

defs.def_en: If the surface of something is pitted, it is covered with a lot of small, shallow holes.

ext.ext_cn: 韦恩·戈斯州长揭开诗人巴尼奥·佩特森的等身塑像时，人群欢呼起来。
ext.ext_en: The crowd cheered as Premier Wayne Goss unveiled a lifesize statue of poet Banjo Paterson...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天，瑞士球迷在雅各布·赫拉塞克对阵库里耶的比赛中为赫拉塞克喝彩加油。
ext.ext_en: Swiss fans cheered Jakob Hlasek during yesterday's match with Courier.

defs.def_en: When people cheer, they shout loudly to show their approval or to encourage someone who is doing something such as taking part in a game.

ext.ext_cn: 斯蒂芬注意到，周围的人们似乎因为他的到来而受到鼓舞。
ext.ext_en: Stephen noticed that the people around him looked cheered by his presence...

ext.ext_cn: 他告诉自己，那样的天气出去野餐再合适不过了，可是，这丝毫不能让他提起精神来。
ext.ext_en: The weather was perfect for a picnic, he told himself, but the thought did nothing to cheer him.

defs.def_en: If you are cheered by something, it makes you happier or less worried.

ext.ext_cn: 他整天笑呵呵的样子给他们留下很深的印象。
ext.ext_en: They were impressed by his steadfast good cheer...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天玩宾戈赢了一把，适时地给朱丽叶·利特尔一家带来些许的欢快心情。
ext.ext_en: A timely bingo win brought some cheer to Juliet Little's family yesterday.

defs.def_en: Cheer is a feeling of cheerfulness.
People sometimes say 'Cheers' to each other just before they drink an alcoholic drink.
Some people say 'Cheers' as a way of saying 'thank you' or 'goodbye'.

defs.def_cn: 英文字母表的第 19 个字母
defs.def_en: S is the nineteenth letter of the English alphabet.

defs.def_cn: (用于首字母为 s 的一些单词的缩写，如 south, seconds 和 son)
defs.def_en: S or s is an abbreviation for words beginning with s, such as 'south', 'seconds', and 'son'.

defs.def_cn: (英国引进十进制货币之前 shilling 或 shillings 的缩写)
defs.def_en: s. was a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) shilling or shillings in Britain before decimal currency was introduced in 1971.

ext.ext_cn: 她患有支气管哮喘。
ext.ext_en: She suffers from bronchial asthma.

defs.def_en: Bronchial means affecting or concerned with the bronchial tubes.

ext.ext_cn: 这是东西方可以聚首的唯一论坛。
ext.ext_en: This is the only forum where East and West can get together.

defs.def_en: See also:get-together;When people get together, they meet in order to discuss something or to spend time together.

ext.ext_cn: 当时我和保罗在组建一个乐队，我们需要签一份新唱片合约。
ext.ext_en: Paul and I were getting a band together, and we needed a new record deal.

defs.def_en: If you get something together, you organize it.

ext.ext_cn: 现在，你们终于凑足了钱，可以去为梦寐以求的房子交订金了。
ext.ext_en: Now you've finally got enough money together to put down a deposit on your dream home.

defs.def_en: If you get an amount of money together, you succeed in getting all the money that you need in order to pay for something.

defs.def_cn: （尤指拉斯塔法里教派成员蓄的）“骇人”长发绺

ext.ext_cn: 他拒绝剪掉他的“骇人”长发绺,所以没能谋到开车的差事。
ext.ext_en: He was turned down for a driving job when he refused to cut his dreadlocks.

defs.def_en: If someone has dreadlocks, their hair is divided into a large number of tight strips, like pieces of rope. Dreadlocks are worn especially by men who are Rastafarians.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人兴奋的;令人振奋的;令人高兴的

ext.ext_cn: 重新踏上旅途令他非常振奋，兴致高涨。
ext.ext_en: It was exhilarating to be on the road again and his spirits rose.

ext.ext_cn: 在德国实现统一的那些振奋人心的日子里
ext.ext_en: ...in the exhilarating days of German unification.

defs.def_en: If you describe an experience or feeling as exhilarating, you mean that it makes you feel very happy and excited.

ext.ext_cn: 爸爸的健康状况近来不太好。
ext.ext_en: Dad's health hasn't been too good lately...

ext.ext_cn: 托马斯勋爵最近被任命为政策研究中心主席。
ext.ext_en: Lord Tomas had lately been appointed Chairman of the Centre for Policy Studies...

defs.def_en: You use lately to describe events in the recent past, or situations that started a short time ago.

ext.ext_cn: 新卸任的政府法务部副部长蒂莫西·琼·杰弗里·普拉特
ext.ext_en: ...Timothy Jean Geoffrey Pratt, lately deputy treasury solicitor...

defs.def_en: You can use lately to refer to the job a person has been doing until recently.

ext.ext_cn: 警方正在试图招募更多黑人和亚裔警官。
ext.ext_en: The police are trying to recruit more black and Asian officers...

ext.ext_cn: 在招收计算机系统工程专业的学生时，这个大学看重的是学生的综合能力。
ext.ext_en: In recruiting students to Computer Systems Engineering, the University looks for evidence of all-round ability...

defs.def_en: If you recruit people for an organization, you select them and persuade them to join it or work for it.
A recruit is a person who has recently joined an organization or an army.

ext.ext_cn: 要想利用先进技术，他们必须先对计算机有个基本的了解。
ext.ext_en: They have to have a basic understanding of computers in order to use the advanced technology.

defs.def_en: If you have an understanding of something, you know how it works or know what it means.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 能谅解的；宽容的；通情达理的

ext.ext_cn: 她的老板很通情达理，准了她的假。
ext.ext_en: Her boss, who was very understanding, gave her time off...

ext.ext_cn: 幸运的是，约翰有一个通情达理的妻子。
ext.ext_en: Fortunately for John, he had an understanding wife.

defs.def_en: If you are understanding towards someone, you are kind and forgiving.

ext.ext_cn: 我们要感谢他们的耐心和理解。
ext.ext_en: We would like to thank them for their patience and understanding.

defs.def_en: If you show understanding, you show that you realize how someone feels or why they did something, and are not hostile towards them.

ext.ext_cn: 我和威尔逊之间完全能够彼此理解，相互信任。
ext.ext_en: There was complete understanding between Wilson and myself.

defs.def_en: If there is understanding between people, they are friendly towards each other and trust each other.

ext.ext_cn: 我们还没有确定结婚的日子，不过我们对此有一致的想法。
ext.ext_en: We had not set a date for marriage but there was an understanding between us.

defs.def_en: An understanding is an informal agreement about something.

ext.ext_cn: 据我了解，这种折磨已经持续很多年了。
ext.ext_en: It is my understanding that this torture has been going on for many years...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的理解是，他们想呆在华盛顿。
ext.ext_en: Our understanding is that they wanted to be in Washington.

defs.def_en: If you say that it is your understanding that something is the case, you mean that you believe it to be the case because you have heard or read that it is.

ext.ext_cn: 凯文接受了治疗，但条件是他要努力克服自身的酗酒问题。
ext.ext_en: Kevin had treatment on the understanding that he would attempt to overcome his drinking problem.

defs.def_en: If you agree to do something on the understanding that something else will be done, you do it because you have been told that the other thing will definitely be done.

ext.ext_cn: 他已赢得了超过25次国际级别赛事的胜利。
ext.ext_en: He had notched up more than 25 victories worldwide...

ext.ext_cn: 经济在发展，实现了高增长率。
ext.ext_en: The economy is expanding, notching up high growth rates.

defs.def_en: If you notch up something such as a score or total, you achieve it.

defs.def_cn: (旧时供电影院放映的)新闻短片
defs.def_en: A newsreel is a short film of national or international news events. In the past newsreels were made for showing in cinemas.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 约翰双眼红肿。
ext.ext_en: John's eyes were bloodshot and puffy.

defs.def_en: If your eyes are bloodshot, the parts that are usually white are red or pink. Your eyes can be bloodshot for a variety of reasons, for example because you are tired or you have drunk too much alcohol.
Vitreous means made of glass or resembling glass.

defs.def_cn: 旗舰;(尤指指挥官所在的)主舰
defs.def_en: A flagship is the most important ship in a fleet of ships, especially the one on which the commander of the fleet is sailing.

defs.def_cn: 王牌;主打产品;旗舰产品

ext.ext_cn: 这家医院一直是政府的旗舰机构，引领着医疗服务的改革。
ext.ext_en: The hospital has been the government's flagship, leading the health service reforms...

ext.ext_cn: 公司计划本月在纽约开一家旗舰店。
ext.ext_en: The company plans to open a flagship store in New York this month.

defs.def_en: The flagship of a group of things that are owned or produced by a particular organization is the most important one.

defs.def_cn: （通常指因他人做过某事而对其产生的）憎恨，厌恶，不满

ext.ext_cn: 原告遭到了公众的憎恨、非议与蔑视。
ext.ext_en: The complainant has been exposed to public odium, scandal and contempt.

defs.def_en: Odium is the dislike, disapproval, or hatred that people feel for a particular person, usually because of something that the person has done.

ext.ext_cn: 警方已经失去了公众的信任。
ext.ext_en: The police have lost their credibility...

ext.ext_cn: 总统将不得不努力使公众恢复对他的信任。
ext.ext_en: The president will have to work hard to restore his credibility.

defs.def_en: If someone or something has credibility, people believe in them and trust them.

ext.ext_cn: 他戴上了一顶破旧的防护头盔，上面的面罩已有划痕。
ext.ext_en: He pulled on a battered old crash helmet with a scratched visor.

defs.def_en: A visor is a movable part of a helmet which can be pulled down to protect a person's eyes or face.

defs.def_cn: （汽车内挡风玻璃上方的）遮阳板

ext.ext_cn: 我拉下遮阳板来遮挡耀眼的阳光。
ext.ext_en: I put down the sun visor to shade my eyes from the light.

defs.def_en: A visor is a piece of plastic or other material fixed above the windscreen inside a car, which can be turned down to protect the driver's eyes from bright sunshine.

defs.def_cn: (被保险人中途退保时收回的)退保现金价值，退保金额
defs.def_en: The surrender value of a life insurance policy is the amount of money you receive if you decide that you no longer wish to continue with the policy.

ext.ext_cn: 与世隔绝的修道士和修女
ext.ext_en: ...monks and nuns from enclosed orders.

defs.def_en: An enclosed community of monks or nuns does not have any contact with the outside world.
A motorcycle is a vehicle with two wheels and an engine.

ext.ext_cn: 我自学了弹钢琴。
ext.ext_en: I taught myself how to play the piano...

ext.ext_cn: 他7岁开始上钢琴课。
ext.ext_en: He started piano lessons at the age of 7.

defs.def_en: See also:grand piano;upright piano;A piano is a large musical instrument with a row of black and white keys. When you press these keys with your fingers, little hammers hit wire strings inside the piano which vibrate to produce musical notes.
A piece of music that is played piano is played quietly.

ext.ext_cn: 冥想有助于降低血压或使血压恢复正常。
ext.ext_en: Meditation tends to lower or normalize blood pressure...

ext.ext_cn: 要使饮食习惯正常，你也许要先处理好一些根深蒂固的情感问题。
ext.ext_en: There may be some deep-seated emotional reason which has to be dealt with before your eating habits normalize.

defs.def_en: When you normalize a situation or when it normalizes, it becomes normal.

ext.ext_cn: 两国政府即将恢复正常邦交。
ext.ext_en: The two governments were close to normalizing relations...

ext.ext_cn: 美国表示他们不准备加入到和宿敌恢复正常关系的行动中。
ext.ext_en: The United States says they are not prepared to join in normalizing ties with their former enemy...

defs.def_en: If people, groups, or governments normalize relations, or when relations normalize, they become normal or return to normal.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不悦耳的;不成调的;难听的

ext.ext_cn: 有人走过，唱着一首不成调的歌。
ext.ext_en: Someone walked by, singing a tuneless song.

defs.def_en: Tuneless music and voices do not sound pleasant.

defs.def_cn: 信仰疗法治疗者(相信用祈祷或超自然的力量可以给人治病)
defs.def_en: A faith healer is someone who believes they can treat and heal sick people using prayer or supernatural powers.

ext.ext_cn: 她一动不动，好像着了魔。
ext.ext_en: She was not moving, as if someone had bewitched her...

ext.ext_cn: 医生被马娅的美貌深深吸引。
ext.ext_en: The doctor is bewitched by Maya's beauty.

defs.def_en: If someone or something bewitches you, you are so attracted to them that you cannot think about anything else.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 人员不足的；缺少人手的

ext.ext_cn: 有些店我们人手不足，对顾客照顾不周。
ext.ext_en: In some stores we were undermanned and customer service was suffering.

defs.def_en: If an organization is undermanned, it does not have enough employees to function properly.
See also:common stock;Preferred stock is the same as preference shares .

defs.def_cn: (开销)可在税前扣除的，课税减免的

ext.ext_cn: 私人的儿童保育费用应该进行税前扣除。
ext.ext_en: The cost of private childcare should be made tax-deductible...

ext.ext_cn: 记下可减免课税的开支，比如买的原料和设备。
ext.ext_en: Keep track of tax-deductible expenses, such as the supplies and equipment you buy.

defs.def_en: If an expense is tax-deductible, it can be paid out of the part of your income on which you do not pay tax, so that the amount of tax you pay is reduced.

defs.def_cn: （通常因害怕或痛楚）尖叫;（狗）嚎叫

ext.ext_cn: 她的狗汪地叫了一声，紧跟了上来。
ext.ext_en: Her dog yelped and came to heel.

ext.ext_cn: 我只好强忍住，没惊叫出来。
ext.ext_en: I had to bite back a yelp of surprise.

defs.def_en: If a person or dog yelps, they give a sudden short cry, often because of fear or pain.

ext.ext_cn: 警方正在试图招募更多黑人和亚裔警官。
ext.ext_en: The police are trying to recruit more black and Asian officers...

ext.ext_cn: 在招收计算机系统工程专业的学生时，这个大学看重的是学生的综合能力。
ext.ext_en: In recruiting students to Computer Systems Engineering, the University looks for evidence of all-round ability...

defs.def_en: If you recruit people for an organization, you select them and persuade them to join it or work for it.
A recruit is a person who has recently joined an organization or an army.
A phoenix is an imaginary bird which, according to ancient stories, burns itself to ashes every five hundred years and is then born again.

ext.ext_cn: 在经济废墟中可能孕育着经济复苏的苗头。
ext.ext_en: Out of the ashes of the economic shambles, a phoenix of recovery can arise.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as a phoenix, you mean that they return again after seeming to disappear or be destroyed.

ext.ext_cn: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。
ext.ext_en: Autumn's my favourite season.

ext.ext_cn: 巴西唯一一个四季分明的地区
ext.ext_en: ...the only region of Brazil where all four seasons are clearly defined.

defs.def_en: The seasons are the main periods into which a year can be divided and which each have their own typical weather conditions.

defs.def_cn: (一年中某项活动或某一事件发生的)节期，时期

ext.ext_cn: 飞来准备度过繁殖季节的鸟群
ext.ext_en: ...birds arriving for the breeding season...

ext.ext_cn: 对学法律的学生来说，秋季是招聘旺季。
ext.ext_en: For law students, autumn brings the recruiting season.

defs.def_en: You can use season to refer to the period during each year when a particular activity or event takes place. For example, the planting season is the period when a particular plant or crop is planted.

defs.def_cn: (水果、蔬菜等的)当令期，上市期

ext.ext_cn: 快到吃李子的季节了。
ext.ext_en: The plum season is about to begin...

ext.ext_cn: 现在英国芦笋正当令。
ext.ext_en: Now British asparagus is in season.

defs.def_en: You can use season to refer to the period when a particular fruit, vegetable, or other food is ready for eating and is widely available.

ext.ext_cn: 棒球赛季
ext.ext_en: ...the baseball season...

ext.ext_cn: 这是他本赛季的第一场比赛。
ext.ext_en: It is his first race this season.

defs.def_en: You can use season to refer to a fixed period during each year when a particular sport is played.

defs.def_cn: (戏剧、表演的)上演期，会演期，献演期

ext.ext_cn: 3 部新戏剧的上演期
ext.ext_en: ...a season of three new plays.

ext.ext_cn: 皇家芭蕾舞团的夏季献演期
ext.ext_en: ...the Royal Ballet's summer season.

defs.def_en: A season is a period in which a play or show, or a series of plays or shows, is performed in one place.

ext.ext_cn: 阿尔托出演的系列影片的短暂上映期
ext.ext_en: ...a brief season of films in which Artaud appeared.

defs.def_en: A season of films is several of them shown as a series because they are connected in some way.

ext.ext_cn: 休假高峰期
ext.ext_en: ...the peak holiday season...

ext.ext_cn: 那里有迪斯科舞厅和夜总会，但是通常只在度假旺季营业。
ext.ext_en: There are discos and clubs but these are often closed out of season.

defs.def_en: The holiday or vacation season is the time when most people have their holiday.

ext.ext_cn: 用盐和胡椒粉给肉调味。
ext.ext_en: Season the meat with salt and pepper...

ext.ext_cn: 我认为在把食物端上餐桌前应该先调味。
ext.ext_en: I believe in seasoning food before putting it on the table.

defs.def_en: If you season food with salt, pepper, or spices, you add them to it in order to improve its flavour.

defs.def_cn: 对(木材)作干燥处理;风干，晒干(木材)

ext.ext_cn: 确保新木材已经风干。
ext.ext_en: Ensure that new wood has been seasoned.

defs.def_en: If wood is seasoned, it is made suitable for making into furniture or for burning, usually by being allowed to dry out gradually.
If a female animal is in season, she is in a state where she is ready to have sex.

ext.ext_cn: 无论人们如何强烈地批评她的处事风格和某些政策，她的勇气却无人能够否认。
ext.ext_en: However much people have criticised her style and some of her policies no one will gainsay her courage...

ext.ext_cn: 不容否认的事实是，他们一手建起了一座真正伟大的建筑。
ext.ext_en: There is no gainsaying the fact that they have been responsible for a truly great building.

defs.def_en: If there is no gainsaying something, it is true or obvious and everyone would agree with it.

defs.def_cn: 关键；关键性人物（或事物）

ext.ext_cn: 他是我们队伍的核心，对实现我的长远规划举足轻重。
ext.ext_en: He's  the lynchpin of our team and crucial to my long-term plans.

defs.def_en: If you refer to a person or thing as the linchpin of something, you mean that they are the most important person or thing involved in it.

ext.ext_cn: 去年我对一群学童讲话，他们听到什么都笑。
ext.ext_en: Last year I had an audience of schoolchildren and they laughed at everything.

defs.def_en: Schoolchildren are children who go to school.

defs.def_cn: (木头、玻璃等硬物的)尖细碎片，破片，裂片

ext.ext_cn: 玻璃碎片
ext.ext_en: ...splinters of glass.

ext.ext_cn: 扎进手指的木刺
ext.ext_en: ...a splinter in the finger.

defs.def_en: A splinter is a very thin, sharp piece of wood, glass, or other hard substance, which has broken off from a larger piece.

ext.ext_cn: 尺子裂开了，碎成了小片。
ext.ext_en: The ruler cracked and splintered into pieces...

ext.ext_cn: 石块击中了玻璃，将它打成了碎片。
ext.ext_en: The stone rocketed into the glass, splintering it.

defs.def_en: If something splinters or is splintered, it breaks into thin, sharp pieces.
A throne is a decorative chair used by a king, queen, or emperor on important official occasions.

ext.ext_cn: 女王登基 50 周年纪念日
ext.ext_en: ...the Queen's 50th anniversary on the throne.

ext.ext_cn: 王位继承人
ext.ext_en: ...the heir to the throne.

defs.def_en: You can talk about the throne as a way of referring to the position of being king, queen, or emperor.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有德行的;道德高尚的;正直的

ext.ext_cn: 路易斯在人们眼里是一个智慧、勇敢、品德高尚的顾家男人。
ext.ext_en: Louis was shown as an intelligent, courageous and virtuous family man.

defs.def_en: A virtuous person behaves in a moral and correct way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 自命不凡的;自鸣得意的

ext.ext_cn: 我打扫了整个公寓，这让我觉得自己很了不起。
ext.ext_en: I cleaned the flat, which left me feeling virtuous.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as virtuous, you mean that they have done what they ought to do and feel very pleased with themselves, perhaps too pleased.
Sorcery is magic performed by using the power of evil spirits.

ext.ext_cn: 该乐队1977年斯堪的纳维亚巡回演唱会的盗版录音带
ext.ext_en: ...a bootleg recording of the band's 1977 tour of Scandinavia.

ext.ext_cn: 私酒
ext.ext_en: ...bootleg liquor.

defs.def_en: Bootleg is used to describe something that is made secretly and sold illegally.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经起诉一个歌迷非法录制他音乐会的节目。
ext.ext_en: He has sued a fan for bootlegging his concerts...

ext.ext_cn: 鲍勃·迪伦的疯狂歌迷们对他的盗版唱片视若珍宝。
ext.ext_en: Avid Bob Dylan fans treasure bootlegged recordings.

defs.def_en: To bootleg something such as a recording means to make and sell it illegally.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 多种多样的;五花八门的

ext.ext_cn: 西班牙是多种传统和多个民族的合成体。
ext.ext_en: Spain is a composite of multifarious traditions and people...

ext.ext_cn: 关闭是多种原因造成的。
ext.ext_en: The reasons for closure are multifarious.

defs.def_en: If you describe things as multifarious, you mean that they are many in number and of many different kinds.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 尼罗河流域一年四季气候温和。
ext.ext_en: The Nile Valley keeps a temperate climate throughout the year.

defs.def_en: Temperate is used to describe a climate or a place which is never extremely hot or extremely cold.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (行为)温和的，心平气和的，平心静气的

ext.ext_cn: 和之前的备忘录相比，他递交给总统的总结报告措辞要更为温和得体。
ext.ext_en: His final report to the President was far more temperate and balanced than the earlier memorandum.

defs.def_en: If a person's behaviour is temperate, it is calm and reasonable, so that they do not get angry or lose their temper easily.

defs.def_cn: (因种族、性别、宗教不同而采取的)隔离措施，隔离政策

ext.ext_cn: 联邦最高法院一致裁定学校实行的种族隔离措施违反宪法。
ext.ext_en: The Supreme Court unanimously ruled that racial segregation in schools was unconstitutional...

ext.ext_cn: 康涅狄格州同意不再隔离患艾滋病的囚犯。
ext.ext_en: Connecticut agreed to end its segregation of prison inmates suffering from AIDS.

defs.def_en: Segregation is the official practice of keeping people apart, usually people of different sexes, races, or religions.
A detonation is a large or powerful explosion.

ext.ext_cn: 核武器的意外引爆
ext.ext_en: ...accidental detonation of nuclear weapons.
