ext.ext_cn: 这儿离马尔锡有多远？
ext.ext_en: How far is it to Malcy?...

defs.def_en: If you ask how far a place is, you are asking what distance it is from you or from another place. If you ask how far someone went, you are asking what distance they travelled, or what place they reached.

defs.def_cn: (同一处的两物)离得较远的，那一边的

ext.ext_cn: 他转到屋子的那一头。
ext.ext_en: He had wandered to the far end of the room...

ext.ext_cn: 一条狭窄陡峭的小径向下伸进山谷，又从山谷的那一边向上延伸。
ext.ext_en: A narrow steep path leads down into a valley and up the far side.

defs.def_en: When there are two things of the same kind in a place, the far one is the one that is a greater distance from you.

ext.ext_cn: 我花了很长时间在英国徒步漫游，从苏格兰的最北端一直走到康沃尔。
ext.ext_en: I've spent a lot of time walking around Britain from the far north of Scotland down to Cornwall...

ext.ext_cn: 我把日期写在黑板的最左边。
ext.ext_en: I wrote the date at the far left of the blackboard.

defs.def_en: You can use far to refer to the part of an area or object that is the greatest distance from the centre in a particular direction. For example, the far north of a country is the part of it that is the greatest distance to the north.

ext.ext_cn: 很久以前就埋下祸根的潜在冲突
ext.ext_en: ...hidden conflicts whose roots lie far back in time...

ext.ext_cn: 6个月以后的事情我就无法预见了。
ext.ext_en: I can't see any farther than the next six months...

defs.def_en: A time or event that is far away in the future or the past is a long time from the present or from a particular point in time.

defs.def_cn: (用于谈及程度或范围)到…程度(或范围)

ext.ext_cn: 影片讲述的巴恩斯·沃利斯的故事有多少真实的成分？
ext.ext_en: How far did the film tell the truth about Barnes Wallis?...

ext.ext_cn: 但他们在电厂工程中能给予多少帮助尚不清楚。
ext.ext_en: But it is not clear how far they could help with the work on a power plant.

defs.def_en: You can use far to talk about the extent or degree to which something happens or is true.

defs.def_cn: (用于谈及进展)到…程度，到…阶段

ext.ext_cn: 讨论一直没多大进展。
ext.ext_en: Discussions never progressed very far...

ext.ext_cn: 想想我们在短短的时间内取得如此大的进展。
ext.ext_en: Think of how far we have come in a little time...

defs.def_en: You can talk about how far someone or something gets to describe the progress that they make.

defs.def_cn: (用于谈论行为)过分到，过分得

ext.ext_cn: 俄罗斯议院在实施自己的计划时到底会采取怎样的极端措施尚不明了。
ext.ext_en: It's still not clear how far the Russian parliament will go to implement its own plans...

ext.ext_cn: 竞争可以是良性的，但如果太过火，就可能造成以强凌弱。
ext.ext_en: Competition can be healthy, but if it is pushed too far it can result in bullying...

defs.def_en: You can talk about how far a person or action goes to describe the degree to which someone's behaviour or actions are extreme.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示在多大程度上赞成)我可不那样认为/我这样认为

ext.ext_cn: “这听上去像音乐吗？”——“我可不那样认为。”
ext.ext_en: 'Does it sound like music?' — 'I wouldn't go that far.'...

ext.ext_cn: 我可以这么说，这绝对是神经过敏。
ext.ext_en: I would go so far as to say it's positively neurotic.

defs.def_en: You can use far in expressions like 'I wouldn't go that far' and 'I would go so far' to indicate to what extent you agree with something.

defs.def_cn: (比较时用作强调)…得多，非常，太

ext.ext_cn: 吃新鲜蔬菜多的女性患焦虑症或抑郁症的几率要小很多。
ext.ext_en: Women who eat plenty of fresh vegetables are far less likely to suffer anxiety or depression...

ext.ext_cn: 警方称反应比预期好很多。
ext.ext_en: The police say the response has been far better than expected...

defs.def_en: You can use far to mean 'very much' when you are comparing two things and emphasizing the difference between them. For example, you can say that something is far better or far worse than something else to indicate that it is very much better or worse. You can also say that something is, for example, far too big to indicate that it is very much too big.

ext.ext_cn: 现在极右派比极左派威胁更大。
ext.ext_en: The far right is now a greater threat than the extreme left...

ext.ext_cn: 反种族主义活动家正在力促政府取缔所有极右组织。
ext.ext_en: Anti-racist campaigners are urging the Government to ban all far-Right groups.

defs.def_en: You can describe people with extreme left-wing or right-wing political views as the far left or the far right.

defs.def_cn: (用于表示不太确信)据我所知/就我记得的

ext.ext_cn: 据我所知，它仅仅维持了两三年。
ext.ext_en: It only lasted a couple of years, as far as I know...

ext.ext_cn: 据我了解，目前对该问题尚未进行过正规的调查。
ext.ext_en: So far as I am aware, no proper investigation has ever been carried out into the subject.

defs.def_en: You can use far in expressions like 'as far as I know' and 'so far as I remember' to indicate that you are not absolutely sure of the statement you are about to make or have just made, and you may be wrong.

defs.def_cn: (比较时用作强调)显然,…得多，大大地

ext.ext_cn: 他仍然是我们最最优秀的人才。
ext.ext_en: He's still far and away the best we have.

defs.def_en: You use the expression far and away when you are comparing something or someone with others of the same kind, in order to emphasize how great the difference is between them. For example, you can say that something is far and away the best to indicate that it is definitely the best.

defs.def_cn: (比较时用作强调)显然,…得多，大大地

ext.ext_cn: 对他们来说最重要的无疑就是失业问题。
ext.ext_en: By far the most important issue for them is unemployment...

ext.ext_cn: 保持头脑清醒要好得多。
ext.ext_en: It was better by far to be clear-headed.

defs.def_en: You use the expression by far when you are comparing something or someone with others of the same kind, in order to emphasize how great the difference is between them. For example, you can say that something is by far the best or the best by far to indicate that it is definitely the best.

ext.ext_cn: 显然，他们所记录的很多根本不是事实。
ext.ext_en: It was obvious that much of what they recorded was far from the truth...

ext.ext_cn: 我们两人非但没有放松，反而都感觉很不自在，几乎没有说话。
ext.ext_en: Far from being relaxed, we both felt so uncomfortable we hardly spoke...

defs.def_en: If you say that something is far from a particular thing or far from being the case, you are emphasizing that it is not that particular thing or not at all the case, especially when people expect or assume that it is.

defs.def_cn: (用于加强否定)远非如此，绝非这样

ext.ext_cn: 患有诵读困难症并不意味着智力低下。两者相差甚远。
ext.ext_en: Being dyslexic does not mean that one is unintelligent. Far from it.

defs.def_en: You can use the expression 'far from it' to emphasize a negative statement that you have just made.

defs.def_cn: (表示委婉地反对或批评)不是我要，不是我想

ext.ext_cn: 不是我要挑理，他们的母亲难道就不应该负点责任吗？
ext.ext_en: Far be it from me to criticise, but shouldn't their mother take a share of the blame?

defs.def_en: You say far be it from me to disagree, or far be it from me to criticize, when you are disagreeing or criticizing and you want to appear less hostile.

defs.def_cn: 在一定程度上，在有限程度上(不错或正确)

ext.ext_cn: 他的减税方案还算不错，但并不足以促使经济再次发展。
ext.ext_en: His plan for tax relief is fine as far as it goes but will not be sufficient to get the economy moving again.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is good as far as it goes or true so far as it goes, you mean that it is good or true only to a limited extent.

ext.ext_cn: 我对迈克尔·鲍尔的才华印象非常深刻，他将来会前途无量。
ext.ext_en: I was very impressed with the talent of Michael Ball. He will go far.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone will go far, you mean that they will be very successful in their career.

defs.def_cn: 病入膏肓的;无可救药的;积重难返的

ext.ext_cn: 在他弥留人世的最后几天里，疼痛似乎止住了，但那时他已奄奄一息，不再感到丝毫安慰。
ext.ext_en: In his last few days the pain seemed to have stopped, but by then he was so far gone that it was no longer any comfort...

ext.ext_cn: 很多地产情况都很糟糕，但都还不至于无法挽救。
ext.ext_en: Many of the properties are in a desperate state but none is too far gone to save.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is far gone is in such a bad state or condition that not much can be done to help or improve them.

defs.def_cn: 几近正确;相差无几;仅差毫厘

ext.ext_cn: 我过去的估计大致正确。
ext.ext_en: I hadn't been far wrong in my estimate...

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯逊离她的目标不远了。
ext.ext_en: Robertson is not far off her target.

defs.def_en: Someone or something that is not far wrong ,not far out, or not far off is almost correct or almost accurate.

ext.ext_cn: 在我看来，那就是问题所在。
ext.ext_en: That's the problem as far as I can see...

ext.ext_cn: 就我看来，采取这个行动只有两个原因。
ext.ext_en: As far as I can see there are only two reasons for such an action.

defs.def_en: You can use the expression 'as far as I can see' when you are about to state your opinion of a situation, or have just stated it, to indicate that it is your personal opinion.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的忠诚只能到这个程度。
ext.ext_en: Their loyalty only went so far...

ext.ext_cn: 教会在世俗事务上只能做这么多。
ext.ext_en: The church can only go so far in secular matters.

defs.def_en: If you say that something only goes so far or can only go so far, you mean that its extent, effect, or influence is limited.

ext.ext_cn: 到现在为止还算安静。
ext.ext_en: It's been quiet so far...

ext.ext_cn: 迄今为止，他们还从未成功过。
ext.ext_en: So far, they have met with no success...

defs.def_en: If you tell or ask someone what has happened so far, you are telling or asking them what has happened up until the present point in a situation or story, and often implying that something different might happen later.

defs.def_cn: 目前情况良好;现在还算不错

ext.ext_cn: 当然，目前情况还算不错，但这也只是一步而已。
ext.ext_en: Of course, it's a case of so far, so good, but it's only one step.

defs.def_en: You can say so far so good to express satisfaction with the way that a situation or activity is progressing, developing, or happening.

defs.def_cn: (故事)说到这儿;(情势)到这一刻

ext.ext_cn: 到目前为止，两位首相还没有取得实质性成果。
ext.ext_en: Thus far, the two prime ministers have achieved no concrete results.

defs.def_en: Thus far means up until the present point in a situation or story.

ext.ext_cn: 志愿者来自四面八方。
ext.ext_en: Volunteers came from far and wide...

ext.ext_cn: 他远近闻名。
ext.ext_en: His fame spread far and wide.

defs.def_en: If people come from far and wide, they come from a large number of places, some of them far away. If things spread far and wide, they spread over a very large area or distance.

ext.ext_cn: 记住这三条金律，就不会错到哪儿。
ext.ext_en: If you remember these three golden rules you won't go far wrong.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone won't go far wrong or can't go far wrong with a particular thing or course of action, you mean that it is likely to be successful or satisfactory.
In a vehicle, the gearshift is the same as the gear lever .

ext.ext_cn: 这些细胞可以直接攻击和杀死微生物。
ext.ext_en: These are the cells that directly attack and kill micro-organisms...

ext.ext_cn: 脉冲通常以微秒计。
ext.ext_en: The pulse is usually timed in microseconds.

defs.def_en: Micro- is used to form nouns that refer to something that is a very small example or fraction of a particular type of thing.
If a baby has nappy rash, the skin under its nappy is red and sore.

Indirect speech is speech which tells you what someone said, but does not use the person's actual words: for example, 'They said you didn't like it', 'I asked him what his plans were', and 'Citizens complained about the smoke'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 务农可能是件非常碰运气的事。
ext.ext_en: Farming can be very much a hit-and-miss affair.

defs.def_en: If something is hit and miss or hit or miss, it is sometimes successful and sometimes not.

defs.def_cn: (加在以 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 或 13 结尾的数字后构成序数词表示)“第…”

ext.ext_cn: 1990年5月10日，星期四
ext.ext_en: ...Thursday, 10th May, 1990.

ext.ext_cn: 百老汇和第六大道之间
ext.ext_en: ...between Broadway and 6th Avenue.

defs.def_en: You add -th to numbers written in figures and ending in 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, or 13 in order to form ordinal numbers. These numbers are pronounced as if they were written as words. For example, 7th is pronounced the same as 'seventh', and 5th is pronounced the same as 'fifth'.
You use -baiting after nouns to refer to the activity of attacking a particular group of people or laughing at their beliefs.

defs.def_cn: 表示“纵狗斗（獾、熊或牛等）”
defs.def_en: Badger-baiting, bear-baiting, and bull-baiting involve making these animals fight dogs, while making sure that the animals are unable to defend themselves properly.

defs.def_cn: 来之不易的;努力争取的

ext.ext_cn: 这场纠纷可能会让澳大利亚劳资关系稳定这一来之不易的名声毁于一旦。
ext.ext_en: The dispute could destroy Australia's hard-won reputation for industrial stability.

defs.def_en: If you describe something that someone has gained or achieved as hard-won, you mean that they worked hard to gain or achieve it.

ext.ext_cn: 验尸报告上显示死因为中毒。
ext.ext_en: The autopsy report gave the cause of death as poisoning.

defs.def_en: An autopsy is an examination of a dead body by a doctor who cuts it open in order to try to discover the cause of death.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 沮丧的;忧郁的;郁郁寡欢的

ext.ext_cn: 他没有取得过太多的成功，但他努力使自己不要太过沮丧。
ext.ext_en: He did not have much success, but tried not to get too disconsolate.

defs.def_en: Someone who is disconsolate is very unhappy and depressed.

ext.ext_cn: 另有5名美军士兵死于各种意外。
ext.ext_en: Five other US military personnel were killed in various incidents...

ext.ext_cn: 从事高等教育的人员新老更替极其缓慢。
ext.ext_en: There has been very little renewal of personnel in higher education...

defs.def_en: The personnel of an organization are the people who work for it.

ext.ext_cn: 她的第一份工作是人事方面的。
ext.ext_en: Her first job was in personnel.

defs.def_en: Personnel is the department in a large company or organization that deals with employees, keeps their records, and helps with any problems they might have.
A godfather is a male godparent.

defs.def_cn: 犯罪集团的头目；黑帮老大

ext.ext_cn: 令人畏惧的黑手党头目
ext.ext_en: ...the feared godfather of the Mafia.

defs.def_en: A powerful man who is at the head of a criminal organization is sometimes referred to as a godfather .

ext.ext_cn: 灵乐的开创者詹姆斯· 布朗
ext.ext_en: ...the godfather of soul, James Brown.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a man who started or developed something such as a style of music as the godfather of that thing.

defs.def_cn: 让人放松的；让人精神松弛的

ext.ext_cn: 他拖着脚去到一间休息室整理思绪。
ext.ext_en: He shuffled off to one of the chill-out rooms to collect his thoughts.

ext.ext_cn: 一些夏日的舒缓音乐
ext.ext_en: ...some summer chill-out music.

defs.def_en: Chill-out places or things are intended to help you relax.

ext.ext_cn: 有史以来最大的一桩洗钱丑闻
ext.ext_en: ...the largest money-laundering scandal in history.

defs.def_en: Money laundering is the crime of processing stolen money through a legitimate business or sending it abroad to a foreign bank, to hide the fact that the money was illegally obtained.

ext.ext_cn: 我们决不能低估自由的价值。
ext.ext_en: We must never undervalue freedom...

ext.ext_cn: 许多公司轻视女员工。
ext.ext_en: Many companies deal with their female employees in a way that undervalues them.

defs.def_en: If you undervalue something or someone, you fail to recognize how valuable or important they are.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 乌黑亮泽的头发
ext.ext_en: ...glossy black hair...

ext.ext_cn: 树叶颜色深暗，颇有光泽。
ext.ext_en: The leaves were dark and glossy.

defs.def_en: Glossy means smooth and shiny.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 虚饰的；浮华的；虚有其表的

ext.ext_cn: 装饰浮华的新办公室
ext.ext_en: ...a glossy new office...

ext.ext_cn: 英国的电视广告光艳浮华，矫揉造作。
ext.ext_en: British TV commercials are glossy and sophisticated.

defs.def_en: You can describe something as glossy if you think that it has been designed to look attractive but has little practical value or may have hidden faults.

ext.ext_cn: 一本叫《今日女性》的精美杂志
ext.ext_en: ...a glossy magazine called 'Women Today'.

defs.def_en: Glossy magazines, leaflets, books, and photographs are produced on expensive, shiny paper.
A flintlock gun is a type of gun that was used in former times. It is fired by pressing a trigger which causes a spark struck from a flint to light gunpowder.

ext.ext_cn: 龙的毒素会引起瘫痪、肿胀和恶心。
ext.ext_en: Poison from the weaver fish causes paralysis, swelling, and nausea...

ext.ext_cn: 水银是一种已知的有毒物质。
ext.ext_en: Mercury is a known poison.

defs.def_en: Poison is a substance that harms or kills people or animals if they swallow it or absorb it.

ext.ext_cn: 她曾下毒害他的谣言永远都无法得到证实。
ext.ext_en: The rumours that she had poisoned him could never be proved.

defs.def_en: If someone poisons another person, they kill the person or make them ill by giving them poison.

ext.ext_cn: 因吸入有害气体而中毒的员工昨天被送进了医院。
ext.ext_en: Employees were taken to hospital yesterday after being poisoned by fumes...

ext.ext_cn: 有毒废物可能危及生命，毒死鱼类。
ext.ext_en: Toxic waste could endanger lives and poison fish.

defs.def_en: If you are poisoned by a substance, it makes you very ill and sometimes kills you.

ext.ext_cn: 如果我是你老婆，我会在你的咖啡里下毒。
ext.ext_en: If I was your wife I would poison your coffee.

defs.def_en: If someone poisons a food, drink, or weapon, they add poison to it so that it can be used to kill someone.

defs.def_cn: 破坏，污染（水、空气或土地）

ext.ext_cn: 污染空气、破坏水源并消耗大量自然资源的纺织纤维工业
ext.ext_en: ...the textile and fibre industries that taint the air, poison the water and use vast amounts of natural resources...

ext.ext_cn: 土地已被化学品彻底污染。
ext.ext_en: The land has been completely poisoned by chemicals.

defs.def_en: To poison water, air, or land means to damage it with harmful substances such as chemicals.

ext.ext_cn: 整个气氛已全然遭到破坏。
ext.ext_en: The whole atmosphere has really been poisoned.

ext.ext_cn: 将会危害有关共同外交政策的进一步商讨的敌意
ext.ext_en: ...ill-feeling that will poison further talk of a common foreign policy.

defs.def_en: Something that poisons a good situation or relationship spoils it or destroys it.

defs.def_cn: （通常指以谎言）使（对…）产生恶感，使（对…）心怀仇视
defs.def_en: If someone poisons your mind against another person, they make you dislike that person, usually by telling you things that are not true.

ext.ext_cn: 有了地质图、书籍和地图册，你便可以找到所有已探明的珍贵矿藏的位置。
ext.ext_en: With geological maps, books and atlases you can find out all the proven sites of precious minerals.

ext.ext_cn: 一次漫长的地质勘探
ext.ext_en: ...a lengthy geological survey.

defs.def_en: Geological means relating to geology.

ext.ext_cn: 议会采纳了要求全部撤军的决议。
ext.ext_en: Parliament adopted a resolution calling for the complete withdrawal of troops...

ext.ext_cn: 应帮助学生对环境采取积极的态度。
ext.ext_en: Pupils should be helped to adopt a positive approach to the environment.

defs.def_en: If you adopt a new attitude, plan, or way of behaving, you begin to have it.

ext.ext_cn: 有数以百计的人渴望领养孩子。
ext.ext_en: There are hundreds of people desperate to adopt a child...

ext.ext_cn: 被收养的孩子有权看自己的出生证明。
ext.ext_en: The adopted child has the right to see his birth certificate.

defs.def_en: If you adopt someone else's child, you take it into your own family and make it legally your son or daughter.

ext.ext_cn: 我努力保持蜷曲的姿势以免四肢受伤。
ext.ext_en: I tried to adopt a curled-up position to avoid damaging my limbs.

defs.def_en: If you adopt a physical position, you move yourself into it.

defs.def_cn: 移居（某国）;选择（某国）定居

ext.ext_cn: 波度尔斯基加入美国海军当上了飞行员，不仅改了国籍还换了行当。
ext.ext_en: Podulski had joined the U.S. Navy as an aviator, adopting a new country and a new profession.

ext.ext_cn: 他们移居英国的家
ext.ext_en: ...their adopted home in England.

defs.def_en: If you adopt a country, you choose it as a place to live.

ext.ext_cn: 他承袭了二战时期播音员的口音。
ext.ext_en: He has adopted the accent of a Second World War newscaster...

ext.ext_cn: 女孩不知道该做什么，也不知道该用什么口气说。
ext.ext_en: The girl was uncertain what to do, or what tone of voice to adopt.

defs.def_en: If you adopt an accent or a particular tone of voice, you speak differently from normal, especially to create an effect in a particular situation.

ext.ext_cn: 必要的话我们会动用空军保护联合国维和人员。
ext.ext_en: We will use air power to protect UN peacekeepers if necessary.

defs.def_en: A nation's air power is the strength of its air force.
A bedpost is one of the four vertical supports at the corners of a bed with an old-fashioned wooden or iron frame.
A woman's womb is the part inside her body where a baby grows before it is born.
If someone calls another person a twat, they are insulting them and showing that they do not like or respect them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 关于该政党目标宗旨的广泛争论
ext.ext_en: ...a wide-ranging debate about the party's goals.

ext.ext_cn: 内容广泛的一揽子经济改革方案
ext.ext_en: ...a package of wide-ranging economic reforms...

defs.def_en: If you describe something as wide-ranging, you mean it deals with or affects a great variety of different things.

defs.def_cn: (在辩论、争论中)认错，服输，改变意图（或要求）

ext.ext_cn: 如果拉方丹被迫让步，他可能愿意重新考虑自己的立场。
ext.ext_en: If Lafontaine is forced to climb down, he may wish to reconsider his position...

ext.ext_cn: 他已经作出退让，许诺降低资本收益税。
ext.ext_en: He has climbed down on pledges to reduce capital gains tax.

defs.def_en: If you climb down in an argument or dispute, you admit that you are wrong, or change your intentions or demands.

defs.def_cn: 运作（或运转）着的；起作用的；产生影响的

ext.ext_cn: 商业电话服务已不再运营。
ext.ext_en: The commercial telephone service was no longer operative...

ext.ext_cn: 青年培训计划一直持续到1983年底。
ext.ext_en: The Youth Training Scheme was operative by the end of 1983.

defs.def_en: A system or service that is operative is working or having an effect.

ext.ext_cn: 在自动化汽车制造厂看不到一个工人。
ext.ext_en: In an automated car plant there is not a human operative to be seen.

defs.def_en: An operative is a worker, especially one who does work with their hands.

defs.def_cn: 特工；间谍；密探；情报人员

ext.ext_cn: 美国中央情报局当然想保护其特工。
ext.ext_en: Naturally the CIA wants to protect its operatives.

defs.def_en: An operative is someone who works for a government agency such as the intelligence service.

ext.ext_cn: 只要“贪婪”仍是一切的出发点，就别指望人们会降低成本。
ext.ext_en: As long as the operative word is 'greed', you can't count on people keeping the costs down...

ext.ext_cn: 医生可以建议60岁以上的老人少量地喝点威士忌以改善睡眠，然而至关重要的是必须强调“少量”这个关键词。
ext.ext_en: A small dram of whisky may be prescribed by doctors for those over 60 to help them sleep. It is vital though to emphasize that 'small' is the operative word.

defs.def_en: If you describe a word as the operative word, you want to draw attention to it because you think it is important or exactly true in a particular situation.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 调皮的;淘气的;恶作剧的

ext.ext_cn: 她像个顽皮的孩子似的，坐在椅子上来回摇晃。
ext.ext_en: She rocks back and forth on her chair like a mischievous child...

ext.ext_cn: 他有一点淘气。
ext.ext_en: He's a little mischievous.

defs.def_en: A mischievous person likes to have fun by playing harmless tricks on people or doing things they are not supposed to do.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 恶意的;不友善的;捣乱的

ext.ext_cn: 媒体恶意分裂非洲国民大会的运动
ext.ext_en: ...a mischievous campaign by the press to divide the ANC...

ext.ext_cn: 外交部驳斥该报道为恶意报道，不符合事实。
ext.ext_en: The Foreign Office dismissed the story as mischievous and false.

defs.def_en: A mischievous act or suggestion is intended to cause  trouble.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 把所有值钱的东西和易碎的物品都收起来。
ext.ext_en: Put away any valuable or breakable objects.

ext.ext_cn: 把易碎物品放在小孩子够不到的地方。
ext.ext_en: Keep breakables out of reach of very young children.

defs.def_en: Breakable objects are easy to break by accident.

ext.ext_cn: 他现在可能打算批准使用武力。
ext.ext_en: He may now be ready to sanction the use of force...

ext.ext_cn: 他似乎正准备批准增加公共贷款。
ext.ext_en: He seemed to be preparing to sanction an increase in public borrowing.

defs.def_en: If someone in authority sanctions an action or practice, they officially approve of it and allow it to be done.

ext.ext_cn: 1935 年国际联盟在意大利入侵埃塞俄比亚之后对其实施了制裁。
ext.ext_en: In 1935 the League of Nations imposed sanctions against Italy following its invasion of Ethiopia.

ext.ext_cn: 他对解除制裁表示反对。
ext.ext_en: He expressed his opposition to the lifting of sanctions.

defs.def_en: Sanctions are measures taken by countries to restrict trade and official contact with a country that has broken international law.

ext.ext_cn: 作为最高的处罚，他们可以出售他们的股份。
ext.ext_en: As an ultimate sanction, they can sell their shares.

defs.def_en: A sanction is a severe course of action which is intended to make people obey instructions, customs, or laws.

ext.ext_cn: 对日本违反国际保护条约残杀鲸鱼的行为他们未能进行制裁
ext.ext_en: ...their failure to sanction Japan for butchering whales in violation of international conservation treaties.

defs.def_en: If a country or an authority sanctions another country or a person for doing something, it declares that the country or person is guilty of doing it and imposes sanctions on them.

defs.def_cn: (不加牛奶的)纯巧克力，黑巧克力
defs.def_en: Plain chocolate is dark brown chocolate that has a stronger and less sweet taste than milk chocolate.

defs.def_cn: 把…打扮得漂漂亮亮；把…装饰得更吸引人

ext.ext_cn: 他们都打扮得漂漂亮亮。
ext.ext_en: They all got gussied up.

ext.ext_cn: 将会场装饰一新、提供更加美味的食物和更好的电子游戏厅的计划
ext.ext_en: ...plans to gussy up the venues, offering better food and games arcades.

defs.def_en: If someone is gussied up, they are dressed very smartly. If something is gussied up, it is made more interesting or attractive.

ext.ext_cn: 他缓缓地深吸了一口气。
ext.ext_en: He took a long slow breath, inhaling deeply...

ext.ext_cn: 他因吸入烟尘而接受治疗。
ext.ext_en: He was treated for the effects of inhaling smoke.

defs.def_en: When you inhale, you breathe in. When you inhale something such as smoke, you take it into your lungs when you breathe in.

ext.ext_cn: 他宣称自己是清白的，在钱财上没有弄虚作假。
ext.ext_en: He asserted his innocence and his financial probity.

defs.def_en: Probity is a high standard of correct moral behaviour.
An adulteress is a woman who commits adultery.

defs.def_cn: 解剖的；（人体或动物体）结构上的

ext.ext_cn: 昆虫身体结构之间的细微差别
ext.ext_en: ...minute anatomical differences between insects.

defs.def_en: Anatomical means relating to the structure of the bodies of people and animals.

ext.ext_cn: 他因受到行贿指控而被捕入狱。
ext.ext_en: He was jailed on charges of bribery.

ext.ext_cn: 行贿和腐败的指控
ext.ext_en: ...accusations of bribery and corruption.

defs.def_en: Bribery is the act of offering someone money or something valuable in order to persuade them to do something for you.
A dry dock is a dock from which water can be removed so that ships or boats can be built or repaired.

ext.ext_cn: 他从事医学。
ext.ext_en: He pursued a career in medicine...

ext.ext_cn: 我对替代疗法非常感兴趣，想做个芳香疗法治疗师。
ext.ext_en: I was interested in alternative medicine and becoming an aromatherapist...

defs.def_en: Medicine is the treatment of illness and injuries by doctors and nurses.

ext.ext_cn: 由于药品匮乏，医院里的病人濒临死亡。
ext.ext_en: People in hospitals are dying because of shortage of medicine.

ext.ext_cn: 草药
ext.ext_en: ...herbal medicines.

defs.def_en: Medicine is a substance that you drink or swallow in order to cure an illness.

defs.def_cn: 麋鹿，驼鹿(一些英国人以 elk 称亚洲和欧洲的亚种，以 moose 称北美亚种)
defs.def_en: An elk is a type of large deer. Elks have big, flat horns called antlers and are found in Northern Europe, Asia, and North America. Some British speakers use elk to refer to the European and Asian varieties of this animal, and moose to refer to the North American variety.

ext.ext_cn: 她靠他帮忙解决自身问题。
ext.ext_en: She leaned on him to help her to solve her problems.

defs.def_en: If you lean on someone or lean upon them, you depend on them for support and encouragement.

ext.ext_cn: 他叫我们滚蛋，于是我们威胁他的孩子。
ext.ext_en: He told us to get stuffed so we leaned on his kid...

ext.ext_cn: 科林正承受来自银行的压力。
ext.ext_en: Colin was being leaned on by his bankers.

defs.def_en: If you lean on someone, you try to influence them, especially by threatening them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我想她此刻定会觉得受到了极大的伤害，无人关爱。
ext.ext_en: I think she feels desperately wounded and unloved at the moment.

ext.ext_cn: 孤独的、没人疼爱的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...a lonely, unloved child.

defs.def_en: If someone feels unloved, they feel that nobody loves them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 莫雷蒂用手理了理他那一头凌乱的红发。
ext.ext_en: Moretti ran a hand through his disordered red hair.

ext.ext_cn: 一堆杂乱的长满苔藓的树枝
ext.ext_en: ...a disordered heap of mossy branches.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as disordered, you mean it is untidy and is not neatly arranged.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (精神)失调的，错乱的，不正常的，有病的

ext.ext_cn: 帮助患有心理障碍的罪犯的社会机构
ext.ext_en: ...agencies working with mentally disordered offenders.

ext.ext_cn: 在精神不正常的人看来是一个阴谋的事件
ext.ext_en: ...events that crystallized into a conspiracy in one disordered mind.

defs.def_en: Someone who is mentally disordered or who has a disordered mind is mentally ill.

defs.def_cn: 军训营;(运动员)集训基地
defs.def_en: A training camp for soldiers or sports players is an organized period of training at a particular place.

ext.ext_cn: 他想成立一家主要归这所大学所有的营利性公司。
ext.ext_en: He wants to set up a profit-making company, owned mostly by the university.

defs.def_en: See also:non-profit-making;A profit-making business or organization makes a profit.

ext.ext_cn: 气候和天气影响着我们生活的方方面面。
ext.ext_en: Climate and weather affect every aspect of our lives...

ext.ext_cn: 他对这里工作的所有方面都感兴趣。
ext.ext_en: He was interested in all aspects of the work here...

defs.def_en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

ext.ext_cn: 这幢房子面向西南。
ext.ext_en: The house had a south-west aspect.

defs.def_en: The aspect of a building or window is the direction in which it faces.

ext.ext_cn: 我们所到之地呈现出一派新景象。乡村变得不再熟悉。
ext.ext_en: Our journey had taken on a new aspect. The countryside was no longer familiar...

ext.ext_cn: 积雪覆盖的街道就像教堂一样，显得沉闷、毫无生气。
ext.ext_en: The snowy street, like the church, assumed a dumb, lifeless aspect.

defs.def_en: If something begins to have a new aspect, it begins to have a new appearance or quality.

In grammar, aspect is the way that a verb group shows whether an activity is continuing, is repeated, or is completed. For example, in 'They were laughing', the verb is in the progressive aspect and shows that the action was continuing.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在咖啡馆道别。
ext.ext_en: They said their farewells there at the cafe.

ext.ext_cn: 他们在咖啡馆道别。
ext.ext_en: They said their farewells there at the cafe.

defs.def_en: Farewell means the same as goodbye .
Spaghetti is a type of pasta. It looks like long pieces of string and is usually served with a sauce.

ext.ext_cn: 英国航空公司地勤人员的罢工已经造成伦敦至曼彻斯特的航线停运。
ext.ext_en: A strike by British Airways ground staff has led to the suspension of flights between London and Manchester...

ext.ext_cn: 艺术专家们呼吁暂缓对一幅莱昂纳多·达芬奇的绝世名画的修复计划。
ext.ext_en: Art experts have appealed for the suspension of plans to restore one of Leonardo da Vinci's most celebrated paintings.

defs.def_en: The suspension of something is the act of delaying or stopping it for a while or until a decision is made about it.

ext.ext_cn: 部长警告说，任何擅离职守的公务员都会被立即停职。
ext.ext_en: The minister warned that any civil servant not at his desk faced immediate suspension...

ext.ext_cn: 该运动员因尿检结果呈阳性而被停赛两年。
ext.ext_en: The athlete received a two-year suspension following a positive drug test.

defs.def_en: Someone's suspension is their removal from a job or position for a period of time or until a decision is made about them.
A vehicle's suspension consists of the springs and other devices attached to the wheels, which give a smooth ride over uneven ground.

defs.def_cn: 偶然听到；无意中听到；偷听到

ext.ext_cn: 我无意中听到两位医生讨论我的病情。
ext.ext_en: I overheard two doctors discussing my case.

ext.ext_cn: 偷听到的片言只语
ext.ext_en: ...snatches of overheard conversation.

defs.def_en: If you overhear someone, you hear what they are saying when they are not talking to you and they do not know that you are listening.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 冒犯的；得罪人的；唐突的;无礼的

ext.ext_cn: 他的一些朋友觉得该剧非常让人反感。
ext.ext_en: Some friends of his found the play horribly offensive.

ext.ext_cn: 令我公司的诚信遭受质疑的冒犯性言论
ext.ext_en: ...offensive remarks which called into question the integrity of my firm.

defs.def_en: Something that is offensive upsets or embarrasses people because it is rude or insulting.

ext.ext_cn: 它对叛军的最新一轮军事进攻旨在重新打开重要的贸易通道。
ext.ext_en: Its latest military offensive against rebel forces is aimed at reopening important trade routes...

ext.ext_cn: 这支武装部队已发动进攻要夺回失去的阵地。
ext.ext_en: The armed forces have launched offensives to recapture lost ground.

defs.def_en: A military offensive is a carefully planned attack made by a large group of soldiers.

defs.def_cn: （表示愤怒或反对的）强硬行动

ext.ext_cn: 共和党人承认他们别无选择，只有对获提名的民主党人展开全面攻击。
ext.ext_en: Republicans acknowledged that they had little choice but to mount an all-out offensive on the Democratic nominee.

ext.ext_cn: 外交攻势
ext.ext_en: ...a diplomatic offensive.

defs.def_en: See also:charm offensive;If you conduct an offensive, you take strong action to show how angry you are about something or how much you disapprove of something.

defs.def_cn: （体育运动中球队）进攻的，攻方的

ext.ext_cn: 该队前所未有的惨败再次证明斯坦福队是国内最具爆发力的进攻型队伍之一。
ext.ext_en: The worst-ever defeat of this team proved once again that Stanford can be one of the most explosive offensive teams in the country.

defs.def_en: In sports such as American football or basketball, the offensive team is the team which has possession of the ball and is trying to score.

defs.def_cn: 采取强势行动；采取攻势

ext.ext_cn: 西非部队对袭击者展开全力还击。
ext.ext_en: The West African forces went on the offensive in response to attacks on them...

ext.ext_cn: 外交大臣决定在有关该社群未来的讨论中采取攻势。
ext.ext_en: The Foreign Secretary has decided to take the offensive in the discussion on the future of the community.

defs.def_en: If you go on the offensive ,go over to the offensive, or take the offensive, you begin to take strong action against people who have been attacking you.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 理想主义青年为这项事业而献身。
ext.ext_en: Idealistic young people died for the cause...

ext.ext_cn: 较年长的母亲往往对身为人母的乐趣过于理想化。
ext.ext_en: Older mothers tend to be too idealistic about the pleasures of motherhood.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as idealistic, you mean that they have ideals, and base their behaviour on these ideals, even though this may be impractical.

ext.ext_cn: 硬木地板上铺着一张波斯地毯。
ext.ext_en: A Persian rug covered the hardwood floors.

defs.def_en: A rug is a piece of thick material that you put on a floor. It is like a carpet but covers a smaller area.

defs.def_cn: (盖肩膀或膝盖以保暖的)围毯，小毯子

ext.ext_cn: 老太太坐在窗边的椅子上，膝盖上盖着一条小毯子。
ext.ext_en: The old lady was seated in her chair at the window, a rug over her knees.

ext.ext_cn: 旅行毛毯
ext.ext_en: ...a travel rug.

defs.def_en: A rug is a small blanket which you use to cover your shoulders or your knees to keep them warm.

ext.ext_cn: 如果这些银行不再对这个倒霉的项目提供支持，它也就破产了。
ext.ext_en: If the banks opt to pull the rug from under the ill-fated project, it will go into liquidation.

defs.def_en: If someone pulls the rug from under a person or thing or pulls the rug from under someone's feet, they stop giving their help or support.  to sweep something under the rug→see: sweep;

defs.def_cn: （房屋、公寓、土地的）占用者，居住人，使用人
defs.def_en: See also:owner-occupier;The occupier of a house, flat, or piece of land is the person who lives or works there.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不能允许教条主义阻碍进步。
ext.ext_en: We cannot allow dogmatism to stand in the way of progress.

defs.def_en: If you refer to an opinion as dogmatism, you are criticizing it for being strongly stated without considering all the relevant facts or other people's opinions.

ext.ext_cn: 她小口地吃着热狗，用餐巾优雅地擦着嘴。
ext.ext_en: She was taking tiny bites of a hot dog and daintily wiping her lips with a napkin.

defs.def_en: A napkin is a square of cloth or paper that you use when you are eating to protect your clothes, or to wipe your mouth or hands.

defs.def_cn: (版面小、文章短、图片多的)通俗小报

ext.ext_cn: “当时的英国小报都说我‘双腿修长’、‘艳惊四座’，”她回忆道。
ext.ext_en: 'The British tabloids called me leggy and stunning,' she recalls.

defs.def_en: A tabloid is a newspaper that has small pages, short articles, and lots of photographs. Tabloids are often considered to be less serious than other newspapers.
If one person calls another person an asshole, they think that person is extremely stupid or has behaved in a stupid way.

ext.ext_cn: 他的声音在刺骨的寒风中越来越微弱。
ext.ext_en: His voice tailed away in the bitter cold air...

ext.ext_cn: 贝内迪克特的声音渐渐小到快听不见时又大了起来。
ext.ext_en: Benedict's voice tailed off, then resumed.

defs.def_en: When a person's voice tails away or tails off, it gradually becomes quieter and then silent.

ext.ext_cn: 一局斯诺克比赛
ext.ext_en: ...a game of snooker...

ext.ext_cn: 他们在打斯诺克。
ext.ext_en: They were playing snooker.

defs.def_en: Snooker is a game involving balls on a large table. The players use a long stick to hit a white ball, and score points by knocking coloured balls into the pockets at the sides of the table.

defs.def_cn: 阻止…采取行动;使…不如愿

ext.ext_cn: 在这个问题上，总统未能如愿。
ext.ext_en: The President has been snookered on this issue.

defs.def_en: If you are snookered by something, it is difficult or impossible for you to take action or do what you want to do.

defs.def_cn: 名称;称号;标示;指定;命名;指派

ext.ext_cn: 用于标示非常严重事件的第四级警戒
ext.ext_en: ...a level four alert, a designation reserved for very serious incidents.

ext.ext_cn: 马德里被命名为 1992 年度的欧洲文化之城
ext.ext_en: ...the designation of Madrid as European City of Culture 1992.

defs.def_en: A designation is a description, name, or title that is given to someone or something. Designation is the fact of giving that description, name, or title.

defs.def_cn: （从高处俯视产生的）眩晕，头晕;恐高症

ext.ext_cn: 如果你头晕，就会觉得整个房间都旋转起来。
ext.ext_en: If you have vertigo it seems as if the whole room is spinning round you...

ext.ext_cn: 他忽然头晕得厉害。
ext.ext_en: He had a dreadful attack of vertigo.

defs.def_en: If you get vertigo when you look down from a high place, you feel unsteady and sick.
A pot roast is a piece of meat that is cooked very slowly with a small amount of liquid in a covered pot.

defs.def_cn: (用于强调情感或需要的强烈程度)很，非常

ext.ext_cn: 我本人就感到特别失望。
ext.ext_en: I for one was sorely disappointed.

ext.ext_cn: 通过海外订单为英国赚取其迫切需要的资金的可能性
ext.ext_en: ...the potential to earn sorely needed money for Britain from overseas orders...

defs.def_en: Sorely is used to emphasize that a feeling such as disappointment or need is very strong.

ext.ext_cn: 被裁员的耻辱
ext.ext_en: ...the ignominy of being made redundant...

ext.ext_cn: 一旦他们被抓住,她就会名誉扫地,被很不光彩地撤职开除。
ext.ext_en: If they were caught, she would be thrown out in disgrace, dismissed with ignominy.

defs.def_en: Ignominy is shame or public disgrace.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

defs.def_en: If you regard someone as a mother figure, you think of them as having the role of a mother and being the person you can turn to for help, advice, or support.

defs.def_en: If people promulgate a new law or a new idea, they make it widely known.

ext.ext_en: A new constitution was promulgated last month.

defs.def_en: If a new law is promulgated by a government or national leader, it is publicly approved or made official.

ext.ext_en: Why is full-frontal male nudity still so scarce in films?

defs.def_en: If you hurry somewhere, you go there as quickly as you can.

defs.def_en: If you are in a hurry to do something, you need or want to do something quickly. If you do something in a hurry, you do it quickly or suddenly.

ext.ext_en: ...The President's attempt to hurry the process of independence.

defs.def_en: To hurry something means the same as to hurry up something.

defs.def_en: If you hurry someone to a place or into a situation, you try to make them go to that place or get into that situation quickly.

ext.ext_en: Many academics remain unconvinced of the need for change.

ext.ext_en: On the customs declaration, the sender labeled the freight as agricultural machinery...

ext.ext_en: They will ask you to sign a declaration allowing your doctor to disclose your medical details.

defs.def_en: A declaration is a written statement about something which you have signed and which can be used as evidence in a court of law.

ext.ext_en: The truck industry is a benchmark for the economy.

defs.def_en: A benchmark is something whose quality or quantity is known and which can therefore be used as a standard with which other things can be compared.

ext.ext_en: ...gangs of ruffians who lurk about intent on troublemaking.

defs.def_en: A ruffian is a man who behaves violently and is involved in crime.
A night stand is a small table or cupboard that you have next to your bed.
A tent is a shelter made of canvas or nylon which is held up by poles and ropes, and is used mainly by people who are camping.

ext.ext_en: Valentino was virtually deified by legions of female fans.

defs.def_en: If someone is deified, they are considered to be a god or are regarded with very great respect.

ext.ext_en: He didn't speak much, he just smiled with that serene smile of his.

ext.ext_en: The old men blather on and on...

ext.ext_en: Stop blathering...

defs.def_en: If someone is blathering on about something, they are talking for a long time about something that you consider boring or unimportant.

ext.ext_cn: 灰色套装
ext.ext_en: ...a grey suit.

defs.def_en: Grey is the colour of ashes or of clouds on a rainy day.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...my grey hair...

ext.ext_cn: 埃迪的头发开始变白了。
ext.ext_en: Eddie was going grey.

defs.def_en: You use grey to describe the colour of people's hair when it changes from its original colour, usually as they get old.

ext.ext_cn: 这是4月一个阴雨绵绵的星期天。
ext.ext_en: It was a grey, wet April Sunday.

defs.def_en: If the weather is grey, there are many clouds in the sky and the light is dull.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Brazilians look gloomily forward to a New Year that even the president admits will be grey and cheerless.

defs.def_en: If you describe a situation as grey, you mean that it is dull, unpleasant, or difficult.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...little grey men in suits.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as grey, you think that they are boring and unattractive, and very similar to other things or other people.

defs.def_en: Journalists sometimes use grey to describe things concerning old people.

defs.def_en: If you reap the harvest, you benefit or suffer from the results of your past actions or of someone else's past actions.

ext.ext_en: Both leaders seemed to expect measurable progress.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as measurable, you mean that it is large enough to be noticed or to be significant.

ext.ext_en: The race for the White House begins in earnest today...

ext.ext_en: The College welcomes students of all races, faiths, and nationalities...

ext.ext_en: Do they realize we are racing towards complete economic collapse?...

ext.ext_en: American economic growth raced ahead.

ext.ext_en: He still raced sports cars as often as he could.

defs.def_cn: （心脏因兴奋或害怕）快速搏动，剧烈跳动

ext.ext_cn: 一名空军发言人说这次营救行动是在和时间赛跑。

defs.def_cn: 人道主义；人道主义行为

defs.def_en: A lesion is an injury or wound to someone's body.

defs.def_cn: 充满活力的;生气勃勃的

ext.ext_en: ...a lucid account of the history of mankind...

defs.def_en: If someone seems very satisfied with something they have done, you can say that they are pleased with themselves, especially if you think they are more satisfied than they should be.

defs.def_cn: 见到你很高兴；幸会；认识你很高兴

ext.ext_en: Museum basements are stacked full of objects which never see the light of day.

defs.def_en: If you say that an object sees the light of day or sees the light, you mean that it is taken out of the place where it is stored.

ext.ext_cn: 这份非同寻常的文件第一次公开是在1966年。
ext.ext_en: This extraordinary document first saw the light of day in 1966.

defs.def_en: If something sees the light of day at a particular time, it comes into existence or is made known to the public at that time.

ext.ext_cn: 我终于醒悟，甩掉了他。
ext.ext_en: I saw the light and ditched him.

defs.def_en: If someone sees the light, they finally realize something or change their attitude or way of behaving to a better one.

ext.ext_en: They had poured fuel through the door of the flat and had then set light to it.

defs.def_en: If you set light to something, you make it start burning.

defs.def_cn: 使（某事）显得非常清楚；使人了解（某事）

ext.ext_cn: 新的方法提供了一个答案，并且可能让人们对一个更大的问题有进一步的了解。
ext.ext_en: A new approach offers an answer, and may shed light on an even bigger question.

defs.def_en: To shed light on ,throw light on, or cast light on something means to make it easier to understand, because more information is known about it.

defs.def_cn: 隧道尽头的曙光；黑暗尽头的希望

ext.ext_cn: 我只能告诉她要坚持，让她知道总会柳暗花明的。
ext.ext_en: All I can do is tell her to hold on, that there's light at the end of the tunnel.

defs.def_en: When you talk about the light at the end of the tunnel, you are referring to the end of the difficult or unpleasant situation that you are in at the moment.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Modern tennis rackets are now apparently 20 per cent lighter.

ext.ext_cn: 轻量负重训练
ext.ext_en: ...weight training with light weights...

defs.def_en: Something that is light does not weigh very much, or weighs less than you would expect it to.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 少量的；程度轻的；强度低的

ext.ext_cn: 这是一个星期天，像任何一个星期天一样，城里的车辆不多。
ext.ext_en: It's  a Sunday like any other with the usual light traffic in the city...

ext.ext_cn: 昨天拍卖之前的成交量很小。
ext.ext_en: Trading was very light ahead of yesterday's auction.

defs.def_en: Something that is light is not very great in amount, degree, or intensity.

ext.ext_cn: 轻型装甲车队
ext.ext_en: ...a convoy of light armoured vehicles...

ext.ext_cn: 他们使用了轻机枪和AK—47步枪。
ext.ext_en: They used light machine guns and AK forty-sevens.

defs.def_en: Light equipment and machines are small and easily moved, especially because they are not heavy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 进入底土的化学物质会减少，这对土质松软的热带土壤而言尤为重要。
ext.ext_en: Less chemical gets into the subsoil which is particularly important with the light, tropical soils.

defs.def_en: Soil that is light is easy to dig, because it has a loose texture and is not sticky or solid.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 墙的颜色素淡，贴了墙纸。
ext.ext_en: The walls are light in colour and covered in paper...

ext.ext_cn: 他浅色头发，灰色眼睛。
ext.ext_en: He is light haired with gray eyes.

defs.def_en: Something that is light is very pale in colour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她迷迷糊糊地进入了浅睡。
ext.ext_en: She had drifted into a light sleep...

ext.ext_cn: 她通常很容易惊醒。
ext.ext_en: She was usually a light sleeper.

defs.def_en: A light sleep is one that is easily disturbed and in which you are often aware of the things around you. If you are a light sleeper, you are easily woken when you are asleep.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 那嗓音甜美轻柔。
ext.ext_en: The voice was sweet and light.

defs.def_en: A light sound, for example someone's voice, is pleasantly quiet.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 量少而健康的午餐
ext.ext_en: ...a light, healthy lunch.

ext.ext_cn: 酒和奶酪或其他小食品
ext.ext_en: ...wine and cheese or other light refreshment.

defs.def_en: A light meal consists of a small amount of food, or of food that is easy to digest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 伯蒂做的西红柿清汤清淡可口。
ext.ext_en: Berti's  clear tomato soup is deliciously light...

ext.ext_cn: 用箔纸包烤或用清汤蒸煮三文鱼8至10分钟。
ext.ext_en: Bake salmon in foil or poach in a light stock for 8-10 minutes.

defs.def_en: Food that is light has a delicate flavour and is easy to digest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 昨天他在训练场进行了一些强度较小的训练。
ext.ext_en: He was on the training field for some light work yesterday.

defs.def_en: Light work does not involve much physical effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （行为后果、处罚等）轻微的，不严重的

ext.ext_cn: 父亲来探监时，她承认对自己受到的从轻判决感到诧异。
ext.ext_en: She confessed her astonishment at her light sentence when her father visited her at the jail.

defs.def_en: If you describe the result of an action or a punishment as light, you mean that it is less serious or severe than you expected.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 轻捷的；轻盈的；用力小的

ext.ext_cn: 涂抹乳霜或化妆品时动作要轻。
ext.ext_en: Use a light touch when applying cream or make-up...

ext.ext_cn: 有人在轻轻地敲门。
ext.ext_en: There was a light knock at the door.

defs.def_en: Movements and actions that are light are graceful or gentle and are done with very little force or effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （书、音乐、电影等）消遣性的，娱乐性的，轻松的

ext.ext_cn: 他不喜欢我看些消遣小说。
ext.ext_en: He doesn't like me reading light novels.

ext.ext_cn: 轻古典音乐
ext.ext_en: ...light classical music.

defs.def_en: If you describe things such as books, music, and films as light, you mean that they entertain you without making you think very deeply.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 用友好随意的方式跟他谈谈这一关系吧。
ext.ext_en: Talk to him in a friendly, light way about the relationship...

ext.ext_cn: 最后，我们谈一个比较轻松的话题吧。
ext.ext_en: Let's finish on a lighter note.

defs.def_en: If you say something in a light way, you sound as if you think that something is not important or serious.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （通常用于否定句）轻微的，不重要的

ext.ext_cn: 竟然有那么多的年轻囚犯试图自杀或自残，内政部决不可等闲视之。
ext.ext_en: It can be no light matter for the Home Office that so many young prisoners should have wanted to kill or injure themselves.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not a light matter, you mean that it should be treated or considered as being important and serious.

defs.def_cn: 轻视；对…不在乎；视…为微不足道

ext.ext_cn: 罗伯茨试图轻描淡写自己的不适。
ext.ext_en: Roberts attempted to make light of his discomfort.

defs.def_en: If you make light of something, you treat it as though it is not serious or important, when in fact it is.

defs.def_cn: （靠风力或水力驱动机器的)翼，叶片，轮叶
defs.def_en: See also:weather vane;A vane is a flat blade which pushes or is pushed by wind or water, and forms part of a machine such as a fan, a windmill, or a ship's propeller.

ext.ext_cn: 多伦多枫叶队连续第三年捧杯。
ext.ext_en: The Cup was won for the third consecutive year by the Toronto Maple Leafs...

ext.ext_cn: 在连续两个艳阳天的同一时间拍摄的照片也可能大不相同。
ext.ext_en: Photographs taken at the same time on two consecutive sunny days can be quite different from one another.

defs.def_en: Consecutive periods of time or events happen one after the other without interruption.

defs.def_cn: 菲洛法克斯活页记事本
defs.def_en: A Filofax is a type of personal filing system in the form of a small book with pages that can easily be added or removed.

defs.def_cn: (who will 和 who shall的一种口语表达形式)
defs.def_en: Who'll is a spoken form of 'who will' or 'who shall'.

ext.ext_cn: 他说，难民们将被转移到一个搭有帐篷的营地去。
ext.ext_en: He said the refugees would be moved to a tented camp.

defs.def_en: A tented field or a tented camp is an area where a number of people are living in tents.

ext.ext_cn: 帐篷形的就餐区
ext.ext_en: ...a tented dining area...

ext.ext_cn: 形似帐篷的天花板上隐藏着迷宫似的水管。
ext.ext_en: The tented ceiling hides a maze of water pipes.

defs.def_en: A tented room has long pieces of material hanging down from the centre of the ceiling to the walls, so that the room has the appearance of the inside of a large tent.

defs.def_en: An office boy is a young man, especially one who has just left school, who is employed in an office to do simple tasks.

ext.ext_en: You measure yourself, enter measurements and the computer will print out the pattern...

ext.ext_en: The images of the moon's surface were transmitted back to earth and printed out...

defs.def_en: See also:printout;If a computer or a machine attached to a computer prints something out, it produces a copy of it on paper.

ext.ext_cn: 谢尔登一周 7 天都要写作，每天早上口述小说让别人记录。
ext.ext_en: Sheldon writes every day of the week, dictating his novels in the morning...

ext.ext_cn: 他口授的所有内容都签上名并在同一天寄出了。
ext.ext_en: Everything he dictated was signed and sent out the same day.

defs.def_en: If you dictate something, you say or read it aloud for someone else to write down.

defs.def_cn: 命令;发号施令;强行规定

ext.ext_cn: 他警告西方国家不要试图对苏联发号施令。
ext.ext_en: He had warned the West against trying to dictate to the Soviet Union...

ext.ext_cn: 一个国家有什么权力强行给另一个国家制定环境标准？
ext.ext_en: What right has one country to dictate the environmental standards of another?...

defs.def_en: If someone dictates to someone else, they tell them what they should do or can do.

ext.ext_cn: 影片的预算决定了拍摄进度会很紧张。
ext.ext_en: The film's  budget dictated a tough schedule...

ext.ext_cn: 他们的着装受到时尚规则的严格限制。
ext.ext_en: The way in which they dress is dictated by very rigid fashion rules...

defs.def_en: If one thing dictates another, the first thing causes or influences the second thing.

ext.ext_cn: 现在，常识告诉我们卖掉一些股票是明智的。
ext.ext_en: Commonsense now dictates that it would be wise to sell a few shares.

defs.def_en: You say that reason or common sense dictates that a particular thing is the case when you believe strongly that it is the case and that reason or common sense will cause other people to agree.

ext.ext_cn: 他们的工作就是确保党的指示得到执行。
ext.ext_en: Their job is to ensure that the dictates of the Party are followed.

defs.def_en: A dictate is an order which you have to obey.

ext.ext_cn: 我们遵从了自己的良知，尽到了自己的义务。
ext.ext_en: We have followed the dictates of our consciences and have done our duty.

defs.def_en: Dictates are principles or rules which you consider to be extremely important.
A tank top is a knitted piece of clothing that covers the upper part of your body and has no sleeves.
A tank top is a soft cotton shirt with no sleeves, collar, or buttons.

defs.def_cn: （电台或电视台节目的）制作播出，播放

ext.ext_en: If this happens it will change the face of religious broadcasting.

ext.ext_en: ...the state broadcasting organisation.

defs.def_en: Broadcasting is the making and sending out of television and radio programmes.

ext.ext_cn: 咖啡因是茶、咖啡之类饮品中的活性成分。
ext.ext_en: Caffeine is the active constituent of drinks such as tea and coffee.

defs.def_en: A constituent of a mixture, substance, or system is one of the things from which it is formed.

ext.ext_cn: 把公司按组成部分分割后分别出售的计划
ext.ext_en: ...a plan to split the company into its constituent parts and sell them separately.

ext.ext_cn: 俄联邦各成员国的领导人
ext.ext_en: ...the leaders of Russia's constituent republics.

defs.def_en: The constituent parts of something are the things from which it is formed.

ext.ext_cn: 那些牛甩动着尾巴驱赶苍蝇。
ext.ext_en: The cattle were swinging their tails to disperse the flies.

ext.ext_cn: 长尾黑狗
ext.ext_en: ...a black dog with a long tail.

defs.def_en: The tail of an animal, bird, or fish is the part extending beyond the end of its body.

ext.ext_en: ...the horizontal stabilizer bar on the plane's tail...

ext.ext_en: Elsie tugged her husband's coat tail.

defs.def_en: You can use tail to refer to the end or back of something, especially something long and thin.
If a man is wearing tails, he is wearing a formal jacket which has two long pieces hanging down at the back.

ext.ext_en: Officers had tailed the gang from London during a major undercover inquiry...

ext.ext_en: He trusted her so little that he had her tailed.

defs.def_en: To tail someone means to follow close behind them and watch where they go and what they do.

ext.ext_en: He checked behind. No tail.

defs.def_en: A tail is someone who is paid to watch and to follow another person.
If you toss a coin and it comes down tails, you can see the side of it that does not have a picture of a head on it.

ext.ext_cn: 以往和电视台的交易中，足球俱乐部就已经有过喧宾夺主的记录。现在，他们更是觉得可以和电视台平起平坐了。
ext.ext_en: Past TV deals have seen the tail wagging the dog. Now football clubs feel they are equal partners with TV.

defs.def_en: If you say that the tail is wagging the dog, you mean that a small or unimportant part of something is becoming too important and is controlling the whole thing.

defs.def_cn: （由于失败或羞愧）夹着尾巴，垂头丧气

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚，他的队伍灰溜溜地退场了。
ext.ext_en: His team retreated last night with tails tucked firmly between their legs.

defs.def_en: If you say that you have your tail between your legs, you are emphasizing that you feel defeated and ashamed.

ext.ext_cn: 我掉头就跑，朝主屋方向逃去。
ext.ext_en: I turned tail and fled in the direction of the main house.

defs.def_en: If you turn tail, you turn and run away.

ext.ext_cn: 总统在他的就职演说中呼吁国家统一。
ext.ext_en: In his inaugural address, the President appealed for unity.

defs.def_en: An inaugural meeting or speech is the first meeting of a new organization or the first speech by the new leader of an organization or a country.

ext.ext_en: There are not many players who can outrun me.

defs.def_en: If you outrun someone, you run faster than they do, and therefore are able to escape from them or to arrive somewhere before they do.

ext.ext_cn: 消费有可能超出企业的产能。
ext.ext_en: Spending could outrun the capacity of businesses to produce the goods.

defs.def_en: If one thing outruns another thing, the first thing develops faster than the second thing.

ext.ext_en: Our branches are open from 9am to 5pm during the week and until 12 noon on Saturdays.

defs.def_en: See also:high noon;Noon is twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.

ext.ext_cn: 正午的阳光火辣辣的。
ext.ext_en: The noon sun was fierce...

ext.ext_cn: 他希望转账在今天中午的最后期限之前完成。
ext.ext_en: He expected the transfer to go through by today's noon deadline.

defs.def_en: Noon means happening or appearing in the middle part of the day.

ext.ext_cn: 损失了大笔钱财。
ext.ext_en: Large sums of money were lost...

ext.ext_cn: 现在即使是相对来说并不算多的 5 万英镑对他来说也是遥不可及的。
ext.ext_en: Even the relatively modest sum of £50,000 now seems beyond his reach.

defs.def_en: A sum of money is an amount of money.

ext.ext_cn: 我算不出来。
ext.ext_en: I can't do my sums.

defs.def_en: A sum is a simple calculation in arithmetic.

ext.ext_cn: 三角形内角总和为 180 度。
ext.ext_en: The sum of all the angles of a triangle is 180 degrees.

defs.def_en: In mathematics, the sum of two numbers is the number that is obtained when they are added together.

ext.ext_cn: “舆论”只是所有像你一样的成千上万人的意见的总和。
ext.ext_en: 'Public opinion' is only the sum of the views of thousands of people like yourself...

ext.ext_en: The sum of evidence points to the crime resting on them...

defs.def_en: The sum of something is all of it.

ext.ext_en: It is a situation, in sum, devoid of logic.

defs.def_en: You use in sum to introduce a statement that briefly describes a situation.

ext.ext_en: As individual members' solo careers have proved, each band was greater than the sum of its parts.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is more than the sum of its parts or greater than the sum of its parts, you mean that it is better than you would expect from the individual parts, because the way they combine adds a different quality.

defs.def_cn: 石油输出国组织；欧佩克

The crust on a loaf of bread is the outside part.

defs.def_cn: (尤指较软或较湿的物质上的)硬层，硬皮

ext.ext_cn: 随着水分的蒸发，地面上留下了一层结晶盐。
ext.ext_en: As the water evaporates, a crust of salt is left on the surface of the soil.

defs.def_en: A crust is a hard layer of something, especially on top of a softer or wetter substance.

ext.ext_cn: 地震会在地壳上留下裂痕。
ext.ext_en: Earthquakes leave scars in the earth's crust.

defs.def_en: The earth's crust is its outer layer.

defs.def_cn: (尤指通过做不愿意做的工作)谋生

ext.ext_cn: 早年为了能在体育界混口饭吃，他几乎什么都做。
ext.ext_en: In his early days, he would do almost anything to earn a crust from the sport.

defs.def_en: If you earn a crust, you earn enough money to live on, especially by doing work you would prefer not to do.

defs.def_cn: (织物上的)绒毛，蓬松毛团;(小动物的)绒毛

ext.ext_cn: 窝里有两只雏鸟：看上去还只是两个灰色的毛毛球
ext.ext_en: ...the nestbox which contained two chicks: just small grey balls of fluff...

ext.ext_cn: 她发现羊毛衫的袖口上起了一些毛球。
ext.ext_en: She noticed some bits of fluff on the sleeve of her sweater.

defs.def_en: Fluff consists of soft threads or fibres in the form of small, light balls or lumps. For example, you can refer to the fur of a small animal as fluff .

ext.ext_cn: 她在牛津的面试搞砸了。
ext.ext_en: She fluffed her interview at Oxford.

defs.def_en: If you fluff something that you are trying to do, you are unsuccessful or you do it badly.

defs.def_cn: 抖松(靠垫、羽毛等);使蓬松

ext.ext_cn: 她站起身来，弄松了头发，将手指穿过发丝，然后把头发向后一甩。
ext.ext_en: She stood up and fluffed her hair, wiggling her fingers through it and then throwing it back.

ext.ext_cn: 把平底锅从火上拿开，焖 5 分钟让米饭变松软。
ext.ext_en: Take the pan off the heat and cover for 5 minutes to fluff up the rice.

defs.def_en: If you fluff things such as cushions or feathers, you get a lot of air into them, for example by shaking or brushing them, in order to make them seem larger and lighter.

defs.def_cn: （用作从句中动词或代词的宾语，指代动词主语“我”或“任何人”）自己，自身

ext.ext_cn: 人们必须立足现在，目光锁定未来目标。
ext.ext_en: One must apply oneself to the present and keep one's eyes firmly fixed on one's future goals...

ext.ext_cn: 一个人要工作就必须有属于自己的时间。
ext.ext_en: To work one must have time to oneself.

defs.def_en: A speaker or writer uses oneself as the object of a verb or preposition in a clause where 'oneself' meaning 'me' or 'any person in general' refers to the same person as the subject of the verb.

defs.def_cn: （one 虽缺失但可理解为动词主语时，用作动词或介词的宾语）自己，自身

ext.ext_cn: 该镇的历史气息让它成为人们夏季度假的好去处。
ext.ext_en: The historic feeling of the town makes it a pleasant place to base oneself for summer vacations...

ext.ext_cn: 只有坐头等舱旅行才能保证一个人独享一舱。
ext.ext_en: The only guarantee of having a cabin to oneself is by travelling first class...

defs.def_en: Oneself can be used as the object of a verb or preposition, when 'one' is not present but is understood to be the subject of the verb.

ext.ext_cn: 独自解决这个问题是一次受益匪浅的锻炼。
ext.ext_en: It is a very rewarding exercise to work this out oneself...

ext.ext_cn: 有些事情必须亲自去做。
ext.ext_en: Some things one must do oneself.

defs.def_en: To do something oneself means to do it without any help from anyone else.

defs.def_cn: （强调事情发生的对象）自己，自身

ext.ext_cn: 宁可自亡，不可行凶。
ext.ext_en: It is better to die oneself than to kill.

defs.def_en: You use oneself to emphasize that something happens to you rather than to people in general.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 乳腺癌在年轻女子当中并不常见。
ext.ext_en: Cancer of the breast in young women is uncommon...

ext.ext_cn: 狗活15年并不少见。
ext.ext_en: A 15-year lifespan is not uncommon for a dog.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as uncommon, you mean that it does not happen often or is not often seen.

ext.ext_cn: 两人在修理东西方面都身手不凡。
ext.ext_en: Both are blessed with uncommon ability to fix things...

ext.ext_cn: 她怀着极大的兴趣读完了塞塞莉娅的最后一封信。
ext.ext_en: She read Cecelia's last letter with uncommon interest.

defs.def_en: If you describe a quality, usually a good quality, as uncommon, you mean that it is unusually great in degree or amount.

ext.ext_cn: 当局表示，如果叛乱分子答应停止攻击平民目标，就不再发射导弹。
ext.ext_en: The authorities offered to stop firing missiles if the rebels agreed to stop attacking civilian targets.

ext.ext_cn: 核弹
ext.ext_en: ...nuclear missiles.

defs.def_en: A missile is a tube-shaped weapon that travels long distances through the air and explodes when it reaches its target.

defs.def_cn: （作为武器的）投掷物，抛掷物，发射物

ext.ext_cn: 足球迷们开始扔东西，其中还砸到了裁判一次。
ext.ext_en: The football supporters began throwing missiles, one of which hit the referee.

defs.def_en: Anything that is thrown as a weapon can be called a missile.

defs.def_cn: 难以言传的;表达不出的;无法形容的

ext.ext_cn: 他突然有种说不出的孤独感。
ext.ext_en: He felt a sudden inexpressible loneliness.

defs.def_en: An inexpressible feeling cannot be expressed in words because it is so strong.

defs.def_cn: 简化的;分解成简单部分的

ext.ext_cn: 还原论科学
ext.ext_en: ...reductionist science...

ext.ext_cn: 这助长了对法西斯意识形态的简单化解释。
ext.ext_en: This encourages reductionist explanations of fascist ideology.

defs.def_en: Reductionist describes a way of analysing problems and things by dividing them into simpler parts.
A water feature is something such as an artificial pond or waterfall, usually in a garden.
A crew cut is a man's hairstyle in which his hair is cut very short.

ext.ext_cn: 屋子里太吵闹，他需要安静。
ext.ext_en: There was too much noise in the room and he needed peace...

ext.ext_cn: 炸弹和枪炮接连不断。
ext.ext_en: The noise of bombs and guns was incessant...

defs.def_en: Noise is a loud or unpleasant sound.

ext.ext_cn: 杰拉尔德爵士从喉咙里发出了点儿声音。
ext.ext_en: Sir Gerald made a small noise in his throat.

ext.ext_cn: 鸟鸣声和其他动物的声音
ext.ext_en: ...birdsong and other animal noises...

defs.def_en: A noise is a sound that someone or something makes.

ext.ext_cn: 总统小心谨慎地表达了他对未来的乐观态度。
ext.ext_en: The President took care to make encouraging noises about the future...

ext.ext_cn: 他妈妈也开始旁敲侧击，暗示他应该离家独立了。
ext.ext_en: His mother had also started making noises about it being time for him to leave home.

defs.def_en: If someone makes noises of a particular kind about something, they say things that indicate their attitude to it in a rather indirect or vague way.

ext.ext_cn: 但在每年政党会议上，他总是随声附和。
ext.ext_en: But at the annual party conference he always made the right noises...

ext.ext_cn: 他假意支持多党民主和人权问题。
ext.ext_en: He was making all the right noises about multi-party democracy and human rights.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone makes the right noises or makes all the right noises, you think that they are showing concern or enthusiasm about something because they feel they ought to rather than because they really want to.

ext.ext_cn: 所有开口瓶中的肉都腐烂了。
ext.ext_en: The meat in all of the open flasks putrefied.

ext.ext_cn: 腐烂的尸体
ext.ext_en: ...putrefying corpses.

defs.def_en: When something putrefies, it decays and produces a very unpleasant smell.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: Snobby means the same as snobbish .

ext.ext_cn: 他看上去几乎是以慢动作倒下的。
ext.ext_en: It seemed almost as if he were falling in slow motion...

ext.ext_cn: 借助于慢镜头的回放，可以很容易地看清楚这个过程。
ext.ext_en: This can be seen easily with the benefit of slow motion video playback.

defs.def_en: When film or television pictures are shown in slow motion, they are shown much more slowly than normal.

ext.ext_cn: 我成了这个办公室霸王欺侮的对象。
ext.ext_en: I fell victim to the office bully...

ext.ext_cn: 他是一个懦夫，一个分不清蛮力和大丈夫气概的恃强凌弱者。
ext.ext_en: He's a coward and a bully who confuses physical strength with manhood.

defs.def_en: A bully is someone who uses their strength or power to hurt or frighten other people.

ext.ext_cn: 我可不打算任由他欺负。
ext.ext_en: I wasn't going to let him bully me...

ext.ext_cn: 我问她有没有被别的孩子欺负。
ext.ext_en: I asked her if she was bullied by the other children.

defs.def_en: If someone bullies you, they use their strength or power to hurt or frighten you.

ext.ext_cn: 我们认为试图迫使他们屈服会适得其反。
ext.ext_en: We think an attempt to bully them into submission would be counterproductive...

ext.ext_cn: 她过去总是强迫我写作业。
ext.ext_en: She used to bully me into doing my schoolwork...

defs.def_en: If someone bullies you into something, they make you do it by using force or threats.

defs.def_cn: 迷迷糊糊地睡去;逐渐入睡

ext.ext_cn: 只有当他最后迷迷糊糊睡着时,他的头痛才有所减轻。
ext.ext_en: It was only when he finally drifted off to sleep that the headaches eased.

defs.def_en: If you drift off to sleep, you gradually fall asleep.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: “那么你认为如何？”她声音嘶哑地悄声问道。
ext.ext_en: 'So what do you think?' she said in a hoarse whisper...

ext.ext_cn: 尼克的声音因尖叫而变得嘶哑了。
ext.ext_en: Nick's voice was hoarse with screaming...

defs.def_en: If your voice is hoarse or if you are hoarse, your voice sounds rough and unclear, for example because your throat is sore.

ext.ext_cn: 他用棒球棒恶意损毁了一辆汽车。
ext.ext_en: He maliciously damaged a car with a baseball bat...

ext.ext_cn: 阳光能损伤皮肤。
ext.ext_en: The sun can damage your skin.

defs.def_en: To damage an object means to break it, spoil it physically, or stop it from working properly.

ext.ext_cn: 杰克逊不想损害自己政界名人的声誉。
ext.ext_en: Jackson doesn't want to damage his reputation as a political personality...

ext.ext_cn: 他警告说该行动正对经济造成破坏。
ext.ext_en: He warned that the action was damaging the economy.

defs.def_en: To damage something means to cause it to become less good, pleasant, or successful.

ext.ext_cn: 爆炸给这所房子造成了大面积的损坏。
ext.ext_en: The blast caused extensive damage to the house...

ext.ext_cn: 许多职业拳击手结束运动生涯时都已受到了脑损伤。
ext.ext_en: Many professional boxers end their careers with brain damage.

defs.def_en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to an object.

defs.def_cn: （对人、情况、行为的）损害，伤害，不良影响

ext.ext_cn: 这类事件会对与该社群的关系造成不可弥合的伤害。
ext.ext_en: Incidents of this type cause irreparable damage to relations with the community...

ext.ext_cn: 遵守新的规定就意味着赛车比赛将遭受严重影响。
ext.ext_en: Adhering to the new rules meant inflicting serious damage on motor racing.

defs.def_en: Damage consists of the unpleasant effects that something has on a person, situation, or type of activity.

ext.ext_cn: 他在法庭上被证明无罪，并且获得了损害赔偿金。
ext.ext_en: He was vindicated in court and damages were awarded.

defs.def_en: If a court of law awards damages to someone, it orders money to be paid to them by a person who has damaged their reputation or property, or who has injured them.

defs.def_cn: 事已至此;已造成的损害无法挽回

ext.ext_cn: 伤害一旦造成，即使是现代外科手术也无法将其完全消除。
ext.ext_en: Once the damage is done, even modern surgery can't undo it entirely.

defs.def_en: If you say 'the damage is done', you mean that it is too late now to prevent the harmful effects of something that has already happened.
An eagle is a large bird that lives by eating small animals.

defs.def_cn: 锐利的目光;敏锐的观察力

ext.ext_cn: 他在老师锐利目光的注视下完成了作业。
ext.ext_en: He did the work under the eagle eye of his teacher...

ext.ext_cn: 船长目光如炬地扫过房间。
ext.ext_en: The Captain's eagle eye swept the room.

defs.def_en: If you talk about a person's eagle eye, you mean that they are watching someone or something carefully or are very good at noticing things.

ext.ext_cn: 关键任务是要实现经济在微观层面的自由运转。
ext.ext_en: The vital task was to allow the economy to operate freely at a micro level.

defs.def_en: You use micro to indicate that something relates to a specific area, rather than a general one

ext.ext_cn: 她需要一份关于事情来龙去脉的报告。
ext.ext_en: She wanted a blow-by-blow account of what happened.

defs.def_en: A blow-by-blow account of an event describes every stage of it in great detail.

defs.def_cn: (伊斯兰教中以狂舞为礼拜仪式一部分的)托钵僧，苦行僧

ext.ext_cn: 在安纳托利亚大草原的深处，与真主神秘会合的庆祝场合，仍然会有托钵僧旋转起舞的身影。
ext.ext_en: In the heart of the Anatolian steppe, dervishes still whirl on festive occasions in mystic union with God...

defs.def_en: A dervish is a member of a Muslim religious group which has a very active and lively dance as part of its worship.

defs.def_cn: 像托钵僧一样旋转舞蹈的;动作敏捷迅速的

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩如同旋转舞蹈的托钵僧一样转来转去，一边拍打着蚊子一边抱怨不停。
ext.ext_en: Brian was whirling like a dervish, slapping at the mosquitoes and moaning.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is like a dervish, you mean that they are turning round and round, waving their arms about, or working very quickly.

ext.ext_cn: 其他行业只得精简管理人员以减少行政开支。
ext.ext_en: Other industries have had to sack managers to reduce administrative costs...

ext.ext_cn: 项目将包括一个12人组成的管理小组。
ext.ext_en: The project will have an administrative staff of 12.

defs.def_en: Administrative work involves organizing and supervising an organization or institution.

defs.def_cn: (用奏乐等方式控制蛇的活动以娱乐他人的)弄蛇人，玩蛇者
defs.def_en: A snake charmer is a person who entertains people by controlling the behaviour of a snake, for example by playing music and causing the snake to rise out of a basket and drop back in again.
A jetty is a wide stone wall or wooden platform where boats stop to let people get on or off, or to load or unload goods.

ext.ext_cn: 媒体把他描述成一个左翼大反派。
ext.ext_en: The media depict him as a left-wing bogeyman.

defs.def_en: A bogeyman is someone whose ideas or actions are disapproved of by some people, and who is described by them as evil or unpleasant in order to make other people afraid.

defs.def_cn: （父母用来吓唬小孩的）鬼怪，妖怪
defs.def_en: A bogeyman is an imaginary evil spirit. Some parents tell their children that the bogeyman will catch them if they behave badly.

ext.ext_cn: 用钢筋加固的15英尺厚的屋顶
ext.ext_en: ...a 15-foot thick roof that was reinforced with steel rods.

defs.def_en: See also:fishing rod;lightning rod;A rod is a long, thin metal or wooden bar.

ext.ext_cn: 请于今日将随函附上的捐款表格用所提供的邮资预付的信封寄回。
ext.ext_en: Return the enclosed Donation Form today in the prepaid envelope provided.

ext.ext_cn: 预付费的葬礼
ext.ext_en: ...prepaid funerals.

defs.def_en: Prepaid items are paid for in advance, before the time when you would normally pay for them.

ext.ext_cn: 劳工大臣表示，改革将带来新的就业机会。
ext.ext_en: The Employment Minister said the reforms would generate new jobs.

ext.ext_cn: 东欧变革引起的骚动
ext.ext_en: ...the excitement generated by the changes in Eastern Europe.

defs.def_en: To generate something means to cause it to begin and develop.

ext.ext_cn: 新英格兰电力公司用煤发电。
ext.ext_en: The company, New England Electric, burns coal to generate power.

defs.def_en: To generate a form of energy or power means to produce it.

defs.def_cn: 即兴演出，临时插入（脚本或讲稿中没有的台词）

ext.ext_cn: 他即兴调侃起了一段剧本。
ext.ext_en: He began comically ad-libbing a script...

ext.ext_cn: 他善于为自己妙语解围。
ext.ext_en: He's good at ad-libbing his way out of trouble...

defs.def_en: If you ad-lib something in a play or a speech, you say something which has not been planned or written beforehand.

defs.def_cn: 即兴（或临时插入）的台词

ext.ext_cn: 每次我台词出错时，伦尼都通过机智的临场发挥帮我解围。
ext.ext_en: Every time I fluffed a line Lenny got me out of trouble with a brilliant ad-lib.

ext.ext_cn: 我在讲坛上发表即兴演说。
ext.ext_en: I spoke from the pulpit ad lib.

defs.def_en: An ad-lib is something which is said without having been planned or written beforehand.
A communicable disease is one that can be passed on to other people.

ext.ext_cn: 警察们持搜查证进入了那所公寓。
ext.ext_en: Officers armed with a search warrant entered the flat.

defs.def_en: A search warrant is a special document that gives the police permission to search a house or other building.

defs.def_cn: 装有格栅的；斜条格构状的

ext.ext_cn: 格子门
ext.ext_en: ...latticed doors...

ext.ext_cn: 大脑表层呈灰红色，上面的微细血管纵横交错，宛如一个个斜格子。
ext.ext_en: The surface of the brain is pinky-grey and latticed with tiny blood vessels.

defs.def_en: Something that is latticed is decorated with or is in the form of a lattice.

defs.def_cn: 大小;(尤指庞大的)规模,范围,程度

ext.ext_cn: 然而，他低估了问题的严重性。
ext.ext_en: However, he underestimates the scale of the problem...

ext.ext_cn: 看到此处气势如此恢宏，你可能会觉得自己很渺小。
ext.ext_en: You may feel dwarfed by the sheer scale of the place...

defs.def_en: See also:full-scale;large-scale;small-scale;If you refer to the scale of something, you are referring to its size or extent, especially when it is very big.

ext.ext_cn: 里氏 5.5 级地震
ext.ext_en: ...an earthquake measuring five-point-five on the Richter scale...

ext.ext_cn: 患者按十分制给这些治疗方法打分。
ext.ext_en: The patient rates the therapies on a scale of zero to ten...

defs.def_en: See also:sliding scale;timescale;A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

defs.def_cn: (根据年龄、工种等核定的工资或费用)级别,标准

ext.ext_cn: 工资级别最高的人
ext.ext_en: ...those on the high end of the pay scale...

ext.ext_cn: 在病人决定是否就诊之前，注册整骨医师会很乐意告知其收费标准。
ext.ext_en: A Registered Osteopath will be pleased to tell you his scale of fees before you decide on a consultation.

defs.def_en: A pay scale or scale of fees is a list that shows how much someone should be paid, depending, for example, on their age or what work they do.

defs.def_cn: (地图、图纸、模型的)比例，比例尺

ext.ext_cn: 该地图以 1:10,000 的比例尺显示了 5,000 多条不同道路。
ext.ext_en: The map, on a scale of 1:10,000, shows over 5,000 individual paths.

defs.def_en: See also:full-scale;large-scale;The scale of a map, plan, or model is the relationship between the size of something in the map, plan, or model and its size in the real world.

defs.def_cn: (模型或复制品)按比例缩小的

ext.ext_cn: 富兰克林为他的母亲制作了一个复杂精细的房屋模型。
ext.ext_en: Franklin made his mother an intricately detailed scale model of the house.

defs.def_en: A scale model or scale replica of a building or object is a model of it which is smaller than the real thing but has all the same parts and features.

ext.ext_cn: C 大调音阶
ext.ext_en: ...the scale of C major.

defs.def_en: In music, a scale is a fixed sequence of musical notes, each one higher than the next, which begins at a particular note.
The scales of a fish or reptile are the small, flat pieces of hard skin that cover its body.

ext.ext_cn: 一台厨房秤
ext.ext_en: ...a pair of kitchen scales.

ext.ext_cn: 浴室体重秤
ext.ext_en: ...bathroom scales...

defs.def_en: Scales are a piece of equipment used for weighing things, for example for weighing amounts of food that you need in order to make a particular meal.

ext.ext_cn: 1981 年，一支登山队的5名队员在攀登胡德峰时遇难。
ext.ext_en: In 1981, five members of a climbing party died while scaling Mount Hood.

ext.ext_cn: 那些男人攀上一堵墙然后顺着另一侧的脚手架爬了下去。
ext.ext_en: The men scaled a wall and climbed down scaffolding on the other side.

defs.def_en: If you scale something such as a mountain or a wall, you climb up it or over it.

ext.ext_cn: 那座塔的顶部矗立着一尊巨型雕像，与整个建筑完全不成比例。
ext.ext_en: The tower was surmounted by an enormous statue, utterly out of scale with the building.
