defs.def_en: The conditions in which people live or work are the factors which affect their comfort, safety, or health.

defs.def_cn: (某一群人的)生活状况，境况;(尤指)艰难处境

ext.ext_cn: 人们的生活状况可以通过社会改革方案得到改善。
ext.ext_en: The condition of the people could be elevated by a programme of social reform...

ext.ext_cn: 政府鼓励人民改善生活状况。
ext.ext_en: The government has encouraged its people to better their condition.

defs.def_en: The condition of a group of people is their situation in life, especially with regard to the difficulties they have.

defs.def_cn: (尤指写入合同或法律的)条件，条款

ext.ext_cn: 作为贷款偿还条件所设定的经济目标
ext.ext_en: ...economic targets set as a condition for loan payments.

ext.ext_cn: 雇用条款及条件
ext.ext_en: ...terms and conditions of employment...

defs.def_en: A condition is something which must happen or be done in order for something else to be possible, especially when this is written into a contract or law.

ext.ext_cn: 医生怀疑他可能有心脏病。
ext.ext_en: Doctors suspect he may have a heart condition.

ext.ext_cn: 引起脑组织变性的罕见疾病
ext.ext_en: ...a rare condition that causes degeneration of the brain tissue.

defs.def_en: If someone has a particular condition, they have an illness or other medical problem.

ext.ext_cn: 我们都受到早年印象和经历的影响。
ext.ext_en: We are all conditioned by early impressions and experiences...

ext.ext_cn: 你习惯性地认为害怕是软弱的表现。
ext.ext_en: You have been conditioned to believe that it is weak to be scared...

defs.def_en: If someone is conditioned by their experiences or environment, they are influenced by them over a period of time so that they do certain things or think in a particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 对干燥、受损的头发有极佳护理效果的蛋白质
ext.ext_en: ...a protein which is excellent for conditioning dry and damaged hair.

defs.def_en: To condition your hair or skin means to put something on it which will keep it in good condition.

defs.def_cn: (因病重、烦乱或酒醉而)不能(做某事)

ext.ext_cn: 很显然，她谁都不能见。
ext.ext_en: She was clearly in no condition to see anyone.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is in no condition to do something, you mean that they are too ill, upset, or drunk to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 在不披露身份的条件下，他接受了记者的采访。
ext.ext_en: He spoke to reporters on condition that he was not identified.

defs.def_en: When you agree to do something on condition that something else happens, you mean that you will only do it if this other thing also happens.

defs.def_cn: (由于缺乏锻炼而)身体状况不佳

ext.ext_cn: 他体质太差，爬不到山顶。
ext.ext_en: He was too out of condition to clamber over the top.

defs.def_en: If someone is out of condition, they are unhealthy and unfit, because they do not do enough exercise.

ext.ext_cn: 在塞恩斯伯里超市的收款处前排队
ext.ext_en: ...queuing at the checkout in Sainsbury's.

defs.def_en: In a supermarket, a checkout is a counter where you pay for things you are buying.

ext.ext_cn: 当地政府提供的保育服务只有少数上班族母亲才能够享受到。
ext.ext_en: Local authority nursery provision covers only a tiny minority of working mothers...

ext.ext_cn: 这些孩子只是很少的一部分。
ext.ext_en: These children are only a small minority.

defs.def_en: If you talk about a minority of people or things in a larger group, you are referring to a number of them that forms less than half of the larger group, usually much less than half.

ext.ext_cn: 这个地区的少数民族
ext.ext_en: ...the region's ethnic minorities...

ext.ext_cn: 学生要求聘请更多女教师和少数民族族裔的老师。
ext.ext_en: Students have called for greater numbers of women and minorities on the faculty...

defs.def_en: A minority is a group of people of the same race, culture, or religion who live in a place where most of the people around them are of a different race, culture, or religion.

ext.ext_cn: 他听收音机打发时间。
ext.ext_en: He spent his time listening to the radio...

ext.ext_cn: 索尼娅没有用心听。
ext.ext_en: Sonia was not listening.

defs.def_en: If you listen to someone who is talking or to a sound, you give your attention to them or it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们留神听是不是有脚步声传来。
ext.ext_en: We listen for footsteps approaching...

ext.ext_cn: 他们都在楼上睡着了，但你不介意留神听着点以防万一吧？
ext.ext_en: They're both asleep upstairs, but you don't mind listening just in case of trouble, do you?

defs.def_en: If you listen for a sound, you keep alert and are ready to hear it if it occurs.

ext.ext_cn: 安妮，这次你得听我的。
ext.ext_en: Anne, you need to listen to me this time...

ext.ext_cn: 我叫他停下，可他不听。
ext.ext_en: When I asked him to stop, he would not listen.

defs.def_en: If you listen to someone, you do what they advise you to do, or you believe them.

ext.ext_cn: 听我说，我一点钟收工。
ext.ext_en: Listen, I finish at one.

defs.def_en: You say listen when you want someone to pay attention to you because you are going to say something important.

ext.ext_cn: 好了，听我说，各位。我们需要谈谈大家的形象问题。
ext.ext_en: Okay, listen up, guys. We've got to talk a little about how you look.

defs.def_en: You say listen up when you want someone to listen to what you are going to say.

ext.ext_cn: 你给我听着，小姐。别那样叫我！
ext.ext_en: Listen here, young lady. Don't you call me that!

defs.def_en: You say listen here when you are going to say something important to someone, especially when you are angry at what they have done or said.

ext.ext_cn: 在开暖气的房间里可用加湿器，防止吸入干燥空气造成喉咙不适。
ext.ext_en: Use a humidifier in heated rooms to prevent dry air irritating your throat.

defs.def_en: A humidifier is a machine for increasing the amount of moisture in the air.

ext.ext_cn: 她遭到丈夫的殴打和羞辱。
ext.ext_en: She had been beaten and humiliated by her husband...

ext.ext_cn: 他的数学老师频频在课上羞辱他。
ext.ext_en: His teacher continually humiliates him in maths lessons.

defs.def_en: To humiliate someone means to say or do something which makes them feel ashamed or stupid.

defs.def_cn: 化学的;化学反应的;用化学方法生成的

ext.ext_cn: 导致臭氧受到破坏的化学反应
ext.ext_en: ...chemical reactions that cause ozone destruction.

ext.ext_cn: 海洋的化学成分
ext.ext_en: ...the chemical composition of the ocean.

defs.def_en: Chemical means involving or resulting from a reaction between two or more substances, or relating to the substances that something consists of.

defs.def_cn: 化学品;化合物;化学制品

ext.ext_cn: 整个食物链因农业生产过程过多使用化学品而受到影响。
ext.ext_en: The whole food chain is affected by the overuse of chemicals in agriculture.

ext.ext_cn: 化工公司
ext.ext_en: ...a chemicals company.

defs.def_en: Chemicals are substances that are used in a chemical process or made by a chemical process.
A multiplication table is a list of the multiplications of numbers between one and twelve. Children often have to learn multiplication tables at school.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我怎么吃都不胖。
ext.ext_en: I could eat what I liked without getting fat...

ext.ext_cn: 5分钟后，我前排座位上的胖女人便睡着了。
ext.ext_en: After five minutes, the fat woman in the seat in front of me was asleep.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or animal is fat, you mean that they have a lot of flesh on their body and that they weigh too much. You usually use the word fat when you think that this is a bad thing.

ext.ext_cn: 由于没有消耗卡路里，你吃的所有东西都会变成脂肪。
ext.ext_en: Because you're not burning calories, everything you eat turns to fat.

defs.def_en: Fat is the extra flesh that animals and humans have under their skin, which is used to store energy and to help keep them warm.

ext.ext_cn: 烹调时不论是植物油还是动物油，都要尽量少用。
ext.ext_en: When you use oil or fat for cooking, use as little as possible.

ext.ext_cn: 椰子油和棕榈油一类的植物油
ext.ext_en: ...vegetable fats, such as coconut oil and palm oil.

defs.def_en: Fat is a solid or liquid substance obtained from animals or vegetables, which is used in cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 减少饮食中脂肪摄入量的简单方法就是避免吃红肉。
ext.ext_en: An easy way to cut the amount of fat in your diet is to avoid eating red meats...

ext.ext_cn: 大多数低脂酸奶每100克约含40卡热量。
ext.ext_en: Most low-fat yogurts are about 40 calories per 100g.

defs.def_en: Fat is a substance contained in foods such as meat, cheese, and butter which forms an energy store in your body.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 9 月 22 日出版的大部头书《数说欧洲》
ext.ext_en: ...'Europe in Figures', a fat book published on September 22nd...

ext.ext_cn: 他掏出鼓鼓的钱包，抽出几张钞票。
ext.ext_en: He took out his fat wallet and peeled off some notes.

defs.def_en: A fat object, especially a book, is very thick or wide.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他们下定决心要大赚一笔。
ext.ext_en: They are set to make a big fat profit.

defs.def_en: A fat profit or fee is a large one.

ext.ext_cn: “你的汽车容易被盗吗？”——“不太可能。有个装置，可关闭油门和点火开关。”
ext.ext_en: 'Would your car be easy to steal?' — 'Fat chance. I've got a device that shuts down the gas and ignition.'

defs.def_en: If you say that there is fat chance of something happening, you mean that you do not believe that it will happen.

defs.def_cn: (靠…)发财，致富，大发横财，肥起来

ext.ext_cn: 利物浦是靠奴隶贸易肥起来的。
ext.ext_en: Liverpool grew fat on the basis of the slave trade.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or organization has grown fat on something, you mean that they have become very rich as a result of it.

defs.def_cn: 无济于事;于事无补;毫无用处

ext.ext_cn: “我觉得我们应该进去把他们狠揍一顿。”——“那对我们有个屁用。”
ext.ext_en: 'I think we should go in and hammer them.' — 'And a fat lot of good that would do us.'

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a fat lot of good or a fat lot of help, you are saying rudely that it is no good or no help at all.

ext.ext_cn: 申请修读这门课程者至少要年满16岁。
ext.ext_en: All applicants should be at least 16 years of age at the commencement of this course.

defs.def_en: The commencement of something is its beginning.

defs.def_cn: 学位授予仪式;(大学或高中的)毕业典礼
defs.def_en: Commencement is a ceremony at a university, college, or high school at which students formally receive their degrees or diplomas.

defs.def_cn: (政府或经选举组建的机构的)授权，委托

ext.ext_cn: 总统及其支持者几乎肯定地认为这次投票是对继续进行经济改革的授权。
ext.ext_en: The President and his supporters are almost certain to read this vote as a mandate for continued economic reform...

ext.ext_cn: 工会已经得到大会的授权为罢工进行投票。
ext.ext_en: The union already has a mandate from its conference to ballot for a strike .

defs.def_en: If a government or other elected body has a mandate to carry out a particular policy or task, they have the authority to carry it out as a result of winning an election or vote.

ext.ext_cn: 独立检察官受命调查这件事还要多长时间？
ext.ext_en: How much longer does the independent prosecutor have a mandate to pursue this investigation?...

ext.ext_cn: 执行任何计划都需要联合国的授权。
ext.ext_en: A mandate from the UN would be needed before any plans could be implemented.

defs.def_en: If someone is given a mandate to carry out a particular policy or task, they are given the official authority to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 他关于任期一满就离开政界的打算。
ext.ext_en: ...his intention to leave politics once his mandate ends.

defs.def_en: You can refer to the fixed length of time that a country's leader or government remains in office as their mandate .

ext.ext_cn: 他受西非经济共同体的委托介入并执行停火协定。
ext.ext_en: He'd been mandated by the West African Economic Community to go in and to enforce a ceasefire...

ext.ext_cn: 选举是在去年5月政府签署的和平协议的授权下进行的。
ext.ext_en: The elections are mandated by a peace accord signed by the government last May.

defs.def_en: When someone is mandated to carry out a particular policy or task, they are given the official authority to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 倡议将强制规定把二氧化碳排放量降低40%。
ext.ext_en: The proposed initiative would mandate a reduction of carbon dioxide of 40%...

ext.ext_cn: 魁北克省颁布法令，强制所有移民将子女送进法语学校就读。
ext.ext_en: Quebec mandated that all immigrants send their children to French schools.

defs.def_en: To mandate something means to make it mandatory.

defs.def_cn: 汇入主干道的;汇入干流的;(铁路)支线的

ext.ext_cn: 通往机场的岔路
ext.ext_en: ...the feeder road leading to the airport.

defs.def_en: A feeder road, railway, or river is a smaller one that leads to a more important one.

ext.ext_cn: 英国航空公司飞往大西洋彼岸的航班的支线航线
ext.ext_en: ...a feeder to British Airways's transatlantic destinations.

defs.def_en: Feeder airline and railway services connect major routes and local destinations.

defs.def_cn: (为重点学校或球队输送学生或球员的)生源学校，直属学校，直属球队

ext.ext_cn: 从两个直属幼儿学校来的孩子
ext.ext_en: ...children coming up from two infant feeder schools.

defs.def_en: A feeder school or team provides students or players for a larger or more important one.
A feeder is a container that you fill with food for birds or animals.

ext.ext_cn: 艾滋病病毒大半是经异性性接触传播的。
ext.ext_en: Heterosexual contact is responsible for the bulk of HIV transmission.

ext.ext_cn: 传真机及其他形式的电子数据传输
ext.ext_en: …the fax machine and other forms of electronic data transmission.

defs.def_en: The transmission of something is the passing or sending of it to a different person or place.
The transmission of television or radio programmes is the broadcasting of them.
A transmission is a broadcast.

ext.ext_cn: 这辆车装配了自动变速器。
ext.ext_en: The car was fitted with automatic transmission.

ext.ext_cn: 四挡手动变速器
ext.ext_en: ...a four-speed manual transmission.

defs.def_en: The transmission on a car or other vehicle is the system of gears and shafts by which the power from the engine reaches and turns the wheels.

defs.def_cn: 肺结核;结核病(缩略形式为 TB)
defs.def_en: Tuberculosis is a serious infectious disease that affects someone's lungs and other parts of their body. The abbreviation TB is also used.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 神圣不可侵犯的;不容指责的;不可变更的

ext.ext_cn: 新闻自由是神圣不可侵犯的。
ext.ext_en: Freedom of the press is sacrosanct.

ext.ext_cn: 占用周末休息日被认为没得商量。
ext.ext_en: ...weekend rest days were considered sacrosanct.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as sacrosanct, you consider it to be special and are unwilling to see it criticized or changed.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管她从未在舞台上演唱过，国家歌剧院的约瑟夫·克里普斯还是聘用了她。
ext.ext_en: Josef Krips at the State Opera hired her in spite of the fact that she had never sung on stage...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管面临众多的艰难困苦，他们还是几乎义无反顾地表现出了对生活的热爱。
ext.ext_en: Their love of life comes in spite of, almost in defiance of, considerable hardship.

defs.def_en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

ext.ext_cn: 这番率直的话让理查德不由自主地大笑起来。
ext.ext_en: The blunt comment made Richard laugh in spite of himself...

ext.ext_cn: 她被深深地打动了，禁不住为之动容。
ext.ext_en: She was deeply moved and in spite of herself could not help showing it.

defs.def_en: If you do something in spite of yourself, you do it although you did not really intend to or expect to.

ext.ext_cn: 我拒绝和她离婚，就是为了出口恶气。
ext.ext_en: I refused her a divorce, out of spite I suppose...

ext.ext_cn: 她从未见过这样的怨恨和偏狭。
ext.ext_en: Never had she met such spite and pettiness.

defs.def_en: If you do something cruel out of spite, you do it because you want to hurt or upset someone.

ext.ext_cn: 潘特拉拉斯将自己的艺术藏品全都无偿捐了出去，存心要激怒玛丽和她的丈夫。
ext.ext_en: Pantelaras was giving his art collection away for nothing, to spite Marie and her husband.

defs.def_en: If you do something cruel to spite someone, you do it in order to hurt or upset them.

ext.ext_cn: 石墙的一部分在某处悬于小路的上方。
ext.ext_en: Part of the rock wall overhung the path at one point...

ext.ext_cn: 这些修葺一新的房屋俯视着静静流淌的运河河网。
ext.ext_en: These restored houses overhang a system of quiet canals.

defs.def_en: If one thing overhangs another, it sticks out over and above it.

ext.ext_cn: 一块凸出来的尖利岩石成了他们的避身之所。
ext.ext_en: A sharp overhang of rock gave them cover...

ext.ext_cn: 悬吊的屋顶下是一条宽阔的游廊。
ext.ext_en: There is a wide veranda under the overhang of the roof.

defs.def_en: An overhang is the part of something that sticks out over and above something else.

ext.ext_cn: 用油酥面皮盖住边缘，每层之间抹些熔化的黄油。
ext.ext_en: Let the pastry overhang the rim and brush between the layers with the melted butter.

defs.def_en: If one thing overhangs another, it is supported by it and hangs down its sides.

ext.ext_cn: 水很黑。
ext.ext_en: The water was blackish...

ext.ext_cn: 凯蒂有一头乌黑的长发。
ext.ext_en: Katy has long blackish hair.

defs.def_en: Something that is blackish is very dark in colour.

defs.def_cn: 廉价的；劣质的；拿不出手的

ext.ext_cn: 拙劣的摇滚音乐剧
ext.ext_en: ...a bargain-basement rock musical.

defs.def_en: If you refer to something as a bargain basement thing, you mean that it is cheap and not very good quality.

ext.ext_cn: 刚开始他的爱慕让她感到荣幸。
ext.ext_en: At first she was flattered by his devotion.

defs.def_en: Devotion is great love, affection, or admiration for someone.

ext.ext_cn: 献身于人民的事业，献身于社会主义
ext.ext_en: ...devotion to the cause of the people and to socialism...

ext.ext_cn: 我并不是要一再批评他对工作的专注。
ext.ext_en: I don't mean to keep criticising his devotion to his job.

defs.def_en: Devotion is commitment to a particular activity.

ext.ext_cn: 他虔诚地跪在床边。
ext.ext_en: He was kneeling by his bed in an attitude of devotion.

defs.def_en: Devotion is religious worship or strong religious feeling.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 使人想起…的；使人联想到…的

ext.ext_cn: 使人联想起远东文化的打击乐器
ext.ext_en: ...percussion instruments, redolent of Far Eastern cultures.

ext.ext_cn: 使人觉得遗憾的悲情故事
ext.ext_en: ...a sad tale, redolent with regret.

defs.def_en: If something is redolent of something else, it has features that make you think of that other thing.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 有…气味的;使人联想起…气味的

ext.ext_cn: 空气里飘着桂皮和苹果的味道
ext.ext_en: ...the air redolent of cinnamon and apple.

ext.ext_cn: 闻起来像迷迭香
ext.ext_en: ...redolent with the scent of rosemary.

defs.def_en: If something is redolent of something else, it smells strongly of that other thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他姐姐萨拉帮助了他。
ext.ext_en: His sister Sarah helped him.

ext.ext_cn: 弗吉尼娅·伍尔夫的姐姐瓦妮莎·贝尔
ext.ext_en: ...Vanessa Bell, the sister of Virginia Woolf...

defs.def_en: See also:half-sister;stepsister;Your sister is a girl or woman who has the same parents as you.

defs.pos_cn: 可数名词；头衔名词；称呼名词

ext.ext_cn: 弗朗西丝卡修女走进了小教堂。
ext.ext_en: Sister Francesca entered the chapel.

ext.ext_cn: 卢尔德仁爱修女会的安养院
ext.ext_en: ...the Hospice of the Sisters of Charity at Lourdes.

defs.def_en: Sister is a title given to a woman who belongs to a religious community.

defs.pos_cn: 可数名词；头衔名词；称呼名词

ext.ext_cn: 请求和病房里的护士长说话。
ext.ext_en: Ask to speak to the sister on the ward...

ext.ext_cn: 护士长米德尔顿跟在送咖啡的推车后面。
ext.ext_en: Sister Middleton followed the coffee trolley.

defs.def_en: A sister is a senior female nurse who supervises part of a hospital.

defs.def_cn: (同一种族、宗教、国家或职业的)姐妹;同道中的女性;志同道合的女士

ext.ext_cn: 现代女性已经从许多压在旧时女性身上的责任中解放出来了。
ext.ext_en: Modern woman has been freed from many of the duties that befell her sisters in times past.

ext.ext_cn: 我们犹太教的兄弟姐妹们
ext.ext_en: ...our Jewish brothers and sisters.

defs.def_en: You can describe a woman as your sister if you feel a connection with her, for example because she belongs to the same race, religion, country, or profession.

defs.def_cn: 同类型的;相关联的;如同姐妹的

ext.ext_cn: 国际货币基金组织及其姊妹机构——世界银行
ext.ext_en: ...the International Monetary Fund and its sister organisation, the World Bank.

ext.ext_cn: “旅行者 2 号”太空探测器及其姊妹探测器——“旅行者 1 号”
ext.ext_en: ...Voyager 2 and its sister ship, Voyager 1.

defs.def_en: You can use sister to describe something that is of the same type or is connected in some way to another thing you have mentioned. For example, if a company has a sister company, they are connected.
A wading pool is a shallow artificial pool for children to play in.

ext.ext_cn: 一些发言者认为拳击的危险性比橄榄球运动小。
ext.ext_en: Some speakers argued that boxing was less dangerous than rugby.

defs.def_en: Boxing is a sport in which two people wearing large padded gloves fight according to special rules.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 兴高采烈的;活泼的;活跃的

ext.ext_cn: 今早他看上去格外高兴。
ext.ext_en: He looked unusually chipper this morning.

defs.def_en: Chipper means cheerful and lively.

defs.def_cn: 政治上正确（指力求避免冒犯处于不利地位或被歧视的社会群体的态度或原则）

ext.ext_cn: 在很注重政治上是否正确的部门，我因此事受到了批评。
ext.ext_en: In some sectors, where political correctness is a powerful force, I've been criticized for that.

defs.def_en: Political correctness is the attitude or policy of being extremely careful not to offend or upset any group of people in society who have a disadvantage, or who have been treated differently because of their sex, race, or disability.

A diphthong is a vowel in which the speaker's tongue changes position while it is being pronounced, so that the vowel sounds like a combination of two other vowels. The vowel sound in 'tail' is a diphthong.

defs.def_cn: (尤指通过规章制度)管理，调整，控制

ext.ext_cn: 欧盟委员会对竞争的监管权越来越大。
ext.ext_en: The powers of the European Commission to regulate competition are increasing...

ext.ext_cn: 随着年龄的增长，人体体温调节机制的功能往往会有所弱化。
ext.ext_en: As we get older the temperature-regulating mechanisms in the body tend to become a little less efficient.

defs.def_en: To regulate an activity or process means to control it, especially by means of rules.

ext.ext_cn: 摄影师往后退开，好让我们查看尸体。
ext.ext_en: The photographers drew back to let us view the body...

ext.ext_cn: 她满怀期待地从门口退了回来。
ext.ext_en: She stepped back from the door expectantly...

defs.def_en: If you move back, you move in the opposite direction to the one in which you are facing or in which you were moving before.

ext.ext_cn: 我回到床上。
ext.ext_en: I went back to bed...

ext.ext_cn: 我预计下午晚些时候回到伦敦。
ext.ext_en: I'm  due back in London by late afternoon...

defs.def_en: If you go back somewhere, you return to where you were before.

defs.def_cn: 恢复原状；回到原来的状态

ext.ext_cn: 铁路公司表示，其运输服务将慢慢恢复正常。
ext.ext_en: The rail company said it expected services to get slowly back to normal...

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼丝希望等女儿满周岁就回去工作。
ext.ext_en: Denise hopes to be back at work by the time her daughter is one...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is back in a particular state, they were in that state before and are now in it again.

ext.ext_cn: 她递还刀子。
ext.ext_en: She handed the knife back...

ext.ext_cn: 把它放回冰箱。
ext.ext_en: Put it back in the freezer...

defs.def_en: If you give or put something back, you return it to the person who had it or to the place where it was before you took it. If you get or take something back, you then have it again after not having it for a while.
If you put a clock or watch back, you change the time shown on it so that it shows an earlier time, for example when the time changes to winter time or standard time.

ext.ext_cn: 他们回信告诉我说不必那么做。
ext.ext_en: They wrote back to me and they told me that I didn't have to do it...

ext.ext_cn: 如果有电话打来，就说你吃完饭再回电话。
ext.ext_en: If the phone rings say you'll  call back after dinner...

defs.def_en: If you write or call back, you write to or telephone someone after they have written to or telephoned you. If you look back at someone, you look at them after they have started looking at you.

ext.ext_cn: 我能再回到维护治安的问题上来吗？
ext.ext_en: Can I come back to the question of policing once again?...

ext.ext_cn: 回到我在导言中所说的，19世纪的西班牙是欧洲整体的一部分。
ext.ext_en: To come back to what I said in the Introduction, in the nineteenth century Spain was fully a part of Europe...

defs.def_en: You can say that you go or come back to a particular point in a conversation to show that you are mentioning or discussing it again.

defs.def_cn: 再次流行；再度成为潮流

ext.ext_cn: 短裙又流行起来了。
ext.ext_en: Short skirts are back...

ext.ext_cn: 共识政治很可能再度兴起。
ext.ext_en: Consensus politics could easily come back into fashion.

defs.def_en: If something is or comes back, it is fashionable again after it has been unfashionable for some time.

ext.ext_cn: 请勿靠近站台边缘。
ext.ext_en: Keep back from the edge of the platform...

ext.ext_cn: 我距离边境数英里。
ext.ext_en: I'm  a few miles back from the border...

defs.def_en: If someone or something is kept or situated back from a place, they are at a distance away from it.

ext.ext_cn: 她的头发扎了起来。
ext.ext_en: Her hair was tied back...

ext.ext_cn: 窗帘用穗子拢了起来。
ext.ext_en: The curtains were held back by tassels.

defs.def_en: If something is held or tied back, it is held or tied so that it does not hang loosely over something.

ext.ext_cn: 她躺下盯着天花板。
ext.ext_en: She lay back and stared at the ceiling...

ext.ext_cn: 她靠在椅背上，微笑起来。
ext.ext_en: She leaned back in her chair and smiled.

defs.def_en: If you lie or sit back, you move your body backwards into a relaxed sloping or flat position, with your head and body resting on something.

ext.ext_cn: 尼克回头看了看，又皱着眉头停了下来。
ext.ext_en: Nick looked back over his shoulder and then stopped, frowning...

ext.ext_cn: 他转身叫她。
ext.ext_en: He called back to her.

defs.def_en: If you look or shout back at someone or something, you turn to look or shout at them when they are behind you.

defs.def_cn: （表示描述场所的转换）在曾提到过的地方

ext.ext_cn: 与此同时，伦敦的皇宫影业公司也正在分崩离析。
ext.ext_en: Meanwhile, back in London, Palace Pictures was collapsing...

ext.ext_cn: 随后，家里的电话响了。
ext.ext_en: Later, back at home, the telephone rang.

defs.def_en: You use back in expressions like back in London or back at the house when you are giving an account, to show that you are going to start talking about what happened or was happening in the place you mention.

ext.ext_cn: 故事可以追溯到1950年，那时我才5岁。
ext.ext_en: The story starts back in 1950, when I was five...

ext.ext_cn: 今年1月份我在圣卢西亚。
ext.ext_en: I was in St. Lucia back in January of this year...

defs.def_en: If you talk about something that happened back in the past or several years back, you are emphasizing that it happened quite a long time ago.

ext.ext_cn: 我回想起1975年我儿子病得奄奄一息的那段时间。
ext.ext_en: I thought back to the time in 1975 when my son was desperately ill...

ext.ext_cn: 我回想起曾听到过的关于文妮的那些传闻。
ext.ext_en: My mind flew back to stories I had heard about Vinnie.

defs.def_en: If you think back to something that happened in the past, you remember it or try to remember it.

ext.ext_cn: 他来回踱步。
ext.ext_en: He paced back and forth...

ext.ext_cn: 两个男孩在街上来来回回地投接棒球。
ext.ext_en: Two boys were in the street, tossing a baseball back and forth.

defs.def_en: If someone moves back and forth, they repeatedly move in one direction and then in the opposite direction.

ext.ext_cn: 她儿子安静地仰面躺着。
ext.ext_en: Her son was lying peacefully on his back...

ext.ext_cn: 她转过身背对着观众。
ext.ext_en: She turned her back to the audience...

defs.def_en: A person's or animal's  back is the part of their body between their head and their legs that is on the opposite side to their chest and stomach.

ext.ext_cn: 商店后部的一个房间
ext.ext_en: ...a room at the back of the shop...

ext.ext_cn: 她举起双手放于颈后。
ext.ext_en: She raised her hands to the back of her neck...

defs.def_en: The back of something is the side or part of it that is towards the rear or farthest from the front. The back of something is normally not used or seen as much as the front.

ext.ext_cn: 他打开了后门。
ext.ext_en: He opened the back door...

ext.ext_cn: 安记得自己坐在他们车的后座上。
ext.ext_en: Ann could remember sitting in the back seat of their car.

defs.def_en: Back is used to refer to the side or part of something that is towards the rear or farthest from the front.

ext.ext_cn: 椅子的靠背上搭着一件叠得整整齐齐的粉色毛衫。
ext.ext_en: There was a neatly folded pink sweater on the back of the chair.

defs.def_en: The back of a chair or sofa is the part that you lean against when you sit on it.

ext.ext_cn: 将答案写在明信片背面寄出。
ext.ext_en: Send your answers on the back of a postcard.

defs.def_en: The back of something such as a piece of paper or an envelope is the side which is less important.

ext.ext_cn: 书末索引
ext.ext_en: ...the index at the back of the book...

ext.ext_cn: 你已经在末尾完整地列出了名字和地址。
ext.ext_en: You've given a whole list of names and addresses at the back.

defs.def_en: The back of a book is the part nearest the end, where you can find the index or the notes, for example.

defs.def_cn: （用于round the back, out the back等表达方式中）房屋（或其他建筑物）后的区域

ext.ext_cn: 他在房子后面养了些鸡啊什么的。
ext.ext_en: He had chickens and things round the back...

ext.ext_cn: 厕所在房子后面。
ext.ext_en: The privy's  out the back.

defs.def_en: You can use back in expressions such as round the back and out the back to refer generally to the area behind a house or other building.

defs.def_cn: （用于out back等表达方式中）房屋（或其他建筑物）后的区域；（用于in back等表达方式中）汽车（或建筑物等）的后部

ext.ext_cn: 丹告诉她说他要去房子后面的露台上擦鞋。
ext.ext_en: Dan informed her that he would be out back on the patio cleaning his shoes...

ext.ext_cn: 卡特利特开车，我坐在车子后面。
ext.ext_en: Catlett got behind the wheel and I sat in back...

defs.def_en: You use back in expressions such as out back to refer to the area behind a house or other building. You also use in back to refer to the rear part of something, especially a car or building.

defs.def_cn: （足球、曲棍球等运动中的）后卫
defs.def_en: In team games such as football and hockey, a back is a player who is concerned mainly with preventing the other team from scoring goals, rather than scoring goals for their own team.

defs.def_cn: （美式橄榄球运动中的）进攻后卫
defs.def_en: In American football, a back is a player who stands behind the front line, runs with the ball and attacks rather than defends.

ext.ext_cn: 你吃着她的食物，享受着她的款待，然后还在背地里指责她。
ext.ext_en: You eat her food, enjoy her hospitality and then criticize her behind her back.

defs.def_en: If you say that something was  done behind someone's back, you disapprove of it because it was done without them knowing about it, in an unfair or dishonest way.

ext.ext_cn: 看起来至少我们已经解决了这个国家通货膨胀中最棘手的问题。
ext.ext_en: It seems at least that we've broken the back of inflation in this country...

ext.ext_cn: 我们可以运送物资，努力解决饥荒中最关键的问题。
ext.ext_en: We can deliver supplies and work to break the back of the famine.

defs.def_en: If you break the back of a task or problem, you do the most difficult part of what is necessary to complete the task or solve the problem.

ext.ext_cn: 连续播放的两档半小时节目
ext.ext_en: ...two half-hour shows, which will be screened back to back.

defs.def_en: If two or more things are done back to back, one follows immediately after the other without any interruption.

defs.def_cn: （衣服）前后穿反；（顺序）前后颠倒

ext.ext_cn: 他把棒球帽反戴着。
ext.ext_en: He wears his baseball cap back to front...

ext.ext_cn: 图片印反了。
ext.ext_en: The picture was printed back to front.

defs.def_en: If you are wearing something back to front, you are wearing it with the back of it at the front of your body. If you do something back to front, you do it the wrong way around, starting with the part that should come last.

defs.def_cn: 不再（对某人）批评（或施压等）

ext.ext_cn: 他一直对我唠叨个没完，有时我真希望他不要再烦我了。
ext.ext_en: He kept on at me to such an extent that occasionally I wished he would get off my back.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to get off your back you are telling them angrily to stop criticizing you or putting pressure on you.

ext.ext_cn: 8年的艰难时期刚刚过去，在此期间，伦敦有3家消防站遭关闭。如获批准，裁减又会接踵而至。
ext.ext_en: The cuts, if approved, come on the back of a difficult eight years that have seen three London fire stations closed.

defs.def_en: If you say that one thing happens on the back of another thing, you mean that it happens  after that other thing and in addition to it.

defs.def_cn: （使）受到威胁；（使）处于不利地位

ext.ext_cn: 今后工党在福利问题上将处于下风。
ext.ext_en: From now on Labour will be on the back foot on the subject of welfare.

ext.ext_cn: 另一项纯粹旨在让苏格兰民族党人被迫退居守势的计划
ext.ext_en: ...another scheme designed purely to put the Scots Nationalists on the back foot.

defs.def_en: If someone is on the back foot, or if something puts them on the back foot, they feel threatened and act defensively.

defs.def_cn: 互相帮助；与人方便，与己方便
defs.def_en: People say 'You scratch my back and I'll scratch yours' to mean that one person helps another on condition that the second person helps them in return.

ext.ext_cn: 我的表现如此差劲，相信她会很高兴看到我离开。
ext.ext_en: I was so badly behaved I was convinced she would be glad to see the back of me.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will be glad to see the back of someone, you mean that you want them to leave.

defs.def_cn: 忽略；背弃；拒绝；对…不予理睬

ext.ext_cn: 斯泰茜·拉蒂索抛弃了自己在摩城唱片公司的演唱事业，成为了一名福音歌手。
ext.ext_en: Stacey Lattisaw has turned her back on her singing career with Motown Records to become a gospel singer...

ext.ext_cn: 冈内尔不是那种将指导了自己12年的教练拒之门外的人。
ext.ext_en: Gunnell is not the sort to turn her back on someone who has coached her for 12 years.

defs.def_en: If you turn your back on someone or something, you ignore them, leave them, or reject them.

ext.ext_cn: 有些食物标签的贴法实在让我生气。
ext.ext_en: Some food labelling practices really get my back up.

defs.def_en: If someone or something puts your back up or gets your back up, they annoy you.

ext.ext_cn: 我们住在一楼的一套公寓房里，背对着一条繁忙的街道。
ext.ext_en: We live in a ground floor flat which backs onto a busy street...

ext.ext_cn: 他的花园背朝一所学校。
ext.ext_en: His garden backs onto a school.

defs.def_en: If a building backs onto something, the back of it faces in the direction of that thing or touches the edge of that thing.

ext.ext_cn: 他把车倒出了私人车道。
ext.ext_en: He backed his car out of the drive...

ext.ext_cn: 火车倒出了阿德莱德调车场，开上了都柏林-贝尔法斯特线。
ext.ext_en: The train backed out of Adelaide Yard on to the Dublin-Belfast line...

defs.def_en: When you back a car or other vehicle somewhere or when it backs somewhere, it moves backwards.

ext.ext_cn: 有新的目击证人证明他的说法，他是被错认了。
ext.ext_en: There is a new witness to back his claim that he is a victim of mistaken identity.

ext.ext_cn: 如果法国不能说服安理会五个常任理事国都支持该计划
ext.ext_en: ...if France cannot persuade all five permanent members of the Security Council to back the plan...

defs.def_en: If you back a person or a course of action, you support them, for example by voting for them or giving them money.

defs.def_cn: 预测…获胜；（通常指）下赌注于

ext.ext_cn: 昨晚罗兰·尼尔森打赌谢菲尔德周三队会捧得欧洲联盟杯。
ext.ext_en: Roland Nilsson last night backed Sheffield Wednesday to win the UEFA Cup...

ext.ext_cn: 马的主人希钦斯先生以200比1的赔率赌它获得前三名。
ext.ext_en: The horse's owner Mr Hitchins backed him at 200-1 to finish in the first three...

defs.def_en: If you back a particular person, team, or horse in a competition, you predict that they will win, and usually you bet money that they will win.

ext.ext_cn: 原声吉他、贝斯和康茄鼓为她伴奏。
ext.ext_en: She was backed by acoustic guitar, bass and congas.

defs.def_en: If a singer is backed by a band or by other singers, they provide the musical background for the singer.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 富于表情的;富于表现力的

ext.ext_cn: 可以训练人们使其更具表现力。
ext.ext_en: You can train people to be more expressive.

ext.ext_cn: 她那张通常表情丰富的小脸
ext.ext_en: ...her small, usually expressive face.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as expressive, you mean that their behaviour clearly indicates their feelings or intentions.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 也许他所有的诗歌其实都是爱情诗，表现了对某个人的爱。
ext.ext_en: Perhaps all his poems were really love poems, expressive of love for someone...

ext.ext_cn: 它的历史体现了其拥有者的性格特征和发展过程。
ext.ext_en: Its history is expressive of the character and development of the people who possess it.

defs.def_en: If something is expressive of particular ideas or qualities, it has features which indicate or demonstrate them.

ext.ext_cn: 在他声名鼎盛之时，他的每句话都受到重视。
ext.ext_en: At the height of his fame, his every word was valued...

ext.ext_cn: 这部电影为他赢得了国际声望。
ext.ext_en: The film earned him international fame.

defs.def_en: If you achieve fame, you become very well-known.  claim to fame→see: claim;

ext.ext_cn: 这一婚姻没有任何司法上的障碍，他对此很满意。
ext.ext_en: He was satisfied there was no legal impediment to the marriage.

defs.def_en: Something that is an impediment to a person or thing makes their movement, development, or progress difficult.

ext.ext_cn: 约翰有轻微的言语障碍，这令母亲很难理解他的话。
ext.ext_en: John's slight speech impediment made it difficult for his mother to understand him.

defs.def_en: Someone who has a speech impediment has a disability which makes speaking difficult.

ext.ext_cn: 到早上10点钟，温度已经超过100华氏度了。
ext.ext_en: By mid-morning, the temperature was already above 100 degrees Fahrenheit.

ext.ext_cn: 他被问到水的沸点是华氏多少度。
ext.ext_en: He was asked for the boiling point of water in Fahrenheit.

defs.def_en: Fahrenheit is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 32 degrees and boils at 212 degrees. It is represented by the symbol ˚F.  →see usage note at:temperature

ext.ext_cn: 同性恋者的生活质量在过去20年里有了改善。
ext.ext_en: The quality of life for gay men has improved over the last two decades.

ext.ext_cn: 同性恋者群落
ext.ext_en: ...the gay community.

defs.def_en: A gay person is homosexual.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我快活自由，身体健康，积极乐观。
ext.ext_en: I am happy and free, in good health, gay and cheerful.

defs.def_en: A gay person is fun to be with because they are lively and cheerful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢色彩鲜艳、让人放松的画。
ext.ext_en: I like gay, relaxing paintings.

defs.def_en: A gay object is brightly coloured and pretty to look at.

ext.ext_cn: 他向裁判抗议。
ext.ext_en: He remonstrated with the referee...

ext.ext_cn: 我跳进汽车去提出抗议。
ext.ext_en: I jumped in the car and went to remonstrate.

defs.def_en: If you remonstrate with someone, you protest to them about something you do not approve of or agree with, and you try to get it changed or stopped.

ext.ext_cn: 南极大陆
ext.ext_en: ...the Antarctic landmass.

ext.ext_cn: 该国7.68亿公顷的广阔陆地
ext.ext_en: ...the country's large land mass of 768 million hectares.

defs.def_en: A land mass is a very large area of land such as a continent.
A handcart is a small cart with two wheels which is pushed or pulled along and is used for transporting goods.
A tot is a very young child.
A tot of a strong alcoholic drink such as whisky or brandy is a small amount of it in a glass.

ext.ext_cn: 如此快速达成这项协定是一大伟绩。
ext.ext_en: Reaching this agreement so quickly was a great achievement...

ext.ext_cn: 该会议将成为对女性成就的一曲赞歌。
ext.ext_en: The Conference will be a celebration of women's achievements.

defs.def_en: An achievement is something which someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

ext.ext_cn: 只有达成这些目标才会带来持久的和平。
ext.ext_en: Only the achievement of these goals will bring lasting peace.

defs.def_en: Achievement is the process of achieving something.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 蒸上 12 分钟左右，直到蛋糕膨起，中心摸起来很有弹性。
ext.ext_en: Steam for about 12 mins until the cake is risen and springy to touch in the centre.

defs.def_en: If something is springy, it returns quickly to its original shape after you press it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们不时地听到大卡车的轰鸣声。
ext.ext_en: Now and then they heard the roar of a heavy truck.

defs.def_en: A truck is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

defs.def_cn: (铁路)运货车皮，敞篷货运火车

ext.ext_cn: 它们被装上开往利物浦的货运火车。
ext.ext_en: They were loaded on the railway trucks to go to Liverpool.

defs.def_en: A truck is an open vehicle used for carrying goods on a railway.

defs.def_cn: 用卡车装运;用货车运送

ext.ext_cn: 该酒合法出售，用卡车运出了该州。
ext.ext_en: The liquor was sold legally and trucked out of the state.

defs.def_en: When something or someone is trucked somewhere, they are driven there in a lorry.

defs.def_cn: 不愿参与;不与…来往;不掺和

ext.ext_cn: 他不愿去骗人。
ext.ext_en: He would have no truck with deceit...

ext.ext_cn: 作为一名美国人，她不愿拘泥于英国人生活中令人非常不舒服的繁文缛节。
ext.ext_en: As an American, she had no truck with the painful formality of English life.

defs.def_en: If you say that you will have no truck with someone or something, you are refusing to be involved with them in any way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (因害怕或担心)发狂的，狂躁的

ext.ext_cn: 一只鸟被关进了笼子，到现在它都十分狂躁。
ext.ext_en: A bird had been locked in and was by now quite frantic.

defs.def_en: If you are frantic, you are behaving in a wild and uncontrolled way because you are frightened or worried.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 匆忙混乱的;紧张忙乱的

ext.ext_cn: 餐馆晚上生意好,厨房里可能会忙成一片。
ext.ext_en: A busy night in the restaurant can be frantic in the kitchen.

defs.def_en: If an activity is frantic, things are done quickly and in an energetic but disorganized way, because there is very little time.
A ferret is a small, fierce animal which is used for hunting rabbits and rats.

ext.ext_cn: 但她还是继续寻找可能的工作。
ext.ext_en: She nonetheless continued to ferret about for possible jobs...

ext.ext_cn: 她在一些文件中翻找着。
ext.ext_en: She ferreted among some papers.

defs.def_en: If you ferret about for something, you look for it in a lot of different places or in a place where it is hidden.

ext.ext_cn: 谎称自己是护士
ext.ext_en: ...fraudulent claims about being a nurse.

defs.def_en: A fraudulent activity is deliberately deceitful, dishonest, or untrue.

defs.def_cn: 白领的;文职的;脑力劳动的

ext.ext_cn: 如今白领工人的工作时间比以前更长了。
ext.ext_en: White-collar workers now work longer hours.

defs.def_en: White-collar workers work in offices rather than doing physical work such as making things in factories or building things.

defs.def_cn: (犯罪)白领的(指非法窃取公司、政府钱财等)
defs.def_en: White-collar crime is committed by people who work in offices, and involves stealing money secretly from companies or the government, or getting money in an illegal way.

defs.def_cn: 使(言辞)温和；使(调子)缓和;收敛

ext.ext_cn: 言辞激烈的右翼领袖在会后收敛了他的好战言论。
ext.ext_en: The fiery right-wing leader toned down his militant statements after the meeting...

ext.ext_cn: 该预测不得不在此后放低调子，因为经济已明白无误地显示出放缓的迹象。
ext.ext_en: The forecasts have since had to be toned down, as the economy has exhibited unmistakable signs of slowing…

defs.def_en: If you tone down something that you have written or said, you make it less forceful, severe, or offensive.
Breadcrumbs are tiny pieces of dry bread. They are used in cooking.

ext.ext_cn: 是钱毁了他。
ext.ext_en: Money was the ruination of him...

ext.ext_cn: 这些牧师给我们带来了灭亡。
ext.ext_en: The clerics have brought ruination on our people.

defs.def_en: The ruination of someone or something is the act of ruining them or the process of being ruined.

defs.def_cn: 与业绩挂钩的工资；绩效工资

ext.ext_cn: 教师们将竭力反对部长们在学校中实行绩效工资的计划。
ext.ext_en: Teachers will fight Ministers' plans to introduce performance-related pay in schools.

defs.def_en: Performance-related pay is a rate of pay which is based on how well someone does their job.

ext.ext_cn: 一心一意、坚定不移地追求完美的年轻人
ext.ext_en: ...a young man whose relentless pursuit of excellence is conducted with single-minded determination.

ext.ext_cn: 为了追求某个梦想而使家庭陷于贫困的人
ext.ext_en: ...individuals who impoverish their families in pursuit of some dream.

defs.def_en: Your pursuit of something is your attempts at achieving it. If you do something in pursuit of a particular result, you do it in order to achieve that result.

ext.ext_cn: 坚决贯彻方针政策并不能保证成功。
ext.ext_en: The vigorous pursuit of policies is no guarantee of success.

defs.def_en: The pursuit of an activity, interest, or plan consists of all the things that you do when you are carrying it out.

ext.ext_cn: 以超过每小时120英里的时速驾驶巡逻车追赶一辆摩托车的警官
ext.ext_en: ...a police officer who drove a patrol car at more than 120mph in pursuit of a motor cycle.

defs.def_en: Someone who is in pursuit of a person, vehicle, or animal is chasing them.

defs.def_cn: （自行车赛和滑冰竞赛中的）追逐赛

ext.ext_cn: 莫罗在个人五公里追逐赛中获得金牌。
ext.ext_en: Moreau took gold in the five-kilometre individual pursuit competition.

defs.def_en: In cycling and skating, the pursuit is a race in which two competitors or teams start on opposite sides of a circular track and try to catch up with each other.

ext.ext_cn: 他们俩都喜欢户外活动。
ext.ext_en: They both love outdoor pursuits...

ext.ext_cn: 儿时他最大的爱好是帆船运动、游泳和骑自行车。
ext.ext_en: His favourite childhood pursuits were sailing, swimming and cycling.

defs.def_en: Your pursuits are your activities, usually activities that you enjoy when you are not working.

ext.ext_cn: 我冲了过去，苏在后面穷追不舍。
ext.ext_en: I rushed through with Sue in hot pursuit.

defs.def_en: If you are in hot pursuit of someone, you are chasing after them with great determination.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这东西一定要小心,稍不注意的话就会有危险。
ext.ext_en: Be very careful with this stuff, it can be dangerous if it isn't handled properly...

ext.ext_cn: 走那几段楼梯要当心!
ext.ext_en: Careful on those stairs!...

defs.def_en: If you are careful, you give serious attention to what you are doing, in order to avoid harm, damage, or mistakes. If you are careful to do something, you make sure that you do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 在认真考虑了所有相关事实后,他决定起诉她。
ext.ext_en: He has decided to prosecute her after careful consideration of all the relevant facts...

ext.ext_cn: 我们目前对该疾病的认识是通过对病变器官的仔细研究得来的。
ext.ext_en: What we now know about the disease was learned by careful study of diseased organs.

defs.def_en: Careful work, thought, or examination is thorough and shows a concern for details.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得你说话应该小心,不能把反叛分子当英雄。
ext.ext_en: I think you should be careful about talking of the rebels as heroes...

ext.ext_cn: 我想,每个人宣布胜利时都应该慎重。
ext.ext_en: It is important, I think, for everyone to be careful about claiming victory.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone to be careful about doing something, you think that what they intend to do is probably wrong, and that they should think seriously before they do it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 你得格外注意培养孩子的节俭意识，零花钱要省着花。
ext.ext_en: You will have to make a special effort to train your child to be careful with her pocket-money...

ext.ext_cn: 这将迫使企业更加节约资源。
ext.ext_en: It would force industries to be more careful with natural resources.

defs.def_en: If you are careful with something such as money or resources, you use or spend only what is necessary.

defs.def_cn: 越谨慎越好;再小心也不为过

ext.ext_cn: 孩子在水边时,还是越小心越好。
ext.ext_en: You can't be too careful when a young child is near water.

defs.def_en: You can say 'You can't be too careful' as a way of advising someone to be careful, even when this seems unnecessary.
A skunk is a small black and white animal which releases an unpleasant smelling liquid if it is frightened or attacked. Skunks live in America.
Skunk is a type of powerful, strong-smelling marijuana.

ext.ext_cn: 我为几个密友办了晚宴。
ext.ext_en: I gave a dinner party for a few close friends...

ext.ext_cn: 后来我们喝了几杯。
ext.ext_en: We had a few drinks afterwards...

defs.def_en: You use a few to indicate that you are talking about a small number of people or things. You can also say a very few .

defs.def_cn: (用于形容词和限定词后)几个，少数的

ext.ext_cn: 过去几周是她记忆中平生最愉快的日子。
ext.ext_en: The past few weeks of her life had been the most pleasant she could remember...

ext.ext_cn: 领导人将在接下来的几天中飞往麦加签署协议。
ext.ext_en: The leaders are expected to fly to Mecca in the next few days to seal the agreement.

defs.def_en: You use few after adjectives and determiners to indicate that you are talking about a small number of things or people.

defs.def_cn: (前面可用 so，too，very 修饰)极少的,几乎没有

ext.ext_cn: 她几乎没什么朋友，总的来说不怎么开心。
ext.ext_en: She had few friends, and was generally not very happy...

ext.ext_cn: 几乎没什么成员打算投他的票。
ext.ext_en: Few members planned to vote for him...

defs.def_en: You use few to indicate that you are talking about a small number of people or things. You can use 'so', 'too', and 'very' in front of few .

defs.def_cn: (尤指享有某种机遇等的)少数派，少数

ext.ext_cn: 这不应是少数几个人的经历。
ext.ext_en: This should not be an experience for the few.

ext.ext_cn: 建立在面向少数人的精英教育上的体制
ext.ext_en: ...a system built on academic excellence for the few.

defs.def_en: The few means a small set of people considered as separate from the majority, especially because they share a particular opportunity or quality that the others do not have.

ext.ext_cn: 一项研究显示，一天只抽 10 支烟也会损害生育能力。
ext.ext_en: One study showed that even as few as ten cigarettes a day can damage fertility...

ext.ext_cn: 今年，工厂生产的小轿车可能只有 1,500 辆。
ext.ext_en: The factory may make as few as 1,500 cars this year.

defs.def_en: You use as few as before a number to suggest that it is surprisingly small.

ext.ext_cn: 成功的女政治家凤毛麟角。
ext.ext_en: Successful women politicians are few and far between...

ext.ext_cn: 在这种经济环境下，新想法极为罕见。
ext.ext_en: In this economic climate new ideas were few and far between.

defs.def_en: Things that are few and far between are very rare or do not happen very often.

defs.def_cn: 不少,相当多(a good few 主要用于英国英语)

ext.ext_cn: 我提出了此论点，而这会是相当多的人都不同意的。
ext.ext_en: I've made this argument, and not a few people would disagree with me...

ext.ext_cn: 我觉得其他人中不少都像我一样，有点迷惑不解。
ext.ext_en: I think a good few of the others were like me, a bit confused.

defs.def_en: You use not a few when you are referring to quite a lot of things or people. You can also use a good few in this way, mainly in British English.

ext.ext_cn: 呼吸分析器显示你饮酒过量。
ext.ext_en: A breathalyzer tells you you've a had a few too many.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has had a few too many or has had a few, you mean that they have drunk too many alcoholic drinks.

ext.ext_cn: 至少有 13 国外长出席了这届会议。
ext.ext_en: No fewer than thirteen foreign ministers attended the session.

defs.def_en: You use no fewer than to emphasize that a number is surprisingly large.

ext.ext_cn: 她的脑袋嗡嗡作响并且浑身疼痛。
ext.ext_en: Her head was throbbing and she ached all over...

ext.ext_cn: 坐下时我的腿还会痛。
ext.ext_en: My leg still aches when I sit down...

defs.def_en: If you ache or a part of your body aches, you feel a steady, fairly strong pain.

defs.def_cn: （身体某部位持续且较强烈的)疼痛

ext.ext_cn: 症状为恶心和肌肉疼痛。
ext.ext_en: You feel nausea and aches in your muscles...

ext.ext_cn: 姿势不当会导致颈部疼痛、头痛和呼吸困难。
ext.ext_en: Poor posture can cause neck ache, headaches and breathing problems.

defs.def_en: See also:backache;headache;heartache;stomach ache;An ache is a steady, fairly strong pain in a part of your body.

defs.def_cn: 渴望（且因得不到而痛苦）

ext.ext_cn: 她仍旧渴望拥有婚姻中逝去的那份缱绻和肌肤之亲。
ext.ext_en: She still ached for the lost intimacy and sexual contact of marriage...

ext.ext_cn: 但西班牙是一个渴望摆脱以往形象的国家。
ext.ext_en: But Spain was a country aching to get away from its past...

defs.def_en: If you ache for something or your heart aches, you want something very much, and feel very unhappy because you cannot have it.

ext.ext_cn: 繁忙劳碌了一天所带来的周身酸痛似乎被一扫而空。
ext.ext_en: It seems to ease all the aches and pains of a hectic and tiring day.

defs.def_en: You can use aches and pains to refer in a general way to any minor pains that you feel in your body.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 完美的;无瑕的;无可挑剔的

ext.ext_cn: 她将自己无瑕的肌肤归功于所使用的保湿霜。
ext.ext_en: She attributed her flawless complexion to the moisturiser she used...

ext.ext_cn: “发现”号航天飞机今晨从卡纳维拉尔角顺利发射升空。
ext.ext_en: Discovery's takeoff this morning from Cape Canaveral was flawless.

defs.def_en: If you say that something or someone is flawless, you mean that they are extremely good and that there are no faults or problems with them.

ext.ext_cn: 动脉疾病患者
ext.ext_en: ...people with arterial disease.

defs.def_en: Arterial means involving or relating to your arteries and the movement of blood through your body.

ext.ext_cn: 该城市的主干道之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the main arterial roads through the city.

defs.def_en: An arterial road or railway is a main road or railway within a complex road or railway system.

ext.ext_cn: 多年来他一直打电话给我，甚至是在他结婚以后。
ext.ext_en: He kept calling me for years, even after he got married...

ext.ext_cn: 即使黑皮肤的女性也应该涂抹防晒霜。
ext.ext_en: Even dark-skinned women should use sunscreens...

defs.def_en: You use even to suggest that what comes just after or just before it in the sentence is rather surprising.

defs.def_cn: （与形容词、副词的比较级连用）更加，愈发

ext.ext_cn: 作为采访者，是电视让他产生了更大的影响。
ext.ext_en: It was on television that he made an even stronger impact as an interviewer...

ext.ext_cn: 第二天，爱德华看起来比前一天更加苍白，也更加安静了。
ext.ext_en: During his second day Edward looked even more pale and quiet than on his first...

defs.def_en: You use even with comparative adjectives and adverbs to emphasize a quality that someone or something has.

ext.ext_cn: 辛西娅不为自己的所作所为感到羞愧，即使最终证明她所做的是错误的。
ext.ext_en: Cynthia is not ashamed of what she does, even if she ends up doing something wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 即便是需要我一个人工作，我还是可以和别人进行交流的。
ext.ext_en: Even though I'm supposed to be working by myself, there are other people who I can interact with.

defs.def_en: You use even if or even though to indicate that a particular fact does not make the rest of your statement untrue.

ext.ext_cn: 就在她说这个的时候，她知道自己说的并非全是真的。
ext.ext_en: Even as she said this, she knew it was not quite true...

ext.ext_cn: 即使在睡觉的时候，他也一直听得到发动机的噪音。
ext.ext_en: He had been aware, even as he slept, of the noise of the engine.

defs.def_en: If one thing happens even as something else happens, they both happen at exactly the same time.

ext.ext_cn: 公共汽车上只坐满了一半。尽管如此，一个年轻男子还是问尼娜她旁边的座位有没有人坐。
ext.ext_en: The bus was only half full. Even so, a young man asked Nina if the seat next to her was taken...

ext.ext_cn: 她从未放弃过她的国籍。即便如此，反对者仍然说她不是真正的缅甸人。
ext.ext_en: She has never given up her nationality. Even so, her opponents argue that she is not a true Burmese.

defs.def_en: You use even so to introduce a surprising fact which relates to what you have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 和平只会逐渐到来，而且每一步都走得小心翼翼。即使那样，要实现和平听起来仍几乎不可能。
ext.ext_en: Peace could come only gradually, in carefully measured steps. Even then, it sounds almost impossible to achieve...

ext.ext_cn: 她在十八九岁的时候最漂亮，但是即使在那时，也总有人比她更漂亮。
ext.ext_en: She was at her prettiest in her late teens, but even then she always had somebody who was prettier.

defs.def_en: You use even then to say that something is the case in spite of what has just been stated or whatever the circumstances may be.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 工作时周围环境温度恒定有多么重要呢？
ext.ext_en: How important is it to have an even temperature when you're working?...

ext.ext_cn: 那栋砖砌的房子里全年温度恒定。
ext.ext_en: The brick-built property keeps the temperature at an even level throughout the year.

defs.def_en: An even measurement or rate stays at about the same level.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 桌子装了玻璃表面，因此十分平滑。
ext.ext_en: The tables are fitted with a glass top to provide an even surface.

defs.def_en: An even surface is smooth and flat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 将面团分成12等份，每份揉成球状。
ext.ext_en: Divide the dough into 12 even pieces and shape each piece into a ball...

ext.ext_cn: 很多人厌倦了因为自己的财富而不受欢迎，从而会鼓励更加均匀地分配财富。
ext.ext_en: Many are tired of being unpopular because of their wealth and would encourage more even distribution of it.

defs.def_en: If there is an even distribution or division of something, each person, group, or area involved has an equal amount.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （比赛、竞争等）平衡的，不相上下的，势均力敌的

ext.ext_cn: 这是一场势均力敌的比赛。
ext.ext_en: It was an even game.

ext.ext_cn: 8个国家间一场不相上下的竞赛
ext.ext_en: ...an even match between eight nations.

defs.def_en: An even contest or competition is equally balanced between the two sides who are taking part.

ext.ext_cn: 你不欠我，我也不欠你，我们扯平了。
ext.ext_en: You don't owe me. I don't owe you. We're even.

defs.def_en: If you are even with someone, you do not owe them anything, such as money or a favour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 我的声音听起来心平气和、不露一丝感情，这让我自己颇感惊讶。
ext.ext_en: My voice surprised me; it was even and emotionless.

defs.def_en: If your voice is even, you are speaking in a very controlled way which makes it difficult for people to tell what your feelings are.
An even number can be divided exactly by the number two.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （成败机会）各半的，对半的，相等的

ext.ext_cn: 他们赢得下届选举的机会在五成以上。
ext.ext_en: They have a more than even chance of winning the next election...

defs.def_en: See also:evens;If there is an even chance that something will happen, it is no more likely that it will happen than it will not happen.

ext.ext_cn: 那家航空公司希望明年实现收支相抵，在随后一年重新盈利。
ext.ext_en: The airline hopes to break even next year and return to profit the following year...

ext.ext_cn: 那家剧院每天晚上需要有90%以上的上座率才刚刚能够收支相抵。
ext.ext_en: The theatre needs to fill over ninety per cent of its seats every night just to break even.

defs.def_en: When a company or a persn running a business breaks even, they make neither a profit nor a loss.

ext.ext_cn: 我会跟你算这笔账的。
ext.ext_en: I'm going to get even with you for this...

ext.ext_cn: 与其生闷气，不如出口气。
ext.ext_en: Don't get angry, get even.

defs.def_en: If you say that you are going to get even with someone, you mean that you are going to cause them the same amount of harm or annoyance as they have caused you.

ext.ext_cn: 他们担心极权主义者会征服整个世界。
ext.ext_en: They feared that totalitarians might yet conquer the entire world.

ext.ext_cn: 他们担心极权主义者会征服整个世界。
ext.ext_en: They feared that totalitarians might yet conquer the entire world.

defs.def_en: A totalitarian political system is one in which there is only one political party which controls everything and does not allow any opposition parties.
A crayon is a pencil containing coloured wax or clay, or a rod of coloured wax used for drawing.

ext.ext_en: The European Parliament badly needs a president who can burnish its image.

defs.def_en: To burnish the image of someone or something means to improve their image.

defs.def_cn: 不必要地拖延;使持续过久

ext.ext_cn: 公司愿意将诉讼拖上几年。
ext.ext_en: The company was willing to drag out the proceedings for years...

ext.ext_cn: 我们尽快把它完成吧，不要再拖了。
ext.ext_en: Let's get it over with as soon as possible, rather than drag it out.

defs.def_en: If you drag something out, you make it last for longer than is necessary.

ext.ext_cn: 这些家庭很快发现每条消息都得从有关当局口中套出来。
ext.ext_en: The families soon discovered that every piece of information had to be dragged out of the authorities.

defs.def_en: If you drag something out of a person, you persuade them to tell you something that they do not want to tell you.
Stamp collecting is the hobby of building up a collection of stamps.

ext.ext_cn: 这篇报道批评了报纸哗众取宠的作风。
ext.ext_en: The report criticises the newspaper for sensationalism.

defs.def_en: Sensationalism is the presenting of facts or stories in a way that is intended to produce strong feelings of shock, anger, or excitement.

defs.def_cn: 社交聚会常客；特定聚会的参加者

ext.ext_cn: 酩酊大醉的聚会者唱歌吵醒了居民，有人报了警。
ext.ext_en: Chants from the drunken party-goers woke residents and the police were called...

ext.ext_cn: 这些参加聚会的人中至少有一半不到15岁。
ext.ext_en: At least half the partygoers were under 15.

defs.def_en: A party-goer is someone who likes going to parties or someone who is at a particular party.

defs.def_cn: (动物或植物)发育完全的，完全长成的，成熟的

ext.ext_cn: 成年的雄性猩猩
ext.ext_en: ...a full-grown male orang-utan.

defs.def_en: An animal or plant that is full-grown has reached its full adult size and stopped growing.

ext.ext_cn: 韦德把香烟叼在嘴里。
ext.ext_en: Wade stuck the cigarette between his lips.

defs.def_en: Your lips are the two outer parts of the edge of your mouth.

defs.def_cn: 唇状物；边缘；（容器等的）嘴

ext.ext_cn: 壶嘴
ext.ext_en: ...the lip of the jug.

ext.ext_cn: 埃特纳火山冒着烟的火山口
ext.ext_en: ...the lip of Mount Etna's smouldering crater.

defs.def_en: The lip of something such as a container or a high area of land is its edge.

defs.def_cn: 咬嘴唇（以按下怒气或抑制痛苦等）

ext.ext_cn: 回想起他甩给她的那些话，她咬了咬唇。
ext.ext_en: She bit her lip as she recalled the words he'd thrown at her.

defs.def_en: If you bite your lip, you try very hard not to show the anger or distress that you are feeling.

defs.def_cn: 大家都说的；大家都在谈论的

ext.ext_cn: 一名记者向总裁提了大家都想问的问题：“您觉得自己会再获任命吗？”
ext.ext_en: A reporter asks the president the question on everyone's lips: 'Do you anticipate being re-appointed?'...

ext.ext_cn: 他就是那个现在大家都在谈论的人。
ext.ext_en: He is the guy whose name is on everyone's lips at the moment.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is on everyone's  lips, you mean that a lot of people seem to be interested in it and are talking about it.

defs.def_cn: （在想到美好的事物或尝到好东西时）舔嘴唇

ext.ext_cn: 他们舔舔嘴唇，满怀期待。
ext.ext_en: They licked their lips in anticipation...

ext.ext_cn: 我们一口吞下了巧克力，满意地咂着嘴。
ext.ext_en: We swallowed the chocolates in one gulp, licking our lips.

defs.def_en: If you lick your lips, you move your tongue across your lips as you think about or taste something pleasant.

ext.ext_cn: 至于私底下告诉我的任何事情，我会守口如瓶的。
ext.ext_en: As for anything told to me in confidence, well, my lips are sealed.

defs.def_en: If you tell someone that your lips are sealed, you are promising them that you will keep a secret that they have told you.
If you say that someone is keeping a stiff upper lip, you mean that they are not showing any emotion even though it is difficult for them not to.

defs.def_cn: 终结性;决定性;不可改变性

ext.ext_cn: 小孩子很难理解死亡的不可改变性。
ext.ext_en: Young children have difficulty grasping the finality of death...

ext.ext_cn: “这次不行，费伊，”他斩钉截铁地说。
ext.ext_en: 'Not this time, Faye,' he replied with finality.

defs.def_en: Finality is the quality of being final and impossible to change. If you say something with finality, you say it in a way that shows that you have made up your mind about something and do not want to discuss it further.

ext.ext_cn: 一旦投完票，事情便很快平息了下来。
ext.ext_en: Once the vote was taken, things quieted down quickly...

ext.ext_cn: 临近就寝的时候，要尽量让他们渐渐安静下来。
ext.ext_en: Try gradually to quiet them down as bedtime approaches.

defs.def_en: If someone or something quiets down or if you quiet them down, they become less noisy or less active.

ext.ext_cn: 她是个刻薄的老泼妇。
ext.ext_en: She was a mean old harridan.

defs.def_en: If you call a woman a harridan, you mean that she is unpleasant and speaks too forcefully.

ext.ext_cn: 他从未表现出他前任的那种近乎傲慢的自信。
ext.ext_en: He has never exhibited the self-confidence, bordering on arrogance, of his predecessor...

ext.ext_cn: 这种氛围近似梦幻。
ext.ext_en: The atmosphere borders on the surreal.

defs.def_en: See also:border;If you talk about a characteristic or situation bordering on something, usually something that you consider bad, you mean that it is almost that thing.
A matchbox is a small box that you buy with matches in it.
A person's anus is the hole from which faeces leaves their body.

defs.def_cn: 安慰者;给人安慰的事物

ext.ext_cn: 他成了费雯丽忠诚的朋友和给她安慰的人。
ext.ext_en: He became Vivien Leigh's devoted friend and comforter.

defs.def_en: A comforter is a person or thing that comforts you.
A comforter is a large cover filled with feathers or similar material which you put over yourself in bed instead of a sheet and blankets.
A roll-up is a cigarette that someone makes for themselves, using tobacco and cigarette papers.

ext.ext_cn: 这个女人和她年幼的婴儿被赶了出来，无人照管。
ext.ext_en: The woman and her young baby had been thrown out and left to fend for themselves.

defs.def_en: If you have to fend for yourself, you have to look after yourself without relying on help from anyone else.

ext.ext_cn: 他回避各国媒体的提问时显得轻松而果决。
ext.ext_en: He looked relaxed and determined as he fended off questions from the world's Press...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾想方设法还债主的钱，但却再也躲不过他们了。
ext.ext_en: He had struggled to pay off creditors but couldn't fend them off any longer.

defs.def_en: If you fend off unwanted questions, problems, or people, you stop them from affecting you or defend yourself from them, but often only for a short time and without dealing with them completely.

ext.ext_cn: 他抬起手来抵挡那一拳。
ext.ext_en: He raised his hand to fend off the blow.

defs.def_en: If you fend off someone who is attacking you, you use your arms or something such as a stick to defend yourself from their blows.

ext.ext_cn: 公路建在铁路旁边。
ext.ext_en: The road ran beside a railway.

ext.ext_cn: 废弃的铁路线
ext.ext_en: ...a disused railway line.

defs.def_en: A railway is a route between two places along which trains travel on steel rails.

ext.ext_cn: 法国国有铁路公司
ext.ext_en: ...the state-owned French railway.

ext.ext_cn: 铁路私有化
ext.ext_en: ...the privatisation of the railways.

defs.def_en: A railway is a company or organization that operates railway routes.
A railway is the system and network of tracks that trains travel on.

defs.def_cn: （有时会导致死亡的）心力衰竭

ext.ext_cn: 他发生心力衰竭后病情一直危重。
ext.ext_en: He remained in a critical condition after suffering heart failure.

defs.def_en: Heart failure is a serious medical condition in which someone's heart does not work as well as it should, sometimes stopping completely so that they die.

ext.ext_cn: 砰的摔门声把她吵醒了。
ext.ext_en: The noise of a door slamming wakened her...

ext.ext_cn: 女性通常比男性更易被噪音吵醒。
ext.ext_en: Women are much more likely than men to waken because of noise.

defs.def_en: When you waken, or when someone or something wakens you, you wake from sleep.

ext.ext_cn: 既然对你起作用,这就是个明智的决定。
ext.ext_en: This was a good decision inasmuch as it worked for you.

defs.def_en: You use inasmuch as to introduce a statement which explains something you have just said, and adds to it.
Toiletries are things that you use when washing or taking care of your body, for example soap and toothpaste.

ext.ext_en: 'I guess you guys don't mind if I smoke?' he drawled...

ext.ext_cn: 他嗓音低沉，说话略带拖腔。
ext.ext_en: He has a deep voice and he drawls slightly.

defs.def_en: If someone drawls, they speak slowly and not very clearly, with long vowel sounds.

ext.ext_en: ...a boy expelled from school for making death threats to his teacher.

defs.def_en: If someone is expelled from a school or organization, they are officially told to leave because they have behaved badly.

ext.ext_cn: 昨天一位美国学者被逐出该国。
ext.ext_en: An American academic was expelled from the country yesterday...

ext.ext_cn: 一开始有人告诉他们应该直接将那些难民驱逐出境。
ext.ext_en: They were told at first that they should simply expel the refugees.

defs.def_en: If people are expelled from a place, they are made to leave it, often by force.

ext.ext_cn: 每天擦洗皮肤有助于皮肤排毒。
ext.ext_en: Daily brushing of the skin helps the skin expel toxins...

ext.ext_cn: 肺呼出这些废气被排到空气中。
ext.ext_en: As the lungs exhale this waste, gas is expelled into the atmosphere.

defs.def_en: To expel something means to force it out from a container or from your body.

ext.ext_en: About half the subjects considered themselves to be telepathic...

ext.ext_en: I could not know that. I'm not telepathic.

defs.def_en: If you believe that someone is telepathic, you believe that they have mental powers which cannot be explained by science, such as being able to communicate with other people's minds, and know what other people are thinking.

defs.def_cn: 领事的;与领事(或领事工作)有关的

ext.ext_en: If you need to return to the UK quickly, British Consular officials may be able to arrange it.

defs.def_en: Consular means involving or relating to a consul or the work of a consul.

ext.ext_cn: 未经患者同意而对其进行检查被视为违反职业操守并触犯法律。
ext.ext_en: Testing patients without their consent would constitute a professional and legal offence...

ext.ext_cn: 这次投票很难被视为一次胜利。
ext.ext_en: The vote hardly constitutes a victory...

ext.ext_en: Volunteers constitute more than 95% of The Center's work force.

ext.ext_en: ...the four companies  constituting the Aramco partnership.

defs.def_en: If a number of things or people constitute something, they are the parts or members that form it.

ext.ext_en: On 6 July a People's Revolutionary Government was constituted...

ext.ext_en: The accused will appear before a specially constituted military tribunal.

ext.ext_en: Franklin shared the family's scorn for his wife's new friends...

defs.def_en: If you treat someone or something with scorn, you show contempt for them.

ext.ext_en: People scorn me as a single parent.

defs.def_en: If you scorn someone or something, you feel or show contempt for them.

ext.ext_en: ...people who scorned traditional methods.

defs.def_en: If you scorn something, you refuse to have it or accept it because you think it is not good enough or suitable for you.

ext.ext_en: He used to heap scorn on Dr Vazquez's socialist ideas.

defs.def_en: If you pour scorn on someone or something or heap scorn on them, you say that you think they are stupid and worthless.

ext.ext_en: He thought her confession had been made under duress.

defs.def_en: To do something under duress means to do it because someone forces you to do it or threatens you.

defs.def_cn: 在大而空荡荡的房屋里住（或工作）

ext.ext_en: We don't want to move, but we're rattling around in our large house.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone rattles around in a room or other space, you mean that the space is too large for them.

ext.ext_cn: 裁决合法权益的专员
ext.ext_en: ...a commissioner to adjudicate on legal rights...

ext.ext_cn: 国际法庭或许是对所有权作出裁决的合适之地。
ext.ext_en: The international court of justice might be a suitable place to adjudicate claims.

defs.def_en: If you adjudicate on a dispute or problem, you make an official judgment or decision about it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: ...one of his more quotable sayings.

ext.ext_cn: 临时代用咖啡桌
ext.ext_en: ...a makeshift coffee table.

defs.def_en: Makeshift things are temporary and usually of poor quality, but they are used because there is nothing better available.

defs.def_en: A go-go dancer is a young woman whose job involves dancing to pop music in nightclubs wearing very few clothes.

defs.def_cn: 生意兴隆的；赚大钱的；（公司）迅猛发展的

ext.ext_en: It will be a go-go business with pre-tax profits forecast to climb from £52m last year to £100m.

defs.def_cn: （发动机下部贮存润滑油的）油底壳

defs.def_cn: 管理不善;执行不公;弊政

ext.ext_cn: 要求对管理不善的指控展开调查
ext.ext_en: ...a request to investigate a claim about maladministration.

defs.def_en: Maladministration is the act or process of running a system or organization incorrectly.

defs.def_cn: （电台或电视台的）广播员，播音员，节目主持人

ext.ext_en: ...the prominent naturalist and broadcaster, Sir David Attenborough.

defs.def_en: A broadcaster is someone who gives talks or takes part in interviews and discussions on radio or television programmes.

ext.ext_cn: 不通世故的乡巴佬
ext.ext_en: ...unsophisticated country bumpkins.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a bumpkin, you think they are uneducated and stupid because they come from the countryside.

defs.def_cn: (尤指为某一特定目的给予的)资金，钱款

ext.ext_cn: 这场音乐会将为艾滋病研究筹款。
ext.ext_en: The concert will raise funds for research into Aids.

ext.ext_cn: 政府资金
ext.ext_en: ...government funds.

defs.def_en: See also:fund-raising;Funds are amounts of money that are available to be spent, especially money that is given to an organization or person for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 养老基金
ext.ext_en: ...a pension fund.

ext.ext_cn: 提供给工程学本科生的奖学金基金
ext.ext_en: ...a scholarship fund for undergraduate engineering students.

defs.def_en: See also:trust fund;A fund is an amount of money that is collected or saved for a particular purpose.

ext.ext_cn: 布什基金会已经资助了许多教员发展项目。
ext.ext_en: The Bush Foundation has funded a variety of faculty development programs...

ext.ext_cn: 该机场是由一个建筑集团私人出资兴建的。
ext.ext_en: The airport is being privately funded by a construction group.

defs.def_en: When a person or organization funds something, they provide money for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他的精力异常充沛。
ext.ext_en: He is possessed of an extraordinary fund of energy.

defs.def_en: If you have a fund of something, you have a lot of it.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他告诉他们，他年老体弱，不能走那么远。
ext.ext_en: He told them he was old and feeble and was not able to walk so far...

ext.ext_cn: 锡灯微弱的光线
ext.ext_en: the feeble light of a tin lamp.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as feeble, you mean that they are weak.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: He said that the Government had been feeble.

ext.ext_cn: 一些相当软弱的传统主义者
ext.ext_en: ...some rather feeble traditionalists.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as feeble, you are criticizing them because they are afraid of taking strong action or seem to make no effort.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个论点尤其站不住脚。
ext.ext_en: This is a particularly feeble argument.

defs.def_en: If you describe something that someone says as feeble, you mean that it is not very good or convincing.

ext.ext_en: Residents said local gang leaders had cashed in on the violence to seize valuable land...

ext.ext_en: Avoid cashing in a policy early as you could lose out heavily...

ext.ext_cn: 他没有把股票兑换成现款。
ext.ext_en: He did not cash in his shares.

defs.def_en: If you cash in something such as an insurance policy, you exchange it for money.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Many of those most affected are elderly.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
