ext.ext_en: Some of those artillery pieces look a little elderly.

defs.def_en: If you describe an object as elderly, you are referring, often in a humorous way, to the fact that it is rather old or old-fashioned and not as good or efficient as a new one would be.  →see usage note at:elder
A veterinarian is a person who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals.

defs.def_cn: (令人焦虑或不快的)习惯，经常性行为，倾向

ext.ext_cn: 军方对于北方几个共和国不断加剧的分裂倾向感到越来越不安。
ext.ext_en: The army has become increasingly restless over the mounting separatist tendencies of the northern republics.

ext.ext_cn: 近年来政府的保密倾向
ext.ext_en: ...the government's tendency towards secrecy in recent years.

defs.def_en: A tendency is a worrying or unpleasant habit or action that keeps occurring.

ext.ext_cn: 他被宠坏了，傲慢无礼，而且经常自命不凡。
ext.ext_en: He is spoiled, arrogant and has a tendency towards snobbery...

ext.ext_cn: 海伦一直在压制心里的自杀念头。
ext.ext_en: Helen had been struggling against suicidal tendencies.

defs.def_en: A tendency is a part of your character that makes you behave in an unpleasant or worrying way.

defs.def_cn: 天花乱坠的广告宣传;炒作

ext.ext_cn: 我们无疑已经看到来自一些公司的大肆宣传。
ext.ext_en: We are certainly seeing a lot of hype by some companies...

ext.ext_cn: 我的产品销售靠的不是天花乱坠的广告宣传，而是良好的口碑。
ext.ext_en: My products aren't based on advertising hype, they sell by word of mouth.

defs.def_en: Hype is the use of a lot of publicity and advertising to make people interested in something such as a product.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不得不热炒这部电影以吸引投资人。
ext.ext_en: We had to hype the film to attract the financiers...

ext.ext_cn: 这些权威得到了出版商的力推和商务出版界的大肆宣传。
ext.ext_en: These gurus are being promoted by publishers and hyped in the business press.

defs.def_en: To hype a product means to advertise or praise it a lot.

ext.ext_cn: 为了给电影制造噱头以吸引眼球，他把汽车猛地撞向一辆驶过的卡车。
ext.ext_en: In a bold promotional stunt for the movie, he smashed his car into a passing truck.

defs.def_en: A stunt is something interesting that is done in order to attract attention and get publicity for the person or company responsible for it.

ext.ext_cn: 肖恩·康纳利在他的新片中为求真实，坚持自己出演特技部分。
ext.ext_en: Sean Connery insisted on living dangerously for his new film by performing his own stunts.

defs.def_en: A stunt is a dangerous and exciting piece of action in a film.

defs.def_cn: 阻碍(生长);妨碍(发展);遏制

ext.ext_cn: 心脏病已经多少影响了他的成长。
ext.ext_en: The heart condition had stunted his growth a bit...

ext.ext_cn: 高利率已经阻碍了经济的增长。
ext.ext_en: High interest rates have stunted economic growth.

defs.def_en: If something stunts the growth or development of a person or thing, it prevents it from growing or developing as much as it should.

ext.ext_cn: 他们靠作秀出名的日子早已过去。
ext.ext_en: The days when they needed to pull publicity stunts to get noticed are long gone.

defs.def_en: If someone pulls a stunt, they do something silly or risky.

ext.ext_cn: 这使得两种文化能相互融合，却又不失其个性。
ext.ext_en: This allows the two cultures to intermingle without losing their separate identities.

ext.ext_cn: 与其他国家的公民打成一片的机会
ext.ext_en: ...an opportunity for them to intermingle with the citizens of other countries.

defs.def_en: When people or things intermingle, they mix with each other.

defs.def_cn: 未予回答的；未得到回复的

ext.ext_cn: 最重要的一些问题依然没有答案。
ext.ext_en: Some of the most important questions remain unanswered...

ext.ext_cn: 读者应该把那些未得到回复的信件复印一份寄给代表他们的议员。
ext.ext_en: Readers should send a copy of unanswered letters to their MP...

defs.def_en: Something such as a question or letter that is unanswered has not been answered.
Myopia is the inability to see things properly when they are far away, because there is something wrong with your eyes.

defs.def_cn: 资产倒卖（廉价收购企业，再出售其资产以获利）
defs.def_en: If a person or company is involved in asset-stripping, they buy companies cheaply, sell off their assets to make a profit, and then close the companies down.

defs.def_cn: 发生的事情;意外事件;难以解释的事

ext.ext_cn: 布达佩斯办事处计划聘用自由撰稿记者来报道最近发生的一些事件。
ext.ext_en: The Budapest office plans to hire freelance reporters to cover the latest happenings.

defs.def_en: Happenings are things that happen, often in a way that is unexpected or hard to explain.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 介绍各个地区新潮流行乐队的权威指南
ext.ext_en: ...a definitive area-by-area guide to the hip and happening bands.

ext.ext_cn: 时下最热门的去处——Que俱乐部
ext.ext_en: ...the most happening place at the moment, the Que Club.

defs.def_en: If you describe something or someone as happening, you mean that they are exciting or lively, and involved in the newest fashions or trends.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 汽油和煤油之类的易燃液体
ext.ext_en: ...flammable liquids such as petrol or paraffin.

defs.def_en: Flammable chemicals, gases, cloth, or other things catch fire and burn easily.

ext.ext_cn: 残阳下的影子越拉越长。
ext.ext_en: The evening shadows were lengthening...

ext.ext_cn: 她开始加快步子，但他加大了步幅跟着她。
ext.ext_en: She began to walk faster, but he lengthened his stride to keep up with her...

defs.def_en: When something lengthens or when you lengthen it, it increases in length.

defs.def_cn: （使）（时间）延长；（使…）持续更长时间

ext.ext_cn: 假期延长，工作周就缩短了。
ext.ext_en: Vacations have lengthened and the work week has shortened...

ext.ext_cn: 委员会不支持通过延长在校时间来插入其他活动。
ext.ext_en: The council does not support lengthening the school day to fit in other activities.

defs.def_en: When something lengthens or when you lengthen it, it lasts for a longer time than it did previously.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 兴高采烈的；快乐的；高兴的

ext.ext_cn: 她是个心地善良、整天乐呵呵的女人。
ext.ext_en: She was a jolly, kindhearted woman.

defs.def_en: Someone who is jolly is happy and cheerful in their appearance or behaviour.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 令人愉快的；欢快的；惬意的

ext.ext_cn: 我期待着有一个令人愉快的聚会。
ext.ext_en: I was looking forward to a jolly party...

ext.ext_cn: 她在韩国玩得很惬意。
ext.ext_en: She had a very jolly time in Korea.

defs.def_en: A jolly event is lively and enjoyable.

ext.ext_cn: 她拼图玩得很棒。
ext.ext_en: She was jolly good at jigsaws...

ext.ext_cn: 这可是件很苦的差事，不过我喜欢。
ext.ext_en: It was jolly hard work, but I loved it.

defs.def_en: Jolly is sometimes used to emphasize an adjective or adverb.

defs.def_cn: （用于强调看法或意图，表示恼火或生气）当然，无疑，真是

ext.ext_cn: 我们不能就这么直接地告诉他我们到底是怎么看他的，是吧？
ext.ext_en: We can hardly just tell him what we jolly well think of him can we?...

ext.ext_cn: 她肯定不会在这件事上就这么放过他们。
ext.ext_en: She was jolly well not going to let them get away with it.

defs.def_en: Jolly well is sometimes used to emphasize an opinion or intention, and to express annoyance or anger.

defs.def_cn: (规则、原则、税项等)无效的，不能生效的，不起作用的
defs.def_en: An inoperative rule, principle, or tax is one that does not work any more or that cannot be made to work.

defs.def_cn: (用蔗糖、黄油、牛奶制成的)卡拉梅尔糖,黄油奶糖
defs.def_en: A caramel is a chewy sweet food made from sugar, butter, and milk.
Caramel is burnt sugar used for colouring and flavouring food.

ext.ext_cn: 他们经常到湖边去。
ext.ext_en: They were out by the lakeside a lot.

ext.ext_cn: 风景怡人的意大利湖畔之城卢加诺
ext.ext_en: ...the picturesque Italian lakeside town of Lugano.

defs.def_en: The lakeside is the area of land around the edge of a lake.

ext.ext_cn: 他们下降了41,000英尺后才拉开伞。
ext.ext_en: They fell 41,000 ft. before opening their parachutes...

ext.ext_cn: 联合国部队可以乘直升机着陆，甚至可以伞降。
ext.ext_en: UN troops could be landed by helicopter or even by parachute.

defs.def_en: A parachute is a device which enables a person to jump from an aircraft and float safely to the ground. It consists of a large piece of thin cloth attached to your body by strings.

ext.ext_cn: 他是波兰地下组织的情报员，被空降到华沙。
ext.ext_en: He was a courier for the Polish underground and parachuted into Warsaw...

ext.ext_cn: 他空降进入。
ext.ext_en: He was parachuted in.

defs.def_en: If a person parachutes or someone parachutes them somewhere, they jump from an aircraft using a parachute.

ext.ext_cn: 飞机将食品、衣物、毯子、药品和水空投到崎岖多山的边界地区。
ext.ext_en: Planes parachuted food, clothing, blankets, medicine and water into  the rugged mountainous border region...

ext.ext_cn: 补给物资被空投到山区。
ext.ext_en: Supplies were parachuted into the mountains.

defs.def_en: To parachute something somewhere means to drop it somewhere by parachute.

defs.def_cn: （使）空降（指突然从机构外调入）

ext.ext_cn: 空降到公司协助制定战略思想的顾问
ext.ext_en: ...a consultant who parachutes into corporations and helps provide strategic thinking.

ext.ext_cn: 18个月前，人们普遍猜测前外交大臣可能会空降至苏格兰议会。
ext.ext_en: There was intense speculation 18 months ago that the former foreign secretary might be parachuted into the Scottish Parliament.

defs.def_en: If a person parachutes into an organization or if they are parachuted into it, they are brought in suddenly in order to help it.
Blackheads are small, dark spots on someone's skin caused by blocked pores.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (因稀少或漂亮而)值得收藏的

ext.ext_cn: 特价出售、值得收藏的精美艺术品种类繁多，将会让参观者大开眼界。
ext.ext_en: Visitors will be impressed with the enormous range of collectable objets d'art on offer...

ext.ext_cn: 这些垫子很多都保存了下来，非常有收藏价值。
ext.ext_en: Many of these cushions have survived and are very collectible.

defs.def_en: A collectable object is one which is valued very highly by collectors because it is rare or beautiful.
A diplomat is a senior official who discusses affairs with another country on behalf of his or her own country, usually working as a member of an embassy.

defs.def_cn: (指股份为另一家公司所全部拥有的)全资子公司

ext.ext_cn: 机车建筑有限公司是该托拉斯的全资子公司。
ext.ext_en: The Locomotive Construction Company Ltd is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Trust.

defs.def_en: A wholly-owned subsidiary is a company whose shares are all owned by another company.

defs.def_cn: (用于钳锁非法停放车辆的)丹佛锁箍，丹佛锁扣
defs.def_en: A Denver boot is a large metal device which is fitted to the wheel of an illegally parked car or other vehicle in order to prevent it from being driven away. The driver has to pay to have the device removed.

ext.ext_cn: 人世间的残酷无情让我感到无比悲哀。
ext.ext_en: The cruelty in the world saddens me incredibly.

defs.def_en: If something saddens you, it makes you feel sad.

ext.ext_cn: 要是我买的东西他不喜欢的话，我就会去退货。
ext.ext_en: If I buy something and he doesn't like it I'll take it back...

ext.ext_cn: 我去了图书馆，帮你把书还了。
ext.ext_en: I went to the library and took your books back...

defs.def_en: If you take something back, you return it to the place where you bought it or where you borrowed it from, because it is unsuitable or broken, or because you have finished with it.

defs.def_cn: 收回，撤回(所说的话或想法)

ext.ext_cn: 我收回说过的话，我想也许我是外向型的人。
ext.ext_en: I take it back, I think perhaps I am an extrovert...

ext.ext_cn: 收回你说的关于杰里米的话。
ext.ext_en: Take back what you said about Jeremy!

defs.def_en: If you take something back, you admit that something that you said or thought is wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 她怎么又让他回家了？
ext.ext_en: Why did she take him back?...

ext.ext_cn: 政府同意让那些被认为是经济难民的人回国，但政治难民不包括在内。
ext.ext_en: The government has agreed to take back those people who are considered economic rather than political refugees.

defs.def_en: If you take someone back, you allow them to come home again, after they have gone away because of a quarrel or other problem.

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢尝试各种颜色——它使我感觉像是又回到了 5 岁的时候。
ext.ext_en: I enjoyed experimenting with colours — it took me back to being five years old...

ext.ext_cn: 这使我想起了过去。
ext.ext_en: This takes me back.

defs.def_en: If you say that something takes you back, you mean that it reminds you of a period of your past life and makes you think about it again.

ext.ext_cn: 可擦写的光盘
ext.ext_en: ...rewritable discs.

defs.def_en: A rewritable CD or DVD is a CD or DVD that you can record onto more than once.

ext.ext_cn: 双方在条约中都承诺将尊重人权。
ext.ext_en: In the treaty both sides pledge to respect human rights.

defs.def_en: Human rights are basic rights which many societies believe that all people should have.
The tonnage of a ship is its size or the amount of space that it has inside it for cargo.
Tonnage is the total number of tons that something weighs, or the total amount that there is of it.

ext.ext_cn: 一两个歌剧剧本的作者
ext.ext_en: ...the author of one or two opera librettos.

defs.def_en: The libretto of an opera is the words that are sung in it.

ext.ext_cn: 被关在卢卡斯维尔一级警戒监狱的450名囚犯
ext.ext_en: ...the 450 inmates at the maximum-security lock-up in Lucasville.

defs.def_en: A lock-up is the same as a jail .

ext.ext_cn: 在她租给亨德森先生的车库里发现了25磅塞姆汀塑胶炸药。
ext.ext_en: 25lb of Semtex explosive was found in the lock-up she had rented to Mr Henderson.

ext.ext_cn: 独立车库
ext.ext_en: ...a lock-up garage.

defs.def_en: A lock-up is a garage that is used by someone, but is not next to their house.

ext.ext_cn: 他们由于疏忽没有及时重整军备，结果使英国面临灾祸。
ext.ext_en: They neglected to rearm in time and left Britain exposed to disaster.

ext.ext_cn: 北约重新武装西德的决定
ext.ext_en: ...NATO's decision to rearm West Germany.

defs.def_en: If a country rearms or is rearmed, it starts to build up a new stock of military weapons.
A skeleton key is a key which has been specially made so that it will open many different locks.

defs.def_cn: 调查;民意调查;民意测验

ext.ext_cn: 市政会就农场建筑的使用情况进行了调查。
ext.ext_en: The council conducted a survey of the uses to which farm buildings are put...

ext.ext_cn: 根据这项调查，世界贸易整体上也有所放慢。
ext.ext_en: According to the survey, overall world trade has also slackened.

defs.def_en: If you carry out a survey, you try to find out detailed information about a lot of different people or things, usually by asking people a series of questions.

defs.def_cn: 调查;对…作民意调查;对…进行民意测验

ext.ext_cn: 企业发展顾问公司为此报告调查了 211 家公司。
ext.ext_en: Business Development Advisers surveyed 211 companies for the report...

ext.ext_cn: 被调查者中只有 18%的人反对该主张。
ext.ext_en: Only 18 percent of those surveyed opposed the idea.

defs.def_en: If you survey a number of people, companies, or organizations, you try to find out information about their opinions or behaviour, usually by asking them a series of questions.

defs.def_cn: 总体研究;审视;全面观察

ext.ext_cn: 他站起来仔细打量整间屋子。
ext.ext_en: He pushed himself to his feet and surveyed the room...

ext.ext_cn: 他用一种保守的世界观审视美国政治。
ext.ext_en: He surveys American politics with a conservative world view.

defs.def_en: If you survey something, you look at or consider the whole of it carefully.

ext.ext_cn: 有关占星术的几本重要著作的简要概述
ext.ext_en: ...a brief survey of some important books on astrology...

ext.ext_cn: 他闻了闻她身上的香水味，然后又飞快地打量了她一眼。
ext.ext_en: He sniffed the perfume she wore, then gave her a quick survey.

defs.def_en: If you give something a brief survey or a quick survey, you look at or consider all of it quickly, but not in detail.

ext.ext_cn: 印度地质勘察活动的组织者
ext.ext_en: ...the organizer of the geological survey of India...

ext.ext_cn: 科学家们在两次地面勘测后又进行了两次空中勘测。
ext.ext_en: The scientists conducted two aerial surveys followed by two ground surveys.

defs.def_en: If someone carries out a survey of an area of land, they examine it and measure it, usually in order to make a map of it.

ext.ext_cn: 斯卡伯勒市政会在今年早些时候委托地质专家对这些悬崖进行勘测。
ext.ext_en: Scarborough Council commissioned geological experts earlier this year to survey the cliffs.

defs.def_en: If someone surveys an area of land, they examine it and measure it, usually in order to make a map of it.

defs.def_cn: (通常指为欲购房者作的)房屋鉴定

ext.ext_cn: 由一位有资质的房屋鉴定员所作的结构评估
ext.ext_en: ...a structural survey undertaken by a qualified surveyor.

defs.def_en: A survey is a careful examination of the condition and structure of a house, usually carried out in order to give information to a person who wants to buy it.

defs.def_cn: 对(建筑物)进行评估;鉴定;检查

ext.ext_cn: 抵押贷款房屋的评估人员
ext.ext_en: ...the people who surveyed the house for the mortgage.

defs.def_en: If someone surveys a house, they examine it carefully and report on its structure, usually in order to give advice to a person who is thinking of buying it.
A snare drum is a small drum used in orchestras and bands. Snare drums are usually played with wooden sticks, and make a continuous sound.

defs.def_cn: 暴君;专制君主;暴君似的人

ext.ext_cn: 自 1804 年以来，该国大部分时间都处于暴君的统治之下。
ext.ext_en: Since 1804 the country has mostly been ruled by tyrants.

ext.ext_cn: 父亲残暴专横的家庭
ext.ext_en: ...households where the father was a tyrant.

defs.def_en: You can use tyrant to refer to someone who treats the people they have authority over in a cruel and unfair way.

defs.def_cn: （圣诞节吃的）浓味干果布丁，葡萄干布丁
defs.def_en: Plum pudding is a special pudding eaten at Christmas which is made with dried fruit, spices, and suet.
A cement mixer is a machine with a large revolving container into which builders put cement, sand, and water in order to make concrete.

ext.ext_cn: 有屋顶的走廊
ext.ext_en: ...a roofed corridor...

ext.ext_cn: 现在，只有那两座大房子还有屋顶。
ext.ext_en: Nowadays, only the two big houses remain roofed.

defs.def_en: A roofed building or area is covered by a roof.

defs.def_cn: (苏格兰)花格图案，花格织物，格呢

ext.ext_cn: 走廊里铺的是花格地毯。
ext.ext_en: The corridors are carpeted in tartan.

ext.ext_cn: 传统的苏格兰格呢短褶裙
ext.ext_en: ...traditional tartan kilts.

defs.def_en: Tartan is a design for cloth traditionally associated with Scotland, and which has a number of distinctive types. The design is made up of lines of different widths and colours crossing each other at right angles. Tartan is also used to refer to cloth which has this pattern.
An IOU is a written promise that you will pay back some money that you have borrowed. IOU is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'I owe you'.

ext.ext_cn: 只要达到了拍卖底价，标的物就会出售给出价最高的竞买人。
ext.ext_en: The sale will be made to the highest bidder subject to a reserve price being attained.

defs.def_en: A bidder is someone who offers to pay a certain amount of money for something that is being sold. If you sell something to the highest bidder, you sell it to the person who offers the most money for it.

ext.ext_cn: 努力争取得到两张在希腊开发移动电话系统许可证的运营商
ext.ext_en: ...bidders for two licences to develop cellular telephone systems in Greece.

defs.def_en: A bidder for something is someone who is trying to obtain it or do it.

defs.def_cn: (拥有价值数百万英镑、美元财产的)大富翁
defs.def_en: A multi-millionaire is a very rich person who has money or property worth several million pounds or dollars.
A picture postcard is a postcard with a photograph of a place on it. People often buy picture postcards of places they visit when on holiday.

defs.def_cn: 风景明信片般的；风光如画的

ext.ext_cn: 美丽如画的诺曼底村庄
ext.ext_en: ...picture-postcard Normandy villages.

defs.def_en: You can use picture postcard to describe a place that is very attractive.
A groundhog is a type of small animal with reddish-brown fur that is found in North America.
If you refer to someone as a country cousin, you think that they are unsophisticated because they come from the country.

defs.def_cn: 决定性的试验；严峻的考验

ext.ext_cn: “你会将自己的孩子送去那里吗？”这一问题是衡量一所学校的试金石。
ext.ext_en: The acid test of a school is 'would you send your own children there?'

defs.def_en: The acid test of something is an important aspect or result that it might have, which allows you to decide whether it is true or successful.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 复杂的；难以解决的；棘手的

ext.ext_cn: 新的管理团队面临一些棘手的问题。
ext.ext_en: The new management team faces some knotty problems.

defs.def_en: A knotty problem is complicated and difficult to solve.

ext.ext_cn: 多节的山楂树干
ext.ext_en: ...the knotty trunk of a hawthorn tree.

defs.def_en: Knotty wood has a lot of small hard areas on it where branches once grew.
A gunslinger is someone, especially a criminal, who uses guns in fighting.
A handbag is a small bag which a woman uses to carry things such as her money and keys in when she goes out.
A phone booth is a place in a station, hotel, or other public building where there is a public telephone.
A phone booth is the same as a phone box .

ext.ext_cn: 瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。
ext.ext_en: The Swiss wanted to discourage an inflow of foreign money.

ext.ext_cn: 东欧移民的涌入
ext.ext_en: ...the inflow of immigrants from Eastern Europe

defs.def_en: If there is an inflow of money or people into a place, a large amount of money or people move into a place.
Moonshine is whisky that is made illegally.

ext.ext_cn: 正如莫里森所说，这个故事纯属妄想。
ext.ext_en: As Morison remarks, the story is pure moonshine.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone's thoughts, ideas, or comments are moonshine, you think they are foolish and not based on reality.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 本世纪最杰出的科学家们
ext.ext_en: ...the most illustrious scientists of the century.

ext.ext_cn: 他漫长辉煌的职业生涯
ext.ext_en: ...his long and illustrious career.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as an illustrious person, you mean that they are extremely well known because they have a high position in society or they have done something impressive.

ext.ext_cn: 他对人们行为上的细微差别极感兴趣，这使他成了一个很会讲故事的人。
ext.ext_en: His fascination with the subtleties of human behaviour makes him a good storyteller...

ext.ext_cn: 当一部书被翻译成另一种语言后，所有那些语言上的精妙之处就都丢失了。
ext.ext_en: When a book goes into translation, all those linguistic subtleties get lost.

defs.def_en: Subtleties are very small details or differences which are not obvious.

ext.ext_cn: 非洲舞蹈充满活力，但不乏精妙之处，需要舞者有很强的力量和控制能力。
ext.ext_en: African dance is vigorous, but full of subtlety, requiring great strength and control...

ext.ext_cn: 许多如此酿制的葡萄酒都不像最初的葡萄酒那样耐人品味。
ext.ext_en: Many of the resulting wines lack the subtlety of the original model.

defs.def_en: Subtlety is the quality of being not immediately obvious or noticeable, and therefore difficult to describe.

ext.ext_cn: 她非常敏锐地分析自己。
ext.ext_en: She analyses herself with great subtlety.

defs.def_en: Subtlety is the ability to notice and recognize things which are not obvious, especially small differences between things.

ext.ext_cn: 他们显然一直希望能更巧妙地切入这一话题。
ext.ext_en: They had obviously been hoping to approach the topic with more subtlety.

defs.def_en: Subtlety is the ability to use indirect methods to achieve something, rather than doing something that is obvious.

ext.ext_cn: 陈旧的石制牛食槽仍然放在大门口。
ext.ext_en: The old stone cattle trough still sits by the main entrance.

defs.def_en: A trough is a long narrow container from which farm animals drink or eat.

ext.ext_cn: 船在波涛起伏的海浪中剧烈摇摆。
ext.ext_en: The boat rolled heavily in the troughs between the waves.

defs.def_en: A trough is a low area between two big waves on the sea.

ext.ext_cn: 今后回想起来你就会明白，这并非你事业中一蹶不振的低谷。
ext.ext_en: Looking back afterwards you will see that this was not a terminal trough in your career...

ext.ext_cn: 美国的银行股自从去年 10 月跌入低谷以来已经上涨了 60%。
ext.ext_en: American bank shares have risen by 60% since their trough last October.

defs.def_en: A trough is a low point in a process that has regular high and low points, for example a period in business when people do not produce as much as usual.

ext.ext_cn: 低压槽延伸约 1,000 公里。
ext.ext_en: The trough of low pressure extended over about 1000 kilometres.

defs.def_en: A trough of low pressure is a long narrow area of low air pressure between two areas of higher pressure.

ext.ext_cn: 移民故事一直是小说中常见的主题。
ext.ext_en: Immigrant tales have always been popular themes in fiction...

ext.ext_cn: 黛安娜是历史小说作家。
ext.ext_en: Diana is a writer of historical fiction.

defs.def_en: See also:science fiction;Fiction refers to books and stories about imaginary people and events, rather than books about real people or events.

ext.ext_cn: 这个故事一直以来真伪莫辨。
ext.ext_en: The truth or fiction of this story has never been truly determined.

defs.def_en: A statement or account that is fiction is not true.

ext.ext_cn: 认为美国可以接纳所有的人，使之和谐相处是一个幻想。
ext.ext_en: The idea that the United States could harmoniously accommodate all was a fiction.

defs.def_en: If something is a fiction, it is not true, although people sometimes pretend that it is true.
Tadpoles are small water creatures which grow into frogs or toads.

defs.def_cn: 绊脚;跌跌撞撞地走;踉跄;步履蹒跚

ext.ext_cn: 他差点被绊倒。
ext.ext_en: He stumbled and almost fell...

ext.ext_cn: 我跌跌撞撞地进了电话亭拨了 999。
ext.ext_en: I stumbled into the telephone box and dialed 999.

defs.def_en: If you stumble, you put your foot down awkwardly while you are walking or running and nearly fall over.

defs.def_cn: (朗读或说话时)结巴，磕磕巴巴

ext.ext_cn: 他声音颤抖，一度说话磕磕巴巴的
ext.ext_en: ...his voice wavered and he stumbled over the words at one point.

defs.def_en: If you stumble while you are reading aloud or speaking, you make a mistake, and have to pause before saying the words properly.

defs.pos_cn: 可数名词；头衔名词；称呼名词

ext.ext_cn: 她做了29年的护士。
ext.ext_en: She had spent 29 years as a nurse...

ext.ext_cn: 因为护理人员严重不足，患者生命垂危。
ext.ext_en: Patients were dying because of an acute shortage of nurses.

defs.def_en: A nurse is a person whose job is to care for people who are ill.

ext.ext_cn: 他生病的这些年来，我妈妈一直照料着他。
ext.ext_en: All the years he was sick my mother had nursed him...

ext.ext_cn: 她赶回家去，要照顾女儿恢复健康。
ext.ext_en: She rushed home to nurse her daughter back to health.

defs.def_en: If you nurse someone, you care for them when they are ill.

ext.ext_cn: 我们打算回家调养感冒。
ext.ext_en: We're going to go home and nurse our colds.

defs.def_en: If you nurse an illness or injury, you allow it to get better by resting as much as possible.

defs.def_cn: 怀有，抱有(强烈的希望、愿望等)

ext.ext_cn: 简仍因遭到拒绝而痛苦。
ext.ext_en: Jane still nurses the pain of rejection...

ext.ext_cn: 他一直有一个梦想，希望能指挥一支自己的顶级管弦乐队。
ext.ext_en: He had nursed an ambition to lead his own big orchestra.

defs.def_en: If you nurse an emotion or desire, you feel it strongly for a long time.

ext.ext_cn: 每天早晨，她和孩子、保姆一起早早起床。
ext.ext_en: Every morning she got up early with the children and the nurse.

defs.def_en: A nurse is a person who is trained to look after young children.

ext.ext_cn: 大部分权威人士建议婴儿饿了就随时喂奶。
ext.ext_en: Most authorities recommend letting the baby nurse whenever it wants.

ext.ext_cn: 给孩子喂奶的年轻妈妈
ext.ext_en: ...young women nursing babies...

defs.def_en: When a baby nurses or when its mother nurses it, it feeds by sucking milk from its mother's breast.

ext.ext_cn: 传说中的不列颠部落首领——亚瑟王
ext.ext_en: ...the legendary British chieftain, King Arthur.

defs.def_en: A chieftain is the leader of a tribe.

defs.def_cn: 国际主义;国际友好合作观
defs.def_en: Internationalism is the belief that countries should work with, help, and be friendly with one another.

ext.ext_cn: 他的车遭遇拦劫，随后他被4名持枪歹徒劫持。
ext.ext_en: His car was held up and he was abducted by four gunmen...

ext.ext_cn: 她被控诱拐一个6个月大的孩子。
ext.ext_en: She was charged with abducting a six-month-old child.

defs.def_en: If someone is abducted by another person, he or she is taken away illegally, usually using force.
A botanist is a scientist who studies plants.

ext.ext_cn: 一大群学生和赶时髦的左派分子
ext.ext_en: ...a large group of students and trendy lefties.

defs.def_en: If you refer to someone as a lefty, you mean that they have socialist beliefs.

defs.def_cn: 左撇子；（尤指）惯用左手的运动员

ext.ext_cn: 戈兰是个左撇子，他的发球由此质量要更高一些。
ext.ext_en: The fact that Goran is a lefty just makes his serve that little bit better.

defs.def_en: A lefty is someone, especially a sports player, who is left-handed.
Temazepam is a drug that is used to make people feel calmer or less anxious.

defs.def_cn: 无性的；非性的；与性无关的

ext.ext_cn: 他们之间的关系根本与性无关。
ext.ext_en: Their relationship was totally asexual.

ext.ext_cn: 无性繁殖
ext.ext_en: ...asexual reproduction.

defs.def_en: Something that is asexual involves no sexual activity.

ext.ext_cn: 无性器官的寄生虫
ext.ext_en: ...asexual parasites.

defs.def_en: Asexual creatures and plants have no sexual organs.

ext.ext_cn: 我们的文化里还有一种错误观念，就是认为上了年纪的人就不再有性欲了。
ext.ext_en: It is another unfortunate myth of our culture that older people are asexual.

defs.def_en: Someone who is asexual is not sexually attracted to other people.

ext.ext_cn: 他会模仿各种口音，还会讲笑话——他可以当个独角喜剧演员。
ext.ext_en: He does all kinds of accents, he can do jokes—he could be a stand-up comic...

ext.ext_cn: 女性靠演单人喜剧通常无法成名。
ext.ext_en: Women do not normally break into the big time by doing stand-up comedy.

defs.def_en: A stand-up comic or comedian stands alone in front of an audience and tells jokes.

defs.def_cn: 单人滑稽表演;单口相声

ext.ext_cn: 凭借个人魅力、精湛的技艺和进行单人喜剧表演所需要的勇气过活
ext.ext_en: ...getting by on likeability, professionalism and the kind of nerve you need to do stand-up.

defs.def_en: Stand-up is stand-up comedy.
If people have a stand-up argument or fight, they stand up and shout at each other or hit each other violently.
Twenty is the number 20.

defs.def_cn: (20 至 29 之间的数字)二十几

ext.ext_cn: 他们俩都二十几岁，都已经结婚生子了。
ext.ext_en: They're both in their twenties and both married with children of their own.

defs.def_en: When you talk about the twenties, you are referring to numbers between 20 and 29. For example, if you are in your twenties, you are aged between 20 and 29. If the temperature is in the twenties, the temperature is between 20 and 29 degrees.

defs.def_cn: 二十世纪二十年代(1920 至 1929 年间)

ext.ext_cn: 它写于20世纪20年代，但直到今天仍然备受瞩目。
ext.ext_en: It was written in the Twenties, but it still really stands out.

defs.def_en: The twenties is the decade between 1920 and 1929.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 受过培训的;受过教育的;有经验的

ext.ext_cn: 他们俩都受过良好的陆军训练。
ext.ext_en: They were both well schooled in the ways of the Army...

ext.ext_cn: 她是个专业经济学家，因此在驳斥类似国家干预行为方面经验丰富。
ext.ext_en: She is a professional economist and therefore schooled in the arguments against that sort of state intervention.

defs.def_en: See also:school;If you are schooled in something, you have learned about it as the result of training or experience.

defs.def_cn: (19世纪和20世纪早期剧院里的)歌舞杂耍演出

ext.ext_cn: 一曲歌舞杂耍演出里的老歌
ext.ext_en: ...an old music hall song.

defs.def_en: Music hall was a popular form of entertainment in the theatre in the nineteenth and early twentieth century. It consisted of a series of performances by comedians, singers, and dancers.
A music hall was a theatre that presented popular entertainment.

ext.ext_cn: 我恳求他和我一起回英格兰。
ext.ext_en: I begged him to come back to England with me...

ext.ext_cn: 我请求允许我离开。
ext.ext_en: I begged to be allowed to leave...

defs.def_en: If you beg someone to do something, you ask them very anxiously or eagerly to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 我被一群讨饭的围住了。
ext.ext_en: I was surrounded by people begging for food...

ext.ext_cn: 洛杉矶有数以千计像他这样的人，沿街乞讨，露宿街头。
ext.ext_en: There are thousands like him in Los Angeles, begging on the streets and sleeping rough...

defs.def_en: If someone who is poor is begging, they are asking people to give them food or money.
You say 'I beg to differ' when you are politely emphasizing that you disagree with someone.

ext.ext_cn: 城里还有些住宅无人问津。
ext.ext_en: There is other housing going begging in town.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is going begging, you mean that it is available but no one is using it or accepting it.

defs.def_cn: 引起疑问，使人想问（一些人认为此用法不正确）

ext.ext_cn: 霍普韦尔的成功让人不禁要问：为什么其他公司不效仿呢？
ext.ext_en: Hopewell's success begs the question: why aren't more companies doing the same?

defs.def_en: If you say that something begs a particular question, you mean that it makes people want to ask that question; some people consider that this use is incorrect.

defs.def_cn: （认为问题已获解决而）绕过问题

ext.ext_cn: 研究绕过了一些问题。
ext.ext_en: The research begs a number of questions.

defs.def_en: If you say that something begs a particular question, you mean that it assumes that the question has already been answered and so does not deal with it.

ext.ext_cn: 现有的情况是，新的结果缩小了可能性的范围。
ext.ext_en: What's happened is that the new results narrow down the possibilities...

ext.ext_cn: 我已设法把清单上的项目压缩到了23项。
ext.ext_en: I've managed to narrow the list down to twenty-three.

defs.def_en: If you narrow down a range of things, you reduce the number of things included in it.

ext.ext_cn: 警方不得不对这两个对立团体进行干预。
ext.ext_en: Police had to interpose themselves between the two rival groups...

ext.ext_cn: 该艺术品在两面圆形大镜子中间插入一块玻璃板。
ext.ext_en: The work interposes a glass plate between two large circular mirrors.

defs.def_en: If you interpose something between two people or things, you place it between them.

ext.ext_cn: “他刚刚给我打过电话,”她插嘴说。
ext.ext_en: 'He rang me just now,' she interposed...

ext.ext_cn: 雅各布沉默的时间太长了,莉薇只好插话了。
ext.ext_en: Jacob was silent so long that Livvy interposed.

defs.def_en: If you interpose, you interrupt with a comment or question.

ext.ext_cn: 我去参加了会议。
ext.ext_en: I went along to the meeting...

ext.ext_cn: 你应该去瞧瞧。
ext.ext_en: You should go along and have a look.

defs.def_en: If you go along to a meeting, event, or place, you attend or visit it.

ext.ext_cn: 事情进展十分顺利。
ext.ext_en: Things were going along fairly well.

defs.def_en: If you describe how something is going along, you describe how it is progressing.

ext.ext_cn: 涂鸦如今在北安普顿是一种艺术形式。
ext.ext_en: Graffiti is now an art form in Nor-thampton.

ext.ext_cn: 印度舞蹈和相关的艺术形式
ext.ext_en: ...Indian dance and related art forms.

defs.def_en: If you describe an activity as an art form, you mean that it is concerned with creating objects, works, or performances that are beautiful or have a serious meaning.

ext.ext_cn: 他们向申请重新接通服务的用户收取66.10英镑的费用。
ext.ext_en: They charge a £66.10 fee for reconnecting cut-off customers...

ext.ext_cn: 当地电力公司称一些住户要到周末才能恢复供电。
ext.ext_en: Local electricity companies say some homes won't be reconnected until the end of the week.

defs.def_en: If a company reconnects your electricity, water, gas, or telephone after it has been stopped, they provide you with it once again.

ext.ext_cn: 人世间的残酷无情让我感到无比悲哀。
ext.ext_en: The cruelty in the world saddens me incredibly.

defs.def_en: If something saddens you, it makes you feel sad.

ext.ext_cn: 德莫特把钱存在一个定期存款账户里。
ext.ext_en: Dermot's putting his money by, in a Deposit Account...

ext.ext_cn: 存的钱足够付她的机票钱。
ext.ext_en: There was enough put by for her fare...

defs.def_en: If you put money by, you save it so that you can use it later.

ext.ext_cn: 大赦国际的一名发言人诺尔马·约翰斯顿讲述了几个案例。
ext.ext_en: A spokesperson for Amnesty, Norma Johnston, describes some cases.

defs.def_en: A spokesperson is a person who speaks as the representative of a group or organization.

ext.ext_cn: 她补充说，西方人对包办婚姻的概念有些误解。
ext.ext_en: She added that the concept of arranged marriages is misunderstood in the west.

ext.ext_cn: 基本的法律概念
ext.ext_en: ...basic legal concepts.

defs.def_en: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她躺在床上，看上去特别虚弱。
ext.ext_en: She lay in bed looking particularly frail.

defs.def_en: Someone who is frail is not very strong or healthy.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他爬进来的时候，那件易碎的工艺品摇晃起来。
ext.ext_en: The frail craft rocked as he clambered in.

defs.def_en: Something that is frail is easily broken or damaged.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 港口里满是船只。
ext.ext_en: The Harbor was replete with boats...

ext.ext_cn: 历史上人口失控的例子比比皆是。
ext.ext_en: History is replete with examples of populations out of control.

defs.def_en: To be replete with something means to be full of it.

ext.ext_cn: 吃饱喝足后，宾客们可以到现代化的暖房里享受一杯咖啡。
ext.ext_en: Replete, guests can then retire to the modern conservatory for coffee.

defs.def_en: If you are replete, you are pleasantly full of food and drink.
Serialization is the act of serializing a book.

ext.ext_cn: 在根据简·奥斯汀的小说《傲慢与偏见》改编的系列剧中
ext.ext_en: ...in the serialisation of Jane Austen's Pride and Prejudice.

defs.def_en: A serialization is a story, originally written as a book, which is being published or broadcast in a number of parts.

ext.ext_cn: 加入欧洲汇率机制并不是解决英国经济问题的万灵丹。
ext.ext_en: Membership of the ERM is not a panacea for Britain's economic problems...

ext.ext_cn: 西方援助可能会有所帮助，但并非灵丹妙药。
ext.ext_en: Western aid may help but will not be a panacea.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is not a panacea for a particular set of problems, you mean that it will not solve all those problems.

defs.def_cn: 考虑到；将…计算在内；为…酌留余地

ext.ext_cn: 你必须将一定量的误差考虑在内。
ext.ext_en: You have to allow for a certain amount of error...

ext.ext_cn: 该机构的预算根本没有将如此大额的超支计算在内。
ext.ext_en: The Agency's budget simply did not allow for such a massive increase.

defs.def_en: If you allow for certain problems or expenses, you include some extra time or money in your planning so that you can deal with them if they occur.

ext.ext_cn: 中东地区的两大河流发源于土耳其境内的山脉。
ext.ext_en: The two great rivers of the Middle East rise in the mountains of Turkey.

defs.def_en: The Middle East is the area around the eastern Mediterranean that includes Iran and all the countries in Asia to the west and south-west of Iran.

ext.ext_cn: 这表明英国中产阶级不再相信托利党人。
ext.ext_en: This shows that the people of Middle England no longer trust the Tories.

defs.def_en: Journalists use Middle England to refer to middle class people in England who are believed not to like change.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 阴暗的;幽暗的;被阴影笼罩的

ext.ext_cn: 我躲在一个阴暗的角落里观察他。
ext.ext_en: I watched him from a shadowy corner.

ext.ext_cn: 一间宽敞阴暗的房间
ext.ext_en: ...a broad, shadowy room.

defs.def_en: A shadowy place is dark or full of shadows.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 灰白的墙上映出一个高大而模糊的人影
ext.ext_en: ...a tall, shadowy figure silhouetted against the pale wall.

ext.ext_cn: 装满木材的巨大驳船的模糊轮廓
ext.ext_en: ...the shadowy shape of a big barge loaded with logs.

defs.def_en: A shadowy figure or shape is someone or something that you can hardly see because they are in a dark place.

defs.def_cn: 鲜为人知的;神秘莫测的

ext.ext_cn: 间谍的神秘世界
ext.ext_en: ...the shadowy world of spies.

ext.ext_cn: 一个自称为“人民军队”的神秘组织
ext.ext_en: ...a shadowy group calling itself the People's Army.

defs.def_en: You describe activities and people as shadowy when very little is known about them.

ext.ext_cn: 杀戮异常残暴。那些犯下如此暴行的人都应该受到审判和惩罚。
ext.ext_en: The killing was cold-blooded, and those who committed this atrocity should be tried and punished.

defs.def_en: An atrocity is a very cruel, shocking action.

defs.def_cn: 专责工作员；主要负责人
defs.def_en: The keyworker for a particular group of clients or patients is the person who works with them most closely and has most responsibility for them.

defs.def_cn: 说明，表示，证明（某事属实）

ext.ext_cn: 警方记录证明他有长期从事暴力活动的前科。
ext.ext_en: Police records attest to his long history of violence...

ext.ext_cn: 感冒和流感季节来了，对此我有切身体会。
ext.ext_en: I can personally attest that the cold and flu season is here...

defs.def_en: To attest something or attest to something means to say, show, or prove that it is true.

defs.def_cn: (活动或状态的)恢复，重新开始，复兴

ext.ext_cn: 他们将讨论恢复外交关系的可能性。
ext.ext_en: They will discuss the possible renewal of diplomatic relations...

ext.ext_cn: 他真的在考虑在这个阶段恢复敌对状态吗？
ext.ext_en: Is he really considering a renewal of hostilities at this stage?

defs.def_en: If there is a renewal of an activity or a situation, it starts again.

ext.ext_cn: 他的合同该续签了。
ext.ext_en: His contract came up for renewal...

ext.ext_cn: 保险费用需在14天的续约期内交到此办公室。
ext.ext_en: The premium should be received in this office within fourteen days of the renewal date.

defs.def_en: The renewal of a document such as a licence or a contract is an official increase in the period of time for which it remains valid.

ext.ext_cn: 城市改造和重建
ext.ext_en: ...urban renewal and regeneration...

ext.ext_cn: 现在是春天，万物重生的季节。
ext.ext_en: Now it is spring, a time of renewal.

defs.def_en: Renewal of something lost, dead, or destroyed is the process of it growing again or being replaced.

defs.def_cn: 码（长度单位，等于36英寸或约91.4厘米）

ext.ext_cn: 事件发生在距他所站位置大约500码远的地方。
ext.ext_en: The incident took place about 500 yards from where he was standing...

ext.ext_cn: 几码之外，乔斯·瓦尔加斯站在他的小房子旁边。
ext.ext_en: A few yards away, Jos Vargas stands beside his small home.

defs.def_en: A yard is a unit of length equal to thirty-six inches or approximately 91.4 centimetres.

ext.ext_cn: 我看到他站在院子里。
ext.ext_en: I saw him standing in the yard.

defs.def_en: A yard is a flat area of concrete or stone that is next to a building and often has a wall around it.

defs.def_cn: （进行某项作业的）区域，场地，工场

ext.ext_cn: 铁路调车场
ext.ext_en: ...a railway yard.

ext.ext_cn: 船舶修理场
ext.ext_en: ...a ship repair yard.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a large open area where a particular type of work is done as a yard.

ext.ext_cn: 我出生的时候，他在埃杰顿大街我们家的园圃里挖了个坑，种了棵枫树。
ext.ext_en: He dug a hole in our yard on Edgerton Avenue to plant a maple tree when I was born.

defs.def_en: A yard is a piece of land next to someone's house, with grass and plants growing in it.

ext.ext_cn: 一套完备的急救用品
ext.ext_en: ...a well-stocked first aid kit...

ext.ext_cn: 整套工具包括大约20种化妆用品和一个女士褪毛器。
ext.ext_en: The kit consisted of about twenty cosmetic items and a lady's shaver.

defs.def_en: A kit is a group of items that are kept together, often in the same container, because they are all used for similar purposes.

defs.def_cn: （尤指某运动的）全套衣服和装备

ext.ext_cn: 我忘带健身用品了。
ext.ext_en: I forgot my gym kit.

defs.def_en: Kit is special clothing and equipment that you use when you take part in a particular activity, especially a sport.

ext.ext_cn: 她那广受欢迎的防烫布垫也可以自己购买原料套装自己制作。
ext.ext_en: Her popular pot holder is also available in do-it-yourself kits.

defs.def_en: A kit is a set of parts that can be put together in order to make something.

defs.def_cn: 脱掉所有衣服/不脱掉所有衣服

ext.ext_cn: 我不喜欢在银幕上表演裸戏。
ext.ext_en: I don't like taking my kit off on screen...

ext.ext_cn: 回首50年代，那时社会习俗要求男模不能脱掉所有衣服。
ext.ext_en: Back in the Fifties, social convention required that males models keep their kit on.

defs.def_en: If someone gets their kit off or takes their kit off, they take off all their clothes. If they keep their kit on, they do not take off all their clothes, even though people may be expecting them to.

ext.ext_cn: 若想获得预防犯罪方面的帮助，请拨打我们的24小时咨询热线。
ext.ext_en: For help on crime prevention, call our 24-hour advice line.

defs.def_en: An advice line is a service that you can telephone in order to get advice about something.

defs.def_cn: 推销商品用语;商品宣传语

ext.ext_cn: 他的推销词流畅又有说服力。
ext.ext_en: His sales pitch was smooth and convincing.

defs.def_en: A salesperson's sales pitch is what they say in order to persuade someone to buy something from them.

defs.def_cn: 不可能错的;不会犯错误的;永无过失的

ext.ext_cn: 尽管他经验丰富,却并非不会出错。
ext.ext_en: Although he was experienced, he was not infallible...

ext.ext_cn: 在时尚方面她的眼光错不了。
ext.ext_en: She had an infallible eye for style.

defs.def_en: If a person or thing is infallible, they are never wrong.

defs.def_cn: 地球村（指整个世界由电子通信设施，尤其是因特网连接为一个社会）

ext.ext_cn: 既然我们都是地球村的一部分，大家都成了邻居。
ext.ext_en: Now that we are all part of the global village, everyone becomes a neighbour.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to the world as a global village when they want to emphasize that all the different parts of the world form one community linked together by electronic communications, especially the Internet.
BSE is a disease which affects the nervous system of cattle and kills them. BSE is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'bovine spongiform encephalopathy'.

ext.ext_cn: 我们必须努力和我们自己及周围的人和睦相处。
ext.ext_en: We must try to live in peace and harmony with ourselves and those around us...

ext.ext_cn: 他把自己标榜成民族团结与和睦的捍卫者。
ext.ext_en: He projected himself as the protector of national unity and harmony.

defs.def_en: If people are living in harmony with each other, they are living together peacefully rather than fighting or arguing.

ext.ext_cn: 复杂的声乐和声
ext.ext_en: ...complex vocal harmonies.

ext.ext_cn: 和声演唱
ext.ext_en: ...singing in harmony.

defs.def_en: Harmony is the pleasant combination of different notes of music played at the same time.

defs.def_cn: （各组成部分的）协调，和谐，调和

ext.ext_cn: 宇宙的有序和谐
ext.ext_en: ...the ordered harmony of the universe...

ext.ext_cn: 他看起来放松了些，仿佛周围的和谐环境感染了他。
ext.ext_en: He looked more relaxed, as if some of the harmony from his surroundings had flowed into him.

defs.def_en: The harmony of something is the way in which its parts are combined into a pleasant arrangement.

ext.ext_cn: 我建议你告诉他，他应该及早预订。
ext.ext_en: I suggest you tell him there was a mistake over his late booking.

defs.def_en: A booking is the arrangement that you make when you book something such as a hotel room, a table at a restaurant, a theatre seat, or a place on public transport.

defs.def_cn: 永动（理论）（认为物体可以不获取任何能量而永远运动下去）
defs.def_en: The idea of perpetual motion is the idea of something continuing to move for ever without getting energy from anything else.

defs.def_cn: （尤指前期不努力之后）开始努力工作（或学习）

ext.ext_cn: 唯一能做的就是开始努力工作，好好干出点儿成绩来。
ext.ext_en: The only thing to do was knuckle down and get on with some serious hard work...

ext.ext_cn: 他在离考试还有足够长时间的时候就开始认真学习，从而通过了考试。
ext.ext_en: He managed to knuckle down to his lessons long enough to pass his examination.

defs.def_en: If someone knuckles down, they begin to work or study very hard, especially after a period when they have done very little work.

ext.ext_cn: 特大剪刀
ext.ext_en: ...an outsize pair of scissors...

ext.ext_cn: 一幅巨大的照片挂在她卧室的壁炉上方。
ext.ext_en: An outsized photograph hung above her bedroom fireplace.

defs.def_en: Outsize or outsized things are much larger than usual or much larger than you would expect.

ext.ext_cn: 超大号服装常常质地较差，而且看上去好似丑陋的帐篷。
ext.ext_en: Often outsize clothes are made from cheap fabric and look like ugly tents.

defs.def_en: Outsize clothes are clothes for very large people.
A remould is an old tyre which has been given a new surface or tread and can be used again.

ext.ext_cn: 重塑工党形象举措的新阶段
ext.ext_en: ...a new phase in the attempt to remould Labour's image.

defs.def_en: To remould something such as an idea or an economy means to change it so that it has a new structure or is based on new principles.
Sound effects are the sounds that are created artificially to make a play more realistic, especially a radio play.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 1986年的印度之行给我留下了难忘的印象。
ext.ext_en: My visit to India in 1986 left an indelible impression on me...

ext.ext_cn: 战争给世人留下了不可磨灭的印记。
ext.ext_en: The war has made an indelible mark on the world.

defs.def_en: If you say that something leaves an indelible impression, you mean that it is very unlikely to be forgotten.

defs.def_cn: 难以去除的;洗不掉的;擦不掉的

ext.ext_cn: 它会在衣物上留下洗不掉的污渍。
ext.ext_en: It leaves indelible stains on clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 用不褪色墨水写就
ext.ext_en: ...written in indelible ink.

defs.def_en: Indelible ink or an indelible stain cannot be removed or washed out.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 英勇的中士冒着生命危险从熊熊燃烧着的拖网渔船上救出了29名渔民。
ext.ext_en: The heroic sergeant risked his life to rescue 29 fishermen from their blazing trawler...

ext.ext_cn: 他的英雄事迹在印度广为传颂。
ext.ext_en: His heroic deeds were celebrated in every corner of India.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person or their actions as heroic, you admire them because they show extreme bravery.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 矢志不渝的;艰苦卓绝的

ext.ext_cn: 公司在降低成本方面付出了艰苦卓绝的努力。
ext.ext_en: The company has made heroic efforts at cost reduction...

ext.ext_cn: 他在这场艰苦比赛的最后一局中踉跄结束。
ext.ext_en: He finally faltered in the last game of a heroic match...

defs.def_en: If you describe an action or event as heroic, you admire it because it involves great effort or determination to succeed.

ext.ext_cn: 书中的中心主角人物
ext.ext_en: ...the book's central, heroic figure.

defs.def_en: Heroic means being or relating to the hero of a story.

defs.def_cn: 英雄壮举;英勇果断的行为

ext.ext_cn: 以空中的英雄壮举拯救了直升机飞行员的人
ext.ext_en: ...the man whose aerial heroics helped save the helicopter pilot...

ext.ext_cn: 英格兰队此刻需要队长采取英勇果断的行为。
ext.ext_en: England need heroics from the captain now.

defs.def_en: Heroics are actions involving bravery, courage, or determination.

ext.ext_cn: 他说自己的建议是：“不要逞英雄，要遵纪守法。”
ext.ext_en: He said his advice was: 'No heroics, stay within the law'...

ext.ext_cn: 住手吧，佩里。你已经逞过英雄了。现在一切都结束了。
ext.ext_en: Cut it out, Perry. You've performed your heroics. It's all over now.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's actions or plans as heroics, you think that they are foolish or dangerous because they are too difficult or brave for the situation in which they occur.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 西蒙为人头脑冷静，讲求实际。
ext.ext_en: Simon is level-headed and practical...

ext.ext_cn: 他这人沉稳冷静，会见机行事的。
ext.ext_en: His level-headed approach suggests he will do what is necessary.

defs.def_en: If you describe a person as level-headed, you mean that they are calm and sensible even in difficult situations.
Bone meal is a substance made from animal bones which is used as a fertilizer.

ext.ext_cn: 文学经典
ext.ext_en: ...classic works of literature.

ext.ext_cn: 英国文学教授
ext.ext_en: ...a Professor of English Literature...

defs.def_en: Novels, plays, and poetry are referred to as literature, especially when they are considered to be good or important.

defs.def_cn: （某一学科的）著述，文献，图书资料

ext.ext_cn: 关于移民政策方面的著述几乎总是会一成不变地批评政府。
ext.ext_en: The literature on immigration policy is almost unrelievedly critical of the state...

ext.ext_cn: 这一著作被列为科学文献。
ext.ext_en: This work is documented in the scientific literature.

defs.def_en: The literature on a particular subject of study is all the books and articles that have been published about it.

ext.ext_cn: 我把另外两家提供类似服务的公司的宣传资料发给你。
ext.ext_en: I am sending you literature from two other companies that provide a similar service...

ext.ext_cn: 一些公司已降低了宣传资料中标榜之词的调门。
ext.ext_en: Some companies have toned down the claims on their promotional literature.

defs.def_en: Literature is written information produced by people who want to sell you something or give you advice.

ext.ext_cn: 他们有3个孩子。
ext.ext_en: They've got three kids...

ext.ext_cn: 我们班所有的孩子都能阅读。
ext.ext_en: All the kids in my class could read.

defs.def_en: You can refer to a child as a kid .

ext.ext_cn: 过去有成群结队的年轻人骑着摩托车四处游荡。
ext.ext_en: There were gangs of kids on motorbikes roaming around...

ext.ext_cn: 那对一个22岁的年轻人来说是够难应付的。
ext.ext_en: That's a lot for a kid of 22 to cope with.

defs.def_en: Young people who are no longer children are sometimes referred to as kids .

ext.ext_cn: 我妹妹醒了，哭了起来。
ext.ext_en: My kid sister woke up and started crying.

defs.def_en: You can refer to your younger brother as your kid brother and your younger sister as your kid sister.
A kid is a young goat.

ext.ext_cn: 我没有开玩笑，弗兰克。外面有一头母牛，就站在附近。
ext.ext_en: I'm not kidding, Frank. There's a cow out there, just standing around...

ext.ext_cn: 我只是开玩笑。
ext.ext_en: I'm just kidding...

defs.def_en: If you are kidding, you are saying something that is not really true, as a joke.

ext.ext_cn: 他很喜欢捉弄英格丽德。
ext.ext_en: He liked to kid Ingrid a lot...

ext.ext_cn: 他过去常取笑我胖。
ext.ext_en: He used to kid me about being chubby.

defs.def_en: If you kid someone, you tease them.

ext.ext_cn: 我们在自己骗自己，比尔。我们没有赢，我们甚至都没有发挥好。
ext.ext_en: We're kidding ourselves, Bill. We're not winning, we're not even doing well...

ext.ext_cn: 我可以欺骗自己你这样做是为了我，但那终究是谎言。
ext.ext_en: I could kid myself that you did this for me, but it would be a lie.

defs.def_en: If people kid themselves, they allow themselves to believe something that is not true because they wish that it was true.

defs.def_cn: （强调所说的是真实的或是认真的）真的，不是开玩笑

ext.ext_cn: 我很害怕。不是开玩笑，真的。
ext.ext_en: I'm scared. No kidding, really.

defs.def_en: You can say 'No kidding' to emphasize that what you are saying is true, or that you mean it.

ext.ext_cn: “我们赢了。”——“真的吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'We won.' — 'No kidding?'

defs.def_en: You can say 'No kidding?' to show that you are interested or surprised when someone tells you something.

defs.def_cn: （表示认为某人所言极为荒唐或完全是假的）你一定是在开玩笑

ext.ext_cn: 你在开玩笑吧！我不可能住这儿！
ext.ext_en: You've got to be kidding! I can't live here!...

ext.ext_cn: “他是个温和、没有恶意的人，不是吗？”——“啊，你不是开玩笑吧。”
ext.ext_en: 'He's a mild inoffensive man isn't he? — Oh you've gotta be kidding.'

defs.def_en: You can say 'you've got to be kidding' or 'you must be kidding' to someone if they have said something that you think is ridiculous or completely untrue.

defs.def_cn: （表示认为某人不够真诚或不相信某人所言）她骗谁啊？/他想骗谁啊?

ext.ext_cn: 她装作一个温顺、天真、害羞的女孩。真不知道她想骗谁。
ext.ext_en: She played the role of a meek, innocent, shy girl. I don't know who she was trying to kid...

ext.ext_cn: “也许明天会更好，”我说着挂断了电话。“我在骗谁啊？”我对沃尔夫说。“明天还是一个样。”
ext.ext_en: 'Maybe tomorrow will be better,' I said, hanging up. 'Who am I kidding?' I told Wolfe. 'Tomorrow will be more of the same.'

defs.def_en: You can say 'who is she kidding?' or 'who is he trying to kid?' if you think it is obvious that someone is not being sincere and does not mean what they say.

ext.ext_cn: 马克所热衷的孩子气的泼水和打闹
ext.ext_en: ...the childish splashing and horseplay Mark indulged in.

defs.def_en: Horseplay is rough play in which people push and hit each other, or behave in a silly way.

defs.def_cn: (置于括号中，注于某看似古怪或拼写有误的单词或词组后)原文如此，故意如此

ext.ext_cn: 最新的学校兼职工作版面上有广告登着“各种六年级课程”(range 误拼为 rnage，原文如此)。
ext.ext_en: The latest school jobs page advertises a 'wide rnage (sic) of 6th form courses.'

defs.def_en: You write sic in brackets after a word or expression when you want to indicate to the reader that although the word looks odd or wrong, you intended to write it like that or the original writer wrote it like that.

defs.def_cn: 牙仙（传说中如果儿童把脱落的牙齿放在枕下，牙仙会在他们睡着时把牙齿取走，留下硬币）
defs.def_en: The tooth fairy is an imaginary creature. Children are told that if they put a tooth that comes out under their pillow, the tooth fairy will take it away while they are sleeping and leave a coin in its place.
If you call someone a swine, you dislike them or think that they are a bad person, usually because they have behaved unpleasantly towards you.

ext.ext_cn: 从加拿大进口的活猪
ext.ext_en: ...imports of live swine from Canada.

ext.ext_cn: 患猪瘟的猪
ext.ext_en: ...pigs with swine fever.

defs.def_en: A swine is a pig.  to cast pearls before swine→see: pearl;

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 过分严肃的;夸张的;小题大做的

ext.ext_cn: 简问：“你难道不觉得自己有些太夸张了吗？”
ext.ext_en: 'Don't you think you're being rather melodramatic?' Jane asked...

ext.ext_cn: 她一下子摆出一副筋疲力尽的夸张姿势。
ext.ext_en: She'd flung herself in a pose of melodramatic exhaustion.

defs.def_en: Melodramatic behaviour is behaviour in which someone treats a situation as much more serious than it really is.

ext.ext_cn: 我们频繁地提到了他的观点。
ext.ext_en: We have referred freely to his ideas...

ext.ext_cn: 乔治花钱大手大脚。
ext.ext_en: George was spending very freely.

defs.def_en: Freely means many times or in large quantities.

ext.ext_cn: 她不知道他是否有可以倾心交谈的对象。
ext.ext_en: She wondered whether he had someone to whom he could talk freely.

defs.def_en: If you can talk freely, you can talk without needing to be careful about what you say.

ext.ext_cn: 丹尼十分乐意地和所有感兴趣的人分享他的知识。
ext.ext_en: Danny shared his knowledge freely with anyone interested...

ext.ext_cn: 威廉斯坦承他为赛车而活。
ext.ext_en: Williams freely admits he lives for racing.

defs.def_en: If someone gives or does something freely, they give or do it willingly, without being ordered or forced to do it.

ext.ext_cn: 红土网球场很滑，他不能自如地移动。
ext.ext_en: The clay court was slippery and he was unable to move freely...

ext.ext_cn: 必须让杆头一气呵成地挥出。
ext.ext_en: You must allow the clubhead to swing freely.

defs.def_en: See also:free;If something or someone moves freely, they move easily and smoothly, without any obstacles or resistance.

ext.ext_cn: 一个骑着灰马的小个子男人出现了。
ext.ext_en: A small man on a grey horse had appeared.

defs.def_en: A horse is a large animal which people can ride. Some horses are used for pulling ploughs and carts.

ext.ext_cn: 他仍然喜欢赌马。
ext.ext_en: He still likes to bet on the horses.

defs.def_en: When you talk about the horses, you mean horse races in which people bet money on the horse which they think will win.
A vaulting horse is a tall piece of gymnastics equipment for jumping over.

defs.def_cn: 从知情人那里直接（获悉）

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 糟糕透顶的;无可救药的;极坏的

ext.ext_cn: 我不开车，公共汽车条件又太糟糕。
ext.ext_en: I don't drive and the buses are quite hopeless...

ext.ext_cn: 阿根廷的经济政策糟得一塌糊涂。
ext.ext_en: Argentina's economic policies were a hopeless mess.

defs.def_en: You use hopeless to emphasize how bad or inadequate something or someone is.

defs.def_cn: 估价员;（资产）评估师;估税员
defs.def_en: An assessor is a person who is employed to calculate the value of something, or the amount of money that should be paid, for example in tax.

defs.def_cn: 专家;（尤指法庭的）陪审推事，顾问

ext.ext_cn: 两名法官和六名大众陪审推事判决怀特终身监禁。
ext.ext_en: Two judges and six lay assessors sentenced White to life in prison.

defs.def_en: An assessor is a person who is an expert in a subject, especially someone asked to advise a court of law on that subject.

defs.def_cn: （考试、面试、体育赛事等的）评分者，评委

ext.ext_cn: 普通中等教育证书考试结果的外请评分者
ext.ext_en: ...external assessors of GCSE exam results.

defs.def_en: An assessor is a person who judges the performance of someone else, for example in an exam, at an interview or at a sporting event.

ext.ext_cn: 这人一定是疯了，居然去冒这种风险。
ext.ext_en: The man must be bonkers to take such a risk...

ext.ext_cn: 挫败感让我几近疯狂。
ext.ext_en: I nearly went bonkers with frustration.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is bonkers, you mean that they are silly or act in a crazy way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 极其严重的；令人担忧的

ext.ext_cn: 失去它们将会是对我们工程行业的一个沉重打击。
ext.ext_en: Their loss would be a grievous blow to our engineering industries...

ext.ext_cn: 莫里斯先生说遇难者因为一个极其严重的失误而遭遇不幸。
ext.ext_en: Mr Morris said the victims had suffered from a very grievous mistake.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as a loss as grievous, you mean that it is extremely serious or worrying in its effects.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 剧烈的；极痛苦的；疼痛难耐的

ext.ext_cn: 尽管身受重伤，他还是活下来了。
ext.ext_en: He survived in spite of suffering grievous injuries.

defs.def_en: A grievous injury to your body is one that causes you great pain and suffering.

defs.def_cn: （织物或砖砌结构上的）人字形图案，鲱骨式图案
defs.def_en: Herringbone is a pattern used in fabrics or brickwork which looks like parallel rows of zigzag lines.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 克制的;冷静的;不动声色的

ext.ext_cn: 在那种情况下，他觉得自己一直非常冷静。
ext.ext_en: In the circumstances he felt he'd been very restrained...

ext.ext_cn: 莉薇觉得卡罗琳的问候似乎有些不冷不热。
ext.ext_en: Livy thought Caroline's greeting seemed a little restrained.

defs.def_en: Someone who is restrained is very calm and unemotional.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (穿着、装饰等)简单的，淡雅的，朴素的

ext.ext_cn: 她的黑色套装简单而昂贵。
ext.ext_en: Her black suit was restrained and expensive.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's clothes or the decorations in a house as restrained, you mean that you like them because they are simple and not too brightly-coloured.

ext.ext_cn: 我从未对他的狡猾和奸诈掉以轻心。
ext.ext_en: His cunning and guile were not attributes I would ever underestimate...

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢孩子的天真无邪。
ext.ext_en: I love children's innocence and lack of guile.

defs.def_en: Guile is the quality of being good at deceiving people in a clever way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 从不锻炼的书呆子们
ext.ext_en: ...nerdy types who never exercise.

ext.ext_cn: 王子可笑的发型
ext.ext_en: ...the Prince's nerdy hairstyle.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as nerdy, you think that they are a nerd or look like a nerd.

ext.ext_cn: 欧洲一体化进程
ext.ext_en: ...the process of general European unification.

defs.def_en: Unification is the process by which two or more countries join together and become one country.
'Howdy' is an informal way of saying 'Hello'.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不引人注目的;不惹人注意的

ext.ext_cn: 我会尽量不惹人注意。
ext.ext_en: I'll try to be as inconspicuous as possible...

ext.ext_cn: 他已骑车出了剑桥,淹没在几百名年轻的自行车手当中。
ext.ext_en: He had ridden out of Cambridge, inconspicuous among the hundreds of young cyclists.

defs.def_en: Someone who is inconspicuous does not attract attention to themselves.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不显眼的灰色建筑
ext.ext_en: ...an inconspicuous grey building.

defs.def_en: Something that is inconspicuous is not easily seen or does not attract attention because it is small, ordinary, or hidden away.
A statue is a large sculpture of a person or an animal, made of stone or metal.

ext.ext_cn: 古典芭蕾僵化的形式主义
ext.ext_en: ...the rigid formalism of classical ballet.

defs.def_en: Formalism is a style, especially in art, in which great attention is paid to the outward form or appearance rather than to the inner reality or significance of things.

ext.ext_cn: 我有很多失业的朋友。
ext.ext_en: I've got loads of friends who're unemployed...

ext.ext_cn: 你要跟谁一起去电影院？
ext.ext_en: Who're you going to the pictures with?

defs.def_en: Who're is a spoken form of 'who are'.
A record player is a machine on which you can play a record in order to listen to the music or other sounds on it.
Tins, trays, and dishes that are used for baking can be referred to as bakeware .
A carp is a kind of fish that lives in lakes and rivers.

ext.ext_cn: 他不明白为什么她总是找他的茬儿。
ext.ext_en: He cannot understand why she's constantly carping at him...

ext.ext_cn: 这就是老被其他教练挑毛病的那个人。
ext.ext_en: This was the man whom other trainers love to carp about.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is carping, you mean that they keep criticizing or complaining about someone or something, especially in a way you think is unnecessary or annoying.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (礼貌、诙谐的说法)（男子）阳具硕大的
defs.def_en: If someone says that a man is well-hung, they are saying in a polite or humorous way that he has a large penis.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他父亲的面容忽然温和起来，充满了忧伤。
ext.ext_en: His father's face looked suddenly soft and sorrowful...

ext.ext_cn: 罗伊用简单的、人人都能理解的语言讲述了他那个伤感的故事。
ext.ext_en: Roy told his sorrowful tale with simple words anybody could understand.

defs.def_en: Sorrowful means very sad.

defs.def_cn: (尤指减肥时代替食糖使用的)糖精
defs.def_en: Saccharin is a very sweet chemical substance that some people use instead of sugar, especially when they are trying to lose weight.
A peddler is someone who goes from place to place in order to sell something.
A drug peddler is a person who sells illegal drugs.

defs.def_cn: （思想或信息的）宣扬者，散布者

ext.ext_cn: 恐惧的散布者
ext.ext_en: ...the peddlers of fear.

defs.def_en: A peddler of information or ideas is someone who frequently expresses such ideas to other people.

ext.ext_cn: 埃玛掰了一块脆饼干给正在出牙的贾辛塔。
ext.ext_en: Emma broke off a bit of rusk and gave it to Jacinta, who was teething...

ext.ext_cn: 春黄菊长期以来一直用作减轻婴儿出牙时的不适的药物。
ext.ext_en: Camomile has long been used as a remedy for teething babies.

defs.def_en: When babies are teething, their teeth are starting to appear through their gums, often causing them pain.

ext.ext_cn: 虽然邦德遭遇的诡计层出不穷，但最后却总能脱离险境，令人惊叹。
ext.ext_en: It seems astonishing that Bond got away with so much jiggery-pokery for as long as he did.

defs.def_en: If you describe behaviour as jiggery-pokery, you mean that it involves tricking people or being dishonest.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 人手短缺的;人员不足的

ext.ext_cn: 这所医院人手极为短缺。
ext.ext_en: The hospital is desperately short-staffed.

defs.def_en: A company or place that is short-staffed does not have enough people working there.

ext.ext_cn: 我俩的黑白合影
ext.ext_en: ...a black-and-white photo of the two of us together.

ext.ext_cn: 老黑白电影胶片
ext.ext_en: ...old black and white film footage...

defs.def_en: In a black and white photograph or film, everything is shown in black, white, and grey.
A black and white television set shows only black-and-white pictures.

defs.def_cn: 简单明了的；容易判别的；泾渭分明的

ext.ext_cn: 但这不是一个非黑即白的问题，玛丽安娜。
ext.ext_en: But this isn't  a simple black and white affair, Marianne...

ext.ext_cn: 她总是用简单绝对的眼光看待事物。
ext.ext_en: She saw things in black and white.

defs.def_en: A black and white issue or situation is one which involves issues which seem simple and therefore easy to make decisions about.

ext.ext_cn: 他已经看过书面证据。
ext.ext_en: He'd seen the proof in black and white...

ext.ext_cn: 也许你不想看有关道格死亡的书面材料。
ext.ext_en: Maybe you don't want to read about Doug's death in black and white.

defs.def_en: You say that something is in black and white when it has been written or printed, and not just said.
A barber shop is a shop where a barber works.
Botanic means the same as botanical .

defs.def_cn: 氟硝西泮，罗眠乐（使人处于半昏迷状态的迷幻药）
defs.def_en: Rohypnol is a powerful drug that makes a person semiconscious.
Mononucleosis is a disease which causes swollen glands, fever, and a sore throat.

defs.def_cn: 不可改变的;不可推翻的

ext.ext_cn: 最好等到更合适的时候再作出不能反悔的承诺。
ext.ext_en: It may well be worth waiting for better times before making any irrevocable commitment...

ext.ext_cn: 他说这项决定是不可改变的。
ext.ext_en: He said the decision was irrevocable.

defs.def_en: If a decision, action, or change is irrevocable, it cannot be changed or reversed.

ext.ext_cn: 他把衣服挂在门口的晾衣绳上晾干。
ext.ext_en: He hung his clothes out to dry on the clothesline across the doorway.

defs.def_en: A clothesline is a thin rope on which you hang washing so that it can dry.
Eyeliner is a special kind of pencil which some women use on the edges of their eyelids next to their eyelashes in order to look more attractive.

defs.pos_cn: 与形容词，可数名词构成的词
defs.def_cn: (用于动词前构成形容词和名词)表示“必须（要看、拥有、要读）的”，“必须…之物”

ext.ext_cn: 皮革牛仔裤是这一季必备的时尚服饰。
ext.ext_en: Leather jeans are the must-have fashion item of the season.

ext.ext_cn: 必看电影一览表
ext.ext_en: ...a list of must-see movies...

defs.def_en: Must- is added to verbs such as 'see', 'have', or 'read' to form adjectives and nouns which describe things that you think people should see, have, or read. For example, a must-have is something which you think people should get, and a must-win game is one which a team needs to win.

ext.ext_cn: 我们这群小孩叫她Oma，两个音节都重读。
ext.ext_en: We children called her Oma, accenting both syllables.

defs.def_en: A syllable is a part of a word that contains a single vowel sound and that is pronounced as a unit. So, for example, 'book' has one syllable, and 'reading' has two syllables.

ext.ext_cn: 这起谋杀引起了国际社会的强烈抗议。
ext.ext_en: The killing caused an international outcry...

ext.ext_cn: 反堕胎人士公开大声抗议。
ext.ext_en: There was public outcry from those opposed to abortion.

defs.def_en: An outcry is a reaction of strong disapproval and anger shown by the public or media about a recent event.
A discounter is a shop or organization which specializes in selling things very cheaply. Discounters usually sell things in large quantities, or offer only a very limited range of goods.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他在私生活方面的不检点是出了名的。
ext.ext_en: He is notoriously indiscreet about his private life...

ext.ext_cn: 他曾轻率地说过什么吗？
ext.ext_en: Had he been indiscreet in what he had said?

defs.def_en: If you describe someone as indiscreet, you mean that they do or say things in public which they should only do or say secretly or in private.

ext.ext_cn: 他21岁时突患致残重疾。
ext.ext_en: He was stricken at twenty-one with a crippling malady.

defs.def_en: A malady is an illness or disease.

defs.def_cn: (书面语中，指社会、环境等的)严重问题，弊病，弊端

ext.ext_cn: 废除了种族隔离政策后痼疾依然存在。
ext.ext_en: When apartheid is over the maladies will linger on.

ext.ext_cn: 爱情的弊端
ext.ext_en: ...the maladies of love.

defs.def_en: In written English, people sometimes use maladies to refer to serious problems in a society or situation.
A resistor is a device which is designed to increase the ability of an electric circuit to stop the flow of an electric current through it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不能保证这些数据的准确性。
ext.ext_en: We cannot guarantee the accuracy of these figures.

defs.def_en: The accuracy of information or measurements is their quality of being true or correct, even in small details.

ext.ext_cn: 能准确无误地击中3,000码以外目标的武器
ext.ext_en: ...weapons that could fire with accuracy at targets 3,000 yards away...

ext.ext_cn: 每家银行都非常关注雇员的工作速度和无差错率。
ext.ext_en: Every bank pays close attention to the speed and accuracy of its staff.

defs.def_en: If someone or something performs a task, for example hitting a target, with accuracy, they do it in an exact way without making a mistake.
A bursary is a sum of money which is given to someone to allow them to study in a college or university.

defs.def_cn: (用于构成形容词)表示“…语调的”，“…口音的”

ext.ext_cn: “巡佐,我想和您说句话,”新来的人用悦耳的男中音说道。
ext.ext_en: 'Sergeant, I should like a word with you,' said the newcomer, in a pleasantly-inflected baritone.

defs.def_en: -inflected is used to form adjectives describing someone's voice or accent.

defs.def_cn: (用于构成形容词)表示“(音乐或表演)…风格的”

ext.ext_cn: 他那种充满爆发力的、福音音乐式的演唱风格
ext.ext_en: ...his attacking, gospel-inflected vocal style.

defs.def_en: -inflected is used to form adjectives describing the style of a piece of music or a performance.
A flatbed is a truck that has a long flat platform with no sides.
A love nest is a house or flat where two people who are having a love affair live or meet.

ext.ext_cn: 盐晶体
ext.ext_en: ...salt crystals.

ext.ext_cn: 冰晶
ext.ext_en: ...ice crystals.

defs.def_en: See also:liquid crystal;liquid crystal display;A crystal is a small piece of a substance that has formed naturally into a regular symmetrical shape.

ext.ext_cn: 一串水晶珠子
ext.ext_en: ...a strand of crystal beads.

defs.def_en: Crystal is a transparent rock that is used to make jewellery and ornaments.

ext.ext_cn: 一些最高档的酒杯是用铅晶质玻璃制成的。
ext.ext_en: Some of the finest drinking glasses are made from lead crystal.

ext.ext_cn: 水晶玻璃杯
ext.ext_en: ...crystal glasses.

defs.def_en: Crystal is a high quality glass, usually with patterns cut into its surface.

defs.def_cn: 水晶玻璃杯;水晶玻璃容器

ext.ext_cn: 拿出你最好的瓷器和水晶玻璃器皿。
ext.ext_en: Get out your best china and crystal.

defs.def_en: Glasses and other containers made of crystal are referred to as crystal .

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他总是这样傻傻地咧嘴笑。
ext.ext_en: He always had this inane grin...

ext.ext_cn: 她开始问我愚蠢的问题。
ext.ext_en: She started asking me inane questions.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone's behaviour or actions as inane, you think they are very silly or stupid.

ext.ext_cn: 一双忧郁的灰眼睛，眼睫毛长得出奇
ext.ext_en: ...sombre grey eyes, with unusually long lashes...

ext.ext_cn: 乔安娜眯着眼睛打量他。
ext.ext_en: Joanna studied him through her lashes.

defs.def_en: Your lashes are the hairs that grow on the edge of your upper and lower eyelids.

ext.ext_cn: 把锚系到栏杆上拴牢。
ext.ext_en: Secure the anchor by lashing it to the rail...

ext.ext_cn: 把杆子扎成一个穹顶小棚就成了遮蔽所。
ext.ext_en: The shelter is built by lashing poles together to form a small dome...

defs.def_en: If you lash two or more things together, you tie one of them firmly to the other.

ext.ext_cn: 本世纪最恶劣的冬季暴风雪横扫北美东海岸。
ext.ext_en: The worst winter storms of the century lashed the east coast of North America...

ext.ext_cn: 蓦地，大雨猛烈地抽打在窗户上。
ext.ext_en: Suddenly rain lashed against the windows...

defs.def_en: If wind, rain, or water lashes someone or something, it hits them violently.

ext.ext_cn: 她沉默片刻，寻思着抨击他的话语。
ext.ext_en: She went quiet for a moment while she summoned up the words to lash him...

ext.ext_cn: 该报告严斥警局指挥官没有根据情报采取行动。
ext.ext_en: The report lashes into police commanders for failing to act on intelligence information.

defs.def_en: If someone lashes you or lashes into you, they speak very angrily to you, criticizing you or saying you have done something wrong.
A lash is a thin strip of leather at the end of a whip.

defs.def_cn: （尤指作为惩罚抽在背部的）鞭打

ext.ext_cn: 村民们裁定将一名偷邻居火腿的男子鞭打5下。
ext.ext_en: The villagers sentenced one man to five lashes for stealing a ham from his neighbor.

defs.def_en: A lash is a blow with a whip, especially a blow on someone's back as a punishment.

ext.ext_cn: 他们抓起鞭子，朝跌倒的人背上抽去。
ext.ext_en: They snatched up whips and lashed the backs of those who had fallen.

defs.def_en: If someone lashes another person, they hit that person with a whip.

ext.ext_cn: 遇有危险，食蚁兽会迅速用尾巴卷住树枝。
ext.ext_en: When in danger, the anteater lashes its tail round a branch...

ext.ext_cn: 他们试图把鱼叉刺进鳐鱼体内，以防它猛摆那蜇人的尾巴报复。
ext.ext_en: They tried to get the harpoon into the ray before the sting tail came lashing over to retaliate...

defs.def_en: If an animal lashes its tail, or if its tail lashes, it moves its tail very fast and violently.
Radium is a radioactive element which is used in the treatment of cancer.

defs.def_cn: 变卦;取消诺言;打退堂鼓

ext.ext_cn: 她接受了巴伦一起去看比赛的邀请，但她感冒了，最后不得不取消约定。
ext.ext_en: Barron invited her to the races and she agreed, but she caught flu and had to cry off at the last minute.

defs.def_en: If you cry off, you tell someone that you cannot do something that you have agreed or arranged to do.
Foie gras is a food made from the livers of geese that were specially fed so that their livers became very large.

defs.def_cn: (艺术、食品、酒等的)鉴赏家，鉴定家，行家

ext.ext_cn: 萨拉告诉我你是一位艺术鉴赏家。
ext.ext_en: Sarah tells me you're something of an art connoisseur.

ext.ext_cn: 美食家
ext.ext_en: ...connoisseurs of good food.

defs.def_en: A connoisseur is someone who knows a lot about the arts, food, drink, or some other subject.

ext.ext_cn: 灰色的油毡地面
ext.ext_en: ...a gray linoleum floor.

ext.ext_cn: 黑白相间的油地毡块
ext.ext_en: ...black-and-white squares of linoleum.

defs.def_en: Linoleum is a floor covering which is made of cloth covered with a hard shiny substance.

ext.ext_cn: 现在有些什么娱乐设施？
ext.ext_en: What recreational facilities are now available?...

ext.ext_cn: 问题在于要把病人尽快送至医院。
ext.ext_en: The problem lies in getting patients to a medical facility as soon as possible.

defs.def_en: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose.

defs.def_cn: （组织提供的）附加服务，特色服务;(机器的)功能

ext.ext_cn: 有透支功能用处很大。
ext.ext_en: It is very useful to have an overdraft facility...

ext.ext_cn: 新型号中有一款具备复读和文本复制的功能。
ext.ext_en: One of the new models has the facility to reproduce speech as well as text.

defs.def_en: A facility is something such as an additional service provided by an organization or an extra feature on a machine which is useful but not essential.
