ext.ext_en: Will it be any trouble to get over here that quickly?

defs.def_en: If you tell someone that it is no trouble to do something for them, you are saying politely that you can or will do it, because it is easy or convenient for you.

defs.def_cn: 需劳神费力的人(或动物)

ext.ext_cn: 我的小孙子一点都不让人操心，但是他6岁大的姐姐却野蛮而又自私。
ext.ext_en: My little grandson is no trouble at all, but his 6-year-old elder sister is rude and selfish.

defs.def_en: If you say that a person or animal is no trouble, you mean that they are very easy to look after.

ext.ext_cn: 有什么事情让你烦恼吗？
ext.ext_en: Is anything troubling you?...

ext.ext_cn: 他对儿子的生活方式感到很担心。
ext.ext_en: He was troubled by the lifestyle of his son.

defs.def_en: If something troubles you, it makes you feel rather worried.

ext.ext_cn: 溃疡已经折磨她好几年了。
ext.ext_en: The ulcer had been troubling her for several years.

defs.def_en: If a part of your body troubles you, it causes you physical pain or discomfort.

ext.ext_cn: 他打了个哈欠，都懒得抬抬手遮一下嘴巴。
ext.ext_en: He yawns, not troubling to cover his mouth...

ext.ext_cn: 他都没想要看看后视镜。
ext.ext_en: He hadn't troubled himself to check his mirrors...

defs.def_en: If you say that someone does not trouble to do something, you are critical of them because they do not behave in the way that they should do, and you think that this would require very little effort.

ext.ext_cn: 对不起打扰了，但我想打听一下您是否知道他在哪里。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry to trouble you, but I wondered if by any chance you know where he is...

ext.ext_cn: 我真不愿打扰您，但莉娜阿姨的生日就要到了，我想给她买点好东西。
ext.ext_en: I hate to trouble you, but Aunt Lina's birthday is coming up and I would like to buy something nice for her.

defs.def_en: You use trouble in expressions such as I'm sorry to trouble you when you are apologizing to someone for disturbing them in order to ask them something.

defs.def_cn: 处于困境;惹麻烦;将受惩罚

ext.ext_cn: 老师们都想好好教训他。
ext.ext_en: He was in trouble with his teachers...

ext.ext_cn: 把那笔钱借给我的那个人因此倒霉了。
ext.ext_en: The person who loaned them to me got into terrible trouble for it.

defs.def_en: If someone is in trouble, they are in a situation in which a person in authority is angry with them or is likely to punish them because they have done something wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 值得费点劲用手挑挑果子。
ext.ext_en: It is worth taking the trouble to sieve the fruit by hand…

ext.ext_cn: 他在批评那部电影之前都懒得费神欣赏。
ext.ext_en: He did not take the trouble to see the film before he attacked it.

defs.def_en: If you take the trouble to do something, you do something which requires a small amount of additional effort.

ext.ext_cn: 有人抱怨说根本不值得为约翰逊浪费精力。
ext.ext_en: Some grumbled that Johnson was more trouble than he was worth...

ext.ext_cn: 似乎总是觉得没必要为进一步了解它而大费工夫。
ext.ext_en: Learning more about it always seemed more trouble than it was worth.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something is more trouble than they are worth, you mean that they cause you a lot of problems or take a lot of time and effort and you do not achieve or gain very much in return.

ext.ext_cn: 在该村实行了宵禁。
ext.ext_en: The village was placed under curfew...

ext.ext_cn: 在勒克瑙，成群的人们违抗宵禁令到街上去庆祝。
ext.ext_en: In Lucknow crowds of people defied the curfew to celebrate on the streets.

defs.def_en: A curfew is a law stating that people must stay inside their houses after a particular time at night, for example during a war.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 风靡一时的;流行一时的

ext.ext_cn: 时髦的鞋子
ext.ext_en: ...faddish footwear.

defs.def_en: If you describe something as faddish, you mean that it has no real value and that it will not remain popular for very long.

defs.def_cn: 对…缓期执行，撤销…的刑罚

ext.ext_cn: 因谋杀前首相而即将处以绞刑的14个人已获缓刑。
ext.ext_en: Fourteen people, waiting to be hanged for the murder of a former prime minister, have been reprieved.

ext.ext_cn: 一个即将被执行注射死刑的男子在最后一分钟获得缓刑。
ext.ext_en: A man awaiting death by lethal injection has been saved by a last minute reprieve.

defs.def_en: If someone who has been sentenced in a court is reprieved, their punishment is officially delayed or cancelled.

defs.def_cn: (不好或艰难情况的)暂缓，延缓

ext.ext_cn: 这所大学看起来要关闭了，但这周情况暂时有所缓解。
ext.ext_en: It looked as though the college would have to shut, but this week it was given a reprieve.

defs.def_en: A reprieve is a delay before a very unpleasant or difficult situation which may or may not take place.

ext.ext_cn: 简而言之，业主们认为自己最了解情况。
ext.ext_en: In a nutshell, the owners thought they knew best...

ext.ext_cn: 简言之，这好像就是理查德·查普林所做的一切。
ext.ext_en: This, in a nutshell, is what Richard Chaplin appears to have done.

defs.def_en: You can use in a nutshell to indicate that you are saying something in a very brief way, using few words.
Nightwear is clothing that you wear in bed.
Starlight is the light that comes from the stars at night.

ext.ext_cn: 你怎么学会烘蛋糕的？
ext.ext_en: How did you learn to bake cakes?...

ext.ext_cn: 我喜欢烘烤糕点。
ext.ext_en: I love to bake.

defs.def_en: If you bake, you spend some time preparing and mixing together ingredients to make bread, cakes, pies, or other food which is cooked in the oven.

ext.ext_cn: 将蛋糕烘35到50分钟。
ext.ext_en: Bake the cake for 35 to 50 minutes...

ext.ext_cn: 烘烤的时候，面糊会膨胀起来。
ext.ext_en: The batter rises as it bakes.

defs.def_en: When a cake or bread bakes or when you bake it, it cooks in the oven without any extra liquid or fat.  →see usage note at:cook

ext.ext_cn: 如果把窗户关上，你会热死的。
ext.ext_en: If you closed the windows you baked...

ext.ext_cn: 地中海的热浪炙烤着英国。
ext.ext_en: Britain bakes in a Mediterranean heatwave.

defs.def_en: If places or people become extremely hot because the sun is shining very strongly, you can say that they bake .

defs.def_cn: （蔬菜或鱼与其他配料切碎拌和后经烘烤的）烤菜

ext.ext_cn: 烤茄子
ext.ext_en: ...an aubergine bake.

defs.def_en: A vegetable or fish bake is a dish that is made by chopping up and mixing together a number of ingredients and cooking them in the oven so that they form a fairly dry solid mass.
Wax paper is paper that has been covered with a thin layer of wax. It is used mainly in cooking or to wrap food.

ext.ext_cn: 她用纸巾擦了擦鼻子。
ext.ext_en: She wiped her nose with a tissue...

ext.ext_cn: 她有一双古怪的眼睛和一个大鼻子。
ext.ext_en: She's got funny eyes and a big nose.

defs.def_en: Your nose is the part of your face which sticks out above your mouth. You use it for smelling and breathing.

defs.def_cn: (汽车或飞机的)前部;车头;机头

ext.ext_cn: 休把小货车停在远离大街的地方，车头背对着大街。
ext.ext_en: Sue parked off the main street, with the van's nose pointing away from the street.

defs.def_en: The nose of a vehicle such as a car or aeroplane is the front part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 穿过米德尔斯伯勒的那条河变得污秽不堪、臭不可闻。
ext.ext_en: The river that runs through Middlesbrough became ugly on the eye and hard on the nose.

defs.def_en: You can refer to your sense of smell as your nose .

ext.ext_cn: 一匹名为切厄克帕的赛马从他右侧疾驰而过，以一鼻之差获胜。
ext.ext_en: Chirkpar rattled past him on the right to snatch the prize by a nose.

defs.def_en: If a horse wins a race by a nose, it wins by a very small distance.

ext.ext_cn: 车慢慢向前开，他却看不见司机。
ext.ext_en: He could not see the driver as the car nosed forward...

ext.ext_cn: 一艘摩托艇缓缓驶出薄雾，蹭进一棵树的枝叶中。
ext.ext_en: A motorboat nosed out of the mist and nudged into the branches of a tree...

defs.def_en: If a vehicle noses in a certain direction or if you nose it there, you move it slowly and carefully in that direction.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你规规矩矩，就可以一辈子都捧着这个饭碗。
ext.ext_en: If you kept your nose clean, you had a job for life.

defs.def_en: If you keep your nose clean, you behave well and stay out of trouble.

defs.def_cn: 笔直往前;沿最明显路线

ext.ext_cn: 径直往前开，大约5分钟就能到旧铁路线。
ext.ext_en: Just follow your nose and in about five minutes you're at the old railway.

defs.def_en: If you follow your nose to get to a place, you go straight ahead or follow the most obvious route.

defs.def_cn: 凭直觉行事;凭本能行事

ext.ext_cn: 你不必思考，跟着你的直觉走。
ext.ext_en: You won't have to think, just follow your nose.

defs.def_en: If you follow your nose, you do something in a particular way because you feel it should be done like that, rather than because you are following any plan or rules.

ext.ext_cn: 他善于发现问题，还总能想出高明的策略。
ext.ext_en: He had a nose for trouble and a brilliant tactical mind...

ext.ext_cn: 格根有很强的新闻意识，对潮流嗅觉灵敏，而且人脉很广。
ext.ext_en: Gergen had a great sense of news, a good nose for trends, and a wide range of contacts.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone has a nose for something, you mean that they have a natural ability to find it or recognize it.

ext.ext_cn: 他这会儿真让我生气。
ext.ext_en: He's just getting up my nose so much at the moment.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone or something gets up your nose, you mean that they annoy you.

ext.ext_cn: 我并不轻视喜剧。
ext.ext_en: I don't look down my nose at comedy...

ext.ext_cn: 他们相当瞧不起不会说法语的人。
ext.ext_en: They rather looked down their noses at anyone who couldn't speak French.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone looks down their nose at something or someone, you mean that they believe they are superior to that person or thing and treat them with disrespect.

ext.ext_cn: 下馆子时，我们不喜欢在酒水上花很多钱。
ext.ext_en: We don't like paying through the nose for our wine when eating out.

defs.def_en: If you say that you paid through the nose for something, you are emphasizing that you had to pay what you consider too high a price for it.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不喜欢陌生人干预我们的事务。
ext.ext_en: We don't like strangers who poke their noses into our affairs...

ext.ext_cn: 你为什么非要插手？
ext.ext_en: Why did you have to stick your nose in?

defs.def_en: If someone pokes their nose into something or sticks their nose into something, they try to interfere with it even though it does not concern them.

defs.def_cn: 反复向…提及(不愉快的事);揭…的疮疤

ext.ext_cn: 他的对手会试图揪住他过去政策陈述的漏洞不放。
ext.ext_en: His enemies will attempt to rub his nose in past policy statements.

defs.def_en: To rub someone's nose in something that they do not want to think about, such as a failing or a mistake they have made, means to remind them repeatedly about it.

defs.def_cn: 跟别人怄气却害了自己;赌气做出不顾后果的事

ext.ext_cn: 有证据表明该产业的贪婪是在作茧自缚。
ext.ext_en: There is evidence that the industry's greed means that it is cutting off its nose to spite its face.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is cutting off their nose to spite their face, you mean they do something that they think will hurt someone, without realizing or caring that it will hurt themselves as well.

ext.ext_cn: 一排大约20辆首尾相接、快速行驶的卡车
ext.ext_en: ...a line of about twenty fast-moving trucks driving nose to tail.

defs.def_en: If vehicles are nose to tail, the front of one vehicle is close behind the back of another.

ext.ext_cn: 他对媒体一直都嗤之以鼻。
ext.ext_en: He has always thumbed his nose at the media.

defs.def_en: If you thumb your nose at someone, you behave in a way that shows that you do not care what they think.

ext.ext_cn: 我的经济境况使我无法对几十万英镑无动于衷。
ext.ext_en: I'm not in a financial position to turn up my nose at several hundred thousand pounds.

defs.def_en: If you turn up your nose at something, you reject it because you think that it is not good enough for you.

defs.def_cn: 当着…的面;在…的眼皮底下

ext.ext_cn: 有外遇就有外遇好了，但别在我眼皮底下。
ext.ext_en: Okay so have an affair, but not right under my nose.

defs.def_en: If you do something under someone's nose, you do it right in front of them, without trying to hide it from them.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不民主的；非民主的；独裁的

ext.ext_cn: 原统治集团的独裁统治
ext.ext_en: ...the undemocratic rule of the former political establishment...

ext.ext_cn: 反对派抨击该法令是不民主的、违反宪法的。
ext.ext_en: Opponents denounced the decree as undemocratic and unconstitutional.

defs.def_en: A system, process, or decision that is undemocratic is one that is controlled or made by one person or a small number of people, rather than by all the people involved.

ext.ext_cn: 她的心脏紧抵着肋骨砰砰跳动。
ext.ext_en: Her heart was thumping against her ribs...

ext.ext_cn: 我的脸上全是瘀伤，肋骨还断了一根。
ext.ext_en: My face was covered with bruises and I had a broken rib.

defs.def_en: Your ribs are the 12 pairs of curved bones that surround your chest.

ext.ext_cn: 牛排
ext.ext_en: ...a rib of beef.

ext.ext_cn: 带甜酱的猪排
ext.ext_en: ...pork ribs in sweet sauce.

defs.def_en: A rib of meat such as beef or pork is a piece that has been cut to include one of the animal's ribs.
Rib is a method of knitting that makes a raised pattern of parallel lines. You use rib, for example, round the edge of sweaters so that the material can stretch without losing its shape.

ext.ext_cn: 我家当地酒馆里的人以前总是取笑我喝“女人”饮料。
ext.ext_en: The guys in my local pub used to rib me about drinking 'girly' drinks.

defs.def_en: If you rib someone about something, you tease them about it in a friendly way.
A halter is a piece of leather or rope that is fastened round the head of a horse so that it can be led easily.

defs.def_cn: （行动）探究的，探测的，探索性的

ext.ext_cn: 探查性的外科手术查出她患了肝癌。
ext.ext_en: Exploratory surgery revealed her liver cancer...

ext.ext_cn: 首相与民主党领袖们的谈话在很大程度上是试探性的。
ext.ext_en: The Prime Minister's talks with the leaders of the Democratic Party were largely exploratory.

defs.def_en: Exploratory actions are done in order to discover something or to learn the truth about something.

defs.def_cn: (引擎或机器运转)正常地,良好地

ext.ext_cn: 他听到敞开的门口外的汽车引擎运转正常。
ext.ext_en: He heard the car engine running sweetly beyond the open door.

defs.def_en: If an engine or machine is running sweetly, it is working smoothly and efficiently.

ext.ext_cn: 他击球可以和 28 年前一样准。
ext.ext_en: He could strike the ball as sweetly as when he was 28 years younger.

defs.def_en: If you kick or hit a ball sweetly, you kick or hit it in the very middle of it so that it goes firmly and accurately to the place you are aiming for.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 把这所房子收拾得可以住人，那可是项大工程。
ext.ext_en: Making the house habitable was a major undertaking.

defs.def_en: If a place is habitable, it is good enough for people to live in.

defs.def_cn: 蓝筹股；绩优股；稳赚钱的股票

ext.ext_cn: 蓝筹股一路飙升，但股市其他股票却在当天收盘时稍有走低。
ext.ext_en: Blue chip issues were sharply higher, but the rest of the market actually declined slightly by the end of the day.

defs.def_en: Blue chip stocks and shares are an investment which are considered fairly safe to invest in while also being profitable.

ext.ext_cn: 巴拿马地峡
ext.ext_en: ...the Isthmus of Panama.

defs.def_en: An isthmus is a narrow piece of land connecting two very large areas of land.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 委员会主席对于这些妥协和拖延似乎并不显得懊恼。
ext.ext_en: The chair of the committee did not appear chagrined by the compromises and delays.

defs.def_en: If you are chagrined by something, it disappoints, upsets, or annoys you, perhaps because of your own failure.

ext.ext_cn: 症状包括疲倦、脸色苍白、没有精神。
ext.ext_en: Symptoms include tiredness, paleness, and lethargy.

ext.ext_cn: 一开始就困扰着这个项目的人员懒散问题
ext.ext_en: ...the lethargy that plagued this project from its outset.

defs.def_en: Lethargy is the condition or state of being lethargic.
The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the earth at an equal distance from the North Pole and the South Pole.

ext.ext_cn: 她接下来说的话使谈话戛然而止。
ext.ext_en: Her next remark abruptly terminated the conversation...

ext.ext_cn: 他的合同在本赛季末终止。
ext.ext_en: His contract terminates at the end of the season.

defs.def_en: When you terminate something or when it terminates, it ends completely.

ext.ext_cn: 经历一番痛苦挣扎后，她决定终止妊娠。
ext.ext_en: After a lot of agonizing she decided to terminate the pregnancy...

ext.ext_cn: 从全世界看来，所有怀孕的人中约 10% 的妊娠被终止了。
ext.ext_en: In the world as a whole, about ten per cent of all pregnancies are terminated.

defs.def_en: To terminate a pregnancy means to end it.

ext.ext_cn: 这列火车的终点站是汤顿。
ext.ext_en: This train will terminate at Taunton.

defs.def_en: When a train or bus terminates somewhere, it ends its journey there.

ext.ext_cn: 想在尽可能短的时间内突击学习知识的参观者
ext.ext_en: ...visitors who want to mug up their knowledge in the shortest possible time...

ext.ext_cn: 你最好能突击提高一下你的西班牙语，因为当地没多少人讲英语。
ext.ext_en: It is advisable to mug up on your Spanish, too, as few locals speak English.

defs.def_en: If you mug up a subject or mug up on it, you study it quickly, so that you can remember the main facts about it.

defs.def_cn: 超过规定（或合格）年龄的

ext.ext_cn: 他年龄大了几个月，进不了青年队。
ext.ext_en: He was a couple of months over-age for the youth team.

defs.def_en: If you are over-age, you are officially too old to do something.

ext.ext_cn: 过老的夜总会歌手
ext.ext_en: ...an over-age nightclub singer.

defs.def_en: You use over-age to describe someone who is doing something that is usually done by much younger people, and which therefore seems inappropriate or silly.

ext.ext_cn: 有一堆疑难症状的病人
ext.ext_en: ...patients with a welter of confusing symptoms.

ext.ext_cn: 他上任后的一堆杂乱的宣传活动
ext.ext_en: ...the welter of publicity that followed his engagement.

defs.def_en: A welter of something is a large quantity of it which occurs suddenly or in a confusing way.

defs.def_cn: 经久不衰的事物；一直备受欢迎的事物
defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to something that is still successful or popular even though it is quite old as a golden oldie .
A talisman is an object which you believe has magic powers to protect you or bring you luck.

ext.ext_cn: 利物浦队一小时前开的球。
ext.ext_en: Liverpool kicked off an hour ago.

defs.def_en: In football, when the players kick off, they start a game by kicking the ball from the centre of the pitch.

ext.ext_cn: 演出10月24日开始。
ext.ext_en: The shows kick off on October 24th...

ext.ext_cn: 市长宣布晚会开始。
ext.ext_en: The Mayor kicked off the party...

defs.def_en: If an event, game, series, or discussion kicks off, or is kicked off, it begins.

ext.ext_cn: 她四肢平摊躺在沙发上，踢掉了鞋子。
ext.ext_en: She stretched out on the sofa and kicked off her shoes.

defs.def_en: If you kick off your shoes, you shake your feet so that your shoes come off.

ext.ext_cn: 我们不能把他们从岛上赶走。
ext.ext_en: We can't kick them off the island.

defs.def_en: To kick someone off an area of land means to force them to leave it.

ext.ext_cn: 过分强调研究的重要性。
ext.ext_en: Too much emphasis is placed on research...

ext.ext_cn: 格兰特在他的绘画中特别注重天气。
ext.ext_en: Grant puts a special emphasis on weather in his paintings.

defs.def_en: Emphasis is special or extra importance that is given to an activity or to a part or aspect of something.

defs.def_cn: （对音节、单词或短语的）强调，重读

ext.ext_cn: “我早该料到了！”伯内特小姐加重语气说。
ext.ext_en: 'I might have known it!' Miss Burnett said with emphasis...

ext.ext_cn: 重音在最后一个单词的第一个音节上。
ext.ext_en: The emphasis is on the first syllable of the last word.

defs.def_en: Emphasis is extra force that you put on a syllable, word, or phrase when you are speaking in order to make it seem more important.

ext.ext_cn: 那算是对现状的赞同。
ext.ext_en: That adds up to an endorsement of the status quo...

ext.ext_cn: 这是对他较温和的执政风格强有力的支持。
ext.ext_en: This is a powerful endorsement for his softer style of government.

defs.def_en: An endorsement is a statement or action which shows that you support or approve of something or someone.
An endorsement is a note on someone's driving licence saying that they have been found guilty of a driving offence.

defs.def_cn: (对产品、公司的)广告宣传，支持
defs.def_en: An endorsement for a product or company involves appearing in advertisements for it or showing support for it.
A can opener is the same as a tin opener .

ext.ext_cn: 在日益萧条的经济环境中挣扎求生的各个公司
ext.ext_en: ...companies which have been struggling for survival in the advancing recession...

ext.ext_en: Ask for the free booklet 'Debt: a Survival Guide'.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the survival of something or someone, you mean that they manage to continue or exist in spite of difficult circumstances.

ext.ext_cn: 如果癌症在早期发现的话，存活的几率会很高。
ext.ext_en: If cancers are spotted early there's a high chance of survival...

ext.ext_cn: 动物的嗅觉对其生存仍然至关重要。
ext.ext_en: An animal's sense of smell is still crucial to its survival.

defs.def_en: If you refer to the survival of a person or living thing, you mean that they live through a dangerous situation in which it was possible that they might die.
You can use the survival of the fittest to refer to a situation in which only the strongest people or things continue to live or be successful, while the others die or fail.

ext.ext_cn: 我难以相信这些人竟会有这种举动。
ext.ext_en: I couldn't believe these people were behaving in this way...

ext.ext_cn: 他表现得很糟糕。
ext.ext_en: He'd behaved badly.

defs.def_en: The way that you behave is the way that you do and say things, and the things that you do and say.

defs.def_cn: 守规矩；举止得体；行为检点

ext.ext_cn: 你得规矩点。
ext.ext_en: You have to behave...

ext.ext_cn: 他们应该守规矩。
ext.ext_en: They were expected to behave themselves.

defs.def_en: If you behave or behave yourself, you act in the way that people think is correct and proper.

defs.def_cn: （在科学领域）运动，起作用，作出反应

ext.ext_cn: 在一定条件下，电子可以作波状运动，而不是粒子状运动。
ext.ext_en: Under certain conditions, electrons can behave like waves rather than particles.

defs.def_en: In science, the way that something behaves is the things that it does.

ext.ext_cn: 有组织的艺术品盗窃团伙
ext.ext_en: ...organised groups of art thieves.

ext.ext_cn: 有组织的宗教
ext.ext_en: ...organised religion.

defs.def_en: An organized activity or group involves a number of people doing something together in a structured way, rather than doing it by themselves.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这些人做事效率很高，井井有条，并且十分善于管理时间。
ext.ext_en: These people are very efficient, very organized and excellent time managers.

defs.def_en: Someone who is organized plans their work and activities efficiently.

defs.def_cn: 几乎;实际上;事实上;差不多

ext.ext_cn: 差不多所有的烹饪都是在燃煤灶上进行的。
ext.ext_en: Virtually all cooking was done over coal-fired ranges...

ext.ext_cn: 要对所有的信息进行分析研究几乎是不可能的。
ext.ext_en: It would have been virtually impossible to research all the information.

defs.def_en: You can use virtually to indicate that something is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 迷迷糊糊的;昏昏欲睡的;昏昏沉沉的

ext.ext_cn: 那种药物总是让他觉得昏昏沉沉的，无法集中注意力。
ext.ext_en: The medicine always made him feel dopey and unable to concentrate.

defs.def_en: Someone who is dopey is sleepy, as though they have been drugged.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_en: If you describe someone as dopey, you mean that they are rather stupid.

defs.def_cn: 星光照耀的;星光灿烂的

ext.ext_cn: 星光灿烂的晴朗天空
ext.ext_en: ...a clear starlit sky.

ext.ext_cn: 这个繁星满天的寒冷夜晚
ext.ext_en: ...this cold, starlit night.

defs.def_en: Starlit means made lighter or brighter by the stars.

ext.ext_cn: 潮水正处于最高位。
ext.ext_en: The tide was at its highest...

ext.ext_cn: 正在退潮，沙滩平坦，闪着微光。
ext.ext_en: The tide was going out, and the sand was smooth and glittering...

defs.def_en: The tide is the regular change in the level of the sea on the shore.

ext.ext_cn: 罗马的船只过去经常乘着潮汐从布洛涅航行到里奇伯勒。
ext.ext_en: Roman vessels used to sail with the tide from Boulogne to Richborough.

defs.def_en: A tide is a current in the sea that is caused by the regular and continuous movement of large areas of water towards and away from the shore.

ext.ext_cn: 绝大多数人的观点看来是一边倒地支持他的。
ext.ext_en: The tide of opinion seems overwhelmingly in his favour.

defs.def_en: The tide of opinion, for example, is what the majority of people think at a particular time.

ext.ext_cn: 他们谈到扭转历史潮流。
ext.ext_en: They talked of reversing the tide of history...

ext.ext_cn: 战争的浪潮回过头来席卷了全国。
ext.ext_en: The tide of war swept back across their country.

defs.def_en: People sometimes refer to events or forces that are difficult or impossible to control as the tide of history, for example.

ext.ext_cn: 不断高涨的犯罪浪潮
ext.ext_en: ...an ever increasing tide of crime...

ext.ext_cn: 民族主义浪潮在许多共和国势头正盛。
ext.ext_en: The tide of nationalism is still running high in a number of republics.

defs.def_en: You can talk about a tide of something, especially something which is unpleasant, when there is a large and increasing amount of it.
An icebox is the same as a refrigerator .

ext.ext_cn: 他的车遭遇拦劫，随后他被4名持枪歹徒劫持。
ext.ext_en: His car was held up and he was abducted by four gunmen...

ext.ext_cn: 她被控诱拐一个6个月大的孩子。
ext.ext_en: She was charged with abducting a six-month-old child.

defs.def_en: If someone is abducted by another person, he or she is taken away illegally, usually using force.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （计划、想法）空想的，不切实际的

ext.ext_cn: 他怀揣着一个实现世界繁荣的乌托邦之梦。
ext.ext_en: He was pursuing a utopian dream of world prosperity...

ext.ext_cn: 在今天，完全取消国家边界控制的观点与建立一个世界政府的想法一样不切实际。
ext.ext_en: A complete absence of national border controls is as utopian today as the vision of world government.

defs.def_en: If you describe a plan or idea as utopian, you are criticizing it because it is unrealistic and shows a belief that things can be improved much more than is possible.

defs.def_cn: （政治或宗教思想）空想的，乌托邦式的

ext.ext_cn: 他对大自然怀有一种极为纯粹的乌托邦式看法。
ext.ext_en: His was a utopian vision of nature in its purest form.

ext.ext_cn: 20世纪20年代和30年代移民而来的一群空想家
ext.ext_en: ...a group of utopians who immigrated in the 1920s and '30s.

defs.def_en: Utopian is used to describe political or religious philosophies which claim that it is possible to build a new and perfect society in which everyone is happy.

ext.ext_cn: 他于今天早些时候被注射处死。
ext.ext_en: He was executed by lethal injection earlier today...

ext.ext_cn: 一个组织声称已经处决了那名美国人质。
ext.ext_en: One group claimed to have executed the American hostage...

defs.def_en: To execute someone means to kill them as a punishment for a serious crime.

ext.ext_cn: 我们将严格施行我们的竞选计划。
ext.ext_en: We are going to execute our campaign plan to the letter.

defs.def_en: If you execute a plan, you carry it out.

ext.ext_cn: 我在山脉西侧陡峭的高处成功地急转弯。
ext.ext_en: I executed the hairpin turn high on the sheer western face of the mountains...

ext.ext_cn: 熟练地完成了着陆。
ext.ext_en: The landing was skilfully executed.

defs.def_en: If you execute a difficult action or movement, you successfully perform it.

ext.ext_cn: 莫里斯在1978年创作了由12幅画组成的一组作品。
ext.ext_en: Morris executed a suite of twelve drawings in 1978...

ext.ext_cn: 欣赏优秀的高桅横帆船摄影作品是种乐趣。
ext.ext_en: A well-executed shot of a tall ship is a joy to behold.

defs.def_en: When someone executes a work of art, they make or produce it, using an idea as a basis.
A larch is a tree with needle-shaped leaves.

defs.def_cn: 可归因于…的;由…造成的;与…有关的

ext.ext_cn: 他的死亡很可能是由 1724 年的一起事件造成的。
ext.ext_en: The probable cause of his death is traceable to an incident in 1724...

ext.ext_cn: 英国的通货膨胀有一部分大概要归因于财政大臣未能将汇率控制在合理水平。
ext.ext_en: Britain's inflation is probably traceable in part to the Chancellor's failure to get the exchange rate right.

defs.def_en: If one thing is traceable to another, there is evidence to suggest that the first thing was caused by or is connected to the second thing.
A Welshman is a man who was born in Wales and considers himself to be Welsh.

defs.def_cn: 血球计数；血细胞计数；血球计数检查

ext.ext_cn: 她的血球指数正常。
ext.ext_en: Her blood count was normal...

ext.ext_cn: 我们检查了血球指数，以确保一切正常。
ext.ext_en: We do a blood count to ensure that all is well.

defs.def_en: Your blood count is the number of red and white cells in your blood. A blood count can also refer to a medical examination which determines the number of red and white cells in your blood.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 另一名受伤男子是腹部的皮外伤。
ext.ext_en: The other injured man had a superficial stomach wound...

ext.ext_cn: 他们中很多人会因伤势过重而死亡。
ext.ext_en: Many of them will have died because they were so badly injured.

defs.def_en: An injured person or animal has physical damage to part of their body, usually as a result of an accident or fighting.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 自尊心受到伤害的表情
ext.ext_en: ...a look of injured pride.

ext.ext_cn: 精神损失赔偿
ext.ext_en: ...compensation for injured feelings.

defs.def_en: If you have injured feelings, you feel upset because you believe someone has been unfair or unkind to you.

ext.ext_cn: 我们几小时后到达了纽约市郊。
ext.ext_en: Hours later we reached the outskirts of New York.

defs.def_en: The outskirts of a city or town are the parts of it that are farthest away from its centre.
An ice lolly is a piece of flavoured ice or ice cream on a stick.

defs.def_cn: 恢复；重新开始；重操（旧业）

ext.ext_cn: 我现在渴望尽早回到工作岗位。
ext.ext_en: I now look forward to going back to work as soon as possible...

ext.ext_cn: 埃米重拾学业。
ext.ext_en: Amy went back to studying.

defs.def_en: If you go back to a task or activity, you start doing it again after you have stopped doing it for a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 请允许我再回到我刚才所提的观点。
ext.ext_en: Let me just go back to the point I was making.

defs.def_en: If you go back to a particular point in a lecture, discussion, or book, you start to discuss it.

defs.def_cn: 削弱…的效能;损害;使失效;使变质

ext.ext_cn: 由于“东方人”和“西方人”之间存在巨大的分歧，战争期间的战略方针没有得到切实的执行。
ext.ext_en: Strategic policy during the War was vitiated because of a sharp division between 'easterners' and 'westerners'...

ext.ext_cn: 但这不会威胁到他的奖学金。
ext.ext_en: But this does not vitiate his scholarship.

defs.def_en: If something is vitiated, its effectiveness is spoiled or weakened.
A sled is the same as a sledge .

ext.ext_cn: 我们回到家里，然后去后院的小山上滑雪橇。
ext.ext_en: We got home and went sledding on the small hill in our back yard.

defs.def_en: If you go sledding, you ride on a sled.

ext.ext_cn: 重要的绘画、雕塑、镶嵌画和建筑作品都在威尼斯原地得到了仔细检查。
ext.ext_en: Major works of painting, sculpture, mosaic and architecture were examined in situ in Venice.

ext.ext_cn: 由实验室与就地实验得出的技术数据
ext.ext_en: ...technical data derived from laboratory and in-situ experimentation.

defs.def_en: If something remains in situ, especially while something is done to it, it remains where it is.
A plasma screen is a type of thin television screen or computer screen that produces high-quality images.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 这个不祥的警告很快证明是有预见性的。
ext.ext_en: This ominous warning soon proved prophetic...

ext.ext_cn: 朋友们回想起几年前伊丽莎白预言性的一番话。
ext.ext_en: Friends recalled Elisabeth's prophetic words of several years ago.

defs.def_en: If something was prophetic, it described or suggested something that did actually happen later.

defs.def_cn: 预言的；先知的；预言者的

ext.ext_cn: 融科学事实和先知远见于其中的一个动人浪漫故事
ext.ext_en: ...a charming romance intermingled with scientific fact and prophetic vision.

defs.def_en: Prophetic means related to a prophecy or a prophet.

ext.ext_cn: 他的膝伤正在康复。
ext.ext_en: He is recovering from a knee injury...

ext.ext_cn: 一名警员昨夜被刺伤之后入院进行康复治疗。
ext.ext_en: A policeman was recovering in hospital last night after being stabbed...

defs.def_en: When you recover from an illness or an injury, you become well again.

defs.def_cn: （从不开心或不愉快的经历中）恢复，复原

ext.ext_cn: 他一直未能完全从中走出的悲剧
ext.ext_en: ...a tragedy from which he never fully recovered...

ext.ext_cn: 她乘坐的飞机出了故障，18个小时后她才到达那里。之后她花了3天时间才完全恢复过来。
ext.ext_en: Her plane broke down and it was 18 hours before she got there. It took her three days to recover.

defs.def_en: If you recover from an unhappy or unpleasant experience, you stop being upset by it.

defs.def_cn: （从弱势或困境中）好转，扭转，恢复

ext.ext_cn: 他在2比4落后的情况下实现逆转闯进1/4决赛。
ext.ext_en: He recovered from a 4-2 deficit to reach the quarter-finals...

ext.ext_cn: 股市指数下跌了80%后才开始反弹。
ext.ext_en: The stock-market index fell by 80% before it began to recover.

defs.def_en: If something recovers from a period of weakness or difficulty, it improves or gets stronger again.

ext.ext_cn: 警方突击搜查了伦敦东南区的5幢房屋，找到了失窃物品。
ext.ext_en: Police raided five houses in south-east London and recovered stolen goods...

ext.ext_cn: 救援队从瓦砾中挖出了更多尸体。
ext.ext_en: Rescue teams recovered more bodies from the rubble.

defs.def_en: If you recover something that has been lost or stolen, you find it or get it back.

defs.def_cn: 恢复（意识、神志或身体状态）

ext.ext_cn: 有一小会儿他看上去有些迟疑不定，之后又恢复了镇定。
ext.ext_en: For a minute he looked uncertain, and then recovered his composure...

ext.ext_cn: 她的哮喘病严重发作，一个小时后呼吸才恢复正常。
ext.ext_en: She had a severe attack of asthma and it took an hour to recover her breath...

defs.def_en: If you recover a mental or physical state, it comes back again. For example, if you recover consciousness, you become conscious again.

defs.def_cn: 收回（花掉、投资或借出的钱）

ext.ext_cn: 正在进行诉讼以收回那笔钱。
ext.ext_en: Legal action is being taken to try to recover the money...

ext.ext_cn: 单是英国的市场还不足以让他们收回生产成本。
ext.ext_en: The British market alone was not large enough to recover their costs of production.

defs.def_en: If you recover money that you have spent, invested, or lent to someone, you get the same amount back.

ext.ext_cn: 他一吃完就告辞离开了。
ext.ext_en: As soon as he'd finished eating, he excused himself...

ext.ext_cn: 古尔德先生结束演讲后，全场起立鼓掌并热烈欢呼。
ext.ext_en: Mr Gould was given a standing ovation and loud cheers when he finished his speech...

defs.def_en: When you finish doing or dealing with something, you do or deal with the last part of it, so that there is no more for you to do or deal with.

ext.ext_cn: 顾问们一直在为要于本周内完成一份报告而工作。
ext.ext_en: The consultants had been working to finish a report this week.

ext.ext_cn: 现在她正忙着完成卡罗琳王后的传记。
ext.ext_en: Now she is busy finishing off a biography of Queen Caroline.

defs.def_en: When you finish something that you are making or producing, you reach the end of making or producing it, so that it is complete.

ext.ext_cn: 一天的教学在下午4点左右结束。
ext.ext_en: The teaching day finishes at around 4pm...

ext.ext_cn: 一部戏剧连演结束后，很多服装都会租借给业余剧团和学校。
ext.ext_en: When a play finishes its run, many of the costumes are hired out to amateur dramatics companies and schools.

defs.def_en: When something such as a course, film, or sale finishes, especially at a planned time, it ends.

ext.ext_cn: 他们两人最后互相吻别。
ext.ext_en: The two of them finished by kissing each other goodbye...

ext.ext_cn: 晚会的最后是欢迎3个新成员。
ext.ext_en: The evening finished with the welcoming of three new members...

defs.def_en: You say that someone or something finishes a period of time or an event in a particular way to indicate what the final situation was like. You can also say that a period of time or an event finishes in a particular way.

ext.ext_cn: 他连续4年获得锦标赛亚军。
ext.ext_en: He finished second in the championship four years in a row.

defs.def_en: If someone finishes second, for example, in a race or competition, they are in second place at the end of the race or competition.

ext.ext_cn: 她眼光一闪，但他举起一只手说：“让我把话讲完。”
ext.ext_en: Her eyes flashed, but he held up a hand. 'Let me finish.'

defs.def_en: To finish means to reach the end of saying something.

ext.ext_cn: 我打算继续下去，直到工作彻底完成。
ext.ext_en: I intend to continue it and see the job through to the finish...

ext.ext_cn: 他自始至终都相信我，而且时常超过我对自己的信任。
ext.ext_en: From start to finish he believed in me, often more than I did myself.

defs.def_en: The finish of something is the end of it or the last part of it.

ext.ext_cn: 赢得观看环法自行车赛最后阶段比赛之旅！
ext.ext_en: Win a trip to see the finish of the Tour de France!...

ext.ext_cn: 对难分先后的冲线镜头的回放显示奥蒂先于奥运冠军到达终点。
ext.ext_en: The replays of the close finish showed Ottey finished ahead of the Olympic champion.

defs.def_en: The finish of a race is the end of it.

ext.ext_cn: 这件木工品的抛光和做工均属上乘。
ext.ext_en: The finish and workmanship of the woodwork was excellent.

defs.def_en: See also:finished;If the surface of something that has been made has a particular kind of finish, it has the appearance or texture mentioned.

ext.ext_cn: 该岛北部和东部的冲突是一场你死我活的斗争。
ext.ext_en: The conflict in the North and East of the island was a fight to the finish.

defs.def_en: A fight to the finish is one in which one of the people or groups fighting is killed or completely defeated.

ext.ext_cn: 直到最后一刻，工人们仍在对展馆进行最后的修饰。
ext.ext_en: Right up until the last minute, workers were still putting the finishing touches on the pavilions...

ext.ext_cn: 这些布丁大部分只需要用蛋奶沙司最后点缀一下。
ext.ext_en: The only finishing touch most of these puddings need is a custard sauce.

defs.def_en: If you add the finishing touches to something, you add or do the last things that are necessary to complete it.

ext.ext_cn: 凯利喝光了他的咖啡。
ext.ext_en: Kelly finished off his coffee...

ext.ext_cn: 他从她手里夺过瓶子，一饮而尽。
ext.ext_en: He took the bottle from her hands and finished it off in one long swallow.

defs.def_en: If you finish off something that you have been eating or drinking, you eat or drink the last part of it with the result that there is none left.

defs.def_cn: 杀死(已受严重伤害的人);毁灭(已遭严重损坏的物)

ext.ext_cn: 他们打算毫不留情地迅速结果了她。
ext.ext_en: They meant to finish her off, swiftly and without mercy.

defs.def_en: If someone finishes off a person or thing that is already badly injured or damaged, they kill or destroy them.  →see: finish 2;

defs.def_cn: 最后(处于某地或某种情形)

ext.ext_cn: 他们在大学偶遇，最后结了婚。
ext.ext_en: They had met by chance at university and finished up getting married...

ext.ext_cn: 他最后很可能会因为商业诈骗而入狱。
ext.ext_en: He's probably going to finish up in jail for business fraud.

defs.def_en: If you finish up in a particular place or situation, you are in that place or situation after doing or experiencing several things.

ext.ext_cn: 请现在喝完。
ext.ext_en: Finish up your drinks now, please.

defs.def_en: See also:finish 1;2;If you finish up something that you have been eating or drinking, you eat or drink the last part of it.

defs.def_cn: 与…断绝关系;对…不再感兴趣;同…不再打交道

ext.ext_cn: 男友威胁说要和我分手。
ext.ext_en: My boyfriend was threatening to finish with me...

ext.ext_cn: “你已经都问完我了吗?”卢克听完阿姆斯特朗向自己重述的证词后问道。
ext.ext_en: 'Have you finished with me?' Luke asked, when he had listened to Armstrong's report of his evidence.

defs.def_en: If you finish with someone or something, you stop dealing with them, being involved with them, or being interested in them.

defs.def_cn: （通常在正餐前食用的）大虾冷盘
defs.def_en: A prawn cocktail is a dish that consists of prawns, salad, and a sauce. It is usually eaten at the beginning of a meal.

ext.ext_cn: 尽管这种增长的数量相对较小，但是潜在的市场是巨大的。
ext.ext_en: While the numbers of such developments are relatively small, the potential market is large...

ext.ext_cn: 尽管模特行业绝不是那么容易进入的，但是好的模特，不论男女，总是需要的。
ext.ext_en: While the modelling business is by no means easy to get into, the good model, male or female, will always be in demand...

defs.def_en: You use while, before making a statement, in order to introduce information that partly conflicts with your statement.

ext.ext_cn: 他们默默地走了一会儿。
ext.ext_en: They walked on in silence for a while...

ext.ext_cn: 他不久前刚刚结婚。
ext.ext_en: He was married a little while ago...

defs.def_en: A while is a period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 我吃东西的时候邻桌的人一直在看我。
ext.ext_en: All the while the people at the next table watched me eat.

defs.def_en: You use all the while in order to say that something happens continually or that it happens throughout the time when something else is happening.

defs.def_cn: 使士气低落;使失去信心;使泄气

ext.ext_cn: 很明显，目标之一就是要用一切可能的手段打击敌军的士气。
ext.ext_en: Clearly, one of the objectives is to demoralize the enemy troops in any way they can.

defs.def_en: If something demoralizes someone, it makes them lose so much confidence in what they are doing that they want to give up.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （论点、解释等）难以令人信服的，没有说服力的

ext.ext_cn: 帕特尔先生致电大学要求对方作出解释，但只得到了一些无关痛痒的惯用托词。
ext.ext_en: Mr Patel phoned the University for an explanation, and he was given the usual unconvincing excuses...

ext.ext_cn: 在很多读者看来，这很难令人信服。
ext.ext_en: To many readers it sounded unconvincing.

defs.def_en: If you describe something such as an argument or explanation as unconvincing, you find it difficult to believe because it does not seem real.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: （故事或人物）不可信的，不真实的

ext.ext_cn: 不太可信的爱情故事
ext.ext_en: ...an unconvincing love story.

defs.def_en: If you describe a story or a character in a story as unconvincing, you think they do not seem likely or real.

ext.ext_cn: 政府非法窃听了他的电话。
ext.ext_en: The government illegally eavesdropped on his telephone conversations...

ext.ext_cn: 女佣在厨房门后偷听。
ext.ext_en: The housemaid eavesdropped from behind the kitchen door.

defs.def_en: If you eavesdrop on someone, you listen secretly to what they are saying.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (食物)多筋的，纤维多而不嫩的，柴的

ext.ext_cn: 这肉嚼不烂。
ext.ext_en: The meat was stringy...

ext.ext_cn: 幸好它不像有些比萨饼那样上面涂满了难嚼的奶酪。
ext.ext_en: Thankfully, it wasn't smothered in stringy cheese like some pizzas.

defs.def_en: Stringy food contains long, thin pieces that are difficult or unpleasant to eat.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 留着稀疏的灰白长发、身形臃肿的男子
ext.ext_en: ...an enormously fat man with long, stringy gray hair.

defs.def_en: Stringy hair is thin and unattractive.
A coffee pot is a tall narrow pot with a spout and a lid, in which coffee is made or served.

ext.ext_cn: 一件艳粉红色T恤
ext.ext_en: ...a shocking-pink T-shirt.

defs.def_en: Something that is shocking pink is very bright pink.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 如果工作忙、难度大，要想保持桌面整洁似乎不太可能。
ext.ext_en: Having a tidy desk can seem impossible if you have a busy, demanding job...

ext.ext_cn: 我会帮你弄弄花园，帮你保持它的整洁。
ext.ext_en: I'll do your garden, I'll keep that tidy for you.

defs.def_en: Something that is tidy is neat and is arranged in an organized way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她有洁癖，整天不是用吸尘器吸尘，就是擦来擦去。
ext.ext_en: She's obsessively tidy, always hoovering and polishing.

defs.def_en: Someone who is tidy likes everything to be neat and arranged in an organized way.

ext.ext_cn: 她整理了床铺，收拾了自己的房间。
ext.ext_en: She made her bed, and tidied her room.

defs.def_en: When you tidy a place such as a room or cupboard, you make it neat by putting things in their proper places.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 赚大钱的机会就在那儿摆着。
ext.ext_en: The opportunities are there to make a tidy profit.

defs.def_en: A tidy amount of money is a large amount.

defs.def_cn: （与 kind、cold 等形容词连用构成形容词）表示“心地…的”，“心肠…的”，“心情…的”

ext.ext_cn: 他们现在开始意识到那些心地善良的陌生人帮了他们多大的忙。
ext.ext_en: They are now realising just how much they owe to kind-hearted strangers...

ext.ext_cn: 那个哈丽雅特是个心肠冷酷的婊子。
ext.ext_en: That Harriet is a cold-hearted bitch...

defs.def_en: -hearted combines with adjectives such as 'kind' or 'cold' to form adjectives which indicate that someone has a particular character or personality or is in a particular mood.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她生活俭朴。
ext.ext_en: She lives a frugal life.

defs.def_en: People who are frugal or who live frugal lives do not eat much or spend much money on themselves.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 饮食很简单：奶酪、水、米饭、豆类。
ext.ext_en: The diet was frugal: cheese and water, rice and beans.

defs.def_en: A frugal meal is small and not expensive.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 外交官可能会提供一些靠不住的误导性信息，这是众所周知的。
ext.ext_en: Diplomats can be a notoriously unreliable and misleading source of information...

ext.ext_cn: 他的判断不可靠。
ext.ext_en: His judgement was unreliable...

defs.def_en: If you describe a person, machine, or method as unreliable, you mean that you cannot trust them.

ext.ext_cn: 教皇昨天直言全世界的神父都应该禁欲。
ext.ext_en: The Pope bluntly told the world's priests yesterday to stay celibate.

defs.def_en: Someone who is celibate does not marry or have sex, because of their religious beliefs.

defs.def_cn: (特定时期)禁欲的，节制性欲的

ext.ext_cn: 我有两年没有性生活。
ext.ext_en: I was celibate for two years.

defs.def_en: Someone who is celibate does not have sex during a particular period of their life.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 他有时会很冷淡，很粗鲁，甚至对自己的朋友也是如此。
ext.ext_en: He can be quite stand-offish and rude, even to his friends.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is stand-offish, you mean that they behave in a formal and rather unfriendly way.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: 不悦耳的;不成调的;难听的

ext.ext_cn: 有人走过，唱着一首不成调的歌。
ext.ext_en: Someone walked by, singing a tuneless song.

defs.def_en: Tuneless music and voices do not sound pleasant.

defs.def_cn: 精神病；精神错乱；精神失常

ext.ext_cn: 他晚年可能患有某种神经症或精神病。
ext.ext_en: He may have some kind of neurosis or psychosis later in life.

ext.ext_cn: 老年性精神病
ext.ext_en: ...senile psychoses.

defs.def_en: Psychosis is mental illness of a severe kind which can make people lose contact with reality.

defs.def_cn: (导弹)地对地(或舰)的，舰对舰(或地)的

ext.ext_cn: 从首都西部发射了多枚地对地导弹。
ext.ext_en: The surface-to-surface missiles were fired from the west of the capital.

defs.def_en: Surface-to-surface missiles are fired from the ground or a boat and aimed at targets on the ground or at other boats.
A poodle is a type of dog with thick curly hair.

defs.def_cn: （尤指不适宜地）使统一，使单一，使类同

ext.ext_cn: 哪怕是布鲁塞尔的官僚也无法使民族文化和品位单一化。
ext.ext_en: Even Brussels bureaucrats can't homogenize national cultures and tastes.

defs.def_en: If something is homogenized, it is changed so that all its parts are similar or the same, especially in a way that is undesirable.

ext.ext_cn: 这个包里装着一张圣诞卡。
ext.ext_en: The bag contained a Christmas card...

ext.ext_cn: 工厂车间里陈设着种类繁多的廉价家具。
ext.ext_en: Factory shops contain a wide range of cheap furnishings...

defs.def_en: If something such as a box, bag, room, or place contains things, those things are inside it.

ext.ext_cn: 希腊酸奶比高脂浓奶油所含脂肪要少得多。
ext.ext_en: Greek yogurt contains much less fat than double cream...

ext.ext_cn: 很多车使用含铅汽油。
ext.ext_en: Many cars run on petrol which contains lead.

defs.def_en: If a substance contains something, that thing is a part of it.

defs.def_cn: (著作、讲话或电影中)包括，包含

ext.ext_cn: 这张单子列出了病人可能会向医生提出的一系列问题。
ext.ext_en: This sheet contained a list of problems a patient might like to raise with the doctor...

ext.ext_cn: 这两张唱片还包含了布里顿两首不甚知名的声乐套曲。
ext.ext_en: The two discs also contain two of Britten's lesser-known song-cycles.

defs.def_en: If writing, speech, or film contains particular information, ideas, or images, it includes them.

ext.ext_cn: 这个委员会包括11名民主党人和9名共和党人。
ext.ext_en: The committee contains 11 Democrats and nine Republicans.

defs.def_en: If a group or organization contains a certain number of people, those are the people that are in it.

ext.ext_cn: 上百名消防队员仍在试图控制工厂的火势。
ext.ext_en: More than a hundred firemen are still trying to contain the fire at the plant...

ext.ext_cn: 市政府称宵禁遏制住了暴力事件。
ext.ext_en: The city authorities said the curfew had contained the violence.

defs.def_en: If you contain something, you control it and prevent it from spreading or increasing.

ext.ext_cn: 但他满心好奇，一天，他真的忍不住了。“你打算做什么？”他问道。
ext.ext_en: But he was bursting with curiosity, and one day he just couldn't contain himself. 'What are you going to do?' he asked...

ext.ext_cn: 埃文斯喜不自禁：“我真为她骄傲。”他说。
ext.ext_en: Evans could barely contain his delight: 'I'm so proud of her,' he said.

defs.def_en: If you cannot contain a feeling such as excitement or anger, or if you cannot contain yourself, you cannot prevent yourself from showing your feelings.

defs.def_cn: 西印度群岛的；西印度群岛人的;西印度群岛文化的

ext.ext_cn: 西印度群岛的板球运动看起来前景光明。
ext.ext_en: The future quality of West Indian cricket looks promising...

ext.ext_cn: 出生在巴巴多斯的弗兰克·科利摩尔是20世纪四五十年代西印度群岛文学复兴运动的核心人物。
ext.ext_en: Barbadian-born Frank Collymore was at the heart of the West Indian literary renaissance in the '40s and '50s.

defs.def_en: West Indian means belonging or relating to the West Indies, or to its people or culture.
A West Indian is a citizen of the West Indies or a person of West Indian origin.

ext.ext_cn: 城乡差别
ext.ext_en: ...the contrast between town and country...

ext.ext_cn: 这两位访客的外表截然不同。
ext.ext_en: The two visitors provided a startling contrast in appearance...

defs.def_en: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

ext.ext_cn: 相比之下，私营部门就有很多钱可供开销。
ext.ext_en: The private sector, by contrast, has plenty of money to spend...

ext.ext_cn: 相反，生活在富裕家庭的女孩子通常都备受呵护。
ext.ext_en: In contrast, the lives of girls in well-to-do families were often very sheltered...

defs.def_en: You say by contrast or in contrast, or in contrast to something, to show that you are mentioning a very different situation from the one you have just mentioned.

defs.def_cn: 与…截然不同;与…对比鲜明

ext.ext_cn: 他和他儿子在公开场合的言论总是截然不同。
ext.ext_en: His public statements have always been in marked contrast to those of his son...

ext.ext_cn: 那和1970年石油危机时的情形完全不同。
ext.ext_en: That is in stark contrast to the situation during the 1970 oil crisis.

defs.def_en: If one thing is in contrast to another, it is very different from it.

defs.def_cn: 截然不同的事物;差异明显的事物

ext.ext_cn: 这个男孩的房间和客房截然不同。
ext.ext_en: The boy's room is a complete contrast to the guest room.

ext.ext_cn: 一个截然不同的国家
ext.ext_en: ...a country of great contrasts.

defs.def_en: If one thing is a contrast to another, it is very different from it.

ext.ext_cn: 她将当时的情况和目前的危机进行对比。
ext.ext_en: She contrasted the situation then with the present crisis...

ext.ext_cn: 将那个方法和大多数机构现行的做法进行对比。
ext.ext_en: Contrast that approach with what goes on in most organizations...

defs.def_en: If you contrast one thing with another, you point out or consider the differences between those things.

defs.def_cn: 截然不同;有明显差异;对比鲜明

ext.ext_cn: 约翰逊的亲和力和他老板易怒的性格形成了鲜明的对比。
ext.ext_en: Johnson's easy charm contrasted sharply with the prickliness of his boss...

ext.ext_cn: 把这面墙刷成对比鲜明的颜色。
ext.ext_en: Paint the wall in a contrasting colour.

defs.def_en: If one thing contrasts with another, it is very different from it.

defs.def_cn: (照片、电视图像、画作等的)颜色反差，明暗对比

ext.ext_cn: 颜色更为鲜艳、图像对比度更高、具备数字音响效果的电视
ext.ext_en: ...a television with brighter colours, better contrast, and digital sound.

defs.def_en: Contrast is the degree of difference between the darker and lighter parts of a photograph, television picture, or painting.

defs.def_cn: 马虎拖拉；不务正业；游手好闲

ext.ext_cn: 我把该用于工作的时间都在海滩上游手好闲掉了，而没去从事一份像样的工作。
ext.ext_en: I spent my working life poncing around on a beach instead of doing a proper job.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone is poncing around or poncing about, you mean that they are not doing something properly, quickly, or seriously.

ext.ext_cn: 在一张宽大的橡树桌上摆放着一盒盒中式食品。
ext.ext_en: Cartons of Chinese food were arrayed on a large oak table.

ext.ext_cn: 在塑料和其他聚合物材料中，分子如何排列
ext.ext_en: ...how molecules are arrayed in materials such as plastics and other polymers.

defs.def_en: If things are arrayed in a particular way, they are arranged or displayed in that way.

ext.ext_cn: 所有这类提案遇到的困难是有太多强大的利益集团表示反对。
ext.ext_en: The trouble with all such proposals is that so many powerful interests are arrayed against them...

ext.ext_cn: 拿破仑计划击溃那两支列队待战的部队，却最终失利。
ext.ext_en: Napoleon ultimately failed in his plan to defeat the two armies arrayed against him.

defs.def_en: If something such as a military force is arrayed against someone, it is ready and able to be used against them.

ext.ext_cn: 萨布丽娜脱下平日穿的工作服，换上了黑色的超短裙和连裤袜。
ext.ext_en: Sabrina has discarded her habitual boilersuit and is arrayed in black mini and tights.

ext.ext_cn: 穿戴华丽的牧师
ext.ext_en: ...gorgeously arrayed priests.

defs.def_en: If someone is arrayed in particular clothes, especially attractive or beautiful ones, they are dressed in those clothes.

ext.ext_cn: 就孩子对艺术的理解和欣赏所作的调查
ext.ext_en: ...an investigation into children's understanding and appreciation of art...

ext.ext_cn: 布赖恩吹口哨以示赞赏。
ext.ext_en: Brian whistled in appreciation.

defs.def_en: Appreciation of something is the recognition and enjoyment of its good qualities.

ext.ext_cn: 他表示很感激沙特阿拉伯推行的被他称作稳健而务实的石油政策。
ext.ext_en: He expressed his appreciation for what he called Saudi Arabia's moderate and realistic oil policies.

ext.ext_cn: 为感谢他们所做的工作而赠与他们的礼物
ext.ext_en: ...the gifts presented to them in appreciation of their work.

defs.def_en: Your appreciation for something that someone does for you is your gratitude for it.

ext.ext_cn: 他们对经济激励的重要性有了更深的理解。
ext.ext_en: They have a stronger appreciation of the importance of economic incentives.

defs.def_en: An appreciation of a situation or problem is an understanding of what it involves.

ext.ext_cn: 你必须将该处房产的资本增值考虑在内。
ext.ext_en: You have to take capital appreciation of the property into account.

defs.def_en: Appreciation in the value of something is an increase in its value over a period of time.

defs.def_cn: （对艺术家、表演者或其作品的）评论，评价

ext.ext_cn: 我为一家杂志社写过一篇评论埃尔南德斯的文章。
ext.ext_en: I had written an appreciation of Hernandez for a magazine.

defs.def_en: An appreciation of an artist or performer or of their work is a speech or piece of writing in which they are discussed and assessed.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 把这些事都留给你去做，我真感到过意不去。
ext.ext_en: I feel so guilty, leaving all this to you...

ext.ext_cn: 她见到我时一脸歉疚。
ext.ext_en: When she saw me she looked guilty.

defs.def_en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you think that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

ext.ext_cn: 许多人或许保守着这个罪恶的秘密。
ext.ext_en: Many may be keeping it a guilty secret...

ext.ext_cn: 我带着一种罪恶的解脱感离开。
ext.ext_en: I leave with a guilty sense of relief.

defs.def_en: Guilty is used of an action or fact that you feel guilty about.  guilty conscience→see: conscience;

ext.ext_cn: 他们被判谋杀罪成立。
ext.ext_en: They were found guilty of murder...

ext.ext_cn: 他承认确实犯有人身伤害罪。
ext.ext_en: He pleaded guilty to causing actual bodily harm.

defs.def_en: If someone is guilty of a crime or offence, they have committed that crime or offence.

ext.ext_cn: 他宣称布鲁克先生犯有“判断失误的重大过错”。
ext.ext_en: He claimed Mr Brooke had been guilty of a 'gross error of judgment'...

ext.ext_cn: 他们将考虑他是否犯有玩忽职守的重大过失。
ext.ext_en: They will consider whether or not he has been guilty of serious professional misconduct.

defs.def_en: If someone is guilty of doing something wrong, they have done that thing.

ext.ext_cn: “你说过你要呆到明天的。”——“我知道，贝尔，但我还是想回去。”
ext.ext_en: 'You said you'd stay till tomorrow.' —  'I know, Bel, but I think I would rather go back.'...

ext.ext_cn: 把炖锅置于中火上加热，直到苹果酒变得很烫，但不要加热到沸腾。
ext.ext_en: Place the saucepan over moderate heat until the cider is very hot but not boiling...

defs.def_en: You use but to introduce something which contrasts with what you have just said, or to introduce something which adds to what you have just said.

ext.ext_cn: 监狱需要招募更多的工作人员。但我想补充一点，很多监狱都是在19世纪建造的。
ext.ext_en: They need to recruit more people into the prison service. But another point I'd like to make is that many prisons were built in the nineteenth century.

defs.def_en: You use but when you are about to add something further in a discussion or to change the subject.

ext.ext_cn: 不好意思，但有些话我必须说。
ext.ext_en: Please excuse me, but there is something I must say...

ext.ext_cn: 对不起，但是这跟你没关系。
ext.ext_en: I'm sorry, but it's nothing to do with you...

defs.def_en: You use but after you have made an excuse or apologized for what you are just about to say.

defs.def_cn: （引出下文，表示惊讶、难以置信、拒绝或抗议）但是，可是

ext.ext_cn: “我觉得我不应该再呆在这所房子里。”——“可是为什么？”
ext.ext_en: 'I don't think I should stay in this house' — 'But why?'...

ext.ext_cn: “有人打电话找你。”——“可没有人知道我在这里啊！”
ext.ext_en: 'Somebody wants you on the telephone' — 'But no one knows I'm here!'

defs.def_en: You use but to introduce a reply to someone when you want to indicate surprise, disbelief, refusal, or protest.

ext.ext_cn: 除了两项赛事之外，欧洲在其余5项赛事中都有代表参加。
ext.ext_en: Europe will be represented in all but two of the seven races...

ext.ext_cn: 他只会说希腊语。
ext.ext_en: He didn't  speak anything but Greek...

defs.def_en: But is used to mean 'except'.

ext.ext_cn: 这只是为让那些酗酒者戒酒所尝试的方法之一。
ext.ext_en: This is but one of the methods used to try and get alcoholics to give up drink.

ext.ext_cn: 只提两位在贵宾房住过的人，就是拿破仑和玛丽·安托瓦妮特。
ext.ext_en: ...Napoleon and Marie Antoinette, to name but two who had stayed in the great state rooms.

defs.def_en: But is used to mean 'only'.

ext.ext_cn: “但——但——但是”，我结结巴巴地说道。——“别跟我讲那些‘但是’了。”她咆哮道。
ext.ext_en: 'B-b-b-b-but' I stuttered. — 'Never mind the buts,' she ranted...

ext.ext_cn: 他犯了罪，这是无可争辩的。
ext.ext_en: He committed a crime, no ifs or buts about it.

defs.def_en: You use buts in expressions like 'no buts' and 'ifs and buts' to refer to reasons someone gives for not doing something, especially when you do not think that they are good reasons.

ext.ext_cn: 手枪放在我抬眼就能看见的地方。
ext.ext_en: The pistol was positioned where I couldn't help but see it...

ext.ext_cn: 她只能祝贺他。
ext.ext_en: She could not but congratulate him.

defs.def_en: You use cannot but ,could not but, and cannot help but when you want to emphasize that you believe something must be true and that there is no possibility of anything else being the case.

ext.ext_cn: 下面的小广场空空荡荡,只有一辆送货车和几棵棕榈树
ext.ext_en: ...the small square below, empty but for a delivery van and a clump of palm trees...

ext.ext_cn: 要不是你，我们可能已经被他们甩掉了。
ext.ext_en: But for you, they might have given us the slip.

defs.def_en: You use but for to introduce the only factor that causes a particular thing not to happen or not to be completely true.

defs.def_cn: （表示与前面说过的话略有矛盾）不过，然而

ext.ext_cn: 我丈夫常占用浴室好几个小时，不过我也是这样。
ext.ext_en: My husband spends hours in the bathroom, but then again so do I.

defs.def_en: You use but then or but then again before a remark which slightly contradicts what you have just said.

defs.def_cn: （表示前述事情并不奇怪）不过，但是

ext.ext_cn: 他年轻有为，不过他父亲也曾经是。
ext.ext_en: He was a fine young man, but then so had his father been...

ext.ext_cn: 索尼娅的英语也许说得不好，但谁又说得好呢？
ext.ext_en: Sonia might not speak the English language well, but then who did?

defs.def_en: You use but then before a remark which suggests that what you have just said should not be regarded as surprising.
A higher-up is an important person who has a lot of authority and influence.
Your super-ego is the part of your mind which makes you aware of what is right and wrong, and which causes you to feel guilty when you have done something wrong.

ext.ext_cn: 政府打算推进其改革计划。
ext.ext_en: The government intends to push ahead with its reform programme.

defs.def_en: If you push ahead or push forward with something, you make progress with it.
Serotonin is a chemical produced naturally in your brain that affects the way you feel, for example making you feel happier, calmer, or less hungry.

ext.ext_cn: “这事你休想就这么过去，”他以出人意料的强横语气说道。
ext.ext_en: 'You won't  get away with this,' he said with unexpected bravado.

defs.def_en: Bravado is an appearance of courage or confidence that someone shows in order to impress other people.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 她有点想家。
ext.ext_en: She's feeling a little homesick.

defs.def_en: If you are homesick, you feel unhappy because you are away from home and are missing your family, friends, and home very much.

ext.ext_cn: 甘利说他没有看见诈骗泛滥的证据。
ext.ext_en: Ganley said he'd seen no evidence of widespread fraud...

ext.ext_cn: 有很多证据证明压力是造成疾病的原因之一。
ext.ext_en: There is a lot of evidence that stress is partly responsible for disease...

defs.def_en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

ext.ext_cn: 对他不利的这项证据完全是间接证据。
ext.ext_en: The evidence against him was purely circumstantial.

ext.ext_cn: 足以胜诉的证据
ext.ext_en: ...enough evidence for a successful prosecution.

defs.def_en: Evidence is the information which is used in a court of law to try to prove something. Evidence is obtained from documents, objects, or witnesses.

ext.ext_cn: 进行最初化验的法医学家将被传唤到庭作证。
ext.ext_en: The forensic scientists who carried out the original tests will be called to give evidence...

ext.ext_cn: 机舱人员一直在为M1空难调查作证。
ext.ext_en: Cabin crew have been giving evidence at the M1 aircrash enquiry.

defs.def_en: If you give evidence in a court of law or an official enquiry, you officially say what you know about people or events, or describe an occasion at which you were present.

ext.ext_cn: 他在其他方面同样明智，这一点可以从他不打网球改打高尔夫的理由中得到证明。
ext.ext_en: He's wise in other ways too, as evidenced by his reason for switching from tennis to golf...

ext.ext_cn: 她没什么心计，而且能感觉出她对钱没什么兴趣。
ext.ext_en: She was not calculating and evidenced no specific interest in money.

defs.def_en: If a particular feeling, ability, or attitude is evidenced by something or someone, it is seen or felt.

ext.ext_cn: 没看见几个士兵。
ext.ext_en: Few soldiers were in evidence...

ext.ext_cn: 贫困和糟糕的住房条件仍很常见。
ext.ext_en: Poverty and bad housing conditions are still very much in evidence.

defs.def_en: If someone or something is in evidence, they are present and can be clearly seen.

defs.def_cn: （美国南部、尤指路易斯安那州的）牛轭湖，长沼
defs.def_en: A bayou is a slow-moving, marshy area of water in the southern United States, especially Louisiana.

ext.ext_cn: 扣人心弦的心理惊悚片
ext.ext_en: ...a tense psychological thriller.

defs.def_en: A thriller is a book, film, or play that tells an exciting fictional story about something such as criminal activities or spying.

defs.def_cn: 信徒;门徒;追随者;崇奉者

ext.ext_cn: 弗洛伊德的门徒
ext.ext_en: ...a disciple of Freud.

ext.ext_cn: 耶稣的门徒之一
ext.ext_en: ...one of the disciples of Christ.

defs.def_en: If you are someone's disciple, you are influenced by their teachings and try to follow their example.

ext.ext_cn: 木头刻成的人手
ext.ext_en: ...a wood carving of a human hand.

defs.def_en: A carving is an object or a design that has been cut out of a material such as stone or wood.

ext.ext_cn: 我发觉刻木雕过瘾，画油画好玩。
ext.ext_en: I found wood carving satisfying and painting fun.

defs.def_en: Carving is the art of carving objects, or of carving designs or writing on objects.
A pit bull terrier or a pit bull is a very fierce kind of dog. Some people train pit bull terriers to fight other dogs.

defs.def_cn: 有作为的；有希望的；有前途的

ext.ext_cn: 他愿与冉冉升起的年轻新星分享聚光灯
ext.ext_en: ...his readiness to share the limelight with young, up-and-coming stars...

ext.ext_cn: 赫福德先生是一名很有前途的球员。
ext.ext_en: Mr Hurford is an up-and-coming player.

defs.def_en: Up-and-coming people are likely to be successful in the future.

defs.def_cn: (股票、外汇或商品）经纪人，代理商
defs.def_en: A broker is a person whose job is to buy and sell shares, foreign money, or goods for other people.

defs.def_cn: （国家或政府作为中间人）协调，安排

ext.ext_en: The United Nations brokered a peace in Mogadishu at the end of March.

defs.def_en: If a country or government brokers an agreement, a ceasefire, or a round of talks, they try to negotiate or arrange it.

ext.ext_cn: 她的私生活与公众形象之间的巨大反差
ext.ext_en: ...the contradictions between her private life and the public persona...

ext.ext_cn: 在我看来，这次的表现是不可宽恕的，和奥运精神完全相悖。
ext.ext_en: The performance seemed to me unpardonable, a contradiction of all that the Olympics is supposed to be...

defs.def_en: If you describe an aspect of a situation as a contradiction, you mean that it is completely different from other aspects, and so makes the situation confused or difficult to understand.

ext.ext_cn: 以营利为目的的公共服务机构——这是典型的用词上的自相矛盾（如果真有这种说法的话）。
ext.ext_en: A public service run for profit — a contradiction in terms if there ever was one.

defs.def_en: If you say that something is a contradiction in terms, you mean that it is described as having a quality that it cannot have.

ext.ext_cn: 港区在其最繁荣的时期曾是主要的工商业活动中心。
ext.ext_en: Docklands in its heyday was a major centre of industrial and commercial activity...

ext.ext_cn: 据报道，警察、车辆和商业经营场所均遭到袭击。
ext.ext_en: Attacks were reported on police, vehicles and commercial premises.

defs.def_en: Commercial means involving or relating to the buying and selling of goods.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (组织、活动)营利的，商业化的，偏重利润的

ext.ext_cn: 过去10年来，英国铁路确实变得更加商业化了。
ext.ext_en: British Rail has indeed become more commercial over the past decade...

ext.ext_cn: 对森林的商业开发所带来的影响让智利的自然资源保护者们感到忧心忡忡。
ext.ext_en: Conservationists in Chile are concerned over the effect of commercial exploitation of forests...

defs.def_en: Commercial organizations and activities are concerned with making money or profits, rather than, for example, with scientific research or providing a public service.

defs.def_cn: (产品)商品化的，供市场出售的

ext.ext_cn: 在军工产品和民用产品的制造方面，他们都处于领先地位。
ext.ext_en: They are the leading manufacturer in both defence and commercial products.

defs.def_en: A commercial product is made to be sold to the public.

ext.ext_cn: 法律规定商用车辆、长途汽车和卡车要安装转速计。
ext.ext_en: Commercial vehicles, coaches and lorries are required by law to be fitted with tachographs.

ext.ext_cn: 商用客船最快的一次横渡大西洋
ext.ext_en: ...the fastest crossing of the Atlantic by a commercial passenger vessel.

defs.def_en: A commercial vehicle is a vehicle used for carrying goods, or passengers who pay.

defs.def_cn: (电视、广播)靠广告收入维持的，商业性的

ext.ext_cn: 国内首家商业广播电台——经典调频
ext.ext_en: ...Classic FM, the first national commercial radio station.

defs.def_en: Commercial television and radio are paid for by the broadcasting of advertisements, rather than by the government.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词
defs.def_cn: (电影或音乐)商业化的，迎合大众口味的

ext.ext_cn: 很多人都觉得音乐变得过于商业化了。
ext.ext_en: There's a feeling among a lot of people that music has become too commercial.

defs.def_en: Commercial is used to describe something such as a film or a type of music that it is intended to be popular with the public, and is not very original or of high quality.

ext.ext_cn: 政府通过电视广告和传单的形式发起了宣传活动。
ext.ext_en: The government has launched a campaign of television commercials and leaflets.

defs.def_en: A commercial is an advertisement that is broadcast on television or radio.
The tenth item in a series is the one that you count as number ten.

ext.ext_cn: 整个 6 月，我们这里的降水量只有0.2英寸。
ext.ext_en: We received only two tenths of an inch of rain during the entire month of June.

defs.def_en: A tenth is one of ten equal parts of something.

ext.ext_cn: 一个无论从字面还是比喻意义上来说都将改变你的路线的事件
ext.ext_en: ...an event that will change your route — in both the literal and figurative sense.

defs.def_en: If you use a word or expression in a figurative sense, you use it with a more abstract or imaginative meaning than its ordinary literal one.

ext.ext_cn: 他的职业生涯延续了大约50年，作品既有抽象画也有写实画。
ext.ext_en: His career spanned some 50 years and encompassed both abstract and figurative painting.

defs.def_en: Figurative art is a style of art in which people and things are shown in a realistic way.

ext.ext_cn: 有那么一会儿,凯瑟琳很想逃跑。
ext.ext_en: For an instant, Catherine was tempted to flee...

ext.ext_cn: 疼痛立刻就消失了。
ext.ext_en: The pain disappeared in an instant.

defs.def_en: An instant is an extremely short period of time.

ext.ext_cn: 就在那时,博物馆陷入了一片漆黑。
ext.ext_en: At that instant the museum was plunged into total darkness...

ext.ext_cn: 与此同时,他猛地推开了车门。
ext.ext_en: In the same instant he flung open the car door.

defs.def_en: If you say that something happens at a particular instant, you mean that it happens at exactly the time you have been referring to, and you are usually suggesting that it happens quickly or immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 我一看到蝙蝠就把门闩上了。
ext.ext_en: I had bolted the door the instant I had seen the bat.

defs.def_en: To do something the instant something else happens means to do it immediately.

ext.ext_cn: 波特先生的书一经推出便大受欢迎。
ext.ext_en: Mr Porter's book was an instant hit...

ext.ext_cn: 他一到莫特莱克就觉得不喜欢这个地方。
ext.ext_en: He had taken an instant dislike to Mortlake.

defs.def_en: You use instant to describe something that happens immediately.

defs.def_cn: (食品)已配制好的，调制快速方便的，速溶的

ext.ext_cn: 速溶咖啡
ext.ext_en: ...instant coffee.

defs.def_en: Instant food is food that you can prepare very quickly, for example by just adding water.

ext.ext_cn: 缪特先生拒绝在没有其律师同事陪同的情况下和他们说话，于是警察们就离开了。
ext.ext_en: Mr Muite refused to talk to them except in the company of his legal colleagues, whereupon the police officers departed...

ext.ext_cn: “那好吧，继续吧，”多布森说，于是戴维斯开始解释。
ext.ext_en: 'Well, get on with it then,' said Dobson, whereupon Davies started to explain.

defs.def_en: You use whereupon to say that one thing happens immediately after another thing, and usually as a result of it.

ext.ext_cn: 肝坏死
ext.ext_en: ...liver necrosis.

defs.def_en: Necrosis is the death of part of someone's body, for example because it is not getting enough blood.

ext.ext_cn: 如果你常常因为沮丧而暴饮暴食，首先应该设法找到悲伤的原因。
ext.ext_en: If you tend to overeat because of depression, first take steps to recognize the source of your sadness.

ext.ext_cn: 辛辣食品吃得过多的人
ext.ext_en: ...people who overeat spicy foods.

defs.def_en: If you say that someone overeats, you mean they eat more than they need to or more than is healthy.

defs.def_cn: （英国下院的）后座（或普通）议员席；（亦总称）后座（或普通）议员

ext.ext_cn: 这一问题引发了后座议员的不满。
ext.ext_en: This issue is creating unrest on the backbenches.

defs.def_en: The backbenches are the seats in the British House of Commons where backbenchers sit. The Members of Parliament who sit on the backbenches are also referred to as the backbenches.

ext.ext_cn: 这个器具被用来为母牛实施人工授精。
ext.ext_en: The gadget is used to artificially inseminate cows.

defs.def_en: To inseminate a woman or female animal means to put a male's sperm into her in order to make her pregnant.

defs.def_cn: 笨蛋；卑鄙之人;卑微之人
defs.def_en: If someone calls a man a wanker, they do not like him and they think he is very stupid or unpleasant.

defs.def_cn: 防水胶靴;长筒橡胶雨靴
defs.def_en: Wellingtons or wellington boots are long rubber boots which you wear to keep your feet dry.

ext.ext_cn: 他认识他老婆的时候他还是个油漆工，而她是个女招待。
ext.ext_en: He had met his old lady when he was a house painter and she was a waitress.

defs.def_en: Some men refer to their wife, girlfriend, or mother as their old lady .

ext.ext_cn: 持枪歹徒坐上一辆由同伙驾驶的摩托车逃逸。
ext.ext_en: The gunman escaped on a motorcycle being ridden by an accomplice.

ext.ext_cn: 经过警方的一番飞车追逐，他的同伙遭到逮捕。
ext.ext_en: His accomplice was arrested after a high-speed police chase.

defs.def_en: Someone's accomplice is a person who helps them to commit a crime.

defs.def_cn: 浮码头；（常指架设浮桥用的）浮舟

ext.ext_cn: 浮桥
ext.ext_en: ...a pontoon bridge.

defs.def_en: A pontoon is a floating platform, often one used to support a bridge.

defs.def_cn: (其他方法行不通时)转而做，转而使用，转而依靠

ext.ext_cn: 由于在条理上说不过他，她便转而重施故技，抓住他的演讲不放。
ext.ext_en: Unable to defeat him by logical discussion, she fell back on her old habit of criticizing his speech...

ext.ext_cn: 必要时，最保险的办法就是凭直觉判断。
ext.ext_en: When necessary, instinct is the most reliable resource you can fall back on.

defs.def_en: If you fall back on something, you do it or use it after other things have failed.

ext.ext_cn: 法官的结论明摆着是错的。
ext.ext_en: The judge's conclusion was plainly wrong...

ext.ext_cn: 显而易见，必须采用更为客观的描述方法。
ext.ext_en: Plainly, a more objective method of description must be adopted...

defs.def_en: You use plainly to indicate that you believe something is obviously true, often when you are trying to convince someone else that it is true.

ext.ext_cn: 他明显是生气了。
ext.ext_en: He was plainly annoyed...

ext.ext_cn: 我能清楚地看到他左右摇晃着脑袋。
ext.ext_en: I could plainly see him turning his head to the right and left...

defs.def_en: You use plainly to indicate that something is easily seen, noticed, or recognized.

ext.ext_cn: 马克非常直率而严肃地说：“你是个懦夫。”
ext.ext_en: 'You're a coward,' Mark said very plainly and soberly...

ext.ext_cn: 我们的政治领导人没有几个愿意开诚布公地谈论国家所面对的紧急情况。
ext.ext_en: Few of our political leaders are willing to talk plainly and honestly about the emergency facing the country.

defs.def_en: See also:plain;If you say something plainly, you say it in a direct and honest way, without trying to hide the facts.

defs.def_cn: 大肆杀戮者;屠杀案凶手
defs.def_en: A mass murderer is someone who deliberately kills a large number of people illegally.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: It was quite rough at times, and she was seasick.

defs.def_en: If someone is seasick when they are travelling in a boat, they vomit or feel sick because of the way the boat is moving.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: When the fruit is mushy and cooked, remove from the heat.

defs.def_en: Vegetables and fruit that are mushy are soft and have lost most of their shape.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 不要变得过于多愁善感。
ext.ext_en: Don't go getting all mushy and sentimental.

defs.def_en: If you describe someone or something as mushy, you mean that they are very sentimental.

ext.ext_cn: 这些主张几乎找不到科学依据来证实。

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_cn: 闪着灯、鸣着笛、飞速行驶的车辆
ext.ext_en: ...fast cars with flashing lights and sirens...

ext.ext_cn: 众所周知，布林德利是个喜欢飞车的人。
ext.ext_en: Brindley was known as a very, very fast driver...

defs.def_en: Fast means happening, moving, or doing something at great speed. You also use fast in questions or statements about speed.

ext.ext_cn: 当你遇到这样的危急情况，就需要专业救援了——要快！
ext.ext_en: When you've got a crisis like this you need professional help — fast!...

ext.ext_cn: 如果您能尽快离开，我们将不胜感激。
ext.ext_en: We'd appreciate your leaving as fast as possible.

defs.def_en: You use fast to say that something happens without any delay.

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: That clock's an hour fast.

defs.def_en: If a watch or clock is fast, it is showing a time that is later than the real time.

ext.ext_cn: 她紧紧地抓着栏杆，小心翼翼地爬楼梯。
ext.ext_en: She climbed the staircase cautiously, holding fast to the rail...

ext.ext_cn: 油轮紧卡在礁石中间动弹不得。
ext.ext_en: The tanker is stuck fast on the rocks.

defs.def_en: If you hold something fast, you hold it tightly and firmly. If something is stuck fast, it is stuck very firmly and cannot move.

ext.ext_cn: 我们只能努力坚守那些古老的价值观：诚实、正派、关心他人。
ext.ext_en: We can only try to hold fast to the age-old values of honesty, decency and concern for others...

ext.ext_cn: 他叫支持者在接下来的几个重要日子里站稳立场。

defs.pos_cn: 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词

ext.ext_en: Tour prices are being discounted as much as 33%.

defs.def_en: If you plaster a surface or a place with posters or pictures, you stick a lot of them all over it.

ext.ext_en: She plastered herself from head to toe in high factor sun lotion.

defs.def_en: If you plaster yourself in some kind of sticky substance, you cover yourself in it.

defs.def_cn: 打着石膏；上着筒形石膏夹
defs.def_en: If you have a leg or arm in plaster, you have a cover made of plaster of Paris around your leg or arm, in order to protect a broken bone and allow it to mend.

defs.def_en: If something snaps or if you snap it, it breaks suddenly, usually with a sharp cracking noise.

ext.ext_en: He snapped the notebook shut...

ext.ext_en: He snapped the cap on his ballpoint...

defs.def_en: If you snap something into a particular position, or if it snaps into that position, it moves quickly into that position, with a sharp sound.

ext.ext_en: She had millions of listeners snapping their fingers to her first single...

ext.ext_en: He snapped his fingers, and Wilson produced a sheet of paper...

defs.def_en: If you snap your fingers, you make a sharp sound by moving your middle finger quickly across your thumb, for example in order to accompany music or to order someone to do something.

defs.def_cn: 恶声恶气地说;声色俱厉地说

defs.def_en: If you snap someone or something, you take a photograph of them.
